zh: 虽然美国债务相对GDP比率在过去十年增加了一倍，奥巴马政府和国会却刻意无视这一问题，相反着眼于2012年以来年度赤字额的逐步下降和赤字相对GDP比率的相对稳定。
en: Although the US debt-to-GDP ratio doubled in the past decade, the Obama administration and Congress ignored the problem, focusing instead on the annual deficit’s decline since 2012 and the relative stability of the deficit as a share of GDP.

zh: 但这个短期成绩其实源自于经济复苏以及美国国会对国防和非国防可自由支配开支项目的限制决议。
en: That temporary progress reflected the economic recovery and congressional votes to limit spending on defense and nondefense discretionary programs.

zh: 但年度赤字的长期性上涨 — — 由于人口老龄化、医疗技术不断提升和利率上升 — — 以及因此导致的债务相对GDP比率上升是无可避免的（国会预算办公室和其他机构对此已有明确预测 ） 。
en: But the longer-term rise in the annual deficits – owing to an aging population, changing medical technology, and rising interest rates – and the resulting increase in the debt-to-GDP ratio were inevitable (and were clearly predicted by the CBO and others).

zh: 大量有资格领取社会保障福利的美国老年人将在未来30年使得社会保障计划支出相对GDP的比例从当前的4.9％上升至6.3 ％ 。
en: The larger number of older Americans who are eligible for Social Security benefits will drive the program’s costs from 4.9% of GDP this year to 6.3% of GDP over the next 30 years.

zh: 各项主要联邦医疗保健计划的成本从现在相对GDP5.5％上涨至2046年的8.9 ％ ， 一半归因于受益人寿命和人数的双双提升，另一半归因于为治疗他们而产生的额外医疗技术费用。
en: Half of the rise in the cost of the major federal health-care programs, from 5.5% of GDP now to 8.9% in 2046, will result from the increased number of older beneficiaries, with the other half caused by the technologically-driven extra cost of treating them.

zh: 尽管债务总额增加，但美联储的非常规货币政策依然拉低了联邦债务净利息的成本，使之仅相当于GDP的1.4 ％ 。
en: The Federal Reserve’s unconventional monetary policy has driven down the cost of the net interest on the federal debt to just 1.4% of GDP, despite the increase in the volume of the debt.

zh: 但随着利率正常化和债务量的增长，维持国家债务利息的成本预计将增加至相当于GDP的5.8 ％ 。
en: But as interest rates normalize and the volume of debt grows, the cost of servicing the interest on the national debt is projected to increase to 5.8% of GDP.

zh: 如果赤字和债务预测的其余部分都被证明是正确的，预计利息成本可能远小于实际成本。
en: That projected interest cost may be much less than it would actually be if the rest of the deficit and debt forecast turns out to be correct.

zh: 随着联邦债务相对GDP比例达到141 ％ ， 相当于GDP5.8％的利息成本意味着只有4％的平均名义利率，鉴于国会预算办公室的通胀预测，实际利率大约是2 % — —与债务与GDP比率少于40%时的历史利率相当。
en: With a federal debt of 141% of GDP, that 5.8%-of-GDP interest cost implies an average nominal interest rate of just 4% and, given the CBO’s inflation forecast, a real interest rate of about 2% – similar to historic rates when the debt ratio was less than 40% of GDP.

zh: 但美国国债投资者可能会要求高得多的利率来作为提高自身投资组合中国债比例的回报。
en: But investors in Treasury bonds might demand a much higher interest rate in exchange for loading up their portfolios with US debt.

zh: 在这种情况下，利息成本和债务会大得多。
en: In that case, the interest cost and the debt would be much greater.

zh: 超过一半的美国公开发行国债都由外国投资者持有的事实可能使利率对债务规模的变化更为敏感。
en: The fact that more than half of the publicly held US government debt is now owned by foreign investors might make the interest rate even more sensitive to the debt’s relative size.

zh: 外国投资者可能会担心政府会采取一些减少他们实际持有价值的政策。
en: Foreign investors might fear that the government could adopt policies that reduced the real value of their holdings.

zh: 尽管美国政府绝不会明目张胆地违约，但它可以采取的政策（如对利息扣除所得税）去这样做，这将对外国持有者不利并压低债券的价值。
en: While the US government would never explicitly default, it could adopt policies such as deducting income tax on interest payments, which would disadvantage foreign holders and depress the value of the bonds.

zh: 此外，外国投资者可能担心过高的债务水平可能会导致通胀性货币政策，这将导致美元贬值并降低债券的实际价值。
en: Moreover, foreign investors might fear that very high debt levels could lead to inflationary monetary policy, which would depreciate the value of the dollar and lower the real value of their bonds.

zh: 以下是美国国会预算办公室的预测为何会令人惊讶不安的原因。
en: Here is an amazing and disturbing implication of the CBO’s forecast.

zh: 到2046年，那些“强制性”福利项目的预计支出（社会保障和主要健康计划 ） ， 再加上债务利息，将高出政府当前税收水平下的收入。
en: By 2046, the projected outlays for the “mandatory” entitlement programs (Social Security and the major health programs), plus interest on the debt, would absorb more than all of the revenue that the government would collect with current tax rates.

zh: 就算把国防等每年拨付“自由裁量”项目支出都节省下来，也会出现一个小规模的赤字（相当于GDP的1.6 ％ ） 。
en: A small deficit (1.6% of GDP) would emerge even before spending on defense and other annually appropriated “discretionary” programs.

zh: 我们是无法借助减缓国防和其他自由裁量项目的增长来抵消强制性项目支出增长的。
en: There is no way to offset the growth of the mandatory programs by slowing the growth of defense and other discretionary outlays.

zh: 总的国防开支仅相当于目前国内生产总值的3.2 ％ ， 并预计在未来十年内下降至2.6％并在之后20年内保持在相同水平。
en: Total defense spending is now just 3.2% of GDP and is expected to decline to 2.6% over the next ten years and to remain at that level for the next 20 years.

zh: 这将是自二战前以来国防支出相对GDP比例最低的水平。
en: That would be the lowest defense share of GDP since before World War II.

zh: 预计所有非国防自由裁量项目也会同步减少，也创下了相对GDP比率的最低记录。
en: The same reduction is projected for all non-defense discretionary programs, also a record-low share of GDP.

zh: 这种惨淡景象的亮点在于它不需要过多通过削减年度赤字以防止负债率的上升，甚至还能让后者倒退到十年前的水平。
en: The bright spot in this bleak picture is that it would not take much in terms of annual deficit reductions to prevent the rise in the debt ratio, or even to bring it back to where it was a decade ago.

zh: 如果能在2017年开始利用减少支出和提高收入的任意组合政策使得赤字占GDP的比例下降1.7 ％ ， 就可以避免在当前75％的债务相对GDP水平上有所增长。
en: Reducing the annual deficit by 1.7% of GDP by any combination of reduced spending and higher revenue would, if begun in 2017, prevent an increase from the current 75% debt-to-GDP ratio.

zh: 同时每年减少3%赤字将扭转债务发展的轨迹，并将其带回到��济衰退之前那几十年的状态。
en: And reducing the deficit by 3% a year would reverse the debt trajectory and bring it back to where it was in the decades before the recession.

zh: 至今没有一个总统候选人发布过扭转国家债务上升预期的计划或意愿。
en: Neither of the presidential candidates has indicated either a plan or an inclination to reverse the projected rise in the national debt.

zh: 但这应该是白宫主人明年施政的重中之重。
en: But it should be a top priority for whoever moves into the White House next year.

zh: 我们没有任何借口去拖延等待，只能迅速采取行动，避免最坏情况的降临。
en: Given the need to act quickly to avoid the worst-case scenario, there is no excuse for waiting.

zh: 美国的反环境保护主义者
en: America’s Anti-Environmentalists

zh: 作为美国人，我对我们国家在处理全球气候变暖问题上缺乏领导作用感到惊讶、羞愧以及尴尬。
en: As an American, I am appalled, ashamed, and embarrassed by my country’s lack of leadership in dealing with global warming.

zh: 有关气候变暖风险的科学证据与日俱增。 最近，英国权威的斯特恩报告也作出了记载。
en: Scientific evidence on the risks mounts by the day, as most recently documented in England’s magisterial Stern Report.

zh: 但是，尽管在所有的全球人造碳排放中美国占大约25 ％ ， 美国人对改变他们的消费没有表现出什么意愿或倾向。
en: Yet, despite the fact that the United States accounts for roughly 25% of all man-made global carbon emissions, Americans show little will or inclination to temper their manic consumption.

zh: 尽管出于错误的理由，布什当局在第一个任期拒绝签署所谓的“京都议定书”大概还是正确的。
en: The first George W. Bush administration was probably right to refuse to sign the so-called “Kyoto Protocol,” albeit for the wrong reasons.

zh: 京都议定书问题重重，其中之一是向发展中国家重新分配碳排放权利做得并不够。
en: Among other problems, the Kyoto Protocol does not go far enough towards redistributing carbon emission rights towards developing countries.

zh: 但是，为何美国就不能对汽油以及类似煤炭发电厂等其他碳排放源增税呢？
en: But why can’t the US bring itself to raise taxes on gasoline and other sources of carbon emission like coal burning power plants?

zh: 尽管经济处于繁荣增长，但是美国政府还是赤字累累。 好像美国并非不需要这些钱。
en: It is not like the US government, running a huge deficit despite an economic boom, does not need the money.

zh: 许多人认为布什是问题所在。
en: Many people seem to think that the Bush administration is the problem.

zh: 让一个德克萨斯州的石油商人和及其好友们执掌大权，你能指望什么呢？ 难道是环境保护妈？
en: Put a Texas oilman and his buddies in charge and what do you expect, conservation?

zh: 不幸的是，那是一个浅显的借口。
en: Unfortunately, that is a facile excuse.

zh: 美国公民抵制为了全球环境而减少能源消费是更为根深蒂固的。
en: American citizens’ resistance to moderating energy consumption for the sake of the global environment is much more deeply embedded.

zh: 例如，美国前副总统戈尔制作的有关全球气候变暖的电影纪录片<<来之不易的真相>>对于化石燃料消费将人类推向灾难边缘进行了深刻的刨析因而赢得赞誉。
en: Consider former US Vice President Al Gore, for example, whose documentary film on global warming, An Inconvenient Truth, is celebrated for its unflinching look at how fossil fuel consumption is leading mankind to the brink of catastrophe.

zh: 全球气候变暖的证据比戈尔的电影所描述的远远要模糊，但是基本问题确实真实的。
en: The evidence on global warming is considerably more muddled than Gore’s film suggests, but the basic problem is real.

zh: 但是不幸的是，戈尔在从政期间却并未成功地高举气候变暖的火炬。
en: Unfortunately, however, Gore was not successful in carrying the torch on global warming when he was a politician.

zh: 对于克林顿和戈尔当局在九十年代采取任何果敢的步骤大幅度减少碳的排放，人们并无法恭维。
en: One cannot commend the 1990’s Clinton-Gore administration for taking any brave steps aimed at radically reducing carbon emissions.

zh: 怪不得美国公众强烈抵制任何确实迫使他们改变其大肆耗费石油的生活方式的东西。
en: Small wonder: the American public is fiercely resistant to anything that seriously forces them to compromise on their energy-burning, gas-guzzling lifestyle.

zh: 在这一点上，并非只有政客们没有予以提供领导。
en: It is not just politicians who have failed to provide leadership here.

zh: 受人尊重的纽约时报编辑版面直到最近还一直明显反对任何能源税，最后才支持这一提议。
en: The venerable New York Times editorial page was apparently opposed to an energy tax until only recently, when the newspaper finally endorsed the idea.

zh: 像许多自由派人士一样，该报的编辑担心更高的能源税将使穷人过多地更为不利。
en: Like many liberals, the Times’ editors worried that higher energy taxes would fall disproportionately on the poor.

zh: 人们听到的典型的争辩是这样的：一个开着耗油的1980年雪佛兰破车的穷人没有别的途径上班，你让他怎么办？
en: The typical argument one hears is, “What about the poor guy with the gas-guzzling 1980 Chevy car, who has no other way to get to work?”

zh: 这确实是有效的论点，但是，正如斯特恩报告所指出的那样，如果海平面开始上升，许多我们的孩子们就会在某一天游泳上班了。
en: It is a legitimate point, but if ocean levels start rising, as the Stern Report predicts, a lot of our children will be swimming to work some day.

zh: 需要采取纠正性的措施来减少贫困并不是对全球变暖无动于衷的借口。
en: The need for corrective measures to alleviate inequality is no excuse for inaction on global warming.

zh: 不幸的是，纽约时报改变立场并不昭示美国选民立场的改变。
en: The change of position by the Times, unfortunately, does not herald an about-face in the American electorate.

zh: 如果对任何一个美国2008年总统大选可能的候选人提出能源税的问题，他们就会变色。
en: Mention the idea of an energy tax to any potential 2008 US Presidential candidate, and their faces will pale.

zh: 宣称你关心环境问题或者像布什那样说神奇的技术将会在没有很大痛苦的情况下解决问题是无关痛痒的。
en: It is fine to say that you care about the environment or to claim, as Bush seems to do, that miracle technologies will solve the problem without too much pain.

zh: 但是，任何敢于谈论为了将来更为安全的环境而现在作出牺牲的2008年总统候选人肯定冒很大的风险。
en: But any 2008 Presidential candidate that dares to talk about making sacrifices now for a safer environment later will really be sticking his neck out.

zh: 在美国人开始解决由他们比其他人所造成更多的全球环境问题之前，很难从世界其他地方得到全心全意的支持。
en: Until Americans suck it up and start fixing global environmental problems that they, more than anyone, have caused, it will be difficult to get the wholehearted support of the rest of the world.

zh: 发展中国家问道，如果富国不愿意大幅度限制它们自身的排放，为什么它们就应该关注全球气候变暖问题呢？
en: Developing countries ask why they should pay attention to global warming if rich countries are not prepared to curtail their own emissions sharply?

zh: 如果富国如此肆意挥霍，为何穷国就应该担心森林退化造成全球变暖的问题呢？
en: Why should poor countries worry about how deforestation contributes to global warming when rich countries remain so profligate?

zh: 科学证据表明，世界任何地方的碳排放对于全球变暖具有大致相同的影响。
en: The scientific evidence suggests that carbon emissions from anywhere in the world have about the same impact on global warming.

zh: 出于这一原因，许多经济学家赞同一项统一（协调）的全球税收来对世界上所有地方、所有来源的碳排放平等征税，无论来源是煤炭、石油或者天然气，无论消费者还是商家所排放。
en: For this reason, a wide range of economists favor a uniform (“harmonized”) global tax that would tax carbon emissions equally everywhere in the world, and from whatever source – whether coal, oil, or gas, and whether consumers or businesses.

zh: 这样的税收是最为灵活、也是亲市场的途径，而且对经济增长的影响最小。
en: Such a tax is the most flexible and market-friendly approach, and would have the least impact on economic growth.

zh: 相反，由欧洲所倾向并且体现在京都议定书中的复杂的配额制度有可能导致更大规模的低效率和成本。
en: Instead, the complex system of quotas favored by the Europeans and embodied in the Kyoto Protocol is likely to lead to much larger inefficiencies and costs.

zh: 出于这一理由，英国的斯特恩报告中有关减少碳排放的折中途径将每年只花费1％的收入的估计未免过于乐观。
en: For this reason, England’s Stern Report is probably far too optimistic when it calculates that an eclectic approach to reducing carbon emissions will cost the world only 1% per year of income.

zh: 但是斯特恩报告主张继续无动于衷潜在的风险远远更为巨大则是正确的。
en: But the Stern Report is still right to argue that the potential risks of continued inaction are far greater.

zh: 某一天，美国不愿意在环境问题上发挥领导作用将会被认为是国家最为深重的政治失策。
en: America’s unwillingness to take the lead on environmental issues may some day be regarded as one of the country’s most profound political failures.

zh: 人们希望在我们所有人被迫穿游泳衣上班之前美国马上改弦更张。
en: One hopes that it changes course soon, before we all are forced to wear swimsuits to work.

zh: 诋毁中国行动的新低点
en: A New Low for China Bashing

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 随着美国的大选季节接近尾声，与选举有关的辩论似乎也变得精神错乱起来。
en: NEW HAVEN – As America’s election season nears its finish, the debate seems to have come unhinged.

zh: 对此没有比对中国的迷恋更能证明这一点的地方了 — — 现任总统奥巴马及其共和党挑战者米特·罗姆尼（Mitt Romney）都将中国单独提出来并称之为美国工人及其家庭所受压力的主要来源。
en: Nowhere is that more evident than in the fixation on China – singled out by both President Barack Obama and his Republican challenger, Mitt Romney, as a major source of pressure bearing down on American workers and their families.

zh: 两人都在大选辩论中强调：只要对中国强硬，美国人的痛苦自会有所减轻。
en: Get tough with China, both stressed in the presidential debates, and the pain will ease.

zh: 没有事情是能偏离真相的，请思考下面的这些指控：
en: Nothing could be further from the truth. Consider the following charges:

zh: 货币操纵。
en: Currency manipulation.

zh: 自从中国在2005年7月实施汇率调控机制改革以来，人民币兑美国升值了32 % ， 并在去除通胀因素后对一揽子货币升值了约30 % 。
en: Since China reformed its exchange-rate regime in July 2005, the renminbi has risen 32% relative to the dollar and about 30% in inflation-adjusted terms against a broad basket of currencies.

zh: 这并不是一个微不足道的数目，而且预计未来数年人民币汇率还将继续上升。
en: These are hardly trivial amounts, and more renminbi appreciation can be expected in the years to come.

zh: 跟1985年在西方压力下被迫进行日元大幅升值 （ “ 广场协议 ” ） 的日本不同，中国人选择更为渐进而谨慎地行事。
en: Unlike Japan, which was pressured by the West into a large yen revaluation in 1985 (the “Plaza Accord”), the Chinese have opted to move gradually and deliberately.

zh: 美国官员们把这个视为“操纵 ” ， 认为市场的力量本应使人民币实现比当前更大幅度的升值。
en: American officials call this “manipulation,” arguing that market forces would have resulted in a sharper renminbi appreciation than has occurred.

zh: 而相反中国人则痴迷于维护稳定 — — 这是一个美国政客和政策制定者都不熟悉的概念 — — 也因此喜欢在管理调整自身货币方面承担更积极的角色。
en: Fixated on stability – a concept alien to US politicians and policymakers – the Chinese prefer, instead, to play a more active role in managing the adjustment of their currency.

zh: 我把这称之为谨慎 — — 或者甚至是明智。
en: I call that prudence – perhaps even wisdom.

zh: 在经历了20年的迷失之后，日本这个实验品或许会知道哪种方法更加合适。
en: Two lost decades later, the guinea pig, Japan, might have a view on which approach works best.

zh: 业务外包和知识产权。
en: Outsourcing and intellectual property.

zh: 尽管美国的劳动力市行在最近稍有起色，美国的就业情况依然糟糕。
en: Notwithstanding some recent modest improvements in the US labor market, America’s job situation remains terrible.

zh: 私人部门的就业人数依然比2008年1月的高峰期少了410万。
en: Private-sector employment is still down 4.1 million from its January 2008 peak.

zh: 但这根本不足以支撑两党关于当前危机源于美国制造业职位外包给中国的论调。
en: Yet there is not a shred of evidence to support bipartisan claims that this ongoing carnage is the result of outsourcing US manufacturing jobs to China.

zh: 虽然制造业占私人部门就业的比例从2008年1月的11.9%下跌到2012年9月的10.7 % ， 但这只是自1970年代早期出现的长期大幅下滑趋势的其中一小部分而已，须知当时制造业所占的份额可是超过30 % 。
en: While the manufacturing sector’s share of private employment fell from 11.9% in January 2008 to 10.7% in September 2012, this is only a small portion of the enormous secular decline since the early 1970’s, when manufacturing accounted for more than 30% of private-sector employment.

zh: 相比于中国来说，需求疲软 — — 尤其是消费者支出增长在危机爆发后的暴跌 — — 更像是最近雇佣需求下滑的罪魁祸首。
en: Weak demand – especially the post-crisis collapse in consumer spending growth – is a far more likely culprit than China in explaining the recent hiring shortfall.

zh: 而中国自身则成为了全球化的主要出力者 — — 它既是一个多国供应链生产产品的组装中心，又是囊中羞涩的西方跨国企业的高效离岸解决方案。
en: China, for its part, has become a major workhorse of globalization – an assembly hub for inputs produced by multi-country supply chains and an offshore efficiency solution for hard-pressed Western multinational corporations.

zh: 约有50%的中国出口商品之前曾在其他经济体中进行加工，近60%的产品都是由所谓“外资企业”的中国子公司送出国外的。
en: About 50% of all exports leaving China have been processed previously by other economies, and close to 60% are shipped by Chinese subsidiaries of “foreign-invested enterprises.”

zh: 这些趋势在令中国工人受益的同时还造福了美国以及其他国家，因为这既帮助控制了通胀，同时也使各国企业得以应对严酷的竞争压力。
en: While these trends benefit Chinese workers, they also support America and other countries by holding down inflation and making it possible for their companies to cope with tough competitive pressures. They allow beleaguered American families to stretch their paychecks (think Wal-Mart).

zh: 此外这也没有阻止那些西方创新企业将知识产权和新技术投放在中国的生产线上来为美国消费者提供令人赞叹的新产品（比如苹果公司 ） 。
en: And they have not stopped innovative Western companies from putting their intellectual property and new technologies on the line in China in order to deliver spectacular new products to US customers (think Apple).

zh: 贸易逆差。
en: The trade deficit.

zh: 没错，美国对中国存在着巨大的贸易逆差 — — 2011年约为2950亿美元，相当于美国7380亿美元商品贸易总缺口的40 % 。
en: Yes, the US runs a massive trade deficit with China – around $295 billion in 2011, or fully 40% of America’s total merchandise trade gap of $738 billion.

zh: 共和民主两党都一直认定这是美国就业问题的关键。
en: Republicans and Democrats alike argue that this is the crux of America’s jobs problem.

zh: 毕竟贸易逆差意味着职位流失。
en: After all, trade deficits mean job losses.

zh: 由于美国贸易缺口的最大一部分来自中国这个被诽谤为货币操纵作弊者的国家，双边贸易逆差因而成为了诋毁中国者的指路明灯。
en: Because the biggest share of the US trade gap is with China, a country vilified as a currency-manipulating cheater, the bilateral trade deficit has become the lightening rod for China bashers.

zh: 这正是驱使奥巴马最近在WTO与中国唇枪舌战并限制中国投资俄勒冈州风力发电厂的背后原因，也是罗姆尼在货币操纵和贸易制裁等方面大肆叫嚣的幕后推手。
en: It is what has driven Obama to go to the mat with China on recent disputes within the World Trade Organization and on restrictions on Chinese investment in Oregon wind farms, and what has led to saber-rattling by Romney on currency manipulation and trade sanctions.

zh: 但两个候选人都没有意识到更大的症结所在。
en: But neither candidate acknowledges the much bigger elephant in the room.

zh: 美国在2011年与98个国家之间出现了贸易逆差。
en: In 2011, the US had trade deficits with 98 countries.

zh: 其他97项逆差也并未凭空消失。
en: The other 97 deficits did not magically appear.

zh: 它们都是源自于美国前所未有的储蓄下滑 — — 计入了贬值因素的“国民净储蓄率 ” （ 结合企业，家庭和政府）自2008年一直为负值 — — 所导致的大规模多边贸易逆差的一部分。
en: They are all part of an enormous multilateral trade deficit that stems from America’s unprecedented shortfall of saving – a depreciation-adjusted “net national saving rate” (combining businesses, households, and the government sector) that has been negative since 2008.

zh: 缺少储蓄却期望增长，美国唯有在巨额经常账户和多边贸易逆差下运作来进口其他国家的多余储蓄。
en: Lacking in savings and wanting to grow, the US runs massive current-account and multilateral trade deficits in order to import other countries’ surplus savings.

zh: 这触及到了诋毁中国愚蠢行为的核心。
en: This goes to the heart of the folly of China bashing.

zh: 历史上没有一个领导国家会一直维持着负储蓄率的。
en: No leading country in world history has persistently maintained a negative saving rate.

zh: 贸易逆差 — — 来自中国或者其他国家 — — 就是美国为其肆意挥霍所付出的代价之一。
en: Trade deficits – with China or any other country – are part of the price that America pays for its unbridled profligacy.

zh: 除非并直至美国能直接面对自身在储蓄上的长期背离 — — 也就是说，通过削减大规模联邦预算支出并鼓励重建早已严重枯竭的家庭储蓄 — — 否则多边贸易逆差将继续存在下去。
en: Unless and until the US faces up to its chronic aversion to saving – namely, by reducing massive federal budget deficits and encouraging the rebuilding of severely depleted household saving – multilateral trade deficits will persist.

zh: 简单的计算和基本的经济学原理告诉我们：你是无法通过一个双边解决方案来解决多边问题的。
en: Simple arithmetic and basic economics tell us that a multilateral problem cannot be addressed by a bilateral solution.

zh: 政客们都非常嗜好一些简明有力的信息。
en: Politicians have a penchant for simple and powerful messages.

zh: 但那些信息往往都言过其实。
en: Yet those messages are often more spin than substance.

zh: 众多美国家庭正在受害，而选举产生的官员则希望把指责推到中国身上，并以此把民众的注意力从重建储蓄，恢复竞争力以及量入为出等艰巨任务上引开。
en: American families are hurting, and elected officials want to pin the blame on China, thereby deflecting attention from the difficult task of rebuilding saving, restoring competitiveness, and living within the country’s means.

zh: 事实上，可以说正是美国公众被那些瞄准中国的错误指控所操纵了。
en: Indeed, one could argue that it is the American public that is being manipulated by the erroneous charges leveled at China.

zh: 但幸运的是，大选期正在接近尾声。
en: Fortunately, the campaign season is nearly over.

zh: 但那些未能回答的问题则是下一次又将会出现什么情况。
en: Left unanswered, however, is what comes next.

zh: 那些诋毁中国的人一般都会在总统选举之后调转话头。
en: China bashers typically change their tune after a presidential election.

zh: 但估计会在11月6号过后继续高悬在美国家庭头上的压力可不会消失。
en: But there is nothing typical about the pressures that are likely to continue squeezing American families long after November 6.

zh: 无论是奥巴马还是罗姆尼都面临着在中国问题上自断后路的风险。
en: Both Obama and Romney run the risk of painting themselves into a corner when it comes to China.

zh: 这可能把我们所有人都推向一个下滑的深渊。
en: That could take all of us to the edge of a slippery slope.

zh: 在一切都已经无法挽回之前，美国领导人必须向自己的人民坦白。
en: America’s leaders need to come clean with the American people – before it is too late.

zh: 社会民主体制走近美国？
en: America’s Coming Social Democracy?

zh: 几乎所有的世界发达国家都自认为是社会民主政体，奉行混合经济体制，由庞大的政府实行多种社会福利和保障体制，以政府行为代替市场调节进行大部分社会财富和生活物资的分配调节工作。
en: Almost all of the world’s developed countries consider themselves, and are, social democracies: mixed economies with very large governments performing a wide array of welfare and social insurance functions, and removing large chunks of wealth and commodity distribution from the market.

zh: 美利坚合众国也许略有不同，真的吗？
en: The United States is something different. Or is it?

zh: 不管它过去如何，美国在不久的将来必须决定是否成为一个社会民主政体，以及在多大程度上接受社会民主体制？
en: Whatever it has been in the past, the US in the future will have to choose whether, and how much, it will be a social democracy.

zh: 过去，至少从以往种种传说来看，美国几乎没有发生过“整体下流”的情形。
en: Once upon a time, according to mythology at least, America had little downward mobility.

zh: 相反，在美国内战前，你可以从劈铁轨开始，接着迅速转战到西部地区，在前线一举获胜，最后问鼎白宫成为总统 — — 如果你叫亚伯拉罕·林肯的话。
en: On the contrary, before the Civil War you could start out splitting rails, light out for the Western Territory, make a success of yourself on the frontier, and wind up as President – if you were named Abraham Lincoln.

zh: 在二战时期，你可以在工会联盟的制造企业中保全一份蓝领工作，或辛苦爬至管理机构最高层，享受良好的职业保障，相对丰厚的薪酬，以及长期稳定的职业发展生涯。
en: In the generation after World War II, you could secure a blue-collar unionized manufacturing job or climb to the top of a white collar bureaucracy that offered job security, relatively high salaries, and long, stable career ladders.

zh: 但这些传说至少一半被神化了。
en: This was always half myth.

zh: 向西北地区进军得付出昂贵代价，隐蔽的篷车造价不菲。
en: Setting out for the Western Territory was expensive. Covered wagons were not cheap.

zh: 即使是在后二战时期，只有一小部分美国人 — — 大多为白人男性 — — 才能在大规模资本集约型的工会联盟制造企业，诸如GM, GE或者AT&T中获得一份收入不错且安定的工作。
en: Even in the first post-WWII generation, only a minority of Americans – a largely white, male minority – found well-paying stable jobs at large, unionized, capital-intensive manufacturing companies like GM, GE, or AT&T.

zh: 但若这种说法一半是吹嘘，那么还有一半总是真的。
en: But if this story was half myth, it was also half true, particularly in the years after WWII.

zh: 尤其在二战后的几年内，多数未受教育或不依赖家庭生活的美国人，都能找到一份“有前途的”工作，过上经济稳定、安全有保障的生活。
en: Largely independent of education or family, those Americans who did value stability and security could grasp it in the form of jobs with “a future.”

zh: 即使是那些不太幸运的人，也通常无须承受什么经济风险：上世纪60年代已婚男性的平均失业率只有2.7 % ， 找份新工作是件再简单不过的事情。
en: Even for those not so lucky, economic risks were usually fairly low: the unemployment rate for married men during the 1960’s averaged 2.7%, and finding a new job was a relatively simple matter.

zh: 大约就是在1948年到1973年这一阶段，社会学家们开始发现，大部分美国人开始将自己定位为中产阶级而不是工人阶级了。
en: It was during this era – roughly from 1948 to 1973 – that sociologists found that a majority of Americans had come to define themselves not as working class, but as middle class.

zh: 在美国人的集体记忆中，后二战时期是个参考点，尽管这多半是段非正常的时期。
en: The post-WWII period stands as a reference point in America’s collective memory, but it was in all likelihood an aberration.

zh: 在二战刚结束的十年里，由于美国市场与战后萧条的欧洲大陆市场的完全隔离，海外竞争实质上对美国经济毫无影响。
en: In the early postwar decades, foreign competition exerted virtually no pressure on the economy, owing to the isolation of America’s continental market from the devastation of WWII.

zh: 与此同时，这场战争反而刺激了人们对于汽车、洗衣机、冰箱、割草机、电视机等批量化生产的产品的大量需求，这种需求在战时已经被压抑过久。
en: At the same time, the war left enormous pent-up demand for the products of mass production: cars, washing machines, refrigerators, lawn mowers, television sets, and more.

zh: 政府随即回来使用政策指挥棒，开始实施一个有关费用和调查发展的永久性军事项目，并将此项目持续在民众的工作计划和郊区化项目中推进，并得到了联邦高速公路项目的支持，资助人们向联邦房屋管理局进行房屋贷款。
en: Government policy back then began with a permanent military program of spending and R&D and continued through massive public works program and suburbanization, underpinned by the Federal Highway Program and subsidized home ownership loans from the Federal Housing Administration.

zh: 由“新政主义”提出、并在二战中得以发展的监管机制和行为准则得以全部生效。 它们包括：社会安全、工会劳动力关系体系和市场规范。
en: The regulatory institutions and behavioral norms that originated in the New Deal and developed during WWII came into full force: social security, a system of unionized labor relations, market regulation.

zh: 在无海外竞争的环境中，在有利的宏观经济环境下，加之政府部门的大力支持和有效调节，以及大规模的私人保险（在欧洲却是公共社会保险 ） ， 以上四者合在一起，使二战后的美国不费什么成本，就得到了社会民主体制的诸多效益利润。
en: Favorable macroeconomic circumstances, the absence of foreign competition, a system of government support and regulation, and large-scale private provision of what in Europe would have been public social insurance all combined to give post-WWII America many of social democracy’s benefits without the costs. The economy did not stagger under the weight of ample benefits or high taxes.

zh: 美国人 — — 尤其是白人男性 — — 根本不用在机会和保障之间权衡两难，因为美国对这两种情况有给予优先照顾。
en: Americans – at least white, male Americans – did not have to worry about tradeoffs between security and opportunity, because the US offered the advantages of both.

zh: 公司福利资本主义代替了欧洲模式中政府调控的社会民主制度。
en: Corporate welfare capitalism substituted for what in Europe would have been government provided social democracy.

zh: 美国因此成为了一个特别的地方。
en: America was thus a special place.

zh: 他独享着自己的（市场）蛋糕，其同时也并合了一个机会与创业的保障体系。
en: It had its cake and ate it, too: a combination of security with opportunity and entrepreneurship.

zh: 看起来这正是事物发展的自然规律。
en: It seemed that this was the natural order of things.

zh: 因此政府一手操办的社会民主体制几乎无甚压力。
en: Hence there was little pressure for government-sponsored social democracy: Why bother?

zh: 既然如此，何须费神再加一个新体制呢？
en: What would it add?

zh: 只因如今形势不同往昔。
en: Now things are very different.

zh: 通用汽车公司已不再代表典型的美国雇主。
en: The typical American employer is no longer General Motors.

zh: 沃尔马已经取而代之。
en: It is Wal-Mart.

zh: 私人企业正在通过不断减少其员工的固定福利，如养老金、健康保险及其他形式的保险，以减低经济风险。
en: Private businesses are providing their workers with less and less in the form of defined-benefit pensions, health insurance, and other forms of insurance against life’s economic risks.

zh: 日益突出的收入不平衡矛盾提升了经济游戏的投资额度。
en: Sharply rising income inequality has raised the stakes of the economic game.

zh: 一个不能平衡国内财政情况的国家不可能提供一个稳定的宏观经济环境。
en: A government that cannot balance its own finances cannot be relied on to provide macroeconomic stability.

zh: 事实上，前美国联邦储备主席保罗·沃尔克已经预见到这一点，认为美国的宏观经济情形岌岌可危，将难以承受货币危机，其在未来几年中发生的可能性高达75 % 。
en: Indeed, former Chairman of the US Federal Reserve Paul Volcker sees the US as so macroeconomically vulnerable as to be running a 75% chance of a full-fledged dollar crisis over the next several years.

zh: 美国的下一代将会是替大部分美国人承受“整体下流”的一代。
en: The coming generation will be one of massive downward mobility for many Americans.

zh: 由此产生的政治斗争将会决定，美国究竟是越来越靠近其他发达国家的社会民主制度规范，还是另辟蹊径，找寻能承受美国的高经济风险和悬殊的贫富收入差距，并合理地解决这一问题的办法。
en: The political struggles that this generates will determine whether America will move more closely to the social democratic norm for developed countries, or find some way to accept and rationalize its existence as a country of high economic risk and deep divisions of income and wealth.

zh: 叙利亚和911
en: Syria and September 11

zh: 巴黎—说来也巧，美国国会有可能在9月11日左右决定是否支持奥巴马就叙利亚政府对平民使用毒气采取军事行动的方案。
en: PARIS – By chance, it appears that the US Congress will decide on or around September 11 whether to endorse President Barack Obama’s proposal to respond militarily to the Syrian government’s use of poison gas against civilians.

zh: 此前两次发生在9月11日的事件的阴影影响着结果 — — 事实上，是影响着这个问题是否会被考虑。
en: The shadow of two previous events that took place on September 11 looms over the outcome – indeed, over the fact that the question is even being considered at all.

zh: 在9月11日成为美国的特殊日子之前四十年，它就在智利获得了相似的重要性。 1973年9月11日，皮诺切特将军领导的军队推翻了民选政府。
en: Long before September 11 became a day of infamy in the United States, it acquired similar significance in Chile, where 40 years ago, on September 11, 1973, the armed forces, led by General Augusto Pinochet, overthrew the country’s democratically elected government.

zh: 从当代全球人权运动和美国在国际上推行人权的角度，这次暴力政变可谓居功至伟。
en: More than any other event of our era, that violent coup was responsible for launching both the contemporary global movement for human rights and the American movement to promote human rights internationally.

zh: 从某些角度，这反映了新政权的残酷性。
en: In part, this reflected the new regime’s cruelty.

zh: 皮诺切特统治期间，三千多人被杀或“被消失 ” ， 数千人遭遇军方虐待，数万人被迫流亡。
en: More than three thousand people were murdered or “disappeared” during Pinochet’s rule, thousands more were tortured by his forces, and tens of thousands were forcibly exiled.

zh: 但是，从更深层次看，刺激了人权运动的是全世界 — — 包括美国国内 — — 对美国总统尼克松和国务卿基辛格援助皮诺切特军队的厌憎。
en: To an even greater extent, however, the motivation that spurred the human-rights movement was revulsion worldwide, including in the US, against American aid to Pinochet’s forces, a policy directed by President Richard Nixon and Secretary of State Henry Kissinger.

zh: 在美国国内，国会议员将这次政变变成了推行人权运动的平台。
en: In the US, members of Congress turned the coup into a platform for efforts to promote human rights.

zh: 他们谴责智利的事态，举行关于推行人权重要性的听证，并克服了总统福特的否决，通过立法要求用人权标准作为美国对外政策的指导。
en: They condemned developments in Chile, held hearings about the importance of promoting human rights, and adopted legislation – over President Gerald Ford’s veto – requiring that human-rights standards guide US foreign policy.

zh: 如今，这一立法仍然有效，只是略微做了一些修订。
en: A slightly revised version of that legislation remains in force.

zh: 奥巴马宣布，叙利亚使用化学武器将跨越“红线 ” — —并暗示如果越线将动用武力 — — 这反映了美国过去四十年来所形成的在世界范围内推行人权的承诺。
en: Obama’s proclamation that the use of chemical weapons in Syria would cross a “red line” – and his implicit threat to use force if that line were crossed – reflects the commitment that the US has made during the past four decades to promote human rights worldwide.

zh: 2001年9月11日发生的事件也对向叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权采取惩罚性打击的问题起到了关键作用。
en: The events of September 11, 2001, are also playing a crucial role in deciding the question of a punitive strike against Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s regime.

zh: 12年前的恐怖袭击的一个后果是美国和其他西方国家认识到，中东的发展可能影响其自身安全和保障。
en: One consequence of the terrorist attacks 12 years ago is that Americans and others in the West became aware that developments in the Middle East could affect their own safety and security.

zh: 一开始，袭击造成了极强的复仇欲望，随后，由于后果不可预测，复仇欲望被谨慎干预取代。
en: Initially, the attacks unleashed a strong desire to retaliate, which later gave way to caution about intervention, owing to unforeseen consequences.

zh: 在英国，人们对国家被骗参与伊拉克战争的骗局一直满怀憎恨，这成为国会拒绝支持打击叙利亚的主要原因。
en: In Britain, continuing intense resentment over the deceptions that led to the country’s engagement in the Iraq war seems to be the main reason for Parliament’s refusal to back a strike against Syria.

zh: 担心又一场中东战争也是奥巴马只愿意对叙利亚采取一次性惩罚性打击的原因，一些国会议员甚至连这一点都反对。
en: Wariness of another Middle East war has also underpinned Obama’s unwillingness to go beyond a one-time punitive strike on Syria – with some in Congress opposed to even that.

zh: 国会必须小心避免重蹈2003年支持伊拉克战争的灾难性错误的覆辙，但美国在1973年9月11日后所秉承的推行人权承诺似乎才是评估奥巴马的美国军事干预叙利亚方案的更合适的标准。
en: Though Congress must guard against repeating its disastrous mistake in 2003, when it supported the war in Iraq, the commitment to promote human rights that the US made following September 11, 1973, seems a more appropriate standard for weighing Obama’s proposal for US military action in Syria.

zh: 维护使用化学武器的国际禁令是迫切的问题。
en: Maintaining the international prohibition on the use of chemical weapons is an urgent concern.

zh: 巴沙尔政权使用化学武器的罪行是毋庸置疑的。
en: The Assad regime’s culpability for using these weapons is not in doubt.

zh: 如果美国国会负责任地考虑奥巴马的计划，而不是屈服于次次让他难堪的党派私利，那么就能增强其夺回宪法权力授权军事冲突的立场 — — 在过去半个世纪中，这一权力往往遭受削弱而不是增强。
en: If the US Congress deals with Obama’s proposal responsibly, and does not yield to those motivated by a partisan desire to embarrass him at every turn, it will enhance its own claim to recapture the constitutional power to authorize military conflict – a power that has been disregarded more often than not in the past half-century.

zh: 这一角色的一个关键部分是谨慎考虑惩罚性打击的界线。
en: A critical part of its role must be to consider with care the limits that should be placed on a punitive strike.

zh: 伊拉克战争从一开始就被误解了，因为这是以侵略和占领与事无干的国家报复2001年9月11日的恐怖袭击。
en: The war in Iraq was misconceived from the start, because it was an attempt to avenge the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks by invading and occupying a country that had no part in them.

zh: 相反，奥巴马打击叙利亚的方案是为了强化重要的人权规范，其手段并不包括侵略和占领，而是直接惩罚犯下重罪的对象。
en: Obama’s proposal to strike Syria, by contrast, is an attempt to enforce an important human-rights norm by directly punishing – through means that do not involve invasion and occupation – those who committed a gross violation.

zh: 这让人权重新回到了1973年9月11日后设定的美国对外政策核心位置上。
en: It restores human rights to the central place in American foreign policy set forth after September 11, 1973.

zh: 约束重重的美国选择
en: America’s Constrained Choice

zh: 纽波特海滩—关于11月的美国总统大选，传统智慧只能说是部分正确。
en: NEWPORT BEACH – The conventional wisdom about the November presidential election in the United States is only partly correct.

zh: 是的，经济问题将在结果决定中起到很大作用。
en: Yes, economic issues will play a large role in determining the outcome.

zh: 但下一个阶段 — — 在日趋丑陋的竞赛中获胜的那一方是否拥有采取与其对手截然不同的政策的奢侈 — — 的不确定性要大得多。
en: But the next step in the argument – that the winner of an increasingly ugly contest will have the luxury of pursuing significantly different policies from his opponent – is much more uncertain.

zh: 新总统的任期将从2013年1月开始，与目前奥巴马和罗姆尼竞争口号中所描述的情形相反，上台者将会发现没有多少空间可以用于调整经济政策。
en: By the time the next presidential term starts in January 2013, and contrary to the current narratives advanced by the Obama and Romney campaigns, the incumbent will find himself with limited room for maneuver on economic policy.

zh: 事实上，美国的潜在分歧随处可见，选民们对此并没有充分的认识。
en: Indeed, the potential differences for America are elsewhere, and have yet to be adequately understood by voters.

zh: 他们将注意力集中在伴随着范围甚广的类似经济政策的社会政策上；而在这方面，候选人之间的分歧将产生重大后果。
en: They center on the social policies that would accompany a broadly similar set of economic measures; and, here, the differences between the candidates are consequential.

zh: 不管谁当选，都将在明年面临经济增长只有2%的局面，并伴随着完全停滞的风险。
en: Whoever wins will face an economy growing at a sluggish 2% or less next year, with a nagging risk of stalling completely.

zh: 失业率仍处于过高的水平，大约有一半的失业者是难以找到工作的长期失业者 — — 要是我们把退出劳动力市场的美国人也算上的话（理应如此）这个比例还会更高。
en: Unemployment will still be far too high, and almost half of it will be hard-to-solve, long-term joblessness – and even more if we count (as we should) the millions of Americans who have dropped out of the labor force.

zh: 经济的财政面也值得担忧。
en: The financial side of the economy will also be a source of concern.

zh: 财政赤字将继续在10%GDP的水平上徘徊，令人对美国中期债务动态愈加担心了。
en: The fiscal deficit will continue to flirt with the 10%-of-GDP level, adding to worries about the country’s medium-term debt dynamics.

zh: 银行部门仍在“去风险 ” ， 因此限制了流向中小企业、提振招聘和产房设备投资所必须的信贷流。
en: The banking sector will still be “de-risking,” limiting the flow of credit to small and medium-size companies and undermining hiring and investment in plant and equipment.

zh: 而家庭部门痛苦的去杠杆化阶段也只进行了一半。
en: And the household sector will be only partly through its painful de-leveraging phase.

zh: 政策面也同样令人不安。
en: The policy front will be equally unsettling.

zh: 在犹豫和扯皮了太久之后，美国国会将发现，不能在拖延应对这些挑战的措施了。
en: Having dithered and bickered for too long, the US Congress will find it increasingly difficult to postpone action on these challenges.

zh: 与此同时，美联储翻唱的激进主义 — — 包括不断延长的“摸石头过河”措施清单 — — 收效将越来越少，而成本与风险将越来越大。
en: Meanwhile, the Federal Reserve’s unusual activism, including an ever-expanding list of experimental measures, will yield fewer benefits and entail growing costs and risks.

zh: 美国经济运行的全球环境也越来越困难。
en: The US economy will also be operating in a more difficult global environment.

zh: 在未来几个月中，欧洲债务危机极有可能会继续恶化。
en: In the next few months, Europe’s debt crisis will most likely worsen.

zh: 由于新兴市场（包括中国）的减速，同时有意义的多边政策协调始终不够充分，主要贸易大国将竞争一块不再变大的饼，因此保护主义压力将会大增。
en: With emerging economies (including China) slowing, and with meaningful multilateral policy coordination remaining inadequate, protectionist pressures will mount as major trading powers compete for a stagnant pie.

zh: 因此，不管现任总统奥巴马还是罗姆尼在11月胜出，新总统都将受到双重压力的约束 — — 一边是急需稳定经济，一边是长期改革。
en: So, whether President Barack Obama or Mitt Romney prevails in November, the next president will be constrained by the twin need for urgent economic stabilization and longer-term reforms.

zh: 而在欧洲危机和世界各国同时放缓的压力下，两位候选人别无选择，只能采取相似的经济政策重建就业创造活力和金融稳定，至少在任期开始时是如此。
en: And, with headwinds from Europe and a synchronized global slowdown, the candidates will have no choice but to pursue, at least initially, similar economic policies to restore dynamic job creation and financial stability.

zh: 在寻求短期经济刺激和中期财政可持续性之间的平衡的过程中，最要紧的步骤是合理处置因暂时性减税政策到期结束以及深度跨部门削减支出自动开始所导致的财政悬崖。
en: In striking the right balance between immediate economic stimulus and medium-term fiscal sustainability, the most urgent step will be to counter properly the looming fiscal cliff, as temporary tax cuts expire and deep, across-the-board spending reductions kick in automatically.

zh: 在这方面失败将大大增加美国陷入全面衰退的风险。
en: Failure to do so would significantly increase the risk of an outright American recession.

zh: 深度中期预算改革是应对国会一再不作为所造成的问题之所必须。
en: Serious medium-term budget reforms are needed to deal with the legacy of repeated congressional failures.

zh: 此外，如能了解到真实的数字，下任总统很快就会认识到，正确的税收和支出改革之路已经非常狭窄，远非今天竞争性政治口号所描绘得那样宽阔。
en: And, if provided with realistic numbers, the next president will soon recognize that the right mix of tax and spending reforms falls into a much narrower range than today’s competing political narratives suggest.

zh: 这绝对不是一个要么/要么命题。
en: It is certainly not an either/or proposition.

zh: 财政改革在充满活力的经济中才能取得最佳效果。
en: Fiscal reforms work best in a dynamic economy.

zh: 在这方面，奥巴马和罗姆尼必须排除万难，实现增长和就业创造。
en: To this end, Obama and Romney will need to lift the impediments to growth and job creation.

zh: 与房地产、劳动力市场、信用中介和基础设施等领域一样，在这一领域，办法并不像政客们希望我们所认为的那样多。
en: Here again – in areas like housing, the labor market, credit intermediation, and infrastructure – there is less room for maneuver than most politicians would like us to believe.

zh: 但这并不意味着一点改变都无法做出。
en: But this does not mean that there is no scope for differences.

zh: 改变的空间是有的，这反映出一个事实：总体经济趋势将伴随多重水平不同速度的动态。
en: There is, and they reflect the fact that general economic tendencies will be accompanied by multi-speed dynamics at many levels.

zh: 根据技能和教育程度的不同，失业率存在持久差异；收入和财富不平等性正在创出历史记录 — — 从分配效应看，任何经济决策都将伴随着社会调整的需要，这种需要可能是直接的，但更多情况下将是隐含的。
en: From persistent differences in unemployment rates depending on skills and education to record-high income and wealth inequalities, each economic decision will be accompanied by the need for social judgment – whether explicit or, more likely, implicit – regarding its distributional impact.

zh: 在经历了过度杠杆化、债务创造和信贷泛滥、并在2008年全球金融危机爆发前达到顶峰的“时代”后，美国仍然面临着一项艰巨的挑战 — — 如何分配持久抑制投资、就业和竞争力的累积损失。
en: After an “age” of excessive leverage, debt creation, and credit entitlement that culminated in the 2008 global financial crisis, America still faces the tricky challenge of allocating cumulative losses that continuously inhibit investment, jobs, and competitiveness.

zh: 到目前为止，国会的过度政治极端化已经产生了让承受能力较弱者经受更多调整负担的效果。
en: Until now, Congress’s excessive political polarization has translated into an approach that has pushed more of the burden of adjustment onto those who are less able to bear it.

zh: 在理想世界中，美国新总统应快速实施两步走计划以重塑就业活力、重振金融稳定性。
en: In an ideal world, America’s next president would rapidly embark on a two-step approach to restoring job dynamism and financial soundness.

zh: 首先，他应该设计可行而令人满意的全面经济政策计划组合 — — 在这方面，做出重大不同的空间是有限的。
en: First, he would devise a comprehensive set of economic-policy initiatives that are both feasible and desirable – and, again, the scope for major differences here is limited.

zh: 其次，对于这些经济政策，应辅之以明确的社会政策组合 — — 在这方面，潜在改变空间极大 — — 以满足公平负担共担的需要。
en: Second, he would accompany this with an explicit set of social policies – and here the potential differences are profound – that addresses the need for equitable burden-sharing.

zh: 其实，此次选举绝非选择外包和增税还是福利改革；选择政府控制生产还是自由放任私人部门活动；选择就业创造还是免费搭车等热门���题。
en: This is not really an election about such hotly-debated issues as outsourcing, tax increases versus entitlement reforms, government control of production versus unfettered private sector activity, or job creators versus free riders.

zh: 此次选举中兹事体大者在于它所伴随的社会公平、福利、平等呢个性以及富庶文明社会行为准则等概念。
en: It is much more about the accompanying concepts of social fairness, entitlement, equality and, yes, standards of behavior for a rich and civilized society.

zh: 这是一场事关社会责任的选举。 所谓社会责任，即社会支持因并非由其自身造成的错误而承受寻找工作、实现收支平衡压力的群体的义务。
en: This is an election about social responsibility – a society’s obligation to support those who are struggling, through no fault of their own, to find jobs and make ends meet.

zh: 这场选举事关通过让他们获得健康保险保护社会最脆弱群体。
en: It is about protecting the most vulnerable segments of society, including by providing them access to proper health coverage.

zh: 这场选举事关改革让美国年轻人落于人后的教育制度（以及向需要者提供合适的再培训 ） 。
en: It is about reforming an education system that fails America’s young people (and about providing appropriate retraining to those who need it).

zh: 在诸多公平和公正问题中，让富人回馈给他们带来不可想象的财富的制度才是此次选举的重点。
en: Among the numerous issues of fairness and equality, it is about the rich giving back to a system that has brought them unimaginable wealth.

zh: 奥巴马和罗姆尼的分歧之所以重要，原因就在这里。
en: It is here where the differences between Obama and Romney are important.

zh: 竞选活动越早以此为重心，美国人民就越有可能做出信息更充分的选择，从而采取必须的集体行动让美国免蹈倾覆之辙。
en: The sooner the campaign debate pivots to this, the greater the probability that Americans will make a more informed choice and, thus, buy into the collective effort needed to escape national malaise.

zh: 美国的裙带资本主义
en: America’s Crony Capitalism

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯－20年来，美国一直在公开抨击第三世界国家，特别是亚洲国家的“裙带资本主义 ” 。
en: Buenos Aires – For 20 years, Americans have denounced the “crony capitalism” of Third World countries, especially in Asia.

zh: 然而，就在这些受到美国抨击的地区一直在改善其政府和公司治理的时候 — — 香港法院刚刚作出了一个对当地电信巨头不利的具有突破性的判决，该电信巨头是香港地区最富有和最有权势的人的儿子 — — 裙带资本主义却在美国这样一个长期以来被世界看作是公平商业竞争环境卓越典范的国家，生根发芽了。
en: But, just as those regions have been improving their public and corporate governance – Hong Kong just witnessed a breakthrough court decision against a telecom tycoon who is the son of the province’s richest and most powerful man – crony capitalism is taking root in the United States, a country that the world long considered the gold standard of a level playing field in business.

zh: 美国财政部最近完成的银行 “压力测试 ” ， 只是裙带资本主义占领华盛顿特区的一个最新标志而已。
en: The recently completed “stress tests” of US banks are but the latest indication that crony capitalists have now captured Washington, DC.

zh: 美国财政部长蒂莫西·盖特纳（Timothy Geithner）对美国大银行进行了压力测试，而在测试结果正式公布的几个星期之前，其大致结果就被泄露了，这就难怪股票市场会欢迎压力测试的结果了。
en: It is no surprise that stock markets liked the results of the stress tests that US Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner administered to America’s big banks, for the general outcome had been leaked weeks before.

zh: 事实上，许多专业投资者即使因为持有股票而从股市的上涨中获益，也仍然认为压力测试是不诚实的。
en: Indeed, most professional investors trashed the tests as dishonest even as their holdings benefited from a rising market.

zh: 就连通常是金融市场声音最响亮的拉拉队长的《华尔街日报 》 ， 也公开怀疑测试的诚实性，因为美国政府允许银行家就压力测试的结果进行“谈判 ” ， 这就像是一个学生参加期末考试后和老师谈判其成绩一样。
en: Even The Wall Street Journal, usually financial markets’ loudest cheerleader, openly disparaged the tests’ integrity. The government had allowed bankers to “negotiate” the results, like a student taking a final examination and then negotiating her grade.

zh: 压力测试是用来反映大量持有房屋贷款和金融衍生产品的银行未经审计的有害资产的真实情况的，因而，进行压力测试背后的理由似乎是无懈可击的。
en: The tests were supposed to reveal the true conditions of banks saddled with unaudited toxic assets in housing loans and financial derivatives. The reasoning behind the tests seemed unimpeachable.

zh: 但是，事实果真如此吗？
en: But was it?

zh: 任何经验丰富的银行家都知道，管理良好的银行应该将定期进行内部“压力测试”作为良好的企业管理的一部分。
en: As any seasoned banker knows, a well-managed bank should undertake internal “stress tests” regularly as a matter of good housekeeping.

zh: 金融危机本来应该已经迫使银行自己进行持续的压力测试，以便银行高层知道银行的最新情况，然而事实却并非如此。 那么，为什么美国需要政府来进行银行家自己能够进行并且应该做得更快更好的金融行为呢？
en: The financial crisis should have mandated a running stress test to keep senior management up to date daily. Why, then, did the US need the government to conduct a financial exercise that bankers themselves could and should have done far better and faster?

zh: 这背后的真相是，美国进行压力测试的目的不是为了找到问题的答案。
en: The truth is that the tests were not designed to find answers.

zh: 华尔街的巨头们和奥巴马政府都已经知道了问题的真相。
en: Both Wall Street’s chieftains and the Obama administration already knew the truth.

zh: 他们知道，如果公开披露美国大银行的真实情况，许多银行就会立即被宣布破产，而这会迫使政府的破产管理机构来阻止由此而引发的银行挤兑浪潮。
en: They knew that if the true conditions at many big banks were publicly revealed, many would have been immediately declared bankrupt, necessitating government receivership to stop a tsunami of bank runs.

zh: 虽然像美联储前主席保罗·沃尔克（Paul Volcker）这样的专家都推荐美国进行银行国有化，但是，奥巴马政府却连非常短暂的国有化也不愿意进行，因为它不想因为国有化银行而被贴上“社会主义者”的标签。
en: But the Obama administration did not want to be tagged as “socialist” for nationalizing banks, however temporarily, even though experts such as former US Federal Reserve Chairman Paul Volcker had recommended just that.

zh: 而且，如果美国进行银行国有化，就一定会有一些华尔街巨头及其同僚因为严重经营不善而遭到解雇。
en: Moreover, nationalizing banks would have required dismissing Wall Street captains and their boards for grossly mismanaging their firms.

zh: 然而，华尔街的巨头们已经让奥巴马及其政府成员相信，他们持续工作对世界经济摆脱当前的危机至关重要。
en: Wall Street’s titans, however, had convinced Obama and his team that their continued stewardship was essential to getting the world out of its crisis.

zh: 而且，他们还成功地将自己描绘成经济危机的受害者，而不是引发经济危机的帮凶。
en: They successfully portrayed themselves as victims of a firestorm, rather than as accessories to arson.

zh: 盖特纳和奥巴马的首席经济顾问拉里·萨默斯（Larry Summers ） ， 是曾任美国财政部长、后来担任花旗集团董事会主席和高级顾问的罗伯特·鲁宾（Robert Rubin）的门徒，他们认同华尔街的文化，因而都不觉得接受华尔街银行家荒谬的逻辑是很困难的。
en: Geithner and Larry Summers, Obama’s chief economic advisor, share Wall Street’s culture as protégés of Robert Rubin, the former treasury secretary who went on to serve as a director and senior counselor at Citigroup. Neither man found it difficult to accept the bankers’ absurd logic.

zh: 压力测试本来是要告诉公众，银行没有迫在眉睫的破产威胁。
en: The stress tests were meant to signal to the public that there was no immediate threat of bank failures.

zh: 政府希望，这样的信息可以稳定市场，以便“有毒”资产的价格可以上涨到银行家在卖掉它们时可以感觉不太为难的水平。
en: This message, it was hoped, would stabilize the market so that prices for “toxic” assets could rise to a level at which bankers might feel comfortable selling them.

zh: 毕竟，高级银行家曾经声称这些银行资产的“价格定错了 ” ， 将它们按市场水平定价会使银行遭受了不必要地惩罚。
en: After all, senior bankers had been claiming that these assets were “mispriced,” and that pricing them at market levels would penalize the banks unnecessarily.

zh: 目前看来，盖特纳的“压力测试”似乎成功了，因为事实上，股票市场不只是稳定下来而已，像花旗集团和美国银行这样的银行股票的价格，还从最低点上涨了四倍。
en: So far, Geithner seems to have succeeded in his “tests,” as the stock market has indeed more than stabilized, with prices of bank shares such as Citigroup and Bank of America quadrupling from their lows.

zh: 以前人们所担忧的华尔街的破产，现��似乎已经避免了。
en: The feared implosion of Wall Street seems to have been avoided.

zh: 但是，从来没有人真正地认为美国会让花旗集团和美国银行 — — 在此，我仅列举两家银行 — — 破产。
en: But no one ever seriously thought that the US would allow Citigroup and Bank of America, to name just two, to fail.

zh: 事实上，股票市场在去年冬天就已经见底了。
en: In fact, the stock market bottomed out last winter.

zh: 市场已经将人们对美国政府不会让更多的银行破产的看法，反应到股票的价格中去了。
en: Markets had factored into share prices the belief that the US government would not allow any more banks to collapse.

zh: 世界想要的东西，是有关银行价值的准确数据和根据银行还需要多少注资所确定的引导投资者的“市价”估值。
en: What the world wanted was an accurate picture of what the banks were worth and “mark-to-market” valuations to guide investors as to how much new capital they needed.

zh: 世界也希望看到，美国能够重新回到增强商业道德和诚实信用的道路上来 — — 上一届的美国政府非常缺乏这两样东西。
en: The world also wanted to see the US retaking the high road in reinforcing business ethics and integrity – so lacking under the last administration.

zh: 因为纳税人已经为挽救濒临破产的银行投入了巨额资金，并且可能还要投入更多的资金，所以，有一个表明这些钱是怎样使用的透明的程序，势在必行。
en: As taxpayers had already put huge sums into rescuing failing banks, with the prospect of more to come, a transparent process to reveal how the money was being used was imperative.

zh: 据报道，美国有大量的公共援救资金，不是为了保护公共利益的目的而被转移到了外国银行、高盛手中或者被当作金融机构员工的奖金。
en: Substantial public rescue funds have reportedly been siphoned off to foreign banks, Goldman Sachs, and staff bonuses for purposes unrelated to protecting public interests.

zh: 盖特纳的压力测试没有披露或拆穿这些情况。
en: None of this was either revealed or debunked by Geithner’s tests.

zh: 相反，美国政府的工作人员现在却似乎在和华尔街沆瀣一气，营造出一个虚假的盈利氛围。
en: Instead, public servants now appear to be in cahoots with Wall Street to engineer an artificial aura of profitability.

zh: 而且，美国对有毒资产的价值和以前一样讳莫如深。
en: Moreover, the value of toxic assets remains as murky as ever.

zh: 为了让银行基本上能够随心所欲的进行报告，在华尔街的要求下，美国政府将神圣的会计准则都进行了修改。
en: Once sacrosanct accounting principles have been amended at Wall Street’s behest in order to allow banks to report essentially whatever they want.

zh: 现在，美国公布了由美国政府和银行进行谈判形成的压力测试结果，想以此 “证明”美国的银行比人们想象的要健康得多。
en: And now negotiated stress test results have been released to “prove” that the banks are a lot healthier.

zh: 虽然将这种行为称为旁氏骗局可能太尖刻了，但是它们却有相似的地方。
en: Calling this a Ponzi scheme might be too harsh.

zh: 这种骗局愚弄不了大多数的金融专业人士。
en: But few financial professionals have been fooled.

zh: 同时，华尔街巨头及其董事们对美国政府已经没什么好担心的了，相反，他们现在在完成这个不诚实的计划的共同冒险中，成为了美国政府的合作伙伴。
en: Meanwhile, Wall Street chieftains and their boards of directors have nothing to fear from government. On the contrary, they are now the government’s partners in a joint venture to manage this dishonest scheme.

zh: 像猪流感那样，裙带资本主义已经从腐败的第三世界国家转移到了曾经是可靠的政府和公司治理根据地的美国。
en: Like swine flu, crony capitalism has migrated from corrupt Third World countries to America, once the citadel of sound public and private governance.

zh: 所以，对中国被认为是发展中国家越来越可靠的典范，而美国现在被认为是伪善和双重标志的象征，我们有什么好奇怪的呢?
en: Is it any wonder that China is perceived as an increasingly credible model for much of the developing world, while the US is now viewed as a symbol of hypocrisy and double standards?

zh: 引火烧身的美国债务限额之辩
en: America’s Dangerous Debt Ceiling Debate

zh: 发自纽波特滩 — — 美国政府的债务限额在过去50年内已经上调了超过70次，一般都没有什么异议。
en: NEWPORT BEACH – It has been raised more than 70 times in the last 50 years, mostly without commotion.

zh: 而当今美国政府如果还想继续按时还债的话，就必须在今年夏天再次上调这一限额。
en: It must be raised again this summer if the United States government is to continue paying its bills on time.

zh: 于是该额度就成为了政治家们私下频繁政治表态和紧急谈判的议题，而其最终结果显然也将对美国以外的世界各地造成广泛影响。
en: But now America’s debt ceiling has become the subject of intense political posturing and touch-and-go negotiations behind closed doors. And, obviously, the outcome has implications that go well beyond the US.

zh: 作为美国制衡政治体制的组成部分，国会不仅扮演着审批联邦预算的角色，还负责制定美国财政部的债务限额。
en: As part of America’s system of checks and balances, Congress gets to do more than just approve the annual federal budget. It also sets a limit on how much debt the US Treasury is allowed to issue.

zh: 一旦超出该限额，政府就只好从当年财政收入中掏钱支出了。
en: Beyond this ceiling, the government can spend only from current revenues.

zh: 美国财政部长盖特纳最近就政府将在8月2日左右触及债务限额一事向国会作了汇报。
en: US Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner recently informed members of Congress that the government will be in this situation on or around August 2.

zh: 在借债总额已经到达上限的情况下，财政部当前正在东挪西凑地动用各种闲置资金还债。
en: Having already officially hit the ceiling, the Treasury is moving money around and tapping various pots of unused funds to pay its bills.

zh: 而再过几个星期，这些“流动性”也将告罄。
en: In a few weeks, this “flexibility” will be used up.

zh: 考虑到美国政府当前每1美元的支出中就有40美分债务的处境，一个真正具有约束力的债务限额将迫使其不顾一切地大幅削减支出。
en: With the US government now borrowing around 40% of every dollar it spends, a truly binding debt ceiling would immediately force the government to reduce spending radically and in a disorderly fashion.

zh: 各党政治家们都知道这一状况将动摇早已脆弱不堪的美国经济，严重削弱美元，并引发包括美国未来仍需仰仗的国外债权人在内的市场各方对美国还债能力的高度怀疑。
en: Politicians across the political spectrum know that such a situation would unsettle an already fragile US economy, severely weaken the dollar, and raise serious concerns about the country's ability to meet its debt-service obligations, including to the many foreign creditors that the US will need in the future.

zh: 但在华盛顿当前极端对立的政治环境下，共和党和民主党彼此都不愿妥协 — — 或者认为现在妥协还为时尚早。
en: Yet, in today’s polarized environment in Washington, Republicans and Democrats are unwilling to compromise – or at least to compromise “too early.”

zh: 共和党人想利用僵持来迫使奥巴马当局大规模消减开支。
en: By holding out, Republicans wish to force President Barack Obama’s administration into massive spending cuts.

zh: 民主党则辩称这个不考虑其他因素的单一手段不但会损害经济，还会造成社会不公。
en: Democrats respond that such a one-sided approach would be economically harmful and socially unjust.

zh: 与此同时，双方都冒着扰乱转移支付（包括老人补助）和公共服务供给的风险，甚至进一步威胁到美国的全球信用。
en: In the meantime, both sides risk disrupting transfer payments (including to the elderly) and the provision of public services, as well as eroding further America’s global credit standing.

zh: 目前主流（也合理）的期望是，两党能在国内经济和金融严重扭曲前不计前嫌，调高债务限额。
en: The overwhelming – and sensible – expectation is that the two parties will compromise and raise the debt ceiling before inflicting serious economic and financial dislocations.

zh: 而最近的范例就是在今年早些时候的本年度财政预算案，当时这一预算案一直未能得到国会批准，进而威胁到政府的正常运行，最后终于在妥协中过关。
en: The most recent precedent was the bipartisan agreement reached earlier this year on another fiscal issue that threatened to disrupt the normal functioning of government: the absence of a formally approved budget for this year.

zh: 彼此妥协则双方都能各得其所，既能让政府承诺减少支出，又能采取一系列步骤来使税收具有更多的社会正义性。
en: A compromise would allow both parties to declare partial victory, for it would likely entail commitments to cut spending and some steps to make taxation more socially just.

zh: 但正如众多最后一刻达成的协议一样，这个协议也缺乏长期效力。
en: But, like many last-minute agreements, it would have little durable impact.

zh: 事实上，美国的政治系统很快又会故伎重演，对协议敷衍塞责，而人们所期望的财政改革只有在2012年总统大选之后才能取得实质性进展。
en: In effect, the political system would again be kicking the can down the road, with real progress on necessary fiscal reforms expected only after the November 2012 presidential election.

zh: 两党暂时取得妥协的时间点将取决于是一步到位还是分两步走，因此可能出现两种情况：大多数人认为在8月2日之前两党会选择直接达成妥协协议。
en: Two scenarios for the timing of an interim compromise are possible, depending on whether it is a one- or two-step process. Most observers expect a one-step process for bipartisan agreement before August 2.

zh: 此外就是政治家们需要分两步走：首先是协议失败，��后在引发金融市场动荡后迅速妥协。
en: But politicians may need two steps: an initial failure to agree, and then a quick deal in response to the resulting financial-market convulsions.

zh: 同时财政部会暂时重新安排还款优先次序并延缓付款。
en: In the meantime, the Treasury would temporarily re-prioritize and slow outgoing payments.

zh: 这个两步走的过程与2008年的情况有点相似，当时国会面对的是另一种危险状况：布什政府要求动用700亿美元来防止金融市场崩溃和经济衰退。
en: This two-step process would be similar to what happened in 2008, when Congress was confronted with another cliffhanger: the Bush administration’s request for $700 billion to prevent a financial-market collapse and an economic depression.

zh: 国会一开始拒绝了这一要求，但股市急挫770点使得政治家无暇旁顾，随后将这一提案重新提上议程并最终通过。
en: Congress initially rejected the measure, but a dramatic 770-point drop in the stock market focused politicians’ minds, bringing them back to the table – and to agreement.

zh: 但这个方案会为美国经济及其全球地位埋下众多慢性风险，而美国政治家解决债务限额问题所耗费的时间越长，则发生意外事故的风险越大。
en: But the two-step scenario involves incremental risks to the US economy, and to its standing in the global system. And the longer America’s politicians take to resolve the debt-ceiling issue, the greater the risk of an inadvertent accident.

zh: 这样一来就可能引发更为令人担忧的第三种情况：谈判旷日持久，遥遥无期，给政府的财政支付，履行其他合同义务以及公共服务造成更大的紊乱。
en: This brings us to a third, and even more unsettling possibility: a longer and more protracted negotiation, resulting in greater disruptions to government entitlement payments, other contractual obligations, and public services.

zh: 而那些已经大量持有美国债券的债权人则会在继续购买时表达更严重的忧虑，从而使已经面临失业危机和不稳定增长的美国经济遭遇更多阻力。
en: Creditors would then ask many more questions before adding to their already-considerable holdings of US government debt, generating still more headwinds in a US economy that already faces an unemployment crisis and uneven growth.

zh: 未来5个星期的政治舞台必有众多好戏上演。
en: The next few weeks will provide plenty of political drama.

zh: 而我们的最基本期望是民主党和共和党能在风险之下想办法避免给脆弱的美国经济制造紊乱，只是这一妥协并不能带来有实质意义的中期财政改革。
en: The baseline expectation, albeit subject to risk, is that Democrats and Republicans will find a way to avoid disruptions that would damage the fragile US economy, but that the compromise will not meaningfully address the need for sensible medium-term fiscal reforms.

zh: 对美国的私人企业以及依赖美国在全球经济中扮演核心角色的国家来说，美国政治体制在面临如此关键的经济问题时所发生的瘫痪更加令他们感到不安。
en: Such political paralysis on key economic issues is increasingly unsettling for the US private sector, and for other countries that rely on a strong US at the core of the global economy.

zh: 这就解释了为什么这么多企业愿意继续持有现金而不进行国内投资，也解释了为什么越来越多的国家想方设法逐步实施多元化策略，不再将美元作为单一储备货币，也不愿借助美国金融市场来管理他们辛苦积蓄的血汗钱。
en: This helps to explain why so many companies continue to hoard cash, rather than investing domestically, and why a growing number of countries want to diversify gradually away from dependence on the dollar as the reserve currency and on US financial markets for intermediation of their hard-earned savings.

zh: 全球经济与一个强势美国的假设紧密相连，而美国人也从中大获其利。
en: The world economy is hard-wired to the assumption of a strong America, and Americans benefit from this.

zh: 但美国政治家在债务限额问题上的争论越激烈，这一关联就越有可能发生无法挽回的断裂。
en: But the more their politicians argue over the debt ceiling, the greater the risk that the wiring will become irreparably frayed.

zh: 不断恶化的美国道德危机
en: America’s Deepening Moral Crisis

zh: 发自纽约 — — 美国的政治和经济危机必将在11月国会中期选举之后进一步恶化。
en: NEW YORK – America’s political and economic crisis is set to worsen following the upcoming November elections.

zh: 而一直致力于推动扶助贫困阶层和环保立法的奥巴马也将失去最后一丝希望。
en: President Barack Obama will lose any hope for passing progressive legislation aimed at helping the poor or the environment.

zh: 事实上，所有重要的立法和改革都将停滞不前，直到2013年的新一轮总统大选之后才有转机。
en: Indeed, all major legislation and reforms are likely to be stalemated until 2013, following a new presidential election.

zh: 而这个充斥着僵局和刻薄攻击的可悲状况很可能会愈演愈烈，因此世界也不必指望这个内部急剧分化的美国能表现出多少全球领导力。
en: An already bad situation marked by deadlock and vitriol is likely to worsen, and the world should not expect much leadership from a bitterly divided United States.

zh: 大部分美国人如今都怀着一种丑陋的心态，而同情和怜悯之心则被抛到了九霄云外。
en: Much of America is in a nasty mood, and the language of compassion has more or less been abandoned.

zh: 两大党虽然都自称捍卫中产阶级利益，但其实只为那些富有的选举捐款人服务。
en: Both political parties serve their rich campaign contributors, while proclaiming that they defend the middle class.

zh: 官方统计说美国有15%的贫困人口，但如果我们把那些在医疗，住房，就业等方面苦苦挣扎的家庭计算在内的话，实际的数目会更加庞大，但民主共和两党却对此绝口不提。
en: Neither party even mentions the poor, who now officially make up 15% of the population but in fact are even more numerous, when we count all those households struggling with health care, housing, jobs, and other needs.

zh: 共和党最近发布了一份名为《向美国宣誓：新共和党议程》的宣言来阐述自己的信念和选举承诺。
en: The Republican Party recently issued a “Pledge to America” to explain its beliefs and campaign promises.

zh: 但宣言中却充斥着类似“高税率和过度监管导致了美国高失业率”这样的荒唐言论，堪称一派胡言。
en: The document is filled with nonsense, such as the fatuous claim that high taxes and over-regulation explain America’s high unemployment.

zh: 此外宣言还蓄意误导公众，比如引用美国前总统约翰·F·肯尼迪关于“高税率会令经济窒息”的语录，却不知道这番话发表于半个世纪之前，而当时的最高边际税率是如今的两倍。
en: It is also filled with propaganda. A quotation by President John F. Kennedy states that high tax rates can strangle the economy, but Kennedy’s was speaking a half-century ago, when the top marginal tax rates were twice what they are today.

zh: 最糟糕的是，共和党阵营根本就毫无同情心可言。
en: Most of all, the Republican platform is devoid of compassion.

zh: 而美国之所以发生这种富裕国家内部解体现象，就是因为其核心价值已经崩溃。
en: America today presents the paradox of a rich country falling apart because of the collapse of its core values.

zh: 美国的生产力居世界前列。
en: American productivity is among the highest in the world.

zh: 人均国民收入高达4.6万美元 — — 不仅能保证温饱，还足以令民众过上富足的生活。
en: Average national income per person is about $46,000 – enough not only to live on, but to prosper.

zh: 但整个国家却被一场严重的道德危机所荼毒。
en: Yet the country is in the throes of an ugly moral crisis.

zh: 收入不均程度已经达到了历史最高点，但富人们却宣称自己不需要对其他国民负责。
en: Income inequality is at historic highs, but the rich claim that they have no responsibility to the rest of society.

zh: 他们不愿扶助贫困阶层，而且尽可能地为减税政策辩护。
en: They refuse to come to the aid of the destitute, and defend tax cuts at every opportunity.

zh: 所有人都在抱怨，所有人在维护自己那些狭隘的短期利益，所有人都将社会长远利益和推己及人的理念抛诸脑后。
en: Almost everybody complains, almost everybody aggressively defends their own narrow and short-term interests, and almost everybody abandons any pretense of looking ahead or addressing the needs of others.

zh: 在美国当前的政治辩论中，最流行的做法莫过于两党争相向中产阶级做出更大的政治承诺，而且主要集中在削减政府预算和减税上，但与此同时美国的财政赤字却已经超过了GDP的10 % 。
en: What passes for American political debate is a contest between the parties to give bigger promises to the middle class, mainly in the form of budget-busting tax cuts at a time when the fiscal deficit is already more than 10% of GDP.

zh: 美国人似乎相信他们本来就该免费享用政府服务而无需缴税。
en: Americans seem to believe that they have a natural right to government services without paying taxes.

zh: 在美国的政治词汇中 ， “ 税”就意味着“限制自由 ” 。
en: In the American political lexicon, taxes are defined as a denial of liberty.

zh: 但就在不久之前的一个时期，美国人其实非常热衷于在国内外谈论消除贫困问题。
en: There was a time, not long ago, when Americans talked of ending poverty at home and abroad.

zh: 1960年代中期林登·约翰逊的“向贫困宣战”运动就反映了当时的风貌，全国上下都弥漫着乐观情绪，相信整个社会必须联合行动来解决贫困，污染和医疗卫生这类宏观问题，还执行了一系列贫民区重建，改善空气和水污染以及老年人医疗保障的项目。
en: Lyndon Johnson’s War on Poverty in the mid-1960’s reflected an era of national optimism and the belief that society should make collective efforts to solve common problems, such as poverty, pollution, and health care. America in the 1960’s enacted programs to rebuild poor communities, to fight air and water pollution, and to ensure health care for the elderly.

zh: 但随后全社会在越战和民权议题上爆发分歧，加上消费主义和广告的入侵，似乎最终令这个为公共福利共同付出的时代走向了终结。
en: Then the deep divisions over Vietnam and civil rights, combined with a surge of consumerism and advertising, seemed to end an era of shared sacrifice for the common good.

zh: 其后40年间，我们的政治同情心不断消退。
en: For 40 years, compassion in politics receded.

zh: 罗纳德·里根通过减少贫困阶层的社会福利（他宣称穷人经常用欺骗的手段获取额外福利）并赢得了支持。
en: Ronald Reagan gained popularity by cutting social benefits for the poor (claiming that the poor cheated to receive extra payments).

zh: 而比尔·克林顿则在1990年代故伎重施。
en: Bill Clinton continued those cuts in the 1990’s.

zh: 时至今日，甚至没有政治家敢于提起任何扶贫政策了。
en: Today, no politician even dares to mention help for poor people.

zh: 那些财大气粗的选举捐款人花钱的目的就是为了确保他们的既得利益能主导整个政治辩论的方向。
en: The big campaign contributors to both parties pay to ensure that their vested interests dominate political debates.

zh: 这意味着两大党都不断为富人的利益辩护，只不过共和党的作为比民主党稍稍多一点而已。
en: That means that both parties increasingly defend the interests of the rich, though Republicans do so slightly more than Democrats.

zh: 即便是某个针对富人的温和加税政策在美国也是无人问津的。
en: Even a modest tax increase on the rich is unlikely to find support in American politics.

zh: 所有这一切的最终结果就是美国实力和繁荣的长期衰退，因为美国人再也不集体投资于他们的共同未来了。
en: The result of all of this is likely to be a long-term decline of US power and prosperity, because Americans no longer invest collectively in their common future.

zh: 美国在一段长时期内依然会是一个富裕的国家，但同时也会逐渐走向分化和动荡。
en: America will remain a rich society for a long time to come, but one that is increasingly divided and unstable.

zh: 恐惧和误导性宣传将导致美国发起更多国际战争，正如过去十年那样。
en: Fear and propaganda may lead to more US-led international wars, as in the past decade.

zh: 而发生在美国的一切也会在世界其他地方重演。
en: And what is happening in America is likely to be repeated elsewhere.

zh: 社会的高度分化导致美国极其容易发生社会崩溃。
en: America is vulnerable to social breakdown because it is a highly diverse society.

zh: 而种族主义和反移民思潮其实就是对贫困人口的攻击的重要部分，或者至少是人们愿意听信那些反对扶助贫困阶层的政治宣传的原因。
en: Racism and anti-immigrant sentiments are an important part of the attack on the poor, or at least the reason why so many are willing to heed the propaganda against helping the poor.

zh: 随着其他各国社会内部分化的恶化，他们最终也会步美国后尘。
en: As other societies grapple with their own increasing diversity, they may follow the US into crisis.

zh: 瑞典选民最近给一个右翼反移民政党投下了足够多的选票，足以让其在议会拥有一席之地，这反映出瑞典人对外国移民越来越强烈的抵制心理。
en: Swedes recently gave enough votes to a right-wing, anti-immigrant party to give it representation in parliament, reflecting a growing backlash against the rising number of immigrants in Swedish society.

zh: 在法国，萨科齐政府尝试通过将吉普赛移民驱逐出境的方式来赢得工薪阶层支持，而这些人在法国早已成为种族仇恨和攻击的众矢之的。
en: In France, Nicolas Sarkozy’s government has tried to regain popularity with the working class by deporting Roma migrants, a target of widespread hatred and ethnic attacks.

zh: 这两个例子都显示出随着我们的社会在种族上越来越多元化，欧洲也无法克服随之诱发的政治分裂现象，正如美国一样。
en: Both examples show that Europe, like the US, is vulnerable to the politics of division, as our societies become more ethnically diverse.

zh: 美国的教训就是经济发展并不能确保人民幸福和政治稳定。
en: The lesson from America is that economic growth is no guarantee of wellbeing or political stability.

zh: 美国的社会形势正不断恶化，富人们用钱来换取政治权力，而穷人则自生自灭。
en: American society has become increasingly harsh, where the richest Americans buy their way to political power, and the poor are abandoned to their fate.

zh: 在私人生活中，美国人已经深陷于消费主义无法自拔，而消费主义则反过来吞噬了美国人的时间、金钱、精力，以及致力于集体福祉的倾向。
en: In their private lives, Americans have become addicted to consumerism, which drains their time, savings, attention, and inclination to engage in acts of collective compassion.

zh: 全世界都必须引以为戒。
en: The world should beware.

zh: 除非我们能摆脱这种权钱交易和病态消费主义的怪圈，否则的话，每增加一点生产力，我们就会多丢失一点人性。
en: Unless we break the ugly trends of big money in politics and rampant consumerism, we risk winning economic productivity at the price of our humanity.

zh: 美国的经济僵局
en: America’s Economic Stalemate

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 美国似乎陷入了危险的经济停滞陷阱。 共和党和民主党均拒绝在预算问题上让步，这让美国政府无法处理大规模财政赤字和快速上升的国民债务问题。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The United States appears trapped in a dangerous economic stalemate.  The refusal by both Republicans and Democrats to give ground on the budget is preventing the government from dealing with its massive fiscal deficit and rapidly rising national debt.

zh: 事实上，国会预算办公室估计，国民债务将在未来十年内上升至GDP的82 % ， 即2008年水平的两倍。
en: Indeed, the Congressional Budget Office projects that the national debt could increase to 82% of GDP over the next ten years – more than double the debt ratio as recently as 2008.

zh: 此外，这一估计是建立在十分乐观的经济增长和低利率假设上的。
en: That forecast, moreover, is based on quite optimistic assumptions of strong economic growth and low interest rates.

zh: 如果增长率没有那么高，名义利率没有那么低，则债务比率将在2021年突破100 % ， 在2030年超过150 % 。
en: With slower growth and more normal interest rates, the debt ratio could easily rise to more than 100% in 2021, and exceed 150% by 2030.

zh: 政府债务上升越来越快的一个主要原因是美国人口在迅速老龄化，这导致全民退休金和医保项目 — — 社会福利和医疗保险（Social Security and Medicare ） — —成本节节攀升。
en: A major reason for the accelerating growth in government debt is America’s rapidly aging population and the resulting increase in the cost of the universal pension and health-care programs – Social Security and Medicare.

zh: 大多数专家认为，欲限制债务增长，就必须降低这些“福利”项目占GDP的比重，同时提高税收占GDP的比重。
en: Most experts believe that limiting the rise in debt will require slowing the growth of these “entitlement” programs and increasing taxes as a share of GDP.

zh: 但奥巴马总统和国会中的民主党反对任何福利项目削减计划，而共和党总统候选人及其国会代表反对任何税收增加计划。
en: But President Barack Obama and the congressional Democrats oppose any reduction in future entitlement programs, while the Republican presidential candidates and their party’s congressional delegation oppose any increase in tax revenues.

zh: 结果就是当前的僵局 — — 无法削减财政赤字，也无法扭转国民债务的上升趋势。
en: The result is the current stalemate in reducing the fiscal deficit and reversing the growth of the national debt.

zh: 共和党指出，国民债务增长只能通过削减政府支出来限制。
en: Republicans argue that the national debt’s growth should be limited only by cutting government spending.

zh: 尽管一些传统开支的削减原本就是支出控制的一部分，但这一办法需要辅之以削减“税收支出 ” — —即税法中补贴医保、按揭贷款和地方政府税收之类的部分。
en: Although some cuts in traditional outlays should be part of efforts to rein in spending, this approach should be supplemented by reducing “tax expenditures” – the special features of the tax code that subsidize health care, mortgage borrowing, local-government taxes, etc..

zh: 限制税收支出可以削减相当于2%GDP的年度赤字，从而在2021年将债务-GDP比率拉低25个百分点以上。
en: Limiting tax expenditures could reduce the annual deficit by as much as 2% of GDP, thereby reducing the debt-to-GDP ratio in 2021 by more than 25 percentage points.

zh: 共和党普遍拒绝这种形式的支出削减，因为这会导致税收增加。
en: Republicans generally reject this form of spending reduction, because it results in additional tax revenue.

zh: 该方法确实会让总税收收入增加，但限制税收支出的经济效应与通过其他方法减少这些项目的支出是完全一样的。
en: While this method does indeed increase total revenue, the economic effect of limiting tax expenditures is the same as it is under any other method of cutting spending on those programs.

zh: 但共和党反对任何令税收收入增加的办法，这意味着这一打破预算僵局的关键永远不会得到实施。
en: But the Republicans’ opposition to anything that raises revenue means that this key to breaking the budget stalemate won’t be implemented.

zh: 社会福利的预算成本可以通过用基于投资的个人退休金账户所产生的年金替代部分目前靠税收支付的福利项目来实现逐步削减。
en: The budget cost of Social Security pensions could be gradually reduced by substituting annuities generated by investment-based personal retirement accounts for part of the current tax-financed benefits.

zh: 但即使这样的改革可以维持退休者的收入水平，民主党也会反对，因为这会让传统政府福利减少。
en: But even though such a reform could maintain income levels for retirees, Democrats oppose it, because it lowers traditional government benefits.

zh: 于是，僵局会因此加深。
en: This reinforces the stalemate.

zh: 两党立场均十分强硬，这将影响到2012年的国会和总统选举。
en: The two parties’ hardline stances anticipate the upcoming congressional and presidential elections in November 2012.

zh: 事实上，共和党向选民打出的口号将是“我们不会对你们增税，但民主党会。
en: The Republicans, in effect, face the voters with a sign that says, “We won’t raise your taxes, but the Democrats will.”

zh: ”而民主党将针锋相对，树立“我们不会削减退休金和医保福利，但共和党会”的大旗。
en: The Democrats’ sign, by contrast, says, “We won’t reduce your pension or health benefits, but the Republicans will.”

zh: 双方在大选前都将保持鲜明的立场，因此，马上实现税收支出和未来社保退休金变化是不可能的。
en: Neither side wants any ambiguity in their message before the election, thus ruling out the possibility of any immediate changes in tax expenditures or future Social Security pensions.

zh: 但是，出于同样的理由，我对僵局将在大选后不复存在十分乐观。
en: But, for the same reason, I am optimistic that the stalemate will end after the election.

zh: 那时候，不论是共和党还是民主党，都可以接受当前必须拒绝的改革。
en: At that point, both Republicans and Democrats will be able to accept reforms that they must reject now.

zh: 另一条在选举后赤字削减的办法是降低边际税率，同时用削减税收支出来弥补收入的减少。
en: Another post-election route to deficit reduction would be to lower marginal tax rates and balance that revenue loss with cuts in tax expenditures.

zh: 官方分析低估了降低边际税率对可征税收入的影响，但经验表明，边际税率降低会让纳税人工作更卖命、更多地以可征税现金而不是以额外津贴的形式获得报酬，并减少退税消费，从而使可征税收入水平大幅提高。
en: Official analyses downplay the effect of lower marginal tax rates on taxable income, but experience shows that taxable income rises substantially as taxpayers respond to lower marginal rates by working more, taking more of their compensation in taxable cash than in fringe benefits, and reducing their tax-deductible consumption.

zh: 削减税收支出和降低边际税率双管齐下可以通过增加可纳税收入水平大大增加税收收入。
en: Reducing tax expenditures while lowering marginal tax rates can produce substantial revenue by increasing the level of taxable income.

zh: 当前的经济僵局十分危险，因为金融市场可能对此产生负面反应，且推迟解决财政赤字问题意味着国民债务会继续攀升。
en: The current economic stalemate is troubling, because financial markets could react adversely, and because delays in addressing the fiscal deficit means a higher national debt.

zh: 我也许有些过于乐观了，但我认为有很好的理由相信当前的预算僵局���粹是为了给选举造势，一旦选举结果尘埃落定，美国政治体系将在财政整合问题上显示出高效率。
en: I may be too optimistic, but I think there is good reason to believe that the current budget stalemate reflects election posturing, and that the US political system will prove more effective at making progress on fiscal consolidation once the election is past.

zh: 美国大选和全球经济
en: America’s Election and the Global Economy

zh: 斯坦福—美国大选临近，总统奥巴马以微弱优势领先于共和党挑战者、马萨诸塞州州长罗姆尼，民意专家则仍然认为美国总统和参议员选举还远未分出胜负，众议院则极有可能仍保持在共和党手里。
en: STANFORD – As America’s elections approach, with President Barack Obama slightly in front of his Republican challenger, former Massachusetts Governor Mitt Romney, pollsters still rate the races for control of the presidency and the United States Senate too close to call, with the House of Representatives likely to remain in Republican hands.

zh: 候选人之间的差异是显而易见的，对美国经济政策和全球经济的影响是重大的，尽管总统经济政策的实施还要看众议院的脸色。
en: The differences between the candidates are considerable, and highly consequential for American economic policy and the global economy, although enactment of their programs will depend on the makeup of Congress.

zh: 两大总统候选人的主要差别可以总结如下：
en: The most important differences between the two candidates can be summarized as follows:

zh: 指出。
en: Spending.

zh: 奥巴马大举增加了支出。
en: Obama has dramatically increased spending.

zh: 他可能会继续实施临时性措施（正如米尔顿·弗里德曼曾经观察到的 ， “ 没有什么比政府临时政策更持久的了。 ” ） ；增加一倍投入让政府来决定绿色能源领域的赢家和输家；扩大教育和基础设施支出；以及大规模削减防务支出。
en: He would likely continue many of his temporary programs (as Milton Friedman once observed, “There is nothing so permanent as a temporary government program.”); double down on having government pick winners and losers in green energy; expand spending on education and infrastructure; and substantially reduce defense expenditures.

zh: 相反，罗姆尼支持限制联邦总支出，将其规模从目前占GDP的24%缩减至20 % ， 并将赤字维持在GDP的4%的水平。
en: Romney, by contrast, favors limiting overall federal spending, currently 24% of GDP, to 20%, and keeping defense at 4%.

zh: 他希望让私人市场而不是政府来选择企业和技术赢家。
en: He wants private markets, not government, to choose winning firms and technologies.

zh: 民主党反对大多数非防务支出削减，他们指出，削减支出将导致经济衰退。
en: Democrats oppose most nondefense spending cuts, arguing that reductions would cause the economy to contract.

zh: 当支出削减突然性地发生在疲软经济时，这种效应最为强烈。
en: That case is strongest if the spending reductions are large and abrupt in a weak economy.

zh: 如果在多年的经济复苏过程中实现（如罗姆尼所规划的 ） ， 那么节流可能会收到扩张性的效果。
en: If phased in over a multi-year period as the economy recovers, as Romney proposes, thrift would likely be expansionary.

zh: 比如，美国联邦支出占GDP的比重在20世纪80年代中期至90年代末之间下降了5个百分点，在最近几十年的加拿大，支出-GDP比下降得更多 — — 都是在经济强劲增长期间发生的。
en: For example, federal spending relative to GDP fell by five percentage points from the mid-1980’s to the late 1990’s in the US, and by an even larger margin in recent decades in Canada – that is, through periods of strong economic growth.

zh: 税收。
en: Taxes.

zh: 奥巴马将提高工资、资本利得、分红、利息和房地产的最高边际税率，特别是对高收入个人和小企业。
en: Obama would raise the top marginal tax rates on wages, capital gains, dividends, interest, and estates, especially on higher-income individuals and small businesses.

zh: 但不论是在个人还是在公司所得税方面，他都没有提出全面的改革计划。
en: Yet he has never proposed comprehensive reform of either the personal or corporate income tax.

zh: 相反，罗姆尼将把美国公司税率（为经合组织国家的最高水平）降至25 % ， 并将对美国跨国公司的税基从全世界改为地方，以增加税收竞争力。
en: By contrast, Romney would reduce America’s corporate tax rate (the highest in the OECD) to 25% and tax American multinationals on a territorial, rather than a worldwide, basis in order to increase their tax competitiveness. He would also lower personal tax rates by 20%, and make up lost revenue by limiting tax deductions and credits, particularly at the upper end, thereby raising about 18.5% of GDP, just above the historical average, at full employment.

zh: 他还将把个人税率降低20 % ， 并通过限制税收减免（特别是高端人群的税收减免，该措施可以筹集相当于充分就业水平GDP的18.5%的税收，略高于历史平均水平）冲抵收入的下降。
en: Romney’s fiscal plan thus reduces deficits sufficiently to decrease the debt-to-GDP ratio. He favors a balanced-budget amendment to the Constitution, and hopes to balance the budget over eight years.

zh: 相反，奥巴马将扩大赤字 — — 他的增支计划远比增税计划庞大 — — 这意味着未来会发生大规模增税。
en: Obama, by contrast, would run larger deficits – his spending increase is much larger than his tax increase – which imply large tax hikes in the future.

zh: 此外，奥巴马的税收比率将远高于罗姆尼，因为债务的最大原因的福利支出。
en: Moreover, he would run far larger debt ratios than Romney, because the main driver of the debt is entitlement spending.

zh: 福利。
en: Entitlements.

zh: 奥巴马在医疗保险和社会保障方面的改革一直缄口不言，这些计划的长期赤字是国民债务的数倍。
en: Obama has remained silent about reform of Medicare and Social Security, whose long-run deficits are several times the national debt.

zh: 副总统拜登甚至说社会保障计划“不会有变化 ” 。
en: Vice President Joe Biden has even said that “no changes” to Social Security are to be made.

zh: 罗姆尼支持逐渐提高退休年林、以保险金支持的医疗保险模式、以及将医疗补助（面向穷人的医保）通过取消补助移交给各州。
en: Romney supports gradually increasing retirement ages, a premium-support model for Medicare, and shifting Medicaid (health insurance for the poor) to the states via block grants.

zh: 奥巴马的竞选方针是攻击罗姆尼的医疗保险计划，而罗姆尼的策略是攻击奥巴马拒绝讨论该问题甚至拿不出解决方案草案。
en: The Obama campaign is pummeling Romney on Medicare, and the Romney campaign is hammering Obama for his refusal to negotiate or even propose a solution.

zh: 因此，奥巴马的政策将导致更高的赤字水平，债务比率将远高于GDP的100 % ， 大量研究表明，如此水平将导致美国经济增长率萎缩三分之一以上，并引发主权债务危机。
en: The Obama policy would thus lead to ever-higher deficits and debt ratios well over 100% of GDP, a level that numerous studies imply would reduce US economic growth by one-third or more and might induce a sovereign-debt crisis.

zh: 一些观察者认为奥巴马未明言的计划是用欧洲式的增值税来为不断增加的福利支出买单。
en: Some observers suggest that Obama’s unspoken plan is ever-growing entitlements eventually paid for by a European-style value-added tax.

zh: 贸易。
en: Trade.

zh: 奥巴马是相当长的一段时间以来第一位没有在全球贸易自由化方面起到领导作用的美国总统。
en: Obama is the first US president in a long time who has not played a leading role on global trade liberalization.

zh: 世贸谈判多哈回合依然停滞不前，并推迟了三项自他入主白宫以来一直等在签署的双边自由贸易协定。
en: The Doha Round of global trade talks remains stalled, and Obama delayed the three bilateral free-trade agreements that awaited approval when he came into office.

zh: 罗姆尼是自由贸易的支持者，但也表示将对中国贸易行为和货币政策采取更强硬的立场。
en: Romney is a proponent of free trade, but has said that he would be tougher on China’s trade practices and currency policies.

zh: 监管。
en: Regulation.

zh: 奥巴马希望进一步扩大联邦指令-控制（command-and-control）监管（尽管法院已经叫停了他的某些监管权力的扩张 ） 。
