en: And that means that the financial institutions that own them cannot have confidence in the liquidity or solvency of potential counterparties – or even in the value of their own capital.

zh: 没有这种信心，信贷就不会流动，经济活动也会被抑制。
en: Without this confidence, credit will not flow and economic activity will be constrained.

zh: 再者，因为金融机构的资产主要使用贷款购得，信贷短缺又加剧了它们减债的需求。
en: Moreover, because financial institutions’ assets were bought mainly with borrowed money, the shortage of credit is exacerbated by their need to deleverage.

zh: 由于融资困难重重且代价不菲，他们就通过减少放贷来减债。
en: Since raising capital is difficult and costly, they deleverage by lending less.

zh: 但美国宏观经济的疲软远远不止于信贷供应的萎缩。 不断下跌的房价使家庭财富缩水从而减少��消费支出。
en: But the macroeconomic weakness in the US now goes beyond the decreased supply of credit.  Falling house prices reduce household wealth and therefore consumer spending.

zh: 就业率的下降降低了薪资收入。
en: Falling employment lowers wage and salary incomes.

zh: 高企的食品和能源价格进一步遏制了实际收入。
en: The higher prices of food and energy depress real incomes further.

zh: 世界其他国家和地区经济活力的下降也正在降低对美国出口产品的需求。
en: And declining economic activity in the rest of the world is lowering demand for US exports.

zh: 我个人认为美联储的应对是得当的。 它大幅降低了联邦基金的利率并创立了一系列新的信贷举措。
en: The US Federal Reserve has, in my judgment, responded appropriately by reducing the federal funds interest rate sharply and creating a variety of new credit facilities.

zh: 低利率使美元更具竞争力，但因为房地产的现状和信贷市场的功能失灵，除此之外的货币政策似乎失去了牵引力。
en: The low interest rate helped by making the dollar more competitive, but otherwise monetary policy appears to have lost traction because of the condition of the housing sector and the dysfunctional state of the credit markets.

zh: 美国国会和布什政府实施了一项1000亿美元的减税计划，试图刺激消费支出。
en: The US Congress and the Bush administration enacted a $100 billion tax rebate in an attempt to stimulate consumer spending.

zh: 我们当中那些支持这项政策的人大都明白历史和经济理论证明这种一次性的财政转移支付收效不佳。 但我们认为这次可能会有所不同。
en: Those of us who supported this policy generally knew that history and economic theory implied that such one-time fiscal transfers have little effect, but we thought that this time might be different.

zh: 支持我们观点的论据用Samuel Johnson的话来讲就是“一次希望对于经验的胜利。 ”
en: Our support was, in the words of Samuel Johnson, a triumph of hope over experience.

zh: 最终，我们的希望受挫了。
en: In the end, our hopes were frustrated.

zh: 第二季度的官方国民收入财务数据已经公布，其显示退税政策对刺激消费几乎没有作用。
en: The official national income accounting data for the second quarter are now available, and they show that the rebates did very little to stimulate spending.

zh: 80%的退税款都被存入银行或用于还债。
en: More than 80% of the rebate dollars were saved or used to pay down debt.

zh: 只有很少的一部分被加入到现有支出之上。
en: Very little was added to current spending.

zh: 所以这就是美国的现状：深陷一场金融危机之中，经济正走向衰退，货币政策已经宽松到最大限度，财政转移支付不力。
en: So that is where the US is now: in the middle of a financial crisis, with the economy sliding into recession, monetary policy already at maximum easing, and fiscal transfers impotent.

zh: 至少这对于任何一位继任总统都不是什么大好形势。
en: That is an unenviable situation, to say the least, for any incoming president.

zh: 奥巴马的缅甸之赌
en: Obama’s Burmese Gamble

zh: 阿林顿—美国和缅甸以极快的速度恢复了邦交。
en: ARLINGTON – The rapprochement between the United States and Myanmar (Burma) has proceeded at a blistering pace.

zh: 一年前，两国还没有互派大使。
en: A year ago, the two countries did not even have ambassadors in each other’s capitals.

zh: 5月，总统吴登盛成为近半个世纪以来第一个访问白宫的缅甸领导人。
en: In May, President Thein Sein became the first leader from Myanmar to visit the White House in nearly a half-century.

zh: 但奥巴马政府接受这个不久前还是世界最残酷政权的国家是不是太快了点？
en: But has Barack Obama’s administration been too quick to embrace what was, until recently, one of the world’s most repressive regimes?

zh: 或者反过来，美国的果断支持是否对缅甸摸石头过河的改革过程至关重要？
en: Or, on the contrary, is decisive US support essential to Myanmar’s fledgling reform process?

zh: 1948年，缅甸独立。 自1962年到不久前，缅甸一直由神秘的军事集团统治。
en: Until the recent opening, Myanmar, which gained independence in 1948, had been ruled by a secretive military junta since 1962.

zh: 迟至2010年，缅甸军政府还举行了一场赤裸裸操纵的选举，以至于反对党拒绝参与。
en: As recently as 2010, the regime held elections so blatantly rigged that the main opposition party refused to participate.

zh: 但在2011年，军政府时期以将军身份担任总理的吴登盛在就任总统前开始采取令最狐疑的观察者也觉得了不起的步骤。
en: But in 2011, shortly before assuming the presidency, Sein, a general who served as Prime Minister under the junta, began to take steps that impressed even the most skeptical observers.

zh: 与此前的统治者装模作样的改革姿态不同，吴登盛的动作是具体且意义深远的。
en: Unlike the token gestures of reform offered by previous rulers, Sein’s actions appeared substantive and meaningful.

zh: 一个重要的变化是释放了数百名政治犯，包括最著名的体制反对者昂山素季，她被软禁将近15年。
en: One important change was the release of hundreds of political prisoners, including the regime’s most prominent opponent, Aung San Suu Kyi, who had been under house arrest for nearly 15 years.

zh: 此外，吴登盛还与身为诺贝尔和平奖获得者兼全国民主联盟（NLD）领袖的昂山素季举行了会谈，商讨向文治的转型。
en: Moreover, Sein initiated a dialogue with Suu Kyi, a Nobel Peace Prize winner and the leader of the National League for Democracy (NLD), about a transition to civilian rule.

zh: 随后的选举增强了人们关于缅甸民主未来的希望。
en: The subsequent elections bolstered hope for Myanmar’s democratic future.

zh: 1990年，NLD在议会赢得80%议席，但军政府马上宣布结果无效并逮捕了昂山素季。
en: In 1990, when the NLD won 81% of the seats in Parliament, the junta promptly voided the results and arrested Suu Kyi.

zh: 2012年，NLD在其所争取的44个议席中赢下43席，而军政府接受昂山素季作为改革运动的合法领袖。
en: In 2012, the NLD won 43 of the 44 seats that it contested, and the military accepted Suu Kyi as the reform movement’s legitimate leader.

zh: 此外，吴登盛还与克伦、克钦和其他少数民族进行了接触 — — 这些群体遭受了长达数十年的官方迫害和虐待。
en: Furthermore, Sein has reached out to the Karen, Kachin, and other ethnic minorities – groups whose members have suffered decades of official persecution and mistreatment.

zh: 将缅甸经济向国际贸易开放改变了缅甸的经济首都仰光，目前，商人至少可以从六个国家的首都直飞仰光，曾经空空荡荡的街道如今跑满了进口汽车。
en: And efforts to open Myanmar’s economy to international trade have transformed the country’s commercial capital, Yangon (Rangoon), with businesspeople now arriving on direct flights from at least a half-dozen foreign capitals and once-empty streets now congested with imported cars.

zh: 但是，在某些领域，改革进展极为缓慢。
en: But, in some areas, reform has been painfully slow.

zh: 事实上，在人权和少数民族保护方面，缅甸甚至可能在退步。
en: In fact, when it comes to human rights and minority protections, Myanmar may even be regressing.

zh: 解放过程暴露了缅甸长期存在的宗教分歧，导致了一系列主要针对穆斯林少数派的宗派暴力。
en: The liberalization process has exposed the country’s long-standing religious divisions, leading to a wave of sectarian violence aimed primarily at the minority Muslim community.

zh: 从沿海的若开到内陆的密铁拉和达贡，佛教徒无不煽动着针对穆斯林的暴力（有时则反过来 ） ， 而地方官员往往对宗教流血束手旁观。
en: From coastal Rakhine to inland towns like Meiktila and Tatkon, Buddhist monks have incited violence against Muslims (and sometimes vice versa), with local officials often tacitly permitting religious bloodletting.

zh: 奥巴马在华盛顿与吴登盛会晤时谴责了针对缅甸穆斯林、让其中很多人流离失所的暴力。
en: At his meeting with Sein in Washington, DC, Obama condemned the violence against Myanmar’s Muslims, which has displaced many of them.

zh: 同一天，美国国务院发布了其宗教自由年度报告，缅甸名列全世界对宗教干涉最粗暴的八个国家之一。
en: On the same day, the US State Department released its annual report on religious freedom, in which Myanmar was included among the world’s eight worst offenders.

zh: 并非总是如此。
en: This has not always been the case.

zh: 尽管缅甸是个佛教占压倒性优势的国家，但长期以来，数十种宗教和民族一直共处着。
en: Although Myanmar is an overwhelmingly Buddhist country, dozens of religious and ethnic communities have long lived there side by side.

zh: 在仰光市中心，苏雷宝塔（Sule Pagoda）的金顶与孟加拉清真寺（Bengali Mosque）尖塔隔街相望。
en: In the heart of Yangon, the golden dome of the Sule Pagoda stands just across the street from the minarets of the Bengali Mosque.

zh: 为了实现巩固缅甸民主转型所需要的和平和稳定，吴登盛和昂山素季都需要更上层楼，把自己打造成全体缅甸人民的代表。
en: In order to achieve the peace and stability needed to consolidate Myanmar’s democratic transition, both Sein and Suu Kyi should do more to establish themselves as representatives of all of Myanmar’s citizens.

zh: 穆斯林需要得到人生安全和充分公民权利保证。
en: Muslims need to be assured of their personal security and guaranteed full civil rights.

zh: 奥巴马政府下了极大地政治资本赌注，押注缅甸的承诺最终能产生结果。
en: The Obama administration has staked significant political capital on the wager that Myanmar’s promise may finally bear fruit.

zh: 而事实上，缅甸在过去两年变化的速度绝对称得上令人瞩目。
en: And, indeed, the rate of change in Myanmar over the last two years has been nothing short of remarkable.

zh: 但是，正如吴登盛在白宫所承认的，缅甸政府“已经在（其）民主化道路上遇到了障碍和挑战。
en: But, as Sein acknowledged at the White House, Myanmar’s government “has been encountering obstacles and challenges along [its] democratization process.”

zh: ”它如何处理这些（以及尚未出现的）问题将决定美国支持缅甸的决定是否操之过急。
en: How it copes with these problems – and those that have yet to arise – will determine whether America has given its blessing prematurely.

zh: 人民币现实主义
en: America's Renminbi Fixation

zh: 纽约—七年来，美国一直紧紧抓住人民币汇率不放，从而将人们的注意力从中美关系的其他重要得多的问题上移开。
en: NEW YORK – For seven years, the United States has allowed its fixation on the renminbi’s exchange rate to deflect attention from far more important issues in its economic relationship with China.

zh: 即将到来的中美战略和经济对话将是一次检验（和反思）美国策略重点的良机。
en: The upcoming Strategic and Economic Dialogue between the US and China is an excellent opportunity to examine – and rethink – America’s priorities.

zh: 2005年以来，美国国会一再与立法者演双簧，试图将压力重重的美国工人从假定的廉价人民币的威胁中解救出来。
en: Since 2005, the US Congress has repeatedly flirted with legislation aimed at defending hard-pressed American workers from the presumed threat of a cheap Chinese currency.

zh: 对此手段的跨党派支持始于参议员舒默（Charles Schumer，纽约州自由派民主党）和格雷厄姆（Lindsey Graham，南加州共和党）所提出的首个人民币法案。
en: Bipartisan support for such a measure surfaced when Senators Charles Schumer (a liberal Democrat from New York) and Lindsey Graham (a conservative Republican from South Carolina) introduced the first Chinese currency bill.

zh: 立法行为的理由惊人地简单：自2005年以来，美国平均商品贸易赤字达GDP的4.4 % ， 创下了历史之最，中国贡献了其中35 % ， 据信这是它操纵人民币汇率的结果。
en: The argument for legislative action is tantalizingly simple: the US merchandise trade deficit has averaged a record 4.4% of GDP since 2005, with China accounting for fully 35% of the shortfall, supposedly owing to its currency manipulation.

zh: 大批政客、商人和经济学家众口一词，坚持人民币必须升值，否则就应该对中国采取制裁。
en: The Chinese, insists a broad coalition of politicians, business leaders, and academic economists, must revalue or face sanctions.

zh: 美国公众对此颇有共鸣。
en: This reasoning resonates with the US public.

zh: 2011年民意调查现实，61%美国人相信中国是严重的经济威胁。
en: Opinion polls conducted in 2011 found that fully 61% of Americans believes that China represents a serious economic threat.

zh: 于是，货币争论便成了即将到来的总统大选的主要话题。
en: As such, the currency debate looms as a major issue in the upcoming US presidential campaign.

zh: “ ‘ 够了’已经够了。 ”总统奥巴马在他与胡锦涛主席会面后被问及人民币问题时回答说。
en: “Enough is enough,” President Barack Obama replied, when queried on the renminbi in the aftermath of his last meeting with Chinese President Hu Jintao.

zh: 十有八九将成为奥巴马对手的共和党候选人罗姆尼（Mitt Romney）承诺说，只要他入主白宫，马上就将中国对人民币的操纵宣布为非法。
en: Obama’s presumptive Republican challenger, Mitt Romney, has promised to declare China guilty of currency manipulation the day he takes office.

zh: 但是，如此逻辑虽然非常吸引人，但却是错的。
en: But, however appealing this logic may be, it is wrong.

zh: 首先，美国贸易赤字是多边的：2010年，美国对88个国家存在赤字。
en: First, America’s trade deficit is multilateral: the US ran deficits with 88 nations in 2010.

zh: 多边失衡 — — 特别是可以追溯到储蓄不足的多边失衡 — — 是无法通过施压双边汇率解决的。
en: A multilateral imbalance – especially one that it is traceable to a saving shortfall – cannot be fixed by putting pressure on a bilateral exchange rate.

zh: 事实上，美国的主要威胁在于国内。
en: Indeed, America’s major threat is from within.

zh: 指责中国只会耽误解决国内重担的时间 — — 即通过削减预算赤字提振储蓄以及鼓励家庭储蓄收入而不是依靠资产泡沫。
en: Blaming China merely impedes the heavy lifting that must be done at home – namely, boosting saving by cutting budget deficits and encouraging households to save income rather than rely on asset bubbles.

zh: 其次，自2005年年中以来，人民币已经对美元升值了31.4 % ， 比当初的舒默-格雷厄姆法案所要求的27.5%幅度大多了。
en: Second, the renminbi has now appreciated 31.4% against the dollar since mid-2005, well in excess of the 27.5% increase called for by the original Schumer-Graham bill.

zh: 中国人吸取了日本的教训 — — 特别是日本屈服于1985年广场协议让日元剧烈升值所带来的灾难性影响 — — 选择了逐步升值之路。
en: Mindful of the lessons of Japan – especially its disastrous concession on sharp yen appreciation in the Plaza Accord of 1985 – the Chinese have opted, instead, for a gradual revaluation.

zh: 最近中国出台了人民币国际化、加大资本账户开放、增加货币交易上下限等措施，毫无疑问地表明了其最终目标是基于市场的、完全可兑换的人民币。
en: Recent moves toward renminbi internationalization, a more open capital account, and wider currency trading bands leave little doubt that the endgame is a market-based, fully convertible renminbi.

zh: 第三，中国外部失衡问题已经得到了很大的改善。
en: Third, there has been significant improvement in China’s external imbalance.

zh: IMF估计，中国经常项目盈余占GDP的比重将在2012年收缩至2.3 % ， 该数字的高峰出现在2007年，为10.1 % 。
en: The International Monetary Fund estimates that China’s current-account surplus will narrow to just 2.3% of GDP in 2012, after peaking at 10.1% in 2007.

zh: 长期以来，美国官员一直认为中国储蓄过剩是全球不稳定性的重要原因。
en: American officials have long bemoaned China’s saving glut as a major source of global instability.

zh: 但他们需要好好照照镜子：美国的经常项目赤字今年预计将达5100亿美元，比中国的盈余高出2.8倍。
en: But they should look in the mirror: America’s current-account deficit this year, at an estimated $510 billion, is likely to be 2.8 times higher than China’s surplus.

zh: 最后，中国已经从世界工厂转变为流水线。
en: Finally, China has evolved from the world’s factory to its assembly line.

zh: 研究表明，中国出口到美国的货物中，只有不超过20—30%体现了在中国获得的增加值。
en: Research shows that no more than 20% to 30% of Chinese exports to the US reflect value added inside China.

zh: 大约60%的中国出口仅仅是“外商投资企业”的出货，从本质上说是中国对全球跨国公司的补贴。
en: Roughly 60% of Chinese exports represent shipments of “foreign invested enterprises” – in effect, Chinese subsidiaries of global multinationals.

zh: 苹果就是明证。
en: Think Apple.

zh: 全球化生产平台扭曲了中美双边贸易数据，这与汇率一点关系也没有。
en: Globalized production platforms distort bilateral trade data between the US and China, and have little to do with the exchange rate.

zh: 中国不应该被戴上美国首要经济威胁的帽子，中美贸易关系应该被当做是一个机会。
en: Rather than vilifying China as the principal economic threat to America, the relationship should be recast as an opportunity.

zh: 美国总需求的最大组成部分 — — 消费者 — — 目前很不给力。
en: The largest component of US aggregate demand – the consumer – is on ice.

zh: 家庭正在忙于修复严重受损的资产负债表，过去四年来，经通胀调整的私人消费年平均增长率只有区区0.5 % 。
en: With households focused on repairing severely damaged balance sheets, inflation-adjusted private consumption has expanded at an anemic 0.5% average annual rate over the past four years.

zh: 消费者去杠杆化可能还会持续几年，这使得美国需要竭尽全力寻找新的增长源。
en: Consumer deleveraging is likely to persist for years to come, leaving the US increasingly desperate for new sources of growth.

zh: 出口便是新增长源最有力的候选者之一。
en: Exports top the list of possibilities.

zh: 如今，中国是美国第三大也是增长最快的出口市场。
en: China is now America’s third largest and most rapidly growing export market.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国具有填补美国消费者留下的空白的潜力。
en: There can be no mistaking its potential to fill some of the void left by US consumers.

zh: 抓住这一机会的关键在于进入中国市场 — — 特别是借中国即将支持消费以实现再平衡的东风。
en: The key to realizing that opportunity lies in access to Chinese markets – all the more significant in light of China’s upcoming pro-consumption rebalancing.

zh: 从历史上看，中国已经形成了开放发展模式，自2002年以来进口相当于GDP的28 % ， 是日本高增长时期（1960—1989年）10%的近三倍。
en: Historically, China has had an open development model, with imports running at 28% of GDP since 2002 – nearly three times Japan’s 10% import ratio during its high-growth era (1960-1989).

zh: 因此，在国内需求增量给定的情况下，中国偏向外部资源的倾向要强得多。
en: As a result, for a given increment of domestic demand, China is far more predisposed toward foreign sourcing.

zh: 随着中国消费者的崛起，对各种美国制造商品 — — 从新一代信息技术和生物技术到汽车零部件和飞机 — — 将得到保障。
en: As the Chinese consumer emerges, demand for a wide variety of US-made goods – ranging from new-generation information technology and biotech to automotive components and aircraft – could surge.

zh: 服务亦然。
en: The same is true of services.

zh: 中国服务部门贡献的GDP只占总量的43 % ， 相对来说相当弱小。
en: At just 43% of GDP, China’s services sector is relatively tiny.

zh: 美国的全球服务公司在中国的扩张前景无限，特别是交易密集型物流部门 — — 批发和零售贸易、国内运输、供应链物流等 — — 以及金融、医疗和数据仓储方面的处理细分市场。
en: There is enormous scope for America’s global services companies to expand in China, especially in transactions-intensive distribution sectors – wholesale and retail trade, domestic transportation, and supply-chain logistics – as well as in the processing segments of finance, health care, and data warehousing.

zh: 中国需要调整中美贸易日程的重点，将之放在扩大诸领域的市场进入上 — — 反对中国政策和政府采购优先考虑国产商品和自主创新。
en: The US needs to refocus the US-China trade agenda toward expanded market access in these and other areas – pushing back against Chinese policies and government procurement practices that favor domestic production and indigenous innovation.

zh: 这方面已经取得了一定的进步，但还不够 — — 比如让中国加入世贸组织政府采购协定。
en: Some progress has been made, but more is needed – for example, getting China to join the World Trade Organization’s Government Procurement Agreement.

zh: 与此同时，美国必须反思限制中国采购技术密集型商品的过时冷战思维。
en: At the same time, the US should reconsider antiquated Cold War restrictions on Chinese purchases of technology-intensive items.

zh: 对可望增长的美国来说，进入市场的机会远大于货币威胁。
en: For a growth-starved US, the opportunities of market access far outweigh the currency threat.

zh: 沉睡已久的中国消费者马上就要觉醒了。
en: The long-dormant Chinese consumer is about to be unleashed.

zh: 这正好契合美国最大的优势之一 — — 摩拳擦掌竞相进入新市场。
en: This plays to one of America’s greatest strengths – its zeal to compete in new markets.

zh: 如果美国在即将举行的战略和经济对话中顽固不化从而浪费掉这一千载难逢的机会，那着实是一件丢人之事。
en: Shame on the US if it squanders this extraordinary chance by digging in its heels at the upcoming Strategic and Economic dialogue.

zh: 美国从亚洲撤军
en: America's Retreat from Asia

zh: 8月16日，乔治·W·布什总统宣布美国打算从亚洲撤军。 虽然撤军不一定会影响到亚太地区、特别是朝鲜的和平稳定，但重新部署的顺利进行有个重要条件，就是美国与盟国间的密切协商。
en: The United States' planned withdrawal of troops from Asia, which President George W. Bush announced on August 16, need not harm peace and stability in the region and particularly in Korea.

zh: 但直到现在，美国在这方面做得都不好。
en: But a key condition for a smooth redeployment of US troops is close consultations by America with its allies, something it has not done well up to now.

zh: 如果这次现在看来无可避免的撤军想获得成功，就要认真考虑韩国和日本的需求。
en: South Korea and Japan need to have their views taken into serious account if this now inevitable withdrawal is to succeed.

zh: 恰恰相反，单方面宣布撤军后再单方面执行，可能会损害留亚美军的根本使命：那就是确保朝鲜和整个亚洲地区的威慑力、稳定及核不扩散。
en: By contrast, unilaterally announcing the withdrawal - and then unilaterally implementing it - may harm the very purpose that the remaining US troops in Asia are intended to serve: assuring deterrence, stability, and nonproliferation in Korea and Asia.

zh: 撤军计划引发了很多忧虑。
en: The withdrawal plan is causing countless worries.

zh: 很多日本人担心日本会变成美国在亚洲的前哨指挥部，这可能超越了日美双边安全协议规定的范畴。
en: In Japan, there are concerns that it will make the country America's frontline command post in Asia, possibly beyond the scope of its bilateral security treaty with the US.

zh: 美日军事合作的任何扩大都会引起中国的警觉。
en: One result is that China feels nervous about the implications of any expansion of the American-Japanese military partnership.

zh: 但受美军撤离计划影响最大的是韩国。
en: But the impact of America's planned troop withdrawals is felt most keenly in South Korea.

zh: 6月，布什政府宣布要在2005年前从37，000名驻韩美军中撤出约12，500人，其中包括第二步兵师的第二装甲旅，已经确定这支部队要重新派驻伊拉克。
en: In June, the Bush administration revealed its plan to withdraw some 12,500 of the 37,000 US soldiers stationed in South Korea by the end of 2005. These include 3,600 troops from the 2nd Brigade of the 2nd Infantry Division, who are already earmarked for redeployment in Iraq.

zh: 美国防部称上述变动是所谓"驻外美军重新部署计划"的组成部分，目的是更灵活机动地把军队部署到全球更急需的地区。
en: The US Defense Department justifies this change as part of the so-called "Global Posture Review" that it has been carrying out to provide more flexibility and mobility in deploying troops to more urgently needed places around the world.

zh: 但通告的单边性质和撤军的紧迫日程在韩国引起了恐慌，日本可能也一样，害怕这次撤军会使美军遏制另一次朝鲜战争的任务面临严重的危机。
en: But the unilateral nature of the announcement, and the abrupt timing of the plan, has incited alarm in South Korea, and perhaps in Japan, that withdrawal could pose serious risks to the vital role that US forces have performed in deterring another war in Korea.

zh: 韩国真心害怕撤军计划会使北朝鲜认为固执己见产生了作用，进而会削弱遏制的效果。 北朝鲜一直要求美国撤军，却不肯放弃自己的核武器目标。
en: South Koreans genuinely fear that the plan may weaken deterrence by sending North Korea - which is demanding a US military withdrawal while refusing to abandon its nuclear weapons ambitions - the message that intransigence pays.

zh: 实际上，我们不该忘记北朝鲜仍保留着110万人的部队。
en: Indeed, it should not be forgotten that North Korea maintains an army of 1.1 million troops.

zh: 此外，布什政府宣布撤军计划的方式削弱了美韩联盟的信任基础。
en: Moreover, the manner in which the Bush administration unveiled its withdrawal plan has weakened the credibility of the US-Korean alliance.

zh: 美国的单方面宣布使韩国国内谣言四起，说这次撤军肯定与韩国国内日益高涨的反美风潮有关，特别是韩国不情愿并拖延再次派遣3，600名本土士兵到伊拉克，是这次撤军直接的导火索。
en: America's unilateral announcement has fuelled rumors to the effect that withdrawal must have something to do with the rising tide of anti-Americanism in South Korea, and especially with the country's reluctance and delay in dispatching an additional 3,600 of its own soldiers to Iraq.

zh: 布什政府试图对流言进行回击，声明撤军不会削弱美军的遏制能力，因为美国将在该地区保留占绝对优势的海空部署。
en: The Bush administration tries to rebut these charges by saying that the plan will not weaken the deterrence capabilities of American forces, for America's far more powerful air and naval presence in the area will be maintained.

zh: 不仅如此，美国还计划在5年内批准对韩出售约110亿美元的高科技装备，以加强韩国自身的部队建设。
en: Moreover, the US plans to strengthen South Korea's own forces by supplying some $11 billion worth of high-technology equipment over the next five years.

zh: 军事上看，这种说法有一定道理。
en: Militarily, this argument does make sense.

zh: 但从政治和心理的角度，这次撤军的方式，更不用说具体的日程和安排，都给美韩安全联盟今后的可行性带来了不少问题。 美韩联盟似乎飘浮不定，既缺乏共同的目标，也不知要去往何处。
en: Politically and psychologically, however, the method, let alone the timing and implementation of the withdrawals, raises many questions about the ongoing viability of the US-Korean security alliance, for the alliance now seems adrift, without a common purpose and with little direction from either side.

zh: 而布什政府强调 ： " 美国眼中的韩国是强大稳定的联盟，我们会全力维护韩国的安全，维护与汉城的盟友和伙伴关系。
en: Yet the Bush administration insists: "The US views South Korea as a strong and steadfast ally. We are committed to South Korea's security and to our alliance and partnership with Seoul."

zh: "如果华盛顿把这个承诺当真，就应该将其转化为长期全面的联盟，能够顺利地渡过眼前的危机－即便朝韩统一之后也始终不改－布什应该与韩国政府首脑联合发表声明。
en: If Washington is serious about these words, it should transform this commitment into a long-term and comprehensive alliance that can survive the current estrangement - and continue even after Korean unification - by making a joint declaration with South Korea's government at the highest level.

zh: 为了减少顾虑，恢复信任，美韩需要重申两国的共同利益，那就是在亚洲和朝鲜半岛追求遏制、不扩散、稳定和民主的目标。
en: In order to allay misgivings and restore trust in the alliance, it is necessary for the US and South Korea to reaffirm their common interests and values in pursuing deterrence, nonproliferation, stability, and democracy on the Korean peninsula and across Asia.

zh: 一旦它们决意出于上述目的将联盟继续下去，相关官员就有可能确定具体安全合作的指导原则。
en: Once they resolve to continue their alliance with these purposes in mind, it should be possible for responsible officials to work out guiding principles for concrete security cooperation.

zh: 无论是美军撤离韩国，还是从非军事区到汉城南部的重新调动，都必须遵照原则加以实行。
en: Specific negotiations on withdrawing American troops from Korea or on redeploying them from the DMZ to south of Seoul must be carried out according to these principles.

zh: 要实现这个目标，美国必须完全把韩国作为伙伴，在涉及他们自身安全利益的问题上有权发言。
en: In so doing, America must treat South Korea as a full partner with its own voice in making decisions that affect its security interests.

zh: 韩国是51年的美国伙伴，东亚第三的经济大国，他们有权在上述问题上充分表态。
en: As an American ally for 51 years, and as East Asia's third-largest economy, South Korea is entitled to be fully consulted on such decisions.

zh: 尽管有些韩国人存在着反美情绪，但多数人还是希望美军稳定部队留在韩国。
en: Despite anti-American sentiments among some South Koreans, a majority of the country's people wants American forces to remain as a stabilizing force.

zh: 朝鲜半岛上，中国、日本、俄国和美国的利益直接交叉，在这里实现和平和无核化是全球最重要的安全目标之一。
en: Securing a peaceful and nuclear-free Korean peninsula, a place where the interests of China, Japan, Russia, and America directly intersect, is one of the most important security goals anywhere on the planet.

zh: 也正因为如此，美国和韩国必须重新以战略的眼光审视未来。
en: For this reason, America and South Korea must restore a strategic vision for the future.

zh: 矛盾式发展的美国经济
en: America's Schizophrenic Economy

zh: 美国经济在三月上旬渐行渐弱的消息又一次为我们描绘了一幅只有精神分裂症患者才能画出的情景。
en: The news about America's economy that dribbled out over the first half of March painted - once again - a picture that only a schizophrenic could create.

zh: 实际投资（由于高科技和与信息有关的资本货物价格下跌而调整后的投资）继续大幅增长。
en: Real investment (investment adjusted for the declining prices of high-tech and information-related capital goods) continued to roar ahead.

zh: 生产和销售与公认的4%或以上的实际GDP年增长率预测保持一致。
en: Production and sales were consistent with the consensus forecast of real GDP growth at an annual rate of 4% or more.

zh: 可尽管如此，就业情况仍不景气：美国的净工作创造量仍然停滞不前。
en: Yet, despite all this, employment remained stagnant: net job creation in the United States continues to stall.

zh: 这并不意味着美国的就业率不能增长了。
en: This does not mean that employment in America cannot grow.

zh: 于去年相比，美国的教育和医疗行业多雇佣了约30万人-就业年增长率达1.7 % 。
en: Roughly 300,000 more Americans are employed in education and health care than a year ago - an annual rate of employment growth of 1.7%.

zh: 商业和专业服务行业多雇佣了25万人-就业年增长率为1.6 % 。
en: A quarter of a million more Americans are employed in business and professional services than a year ago - a 1.6% annual rate of employment growth.

zh: 就业状况不景气的逻辑并不是美国经济不可能创造新的工作，而是需求的增长不足以创造足够的工作机会以吸纳失业者。
en: The logic of stagnant employment is not that adding jobs to the American economy is impossible, but that demand growth is insufficient to create more jobs than are lost.

zh: 这点很容易说明。
en: This is easy to demonstrate.

zh: 美国的总名目支出年增长5.5 % ， 年通货膨胀率为1.5 % 。
en: Total nominal spending in America grows at 5.5% per year. Inflation is 1.5% per year.

zh: 全员劳动生产率的年增长率为3.5 % 。
en: And overall productivity growth is 3.5% per year.
So the equation is simple: 5.5%-1.5%-3.5% = 0.5%.

zh: 而就业率的增长就只能达到0.5 % ， 因为尽管劳动生产率增长强劲，要满足需求却只需要这样就业率增长。
en: That 0.5% is all that is left for job growth, because that's all the job growth required to meet demand given the remarkably strong rate of growth of productivity.

zh: 美国劳动生产率的增长从何而来是显而易见的。
en: Where America's productivity growth is coming from is clear.

zh: 其较小的部分增长是来自简单的加速：在目前的经济形势下，美国的失业人口找到新工作的间隔时间逼近二战后的历史高点。 因此对于加快工作节奏的要求，雇员的态度总是"是，老板！
en: A relatively small part of it is coming from simple speed-up: in an economy where the amount of time it takes for the unemployed to find new jobs is close to a post-WWII record high, demands for speeding-up the pace of work will be met with a "Yes, boss!" rather than a "Take this job and shove it!"

zh: 劳动生产率的较大部分增长来自于计算机和通信技术的革命-这使得高科技资本的有效性大幅增加，而其成本则大幅降低。
en: A bigger part of this increased productivity comes from the extraordinary technological revolutions in computers and communications that have led to dramatic increases in the usefulness - and decreases in the cost - of high-tech capital.

zh: "新经济"对财富增长的驱动力让其最热忱的推动者也难以想象。
en: The boost to wealth provided by the "new economy" is exceeding even its most avid boosters' wildest dreams.

zh: 出人意料的是新的财富并没有流向dot-com公司的股东，而是流向高科技资本的购买者和使用者，以及他们所服务的消费者。
en: What is unexpected is that the new wealth is flowing not to the shareholders of dot-com companies, but to purchasers and users of high-tech capital and the consumers they serve.

zh: 可为什么这种情况让人如此惊异呢？
en: But why does this seem so surprising?

zh: 19世纪末，美国铁路系统获得的巨额投资和技术进步似乎使除了铁路公司股东和债主之外的所有人受益。 当铁路经济泡沫在繁荣之后破裂时，投资者自食垃圾证券的苦果成为华尔街最受欢迎的游戏。
en: At the end of the nineteenth century the huge amount of investment and technological progress in America's railroads appeared to benefit everyone but the stockholders and bondholders of railroad companies, as bust followed boom and ramming worthless securities down the throats of investors became Wall Street's favorite sport.

zh: 还有一部分美国劳动生产率的增长来自于这样一个事实：高科技资本给美国公司带来的巨大动力以促使它们投入巨资改造组织和商务流程从而使其适应计算机化和网络化的需求。 可这些投资往往是难以发觉，甚至难以衡量的。
en: Yet another part of US productivity growth due to the fact that high-tech capital gives America's firms enormous incentives to make massive but hard to see - and even harder to measure - investments in organization and business processes that are complementary to computerization and networking.

zh: 对于美国来说，劳动生产率的年增长达到3.5%而非1995年之前的1.2%是难能可贵的。
en: For the US to have a rate of productivity growth of 3.5% per annum rather than the pre-1995 rate of 1.2% is amazing.

zh: 这意味着仅这一个国家就为世界收入带来了2500亿美金的年增加值。
en: That means an annual increment to world income of $250 billion from this source alone.

zh: 这相当于每年为世界增加等同于1/4个印度的生产力。
en: That's the equivalent of adding productive power equal to a quarter of the economy of India - and adding it every year.

zh: 然而，美国劳动生产率的持续攀升却为乔治·W·布什总统带来了一个巨大的政治问题。
en: This persistent acceleration in American productivity growth has, however, created a massive political problem for President George W. Bush.

zh: 在前几十年一路凯歌的内需增长突然变得严重不足，由此造成的劳动力市场疲软也使布什备受指责（他在一定程度上的确难辞其咎 ） 。
en: Demand growth at a pace that in any previous decade would have been seen as highly satisfactory is suddenly desperately insufficient, and Bush is being blamed (with some justice) for the slack labor market that has resulted.

zh: 但对于所有人来说-除了布什和那些由于内需乏力而失业的人-这都是一个绝佳的机会。
en: But for everyone except Bush - and those left unemployed by the lag in demand - it is an extraordinary opportunity.

zh: 只要美国的决策者们抗拒诱惑，不从政治利益出发追求"保护"产量和就业但却会破坏经济发展的政策，那么美国现在伸手可及的对生产率的显著推动力会最终带来真正利润和薪酬的强劲增长。
en: The remarkable boosts to productivity that have been within America's grasp will ultimately lead to accelerating growth of real profits and real wages, if only US policy makers resist the temptation to pursue politically expedient, but economically damaging, measures to "protect" output and employment.

zh: 作为领军世界的经济体，美国在确保经济增长方面任务艰巨。 因为它必须创造-并不仅仅是摹仿和改良-新技术、更佳的资本形式和更有生产效率的商业组织。
en: As the world's leading-edge economy, America faces the hardest work in ensuring growth, for it must create - not only copy and adapt - new technologies, better forms of capital, and more productive business organizations.

zh: 如果美国的经济能够以现在的速度发展，这对于其它较不发达的经济体来说是个好消息。 特别是因为在发展中的计算机和通信技术革命的强大推动作用下，世界各国能够更容易地参与到以美国为中心的全球劳动分工之中。
en: If America can grow as fast as it is now, that is very good news for other, less-developed economies, especially since one powerful effect of ongoing technological revolutions in computers and communications is to make it much easier to participate in the global division of labor now centered in the US.

zh: 因此美国经济的矛盾式发展昭示着世界已进入了一个有着非凡机遇的经济时代-前提是我们要彻底而耐心地抓住它们。
en: So the schizophrenic American economy is a sign that the world is entering an economic era of truly wonderful things - if only we properly, and patiently, grasp them.

zh: 美国的焦土管理
en: America’s Scorched Earth Management

zh: 显示美国经济处于危险境地的迹象到处可见 — — 从巨大的财政以及经常账户赤字缺口到快速下降的房价和弱势美元的价格。
en: Signs of the American economy’s perilous condition are everywhere – from yawning fiscal and current-account deficits to plummeting home prices and a feeble dollar.

zh: 但是，有些没有在任何经济指标中显现的东西可能驱动着许多经济指标：美国管理的恶化 — — 它不仅削弱了许多美国大企业，也削弱了美国企业书写传奇的精神。
en: But something that shows up in none of the economic indicators may be driving many of them: the deterioration of American management, which is undermining not only many of America’s great enterprises, but also its legendary spirit of enterprise.

zh: 荒谬的是，在美国有一个指标一直在稳健增长 — — 生产率 — — 可能是这一问题最明显的迹象。
en: Paradoxically, one indicator that has been improving steadily in the US – productivity – may be the clearest sign of the problem.

zh: 当说到生产率的时候，经理们要么在员工培训、更高效的制造工艺等等上进行投资，要么采取似乎能在短期内推进生产率但是在长期内损害生产率的措施。
en: When it comes to productivity, managers either invest in employee training, more efficient manufacturing processes, and the like, or they take steps that appear to boost productivity in the short run but that erode it in the long run.

zh: 生产率是度量每工作小时产出的标准。
en: Productivity is a measure of output per hour worked.

zh: 所以，一个解雇其所有工人然后运输库存的公司可以看起来很多产 — — 直到它将库存用尽。
en: So a company that fires all its workers and then ships from stock can look very productive – until it runs outs of stock.

zh: 当然，没有公司能这样做，但是许多美国公司已经在大量剥离工人和中层经理 — — 2008年1月份的数字比去年同期增加了19 % 。
en: Of course, no company can do that, but many US companies have been shedding workers and middle managers in great numbers – the figures for January 2008 were up 19% from a year earlier.

zh: 同时，那些留下来的员工必须更加努力地工作，而且通常没有增加工资。
en: Meanwhile, those employees left behind must work that much harder, often without increased compensation.

zh: 工人的工资按通货膨胀调整后，在2007年是下降的，继续了这十年的趋势。
en: Workers’ wages, adjusted for inflation, fell in 2007, continuing a trend throughout this decade.

zh: 这也是“多产的 ” — —直到这些工作过度的人们辞职或者工作能力枯竭。
en: That, too, is “productive” – until these overworked people quit or burn out.

zh: 一个可持续的公司不是一个“人力资源”的集合，而是一个人的团体。
en: A sustainable company is not a collection of “human resources.” It is a community of human beings.

zh: 它的力量植根于它的人，它的文化以及在它的客户和供应商中建立起来的商誉。
en: Its strength resides in its people, its culture, and the goodwill it has built up among its customers and suppliers.

zh: 所以，当工人和中层经理离开这些公司的时候，他们带走的不仅是许多重要的信息，而且通常也带走了他们公司的心脏和灵魂，从而对美国的竞争力产生深远的影响。
en: So, as workers and middle managers have been departing these companies, they have taken with them not only much critical information, but often also the hearts and souls of their enterprises, with profound effects on American competitiveness.

zh: 想想高科技，在这个领域人们认为美国应该超过其他国家。
en: Consider high technology, where America is supposed to excel.

zh: 根据由知名的大学、智囊团、工业同业公会以及企业组成的美国创新前景工作小组2006年11月的报告，高科技贸易赤字到2005年已经连续三年扩大。
en: According to a November 2006 report by The Task Force on the Future of American Innovation, made up of prominent universities, think tanks, industry trade associations, and corporations, the high-tech trade deficit widened in 2005, for the third consecutive year.

zh: 这不是服装或汽车，而是美国最大最有名的出口部门。
en: This is not clothing or cars, but America’s largest, and most renowned, export sector.

zh: 这个赤字反映了一个潜在的研究不足。
en: This deficit reflects an underlying research deficit.

zh: 在2006年取得美国专利最多的25个公司中，只有8家是美国公司，有12家日本公司。
en: Of the 25 companies granted the most US patents in 2006, only eight were American; 12 were Japanese.

zh: 或许，这可以帮助说明为什么位于纽约的声誉研究所在2007年对29个国家超过6万人进行调查从而对“世界上最受尊敬的企业” 的排序中，出现在这个名单的第一家美国公司排在第15位，第二家美国公司排在第25位。
en: Perhaps this helps to explain why, in a survey of more than 60,000 people in 29 countries conducted in 2007 by the New York-based Reputation Institute to rank the “world’s most respected companies,” the first US company on the list appeared in 15th place; the second was in 25th place.

zh: 没有人能够确定最近几年美国生产率的提高有多少是由于压榨人力资本取得的，因为这样的东西没有办法进行测量的。
en: No one can determine how much of America’s productivity gains in recent years have resulted from squeezing human capital, because such things are not measured.

zh: 但是很明显，美国对这个策略有很大的依赖，因为公司剥离员工不仅仅是因为它们必须这么做，而且通常是因为它们没有达到华尔街分析家的财务预期。
en: But there has clearly been a great deal of reliance on this strategy, with companies shedding employees not only because they must, but often because they have not met Wall Street analysts’ financial expectations.

zh: 经理们增加对最大化股东价值的关注在20世纪80年代这个观点被引进来的时候赢得了许多的支持者：不考虑个人情感的金融市场法则会迫使公司变得更多产，更能创新。
en: Managers’ increased focus on maximizing shareholder value won many adherents when the idea was introduced in the 1980’s: the impersonal discipline of financial markets would force companies to become more productive and innovative.

zh: 而且，事实上，美国在20世纪80年代和90年代生产率的提高很大一部分可能要归功于在信息通信技术上的大规模投资。
en: And, in fact, much of the US productivity increase in the 1980’s and 1990’s can likely be attributed to large-scale investment in information and communications technology.

zh: 但是，当从这些投资中取得的边际生产率增加开始下降的时候，高级经理们的去留和报酬继续和股票市场的表现联系在一起。
en: But, as the marginal productivity gains from such investment began to fall, senior managers’ survival and compensation continued to be tied to stock-market performance.

zh: 结果，许多高级经理仅仅学会了以牺牲对他们的产品和顾客的关注为代价来管理他们公司短期的股票价格。
en: As a result, many simply learned to manage their companies’ short-term share price at the expense of attention to their products and customers.

zh: 而且，因为最大化股东价值对工人和中层经理来说并不是一个很好的激励因素，公司的董事会不断的以首席执行官为中心集中权力，由此鼓励了一个和公司其他人脱离的“英雄”式的领导层。
en: Moreover, because maximizing shareholder value is a poor incentive for workers and middle managers, companies’ boards have increasingly centralized power around chief executives, thereby encouraging a “heroic” form of leadership that is detached from the rest of the enterprise.

zh: 确实，在许多情况下，CEO — — 通常是华尔街认可的“超级明星”空降下来“进行彻底的整合 ” — —现在就是公司，尽管其对公司的产品、客户和竞争对手知之甚少。
en: Indeed, in many cases, the CEO – frequently a Wall Street-endorsed “superstar” parachuted in to “shake things up” – now is the company, despite having little knowledge of its products, customers, and competitors.

zh: 这种向“英雄”领导的转变可以从不断膨胀的CEO报酬可以看出。
en: This shift to “heroic” leadership can be seen in ballooning CEO compensation.

zh: 根据合益集团（Hay Group）2008年1月份的一份报告，最大的50家美国企业的CEO现在的报酬几乎是欧洲相当职位人员的三倍 — — 这比他们自己的工人的报酬多几百倍。
en: According to a January 2008 report by the Hay Group, the CEO’s of the 50 largest US companies are now paid almost three times what their European counterparts receive ­– which is many hundreds of times more than their own workers.

zh: 直到最近，美国的资产泡沫 — — 首先是股票市场的泡沫，接着是房地产市场的泡沫 — — 掩盖了美国公司潜在的衰落。
en: Until recently, the US asset-price bubble ­– first in the stock market, then in real estate – masked the underlying depreciation of American enterprises.

zh: 但是，泡沫本身是由和那些危害实体经济相同的管理弊端造成的。
en: But the bubble itself resulted from the same management pathologies as those afflicting the real economy.

zh: 毕竟，管理的短期化鼓励了抵押贷款人提供人为的低“诱惑”利率来引诱潜在的购房者。
en: After all, managing for the short run encouraged mortgage lenders to offer artificially low “teaser” interest rates to lure potential homeowners.

zh: 然后，那些购买了这些抵押的人从来不劳烦去调查它们的潜在价值 — — 这是对管理责任的严重的不负责。
en: And then those who bought these mortgages never bothered to investigate their underlying value – a spectacular abdication of managerial responsibility.

zh: 现在，泡沫已经破灭，然而美国当前的经济低迷可能比以前的低迷严重得多，因为美国企业不得不缓慢而小心地进行重建。
en: Now that the bubble has burst, America’s current economic downturn is likely to be far worse than previous ones, because US enterprises will have to be rebuilt, slowly and carefully.

zh: 美元的急剧贬值可能会帮助美国缩减其巨额的贸易赤字，但是，如果在美国的管理上没有巨大的改变，我们不应该期望能够有任何持续的改进。
en: The dramatic weakening of the US dollar may help America to narrow its massive trade deficit, but we should not expect any sustained improvement without drastic changes in American management.

zh: 幸运的是，或许可以将它对世界其他地区的不利影响降到最低。
en: Fortunately, it may be possible to minimize the fallout for the rest of the world.

zh: 虽然美国的经济学家、政治家和商业领袖多年来一直寻求将他们的管理模式兜售到国外，但是其他地区的许多公司还没有买账。
en: While American economists, politicians, and business leaders have for years sought to sell their model of management abroad, many companies elsewhere have not been buying it.

zh: 结果，其他主要经济体的经济比美国的经济要健康得多。
en: As a result, other key economies remain healthier than America’s.

zh: 别搞错：这个问题是在美国产生的，也只能在美国得到解决。
en: Make no mistake: this problem was made in America, and that is where it will have to be solved.

zh: 把美国自己击败的霸权
en: America’s Self-Defeating Hegemony

zh: 20年前撰写“历史的终结”一文时，我没有料到美国的行为和错误判断竟会使反美主义成为全球政治的重要标志线。
en: When I wrote about the “end of history” almost twenty years ago, one thing that I did not anticipate was the degree to which American behavior and misjudgments would make anti-Americanism one of the chief fault-lines of global politics.

zh: 但特别是在2001年9月11日的恐怖袭击后，这一事实已经摆在面前，究其原因与布什政府所犯的四大错误有关。
en: And yet, particularly since the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, that is precisely what has happened, owing to four key mistakes made by the Bush administration.

zh: 首先，为回应2001年袭击制定的“先发制人”的总体策略被不恰当地扩大到涵盖伊拉克和其它威胁要发展大规模杀伤性武器的其它所谓“流氓”国家。
en: First, the doctrine of “preemption,” which was devised in response to the 2001 attacks, was inappropriately broadened to include Iraq and other so-called “rogue states” that threatened to develop weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 可以肯定的是，用先发制人的策略对待挥舞大规模杀伤性武器的无国家恐怖分子是合理的。
en: To be sure, preemption is fully justified vis-à-vis stateless terrorists wielding such weapons.

zh: 但这样的策略却不能成为所有不扩散政策的核心，在这种政策的指导下，美国四处进行军事干预，目的是防止核武器的发展。
en: But it cannot be the core of a general non-proliferation policy, whereby the United States intervenes militarily everywhere to prevent the development of nuclear weapons.

zh: 执行上述政策的成本太过昂贵（在伊拉克造成了数千亿美元的损失和数万平民的伤亡，这个数字还在不断扩大 ） 。
en: The cost of executing such a policy simply would be too high (several hundred billion dollars and tens of thousands of casualties in Iraq and still counting).

zh: 布什政府也因此躲避与北朝鲜和伊朗的军事对峙，尽管美国对以色列1981年空袭伊拉克的奥西拉克反应堆表示赞赏，因为那次行动使萨达姆的核计划延迟了几年之久。
en: This is why the Bush administration has shied away from military confrontations with North Korea and Iran, despite its veneration of Israel’s air strike on Iraq’s Osirak reactor in 1981, which set back Saddam Hussein’s nuclear program by several years.

zh: 但归根结底，那次袭击的成功本身意味着这样有限度的干涉不可能复制，因为可能的扩散者都学会了埋藏、隐蔽或复制它们新生的武器计划。
en: After all, the very success of that attack meant that such limited intervention could never be repeated, because would-be proliferators learned to bury, hide, or duplicate their nascent weapons programs.

zh: 重要失误二是错误地判断了世界各国对美国行使霸权可能做出的反应。
en: The second important miscalculation concerned the likely global reaction to America’s exercise of its hegemonic power.

zh: 布什政府中很多人认为即使没有得到联合国安理会或北约的批准，出兵成功也会让美国使用军事力量变得合法化。
en: Many people within the Bush administration believed that even without approval by the UN Security Council or NATO, American power would be legitimized by its successful use.

zh: 这在冷战期间和20世纪90年代的巴尔干是许多美国行动的惯用模式，那时候，人们把这称之为“领导”而不是“单边主义 ” 。
en: This had been the pattern for many US initiatives during the Cold War, and in the Balkans during the 1990’s; back then, it was known as “leadership” rather than “unilateralism.”

zh: 但是，伊拉克战争爆发时，条件已经发生了变化：美国相对于世界其它国家力量变得如此强大，缺乏协商互动即便对美国最亲密的盟友来说也成为了愤怒的源泉。
en: But, by the time of the Iraq war, conditions had changed: the US had grown so powerful relative to the rest of the world that the lack of reciprocity became an intense source of irritation even to America’s closest allies.

zh: 全球权力分配所引发的结构性反美运动在伊拉克战争爆发前就非常明显，这与克林顿在任时由美国领导的全球化形成了鲜明的对照。
en: The structural anti-Americanism arising from the global distribution of power was evident well before the Iraq war, in the opposition to American-led globalization during the Clinton years.

zh: 但布什政府上任后“当面”对很多国际机构不理不睬使反美情绪进一步恶化 — — 这种模式通过发动伊拉克战争仍然得以延续。
en: But it was exacerbated by the Bush administration’s “in-your-face” disregard for a variety of international institutions as soon it came into office – a pattern that continued through the onset of the Iraq war.

zh: 美国的第三个错误是过高估计了传统军事力量在对待国际政治中典型的弱国和跨国组织网络中所起的作用，至少在泛中东地区的确如此。
en: America’s third mistake was to overestimate how effective conventional military power would be in dealing with the weak states and networked transnational organizations that characterize international politics, at least in the broader Middle East.

zh: 值得思考的是，为什么一个军事力量超过人类历史上任何国家，并且在军事上所耗资金相当于所有其它国家总和的民族，在长达3年的占领后仍然不能在一个只有2400万人口的小国实现和平。
en: It is worth pondering why a country with more military power than any other in human history, and that spends as much on its military as virtually the rest of the world combined, cannot bring security to a small country of 24 million people after more than three years of occupation.

zh: 这其中至少部分原因在于美国所面对的不是能执行规则的集中的社会力量，因此也就无法通过传统军力对它们进行牵制、强迫或者操纵。
en: At least part of the problem is that it is dealing with complex social forces that are not organized into centralized hierarchies that can enforce rules, and thus be deterred, coerced, or otherwise manipulated through conventional power.

zh: 在认为能够利用强大的常规军事力量在去年夏天的黎巴嫩战争中摧毁真主党的问题上，以色列也犯下了类似的错误。
en: Israel made a similar mistake in thinking that it could use its enormous margin of conventional military power to destroy Hezbollah in last summer’s Lebanon War.

zh: 以色列和美国都非常怀念21世纪的民族国家世界，它们有这样的想法顺理成章，因为在那个世界里，它们所拥有的传统力量最容易发挥作用。
en: Both Israel and the US are nostalgic for a twentieth-century world of nation-states, which is understandable, since that is the world to which the kind of conventional power they possess is best suited.

zh: 可是怀旧情绪使得这两个国家错误地估计了目前所面临的挑战，无论是把基地组织与萨达姆·侯赛因的伊拉克连在一起，还是把真主党与伊朗和叙利亚扯到一块都是这种错误的典型表现。
en: But nostalgia has led both states to misinterpret the challenges they now face, whether by linking al-Qaeda to Saddam Hussein’s Iraq, or Hezbollah to Iran and Syria.

zh: 在涉及真主党的问题上这种联系的确存在，但网络之中的各派势力有着它们自身的社会根基，而并不单纯是被地区力量操纵的木偶。
en: This linkage does exist in the case of Hezbollah, but the networked actors have their own social roots and are not simply pawns used by regional powers.

zh: 这就解释了为什么使用传统力量只能带来令人沮丧的结果。
en: This is why the exercise of conventional power has become frustrating.

zh: 最后，布什政府对军力的运用不仅缺乏强制性的策略或规范，单就实力而言也明显不足。
en: Finally, the Bush administration’s use of power has lacked not only a compelling strategy or doctrine, but also simple competence.

zh: 仅就伊拉克来讲，布什政府错误地估计了大规模杀伤性武器的力量，也未能制定充分的占领计划，而后又在情况发生时未能迅速地适应调节。
en: In Iraq alone, the administration misestimated the threat of WMD, failed to plan adequately for the occupation, and then proved unable to adjust quickly when things went wrong.

zh: 迄今为止，美国已经在伊拉克所有简单问题，比如为民主宣传筹集资金上暂停了一切运作。
en: To this day, it has dropped the ball on very straightforward operational issues in Iraq, such as funding democracy promotion efforts.

zh: 执行方面的受阻带来了战略性的恶果。
en: Incompetence in implementation has strategic consequences.

zh: 那些高声呼吁对伊拉克作战，而后又把局势搞得一团糟的势力现在又在煽动对伊朗作战。
en: Many of the voices that called for, and then bungled, military intervention in Iraq are now calling for war with Iran.

zh: 世界其它国家凭什么要相信这些人在与更大更坚决的��人作战时能处理得更好？
en: Why should the rest of the world think that conflict with a larger and more resolute enemy would be handled any more capably?

zh: 但最根本的问题依然是国际体系中不平衡的权力分配。
en: But the fundamental problem remains the lopsided distribution of power in the international system.

zh: 任何与美国有同等地位的国家，即使是民主国家，都会经不住诱惑越来越肆无忌惮地行使自己的支配权力。
en: Any country in the same position as the US, even a democracy, would be tempted to exercise its hegemonic power with less and less restraint.

zh: 美国的建国之父们同样认为不受任何限制的权力，即使在政治上合理合法，同样也充满了危险，也正基于这样的考虑，他们才建立了内部分权的宪法制度，以便对领导人进行牵制。
en: America’s founding fathers were motivated by a similar belief that unchecked power, even when democratically legitimated, could be dangerous, which is why they created a constitutional system of internally separated powers to limit the executive.

zh: 今天全球范围内并没有这样的体系存在，这也许可以解释美国陷入麻烦的原因。
en: Such a system does not exist on a global scale today, which may explain how America got into such trouble.

zh: 更为均衡的权力分配，即便在不完全民主的全球体制下，也会减少放弃谨慎使用权力的诱惑。
en: A smoother international distribution of power, even in a global system that is less than fully democratic, would pose fewer temptations to abandon the prudent exercise of power.

zh: 美国自作自受的衰退
en: America’s Self-Inflicted Decline

zh: 墨尔本 — — 如果持续了六十年之久的二战后大面积繁荣嘎然而止，美国和欧洲都要对此负责。
en: MELBOURNE – If the broad post-World War II prosperity that has endured for six decades comes to an end, both the United States and Europe will be responsible.

zh: 政治已经在整个西方世界成为令人不齿的职业，在这个问题上几乎没有任何区别。
en: With rare exceptions, politics has become a discredited profession throughout the West.

zh: 明天总是比下周重要、而下周比明年重要，没有人努力追求长远的未来。
en: Tomorrow is always treated as more important than next week, and next week prevails over next year, with no one seeking to secure the long-term future.

zh: 现在西方正在为此付出代价。
en: Now the West is paying the price.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马总统的直觉或许是个例外，但他不仅要对抗美国强大的保守势力，还要对抗比保守势力更糟的以茶党形式存在的蛊惑人心的民粹主义 — — 这可能导致他在2012年竞选失败，并进而严重损害美国的利益。
en: President Barack Obama’s instincts may be an exception here, but he is fighting powerful hidebound forces in the United States, as well as a demagogic populism, in the form of the Tea Party, that is far worse – and that might defeat him in 2012, seriously damaging America in the process.

zh: 美国在世界各地的盟友惊异地注视着最近因提高联邦政府债务上限而引发的口水战，他们惊讶于美国国会无法达成任何均衡而具前瞻性的折衷协议。
en: America’s friends around the world watched with dismay the recent brawl in over raising the federal government’s debt ceiling, and the US Congress’s inability to come to anything like a balanced and forward-looking compromise.

zh: 相反，这样的结果代表着茶党喽罗的巨大胜利，他们的目标是最大限度地压缩政府的债务和开支（某些人甚至反对设立央行 ） ， 并继续实行乔治·W·布什总统令人愤慨的富裕阶层减税优惠。
en: On the contrary, the outcome represents a significant victory for the Tea Party’s minions, whose purpose seems to be to reduce government obligations and expenditures to a bare minimum (some object even to having a central bank), and to maintain President George W. Bush’s outrageous tax breaks for the wealthy.

zh: 美国目前财政问题的根源在于长期没有来源的开支。
en: America’s current fiscal problems are rooted in a long period of unfunded spending.

zh: 布什的阿富汗和伊拉克战争和他开展“全球反恐战争”的做法使得整体状况迅速恶化，导致局势完全无法持续。
en: Bush’s wars in Afghanistan and Iraq, and the manner in which he conducted the “global war on terror” made matters much worse, contributing to a totally unsustainable situation.

zh: 事实上，奥巴马接过的是几乎毫无希望的烂摊子。
en: Indeed, Obama inherited an almost impossible legacy.

zh: 债务上限协议达成数周后，人们越来越清楚地意识到合理治政在美国或许是不可能的。
en: In the weeks since the debt ceiling agreement, it has become increasingly clear that good government might be impossible in the US.

zh: 今后几个月的美国总统竞选将会争论哪些开支应该削减，而类似的争吵其实毫无意义。
en: The coming months of campaigning for the US presidency will be spent in petty brawling over what should be cut.

zh: 近几周的例子让我们没有理由乐观地认为美国议员会摆脱党派之争的束缚，扪心自问怎样做才最符合美国的利益。
en: The example of recent weeks gives us no cause for optimism that US legislators will rise above partisan politics and ask themselves what is best for America.

zh: 在这种情况下，金融市场回归极度动荡原本不足为奇。
en: In these circumstances, it is not surprising that financial markets have returned to extreme volatility.

zh: 债务上限辩论结果授权的开支削减将压缩经济活动，进而破坏增长，进一步增加减债的难度。
en: The expenditure cuts mandated by the outcome of the debt-ceiling debate will reduce economic activity, thereby undermining growth and making debt reduction even more difficult.

zh: 进一步施加财政刺激推动经济发展也将伴随相应的风险，既因为债务上限，也因为另一种更为不详的因素：美国已经过度负债，有迹象表明美国国债主要持有人最终厌倦了被偿以贬值的货币。
en: Providing further fiscal stimulus to boost economic growth would carry its own risks, owing to the debt ceiling and another, more ominous factor: America is already overly indebted, and there are signs that major holders of US government securities are finally tired of being repaid in depreciated currency.

zh: 更为重要的是，中国呼吁引入全新储备货币是因其懊恼于美国和欧洲等主要国家政府无力在管理自己的经济事务时表现出现实的态度和良好的判断力。
en: Most importantly, China’s call for the introduction of a new reserve currency stems from its frustration with the failure of major governments – whether in the US or Europe – to govern their economic affairs with realism and good sense.

zh: 中国认识到美国面临的巨大困难（事实上，中国对这一点的认识比美国本身更清晰 ） ， 而且鉴于目前在华盛顿占主导地位的有毒政治氛围，回归合理执政、经济稳定和强劲增长的健康状况其实并不容易。
en: China recognizes that America is in great difficulty (indeed, it recognizes this more clearly than the US itself), and that, given the poisonous political atmosphere prevailing in Washington, there will be no easy return to good government, economic stability, and strong growth.

zh: 美国对世界事务的领导力随布什奉行单边主义开始削弱，而今天的经济问题正在强化这一趋势。
en: America’s leadership in world affairs began to weaken with the unilateralism of Bush, and today’s economic problems are reinforcing this tendency.

zh: 奥巴马需要两党协力支持其（相当主流的）政策来扭转美国衰落的颓势，但截至目前美国国会对履行立法责任时秉承坚持原则的态度似乎不感兴趣。
en: To reverse America’s decline, Obama needs bipartisan support for his (quite mainstream) policies, but so far the US Congress has shown no stomach for a principled approach to its legislative duties.

zh: 如果德国三心二意的欧洲稳定行动不知怎样取得了成功，美国的地位会遭到进一步侵蚀，而世界各国的中央银行也将开始再次将欧元视为替代美元的可靠储备货币。
en: If Germany’s half-hearted efforts to stabilize Europe somehow turn out to be successful, America’s position will be further eroded, and central banks around the world will begin to regard the euro once again as a reliable alternative to the dollar as a reserve currency.

zh: 中国已经提出的替代方案是推出新的储备货币。
en: The alternative, as China has suggested, would be to develop a new reserve currency.

zh: 当前的现实状况折射出我们这一生中从未经历过的���种权力转移。
en: These realities represent a power shift of a kind that we have not experienced in our lifetimes.

zh: 中国相对于美国已经积累了可观的经济优势，这不仅会制约美国在金融市场的影响，而且会限制其动用军力的能力。
en: China’s economic power over the US is now substantial, and will limit not only America’s influence in the financial markets, but also its capacity to use military power.

zh: 如果美国能因此被迫退回到国际关系学者约瑟夫·奈所谓的“软实力和多边外交”时代，这很可能不失为一件好事。
en: If this forces America back towards what the international-relations scholar Joseph Nye calls “soft power and multilateral diplomacy,” it may well be a good thing.

zh: 但这种处事方式在美国共和党，特别是其茶党派系看来无异于一种诅咒，他们可能让被中国日益增长的军事实力弄得紧张兮兮的众多亚洲人丧失勇气。
en: But such approaches are anathema to the US Republican Party, and to its Tea Party faction in particular, and they might unnerve the many Asians who are nervous at China’s growing military might.

zh: 中国卖出或不再继续买入美国国债会像伤及美国那样有损于中国的反面论调并没有充分的依据。
en: The counter-argument – that any sell-off or failure by China to continue to buy US government securities would hurt China as much as America – is not valid.

zh: 年复一年，中国市场日益向全球拓展，其国内市场也在国内生产总值中开始占据越来越大的百分比。
en: As each year passes, China’s markets expand worldwide, and its domestic market comes to represent a greater percentage of its own GDP.

zh: 这将导致中国长期来看不再需要强势美元的支持。
en: As a result, China will not need a strong dollar in the long term.

zh: 美国必须在中国丧失支持美元的兴趣之前整顿好国内经济秩序。
en: Americans need to get their economic house in order before China loses its incentive to support the dollar.

zh: 在二战结束后的几次战争中，美国从惨痛的代价中学到了军事实力的有效运用无法解决所有问题。
en: On several occasions in the post-WWII period, the US has learned with great pain that there are limits to the effective use of military power.

zh: 美国的目标无法在越南实现。
en: American objectives could not be achieved in Vietnam.

zh: 美国军队从伊拉克撤军前根本无法确定伊拉克的最终局势。
en: The outcome in Iraq will not be determined until the last American troops have been withdrawn.

zh: 在撤军日期已经确定的阿富汗，很难相信有凝聚力的统一国家将得以最终建立。
en: In Afghanistan, where withdrawal dates have already been set, it is difficult to believe that a cohesive unified state can be established.

zh: 随着军事力量效果的削弱，经济力量的重要性却越来越突出。
en: As the efficacy of military power is reduced, so the importance of economic power grows.

zh: 切实承认上述核心现实和最终解决所需的两党合作对美国、还有西方的未来都是至关重要的。
en: Recognition of these central realities – and bipartisanship in addressing them – is critical for America’s future, and that of the West.

zh: 美国针对富人的“社会主义”
en: America’s Socialism for the Rich

zh: 正当人们谈论金融危机复苏之际，美国的银行业同时在重新考虑如何加强监管。
en: With all the talk of “green shoots” of economic recovery, America’s banks are pushing back on efforts to regulate them.

zh: 为了以防止另一次危机的发生，政治人物也在谈论如何改革监管规范。 还有一个我们必须关注的领域 — — 银行正在重整旗鼓，想要回复到往日的辉煌。
en: While politicians talk about their commitment to regulatory reform to prevent a recurrence of the crisis, this is one area where the devil really is in the details – and the banks will muster what muscle they have left to ensure that they have ample room to continue as they have in the past.

zh: 过去的体系对银行非常有利（虽然对股东是否有利就另说了 ） ， 如此说来，他们为什么要改变呢？
en: The old system worked well for the bankers (if not for their shareholders), so why should they embrace change?

zh: 实际上，我们在危机后作出了的大量努力，但收效却甚微，银行比以前更没有竞争力，那些因为规模庞大而没法倒闭的银行变得规模更加庞大。
en: Indeed, the efforts to rescue them devoted so little thought to the kind of post-crisis financial system we want that we will end up with a banking system that is less competitive, with the large banks that were too big too fail even larger.

zh: 大家早就知道一个事实：美国银行不仅大的不能倒闭，而且如此庞大的规模也不利于管理。
en: It has long been recognized that those America’s banks that are too big to fail are also too big to be managed.

zh: 这也是他们一直经营不善的原因所在。
en: That is one reason that the performance of several of them has been so dismal.

zh: 每当他们运转失灵之时，政府就出面重组，提供存款信用保险，同时持有银行的股份。
en: Because government provides deposit insurance, it plays a large role in restructuring (unlike other sectors).  Normally, when a bank fails, the government engineers a financial restructuring; if it has to put in money, it, of course, gains a stake in the future.

zh: 政府官员们深知，如果他们救援稍缓出台，那些“僵尸”或是濒临“僵尸”银行 — — 几乎没有净资产 ， “ 死马”还被当作“活马”来医 — — 为了自保，很有可能会放手一搏。
en: Officials know that if they wait too long, zombie or near zombie banks – with little or no net worth, but treated as if they were viable institutions – are likely to “gamble on resurrection.”

zh: 如果冒险成功，他们自然会转危为安，如果失败，那就留给政府来“埋单”了。
en: If they take big bets and win, they walk away with the proceeds; if they fail, the government picks up the tab.

zh: 这不仅仅是我们的想象，而是有前车之鉴。
en: This is not just theory; it is a lesson we learned, at great expense, during the Savings & Loan crisis of the 1980’s.

zh: 在1980年代时发生的储贷危机中，当时的ATM机没有“足够现金 ” ， 政府被迫出手救助，以避免资金枯竭导致存款人血本无归。
en: When the ATM machine says, “insufficient funds,” the government doesn’t want this to mean that the bank, rather than your account, is out of money, so it intervenes before the till is empty.

zh: 在通常的金融重组中，股东一般承担损失所有的投资损失，而债券持有人往往成为新的股东。
en: In a financial restructuring, shareholders typically get wiped out, and bondholders become the new shareholders.

zh: 政府有可能提供额外的资金，而新的投资者必须接管倒闭的银行。
en: Sometimes, the government must provide additional funds; sometimes it looks for a new investor to take over the failed bank.

zh: 然而，奥巴马政府引入一个新的概念：过于庞大的银行不能进行重组。
en: The Obama administration has, however, introduced a new concept: too big to be financially restructured.

zh: 不能以常规的方法来治理这些规模庞大的银行。 因为如果想要改组银行,市场会出现恐慌。
en: The administration argues that all hell would break loose if we tried to play by the usual rules with these big banks.

zh: 所以说不仅不能碰债券人，甚至连股东都不能碰 — — 所有的一切只能依赖于政府的救助计划。
en: Markets would panic. So, not only can’t we touch the bondholders, we can’t even touch the shareholders – even if most of the shares’ existing value merely reflects a bet on a government bailout.

zh: 我个人认为这个思路是错误的。
en: I think this judgment is wrong.

zh: 奥巴马政府可能是在政治的压力和大银行的误导下作出的判断。
en: I think the Obama administration has succumbed to political pressure and scare-mongering by the big banks.

zh: 他把救助银行和救助银行的股东和债权人混为一谈了。
en: As a result, the administration has confused bailing out the bankers and their shareholders with bailing out the banks.

zh: 重组给了银行一个新生的机会：新的投资者（不论是资产抵押或是债券重组）将更有信心，其他银行也会乐于把资金借给他们。 对于债券人来说。
en: Restructuring gives banks a chance for a new start: new potential investors (whether in equity or debt instruments) will have more confidence, other banks will be more willing to lend to them, and they will be more willing to lend to others.

zh: 如果银行资产的实际价值比市场的价格要高，他们自然会得到补偿。 由此而受益。
en: The bondholders will gain from an orderly restructuring, and if the value of the assets is truly greater than the market (and outside analysts) believe, they will eventually reap the gains.

zh: 显而易见的是，奥巴马的战略在目前和将来成本都会很高 — — 目前看来，他并没有实现预定的有限目标：那就是重新启动借贷活动。
en: But what is clear is that the Obama strategy’s current and future costs are very high – and so far, it has not achieved its limited objective of restarting lending.

zh: 纳税人已经掏出了数百亿美元，而且很可能在将来掏出更多个百亿美元来担保。
en: The taxpayer has had to pony up billions, and has provided billions more in guarantees – bills that are likely to come due in the future.

zh: 重新改写市场经济的规则不仅仅是金融业蒙受到损失，获利者往往是那些金融危机的始作俑者。
en: Rewriting the rules of the market economy – in a way that has benefited those that have caused so much pain to the entire global economy – is worse than financially costly.

zh: 绝大多数的美国人认为这非常不公平，特别是他们看到银行接受到数百亿美元救助后，忙着给自己支付巨额的奖金和分红之后。
en: Most Americans view it as grossly unjust, especially after they saw the banks divert the billions intended to enable them to revive lending to payments of outsized bonuses and dividends.

zh: 撕毁社会合同不能如此的轻率。
en: Tearing up the social contract is something that should not be done lightly.

zh: 如果采取如此的改革方案：也就是赚钱归个人，赔钱则由社会大众承担。
en: But this new form of ersatz capitalism, in which losses are socialized and profits privatized, is doomed to failure.

zh: 这样的做法注定要失败。
en: Incentives are distorted.

zh: 既然激励机制失灵了，哪里有什么市场游戏的规则可言？
en: There is no market discipline.

zh: 那些庞大到不能被重组的银行知道他们可以毫无顾忌地赌博 — — 因为美联储提供利率几乎为零的资金，而资金可以源源不断地提供。
en: The too-big-to-be-restructured banks know that they can gamble with impunity – and, with the Federal Reserve making funds available at near-zero interest rates, there are ample funds to do so.

zh: 一些人把这种新的经济形式成为“美国式的社会主义 ” 。
en: Some have called this new economic regime “socialism with American characteristics.”

zh: 但社会主义关注的是普通人的利益。
en: But socialism is concerned about ordinary individuals.

zh: 与此相反的是，美国并没有给数百万失去家园的普通美国人提供帮助。
en: By contrast, the United States has provided little help for the millions of Americans who are losing their homes.

zh: 失业的工人仅仅得到39个星期的有限失业救助，之后只能自谋出路。
en: Workers who lose their jobs receive only 39 weeks of limited unemployment benefits, and are then left on their own.

zh: 当他们失去了工作，同时也失去了健康医疗保险。
en: And, when they lose their jobs, most lose their health insurance, too.

zh: 美国正在无休止地对公司提供安全保障，从商业银行到投资银行，然后是保险公司，现在是汽车行业，看来被救助的名单还远远没有完结。
en: America has expanded its corporate safety net in unprecedented ways, from commercial banks to investment banks, then to insurance, and now to automobiles, with no end in sight.

zh: 实际上，这不是社会主义，而是长期的公司福利主义的延伸。
en: In truth, this is not socialism, but an extension of long standing corporate welfarism.

zh: 有钱有权的人可以伸手向政府求助，而普通大众却没什么社会保障。
en: The rich and powerful turn to the government to help them whenever they can, while needy individuals get little social protection.

zh: 我们必须拆分这些庞大而不能倒闭的银行。 没有任何证据可以说明这些“金融怪兽”在接受救援后，会给社会大众带来任何好处。
en: We need to break up the too-big-to-fail banks; there is no evidence that these behemoths deliver societal benefits that are commensurate with the costs they have imposed on others.

zh: 如果他们不被拆分，我们也要大大限制他们的权限。
en: And, if we don’t break them up, then we have to severely limit what they do.

zh: 让他们不能还像过去那样为所欲为 — — 赌博后的损失由其他人来承担。
en: They can’t be allowed to do what they did in the past – gamble at others’ expenses.

zh: 对于这些金融怪兽来说，还有一个值得关注的问题：他们有着非常强大的政治势力。
en: This raises another problem with America’s too-big-to-fail, too-big-to-be-restructured banks: they are too politically powerful.

zh: 他们游说团的工作非常有效：先是减少监管，然后是纳税人来给他们收拾残局。
en: Their lobbying efforts worked well, first to deregulate, and then to have taxpayers pay for the cleanup.

zh: 正如他们所述求的那样，不顾纳税人和全球经济的死活，还想再一次地全身而退。
en: Their hope is that it will work once again to keep them free to do as they please, regardless of the risks for taxpayers and the economy.

zh: 这次，我们不能再让他们得逞。
en: We cannot afford to let that happen.

zh: 美国坐视中国崛起
en: America’s Sputnik Moment in Beijing

zh: 纽约 - - 2008年8月8日或许会成为后美国时代的第一天，也许会是另一个“人造卫星”升天的日子。
en: NEW YORK – August 8, 2008, may someday be remembered as the first day of the post-American era.

zh: 1957年，苏联进入外层空间，美国人民意识到他们的国家衰落了，于是就决心重振旗鼓。
en: Or it could be remembered as another “Sputnik moment,” when, as with the Soviet foray into outer space in 1957, the American people realized that the country had lost its footing and decided it was time for the United States to get its act together.

zh: 人们不会误解8月8日北京奥运会开幕式的象征意义和震撼力。
en: There was no mistaking the power and symbolism of the opening ceremonies for the Beijing Olympic Games on August 8.

zh: 这一多媒体盛会绝不仅仅是回顾中国五千年的文明史；它也是向世人宣布，中国是一个文明古国，要求在全球体系中占有一席之地，而且也理应如此。
en: That multimedia spectacular did far more than trace China’s 5,000-year history; it was a statement that China is a major civilization that demands and deserves its rightful place in the global hierarchy.

zh: 美国总统布什从露天看台高兴地挥手示意，而中国主席胡锦涛则端坐在好似王座的位置上。 人们也不会误解这里的象征意义。
en: There was also no mistaking the symbolism of seeing President Bush, waving cheerfully from his spot in the bleachers while Chinese President Hu Jintao sat behind what looked more like a throne.

zh: 中国政府一向对外交礼节斤斤计较，因此，人们难以想象，中国政府并无刻意安排，从而显示出美国相对于持有一万四千亿美元国债的国家衰落这一鲜明形象。
en: It is hard to imagine that China’s government, which obsesses over every minute issue of diplomatic protocol, had not orchestrated this stark image of America’s decline relative to the country to which it owes $1.4 trillion.

zh: 难以想象罗斯福或者里根会接受这样类似的居于人下的位置。
en: It would be hard to imagine Franklin Roosevelt or Ronald Reagan accepting a similar relative position.

zh: 就在布什在看台上挥手的时候，俄国正在入侵美国在高加索最紧密的伙伴格鲁吉亚。
en: At the very same time that Bush was waving from the stands, Russia was invading Georgia, America’s closest partner in the Caucasus.

zh: 俄国明确向倾西方的前苏联加盟共和国发出信号，那就是，美国保护不了你们。
en: Russia’s message to other West-leaning countries in the former Soviet world was clear: America cannot protect you.

zh: 令人害怕的是，俄国或许是对的。 美国本来就身陷伊拉克泥潭，难以在全球施加实力。
en: Frighteningly, the Russians were likely correct.

zh: 加之美国债务不断加重，与敌友发生冲突，对于正在改变的世界没有任何现实的应对战略，而其政治体制看似无法采取行动来处理这些挑战。 这些因素汇集起来把美国变成了一个疲于奔命的巨人。
en: While the Iraq quagmire has made it difficult for America to project force around the world, America’s growing debt, conflicts with friends and enemies alike, absence of any perceivable strategy for changing times, and its political system’s seeming inability to take action to address these challenges have combined to turn America into a struggling giant.

zh: 如今，在达尔富尔、津巴布韦以及格鲁吉亚等世界各地，人们正在见证正在成形的后美国世界的影响，而这一景象并不十分好看。
en: Today, from Iran to Darfur to Zimbabwe to Georgia, the world is witnessing the effects of a budding post-American world, and the picture does not look pretty.

zh: 美国在过去五十年里无论有多少缺陷，但毕竟还是一个良性的强国。 尽管我们重视中国和印度等新强国的兴起，但是，这些国家是否会像美国那样还有待观察。
en: As much as we all value the rise of new powers like China and India, it remains to be seen whether these countries will become as benevolent a power as America, however flawed, has been over the past half-century.

zh: 新殖民主义正在重返非洲，全球人权事业正在倒退，而世界贸易体系则相比变得远为封闭。
en: Neo-colonialism is returning to Africa, the global project of human rights is in retreat, and the world trade system is becoming far less open.

zh: 残忍的独裁者逍遥法外，因为他们受到在其自然资源中应有利益的大国保护。
en: Brutal dictators go unpunished because their interests are protected by large powers with stakes in their natural resources.

zh: 扭转这一趋势不仅符合美国的利益，也符合世界的利益。
en: Reversing this trend is not only in America’s interest, but also in the world’s interest.

zh: 为此，美国必须确认其所面临的巨大挑战并且加以解决，这要从零做起。 美国的政治竞选经费结构导致政府资金大量误用，必须加以解决。
en: To do so, Americans must identify and address the great challenges the United States faces, starting from the ground up.

zh: 美国的教育体系参差不齐，病态百出，必须予以恢复生机。 要建立积极从全球招募精英的移民体系，迅速赋予他们美国公民资格。
en: Fixing America’s campaign finance structure, which leads to massive misallocations of government funds, resuscitating America’s wildly uneven and often moribund education system, building an immigration system that actively recruits the most talented people from around the world via a fast track to US citizenship, and developing a national energy policy that moves the US far more quickly toward energy independence would all be important steps in this direction.

zh: 努力重新建立起超越党派分歧的外交政策共识也将会让美国成为一个对于全球友邦和盟国而言更为可以预料的伙伴国家。
en: Working to rebuild the traditional bipartisan foreign-policy consensus would also make the US a far more predictable partner to friends and allies around the world.

zh: 而且，美国也必须是一个值得尊重的伙伴国家，从而鼓励中国和印度等崛起大国在国际事务中发挥更为具有建设性的作用。
en: And America must be a respectful partner in order to encourage rising powers like India and China to play more constructive roles in international affairs.

zh: 世界尚未准备好迎接后美国时代，而印度和中国等国家必须在巩固现有世界和平机制上发挥远远更大的作用。 在必要的时候要建立新的机制以促进全球安全、尊严、人权和繁荣议程。
en: The world is not ready for the post-American era, and countries like China and India must play a far greater role in strengthening the existing institutions of world peace and, where appropriate, building new ones that can promote a positive agenda of security, dignity, rights, and prosperity across the globe.

zh: 而且，在做到以前，世界需要一种新型的美国领导人。 这一领导人应该能够鼓舞美国人民和全球伙伴一道解决其国内外问题，促进建立共同议程，而这一议程应当像六十年前从二战废墟上建立起来的秩序一样果敢和进步。
en: The world community is not there yet, and until it is, the world needs a new kind of American leader – a leader able to inspire Americans to fix their problems at home and work with partners across the globe in promoting a common agenda as bold and progressive as the order built from the ashes of World War II 60 years ago.

zh: 北京奥运会对于美国而言也许会成为苏联卫星升天时刻，鼓舞这一国家有意义地面对纷繁变化的世界。
en: The Beijing Olympics could be remembered as a new “Sputnik moment” for the US, inspiring the country to meaningfully face the music of a changing world.

zh: 但是只有直面其所面临的巨大挑战并且采取大胆的步骤解决这些挑战，美国才能在国内外与盟友携手取得成功。
en: But America can make it so only by recognizing the great challenges it faces and taking bold steps towards addressing them, at home and with allies abroad.

zh: 美国的支点岌岌可危
en: America’s Perilous Pivot

zh: 马德里 — — 太平洋还是中东？
en: MADRID – The Pacific or the Middle East?

zh: 这是美国当前面临的首要战略问题。
en: For the United States, that is now the primary strategic question.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马在金边会见亚洲领导人时加沙发生暴力事件是对美国两难困境的完美诠释。
en: The violence in Gaza, coming as President Barack Obama was meeting Asia’s leaders in Phnom Penh, perfectly encapsulates America’s dilemma.

zh: 奥巴马非但无法关注亚洲这个美国外交政策的“支点 ” ， 反而被迫在与埃及和以色列领导人的谈判中耗费大量时间，并指派国务卿希拉里·克林顿离开亚洲，以便促成在加沙地区达成停火协议。
en: Instead of being able to focus on US foreign policy’s “pivot” to Asia, Obama was forced to spend many hours in conversation with the leaders of Egypt and Israel, and to dispatch Secretary of State Hillary Clinton from Asia, in order to facilitate a cease-fire in Gaza.

zh: 上述两个吸引美国关注的地缘政治焦点中，一个代表未来、另一个则代表过去。
en: Of the two geopolitical focal points demanding America’s attention, one represents the future and the other the past.

zh: 尽管亚洲在美国总统竞选中发挥了重要作用，中国的崛起问题被反复提及，但美国数十年来一直深陷于中东问题。
en: Whereas Asia played an important role in a US presidential election campaign that was marked by often-heated references to China’s rise, the Middle East has kept the US bogged down for decades.

zh: 除永恒不变的巴以冲突外，伊拉克的混乱局势、阿拉伯之春、叙利亚内战和伊朗目前的核僵局都吸引着美国的注意力。
en: In addition to the eternal Israel-Palestine conflict, Iraq’s instability, the Arab Spring, Syria’s civil war, and the ongoing nuclear standoff with Iran all demand America’s attention.

zh: 如果伊朗危机失控，美国的外交重点将不再是亚洲问题。
en: If the Iran crisis were to boil over, the pivot to Asia would no longer be America’s main foreign-policy priority.

zh: 但如果能以外交手段解决和伊朗的争端，中东问题或许可能像奥巴马总统明确期望的那样转移到不那么重要的位置。
en: But if the dispute with Iran is resolved diplomatically, the Middle East might, perhaps, be relegated to a position of lesser importance, as Obama clearly desires.

zh: 因此问题在于美国是否会在对中东能源依赖度日益降低的同时被该地区爆发的另一场战争所波及。
en: The question, therefore, is whether the US will find itself drawn into another war in a region on which it depends less and less for energy.

zh: 事实上，根据国际能源机构的近期预测，打破常规的碳氢化合物（特别是页岩油气）革命到2020年将使美国成为世界最大产油国，而到2030年则将成为最大产能国，由此产生的全球反响将不容小觑。
en: Indeed, the revolution in non-conventional hydrocarbons, particularly shale gas and oil, which the International Energy Agency recently predicted would make the US the world’s largest oil producer by 2020, and the top energy producer overall by 2030, will have enormous global repercussions.

zh: 对美国而言，能源自给是分阶段从中东撤军的完美借口；一旦摆脱对能源的依赖，美国就可以集中精力处理太平洋事务。
en: For the US, energy self-sufficiency is the perfect excuse for a phased withdrawal from the Middle East; freed from energy dependency, America should be able to concentrate on the Pacific.

zh: 尽管保持全球能源价格稳定和与以色列联盟的需要意味着美国无法从中东烦恼中彻底脱身， 但战略重点向亚洲的转移早在奥巴马的首届任期内已经开始，克林顿甚至早在美国从伊拉克撤军前就宣布了美国战略重点的转移。
en: Although maintaining stable global energy prices and its alliance with Israel means that the US cannot cut itself off completely from the Middle East’s troubles, the shift in focus to Asia began early in Obama’s first administration, with Clinton announcing America’s strategic reorientation even before US troops began withdrawing from Iraq.

zh: 竞选连任后，奥巴马的首次国外访问选择了缅甸、泰国和柬埔寨 — — 中国不可能喜欢这样的选择，因为上述三国均为东盟成员，而缅甸直到开始民主过渡前一直是中国的亲密盟友。
en: Following his re-election, Obama’s first foreign visit was to Myanmar, Thailand, and Cambodia – a choice that cannot have pleased China, as all three are ASEAN members, while Myanmar was, until it began its democratic transition, a close Chinese ally.

zh: 当然，亚洲经济飞速发展，但需要依靠地区安全机制和经济一体化来控制该地区剑拔弩张的民族紧张局势。
en: Asia is, of course, experiencing rapid economic growth, but managing the region’s strong nationalist tensions calls for the creation of regional security structures, together with closer economic integration.

zh: 美国学者李侃如和北京大学国际研究院院长王缉思近期在一篇布鲁金斯学会论文中指出 ， “ 战略不信任”已进一步恶化了本已复杂的局势。
en: Complicating matters even more is what US scholar Kenneth Lieberthal and Wang Jisi, the dean of international studies at Peking University, called in a recent paper for the Brookings Institution “strategic distrust.”

zh: 国际体系和谐运转的基础将取决于能否培养二十一世纪大国之间的战略互信。
en: Cultivating strategic trust between the twenty-first century’s leading powers will be fundamental to the international system’s harmonious functioning.

zh: 但上述目标怎样才能实现？
en: But how can this be achieved?

zh: 因为到2020年中国石油进口量的四分之三将来源于中东，一个重要的步骤��争取中国的合作以解决该地区的问题。
en: As China will be importing three-quarters of its oil from the Middle East by 2020, one step forward would be China’s cooperation in finding solutions to the region’s problems.

zh: 2013年1月以色列大选后，伊朗将再次成为奥巴马外交政策议程中的首要问题。
en: After the January 2013 Israeli elections, Iran will again move to the top of Obama’s foreign-policy agenda.

zh: 对伊朗实施军事干预可能引发地区、乃至全球动荡，伊朗国内将于6月举行总统选举。
en: Military intervention in Iran – which itself will be holding a presidential election in June – would incite not only regional, but global, instability.

zh: 阿拉伯世界、俄罗斯和中国将被迫表明立场，导致全球处在权力两极的大国间关系紧张，并加剧太平洋地区的紧张局势。
en: The Arab world, Russia, and China would be forced to take sides, straining global relations between the different poles of power and raising tensions in the Pacific.

zh: 因此同美国合作避免决一胜负完全符合中国的战略利益。
en: So China has a large strategic interest in working with the US to avoid a showdown.

zh: 除伊朗问题外，迫切需要稳定整个中东地区的动荡局势。
en: Beyond Iran, the volatile situation throughout the Middle East urgently demands solutions.

zh: 哈马斯和以色列之间最新爆发的暴力冲突凸显了恢复和平进程的重要性。
en: The latest eruption of violent conflict between Hamas and Israel underscores the importance of reviving the peace process.

zh: 导致越来越多地区力量卷入其中的叙利亚内战已经越来越像是（沙特阿拉伯及其他海湾国家、土耳其、埃及的）逊尼派穆斯林和（伊朗及真主党的）什叶派穆斯林之间为争夺区域霸权发动全面战争的试验场。
en: Syria’s civil war, in which a growing number of regional players have become involved, is beginning to look increasingly like a trial run for all-out war between Sunni Muslims (Saudi Arabia and the other Gulf States, Turkey, and Egypt) and Shia Muslims (Iran and Hezbollah) for regional dominance.

zh: 伊朗领导人似乎深信美国在承受了十余年战争所带来的极高的经济及人员损失后，更愿意尽力避免另一次军事行动。
en: Iran’s leaders appear to believe that the US, having incurred extremely high economic and human costs from more than a decade of war, would rather avoid another military intervention.

zh: 这种看法在美国舆论中似乎也得到了印证。
en: US public opinion seems to confirm this.

zh: 芝加哥全球事务理事会近来的一次调查表明，67%的美国人认为伊拉克战争得不偿失。
en: A recent survey by the Chicago Council on Global Affairs indicated that 67% of Americans believe that the Iraq war was not worthwhile.

zh: 此外，69%的人认为美国在阿富汗战争后面临的恐怖主义威胁并未减弱，而71%的人表示伊拉克的经验表明美国应该更加谨慎地使用武力。
en: Moreover, 69% do not believe that the US is safer from terrorism since the war in Afghanistan, and 71% say that the experience in Iraq shows that the US should take greater care in how it uses force.

zh: 但即便美国人似乎不愿为又一次没有出路的国外冒险投资数十亿美元，伊朗领导人却越来越深地陷入破坏该国经济的国际制裁的包围。
en: But, if Americans seem unlikely to be willing to invest billions of dollars in another dead-end foreign adventure, Iran’s leaders, for their part, are increasingly hemmed in by international sanctions, which are beginning to wreak havoc on the country’s economy.

zh: 双方也许认为至少从目前的情况看，谈判才是他们最好的选择。
en: Both sides may believe that their best option – at least for now – is to negotiate.

zh: 和平解决伊朗问题将帮助美国完成向亚洲的过渡。
en: Peaceful resolution of the Iranian question would help the US to complete its shift toward Asia.

zh: 中国可能不希望看到这样的结果，但它在中东能源供应安全领域的切身利益迫使它不得不合作。
en: China may not wish for that outcome, but its own vital interest in the security of Middle East energy supplies should compel it to cooperate.

zh: 毕竟，再次爆发中东冲突将在未来几十年中毒害和扭曲该地区关系，而对美中两国而言，这将是可能出现的最坏结果。
en: After all, another Middle East conflict would poison and distort relations in the region for decades, which would be the worst of all possible consequences – for the US and China alike.

zh: 美国自杀式的治国之策
en: America’s Suicidal Statecraft

zh: 自从赢得冷战以来，美国的全球性霸权依赖于三大支柱，即经济实力、军事力量及其输出大众文化的巨大能力。
en: Since its victory in the Cold War, America’s global hegemony has rested on three pillars: economic power, military might, and a vast capacity to export its popular culture.

zh: 最近新的强权像欧盟、中国、印度以及力争恢复其失去的地位的俄国等的兴起已经侵蚀了美国单方面主宰世界事务的能力。
en: The recent emergence of additional powers – the European Union, China, India, and a Russia driven to recover its lost status – has eroded America’s capacity to shape events unilaterally.

zh: 即使如此，美国依旧是世界上最为强大的国家；其衰落与其运用其实力不当有关，其程度超过竞争对手的崛起。
en: Even so, America remains by far the world’s most powerful country; its decline has more to do with its incompetent use of power than with the emergence of competitors.

zh: 借用英国历史学家汤因比简练又力的话来说，美国的境况应当归咎于美国领导人“自杀式的治国之策 ” 。 汤因比用这一词语来总结帝国崩溃的最终原因。
en: It is American leaders’ “suicidal statecraft,” to use Arnold Toynbee’s pithy phrase for what he considered the ultimate cause of imperial collapse, that is to blame for America’s plight.

zh: 让我们来考虑一下中东的情况。
en: Consider the Middle East.

zh: 美国在1991年第一次海湾战争期间冷静地使用武力，而在如今的伊拉克战争中却充满傲慢和欺骗。 没有任何事情比这两者的对比更可以解释美国在该地区的衰落了。
en: Nothing reveals the decline of the United States in the region better than the contrast between America’s sober use of power in the first Gulf War in 1991 and the hubris and deceit of today’s Iraq war.

zh: 在1991年，美国组建了自二战以来最为强大的国际联合部队，并且在一场完全合法的战争中率领这一部队。 那一场战争的目的是为了在萨达姆入侵科威特后恢复地区平衡。
en: In 1991, America forged the most formidable international coalition since World War II, and led it in a fully legitimate war aimed at restoring regional balance after Saddam Hussein’s invasion of Kuwait.

zh: 在2003年，美国在操纵虚假的开战主张后抛开其跨大西洋盟国发动战争。
en: In 2003, America went to war without its trans-Atlantic allies after manipulating false assertions.

zh: 美国这样做就实施了一个荒唐的宏观战略。 这一战略目的在于同时消灭伊拉克的独裁政权、重建整个中东地区、摧毁基地组织并且帮助民主在整个阿拉伯世界生根。
en: In doing so, the US embarked on a preposterous grand strategy that aimed no less at simultaneously dismantling Iraq’s tyrannical regime, restructuring the entire Middle East, destroying al-Qaeda, and helping democracy to take root throughout the Arab world.

zh: 这一战略的结果却是完全失败，那就是军事失败以及美国的道义地位大为降低。
en: The result has been utter failure: military defeat and a severe degradation of America’s moral standing.

zh: 美国不仅没有破坏极端伊斯兰主义，还在伊拉克及其以外的国家使得其合法化了。
en: Rather than undermining radical Islam, the US has legitimized it, in Iraq and beyond.

zh: 的确，构成该地区未来的不是民主，而是伊拉克战争所促成的什叶派和逊尼派的暴力分歧。
en: Indeed, what will now shape the future of the region is not democracy, but the violent divide between Shiites and Sunnis that the Iraq war precipitated.

zh: 正是这一场穆斯林内战才允许基地组织得以大量招募人员。
en: It is this Muslim civil war that is allowing al-Qaeda to gain a larger pool of recruits.

zh: 伊拉克有可能成为第一个什叶派穆斯林统治的阿拉伯国家，进而融入到不断扩张中的伊朗什叶派帝国之中。 在这种情况下，美国在该地区的逊尼派盟国现在认为美国是不可靠的。
en: With Iraq probably becoming the first Arab country to be ruled by Shiites, and hence integrated into an expanding Shiite Iranian empire, America’s Sunni allies in the region now view the US as unreliable.

zh: 确实，美国被认为是激发什叶派复兴这一伊斯兰运程大逆转的事实上的同谋。
en: Indeed, the US is seen as practically complicit in inciting a monumental reversal of Islam’s fortunes, the Shia revival.

zh: 民主的福音对于美国的阿拉伯盟国而言也并不十分可爱，因为呼吁实行民主只不过是鼓励了伊斯兰分子挑战现今的精英阶层来获取权力。
en: Nor is the gospel of democracy especially dear to America’s Arab allies, for the call to democratize has only emboldened the Islamists to challenge the incumbent elites for power.
