zh: 毫无疑问，暴力伊斯兰原教旨主义在阿拉伯民族主义不断衰退的保证中有着更深的原因。
en: Admittedly, violent Islamic fundamentalism has deeper roots in the fading promise of Arab nationalism.

zh: 但是美国拙劣的民主主张结果是同时疏远了其保守派的地区盟国以及伊斯兰分子。 疏远保守派给了政治伊斯兰新的生机，他们可以利用投票箱来作为获得权力的途径，而伊斯兰分子所获得的选举胜利却被美国所拒绝。
en: But America’s misbegotten democratic message has ended up alienating both its conservative regional allies, as it gave a new lease on life to political Islam, which can use the ballot box as a route to power, and the Islamists, whose electoral gains are then rejected by the US.

zh: 美国在中东地区的最大的战略错误应当是与伊朗实力的涌现有关。
en: America’s biggest strategic blunder in the Middle East arguably concerns the emergence of Iranian power.

zh: 美国摧毁了作为制约性的地区力量的伊拉克，从而给其传统上的海湾盟国以强烈的一击，因为伊拉克是伊朗的野心的障碍。
en: By destroying Iraq as a counterbalancing regional force, the US dealt a major blow to its traditional Gulf allies, for whom Iraq served as a barrier against Iran’s ambitions.

zh: 美国将某些战略资产拱手让给伊朗。 霍梅尼的革命在与萨达姆八年之久的战争中以及在整个地区输出伊斯兰革命都未能取得这些战略资产。
en: America offered Iran on a silver platter strategic assets that Khomeini’s revolution failed to acquire either in eight years of war against Saddam or in its abortive attempts to export the Islamic revolution throughout the region.

zh: 同样，由于伊朗觉得美国“先发制人的战争”的概念在伊拉克惨败就可以为所欲为，它的核子规划也咄咄逼人。
en: Likewise, Iran’s nuclear program gained momentum thanks to its sense of impunity following the colossal failure in Iraq of America’s concept of “preventive war.”

zh: 美国在伊拉克军事行动是灾难性的，使得其在战略上被压低了。
en: The calamitous US military experience in Iraq has left it strategically diminished.

zh: 伊拉克现在已经成为上帝的游乐场，而美国只有依靠其他地区大国的帮助才能够指望在那里实现些许的稳定。
en: Iraq has now become God’s playground, and America can hope to achieve a modicum of stability there only with the help of other regional powers.

zh: 但是，美国仍将是中东地区最为具有影响力的外部国家，因为它的失利是领导不力，而非实际实力不济。
en: Nevertheless, the US will remain the most influential external actor in the Middle East, for its failure is one of leadership, not of actual power.

zh: 美国由于军事失败而变得谦逊，只有通过避免傲慢的罪恶以及学习再不试图操控他人的情况下发挥领导作用才能够恢复其在该地区的作用。
en: Humbled by military defeat, America can recover its regional relevance only by avoiding the sin of hubris, and learning to lead without attempting to dominate.

zh: 这就要求与像伊朗和叙利亚那样的革命性国家接触、尊重而不是孤立那些脱离圣战主义赞成政治参与的伊斯兰运动并且率领国际同盟来实现以阿拉伯联盟的倡议为基础的阿以和平。
en: This requires engaging revolutionary forces like Iran and Syria; respecting, rather than ostracizing, those Islamist movements that have opted out from jihadism in favor of political participation; and leading an international alliance for an Arab-Israeli peace based on the Arab League initiative.

zh: 确实，美国险恶的伊拉克政策的自相矛盾之处在于，由于伊朗崛起以及大范围的原教旨主义威胁让阿拉伯人把注意力集中到与以色列和解的急迫性上来，因此这些政策创造了阿以和平的有利条件。
en: Indeed, the paradox of America’s pernicious policies in Iraq is that they have created favorable conditions for an Arab-Israeli peace, as the emergence of Iran and the threat of a fundamentalist tsunami have focused Arab minds on the urgency of a settlement with Israel.

zh: 巴勒斯坦问题并不是所有中东麻烦问题的源泉，但是解决巴勒斯坦问题却可以极大地改善美国在阿拉伯人中的地位。
en: The Palestinian issue is not the source of all the Middle East’s ills, but its resolution would dramatically improve America’s standing among Arabs.

zh: 更为重要的是，这将不让伊朗具有把令世人瞩目的伊斯兰和阿拉伯事业与其自身的霸权主义野心连接起来的能力。
en: More importantly, it would deny Iran the ability to link popular Islamic and Arab causes with its own hegemonic ambitions.

zh: 美国对跨太平洋贸易的威胁
en: America’s Threat to Trans-Pacific Trade

zh: 发自孟买 — — 似乎暗中破坏世界贸易组织多哈回合全球自由贸易谈判还不够出格（在日内瓦举行的最后一次部长级会议在一片废话中闭幕 ） ， 美国又继续做出愚蠢举动 — — 积极推动跨太平洋伙伴关系协议（简称TPP ） 。
en: MUMBAI – As if undermining the World Trade Organization’s Doha Round of global free-trade talks was not bad enough (the last ministerial meeting in Geneva produced barely a squeak), the United States has compounded its folly by actively promoting the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP).

zh: 美国总统奥巴马在最近出访该地区时和九个亚洲国家一道宣布了这一消息。
en: President Barack Obama announced this with nine Asian countries during his recent trip to the region.

zh: 在顺从的媒体和轻信的公众眼中，该协议被视为美国贸易领先地位的证明。
en: The TPP is being sold in the US to a compliant media and unsuspecting public as evidence of American leadership on trade.

zh: 但真相恰恰相反，而那些关注全球贸易体系的人也有必要知道这究竟是怎么回事。
en: But the opposite is true, and it is important that those who care about the global trading system know what is happening.

zh: 我希望这些知识能触发所谓的“吸血僵尸效应 ” ： 那些藏在暗处的东西能被曝光，并随之枯萎消亡。
en: One hopes that this knowledge will trigger what I call the “Dracula effect”: expose that which would prefer to remain hidden to sunlight and it will shrivel up and die.

zh: 跨太平洋伙伴关系协议其实是美国工业政治游说者，国会和总统共同搞乱公共政策的最好证明。
en: The TPP is a testament to the ability of US industrial lobbies, Congress, and presidents to obfuscate public policy.

zh: 如今大家都知道自由贸易协定，不管是双边还是多边的（在超过两个国家但不针对全部国家 ） ， 都是构建在歧视之上。
en: It is widely understood today that free-trade agreements (FTAs), whether bilateral or plurilateral (among more than two countries but fewer than all) are built on discrimination.

zh: 这也是为什么经济学家一般将其称为优先贸易协定。
en: That is why economists typically call them preferential-trade agreements (PTAs).

zh: 而这也是为何美国政府的公关机器把这个实际上歧视性的多边贸易协定称之为“伙伴关系 ” ， 试图为其安上一个似乎体现合作与世界性的虚伪光环。
en: And that is why the US government’s public-relations machine calls what is in fact a discriminatory plurilateral FTA, a “partnership” invoking a false aura of cooperation and cosmopolitanism.

zh: 原则上各国都可以自由加入协议。
en: Countries are, in principle, free to join the TPP.

zh: 日本和加拿大也宣称计划加入。
en: Japan and Canada have said they plan to do so.

zh: 但仔细观察之下就会发现中国并不在这个议程之内。
en: But a closer look reveals that China is not a part of this agenda.

zh: 跨太平洋伙伴关系协议其实也是一个对中国新进攻态势的政治回应，因此也构建于对抗和遏制之上，与合作毫不相干。
en: The TPP is also a political response to China's new aggressiveness, built therefore in a spirit of confrontation and containment, not of cooperation.

zh: 美国对它的优先贸易伙伴附加了许多与贸易无关的条款，因此不出意外在跨太平洋伙伴关系协议上也附加了许多与贸易无关的议程，包括劳工标准以及对资本账户控制的限制，而这些议程中的许多条款都试图将中国排除在外。
en: The US has been establishing a template for its PTAs that includes several items unrelated to trade. So it is no surprise that the TPP template includes numerous agendas unrelated to trade, such as labor standards and restraints on the use of capital-account controls, many of which preclude China’s accession.

zh: 从一开始，跨太平洋伙伴关系协议中所谓的开放式就是一场彻头彻尾的骗局。
en: From the outset, the TPP’s supposed openness has been wholly misleading.

zh: 为了实现这一点，协议的谈判都在那些包括越南，新加坡和新西兰这些国力较弱，容易被迷惑并接受这类条款的国家间展开。
en: Towards this end, the TPP was negotiated with the weaker countries like Vietnam, Singapore, and New Zealand, which were easily bamboozled into accepting such conditions.

zh: 只有像日本这样实力较强的国家才能被赋予“进出自由”的谈判基础。
en: Only then were bigger countries like Japan offered membership on a “take it or leave it” basis.

zh: 随后那些公关机器又被急速开动起来，宣传这些不相关的条款能使跨太平洋伙伴关系协议成为21世纪的“高质量”贸易协议，而实际上这只不过美国国内众多游说团体趁机敲竹杠的说辞而已。
en: The PR machine then went into overdrive by calling the inclusion of these extraneous conditions as making the TPP a “high-quality” trade agreement for the twenty-first century, when in fact it was a rip-off by several domestic lobbies.

zh: 美国对本国周边的区域主义行为显示它目前正试图推广美洲自由贸易协定（简称FTAA ） 。
en: American regionalism closer to home shows the US now trying to promote the Free Trade Agreement of the Americas (FTAA).

zh: 但其喜欢的模式就是将北美自由贸易协定（加拿大，墨西哥和美国）扩展到南美国家并夹带大量与贸易无关而且必须强逼这些国家接受的事务。
en: But its preferred template was to expand the North America Free Trade Agreement (Canada, Mexico, and the US) to the Andean countries and include huge doses of non-trade-related issues, which they swallowed.

zh: 而这对于巴西这个美洲自由贸易协定的幕后领导势力来说无法接受，因为该国只愿着眼于贸易事务。
en: This was not acceptable to Brazil, the leading force behind the FTAA, which focuses exclusively on trade issues.

zh: 巴西前总统卢拉，也是世界上其中一位伟大的贸易联盟领袖，拒绝在贸易协定和体制中涵盖劳工标准。
en: Brazil’s former President Luiz Lula Inácio da Silva, one of the world’s great trade-union leaders, rejected the inclusion of labor standards in trade treaties and institutions.

zh: 而美国在南美的行为所产生的结果就是将该区域分裂成了两个不同的集团，而这种状况也可能在亚洲出现。
en: The result of US efforts in South America, therefore, has been to fragment the region into two blocs, and the same is likely to happen in Asia.

zh: 在美国发现自己选择了错误的区域来推行区域化之后，它就开始在亚洲寻找一席之地。
en: Ever since the US realized that it had chosen the wrong region to be regional with, it has been trying to win a seat at the Asian table.

zh: 美国之所以最终选择了跨太平洋伙伴关系协议，只是因为中国在宣示其南海主权以及中印中日领土冲突方面过于激进。
en: The US finally got it with the TPP, simply because China had become aggressive in asserting its territorial claims in the South China Sea, the South China Sea, and vis-à-vis India and Japan.

zh: 许多亚洲国家选择加入协议就是为了在面对中国粗暴行为时“把美国留在这个区域 ” 。
en: Many Asian countries joined the TPP to “keep the US in the region” in the face of Chinese heavy-handedness.

zh: 而他们这种行为跟东欧国家在面对苏联解体后的俄罗斯（无论是现实还是想象的）威胁时抢着加入北约或者欧盟的做法如出一辙。
en: They embraced the US in the same way that East Europeans rushed to join NATO and the European Union in the face of the threat, real or imagined, posed by post-Soviet Russia.

zh: 美国对亚洲贸易的设计就是源自于遏制中国的目标，而跨太平洋伙伴关系协议的条款实际上也将中国排除在外。
en: America’s design for Asian trade is inspired by the goal of containing China, and the TPP template effectively excludes it, owing to the non-trade-related conditions imposed by US lobbies.

zh: 而唯一能使中国融入协议使之具备获得公信力的方法就是将所有与贸易无关的条款列为可选项。
en: The only way that a Chinese merger with the TPP could gain credibility would be to make all non-trade-related provisions optional.

zh: 当然，美国的国会游说者们可不想令这种状况发生。
en: Of course, the US lobbies would have none of it.

zh: 美国的三大赤字
en: America’s Three Deficits

zh: 伯克利 — — 新年伊始的一系列报告都在令人兴奋地表明，美国经济复苏得到了提振。
en: BERKELEY – This year began with a series of reports providing tantalizing evidence that economic recovery in the United States is strengthening.

zh: 就业岗位创造速度增加了，制造业和服务业指标改善了，消费支出也要强于预期。
en: The pace of job creation has increased, indicators for manufacturing and services have improved, and consumption spending has been stronger than anticipated.

zh: 但是，不要高兴得太早了。
en: But it is too early to celebrate.

zh: 美国的产出增长依然相当低迷，美国经济依然面临三大赤字：就业赤字、投资赤字和长期财政赤字，这三大赤字都不可能在选举年得到解决。
en: Output growth in the US remains anemic, and the economy continues to face three significant deficits: a jobs deficit, an investment deficit, and a long-run fiscal deficit, none of which is likely to be addressed in an election year.

zh: 尽管如今产出已经高于2007年第四季度，但仍要比劳动力和产能充分调动情形低很多。
en: Although output is now higher than it was in the fourth quarter of 2007, it remains far below what could be produced if labor and capacity were fully utilized.

zh: 其中的缺口 — — 即实际产出和潜在产出之差 — — 大约在GDP的7 % （ 1万亿美元）以上。
en: That gap – between actual and potential output – is estimated at more than 7% of GDP (more than $1 trillion).

zh: 产出缺口反映了超过1 200万的就业赤字，即使就业率达到2007年顶峰时期的水平并吸收每个月进入劳动力市场的125 000人所需要增加的就业量。
en: The output gap reflects a deficit of more than 12 million jobs – the number of jobs needed to return to the economy’s peak 2007 employment level and absorb the 125,000 people who enter the labor force each month.

zh: 即使2012年经济增长如许多人预计的那样达到2.5 % ， 就业赤字仍然无法消除，可能将一直持续到2024年。
en: Even if the economy grows at 2.5% in 2012, as most forecasts anticipate, the jobs deficit will remain – and will not be closed until 2024.

zh: 美国就业赤字的主因是总需求不足。
en: America’s jobs deficit is primarily the result of inadequate aggregate demand.

zh: 占美国总支出水平七成的消费受高失业、低工资增长和房价及消费者财富快速缩水的约束。
en: Consumption, which accounts for about 70% of total spending, is constrained by high unemployment, weak wage gains, and a steep decline in home values and consumer wealth.

zh: 2011年12月消费水平的上升是受家庭储蓄下降和消费信贷大增的提振。
en: The uptick in consumption in the last months of 2011 was financed by a decline in the household saving rate and a large increase in consumer credit.

zh: 这两个趋势都不是健康趋势，也不可能持续。
en: Neither of these trends is healthy or sustainable.

zh: 目前失业率高达8.5 % ， 劳动市场参与率只有64 % ， 真实工资一直停滞不前，这导致劳动收入占国民收入的比重只有44 % ， 为历史最低值。
en: With an unemployment rate of 8.5%, a labor-force participation rate of only 64%, and stagnant real wages, labor income has fallen to an historic low of 44% of national income.

zh: 劳动收入是家庭收入的最重要组成部分，也是消费支出的主要推动力。
en: And labor income is the most important component of household earnings, the major driver of consumption spending.

zh: 在大衰退之前，美国工人和家庭便已经陷入了困境。
en: Even before the Great Recession, American workers and households were in trouble.

zh: 2000—2007年就业增长率较之前30年下降了整整一半。
en: The rate of job growth between 2000 and 2007 slowed to only half its level in the three preceding decades.

zh: 生产率的增长相当强劲，但远远超出了工资增长，而工人的平均真实时薪在下降，即使是大学生也无法幸免。
en: Productivity growth was strong, but far outpaced wage growth, and workers’ real hourly compensation declined, on average, even for those with a university education.

zh: 事实上，2000—2007年这段时期只是中位家庭真实收入下降趋势中的一次反弹。
en: Indeed, the 2002-2007 period was the only recovery on record during which the median family’s real income declined.

zh: 此外，就业机会继续呈现两极分化的态势，高收入的专业、技术和管理职位，以及低工资的食品服务、个人看护和防护职位的数量在增长。
en: Moreover, job opportunities continued to polarize, with employment growing in high-wage professional, technical, and managerial occupations, as well as in low-wage food-service, personal-care, and protective-service occupations.

zh: 相反，技能要求中等的白领和蓝领职位在减少，尤其是制造业职位。
en: By contrast, employment in middle-skill, white-collar, and blue-collar occupations fell, particularly in manufacturing.

zh: 压力重重的美国家庭不得不削减储蓄率、用房屋所有权作抵押借贷，以债务的增加为代价维持消费水平，这导致了房地产和信贷泡沫。 2008年，这一泡沫破裂，此后便开始了痛苦的去杠杆化过程。
en: Hard-pressed American households slashed their savings rates, borrowed against their home equity, and increased their debt to maintain consumption, contributing to the housing and credit bubbles that burst in 2008, requiring painful deleveraging ever since.

zh: 三大因素导致了美国劳动力市场的有害结构变化：
en: Three forces have driven the US labor market’s adverse structural changes:

zh: ·         基于技能的技术变迁，即传统工作的自动化和至少需要本科学历的高技能员工需求增加同时发生。
en: ·         Skill-biased technological change, which has automated routine work while boosting demand for highly educated workers with at least a college degree.

zh: ·         贸易和外包带来的全球劳动市场竞争和一体化减少了就业岗位，压低了工资。
en: ·         Global competition and the integration of labor markets through trade and outsourcing, which have eliminated jobs and depressed wages.

zh: ·         美国竞争力下降，不再具有对生产和岗位的吸引力。
en: ·         America’s declining competitiveness as an attractive place to locate production and employment.

zh: 技术变迁和全球化在其他发达国家也造成了类似的劳动力市场挑战。
en: Technological change and globalization have created similar labor-market challenges in other developed countries.

zh: 但美国竞争力下降却是政策选择的结果。
en: But US policy choices are responsible for the erosion of America’s competitiveness.

zh: 特别是，在创造和维持高工资岗位等方面，美国在三个领域上投资不足：技能与培训、基础设施，以及研发。
en: In particular, the US is underinvesting in three major areas that help countries to create and retain high-wage jobs: skills and training, infrastructure, and research and development.

zh: 美国政府在这三个领域的支出只有总支出的不到10 % ， 而且这一比重还在不断下降。
en: Spending in these areas accounts for less than 10% of US government spending, and this share has been declining over time.

zh: 当前，联邦政府能够以极低利率借钱，而在教育、基础设施和研究领域，有很多项目都能带来较高的回报、立刻产生新增就业并提振美国吸引高工资岗位的竞争力。
en: The federal government can currently borrow at record-low interest rates, and there are many projects in education, infrastructure, and research that would earn a higher return, create jobs now, and bolster US competitiveness in attracting high-wage jobs.

zh: 奥巴马总统提出了大量方案投资于美国国家竞争力基础，但国会中的共和党拒绝了这些方案，他们说，美国的当务之急的财政危机。
en: President Barack Obama has offered numerous proposals to invest in the foundations of national competitiveness, but Congressional Republicans have rebuffed them, claiming that the US faces an impending fiscal crisis.

zh: 事实上，在2030年上升到不可持续水平之前，联邦赤字占GDP的比重将在未来数年内大幅下降，就算没有进一步的赤字削减手段也是如此。
en: In fact, the federal deficit as a share of GDP will shrink significantly over the next several years, even without further deficit-reduction measures, before rising to unsustainable levels by 2030.

zh: 美国确实面临着长期财政赤字��题，这是由上涨的医保成本和老龄化的人口导致的。
en: The US does indeed face a long-run fiscal deficit, largely the result of rising health-care costs and an aging population.

zh: 但当前财政赤字主要是由税收收入不足造成的，其原因是低增长、高失业以及在总需求依然疲软的情况下，暂时性刺激措施到期、需要投入新的刺激措施。
en: But the current fiscal deficit mainly reflects weak tax revenues, owing to slow growth and high unemployment, and temporary stimulus measures that are fading away at a time when aggregate demand remains weak and additional fiscal stimulus is warranted.

zh: 无论如何，为了保证美国经济今年能有2.5%的增长，奥巴马所提出的工资税削减和失业救济方案应该延期到今年年底。
en: At the very least, to keep the economy on course for 2.5% growth this year, the payroll tax cut and unemployment benefits proposed by Obama should be extended through the end of the year.

zh: 这些措施能够为脆弱的复苏上保险，而对长期财政缺口毫无影响。
en: These measures would provide insurance to the fragile recovery and add nothing to the long-run fiscal gap.

zh: 那么，如何解决美国经济的就业赤字、投资池子和长期财政赤字呢？
en: So, how should the US economy’s jobs deficit, investment deficit, and long-run fiscal deficit be addressed?

zh: 决策者应该在财政政策方面双管齐下，在当下消除就业和投资池子，同时提出一个多年计划逐渐削减长期财政赤字。
en: Policymakers should pair fiscal measures to ameliorate the jobs and investment deficits now with a multi-year plan to reduce the long-run fiscal deficit gradually.

zh: 这一长期计划应该增加教育、基础设施和研究方面的支出，同时限制医保支出的进一步增长（比如通过奥巴马医疗改革立法中提出的成本限制机制 ） 。
en: This long-run plan should increase spending on education, infrastructure, and research, while curbing future growth in health-care spending through the cost-containment mechanisms contained in Obama’s health-reform legislation.

zh: 现在就通过长期赤字削减计划，但推迟到经济达到接近充分就业时再实施，这样可以防止财政收缩操之过急，把经济重新拖入衰退。
en: Approving a long-run deficit-reduction plan now but deferring its starting date until the economy is near full employment would prevent premature fiscal contraction from tipping the economy back into recession.

zh: 事实上，颁布这一揽子计划可以大小投资者对未来赤字的担忧，提振消费者和商业信心，从而增加产出和就业。
en: Indeed, enactment of such a package could bolster output and employment growth by easing investor concerns about future deficits and strengthening consumer and business confidence.

zh: 怎样填补长期财政缺口？ 痛苦的选择应该马上做出，并等到经济复苏后大力推行。
en: Painful choices about how to close the long-run fiscal gap should be decided now and implemented promptly once the economy has recovered.

zh: 但是，在未来几年中，财政政策的额当务之急是就业、投资和增长。
en: But, for the next few years, the priorities of fiscal policy should be jobs, investment, and growth.

zh: 无药可救的美国预算
en: America’s Ungovernable Budget

zh: 纽约 — — 任何政府的核心都是预算问题。
en: NEW YORK – The heart of any government is found in its budget.

zh: 政治家尽可以没完没了地许诺，但如果预算跟不上，政治就不过是空话而已。
en: Politicians can make endless promises, but if the budget doesn’t add up, politics is little more than mere words.

zh: 这样的窘境已经在美国成为现实。
en: The United States is now caught in such a bind.

zh: 在刚刚发表的国情咨文中，巴拉克·奥巴马总统描绘出二十一世纪现代政府的一幅诱人图景。
en: In his recent State of the Union address, President Barack Obama painted a convincing picture of modern, twenty-first-century government.

zh: 奥巴马的共和党对手抱怨这项提案会让政府破产。
en: His Republican Party opponents complained that Obama’s proposals would bust the budget.

zh: 可事实是两党都没有勇气承认现实： 如果不增加税收，就不可能缔造出现代化、有竞争力的美国经济。
en: But the truth is that both parties are hiding from the reality: without more taxes, a modern, competitive US economy is not possible.

zh: 奥巴马明智地认识到当今世界的竞争力取决于现代化的基础设施和知识型劳动力。
en: Obama rightly emphasized that competitiveness in the world today depends on an educated workforce and modern infrastructure.

zh: 这条规律对任何国家均不例外，但对富裕国家尤其如此。
en: That is true for any country, but it is especially relevant for rich countries.

zh: 美国和欧洲必须与巴西、中国、印度和其他新兴国家直接竞争，而他们的工资水平在某些情况下只有高收入国家的四分之一（甚至更低 ） 。
en: The US and Europe are in direct competition with Brazil, China, India, and other emerging economies, where wage levels are sometimes one-quarter those in high-income countries (if not even lower).

zh: 只有将竞争力建立在先进技术、尖端科技和现代化基础设施之上，美国和欧洲才能保持自己的生活水平。
en: America and Europe will keep their high living standards only by basing their competitiveness on advanced skills, cutting-edge technologies, and modern infrastructure.

zh: 奥巴马也因此呼吁美国加大对以下三大领域的公共投资： 教育、科学技术和基础设施（包括宽带网络、快速轨道交通和清洁能源 ） 。
en: That is why Obama called for an increase in US public investment in three areas: education, science and technology, and infrastructure (including broadband Internet, fast rail, and clean energy).

zh: 他详细描绘了一幅未来公共和私人投资相互补充、相互支持的经济发展愿景。
en: He spelled out a vision of future growth in which public and private investment would be complementary, mutually supportive pillars.

zh: 奥巴马有充分理由强调这些主题。
en: Obama emphasized these themes for good reason.

zh: 目前美国失业率持续在10%附近徘徊，部分原因是新兴经济体分得更多的新增就业机会，同时由于全球竞争日趋激烈，现在美国创造的许多工作机会薪酬都与过去不可同日而语。
en: Unemployment in the US now stands at nearly 10% of the labor force, in part because more new jobs are being created in the emerging economies, and many of the jobs now being created in the US pay less than in the past, owing to greater global competition.

zh: 除非美国加大对教育、科学、技术和基础设施的投入，否则这样的不利趋势将会继续下去。
en: Unless the US steps up its investment in education, science, technology, and infrastructure, these adverse trends will continue.

zh: 可当转向预算赤字问题时，奥巴马的讲话便开始脱离现实。
en: But Obama’s message lost touch with reality when he turned his attention to the budget deficit.

zh: 在承认近期财政政策导致公共债务不可持续膨胀的同时，奥巴马表示争取预算平衡是实现财政稳定的关键问题。
en: Acknowledging that recent fiscal policies had put the US on an unsustainable trajectory of rising public debt, Obama said that moving towards budget balance was now essential for fiscal stability.

zh: 因此他呼吁在五年内冻结美国政府所谓“有决定权”的公众开支。
en: So he called for a five-year freeze on what the US government calls “discretionary” civilian spending.

zh: 问题在于上述开支的超过半数用于教育、科技和基础设施领域 — — 奥巴马刚刚提出要加大对上述领域的投资力度。
en: The problem is that more than half of such spending is on education, science and technology, and infrastructure – the areas that Obama had just argued should be strengthened.

zh: 就在告诉美国人政府投资对现代化发展何等重要后，他承诺要在今后五年内冻结这笔开支！
en: After telling Americans how important government investment is for modern growth, he promised to freeze that spending for the next five years!

zh: 政治家经常在不同演讲中变换不同的观点，但在同一次讲话中却极少出现如此明显矛盾的命题。
en: Politicians often change their message from one speech to the next, but rarely contradict it so glaringly in the same speech.

zh: 这种矛盾凸显了25年来美国预算政策适得其反的无奈特点，而今后这种特点仍有可能持续下去。
en: That contradiction highlights the sad and self-defeating nature of US budget policies over the past 25 years, and most likely in the years to come.

zh: 一方面，美国政府必须加大投资推动经济竞争力的发展。
en: On the one hand, the US government must invest more to promote economic competitiveness.

zh: 而另一方面，美国长期过低的税收却又无法支持必需的政府投资。
en: On the other hand, US taxes are chronically too low to support the level of government investment that is needed.

zh: 奥巴马讲话两天后，国会预算办公室发表的最新研究���告显示今年的预算赤字将达1.5万亿美元，如此庞大的赤字即使就美国的经济规模而言也远超人们的想象力。
en: America’s fiscal reality was made painfully clear two days after Obama’s speech, in a new study from the Congressional Budget Office, which revealed that the budget deficit this year will reach nearly $1.5 trillion – a sum almost unimaginable even for an economy the size of the US.

zh: 近国内生产总值10%的巨额赤字让政府债台高筑，严重威胁到今后的美国经济。
en: At nearly 10% of GDP, the deficit is resulting in a mountain of debt that threatens America’s future.

zh: 国会预算办公室研究报告进一步表明，十二月奥巴马和共和党反对派达成的减税协议明知故犯地大幅度增加了财政预算赤字。
en: The CBO study also made clear that December’s tax-cut agreement between Obama and the Republican opposition willfully and deliberately increased the budget deficit sharply.

zh: 乔治·W·布什实行的各项减税政策原定于2010年底到期终止。
en: Various tax cuts initiated by George W. Bush were set to expire at the end of 2010.

zh: 奥巴马和共和党人同意将上述减税政策延长至少两年（现在看来两年后继续延长的可能性极大 ） ， 也因此造成今年税收收入降低3500亿美元，且2012年还会进一步降低。
en: Obama and the Republicans agreed to continue those tax cuts for at least two years (they will now probably continue beyond that), thereby lowering tax revenue by $350 billion this year and again in 2012.

zh: 为最富裕的美国人减税也是方案的内容之一。
en: Tax cuts for the richest Americans were part of the package.

zh: 当今美国政治的现实情况再简单不过。
en: The truth of US politics today is simple.

zh: 两党领袖在以减税（特别是为富人减税）为重要政策方面达成了共识。
en: The key policy for the leaders of both political parties is tax cuts, especially for the rich.

zh: 无论民主共和两党还是白宫都宁愿减税而非在教育、科技和基础设施领域增加开支。
en: Both political parties, and the White House, would rather cut taxes than spend more on education, science and technology, and infrastructure.

zh: 其中的原因简单明了： 最富裕的美国家庭为政治竞选提供资金。
en: And the explanation is straightforward: the richest households fund political campaigns.

zh: 因此两党无不以满足他们的愿望为第一要著。
en: Both parties therefore cater to their wishes.

zh: 正因如此，美国30%的税收收入占国民收入比例在所有高收入国家中排行末尾，而欧洲国家的一般占比在40%左右。   但国内生产总值的30%不够满足医疗、教育、科技、社保、基础设施和其他重要的政府责任需求。
en: As a result, America’s total tax revenues as a share of national income are among the lowest of all high-income countries, roughly 30%, compared to around 40% in Europe.  But 30% of GDP is not enough to cover the needs of health, education, science and technology, social security, infrastructure, and other vital government responsibilities.

zh: 有一个预算领域可以而且应当进行削减： 这就是军事开支。
en: One budget area can and should be cut: military spending.

zh: 不过即便美国极端过分的军事预算得到大幅削减（目前这项计划遭到两党的一致反对 ） ， 仍有必要增加新的税收。
en: But even if America’s wildly excessive military budget is cut sharply (and politicians in both parties are resisting that), there will still be a need for new taxes.

zh: 长时间减税的经济和社会后果已经毋庸置疑。
en: The economic and social consequences of a generation of tax cutting are clear.

zh: 美国的国际竞争力正在衰退，穷人则受到忽视 — — 五分之一的美国儿童陷于贫困 — — 而且给年轻人留下堆积如山的债务。
en: America is losing its international competitiveness, neglecting its poor – one in five American children is trapped in poverty – and leaving a mountain of debt to its young.

zh: 虽然奥巴马政府嘴上高谈阔论，但其财政政策提案并未认真努力解决上述问题。
en: For all of the Obama administration’s lofty rhetoric, his fiscal-policy proposals make no serious attempt to address these problems.

zh: 解决问题需要呼吁增加税收，而乔治·W·布什1992年得到的教训是，这样做必将失去连任的机会。
en: To do so would require calling for higher taxes, and that – as George H. W. Bush learned in 1992 – is no way to get re-elected.

zh: 美国精神错乱的“重心”
en: America’s Unhinged “Pivot”

zh: 新德里—奥巴马总统第二个任期的首次出访彰显亚洲在美国经济和安全领域的新核心地位。
en: NEW DELHI – President Barack Obama’s first foreign trip since winning a second term highlights Asia’s new centrality to America’s economy and security.

zh: 但奥巴马的亚洲之行也敲响了美国的亚洲政策的主要问题：美国的亚洲“重心”有具体的战略内容吗？ 还是仍然是老政策的新瓶装旧酒？
en: But Obama’s Asian tour also underscores the main question about American policy in the region: Will the United States’ “pivot” to Asia acquire concrete strategic content, or will it remain largely a rhetorical repackaging of old policies?

zh: 美国很快地利用了亚洲地区由中国日渐增长的实力自信所触发的担忧情绪，强化了与原有亚洲盟国的军事关系，并打造了一批新的安全伙伴。
en: The United States, quick to capitalize on regional concerns triggered by China’s increasingly muscular self-assertion, has strengthened its military ties with its existing Asian allies and forged security relationships with new friends.

zh: 但美国回归亚洲中心舞台的风光面临着中国战略雄心的制约，其充当亚洲主要安全锚所要面对着诸多关键性的挑战。
en: But the heady glow of America’s return to center stage in Asia has obscured key challenges in remaining the region’s principal security anchor in the face of China’s strategic ambitions.

zh: 挑战之一是阻止美国相对实力的滑落，而这反过来需要全面的国内革新，包括财政整合。
en: One challenge is the need to arrest the erosion of America’s relative power, which in turn requires comprehensive domestic renewal, including fiscal consolidation.

zh: 但削减支出的需要也让人感觉美国可能无法为其将军事重心转向亚太地区的转变融资，甚至可能被迫减弱这方面的支出。
en: But the need for spending cuts also raises the prospect that the US might be unable to finance a military shift toward the Asia-Pacific region – or, worse, that it will be forced to retrench there.

zh: 奥巴马治下的美国一再对中国让步，这一趋势其实从布什政府陷入阿富汗和伊拉克战争泥淖就开始了。
en: The US under Obama has increasingly ceded ground to China, a trend that admittedly began when the Bush administration became preoccupied with the wars in Afghanistan and Iraq.

zh: 这激起了关于美国是否有能力通过更高层次的亚太地区承诺（美国在该地区已有320 000驻军）支持这一战略“重心”的能力的质疑。
en: This has spurred doubts about America’s ability to provide strategic heft to its “pivot” by sustaining a higher level of commitment in the Asia-Pacific region, where it already maintains 320,000 troops.

zh: 美国计划在澳大利亚增加2500名海军驻军基本上只是象征性的行动。
en: The proposed deployment of an additional 2,500 Marines in Australia is largely symbolic.

zh: 事实上，在提高了亚洲人民对美国针对中国崛起的稳健反应的预期后，奥巴马政府开始减少其“重心”的军事部署，转而强调美国的经济参与。
en: In fact, after raising Asians’ expectations of a more robust US response to China’s growing assertiveness, the Obama administration has started to tamp down the military aspects of its “pivot,” emphasizing instead greater US economic engagement.

zh: 这一变化让亚洲地区担心必须在美国和中国之间二选一的国家舒了口气。
en: That change has come as a relief to those in the region who fear being forced to choose between the US and China.

zh: 但是，对于承受着中国关于领土和领海纠纷的坚决主张压力的国家来说，美国的强调经济参与激发了对其承诺的新疑虑。
en: But, for the countries bearing the brunt of China’s recalcitrant approach to territorial and maritime disputes, this emphasis raises new doubts about America’s commitment.

zh: 事实上，美国“重心”的经济再定位纠正了过度强调军事内容、让美国和中国走上冲突之路的政策。
en: In fact, the economic reorientation of the US “pivot” corrects a policy that had overemphasized the military component and put the US on a path toward conflict with China.

zh: 国务卿希拉里·克林顿在河内2010年东盟地区论坛措辞强硬，表达出美国对中国的鹰派立场；如今，她的语气缓和了许多，在访问亚洲国家期间敦促贸易和投资。
en: It was Secretary of State Hillary Clinton who signaled a more hawkish US stance on China with her tough talk at the 2010 Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) Regional Forum in Hanoi; now she is moderating that position by promoting trade and investment during her visits to Asian countries.

zh: 奥巴马也在强调美国“重心”的经济方面，将其亚洲之行描述意在为通过增加对“世界增长最快、最有活力的地区的出口”来早就更多国内制造业岗位。
en: Obama, too, is highlighting the economic aspects of the US “pivot,” portraying his Asia tour as an effort to generate more domestic manufacturing jobs through higher exports to “the most rapidly growing and dynamic region in the world.”

zh: 即使是他对缅甸的历史性访问 — — 他是第一个访问该国的美国总统 — — 对贸易的关注也将不亚于促使这个具有战略地理重要性的资源丰富国家摆脱中国的影响。
en: Even his historic visit to Myanmar – the first ever by a US president – is as much about trade as it is about weaning a strategically located, resource-rich country from Chinese influence.

zh: 将注意力转向贸易和经济问题还促使华盛顿推出了泛太平洋伙伴关系协定，该协定意在打造一个不包括中国的亚太自由贸易集团。
en: The refocus on trade and economic issues has also prompted Washington to promote the Trans-Pacific Partnership, which aims to create a new Asia-Pacific free-trade group that excludes China.

zh: 此外，美国还在强调东亚峰会和东盟的重要性，后者的峰会与奥巴马将出席的金边东亚峰会重叠。
en: Moreover, the US is emphasizing the importance of the East Asia Summit and ASEAN, whose summit overlaps with the EAS meeting in Phnom Penh that Obama will be attending.

zh: 美国路线的调整也受到其他考虑因素的影响：对于中国和邻国的争端问题，站队对美国来说没有任何好处 — — 当然，除非美国的直接利益受到了影响，南海问题便是如此，美国的领海主张威胁到某些世界最繁忙的海运路线。
en: The US course correction is being dictated by another consideration as well: America has nothing to gain from taking sides in China’s disputes with its neighbors – unless, of course, US interests are directly at stake, as in the South China Sea, where Chinese maritime claims threaten freedom of navigation in some of the world’s most heavily trafficked shipping lanes.

zh: 对其自身国家里的关心可以解释为何美国在中印领土纠纷重燃 — — 包括中国突然重新提出对广袤的印度喜马拉雅山区的阿鲁纳恰尔邦的领土主张 — — 时保持中立。
en: Concern for its own national interest explains why America has charted a course of tacit neutrality regarding the revival of Sino-Indian territorial disputes, including China’s sudden resurrection of a claim to the large Himalayan Indian state of Arunachal Pradesh.

zh: 类似地，美国也在敦促中国和日本和平解决日本控制的钓鱼岛的争端。
en: Similarly, the US has urged both China and Japan to resolve peacefully their dispute over the Japanese-controlled Senkaku Islands.

zh: 美国的主要目的是防止僵局发展到它不得不站到日本一边的程度 — — 这与其自身利益不符。
en: America’s main goal is to prevent the standoff from escalating to the point that it would be forced – against its own interests – to take Japan’s side.

zh: 美国国防部长帕内塔与中国领导人习近平9月份会面时，他听到了“令人吃惊的要求 ” — —美国应该置身中日纠纷之外，事实上，在9月份精心安排的中国反日游行期间，帕内塔并没有建议中国压制通常导致暴力的示威活动，而是公开重申美国在钓鱼岛纠纷中的中立态度。
en: When US Defense Secretary Leon Panetta met Chinese leader Xi Jinping in China in September, he got “an earful” that the US should stay out of the Sino-Japanese dispute. Indeed, amid the orchestrated anti-Japanese protests in China in September, Panetta – instead of advising China to rein in the often-violent demonstrations – publicly reiterated America’s neutrality in the struggle over control of the islands.

zh: 美国政策的修正事实上已经扩展到了用语方面。
en: The correction in US policy actually extends even to terminology.

zh: 美国外交官已经不再使用“重心”一词，因为暗含军事动向，转而使用“再平衡 ” 。
en: American diplomats have now abandoned the term “pivot” altogether, owing to its military connotation, in favor of “rebalancing.”

zh: 不管你如何称呼它，新政策方针的唯一目标就是中国，美国在强化中国周边的盟友和友邦，包括印度、日本、菲律宾、越南、印尼和韩国。
en: Whatever one calls it, the new policy approach is all about China, with America bolstering alliances and friendships with countries around China’s periphery, including India, Japan, the Philippines, Vietnam, Indonesia, and South Korea.

zh: 但奥巴马政府继续否认中国是其战略核心，事实上，奥巴马政府不愿意说、也不愿意做任何可能引起中国反感的事情。
en: Yet the Obama administration continues to deny that China is at the center of its strategy. In fact, it is reluctant to say or do anything publicly that might raise China’s hackles.

zh: 亚太地区将在奥巴马的第二个任期日程表中占据更加重要的位置，特别是美国将在2014年完成撤军结束阿富汗战争。
en: The Asia-Pacific region will loom larger in Obama’s second-term agenda, especially as the ongoing US troop withdrawal ends the Afghanistan war by 2014.

zh: 但奥巴马必须给出更加明确的美国政策，遏制独裁统治中国的快速崛起，对外积极主张领土要求，对内激发民族主义情绪。
en: But Obama will have to define a clearer US policy, addressing China’s rapid rise under an authoritarian regime that aggressively pursues border claims and whips up nationalism at home.

zh: 美国和亚洲其他国家不能被中国牵着鼻子走，它们必须寻求让中国遵守规则。
en: The US and the rest of Asia must not merely adjust to China; they must seek to shape a China that plays by the rules.

zh: 美国战痕累累的经济
en: America’s War-Torn Economy

zh: 纽约 - - 有人说在即将来临的美国选举中有两大议题，就是伊拉克战争和经济。
en: NEW YORK – Some say there are two issues in the coming American elections: the Iraq war and the economy.

zh: 当伊拉克战事比预料的要好、而经济要差的时候，经济问题掩盖了战争问题。 但是这两个哪一个也不好。
en: On days when the war seems to be going better than expected, and the economy worse, the economy eclipses the war; but neither is faring well.

zh: 在某些意义上只有一个议题，那就是伊拉克战争。 这一战争加剧了美国经济问题。
en: In some sense, there is only one issue, and that is the war, which has exacerbated America’s economic problems.

zh: 当世界上最大经济体生病的时候，而且病得不轻，整个世界都遭殃。
en: And when the world’s largest economy is sick – and it is now very sick – the entire world suffers.

zh: 人们以往认为战争有利于经济。
en: It used to be thought that wars were good for the economy.

zh: 毕竟，很多人认为第二次世界大战帮助全球经济摆脱了大萧条。
en: After all, World War II is widely thought to have helped lift the global economy out of the Great Depression.

zh: 但是，我们至少从凯恩斯时代以来知道如何更为有效地刺激经济，而且其方法也提高长期的生产效劳和提高生活水平。
en: But, at least since Keynes, we know how to stimulate the economy more effectively, and in ways that increase long-term productivity and enhance living standards.

zh: 这一场战争尤其对经济不利有三个原因。
en: This war, in particular, has not been good for the economy, for three reasons.

zh: 首先，它造成石油价格上升。
en: First, it has contributed to rising oil prices.

zh: 美国开战的时候，石油价格是25美元不到，而期货市场预计价格会在十年内保持这一水平。
en: When the United States went to war, oil cost less than $25 a barrel, and futures markets expected it to remain there for a decade.

zh: 期货交易员了解中国和其他新兴市场的增长。 但是他们预计主要来自中东产油国的石油供给与需求增长同步。
en: Futures traders knew about the growth of China and other emerging markets; but they expected supply – mainly from low-cost Middle East providers – to increase in tandem with demand.

zh: 这一战争改变了这一等式。
en: The war changed that equation.

zh: 高油价意味着美国人(以及欧洲人和日本人) 向中东石油独裁者以及其他地方的出口国支付数以亿计的美元，而不是用在国内。
en: Higher oil prices mean that Americans (and Europeans and Japanese) are paying hundreds of millions of dollars to Middle East oil dictators and oil exporters elsewhere in the world rather than spending it at home.

zh: 而且，花费在伊拉克战争上的金钱如今并不像花在国内道路、医院或者学校那样刺激经济，而且也并不有利于长期经济增长。
en: Moreover, money spent on the Iraq war does not stimulate the economy today as much as money spent at home on roads, hospitals, or schools, and it doesn’t contribute as much to long-term growth.

zh: 经济学家谈论所谓如何通过花钱来刺激经济。
en: Economists talk about “bang for the buck” – how much economic stimulus is provided by each dollar of spending.

zh: 难以想像把钱花在在伊拉克工作的尼泊尔承包商身上可以如何刺激经济。
en: It’s hard to imagine less bang than from bucks spent on a Nepalese contractor working in Iraq.

zh: 随着美元大量外流，美国经济理应比现在看起来的要差劲。
en: With so many dollars going abroad, the American economy should have been in a much weaker shape than it appeared.

zh: 但是，正如布什政府竭力通过不完整和误导的会计手法来掩盖战争的实际代价，美联储提供了大量的流动资金而且金融行业监管松弛掩盖了经济缺陷。
en: But, much as the Bush administration tried to hide the true costs of the war by incomplete and misleading accounting, the economy’s flaws were covered up by a flood of liquidity from the Federal Reserve and by lax financial regulation.

zh: 如此众多的钱涌入经济之中，而监管又如此不力，乃至于一家美国大银行的贷款广告是“生而合格 ” 。 这清楚地表明了实际上就没有什么信贷标准。
en: So much money was pumped into the economy and so lax were regulators that one leading American bank advertised its loans with the slogan “qualified at birth” – a clear indication that there were, in effect, no credit standards.

zh: 布什政府希望清算的日子在2008年11月以后到来。 相反，2007年8月局面就显现出来了。
en: In a sense, the strategy worked: a housing bubble fed a consumption boom, as savings rates plummeted to zero.  The economic weaknesses were simply being postponed to some future date; the Bush administration hoped that the day of reckoning would come after November 2008.  Instead, things began to unravel in August 2007.

zh: 现在布什政府的反应是一项综合经济刺激办法，而这一办法来得太少太迟，而且结构粗糙。
en: Now it has responded, with a stimulus package that is too little, too late, and badly designed.

zh: 近年来，房产股本贷款超过一万五千亿美元。 跟这个相比较就可以看出这一办法是不够的了。
en: To see the inadequacy of that package, compare it with the more than $1.5 trillion that was borrowed in home equity loans in recent years, most of it spent on consumption.

zh: 基于房产价格只会上升这一信念的游戏结束了。
en: That game – based on a belief in ever-spiraling home prices – is over.

zh: 随着房产价格下降(而且会继续下降)以及银行对自身的财政状态不确信，贷款者不愿意借钱给人而各个家庭又不愿意借钱。
en: With home prices falling (and set to continue to fall), and with banks uncertain of their financial position, lenders will not lend and households will not borrow.

zh: 因此，尽管美联储向金融系统注入的额外流动资金或许防止了崩溃，但是它并不会刺激多少消费或者投资。
en: So, while the additional liquidity injected into the financial system by the Fed may have prevented a meltdown, it won’t stimulate much consumption or investment.

zh: 相反，大部分钱会流向国外。
en: Instead, much of it will find its way abroad.

zh: 例如中国就担心美联储的刺激手段将会提高其国内的通货膨胀。
en: China, for example, is worried that the Fed’s stimulus will increase its domestic inflation.

zh: 这一战争对于美国经济不利还有第三个原因。
en: There is a third reason that this war is economically bad for America.

zh: 美国不仅已经在这一战争上花费巨资每月高达一千二百亿美元，而且还在增加，但是大部分的账单还是没有支付，例如从战场返回的40%残疾老兵的补偿和医疗费用。 许多士兵的伤势严重。
en: Not only has America already spent a great deal on this war – $12 billion a month, and counting – but much of the bill remains to be paid, such as compensation and health care for the 40% of veterans who are returning with disabilities, many of which are very serious.

zh: 而且，为这一战争提供资金的方式与美国历史上的任何其他战争都不同，可能与任何国家近来的历史都不同。
en: Moreover, this war has been funded differently from any other war in America’s history –perhaps in any country’s recent history.

zh: 一般情况下，交战国家在要求年轻男女承受生命危险的时候会要求大家共��风险。
en: Normally, countries ask for shared sacrifice, as they ask their young men and women to risk their lives.

zh: 税收会提高。
en: Taxes are raised.

zh: 还有人讨论应该把多少负担转嫁到后人身上。 在这一战争中，没有人讨论这些。
en: There is a discussion of how much of the burden to pass on to future generations.  In this war, there was no such discussion.

zh: 美国开战的时候还有赤字。
en: When America went to war, there was a deficit.

zh: 但是令人惊奇的是，布什却要求为富人鲁莽地减税并且还如愿以偿。
en: Yet remarkably, Bush asked for, and got, a reckless tax cut for the rich.

zh: 这就意味着花在战争上的前事实上是借来的。
en: That means that every dollar of war spending has in effect been borrowed.

zh: 两个世纪以前的独立战争以来第一次美国向外国人借钱用来打仗，因为美国家庭没有储蓄。
en: For the first time since the Revolutionary War, two centuries ago, America has had to turn to foreigners for financing, because US households have been saving nothing .

zh: 这一数字难以置信。
en: The numbers are hard to believe.

zh: 国家债务在八年时间里增加了50 % ， 而增加的一万亿美元花在了打仗上面。 这一数目在十年内可能会增加两倍多。
en: The national debt has increased by 50% in eight years, with almost $1 trillion of this increase due to the war – an amount likely to more than double within ten years.

zh: 谁会相信一个政府会这么快做了这么多破坏？
en: Who would have believed that one administration could do so much damage so quickly?

zh: 美国以及全世界都会在未来几十年中付出代价来修复这些破坏。
en: America, and the world, will be paying to repair it for decades to come.

zh: 奥巴马的伊朗年
en: Obama’s Year of Iran

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 随着美国总统奥巴马第二任期的开始，他不得不耗费大量精力整顿国内财政政策。
en: PRINCETON – As US President Barack Obama begins his second term, he will have to devote much of his attention to figuring out how to get America’s domestic finances in order.

zh: 但外交问题同样十分突出，尽管叙利亚冲突持续不断且战火有可能蔓延至非洲萨赫勒地区，华盛顿的共识是2013年将是伊朗问题的“决策之年 ” 。
en: But foreign-policy issues loom large as well, and, notwithstanding the ongoing conflict in Syria and the possible spread of war across Africa’s Sahel region, the consensus in Washington is that 2013 will be the “year of decision” on Iran.

zh: 奥巴马开启首任任期时就曾承诺要与伊朗伊斯兰共和国保持接触；这一点在2009年他首次令人难忘的就职演说中就曾有记录 ， “ 如果你们愿意松开双拳，我们就将伸出援手。
en: Obama began his first administration with an offer to engage with the Islamic Republic; as he memorably put it in his first inaugural address in 2009, “We will extend a hand if you are willing to unclench your fist.”

zh: ”他转弯抹角地在第二次就职演说时重申了这项承诺 ： “ 我们将显示出和平解决与他国分歧的勇气 — — 这并非因为我们天真到无视所面临的风险，而是因为接触可以更持久地消除怀疑和恐惧。 ”
en: He repeated that commitment, although much more obliquely, in his second inaugural address: “We will show the courage to try and resolve our differences with other nations peacefully – not because we are naive about the dangers we face, but because engagement can more durably lift suspicion and fear.”

zh: 正如美国学者兼社会活动家侯赛因·伊比什近来所说，奥巴马任命的内阁让他有最大空间通过谈判与伊朗达成交易。
en: As the American scholar and activist Hussein Ibish recently argued, Obama has appointed a cabinet designed to give him maximum room to negotiate a deal with Iran.

zh: 特别是任命退伍军人担任国务卿和国防部长将为达成协议提供宝贵的国内政治掩护，因为协议签署将不可避免地需要解除对伊朗的制裁，并几乎肯定要承认伊朗提取低纯度浓缩铀的权利。
en: In particular, naming military veterans as Secretary of State and Secretary of Defense will provide him with valuable domestic political cover for an agreement that would inevitably require lifting sanctions on Iran and almost certainly recognizing its right to enrich uranium at a low level of concentration.

zh: 这不仅将向伊朗统治者表明美国对协议的态度非常严肃，而且要让他们明白，美国所提出的将是他们可以期望得到的最好的交易。
en: That should signal to Iran’s rulers not only that the US is serious about a deal, but also that whatever the US offers is likely to be the best deal that they can get.

zh: 奥巴马政府已组建特别国家联盟实施经济制裁，并已对伊朗国内的商品价格和供应情况产生显著影响，就连革命卫队等强权机构在生意往来中也无法摆脱这种影响。
en: The Obama administration has assembled an extraordinary coalition of countries to impose economic sanctions that are having a demonstrable effect on the price and availability of goods in Iran and on the ability of even powerful institutions, such as the Revolutionary Guard, to do business.

zh: 但联盟不可能永远稳固，制裁之痛往往具有两面性，在影响买方的同时也影响卖方。
en: But coalitions do not hold together forever, and the pain of sanctions often cuts both ways, affecting buyers as well as sellers.

zh: 比方说，韩日等国仅仅是勉强压缩从伊朗的原油进口，而中俄等国则从一开始就极少对制裁投赞成票。
en: Countries like South Korea and Japan, for example, have curtailed their imports of Iranian oil only reluctantly; countries like China and Russia rarely play straight on sanctions in the first place.

zh: 此外，奥巴马威胁“所有选择都已摆在桌面上”的次数不能多到在伊朗和其他中东国家民众面前丧失信誉。
en: Moreover, Obama can threaten that “all options are on the table” only so many times without losing credibility with the Iranians and other countries in the Middle East.

zh: 布鲁金斯学会外交政策专家苏珊·马洛尼指出，中东及其他地区国家已经对美国在叙利亚问题上鲜有作为而感到沮丧。
en: As Brookings Institution foreign-policy expert Suzanne Maloney points out, countries in the region and beyond are already dismayed at the lack of US leadership concerning Syria.

zh: 如果美国再次试图展开正式谈判（本着真诚接触的意愿提出可信的建议 ） ， 却在再次遭到拒绝后什么也不做，则必将切实暴露其纸老虎的真实面目。
en: If the US gives negotiations one more serious try (a credible offer and a genuine willingness to engage), gets rebuffed, and then does nothing, it will effectively declare itself a paper tiger.

zh: 如果出现这种情况，制裁联盟最有可能因全面丧失对美国领导力的信心而土崩瓦解。
en: At that point, the sanctions coalition will most likely disintegrate amid a much broader loss of confidence in US leadership.

zh: 美国就这样把自己逼进了死胡同。
en: The US has thus painted itself into a corner.

zh: 美国前国家安全顾问兹比格涅夫·布热津斯基不久前提出坚决反对军事行动，并提出战略要继续制裁并扩大威慑。
en: Former US National Security Adviser Zbigniew Brzezinski recently argued strongly against military action, proposing, instead, a strategy that would continue sanctions and extend deterrence.

zh: 像冷战时期美国对苏联集团的政策一样 ， “ 伊朗对以色列或中东任何美国盟国的军事威胁将被视为对美国的直接挑衅，并将导致美国采取相应的对策。 ”
en: Like US policy toward the Soviet bloc during the Cold War, “An Iranian military threat aimed at Israel or any other US friend in the Middle East would be treated as if directed at the United States itself and would precipitate a commensurate US response.”

zh: 我真正理解布热津斯基做法的智慧之处。
en: I can certainly see the wisdom in Brzezinski’s approach.

zh: 但奥巴马率领着美国及其盟国在这条路上走过了头。
en: But Obama has marched the US and its allies too far down the current path.

zh: 此外，关键问题是，布热津斯基忘了奥巴马不仅因为关注以色列安全抑或整个中东地区稳定而决意阻止伊朗获取核武器。
en: Moreover, and crucially, Brzezinski forgets that Obama’s determination to stop Iran from acquiring a nuclear weapon does not stem only from his concern for Israel’s security or the stability of the wider Middle East.

zh: 奥巴马已反复承诺要实现“全球零核化”目标 — — 即消除全世界所有核武器。
en: Obama has repeatedly committed himself to the goal of turning the world in the direction of “global zero” – a world without nuclear weapons.

zh: 他坚信（前国务卿亨利·基辛格和乔治·舒尔茨，前国防部长威廉·佩里和前参议员萨姆·纳恩也秉承同样的信念）除非世界找到一种无核化方法，否则国际体系中将有30－50个国家持有核武器，进而导致意外或蓄意发射的危险性提高到无法接受的程度。
en: He believes (as do former Secretaries of State Henry Kissinger and George Shultz, former Secretary of Defense William Perry, and former Senator Sam Nunn) that unless the world finds a way to live without nuclear weapons, we will find ourselves in an international system in which 30-50 states possess them, raising the danger of accidental or deliberate launch to an unacceptably high level.

zh: 说服大国销毁核武器或许看上去就像让美国国会通过枪支管制法一样在政治上想入非非，但在这个问题上，奥巴马已经明确表示自己愿意尝试。
en: Convincing great powers to eliminate their nuclear arsenals might seem as politically fanciful as pushing gun-control legislation through the US Congress, but on that issue, too, Obama has made clear that he is willing to try.

zh: 无论遏制政策多么严谨而富于诱惑，奥巴马任内实现全球无核化的承诺意味着他不会像前任纵容印度、以色列、朝鲜和巴基斯坦那样任由另一个国家获取核武器。
en: However logical or attractive a containment policy might be, and however disastrous the consequences of bombing are likely to be, Obama’s commitment to realizing global denuclearization as part of his legacy implies that he will not allow another country to acquire a nuclear weapon on his watch, as his predecessors allowed India, Israel, North Korea, and Pakistan to do.

zh: 因此，美国和伊朗双方都押上了极高的赌注。
en: Thus, the stakes for both the US and Iran are very high.

zh: 其他国家最好不要低估奥巴马的决心；与伊朗有关系的政府应当强调达成交易的时机已经成熟。
en: Other countries would do well not to underestimate Obama’s resolve; governments that have relations with Iran should emphasize that the time to make a deal is now.

zh: 土耳其和巴西等国政府（也许还有印度和埃及）可以通过为伊朗设计出在满足国际社会要求的同时能够保全颜面的方式来发挥有益的作用，此外还需制定长期燃料浓缩替代方案，从而减轻全球核威胁。
en: And countries like Turkey and Brazil (and perhaps India and Egypt) could play a useful role by devising face-saving ways for the Iranians to meet the international community’s demands, together with longer-term alternatives for fuel enrichment that would be consistent with reducing the global nuclear threat.

zh: 反过来，美国的盟国必须在制定交易内容和进行军事打击时与美国保持一致。
en: America’s allies, in turn, must be prepared to close ranks with it on both the outlines of a deal and the willingness to strike militarily.

zh: 治国的艺术不是要像两者相互排斥般在战争和外交之间做出选择，而是必须理解这两种方案怎样相互结合。
en: The art of statecraft is not to choose between war and diplomacy as if they were mutually exclusive alternatives, but to understand how they fit together.

zh: 具体到叙利亚问题，西方国家曾多次在排除军事行动可能性的前提下呼吁外交解决，这样做显然不会取得太好的结果。
en: In the case of Syria, the West has repeatedly called for diplomacy while ruling out any military action, with predictably bad results.

zh: 美国不会在伊朗问题再次犯错。
en: The US will not make that mistake with Iran.

zh: 伪善的美国
en: America the Hypocritical

zh: 在去年7月庆祝美国独立230周年时，布什总统强调“美国革命战争”的爱国者们坚信人生来平等，拥有不可剥夺的权利。
en: In commemorating the 230th anniversary of America’s independence last July, President George W. Bush noted that the patriots of the Revolutionary War believed that all men are created equal, and with inalienable rights.

zh: 他宣称，因为这些理想，美国“仍然是所有梦想自由的人们的希望灯塔，也为全世界树立了一个自由民族能够实现的成就的楷模。 ”
en: Because of these ideals, he proclaimed, the United States “remains a beacon of hope for all who dream of liberty and a shining example to the world of what a free people can achieve.”

zh: 但与此同时，他的政府却在位于古巴关塔纳摩湾的美国海军基地羁押了约400名囚犯。
en: But, at the same time, his administration was holding approximately 400 prisoners at the US Naval Base at Guantánamo Bay in Cuba.

zh: 他们中间有的人已经被关押了5年多，其中没有一个人受到过审判。
en: Some of them have now been there for more than five years. None of them has ever been put on trial.

zh: 上个月，来源高度可靠的消息证实关塔纳摩的囚犯们所遭受的还不仅仅是无限期的关押。
en: Last month, a highly reputable source confirmed that the Guantánamo prisoners are suffering from more than indefinite detention.

zh: 美国联邦调查局（FBI）所发布的文件显示，一名FBI特工“好几次”目睹被关押者“以婴儿的姿势被手脚同铐在地上 ” ， 没有椅子、食物或水。
en: The US Federal Bureau of Investigation released documents showing that an FBI agent witnessed “on several occasions” detainees who were “chained hand and foot in [a] fetal position to [the] floor,” without a chair, or food or water.

zh: 在这种情况下 ， “ 大多数人都大小便在自己身上。
en: In these conditions, “most urinated or defecated on [them]selves.”

zh: ”他们在这样的情况下会待上18或24小时，或更长的时间。
en: They were left there for 18 or 24 hours, or more.

zh: 这位特工报告说，某一次 ， “ 空调的温度被调得如此之低，以至于赤脚的被囚者冷得发抖。
en: On one of these occasions, the agent reported, “the air conditioning was turned up so low that the barefooted detainee was shaking with cold.”

zh: ”另有一次，囚室没有通风，室温高达100华氏度，被囚者躺在地上几乎失去知觉，旁边还有一堆头发 — “ 很明显，他整夜都在抓扯着自己的头发。 ”
en: On another occasion the room was unventilated, the temperature over 100 degrees Fahrenheit, and the detainee was almost unconscious on the floor with a pile of hair next to him – “he had apparently been pulling it out throughout the night.”

zh: 另一位FBI特工被一位民间承包人开玩笑似地告知“必须得去见识一下。
en: Another FBI agent was laughingly told by a civilian contractor, “[Y]ou have to see this.”

zh: ”于是他被带到一间审讯室，看见一个长头发满脸胡子的男子被“裹满大半个头部”的管道包裹带搞得快要窒息。
en: He was then taken to an interrogation room where he saw a longhaired man with a full beard who was gagged with duct tape that “covered much of his head.”

zh: 当这名特工询问怎样取下封带时却没有得到答案。
en: When the agent asked how the tape would be removed, he was not given any answer.

zh: 其他FBI特工报告说看到囚犯被戴上镣铐在低气温的情况下待上12个小时或更长的时间，同时还被用闪光灯照射和高音量的说唱乐轰炸长达数小时，或者被强迫用以色列国旗包裹自己的身体。
en: Other FBI agents reported seeing prisoners left in shackles for 12 hours or more, again in cold conditions, being subjected to strobe lights and loud rap music for many hours, or being forced to wrap themselves in an Israeli flag.

zh: 而FBI报告对这些事件的注释性评论认为“就国防部目前的政策而言（这些事件）似乎并不出格。 ”
en: The FBI report noted these incidents with the comment: “doesn’t seem excessive given Department of Defense policy.”

zh: 几位被羁押者告诉FBI特工说他们与恐怖主义并无关系，不知道为什么会被绑架并带到关塔纳摩。
en: Several of the detainees told the FBI agents that they had no connection with terrorism and had no idea why they had been abducted and taken to Guantánamo.

zh: 许多囚犯并不是在阿富汗战争中被俘的。
en: Many prisoners were not captured fighting in Afghanistan.

zh: 有的人在波斯尼亚、印度尼西亚、泰国、毛里塔尼亚和巴基斯坦被抓捕。
en: Some were picked up in Bosnia, Indonesia, Thailand, Mauritania, and Pakistan.

zh: 布什政府说这些被关押者是全球反恐战争中的“敌方战斗分子 ” — 那是一场在全世界范围内发动，可能持续数十年的战争。
en: The Bush administration says that the detainees are “enemy combatants” in the global war against terror – a war that is being waged around the world, and that could last for decades.

zh: 关塔纳摩特别行动的指挥官，海军少将小Harry B. Harris最近为残酷对待囚犯的行为辩护说 ： “ 他们都是恐怖分子；他们都是敌方的战斗分子。 ”
en: The commander of the Guantánamo task force, Rear Admiral Harry B. Harris, Jr., recently defended harsh treatment of his prisoners, claiming, “They’re all terrorists; they’re all enemy combatants.”

zh: 但美国中央情报局（CIA）曾经犯过错误。
en: But the CIA has made mistakes before.

zh: 例如，Murat Kurnaz，一位出生在德国的土耳其人，就在被关押在关塔纳摩长达4年后于去年8月获释。
en: For example, Murat Kurnaz, a German-born Turkish man, was held in Guantánamo for four years before being released last August.

zh: 另一位黎巴嫩裔的德国人Khaled el-Masri的案子似乎也是同样错误的结果。
en: The case of Khaled el-Masri, a German citizen of Lebanese descent, appears to be another of these errors.

zh: 被中情局在马其顿抓获以后，他被带到阿富汗，并在遭受了长达5个月的审讯之后被无罪开释。
en: Seized by the CIA in Macedonia, he was taken to Afghanistan and interrogated for five months before being released without charge.

zh: 德国的一家法院已经对参与这起绑架的人员发出了逮捕令。
en: A German court has now issued arrest warrants for those involved in his abduction.

zh: 如果根本上还有人权的话，那么不被未经审讯无限期关押的权利肯定是其中一条。
en: If there are any human rights at all, the right not to be locked up indefinitely without trial is surely one of them.

zh: 《美国宪法》的《人权法案》再三强调了这一项权利，在《第六修正案》中特别指出在所有刑事起诉中 ， “ 被告享有在迅速和公开的情况下被一个公正的陪审团审判的权利”并“有权被告知指控的内容和原由；有权面对控方证人。
en: The US Constitution’s Bill of Rights puts considerable emphasis on that right, specifying in the Sixth Amendment that in all criminal prosecutions, “the accused shall enjoy the right to a speedy and public trial, by an impartial jury” and “to be informed of the nature and cause of the accusation; to be confronted with the witnesses against him.”

zh: ”而却没有一个关塔纳摩的囚犯被给予了这样的权利。
en: None of the Guantánamo inmates has been granted these rights.

zh: 所以，他们是恐怖分子的论断从未得到过由美国《宪法》所设立的标准的证实。
en: So it has never been proved, by the standards laid down in the US Constitution that any of them really are terrorists.

zh: 但《第六修正案》却��不适用于关塔纳摩的囚犯，因为他们不是美国公民，并且被关押在从技术上讲并非位于美国领土的设施里，虽然这一设施完全在美国政府的控制之下。
en: But the Sixth Amendment does not apply to the Guantánamo prisoners, because they are not US citizens and are in a facility that, technically, is not part of US territory, although it is under the full control of the US government.

zh: 不论美国法庭如何解释，从全世界各地绑架人口，将他们在未被治罪的情况下关押数年，并以残酷和侮辱的方式对待他们就是对国际法的公然践踏。
en: Whatever US courts say about it, abducting people all over the world, locking them up for years without establishing that they are guilty of anything, and subjecting them to harsh and abusive treatment is a flagrant violation of international law.

zh: 以任何的司法标准来看这都是错误的。
en: By any standard of justice, it is also just plain wrong.

zh: 汤姆•佩恩，这位伟大的美国革命者和《人类的权利》一书的作者写道 ： “ 想确保自身自由的人甚至必须保卫他的敌人也不受压迫；因为如果他违反了这项义务，就建立了一个会使他自己承受同样后果的先例。
en: Tom Paine, the great American revolutionary and author of The Rights of Man, wrote: “He that would make his own liberty secure must guard even his enemy from oppression; for if he violates this duty he establishes a precedent that will reach himself.”

zh: ”要是美国听进了这一忠告，那么它还真的有可能成为一座希望的灯塔和一个耀眼的楷模。
en: If America would only follow that advice, it might really be a beacon of hope and a shining example.

zh: 但只要它仍然不进行公正的审判，继续扣押和虐待囚犯，那么它所鼓吹的理想会继续在全世界其他人的耳朵里听来如同极度的伪善。
en: But as long as it continues to hold and abuse prisoners without giving them a fair trial, America’s professed ideals will continue to sound to the rest of the world like the deepest hypocrisy.

zh: 输者美国
en: America the Loser

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 《华盛顿邮报》的凯瑟琳·兰普尔（Catherine Rampell）最近追述了总统特朗普于2017年2月在白宫与哈雷摩托车高管和工会代表举行会议时的情形，他感谢与会各位“在美国进行生产建设 ” ， 并预测这家标志性的美国摩托车公司将在他任内持续扩张。
en: BERKELEY – The Washington Post’s Catherine Rampell recently recalled that when US President Donald Trump held a session for Harley-Davidson executives and union representatives at the White House in February 2017, he thanked them “for building things in America.” Trump went on to predict that the iconic American motorcycle company would expand under his watch.

zh: “我知道你们的生意现在相当好 ， ” 他说 ， “ 这个国家在过去几个月总是缺少点精气神，而现在全都有了。 ”
en: “I know your business is now doing very well,” he observed, “and there’s a lot of spirit right now in the country that you weren’t having so much in the last number of months that you have right now.”

zh: 会后一年，时过境迁。
en: What a difference a year makes.

zh: 哈雷最近宣布将把部分业务转移到其他司法管辖区，以免遭遇欧盟针对特朗普进口钢铁/铝关税而采取的报复措施影响。
en: Harley-Davidson recently announced that it would move some of its operations to jurisdictions not subject to the European Union’s retaliatory measures adopted in response to Trump’s tariffs on imported steel and aluminum.

zh: 而特朗普则发推特说 ： “ 我惊讶地发现哈雷竟然是所有企业里第一个举白旗的。 ”并许下一个无法兑现的承诺 ： “ . . . . . .
en: Trump then took to Twitter to say that he was, “Surprised that Harley-Davidson, of all companies, would be the first to wave the White Flag.”

zh: 最终（我会让）他们无需支付关税就把产品卖进欧盟。 “
en: He then made a promise that he cannot keep: “… ultimately they will not pay tariffs selling into the EU.”

zh: 然后在稍后发出的推文中，特朗普错误地写道 ： “ 今年年初，哈雷表示将把堪萨斯城的大部分工厂搬迁到泰国”并使用“关税/贸易战作为借口。
en: Then, in a later tweet, Trump falsely stated that, “Early this year Harley-Davidson said they would move much of their plant operations in Kansas City to Thailand,” and that “they were just using Tariffs/Trade War as an excuse.”

zh: ”事实上，当该公司宣布即将关闭其在密苏里州堪萨斯城的工厂时，这些业务其实要被转移到宾夕法尼亚州的约克市。
en: In fact, when the company announced the closure of its plant in Kansas City, Missouri, it said that it would move those operations to York, Pennsylvania.

zh: 无论如何，特朗普的观点是荒谬的。
en: At any rate, Trump’s point is nonsensical.

zh: 如果企业是基于他自己宣称即将发动贸易战的预期而做出行动，那么贸易战不仅仅是一个借口，而是真实存在的。
en: If companies are acting in anticipation of his own announcement that he is launching a trade war, then his trade war is not just an excuse.

zh: 在另一条推文中，特朗普转而威胁并警告说 ， “ 哈雷必须意识到自己必须缴纳重税，否则别想把摩托车卖回美国！
en: In yet another tweet, Trump turned to threats, warning that, “Harley must know that they won’t be able to sell back into U.S. without paying a big tax!”

zh: ”但是这个说法依然是荒谬的：哈雷之所以将部分生产转移到不受欧盟关税限制国家，其目的就是向欧洲人出售免关税摩托车。
en: But, again, this is nonsensical: the entire point of Harley-Davidson shifting some of its production to countries not subject to EU tariffs is to sell tariff-free motorcycles to Europeans.

zh: 在最后一条推文中特朗普开始发号施令 ： “ 哈雷绝不应该在另一个国家生产 — — 永远不要！
en: In a final tweet, Trump decreed that, “A Harley-Davidson should never be built in another country – never!”

zh: ”然后他发誓要毁掉这个企业 — — 从而毁掉人们的工作 ： “ 走着瞧，如果他们搬家，这就是一场终结的开端 — — 他们会投降，倒闭！
en: He then went on to promise the destruction of the company, and thus the jobs of its workers: “If they move, watch, it will be the beginning of the end – they surrendered, they quit!

zh: 光环将会消失，税也会前所未有地重！ ”
en: The Aura will be gone and they will be taxed like never before!”

zh: 毋庸置疑，这一切都不正常。
en: Needless to say, none of this is normal.

zh: 特朗普的声明明显就是蔑视法治。
en: Trump’s statements are dripping with contempt for the rule of law.

zh: 其中没有任何一条能达到可称之为贸易政策的水平，更别说治理了。
en: And none of them rises to the level of anything that could be called trade policy, let alone governance.

zh: 这俨然让我们回到了英王亨利八世执政的时代 — — 这位冲动癫狂的君主被一群财阀，马屁精和谄媚者所包围着，所有人都试图保持国家这艘大船不沉的情况下尽量给自己捞好处。
en: It is as if we have returned to the days of Henry VIII, an impulsive, deranged monarch who was surrounded by a gaggle of plutocrats, lickspittles, and flatterers, all trying to advance their careers while keeping the ship of state afloat.

zh: 特朗普显然无法心怀善意地履行其职务。
en: Trump is clearly incapable of executing the duties of his office in good faith.

zh: 美国众议院和参议院早就该弹劾他并将其赶下台 — — 至少他已经违反了美国宪法中的薪酬条款。
en: The US House of Representatives and Senate should have impeached him and removed him from office already – for violations of the US Constitution’s emoluments clause, if nothing else.

zh: 除此之外，副总统迈克·彭斯（Mike Pense）应该早就援引第25修正案，废黜这位大多数内阁成员认为“无法履行其职务权力和职责”的总统。
en: Barring that, Vice President Mike Pence should have long ago invoked the 25th Amendment, which provides for the removal of a president whom a majority of the cabinet has deemed “unable to discharge the powers and duties of his office.”

zh: 然而，无论是众议院议长保罗·瑞恩（Paul Ryan）还是参议院多数派领袖米奇·麦康奈尔（Mitch McConnell）以及彭斯都不敢针对特朗普对美国民主的攻击进行任何反抗。
en: And yet, neither Speaker of the House Paul Ryan nor Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell nor Pence has dared to do anything about Trump’s assault on American democracy.

zh: 共和党人担心如果跟（目前有近90％的选民基础支持）的特朗普对着干，他们将在今年11月的国会中期选举民调中受挫。
en: Republicans are paralyzed by the fear that if they turn on Trump, who is now supported by roughly 90% of their party’s base, they will all suffer at the polls in the midterm congressional election this November.

zh: 那种觉得选举将解决所有问题的想法不错。
en: It is nice to think that the election will fix everything.

zh: 但由于共和党不公正地重新划分了国会选区，民主党至少需要6%的得票优势才能重夺众议院。
en: But, at a minimum, the Democratic Party needs a six-percentage-point edge to retake the House of Representatives, owing to Republican gerrymandering of congressional districts.

zh: 此外民主党人还必须克服参议院的选区重划影响。
en: Democrats also have to overcome a gerrymandering effect in the Senate.

zh: 目前，站在民主党阵营的49名参议员代表1.81亿人，而共和党阵营的51名参议员仅代表1.42亿人。
en: Right now, the 49 senators who caucus with the Democrats represent 181 million people, whereas the 51 who caucus with the Republicans represent just 142 million people.

zh: 此外，美国中期选举期的选民投票率一向极低，为民主党候选人的前景蒙上阴影。
en: Moreover, the US is notorious for its low voter turnout during midterm elections, which tends to hurt Democratic candidates’ prospects.

zh: 特朗普和国会共和党人一直在执掌一个相对强大的经济体，虽然他们很高兴地自称是自己的，但其实是从前总统奥巴马那里继承来的。
en: And Trump and congressional Republicans have been presiding over a relatively strong economy, which they inherited from former President Barack Obama, but are happy to claim as their own.

zh: 最后，人们不能忽视恐惧因素。
en: Finally, one must not discount the fear factor.

zh: 无数美国人经常成为社交和有线媒体选举广告的受害者，这些选举广告会激发人们最恶劣的本能。
en: Countless Americans routinely fall victim to social- and cable-media advertising campaigns that play to their worst instincts.

zh: 不用想，这个选举周期也会跟过去一个德行，老年白人选民将受到关于移民、有色人种，穆斯林威胁论以及其他牛鬼蛇神特朗普选民的轰炸（如果他们还没被骗去买假糖尿病治疗方案和高价黄金基金的话 ） 。
en: You can rest assured that in this election cycle, as in the past, elderly white voters will be fed a steady diet of bombast about the threat posed by immigrants, people of color, Muslims, and other Trump-voter bugaboos (that is, when they aren’t being sold fake diabetes cures and overpriced gold funds).

zh: 无论今年11月发生了什么，情况已经很清楚，美国的世纪已经于2016年11月8日落下帷幕。
en: Regardless of what happens this November, it is already clear that the American century ended on November 8, 2016.

zh: 从那一天起，美国不再是领导世界的超级大国 — — 那个有缺陷但最终心怀善意的和平，繁荣以及世界各地人权的保障者。
en: On that day, the United States ceased to be the world’s leading superpower – the flawed but ultimately well-meaning guarantor of peace, prosperity, and human rights around the world.

zh: 美国的金德伯格式霸权时代已经过去。
en: America’s days of Kindlebergian hegemony are now behind it.

zh: 特朗普主义者在俄罗斯和美国选举人团的怂恿之下丢失的信誉，也永远无法重拾。
en: The credibility that has been lost to the Trumpists – abetted by Russia and the US Electoral College – can never be regained.

zh: 关于美国贸易赤字的令人不快的事实
en: Inconvenient Truths About the US Trade Deficit

zh: 坎布里奇—美国的贸易赤字大约为4,500亿美元，或GDP的2.5 % 。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The United States has a trade deficit of about $450 billion, or 2.5% of GDP.

zh: 这意味着美国进口的商品和服务要比它出口给世界其他国家的多4,500亿美元。
en: That means that Americans import $450 billion of goods and services more than they export to the rest of the world.

zh: 如何解释美国年复一年的巨大赤字？ 若要降低赤字，美国人的生活水平会如何变化？
en: What explains the enormous US deficit year after year, and what would happen to Americans’ standard of living if it were to decline?

zh: 很容易将巨额贸易赤字归咎于阻挠美国政府在本国市场销售的外国政府，这伤害了美国企业，也降低了这些企业员工的生活水平。
en: It is easy to blame the large trade deficit on foreign governments that block the sale of US products in their markets, which hurts American businesses and lowers their employees’ standard of living.

zh: 也很容易将巨额贸易赤字归咎于补贴对美出口的外国政府，这伤害了销售败给外国供应商的美国企业和员工（尽管在外国政府补贴美国消费者所购买的东西时，美国家庭作为一个整体是受益者 ） 。
en: It’s also easy to blame foreign governments that subsidize their exports to the US, which hurts the businesses and employees that lose sales to foreign suppliers (though US households as a whole benefit when foreign governments subsidize what American consumers buy).

zh: 但外国进口壁垒和出口补贴都不是美国贸易赤字的原因。
en: But foreign import barriers and exports subsidies are not the reason for the US trade deficit.

zh: 真正的原因是美国人花的比挣的多。
en: The real reason is that Americans are spending more than they produce.

zh: 总贸易赤字是美国家庭和企业的储蓄和投资决定的结果。
en: The overall trade deficit is the result of the saving and investment decisions of US households and businesses.

zh: 外国政府的政策只能影响这一赤字如何在美国贸易伙伴之间分配。
en: The policies of foreign governments affect only how that deficit is divided among America’s trading partners.

zh: 为何美国人的储蓄和投资决定带来了总贸易赤字？ 原因很简单：如果一国将总产出的更多部分储蓄起来而不是投资于企业设备和结构，它就有剩余产出卖给世界其他国家。
en: The reason why Americans’ saving and investment decisions drive the overall trade deficit is straightforward: If a country saves more of total output than it invests in business equipment and structures, it has extra output to sell to the rest of the world.

zh: 换句话说，储蓄减去投资等于出口减去进口 — — 这是一个基本的会计恒等式，适用于每个国家、每个年头。
en: In other words, saving minus investment equals exports minus imports – a fundamental accounting identity that is true for every country in every year.

zh: 因此，减少美国贸易赤字要求美国人增加储蓄，减少投资。
en: So reducing the US trade deficit requires Americans to save more or invest less.

zh: 让其他国家的市场对美国产品开放，或让美国市场对外国产品关闭，这些政策本身都不会改变总体贸易平衡。
en: On their own, policies that open other countries’ markets to US products, or close US markets to foreign products, will not change the overall trade balance.

zh: 美国之所以能在三十多年的时间里年年保持贸易赤字，是因为外国人愿意把钱借给美国人为其净购买融资，方式是购买美国债券和股票或者投资美国房地产和其他企业。
en: The US has been able to sustain a trade deficit every year for more than three decades because foreigners are willing to lend it the money to finance its net purchases, by purchasing US bonds and stocks or investing in US real estate and other businesses.

zh: 这并不是说未来几十年还将如此；但也没有理由认为这一局面会必然终结。
en: There is no guarantee that this will continue in the decades ahead; but there is also no reason why it should come to an end.

zh: 尽管借钱给美国借款人的外国实体总有一天要求还钱，但其他人会取而代之，成为下一批贷款人。
en: While foreign entities that lend to US borrowers will want to be repaid some day, others can take their place as the next generation of lenders.

zh: 但如果外国人作为一个整体降低了对美国金融资产的需求，这些资产的价格就会下跌，并导致利率升高。
en: But if foreigners as a whole reduced their demand for US financial assets, the prices of those assets would decline, and the resulting interest rates would rise.

zh: 美国利率的升高将制约国内投资、增加国内储蓄，导致贸易赤字下降。
en: Higher US interest rates would discourage domestic investment and increase domestic saving, causing the trade deficit to shrink.

zh: 贸易赤字的下降有助于目前需要与进口竞争的美国出口商和企业。
en: The smaller trade deficit would help US exporters and firms that now compete with imports.

zh: 但贸易赤字的下降也将减少美国人在美国国内消费的产出，或生产未来消费的投资。
en: But a decline in the trade deficit would leave Americans with less output to consume in the US or to invest in the US to produce future consumption.

zh: 而这只是故事的一部分。
en: And that is only part of the story.

zh: 除了降低美国家庭和企业可以获得的商品和服务的剩余量，贸易赤字的下降还要求美国商品和服务更加能够吸引外国买家，而外国商品和服务不再能够吸引美国买家。
en: In addition to shrinking the remaining amount of goods and services available to US households and businesses, reducing the trade deficit requires making US goods and services more attractive to foreign buyers and foreign goods less attractive to US buyers.

zh: 这意味着美国出口价格下降，进口价格升高 — — 通过美元贬值实现。
en: That means lower US export prices and higher import prices, brought about by a fall in the value of the dollar.

zh: 即使国民产出的体量不变，美国产出对国内消费者的价值也会下降，因为美国必须出口更多产出才能获得与进口相同的价值。
en: Even with the same physical volume of national output, the value of US output to domestic consumers would fall, because the US would have to export more output to obtain the same value of imports.

zh: 贸易专家估算，美国贸易赤字降低GDP的1%要求出口价格下降10%或进口价格上升10 % 。
en: Trade experts estimate that reducing the US trade deficit by one percent of GDP requires export prices to fall by 10% or import prices to rise by 10%.

zh: 如果这两个变化同时实现，将让当前贸易赤字减少相当于美国GDP的2 % ， 使美国贸易实现基本平衡。
en: A combination of these price changes is about what it would take to shrink the current trade deficit by 2% of our GDP, bringing the US close to trade balance.

zh: 但是，由于美国出口和进口分别占GDP的15%和12 % ， 出口价格下降10%将减少大约1.5%的真实（经通胀调整的）平均收入，而进口价格升高10%将让真实收入再降低1.2 % 。
en: But, because US exports and imports are 15% and 12% of GDP, respectively, a 10% decline in export prices would reduce average real (inflation-adjusted) income by 1.5%, while a 10% rise in import prices would reduce real incomes by an additional 1.2%.

zh: 因此，消除贸易赤字需要将2.5%的美国实际产量转移到世界其他国家，以及让GDP真实值再下降2.7%的进出口价格变化。
en: Thus, eliminating the trade deficit would require shifting about 2.5% of US physical production to the rest of the world, as well as a change in export and import prices that reduces their real value by another 2.7% of GDP.

zh: 简言之，在国民产出水平不变的情况下，美国真实收入将下降大约5 % 。
en: In short, with no change in the level of national output, Americans’ real incomes would decline by about 5%.

zh: 从长期看，国民产出增长率取决于美国总厂房和设备投资情况。
en: Over the longer run, the growth rate of national output depends on what happens to overall US investment in plant and equipment.

zh: 如果贸易赤字因为消费增加、投资减少而下降，那么减少的投资水平将导致增长率下降，进一步降低长期真实收入水平。
en: If the trade deficit shrinks because consumption rises and investment falls, the lower level of investment would cause the growth rate to decline, further decreasing the long-run level of real income.

zh: 但如果贸易赤字收窄是因为家庭增加储蓄和政府赤字减少，那么有投资有可能会提高 — — 从而提高长期收入。
en: But if the trade deficit narrows because households save more and government deficits are reduced, it is possible to have a higher level of investment – and thus higher incomes in the long term.

zh: 因此，美国人储蓄率变化才是贸易平衡的关键，也是其长期真实收入水平的关键。
en: So changes in America’s saving rate hold the key to its trade balance, as well as to its long-term level of real incomes.

zh: 将矛头指向其他国家并不能改变这一事实。
en: Blaming others won’t alter that fact.

zh: 美国的状态
en: The State of the United States

zh: 纽约—美国总统竞选尚未过半，还不可能笃定知道哪位能获得两大党的提名，更不用说谁能成为白宫第45位主人了。
en: NEW YORK – The US presidential election is still more than half a year away, and it is impossible to know with any certainty who will be nominated to represent the major parties, much less who will be the 45th occupant of the White House.

zh: 但评估这个拥有3.2亿居民的国家的情绪，以及这对于这场全世界大部分人眼里没完没了的政治肥皂剧的最终获胜者的意义已经不早了。
en: But it is not too soon to assess the mood of the country's more than 320 million inhabitants and what it will mean for the man or woman who ultimately prevails in what must seem to most people around the world to be an endless political soap opera.

zh: 今天，美国的主流情绪是非常焦虑的，甚至可以说是出离愤怒。
en: The dominant mood in the United States today is one of considerable anxiety, if not outright anger.

zh: 《华盛顿邮报》最近发表了一篇由四部分组成的系列文章，揭示了针对华尔街、穆斯林、贸易协议、华盛顿、警察枪击、奥巴马总统、共和党、移民和其他目标的群众愤怒。
en: The Washington Post recently published a four-part series of articles revealing popular fury aimed at Wall Street, Muslims, trade deals, Washington, police shootings, President Barack Obama, Republicans, immigrants, and other targets.

zh: 如今，对一个人最糟糕的描述是“职业政客 ” 。
en: One of the worst descriptions to be applied to a person nowadays is “professional politician.”

zh: 这一思维状态的受益者是反建制候选人，他们力挺反对自由贸易和移民改革，要求彻底改变当前税收和支出政策。
en: The beneficiaries of this state of mind are anti-establishment candidates who espouse policies in opposition to free trade and immigration reform and who call for a radical overhaul of current tax and spending policies.

zh: 他们所鼓吹的具体细节可能大不相同，但他们的平台都承诺彻底远离现状。
en: The details of what they advocate may well differ, but their platforms share a promise of radical departure from the status quo.

zh: 这一情绪背后的基础并不显而易见，因为美国经济比五六年前2007—2008年经济危机刚刚过去时情况要好。
en: The basis of this mood is hardly self-evident, as the country is better off economically than it was a half-dozen years ago, in the immediate aftermath of the 2007-2008 economic crisis.

zh: 在此期间，九百万以上工作岗位被创造出来，利率很低（让住房和汽车贷款变得很便宜 ） ， 而汽油价格的下跌相当于给每户美国家庭减税700美元。
en: Over nine million jobs have been created since then, interest rates are low (making loans for homes and cars more affordable), and the fall in the price of gasoline is the equivalent of a $700 tax cut for the average American family.

zh: 此外，股市自七年前低点上涨200 % ， 以前没有医疗保险的数百万人现在得到了保险覆盖。
en: Moreover, the stock market has risen some 200% since its low of seven years ago, and millions of people who were without health insurance are now covered.

zh: 但这一经济好消息被家庭收入增长萎靡所抵消，美国真实（经通胀调整的）家庭收入已有15年不见增加。
en: Yet this good economic news is offset in many cases by weak growth in household incomes, which have stagnated in real (inflation-adjusted) terms for some 15 years.

zh: 拥有全职工作的美国人百分比仍没有达到七年前的水平。
en: The percentage of Americans working full time has still not reached the level it was at seven years ago.

zh: 更有许多人担心会因为外国竞争、新技术或外包丢掉饭碗。
en: And many fear that their jobs will disappear because of foreign competition, new technologies, or outsourcing.

zh: 大量美国人寿命变得更长，但他们很焦虑，因为没有存够钱以保证退休后能安享晚年。
en: A large number of Americans are living longer, but are anxious, as they have failed to set aside the funds needed to ensure that their retirement will allow them to live comfortably into old age.

zh: 由于奥巴马所实施的改革要求，一些人需要支付此前免于支付的健康保险费。
en: Some are paying health-insurance premiums that they previously had avoided because of mandates in the reform enacted under Obama.

zh: 还有不平等性问题。
en: There is also the issue of inequality.

zh: 这导致真正的愤怒，但这一问题并不在于不平等（不平等尽管糟糕，但绝非新鲜事 ） ， 而在于机会的减少。
en: This causes real anger, but the problem is not so much inequality (which, though worse, is nothing inherently new) as it is the decline in opportunity.

zh: 美国梦正在让位给阶级意识 — — 对于这个建立在人人都能通过努力工作改善生活的理想的国家来说，这是个影响深远的变化。
en: The American Dream is giving way to class consciousness – a profound change for a country founded on the ideal that anyone can improve his or her lot through hard work.

zh: 但焦虑和愤怒的原因不仅限于经济现实和忧虑。
en: But the reasons for anxiety and anger transcend economic realities and worries.

zh: 还有生体不安全感，不管是因为犯罪还是因为害怕恐怖主义。
en: There is also physical insecurity, whether because of crime or the fear of terrorism.

zh: 在许多社区，还存在文化和社会何去何从的担忧。
en: In many communities, there is concern, too, about where the culture and the society are heading.

zh: 现代媒体总是让事情变得更糟。
en: Modern media tend to make things worse.

zh: 我们的时代是一个“窄播 ” （ narrowcasting）时代，而不是“广播 ” （ broadcasting）时代。
en: Ours is an age of “narrowcasting,” not broadcasting.

zh: 人们越来越只愿意看加强自身观点和意识形态的有线电视频道和网站。
en: People increasingly tune in to cable channels or websites that reinforce their views and ideologies.

zh: 所有这些都不让人放心。
en: Little of this is reassuring.

zh: 国家情绪超越选战，将给新总统和国会带来真正的挑战。
en: The national mood transcends the election campaign and will pose a real challenge to the new president and Congress.

zh: 民主党和共和党内部和彼此之间的分歧将形成妥协和联盟，这是治理不可能的关键。
en: The divisions within and between the Democratic and Republican parties will make compromise and the formation of coalitions that are essential for governing all but impossible.

zh: 关于退休和医疗平价问题的担忧将极大地增加改革权益的难度，即使这些权益的扩大将让国民债务提高到创纪录的水平。
en: Concerns over retirement and health-care affordability will make it that much more difficult to reform entitlements, even though their expansion will drive up the national debt to record levels.

zh: 自由贸易被指为就业损失的原因，正在失去支持，即使它也是新就业和更多消费者选择的来运 — — 也增强了美国在全世界的战略地位。
en: Free trade is blamed for job losses and is losing support, even though it has also been a source of new jobs and greater consumer choice – and has strengthened America’s strategic position around the world.

zh: 移民一直是美国特色的一部分，也是出色人才来源，现在也受到许多争议，改革前景黯淡。
en: Immigration, long part of the country’s heritage and a source of valuable talent, is now the object of so much controversy that prospects for reform are dim.

zh: 美国的情绪还可能加强官员的国内关注度。
en: The mood of the US may also intensify officials’ domestic focus.

zh: 伊拉克和阿富汗干涉的代价远远高于所得，许多美国人对此后的外交参与感到失望，对于美国可以在海外取得怎样的成果感到怀疑。
en: Already turned off by foreign involvement in the wake of the Iraq and Afghanistan interventions, which cost much more than they achieved, many Americans are skeptical of what the US can accomplish abroad.

zh: 他们对盟友没有承担公平比例的共同负担感到沮丧，越来越相信美国政府应该减少注重世界，更多解决美国的问题。
en: They are frustrated with allies seen as not carrying their fair share of common burdens, and they are increasingly convinced that the government needs to focus less on the world and more on fixing what is wrong with the US.

zh: 显然，一些其他国家的人对于这一点非常满意；但是，总体而言，这对于世界大部是一个坏消息。
en: Some in other countries will no doubt read all of this with satisfaction; but, overall, it is bad news for much of the world.

zh: 注意力涣散的分裂的美国更加不可能愿意和能够在推进中东、欧洲或亚洲的稳定或者应对全球挑战方面起到领导作用。
en: An America that is distracted and divided is less likely to be willing and able to take the lead in promoting stability in the Middle East, Europe, or Asia, or in meeting global challenges.

zh: 而没有美国的领导，这些挑战可能无法解决，成为问题，或者更糟糕地，成为危机。
en: And, without US leadership, these challenges are likely to go unmet, turning into problems or, worse, crises.

zh: 美国醒悟在气候变化之际
en: America Wakes Up to Climate Change

zh: 经过多年的争论和布什政府反对采取任何行动的态度影响，美国终于开始对全球气候变化的现实有所醒悟。
en: After years of debate in the United States, and opposition to action by the Bush administration, America is finally waking up to the reality of global climate change.

zh: 但这一过程中的主导作用并非来自总统，而是来自私有部门的行动。
en: Leadership is still not coming from the president, but the private sector has begun to act.

zh: 美国主要公司的领导人们都认为全球人为的气候变化是不争的事实，必须加以控制，而商界在这一过程中必须发挥建设性的作用。
en: Leaders of major US companies have decided that global man-made climate change is real, must be controlled, and that business must play a constructive part in the process.

zh: 因此，即便是布什政府和一些与科学证明背道而驰的人仍在粉饰太平，美国的公司领导人们还是在寻求着切实的解决方案。
en: Thus, even as the Bush administration and some scientific contrarians pretend that there is no problem, US corporate leaders are seeking practical solutions.

zh: 多年以来，基本的情况已经非常明了。
en: The basic situation has been clear for years.

zh: 化石燃料的全球性使用正导致大气中二氧化碳含量的急剧升高，而这又使地球变暖。
en: Global use of fossil fuels is contributing to a sharp rise in atmospheric carbon dioxide, which is causing the Earth to warm.

zh: 降水模式也正发生着改变。
en: Rainfall patterns are changing.

zh: 沙漠和干燥地区变得更为干旱。
en: Deserts and dry regions are becoming drier.

zh: 飓风和台风一类的极端天气现象发生的频率也在增加。
en: Extreme weather events such as hurricanes and typhoons are likely to increase.

zh: 欧洲的水灾可能会变得更为严重，而这样的过程可能已经发生了。
en: Flooding in Europe is likely to intensify, a process that may already have begun.

zh: 海平面正在上升，如果格林兰和南极洲的冰盖在全球变暖的作用下变得不稳定，那么这种上升的趋势还会进一步加剧。
en: Sea levels are rising, and could climb sharply if global warming leads to a destabilization of the Greenland and Antarctic ice sheets.

zh: 简言之，有越来越多的科学证据正强烈地显示我们这个星球已处于危险之中。 许多不良作用已经显现，而这些还只是冰山一角。
en: In short, the scientific evidence is strong and growing that the planet is at grave risk, with many ill effects already being felt and more to come.

zh: 正确的应对方式也正为越来越多的人理解。
en: The proper responses are also increasingly understood.

zh: 我们必须转向一种可持续的能量系统，一种不会让大气中的碳含量急剧增加的系统。
en: We must move to a sustainable energy system, one that does not mean a huge increase of carbon in the atmosphere.

zh: 这将会要求我们转向使用太阳能及核能在内的可再生能源，并采用能将发电厂排放的二氧化碳收集起来并集中进行安全地下处置的新技术。
en: This will require a shift to renewable energy sources such as solar power, and perhaps nuclear power, as well as new technologies to capture carbon dioxide at power plants and then to dispose of the carbon dioxide in safe underground deposits.

zh: 社会必须为采用这些新能源技术付出必要的成本，但我们从中的获益会远大于我们的付出。
en: Society will have to pay a price for these investments in new energy technologies, but the benefits will be vastly greater than the price.

zh: 美国是世界上通过能源使用排放二氧化碳的主要国家。 但在主要国家中，它为应对全球气候挑战所采取的行动却是最少的。
en: The US is the world’s major emitter of carbon dioxide from energy use, but it has done the least among all major economies to confront the global challenge.
