zh: 奥巴马总统的财政悬崖替代方案将大幅提高薪酬最高的2%人群的税率，限制他们的税收减免优惠，如今，该群体贡献了联邦个人所得税总量的45%以上。
en: President Barack Obama’s proposed alternative to the fiscal cliff would substantially increase tax rates and limit tax deductions for the top 2% of earners, who now pay more than 45% of total federal personal-income taxes.

zh: 他的预算还将增加公司税，结束当前的工资税“豁免期 ” ， 这意味着对所有工薪族增加2%的税收。
en: His budget would also increase taxes on corporations, and would end the current payroll-tax “holiday,” imposing an additional 2% tax on all wage earners.

zh: 这些变化加起来将拉低相当于约GDP的2%的总需求。
en: Together, these changes could lower total demand by nearly 2% of GDP.

zh: 更高的边际税率将遏制工作和投资的激励，进一步拖累经济活动。
en: And the higher marginal tax rates would reduce incentives to work and to invest, further impeding economic activity.

zh: 这对于一个仍在挣扎着维持不到2%的增长率的经济来说是致命的。
en: All of that could be fateful for an economy that is still struggling to sustain a growth rate of less than 2%.

zh: 国会预算办公室和美联储预计跌下财政悬崖将在2013年导致衰退，美联储伯南克最近宣称，美联储无法冲销经济所受到的消极效应。
en: The Congressional Budget Office and the Federal Reserve predict that going over the fiscal cliff would cause a recession in 2013, with Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke recently saying that the Fed would be unable to offset the adverse effect on the economy.

zh: 对于奥巴马的预算方案所造成的财政拖累，伯南克也许也会这样说。
en: He could have said the same thing about the fiscal drag that would be created by Obama’s budget proposal.

zh: 尽管国会中的共和党正确地对提高税率表示反对，但他们似乎愿意通过税收改革提高收入，如果这是包括了削减主要福利项目 — — 联邦医保和社会保障的长期成本的方案的一部分的话。
en: Although Congressional Republicans rightly object to raising tax rates, they appear willing to raise revenue through tax reform if that is part of a deal that also includes reductions in the long-run cost of the major entitlement programs, Medicare and Social Security.

zh: 尽管一些共和党只愿意看到由刺激经济更快增长带来的收入增加，但这一目标无法达到，如果边际税率不降而民主党不可能接受的公司税改革不实施的话。
en: Although some Republicans would like to see revenue increased only by stimulating faster economic growth, that cannot be achieved without the reductions in marginal tax rates and improvements in corporate taxation that the Democrats are unlikely to accept.

zh: 通过税收改革增加收入将意味着减少特别税收减免项目，目前，这些项目一致了税收收入。
en: Raising revenue through tax reform will have to mean reducing the special deductions and exclusions that now lower tax receipts.

zh: 预算方案的潜在衰退风险可以通过逐步采取扩大税基增加收入的办法避免。
en: The potential recession risk of a budget deal can be avoided by phasing in the base-broadening that is used to raise revenue.

zh: 扩大税基的合理方法可以是对每位纳税人可以通过税收减免优惠获得的减税总额加以限制。
en: A desirable way to broaden the tax base would be to put an overall cap on the amount of tax reduction that each taxpayer can achieve through deductions and exclusions.

zh: 总额限制允许每位纳税人继续获得所有已有的税收减免优惠，但限制了他可以通过这一方法削减的税收负担规模。
en: Such an overall cap would allow each taxpayer to retain all of his existing deductions and exclusions but would limit the amount by which he could reduce his tax liability in this way.

zh: 总额限制也将促使大量目前采用逐条列举扣的个人转向标准扣除 — — 这意味着极大地简化税收登记，从而是激励方面的改善。
en: An overall cap would also cause many individuals who now itemize deductions to shift to the standard deduction – implying significant simplification in record-keeping and thus an improvement in incentives.

zh: 为源自税收支出（相当于每位个人经调整的毛收入的2 % ） 的税收削减施加上限将在2013年筹集2 000亿美元，如果被应用于当前所有针对市政债券利息和雇主支付健康保险等税收减免项目的话。
en: A cap on the tax reductions derived from tax expenditures that is equal to 2% of each individual’s adjusted gross income would raise more than $200 billion in 2013 if applied to all of the current deductions and to the exclusions for municipal-bond interest and employer-paid health insurance.

zh: 即使针对慈善的减税优惠被我安全保留，只将高价值健康保险视为税收支出，2013年的额外收入仍将达到1 500亿美元。
en: Even if the full deduction for charitable gifts is preserved and only high-value health insurance is regarded as a tax expenditure, the extra revenue in 2013 would be about $150 billion.

zh: 十年后，该方案意味着不在当前基础提高税率的情况下增加2万亿美元的收入。
en: Over a decade, that implies nearly $2 trillion in additional revenue without any increase in tax rates from today’s levels.

zh: 2013年的1 500亿美元额外收入将相当于GDP的1 % ， 美国经济还吞不下如此巨额的数量，特别是如果还要加上政府支出削减和工资税增加的话。
en: Extra revenue of $150 billion in 2013 would be 1% of GDP, and could be too much for the economy to swallow, particularly if combined with reductions in government spending and a rise in the payroll tax.

zh: 但相同的基本框架可以通过设置更高的起始限制并在多年内逐渐调低实现。
en: But the same basic framework could be used by starting with a higher cap and gradually reducing it over several years.

zh: 5%的收入支出收益限制将在2013年形成750亿美元的额外收入，约相当于GDP的1 % ； 但该限制可以在未来几年里降至2 % ， 在经济更加坚挺时形成多得多的收入。
en: A 5% cap on the tax-expenditure benefits would raise only $75 billion in 2013, about 0.5% of GDP; but the cap could be reduced from 5% to 2% over the next few years, raising substantially more revenue when the economy is stronger.

zh: 减缓政府在联邦医保和社会保障方面的支出是避免国民债务长期爆发和大规模个人税率提高之所必须。
en: Slowing the growth of government spending for Medicare and Social Security is necessary to prevent a long-term explosion of the national debt or dramatic increases in personal tax rates.

zh: 这些变革也应该逐渐地实施，以保护受益者、避免经济衰退。
en: Those changes should also be phased in gradually to protect beneficiaries and avoid an economic downturn.

zh: 美国的国民债务水平在过去五年里翻了一倍，除非支出和税收的变革得到实施，否则必将在未来十年中突破GDP的100 % 。
en: America’s national debt has more than doubled in the past five years, and is set to rise to more than 100% of GDP over the next decade unless changes in spending and taxes are implemented.

zh: 精心设计的税收支出上限和福利项目支出增长逐渐放缓的组合可以扭转债务上升的趋势，强化美国经济。
en: A well-designed combination of caps to limit tax expenditures and a gradual slowing of growth in outlays for entitlement programs could reverse the rise in the debt and strengthen the US economy.

zh: 美国的当前预算谈判应该集中于达成可信的国民债务长期削减方案，同时保护短期经济扩张势头。
en: America’s current budget negotiations should focus on achieving a credible long-term decline in the national debt, while protecting economic expansion in the near term.

zh: 阿拉伯的“第三条路”
en: An Arab “Third Way”

zh: 安曼—在整个后殖民地时期，阿拉伯国家一直没能建立起有效的 — — 更不用说民主的 — — 政府制度。
en: AMMAN – Throughout the post-colonial period, Arab countries have consistently failed to produce an efficient – let alone democratic – system of government.

zh: 如今在经历了半个世纪的军事或皇室独裁与军事伊斯兰教政权的竞争后，许多阿拉伯人开始再次寻找“第三条路 ” — —通向可信的代议制民主的道路。
en: Now, after a half-century of competition between military or royal dictatorships and militant Islamist regimes, many Arabs are again seeking a “third way” – a path toward a credible form of representative democracy.

zh: 但是，他们今天的努力回合过去一样以失败收场吗？
en: But will their efforts prove as futile now as they have in the past?

zh: 中东 — — 这个名字来源于它夹在欧洲和东亚中间的地理位置 — — 曾归属奥斯曼土耳其帝国统治400年，随后，奥斯曼帝国在一战中被协约国打败，中东也根据赛克斯-皮科协定（Sykes-Picot Agreement）分裂为不同的政治单元，归属英国或法国的势力范围。
en: The Middle East – named for its geographic position between Europe and East Asia – was under Ottoman rule for 400 years before the Allied powers, after defeating the Ottomans in World War I, partitioned the region into distinct political units that, under the Sykes-Picot Agreement, fell within spheres of influence carved out by the United Kingdom and France.

zh: 但是，随着新分裂局面出现的是阿拉伯的觉醒 — — 源自对巴勒斯坦的泛阿拉伯支持。
en: But, in response to these new divisions, an Arab awakening – shaped by pan-Arabism and support for Palestine – was occurring.

zh: 天赋异禀的年轻军事执政者 — — 比如埃及的纳赛尔、伊拉克的萨达姆·侯赛因、利比亚的卡扎菲、也门的萨利赫和叙利亚的哈菲兹·阿萨德 — — 利用这一民意赢得公众支持，由执政者转身成为独裁者。
en: Charismatic young military rulers-turned-dictators like Egypt’s Gamal Abdel Nasser, Iraq’s Saddam Hussein, Libya’s Muammar el-Qaddafi, Yemen’s Ali Abdullah Saleh, and Syria’s Hafez al-Assad used these popular causes to win public support.

zh: 但他们没能给人民带来更好的生活，加上左翼思想因为苏联解体而失去信誉，于是产生了敌对运动 — — 政治伊斯兰教。
en: But their failure to deliver better lives to their citizens, together with the discrediting of left-wing ideologies following the Soviet Union’s collapse, fueled the rise of a rival movement: political Islam.

zh: 1928年成立于埃及小城伊斯梅里亚的穆斯林兄弟会是伊斯兰教最老牌、组织最好、影响最广的政治伊斯兰教支持者，它曾（现在仍然如此）受到世俗阿拉伯人和阿拉伯君主的蔑视。
en: The Muslim Brotherhood – established in the Egyptian town of Ismailia in 1928 and political Islam’s oldest, best organized, and most widespread proponent – was (and is) despised by both secular Arabs and Arab monarchies.

zh: 事实上，世俗独裁者在每一个转折点上都对穆兄会实施了镇压 — — 通常是暴力镇压，如1982年阿萨德残忍地粉碎了穆兄会领导的哈马（Hama）起义。
en: Indeed, secular dictators have worked to suppress the Brothers at every turn – often violently, as when Assad ruthlessly crushed a Brotherhood-led uprising in Hama in 1982.

zh: 被迫转入地下的穆兄会通过定位于穷人需求的社会日程赢得了支持，同时它也在不断加强其伊斯兰教关系，不惜通过强制性的“天课 ” （ 每年向宗教事务的财务捐赠）建立起社会网络。
en: Forced to operate clandestinely, the Brotherhood built its support base with a social agenda that targeted the needs of the poor, while consistently reinforcing its Islamic ties, even using the compulsory zakat (annual financial contribution to religious causes) to build up its social network.

zh: 穆兄会在保守社会和清真寺的帮助下做好了一有机会就夺取权力的准备。
en: The Brothers, with the help of a conservative society and the mosques, were prepared to seize power whenever the opportunity arose.

zh: 另一个伊斯兰教运动 — — 阿尔及利亚的伊斯兰拯救阵线在1991年几乎迎来了这样一次机会。 它赢得了第一轮大选。
en: Another Islamist movement, Algeria’s Islamic Salvation Front, almost had such an opportunity in 1991, when it won the first round of a general election.

zh: 但军队取消了第二轮大选，从而阻止了它获得胜利，并引发了一场为时八年的内战，约20万人因此丧生。
en: But the military prevented its victory by canceling the second round, triggering a brutal eight-year civil war in which an estimated 200,000 people died.

zh: 巴勒斯坦的哈马斯也属于穆兄会的分支，它成功地在2006年选战中胜出，但此后并未交出令人信服的治理成绩。
en: Palestine’s Hamas, an offshoot of the Brotherhood, succeeded at the ballot box in 2006, but has since failed to deliver credible governance.

zh: 接着便是2011年阿拉伯之春的爆发，这创造了政治革新的新机会。
en: Then the Arab Spring erupted in 2011, creating new opportunities for political renewal.

zh: 在几个月内，以穆兄会思想武装起来的伊斯兰政党就颠覆了突尼斯和埃及的世俗独裁者，并骎骎然大有接管也门和叙利亚之势，这主要是因为它们是革命中唯一的组织良好的政治运动。
en: Within months, Islamist parties shaped by the Brotherhood’s ideology had replaced secular dictators in Tunisia and Egypt, and seemed poised to take over Yemen and Syria, largely because they were the only well-organized political movements on the scene.

zh: 此外，穆斯林兄弟会还赢得了阿拉伯之春中最大、最有影响力的国家 — — 埃及的控制权。
en: Moreover, the Muslim Brotherhood gained control of Egypt, the largest and most influential of the Arab Spring countries.

zh: 但它们排他性的僵化意识形态并不适合治理如此庞大而多样化的国家。
en: But their exclusive, rigid ideology was poorly suited to governing such a large and diverse country.

zh: 结果，在掌权仅仅一年后，军队旧推翻了总统穆尔西，而支持军队的正是在2011年揭竿而起的世俗自由主义年轻人。
en: As a result, after only a year in power, the military – backed by the same secular, liberal young people who had opposed it in 2011 – drove President Mohamed Morsi out of power.

zh: 但是，由于无法给出政治替代方案，示威者的拒绝伊斯兰政府最终导致军队重新回到了权力中心。
en: Unable to mount a political alternative, however, the protesters’ rejection of the Islamist government served only to put the army back in charge.

zh: 有人指出，阿拉伯政治之所以缺乏世俗自由主义的选择，是因为害怕政治伊斯兰教。
en: Some argue that the absence of a secular liberal option in Arab politics stems from fear of political Islam.

zh: 几十年来，西方列强一直支持着阿拉伯世界的军事统治，有意忽略它们对民主运动和权利的系统性镇压，以确保伊斯兰教不会赢得权力。
en: For decades, Western powers backed military regimes in the Arab world, willingly ignoring their systematic repression of democratic movements and rights, in order to ensure that Islamists did not gain power.

zh: 如今，军队领导和伊斯兰教领导的制度都已经信誉扫地，阿拉伯政坛出现了意思形态真空。
en: Now that both the military- and Islamist-led systems have been discredited, an ideological vacuum has appeared in Arab politics.

zh: 但今天的阿拉伯人 — — 大部分不到三十岁 — — 对占支配地位的政治意思形态不感兴趣，他们更愿意接受能实施旨在创造就业、提振经济增长的可靠政策的高效代议制政府。
en: But Arabs today – most of whom are under the age of 30 – are less interested in an overarching political ideology than they are in an efficient representative government that implements sound policies aimed at creating jobs and bolstering economic growth.

zh: 简言之，他们希望政府专注于改善人民的生活。
en: In short, they want a government that is focused on improving citizens’ lives.

zh: 事实上，具体意识形态的缺失乃是起初阿拉伯之春在埃及和突尼斯取得成功的根本原因，因为它使大量年轻活跃分子能够结成松散的同盟。
en: In fact, the absence of a specific ideology was essential to the Arab Spring’s initial success in Egypt and Tunisia, for it allowed a large number of young activists to forge loose alliances.

zh: 但群众运动充其量也只能将一国推动到这一步，建立可信的代议制政府要求围绕明确指导原则组织起来的政党。
en: But mass movements can take a country only so far; establishing a credible representative government requires political parties organized around clearly defined principles.

zh: 穆斯林兄弟会具备这一组织原则，但其内在顽固性 — — 至少从其舵手穆尔西身上看来 — — 决定了它不适合执政。
en: While the Muslim Brotherhood has such an organizing principle, its internal rigidity – at least with Morsi at its helm – made it unfit to govern.

zh: 与此同时，埃及自由派之间的内斗也决定了他们无法形成建立在多样性、多数支持、尊重女性和言论自由等原则基础上的有纪律的、可靠的穆兄会替代品。
en: Meanwhile, infighting among Egypt’s liberals prevented them from establishing a disciplined, reliable alternative to the Brotherhood based on principles like diversity, plurality, respect for women, and freedom of expression.

zh: 因此，当伊斯兰政府信誉扫地时，军队成了埃及唯一的选择。
en: So when the Islamist government’s credibility collapsed, the military was Egypt’s only remaining option.

zh: 为了取得进展，推动了阿拉伯之春的年轻人领导的运动必须让他们的共同原则转化为有效的政治结构，并选出有能力将寻找共识置于个人野心之前的领导人。
en: In order to make progress, the youth-led movements that drove the Arab Spring must translate their shared principles into effective political structures, and choose leaders who are capable of placing the search for consensus ahead of personal ambition.

zh: 如果他们获得了成功，那么阿拉伯世界或许最终能够找出将军或毛拉统治的替代方案。
en: If they succeed, the Arab world may finally have an alternative to rule by generals or mullahs.

zh: 即使他们没能赢得权力，如此替代方案的出现也必将影响阿拉伯世界未来多年的日程。
en: Even if they fail to gain power, the emergence of such an alternative would surely influence the Arab world’s agenda for years to come.

zh: 一场有美国特色的石油泄漏
en: An American Oil Spill

zh: 发自新加坡 — — 每当事故发生之时，总会有一大堆指责满天飞，而当墨西哥湾深海地平线号钻井平台发生漏油事故之后，自然也没人能置身事外 — — 除了其中一个首犯，那就是美国公众。
en: SINGAPORE – When accidents happen, there is always enough blame to go around, and with the Deepwater Horizon oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico, no one has been spared – with the exception of one of the main culprits, the American public.

zh: 在事故发生几小时之内，批评就指向了所有可疑的方面：首先是美国联邦矿产管理局，因为该单位在例行检查中向英国石油公司开了绿灯，照美国总统奥巴马的说法，它还和石油企业保持着某种“亲密”关系；接着是总统奥巴马本人，因为他未能兑现自己选举时许下的承诺，对内政部进行改革；还有石油服务公司Transocean，那个有问题的防井喷装置就是出自他们之手；最后当然是英国石油公司，因为该公司“不严格”甚至是“鲁莽”的安全文化。
en: Within a few hours of the accident, critics trained their sights on all the usual suspects: the Minerals Management Service, for giving BP a pass on routine inspections and lapsing into a relationship with the oil industry that United States President Barack Obama denounced as “cozy”; Obama himself, for having failed to enact the reforms at the Interior Department that he had promised while campaigning for election; the oil services firm Transocean, for the faulty blowout preventer; and, of course, BP, for a “lax” and even “reckless” safety culture.

zh: 在持续数周的愤怒声讨之后，主要责任最终落到了英国石油公司身上。
en: After weeks of swirling wrath, primary responsibility eventually landed on BP’s shoulders.

zh: 在美国参议院小组委员会的听证会上，该公司CEO东尼·海伍德的敷衍塞责和答非所问不但激怒了议员们，还惹火了美国公众。
en: At hearings before a US Senate subcommittee, BP CEO Tony Hayward’s evasive maneuvering and failure to answer point-blank questions infuriated Congressmen and the American public alike.

zh: 他所表示的“悔恨”虽然让人感到一丝宽慰，觉得终于揪出了主犯，但对阻止油井继续泄漏却毫无帮助。
en: His expression of “contrition” may provide some relief that the key culprit has been fingered, but it brought the sealing of the well no closer.

zh: 泄露的速度既不是英国石油公司原先预计的每天1000桶，也不是流量技术集团计算的每天1.9万桶，而是最近披露的一份英国石油公司内部文件所指出的 — — 每天10万桶。
en: Furthermore, the situation in the Gulf of Mexico is worsening.  Oil is not leaking at the rate of 1,000 barrels per day, as BP originally estimated, nor up to 19,000 bpd, as calculated by the Flow Rate Technical Group. As a newly released BP internal document revealed, the actual flow is up to 100,000 bpd.

zh: 虽然这起事故无疑会有一大批受害者 — — 首当其冲的就是海湾沿岸各州的居民 — — 但美国公众不会因此而逃脱罪责。
en: While there is no denying that the accident will create a long list of victims – the residents of the Gulf states being among the worst affected – the American public also is to blame.

zh: 他们长久以来对廉价石油的痴迷，以及用“非美国生活方式”的理由来反对能源改革的做法助长了一种试图用钻探，围堰和采掘等方式来解决国家能源问题的迷思。
en: An historical addiction to cheap gasoline, and opposition to energy reform as “un-American,” has fueled an obsession with drilling, damming, and digging the country’s way out of problems.

zh: 这种对供应（增加获取能源的途径）的强调掩盖了通过遏制需求来解决问题的途径（通过改变人们的生活方式来减低能源消耗 ） ， 而后者则是更廉价且更为有效的。
en: This emphasis on the supply side (increasing access to energy fuel) has obscured cheaper and possibly more beneficial actions on the demand side (cutting energy consumption by changing people’s behavior).

zh: 比如说，美国人应该支持制订更高的燃油经济性标准或是提高联邦能源税，但他们却拒绝这样做。
en: For example, while Americans could have supported more aggressive fuel-economy standards or increased federal taxes on energy, they didn’t.

zh: 美国人总有种错觉，认为围绕着廉价石油和大排量汽车的生活方式是自己的天然权利，对提高燃油经济性标准的渴望已经持续了很多年，但政客们却像对待瘟疫一样避之唯恐不及。
en: Under the illusion that lifestyles revolving around cheap oil and big cars were America’s perennial right, fuel-economy standards languished for decades, and politicians avoided the t-word like the plague.

zh: 一直以来，美国人享用着发达国家中最便宜的燃油价格。
en: All the while, Americans have been enjoying the cheapest gasoline in the developed world.

zh: 另外，这个国家也没有预料到中国和印度的崛起会引发对燃料的爆炸性需求，进而对全球能源价格产生极大影响。
en: The country failed to anticipate the rise of China and India, whose exponential demand growth would have obvious implications for global energy prices.

zh: 而事实上，不断成熟的工程技术在某程度上弥合了供需之间的上述差距。
en: Instead, the supply-demand gap has been partly bridged by increasingly sophisticated engineering techniques.

zh: 毫无疑问，类似三维地质成像和管道水平钻井这样技术都令人眼前一亮，但如果没有和适当的应急反应方案相配套，或者定时检查以确保防止和减少事故的话，这些技术都很容易产生问题。
en: Technical feats like three-dimensional seismic imaging and tube-rotary drilling are no doubt impressive, but they are problematic when unaccompanied by adequate emergency-response plans or the regulatory oversight needed to ensure that accidents are prevented and mitigated.

zh: 如今这些问题都清楚明白地暴露了出来，以致奥巴马当即下定暂缓一切深海钻探项目的审批，并引发了人们对墨西哥湾所有现存采油项目的怀疑。
en: This is plain to see today, and it resulted in Obama’s knee-jerk imposition of a moratorium on deepwater drilling permits and suspension of existing projects in the Gulf of Mexico.

zh: 即便对离岸钻井程序和政策的调整制订已是当务之急，但如果缺乏其他控制需求方面的措施的话，效果就必然是不全面的。
en: While a regulatory overhaul of offshore drilling procedures and policies is clearly necessary, it will be insufficient to reduce the risk of spills and accidents if it is not accompanied by other demand-side measures.

zh: 比如说，现在就是时候用提高燃料经济性标准以及/或者是提高燃油税的方法来降低美国的石油需求。
en: For example, now is the time to begin reducing US oil demand through improved fuel-economy standards and/or progressive increases in fuel taxes.

zh: 这两项措施都是非常有必要的，因为当燃料使用效率在近年获得少量改进之时，人们更加长途的旅行却抹杀了这些改进。
en: Both may be necessary, because, while average fuel economy has made slight gains in recent years, the longer distances that people are traveling have offset any improvement.

zh: 政府同时也可以大力推行向电动汽车的转换。
en: The government also could start aggressively pushing a shift to electric vehicles.

zh: 在整车使用寿命成本上计算，这类汽车比汽油/柴油动力汽车节能4到6倍。
en: In terms of total lifecycle costs, these vehicles are three to six times more energy-efficient than their petroleum counterparts.

zh: 人们甚至可以稍稍改变自己的生活方式，通过给轮胎适当加压，在高速公路上开慢一点（90公里/小时是最省油的速度）以及停开自己的SUV这些方法来节省能源。
en: People could make even simpler changes to their lifestyles by properly inflating their tires, driving more slowly on the highway – a car is most fuel efficient at about 55 miles (90 kilometers) per hour – and abandoning their SUVs.

zh: “从危机中找机会”的论调在深海地平线号钻井事故的整个过程中都萦绕在耳边，但要抓住机会就必须从过去的指责中超脱出来，从错误中学习，并找到一个切合实际的长期国家能源政策。
en: The mantra of “opportunity found in crisis” has been uttered endlessly over the course of the Deepwater Horizon disaster. But seizing that opportunity requires moving past blame, learning from mistakes, and identifying how best to achieve a sensible, long-term national energy policy.

zh: 如果美国人不想发生到另一个类似深海地平线号的事故，也不忍再看到那些浑身黑油的���生动物的话，他们就必须先减少自身的石油需求，还得确保石油生产是负责而且安全的。
en: If Americans want a future without other Deepwater Horizon-style accidents and oil-tarred wildlife, they must reduce oil demand, in addition to ensuring that oil production is carried out responsibly and safely.

zh: 对俄罗斯挑战的回答
en: An Answer to the Russian Challenge

zh: 柏林－19年来，西方（美国和欧洲）一直在推延回答一个关键的战略问题：苏联后的俄罗斯应该在国际上、在欧洲秩序中扮演什么角色？
en: BERLIN – For 19 years, the West (America and Europe) has been putting off answering a critical strategic question: what role should post-Soviet Russia actually play globally and in the European order?

zh: 它应该被当作是一个难以相处的伙伴，还是被当作是一个战略对手？
en: Should it be treated as a difficult partner or a strategic adversary?

zh: 即使在去年夏天俄罗斯与格鲁吉亚短暂的战争危机期间，当进行选择变得极其尖锐的时候，西方也没有为这个问题提供一个确定的答案。
en: Even when this choice became critically acute during the crisis of Russia’s short war against Georgia last summer, the West didn’t provide a conclusive answer to this question.

zh: 如果你追随大多数东欧国家，英国以及布什政府，答案就是“战略对手 ” 。
en: If you follow most East Europeans, the United Kingdom and the Bush administration, the answer is “strategic adversary.”

zh: 但是，大多数西欧国家倾向于认为俄罗斯是一个“难以相处的伙伴 ” 。
en: But most West Europeans prefer “difficult partner.”

zh: 这两个表面上相互排斥的选择在有一点上是共同的：人们都没有最终将它们想清楚。
en: These seemingly mutually exclusive alternatives have one thing in common: neither of them has been thought through to the end.

zh: 如果你将俄罗斯看作是一个战略对手 — — 而且，在弗拉基米尔·普京领导下的大俄罗斯权力政治的回归，损害了俄罗斯的国内政策和外交政策的法治精神，这一点确实说明俄罗斯是一个战略对手 — — 那么，西方就应该从根本上改变其议程。
en: If you see Russia as a strategic adversary – and the restoration of Great Russian power politics under Vladimir Putin, to the detriment of the rule of law in domestic and foreign policy, does indeed speak for it – then the West should fundamentally change its agenda.

zh: 虽然俄罗斯再也不是苏联时期的超级大国了，但是，从军事上讲，它仍然是一个大国，至少在欧洲和亚洲是如此。
en: While Russia is no longer the superpower it was in the Soviet era, militarily it is still a great power, at least in Europe and Asia.

zh: 为了应对众多的区域冲突（伊朗，中东，阿富汗/巴基斯坦，中亚，北朝鲜）以及那些在西方的议程上具有很高优先级别的全球挑战（气候保护，裁军，军备控制，防止核扩散，能源安全 ） ， 西方和俄罗斯进行合作是必要的。
en: To address the numerous regional conflicts (Iran, Middle East, Afghanistan/Pakistan, Central Asia, North Korea) and global challenges (climate protection, disarmament, arms control, nuclear anti-proliferation, energy security) that have high priority on the Western agenda, cooperation with Russia is necessary.

zh: 西方和莫斯科的战略对抗，例如，新型的“迷你冷战 ” ， 会破坏这一议程，或者，至少会严重使其施行变得复杂化。
en: A strategic confrontation with Moscow, i.e., a new kind of “mini-Cold War,” would undermine this agenda, or at least complicate its implementation significantly.

zh: 所以，简单来讲，西方要回答的问题是，源自俄罗斯的威胁是否严重到需要西方方面进行战略再定位？
en: So the question is simply whether the threat emanating from Russia is so grave that this kind of strategic reorientation on the part of the West is required?

zh: 我认为答案是否定的。
en: I believe it is not.

zh: 普京的强国地位主张以及其强国政策，在结构上都是很脆弱的。
en: Putin’s claim to great-power status and his great-power policies are structurally very vulnerable.

zh: 这一点在油价已经跌到每桶40美元以下的时候，尤其如此。
en: This is especially true at times where the price of oil has fallen below $40 per barrel.

zh: 而且，普京很清楚这一点。
en: And he knows that.

zh: . 从人口统计角度看，俄罗斯处在急剧的衰落之中；它的经济和社会都在倒退；它的基础设施落后，在教育和职业培训方面的投资也是如此。
en: Demographically, Russia is in a dramatic nose-dive; it remains economically and socially backward; its infrastructure is underdeveloped, as are its investments in education and vocational training.

zh: 从经济上讲，它主要依赖能源和商品出口，并且在其现代化的努力中，它在很大程度上依靠西方，特别是欧洲。
en: Economically, it mainly relies on energy and commodity exports, and in its modernization efforts, it is largely dependent on the West, particularly Europe.

zh: 但是，因为其地缘政治位置和潜力，俄罗斯仍然是在欧洲和亚洲不可忽略的永久性战略因素。
en: Due to its geopolitical position and its potential, however, Russia will remain a permanent strategic factor in Europe and Asia that cannot be ignored.

zh: 因此，将俄罗斯 融入战略伙伴关系符合西方的利益。
en: To integrate the country into a strategic partnership is therefore in the West’s interest.

zh: 但是，实现这一点需要一项建立在长期考虑上的西方政策以及一个自信而实力强大的地位 ，因为克里姆林宫会将任何分歧和软弱看作是对其回归大俄罗斯权力政治的鼓励。
en: But this would require a Western policy based on long-term thinking and a self-confident and strong power position, because the Kremlin will perceive any sign of division and weakness as encouragement to return to Great Russian power politics.

zh: 几个月前，俄罗斯政府提出了一个在欧洲安全与合作组织框架内谈判新欧洲秩序的提议。
en: A few months ago, the Russian government came up with a proposal to negotiate a new European order within the framework of the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe.

zh: 俄罗斯认为20世纪90年代签订的协议是不公正的，因为这些协议是建立在当时的俄罗斯处于弱势的基础上的，并且希望对它们进行修改。
en: Russia considers the agreements from the 1990’s unjust, based as they were on its weakness at the time, and it wants to revise them.

zh: 俄罗斯的主要战略目标是，作为反对俄罗斯的军事联盟的北约的削弱，或者甚至后退，并且重新建立其在东欧和中亚的势力范围。
en: Moscow’s main strategic objective is the weakening or even roll-back of NATO as an Ant-Russian military alliance and the re-establishment of its East European and Central Asian zones of influence.

zh: 但是，普京在此犯了一个大错误，因为所有这些目标对西方来说都是无法接受的，而且克里姆林宫似乎仍不明白，北约存在最好并且最有效的保证，在过去，在现在和在将来，都是具有攻击性的俄罗斯外交政策。
en: But Putin is making a big mistake here, because all these aims are unacceptable for the West, and the Kremlin still doesn’t seem to understand that the best and most effective guarantee of NATO’s existence was, is, and will continue to be an aggressive Russian foreign policy.

zh: 作为曾是马克思列宁主义发源地的俄罗斯，其领导人似乎仍然不明白辩证法。
en: In the former mother country of Marxism-Leninism, the leaders still don’t seem to understand dialectics.

zh: 毕竟，如果俄罗斯政府真正想要对苏联后的现状进行改变，首要的是，它 应该追求在与邻国相关的政策中，减少它们担忧，而不是增加它们的担忧。
en: After all, if Russia’s government really wanted to achieve a change in the post-Soviet status quo, it should, first and foremost, pursue a policy vis-à-vis its neighbors that reduces rather than increases fears.

zh: 但是，如果反过来，这同样对西方适用：一方面，在1989/1990年后由欧洲安全与合作组织确定的新欧洲的原则，不允许有关联盟的决定可以遭到一个相邻的大国的否决。
en: But this applies similarly, if in reverse, to the West: on the one hand, the principles of a new Europe as defined by the OSCE after 1989/1990 don’t allow decisions about alliances to be subject to the veto of a large neighbor.

zh: 在自由和秘密选���以及边境神圣不可侵犯上，也是如此。
en: The same is true for free and secret elections and the inviolability of borders.

zh: 另一方面，在波兰和捷克共和国的导弹防御系统以及格鲁吉亚和乌克兰可能的对北约的加入，承担起在根本不必要的地方进行对抗的责任。
en: On the other hand, the missile defense systems in Poland and the Czech Republic, and the prospect of NATO accession for Georgia and Ukraine, assume confrontation where this was not at all necessary.

zh: 西方不应该拒绝俄罗斯对欧洲安全体系进行新的谈判的期望。
en: The West should not reject Russia’s wish for new negotiations on a European security system.

zh: 相反，这应该被看作是一个最终回答俄罗斯在欧洲的地位这一关键问题的机会。
en: Instead, it should be viewed as an opportunity finally to answer the key question of Russia’s place within Europe.

zh: 在此，北约必须起到中心作用，因为它对绝大多数欧洲国家以及美国来说，是绝对必要的。
en: NATO must play the central role here, because it is indispensable for the vast majority of Europeans and for America.

zh: 西方和俄罗斯可能进行的交易可以是，包括北约在内的现存的后苏联欧洲秩序的原则和机制不变，并且这些原则和机制为俄罗斯所接受和施行，而俄罗斯在北约内部发挥的作用得到极大地增强，包括未来取得北约完全成员国地位的可能。
en: The possible trade-off could be that the existing principles and institutions of the post-Soviet European order, including NATO, remain unchanged and are accepted and implemented by Russia, which would get a significantly enhanced role within NATO, including the perspective of full membership.

zh: 北约－俄罗斯理事会实质上的边缘性显然不够，并且不起作用。
en: The peripheral nature of the NATO-Russia Council was clearly not enough and did not work.

zh: 但是，为什么不考虑将北约转变成为一个包括俄罗斯的真正的欧洲安全体系呢？
en: But why not think about transforming NATO into a real European security system, including Russia?

zh: 如果这样，游戏的规则就会发生变化，各种各样的战略目标 — — 欧洲安全，邻国间的冲突，能源安全，裁减军备，防止核扩散，等等 — — 都可以实现。
en: The rules of the game would be changed and a whole variety of strategic goals could be achieved – European security, neighborhood conflicts, energy security, arms reduction, anti-proliferation, etc.

zh: 是的，这样大胆的举动可以使北约发生改变。
en: Yes, such a bold step would transform NATO.

zh: 但是，它对俄罗斯导致的改变更大。
en: But it would transform Russia even more.

zh: 如果西方在和俄罗斯讨论这些问题时，不抱幻想，并且明白自身的战略利益，带着和俄罗斯结成伙伴关系和进行合作的新观点进行谈判，那么，人们要担心的最糟的情况就是失败了。
en: If the West approaches these discussions with Russia without illusions, with a clear understanding of its own strategic interests, and with new ideas for partnership and cooperation, the worst to be feared is failure.

zh: 当然，这种方法需要两个在当前不存在的条件：大西洋两岸应对俄罗斯的共同的方式，以及一个行动更加一致并因而更加强大的欧盟。
en: Of course, this approach presupposes two things that don’t exist at the moment: a common transatlantic approach to dealing with Russia, and a European Union that acts in much greater unison and is therefore stronger.

zh: 然而，俄罗斯带来的挑战不允许进行进一步的拖延。
en: Nonetheless, the challenge posed by Russia does not allow any further procrastination.

zh: 对此加以解决至关重要。
en: There is simply too much at stake.

zh: 核野心的用处
en: The Uses of Nuclear Ambitions

zh: 马德里 — — 11月24日凌晨，伊朗和P5+1集团（即联合国安理会5个常任理事国加上德国）就伊朗核计划达成协议证明了一个极其重要的问题：制裁起作用了。
en: MADRID – The agreement reached in Geneva in the wee hours of November 24 between Iran and the P5+1 (the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council, plus Germany) on Iran’s nuclear program proves a crucially important point: the sanctions regime worked.

zh: 临时协议是10余年来伊朗首次就核计划做出妥协，也是在军事干预阴霾长期笼罩领域取得的外交胜利。
en: The interim deal is Iran’s first compromise on its nuclear program in more than a decade, and a diplomatic victory in a field long overshadowed by the looming cloud of military intervention.

zh: 但有人兴高采烈却是个错误。
en: Yet the euphoric reaction seen in some quarters is misplaced.

zh: 抛开6个月协议的模糊和局限性不谈，此次谈判已清楚地暴露了伊朗的核武器计划，说得更宽泛点，伊朗把核武器视作地缘战略地位的象征。
en: Beyond the ambiguities and limitations of the six-month agreement, the negotiations have clearly exposed Iran’s nuclear-weapons program and, more broadly, its understanding that nuclear weapons remain a geostrategic status symbol.

zh: 这表明了达成全面协议难度有多大，告诫我们国际努力或许只能订立一系列推迟伊朗核武器计划的小协议，而不可能彻底消除伊朗的核威胁。
en: This points to the difficulty of achieving a comprehensive agreement and the possibility that the international effort could result only in a series of small deals aimed at delaying Iran’s acquisition of a nuclear weapon rather than removing the threat of it altogether.

zh: 历史性协议的头条新闻掩盖了有限和模糊的规定。
en: Beneath the headlines of the historic deal lies a limited and ambiguous agreement.

zh: 欧盟高级代表凯瑟琳·阿什顿和伊朗外长贾瓦德·扎里夫发表联合声明指出该协议是“明确长期全面解决方法”的“联合行动计划 ” 。
en: The joint statement released by European Union High Representative Catherine Ashton and Iranian Foreign Minister Javad Zarif referred to the agreement as “a joint plan of action” that “sets out an approach toward reaching a long-term comprehensive solution.”

zh: 虽然向“实现全面解决的时点和环境”迈出了第一步，但临时协议实际主要是建立信任的举措。
en: While it includes a first step that “creates the time and environment needed for a comprehensive solution,” the interim accord is really about confidence-building measures.

zh: 事实上，协议用“自愿措施”来形容规定的义务。
en: Indeed, the obligations that it lists are referred to as “voluntary measures.”

zh: 协议充其量也就是维持了目前的现状，甚至允许伊朗在某些方面进一步发展其核计划。
en: At best, the agreement maintains the current status quo, and in some respects even allows for further development of Iran’s nuclear program.

zh: 从这个意义上讲，即将投入运营的伊朗阿拉克核电厂（允许伊朗在国内生产钚元素并实现其武器化）或许是临时协议最令人不安的项目。
en: In this sense, perhaps the most troubling aspect of the interim deal concerns Iran’s yet-to-be-opened Arak plant, which would offer a path to domestic plutonium production and weaponization.

zh: 虽然伊朗在日内瓦协议中承诺不转让其核燃料或重水，也不委托修建阿拉克核反应堆，但是对反应堆的施工却似乎没有任何有效的延缓措施。
en: Though the agreement reached in Geneva includes Iran’s pledge not to transfer fuel or heavy water or commission its Arak reactor, there does not appear to be any overarching moratorium on construction at the site.

zh: 国际原子能总署认定阿拉克电厂控制室设备和冷却泵等几种关键的反应堆构件仍没有到位。
en: According to the International Atomic Energy Agency, the Arak plant still lacks several major reactor components, such as control-room equipment and cooling pumps.

zh: 因此看来伊朗将利用6个月的信任建立期推进其钚计划。
en: So, Iran, it seems, will be able to advance its plutonium program during the six-month confidence-building period.

zh: 鉴于本周法国媒体报道了有关设拉子核设施的建设情况，该设施可以用来分离钚元素，以生产核武器所需的裂变材料。
en: That loophole is all the more troubling in light of French press reports this week concerning Western intelligence on the construction of facilities in Shiraz that may be used to separate plutonium in order to create the fissile material needed for nuclear weapons.

zh: 不可否认，伊朗生产核武器的冲动部分来源于安全方面的忧虑。
en: That Iran’s push to acquire the capacity to produce nuclear weapons is partly motivated by security concerns cannot be denied.

zh: 但民族主义却是更重要的因素。
en: Nationalism, however, is a more important factor.

zh: 不光所有大国都拥有核武器；从伊朗的角度看，问题在于不少实力稍逊的小国 — — 特别是相邻的巴基斯坦和以色列 — — 也掌握核武器技术。
en: It is not just that all the great powers have nuclear weapons; the problem, from Iran’s perspective, is that lesser powers – particularly neighboring states such as Pakistan and Israel – have them.

zh: 伊朗人自诩为伟大古老文明的继承者，这样的野心在争取地区优势的过程中时有流露。
en: The Iranians regard themselves as the heirs to a great and ancient civilization, and their ambition of achieving regional preeminence reflects this.

zh: 此外他们认为自己的国家遭到歧视和边缘化，一直遭受着咄咄逼人的国际谴责。
en: At the same time, they perceive their country to be marginalized, discriminated against, and the target of aggressive international condemnation.

zh: 广岛长崎原子弹爆炸近70年后，世界各国依然认为拥有核武器才能在地缘政治谈判桌上获得席位。
en: Nearly 70 years after the bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki, the view persists globally that gaining a seat at the grownup table of geopolitics requires nuclear weapons.

zh: 德国是唯一一个例外，但在地缘战略问题上还算不上重量级角色；虽然日本最了解核战争的恐怖，但国内依然有重要势力呼吁改变其无核态度。
en: Germany is an exception, though hardly a geostrategic heavyweight; and though Japan knows the horror of nuclear war, important domestic voices there are calling for a change of its non-nuclear status.

zh: 将全世界严格分为有核及无核两大阵营的核不扩散体系巩固了这种将核武器视为国家实力象征的态度。
en: This view of nuclear weapons as a shorthand for national greatness is reinforced by the architecture of the non-proliferation regime, which firmly divides states into two camps: nuclear haves and have-nots.

zh: 同时身为联合国5大常任理事国的中、法、俄、英、美等核不扩散条约有核国家进一步巩固了核沙文主义态度。
en: That nuclear chauvinism is an attitude reinforced by the “haves” of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty – China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States – which also constitute the P5.

zh: 只要拥有核武器依然是国家展示其大国地位最明确的方式，保持核武器的研发能力对伊朗这样的国家就极具诱惑力，甚至不惜作伪证。
en: As long as possessing nuclear weapons remains a state’s clearest way to demonstrate its bona fides as a great power, maintaining the potential to develop such weapons will be too tempting for countries like Iran to forswear.

zh: 我们需要世界各国远离核武器等于地缘政治实力的恒等式。
en: What is needed is a global shift away from the equation of nuclear weapons with geopolitical greatness.

zh: 切断上述联系的努力并不成功，这一点从克里姆林宫不接受美国总统奥巴马双方削减核武器库存的提议就可以证实。
en: Progress on various efforts to sever this link have not been very encouraging, as was recently demonstrated by the Kremlin’s negative reaction to US President Barack Obama’s proposal that both sides cut their nuclear stockpiles.

zh: 另外，除P5以外的核武器国家核武库持续扩大，巴基斯坦和印度过去10年来核武器数量接近于原来的3倍。
en: Meanwhile, non-P5 nuclear-weapons states continue to expand their arsenals, with Pakistan and India estimated to have nearly tripled their stockpiles during the past decade.

zh: 伊朗临时协议是重要关口的标志。
en: The interim agreement with Iran marks an important juncture.

zh: 归根结底，该协议表明国际制裁措施能够见效，而取得进展的外交途径 — — 尽管非常狭窄 — — 但却是可能的。
en: Above all, it shows that international sanctions can bear fruit, and that a diplomatic way forward – even if proves to be a narrow one – is possible.

zh: 我们可以做到既切合实际又雄心勃勃。
en: We can remain both ambitious and realistic.

zh: 但与伊朗达成全面协议 — — 也是争取未来追随者的必须要素 — — 需要进行涉及面更广的改革：这要求世界各国不仅要杜绝核武器被用于进攻，而且要最终认识到其威慑力是不可持续的。
en: But a comprehensive deal with Iran – and the need to preempt future epigones – requires a broader change: a world that not only excludes the offensive use of nuclear weapons but also acknowledges the ultimate unsustainability of their deterrent power.

zh: 不安全的欧洲
en: Insecure Europe

zh: 马德里—过去五年来，欧洲经历了金融和经济危机，许多欧洲公民的生活毁于一旦。
en: MADRID – For the last five years, Europe has been shaken by financial and economic convulsions that have wreaked havoc on many of its citizens’ livelihoods.

zh: 好消息是欧盟经济和货币制度终于又有了新的进展，这将有助于回归增长之路。
en: The good news is that progress is finally being made in redeveloping the European Union’s economic and monetary architecture, which should help to bring about a return to growth.

zh: 但欧盟领导人的注意力集中在欧盟内部，这让他们忽视了外部政策，特别是安全政策。
en: But EU leaders’ focus on internal problems has caused them largely to neglect external policies, particularly in the area of security.

zh: 随着2014年的到来，对经济不安全的担忧将让位给欧盟的战略定位。
en: As 2014 begins, economic insecurity is giving way to worries about the EU’s strategic position.

zh: 人们期待12月的欧洲理事会会议能成为欧洲回归更加外向的政策方针的标志，特别是在安全事务上。
en: There were expectations that the European Council’s December meeting would signal a return to a more outward-looking approach, especially on security matters.

zh: 不幸的是，这一希望很快就落空了。
en: Unfortunately, these hopes were quickly dashed.

zh: 事实上，这次会议通过了多项相去甚远的方案，尽管很有意思，但缺少必要的广度和范围，并且不得不通过过时的虚弱战略框架来整合。
en: Indeed, the disparate assortment of initiatives that were agreed at the meeting, though interesting, lack the needed breadth and scope, and will have to be integrated within a weak and outdated strategic framework.

zh: 起草于2003年并在2008进行过一次修订的现行欧洲安全战略（European Security Strategy，ESS）存在缺陷，其缺陷反映了其概念的所处环境。
en: The flawed nature of the current European Security Strategy – drafted in 2003, with a token revision in 2008 – reflects the circumstances surrounding its conception.

zh: ESS是在伊拉克战争后、欧洲宪法草案引起热烈争论时发展起来的，其起草过程匆忙而被动，并被意图将欧洲定位为美国的制衡甚至敌对力量的人所把持。
en: The ESS was developed in the aftermath of the Iraq war, amid heated debate over a proposed European constitution, in a hasty and reactive process hijacked by those who sought to position Europe as a counterweight – or even a rival power – to the United States.

zh: 更加糟糕的是，自ESS起草以来，由于经济向亚洲倾斜、阿拉伯世界动荡、俄罗斯重振雄风以及美国日渐倒向孤立主义等因素，地缘政治环境发生了根本性变化。
en: Making matters worse, the geopolitical environment has changed fundamentally in the decade since the ESS was ratified, owing to economic rebalancing toward Asia, the upheavals in the Arab world, the revival of Russian assertiveness, and the rise of isolationist tendencies in the US.

zh: 因此，ESS已不适应当前世界的现实，这从它的开宗明义 — — “欧洲从未如此繁荣”中便可见一斑。
en: As a result, the ESS does not capture the reality of today’s world – a fact that is obvious from its opening declaration that “Europe has never been so prosperous.”

zh: 诚然，ESS的三大基本原则 — — 发展援助、软实力和有效的多边主义仍然十分重要。
en: To be sure, the ESS’s three basic tenets – development assistance, soft power, and effective multilateralism – remain important.

zh: 但欧洲领导人必须在当今挑战的背景下重新认识这些概念。
en: But Europe’s leaders must reconceive these concepts in light of today’s challenges.

zh: 就发展而论，欧洲必须摆脱援助必须用于增进贸易联系的观念，认识外国投资的重要性。
en: In terms of development, Europe must move away from the idea that aid should be used to bolster trade linkages and acknowledge the importance of foreign investment.

zh: 事实上，从全球看，发展中国家的净私人资本流入规模已是官方发展援助的近十倍。
en: In fact, net private capital flows to developing countries now outweigh official development assistance by nearly ten to one worldwide.

zh: 作为世界第二大外国直接投资来源地，欧盟有着卓著的影响力，欧洲投资者给项目和地区带来信誉，从而有利于吸引更多投资。
en: As the world’s second-largest source of foreign direct investment, the EU wields considerable influence, with European investors bringing credibility to projects and regions, thereby serving to attract further investment.

zh: 比如，摩洛哥的瓦尔扎扎特（Ouarzazate）太阳能电站及其饮用水效率计划（Drinking Water Efficiency Program）便是在欧盟周边投资基金（Neighborhood Investment Facility）3,700万欧元的支持下建设的；这些项目招徕了大量后续融资，总额高达6亿欧元以上。
en: For example, Morocco’s Ouarzazate Solar Power Plant and its Drinking Water Efficiency Program were launched with €37 million ($50.6 million) from the EU’s Neighborhood Investment Facility; these projects subsequently gained additional funding totaling more than €600 million.

zh: ESS对软实力的强调也迫切地需要重估。
en: The ESS’s emphasis on soft power is also in urgent need of reassessment.

zh: 阿拉伯世界风起云涌的示威潮让一些欧洲人认为这些国家将在某种程度上模仿西方的制度、价值和规范。
en: The upsurge of protest across the Arab world raised expectations among Europeans that these countries would, to some extent, emulate Western institutions, values, and norms.

zh: 但是，尽管这并没有实现，但欧洲原则也显然没有失去吸引力，最近乌克兰总统亚努科维奇决定与欧洲决裂的消息引起乌克兰人民示威游行就是明证。
en: But, while that did not occur, European principles certainly have not lost their allure, as recent protests in Ukraine, triggered by President Viktor Yanukovych’s decision to shun closer ties with Europe, have shown.

zh: 尽管如此，ESS的软实力方针不能掩盖欧洲所面临的安全挑战。
en: Nonetheless, the ESS’s soft-power vision should not be allowed to obscure the security challenges that Europe faces.

zh: 随着非传统威胁的日益增加，欧洲日益忽视国家间战争等传统安全风险，认为它们不再与自己有关 — — 这一概念便体现在ESS中。
en: With the rise of non-traditional threats, Europeans are increasingly overlooking classical security risks like inter-state warfare, believing that they are no longer relevant – a notion that is reflected in the ESS.

zh: 但是，正如中国在南海和东海立场日益强硬所凸显的，这一观念不但是错误的，而且可能十分危险。
en: But, as China’s increasingly assertive stance in the South and East China Seas starkly demonstrates, this idea is not only wrong; it can be very dangerous.

zh: 这就引出了ESS的第三个原则：推进“发展更强大的国际社会、运转良好的国际机构和基于规则的国际秩序 ” 。
en: This brings us to the ESS’s third tenet: advancing “the development of a stronger international society, well-functioning international institutions, and a rule-based international order.”

zh: 在这方面，问题在于缺少承诺，欧盟宁可选择权宜的非正式安排带来的便利，而不愿对联合国、国际货币基金组织和世界银行等对有效的多边主义至关重要的机构进行改革。
en: In this case, the problem comes down to a lack of commitment, with the EU choosing the convenience of informal and ad hoc groupings over the challenge of reforming key institutions like the United Nations, the International Monetary Fund, and the World Bank, which are essential for effective multilateralism.

zh: 事实上，欧盟一直是近来流行的“G”俱乐部 — — 最新的版本是G-20 — — 的领导者之一。
en: Indeed, the EU is among the leading actors in the current “G” fad, which has culminated most recently in the G-20.

zh: 此外，尽管身为国际法的化身之一，欧盟却沉迷于软法（soft-law）方针，不管是在华沙COP-19气候变化会议上还是在支持关于伊朗核计划的“日内瓦协定”上都是如此。 如今，显而易见媒体夸大了这两件事的成果。
en: And, despite being an embodiment of international law, the EU indulges in soft-law approaches, whether at the recent COP-19 climate-change meeting in Warsaw, or by supporting the “Geneva agreement” on Iran’s nuclear program, which, it is now clear, is nothing more than two aspirational declarations linked by a press release.

zh: 在发展新的安全战略的过程中，欧盟必须考虑美国作为地缘政治环境关键组成部分的角色，美国不止是陪衬，而是微妙的伙伴。
en: In developing its new security strategy, Europe must consider America’s role as an essential component of the geopolitical environment, viewing the US not as a foil, but as a nuanced partner.

zh: 除了北约（虽然它正处于低潮期，但仍然十分重要 ） ， 谈判中的跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系提供了形成基于规则的国际秩序的好机会。
en: Beyond NATO, which remains important even at a low ebb, the proposed Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership offers a potent opportunity to shape a rule-based international order.

zh: 欧盟或许已经在走下坡路，但基辅独立广场（Maidan Square）的壮观景象有力地提醒我们，欧洲的核心价值仍具有吸引力。
en: The shine may have come off the EU, but the gripping scenes from Kyiv’s Maidan Square are a powerful reminder of the enduring appeal of Europe’s core values.

zh: 欧盟现在需要的是更新其外部政策，利用其吸引力构建影响力、安全和繁荣，从而避免纠结于细枝末节。
en: What the EU needs now is an updated external strategy that capitalizes on this allure to bolster its influence, security, and prosperity, thereby halting its slide toward irrelevance.

zh: 俄罗斯和丝绸之路方针
en: Russia and the Silk Road Approach

zh: 马德里—乌克兰的瓦解让西方面临三大对外政策挑战：孤立的俄罗斯的危险、中国冷漠之谜以及新思想的普遍缺乏。
en: MADRID – The unraveling of Ukraine has brought to the fore three major foreign policy challenges for the West: the danger of isolating Russia, the conundrum of China’s aloofness, and the pervasive lack of fresh ideas.

zh: 克服这些挑战需要不同政治制度和国家利益的国家齐心协力加强合作、建立信任。
en: Surmounting them will require a concerted drive to enhance cooperation and build trust among countries with disparate political systems and national interests.

zh: 中国国家主席习近平的丝绸之路经济带颇有可借鉴之处。
en: Chinese President Xi Jinping’s Silk Road economic belt could contribute to such an effort.

zh: 欧洲和美国对乌克兰危机的反应是失败的，体现在两个方面。
en: Europe and the United States’ response to the crisis in Ukraine has failed in two respects.

zh: 首先也是最重要的是反应不力，这不啻于示弱，从而束缚了其扭转俄罗斯吞并克里米亚之势（在策略上，这一事实已经被接受）和遏制其面向东乌克兰的侵略行为的能力。
en: First and foremost, it has been anemic, projecting an image of weakness that undermines its ability to reverse Russia’s annexation of Crimea, which has been tacitly accepted, or counter its aggressive behavior toward eastern Ukraine.

zh: 与此同时，定向制裁和外交抵制加剧了俄罗斯的国际孤立，不利于构建功能性关系的长期目标。
en: At the same time, the use of targeted sanctions and diplomatic snubs has contributed to Russia’s international isolation, undercutting the long-term goal of building a functional relationship.

zh: 坚持原则（包括通过实施严厉制裁）对西方来说十分关键，但务实也同样重要。
en: While it is critical for the West to stand by its principles, including by imposing biting sanctions, pragmatism is equally important.

zh: 毕竟，一个弱势、孤立的俄罗斯要比一个强大、融入国际社会的俄罗斯危险得多。
en: After all, a weak, isolated Russia is far more dangerous than a strong, internationally integrated one.

zh: 此外，不可否认的是，与俄罗斯的关系现在已经破裂，互信程度已降至苏联解体以来的最低点。
en: And yet there can be no denying that the relationship with Russia is now broken, with mutual trust having reached its lowest point since the collapse of the Soviet Union.

zh: 在这样的情况下，让俄罗斯回到国际舞台需要中国的参与。
en: In this context, bringing Russia back into the international fold will require the involvement of China.

zh: 但是，对中国来说，乌克兰问题是复杂的，因为建设对俄紧密关系符合中国的利益，并且从某种程度上说，中国对西藏的采取的行动与俄罗斯对克里米亚具有相似性。
en: But, for China, the Ukraine issue is complex, owing to its interest in fostering closer ties with Russia and, to some degree, the parallels with its own actions in places like Tibet.

zh: 基于此 — — 以及中国向来对获得全球领导地位不是很热衷 — — 只有在带具体目标的定向激励的刺激下，中国才有可能参与进来。
en: Given this – and China’s general reticence to assume a global leadership position – direct Chinese engagement is likely to come only through targeted initiatives with concrete goals.

zh: 而丝绸之路经济带正提供了这一点，我在最近的北京之行中有所目睹。
en: That is precisely what the Silk Road economic belt offers, as I had the opportunity to witness during a recent trip to Beijing.

zh: 这一计划在去年9月出台，目标是改善亚洲和欧洲市场之间的联系，包括俄罗斯在内的沿途18个中亚和欧洲国家都会获得切实的好处。
en: The initiative, launched last September, aims to improve the linkages between the Asian and European markets, with concrete benefits for all 18 Central Asian and European countries along the route, including Russia.

zh: 该计划 — — 旨在通过人际交流、高山贸易流和增加货币流通建设共同繁荣 — — 正是世界避免回归冷战的分裂状态和东欧巴尔干化的必要条件。
en: The project – which aims to foster shared prosperity through people-to-people exchanges, improved trade flows, and increased currency circulation – is precisely what the world needs if it is to avoid a return to the Cold War divide or the Balkanization of Eastern Europe.

zh: 毕竟，建立合作和信任的最佳方式是确保这能给各方带来明确的好处。
en: After all, the best way to generate cooperation and trust is to ensure that it offers clear benefits to all parties involved.

zh: 尽管中国官员大谈要加强人际交流、放松外币使用限制、降低贸易壁垒，但振兴并实现古丝绸之路的现代化还需要以互容和多边互通为核心的功能良好的基础设施。
en: Though Chinese officials have spoken broadly of enhancing exchanges of people, easing restrictions on the use of foreign currency, and reducing trade barriers, reviving and modernizing the ancient Silk Road also requires functioning infrastructure focused on interoperability and multimodal connectivity.

zh: 整合一个由公路、内河、航空和海洋组成的强大的交通网络能产生层级效应，有助于优化供应链，从而带来巨大 — — 并且立竿见影 — — 的经济好处。
en: Consolidating a strong transport network of road, inner waterways, air, and sea would produce a cascading effect while offering significant – and immediate – economic gains by helping to optimize supply chains.

zh: 铁路在该计划中具有至关重要的地位，因为它可以减轻过长并且充满不确定性的海路，提供更快捷的互联，对环境的影响也更小。
en: Rail is critical to this effort, as it can ease stress on overextended and uncertain sea-lanes and provide faster connections, with fewer environmental repercussions.

zh: 如今，从中国到欧洲的铁路货运量还不到船运的一半。
en: Today, freight transport from China to Europe via rail takes less than half as long as shipping.

zh: 但是有一个危险：中国可能追求双边方针，利用该项目服务于其狭隘外交政策利益。
en: There is a danger, however, that China will pursue a bilateral approach, using the project to serve narrow foreign-policy interests.

zh: 尽管中国也许有办法为该项目所需要的大规模基础设施工程融资，但如此碎片化的战略将不利于融合，也会增加中国崛起威胁国际秩序的感觉。
en: Though China may have the means to finance the large-scale infrastructure projects that the initiative demands, such a fragmented strategy would inhibit integration, while reinforcing the view that a rising China poses a threat to the international order.

zh: 中国领导人应该认识到，如果丝绸之路经济带要实现其潜力，就必须��于一个包括融资多样化、所有权多边化和多个行动方参与的有效组织在内的更开阔的视角。
en: China’s leaders should recognize that, if the Silk Road economic belt is to reach its potential, it must be based on a broader vision that includes diversity of financing, multiplicity of ownership, and effective organization involving a range of actors.

zh: 世界银行最近通过其全球基础设施基金（Global Infrastructure Facility）支持了这样一套开阔视角。 基础设施基金将连接多边、地区和国家级公共行动方以及私人部门，使它们携手为基础设施开发提供融资。
en: The World Bank has recently endorsed just such a broad-based approach through its Global Infrastructure Facility, which will connect multilateral, regional, and national public actors, as well as the private sector, in financing infrastructure development.

zh: 该基金的实际国际日程制定者二十国集团已经表态支持该项目。
en: The G-20, the de facto international agenda-setter, has already expressed support for the project.

zh: 将这一全面的模型应用于丝绸之路工程 — — 特别是通过结合欧洲、中国、俄罗斯和多边机构实现这一点 — — 将能强化现有激励。
en: Applying this comprehensive model to the Silk Road project – particularly by incorporating Europe, China, Russia, and multilateral institutions – would reinforce existing initiatives.

zh: 比如，这能够强化中亚地区经济合作计划（Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Program）的交通和贸易促进战略。 该战略目前在亚洲开发银行的赞助下操作，欧洲复兴开发银行也贡献了力量。
en: For example, it would strengthen the Central Asia Regional Economic Cooperation Program’s transport and trade facilitation strategy, which operates under the auspices of the Asian Development Bank with contributions from the European Bank of Reconstruction and Development.

zh: 但是，除了联合融资，有效合作才是这一工程成功的关键。
en: But, beyond joint financing, effective coordination is crucial to such a project’s success.

zh: 在这方面，欧洲的妥协和调和经验可以起到至关重要的作用。
en: This is where Europe’s experience in compromise and harmonization is essential.

zh: 为了改进其支离破碎的交通系统，欧盟设计了一个核心走廊方针 — — 与主要跨国交通流相适应并解决不通路和堵塞问题 — — 以此构成一体化、互容和协调的基础设施开发和管理基础。
en: To improve its fragmented transport system, the European Union designed a core corridors approach – corresponding to major trans-national traffic flows and addressing missing links and blockages – to form the basis for integration, interoperability, and coordinated infrastructure development and management.

zh: 这一方针成了不同利益相关方坐下来谈判的催化剂。
en: In doing so, it serves as a catalyst for dialogue among disparate stakeholders.

zh: 欧洲铁路交通管理系统（European Rail Traffic Management System）克服了不同成员国之间安全和安保标准不一致的问题，建立了一个统一的系统。 这只是这一创新性战略所促成的诸多成功例子中的一个。
en: The European Rail Traffic Management System, which has overcome divergent safety and security standards among member states to create a unified system, is but one of the many successes that this innovative strategy has facilitated.

zh: 欧洲已经证明，共同拥有感加上具体的解决目标能够鼓励建设性对话，开启互惠合作之门。
en: Europe has demonstrated that a sense of common ownership, combined with concrete solutions, can encourage productive dialogue, opening the door to mutually beneficial cooperation.

zh: 丝绸之路所提供的不仅是经济机会；它符合各参与方的长期安全利益。
en: The Silk Road offers more than economic opportunity; it serves participants’ long-term security interests.

zh: 如今，在大量连接方式遭到破坏的情况下，欧洲决不能再错失这一机会了。
en: At a time when so many connections have been broken, this is an opportunity that Europe cannot afford to pass up.

zh: 让伊朗不再冷
en: Bringing Iran in from the Cold

zh: 马德里—长期以来，伊朗和西方恢复邦交一直是全球政治的“白鲸 ” 。
en: MADRID – Rapprochement between Iran and the West has long been a “white whale” of global politics.

zh: 但一个日益明显的趋势是世界或许正处在新纪元的边缘，新纪元的一大特征将是国家间 — — 特别是伊朗和美国间 — — 谨慎但重要的合作。 自1979年伊朗伊斯兰革命以来，这样的合作一直无法协调。
en: But it increasingly appears that the world may be on the verge of a new era, characterized by a wary yet crucial collaboration between countries – particularly Iran and the United States – that had been irreconcilable since Iran’s Islamic Revolution in 1979.

zh: 这类合作的必要性促使柯尔柏基金会（Körber Foundation）与科学与国际安全研究所（Institute for Science and International Security）联合组织了上个月的贝尔格多夫圆桌会议（Bergedorf Round Table ） 。
en: The imperative for such cooperation drove last month’s Bergedorf Round Table, organized by the Körber Foundation in conjunction with theInstitute for Political and International Studies.

zh: 我也出席了这次会议。 会上，来自欧洲、美国和伊朗的30位政治家、高级官员和专家讨论了这一关系的未来，产生了对未来决策具有指导意义的重要洞见。
en: At the event, which I attended, 30 politicians, senior officials, and experts from Europe, the US, and Iran considered the relationship’s future, producing some important insights that should inform future policy decisions.

zh: 在中东各国举步维艰、领土主权难以维系的情况下（特别是伊拉克 ） ， 此次会议可谓及时雨。
en: With countries across the Middle East crumbling and territorial sovereignty disintegrating – most notably in Iraq – this effort could not be timelier.

zh: 为了扭转中东地区滑向混乱的趋势，需要强大的稳定力量为旨在遏制宗派冲突的联合行动打下基础。
en: To reverse the region’s slide into chaos, it needs strong stabilizing forces that can underpin coordinated action aimed at curtailing sectarian violence.

zh: 在这方面，伊朗可以起到关键作用。
en: Here, Iran has a key role to play.

zh: 伊朗的历史和文化深度使得它在中东拥有一定的权威，除此之外，伊朗也拥有该地区极少数有能力对地缘政治发展态势做出反应的政府之一。
en: Beyond its historical and cultural depth, which gives it a certain authority in the Middle East, Iran has one of the region’s few functioning governments capable of responding to geopolitical developments.

zh: 这与其巨大的石油储备没什么关系，虽然石油储备确保了它在复杂的全球能源局势中的关键地位，特别是对致力于减少俄罗斯能源进口依赖的欧洲来说。
en: This is to say nothing of its massive oil reserves, which secure its critical role in the complex global energy equation, particularly as it applies to Europe, which is working to reduce its dependence on Russian energy imports.

zh: 问题在于伊朗总是浪费其领导潜力，反而选择干扰者的角色，特别是经常利用代理军队。
en: The problem is that Iran has consistently squandered its leadership potential, choosing instead to act as a spoiler, especially through the use of proxy armies.

zh: 这一搅局倾向更增加了合作的必要性，而合作的基础是让伊朗有强烈的激励维持其建设性的温和外交政策。
en: This disruptive tendency reinforces the need for collaboration, underpinned by strong incentives for Iran to maintain a constructive, moderate foreign policy.

zh: 在这方面，伊朗与E3+3（法国、德国和英国加上中国、俄罗斯和美国）的核谈判是重要的第一步。
en: To this end, the nuclear negotiations between Iran and the E3+3 (France, Germany, and the UK plus China, Russia, and the US) are an important first step.

zh: 伊朗的核野心长期以来一直是中东的一个重大安全威胁，因为这引起了以色列或美国采取先发制人军事行动的风险，甚至有可能导致与海湾国家的地区军备竞赛。
en: Iran’s nuclear ambitions have long posed a major security threat in the Middle East, as they raise the risk of preemptive military action by Israel or the US and, perhaps even more harrowing, of a regional arms race with the Gulf states and Turkey.

zh: 尽管最近分裂和宗派暴力成了更迫切的威胁，但与伊朗成为有核国家相关的风险不应该被低估。
en: Though fragmentation and sectarian violence have recently become a more urgent danger, the risks associated with Iran’s emergence as a nuclear power should not be underestimated.

zh: 进一步增加当前谈判重要性的是伊朗国内政治形势。
en: Further underlying the significance of the current talks are Iran’s internal political dynamics.

zh: 如果到明年的议会选举前，伊朗总统鲁哈尼不能通过走进西方而给伊朗人民带来实实在在的经济回报 — — 特别是国际制裁的放松 — — 强硬派就将重新掌握其对伊朗外交政策的主导权。
en: If Iranian President Hassan Rouhani is unable to offer citizens concrete economic returns on his engagement with the West – especially loosened international sanctions – by next year’s parliamentary election, hardliners will recapture their dominance over Iran’s foreign policy.

zh: 因此，西方终于看到鲁哈尼和伊朗外交部长扎里夫（Javad Zarif）成为相当热心 — — 并且表面上看效率也相当高 — — 的谈判者。
en: Given this, the West has finally found in Rouhani and Iranian Foreign Minister Javad Zarif motivated – and ostensibly effective – interlocutors.

zh: 也许E3+3谈判最重要的动机在于打消伊朗核地位已成为伊朗回归国际社会的前提。
en: Perhaps the most important motivation for the E3+3 negotiations is that resolving Iran’s nuclear status has become a sine qua non for bringing the country back into the fold of the international community.

zh: 身为流氓国家的伊朗是无法扮演中东稳定者的角色的。
en: Iran cannot play a stabilizing role in the Middle East as a pariah state.

zh: 这并不是说谈判者应该不惜一切代价促成协议。
en: This is not to say that negotiators should pursue a deal at any cost.

zh: 如果形成了一个较弱的协议，缺少足够的检查机制、让伊朗保留足够核浓缩能力用于武器开发，那将是弊大于利。
en: A weak agreement that lacks adequate verification mechanisms and leaves Iran with sufficient enrichment capacity for short-term weapon development would do more harm than good.

zh: 除了激起以色列的安全忧虑和导致已经持有怀疑态度的美国国会更加反对之外，这样一份弱契约将强化伊朗搅局者的地位，让未来建设性参与的可能更加渺茫。
en: Beyond stoking Israeli security fears and fueling increased opposition from an already skeptical US Congress, such a pact would strengthen the position of Iran’s most obstructionist elements, all but eliminating the possibility of constructive future engagement.

zh: 达成公平有效协议毫无疑问是困难的；但有理由相信这是可能的。
en: Reaching an effective, fair agreement will undoubtedly be difficult; but there is reason to believe that it is possible.

zh: 当前谈判轮已经在这一问题的两大焦灼点之一 — — 阿拉克（Arak）重水反应堆上取得了进展。
en: The current round of talks has produced some progress on one of the issue’s two major sticking points: the heavy-water reactor at Arak.

zh: 另一个关键问题 — — 离心机更加严重一些。
en: The other key issue, centrifuges, is more problematic.

zh: 但替代方案（如专注于总量控制而非离心机数量）加上稳健的监督保证有助于协议的达成。
en: But alternative metrics – for example, focusing on overall production volume, instead of the number of centrifuges – together with robust monitoring guarantees, could facilitate an agreement.

zh: 如能解决核问题，西方领导人可以在其他关键领域推进与伊朗的合作 — — 可以以中东安全与稳定为起点。
en: With the nuclear issue resolved, Western leaders could advance cooperation with Iran in other critical areas – beginning with security and stability in the Middle East.

zh: 当然，伊朗参与其中尽管重要，也并不足以停止目前的大屠杀。
en: Of course, Iran’s involvement in this effort, while important, would not be sufficient to stop the current carnage.

zh: 考虑到地区冲突的宗派性质 — — 而伊朗当局要在这一问题上承担相当大的责任 — — 与伊朗合作必须在更广泛的地区合作框架（特别是与海湾国家的合作框架）内进行。
en: Given the sectarian nature of regional conflicts – for which the Iranian authorities bear a heavy responsibility – engagement with Iran must be conducted within a broader framework of regional cooperation, in particular with the Gulf states.

zh: 由于美国和欧洲要么缺乏兴趣，要么缺乏资金，无法有效应对中东的剧变局势，因此解决方案至少部分需要来自拥有强大影响力的国家。
en: Given that the US and Europe have neither the appetite nor the wherewithal to respond effectively to the cataclysmic developments in the Middle East, solutions will need to come, at least partly, from countries with strong influence on the ground.

zh: 但是，在追求与伊朗这样的国家的合作方面，西方领导人必须保持警惕，并且不能因为问题太紧迫而忽略对这些政权的破坏潜力的关注。
en: But, in pursuing collaboration with countries like Iran, Western leaders must remain vigilant, and avoid allowing a sense of urgency to overwhelm their regard for these regimes’ disruptive potential.

zh: 若能将这一戒律铭记在心，西方与伊朗合作的潜在好处将是无穷的。
en: Bearing in mind that caveat, the potential benefits of Western engagement with Iran cannot be overstated.

zh: 在未来几周，美国和欧盟将有机会在推动更稳定、更安全的中东方面迈出重要一步 — — 这一结果将有利于全世界。
en: Over the coming weeks, the US and the EU will have the opportunity to make important strides toward a more stable, secure Middle East – an outcome that would benefit the entire world.

zh: 美国的战略盲目
en: America’s Strategic Blindness

zh: 马德里—由前美国情报承包商斯诺登的大揭秘掀起的对美国间谍行为的控诉目前进入了白热化。
en: MADRID – The recriminations over US spying activities, triggered by the revelations of the former American intelligence contractor Edward J. Snowden, have now reached fever pitch.

zh: 疑问重重 — — 总统奥巴马知道了什么、何时知道的；窃听友邦领导人对话的合法性；跨大西洋关系的未来；甚至“盟友”这个词的含义。
en: Questions abound – about what President Barack Obama knew and when, about the legitimacy of eavesdropping on friendly foreign leaders’ conversations, about the future of transatlantic relations, and even about the meaning of the term “ally.”

zh: 但最近的风波与其他与美国相关的当前外交危机一样，反映了一个更加根本的问题：美国外交政策缺少战略眼光。
en: But the current firestorm, like other recent diplomatic crises for the United States, reflects a more fundamental problem: the lack of strategic vision in American foreign policy.

zh: 在美国能够建立起包罗万象、目的导向的框架来与世界发生关系之前，难免要采取被动方式，我们在本月所看到的轩然大波将继续成为常态。
en: Until the US is able to establish an overarching, purpose-oriented framework through which it relates to the world, a reactive approach is inevitable, with high-intensity incidents such as we have seen this month continuing to be the norm.

zh: 在四十多年的时间里，遏制苏联影响力的冷战政策一直是美国的战略框架。
en: For more than 40 years, the Cold War policy of containment of Soviet influence provided America its strategic framework.

zh: 尽管在策略上一直存在争论，并且随着政府的变换而改变着，但总体方针一直没有变化，因为这受到了共和党和民主党的广泛支持。
en: Though US tactics were debated and shifted from administration to administration, the overarching approach remained consistent, because it was broadly supported by Republicans and Democrats alike.

zh: 当然，总体国家安全战略并不能保证解决问题，甚至没有能够避免美国在越南和尼加拉瓜遭遇的灾难。
en: Of course, an overarching national-security strategy provided no guarantee against problems or even major disasters in countries like Vietnam and Nicaragua.

zh: 尽管如此，事后看来，遏制给美国外交政策带来了如今所缺乏的秩序和组织。
en: Nonetheless, in hindsight, containment infused an order and organization on US foreign policy that is absent today.

zh: 柏林墙倒塌后，促成遏制战略的必要性已不复存在。
en: After the fall of the Berlin Wall, the necessity that had been driving containment disappeared.

zh: 自满于胜利的美国认为瓦解苏联集团是其卓异论（exceptionalism）的又一明证，并且陷入了一个幻觉：其冷战的成功本身即是一种战略。
en: The US, inebriated by victory, saw in the triumph over the Soviet bloc another sign of its exceptionalism, and found itself taken in by the mirage that its Cold War success was itself a strategy.

zh: 随后的十年是外交政策漫无目的的十年，不作为和不参考更广泛的看法一意孤行的例子比比皆是。
en: What followed was a decade of scattershot foreign policy marked by notable cases of inaction, together with individual initiatives taken largely without reference to a broader doctrine.

zh: 在单极时代，美国没有对手，可以奢侈地无需考虑战略目标。
en: Unchallenged in the world’s unipolar moment, the US had the luxury of not knowing its strategic goals.

zh: 9·11袭击令美国震惊，于是强行在其仍未受质疑的通往自由的历史洪流思维上推出了新框架。
en: Shocked by the attacks of September 11, the US forced a new framework onto its still-unquestioned belief in the inexorable movement of history toward freedom.

zh: 不幸的是，随后出现的是有严重缺陷的方针，因为宣布“反恐战争”的美国的对立面是一套策略，而不是一个实体或一种意识形态。
en: Unfortunately, what emerged was a deeply flawed approach, not least because in declaring a “war on terror,” America positioned itself against a tactic, not an entity or an ideology.

zh: 在奥巴马治下，美国开始远离这一方针。
en: Under Obama, the US has begun to depart from this approach.

zh: 问题在于美国仍没有找到有意义的方向。
en: The problem is that it remains a departure without any meaningful destination.

zh: 与20世纪90年代一样，美国没有有组织的当务之急，而结果也是一样的：不作为和不协调的行动的结合。
en: As in the 1990’s, the US has no organizing imperative, and the result is the same: a combination of inactivity and incoherent initiatives.

zh: 此外，在美国国内出现政治两极分化的情况下，全球战略的缺位让美国失去了一个能统一民主党和共和党的聚焦点。
en: And, at a time of domestic political polarization, the lack of a global strategy denies a potential rallying point around which Democrats and Republicans can unite.

zh: 二十年前，地缘政治环境限制了美国外交政策真空的回力。
en: Two decades ago, geopolitical conditions limited blowback from America’s foreign-policy vacuum.

zh: 如今，美国仍是世界最重要强国，但已不再是唯一的强国。
en: Today, the US remains the world’s essential power, but it is no longer the exclusive power.

zh: 美国不再能够单枪匹马解决直接影响自身的问题，尽管美国的领导仍是不可或缺的。
en: It cannot solve problems that directly affect it by acting on its own, though its leadership remains indispensable.

zh: 考虑问题的性质也发生了变化，这一点更显得正确了。
en: That is all the more true given that the nature of such problems has also changed.

zh: 与我们其他人一样，美国也无法逃避气候变化、流行病和恐怖主义 — — 这些挑战需要全球合作解决。
en: America, like the rest of us, is vulnerable to climate change, pandemics, and terrorism – challenges that require coordinated global solutions.

zh: 但是，对美国来说，多边主义的功效完全是权宜性的。
en: For the US, however, the utility of multilateralism is purely situational.

zh: 说到底，多边主义永远不会比“好的”双边方案更好 — — 这一观点强化了削弱（而不是增强）有效国际行动的能力。
en: Above all, multilateralism is never preferable to a “good” bilateral solution – a view that has reinforced behavior that undermines, rather than strengthens, the capacity for effective international action.

zh: 事实上，美国永远准备谈判条约，但很少愿意签署 — — 批准的情况就更少了 — — 这使得美国仍游离于京都议定书、禁止地雷公约和联合国海洋法宣言等全球协定之外。
en: Indeed, always ready to negotiate treaties but rarely prepared to sign – and even less likely to ratify – them, the US remains absent from such key global agreements as the Kyoto Protocol, the Mine Ban Treaty, and the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea.

zh: 其在建立联合国和世界银行等正式机构上所表现出来的灵光一现的创造力和支持让位给了对孱弱、非正式和临时性组织的偏好，比如各种“G-某”集团和“意愿联盟 ” 。
en: Its inspired creativity and support in building formal institutions like the United Nations and World Bank has given way to a predilection for weak, informal, and ad hoc groupings, such as the various G-somethings and “coalitions of the willing.”

zh: 建立有效的多边主义需要强调有利于协调的规则和机构。
en: Establishing effective multilateralism requires an emphasis on rules and institutions that facilitate coordination.

zh: 美国最近决定签署武器贸易条约，这或许是一个好的开始 — — 只要国会能取得批准这一条约所需要的跨党派支持。
en: The recent decision by the US to sign the Arms Trade Treaty could be a good start – if only Congress could marshal the bipartisan support needed to ratify it.

zh: 但朝着正确方向的零星动作是不够的。
en: But scattered moves in the right direction will not suffice.

zh: 真正需要的是目光和心态上的变化 — — 不再将多边主义视为一种策略，而是视为一种战略当务之急。
en: What is really needed is a change in vision and mentality – a shift from viewing multilateralism as a tactic to embracing it as a strategic imperative.

zh: 最近的间谍丑闻是美国外交政策缺少方向、集中于全面大局的概念范围之外的狭隘的策略性目标的结果。
en: The current spying scandal is the product of a rudderless US foreign policy focused on narrowly drawn tactical objectives that exist outside the conceptual funnel of a comprehensive vision.

zh: 此案的结果危害了跨大西洋关系，一些欧洲人甚至要求暂停计划中的跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系（TTIP）谈判。
en: The result in this case has been damage to the transatlantic relationship, with some in Europe even calling for a halt to the talks on the proposed Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP).

zh: 中止贸易谈判是愚蠢的，不仅从地区角度看是如此，也是因为TTIP应该成为影响全球的规则制定操作。
en: Suspending the trade talks would be folly, not just in terms of the regional impact, but also because the TTIP should be an exercise in rule-making that echoes globally.

zh: 当前的外交危机也是一次机会，可以利用它来保证关于隐私和监控的跨大西洋讨论可以在多边基础上进行；抓住这一机会将是一个小进步，但这一小步对于过去二十五年所极度缺少的战略眼光来说是一个大贡献。
en: The current diplomatic crisis, too, is an opportunity to ensure that transatlantic discussions about privacy and surveillance reverberate in a multilateral setting; seizing it would represent a small but significant contribution to the strategic vision that has been sorely lacking for the last quarter-century.

zh: 欧洲的容克革命
en: Europe’s Juncker Revolution

zh: 马德里—在被任命为欧盟委员会主席之前，让-克劳德·容克被抨击为老派联邦主义者，他的上任无益于改变现状。
en: MADRID – Before his appointment as EU Commission President, Jean-Claude Juncker was pilloried as an old-school federalist who would do little to alter the status quo.

zh: 但他给欧盟委员会带来的新结构可以说是给布鲁塞尔做了一次彻底大修。
en: But the new structure that he has imposed on the Commission implies a radical overhaul of how things are done in Brussels.

zh: 目前，对谁被任命为什么职位的关注 — — 特别是相对缺少经验的费得利卡·莫格里尼（Federica Mogherini）被任命为欧盟共同外交和安全政策高级代表 — — 困扰着欧盟委员会的结构转型。
en: Up to now, a focus on who has been appointed to what post – in particular, the appointment of the relatively inexperienced Federica Mogherini as EU High Representative for the Common Foreign and Security Policy – has overshadowed the Commission’s structural transformation.

zh: 但个别委员的重要性远没有导致欧盟委员会将其重点从扩张和内部市场转移到能源和货币联盟的趋势那么大。
en: But individual commissioners are far less important than the trends that have caused the Commission to shift its priorities from enlargement and the internal market toward energy and monetary union.

zh: 趋势之一是欧洲人对一体化的日益质疑，5月的欧洲议会选举说明了这一点。
en: One such trend is Europeans’ growing skepticism toward integration, exemplified in May’s European Parliament election.

zh: 较新的成员国出现了退步 — — 比如罗马尼亚的法治精神、保加利亚的腐败和维克托·奥班（Viktor Orbán）治下的匈牙利民主规范等 — — 因此，现在应该将注意力集中在现有成员国。
en: With newer European Union members backsliding – Romania on the rule of law, Bulgaria in corruption, and Hungary on democratic norms under Viktor Orbán’s government – now is the time, or so it seems, to focus on existing members.

zh: 加强这一变化的因素是土耳其向极权主义靠拢，这将威胁到其欧盟成员资格。
en: Reinforcing this shift is Turkey’s drift toward authoritarianism, which is undermining the viability of its candidacy for EU membership.

zh: 至于乌克兰，目前的团结姿态 — — 比如签署入盟协议 — — 在可以预见的未来已不可能有任何大进展。
en: As for Ukraine, recent gestures of solidarity, such as the signing of an association agreement, are unlikely to develop into anything substantial in the foreseeable future.

zh: 欧盟扩大作为首要政策已是明日黄花，欧盟委员会正在准备其他重要步骤。
en: In downgrading EU enlargement as a formal policy priority, the Commission is preparing itself to take other important steps.

zh: 欧洲南部和东部邻邦的剧变或许会带来拖延已久的欧盟邻国政策变化。
en: The upheaval among Europe’s southern and eastern neighbors may well bring about a long-overdue revamping of the EU’s Neighborhood Policy.

zh: 此外，在为扩大欧盟范围寻找其他办法时，欧洲领导人应该复兴欧洲经济区（European Economic Area ） 。
en: And, in pursuit of other avenues for expanding the EU’s reach, European leaders might reinvigorate the European Economic Area.

zh: 另一个重要性下降的政策领域是内部市场 — — 这是一个值得关注的决定，因为自1958年欧盟成立以来，它一直是欧洲工程的核心。
en: Another policy area that has lost its centrality is the internal market – a notable decision, given that it has been the centerpiece of the European project since the Commission was created in 1958.

zh: 内部市场的四大支柱 — — 商品、服务、资本和人力的自由转移 — — 撑起了一整套欧盟措施，如外交政策和司法和内部事务等领域，而现在将归于从经济和金融事务到数字日程的各种新的政策领域。
en: The internal market’s four pillars – the free movement of goods, services, capital, and people – have underpinned broader EU measures, in areas like foreign policy and justice and home affairs, and will now be subsumed under new policy labels, from economy and financial affairs to the digital agenda.

zh: 之所以将注意力从内部市场转移到其他地方，部分原因在于成员国政府厌恶更多的欧盟层面立法。
en: This move away from the internal market can be explained partly by member governments’ aversion to more EU-level legislation.

zh: 尽管关于欧盟现行法（acquis communitaire ） “ 臃肿”的抱怨常常毫无道理，但欧盟立法程序也不是没有缺点，最近的协调努力就是明证。
en: Though complaints about the “bloated” acquis communitaire (the body of EU law) are often unfounded, the EU legislative process is not without its shortcomings, as recent attempts at harmonization clearly demonstrate.

zh: 比如，对4月完成的欧盟法定审计，欧洲议会同意采取经过修订的指引和应该适用于所有28个成员国的新的监管。
en: For example, for the EU-wide statutory audit that was completed in April, the European Parliament agreed to a revised directive and new regulation that should have been directly applicable in all 28 member countries.

zh: 但是，有20多个成员国被授予实施和解释的自由裁量权。
en: But, in more than 20 cases, member states were given discretion over its implementation and interpretation.

zh: 新欧盟委员会将试图改变这一点，办法是专注于规则实施和监督而不是创立。
en: The new Commission will attempt to change this by focusing on rule implementation and oversight, rather than creation.

zh: 这一办法将由新成立的七个副主席岗位的代表合作进行，牵头的是首席副主席，目标是建立一个专注于“更好的监管”的组合。
en: This effort will be coordinated by representatives in seven newly established vice-presidential positions, and spearheaded by the first vice president to have a portfolio focused on “better regulation.”

zh: 平心而论，解放监管负担是欧盟的长期主旋律。
en: To be sure, easing regulatory burdens is a longstanding leitmotif of the EU.

zh: 尽管由何塞·曼努埃尔·巴罗佐所领导的前两届委员会赞成致力于合理化、明确化并撰写规则，但几乎没有实际行动。
en: Though the last two Commissions, led by José Manuel Barroso, espoused a commitment to rationalizing, clarifying, and compiling rules, little concrete action has been taken.

zh: 但是，容克的变化也许预示着这��面以及迈向货币和能源联盟的真正进步。
en: Juncker’s changes, however, may portend genuine progress on this front, as well as toward monetary and energy union.

zh: 事实上，欧盟委员会的结构表明容克希望加强其在指导欧洲货币联盟和相关政策方面的作用。
en: Indeed, the new Commission’s structure suggests that Juncker hopes to enhance its role in guiding the European Monetary Union and related policies, control over which largely rested with the European Council and EU member governments (especially Germany) during the crisis.

zh: 类似地，欧盟委员会已经引入了负责能源事务的新副主席，并将能源事务重命名为“能源联盟 ” 。
en: Similarly, a new vice president has been introduced for energy, which has been reframed as “energy union.”

zh: 这方面在过去两届委员会中迟迟得不到进展，这主要是拜德国的俄罗斯现代化工程所赐 — — 这决定了它的能源安全方针。
en: The lack of progress on this front during the last two Commissions was rooted mainly in Germany’s Russian modernization project, which has shaped its approach to energy security.

zh: 此外，法国因为严重依赖核能而一直不愿建立互相连通的欧洲电网。
en: For its part, France has been reluctant to build an interconnected European grid, owing to its heavy reliance on nuclear energy.

zh: 但是，考虑到俄罗斯在乌克兰的行径，欧盟领导人已开始反思这一方针。
en: Given Russian behavior in Ukraine, however, EU leaders have been rethinking their approach.

zh: 在这样的情况下，欧盟委员会的新结构 — — 更不用说新的欧洲理事会主席、前波兰总理唐纳德·塔斯克（Donald Tusk）早就开始寻求能源联盟这一事实了 — — 可能会极大地推进这方面的政策。
en: In this context, the Commission’s new structure – not to mention the fact that the new European Council president, former Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk, has long sought an energy union – may well push the policy forward.

zh: 尽管不可能在早期阶段就完全了解欧盟委员会的新结构，但一些机构架构已经浮现出来。
en: Though it is impossible to understand fully the implications of the Commission’s new structure at this early stage, some of its institutional ramifications are already emerging.

zh: 除了与欧洲理事会角力之外，欧盟委员会的偏离立法功能还将改变在过去五年里欧洲议会紧跟欧盟委员会的积极立法日程建立起来的角色。
en: Beyond inciting a kind of tug-of-war with the European Council, the Commission’s shift away from lawmaking will alter the European Parliament’s role, which it has forged over the last five years on the back of the Commission’s active legislative agenda.

zh: 欧洲议会没有权力实施立法，因此别无选择，也只能将重点转向监督。
en: With little authority to initiate legislation, the Parliament, too, will have no choice but to pivot toward oversight.

zh: 所有这些在未来几个月和几年里如何发展将决定欧洲工程是进步还是停滞不前。
en: Precisely how all of this all plays out in the coming months and years will determine whether the European project progresses or stagnates.

zh: 也许观察者应该更少关注“谁 ” ， 更多关注“什么 ” 。
en: Perhaps observers should be paying a little less attention to the “who” and a bit more to the “what.”

zh: 埃博拉之外的非洲
en: Africa Beyond Ebola

zh: 马德里—在今年夏天全世界的死亡恐惧中，埃博拉病毒的蔓延主宰了撒哈拉以南非洲问题的讨论，也在活力非洲的新形象冉冉升起时重新点燃了混乱和绝望的古老印象。
en: MADRID – Among this summer’s grave global worries, the spread of the Ebola virus has monopolized the discussion of Sub-Saharan Africa and reinvigorated hoary notions of disorder and despair – at a time when a new image of a dynamic Africa was emerging.

zh: 事实上，对于非洲地区的前景，我们仍有很强的理由保持乐观。
en: In fact, there is still strong reason for optimism about the region’s prospects.

zh: 埃博拉的爆发让影响非洲地区的三个重要事件黯然失色。
en: The Ebola outbreak overshadowed three key events affecting the region.

zh: 7月1日，世界银行集团实施了一项重大组织重构。
en: On July 1, a major organizational restructuring at the World Bank Group was implemented.

zh: 两周后，金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）宣布成立新开发银行。
en: Two weeks later, the BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) announced the establishment of the New Development Bank.

zh: 8月初，非洲政府和商界领袖齐聚华盛顿，参加推进可改变非洲的私人投资的峰会。
en: And, in early August, African government and business leaders gathered in Washington, DC, for a summit that could portend transformative private investment in Africa.

zh: 如今，流向私人净资本流是官方发展援助的十倍，在这样的背景下，这类投资十分关键。
en: Such investment is essential in a world in which net private capital flows to developing countries outstrip official development assistance by a margin of ten to one.

zh: 如果这成为非洲的反转点而不是又一次假反弹，那么今年夏天必然是刺激私人部门参与的长期努力的起点。
en: If this is to be a turning point for Africa, rather than another false dawn, this summer must be the start of a prolonged effort to stimulate private-sector engagement.

zh: 世界银行的重组是行长金墉（Jim Yong Kim）所领导的更加宏大的计划的一部分，金墉努力使世界银行重新定位为与私人部门齐头并进的促进器，而不是主要援助提供者。
en: The reorganization of the World Bank is a central part of a larger effort under its president, Jim Yong Kim, to reposition the Bank as a facilitator vis-a-vis the private sector, rather than a primary provider.

zh: 从2009年到2013年，世界银行私人部门贷款机构国际金融公司（International Finance Corporation）所作出的投资承诺增长了73 % 。
en: From 2009 to 2013, new investment commitments by the International Finance Corporation, the World Bank’s private-sector lending arm, have risen 73%.

zh: 与此同时，世界银行为发展中国家投资提供政治风险保险的机构跨国投资担保局（Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency）采取双管齐下措施扩展活动范围 — — 既扩大了其所支持的项目种类，也扩充了现有限定条件以增加覆盖面。
en: Meanwhile, the Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency, the Bank’s provider of political risk insurance covering investments in developing countries, has moved to expand its activities, both by broadening the types of projects that it supports and widening existing definitions to allow greater coverage.

zh: 7月的重组就发生在这些范围更大的动作的背景下。
en: July’s restructuring occurs within the context of these broader moves.

zh: 在重新组织世界银行集团核心部分 — — 国际复兴开发银行（International Bank for Reconstruction and Development）过程中，金墉采取了将专家知识与地区覆盖相统一的管理顾问模式。
en: In reorganizing the World Bank Group’s central component, the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, Kim has adopted a management-consulting model that unites expertise with regional coverage.

zh: 为了拔出将地区专家彼此之间互相隔离的官僚主义“据点 ” ， 建立了14个能源、水和教育等领域的全球行动组织以充分调动世界银行可观的关于项目与合作的知识。
en: Seeking to eliminate the bureaucratic “silos” that have isolated regional experts from one another, 14 global practice groups in areas such as energy, water, and education have been established to bring to bear the full force of the World Bank’s considerable knowledge on projects and partnerships.

zh: 正如世界银行在重新给自己定位，金砖国家一致同意���立自己的银行。
en: Just as the World Bank was repositioning itself, the BRICS agreed to establish their own bank.

zh: 关于新开发银行如何运行，还存在许多重大问题有待解决，但早期迹象表明基础设施将是该银行活动的核心领域，而非洲则是重点地区。
en: There are significant outstanding issues about how the New Development Bank will operate, but early indications suggest that infrastructure will be central to its activities, with an emphasis on Africa.

zh: 世界银行估算，基础设施不足令非洲生产率下降了约40 % 。
en: The World Bank estimates that insufficient infrastructure reduces productivity in Africa by approximately 40%.

zh: 拥有1,000亿美元初始授权资本的新开发银行的加入 — — 以及自去年启动以来以筹集到260亿美元出资承诺的美国非洲加油计划（Power Africa program）和世界银行新成立的全球基础设施基金（Global Infrastructure Facility ） — —能够极大地缓解基础设施融资难问题。
en: The entrance of a new player with initial authorized capital of $100 billion – along with the United States’ Power Africa program, which has garnered $26 billion in commitments since its launch last year, and the World Bank’s new Global Infrastructure Facility – promises to help ease infrastructure financing significantly.

zh: 但是，眼下新开发银行仍然比只是一份政治团结宣言，是否能够成为现实还有待观察。
en: But, as of now, the New Development Bank is little more than a statement of political solidarity, and whether it comes into existence remains to be seen.

zh: 即使它真的开始运作，金砖国家也缺乏更给予各种开发银行（特别是世界银行）合法性和分量的东西：主要由具备世界顶尖水平的敬业专家工作人员。
en: Even if it does begin to function, the BRICS lack what gives development banks, and the World Bank in particular, legitimacy and weight: a staff composed mostly of dedicated experts who are among the world’s best.

zh: 最后，美非领导人峰会的规格相当高，有40多个国家的元首出席，奥巴马总统也直接参与了峰会，这使得非洲话题成了热门。
en: Finally, the high profile of the US-Africa Leaders Summit, with more than 40 heads of state in attendance, as well as President Barack Obama’s direct involvement, generated buzz about Africa.

zh: 美国企业和投资者显然更好地了解了非洲的潜力，也根深地认识到非洲大陆投资气候的多样性。
en: US businesses and investors certainly gained more awareness about Africa’s potential and a deeper understanding of the variety of investment climates throughout the continent.

zh: 但是，尽管此次峰会可谓成功，其长期影响仍不清楚，特别是在考虑到未来不确定性的情况下。
en: But, though the summit may be called a success, its long-term implications are unclear, particularly given the uncertainty about what will follow.

zh: 眼下，似乎没有将峰会制度化的打算。
en: At the moment, there does not seem to be a plan to institutionalize the summit.

zh: 此外，如此多国家元首的参与掩盖了非洲商界领袖的风头。
