en: Moreover, the participation of so many heads of state overshadowed that of African business leaders.

zh: 美国公司在决定是否投资时所需要的务实关系理应在峰会期间或之后有所进展，但并非如此。
en: The practical connections that US companies will need when deciding whether to invest could have been cultivated on the summit’s margins, or in its aftermath, but were not.

zh: 打好未来参与的基础需要不断的承诺和努力，光靠宣传是不行的。
en: Laying a foundation for future engagement requires ongoing commitment and effort that goes beyond mere publicity.

zh: 世界银行也是如此。
en: The same could be said about the World Bank.

zh: 将新组织模式融入现有银行结构和实践领域还有很多工作要做。
en: There is much work to be done in integrating the new organizational model with existing Bank structures and practice areas.

zh: 即使能够实现无缝转型，世界银行仍面临着艰苦的内部斗争，需要战胜根深蒂固的官僚利益和无处不在的过度厌恶风险、过度注重过程而非结果的制度思维。
en: Even if this transition occurs seamlessly, the Bank faces a serious internal struggle against entrenched bureaucratic interests and a pervasive institutional mindset that is overly risk-averse and fixates on processes rather than outcomes.

zh: 近几年来，昔日的可怜之地非洲正在崛起为机会之地。
en: In recent years, Africa, once a land of pity, has emerged as a land of opportunity.

zh: 如果非洲想要成为表现之地，就必须将目标放在促进国内外投资商。
en: If it is to become a land of performance, the goal must be to facilitate investment, both domestic and foreign.

zh: 这需要努力和承诺；由于稳定的国际秩序日益需要繁荣而增长的非洲，因此这也是全世界不可丧失的机会。
en: That will demand effort and commitment; given that a stable international order increasingly depends on a prosperous and growing Africa, it is a goal that the world cannot afford to miss.

zh: 欧洲的伊朗使命
en: Europe’s Iranian Imperative

zh: 马德里—上个月，当全世界的目光都投向克里米亚危机和寻找马航370航班时，伊朗和P5+1（美国、中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国加上德国）之间的谈判在维也纳静悄悄地结束了最新一轮。
en: MADRID – Last month, with the world’s attention fixed on the crisis in Crimea and the search for Malaysian Airlines Flight 370, the latest round of negotiations between Iran and the P5+1 (the United States, China, France, Russia, and the United Kingdom, plus Germany) passed quietly in Vienna.

zh: 虽然下周讨论还将继续，但谈判的结果远未可知 — — 并且世界领导人都不得不把注意力集中于此。
en: Even with discussions set to continue next week, the talks’ outcome remains far from certain – and world leaders cannot afford to become distracted.

zh: 欧洲尤其如此，在这个节骨眼上，它对伊朗的统一态度是至关重要的。
en: This is especially true for Europe, whose unified approach to Iran has been invaluable up to this point.

zh: 事实上，正是欧洲制裁的威力让伊朗最终来到谈判桌前，而统一的欧洲外交也将助力“联合行动计划 ” ， 为六个月内达成全面长期协议贡献力量。
en: Indeed, it was the bite of European sanctions that ultimately brought Iran to the negotiating table, and the force of unified European diplomacy facilitated the “joint plan of action,” which set out the terms for reaching a comprehensive long-term agreement within six months.

zh: 但如今，在计划进行了一半时，我们却看不见实实在在的进展，上个月的谈判在可接受的伊朗铀浓缩水平和阿拉克（Arak）重水反应堆的未来等关键问题的讨论上没有取得任何成果。
en: But now, at the plan’s halfway point, there has been little concrete progress, with last month’s negotiations producing no headway on two key issues being discussed: the acceptable level for uranium enrichment in Iran and the future of the heavy-water reactor at Arak.

zh: 成果寥寥与伊朗最近宣布将在7月达成最终协议之间的鲜明反差产生了关于伊朗战略和目标的重要问题 — — 在决定最佳方针时，谈判者必须小心对待这些问题。
en: The sharp contrast between this lack of achievement and Iran’s recent declarations about reaching a final deal by July raises important questions about Iran’s strategy and goals – questions that negotiators must consider carefully when determining the best approach.

zh: 成功的关键在于进程的背景。
en: The key to success is the background against which the process plays out.

zh: 伊朗是矛盾之地。
en: Iran is a land of contrasts.

zh: 在欧洲外交关系委员会（ECFR）组织的最新访问中，根深蒂固的传统与快速的变迁如何共存的问题显得颇为突出。
en: On a recent visit organized by the European Council on Foreign Relations (ECFR), the coexistence of entrenched tradition and rapid transformation was starkly apparent.

zh: 在德黑兰市中心，年轻人青春洋溢，女性脚踩高跟鞋，头戴传统头巾，身穿夹克衫、系腰带、穿裤子 — — 彰显出对进步的渴望。
en: Central Tehran – ebullient with young people and high-heeled women donning testimonial headscarves and mid-thigh jackets over pants – embodies a thirst for openness.

zh: 60%的伊朗人口出生于1979年伊斯兰革命之后，40%多的伊朗人出生于20世纪80年代两伊战争之后。
en: More than 60% of Iranians were born after the 1979 Islamic Revolution, and more than 40% were born after the Iran-Iraq War of the 1980’s.

zh: 对他们来说，革命只是历史，而不是个人价值的主要来源。
en: For them, the revolution is a part of history, not the main source of their personal values.

zh: 多年的严厉经济制裁的后果也随处可见。
en: The toll taken by years of tough economic sanctions is also apparent.

zh: 尽管伊朗官员竭尽全力降低了制裁的影响，但通货膨胀仍然难以控制在30%以下，今年的GDP增长率预计只有1 % 。
en: Despite Iranian officials’ best efforts to downplay the sanctions’ impact, it is difficult to spin inflation in excess of 30% and projected GDP growth of just 1% this year.

zh: 年轻的人口和蹒跚的经济的组合是危险的，会给政权带来生存威胁 — — 政权也知道这一点。
en: The combination of a young population and a crumbling economy is a combustible mix, one that amounts to an existential threat to the regime – and the regime knows it.

zh: 从这个角度讲，与国际社会达成巩固繁荣的协议对伊朗领导人来说从未如此紧迫。
en: In this sense, the imperative to reach a prosperity-enhancing agreement with the international community is greater than ever for Iran’s leadership.

zh: 此外，伊朗的谈判风格就像它的首都，既让人心力憔悴，又让人困惑不解。
en: Furthermore, Iran’s negotiating style, like its capital city, can be both fatiguing and confusing.

zh: 在详细阐释了可兰经的核武器禁忌几个月后，伊朗谈判员又宣称福尔道（Fordow）地下核设施不可空袭是任何协议的核心问题。
en: Just moments after elaborating at length on the Koran’s prohibition of nuclear weapons, an interlocutor would declare that the underground Fordow nuclear facility’s impregnability to airstrikes must be central to any deal.

zh: 现实是，伊朗从未想过放弃其核突破能力。
en: The reality is that Iran does not envisage giving up its nuclear breakout capacity.

zh: 谈判的目标不在于扑灭这一能力，而在于延长时间 — — 具体地说，在于将铀浓缩丰度限制在3.5%以内，在于建立严格的检查制度，在于就阿拉克核设施问题达成协议。
en: The negotiations are aimed not at eradication, but at lengthening lead-time – specifically, limiting uranium-enrichment levels to 3.5%, establishing a strong inspections regime, and reaching an agreement on the Arak nuclear facility.

zh: 但即使这些目标可能也无法达成。
en: But even this may not happen.

zh: 毕竟，伊朗官员并未表达过接受严格的、可验证的检查的承诺。
en: After all, Iranian officials have thus far not demonstrated their commitment to accepting stringent and verifiable checks.

zh: 此外，伊朗设法将核谈判和其他范围更广的相关问题（如弹道导弹计划、其对真主党等组织的支持以及其国内人权纪录等）分离。
en: Moreover, Iran has managed to separate the nuclear negotiations from broader, related issues like its ballistic-missile program, its support for groups like Hezbollah, and its domestic human-rights record.

zh: 美国不愿意在现有局面中再增加干扰因素，因此这些问题都不可能被提到讨论议程上来。
en: With the US loath to introduce potential spoilers into the mix, there is no chance that any of these issues will be up for discussion.

zh: 在这样的背景下，欧盟高级代表凯瑟琳·阿什顿（Catherine Ashton）在最近访问德黑兰期间与持异见者的会晤只不过是象征性的姿态。
en: In this context, EU High Representative Catherine Ashton’s meeting with dissidents during her most recent trip to Tehran was merely a symbolic gesture.

zh: 这给了伊朗所需要的战略赌注机会 — — 叙利亚冲突将造成西方与伊朗的主要地区对手沙特阿拉伯之间的摩擦升级。
en: This leaves Iran the opening it needs to place a strategic bet that the Syrian conflict will generate increasing friction between the West and Iran’s regional archrival, Saudi Arabia.

zh: 对叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权的坚定支持者伊朗来说，美国-沙特关系的削弱是改变地区实力平衡的关键 — — 特别是伴随着西方经济制裁放松的话。
en: For Iran, a staunch supporter of Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s regime, a weaker US-Saudi relationship is key to shifting the regional balance of power – especially if it is accompanied by the easing of Western economic sanctions.

zh: 从某种程度上说，这一希望因为伊朗将美国总统奥巴马视为核谈判中有积极性的伙伴而加强了。
en: To some degree, this hope is reinforced by Iran’s perception of US President Barack Obama as a motivated partner in the nuclear talks.

zh: 毕竟对奥巴马来说，与伊朗的长期协议不但是突出的外交成就，也有利于他让美国摆脱中东。
en: After all, a long-term agreement would be both a singular foreign-policy achievement for Obama and a boon to his efforts to disentangle the US from the Middle East.

zh: 但伊朗也认识到时间紧迫。
en: But Iran also recognizes that the clock is ticking.

zh: 奥巴马的总统任期正在走向尾声，共和党大有在11月的中期选举中控制参议院之势，而民主党则日益被认为“对伊朗太软弱 ” 。
en: Obama’s presidency is coming to an end, the Republicans are poised to regain control of the Senate in November’s mid-term election, and Democrats are increasingly reticent to be viewed as “soft on Iran.”

zh: 因此，美国国会应该会对与伊朗的协议敌意越来越大；事实上，最终协议达成越晚，国会阻挠的可能性就越大。
en: As a result, the US Congress appears to be growing more hostile toward a deal; indeed, the longer it takes to conclude a final agreement, the more likely Congress is to scupper it.

zh: 在此背景下，欧洲将起到关键作用。
en: In this context, Europe has a key role to play.

zh: 尽管在伊朗看来，欧洲在外交政策上一直有“软弱”的名声，但欧洲在迫使伊朗参与谈判方面起到的作用一直是当前对话的基础。
en: While Europe’s reputation for foreign-policy “softness” continues to shape Iranian perceptions, the EU’s role in compelling Iran to negotiate underpins the current talks.

zh: 类似地，导致去年11月没能在日内瓦达成协议的原因是法国坚决主张严格控制。
en: Likewise, it was France’s insistence on more stringent controls that initially blocked the agreement in Geneva last November.

zh: 十年前，欧洲因为美国的压力而从谈判中撤出，让伊朗大失所望 — — 有人认为这促进了伊朗前总统内贾德的上台。
en: A decade ago, Europe disappointed Iran by withdrawing from negotiations, under pressure from the US – a move that some have suggested aided former Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad’s rise to power.

zh: 如今，欧洲将在推动进程方面起到关键作用，特别是在美国国会阻挠有利协议的情况下。
en: Today, Europe will be critical to driving progress, particularly in the event that the US Congress torpedoes a sensible agreement.

zh: 事实上，在伊朗问题上，欧洲的统一意见能让它获得比其他重要外交政策问题更大的影响力。
en: Indeed, on Iran, Europe’s unified approach has enabled it to have a greater impact than on any other significant foreign-policy issue.

zh: 这应该被树立为未来的榜样和现在的经验。
en: This should be regarded as a model for the future and a lesson for the present.

zh: 统一目标、保持它所带来的压力和谈判动力可以让欧洲向伊朗、美国及其本身展示什么才是真正的全球行动者。
en: By preserving its unity of purpose and maintaining the pressure and negotiating momentum that it has generated, Europe can demonstrate to Iran, the US, and itself that it has what it takes to be a major global actor.

zh: 被遗忘的叙利亚
en: Forsaken Syria

zh: 马德里 — — 扬·卡尔斯基诞辰一百周年纪念日已大抵淹没在今年俯拾皆是的纪念活动当中。
en: MADRID – In this year of ubiquitous commemorations, the centennial of Jan Karski’s birth has been largely overlooked.

zh: 但卡尔斯基留下的遗产却比以往任何时候都更重要 — — 尤其是在叙利亚。
en: And yet Karski’s legacy is more important than ever – nowhere more so than in Syria.

zh: 随着日内瓦第二次和平进程的艰难前行 — — 身后留下了堆积如山的尸体和罄竹难书的暴行 — — 卡尔斯基不顾政府和公众所表现出的惰性，尽力让世界了解二战期间波兰犹太人困境的壮举恰恰体现了叙利亚所迫切需要的精神。
en: As the Geneva II peace process slogs along – leaving cadavers and atrocities to pile up – Karski’s dedication to bringing the plight of Poland’s Jews to the world’s attention during World War II, despite the inertia of governments and publics, embodies exactly what Syria desperately needs.

zh: 1942年，波兰出生的外交官卡尔斯基前往英国报告后来被称之为大屠杀的暴行。
en: In 1942, Karski, a Polish-born diplomat, traveled to the United Kingdom to report on what came to be called the Holocaust.

zh: 第二年他又踏上了向美国总统富兰克林·D·罗斯福及其他政要汇报他亲眼目睹的恐怖行径的旅程。
en: The next year, he embarked on a mission to the United States to brief President Franklin D. Roosevelt and other dignitaries on the horrors that he had witnessed.

zh: 他的英美之旅无一例外地遭遇了怀疑和冷漠。
en: In both cases, he was met with skepticism and apathy.

zh: 事实上，直到战争末期国际社会才为阻止屠杀采取了行动。
en: Indeed, it was only toward the end of the war that action was taken to stop the slaughter.

zh: 虽然没有什么能与大屠杀造成的破坏相比，但想到国际社会今天对叙利亚的态度人们不禁会想起卡尔斯基。
en: Although the Holocaust is a category of persecution sui generis, one cannot avoid thinking of Karski in light of the international community’s approach to Syria today.

zh: 外界对日内瓦会谈几乎不抱什么希望，以致于巴沙尔·阿萨德总统的谈判代表和反对派同坐在一间屋子里（虽然并没有坐在一张桌前）这样微不足道的琐事都被看做是一种成功。
en: Expectations for the Geneva talks are so low that trivial matters – such as the fact that President Bashar al-Assad’s negotiators and the opposition are sitting together in the same room (though not at the same table) – are being hailed as successes.

zh: 就连允许妇女儿童离开霍姆斯市（阿萨德反对派大本营）封锁区的协议都距离国际调解员的目标相去甚远 — — 而且就连这一点点成就现在似乎都值得怀疑。
en: Even the agreement to allow women and children to leave blockaded areas of the city of Homs – an anti-Assad stronghold – fell far short of international mediators’ vision (and even this achievement seems to be in doubt).

zh: 政府并未允许联合国援助车队为该地区民众带去人道主义援助，而是同意按照尚未确定的时间表释放妇女和儿童，而男性则只有在洗脱罪名之后才能离境。 政府的举动导致人们因害怕被捕而人心惶惶。
en: Instead of allowing a United Nations aid convoy to bring humanitarian aid to the area, the government agreed to release women and children on an as-yet-uncertain timeline, while men can leave only after their names had been cleared, raising fears of arrest.

zh: 此外，因为对渐进步骤审议进展缓慢且明显无法满足需要，叙利亚人正陷入流离失所、惨遭伤害、折磨和大批被杀的困境当中。
en: Meanwhile, amid plodding deliberations of incremental steps that are clearly inadequate, Syrians are being displaced, wounded, tortured, and killed in droves.

zh: 无论采用何种标准，叙利亚的苦难指数都令人触目惊心。
en: By any measure, the level of suffering in Syria is shocking.

zh: 虽然数字并不足以显示各方行为的残酷，但列举数字已经成为一种礼节性的需求：超过100,000人丧生、230万登记难民和超过400万民众在国内流离失所（有人估计国内流离失所的民众甚至高达650万人 ） 。
en: Although figures do not convey the cruelty by all sides, it has become de rigueur to cite the numbers: more than 100,000 dead, 2.3 million refugees, and four million people internally displaced.

zh: 但一年前这个数字其实已经非常可怕：60,000人死亡、700,000名难民以及200万国内民众流离失所。
en: But a year ago, the figures were already dire: 60,000 dead, 700,000 international refugees, and two million internally displaced.

zh: 如果苦难达到一定限度就能让国际社会说“够了 ” ， 那么叙利亚现在的情况早就已经突破了这个限度。
en: If there were a threshold of misery that would cause the world to say, “Enough is enough,” it surely would have been crossed by now.

zh: 丑陋的真相是世界对危机的反应并不是结束这场骇人听闻的人间苦难，反而是争夺各参与方的地缘政治利益。
en: The ugly truth is that the world’s response to this crisis has been shaped by geopolitical interests, not the need to put an end to appalling human suffering.

zh: 事实上，叙利亚冲突只是沙特和伊朗、���特和卡塔尔、美国和伊朗、俄国和美国、什叶和逊尼派穆斯林以及温和派和极端派更大规模斗争的代理早已不是什么秘密 — — 解决这场冲突需要各方面共同付出艰苦的努力。
en: Indeed, it is no secret that the conflict serves as a proxy for larger struggles – between Saudi Arabia and Iran, Saudi Arabia and Qatar, the US and Iran, Russia and the US, Shia and Sunni Muslims, and moderates and extremists – and that resolving it will require significant effort on all of these fronts.

zh: 从美国的角度看，叙利亚并不是一颗战略上的关键棋子。
en: From an American perspective, Syria is not strategically critical.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马总统政府一直强烈关注国内事务，美国公众也异常警惕介入国外问题。
en: President Barack Obama’s administration has maintained an intensely inward-looking focus, reinforced by a public wary of foreign engagements.

zh: 除非叙利亚冲突性质突然急剧变化并威胁美国核心利益，否则都不要指望美国直接干预叙利亚问题。
en: Nothing short of a drastic change in the conflict’s nature that threatened America’s core interests would lead to direct US involvement.

zh: 单靠负疚感采取国际行动显然远远不够。
en: Guilt, after all, is a poor motivator for international action.

zh: 就连英国和法国 — — 毫不避讳地威胁要对阿萨德政权采取军事行动的唯一两个国家 — — 也在面对孤军奋战的可能性时充当了逃兵。
en: Even the UK and France – the only two countries that were not shy about threatening military action against Assad’s regime – got cold feet when confronted with the possibility of going it alone.

zh: 相反，世界正在对难以言喻的暴行画面表现出纯粹的愤怒 — — 包括阿萨德政权的酷刑拷问或反对派执行的处决。
en: Instead, the world is responding to graphic images of unspeakable brutality – torture by the regime or executions carried out by the opposition – with sterile shows of outrage.

zh: 一系列的声明、折中举措和笨拙行动并未起到改善局势的作用 — — 甚至在某些情况下进一步恶化了现有局势。
en: The stream of statements, half-measures, and clumsy initiatives has done little to improve the situation – and, in some instances, has made things worse.

zh: 想想奥巴马要求阿萨德“下台”的缺乏实际行动支持的空洞呼吁，以及可以追溯到2012年初期的反复承诺为叙利亚反对派提供非致命性援助 — — 直到去年下半年奥巴马的承诺才终于兑现，但也只是兑现了一段时间而已。
en: Consider Obama’s call, backed by no action, for Assad to “step aside,” and his repeated promises, dating to early 2012, to provide non-lethal aid to the Syrian opposition – promises that were finally fulfilled late last year, and then only temporarily.

zh: 言论和行动的巨大差距留下了一段真空；沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔和私人捐助者随后通过支持反对派极端势力填补了这段真空，并在巩固自己势力的同时削弱了温和派的势力。
en: This gap between rhetoric and action left a vacuum; Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and private donors subsequently filled it by channeling support to extremist elements of the opposition, strengthening their hand at the expense of those being called moderates.

zh: 但奥巴马于2012年宣布化学武器将成为美国被迫干预的“红线”是美国政策瘫痪最臭名昭著的例子。
en: But the most infamous example of this policy paralysis was Obama’s 2012 declaration that the use of chemical weapons was the “red line” beyond which the US would be forced to intervene.

zh: 他最终未能兑现诺言让阿萨德变得更加大胆，并且在某种程度上重新获得了合法地位。
en: His ultimate failure to follow through on his proclamation emboldened and, in a way, re-legitimized Assad.

zh: 日内瓦二次会议是否会沿用这一模式尚有待观察。
en: It remains to be seen whether Geneva II will follow this pattern.

zh: 谈判已经付出了高昂的代价，因为各方都通过加紧暴力活动巩固自己在谈判桌上的位置。
en: The price of the talks has already been high, with all sides having ramped up violence to strengthen their respective positions ahead of the negotiations.

zh: 这还不算撤回对伊朗邀请所代表的惨败，有效解决叙利亚问题必须得到伊朗的支持。
en: This is to say nothing of the fiasco surrounding the withdrawn invitation to Iran, whose buy-in will be essential for any resolution.

zh: 无论如何，谈判的渐进性掩盖了局势的紧迫性。
en: In any case, the incremental nature of the talks belies the situation’s urgency.

zh: 在对政权更迭、过渡政府和谈判代表的关注中，确实有可能忽略已然陷入绝境的人道主义局势。
en: Amid the current focus on regime change, a transitional government, and negotiating delegations, there is a real danger that the desperate humanitarian situation will be overlooked.

zh: 民众在这种情况下能够起到关键的作用。
en: Here, citizens have a critical role to play.

zh: 但各国民众像其领袖一样行事一直谨小慎微。
en: But, like their leaders, publics everywhere have been reticent to act.

zh: 事实上，民意调查显示尽管对局势几乎达成了普遍看法，但对叙利亚采取干预行动却很少得到民众的支持。
en: Indeed, opinion polls show that, despite near-universal awareness of the situation in Syria, there is very little public support for intervention.

zh: 但焦躁不安没有任何用处；普通民众必须承担责任结束这场悲剧，迫使本国领导人采取行动。
en: But handwringing will not help; we – individuals – must accept real responsibility for ending the tragedy and press our leaders to act.

zh: 卡尔斯基向世界报告大屠杀已经过去70年了。
en: It has been more than 70 years since Karski presented his report to the world.

zh: 在此期间，我们建立了联合国、通过了世界人权宣言，并且无休止地探讨政府对民众的“保护责任 ” 。 但眼看叙利亚的悲剧不断发展，人们可能认为情况没有发生任何变化。
en: In that time, we have created the United Nations, adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, and discussed endlessly governments’ “responsibility to protect” their citizens.

zh: 我们究竟还要多少次地发誓“永远不再允许这样的悲剧重演 ” ， 才能真正杜绝这样的悲剧再次发生？
en: Yet, watching the Syrian tragedy develop, one might conclude that nothing has changed. How many times must we say, “Never again”?

zh: 沉迷电视的国度
en: A Nation of Vidiots

zh: 发自纽约 — — 过去半个世纪是电子化大众媒体的时代。
en: NEW YORK – The past half-century has been the age of electronic mass media.

zh: 电视已经重塑了世界各地的社会面貌。
en: Television has reshaped society in every corner of the world.

zh: 现在，一系列新视频工具正在加入电视的行列：DVD，电脑，游戏机，智能手机等等。
en: Now an explosion of new media devices is joining the TV set: DVDs, computers, game boxes, smart phones, and more.

zh: 但同时也有越来越多的证据显示，这些媒体的扩散将带来无穷的祸患。
en: A growing body of evidence suggests that this media proliferation has countless ill effects.

zh: 美国把世界带入了电视时代，而因此造成的影响可以从美国与哈兰·艾莉森所谓“玻璃奶嘴”的著名论断之间的漫长爱情故事中得到最直接体现。
en: The United States led the world into the television age, and the implications can be seen most directly in America’s long love affair with what Harlan Ellison memorably called “the glass teat.”

zh: 在1950年，拥有电视机的美国家庭比例不到8 % ； 到了1960年，90%的美国家庭都拥有了一台电视机。
en: In 1950, fewer than 8% of American households owned a TV; by 1960, 90% had one.

zh: 相比之下世界其他国家要多花几十年才能使电视机的普及率达到了美国同样的水平，而那些最贫困国家到目前为止都还未能企及。
en: That level of penetration took decades longer to achieve elsewhere, and the poorest countries are still not there.

zh: 尽管相关统计稍显粗略和不完整，但相关数据显示，美国人不但过去曾是最大的电视迷，现在也依然如此。
en: True to form, Americans became the greatest TV watchers, which is probably still true today, even though the data are somewhat sketchy and incomplete.

zh: 最有力的证据显示美国人每天平均看电视5小时以上 — — 别忘了在看电视之前他们还花了几个小时在其他的视频设备上，这是一个多么惊人的数字啊。
en: The best evidence suggests that Americans watch more than five hours per day of television on average – a staggering amount, given that several hours more are spent in front of other video-streaming devices.

zh: 其他国家花在看电视上的时间就少得多了。
en: Other countries log far fewer viewing hours.

zh: 比如在斯堪的纳维亚半岛，人们花在看电视上的时间大约只有美国的一半。
en: In Scandinavia, for example, time spent watching TV is roughly half the US average.

zh: 对全世界来说，电视对美国社会造成的影响是一道深刻而又令人烦恼的的警钟 — — 尽管现在说什么都晚了。
en: The consequences for American society are profound, troubling, and a warning to the world – though it probably comes far too late to be heeded.

zh: 首先，电视看多了，快乐就少了。
en: First, heavy TV viewing brings little pleasure.

zh: 许多调查显示，看电视就像吸毒，短暂的快感换来的只是长期的痛苦和自责。
en: Many surveys show that it is almost like an addiction, with a short-term benefit leading to long-term unhappiness and remorse.

zh: 这些电视迷说要是可以重新选择的话，他们宁愿少看点电视。
en: Such viewers say that they would prefer to watch less than they do.

zh: 另外，沉迷于电视会导致社会分裂。
en: Moreover, heavy TV viewing has contributed to social fragmentation.

zh: 人们曾经花在社区交际上的时间现在都被用来独自看电视了。
en: Time that used to be spent together in the community is now spent alone in front of the screen.

zh: 美国研究社区意识衰落问题的泰斗罗伯特·普特南发现，电视节目是导致“社会资本 ” — —即维持社区凝聚的信任 — — 衰减的核心因素。
en: Robert Putnam, the leading scholar of America’s declining sense of community, has found that TV viewing is the central explanation of the decline of “social capital,” the trust that binds communities together.

zh: 现在的美国人比他们的上一代人更少互相信赖。
en: Americans simply trust each other less than they did a generation ago.

zh: 当然，还有其他因素导致社会分裂，但是电视促进的社会原子化是不可忽略的重要原因。
en: Of course, many other factors are at work, but television-driven social atomization should not be understated.

zh: 毫无疑问，沉迷电视对个人的身体和精神健康都有害。
en: Certainly, heavy TV viewing is bad for one’s physical and mental health.

zh: 美国是世界上肥胖症最严重的国家，当前，大约2/3的美国人身体都过胖。
en: Americans lead the world in obesity, with roughly two-thirds of the US population now overweight.

zh: 当然导致身体过胖的原因也有很多，包括长期吃廉价、不健康的油炸食品，不过长时间坐在电视机前不动也是一个很重要的原因。
en: Again, many factors underlie this, including a diet of cheap, unhealthy fried foods, but the sedentary time spent in front of the TV is an important influence as well.

zh: 同时，精神上收到的影响与肉体上的同样重要。
en: At the same time, what happens mentally is as important as what happens physically.

zh: 在社会上，电视和相关的媒体是公司广告和政治宣传最大的传输工具。
en: Television and related media have been the greatest purveyors and conveyors of corporate and political propaganda in society.

zh: 美国的电视台几乎都掌握在私人手里，而电视台老板则通过不断播出广告而赚钱。
en: America’s TV ownership is almost entirely in private hands, and owners make much of their money through relentless advertising.

zh: 有效的广告宣传，迎合了消费者无意识的冲动 — — 这些冲动通常与食物，性和身份地位有关 — — 推动了消费者购买那些对其自身或社会来说都没有多少价值的产品。
en: Effective advertising campaigns, appealing to unconscious urges – typically related to food, sex, and status – create cravings for products and purchases that have little real value for consumers or society.

zh: 政治上也有类似的情形。
en: The same, of course, has happened to politics.

zh: 眼下，美国政治家们都成了一个品牌名称，被包装在诸如谷物早餐等商品上。
en: American politicians are now brand names, packaged like breakfast cereal.

zh: 利用彩带和动人的旋律可以打包卖掉任何人 — — 和任何思想。
en: Anybody – and any idea – can be sold with a bright ribbon and a catchy jingle.

zh: 在美国，要想当权都要借道电视机，而要获得电视台的帮助就要花大钱。
en: All roads to power in America lead through TV, and all access to TV depends on big money.

zh: 这一简单的逻辑使美国的政治史无前例地掌握在了富人的手上。
en: This simple logic has put American politics in the hands of the rich as never before.

zh: 甚至连战争都能最作为新产品在电视上���销。
en: Even war can be rolled out as a new product.

zh: 布什政府利用与电视广告类似的颜色，快节奏和图片风格来推销其攻发动拉克战争的原因 — — 萨达姆侯赛因拥有所谓的大规模杀伤性武器。
en: The Bush administration promoted the premises of the Iraq war – Saddam Hussein’s non-existent weapons of mass destruction –in the familiar colorful, fast-paced, and graphics-heavy style of television advertising.

zh: 然后，战争一开始就以所谓的“震慑与恐惧”的轰炸来袭击巴格达 — — 这是为了确保群众支持美国入侵伊拉克而安排的特写镜头。
en: Then the war itself began with the so-called “shock and awe” bombing of Baghdad – a made-for-TV live spectacle aimed at ensuring high ratings for the US-led invasion.

zh: 许多神经科学家认为，电视节目对精神健康的影响远远不止于导致上瘾，引发消费主义，导致社会信任消失以及政治洗脑。
en: Many neuroscientists believe that the mental-health effects of TV viewing might run even deeper than addiction, consumerism, loss of social trust, and political propaganda.

zh: 或许，电视正在重构沉迷电视者大脑的接收系统，并使他们丧失认知能力。
en: Perhaps TV is rewiring heavy viewers’ brains and impairing their cognitive capacities.

zh: 美国儿科学会最近发出警告说，电视节目有害于少年儿童大脑的发展，并呼吁父母们要让他们的孩子远离电视和类似媒体。
en: The American Academy of Pediatrics recently warned that TV viewing by young children is dangerous for their brain development, and called on parents to keep children under two away from the TV and similar media.

zh: 美国媒体常识组织最近的调查揭示了一个看似矛盾，却很好理解的现象。
en: A recent survey in the US by the organization Common Sense Media reveals a paradox, but one that is perfectly understandable.

zh: 今天，美国贫穷家庭的孩子不但比富裕家庭的孩子多看电视，而且他们的房子里都会放一台电视。
en: Children in poor American households today not only watch more TV than children in wealthy households, but are also more likely to have a television in their room.

zh: 当一种商品的消费随着收入的上升而下降时，经济学家称其为“次优”品。
en: When a commodity’s consumption falls as income rises, economists call it an “inferior” good.

zh: 不可否认，作为信息，教育，娱乐，甚至政治意识的供应商，大众媒体的作用是巨大的。
en: To be sure, the mass media can be useful as a provider of information, education, entertainment, and even political awareness.

zh: 但过度地使用大众媒体则会有害，这要求我们懂得适可而止。
en: But too much of it is confronting us with dangers that we need to avoid.

zh: 至少，我们可以使那些伤害最小化。
en: At the very least, we can minimize those dangers.

zh: 世界上行之有效的方法包括限制电视宣传，特别是对少年儿童；如BBC这样的非商业化，公有电视网络 ； （ 在限定的）电视时间内免费播放政治选举宣传片。
en: Successful approaches around the world include limits on TV advertising, especially to young children; non-commercial, publicly-owned TV networks like the BBC; and free (but limited) TV time for political campaigns.

zh: 当然，最好的防御方法还是靠我们的自我控制。
en: Of course, the best defense is our own self-control.

zh: 每天，我们完全可以少看电视，花更多时间阅读，交流和重建个人健康和社会信任的基础。
en: We can all leave the TV off more hours per day and spend that time reading, talking with each other, and rebuilding the bases of personal health and social trust.

zh: 对一场危机的剖析
en: Anatomy of a Crisis

zh: 伯克利－从我们当前的金融混乱状态脱身首先需要了解我们是怎样陷入其中的。
en: BERKELEY – Getting out of our current financial mess requires understanding how we got into it in the first place.

zh: 根据像约翰·麦凯恩这样的人的观点，最根本的原因是华尔街的贪婪和腐败。
en: The fundamental cause, according to the likes of John McCain, was greed and corruption on Wall Street.

zh: 虽然我不否认这样的基础动力的存在，但是，我还是坚持认为这场危机根源于过去几十年里关键的政策决定。
en: Though not one to deny the existence of such base motives, I would insist that the crisis has its roots in key policy decisions stretching back over decades.

zh: 在美国，有两个关键的决定。
en: In the United States, there were two key decisions.

zh: 第一个是在20世纪70年代解除了对支付给股票经纪人的佣金的管制；第二个是在20世纪90年代废止了《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法》对商业银行和投资银行混业经营的限制。
en: The first, in the 1970’s, deregulated commissions paid to stockbrokers. The second, in the 1990’s, removed the Glass-Steagall Act’s restrictions on mixing commercial and investment banking.

zh: 在固定佣金的时代，投资银行可以通过登记股票交易很舒适的生存下去。
en: In the days of fixed commissions, investment banks could make a comfortable living booking stock trades.

zh: 解除对固定佣金的管制意味着竞争和利润的减少，而《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法》的废止使商业银行可以蚕食投资银行的其他传统业务领域。
en: Deregulation meant competition and thinner margins. Elimination of Glass-Steagall then allowed commercial banks to encroach on the investment banks’ other traditional preserves.

zh: 作为回应，投资银行渗透到像创设和发行复杂的衍生证券这样新的业务领域。
en: In response, investment banks branched into new businesses like originating and distributing complex derivative securities.

zh: 它们借钱然后进行运作以维持其利润率。
en: They borrowed money and put it to work to sustain their profitability.

zh: 这引发了危机产生的第一个原因：证券化的创设和发行模式以及对杠杆的广泛使用。
en: This gave rise to the first causes of the crisis: the originate-and-distribute model of securitization and the extensive use of leverage.

zh: 注意到这些都是基本明智的政策决定的计划之外的后果，是很重要的。
en: It is important to note that these were unintended consequences of basically sensible policy decisions.

zh: 在其他各方面相同的情况下，解除佣金管制使小投资者可以以更低的成本交易股票，这使他们的经济状况变好。
en: Other things being equal, deregulation allowed small investors to trade stocks more cheaply, which made them better off. But other things were not equal.

zh: 但是各方面情况并不相同，特别是，被这些政策变化驱使从事风险更高的活动的投资银行，完全游离在监管网络之外的事实，是引 起灾难的原因。
en: In particular, the fact that investment banks, which were propelled into riskier activities by these policy changes, were entirely outside the regulatory net was a recipe for disaster.

zh: 同样，废止《格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法》从根本上讲是明智的。
en: Similarly, eliminating Glass-Steagall was fundamentally sensible.

zh: 混业经营使金融机构的业务多样化，和商业银行的结合使投资银行可以使用相对稳定的存款而不是变幻无常的货币市场来为其运营提供资金。
en: Conglomerates allow financial institutions to diversify their business, and combining with commercial banks allows investment banks to fund their operations using relatively stable deposits instead of fickle money markets.

zh: 这种模式在欧洲的几个世纪中证明了其生命力，即使是现在，在美国银行购买美林的活动中，其在美国的优势也是很明显的。
en: This model has proven its viability in Europe over a period of centuries, and its advantages are evident in the US even now with Bank of America’s purchase of Merrill Lynch.

zh: 但是，混业经营需要时间。
en: But conglomeratization takes time.

zh: 在短期内，美林和其他投资银行一样，被允许并到其他机构内。
en: In the short run, Merrill, like the other investment banks, was allowed to double up its bets.

zh: 它仍然完全处在监管的范围之外。
en: It remained entirely outside the purview of the regulators.

zh: 作为一个单独的实体，那么，它就易于受到市场波动的影响。
en: As a stand-alone entity, it was then vulnerable to market swings.

zh: 需要一个足以威胁整个金融系统的危机来加速不可避免的混业经营。
en: A crisis sufficient to threaten the entire financial system was required to precipitate the inevitable conglomeratization.

zh: 危机中的另一个因素是引起全球失衡的一系列政策。
en: The other element in the crisis was the set of policies that gave rise to global imbalances.

zh: 布什政府减税，美联储降低利率以回应2001年的衰退都是这样的政策。
en: The Bush administration cut taxes. The Fed cut interest rates in response to the 2001 recession.

zh: 同时，金融创新促使信贷更便宜并可以为更多的人获得。
en: Financial innovation, meanwhile, worked to make credit even cheaper and more widely available.

zh: 当然，这是次级抵押贷款以另一种姿态的出现。
en: This, of course, is just the story of subprime mortgages in another guise.

zh: 这些政策的结果是美国开支的增加和标准家庭储蓄由减少变成了负增长。
en: The result was increased US spending and the descent of measured household savings into negative territory.

zh: 同样重要的是，在1997－1998年金融危机之后中国的崛起和在亚洲投资的下降。
en: Of equal importance were the rise of China and the decline of investment in Asia following the 1997-1998 financial crisis.

zh: 随着中国的储蓄率几乎达到了其国民生产总值的50 ％ ， 所有这些钱必须有一个去向。
en: With China saving nearly 50% of its GNP, all that money had to go somewhere.

zh: 这些钱中有许多进入了美国国库和成为房利美及房地美的债券。
en: Much of it went into US treasuries and the obligations of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

zh: 这对美元构成了支撑并降低了美国家庭的借款成本，鼓励了他们过一种他们的能力无法达到的生活；这也为房地美和房利美的证券创造了一个活跃的市场，滋养了创设和发行的机器。
en: This propped up the dollar and reduced the cost of borrowing for US households, encouraging them to live beyond their means. It also created a more buoyant market for the securities of Freddie and Fannie, feeding the originate-and-distribute machine.

zh: 再一次的，这些都不是完全的政策错误。
en: Again, these were not outright policy mistakes.

zh: 使十亿中国人脱离贫困可能是我们一生的时间里一件最重要的事件。
en: Lifting a billion Chinese out of poverty is arguably the single most important event in our lifetimes.

zh: 事实是，美联储在2001年衰退时的快速反应阻止了衰退的恶化。
en: The fact that the Fed responded quickly prevented the 2001 recession from worsening.

zh: 但是，这产生了计划之外的后果。 当大量的资本流入和宽松的美联储政策结合在一起的时候，美国监管者没能收紧资本和贷款标准，这引燃了一个极度的信贷繁荣。
en: But there were unintended consequences.  The failure of US regulators to tighten capital and lending standards when abundant capital inflows combined with loose Fed policies ignited a furious credit boom.

zh: 中国没能快速采取措施鼓励和其更高的收入相称的更多的 国内开支，为这一繁荣火上浇油。
en: The failure of China to move more quickly to encourage higher domestic spending commensurate with its higher incomes added fuel to the fire.

zh: 现在，臃肿的金融部门正在被迫收缩。
en: Now, a bloated financial sector is being forced to retrench.

zh: 有些结果，像美国银行和美林的联姻，要比其他的结果令人高兴一些，例如雷曼兄弟的破产。
en: Some outcomes, like the marriage of Bank of America and Merrill Lynch, are happier than others, like the bankruptcy of Lehman Brothers.

zh: 但是，不管是哪一种结果，金融部门的规模都会减小。
en: But, either way, there will be downsizing.

zh: 外国中央银行都在经受其考虑不周的投资带来的资金损失。
en: Foreign central banks are suffering capital losses on their unthinking investments.

zh: 当他们接管美国国库和机构证券中他们的损失的时候，流向美国的资本将会减少。
en: As they absorb their losses on US treasury and agency securities, capital flows toward the US will diminish.

zh: 美国经常账户赤字和亚洲国家的盈余都会减少。
en: The US current-account deficit and the Asian surplus will shrink.

zh: 美国家庭将不得不再次开始储蓄。
en: US households will have to start saving again.

zh: 一个异常现象是美元在最近几周的走强。
en: The one anomaly is that the dollar has strengthened in recent weeks.

zh: 随着美国不再被认为是高质量的金融资产的提供者，人们可能会期望美元已经走弱。
en: With the US no longer viewed as a supplier of high-quality financial assets, one would expect the dollar to have weakened.

zh: 美元的走强反映了投资者仓促涌入美国将美国国库作为安全港的下意识反应。
en: The dollar’s strength reflects the knee-jerk reaction of investors rushing into US treasuries as a safe haven.

zh: 值得记住的是，当2007年8月次级抵押贷款危机爆发的时候，发生了同样的事情。
en: It is worth remembering that the same thing happened in August 2007, when the sub-prime crisis erupted.

zh: 但是，一旦投资者认识到美国金融问题的程度，涌入美国国库的资金就会减少，美元就会继续下跌。
en: But once investors realized the extent of US financial problems, the rush into treasuries subsided, and the dollar resumed its decline.

zh: 现在，当投资者回想起美国金融问题的程度时，我们会再次看到美元继续下跌。
en: Now, as investors recall the extent of US financial problems, we will again see the dollar resume its decline.

zh: 强调贪婪和腐败是危机的根源会导致悲观的预测。
en: Emphasizing greed and corruption as causes of the crisis leads to a bleak prognosis.

zh: 我们不会去改变人性。
en: We are not going to change human nature.

zh: 我们不可能让投资者不那么贪婪。
en: We cannot make investors less greedy.

zh: 但是，强调政策决定提供了一个更积极的前景。
en: But an emphasis on policy decisions suggests a more optimistic outlook.

zh: 计划之外的 结果不是总是可以防止的。
en: Unintended consequences cannot always be prevented.

zh: 政策错误不是总是可以避免的。
en: Policy mistakes may not always be avoidable.

zh: 但是，政策错误至少是可以被纠正的。 然而，这首先需要对问题的根本原因有更深刻的认识。
en: But they at least can be corrected.  That, however, requires first looking more deeply into the root causes of the problem.

zh: 对金融危机的剖析
en: Anatomy of a Financial Meltdown

zh: 纽约-美国目前正经历着一个恶性循环，并且可能会影响到全球的经济。
en: NEW YORK – A vicious circle is currently underway in the United States, and its reach could broaden to the global economy.

zh: 美国的经济危机所引发的严重的信贷紧缩加剧了美国经济的衰退，而越来越深重的衰退正在引发金融市场更大规模的损失，从而损害更广层面的经济。
en: America’s financial crisis has triggered a severe credit crunch that is making the US recession worse, while the deepening recession is leading to larger losses in financial markets – thus undermining the wider economy.

zh: 随着巨大的信贷和资产泡沫的破裂，美国金融市场正面临严重的系统性危机的风险。
en: There is now a serious risk of a systemic meltdown in US financial markets as huge credit and asset bubbles collapse.

zh: 现在的问题已经不单单是次级抵押贷款而更像是一场“次级”金融体系的危机。
en: The problem is no longer merely sub-prime mortgages, but rather a “sub-prime” financial system.

zh: 房地产市场的衰退是美国有史以来最严重的一次并且每天都在持续恶化，将最终导致房地产价格下跌超过20 % ， 使数以百万计的美国人失去他们的住所。
en: The housing recession – the worst in US history and worsening every day – will eventually see house prices fall by more than 20%, with millions of Americans losing their homes.

zh: 拖欠债务、违约和取消抵押品赎回权的现象正从次级抵押贷款蔓延到近优和优质抵押贷款上。
en: Delinquencies, defaults, and foreclosures are now spreading from sub-prime to near-prime and prime mortgages.

zh: 与抵押贷款相关的投资工具包括像债务抵押证券（CDOs）这样的外来的信贷衍生产品的损失总计将超过4000亿美元。
en: Thus, total losses on mortgage-related instruments – include exotic credit derivatives such as collateralized debt obligations (CDOs) – will add up to more than $400 billion.

zh: 此外，商业房地产也开始跟随居民房地产出现持续下跌。
en: Moreover, commercial real estate is beginning to follow the downward trend in residential real estate.

zh: 不管怎样，有谁愿意在散落在美国西部那些空旷、被遗废的城市建造办公楼、商店和购物中心呢？
en: After all, who wants to build offices, stores, and shopping centers in the empty ghost towns that litter the American West?

zh: 除开房地产市场的下跌，消费信贷更大的泡沫也正在破裂：随着美国经济滑向衰退，对信用卡、汽车贷款和学生贷款不履行还款义务的现象正在急剧上升。
en: In addition to the downturn in real estate, a broader bubble in consumer credit is now collapsing: as the US economy slips into recession, defaults on credit cards, auto loans, and student loans will increase sharply. US consumers are shopped-out, savings-less, and debt-burdened.

zh: 鉴于个人消费占据美国需求总量70%以上的份额，房地产消费的缩减将进一步加剧这场衰退。
en: With private consumption representing more than 70% of aggregate US demand, cutbacks in household spending will deepen the recession.

zh: 在这些金融风险之中，我们还可以加上债券保险商为许多像债务抵押证券这样有风险的证券化产品提供担保所带来的巨大问题。
en: We can also add to these financial risks the massive problems of bond insurers that guaranteed many of the risky securitization products such as CDOs.

zh: 这些保险商的信用评级极有可能出现的下降将迫使持有这些风险资产的银行和金融机构对它们进行冲销，从而给金融体系已经越积越高的损失中再增加1500亿美元的损失。
en: A very likely downgrade of these insurers’ credit ratings will force banks and financial institutions that hold these risky assets to write them down, adding another $150 billion to the financial system’s mounting losses.

zh: 此外还有银行和其他金融机构在为鲁莽的杠杆收购（LBOs）进行融资的借贷中所遭受的越来越大的损失。
en: Then there is the exposure of banks and other financial institutions to rising losses on loans that financed reckless leveraged buy-outs (LBOs).

zh: 随着衰退的继续恶化，许多背负着过高的债务以及没有足够流动资金的杠杆收购会像利润越来越低或亏损越来越高的公司一样无法偿还它们的贷款。
en: With a worsening recession, many LBOs that were loaded with too much debt and not enough equity will fail as firms with lower profits or higher losses become unable to service their loans.

zh: 在这些情况下，衰退将会导致不履行债务的企业急剧增多，这一数字在过去两年曾经非常低，每年平均为0.6 % ， 而历史平均数为3.8 % 。
en: Given all this, the recession will lead to a sharp increase in corporate defaults, which had been very low over the last two years, averaging 0.6% per year, compared to an historic average of 3.8%.

zh: 在典型的衰退期间，不履行债务的企业的比率可能升高到10-15 % ， 从而使那些持有高风险公司债券的机构面临巨额损失的危险。
en: During a typical recession, the default rate among corporations may rise to 10-15%, threatening massive losses for those holding risky corporate bonds.

zh: 其结果是，信用违约互换（CDS）市场对企业违约的保险进行买卖的市场可能也会遭受巨额损失。
en: As a result, the market for credit default swaps (CDS) ­– where protection against corporate defaults is bought and sold – may also experience massive losses.

zh: 如果出现这样的情况，某些出售这类保险的公司极有可能会破产，从而使购买这些保险的机构面临进一步的损失，因为对方没有能力付款了。
en: In that case, there will also be a serious risk that some firms that sold protection will go bankrupt, triggering further losses for buyers of protection when their counterparties cannot pay.

zh: 除开所有这些情况，非银行金融机构的金融体系也面临着阴影，它们像银行一样，借来短期和流动资金然而借给或者投资在长期和非流动的资产上。
en: On top of all this, there is a shadow financial system of non-bank financial institutions that, like banks, borrow short and liquid and lend to or invest in longer-term and illiquid assets.

zh: 这种面临阴影的体系包括结构性投资工具（SIVs ） 、 管道（以资产支持商业票据为自己筹资 ） 、 货币市场基金、对冲基金和投资银行。
en: This shadow system includes structured investment vehicles (SIVs), conduits, money market funds, hedge funds, and investment banks.

zh: 像银行一样，所有这些金融机构都面临着流动性或资金周转的风险，如果它们的债权人无法周转它们的短期贷款额度，它们就会垮掉。
en: Like banks, all these financial institutions are subject to liquidity or rollover risk – the risk of going belly up if their creditors do not rollover their short-term credit lines.

zh: 但是，与银行不同���它们没有中央银行作为出借方最后的救命稻草为它们提供的安全网。
en: But, unlike banks, they do not have the safety net implied by central banks’ role as lender of last resort.

zh: 在当前衰退不断深化的情况下，美国和全球的股票市场正在开始下跌：在一场典型的美国衰退中，标准普尔500指数会随着公司收入和利润的下滑而平均下跌28 % 。
en: Now that a recession is underway, US and global stock markets are beginning to fall: in a typical US recession, the S&P 500 index falls by an average of 28% as corporate revenues and profits sink.

zh: 股票市场的损失会产生双重效应：它们减少了家庭的财富从而使他们的消费下降；同时它们造成借款投资股票的投资者的损失，从而引发保证金催缴和减价销售资产的风潮。
en: Losses in stock markets have a double effect: they reduce households’ wealth and lead them to spend less; and they cause massive losses to investors who borrowed to invest in stock, thus triggering margin calls and asset fire sales.

zh: 这些很有可能引发许多股权和信贷市场的杠杆投资者将被迫出售非流动市场上的非流动资产的更广泛的风险，从而使资产价格大幅下降到它们的基本价值以下。
en: There is thus a broader risk that many leveraged investors in both equity and credit markets will be forced to sell illiquid assets in illiquid markets, leading to a cascading fall in asset prices to below their fundamental values.

zh: 随之引发的损失将加剧金融危机和经济紧缩。
en: The ensuing losses will aggravate the financial turmoil and economic contraction.

zh: 事实上，如果把金融市场所有这些的损失加起来，总额将达到惊人的10000亿美元。
en: Indeed, adding up all these losses in financial markets, the sum will hit a staggering $1 trillion.

zh: 更严厉的信用评级将进一步阻碍家庭和公司进行借贷、消费、投资和持续经济增长的能力。
en: Tighter credit rationing will then further hamper the ability of households and firms to borrow, spend, invest, and sustain economic growth.

zh: 一场系统性的金融危机会引发美国和全球更明显的衰退的风险已经从理论上的可能性变成了越来越可能出现的情况。
en: The risk that a systemic financial crisis will drive a more pronounced US and global recession has quickly gone from being a theoretical possibility to becoming an increasingly plausible scenario.

zh: 解剖一场被贻误了的革命
en: Anatomy of a Revolution Delayed

zh: 当前发生在伊朗统治者和民众之间的冲突，实际上源自于两种互为矛盾之力的正面碰撞。
en: The ongoing conflict between Iran’s rulers and the Iranian public is the result of a head-on collision between two contradictory forces. In recent years, public attitudes in Iran have become more liberal.

zh: 这些年来，伊朗公众的态度日渐自由化，而与此同时，政府权力却从保守实用主义者处传到了更为好战的伊斯兰原教旨主义者手里。 而从伊朗神职人员之中最重要的团体 （ “ 战斗教士协会 ” ） 处发出的要求废除选举结果的呼吁，则堪称改革派和实用主义保守派集团的最新反击。
en: At the same time, power has shifted from conservative pragmatism toward a much more militant fundamentalism.  The call by the most important group of Iran’s clerics for the election results to be thrown out is but the latest sign of the fight back of both the reformist and pragmatic conservative factions.

zh: 在伊斯兰革命爆发30年后，伊朗人显然已变得更自由化，对宗教的态度也日益开放。
en: Thirty years after the Islamic revolution, Iranians are growing demonstrably less religious and more liberal.

zh: 分别在2000年和2005年进行的两场各涵盖2500名成年伊朗人的现场调查清楚地揭示了这一趋势。
en: Two face-to-face surveys of more than 2,500 Iranian adults, conducted in 2000 and 2005, clearly show the trend.

zh: 仅仅相隔5年 ， “ 非常同意”民主制是最佳政府组织形式的受访者比例就从20%增加到31 % 。
en: The percentage of those who “strongly agree” that democracy is the best form of government increased from 20% to 31%.

zh: 同样地，在关于性别平等的一系列问题上 — — 包括领导人性别，高等教育平等权以及妻子行为守则方面 — — 统计数字也向着好的趋势发展。
en: Similarly, on a number of questions concerning gender equality – including political leadership, equal access to higher education, and wifely obedience – the numbers continued a downward trend.

zh: 当认为爱情是婚姻基础的人的比例从49%增加到69%之时，依赖父母之命来结为夫妻的比例则从41%降至24 % 。
en: Those who considered love as the basis for marriage increased from 49% to 69%, while those who depended on parental approval fell from 41% to 24%.

zh: 在2005年的调查中，认为自己“首先是伊朗人”而不是“首先是穆斯林”的人的比例也比2000年显著增加。
en: In 2005, a much higher percentage than in 2000 defined themselves as “Iranian, above all” rather than “Muslim, above all.”

zh: 事实上，要理解这一趋势可并不难。
en: This trend is not hard to understand.

zh: 因为当全社会都被迫接受某种单一宗教论调的时候，自由主义对伊朗人自然更具吸引力。
en: The imposition of a monolithic religious discourse on society has made liberal values attractive to Iranians.

zh: 但当这一趋势以改革主义的面目在伊朗更广泛的政治生活中被反映出来之时，一场针对好战原教旨主义的运动也在政权权力架构中逐渐凸现出来。
en: But, while this was reflected in reformist trends in the country’s wider political life, a movement toward militant fundamentalism took shape within the regime’s power structure.

zh: 当然，改革派领导人必须为这一改变承担一定的责任。
en: Reform-minded politicians were partly to blame for this change.

zh: 因为他们并没有将专制主义视为实现神权民主制的障碍并反对之，而是试图说服专制主义的代表，最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊，希望他能明白改革的价值所在。
en: Far from opposing absolutist power as an impediment to religious democracy, they tried to persuade the Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, of the value of reform.

zh: 但哈梅内伊显然对改革一点兴趣也没有，他此次肢解改革运动时的所作所为已经很好地证明了这一点。
en: But Khamenei had no interest in reform, as he made plain in dismantling the reform movement.

zh: 由于穆罕默德·哈塔米 — — 这个自认改革主义者的政治家 — — 自1997年起连续当了8年伊朗总统，而哈塔米在任期内的作为，使得哈梅内伊坚信只有扶持一个像现任总统马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪-内贾德这种言听计从的原教旨主义者在位，他作为最高领袖的权威才能得以保全。
en: The presidency of Mohammad Khatami, an avowed reformer, who served eight years, beginning in 1997, convinced the Supreme Leader that his authority would be assured only if the presidency was held by a subservient fundamentalist such as the current president, Mahmoud Ahmadinejad.

zh: 而在这点上哈梅内伊的想法和已故的伊朗国王巴列维如出一辙，后者从1965年起就持续任命忠实追随者阿米尔·阿巴斯·胡韦达为首相，直到1979年王朝被彻底推翻为止。
en: In this, Khamenei was following the lead of the late Shah, who kept Amir Abbas Hoveyda, a loyal retainer, as prime minister from 1965 until the Shah was overthrown in 1979.

zh: 然而最高领袖的政治算计也有个问题，那就是艾哈迈迪-内贾德是个口无遮拦的大嘴巴。
en: The problem with the Supreme Leader’s calculation, however, is that Ahmadinejad is a loose cannon.

zh: 他那套民粹主义夹杂宗教原教旨主义的花言巧语早就疏远了一大批信奉保守实用主义的毛拉及其支持者们。
en: His populist rhetoric and religious fundamentalism have alienated a large section of conservative-pragmatist clerics and their supporters.

zh: 这一派毛拉团体的许多成员尊重私有制，而艾哈迈迪-内贾德那套重新分配财富的言论自然不对他们的胃口。
en: Many members of this group honor the institution of private property, and Ahmadinejad’s talk of redistributing wealth is not to their liking.

zh: 更令他们感到不舒服的则是艾哈迈迪-内贾德深信“遁世的伊玛目 ” ， 也就是“马赫迪 ” （ 救世主）即将降临世上，而传说这意味着世界末日的到来。
en: More disturbing to them is his apocalyptic conviction regarding the imminent advent of the Hidden Imam, the Mahdi, whose appearance is believed to lead to the destruction of the world and the end of time.

zh: 而艾哈迈迪-内贾德一般在演讲之前都会祈祷，祈祷救世主能尽快回归。
en: Generally, Ahmadinejad begins his public speeches with prayers for the Mahdi’s immediate return.

zh: 对于伊斯兰什叶派神权阶层来说，传统上救世主降临都被解释成极久远的未来才会发生的事，而艾哈迈迪-内贾德坚持不懈的救世主降临论简直就是自找麻烦。
en: For the Shia religious hierarchy, long accustomed to relegating the advent of the Mahdi to a distant future, Ahmadinejad’s insistent millenarianism is troublesome.

zh: 毛拉们经常把那些宣称自己跟“遁世的伊玛目”有亲身接触或者借“降临”投机的人 — — 如果这些人不是异教徒的话 — — 定义为非正统教徒。
en: They have often dismissed as unorthodox, if not heretical, any claim of personal contact with the Imam or speculation about his arrival.

zh: 而一些阿亚图拉（高级神职人员）更认为关于救世主的言论对于一位总统来说极不恰当，甚至严重点来说，这个领导人根本不可靠。
en: Several ayatollahs opined that such talk about the Mahdi is unbecoming of a president or, worse, indicative of an unstable leader.

zh: 而这些事实也解释了为什么“战斗教士协会”这样一个保守政治团体会不认可艾哈迈迪-内贾德的总统候选人资格了。
en: These concerns were reflected in the fact that the Society of Combatant Clergy, a conservative body, was unable to endorse Ahmadinejad’s candidacy.

zh: 另一方面，在最高领袖坚持认定艾哈迈迪-内贾德获胜后的第二天，数百万伊朗人对哈梅内伊的公开抗议立刻把整个国家拖入了一场政治危机��中。
en: Defiance of the Supreme Leader by millions of Iranians just a day after he firmly endorsed Ahmadinejad threw the country into a political crisis.

zh: 而在全世界广为播放的殴打屠杀示威者的镜头则令这个政权的宗教公信力大大受损。
en: Worldwide broadcasts of the beating and killing of protesters have undermined the regime’s religious credentials.

zh: 为了在严峻形势下找条出路，最高领袖公开声明选举纠纷不该通过上街抗议来解决，而是必须通过法律途径。
en: Seeking a way out of this difficult situation, the Supreme Leader declared that the electoral disputes must be settled in through legal channels, not on the street.

zh: 考虑到他本人就是选举是否舞弊的裁决者，这一声明似乎更像是缓兵之计，好让他有时间清理街头示威者，在肉体和精神上双重打压反对派领导人，并采取手段孤立米尔·侯赛因·穆萨维这个原本预测要赢得大选的候选人。
en: Given his role in justifying electoral fraud, this argument seems like an effort to buy time to clear the streets of demonstrators, put opposition leaders under severe physical and psychological stress, and isolate Mir Hossein Mousavi, the presumed winner of the real vote.

zh: 而即便如此，哈梅内伊走法律途径的说法却激起了许多虽无意直接挑战其权威，却倾向穆萨维的保守实用主义者的反响。
en: Nonetheless, Khamenei’s invocation of the law echoes the demands of many conservative-pragmatists who lean toward Mousavi, who is not in a position to challenge Khamenei’s authority directly.

zh: 而穆萨维自己则必须小心翼翼地继续其法律行动，更不能把大多数伊朗人赋予的信任给在政治上就这么妥协掉。
en: Mousavi must carefully continue his legal campaign, without compromising the trust he has gained from the majority of Iranians.

zh: 他必须坚持两个原则性要求：一是废除选举结果，二是建立一个中立的委员会去裁决政府违反选举法的行为。
en: He must stand by his two principal demands: nullification of the election and establishment of an impartial committee to rule on the government’s violations of the electoral law.

zh: 如果穆萨维能成功说服哈梅内伊去接受他的立场的话，最高领袖对权力的掌控就会被动摇。
en: Should Mousavi persuade Khamenei to reconsider his position, the Supreme Leader’s hold on power will be shaken.

zh: 如果哈梅内伊迅速攫紧权力，穆斯维就难以到总统之位，但他至少还继续承载着那些与政府意见相左的大多数伊朗人的期望。
en: If Khamenei holds fast, Mousavi cannot gain the presidency, but he will continue to represent the hopes of the majority of Iranians who differ dramatically with their government.

zh: 而眼下事态的演变，则只能取决于穆萨维本人的韧性了。
en: For now, what will happen depends on Mousavi’s perseverance.

zh: 剖析撒切尔主义
en: Anatomy of Thatcherism

zh: 伦敦 — — 三十年前的本月，玛格丽特·撒切尔开始执掌政权，虽然受制于英国本国条件，撒切尔式的革命还是立即成为了一个国际标签。
en: London – Thirty years ago this month, Margaret Thatcher came to power. Although precipitated by local conditions, the Thatcher (or more broadly the Thatcher-Reagan) revolution became an instantly recognizable global brand for a set of ideas that inspired policies to free markets from government interference.

zh: 这套理论的核心思想是以自由市场来代替政府的干预。 三十年后的今天，世界正处于经济萧条之中，一些人把此次全球危机的原因归咎于以上的理论。
en: Three decades later, the world is in a slump, and many people attribute the global crisis to these very ideas.

zh: 实际上，即便不是左派人士也会认为，英美模式的资本主义已经失败了。
en: Indeed, even beyond the political left, the Anglo-American model of capitalism is deemed to have failed.

zh: 此种模式应该对几乎导致金融体系全面崩盘负责。
en: It is held culpable for the near financial meltdown.

zh: 经过三十年的反思，我们应该判断撒切尔式革命中的哪些因素应该保留，而哪些因素应该被调整修改，以便于将来经济的复苏。
en: But 30 years of hindsight enable us to judge which elements of the Thatcher revolution should be preserved, and which should be amended in the light of today’s global economic downturn.

zh: 大多数人认为，相对于政府的过度干预而言，对市场监管的越少就越有利于市场的稳定和活力。
en: Most obviously in need of amendment is the view that minimally managed and regulated markets are both more stable and more dynamic than those subject to extensive government intervention.

zh: 按照亲撒切尔主义者的说法，政府所犯的错误所造成的影响要远超过市场失效所导致的后果。
en: The Thatcherite assumption, in other words, was that government failure is far more menacing to prosperity than market failure.

zh: 历史也会和我们开玩笑。
en: This was always bad history.

zh: 数据显示，在1950年到1973年之间，在这段和平时期，政府对市场经济的干预相当成功，在此期间即没有全球范围的经济萧条，而且全球GDP（人均GDP）的增长率也处于较快的水平。 比此前和此后的历史表现的都要好。
en: The record shows that the period 1950-1973, when government intervention in market economies was at its peacetime height, was uniquely successful economically, with no global recessions and faster rates of GDP growth – and growth of GDP per capita – than in any comparable period before or since.

zh: 有人可能会提出质疑，认为如果当时政府的干预少一些，经济还会表现的更好。
en: One can argue that economic performance would have been even better with less government intervention.

zh: 但是，就象没有完美的政府一样，完美的市场也并不存在。
en: But perfect markets are no more available than perfect governments.

zh: 我们只能在过去不同的时间阶段，来比较不同的政策效果。
en: All we have are comparisons between what happened at different times.

zh: 由此，我们所得出的结论是市场经济加上政府监管要好于市场经济和较少的政府监管。
en: What these comparisons show is that markets plus government have done better than markets minus government.

zh: 然后，在1970年代，撒切尔时代之前的经济正处于危机之中，最明显的症状就是“停滞型膨胀 ” — —通货膨胀和高失业率并行。
en: Nevertheless, by the 1970’s the pre-Thatcher political economy was in crisis. The most notorious symptom of this was the emergence of “stagflation” – simultaneously rising inflation and unemployment.

zh: 看来，运用凯恩斯主义的理论管理下的经济还是出了问题。
en: Something had gone wrong with the system of economic management bequeathed by John Maynard Keynes.

zh: 此外，政府的支出不断增加，工会势力越来越激进。 政府所推出的各项政策开始失灵，企业对利润的预期也开始下调。
en: In addition, government spending was on the rise, labor unions were becoming more militant, policies to control pay kept breaking down, and profit expectations were falling.

zh: 许多人发现政府已经不能有效地实施职能，解决的方法只有两种：要么进一步加强监管，要么是放弃一部分监管的内容。
en: It seemed to many as though government’s reach had come to exceed its grasp, and that either its grasp had to be strengthened or its reach had to be reduced.

zh: 显然，撒切尔主义的出现正是替代国家社会主义的产物。
en: Thatcherism emerged as the most plausible alternative to state socialism.

zh: 尼格尔·劳森是撒切尔时代的第二任财政大臣，或者说是财政部长。
en: Nigel Lawson was Thatcher’s second Chancellor of the Exchequer, or finance minister.

zh: 因此，当时反通涨采取的政策被称为“劳森原理 ” ， 这项在1984年首推的政策一经推出，此后一直被各国政府和央行广泛使用。
en: Out of the government’s anti-inflationary efforts emerged the “Lawson doctrine,” first stated in 1984 and broadly accepted by governments and central banks ever since.

zh: “解决通货膨胀问题”劳森说 ； “ 应该属于是宏观经济政策的范畴。
en: “The conquest of inflation,” Lawson said, “should...be the objective of macroeconomic policy.

zh: 而经济增长和创造就业机会的问题是属于微观经济政策的范围。 ”
en: And the creation of conditions conducive to growth and employment should be...the objective of microeconomic policy.”

zh: 此项提议一举推翻了之前盛行的凯恩斯主义的信条，也就是认为宏观经济政策的目的是保证充分就业，而用薪酬体制来控制通货膨胀。
en: This proposition overturned the previous Keynesian orthodoxy that macroeconomic policy should aim at full employment, with the control of inflation left to wage policy.

zh: 尽管当时的撒切尔政府引入了“供给方面”的改革措施，1980年代的失业率达到达7.4 % ， 仍然高于1950和60年代的1.6 % 。
en: Yet, despite all the “supply side” reforms introduced by Thatcherite governments, unemployment has been much higher since 1980 than in the 1950’s and 1960’s – 7.4% on average in the United Kingdom, compared to 1.6% in the earlier decades.

zh: 控制通胀的目的是什么呢？
en: What about inflation targeting?

zh: 1980年通货膨胀率已经达到了顶点，尽管有来自亚洲的低工资的竞争而产生的通货紧缩的压力，1980年之前1950年到1973年以及随后的1980年到2007年的通货膨胀��都在3%多一点。
en: Here, too, the record since 1980 has been patchy, despite the huge deflationary pressure exerted by low-wage competition from Asia.

zh: — — 看来，控制了通胀并没有防止随后资产泡沫的出现，最终导致经济进入萧条期。
en: Inflation in 1950-1973 and 1980-2007 was about the same – just over 3% – while inflation targeting has failed to prevent a succession of asset bubbles that have brought recessions in their wake.

zh: 撒切尔时期的政策也没有解决当时的主要问题 — — 如何减少政府支出在国民收入中的比例。
en: Nor has Thatcherite policy succeeded in one of its chief aims – to reduce the share of government spending in national income.

zh: 最多只能说当时的政策阻止了政府支出的进一步增加的趋势。
en: The most one can say is that it halted the rise for a time.

zh: 现在政府开支又有所增加,已经高达GDP的10 % ， 财政赤字也创了和平时期的历史新高。
en: Now public spending is on the increase again, and record peacetime deficits of 10% or more of GDP stretch ahead for years.

zh: 在全球范围内的降低监管的风潮中，撒切尔—里根式的革命带来了铜臭味的同时，并没有带来财富的增加 — — 当然除了那些富豪阶层之外。
en: In de-regulating financial markets worldwide, the Thatcher-Reagan revolution brought about the corruption of money, without improving on the previous growth of wealth – except for the very wealthy.

zh: 如果1980年到2007年全球GDP的增长速度能保持1950年到1973年的增长水平，全球人均GDP将会比现在增加20 % — —这还不排除中国的因素,因为中国在过去20年一直保持着较高的增长率。
en: The average world citizen would have been 20% richer had world GDP per capita grown at the same rate between 1980 and 2007 as it did between 1950 and 1973 – and this despite China’s high growth rates in the past 20 years.

zh: 在撒切尔主义推崇的”金钱至上”的观念之下，西方社会整体的道德开始下滑。
en: Furthermore, in unleashing the power of money, the Thatcherites, for all their moralizing, contributed to the moral decay of the West.

zh: 除了上述三个的缺点之外，撒切尔主义也给我们带来了三点好处。
en: Against these formidable minuses are three pluses.

zh: 首先是私有化。
en: The first is privatization.

zh: 就是将绝大多数的国有企业私有化，撒切尔式的革命消除了国家社会主义。
en: By returning most state-owned industries to private ownership, the Thatcher revolution killed off state socialism.

zh: 前共产主义国家也可以得到英国私有化运动的启示，他们可以在转型的过程中借鉴有关的思想和手段来转变过去效率低下的计划经济体制。
en: The British privatization program’s greatest influence was in the former communist states, to which it gave the ideas and techniques needed to dismantle grossly inefficient command economies.

zh: 当然，同样的理念也可以运用在如今时髦的“国有化”银行的进程中。
en: This gain must be preserved in the face of the current clamor to “nationalize” banks.

zh: 撒切尔主义的第二大功劳是削弱了工会的力量。
en: Thatcherism’s second success was to weaken trade unions.

zh: 在1970年代，作为弱势群体代言人的工会势力成为了经济发展的阻力，是社会保守主义的主要支持者。
en: Set up to protect the weak against the strong, labor unions had become, by the 1970’s, enemies of economic progress, a massive force of social conservatism.

zh: 因此，以一种新的经济形式来取代僵化的社会结构未尝不是一种好的选择。
en: It was right to encourage a new economy to grow outside these congealed structures.

zh: 最后，撒切尔主义终结了固定价格和固定工资的强制体系，结束了政府，资方和工会组织之间三方博弈游戏。
en: Finally, Thatcherism put paid to the policy of fixing prices and wages by central diktat or by tripartite “bargains” between governments, employers, and trade unions.

zh: 如果任由这种局面发展下去的话，就会出现法西斯主义和共产主义，最终会摧毁不仅仅是经济，还包括政治和自由。
en: These were the methods of fascism and communism, and they would, in the end, have destroyed not just economic, but political, liberty.

zh: 政治的摇摆性有时候也会过度。
en: Political pendulums often swing too far.

zh: 在重新构建后撒切尔主义经济形态时，我们应该小心谨慎，不能重复过去被验证已经失败的政策。
en: In rebuilding the shattered post-Thatcherite economy, we should be careful not to revive the failed policies of the past. I still find fruitful Keynes’s distinction between the agenda and the non-agenda of politics.

zh: 只要中央政府能够保持一个充分而且稳定的就业环境，凯恩斯的思想，绝大多数的经济生活应该不受干扰，自由发展。
en: As long as central government takes responsibility for maintaining a high and stable level of employment, Keynes thought, most of the rest of economic life can be left free of official interference.

zh: 如何在政府干预和自由市场之间建立一个合适的分界线是我们当前所面临的主要任务。
en: Building a proper division of responsibility between state and market from this insight is today’s main task.

zh: 在秋天坠入深渊？
en: An Autumn Abyss?

zh: 发自柏林 — — 在未来这几个月，几场严重的区域性经济和政治危机将汇集成一个巨大的分水岭，激起一场全球性的剧变。
en: BERLIN – In the coming months, several serious regional economic and political crises could combine into one mega-watershed, fueling an intense global upheaval.

zh: 从今夏的情况看来，一个危机重重的秋天正日益逼近。
en: In the course of the summer, the prospect of a perilous fall has become only more likely.

zh: 在中东地区，战鼓擂得比以往任何时候都要响亮。
en: The drums of war are being banged ever more loudly in the Middle East.

zh: 没有人能预测埃及的逊尼派伊斯兰总统和议会多数派将带领该国走向何方。
en: No one can predict the direction in which Egypt’s Sunni Islamist president and parliamentary majority will lead the country.

zh: 但有一点是明确的：逊尼派伊斯兰主义者正在决定性地改变着该地区的政治面貌。
en: But one thing is clear: the Sunni Islamists are decisively altering the region’s politics.

zh: 这场区域性战略的重新调整并不一定是反西方的，然而一旦以色列或美国对伊朗发起军事进攻，那么后果就必将如此。
en: This regional re-alignment need not be necessarily anti-Western, but it surely will be if Israel and/or the United States attack Iran militarily.

zh: 与此同时，内战和人道主义灾难正蹂躏着叙利亚。
en: Meanwhile, civil war is raging in Syria, accompanied by a humanitarian catastrophe.

zh: 毫无疑问，总统巴沙尔·阿萨德（Bashar al-Assad）的政权必将垮台，却决心顽抗到底。
en: To be sure, President Bashar al-Assad’s regime will not survive, but it is determined to fight until the end.

zh: 不同种族和宗教群体将叙利亚巴尔干化也将是一个可以清晰预见的结果。
en: Syria’s balkanization among the country’s diverse ethnic and religious groups is a clearly predictable result.

zh: 事实上一个类似当年波斯尼亚问题的解决方案必须被考虑在内，而一旦叙利亚政府丧失对其化学武器的控制权，就将马上遭遇土耳其、以色列或者美国的军事干预威胁。
en: Indeed, a Bosnia-type scenario can no longer be excluded, while the prospect of the Syrian government’s loss of control over its chemical weapons poses an immediate threat of military intervention by Turkey, Israel, or the US.

zh: 此外叙利亚内战也已成为各方公开争夺区域霸主地位的战略节点，一方是伊朗，另一方则是沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔、土耳其和美国。
en: Moreover, the Syrian civil war has become a proxy in an openly declared battle for regional hegemony between Iran on one side and Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Turkey, and the US on the other.

zh: 而游走在这个阿拉伯-西方联盟边缘的以色列则在谨慎地观察着事态的发展。
en: Staying on the sidelines of this Arab-Western coalition, Israel is playing its cards close to its chest.

zh: 在伊朗方面，该国已表明叙利亚是不可或缺的盟友，并决心通过一切手段防止政权更迭。
en: Iran, for its part, has proclaimed Syria an indispensable ally, and is determined to prevent regime change there by all available means.

zh: 这是否意味着邻国黎巴嫩的真主党民兵将直接卷入叙利亚内战？
en: Does that mean that Hezbollah’s militias in neighboring Lebanon will now become directly involved in Syria’s civil war?

zh: 这种干预是否会让黎巴嫩上世纪70~80年代的长期内战死灰复燃？
en: Would such intervention revive Lebanon’s own long civil war of the 1970’s and 1980’s?

zh: 一场新的阿拉伯-以色列战争威胁是否会降临中东？
en: Is there a threat of a new Arab-Israeli war hanging over the Middle East?

zh: 同时随着叙利亚国内外的库尔德人越发刚愎自用，人口众多且一直心怀不满的土耳其库尔德人也使该国变得越来越动荡不安。
en: And, as Kurds inside and outside of Syria grow more assertive, Turkey, with its large and long-restive Kurdish population, is also growing restive.

zh: 与此同时，在叙利亚上演的区域斗争正日渐与另一个主要战争源头 — — 伊朗核计划 — — 纠缠在一起。
en: At the same time, the regional struggle currently playing out in Syria is becoming increasingly entangled with the other major source of war sounds: Iran’s nuclear program.

zh: 事实上与叙利亚这场大片类似，以色列和伊朗在该计划上的对峙言论也变得越来越刺耳。
en: Indeed, parallel to the Syrian drama, the rhetoric in the confrontation between Israel and Iran over the program has become dramatically harsher.

zh: 双方都把自己逼进了死胡同。
en: Both sides have maneuvered themselves into a dead-end.

zh: 如果伊朗屈服，并同意一个可持续的外交解决方案，那该政权将会在一个关键国内问题颜面丧尽，进而危及其合法性和生存。
en: If Iran gives in and agrees to a sustainable diplomatic solution, the regime will lose face on a critical domestic issue, jeopardizing its legitimacy and survival.

zh: 在该政权看来，1979年伊斯兰革命斗争得来的成果危在旦夕。
en: From the regime’s point of view, the legacy of the 1979 Islamic revolution is at stake.

zh: 但国际制裁又伤筋动骨，还面临着失去叙利亚的风险。
en: But the international sanctions are hurting, and Iran risks losing Syria.

zh: 一切都表明伊朗政权把对成功的渴求 — — 如今比以往任何时候都更多 — — 都放在了核计划上面。
en: Everything points to the regime’s need for success – now more than ever – concerning its nuclear program.

zh: 以色列政府同样也让自己陷入了国内政策困局之中。
en: Similarly, Israel’s government has backed itself into a domestic policy trap of its own.

zh: 总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡（Binyamin Netanyahu）及国防部长埃胡德·巴拉克（Ehud Barak）无法接受一个拥有核武器的伊朗。
en: Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Ehud Barak cannot accept a nuclear-armed Iran.

zh: 他们不是害怕伊朗对以色列发起核攻击，而是害怕地区核军备竞赛和对以色列不利的戏剧性权力更迭。
en: They do not fear a nuclear attack against Israel, but rather a nuclear arms race in the region and a dramatic shift in power to Israel’s disadvantage.

zh: 从他们的角度看来，以色列必须要么说服美国袭击伊朗及其核设施，要么承担最大限度的风险去动用本国军队。
en: From their point of view, Israel must either convince the US to attack Iran and its nuclear plants or take on the maximum risk of using its own military forces to do so.

zh: 双方都极大减少了自身的选项，从而限制了外交妥协的可能性。
en: Both sides have substantially reduced their options, thereby limiting the possibility of a diplomatic compromise.

zh: 这意味着双方都不再思考自己的行为所带来的后果。
en: And that means that both sides have stopped thinking through the consequences of their actions.

zh: 到处都在谈论“军事选项 ” ， 也就是是空袭。
en: Everywhere there is talk of a “military option,” which means air strikes.

zh: 但当那些鼓吹者谈到有限的“外科手术”时，他们实际上谈论的就是两场战争的开始：一场是由美国和以色列主导的空中战争，另一场则是伊朗及其盟友主导的非对称战争。
en: But, while advocates speak of a limited “surgical operation,” what they are really talking about is the start of two wars: an aerial war, led by the US and Israel, and an asymmetric war, led by Iran and its allies.

zh: 如果这个“军事选项”失败了呢？
en: And what if this “military option” fails?

zh: 如果伊朗成为一个核国家，该地区的民主运动被一股反西方的伊斯兰联合力量一扫而空，该政权随之变得更加强大，那该怎么办？
en: What if Iran becomes a nuclear power, the region’s democratic movements are swept away by a wave of anti-Western Islamic solidarity, and the Iranian regime emerges even stronger?

zh: 伊朗显然也没有好好思考自身所处的位置来��出合乎逻辑的结论。
en: Iran, too, evidently has not thought its position through to its logical conclusion.

zh: 如果要在可预见的未来付出区域孤立和联合国严厉制裁的代价，那么核国家的地位又能带来什么？
en: What does it stand to gain from nuclear status if it comes at the cost of regional isolation and harsh United Nations sanctions for the foreseeable future?

zh: 如果它触发了地区核军备竞赛呢？
en: And what if it triggers a regional nuclear arms race?

zh: 波斯湾仍然是全球加油站，在这里爆发的战争会在一段时间内影响石油出口，导致能源价格飙升，对徘徊在衰退边缘的全球经济造成严重的打击。
en: A war in the Persian Gulf – still the world’s gas station – would affect oil exports for some time, and energy prices would skyrocket, dealing a severe blow to a global economy that is teetering on the brink of recession.

zh: 中国已经处于经济困境，并将和整个东亚一起遭受最严重的打击。
en: China, already in economic trouble, would be hit hardest, along with the whole of East Asia.

zh: 随着美国经济走弱以及总统选举临近，美国的领导能力将会严重收缩。
en: With the US also economically weakened and facing a presidential election, America’s leadership ability would be seriously constricted.

zh: 而衰弱的欧洲能应对石油危机吗？ 由非对称战争引起的区域和全球安全冲击会进一步加剧世界经济的困境，导致出口进一步暴跌。
en: And could a weakened Europe cope with an oil shock at all?  A regional and global security shock caused by asymmetric warfare could add still further to the world economy’s troubles, causing exports to slump even more.

zh: 古罗马人常说 ： “ 想想后果吧！
en: Respice finem!

zh: ” （ Respice finem！ ） 。
en: (“Consider the end”), the Romans used to say.

zh: 世界各国的领导人都需要把这永恒的智慧谨记于心。
en: World leaders need to take this timeless wisdom to heart.

zh: 对欧洲人来说更是如此。
en: And that applies doubly to Europeans.

zh: 如果我们不得不再次遭受一场真正的灾难才能明白欧洲一体化的意义，那将是荒谬的。
en: It would be absurd if we had to suffer a real catastrophe again in order to understand what European integration has always been about.

zh: 北约的新边界
en: NATO’s New Frontier

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 本周一艘驶入西班牙海军基地的美国军舰创造了历史。
en: BRUSSELS – Last week, an American ship sailed into a Spanish naval base, making history.

zh: 美国军舰唐纳德·库克号从弗吉尼亚州诺福克港抵达西班牙大西洋沿岸的新母港罗塔港标志着装备高科技宙斯盾弹道导弹防御系统的美国海军舰艇首次永久驻防欧洲。
en: The arrival of the USS Donald Cook from Norfolk, Virginia, to its new home port in Rota, on Spain’s Atlantic coast, marks the first time that a US Navy ship equipped with the high-tech Aegis ballistic missile-defense system will be permanently based in Europe.

zh: 由1,200名职员及水手组成的美舰唐纳德·库克号将会是北约导弹防御体系中发挥核心作用的四艘美国海军驱逐舰之一。
en: The USS Donald Cook is the first of four US Navy destroyers that, with around 1,200 sailors and personnel, will play a central role in NATO’s missile-defense capability.

zh: 该舰同时还肩负海事安全行动、双边和多边训练演习及参与北约行动部署（包括常设北约海事组织）等多项其他任务。
en: But the ships will carry out many other tasks as well, such as maritime security operations, bilateral and multilateral training exercises, and participation in NATO operations and deployments, including the Standing NATO Maritime Groups.

zh: 美国军舰唐纳德·库克号的抵达标志着北约在欧洲安全及跨大西洋合作领域向前迈进了一步。
en: The arrival of the USS Donald Cook marks a step forward for NATO, for European security, and for transatlantic cooperation.

zh: 库克号的抵达明确无误地显示了美国和欧洲在应对我们这个时代复杂而不可预测的安全挑战中的合作力度。
en: It clearly demonstrates the strength of the bond between America and Europe in dealing with the complex and unpredictable security challenges of our age.

zh: 2010年11月以来美欧合作一直稳步推进，北约在当时召开的里斯本峰会上决定建设导弹防御系统，以保护所有北约欧洲民众、领土和军队。
en: Steady progress has been made since November 2010, when, at its Lisbon summit, NATO decided to develop a missile-defense capability to protect all NATO European populations, territory, and forces.

zh: 2012年4月，北约在芝加哥峰会上公布其阶段性业绩，并被视为在项目执行中具有关键意义的首要步骤。
en: In April 2012, at its summit in Chicago, NATO announced an interim capability as an operationally significant first step.

zh: 预计将在未来几年彻底实现既定的能力目标。
en: Full capability is expected to be attained in the years ahead.

zh: 北约导弹防御系统的目的是在出现真正威胁时保卫欧洲。
en: The purpose of NATO’s missile-defense system is to defend Europe against a real threat.

zh: 世界范围内掌握弹道导弹或正在努力掌握这项技术的国家至少有30个之多。
en: At least 30 countries around the world either have ballistic missiles or are trying to acquire them.

zh: 制造弹道导弹所需要的知识正被越来越多的国家掌握，导弹的射程也越来越远，某些欧洲大西洋以外地区已经能对欧洲城市发动袭击。
en: The know-how needed to build them is spreading, and their range is increasing, with some from outside the Euro-Atlantic region already capable of targeting European cities.

zh: 美国军舰唐纳德·库克号和其他三艘美国驱逐舰配备先进的传感和拦截设备，可以发现并击落以欧洲为目标的弹道导弹。
en: The USS Donald Cook and the three other US destroyers have advanced sensor capabilities and interceptors that can detect and shoot down ballistic missiles directed at Europe.

zh: 未来导弹防御系统的其他重要部件将包括更多雷达、传感设备及拦截设备 — — 以及更多的军舰。
en: In the future, other important components of the missile-defense system will include additional radars, sensors, and interceptors – and more ships.

zh: 目前，多亏美欧采取的分阶段适应性导弹防御策略，北约已经能够仰仗土耳其强大的雷达设备。
en: Already, thanks to the US European Phased Adaptive Approach to missile defense, NATO can rely on a powerful radar based in Turkey.

zh: 罗马尼亚已动工建设陆基拦截系统和雷达阵列。
en: Work has already begun on construction of a land-based interceptor and radar site in Romania.

zh: 波兰也已经宣布建设本国的防空及导弹防御能力。
en: Poland has announced plans to build up its air and missile-defense capabilities.

zh: 荷兰正在为四艘雷达护卫舰加装导弹防御系统，并已将爱国者反导系统贡献出来。
en: The Netherlands is upgrading four radar frigates to make them capable of missile defense, and has offered its Patriot anti-missile systems.

zh: 采取类似举措的还有德国。
en: So has Germany.

zh: 荷兰、德国和美国已经部署在北约东南边境的爱国者导弹有助于捍卫和保护土耳其免遭叙利亚可能的导弹袭击。
en: The Netherlands, Germany, and the US have already deployed Patriot missiles on NATO’s southeastern border to help defend and protect Turkey from possible missile attacks from Syria.

zh: 同时，西班牙允许四艘美国海军驱逐舰驻防不仅对北约导弹防御意义重大，而且能够确保整个地中海区域的安全。
en: And, by hosting the four US Navy destroyers, Spain is making a vital contribution not just to NATO’s missile defense, but also to security throughout the Mediterranean region.

zh: 为把所有这些国家资产联系在一起，北约已经建成并正在扩充一套设在德国拉姆施泰因空军基地的技术先进的指挥控制系统。
en: To link all of these national assets together, NATO has developed, and is expanding, a technologically advanced command-and-control system, based at Ramstein Air Base in Germany.

zh: 该系统已经可以联络卫星、雷达和拦截设备共同防御导弹袭击，而这种能力将在未来几年内变得愈加复杂和灵活。
en: The system already can connect satellites, radars, and interceptors to defend against missile attacks, and that capability will grow more complex and agile in the years ahead.

zh: 这使得北约的地位独一无二：它是能将世界最先进国家最复杂系统整合成有效整体的唯一一个多边组织。
en: This makes NATO unique: it is the only multilateral organization that can combine the most complex systems from the world’s most capable countries to create an effective whole.

zh: 最重要的是，上述部署推进了跨大西洋合作，因为美国军舰所代表的远远不止是军事能力。
en: Above all, this deployment is a step forward for transatlantic cooperation, because the US ships represent more than a military capability.

zh: 每艘军舰都是一本美国致力于保护欧洲安全的八千吨级的备忘录。
en: Each one is an eight-thousand-ton reminder of America’s commitment to security in Europe.

zh: 与此同时，北约的导弹防御显示了欧洲盟国在建设导弹防御能力领域的安全承诺。
en: At the same time, NATO’s missile defense demonstrates European allies’ commitment to security as they develop their capabilities in this area.

zh: 我呼吁所有盟国认真思考能够为保护整个欧洲安全的防御体系做些什么。
en: I encourage all allies to consider how they can contribute further to a system that will defend all of us in Europe.

zh: 导弹防御宣告了一种全新合作形式，一种应对新威胁的新能力。
en: Missile defense heralds a new form of cooperation, with new capabilities against new threats.

zh: 曾几何时我们只能沿边境区域集结坦克，现在却可以建设一套需要众多盟国贡献一系列高科技的复杂陆、海、空防御系统。
en: Where once we lined up tanks along borders, we are now building a complex system that requires a range of high-tech contributions from many allies – on land, at sea, and in the air.

zh: 北约的导弹防御系统体现了二十一世纪跨大西洋的团队合作。
en: NATO’s missile-defense system is what transatlantic teamwork looks like in the twenty-first century.

zh: 南极点的不归路
en: Antarctica’s Point of No Return

zh: 波茨坦 — — 最新卫星观测证实了两台独立计算机的模拟结果，那就是南极西部冰盖已陷入势不可挡的崩溃状态。
en: POTSDAM – Recent satellite observations have confirmed the accuracy of two independent computer simulations that show that the West Antarctic ice sheet has now entered a state of unstoppable collapse.

zh: 地球现已进入气候变化不可逆后果的崭新时代。
en: The planet has entered a new era of irreversible consequences from climate change.

zh: 现在唯一剩下的问题是我们能否阻止类似状况在其他地方出现。
en: The only question now is whether we will do enough to prevent similar developments elsewhere.

zh: 最新研究结果表明世界气候系统的关键部分尽管规模巨大但却极为脆弱，可能受到人类活动难以弥补的破坏。
en: What the latest findings demonstrate is that crucial parts of the world’s climate system, though massive in size, are so fragile that they can be irremediably disrupted by human activity.

zh: 全球气温越高，南极洲其他部分达到类似临界点的风险必然也就越大；事实上，我们现在知道南极东部跟西部冰盖面积相仿、甚至更胜一筹的威尔克斯盆地很有可能也面临着同样的威胁。
en: It is inevitable that the warmer the world gets, the greater the risk that other parts of the Antarctic will reach a similar tipping point; in fact, we now know that the Wilkes Basin in East Antarctica, as big or even bigger than the ice sheet in the West, could be similarly vulnerable.

zh: 我们无法提前数十、数百甚至数千年合理预测某种人类活动的影响。
en: There are not many human activities whose impact can reasonably be predicted decades, centuries, or even millennia in advance.

zh: 核废料的影响仅是其中之一；人类燃烧化石燃料释放温室气体造成海平面上升所导致的全球变暖则是另外一种可能的影响。
en: The fallout from nuclear waste is one; humans’ contribution to global warming through greenhouse-gas emissions from burning fossil fuels, and its impact on rising sea levels, is another.

zh: 事实上，最新发布的政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）报告以一反常态的强硬语气表示，海平面“几乎毫无疑问”将在今后几百甚至上千年继续升高。
en: Indeed, the latest Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) report stated, in uncharacteristically strong terms, that the sea level is “virtually certain” to continue to rise in the coming centuries or millennia.

zh: 此外，人类碳排放量越多，海平面升高的幅度也就越大。
en: Moreover, the greater our emissions, the higher the seas will rise.

zh: 但这并不符合南极洲所出现的最新情况。
en: But the recent revelations about Antarctica are different.

zh: 南极西部冰盖突然“跨过临界点”进入到一种全新状态，而并没有在全球变暖影响下呈现出可以预测的渐进性改变。
en: Rather than reacting to global warming with gradual and predictable patterns of change, the West Antarctic ice sheet has suddenly “tipped” into a new state.

zh: 阿蒙森海冰架下的少量融冰已将其地平线推到了被冰川掩盖的丘陵上，现在正处在一种“下滑”的状态。
en: A relatively small amount of melting beneath the Amundsen Sea’s ice shelf has pushed its grounding line to the top of a sub-glacial hill, from which it is now “rolling down.”

zh: 简言之，只消外部温度的一次剧烈变化就足以启动冰川内部的应激机制，到那时即便人类想要阻止也已经难上加难。
en: Simply put, one thermal kick was enough to initiate an internal dynamic that will now continue under its own momentum, regardless of any action that humans might take to prevent it.

zh: 这种临界点是否是人类活动的结果目前尚不清楚 — — 但在人类开始干预地球能量平衡前长达11,500年的全新世时期却从未出现过类似的改变。
en: It is not completely clear whether humans have caused this tipping – though nothing like it has ever occurred during the 11,500-year Holocene period before humans started interfering with the planet’s energy balance.

zh: 但这还不是重点。
en: But that is not the point.

zh: 重要的是我们必须认识到地球气候系统存在巨型组成部分 — — 比方说南极洲西部三千万亿吨的冰盖 — — 只消关键部位微不足道的升温就可能打破平衡状态。
en: What is important is that we recognize the existence of gigantic parts of the earth’s climate system – such as West Antarctica’s three-quadrillion-ton ice sheet – that can be tipped when a fractional temperature rise occurs in key locations.

zh: 这已经不仅仅是理论上的风险。
en: This risk is no longer merely theoretical.

zh: 观察和计算机模拟演算首次得出了一模一样的结论：南极洲西部巨大的阿蒙森海冰盖已经开始不可逆转的融化，此后的任何因素都无法阻止整个盆地逐渐融化成水。
en: For the first time, findings based on observations and computer simulations all point to the same conclusion: the huge Amundsen Sea sector of West Antarctica has begun an irreversible ice discharge, and nothing can now halt the subsequent drainage of the entire basin.

zh: 南极洲西部冰盖已经踏上了不归路。
en: It has passed the point of no return.

zh: 因此我们现在必须关注其他地方相似的地形条件。
en: That is why we must now focus on similar topographic conditions elsewhere.

zh: 如果威尔克斯盆地沿岸附近的“冰塞”融化或者断成冰山，那么盆地巨大的储水量终将流入大海。
en: If an “ice plug” near the coast of Wilkes Basin melts or breaks off into icebergs, the basin’s huge quantities of water will drain into the ocean.

zh: 虽然没有人知道什么会破坏威尔克斯盆地的稳定，但我们可以肯定温室气体排放造成的进一步全球变暖会加大这样的风险。
en: Although no one knows precisely what might destabilize the Wilkes Basin, we can be fairly certain that further global warming, caused by greenhouse-gas emissions, will increase the risk.

zh: 海平面将会继续升高的事实已经很清楚了。
en: The fact that sea levels will continue to rise is now clear.

zh: 但我们仍可以通过控制我们造成的全球变暖来决定海平面以何种幅度和速度升高。
en: But we can still determine how high and how fast levels rise by controlling the degree of global warming that we cause.

zh: 气候变化是人类造成的，所以好消息是人类可以通过减少温室气体排放来遏制气候改变。
en: Climate change is caused by mankind, so the good news is that mankind can stop it by cutting greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 虽然南极洲西部冰盖注定已难逃厄运，但我们仍可以保护南极洲东部的海洋冰盖。
en: Although West Antarctica’s fate is sealed, we may still be able to prevent the collapse of East Antarctica’s marine ice sheet.

zh: 这意味着我们必须趁早决定采取何种对策。
en: That means deciding – sooner rather than later – which path to follow.

zh: 目前的对策可能进一步威胁南极冰盖的稳定；让地球走上新能源之路是我们最好、也是最后的希望。
en: The current path risks further destabilization in Antarctica; choosing the alternative path of a new energy system for the planet is our last best hope.

zh: 重振乌克兰经济
en: Reviving Ukraine’s Economy

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 乌克兰突然之间就走到了民主的突破口上。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Ukraine has suddenly arrived at a democratic breakthrough.

zh: 在前总统维克多·亚努科维奇（Viktor Yanukovich）发动大规模流血事件之后，他旗下的许多议员纷纷倒戈转投反对派，形成了另一个多数派。
en: After former President Viktor Yanukovych incited major bloodshed, many of his MPs defected to the opposition, creating a large majority.

zh: 未来无论是哪个新政府上台，为了巩固其政权，他们都必须迅速果断行动起来 — — 并接受一定程度的国际援助 — — 重整该国遭危机蹂躏的经济。
en: In order to consolidate its authority, whatever new government emerges will need to act fast and resolutely – and receive considerable international support – to overhaul the country’s crisis-ridden economy.

zh: 乌克兰面临着三大经济问题。
en: Ukraine suffers from three large economic problems.

zh: 首先，该国已经无力支付其的对外帐款。
en: First, its foreign payments are unsustainable.

zh: 去年乌克兰的经常帐户赤字约为GDP的8.3 % ， 导致其外汇储备不断减少，仅能维持两个月的进口所需。
en: Its current-account deficit last year was an estimated 8.3% of GDP, and its foreign-currency reserves are quickly being depleted, covering just over two months of imports.

zh: 其次，公共财政也无以为继，国家财政赤字高达GDP的8%而且政府债券利率高涨。
en: Second, public finances are also unsustainable, with the budget deficit reaching almost 8% of GDP and government-bond yields skyrocketing.

zh: 第三，该国经济自2012年年中以来已经连续五个季度出现衰退了。
en: Third, the economy has been in recession for five quarters since mid-2012.

zh: 这些问题正是亚努科维奇经济政策的恶果，而这些政策只有一个目的：为总统本人及其家人亲信捞钱。
en: These problems reflect Yanukovych’s economic policy, which had one aim: enriching him, his family, and a few of his cronies.

zh: 在过去四年中，乌克兰领导人挪用了前所未有的巨额款项，估计让亚努科维奇家族聚敛了120亿美元的财富。
en: During the last four years, Ukraine has experienced unprecedented embezzlement by its rulers, with estimates putting the Yanukovych family’s wealth at $12 billion.

zh: 而新政府如果想填补其中一些窟窿的话就需要国际上伸出援手。
en: Here, too, the new government will need international assistance if it is to recover at least some of this loot.

zh: 随着亚努科维奇下台，执政者对乌克兰企业的敲诈勒索应该从此告一段落，让经济得以复苏。
en: With Yanukovych out of the way, official extortion of Ukrainian business should end, enabling the economy to recover.

zh: 事实上，由于总统的亲信遭到了示威的冲击，乌克兰经济其实在2013年第四季度实现了3.3%的增长。
en: In fact, Ukraine’s GDP actually grew by 3.3% in the last quarter of 2013, because his cronyism was stifled by the protests.

zh: 但依然有很多事情可以也必须迅速着手行动起来，因为乌克兰的国库正在不断枯竭。
en: Yet much can and must be done very quickly, because Ukraine is running out of money.

zh: 首先，新的乌克兰议会多数派需要委任一个新政府，并因此启动一个全新的经济政策议程。
en: For starters, the new parliamentary majority needs to appoint a new government, so that a fresh economic-policy agenda can be launched.

zh: 同时还须任命一个新的央行行长，他的首要任务就是让汇率自由浮动。
en: A new central bank governor also should be named, with the first order of business being to float the exchange rate.

zh: 此举将导致乌克兰货币格里夫纳（hryvnia）贬值约10 % ， 因此遏制住近期的汇率下跌趋势，消除经常帐户赤字，并且削减乌克兰极高的利率，以此刺激投资。
en: This would lead to a substantial devaluation of perhaps 10%, thereby ending the current run on the hryvnia, eliminating the current-account deficit, and enabling a reduction in Ukraine’s extremely high interest rates, which would stimulate investment.

zh: 一旦新政府成立，国际货币基金组织（IMF）应当立刻派代表团前往乌克兰。
en: As soon as a government has been appointed, the International Monetary Fund should send a mission to Ukraine.

zh: 在两星期的时间内，该代表团会与新政府共同出台一个新的金融稳定政策。
en: Within two weeks, the IMF mission could conclude a new financial stabilization program with the new administration.

zh: 如果能加急处理的话IMF应该可以在3月底拨出第一笔大型款项。
en: The IMF works fast and could make a first large disbursement in late March.

zh: IMF可以向乌克兰借出100~120亿美元用于一年的稳定计划，而欧盟则可从其国际收支机构中拨出30~50亿美元与IMF共同建立后备计划。
