en: The IMF could lend Ukraine $10-12 billion for a one-year stabilization program, with the European Union using $3-5 billion from its balance-of-payments facility to co-finance an IMF standby program.

zh: 光是这两大资金来源就可以支付乌克兰代理财政部长尤里·柯罗波夫（Yuriy Kolobov）所提出的未来两年所需350亿美元外部融资金额中的绝大部分。
en: These two sources alone could cover much of the $35 billion in external financing that Yuriy Kolobov, Ukraine’s acting finance minister, has said the country could need over the next two years.

zh: 此外，IMF的贷款要比原本亚努克维奇政府依赖（而且不太可能继续获得）的俄罗斯政府贷款利率更低，到期日也更长。
en: Moreover, IMF loans carry a lower interest rate and a longer maturity than the Russian loans on which the Yanukovych government relied (and which are unlikely to continue).

zh: 而IMF为贷款附加的条件将有助于乌克兰清除亚努克维奇的腐败政策。
en: The conditions that the IMF places on its loans can help Ukraine undo Yanukovych’s venal policies.

zh: 首先，乌克兰必须大幅削减其财政赤字，同时考虑到其庞大的税收收入，可以与支出削减和冻结结合起来实施。
en: First and foremost, Ukraine will have to reduce its budget deficit sharply, which, given large tax revenues, should be accomplished through expenditure cuts and freezes.

zh: 那些毫无作用而且只是肥了亚努克维奇支持者钱包的大规模的行业补贴 — — 例如对煤炭工业 — — 必须立刻取消。
en: Large industrial subsidies – for example, to the coal industry – amount to nothing but giveaways to Yanukovych’s supporters and should be eliminated immediately.

zh: 同样，必须放开天然气价格以防止监管机构继续从中渔利。
en: Likewise, gas prices should be liberalized to stop corrupt enrichment from regulatory arbitrage.

zh: 应该得到援助的是那些贫穷的消费者，而不是脑满肠肥的生产商。
en: Needy consumers, not wealthy producers, should receive assistance.

zh: 同样，国际货币基金组织将要坚持让乌克兰政府重新启动竞争性投标程序。
en: Similarly, the IMF will insist on the reintroduction of competitive tenders.

zh: 自2010年以来，有序的公共采购已经停止，亚努科维奇直接向朋友和同事发放两倍于市场价格的政府合同。
en: Since 2010, orderly public procurement has ceased, with Yanukovych simply doling out state contracts to friends and acolytes at twice the market price.

zh: 当然，面向支持者的变卖国有企业行为 — — 通常以最低的价格 — — 也必须结束。
en: Naturally, sales of state enterprises to loyalists – typically at rock-bottom prices – must end as well.

zh: 腐败的另一个来源就是最高税务官员收受佣金为出口商进行出口增值税退税。
en: Another source of corruption has been refunds of value-added tax for exporters, for which top tax officials charge a commission.

zh: 阻止这种行为能刺激出口。
en: Putting a stop to this would stimulate exports.

zh: 此外，乌克兰应该为小型企业重新引入被亚努科维奇取消了的简化税法。
en: In addition, Ukraine should reintroduce the simplified tax code for small businesses that Yanukovych abolished.

zh: 二百万个小企业因为这一变故而倒闭；如能废除这种收费高昂的税收程序，许多小企业都有望重新起步。
en: Two million small enterprises were wiped out by that change; many of them could be revived if tax procedures were no longer prohibitive.

zh: 乌克兰也需要与欧盟合作。
en: Ukraine also needs to work with the EU.

zh: 一周之内，新政府就能满足欧盟签署长期联系协议的条件，而这件事应该会列入3月的欧盟乌克兰峰会议程。
en: Within a week, the new government can fulfill the EU’s conditions for signing the long-concluded Association Agreement, and doing so should be on the agenda at the EU-Ukraine summit in March.

zh: 议会已经安排举行新一轮大选，前总理尤利娅·季莫申科（Yuliya Tymoshenko）已经从监狱中释放出来。
en: Parliament has already scheduled new elections, and former Prime Minister Yuliya Tymoshenko has been released from prison.

zh: 欧盟剩下的最后一个条件 — — 改革检察官办公室的相关立法 — — 将很快实现。
en: The only remaining EU condition – legislation reforming the prosecutor’s office – can be adopted quickly.

zh: 欧盟与乌克兰联系协定将大大有利于乌克兰。
en: The EU-Ukraine Association Agreement will greatly benefit Ukraine.

zh: 它相当于乌克兰国家机器的全面改革计划，包括其执法机构。
en: It amounts to a comprehensive reform program for the Ukrainian state apparatus, including its law-enforcement bodies.

zh: 各欧盟国家六十个国家机构已经与乌克兰的同僚们就必要的改革达成了协议。
en: Sixty state agencies in various EU countries have already concluded agreements with their Ukrainian counterparts concerning the necessary reforms.

zh: 该协议还包含了深入而全面的自由贸易区，这将向乌克兰出口商打开广阔的欧洲市场 — — 从而为乌克兰吸引更多的外国直接投资。
en: The agreement also contains a Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area, which will open the vast European market to Ukrainian exporters – and thus attract more foreign direct investment to Ukraine.

zh: 这也将有助于保护该国免受俄罗斯可能进行的贸易制裁。
en: This will also help to safeguard the country against possible Russian trade sanctions.

zh: 在这里，外交政策也将发挥重要的作用。
en: Here, diplomacy will play an important role as well.

zh: 美国和欧盟需要说服俄罗斯总统弗拉迪米尔·普京（Vladimir Putin）去和新任乌克兰领导人达成谅解，而不是通过威胁对其进行制裁。
en: The United States and the EU need to persuade Russian President Vladimir Putin to reach an understanding with Ukraine’s new leaders, rather than follow through on his threat to impose sanctions.

zh: 只有和平共处，不制造双边紧张关系，才能实现两个国家利益最大化。
en: Peaceful co-existence, not mounting bilateral tension, is in both countries’ best interest.

zh: 自由流淌的尼罗河
en: And Free Flows the Nile

zh: 新德里 — — 18天来，随着抗议活动的起起落落，没人能够想到埃及革命的结尾会来得如此突然，不过是一则不到半分钟的简短公告。
en: NEW DELHI – For 18 days, during the ebb and flow of protest, it did not seem possible that the end of the Egyptian Revolution would come so suddenly, in a terse announcement that lasted no more than a half-minute: “President Hosni Mubarak has relinquished office….”

zh: “胡斯尼·穆巴拉克总统已辞去总统职务 … ” 话音甫落，随着震耳欲聋的胜利的欢呼，一个时代落下了帷幕，这正应验了一句老话“全世界的墓地里都埋葬着自以为对国家不可缺少的角色。 ”
en: With that, amidst roars of victory, an era was ended, reaffirming the old saying that “the graveyards of the world are full of those who considered themselves indispensable to their nations.”

zh: 今后从开罗传来的消息也许并不鼓舞人心，但我们永远不要忘记埃及已经迈出重要的一步，这一步对全体阿拉伯人都具有重要的现实意义。
en: In the days and weeks ahead, there could arise occasions when the news from Cairo is not uplifting, but let us never forget that Egypt has taken a giant step, which in reality is a giant step for all Arabs.

zh: 毕竟，埃及是阿拉伯世界的心脏、大脑和神经中枢。
en: After all, Egypt is the heart, brain, and nerve center of the Arab world.

zh: 没错，埃及曾经催生了激进的穆斯林兄弟会，但它也同样是伊斯兰社会主义和反殖民主义、阿拉伯团结的发源地，而今又以民主的方式肯定了人民的意志。
en: True, it once spawned the radical Muslim Brotherhood, but it also gave birth to Islamic socialism and anti-colonialism, Arab unity, and now a democratic affirmation of the people’s will.

zh: 阿拉伯人不需要民主的弥天大谎已经被彻底揭露。
en: Pernicious talk that Arabs do not want democracy has been exposed as the big lie it is.

zh: 在伟大的孟加拉诗人泰戈尔流芳百世的诗句中，埃及（如今）是“昂首挺胸、无所畏惧 … ” 的土地。 此次革命影响之深远毋庸置疑。
en: Egypt, in the great Bengali poet Rabindranath Tagore’s memorable words, is the land “where the head is (now) held high and the mind is (now) without fear…” The consequences will be vast.

zh: 古老的阿拉伯土地欢欣鼓舞。
en: Ancient Arab lands are bestirred.

zh: 执政数十年，看似不可动摇的独裁政权发现统治已经不再稳固，变革正在不知不觉中悄然发生。
en: Decades-old, apparently immovable autocracies are finding their hold on power unhinged; change is invading their static environs.

zh: 过去与美以等国签订的条约已经不再像以往那样是保证国家政策的工具。
en: Yesterday’s treaties, particularly those with the United States and Israel, will no longer inspire the same type of confidence they have long had as instruments of state policy.

zh: 过去18天的记忆如此密集，以致于难以区分不同的事件和阶段： 惊喜、感动、离奇、梦幻和平凡交织在一起。
en: Memory of these 18 days is so crowded that it is difficult to separate one event from another, one phase from the next: the dramatic, the moving, the bizarre, and the unreal from the bathetic.

zh: 可是对“变革”的向往是联接这一切的线索和一以贯之的主题 — — 这种变革不是虚无的承诺或诱人却又可望不可及的海市蜃楼，而是近在眼前的现实事件。
en: But the thread that united all, the theme that remained unerringly constant, was the yearning for “change” – immediate, real, and tangible, not a promise or a tantalizing, unreachable mirage.

zh: 这种向往能否超越尼罗河，就像它从突尼斯来到开罗？
en: Will this yearning travel beyond the Nile, as it did from Tunis to Cairo?

zh: 这一问题不断困扰着其他阿拉伯政权。
en: This question haunts other Arab portals of power.

zh: 而且除阿拉伯以外，世界各国都忙碌而茫然地修订和改写自己的外交政策。
en: And not just Arab; globally, foreign policies are being hurriedly – and somewhat confusedly – revised and rewritten.

zh: 美国的政策也因此令人难堪地摇摆不定，从国务卿希拉里·克林顿的“切勿操之过急，否则民主运动可能被人利用”到巴拉克·奥巴马总统的有力呼吁“立即改革 ” 。
en: This is why US policy oscillated so disconcertingly from Secretary of State Hillary Clinton’s “Do not rush the pace or else the pro-democracy movement could well be hijacked” to President Barack Obama’s emphatic call for “change now.”

zh: 当然，关于目前政治的埃及最高军事委员会最高统帅部的严肃问题是： 现状的捍卫者怎能促动改革？
en: Of course, a grave question arises about the now-ruling Supreme Council of the Military High Command in Egypt: How can the enforcers of the status quo become the agents of change?

zh: 但军事统治不过是权宜之计，至少我们是这样认为的。
en: But, then, military rule is only a temporary measure, or so we reason.

zh: 伟大的突尼斯诗人阿布·卡西姆·阿尔·沙比深刻地领略了埃及传奇的涵义 ： “ 如果有一天人们想要真正的生活，就会带来命中注定的劫数…黑夜会消弭于无形，枷锁会被打碎 … ” 。 这就是埃及年轻人的作为。
en: The great Tunisian poet Abul-Qasim Al Shabi has captured poignantly the spirit of Egypt’s saga: “If one day the people want life, then fate will arise…night fade away, chains broken…” That, in essence, is what the young in Egypt have done.

zh: 他们的语言正在流行，今天的电子媒体是他们的改革工具。
en: Their idiom is current; their instruments of change are today’s electronic media.

zh: 他们 — — 还有我们 — — 与穆巴拉克、或伟大的纳赛尔熟悉和理解的世界已经拉开了距离。
en: They – and we – are very far from the world that Mubarak, or the great Gamal Abdel Nasser, knew and understood.

zh: 埃及革命正面对着所有成功革命必需面对的任务： 如何描绘未来的蓝图。
en: The Egyptian revolution now faces the exacting task that confronts all successful revolutions: how to define the future.

zh: 就像1922年奥斯曼帝国分裂或1952年纳赛尔推翻国王法鲁克政权一样，目前的变革也同样需要孕育。
en: Like the Ottoman Empire’s fragmentation in 1922 or Nasser’s overthrow of King Farouk’s regime in 1952, the current transformation, too, must be shaped.

zh: 而孕育未来的过程会决定穆巴拉克的终结是否标志着中东地区政治改革的开始。
en: And how that future is shaped will determine whether or not Mubarak’s end marks the beginning of political transformation throughout the Middle East.

zh: 正是这样的机遇吸引了从华盛顿到北京等各国政府的注意力。
en: That is the possibility that is shaking governments from Washington to Beijing.

zh: 未来存疑的不只是苏伊士运河和石油出口，数十年来一成不变的战略确定性现在需要重新审视。
en: It is not just the reliability of the Suez Canal and oil exports that are now in doubt; decades of fixed strategic certainties must now be reexamined.

zh: 比如以色列，这个国家以1979年1月后从未有过的忧虑密切关注着开罗的事态，1979年1月，阿亚图拉鲁霍拉·霍梅尼将伊朗国王赶下台。
en: Consider Israel, which has watched the events in Cairo with a degree of worry unfelt since January 1979, when Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini unseated the Shah of Iran.

zh: 这场战略噩梦令以色列和美国失去了中东地区最亲密的盟友，这位曾经的盟友迅速转化为不共戴天的仇敌。
en: That strategic nightmare cost Israel and the US their closest ally in the region, one that was soon transformed into an implacable enemy.

zh: 以色列最近的两次战争 — — 2006年袭击黎巴嫩真主党和2009年袭击加沙哈��斯 — — 无一例外地针对由伊朗资助、装备和训练的团体。
en: Israel’s two most recent wars – against Hezbollah in Lebanon in 2006, and against Hamas in Gaza in 2009 – were fought against groups sponsored, supplied, and trained by Iran.

zh: 显而易见，以色列对埃及事态的关注将使以巴和谈陷入停滞。
en: Clearly, Israeli-Palestinian negotiations will also now lie unattended as Israel concentrates on developments in Egypt.

zh: 以色列肯定首先怀疑与埃及的和平协议能否持续下去，如果不能，它应当如何调整自己的防卫部署。
en: Above all, Israel must wonder if the peace treaty with Egypt will hold, and, if not, how to carry out the massive restructuring of its defense posture that will be required.

zh: 不过撼动美国政策根本的并不只有以色列的命运。
en: But it is not only the fate of Israel that has now shocked US policy, in particular, to its core.

zh: 毕竟三十年来，埃及一直是美国平衡中东 — — 以及伊斯兰世界的基石。
en: Egypt, after all, has been the cornerstone of America’s balancing act in the Middle East – and the Islamic world – for three decades.

zh: 埃以和平协议巩固了埃及的中立地位，美国也因此得以将战略资源投向别处。
en: The Egypt-Israel peace treaty has kept Egypt comfortably neutralized, freeing the US to commit its strategic resources elsewhere.

zh: 反过来，埃及在巨额美国援助的支持下避免中东陷入更大的灾难，尽管在此期间以巴冲突的火焰一直无法熄灭。
en: In turn, Egypt, propped up by massive US aid, has secured the region from a larger conflagration, even though the Israel-Palestine conflict has continued to smolder.

zh: 美国两难处境的核心正在于此：它希望埃及基本的国家机器继续存在，确保权力不会落入敌对份子手里。
en: Herein lies the core of the dilemma for the US: it wants Egypt’s basic state apparatus to survive, so that the levers of power do not fall into the wrong hands.

zh: 这就需要美国看似站在公众改革要求的一边，同时又要避免显露出政治立场的顽固。
en: This requires the US to be seen as siding with the public’s demand for change, yet to avoid being identified with political immobility.

zh: 奥巴马的反应显然能够打消某些疑虑。
en: There is reason to feel reassured by Obama’s reactions.

zh: 他将穆巴拉克下台称为“人类尊严力量的展露 ” ， 并说“埃及民众已经面对世界说出了自己的愿望，埃及将不再是以前那个埃及。 ”
en: He termed Mubarak’s departure a display of “the power of human dignity,” adding that “the people of Egypt have spoken, their voices have been heard, and Egypt will never be the same.”

zh: 但奥巴马或其他人的言辞都无法解答美国高官所关注的问题：埃及人民政权的到来是否不可避免会带来反美主义？
en: But nothing that Obama, or anyone else, says can answer the question now occupying the attention of senior US officials: Will the coming of popular sovereignty to Egypt inevitably lead to anti-Americanism?

zh: 原地踏步
en: Running in Place

zh: 圣地亚哥—一位拥有哈佛学位的亿万富翁竞选智利总统，承诺加强提高生产率和竞争力的改革，并在大选中胜出。
en: SANTIAGO – A billionaire with a Harvard degree runs for President of Chile promising reforms to enhance productivity and competitiveness, and wins.

zh: 2010年开始执政后，智利经济迅速从全球金融危机中复苏，就业机会被创造出来，并一直增长的最近。
en: Once he takes office in 2010, the economy recovers quickly from the global financial crisis, creates jobs, and continues growing until recently.

zh: 这位亿万富翁也从来不羞于在公众面前标榜自己的成就。
en: The billionaire, never one to shy from publicity, claims the credit.

zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·皮涅拉（Sebastián Piñera）指出，智利是成功市场改革的例子。 他将于3月11日卸任总统。
en: Chile is a case of successful pro-market reform, argues Sebastián Piñera, who stepped down from the presidency on March 11.

zh: 他说错了。
en: He is wrong.

zh: 智利经济有所扩张，每一个立场正确的人都不会不为此感到欣慰；但这一增长和这位前总统的政策基本无关。
en: The Chilean economy has expanded, and no one with his or her heart in the right place can fail to celebrate that; but this growth has little to do with the former president’s policies.

zh: 更糟糕的是，经济扩张被证明是不可持续的，智利人将很快感受到皮涅拉没能兑现其促增长承诺的后果。
en: Even worse, the expansion is proving to be unsustainable, and Chileans will soon feel the consequences of Piñera’s failure to carry out the pro-growth reforms he once promised.

zh: 2008—2009年金融危机期间，智利遭到重创：外国贷款蒸发殆尽，主要出口品铜价格暴跌。
en: Chile was hit hard by the 2008-2009 financial crisis: foreign loans vanished and the price of copper, Chile’s main export, collapsed.

zh: 但这一回，智利经济的状况足以抵御大规模外部冲击。
en: But this time around, the Chilean economy was in shape to withstand massive external shocks.

zh: 政府一直有盈余，公债水平可以忽略不计，银行监管也很出色。
en: The government had been running surpluses, public debt was almost nil, and banks were well regulated.

zh: 因此，米歇尔·巴切莱特总统（Michelle Bachelet，2006—2010年在任，并且刚刚宣誓第二次出任总统）能够采取强力反危机财政刺激，用此前铜繁荣期储存下来的资源提供融资。
en: As a result, the government of President Michelle Bachelet (who was in office from 2006 to 2010 and has just been sworn in for a second term) was able to launch a potent anti-crisis fiscal stimulus, financed with resources saved from the earlier copper boom.

zh: 摆脱了政治压力、由广受尊敬的专业人士主导的中央银行也出手干预，大幅降低利率。
en: The central bank, autonomous from political pressures and run by highly respected professionals, did its part by slashing interest rates.

zh: 在欧洲，衰退已经持续了六年并还在继续；在智利，衰退只维持了十个月。
en: In Europe, the recession has lasted six years and counting; in Chile, it lasted ten months.

zh: 严格的监管和创纪录的低利率让企业和家庭并未积累债务，因此也不需要去杠杆。
en: Tough regulation and record-low interest rates left companies and households with no debt overhang and little need to deleverage.

zh: 2009今年底，智利经济开始再度增长，此后几年以来，增长受极为有利的外部环境推动。
en: By late 2009, the Chilean economy was growing again, and in the years since, growth has been helped by highly propitious external conditions.

zh: 智利希望从外部得到高企的商品价格、极低的美元利率和充足的国际流动性；而自2010年以来，这些都得到了满足。
en: Sky-high commodity prices, rock-bottom dollar interest rates, and ample international liquidity are what Chile hopes for in the rest of the world; they are also precisely what Chile got since 2010.

zh: 毫不奇怪，智利增长十分迅速，直到去年年底美联储开始逐渐退出量化宽松并且世界商品价格下跌导致经济活动迅速减速。
en: Unsurprisingly, growth was swift – until late last year, when the combination of the US Federal Reserve’s gradual exit from quantitative easing and lower commodity prices worldwide caused a swift deceleration in economic activity.

zh: 在经历了GDP年增长率平均高达5%以上的过去四年后，2014年智利经济增长率预计将下降至3.7%或以下。
en: After recording annual GDP growth of more than 5% on average during the last four years, Chile’s economy is expected to grow by 3.7% or less in 2014.

zh: 皮涅拉因此指责即将上任的巴切莱特政府及其增税计划是增长率下降的罪魁。
en: Piñera blamed the incoming Bachelet administration, and its plan to raise taxes, for the drop in the growth rate.

zh: 果真如此的话，巴切莱特的经济学家影响力可真是太大了，因为所有拉丁美洲国家和全世界新兴国家都经历了类似的减速。
en: If so, Bachelet’s economists are very influential indeed, because a similar slowdown has occurred all over Latin America and in emerging countries worldwide.

zh: 智利减速的直接原因是投资下降，特别是矿业投资下降；但根本问题在于没有充分实现经济的多样化，这导致了很难弄清哪种新投资以及哪种新出口可以顶上来。
en: The immediate cause of Chile’s slowdown is the decline in investment, particularly in mining; but the underlying problem is that the failure to diversify the economy sufficiently makes it far from clear what new kinds of investment, and which new exports, will take up the slack.

zh: 泰国、马来西亚、墨西哥和爱尔兰等多样化国家的出口篮子较一代人之前有了彻底的变化。
en: The export basket of economically diversified countries like Thailand, Malaysia, Mexico, and Ireland is entirely different from what it was a generation ago.

zh: 相反，智利的出口篮子一成不变。
en: By contrast, Chile’s export basket has remained unchanged.

zh: 1984年，智利出口铜和其他原材料、纸和纸浆、水果和酒、鱼粉以及少量轻工业制造品。
en: In 1984, Chile exported copper and other minerals, paper and pulp, fruits and wine, fishmeal, and a smattering of light manufactures.

zh: 三十年后，智利的出口篮子里依旧是这些东西。
en: Thirty years later, Chile’s exports comprise the same items.

zh: 能源投资或许可以启动 — — 但必须在智利机构实现现代化使之成为可能的情况下。
en: Investment in energy would probably take off – if only Chile’s institutions were modernized to make that possible.

zh: 这是皮涅拉留下的另一个后遗症。
en: This is another area where Piñera’s legacy is wanting.

zh: 智利与邻国有很大区别，它不出产石油和天然气。
en: Chile is unique among its neighbors in having no oil or gas.

zh: 如今，智利的电费是地区追高的，因为发电量赶不上不断增长的需求。
en: Chileans today pay the highest electricity rates in the region, because generating capacity has failed to keep pace with rising demand.

zh: 漫长的干旱期可能导致未来几年中无法点亮电灯。
en: A prolonged dry spell could cause the lights to go off in the next few years.

zh: 同时确保廉价的能源和清洁的环境是一个巨大的挑战。
en: Ensuring both cheaper energy and a clean environment is a big challenge.

zh: 专家们都同意这需要国家规划部署智利山区的发电厂，修订输电机制，更集约地使用天然气，以及多管齐下促进可再生能源，特别是风能和太阳能的利用。
en: Experts agree that it will require a national plan for locating generators across Chile’s mountainous territory, a revamped regime for the transmission of power, more intensive use of natural gas, and a concerted effort to promote renewables, particularly wind and solar.

zh: 遗憾的是，皮涅拉在这些领域毫无作为。
en: Regrettably, Piñera took action in none of these areas.

zh: 就业政策是皮涅拉政府的又一短板。
en: Employment policy was yet another shortcoming of his administration.

zh: 2009年后复苏的同时，记录失业率有所下降，这让政府极少关注将无数女性和智利青年排除在外的劳动力市场。
en: With the post-2009 recovery came a drop in measured joblessness, which allowed the government to pay scant attention to a labor market that leaves out far too many women and young Chileans.

zh: 一个广泛的共识是智利必须改变其雇用和解雇法规，���许工会谈判换班制和工时，改善在职和脱产培训，为寻找工作者提供更多信息。
en: There is broad consensus that Chile must change hiring and firing rules, allow unions to negotiate shifts and working hours, improve on- and off-the-job training, and make more information available to job-seekers.

zh: 但这些问题都具有政治敏感性，微小的法律变化也会导致极大的反对。
en: But these are all politically sensitive areas, where the smallest legal change can elicit howls of opposition.

zh: 皮涅拉采用了安全做法 — — 不尝试任何改变。
en: Piñera took the safe route of attempting no changes at all.

zh: 当然，这些智利青年若能得到第一流的教育，他们找工作的前景也必然会改善。
en: And, of course, those young Chileans will have better prospects of getting a job if they come equipped with a first-rate education.

zh: 智利在普及教育方面做得很成功（入学率已可以和发达国家相媲美 ） ； 但在确保青年 — — 特别是低收入家庭的孩子 — — 获得高质量教育方面并未取得多少成就。
en: Chile has succeeded in getting the young into the classroom (enrollment rates are comparable to those in developed countries); but it has had limited success at ensuring that the young – and particularly the children of low-income families – receive a high-quality education once they are there.

zh: 皮涅拉政府就应该由谁来支付大学学费问题与示威学生产生了对立。
en: Piñera’s government became embroiled in a fight with protesting students over who should pay for university education.

zh: 这场对立阻碍了教育领域其他变革的推进。
en: That controversy prevented most other changes in education from going forward.

zh: 巴切莱特已承诺要结束这一僵局，并把教育改革作为她的政府的当务之急。
en: Bachelet has vowed to end this paralysis and make educational reform her administration’s top priority.

zh: 目标是值得赞赏的，但实现目标决非易事。
en: The goal is laudable, but achieving it will not be easy.

zh: 每一年，智利财政部都会请独立专家组评估智利可以在不引起通胀和其他失衡的情况下实现多高的增长率。
en: Every year, Chile’s finance ministry asks a group of independent experts how fast Chile can grow without triggering inflation or other imbalances.

zh: 2008年，在智利受金融危机冲击前，专家给出的平均答案是4.83 % 。
en: In 2008, before Chile felt the consequences of the financial crisis, the average answer provided by those experts was 4.83%.

zh: 2013年，在中右翼政府执政三年后，同样的问题答案是 … … 4.85 % 。
en: In 2013, after three years of center-right government in Chile, the corresponding answer was ...4.85%.

zh: 在皮涅拉政府治下，亲增长的口号喊得很响。
en: Under Piñera’s government, pro-growth rhetoric was abundant.

zh: 但光喊口号是无法提振经济的增长轨迹的。
en: But rhetoric alone cannot boost an economy’s growth trajectory.

zh: 百日孤独
en: One Hundred Days of Solitude

zh: 圣地亚哥—暴力正在乌克兰兴起，示威者开始死于政府代理人之手，而欧盟威胁要制裁负有“暴力和过度使用武力”责任的乌克兰官员。
en: SANTIAGO – When violence flared up in Ukraine and protesters began dying at the hands of government agents, the European Union threatened sanctions against Ukrainian officials responsible for “violence and excessive force.”

zh: 乌克兰总统亚努科维奇逃离基辅，留下一个住着外来猪和羊的私人动物园 — — 以及德国、法国和波兰的外交部长，他们正在致力于牵线结束暴力的协议。
en: President Viktor Yanukovych fled Kyiv, leaving behind a private zoo with exotic pigs and goats – and also the foreign ministers of Germany, France, and Poland, who were in town trying to broker a deal to end the violence.

zh: 但在几乎相同的时间，暴力也在委内瑞拉兴起，示威者开始死于政府代理人之手，美洲国家组织（Organization of American States，OAS）发声宣布 … … 它不会发声。
en: But when violence flared up – virtually simultaneously – in Venezuela and protesters began dying at the hands of government agents, the Organization of American States raised its voice to announce that...it would not raise its voice.

zh: OAS说，委内瑞拉自己会解决问题。
en: The situation was up to Venezuela to sort out, the OAS stated.

zh: 在加拉加斯，你看不到其他拉丁美洲国家的外交部长 — — 他们当然没有在谴责镇压、要求结束暴力。
en: Foreign ministers from other Latin American countries are nowhere to be seen in Caracas – certainly not denouncing repression and demanding an end to the violence.

zh: 与此同时，死亡人数一直在上升。
en: Meanwhile, the body count keeps rising.

zh: 如此反差凸显出一个人人皆知的秘密：拉丁美洲地区机构很弱，甚至比欧洲的还弱。
en: The contrast highlights what everyone already knows: Latin America’s regional institutions are weak – even weaker than Europe’s.

zh: 但这也揭露了令一些东西：政府和领导人在面对侵犯、镇压甚至死亡时保持沉默，因为不论说什么都等同于“干涉”他国内政，谴责这样的政府和领导人的逻辑在道德上是站不住脚的。
en: But it also reveals something else: a morally crooked logic that condemns governments and leaders to remain silent in the face of aggression, repression, and even death, because to say anything would be tantamount to “intervention” in another country’s internal affairs.

zh: 并非总是如此。
en: It was not always like this.

zh: 不久前，在拉丁美洲，生命和自由被视为普世权利，应该超越国界受到保护。
en: Not long ago in Latin America, life and liberty were deemed to be universal rights, to be defended across national borders.

zh: 我的父亲是一名智利律师兼人权活动家。
en: My father was a Chilean lawyer and human-rights activist.

zh: 皮诺切特将军将他和我们的家庭赶出了智利，我的少年时光和成人的早期阶段都在流亡中度过，我和其他来自智利、阿根廷、巴西和乌拉圭的流亡者具有共同的希望和恐惧。
en: General Augusto Pinochet kicked him and our family out of the country, and I spent my adolescence and early adulthood in exile, sharing hopes and fears with other expatriates from Chile, Argentina, Brazil, and Uruguay.

zh: 我们中没有人 — — 拉丁美洲左翼中也没有人 — — 曾经怀疑过捍卫人权是属于每个人的责任、国际社会应该对虐待和杀戮本国人民的政府严加追究。
en: None of us – and no one on the Latin American left – would have doubted for a moment that defending human rights was everyone’s responsibility, and that the international community should come down hard on governments that tortured and killed their own people.

zh: 在皮诺切特的智利或魏地拉将军的阿根廷，任何指责政府发起的暴力行为的人都会被扣上国际共产主义同谋的帽子。
en: In Pinochet’s Chile or General Jorge Rafael Videla’s Argentina, anyone who complained about government-sponsored violence was painted as a member of an international communist conspiracy.

zh: 如今，任何指责委内瑞拉暴力的人都是 — — 用总统马杜罗的话说 — — 法西斯主义、美帝国主义的走狗。
en: Today, anyone who complains about violence in Venezuela is, according to President Nicolás Maduro, a fascist and a lackey of the American empire.

zh: 一切都改变了，但一切都和原来一样。
en: Everything has changed, yet everything remains the same.

zh: 是的，委内瑞拉的局面必须由委内瑞拉人决定。
en: Yes, the situation in Venezuela must be sorted out by Venezuelans.

zh: 问题在于如今一些委内瑞拉人无法上街进行和平游行而不被射杀。
en: The problem is that some Venezuelans today cannot march peacefully on the streets without being shot at.

zh: 一些委内瑞拉人无法自由地向同胞讲话，因为任何一个播放了他们的声音的电视台都会被封杀和扼杀。
en: Some Venezuelans cannot speak freely to their fellow citizens, because each and every television station that would carry their words has been muzzled or driven off the air.

zh: 一些委内瑞拉人无法保证他们的权利得到尊重。
en: And some Venezuelans cannot be sure their rights will be respected.

zh: 总检察长、国家选举委员会委员和最高法院法官任期早已届满，但他们的继任者迟迟没有得到人名，因为马杜罗不愿与反对派展开谈判，又无法达到任命他的心仪人选所必须的国民大会三分之二多数。
en: Terms in office have expired for the prosecutor-general, members of the national election commission, and supreme court justices, but no successors have been named, because Maduro is unwilling to negotiate with the opposition and lacks the two-thirds majority in the National Assembly needed to appoint officials of his choosing.

zh: 若能够决定自己的命运，委内瑞拉人将无比开心，但他们无法获得这样做的民主方式。
en: Venezuelans would like nothing better than to be the ones who decide their own destiny, but the democratic means to do so are being denied to them.

zh: 事实上，主要反对派领袖之一洛佩兹（Leopoldo López）因为可笑的“煽动犯罪”指控而被捕。
en: Indeed, one of the key opposition leaders, Leopoldo López, has been arrested on ludicrous charges of “inciting crime.”

zh: 要面对政府爪牙的乌克兰示威者在没有外部团结或支持的情况下咬牙坚持是荒谬可笑的。
en: It would have been preposterous to tell Ukrainian demonstrators facing government storm troopers to just grin and bear it without any external solidarity or support.

zh: 要委内瑞拉示威者这样做亦然。
en: It is just as preposterous to tell Venezuelan demonstrators the same thing.

zh: 在这样的环境下，各国外交部动辄挂碍嘴边的自主原则成了一句空洞的口号。
en: In these circumstances, the principle of self-determination, so beloved of foreign ministries everywhere, becomes an empty slogan.

zh: 或许最悲伤的外国反应来自智利大学学生联合会。
en: Perhaps the saddest of all foreign reactions came from the University of Chile’s student federation.

zh: 该联合会用让人想起20世纪50年代斯大林主义者的语气谴责委内瑞拉学生“捍卫旧秩序 ” 、 “偏离了人民所选择的道路 ” 。 而正是这个学生联合会，曾经领导过要求智利政府改善教育的学生示威。
en: Using language reminiscent of the Stalinist 1950’s, the federation – which has led student protests demanding better education in Chile – condemned their Venezuelan counterparts for “defending the old order” and “deviating from the path the people have chosen.”

zh: 这一观点（如果可以称之为观点的话）的问题在于“人民”并没有用一个声音发声，也无法发出完整的声音。
en: The problem with this argument (if one can call it that) is that “the people” do not speak with one voice, nor do their pronouncements fall fully formed from the sky.

zh: 要想搞清楚真正的人民到底想要什么并据此做出反应，民主国家有程序，有宪法保证，有个人权利。
en: To figure out what real people actually want and respond accordingly, democracies have procedures, constitutional guarantees, and individual rights.

zh: 当这些东西遭到践踏时 — — 就像委内瑞拉一样 — — 人民根本不可能自由地发声，也不可能自由地选择道路。
en: When these are trampled upon, as they have been in Venezuela, people can neither speak freely nor choose their path.

zh: 认为马杜罗的行动必然是合法的，因为他是通过选举掌权的，这一观点也同样大错特错。
en: It is equally silly to argue that Maduro’s actions must be legitimate because he came to power through an election.

zh: 民主选出的领袖只有在其执政后民主地治国才具有合法性。
en: A democratically elected leader retains legitimacy only to the extent that he or she behaves democratically once in office.

zh: 乔治敦大学教授夏米拉斯（Hector Schamis）最近回忆说，葡萄牙的萨拉扎（António de Oliveira Salazar ） 、 巴拉圭的斯特罗斯纳（Alfredo Stroessner）和印尼的苏哈托都是通过选举掌握权力的，但没有哪本历史书会说他们是民主的。
en: As Georgetown professor Hector Schamis recently recalled, António de Oliveira Salazar in Portugal, Alfredo Stroessner in Paraguay, and Suharto in Indonesia attained power through elections, yet no history book calls them democratic.

zh: 亚努科维奇也曾赢得选举，但人们对他的记忆只有他所引起的流血、现在的乌克兰所面临的经济破产，当然，还有他的私人动物园和法拉利车库。
en: Yanukovych, too, won an election, but he will be remembered mostly for the bloodshed he unleashed, the bankruptcy that now faces Ukraine’s economy, and, of course, his private zoo and stable of Ferraris.

zh: 和乌克兰人一样，委内瑞拉人应该明白他们并不孤独。
en: Venezuelans, like Ukrainians, should know that they are not alone.

zh: 他们为民主权利所做的斗争是所有人的斗争。
en: Their struggle for democratic rights is everyone’s struggle.

zh: 拉丁美洲人民知道这一点，即使他们的领导人并不总是愿意大声说出来。
en: People in Latin America know this, even if their leaders are not always willing to say it out loud.

zh: 产业政策再思考
en: Industrial Policy Reconsidered

zh: 圣地亚哥—首先，世界银行成为不遗余力的女性和同性恋权利支持者。
en: SANTIAGO – First, the World Bank became a tireless advocate of women’s and gay rights.

zh: 接着，国际货币基金组织支持使用资本管制，并表示关注收入不平等问题。
en: Then the International Monetary Fund backed the use of capital controls and voiced concern over income inequality.

zh: 这条意识形态现代化阵线的下一个是泛美开发银行：在即将发布的报告中，该银行呼吁拉丁美洲采取产业政策。
en: Next in line for ideological modernization is the Inter-American Development Bank (IADB): in a forthcoming report, the bank calls for industrial policies in Latin America.

zh: 这是值得欢迎的发展趋势。
en: This is a welcome development.

zh: 平心而论，泛美开发银行虽然不像布雷顿森林体系诞生的两大机构那样顽固，但也属于传统国际金融官僚，没有产业政策置喙；它使用了政治正确的用词 ： “ 生产性发展政策 ” 。
en: To be sure, the IADB – never as stodgy as the Bretton Woods twins, but still a traditional international financial bureaucracy – does not speak of industrial policies; it uses the politically correct phrase “productive development policies” (PDPs).

zh: 但其中的信号是明确的：在拉丁美洲，公共政策应该在决定生产什么方面起到作用。
en: Yet the message is clear: in Latin America, the state and public policy should have a role in deciding what gets produced.

zh: 一代人之前，这一信号会被视为异端。
en: A generation ago, this message would have been heretical.

zh: 如今，这已是常识。
en: Today, it is a matter of common sense.

zh: 上周，来自泛美开发银行的经济学家带着他们的方案来到智利圣地亚哥开会。
en: Last week, economists from the IADB brought their gospel to a conference in Santiago, Chile.

zh: 几十年来，智利一直是拉丁美洲经济管理的榜样，也是彰显所有拉丁美洲经济体所面临的问题的镜子。
en: The country, for decades the region’s poster-child for good economic management, is also an example of the risks that all Latin American economies face.

zh: 商品价格下跌、美元利率上升导致智利增长大幅减速。
en: With commodity prices falling and dollar interest rates on the rise, Chilean growth is slowing sharply.

zh: 近15年来生产率几无增长，而其出口品组成亦与20世纪80年代别无二致。
en: Productivity gains have been sluggish for nearly 15 years, and the country’s export basket is the same as it was in the 1980’s.

zh: 智利的增长问题是地区内最轻微的。
en: Chile’s growth problems are among the least severe in the region.

zh: 它是该地区仅有的自1960年以来与美国人均收入差距缩小的四个国家之一（另三国是巴西、巴拿马和多米尼加 ） 。
en: It is one of only four countries (along with Brazil, Panama, and the Dominican Republic) that have managed to reduce the per capita income gap with the United States since 1960.

zh: 泛美开发银行在此前的多份报告中指出，拉丁美洲大部分国家生产率处于停滞状态已逾半个世纪。
en: As the IADB has pointed out in several earlier reports, productivity has been stagnant in most of Latin America for a half-century or more.

zh: 可以做些什么？
en: What is to be done?

zh: 传统药方包括改善教育（特别是技术教育 ） 、 现代化劳动力市场、减少官僚主义官样文章以及促进外国投资和技术转移。
en: The conventional prescription includes improving education (especially the technical kind), modernizing labor markets, reducing bureaucratic red tape, and facilitating foreign investment and technology transfer.

zh: 如今，泛美开发银行在这一标准清单上加入了或“横向”或“纵向”的生产性发展政策。
en: To this standard tool kit the IADB now adds PDPs, which can be “horizontal” or “vertical.”

zh: 横向生产性发展政策为不同部门的格雷企业提供增长和发展所需要的投入品。
en: Horizontal PDPs provide the inputs that a broad range of firms, across different sectors, need for their growth and development.

zh: 简单的例子包括交通基础设施、受过培训的工程师和英语流利的拉动力。
en: Simple examples include transport infrastructure, trained engineers, and a labor force proficient in English.

zh: 更复杂的例子包括健康和安全检查体系、产品质量认证或知识产权保护。
en: More sophisticated examples can involve systems for health and safety inspection, product-quality certification, or intellectual-property protection.

zh: 问题在于这些公共提供投入品中有一些只能用于特定的部门或产品。
en: The problem is that some of these publicly provided inputs can be sector- or product-specific.

zh: 通往偏远而美丽的山区的公路能提振生态旅游，但无助于将货物运往最近的港口。
en: Roads to remote and beautiful mountains foster eco-tourism but do not help carry merchandise to the nearest port.

zh: 用于检测牛肉是否含有口蹄疫的实验室对于检验水果和蔬菜出口疫病没有任何用处。
en: A lab built to certify that beef does not have foot-and-mouth disease is of little use in verifying that fruit and vegetable exports are similarly disease-free.

zh: 这时就需要纵向政策 — — 让具体部门收益的政策 — — 登场了。
en: That is where vertical policies – those that favor a particular sector – come in.

zh: 横向生产性发展政策相对来说正以较少，但纵向生产性发展政策可能招致严厉的批评，质疑者称它们涉嫌“挑选赢家 ” 。
en: Horizontal PDPs are relatively uncontroversial, but vertical PDPs can unleash severe criticism, with skeptics claiming that they involve “picking winners.”

zh: 但是，上述例子表明，横向和纵向政策之间的界线难免模糊。
en: But, as the examples given above suggest, the line between horizontal and vertical policies is inevitably fuzzy.

zh: 换句话说，当政府提供资金用于培训某种特定类型的工程师、修建特定公路或建设特定实验室时，就给了某些部门其他部门没有的优待，从而在事实上挑选了赢家。
en: In other words, when a government provides money to train a particular kind of engineer, lay out a particular road, or build a particular lab, it is favoring one sector over others, and hence de facto picking winners.

zh: 泛美开发银行指出，最好有意识地、透明地实施这一政策，并引入适当的制衡机制。
en: The IADB argues that it is better to do this consciously, transparently, and with the appropriate checks and balances.

zh: 纵向政策还可以用于解决合作失灵问题。
en: Vertical policies are also useful in solving coordination failures.

zh: 以旅游业为例。 在阿根廷和智利南部美丽的巴塔哥尼亚地区，旅游业大有可为。
en: Consider the tourism industry, which has great potential in the beautiful Patagonia region of southern Argentina and Chile.

zh: 但如果没有接通公路，就不会有私人企业会在如此偏远、人口稀少的地区建设饭店。
en: But no private firm will build a hotel in this remote, under-populated region if no road leads there.

zh: 反之，如果没有饭店和客栈，就不会有政府官员会想到建设公路，因为建了也没有意义。
en: By the same token, no government official will build a road if there are no hotels or lodges, for the road would lead nowhere.

zh: 旅游业如果不进行深思熟虑的公私合作，就无法起飞。
en: Without deliberate private-public coordination focused on tourism, the sector may never take off.

zh: 怀疑派还指出，拉丁美洲已经在20世纪六七十年代经历过一轮产业政策，效果只能说差强人意。
en: Skeptics also point out that Latin America already went through a round of industrial policy in the 1960’s and 1970’s, with results that were mediocre at best.

zh: 泛美开发银行的报告提供了关于这段历史的平衡的评估。
en: The IADB report provides a balanced assessment of that episode.

zh: 尽管进口替代和补贴在点燃工业化方面一开始取得了一些成功，但规模的欠缺很快就形成了掣肘（一个只有几百万人口的国家是不可能拥有只面向国内市场的汽车业的 ） 。
en: Though import substitution and subsidies were initially successful in igniting industrialization, lack of scale soon hindered efforts (a country of a few million cannot hope to have an auto industry aimed only at the domestic market).

zh: 更糟糕的是，政府帮助不论行业强弱一刀切。
en: Worse, government help was handed out to strong and weak performers alike.

zh: 在亚洲，许多一开始获得帮助的企业或早或晚成长为世界级竞争者。
en: In Asia, many firms that initially received help sooner or later became world-class competitors.

zh: 但在几无市场和政策纪律可言并且汇率长期高估的拉丁美洲，这样的转变极少发生。
en: In Latin America, with little market and policy discipline and chronically overvalued exchange rates, that transition seldom happened.

zh: 平心而论，这些问题都需要克服。
en: To be sure, those problems had to be corrected.

zh: 但泛美开发银行指出，在实践过程中，拉丁美洲政府或许走得太远了 ： “ 如今，决策者和分析家正在日益形成共识，一刀切地排斥产业政策可能导致婴儿与洗澡水一起泼出。
en: But in doing so, claims the IADB, Latin American governments may have gone too far: “There is now a growing consensus among policymakers and analysts alike that by putting all industrial policy out of bounds, the region may have thrown out the baby with the bathwater.

zh: 越来越明显的是，问题不在于要不要采取生产性发展政策，而是如何采取这一政策。
en: More and more, the question is not put in terms of whether to do active productive development policies but rather how to do them.”

zh: ”与20世纪60年代陈旧的产业政策不同，现代生产性发展政策旨在纠正市场失灵，而不是废除市场激励。
en: Unlike 1960’s-vintage industrial policy, modern PDPs aim to correct market failures, not do away with market incentives.

zh: 市场失灵不是唯一的问题。
en: Market failure is not the only issue.

zh: 新兴的生产性发展政策新方针还害怕国家失灵。
en: The emerging new approach to PDPs is also fearful of state failure.

zh: 国家机构可能被利益集团俘虏，援助可能被挪用作私人或政治用途。
en: State agencies can be captured and aid can be used for private or political gain.

zh: 为了防止这一问题，报告再次偏离了要国家识别和复制海外“最佳实践”的正统做法。
en: To prevent this, the report again usefully deviates from reigning orthodoxy, which tells countries to identify and copy “best practices” from abroad.

zh: 如果这些最佳实践要求地方政府所无法提供的条件，这一方法就不可能成功。
en: This approach cannot succeed if such practices require what local government cannot deliver.

zh: 因此 ， “ 核心不应该放在政策最佳实践上，而应该放在最符合机构能力的政策上。 ”
en: Hence, “the focus ought to be not on policy best practices but on policy best matches with institutional capabilities.”

zh: 如果想在后商品繁荣时期保持增长，拉丁美洲需要大量新思维和政策创新。
en: Latin America will need a great deal of fresh thinking and many policy innovations if it is to keep growing in a post-commodity-boom era.

zh: 没有哪个政策可以免于失败。
en: No policy is failure-proof.

zh: 但即将发布的泛美开发银行报告所提出的方针是最有希望成功的。
en: But the approach advocated in the forthcoming IADB report is the region’s best hope today.

zh: 死牛迈步？
en: Dead Cow Walking?

zh: 圣地亚哥—希望将整个南美大陆统一为一个国家的南美独立英雄玻利瓦尔一定会对如今南美大陆能源部门各自为战的情景痛心疾首。
en: SANTIAGO – Simón Bolívar, the South American independence hero who hoped to weave the continent into a single nation, would shudder at the disintegration that prevails today in the continent’s energy sector.

zh: 毫无疑问，他一眼就能看出没有哪个社会可以建立在如此分散的基础上。
en: Surely he would understand that no community can be built on so fragmented a foundation.

zh: 秘鲁有天然气，并向墨西哥出售。
en: Peru has gas, which it sells to Mexico.

zh: 玻利维亚也有天然气，但自2006年天然气行业被国有化以来一直处于开发不足的状态。
en: Bolivia also has gas, but it has been under-exploiting it ever since it nationalized the industry in 2006.

zh: 阿根廷曾经有天然气行业，但毁于多年来的政府政策瞎指挥。
en: Argentina used to have a gas industry, but it was decimated by years of misguided government policies.

zh: 巴西几年前在大西洋深海发现了碳氢化合物并开始拍卖采矿权，但开始实际生产还要等好几年。
en: Brazil discovered hydrocarbons deep in the Atlantic Ocean a few years ago and has begun auctioning off rights, but actual production is still years away.

zh: 智利没有石油和天然气，也没有哪个邻国会卖给它，因此不得不从遥远的印尼购买。
en: Chile has no oil or gas, and no one in the neighborhood will sell it any, so it has to buy its supplies from as far away as Indonesia.

zh: 此外，南美的电网也往往互不相同，电费也大相径庭。
en: Moreover, South America’s electricity grids are seldom interconnected, and rates for power vary widely.

zh: 巴西和智利的电费为南美地区最高（放到却世界也不遑多让 ） 。
en: Brazil and Chile have the region’s highest electricity prices (which are also among the highest in the world).

zh: 它们的工业竞争力和消费者家庭预算也因此受到影响。
en: The competitiveness of their industries, and consumers’ household budgets, suffer accordingly.

zh: 乐观者所想象的景象是生产合理、管网建设完全、电网互通，玻利维亚、阿根廷和其他地方的天然气能提振整个南美大陆的增长，并让所有人在此过程中受益。
en: Optimists imagine a scenario in which production is rationalized, pipelines are built, grids are interconnected, and gas from Bolivia, Argentina, or elsewhere fuels growth throughout the continent, benefiting everyone in the process.

zh: 但这一梦想总是遇到可怕的障碍：几十年 — — 有的时候是几百年 — — 之久的民族对立一再将可以创造共同利润的能源一体化协议拒之门外。
en: But such dreams always hit a formidable obstacle: national rivalries that date back decades – in some cases centuries – and that repeatedly keep mutually profitable energy-integration agreements from being signed.

zh: 即使签署了协议，也常常因为强制性短期考虑因素而被破坏。
en: Or, if they are signed, they are often broken when compelling short-term considerations intervene.

zh: 比如，十年前智利和阿根廷签署了后者以预定价格向前者供应天然气的合约，智利为此花了数十亿改装电站。
en: For example, a decade ago, contracts promising a steady supply of Argentine gas at pre-set prices led Chile to spend billions refitting its power stations.

zh: 但是，在经历了长时间的价格管制和投资严重不足后，阿根廷国内需求远远超过了供给。
en: But, after a long period of price controls and massive underinvestment, domestic demand in Argentina was far outpacing supply.

zh: 于是，时任总统基什内尔政府撕毁了与智利的合约，削减了对智利的天然气出口，给智利经济增长造成了严重打击，也严重伤害了智利人民的感情。
en: So then-President Néstor Kirchner’s government tore up the contracts and cut off exports to Chile, stunting its economic growth and leaving painful memories among its citizens.

zh: 但如今，一个新的有力因素可能改变这一令人沮丧的政治局面：已经对美国及其经济产生重大影响的页岩气。
en: But now a new and powerful factor could change this dismal political equation: shale gas, which is already having an important effect on the United States and its economy.

zh: 美国天然及价格已经降到略高于4美元/百万英热（几年前高达13美元 ） ， 即使是谨慎的分析师也认为页岩能源革命将提振美国潜在经济增长并增加多大200万个新工作岗位。
en: With US natural-gas prices down to just over $4 per million BTU (from $13 just a few years ago), even prudent analysts expect the shale-energy revolution to increase America’s potential economic growth and add as many as two million new jobs.

zh: 页岩能源对南美的影响是两方面的。
en: The impact of shale energy on South America is twofold.

zh: 首先，没有天然气的国家（如智利）和本地需求超过本地供给的国家（如巴西）的进口成本可能会降低。
en: For starters, there is the potential for cheaper imports for those countries with no gas (Chile) or where local demand could exceed local supply (Brazil).

zh: 对于像智利这样的国家，大型水电项目总是引起颇多政治争议，太阳能电和风电增长又太慢，来自美国的天然气进口将成为有力的助推器。
en: For a country like Chile, where large hydroelectric projects have been politically controversial, and where solar and wind power have been too slow in coming, gas imports from the US would be a tremendous boon.

zh: 2013年，美国能源部批准了第一批大规模天然气出口设施；尽管这一气源并未形成稳定的天然气流，但美国和全球气价之间的差异意味着它潜力无限。
en: In 2013, the US Department of Energy authorized the first substantial gas-export facilities; while the trickle is not yet a steady flow, the gap between US and much-higher world prices implies tremendous potential benefits.

zh: 另一方面则是据本国更近的页岩气开发。
en: Then there is the shale gas to be exploited closer to home.

zh: 据报道，阿根廷拥有世界第三大页岩气储量，仅次于美国和中国。
en: Argentina reportedly has the world’s third-largest shale-gas reserves, after the US and China.

zh: 能源公司YPF拥有巨大的死牛（Vaca Muerta）气田，并刚刚开始勘探。
en: The huge Vaca Muerta (Dead Cow) field, owned by the energy company YPF, is just now beginning to be explored.

zh: 2012年，阿根廷政府将YPF从西班牙雷普索尔公司（Repsol）手中收归国有，这造成了大量诉讼和反诉讼，拖延了页岩气领域的潜在投资。
en: Argentina’s government expropriated YPF from Spain’s Repsol in 2012, with the resulting suits and countersuits delaying any potential investment in shale.

zh: 但是，最近阿根廷和雷普索尔公司达成了和解，对页岩气的投资兴趣也开始激活。
en: But, with Argentina and Repsol recently reaching a settlement, interest has revived.

zh: 诚然，勘探这笔页岩气储量面临着巨大的技术挑战，全世界只有少数几家公司拥有这方面的技能。
en: Surely, the technical challenges of exploiting such shale-gas reserves are huge, and only a handful of firms in the world have the necessary knowhow.

zh: 金融挑战则更加严峻：分析师预测需要投入的资金高达几百甚至几千亿美元。
en: The financial challenges are even greater: analysts speak of tens or even hundreds of billions of dollars in required investment.

zh: 但阿根廷和地区潜力是无穷的。
en: But the potential for Argentina and the region is tremendous.

zh: 阿根廷经济学家、布宜诺斯艾利斯省银行（Banco de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires）行长斯特尔泽尼格（Federico Sturzenegger）估算，死牛气田天然气价值（以阿根廷现行天然气进口价格衡量）是阿根廷GDP的九倍。
en: Federico Sturzenegger, an Argentine economist and President of Banco de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires, has estimated the value of Vaca Muerta gas (at the prices Argentina currently pays for gas imports) to be equal to nine times the country’s GDP.

zh: 但是，由于全球价格可能会因为美国加入出口国行列而快速下跌，阿根廷必须尽快行动以把握这一潜在收益。
en: But, because world prices are likely to drop fast as the US steps up exports, Argentina has to act quickly in order to capture these potential gains.

zh: 斯特尔泽尼格认为页岩气方面的决定是阿根廷经济史上“最重要的”决定。
en: Sturzenegger has called the decision about shale gas “the most important” in Argentina’s economic history.

zh: 阿根廷的选择将不仅影响地区经济，还将影响地区政治。
en: Argentina’s choices could matter not just for the region’s economy, but also for its politics.

zh: 由于死牛气田的天然气远远超过了阿根廷本国的需求量，出口将是不可避免的，��相邻的巴西和智利则是天然客户。
en: Because Vaca Muerta holds much more gas than Argentina could ever burn, exports are the inescapable way forward, and neighboring Brazil and Chile are among the natural customers.

zh: 南美地区天然气实力平衡的变化可能反过来让玻利维亚、秘鲁和其他国家的民族主义者反思他们的政策。
en: The shift in the regional balance of gas-based power could in turn cause nationalists in Bolivia, Peru, and elsewhere to rethink their policies.

zh: 石油、天然气和其他能源业的一体化以及国家电网的连通可能会相继到来。
en: Integration in the oil, gas, and other energy industries, along with the interconnection of national power grids, could follow.

zh: 南美的经济和政治局面将发生永久改变。
en: South America’s economic and political landscape would be changed forever.

zh: 这样说会不会太乐观了？
en: Is this too optimistic?

zh: 也许会。
en: Perhaps.

zh: 在南美，保证能源流安全且可靠的政治和法律保障仍有待建立。
en: The political and legal safeguards needed to make energy flows safe and reliable would have to be built.

zh: 正如地区历史所表明的，这不是一个简单的任务。
en: As the region’s history shows, that is no easy task.

zh: 民族主义和政治短视曾经一次又一次地压倒了理性。
en: Time and again, nationalism and shortsighted politics have trumped reason.

zh: 但既然赌注如此之高、潜力如此之大，我们至少应该保持希望。
en: But the stakes are so high, and the potential so great, that the least one must do is hope.

zh: 令人忧虑的南方共同市场
en: Mercosur Blues

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 南方共同市场领导人本周在加拉加斯会面时，空气中充斥着反帝国主义口号。
en: SANTIAGO – When the leaders of Mercosur met in Caracas this week, the usual bluster about standing up to imperialism filled the air.

zh: 但同样弥漫着的是显而易见的腐朽味道。
en: But so did the unmistakable scent of decay.

zh: 南方共同市场通常被定义为贸易组织；事实上，自成立伊始它就与政治挂钩。
en: Mercosur is usually described as a trade grouping; in fact, it has been a political creation from the start.

zh: 外界总认为地区性大国巴西能在西半球事务中制衡美国。
en: Brazil, the regional powerhouse, always viewed it as a counterweight to the United States in hemispheric affairs.

zh: 阿根廷庇隆政府利用该组织在不取消实际贸易壁垒的前提下大肆宣传地区整合。
en: Peronist governments in Argentina used it to hype integration while doing little or nothing to remove actual barriers to trade.

zh: 随着2006委内瑞拉总统查韦斯的加入，民粹主义倾向已经再明显不过。
en: With the entrance of Hugo Chávez’s Venezuela in 2006, the lurch toward populism became unmistakable.

zh: 因为近10年来担任过智利政府部长，我清楚地记得南方共同市场会议的无可奈何（智利当时曾以准会员的身份与会 ） 。
en: As a Chilean government minister late last decade, I remember the frustration of attending Mercosur gatherings (Chile is an associate member).

zh: 他们长于摆出各种姿态和无休无止的长篇大论，却短于就任何问题达成实质性的一致。
en: They were long on posturing and endless speeches, but short on substantive agreements about anything.

zh: 2006年召开的科尔多瓦峰会上，查韦斯和卡斯特罗大有比拼谁的讲话最长最漫无边际之势，峰会上弥漫着高涨的情绪。
en: At the 2006 summit in Córdoba, when Chávez and Fidel Castro dueled over who could deliver the longest and most rambling address, spirits were running high.

zh: 由颇具个人魅力的民粹主义领导者治理的玻利维亚迫不及待想建立更加密切的关系。
en: Bolivia, also governed by a charismatic populist, was keen to develop closer ties.

zh: 厄瓜多尔很快也积极附议。
en: Ecuador soon followed suit.

zh: 少数中美及加勒比小国也为换取慷慨注入的现金和石油而对委内瑞拉的政治路线齐声附和。
en: And a smattering of smaller countries in Central America and the Caribbean fell into political line in exchange for generous infusions of Venezuelan cash and oil.

zh: 那时南方共同市场领导人还可以声称为地区建立了“替代发展模式 ” 。
en: Back then, Mercosur leaders could claim to offer an “alternative development model” for the region.

zh: 现在已经没人再相信这套谎话。
en: No more.

zh: 本周的加拉加斯充满了哀伤。
en: This week in Caracas, the mood was funereal.

zh: 查韦斯的继任者马杜罗面临着经济崩溃和党内关系紧张。
en: The host, Chávez’s successor Nicolás Maduro, confronts a collapsing economy and tensions within his own party.

zh: 虽然油价仍处于相对高位，但并未改变委内瑞拉庞大的财政赤字和外汇储备下降。
en: Despite relatively high oil prices, Venezuela has a large fiscal deficit and falling foreign-exchange reserves.

zh: 通胀率在区域内高居榜首，而经济正在陷入滞胀。
en: The inflation rate is the region’s highest, and the economy is stagnating.

zh: 面对民众对生活条件恶化的不满，马杜罗政府一直靠暴力镇压来杜绝街头抗议活动。
en: In the face of popular frustration with worsening living conditions, Maduro’s government has relied on violent repression to put an end to street protests.

zh: 反对派领导人莱奥波尔多·洛佩斯在军事监狱里待了几个月才开始受审。
en: Opposition leader Leopoldo López spent months in a military prison before recently being put on trial.

zh: 以人权观察为首的机构已屡次谴责政府侵犯人权及限制公民自由。
en: Institutions like Human Rights Watch have repeatedly denounced the government’s rights violations and restrictions on civil liberties.

zh: 阿根廷总统克里斯蒂娜·费尔南德斯·基什内尔飞抵加拉加斯寄希望外界支持她打击所谓秃鹫基金低价购买该国主权债券并成功起诉要求全额支付的行动。
en: Argentina’s president, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, arrived in Caracas hoping to rouse support in her fight against the so-called vulture funds that bought her country’s sovereign bonds on the cheap and have successfully sued for payment in full.

zh: 但费尔南德斯发现同僚礼貌的鼓励其实无关紧要。
en: But Fernández found that her colleagues’ polite words of encouragement mattered little.

zh: 美国最高法院上月维持下级法院对阿根廷不利的裁决令她陷入绝望。
en: The US Supreme Court’s decision last month to uphold a lower court’s ruling against Argentina put her in an impossible situation.

zh: 付款给顽固的债券持有人不仅丢面子，还有可能引发跟风诉讼；不付款相当于技术违约，并要承担一切由此造成的后果。
en: Paying the recalcitrant bondholders would mean losing face and possibly triggering a salvo of copycat lawsuits; not paying would mean technical default and all of its attendant costs.

zh: 她在两难之中选择了后者。
en: She chose the latter option.

zh: 外国资本对费尔南德斯至关重要，因为像马杜罗一样，她也面临着经济停滞及美元短缺问题日益恶化。
en: Access to foreign capital matters for Fernández, because, like Maduro, she faces a stalled economy and a growing dollar shortage.

zh: 今年初的国内稳定措施为她赢得了时间，但并未消除对经济衰退的担忧。
en: Domestic stabilization measures earlier this year bought her some time, yet fear of a recession remains.

zh: 为求重新进入资本市场，她的经济团队修复了与主权债权人巴黎俱乐部和西班牙雷普索尔公司（国有化石油巨头YPF的前任所有者）的关系；但与秃鹫基金这场战役的失利让她的国家遭受重挫。
en: In an effort to regain access to capital markets, her economic team patched up things with the Paris Club of sovereign creditors and Spain’s Repsol (the former owner of nationalized oil giant YPF); but the fight with the vultures has set the country back.

zh: 随着2015年10月总统大选的临近，绝大多数有潜力的候选人（甚至包括她自己所在党派的候选人）都忙不迭地与她的专制作风和糟糕的经济状况拉开距离。
en: With a presidential election looming in October 2015, most potential candidates (even those from her own party) are quickly distancing themselves from her authoritarian style and troubled economic legacy.

zh: 玻利维亚总统莫拉莱斯耍尽了宪法和法律花招以确保自己能连续当选。
en: In Bolivia, President Evo Morales has resorted to legal and constitutional shenanigans to guarantee himself yet another term in office.

zh: 本来连任两届的莫拉莱斯理论上禁止再竞选连任。
en: After two terms, Morales would in theory be prohibited from running again.

zh: 但玻利维亚宪法法院却裁定他可以参选，因为新通过的宪法将玻利维亚改名为多民族玻��维亚国；因此莫拉莱斯之前担任的是另一个国家的元首。
en: But Bolivia’s constitutional court has ruled that he can, because the adoption of a new constitution redefined the country as the Plurinational State of Bolivia; Morales, therefore, served his first term as the head of a different state.

zh: 当被问及为何要再次参选时他回答（这一回答对国家领导人来讲可谓独树一帜 ） ， 西班牙前王后索菲亚鼓励他“完成这项任务 ” 。
en: When asked why he will run again, he replied – in a peculiar confession for a nationalist leader – that former Queen Sofía of Spain had encouraged him to “finish the job.”

zh: 厄瓜多尔的民主制度同样也在遭到围攻。
en: In Ecuador, too, democratic institutions are under siege.

zh: 一份独立报告记录了12起政府插手法院裁决的案件。
en: An independent report has chronicled 12 separate episodes of government meddling with court rulings.

zh: 去年颁布的有争议的媒体禁言令已经导致主要纸媒体停印。
en: A controversial gag law on the press that was enacted last year has already ended a major newspaper’s print edition.

zh: 即将离任的美洲人权委员会言论自由专员卡特琳娜·波特罗表示 ， “ 厄瓜多尔和古巴两国对言论自由的限制最为严重。 ”
en: According to Catalina Botero, the outgoing rapporteur for Freedom of Expression of the Inter-American Human Rights Commission, “Ecuador is, along with Cuba, the country that most restricts freedom of expression.”

zh: 巴西总统迪尔玛·罗塞夫所面临的局势既与南方共同市场的官僚们相似但又略有不同。
en: Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff faces a situation that is both similar to and different from that of her Mercosur colleagues.

zh: 巴西总统无权随意操纵宪法或查封媒体。
en: Brazil is not the kind of country where a president can manipulate the constitution or close newspapers at will.

zh: 但不满情绪却一直弥漫在巴西利亚的空气中（这还不包括德国对巴西的世界杯大胜 ） 。
en: But malaise is in the air in Brasilia (leaving aside the World Cup thrashing delivered by Germany).

zh: 巴西从2008年金融危机中迅速恢复令其成为国际金融市场的新宠；但自此之后的增长乏力却留下了昨天没有兑现的承诺。
en: Brazil’s swift recovery from the 2008 financial crisis endeared it to international financial markets; but weak growth since then has left yesterday’s promise unfulfilled.

zh: 虽然失业率不高但人们却对经济越来越忧虑 — — 而且上述忧虑已经向政治领域渗透。
en: Despite low unemployment, economic anxiety is on the rise – and is beginning to filter to the political realm.

zh: 随着罗塞夫民调支持率降低而其对手缓慢攀升，10月举行的总统大选 — — 之前曾被认为已经没有悬念 — — 现在可能会出现竞争。
en: With Rousseff dropping in the polls and her opponents slowly gaining, the October presidential election – once thought to be a done deal – may be up for grabs.

zh: 智利总统米歇尔·巴切莱特缺席了加拉加斯峰会，理由是感冒和国内事务繁忙。
en: Absent from the Caracas summit was Chile’s president, Michelle Bachelet, who blamed a cold and a busy domestic agenda for her inability to travel.

zh: 与委内瑞拉反对派会晤（巴切莱特已决意不亲自出席而是派外长代表）相关的政治并发症也可能是部分理由。
en: Political complications linked to a possible meeting with the Venezuelan opposition, which Bachelet had chosen not to attend (preferring to send her foreign minister), likely also played a part.

zh: 领导温和派对抗马杜罗、费尔南德斯、莫拉莱斯和科雷亚等民粹主义势力的自然是罗塞夫和巴切莱特。
en: Rousseff and Bachelet were natural candidates to lead the development of a moderate counterweight to the populism of Maduro, Fernández, Morales, and Correa.

zh: 但罗塞夫像她享有盛誉的前任路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦一样选择与其奉迎委内瑞拉，还不如放弃这一角色。
en: But Rousseff, like her predecessor, the popular Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, has chosen not to fill that role, instead cozying up to Venezuela.

zh: 智利想要单干却实力不足。 而且巴切莱特也疲于应对争议越来越大的税务、教育和宪法改革。
en: Chile is too small to go it alone, and Bachelet has her hands full with increasingly controversial tax, education, and constitutional reforms.

zh: 乌拉圭总统何塞·穆希卡对加拉加斯形势做出了最好的总结 ： “ 我们发表了声明。
en: Uruguay’s president, José Mujica, offered the best summary of what happened in Caracas: “We issued a statement.”

zh: ”换句话讲，加拉加斯仍然是无关紧要的清谈俱乐部 — — 拉美现代中左翼地区领袖的崛起还不到时候。
en: In other words, Mercosur remains an irrelevant talking shop – and the emergence of a modern center-left regional leadership in Latin America will have to wait.

zh: 第三条道路的第二次机会
en: The Third Way's Second Chance

zh: 圣地亚哥—还记得布莱尔和克林顿的第三条道路（Third Way）吗？
en: SANTIAGO – Remember Tony Blair and Bill Clinton’s Third Way?

zh: 它回来了。
en: It is back.

zh: 面貌和名字换过了，但政府可以 — — 也应该 — — 结合社会民主价值和现代自由经济学的思想又回到了中心舞台。
en: The faces and names have changed, but the idea that governments can – and should – combine social-democratic values and modern liberal economics has returned to center stage.

zh: 在2000年6月由时任德国总理施罗德主持的柏林领导人会议上第三条道路似乎成了未来之路。
en: At a June 2000 gathering of leaders in Berlin, hosted by Germany’s then-Chancellor Gerhard Schröder, the Third Way seemed like the way of the future.

zh: 这次会议是布莱尔谋划的产物（尽管他因为妻子生产而没有出席 ） 。
en: The gathering was Blair’s brainchild (though he did not attend because his wife had just had a child).

zh: 但克林顿发表了关于新技术如何有助于解决旧时代社会弊端的雄辩的长篇演讲。
en: But Clinton held forth eloquently on how new technologies could help to solve age-old social ills.

zh: 瑞典和新西兰领导人指出你可以让国家变得更精干、更有效。
en: Leaders from Sweden and New Zealand argued that you could make the state both leaner and more effective.

zh: 而南非的姆贝基、巴西的卡多佐和智利的拉各斯（我也是拉各斯代表团的成员）宣称，第三条道路可以顺利地套用到所谓的第三世界头上。
en: And the Third Way could travel well to what was once called the Third World, claimed South Africa’s Thabo Mbeki, Brazil’s Fernando Henrique Cardoso, and Chile’s Ricardo Lagos (I was present as part of Lagos’s delegation.)

zh: 不幸的是，这一幕并不长久。
en: Sadly, it was not to last.

zh: 掷地有声的进步治理（progressive governance）论并没有轻松地变为持久的政治哲学。
en: The sound bites about progressive governance did not grow easily into a lasting political philosophy.

zh: 戈尔用克林顿经济学换取传统民粹主义，结果败给了小布什。
en: Al Gore traded Clintonomics for traditional populism and was defeated by George W. Bush.

zh: 社会民主党及其盟友在多个欧洲国家失去了权力。
en: Social democrats and their allies lost power in several European countries.

zh: 伊拉克战争和2008—2009年全球金融危机导致第三条道路领导人所鼓吹的一些政策遭到严重抨击。
en: The war in Iraq and the global financial crisis of 2008-2009 caused a backlash against some of the policies advocated by Third Way leaders.

zh: 快速回到现状。
en: Fast forward to the present.

zh: 39岁的意大利社会主义者总理伦齐常常被称为意大利最后的希望。
en: Italy’s 39-year-old socialist prime minister, Matteo Renzi, is often described as his country’s last hope.

zh: 他承诺（尽管没怎么兑现过）采取深刻的劳动力市场和财政改革。
en: He is promising (though not quite yet delivering) deep labor-market and fiscal reforms.

zh: 在选举中胜出后，伦齐获得了来自布莱尔本人的赞美，布莱尔称“伦齐有活力、有创造力、有毅力，能获得成功。 ”
en: After his electoral victory, Renzi received early kudos from Blair himself, who claimed that “Matteo has the dynamism, creativity, and toughness to succeed.”

zh: 法国的社会主义者总理瓦尔斯正在把政治资本押注于雄心勃勃的削减税收和支出计划，该计划并不受其所在政党传统派的支持。
en: Manuel Valls, France’s Socialist prime minister, is staking his political capital on an ambitious program of tax and spending cuts that does not enjoy the backing of his party’s traditionalist wing.

zh: 来自正统左派的批评指责他“照搬布莱尔和施罗德的方案。 ”
en: Critics from the orthodox left accuse him of “taking solutions from Blair and Schröder.”

zh: 伦齐和瓦尔斯 — — 以及西班牙社会党（Socialist Party）的桑切斯（Pedro Sánchez ） — —是更广泛的趋势的一部分。
en: Renzi and Valls – along with Pedro Sánchez of Spain’s Socialist Party – are part of a broader trend.

zh: 随着世界经济增长放缓，许多中左翼政客试图在投资于就业和技能的同时动员市场、刺激增长。
en: With the world economy growing slowly, many center-left politicians are trying to mobilize markets and jump-start growth while investing in jobs and skills.

zh: 因此，迫切的需要是回归第三条道路思想的直接原因。
en: Thus, dire need is the immediate explanation for the return of Third Way ideas.

zh: 毫不奇怪，债务重重的欧洲政府正在苦寻低财政成本的新社会政策。
en: It is not surprising that deeply indebted European governments are casting about for new social policies at a low fiscal cost.

zh: 但德国保守主义政府所推行的严厉紧缩与新一代南欧社会民主党人所追求的渐进调整并不相同。
en: But the harsh austerity advocated by Germany’s conservative government is not the same as the gradual adjustment sought by the new generation of Southern social democrats.

zh: 保守派要求将财政调整放在首位，不管结果如何。
en: Conservatives demand fiscal adjustment up front, whatever the consequences.

zh: 读过凯恩斯的现代社会民主党知道，一些立刻调整是使计划可信的必要条件。
en: Modern social democrats who have read their Keynes understand that some immediate adjustment is necessary to make the program credible.

zh: 但他们还知道，增加人力资本和实体基础设施支出是限制财政收缩对就业和工资的影响、强化经济的增长潜力的必要条件。
en: But they also know that additional spending on human capital and physical infrastructure is necessary to limit the impact of fiscal retrenchment on employment and wages and to strengthen the economy’s growth potential.

zh: 另一个让第三条道路思想重获市场的原因是它管用。
en: The other reason for giving Third Way ideas a second hearing is that they work.

zh: 施罗德在21世纪初重组德国劳动力市场的努力在当时引起了巨大的争议；但是，事后看来，施罗德的努力将德国从欧洲病夫变为欧洲大陆的出口冠军。
en: Schröder’s reshaping of Germany’s labor market in the early 2000s was hugely controversial at the time; but, in retrospect, it turned Germany from the sick man of Europe into the continent’s export powerhouse.

zh: 北欧国家是实验新方法提供公共服务、同时采取劳动力关系上的“弹性保障 ” （ flexicurity）的先锋。
en: The Nordic countries have led the way in experimenting with new ways to deliver public services while adopting “flexicurity” in labor relations.

zh: 结果：它们实现了稳增长、高就业、低公债的三重目标。
en: The result: they have achieved the trifecta of robust growth, high employment, and low public debt.

zh: 这���思想的效果并不局限于北欧富国。
en: The effectiveness of these ideas is not limited to the rich countries of the North.

zh: 智利民主联盟（Concertación ） 、 秘鲁加西亚、巴西卡多佐政府都从布莱尔-克林顿-施罗德日程中汲取了灵感。
en: The governments of the Concertación in Chile, Alan García in Peru, and Fernando Henrique Cardoso in Brazil all derived inspiration from the Blair-Clinton-Schröder agenda.

zh: 他们在各自国家都引起过（或引起着）争议。
en: All had (or have) their share of controversies.

zh: 但他们都不可否认地开启了各自国家前所未有的民主整合和经济现代化过程。
en: But each undeniably launched an unprecedented period of democratic consolidation and economic modernization in their respective countries.

zh: 在即将到来的巴西总统选举中，现任总统罗塞夫的两名主要对手都在鼓吹回归昔日好时光的政策。
en: In Brazil’s upcoming presidential election, both of the incumbent Dilma Rousseff’s main opponents are advocating policies that hark back to the good old days.

zh: 与卡多佐同一政党的内弗斯（Aécio Neves）这样做并不令人奇怪。
en: In the case of Aécio Neves, who belongs to Cardoso’s party, that is not surprising.

zh: 但社会主义者席尔瓦（Marina Silva）这么做相当令人瞩目。 她提出了签署超越南方共同市场（Mercosur）的新贸易契约、让巴西中央银行独立等口号。
en: But it is remarkable in the case of socialist Marina Silva, who is calling for new trade pacts beyond Mercosur and for making the Central Bank of Brazil independent.

zh: 在出任首相的第一周就授予英格兰银行完全独立地位的布莱尔一定会很自豪。
en: Blair, who gave the Bank of England its full independence during his first week in office, would be proud.

zh: 国家和时间存在很多不同，但最终这些成功经验中包含了四个共同思想。
en: There are many differences across countries and time, but in the end four ideas are common to these successful experiences.

zh: 首先是政策务实主义。
en: The first is policy pragmatism.

zh: 重要的是什么管用，而不是什么在意识形态上纯正。
en: What matters is what works, not what is ideologically pure.

zh: 争论国家应该大些还是小些既冗长又毫无意义，还不如问问什么类型的国家干预、在哪些地方进行干预更有效实在。
en: Instead of the sterile and endless debate as to whether the state should be big or small, it is more fruitful to ask what kind of state intervention, and where.

zh: 第二个思想是财政现实主义。
en: The second idea is fiscal realism.

zh: 预算审慎值得追求（不可持续的赤字顾名思义是无法持续下去的 ） ， 也具有进步性（当情况转坏时，穷人和脆弱群体受创最重 ） 。
en: Budgetary prudence is both desirable (unsustainable deficits owe their name to the fact that they cannot be sustained) and progressive (when things blow up, it is the poor and the vulnerable who suffer the most).

zh: 第三个思想是现代福利国家。
en: The third idea is modern welfarism.

zh: 国家可以也应该实行收入和财富再分配，但与此同时不能破坏工作和储蓄的激励。
en: The state can and should redistribute income and wealth, but in doing so it should not weaken incentives to work and to save.

zh: 政府不能只是做点宣传，而应该致力于保证好工作和好收入。
en: Instead of simply providing handouts, governments should strive to guarantee good jobs at good wages.

zh: 最后，第三条道路是由进步自由主义定义的。
en: Finally, the Third Way is defined by progressive liberalism.

zh: 自由和平等是互补而非矛盾的原则。
en: Liberty and equality are complementary, not contradictory, principles.

zh: 如果规则得到合理制定，人民自由决定和行动的社会可以成为机会公平分布的社会。
en: If the rules are designed properly, a society in which people decide and act freely can also be a society in which opportunities are fairly distributed.

zh: 反之，没有最低限度的人人平等，自由就只能是海市蜃楼。
en: And conversely, without minimum opportunity for all, liberty is more illusory than real.

zh: 这四个思想未第三条道路注入了生命力，让它在今天获得了第二次机会 — — 尽管它早就应该成为全人类的第一选择。
en: These four ideas animate a Third Way that is now enjoying a second chance – though it should have been the first choice all along.

zh: 无法之海
en: The Lawless Sea

zh: 圣地亚哥—法治精神几乎完全不存在，基本没有治理和政策可言。
en: SANTIAGO – The rule of law is almost entirely absent, with virtually no governance or policing.

zh: 非法的、地下的、不受监管的经济活动猖獗。
en: Illegal, unreported, and unregulated economic activities are common.

zh: 强者蹂躏弱者，抢夺不可再生资源。
en: The powerful seize non-renewable resources at the expense of the powerless.

zh: 环境破坏日益加剧。
en: Environmental degradation is on the rise.

zh: 这听起来像是在描述某个失败国家，一个饱受内战摧残的绝望穷国，或是虚构异邦。
en: That may sound like a description of a failed state, a desperately poor country beset by civil war, or a fictional dystopia.

zh: 非也。
en: But it is none of the above.

zh: 有一片接近无政府状态的广袤之地（占地球表面的45 % ） ，它的名字叫作公海。 全球近三分之二的海域处于所有国家的法律辖区之外。
en: The vast region (45% of the earth’s total surface) with next to no governance or rule of law is the high seas – nearly two-thirds of the global ocean that lies outside of any country’s jurisdiction.

zh: 这是如何形成的？
en: How is this possible?

zh: 毕竟，1982年就有了具备法律约束力的联合国海洋法公约（United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea，简称UNCLOS ） ， 166个国家和欧盟在公约上签了字。
en: After all, there is the legally binding 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, which has been ratified by 166 states and the European Union.

zh: 在UNCLOS尚处于谈判阶段时，公海是受保护的，因为它们很难进入。
en: When UNCLOS was negotiated, the high seas were protected because they were inaccessible.

zh: 但科技进步使得资源勘探能够在比以往任何时候更远更深的地方进行。
en: But technological advances have enabled the exploitation of resources to extend farther and deeper than ever before.

zh: 如今，渔船可以全球作业，深海钻井提供的石油和天然气比例日益增加。
en: Fishing vessels can now operate across the ocean, and deep-sea drilling provides a growing proportion of our oil and gas.

zh: UNCLOS已经跟不上时代的发展了。
en: UNCLOS has not kept pace with these developments.

zh: 渔业、航运和海底采掘等行业和活动的监管是各自独立的。
en: Industries and activities such as fisheries, shipping, and seabed mining are all regulated separately.

zh: 对能源生产等新兴公海产业则没有治理框架可言。
en: No governance framework is in place for emerging high-seas industries such as energy production.

zh: 透明和问责情况堪忧，也没有执法活动。
en: Transparency and accountability are weak, and there is little enforcement of rules.

zh: 此外，当局拦截可疑非法活动船只的权力有限。
en: Moreover, the authorities have limited power to intercept vessels suspected of illegal activity.

zh: 结果，针对非法捕鱼、武器和毒品走私、人口贩卖、海盗以及从事恐怖活动船只的国际合作大受掣肘。
en: As a result, international cooperation to counter illegal fishing, smuggling of weapons and drugs, human trafficking, piracy, and the use of vessels in terrorist operations has been greatly hampered.

zh: 结果是可怕的。
en: The consequences are dire.

zh: 海洋是地球的生命支持系统，地球的健康和生产力全仰仗海洋。
en: The ocean is our planet’s life-support-system, keeping it healthy and productive.

zh: 但过度捕捞和污染正在造成严重伤害。
en: But overfishing and pollution are causing tremendous damage.

zh: 海洋废物每年要导致一百万海鸟和100,000海生哺乳动物（海豹、鲸鱼和海豚）因为溺水、窒息或饥饿而死去。
en: Marine debris causes the death by drowning, suffocation, or starvation of some one million seabirds and around 100,000 marine mammals (seals, whales, and dolphins) every year, not to mention the hazard posed to shipping by sea junk.

zh: 塑料污染 — — 包括碎片和进入食物链的有害于人类健康的塑料微粒 — — 正在成为日益严重的问题。
en: Plastic pollution – including pellets and micro plastics that enter food chains and can endanger human health – is a growing problem.

zh: 类似地，温度的升高正在导致海水携氧能力下降。
en: Likewise, rising temperatures are reducing the ocean's oxygen-carrying capacity.

zh: 二氧化碳吸收量的增加正在导致海洋酸化和前所未有的化学和物理性质改变，反过来影响海洋生物和生态系统。
en: The increasing uptake of carbon dioxide is causing ocean acidification and unprecedented changes in chemical and physical conditions, which in turn are affecting marine organisms and ecosystems.

zh: 全球海洋中的每一个生命都在受到威胁。
en: The very life of the global ocean is under threat.

zh: 如今，我们需要将海洋法引入公海，这也是全球海洋委员会（Global Ocean Commission）的初衷。
en: The time has come to bring the rule of law to the high seas.

zh: 全球海洋委员会是由前国家首脑、政府部长和商界领袖组成的独立国际机构。
en: That is the purpose behind the Global Ocean Commission, an independent international body comprising former heads of state, ministers, and business leaders.

zh: 我也是委员之一。
en: I am one of the commissioners.

zh: 上周，我们提出了包括八项改善治理、重塑海洋健康措施的一揽子补救计划。
en: Last week, we proposed a rescue package that offers eight proposals to improve governance and restore ocean health.

zh: 为了强化公海治理，全球海洋委员会呼吁形成一个基于UNCLOS的新协议以保护国家法律管辖区之外区域的生物多样性。
en: To strengthen high-seas governance, the Global Ocean Commission is joining the call for a new agreement under UNCLOS to protect biodiversity beyond national jurisdiction.

zh: 目前只有不到1%的公海海域得到了保护，因此新协议包括了在公海建立保护区的条款，这一点十分关键。
en: Less than 1% of the high seas is currently protected, so it is crucial that this new agreement includes provisions for creating protected areas in the high seas.

zh: 我们还建议采取国际公约为离岸油气开采和生产所造成的经济损失和生态破坏规定责任和补偿。 离岸油气开采和生产活动也应该受到具法律约束力的安全协议的管辖。
en: We are also proposing that an international convention be adopted to establish liability and compensation for both economic losses and ecological damage caused by offshore oil and gas exploration and production, which should also always be subject to legally binding safety protocols.

zh: 尽管已处于过度捕捞状态，但一小撮国家 — — 包括美国、日本和中国，以及欧盟 — — 仍有意识地支持工业公海捕捞。
en: Despite overfishing, a handful of countries – including the United States, Japan, and China, as well as the EU – are artificially supporting industrial high-seas fishing.

zh: 若无补贴，公海捕鱼作业根本无利可图。
en: Without subsidies, high-seas fisheries would not be financially viable.

zh: 我们建议立刻限制公海捕鱼补贴并在五年内取消这项补贴，各国的渔业补贴应该完全透明，并将60%左右用于直接鼓励可持续渔业作业。
en: We are proposing that subsidies be capped immediately and eliminated within five years, and that countries be fully transparent about all fishing subsidies, about 60% of which directly encourage unsustainable practices.

zh: 此外，为了取缔扼住���洋和海洋生命咽喉的非法捕捞，我们呼吁采取强制性身份编号制度，追踪所有公海渔船，并彻底禁止海上转运。
en: Moreover, to eliminate illegal fishing, which strips our oceans of marine life, we are calling for mandatory identification numbers and the tracking of all high-seas fishing vessels, and a total ban on transshipment at sea.

zh: 通过填补漏洞，我们最终将让非法捕捞的渔获无法靠岸、失去市场。
en: By closing loopholes, we will finally close our ports and markets to illegally obtained fish.

zh: 应该由独立的全球海洋问责委员会（Global Ocean Accountability Board，亦是我们建议采取的措施之一）监控所有这些领域的进展。
en: An independent Global Ocean Accountability Board – the creation of which we are also proposing – should monitor progress on all of these fronts.

zh: 如果海洋恶化情况持续，并且不能采取足够的保护措施，那么不出五年，国际社会就不得不考虑将公海 — — 地区渔业管理组织行为有效的区域除外 — — 作为禁止工业捕鱼的保育区。
en: In five years, if ocean decline continues and adequate prevention measures have not been implemented, the international community should consider turning the high seas – with the exception of those areas where action by regional fisheries management organizations is effective – into a regeneration zone where industrial fishing is forbidden.

zh: 我们能够扭转海洋环境恶化的局面。 将恶化循环转变为再生循环。
en: We can reverse ocean degradation, and turn the cycle of decline into a cycle of renewal.

zh: 我们知道需要怎样做重塑海洋健康，但我们无法单枪匹马完成。
en: We know what needs to be done to restore ocean health, but we cannot do it alone.

zh: 带来变化需要政治意愿，也需要政府、企业和公民社会的共同努力。
en: Delivering change will take political will and require joint efforts by governments, businesses, and civil society.

zh: 这可以做到，也必须做到。
en: It can and must be done.

zh: 请加入我们：http : / /missionocean.me。
en: Join our mission at http://missionocean.me.

zh: 现在就必须采取行动。
en: The time to act is now.

zh: 除非我们采取强力治理、动用必要手段执行监管，否则猖獗的盗捕将继续无法无天，将不会有针对深海油气钻井的具有约束力的国际安全标准，塑料污染和废弃捕捞工具将继续增加。
en: Unless we respond with strong governance and the necessary tools to enforce regulations, ruthless pirate fishing will continue with impunity, there will be no binding international safety standards for deep sea oil and gas drilling, and plastic pollution and abandoned fishing gear will continue to proliferate.

zh: 全球海洋生存状况越恶劣，我们的子孙后代的生存状况也会越恶劣。
en: The more the global ocean struggles for life, the more our children and future generations will struggle for theirs.

zh: 阿根廷利用和滥用凯恩斯理论
en: Argentina’s Use and Abuse of Keynes

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯 — — 众所周知，美国共和党总统尼克松曾于1971年公开表示“现在我们都是凯恩斯主义者。
en: BUENOS AIRES – “We are all Keynesians now,” Republican US President Richard Nixon famously said in 1971.

zh: ”阿根廷奉行庇隆主义的经济部长阿克塞尔·基奇洛夫现在和尼克松的看法如出一辙。
en: Today, Axel Kicillof, Argentina’s Peronist economy minister, is echoing this sentiment.

zh: 他究竟是对是错？
en: Is he right?

zh: 基奇洛夫举世闻名因为他是阿根廷对抗所谓秃鹫基金的代表人物，这些基金以几美分的价格购入面值1美元的阿根廷债券，并试图勒索阿根廷全额支付。
en: Kicillof has gained international recognition as the public face of Argentina’s fight against the so-called vulture funds that want to extort full payment on Argentine bonds that they purchased for a few pennies on the dollar.

zh: 但是在加盟克里斯蒂娜·费尔南德斯·基什内尔总统的内阁前，基奇洛夫在阿根廷知识界闻名是因为一本名为回归凯恩斯主义的著作。
en: But, before joining President Cristina Fernández de Kirchner’s cabinet, Kicillof was known in Argentine intellectual circles as the author of the book Volver a Keynes (Return to Keynes).

zh: 上周，在被阿根廷商界精英挤得水泄不通的金色宴会厅讲话时，基奇洛夫将政府政策解释为凯恩斯主义理论的现实应用。
en: Last week, addressing a gilded ballroom packed with the elite of Argentina’s business community, Kicillof explained the government’s policies as a real-world application of Keynesian theories.

zh: 长达一小时的讲话关键点主要有两个。
en: In an hour-long speech, he made two key points.

zh: 首先，基奇洛夫把阿根廷2001年债务违约和2008年全球金融危机间经济快速增长的年份归因为国内总需求的凯恩斯主义景气恢复。
en: First, Kicillof attributed Argentina’s rapid economic growth in the years between its 2001 debt default and the 2008 global financial crisis to a Keynesian reflation of domestic aggregate demand.

zh: 凯恩斯的巨大贡献在于证明市场经济供给并不一定能够创造需求，而这种需求的缺失可能导致的经济衰退本来是可以避免的。
en: Keynes made a tremendous intellectual contribution in showing that supply in a market economy does not necessarily create its own demand, and that demand shortfalls can cause avoidable recessions.

zh: 这样的逻辑在阿根廷能否适用？
en: Is this logic at work in Argentina?

zh: 2001年阿根廷经济崩盘时，民众丢掉工作企业失去信贷，导致国内需求瞬间萎缩。
en: When the Argentine economy imploded in 2001, citizens lost their jobs and firms lost their access to credit, causing domestic demand to collapse.

zh: 产量跌入低谷。
en: Output fell sharply.

zh: 但当阿根廷废除货币与美元1：1挂钩时，实际汇率大幅下降。
en: But, as the country abandoned the one-to-one currency peg to the US dollar, the real exchange rate depreciated.

zh: 这导致了从进口向本国产品的需求转折。
en: This shifted demand away from imports toward domestically produced goods.

zh: 之后粮食出口价格大幅上涨，而这部分出口在阿根廷税收很重，政府收入因此而增加，积累了足够的现金用于增加支出。
en: Next, a sharp rise in the price of food exports, heavily taxed in Argentina, augmented government revenues, providing the cash to finance increased expenditure.

zh: 因为阿根廷几乎孤立于国际金融市场，其央行可以在无惧资本外逃的情况下下调国内利率。
en: Given Argentina’s isolation from world financial markets, its central bank could cut domestic interest rates with limited fear of capital flight.

zh: 财政及货币刺激共同支撑了国内经济快速恢复。
en: The fiscal and monetary impulse supported a rapid recovery.

zh: 乍看上去基奇洛夫似乎很有道理；这确实与教科书式的凯恩斯通货再膨胀极为相似。
en: At first glance, Kicillof seems to be correct; this looks like textbook Keynesian reflation.

zh: 但凯恩斯本人恐怕并不会赞成费尔南德斯及其前任兼丈夫（已故的内斯托尔·基什内尔）所推行的宏观经济政策。
en: But Keynes would not have approved of the macroeconomic policies pursued by Fernández and her predecessor and husband, the late Néstor Kirchner.

zh: 凯恩斯主义政策会首先确保需求不会和供应相差甚远。
en: A Keynesian approach would ensure that demand does not fall short of supply.

zh: 基什内尔夫妇已经确保需求远远大于供给水平。
en: The Kirchners have made sure that demand far exceeds supply.

zh: 阿根廷年通胀率10多年来一直维持在20%甚至更高的事实清楚地说明了这一点 — — 人为冻结的公用产品价格和一而再再而三的消费物价指数操纵掩盖不了真正的现实状况。
en: The fact that Argentina’s annual inflation rate has stood at 20% or more for over a decade clearly illustrates this – and cannot be obscured by frozen utility rates and repeated manipulation of the consumer price index.

zh: 基奇洛夫在讲话中强调的第二点是阿根廷企业和消费者不应向悲观低头。
en: Kicillof’s second point was that Argentina’s businesses and consumers should not succumb to pessimism.

zh: 他提到了凯恩斯的预期自我实现理论，并警告人们如果预期会出问题，那么预期就会变为现实。
en: Alluding to Keynes’s theories about self-fulfilling expectations, he warned that, if people expect things to go wrong, they will.

zh: 凯恩斯的确说过资本主义经济就像一场选美比赛，评委们选出的不是最漂亮的选手，而是他们心目中同事认为最漂亮的。 这一观点非常重要。
en: Keynes did say – and it was a very important insight – that a capitalist economy resembles a beauty contest, with judges voting not for the most beautiful contestant, but for the contestant whom they believe their colleagues will find most beautiful.

zh: 预期的变化可以改变结果。
en: Shifts in expectations can thus alter the outcome.

zh: 但阿根廷人并不是因为其他阿根廷人悲观才对经济持悲观态度。
en: But Argentines are not pessimistic about the economy because other Argentines are pessimistic.

zh: 他们悲观是因为经济基本面疲弱 — — 两者之间有着本质的不同。
en: They are pessimistic because the economy’s fundamentals are weak – a fundamental difference.

zh: 1991年，诺贝尔经济学奖得主保罗·克鲁格曼（也许是当今世界最具威望的凯恩斯主义者）告诉人们预期能否自我实现取决于基本的经济条件。
en: In 1991, the Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman, who is perhaps the world’s leading Keynesian today, showed that whether or not expectations are self-fulfilling depends on underlying economic conditions.

zh: 如果经济基本面非常薄弱，危机迟早会不可避免的发生；如果基本面非常强劲，危机永远不会发生；但如果基本面不上不下，那么危机有且只有在人们预期发生时才会发生。
en: If an economy’s fundamentals are very weak, a crisis will inevitably occur sooner or later; if its fundamentals are very strong, a crisis never happens; and if they are in an intermediate range, a crisis happens if – and only if – people expect one.

zh: 几年前欧元区的情况属于后一种。
en: A couple of years ago, the eurozone was in the latter situation.

zh: 欧洲央行行长德拉吉“不惜一切代价”拯救欧元的承诺即刻阻止了欧元区债务危机。
en: That is why European Central Bank President Mario Draghi’s pledge to do “whatever it takes” to save the euro immediately brought the eurozone’s debt crisis to a halt.

zh: （当然，发展危机仍尚未解除。 ）
en: (The growth crisis, of course, has yet to be resolved.)

zh: 但阿根廷毕竟不是欧元区。
en: But Argentina is not the eurozone.

zh: 无论基奇洛夫说得如何天花乱坠都不可能有德拉吉承诺那样的抚慰效果。
en: There is nothing that Kicillof could say today that would have the soothing effect that Draghi’s promise did.

zh: 今天的阿根廷人感觉很像刚刚踏上奥兹土地的多萝西 — — 他们已经远离了安全熟悉的“堪萨斯”故土。
en: Argentines today feel much like Dorothy did when she first landed in Oz – they are not in the safe and familiar “Kansas” anymore.

zh: 但凯恩斯不应为此承担责任，基奇洛夫和基什内尔才是始作俑者。
en: But Keynes is not to blame. Kicillof and Kirchner are.

zh: 皮克提先生来到拉丁美洲
en: Monsieur Piketty Goes to Latin America

zh: 圣地亚哥—没有什么能比一本法国人写的关于不平等性的书让拉美左翼知识分子更加兴奋的了。
en: SANTIAGO – Few things excite intellectuals of the old Latin American left like a book on inequality written by a Frenchman.

zh: 因此，不难预见，托马斯·皮克提（Thomas Piketty）的《二十一世纪资本论 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）一时洛阳纸贵。
en: So, predictably, Thomas Piketty’s Capital in the Twenty-First Century has been a big hit.

zh: 在此书英文版面世两个月以来，许多人纷纷宣布这位巴黎经济学院（Paris School of Economics）教授的伟大作品确认了此前关于拉美不平等性风险的论断（这一论断往往来自评论者本人 ） 。
en: In the two months since the book’s publication in English, many an essay has been penned claiming that the Paris School of Economics professor’s grand oeuvre confirms earlier claims (usually the author’s own) about the perils of inequality in Latin America.

zh: 皮克提优美地阐述了市场经济中的资本积累动态。
en: Piketty weaves a grand narrative about the dynamics of capital accumulation in a market economy.

zh: 在他现已闻名天下的公式中，如果资本回报高于经济增长率，继承财富将以比公司收入更快的速度增长，资本所有者占国民产出的比例将不断增加。
en: In his now-famous formulation, if the rate of return on capital is greater than the rate of growth of the economy, inherited wealth will grow more quickly than wage income, and the owners of capital will receive an increasing share of national output.

zh: 没人能否认拉美的收入分配不平等性太大。
en: No one can deny that the distribution of income is scandalously unequal in Latin America.

zh: 但皮克提的支持者（其中许多人根本没有读过他的书）可能会感到惊讶，他的理论其实与拉美地区测得的收入分配动态没有什么关系。
en: But it will come as a surprise to Piketty’s boosters (many of whom have yet to read his book) that his theory has little, if anything, to do with the measured dynamics of income distribution in the region.

zh: 皮克提的理论是关于经济学家所谓的收入的功能性分配的，亦即劳动力提供者和资本所有者之间的分配。
en: Piketty’s theory concerns what economists call the functional distribution of income, or the split between providers of labor and owners of capital.

zh: 但在拉美造成严重不和谐的分配不均是关于劳动收入的个人分配的，亦即工薪阶层内部的分配。
en: But the maldistribution that causes so much unease in Latin America concerns the personal distribution of labor income – that is, the split among wage earners.

zh: 这是因为，拉美收入分配数据主要来自家庭调查，这样的调查很少能提供关于皮克提所谓的食利者（他们的收入形式是实际获得的利润、红利或利息）的真实信息。
en: That is because the bulk of income-distribution data in Latin America comes from household surveys, which seldom manage to elicit truthful information about how much Piketty’s rentiers, who receive their income as profits, dividends, or interest, actually earn.

zh: 比如，覆盖范围极广的2009年智利CASEN家庭调查显示，资本收入的分配比劳动收入更加公平。
en: For example, the results from the 2009 CASEN, Chile’s broad-ranging household survey, suggest that capital income is more equally distributed than labor income.

zh: 当然，心智正常的人都不会相信这一点。
en: No one in his right mind should believe this, of course.

zh: 这一结果只表明，股票和债券所有者总是倾向于对政府调查者撒谎。
en: All this result shows is that owners of stocks and bonds tend to lie to government surveyors.

zh: 这反过来揭示了两点关于拉美收入分配的信息 — — 都不容乐观。
en: That, in turn, reveals two bits of information – both grim – about income distribution in Latin America.

zh: 首先，真实个人收入分配 — — 包括所有收入，不论是来自劳动还是来自资本 — — 几乎肯定比新闻标题上所显示的更加糟糕。
