en: First, the true personal distribution of income – comprising all income, whether from labor or from capital – is almost surely worse than commonly cited headline figures suggest.

zh: 其次，即便让皮克提忧心忡忡的资本动态都可以被排除，拉美的收入分配仍将十分扭曲。
en: Second, even if all of the capital dynamics that so concern Piketty could be wished away, the distribution of income in Latin America would still be appallingly skewed.

zh: 分配不均的解决办法也不是仅靠皮克提所提出的高额财富税就足够的。
en: And the cure for that maldistribution does not lie just in the sizeable wealth taxes that Piketty advocates.

zh: 为何不？
en: Why not?

zh: 显然，如果劳动收入是扭曲的，那么将资本收入或资产再分配给穷人就能增加总体平等度。
en: Surely, if labor income is skewed, redistributing capital income or assets to the poor can boost overall equality.

zh: 国际货币基金组织经济学家所撰写的最新论文利用覆盖大量国家的新数据集，相当乐观地指出在不破坏经济增长的情况下增进再分配大有可为。
en: A recent paper by economists at the International Monetary Fund, using a new data set covering many countries, is fairly sanguine about the potential for increased redistribution without undermining economic growth.

zh: 但该论文也提醒人们，税收体系能够再分配的收入是相当有限的。
en: But the paper also offers a reminder that there are limits to how much income the tax system can redistribute.

zh: 作者比较了政府课税和转移支付前后的基尼系数。 （基尼系数是衡量不平等程度的指数，满分为100点，零点表示完全平等，100点表示完全不平等。
en: The authors compare the Gini coefficient (a commonly used 100-point index of inequality, with zero signifying perfect equality and 100 indicating perfect inequality) before and after government taxes and transfers.

zh: ）结果表明，只有少数国家的再分配造成了10点以上的基尼系数变化，并且再平衡���动的基尼系数波动如果超过13点，将对增长造成消极影响。
en: They show that only a handful of countries redistribute enough to make more than a ten-point difference in the coefficient, and that redistribution-fueled swings of more than 13 points do tend to have an adverse effect on growth.

zh: 当然，现实生活中的再分配比这要小得多，至少在拉美是如此。
en: Of course, real-life redistributions, at least in Latin America, are much smaller than that.

zh: 最近由智利总统巴切莱特（Michelle Bachelet）政府提出的税收改革将税收提高了3%的GDP。
en: The tax reform recently proposed by President Michelle Bachelet’s administration in Chile involves raising an additional 3% of GDP.

zh: 即使这笔钱毫无漏出，并且全部用于向贫困智利人的再分配，这项改革也只能将智利基尼系数拉低三点。
en: Even if none of that money leaks and all is redistributed to poorer Chileans, the reform is unlikely to lower the Gini score by more than three points.

zh: 问题在于智利的税后基尼系数在50左右（巴西、哥伦比亚和秘鲁也是如此 ） ， 而发达国家的基尼系数大多在30以下甚至20大几。
en: The problem is that Chile’s after-tax Gini coefficient is approximately 50 (Brazil, Colombia, and Peru have similar figures), while those of the advanced countries are mostly in the low 30’s or even the high 20’s.

zh: 让智利及其某些邻国达到经合组织国家的平等性水平所需要的远不止于税收改革。
en: Turning Chile and some of its neighbors into countries with OECD levels of equality will require a great deal more than tax reform.

zh: 换言之，如果一个社会的初始竞争条件非常不公平，那么这个社会即使经历了规模巨大的财政再分配，不平等程度仍将十分严重。
en: Put differently: if a society’s initial playing field is very uneven, that society will remain quite unequal even after a sizeable fiscal redistribution.

zh: 因此，政策着力点必须也放在耶鲁大学政治学家雅各布·哈克（Jacob Hacker）所谓的“前分配 ” （ pre-distribution）上，即改变市场决定的工资收入结构。
en: The policy focus, therefore, must also be on what Yale University political scientist Jacob Hacker calls “pre-distribution”: changing the market-determined structure of wage incomes.

zh: 改善收入的前分配状况有三种工具。
en: Three main tools are available for improving the pre-distribution of income.

zh: 首先，教育改革 — — 大力强调教师培训 — — 能让低收入公民具备可在劳动力市场提供的新技能。
en: First, education reform – with a strong emphasis on technical training – would endow low-income citizens with new skills that they could supply in the labor market.

zh: 其次，定向产业政策能创造出这些工人以及他们新获得的技能的需求。
en: Second, targeted industrial policy would create the demand for those workers and their newly acquired skills.

zh: 第三，劳动力市场现代化能在日益趋异的背景下更有效地匹配工人技能和企业的特殊需要。
en: And, third, modernization of labor markets would lead to more efficient matching of workers’ skills and firms’ special needs in a context of growing heterogeneity.

zh: 这些政策不是替代性的，而是互补性的：它们必须同时实施。
en: These policies are not substitutes but complements: they must all be undertaken at the same time.

zh: 这样做决非易事。
en: Doing so is not easy.

zh: 在拉美，左翼政治领导人担心经济和社会正义问题，必须推行适用于本国的方法。
en: In Latin America, center-left political leaders, concerned as they are with economic and social justice, will have to fashion their own country-specific approaches.

zh: 在法国经济学家的皇皇巨著中找不到他们想要的秘方。
en: There is no ready-made recipe awaiting them in a French economist’s magnum opus.

zh: 海洋退化的沉重代价
en: The High Cost of Ocean Decline

zh: 圣地亚哥—地球的海洋陷入了麻烦。
en: SANTIAGO – The world’s oceans are in trouble.

zh: 在刚刚过去的9月，政府间气候变化委员会（Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change）报告说海洋正在变暖，海水正在变酸，氧气浓度正在下降。
en: In late September, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change reported that the oceans are warming, seawater is acidifying, and oxygen concentrations are dropping.

zh: 上周，另一个项目国际海洋状态计划（International Program on the State of the Ocean）列出了以上这些因素和其他因素（比如破坏性捕捞和污染）对海洋生物的影响。
en: Last week, another initiative, the International Program on the State of the Ocean, outlined the toll that these and other factors, such as destructive fishing and pollution, are having on marine life.

zh: 海洋环境恶化不像森林退化那样清晰可见，但其危害并不在其下。
en: Ocean degradation is not as visible as deforestation, but it is at least as dangerous.

zh: 我们所呼吸的氧气中至少有一半来自海洋。
en: The oceans provide at least half of the oxygen we breathe.

zh: 海洋吸收的二氧化碳比森林还要多。
en: They absorb more carbon dioxide than forests do.

zh: 伤害海洋会给全球带来严重影响。
en: Harm to the oceans can have a tremendous global impact.

zh: 环境恶化在由国际治理的广袤公海上尤其严重。
en: Degradation is particularly serious in the one substantial part of the world that is governed internationally – the high seas.

zh: 这些水域处于专属经济区海域之外；它们构成了海洋总面积的三分之二，覆盖了整整45%的地球表面。
en: These waters are outside maritime states’ exclusive economic zones; they comprise two-thirds of the oceans’ area, covering fully 45% of the earth’s surface.

zh: 全球海洋委员会（Global Ocean Commission，这是一项独立项目，我在今年早些时候加入其中）正在检视公海的情况。
en: The Global Ocean Commission, an independent initiative that I joined earlier this year, is reviewing the condition of the high seas.

zh: 明年，全球海洋委员会将给出一系列关于如何让海洋恢复健康、重建生态生产力的建议。
en: Next year, it will produce a set of recommendations concerning how to restore our oceans to full health and ecological productivity.

zh: 首批任务之一是对海洋环境恶化带来的经济损失做出定量分析。
en: One of the first tasks is to quantify the economic losses caused by ocean degradation.

zh: 1997年，克斯坦扎（Robert Costanza）及其同事所撰写的开创性论文推算海洋生态系统功能的总价值为21万亿美元。
en: Back in 1997, a pioneering paper by Robert Costanza and his colleagues put the overall value of marine ecosystem services at $21 trillion.

zh: 其他人估算每年非法捕捞给全球经济造成100—235亿美元损失；渔场管理不善每年造成500亿美元损失。
en: Others have estimated that illegal fishing costs the global economy $10-23.5 billion per year, and poor management of fisheries $50 billion per year.

zh: 但这些都是十年前的数字，全球海洋委员会将对这些数字进行更新，使它们更加准确。
en: But these figures are nearly a decade old; the Commission will update these estimates and make them more precise.

zh: 光证明损失巨大是不够的。
en: It is not enough to document that the losses are big.

zh: 显然，下一个问题是对此应该怎样做。
en: Obviously, the next question is what to do about it.

zh: 没有哪个官方机构对可以对公海完全负责。
en: No single official body has overall responsibility for the high seas.

zh: 因此，即使经济损失远高于先前的估计，目前也没有有效的机制能够改变局面。
en: So, even if the economic losses turn out to be much higher than previous estimates, there are currently few effective mechanisms to bring about change.

zh: 海洋治理的主要支柱 — — 联合国海洋法公约（United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea ） — —是30年前的产物。
en: The basic pillar of ocean governance, the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, was established 30 years ago.

zh: 30年来，技术早已日新月异，对资源的需求也有了极大的增长。
en: Since then, huge technological advances have occurred, and demand for resources has increased massively.

zh: 因此停止并逆转全球海洋环境破坏之势需要改善治理机制，必须通过改善后的机制强化经济可行性和创新性解决方案。
en: So stopping and reversing the degradation of the world’s oceans requires improved governance mechanisms, which must be used to enforce economically sensible and innovative solutions.

zh: 在这方面，具有治理森林退化经验的国家可以起到很大帮助。
en: Here the experience of countries fighting against deforestation is helpful.

zh: 哥斯达黎加的森林治理大约始于20世纪90年代初，该国对化石燃料征税，用所得收入保护森林。
en: Costa Rica arguably started a trend in the early 1990’s, when it began levying taxes on fossil fuels and using the revenue to protect forests.

zh: 净结果是森林退化之势得到了扭转。
en: The net result was a reversal of deforestation.

zh: 哥斯达黎加经济也直接受益于旅游业的增长，间接受益于生态系统功能（如授粉）的保护。
en: The economy has benefited directly through a growth in tourism, and indirectly by preserving ecosystem services such as pollination.

zh: 为生态系统功能而支付的概念目前正在受到全世界各国政府的关注。
en: The concept of payment for ecosystem services is currently receiving attention from governments around the world.

zh: 哥斯达黎加和哥伦比亚都签署了由赞助国政府出资的计划。
en: Costa Rica and Colombia have both signed up to a program funded by donor governments.

zh: 巴西出台了为保护河道而支付的计划。
en: Brazil has schemes that pay for protecting watercourses.

zh: REDD（从森林采伐和森林退化中减少排放）计划将通过奖励森林保护为全球范围的生态系统功能支付，从而校正气候变化。
en: An initiative called REDD (Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation) would pay for ecosystem services on a global scale by rewarding forest conservation, thereby regulating climate change.

zh: 在未来，这些思想应该得到更多的注意，因为我们的不可再生资源供给正在枯竭。
en: These ideas should receive more attention in the future, as our supplies of non-renewable resources dwindle.

zh: 在全球海洋委员会明年发布其改革建议中，经济分析将是核心内容。
en: When the Global Ocean Commission issues its recommendations for reform next year, economics will be at their heart.

zh: 掌握了关于海洋价值的更准确的数据后，我们必须决定如何使用这一信息。
en: Once we have more accurate data on the value of the ocean, we must decide how we use this information.

zh: 为生态系统功能支付时解决方案之一，尽管可能还有更简单的选择。
en: Payment for ecosystem services could be a solution, though there are likely to be simpler options.

zh: 但不管最后采取何种机制，我们都必须解决治理问题：今天的制度健全将导致经济和生态损失持续发生。
en: But whichever mechanism is eventually adopted, we must also address the governance question: today’s inadequate system allows both economic and ecological losses to persist.

zh: 全球海洋委员会将与各国政府共享其建议。
en: The Commission will share its recommendations with governments.

zh: 让当前的自由放任机制继续运行下去会带来极高的代价。
en: There are tremendous costs associated with allowing the current laissez-faire regime to continue.

zh: 我们希望各国领导人明白，地球的海洋 — — 及其所提供的生态系统功能 — — 十分重要，不容我们失败。
en: We hope leaders understand that the world’s oceans – and the ecosystem services they provide – are too important to be allowed to fail.

zh: 长期停滞南进
en: Secular Stagnation Heads South

zh: 圣地亚哥—商品价格重回人间，美联储也将逐渐退出量化宽松，这推高了美国的利率，拉美经济体面临可持续增长的挑战。
en: SANTIAGO – As commodity prices come back to earth and the Federal Reserve’s gradual exit from quantitative easing leads to higher interest rates in the United States, Latin America’s economies face the challenge of sustaining growth.

zh: 2013年，拉美地区主要经济体增长纷纷减速，预计2014年亦将如此。
en: The region’s main economies recorded slower GDP growth in 2013, and much the same is being forecast for 2014.

zh: 如今，显而易见的是，2008—2009年全球经济危机之后几年中拉美的快速增长并非来自革命性的政策变化，而是来自极为有利的外部环境。
en: It is pretty clear by now that an extraordinarily benevolent external environment, not a revolutionary policy shift, underpinned Latin America’s rapid growth in the years following the 2008-2009 global economic crisis.

zh: 只要大豆、小麦、铜、石油和其他原材料价格居高不下，巴西、智利和秘鲁等商品富裕国就能得到很大的提振；甚至经济政策十分糟糕的阿根廷增长也十分迅速。
en: As long as the price of soy, wheat, copper, oil, and other raw materials remained stratospheric, commodity-rich countries like Brazil, Chile, and Peru got a tremendous boost; even Argentina grew rapidly, despite terrible economic policies.

zh: 但如今 ， “ 长期停滞 ” — —自从前美国财政部张拉里·萨默斯（Larry Summers）在去年11月指出美国（或许也包括其他发达经济体）进入了长期的GDP增长萎靡阶段以来，这个新兴概念便成为美国政策争论中的热词 — — 可能将来到拉丁美洲。
en: But now “secular stagnation” – the concept du jour in US policy debates since former Treasury Secretary Larry Summers argued last November that the US (and perhaps other advanced economies) has entered a long period of anemic GDP growth – may also be coming to Latin America.

zh: 道理是这样的：消费者债务高企、人口增长下降和不平等的恶化削弱了消费需求、刺激了储蓄，而生产率和产出本身增长放缓抑制了投资。
en: The argument goes like this: high consumer debt, slowing population growth, and rising income inequality have weakened consumer demand and stimulated savings, while slowing growth in productivity and output itself has discouraged investment.

zh: 因此 ， “ 自然”利率 — — 使投资需求等于储蓄供给的利率 — — 下降了，甚至下降到负水平。
en: So the “natural” rate of interest – the rate at which the demand for investment equals the supply of savings – has fallen, and arguably has become negative.

zh: 但是，由于实际利率不可能处于严重负水平（除非通胀很高，现实并非如此 ） ， 因此就产生了储蓄过剩。
en: But, because real interest rates cannot be strongly negative unless inflation is high (which it is not), there is a savings glut.

zh: 在消费和投资的拖累下，美国经济将注定陷入停滞。
en: With consumption and investment lagging, the US economy is bound to stagnate.

zh: 但这套理论为何适用于拉美呢？ 相比美国，拉美的增长更快、利率更高、内需也更强。
en: But how could such a situation apply to Latin America, where GDP growth is faster, interest rates are higher, and domestic demand is stronger than in the US?

zh: 考察一下拉美的历史。
en: Consider the region’s history.

zh: 在最近的商品驱动繁荣之前，拉美的增长并无亮点可寻。
en: Until the recent commodity-driven boomlet, growth in Latin America was mediocre.

zh: 20世纪80年代饱受债务危机和大规模衰退困扰，被称为“失去的十年 ” ， 与此同时，20世纪90年代的市场改革也未能提振短期增长。
en: The 1980’s are known as the “lost decade,” owing to a debt crisis and massive recessions, while the market-based reforms of the 1990’s did little to reignite short-run growth.

zh: 从1996年到2007年，拉美和加勒比地区只有四个国家 — — 巴西、智利、多米尼加和巴拿马 — — 增长快于美国。
en: From 1960 to 2007, only four countries in Latin America and the Caribbean – Brazil, Chile, the Dominican Republic, and Panama – grew faster than the US.

zh: 因此未来几年增长率下降只不过是回到了拉美的老路上去，而不是脱离历史轨迹。
en: So meager growth in the coming years would be a return to Latin America’s historical pattern, not a deviation from it.

zh: 这把我们拉回了长期停滞。
en: That brings us back to secular stagnation.

zh: 诚然，拉美国家平均人均GDP只有美国的四分之一，因此应该比这个北方邻国增长得更快。
en: Yes, Latin American countries’ average per capita GDP is only one-quarter that of the US, so they should be growing faster than their rich northern neighbor.

zh: 问题在于快多少。
en: The question is how much faster.

zh: 在这一背景下，停滞意味着在相当长的时间内，增长率不足以确保生活水平向美国看齐。
en: Stagnation in this context means a growth rate that is too low to ensure convergence toward US living standards within a reasonable period of time.

zh: 与美国不同，拉美经济体的实际产出达到或接近了其潜在水平，因此提振增长需要增加投资。
en: Unlike the US, Latin American economies’ actual output is at or near potential, so growing more means investing more.

zh: 但投资一直令人失望。
en: Yet investment has been disappointing.

zh: 拉美地区的问题不是国内储蓄过多，而是过少。
en: And the region’s problem is not too much domestic savings, but too little.

zh: 拉美国家储蓄占GDP之比平均为18 % ， 而高增长的东亚为30 % 。
en: Latin American countries save 18% of GDP, on average, compared to 30% in fast-growing East Asia.

zh: 因此，每当拉美投资开始增加，就必须从国外拉贷款。
en: As a result, every time investment picks up in Latin America, it has to be financed with loans from abroad.

zh: 外国投资者愿意接受经常项目赤字增加的结果，但有一个限度。
en: Foreign investors are willing to live with the resulting current-account deficits, but only up to a point.

zh: 去年5月，美联储主席伯南克只是轻描淡写地说了几句话 — — 宣布量化宽松终于要告一段落了 — — 便摧毁了这批经常项目赤字占GDP的4%上下的新兴经济体的信心。
en: It took only a few words from Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke last May – announcing the eventual end of quantitative easing – for markets to lose confidence in emerging economies with current-account deficits near or above 4% of GDP.

zh: 巴西受到的冲击尤为严重，但分析师担心拉美地区其他国家同样脆弱。
en: Brazil was the most prominent among the Latin American economies under attack, but analysts worried about similar vulnerabilities elsewhere in the region.

zh: 因此，与过去一样，如今只要外国人感到紧张，拉美的融资和投资就会削减，增长也会受阻。
en: As a result, now, as in the recent past, whenever foreigners get jittery, financing and investment in Latin America are curtailed, and growth suffers.

zh: 拉美地区的储蓄稀缺反映了设计不合理的税收和退休金制度带来的不良激励。
en: The scarcity of savings in the region reflects the weak incentives embedded in poorly designed tax and pension systems.

zh: 但储蓄表现也与长期财政问题有关。
en: But savings performance is also related to long-standing fiscal problems.

zh: 诚然，在2007年前，许多拉美经济体的财政状况有所改善，因此智利等国家能够实施强有力的反危机财政措施。
en: To be sure, the fiscal stance improved in many Latin American economies in the years leading up to 2007, so countries like Chile were able to mount a strong anti-crisis fiscal response.

zh: 但是，泛美开发银行（IADB）的一份2013年报告明确指出，财政刺激并不总能在危机过去后及时推出，因此现在拉美地区的财政状况比2007年更加疲软。
en: But, as a 2013 Inter-American Development Bank (IADB) report makes clear, the fiscal stimulus was not always withdrawn in time when the crisis abated, so the fiscal position across the region today is weaker than it was in 2007.

zh: 政府支出的组成也有问题。
en: The composition of government spending is also a problem.

zh: 根据上述IADB报告，投资只占财政总支出的16 % ， 还不到新兴亚洲的比例的一半。
en: According to the same IADB report, investment accounts for only 16% of fiscal outlays, less than half the share in emerging Asia.

zh: 因此拉美长期饱受技术设施赤字的困扰，已成为增长的拖累因素。
en: So Latin America suffers from a longstanding infrastructure deficit, which acts as a drag on growth.

zh: 即使未来国内储蓄有余也不能保证投资的提高。
en: Even abundant domestic savings in the future would not guarantee higher investment.

zh: 企业的投资意愿取决于可以从投资中收获多少产出增量，而目前拉美（以及美国）的生产率增长令人失望。
en: Firms’ eagerness to invest depends on how much additional output they can get out of that investment, and recent productivity growth in Latin America – as in the US – has been disappointing.

zh: 生产率滞后的原因问多，但其中之一是没有事先本地经济结构的多样化。
en: Lagging productivity has many causes, but one is the failure to diversify local economic structures.

zh: 要提高经济的生产率，要么增加效率，要么把资源转移到生产率较高的新部门 — — 这一过程是否发生，可以通过观察出口多样化程度了解。
en: Economies become more productive either by doing what they do more efficiently, or by shifting resources into new sectors in which productivity is higher – a process that can be observed (or not) by looking at export diversification.

zh: 悲惨的事实是，如今大部分拉美国家 — — 墨西哥是个显著的例外 — — 所出口的东西与二十年前几乎没有变化。
en: And the sad fact is that today most Latin American countries – Mexico being a notable exception – export pretty much the same goods that they exported a generation ago.

zh: 这是拉美和东亚的又一显著差异。
en: That is yet another big difference between the region and East Asia.

zh: 因此，拉美经济体能够在商品价格和世界利率回归正常水平的情况下保持增长吗？
en: So, can Latin American economies keep growing once commodity prices and world interest rates edge back toward normality?

zh: 作为拉美人，我们希望答案是肯定的。
en: We in the region hope they can.

zh: 但恢复停滞也是可能的 — — 只有决策者承认这一点并正确地采取预防措施，才能让这一可能性最小化。
en: But a return to stagnation is also a possibility – one that can be minimized only if policymakers acknowledge it and begin taking preventive action right away.

zh: 人文科学危机
en: The Humanities Crisis

zh: 纽约—关于高等教育的未来，全世界的讨论显示出惊人的对称性。
en: NEW YORK – A striking symmetry is emerging in debates about the future of higher education around the world.

zh: 一方面，越来越多的人担心，在推动二十一世纪“知识经济”的领域，如工程和信息技术，美国和许多欧洲国家无法拿出足够的大学毕业生。
en: On the one hand, there is growing concern that the United States and many European countries are failing to prepare enough university graduates in the fields driving the twenty-first century “knowledge economy,” such as engineering and information technology.

zh: 这一担忧导致了教育这一概念的狭隘化，使其专指实践技能的获得。
en: This fear has led to the narrowing of the concept of education to mean the acquisition of practical skills.

zh: 另一方面，一些亚洲国家的担忧则是进入劳动力大军的年轻人经历了充分的技术训练，但缺少足够的“另辟蹊径”经验。
en: On the other hand, the worry in some parts of Asia is that young people entering the work force with strong technical training lack sufficient experience “thinking outside the box.”

zh: 这一担忧正在扩大教育范围、纳入对感觉和想象的培养的初步努力中逐渐显现。
en: This fear is manifesting itself in an incipient effort to expand education to include the cultivation of feeling and imagination.

zh: 这两个方向的发展根源都在于经济问题。
en: Both movements are rooted in economic concerns.

zh: 在美国，大部分本科生或多或少都因为大学教育而背上了债务，给予科学、技术、工程和数学（所谓的“干”领域）学费优惠和贷款豁免的政治压力越来越大。
en: In the US, where most undergraduates bear at least part of the cost of their university education, political pressure is mounting to provide incentives like tuition discounts or loan forgiveness to students of science, technology, engineering, or mathematics (the so-called STEM fields).

zh: 将传统的四年学位项目压缩为三年、因此减少和取消文学、哲学和美术等“非实践”选修课程等成本削减措施也在讨论当中。
en: Cost-cutting measures, such as compressing traditional four-year degree programs into three years – thereby reducing or eliminating elective courses in “impractical” subjects like literature, philosophy, and fine arts – are also being discussed.

zh: 与此同时，在中国香港、新加坡和中国，人们要求延长大学教育，使学生获得广泛的文科教育，以期毕业生更倾向于实验和创新。
en: Meanwhile, in Hong Kong, Singapore, and China, there are calls for extending university programs so that students can obtain a broad, liberal education, in the hope that graduates will be more inclined to experiment and innovate.

zh: 比如，香港大学将其本科生项目从三年延长为四年。
en: Hong Kong University, for example, has extended its undergraduate programs from three years to four.

zh: 但这一狭隘的基于经济的观点没有考虑到全球社会所面临的更大的价值问题。
en: But such a narrow, economics-based view fails to account for the larger questions of value that societies worldwide are facing.

zh: 平心而论，任何领域的进步，不管是商业、通信还是健康和环境科学，都将越来越依赖技术创新，因此也越来越依赖推动技术创新的高阶技能，而高阶技能需要强化技术训练才能获得。
en: To be sure, progress in any field, from commerce and communications to health and environmental science, will become increasingly dependent on technological innovation, and thus on the high-order skills – acquired through intensive technical training – that drive it.

zh: 但是，另一个事实是强化技术训练并不能提供解决更抽象但极其重要的问题的充分基础。 这些问题最终将指导全球政策和决策。
en: It is also true, however, that such training does not provide an adequate foundation for addressing the more abstract, but profoundly important, questions that ultimately must guide global policy and decision-making.

zh: 比如：
en: For example:

zh: ·         经济发展的紧迫任务如何与限制气候变化的需要相协调？
en: ·         How can the imperative of economic development be reconciled with the need to limit climate change?

zh: ·         国家主权在疾病、污染和恐怖分子可以随心所欲地穿越边境的世界中意味着什么？
en: ·         What does national sovereignty mean in a world where diseases, pollutants, and terrorists cross national borders at will?

zh: ·         存在超越特殊文化传统观念冲突的普世人权吗？
en: ·         Are there universal human rights that transcend conflicting claims of particular cultural traditions?

zh: ·         应该如何配置有限的资源，从而为年轻人带来机会和希望，同时又让老年人得到尊严和尊重？
en: ·         How should limited resources be distributed in order to provide opportunity and hope to young people, while treating the elderly with dignity and respect?

zh: ·         一国对因迫害、贫困和冲突而到来的外国难民有什么义务？
en: ·         What are a country’s obligations to refugees fleeing from persecution, poverty, or strife elsewhere?

zh: ·         我们如何平衡个人自由和集体安全？
en: ·         How should we balance individual liberty and collective security?

zh: 回答这些问题时，科学和技术的进步（比如能源产品、监控或在线学习的新方法）将起到关键作用。
en: In answering such questions, advances in science and technology (for example, new methods of energy production, surveillance, or online learning) will have a key role to play.

zh: 但道德和伦理问题从来不会有完全技术的解决方案；这些问题还需要对人类社会和文化传统的理解。
en: But moral and ethical questions never yield fully to technical solutions; they also require an understanding of humanity’s social and cultural heritage.

zh: 科学可以帮助我们获得想要的生活，但无法教导我们怎样的生活值得向往。
en: Science can help us to attain the life we want, but it cannot teach us what kind of life is worth wanting.

zh: 简而言之，当前教育争论的双方都是对错参半。
en: In short, each side in the current education debate is half right.

zh: 人类事务变得越来越复杂，对道德的要求越来越严苛，因此我们的子孙后代将需要科学和人文学习的双管齐下 — — 比此前任何时候都需要。
en: As human affairs become increasingly complex and morally exigent, future generations will need both scientific and humanistic learning – and they will need them more than ever.

zh: 幸运的是，让教育更有条理、范围更宽广的很有希望的新模式已经出现。
en: Fortunately, promising new models for making education more coherent and capacious are emerging.

zh: 耶鲁大学和新加坡国立大学共同成立了耶鲁-新加坡国立大学，这是新加坡第一所文科学院。
en: Yale University and the National University of Singapore have worked together to establish Yale-NUS, Singapore’s first liberal arts college.

zh: 这个新成立的寄宿制学院由文科学者和天文学家共同领导，其目标是打破学科界限，让学生能彼此学习。
en: Led by a literary scholar and an astronomer, this new residential college aims to break down interdisciplinary boundaries and enable students to learn from one another.

zh: 类似地，加拿大奎斯特大学（Quest University）鼓励学生同时用科学和人文知识探索当今最紧迫的问题。
en: Likewise, Quest University in Canada encourages students to bring both scientific and humanistic knowledge to bear on today’s most pressing problems.

zh: 美国进行类似尝试也已经多年。
en: Similar efforts have been underway for years in the US.

zh: 比如，北卡罗来纳州立大学的本杰明·富兰克林学者计划 — — 由工学院和人文和社会科学学院合作举办 — — 旨在“培养通才式专业人才，既能用分析方法解决问题，也能做出道德决策，同时又身为高效沟通者 ” 。
en: For example, North Carolina State University’s Benjamin Franklin Scholars program – a collaboration between the College of Engineering and the College of Humanities and Social Sciences – aims “to produce well-rounded professionals who are analytical problem-solvers, ethical decision-makers, and effective communicators.”

zh: 不幸的是，这类计划大多缺少曝光度和影响力，无法决定教育改革走向。
en: Unfortunately, such programs largely lack the visibility and influence needed to shape educational reform.

zh: 应该抛弃让科学与人文对立的“要么/要么”思维，英国化学家兼小说家斯诺（C. P. Snow）五十年前就认识到这是人类进步的一大障碍。
en: It is time to abandon the “either/or” discourse that pits science against humanities – which the British chemist and novelist C.P. Snow identified more than a half-century ago as an obstacle to human progress.

zh: 应该寻找弥合这一推定分歧的办法并推而广之。
en: It is time to seek out best practices that bridge this putative divide, and scale them up.

zh: 在调整教育机构以适应未来的重要工作中，我们决不能忘记已在过去得到充分阐明的教育机构的核心任务。
en: In the important work of adapting educational institutions for the future, we must not lose sight of their core mission as articulated in the past.

zh: 在这方面，做的最好的莫过于本杰明·富兰克林，他既是文学家，也是科学创新者，他把教育定义为对“真正美德”的追求。
en: No one has expressed that mission better than Benjamin Franklin, a man of letters and a scientific innovator, who defined education as the quest for “true merit.”

zh: “真正美德”富兰克林写道，存在于“服务人类、祖国、朋友、亲人的能力和愿望的结合；能力 … … 可以通过真正的学习获得或大大增强；事实上，也应该是所有学习的大目标和终点。
en: “True merit,” Franklin wrote, consists in “an inclination joined with an ability to serve mankind, one’s country, friends, and family; which ability is…to be acquired or greatly increased by true learning; and should, indeed, be the great aim and end of all learning.”

zh: ”每一代人都应该有这样的抱负。
en: This is an aspiration that should be renewed for every generation.

zh: 中国特色的皮克提
en: Piketty with Chinese Characteristics

zh: 香港—托马斯·皮克提（Thomas Piketty）在其畅销书《二十一世纪资本论 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）中指出，资本主义的种种机制加剧了不平等，而这些机制都基于同一个概念 — — r（资本回报）下降得比g（收入增长）更快。
en: HONG KONG – In his bestselling book Capital in the Twenty-First Century, Thomas Piketty argues that capitalism aggravates inequality through several mechanisms, all of which are based on the notion that r (the return on capital) falls less quickly than g (growth in income).

zh: 尽管关于皮克提著作的争论大多集中在发达经济体，但这一基本概念同样适用于近年来中国的经验，因此值得我们进一步深入探讨。
en: While debate about Piketty’s work has focused largely on the advanced economies, this fundamental concept fits China’s recent experience, and thus merits closer examination.

zh: 毫无疑问，大部分中国人都从三十年来前所未有的GDP高速增长中获益。
en: Of course, a large share of China’s population has gained from three decades of unprecedentedly rapid GDP growth.

zh: 构成中国增长模式基础的固定资本投资，总体上已令整体经济受益；比如，基础设施的改善使农村贫困人口的生产率和收入得以提高。
en: The fixed-capital investments that have formed the basis of China’s growth model largely have benefited the entire economy; infrastructure improvements, for example, have enabled the rural poor to increase their productivity and incomes.

zh: 随着投资率增至GDP的一半左右，消费的比重下降到将近三分之一。
en: As the investment rate rose to almost half of GDP, the share of consumption fell to as little as a third.

zh: 政府意识到需要实现增长的再平衡，2011年开始以近两倍于实际GDP增长的速度提高了最低工资，确保普通家庭能够获得更多的可支配收入用于消费。
en: The government, recognizing the need to rebalance growth, began to raise the minimum wage in 2011 at nearly double the rate of real GDP growth, ensuring that the average household had more disposable income to spend.

zh: 但是，房地产价格比工资和制造业利润增长得更快，导致一小部分房地产拥有者的资产回报速度高于中国GDP的增长。
en: But property prices have risen faster than wages and profits in manufacturing, causing the return on capital for a select few real-estate owners to grow faster than China’s GDP.

zh: 这批人还同时从强劲的信贷增长所带来的隐性杠杆中获益。
en: The same group has also benefited from the leverage implied by strong credit growth.

zh: 结果是中国收入最高的1%人群积累财富的速度显著快于世界其他地区的同类群体，更把普通中国人远远抛在后面。
en: As a result, China’s top 1% income earners are accumulating wealth significantly faster than their counterparts in the rest of the world – and far faster than the average Chinese.

zh: 事实上，尽管中国和其他新兴经济体的崛起降低了国家间的不平等性，但国内的不平等性却无处不在地加剧。
en: In fact, while the rise of China and other emerging economies has reduced inequality among countries, domestic inequality has risen almost everywhere.

zh: 皮克提的理论框架强调了这一趋势的几个重要驱动因素。
en: The Piketty framework highlights several drivers of this trend.

zh: 首先，通过降低贸易和投资壁垒，全球化创造了“赢家通吃”的环境，在这个环境中，技术最领先的参与者通过规模经济赢得市场份额。
en: For starters, by lowering trade and investment barriers, globalization has created a sort of winner-take-all environment, in which the most technologically advanced actors have gained market share through economies of scale.

zh: 尤其是随着全球经济转向以知识为基础的价值创造，一些品牌在全球化的高科技创意领域大获全胜，随着全球经济的繁荣，科技股的收益大增。
en: In particular, as the global economy moves toward knowledge-based value creation, a few innovators in global branding, high-technology, and creative industries win big, with the global boom in tech stocks augmenting their gains.

zh: 由此导致的收入、财富和权力高度集中，形成了一些“大而不倒”的经济实体，从而大大破坏了系统稳定性，也阻碍了规模较小的参与者的竞争力。
en: The resulting concentration of revenue, wealth, and power undermines systemic stability by creating too-big-to-fail entities, while hampering smaller players’ ability to compete.

zh: 由于实际的负利率加剧了对居民储蓄的金融抑制，全球金融体系实质上强化了这种收入、财富与权力的集中。
en: The global financial system reinforces this concentration, with negative real interest rates promoting financial repression on household savings.

zh: 鉴于银行更愿意贷款给大企业和有抵押的借款人，中小企业难以获得信用和资本。
en: Given that banks prefer lending to larger enterprises and borrowers with collateral, small and medium-size enterprises struggle to gain access to credit and capital.

zh: 另一个问题是，发达国家央行的非常规货币政策所造成的低利率，导致长期养老基金的资本萎缩，从而减少了退休后的收入。
en: Another problem is that the low interest rates generated by advanced-country central banks’ unconventional monetary policies have led to the “decapitalization” of long-term pension funds, thereby reducing the flow of retirement income into the economy.

zh: 在许多新兴经济体（包���中国 ） ， 对退休后收入不足的普遍担心正在助长家庭储蓄率高企的局面。
en: In many emerging economies, including China, widespread fear of insufficient retirement income is fueling high household saving rates.

zh: 大多数经济学家认为这一不平等加剧的趋势是不可持续的，但对于如何制止这一趋势众说纷纭。
en: Economists largely agree that this trend toward inequality is unsustainable, but they differ on how to curb it.

zh: 右派认为应该通过更多“以市场为基础”的改革来创造财富，左派则支持更多的政府干预。
en: Those on the right argue for more market-based innovation to create wealth, while those on the left argue for more state intervention.

zh: 事实上，这两种方法均可发挥作用，特别是在中国。 中国政府正在采取更加市场化的发展战略，但在经济领域仍保留了相当的控制权。
en: In fact, both approaches have a role to play, particularly in China, where the government is pursuing a more market-oriented growth strategy but retains considerable control over many aspects of the economy.

zh: 中国需要在政策支持的稳定和以市场为导向的发展之间取得平衡。
en: China needs to strike a balance between policy-supported stability and market-driven progress.

zh: 特别是，政策和制度因素导致了重要资源定价过低，从而引起了重大风险。
en: In particular, policy and institutional factors have led to the underpricing of key resources, generating significant risk.

zh: 中国的劳动力大军压低了劳动力价格，阻止经济向高收入、国内消费驱动的增长模式转变。
en: The vast workforce has driven down the price of labor, impeding the transition to a high-income, domestic-consumption-driven growth model.

zh: 同样，没有考虑外部环境因素导致自然资源（如煤炭）定价过低，助长了资源的过度消耗，造成了严重的环境污染问题。
en: Similarly, failure to account for environmental externalities has contributed to the underpricing of natural resources like coal, fueling excessive resource consumption and creating a serious pollution problem.

zh: 此外，旨在稳定汇率、维持低利率的政策导致大项目的资本和风险被低估。
en: Moreover, policies aimed at stabilizing the exchange rate and keeping interest rates low have caused capital and risk to become undervalued in large projects.

zh: 地方政府纷纷通过人为压低价格向投资者出售土地以获得发展资金，这就刺激了大量投资流入房地产开发，导致房地产价格以不可持续的高速度增长。
en: And local governments’ effort to finance development by selling land to investors at artificially low prices has spurred massive investment in real-estate development, causing property prices to rise at unsustainably high rates.

zh: 由于房地产是银行贷款的主要抵押形式，金融风险也随之急剧上升。
en: Given property’s role as the main form of collateral for bank loans, financial risk has risen sharply.

zh: 如今，政府正试图通过赋予利率和汇率更大的灵活性，以降低投资者和地方政府所承担的风险。
en: The government is now attempting to mitigate the risks that investors and local governments have assumed by allowing more interest- and exchange-rate flexibility.

zh: 但这一转型必须谨慎推进，以确保房地产价格不会崩盘。 因为一旦房地产价格崩盘，不良贷款率将会大幅增加，甚至可能引发大规模金融危机。
en: But the transition must be handled carefully to ensure that property prices do not plummet, which would increase the ratio of non-performing loans – and possibly even trigger a major financial crisis.

zh: 为了确保长期社会稳定，中国必须推动包容性的财富创造，例如建立强大的创新激励机制。
en: In order to ensure long-term social stability, China must promote inclusive wealth creation, for example, by establishing strong incentives for innovation.

zh: 华为、腾讯、阿里巴巴等高科技公司的崛起是朝正确方向迈出的一步，尽管我们也需要面对一个现实问题，即这些中国最成功的科技公司都在海外上市因而无法惠及国内的投资者，监管和外汇管制阻止了个人投资从新财富创造中获益。
en: The rise of high-tech companies like Huawei, Tencent, and Alibaba is a step in the right direction, though the fact that the most successful Chinese tech companies are listed overseas, and are thus not available to mainland investors, is problematic. Regulations and exchange controls prevent the retail sector from benefiting from new wealth creation.

zh: 另一个挑战是上证指数从2007年6,000点的峰值跌至今天的2,000点左右。
en: Another challenge lies in the decline in the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index from its 2007 peak of 6,000 to around 2,000 today.

zh: 金融资产不能带来充足的红利或资本增值，从而导致投资者转向投入房地产作为对冲通胀的手段。
en: With financial assets failing to bring adequate dividends or capital appreciation, many investors have switched to real estate as a hedge against inflation.

zh: 中国领导人已开始致力于引导增长模式的转型，即以国内消费和高附加值生产为驱动力的新增长模式。
en: China’s leaders are already working to guide the transition to a growth model driven by domestic consumption and higher-value-added production.

zh: 但他们面临的挑战更加复杂。
en: But the challenge is more complex than that.

zh: 如果能在合适的领域、合适的时间获得市场力量的帮助，新模式将追求确保财富创造的可持续性和财富分配的广泛性。
en: The new model – with the help of market forces, where and when appropriate – seeks to ensure that wealth is created sustainably and shared widely.

zh: 如果这一努力成功，中国梦将得以实现。
en: To succeed would fulfill the Chinese Dream.

zh: 而失败则意味着不平等性将继续在世界范围内加剧。
en: Failure would mean that inequality would continue to fester worldwide.

zh: 中国的次贷风险
en: China’s Subprime Risks

zh: 香港—一个广为接受的观点是，最近的全球金融危机实际上是一场资产负债表危机。
en: HONG KONG – It is now widely accepted that the recent global financial crisis was actually a balance-sheet crisis.

zh: 美国长时间的负利率助长了不可持续的资产购买融资热潮，而高风险按揭破坏了美国的国家资产负债表。
en: Long periods of negative interest rates facilitated the unsustainable financing of asset purchases, with high-risk mortgages weakening national balance sheets.

zh: 当关键的银行间市场流动性枯竭时，脆弱性就暴露无遗，并且产生了灾难性后果。
en: When liquidity in the key interbank markets dried up, the fragilities were exposed – with devastating consequences.

zh: 如今，中国金融机构资产负债表快速扩张 — — 从2007年到2011年共增长92 % ， 而名义GDP增长为78 % — —正在让越来越多的人预测中国很快就会经历其自身的次贷危机。
en: Today, the rapid expansion of Chinese financial institutions’ balance sheets – which grew by 92% from 2007 to 2011, alongside 78% nominal GDP growth – is fueling predictions that the country will soon experience its own subprime meltdown.

zh: 这样的预测有合理性吗？
en: Is there any merit to such forecasts?

zh: 评估中国经济脆弱性的第一步是区分偿债能力危机和流动性危机。 偿债能力危机发生在企业没有足够资本抵御资产价格崩盘时。
en: The first step in assessing China’s financial vulnerability is to distinguish a solvency crisis, which can occur when firms lack sufficient capital to withstand an asset-price meltdown, from a liquidity crisis.

zh: 20世纪90年代亚洲金融危机期间，一些国家经历了外汇危机，贬值和高利率使银行和企业资本流失殆尽，因为它们缺少足够的储备偿还外汇债务。
en: During the Asian financial crisis of the 1990s, some countries suffered foreign-exchange crises, in which devaluation and high real interest rates de-capitalized banks and enterprises, owing to the lack of sufficient reserves to repay foreign-exchange debts.

zh: 在1989年日本资产价格危机中（2008年的美国也是如此 ） ， 银行资本重组和央行流动性支持重塑了市场的信心。
en: In the case of Japan’s asset-price collapse in 1989, and again in the United States in 2008, bank recapitalization and central-bank liquidity support restored market confidence.

zh: 中国社会科学院最新发布的国家资产负债表报告（http : / /cass.cssn.cn/baokanchuban/xinshukuaidi/201403/t20140318_1033767.html） 表明，中国不太可能经历外汇短缺或国家资产负债表失衡型的破产危机。
en: The recently released Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (CASS) National Balance Sheet Report suggests that China is unlikely to undergo a foreign-exchange or national insolvency crisis.

zh: 2011年底，中央政府净资产为87万亿人民币，占GDP的192 % ， 其中33万亿为国有企业的股本。
en: At the end of 2011, the central government’s net assets amounted to CN¥87 trillion ($14 trillion), or 192% of GDP, of which CN¥33 trillion comprised equity in state-owned enterprises (SOEs).

zh: 此外，截至去年底，中国净外汇头寸为2万亿美元 — — 相当于GDP的21 % — —总外汇储备略低于4万亿美元。
en: Moreover, at the end of last year, China’s net foreign-exchange position totaled $2 trillion – 21% of GDP – with gross foreign-exchange reserves totaling just under $4 trillion.

zh: 值得关注的是，中国国内债务的快速增加，目前已占GDP的215 % 。
en: The concern is China’s rapidly increasing domestic debt, which currently stands at 215% of GDP.

zh: 自2008年以来，国有企业和所谓的地方政府融资平台一直在使用贷款为大型固定资产投资融资，而非国有企业的借贷通常是通过影子银行 — — 为房地产开发投资融资。
en: Since 2008, SOEs and so-called local-government financing platforms have been using loans to fund massive fixed-asset investments, while private-sector actors have been borrowing – often from the shadow-banking sector – to finance investment in real-estate development.

zh: 过度依赖银行信贷的原因是缺少足够的其它融资渠道，特别是股市的相对欠发达。 中国股市市值只占GDP的37 % ， 而美国为GDP的104 % 。
en: This excessive dependence on credit stems from the lack of adequate funding and the relative underdevelopment of China’s equity markets, with market capitalization amounting to only 37% of GDP, compared to 104% of GDP in the US.

zh: 中国非金融企业债务相当于GDP的113 % ， 美国为72 % ， 日本为99 % 。
en: The debt held by non-financial enterprises amounts to 113% of GDP in China, compared to 72% in the US and 99% in Japan.

zh: 但是，由于中国的大企业多为国有企业，或为地方政府实体，因此它们的债务实际上都是国内主权债务。
en: But, given that the largest enterprises are either state-owned or local-government entities, their debts are essentially domestic sovereign obligations.

zh: 不计国企及地方债务，中国的政府总债务/GDP之比只有53 % ， 远低于美国的80%和日本的226 % ， 因此有充足的空间采取债务-股本互换来解决内债问题。
en: With China’s total government debt/GDP ratio amounting to only 53% – much less than America’s 80% and Japan’s 226% – there is sufficient space to undertake debt-equity swaps to tackle the internal-debt problem.

zh: 当然，中国领导人需要继续进行重大财政改革，包括改善中央和地方政府的收入分配关系。
en: Of course, China’s leaders will also need to pursue major fiscal reforms, including improved revenue-sharing between central and local governments.

zh: 长远来看，政府必须实��更严格的监管以确保地方政府基础设施投资的可持续性，并且不完全依赖于土地出售收入。
en: In the longer term, the authorities must put in place stricter regulations to ensure that local-government infrastructure investments are sustainable and do not depend excessively on revenue from land sales.

zh: 在过渡期间，调整的重担落在了货币政策方面，考虑到生产率较高部门所面临的结构性流动性“趋紧 ” ， 这一挑战尤其艰巨。
en: In the interim, the burden of adjustment will fall largely on monetary policy, which will be particularly challenging given the structural “tightness” in liquidity in the more productive sectors.

zh: 从2007年到2011年，中国货币供给增加了116 % ， 而其外汇储备增加了180 % 。
en: From 2007 to 2011, China’s money supply increased by 116%, whereas its foreign-exchange reserves grew by 180%.

zh: 外汇储备增长超出的部分通过对银行存款采取高达20%的法定储备金比率回收。
en: The excess was mopped up through statutory reserve requirements amounting to as much as 20% of bank deposits.

zh: 因此，国有银行体系饱受掣肘，将剩余信贷额度配置给大企业和能提供足够抵押品的客户，这导致了贷款在地区和部门之间的不平衡分配。
en: With the official banking system thus constrained, it allocated the remaining credit to large enterprises and those with sufficient collateral, resulting in an uneven distribution of loans across regions and sectors.

zh: 结果，大企业 — — 大部分是国企，它们能享受到可观的金融补贴和流动性 — — 在2011年获得了银行总贷款的43 % ； 中小企业则面临金融抑制，包括更高的借贷成本和趋紧的流动性，它们只获得了银行总贷款的27 % 。
en: As a result, large enterprises – mostly SOEs, which enjoy considerable financial subsidies and liquidity – accounted for 43% of total bank loans in 2011; small and medium-size enterprises (SMEs), which face financial repression, including higher borrowing costs and tight liquidity, accounted for only 27%.

zh: 这凸显出两大根本性结构问题。
en: This highlights two fundamental structural imperatives.

zh: 首先，必须遏制大型国企和地方政府的过度投资，因为这些投资降低了资本回报率。
en: First, large SOEs and local governments must be discouraged from over-investing, which undermines the rate of return.

zh: 其次，必须把更多的资本引向中小企业和增长更快的地区和行业，那些地方更有可能创造就业和创新。
en: Second, more capital must be channeled toward SMEs and faster-growing regions, which are more likely to generate jobs and innovation.

zh: 换言之，利率改革必须与资本市场改革齐头并进。 资本市场改革能让生产率更高的部门更容易获得信贷。
en: In other words, interest-rate reforms must be pursued alongside capital-market reforms that boost access to credit by the more productive sectors.

zh: 只有创新所创造的价值超过产能过剩所摧毁的价值，中国才能完成从出口拉动型经济向国内消费和服务推动型经济的转型。
en: China cannot complete its transformation from an export-led economy to one driven by domestic consumption and services unless value creation through innovation exceeds value destruction from excess capacity.

zh: 简言之，尽管拥有强大的国家资产负债表和充足的央行流动性，中国仍面临着局部次贷风险问题。 而为防止过度信贷而设立的高准备金却会导致健康项目面临局部流动性紧缺。
en: In short, despite a strong national balance sheet and ample central-bank liquidity, China is confronting a localized subprime problem, owing partly to high reserve requirements.

zh: 一个令人振奋的举措是央行最近通过向国家开发银行提供直接贷款释放出1万亿元的流动性。 这笔流动性帮助国家开发银行贷给棚户区改造项目，以满足社会包容性投资的需要。
en: One promising move is the central bank’s recent release of CN¥1 trillion in liquidity through direct lending to the China Development Bank for the reconstruction of shanty towns, fulfilling the need for socially inclusive investment.

zh: 与美联储不同，中国央行并未直接购买次贷。
en: Unlike the US Federal Reserve, it has not purchased subprime mortgages.

zh: 成功的关键将是管理好流动性资金的注入和利率改革的顺序，以使纠正地方次级债务的动作不会触发资产价格贬值。
en: The key to success will be to manage the sequence of liquidity injections and interest-rate reforms so that the effort to address local subprime debts does not trigger asset-price deflation, while reducing financial repression that cuts off funding to more productive sectors and regions.

zh: 如果中国能顺利地完成结构性改革，那么它 — — 以及世界其它地区 — — 将能够避免经济硬着陆的后果。
en: If it manages to get these structural reforms right, China – and the rest of the world – will be able to avoid the consequences of a hard economic landing.

zh: 改革中国的双轨经济
en: The Dual Dragon

zh: 香港—海外媒体有关中国经济正再次面临硬着陆风险的讨论越来越多。
en: HONG KONG – China’s economy is again facing the specter of a hard landing.

zh: 房地产泡沫、地方政府债务和难以驾驭的影子银行被认定为潜在巨大金融风险的源头，使政府在化解劳动力成本上涨、信贷过度、污染严重、腐败横行、税收制度落后和国际竞争不断升温等挑战时增加了难度与复杂性。
en: Property bubbles, mounting local-government debt, and wayward shadow-banking activities are generating considerable financial risk, complicating the government’s efforts to address rising labor costs, excessive credit, overwhelming pollution, rampant corruption, an undeveloped tax system, and rising international competition.

zh: 每一个改革的转折点都伴随着潜在的额外风险。
en: And additional risks seem to lurk at almost every turn.

zh: 任何应对经济减速风险的战略都必须考虑中国经济的双轨特征。
en: Any strategy for mitigating the threat of a sharp slowdown must account for the dual nature of China’s economy.

zh: 一方面，中国的一些城市日益现代化并融入全球经济。
en: On the one hand, Chinese cities are becoming increasingly modern and globally engaged.

zh: 中国最具活力的十七个城市已经进入了世界银行所定义的高收入行列，他们合计占11%的全国人口和30%的GDP。 中国也即将取代美国成为世界第一大电子商务市场。
en: Indeed, China’s 17 most dynamic cities – which together account for 11% of the population and about 30% of GDP – have already reached high-income status, as defined by the World Bank, and the country is set to overtake the United States as the world’s top e-commerce market.

zh: 另一方面，中国一半的人口仍生活在农村，大部分收入来自务农。
en: On the other hand, half of China’s population remains rural, deriving a large share of income from agricultural activities.

zh: 根据万事达公司（MasterCard）的数据，中国25%的消费支出仍然使用现金，这表明中国的非正规经济比人们所预测的更为庞大及强劲。
en: According to MasterCard, 25% of consumer payments are still made in cash, implying that China’s informal economy remains much more robust than believed.

zh: 这一双轨特征对中国经济前景有积极影响。
en: This duality has positive implications for China’s economic prospects.

zh: 尽管在过去几十年中，经济增长的主要推动力是沿海的外向型制造业，但随着国内消费的增加，内陆的农村及内向型城市经济将成为增长的强劲引擎。
en: While its coastal manufacturing activities have fueled much of the economy’s growth over the last few decades, the country’s rural, inland economies will remain strong drivers of growth as domestic consumption rises.

zh: 换言之，中国的经济基础比很多人所意识到的规模更大、更为多元化，这意味着中国的潜在增长势头很难被节制。
en: In other words, China has an even larger and more diversified economic base than many realize – implying a degree of growth momentum that would be difficult to lose.

zh: 中国经济的这一特点，以及中国拥有的3.8万亿美元外汇储备和庞大（尽管正在下降）的经常项目盈余，让中国经济不必依赖外国储蓄和投资。
en: It helps that, with $3.8 trillion in foreign-exchange reserves and a large (though declining) current-account surplus, China’s economy does not depend on foreign saving and investment.

zh: 因此，地方政府债务和不良贷款只是国内债务再分配问题。
en: Local-government liabilities and non-performing loans are thus a domestic problem, whose only real spillover effects would stem from debt-redistribution efforts.

zh: 唯一实际的国际溢出效应来自抑制信贷扩张的货币政策和财政紧缩政策有可能降低GDP增长，从而抑制中国对大宗商品的需求。
en: Monetary and fiscal tightening aimed at curtailing credit expansion runs the risk of undermining GDP growth and reducing Chinese demand for commodities.

zh: 这会伤害大宗商品出口型的新兴经济体，而这些经济体中有不少目前已经受到美联储货币政策逆转的影响而面临资本外逃的不佳境况。
en: This would hurt commodity-exporting emerging economies, many of which are already suffering from capital flight, owing to the US Federal Reserve’s ongoing monetary-policy reversal.

zh: 在改革中国的双轨经济时，中国必须小心调整其市场取向的改革战略，以确保一方面不会引发预期之外的新的系统性风险，而另一方面又能克服既得利益对营造公平竞争市场环境的重大改革的抵制。
en: In this dualistic environment, China must calibrate its market-oriented reform strategy carefully to ensure that it does not create any new and unexpected systemic risks, while overcoming the vested interests that resist substantive reforms aimed at leveling the playing field.

zh: 要达到这个目标，中国需要解决当前经济发展中一个突出的双轨经济问题：双轨信用体系及利率双轨制。
en: Achieving this will require that China address another, more problematic dualism in its economy: the two-tiered credit system.

zh: 自2005年以来，在国内储蓄过剩、资本账户严格管制和信贷高速扩张的背景下，中国商业银行的官方利率相对需求一直处于过低水平，而且受限于存款和贷款利率的严格管制。
en: Given excess domestic savings, a tightly controlled capital account, and rapid credit creation, interest rates have been low relative to demand since 2005.

zh: 因此大型国企和地方政府成了唯一能够获得足够廉价信贷进行大规模基础设施等项目投资的借款方。
en: With the formal banking sector subject to strict controls on deposit and lending rates, large state-owned enterprises and local governments were the only entities that could access enough credit to finance large-scale investments like infrastructure projects.

zh: 2008年全球金融危机削弱了中国的出口增长。 此后，民营企业开始向非出口导向类生产和服务业转移，尤其是转向暴利的房地产行业。
en: After the 2008 global financial crisis weakened export growth, the private sector began to move toward non-tradable goods and services, particularly property.

zh: 这一转变，加上经常项目盈余降低和大规模基础设施投资，给国内利率造成了上升压力。
en: This shift – together with the declining current-account surplus and massive infrastructure investment – put upward pressure on domestic interest rates.

zh: 尽管当局能够控制官方利率，但非官方利率开始不可遏止地上升，助长了影子银行的快速扩张。
en: While the authorities could keep official interest rates under control, unofficial rates began to rise irrepressibly, fueling the rapid expansion of shadow banking.

zh: 宽松及廉价的商业银行官方信贷让房价飙升，70个大中型城市平均房价从2002年的每平米2291元上涨至十年后的5791元。 现在的问题是，这一涨幅有多少来源于实际生产率的提高和经济繁荣而不是来自宽松信贷驱动的投机行为。
en: Easy credit caused property prices to skyrocket, from ¥2,291 ($374) per square meter, on average, in 2002 to ¥5,791 a decade later, as measured in 70 large and medium-size Chinese cities.

zh: 应该指出，新兴工业化经济体，如日本、香港、台湾和韩国，在其经济发展早期都曾经有过基于实际生产率提高的房价涨幅与经济繁荣，但也在后期有过基于信贷膨胀的房地产泡沫。
en: The question now concerns the degree to which this increase reflected rising productivity and prosperity – as did comparable gains in newly industrialized economies like Japan, Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Korea – rather than speculation motivated by easy credit.

zh: ���国表现最佳的前17个城市的生产率大约是香港的三分之一（香港的人均GDP是其的三倍 ） ， 因此这些城市的房价达到香港的三分之一左右不足为奇。
en: Given that China’s 17 top-performing cities are roughly one-third as productive as Hong Kong, where per capita GDP is three times higher, it is not surprising that their property prices amount to about one-third of Hong Kong’s.

zh: 然而，其它一些非一线及表现不佳的城市却面临劳动力及资金外流，他们的房地产热往往沦为外表光鲜的鬼城。
en: But rapidly rising property prices in some of China’s less dynamic cities are leading to outward labor migration, effectively turning them into shiny ghost towns.

zh: 在追求利率自由化的过程中，中国的目标应该是让正式和非正式利率并轨，这需要宏观和微观层面的双管齐下。
en: In pursuing interest-rate liberalization, China must unify formal and informal rates, which requires action at both the macro and micro levels.

zh: 具体而言，中国需要改革微观制度，以促进由市场主导的创造性调整过程，比如通过破产程序制度化帮助处理鬼城和失败的房地产项目，从而最大限度地减少对宏观经济的破坏。
en: Specifically, China’s leaders must reform micro-institutions to facilitate the market-driven process of creative destruction, such as through institutionalized bankruptcy processes that help to eliminate ghost cities and failed real-estate projects, thereby minimizing the associated macroeconomic disruption.

zh: 仅仅依赖收紧信贷总量来限制宏观风险会使问题变得更加复杂。
en: Furthermore, relying largely on tightening credit to limit risks also raises new complications.

zh: 大范围的结构性经济调整及改革深化需要稳健的货币政策和稳定及社会可承受的通胀预期，但在表现良好的实体经济对信贷有持续增长的实际需要的情况下，过度收紧货币政策会影响经济调整过程的顺利展开。
en: While broader structural economic change requires tighter monetary policy and lower inflation, excessively tight monetary policy, given continued high credit demand, could disrupt the adjustment process.

zh: 事实上，货币供应增长的迅速放缓，如从2009年的约25%下降到如今的约14 % ， 恰好伴随着影子银行的快速扩张。
en: In fact, the slowdown in money-supply growth – from roughly 25% in 2009 to roughly 14% today – has paralleled the shadow-banking sector’s rapid expansion.

zh: 2012年底，影子银行占据了总信用规模的24 % ， 其利率比官方利率高出10—15 % 。
en: As of the end of 2012, shadow banking accounted for 24% of total credit, at interest rates 10-15% higher than official rates.

zh: 这个意外的情况增加了市场取向企业的资金成本，从而伤害了实体经济。
en: This has hurt the real economy by increasing the cost of capital.

zh: 除非低效率的官方信贷借款人退出市场或宣布破产，否则他们将继续扭曲资源配置，排挤生产率更高的市场取向企业。
en: Unless inefficient borrowers exit the market or declare bankruptcy, they will continue to disrupt resource allocation, crowding out more productive firms.

zh: 因此，合并双轨的利率及信用体制的关键在于改革信贷资源配置机制，向表现出色的项目提供更多资金，并对表现不佳的借款人施加各种硬约束。
en: The key to merging interest rates thus lies in reforming the credit-allocation mechanism to provide more capital to well-performing projects and enforce hard budget constraints on poor-performing borrowers.

zh: 这难免会触发一些违约并影响银行的贷款组合质量，但这些努力和成本是值得的，会对中国实现更平衡、更健康的经济发展做出重大贡献。
en: While this will inevitably trigger some defaults and erode the quality of banks’ loan portfolios, the end result – a more balanced and healthy economy – will be more than worth it.

zh: 梳理中国的竞争脉络
en: Harnessing China’s Competitive Streak

zh: 香港—中国国务院最近发布了2020年资本市场改革的若干意见，其中提出了两个关键目标 ： “ 维护公开、公平、公正的市场秩序，保护投资者特别是中小投资者的合法权益。
en: HONG KONG – China’s State Council recently unveiled a comprehensive blueprint for capital-market reform until 2020, in which it identifies two key objectives: “to support open, fair, and integral market processes, and to protect investors, particularly the legal rights of small investors.”

zh: ”要实现意见中提出的这些目标，决策者需要权衡市场自主竞争与政府监管、创新与稳定、保护投资者与购者自慎，以及加速改革和务实稳妥之间的平衡。
en: Achieving these goals, as the blueprint recognizes, will require policymakers to weigh market autonomy against state authority, innovation against stability, investor protection against caveat emptor, and the temptation of rapid reform against the need for pragmatism.

zh: 中国有可能实现这些平衡吗？
en: Can it be done?

zh: 从政策角度看，目标应该是在竞争（刺激经济增长但也可能造成不稳定的改革）与合作（有利于长期的社会团结但也有可能导致停滞）之间取得平衡。
en: From a policy perspective, the goal should be to strike a balance between competition (which spurs growth-enhancing innovation but can also generate instability) and cooperation (which promotes long-term social cohesion but can also lead to stagnation).

zh: 在一过程中，中国领导人必须考虑三个层面的竞争：企业间竞争、部门间竞争，以及公民、企业和国家利益间的竞争。
en: In doing so, China’s leaders must account for three levels of competition: inter-enterprise competition, inter-sectoral competition, and competition among the interests of citizens, businesses, and the state.

zh: 企业竞争框架的落实已取得了进展。
en: The implementation of a competition framework for enterprises is a work in progress.

zh: 2008年，政府颁布了“反垄断法 ” ， 旨在防止企业间形成阻碍竞争或“垄断性”的合约，最大限度地减少通过独占市场份额来操纵市场的行为，并阻止可能阻碍或过度限制竞争的并购活动。
en: In 2008, the government enacted an anti-monopoly law aimed at preventing anti-competitive or “monopoly” agreements among enterprises, minimizing abuse of market dominance, and blocking mergers and acquisitions that would eliminate or unduly restrict competition.

zh: 但监管拥有三个主要参与者（国有企业、民营企业与外资企业）的市场竞争是一个复杂的任务。
en: But managing competition in a market that has three major players – state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and domestic and foreign private companies – is a complex task.

zh: 民营企业对国有企业享有的特权十分不满，而外资企业则抱怨它们在与本土公司的竞争中处于下风。
en: Private-sector firms are frustrated with the privileges that SOEs enjoy, while foreign-owned enterprises complain that they are at a disadvantage vis-à-vis domestic companies.

zh: 监管部门间的责任划分则更加复杂。
en: The management of inter-sectoral competition is even more complicated.

zh: 比如，银行业的竞争是非常激烈的，中国也是极少数银行业集中度（五家最大银行所占市场的份额）在最近几年呈现出下降趋势的国家之一。
en: In banking, for example, competition is extremely fierce, and China is one of the few economies where concentration (the market share of the top five players) has declined in recent years.

zh: 但是，在加入世贸组织十多年后，外资银行占中国市场的份额只有 2 % — — 这表明中国还需要改进准入、开放及公平竞争环境。
en: But, more than a decade after China’s accession to the World Trade Organization, foreign banks’ share of the Chinese market stands at a miniscule 2% – a reflection of Chinese regulators’ failure to create a level playing field.

zh: 技术进步和监管套利加剧了这一挑战。
en: The challenge is intensified by technological advances and regulatory arbitrage.

zh: 阿里巴巴等电子商务平台不但侵蚀了银行的支付业务；还开始提供理财产品。
en: E-commerce platforms like Alibaba have not only breached banks’ payment business; they have also begun to offer wealth-management products.

zh: 监管套利则刺激了影子银行与传统金融机构积极竞争理财产品和贷款业务。
en: And regulatory arbitrage has fueled the emergence of shadow banking, which is competing actively with traditional financial institutions for wealth-management and lending business.

zh: 监管套利产生于监管部门间由于责任不清而导致的监管权限的重叠与缺位， 往往会拖延市场发展和体制改革，因为各监管机构间的协调并不容易。
en: Regulatory arbitrage arises from competition among central-government agencies for the authority to regulate – competition that often delays market reforms and institutional change, owing to agencies’ unwillingness to accept one another’s authority.

zh: 比如，中国债券市场至少要接受五个机构和部门的重叠监管，这阻碍了它的发展。
en: For example, overlapping regulation by at least five agencies and ministries has delayed the development of China’s bond market considerably.

zh: 中国良性竞争的最佳范例发生在城市之间。
en: The best example of healthy competition in China is that which occurs among cities.

zh: 中国有287个地级市，人口中位数370万人，人均GDP中位数为5,800美元。
en: China has 287 prefecture-level cities, with a median population of 3.7 million and median per capita GDP of $5,800.

zh: 其中有十六个人口超过三百万的城市已经跨越世界银行的高收入门槛（年人均收入超过12,616美元 ） ， 更有四个城市 — — 北京、上海、广州和深圳 — — 已跻身全球大都市行列。
en: Sixteen cities have already crossed the World Bank’s threshold for high-income status, with annual per capita incomes of more than $12,616, and four – Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen – have global reach.

zh: 这些先锋城市是中国能否跨越中等收入陷阱的关键。
en: These cities hold the key to the ability of China as a whole to avoid the middle-income trap.

zh: 中国经济自1979年以来取得巨大成功的秘诀便是放松中央计划，分权给城市、市场和民营企业去尝试、创新、及增长。
en: That should come as no surprise. The secret of China’s economic success since 1979 has been the easing of central-planning rules to empower cities, markets, and private businesses to experiment, innovate, and grow.

zh: 由于难以确定旧体制中哪些需要改革或淘汰，这一过程得益于中央对地方的放权，因为地方处于更有利的位置来尝试及发现通过建立市场规则来提振经济增长。
en: Given the difficulty of identifying which of the old rules needed to be reformed or eliminated, the process depended on the delegation of central-government powers to local governments, which were better equipped to experiment with market rules to boost economic growth.

zh: 与此同时，为了保证系统的稳定和健全，放权的同时中央政府也上收了财政权和某些市场监督权。
en: At the same time, in order to preserve the system’s stability and integrity, these efforts were accompanied by the centralization of fiscal authority and certain oversight powers.

zh: 这一横向竞争和纵向监管的矩阵式治理平衡是刺激中国城市腾飞和活力的关键。
en: This balance between horizontal competition and vertical regulation was critical to promoting growth and dynamism in Chinese cities.

zh: 但这一治理平衡绝非完美。
en: But the balance has been far from ideal.

zh: 事实上，由于城市GDP增速对地方官员升迁的重要影响，城市间的过度竞争也导致了一些破坏性的失衡。
en: Indeed, competition among cities – intensified by the large role that municipal-level GDP growth plays in determining local officials’ career paths – went too far, creating destabilizing imbalances.

zh: 地方自主竞争有助于实施提高生产率的大胆措施，如农地转工业和商业用途、公私合作的基础设施项目融资方式、及民营企业与国有企业争夺服务业和制造业的市场份额。
en: Yes, local autonomy facilitated bold productivity-enhancing activities, such as the use of rural land for industry and commerce and the creation of public-private partnerships to finance major infrastructure projects; private enterprises were thus able to seize market share from SOEs in the service and manufacturing sectors.

zh: 但城市间争相模仿彼此的增长模式也导致了严重的环境污染 、过度的地方负债、过剩的基础设施、不平等加剧、农地耗竭、 及滥用行政权力侵害国家及公民财产权的腐败行为。
en: But cities’ hasty efforts to imitate one another’s growth models also led to overwhelming environmental pollution, mounting debt, excess infrastructure capacity, rising inequality, depletion of farmland, and rampant corruption, including administrative abuses that encroached on citizens’ property rights.

zh: 由竞争推动的增长已经将中国转变为世界第二大经济体。
en: Competition-fueled growth propelled China’s emergence as the world’s second-largest economy.

zh: 但目前不平衡的增长模式不可持续 。
en: But it is unsustainable.

zh: 现在的任务是实现竞争模式的再平衡，即纠正政府和市场两方面都存在的损害公民利益的负外部性 。
en: The imperative now is to rebalance competition to address the negative externalities of state and market activities that harm citizens’ interests.

zh: 中央政府最近上收了地方政府的一些司法权，从而强化了财产权的保护，这是朝改革迈出的重要一步。
en: The central government’s recent removal of certain judicial powers from local governments, thereby strengthening protection of property rights, is an important step in this direction.

zh: 但这还不够。
en: But it is not enough.

zh: 让市场决定资源配置，并同时确保所有参与者能公平竞争，需要政府设定明确的竞争规则，这或许需要一个强有力的“竞争委员会”来提供支持。
en: Enabling the market to drive resource allocation, while ensuring a level playing field for all participants, will require the establishment of clear competition principles, possibly supported by a powerful “competition commission.”

zh: 没有公开、公平、公正的规则就没有好的竞争。
en: No competition can work without clear, fair rules.

zh: 这是目前中国领导人所面临的真正挑战。
en: That is the real challenge facing China’s leaders today.

zh: 如果他们能够成功应对这一挑战，中国进入高收入行列将只是时间问题。
en: If they succeed, a high-income China will be only a matter of time.

zh: 调整中的政府职能
en: Re-Governing China

zh: 北京—今年的中国发展论坛清楚揭示了中国领导人准备如何实现“中国梦 ” 。 习近平主席将“中国梦”描述为“国家富强、民族振兴、人民幸福。
en: BEIJING – This year’s China Development Forum in Beijing revealed the clearest vision yet of how China’s leaders intend to deliver the “Chinese Dream,” which President Xi Jinping has described as “national rejuvenation, improvement of people’s livelihoods, prosperity, construction of a better society, and military strengthening.”

zh: ” 。 问题在于政府如何贯彻这一宏伟的改革发展计划。
en: The question is whether the government can follow through on its ambitious reform and development plans.

zh: 去年11月的中共十八届三中全会制定了需在2020年前落实的改革方案，涵盖60个领域的330多项重大改革，改革的广度、深度和复杂度前所未有。
en: Last November’s Third Plenum of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party produced more than 330 major reforms in 60 areas for implementation by 2020 – a package of unprecedented scale, depth, and complexity.

zh: 实现中国从以制造和出口为基础的经济模式向由消费和服务驱动的经济模式的转变，即包容性、环境可持续性，同时每年创造1,300多万个就业岗位。 这是一项极其艰巨的任务。
en: Orchestrating China’s transformation from a manufacturing- and export-based economic model to one driven by consumption and services – and that is inclusive, environmentally sustainable, and creates more than 13 million jobs annually – is a massive undertaking.

zh: 除此之外，中国政府还面临维护金融和社会稳定的挑战，与此同时需要管理好世界最庞大的官僚机构。 任务之艰巨令人难以置信。
en: Add to it the challenge of upholding financial and social stability – and accomplishing all of this while managing one of the world’s largest bureaucracies – and the task ahead becomes truly mind-boggling.

zh: 以去年夏天政府财政状况的评估为例。
en: Consider the effort last summer to assess the government’s financial condition.

zh: 国家审计署需要动员55,400位工作人员审查各级政府的账目，包括中央政府以及31个省和自治区、5个直辖市、391个市、2,778个县、33,091个农村社区。
en: The National Audit Office had to mobilize 55,400 staff members to review not only the central government’s accounts, but also those of 31 provinces and autonomous regions, five central municipalities, 391 cities, 2,778 counties, and 33,091 rural communities.

zh: 整个调查涵盖62,215个政府部门和机构、7,170家地方政府融资机构、68,621家公共财政支持的机构、2,235家上市公司以及14,129家其他机构 — — 总计730,065个项目和2,454,635项债务。
en: The investigation covered 62,215 government departments and agencies, 7,170 local-government financing vehicles, 68,621 public finance-supported reporting units, 2,235 public business units, and 14,219 other entities – responsible, altogether, for 730,065 projects and 2,454,635 items of debt.

zh: 显然，中国公共部门的治理与西方截然不同。 西方的结构模式是法治、民主和市场化。
en: Clearly, public-sector governance in China is radically different from that in the West, where the rule of law, democratic elections, and free markets are structural norms.

zh: 尽管35年以来的重大改革带来了巨大变化，民营部门已成为创造就业的主力军，但中国仍有很多方面有待改善 — — 一个显著的例子便是国有部门，特别是地方政府和国有企业仍掌握着中国大部分信贷资源。
en: And, though 35 years of major reforms have brought about considerable change, with the private sector now accounting for the bulk of job creation, there remains much to be done – exemplified in the fact that the state, especially local governments and state-owned enterprises, still command most of China’s credit resources.

zh: 理解中国治理体系复杂性的一个角度是考察机构之间的关系矩阵，即所谓的“条条块块 ” 。
en: One way to appreciate the complexity of China’s governance ecosystem is to examine the matrix of relationships among institutions, the tiao tiao kuai kuai – literally, “lines and pieces.”

zh: “条条”指从中央政府通过国家部门和机关控制地方机构的垂直体系，包括国家发改委，其它重要部委、国有企业和各级地方政府重要职位的任命及升迁，以及宏观经济工具，特别是财政、货币、汇率和监管政策。
en: Tiao tiao refers to the vertical lines of control from the central government through national ministries or agencies to local-level institutions. They include central planning concerning development and reform; the nomination and promotion of officials to important posts in ministries, state-owned enterprises, and local governments at all levels; and macroeconomic tools, particularly fiscal, monetary, exchange-rate, and regulatory policies.

zh: “块块”指地方实体之间高度竞争的横向关系，中央政府在这方面向地方下放了相当的自主权。
en: Kuai kuai refers to the lateral, highly competitive relationships among regional entities, to which the central government delegates a certain amount of autonomy.

zh: 为了实现真正的稳定，中国领导人必须在条条的控制和块块的自主性之间保持巧妙的平衡。
en: In order to achieve genuine stability, China’s leaders must strike a delicate balance between tiao tiao control and kuai kuai autonomy.

zh: 但这是个艰难的任务，放松条条往往不仅带来地方经济快速的增长和公共服务的改善，也造成失衡的加剧和过热高企的风险，原因在于过度的固定资产投资等顺应趋势的羊群行为。
en: But this has proved difficult, with relaxation of tiao tiao often leading not just to rapid regional growth and improvements in local public services, but also to widening imbalances and a heightened risk of overheating, owing to pro-cyclical herding behavior, such as excessive fixed-asset investment.

zh: 所以，中央政府不得不重新启动宏观调控，紧急叫停。
en: The government is then forced to re-impose central control abruptly, bringing about a sudden stop.

zh: 如果把中国经济比作一辆汽车，那么国家领导人一直在交替猛踩油门和刹车。
en: If China’s economy were a car, the country’s leaders would always be either flooring the accelerator or slamming on the brakes.

zh: 最新的改革方案表明，中国政府终于开始尝试政策的微调。
en: With its latest set of reforms, China’s government is attempting finally to fine-tune its approach.

zh: 改革计划将一些责任集中到中央，例如应对既得利益的阻力；同时在另一些领域扩大地方政府自主权，包括执照发放流程和计划批准流程。
en: The package centralizes some responsibilities, such as managing resistance from vested interests, while expanding local-government autonomy in other areas, including procedures for licensing and planning approval.

zh: 政府还建立了自由贸易区（低关税、降低海关壁垒并减少行政干预 ） ， 试图以此加强市场在资源配置中的决定性作用。
en: With the creation of free-trade zones – which entail lower tariffs, reduced customs barriers, and less administrative intervention – the government is attempting to give market forces a decisive role in resource allocation.

zh: 这一措施缓解了对地方机构不必要的约束，将带来市场和制度创新。
en: This effort to ease unnecessary constraints on regional entities will lead to market and institutional innovations.

zh: 这些创新，再加上提高透明度和采用尖端科技，有望遏制寻租和腐败，同时提高生产率和增加就业。
en: These innovations, together with increased transparency and the implementation of cutting-edge technologies, are likely to reduce rent-seeking and corruption, while boosting productivity and employment significantly.

zh: 政府逐步改革户籍制度的最新决定将进一步扩大成果，这使劳动者和民营企业主有机会自主选择在哪里生活、工作和投资。
en: The government’s recent decision to phase out the household registration (hukou) system will augment these gains further, as it gives workers and private business-owners alike the opportunity to choose where to live, work, and invest.

zh: 中国领导人在十八届三中全会上明确指出，消除武断的条条控制能够让各大城市和地方根据自身的比较优势进一步发展。
en: As China’s leaders explicitly recognized at the Third Plenum, the removal of arbitrary tiao tiao controls can enable cities and local communities to evolve according to their own comparative advantages.

zh: 中国的逐步开放，将使越来越多的公司和个人能够出国追求更有吸引力的机会，而这将使中国的治理体系进一步复杂化。
en: But China’s gradual opening up will increasingly allow companies and individuals to cross national borders in search of more lucrative opportunities, complicating the country’s governance matrix further.

zh: 事实上，为了应对市场、资源、人才和全球竞争，中国和全球治理体系需要双向互动。
en: Indeed, coping with global competition for markets, resources, talent, and respect will require a two-way interaction between Chinese and global governance systems.

zh: 中国领导人已经表明，他们知道实施现代管理技术的必要性，也明白这样做需要更新和重新调整长期以来所依赖的中央控制工具。
en: China’s leaders have already demonstrated that they understand the need to implement modern management techniques, and that doing so requires them to update and recalibrate the tools of central control on which they have long relied.

zh: 如果能做出正确的调整，中国的治理体系将能够有效地解决空气和水污染、食品安全、能源效率和贫富不均等问题，并确保中国的长期繁荣。
en: With the right adjustments, China’s governance system can effectively address market failures like air and water pollution, food safety, energy efficiency, and social inequality, while ensuring the country’s long-term prosperity.

zh: 这一过程才刚刚开始，但这仍是个好的开局。
en: This process is only beginning, but it is off to a strong start.

zh: 中国的大都会与鬼城
en: Great Cities and Ghost Towns

zh: 香港—许多观察家喜欢将无人居住的现代“鬼城”作为中国经济即将崩溃的征兆。 这些“鬼城”常常由有风险性的地方政府融资平台提供资金。
en: HONG KONG – Many observers tend to regard the rise of unoccupied modern “ghost towns,” funded through risk-laden local-government financing vehicles (LGFVs), as symptoms of China’s coming collapse.

zh: 但这一观点低估了类似的挑战在发展道路上的必然性，或者更确切的说是必要性。
en: But this view underestimates the inevitability – indeed, the necessity – of such challenges on the path to development.

zh: 2012年，风险资本家威廉·詹韦（William Janeway ）指出，经济发展是一个包括国家、创新型私人企业家和金融资本主义的三方博弈，它必然会产生超调，从而为下一波发明和产出增长创造条件。
en: In 2012, the venture capitalist William Janeway argued that economic development is a three-player game involving the state, private entrepreneurial innovation, and financial capitalism, with inevitable cyclical overshoots that create the conditions for the next wave of invention and output growth.

zh: 美国在十九世纪中叶铁路、矿产和工业化投资兴起后也出现了鬼城。
en: The United States had ghost towns and local bank busts once it began investing in railways, mining, and industrialization in the mid-nineteenth century.

zh: 但美国并没有因此而遭遇超越国界的系统性危机。
en: But it experienced no systemic crisis that spilled over its borders.

zh: 没有大规模基础设施投资，特别是交通投资，就不可能产生让美国跻身世界工业强国的生产率的提升。
en: Without large-scale infrastructure investment, especially in transport, the productivity gains that enabled America’s emergence as an industrial power would have been impossible.

zh: 尽管这一过程包括了巨大的创新性破坏，但经济的高速增长抵消了产能过剩造成的损失。
en: Though the process included significant creative destruction, rapid economic growth offset losses resulting from excess capacity.

zh: 同样，从历史的长镜头看，中国的鬼城也将不过是发展道路上的坑洼。
en: Similarly, when viewed through the long lens of history, China’s ghost towns will prove to be potholes on the path to development.

zh: 主要通过地方政府融资平台融资的大规模基础设施投资，更有可能因其对中国经济现代化的关键贡献而被铭记。
en: China’s massive infrastructure investment, funded largely through LGFVs, will most likely be remembered for its critical contribution to the country’s economic modernization.

zh: 当然，基础设施投资并不一定能转化为经济发展。
en: Of course, the translation of infrastructure investment into economic progress is not guaranteed.

zh: 新的基础设施 — — 以及让中国工人能够有效管理这些设施的在职培训 — — 必须让中国生产力有足够大的提升，才能抵消多余的固定资产被淘汰及闲置而带来的价值毁灭。
en: The new infrastructure – together with on-the-job training that enables Chinese workers to manage it effectively – must boost the country’s productive capacity sufficiently to offset the value destruction from obsolete fixed assets and underemployment.

zh: 从这个角度讲，中国的前景相当乐观。
en: In this sense, China’s prospects are promising.

zh: 目前，中国基础设施投资总值只相当于GDP的240 % ， 比日本的551%低一半有余 — — 并且人口也要年轻得多。
en: As it stands, the total value of infrastructure investment in China amounts to only about 240% of GDP, less than half of Japan’s 551% – and with a much younger population.

zh: 中国人均资本存量仍低于10,000美元，而美国则超过了90,000美元，日本超过了200,000美元（按2011年价格计算 ） 。
en: China’s capital stock remains below $10,000 per capita; that figure is above $90,000 in the US and more than $200,000 in Japan (at 2011 prices).

zh: 此外，每年有大约1%的中国人口 — — 即1200万人 — — 迁往城市。
en: Moreover, roughly 1% of China’s population – about 12 million people – is migrating to cities each year.

zh: 这对改善人民生活、提高能源效率以及实现污染最小化的创新型现代基础设施有巨大需求 — — 特别是在考虑到城市化在经济现代化和生产率提高方面的核心作用。
en: Unrelenting demand for modern, innovative infrastructure that supports citizens’ livelihoods, improves energy efficiency, and minimizes pollution cannot simply be ignored – especially given urbanization’s central role in driving economic modernization and productivity gains.

zh: 尽管地方政府融资平台由于透明度低和政府监管不力而具有一些内在风险，但到目前为止，它们已经融入了中国现代化进程。
en: Though LGFVs carry some intrinsic risks, stemming from relatively low levels of transparency and government supervision, they have been integral to China’s industrialization process so far.

zh: 事实上，它们在20世纪90年代初就已经出现，为上海和广东得以升级基础设施和工业化腾飞做好了准备。
en: Indeed, they emerged in the early 1990s to enable Shanghai and Guangdong to upgrade their infrastructure in preparation for their industrialization drive.

zh: 当初这两个城市都饱受技术和体制性质的局限及外汇和国内信用稀缺的困扰。
en: Both cities suffered from weak technical and institutional capacity and little foreign exchange or domestic credit.

zh: 通过与世界银行和国家开发银行的合作，上海和广东都���立了创新性制度结构，为利益相关方提供法律、会计及管理的合作便利以使具体的基础设施工程得以实施，特别是启用了现代公司的法律和会计工具。
en: By working with the World Bank and the China Development Bank (CDB), Shanghai and Guangdong created an innovative institutional structure to facilitate the coordination of stakeholders to deliver specific infrastructure projects, employing the legal and accounting tools of modern corporations.

zh: 换言之，地方政府融资平台在本质上正是地方经济的现代化平台。
en: In other words, the LGFV is, at its core, a vehicle for local modernization.

zh: 这一制度创新使数百个中国城市得以复兴，并通过机场、高速公路、高速铁路和先进的通讯系统连接在一起。
en: This institutional innovation enabled the reconstruction of hundreds of Chinese cities, connected by airports, highways, high-speed rail, and advanced telecommunication systems.

zh: 在这些结构和连接的支持下，三分之一的中国城市人均GDP已经突破10,000美元。
en: Supported by these structures and linkages, one-third of Chinese cities have attained per capita GDP of more than $10,000.

zh: 此外，最早的地方政府融资平台并没有受到期限错配影响，因为它们是通过长期国开行贷款融资的，地方政府用从完工的基础设施中所获得的税费覆盖运营成本、偿还债务。
en: Moreover, the original LGFVs were not subject to maturity mismatches, because they were funded through long-term CDB loans, with local governments using the fees and taxes they accrued from the completed infrastructure to cover operating costs and service their debt.

zh: 如此，地方政府融资平台还帮助建设了将地方市场与全球价值链连接起来的网络。
en: In this way, LGFVs also helped to create the network linking local markets to global value chains.

zh: 但是，与往常一样，成功总是导致冒进。
en: But, as is often the case, success led to excess.

zh: 全球金融危机后的大规模政府刺激计划促使地方政府以廉价银行贷款及土地为基础，来追求其梦想的基础设施工程。 偏远城市纷纷试图模仿上海、北京或深圳等榜样城市。
en: Massive government stimulus in the wake of the global financial crisis spurred local governments to take loans from Chinese banks to realize dream infrastructure projects, with remote cities attempting to imitate urban showcases like Shanghai or Shenzhen.

zh: 从某种意义上说，这是个积极的进步。
en: In a sense, this was a positive development.

zh: 毕竟，缩小基础设施差距扩大了个人和公司决定在哪里生活或在哪里开设工厂和办事处的选择范围。
en: After all, leveling the infrastructure gap enlarges the range of options from which people and companies can choose when deciding where to live or establish factories and offices.

zh: 但基础设施繁荣的背后有一个关键的因素：即相信地方政府能够轻易获得廉价的信贷、廉价的土地和不断上升的需求。
en: But the infrastructure boom was underpinned by the belief that local governments would always have access to easy credit, cheap land, and rising demand.

zh: 当2011年市场趋紧时，许多工程的前景不再光明，这就刺激了地方政府融资平台转向影子银行寻找信贷机会，进一步导致借贷成本上升，以及来自市场的对改革进程的新挑战。
en: When the market tightened in 2011, many projects’ prospects diminished, spurring LGFVs to seek credit in the shadow banking sector, which has caused their borrowing costs to rise and introduced new market-based challenges to the reform process.

zh: 尽管如此，由于中国是世界的净债权人，因此地方政府融资平台债务并不会对全球金融有系统性冲击。
en: Nonetheless, because China is a net lender to the world, LGFV debt has no global systemic implications.

zh: 2011年末，中国未偿还地方政府债务总额为29万亿人民币，而其土地和固定资产总价值为90万亿人民币，这意味着即使资产价值缩水一半，地方政府作为一个总体仍不会资不抵债。
en: While China’s outstanding local-government debt totaled CN¥29 trillion ($4.7 trillion) at the end of 2011, its land and fixed assets are worth some CN¥90 trillion, meaning that even if asset values were written down by half, local governments would remain solvent.

zh: 这样就只剩下债务偿还及分配问题了。
en: This leaves only the issue of debt servicing.

zh: 为了解决这一问题，中国政府已宣布了财政体制改革，目的是进一步理清中央和地方财政收入的来源及支出责任，特别是允许地方政府能够发行长期市政债券。
en: To resolve it, the government has announced fiscal reforms to split revenues between central and local governments and enable local governments to issue long-term municipal bonds.

zh: 中国的鬼城和地方政府债务并非末日预兆，而只是迈向发达经济道路上的小颠簸，冒进问题必然会得到纠正，要么通过国家，要么通过市场。
en: China’s ghost towns and local-government debts are not harbingers of doom. They are bumps on the road to a developed economy, in which excesses will have to be resolved by the state or the market.

zh: 事实上，从长期看，克服这些挑战将造就更具弹性的强大经济。
en: In fact, overcoming these challenges will make for a more resilient economy in the long run.

zh: 为谁而战？
en: The Coming CLASS War

zh: 香港—十八世纪德国军事战略家克劳塞维茨将战争定义为：政治以不同手段的延续。 与中国古代战略家孙子一样，他认为确保和平意味着为暴力冲突做好了准备。
en: HONG KONG – The eighteenth-century German military strategist Carl von Clausewitz defined war as the continuation of politics by different means, and, like the ancient Chinese strategist Sun Tzu, believed that securing peace meant preparing for violent conflict.

zh: 随着世界变得日益动荡，如乌克兰军事冲突复燃、中东持续混乱以及东亚紧张局势的升级等局势所证实，对战争的这一深刻理解变得非常重要。
en: As the world becomes increasingly tumultuous – apparent in the revival of military struggle in Ukraine, continued chaos in the Middle East, and rising tensions in East Asia – such thinking could not be more relevant.

zh: 传统上，战争围绕领土进行。
en: Wars are traditionally fought over territory.

zh: 但领土的定义包括五个维度：陆地、天空、海洋、空间以及最新出现的网络。
en: But the definition of territory has evolved to incorporate five domains: land, air, sea, space, and, most recently, cyberspace.

zh: 这种多位一体的战争形式反映了当今世界所面临的威胁。
en: These dimensions of “CLASS war” define the threats facing the world today.

zh: 但最重要的问题是：为谁而战？ 战争的具体触发因素、目标和冲突的战线其实主要将由五个因素决定：信仰、种族、文化、气候和货币。
en: The specific triggers, objectives, and battle lines of such conflicts are likely to be determined, to varying degrees, by five factors: creed, clan, culture, climate, and currency.

zh: 事实上，这些因素正在主导全球性的冲突。
en: Indeed, these factors are already fueling conflicts around the world.

zh: 首先，信仰及宗教是历史上最常见的战争动机之一，二十一世纪也不例外。
en: Religion, or creed, is among history’s most common motives for war, and the twenty-first century is no exception.

zh: 以圣战组织的兴盛为例，包括仍在蚕食伊拉克和叙利亚领土的伊斯兰国和在尼日利亚实施野蛮绑架、轰炸和谋杀的博科圣地（Boko Haram）组织。
en: Consider the proliferation of jihadist groups, such as the Islamic State, which continues to seize territory in Iraq and Syria, and Boko Haram, which has been engaged in a brutal campaign of abductions, bombings, and murder in Nigeria.

zh: 还有缅甸和泰国南部佛教徒和穆斯林的暴力冲突，以及菲律宾伊斯兰教徒和天主教徒的暴力冲突。
en: There have also been violent clashes between Buddhists and Muslims in Myanmar and southern Thailand, and between Islamists and Catholics in the Philippines.

zh: 第二个因素 — — 种族，体现于欧洲、土耳其、印度和其它地区日益激烈的种族紧张局势中。
en: The second factor – clan – is manifested in rising ethnic tensions in Europe, Turkey, India, and elsewhere, driven by forces like migration and competition for jobs.

zh: 这些紧张局势的起因是移民和就业竞争等。 在非洲，由殖民者人为划定的边界已难以维持，不同部落和种族群体试图开拓其自身的领土空间。
en: In Africa, artificial borders that were drawn by colonial powers are becoming untenable, as different tribes and ethnic groups attempt to carve out their own territorial spaces.

zh: 而乌克兰的冲突激起了苏联解体后遗留下来的俄罗斯民族压抑已久的怨气。
en: And the conflict in Ukraine mobilizes the long-simmering frustration felt by ethnic Russians who were left behind when the Soviet Union collapsed.

zh: 冲突的第三个潜在因素，是由不同社会独特的历史和制度体系所形成的根本性文化差异。
en: The third potential source of conflict consists in the fundamental cultural differences created by societies’ unique histories and institutional arrangements.

zh: 尽管美国和欧洲人口只占世界的八分之一，但它们长期占据着经济主宰地位 — — GDP约占世界的一半 — — 并拥有不成比例的国际影响力。
en: Despite accounting for only one-eighth of the world’s population, the United States and Europe have long enjoyed economic dominance – accounting for half of global GDP – and disproportionate international influence.

zh: 但是，随着新经济强国的崛起，它们开始日益挑战西方，它们的目标不仅仅是市场份额和资源；它们还将寻求往全球秩序中注入它们自身的文化体系（或软实力 ） 。
en: But, as new economic powerhouses rise, they will increasingly challenge the West, and not just for market share and resources; they will seek to infuse the global order with their own cultural understandings and frames of reference.

zh: 当然，资源竞争也将是重要因素，这与第四个因素，即气候变化有关。 它会使这一问题加剧恶化。
en: Of course, competition for resources will also be important, especially as the consequences of the fourth factor – climate change – manifest themselves.

zh: 许多国家和地区面临着严重的水资源紧缺压力，而随着气候变化导致自然灾害和干旱等极端天气事件日益频繁，缺水的压力还会继续恶化。
en: Many countries and regions are already under severe water stress, which will only intensify as climate change causes natural disasters and extreme weather events like droughts to become increasingly common.

zh: 同样的，随着森林和海洋资源的消耗，粮食竞争也可能导致冲突。
en: Likewise, as forests and marine resources are depleted, competition for food could generate conflict.

zh: 这些冲突与全球化的福音直接相悖。 全球化理应让各国能够获得进口的粮食和能源，从而让各国集中精力发展自身的比较优势。
