en: If we want Europe to be more legitimate, we must explain how to tie these two dimensions of power.

zh: 除了公众不了解里斯本战略和成员国在长期改革领域无所作为外，另一个问题是人们缺乏对竞争优势的清醒认识－竞争是确保品质、创新和低价的有效法宝。
en: Aside from ignorance of the Lisbon Strategy among the public and inaction on long-term reforms among the member states, a second problem concerns the lack of acceptance of the virtues of competition – the most effective way to ensure quality, innovation, and low prices for consumers.

zh: 竞争还能有效抑制寻租问题，取消对传统公司利益的保护。
en: Competition also puts an end to rent seeking and protection of traditional corporate advantages.

zh: 当然，我们必须对竞争的范围严加限制：举例来讲，没有必要在税收领域引入竞争。
en: Of course, we must limit the scope of competition: there is no reason, for example, to extend it to taxation.

zh: 与此相似，尽管竞争能改善研究和教育的质量，但也并不一定要削减公共投资、牺牲基础研究或取消研究基金。
en: Similarly, while competition will improve the quality of research and education, this does not imply reduced public funding, a lower priority for basic research, or the elimination of scholarships.

zh: 竞争可以迫使决策者确保透明和公正，从而成为恢复民主和实现政治机构现代化的有效手段，也许这才是最重要的。
en: Perhaps most importantly, competition is a powerful means to restore democracy and modernize political institutions by compelling policymakers to ensure transparency and accountability.

zh: 所谓的中坚分子必须放弃特权，而调整公司管理必须限制管理者、公仆或政客之间的勾结。
en: Elites must give up their privileges, and regulations on corporate governance must limit collusion between managers and civil servants or politicians.

zh: 我们必须向人们说明欧洲要坚守公众信仰、在经济、政治和社会生活中坚守公平竞争的民主优势。
en: We must explain to citizens Europe’s contribution to public ethics, and the democratic virtues of fair competition in economic, political, and social life.

zh: 如何组织研究和高等教育也是里斯本战略的主要目标之一。
en: Consider one of the main purposes of the Lisbon Strategy: the organization of research and higher education.

zh: 从根本上改变多数成员国任命学者和研究人员的方法，或是彻底改革资助教学和实验人员的标准是不可能的，但欧盟却可以通过建立欧洲示范大学和实验中心，使之成为各国品质和改革的催化剂，成功地逾越各国政府设置的障碍。
en: It is impossible to change radically the way scholars and research workers are appointed in most member states, and to revise completely the criteria for funding of faculties and laboratories. But the EU can overcome national impediments by developing exemplary universities and research centers that would be properly European, serving as an incentive to quality and reform at the national level.

zh: 对优秀榜样的模仿将会成为竞争实力的核心。
en: Emulation through excellence is the motor of competitiveness.

zh: 法国社会党领袖史特劳斯卡恩提出的计划是个不错的开始，他提出欧洲国内生产总值的0.25%用做科研经费，建立欧洲研究所。
en: A good place to start is an idea supported by French Socialist leader Dominique Strauss-Kahn, who has proposed that 0.25% of Europe’s GDP be dedicated to research and used to create a European Agency for Research.

zh: 不仅如此，欧洲必须开发战略分析、评估以及预测激发和催生公众辩论的工具。
en: Moreover, Europe must build up tools for strategic analysis, assessment, and forecasting to provoke and nourish public debate.

zh: 上述整个欧洲范围内的思想家们必须保持自由和独立，而领袖们则需倾听他们的意见，���把他们的建议融入制定决策的过程。
en: Such think tanks at the European level must remain free and independent, but leaders must learn to pay attention to and integrate their recommendations into the policy-making process.

zh: 在属于里斯本战略的很多领域，欧盟都无法回避成员国的忧虑。
en: In many matters pertaining to the Lisbon Strategy, the EU cannot avoid member states’ concerns.

zh: 但由于所有的国家都不可能自行其是，也不会拒绝保持政治控制，我们就必须把欧盟的政策与各成员国的政策很好地结合起来。
en: But as the states won’t be able to do everything alone and won’t renounce maintaining political control, we must be able to link the Union’s policies and those of specific states.

zh: 否则，里斯本战略可能只会造成低效官僚的膨胀，而不是促进欧盟民主的合理化。
en: Otherwise, the Lisbon Strategy could merely empower an inefficient bureaucracy, rather than boosting the EU’s democratic legitimacy.

zh: 简言之，里斯本战略要么会在未来数十年内使欧洲成为真正的巨人，要么会促进“欧洲怀疑论”的进一步滋生。
en: In short, the Lisbon Strategy could lead Europe to become a real power in the coming decades, or it could fuel further growth of Euroskepticism.

zh: 崭新的俄国民主日程
en: A New Democratic Agenda for Russia

zh: 莫斯科 — — 俄国总统德米特里·梅德韦杰夫面对联邦议会发表施政报告的时候，他的讲话似乎针对的是一个先进、繁荣的国家，而不是今天的俄罗斯，这着实令我感到惊讶。
en: MOSCOW – When Russian President Dmitri Medvedev delivered his annual address to the Federal Assembly I was struck by the fact that his speech seemed to be meant for an advanced, prosperous country, not the real Russia of today.

zh: 俄罗斯将在2012年举行总统选举。
en: Russia will hold a presidential election in 2012.

zh: 在我看来，2011年发生事件的意义将超过2012年的选举活动。
en: What happens in 2011 will, in my opinion, be even more important than the election itself.

zh: 事实上，尽管国内反对派拒绝改变，也有人不负责任地将俄罗斯划定为“不可救药的专制国家 ” ， 但社会的发展完全有可能改变俄罗斯的政治。
en: Indeed, the evolution of Russian society could transform Russian politics, despite those domestic opponents who deny change or those who unqualifiedly classify Russia as “incorrigibly authoritarian.”

zh: 但要想实现这一目标，必须在今年制定出新的计划。
en: But, in order for that to happen, a new agenda for Russia must be developed this year.

zh: 十年前，捍卫领土完整和恢复统治秩序曾经是俄国的当务之急。
en: A decade ago, defense of Russia’s territorial integrity and restoration of governability topped the list of priorities.

zh: 民众支持弗拉基米尔·普京总统，后者则致力于稳定俄国秩序。
en: People supported a president, Vladimir Putin, who was devoted to this “stabilization” agenda.

zh: 具体采用的手段和取得的结果虽然有值得商榷之处，但俄罗斯已经克服“生存挑战”却是不争的事实。
en: We may debate the means by which it was pursued, and how successfully, but Russia’s “existential” challenges were largely overcome.

zh: 但稳定局势方面的进展进一步凸显出俄国从未解决的问题，虽然始作俑者不是全球金融危机，但这些问题在全球金融危机中却变得更为严重。
en: But progress on stabilization only highlighted Russia’s unresolved problems, which the global financial crisis exacerbated, but did not cause.

zh: 归根结底，俄国人自己选择了这种去工业化、以资源为基础、并依赖支出驱动的经济发展模式。
en: After all, Russia’s resource-based, de-industrializing, expenditure-driven economy is the result of purely domestic choices.

zh: 影响各级官员并致使俄国失去民主动力的腐败现象随处可见，这些同样不能归咎于全球金融危机的爆发。
en: Nor was it the crisis that gave rise to corruption, which affects officialdom at all levels, or that caused Russia to lose its democratic dynamic.

zh: 我们俄国人继续依赖石油和天然气，而忘记了这些资源不是解决问题的永久方法。
en: We Russians rode along on oil and gas, forgetting that these resources will not last forever.

zh: 但即使在有利的世界市场条件下，我们也未能解决数百万俄国人所面临的贫困问题。
en: But, even with favorable world market conditions, we did not manage to solve the problem of poverty, in which millions of Russians still live.

zh: 我相信俄国的所有麻烦都来自政治。
en: I am convinced that Russia’s troubles all come down to politics.

zh: 我们需要的是竞争性的民主环境，各级官员的积极参与、充满活力的民间社会和真正意义上的公共控制。
en: We need a democratic, competitive environment, initiative at all levels, an active civil society, and real public control.

zh: 只有在这样的环境下才能找到困难问题的解决方案。
en: Only under such conditions will difficult problems lend themselves to solution.

zh: 但从2005－2006年度开始，政府措施几乎杜绝了迅速解决尖锐问题的可能性。
en: But, starting in 2005-2006, the authorities implemented measures that made responsiveness to acute problems practically impossible.

zh: 以任命取代选举产生区域省长，实行政党排名制投票措施、抬高党派进入杜马的选举门槛，以及废止最低投票率的相关规定 — — 所有这些伴随着对选举和公众媒体的疯狂操纵 — — 形成了一套无视社会反馈的政治系统。
en: The decisions to appoint, rather than elect, regional governors, to introduce party-list voting, to raise the electoral threshold for parties to enter the Duma, and to repeal the minimum-turnout requirement – all accompanied by rampant manipulation of elections and the mass media – created a political system closed to feedback from society.

zh: 在这种情况下，政治精英变得固执己见，只顾及自身的狭隘利益也就成了自然而然的事情。
en: Not surprisingly, the political elite became self-absorbed and served only its own narrow interests.

zh: 今年夏天随着莫斯科城外的山林大火，政治精英们的高高在上越来越显示出其危险性。
en: This summer, with wildfires raging outside Moscow, the elite’s isolation took on a menacing nature.

zh: 但同时起作用的还有其他因素： 社会民众的要求越来越高，他们在认识到自身利益的同时也知道如何表达自己的诉求。
en: But something else happened: society became more demanding, recognizing its own interests and knowing how to express them.

zh: 尽管俄国自我管理的传统既不深厚也不强大，但朝着这一目标的真正进展我们每个人都可以看到。
en: Although the traditions of self-organization in Russian society are neither deep nor strong, real movement in this direction became visible for all to see.

zh: 经历过公职人员暴政和腐败的公众活动人士、记者、生态主义者、商人和普通民众都开始参与其中。
en: Activists from public movements, journalists, ecologists, businessmen, and ordinary people who had suffered the tyranny and corruption of public officials began to join in.

zh: 这一点也在某种程度上得到了政府的认可。
en: The authorities have recognized this, at least to some degree.

zh: 梅德韦杰夫面对大规模公众抗议决定暂停莫斯科附近科希姆基森林高速公路的修建就是一项具有重要意义的举措。
en: Medvedev's decision to suspend construction of a highway through the Khimki forest near Moscow in the face of widespread civic protest was important.

zh: 几个月来，莫斯科和联邦政府一直对高速公路的反对者视若无睹，因此梅德韦杰夫的决策向人们发出信号： 不允许轻视民众的要求。
en: For many months, Moscow and federal authorities ignored the highway’s opponents, so Medvedev’s decision was a signal: contempt for the people is inadmissible.

zh: 但就在这项决策做出后不久，官僚机构就试图将公开听证会变成可有可无的形式，而召集听证会的本意是在解决类似问题时将发言权赋予公众和民间机构。
en: Yet right after that, the bureaucracy tried to turn the public hearings – called to give people and civil institutions a voice in solving such problems – into an empty formality.

zh: 因此民主和反民主潮流之间的争斗正在愈演愈烈。
en: So the struggle between democratic and anti-democratic tendencies is becoming acute.

zh: 如果反民主潮流胜出，将会威胁到我们在前些年已经取得的成果 — — 稳定本身也包含其中。
en: If the anti-democratic tendencies win out, all that we have accomplished in previous years will be jeopardized – including stability itself.

zh: 正是在这样的威胁下，梅德韦杰夫才在11月公开表态： 他在自己的博客中写道 ， “ 到某个阶段为止，政治生活已经出现停滞的迹象，将稳定变为停滞因素的威胁也已经产生，这已经不是什么秘密了。 ”
en: This threat evidently motivated Medvedev to speak out in November: “It is no secret,” Medvedev wrote in his blog, “that, as of a certain period, symptoms of stagnation have begun to appear in our political life, and the threat of turning stability into a factor of stagnation has appeared.”

zh: 总统的表态有些出人意料。
en: The president’s statement was unexpected.

zh: 梅德韦杰夫的看法佐证了他对俄国问题源于政治的理解 — — 执政党派的堕落、反对力量的缺失、以及缺乏对少数政治势力的尊���。
en: Medvedev’s assessment attested to his understanding that Russia’s problems are rooted in its politics – in the degradation of the ruling party, in the absence of a real opposition, and in the lack of respect for the rights of political minorities.

zh: 我对梅德韦杰夫关注社会热点及其反官僚言论持欢迎态度。
en: I welcome Medvedev’s emphasis on social concerns and his anti-bureaucratic rhetoric.

zh: 但他的表态不过是制定俄国新计划的第一步，其中首先是要恢复并加快朝着真正有效民主政体的发展速度。
en: But his statements are only a first step toward formulating a new Russian agenda, the first point of which must be a renewal and acceleration of movement toward real and effective democracy.

zh: 重要的是让俄国人相信梅德韦杰夫的言论反应了他的心声，相信他愿意为民众而奋斗。
en: It is vital that Russians believe that Medvedev’s words reflect his priorities, and that he is prepared to fight for them.

zh: 在这些当务之急中间，教育无疑是最重要的项目。
en: Among these priorities, one of the most important is education.

zh: 我们已经接近危险的边缘，宪法有关普及免费教育的规定很可能沦为一纸空文。
en: We have approached the point when the constitutional requirement of universal, free education may become a fiction.

zh: 人们在问： 为什么二战结束后国家都有钱提供免费教育，而今天的政府却做不到？
en: People are asking: How is it that, after World War II, the state had enough money to provide free education, whereas today’s Russian state does not?

zh: 社会民众还要求建立对抗腐败的有效机制，这也正成为日益严重的政治问题，究其原因是这种要求拉大了政府和民众之间的差距。
en: Society also demands effective mechanisms for combating corruption, which is turning into a serious political problem, precisely because it has widened the gap between the people and the authorities.

zh: 事实上，今天的精英人士不能也不会解决这一问题。
en: Indeed, today’s elite cannot or will not solve the problem.

zh: 只有获得民间社会和勇敢政治新势力支持的严肃的总统计划有能力解决这一问题。
en: Only a serious presidential initiative, supported by civil society and brave new political forces, can do the job.

zh: 新计划还必须包含强有力的经济因素。
en: The new agenda must also include a strong economic component.

zh: 对预算方案和具体计划漏洞的修修补补不足以确保经济获得重生。
en: Patching up holes in the budget and individual initiatives are not enough to ensure economic renewal.

zh: 俄国需要取得突破，建设以知识为基础、能在生态领域持续发展的现代经济。
en: Russia needs a breakthrough toward an up-to-date, knowledge-based, and ecologically sustainable economy.

zh: 我认为这与教育问题有着直接的联系。
en: Here, I see a direct connection with the problem of education.

zh: 我确信梅德韦杰夫必将成为制定俄国新计划的领袖，而他必须在即将到来的一年采取措施。
en: I am convinced that Medvedev must become the leader in the process of formulating the new Russian agenda, and he must act in the coming year.

zh: 他将获得社会民众的支持。
en: Society will support him.

zh: 去风险再临
en: De-Risking Revisited

zh: 纽约—在金融市场最新一波动荡发生前，大量风险资产（包括股票、政府债券和商品）自去年夏天以来一直在反弹。
en: NEW YORK – Until the recent bout of financial-market turbulence, a variety of risky assets (including equities, government bonds, and commodities) had been rallying since last summer.

zh: 但全世界的经济增长仍保持停滞状态，尽管风险厌恶程度和波动性在下降而资产价格在上升。
en: But, while risk aversion and volatility were falling and asset prices were rising, economic growth remained sluggish throughout the world.

zh: 如今，全球经济要消停了。
en: Now the global economy’s chickens may be coming home to roost.

zh: 与停滞和斗争了二十年的日本不得不祭出安倍经济学来避免五重底衰退。
en: Japan, struggling against two decades of stagnation and deflation, had to resort to Abenomics to avoid a quintuple-dip recession.

zh: 在英国，自去年夏天开始的争论便集中于三重底衰退。
en: In the United Kingdom, the debate since last summer has focused on the prospect of a triple-dip recession.

zh: 大部分欧元区国家仍陷在严重的衰退中，如今已从外围蔓延至核心。
en: Most of the eurozone remains mired in a severe recession – now spreading from the periphery to parts of the core.

zh: 即使在美国，经济表现也毫无亮点，过去几个季度的增长率一直徘徊在1.5 % 。
en: Even in the United States, economic performance has remained mediocre, with growth hovering around 1.5% for the last few quarters.

zh: 而如今，世界经济的宠儿新兴市场也无法扭转颓势了。
en: And now the darlings of the world economy, emerging markets, have proved unable to reverse their own slowdowns.

zh: 据IMF的数据，中国年GDP增长已从2010年的10%放缓至8 % ； 与此同时，印度增长率从11.2%降至5.7 % 。
en: According to the IMF, China’s annual GDP growth has slowed to 8%, from 10% in 2010; over the same period, India’s growth rate slowed from 11.2% to 5.7%.

zh: 俄罗斯、巴西和南非以3%左右的速度增长，其他新兴市场也好不到哪里去。
en: Russia, Brazil, and South Africa are growing at around 3%, and other emerging markets are slowing as well.

zh: 金融和民生的差异（资产价格上升而经济表现弱于预期）可以用三个因素来解释。
en: This gap between Wall Street and Main Street (rising asset prices, despite worse-than-expected economic performance) can be explained by three factors.

zh: 首先，全球经济中的尾部风险（低概率、高冲击事件 ） — —欧元区崩溃、美国掉下财政悬崖、中国经济硬着陆、以色列与伊朗因核扩散问题开战 — — 较一年前有所降低。
en: First, the tail risks (low-probability, high-impact events) in the global economy – a eurozone breakup, the US going over its fiscal cliff, a hard economic landing for China, a war between Israel and Iran over nuclear proliferation – are lower now than they were a year ago.

zh: 其次，尽管发达国家和新兴市场的增长都令人失望，金融市场仍希望更好的经济数据会在2013年下半年和2014年出现，特别是美国和日本，而英国和欧元区会触底，大部分新兴市场会重现活力。
en: Second, while growth has been disappointing in both developed and emerging markets, financial markets remain hopeful that better economic data will emerge in the second half of 2013 and 2014, especially in the US and Japan, with the UK and the eurozone bottoming out and most emerging markets returning to form.

zh: 乐观派反复重申“今年不同了 ” ： 在长时间的痛苦去杠杆时期后，全球经济想必已经站在更强劲增长的起点。
en: Optimists repeat the refrain that “this year is different”: after a prolonged period of painful deleveraging, the global economy supposedly is on the cusp of stronger growth.

zh: 第三，为了应对低增长和低通胀（部分是因为商品价格走低 ） ， 世界主要央行实施了新一轮非常规货币宽松：降低政策利率、前瞻性指引、量化宽松（QE）和信贷宽松。
en: Third, in response to slower growth and lower inflation (owing partly to lower commodity prices), the world’s major central banks pursued another round of unconventional monetary easing: lower policy rates, forward guidance, quantitative easing (QE), and credit easing.

zh: 类似地，许多新兴市场央行也用降低政策利率来对付低增长和低通胀。
en: Likewise, many emerging-market central banks reacted to slower growth and lower inflation by cutting policy rates as well.

zh: 这一流动性寻找收益率的巨潮助长了全球资产价格反弹。
en: This massive wave of liquidity searching for yield fueled temporary asset-price reflation around the world.

zh: 但流动性推动的资产价格反弹存在两大风险。
en: But there were two risks to liquidity-driven asset reflation.

zh: 首先，如果增长不能复苏，不能给出惊喜（从而证明资产价格上涨的合理性 ） ， 最终低增长将压倒流动性带来的浮力，迫使资产价格随着疲软的经济基本面而下跌。
en: First, if growth did not recover and surprise on the upside (in which case high asset prices would be justified), eventually slow growth would dominate the levitational effects of liquidity and force asset prices lower, in line with weaker economic fundamentals.

zh: 其次，有可能一些央行 — — 即美联储 — — 会拔掉插头（或水管 ） ， 退出QE和零政策利率。
en: Second, it was possible that some central banks – namely the Fed – could pull the plug (or hose) by exiting from QE and zero policy rates.

zh: 这带来了近期的金融市场动荡。
en: This brings us to the recent financial-market turbulence.

zh: 今年一二季度表明，中国和其他新兴市场的增长在减速。
en: It was already evident in the first and second quarters of this year that growth in China and other emerging markets was slowing.

zh: 这解释了商品价格和新兴市场股票在最近的动荡之前便开始表现不佳。
en: This explains the underperformance of commodities and emerging-market equities even before the recent turmoil.

zh: 但美联储最近提早退出QE的信号 — — 与中国减速的更有力证据以及中国、日本和欧洲央行没有提供投资者所期待的进一步的货币宽松一起 — — 让新兴市场雪上加霜。
en: But the Fed’s recent signals of an early exit from QE – together with stronger evidence of China’s slowdown and Chinese, Japanese, and European central bankers’ failure to provide the additional monetary easing that investors expected – dealt emerging markets an additional blow.

zh: 这些国家发现自己处于接收端 — — 不仅包括商品价格和股票的修正走势，还包括凶猛的货币重新计价和国本外币固定收益资产。
en: These countries have found themselves on the receiving end not only of a correction in commodity prices and equities, but also of a brutal re-pricing of currencies and both local- and foreign-currency fixed-income assets.

zh: 巴西和其他国家曾抱怨“热钱”流入和“货币战争 ” ， 而如今，它们猛然得到了欲得之物：美联储提早退出QE的可能性。
en: Brazil and other countries that complained about “hot money” inflows and “currency wars,” have now suddenly gotten what they wished for: a likely early end of the Fed’s QE.

zh: 其结果 — — 剧烈的资本反向流动现在正威胁着所有高风险新兴市场资产 — — 一点都不美妙。
en: The consequences – sharp capital-flow reversals that are now hitting all risky emerging-market assets – have not been pretty.

zh: 风险资产的修正走势是暂时性的还是熊市开端取决于几大因素。
en: Whether the correction in risky assets is temporary or the start of a bear market will depend on several factors.

zh: 一是美联储是否会如信号显示那样尽快退出QE。
en: One is whether the Fed will truly exit from QE as quickly as it signaled.

zh: 极有可能疲软的美国经济增长和更低的通胀将迫使美联储放缓退出流动性支持的节奏。
en: There is a strong likelihood that weaker US growth and lower inflation will force it to slow the pace of its withdrawal of liquidity support.

zh: 另一个变数是其他发达国家的货币政策会如何更加宽松。
en: Another variable is how much easier monetary policies in other developed countries will become.

zh: 日本银行、欧洲央行、英格兰银行和瑞士国民银行均在经济滞后于美国的情况下放松了货币政策。
en: The Bank of Japan, the European Central Bank, the Bank of England, and the Swiss National Bank are already easing policy as their economies’ growth lags that of the US.

zh: 它们后续会怎么走，很大程度上取决于国内情况，以及中国增长放缓将如何威胁亚洲经济、商品出口国和美国以及欧元区。
en: How much further they go may well be influenced in part by domestic conditions and in part by the extent to which weaker growth in China exacerbates downside risks in Asian economies, commodity exporters, and the US and the eurozone.

zh: 中国和其他新兴市场的进一步放缓是金融市场所面临的的又一风险。
en: A further slowdown in China and other emerging economies is another risk to financial markets.

zh: 还有新兴市场决策者如何应对动荡的问题：它们会提高利率以阻止通胀性贬值和资本外流还是降低利率提振萎靡的GDP增长，从而增加通胀和资本流突然逆转的风险？
en: Then there is the question of how emerging-market policymakers respond to the turbulence: Will they raise rates to stem inflationary depreciation and capital outflows, or will they cut rates to boost flagging GDP growth, thus increasing the risk of inflation and of a sudden capital-flow reversal?

zh: 最后还有两个因素：欧元区经济多快见底（最近已出现一些稳定信号，但该货币联盟的长期顽疾并未解决 ） ； 以及中东紧张局势和核扩散危险 — — 以及美国和以色列对此威胁的应对 — — 会逐步升级还是成功遏制。
en: Two final factors include how soon the eurozone economy bottoms out (there have been some recent signs of stabilization, but the monetary union’s chronic problems remain unresolved), and whether Middle East tensions and the threat of nuclear proliferation in the region – and responses to that threat by the US and Israel – escalate or are successfully contained.

zh: 不确定性和波动性的新时代已经开始，并且可能在经济和市场上掀起汹涌波涛。
en: A new period of uncertainty and volatility has begun, and it seems likely to lead to choppy economies and choppy markets.

zh: 事实上，更广阔的金融市场去风险周期也许即将到来。
en: Indeed, a broader de-risking cycle for financial markets could be at hand.

zh: 伊斯兰科学的新时代？
en: A New Era for Islamic Science?

zh: 在数百年的时间里，当科学和数学正经历着一段伟大发明的时代，世界上的一个地区脱颖而出。
en: For a few hundred years, when science and mathematics were enjoying a period of great invention, one region of the world stood out.

zh: 这些学科的大师们在那里倍受尊崇，医药迅猛发展，普通人也对大自然的奥秘充满了好奇。
en: Masters of these disciplines were revered there, medicine advanced quickly, and the average person was curious about how nature worked.

zh: 如是，这一地区也毫不意外地得到全球来自全球的尊敬。
en: Not surprisingly, this region was globally respected.

zh: 而在这个星球已知的另一半，科学家们却被惩罚，甚至惨遭杀戮。
en: In the other half of the known planet, scientists were punished, even killed.

zh: 数学作为非宗教的异端被法律禁止，进而沦为宗教的附庸。
en: Mathematics was outlawed as irreligious and alien, and was later made subservient to religion.

zh: 那里的生活水平也甚为低下。
en: The standard of living was low.

zh: 那片繁荣的地方是伊斯兰教的中东，而相形之下的就是陷于困顿的无知欧洲。
en: The prosperous region was the Islamic Middle East, while an ignorant Europe remained poor.

zh: 两个地区都处于宗教统治之下（历史学家们对这样背景下宗教的作用和特点意见不一 ） ， 但科学只在其中的一个地区得以兴旺。
en: Both regions were religiously governed (historians differ about the role and natures of the religions in this context), but science flourished only in one of them.

zh: 当然，现今伊斯兰教的中东和西方的角色发生了逆转。
en: Now, of course the roles of the Islamic Middle East and the West are reversed.

zh: 自二战以来，美国在科学领域就是毋庸置疑的世界领导者。
en: Since World War II, the United States has been the world’s undisputed leader in science.

zh: 这整个这一时期，世界上最聪明的学生在美国更优越的研究型大学和机遇的吸引下离开祖国。
en: Throughout this period, the brightest students were drawn away from their native lands, attracted by superior research universities and opportunities.

zh: 直到最近，超过半数的美国数学、科学和工程专业的研究生都是外国出生的。
en: Until recently, more than half of all mathematics, science, and engineering graduate students in the US were foreign-born.

zh: 这些人才中的许多人毕业后留在了美国，而美国的业界和政府也乐得其所。
en: Many of these talents stayed after graduation, and both industry and government took advantage of this.

zh: 与此同时，伊斯兰文化却进入了这样一个历史阶段：科学被等同为西方的影响而被疏远。
en: Meanwhile, Islamic cultures entered a historical phase in which science was equated with Western influence and eschewed.

zh: 甚至在石油收入可以支持相当数量的科研的国家，阿拉伯的统治者们也不鼓励这样的投资。 其结果使这些社会没有达到其本应达到的繁荣程度。
en: Even in countries where oil revenues could fuel a significant amount of research, Arab rulers did not encourage such investment, with the result that their societies have not prospered as much as they might have.

zh: 最近，争取更多政治上的尊敬的愿望促使伊斯兰各国投资技术，其中最为显著的就是巴基斯坦和伊朗的核雄心。
en: Recently, a desire for greater political respect has spurred Islamic nations to invest in technology, which is most visible in Pakistani and Iranian nuclear ambitions.

zh: 但是，尽管核武器有一定的政治分量，可支撑它的科学却是普通而陈旧的。
en: But while such weapons carry political weight, the science behind them is mundane and old.

zh: 由培育真正的洞察力而获得的尊敬比用过去的科学发现制造的产品更有意义。
en: More meaningful is the respect that comes from incubating insights, rather than the products of past discoveries.

zh: 想象一个在癌症研究方面处于世界领先地位的巴基斯坦机构所能产生的影响力。
en: Imagine the influence that would be generated by a Pakistani institute that was the world leader in cancer research.

zh: 如果阿曼的研究人员发现了抑制艾滋病的方法，该国的政治话语权又会发生怎样的变化呢？
en: Would the political rhetoric shift if researchers in Oman discovered a key to suppressing AIDS?

zh: 这是一个被忽视的机遇。
en: This is one unclaimed opportunity.

zh: 但另一个机遇也不仅仅只针对伊斯兰社会而存在着。
en: But another exists, and not just for Islamic societies.

zh: 美国最近步步皆错。
en: The US has made profound missteps recently.

zh: 整个政府内部自总统而下 ， “ 事关信仰”替代了科学。
en: “Matters of faith” have been substituted for science across government, from the president down.

zh: 当事实与官方信念发生冲突时，顶尖研究者们的报告就被政治手段纂改。
en: Top researchers have had their reports changed by political operatives when the facts contradicted official belief.

zh: 在一届受到宗教影响的政府的鼓励下，学校系统也将关注的重点从“科学”转移到“价值观 ” 。
en: Encouraged by a religiously influenced administration, school systems are shifting their focus from science to “values.”

zh: 自从2001年的恐怖袭击以来，美国的入境签证配额减少，获得签证也更为困难。 这就影响了年轻人才向美国各大学的流动。
en: Since the terrorist attacks of September 2001, entry visas are fewer and more difficult to obtain, stanching the flow of young talent into US universities.

zh: 主要的科学组织提出过抗议，但却于事无补。
en: Major scientific organizations have protested, without result.

zh: 同时，修改后的税法使得投资者们在短期内变得更为富有，从而遏制了对科研的长期投入。
en: At the same time, tax laws have been revised to make investors wealthier in the near term, discouraging long-term investment in research.

zh: 伊拉克战争获得了五千亿美金的拨款—这一数额几乎等于过去一千年以来在基础研究方面所获得的全部资金支持。
en: Half a trillion dollars was committed to the war in Iraq, an amount roughly equal to the sponsorship of all basic research for the last thousand years.

zh: 即使美国能避免陷入一个原教旨主义的黑暗时代，它也显然面临着丧失全球科研主导地位的风险。
en: Even if the US avoids a fundamentalist dark age, it clearly risks losing its global research dominance.

zh: 在1980年代，日本认识到了政治影响力和科学之间的联系。
en: Japan recognized the link between political clout and science in the 1980’s.

zh: 日本首屈一指的实业家，索尼公司董事长盛田昭夫和右翼政客石原慎太郎发表过一系列的演讲，并在1986年以《日本可以说不》为书名，汇集出版。
en: Japan’s chief industrialist, Akio Morita, the chairman of Sony, and the right-wing politician Shintaro Ishihara gave a series of speeches that were collected and published in 1986 as a book called The Japan that Can Say No.

zh: 他们勾划出了一种以科学领导力产生世界影响力的国家战略。
en: They outlined a national strategy in which world influence was understood to flow from scientific leadership.

zh: 其中的关键理念是：如果军事技术的“食物链”被别国掌控，那么军事力量的概念就过时了。
en: The key idea was that military power could be made obsolete if the “food chain” of military technologies was controlled by other nations.

zh: 该书的标题意指日本在掌握了关键军事技术之后就会对美国的军事影响力说“不 ” 。
en: The book’s title refers to Japan’s plan to “say no” to US military influence once Japan controlled key military technologies.

zh: 以石油创造的财富来打造知识经济是完全可能的。
en: Building a knowledge-based economy using oil wealth is clearly possible.

zh: 例如，德克萨斯州和大多数美国南部各州一样，曾经一度经济落后，并不断恶化。
en: For example, Texas, like most southern US states, was once economically poor and declining.

zh: 它虽然有来自石油的收入，但用美元来为经济输血，就其本身而言，对繁荣的促进程度可能并没有我们想象的那么大。
en: Although it had oil revenue, the flow of dollars into an economy, by itself, does not boost prosperity as much as one might think.

zh: 所以，德克萨斯决定将其石油收益投入一笔教育基金。
en: So Texas decided to devote its oil money to an educational endowment.

zh: 现在，这笔基金的数额可以媲美哈佛大学的家底，并由15所大学分享。
en: Today, that endowment is roughly equal to that of Harvard University and spread over 15 universities.

zh: 其效果也令人惊叹：航天制造业在加州已近绝迹，但在德克萨斯却方兴未艾。
en: The effect has been staggering: aerospace manufacturing has almost disappeared from California, but is booming in Texas.

zh: 电信研究中心和财团纷至沓来，甚至加拿大的电信巨擘北方电信也在此安营扎寨。
en: Telecom research centers and consortia have flocked to Texas, even from the Canadian telecommunications giant Nortel.

zh: 虽然美国的制造业处于危机之中，但德克萨斯的制造经济却是世界最强之一。
en: Although manufacturing in the US is in crisis, Texas has one of the strongest manufacturing economies in the world.

zh: 同样的结果没有理由不能在中东出现。
en: There is no reason that the same outcome could not be achieved in the Middle East.

zh: 然而，伊斯兰世界必须首先重新发现并继承其引以为豪的传统。
en: First, however, the Islamic world must rediscover and embrace its proud heritage.

zh: 欧洲增长新日程
en: ­A New European Growth Agenda

zh: 布鲁塞尔—光靠紧缩无法解决欧洲的经济和金融危机。
en: BRUSSELS – Austerity alone cannot solve Europe's economic and financial crisis.

zh: 增长和就业需要双管齐下。
en: Growth and jobs need to be promoted with equal zeal.

zh: 欧盟领导人现在已经意识到了这一点，在2012年重振增长将是1月30日欧盟委员会会议的有限日程项目。
en: European Union leaders now recognize this: kick-starting growth in 2012 was high on the agenda at the European Council’s meeting on January 30.

zh: 但仍有一个大问题没有解决：如何重振增长？
en: But the big question remains: How?

zh: 显然，我们需要立刻采取行动。
en: The need for immediate action is clear.

zh: 欧元区在2011年第四季度出现了收缩，就连德国也未能幸免。
en: The eurozone’s economy contracted in the last three months of 2011; even Germany’s shrank.

zh: 2012年看起来也不太妙。
en: The new year is looking grim.

zh: 法国和英国步履维艰。
en: France is flat-lining (as is Britain).

zh: 意大利和西班牙已经陷入了深度衰退。
en: Italy and Spain have sunk into deep recession.

zh: 希腊将步入第五个衰退之年。
en: Greece is in its fifth year of a slump.

zh: 欧元区失业率创出了历史新高，在西班牙和希腊，每两个年轻人中就有一个找不到工作。
en: And eurozone unemployment is at record highs, with nearly one in two young people jobless in Spain and Greece.

zh: 经济所面临的困难是巨大的：财政紧缩、AAA以下级别国家的高利率、银行信用的削减、家庭的去杠杆化、疲软的私人部门投资以及因全球减速影响需求而导致的出口下降。
en: The economic headwinds are formidable: fiscal austerity, high interest rates outside AAA-rated countries, credit cutting by banks, deleveraging households, weak private-sector investment, and declining exports as the global slowdown undermines demand.

zh: 除非增长获得重振，否则任何暂时性的财政稳定都是非常脆弱的。
en: Until growth resumes, any tentative financial stabilization will be extremely fragile.

zh: 衰退将冲击银行和政府已然孱弱不堪的资产负债表，加剧去杠杆化的压力。
en: Recession will hit banks’ and governments’ already-weak balance sheets, increasing pressure for faster deleveraging.

zh: 但是，尽管渐进调整才是关键之举，但过快过深的削减很可能会适得其反：私人信用和政府支出的大量削减将导致更剧烈的减速，从而造成衰退的恶性循环。
en: But, while gradual adjustment is essential, faster and deeper cuts are largely self-defeating: big reductions in private credit and government spending will cause a sharper slowdown – and thus a vicious downward spiral.

zh: 因此，新的重磅增长措施必不可少。
en: A big new push for growth is therefore vital.

zh: 到目前为止，增长日程主要由结构性改革组成，这对于提振未来生产率和生产弹性是不必可少的。
en: So far, the growth agenda has consisted largely of structural reforms, which are essential for boosting future productivity and flexibility.

zh: 这场危机也确实为许多国家提供了在该方向上做大动作的政治机会；但总体而言，结构性改革不会立刻产生增长和就业机会（除了允许商店延长营业时间这一措施 ） 。
en: The crisis does provide a political opportunity for bold moves on this front in many countries; but structural reforms generally will not generate growth and jobs immediately (one exception is permitting shops to open longer).

zh: 相反，像淘汰生产率低下的工作岗位这样的措施一开始会抬高失业率，增加政府支出，减少私人支出。
en: On the contrary, a shakeout of less productive jobs, for example, would at first raise unemployment, increase government outlays, and reduce private spending.

zh: 此外，由于需求被压抑着，信用供给不足，而创业壁垒通常较高，因此企业创造高生产率岗位需要比平常耗费更长时间。
en: And, because demand is depressed, credit is in short supply, and barriers to enterprise are often high, it will take longer than usual for businesses to create more productive jobs.

zh: 简言之，光靠结构性改革是无法但其刺激2012年增长的重任的。
en: In short, structural reforms alone cannot be relied upon to stimulate growth in 2012.

zh: 事实上，现在应该将注意力放在提振经常项目赤字国的投资和出口上，比如法国、意大利和西班牙（还有英国 ） ； 同时刺激德国和荷兰等盈余国的消费。
en: Instead, the immediate focus needs to be on boosting investment and exports in economies with a current-account deficit – such as France, Italy, and Spain (and the United Kingdom) – and stimulating consumption in surplus countries such as Germany and the Netherlands.

zh: 欧洲央行已经做出了果断的行动，提振欧洲银行；现在，它应该同时支持实体经济。
en: The European Central Bank has acted decisively to prop up European banks; now it needs to support the real economy, too.

zh: 尽管官方利率只有1 % ， 但并无偿债问题的西班牙等国家，其十年期债务利率高达5 % ， 而在意大利，信誉卓著的企业也不得不以极高的利率借钱（如果借得到的话 ） 。
en: While official interest rates are only 1%, solvent sovereigns such as Spain pay more than 5% to borrow for ten years, while creditworthy businesses in Italy can borrow only at punitive rates, if at all.

zh: 因此，欧洲央行应该出手疏通货币政策的传递机制；欧洲银行局（European Banking Authority）应该组织过度去杠杆化，不同银行应该有不同的资本要求，而不是一刀切的9 % ； 此外，在必要时，国家级别的政府应该为流向中小企业的银行贷款提供担保。
en: So the ECB should do more to unblock the transmission mechanism for monetary policy; the European Banking Authority should discourage excessive deleveraging by insisting that banks raise specific capital amounts rather than hit a uniform 9% ratio; and, where necessary, national governments should provide guarantees for bank lending to small and medium-size businesses.

zh: 改善融资难的情况固然十分关键，但政府还需要做更多的事来提振投资。
en: While improving access to finance is vital, governments also need to do more to boost investment.

zh: 它们需要尽快采取措施，让创业变得更容易，让风险资本不再受到各种壁垒的限制，让企业享受100%的暂时性资本免税额，以增进投资。
en: They should prioritize measures to make it easier to start a business, lift barriers to venture capital, and introduce temporary 100% capital allowances to encourage businesses to bring forward investment.

zh: 在欧盟层面，正如欧盟主席巴罗佐在其去年9月的欧盟国情咨文中所建议的，欧洲投资银行（European Investment Bank）的（可赎回）资本应该大量增加，以便其为大量泛欧洲投资项目（特别是基础设施项目）提供融资。
en: At the EU level, the (callable) capital of the European Investment Bank should be greatly increased, as European Commission President José Manuel Barroso suggested in his State of the Union speech last September, so that the EIB can finance a big wave of pan-European investment, notably in infrastructure.

zh: 提振增长也很重要。
en: Boosting exports is also essential.

zh: 赤字国需要增加竞争力、提高生产率，同时削减成本。
en: Deficit countries need to become more competitive, increasing productivity while cutting costs.

zh: 更具竞争力的货币是一种优势：自2008年以来，英镑的贬值就提振了英国的出口，同理，欧元的贬值也会有助于地中海国家重新获得高价格弹性出口品上的竞争力。
en: A more competitive currency would be welcome: just as the sterling’s collapse since 2008 has lifted UK exports, a weaker euro would help Mediterranean economies regain competitiveness for price-sensitive exports.

zh: 财政性贬值 — — 降低工资税，替之以对收入收取的更高的增值税 — — 也能有所助益。
en: A fiscal devaluation – slashing payroll taxes and replacing the revenues with a higher VAT – would also help.

zh: 盈余国也应该完成自己的责任，这符合它们的自身利益。
en: Surplus countries, too, must do their part, which is in their own interest.

zh: 正如中国需要允许人民币升值，德国也需要提高真实汇率 — — 不管从绝对数量还是从占GDP的比重来看，德国的经常项目盈余均超过了中国。
en: Just as China needs to allow the renminbi to rise, so Germany – whose current-account surplus exceeds China's both as a share of GDP and in absolute terms – needs a higher real exchange rate.

zh: 这意味着德国应该提高工资，让工资与其不断提高的生产率相符，从而让德国人民能够享受希腊人和西班牙人享受的假期。
en: That means that Germans need to earn higher wages, commensurate with their increased productivity, so that they can afford more Greek and Spanish holidays.

zh: 如果企业不愿意如此做，可以采用减少所得税的方式实现。
en: If businesses will not oblige, an income-tax cut would do the trick.

zh: 这就需要财政政策。
en: That brings us to fiscal policy.

zh: 无法以低利率从市场上借到钱（甚至无论如何也借不到钱）的政府别无选择，只能缩紧裤腰带过日子。
en: Governments that cannot borrow cheaply (or at all) from markets have no option but to tighten their belts.

zh: 但它们应该寻求精明的财政整合，而不是不假思索的紧缩。
en: But they should pursue smart consolidation rather than unthinking austerity.

zh: 因此，它们应该维持在技能和基础设施方面的投资，同时削减补贴和转移支付。
en: So they should maintain investment in skills and infrastructure, while cutting subsidies and transfer payments.

zh: 它们还应该为未来改革立法，特别是鼓励人们延长工作时间。
en: They should also legislate now for future reforms, notably to encourage people to work longer.

zh: 最后，能够以前所未有的低利率借钱的政府（比如，德国可以以0%的真实利率发行10年期以上的国债）应该承担起支持需求的责任。
en: Last but not least, governments that can borrow at unprecedentedly low rates – 0% in real terms over 10 years in the case of Germany – must play their role in supporting demand.

zh: 在明年德国大选以前看到增值税下降真的如此困难吗？
en: Would it be really be so difficult to see VAT coming down ahead of the German election next year?

zh: 是否是新的神圣联盟？
en: A New Holy Alliance?

zh: 伦敦 - - 沙特阿拉伯国王阿卜杜拉和教皇本笃十六世最近在梵蒂冈以“圣地监护人”的身份会见意义深远，特别是激进穆斯林正在责难在中东政治中“圣战者”发挥的作用之际尤其如此。
en: LONDON -- The recent meeting in the Vatican of the “Custodian of The Holy Places,” King Abdullah of Saudi Arabia, and Pope Benedict XVI was a seminal event, particularly as it comes at a time when radical Muslims are decrying the role of “crusaders” in Middle East politics.

zh: 这也是世界保守派领导人中正在上升的“神圣联盟”的最为清楚的迹象。
en: It was also the clearest sign yet of a rising “Holy Alliance” among the world’s conservative leaders.

zh: 因为这次穆斯林国王和罗马天主教教宗会见的主要观众并非其追随者，而是另一位保守派领导人布什总统。
en: For the key audience for this meeting of Muslim king and Roman Catholic Pontiff was not their followers, but another conservative leader, President George W. Bush.

zh: 史上第一个“神圣联盟”是奥地利王子梅特涅在拿破仑战争之后建立的。
en: The first “Holy Alliance” was a creation of Austria’s Prince Metternich following the Napoleonic wars.

zh: 它意在通过坚持共同价值观的战胜者联盟维持和平(以及相对脆弱的奥地利帝国的安全 ) 。
en: It was an attempt to preserve the peace (and the security of the relatively weak Austrian Empire) through a coalition of victors upholding shared values.

zh: 梅特涅的“神圣联盟”是发源于拿破仑战败的具有创意的政治观点。
en: Metternich’s “Holy Alliance” was the one original political idea to emerge from Napoleon’s defeat.

zh: 在其崇高的名分之后是一个具有巨大外交意义的创新，也就是把经过算计的道德限制因素引入国际政治之中。
en: Behind its exalted name lay an innovation of great diplomatic significance: the introduction of an element of calculated moral restraint into international relations.

zh: 其联盟成员奥地利、普鲁士和俄国在各自国内机制的生存上具有既得利益，从而引导它们寻求避免冲突。 在过去，这些国家将会理所当然地进行冲突。
en: The vested interests that the Alliance members – Austria, Prussia, and Russia – had in the survival of their domestic institutions led each to seek to avoid conflicts that, in the past, they would have pursued as a matter of course.

zh: 梅特涅的体系在十九世纪的大部分都奏效，因为它保护了具有共同价值观国家间的实在的力量平衡。
en: Metternich’s system worked through much of the nineteenth century, because it protected a genuine balance of power between countries that shared common values.

zh: 但是，沙特国王、教皇以及美国总统之间有什么“共同价值观”呢？
en: But what “common values” do King, Pope, and American President share?

zh: 这一会见本身就表明教皇和国王都相信应当有所作为。
en: That such a meeting took place is a sign that both Pope and King believed that there was something to achieve.

zh: 实际上，阿卜杜拉国王相信他自己是穆斯林世界的最高领导人，是第一位提议会见基督教领导人的沙特国王。
en: Indeed, Abdullah, who believes himself to be the paramount leader of the Muslim world, is the first Saudi king to initiate a meeting with a leader of the Christian faith.

zh: 二人的会见看起来平起平坐，并不表达共同的保守主义价值观，而是确认并且促进其坚持传统价值观的权威。
en: The two men met, seemingly as equals, not to express the common values of conservatism, but to confirm and promote their authority to uphold traditional values.

zh: 二人同意改革必须缓慢谨慎，并且不得破坏固有机制，特别是宗教和族长家族。
en: Both agreed that reform must be slow, cautious and that it must never undermine established institutions, especially religion and the patriarchal family.

zh: 阿卜杜拉想要见面，是因为他相信2001年以来的世界分裂了保守派的团结。
en: Abdullah sought the meeting because he believes that the world since 2001 has divided the fraternity of conservatives.

zh: 在此之前，他和布什具有共同的世界观，强调宗教的重要性、传统家庭(正如两国所理解的那般 ) 、 社会纪律以及国家在支持这些机制上发挥的作用。
en: Until then, he and Bush shared a common worldview, emphasizing the importance of religion, the traditional family (as both countries understood it), social discipline, and the state’s role in supporting these institutions.

zh: 但是，布什自2001年恐怖袭击以来背离了保守主义。 他寻求改造中东，其途径不仅是推翻阿富汗的塔利班政权和伊拉克的萨达姆政权，而且还高声呼吁民主化。
en: But Bush, following the terrorist attacks of 2001, turned his back on conservatism.  He sought to radically reinvent the Middle East, not only by overthrowing the Taliban regime in Afghanistan and Saddam Hussein’s regime in Iraq, but also through his strident calls for democratization.

zh: 但是，美国的极端主义造成中东宗教社区之间的紧张升级，极端主义的伊朗崛起争取地区霸权。
en: American radicalism, however, resulted in increasing tensions between religious communities in the Middle East, and the rise of radical Iran with its bid for regional hegemony.

zh: 从2001年以来，整个中东地区的基督教少数派都称为攻击目标，甚至包括黎巴嫩的马龙派社区。
en: Since 2001, Christian minorities have been targeted throughout the region, including even Lebanon’s Maronite Christian community.

zh: 而在伊拉克，逊尼派穆斯林感觉受到该国占据统治地位的多数派什叶派的围攻。
en: And in Iraq, Sunni Muslims feel under siege from the country’s majority and now ruling Shia.

zh: 在这一背景下，要求道德限制的神圣联盟应运而生。
en: Here is where the Holy Alliance concept of moral restraint comes in.

zh: 阿卜杜拉可能比大多数其他人更早地理解，为了不让整个中东地区陷于混战，就需要有某种限制准则。
en: Abdullah, perhaps earlier than most others, understood that some code of restraint was needed if the entire region was not to descend into a war of all against all.

zh: 而且，阿卜杜拉理解，其摇摇欲坠的政权如果能够建立起梅特涅建立的寻求稳定的联盟才能够抵御极端主义狂风大作。
en: Moreover, Abdullah understands that his wobbly regime will only be able to withstand the radical gales that are now blowing if it can forge the type of stability-seeking alliance that Metternich built.

zh: 阿卜杜拉国王和梅特涅和奥地利皇帝们一样理解托克维克的理论，也就是政权最为危险的时刻是其开始改革之际。
en: The King, like Metternich and the Austrian Kaisers, understands de Tocqueville’s dictum that the most dangerous moment for a regime is when it starts to reform.

zh: 阿卜杜拉国王极为谨慎地开始在政治上开放，他知道他需要地区和平和减少伊斯兰神圣愤怒。
en: Having begun, ever so carefully, to politically open his country, the King knows that he needs regional peace and a lowering of Islamic holy rage.

zh: 问题是，阿卜杜拉无法依靠其国内的保守派盟友来给他王国所需要的时间。
en: The problem is that Abdullah cannot rely on his domestic conservative allies to give him the time that the Kingdom needs.

zh: 瓦哈比宗教机构是沙特国家的幕后共同统治者，很有可能破坏其地区宗教和解的企图。
en: The Wahhabi religious establishment, the Saudi state’s hidden co-rulers, could very well obstruct Abdullah’s attempts at regional religious reconciliation.

zh: 宗教警察成员坚持该国的基督教客人必须继续遵守严格的瓦哈比行为规范。
en: Members of the religious police remain adamant that the country’s Christian guests must continue to live according to strict Wahhabi rules of behavior.

zh: 瓦哈比还是可以通过石油美元加以贿赂，这一教派追逐权力的法官们急迫地在利雅德的公共广场上等待下一个的斩首、乱石击死或者鞭击。
en: While the Wahhabis could yet be bribed again with oil money, the sect’s power-hungry judges eagerly await the next beheading, stoning, or lashing in Riyadh’s public square.

zh: 如此，联合现在的保守派力量就成为沙特唯一可行的外交战略，即使这些保守派的某些人是基督教派。
en: Thus, uniting the forces of status quo conservatism, even if some of those conservatives are Christian, is the only viable diplomatic strategy open to Saudi Arabia.

zh: 保守派统治者未能控制其自身弱点、特别是革命性的挑战以保守派的外衣包裹的时候就会倒台。
en: For conservative rulers usually fall when they fail to grasp their own vulnerability, especially when the revolutionary challenge is cloaked in conservative garb.

zh: 毕竟，很少有政治制度可以抵御这些，就像沙特的伊斯兰极端主义者那样。 他们宣称他们可以比当前的统治着更为有效地维持这一制度及其宗教价值。
en: After all, few political systems can defend against those, like Saudi Arabia’s Islamic radicals, who claim that they can preserve the system and its religious values more effectively than the current rulers.

zh: 阿卜杜拉相信，只有保守派领导人和强国(包括美国从外交极端主义后撤)的联盟才能够在中东恢复某种稳定。
en: Only an alliance of conservative leaders and powers (including a retreat by America from diplomatic radicalism), Abdullah believes, can restore some stability to the Middle East.

zh: 伊朗的一线希望
en: A Glimmer of Hope in Iran

zh: 柏林 — — 哈桑·鲁哈尼在伊朗总统选举中获胜出乎所有人的预料。
en: BERLIN – No one could have reckoned with Hassan Rowhani’s victory in Iran’s presidential election.

zh: 在八人参与的激烈竞选中，就连最高领袖哈梅内伊可能也对鲁哈尼的首轮获胜吃惊不小。
en: Even Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was probably more than a little surprised by Rowhani’s first-round victory, following a campaign that began with eight candidates.

zh: 于是与伊朗的核计划及叙利亚内战谈判很有可能出现新的动态。
en: As a result, the negotiations with Iran over its nuclear program, as well as the civil war in Syria, may well take on a new dynamic.

zh: 但中东局势就是如此：你永远不知道接下来会发生什么。
en: But that is how it is in the Middle East: you never know what lies around the corner.

zh: 今年是伊朗和德、法、英这欧洲三驾马车就伊朗核计划启动外长级谈判的十周年纪念日。
en: This year marks the tenth anniversary of the launch, at the foreign-minister level, of negotiations between Iran and the European triumvirate of Germany, France, and the United Kingdom on Iran’s nuclear program.

zh: 当时我代表德国见证了这一历史时刻，鲁哈尼则率领伊朗代表团参加。
en: I was there, representing Germany; so was Rowhani, who led the Iranian delegation.

zh: 德国和联合国安理会五大常任理事国与伊朗的扩大会谈直到今天仍在继续，但没有取得任何切实成果。
en: The talks have continued until today – in an expanded format that includes Germany and the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council (the P5+1) – without any tangible results.

zh: 如今鲁哈尼重新面对伊朗的高风险核计划，只不过这次身份换成了总统。
en: Now Rowhani returns to the risky business of Iran’s nuclear program, though this time as President.

zh: 我们 — — 和他应该抱有怎样的期望？
en: What can we – and he – expect?

zh: 根据个人经验，鲁哈尼的性格特点是礼貌而开放。
en: Based on my personal experience, Rowhani is a polite and open character.

zh: 不同于卸任总统马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪 - 内贾德，他身边从不缺少以技巧和经验见长的外交家。
en: Unlike outgoing President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, he surrounds himself with very skillful and experienced diplomats.

zh: 但他与政府同仇敌忾应当没有疑问，他是现实而温和的伊斯兰共和国政治精英 — — 而不是反对派代表。
en: But there should be no doubt that he is a man of the regime – a realist and moderate member of the Islamic Republic’s political elite – not a representative of the opposition.

zh: 而且毋庸置疑，他对伊朗核计划持支持态度。
en: And, of course, he backs Iran’s nuclear program.

zh: 要想在任内获得成功，鲁哈尼必须在不威胁伊斯兰共和国的情况下兑现改善伊朗人生活水平的承诺。
en: If Rowhani wants to succeed in office, he will have to keep his promise to improve Iranians’ living conditions without endangering the Islamic Republic in the process.

zh: 做到这一点绝非易事，实际是一项不可能完成的任务。
en: That will not be easy; in fact, it could amount to trying to square a circle.

zh: 鲁哈尼当选时选民要求的经济改善几乎肯定只有在解除西方和国际制裁的前提下才能实现。
en: The economic improvement that voters demanded in electing Rowhani can almost certainly be achieved only if Western and international sanctions are lifted.

zh: 但结束国际制裁的前提是在核谈判中取得突破。
en: But an end to international sanctions presupposes a breakthrough in the nuclear negotiations.

zh: 经济发展还需要至少暂时解决主要地区冲突。
en: It may also presuppose at least a temporary settlement of the main regional conflicts.

zh: 过去十年中东地区发生了巨大的变化。
en: The Middle East has changed dramatically in the last ten years.

zh: 从伊拉克撤军和明年撤离阿富汗使美国的力量有所削弱。
en: America has reduced its involvement, having withdrawn its troops from Iraq and winding down its engagement in Afghanistan by next year.

zh: 同时，我们正在见证一战后英法缔造的中东格局的土崩瓦解，当时欧洲这两大殖民强国在巴勒斯坦、叙利亚（包括今天的黎巴嫩 ） 、 约旦河外和伊拉克都凭空创造出领土要求。
en: At the same time, we are witnessing the dissolution of the old Middle East created by France and Britain after World War I, when Europe’s two great colonial powers created territorial mandates in Palestine, Syria (including present-day Lebanon), Transjordan, and Iraq.

zh: 新的地区秩序尚未形成，我们面对着充满危险和混乱的未来。
en: A new regional order is not yet discernible, which points to a future fraught with risk and possible chaos.

zh: 随着伊朗试图维护自身及什叶派盟友的影响和利益，它与安理会的核争端已经和它的区域野心紧密挂钩。
en: As Iran seeks to assert its influence and interests, as well as those of its Shia allies, its dispute with the Security Council over its nuclear program has become closely tied to its regional ambitions.

zh: 归根结底，伊朗的核前景极有可能加剧地区核军备竞赛和暴力冲突。
en: After all, the prospect of a nuclear-armed Iran would most likely exacerbate violent conflict and a nuclear arms race in the region.

zh: 因此，这两个问题必须在解除制裁前成功地解决掉。
en: As a result, both issues may well have to be addressed successfully prior to any move to lift the sanctions.

zh: 伊朗及其国际对话方应当汲取以往的教训，恰当地预期有可能取得的成果。
en: Iran and its international interlocutors should learn from the past and manage expectations accordingly.

zh: 鉴于当事各方利益截然相反、各有各的国内及联盟阻力及各方信任严重缺失，对话不可能很快达成协议（甚至根本达不成协议 ） 。
en: There will not be any quick solutions (if, indeed, there are any solutions at all), given the parties’ diametrically opposed interests, their respective domestic and alliance-related obstacles, and a profound lack of trust on all sides.

zh: 此外，除了与P5+1谈判外，直接和美国谈判对伊朗而言是很好的选择。
en: Moreover, aside from negotiating with the P5+1, Iran would be well advised to launch direct negotiations with the United States.

zh: 要想取得积极成果，伊朗很可能要与沙特和海湾国家改善关系，并改变对以色列的态度。
en: It will also most likely have to improve its relations with Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states, and change its behavior toward Israel, if a positive result is to be achieved.

zh: 同样，西方国家必须理解伊斯兰共和国并非铁板一块。
en: Similarly, the West will have to understand that the Islamic Republic is not a monolithic dictatorship.

zh: 伊朗政府多权力中心并存，在决策过程中相互牵制影响。
en: The regime has multiple coexisting power centers, which influence and limit each other’s decisions.

zh: 总统办公室仅仅其中之一。
en: The office of the president is just one power center.

zh: 最高领袖也同样如此，虽然拥有貌似绝对的头衔，但绝对统治权并不掌握在他的手上。
en: The same applies to the Supreme Leader, who, despite his title, is not an absolute ruler.

zh: 过去十年伊朗尝试了两条政治道路：穆罕默德·哈塔米总统的改革模式，以及内贾德统治下的强硬激进主义。
en: Iran has tried two political approaches in the last ten years: a reformist model, under President Mohamed Khatami, and hardline radicalism, under Ahmadinejad.

zh: 这两条道路都走向了失败。
en: Both approaches failed.

zh: 改革者无法战胜保守反对派，而激进份子则无法战胜其外交及核政策所造成的国内经济现实。
en: The reformers could not overcome conservative opposition, while the radicals could not defeat the domestic economic realities wrought by their foreign and nuclear policies.

zh: 鲁哈尼必须争取多数权力中心的支持，同时还要完成选民赋予的任务。
en: Rowhani must seek a path that does not cost him the support of the majority of the regime’s power centers, yet that also allows him to fulfill the mandate he received from voters.

zh: 在伊朗国内，无所不在的信任缺失将使本已艰巨的任务变得更加错综复杂。
en: At home, too, massive distrust will further complicate an inherently difficult task.

zh: 美国和西方很多人将鲁哈尼视为伊斯兰共和国的温和派，因为艾哈迈迪内贾德更加激进而把他视作伊朗人的本来面目。
en: In America and the West, many will probably regard Rowhani as the friendly face of the Islamic Republic, whereas Ahmadinejad was its true – because more radical – embodiment.

zh: 反过来，很多伊朗人把奥巴马视为力争颠覆伊朗政权的美国温和派，而将其前任乔治·W·布什视为美国最诚实、也最激进的代表人物。
en: Many Iranians, in turn, regard Obama as the friendly face of a US that still seeks regime change in their country, whereas his predecessor, George W. Bush, was America’s more honest – because more radical – representative.

zh: 这两种看法都歪曲了事实，但又都包含有现实的因素。
en: Both perceptions distort reality, though both contain a kernel of truth.

zh: 尽管上述印象不尽准确 — — 也许恰恰因为不准确，鲁哈尼政府为核谈判和政治解决叙利亚问题提供了一个意想不到的机会。
en: Despite these perceptions – or perhaps precisely because of them – Rowhani’s presidency offers an unexpected opportunity for both the nuclear negotiations and a political solution in Syria.

zh: 就算仅仅为了测试鲁哈尼的重视程度，伊朗也必须出席国家和平会议。
en: Iran’s participation in an international peace conference is an absolute necessity, if only to test Rowhani’s seriousness.

zh: 2001年波恩阿富汗会议期间，伊朗采取了注重实效的务实的做法，而当时伊朗这种做法没有得到美国的任何回报。
en: During the Afghanistan conference in Bonn in 2001, Iran behaved in a pragmatic, results-oriented way – an approach that went completely unrewarded by the US.

zh: 至于核谈判，P5+1需要重点保证从客观上堵死伊朗军事利用核能的所有道路。
en: As for the nuclear negotiations, the P5+1 will focus on objective guarantees that leave Iran no path toward military use of its nuclear capabilities.

zh: 而伊朗的重点则应是在遵守《不扩散协议》及其议定书规则的前提下，争取国际社会认可其和平利用核能的权利。
en: For Iran, the focal point of its efforts will be recognition of its right to civilian use of nuclear energy, in keeping with the provisions of the Non-Proliferation Treaty and its protocols.

zh: 这两个问题听起来都比实际简单：细节决定成败，而谈判中有足够的空间就条款的定义、监管和执行讨价还价。
en: Both issues sound simpler than they are: the devil is in the details, and the details leave ample scope for disagreement over the definition, monitoring, and enforcement of terms.

zh: 需要再次强调重要的是设定现实的期望。
en: Again, maintaining realistic expectations must be paramount.

zh: 成功达成核谈判协议甚至成功控制主要地区冲突都是艰巨的任务。
en: A successful outcome in the nuclear negotiations and resolution or even containment of the main regional conflicts will be difficult to achieve.

zh: 但不以全部的力量、真诚和创造力抓住鲁哈尼当选这个意料之外的机会将是高度的不负责任。
en: But it would be the height of irresponsibility not to seize the unexpected opportunity created by Rowhani’s election with all the strength, good faith, and creativity we can muster.

zh: 欧洲改革的第二次机会
en: A Second Chance for European Reform

zh: 慕尼黑—欧洲央行用其无限制买入欧元区政府债券的承诺稳定了市场，因为这一承诺实际上是向债权人保证，欧元区依然坚挺的国家的纳税人和退休金领取者会在必要时承担偿债负担。
en: MUNICH – The European Central Bank has managed to calm the markets with its promise of unlimited purchases of eurozone government bonds, because it effectively assured bondholders that the taxpayers and pensioners of the eurozone’s still-sound economies would, if necessary, shoulder the repayment burden.

zh: 尽管欧洲央行对于如何实施购买计划并未提及，但其承诺已足够刺激投资者的胃口，降低欧元区内部利差，并且使通过印钞（Target信用）降低受危机侵袭国家资金负担成为了可能。
en: Although the ECB left open how this would be carried out, its commitment whetted investors’ appetite, reduced interest-rate spreads in the eurozone, and made it possible to reduce the funding of crisis-stricken economies through the printing press (Target credit).

zh: 暂时缓和为推进改革提供了理想良机。
en: This respite offers an ideal opportunity to push forward with reforms.

zh: 希腊总理萨马拉斯必须让希腊人民相信，他实施改革的意图是严肃的。
en: Greek Prime Minister Antonis Samaras must convince his countrymen that he is serious about implementing them.

zh: 西班牙首相拉霍伊和葡萄牙财政部长加斯帕（Vitor Gaspar）的计划应该获得更大支持。
en: Spanish Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy and Portuguese Finance Minister Vitor Gaspar deserve more support for their plans.

zh: 我们还应该希望意大利看守总理蒙蒂参与下一轮大选。
en: And one can only hope that Italy’s caretaker prime minister, Mario Monti, contests the next general election.

zh: 这些领导人知道必须做什么。
en: All of these leaders understand what must be done.

zh: 相反，法国还没有注意到不祥之兆。
en: France, by contrast, does not appear to have noticed the writing on the wall.

zh: 总统奥朗德希望用增长计划解决法国的问题。
en: President François Hollande wants to solve his country’s problems with growth programs.

zh: 但当政客说“增长”时，他们的实际意思是“借钱 ” 。
en: But when politicians say “growth,” they mean “borrowing.”

zh: 而这是法国最不需要做的事情。
en: That is the last thing that France needs.

zh: 法国的债务/GDP比率已经高达90%左右，即使其2013年预算赤字不超过3.5%的GDP，其债务/GDP比率也会在当年年末升至93 % 。
en: France’s debt/GDP ratio is already around 90%; even if its 2013 budget deficit does not exceed 3.5% of GDP, its debt/GDP ratio will have climbed to 93% by the end of the year.

zh: 政府的GDP比重56%为欧元区最高，在所有发达国家中名列第二。
en: The government’s GDP share, at 56%, is the highest in the eurozone and second highest among all developed countries.

zh: 不但像德帕迪约这样的影星移居国外躲避高税收；产业界也有这样的感觉。
en: It is not only film actors like Gérard Depardieu who are leaving the country to escape its high taxes; industry is fleeing as well.

zh: 法国曾经引以为豪的汽车公司正在为生存挣扎。
en: France’s once-proud carmakers are fighting for survival.

zh: 事实上，法国制造业占GDP比重已经下滑到9 % ， 低于英国（10 % ） ，更是不及德国（20 % ） 的一半。
en: Indeed, France’s manufacturing industry has shrunk to barely 9% of GDP, less than Britain’s manufacturing share (10%) and less than half of Germany’s (20%).

zh: 法国经常项目正在向更深的赤字黑洞滑落。
en: Its current account is sliding into an ever-deeper deficit hole.

zh: 失业率也在创造历史记录。
en: Unemployment is rising to record levels.

zh: 与受危机影响最重的国家相同，法国的基本问题是欧元诞生所带来的廉价信贷催生了通胀性泡沫，从而破坏了其竞争力。
en: France’s basic problem, like that of the countries most affected by the crisis, is that the wave of cheap credit that the euro’s introduction made possible fueled an inflationary bubble that robbed it of its competitiveness.

zh: 高盛计算，法国必须降价20%才能可持续地维持债务。
en: Goldman Sachs has calculated that France must become 20% cheaper to service its debt on a sustainable basis.

zh: 西班牙也是如此，意大利需要降价10—15 % ， 希腊和葡萄牙的国内物价分别需要下降30%和35 % 。
en: The same is true of Spain, while Italy would have to become 10-15% cheaper and Greece and Portugal would need domestic prices to fall 30% and 35%, respectively.

zh: 经合组织购买力统计数字显示了相同的图景，希腊需要贬值39 % ， 葡萄牙需要编制32 % ， 才能达到土耳其的物价水平。
en: The OECD purchasing-power statistics paint a similar picture, with Greece needing to depreciate by 39% and Portugal by 32% just to reach the price level prevailing in Turkey.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，在这方面几乎毫无进展。
en: But, so far, virtually nothing has been done in this respect.

zh: 更糟糕的是，一些受困经济体通胀率仍比贸易伙���更高。
en: Worse, some of the troubled countries’ inflation rates are still running higher than those of their trading partners.

zh: 欧元区政客总是相信通过实施改革、推出基础设施工程和改善生产率就可以重获竞争力，降低国内价格不是必须的。
en: Eurozone politicians tend to believe that it is possible to regain competitiveness by carrying out reforms, undertaking infrastructure projects, and improving productivity, but without reducing domestic prices.

zh: 这是错的，因为这些措施之所以能改善竞争力，只是因为它们降低了相对于欧元区竞争者的国内价格。
en: That is a fallacy, because such steps improve competitiveness only in the same measure as they reduce domestic prices vis-à-vis eurozone competitors.

zh: 只要这些国家留在欧元区，就无法降低相对国内价格：要么它们通缩，要么它们的贸易伙伴更快地通胀。
en: There is no way around a reduction in relative domestic prices as long as these countries remain in the currency union: either they deflate, or their trading partners inflate faster.

zh: 要达到这一目标，没有轻松愉快的路可走。
en: There is no easy or socially comfortable way to accomplish this.

zh: 在某些情况下，这一目标的风险很大，甚至希望渺茫。
en: In some cases, such a course can be so perilous that it should not be wished upon any society.

zh: 重塑竞争力所需要做的和公民能够忍受的（在仍留在欧元的情况下）之间的差异太大了。
en: The gap is simply too large between what is needed to restore competitiveness and what citizens can stomach if they remain part of the monetary union.

zh: 为了有序地贬值，一国的通货膨胀率必须低于其竞争者，但这只有通过经济衰退才能达到。
en: In order to become cheaper, a country’s inflation rate must stay below that of its competitors, but that can be accomplished only through an economic slump.

zh: 工会越是奋力维持现有工资结构，生产率增长就越低，衰退的时间也就越长。
en: The more trade unions defend existing wage structures, and the lower productivity growth is, the longer the slump will be.

zh: 西班牙和法国将需要十年的衰退期，期间年通过膨胀率比竞争对手低2 % ， 这样才能重获竞争力。
en: Spain and France would need a ten-year slump, with annual inflation 2% lower than that of their competitors, to regain their competitiveness.

zh: 对意大利来说，重获竞争力之路要短一些，但葡萄牙和希腊的道路就要长得多了 — — 可能太长了。
en: For Italy, the path toward competitiveness is shorter, but for Portugal and Greece it is substantially longer – perhaps too long.

zh: 意大利、法国和西班牙应该能够在可预见的时间内重获欧元区内的竞争力。
en: Italy, France, and Spain should be able to regain competitiveness in the eurozone within a foreseeable period of time.

zh: 毕竟，从1995年（即明确宣布实施欧元计划之年）到2008年（全球金融危机爆发之年 ） ， 德国相对其欧元区贸易伙伴价格降低了22 % 。
en: After all, Germany cut its prices relative to its eurozone trading partners by 22% from 1995, when the euro was definitively announced, to 2008, when the global financial crisis erupted.

zh: 十年前，德国就像今天的法国，是欧洲病人。
en: Ten years ago, Germany was like France is today – the sick man of Europe.

zh: 它经历了失业率的上升和投资不足。
en: It suffered from increasing unemployment and a lack of investment.

zh: 大部分储蓄被投资于国外，国内净投资比例在经合组织国家中垫底。
en: Most of its savings were being invested abroad, and its domestic net investment share was among the lowest of all OECD countries.

zh: 在增长压力下，施罗德的社会民主党政府在2003年决定取消数百万德国人的二等失业救济，从而扫清了形成低工资部门的道路，而这反过来又降低了通胀率。
en: Under growing pressure to act, Gerhard Schröder’s Social Democratic government decided in 2003 to deprive millions of Germans of their second-tier unemployment insurance, thus paving the way for the creation of a low-wage sector, in turn reducing the rate of inflation.

zh: 不幸的是，到目前为止，危机国家 — — 以法国为首 — — 还没有任何迹象表明做好了咬紧牙关的准备。
en: Unfortunately, thus far, there is no sign that the crisis countries, above all France, are ready to bite the bullet.

zh: 它们对魔法程式抱有幻想的时间越长，欧元危机困扰它们的日子就越久。
en: The longer they cling to a belief in magic formulas, the longer the euro crisis will be with us.

zh: 崭新的科学
en: A New Science

zh: 今年夏天，一次不同寻常的科学家大会在巴黎召开，来自世界各地的科学家们汇聚一堂，共同探讨创立新科学的必要性，他们所讨论的新科学也许会像一个世纪前爱因斯坦的发现那样为人类带来革命性的突破。
en: An unusual meeting of scientists took place in Paris this summer, when scientists gathered to brainstorm about the need for a new science, one that could be as revolutionary as Einstein’s insights were a century ago.

zh: 多数科学家认为基本的科学定律都已经为人类知晓。
en: Most scientists assume that the basics of science are known.

zh: 而谈到大的挑战，传统的观念认为我们尚未发现的事物已经寥寥。
en: In terms of big challenges, the conventional wisdom is that few things are left to discover.

zh: 仅剩的问题可以分为三类 ： “ 重要的科学难题 ” （ 比如重力学和电学的统一 ） ， 这类研究不仅需要巨大的投资，也离不开一流的科研设备 ； “ 资料收集 ” ， 是与考古发掘和生物/基因调查相关的实际工作；以及“科学信息问题 ” ， 比如应对艾滋病或者全球变暖。
en: The remaining options are said to fall into three groups: “grand scientific quandaries” (such as uniting gravity and electricity into one theory) which require a huge investment and first world infrastructure; “data collection,” which is the field work associated with archeological digs and biological/genetic surveys; and “science-informed problems,” such as combating AIDS or addressing global warming.

zh: 除此之外，很多人认为如何利用现有法则使人类从全新的技术中获益是目前仅剩的艰苦工作。
en: Beyond that, many believe the only hard work will be to use existing laws to benefit humankind in new technological ways.

zh: 谁能提出不同意见呢？
en: Who can argue?

zh: 归根结底，今天的模式是成功的。
en: After all, today’s models work.

zh: 但有的科学家开始指出现有的理论无法完全解释某些现象。
en: But an emerging group of scientists points to phenomena that current theories do not address well.

zh: 这些问题其实极为普遍，人们只要碰到总是会巧妙地避开，因为能够解释它们的科学根本就不存在。
en: These problems are exceedingly common and artfully avoided because the science that would account for them just doesn’t exist.

zh: 这种缺失的科学法则是用来描述过程，以及整个系统如何演化。
en: This missing science would describe processes, and how entire systems evolve.

zh: 我们对单一学科都有了非常深入的了解。
en: Individual scientific disciplines are understood fairly well.

zh: 比如物理，至少是我们普通人能够用到的物理，已经建起了完整的构架。
en: Physics, at least the physics we encounter as ordinary humans, is well mapped.

zh: 化学和生物化学同样拥有坚实的基础¾虽然人体内还有我们未知的领域，但普遍的看法是我们已经掌握了细胞和分子反应的基本方法。
en: Chemistry and biochemistry are similarly solid -- there are some things we don’t understand about the body, but it is believed that the basic machinery of how cells and molecules interact is known.

zh: 稍微远一点的还有新的社会科学，人和社会是这门学科的研究领域。
en: Slightly apart from these are the new social sciences, which deal with humans and societies.

zh: 在物理、生物化学和社会科学的任何一个领域，理论构架都已经比较成熟，也不存在太多的疑义。
en: In each of these areas -- physics, biochemistry and social science -- the theories are mature and largely uncontroversial.

zh: 各学科都有自己的表达方式和学科机制。
en: Each discipline has its own language and its own separate machinery.

zh: 很少有科学家通晓多种领域，因为不同领域和表达方法都迥然不同。
en: Rarely is a scientist an expert in more than one area, because the worlds and languages are so different.

zh: 这就意味着我们无法对跨学科的问题做出回答。
en: This means that we can’t answer complex questions that depend on more than one field. Consider the brain, for example.

zh: 就比如大脑，这个复杂器官是由按照物理定律相互作用的分子所构成的，而信息的传递则遵循电学的定律。
en: This complex organ is composed of molecules that interact using the principles of physics. That information moves according to the laws of electricity.

zh: 此外还有专用细胞体系，这些相互反应、相互交流的化学物质也承担着信息传递的任务。
en: There is also a system of specialized cells, and these interact, exchanging chemicals that also convey information.

zh: 大脑之间的交互又增加了一个崭新的领域：在这里，信息通过语言、符号和思想进行传播。
en: The interaction between two brains adds another level: here, information is exchanged by means of languages, signs and ideas.

zh: 我们在每个层面上都掌握了非常丰富的信息，有相当完善的理论对各个层面做出解释。
en: Information is at work on each level and comfortable theories explain how the separate ones operate.

zh: 但信息也在不同层面上得以传递。
en: But information is being exchanged between the levels as well.

zh: 即便在最根本的领域，也没有任何科学能对此做出解释。
en: There is no science that explains this, even at the most rudimentary level.

zh: 为了解决这个问题，有些科学家曾尝试将某个层面的理论进行重组，然后再应用到其它的领域。
en: To cope with this deficiency, some scientists have tried to reinvent the tools of one level in order to apply them to another.

zh: 于是细胞层面的“语言”和有组织社会背后的“能量”等术语就应运而生。
en: This leads to such things as a “language” at the level of cells and “energy” behind organized societies.

zh: 有些时候这种移植能够成功，但却解决不了核心的问题：能够在不同层次间传递的信息有哪些特性，它们又是如何进行传递的？
en: Sometimes the transplant works well enough, but it does not address the central problem: What is the nature of the information conveyed between each level, and how is it conveyed?

zh: 其实，世界上几乎所有的系统都有着不同的层面。
en: As it happens, nearly every system in the world is composed of such layers.

zh: 因此在任何情况下，对整个系统的运作方式都存在着理解上的匮乏。
en: A similarly embarrassing lack of understanding about how the whole system works exists in every case.

zh: 汇聚巴黎的跨学科科学家以“信息科学基金会”的名义松散地组织在一起。
en: The group of interdisciplinary scientists that met in Paris is loosely affiliated under the banner “Foundations of Information Science.”

zh: 他们已经有过长达8年的分工合作，来自五湖四海和不同的专业。
en: They have been working in a distributed collaboration for eight years and come from a range of countries and specialties.

zh: 和相关专业的科学家一样，艺术理论家、精神病专家、语言专家和哲学家们也开始加入到讨论中来。
en: As well as scientists from the relevant disciplines, art theorists, psychiatrists, language experts and philosophers are beginning to participate in the discussion.

zh: 大多数团体对“移植”策略寄与厚望，也就是将某个层面的基础科学移植到其它领域，同时进行调整或补充，以便能够发挥作用。
en: Most of the group is banking on the “transplant” strategy, in which the basic science of one layer is placed in another, tweaked and supplemented in order to be functional.

zh: 其它人则认为必须找到全新的方法。
en: Others think that a whole new approach is required.

zh: 他们认为很多科学定理都是历史的巧合，可以有全新的提炼方式。
en: They assume that many scientific conventions are accidents of history and new abstractions can be devised.

zh: 如果信息科学基金会更加幸运，将会有目前无缘使用一流研究设备的思想家提出全新的想法。
en: If the FIS group is lucky, there will also be some radical input from thinkers that do not presently have access to first world infrastructure.

zh: 独立思考的作用常常被低估。
en: Independent thinking is an underestimated factor.

zh: 几乎所有汇聚到“科学”大旗下的活动都与相应的经济活动存在着制度上的趋同。
en: Nearly all the activities collected under the banner of “science” have developed institutional tendencies that are similar to their economic counterparts.

zh: 很多人认为发展中国家需要模仿发达国家的模式进行资源重组，但这样做可能会压制最富创造力的想象。
en: It is usually assumed that developing economies need to build resources that emulate those in the developed world, but this could actually stifle the most creative thinking.

zh: 很多信奉科学的人都在经历着一场革命，很多这样的想法，有时甚至是革命性的想法，正在从未与大型机构挂钩的实验室和研究中心蒸腾而出。
en: Many scientific disciples are going through a revolution, and a lot of those ideas -- sometimes revolutionary ideas -- are bubbling up from labs and research centers that are unaffiliated with large institutions.

zh: 近20年来，数学运算方面最先进的思想全部来自根本没有计算能力的苏维埃帝国。
en: Twenty years of the most advanced thinking for mathematical algorithms came from a Soviet empire starved of computing power.

zh: 近两代人最有智慧和冲击力的物理观念并非来自当今被寄与厚望的动力机构，而是布达佩斯的研究成果。
en: The cleverest, most literally earth-shattering notions of physics for two generations came not from the expected powerhouses of the day, but from Budapest.

zh: 伊朗从古至今就有着建筑设计的传统，带来过认知科学的重大发现。
en: Iran has a tradition of architectural design that has revealed key insights to cognitive scientists.

zh: 即便今天，第二代人工智能的最新思想（所谓的“自治代理 ” ） 仍然在布拉格进行孵化。
en: Today, some of the most radical new ideas in second generation artificial intelligence (so-called “autonomous agents”) are incubating in Prague.

zh: 最富创造力的突破往往会一举成名。
en: The most creative breakthroughs became famous events.

zh: 爱因斯坦将新概念融入物理学科的时候，时空的概念发生了巨大的改变。
en: When Einstein added new abstractions to the language of physics, the identity of space and time changed.

zh: 信息科学基金会7月的会议就是以这种方式重塑宇宙的开始，这种努力是旷古未有的。
en: The FIS meeting in July was the unheralded beginning of an attempt to remodel the universe in such a way.

zh: 科学家们找到了需要解释的差距，他们将吸纳更多的思想家，包括来自必要创新领域的科学家。
en: The group identified the gaps that need explanation. They will expand their pool of thinkers to include scientists from necessarily innovative regions.

zh: 在此之后，他们会确定新的科学可能解决哪些现有问题，��带来哪些新的发现。
en: Following this, they will identify which problems might be solved if this new science is developed. Or if you wish, discovered.

zh: 一种全新的中美关系？
en: A New Sino-American Relationship?

zh: 随着中美战略经济对话的结束，两国之间形成了一种全新的氛围，但 两国的“蜜月期”是否真的到来了么？
en: NEW YORK – The Strategic and Economic Dialogue between the United States and China has now ended with the establishment of a felicitous new atmosphere between the two countries. But how can this “love-in” be made concrete?

zh: 本次会谈达成的最具有成效的成果是在全球气候问题上。
en: The most logical and potentially fruitful area of collaboration is climate change.

zh: 在此议题上美方的两名官员分别是能源部长朱棣文和贸易部长骆家辉。
en: Here, the two US government officials best equipped to lead are Secretary of Energy Steven Chu and Secretary of Commerce Gary Locke.

zh: 朱棣文原先是伯克利大学和斯坦福大学的物理学教授，劳伦斯·伯克利国家实验室主任。 而骆家辉是前华盛顿州州长，长期以来一直致力于中美贸易关系正常化。
en: Chu is a former Berkeley and Stanford professor of physics and head of the Lawrence Berkeley National Lab, while Locke is a former Washington State governor and a long-time supporter of US-China commercial exchanges.

zh: 两人都带有务实柔性的外交气质，这也是中国领导人希望接触的人选：名校出身的学术背景，先进的科技知识，高阶的政府职位，以及诺贝尔奖得主（朱棣文是五名华裔的诺贝尔奖得主之一，然而令中方尴尬的是，这五名都不具有中国国籍 ， ）
en: Each packs the kind of soft, utilitarian powers of persuasion that Chinese leaders are most willing to embrace: academic degrees from prestigious universities, advanced scientific and technological knowledge, high office, and a Nobel Prize. (Chu is one of five ethnic Chinese to have won a Nobel, although no winner has yet come from the PRC, a fact that gnaws at Chinese pride.)

zh: 由于他们是首次担任美国内阁部长的华裔人士，中国媒体都在热炒此二人。
en: China’s press was abuzz over Chu and Locke, the first ethnic Chinese men to become US Cabinet Secretaries.

zh: 绝大多数的中国报纸都将朱棣文的照片放在头版头条 ， 《 北京商报》却表示谨慎的乐观,文章的标题为“别把美华裔部长来访当成走亲戚 ” ， 并且进一步地警告说 ： “ 似乎在不少人的心里，骆家辉、朱棣文首先是“华裔 ” 、 其次是“部长 ” 、 最后才是“美国的 ” 。
en: Most major Chinese papers ran Chu’s photo on the front page, with Beijing Business Today running a cautionary headline: “Don’t Mistake the Visiting American Ministers as Relatives!”

zh: 不过在这两位心里，恐怕是恰恰相反的一种排序。 ”
en: The paper went on to warn that, “In their own hearts, we are afraid that Chu and Locke put their priorities in exactly the opposite order.”

zh: 当朱棣文在清华大学和天津大学做了关于能源和气候变化的演讲，清华大学是中国理工科的最高学府，朱棣文父母的母校。 朱棣文的爷爷曾任天津大学的校长。
en: When Chu gave speeches on energy and climate change at Tsinghua University, China’s most elite institution for science and engineering (where his parents had been students), and then at Tianjin University (where his grandfather was once President), he was received with enormous enthusiasm, overflow crowds, and standing ovations.

zh: 在这两所学校，他受到了热烈地欢迎，到处是拥挤的人群和长时间的掌声。 于是，中国人对他们有两种相互矛盾的认知：美国政府高级官员和同根同种的中国人。
en: So, the Chinese ended up embracing Chu and Locke in contradictory ways: as high-ranking representatives of the US government and as compatriots with whom they share the common bond of Chinese-ness.

zh: 朱棣文和骆家辉深知，中美两国目前是世界上最大的温室气体排放国家。 如果要解决这个问题，两国必须找到一个合作的方法。
en: Both Chu and Locke are aware that the US and China are now the world’s largest emitters of greenhouse gases, and that, if there is any hope of remedying global climate change, the two countries must quickly find a way to collaborate.

zh: 朱在清华的演讲中指出，目前的全球气候问题“非常严峻 ” ， 并强调说，我们必须联合起来。
en: Chu emphasized this point in his Tsinghua University speech, calling the global climate situation “very disturbing,” and stressing that we were “all in it together.”

zh: “我承认，发达国家确实是问题的制造者 ， ” 他对台下全神贯注的听众说道 ， “ 不过，发展中国家会使得问题雪上加霜。
en: “The developed world did make the problem…I admit that,” he acknowledged to his rapt audience. “But the developing world can make it much worse.”

zh: 在关于中美联合研究项目中，朱将清洁能源说成“我们这个时代中美合作关系中最大的一个机会 ” ， 并且说“联合起来比各自为战的效果要好很多 ” 。
en: In announcing a new Sino-US joint research effort, Chu described clean energy as “one of the great opportunities of our time” for Sino-US cooperation, saying that by “working together, we can accomplish more than [by] acting alone.”

zh: 但是，我们不仅要问，这种新型的友好合作关系是否足够牢固？ 能否化解两国长期以来的相互之间不信任，以及由于中国经济迅速崛起带来的新的不平衡？
en: Still, one is left wonder if this new collaborative bonhomie and ethnic bonding will prove strong enough to cut through not only the long history of distrustful interactions between the US and China, but also the destabilizing effects of China’s sudden economic rise?

zh: 虽然，美国一直受益于“大熔炉 ” （ 奥巴马总统的内阁确实代表了更广泛的族群背景）的文化背景，但美国主流社会一直对外来移民进入权力中心保持警惕。
en: For, although the US has drawn strength from the ideal of a “melting pot” – and President Barack Obama’s cabinet does represent a new high-water mark for diversity – Americans have often shown a xenophobic distrust of immigrants who have drawn too close to power.

zh: 特别是对华裔而言，一直有着“忠于哪个国家”和“第五纵队”的疑虑。
en: Especially in the case of Chinese, fears of divided national loyalties and “fifth columns” have been strong.

zh: 一个近期的例子就是“李文和案件 ” ， 他是洛斯阿拉莫斯国家实验室的科学家，曾经被无端指控为间谍。 这更加说明了美国社会的“阴阳”两面性以及在少数族裔问题上的敏感立场。
en: One need only recall the recent case of Wen Ho Lee, the Los Alamos National Laboratory scientist who was unjustly accused of spying, to be reminded of how yin and yang are America’s feelings about minority members in sensitive positions.

zh: 还有第二个问题：美国国会拒绝接受气候变化的新提案，理由是作为发展中国家的中国没有履行碳排放量的限制；由于美国政府拒绝接受人均及总排放量的限制 ， （ 这个限制分别约为限制中国水平的三到四倍。
en: There is a second obstruction as well: the US Congress refuses to face up realistically to the climate challenge, because China, as a developing country, is not obliged to accept compulsory carbon limits. Then, because the US refuses to take responsibility for its cumulative and per capita greenhouse-gas emissions – which are, respectively, roughly four and three times greater than China’s – the Chinese leadership refuses to make concessions.

zh: ） ， 中国政府也拒绝让步。 目前僵局还没有打破。
en: A standoff ensues, which is where we are now.

zh: 中国近期要求美国将碳排放量减少1990年排放水平的40%的同时，利用美国0.5-1%的GDP来资助中国以及其他发展中国家减排。
en: China recently demanded that the US reduce its emissions by 40% from its 1990 baseline levels and subsidize emission reduction efforts in China and other developing countries to the tune of .05-1% of America’s GDP.

zh: 但近期美国众议院通过的《瓦克斯曼-马凯气候变化议案》仅仅要求美国减少1990年排放水平的3.6 % 。
en: But the recently House-passed Waxman-Markey bill proposes that the US only cut emissions by 3.6% of 1990 baseline levels.

zh: 所以说，目前说美中之间的相互理解并真正达成确实可行的协定还为时过早。
en: So it is still far from clear what will actually work to bring about an understanding between the US and China that produces real results.

zh: 再加上印度反对美国国务卿希拉里在气候变化问题上的立场，这更加说明发展中国家在此问题上的立场是相当一致团结。
en: Moreover, with India poking Secretary of State Hillary Clinton in the eye over her climate-change entreaties, the world could easily see an even more unified and unyielding bloc emerge among developing countries.

zh: 接下来就要看今年11月奥巴马总统的北京之行了。
en: The next moment to watch is Obama’s trip to China in November.

zh: 如果所有的友好氛围都不能落在实处，中美两国之间来之不易的大好局面将会荡然无存。
en: Here, if all the expressions of good feeling cannot be made concrete, an incomparable opportunity to recast Sino-US relations around the issue of climate change will have been lost.

zh: 核不扩散的新起点
en: A New Start for Non-Proliferation

zh: 维也纳 — — 美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马已经为中止了十年的核裁军的努力注入了新的动力。
en: VIENNA – US President Barack Obama has injected fresh momentum into efforts – stalled for a decade – to bring about nuclear disarmament.

zh: 他许下了一个关于没有核武器世界的诺言，并且承认核不扩散与核能源和平利用存在着关联。
en: He has committed himself to the vision of a world free of nuclear weapons and acknowledges the link between nuclear non-proliferation and disarmament by the nuclear-weapon states.

zh: 奥巴马表示，他将令于1970年签订的核不扩散条约（NPT）恢复活力，这一条约旨在防止核武器的扩散。
en: Obama has pledged to revitalize the 1970 Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT), which aims to prevent the spread of nuclear weapons.

zh: 由核不扩散条约作为基石的核不扩散体制正陷入混乱，其中存在的主要问题显而易见。
en: The non-proliferation regime, of which the NPT is the cornerstone, is in disarray. The main problems are easily identified.

zh: 问题之一在于，五个主要的核武器拥有国并没有认真对待他们所承担的核不扩散条约中关于进行核裁军的义务。
en: First, the five main nuclear-weapon states have not taken seriously their NPT obligation to work for nuclear disarmament.

zh: 相反，它们坚称核武器对于其安全至关重要，并且仍在对其核武库进行现代化升级。
en: Instead, they have insisted that nuclear weapons are essential for their security and continued to modernize their nuclear arsenals.

zh: 这自然使其失去了说服他国不要获取核武器的道义权威，而核武器依旧被人们视为权力与影响力的一大来源，同时也是防止遭受进攻的一种保险政策。
en: This naturally robs them of the moral authority to persuade others not to acquire nuclear weapons, which continue to be perceived as a source of power and influence, and an insurance policy against attack.

zh: 问题之二在于，正如我们在朝鲜案例中所看到的那样，没有能阻止住条约签字国在宣布“非常事件”已对其至高利益构成威胁后、从不扩散体制中一走了之的办法。
en: Second, as we have seen in the case of North Korea, there is nothing to stop countries that sign the Treaty from simply walking out after declaring that “extraordinary events” have jeopardized their supreme interests.

zh: 问题之三在于，被认为是不扩散机制维护者的国际原子能机构正处于资金不足的耻辱境地。
en: Third, the International Atomic Energy Agency, which is supposed to police the non-proliferation system, is shamefully underfunded.

zh: 当国际原子能机构在判定一国是否正在从事秘密核武器计划时，该机构检查人员常常感到力不从心，这或是因为他们缺乏进入被其认为是必须检查的场所的法律权威，或是因为国际原子能机构的分析实验室已经过时，又或是因为该机构无法获取充足的卫星图片。
en: When it comes to determining whether or not a country is conducting a covert nuclear weapons program, IAEA inspectors often have their hands tied, either because they lack the legal authority to gain access to all the locations they consider necessary, or because the IAEA’s analytical laboratories are outdated, or because the Agency does not have adequate access to satellite imagery.

zh: 问题之四在于，出口管制未能阻止敏感核技术的传播。 这一点尤其源于秘密核网络所采取的复杂而老练的努力，由巴基斯坦核科学家卡迪尔·汗运作的网络便为其中一例。
en: Fourth, export controls have failed to prevent the spread of sensitive nuclear technology, not least due to the sophisticated efforts of clandestine networks like the one run by Pakistani nuclear scientist A.Q. Khan.

zh: 已经有九个国家拥有核武器，而假定其他国家，尤其是那些身处冲突地区的国家，对于核武器没有非分之想，这真是过于天真了。
en: Nine countries already have nuclear weapons, and it would be naive to presume that others, particularly in regions of conflict, will not try to get hold of them.

zh: 此外，一批开展核能项目的国家还拥有这种能力：当它们的安全认知发生改变时，只要愿意，便能在短短数月内生产出核武器，这是因为它们已经掌握了临界技术 — — 铀浓缩与钚的再处理。
en: In addition, a number of countries with nuclear energy programs have the capability, if they choose, to manufacture nuclear weapons within a matter of months if their security perceptions change, because they have mastered the critical technology – uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing.

zh: 如果更多的国家进行效仿，这个问题将被证明是核不扩散体制的阿喀琉斯之踵。
en: If more countries take this path, it could prove to be the Achilles’ heel of non-proliferation.

zh: 问题之五在于，以联合国安理会为首的国际社会往往在国际安全面临挑战的情况下陷入瘫痪，对于疑似的核扩散事件也无法做出有效的回应。
en: Fifth, the international community, spearheaded by the United Nations Security Council, has more often than not been paralyzed in the face of challenges to international security and ineffectual in responding to suspected cases of nuclear proliferation.

zh: 这些问题不可能在一夜之间得到解决，但有很多工作却可以相对较快地完成。
en: These issues will not be resolved overnight. But there is much that can be done relatively quickly.

zh: 美俄已经开启谈判，以对两国占全球27000枚核弹头总量95%的核武库进行大规模削减。
en: The United States and Russia have started negotiations on deep cuts in their nuclear arsenals, which together account for 95% of the world’s 27,000 warheads.

zh: 其他一些关键步骤包括：令全面禁止核试验条约生效；通过谈判制定出一份可被验证的条约，以停止用于武器目的的裂变材料的生产；极大地改善核物质与放射性物质的物理安全，这对于防止它们落入恐怖分子之手非常重要；同时还要对国际原子能机构加以强化。
en: Other key steps include bringing into force the Comprehensive Nuclear Test Ban Treaty; negotiating a verifiable treaty to end production of fissile material for use in weapons; radically improving the physical security of nuclear and radioactive materials, which is vital to prevent them from falling into the hands of terrorists; and strengthening the IAEA.

zh: 上个月，我向国际原子能机构理事会提出了关于强化不扩散机制的关键措施的建议 — — 即创立一家国际原子能机构低浓缩铀 (LEU)银行，以保证对那些需要核燃料来维持其核能反应堆运转的国家的供应。
en: Last month, I proposed a key measure to strengthen non-proliferation to the IAEA’s Board of Governors – establishing an IAEA bank of low-enriched uranium (LEU) to guarantee supplies to countries that need nuclear fuel for their power reactors.

zh: 低浓缩铀无法被用来制造武器。
en: LEU cannot be used to make weapons.

zh: 随着更多的国家引入核能，这一类机制将在未来的几十年中发挥关键的作用。
en: Some such mechanism will be essential in the coming decades as more and more countries introduce nuclear energy.

zh: 我提议创立一座处于国际原子能机构支配下的低浓缩铀实体储备库，它将作为那些拥有核能项目的国家在面对并非由商业因素造成的供应中断时，所能求助的终极储备。
en: My proposal is to create a physical stockpile of LEU at the disposal of the IAEA as a last-resort reserve for countries with nuclear power programs that face a supply disruption for non-commercial reasons.

zh: 这一措施将令各国产生信心，使其相信可以依赖可靠的燃料供给来维持其核电站的运转，由此，它们不再需要发展本国的铀浓缩或钚再处理能力。
en: This would give countries confidence that they can count on reliable supplies of fuel to run their nuclear power plants, and therefore do not need to develop their own uranium-enrichment or plutonium-reprocessing capability.

zh: 这一措施将有助于避免伊朗在1979年革命后的经历重演，当时有关该国计划中的核能项目的燃料与技术合同未得到履行。
en: This could help to avoid a repeat of Iran’s experiences after its 1979 revolution, when contracts for fuel and technology for its planned nuclear power program were not honored.

zh: 三十年后，我们仍然能感受到这一事件的部分后果。
en: Thirty years later, some of the consequences are still being felt.

zh: 低浓缩铀将在非政治性、非歧视性标准的基础上，向那些存在需求的国家开放。
en: The LEU would be available to countries in need on the basis of non-political and non-discriminatory criteria.
