zh: 所有遵守核保障义务的国家都能按市场价格获得这些材料。
en: It would be accessible at market prices to all states in compliance with their nuclear safeguards obligations.

zh: 各国将不会被要求放弃发展本国燃料循环技术的权利。
en: No state would be required to give up the right to develop its own fuel cycle.

zh: 低浓缩铀银行所需的启动资金已经到位，这主要归功于非政府组织 — — “核威胁倡议 ” ， 以及来自沃伦·巴菲特的初步资助。
en: The money needed to launch an LEU bank is in place, thanks primarily to a non-governmental organization – the Nuclear Threat Initiative – and initial funding from Warren Buffett.

zh: 但这仅仅还只是第一步，接下来应当签署一份协议，使得所有新的浓缩与再处理活动将被完全置于多国管制之下，而所有现存类似设施的管制权也将由一国转移到多国手中。
en: But this can only be a first step. It should be followed by an agreement that all new enrichment and reprocessing activities will be placed exclusively under multinational control, and that all existing such facilities will be converted from national to multinational control.

zh: 这是一个大胆的想法，但在今日，我们比过去任何时候都更需要大胆的想法。
en: This is a bold idea, but bold ideas are needed now more than ever.

zh: 60年前，由于冷战的关系，人类错失了将核燃料循环置于多国管制下的机会；如今，核技术的散播与核恐怖主义风险的不断增长使得我们必须在这一次将它导向正轨。
en: The opportunity to put the nuclear fuel cycle under multinational control was missed 60 years ago because of the Cold War. The spread of nuclear technology and the growing risk of nuclear terrorism make it imperative that we get it right this time.

zh: 以色列和巴勒斯坦的新建国方案
en: A New-State Solution for Israel and Palestine

zh: 普林斯顿—考虑在巴以问题上提出这样一个两国方案：巴勒斯坦人有权回到家园，以色列人可以在约旦河西岸任何买得到土地的地方定居，而耶路撒冷不需要一分为二。
en: PRINCETON – Imagine a two-state solution in Israel and Palestine in which Palestinians would have the right of return; Israelis could settle wherever they could purchase land in the West Bank; and Jerusalem need not be divided.

zh: 这并不是一个理想方案，但具有创造力，堪称21世纪建国明智样板。
en: This is not a fanciful vision, but a creative and eminently sensible reinvention of twenty-first century statehood.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马刚刚结束的以色列之行就提供了探索真正新思维的机会。
en: And US President Barack Obama’s just-completed visit to Israel provides an opportunity to explore genuinely new thinking.

zh: 2000年，比尔·克林顿几乎成功地促成了全面和解，至此以后，以巴和平进程支持者一直受一个咒语的困扰：尽管存在解决方案，愿意向这个方向靠拢的以色列和巴勒斯坦领导人从未获得成功。
en: Ever since Bill Clinton nearly succeeded in brokering a comprehensive settlement in 2000, the mantra among supporters of the Israeli-Palestinian peace process has been that, while a solution exists, Israeli and Palestinian leaders who are willing to reach it do not.

zh: 解决方案正是克林顿所追求的协议：基于1967年边界的两个主权国家，土地交换的谈判反应现有和解模式。
en: The solution is a version of the deal that Clinton sought: two sovereign states based on the 1967 borders, with negotiated land swaps to reflect existing settlement patterns.

zh: 这一安排包括一个联系加沙和约旦河西岸的陆上走廊；将耶路撒冷一分为二，保证所有人都能前往宗教场所；巴勒斯坦放弃回家的权利；以色列愿意拆除一致边界外的定居点；中东承认两国地位。
en: The agreement would include a land corridor connecting Gaza and the West Bank; a divided Jerusalem with guaranteed access for all to religious sites; Palestinians’ renunciation of the right of return; Israel’s willingness to dismantle settlements outside the agreed borders; and recognition of both states across the Middle East.

zh: 但是，考虑一下，巴勒斯坦人和以色列人之所以愿意达成这样一个方案，其原因是这一方案本身在双方内部都得不到支持。
en: But suppose that the reason that no Palestinians and Israelis willing to conclude such a deal have emerged is that the solution itself is domestically unsupportable on both sides.

zh: 考虑一下，只要这一方案的某个版本是唯一的方案，则以色列国的逐渐蚕食土地和以色列阿拉伯裔人口的不断增加将持续破坏其基础。
en: Suppose that as long as a version of this deal is the only game in town, the creeping physical expansion of the Israeli state and the demographic expansion of Israeli Arabs will continue to erode its foundation.

zh: 两国方案的窗口正在迅速关闭（获悉已经关闭 ） ， 之所以有这样的警告，是因为这一方案本是就是问题。
en: For all the dire warnings that the window for a two-state solution is rapidly closing (or has already closed), it is the solution itself that is the problem.

zh: 2008年，普林斯顿一名名叫罗素·尼利（Russell Nieli）的哲学研究生在普林斯顿犹太生活中心（Princeton Center for Jewish Life）做了一次演讲，这次演讲广受好评，以至于他后来将内容扩展为刊登在美国杂志Tikkun上的一篇文章（该杂志创始人是勒纳拉比（Rabbi Michael Lerner ） ） 。
en: In 2008, a Princeton University graduate student in philosophy named Russell Nieli gave a talk at the Princeton Center for Jewish Life that was so well received that he later expanded it into an article for the US-based magazine Tikkun, founded by Rabbi Michael Lerner.

zh: 这篇题为《通向永久巴以和平 — — 两国安全套主义方案研究 》 （ Toward a Permanent Palestinian/Israeli Peace – the Case for Two-State Condominialism）发表的目的是刺激“犹太人和阿拉伯人年青一代的创造性思维，不要深陷过去的短浅目光和失败政策之囹圄。 ”
en: The article, “Toward a Permanent Palestinian/Israeli Peace – the Case for Two-State Condominialism,” was published with the express aim of stimulating “productive thinking among a younger generation of Jews and Arabs not bound by the restricted vision and failed policies of the past.”

zh: “两国安全套主义方案”的名字颇为不雅，但相当有远见。
en: “Two-state condominialism” is as visionary as the name is clunky.

zh: 其核心观点是以色列人和巴勒斯坦人将是两个独立国家的公民，从而属于两个独立的正值当局。
en: The core idea is that Israelis and Palestinians would be citizens of two separate states and thus would identify with two separate political authorities.

zh: 巴勒斯坦将是巴勒斯坦人民的国家，以色列将是犹太人国家。
en: Palestine would be defined as a state of the Palestinian people, and Israel as a Jewish state.

zh: 但是，在“安全套主义”下，巴勒斯坦人和犹太人“将被赋予在两国任意土地上定居的权利，这两个国家将形成一个单一的双民族定居社会。 ”
en: Under “condominialism,” however, both Palestinians and Jews “would be granted the right to settle anywhere within the territory of either of the two states, the two states thus forming a single, binational settlement community.”

zh: 花点时间想想这一点。
en: Think about that for a minute.

zh: 正如尼利所描述的，巴勒斯坦人“有权在以色列内部任何地方定居，正如犹太人有权在巴勒斯坦国领土内任何地方定居。
en: As Nieli describes it, Palestinians “would have the right to settle anywhere within Israel just as Jews would have the right to settle anywhere within the territory of the Palestinian state.

zh: 不管他们生活在哪个国家，所有巴勒斯坦人都是巴勒斯坦国公民，所有犹太人都是以色列公民。
en: Regardless of which of the two states they lived in, all Palestinians would be citizens of the Palestinian state, all Jews citizens of Israel.”

zh: ”每个国家都有政府和满足生活在另一个国家领土内的公民的经济、文化、宗教和福利需要的义务。
en: Each state would have the authority and the obligation to provide for the economic, cultural, religious, and welfare needs of its citizens living in the other state’s territory.

zh: 这些是超越国界的权利和责任，正如（比如）美国要满足驻外人员（比如海外军事基地的平民家属）的这些需要。
en: These would be extraterritorial rights and responsibilities, just as the United States, for example, provides for its large numbers of expatriates, such as civilian dependents of US military personnel based abroad.

zh: 为了要让这个方案奏效，首先必须定义每个国家的边界 — — 或许是以1967年边界为基础辅以互相同意的领土交换。
en: To make this work, the borders of each state would first have to be defined – presumably on the basis of the 1967 borders, with mutually agreed territorial swaps.

zh: 以色列阿拉伯人将被要求将国籍、国民身份和投票权 — — 但不包括敌据点 — — 转换至新的巴勒斯坦国。
en: Israeli Arabs would then be required to transfer their citizenship, national identity, and national voting rights – but not their residence – to the new Palestinian state.

zh: 他们将拥有永久居住在以色列的权利，保有目前以以色列公民身份获得的福利，但他们将以巴勒斯坦公民的身份参与投票。
en: They would have a permanent right to live in Israel and would retain the benefits to which they are currently entitled as Israeli citizens, but they would now vote as citizens of Palestine.

zh: 其他居住在以色列的巴勒斯坦人将只获得巴勒斯坦法律规定的权利和福利。
en: All other Palestinians living in Israel would have rights and benefits only under Palestinian law.

zh: 安全套主义承认约旦河西岸以色列定居者和其他以色列之间具有深刻联系的现实 — — 包括公路、供水、电网、政府结构和经济关系等（正如耶路撒冷的以色列区和巴勒斯坦区互相联系一样 ） 。
en: Condominialism recognizes the reality of the deep interconnectedness of Israeli settlers in the West Bank with the rest of Israel – through roads, water supplies, electricity grids, administrative structures, and economic relationships (just as Israeli and Palestinian parts of Jerusalem are interdependent).

zh: 与隔离和重建所有这些结构和关系相比，在此基础上以让两国人民和经济都受益的方式进行建设更加有效。
en: Instead of trying to separate and recreate all of these structures and relationships, it makes far more sense to build on them in ways that benefit both states’ peoples and economies.

zh: 此外，在许多公民将越来越多的时间用于虚拟空间的世界中，安全套主义实际上已经发生了。
en: And, in a world in which many citizens spend an increasing proportion of their time in virtual space, de facto condominialism is already happening.

zh: 20世纪50年代，欧洲在经历了四十年战争蹂躏后，形成了欧盟的思想，成员国公民可以自由地跨国工作，同时保留政治忠诚和文化身份，这一思想同样意义深远。
en: In the 1950’s, after four decades of war across Europe, the idea of a European Union in which member states’ citizens could live and work freely across national borders while retaining their political allegiance and cultural identity seemed equally far-fetched.

zh: （事实上，欧盟建立的政治过程的名字 ， “ 新功能主义 ” （ neo-functionalism）之抽象和繁琐与“两国安全套主义”如出一辙。
en: (Indeed, the name of the political process by which the EU was to be constructed, “neo-functionalism,” was every bit as abstract and cumbersome as “two-state condominialism.”)

zh: ）但法国和德国政治家带着远见和决心开启了大胆的实验，一个包括了5亿人民币的单一经济体实验。
en: Yet French and German statesmen summoned the vision and the will to launch a bold experiment, one that has evolved into a single economy of 500 million people.

zh: 为何另一个古老对立不能成为建国新概念源头？
en: Why shouldn’t another site of ancient enmities be the source of a new conception of statehood?

zh: 有趣的是，20世纪50年代的很多年轻人，比如我的比利时母亲，热烈支持新欧洲的愿景。
en: Interestingly, many young people in the 1950’s, like my Belgian mother, ardently supported the vision of a new Europe.

zh: 今天的年轻以色列人和巴勒斯坦人以他们的创业主义而自豪，尽管开创新事业包含着各种新风险，需要各种远见卓识。
en: Today’s young Israelis and Palestinians pride themselves on their entrepreneurialism, with all the risk and vision that starting something new entails.

zh: 支持并为创新政治开端做出贡献将是这一代人的标志性行为。
en: Supporting and contributing to an innovative political start-up would be their generation’s defining act.

zh: 美国的拉丁美洲新议程
en: A New US Agenda for Latin America

zh: 墨西哥城－对下一任美国总统来说，处理布什政府遗留下来的国际混乱状态不是一个简单的任务。
en: MEXICO CITY – For the next American president, fixing the international mess inherited from the Bush administration will be no simple task.

zh: 虽然拉丁美洲对不管是奥巴马政府还是麦凯恩政府来说，都不是首要任务，但是，美国政府继续过去七年来对拉丁美洲的忽略态度不再可行了。
en: While Latin America will not be a priority for either an Obama or McCain administration, continuing the United States’ neglect of the last seven years is no longer viable.

zh: 拉丁美洲有两个明显的政治/外交挑战突显出来：古巴即将到来的转变或继承危机，该地区“两种左派”力量的持续上升，其中一种是由委内瑞拉总统雨果·查韦斯代表的左派，另一种是由巴西影响力不断增强的总统卢拉·达席尔瓦所代表的左派。
en: Two distinct political/diplomatic challenges stand out: Cuba’s imminent transition or succession crisis, and the continuing ascent of the region’s “two lefts,” one represented by Venezuela’s President Hugo Chávez and the other by Brazil’s increasingly influential President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

zh: 如果下一届美国政府领会到拉丁美洲正在经历一个结合了其历史上最好和最坏的方面的时刻：20世纪70年代以来最快的经济增长速度，贫困和不平等在逐渐减少，比以前任何时候都更民主和尊重人权，但是也在政治上变得更两极化了，它一定会成功。
en: The next US administration will only prove successful if it grasps that Latin America is living through a moment that combines the best and worst aspects of its history: the fastest economic growth since the 1970’s, with poverty and inequality diminishing, and more democratic and respectful of human rights than ever before, but becoming more politically polarized.

zh: 在古巴，菲德尔·卡斯特罗最终从历史舞台上的消失代表着一个巨大的挑战。
en: In Cuba, Fidel Castro’s eventual passing from the scene represents an immense challenge.

zh: 美国不能再继续过去半个世纪失败的政策。
en: The US cannot continue with the failed policies of the past half-century.

zh: 美国要求以完全的民主转变作为美国和古巴关系正常化的前提，对拉丁美洲来说是既不切实际又不受欢迎的。
en: Demanding a full-fledged democratic transition as a pre-condition for normalizing US-Cuban relations is both unrealistic and unpalatable to Latin America.

zh: 然而，在其等待着菲德尔的弟弟劳尔继续统治的时候，美国不可能将古巴的民主和人权问题置之不理。
en: Yet the US cannot set aside the question of democracy and human rights in Cuba while it awaits the departure of Fidel’s brother, Raúl.

zh: 现实政治和对另一大批古巴难民通过佛罗里达海峡涌入的担忧，可能会吸引美国对古巴使用“中国”或“越南”解决办法：用外交关系的正常化换取经济改革，同时将内部政治变革的问题留待以后解决。
en: Realpolitik and fear of another exodus of Cuban refugees across the Florida Straits may tempt the US to pursue a “Chinese” or “Vietnamese” solution to Cuba: normalizing diplomatic relations in exchange for economic reform, while leaving the question of internal political change until later.

zh: 但是，美国不应该在这种诱惑面前让步。
en: But the US should not succumb to this temptation.

zh: 美国、加拿大、欧洲以及拉丁美洲已经建立了一个区域法律体制来保护该半球的民主统治和人权，这一体制不应该被抛弃。
en: The US, Canada, Europe, and Latin America have constructed a regional legal framework, which must not be abandoned, to defend democratic rule and human rights in the hemisphere.

zh: 古巴需要回归到地区强国的圈子，但是它必须接受该圈子的规则。
en: Cuba needs to return to the regional concert of powers, but it must accept this concert’s rules.

zh: 进行自由和公平的选举可能不是最主要的问题，但是，它们也不应该为了稳定和私利而被搁置一边。
en: Holding free and fair elections may not be the primary issue, but nor are they issues that should be shelved in the interests of stability and expediency.

zh: 选举反而应该是全面关系正常化进程的一部分：它们既不应该是达成协议的障碍，也不应该是一个不是问题的问题。
en: Elections must instead be part of a comprehensive process of normalization: they should neither be a deal-breaker nor a non-issue.

zh: 在古巴的转变一旦开始美国就应该解除其贸易禁运的同时，其他所有事情也应该以古巴开始解决一切突出问题的进程为条件。
en: While the US should lift its trade embargo as soon as Cuba’s transition begins, everything else should be conditional on Cuba initiating a process of resolving all outstanding issues.

zh: 但是，古巴仅仅是可以被称作拉丁美洲“左派”问题的一部分。
en: But Cuba is just part of what might be called Latin America’s “left” problem.

zh: 确实，最近已经有大量关于在过去十年里拉丁美洲左派势力增强的文章。
en: Indeed, much has been written recently about the ascent of the left in Latin America over the past decade.

zh: 事实上，在该地区有两种左派：一种是智利、巴西、乌拉圭、中美洲的一部分国家以及某种程度上的秘鲁的现代的、民主的、全球化的以及对市场友好的左派；另一种是墨西哥、萨尔瓦多、尼加拉瓜、古巴、厄瓜多尔、玻利维亚、委内瑞拉以及阿根廷、哥伦比亚以及巴拉圭的不那么强烈的倒退的、民粹主义的、独裁的、中央经济统治的以及反美的左派。
en: In fact, there are two lefts in the region: a modern, democratic, globalized and market-friendly left, found in Chile, Brazil, Uruguay, parts of Central America, and, up to a point, in Peru; and a retrograde, populist, authoritarian, statist, and anti-American left, found in Mexico, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Cuba, Ecuador, Bolivia, Venezuela, and, to a lesser extent, in Argentina, Colombia, and Paraguay.

zh: 有些这样的“左派”正在执政；有些，像墨西哥上届充满争议的总统选举那样，刚刚未能当选，但是将来仍有可能执政。
en: Some of these “lefts” are in power; some, as in Mexico in its last, disputed presidential election, barely missed conquering it, but may still do so.

zh: 在过去两年里，总的来说 ， “ 现代的”或“温和的”左派将国家治理得不错，这一点越来越明显了。
en: Over the past two years, it has become increasingly evident that the “modern” or “soft” left is, all in all, governing well.

zh: 另一种左派已经变得比许多人预期的要更加极端和 不可琢磨。
en: The other left has proved to be more extreme and erratic than many anticipated.

zh: 前者没有将其“模式 ” “ 出口”的动力，而后者有这样做的策略和途径。
en: The former feels no urge to “export” its “model,” whereas the latter has a strategy and the means to do so.

zh: 现在倒退的左派可以实现切·格瓦拉过去的梦想：不是“一个，两个，许多的越南人 ” ， 而是“一个，两个，许多的委内瑞拉人 ” ， 通过投票赢得权力，然后通过宪法变革和建立武装自卫队以及完全统一的政党来保存和集中权力。
en: The retrograde left today can realize Che Guevara’s old dream: not “one, two, many Vietnams,” but “one, two, many Venezuelas,” winning power by the ballot and then conserving and concentrating it through constitutional changes and the creation of armed militias and monolithic parties.

zh: 它可以从委内瑞拉的国有石油公司的支持中来获得实现所有这些活动所需的资金，执行在长期内是误导的但是在短期内很诱人的社会政策，特别是当这些政策是由古巴医生、教师和教导人员执行的时候。
en: It can finance all of this with the support of Venezuela’s state oil company, implementing social policies that are misguided over the long term but seductive in the short run, especially when carried out by Cuban doctors, teachers, and instructors.

zh: 对美国的下任总统来说，在这里有一个两难的问题：怎样以一种改善美国和拉丁美洲国家之间关系 ，加强现代左派，又不借助于过去失败的干涉主义政策来削弱倒退的左派的方式，来应对两种左派之间明显的区分。
en: Herein lies a dilemma for the next US president: how to address the clear rift between the two lefts in a way that improves US-Latin American relations, fortifies the modern left, and weakens the retrograde left without resorting to the failed interventionist policies of the past.

zh: 最好的严格专注于拉丁美洲的措施是不言自明的，即使它们不是很容易取得成功。
en: The best, strictly Latin America-focused steps, are self-evident, if not easily achievable.

zh: 这些措施需要壮大由现代左派执政的政府，或者那些受到旧式左派威胁的中间或中间偏右的政府，并同时让旧式左派明白，违反民主的基本原则，不尊重人权以及不遵守法制，是要付出代价的。
en: They require strengthening those governments of the modern left, or those of the center or center-right threatened by the old-fashioned left, and simultaneously making it clear to the latter that there is a price to be paid for violating the basic tenets of democracy, respect for human rights, and the rule of law.

zh: 对美国来说，面对这样的挑战的时候不予理睬，不再是 一个可行的选择。
en: Turning its back in the face of such challenges is no longer a viable American option.

zh: 除了其特别关注的领域（石油，武器，游击队，毒品）以外，美国现在非常需要拉丁美洲，因为对其的抵制到处存在，并且这些抵制比自二战结束以来的任何时候都具有更大的恶意。
en: Aside from areas of particular concern (oil, arms, guerrillas, drugs), the US needs Latin America dearly nowadays because resistance to it is springing up everywhere, and with greater virulence than at any time since World War II’s end.

zh: 下任美国总统必须复兴一种自70年前富兰克林·罗斯福的睦邻政策以来，首次准备进行充分变革的拉丁美洲关系。
en: The next US president must reinvigorate a relationship that is ready to be substantially transformed for the first time since Franklin Roosevelt’s Good Neighbor Policy of seven decades ago.

zh: 全球冲突之年
en: A New Year of Global Conflict

zh: 达沃斯—在当今世界，要想识别和管理热点，光是画一张地图，标明出火点然后派全副武装的外交官去灭火是不够的。
en: DAVOS – In today’s world, identifying and managing hotspots is not simply a matter of pulling out a map, spotting the wildfires, and empowering diplomats to douse the flames.

zh: 要理解当今世界的主要冲突和对抗，我们必须认清导致它们产生的全球政治环境。
en: To understand today’s major conflicts and confrontations, we must recognize important ways in which global political conditions enable them.

zh: 冲突最有可能产生或持续的情况是有办法阻止或终结它们的人无法或不愿这样做。
en: Conflicts are much more likely to arise or persist when those with the means to prevent or end them cannot or will not do so.

zh: 不幸的是，这将是2013年的一大特征。
en: Unfortunately, this will be borne out in 2013.

zh: 在美国，除非发生直接威胁国家安全的外交政策危机，否则总统奥巴马的政府将把大部分时间、能量和政治资本集中在减少债务和其他国内事务上。
en: In the United States, barring a foreign-policy crisis that directly threatens national security, President Barack Obama’s administration will focus most of its time, energy, and political capital on debt reduction and other domestic priorities.

zh: 在欧洲，官员将继续为重塑欧元区信心而挣扎。
en: In Europe, officials will continue their struggle to restore confidence in the eurozone.

zh: 而在中国，尽管对经济增长和就业创造的需求将迫使新领导人发展与其他地区的信联系，但他们不会因经济改革的复杂性过大分去太多精力而在亚洲之外造成不必要的损失和风险。
en: And, in China, though the demands of economic growth and job creation will force the country’s new leaders to develop new ties to other regions, they are far too preoccupied with the complexities of economic reform to assume unnecessary costs and risks outside Asia.

zh: 这就是为何世界之火将在今年烧得更旺。
en: That is why the world’s fires will burn longer and hotter this year.

zh: 这并不意味着世界大国不会给自己造成麻烦。
en: This does not mean that the world’s powers will not inflict damage of their own.

zh: 如今，大国政府更有可能使用无人机和特种部队对付它们眼中的敌人。
en: Today, these governments are more likely to use drones and special forces to strike at their perceived enemies.

zh: 世界已经习惯了美国使用无人机对阿富汗、巴基斯坦和也门实施空袭，但最新报道显示，中国和日本也在投资无人机 — — 部分是为了在东海岛争中占得先机。
en: The world has grown used to US drone strikes in Afghanistan, Pakistan, and Yemen, but recent news reports suggest that China and Japan are also investing in unmanned aircraft – in part to enhance their leverage in disputes over islands in the East China Sea.

zh: 这些技术创新降低了袭击的成本和风险，从而加大了军事行动的可能性。
en: By lowering the costs and risks of attack, these technological innovations make military action more likely.

zh: 或许削弱对手、打击敌人成本最低的方式是网络战。
en: Perhaps the lowest-cost way to undermine rivals and attack enemies is to launch attacks in cyberspace.

zh: 这就是为什么大量财大气粗的政府 — — 以及某些财力并不如此雄厚的政府 — — 正在投资于这方面的技术和技能。
en: That is why so many deep-pocketed governments – and some that are not so rich – are investing heavily in the technology and skills needed to enhance this capability.

zh: 这种形式的战争更值得担心，原因有二。
en: This form of warfare is especially worrisome for two reasons.

zh: 首先，与冷战时代的“确保互相摧毁”结构不同，网络武器为使用者提供了匿名袭击的机会。
en: First, unlike the structure of Cold War-era “mutually assured destruction,” cyber weapons offer those who use them an opportunity to strike anonymously.

zh: 其次，技术的不断改变保证了没有哪个政府可以了解其网络武器能造成多大的破坏以及形成多大的威慑力，只有使用过以后才能知晓。
en: Second, constant changes in technology ensure that no government can know how much damage its cyber-weapons can do or how well its deterrence will work until they use them.

zh: 结果，如今各国都无时无刻不在互相监视防御力量，从而增加了意外敌对的风险。
en: As a result, governments now probe one another’s defenses every day, increasing the risk of accidental hostilities.

zh: 如果约翰·克里和查克·哈格尔分别被确认为美国国务卿和国防部长，则奥巴马政府中将出现两位坚���的军事干预质疑派。
en: If John Kerry and Chuck Hagel are confirmed as US secretaries of state and defense, respectively, the Obama administration will feature two prominent skeptics of military intervention.

zh: 但美国在无人机、网络工具和其他非传统武器上的投资水平极有可能不会降低。
en: But high levels of US investment in drones, cyber-tools, and other unconventional weaponry will most likely be maintained.

zh: 这些技术进步形成了两大最重要地缘政治热点的竞争和敌对的背景。
en: These technological advances create the backdrop for the competition and rivalries roiling the two most important geopolitical hotspots.

zh: 在中东，美国和欧洲官员今年将继续拒绝深度参与地区动荡，让本地势力 — — 土耳其、伊朗和沙特 — — 竞争地区影响力。
en: In the Middle East, US and European officials will continue to resist deeper involvement in regional turmoil this year, leaving local powers – Turkey, Iran, and Saudi Arabia – to vie for influence.

zh: 温和派和激进派的对立，以及逊尼派和什叶派的对立，将在不少北非和中东国家上演。
en: Confrontations between moderates and militants, and between Sunni and Shia factions, are playing out in several North African and Middle Eastern countries.

zh: 美国官员有理由相信，假以时日，他们可以降低对该地区及其问题的担忧程度。
en: US officials have reason to believe that, over time, they will be able to worry less about the region and its problems.

zh: 根据当前预测，非传统能源领域技术创新将在2020年使美国靠北美和南美的资源便可满足80%以上的能源需求。
en: According to current projections, technological innovations in unconventional energy will allow the US to meet more than 80% of its oil demand from sources in North and South America by 2020.

zh: 另一方面，中国将越来越依赖中东的石油产出。
en: China, on the other hand, is set to become more dependent on Middle Eastern output.

zh: 与此同时，东亚仍将是2013年潜在麻烦点。
en: Meanwhile, East Asia will remain a potential trouble spot in 2013.

zh: 中国的众多邻国担心其经济和军事的不断扩张给它们的利益和独立带来越来越大的威胁，并在倒向美国以寻求安全伙伴的多样化以及防范中国的不良企图。
en: Many of China’s neighbors fear that its ongoing economic and military expansion poses a growing threat to their interests and independence, and are reaching out to the US to diversify their security partnerships and hedge their bets on China’s benign intentions.

zh: 美国则可望通过在世界增长最快的地区开发新贸易伙伴来提振其长期经济前景，因此也在转向亚洲 — — 尽管美国（和欧洲）决策者同时也在明智地推进跨大西洋自由贸易协定。
en: The US, eager to boost its economy’s longer-term prospects by engaging new trade partners in the world’s fastest-growing region, is shifting resources to Asia – though US (and European) policymakers would be wise to move forward with a transatlantic free-trade agreement as well.

zh: 一个越来越大的风险是，新的中国领导权将意味着美国在该地区的深度参与，以此作为遏制中国崛起、阻碍中国增长的手段。
en: There is a growing risk that the new Chinese leadership will interpret a heavier US presence in the region as an attempt to contain China’s rise and stunt its growth.

zh: 在该地区，我们已经看到了一系列令人担忧的对立，比如南海的中越对立和中菲对立，以及东海的中日对立。
en: We have already seen a series of worrisome confrontations in the region, pitting China against Vietnam and the Philippines in the South China Sea, and against Japan in the East China Sea.

zh: 这些纷争今年尚不会导致军事对抗，但无人机和网络武器的使用仍是实实在在的威胁。
en: While these disputes are unlikely to provoke military hostilities this year, the use of drones and cyber weapons remains a real threat.

zh: 2013年的最大风险是亚洲的大规模经济冲突，这不仅会直接伤害牵涉到的国家，也会阻碍全球复苏。
en: The greatest risk for 2013 is large-scale economic conflict in Asia, which would not only harm the countries directly involved, but would also undermine global recovery.

zh: 这个战场上的第一批战火已经被点燃了。
en: The first shots in this battle have already been fired.

zh: 去年夏天，东海一系列岛屿上的争议导致了世界第二和第三大经济体 — — 中国和日本的交恶。
en: Last summer, disputes over a string of contested islands in the East China Sea led to a furious exchange of charges between China and Japan, the world’s second- and third-largest economies, respectively.

zh: 双方距离开战为时尚早，但中国官员放任国内爆发民族主义游行、抵制日货和针对日企的破坏活动。
en: The two sides were never in danger of going to war, but Chinese officials allowed nationalist protests to develop into boycotts of Japanese products and acts of vandalism against Japanese companies.

zh: 日本对华汽车出口下降了44.5 % ， 而中国来自日本的进口下降了近10 % — —所有这些都是在一个月内发生的。
en: Japan’s automobile exports to China fell 44.5%, and China’s imports from Japan fell nearly 10% – all in just one month.

zh: 对于苦苦挣扎的日本经济来说，这是个严重的打击。
en: That was a tough hit for a struggling Japanese economy.

zh: 对我们这些认为并非军队、坦克和火箭才能造成沉重代价的人来说，这也是个清晰的警告。
en: It is also a clear warning to the rest of us that a fight need not involve troops, tanks, and rockets to exact a heavy price.

zh: 新年的决心
en: A New Year's Resolution

zh: 又值做新年决心之季，今年尤为明显。
en: It is time for New Year's resolutions, and this year's are obvious.

zh: 新千年伊始之际，世界各国领导者们庄重许诺，将致力于寻求和平方案、解决贫困问题，创造一个更为清洁的环境。
en: When the millennium opened, world leaders pledged to seek peace, the end of poverty, and a cleaner environment.

zh: 自那以后，全世界却目睹了无数暴力恐怖活动、饥荒成灾和环境不断恶化。
en: Since then, the world has seen countless acts of violence, terrorism, famine, and environmental degradation.

zh: 2005年，我们准备调整方向。
en: In 2005, we can begin to change direction.

zh: 各种新认知、科学进步、旅游和全球传播给了我们更多的选择以解决世界重大问题。
en: Knowledge, scientific advance, travel, and global communications give us many opportunities to find solutions for the world's great problems.

zh: 去年一种叫做SARS的新疾病袭击中国，世界卫生组织协调各国政府行动，迅速控制了危险局面，至少现在已完全平息。
en: When a new disease called SARS hit China last year, the World Health Organization coordinated the actions of dozens of governments, and the crisis was quickly brought under control, at least for now.

zh: 当比尔·盖茨向贫穷儿童捐出价值十亿美元的疫苗时，他保护了成千上万年轻人免受疾病传染。
en: When Bill Gates donated $1 billion to bring vaccines to poor children, he made it possible to protect tens of millions of young people from preventable diseases.

zh: 当一个叫做世界农林中心的农业调查机构发现有一种树可以帮助非洲农民扩大粮食产量，它们介绍了一种全新且有价值的方法以克服长期困扰非洲的粮食危机。
en: When an agricultural research unit called the World Agroforestry Center discovered that a certain tree could help African farmers grow more food, they introduced a new and valuable approach to overcoming Africa's chronic food crisis.

zh: 不幸的是，这样全球合作的例子少得可怜，不足以给人们留下深刻印象。
en: Unfortunately, such examples of international cooperation are as rare as they are impressive.

zh: 世界最贫困人口的生活条件可以在我们现有的知识和科学技术水平帮助下得到显著提高，使成千上百万人免遭疟疾、艾滋病、饥荒和贫民窟生活的折磨。
en: With our knowledge, science, and technology, the horrendous living conditions of the world's poorest people could be dramatically improved. Millions of people could be spared malaria, HIV/AIDS, hunger, and life in slums.

zh: 问题不是我们缺少解决良方，而是我们不能通力进行全球性合作来把这些措施付诸于实施。
en: The problem is not that we lack good solutions. The problem is that we fail to cooperate globally to put those solutions into practice.

zh: 联合国秘书长科菲·安南任命我为"千年发展目标"的特别顾问，让我带领一个由学者和发展专家组成的团队，确定实质性的步骤，以期在2005年完成预定目标，这让我感到莫大的荣幸。
en: United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan has honored me by making me his Special Adviser on the Millennium Development Goals and asking me to lead a group of scholars and development experts in identifying practical steps to reach the goals by the target date in 2015.

zh: 同时，我们将在2005年1月17日向安南秘书长递交有关"联合国千年计划"的报告。
en: This effort, known as the UN Millennium Project, will issue its report to Secretary-General Annan on January 17, 2005.

zh: 而全世界的人们也将能在网站www.unmillenniumproject.org上免费看到我们的研究成果《投资发展：完成千年发展目标的实质性步骤 》 。
en: Our study, Investing in Development: A Practical Plan to Achieve the Millennium Development Goals , will be available for free around the world at www.unmillenniumproject.org .

zh: 我们的研究结果归纳起来很简单对我们知道的内容进行归纳是很简单的。
en: What we learned is easily summarized.

zh: 对于每个主要问题，诸如饥荒、文盲、营养不良、疟疾、艾滋病、干旱等等，也有相应能够承受且已被证明可操作的解决方法。
en: For every major problem - hunger, illiteracy, malnutrition, malaria, AIDS, drought, and so forth - there are practical solutions that are proven and affordable.

zh: 反过来，这些投资也可以加强私有产业并推动经济增长。
en: These investments, in turn, would strengthen the private sector and economic growth.

zh: 但这要求全球贫富国家之间通力合作才能做到。
en: Yet they require global partnership between the rich and poor countries of the world.

zh: 最重要的是，最富有的国家应该帮助帮助最贫穷的国家充分利用现代科学技术来解决这些主要问题。
en: Most importantly, the world's richest countries need to do much more to help the poorest countries make use of modern science and technology to solve these great problems.

zh: 比如说，近几年美国军费高达每年4,500亿美元，而政府用于帮助最贫穷的国家战胜疾病、教育儿童和保护环境的支出还不到150亿美元。
en: The US, for example, currently spends around $450 billion each year on its military, but less than $15 billion to help the world's poorest countries fight disease, educate their children, and protect the environment.

zh: 这是一个错误，因为仅靠军备不足以确保美国安全。
en: This is a mistake, because military approaches alone cannot make America safe.

zh: 只有共同繁荣才能真正给地球带来安全。
en: Only shared prosperity can truly make the planet secure.

zh: 美国应该在和平经济发展方面投入更多。
en: The US should be investing much more in peaceful economic development.

zh: 德国、日本和其余的发达国家也同样做得不够，远不如他们曾对贫穷国家承诺过的那么好。
en: Germany, Japan, and several other rich countries are also doing much less than they should - and much less than they promised the poor countries that they would do.

zh: 在2002年，所有的捐助国都承诺要通过"实质性努力"拿出国家收入的0.7%去帮助贫穷国家发展。
en: In 2002, all donor countries committed to "make concrete efforts" to reach 0.7% of national income in development aid to poor countries.

zh: 但是，德国、日本和美国，和其他发达国家，做的比起他们承诺的差得太远。
en: Germany, Japan, and the US, among others, remain far below this commitment.

zh: 全世界各国公民在2005年会有很多机会坚持要求他们的政府信守承诺，完成千年计划。
en: The year 2005 will offer many opportunities for citizens around the world to insist that their leaders keep their Millennium promises.

zh: 我们的报告将会在一月份完成，届时安南秘书长会在春天发布一份报告，确认新的一年里要采取的具体步骤。
en: After our report is issued in January, Secretary-General Kofi Annan will issue a report to the world in the spring, identifying the practical steps that should be taken this year.

zh: 同时，一个重要的非洲委员会会向英国首相布莱尔提交一份报告。
en: Around the same time, an important commission on Africa will issue a report to United Kingdom Prime Minister Tony Blair.

zh: 随后，英国将在7月份主持一年一度的八国峰会。
en: Then, in July, the UK will host the annual G-8 Summit of the rich countries.

zh: 布莱尔首相承诺它会致力于解决贫困和长期气候变化问题，这也是峰会的两大焦点问题。
en: Blair has promised that he will make the fight against poverty and long-term climate change the two priorities of the summit.

zh: 9月份，各国领导会再次相聚于联合国，讨论决定今后十年的行动计划。
en: In September, the world's leaders will reconvene at the UN to decide on their actions during the coming decade.

zh: 富有强大的国家经常向全世界宣扬他们的领导能力。
en: The rich and powerful nations often declare their leadership in the world.

zh: 美国声称它帮助世界抵抗贫穷，但事实上它在武器上花了很多钱。
en: The US claims that it helps the world fight poverty, but instead spends its money on weapons.

zh: 德国和日本说他们想在联合国安理会获得常任理事国的席位，但他们都没有坚持承诺去帮助世界上最贫穷的人们。
en: Germany and Japan say that they want a permanent seat on the UN Security Council, but neither has yet followed through on its own pledges to help the world's poorest people.

zh: 最贫穷的国家就会问：若德国和日本不能信守承诺，为什么还要投票支持他们获得常任理事国的席位呢？
en: The world's poorest countries will ask themselves why they should vote for Germany and Japan to have permanent seats on the Security Council if they can't keep their promises.

zh: 所以对世界最富裕的国家而言，最明智的选择就是信守承诺帮助世界上贫穷、饥饿和深受疾病折磨的人们。
en: Nothing would be wiser for the world's rich countries than to fulfill their pledges to the world's poor, hungry and disease-ridden peoples.

zh: 和平之路就在脚下。
en: Therein lies the path to sustained peace.

zh: 2005年是诺言实现的一年，世界将实现我们赋予新千年的希望，我们要让各国首领意识到，我们希望分享和平和繁荣。
en: 2005 is the year that words can become reality, and that the world can begin to fulfill its hopes for our new millennium. Let us make our leaders aware that we aspire to shared peace and prosperity.

zh: 让我们举杯祝福，富裕强盛的国家能采取切实行动帮助贫困、弱势和痛苦中煎熬的人们。
en: Let us pledge that the rich and powerful should take real actions to help the poor, the weak, and the suffering.

zh: 再见，终于摆脱了
en: Auf Wiedersehen, and Good Riddance

zh: 伦敦 — — 她被冠之以欧洲女王，自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普当选后，又被冠之以自由世界的领袖。
en: LONDON – She has been dubbed the Queen of Europe and, since US President Donald Trump’s election, the leader of the free world.

zh: 随着欧盟过去十年从危机走向危机，德国总理安格拉·默克尔的稳定之手协助维护了欧盟的统一。
en: As the European Union has lurched from crisis to crisis over the past decade, German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s steady hand has helped hold the bloc together.

zh: 传统智慧认为当她在2021年德国下一次联邦大选后交出总理职位时 — — 如果她的大联盟陷入崩溃可能还要早得多 — — 人们会非常想念她。
en: According to the conventional wisdom, when she hands over the chancellorship after Germany’s next federal election in 2021 – and perhaps much sooner if her grand coalition collapses – she will be sorely missed.

zh: 但实际情况并不是这样。
en: However, this will hardly be the case.

zh: 在默克尔执政的13年发生了国内漂移和欧洲衰退。
en: Merkel’s 13 years in office have involved domestic drift and European decay.

zh: 而她却一路沾沾自喜，未能解决德国日益严峻的经济和安全挑战，从而允许欧洲许多危机不断恶化。
en: She has complacently coasted along, failing to address Germany’s mounting economic and security challenges, and allowing Europe’s many crises to fester.

zh: 一个岁月静好的小国可以容忍她昏昏欲睡、无所作为的管理理念；但对身处动荡年代的欧洲主导国家来说，她的所作所为却是灾难性的。
en: Her lethargic managerialism would be tolerable for a small country in quiet times; it is catastrophic for Europe’s dominant power in an era of upheaval.

zh: 与欧洲许多国家不同，德国过去十年来一直享受着稳健经济增长所带来的成果。
en: Unlike many European countries, Germany has enjoyed solid economic growth over the past decade.

zh: 但这几乎不是默克尔的功劳。
en: But Merkel can scarcely take credit for that.

zh: 她的四任政府从未推行任何重要的促增长改革。
en: Her four governments have enacted no significant growth-enhancing reforms.

zh: 在对预算盈余的痴迷中，他们未能投资于德国摇摇欲坠的基础设施和教育体系。
en: And in their obsession with running a budget surplus, they have failed to invest in the country’s crumbling infrastructure and education system.

zh: 默克尔从未采取任何措施让德国能为应对威胁其制造业核心 — — 尤其是汽车行业的数字破坏做好准备，前车之鉴就是苹果iPhone对诺基亚的影响。
en: Merkel has done nothing to prepare Germany for the digital disruption that threatens to do to its manufacturing heartland – notably its car industry – what Apple’s iPhone did to Nokia.

zh: 德国终将后悔在太阳依然闪耀时没有将屋顶修理好。
en: Germany will regret not fixing its roof while the sun was still shining.

zh: 欧元区危机大大增强了德国在货币联盟内部的金融影响力。
en: The eurozone crisis greatly enhanced Germany’s financial clout within the currency union.

zh: 这赋予默克尔巨大的政治权力，她本来可以好好利用它。
en: That gave Merkel massive political power, which she could have put to good use.

zh: 相反，她却把德国作为债主的狭隘近期利益放在首位，这导致她做出加剧欧元区危机的决策，向其他国家转嫁成本，并阻挠任何长期解决方案。
en: Instead she put Germany’s narrow near-term interests as a creditor first, leading her to make decisions that exacerbated the eurozone crisis, shifted its costs to others, and prevented any long-term resolution.

zh: 默克尔最终应对欧盟2010年拒绝重组希腊债务的行为负责。
en: Merkel is ultimately responsible for the EU’s refusal to restructure Greece’s debts in 2010.

zh: 她支持将欧洲纳税人的资金借给受困政府为德国银行提供救助。
en: She was behind the lending of European taxpayers’ money to stricken governments to bail out German banks.

zh: 而她的政府要求债务国通过极端紧缩和痛苦的调整来应对金融恐慌，哪怕与此同时德国的经常账户盈余是不断膨胀的。
en: And her governments responded to financial panic by demanding extreme austerity and painful adjustments in debtor countries, even as Germany’s current-account surplus swelled.

zh: 通过最终同意欧洲央行行长马里奥·德拉吉“尽一切努力”保护欧元的承诺，默克尔所做的仅仅是挽救了统一货币，而同时却对一个功能失调、不完整的货币联盟所存在的缺陷没有进行任何改革。
en: By eventually green-lighting European Central Bank President Mario Draghi’s pledge to do “whatever it takes” to hold the euro together, Merkel did just enough to save the single currency, while leaving in place all of the flaws of a dysfunctional, incomplete monetary union.

zh: 可以肯定，随着特朗普摧毁自由国际秩序和英国、匈牙利、波兰、意大利及其他国家随处可见斜眼看人的民族主义者，默克尔理应为发出平静、温和、令人感到安心的声音而受到赞扬。
en: To be sure, with Trump demolishing the liberal international order and swivel-eyed nationalists running amok in Britain, Hungary, Poland, Italy, and elsewhere, Merkel deserves credit for offering a calm, reassuring voice of moderation.

zh: 她决定欢迎100多万难民是一种异常大胆的人道主义姿态。
en: Her decision to welcome more than one million refugees was an uncharacteristically bold humanitarian gesture.

zh: 而在英国首相特雷莎·梅因为向特朗普叩头而为自己带来耻辱的同时，默克尔却成了自由国际主义价值观的代表。
en: And whereas British Prime Minister Theresa May has humiliated herself by kowtowing to Trump, Merkel has spoken up for liberal, internationalist values.

zh: 同样与德国许多高级政治家不同，她一直坚决抵制俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的欺凌和侵略行为。
en: Likewise, unlike many senior politicians in Germany, she has stood up to Russian President Vladimir Putin’s bullying and aggressive behavior.

zh: 尽管如此，默克尔不温不火的领导使德国极易受到今天民族主义强烈反弹的影响。
en: Still, Merkel’s tepid leadership has left Germany exceptionally vulnerable to today’s nationalist backlash.

zh: 该国的经济、政治和地缘政治安全恰恰建立在民族主义分子想要破坏的三大基础之上：德国出口所依赖的动态开放市场；一个巩固德国在欧洲和全世界地位的统一的欧盟；以及保障德国防御的美国核保护伞。
en: The country’s economic, political, and geopolitical security rest on precisely the three things that nationalists want to destroy: dynamic open markets for German exports; an integrated EU that anchors Germany’s position in Europe and the world; and the US nuclear umbrella that ensures its defense.

zh: 德国绝非像特朗普政府所声称的那样搞贸易欺诈。
en: Germany is not a trade cheat, as the Trump administration has claimed.

zh: 但在默克尔的领导下，它无疑采取了一种压制工资并不惜一切代价促进出口的以邻为壑的重商主义发展政策。
en: And yet, under Merkel, it certainly has pursued a beggar-thy-neighbor mercantilist growth strategy that suppresses wages and boosts exports at all costs.

zh: 的确，保护主义是一种错误；但重商主义却能够鼓励它。
en: Yes, protectionism is misguided; but mercantilism encourages it.

zh: 如果德国能够采取更多措施刺激国内需求，无疑是符合德国、欧洲和全球利益的。
en: German, European, and global interests would all be served if Germany were to do more to stimulate domestic demand.

zh: 同样道理，默克尔不应因为英国脱欧或意大利的许多阵痛而受到指责，这两个国家是自作自受的。
en: Similarly, Merkel cannot be blamed for Brexit or for many of Italy’s travails, which are of its own making.

zh: 但她的欧元区政策是意大利现任民粹主义政府发誓要阻挠未来欧盟贸易协定、煽动难民危机并威胁造成又一次欧元区恐慌的一个主要因素。
en: And yet her eurozone policies are a big reason why Italy now has a populist government vowing to block future EU trade deals, inflaming the refugee crisis, and threatening another eurozone panic.

zh: 除非德国和意大利能够愉快地分享统一货币联盟，否则欧元区不会是安全的。
en: The eurozone will not be secure until Germany and Italy can both happily share a monetary union.

zh: 事实最终可能证明，这根本是不可能的。
en: This may ultimately prove to be impossible.

zh: 但如果有可行的方案，将需要像法国总统马克龙去年所提议的那样进行重大的改革。
en: But if there is a workable arrangement, it will require significant reforms, as French President Emmanuel Macron proposed last year.

zh: 因此，默克尔对马克龙改革提议的唾弃标志着又一个机会被德国悲剧性的错过。
en: Merkel’s spurning of Macron’s reform effort thus represents a tragic missed opportunity.

zh: 在安全方面，即使默克尔承认，德国不能再完全依赖美国包办其防务，但她在加强德国或欧洲军事能力方面却几乎鲜有任何举措。
en: With respect to security, even as Merkel has acknowledged that Germany can no longer rely wholly on the US for its defense, she has done little to bolster German or European military capabilities.

zh: 德国国防开支依旧不足，而这恰恰赋予了特朗普破坏北约的借口。
en: German defense spending remains inadequate, giving Trump a pretext to undermine NATO.

zh: 德国摇摇欲坠的军队拥有开不动的坦克车、潜不了水的潜水艇和不能飞的飞机。
en: The country’s ramshackle military has tanks that don’t drive, submarines that don’t dive, and planes that don’t fly.

zh: 而在核威慑必要性的问题上几乎没有任何讨论，无论在德国还是在欧洲。
en: And there has scarcely been any debate about the need for a nuclear deterrent, whether German or European.

zh: 因此，默克尔的离开非但不是悲剧，反而为欧洲改革者提供了机遇。
en: Far from a tragedy, then, Merkel’s departure represents an opportunity for European reformers.

zh: 马克龙及其欧洲盟友将明年5月欧洲议会竞选活动的主基调确定为极右翼民粹分子所造成的威胁是极为正确的。
en: Macron and his European allies are right to focus their campaign for the European Parliament election next May on the threat posed by far-right populism.

zh: 但因为马克龙不想得罪强大的伙伴，迄今为止他一直未能挑战默克尔有缺陷的欧洲领导政策。
en: But in his desire not to upset a powerful partner, Macron has so far failed to challenge Merkel’s flawed European leadership.

zh: 随着默克尔即将淡出，他和其他改革者终于有了全新机会宣传一个为所有人服务的不同的欧洲。
en: With Merkel on the way out, he and other reformers have a fresh chance to campaign for a different Europe that works for everyone.

zh: 如果他们不利用她的退出，极右翼的那些庸医是肯定不会放过这次机会的。
en: If they don’t take advantage of her exit, the charlatans of the far right certainly will.

zh: 为默克尔辩护
en: In Defense of Angela Merkel

zh: 巴黎 — — 近期《明镜周刊》印有纳粹军官在雅典卫城前环绕德国总理默克尔的封面其实有着重要的目的：即终于以无可回避的方式将欧洲的恐德问题摆在了人们面前。
en: PARIS – The recent cover of Der Spiegel showing German Chancellor Angela Merkel in front of the Acropolis surrounded by Nazi officers serves an important purpose: it finally poses, in a way that cannot be evaded, the question of Germanophobia in Europe.

zh: 对德国的侮辱已经持续了很长一段时间。
en: The abuse of Germany has dragged on for quite some time.

zh: 2013年3月塞浦路斯示威者举着将默克尔描绘成希特勒形象的漫画。
en: Demonstrations in Cyprus in March 2013 included banners bearing caricatures of Merkel done up as Adolf Hitler.

zh: 几乎同时在瓦伦西亚一年一度的火节庆典上，出现了装扮成邪恶女校长的默克尔将“灭绝女王安吉拉十诫”亲手交给西班牙政府首脑及各部部长。
en: In Valencia at around the same time, on the occasion of the annual Fallas celebration, there was Merkel as an evil headmistress delivering to the head of the Spanish government and his ministers “The Ten Commandments of Angela the Exterminator.”

zh: 圣约瑟篝火的烈焰最终吞噬了默克尔的肖像。
en: She ended up being burned in effigy in the flames of the bonfires of St. Joseph.

zh: 两个月后，葡萄牙举行的类似游行高举同样希特勒化的默克尔肖像，高声叫喊的示威者身着丧服，谴责德国领导人实习“屠杀穷人的政策 ” 。
en: Two months later, in Portugal, similar parades featured the same Hitlerized Merkel caricatures, borne by howling demonstrators dressed in mourning clothes and decrying the German leader’s “policy of massacring the poor.”

zh: 当然还有希腊，仇德现象在2012年10月希腊近乎骚乱的活动中达到了高潮。 全世界在目睹《明镜周刊》封面前，亲眼见证了纳粹和德国国旗一同飘扬，之后又在雅典卫城前同被付之一炬的奇异景象。
en: And, naturally, there was Greece, where the phenomenon reached its apogee during the near-riots of October 2012, in which the world was treated to the spectacle of Nazi and German flags flown together – and then burned – together before the Acropolis in scenes that presaged the Der Spiegel cover.

zh: 意大利右翼日报《伊尔乔尔纳莱》毫不犹豫地将2012年8月3日的头版头条定为兴起的“第四帝国 ” 。
en: In Italy, the right-wing daily newspaper Il Giornale had no scruples about devoting its headline for August 3, 2012, to the emergence of the “Fourth Reich.”

zh: 同样，北欧国家的阴谋论站点声称德国热心支持乌克兰总统波罗申科对抗俄国总统普京是想重演希特勒对乌克兰的征服。
en: Likewise, conspiracy websites in the countries of northern Europe claim that Germany’s eagerness to support Ukrainian President Petro Poroshenko against Russian President Vladimir Putin is a reenactment of Hitler’s subjugation of Ukraine.

zh: 再有就是法国，那里似乎在比赛谁能在民粹主义谴责可恨的“新德意志帝国”的战斗中拔得头筹。
en: Then there is France, where the game seems to be to see who can come out on top in populist denunciations of the new and detestable “German empire.”

zh: 极右翼的国民阵线领导人勒庞谴责默克尔带给欧洲人民的“痛苦 ” 。
en: From the extreme right, National Front leader Marine Le Pen chides Merkel for the “suffering” that she is imposing on the peoples of Europe.

zh: 同时极左翼党派的吕克·梅朗松大声反对默克尔的“紧缩”政策，并请她“别再说话 ” 。
en: From the opposite extreme, we have the Left Party’s Jean-Luc Mélenchon thundering against Merkel’s “austerity” policy and inviting her to “shut up.”

zh: 仇德问题最可怕的并非愚蠢，也不是宏大的欧洲统一融合计划就在我们眼前成了黄粱美梦。
en: The problem with this Germanophobia is not simply that it is stupid, or that it is yet another symptom of the decomposition, before our eyes, of the noble European project of integration and ever-closer union.

zh: 不，今天仇德问题的实质恰恰背离了那些幕后操纵者的初衷，他们的所作所为绝非在反对初露端倪的真正法西斯主义的崛起，反而是为法西斯主义贡献和效忠。
en: No, the problem with today’s Germanophobia is that, contrary to what the sorcerer’s apprentices who stoke it would have us believe, their behavior is not a sign of their opposition to the true fascism that lies on the horizon, but rather of their allegiance – and even contribution – to it. Why?

zh: 这么说有几个理由。
en: There are several reasons.

zh: 首先，通过将默克尔等同于希特勒的方式来反对德国社会、经济和外交政策是对希特勒的庸俗化。
en: For starters, to oppose Germany’s social, economic, and foreign policies by equating Merkel with Hitler is to banalize Hitler.

zh: 无论德国现行政策所引发的分歧多么合情合理，德国依然是欧洲大陆上最严格和模范的民主国家。
en: However legitimate disagreement with those policies may be, Germany is one of the continent’s most scrupulous and exemplary democracies.

zh: 说德国在任何方面类似于在欧洲仍象征毁灭民主（甚至是文明本身）的纳粹政权是在为纳���政权开脱，是在安抚和鼓励今天的新法西斯主义者，让他们有意无意地回到公众辩论之中。
en: To say that it resembles in any way the Nazi regime – which in Europe still stands for the destruction of democracy (indeed, civilization itself) – is to exonerate that regime, and to reassure and encourage today’s neo-fascists, allowing them, whether intentionally or not, to reenter the public debate.

zh: 更有甚者（而且也是问题的关键所在 ） ， 正是那些最急于抹黑默克尔的人毫不犹豫地与维也纳新纳粹分子勾勾搭搭，比如雅典就与真正的极端主义党派领袖结成联盟。
en: What is more (and this is key), those keenest to discredit Merkel just happen to be the same people who do not hesitate to waltz with Viennese neo-Nazis or to form an alliance, as in Athens, with the leaders of a genuinely extremist party.

zh: 所谓德国“重新妖魔化”的叫嚣掩盖了法西斯党派的行踪 — — 其中包括希腊金色黎明党和匈牙利比克党，还有斯洛伐克民族党，比利时法兰德斯利益党，保加利亚艾塔克党都在竭力争取在欧洲站稳脚跟。
en: All of the clamor raised around a Germany that has supposedly “reunited with its demons” masks the voice of fascistic parties – from Greece’s Golden Dawn to Hungary’s Jobbik, Slovakia’s SNS, Belgium’s Vlaams Belang, and Bulgaria’s Ataka – that are in the process of establishing themselves in Europe.

zh: 此外还要注意默克尔是位女性，而对女性的仇恨 — — 二十世纪二三十年代种族主义理论家对犹太人和女性的蔑视一直是法西斯主义最重要的表达。
en: It should also be noted that Merkel is a woman, and that hatred for women – the disdain in which they, right alongside the Jews, were regarded by the racist theoreticians of the 1920s and 1930s – has been an essential dimension of every expression of fascism.

zh: 同样，2012年10月瓦伦西亚示威者在总理肖像前高喊的口号“你对钱的爱超过一切”和“你要确保兑付欧洲和各国央行 ” — —毫无疑问能闻到原来纳粹口号的臭气，比方说“金牛”和“都会富豪 ” 。
en: Likewise, the slogans slung about in Valencia in October 2012 – with demonstrators urged to chant at the chancellor’s effigy, “You will love money above all else” and “You will honor the banks and the Bank” – had the unmistakably foul odor of the old mantras about “the golden calf” and the “cosmopolitan plutocracy.”

zh: 人们终于认识到出身极右翼并在德国受哲学家马丁·海德格尔及其追随者助长的反美主义其实质属于法西斯主义现象。
en: People have finally come to understand that anti-Americanism, born on the extreme right and fed, in Germany, for example, by the philosophy of Martin Heidegger and his acolytes, is a fixture of fascism.

zh: 我们现在应该理解仇德也属于同样的现象。
en: It is now time for us to understand that the same is true of Germanophobia.

zh: 在康德哲学中看到欧洲思想“犹太化”契机的法国反犹主义小说家兼活动家莫里斯·巴雷斯是始作俑者。
en: In France, it appeared with the French anti-Semitic novelist and activist Maurice Barrès, who saw in the philosophy of Immanuel Kant a vehicle for the “Jewification” of European minds.

zh: 仇德思想与查尔斯·莫拉斯的“法语行动”及其对“犹太与德国抽象概念”的持久战一同广为传播。
en: It triumphed with Charles Maurras’ Action Française and its protracted war with “Jewish and Germanic abstractions.”

zh: 它随红褐小组的崛起达到高潮，并且时至今日，仍在我不愿提及的隐秘地点为愿意“干掉”总理“手下老板”的志愿者提供藏身之所。
en: And it culminated with the red-brown cells that, even today, on sites that I prefer not to mention, offer “grub” and a “hideout” for persons willing to “bump off” the “bosses” on the chancellor’s “payroll.”

zh: 思想的轨迹自有其独特的逻辑、理性和愚蠢。 它虽无意识但又遵循某种轨迹。
en: The history of ideas has its logic, reason, and folly, its unconscious and its trajectory.

zh: 否认任何一面不仅危险而且徒劳。
en: It is both futile and dangerous to deny any of them.

zh: 正因如此，今天在欧洲崛起、膨胀、招摇的黑暗势力面前，捍卫默克尔就显得至关重要。
en: That is why, today, it is critically important, in the face of a dark force that is rising, swelling, and unfurling in Europe, to defend Angela Merkel.

zh: 安格拉•默克尔新官上任
en: Angela Merkel Meets the World

zh: 终于，安格拉•默克尔成为德国的新任—也是第一位女性—总理。
en: At long last, Angela Merkel is Germany’s new – and first woman – Chancellor.

zh: 虽然连续性会仍然是外交政策的主旋律，但是德国在默克尔领导之下在国际事务中的表现和在施罗德的领导之下会有不同的面貌。
en: Although continuity will remain the hallmark of foreign policy, Germany’s international engagement under Merkel will sound and feel different from that under Gerhard Schroeder’s leadership.

zh: 施罗德代表着新一代的德国人在7年前掌权。 这一代人的集体体验不是“冷战 ” 、 不是欧洲一体化、不是跨越大西洋的友谊，而是德国的统一和国家主权的恢复。
en: Schroeder came to power seven years ago representing a new generation whose formative experience was not the Cold War, European integration, and transatlantic friendship, but German unification and the restoration of national sovereignty.

zh: 对于他和从执政16年的科尔手中接过大权的那个团队来说，德国已经成为一个普通的国家，与欧洲其他如法国或英国这样的重量级国家没有什么不同。
en: For him and the team that took over after Helmut Kohl’s 16-year reign, Germany had become a normal country, no different from other European heavyweights like France or Britain.

zh: 确实，施罗德的第一次重大外交政策经验就是1999年的欧盟峰会。 当时的英法两国领导人给了这位来自柏林的政坛新人一个下马威。
en: Indeed, one of Schroeder’s first major foreign-policy experiences was the EU summit of 1999, where the leaders of France and Britain played rough with the newcomer from Berlin.

zh: 施罗德所汲取的教训就是坚持德国不能再被轻视，它需要扮演一个与其国力相适应的角色。
en: The lesson that Schroeder drew was to insist that Germany could no longer be taken for granted and would demand a role commensurate to its size and weight.

zh: 坚持己见成为德国外交政策的口号。
en: Self-assertion became the watchword of German foreign policy.

zh: 因此，当施罗德宣称德国未能遵守欧盟《稳定和增长协定》所规定的预算上限有其特殊原因时，他似乎是在辩解说这样的限制只应该适用于小国而不是大国。
en: Thus, when Schroeder claimed special circumstances for Germany’s failure to meet the budgetary ceilings of the European Union’s Stability and Growth Pact, he seemed to be arguing that the restrictions should apply only to smaller countries, not to the big players.

zh: 当他公开反对美国出兵伊拉克时，向世界上唯一的超级大国示威的自豪之情溢于言表。
en: When he rightly opposed America’s war against Iraq, the pride of standing up to the world's only superpower was palpable.

zh: 当他与俄罗斯总统普京建立起密切的个人和政治关系时，他向世界—以及欧盟敏感的东欧新成员国 - - 传递的信息是，德国的外交政策将不再受过去的牵制。
en: When he established a close personal and political relationship with Russian President Vladimir Putin, he signaled to the world – and to the EU’s sensitive new Eastern European members – that Germany’s foreign policy would no longer be constrained by the past.

zh: 凭心而论，应该承认德国正是在施罗德的领导下才打消了向海外派兵的顾虑。
en: In fairness, it should be acknowledged that it was under Schroeder that Germany shed hesitations to deploy soldiers abroad.

zh: 他对在波斯尼亚科索沃或在阿富汗的国际维和行动的支持，需要极大的政治勇气，同时也使德国成为一支主要的国际维和力量。
en: His support for international crisis missions in Kosovo, Bosnia, or Afghanistan required considerable political courage and made Germany one of the major contributors to international stability efforts.

zh: 施罗德在任期内的重大成就之一就是将这一问题从国内的意识形态之争中剔除了。
en: To have removed the issue from domestic ideological controversy ranks as a major achievement of Schroeder’s tenure.

zh: 但这同时传达的另一个信息就是德国已经成长为一个真正意义上的国际强国。
en: But it was also meant to convey that Germany had grown up into a proper international power.

zh: 在默克尔的领导下，德国外交政策几乎不会有实质性的变化，但其张扬的风格会有所收敛。
en: With Merkel, the substance of Germany’s foreign policy will change little, but the assertive style will be muted.

zh: 美国的领导人们会将她的当选作为双边关系恢复常态的证明而表示欢迎。
en: American leaders will welcome her election as proof that the estrangement in bilateral relations is over.

zh: 但这种不和在今年早些时候，布什政府意识到德国在盟国中发挥着重要作用时，就已经结束了。
en: But that alienation already largely ended earlier this year, when the Bush administration realized that allies are good to have and that Germany is an important one.

zh: 默克尔会重拾在施罗德执政时期所缺失的温情，但她也不会对美国言听计从。
en: Merkel will reintroduce the warmth that has been missing under Schroeder, but she will not become America’s yes-woman.

zh: 她更不会放弃与俄罗斯的特殊关系。 这是自阿登纳以来的历届总理都非常重视的关系。
en: Nor will she abandon special relations with Russia, to which every German chancellor since Adenauer has attached major importance.

zh: 但她已经明确表示德国的东欧邻国们没有理由感到被冷落。
en: But she has already made clear that Germany’s neighbors to the East will have no reason not feel bypassed.

zh: 她甚至还可能会通过将第一次官方访问的目的地定为华沙或维尔纽斯而不是巴黎，来确认这一讯息。
en: She may even want to confirm that message by making her first official trip abroad not to Paris but to Warsaw or Vilnius.

zh: 在欧洲项目上，她对一体化的承诺和前任们一样坚定。
en: On the European project, she is as committed to integration as her predecessors have been.

zh: 她会继续强调与法国的紧密关系，因为她别无选择；英国没有加入欧元区和申根边界体系，仍然是欧盟的一大尴尬。
en: She will continue to emphasize close relations with France because there is no alternative; Britain, absent from the euro zone and the Schengen border regime, remains the odd man-in of the EU.

zh: 但是，在拒绝了《宪法条约》的国家的领导人们准备好再努力一次之前，欧洲一体化方面不会有新的举措出台。
en: But there will be no new initiatives on integration until leaders in the countries that rejected the Constitutional Treaty are ready for a new try.

zh: 那时，默克尔会在增加推动欧盟发展的新举措的权重方面发挥重要作用。
en: Then Merkel will be in a key position to add weight to a new effort for moving the EU forward.

zh: 她会继续鼓励欧盟最终接纳巴尔干国家，但她在反对给予土耳其正式成员国地位的立场上也毫不含糊。 这是自施罗德时代以来的一个重大的实质性态度转变（虽然她的政府不会阻挠在十月初启动谈判 ） 。
en: She will continue to favor the eventual admission of the Balkan states, but she has left no doubt of her opposition to full membership for Turkey, which is the major substantive change from the Schroeder era (although her government will not block the start of negotiations in early October).

zh: 实际上，默克尔大选胜出以后，在外交政策方面发挥的余地不大。 至少在开始阶段，执政风格上的转变就足够了。
en: In fact, there is very little Merkel has to do after her election to make her mark on foreign policy; the visible change of style will suffice, at least at first.

zh: 不论如何，推进经济改革的任务就足以让她全力以赴，而应对这些当务之急也正是她获选的原因。
en: In any case, she will have her hands full pushing through the economic reforms for which she will be elected and which are her top priority.

zh: 有迹象表明德国正在走出长期的经济滞胀，这少不了要归功于施罗德时代开始的改革。
en: There are indications that Germany is finally emerging from years of economic stagnation, not least thanks to the reforms started under Schroeder.

zh: 在国内，默克尔有希望收获其改革成果。
en: At home, Merkel can hope to reap the rewards.

zh: 在国外，默克尔没有必要展示德国是欧洲大国；她的伙伴们清楚地认识到了这一点。
en: Abroad, Merkel has no need to demonstrate that Germany is a big country in Europe; her partners are fully aware of this.

zh: 然而，德国也决不只是一个寻常国家：它在维系两个会继续保障它的福祉的国际机构—欧盟和大西洋联盟—方面也是举足轻重。
en: But it is also more than just a normal country: Germany remains central to holding together the two international institutions that will continue to assure its well-being, the European Union and the Atlantic alliance.

zh: 有迹象表明默克尔在这一点上的认识比施罗德深刻。
en: There are some indications that Merkel is more aware of this then Schroeder was.

zh: 人们只能希望这一认识会成为她在进行艰难决策时的指向标。 这样的决策是在风格改变不足以应对形势时所必需��。
en: One can only hope that this recognition will serve as her guidepost when tough decisions must be made and changes in style alone will not be enough.

zh: 默克尔的新动力
en: Angela Merkel’s New Momentum

zh: 发自马德里 — — 在阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦在1955年去世时 ， 《 纽约时报》发表了了一封讲述了一件精彩轶事的读者来信。
en: MADRID – Upon Albert Einstein’s death in 1955, the New York Times published a letter to the editor with a marvelous anecdote.

zh: 在广岛和长崎原子弹爆炸后不久，有人问爱因斯坦 ： “ 为何当人的思维已经可以延伸到可以发现原子的结构时，我们却无法设计出相应的政治手段来防止原子摧毁我们自己？
en: Shortly after the atomic bombs had fallen on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Einstein was asked, “Why is it that when the mind of man has stretched so far as to discover the structure of the atom we have been unable to devise the political means to keep the atom from destroying us?”

zh: ”他的回答是永恒的 ： ” 答案很简单，我的朋友，这是因为政治比物理更难懂。
en: His answer was timeless: “That is simple, my friend. It is because politics is more difficult than physics.”

zh: 作为曾经的东德物理学专业学生，德国总理默克尔得以在步入政界时亲自证明爱因斯坦这句讽喻确实属实。
en: As a former student of physics in East Germany, German Chancellor Angela Merkel was able to confirm the truth of Einstein’s quip firsthand when she went into politics.

zh: 我谦卑地相信自己也可以证明这一点，因为我自己的生活也是循着一条类似的道路。
en: I humbly believe that I can attest to the same, as my own life has followed a somewhat similar path.

zh: 正如我多年前在西班牙所做的那样，默克尔对独裁统治崩溃的反应是放弃物理投身公共服务，并最终使自己陷入了欧洲政治的漩涡之中。
en: Just as I had done in Spain a few years before, Merkel reacted to the collapse of the dictatorship she lived in by leaving physics to embrace public service. Eventually, she got caught up in the whirlwind of European politics.

zh: 在她以往所承担的各类公共角色以及随后作为总理的那13年中，默克尔一直保持着一种与其学术出身契合的有条不紊且注重反思的行事风格。
en: In her various public roles, and throughout 13 years as chancellor, Merkel has always maintained a methodical and reflective style that suits her scientific background.

zh: 但世界政治似乎正与这种风格背道而驰，而德国国内的日益骚动也对她的地位构成了冲击。
en: But world politics seems to be diverging from that style, and increasing agitation in Germany has taken a toll on her standing.

zh: 上个月，默克尔宣布自己不会再寻求连任总理，并且将在今年年底辞去基督教民主联盟（简称基民盟）的领导职务。
en: Last month, Merkel announced that she would not be seeking another term as chancellor, and that at the end of this year, she would step down as leader of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU).

zh: 继任者的争夺已经开始。
en: The race to replace her has already begun.

zh: 虽然默克尔的继任者或许完全有能力接过担子，但德国和欧洲其他国家无疑将非常怀念她的沉着和稳重。
en: Merkel’s successors may well be worthy of filling her shoes, but there is no doubt that Germany and the rest of Europe will sorely miss her composure and steadiness.

zh: 对于默克尔的成败已经多有评说。
en: Much has been said about Merkel’s achievements and failures.

zh: 在她执政记录中的最大污点可能是其政府于全球金融危机后在欧盟推行的紧缩政策。
en: The greatest blot on her record may be the austerity policies that her government promoted in the European Union after the global financial crisis.

zh: 这些政策加剧了国与国之间不平等，加深了北部和南部成员国之间的分歧，还拖慢了经济复苏。
en: Those policies increased inequality, deepened the divide between northern and southern member states, and slowed economic recovery.

zh: 从那时起，各路民粹主义者 — — 特别是意大利的五星运动/联盟党执政联盟 — — 都紧盯着紧缩政策所带来的痛苦遗产并借此渔利。
en: Since then, populists – particularly the governing Five Star Movement/League coalition in Italy – have seized on the painful legacy of austerity for their own political gain.

zh: 同样，一些人指责默克尔应当为极右翼政党 — — 包括境内的德国选择党 — — 的崛起负责。
en: Similarly, some blame Merkel for the rise of far-right parties, including the Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) within Germany itself.

zh: 在2015年迎来了100多万难民之后，默克尔成为全欧洲民族主义反移民势力的众矢之的。
en: After welcoming over one million refugees in 2015, Merkel became the bête noire of nationalist anti-immigrant forces across Europe.

zh: 然而毋庸置疑的是，她对紧缩政策的支持与她在难民危机最为严峻时的决定之间形成了鲜明对比。
en: Needless to say, however, there is a stark contrast between her advocacy of austerity and her decisions at the height of the refugee crisis.

zh: 在后一种情况下，在其他国家似乎不再愿意这样做的时候，默克尔却将自己的政治前途押在了捍卫欧洲团结的路线上。
en: In the latter case, Merkel put her own political future on the line to defend European solidarity at a time when other countries no longer seemed willing to do so.

zh: 在最近向欧洲议会发表的一次讲话中，默克尔再次为欧盟的基本价值观辩护。
en: In a recent address to the European Parliament, Merkel once again stood up for the EU’s foundational values.

zh: 她与法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙（Emmanuel Macron ） — —两人在巴黎举行的停战日纪念活动中表现融洽 — — 共同呼吁组建一支欧洲军队。
en: She joined French President Emmanuel Macron – with whom she showed great rapport at the commemoration of the Armistice Day centennial in Paris – in his call to form a European army.

zh: 正如马克龙和默克尔都明确表示的那样，这种力量不仅与北约兼容；甚至会在事实上强化该组织。
en: As both Macron and Merkel have made clear, such a force would not only be compatible with NATO; it would actually strengthen the organization.

zh: 然而不出所料，默克尔雄心勃勃的言论引来了欧洲怀疑论者的蔑视，后者更希望看到欧盟屈服于绝望和政治机会主义。
en: Predictably, however, Merkel’s ambitious speech elicited scorn from Euroskeptics, who would much rather see the EU succumb to despair and political opportunism.

zh: 鉴于她已经宣布隐退，一些人已经将默克尔视为只配在政治讣告中讨论其遗产的“跛脚鸭 ” 。
en: In light of her announced departure, some already regard Merkel as a “lame duck” whose legacy will now be debated in political obituaries.

zh: 然而现在致悼词还为时过早：有充分的理由相信她的欧洲遗产还在构建之中。
en: Yet these eulogies are premature: there is good reason to believe that she is not yet done forging her European legacy.

zh: 可以肯定的是，默克尔在基民盟的继任领导者可能不会紧密追随她的立场，并且可能向其与基督教社会联盟（基民盟在巴伐利亚州的姐妹党）和社会民主党组成的联合政府中注入更多的不稳定性。
en: To be sure, Merkel’s successor at the head of the CDU may not be closely aligned with her positions, and could inject more instability into the coalition government with the Christian Social Union (the CDU’s Bavaria-based sister party) and the Social Democrats (SPD).

zh: 但即便在这种情况下默克尔也还留着几招后手。
en: But even under those circumstances, Merkel would have a few cards up her sleeve.

zh: 首先，在德国的不信任投票不会成功，除非替代者能赢得联邦议院绝对多数的支持。
en: For starters, a no-confidence vote in Germany cannot succeed unless an alternative candidate wins the backing of an absolute majority in the Bundestag.

zh: 这种情况只发生过一次 — — 当时基民盟的赫尔穆特·科尔在1982年取代社民党的赫尔穆特·施密特担任总理 — — 而且在当前这个山头林立的联邦议院中更是极不可能。
en: That has happened only once – when Helmut Kohl of the CDU replaced Helmut Schmidt of the SPD as chancellor in 1982 – and it would be extremely unlikely in a parliament that is as fragmented as the current Bundestag.

zh: 因此不应排除默克尔在完成本届任期后再坚持三年的可能性。
en: A scenario in which Merkel finishes out her term, staying on for another three years, should therefore not be ruled out.

zh: 她在国际舞台上仍然广受欢迎。
en: She remains very popular on the international scene.

zh: 此外从选举压力（至少是一种对她的直接关注）中解放出来后她或许可以更自由地寻求更积极的外交政策。
en: And, liberated from electoral pressures, at least of a kind focusing on her directly, she may feel freer to pursue a more proactive foreign policy.

zh: 回想一下，美国总统奥巴马正是在其执政的最后几年实现了在外交政策上的一些最大里程碑。
en: Recall that it was during his final years in office that US President Barack Obama achieved some of his biggest milestones in foreign policy.

zh: 除与古巴恢复邦交之外，奥巴马政府还与伊朗达成核协议并签署了巴黎气候协议。
en: In addition to restoring diplomatic relations with Cuba, the Obama administration concluded the nuclear deal with Iran and signed the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 尽管特朗普试图扭转这些成就，但他还未能将它们彻底废止。
en: Though President Donald Trump has sought to reverse these accomplishments, he has not been able to consign them to history.

zh: 对于欧盟来说，如果默克尔继续致力于振兴法德轴线从而为欧盟层面的改革打开大门,那么联盟的良性运作就有了保障。
en: For the EU, it would be healthy if Merkel were to continue revitalizing the Franco-German axis, thereby opening the door to EU-level reform.

zh: 然而未来仍存在重大障碍。
en: Nevertheless, there are significant obstacles ahead.

zh: 在这个时代很显然政治要比物理更困难。
en: In this day and age, it is abundantly clear that politics is more difficult than physics.

zh: 然而我们最好不要低估默克尔，并注意爱因斯坦另一句永恒的名言 ： “ 机会总是隐藏在困难中间。 ”
en: However, we would do well not to underestimate Merkel, and to heed another timeless Einstein quote: “In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.”

zh: 默克尔的远景问题
en: Angela Merkel’s Vision Thing

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 在欧洲挣扎着拯救欧元之际，对世界各大经济体缺乏强势领导的抱怨也甚嚣尘上。
en: CAMBRIDGE – As Europe struggles to save the euro, the chorus of complaints about weak leadership in the world’s major economies grows louder.

zh: 其中许多人都专门点了德国总理安格拉·默克尔的名，认为她未能像其前任和导师赫尔穆特·科尔那样为欧洲树立一个长远的愿景。
en: Many have singled out German Chancellor Angela Merkel for failing to promote a vision of Europe similar to that of her predecessor and mentor, Helmut Kohl.

zh: 那么这种说法是对的吗？
en: Are the critics right?

zh: 作为一名优秀的领导者，其中一部分工作就是要传达一种远景，既能以此为相关政策赋予意义，也可借此发动民众对这些政策（及其倡议者）给于支持。
en: Part of what effective leaders do is communicate a vision that gives meaning to policies and inspires others to support these policies (and those who propose them).

zh: 这同时也是领导人之间构建共同目标，为集体行动注入活力的途径之一。
en: It is one of the ways in which leaders help to create shared objectives and energize common action.

zh: 这个远景通常会勾画一副鼓动变革的未来图景，但有时也会绘声绘色地描绘现状 — — 或者辉煌的过去 — — 以抵制变革。
en: Usually, such a vision provides a scenario for the future that is meant to encourage change, though it may also portray the status quo – or the past – as attractive, thereby encouraging resistance to change.

zh: 而一旦缺乏远景，上述两种方式都将无法引领众人。
en: Either way, without a vision, it is difficult to lead others anywhere.

zh: 对此联邦快递首席执行官弗里德里克·斯密斯曾说 ： “ 领导的首要任务就是为组织传达远景和价值观。 ”
en: Frederick Smith, CEO of Federal Express, has argued that “the primary task of leadership is to communicate the vision and values of an organization.”

zh: 但对待远景也必须十分谨慎。
en: But one must be cautious about visions.

zh: 有时领导人自以为远景可以解决他们所面临的大部分问题，但殊不知一个错误的 — — 或是一个野心过分膨胀的 — — 远景却会令他们深受其害。
en: Sometimes leaders think that vision can solve most of their problems, but the wrong vision – or an overly ambitious vision – can do damage.

zh: 老布什就因为缺乏所谓“远景之类的东西”而吃了大亏，甚至连累了自己。
en: George H.W. Bush was faulted (and faulted himself) for not having what he called “the vision thing.”

zh: 当他面对手下们的追问，要求更加直接和详细地阐述其远景时，他却总是回答“那不是我的作风”
en: When pressed by his staff to speak more boldly and expansively, he replied, “It’s just not me.”

zh: 而在2001年9·11恐怖袭击后，他的儿子则小布什构建了一个更为雄心勃勃的远景。
en: After the shock of the September 2001 terrorist attacks, his son, George W. Bush, developed a far more ambitious vision.

zh: 正如一位前白宫顾问指出的那样，小布什“痴迷于把民主带到中东这样的宏大理想，与其父亲谨慎渐进的作风截然不同 ” 。
en: As one former adviser put it, he was “irresistibly drawn to Big Ideas like bringing democracy to the Middle East, Big Ideas that stood in sharp contrast to the prudent small ball played by his father.”

zh: 然而，两相对比之下，我们会发现老布什的外交政策更胜一筹。
en: Yet the elder Bush turned out to have had the better foreign policy.

zh: 一些有抱负的领导人认为自己必须构建一个能够镇摄住其追随者的远景，但在实践中，我们发现一个成功的远景通常源自于集体的需要，领导人只是适时将其提炼出来并阐明清楚而已。
en: Some aspiring leaders think that they must proclaim a vision that overawes their followers. In practice, however, a successful vision often arises from the needs of the group, which are then formulated and articulated by the leader.

zh: 比如马丁·路德·金在他那篇名文《我有个梦想》中所提出的远景不仅发端于美国平等和包容的主流价值观之上，而且还源自于非裔美国人饱受奴役和排斥的惨痛经历。
en: The vision that Martin Luther King, Jr., expressed in his “I Have a Dream” speech, for example, was deeply rooted not only in America’s professed values of equality and inclusion, but also in African-Americans�� experience of subordination and exclusion.

zh: 此外，领导人也会因阐明远景的压力而陷入困境。
en: At the same time, the pressure to articulate a vision can get a leader into difficulty.

zh: 正如一位大学校长所说 ， “ 每个人都会问‘你的远景是什么 ’ 。
en: As one university president put it: “Everyone asks, ‘What’s your vision?’

zh: 如果鲁莽应对的话将得罪很多人，而最佳的回答是以‘你认为呢？
en: But you offend many people and get into trouble by answering too quickly.

zh: ’来开头，然后认真倾听，再阐述你的远景。 ”
en: The smart response at the beginning is, ‘What do you think?’ and then listen before you articulate your vision.”

zh: 一个成功的远景必须能够吸引众多追随者和利益相关方。
en: A successful vision has to be attractive to various circles of followers and stakeholders.

zh: 在一个群体受欢迎不代表在另一群体里就行得通。
en: What plays well with one group may not sit well with another.

zh: 同时一个历久弥坚的成功远景必须奠基于对群体所面临状况的深刻理解。
en: And, to be sustainable, a successful vision must also be an effective diagnosis of the situation that a group faces.

zh: 领导人在提供答案前必须准确把握住问题。
en: Leaders must get the question right before proposing answers.

zh: 他们不仅要倾听追随者们的意见，而且还要深刻理解影响人们选择的背景因素，在此基础上才能选定目标并在远景中阐述出来。
en: To choose goals and articulate them in a vision, they need not only to solicit input from their followers, but also to understand the context of their choices.

zh: 一句话，领导人必须精确评估现实。
en: They must be able to assess reality accurately.

zh: 远景的气魄随领导风格的不同而不同。
en: The boldness of a vision varies with the type of leadership involved.

zh: 社会运动的领导人就比公务员拥有更宏大的远景。
en: Leaders of social movements can call forth larger visions than public officials can.

zh: 一场社会运动的领导人能够宣扬一个远超其追随者想象的远景，而一位承担着多元目标以及各种责任的总理则必须与公众时常沟通，因此许下的远景也无法脱离群众太远。
en: A movement leader can promote a vision that is miles ahead of his followers, while a prime minister with multiple objectives and responsibilities must maintain a continuous dialogue with the public, which keeps him or her from moving too far ahead of citizens.

zh: 美国前副总统戈尔在输掉了2000年总统大选后摇身一变成为对抗全球气候变暖运动的领导人，而他的领导风格也从务实转变为启发性和先知的类型。
en: After former US Vice President Al Gore lost his bid for the presidency in 2000, he became a leader of the social movement to combat global climate change, and his style changed from pragmatic to inspirational and prophetic.

zh: 分析家根据运动领导人是否能在现实与风险，目标与能力之间取得平衡来判断他的远景能否成功。
en: Analysts judge a government leader’s vision in terms of whether it creates a sensible balance between realism and risk, and whether it balances objectives with capabilities.

zh: 谁都能发出一大堆宏愿，但有效的远景是前瞻性和可行性相结合的产物。
en: Anyone can produce a wish list, but effective visions combine inspiration with feasibility.

zh: 就连英国前首相托尼布·莱尔的批评者们也承认：虽然总是对远景的细节缺乏关注，但布莱尔阐述远景的能力也是其作为领导人的巨大优势之一。
en: Critics of former British Prime Minister Tony Blair, for example, acknowledged that his ability to articulate a vision was one of his great strengths as a leader, but complained about his lack of attention to detail.

zh: 类似的还有20世纪的两位美国总统 — — 伍德罗·威尔逊和小布什 — — 他们都擅长阐述一个宏大的外交政策远景，但当这些远景在实施中遇阻之时，却又不善于重新界定和修改远景。
en: Similarly, two twentieth-century US presidents, Woodrow Wilson and George W. Bush, were good at articulating an ambitious foreign-policy vision, but were poor at refining and reshaping their vision when they encountered implementation challenges.

zh: 他们两位都希望推广民主，但都以一种容易招致反抗的方式来实施。
en: Both promoted democracy, but both did so in a manner that generated a backlash against democracy promotion.

zh: 当然，一味的谨慎渐进也是不够的。
en: Of course, prudence is not enough.

zh: 有时候领导人就需要突破现实的藩篱去激励追随者并激发出额外的效应，如同温斯顿·丘吉尔1940年在英国所做的那样。
en: Sometimes leaders need to stretch the boundaries of realism to inspire their followers and call forth extra effort, as Winston Churchill did in Great Britain in 1940.

zh: 但如果没有对背景的理解，没有基于这种理解的某种程度上的谨慎，远景很容易从宏大沦为浮夸，从而损害了它所追求的价值。
en: But, without a degree of prudence based upon comprehension of the context, visions turn from grand to grandiose and undercut the values that they seek to promote.

zh: 正如富兰克林·罗斯福在1930年小心劝服美国人民放弃孤立主义那样，今天，默克尔也在谨慎地拯救欧元。
en: Like Franklin Roosevelt, who acted very cautiously in trying to persuade American opinion to abandon isolationism in the 1930’s, Merkel has proceeded cautiously on saving the euro.

zh: 她顶着公众对使用德国基金拯救希腊经济的怀疑。
en: She faced public skepticism about using German funds to bail out the Greek economy.

zh: 她的政治盟友在这个问题上发生了分裂，自己所在的政党也输掉了州选举。
en: Her coalition was divided on the issue, and her party lost state elections.

zh: 如果采取更激进行动，那么默克尔或许会失去更多的支持，而她目前踏出的步伐仍不足以让市场重获信心。
en: If she had acted more boldly, she might have lost even more support, but the steps that she agreed to remained insufficient to reassure markets.

zh: 然而在今年十月底，她最终为欧洲的未来勾勒了一个远景，并以此说服德国联邦议会同意拯救欧元的一揽子计划。
en: At the end of October, however, she finally articulated a vision of the future of Europe that persuaded the German Bundestag to agree to a package of measures to save the euro.

zh: 但这一远景是否为时已晚 — — 以及是否可行 — — 将在未来数月见分晓。
en: Whether she waited too long – and whether her vision will prove convincing – will be determined in the coming months.

zh: 不要再重启
en: No More Resets

zh: 华盛顿—乌克兰陷入了动荡，美国和俄罗斯警觉地盯着彼此的一举一动，世界眼看着就要滑入类似于冷战的长期冲突。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – With Ukraine in turmoil and the United States and Russia warily eyeing each other’s every move, the world seems to be on the brink of a prolonged confrontation similar to the Cold War.

zh: 果真如此吗？
en: But is it?

zh: 俄罗斯一边指责西方支持“法西斯分子”和“恐怖分子”在基辅炮制的政变，一边吞并了克里米亚，进行了洲际弹道导弹试射，并保留了军事干预东乌克兰以保护那里的俄罗斯人的权利。
en: Russia, accusing the West of supporting a coup d’état by “fascists” and “terrorists” in Kyiv, has annexed Crimea, tested an inter-continental ballistic missile, and reserved the right to intervene militarily in eastern Ukraine to protect the Russian population there.

zh: 美国对俄罗斯实施了制裁，并称其吞并克里米亚为非法。
en: The US has sanctioned Russia and called Crimea’s annexation illegal.

zh: 但美国也呼吁合作以和平解决现状，并宣布乌克兰应该同时追求与俄罗斯和西方的建设性关系。
en: But it has also called for cooperation to resolve the situation peacefully and declared that Ukraine should pursue productive ties with both Russia and the West.

zh: 目前，俄罗斯对美国的态度置若罔闻。
en: So far, the Russians have dismissed those sentiments.

zh: 但这并不是第二次冷战的开端，俄罗斯不是美国的对手。
en: Yet this is not the start of Cold War II, and Russia is not America’s antagonist.

zh: 但它也不是盟友。
en: But nor is it an ally.

zh: 双方在很多问题上都有分歧。
en: The two sides disagree on a wide range of questions.

zh: 但在诸多关键性国际问题上 — — 如叙利亚和伊朗 — — 如果不进行合作就无法取得进展。
en: Yet there are critical international issues – such as Iran and Syria – on which progress is not likely without some cooperation.

zh: 挑战不在于再次试图“重启”双边关系，而是（在乌克兰危机消弭后）找到一个基础，让双方可以在利益重叠之处合作。
en: The challenge is not to try again to “reset” bilateral relations, but rather to find – once the Ukrainian crisis abates – a basis on which the two sides can collaborate where their interests overlap.

zh: 但我们必须认清现实。
en: But we have to be realistic.

zh: 自1992年以来，每一任美国总统都寻求重新设计美俄关系，超越冷战时期的意识形态和军事竞争态势。
en: Every US President since 1992 has sought to refashion the US-Russian relationship and move it beyond the ideological and military competition of the Cold War.

zh: 但每一次的努力尽管能够产生一些结果，最终都以失望告终。
en: But each attempt, while producing some results, ended in disappointment.

zh: 一个关键原因是美国和俄罗斯在改善后的关系到底应该怎样方面存在根本性的理解差异。
en: A key reason is that the US and Russia have fundamentally different understandings of what an improved relationship would look like.

zh: 在审视这些努力时，有一点始终成立：美国取得进展最大的地方正是俄罗斯感到美国尊重了它的利益的地方。
en: In reviewing these efforts, one constant stands out: the US has made the most progress on issues where Russia has felt that America respected its interests.

zh: 第一次外交关系重启发生在老布什总统任期末期，双方在降低因苏联解体而导致的核威胁方面取得了重大进展。
en: The first diplomatic reset, at the end of George H.W. Bush’s presidency, took major steps toward defusing the nuclear dangers resulting from the collapse of the Soviet Union.

zh: 其结果是俄罗斯成为前苏联国家中唯一的有核国家，时任美国参议员努恩（Sam Nunn）和路加尔（Richard Lugar）提出立法帮助确保了核设施、科学家和材料的安全。
en: As a result, Russia remained the only nuclear state in the post-Soviet space, while legislation pioneered by then-US Senators Sam Nunn and Richard Lugar helped to secure nuclear sites, scientists, and materials.

zh: 第二次重启发生在克林顿执政期间，其目标更大：建设全面的合作伙伴关系，促进美国大面积参与俄罗斯经济和变化中的政治制度。
en: The second reset, under President Bill Clinton, was more ambitious: a full-fledged effort to create a partnership that promoted substantial US involvement in Russia’s economy and evolving political system.

zh: 期间还说服不太情愿的俄罗斯支持北约对巴尔干地区的两次干预。
en: It also involved persuading a reluctant Russia to support two NATO interventions in the Balkans.

zh: 但1999年的第二次科索沃战争导致了此次重启的失败。
en: But the second war over Kosovo in 1999 led to the collapse of that reset.

zh: 第三次重启来自俄罗斯总统普京，2001年9·11恐怖袭击后，俄罗斯协助了美国在阿富汗的行动。
en: The third reset came at Russian President Vladimir Putin’s initiative, when he offered Russian assistance in the campaign in Afghanistan after the terror attacks of September 11, 2001.

zh: 但小布什政府的期望与普京大不相同。
en: But the expectations of George W. Bush’s administration were very different from Putin’s.

zh: 俄罗斯寻求的是“不平等双方之间的平等合作伙伴关系 ” ， 特别是美国承认俄罗斯对周边地区的影响范围。
en: Russia sought an “equal partnership of unequals,” especially US recognition of Russia’s sphere of influence in its neighborhood.

zh: 而俄罗斯必须应对伊拉克战争、北约东扩至巴尔干国家、乌克兰和格鲁吉亚的亲西方革命遗迹布什政府旨在全球民主化的“自由日程 ” （ Freedom Agenda ） 。
en: Instead, Russia had to deal with the Iraq war, NATO enlargement to the Baltic states, pro-Western revolutions in Ukraine and Georgia, and the Bush administration’s “Freedom Agenda” aimed at global democratization.

zh: 克里姆林宫十分担心制度演变的幽灵，特别是在其周边地区。
en: The Kremlin viewed with great apprehension the specter of regime change, especially in its neighborhood.

zh: 此次重启结束于2008年俄罗斯-格鲁吉亚战争期间，此后美国将俄罗斯视为全球干扰者。
en: By the time this reset ended in the rubble of the 2008 Russia-Georgia war, the US had come to view Russia as a global spoiler.

zh: 奥巴马政府的重启 — — 苏联解体以来的第四次 — — 是最成功的，至少在其第一个任期内是如此。
en: The Obama administration’s reset – the fourth since the Soviet collapse – was the most successful, at least during the president’s first term in office.

zh: 此次重启的期望更加现实，也实现了一些���果：新START武器控制条约、收紧对伊朗的制裁、在进出阿富汗交通方面的合作，以及俄罗斯加入世贸组织。
en: With more realistic expectations, it achieved results: the New START arms control treaty, tougher sanctions on Iran, cooperation on transportation to and from Afghanistan, and Russia’s accession to the World Trade Organization.

zh: 但此次重启基本上是由奥巴马和梅德韦杰夫的个人关系推动的。 在2012年普京开始其第三个任期前，俄罗斯总统是梅德韦杰夫。
en: But this reset was largely facilitated by the personal ties between Obama and Dmitri Medvedev, who served as President for four years before Putin returned in 2012 for a third term.

zh: 当普金谴责美国指使了反对他回归总统宝座的示威时，美俄关系又开始了恶化。
en: When Putin blamed the US for the opposition demonstrations that accompanied his return, the relationship began to deteriorate.

zh: 去年8月，克里姆林宫决定授予美国情报承包商斯诺登临时避难权，此次重启宣告结束。
en: With the Kremlin’s decision last August to grant temporary asylum to the former US intelligence contractor Edward J. Snowden, the reset ended.

zh: 冷战的意识形态对立也许已成为过去时，但如今俄罗斯自视为不同的文明和社会模式。
en: The ideological antagonism of the Cold War may be gone, but Russia now defines itself as an alternative civilizational and social model.

zh: 俄罗斯明确宣布它是维持现状（status quo）的大国，与“修正主义 ” （ revisionist）的美国相反。 美国寻求通过促进制度演变动摇世界，特别是阿拉伯世界。
en: Pointedly, Russia claims that it is a status quo power, contrasting itself with the US, which it calls a “revisionist” power seeking to destabilize the world by promoting regime change, especially in the Arab world.

zh: 克里姆林宫还把美国视为前苏联地区动荡的根源，指责西方需要为乌克兰动荡负责。
en: The Kremlin also views the US as a source of instability in the former Soviet space and blames the West for the Ukrainian unrest.

zh: 尽管如此，美俄关系永远是一分为二的，有许多迫在眉睫的多边问题美国必须与俄罗斯合作，特别是叙利亚、伊朗和阿富汗（美国将在今年撤军）问题。
en: Nonetheless, the US-Russia relationship has always been compartmentalized, and there are pressing multilateral issues on which the US must work with Russia, particularly Syria, Iran, and Afghanistan (where the US will withdraw its troops this year).

zh: 尽管美国和俄罗斯在如何结束叙利亚内战上存在分歧，但它们仍合作去除了叙利亚的化学武装。
en: Whereas the US and Russia disagree about how to end the Syrian civil war, they have cooperated in disarming Syria of its chemical weapons.

zh: 类似地，双方都不愿意看到伊朗发展出核武器能力。
en: Similarly, neither side wants to see Iran develop a nuclear-weapons capability.

zh: 过去二十年，双方数次抱有极大希望，又数次以失望告终，这表明，在乌克兰危机解决后，美国对俄目标将更温和、更现实。
en: The past two decades of bilateral great expectations, followed by serial disappointments, suggest that, once the Ukraine crisis is resolved, more modest and realistic US goals toward Russia are in order.

zh: 除非两国都能超越冷战、20世纪90年代和今天的危机留下的条条框框，否则不管是白宫还是克里姆林宫发动的重启，最多只能更有效地管理依然是有限的、尝试性的关系。
en: Unless and until both countries move beyond the legacies of the Cold War, the 1990’s, and today’s crisis, any reset – regardless of whether it originates in the White House or the Kremlin – can at best manage more effectively what will remain a limited and trying relationship.

zh: 对美国来说，这意味着承认俄罗斯的地位：这是一个仍具有重要性的大国，政治制度混杂，存在严重的国内经济、人口和政治挑战。
en: For the US, this means recognizing Russia for what it is: a large, still-important country with a hybrid political system and serious domestic economic, demographic, and political challenges.

zh: 俄罗斯的后苏联时代演化是一个数十年的过程，并且演化过程也不可能是线性的。
en: Russia’s post-Soviet evolution is a matter of many decades and will not occur in a linear fashion.

zh: 其世界观与美国截然不同，并且在可预见的未来都将如此。
en: Its worldview is sharply at odds with that of the US and will remain so for the foreseeable future.

zh: 但冷和平总比冷战要好。
en: But a cold peace is preferable to a cold war.

zh: PISA的成功
en: PISA’s Promise

zh: 巴黎—经合组织的国际学生评估计划（Program for International Student Assessment，简称PISA）评估表现最好、进步最大的教育体系下的学生的学力和知识，为如何实现这一点提供有价值的改革选项。
en: PARIS – By assessing the capabilities and knowledge of students in the highest-performing and most rapidly improving education systems, the OECD’s Program for International Student Assessment provides valuable options for reform and information on how to achieve it.

zh: PISA集中了全球决策者、教育者和研究者，讨论若要在当今世界中成为成功而负责任的公民学生需要哪些知识，以及如何发展更高效、更包容的教育体系。
en: PISA brings together policymakers, educators, and researchers from around the world to discuss what knowledge students need to become successful and responsible citizens in today’s world, and how to develop more effective, inclusive education systems.

zh: 有些人说PISA的结果基于太广泛的因素组合，这些因素之间缺乏关联，另一些人则认为测试不同语言和文化背景的学生天生具有不合理性。
en: Some claim that the PISA results are based on too wide a range of factors to be relevant, while others point out the challenges inherent in testing students in various languages and with different cultural backgrounds.

zh: 当然，比较国家间的教育决非易事，但PISA仍是目前试图改善国民教育体系的决策者最有用的工具。
en: Of course, comparing education across countries is not easy, but PISA remains the most useful tool yet developed for policymakers attempting to improve their national education systems.

zh: PISA出现前，许多政府都宣称它们管理者世界上最成功的教育体系，并认为它们i经采取了必要措施纠正一切缺陷。
