en: Before PISA, many governments claimed that they oversaw the world’s most successful education systems, and insisted that they had already taken the steps needed to address any shortcomings.

zh: PISA评估暴露出一国体系的弱点，从而有助于确保决策者认识到 — — 并希望他们改进 — — 仍然存在的缺陷。
en: By exposing weaknesses in a particular country’s system, PISA assessments help to ensure that policymakers recognize – and, it is hoped, address – remaining deficiencies.

zh: PISA给政府和教育部长造成了问责，这有助于刺激他们行动起来。
en: The sense of accountability that PISA fosters among governments and education ministers has helped to spur them into action.

zh: 他们日益开始互相取经如何应用课程、教学和数字资源方面的创新；如何提供个性化学习体验以最大化学生的成功机会；以及如何应对教学所面临的多样性。
en: They increasingly turn to one another to learn how to apply innovations in curricula, pedagogy, and digital resources; how to offer personalized learning experiences that maximize every student’s chances of success; and how to cope with diversity in the classroom.

zh: 经合组织将PISA立为全球评估，因为在当今全球化的世界中，学生必须能够与来自多种背景的人合作，接受不同的思想、观点和价值。
en: The OECD established PISA as a global assessment, because in today’s globalized world students must be able to collaborate with people from diverse backgrounds and appreciate different ideas, perspectives, and values.

zh: 为了让学生获得最大的成功机会，教育必须让他们准备好处理超越国界的问题。
en: To give students the best possible chance to succeed, education must prepare them to handle issues that transcend national boundaries.

zh: 但PISA最重要的结果还在国家层面，因为它启发了创新，扩展了国家内部的教育前景。
en: But PISA’s most important outcomes lie at the national level, because it inspires innovation and broadens educational perspectives within countries.

zh: 芬兰、日本、中国和加拿大等多样化的教育体系 — — 此前极少会有决策者关注 — — 已成为卓越教育表现的全球参照点，有助于其他国家设计有效改革。
en: Education systems as diverse as those in Finland, Japan, China, and Canada – which seldom registered on policymakers’ radars before – have become global reference points for excellence in education, helping other countries to design effective reforms.

zh: 在2000年发布的首次PISA评估中，巴西教育体系表现最差，许多人正确地质疑将新兴市场与芬兰和日本等发达国家相比较是否公平。
en: When Brazil emerged as the lowest-performing education system in the first PISA assessment, released in 2000, many people rightly questioned the fairness of comparing an emerging economy to advanced countries like Finland and Japan.

zh: 但巴西随后奋起直追，在改进教学质量方面做了大手笔投资。
en: But Brazil rose to the challenge, making massive investments in improving the quality of teaching.

zh: 如今巴西已是全球教育体系进步最快的国家。
en: The country now boasts one of the world’s most rapidly improving education systems.

zh: 德国也是PISA 2000中的突出者，其表现不及平均水平，并且存在巨大的教育社会不公，这一结果令德国人十分震惊，并开展了为期几个月的公共争论。
en: Germany also featured in PISA 2000, recording below-average performance and large social inequalities in education – an outcome that stunned Germans and initiated a months-long public debate.

zh: 受到刺激的政府采取了支持弱势和移民学生的措施，并让早教成为德国教育政策的推动力。
en: Spurred into action, the government launched initiatives to support disadvantaged and immigrant students, and made the notion of early childhood education a driving force in German education policy.

zh: 如今呢，PISA报告确认德国教育体系的质量和公平性有了重大进步。
en: Today, PISA reports confirm that the quality and fairness of Germany’s education system have improved considerably.

zh: 即使在全球表现最好的教育体系，PISA也有助于指出改进方向。
en: Even in the world’s best-performing education systems, PISA helps to pinpoint areas for improvement.

zh: 比如，PISA评估表明，尽管日本学生长于复述学到的知识，但被问及需要创造性地应用所学知识的外延性问题时往往难于应付。
en: For example, PISA assessments have revealed that, while Japanese students excel at reproducing what they have learned, they often struggle when asked to extrapolate from that knowledge and apply it creatively.

zh: 在去年4月访问被2011年海啸摧毁的东北学校时，这一结果所带来的创造更具创新性的学习环境的措施随处可见。
en: The effort that this has inspired to create more innovative learning environments was apparent last April, during a visit to the Tohoku schools destroyed by the 2011 tsunami.

zh: 这一经验提供了另一个教训：即使社会和文化因素是决定一国交易风格的主要力量，改进的空间仍然存在。
en: This experience offers yet another lesson: even in cases where social and cultural factors seem to be the main force shaping a country’s education style, improvements are possible.

zh: 日本等国家不需要改变文化来纠正教育不足；它们只需要调整政策和实践。
en: Countries like Japan do not have to change their cultures to address their educational shortcomings; they simply have to adjust their policies and practices.

zh: 自20世纪90年代末PISA计划提出以来，创造教育研究和创新合作的全球平台就一直是其初衷。
en: Creating a global platform for collaboration in education research and innovation has been the PISA initiative’s aspiration from its conception in the late 1990s.

zh: 此后，决策者、研究者和专家建立了全球最大的致力于发展鲁棒、可靠、关于的学生学习成果信息可进行国际比较的专业网络。
en: Since then, policymakers, researchers, and experts have built the world’s largest professional network dedicated to the development of robust, reliable, and internationally comparable information on student learning outcomes.

zh: 与此同时，PISA还测量学生的社会与情商技能���他们对学习的态度，以及教育平等性和家长支持 — — 所有这些为理解全球评估得分提供了不可或缺的基准。
en: At the same time, PISA measures students’ social and emotional skills and attitudes toward learning, as well as educational equity and parental support – all of which provides indispensable context for understanding scores on international assessments.

zh: 当然，评估并未覆盖所有重要技能或态度。
en: Of course, assessments do not cover every important skill or attitude.

zh: 但令人信服的证据表明PISA系统所评估的知识和技能对学生的未来成功至关重要，并且经合组织一直在致力于扩大PISA所测量的认知和社会技能的范围。
en: But there is convincing evidence that the knowledge and skills that the PISA system assesses are essential to students’ future success, and the OECD works continuously to broaden the range of cognitive and social skills that PISA measures.

zh: PISA已经在推动全球教育重要进步方面起到了作用。
en: PISA has already prompted important advances in education worldwide.

zh: 经合组织将继续与80个参与国合作，进一步开发该计划，以使其能够继续帮助决策者和教育者设计和实施更好的教育政策 — — 并让公民获得实现美好生活所需要的工具。
en: The OECD will continue to work with the 80 participating countries to develop the program further, so that it can continue to help policymakers and educators design and implement better education policies – and give their citizens access to the tools that they need to build better lives.

zh: 零排放任务
en: The Zero-Emissions Imperative

zh: 达沃斯—地球警报在拉响。
en: DAVOS – Our planet is warming dangerously.

zh: 政府间气候变化委员会（Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change）2013年报告明确指出，最有可能的罪魁祸首是我们在过去半个世纪中所排放的二氧化碳。
en: And, as the 2013 report by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change makes clear, our carbon-dioxide emissions over the past half-century are extremely likely to be to blame.

zh: 我们需要更更鲁棒的全球变暖应对方针才能避免灾难。
en: A more robust approach to global warming is needed if we are to avoid catastrophe.

zh: 与最近的金融危机不同，地球气候可没有援助选项可选。
en: Unlike the recent financial crisis, there is no bailout option for the earth’s climate.

zh: 三年前，在坎昆联合国COP 16气候变化上，各国同意在2020年把排放量降低到足以阻止全球平均气温比工业化之前高2℃的水平。
en: Three years ago, at the United Nations COP 16 climate-change meeting in Cancún, countries agreed to reduce their emissions by 2020 to a point that would prevent the average global temperature from rising more than 2°C above pre-industrial levels.

zh: 但是，联合国的估计表明，当前趋势只能让世界完成这一目标的25—50 % 。
en: However, UN estimates show that current trends would bring the world only 25-50% of the way to this target.

zh: 这就是我呼吁所有政府都应该提高决心、以到本世纪下半叶实现化石燃料零净排放为目标的原因。
en: This is why I am calling on all governments to be more ambitious – to aim for zero net emissions from fossil fuels by the second half of this century.

zh: 没有能源经济的全面变化，这一目标就不可能实现。
en: Nothing short of a wholesale transformation of the energy economy will suffice.

zh: 本周，欧盟委员会公布了2030年能源和气候目标 — — 欧盟温室气体排放量将在1990年水平的基础上下降40 % ， 27%的能源将来自可再生资源。
en: Just this week, the European Commission unveiled new energy and climate targets for 2030 – calling for a 40% reduction in the bloc’s greenhouse-gas emissions from 1990 levels, with 27% of energy to come from renewable sources.

zh: 这是极其重要的一步，其他国家也应该效而仿之。
en: This is an extremely important step, and more countries should follow suit.

zh: 诚然，我们将面临巨大的障碍。
en: To be sure, we will encounter huge obstacles.

zh: 三分之二的发电量和近95%的能源用于运输系统，并且来自化石燃料。
en: Two-thirds of electricity generation, and nearly 95% of the energy consumed by the world’s transport systems, comes from fossil fuels.

zh: 我们的能源安全日益系于勘探非常规化石燃料存量（如页岩气 ） ， 美国尤其如此。
en: Our energy security is increasingly tied to the exploitation of unconventional fossil-fuel deposits like shale gas, especially in the United States.

zh: 在很多领域，碳密集技术仍比低碳替代方案更有利可图。
en: Carbon-intensive technologies remain more profitable than low-carbon alternatives in many cases.

zh: 囿于现金问题的政府继续鼓励油气勘探，部分原因是这样能让它们获得租金，其数量足以占到岁入的很大一部分。
en: And cash-strapped governments continue to encourage oil and gas exploration, in part because the rents received by some account for a large part of their revenues.

zh: 但变化的可能仍在。
en: But change is possible.

zh: 在政府所做的气候变化承诺和它们通常不一致（更不用说相互矛盾了）的政策之箭存在着巨大的差距。
en: There is a yawning gap between what governments promise to do about climate change and their often-inconsistent (if not incoherent) policies.

zh: 即使政府摆出一副支持更绿色技术的样子，也常常会突然改变甚至逆转政策，让企业不愿投入大量资金，甚至根本不把官方说辞当回事。
en: Even when appearing to support greener technologies, governments are prone to sudden policy changes, sometimes retroactively, leaving businesses reluctant to commit to significant investments, or even take official statements seriously at all.

zh: 我认为，如果能在三个问题上明确方向，我们可以实现巨大且快速的进步：
en: I believe we can make substantial and rapid progress by setting a clear direction on three issues:

zh: 给碳定价。
en: Put a price on carbon.

zh: 通过给碳成本定价，我们可以管理它的使用（或禁用 ） 。
en: By pricing the cost of carbon, we can manage its use (or disuse).

zh: 40多个国家已经实施了某种形式的碳税或排量交易机制。
en: More than 40 countries have already implemented some form of carbon tax or emissions-trading scheme.

zh: 交易机制通常具有更大的政治吸引力，因为它们可以灵活安排（尽管它们的设计和实施可以在很多方面有所改进 ） 。
en: Trading schemes are often politically more attractive, because they can be flexible (although their design and implementation could be improved in many cases).

zh: 但我们的步子可以更大一些。
en: But we can be bolder.

zh: 一些政府成功地引入了碳税而没有对增长产生消极影响，我们应该鼓励更多的国家走这条路。
en: Several governments have successfully introduced carbon taxes without adversely affecting growth, and we should encourage more countries to follow their example.

zh: 削减化石燃料补贴。
en: Cut fossil-fuel subsidies.

zh: 经合组织估算，2005年到2011年间，其成员国的化石燃料补贴每年可达550—900亿美元。
en: The OECD estimates that fossil-fuel subsidies in member countries amounted to $55-90 billion annually from 2005 to 2011.

zh: 国际能源署估算，2012年全球化石燃料补贴增长了5,440亿美元。
en: And the International Energy Agency estimates that in 2012 fossil-fuel subsidies worldwide grew to $544 billion.

zh: 这些补贴的大部分都应该被取消；能源业不需要更多的国家援助来烧化石燃料（而在发展中和新兴经济体，补贴大多效率低下，可能也不是帮助穷人的必要办法 ） 。
en: Most of these subsidies should be scrapped; the energy industry does not need more state aid to burn fossil fuels (and, in developing and emerging economies, subsidies are a grossly inefficient and probably unnecessary way to help the poor).

zh: 明确政策。
en: Clarify policies.

zh: 政府必须纠正能源战略的不一致性，考虑能源战略与广义经济政策的联系，并停止向消费者、生产者和投资者释放互相矛盾的信号。
en: Governments must address inconsistencies in their energy strategies, consider the links with broader economic policies, and stop sending mixed signals to consumers, producers, and investors.

zh: 特别地，政府必须评估是否实施了正确的监管安排以便于清洁能源投资可以根据风险-回报的基础上参与竞争。
en: In particular, they must assess whether the right regulatory arrangements are in place to allow clean-energy investments to compete on a risk-return basis.

zh: 这对于让投资者趋向气候友好型方案至关重要。
en: This will be essential if investors are to redirect investment toward climate-friendly alternatives.

zh: 经合组织将做好分内之事。
en: The OECD will play its part.

zh: 为了更准确地理解和比较不同国家的表现，经合组织经济调查现已包括气候政策的数据和分析。
en: In order to understand and compare countries’ performances more accurately, OECD Economic Surveys will now include data and analysis of climate policies.

zh: 到2015年，我们预期将能产生关于正在取得的进步和经合组织和所有主要新兴经济体仍需面对的挑战的清晰图景，并且向这些国家给出关于它们如何切实提高政策的目标和成本效益的建议。
en: By mid-2015, we expect to have a clear picture of the progress being made and the challenges that remain in OECD countries and all major emerging economies – and to have advised these countries how they can realistically increase the ambition and cost-effectiveness of their policies.

zh: 这些步骤将放出一个信号，要实现零净排放的目标，排放价格必须大幅提高。
en: These steps will signal that the price of emissions must rise substantially if we are to reach our goal of zero net emissions.

zh: 转变绝不是无成本的，政府必须诚实地向选民公布其社会和经济影响。
en: The transformation will not be costless, and governments must be frank with their electorates about its social and economic impact.

zh: 但低碳的、气候恢复力强的世界必然能够提供新的经济机会。
en: But a low-carbon, climate-resilient world will also offer new economic opportunities.

zh: 更重要的是，从长远看，替代方案 — — 不作为，或作为不足 — — 的代价要大得多。
en: More important, the alternative – inaction, or too little action – would be far more expensive in the long run.

zh: 比如，飓风放低给美国造成了相当于其GDP的0.5%的损失。
en: Hurricane Sandy, for example, cost the US the equivalent of 0.5% of its GDP.

zh: 2050年，全球沿海城市每年的防洪支出可能增加到500亿美元以上。
en: The annual bill for flood protection in coastal cities worldwide is likely to rise above $50 billion by 2050.

zh: 发展中国家面临的局面更加困难：2013年袭击菲律宾的台风海燕便是一次惨痛的教训，提醒我们穷国在气候变化面前是多么脆弱。
en: The consequences for developing countries are more dire: Typhoon Haiyan, which hit the Philippines in 2013, was a stark reminder of how vulnerable poor countries can be to climate change.

zh: 如果世界想避免与大自然的碰撞 — — 人类在这场碰撞中绝无获胜可能 — — 我们就必须在各条战线上果断采取行动，特别是在碳定价和经济和能源政策的一致性上。
en: If the world is to avoid a collision with nature – one that humanity surely cannot win – we must act boldly on every front, particularly with respect to carbon pricing and the coherence of our economic and energy policies.

zh: 并且我们必须马上采取行动。
en: And we must do so now.

zh: 美国之怒
en: Anger in America

zh: 香港 - 很多人将当前西方民粹主义反动归咎于极右翼。 极右翼承诺响应工薪阶层之恨，通过煽动恐惧和鼓励极端倾向来赢得选票。
en: HONG KONG – Many blame today’s populist rebellion in the West on the far right, which has won votes by claiming to be responding to working-class grievances, while stoking fear and promoting polarization.

zh: 但在指责领袖利用大众之怒的时候，许多人忽视了愤怒本身的巨大影响，愤怒指向过去三十年中财富急剧膨胀的精英阶层，而相比之下，中产和工薪阶层的财富却不见增长。
en: But, in blaming leaders who have seized on popular anger, many overlook the power of that anger itself, which is aimed at elites whose wealth has skyrocketed in the last 30 years, while that of the middle and working classes has remained stagnant.

zh: 两项最新研究直击当前问题的核心，尤其在美国，但世界其它国家亦然。
en: Two recent analyses get to the heart of the issues at play, particularly in the United States, but also in the rest of the world.

zh: 在新书《尾旋坠落 》 （ Tailspin）中，记者出身的作者史蒂文·布里尔（Steven Brill）指出，美国的自由民主制度已经与其推崇的社会目标脱节，因为它们只保护一小撮人，而以自由市场的名义放任其它脆弱群体遭受掠夺。
en: In his new book Tailspin, the journalist Steven Brill argues that US institutions are no longer fit for purpose, because they protect only the few and leave the rest vulnerable to predatory behavior in the name of the free market.

zh: 在布里尔看来，这是美国英才制度的后果：最优秀、最聪明的人有机会爬到顶端，但随后就把登天梯子撤掉，以便能够把持民主机构，并利用它们固化自己的特权。
en: According to Brill, this is an upshot of America’s meritocracy: the best and brightest had the chance to climb to the top, but then essentially pulled the ladder up behind them, as they captured democratic institutions and used them to entrench special privileges for themselves.

zh: 马修·斯图尔特（Mathew Stewart）对此表示赞同，他指出 ： “ 英才阶层精通巩固财富的老伎俩，康非英才阶层子孙后代之慨将特权传递给自己的后代。
en: The author Matthew Stewart agrees, arguing that, “the meritocratic class has mastered the old trick of consolidating wealth and passing privilege along at the expense of other people’s children.”

zh: ”斯图尔特发现，在20世纪80年代中期，美国底层90%的人所持有的财富比例达到了历史最高值，为35 % ； 三十年后，他们的财富比例下降到20 % ， 而他们所损失的财富几乎全部流向了顶层的0.1 % 。
en: Stewart shows that in the mid-1980s, the share of US wealth held by the bottom 90% of the population peaked at 35%; three decades later, they owned just 20%, with almost all of what they lost going to the top 0.1%.

zh: 中间的9.9 % — —斯图尔特称之为“新美国贵族 ” — —构成了从前所谓的中产阶级。
en: The 9.9% between these two groups – what Stewart calls the “new American aristocracy” – comprises what used to be called the middle class.

zh: 在1963年，底层90%的人口需要让其财富增加六倍后才能成为中间阶层的9.9 % ； 但到了2010年，从底层90%跳到中间阶层9.9 % ， 他们需要让财富增加25倍。
en: In 1963, the 90% would have had to increase their wealth sixfold to reach the level of the 9.9%; by the 2010s, they would need 25 times their wealth to reach that level.

zh: 结果是，大部分美国人比从前工作更努力，但生活水平仍然在下降。 更糟糕的是，他们还要承担高额房债，许多人还没有医保。
en: Much of the US population is working harder than ever, yet has suffered a decline in living standards, compounded by high levels of household debt and, in many cases, lack of health insurance.

zh: 顶层10%能够轻松获得高等教育，让他们的孩子获得与他们一样的特权；而底层90%必须加倍努力才能付得起高昂的学费，通常他们毕业的时候便已经负债累累。
en: The top 10% have easy access to higher education that will enable their children to have the same privileges as them; the bottom 90% must work much harder to cover sky-high tuition fees, and typically graduate with a heavy debt burden.

zh: 顶层10%能获得一流的医疗服务；而底层90%通常无法获得，或必须为此付出极高的代价。
en: The top 10% receive first-rate medical care; the bottom 90% often do not, or must pay an exceptionally high price for it.

zh: 税收理应是促进平等的工具。
en: Taxation is supposed to level the playing field.

zh: 但美国共和党却一直在寻求降低富人的税收，理据是通过降低边际税率来促进投资、就业和经济增长，从而实现财富向社会其他阶层“滴涓”渗透。
en: But US Republicans have long pushed to lower taxes on the rich, arguing that lowering marginal tax rates will promote investment, employment, and economic growth, which will cause the wealth to “trickle down” to the rest of society.

zh: 但事实上，为富人减税只是进一步固化了他们的特权，加剧了社会不平等。
en: In fact, tax cuts for the rich merely further entrench their advantages, exacerbating inequality.

zh: 更糟糕的是，穷人实际上要付更多的间接税（包括土地、不动产、消费税等 ） ， 底层20%的美国人支付的平均州税是顶层1%的两倍多。
en: Making matters worse, the poor pay more indirect taxes (on land, real estate, and consumer goods), and the bottom 20% of the US population pays more than twice what the top 1% pays in state taxes.

zh: 除此之外，底层还需要面临自动化和机器人的挑战，更不用说由气候变化导致的日益频繁和剧烈的自然灾害了，不难看出为何如此多的大众感到如此愤怒。
en: Add to that the challenges posed by automation and robotization, not to mention increasingly frequent and intense natural disasters, and it is not hard to see why so many people are so furious.

zh: 斯图尔特认为，中间9.9%的精英“操控着将资源从底层90%引向顶层0.1%的社会机器 ” ， 并愉快地接受其努力工作的“战利品分赃 ” 。
en: According to Stewart, the 9.9% is “the staff that runs the machine that funnels resources from the 90% to the 0.1%,” happily taking its “cut of the spoils.”

zh: 但这个社会机器所制造的不平等可能带来严重后果，比如刺激社会不满以及我们现在在美国所看到的无法理喻的决策过程与结果。
en: But the inequality that this machine generates can have serious consequences, as it spurs social discontent and, as we are seeing in the US today, erratic policymaking.

zh: 奥地利历史学家沃尔特·沙伊德尔（Walter Scheidel）指出，历史上，不平等往往需要通过战争、革命、国家崩溃或自然灾害来消除。
en: As the Austrian historian Walter Scheidel argues, inequality has historically been countered through war, revolution, state collapse, or natural disaster.

zh: 如果希望避免这些灾难性事件，就需要顶层10%的精英更好地推动底层90%大众的利益，包括收入、财富、福利和机会等。
en: Avoiding such a dramatic event would require the 10% to do a much better job of advancing the interests of the 90%, in terms of income, wealth, welfare, and opportunities.

zh: 但经济短视加上政治极化导致许多人试图将美国大众之怒转移到外国移民、中国和国际贸易（包括与盟国的贸易）头上。
en: Yet a combination of economic myopia and political polarization has led many instead to try to divert popular anger toward immigrants, China, and trade (including with close allies).

zh: 这就导致整个世界目前都陷入了没有赢家的不断升级的保护主义斗争中。
en: As a result, the entire world is now caught in an escalating protectionist war that nobody will win.

zh: 从历史上看，短期内部矛盾和失衡常常会导致国际冲突。
en: It is true that, historically, internal contradictions and imbalances have often led to interstate conflict.

zh: 但这并不是不可避免的。
en: But that is not inevitable.

zh: 相反，结果取决于领袖的领导力质量。
en: Rather, the outcome depends on the quality of leadership.

zh: 比如，在美国，华盛顿、林肯和富兰克林·罗斯福都成功地处理了危机并让美国变得更强大，因为他们都能够认识到解决内部分歧必须兼顾国家核心价值观、国家在全球的地位、以及国家长期发展目标。
en: In the US, for example, George Washington, Abraham Lincoln, and Franklin D. Roosevelt succeeded in strengthening their country because they recognized the need to address internal divisions in the light of America’s core values, global position, and long-term goals.

zh: 美国总统特朗普非常巧妙地利用大众之怒来推动自己的利益与议程。
en: US President Donald Trump has exploited popular anger to advance his own interests.

zh: 但制造愤怒的并不是特朗普，而是美国的精英，几十年来他们为特朗普之流的崛起创造了条件。
en: But he did not create that anger; America’s elites have spent decades doing that, creating the conditions for a figure like Trump to emerge.

zh: 现在特朗普已经大权在握，90%的底层大众的状况很可能会进一步恶化。
en: Now that Trump is in charge, the conditions of the 90% are set to deteriorate further.

zh: 特别是他的贸易保护政策不仅帮不了他理应代表的大众；还会破坏历史上曾经团结大众与领袖的公平和主人翁意识。
en: His approach to trade, in particular, will not only fail to help the people he purports to represent; it will also destroy the sense of fairness and stewardship that has historically bound the masses to their leaders.

zh: 指责外国人是政治权宜之计。
en: Blaming outsiders is politically expedient.

zh: 但“让美国重新伟大”的唯一办法是解决内部不公，而不是进口关税和边境墙。
en: But the only way to “make America great again” is by addressing its internal injustices. No import tariff or border wall can do that.

zh: 反思动物农业
en: Rethinking Animal Agriculture

zh: 塔斯马尼亚—7月中旬，一场严重的旱灾毁掉了庄稼，一些欧洲奶农和肉农被迫提前宰杀牲口降低需要喂养的动物数量。
en: TASMANIA – In mid-July, as a brutal drought decimated crops, some European dairy and meat farmers were forced to cull their herds early to reduce the number of animals they needed to feed.

zh: 在一个热浪越来越长，越来越热，越来越干，越来越频繁的世界，这类绝望的决定会成为常态。
en: Such desperate decisions will become routine in a world where heat waves will be longer, hotter, drier, and more frequent.

zh: 因此，应该从现在开始就动物农业开展严肃讨论。
en: That is why now is the right time to start a serious conversation about animal agriculture.

zh: 动物农业不但非常容易受到气候变化的已有的和预计的效果的影响；也是问题的主要根源之一。
en: The animal agriculture industry is not only vulnerable to the observed and predicted effects of climate change; it is also a key contributor to the problem.

zh: 事实上，肉用和奶用动物农业产生了16.5% 的全球温室气体排放。
en: In fact, the farming of animals for meat and dairy products accounts for 16.5% of global greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 此外，如果我们向紧急状态那样对待气候变化，在未来20年中认真地减缓变暖的速度，则牧业的影响比例会更大。
en: Moreover, if we treated climate change as the emergency it is and were serious about slowing the pace of warming over the next 20 years, the proportional influence of livestock farming would be even greater.

zh: 这是因为，动物农业产生了整整三分之一的人造甲烷和三分之二的一氧化二氮排放 — — 这两种气体都是固热能力比二氧化碳还要强的强力温室气体。
en: This is because the animal sector is responsible for a third of all anthropogenic methane and two-thirds of nitrous oxide emissions – both potent greenhouse gases that trap more heat than carbon dioxide.

zh: 除了气候污染，高达60%的生物多样性损失要归因于为了养殖动物而做出的土地用途改变，80%的耕地被用来饲养动物或种植饲料。
en: Beyond climate pollution, a staggering 60% of all biodiversity loss is attributable to land-use changes from animal cultivation, and as much as 80% of all land in farming is devoted either to raising animals or to growing their feed.

zh: 而吃太多动物导致我们健康下滑也是令人触目惊心的现实。
en: There is also the stubborn reality that eating so many animals is making us less healthy.

zh: 我们不需要做出大的牺牲就能做得更好。
en: We can do better without great sacrifice.

zh: 比如，据英国皇家国际事务研究所（Chatham House）的最新研究，如果能过获得价格相近的方便又美味的替代品，发达国家人民愿意减少摄入肉类。
en: According to recent research by Chatham House, for example, people in developed countries would accept reducing their meat intake if convenient and tasty alternatives were available for about the same price.

zh: 澄清一点，我不是在建议每个人都应该成为广义或狭义的素食者（尽管毫无争议这样的饮食对环境更好，有利于减轻气候变化，也更健康 ） 。
en: To be clear, I am not suggesting that everyone should become vegetarian or vegan (though it is indisputable that these diets are better for the environment, contribute less to climate change, and are healthier).

zh: 我也不认为政府应该强制规定肉类消费限额。
en: Nor do I think that governments should mandate limits on meat consumption.

zh: 但如果决策者相信对大部分发达国家人民而言，减少肉类摄入风险小，收益高，那么存在众多高性价比方案 助推我们往这个方向前进。
en: But for policymakers who accept that there is little downside and significant upside for most people in developed countries to reduce their meat intake, there are plenty of cost-effective solutions to nudge us in that direction.

zh: 首先，政府能够也应该停止补贴工厂化农场和育肥工厂化放牧动物以供屠宰的作物。
en: For starters, governments can – and should – stop subsidizing factory farming and the crops that fatten up factory-farmed animals for slaughter.

zh: 支持这些高污染、不人道的行为真的好比是在付钱请公司破坏2015年巴黎气候协定制定的排放目标。
en: By supporting polluting and inhumane practices, countries are literally paying companies to undermine the emissions targets set by the 2015 Paris climate agreement.

zh: 相反，政府能够也应该转而补贴鼓励气候中性、蛋白质丰富的作物，如豆科植物。
en: Instead, governments can – and should – shift subsidies to encourage the production of more climate-neutral, protein-rich crops, like pulses and other legumes.

zh: 种植更多大豆、豌豆和扁豆有助于减少温室气体排放，从而遏制气候变化，农民也可以因为这些作物更加耐旱耐热而获益。
en: By planting more beans, peas, and lentils, farmers would help combat climate change by lowering greenhouse-gas emissions, and would benefit from crops that are more resilient to drier, warmer weather.

zh: 政府支持还可以从工厂化肉食农场转向开发基于植物的“肉”和其他肉类替代品。
en: Government support can also be diverted from factory meat farms toward development of plant-based “meats” and other meat alternatives.

zh: “清洁肉”尚在襁褓阶段，但增长迅猛，对于市场上较先进的产品，公众反应也是一边倒的支持。
en: The market for “clean meat” is nascent but burgeoning, and the public response has been overwhelmingly positive to some of the more advanced products on the market.

zh: 尽管如此，正如化石燃料行业，肉食行业说客推动决策者阻挠替代品的主流化。
en: Still, just like the fossil-fuel industry, meat industry advocates have pushed policymakers to block the mainstreaming of alternatives.

zh: 在很多国家，游说集团成功禁止植物基产品采用肉基商品名称。
en: In many countries, lobbyists have even successfully championed the prohibition of meat-based names for plant-based products.

zh: 比如，法国最近禁止使用素“汉堡”和“牛排”等用语，因为只有动物肉才符合条件。
en: For example, France recently banned terms like vegan “burger” and “steak” on the grounds that only animal meat could be either.

zh: 这些政策显然都是降低肉食消费的障碍，也与国家实现巴黎气候目标的承诺相抵触。
en: Such policies are a clear barrier to reducing meat consumption, and they contradict countries’ commitment to meet their Paris-agreement targets.

zh: 肉食行业对这些政策的支持让它们和化石燃料行业成为一丘之貉，眼中只有自己的利润。
en: The meat sector’s support for them puts it in the same role as the fossil-fuel industry, focused on nothing more than its own bottom line.

zh: 生产者能够成为远离肉食的转型中的积极力量吗？
en: Or can producers engage as a positive force in the transition away from meat?

zh: 对于气候政策，粮食和农业应该像能源和运输一样对待，给出明确的气候变化和减排指引。
en: When it comes to climate policy, food and agriculture should be treated more like energy and transportation, both of which have clear guidance on how to address climate change and reduce emissions.

zh: 早就应该开始限制农业和粮食生产的变暖效应。
en: Policies to limit the planet-warming effects of agriculture and food production are long overdue.

zh: 我们距离第一份追踪巴黎协定进展状况的主要报告还有两年时间。
en: We are two years away from the first major report to gauge progress under the Paris agreement.

zh: 各国将要拿出它们做了什么以及还将做什么来减少排放。
en: Countries will have to show what they have done and what they are doing to cut their emissions.

zh: 但如果它们不解决肉类和奶类的生产和消费问题，就无法触及问题的一大方面。
en: But they will leave a huge part of the problem untouched if they fail to address the production and consumption of meat and dairy.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲农场主将经历更多的今年夏天这样的旱灾，世界其他地区的粮食生产者亦然。
en: Meanwhile, European farmers will suffer through more droughts like the one they endured this summer, as will other food producers around the world.

zh: 农场肉类和奶类生产将变得越来越困难，提前宰杀将成为新常态。
en: It will become harder and harder to farm meat and dairy products, and early culls will become the new normal.

zh: 和化石燃料一样，我们唯一的选择是克服该行业的抵触，改变我们的粮食体系，让饮食变得更健康、更清洁、更美味。
en: As with fossil fuels, our only choice is to overcome the industry’s defensive resistance and transform our food system so that it enables diets that are healthier, cleaner, and every bit as delicious.

zh: 我们钟爱的国际货币基金组织？
en: An IMF We Can Love?

zh: 剑桥报道－这次经济危机给国际货币基金组织带来了怎样的影响？
en: CAMBRIDGE – What a difference the crisis has made for the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 就在几个月之前，这个重要但不为人爱的机构（战后进行全球经济安排的里程碑）似乎注定无能为力。
en: It was just a few months ago that this important but unloved institution, a landmark of post-war global economic arrangements, seemed destined to irrelevance.

zh: 国际货币基金组织长久以来一直都是左派与右派的替罪羊 — — 为前者替罪，是因为该组织将工作重点聚焦在财政廉洁与经济正统上；而为后者代罪，则是因为该组织的作用在于救援那些负债累累的国家。
en: The IMF has long been a whipping boy for both left and right – the former because of the Fund’s emphasis on fiscal rectitude and economic orthodoxy, and the latter because of its role in bailing out indebted nations.

zh: 发展中国家勉强接受该组织的意见，而不需要资金的发达国家则采取忽略的态度。
en: Developing nations grudgingly took its advice, while advanced nations, not needing the money, ignored it.

zh: 当这个世界的私人资金流阻碍了该组织对各种资源的处理时，货币基金组织就看似一个时代错误。
en: In a world where private capital flows dwarf the resources at its disposal, the IMF had come to seem an anachronism.

zh: 而且，当该组织一些最大的债务人（巴西与阿根廷）开始在几年前预付其债务而没有新的借款人出现时，一切看似就像棺木的最后一颗钢钉也被敲上。
en: And, when some of the IMF’s largest debtors (Brazil and Argentina) began to prepay their debts a few years ago with no new borrowers in sight, it looked like the final nail in the coffin had been struck.

zh: 货币基金组织似乎除了失去其存在的理由，而且因为收入不济而遭受谴责。
en: The IMF seemed condemned to run out of income, in addition to losing its raison d’être.

zh: 该组织将预算缩减，并减小规模，而当新的责任（特别是对“货币操控”执行监控职责）同时赋予给该组织时，其深思熟虑更证明其很大程度上无力胜任。
en: It shrank its budgets and began to downsize, and, while it was handed some new responsibilities in the meantime – surveillance over “currency manipulation,” in particular – its deliberations proved largely irrelevant.

zh: 但这次的经济危机让其倍受鼓舞。
en: But the crisis has invigorated the IMF.

zh: 在其能干的总裁多米尼克•斯特劳斯-卡恩的领导下，国际货币基金组织是世界上少有的走在国际情势之前的官方机构之一，而不是落后与国际情势。
en: Under its capable managing director, Dominique Strauss-Kahn, the Fund has been one of the few official agencies ahead of – instead of behind – the curve.

zh: 它行动快速地为那些采取“合情”政策的国家建立了迅捷支付的信贷急救最高限额；它热切地支持以世界国民生产总值2%来进行全球范围内的财政刺激 — — 考虑到该组织以往在所有财政问题上的保守态度，这种姿态是有些非同寻常的。
en: It moved quickly to establish a fast-disbursing emergency line of credit for countries with “reasonable” policies. It ardently championed global fiscal stimulus on the order of 2% of world GNP – a position that is all the more remarkable in view of its traditional conservatism on all fiscal matters.

zh: 而且，在伦敦20国首脑会议的预备阶段，该组织彻底地对其贷款政策进行了革新，不再强调一贯执行的制约性，让实行了让各国能容易获得贷款的方法。
en: And, in the run-up to the G-20 summit in London, it thoroughly overhauled its lending policies, de-emphasizing traditional conditionality and making it easier for countries to qualify for loans.

zh: 意义更为重大的是，国际货币基金组织在伦敦会议上体面登场，带来了更多更充足的资源，以及表明了自己新的责任。
en: Even more significantly, the IMF has emerged from the London meeting with substantially greater resources, as well as new responsibilities.

zh: 20国首脑会议承诺要把基金组织的贷款能力翻两倍（从2500亿美元到7500亿美元 ） ， 发行了价值2500亿美元的新特别提款权（一种由多国货币组成的储备资产 ） ， 并允许货币基金组织在必要的情况下在资本市场中进行贷款（这在以前从未实行过 ） 。
en: The G-20 promised to triple the Fund’s lending capacity (from $250 billion to $750 billion), issue $250 billion of new Special Drawing Rights (a reserve asset made up of a basket of major currencies), and permit the Fund to borrow in capital markets (which it has never done) if necessary.

zh: 货币基金组织同样被指定成为两个权威机构之一（另一个是扩大化的财经稳定论坛，现已改名为财经稳定理事会 ） ， 其职责是为宏观经济与财政风险提供预警报告，并发表必须的政策执行提议。
en: The IMF was also designated as one of two lead agencies – along with an expanded Financial Stability Forum (now renamed the Financial Stability Board) – charged with providing early warning of macroeconomic and financial risks and issuing the requisite policy recommendations.

zh: 另一个好消息是，欧洲各国现在已经放弃他们对重新任命货币基金组织总裁的声明（正如美国人对世界银行主席的相关声明 ） 。
en: Another piece of good news is that the Europeans have now given up their claim on naming the IMF’s managing director (as have the Americans their corresponding claim on the World Bank presidency).

zh: 今后，这些高级官员要“通过一种公开、透明与优良品质为先的选举程序”进行选拔。
en: These senior officials are henceforth to be selected “through an open, transparent, and merit-based selection process.”

zh: 这样能让该组织更好地实行管理（尽管斯特劳斯-卡恩的领导力堪称典范 ） ， 并将提高两大权威机构在发展中国家心目中的合法性。
en: This will provide for better governance (although Strauss-Kahn’s leadership has been exemplary), and will enhance both institutions’ legitimacy in the eyes of developing nations.

zh: 因此，货币基金组织现在感觉自己再次身处经济大宇宙的环境中。
en: So the IMF now finds itself at the center of the economic universe once again.

zh: 它将如何部署其新发现的权力呢？
en: How will it choose to deploy its newfound power?

zh: 其面临的最大的危险是，它将再次将其权力与能力发挥到极致。
en: The greatest risk is that it will once again over-reach and over-play its hand.

zh: 这是在1995年发生的事情，当时货币基金组织开始鼓吹资本性账户的自由化，在亚洲金融危机时候实行过度紧缩银根的财政拯救方案，并试图单枪匹马的扭转亚洲经济。
en: That is what happened in the second half of the 1990’s, as the IMF began to preach capital-account liberalization, applied over-stringent fiscal remedies during the Asian financial crisis, and single-handedly tried to reshape Asian economies.

zh: 自那之后，货币基金组织就承认在所有这些领域所犯下的错误。
en: The institution has since acknowledged its errors in all these areas.

zh: 但现在仍需观察，它是否在组织内部完全领悟了这些教训，以及我们时候需要一个态度更友好、性情更温和的货币基金组织，来替代先前那个强硬与教条化的组织。
en: But it remains to be seen if the lessons have been fully internalized, and whether we will have a kinder, gentler IMF in lieu of a rigid, doctrinaire one.

zh: 一个颇为鼓舞人的事实是，发展中国家将几乎肯定能在货币基金组织如何运营上获得更大的发言权。
en: One encouraging fact is that developing countries will almost certainly get a larger say in how the Fund is run.

zh: 这将确保稍为贫穷的国家的观点能在将来得到更多的赞同。
en: This will ensure that poorer nations’ views receive a more sympathetic hearing in the future.

zh: 但如果国际货币基金组织的组织文化未能得到改变，那么仅仅给予发展中国家更大的投选权力也就没有多大的用处。
en: But simply giving developing nations greater voting power will make little difference if the IMF’s organizational culture is not changed as well.

zh: 货币基金组织的职员是由很大一批精明的经济学家们组成的，他们所缺乏的是未能过多地去了解并正确评价他们所研究的国家的制度的实际情况。
en: The Fund is staffed by a large number of smart economists, who lack much connection to (and appreciation for) the institutional realities of the countries on which they work.

zh: 他们的专业素质靠的是其高等学历，而不是由其在实际的政策决策中的成就来决定的。
en: Their professional expertise is validated by the quality of their advanced degrees, rather than by their achievements in practical policymaking.

zh: 这样就滋生出了的傲慢情怀与自鸣得意的优越感，超越了其同行 — — 那些必须在多重的复杂日程中权衡一切的决策者。
en: This breeds arrogance and a sense of smug superiority over their counterparts – policymakers who must balance multiple, complicated agendas.

zh: 要解决这些问题就需要货币基金组织的最高领导层在各方面采取主动攻势，如招募人才、员工管理与职位晋升方面。
en: Countering this will require proactive efforts by the IMF’s top leadership in recruitment, staffing, and promotion.

zh: 一种解决方案可以是，充分增加在发展中国家拥有实际经验的中等职业生涯的员工数量。
en: One option would be to increase substantially the number of mid-career recruits with actual practical experience in developing countries.

zh: 相对于理论上的知识，这样就能让货币基金组织的员工能更为认知本土知识。
en: This would make the IMF staff more cognizant of the value of local knowledge relative to theoretical expertise.

zh: 另一种策略是重新配置整体员工，让他们参与实地的“区域工作 ” ， 包括那些供职于执行部门的员工。
en: Another strategy would be to relocate some of the staff, including those in functional departments, to “regional offices” in the field.

zh: 对于那些习惯于在华盛顿整日趾高气昂的员工而言，这种措施可能会遇到相当程度的反抗。
en: This move would likely face considerable resistance from staff who have gotten used to the perks of Washington, DC.

zh: 但要正确评估一个地方就必须亲身力行，没有其它更好的方式。
en: But there is no better way to appreciate the role of context than to live in it.

zh: 前不久进行类似分权的世界银行，最终在服务客户上有了好转（没有在招募高级人才上遇到困难 ） 。
en: The World Bank, which engaged in a similar decentralization a while back, has become better at serving its clients as a result (without facing difficulties in recruiting top talent).

zh: 这是货币基金组织一个重要的时刻。
en: This is an important moment for the IMF.

zh: 国际社团已做好充分的准备等待着货币基金组织的决定与表现。
en: The international community is putting great store in the Fund’s judgment and performance.

zh: 要完全获得外界的信任，货币基金组织将需要组织内部的改革。
en: The Fund will require internal reforms to earn that trust fully.

zh: 打造平等的阿富汗
en: Leveling the Afghan Playing Field

zh: 纽约—阿富汗安全和政治局势仍在受不确定性的困扰，不确定性来自美国和北约战斗部队的撤出、即将到来的总统选举和与塔利班的和平谈判陷入停滞。
en: NEW YORK – Afghanistan’s security and political situation remains plagued by uncertainty, stemming from the withdrawal of United States and NATO combat troops, the upcoming presidential election, and the stalled peace negotiations with the Taliban.

zh: 阿富汗政府认识到，持续的经济不安全将恶化这一危险局面，因此宣布了新的旨在吸引外国直接投资（FDI）的经济激励计划。
en: Recognizing that continued economic insecurity will exacerbate this perilous situation, the government has announced a new package of economic incentives aimed at attracting foreign direct investment.

zh: 该计划包括以极低廉的价格向企业家提供土地、面向工厂主的最长七年的免税、以及面向农民的最长十年的低息贷款。
en: The package includes the provision of land to industrialists at dramatically reduced prices, tax exemptions of up to seven years for factory owners, and low-interest loans of up to ten years for farmers.

zh: 这些激励的目标是外国投资者和本地精英，意在阻止甚至扭转资本外逃。
en: Such incentives are targeted at foreign investors and the local elite, with the aim of stopping or even reversing capital flight.

zh: 但新措施最终还是要走上老路：分裂的政策方法将不足以解决阿富汗的根本性经济问题。
en: But the new measures ultimately amount to more of the same: a fragmented policy approach that will prove inadequate to solve Afghanistan’s fundamental economic problems.

zh: 在战后转型的早期阶段，FDI快速上升，占GDP之比从2002年的1.2%上升至2005年的峰值4.3 % 。
en: In the early stages of the post-war transition, FDI increased rapidly, rising from 1.2% of GDP in 2002 to a peak of 4.3% of GDP in 2005.

zh: 这些流入中的大头进入了建筑和服务业 — — 它们也是GDP增长的主要引擎 — — 其目的是为了满足国际民用和军用需求。
en: Most of these inflows were directed toward the construction and services sectors – the main drivers of GDP growth – and aimed to satisfy international demand, both civilian and military.

zh: 但是在2006—2007年，FDI水平开始下降，原因是安全局势迅速恶化、电力和基础设施持续不足、高技能劳动力短缺、法律和监管系统不完善、官僚流程效率低下、以及企业每年都需要更新执照。
en: But, in 2006-2007, FDI levels began to fall, owing to a sharply deteriorating security situation, a continued lack of electricity and adequate infrastructure, a shortage of skilled labor, inadequate legal and regulatory systems, inefficient bureaucratic procedures, and the need to renew companies’ licenses annually.

zh: 土地掠夺、顽固腐败、逍遥法外、无法强制实施合同以及援助的分散和低效进一步拖累了外国和国内投资，结果，2011—2012年，每年FDI占GDP之比下降至0.5 % 。
en: Land grabs, chronic corruption, impunity, the inability to enforce contracts, and the fragmentation and ineffectiveness of aid deterred foreign and domestic investment further. As a result, FDI collapsed to less than 0.5% of GDP annually in 2011-2012.

zh: 此外，在开发世界最大矿藏之二的过程中，投资者的贪婪战胜了对安全和商业气候的担忧。
en: Moreover, in the effort to develop two of the world’s largest mines, investors’ greed prevailed over their security and business-climate concerns.

zh: 2007年，中冶集团拿下了洛加尔省艾纳克（Aynak）铜矿的开采许可。
en: In 2007, the Metallurgical Corporation of China won the concession for the Aynak copper deposit in Logar Province.

zh: 2007年，印度国有和私人企业组团拿下了巴米扬省哈吉加克（Hajigak）铁矿。
en: In 2011, a group of Indian state and private companies won the concession for the Hajigak iron-ore deposit in Bamyan Province.

zh: 但是，尽管这些项目都报出了数十亿美元的价格、被寄予厚望，可投资并没有带来多少进步，部分原因还在于安全问题。
en: But, despite these projects’ reported billion-dollar price tags and high expectations, the investments have catalyzed little progress, owing partly to security issues.

zh: 更糟糕的是，居民流离失所、工人工资克扣和环境损害已经引起了本地社区的抵触情绪，未来可能还会进一步升高。
en: Worse, the mines’ displacement of residents, underpayment of workers, and environmental damage have generated resentment in local communities, which is likely to grow in the future.

zh: 毕竟，把矿产资源给外国人损害甚至完全抹杀了它们给本地人带来的好处。
en: After all, the granting of mineral resources to foreigners reduces – and could even eliminate – their benefits for local people.

zh: 由此看来，阿富汗经济就像是纸牌堆成的房子。
en: As it stands, Afghanistan’s economy is a house of cards.

zh: 援助水平堪与GDP相比，捐款覆盖了政府支出的约三分之二和所有经常项目赤字（占GDP的40 % ） 。
en: Aid levels are comparable to GDP, with donors covering roughly two-thirds of government expenditure and the entire current-account deficit, which amounts to 40% of GDP.

zh: 但援助正在减少，并且预计将在2014年后大幅减少。
en: But aid is falling and expected to drop sharply after 2014.

zh: 政府不应该继续追求碎片化的措施（如刚刚批准的这些 ） ， 而是需要实施综合性的定向战略，重新激活投资、就业和贸易。
en: Rather than continuing to pursue piecemeal measures like those that it has just approved, the government needs to implement an integrated and targeted strategy for the reactivation of investment, employment, and trade.

zh: 事实上，政策的重大转向已是避免经济崩溃的必要条件。
en: Indeed, a drastic shift in policy is essential to avoid economic collapse.

zh: 为了减少投资阿富汗的相关风险，政府必须建立有利于本地社区和外国投资者的制度。
en: In order to reduce the risks associated with investing in Afghanistan, the government must create a system that benefits local communities and foreign investors alike.

zh: 这可以通过基于两大不同但互惠的“复兴区 ” （ reconstruction zone）的战略实现：出口导向区（ERZ）和地方生产区（LRZ ） 。
en: This can be achieved with a strategy based on two distinct but mutually beneficial “reconstruction zones”: an export-oriented zone (ERZ) and a local-production zone (LRZ).

zh: 出口导向区只专注于生产出口品，它应该投资者提供税收激励、基本基础设施和服务、安全以及稳定的法律框架。
en: The ERZ, focused exclusively on producing goods for export, would provide tax incentives, basic infrastructure and services, security, and a stable legal framework to investors.

zh: 作为交换，投资者应该承诺培训本地员工、通过采购本地原料和服务创造就业、改善公司行为和本地供应商标准、协助技术转移，并建立与本地技术学校和大学的联系。
en: In exchange, investors would commit to train local workers, create employment by purchasing local inputs and services, improve corporate practices and local providers’ standards, facilitate technology transfers, and establish links with local technical schools and universities.

zh: 本地生产区应该通过农产品生产、提供高效服务和轻型制造业让本地人民改善生活。
en: The LRZ would enable local people to improve their livelihoods though the production of agricultural goods, the efficient delivery of services, and light manufacturing.

zh: 这一机制还应该为所有阿富汗人提供安全、社会服务、基础设施、信用和投入品（比如种子、肥料和农用机械）方面的平等待遇，从而增进性别平等。
en: Such a scheme would also help to bolster gender equality by providing a level playing field for all Afghans in terms of security, social services, infrastructure, credit, and inputs (such as seeds, fertilizers, and agricultural machinery).

zh: 此外，它还应该提高食物供给、减轻阿富汗过度的进口依赖。
en: Moreover, it would boost food supplies and reduce Afghanistan’s exorbitant dependence on imports.

zh: 完全专注于外国人和本地精英投资的阿富汗错失了微小企业在稳定GDP增长方面的潜力。
en: By focusing exclusively on foreigners and domestic elites for investment, Afghanistan is missing out on the vast potential of micro-entrepreneurs and small businesses to contribute to steady GDP growth.

zh: 实现姗姗来迟的和平与稳定离不开它们。
en: Achieving long-overdue peace and stability will be impossible without them.

zh: 令人感到为难的和平奖
en: An Inconvenient Peace Prize

zh: 今年的诺贝尔和平奖被公正地授予联合国政府间气候变化专家小组（IPCC）数以千计的科学家。
en: This year’s Nobel Peace Prize justly rewards the thousands of scientists of the United Nations Climate Change Panel (the IPCC).

zh: 这些科学家从事着艰苦卓绝的工作以确定气候变化将给世界造成的确切影响。
en: These scientists are engaged in excellent, painstaking work that establishes exactly what the world should expect from climate change.

zh: 另一位获奖者，美国前总统戈尔，花了许多时间来告诉我们应该担心的问题。
en: The other award winner, former US Vice President Al Gore, has spent much more time telling us what to fear.

zh: 联合国政府间气候变化专家小组的预计和结论是以认真的研究为基础的，而戈尔似乎并没有受到类似的限制。
en: While the IPCC’s estimates and conclusions are grounded in careful study, Gore doesn’t seem to be similarly restrained.

zh: 戈尔在他赢得奥斯卡奖的电影（这部电影最近被一位英国法官认定为是“片面”和包含“科学谬误”的）里告诉世界说在本世纪海平面将会上升20英尺。
en: Gore told the world in his Academy Award-winning movie (recently labeled “one-sided” and containing “scientific errors” by a British judge) to expect 20-foot sea-level rises over this century.

zh: 他显然没有注意到与他共同获得诺贝尔奖的联合国政府间气候变化专家小组的发现，他们得出结论本世纪海平面的上升幅度只会在半英尺到两英尺左右，而他们预计最后的幅度应该在一英尺左右。
en: He ignores the findings of his Nobel co-winners, the IPCC, who conclude that sea levels will rise between only a half-foot and two feet over this century, with their best expectation being about one foot.

zh: 这一幅度与世界在过去150年间所经历的上升幅度相近。
en: That’s similar to what the world experienced over the past 150 years.

zh: 同样地，戈尔为格陵兰岛冰层的加速融化以及它将给地球带来的后果而感到忧心忡忡，但是却忽略了联合国政府间气候变化专家小组得出的结论，即如果保持现在的融化速度，到本世纪末海平面只会因此而上升3英寸。
en: Likewise, Gore agonizes over the accelerated melting of ice in Greenland and what it means for the planet, but overlooks the IPCC’s conclusion that, if sustained, the current rate of melting would add just three inches to the sea level rise by the end of the century.

zh: 戈尔显然也没注意到研究显示格陵兰岛1941年的温度要比今天高。
en: Gore also takes no notice of research showing that Greenland’s temperatures were higher in 1941 than they are today.

zh: 戈尔还很担心北极熊未来的生存。
en: Gore also frets about the future of polar bears.

zh: 他声称它们因为在冰层上的栖息地的消失而淹死。
en: He claims they are drowning as their icy habitat disappears.

zh: 然而，对这种状况进行的唯一科学研究显示四头北极熊是因为一场暴风雪而淹死的。
en: However, the only scientific study showing any such thing indicates that four polar bears drowned because of a storm.

zh: 这个由政治家摇身一变为电影制作人的人因为有预计说因为天气炎热而死亡的人数将会增加而辗转反侧。
en: The politician-turned-movie maker loses sleep over a predicted rise in heat-related deaths.

zh: 这个故事的另一面说起来让人感到很为难：上升的温度将会减少寒冷天气的天数，而后者是一个比炎热大得多的杀手。
en: There’s another side of the story that’s inconvenient to mention: rising temperatures will reduce the number of cold spells, which are a much bigger killer than heat.

zh: 可靠的研究显示，到2050年，气候炎热将夺去40万人的生命，但是因为寒冷而死亡的人数将会减少180万人。
en: The best study shows that by 2050, heat will claim 400,000 more lives, but 1.8 million fewer will die because of cold.

zh: 事实上，根据对气候变化对世界所产生的经济影响的首次全面调查显示，全球变暖实际上将会 挽救 人们的生命。
en: Indeed, according to the first complete survey of the economic effects of climate change for the world, global warming will actually save lives.

zh: 联合国政府间气候变化专家小组宽宏大量地表示如果戈尔单独获得诺贝尔和平奖它将感到很高兴。
en: The IPCC has magnanimously declared that it would have been happy if Gore had received the Nobel Peace prize alone.

zh: 我很高兴他没有，而联合国政府间气候变化专家小组的工作得到了公正的认可。
en: I am glad that he did not, and that the IPCC’s work has rightfully been acknowledged.

zh: 戈尔帮助世界产生担忧。
en: Gore has helped the world to worry.

zh: 不幸的是，我们的注意力被从真正重要的事情上分散开了。
en: Unfortunately, our attention is diverted from where it matters.

zh: 气候变化并不是今天全球面临的唯一难题。
en: Climate change is not the only problem facing the globe.

zh: 我们目光短浅地只把注意力集中在这个问题上而对地球面临的其他挑战很少关注，将会因为戈尔获得诺贝尔和平奖所引发的关注而进一步加剧这种状况。
en: Our blinkered focus on it – to the detriment of other planetary challenges – will only be heightened by the attention generated by Gore’s Nobel Peace Prize.

zh: 戈尔强烈呼吁世界各国领导人减少二氧化碳的排放量，然而还有其他政策可以给这个星球做更多事情。
en: Gore concentrates above all else on his call for world leaders to cut CO2 emissions, yet there are other policies that would do much more for the planet.

zh: 在本世纪接下来的年份里，发展中国家将会越来越依赖于从发达国家进口食品。
en: Over the coming century, developing nations will be increasingly dependent on food imports from developed countries.

zh: 这主要并不是全球变暖所带来的结果，而是发展中国家人口更多、耕地却越来越少所带来的后果。
en: This is not primarily a result of global warming, but a consequence of more people and less arable land in the developing world.

zh: 挨饿人群的数目更多地是与人口和收入而不是气候相关。
en: The number of hungry people depends much less on climate than on demographics and income.

zh: 为了减少碳排放量而耗费巨资可能会带来更多营养不良的人群。
en: Extremely expensive cuts in carbon emissions could mean more malnourished people.

zh: 如果我们的目标是要对抗营养不良，那么给那些需要的人增加营养在挽救生命上比花几十亿美元减少碳排放量要有效5000倍。
en: If our goal is to fight malnutrition, policies like getting nutrients to those who need them are 5,000 times more effective at saving lives than spending billions of dollars cutting carbon emissions.

zh: 同样地，全球变暖可能略微增加疟疾的发病率，但是减少二氧化碳的排放量在对抗这��疾病上远没有蚊帐和药物那么有效，靠这些东西每年可以花很小的代价挽救85万人的生命。
en: Likewise, global warming will probably slightly increase malaria, but CO2 reductions will be far less effective at fighting this disease than mosquito nets and medication, which can cheaply save 850,000 lives every year.

zh: 与之相对比，京都议定书每年只能防止1400人死于疟疾。
en: By contrast, the expensive Kyoto Protocol will prevent just 1,400 deaths from malaria each year.

zh: 当我们在担心气候变化将会在遥远未来所带来的影响时，却对地球今天所面临的问题碌碌无为。
en: While we worry about the far-off effects of climate change, we do nothing to deal with issues facing the planet today. This year, malnutrition will kill almost four million people.

zh: 今年，大约会有400万人死于营养不良，300万人死于艾滋病，250万人死于室内和室外的空气污染，而缺乏微量营养素和干净的饮用水又将分别夺去250万人的生命。
en: Two and a half million people will die because of indoor and outdoor air pollution. A lack of micronutrients and clean drinking water will claim two million lives each.

zh: 鉴于注意力和金钱的投入都是有限的，我们首要应该做的是用最佳的方案解决问题，并且在整个世纪中尽量做最正确的事情。
en: With attention and money in scarce supply, what matters is that we first tackle the problems with the best solutions, doing the most good throughout the century.

zh: 如果我们把注意力集中在解决今天的问题，我们将使社会得到加强、经济更有活力并且基础设施更加发达。
en: If we focus on solving today’s problems, we will leave communities strengthened, economies more vibrant, and infrastructures more robust.

zh: 那将会使这些行业能够更好地应对未来的问题，包括全球变暖。
en: This will enable these societies to deal much better with future problems – including global warming.

zh: 致力于大规模减少碳排放量只会使我们的后代更加贫困，并且缺乏能力去适应挑战。
en: Committing to massive cuts in carbon emissions will leave future generations poorer and less able to adapt to challenges.

zh: 戈尔坚定不移地认为气候变化是世界所面临的最大挑战。
en: Gore has an unshakable faith that climate change is the biggest challenge facing the world.

zh: 公平地说，他应该为他的坚定信念而得到某种形式的肯定。
en: To be fair, he deserves some form of recognition for his resolute passion.

zh: 然而，没有比今年诺贝尔奖的获奖者之间的反差更强烈的了。
en: However, the contrast between this year’s Nobel winners could not be sharper.

zh: 联合国政府间气候变化专家小组坚信事实胜于一切，而从事着一丝不苟的研究。
en: The IPCC engages in meticulous research where facts rule over everything else.

zh: 而戈尔采取的是完全不同的方式。
en: Gore has a very different approach.

zh: 一次测试印巴外交的比赛
en: An India-Pakistan Diplomatic Test Match

zh: 发自拉合尔 — — 在2005年对伊斯兰堡的访问中，我遇见了时任巴基斯坦总统的穆沙拉夫并向他转述了我和印度总理辛格之间的一段对话。
en: LAHORE – In 2005, during a visit to Islamabad, I met Pakistani President Pervez Musharraf and told him of a conversation I had had with Prime Minister Manmohan Singh of India.

zh: 辛格这位与我相识多年的印度领导人在对话中提到，希望将更良好的印巴关系作为政治遗产传与后人
en: The Indian leader, whom I have known for years, had said that he wanted better relations with Pakistan as one his legacies.

zh: 穆沙拉夫对此的反应十分有趣。
en: Musharraf’s response was interesting.

zh: 他说他也有同样的意愿，但这需要双方共同努力才能更进一步。
en: He said he had the same aspiration, but that it would need effort from both sides to move things along.

zh: “我已经不下五六次邀请辛格访问巴基斯坦，也提出过要带他回到自己的出生地，位于伊斯兰堡南面数里外察瓜尔（Chakwal）的一个小村庄，但他却一再推辞。
en: “I have invited Manmohan a half-dozen times to visit Pakistan. I have also offered to take him to his village near Chakwal, a few miles south of Islamabad, where he was born.
But he continues to demur,” he told me.

zh: 我又把穆沙拉夫的回应转述给了辛格听，辛格对此的解释是在一个像印度这样的民主政体中，总理访问巴基斯坦必须与执政联盟成员以及高级官员反复磋商，而相反“穆沙拉夫是个军事领导人，他只需要收拾好行装便可过来印度了。
en: I repeated the conversation to Singh, who explained that in a democracy such as India, a great deal of work needs to be done with the members of the coalition and the senior bureaucracy before the prime minister can travel to Pakistan. “Musharraf is a military leader; he needs only to pack his bags and head this way.”

zh: 而穆沙拉夫也确实在几个月后踏上了访印行程。
en: Musharraf did head that way a few months later, when he forced an invitation out of Singh to watch a cricket match between the two sides in New Delhi in 2005.

zh: 当时他迫使辛格发出了一份邀请，请他出席观看2005年在新德里举行的一场印巴两国板球赛，印度政府花了相当长的时间才研究出如何回应穆沙拉夫的访印要求。
en: It took the Indian government some time to formulate an answer to Musharraf’s request for a visit.

zh: 而当这一回应最终公布时，则充盈着典型的辛格式热情。
en: When it came, it carried Singh’s characteristic warmth.

zh: 在对印度人民院（Lok Sabah，即议会下议院）一次演讲的末尾，辛格发出了他的正式邀请 ： “ 能秉承着与我国板球运动员在（南亚）次大陆运动场上一样的体育精神在议会这一庄严殿堂共商国是，是多么美好的一件事啊！
en: At the end of a speech in the Lok Sabah, the lower house of India’s parliament, Singh issued his formal invitation. “How nice it would be to conduct our affairs in this august House with the same spirit of sportsmanship that our cricketers exhibit on the playing fields of the sub-continent,” he said.

zh: ”他接着说 ： “ 我很高兴地告知各位尊敬的议员，我决定邀请巴基斯坦总统穆沙拉夫来印观看两国之间的板球赛事。
en: “I am happy to inform the honorable members of this House that I have decided to invite President Musharraf to come to India to watch the cricket match between our two teams.

zh: 我最诚挚的愿望莫过于邻邦的人民及其领导人能随心所欲地访问我们。
en: It is my earnest desire that the people in our neighborly countries and their leaders should feel free to visit each other whenever they wish to do so.

zh: 无论是观看一场板球赛事，还是购物，或是探亲访友 — — 印度为自身社会和经济的开放而感到自豪。
en: Be it to watch a cricket match; be it do some shopping; be it to meet friends and families – India is proud to be an open society, an open economy.

zh: 我衷心希望穆沙拉夫总统以及家人印度之行愉快。 ”
en: I do hope that President Musharraf and his family will enjoy their visit to our country.”

zh: 辛格的助手原本担心这番声明会引来嘘声，谁知现场却一片欢呼。
en: The prime minister’s statement was received with cheers, not the jeers that some of his aides had feared.

zh: 穆沙拉夫最终亲临德里的Ferozeshah Kotala板球场并见证了巴基斯坦队的胜利。
en: Musharraf went to Ferozeshah Kotala cricket ground in Delhi and saw his team win the match.

zh: 他和辛格还借比赛间隙就双边关系交换了意见，并同意启动“综合性对话”来讨论一直影响两国关系的8大争议性事务。
en: He and Singh also found time during the game to talk about bilateral relations, and agreed to launch what came to be called the “composite dialogue,” covering eight contentious issues that had soured ties for so long.

zh: 3年之后，一个以巴基斯坦为基地的恐怖分子团队在印度的金融中心孟买大开杀戒，扼杀了超过160条生命 — — 也扼杀了由此次板球比赛所开创的外交局面。
en: Three years later, a Pakistan-based terrorist group killed more than 160 people in Mumbai, India’s financial capital – and, with them, the diplomatic opening initiated by cricket.

zh: 但如今板球又再一次激活了南亚次大陆两大核武对手之间的对话。
en: Once again, however, cricket has revived dialogue between the sub-continent’s two nuclear-armed rivals.

zh: 不过这次则由辛格首先提出，邀请巴基斯坦总理吉拉尼访问新德里附近的莫哈里（Mohali）并观看两国之间在3月30日举行的板球世界杯半决赛，结果巴基斯坦仅以小比分败北。
en: This time, the initiative came from Singh, who invited his Pakistani counterpart, Prime Minister Yousuf Raza Gilani, to visit Mohali, near New Delhi, to watch the two countries play the semi-final in the Cricket World Cup. The match was played on March 30, with Pakistan losing narrowly.

zh: 然而在政治层面，两国却并未实现对等。
en: On the political side, however, the two countries were not evenly matched.

zh: 在目前统治巴基斯坦的三巨头（总统，总理以及总参谋长）中总理的权威是最小的。
en: Of the troika that currently governs Pakistan – the president, the prime minister, and the chief of staff of the army – it is the prime minister who carries the least amount of authority.

zh: 如今坐在辛格身边观看比赛的是吉拉尼，而最终决定双边关系如何走向的却并非外交礼仪，而是巴基斯坦国内的政治进程。
en: It was Gilani who sat next to Singh to watch the game; but, ultimately, process, rather than protocol, will determine how bilateral relations move forward.

zh: 赛后辛格提出“印度和巴基斯坦应当携手努力寻求合作方案，并需要实现永久性的和解以确保两国能有尊严地共存。
en: After the match, Singh said that “India and Pakistan should be working together to find cooperative solutions and need permanent reconciliation to live together in dignity and honor.

zh: 我们应当将过去的仇恨放在一边，合力应对两国所遭遇的难题。
en: We should put our ancient animosities behind us to attend to the problems our two nations face.”

zh: ”吉拉尼也表达了同样的观点 ： “ 我们需要将精力集中在应对共同的敌人 — — 通胀、贫穷、饥饿，疾病和失业 — — 并以此实现两国的繁荣。 ”
en: Gilani expressed the same sentiment: “We need to focus on dealing with our common enemies – inflation, poverty, hunger, disease, and unemployment – for the prosperity of the two countries.”

zh: 如今已经出现了一些双边关系逐渐解冻的迹象。
en: There have been indications of a gradual thaw.

zh: 两国商务，国防和外交等部门的高级官员将在外交部长会谈的两个月后举行会面。
en: Senior officials from the ministries of commerce, defense, and foreign affairs will meet in the next two months followed by a meeting of the foreign ministers.

zh: 吉拉尼也邀请辛格访问巴基斯坦，而印度外交部秘书拉奥琦女士则回应将“认���考虑这一邀请”并提出了一个新的会谈氛围 ： “ 今天，弥漫在两国关系四周的是莫哈里的精神。
en: Gilani invited Singh to visit Pakistan, an invitation that “will be considered carefully,” according to Indian Foreign Secretary Nirupama Rao. And she spoke of a new environment: “Today, it is the Mohali spirit that pervades our relationship.

zh: 而这是一个由今日这场会面所创造出来的非常积极而且鼓舞人心的精神。 ”
en: This was an extremely positive and encouraging spirit that has been generated as a result of today’s meetings.”

zh: 我们曾经也走到过这一步，最后却眼睁睁地看着改善印巴关系的前景毁于一旦。
en: We have been here before, of course, only to see prospects for improved India-Pakistan relations snuffed out.

zh: 没人能保证这次能与上次不同，但对印巴两国来说，希望永远不灭。
en: There are no guarantees that this time will be different. But, for both countries, hope dies last.

zh: 不平衡的重负
en: An Inequality Tax

zh: 中国和印度的经济繁荣有助于减轻全球的不平衡。
en: The economic booms in China and India have helped to reduce global inequality.

zh: 在过去的二十年里，印度人和中国人缩小了他们与富裕国家的差距（相对而言 ） 。
en: Over the two last decades, masses of Indians and Chinese have closed the gap (in relative terms) with the rich world.

zh: 但同时，许多世界上真正贫穷的国家变得更为落后（特别是在发展常常被形容为灾难的非洲 ） ， 并且大多数国家内部的不平衡变得更为严重。
en: But, at the same time, many of the world’s truly poor countries have fallen further behind (particularly in Africa, where developments are often described as catastrophic), and inequality within most countries has risen.

zh: 日益扩大的不平衡在美国（自里根政府时期开始 ） 、 英国（自撒切尔政府时期开始）都有记录，它还出现在俄罗斯的私有化进程中，最近更是表现在中国和印度。
en: Widening inequality has been recorded in the United States (starting with Ronald Reagan’s administration), the United Kingdom (starting with Margaret Thatcher), Russia during its privatization, and more recently in China and India.

zh: 这些情况似乎加剧了全球的不平衡。
en: These developments seem to add to global inequality.

zh: 因此，从总体上讲，全球的不平衡状况在过去的20年里似乎保持了相对的稳定。
en: So, on balance, it seems that global inequality has been relatively stable during the last two decades.

zh: 我们应该对此采取相应的举措吗？
en: Should anything be done about this?

zh: 许多人认为采取全球性的行动应对经济不平衡是没有必要的。
en: Many think that no global action to fight economic inequality is necessary.

zh: 他们认为只有扶贫才是正道。
en: They argue that only poverty reduction matters.

zh: 按国际货币基金组织（IMF）副总裁Anne Krueger的话来说 ， “ 穷人们正迫不及待地要改善物质条件 … … 而不是在收入分配的层级上大步向前。 ”
en: In the words of Anne Krueger, the Deputy Managing Director of the IMF, “Poor people are desperate to improve their material conditions…rather than to march up the income distribution [ladder].”

zh: 因此，就算是美国和非洲人均收入的差距仍在扩大，又有什么可担心的呢？
en: Thus, even if the absolute income gap between an average American and an average African increases, why worry?

zh: 毕竟，持这种观点的人会说，普通非洲人的贫困状况有所改善。
en: After all, such people argue, the average African would be a bit less poor.

zh: 但这种观点假定我们与他人比较的相对收入无关紧要。
en: But this assumes that our income relative to the income of others does not matter.

zh: 相反，心理学研究无一例外地表明人们并不只是看重他们的绝对收入，也看重他们在社会金字塔上的位置以及这一位置是否公平。
en: On the contrary, psychological studies invariably show that people care not only about their absolute income, but also about where they stand in the social pyramid and whether their position is fair.

zh: 过去，一个贫穷的非洲人可能会以憎恶的眼光来看待其同胞的财富；现在，他和比他富有的同胞都以憎恶的眼光来看待他们和富裕世界之间的收入差距。
en: In the past, a poor African might have looked at his compatriots and resented their wealth; now, both he and his better-off compatriots look at the rich world and resent the huge income gaps they see.

zh: 在不同国籍的人一起工作的情况下，正如在许多跨国公司里，这样的差距表现得更为明显。
en: The gaps are most obvious where people from different countries work together, as in many multinational companies.

zh: 一位“外籍员工”的薪水可能是从事同样工作的本地员工的10倍。
en: An “expatriate” may be paid ten times more than local staff for the same job.

zh: 仅仅以国籍为基准的工资津贴令人反感。
en: A wage premium based solely on citizenship is grating.

zh: 但就算人们不共事，将世界带入每个人的起居室（或茅舍）的全球化，也使他们能够将自己的生活水平进行更为广泛的比较。
en: But even when people do not work together, globalization, by bringing the world to everyone’s living room (or hut), enables them to make much wider comparisons of their living standards.

zh: 这样一来就捅破了富裕世界籍以藏身的那只相对安全的茧。
en: It erodes the relative security in which the rich world could shelter itself, as in a cocoon.

zh: 现在，这些收入差距昭然若揭。
en: Now, all can see these income differences.

zh: 这就是为什么需要采取国际性的行动同时应对全球贫穷和全球不平衡的原因。
en: This is why international action to address both global poverty and global inequality is needed.

zh: 由一个国际机构通过税收来实行全球性再分配的理念今天看起来似乎是天方夜谭。 但我们所见证的发展逻辑—特别是民族国家作为主权载体的式微—意味着这一理想可能最终成为现实。
en: Global redistribution through taxes that would be levied by an international body may seem far-fetched today, but the logic of development that we are witnessing – particularly the move away from nation-states as the locus of sovereignty – suggests that it may eventually come to pass.

zh: 我们在1990年代早期错过了一个这样的机会。
en: One such opportunity was missed in the early 1990’s.

zh: 当俄罗斯遭遇其最严重的危机时，经济援助却被给予了腐败的叶利钦政权。
en: When Russia faced its worst crisis, aid was given to the corrupt Yeltsin regime.

zh: 但它本应该以现金的形式直接支付给最需要帮助的俄罗斯人：由于通货膨胀和经济紧缩而收入锐减的退休金一族。
en: But it should have been disbursed directly in cash to the most needy Russians: pensioners whose earnings plummeted due to inflation and economic contraction.

zh: 一个国际组织本可以通过俄罗斯国家现成的基础设施将现金补助分配给2000万左右靠退休金生活的人—比起交给俄罗斯政府处置，这笔钱本应该被更有的放矢地使用。
en: An international organization could have simply used the existing infrastructure of the Russian state to distribute cash grants to some 20 million pensioners – money that would have been much better targeted and spent than by giving the same amount to the government.

zh: 如果当时这样做了，俄罗斯人本可以将从国际社会获得现金援助的经历珍藏在记忆之中，而不是责怪后者将资金转给了腐败的领导人。
en: If this had been done, Russians would have fondly remembered receiving cash aid from the international community rather than blaming it for transferring funds to corrupt leaders.

zh: 然而，同样或类似的举措本可以在从安哥拉到津巴布韦的许多国家施行。
en: But the same or a similar approach could be taken in many countries today, from Angola to Zimbabwe.

zh: 这种举措是简单而有力的。
en: The approach is simple and powerful.

zh: 它包括三个步骤：从全球的富人那里募集资金，不要和政府打交道，并直接以现金的形式将资金分配给穷人。
en: It involves three steps: raise money from the globally rich, do not deal with governments, and transfers funds in cash to the poor.

zh: 那些鼓吹仅在私有领域实行全球化的人可能会憎恶将征税的权力赋予一个全球性机构的理念。
en: Those who advocate leaving globalization exclusively in the hands of the private sector may resent the idea of vesting tax-raising authority in a global agency.

zh: 但他们不可能没有注意到自己所支持的进程也损害了他们自身的利益—令财富的差距更为明显，并使实际的全球（财富）分配的公平性更值得怀疑。
en: But they cannot fail to notice that the processes they support undercut their own position by rendering the wealth gap more obvious and the fairness of the actual global distribution more questionable.

zh: 他们最终会意识到自身的利益在于支持某种形式的应对全球贫困和不平衡的行动。
en: They will ultimately realize that their self-interest lies in supporting some form of global action to deal with both poverty and inequality.

zh: 检讨通货膨胀
en: An Inflation Reality Check

zh: 剑桥 - - 随着世界各地的通货膨胀攀升，或许各国的中央银行行长们需要当头棒喝才会从自满中清醒过来。
en: CAMBRIDGE – As inflation continues to soar everywhere, maybe the world’s central bankers need a jolt to awaken them from complacency.

zh: 是不是可以把他们每两个月一度的会议放在超级通货膨胀的津巴布韦举办？
en: How about holding one of their bi-monthly meetings in hyperinflationary Zimbabwe?

zh: 这可能不大舒服，但是却有教育意义。
en: It might not be comfortable, but it would be educational.

zh: 根据津巴布韦官方统计机构的数据，2007年该国的通货膨胀高达66000 % ， 更有点像是魏玛时期的德国，而不是当今的非洲。
en: According to Zimbabwe’s official statistical agency, inflation topped 66,000% in 2007, which looks more like Weimar Germany than modern-day Africa.

zh: 尽管没有人确切知道政府如何估计价格，但是鉴于商店里空空如也，大多数指标表明津巴布韦确实很有可能打破通货膨胀的世界纪录。
en: While no one is quite certain how the government managed to estimate prices, given that there is virtually nothing for sale in the shops, most indicators suggest that Zimbabwe does have a good shot at breaking world records for inflation.

zh: 当然，尽管各国行长们有点好奇，但是他们还是可以认为在津巴布韦哈拉雷举行会议有可能过于不便而且在政治上让人难受。
en: Of course, curious as they might be, central bankers could decide that meeting in Harare would be too inconvenient and politically unpalatable.

zh: 所幸的是，还有其他许多不错、尽管不是那么引人注目的通货膨胀地点。
en: Fortunately, there are lots of other nice – albeit less spectacular – inflation destinations.

zh: 仅仅举几个可能的地点，俄国、越南、阿根廷以及委内瑞拉的通货膨胀都是两位数。
en: Inflation in Russia, Vietnam, Argentina, and Venezuela is solidly in double digits, to name just a few possibilities.

zh: 确实，除了受到通货紧缩困扰的日本以外，各国的行长们几乎可以随便在哪里开会都可以发现通货膨胀上升高昂。
en: Indeed, except for deflation-ridden Japan, central bankers could meet just about anywhere and see high and rising inflation.

zh: 中国当局对于该国7%的通货膨胀极为担忧，乃至于效仿印度控制食品价格。
en: Chinese authorities are so worried by their country’s 7% inflation they are copying India and imposing price controls on food.

zh: 即使美国去年的通货膨胀达到4 % ， 美联储不知怎地相信大多数人不会注意。
en: Even the United States had inflation at 4% last year, though the Federal Reserve is somehow convinced that most people won’t notice.

zh: 许多行长和经济学家认为当今全球通货膨胀上升只不过是暂时偏离，食品、燃料以及其他商品价格猛升促发了这一现象。
en: Many central bankers and economists argue that today’s rising global inflation is just a temporary aberration, driven by soaring prices for food, fuel, and other commodities.

zh: 的确，许多主要商品的价格从年初以来已经上升了25%到50 % 。
en: True, prices for many key commodities are up 25% to 50% since the start of the year.

zh: 但是如果行长们认为今天的通货膨胀只不过是短期资源馈乏而不是松弛的货币政策的结果，那么他们就错了。
en: But if central bankers think that today’s inflation is simply the product of short-term resource scarcities as opposed to lax monetary policy, they are mistaken.

zh: 事实是在全球大多数地区，通货膨胀并且最终是通货膨胀预期将会继续上升，除非各国中央银行开始紧缩其货币政策。
en: The fact is that around most of the world, inflation – and eventually inflation expectations – will keep climbing unless central banks start tightening their monetary policies.

zh: 美国现在是全球通货膨胀的中心地点。
en: The US is now ground zero for global inflation.

zh: 美联储面临着房价崩盘以及信贷市场内爆的双重压力，一直大幅度降息以试图避免经济衰退。
en: Faced with a vicious combination of collapsing housing prices and imploding credit markets, the Fed has been aggressively cutting interest rates to try to stave off a recession.

zh: 但是即使如果美联储并不在其预计中承认，这一“保险单”的代价几乎肯定是将来几年中会有更高的通货膨胀。
en: But even if the Fed does not admit it in its forecasts, the price of this “insurance policy” will almost certainly be higher inflation down the road, and perhaps for several years.

zh: 如果不是如此多、从中东到亚洲的其他国家实际上将它们的货币与美元挂钩，美国的通货膨胀或许会得以控制。
en: America’s inflation would be contained but for the fact that so many countries, from the Middle East to Asia, effectively tie their currencies to the dollar.

zh: 其他国家，例如俄国和阿根廷并不实际将其货币与美元联系，但是试图让货币波动平缓。
en: Others, such as Russia and Argentina, do not literally peg to the dollar but nevertheless try to smooth movements.

zh: 结果，无论何时美联储降息都让整个“美元区”国家紧随，要不然它们的货币由于投资者寻求高回报而升值。
en: As a result, whenever the Fed cuts interest rates, it puts pressure on the whole “dollar bloc” to follow suit, lest their currencies appreciate as investors seek higher yields.

zh: 美国松弛的货币政策因此就大幅度确定了全球经济通货膨胀的速度，可能达到60 % 。
en: Looser US monetary policy has thus set the tempo for inflation in a significant chunk – perhaps as much as 60% – of the global economy.

zh: 但是，中东和亚洲的大多数国家经济要比美国的更为健康，而大多数新兴市场经济国家的通货膨胀已经大幅度上升，激进的货币刺激是它们最不需要的东西。
en: But, with most economies in the Middle East and Asia in much stronger shape than the US and inflation already climbing sharply in most emerging-market countries, aggressive monetary stimulus is the last thing they need right now.

zh: 欧洲央行目前保持稳定，但是连它也可能压制提升利率，部分原因是担心已经处于创纪录水平的欧元继续升得更高。
en: The European Central Bank is staying calm for the moment, but it, too, is probably holding back on interest-rate hikes partly out of fear of driving the euro, already at record levels, even higher.

zh: 而且欧洲央行担心，如果美国的衰退波及他国，它或许不得不转变政策，开始降息。
en: And the ECB worries that if the US recession proves contagious, it may have to turn around and start slashing rates anyway.

zh: 那么接下来会发生什么事情呢？
en: So what happens next?

zh: 如果美国的衰退从微弱变成深度，那么全球通货紧缩的影响就会抵销世界面临的某些通货膨胀压力。
en: If the US tips from mild recession into deep recession, the global deflationary implications will cancel out some of the inflationary pressures the world is facing.

zh: 全球商品价格将会崩盘，而许多商品和服务价格将会随着失业率和剩余生产能力的增长而停止如此快速上升。
en: Global commodity prices will collapse, and prices for many goods and services will stop rising so quickly as unemployment and excess capacity grow.

zh: 当然，美国经济衰退将同时会带来进一步的美联储降息。 这将会在后来加剧问题。
en: Of course, a US recession will also bring further Fed interest-rate cuts, which will exacerbate problems later.

zh: 但是如果美国的衰退持续微弱而全球增长保持强劲，那么通货膨胀的压力甚至将会恶化。
en: But inflation pressures will be even worse if the US recession remains mild and global growth remains solid.

zh: 在这一情况下，通货膨胀如果不是达到全世界七十年代的水平，也将会轻而易举地达到八十年代的水平。
en: In that case, inflation could easily rise to 1980’s (if not quite 1970’s) levels throughout much of the world.

zh: 直到目前，大多数投资者认为他们宁可冒着几年通货膨胀的风险也不接受短暂而轻微的衰退。
en: Until now, most investors have thought that they would rather risk high inflation for a couple of years than accept even a short and shallow recession.

zh: 但是他们还轻易地忘记了高通货膨胀的代价以及把通货膨胀挤出经济体系之外的困难。
en: But they too easily forget the costs of high inflation, and how difficult it is to squeeze it out of the system.

zh: 或许他们也应当在津巴布韦举行一次会议来自己检讨一下。
en: Maybe they, too, should try holding a few conferences in Zimbabwe, and get a reality check of their own.

zh: 一场反恐怖主义的情报战
en: An Intelligent War on Terror

zh: 恐怖主义是一个现实存在的威胁。
en: Terrorism is an existential threat.

zh: 在我们的"欧洲安全战略"中，恐怖主义被视为欧盟面临的重要战略性威胁之一。 为了抗击恐怖主义，我们正在使用所有能用的方法，特别是在情报邻域。
en: In our European Security Strategy, it was deemed one of the key strategic threats facing the European Union, and to fight it we are using all instruments at our disposal, particularly in the intelligence area.

zh: 情报的首要目标是要找到恐怖分子，阻止他们行动，在他们实施袭击后追踪。
en: The first objective of intelligence is to find terrorists, prevent them from acting, and track them after they do attack.

zh: 这是军事行动上的情报，最好在国家层面上完成。
en: This is the kind of operational intelligence that is best done at the national level.

zh: 欧洲逮捕的许多恐怖分子以及多次挫败恐怖主义行动就是欧盟成员国情报部门合作的结果。
en: Many arrests and disruptions of terrorist operations in Europe result from cooperation between EU members' intelligence services.

zh: 最近有记者问我，机构之间的合作是否足够，欧洲是否应该建立共享军事行动情报的机制。
en: I was recently asked by journalists whether inter-agency cooperation is sufficient and whether European mechanisms for sharing operational intelligence should be created.

zh: 结果当天就有五个欧洲国家在一次联合行动中同时逮捕了多名恐怖分子。
en: Later that very day, a joint operation resulted in simultaneous arrests in five European countries.

zh: 这次行动的成功不是偶然。
en: The operation's success was no accident.

zh: 去年，欧盟签署了两项欧洲刑警组织协议，以及一项引渡与司法互助协议。
en: Last year, the Union concluded two Europol agreements, as well as an Extradition and Mutual Legal Assistance Agreement.

zh: 欧洲的安全服务部门在反恐怖主义组织中紧密合作，欧洲刑警组织的反恐怖主义特别小组也已重新建立起来。
en: Europe's security services are working closely together within the Counter-Terrorist Group, and Europol's Counter-Terrorist Task Force has been re-established.

zh: 一个高层的边境与交通安全组织正在工作，成员国警察局长间的联系也正在加强。
en: A high-level group on border and transport security is at work, and links between member states' police chiefs are strengthening.

zh: 但是，大范围的共享并不总是必要或适当的。
en: But widespread sharing is not always needed or appropriate.

zh: 成员国还需要从正在进行的案件工作中得到的情报，不用给政策的制定提供信息，至少不用直接提供，但是要破坏和解除恐怖主义网络，防止恐怖主义袭击。
en: Member states also need intelligence derived from ongoing casework, not to inform policy, at least not directly, but to disrupt and dismantle networks and prevent attacks.

zh: 这些情报在许多方面都更加敏感，各部门应在"了解"的基础上共享，而不是为了促进合作。
en: This information is in many ways more sensitive, and services share it on a "need to know" basis, not for the sake of promoting cooperation.

zh: 我还发现情报的另一个作用：为政治行动提供信息。
en: I see another role for intelligence: to inform political action.

zh: 情报服务部门可以教育公众，说明恐怖主义下的异化产生的根源，以及激进手段和招募新人的情况，强调恐怖分子的目的、方法和寻找靶子的策略。
en: Intelligence services can educate the public, explaining the origins of the alienation that underpins terrorism, how radicalization and recruitment occur, and highlight terrorists' goals, methods, and targeting strategies.

zh: 我们只有了解了这些才能制定出恰当的、具体的政策。
en: Only when we understand this can we develop appropriate and concrete policies.

zh: 为此，我们需要对情报进行良好的战略评估。
en: For this we need good strategic assessments of intelligence.

zh: 欧盟的成员国国内都有这方面的机制，通过他们的支持和投入，我们正在建设一个全欧洲范围的机制，把这些情报呈现给欧盟的政策制定者们。
en: The EU's members have structures to provide this, and with their support and input we are building structures at a Europe-wide level, to bring this information to EU policymakers.

zh: 欧盟刑警组织掌握着从警察工作中得来的材料，而我们就要努力确保这两方面的努力得以协调。
en: Europol is performing a similar function with material derived from police work, and we are working to ensure synergy between these two efforts.

zh: 这是不同层次的情报，更加具有分析性，同时密切的合作会带来更多有价值的东西。
en: This is a different level of intelligence, more analytical, where close collaboration adds significant value.

zh: 马德里爆炸事件之后，欧盟集中精力抗击国内的恐怖主义。
en: In the aftermath of the Madrid bombings, the EU focused on internal aspects of the fight against terrorism.

zh: 但这并不表示欧盟变得只扫自家门前雪。
en: But this does not mean that the Union has become introverted.

zh: 相反，欧盟认为国际合作是抗击恐怖主义的基础。
en: On the contrary, the EU regards international cooperation as fundamental in the fight against terrorism.

zh: 总的来说，反恐怖主义在我们国际事务中的当务之急，而且日渐融入到欧盟与其他国家的政治对话中。
en: Generally, counter-terrorism is very high on our international agenda and is becoming better integrated into the Union's political dialogue with other countries.

zh: 我们正在把国外援助和职能建设计划用在更加适当的地方，并准备好在必要的时候运用我们的贸易和经济力量，在双边协议中要求制定反恐怖主义条款。
en: We are better targeting our external assistance and capacity building programs, and we are ready to use our trade and economic muscle, when necessary, by demanding counter-terrorism clauses in bilateral treaties.

zh: 欧盟和美国之间的跨大西洋合作也发生了巨变。
en: There has also been a sea change in transatlantic cooperation between the EU and the US.

zh: 事实胜于雄辩，而欧美之间在这方面发生了迅速和有决定性的事件 - - 例如旨在断绝恐怖分子资金来源的联合努力 - - 尽管我们在伊拉克事件上存在巨大的分歧。
en: Deeds speak louder than words, and deeds on the transatlantic level have been swift and decisive - for example, joint efforts aimed at choking off terrorist financing - even when we had strong divergences over Iraq.

zh: 然而，我仍不自满。
en: Still, I am not complacent.

zh: 为了促进欧盟制定反恐怖主义政策这项极端复杂的任务，我们现在有了一份行动纲领，已得到欧盟理事会的批准，其中清楚地规定了各自的职责，以及时限。
en: To facilitate the extremely complex task of counter-terrorism policymaking in the EU, we now have a Plan of Action, approved by the European Council, which clearly specifies who does what, and by when.

zh: 这份纲领还将帮助各国的国会理解欧盟的目标，促进他们计划立法的步伐。
en: This will also help national parliaments understand EU objectives and facilitate their legislative planning.

zh: 我最近任命了一名反恐怖主义协调员帮助我监督这项行动纲领的实施。
en: I have recently appointed a counter-terrorism coordinator to assist me in following through on the Plan of Action.

zh: 在司法和内务方面，我们还有大量新的办法。
en: We also have a considerable number of new instruments in the area of justice and home affairs.

zh: 欧洲逮捕委任状已经产生了具体的结果，我们从而越来越接近欧盟内部"司法决定的自由流动 " ， 通过这种方式，司法决定 - - 如嫌犯的逮捕和引渡、��产的没收和冻结 - - 将得到相互承认。
en: The European Arrest Warrant is already producing concrete results, and we are moving towards the "free movement of judicial decisions" in the EU, through which judicial decisions - such as arrest and surrender of suspects, confiscation, and freezing of assets - will be mutually recognized.

zh: 另外，欧洲边境局将于2005年开始工作。
en: Furthermore, the European Border Agency will become operational in 2005.

zh: 应欧洲理事会的要求，我正在与欧盟执行委员会合作制定断绝恐怖分子财源的战略。
en: As requested by the European Council, I am developing, in cooperation with the European Commission, a strategy to shut down terrorist financing.

zh: 这个领域是对合作的真正考验，因为我们的成功将取决于能否在相关部门和金融、银行界之间取得适当的互动和情报流动。
en: This is where the real test of cooperation lies, for our success will rely on securing the appropriate interaction and flow of intelligence between the relevant services and the financial and banking communities.

zh: 我坚信，单靠军事行动不能击败恐怖主义。
en: I firmly believe that the military option alone cannot defeat terror.

zh: 司法、警方、情报部门之间的合作应该是行动的焦点。
en: Judicial, police, and intelligence cooperation should be the focal point for action.

zh: 这不是说我们不管欧洲安全与防务政策（ESDP）能否做出有意义的贡献，而是说ESDP不是我们努力的核心。
en: This does not mean that we are not working on how European Security and Defense Policy (ESDP) can offer a meaningful contribution. But ESDP is not at the core of our efforts.

zh: 除了安全和情报方面的努力外，我们还必须努力断绝恐怖分子的"氧气 " ， 也就是说要处理给恐怖主义集团提供支持和新人的因素。
en: Aside from security and intelligence efforts, we must also work to deny "oxygen" to the terrorists. This means addressing the factors that contribute to support for and recruitment by terrorist groups.

zh: 地区的冲突会导致愤怒和排斥情绪。
en: Regional conflicts cause anger and resentment.

zh: 阿拉伯和以色列的问题悬而不决也会引起激进主义和极端主义的抬头。
en: The unresolved Arab-Israeli problem leads to the rise of radicalism and extremism.

zh: 对于恐怖主义宣传来说，燃料太多了。
en: There is entirely too much fuel for terrorist propaganda.

zh: 欧盟将坚定地打击恐怖主义，但是也必须坚定地遏制恐怖主义的源头。
en: The EU will be tough on terrorism. But it must also be tough on the causes of terrorism.

zh: 这不是两场战争，而是一场。
en: These are not two fights, but one.

zh: 阿根廷的主权债券困局
en: Argentina’s Sovereign Bondage

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 主权债务最近又占据了新闻头条，而这次是因为美国最高法院关于阿根廷债务问题的一项判决。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Sovereign debt has been back in the news recently, this time because of a United States Supreme Court ruling concerning Argentine debt.

zh: 在此判决之后，这件本已凌乱的事件将变得更为复杂。
en: As a result of the ruling, a complicated issue is likely to become even more so.

zh: 在几个世纪以来，主权债务一直是国际金融体系统的重要特征。
en: Sovereign debt has been a major feature of the international financial system for centuries.

zh: 国王们经常向别国借债以支付战争以其他各项支出。
en: Kings borrowed, often internationally, to finance wars and other expenditures.

zh: 但有时候当他们无法还债的时候，就会出现主权违约。
en: When they couldn’t pay, as sometimes happened, sovereigns defaulted.

zh: 如今，主权国家往往都由民选政府执掌，但它们依然会去借债。
en: Today, sovereigns are more often democratically elected governments, but they still borrow.

zh: 同时也不时发现自己处于无力继续用新债补旧债的状况之下，只得向外界求援以继续承担自身的偿付责任。
en: And they still occasionally find themselves in situations in which their debt has become unsustainable and they need outside help to continue to meet their debt-service obligations.

zh: 当私人企业（或者地区政府）无力偿债之时，一般都会进入法律破产程序去决定如此行动。
en: When private firms (or subnational governments) become insolvent, there are normally legal bankruptcy procedures to determine what to do.

zh: 没有了这些程序，市场经济就无法运作。
en: Without such procedures, a market economy would be unable to function.

zh: 在某种程度上，这是因为债权人会在问题稍露端倪时就转而停止继续信贷并要求偿还。
en: In part, this is because creditors would otherwise stop extending credit and demand repayment at the first sign of trouble.

zh: 这是因为第一个要求偿还的债权人往往能收回全款，而其他人只能部分收回 — — 这也因此产生了一向激励因素，令所有债权人都一窝蜂地要求还债，即便借债人还没失去偿还能力。
en: This is because the first creditors to be paid would receive the full amount owed to them, leaving less for later creditors – and thus creating an incentive for all creditors to rush for the exits even before debt servicing had become impossible.

zh: 此外，在许多情况下，如果能够继续经营下去，受影响实体的资产价值将比分割出售后更高。
en: Moreover, in many cases, the value of the troubled entity’s assets as a going concern is greater than it would be if the assets were sold separately.

zh: 在这类情况下，最符合全体债权人利益的是减少债务而非整体崩盘。
en: In such cases, all creditors would be better off with a debt write-down than with dissolution.

zh: 因此破产法通过防止出现导致所有人受到非必要损害的方式来防止各债权人互相迫害。
en: Bankruptcy law thus protects creditors from each other by preventing an outcome that would needlessly harm all of them.

zh: 但在主权债务问题上，并不存在可以批准破产的约束性国际法律。
en: In the case of sovereign debt, however, there is no binding international law that permits bankruptcy.

zh: 虽然某些常规做法随着国际资本市场的成长而出现，但依然是临时性的。
en: Though some routine practices have emerged as international capital markets have grown, they remain ad hoc.

zh: 考虑到包含于其中的不确定性，以及主权借债人可以通过印钞来偿还用本国货币发行的债务，债权人一般都会要求那些不在法律下发行且不以发达国家（通常为美国或英国）货币发行的债券支付特别高的利息。
en: Given the uncertainty involved, and that sovereign debtors can repay domestic-currency debt simply by printing money, creditors have typically demanded significantly higher interest rates if bonds are not issued under the law and in the currency of an advanced country – often the United States or the United Kingdom.

zh: 当一个主权国家认定自身的外债已经无法维持，政府和其债权人都必须坐下来商讨应该任何行事。
en: When a sovereign decides that its foreign debt is unsustainable, the government and its creditors have had to negotiate among themselves about what to do.

zh: 对于那些由其他主权国家持有的主权债务，由债权国组建的巴黎俱乐部已经制定出相关程序去处理这类债务。
en: For sovereign bonds held by other sovereigns, the Paris Club of creditor countries has developed procedures for handling the debt.

zh: 而针对私人债权人所持有主权债务，如何将这些债权人组织起来就引发了一环接一环的挑战。
