en: But when private creditors hold sovereign debt, organizing them creates a new challenge with each episode.

zh: 当债务无法偿还时，就存在好几种可能的谈判结果。
en: When debt is unsustainable, there are several possible negotiating outcomes.

zh: 有时会重新规定偿还日期，或许还能延长到更长的年限，因此也能让债务国重新获得偿还能力。
en: Sometimes, debt-service payments are rescheduled and perhaps stretched out over a longer period, thus giving the debtor country time to regain its ability to pay.

zh: 有时债务国会同意用票面价值或者利率较低的新债来交换旧债。
en: Sometimes, creditors agree to exchange the old bonds for new ones, which have either a lower face value or lower interest payments.

zh: 很少政府会完全拒绝以任何形式来偿还借款。
en: Few governments refuse to pay at all in any form.

zh: 阿根廷在2001年发生过债务违约。
en: Argentina defaulted on its debt in 2001.

zh: 在艰难维持了数年之后，该国得以谈妥用票面价值相当低的债权来置换无法偿付的债券。
en: After several difficult years, the country managed to negotiate an exchange of outstanding bonds for bonds with a considerably lower face value. About 93% of creditors accepted the exchange and received new bonds with a face value that was about one-quarter of that of the old bonds.

zh: 在2005年后，阿根廷开始对新债券进行偿付。
en: After 2005, Argentina maintained debt service on the new bonds.

zh: 但一些债权人不接受这种做法，并在纽约法庭控告阿根廷（因为这些债权都是依照纽约法律发行的 ） 。
en: But some creditors held out, and sued Argentina in New York (as the bonds were issued under New York law).

zh: 阿根廷债券（和其他大部分债券一样）都拥有一项所谓平等对待条款，承诺政府将平等对待所有债券持有人。
en: Argentine bonds (like most others) had a so-called pari passu clause that committed the government to treat all bondholders alike.

zh: 反对者的诉求是，如果新债券都能（像曾经那样）得到全额偿付，同等的待遇也意味着反对者应该收回所有欠款（不仅包括利息，还有本金 ） 。
en: The holdouts claimed that, if the new bonds were being serviced in full (as they were), equal treatment required that the holdouts should receive the full amount owed to them (including not only interest but also principal).

zh: 美国第二巡回上诉法院判决阿根廷必须以与同意置换者同样的比例（也就是100%全额）承担对反对者的偿还责任。
en: The US Second Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that Argentina was bound to honor its obligations to the holdout bondholders in the same proportion (namely 100%) as the holders of the exchange bonds.

zh: 美国最高法院最近也维持这一判决。
en: It was that ruling that the Supreme Court recently upheld.

zh: 在法院判决之下，阿根廷只能在偿付了反对者的同时才能向新债券的持有者进行偿付，同时也没有美国金融机构能作为为阿根廷进行支付的中间人。
en: Under the court order, Argentina may not pay the holders of the new bonds unless it also pays the holdouts, and no US financial institution can serve as an intermediary to make payments for Argentina.

zh: 因此阿根廷要么全额偿还反对者，要么就只能宣布新债券违约。
en: As a result, Argentina must either pay the holdouts in full or default on the new bonds.

zh: 无论当前的困境最终如何解决，该判决都为主权债券的发行者和持有者提出了许多问题。
en: Regardless of how the current impasse is resolved, the ruling raises many questions for issuers and holders of sovereign debt.

zh: 如果持有者如今认定反对置换能令自己更可能在延长时间的情况下全额收回债务，那么就更加难以对主权债务进行重组并令债务国经济重回正轨。
en: If creditors now believe that holding out makes it more likely that they will receive full value at a later date, restructuring sovereign debt and restoring a debtor economy’s normal functioning will be more difficult.

zh: 在阿根廷危机之后，大多数新债务都在集体行动条款下发行，只要特定比例（一般约70 % ） 的持有者同意债务重整，则所有持有者都要同意。
en: Since the Argentine crisis, most new bonds have been issued with collective action clauses (CACs), under which bondholders are obliged to accept restructuring if a specified share (usually around 70%) agree to it.

zh: 随着时间流逝，不包含集体行动条款的未偿付债券将越来越少。
en: As time passes, there are fewer and fewer outstanding bonds that do not contain CACs.

zh: 但该条款并不能解决所有问题，因为每一份债券都包含一个投票权，如果要反对重整，只要收购足够比例的分额就行了。
en: But CACs may not resolve the problem entirely, because a vote would be required for each separate bond issue, and a holdout position could be achieved by buying up the blocking percentage of a small issue.

zh: 也有可能在未来的债券发行中会有特定语句去取代平等对待条款，但也能为债券持有者提供足够的保障来让市场得以像当前判决之前那样运行。
en: It is also possible that language will be found in future bond issues that replaces the pari passu clause but provides sufficient assurance to bondholders to let the market function much as it did until the current ruling.

zh: 在欧元危机之前，人们相信与主权债务有关的问题只会出现在新兴市场国家或者最不发达国家身上。
en: Until the euro crisis, it was generally believed that problems servicing sovereign debt occurred only in emerging markets and the least developed countries.

zh: 美国最高法院的阿根廷案决议却增添了一道伤痕，并将进一步增加与持有主权债务相关的风险 — — 以及发行这类债券的成本。
en: The US Supreme Court’s decision on Argentina adds a new wrinkle, and may well further increase the risk attached to holding sovereign debt – and this to the cost of issuing it.

zh: 未来的家庭
en: Families of the Future

zh: 华盛顿特区 — — 现在正是很多国家的毕业季，聪明而幸运的年轻人身穿学士袍头戴学士帽领取毕业证，并听取长辈的建议。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – It is graduation season in many countries, a time when classes of bright and fortunate young people don their caps and gowns, receive their diplomas, and hear advice from their elders.

zh: 有些典礼发言者重点褒奖毕业生的成就;还有些重点强调今后的职业挑战。
en: Some commencement speakers focus on the graduates’ accomplishments; others emphasize the career-related challenges that lie ahead.

zh: 但人人往往在头戴花环庆贺学业成就时忽略了家庭 — — 幸福和成功的另一个重要方面。
en: But there is another critical aspect to success and happiness that is often overlooked during these garlanded celebrations of academic achievement: family.

zh: 其实，上述庆典仪式既关乎毕业生又关乎毕业生的家庭 — — 也就是那些深爱和支持他们的家人，不管他们之间是否真的拥有血缘关系。
en: In fact, these ceremonies are about the graduates’ families – that is, those who have loved and supported them, regardless of their biological connection – as much as they are about the graduates themselves.

zh: 无论每个家庭经历了什么，结果是他们的孩子达到了只能存在于很多人梦想中的教育程度。
en: Whatever each family’s experience, the result has been a child reaching a level of education of which many people can only dream.

zh: 除了关注并感谢家人对他们的培养，毕业生还必须思考他们想建立什么样的家庭。
en: Beyond noting and appreciating what their families have done for them, graduates must consider the kind of family that they want to nurture.

zh: 因此他们别无选择，必须思考两性的角色和关系。
en: And here they have no choice but to reflect on gender roles and relations.

zh: 鉴于不同文化对男性和女性截然不同的期望和体验，他们要问的问题也有很大不同。
en: Given the vastly different expectations and experiences of men and women – depending, of course, on the cultural context – the questions that they must ask themselves vary considerably.

zh: 年轻女性往往面对平衡工作和家庭关系的问题其实也是年轻男性需要考虑的因素。
en: The question of how to balance work and family, typically posed to young women, is actually a critical consideration for young men as well.

zh: 传统男性“养家糊口”的角色往往导致工作比和家人待在一起重要。
en: The traditional male role as “provider” has often led work to take precedence over time spent with family.

zh: 事实上，回首童年，很多毕业生或许会抱怨父亲待在家里的时间太少，而他们本来可以给予家庭更多的关注。
en: Indeed, in reflecting on their childhoods, many graduates may lament that their fathers spent too little time at home, or were less nurturing than they could have been.

zh: 除发展个性中勇于竞争的一面，从而在事业上稳步发展之外，男性必须决定如何发掘自己个性中的关爱因素。
en: Men must determine how to develop the caring side of their personality, in addition to the competitive side that will enable them to advance their careers.

zh: 他们必须学会全身心地关爱和付出，扮演好父亲、儿子、丈夫、兄弟、叔叔甚至是朋友的角色。
en: They must aim to love and give fully, not only as fathers, but also as sons, husbands, brothers, uncles, and even friends.

zh: 为此他们应当询问自己的父亲和祖父他们希望当时做出哪些改变 — — 并且据此制定计划。
en: To this end, they should ask their own fathers and grandfathers what they wish they had done differently – and plan accordingly.

zh: 与其坐等挑战出现，年轻人应当现在就开始确定自己的优先事项。
en: Instead of waiting for challenges to arise, young men should begin establishing their priorities now.

zh: 他们怎样确保与未来的伴侣建立平等关系？
en: How can they ensure that their relationship with their future partner is equal?

zh: 他们要如何调整，才能让伴侣实现他或者她的职业理想？
en: How will they adapt to enable their partner to fulfill his or her career aspirations?

zh: 他们是否愿意为伴侣的工作搬家？
en: Will they be willing to move for their partner’s job?

zh: 他们是否愿意放弃工作或减少工作量，以便更好地照顾孩子或父母？
en: Would they be prepared to stop working or reduce their workload, in order to care for a child or parent?

zh: 通过这一切男性应当记住，采用新方法并不等于他们放弃了家庭支柱的角色。
en: Through all of this, men should remember that, by adopting a new approach, they are not abandoning their roles as providers.

zh: 归根结底，提供父爱与提供金钱同样重要。
en: After all, providing care is every bit as important as providing cash.

zh: 他们得到的回报是与子女间建立起传统上只有女性才有的亲密关系。
en: The reward is the close relationship with their children that women have traditionally enjoyed.

zh: 女性也必须认真思考她们眼中最满意的未来。
en: Women, too, must think carefully about the future that they would find most fulfilling.

zh: 对许多女性而言，挑战在于放弃其工作/家庭平衡必须向家庭倾斜的假设，也就是她们必须牺牲自己的事业来成全家庭。
en: For many women, the challenge is abandoning the assumption that their work/family balance will have to tip in favor of family, that it is they who will have to sacrifice their careers.

zh: 当然，许多女性会自愿选择把家庭作为重点（很多男性也是 ） 。
en: Of course, many women might choose to emphasize family (as would many men).

zh: 关键在于选择权：选择将多少精力投入到家庭方面，以兴趣爱好为基础来选择事业，以及选择真正平等的终身伴侣。
en: The point is the choice: the choice of how much energy to devote to one’s home, the choice of a career based on passion, and the choice of a genuinely equal partner.

zh: 实现照顾家庭和经济支柱间平等的合作关系需要双方都做出让步。
en: Upholding an equal partnership of caregivers and breadwinners will require compromises on both sides.

zh: 有事业心的女性应当寻找一位愿意放慢脚步或放弃工作来支持她的伴侣，男人也是一样。
en: A woman with great career ambitions should be able to find a partner who is willing to slow down or stop working to support her, just as a man should.

zh: 但抗拒性别角色是双向的。
en: But bucking gender roles works both ways.

zh: 事实上，这样的机制要想发挥作用，女性必须调整她对配偶的期望。
en: Indeed, for such a dynamic to work, the woman must recalibrate her expectations of her spouse.

zh: 如果她想与男性建立家庭，她不能让传统观念中阳刚局限她的思想。
en: If she wants to build a family with a man, she must not become caught up in traditional perceptions of masculinity.

zh: 如果她对挣得比配偶多感到不适应，那么她就局限了男女双方。
en: If she is uncomfortable, say, out-earning her husband, she is limiting both partners.

zh: 简言之，年轻女性的父亲和祖父可以为她们的母亲和祖母提��的那种支持并不是女性可以而且应当从伴侣那里得到的唯一支助。
en: Simply put, the kind of support that young women’s fathers and grandfathers probably offered to their mothers and grandmothers is not the only kind of support a woman can or should expect from her partner.

zh: 决定她作用的不应是某种老式的规则，而是她自身的优势和志向。
en: Her role should be determined not by old-fashioned rules, but by her individual strengths and ambitions.

zh: 她的伴侣应当有信心和能力鼓励她发挥潜力。
en: And her partner should have the confidence and competence to encourage her to fulfill her potential.

zh: 最后，毕业并不意味着家庭的工作就完成了。
en: Finally, graduation does not mean that the family’s job is complete.

zh: 父母和祖父母必须继续在重塑预期方面发挥关键作用 — — 或者至少支持他们的子女和孙辈做出的选择。
en: Parents and grandparents must continue to play a critical role in reshaping expectations – or at least supporting the choices that their children and grandchildren make.

zh: 这其中包括接受儿子或孙子决定不用来之不易的大学学位成为日后家庭主要的经济支柱，还包括理解女儿或孙女所要的可能不是一个传统意义上的“经济支柱 ” ， 而是一个愿意牺牲自身事业推动她事业发展的丈夫。
en: This means accepting the decision of a son or grandson not to use his hard-earned university degree to become the primary breadwinner in his future household. And it means understanding that what a daughter or granddaughter needs may not be a traditional “provider,” but a partner who makes career sacrifices to enable her to advance hers.

zh: 毕业既是开始也是结束。
en: Graduation is a day of ending and beginning.

zh: 年轻人应当记住家人为自己做出的牺牲，并认真思考他们愿意为自己的家庭做些什么。
en: It is a day for young people to recall the sacrifices that their families have made for them, and consider the kinds of sacrifices they will make for their families.

zh: 毕业当前他们还应当认识到，把家庭放在首位并不意味着工作就是从属；相反，生活其实是各种因素的融合。
en: And it is a day to recognize that, if family comes first, work does not come second; rather, life comes together.

zh: 让欧洲领导乌克兰
en: Let Europe Lead in Ukraine

zh: 华盛顿—在俄罗斯步步实现其对克里米亚的吞并时，美国必须后退，欧洲必须向前，而国际社会必须保证让俄罗斯为其作为付出经济和政治代价，同时俄罗斯和乌克兰民族主义者不会让双方陷入致命的暴力循环。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – As Russia’s annexation of Crimea proceeds, the United States must step back; the European Union must step forward; and the international community must ensure both that Russia pays a steep economic and political price for its actions, and that Russian and Ukrainian nationalists do not lock both sides into a deadly spiral of violence.

zh: 目前，西方领导人正用自己手中的牌尽力施展腾挪，阻止了德国总理默克尔的早期失误 — — 她认为俄罗斯深思熟虑的地区利益主张只是一位与现实脱节的领袖的行为。
en: Thus far, Western leaders have played their cards about as well as they could, barring early missteps by German Chancellor Angela Merkel, who described a calculated assertion of Russia’s regional interests as the behavior of a leader who was out of touch with reality.

zh: 现阶段美国所导致的危机升级只会对俄罗斯总统普京更加有利，让西方显得像只纸老虎。
en: Escalation of the crisis by the US at this stage would merely play into Russian President Vladimir Putin’s hands and expose the West as a paper tiger.

zh: 要了解原因，回忆一些历史是大有裨益的。
en: To see why, it is useful to recall some history.

zh: 在整个二十世纪，美国总是在不时干预拉美颠覆和推翻不为它所喜的政府：古巴、尼加拉瓜、多米尼克、巴拿马、危地马拉、海地、萨尔瓦多、智利、格林纳达莫不如此，以上只是比较著名的例子。
en: Throughout the twentieth century, the US intervened repeatedly in Latin America to topple or subvert governments it did not like: in Cuba, Nicaragua, the Dominican Republic, Panama, Guatemala, Haiti, El Salvador, Chile, and Grenada, to name only the most prominent cases.

zh: 冷战期间，各任美国总统前赴后继，热衷于直接或间接出兵确保友好政府在美洲（以及其他地区）胜出。
en: During the Cold War, successive US presidents were perfectly happy to send in troops, directly or indirectly, to ensure that friendly governments prevailed in the Americas (and beyond).

zh: 再来回忆一下西方对前苏联和俄罗斯入侵具战略重要性的国家的反应：1956年的匈牙利、1968年的捷克斯洛伐克和2008年的格鲁吉亚。
en: Now recall Western responses to previous Soviet and Russian incursions into strategically important countries: Hungary in 1956, Czechoslovakia in 1968, or Georgia in 2008.

zh: 每一次，美国都拒绝军事干预拥有地球上最多数量核武器的国家。
en: Each time, the US refused to engage militarily with a state possessing the largest number of nuclear weapons on earth.

zh: 回顾历史不是为了肯定历史，而是为了理解俄罗斯人会如何理解普京行为的后果。
en: To recite this history is not to approve it, but rather to try to understand how Russians might understand the legitimacy of Putin’s actions.

zh: 此处还有一个放之四海而皆准的政治逻辑，即外国威胁或危机能巩固领袖在国内的地位。
en: There is also the universal political dynamic whereby a foreign threat or crisis strengthens a leader domestically.

zh: 普京通过克里米亚行动所获得的国内支持正如1982年马岛战争时的英国首相撒切尔。
en: Putin is getting the same bump in popularity from his Crimean adventure that then-British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher got from the Falklands War in 1982.

zh: 就连左翼知识分子也一边倒地支持普京保护俄罗斯族的行动以及克里姆林宫及其友好媒体将乌克兰民族主义描绘成“法西斯主义”的做法。
en: Even left-wing intellectuals are lining up to support Putin for protecting ethnic Russians from what the Kremlin and its allied media portray as “fascist” Ukrainian nationalism.

zh: 在这样的背景下，美国国务卿克里明确表示北约未考虑任何形式的军事应对���施是正确的。
en: Against this backdrop, US Secretary of State John Kerry is right to make clear that NATO is not contemplating a military response of any kind.

zh: 他还可以做出更好的措施，将此场危机首席谈判者和发言人的地位让给欧盟领导小组：欧盟高级代表阿什顿（Catherine Ashton ） 、 默克尔、英国首相卡梅伦和波兰总理图斯克。
en: He would do even better to hand off responsibility as lead negotiator and spokesman in this crisis to a group of EU leaders: EU High Representative Catherine Ashton, Merkel, UK Prime Minister David Cameron, and Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk.

zh: 作为整体的欧盟与俄罗斯的经济关系远大于美国，影响力也远胜过美国。
en: The EU as a whole has far more extensive economic ties – and hence influence – with Russia than the US does.

zh: 欧盟是俄罗斯最大的贸易伙伴，而美国是第五大，位列中国和乌克兰之后。
en: The EU is Russia’s largest trading partner – the US is in fifth place, behind China and Ukraine.

zh: 2012年俄罗斯外国直接投资有大约一半去向荷兰、塞浦路斯和瑞士（非欧盟成员，但在欧盟影响力范围内 ） ， 而流入的外国直接投资有75%来自欧盟国家。
en: Roughly half of Russian foreign direct investment in 2012 went to the Netherlands, Cyprus, and Switzerland (which is not an EU member, but is subject to EU pressure), while an estimated 75% of Russia’s inward FDI comes from EU countries.

zh: 最后，俄罗斯寡头在伦敦和法国南部所拥有的产业也多于纽约和迈阿密。
en: Finally, Russian oligarchs own more property in London and the south of France than they do in New York or Miami.

zh: 此外，与美国“干预”俄罗斯邻邦相比，欧盟向俄罗斯施压引起俄罗斯民族主义的可能性更小。
en: Moreover, EU pressure on Russia is less likely to whip up Russian nationalism than US “interference” in Russia’s neighborhood.

zh: 首先，乌克兰也是欧盟的邻国。
en: For starters, Ukraine is in the EU’s neighborhood as well.

zh: 但更重要的是，欧盟没有像美国那样天天在俄罗斯耳边聒噪其在后苏联时代在国际舞台上所遭遇的损失和耻辱。
en: But, more important, the EU does not remind Russians daily of their post-Soviet losses and humiliation on the global stage in the same way that the US does.

zh: 美国的俄罗斯专家比二十年前减少了很多，因为大部分美国对外决策者更多关注的是中国、印度和中东。
en: The US has far fewer Russia experts in politics today than it did two decades ago, because most American foreign policymakers have been paying far more attention to China, India, and the Middle East.

zh: 没有哪个国家喜欢被忽视，前超级大国就更不用说了。
en: No country, much less a former superpower, likes to be ignored.

zh: 最后，如果美国后退一步，欧盟、联合国甚至中国就可以提醒俄罗斯悍然违反国际法、吞并贫穷倔强领土的后果 — — 这片领土远比被操纵的公投结果所表现的的更加难以消化。
en: Finally, if the US steps back, the EU, the United Nations, and even China can remind the Russians of the political consequences of flagrantly violating international law and swallowing up impoverished, restive territories that will prove far harder to digest than the fixed referendum results would suggest.

zh: 穆斯林鞑靼人 — — 约占克里米亚人口的15 % — —强烈反对加入俄罗斯联邦，可能成为永远的反对者，此外还有25%说乌克兰语的克里米亚人，他们在过去十天中一直保持沉默。
en: The Muslim Tatars – roughly 15% of Crimea’s population – strongly oppose joining the Russian Federation and may become a permanent thorn in its side, along with the 25% of Ukrainian-speaking Crimeans who have been silenced over the past ten days.

zh: 美国和欧洲决定现在采取一些经济制裁，并可能在日后收紧和扩大制裁，这不是示弱的信号，而是深思熟虑的战略结论。
en: The US and European decision to impose some economic sanctions now, with the possibility of adopting tougher and broader sanctions later, is not a sign of weakness but of strategic calculation.

zh: 在美国和欧洲的外交武库中还有更重型的武器可以用来阻止普京进一步蚕食乌克兰；与此同时，市场也会给所有俄罗斯人施加更大的经济成本。
en: Heavier weapons remain in the diplomatic arsenal to deter Putin from trying to carve off further sections of Ukraine; in the meantime, markets are imposing additional economic costs on all Russians.

zh: 如今，同样重要的是巩固新乌克兰政府中的温和派，减小可能践踏操俄语的乌克兰人权利的右翼民族主义者的影响力。
en: It is now equally important to strengthen the moderate members of the new Ukrainian government and to reduce the influence of right-wing nationalists who would trample on the rights of Russian-speaking Ukrainians.

zh: 从法国大革命到埃及和叙利亚，极端分子一再迫害温和派，采取他们最初联合起来推翻的政府一样的做派和政治。
en: From the French Revolution to Egypt and Syria, extremists have repeatedly overtaken moderates and then proceeded to mimic the tactics and politics of the government they originally united to overthrow.

zh: 这并不是说美国、欧盟和其他相关行动方不应该竭尽全力确保全体乌克兰人民，不论他操何种语言、信何种宗教，都能获得他所渴望的权利和繁荣。
en: That is not to say that the US, the EU, and other concerned actors should not do everything possible to ensure that Ukraine’s people, whatever language they speak and religion they practice, gain the rights and prosperity that they desperately seek.

zh: 对美国来说，正如其总统奥巴马在国家安全战略中所说的那样，捍卫普世价值是美国的核心利益。
en: For the US, the defense of universal values is, according to President Barack Obama’s National Security Strategy, a core American interest.

zh: 但在乌克兰问题上，追求这一利益的办法决非引入冷战式的针锋相对。
en: But the way to pursue that interest in this case is not to invite a Cold War-style face-off.

zh: 冷战式的针锋相对只掣肘对俄罗斯影响最大、与此危机干系最大（不论战略上还是经济上）解决这场危机。
en: It is to backstop the countries that have the most influence over Russia and the most at stake – strategically and economically – in resolving this crisis.

zh: 带着伊朗协议回家
en: Bringing the Iran Deal Back Home

zh: 华盛顿—美国政府关于“伊朗核计划初步协议”的最初说法首先强调的是这是美国和西方所获得的伟大协议。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The United States government’s initial statements on the “first-step agreement on Iran’s nuclear program” have been focused, above all, on the great deal that the US and the West have gotten.

zh: 伊朗同意暂停5%以上浓度的核浓缩活动，封存浓度近20%的铀，停止囤积浓度为3.5%的铀，放弃“下一代离心机 ” ， 关闭其钚反应堆，并允许对其核设施进行严格的新检查。
en: Iran has agreed to halt enrichment of uranium above 5% purity; neutralize its stockpile of uranium enriched to near 20% purity; stop building its stockpile of 3.5% enriched uranium; forswear “next generation centrifuges”; shut down its plutonium reactor; and allow extensive new inspections of its nuclear facilities.

zh: 作为回报，伊朗将获得对其国际制裁的“有限的、暂时的、有目标的、可撤销的放松 ” 。
en: In return, Iran will get “limited, temporary, targeted, and reversible relief” from international sanctions.

zh: 这一协议只在未来六个月有效，在此期间，双方将试图达成最后的全面协议。
en: The agreement covers only the next six months, during which both sides will try to reach a final comprehensive agreement.

zh: 至于现在，正如美国总统奥巴马所说，从美国的立场看，负担仍“在于要想世界证明其核计划只用和平目的 ” 。
en: For now, as President Barack Obama put it, the burden remains, from the US point of view, “on Iran to prove to the world that its nuclear program will be exclusively for peaceful purposes.”

zh: 将这一问题如此定性反映了需要向狐疑的国会兜售的方案甚至会更加有限、更加临时性。
en: Framing the issue this way reflects the need to sell even a limited, temporary deal to a skeptical US Congress.

zh: 以色列对整个谈判过程非常不满，在过去3个月中，以色列总理内塔尼亚胡一直在表示这个观点，并在国会亲以色列派中引起了强烈的回响。
en: Israel’s manifest displeasure with the entire negotiating process, which Prime Minister Binyamin Netanyahu has emphasized to anyone who will listen over the past three months, reverberates loudly among Israel’s many congressional friends.

zh: 事实上，以色列的立场助长了奥巴马的共和党反对者指责他在对伊朗这个仍然将美国描述为“大恶魔”的国家的谈判中显得软弱而天真。
en: Indeed, Israel’s stance bolsters the desire of Obama’s Republican opponents to paint him as weak and naïve in negotiating with Iran, a country that still describes the US as “the great Satan.”

zh: 共和党和民主党均威胁要在12月通过针对伊朗的新一轮严厉制裁。
en: Both Republicans and Democrats are threatening to pass a new round of tough sanctions against Iran in December.

zh: 因此，奥巴马必须花亚于在伊朗谈判中采取强硬立场的力气“搞掂”国内强硬派。
en: Thus, Obama must focus as much on pushing back against domestic hardliners as on taking a hard line with Iranian negotiators.

zh: 这并不令人奇怪。
en: This is hardly surprising.

zh: 你完全可以估计伊朗政府向其人民说的话也同样强硬，集中强调伊朗谈判者所赢得的让步。
en: One hopes that the Iranian government’s announcement to its own people reads roughly the same, in reverse, focusing on the important concessions that Iranian negotiators have won.

zh: 这些让步包括暂停针对伊朗的石油、黄金和汽车出口制裁（伊朗将因此每年增加15亿美元收入 ） ， 解冻石油销售的42亿美元收入，并放松伊朗政府对伊朗海外留学生的学费补助。
en: That includes suspension of international sanctions on Iran’s exports of oil, gold, and cars, which could yield $1.5 billion in revenue; unfreezing $4.2 billion in revenue from oil sales; and releasing tuition-assistance payments from the Iranian government to Iranian students enrolled abroad.

zh: 一如奥巴马，伊朗总统鲁哈尼也需要引导对和协议的支持，首要任务是抑制通胀、让伊朗经济重新向前。
en: Iranian President Hassan Rouhani needs to marshal support for the deal just as much as Obama does, above all by reducing inflation and getting his country’s economy moving again.

zh: 如果伊朗国内紧张局面（主要来自伊朗难以驾驭的中产阶级）能够有所缓和，伊朗政府就能得到信用，而伊朗国民卫队（Iranian Republican Guard）和其他强硬派也将有所削弱。
en: If domestic tensions, above all within Iran’s restive middle class, ease as a result, the government will receive the credit, while the Iranian Republican Guard and other hardliners will be weakened.

zh: 西方最好寄希望于伊朗的说辞能得到兑现，因为任何有意义的外交协议的政治空间 — — 既包括达成协议的愿望，也包括实现协议的空间 — — 都在于国内。
en: The West had better hope that the Iranian narrative proves true, because the political space for any meaningful diplomatic agreement – both the desire for a deal and the room to achieve it – is created at home.

zh: 尤其是考虑到伊朗新政府是带着振兴经济的承诺问鼎权力的。
en: This is particularly true when a new government comes to power with promises of improving the economy.

zh: 鲁哈尼只有在伊朗人民获得经济上的缓解并将这归��于他的政府时才能战胜寻求阻挠一切最终协议的强硬派。
en: Rouhani can undercut hardliners who would seek to block any ultimate deal only if the Iranian population both experiences economic relief and attributes it to his administration.

zh: 因此，对于这一过渡协议的真正考验是双方能否确保继续谈判的国内空间。
en: The true test of this interim agreement, therefore, is whether both sides can secure the domestic space to continue negotiating.

zh: 兹事体大 — — 不仅是因为伊朗核弹所能引起的实打实的危险的地缘政治后果。
en: The stakes have never been higher – and not only because of the very real and dangerous geopolitical consequences of an Iranian bomb.

zh: 正如奥巴马所说 ， “ 如果伊朗抓住这一机会，伊朗人民就能从重新回到国际社会获益良多，而我们也可以开始消弭存在于我们两国之间的不信任。
en: As Obama put it, “If Iran seizes this opportunity, the Iranian people will benefit from rejoining the international community, and we can begin to chip away at the mistrust between our two nations.

zh: 伊朗将获得一条体面的道路，以互相尊重为基础重新开始与世界打交道。 ”
en: This would provide Iran with a dignified path to forge a new beginning with the wider world based on mutual respect.”

zh: 我们可以暂时地想象一下，如果美国和伊朗可以再一次互相对话，中东和中亚会怎样。
en: Let us imagine, just for a moment, what the Middle East and Central Asia could look like if the US and Iran could once again talk to each other.

zh: 正如我们在2001年9月11日恐怖袭击后所短暂地看到的，来自阿富汗的毒品交易大幅下降。
en: As we saw briefly after the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, the drug trade from Afghanistan could be sharply curtailed.

zh: 此外，达成包括伊朗、印度、巴基斯坦、俄罗斯、中国、土耳其、欧盟和美国在内的地区安全协议的可能性大大增加，为安全和经济增长 — — 从基辛格到已故的霍尔布鲁克（Richard Holbrooke）在内的外交官一直认为这是维持阿富汗和平之必须 — — 提供了框架。
en: Moreover, a regional agreement involving Iran, India, Pakistan, Russia, China, Turkey, the European Union, and the US would become much more likely, providing the framework for security and economic growth that diplomats from Henry Kissinger to the late Richard Holbrooke always claimed would be necessary for lasting peace in Afghanistan.

zh: 也许更重要的是，如果美国能够与伊朗展开谈判，达成叙利亚问题和平协议的可能性也会大大增加 — — 伊朗对叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德的作用远大于俄罗斯。
en: Perhaps most important, a peace settlement in Syria would be much more likely – and more likely to endure – if the US could talk to Iran, which has far more leverage with President Bashar al-Assad’s regime than Russia does.

zh: 毕竟，是伊朗的黎巴嫩代理人 — — 真主党武装力量在去年夏天决定性地扭转了与反对派斗争的形势。
en: After all, it was fighters from Hezbollah, Iran’s Lebanese proxy, who turned the tide of battle decisively against the opposition this past summer.

zh: 伊朗早就明确地表示它希望重新获得作为地区 — — 事实上是全球 — — 主要大国的历史低位，而在看到土耳其地缘政治地位上升后，伊朗的这一雄心越发高涨了。
en: Iran has long made clear that it wants to resume its historic position as a major regional – and indeed global – power, an ambition that can only grow stronger as it watches Turkey’s geopolitical stature rise.

zh: 毕竟，伊朗和土耳其分别是17和18世纪世界上人口最多的国家，拥有成熟的精英阶层和辉煌悠久的历史。
en: Iran and Turkey, after all, are the 17th and 18th largest countries in the world by population, respectively, with sophisticated elites and illustrious and ancient pasts.

zh: 对伊过渡协议的最终赢家是外交进程本身。
en: The ultimate winner in the interim agreement with Iran is the cause of diplomacy itself.

zh: 美国国务卿克里、欧盟高级代表阿什顿（Catherine Ashton）和其他谈判各方 — — 都是能力卓著的外交官团队 — — 花几个月的时间才敲定了协议的细节、让协议来到谈判桌、做出让步、掌控局面，并协调多方（包括媒体）的期望。
en: US Secretary of State John Kerry, EU High Representative Catherine Ashton, and the other parties to the talks – all supported by able teams of diplomats – hammered out the deal’s details over months, staying at the table, compromising, holding firm, and managing the expectations of multiple players (including the press).

zh: 奥巴马政府本身也致力于通过民事而非军事实力充当全球领导。
en: The Obama administration committed itself to global leadership through civilian rather than military power.

zh: 这就是伊朗核谈判的意义。
en: That is what it takes.

zh: 奥巴马对阵“伊斯兰国”
en: Obama Versus the Islamic State

zh: 华盛顿 — — 美国总统奥巴马已经制订了一份美政府打击控制叙利亚和伊拉克大片领土的“伊斯兰国”的详细战略计划。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – US President Barack Obama has laid out a detailed strategy for how his administration plans to combat the Islamic State, which controls a substantial portion of Syria and Iraq.

zh: 虽然在过去两年半的时间里我一直在严厉批评奥巴马的叙利亚政策，但这项新的战略政策既成熟又连贯 — — 虽然在某些方面与他一直公开宣扬的价值观有冲突。
en: Though I have been harshly critical of Obama’s policy toward Syria for two and a half years, his new strategy reflects a mature and coherent foreign policy – albeit one that does not fully live up to his proclaimed values.

zh: 这一点疏忽仍然可能打乱他的整个计划。
en: That omission may yet defeat his plan.

zh: 奥巴马做法值得称道的原因有三。
en: Obama’s approach is praiseworthy for three reasons.

zh: 首先，它将武力和外交融合在一起。
en: First, it combines force and diplomacy.

zh: 其次，它为美国军事行动的种类和范围附加了精心设计的条件。
en: Second, it attaches careful conditions to the type and scope of American military action.

zh: 第三，它把行动的命运和大中东联盟的建立及其有效性联系在一起，向世人表明美国虽然愿意发挥领导作用，但既不能也不会扮演全球警察。
en: Third, it ties the fate of these efforts to the existence and effectiveness of a broad Middle East coalition, making clear that though the United States is prepared to lead, it cannot and will not assume the role of global policeman.

zh: 在中东的权力游戏中，奥巴马已经尽力而为。
en: In the Middle East game of thrones, Obama is playing his hand as well as he can.

zh: 他知道美国领导的军事行动可以显著削弱“伊斯兰国”的势力，但只有开展联合军事政治行动才能彻底击败它。
en: He knows that a US-led military effort can significantly weaken the Islamic State, but that only a combined military-political effort can defeat it.

zh: 他通过明确界限赢得了政治筹码，对外宣称只有新成立的伊拉克政府加入美国才会“不止保护本国民众和执行人道主义任务 ” 。
en: He created political leverage for himself by drawing a clear line, announcing that the US would “expand our efforts beyond protecting our own people and humanitarian missions” only together with the newly-formed Iraqi government.

zh: 如果伊政府兑现其政治包容的承诺，美国将帮助它赢回国家；否则美国将不会这样做。
en: If that government makes good on its promises of political inclusion, the US will help it get its country back; if not, not.

zh: 略显隐晦但却同样重要的是上述立场对伊朗的影响。
en: Equally important, but less evident, is the leverage that this position provides with respect to Iran.

zh: 奥巴马演讲中并未提及伊朗；但评论人士却在猜测这项策略是否扩大了伊朗对美国的影响，因为伊朗支持的战士将是打击“伊斯兰国”地面行动能否成功的关键因素。
en: Obama never mentioned Iran during his speech; but commentators have speculated about whether his strategy gives Iran greater leverage over the US, on the theory that Iranian-backed fighters are critical to the success on the ground in the fight against the Islamic State.

zh: 但伊拉克的什叶派政府是伊朗在该地区的重要战略稳定力量；在美国开始对“伊斯兰国”进行空袭之前，伊拉克政府能否劫后余生还很难讲。
en: But Iraq’s Shia government is one of Iran’s major strategic anchors in the region; before the US began airstrikes against the Islamic State, it was far from certain that the Iraqi government would survive.

zh: 伊朗像美国需要伊朗的地面部队一样需要美国的空中力量。
en: Iran needs US airpower at least as much as the US needs Iranian-backed ground troops.

zh: 美国强调建立反“伊斯兰国”地区联盟同样也是灵活的外交政策。
en: The US emphasis on a regional coalition to fight the Islamic State is also deft diplomacy.

zh: 国务卿约翰·克里已明确表示目前不欢迎伊朗加入。
en: Secretary of State John Kerry has made it clear that for now Iran is not a welcome member.

zh: 但没有伊朗的联盟实际已成为逊尼派阵线，伊朗本应参与谈判并在平息叙利亚内战中发挥更显著的作用。 但这一切的前提是伊朗愿意签署协议控制其核计划。
en: Iran, without which the coalition essentially becomes a Sunni front, can have a place at the table – and play a large and overt role in resolving the Syrian civil war – but only if it is willing to reach a deal to rein in its nuclear program.

zh: 这样好的时机可谓前所未有。
en: There has never been a better time to do so.

zh: 奥巴马政策最薄弱环节是面向普通民众：即传播愤怒、仇恨、绝望或希望、信任、忠诚的人际关系网络。
en: Where Obama’s strategy is weakest is in reaching ordinary people: the networked web of human relationships that transmits rage, hatred, and despair or hope, trust, and loyalty.

zh: 他所提出的美国将动用武力捍卫其“核心利益 ” ， 但同时要动员他国“解决国际秩序更大挑战”的理念在厌战的美国不失为合理有效的政策。
en: His doctrine that the US will use force to defend its “core interests,” but will mobilize others “to address broader challenges to international order,” is sound logic and good politics in a war-weary US.

zh: 但有位叙利亚人给我发了推特，指出世界对此的理解是美国将动用武力对两名美国记者之死进行报复，但却在200,000叙利亚人遭受屠杀时什么也不做。
en: But, as a Syrian tweeted to me, what the world hears Obama saying is that the US will use force to avenge the deaths of two American journalists, but will stand by while 200,000 Syrians are slaughtered.

zh: 除非美国军事行动在民众看来是为保护伊拉克和叙利亚民众的生命财产安全，美国将迅速在对“伊斯兰国”的宣传攻势中败下阵来。
en: Unless US military action is seen as actually protecting the lives and property of the Iraqi and Syrian people, the US will quickly lose the propaganda war to the Islamic state.

zh: 正如许多专家所警告的那样，当无人机首次空袭炸死妇女或儿童，现场和葬礼的视频将被发到网上让整个穆斯林世界看到。
en: As many experts warn, the first time a drone strike kills a woman or child, a video of the scene and the funeral will be posted for the Muslim world to see.

zh: 即便这样的视频不会实际增加对“伊斯兰国”的支持，但数百万穆斯林民众将因此���信美国又一次耍弄了已经用过无数次的军事技巧：为石油或为以色列轰炸，或者干脆就是为打击穆斯林民众。
en: Even if that video does not actually increase support for the Islamic State, it will convince millions of Muslims that the US is up to its old military tricks: bombing for oil, or for Israel, or simply to crush all Muslims.

zh: 那些最近再次高涨的反美情绪将加大获取对抗“伊斯兰国”所需情报的难度，并使美国失去其他逊尼民间武装。
en: Those anti-American attitudes, newly hardened once again, will make it much more difficult to get the necessary intelligence against the Islamic State on the ground and to deprive them of the support of other Sunni militias.

zh: 这不仅会损害美国在叙利亚和伊拉克的利益，它还将决定其他阿拉伯国家民众的看法，导致其政府不敢与美国合作。
en: That will not just hurt the US in Syria and Iraq. It will shape popular views in other Arab states, limiting their governments’ ability to work with the US.

zh: 最具破坏力的是军事行动纯粹的战略借口 — — 捍卫美国的核心利益 — — 根本完成不了在叙利亚需要完成的任务。
en: Most damaging of all, a purely strategic justification for military action – in defense of core US interests – leaves no room to do what actually needs to be done in Syria.

zh: 迫使叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德重回谈判桌的唯一方法是同时削弱他和“伊斯兰国”的力量。
en: The only way to bring Syrian President Bashar al-Assad to the negotiating table is to weaken him and the Islamic State simultaneously.

zh: 打击其空军、弹药库或重型武器装备的唯一合法或道义理由是保护民众免受其伤害的国际义务 — — 就像美国协助保护雅兹迪人免受“伊斯兰国”的迫害一样。
en: And the only legal or moral justification for striking his air force, ammunition dumps, or heavy weaponry is the international responsibility to protect his people from him – just as the US helped to protect the Yezidis from the Islamic State.

zh: 因为与奥巴马的说法不同 ， “ 伊斯兰国”的残忍并不“独特 ” 。
en: For, contrary to Obama’s claim, the brutality of the Islamic State is not “unique.”

zh: 阿萨德就曾在其政府因虐童引起的冲突中杀害过200,000人，其中多数是平民。
en: Assad has killed more than 200,000 people, mostly civilians, in a conflict that started with his government’s torture of children.

zh: 像奥巴马之前做过的那样只谈保护责任、配合更为有限的空袭 — — 或许为惩戒阿萨德据称最近对平民使用氯气 — — 将迅速改变现有状况。
en: Simply talking about the responsibility to protect, as Obama once did, accompanied by even limited strikes – perhaps as punishment for Assad’s reported recent use of chlorine gas against civilians – would change the game quickly.

zh: 伊朗会明白美国对叙利亚的限制并非没有期限；逊尼派政府也会在国内民众眼中因坐视不理而蒙羞 ； “ 伊斯兰国”的残忍故事会与人道主义故事产生激烈的冲突。
en: Iran would understand that America’s restraint in Syria is not indefinite; Sunni governments could be shamed in the eyes of their own people for not doing more; and the Islamic State’s narrative of brutality would collide with a narrative of humanity.

zh: 农民的命运将对国王的命运产生直接而深远的影响。
en: The fate of peasants has a direct and important impact on that of kings.

zh: 奥巴马的政策在基于国家利益和普适价值观（即捍卫“我们共同的安全和人道 ” ） 的地缘政治考量中不停摇摆。
en: Obama’s policy wavers between geopolitical calculations based on national interest and the rhetoric of universal values, of standing for “our common security and common humanity.”

zh: 让空话成真能使他赢得空间，赢得实现其地缘政治目标的必要因素。
en: Making that rhetoric real would buy him the room for maneuver that is needed to pursue his policy’s geopolitical goals.

zh: 关门后的美国
en: Post-Shutdown America

zh: 街上安静得不自然。 几万员工陷入了存在危机。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – After 16 days of closed museums, half-empty federal buildings, unnaturally quiet streets, and tens of thousands of workers left in existential limbo, the lights are back on in Washington.

zh: 如此过了16天后，光明又回到了华盛顿。 但是，由国会共和党激进分子阻挠总统奥巴马的医保立法导致的美国政府关门虽然结束了，仍有三个教训等待我们吸取。
en: But, while the shutdown of the United States government, initiated by radical congressional Republicans seeking to block implementation of President Barack Obama’s health-care legislation, is over – at least for now – three enduring lessons have emerged.

zh: 首先，当下一次欧元区危机爆发时，美国得把紧口风；毕竟，关门的场景所暴露出来的病症之严重一点都不亚于过去五年中欧盟经济和政治谈判所体现的。
en: First, the next time the eurozone crisis flares up, the US will simply have to bite its tongue; after all, the shutdown spectacle revealed pathologies no less severe than those that have characterized the European Union’s economic and political negotiations over the past five years.

zh: 不负责任的行为威胁到全球经济的健康？
en: Irresponsible behavior threatening the health of the global economy?

zh: 是的。
en: Check.

zh: 政治故作姿态和奇谈怪论堵上了任何妥协之路？
en: Political posturing and outlandish claims foreclosing any possibility of compromise?

zh: 是的。
en: Check.

zh: 吓人的边缘政策和11个小时的决策过程，以至于所有旁观者都担心这一次列车真的要坠下悬崖了？
en: Breathtaking brinkmanship and 11th-hour decision-making leaving all bystanders wondering whether this time the cart might in fact go over the cliff?

zh: 是的。
en: Check.

zh: 近几年来，很少有国家能免于国内政治闹剧在全世界丢人现眼的尴尬。
en: Few countries in recent years have been spared the pain of their domestic political spectacles being broadcast around the world.

zh: 英国伦敦两年前爆发了大规模骚乱；巴黎时不时因为罢工和示威而陷入瘫痪；希腊正在日渐变成法西斯城市；墨西哥城因为教师占领中央广场而陷入了实际关闭；土耳其总理埃尔多安6月份以暴力手段镇压了持续了数周的反对其日益独裁的治国风格的游行。
en: The United Kingdom had mass riots in London just two summers ago; strikes and demonstrations have paralyzed Paris on a regular basis; Greece has a rising fascist party; Mexico City has been practically shut down by teachers occupying the central square; and Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan resorted to violence in June to quell weeks of protests against his increasingly autocratic ways.

zh: 在非民主国家，中国爆出了薄熙来丑闻，其故事足以写成一部间谍小说 — — 包括了风流韵事、腐败猖獗、谋杀、高级警官戏剧性地寻求美国领事馆庇护等情节。
en: Among non-democracies, China had the Bo Xilai scandal, which was worthy of a spy novel, with illicit affairs, rampant corruption, murder, and a senior police official’s dramatic quest for asylum in a US consulate.

zh: 从这个角度看，美国政府关门也没什么不同。
en: Against this backdrop, the US government shutdown looks a little different.

zh: 是的，这显然是政治运转不良的症候，其源头是政治化的选区划分和美国政治献金制度带来的扭曲效应。
en: Yes, it was a clear symptom of deep political dysfunction, stemming from the politicized demarcation of electoral districts and the distorting effects of America’s campaign-finance system.

zh: 尽管如此，值得注意的是，整个危机都是根据宪法规则展开的。
en: Nonetheless, it is noteworthy that the entire crisis played out according to constitutional rules.

zh: 事实上，随着债务上限提高期限的临近，布鲁金斯研究所（Brookings Institution）杰出高级研究员阿隆（Henry Aaron）指出美国宪法要求政府“花国会让他花的钱，征国会授权他征的税，借不多于国会授权的钱。
en: Indeed, as the deadline for raising the debt ceiling neared, Henry Aaron, a distinguished senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, pointed out that the US Constitution requires the president “to spend what Congress has instructed him to spend, to raise only those taxes Congress has authorized him to impose, and to borrow no more than Congress authorizes.”

zh: ”如果国会拒绝提高债务上限，就不可能满足所有这三项法律义务，但在没有国会批准的情况下提高债务上限 — — 虽然是不合法且可能被弹劾的过错 — — 却是最不坏的选择。
en: Honoring all three of those legal obligations simultaneously is impossible if Congress refuses to raise the debt ceiling, but raising the debt ceiling without Congressional approval, though illegal and an impeachable offense, was the least-bad choice.

zh: 尽管面临着美国几十年所未见的高度政治两极分化局面 （以及美国多地发自肺腑的对首位非洲裔总统的敌意 ） ， 但美国人及其政客明白，破坏规则意味着破坏宪法粘合国体的作用。
en: Even in the face of deeper political polarization than the US has seen in many decades (and, in many places, a visceral hatred of the country’s first African-American president), Americans and their politicians understand that breaking the rules means dissolving the constitutional glue that holds the polity together.

zh: 这一理解意味着当前僵局的解决方案将会来自选票箱而不是街头。
en: This understanding means that the cure for the current dysfunction will be found at the ballot box rather than in the streets.

zh: 而这一对依法治理政治权力的集体承诺能够执行正是自由民主的本质。
en: And it is this collective commitment to the law governing how political power can be exercised that is the essence of liberal democracy.

zh: 但美国人没兴趣庆祝。
en: But Americans are in no mood to celebrate.

zh: 事实上，来自美国政府关门的第二个结论是美国必胜信念的实质消失。
en: Indeed, the second conclusion to be drawn from the US government shutdown is the virtual disappearance of American triumphalism.

zh: 口号震天的例外论让位给了更冷静的爱国主义，普通公民认为长期趋势正在损害机会平等的承诺，特别是困扰着美国医疗、教育和基础设施系统的缺陷。
en: Chest-thumping exceptionalism has given way to a more sober patriotism, in which ordinary citizens recognize the long-term trends eroding the promise of equal opportunity, particularly the shortcomings that beset the country’s health-care, education, and infrastructure systems.

zh: 茶党共和党的愤怒（就像“占领华尔街”示威者的愤怒）反映的是一种观念 — — 只有戏剧性甚至革命性的手段才能改变制度。
en: The anger of Tea Party Republicans (like the anger of Occupy Wall Street protesters) reflects a sense that nothing but dramatic, even revolutionary, measures can change the system.

zh: 但是，作为回应，更务实的选民越来越恼怒于政治瘫痪以及他们的治理机构在应对显然是多数人口的偏好方面的无能。
en: In response, however, more pragmatic voters are increasingly irate about political paralysis and their governing institutions’ inability to respond to the preferences of a clear majority of the population.

zh: 在政府关门期间，共和党全国选民支持率下降到四分之一，达到了历史最低点，而对全体国会的支持率只有5 % 。
en: In the midst of the shutdown, the Republican Party’s popular approval rating sank to barely a quarter of the national electorate, a historic low, while the approval rating for Congress as a whole stood at just 5%.

zh: 政府关门的最后一个教训是所有种类的政治制度因为更多女性的参与而受益。
en: The final lesson of the shutdown is that political systems of every kind benefit from the addition of women.

zh: 许多人提到了六位女性参议员 — — 既有共和党也有民主党 — — 在达成结束危机所必须的妥协中所扮演的关键角色。
en: Many commented on the critical role played by six women senators – Republicans and Democrats – in reaching the compromises needed to end the crisis.

zh: 这些女性在党派分歧之中保持着彼此之间的关系，而他们的男同事之间的关系却在稳步恶化，逐渐演变为争相哗众取宠和互相谩骂。
en: These women have maintained relationships with one another across the partisan divide, while those among their male colleagues have steadily deteriorated, giving way to competitive grandstanding and vituperation.

zh: 同样重要的是，这些女性感受到了实际治理的道德必要性，并据此行动。
en: Equally important, these women felt – and acted upon – the moral necessity of actually governing.

zh: 用缅因州共和党参议员苏珊·柯林斯（Susan Collins）的话说，政府关门对其缅因州阿卡迪亚国家公园（Acadia National Park ）周边“所有小企业都造成了伤害 ” ， “这是完全错误的。 ”是她首先提出了和解协议纲要并送交参议院。
en: In the words of Senator Susan Collins, a Republican from Maine who first put together the outlines of a deal and took it to the Senate floor, the shutdown “hurt all the small businesses” around Acadia National Park in her home state, “and that is plain wrong.”

zh: 世界应该引起注意。
en: The world should note.

zh: 女性并不天生比男性更能治国，但她们通常拥有不同的视角和交际习惯，这对于打破捍卫男性自尊需要竖立起来的藩篱十分重要。
en: Women are not necessarily better than men at governing, but they often have different perspectives and habits of engagement that can be essential for cutting through the standoffs created by the need to defend male egos.

zh: 她们通常也更关注人民的实际境况而不是坚持大原则，更喜欢形而下的进展而不是形而上的胜利。
en: They are also often more focused on the plight of actual people than on the promotion of grand principles, preferring concrete progress to abstract victory.

zh: 从议会到和平谈判，增加女性角色能让结果更好。
en: From parliaments to peace negotiations, adding women improves outcomes.

zh: 眼下美国政府已经重新开张。
en: The US government is back at work, for now.

zh: 关于所有各方都能接受的真正预算的谈判正在开始。
en: Negotiations for a real budget that all sides can live with are beginning.

zh: 人多人都在评估政府关门对共和党2014年中期选举的影响。
en: And assessments of how the shutdown will affect the Republican Party’s fortunes in the 2014 midterm elections are rife.

zh: 但美国的社会和经济分歧终究会找到政治解决方案，通过选举和千百万美国人的努力实现根本性改革。
en: But the country’s social and economic divisions will ultimately find political solutions, through elections and the efforts of millions of Americans to achieve fundamental reforms.

zh: 最近几周令人沮丧和尴尬，但若不是在美国，局面有可能糟得多。
en: As frustrating and embarrassing as the last several weeks have been, it could have been much worse.

zh: 阻止俄罗斯从叙利亚开始
en: Stopping Russia Starts in Syria

zh: 华盛顿—从某种意义上说，解决乌克兰危机的方法在于叙利亚。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The solution to the crisis in Ukraine lies in part in Syria.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马应该表明他能够在某些状态下下达军事进攻的命令，而不只是秘密的无人机打击和隐蔽行动。
en: It is time for US President Barack Obama to demonstrate that he can order the offensive use of force in circumstances other than secret drone attacks or covert operations.

zh: 其结果不但将改变大马士革，也将改变莫斯科的战略算盘，更不用说北京和东京了。
en: The result will change the strategic calculus not only in Damascus, but also in Moscow, not to mention Beijing and Tokyo.

zh: 许多人认为，去年8月奥巴马在威胁对叙利亚发动导弹袭击的基础上有所退让，这使得俄罗斯总统普京放胆吞并了克里米亚。
en: Many argue that Obama’s climb-down from his threatened missile strikes against Syria last August emboldened Russian President Vladimir Putin to annex Crimea.

zh: 但更有可能普京是因为国内原因才吞并了克里米亚 — — 为了将俄罗斯人的注意力从国家经济不景气上移开，也是为了一雪亲欧示威者推翻他所支持的乌克兰政府的耻辱。
en: But it is more likely that Putin acted for domestic reasons – to distract Russians’ attention from their country’s failing economy and to salve the humiliation of watching pro-European demonstrators oust the Ukrainian government he backed.

zh: 不管普京的初始动机如何，现在，他是在洞察各种环境状况的情况下行动。
en: Regardless of Putin’s initial motivations, he is now operating in an environment in which he is quite certain of the parameters of play.

zh: 他正在进行权衡：一边进一步肢解乌克兰、将其中一部分并入俄罗斯或称为俄罗斯附庸国；另一边是更严厉、更全面的经济制裁带来的痛苦。
en: He is weighing the value of further dismemberment of Ukraine, with some pieces either joining Russia or becoming Russian vassal states, against the pain of much stronger and more comprehensive economic sanctions.

zh: 西方动用武力，而不只是向倒霉的乌克兰军队提供武器，这不在普京的考虑范围内。
en: Western use of force, other than to send arms to a fairly hapless Ukrainian army, is not part of the equation.

zh: 问题就在这里。
en: That is a problem.

zh: 在叙利亚的例子中，世界上最大、最灵活的军事强国美国选择了在三年的时间里自缚双手参与谈判。
en: In the case of Syria, the US, the world’s largest and most flexible military power, has chosen to negotiate with its hands tied behind its back for more than three years.

zh: 在俄罗斯的例子中，美国犯下的错误不亚于此，而像普京这样的领导人是以野性气概衡量自身和其他领导人的。
en: This is no less of a mistake in the case of Russia, with a leader like Putin who measures himself and his fellow leaders in terms of crude machismo.

zh: 应该改变普京的算盘，而叙利亚是理想的着手点。
en: It is time to change Putin’s calculations, and Syria is the place to do it.

zh: 通过坚壁清野、饥饿、低温和现在弹片四射的桶状炸弹，叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德的��队正在获得优势。
en: Through a combination of mortars that shatter entire city quarters, starvation, hypothermia, and now barrel bombs that spray nails and shrapnel indiscriminately, President Bashar al-Assad’s forces have seized the advantage.

zh: 政府正在缓慢但稳健地夺回叛军控制的领土。
en: Slowly but surely, the government is reclaiming rebel-held territory.

zh: “现实主义”外交政策分析家公开称，论残忍，巴沙尔其实比不上基地组织支持的反对派；其他人认为让各方缠斗不休、以一个一个倒下的方式打上几年仗更有利。
en: “Realist” foreign policy analysts openly describe Assad as the lesser evil compared to the Al Qaeda-affiliated members of the opposition; others see an advantage in letting all sides fight it out, tying one another down for years.

zh: 此外，叙利亚政府似乎正在逐渐放弃化学武器，遵守了去年8月的协议。
en: Moreover, the Syrian government does appear to be slowly giving up its chemical weapons, as it agreed last September to do.

zh: 问题在于，如果巴沙尔继续认为他可以对他的人民为所欲为，只要不用化学武器杀戮他们就行，那么他会对反对派赶尽杀绝，杀掉所有俘虏，并惩罚整个社区，正如其父哈菲兹·阿萨德在1982年屠杀哈马（Hama）居民。
en: The problem is that if Assad continues to believe that he can do anything to his people except kill them with chemicals, he will exterminate his opponents, slaughtering everyone he captures and punishing entire communities, just as his father, Hafez al-Assad, massacred the residents of Hama in 1982.

zh: 他一再表明自己不会如此残忍。
en: He has demonstrated repeatedly that he is cut from the same ruthless cloth.

zh: 自叙利亚冲突爆发以来，巴沙尔一直在煽动恐惧，宣传逊尼派反对势力一旦得势将如何对付阿拉维派、德鲁兹派、基督徒和其他少数派。
en: Since the beginning of the Syrian conflict, Assad has fanned fears of what Sunni opposition forces might do to the Alawites, Druze, Christians and other minorities if they won.

zh: 。 但我们必须要猜测巴沙尔的行为。
en: But we need not speculate about Assad’s behavior.

zh: 我们已经看得够多了。
en: We have seen enough.

zh: 现在，美国对叙利亚的打击将改变整个局面。
en: A US strike against the Syrian government now would change the entire dynamic.

zh: 美国可以迫使巴沙尔政权回到谈判桌上，真心实意地寻求和解，至少可以让巴沙尔明确知道要想随心所欲地重建统治是不可能的。
en: It would either force the regime back to the negotiating table with a genuine intention of reaching a settlement, or at least make it clear that Assad will not have a free hand in re-establishing his rule.

zh: 只要俄罗斯还在联合国安理会，就不可能对叙利亚采取合法打击，因为俄罗斯可以否决任何授权动武的决议。
en: It is impossible to strike Syria legally so long as Russia sits on the United Nations Security Council, given its ability to veto any resolution authorizing the use of force.

zh: 但即便是俄罗斯也同意了2月的2139号决议，敦促叙利亚政府增加面向饥饿和受伤公民的人道主义援助。
en: But even Russia agreed in February to Resolution 2139, designed to compel the Syrian government to increase flows of humanitarian aid to starving and wounded civilians.

zh: 此外，2139号决议要求“各方立刻停止一切针对平民的袭击，以及在人口密集区无差别地使用武器，包括炮击和空袭，比如使用桶状炸弹 … … ”
en: Among other things, Resolution 2139 requires that “all parties immediately cease all attacks against civilians, as well as the indiscriminate employment of weapons in populated areas, including shelling and aerial bombardment, such as the use of barrel bombs….”

zh: 美国应该争取尽可能多的国家的合作，使用武力消灭叙利亚的固定翼飞机，以此作为实施2139号决议的第一步。
en: The US, together with as many countries as will cooperate, could use force to eliminate Syria’s fixed-wing aircraft as a first step toward enforcing Resolution 2139.

zh: “空袭”仍可能通过直升机继续进行，但这样的空袭不啻于宣布局面已经改变。
en: “Aerial bombardment” would still likely continue via helicopter, but such a strike would announce immediately that the game has changed.

zh: 在袭击后，美国、法国应该要求安理会批准它们已经采取的行动，就像1999年北约干预科索沃一样。
en: After the strike, the US, France, and Britain should ask for the Security Council’s approval of the action taken, as they did after NATO’s intervention in Kosovo in 1999.

zh: 同样重要的是，美国在叙利亚的开火将在俄罗斯引起巨大的回响。
en: Equally important, shots fired by the US in Syria will echo loudly in Russia.

zh: 巨大的讽刺是，普京今天在乌克兰所做的正是巴沙尔成功地做过的：将合法政治反对派描绘成暴徒和恐怖分子，依靠挑衅和谎言将非暴力示威转变为暴力袭击，以此为借口采取武装干预。
en: The great irony is that Putin is now seeking to do in Ukraine exactly what Assad has done so successfully: portray a legitimate political opposition as a gang of thugs and terrorists, while relying on provocations and lies to turn non-violent protest into violent attacks that then justify an armed response.

zh: 回忆一下，叙利亚反对派冒着炮火和平游行后六个月，自由叙利亚军（Free Syrian Army）才第一次尝试性地集结起来。
en: Recall that the Syrian opposition marched peacefully under fire for six months before the first units of the Free Syrian Army tentatively began to form.

zh: 在乌克兰，普京乐于见到和平反对派驱逐腐败政府演变为内战。
en: In Ukraine, Putin would be happy to turn a peaceful opposition’s ouster of a corrupt government into a civil war.

zh: 普京可能认为，正如西方列强一再告诉本国公民的那样，北约部队不会冒着核战争的风险向乌克兰派兵。
en: Putin may believe, as Western powers have repeatedly told their own citizens, that NATO forces will never risk the possibility of nuclear war by deploying in Ukraine.

zh: 也许并非如此。
en: Perhaps not.

zh: 但动摇东乌克兰的俄军没有任何标识。
en: But the Russian forces destabilizing eastern Ukraine wear no insignia.

zh: 这些神秘军队可以为任何一方而战。
en: Mystery soldiers can fight on both sides.

zh: 在解决乌克兰危机时将武力摆上台面、甚至在叙利亚动武是非常重要的，因为作为西方最重要应对措施之一的向俄罗斯施加经济压力大额做法可能会引起普京的桀骜不驯。
en: Putting force on the table in resolving the Ukraine crisis, even force used in Syria, is particularly important because economic pressure on Russia, as critical as it is in the Western portfolio of responses, can create a perverse incentive for Putin.

zh: 随着俄罗斯卢布的贬值和外国投资的枯竭，俄罗斯人民将躁动不安，普京也更有理由用欢迎更多“俄罗斯人”回归祖国怀抱的爱国场景转移他们的注意力。
en: As the Russian ruble falls and foreign investment dries up, the Russian population will become restive, giving him even more reason to distract them with patriotic spectacles welcoming still more “Russians” back to the motherland.

zh: 奥巴马是带着结束战争而不是开启战争的目标入主白宫的。
en: Obama took office with the aim of ending wars, not starting them.

zh: 但如果美国用言辞来对应子弹，那么暴君就会打起自己的算盘。
en: But if the US meets bullets with words, tyrants will draw their own conclusions.

zh: 盟友亦然，比如，眼下日本就在困惑，如果中国在存在争议的钓鱼岛掀起危机，美国会如何应对。
en: So will allies; Japan, for example, is now wondering how the US will respond should China manufacture a crisis over the disputed Senkaku Islands.

zh: 要想在国家和全球利益上起到有效的领导作用，美国必须证明它时刻准备着承担大国的责任。
en: To lead effectively, in both the national and the global interest, the US must demonstrate its readiness to shoulder the full responsibilities of power.

zh: 打击叙利亚可能不会终结那里的内战，但可以防止乌克兰爆发新内战。
en: Striking Syria might not end the civil war there, but it could prevent the eruption of a new one in Ukraine.

zh: 习近平的改革配方
en: Xi’s Recipe

zh: 华盛顿 — — 中国政府正严厉打击西方记者。 为报复纽约时报和彭博社记者对中国高官贪腐行为的报道，中国政府威胁不再为他们续签签证。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – China’s government is cracking down hard on Western journalists, threatening not to renew visas for reporters from the New York Times and Bloomberg in retaliation for their reporting on the corruption of senior Chinese officials.

zh: 泰晤士报专栏作家托马斯·弗里德曼不久前写了一封公开信致中国政府，指出因为“贪婪腐败是历史上中国政权灭亡的首要原因 ” ， 新闻自由更能帮助而不是伤害中国政府。
en: Times columnist Thomas Friedman recently penned an open letter to the Chinese government telling them that, because the top “cause of death of Chinese regimes in history is greed and corruption,” a free press is more likely to help than hurt.

zh: 相信新闻自由和言论自由同属普世人权的人都会赞同弗里德曼的立场。
en: Anyone who holds freedom of the press and freedom of expression to be universal human rights will agree with Friedman’s position.

zh: 但中国政治 — — 包括权利政治，总是掺杂着经济因素。
en: But, in China, politics – including the politics of rights – is always intertwined with economics.

zh: 上个月，习近平在中央委员会十一届三中全会上宣布了全套改革措施，提出了“实现中华民族伟大复兴” 的目标。
en: Last month, President Xi Jinping announced a set of sweeping economic reforms at the Central Committee’s Third Plenum, setting forth his vision of “the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.”

zh: 他的60点计划包括落实制定存贷款市场利率的财政政策及财政部门改革，允许私营投资者参与国有企业、活跃中小企业、放宽劳动力限制以及征收房产税增加地方政府收入。
en: His 60-point plan included reforms of fiscal policy and the financial sector that would set market interest rates on loans and deposits, permit some private-investor participation in state-owned enterprises, increase the role of small and medium-size enterprises, loosen labor restrictions, and introduce property taxes to boost revenue for local authorities.

zh: 上述重新投入市场怀抱的政策让人联想起1979年邓小平最初那次资本主义转向，当时的政策令中国根深蒂固的企业及政府精英一直如骨鲠在喉。
en: This renewed embrace of the market, reminiscent of Deng Xiaoping’s original turn to capitalism in 1979, will be hard medicine for China’s entrenched business and government elites to swallow.

zh: 如果习政府执政成功 — — 这当中具有很大的不确定性 — — 其改革或许可以帮助中国完成从出口驱动型经济和政府投资到以国内消费为基础的可持续增长模式的必要过渡。
en: If Xi’s administration is successful – a big if – its reforms may enable China to negotiate the necessary transition from an economy driven by exports and government investment to a more sustainable growth model based on domestic consumption.

zh: 其中涉及非常高的赌注。
en: The stakes are high.

zh: 这个过去二十年曾成功令亿万人脱贫的国家现在必须设法保护并逐步扩大这些成果，同时为依然贫困的亿万人口创造同样的奇迹。
en: A country that has lifted hundreds of millions of people out of poverty over the last two decades must now find a way to safeguard and gradually increase those gains while engineering the same miracle for the hundreds of millions still left behind.

zh: 中国改革计划成功将对世界产生难以估量的经济政治和道德影响。
en: The world has a significant economic, political, and moral interest in the success of China’s reform agenda.

zh: 在上述背景下，了解习的经济改革只是这杯精心调制鸡尾酒的成分之一非常重要。
en: In this context, it is important to understand that Xi’s economic reforms are only one ingredient of a carefully crafted cocktail.

zh: 配方的其余部分包括两份颇受欢迎的社会改革 — — 结束众多中国家长的一胎政策、废除“劳动教养”制度，以及一份政治镇压。
en: The rest of the recipe includes two parts popular social reforms – an end to the one-child policy for many Chinese parents and the abolition of “reeducation through labor” – and one part political crackdown.

zh: 强化审查和恐吓外国记者，以及监禁并更严格限制持不同政见者都是为了确保经济混乱不会导致政治叛乱的后果。
en: Increased censorship and intimidation of foreign journalists, together with the imprisonment of dissidents and tighter restrictions on dissent, are an effort to ensure that economic disruption does not give rise to political rebellion.

zh: 为推行雄心勃勃的改革计划，习近平采取了多项举措巩固其个人及官僚权力。
en: To implement his ambitious reform agenda, Xi has taken several steps to consolidate his personal and bureaucratic power.

zh: 他把政治局委员从9人精简至7人，从而降低了制度化集体领导体制下达成共识的难度。
en: He has reduced the membership of the Politburo from nine to seven, making it easier to obtain agreement in a system designed to institutionalize collective leadership.

zh: 他还扩大了由自己领导的中央委员会的权力，设立了新的国家安全委员会。
en: He has increased the power of the Central Committee, which he chairs. And he has created a new State Security Council.

zh: 了解国家安全委员会如何满足习的集权需求可以参考美国的例子。
en: To understand how the State Security Council could serve Xi’s interest in centralizing power, consider the United States.

zh: 没有国家安全委员会和国内政策委员会，美国总统就没有常规方法控制协调各式官僚机构。
en: Without the National Security Council and the Domestic Policy Council, the US president would have no routine way to control and coordinate different bureaucracies.

zh: 供职于国家安全委员会的白宫工作人员召集国务院、国防部、财政部，司法部及其他重要机构官员就特定政策发表意见。
en: White House staff working for the National Security Council call meetings at which officials from the State Department, Defense Department, Treasury, Justice Department, and other key agencies hash out their views on a given policy.

zh: 但引导结果走向及确定今后步骤的却是总统的手下。
en: But it is the president’s staff who guide the outcome and determines the next steps.

zh: 习强化实力的举措让观察者确信他当真要推行改革计划。
en: Xi’s moves to strengthen his hand have helped to convince observers that he means business with the reform agenda.

zh: 自十一届三中全会结束习的改革计划公诸于世以来，许多中国观察家都称赞他是邓小平以来最具变革精神的领导者。
en: Since the Third Plenum ended and the scope of Xi’s reforms has become clear, many China watchers have hailed him as the most transformative leader since Deng.

zh: 时间会告诉我们答案，但2014年和1979年的关键区别是今天这杯中国鸡尾酒中掺杂着恐惧。
en: Time will tell, but a key difference between 2014 and 1979 is that today the Chinese cocktail is spiked with fear.

zh: 埃文·奥斯诺斯曾在《纽约客》撰文报导两年前阿拉伯起义期间，一名高官在北京一次会议上表示如果中国政府在社会媒体促成的全球持不同意见运动中“发生动摇 ” ， “国家将会陷入到深渊之中。
en: Evan Osnos, writing in The New Yorker, reports that two years ago, in the midst of the Arab uprisings, a senior official told a meeting in Beijing that if the Chinese government “waver[ed]” in the midst of social-media-fueled global dissidence, “the state could sink into the abyss.”

zh: ”不久前奥斯诺斯报导一名中国高级外交官在解释政府威胁驱逐纽约时报和彭博社记者的理由时说“纽约时报和彭博社只想让共产党下台，因此不能允许他们继续这样做。 ”
en: Recently, Osnos writes, a high-level Chinese diplomat explained the threatened expulsion of New York Times and Bloomberg journalists on the grounds that “the Times and Bloomberg were seeking nothing short of removing the Communist Party from power, and that they must not be allowed to continue.”

zh: 那种恐惧是驱动习改革计划的重要力量。
en: That fear is one of the principal forces driving Xi’s reform agenda.

zh: 共产党必须保持中国经济增长（即使增长相对缓慢 ） ， 同时与猖獗的腐败现象斗争，响应民众的需求。
en: The Communist Party must keep the Chinese economy growing (even if more slowly), while fighting rampant corruption and responding to citizens’ demands.

zh: 中国民众无权投票，但他们却能够表达自己的不满，这使得中国官僚所谓的“维稳”显得至关重要。
en: Chinese citizens cannot vote, but they can – and do – make their displeasure known, which places a premium on what Chinese bureaucrats call “stability maintenance.”

zh: 独裁者学习曲线的作者威尔·多布森形容中国政府的实质是专家政府，其合法性建立在有效的解决问题之上。
en: Will Dobson, author of The Dictator’s Learning Curve, describes the Chinese government as a technocracy whose legitimacy is founded on efficient problem-solving.

zh: “当政权合法性与表现挂钩时 ， “ 他提出 ， “ 任何危机 — — 以及政党所采取的对策 — — 都可以演变成质疑其是否有权执政。 ”
en: “When a regime’s legitimacy is derived from its performance,” he argues, “any crisis – and how the party responds to it – can raise existential questions about the regime’s right to rule.”

zh: 中国领导人显然担心在中国境内开展西式新闻调查可能会引发这样的危机。
en: China’s leaders apparently worry that Western-style investigative journalism inside China could trigger just such a crisis.

zh: 无论如何，他们都不会冒险这么做。
en: In any case, they are taking no chances.

zh: 他们相信自己可以处理好丑闻，自上而下地推动经济、社会和政治改革。
en: They are placing their faith in their ability to wash their own dirty laundry and drive economic, social, and political change from the top down.

zh: 他们越来越不愿意遵守西方的规则。
en: And they are less and less willing to play by Western rules.

zh: 德国站出来
en: Germany Steps Up

zh: 华盛顿—自开始第一个任期以来，美国总统奥巴马一直在重复对其他国家的咒语 ： “ 责任与实力共存 ” 。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Since the start of his first administration, US President Barack Obama has repeated a simple mantra concerning other countries: “With power comes responsibility.”

zh: 法国一再证明了它理解并承担了这一责任；现在或许该轮到德国了。
en: France has demonstrated repeatedly that it understands and accepts this responsibility; Germany may now be following suit.

zh: 几周前，德国总统高克在第50届慕尼黑安全会议上发表开幕词，回顾了德意志联邦共和国在过去五十年中的历史，这个时期崛起了“一个好德国，一个锁门所知的最好的德国 ” 。
en: Several weeks ago, German President Joachim Gauck’s opening address to the 50th annual Munich Security Conference reflected on the Federal Republic’s evolution over those five decades, a period that gave rise to “a good Germany, the best we have ever known.”

zh: 此外，德国比其他大部分国家更多地得益于当前开放的、基于价值的国际秩序，因此高克说，德国也有更大责任捍卫和扩大这一秩序。
en: And, because Germany benefits more than most countries from the current open, value-based international order, it has, Gauck said, a greater responsibility to defend and extend that order.

zh: 高克的演讲反映了一篇重要新报告道中的思想。 这篇报告由政治和科学基金会（Stiftung Wissenschaft und Politik）以及美国德国马歇尔基金会（German Marshall Fund of the United States ） ， 题目是《新大国、新责任 》 （ New Power, New Responsibility ） 。
en: Gauck’s speech reflected the thinking in an important new report, entitled New Power, New Responsibility, released by the Stiftung Wissenschaft und Politik and the German Marshall Fund of the United States.

zh: 报告产生于为期七个月的德国外交政策和安全界的内部讨论，认为德国的当前价值和利益是致力于“人类尊严、自由、民主、法治精神，以及基于普世规范的国际秩序 ” 。
en: The report – the product of several months of debate within the German foreign-policy and security community – identifies Germany’s current values and interests as a commitment to “human dignity, freedom, democracy, the rule of law, and to an international order that is based on universal norms.”

zh: 正如高克所指出的，德国的“最高战略目标”必须是“保护和持续调整”这一秩序。
en: As Gauck proclaimed, Germany’s “overriding strategic objective” must be the “preservation and continued adaptation” of this order.

zh: 为了实现这一目标，德国必须成为“有决定力的大国 ” （ shaping power ） ， 成为一个有能力为部分甚至全体国际社会解决问题、消弭冲突的国家。
en: To achieve this objective, Germany must become a “shaping power,” a state with the ability to solve problems and resolve conflicts affecting all or part of the international community.

zh: 一国相对于其他国家的实力的传统维度 — — 地理、人口、经济实力和军事实力 — — 仍然很重要，但通常并不足以在国际政治中施加实际影响力。
en: The traditional determinants of states’ power relative to other states – geography, demography, economic heft, and military might, coupled with the availability of resources and technological proficiency – remain important; but they are often insufficient to confer actual influence in international politics.

zh: 有决定力的大国构建关系、投资制度，从而使其能够与其他国家精诚合作并建立和动员“思维相近的国家的联盟和网络 ” 。
en: A shaping power builds relationships and invests in institutions that allow it to work well with others and to create and mobilize “coalitions and networks of like-minded states.”

zh: 作为在保护和扩展国际体系开放性上利益巨大的具有决定力的大国，德国有着帮助全球新大国融���这一体系的特殊责任。
en: As a shaping power with an enormous stake in preserving and extending the openness of the international system, Germany has a special responsibility to help integrate new global powers into that system.

zh: 局面的要害之处正在于此。
en: Here is where things get interesting.

zh: 德国早就开始寻求联合国安理会的常任理事国席位，同样有这一目标的还有日本、巴西和印度。
en: Germany has long sought a seat on the United Nations Security Council, making common cause with Japan, Brazil, and India.

zh: 但《新大国、新责任》指出了一条不同的路径，提出了新的安理会改革方案，将英国和法国的席位合并为永久的欧洲席位，从而“略微扩大常任理事国数量 ” ， 同时确保欧洲的非常任理事国数量。
en: But New Power, New Responsibility suggests a different path, arguing for the reform of the Security Council in a way that would merge the French and British seats into a permanent European seat in a “slightly enlarged circle of permanent members,” while also ensuring European representation among the non-permanent members.

zh: 根据这一情形，德国将通过欧洲席位扮演全球和平和安全方面的角色，同时也可以担任非常任理事国。
en: Under this scenario, Germany would play a role in global peace and security through the European seat, as well as serving as a periodic rotating member.

zh: 此外，德国认为有必要整合欧洲在其他全球机构（如国际货币基金组织和世界银行）的投票权、减少其席位，以便为新兴大国创造空间。
en: Moreover, Germany recognizes the need to consolidate Europe’s voting power and reduce the number of European seats in other global institutions, such as the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank, to make room for emerging powers.

zh: 这一新的“强大而团结的欧洲”的承诺是二十一世纪德国外交政策的第二支柱。
en: This renewed commitment to a strong and united Europe is the second pillar of a twenty-first-century German foreign policy.

zh: 《新大国、新责任》提出通过一系列措施“深化”欧盟，包括让国家议会直接参与其中，并对成员国政府施加更紧的欧洲财政约束，以此换取欧洲银行联盟欧盟、欧元区预算和欧元债券，从而实现金融决策民主化。
en: New Power, New Responsibility calls for “deepening” the European Union through measures that would include democratizing EU financial decision-making by directly engaging national parliamentarians and exchanging tighter European fiscal constraints on member governments’ budgets for a European banking union, a eurozone budget, and Eurobonds.

zh: 在外交和安全政策方面 ， 《 新大国、新责任》提出加强欧盟高级代表和欧洲行动局（European Action Service）的作用。
en: In foreign and security policy, New Power, New Responsibility proposes strengthening the role of the EU High Representative and the role of the European Action Service.

zh: 现任欧盟高级代表凯瑟琳·阿什顿（Catherine Ashton）继续证明着欧盟外交政策机构的价值，比如，她牵线促成了塞尔维亚和科索沃之间的重要和平协议，在对伊朗核谈判方面也起到了关键作用。
en: Current EU High Representative Catherine Ashton continues to prove the worth of EU foreign-policy institutions by, for example, brokering a remarkable peace between Serbia and Kosovo and playing a key role in nuclear negotiations with Iran.

zh: 第三个惊奇之处来自对武力的使用。
en: The third surprise concerns the use of force.

zh: 高克以明确的口吻告诉德国人，他们必须准备好使用武力，至少将使用武力作为最后选择，并指责一些德国同胞“拿德国过去的罪行当借口偷懒或实现脱离世界的愿望。 ”
en: Gauck told Germans in no uncertain terms that they had to be willing to use force, at least as a last resort, and reproached those of his fellow citizens “who use Germany’s guilt for its past as a shield for laziness or a desire to disengage from the world.”

zh: 更具争议的是，高克提出任何武力行动都需要安理会的授权，但他也暗示科索沃可以作为军事干预叙利亚的先例。
en: More controversially, Gauck proclaimed the need for Security Council authorization of any use of force, but also hinted at a Kosovo precedent for possible military intervention in Syria.

zh: 他指出，当国际社会面临显而易见的局面，需要使用武力保护人民不受本国政府伤害，但联合国安理会又无法形成统一意见时 ， “ 合法性与合理性之间的关系就会成为阻碍因素。 ”
en: As he put it, when the international community confronts a clear case for the use of force to protect a population from its own government, but the Security Council is divided, “the relationship between legality and legitimacy will continue to be awkward.”

zh: 在审议《新大国、新责任》的观点时，在这一问题上形成了分歧。
en: The participants in the deliberations that resulted in New Power, New Responsibility split on this question.

zh: 一些人认为安理会授权是必不可少的绝对条件，也有人认为在没有授权的情况下出于权宜之计进行人道主义干预可以成为“严格定义的例外情形 ” 。
en: Some argued for an absolute requirement of Security Council authorization, while others recognized an imperative to contemplate humanitarian intervention without such authorization in “very narrowly defined exceptional cases.”

zh: 美国国务卿克里也在慕尼黑安全会议上发表了讲话。
en: US Secretary of State John Kerry also spoke at the Munich Security Conference.

zh: 但是，他并没有提到高克的发言，因此也错失了一次强调奥巴马的一条关键外交政策原则大获成功的机会：随着美国不再充当世界警察、将更多的注意力转向外交而不是武力时，其他国家必须站出来。
en: But, by not referring to Gauck’s speech, he missed an opportunity to underline the success of one of Obama’s key foreign-policy tenets: as the US steps back from its role as global policeman and focuses more on diplomacy than force, other countries must step up.

zh: 更重要的是，克里和奥巴马可以深思高克的演讲及其背后的报告中所包含的一条关键教训。
en: Even more important, Kerry and Obama would do well to think hard about a key lesson embedded in Gauck’s speech and the report behind it.

zh: 希望在变幻莫测的全球秩序中保持实力的国家必须学会分享它，而这又需要接受并拥抱新的世界格局。
en: Countries that want to retain power in a changing global order must learn to share it, which requires accepting and embracing the contours of a new world.

zh: 奥巴马政府应该仔细思考安理会改革问题。
en: The Obama administration should think hard about Security Council reform.

zh: 它必须释放实实在在的信号，表示愿意用反映2015年的世界的秩序取代反映1945年的世界的秩序。
en: It should signal a real willingness to replace an order that reflects the world of 1945 with one that reflects the world of 2015.

zh: 这意味着支持所有理解并接受维持全球和平与稳定的真实责任的大国扮演更重要的角色。
en: That means supporting a greater global role for all powers that understand and accept real responsibility for maintaining global peace and security.

zh: 遏制叙利亚传染病
en: Stopping the Syria Contagion

zh: 华盛顿 — — 叙利亚内战已经成为一个极其复杂的问题。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Syria’s civil war has become a wretchedly complicated problem.

zh: 由于各方即将在日内瓦举行第二轮由联合国发起的和平谈判，政府军已经对阿勒颇等城市发动了恶性炸弹袭击；包括叙利亚自由军在内的温和派伊斯兰叛乱团体都在与基地组织分支机构公开作战；同时基地组织相关机构也内讧纷起。
en: As the parties prepare to meet in Geneva for the second round of United Nations-sponsored peace talks, the government has launched vicious barrel-bomb attacks on Aleppo and other cities; more moderate Islamist rebel groups, including the Free Syrian Army, are openly at war with Al Qaeda affiliates; and Al Qaeda-linked groups are now fighting among themselves.

zh: 此外，战争对别国的影响也越来越严重。
en: Meanwhile, the war’s spillover effects are worsening.

zh: 战斗加剧了地区不稳定局势；美国和欧洲公民正涌入叙利亚参加圣战；而且一战后中东边界正在解体的看法也越来越被人们所接受。
en: The fighting has heightened instability in the region; US and European citizens are streaming into Syria to take up jihad; and there is a growing consensus that the post-World War I Middle East boundaries are coming undone.

zh: 事实上，由外部势力支持的多个武装团体正在威胁叙利亚这个多民族国家的生存 — — 伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔、俄罗斯、美国、土耳其、法国和众多私人捐助者的目标都相互冲突。
en: Indeed, the viability of Syria, a multi-ethnic state, is being threatened by multiple armed groups supported by external sponsors – Iran, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Russia, the United States, Turkey, France, and many private donors – who themselves have conflicting aims.

zh: 有三种方法可以简化事态，让第二次日内瓦和平会议的参与者不仅就召开第三次日内瓦会议达成共识。
en: Here are three ways to simplify the equation and maximize the chances that the parties to the Geneva II peace conference will be able to agree on more than the desirability of someday holding a Geneva III.

zh: 首先，此次会议能为叙利亚谈判及政治过渡所做最主要的贡献是改变主要当事方的动机。
en: First, the most important contribution that this conference can make to the possibility of a negotiated settlement and a political transition in Syria is to change the principal parties’ incentives.

zh: 在第二次日内瓦会议召开之前，各方都竭力通过多杀敌人和坚守或夺回阵地来巩固自己在谈判桌上的位置。
en: In the run-up to Geneva II, each party has sought to strengthen its hand at the negotiating table by killing as many adversaries and holding or regaining as much ground as possible.

zh: 未来和平缔造者目前的任务是制止这样的趋势进一步发展，以及不管巴沙尔·阿萨德总统届时是否在任，制定最终选举的参选标准。
en: The task now for would-be peace brokers is to halt that dynamic by agreeing on criteria for participation in whatever elections will eventually be held, regardless of whether President Bashar al-Assad remains in power until then.

zh: 上述标准必须包括当事方允许人道主义援助流向控制区域的所有叙利亚民众、结束大面积袭击医务工作者、饿死被围困民众和处决战俘等战争及反人类罪行。
en: Those criteria must include the parties’ willingness to allow humanitarian aid to flow to all Syrian civilians under their control and an end to war crimes and crimes against humanity, including systematic targeting of medical personnel, starvation of populations under siege, and executions of war prisoners.

zh: 联合国必须在此重申其“保护责任”原则，这样做不是为了军事干预寻找借口，而是强调政府对民众负有保护责任这项各国达成共识的基本原则。
en: Here the UN must reaffirm its “responsibility to protect” doctrine, not as a justification for military intervention, but as a fundamental principle agreed by all countries: governments must protect their citizens.

zh: 如果阿萨德的阿拉伯复兴社会党无法承担这样的责任，它就自动放弃��参与未来任何政府的合法理由。
en: If Assad’s Ba’ath party cannot uphold that responsibility, it forfeits its own legitimacy as a participant in any future government.

zh: 其次，国际社会必须重新奠定接触的基础。
en: Second, the international community must re-establish the basis for its engagement.

zh: 叙利亚冲突开始时还属于内部事务，联合国仅扮演人道主义和难民救援等角色。
en: When the Syrian conflict began, it was an internal matter, with UN involvement limited to humanitarian and refugee issues.

zh: 但现在冲突已蔓延至整个中东地区，导致黎巴嫩约旦动荡并有可能分裂伊拉克。
en: But now the conflict has spread across the Middle East, destabilizing Lebanon and Jordan and threatening to fracture Iraq.

zh: 联合国安理会有责任惩罚违约者及消除国际和平威胁，目前这两项标准显然已经满足。
en: The UN Security Council is charged with addressing breaches or threats to international peace, a criterion that is now clearly met.

zh: 安理会常任理事国俄国因此有义务采取行动；它（和中国）不能再用联合国不应介入叙利亚内政来充当借口。
en: As a permanent member of the Security Council, Russia thus has an obligation to act; it (and China) can no longer hide behind the argument that the UN should not be engaged in Syria’s internal affairs.

zh: 值此索契冬奥会使俄国成为国际焦点的重要时刻，美国和其他安理会成员国应当制定系列决议，正面要求克里姆林宫履行其职责或者施加影响结束冲突。
en: At a time when the Winter Olympic Games in Sochi put Russia squarely on the international stage, the US and other Security Council members should plan a series of resolutions that confront the Kremlin with the choice of meeting its responsibility or applying its own leverage to bring the conflict to an end.

zh: 最后，恢复可靠的武力威胁是美国总统奥巴马可以采取的最重要步骤。
en: Finally, the single most important step that US President Barack Obama could take is to put the credible threat of force back on the table.

zh: 在血腥程度不断升级的三年冲突中，阿萨德相信面临美国导弹袭击时取得了唯一的一次外交成功。
en: In three years of increasingly bloody conflict, the only diplomatic success was achieved when Assad believed that he faced US missile strikes.

zh: 他突然认识到销毁化学武器的益处。
en: He suddenly saw the desirability of getting rid of his chemical weapons.

zh: 但多数专家认为不可能进行军事打击。
en: But most experts believe that military force is off the table.

zh: 美国公众坚决拒绝了奥巴马严惩阿萨德反复使用化学武器的导弹袭击计划，而且最近一次皮尤民调显示多数美国人认为“美国应该在国际上管好自己的事务，让其他国家依靠自己的力量，能做到什么程度就做到什么程度。 ”
en: The US public sharply rejected Obama’s planned missile strikes to punish Assad for the repeated use of chemical weapons, and a recent Pew poll indicates that a majority of Americans believe that the US “should mind its own business internationally and let other countries get along the best they can on their own.”

zh: 尤其当涉及国家安全事务，奥巴马要做的是比民调更有眼光。
en: Obama’s job, however, is to look beyond opinion polls, particularly when it comes to safeguarding national security.

zh: 美军已经撤出阿富汗和伊拉克，但付出惨重代价取得的胜利正在逐渐丧失。
en: The US has withdrawn from Afghanistan and Iraq, but the gains so painfully won are being reversed.

zh: 基地组织重新趁虚而入，正在伊拉克西部和叙利亚东部组建他们自己的政府，正在酝酿的基地组织势力离欧洲和美国远比阿富汗山洞要近得多。
en: Al Qaeda is back and is fighting for its own proto-state in western Iraq and eastern Syria, which is far closer to Europe and the US than the caves of Afghanistan.

zh: 或许奥巴马认为自己和继任者可以今后再处理这样的威胁。
en: Perhaps Obama thinks that he or his successor can deal with that threat down the road.

zh: 如果基地组织开始从伊拉克和叙利亚等伊斯兰国家对美国构成威胁，美国可以像在阿富汗、巴基斯坦和也门所做的那样用无人机把他们消灭掉。
en: If Al Qaeda operatives begin threatening the US from the Islamic State of Iraq and Syria, the US will just take them out with drones, as it has done in Afghanistan, Pakistan, and Yemen.

zh: 但如果他愿意考虑将来在没有国际授权的情况下对基地组织使用武力，那为什么现在不能用无人机支持温和的叙利亚反对派，迫使阿萨德认真谈判？
en: But if he is willing to contemplate using force against Al Qaeda without international authorization in the future, why not use drones now to strengthen the moderate Syrian opposition and force Assad into serious negotiations?

zh: 去年9月发射巡航导弹的威胁足以让基地组织成员争相往山里逃。
en: The threat of cruise-missile strikes last September was enough to send Al Qaeda members in Syria scrambling for the hills.

zh: 旨在摧毁阿萨德空军并阻止他向民众投掷钉子炸弹的行动或许能把他的注意力集中到外交谈判上。
en: A strike designed to destroy Assad’s air force and prevent him from dropping bombs full of nails on his people would concentrate his mind on a diplomatic solution.

zh: 奥巴马应该宣布美国致力于政治解决叙利亚问题，他的政府将竭尽全力在下周和平会议及后续行动中找到这样的解决方案。
en: Obama should announce that the US is committed to a political solution in Syria, and that his government will do whatever it can to bring about such a solution through next week’s peace conference and follow-up action.

zh: 但如果停火在未来三个月内一直未能实现，那么美国应该和区域组织及叙利亚人民的朋友一道授权打击基地相关势力和阿萨德政府针对平民的杀戮机器。
en: But if a ceasefire has not been achieved in the next three months, the US should work with regional organizations and all friends of the Syrian people to authorize a set of military strikes on Al Qaeda-linked forces and on the killing machine that Assad’s government has aimed at civilians.

zh: 奥巴马政府应该向美国公众说明这直接关系到美国的安全利益。
en: The Obama administration should make the case for this to the American people in terms of straightforward US security interests.

zh: 毕竟，如果第二次日内瓦会议失败，第三次日内瓦会议就不会只涉及叙利亚问题。
en: After all, if Geneva II fails, Geneva III will not be about Syria alone.

zh: 届时人们可能需要考虑如何结束中东战争。
en: It will be about how to end a war raging across the entire Middle East.

zh: 世界杯美国
en: World Cup America

zh: 华盛顿—上个月，美国发生了一些事 — — 或者说，有一些东西显露出来。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Something changed – or perhaps was revealed – in the United States during the last month.

zh: 收看英语和西班牙语世界杯转播的美国人比以往多了好几百万。
en: Many millions more Americans watched the World Cup soccer tournament in English and Spanish than ever before.

zh: 固然，世界杯和往常一样结束了，许多人指出美国人只不过是四年关注一次，并且只关注美国的比赛。
en: True, with the World Cup’s end, many are arguing, as usual, that Americans pay attention only every four years – and only when the US is playing.

zh: 但这次有所不同：美国人在美国队被淘汰后仍然在看世界杯。
en: But this time something was different: Americans continued to watch even after the US team was eliminated.

zh: 事实上，在仲夏的周末下午，近1,500万美国人将频道锁定在巴西与德国的半决赛。
en: Indeed, on a weekday afternoon in the middle of summer, nearly 15 million Americans tuned in to the Brazil-Germany match in the semifinal.

zh: 这一数字超过了美式橄榄球球迷收看最多的电视节目 — — ESPN《周一橄榄球之夜 》 （ Monday Night Football）的常规收视率。
en: That is more than the usual viewership for ESPN’s Monday Night Football, the biggest regular television draw for fans of American football.

zh: 在我所在的组织 — — 新美国（New America ） ， 几乎所有年轻人都设法收看美国队的小组赛。
en: Almost every young person at my organization, New America, found ways to watch the US games in the early rounds.

zh: 我的公寓室友说，在她美国教育部的办公室，所有人都借口生日派对翘班收看美国与德国的比赛。
en: My apartment mate explained that everyone in her office, in the US Department of Education, had used the excuse of a birthday party to watch the US-Germany match.

zh: 美国与比利时进行八分之一决赛的那个星期二下午，科罗拉多州阿斯彭（Aspen）的每一间酒吧都坐满了人。
en: On the Tuesday afternoon when the US played Belgium in the knockout round, every bar in Aspen, Colorado, was packed.

zh: 当然，阿斯彭是美国最富的社区之一，或许并不能代表美国总体情况。
en: Of course, Aspen is one of the country’s wealthiest communities, and perhaps not representative of the US as a whole.

zh: 但从电视屏幕上我们可以看到，在美国和比利时比赛期间，堪萨斯城露天巨幕电视周围聚集了大量人群。
en: But US television showed an enormous crowd of fans in Kansas City following the US-Belgium match on a large outdoor screen.

zh: 2006年意大利和法国的决赛就没有出现这样的情景，当时，意大利几乎所有小镇都是万人空巷，大家聚集在广场看比赛；而纵观美国，人们只不过是在下班后涌入体育酒吧。
en: It was not quite the equivalent of the final match between Italy and France in 2006, when virtually every small Italian town turned out to watch on the main square; but Americans all over the country spent the month ducking out of work and into sports bars.

zh: 美国人对足球热情日渐高涨反映了美国“加入”世界的某些重要方式。
en: America’s growing embrace of soccer reflects some important ways in which the US has “joined” the world.

zh: 首先，美国队和美国足球观众受移民推动很大 — — 其中许多移民来自全民热爱体育的国家。
en: For starters, both the US team and the US audience for soccer derive their growing strength from immigrants – many from countries where the sport is a national passion.

zh: 比如，在华盛顿，几乎所有出租车司机都是新美国人。
en: For example, in Washington, DC, almost all taxi drivers are newcomers to America.

zh: 我常常遇上埃塞俄比亚司机，每逢此时，我们就会感叹埃塞俄比亚队在预选赛中被尼日利亚队淘汰，然后庆祝美国击败加纳，最后一致同意四年后 — — 顶多八年 — — 美国队将步入世界顶尖行列。
en: When my driver was Ethiopian, as often happened, we would commiserate over the national team’s defeat by Nigeria in a qualifying round, then celebrate the US defeat of Ghana, and end by agreeing that in four years, or certainly in eight, the US team would be among the world’s best.

zh: 几乎每一次，我的司机都会告诉我他的孩子在地区青年联赛踢球。
en: In almost every case, my driver would tell me that his children were playing in local youth leagues.

zh: 这些移民不但为美国提供本土足球人才；还构成了不断扩大的美国足球观众的中坚力量。
en: These immigrants are not only providing homegrown soccer talent for US teams; they are a core part of the expanding US audience for soccer worldwide.

zh: 美国体育网站布里克报告（The Bleacher Report）主写手丹·莱维（Dan Levy）指出，大部分评论员将“美国足球”定义为观看美国足球联赛中美国球员表演的美国人数量。
