en: Dan Levy, lead writer for the US sports website The Bleacher Report, points out that most commentators define “American soccer” as the number of Americans who watch American players in US league play.

zh: 显然，这样的定义是荒谬的。
en: Obviously, that is a ridiculous metric.

zh: 美国网球粉丝观看网球比赛才不会管它是在哪里比，美国高尔夫球观众也不会因为锦标赛是在高尔夫球诞生地苏格兰举行而不看它。
en: US tennis fans watch tennis wherever it is played all over the world, and the US audience for golf does not plummet when a tournament is played in the sport’s birthplace, Scotland.

zh: 更多的美国人收看欧洲和墨西哥联赛的英语和西班牙语转播，并且比收看棒球和冰球比赛更起劲。 后两者与美式橄榄球和篮球并称美国“四大”运动。
en: More Americans watch soccer in the European and Mexican leagues, in English and in Spanish, than watch baseball and ice hockey, traditionally considered two of the “big four” US sports (along with American football and basketball).

zh: 特别是，对美国人来说，世界杯是最好的平衡器。
en: For the US, in particular, the World Cup is a great equalizer.

zh: 我的母亲是比利时人，尽管她入籍美国已逾50年；我仍有舅舅、姨妈和表兄弟姐妹生活在布鲁塞尔。
en: My mother is originally Belgian, though she has been a US citizen for over 50 years; I still have an uncle, aunt, and cousins in Brussels.

zh: 在美国对阵比利时期间，我们的家庭网络上电邮满天飞，充满了友好的对立。
en: During the US-Belgium match, emails flew fast and thick across the family network, with lots of friendly rivalry.

zh: 我母亲在选择主队时有些分裂，因为毕竟比利时是“对阵强大的歌利亚的大卫 ” 。
en: My mother claimed divided loyalty, because Belgium, after all, was “the David against the mighty Goliath.”

zh: 她的三个美国孩子马上反驳说，在足球方面，美国才是大卫。
en: Her three American children all weighed in simultaneously, pointing out that in soccer it is the US that is the underdog.

zh: 其他还有什么领域能让美国体验世界舞台小国的感觉？
en: Where else can the US experience what it is like to be a small country on the global stage?

zh: 和世界各地的观众一样，美国人因为球队而团结起来，不管地方差异。
en: Like viewers around the world, Americans rooted for their team together, regardless of their domestic differences.

zh: 在阿斯彭的一间酒吧，仅有的空座位于一张桌子旁，挨着一位老者和他的女婿（他们欢迎我入座，还提出请我喝啤酒 ） ， 我们为美国队接近得分而欢呼，为美国队错失机会而扼腕。
en: At a bar in Aspen, where the only open seat was at a table with an older man and his son-in-law (who welcomed me and offered to put my beer on their tab), we cheered and groaned whenever the US got close to scoring a goal or missed a kick.

zh: 在中场休息期间，我们互相交谈，发现彼此政治阵营截然对立。
en: In the periodic short breaks, we sounded each other out enough to find out that we were definitely in opposing political camps.

zh: 如今，美国政治极化严重，因此，我想要不是世界杯，我的这两位拼桌朋友是不会愿意请我这位在国务院为希拉里·克林顿卖了两年命的人喝掉好几轮啤酒的。
en: Given the current state of polarization in US politics, I think it is likely that in most other settings, my tablemates would not willingly have bought several rounds of beer for someone who spent two years working at the State Department for Hillary Clinton.

zh: 但是，在这里，我们不为政治立场而欢呼，而是为国家队喝彩。
en: Here, though, we were cheering not for our political side, but for our national side.

zh: 美国队在球场上奋斗，政治滚得远远的。
en: As our team maneuvered the ball down the field, politics fell away.

zh: 当然，奥运会也是如此。
en: That happens at the Olympics, too, of course.

zh: 但奥运会体育大杂烩，每项比赛都有铁杆粉丝，他们会同时为自己所支持的选手喝彩，但他们分散在各个赛场。
en: But the Olympics is a smorgasbord of sports, each with its core of devotees, who often cheer on their favorites at the same time, but separately, in different arenas.

zh: 并且，更常见的情形是他们观看的是个人成就 — — 山地车速降选手的凝神聚气、动如脱兔和勇气，或者体操选手完美规范的动作 — — 而不是真正的团队努力。
en: And, more often than not, what we are witnessing is individual achievement – the deeply concentrated agility and courage of the downhill racer or the finely disciplined movements of the gymnast – rather than true team effort.

zh: 世界杯让某国的所有支持者在某一时刻为了某场比赛而走到一起，形成一加一大于二的效果。
en: The World Cup allows all of the supporters of one country to come together at one moment for one game between two groups that must, like them, become more than the sum of their parts.

zh: 事实上，光是观看世界杯比赛让人感到意犹未尽。
en: It actually feels incomplete to watch the World Cup alone.

zh: 比赛结束时，在为惜败于强大的比利时而扼腕但又认为美国打出了一场伟大比赛的同时，我的新朋友说 ： “ 我们需要的远不止于此。 ”
en: At the end of the game, amid regret over the loss to mighty Belgium but convinced that the US had played a great game, my new friend said: “We need much more of this.”

zh: 当然，美国例外论仍然大有市场。
en: US exceptionalism remains alive and well, of course.

zh: 我怀疑我们会继续永远把这一世界第一运动称为“soccer ” （ 其他国家称为“football ” ， 美国“football”是橄榄球 ） 。
en: I suspect that we will always call the world’s game “soccer.”

zh: 但现在我们热爱这个运动，它也成为了我们的运动。
en: But now we love it, and it is our game, too.

zh: 股东春天运动在继续
en: The Shareholder Spring Continues

zh: 伦敦 — — 现在是一年一度的股东大会季 — — 每年此刻世界某些规模最大的公司一起向股东报告，和他们展开类似对话的交流活动。
en: LONDON – It is annual general meeting season – the time of year when some of the world’s biggest companies gather to report to shareholders and have some semblance of a conversation with them.

zh: 之后几个月，一系列公司将分析前一年有哪些因素影响业绩，他们有怎样的未来计划以及董事会的决定。
en: For the next couple of months, a succession of companies will talk about what influenced their performance over the previous year, what they are planning for the future, and the decisions that their boards have made.

zh: 曾几何时股东会议并未如此大张旗鼓，很多时候公众都并不知情。
en: There was a time when these meetings took place without much fanfare, mostly unnoticed by the public.

zh: 近几年来这样的状况已经非常鲜见。
en: That has not been true for a couple of years.

zh: 经济日益恶化及不平等问题日益凸显促使更多人更多参与，更加关注公司及其管理者的一举一动。
en: A worsening economy and widening inequality have spurred more people to become more engaged and take an interest in the activities of companies and those who run them.

zh: 因此，注意力已经从首席执行官和管理团队，转向了之前鲜为人知的公司董事。
en: And, with that change, attention has broadened from CEOs and executive teams to those who previously existed in a black box: the companies’ board members.

zh: 2012年，股东和其他人开始关注董事会，质疑董事会及其组成成员的决策和行动， 股东春天运动也因此诞生。
en: In 2012, shareholders and others started shining a bright light on boards, questioning their decisions and activities, and those of individual members, and thus was born the Shareholder Spring.

zh: 人们已经厌倦董事会在隔音的会议室里暗箱操作，似乎根本无视经济现实和公众情绪。
en: People grew tired of tone-deaf board directors operating in soundproof rooms, seemingly ignoring economic realities and the public’s mood.

zh: 他们想要直接面对那些高管令人瞠目薪酬的决策者，或者质疑那些采取复杂手段操纵税收的人。
en: They wanted to confront those who decide on executives’ often eye-popping compensation or approve companies’ decisions to undertake sophisticated tax engineering.

zh: 人们希望了解董事会成员是否实际完成了他们的任务，抑或只是尸位素餐，领到一大笔费用。
en: People wanted to know whether board members were actually doing their jobs or just filling seats and collecting a nice fee.

zh: 很多企业和企业董事会都希望这种关注能尽快过去；但事实却是上述趋势的表现形式日益成熟。
en: Many companies and company boards hoped that this heightened interest would pass quickly; instead, it has matured.

zh: 不满情绪持续高涨，投资者、员工、政治家和公众现在不光想了解高管薪酬，还想了解公司最高和最低收入者令人惊讶的差异是怎么造成的。
en: Discontent has continued to mount, and investors, employees, politicians, and members of the public now want to know not only about executive compensation, but also about the frequently staggering discrepancy between what companies’ highest- and lowest-paid personnel earn.

zh: 他们希望了解最低生活工资和零时工合同。
en: They want to know about living wages and zero-hours contracts.

zh: 他们想了解企业采取哪些措施应对气候变化，它们是不是负责任的社会成员、以及他们在冲突地区的一举一动。
en: They want to know what companies are doing to address climate change, whether they are responsible community members, how they behave in conflict zones, and much more.

zh: 质疑者不再满足于站在门外抗议。
en: Those asking the questions are no longer content to protest outside.

zh: 他们越来越善于表达自己的意见，买入股票，直视董事会成员的眼睛大胆发言，使自己的问题成为正式纪录的一部分。
en: They are becoming increasingly sophisticated about how to be heard, buying shares, stepping up to the microphone, and looking board members in the eye, so that their questions become part of the official minutes.

zh: 他们正在向公司主要投资者施加压力，让董事会成员为自己的行为负责。
en: And they are putting pressure on companies’ major investors to hold board members to account as well.

zh: 提出的质疑和做出的陈述有时可能会啰嗦跑题。
en: The questions posed and statements made can sometimes be longwinded.

zh: 但其中也有很多不仅合法，还提醒董事会必须服务于包括投资者、员工、客户和社会各界在内的完整的企业生态体系。
en: But many of them are legitimate, and they are an important reminder to boards that they must serve the company’s entire ecosystem – investors, employees, customers, and community alike.

zh: 事实上，上述开放式会议提醒董事会成员必须时刻牢记困难的问题，而不是象征性地批准管理建议，或者为创造融洽气氛而随声附和。
en: Indeed, these open meetings are a reminder that board members must ask the hard questions all year round, rather than simply rubber-stamping management proposals or going along to get along.

zh: 有趣的是，就在董事会责任运动蔚然成风的同时，某些企业已经采取新的方式召开年度股东大会。
en: Interestingly, just as the movement to hold boards to account has gained greater traction, some companies have adopted new ways of convening annual shareholder meetings.

zh: 股东大会曾经相当古板。
en: These were once fairly staid gatherings.

zh: 公司高管会一步步地投资者和董事会成员讲解报告形式，呈报结果，接受提问，投票，之后再进入下一个步骤。
en: The companies’ senior management would walk investors and board members through the reporting formalities step by step, present results, take questions, vote, and move on.

zh: 会上准备了茶、咖啡、饼干，但没有华而不实的东西。
en: There was tea, coffee, and biscuits, but nothing fancy.

zh: 但近年来已经出现了嘉年华式的聚会。 公司邀请大牌艺人，把股东大会转变为自我感觉良好的赛前动员活动。
en: In recent years, however, there has been a trend toward a more carnival-like atmosphere, with companies bringing in big-name entertainers and turning the event into a feel-good pep rally.

zh: 去年，沃尔玛的年度会议主打小亨利·康尼克、罗宾·锡克和法瑞尔·威廉姆斯。
en: Last year, Wal-Mart’s annual meeting featured Harry Connick, Jr., Robin Thicke, and Pharrell Williams.

zh: 2013年，埃尔顿·约翰曾登台表演。
en: In 2013, Elton John performed.

zh: 相比之下，其他公司纷纷走向另一个极端，即完全采用虚拟形式召开股东会议。
en: In contrast, other companies have swung to the opposite extreme and embraced fully virtual meetings.

zh: 董事会在镜头前向股东进行网络直播，回答提前搜集好的问题，这样就彻底避免了抗议者。
en: The board gathers in front of a camera for a live webcast to shareholders, takes questions submitted in advance, and avoids the protesters altogether.

zh: 今年惠普也采用了这种方式，之前采取同样方式的还有Sprint和Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia。
en: This year, HP joined Sprint and Martha Stewart Living Omnimedia down this road.

zh: 虚拟股东会自有其可取之处：在企业及投资者全球化背景下，投资者不用登上飞机就可以参与股东大会。
en: There is a virtue to having a meeting with a virtual component: businesses are global, and so are their investors, who can participate without having to get on a plane.

zh: 但网络直播加现场听众才是理想的组合。
en: But a webcast of a meeting with a live audience would be the ideal combination.

zh: 尽管企业可能认为完全的虚拟会议可以节省开支 — — 但投资者并不需要罗宾·锡克。
en: And while companies might argue that entirely virtual meetings save money – which of course is true – investors do not need Robin Thicke.

zh: 真实的数据、严肃的讨论和几块饼干就够了。
en: They will settle for good numbers, serious discussion, and a dry biscuit.

zh: 董事和经理们必须认真对待上述会议。
en: Boards and managers must take these meetings seriously.

zh: 他们工作的一部分是面对那些利益攸关人士。
en: Part of the job is facing those with something at stake.

zh: 邀请马戏团或躲在摄像机后面无法避开棘手的问题。
en: Hosting circuses or hiding behind cameras will not keep tough questions from coming.

zh: 承担责任是董事席位的重要部分，董事们必须在没有音乐伴奏的情况下当面应对。
en: A seat at the boardroom table comes with the responsibility to stand up and do this vital part of the job – in person and without musical accompaniment.

zh: 印度的贱民的奥巴马时刻
en: An Obama Moment for India’s Untouchables

zh: 新德里-奥巴马在美国取得了令人难以置信的胜利，这一事件引起了众多的国际影响，其中一个是，全世界正在反省这种突破是否可能在其它地方发生。
en: NEW DELHI – Among the many international consequences of Barack Obama’s stunning victory in the United States is worldwide introspection about whether such a breakthrough could happen elsewhere.

zh: 一个属于有色人种的人是否可能在美国之外的白人占多数的国家里赢得权力？
en: Could a person of color win power in other white-majority countries?

zh: 一个处在多数族群包围中的少数族群的人有可能超越他的出生身份而成为他或她的国家的领袖吗？
en: Could a member of a beleaguered minority transcend the circumstances of his birth to lead his or her country?

zh: 虽然各国的尤其是在欧洲的众多分析家们已经得出结论，认为这类事件在可预见的将来不可能发生，但印度却是个例外。
en: While many analysts in a wide variety of nations, especially in Europe, have concluded that such an event could not occur there in the foreseeable future, India is an exception.

zh: 少数民族的政客很久前就在印度的各种高级职位上掌握了权威，如果还算不上是掌握权力的话。
en: Minority politicians have long wielded authority, if not power, in its various high offices.

zh: 事实上，印度上一次2004年的大选，赢家是一个意大利后裔的信仰罗马天主教的女人（索尼娅·甘地 ） ， 她为一个锡克教徒（曼莫汉·辛格）向一个穆斯林教徒（阿卜杜勒·卡拉姆总统）宣誓就职总理铺平了道路，而该国的人口81 ％是印度教徒。
en: Indeed, India’s last general election, in 2004, was won by a woman of Italian heritage and Roman Catholic faith (Sonia Gandhi) who made way for a Sikh (Manmohan Singh) to be sworn in as Prime Minister by a Muslim (President Abdul Kalam) in a country that is 81% Hindu.

zh: 印度人说，这种情况不仅可能在这里发生，而且它已经发生了。
en: Not only could it happen here, Indians say, it already has.

zh: 但这种自满还为时过早。
en: Such complacency is premature.

zh: 在印度，最能和美国黑人的地位相类比的是贱民-即以前所谓的“最底层不可接触的贱民 ” ， 他们是数千年来遭受屈辱的歧视和压迫的被剥夺种姓的阶层。
en: The closest Indian analogy to the position of black Americans is that of the Dalits – formerly called “Untouchables,” the outcastes who for millennia suffered humiliating discrimination and oppression.

zh: 和美国黑人一样，贱民约占人口的15 ％ ， 他们在低地位、低收入的工作岗位上所占的比例与他们在总人口中的比例不相符合；他们的教育水平低于上等种姓；他们每天仍然仅仅因为他们出生时的身份而受到歧视。
en: Like blacks in the US, Dalits account for about 15% of the population; they are found disproportionately in low-status, low-income jobs; their levels of educational attainment are lower than the upper castes; and they still face daily incidents of discrimination for no reason other than their identity at birth.

zh: 只有当一个贱民可以统治印度的时候，这个国家才真正可以说实现了自己的“奥巴马的时刻 ” 。
en: Only when a Dalit rules India can the country truly be said to have attained its own “Obama moment.”

zh: 从理论上讲，这已经发生了：出生于一个贫穷贱民家庭的雷克南·纳拉亚南，从1997年到2002年间担任过印度总统，这是这个国家的最高职位。
en: In theory, this already has happened: K. R. Narayanan, born into a poor Dalit family, served as India’s president, the highest office in the land, from 1997 to 2002.

zh: 但是，印度的总统基本上是象征性的职位：真正的权力掌握在总理手中，而且从未有贱民的职位曾靠近过总理一职。
en: But the Indian Presidency is a largely ceremonial position: real power is vested in the office of prime minister, and no Dalit has come close to holding that post.

zh: 自1947年独立以来，大多数的印度总理是由婆罗门人担任的，他们是印度教的最高种姓。
en: Since independence in 1947, a majority of India’s prime ministers have been Brahmins, the highest Hindu caste.

zh: 然而，在下次在2009年5月之前将要举行的全国大选中，可能会有一个贱民出来竞争总理的职位-她就是库·玛雅瓦提，印度最大的邦-北方邦-的女性首席部长。
en: Yet the next national elections, due before May 2009, may produce a plausible Dalit contender for the job of prime minister – Kumari Mayawati, the female chief minister of India’s largest state, Uttar Pradesh.

zh: 自1991年以来，没有一个印度执政党在议会中曾享有保险的多数席位，也因此必须组成多党联合政府。
en: Since 1991, no Indian governing party has enjoyed a secure parliamentary majority on its own, necessitating multi-party coalition governments.

zh: 目前由曼莫汉·辛格领导的由国大党主导的政府由20个政党组成，上一届政府是由印度人民党的阿塔尔·比哈里·瓦杰帕伊领导的23党联合政府。
en: The current Congress Party-led government of Manmohan Singh comprises 20 parties; it succeeded a 23-party coalition headed by the Bharatiya Janata Party’s Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

zh: 当明年选举结果宣布后，没有人会怀疑，首个挑战将是组成另一届联合政府。
en: When the election results are declared next year, no one doubts that the first challenge will be to cobble together another coalition.

zh: 国大党和印度人民党都将设法与几十个可能在议会中占有席位的小党组成联盟。
en: Both the Congress and the BJP will seek to make alliances with the dozens of smaller parties likely to be represented in parliament.

zh: 但是，这一次他们很可能面临着第三种选择：玛雅瓦提，其社会报党（ BSP ）可能占有至少50个席位。
en: But this time they are likely to face a third alternative: Mayawati, whose Bahujan Samaj Party (BSP) may command a bloc of at least 50 seats.

zh: 她曾公开表示对两个全国性大党不屑一顾;她宁愿领导一个联合政府，而不是加入一个大党。
en: She has publicly expressed her disdain for both large national parties; she would much rather lead a coalition than join one.

zh: 如果选举人数分配得当，我们可以预料她有可能组合地区性和左翼政党，出任印度总理以领导该国。
en: And if the electoral numbers break down right, she could conceivably assemble a collection of regional and left-wing parties and stake a claim to rule India.

zh: 这是一个了不起的进展：三千年来，由一个贱民女子来领导印度是无法想象的概念。
en: This is a remarkable development: the idea that a Dalit woman could lead India has been inconceivable for 3,000 years.

zh: 但是，印度的民主已开辟了新途径以赋予下层阶级以力量。
en: But India’s democracy has opened new pathways to empowerment for its underclasses.

zh: 穷人和被压迫者所拥有的可能不多，但他们确实拥有人数，而投票时��作用的恰恰是人数。
en: The poor and the oppressed may not have much, but they do have the numbers, which is what matters at the ballot box.

zh: 贱民和印度的原住民（宪法中所列的“贱民和部落 ” ） 在印度的543人组成的议会中有权获得85个席位，这是为他们的社区“保留”的席位。
en: Dalits and India’s aboriginals (listed in the Constitution as “Scheduled Castes and Tribes”) are entitled to 85 seats in India’s 543-member parliament that are “reserved” for candidates from their communities.

zh: 玛雅瓦提的精明的联盟伙伴们，包括一些上等种姓成员，把她推上了北方邦的权利顶峰，并给了她一个机会去赢得其它一些席位。
en: Mayawati’s shrewd alliances, including with some members of the upper castes, which propelled her to power in Uttar Pradesh, give her party a fighting chance to win a number of other seats as well.

zh: 在依赖联合政府的议会制中，这可能是她成为总理所需要的全部条件。
en: In a coalition-dependent parliamentary system, that could be all she needs to become prime minister.

zh: 作为一个政府办事员的女儿，玛雅瓦提曾攻读法律并做过教师，后来被社会报党（ BSP ）的创始人，已故的Kanshi RAM 发现，并培养了她的政治领导才能。
en: The daughter of a government clerk, Mayawati studied law and worked as a teacher before being spotted by the BSP’s founder, the late Kanshi Ram, and groomed for political leadership.

zh: 她的崛起一直注重于象征意义-她在她治理的北方邦建造了无数贱民领导人的雕像，尤其是她自己的雕像，她对奢华的庆祝活动也特别爱好。
en: Her ascent has been marked by a heavy emphasis on symbolism – her rule in Uttar Pradesh has featured the construction of numerous statues of Dalit leaders, notably herself – and a taste for lavish celebrations.

zh: 玛雅瓦提的“着装”弱点已在她主持的奢侈的生日派对上尽显无遗，她的衣着缀满了钻石，她说（这很像艾薇塔·庇隆 ） ， 她的光彩给她的族群带来了魅力和尊严。
en: Mayawati’s weakness for “bling” has been demonstrated at her extravagant birthday parties, which she presides over laden with diamonds, saying (rather like Evita Peron) that her luster brings glamour and dignity to her people.

zh: 她引以自豪的是去年付了约6 00万美元的所得税-这在印度政治家中是最高的-尽管她的收入来源倍受争议。
en: She takes pride in being the Indian politician who pays the highest income taxes – about $6 million last year – though the sources of her income are shrouded in controversy.

zh: 她数次因腐败被指控，但没有被定罪，其中一个广为人知的案件涉及在泰姬陵附近建造一个大型购物中心，这违反了景观规划法。
en: She has been accused, but not convicted, of corruption several times, with one notable case involving the construction of an elaborate shopping complex near the Taj Mahal, in violation of zoning laws.

zh: 批评者认为，玛雅瓦提对贱民福利的促进似乎是以她自己为起点的。
en: Critics argue that Mayawati’s promotion of Dalit welfare seems to start with herself.

zh: 但是，不容否认的是，议会中占了80名议员的印度的最大的邦由她掌权，给了她一个重要平台去竞争印度最有权利的职位。
en: But there is no denying that her rise to power in India’s largest state, which sends 80 members to parliament, has given her a vital platform to bid for India’s most powerful job.

zh: 以她的钻石和她建造的塑像，以及她威严地对待下属的名声，她显然不是奥巴马的料。
en: With her diamonds and her statues, and a reputation for dealing imperiously with her subordinates, she’s clearly no Obama.

zh: 但是，如果她成功了，她将会结束一段更长久的歧视历史。
en: But if she succeeds, she will have overcome a far longer legacy of discrimination.

zh: 为叙利亚设置禁飞区
en: A No-Fly Zone for Syria

zh: 布鲁塞尔—在对国际关系的解读上有一句烂大街的话，叫做敌人的敌人就是我的朋友。
en: BRUSSELS – There is a saying, too often used in interpreting international relations, that my enemy’s enemy is my friend.

zh: 有时这句话是对的，通常它是错的。
en: Sometimes it proves true; often it does not.

zh: 三十年前，阿富汗圣战者在与苏联侵略者做斗争时错误地与西方交了朋友。
en: Thirty years ago, the Afghan mujahedin were mistaken for friends of the West when they fought their country’s Soviet invaders.

zh: 然而站在现在看待此后发生的一切，却道教条害死人。
en: But how lazy that assumption seems now, given all that has since happened.

zh: 叙利亚危机的深化，以及使用化学武器的罪行，创造了一个类似的动态和困境。
en: Syria’s deepening crisis, and the criminal use of chemical weapons there, has created a similar dynamic and dilemma.

zh: 但西方不需要冒犯同样错误、接受同样错误的选择的风险。
en: But the West need not risk making the same mistake and accepting the same false choices.

zh: 让我们从首要原则开始。
en: Begin with first principles.

zh: 刚刚在叙利亚出现的大规模使用化学武器现象必然是局面改变器。
en: A chemical-weapons attack on the scale just seen in Syria must be deemed a game changer.

zh: 尽管拥有这些大规模杀伤性武器在技术上并不违法，但大部分国家加入了1993年化学武器公约，而叙利亚拒绝在该公约上签字。
en: Although possessing these weapons of mass destruction is technically not illegal, most states are parties to the 1993 Chemical Weapons Convention, which Syria has refused to sign.

zh: 因此，对于“接下来会发生什么？ ”这个问题，不能以“什么都不会发生。
en: So the answer to the question “What happens next?” cannot be “Nothing.”

zh: ”作答。 国际法的原则 — — 特别是新兴的“保护责任”思想和在全球强制禁止化学武器的使用 — — 意味着某种形式的军事干预必须进行，以威慑其他可能使用大规模杀伤性武器（特别是针对平民使用）的国家。
en: Principles of international law – in particular, the emerging “responsibility to protect” doctrine and enforcement of the global ban on the use of chemical weapons – dictate that some form of military intervention must occur in order to deter others from using WMDs, particularly against civilians.

zh: 但怎样的动作是合适的，而且真正会有效？
en: But which measures are appropriate and genuinely useful?

zh: 什么措施更有利于增强西方的安全，什么措施可能威胁到西方的安全？
en: What is more likely to strengthen the West’s security, and what runs the risk of weakening it?

zh: 我认为最公平、最简单的合理反应是在叙利亚设置禁飞区。
en: I believe that the fairest and simplest proportionate response would be to impose a no-fly zone on Syria.

zh: 该方案在根据联合国宪章第七条 （ “ 针对和平威胁的行动 ” ） 的解决方案缺位的情况下尤其合适，因为俄罗斯和中国（几乎肯定）将在安理会上投否决票。
en: The proposal is particularly appropriate in the likely absence of any resolution under United Nations Chapter VII (“Action with Respect to Threats to the Peace”), owing to the (almost certain) cynical use by Russia and China of their veto power in the Security Council.

zh: 当然，在叛军控制的大马士革东区爆发骇人听闻的化学武器攻击后，攻讦和反诘便呈现出不可开交之势。
en: Of course, claims and counter-claims have been swirling in the aftermath of the appalling chemical-weapons attack on a rebel-controlled area east of Damascus.

zh: 但是，考虑到总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权的残暴，没人怀疑它会接近所能隐瞒其罪行。
en: But, given the brutality of President Bashar al-Assad’s regime, no one can doubt the lengths to which it would go to hide its guilt.

zh: 阻挠联合国化学武器专家进入核实攻击五天之久足以让巴沙尔政府隐瞒犯罪证据、让证据降解或用后续炮轰毁灭证据。
en: The five-day delay in allowing UN chemical-weapons experts to verify the attack gave Assad’s government ample time to conceal incriminating evidence, allow it to degrade, or destroy it with further shelling.

zh: 美国、法国和英国坚定认为情报和目击证据都表明巴沙尔政府是袭击的发动者。
en: The United States, France, and the United Kingdom are adamant that all the intelligence and eyewitness evidence points to the Assad government as the perpetrator of the attack.

zh: 另一个毫无疑问的要点是对叙利亚反对派的要素的担忧合情合理。
en: There also is no doubt about the legitimacy of concerns about elements of the Syrian opposition.

zh: 叛军中不乏基地组织领导的沙拉菲派极端组织，比如Al Nusra，它们被证实与政府及其盟友 — — 伊朗代理人真主党和伊朗革命卫队一样残暴。
en: The Al Qaeda-led and Salafist extremist groups in the rebel forces, such a Al Nusra, have proved to be just as vicious as the government and its allies, the Iranian proxy Hezbollah and Iran’s Revolutionary Guard.

zh: 但西方情报机构的综合意见认为，没有证据表明这些叛军组织发动了化学武器攻击。
en: But the united view of Western intelligence services is that there is no evidence that these rebel groups launched the chemical-weapons attack.

zh: 在这样的环境下，禁飞区不但能让叙利亚战机和导弹从天空上小时，从而减小屠杀的规模；还能像巴沙尔及其支持者证明，他实在是孱弱不堪。
en: In these circumstances, a no-fly zone would not only clear the skies of Syrian warplanes and missiles, thereby reducing the scale of the slaughter; it would also show Assad and his supporters that he truly is vulnerable.

zh: 下令使用化学武器的将军将不得不考虑巴沙尔政权被推翻、他们以战争罪被送上法庭的风险。
en: Generals ordered to use chemical weapons would have to reckon with the prospect that the regime could, actually, fall, and that they then might find themselves on trial for war crimes.

zh: 当然，好处不仅限于此，如果俄罗斯和中国赞成让安理会来实施这一措施，以达到其目的 — — 保护和平、阻止战争罪行的话。
en: It would be better, of course, if Russia and China would allow the Security Council to do the job for which it was intended – securing peace and preventing war crimes.

zh: 在巴沙尔使用化学武器的情况下继续支持他将让俄罗斯在阿拉伯世界的地位从保护人降格为过街老鼠。
en: By continuing to support Assad despite his use of chemical weapons, Russia’s standing in the Arab world has gone from patron to pariah.

zh: 俄罗斯总统普京在全世界面前所保有的些许道德和政治立场也将蒸发殆尽，他很快就会在即将于圣彼得堡召开的G20峰会上发现这一点。
en: What little moral and political standing Russian President Vladimir Putin has retained in the rest of the world is also evaporating, as he will soon discover at the upcoming G-20 Summit in Saint Petersburg.

zh: 但世界不能屏息等待普京和中国回心转意，这就是禁飞区应该作为试验性军事选择的原因。
en: But the world cannot hold its breath waiting for a change of heart by Putin and China, which is why a no-fly zone should be examined as a military option.

zh: 1991年海湾战争后，由英国首相梅杰首先提出的禁飞区虽然没有推翻萨达姆·侯赛因，但却是阻止了他继续从空中打击北部的库尔德人和南部的什叶派。
en: In the aftermath of the Gulf War in 1991, a no-fly zone, initially proposed by British Prime Minister John Major, did not topple Saddam Hussein, but it did prevent him from carrying out further attacks from the air on Kurds in the north and Shia in the south.

zh: 类似地，在叙利亚设置禁飞区能立刻限制叙利亚政府运送大规模杀伤性武器的能力。
en: Likewise, a no-fly zone in Syria would immediately restrict the Syrian government’s means of delivery of weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 一些军事专家或许会说，叙利亚空中防御系统很成熟，不易压制，强行设置禁飞区太危险。
en: Some military experts may say that Syria’s air-defense systems are too sophisticated to suppress, making a no-fly zone too dangerous to enforce.

zh: 但以色列成功地两次空袭过叙利亚，一次在2007年，摧毁了朝鲜人运行的核反应堆；另一次为时更近，袭击了一支真主党卫队。 两次空袭都没有造成本方伤亡和飞机损失。
en: But Israel has managed to attack Syrian territory twice – destroying a North Korean-staffed nuclear reactor in 2007 and, more recently, striking a Hezbollah convoy – with no casualties or loss of planes.

zh: 对这一弱点心知肚明的俄罗斯向叙利亚提供了更先进的S-300导弹；但没有证据表明这些导弹已经运抵叙利亚，更不用说完成部署了。
en: Mindful of this weakness, Russia has offered Syria its more modern S-300 missiles; but there is no evidence that they have arrived, let alone been deployed.

zh: 而只要叙利亚空中防御系统退化程度足够，阿拉伯国家 — — 沙特、卡塔尔和其他海湾国家 — — 以及土耳其以其空中力量维持禁飞区就成为最佳选择。
en: And once Syria’s air-defense system is sufficiently degraded, it would be best if Arab countries – Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and other Gulf states – and Turkey used their air forces to police the zone.

zh: 只要看一看天际，任何对巴沙尔政权的邪恶的一厢情愿变会烟消云散。
en: Any malicious wishful thinking on the part of Assad’s regime would be dispelled with every glance at the sky.

zh: 中国新边界上的老问题
en: An Old Problem on China’s New Frontier

zh: 发自华沙 — — 如果1991年爆发的那场针对米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫的政变成功了的话，那么最近在中国新疆地区发生的暴乱可能将在俄罗斯上演。
en: WARSAW – Had the August 1991 putsch against Mikhail Gorbachev not failed, the riots and death recently seen in Xinjiang could have been taking place in Russia.

zh: 如果是这样的话，我们听到的可不是在新疆首府乌鲁木齐的镇压行动，而是数百人在哈萨克斯坦的阿拉木图喋血街头，而专栏作家能与之相比较的，则可能是上一年在乌克兰利沃夫市爆发的某场乌克兰人独立运动。
en: Instead of hearing about a crackdown in Urumqi, Xinjiang’s capital, we might be reading about hundreds killed on the streets of Almaty, and columnists would be making comparisons to the bloody crushing of Ukrainian independence demonstrations in Lvov the previous year.

zh: 跟中国现在的情况一样，俄罗斯方面可能会遭到外部世界的一些若有若无的谴责，并流传出一些跟哈萨克武装人员和分离组织，或者伊斯兰极端分子有关的怀疑之声。
en: As with China today, there would have been some feeble international condemnation, and some speculation about possible links between Kazakh militants and exile groups, or Islamic fundamentalists.

zh: 而专家则可能会提醒我们说哈萨克斯坦从来就没有真正成为一个国家，而乌克兰人的独立诉求在历史上根本是站不住脚的。
en: Experts would remind us that Kazakhstan had never been a country, and that Ukrainian claims to independence are historically dubious.

zh: 只要把新疆和哈萨克斯坦，把西藏和乌克兰两者各自调换一下，你就能想象出那个情景了。
en: Substitute Xinjiang for Kazakhstan and Tibet for Ukraine and you get the picture.

zh: 但万幸的是，1991年的那场政变最后以失败收场，腐朽的苏维埃政权再也无力镇压俄罗斯内部蓬勃发展的民主运动 — — 谁知解体10年后普京却完成了这个任务。
en: But that putsch, thankfully, ended as a farce. The decaying Soviet regime was unable to crush Russia’s growing democratic movement – it would take Vladimir Putin to do that a decade later.

zh: 与此同时，中国共产党领导层选择了另一条道路，通过1989年的天安门大屠杀事件，他们把国家送上了一条与俄罗斯截然不同的道路。
en: By opting for the Tiananmen Square massacre in 1989, the Chinese Communist leadership set their country on a road starkly different from the one on which Russia subsequently embarked.

zh: 虽然对于中国这个如一个大陆般巨大的国家来说，其所采取的政策带来了皮诺切特式的经济发展奇迹，但他们同时也剥夺了所有人的自由，甚至连人口占绝大多数的汉族人也不能幸免。
en: Though China’s policies have brought about Pinochet-style economic growth, if on the scale of a country that is almost a continent unto itself, they have also ensured that there is in no freedom for anyone, including the Han majority.

zh: 这意味着当哈萨克斯坦和乌克兰都获得了独立之后，新疆和西藏却依然深陷在暴动和血腥镇压的无尽轮回之中。
en: This, in turn, means that, while Kazakhstan and Ukraine are independent, Tibet and Xinjiang alternate between phases of violent agitation and bloody repression.

zh: 而即使当今的俄罗斯也处在某种程度的独裁统治之下，但要想引入中国式的专政依然不太可能，因为俄罗斯去年的人均GDP达到了1.58万美元，比中国高三倍。
en: Though Russia today is autocratically governed, the introduction of a Chinese-style dictatorship seems hardly plausible, while GDP per capita was $15,800 last year, or almost three times that of China.

zh: 而大多数中国人似乎对政府的政策非常支持，人们对政府对少数民族的残酷镇压以及对民主自由的抵制行径都表示认同。
en: Yet a majority of the Chinese population seems to support its’ government’s policies, including its brutal suppression of minorities and denial of democratic freedoms.

zh: 事实上，后者似乎就是为前者的成功所付出的代价。
en: In fact, the latter seems to be the price paid for the success of the former.

zh: 这可不是一个小说情节。
en: This is not a novel phenomenon.

zh: 在1863年，流亡俄罗斯民主思想家亚历山大·赫尔岑就在他主办的政治刊物《Kolokol（钟 ） 》 中评论说，如果人们对帝俄军队在华沙街头对波兰人起义的暴力镇压安之若素，那么发生圣彼得堡街头的镇压也就不远了。 因为人们和政府之间对镇压的认可实际上是个一揽子交易，有第一次就肯定有第二次，而且既然达成了买卖就得被迫照单全收。
en: In 1863, the Russian democratic émigré thinker Alexander Herzen, commenting on the brutal crushing of the Polish uprising by the Tsarist army, wrote in his publication Kolokol that acceptance of violence on the streets of Warsaw meant the acceptance of violence on the streets of St. Petersburg.

zh: 而这一评论直接导致赫尔岑的俄国读者数量剧减，最终《钟》只得关门大吉。
en: Oppression is a package deal. His comments cost him his Russian readership, and Kolokol had to close down.

zh: 而当赫尔岑写下这些文字的时候，莫斯科不仅忙于镇压波兰人并确保能继续统治波兰近半个世纪，而且还努力和中国一起瓜分中亚（所谓土耳其斯坦地区 ） 。
en: When Herzen was writing his words, Moscow was not only busy successfully putting down the Poles, reasserting its rule there for another half-century, but also, together with China, carving up Central Asia, known then as Turkestan.

zh: 最终这一区域的东部沦为中国统治区，并被重新命名为“新疆 ” ， 意思是“新的边界 ” 。
en: The eastern part of the region fell under Chinese rule, and was renamed Xinjiang, or New Frontier.

zh: 但每当中国的统治被削弱的时候，比如在1930年代和1940年代，短命的东土耳其斯坦共和国就会在俄国的支持下建立，并随之在中俄订立新协约之后灰飞烟灭。
en: Each time Chinese rule weakened, as in the 1930’s and 1940’s, short-lived East Turkestan Republics were established, with Russian support, only to flounder when Russia and China struck new deals.

zh: 而第二个土耳其斯坦的领导人甚至据说是被斯大林下令处决的，当时这些人坐飞机前往北京进行谈判，最终飞机却在苏联领空中坠毁了。
en: The leadership of the second East Turkestan Republic was presumably murdered on Stalin’s orders, when the plane carrying it to Beijing for talks allegedly crashed in Soviet airspace.

zh: 从那以后，东土耳其斯坦就名存实亡了，仅仅作为非联合国会员国家及民族组织（简称UNPO，一个成立于1991年，旨在与联合国分庭抗礼的组织）的成员存在。
en: Since then, East Turkestan has existed solely on paper, as a member of the Unrepresented Nations and Peoples Organization (UNPO), a would-be competitor of the United Nations set up in 1991.

zh: 而对于新疆来说，最近的暴动在本质上是社会意义而不是国家意义上的，目的是反对文化压迫（汉族已经占到了本地区人口的一半）而不是表达独立的诉求。
en: In Xinjiang itself, the current agitation is more social than nationalist in character, and targets cultural oppression (Han Chinese by now make up half of the region’s population) rather than expressing aspirations for independence.

zh: 但流血事件也很可能改变整个状况，因为暴力将不可避免地滋生极端主义。
en: Yet the recent bloodbath there is almost sure to change that, as violence unavoidably breeds radicalization.

zh: 而在中短期内，中国对新疆和西藏的统治似乎安全无忧：国际社会可不会挑战一个安理会常任理事国。
en: In the short and medium term, China’s rule in Xinjiang and Tibet seems secure: the international community will not challenge a Security Council member state.

zh: 只有中国公民能挑战之，但赫尔岑的“一揽子交易”理论似乎防止了这一状况的发生：跟西藏人一样，维吾尔人的行动换来的并不是汉族的团结政策，而是镇压和复仇的叫嚣 — — 这可以理解，因为许多在拉萨和乌鲁木齐的无辜汉人为中国政府的恶行付出了生命的代价。
en: Only its own citizens could do that, but Herzen’s package deal seems to prevent that: just like the Tibetans, the Uighurs elicit not Han solidarity, but a braying for their blood – somewhat understandable, given that ordinary Han in Lhasa and Urumqi were made to pay with their own for China’s misdeeds.

zh: 但在长期来说，中国执政者很有理由去担心：新疆将演变成下一个西藏。
en: In the longer term, however, the Chinese authorities have every reason to be worried: Xinjiang will grow to be a problem like Tibet.

zh: 但事实上，虽然非联合国会员国家及民族组织 — — 包括中东的所谓亚述国或者加拿大的水牛河丘国在内 — — 依然只像是美国著名戏剧团体“马克思兄弟”所虚构的戏剧（有人甚至希望把由喜剧班子成员格兰切诺·马克思任首相的所谓“自由尼亚”也位列其中 ） ， 但如今已经有六个前会员国成功争取到了联合国资格，连已经独立但缺乏联合国承认的科索沃也将走上这条道路，可见在政治版图上，那些虚构的国家是很可能会摇身一变，成为真正国家的。
en: Indeed, though the UNPO, to which both belong – alongside Assyria and the Buffalo River Dene Nation – has a vaguely Marx Brothers’ air to it (one expects Freedonia, the mythical country of which Groucho Marx was prime minister, to be on the roster), six member states already have left it to join the UN, and Kosovo, now independent if lacking UN recognition, will eventually follow. Political maps are never carved in stone.

zh: 因此可以认定的是，不但那些默默无闻的学者和新闻通讯员，甚至连北京的官员如今都在忙于研究新疆伊宁起义以及奥斯曼·巴图尔游击队的历史。
en: It is therefore safe to assume that not only obscure academics and correspondents, but officials in Beijing as well, are now busy studying the history of the Ghulja uprising and of Osman Batur’s guerillas.

zh: 试想一下，1893年被帝俄军队成功镇压的波兰人，如今又是什么样的状况？
en: Come to think of it: whatever happened to the Poles, whom Russia so successfully put down in 1863?

zh: 移民劳工的欧佩克？
en: An OPEC for Migrant Labor?

zh: 迪拜—1906年9月，来自伊朗、伊拉克、科威特、沙特阿拉伯和委内瑞拉的代表齐聚巴格达，组成了石油输出国组织（欧佩克 ） 。
en: DUBAI – In September 1960, delegates from Iran, Iraq, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, and Venezuela met in Baghdad to form the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries.

zh: 随着世界对石油依赖的与日俱增，欧佩克的权力也水涨船高。
en: As the world’s dependence on oil increased, so did OPEC’s power.

zh: 如今，许多发展中国家，包括大部分中东国家，成为世界主要劳动力输出国，是否应该考虑成立一个类似于欧佩克的移民劳工卡特尔？
en: Today, with many developing countries, including a majority of the countries in the Middle East, serving as some of the world’s main labor exporters, might it be time to consider the formation of an OPEC-like cartel for migrant workers?

zh: 欧佩克成功地保护了个体成员国单独无法保护的共同利益。
en: OPEC succeeded in protecting its members’ shared interests that they could not protect individually.

zh: 当市场存在结构性扭曲时，欧佩克所提供的政治工具和集体行动要比公共政策更加有效。
en: When a market has structural distortions, political tools and collective action of the sort that OPEC embodied can be more effective than public policy.

zh: 今天的劳动力输出国与1960年成立欧佩克的那些成员国并无重大不同。
en: Labor-exporting countries today are not so different from OPEC’s founding members in 1960.

zh: 它们也是买方市场的弱势方。
en: They, too, are vulnerable in a market where their customers call the shots.

zh: 富裕的劳动力输入国和贫穷的劳动力输出国存在互相依赖的关系；但劳动力输入国可以单方面收紧或放松移民或劳动力市场规则，而劳动力输出国永远需要面临不确定性。
en: Rich labor-importing countries and poor labor-exporting countries have a mutually dependent relationship; but labor importers can unilaterally tighten or loosen immigration or labor-market regulations, leaving exporters in a constant state of uncertainty.

zh: 这一失衡可能给劳动力输出国造成巨大的成本。
en: This imbalance can have serious costs for labor exporters.

zh: 侨民汇款是许多发展中国家重要的生命线 — — 比包括外国直接投资和援助在内的其他任何金融流都要重要 — — 常常起到平衡一国收支的作用。
en: Remittances by expatriate workers are an essential lifeline for many developing countries – more so than any other financial inflows, including foreign direct investment and aid – and often help to balance a country’s books.

zh: 事实上，据世界银行，2013年侨汇占到了菲律宾和与印度尼西亚GDP的20—24 % ， 塔吉克斯坦的42 % ， 吉尔吉斯斯坦的32 % ， 黎巴嫩的17 % ， 约旦的10.8 % ， 也门的9.9 % ， 埃及和摩洛哥的6.6 % 。
en: Indeed, according to the World Bank, in 2013 remittances amounted to 20-24% of GDP in the Philippines and Indonesia, 42% in Tajikistan, 32% in Kyrgyzstan, 17% in Lebanon, 10.8% in Jordan, 9.9% in Yemen, and 6.6% in Egypt and Morocco.

zh: 对许多发展中国家而言，劳动力是战略性生产要素，正如大宗商品之于资源富裕经济体。
en: For many developing countries, labor is a strategic production factor, just as commodities are for resource-rich economies.

zh: 当我们提到移民劳工时，想到的是农业、建筑业、服务业和家政业的低技能工作。
en: When we think about migrant labor, we think of low-skill work in agriculture, construction, services, and domestic work.

zh: 但约旦和黎巴嫩等国家正在教育工人，让他们不但可以从事家政，也可以成为高技能外来工作者。
en: But countries such as Jordan and Lebanon (among others) are now educating workers to compete as high-skilled expatriates, too.

zh: 如今，劳动力输出国需要保护它们在人力资本上的投资，而类似于卡塔尔的政治实体是最有效的方式。
en: Labor exporters now need to protect their investments in human capital, and a cartel-like political body is the most effective way to do this.

zh: 如果上述国家想加入中国、墨西哥、印度和其他主要劳动力输出国的行列，就必须通过在工资、签证和其他条件上进行集体讨价还价抓住最多筹码 — — 随着全球范式的改变，其中一些也将惠及非成员国。
en: If the countries listed above were to join with China, Mexico, India, and other major labor exporters, they would be holding most of the chips in a collective negotiation about wages, visa terms, and other conditions – some of which would also benefit non-members as global norms changed.

zh: 劳动力输入国需要竞争进入集体市场，而不是个体国家市场，获得进入权的国家将赢得巨大的比较优势。
en: Labor importers would have to vie for access to a collective market, rather than individual national markets, and countries that gained access would have a significant comparative advantage over those that did not.

zh: 卡特尔将防止劳动力输出国牺牲自身利益，而这是目前在双边安排中常有的情况。
en: A cartel would prevent labor-exporting countries from cannibalizing their own interests, as currently happens with bilateral arrangements.

zh: 比如，如果想与海湾合作委员会国家签订单独协议，孤军奋战的东南亚国家将彼此倾轧，最终的结果是获得更加糟糕的协议。
en: For example, if they were to conclude separate agreements with Gulf Cooperation Council countries, individual Southeast Asian countries would undercut one another, with the result that they might end up with worse deals.

zh: 有了卡特尔，政府将转而为不同职业和交易以及不同技能水平制定最低工资率。
en: With a cartel, governments would instead set minimum-wage rates for different professions and trades, as well as for different skill levels.

zh: 随着输出国对移民劳动力进行培训，对这些劳动力的需求将会增加，刺激需求方而不是供给方的竞争，从而形成更高工资、更多技能培训的良性循环。
en: As exporters trained their migrant workforces, demand for their labor would grow and spark competition among venders rather than suppliers, thus fueling a virtuous cycle of higher wages and even more skills training.

zh: 此外，由于这一切都将在全球市场上发生，某些技能的价格将对培训机构、学生、员工和雇主变得更加透明。
en: And, because this would all happen on global markets, the prices of certain skills would become more transparent to training institutions, students, employees, and employers alike.

zh: 在这个新体系中，输入国将收取税收 — — 基于新制定的最低工资 — — 而侨汇将继续免税。
en: In this new system, importing countries would collect taxes – on the basis of the newly set minimum wage – and remittances would remain untaxed.

zh: 从这个角度，卡特尔将起到双重国际工会的作用，为工会力量较弱或被禁止的国家的员工提供议价力。
en: In this sense, the cartel would double as an international workers’ union, lending bargaining power to employees in countries where unions are weak or not permitted at all.

zh: 劳动力输出卡特尔将对现有体系形成深远影响。
en: A labor-exporting cartel would have far-reaching effects on the current system.

zh: 卡特尔成员国将获得奖励和惩罚恶意第三方的能力。
en: Cartel members would be empowered to reward and penalize third parties acting in bad faith.

zh: 此外，更重要的是，工人本身也将获得找回尊严的能力，在当前体系中，他们的这一权利被长期剥夺。
en: And, most important, the workers themselves would be empowered to reclaim their dignity in a system that has long stripped them of it.

zh: 事实上，可以预期，随着获得外籍工人成为一种特权，全世界的仇外情绪都将消退。
en: Indeed, we could expect xenophobia to wane worldwide as access to foreign workers became more privileged.

zh: 卡特尔将推动许多国家进行全面的移民和外籍劳工改革，包括美国、日本和海湾国家。
en: A cartel could advance the cause of comprehensive immigration and expat labor reform in many countries, including the United States, Japan, and the Gulf states.

zh: 根据新谈判的安排，劳动力输出国或将产生遏制免费搭车者和非法向外移民的激励，而劳动力输入国或将产生已入境非法 移民合法化和地位管理的激励。
en: Under a newly negotiated arrangement, labor-exporting countries would likely have an incentive to curb free riders and illegal emigration, and labor-importing countries would likely have an incentive to legalize and manage the status of illegal immigrants already within their borders.

zh: 这一方案的一个可能的反对因素是低技能劳动力成本将会增加，这将刺激自动化。
en: One likely objection to this proposal is that low-skilled labor will cost more, which could accelerate automation.

zh: 但因为自动化而被逐出生产部门的工作岗位将转移到休闲部门，因为对家政、侍应、园丁等岗位的需求将增加。
en: But the jobs automation displaced from the production sector would simply move to the leisure sector, because demand for domestic workers, waiters, gardeners, and the like would increase.

zh: 卡特尔将让这些市场的变化更加明确，因此劳动力输出国将能够做出反应并据此调整工人培训系统，增加劳动力输入国招到更加适合可用岗位的移民劳工的能力。
en: Because a cartel would make these market changes more discernible, labor exporters would be able to respond and adjust their worker-training systems accordingly, increasing labor importers’ ability to recruit migrant workers better suited to the available jobs.

zh: 总而言之，劳动力输出卡特尔将给这个长期陷入争议、因此破坏了许多劳动力输入国名声的行业带来秩序。
en: All told, a labor-exporting cartel would bring order to an industry that has long been mired in controversy, damaging the reputations of more than a few labor-importing countries.

zh: 它将改变劳动力供需的动态，让工人（他们将获得新的保护）和输入国（它们将能够获得受过培训的拉动力以适应通常因为技术而发生的经济条件的快速变化）都受益。
en: It would change the dynamics of labor supply and demand to the benefit of both workers – who would have new protections – and importing countries, which would have access to trained laborers to respond to rapid changes – often driven by technology – in economic conditions.

zh: 致奥尔默特的公开信
en: An Open Letter to Ehud Olmert

zh: 奥尔莫特先生：
en: Dear Mr. Olmert,

zh: 我提笔给您写信，希望您能够从百忙中抽出时间来倾听一个巴勒斯坦人的心声。
en: I am writing you in the hope that you will take time from your busy schedule as Israel’s acting Prime Minister to hear one Palestinian’s hopes.

zh: 尽管由于沙龙的中风您登上总理的位置有一点唐突，我相信您有机会成为历史和解的一部分。
en: Even though your ascension to the position of Prime Minister came in an awkward way because of Ariel Sharon’s stroke, I believe that you have an opportunity to be part of a historic reconciliation.

zh: 我知道，您会坚持说您将遵从沙龙的政治遗产。 但是，您具有某些沙龙所不具备的与巴勒斯坦人相处的重要的优势。
en: While I am sure you will insist that you are going to follow in the political legacy of Sharon, you have some important advantages with Palestinians that Sharon did not have.

zh: 第一个优势是，您并不背负着沙龙在巴勒斯坦人和阿拉伯人中的负面形象。
en: The first advantage is that you’re not burdened with Ariel Sharon’s negative image among Palestinians and Arabs.

zh: 您担任耶路撒冷市市长十年，您亲身了解巴勒斯坦人的处境。
en: Having been the mayor of Jerusalem for 10 years, you know the situation of Palestinians close up.

zh: 我相信，在我们的地区实现政治性突破的机会从来没有这样好过。
en: I believe that the chances for a political breakthrough in our region have never been better.

zh: 在以色列方面，您和沙龙单方面决定与你们自己的意识形态背道而驰并且毅然撤出犹太人定居点，从而展示了你们对政治进程的信仰。
en: On the Israeli side, your faith in the political process was demonstrated recently when you and Sharon decided unilaterally to go against your own ideology and take on the powerful settler movement.

zh: 您两位还通过与你们的利库德集团决裂而与传统的以色列思维分道扬镳，从而极大地削弱了利库德集团极右翼的中央委员会对以色列政治的意识形态方面的操纵。
en: The two of you also went against conventional Israeli thinking by breaking away from your Likud party, greatly weakening the ideological stranglehold that Likud’s far-right central committee held on Israeli politics.

zh: 您两位认识到，从定居地区撤出并且结束对另一个民族永久的占领，对维护以色列的犹太人性质是必要的。 这样就明显地把您两位带入到以色列人思维的中间地带。
en: The realization that withdrawal from populated areas, and thus an end to holding another people under permanent occupation, was necessary to preserve the Jewish nature of Israel clearly brought the two of you to the center of Israeli thinking.

zh: 从另一个小的程度而言，巴勒斯坦方面也发生了巨变。
en: On a much smaller scale, significant change has been taking place on the Palestinian side as well.

zh: 我相信，我们之间的冲突的主因是占领，而非对占领的反应。 巴勒斯坦军事团体决定单方面宣布停火极大地减少了反以色列攻击。
en: While I believe that the occupation, rather than the reaction to it, is the main cause of our conflict, the unilateral tahdia (“declared calm”) decision by Palestinian militant groups has reduced anti-Israeli attacks mightily, which shows that Palestinians also realize the limits of their military actions.

zh: 这就表明巴勒斯坦人也意识到其军事行动的局限性。 哈马斯决定通过参加即将到来的立法选举而加入到政治进程中表明，即是这样一个强硬派里斯兰运动也得出结论，那就是我们之间的冲突应该通过政治手段而不是军事手段来加以解决。
en: The decision by Hamas to join the political process by participating in the upcoming legislative elections shows that even this hardline Islamic movement has concluded that our conflict needs to be addressed by political rather than military means.

zh: 我理解您是一位以色列的爱国者。 我相信，在降低我们两个民族之间的紧张局势方面可以大有作为，最终导向真正的和解与和平。
en: While I understand that you are an Israeli patriot, I believe that much can be done to reduce the tensions between our two peoples, eventually leading to genuine reconciliation and peace.

zh: 作为开始，应当把重点放在面对面谈判上。
en: As a start, priority must be given to face-to-face negotiations.

zh: 沙龙和您可能感觉到，在加沙地带需要单方面的行动。 但是，如果双方都采取行动，从加沙撤军对双方所产生的利益要大很多。
en: Sharon and you might have felt that unilateral action was needed in Gaza, but the withdrawal from Gaza could have produced many more benefits for both sides had it been done bilaterally.

zh: 直接谈判应当集中在两个平行轨道上。
en: Direct talks should concentrate on two parallel tracks.

zh: 会谈应当试图双方立即停止暴力，同时集中精力讨论我们之间冲突的永久解决方案。
en: They should attempt to produce an immediate cessation of violence from both sides while simultaneously focusing on a permanent settlement of our conflict.

zh: 与从被占领土撤军相反的是，停止暴力只能通过双方面实现。
en: Contrary to territorial withdrawal, cessation of violence can be achieved only bilaterally.

zh: 双方都应当承诺结束暗杀、轰炸、炸弹攻击以及对对方军事和平民目标的任何形式的攻击。
en: Both sides should commit to an end to assassinations, shelling, bombings, and any other form of attacks on the other side’s military targets and citizens.

zh: 为了达到效果，此类停火必须包含监督机制。
en: To be effective, such a cease-fire must contain a monitoring mechanism.

zh: 应当要求在主要的热点部署中立的外国观察员，并且对任何一方的任何人违反协议的任何条款都要请他们予以确认。
en: Neutral foreign observers should be asked to be deployed in major hot spots and be asked to identify anyone on either side who violates any of the agreement’s clauses.

zh: 除了这一措施外，应当立即开始有关永久性定居点的切实谈判。
en: Alongside this effort, vigorous negotiations on a permanent settlement should start immediately.

zh: 从历史上说，只有在双方都相信谈判是严肃和诚心诚意的背景下，停火才能维持。
en: Historically, cease-fires have survived only when they are backed by talks that both parties believe are genuine and serious.

zh: 同时，巴勒斯坦人之间的气氛以及他们对以色列的态度必须加以改善，这样我们就可以有一个支撑谈判的政治环境。
en: At the same time, the atmosphere among Palestinians and their attitude towards Israel must be improved, so that we can have a political environment that supports negotiations.

zh: 改善日常生活，特别是增加巴勒斯坦人来往于加沙和西岸之间以及西岸内部的自由也将会大大帮助创造积极的气氛。
en: Improving the daily conditions of life, particularly increasing Palestinians’ freedom of travel both between Gaza and the West Bank and within the West Bank, will also go a long way in helping to create a positive atmosphere.

zh: 我真心祝愿您成功地履行您的代总理和前进党代理主席的职责。
en: I truly wish you success in your responsibilities as acting Prime Minister and acting head of Kadima.

zh: 您的推进解决巴以冲突的努力大为改善整个中东地区的政治气氛。
en: Your efforts to move forward towards resolving the Palestinian-Israeli conflict will generate significant improvement in the political atmosphere in the entire Middle East.

zh: 但是，无论您在今后几个月做什么来赢得即将到来的议会选举，请记住前进党从以色列公众中得到的支持恰恰来源于它采取了温和中间立场的事实。
en: But, whatever you do in the next few months to win the forthcoming parliamentary elections, please remember that the support that Kadima has received from the Israeli public derives precisely from the fact that it has taken a moderate centrist position.

zh: 所以请不要迎合以色列极端分子和鹰派。
en: So please don’t allow yourself to be drawn into pandering to Israel’s radicals and hawks.

zh: 您和您的同事们从以色列人和阿拉伯人得到的支持将取决于您所展示的为和平进程中取得切实进展的决心。
en: The support that you and your colleagues will get from Israelis and Arabs will depend on the resolve that you show in making serious progress in the peace process.

zh: 这一进程正如以往一样，必须最终实现一个独立和民主的巴勒斯坦以及一个安全的以色列。
en: That process, now as before, must culminate in an independent and democratic Palestine alongside a safe and secure Israel.

zh: 亚洲警钟再次响起
en: Another Asian Wake-Up Call

zh: 纽黑文 — — 全球经济复苏再度告急，这是3年来的第2次。
en: NEW HAVEN – For the second time in three years, global economic recovery is at risk.

zh: 2008年，罪魁祸首是美国次贷危机。
en: In 2008, it was all about the subprime crisis made in America.

zh: 这一回则是欧洲主权债务危机。
en: Today, it is the sovereign-debt crisis made in Europe.

zh: 亚洲人应该清晰地听到了警钟 — — 出口导向地区不能对其最大的两个外部需求源的反复震荡无动于衷。
en: The alarm bells should be ringing loud and clear across Asia – an export-led region that cannot afford to ignore repeated shocks to its two largest sources of external demand.

zh: 事实上，两次震荡均将造成长期回响。
en: Indeed, both of these shocks will have long-lasting repercussions.

zh: 在美国，消费者（消费要占美国GDP的71 % ） 正在日本式的资产负债表衰退中苦苦挣扎。
en: In the United States, the American consumer (who still accounts for 71% of US GDP) remains in the wrenching throes of a Japanese-like balance-sheet recession.

zh: 自2008年年初以来的15个季度中，实际消费支出平均年增长率只有0.4 % 。
en: In the 15 quarters since the beginning of 2008, real consumer spending has increased at an anemic 0.4% average annual rate.

zh: 作为世界第一大消费国，美国还从未经历过如此长期的疲软。
en: Never before has America, the world’s biggest consumer, been so weak for so long.

zh: 除非美国家庭在削减债务负担、重建个人储蓄方面取得了重大进展 — — 按现在的缓慢节奏看，得许多年才能完成 — — 深受资产负债表约束的美国经济将继续在缓慢增长泥淖中无法自拔。
en: Until US households make greater progress in reducing excessive debt loads and rebuilding personal savings – a process that could take many more years if it continues at its recent snail-like pace – a balance-sheet-constrained US economy will remain hobbled by exceedingly slow growth.

zh: 欧洲的情况也差不多。
en: A comparable outcome is likely in Europe.

zh: 即使是在目前极为乐观的假设下 — — 欧元区能够保留 — — 欧洲经济前景也相当暗淡。
en: Even under the now seemingly heroic assumption that the eurozone will survive, the outlook for the European economy is bleak.

zh: 被危机摧残的外围经济体 — — 希腊、爱尔兰、葡萄牙、意大利，可能还包括西班牙 — — 已经陷入了衰退。
en: The crisis-torn peripheral economies – Greece, Ireland, Portugal, Italy, and even Spain – are already in recession.

zh: 领先指标表明 — — 如德国订单数据的显著下降 — — 曾经无比坚挺的核心国家德国和法国的经济增长也受到了威胁，出现了初步的疲软迹象。
en: And economic growth is threatened in the once-solid core of Germany and France, with leading indicators – especially sharply declining German orders data – flashing ominous signs of incipient weakness.

zh: 此外，财政紧缩可能在未来数年内影响总需求，资本短缺的银行可能收紧信贷 — — 这对欧洲的以银行为中心的信用中介体系来说是个严重问题 — — 泛欧洲衰退已成不可避免之势。
en: Moreover, with fiscal austerity likely to restrain aggregate demand in the years ahead, and with capital-short banks likely to curtail lending – a serious problem for Europe’s bank-centric system of credit intermediation – a pan-European recession seems inevitable.

zh: 欧洲委员会最近将其2012年GDP增长预测调低到了0.5 % ， 在全面衰退边缘摇摇欲坠。
en: The European Commission recently slashed its 2012 GDP growth forecast to 0.5% – teetering on the brink of outright recession.

zh: 官方预测数据在未来极有可能进一步调低。
en: The risks of further cuts to the official outlook are high and rising.

zh: 很难看出亚洲如何能在全球经济气候如此严峻的形势下成为繁荣的绿洲。
en: It is difficult to see how Asia can remain an oasis of prosperity in such a tough global climate.

zh: 但否定是深层次的，目前的势头看起来十分强劲。
en: Yet denial is deep, and momentum is seductive.

zh: 毕竟，亚洲在最近几年表现出色，太多的人相信，不管世界其他地区情况怎样，亚洲地区都能顶住。
en: After all, Asia has been on such a roll in recent years that far too many believe that the region can shrug off almost anything that the rest of the world dishes out.

zh: 要真是这样该多好。
en: If only it were that easy.

zh: 亚洲对外部冲击的脆弱性恶化了。
en: If anything, Asia’s vulnerability to external shocks has intensified.

zh: 在2008—2009年大衰退发生前夕出口占亚洲新兴市场整体GDP的比重上升到了44 % ， 比1997—1998年亚洲危机时搞了整整十个百分点。
en: On the eve of the Great Recession of 2008-2009, exports had soared to a record 44% of combined GDP for Asia’s emerging markets – fully ten percentage points higher than the export share prevailing during Asia’s own crisis in 1997-1998.

zh: 因此，尽管危机之后的亚洲在21世纪的最初十年专注于修复给其带来巨灾的金融脆弱性 — — 办法是囤积巨大的外汇储备，将经常项目赤字扭转为盈余，以及减少对短期资本流入的过度暴露 — — 但并没有再平衡经济的宏观结构。
en: So, while post-crisis Asia focused in the 2000’s on repairing the financial vulnerabilities that had wreaked such havoc – namely, by amassing huge foreign-exchange reserves, turning current-account deficits into surpluses, and reducing its outsize exposure to short-term capital inflows – it failed to rebalance its economy’s macro structure.

zh: 事实上，亚洲的经济增长变得更加依赖出口和外部需求了。
en: In fact, Asia became more reliant on exports and external demand for economic growth.

zh: 结果，当2008—2009年的冲击袭来时，亚洲地区的所有经济体要么经历了严重减速，要么陷入了严重衰退。
en: As a result, when the shock of 2008-2009 hit, every economy in the region either experienced a sharp slowdown or fell into outright recession.

zh: 这一幕在未来几个月内很可能会再次发生。
en: A similar outcome cannot be ruled out in the months ahead.

zh: 新兴亚洲的出口占GDP比重在2008—2009年间出现了剧减，但现在又回到了早前44%的高度，也就是说，该地区对外部需求冲击的暴露在今天与在3年前次贷危机即将发生时一样大。
en: After tumbling sharply in 2008-2009, the export share of emerging Asia is back up to its earlier high of around 44% of GDP – leaving the region just as exposed to an external-demand shock today as it was heading into the subprime crisis three years ago.

zh: 中国 — — 亚洲增长永动机的长期引擎 — — 是亚洲对发达国家震荡潜在脆弱性的典型代表。
en: China – long the engine of the all-powerful Asian growth machine – typifies Asia’s potential vulnerability to such shocks from the developed economies.

zh: 事实上，欧洲和美国加起来占中国2010年出口总额的38 % ， 是其最大的两个外国市场。
en: Indeed, Europe and the US, combined, accounted for fully 38% of total Chinese exports in 2010 – easily its two largest foreign markets.

zh: 最新数据确凿无疑地显示，亚洲正开始感到最近的全球震荡的冲击。
en: The recent data leave little doubt that Asia is now starting to feel the impact of the latest global shock.

zh: 与3年前相同，中国首当其冲，其年出口增长率从2010年10月的31%下降到了2011年10月的16 % ， 未来数月可能进一步下降。
en: As was the case three years ago, China is leading the way, with annual export growth plummeting in October 2011, to 16%, from 31% in October 2010 – and likely to slow further in coming months.

zh: 在香港，9月出口额实际上收缩了3 % ， 23个月以来首次出现同比下降。
en: In Hong Kong, exports actually contracted by 3% in September – the first year-on-year decline in 23 months.

zh: 韩国和台湾也显示出了类似的出口大幅减速迹象。
en: Similar trends are evident in sharply decelerating exports in Korea and Taiwan.

zh: 即使是长期以来被认为亚洲最能抵御冲击的经济体 — — 印度，年出口增长也从2011年8月的44%下降到了10月的11 % 。
en: Even in India – long thought to be among Asia’s most shock-resistant economies – annual export growth plunged from 44% in August 2011 to just 11% in October.

zh: 与3年前一样，许多人希望亚洲来一次“脱钩 ” ， 让这一腾飞中的地区免于全球震荡的干扰。
en: As was true three years ago, many hope for an Asian “decoupling” – that this high-flying region will be immune to global shocks.

zh: 但是，如今亚洲国家的GDP增长纷纷减速，这���愿望看起来只是一厢情愿。
en: But, with GDP growth now slowing across Asia, that hope appears to be wishful thinking.

zh: 好消息是，强大的投资拉动势头可以部分地抵消出口增长下降，并让亚洲免于硬着陆，实现软着陆。
en: The good news is that a powerful investment-led impetus should partly offset declining export growth and allow Asia’s landing to be soft rather than hard.

zh: 但是，如果欧元区瓦解，欧洲危机全面爆发，亚洲的美好愿望也将随之破灭。
en: All bets would be off, however, in the event of a eurozone breakup and a full-blown European implosion.

zh: 这是亚洲在3年内第二次听见警钟，这一回，亚洲需要认真对待了。
en: This is Asia’s second wake-up call in three years, and this time the region needs to take the warning seriously.

zh: 美国，这次又加上了欧洲，均面临着漫漫复苏路，亚洲新兴经济体无法再将稳健增长建立在依靠发达国家的外部需求的基础上，以维系可持续经济发展了。
en: With the US, and now Europe, facing long roads to recovery, Asia’s emerging economies can no longer afford to count on solid growth in external demand from the advanced countries to sustain economic development.

zh: 如果它们不想让增长减速，让劳动力迟迟得不到吸收，让社会不稳定风险与日俱增，那么他们就必须果断地将注意力转向该地区内部的35亿消费者。
en: Unless they want to settle for slower growth, lagging labor absorption, and heightened risk of social instability, they must move aggressively to shift focus to the region’s own 3.5 billion consumers.

zh: 消费拉动的亚洲再平衡才是最迫切的需要。
en: The need for a consumer-led Asian rebalancing has never been greater.

zh: 另一个巴尔干如日中天
en: Another Balkan High Noon

zh: 正当世界的目光集中在伊拉克、北朝鲜以及因核子武器而可能引发的与伊朗的冲突的时候，科索沃已经脱离了人们的视野。
en: With the world focused on Iraq, North Korea, and a possible clash with Iran over nuclear weapons, Kosovo has fallen off the radar screen.

zh: 这一无人过问的情况即将结束，而有关这一省份命运的决定即将做出。
en: That inattention will end soon; a decision about the province’s fate is looming.

zh: 美国及其欧洲朋友们已经多次表明它们的打算，也就是在年底以前做出决定，是否将科索沃分离出塞尔维亚。
en: The United States and its European friends have repeatedly stated their intent to make the difficult decision before the end of the year on whether to separate Kosovo from Serbia.

zh: 这一决定对于这一不稳定地区的前途至关重要，而且将会考验西方的决心和团结。
en: This decision – crucial to the future of an unstable region – will test Western determination and unity.

zh: 今年，由联合国调停的维也纳谈判表明，不会实现塞尔维亚和科索沃之间有关“最终地位”问题的协商一致的和解方案。
en: Negotiations this year in Vienna, brokered by the United Nations, showed that an agreed settlement between Serbia and Kosovo on “final status” will not happen.

zh: 谈判还在继续，但是，正如联合国谈判者及芬兰前总统阿赫蒂萨里以外交辞令所告诉安理会的那样，谈判实际上已经寿终正寝。
en: Talks continue, but, as UN negotiator and former Finnish President Martti Ahtisaari diplomatically told the Security Council, they are effectively dead.

zh: 没有一个塞尔维亚领导人会同意科索沃独立，因为，民族主义依然是这一国家占据统治地位的政治力量。
en: No Serbian leader will agree to Kosovo’s independence, because nationalism remains the dominant political force in the country.

zh: 实际上，塞尔维亚民族主义的鼓吹者、总理科什图尼察一直尽力试图削弱科索沃的临时政府。
en: Indeed, Prime Minister Vojislav Kostunica, the apostle of Serbian nationalism, has been trying in every way to undermine Kosovo’s interim government.

zh: 他正在迫不及待地在没有严肃的议会辩论和通常的公众教育的情况下在本月对新宪法举行全民公决。
en: He is rushing to hold a national referendum this month on a new constitution without serious parliamentary debate or the usual public education.

zh: 他的新宪法的主要目的就是其序言，这一序言宣布科索沃是塞尔维亚不可分割的一部分。
en: The main purpose of his new constitution is its preamble, which enshrines Kosovo as an inalienable part of Serbia.

zh: 科索沃原住阿尔巴尼亚人已经宣布，他们不会接受任何与塞尔维亚的联系，无论这一联系有多么的脆弱。
en: Kosovo’s ethnic Albanians have proclaimed that they will not accept any tie to Serbia, no matter how tenuous.

zh: 在整个九十年代，他们通过建立平行的机构实际上脱离了由塞尔维亚人治理的科索沃。
en: Throughout the 1990’s, they virtually opted out of Serbian-run Kosovo by creating parallel institutions.

zh: 1999年，他们强制大规模迁移，随后北约进行了干预，结果结束了塞尔维亚的统治并且建立了联合国管理下的准国家。 结果，唯有独立方能够让他们容忍。
en: Their forced mass exodus in 1999 and NATO’s subsequent intervention, which ended Serbia’s rule and established a quasi-state under UN administration, has made anything other than independence intolerable.

zh: 下一两个月的某些时候，巴尔干联络小组，即美国、英国、法国、德国、意大利和俄国将会考虑阿赫蒂萨里有关科索沃最终地位问题的建议，并有可能向安理会提出方案。 最终决定必须由安理会做出。
en: Some time over the next month or two, the Balkan Contact Group — the US, UK, France, Germany, Italy, and Russia – will consider Ahtisaari’s recommendations on Kosovo’s final status and possibly propose a solution to the Security Council, which must make the final decision.

zh: 在公开的场合下，所有联络小组的成员都试图让最终地位问题处于未决状态。 但是私下里，美国及其部分盟国告诉另外两方说它们将会在今年提议独立。
en: In public, all Contact Group members have tried to leave the question of Kosovo’s final status open, but informally the US and some of its allies have told the two parties that they will propose independence this year.

zh: 安理会的某些成员国，特别是俄国和中国反对强加解决方案，或者对此怀疑。 基本上没有国家赞成分割另一个国家的领土，而无论形势有多么迫切。
en: Some members of the Security Council – particularly Russia and China – are opposed to or skeptical of an imposed settlement, and few governments favor dividing up another country’s territory, however compelling the circumstances.

zh: 安理会是否批准独立将很大程度上取决于避免俄国投票反对，而这就要求大量的外交努力。
en: Whether the Security Council will approve independence largely depends on averting a Russian veto, which will require considerable diplomatic effort.

zh: 所赋予的独立的性质也是重要的。
en: The nature of the independence bestowed is also important.

zh: 一个独立的科索沃必须得到安全，其少数民族必须得到保护。
en: An independent Kosovo must be secured and its minorities protected.

zh: 现在，北科索沃很大程度上受到贝尔格莱德控制，因此，除了名义上以外，它无法分割出去。
en: Northern Kosovo, now largely under Belgrade’s control, must not be partitioned off in all but name.

zh: 为了降低对塞尔维亚的打击，安理会必须避免以严重扭曲的方式赋予科索沃独立，以至于新的国家无法运行。
en: In the interest of reducing the blow to Serbia, the Security Council must avoid granting independence in ways that are so contorted that the new state cannot effectively function.

zh: 如果安理会无法就最终地位问题做出决定，这就将会产生严重的局面。 那就是，科索沃将会单方面宣布独立，而所有的国家都不得不决定是否承认这一新的国家。
en: If the Security Council fails to reach a decision on final status, it will produce a GRAVE situation: Kosovo would declare independence unilaterally, and all nations would have to make up their mind whether or not to recognize the new state.

zh: 如果这样的事情发生，北科索沃的塞尔维亚人就可能宣布他们也独立。
en: If that happens, it is likely that the Serbs of North Kosovo would declare their own independence.

zh: 至少，塞尔维亚将会大力反对承认。
en: At a minimum, Serbia would campaign strongly against recognition.

zh: 实际上，塞尔维亚政府已经试图说服西方把决定推迟到2007年年中。
en: In fact, Serbia’s government is already trying to persuade the West to postpone a decision until mid-2007.

zh: 它宣称，如果授予科索沃独立，极端民族主义的激进党将会在下一次的大选中上台；它并且相信，在今年举行选举将会让联络小组推迟向安理会做出提议。
en: It claims that if Kosovo is granted independence, the ultranationalist Radical Party will come to power in the next elections, and believes that holding elections as early as this year will cause the Contact Group to delay a proposal to the Security Council.

zh: 而且，该政府鼓励波斯尼亚的塞族共和国民主进步党的领导人威胁就有关从依旧脆弱的波斯尼亚分离举行自己的全民公决。
en: Moreover, the government has encouraged the leaders of Bosnia’s Republika Srpska to threaten to hold their own referendum on separation from a still fragile Bosnia.

zh: 而且他们继续争取解除阿赫蒂萨里的职务以便拖延维也纳会谈，但是并未如愿。
en: And they continue to push -- unsuccessfully -- for Ahtisaari’s removal in order to prolong the Vienna talks.

zh: 宪法全民公决的时机看起来是推延策略的一部分。
en: The timing of the constitutional referendum appears to be a part of this delaying strategy.

zh: 有人希望，推迟决定将会激发科索沃的暴力并且进一步鼓励西方重新考虑独立事宜。
en: Some hope that postponement will stimulate violence in Kosovo and further encourage Western reconsideration of independence.

zh: 这一战术可能正在奏效。
en: That tactic may be working.

zh: 许多欧盟国家担心夺走某国领土的含义，以及科索沃独立对塞尔维亚民主的影响。
en: Many European Union countries are worried about the implications of taking away a country’s territory, as well as the impact of Kosovo’s independence on Serbian democracy.

zh: 鉴于塞尔维亚政治不稳定，他们质疑短期推迟所带来的损害，尽管大多数是自我造成的。
en: Given Serbia’s political instability, they question the harm of a short-term postponement – albeit mostly self-inflicted.

zh: 但是，推迟只能够给科什图尼察更大的空间来寻找途径让安理会的决定更为困难。
en: But delay only offers more room for Kostunica to find ways to make a Security Council decision more difficult.

zh: 西方必须不理睬贝尔格莱德的警告。
en: The West must ignore Belgrade’s siren song.

zh: 塞尔维亚政治在可以预见的将来将会是混乱不堪以及不稳定的。 塞尔维亚的政客们将力图以此作为避免面临失去科索沃的借口。
en: Serbian politics will be chaotic and unstable for the foreseeable future, and Serbian politicians will attempt to present this as an excuse to avoid facing the loss of Kosovo.

zh: 同样，在塞尔维亚和科索沃之间在任何情况下建立联系都存在问题。
en: Likewise, there will be problems establishing ties between Serbia and Kosovo under any circumstances.

zh: 但是，在科索沃的最终地位问题上裹足不前将会产生更为糟糕的巴尔干局势。 这一局面将会阻止塞尔维亚靠近西方并最终获得欧盟成员国资格，将科索沃的少数族裔至于危险的悬而未决的境地，并且破坏类似波斯尼亚和马其顿那些脆弱国家。
en: But failure to proceed definitively now on Kosovo’s final status will produce a worse Balkan situation, one that blocks Serbia’s move toward the West and ultimate membership in the EU, condemns Kosovo’s ethnic minorities to dangerous ambiguity, and imperils fragile states like Bosnia and Macedonia.

zh: 除了独立以外，对于科索沃而言没有现实的解决方案。
en: No realistic solution exists for Kosovo but independence.

zh: 如果塞尔维亚想要加入西方，它就不应当陷于其民族主义的过去而丧失机会。
en: If Serbia wants to join the West, it must not forsake that opportunity by trapping itself in its nationalist past.

zh: 墙里的另一块“金砖 ” ？
en: Another BRIC in the Wall?

zh: 纽约 — —
en: NEW YORK – Conventional wisdom rarely survives a good stress test, and few tests have been as stressful as that which the global economy has endured over the past 24 months. A healthy season of reappraisal has dawned, shining a new light on boom-time notions like the value of opaque markets, the untouchable status of the American consumer, or the wisdom of deregulation.

zh: 传统的智慧很难应对一个设计良好的压力测试。 在过去的24个月中，很少有这样的压力测试像全球经济经历了那次危机那样难以对付。
en: One piece of bubble wisdom that has escaped relatively unscathed, however, is the assumption that the “BRIC” countries – Brazil, Russia, India, and China – will increasingly call the economic tune in years to come.

zh: 现在，一缕新的曙光正在刚刚出现，伴随着一些新理论的出现，这些理论包括晦涩的市场价格论，美国消费者不可动摇的地位轮，或是称为放松监管论等。
en: The BRIC notion, coined in a 2003 Goldman Sachs report, is not all bad: at 75% correct, it scores a good deal better than most economic prognostications of the day.

zh: 在本轮的泡沫经济中，有一种相对来说没受到冲击的理论，那就是所谓“金砖四国”的概念 — — 巴西，俄罗斯，印度和中国 — — 在全球经济中越来越有分量。
en: Yet the economic crisis that began in 2008 exposed one of the four as an impostor.

zh: 金砖四国的概念是高盛在2003年提出的，这个概念看起来不坏，至少75%的正确，它比当今社会的其他经济概念来的要准确一些。
en: Set the vital statistics of the BRIC economies side-by-side and it becomes painfully obvious that, in the words of the old Sesame Street game, “One of these things is not like the other.”

zh: 起于2008年的经济危机将四个中的一个打回原形。
en: The weakness of the Russian economy and its highly leveraged banks and corporations, in particular, which was masked in recent years by the windfall brought by spiking oil and gas prices, burst into full view as the global economy tumbled.

zh: 如果我们再仔细地一个一个分析金砖四国的经济数据，就会发现真相，正如老芝麻街游戏所说的那样 ： “ 他们之间各不相同。 ”
en: Saddled with a rust-belt infrastructure, Russia further disqualifies itself with dysfunctional and revanchist politics and a demographic trend in near-terminal decline.

zh: 俄罗斯经济的衰弱性及其本国银行和公司的高杠杆性被近些年来虚高的油价和天然气价格所掩盖。 但在本期全球经济大动荡中暴露无遗。
en: Even with the modest recovery in commodity prices over the past six months, Russia’s energy sector has experienced declining production in recent years, due in part to fears among foreign investors of expropriation.

zh: 背负着破败的重工业基础设施，加上运转失灵和复仇主义政治形态，与此同时，俄罗斯的人口也处于近乎下滑通道之中。
en: Russia’s sovereign wealth fund, integral in propping up an increasingly re-centralized economy, is being depleted fast. If negative trends continue, Russia’s reserve fund could eventually be exhausted.

zh: 即使在过去6个月，商品价格有所回升，俄罗斯的能源产量近些年来还一直下滑，部分原因是害怕外资的介入。
en: Russia’s fall back to earth, meanwhile, spawned a kind of parlor game among academics, foreign-policy wonks, and educated investors, aimed at replacing the country in the club of major emerging-market economies.

zh: 随着中央集权的进一步扩大，俄罗斯的主权财富基金正在濒临枯竭。 如果一直这么下去的话，俄罗斯的外汇储备最终也会消耗殆尽。
en: A variety of acronyms has been suggested, from the cutesy BRICET (adding Eastern Europe and Turkey) to BRICKETs (the former plus South Korea) and – an even greater stretch – BRIMC, which shoehorns Mexico into the mix.

zh: 关于俄经济的旧病复发，在学术界，研究对外政策的学究们和受过教育的投资者中引发了一场争论：是否增加新的国家进入新兴市场国家名单之中。
en: In all of these revisions, Russia survives, despite the writing on its economic wall.

zh: 于是，各种不同的新名词纷纷出台，从BRICET（金砖四国加上东欧和土耳其）导BRICKETS（上述国家再加上韩国 ） ， 甚至范围还要扩大 — — BRIMC，连墨西哥都要掺乎在里面。
en: While Russia retains the world’s largest (if somewhat aging) arsenal of nuclear weapons, as well as a permanent seat (and thus veto power) on the UN Security Council, it is more sick than BRIC.

zh: 主要是因为俄罗斯依然拥有世界上最大的核武器库（虽有武器的年头有点老。 ） ， 同时在联合国安理会拥有常任理事国的席位（也就意味着拥有一票否决权。
en: Purely from the standpoint of economic potential and fundamentals, the case is far stronger for South Korea, a sophisticated economic power whose primary liability is the danger that the regime of its evil twin to the north will collapse and inundate it with hungry refugees.

zh: 虽然受到邪恶的小兄弟北韩随时崩盘的危险，韩国坚实的经济实力随时准备接纳来自邻国的难民潮。 土耳其也有类似的情况：生机勃勃的银行业，发展势头强劲的国内市场，对中东和能源政策影响力日益增加。
en: The same is true of Turkey, with its robust banking sector, thriving domestic market, growing importance to Middle East and energy politics, NATO membership, European Union membership bid, and ties to ethnic cousins across Central Asia.

zh: 恐怕最引人入胜的国家要数印度尼西亚了。 作为全世界最大的穆斯林国家，印尼中产阶级人数迅速增加，国内相对稳定的政局。
en: Perhaps the most compelling case of all is that of Indonesia, the world’s largest Muslim state, with a rapidly expanding middle class, relatively stable democratic politics, and an economy that has been a star performer in Asia despite the global recession.

zh: 在全球经济衰退的大背景下，印尼的经济在亚洲一枝独秀地成长。 对于美国来说，印尼比俄罗斯来说更具吸引力，而俄罗斯正在和委内瑞拉一起唱衰美国。
en: From an American perspective, Indonesia is an attractive alternative to Russia, which recently has vied with Venezuela for leadership of the “America in decline” cheering section.

zh: 印尼不仅仅从经济上来说，甚至从一个国家的层面来看，复兴的都更快一些。
en: Indonesia, moreover, has shown resilience not only economically, but also as a nation.

zh: 尽管民族成分复杂，岛屿众多，印尼正在迅速地从军事独裁国家转型，经过包括1997年的亚洲金融危机，2004年的海啸以及极端穆斯林有所抬头和国内政局动荡等多次的挑战和反复之后，国家正在复苏之中。
en: In spite of its diverse ethnic makeup and far-flung island territory, the country has made a quick transition from military dictatorship and has recovered from myriad challenges and setbacks, including the 1997 Asian financial crisis, the tsunami in 2004, the emergence of radical Islam, and domestic unrest.

zh: 虽然印尼的人均GDP还较低，但国家的经济潜力很大，印尼作为一个新星，正在冉冉地升起。
en: While Indonesia’s per capita GDP remains low, it is a country’s potential that matters in economic affairs, and here Indonesia shines.

zh: 和其他亚洲国家相比（更不用说俄罗斯了 ） ， 印尼对对出口的依赖性较小。 本国丰富的原材料（包括木材，棕榈油，特别是煤炭）吸引了大量的外资。
en: Indonesia depends less on exports than its Asian peers (let alone Russia), and its asset markets (timber, palm oil, and coal, in particular) have attracted major foreign investment.

zh: 雅加达的政府在反对腐败问题上立场鲜明，现在更加强调制度建设的重要性。
en: The government in Jakarta, meanwhile, has taken a strong stand against corruption and moved to address structural problems.

zh: 印尼的人口结构也有优势，目前人口2.3亿，是世界上第四大人口大国 — — 相当于德国（八千多万）和俄罗斯人口加起来的总和。
en: Even demographic trends favor Indonesia, which, with 230 million people, is already the fourth largest country in the world by population – a full Germany (80-plus million) larger than Russia.

zh: 但观念一旦形成就很难修改。 俄罗斯已经成为金砖四国不可缺少的一部分。
en: But catchy ideas die hard, and Russia has moved to cement the current concept of the BRICs into an irreversible reality.

zh: 目前这个概念已经成为实际中的现实，在今年6月，这四个国家的领袖召开了第一次金砖四国会议。
en: The ossification of the BRICs into a de facto global institution move forward dramatically in June, when the four countries’ leaders met (in Russia, of course) for the first “BRIC Summit.”

zh: 此次会议明显是冲着美国来的，四国一致同意将美元拉下本国外汇的主要币种。
en: That meeting produced a notable broadside against the United States, as each member declared its desire to unseat the dollar as the global reserve currency.

zh: 几个月之前，四国在20国家峰会之前发表联合声明，誓言要改变全球经济体系的规则。
en: A few months earlier, the four were moved to issue a joint communiqué ahead of the G-20 Summit in April noting their shared determination to change the rules of the global economic system.

zh: 对于私营经济来说，金砖四国指数开始盛行，虽然高盛又引入了一个新的概念 — — “下一个11国 ” ， 这包括了孟加拉国，埃及，印度尼西亚，伊朗，墨西哥，尼日利亚，巴基斯坦，菲律宾，韩国，土耳其加上越南等11个国家，把他们也当做经济变化的晴雨表。
en: In the private sector, BRIC index funds have proliferated, though Goldman Sachs has radically hedged its own BRIC bet by introducing a second term – the “Next 11,” or N-11 – to the debate.

zh: 加上先前的金砖四国，或许形成了一个更具有说服力的新兴国家“第一梯队 ” 。
en: This grouping adds Bangladesh, Egypt, Indonesia, Iran, Mexico, Nigeria, Pakistan, the Philippines, South Korea, Turkey, and Vietnam to the economic radar, and, together with the four BRIC countries, probably comprises a more logical and defensible “first tier” of emerging economies.

zh: 俄罗斯对自身被降级嗤之以鼻，美国官员也好像也要澄清这场口水战。
en: Russia sniffs at the idea of demotion, and American officials appear to have decided to steer clear of the semantic debate.

zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯却在积极筹划金砖四国的叶卡捷琳堡会议，同时抢着买单，难道危机这么快就来了么？
en: Still, it should surprise no one that Russia lobbied hard for the Yekaterinburg BRIC summit, and footed the bill for much of it as well. Why risk exposure too soon?

zh: 又一尊大佛被毁坏
en: Another Buddha Destroyed

zh: 纽约 — — 2001年，阿富汗巴米杨不朽的大佛被塔利班军队摧毁使整个世界沉浸在一片恐怖的氛围中。
en: NEW YORK -- The world watched in horror when Taliban forces destroyed the monumental Buddha statues in Bamiyan, Afghanistan in 2001.

zh: 来自世界各地的政治和文化领袖对袭击行为表示了谴责。
en: Political and cultural leaders from around the globe condemned the attacks.

zh: 很多人主动要求提供帮助。
en: Offers of help poured in.

zh: 每个人都在询问：如果再有这样的事情发生，世界是否做好了应对的准备？
en: Everyone asked: will the world be ready next time?

zh: 唉，回答是完全没有。
en: Alas, the answer is a resounding “no.”

zh: 在巴基斯坦西北部的斯瓦特河谷（Swat valley ） ， 全副武装的伊斯兰好战分子不久前袭击了佛教艺术中一尊最古老也是最重要的雕像。
en: In northwest Pakistan’s Swat valley armed Islamist militants recently attacked one of the oldest and most important sculptures of Buddhist art.

zh: 这尊雕像的历史可以追溯到基督教起源的年代，雕像取坐姿，通高130英尺，在南亚地区的重要性仅次于巴米杨大佛而位列第二。
en: Dating from around the beginning of the Christian era, and carved into a 130-foot-high rock, the seated image of the Buddha was second in importance in South Asia only to the Bamiyan Buddhas.

zh: 不仅如此，这已经是一个月内发动的第二次袭击。
en: This, moreover, was the second attack in less than a month.

zh: 巴基斯坦《黎明报》的Murtaza Razvi指出：这次遭受袭击的佛像并非位于偏远地区。
en: Murtaza Razvi of Pakistan’s Dawn newspaper has pointed out that the image that was attacked was not in a remote area.

zh: 恰恰相反，它就坐落在穿过河谷中央的大路近旁。
en: In fact, it was next to the central road that runs through the valley.

zh: 尽管首次袭击发生之后，巴基斯坦考古学家一再呼吁当地政府保护坐佛和其他古迹，但政府却没有采取任何措施。
en: Despite repeated requests by Pakistani archeologists to the local authorities to protect the seated Buddha and other sites, especially after the first attack, no action was taken.

zh: 事实上，好战分子有充足的时间完成破坏行动 — — 在石像上打眼并填满炸药，而后将其引爆 — — 而这一切破坏活动居然得以在光天化日之下从容进行。
en: In fact, militants were able to carry out their work – drilling holes in the rock, filling them with explosives, and detonating them – in broad daylight.

zh: 他们这样做不是一次，而是两次。
en: They did this not once, but twice.

zh: 第一次，大佛由于好战分子的失误并没有遭到严重的损坏。
en: The first time, the image escaped heavy damage because of the militants’ incompetence.

zh: 而第二次，他们就幸运多了，不仅炸毁了大佛的脸部，而且毁坏了他的肩膀和脚。
en: The second time, they were more successful, destroying not only the sculpture’s face, but also its shoulders and feet.

zh: 似乎这还不够，现在又有关于第三次袭击的报导。
en: As if that were not enough, there are now reports of a third attack.

zh: 1995年，我曾穿越斯瓦特河谷对佛教宝藏进行研究。
en: In 1995, I traveled through the Swat valley to study the area’s Buddhist treasures.

zh: 这些令人叹为观止的文物或者雕刻在悬崖之上，或者收藏在美丽的小型博物馆中，为千百年来一直笃信佛教的当地穆斯林群众带去了快乐与骄傲。
en: Carved in the cliff side or protected in small beautiful museums, these remarkable objects were the pride and joy of local Muslims, followers of the faith for more than a millennium.

zh: 虽然我是一位非穆斯林的印度女性，但我却可以毫无惧怕地穿越整个地区，而且从当地居民那里得到了热情的援助。
en: As a non-Muslim, Indian woman, I was able to travel through the region without any fear and received warm support from local residents.

zh: 所有派别的人们都欢迎我的到来，他们也愿意领我参观重要的佛教文物。
en: People of all stripes welcomed me, and were often willing to take me to important Buddhist sites.

zh: 仅仅10年后，气氛已遭到如此的毒化，以至于当地的警方和居民领袖都不愿挺身而出保护这些有纪念意义的文物，也不敢主张它们的所有权。
en: Today, little over a decade later, the atmosphere is so poisoned that neither local community leaders nor the local police came forward to protect these monuments or claim them as their own.

zh: 更令人悲哀的是，尽管巴基斯坦报纸大范围地谴责袭击事件，批评当地官员的冷漠态度，但在国际媒体上却鲜有这方面的报导见诸报端。
en: Even sadder is that while Pakistani newspapers widely condemned these attacks and criticized local officials’ indifference, there has been almost no coverage in the international press.

zh: 是不是在伊拉克战争以后，在巴格达国家博物馆令人惊讶的掠夺事件发生以后，我们已经失去了愤怒的能力？
en: Can it be that after the Iraq war, and the dismaying images of looting at the National Museum in Baghdad, we have lost our capacity to be outraged?

zh: 是不是我们已经在反恐战争的噩耗中变得麻木，不愿再去了解新发生的事情？
en: Or is it that we have become so inured to bad news surrounding the war on terror that we have no desire to know more?

zh: 在斯瓦特河谷和巴基斯坦西北部有着大量重要的佛教文物。
en: There is a vast number of important Buddhist sites in Swat and other areas of northwest Pakistan.

zh: 就在此刻，由于伊斯兰领袖Mullah Fazlullah的巨大影响，所有这些文物都正面临着灭顶之灾。 Fazlullah是Sufi Mohammad的女婿，正是后者创建了伊斯兰教的极端派别。
en: At this point, all of them are under threat of destruction, thanks to the influential voice of the Islamist leader Mullah Fazlullah, whose father-in-law, Sufi Mohammad, founded one of the extremist orders.

zh: 该教派曾把10，000多名吉哈德战士派往阿富汗，在2001年与塔利班军队一道与美军作战。
en: This order was responsible for bringing more than 10,000 jihadi fighters to Afghanistan to fight alongside Taliban soldiers against the United States in 2001.

zh: 尽管据传Mohammad在一家小监狱里受苦受难，但Mullah Fazlullah却没有受到任何惩罚，而且一直利用电波传播着仇恨和偏狭的消息。
en: While Mohammad is believed to be languishing in a regional jail, Mullah Fazlullah operates with impunity, using the radio to spread a message of hatred and intolerance.

zh: 现在到了全世界人民不仅对此种破坏文物的丑行表示愤怒，而且与绝望地对政府施加压力，让政府为了他们、也为了我们，保护那些前伊斯兰时代的文化遗产的巴基斯坦人并肩作战的时候了。
en: It is time that the world community not only registers its outrage against such destruction of cultural treasures, but also joins those Pakistanis who are desperately trying to pressure their government to preserve – for their sake and ours – their pre-Islamic cultural heritage.

zh: 如果世界这次还不采取行动，我们就可能永远地失去早期佛教历史上最为珍贵的遗产。
en: If the world does not act this time, we risk losing one of the most precious legacies of early Buddhist history.

zh: 英国大选结果恐将拖累改革
en: Another Failed British Experiment

zh: 佛罗伦萨 — — 英国政治一向是发达国家中的试验场。
en: FLORENCE – British politics has always been something of an experimental laboratory for the industrialized world.

zh: 20世纪70年代，英国模式成为管理战后经济崩溃的典范。
en: In the 1970’s, Britain was where the preeminent postwar model of how to manage the economy collapsed.

zh: 该模式政治上的基础是凝聚共识，经济上的基础是凯恩斯主义需求管理。
en: That model had been based politically on the creation of consensus, and economically on Keynesian demand management.

zh: 如今，在我们眼前崩溃掉的是“轻监管”体制，在该体制盛行时期，把自己包装成“新工党”的那个政党接受了大市场模式，尤其是大范围地放松了对金融市场的监管。
en: Today, the equivalent collapse has been of the “regulation-lite” regime in which a party that styled itself as “New Labour” accepted a powerful role for markets – particularly for largely deregulated financial markets.

zh: 20世纪60年代，凯恩斯主义经济政策营造出一种人人受益的幻影：高就业水平、高工资增长；英伦三岛成了地球上最酷的地方，披头士、滚石乐队、嘉纳碧街（Carnaby Street）上的粉彩风（pastal fashions ） ， 无不令人目眩神迷。
en: In the 1960’s, Keynesian policies delivered the illusion that everyone was benefiting, with high levels of employment and significant wage growth. Britain was the coolest place on earth, boasting the Beatles and the Rolling Stones and the pastel fashions of Carnaby Street.

zh: 然而，凯恩斯主义搞的是持续不断的财政扩张，却不用货币紧缩来抵消它的副作用。
en: But Keynesianism involved continued fiscal expansion, with no offsetting monetary contraction.

zh: 到了20世纪70年代，这一套办法终于给英国带来种种苦果：国际收支经常项目下不可持续的巨额赤字、高涨的通货膨胀水平以及在当务之急问题上的政治死结。
en: By the 1970’s, it had brought to the United Kingdom large and ultimately unsustainable current-account deficits, high levels of inflation, and then political gridlock over what to do.

zh: 哪个社会群体该为全民利益第一个作出牺牲？
en: Which group should be the first to make a sacrifice?

zh: 1974年初，爱德华·希思（Edward Heath）的保守党内阁跟势力很大的煤炭工会为了“谁统治英国”而缠斗不休。
en: In early 1974, Edward Heath’s Conservative government was locked in a struggle with the powerful coal miners’ union over “who rules Britain.”

zh: 2月，他要求提前举行议会大选，选举结果却没有一个是赢家。
en: He called a premature election in February, in which there was no clear winner.

zh: 希思的支持率落到谷底。
en: Heath was deeply unpopular.

zh: 反对党工党也乏善可陈，提不出足以代替保守党路线的纲领。
en: But the opposition Labour Party was not convincing either, and had little in the way of an intellectual alternative.

zh: 它只想避免同工会发生正面冲突。
en: It simply sought to avoid confrontation with the unions.

zh: 大选使英国政治陷入僵局。
en: The election produced a political stalemate.

zh: 中间派自由民主党最初采取均势策略，坊间则传言希思准备推动选举制度改革，说他许诺建立比例代表制，方便自由民主党在未来大选中获取更多议席，以换取后者支持保守党重新组阁。
en: The centrist Liberal Democrats appeared to hold the balance of power, and stories circulated of how Heath was prepared to concede a reformed voting system. He held out the promise of proportional representation, which would ensure a greater number of parliamentary seats for the Liberal Democrats in future elections, in exchange for the party’s support for a new Conservative government.

zh: 今年5月6日的英国大选极有可能再度导致1974年那样的僵局。
en: There appears to be an overwhelming likelihood that the 1974 stalemate will be repeated in the upcoming general election on May 6.

zh: 政治交易已在酝酿之中，不受欢迎的现任首相戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）相当于当年希思的那个角色，他正在向自由民主党暗送秋波，承诺推动宪法改革，给这个第三大党更多好处。
