en: The political maneuvering has already started, with the unpopular incumbent prime minister, Gordon Brown, today’s equivalent of Heath, bidding for the Liberal Democrats’ support by promising a constitutional reform that would give the party major advantages.

zh: 1974年的时候，人们谈得很多的保守党—自民党联盟并没有最终形成，因为自由民主党不愿把自己的命运跟一位不受欢迎、信誉扫地的政治家拴在一起。
en: In 1974, the touted Conservative-Liberal Democrat coalition never materialized, as the Liberal Democrats were wary of hitching their fortunes to an unpopular and discredited politician.

zh: 结果诞生了一个少数派内阁，它得不停地为取得支持率与合法性而苦苦挣扎，最终只能出台一些不痛不痒的政策，丝毫没有触及英国深层次的问题。
en: The result was a minority government that struggled for support and legitimacy, and in the end offered only policies that provided no real answer to the country’s underlying problems.

zh: 今日英国的局面更像1974年，而不像1979年，那一年，撒切尔革命把这个国家带上了一条新的轨道。
en: Britain today resembles 1974 much more than it resembles 1979, when the Thatcher revolution set the country on a new path.

zh: 如今，经济上也面临大问题 — — 信贷驱动的泡沫破灭了，银行业岌岌可危（唯一的差别是，由于金融体系的大幅扩张和国际化，如今的银行规模大得多 ） 。
en: There is again a major economic problem, the end of a credit-driven boom, and a threat to the banks (except that it all looks much bigger, owing to the financial system’s massive growth and internationalization).

zh: 两大政党都暴露出疲态，似乎在争相模仿对手。
en: Both major political parties look tired, and at the same time as if they are competing to imitate each other.

zh: 这样的选择让选民意兴阑珊。
en: The choice appalls voters.

zh: 还可以类比1992年的意大利政局，当年，主导意大利政坛40年的两大党 — — 基督教民主党和意大利共产党，由于腐败和思想上的贫乏，居然双双失势。
en: There is also an ominous resemblance to Italy in 1992, when both major parties of the previous 40 years, the Christian Democrats and the Communists, simply melted away in a mixture of corruption and intellectual failure.

zh: 21世纪头十年的经济繁荣，同20世纪60年代一样，看上去人人都像活在童话里一般。
en: In the 2000’s boom, as in the 1960’s, it looked as if everyone could live on the never-never.

zh: 20世纪60年代，反周期财政政策许下全面繁荣的诺言；21世纪头十年，令人们产生幻想的换成了个人负债消费，而不是政府赤字财政。
en: In 1960’s, it was counter-cyclical fiscal policy that held out the promise of prosperity for all; in the 2000’s, it was that individuals rather than the state piled up debt.

zh: 金融市场的魔术使借债和消费的个人化得以可能。
en: The magic of markets made possible an individualization of borrowing and consumption.

zh: 同20世纪70年代时一样，今日的经济崩溃，也令所谓“人人受益”的方式显露无遗：房产所有者看到房价上涨、社会福利覆盖面有所扩大、人们陶醉在一波类似20世纪60年代“酷英伦”的潮流之中。
en: As in the meltdown of the 1970’s, it is easy to see how everyone benefited from the recent boom: homeowners saw their houses rising in price, social-welfare payments were expanded, and people seemed swept up in a new wave of 1960’s-style “Cool Britannia.”

zh: 但是也正如70年代一样，今日英国的未来注定坎坷，而且还笼罩在债台高筑的阴影之下。
en: But now, as then, Britain’s future is bleak and overshadowed by debt.

zh: 大力整顿是当务之急。
en: Major adjustments are needed.

zh: 然而就在此时，两大政党都感觉难以直面问题，因为谁都不敢在大选前呼吁民众为国牺牲。
en: At the same time, the main parties find it hard to address the country’s problems, because they are reluctant to call for sacrifice before an election.

zh: 而且，工党政府和反对党保���党双方的纲领颇显雷同，都在往自由民主党的立场上靠。
en: And, because the party programs of the Labour government and the Conservative opposition are not clearly distinguishable, they find it hard to differentiate themselves from the Liberal Democrats.

zh: 两大党都在争取中间选民，但是在这一点上它们没法儿比原本就是中间政党的自民党做得更好，何况后者向来在野，不像两大党那样饱受腐败丑闻的困扰。
en: Both major parties are appealing to the political center, but they will never be as convincing as a political party that really is in the political center, and that is unencumbered by the scandals attached to the past exercise of power.

zh: 到目前为止的竞选趋势表明，自由民主党成绩异常出色。
en: The course of the electoral struggle so far indicates that the Liberal Democrats will do very well.

zh: 在电视辩论中，自民党党魁的光芒盖过了其他两大党的党魁。
en: Their leader outshines his Conservative and Labour counterparts in television debates and on the campaign trail.

zh: 此外，工党和保守党都陷入了一个政治陷阱。
en: Moreover, Labour and the Conservatives are in a political trap.

zh: 一旦他们反对自民党的立场，他们就显得走了极端，从而失去了选民的好感。
en: The moment they start to disagree with the Liberal Democrats, they will make themselves look extreme and will forfeit voter sympathies.

zh: 然而，这种一味求稳的政治气候会妨碍英国寻找大刀阔斧的改革之道，而那才是英国所急需的东西。
en: But this demand for political moderation impedes the search for the radical and painful solutions that Britain needs.

zh: 大选的结果很可能是产生一个扯皮议会，没有一个政党获得显著多数，就像20世纪70年代那样，对英国的深层次问题碌碌无为，难怪国际货币市场的反应，同20世纪70年代中期如出一辙。
en: Little wonder, then, that currency markets are treating the likely outcome in Britain – a hung parliament, with no clear majority for any party – as a repeat of the mid-1970’s, with no clear solution to the country’s underlying economic problems on offer.

zh: 2009年的汇率将又会大起大落吗？
en: Another Roller Coaster Ride for Exchange Rates in 2009?

zh: 坎布里奇-2008年是汇率非常动荡的一年。
en: CAMBRIDGE – 2008 has been an exceptionally tumultuous year for exchange rates.

zh: 美元的上涨，日元的进入轨道，欧元的回落，和英镑的惨跌，这一切捅了一个大窟窿。
en: The American dollar soared, the Japanese yen went into orbit, the euro fell to earth, and the British pound crashed, leaving a giant crater.

zh: 和加拿大元、澳大利亚元、新西兰元和南非兰特等“商品货币” 一样，新兴市场国家的货币受到打击。
en: Emerging-market currencies were hammered, as were “commodity currencies” such as the Canadian, Australian, and New Zealand dollars, and the South African rand.

zh: 实际上，每个在很大程度上依赖于商品出口国家的货币，都受到影响。
en: Indeed, the currency of any country that is significantly dependent on commodity exports has suffered.

zh: 那么，明年的汇率将会是怎样？
en: So, what will the New Year bring for exchange rates?

zh: 虽然只有持续的高波动性是安全的赌注，但我们正处于一个不寻常的时刻，短期和长期趋势似乎是非常不同的。
en: While the only safe bet is continuing high volatility, we are at an unusual juncture where the short- and long-term trends appear to be very different.

zh: 从短期来看，日元和美元继续受益于大众对风险的逃避，因为惊慌的投资者需要寻求藏身之地。
en: In the short run, the yen and the dollar continue to benefit from a flight to safety, as panicked investors seek a place to hide.

zh: 当其它国家的央行继续把利率下调至微乎其微的地步之时，日元和美元因此正在升值，而日元和美元的利率政策已经占据了这个区域。
en: The yen and dollar are also being bolstered as central banks elsewhere continue to cut interest rates towards zero, territory that the yen and dollar policy rates already occupy.

zh: 因此，尽管美国和日本短期内将不会提高利率，更低的外国利率仍使美元和日元相对更具吸引力。
en: Thus, even though the United States and Japan will not be raising interest rates anytime soon, lower foreign rates still make the dollar and yen relatively more attractive.

zh: 商品价格将继续疲软，会拖累商品货币，尤其会支撑日元，因为资源贫乏的日本是如此依赖于商品进口。
en: Commodity prices will continue to be soft, pulling down commodity currencies, and bolstering the yen especially, since resource-poor Japan is so reliant on commodity imports.

zh: 通常情况下，短期和长期汇率趋势的方向是一致的。
en: Normally, short-run and long-run exchange-rate trends point in the same direction.

zh: 事实上，大量研究表明，对大多数主要货币来说，对下周的汇率、下个月的汇率、或甚至明年的汇率最准确的预测，就是保持今天的汇率不变。
en: Indeed, a huge body of research shows that for most major currencies, the best forecast of next week’s exchange rate, next month’s exchange rate, or even next year’s exchange rate is simply today’s exchange rate.

zh: 但市道很难正常。
en: But times are hardly normal.

zh: 由于美元其避风港的地位，持续的财政危机正对美元造成稳步上升的压力。
en: The continuing financial crisis is putting steady upward pressure on the dollar thanks to its safe haven status.

zh: 商品价格还在探底。
en: Commodity prices are plumbing new depths.

zh: 然而，金融危机终将结束，全球经济衰退也将结束。
en: Yet the financial crisis will eventually end, as will the global recession.

zh: 而你要知道，两者都不会很快结束，再拖7个或8个月也是有可能，如果不是更久的话。
en: Neither will end soon, mind you, perhaps not for another seven or eight months, if not longer.

zh: 但是，当更为正常的增长真的恢复的时候，近来支撑美元和日元升值的趋势将会消失。
en: But, when more normal growth does resume, the recent trends underpinning dollar and yen appreciation will disappear.

zh: 国际投资者也许会感谢美国激进的货币和财政刺激，这样的政策在当选总统奥巴马1月20日上任后将大幅加速。
en: Perhaps international investors will be grateful to the US for its aggressive monetary and fiscal stimulus, which will accelerate sharply when President-elect Barack Obama takes office on January 20.

zh: 但投资者仍担心钱真的投进去时会发生什么情况。
en: But investors will still worry about what happens when the bills come due.

zh: 许多新兴市场也将想要介入反周期的宏观经济政策，但对财政的连续性的担心和对大幅度通货膨胀的恐惧，使他们被捆住了手脚。
en: Many emerging markets will also want to engage in countercyclical macroeconomic policy, but they are hemmed in by concerns of fiscal sustainability and fear of rampant inflation.

zh: 欧洲的财政政策被马斯特里赫特条约限制住了，而欧洲的货币政策则专注于稳定物价。
en: European fiscal policy is constrained by the Maastricht Treaty, while European monetary policy is rather single-mindedly devoted to price stability.ampnbsp;

zh: 诚然，中国因其庞大的外汇储备，它和其它国家一样有钱来花在反宏观经济政策上。
en: True, China, with its vast foreign exchange reserves, has the wherewithal to spend as much on countercyclical macroeconomic policy as anyone.

zh: 但是，中国的统治者们知道，国家在继续推行渐进的金融自由化过程中，中国高度受压抑的银行体系是脆弱的，其外汇储备可能要用来进行资本额调整。
en: But China’s rulers know that their highly repressed banking system is vulnerable as the country continues to pursue gradual financial liberalization, and that foreign currency reserves may be needed for recapitalization.

zh: 因此，也许没有一个地区将和美国一样具有扩张性。
en: Thus perhaps no region will be as expansionary as the US.

zh: 目前，全球投资者得不到足够的美国国库券，美国短期债券的利率的猛跌证明了这一点。
en: For the moment, global investors cannot get enough of US treasury bills, as collapsing interest rates for short-term US securities demonstrates.

zh: 但是，这种需求的大部分是短期性的并由对危机的恐惧所引发的。
en: But a lot of this demand is driven by short-term, crisis-fueled fear.

zh: 当市场趋于正常之时，投资者肯定会环顾四周，并意识到美国为了抗击经济衰退已经大大增加了其债务，增量可能达到数万亿美元。
en: As markets normalize, surely investors will look around and realize that the US has vastly increased its debt in fighting the downturn, possibly by several trillion dollars.

zh: 与此同时，随着大胆的银根放松政策对价格稳定所造成的破坏，今天的物价的下降（或“通缩 ” ） 最终将演变为通胀。
en: At the same time, today’s falling prices (or “deflation”) will eventually morph into inflation as aggressive monetary easing takes its toll on price stability.

zh: 诚然，一些主要货币在过去一年中的变动可被视为正常化。
en: Admittedly, some of the major currency’s movements during the past year can be regarded as normalizing.

zh: 在购买力基础（一种衡量不同货币可以购买实际货物的基本标准）上 ，欧元被荒唐地高估在1.60美元上，而日元则被荒唐地低估在一美元兑120日元以上。
en: On a purchasing power basis (a crude measure of what different currencies can buy in terms of real goods), the euro was absurdly overvalued at $1.60, just as the yen was absurdly undervalued at over ¥120 to the dollar.

zh: 而商品货币也不得不从其戏剧性的高度跌下。
en: Commodity currencies had to come off their meteoric highs.

zh: 因此，过去一年中货币的调整就是在一定程度上使国内相对价格水准和汇率之间达到了更好的平衡。
en: Thus, the past year’s currency alignments have, to some extent, simply brought relative domestic price levels and exchange rates into better balance.

zh: 但现在，新兴市场国家的汇率可能已经下跌过度，而商品货币更是这样。
en: But by now, emerging-market countries’ exchange rates, and even more so commodity currencies, have probably overshot on the downside.ampnbsp;

zh: 从长远来看，全球化和经济融合将重新推进，而新兴市场和商品货币将必定走强。
en: Over the long run, globalization and economic convergence will resume, and emerging market and commodity currencies will have to strengthen.

zh: 与此同时，更高的美国通胀率和美国大规模的更高水准的公债的前景最终必将对美元加压，就像仍然令人担忧的美国贸易赤字一样。
en: At the same time, the prospect of higher US inflation and massively higher US public debt levels must eventually weigh on the dollar, as does the still worrisome US trade deficit.

zh: 至于日元，它也将随着日本的公债水准的持续上升而遭受打击，日本的公债已经列入全世界最高水准了。
en: As for the yen, it, too, will suffer from the continuing rise in Japan’s public debt levels, which are already among the highest in the world.

zh: 持续疲软的日本经济最终将打击日元。
en: Continuing weakness in the Japanese economy will eventually hit the yen.

zh: 如果今天的一些列汇率代表了美元和日元对于尤其是新兴市场的货币的升值过度，那么什么时候会缓解下来呢？
en: If today’s constellation of exchange rates represents some excessive dollar and yen appreciation, especially against emerging-market currencies, when it will unwind?

zh: 这取决于你认为什么时候金融危机将得到缓解，而这和汇率一样很难预测。
en: That depends on when you think the financial crisis will abate, and the timing of that is as hard to predict as exchange rates.

zh: 但是，它终会到来。
en: But come it will.

zh: 然后你就等着看美元和日元自食其果吧。
en: Then watch for the dollar and yen to boomerang.

zh: 回应伊朗
en: Answering Iran

zh: 纽约 — — 我们对伊朗的核计划有所了解，我们也知道不能加以鼓励。
en: NEW YORK – We know quite a bit about Iran’s nuclear program, and what we know is not encouraging.

zh: 据报道，伊朗有两个地方在浓缩铀 — — 其中一些浓度达到了20 % ， 远远超过了民用所需的浓度。
en: Iran is reported to be enriching uranium at two sites – some of it to levels of 20%, far beyond what is required for civilian purposes.

zh: 国际原子能机构也报道说，伊朗正在研究设计核弹头。
en: The International Atomic Energy Agency also reports that Iran is carrying out research to develop designs for nuclear warheads.

zh: 简而言之，伊朗的官员称，他们的核计划只是用于发电或医学研究，这一点说服力都没有。
en: In short, Iranian officials’ claims that their nuclear program is aimed solely at power generation or medical research lacks all plausibility.

zh: 然而，世界还是有很多东西不知道。
en: Yet there is still much that the world does not know.

zh: 比如，我们不知道伊朗是否在未遭披露的地方进行秘密的活动，伊朗何时能研发出粗糙的核武器，据估计是在几个月到几年之间。
en: For example, we do not know whether Iran is conducting secret activities at undisclosed sites, or when Iran could develop a crude nuclear weapon, with estimates ranging from several months to several years.

zh: 我们也不知道伊朗四分五裂的领导层是否已经决定研发核武器，还是只是暂时停一段时间，算计着本国可以在获取核武器的过程中获得许多好处，又不用承受真正获得核武器后的风险和代价。
en: We also do not know whether Iran’s divided leadership has decided to develop nuclear weapons, or to stop just short, calculating that the country could derive many of the benefits of possessing nuclear weapons without running the risks or incurring the costs of actually doing so.

zh: 无论是哪种情况，伊朗的活动都让世界面临艰难的选择。
en: Either way, Iran’s activities confront the world with difficult choices.

zh: 所有选择都是有代价和风险的。
en: None is costless or risk-free.

zh: 此外，代价和风险都不可能准确计算。
en: Moreover, neither the costs nor the risks are possible to calculate with precision.

zh: 一种选择是接受拥核或接近拥核的伊朗并与之相处。
en: One option would be to accept and live with a nuclear or near-nuclear Iran.

zh: 这样做的前提是能够威慑住伊朗不使用核武器，正如冷战期间苏联一样。
en: This assumes that Iran could be deterred from using its weapons, much as the Soviet Union was during the Cold War.

zh: 扩展导弹防御，美国能够增强安全保障，让伊朗明白用核武器威胁或使用核武器，美国将坚定加以回应。
en: Missile defenses could be expanded; the United States could extend security guarantees so that Iran would understand that the threat or use of nuclear weapons would be met with a decisive American response.

zh: 但是默许伊朗拥核具有巨大的缺陷。
en: But there are significant drawbacks to acquiescing to a nuclear-armed Iran.

zh: 鉴于伊朗对其对手采取颠覆和恐怖活动，拥核的伊朗可能会更加咄咄逼人。
en: Given its use of subversion and terrorism against its adversaries, a nuclear-armed Iran might be even more assertive.

zh: 伊朗还可能将与核相关的材料、技术或武器转让给盟友（比如委内瑞拉的乌戈•查韦斯）或激进组织，比如真主党和哈马斯。
en: It might also transfer nuclear-related material, technology, or weapons to allies (Hugo Chávez’s Venezuela, for example) or radical organizations such as Hezbollah and Hamas.

zh: 这样非但无助于该地区各国更加谨慎和稳定，伊朗或以色列可能在危机中率先发动袭击。
en: And, rather than promoting caution and stability in the region, Iran or Israel could be tempted to strike first in a crisis.

zh: 我们也不能认为，伊朗四分五裂和激进的领导层常常会理智地采取行动，核扩散会仅限于伊斯兰共和国。
en: Nor can it be assumed that Iran’s divided and radical leadership would always act rationally, or that proliferation would stop with the Islamic Republic.

zh: 如果伊朗研发了核武器，沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和埃及等国也会购买或研发自己的核武器。
en: If Iran develops its nuclear weapons, countries such as Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Egypt would be tempted to purchase or develop nuclear weapons of their own.

zh: 中东战事一触即发是噩梦最好的写照。
en: A Middle East with multiple fingers on multiple triggers is as good a definition of a nightmare as there is.

zh: 另一个相反的政策选项是防御性的攻击：对伊朗境内与核计划相关的基地发动军事进攻（最有可能由以色列、美国或两国一起发动攻击。
en: At the opposite end of the spectrum of policy choices is a preventive attack: a military strike (most likely by Israel, the US, or both) against sites in Iran associated with its nuclear program.

zh: ） 。 其核心目标是阻碍仍在聚集的威胁出现。
en: The core objective would be to interrupt the emergence of a threat that is still gathering.

zh: 不过这个选项也有很大的缺陷。
en: Here, again, there are considerable drawbacks.

zh: 即使是成功的防御性攻击也至多只能将伊朗的核计划推迟几年。
en: Even a successful preventive attack would at most set back Iran’s nuclear program a few years.

zh: 伊朗几乎肯定会重建基地，可能会建到地下，加固基地从而使发动未来的袭击困难得多。
en: It would almost certainly be rebuilt, presumably in underground, fortified sites that would make future attacks far more difficult to carry out.

zh: 此外，伊朗很可能立即对目标进行报复，这些目标包括沙特阿拉伯、伊拉克、阿富汗以及世界上其他存在美国利益的地方，还有美国本土。
en: Moreover, Iran could well retaliate immediately against targets that could include Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Afghanistan, and other US interests worldwide – as well as sites on American territory.

zh: 真主党可能会攻击以色列。
en: Hezbollah could attack Israel.

zh: 如果这一切真发生了，由于石油短缺和恐惧，石油价格将扶摇直上，可能导致许多已经摇摇欲坠的世界经济体陷入衰退。
en: If all of this happened, the price of oil would skyrocket owing to shortages and fears, possibly driving much of the world economy, already in a precarious position, into recession.

zh: 军事袭击也可能导致伊朗人民团结在政府的周围，降低出现更富责任领导层的可能性。
en: An armed attack could also cause the Iranian public to rally around the government, reducing the chances that a more responsible leadership might emerge.

zh: 因此，美国和世界上的许多国家都在探寻其他选择，其中包括伊朗的政权更迭，这也不足为奇。
en: It thus comes as little surprise that the US and much of the world have explored alternatives, including regime change in Iran.

zh: 然而，虽然这有可能实现，但是没有政策可以确保伊朗发生政权更迭。
en: But, however desirable that might be, no policy can assuredly bring it about.

zh: 所以，针对伊朗的主要政策还是强制实行日益严厉的经济制裁。
en: As a result, the principal policy toward Iran centers on the imposition of increasingly painful economic sanctions.

zh: 这项政策的原理是，随着人们对制裁带来的影响日益不满，伊朗领导人会担心在政治上失去控制，进而重新盘算进行核活动的利弊，为了消除制裁接受谈判中的约束条件。
en: The rationale underlying this policy is that Iran’s leaders, fearful of losing political control as popular discontent increases over the sanctions’ effects, will recalculate the costs and benefits of their nuclear activities and become receptive to negotiated constraints in exchange for removal of sanctions.

zh: 这有可能实现。
en: That could happen.

zh: 国际社会越来越支持制裁措施。
en: International support for sanctions is considerable and increasing.

zh: 伊朗（伊朗的经济在很大程度上依靠每天200多万桶石油的出口）寻找买家 — — 尤其是愿意支付全价的买家 — — 越来越难。
en: It is becoming more difficult for Iran (whose economy depends to a large extent on oil exports of more than two million barrels a day) to find customers – and especially customers willing to pay full price.

zh: 与此同时，伊朗的货币在贬值，导致许多伊朗人买不起进口产品。
en: Meanwhile, Iran’s currency is weakening, pricing imported goods out of many Iranians’ reach.

zh: 当前政策的一些辅助性成分似乎产生了影响，这些辅助性成分是一些暗中的努力，旨在减弱伊朗进口敏感技术的能力。
en: Additional elements of current policy that seem to be having an effect are clandestine efforts aimed at impeding Iran’s ability to import sensitive technologies.

zh: 病毒已经入侵伊朗的计算机，降低浓缩铀至关重要的离心分离机的效率。
en: Viruses have infiltrated computers in Iran, reducing the efficiency of the centrifuges central to enriching uranium.

zh: 个别人员遭暗杀也可能减缓了伊朗核计划的进程。
en: It is also possible that the assassination of selected individuals has slowed the advance of Iranian nuclear efforts.

zh: 但是阻碍伊朗的努力与迫使伊朗停止核计划不是一回事。
en: But slowing Iran’s efforts is not the same as stopping them.

zh: 因此出现了现有的制裁是否应该更加广泛、更加严厉的问题；在这方面，中国和俄罗斯必须决定其优先任务。
en: So one question is whether existing sanctions can be extended and tightened; here, China and Russia must determine their priorities.

zh: 另一个问题是制裁是否足以说服伊朗领导人接受可作证的限制条件，限制其核计划。
en: Another question is whether any sanctions will be enough to persuade Iran’s leaders to accept verifiable limits on their nuclear program.

zh: 第三个未解决的问题是在发动军事袭击之前，以色列或美国还能忍受伊朗的核计划多久。
en: And a third unsettled issue is how long Israel or the US will tolerate Iranian efforts before striking militarily.

zh: 实际上，或许唯一可以确定的是伊朗的核计划将成为2012年的一个重要国际问题 — — 很可能成为最重要的国际问题。
en: Indeed, the only certainty may be that Iran’s nuclear program will be a major international issue in 2012 – quite possibly the most important one.

zh: 新的自然界
en: The New Natural World

zh: 约克—六千六百万年前，一个天体撞击了地球，让恐龙灭绝。
en: YORK – Sixty-six million years ago, a celestial body crashed into the Earth and wiped out the dinosaurs.

zh: 哺乳类动物因此获得了生存空间，并最终演化出有工具武装、具备语言能力的直立猿类，有人认为，它们的力量对地球的改变之大几乎可以和那颗小天体相提并论。
en: With that, there was space for the rise of mammals and, eventually, the evolution of a tool-wielding, linguistically capable, bipedal ape with the power, some argue, to have almost as transformative an impact on the planet as that celestial body.

zh: 随着我们进入所谓的人类世，人类活动主导着气候和环境影响，我们必须认真仔细地审视我们如何使用这一力量。
en: As we enter the so-called Anthropocene epoch, in which human activity is a dominant influence on the climate and environment, we must take a hard – and nuanced – look at how we are using that power.

zh: 很多人认为世界正在变得越来越“不自然 ” — —被人类所毒害。
en: Many believe the world is becoming increasingly “unnatural” – tainted by humanity.

zh: 但考虑到人类系在世界生态系统中演化而成，我们所做的每一件事 — — 杀绝物种、毁灭森林、污染大气 — — 都可以视为演化过程的自然产物。
en: But, given that humans evolved within the world’s biological system, everything we do – killing off species, razing forests, polluting the atmosphere – can be regarded as a natural product of the evolutionary process.

zh: 根据这一逻辑，世界并没有因为我们改变了它而变得不那么自然。
en: By this logic, the world does not become any less natural as we change it.

zh: 可以说，环保主义者和保守主义者所奉行让环境恢复过去的自己是在与自然作对。
en: It could be argued that environmentalists and conservationists, in their efforts to return the environment to a past version of itself, are fighting against nature.

zh: 当今世界的现实是根本不可能完全将生物界的人类与非人类影响区分开来。
en: The reality of today’s world is that it is impossible to separate completely the human from the non-human influences on biological communities.

zh: 纵观地球生命史，生态和演化过程一直是生物界从环境变化中存活下来的途径。
en: Throughout the history of life on Earth, ecological and evolutionary processes have been the means by which the biological world survives environmental change.

zh: 因此，环保主义者和保守主义者不应该自动反对这一变化，而应该区分“好变化”和“坏变化 ” 。
en: Instead of automatically resisting such change, therefore, environmentalists and conservationists should distinguish between “good change” and “bad change.”

zh: 挑战就在于定义好与坏。
en: The challenge is to define good and bad.

zh: 大部分人会同意，彻底灭绝一个物种是一件坏事。
en: Most people would agree that the complete extinction of a species is a bad thing.

zh: 但对于一些物种的消亡（如容易染病的岛屿鸟类 ） ， 我我们可以选择不去干预，因为现实地说，很难阻止它们被演化上“更高等”的模式（如能抵抗病原体的鸟类）取代。
en: Yet, when it comes to the decline of some species (say, disease-susceptible island birds), we may choose not to intervene, not least because, realistically, it would be hard to resist their replacement by evolutionarily “superior” models (such as pathogen-resistant birds).

zh: 我个人支持灭绝毒性最强的人类病原体。
en: I personally would favor the extinction of the most virulent human pathogens.

zh: 尽管如此，保护尽可能多的物种是有意义的。
en: Nonetheless, conserving as many species as possible makes sense.

zh: 今天存在的物种的后代将继续组成所有未来生态系统 — — 它们形成于人类或地球过程形成奇特的条件时 — — 因此，拥有更多种类的物种是一个明显的优势。
en: Since the descendants of today’s living species will go on to comprise all future ecosystems – formed when humans or planetary processes generate novel conditions – there is a clear advantage to having more kinds of them.

zh: 事实上，更多物种形成了环境的“备用件 ” ， 保护算得上是一种长期环境保险。
en: Indeed, more species function as “spare parts” for the environment, and conservation amounts to a kind of long-term environmental insurance policy.

zh: 争议较大的是将物种转移到新生态系统中。
en: More contentious is the transportation of species to new ecosystems.

zh: 园丁喜欢在后院种植外来物种，但本地种常常将开始在后院中生长的“外来”植物视为入侵者 — — 对过去的危险的偏离。
en: Gardeners may love to plant exotic species in their backyards, but communities often treat the “foreign” plants that begin to grow in the countryside as invasive – a dangerous departure from the past.

zh: 有时候，这些植物连除草剂都无从除去。
en: Sometimes, those plants are doused in herbicides, usually to no avail.

zh: 对这种变化的抵制是如此强烈，以至于英国要等待1,000年左右才会将一个物种，比如兔子，视为本地种。
en: So strong is the resistance to such changes that the United Kingdom waits about 1,000 years before it regards a species, like the rabbit, as native.

zh: 在澳大利亚，澳洲野狗 — — 几百年前引入 — — 是否应该被认为是本地种仍在争论当中。
en: In Australia, there is a debate over whether the dingo – introduced thousands of years ago – should be counted as indigenous.

zh: 但到目前为止，大约2,000中非本地动植物并未直接导致本地种灭绝，大部分只是引起了很微小的伤害或毫无伤害。
en: Yet, so far, the roughly 2,000 non-native plant and animal species in the UK have not directly caused any native species to become extinct, with most causing little or no harm at all.

zh: 事实上，在过去几个世纪中，外来物种的输入和传播增加了世界大部分地区的生物多样性。
en: In fact, the importation and spread of immigrant species has increased biological diversity in most regions of the world in the last few centuries.

zh: 这些地区性的生物多样性增加 — — 欧洲国家和美国野生植物种类数量增加了20 % ， 夏威夷群岛和其他太平洋岛屿植物物种数量增加了一倍 — — 应该被视为是积极的发展趋势。
en: These regional increases – including a 20% rise in the number of plant species growing wild in European countries and the United States, and a doubling of plant species in the Hawaiian Archipelago and other Pacific islands – could be interpreted as a positive development.

zh: 考虑到这一点 — — 并且将大部分外来物种遣返也不现实 — — 新来物种或多或少应该被立即接受。
en: Given this – and the impracticality of trying to repatriate most foreign species – newcomers should be accepted more or less immediately.

zh: 这显然要比打着某种理想化的旧自然世界旗号旷日持久地争论它们更有意义。
en: That certainly makes more sense than engaging in millennia-long debates about them, in the name of some idealized past version of the natural world.

zh: 这不是倒退，因为全新物种一直在产生，特别是通过迁移物种的杂交。
en: There is no going back, because entirely new species continually come into existence, particularly through the hybridization of transported species.

zh: 在过去三个世纪中，在英国演化的杂种作物 — — 如大米草和猴面花 — — 要比整个欧洲灭绝的作物（以灭绝记录为准）更多。
en: More new hybrid plants – such as cord grass and monkey flowers – have evolved in the UK in the last three centuries than have gone extinct throughout Europe over the same period (according to existing records).

zh: 北美也有类似情况。
en: The situation is similar in North America.

zh: 这一在人类帮助下发生的新演化意味着在人类世，我们其实既是旧生物多样性的毁灭者，也是新生物多样性的创造者。
en: This evolution of new human-associated species means that, in the Anthropocene, we are effectively creators of new biological diversity as well as destroyers of the old.

zh: 我们不再仅仅依靠地球；现在我们也在改变地球。
en: We no longer merely depend on the planet; we are now also shaping it.

zh: 认识到这一点，我们绝对应该明确绝非所有改变都是“坏的 ” 。
en: Recognizing that, we should certainly resist changes that are unequivocally “bad.”

zh: 但对于让物种适应环境变化的生物学改变 — — 物种一直是通过这一过程实现生存 — — 我们应该采取更多的接受乃至积极的态度。
en: But when it comes to biological changes that will enable species to adjust to environmental changes – the process by which species have always survived – we should take a more accepting and even pro-active approach.

zh: 我在我的新书《地球的继承者：灭绝时代自然如何繁荣 》 （ Inheritors of the Earth: How Nature is Thriving in an Age of Extinction）中指出，我们生活在一个“新的自然界”中。
en: As I argue in my recent book Inheritors of the Earth: How Nature is Thriving in an Age of Extinction, we are living in a “new natural world.”

zh: 它仍然和过去一样被生态和演化动态所推动。
en: It is still driven by the same ecological and evolutionary dynamism as always.

zh: 区别在于这一动态如今主要来自76亿（并在不断增加）的人类的活动。
en: The difference is that that dynamism is now fueled largely by the activities of a human population of 7.6 billion (and rising).

zh: 物种将进入新的人类创造的环境，并与我们一同演化。
en: Species will move into new human-created environments and evolve alongside us.

zh: 我们应该让它们这样演化。
en: We should let them.

zh: 也许我们甚至应该帮助它们。
en: Maybe we should even help them.

zh: 农业的坏药方
en: Agriculture’s Bad Medicine

zh: 圣迭戈—我们大部分人，当由我们的行为所造成的威胁还没有进入视线之前，不会想到这些威胁的存在。
en: SAN DIEGO – Most of us are oblivious to the threats caused by our actions when those threats are invisible.

zh: 对抗生素的使用就是如此。
en: Our use of antibiotics is a case in point.

zh: 明智而审慎地使用的话，抗生素能够拯救生命、阻止致命疾病的传播。
en: When used judiciously, antibiotics save lives and prevent the transmission of deadly diseases.

zh: 但抗生素的效力正在因为它们在农业中的不审慎使用而被浪费。
en: But the therapeutic power of antibiotics is being squandered by their imprudent use in agriculture.

zh: 如今，全世界一大半抗生素用量被用在了食品生产中。
en: Today, more than half of the antibiotics administered around the world are used in the production of food.

zh: 农民用抗生素治疗牲口感染。
en: Farmers use antimicrobials to treat infections in their livestock.

zh: 问题在于他们常常用错了抗生素，要么把它们用于补救不合理的农业做法 — — 如过度拥挤的工厂化农场让疾病更加容易传播 — — 要么把它们用于加快生长和降低生产成本。
en: The problem is that they commonly misuse antibiotics either to compensate for poor agricultural practices – such as overcrowding on factory farms, which encourages the spread of disease – or to accelerate growth and reduce production costs.

zh: 这些做法独立看来也许无甚伤害，但它们的总效应相当危险。
en: These practices may appear harmless in isolation, but their aggregate effect is dangerous.

zh: 抗生素通过人们所吃的食物或动物产生的废物而进入环境中，导致抗生素耐药性加剧。
en: As antibiotics enter the environment through the food people eat or the waste animals produce, antimicrobial resistance intensifies.

zh: 而这给人类健康带来了非常不利的影响。
en: And this affects human health in troubling ways.

zh: 每一天，在全世界的医院和诊所中，患者都会因为结核病、淋病或肺炎能够传染病而是用抗生素治疗细菌感染。
en: Every day, at hospitals and clinics around the world, patients are given antibiotics for bacterial infections like tuberculosis, gonorrhea, or pneumonia.

zh: 也有人因为预防目的而是用抗生素，以避免手术过程或有损免疫力的基本情况或治疗（如化疗）过程中的细菌感染。
en: Others receive antibiotics prophylactically, to prevent bacterial infections during surgery, or when underlying conditions or treatments (such as chemotherapy) compromise their immunity.

zh: 不幸的是，许多被广泛使用的抗生素正在失去它们保护患者、治疗疾病的能力；一个关键原因是农业作业对抗生素的日常滥用。
en: Unfortunately, many widely used antibiotics are losing their ability to protect patients and treat disease; routine misuse of antibiotics in farming is a key reason why.

zh: 苏格兰微生物学家亚历山大·弗莱明（Alexander Fleming）发现能够杀死细菌的菌类后不久就认识到，过度使用抗生素会引起耐药性。
en: Not long after the Scottish microbiologist Alexander Fleming discovered a fungus that could kill bacteria, he recognized that overuse of antibiotics would encourage resistance.

zh: 他在1945年警告说 ， “ 轻率使用青霉素的人要为因为感染了具有青霉素耐药性的微生物而死去的人负有道德责任。 ”
en: As he warned in 1945, “the thoughtless person playing with penicillin is morally responsible for the death of the man who finally succumbs to infection with the penicillin-resistant organism.”

zh: 抗生素在农业中的大规模滥用是“轻率使用青霉素”的最臭名昭著的形式之一。
en: Widespread misuse of antibiotics in agriculture is one of the most egregious forms of “playing with penicillin.”

zh: 2015年，中国家猪身上发现了一种新的抗生素耐药菌，随后中国病人身上也出现了这种细菌。
en: In 2015, a new antibiotic-resistant bacterium was discovered in Chinese pigs, and then in Chinese patients.

zh: 此后又发现了两个变种，而令这些细菌拥有抗生素耐药性的基因可以在物种间跃迁 — — 即所谓的“流动性遗传要素 ” — —目前已经在全世界的农场和医院中发现。
en: Since then, two more variants of the bacterium have been discovered, and the genes that enable these bacteria to resist antibiotics and jump between species – so-called “mobile genetic elements” – have been found on farms and in hospitals around the world.

zh: 如果抗生素在农业中的鲁莽使用情况继续下去，对人的影响将十分严重。
en: If the reckless use of antibiotics in agriculture continues, the impact on people will be severe.

zh: 幸运的是，我们有解决办法。
en: Fortunately, there is a solution.

zh: 十多年前，欧盟禁止除了治疗感染之外的一切原因的抗生素农业用途。
en: More than a decade ago, the European Union banned antibiotics in agriculture for any purpose other than treating infections.

zh: 此外，尽管这个规则并不完美，但它有助于降低抗生素的使用。
en: And, although the rule is not perfect, it has helped lower antibiotic use.

zh: 比如，在丹麦，猪农抗生素用量出现了下降，尽管用于治疗猪瘟的抗生素用量略有增加。
en: In Denmark, for example, total antibiotic use by pig farmers has decreased, despite a slight increase in antibiotics administered for treating porcine diseases.

zh: 这些收益不管多么微小，对协调行动起着鼓励作用 — — 并应该进一步鼓励。
en: These gains, however modest, are encouraging – and should encourage further – coordinated action.

zh: 抗生素耐药性问题是一个全球性威胁，因此，唯有多边合作 — — 以新条约或贸易协定的形式 — — 才能保证各国农民都受到最低标准的约束 — — 在牲畜养殖中不再非必要的情况下使用抗生素。
en: Because of the global nature of the threat, only multilateral cooperation – in the form of a new treaty or trade agreements – can ensure that farmers everywhere abide by minimal standards for raising livestock without the unnecessary use of antibiotics.

zh: 2015年12月，英国政府组织、经济学家吉姆·奥尼尔（Jim O’Neill）领衔的一项研究发现，改变行为的最有效的手段是限制使用抗生素，但允许个体国家尝试用税收或者管制来实现这一限制。
en: In December 2015, a study commissioned by the British government and chaired by the economist Jim O’Neill found that the most effective means of changing behaviors would be to cap the use of antibiotics, but allow individual countries to experiment with taxes or restrictions to meet the cap.

zh: 此外，我在其他文章中指出，应该要求农民在对牲畜使用抗生素前获得处方。
en: Moreover, as I have argued elsewhere, farmers should be required to obtain a prescription before administering medicine to livestock.

zh: 尽管欧盟的禁令包含了这一条款，但规避和豁免导致这条规则形同虚设。
en: Although the EU’s ban includes such a provision, waivers and exemptions have watered down the rule.

zh: 如果达成全球共识 — — 比如通过G20或联合国大会达成 — — 选择对农业抗生素征税的国家可以用所得税收收入推动替代农业作业的转型。
en: If a global consensus were reached – for example, through the G20 or the United Nations General Assembly – countries choosing to tax agricultural antibiotics could use the revenue to help ease the transition to alternative farming practices.

zh: 钱还可以用于资助试管肉的研究，试管肉能大大降低动物的痛苦和传染病负担。
en: Money could also go to fund research on in vitro meat, which would dramatically reduce animal suffering and lower the burden of infectious diseases.

zh: 最重要的是，新条约必须允许签署国灵活地满足农民的多样化需要。
en: Most important, any new treaty must provide signatories with flexibility to meet the diverse needs of their farmers.

zh: 全球行动的目标应该是激励农民减少抗生素使用，而不是进行惩罚。
en: The goal of global action should be to incentivize farmers to reduce their antibiotic use, not to mete out punishment.

zh: 有希望形成一些条件，让抗生素只用于治疗病患，而不会用在健康的动物身上。
en: It is possible to create conditions under which antibiotics are used only to treat sick patients, not healthy animals.

zh: 尽管世界距离这一目标还有很长的路要走，但和消费者驱动的美国的做法欧洲的监管已经证明，如果被鼓励或被要求这样做，农民会改变方针。
en: Although the world is a long way from that goal, consumer-driven practices in the United States and regulations in Europe have demonstrated that farmers will change their approach if encouraged or required to do so.

zh: 尽管如此，我们中大部分人依旧对我们的决定所造成的意外后果视而不见。
en: Still, most of us remain blind to the unintended consequences of our decisions.

zh: 除非人民自愿不再消费工厂化农场生产的肉制品，否则我们必须依靠政府和多边组织让我们保持正确的道路。
en: Unless people voluntarily refrain from consuming factory-farmed meat, we will need governments and multilateral organizations to keep us on the right path.

zh: 有效的抗生素
en: Antibiotics That Work

zh: 墨西哥城 — — 从1928年发现青霉素到二十世纪六十年代最后一批主要抗生素进入市场，人类抵御病原菌的能力发生了极大的变革。
en: MEXICO CITY – From the discovery of penicillin in 1928 to the introduction of the last of the main groups of antibiotics in the 1960s, humanity’s capacity to fight pathogenic bacteria has been transformative.

zh: 但是，随着时间的推移，细菌易感的抗生素数量正在逐渐减少，并且某些病原体已经对多数或所有现有药物产生了耐药反应。
en: But, over time, the number of antibiotics to which bacteria are susceptible has been dwindling, and some pathogens have become resistant to most or all existing drugs.

zh: 结果导致曾经可以治疗的感染正在重新变得致命。
en: As a result, once-treatable infections are becoming deadly again.

zh: 目前，抗生素耐药性每年导致约70，000人死亡，由此造成高达成百上千亿美元的财务损失。
en: Already, antibiotic resistance is leading to an estimated 700,000 deaths per year, with financial costs reaching tens of billions of dollars.

zh: 由于抗生素耐药性继续影响我们治疗癌症、移植器官和植入假体，抗生素耐药性造成的损失将会更加严重。
en: As antibiotic resistance continues to undermine our ability to treat cancers, transplant organs, and implant prosthesis, these figures will only rise.

zh: 抗生素耐药性上升是由诸多因素共同导致的。
en: Many factors have contributed to rising antibiotic resistance.

zh: 细菌可以快速繁殖和突变，并能建立某种类似“基因互联网”的网络，允许某些病原菌“下载”抗生素耐药基因。
en: Bacteria can reproduce and mutate rapidly, and they can establish something of a “genetic Internet” that enables certain pathogenic bacteria to “download” antibiotic-resistant genes.

zh: 此外，多数抗生素是土壤细菌的天然产物，而抗生素耐药性可以在土壤菌群中自然产生。
en: Moreover, most antibiotics are natural products of soil bacteria, in which antibiotic resistance can occur naturally.

zh: 当大规模引入人造抗生素时，具有耐药性的细菌就会越来越盛行。
en: When human-made antibiotics were introduced on a massive scale, the bacteria with resistance became the most prevalent.

zh: 今天，人类每年释放约100,000吨抗生素。
en: Today, humans release about 100,000 tons of antibiotics per year.

zh: 如果这些抗生素运用恰当并能挽救生命，合理的成本效益分析或许会成为可能。
en: If those antibiotics were being used properly and saving lives, a reasonable cost-benefit analysis might be possible.

zh: 但约70%的抗生素却被用于加快农场动物的生长速度。
en: But about 70% of them are used to make farm animals to grow a bit faster.

zh: 其余30%虽然用于治疗病人，但处方却往往不正确或不必要。
en: The other 30%, while used to treat people, are often prescribed incorrectly or needlessly.

zh: 而且，由于大部分用过的药物随废水和粪便排入环境，从而导致土壤、水体和野生动物当中的菌群也能接触到。
en: And, because a substantial share of the used drugs are released into the environment with wastewater and manure, bacterial communities in soils, waters, and wildlife are also exposed.

zh: 如果这种滥用抗生素的局面不尽快结束，我们很快就会发现自己没有有效治疗细菌感染的药物可用。
en: If this abuse of antibiotics does not end, we will soon find ourselves without drugs to treat bacterial infections effectively.

zh: 但尽管正在采取某些措施 — — 去年9月召开的一次联合国高级别会议提出了某些国际政策建议 — — 但采取的措施还远远不够。
en: But while some steps are being taken – a high-level United Nations meeting last September produced proposals for some international measures – they are far from adequate.

zh: 人类真正需要的是立即在全球范围内禁止抗生素的农业应用。
en: What is really needed is an immediate worldwide ban on the agricultural use of antibiotics.

zh: 此外，现在在医疗界执行力度堪比如何选择领带指南的抗生素临床使用指南必须得到严格的审核和执行。
en: Moreover, guidelines for the clinical use of antibiotics, which the medical community now follows as closely as those concerning how to pick a necktie, must be reviewed and strongly enforced.

zh: 仅靠这两项措施 — — 两者都可以由政府监管机构颁布 — — 就可以减少近80%的抗生素用量，从而大大延缓抗生素耐药性的产生。
en: These two measures alone – both of which could be enacted by governmental regulatory agencies – would reduce the use of antibiotics by nearly 80%, slowing the rise of antibiotic resistance substantially.

zh: 当然，让政府实施这些政策并不容易，因为它们与强大的经济利益背道而驰，其中最明显的莫过于制药行业，该行业每年出售价值400亿美元的抗生素。
en: Of course, getting governments to implement such measures will not be easy, because they run counter to powerful economic interests, the most obvious being the pharmaceutical industry, which sells $40 billion worth of antibiotics each year.

zh: 尽管大型药企对继续滥用抗生素兴趣强烈，但却对研发新抗生素应对耐药菌缺乏兴趣。
en: While Big Pharma has a strong interest in continued antibiotic abuse, it has little interest in developing new antibiotics to tackle drug-resistant bacteria.

zh: 他们的底线是抗生素能够治疗癌症和慢性病。
en: Drugs for chronic illnesses and cancer are better for their bottom line.

zh: 因此大型药企要求“激励措施”才愿开展新抗生素的研发，比方说延长专利期限或减税；另外一种办法是为新药开出天文数字的价格。
en: So Big Pharma is seeking “incentives” to pursue research and development of new antibiotics, such as extended patents or tax breaks; the alternative would be to charge astronomical prices for new drugs.

zh: 但这些激励措施为制药企业带来的收益远远超过了实际研发成本；于是成为让公共资金流入私人腰包的工具 — — 而恰恰是这些人最初造成了问题。
en: But the benefits of such incentives for pharmaceutical companies would far exceed the cost of the actual R&D pursued; they would be instruments to funnel public funds into private hands – the very hands that caused the problem.

zh: 但除了这些胡萝卜，社会还应该考虑使用大棒。
en: Beyond all of these carrots, however, societies should consider using some sticks.

zh: 我建议实行一项计划，根据药企在解决抗生素耐药性问题方面的贡献对其进行评级；应当惩罚那些不做贡献的企业减少其销售额。
en: I propose an initiative that rates pharmaceutical companies according to their contribution to solving the antibiotic-resistance problem; those that do not contribute should be punished with fewer sales.

zh: 我称之为NANBU计划（即没有抗生素、就没有业务 ） 。
en: I call it NANBU (No Antibiotics, No Business).

zh: NANBU计划会给积极研究新抗生素的企业添加分数。
en: NANBU would grant points to companies with vigorous research programs or with new antibiotics in the development pipeline.

zh: 不为农业目的制造或出售抗生素、抑或拒绝在不需要此类药物的疾病领域推广抗生素应用的企业也能够获得分数。
en: Companies that do not manufacture or sell antibiotics for agricultural purposes, or that refuse to promote the use of antibiotics for diseases that do not require such drugs, would gain points as well.

zh: 而那些从事相反行为的企业 — — 将抗生素作为牲畜“生长促进剂”出售或积极鼓励医生开药的企业 — — 将会丢掉分数。
en: Those that engaged in the opposite behaviors – selling antibiotics as livestock “growth promoters” or actively encouraging physicians to prescribe the drugs – would lose points.

zh: 起初，几乎所有制药企业都会丢掉分数。
en: At first, virtually all drug companies would have negative scores.

zh: 但随着时间的推移可以对评级进行调整，而调整评级一定要以独立专家组的合理建议为依据。
en: But, over time, the ratings could be adjusted, always according to scientifically sound advice from an independent group of experts.

zh: 然后可以使用评级来指导购药决策。
en: The ratings could then be used to guide drug-purchasing decisions.

zh: 对诸多相关药物种类来讲，往往有不同制药企业生产的若干种药物具有相似的功效和安全性。
en: For many kinds of relevant drugs, there are several options with similar efficacy and safety, produced by different companies.

zh: 于是临床医生可以大量使用来自高评级企业的药物，避免让低评级企业的药物流入市场。
en: So clinicians could prescribe drugs mostly from highly rated companies, and avoid drugs from companies with low ratings.

zh: 患者则应当鼓励这样的决策，并遵循同样的原则购买非处方药。
en: Patients could encourage such decision-making, and follow suit when purchasing over-the-counter drugs.

zh: 随着时间的推移，抗生素可以再次获得更强的盈利能力，因为相关公司可以销售更多其他药物，因此逐渐降低对昂贵激励政策的需求。
en: Over time, antibiotics could become more profitable again, as engaged companies sell more of their other drugs and the need for costly incentives diminishes.

zh: NANBU计划成功的关键是确保人们广泛了解抗生素耐药性造成的威胁及其相关应对举措。
en: The key to NANBU’s success will be to ensure widespread understanding of the antibiotic-resistance threat and what is needed to combat it.

zh: 这将推动患者和医生在决定使用何种药物时考虑NANBU 评级，并迫使它们的政府采取更加有力的行动。
en: This would give patients and doctors the impetus to regard NANBU ratings in making drug decisions, as well as to pressure their governments to take even stronger action.

zh: 利用公众宣传加强政府落实必要但困难政策的压力曾经获得过成功 — — 这方面的例子包括推进林业和渔业的可持续性。
en: The use of a public awareness campaign to intensify pressure on governments to pursue necessary but difficult measures has worked before – for example, in advancing forest and fishery sustainability.

zh: 公众宣传是联合国会议强调的重点事项。
en: Public awareness was among the priorities highlighted at the UN meeting.

zh: 但要推进这项全球工作，我们需要新的全球机构来负责完成。
en: To carry out that global effort, however, we need a new global institution that really is up to the task.

zh: NANBU作为一家国际非政府机构，可以从容面对多数跨国制药企业，并在国内游说或政治压力面前得到保护。
en: NANBU, as an international NGO, would be able to cope with the transnational nature of most drug companies, while being protected from national-level lobbying or political pressure.

zh: 抗生素耐药菌是一种全球威胁，因此不能仅靠国内政策加以应对。
en: Antibiotic-resistant bacteria represent a global threat, and therefore cannot be addressed with national measures alone.

zh: 世界各国必须共同思考和行动，以保护抗生素为人类带来的巨大的健康和福利收益。
en: The world must think and act together to preserve the huge gains to human health and wellbeing that antibiotics have enabled.

zh: 对耐药性的公平之战
en: A Fair Fight Against Antimicrobial Resistance

zh: 布莱顿 — — 现有抗菌药的效果正在逐渐丧失。
en: BRIGHTON – Existing anti-microbial drugs are becoming ineffective.

zh: 如果任由目前趋势继续下去，我们可能重温抗生素发明之前坐视感染性疾病成为主要杀手的境况。
en: If current trends continue, we could end up reliving conditions before the discovery of antibiotics, when infectious diseases were major killers.

zh: 迎接耐药菌发起的挑战绝非易事，这需要大规模投资研发新的抗菌药，还要为确保药物有效性建立起控制及限制新疗法的医疗制度。
en: Meeting the challenge of drug-resistant microbes will be difficult. It will require not only major investments in research and development of new anti-microbial drugs, but also a system to control and restrict new treatments, in order to preserve their efficacy.

zh: 就像应对气候变化问题一样，国际协调行动是任何有效策略的基础。
en: As with the response to climate change, an effective strategy will require international coordination.

zh: 尤其是必须协调药企 、政府付费机构和全球穷人的关系。
en: In particular, the needs of pharmaceutical companies must be reconciled with those of government payers and the global poor.

zh: 事实上，成功的关键在于鼓励穷人参与。
en: Indeed, engaging the poor will be crucial to any effort.

zh: 中低收入国家是耐药菌的重要滋生地。
en: Low- and middle-income countries are an important source of drug-resistant organisms.

zh: 住房拥挤、卫生条件差和免疫系统受损无论因为营养不良还是HIV等慢性感染，均为传染病的蔓延提供了肥沃的土壤。
en: Crowded housing, poor sanitation, and compromised immune systems, whether owing to malnutrition or chronic infections such as HIV, provide fertile ground for contagion.

zh: 抗生素质量低劣并常被误用使细菌有了产生耐药性的机会。
en: Antibiotics are often misused or low-quality, providing bacteria the opportunity to develop resistance.

zh: 大量抗生素同时被应用于畜牧业。
en: Large volumes of antibiotics are also used in animal husbandry.

zh: 此外，各国农村及城市间显著改善的交通基础设施也导致耐药基因迅速在世界各地传播。
en: Meanwhile, greatly improved transportation infrastructure – between rural and urban areas and between countries – means that resistant genes quickly become part of a global pool.

zh: 在很多容易感染传染病的国家，政府的医疗保健系统都无法满足需求，于是这当中的差距就由从医疗专家到非正规供应商的一系列游离于监管体系之外的供应商来负责弥补。
en: In many vulnerable countries, the government health-care system cannot meet demand, and a variety of providers are attempting to bridge the gap. These range from medical specialists to informal providers, who work largely outside the regulatory framework.

zh: 这样的制度外安排确有好处。
en: These patchwork systems do have benefits.

zh: 例如孟加拉国最近的一项研究表明由租摊经营的所谓“乡村医生”所提供的抗生素对降低产后败血症和儿童肺炎的死亡率都有帮助。
en: A recent study in Bangladesh, for example, concluded that antibiotics provided by so-called “village doctors,” often operating from market stalls, contributed to declines in mortality from post-natal sepsis and childhood pneumonia.

zh: 但也有相当多证据表明所提供药品质量参差不齐，并且也经常出现滥用。
en: But there is also considerable evidence that the drugs being provided are of varying quality and are frequently taken unnecessarily.

zh: 很多时候患者都未能按疗程服药。
en: Too often, patients do not purchase a full course of treatment.

zh: 一种对策是制定并执行立法仅凭医生处方购买抗生素。
en: One response could be to enact and enforce laws that make antibiotics available only on a doctor’s prescription.

zh: 但这样可能严重限制穷人获取抗生素的渠道，提高感染死亡率，因此既难以执行又在政治上无法接受。
en: However, this could end up severely limiting poor people’s access to antibiotics, leading to higher death rates from infections, making it politically unacceptable and thus difficult to enforce.

zh: 替代方法是制定通过非正式渠道改善抗生素治疗的新策略。
en: A better alternative would be to develop new strategies to improve antibiotic treatments that are provided through informal channels.

zh: 首先要投资获取常见抗感染药的可靠监测数据。
en: For starters, investment is needed to generate reliable surveillance data on the drugs that are effective against common infections.

zh: 治疗指引必须涵盖上述信息，并将其分发给所有抗生素供应者。
en: Treatment guidelines must incorporate this information and be given to all providers of antibiotics.

zh: 此外，必须以合理价格提供高质量的抗生素。
en: Meanwhile, high-quality antibiotics must be made available at affordable prices.

zh: 必须从市场上消除假冒产品，并在政府、药企和公民团体间建立合作监管机制来控制质量。
en: Counterfeit products must be identified and removed from the marketplace, and a regulatory partnership between governments, the pharmaceutical sector, and citizens’ groups must be developed to control for quality.

zh: 必须通过批量采购等方式以确保药品低价；在某些情况下，可能有必要发放公共补贴。
en: Prices must be kept low through bulk procurement; in some cases, public subsidies may be necessary.

zh: 降价措施需要配合有关规定来防止滥用。
en: Measures to reduce prices will need to be complemented by efforts to discourage overuse.

zh: 推出全疗程组合药物创新包装可以简化治疗决策。
en: Innovations in packaging, perhaps providing full courses of appropriate combinations of drugs, could simplify treatment decisions.

zh: 同样，发展低成本诊断技术可以减少仅以症状为依据的治疗需求。
en: Likewise, development of low-cost diagnostic technologies could help diminish the need to provide treatment on the basis of symptoms alone.

zh: 最大的挑战是鼓励抗生素供应商改变其行为。
en: The biggest challenge will be to encourage providers of antibiotics to change their behavior.

zh: 这需要认证、修改支付机制和鼓励中介机构参与提供技术支持并监控效果。
en: This will require measures such as accreditation, modification of payment mechanisms, and the involvement of intermediary organizations to give technical support and monitor performance.

zh: 上述机构可以包括非政府组织、宗教机构、社会企业家和药物分销企业。
en: These organizations could include NGOs, religious organizations, social entrepreneurs, and companies that distribute drugs.

zh: 这些活动不太可能取得商业利益，因此政府、慈善机构和药品生产商的支持就变得十分必要。
en: These activities are unlikely to be commercially sustainable, and thus will require support from governments, philanthropies, and perhaps drug producers.

zh: 与此同时，必须将正确使用抗生素的可靠信息和建议传达给公众。
en: In the meantime, the public must receive reliable information and advice on the proper use of antibiotics.

zh: 如果民众大都依赖自身资源来应对疾病这一点就显得尤为重要。
en: This is particularly important where citizens rely largely on their own resources to cope with health problems.

zh: 落实系统化的抗生素应用改革需要建立国家和全球联盟。
en: Implementing a system-wide change in the use of antibiotics will require the creation of national and global coalitions.

zh: 必须以制定反映患者和社团需求的医疗工作者和药企基本行为准则为核心目标。
en: One core aim must be to establish basic standards of conduct for health workers and drug companies that reflect the needs of patients and communities.

zh: 政府必须在此过程中发挥有效作用；研制、生产和销售药物和诊断技术的企业将积极探索促进合作。
en: Governments will need to build their capacity to play an effective role in this process, and companies that develop, produce, and distribute drugs and diagnostic technologies will have to contribute actively to the search for collaborative solutions.

zh: 人类从中受益的前提是必须以公正、可持续的方式管理抗生素。
en: Only if we manage antiobiotics in a fair and sustainable way will we be able to benefit from them at all.

zh: 民粹主义的反民主之心
en: The Anti-Democratic Heart of Populism

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 参加国际货币基金组织10月初年度会议的代表普遍认为 ： “ 假设共和党人不顾性骚扰和侮辱性言论提名了像特朗普这样的反贸易主义者，就有可能导致民粹保护主义者入主白宫。
en: SANTIAGO – Many of the men and women who turned out for the annual meeting of the International Monetary Fund in early October were saying something like this: “Imagine if the Republicans had nominated someone with the same anti-trade views as Trump, minus the insults and the sexual harassment.
A populist protectionist would be headed to the White House.”

zh: 弦外之音是美国和欧洲的左右翼民粹主义势力崛起是全球化及其负面影响的直接后果：相关负面影响包括失业和中产阶级收入停滞。
en: The underlying view is that rising populism on the right and the left, both in the United States and in Europe, is a straightforward consequence of globalization and its unwanted effects: lost jobs and stagnant middle-class incomes.

zh: 达沃斯的与会代表不喜欢这个结论，但他们却以皈依者般的热情接受了它。
en: Davos men and women hate this conclusion, but they have embraced it with all the fervor of new converts.

zh: 但还有另一种更具说服力的观点：虽然经济停滞可以助推选民进入民粹主义阵营，但经济形势低迷不是政治混乱的必要和充分条件。
en: Yet there is an alternative – and more persuasive – view: while economic stagnation helps push upset voters into the populist camp, bad economics is neither a necessary nor a sufficient condition for bad politics.

zh: 恰恰相反，普林斯顿大学政治学家穆勒在其新著中提出：民粹主义是代议制民主“永远无法摆脱的阴影 ” 。
en: On the contrary, argues Princeton political scientist Jan-Werner Mueller in his new book: populism is a “permanent shadow” on representative democracy.

zh: 民粹主义的本质不是税收（也不是就业或收入平等 ） 。
en: Populism is not about taxation (or jobs or income inequality).

zh: 它的本质是代表权 — — 谁能以何种形式代表民众说话。
en: It is about representation – who gets to speak for the people and how.

zh: 民主倡导者往往为民主高唱赞歌。
en: Advocates of democracy make some exalted claims on its behalf.

zh: 比如亚伯拉罕·林肯在葛底斯堡提出“民有、民治、民享的政府。
en: As Abraham Lincoln put it at Gettysburg, it is “government of the people, by the people, for the people.”

zh: ”但现代代议制民主 — — 或者任何一种民主 — — 都难免不符合这样的说法。
en: But modern representative democracy – or any democracy, for that matter – inevitably falls short of these claims.

zh: 四年一次在大选中为党派机器确定的候选人投票很难让人联想起林肯高谈阔论的内容。
en: Voting in an election every four years for candidates chosen by party machines is not exactly what Lincoln’s lofty words call to mind.

zh: 穆勒提出，民粹主义者的目标是实现意大利民主理论家贝尔托·波比奥所谓破碎的民主承诺。 穆勒称民粹主义者的言行“就像民众可以达成一致共识 ， . . .
en: What populists offer, Mueller says, is to fulfill what the Italian democratic theorist Norberto Bobbio calls the broken promises of democracy.

zh: 就像他们是一个人那样 ， . . . 就像只要民众选出合适的代表，就可以把命运牢牢控制在自己的手中。
en: Populists speak and act, claims Mueller, “as if the people could develop a singular judgment,...as if the people were one,...as if the people, if only they empowered the right representatives, could fully master their fates.”

zh: 民粹主义的基础是有毒三元组：否定复杂性、反多元主义和扭曲代表形式。
en: Populism rests on a toxic triad: denial of complexity, anti-pluralism, and a crooked version of representation.

zh: 我们多数人都认为社会选择非常复杂，对今后措施存在不同的看法是自然和合理的。
en: Most of us believe that social choices (Build more schools or hospitals?

zh: 但民粹主义者却否认这一点。
en: Stimulate or discourage international trade?

zh: 正如拉尔夫·达伦多夫曾经说过的那样，民粹主义是简单；而民主是复杂。
en: Liberalize or restrict abortion?) are complex, and that the existence of a plurality of views about what to do is both natural and legitimate. Populists deny this.

zh: 在民粹主义者看来，只有一种正确的观点 — — 那就是民众的看法。
en: As Ralf Dahrendorf once put it, populism is simple; democracy is complex. To populists, there is only one right view – that of the people.

zh: 如果真的如此，自由民主的复杂机制及其对授权和代表性的强调都是不必要的。
en: If so, the complex mechanisms of liberal democracy, with its emphasis on delegation and representation, are all unnecessary.

zh: 议会不需要无休无止的辩论：民众的统一意志可以轻易地以一次统一投票的形式表达。
en: No need for parliaments endlessly debating: the unitary will of the people can easily be expressed in a single vote.

zh: 因此民粹主义者热衷于公民投票。
en: Hence populists’ love affair with plebiscites and referenda.

zh: 英国脱欧，还记得吗？
en: Brexit, anyone?

zh: 不是随便哪个人都可以代表民众。
en: And not just anyone can represent the people.

zh: 他们宣扬绝对代表。
en: The claim is to exclusive representation.

zh: 还记不记得特朗普在共和党全国代表大会上的自吹自擂 ： “ 我靠一己之力就可以解决它。 ”
en: Remember Trump’s boast in his address to the Republican National Convention: “I alone can fix it.”

zh: 亚里士多德告诉我们，政治永远关乎道德。
en: Politics is always about morality, Aristotle told us.

zh: 但民粹主义者喜欢穆勒所谓特定的政治道德解读。
en: But populists favor what Mueller calls a particular moralistic interpretation of politics.

zh: 那些对世界看法正确的人是道德的；其他人都是腐败政治精英的走狗，因此都不道德。
en: Those who hold the right view about the world are moral; the rest are immoral, lackeys of a corrupt elite.

zh: 这恰恰是委内瑞拉统治者乌戈·查韦斯宣扬的观点。
en: That was exactly the rhetoric of the late Venezuelan ruler Hugo Chávez.

zh: 他那一套失败后，查韦斯将国家经济搞糟后反正可以把责任推到美帝国主义身上。
en: When that failed, and when Chávez’s sank his country’s economy, there was always US imperialism to blame.

zh: 因此民粹主义是一种身份政治。
en: So populism is a kind of identity politics.

zh: 其本质是我们反对他们。
en: It is always us against them.

zh: 从这个角度看，民粹主义并非技术官僚和精英发现的对民主的有效矫正，就像马琳·勒庞、拉斐尔·科雷亚、雷德普·塔伊普·埃尔多安或形形色色的西方知识分子希望你相信的那样。
en: Viewed in this light, populism is not a useful corrective to a democracy captured by technocrats and elites, as Marine Le Pen, Rafael Correa, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, or assorted Western intellectuals want you to believe.

zh: 恰恰相反，它本质上具有反民主色彩，因此能够威胁到民主本身。
en: On the contrary, it is profoundly anti-democratic, and hence a threat to democracy itself.

zh: 那么我们该怎么做？
en: What is to be done?

zh: 我的处方（不是穆勒的，而是我的）是民主派必须（而且能够）在他们擅长的领域击败民粹主义者。
en: My take (the prescription is my own, not Mueller’s) is that democrats must (and can) beat populists at their own game.

zh: 有毒三元组可以转化为有益的元素。
en: The toxic triad can become salutary.

zh: 首先必须承认局势的复杂性。
en: First, acknowledge complexity.

zh: 让选民像被欺骗一样厌恶的只有一件事：就是像对孩子一样对他们。
en: The only thing that upsets voters as much as being lied to is being treated like babies.

zh: 艰辛生活的民众必须知道世界是复杂的。
en: People who lead challenging lives know that the world is complex.

zh: 他们并不介意有人这样说。
en: They do not mind being told that.

zh: 他们本来就是成年人，应当以成年人的方式同他们对话。
en: They appreciate being spoken to as the grownups they are.

zh: 其次，不要将多种观点和身份当作需要解决的技术性问题。
en: Second, do not treat diversity of views and identities as a problem calling for a technocratic solution.

zh: 相反，尊重上述多样性符合社会深层次道德特征的要求。
en: Rather, make respect for such diversity a profoundly moral feature of society.

zh: 事实上，我们并不完全相同但我们可以和平共处是一项伟大的民主成就。
en: The fact that we are not all the same and we can still get along is a tremendous democratic achievement.

zh: 我们应当大力宣传它。
en: Make the case for it.

zh: 不要相信令人厌倦的陈词滥调，认为民粹主义者才诉诸情感，而民主派必须是理智的。
en: And do not fall for the tired cliché that reason is for democrats and emotion is for populists.

zh: 我们必须以激发情感的方式来宣传多元化民主。
en: Make the case for pluralistic democracy in a way that inspires and stirs emotion.

zh: 第三，捍卫 — — 并且升级 — — 代议制。
en: Third, defend – and update – representation.

zh: 仅在复杂的技术性事务中利用委托。
en: Leave delegation to complex technical matters.

zh: 利用现代技术让其他选择 — — 特别是贴近日常生活的选择 — — 更贴近于投票者。
en: Take advantage of modern technologies to bring other choices – particularly those having to do with the fabric of daily life – closer to voters.

zh: 收紧竞选融资法律、更严格地规范游说并推进平权行动以确保代表来自民众并为民众服务。
en: Tighten campaign finance laws, regulate lobbying better, and enforce affirmative-action measures to ensure that representatives are of the people and work for the people.

zh: 仅靠采取上述措施，还无法确保实现民主所有的破碎承诺。
en: These measures alone will not ensure that all of democracy’s broken promises are fulfilled.

zh: 但我们不能期望靠一系列简单行动来解决复杂问题。
en: But we cannot expect a single set of simple actions to solve a complex problem.

zh: 我们也不能认为仅靠一己之力就可以解决它。
en: Nor can we believe that we alone can fix it.

zh: 如果我们这么认为，我们就成了民粹主义者。
en: If we believed that, we would be populists.

zh: 为了保护民主，这恰恰是我们应当避免的。
en: For the sake of democracy, that is precisely what we should not be.

zh: 左派的退位
en: The Abdication of the Left

zh: 隆达，西班牙 — — 随着世界在英国退欧的余波冲击下动荡，经济学家和决策者渐渐明白他们严重低估了现有全球化形势的脆弱程度。
en: RONDA, SPAIN – As the world reels from the Brexit shock, it is dawning on economists and policymakers that they severely underestimated the political fragility of the current form of globalization.

zh: 正在席卷全球的民众反抗浪潮采取的形式相互重叠而多样化：重新强调地方和国家身份、要求加强民主控制和问责、拒绝中间政党和不信任精英与专家。
en: The popular revolt that appears to be underway is taking diverse, overlapping forms: reassertion of local and national identities, demand for greater democratic control and accountability, rejection of centrist political parties, and distrust of elites and experts.

zh: 出现这样的反弹是可以预见的。
en: This backlash was predictable.

zh: 某些经济学家，包括我本人在内，的确警告过在现有的管理、稳定及合法化市场制度的边界以外推进经济全球化的后果。
en: Some economists, including me, did warn about the consequences of pushing economic globalization beyond the boundaries of institutions that regulate, stabilize, and legitimize markets.

zh: 金融贸易超级全球化本意是创造无缝衔接的世界市场，但却撕裂了国内社会。
en: Hyper-globalization in trade and finance, intended to create seamlessly integrated world markets, tore domestic societies apart.

zh: 更出人意料的是人们果断采取了右倾的政治对策。
en: The bigger surprise is the decidedly right-wing tilt the political reaction has taken.

zh: 欧洲各国主要是民族主义者和本土民粹主义者显露峥嵘，而左翼只在希腊和西班牙等少数地区有所斩获。
en: In Europe, it is predominantly nationalists and nativist populists that have risen to prominence, with the left advancing only in a few places such as Greece and Spain.

zh: 美国右翼煽动家唐纳德·特朗普成功地取代了共和党当权派，而左翼份子伯尼·桑德斯却未能打败中间派的希拉里·克林顿。
en: In the United States, the right-wing demagogue Donald Trump has managed to displace the Republican establishment, while the leftist Bernie Sanders was unable to overtake the centrist Hillary Clinton.

zh: 正在崛起的新兴当权派极不情愿的达成共识：全球化加剧了阶级分裂，拉大了有资源和有能力利用世界市场者和不具备上述能力者之间的鸿沟。
en: As an emerging new establishment consensus grudgingly concedes, globalization accentuates class divisions between those who have the skills and resources to take advantage of global markets and those who don’t.

zh: 收入和阶级分化，相对于以种族、民族或宗教身份为基础的分化，传统上会强化左翼政治势力。
en: Income and class cleavages, in contrast to identity cleavages based on race, ethnicity, or religion, have traditionally strengthened the political left.

zh: 那么左翼势力究竟为什么没能实现政治挑战全球化？
en: So why has the left been unable to mount a significant political challenge to globalization?

zh: 答案之一是其他全球化“冲击”被移民问题掩盖了。
en: One answer is that immigration has overshadowed other globalization “shocks.”

zh: 人们感受到来自文化传统截然不同的贫困国家的大批移民和难民涌入加剧了身份分化，而极右翼政客可以驾轻就熟地利用这样的现状。
en: The perceived threat of mass inflows of migrants and refugees from poor countries with very different cultural traditions aggravates identity cleavages that far-right politicians are exceptionally well placed to exploit.

zh: 因此从特朗普到马琳·勒庞等右翼政治家在重新确立国家地位的主张中掺入大量反穆斯林象征主义也就毫不奇怪了。
en: So it is not a surprise that rightist politicians from Trump to Marine Le Pen lace their message of national reassertion with a rich dose of anti-Muslim symbolism.

zh: 拉美民主国家提供了一种很能说明问题的对照。
en: Latin American democracies provide a telling contrast.

zh: 全球化在上述国家主要表现为贸易和外资冲击，而不是移民冲击。
en: These countries experienced globalization mostly as a trade and foreign-investment shock, rather than as an immigration shock.

zh: 全球化几乎等同于所谓的华盛顿共识政策和金融开放。
en: Globalization became synonymous with so-called Washington Consensus policies and financial opening.

zh: 中东和非洲移民问题仍十分有限，在政治上并不突出。
en: Immigration from the Middle East or Africa remained limited and had little political salience.

zh: 因此在巴西、玻利维亚、厄瓜多尔和最具灾难性的委内瑞拉等拉美国家，民粹主义回归是以左翼形式完成的。
en: So the populist backlash in Latin America – in Brazil, Bolivia, Ecuador, and, most disastrously, Venezuela – took a left-wing form.

zh: 欧洲右翼回归的两个主要除外特例 — — 希腊和西班牙 — — 情况是类似的。
en: The story is similar in the main two exceptions to right-wing resurgence in Europe – Greece and Spain.

zh: 在希腊，主要的政治断点是欧洲机构和国际货币基金组织所强制推行的紧缩政策。
en: In Greece, the main political fault line has been austerity policies imposed by European institutions and the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 而在西班牙，直到不久前多数移民还来自文化相似的拉美国家。
en: In Spain, most immigrants until recently came from culturally similar Latin American countries.

zh: 极右翼势力在其他地方快速发展的温床在上述两国都是不存在的。
en: In both countries, the far right lacked the breeding ground it had elsewhere.

zh: 但拉美和南欧的状况或许暴露了左翼势力一个更大的弱点：那就是缺少重塑21世纪资本主义和全球化的明确计划。
en: But the experience in Latin America and southern Europe reveals perhaps a greater weakness of the left: the absence of a clear program to refashion capitalism and globalization for the twenty-first century.

zh: 从希腊的激进左翼联盟到巴西工党，左翼势力除收入转移等改良政策外，都未能提出经济上可行且政治上受欢迎的想法。
en: From Greece’s Syriza to Brazil’s Workers’ Party, the left has failed to come up with ideas that are economically sound and politically popular, beyond ameliorative policies such as income transfers.

zh: 所以经济学家和技术官僚很大程度上要为此负责。
en: Economists and technocrats on the left bear a large part of the blame.

zh: 他们不仅没能为左翼改革计划作出贡献，反而很轻易地让位给市场原教旨主义并全盘接受了其核心原则。
en: Instead of contributing to such a program, they abdicated too easily to market fundamentalism and bought in to its central tenets.

zh: 更糟的是，他们在关键时间节点领导了超全球化运动。
en: Worse still, they led the hyper-globalization movement at crucial junctures.

zh: 欧盟、经合组织和国际货币基金组织将资本自由流动 — — 尤其是短期资本流动 — — 奉为政策标准可能是近几十年来对全球经济最致命的政策。
en: The enthroning of free capital mobility – especially of the short-term kind – as a policy norm by the European Union, the Organization for Economic Cooperation and Development, and the IMF was arguably the most fateful decision for the global economy in recent decades.

zh: 哈佛商学院教授艾儒蔚（ Rawi Abdelal）已经证明，20世纪80年代末及90年代初推动这项工作的不是自由市场理论者，而是像（欧盟委员会）雅克·德洛尔和（经合组织）亨利·沙夫兰斯基这样与法国社会党有紧密联系的法国技术官僚。
en: As Harvard Business School professor Rawi Abdelal has shown, this effort was spearheaded in the late 1980s and early 1990s not by free-market ideologues, but by French technocrats such as Jacques Delors (at the European Commission) and Henri Chavranski (at the OECD), who were closely associated with the Socialist Party in France.

zh: 同样，在美国完成这项工作的是与亲凯恩斯主义民主党有关的劳伦斯·萨默斯等大力推进放松金融管制的技术官僚。
en: Similarly, in the US, it was technocrats associated with the more Keynesian Democratic Party, such as Lawrence Summers, who led the charge for financial deregulation.

zh: 法国社会党技术官僚似乎从20世纪80年代初密特朗未能成功的凯恩斯主义试验中得出结论，认为国内经济管理任务是不可能完成的，而且没有其他真正的措施能够取代金融全球化。
en: France’s Socialist technocrats appear to have concluded from the failed Mitterrand experiment with Keynesianism in the early 1980s that domestic economic management was no longer possible, and that there was no real alternative to financial globalization.

zh: 能够遵循的最佳路线图是制定欧洲及全球规则，而不是坐视德美等强国强制推行他们自己的规则。
en: The best that could be done was to enact Europe-wide and global rules, instead of allowing powerful countries like Germany or the US to impose their own.

zh: 好消息是左翼学术真空正在得到填补，现在已经没有任何理由相信“没有其他选择”的专制举措。
en: The good news is that the intellectual vacuum on the left is being filled, and there is no longer any reason to believe in the tyranny of “no alternatives.”

zh: 左翼政界人士越来越没有理由不去借鉴“可敬的”经济学学术力量。
en: Politicians on the left have less and less reason not to draw on “respectable” academic firepower in economics.

zh: 举几个例子：安娜特·阿德马蒂和西蒙·约翰逊一贯主张激进的银行改革；托马斯·皮克特和托尼·阿特金森提出了各式各样的针对国内不平等的政策；马里亚纳·马祖卡托和张夏准开创性地指出调动公共部门以促进包容性创新的方法； 约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨和何塞·安东尼奥·奥坎波共同提出了全球改革；布拉德·迪隆、杰弗里·萨克斯和劳伦斯·萨默斯（就是同一个人！ ）呼吁对基础设施和绿色经济领域进行长期公共投资。
en: Consider just a few examples: Anat Admati and Simon Johnson have advocated radical banking reforms; Thomas Piketty and Tony Atkinson have proposed a rich menu of policies to deal with inequality at the national level; Mariana Mazzucato and Ha-Joon Chang have written insightfully on how to deploy the public sector to foster inclusive innovation; Joseph Stiglitz and José Antonio Ocampo have proposed global reforms; Brad DeLong, Jeffrey Sachs, and Lawrence Summers (the very same!) have argued for long-term public investment in infrastructure and the green economy.

zh: 已经有足够的元素供左翼人士在制定纲领性经济对策时使用。
en: There are enough elements here for building a programmatic economic response from the left.

zh: 左右翼势力最关键的差别在于社会越分裂右翼越壮大 — — 右翼奉行“我们”和“他们”的逻辑 — — 而左翼如果取得成功却能通过弥合鸿沟的改革来消除社会分裂。
en: A crucial difference between the right and the left is that the right thrives on deepening divisions in society – “us” versus “them” – while the left, when successful, overcomes these cleavages through reforms that bridge them.

zh: 因此才有了早期左翼改革（凯恩斯主义、社会民主主义和福利国家政策 ） — —所产生的悖论，在拯救资本主义的同时却让自身成为多余的。
en: Hence the paradox that earlier waves of reforms from the left – Keynesianism, social democracy, the welfare state – both saved capitalism from itself and effectively rendered themselves superfluous.

zh: 如果再不出现这样的对策，民粹主义者和极右翼团体就会趁虚而入，他们将像以前那样领导世界，而他们的领导只能加剧分裂和引发更多冲突。
en: Absent such a response again, the field will be left wide open for populists and far-right groups, who will lead the world – as they always have – to deeper division and more frequent conflict.

zh: 新愚人社会主义
en: The New Socialism of Fools

zh: 伯克利—根据主流经济学理论，全球化会“让所有船都浮起来 ” ， 而对于广义收入分配，几乎没有影响。
en: BERKELEY – According to mainstream economic theory, globalization tends to “lift all boats,” and has little effect on the broad distribution of incomes.

zh: 但“全球化”并不只是取消关税和其他让本国有政治影响力的生产商拥有寻租优势的进口壁垒。
en: But “globalization” is not the same as the elimination of tariffs and other import barriers that confer rent-seeking advantages to politically influential domestic producers.

zh: 哈佛大学经济学家丹尼·罗德里克（Dani Rodrik）频繁指出，经济学理论预测，消除关税和非关税壁垒确实会带来净收益；但也会造成大规模再分配，其中消除较小壁垒所带来的再分配相对净收益更大。
en: As Harvard University economist Dani Rodrik frequently points out, economic theory predicts that removing tariffs and non-tariff barriers does produce net gains; but it also results in large redistributions, wherein eliminating smaller barriers yields larger redistributions relative to the net gains.

zh: 出于目的的不同，全球化也有所不同。
en: Globalization, for our purposes, is different.

zh: 它应该被理解为一个过程，在这个过程中，减小运输和通讯成本的技术进步让世界变得日益联动。
en: It should be understood as a process in which the world becomes increasingly interconnected through technological advances that drive down transportation and communication costs.

zh: 诚然，这种形式的全球化让外国生产商以更低的成本向遥远的市场出口商品和服务。
en: To be sure, this form of globalization allows foreign producers to export goods and services to distant markets at a lower cost.

zh: 但它也为另一方打开了出口市场，降低了成本。
en: But it also opens up export markets and reduces costs for the other side.

zh: 最终，消费者以更少的前买到了更多的东西。
en: And at the end of the day, consumers get more stuff for less.

zh: 根据标准经济学理论，只有在一国的出口所需要的生产要素与其进口截然不同时，才会发生再分配。
en: According to standard economic theory, redistribution only comes about when a country’s exports require vastly different factors of production than its imports.

zh: 但当今全球经济中并不具备这样的不同。
en: But there are no such differences in today’s global economy.

zh: 在美国，金融收支盈余意味着更多的美国人从事建筑工人、资本品生产者和护士和家庭健康助手等工作。
en: In the United States, a balance-of-payments surplus in finance means that more Americans will be employed as construction workers, capital-goods producers, and nurses and home health aides.

zh: 类似地，服务业盈余意味着较多的美国人不仅仅在钢筋玻璃幕墙大厦里从事高学历（和高薪）的咨询工作，也在黄石国家公园外的汽车旅馆里当门卫和清洁工。
en: Similarly, a surplus in services means that more Americans will work not only as highly educated (and well-remunerated) consultants in steel-and-glass eyries, but also as, say, janitors and housekeepers in motels outside of Yellowstone National Park.

zh: 与此同时，制造业赤字可能给劳动力成本相对资本较低的国家制造更多的海外制造业岗位；但它并没有毁掉多少美国的就业，因为美国制造业已经是一个资本密集程度很高的行业。
en: At the same time, a deficit in manufacturing may create more manufacturing jobs abroad, in countries where labor costs are low relative to capital; but it destroys relatively few jobs in the US, where manufacturing is already a highly capital-intensive industry.

zh: 斯坦福大学经济学家罗伯特·霍尔（Robert Hall）三十年来一直在强调，在美国，汽车销售员比制造汽车的工人数量更多。
en: As Stanford University economist Robert Hall has been pointing out for three decades, more Americans are employed selling cars than making them.

zh: 美国从国外进口的商品需要大量技能相对较低的劳动力生产，但他们并不会大量取代美国的低技能劳动力。
en: The commodities that the US imports from abroad embody a significant amount of relatively unskilled labor, but they do not displace much unskilled labor in America.

zh: 因此，至少在理论上，美国就业从流水线制造业转向建筑业、服务业和护理业可能对性别间的总体收入分配形成了而一些影响，但对阶级收入分配来说并没有。
en: So, at least in theory, the shift in US employment from assembly-line manufacturing to construction, services, and caretaking may have had an impact on the overall distribution of income in terms of gender, but not in terms of class.

zh: 那么，二十一世纪为什么还有那么强烈的抵制全球化的情绪？
en: Why, then, has there been such strong political resistance to globalization in the twenty-first century?

zh: 我看到了四个原因。
en: I see four reasons.

zh: 首先也是最重要的是，政客将国家的问题归咎于外国人和没有投票权的移民是很容易的。
en: First and foremost, it is easy for politicians to pin the blame for a country’s problems on foreigners and immigrants who do not vote.

zh: 1890年，哈布斯堡帝国的政治家们就惯于将各种社会经济病归咎于犹太人。 奥地利异见者费迪南·克罗纳维特（Ferdinand Kronawetter）有一个著名的观察 ： “ Der Antisemitismus ist der Sozialismus der dummen Kerle ” ， 即反犹是愚人社会主义。
en: Back in 1890, when politicians in the Habsburg Empire routinely blamed Jews for various socioeconomic ills, the Austrian dissident Ferdinand Kronawetter famously observed that “Der Antisemitismus ist der Sozialismus der dummen Kerle”: anti-Semitism is the socialism of fools.

zh: 今天的反全球化也是如此。
en: The same could be said of anti-globalization today.

zh: 其次，全球北方国家一代人以来的既不公平，又不及预期的经济增长，造就了强烈的政治和心理需要，必须找到替罪羊。
en: Second, more than a generation of inequitable and slower-than-expected economic growth in the global North has created a strong political and psychological need for scapegoats.

zh: 人们想要一个简单的叙事来解释为何他们没有赶上曾经蝴蝶许诺的繁荣，以及为何越来越富有的卓越阶级和其他人之间的差距这么大，并且还在不断扩大。
en: People want a simple narrative to explain why they are missing out on the prosperity they were once promised, and why there is such a large and growing gap between an increasingly wealthy overclass and everyone else.

zh: 第三，中国的经济崛起恰逢全球北方国家难以实现充分就业的时期。
en: Third, China’s economic rise coincided with a period in which the global North was struggling to reach full employment.

zh: 与哈耶克和安德鲁· 梅隆（Andrew Mellon）的追随者们经常宣称的相反，经济再调整（readjustments）并没有发生在破产迫使劳动力和资本退出低生产率、低需求的行业时，而是发生在繁荣将劳动力和资本推向高生产率、高需求的行业时。
en: Contrary to what the followers of Friedrich von Hayek and Andrew Mellon have always claimed, economic readjustments do not happen when bankruptcies force labor and capital out of low-productivity, low-demand industries, but rather when booms pull labor and capital into high-productivity, high-demand industries.

zh: 因此，新自由主义不但要求开放和竞争的市场、全球变革以及价格稳定。
en: Thus, neoliberalism does not just require open and competitive markets, global change, and price stability.

zh: 它依赖于充分就业和几乎永恒的繁荣，一如经济学家凯恩斯在20世纪二三十年代所警告的那样。
en: It also depends on full employment and near-permanent booms, just as economist John Maynard Keynes had warned in the 1920s and 1930s.

zh: 在最近几十年中，新自由主义秩序没有实现其中的任何一个条件，最有可能的原因是，即使最优秀的政客在台上，也不可能实现这些条件。
en: In recent decades, the neoliberal order failed to deliver either condition, most likely because doing so would have been impossible even with the best policies in place.

zh: 第四，决策者没有用更激进的社会政策和经济和地理再分配来足够多地补偿这一失败。
en: Fourth, policymakers did not do enough to compensate for this failure with more aggressive social policies and economic and geographic redistribution.

zh: 美国总统特朗普最近告诉纽约北部居民，他们应该离开该地区，去别处找工作，这无非是全球北方国家过去一代政客们的老生常谈。
en: When US President Donald Trump recently told upstate New Yorkers that they should leave the region and seek jobs elsewhere, he was simply echoing the past generation of center-right politicians in the global North.

zh: 全球北方国家当前的政治和经济困境与20世纪二三十年代并没有很大的不同。
en: The global North’s current political and economic dilemmas are not so different from those of the 1920s and 1930s.

zh: 当时，凯恩斯就指出，关键在于创造和维持充分就业，这样，大部分其他问题自然就能解决。
en: As Keynes noted then, the key is to produce and maintain full employment, at which point most other problems will melt away.

zh: 而奥地利-匈牙利经济学家卡尔·波兰尼（Karl Planyi）指出，保护社会经济权利是政府的角色。
en: And, as the Austro-Hungarian economist Karl Polanyi argued, it is the role of government to secure socioeconomic rights.

zh: 人们认为他们有权利生活在健康的社会中，拥有稳定的工作，获得一份随时间不断增加的体面收入。
en: People believe that they have a right to live in healthy communities, hold stable occupations, and earn a decent income that rises over time.

zh: 但这些假定的权利并不是财产权利和稀缺资源权利 — — 即新自由主义的的通货 — — 的应有之义。
en: But these presumed rights do not stem naturally from property rights and claims to scarce resources – the coins of the neoliberal realm.

zh: 全球金融危机和全球北方国家发生“大衰退”已经过去了十年。
en: It has been ten years since the global financial crisis and the start of the “Great Recession” in the global North.

zh: 政府仍然没有修复这些事件所造成的伤害。
en: Governments still have not repaired the damage from those events.

zh: 如果它们不尽快修复的话，愚人“XX主义”将在未来几十年中不断地造成严重破坏。
en: If they do not do so soon, the “-isms” of fools will continue to wreak havoc in the decades ahead.

zh: 移民和新阶级分化
en: Immigration and the New Class Divide

zh: 新加坡 — — 英国的欧洲事务影子大臣帕特·麦克法登最近警告工党党员他们应该尽可能去接纳全球经济，而不要像对待瘟疫一样对移民问题避之唯恐不及。
en: SINGAPORE – The British shadow minister for Europe, Pat McFadden, recently warned members of his Labour Party that they should try to make the most of the global economy and not treat immigration like a disease.

zh: 如他所言 ， “ 你可以从别人的痛苦中寻找满足感，也可以给别人一个机会。
en: As he put it, “You can feed on people’s grievances or you can give people a chance.

zh: 我认为我们的政策应当着重于给别人机会。 ”
en: And I think our policies should be around giving people a chance.”

zh: 在这个被针对移民、银行家、穆斯林 、 “ 自由派精英 ” 、 “欧盟官员 ” 、 世界主义者或哪怕仅有些许陌生的任何事物的不满所占据的世界里，像这样明智的看法已经十分罕有。
en: In a world increasingly dominated by grievances – against immigrants, bankers, Muslims, “liberal elites,” “Eurocrats,” cosmopolitans, or anything else that seems vaguely alien – such wise words are rare.

zh: 世界各国领袖应该多加听取。
en: Leaders worldwide should take note.

zh: 在美国，由茶党活动分子支持的共和党正威胁要关闭政府，理由仅仅因为奥巴马总统为已经在美工作生活多年的非法移民提供了获得公民身份的机会。
en: In the United States, Republicans – backed by their Tea Party activists – are threatening to close the government down just because President Barack Obama has offered undocumented immigrants who have lived and worked in the US for many years a chance to gain citizenship.

zh: 英国独立党（UKIP）正力推一项计划，在五年内禁止移民取得永久定居资格。
en: The United Kingdom Independence Party (UKIP) wants to introduce a five-year ban on immigration for permanent settlement.

zh: 俄罗斯副总理罗戈津曾经公布了一段视频承诺要将垃圾从莫斯科“清理”出去 — — 他把主要来自前苏联加盟共和国的外来务工者称之为垃圾。
en: Russia’s deputy prime minister, Dmitry Rogozin, once released a video promising to “clean the rubbish” – meaning migrant workers, mostly from former Soviet republics – “away from Moscow.”

zh: 就连曾以宽容闻名的荷兰和丹麦人都越来越多地投票给主张严惩移民的党派。
en: Even the once famously tolerant Dutch and Danes are increasingly voting for parties that fulminate against the scourge of immigration.

zh: 一贯主张可以自由侮辱穆斯林的荷兰自由党想要禁止所有的清真寺。
en: Always keen to assert the freedom to insult Muslims, the Dutch Freedom Party wants to ban all mosques.

zh: 就连新加坡势单力薄且备受骚扰的反对党 — — 新加坡几乎人人都是移民的后代 — — 都从迎合民众对于移民（主要是中印移民）的不满中汲取动力，人们认为这些移民从“本地人”手中抢走了工作机会。
en: And the tiny and much-harassed opposition parties in Singapore – a country where almost everyone is descended from immigrants – are gaining traction by appealing to popular gripes about immigrants (mostly from India and China) who are supposedly taking jobs from “natives.”

zh: 美国茶党狂热份子、俄国沙文主义者、忧心忡忡的荷兰和丹麦人以及新加坡左翼人士究竟有哪些共同诉求推动着这样的反移民情绪？
en: What can American Tea Party enthusiasts, Russian chauvinists, fearful Dutch and Danes, and Singaporean leftists possibly have in common that is driving this anti-immigrant sentiment?

zh: 在经济紧缩环境中保住工作无疑是一个严重的问题。
en: Retaining one’s job in a tightening economy is undoubtedly a serious concern.

zh: 但穷苦的墨西哥移民几乎没有威胁到支持茶党的多数美国中年乡村白人的生计。
en: But the livelihoods of most of the middle-aged rural white Americans who support the Tea Party are hardly threatened by poor Mexican migrants.

zh: 英国独立党受欢迎的某些区域移民非常罕见。
en: UKIP is popular in some parts of England where immigrants are rarely seen.

zh: 而许多荷兰自由党选民的住所并不靠近任何清真寺。
en: And many of the Dutch Freedom Party’s voters live nowhere near a mosque.

zh: 反移民情绪不受传统左右翼分界的限制。
en: Anti-immigrant sentiment cuts across the old left-right divide.

zh: 茶党或英国自由党支持者与真正担心被低薪外国人抢走工作的工薪阶层选民唯一的共同点是害怕跟不上迅速变化、由超国家机构主导的全球网络化世界的焦虑。
en: One thing Tea Party or UKIP supporters share with working-class voters who genuinely fear losing their jobs to low-paid foreigners is anxiety about being left behind in a world of easy mobility, supranational organizations, and global networking.

zh: 在右翼领域，对保守党派的支持在移民或超国家机构受益者的商业利益和受威胁团体间发生割裂。
en: On the right, support for conservative parties is split between business interests that benefit from immigration or supranational institutions, and groups that feel threatened by them.

zh: 从中可以找到英国保守党如此害怕自由党的解释。
en: That is why the British Tories are so afraid of UKIP.

zh: 相比于经济发展，英国自由党领袖法拉奇更关注宣扬他的极端民族独立。
en: Nigel Farage, UKIP’s leader, is less concerned with economic growth than with pursuing his extreme conception of national independence.

zh: 而在左翼领域，反对种族主义及狭隘情绪者和想要保住饭碗和本土工薪阶层残存“团结”者所持的意见发生了分歧。
en: On the left, opinion is split between those who oppose racism and intolerance above all and those who want to protect employment and preserve “solidarity” for what is left of the native-born working class.

zh: 将移民问题所引发的焦虑仅仅视为对全球化经济的偏见和忧虑并归结为反动情绪而置之不理无疑是一种错失。
en: It would be a mistake to dismiss anxiety about immigration as mere bigotry or apprehension about the globalized economy as simply reactionary.

zh: 民族、宗教和文化特征（这里缺少更准确的形容词）正在发生转变，虽然转变的动力与其说是移民还不如说是不断发展的全球化资本主义。
en: National, religious, and cultural identities (for lack of a better word) are being transformed, though less by immigration than by the development of globalized capitalism.

zh: 在新的全球经济中，输家和赢家都非常明确。
en: In the new global economy, there are clear winners and losers.

zh: 有能力在各种国际场合有效沟通的受过教育的男性和女性无疑是受益者。
en: Educated men and women who can communicate effectively in varied international contexts are benefiting.

zh: 而缺乏必要教育或经历的人 — — 这种人大有人在 — — 在苦苦地挣扎求助。
en: People who lack the needed education or experience – and there are many of them – are struggling.

zh: 换言之，新一轮阶级分化无关贫富差异，而更多倾向于受过教育的都市精英和没那么世故、灵活，并且在各方面关系也没那��丰富的乡下人的区别。
en: In other words, the new class divisions run less between the rich and the poor than between educated metropolitan elites and less sophisticated, less flexible, and, in every sense, less connected provincials.

zh: 乡下人的政治领袖（及其支持者）有时比他们所痛恨的都市精英更加富有并不能改变什么。
en: It is irrelevant that the provincials’ political leaders (and their backers) are sometimes wealthier than the resented metropolitan elites.

zh: 他们仍然感到被人看不起。
en: They still feel looked down upon.

zh: 因此他们像所有被扑朔迷离而又令人迷惑的世界排除在外的人一样满怀仇恨和痛苦。
en: And so they share the bitterness of those who feel alienated in a world they find bewildering and hateful.

zh: 民粹主义煽动者想要挑起这样的仇恨，痛骂那些为微薄收入卖命或者根本不工作的外国人。
en: Populist rabble-rousers like to stir up such resentments by ranting about foreigners who work for a pittance or not at all.

zh: 但其实更令本土民众沮丧的是少数族裔和移民的相对成功。
