en: But it is the relative success of ethnic minorities and immigrants that is more upsetting to indigenous populations.

zh: 这就解释了奥巴马遭人仇恨的原因。
en: This explains the popular hostility toward Obama.

zh: 美国人知道不久以后白人将成为少数，有色人种将越来越多地身居要职。
en: Americans know that, before too long, whites will be just another minority, and people of color will increasingly be in positions of power.

zh: 此时，所有茶党党员和像他们一样的人所能做的只是大喊 ， “ 把国家还给我们！ ”
en: At this point, all Tea Partiers and others like them can do is declare, “We want our country back!”

zh: 当然，这个要求根本不可能。
en: Of course, this is an impossible demand.

zh: 如果不想像波斯尼亚那样引发全境范围内的大规模血腥种族清洗，美国人和其他人除了习惯生活在越来越多样化的社会里之外其实别无选择。
en: Short of unleashing massive and bloody ethnic cleansing – Bosnia, on a continental scale – Americans and others have no choice but to get used to living in increasingly diverse societies.

zh: 同样，经济全球化的效果也无法消除。
en: Likewise, economic globalization cannot be undone.

zh: 但监管可以而且理应得到改善。
en: But regulation can and should be improved.

zh: 归根结底，有些东西仍然值得保护。
en: After all, some things are still worth protecting.

zh: 我们不想让文化、教育、生活方式或工作完全处在市场力量的创造性破坏之下有着充分的理由。
en: There are good reasons not to leave culture, education, lifestyles, or jobs completely exposed to the creative destruction of market forces.

zh: 麦克法登已准确地找到了的全球化挑战的核心解决方案：那就是赋予民众“谋取全球化世界利益的工具 ” ， 从而使“高度互联的世界更好地为人们服务 ” 。
en: McFadden has pinpointed the central solution to globalization’s challenges: giving people “the tools to reap the benefits” of the globalized world, thereby making the “connected world work better for people.”

zh: 问题是上述呼吁更有可能吸引高学历、已经掌握优势的群体，而不是那些在今天全球经济中感觉权利被剥夺的失意者。
en: The problem is that this call is more likely to appeal to the highly educated, already privileged classes than to those who feel disenfranchised in today’s global economy.

zh: 这个摆在日益代表都市精英利益的左翼政党面前的问题十分严重。 与此同时，乡村民粹主义者正在推动传统的保守派人士在民众仇恨的黑暗领域转向右翼。
en: This is a serious problem for political parties on the left, which increasingly seem to be speaking for the metropolitan elites, while provincial populists are pushing traditional conservatives further to the right by fishing in the dark waters of popular resentment.

zh: 全球合作问题生死攸关
en: Global Cooperation as a Life-and-Death Issue

zh: 伦敦 — — 最近英国投票脱欧所产生的不确定性已经严重冲击全球市场，而且一直牢牢占据着报纸的头版头条。
en: LONDON – The uncertainty generated by the United Kingdom’s recent vote to leave the European Union – which has sent shockwaves through global markets – has been dominating headlines.

zh: 但当我们准备迎接新的政治考验时，绝不能忽视我们已经面临的挑战，尤其是与经济效益和政治稳定不相称的细菌耐药性上升（AMR）所带来的全球健康挑战。
en: But, as we prepare to face new political trials, we must not lose sight of the challenges we already face, especially global health challenges like the rise of antimicrobial resistance (AMR), which has no regard for economic performance or political stability.

zh: 现在的情况是，每年约有700,000人死于耐药菌感染。
en: As it stands, an estimated 700,000 people are losing their lives to drug-resistant infections each year.

zh: 截止2050年，该数据可能上升到每年1000万，累计给世界GDP造成的损失高达100万亿美元。
en: By 2050, this figure could skyrocket to ten million per year, at a cumulative cost to world GDP of $100 trillion..

zh: 为避免出现这样的后果，今年5月，我所领导的《细菌耐药性上升评论》公布了应对上述感染的策略，就确保必要的新抗生素开发和将现有抗生素更有效的用于人类健康和农业生产提出了建议性方案。
en: To avoid that outcome, in May the Review on AMR that I lead published its strategy for tackling such infections, laying out proposals to ensure the development of the necessary new antibiotics, and to use existing antibiotics more efficiently in humans and agriculture.

zh: 在我们所建议的十大干预措施中有4项尤为重要：
en: Of the ten major interventions we proposed, four are particularly important:

zh: ·       发起一场针对不同地区特点的全球运动，以提高对细菌耐药性上升问题的公众认识。
en: · Launch a global campaign, tailored for different regions, to improve public awareness of AMR.

zh: ·       通过为成功新药的研发企业提供一次性市场准入奖励解决目前新抗生素研发领域的市场失灵现象，同时确保全球都能公平地享受到研发成果。
en: · Address the market failure in the development of new antibiotics by introducing lump-sum market-entry rewards to developers of successful new drugs, while ensuring global access.

zh: ·       推进创新并改善诊断技术应用，以支持抗生素的高效应用。
en: · Advance innovation and improve use of diagnostic technology to support more efficient use of antibiotics.

zh: ·       落实旨在减少农业及人类医疗领域抗生素不必要应用的国别目标。
en: · Implement country-level targets focused on reducing unnecessary use of antibiotics in agriculture and humans.

zh: 随着最终报告的完成，评论将继续直接敦促国际政治领导人采取行动。
en: With our final report complete, the Review will now continue to make the international case for action directly to political leaders.

zh: 比方说，作为评论的主席，我最近在日内瓦召开的世界卫生大会上与纽约和华盛顿的联合国及美国决策者讨论了我们的建议。
en: For example, in my capacity as the Review’s Chairman, I recently discussed our recommendations at the World Health Assembly in Geneva, and with United Nations and United States policymakers in New York and Washington, DC.

zh: 在上述讨论中，引人瞩目的是决策者对细菌耐药性上升危险有着越来越清醒的认识。
en: In these discussions, policymakers’ growing awareness of the danger posed by AMR stood out.

zh: 短短两年前，耐药菌感染的话题往往会遭遇像“AMR是什么？ ”或“财政部长为什么要负责一场医疗危机？
en: Just two years ago, the topic of drug-resistant infections would usually be met with questions like “What is AMR?” or, “Why would a finance minister take charge of a health crisis?”

zh: ”这样的提问。 很少有人理解这一挑战的规模和多面性；以及全面采取措施的必要性。
en: Few understood the scale and multifaceted nature of the challenge, and thus the need for a comprehensive approach.

zh: 英国首相戴维·卡梅伦最初邀请我领导《细菌耐药性上升评论》时我也曾经问过自己类似的问题。
en: I asked myself similar questions when British Prime Minister David Cameron first asked me to lead the Review on AMR.

zh: 自那以后情况已经发生了很大改变。
en: The situation has changed considerably since then.

zh: 形形色色经济和政治体制国家的决策者正在参与解决细菌耐药性上升问题，其中某些国家已经在采取针对性措施。
en: Policymakers from countries with a wide variety of economic and political systems are engaging on the AMR problem, with some countries already taking steps to tackle it.

zh: 所有这些都给人们带来了希望，2016年可能会启动真正的变革。
en: All of this provides grounds for hope that 2016 may be the year when real change gets underway.

zh: 但希望是一回事；行动则完全不同。
en: But hope is one thing; action is another.

zh: 虽然高层就细菌耐药性上升问题举行的会议和讲话传达了正确的精神，但如果从今年9月召开的二十国及联合国峰会开始，我们不能成功将现有势头转化为具体行动，那么会议和讲话就没有任何意义。
en: While high-level meetings and speeches about AMR send the right message, they will mean nothing if we do not manage to translate the current momentum into concrete action, beginning at the G20 and UN meetings this September.

zh: 虽然最近的讨论表明上述会议很有可能达成协议，但上述协议能否匹配问题的规模仍具有极大的不确定性。
en: And while my most recent discussions suggest that agreements are likely to be reached at both of these meetings, it is far from certain that they will match the scale of the problem.

zh: 在20国峰会上，必要的协议应着眼于制定一套全球机制，为经济实惠、使用方便高效的全球新抗生素市场重新注入活力。
en: At the G20, the needed agreement should focus on developing a global mechanism to re-invigorate the market for new antibiotics that are globally affordable, accessible, and used as efficiently as possible.

zh: 而联合国的目标应当是真正落实“使用方便而非过剩”的口号，签署一份减少农业不必要使用抗生素的协议，并发起一场全球宣传运动。
en: At the UN, the goal should be to turn the mantra of “access, not excess” into a reality, with an agreement to reduce the unnecessary use of antibiotics in agriculture, and to spearhead a global awareness campaign.

zh: 为新抗生素及诊断方法研发投入更多资金以应对细菌耐药性上升同样至关重要。
en: Increased funding for research and development of new antibiotics and diagnostics to fight AMR is also vital.

zh: 重要的是，协议必须长出牙齿。
en: Crucially, the agreements must have teeth.

zh: 各国应自主制定目标以适应自身独特的需求和环境，但必须加入某些条款，以确保各方尽到自己的努力。
en: Countries should set their own objectives to fit their particular circumstances and needs, but there must be some provisions to ensure that all are pulling their weight.

zh: 首先，应当把解决细菌耐药性上升问题纳入更广泛的经济发展战略，其中包括落实联合国可持续发展目标。
en: For starters, efforts to fight AMR should be incorporated into broader economic-development strategies, including the implementation of the UN Sustainable Development Goals.

zh: 此外，应定期衡量目标的进展状况，这不仅是要让决策者、企业和医疗系统各负其责，也是要让他们的成功可以被其他国家所仿效。
en: Moreover, progress should be measured, not only so that policymakers, companies, and health systems can be held accountable, but also so that others can emulate their successes.

zh: 要想达到目的，我们或许需要计算细菌耐药性上升影响的全新指标。
en: To this end, we may need new metrics for calculating the impact of AMR.

zh: 虽然这听上去技术性很强（事实也的确如此 ） ， 但现实情况是最著名的细菌耐药性问题专家认为确定共同指标可以改变各国制定其自身目标的方法，并使我们在未来若干年内能够更好地衡量进步。
en: While this sounds technical (and it is), the reality is that top AMR scientists think that agreeing on common measurements could change the way individual countries set their own targets and improve our capacity to measure progress in the coming years.

zh: 最后，为了防止政治目标和人物变化，我们需要在抗击细菌耐药性上升过程中设置不变的倡导者。
en: Finally, to account for changing political priorities and personalities, we need a constant champion in the fight against AMR.

zh: 比方说，可以指定一名联合国细菌耐药性上升问题特使，负责持续宣传解决问题的重要性以及监督各国完成自己的目标。
en: For example, a UN envoy on AMR could be appointed, to continue making the international case for addressing the issue and to challenge countries to meet their targets.

zh: 没有这样对解决细菌抗药性上升问题一以贯之的提醒，更不要说及时公布进展状况，世界各国就有可能受到其他问题干扰，从而错失这次推进必要改革以阻止耐药菌感染上升的转瞬即逝的机遇。
en: Without such a consistent reminder of the need to tackle AMR, not to mention transparency about progress, the world could become sidetracked and miss the rapidly closing window of opportunity to deliver the changes needed to stop the rise of drug-resistant infections.

zh: 过去几年来，政府、企业和国际组织在应对细菌耐药性上升问题上已经取得了重大进步。
en: Over the last couple of years, governments, industry, and international organizations have made important strides in meeting the AMR threat.

zh: 但现在需要我们做出真正艰难的决策。
en: But the really hard decisions must be taken now.

zh: 如果想要避免细菌耐药性上升这场慢动作车祸，我们的领导人必须立即采取规避行动。
en: If we are to prevent the slow-motion car crash of rising AMR, our leaders must take evasive action now.

zh: 我们知道应该做些什么；现在我们必须身体力行。
en: We know what we have to do; now we must get on with doing it.

zh: 和国际货币基金组织一起解决抗生素耐药性
en: Tackling AMR With the IMF

zh: 伦敦—本月是联合国抗生素耐药性（AMR）高级别会议召开一周年，该联合国会议由英国的独立AMR评估帮助组织。 对我来说，去年的这个时刻令人无比光荣。
en: LONDON – This month is the first anniversary of the United Nations High-Level Meeting on Antimicrobial Resistance, which the United Kingdom’s independent Review on AMR helped to bring about.

zh: 因为我是AMR评估主席，也因为我的团队和英国总医务官萨利·戴维斯（Sally Davies ） 。
en: That moment last year was very gratifying for me, as the chairman of the Review, as well as for my team and the UK’s Chief Medical Officer, Sally Davies.

zh: 去年的高级别会议决议，成员国代表将在两年后再次开会评估进展情况 — — 因此，下一次会议是在2018年9月。
en: Last year’s High-Level Meeting resolved that member-state delegates are to reconvene for a progress assessment after two years – so, in September 2018.

zh: 会议还号召成立一个机构间协调小组，在两年的时间里指导遏制AMR的工作。
en: The meeting also called for the establishment of an Interagency Coordination Group to guide efforts in the fight against AMR during that two-year period.

zh: 小组由我负责召集，由非常有责任心的人士领导。
en: From what I have gathered, the group is being led by deeply committed individuals.

zh: 在更广的范围上，国家和国际层面的决策者也开始将更多注意力集中在AMR的威胁上。
en: And, more broadly, policymakers at the national and international levels have begun to pay more attention to the threat of AMR.

zh: 事实上，联合国高级别会议举行后，G20也做出了崇高的遏制AMR 承诺。
en: In fact, since the UN High-Level Meeting, the G20 has also made notable commitments in the battle against AMR.

zh: 在7月的G20德国汉堡峰会上，各国政府同意成立“研发合作中心 ” ， 着手逐步停止将抗生素应用于农业。 农业生产上使用抗生素促进牲畜生长。
en: At the G20 summit in Hamburg, Germany, in July, governments agreed to establish an “R&D Collaboration Hub,” and to begin to phase out antibiotics in agriculture, where producers use them to promote animal growth.

zh: 英国AMR评估建议增加20亿美元的AMR初期研究经费，因此，建立研发中心的措施非常值得欢迎。
en: The UK Review recommended that an additional $2 billion be earmarked for early-stage research into AMR, so the creation of an R&D hub is very welcome.

zh: 但限制在农业中使用抗生素的协议意义更加重大。
en: But the agreement to limit the use of antibiotics in agriculture was even more significant.

zh: 在过去，G20主要成员国一致拒绝做出这样的承诺。
en: In the past, key G20 member states have resisted such commitments.

zh: 而在作为联合国高级别会议基础的文件中，农业也没有提及，原因是担心因此导致最终协议胎死腹中。
en: And in the texts that served as a foundation for the UN High-Level Meeting, agriculture wasn’t even mentioned, owing to fear that it would render any eventual agreement dead on arrival.

zh: 联合国和G20所迈出的步伐令人鼓舞。
en: The steps that the UN and the G20 have taken are encouraging.

zh: 但遏制AMR的斗争远远没有结束，反而可能才刚刚开始。
en: But the fight against AMR is hardly over, and has probably only just begun.

zh: 放眼未来，最大的挑战之一在于个体国家和多边组织，比如联合国自身。
en: Looking forward, one of the biggest challenges will be holding to account individual countries and multilateral organizations, such as the UN itself.

zh: 我们如何确定政府和机构会兑现自己的豪言壮语？
en: How will we confirm that governments and institutions have followed through on their lofty declarations?

zh: 首先，我们可以着眼于经济学和公共卫生的交叉互动。
en: For starters, we can look at the intersection of economics and public health.

zh: 国际机构有很多方式可以撬动经济政策杠杆，大大降低传染病暴发的概率，提高脆弱国家对这一风险的抵抗力。
en: There are many ways that international institutions can use economic-policy levers to reduce significantly the probability of infectious-disease outbreaks, and to increase vulnerable countries’ resilience to such risks.

zh: 在我看来，国际货币基金组织（IMF）应该起到领导作用。
en: To my mind, the International Monetary Fund should take the lead.

zh: 彼得·桑兹（Peter Sands）和他的同事们在2016年5月的《柳叶刀》杂志上所发表的研究表明，传染病爆发会造成巨大的经济成本，但它们很少甚至没有作为评估宏观经济风险的因素被考虑到。
en: As Peter Sands and his colleagues show in a May 2016 study in The Lancet, infectious-disease outbreaks have far-reaching economic costs, and yet they are rarely, if ever, factored into assessments of macroeconomic risk.

zh: IMF已经有了针对各国经济健康的定期评估，金融市场分析对此非常重视。
en: The IMF already conducts regular reviews of countries’ economic health, and financial markets give significant weight to its analyses.

zh: 为了经济健康，也为了公共卫生，IMF同样可以在追踪各国AMR进展方面做出出色表现。
en: For the sake of economic as well as public health, the Fund would do well to start tracking countries’ progress in the fight against AMR as well.

zh: 十年多前，欧盟便已经宣布将禁止将抗生素用于促进牲畜生长。
en: The European Union declared more than ten years ago that it would fully phase out the use of antibiotics for animal growth promotion.

zh: 但除了偶尔有调查记者关注此事，还有谁真正深入到各成员国，调查这一目标的进展情况？
en: But who, other than the occasional investigative journalist, has ever actually delved into EU member states’ progress toward that goal?

zh: 在英国，我的AMR评估同僚和我们的建议所引起的政府反应引线深刻，特别是在减少抗生素处方、防止住院传染和将农业中的抗生素用量限制在50毫克/千克牲畜水平方面。
en: In the UK, my Review colleagues and I were quite impressed by the government’s formal policy response to our recommendations, especially with respect to reducing antibiotic prescriptions, preventing hospital-acquired infections, and limiting the use of antibiotics in farming to 50 milligrams per kilogram of livestock.

zh: 在过去的一年中，我在一些积极研究AMR威胁问题的英国大学发表公开演讲。
en: Over the past year, I have given public talks at some of the British universities that are actively working on the AMR threat.

zh: 们鼓励我比过去更多地去会见一些该问题的学术研究者。
en: I have been encouraged to see more academic researchers pursuing this topic than in the past.

zh: 但通过提问听众，我意识到很少有人了解政府的政策反应。
en: But when I have quizzed my audiences, I have come to realize that hardly anyone knows about the government’s policy response.

zh: 这可能只是因为我的听众们不了解情况；但我对此有所怀疑。
en: This could mean that my audiences are simply uninformed; but I doubt that.

zh: 更有可能的情况是政府没有兑现它的承诺。
en: What is more likely is that the government has not yet followed through on its commitments.

zh: IMF是非常理想的解决问题者，它可以将该问题列为其常规经济评估的一部分。
en: The IMF is ideally suited to get to the bottom of this question as a part of its routine economic assessments.

zh: 它的经济分析对于不太富裕的国家价值更高，在这些国家，防止传染病暴发可以对长期经济增长起到直接提振作用。
en: And its analyses would be even more valuable to less wealthy countries, where preventing outbreaks of infectious diseases could directly boost long-term economic growth.

zh: 在联合国高级别会议迎来一周年之际，我的最后一项担忧是决策者仍然没有批准旨在鼓励开发新药和新诊断方法的市场进入奖励经费。
en: One last concern that I have on this first anniversary of the UN High-Level Meeting is that policymakers still need to agree on a source of funding for the market-entry rewards intended to encourage the development of new drugs and diagnostics.

zh: 这些创新将是防止和发现AMR的关键，而刺激这些创新的激励机制正日益被视为正确的方法。
en: Such innovations will be crucial for preventing and detecting AMR, and an incentive mechanism to stimulate them is increasingly regarded as the right way to go.

zh: 在这方面，IMF也能够提供非常宝贵的建议。
en: That, too, is a topic on which the IMF could provide invaluable advice.

zh: 医学的社会科学
en: The Social Science of Medicine

zh: 达沃斯—20实际80年代，当我还是一位医科学生时，我在新几内亚的巴布亚（Papua）得了疟疾。
en: DAVOS – When I was a medical student in the mid-1980s, I contracted malaria in Papua New Guinea. It was a miserable experience.

zh: 这是一段可怕的体验。
en: My head ached.

zh: 我头痛发烧，并出现贫血。
en: My temperature soared. I became anemic.

zh: 但我吃了药，并好了起来。
en: But I took my medicine, and I got better.

zh: 这不是一段愉快的体验，但感谢高效廉价的疟疾药，我从未陷入险境。
en: The experience wasn’t pleasant, but thanks to cheap, effective malaria drugs I was never in very much danger.

zh: 这些把我治愈的药片 — — 氯喹如今已不再有用。
en: The pills that cured me, chloroquine tablets, do not work anymore.

zh: 即使在我服用它们的时候，世界许多地区的导致疟疾的寄生虫已经拥有了氯喹抗药性。 巴布亚新几内亚是这些药片还能管用的最后几个地方之一，而即使在那里，氯喹的药效也是每况愈下。
en: Even at the time I was taking them, the parasite that causes malaria had already become resistant to chloroquine in many parts of the world; Papua New Guinea was one of the last places where the pills continued to be effective, and even there they were losing their potency.

zh: 如今，氯喹已经基本从我们的药品清单中消失。
en: Today, chloroquine has basically disappeared from our medical arsenal.

zh: 病原体对抗生素和其他抗菌药的抗药性越来越强，这正在成为当代医疗的最大危机 — — 而这一危机无法单靠科学解决。
en: The growing capacity of pathogens to resist antibiotics and other antimicrobial drugs is turning into the greatest emerging crisis in contemporary health care – and it is a crisis that cannot be solved by science alone.

zh: 其他药品正在步氯喹的后尘。
en: Other pharmaceuticals are following in chloroquine’s wake.

zh: 结核菌、大肠杆菌、和沙门氏菌的多抗药性菌株已经司空见惯。
en: Multi-drug-resistant strains of tuberculosis, E. coli, and salmonella are now commonplace.

zh: 大部分淋病是不可治愈的。
en: Most gonorrhea infections are untreatable.

zh: 超级病菌，如具有甲氧西林抗药性的金黄葡萄球菌（MRSA）和艰难梭菌，正在迅速繁衍。
en: Superbugs, like methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and Clostridium difficile, are proliferating.

zh: 在印度，2013年因抗生素无效的传染病而令58,000 新生儿死亡。
en: In India, antibiotic-resistant infections killed more than 58,000 newborns in 2013.

zh: 如今，疟疾往往通过青蒿素（一种中国药草总提炼的药物）和其他抗疟疾药物一起使用治疗。
en: Today, malaria is often treated with a combination of artemisinin – a drug derived from a Chinese herb – and other antimalarial drugs.

zh: 但这些革命性药品极有可能步氯喹的后尘成为明日黄花；抗药疟疾菌株已经在东南亚进入记录。
en: But these revolutionary medicines are now in danger of following chloroquine into obsolescence; resistant strains of malaria have been documented in Southeast Asia.

zh: 这不仅仅是一个医学问题；这是一场潜在的经济灾难。
en: This is more than a medical problem; it is a potential economic disaster.

zh: 以经济学家奥尼尔（Jim O’Neil）牵头进行的抗生素抗药性研究（Review on Antimicrobial Resistance）指出，如果当前趋势持续，抗药性传染病将在2050年夺走1 000万人的生命，在未来35年中给全球经济带来100多万亿美元的损失。
en: Research commissioned by the Review on Antimicrobial Resistance, headed by the economist Jim O’Neill, has calculated that if current trends continue, drug-resistant infections will kill ten million people a year by 2050 and cost the global economy some $100 trillion over the next 35 years.

zh: 甚至如此严重的预测也有可能大大低估了情况，因为它只包括了用传染病所造成的生命和福祉衡量的直接损失。
en: Even that dramatic prediction may be a substantial underestimate, as it includes only the direct costs in terms of lives and wellbeing lost to infections. Many other aspects of modern medicine also rely on antibiotics.

zh: 接受化疗的癌症患者是为了用它们抑制非如此就会摧毁他们羸弱的免疫系统的细菌。
en: Cancer patients receiving chemotherapy take them to suppress bacteria that would otherwise overwhelm their weakened immune systems.

zh: 许多如今被视为常规手段的外科收入，包括人工关节和剖腹产，只有在抗生素能够预防偶发感染的情况下才能实施。
en: Many surgical operations now considered routine, including joint replacements and Caesarean sections, can be performed safely only when antibiotics prevent opportunistic infections.

zh: 抗药性的源头在早已是众所周知的进化论。
en: The origins of drug resistance are a well-understood matter of evolution.

zh: 如果病原体被暴露在有选择的毒性药物的压力之下，最终它们会适应这种药物。
en: If pathogens are exposed to the selective pressure of toxic drugs, eventually they will adapt.

zh: 由我担任总裁的惠康基金会（Wellcome Trust）投资了数亿美元用于研究这些机制、改善诊断和创造新药。
en: The Wellcome Trust, which I lead, has invested hundreds of millions of dollars into researching these mechanisms, improving diagnoses, and creating new drugs.

zh: 为了有效解决问题，这一努力必须扩大到科学领域之外，进入与传统上与医学并不相关的领域。
en: In order to address the problem effectively, this effort must be extended beyond the realm of biological science to areas not traditionally associated with medicine.

zh: 不论是富国还是穷国，我们都在系统性滥用抗生素。
en: In rich and poor countries alike, we have become systematic abusers of antibiotics.

zh: 对付抗药性的关键在于拖延病原体的适应。
en: The key to combating resistance is to delay the rate at which the pathogens can adapt.

zh: 但是，由于过多地开出抗生素处方盒无法完成必要的疗程，我们正在让细菌获得恰好能鼓励抗药性的药量。
en: But, by overprescribing antibiotics and failing to complete the required courses of treatment, we are exposing germs to just enough medicine to encourage resistance.

zh: 因此，我们实际上在帮助细菌接种，形成对我们希望用来对付它们的药物的免疫力。
en: In effect, we are vaccinating germs against the drugs we want to use against them.

zh: 这是因为我们一直几乎完全把抗生素看成是一种消费品 — — 我们要求医生给我们开出处方，并在我们感到合适的时候停药。
en: That is because we have come to regard antibiotics almost as consumer goods – ours to demand from doctors, and ours to take or stop taking as we see fit.

zh: 即使是最了解情况的患者也会无用这些出色的药物。
en: Even the most informed patients misuse these wonder drugs.

zh: 英国的研究发现，哪怕是知道抗药性如何发展的人，也常常会在没有处方的情况下服用抗生素或把自己的药给家庭成员，从而加剧了抗药性问题。
en: Research in the United Kingdom has found that even people who understand how resistance develops often contribute to the problem by taking antibiotics without a prescription or giving their drugs to members of their family.

zh: 改变这一破坏性行为需要我们更好地理解其背后的社会和文化因素。
en: Changing such destructive behavior will require that we better understand the social and cultural factors that drive it.

zh: 历史学、心理学、社会学、人类学、经济学、市场研究和社会营销等学科都能有所助益。
en: Disciplines like history, psychology, sociology, anthropology, economics, market research, and social marketing can help.

zh: 不仅抗生素抗压性问题是如此。
en: This is true not only for antimicrobial resistance.

zh: 埃博拉疫情等疫情的爆发也是如此。
en: It also applies to outbreaks like the Ebola epidemic.

zh: 与病毒抗争需要我们理解病毒的生物学、其传播的传染病学，以及可能使用哪些药物和疫苗来对付它。
en: Combating the virus requires knowledge about its biology, the epidemiology of its transmission, and the drugs and vaccines that could potentially be deployed against it.

zh: 但这也需要理解让传染病在利比里亚、塞拉利昂和几内亚肆虐的行为因素。
en: But it also requires an understanding of the behaviors that have allowed infection to spread in Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Guinea.

zh: 解释这些社会为何如此脆弱需要了解地区的最近历史和明白为何那里的人对公共当局极不信任。
en: Explaining what made these societies so vulnerable requires learning about the region’s recent history and understanding why people there are deeply distrustful of public authorities.

zh: 患者隔离和死者安全下葬时遏制埃博拉的关键，但这两项措施的实施都需要顾及文化敏感性 — — 而不仅仅是它们背后的科学解释。
en: Isolation of patients and safe burial of the dead are crucial to containing Ebola, but both need to be introduced with cultural sensitivity – not just explanations of the science behind them.

zh: 今天的公共卫生大威胁具有深远的经济影响。
en: Today’s great public-health threats have profound economic consequences.

zh: 实现它们所造成的风险的最小化需要认识到它们与社会、行为和文化因素互动。
en: Minimizing the risks they pose requires recognizing that they are intertwined with the social, behavioral, and cultural landscape.

zh: 科学提供了强大的工具。
en: Science provides powerful tools.

zh: 但我们需要比科学更多的东西才能有效使用这些工具。
en: But we need more than science to use these tools effectively.

zh: 抗菌素耐药性评估之战中我们现状如何?
en: Where Are We in the Fight Against AMR?

zh: 伦敦 — — 为纪念英国政府抗菌素耐药性评估小组（AMR）成立两周年（我曾有幸担任评估小组的负责职务 ） ， 我和评估小组的另外两位成员安东尼·麦克唐纳和威尔·霍尔共同出版了一本名叫《超级细菌：抗菌斗争的一场军备竞赛》的新书。
en: LONDON – To mark the second anniversary of the British government’s Review on Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR), which I had the honor of chairing, two members of the Review team – Anthony McDonnell and Will Hall – and I have published a new book: Superbugs: An Arms Race Against Bacteria.

zh: 在这本书中，我们探讨了评估小组推荐的十大干预举措 — — 我将这些举措称之为“十诫 ” — —同时还考量了迄今为止所取得的进展，以及仍需完成哪些工作。
en: In it, we discuss the Review’s ten recommended interventions – what I call the Ten Commandments – while considering the progress made so far, and the work that still needs to be done.

zh: 新书的开篇部分详细阐述了我们对细菌和耐药性的理解，并指出有证据表明耐药性的发展现在可能比我们预想的要快得多。
en: The first part of the book provides a detailed history of our understanding of bacteria and drug resistance, and points to evidence that drug resistance may now be rising faster than we had assumed.

zh: 例如，被普遍视为其他抗菌素失效后最后一种可用抗生素的粘菌素，由于在动物饲养中的过度使用，特别是在中国，现在正在快速失效。
en: For example, colistin, which is generally regarded as one of the last usable antibiotics in humans after others have failed, is losing its effectiveness, owing to overuse in animal farming, notably in China.

zh: 同样令人不安的是，我们越来越频繁地看到关于耐药淋病菌株的报道。
en: And, equally disturbing, reports of drug-resistant strains of gonorrhea are becoming more frequent.

zh: 在评估报告中，我们预测如果任由目前趋势持续下去，到2050年每年可能有1，000万人死亡，从2015年算起给全球经济产出共造成约100万亿美元的损失。
en: In the Review, we predicted that if current trends continue, ten million people could die every year by 2050, at a loss of some $100 trillion in global economic output since 2015.

zh: 但现在有理由担心情况可能会变的更糟。
en: But now there is reason to fear that the situation could turn out even worse.

zh: 为了避免这种情况出现，本书的第二部分着重探讨解决方案，并汇集了我们采访的评估小组许多专家的看法。
en: To ensure that it does not, the second part of the book focuses on solutions, and compiles expert viewpoints from many of those we interviewed for the Review.

zh: 我们所推荐的三项“供给侧”干预措施中有两项已经取得了进展，这一点是积极的。
en: On a positive note, there has been progress on two of the three “supply” interventions that we recommended.

zh: 首先，早期研发资金正在增加。
en: First, financing for early-stage research and development is growing.

zh: 就在不久前， 英中两国政府、威康信托基金、美国生物医学高级研究与发展管理局（BARDA）以及丹麦制药企业诺和诺德联合成立了新的资助计划。
en: Just recently, new joint funding initiatives were launched by the British and Chinese governments, the Wellcome Trust, the United States’ Biomedical Advanced Research and Development Authority (BARDA), and the Danish pharmaceutical company Novo.

zh: 如果这样的支持力度能够维持下去，那么评估小组建议的在未来五年内再增加20亿美元的研发经费就是可行的。
en: If this support is sustained, the Review’s recommendation of $2 billion in additional R&D funding over the next five years will be within reach.

zh: 其次，专注抗菌素耐药性研究的研究人员数量似乎正在增加。
en: Second, the number of researchers working on AMR seems to be growing.

zh: 事实上，我总喜欢开玩笑说在英格兰北部，抗菌素耐药性评估研究中心现在可能比按照政府的北方动力计划同意交易权下放的城市还要多。
en: In fact, I like to joke that in Northern England, AMR research centers probably now outnumber the cities that have agreed to devolution deals under the government’s northern powerhouse plan.

zh: 上述两个地区所取得的进展让我期待其他地区也能取得类似的进展。
en: The progress made in these two areas gives me hope that similar advances can be made elsewhere.

zh: 但取得进一步进展需要政府和行业领袖少空谈、多行动。
en: But further progress will require less talk and more action from government and industry leaders.

zh: 制药业尤其如此 — — 这是我们所提出的第三条供给侧干预措施所针对的目标。
en: That is especially true of the pharmaceutical industry – the target of the third “supply” intervention we proposed.

zh: 制药业不能仅关注短期利润，而必须进一步加大研发投资并生产新的治疗药物。
en: Rather than focusing solely on short-term profit margins, the industry must invest more in R&D and the production of new treatments.

zh: 据我所知，全球前25家最大制药企业的代表在今年达沃斯世界经济论坛年会即将举行之际见面讨论抗菌素耐药性评估，并同意就此问题保持进一步接触。
en: Representatives of the 25 largest pharmaceutical firms, I am told, met on the fringes of the World Economic Forum’s annual meeting in Davos this year to discuss AMR, agreeing to remain engaged on the issue.

zh: 换句话讲，他们同意什么都不做。
en: In other words, they agreed to keep doing nothing.

zh: 制药业总是高谈阔论却不采取任何具体行动正变得越来越令人沮丧。
en: The industry’s failure to back earnest rhetoric with concrete actions is becoming increasingly frustrating.

zh: 这25家最大药企可以轻而易举地说服主要政府就评估小组建议的市场进入奖励采取行动。
en: The largest 25 firms could easily persuade key governments to act on the Review’s recommendation for a market-entry reward.

zh: 只要设立10亿美元或金额更高的抗菌素耐药性新疗法奖金，就能促成更多企业开始研发行动。
en: With a prize of $1 billion or more for the development of new treatments to combat AMR, far more firms would start to pursue their own R&D.

zh: 这也表明政府需要进一步采取行动。
en: That points to the need for governments to do more as well.

zh: 在评估小组的努力下，抗菌素耐药性评估最终在2016年中国杭州举行的全球峰会和去年德国汉堡召开的峰会上被纳入20国集团议程。
en: Following the Review, AMR was finally put on the G20’s agenda, both at the 2016 summit in Hangzhou, China, and at last year’s summit in Hamburg, Germany.

zh: 今年的20国集团峰会将在阿根廷的布宜诺斯艾利斯举行，我们只能希望世界领袖开始兑现过去几年的承诺，尤其是设立市场进入奖。
en: This year, the G20 summit will take place in Buenos Aires, Argentina, and one can only hope that world leaders will start to act on the statements of the past few years, not least by piloting a market-entry reward.

zh: 因为有助于推动评估小组六项“减少需求”的干预性举措，包括研发新疫苗和改善诊断方法，设立市场进入奖至关重要。
en: A market-entry reward is crucial because it would also help to advance two of the Review’s six “demand-reducing” interventions: the development of new vaccines and improved diagnostics.

zh: 两年前，我们曾要求西方国家到2020年开始规定针对所有抗菌素类药物处方进行快速诊断检测。
en: Two years ago, we pressed Western countries to start requiring rapid diagnostic tests as a prerequisite for all antibiotic prescriptions by 2020.

zh: 结果没有哪个政府欢迎这样的想法，这并没有什么可大惊小怪的。
en: Not surprisingly, no government welcomed this idea.

zh: 但除非医疗系统更好地推行有效的诊断方法，我们就无法减少不必要的抗生素使用并确保为真正有需求的患者提供有效的治疗。
en: But, unless effective diagnostics become more embedded in health-care systems, we will not be able to reduce unnecessary antibiotic usage and ensure effective treatments for patients with a genuine need.

zh: 因此，诊断方法的创新也应当被纳入市场进入奖的范畴。
en: So, market-entry rewards should be extended to innovations in diagnostics, too.

zh: 提高公众意识、改善卫生条件、改进监管方式等其余四诫也取得了某些进展，并大幅降低了农业抗生素的使用 — — 但这还远远不够。
en: There has been some progress on the remaining four Commandments – greater public awareness, improved sanitation, improved surveillance, and dramatically reduced usage of antibiotics in agriculture – but not enough.

zh: 世界银行、世界卫生组织和国际货币基金组织需要对那些没有投资本国医疗系统的国家进行曝光 。
en: The World Bank, the World Health Organization, and the International Monetary Fund need to shine a brighter spotlight on countries that are not investing in their health systems.

zh: 联合国需要贯彻在2016年9月召开的抗菌素耐药性高级别会议上所提出的目标。
en: And the United Nations needs to follow through on commitments made at the high-level meeting on AMR in September 2016.

zh: 这意味着要采取措施加强监管并监督规则遵守状况，并敦促联合国193个成员国落实于2015年达成一致的“同一健康”国家行动计划。
en: That means taking steps to improve surveillance and compliance, and pressing the UN’s 193 member states to implement the “One Health” national action plans agreed to in 2015.

zh: 具体到农业领域，某些主要西方食品生产及分销商已经明确表示可能制定本企业的抗菌素耐药性评估行动计划。
en: With respect to agriculture, some major Western food producers and distributors have indicated that they may develop their own AMR action plans.

zh: 为此，他们均应同意开始使用颜色代码来标注其肉类及鱼类产品，明确在生产过程中所使用的抗生素；而且他们应当拒绝对任何使用粘菌素的产品进行采购或销售。
en: To that end, they should all agree to start labeling their meat and fish products with color codes denoting the amount of antibiotics that went into their production; and they should refuse to buy or sell any products that have used colistin.

zh: 战胜抗菌素耐药性威胁是完全可能的。
en: Overcoming the AMR threat is entirely feasible.

zh: 但直面挑战需要我们将言辞转化为行动。
en: But confronting it will require us to turn words into action.

zh: 只要现在迈出舒适地带，我们就可以避免在今后出现更糟糕的状况。
en: By getting out of our comfort zones now, we can avoid far worse discomfort down the road.

zh: 与科学精神相悖的种子条约
en: The Anti-Science Seed Treaty

zh: 斯坦福 — — 今年9月，美国批准了粮食和农业植物遗传资源国际条约，该条约亦称国际种子条约。
en: STANFORD – In September, the United States ratified the International Treaty on Plant Genetic Resources for Food and Agriculture, known as the International Seed Treaty.

zh: 像联合国主持制定的许多国际协议一样，这份协议存在严重的问题。
en: Like so many international agreements crafted under the auspices of the United Nations, it is severely flawed.

zh: 事实上，这份种子条约可以说是一份政治正确、但却违背技术规律的失败的条约。
en: Indeed, the Seed Treaty is a politically correct, anti-technology fiasco.

zh: 可以肯定，这份于2004年签订的条约其本意值得赞誉。
en: To be sure, the treaty, which entered into force in 2004, emanates from some laudable intentions.

zh: 但它却最终沦为一堆空头支票式的希望，并转化为对国家间遗传资源（以种子为主）交换的苛刻的法律束缚。
en: But it is ultimately a jumble of pie-in-the-sky aspirations, translated into draconian legal constraints on the exchange of genetic resources (mainly seeds) among countries.

zh: 条约目标的正式声明体现了条约的非现实性 ： “ 保护并可持续利用所有粮食和农业植物遗传资源，公正和平等地享有相关应用所产生的收益，遵守生物多样性公约，并实现农业和粮食安全的长期持续。 ”
en: The unreality of the treaty’s goals comes through in the official statement of its objectives: “the conservation and sustainable use of all plant genetic resources for food and agriculture and the fair and equitable sharing of the benefits arising out of their use, in harmony with the Convention on Biological Diversity, for sustainable agriculture and food security.”

zh: 总之，条约的指导原则是遗传资源是属于成员国（即政府）的“主权权利 ” 。
en: The guiding principle of the Seed Treaty is that genetic resources fall within the “sovereign right” of member states (that is, governments).

zh: 这相当于明确否认动植物资源是“人类共同遗产”的长期解释。
en: This amounts to an explicit rejection of the long-standing understanding that genetic resources in plants and animals are the “common heritage of humanity.”

zh: 它违反了被公认为对全人类有益的某些全球资源不应���个人、国家、企业或其他实体所单方面开发和垄断的理念，过去的认知是这些资源应当以有利于全人类的方式来进行管理。
en: It defies the notion that certain global resources, regarded as beneficial to all, should not be unilaterally exploited and monopolized by individuals, states, corporations, or other entities, but rather should be managed in ways that benefit all of humanity.

zh: 种子条约背后的动因是恐惧“生物剽窃 ” — —即农业种子公司偷盗世界遗传资源，然后要求对其申请专利并行使垄断控制。
en: The Seed Treaty was motivated by fear of “biopiracy” – the pilfering of the world’s genetic resources by agricultural seed companies, which could then claim patents on them and wield monopoly control.

zh: 但尽管指控生物剽窃可能符合某些人的情感诉求，但公正的分析显示这样的做法不具备事实基础。
en: But, though accusations of biopiracy may have emotional appeal, impartial analyses have shown that they have little factual basis.

zh: 事实上，生物剽窃行为十分罕见 — — 因为罕见所以可以直接处理。
en: In fact, biopiracy is rare – so rare that it can be dealt with directly.

zh: 相反，世界却创造了一套复杂、官僚和政治化的制度系统，对科学研究、植物育种和知识产权创造进行全方位限制。
en: Instead, the world created a baroque, bureaucratic, politicized system that systematically inhibits scientific research, plant breeding, and the creation of intellectual property.

zh: 种子条约通过制定限制进入农业遗传资源谈判清单的多边体系来实现这一目的。
en: The Seed Treaty achieves this by establishing a multilateral system for access to a negotiated list of agricultural genetic resources.

zh: 种子条约缔约国及秘书处还控制着组成国际农业研究磋商小组（CGIAR）的15家研究机构，上述研究合作机制具有全球影响力。
en: The Seed Treaty also brought under the control of its parties and secretariat the 15 research institutions that comprise the Consultative Group of International Agricultural Research (CGIAR), an influential global research partnership.

zh: 如果某国批准种子条约，相当于同意其本国种子库 — — 如美国科罗拉多州科林斯堡种子库 — — 将遵守与国际农业研究磋商小组相同的规则。
en: When a country ratifies the Seed Treaty, it agrees that its own seed banks – in the US, the repository at Fort Collins, Colorado – will adhere to the same rules as the CGIAR centers.

zh: 而相同规则却带不来太多帮助。
en: But common rules are little help.

zh: 不幸的是，由于种子条约，各国对待本国的基因资源越来越像狗对待骨头：即使在本国科学家和植物育种人员之间也不许分享，而过去十二年来绝大多数国际基因资源交换一直处于停滞状态。
en: Unfortunately, as a result of the Seed Treaty, countries increasingly treat their genetic resources like a dog treats a bone: no sharing allowed, even among their own scientists and plant breeders, while most international exchanges of genetic resources have been shut down over the last 12 years.

zh: 各国际农业研究磋商小组中心可以继续交换遗传资源，但现在总体过程比种子条约生效前要复杂和苛刻得多。
en: The CGIAR centers have been able to continue exchanges of genetic resources, but the process is now much more complicated and demanding that it was before the Seed Treaty came into force.

zh: 种子条约实施对美国的确切影响很难精确估计，尤其因为条约包含了掩盖其含义和规则的空泛、含混的措辞。
en: For the US, the precise impact of the Seed Treaty’s implementation is difficult to determine, not least because the treaty contains wishy-washy, ambiguous phrasing that obscures its meaning and requirements.

zh: 显而易见的是，执行条约的国家取得的经验并不十分积极，除非它们高度容忍那些以崇高目标为名压制创新和发展的官僚监管制度。
en: What is clear is that the experience of countries that have implemented the treaty has not been particularly positive, unless those countries have a high tolerance for bureaucratic regulatory regimes that stifle innovation and development in the name of lofty aspirations.

zh: 种子条约与反资本主义、反科学、反革新的生物多样性公约（CBD）如出一辙。
en: The Seed Treaty is cut from the same anti-capitalist, anti-science, anti-innovation cloth as the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).

zh: 它还令人联想到明目张胆反科学、反遗传工程的生物多样性公约卡塔赫纳生态安全议定书。
en: It also mirrors the flagrantly unscientific, anti-genetic-engineering Cartagena Protocol on Biosafety to the CBD.

zh: 此外它与另外一项反遗传工程样板名古屋-吉隆坡关于卡塔赫纳议定书的赔偿责任和补充协议有很多共同之处，该协议除了恐吓潜在创业者远离农业生物技术外几乎起不到其他任何作用。
en: And it has much in common with the Nagoya-Kuala Lumpur Supplementary Protocol on Liability and Redress to the Cartagena Protocol – yet another anti-genetic-engineering screed, which accomplishes little except to frighten potential entrepreneurs away from agricultural biotechnology.

zh: 协议规定过度、复杂、混乱 — — 简言之，协议无益于可能为世界穷人带来好处的创新活动。
en: It is overwrought, confusing, and complex – in short, inimical to innovations that could benefit the world’s poor.

zh: 种子条约违背了科学、农业发展和知识产权精神。
en: The Seed Treaty runs counter to science, agricultural development, and intellectual property rights.

zh: 这相当于在决策领域打出一记三振出局的臭球。
en: That, in the policymaking game, is three strikes – and should be an out.

zh: 批准种子条约的美国参议院应当重新思考，因为条约第32条恰恰有这样的规定。
en: The US Senate, which ratified the Seed Treaty, should reconsider, as Article 32 of the treaty allows.

zh: 此后，美国国务院应当通知条约秘书处，并将在一年后实现正式退出。
en: Thereafter, the US State Department would notify the treaty’s secretariat, with official withdrawal taking effect a year later.

zh: 交易艺术一书的作者、当选总统唐纳德·特朗普已经向美国人承诺他将撤销不明智的决策。
en: President-elect Donald Trump, author of The Art of the Deal, has promised Americans that he will put an end to bad ones.

zh: 从退出种子条约开始兑现承诺将是一个不错的选择。
en: Withdrawal from the Seed Treaty would be an auspicious start to making good on that pledge.

zh: 再次捍卫犹太人
en: In Defense of the Jews, Again

zh: 马德里 — — 尽管法国各地大规模团结集会给人留下了相反的印象，但最近针对讽刺杂志《查理周刊》的袭击并不意味着西欧的言论自由正面临任何严重威胁。
en: MADRID – Despite the impression given by massive unity rallies throughout France, the recent attack on the satirical magazine Charlie Hebdo does not mean that freedom of expression is under any serious threat in Western Europe.

zh: 恐怖袭击也不意味着伊斯兰激进主义即将以某种方式吞噬或改变西方社会。
en: Nor does it indicate that Islamic radicalism is somehow about to engulf or transform Western societies.

zh: 这次事件真正凸显的是一种不为人知的威胁：那就是针对欧洲犹太人的歧视和暴力正在死灰复燃。
en: The threat that it does highlight is a less publicized one: the resurgence of discrimination and violence against Europe’s Jews.

zh: 《查理周刊》是19世纪法国讽刺宗教政治人物的低俗野蛮传统所遗留的最后一点痕迹 — — 完全可以被看成言论自由的理想符号。
en: Charlie Hebdo – the last vestige of a bawdy and somewhat savage nineteenth-century French tradition of outrageous caricature of religious and political figures – may well be an ideal icon of free expression.

zh: 欧洲人群起捍卫一项重要的原则；无论言论自由是多么可恶，但仍在任何民主国家占有一席之地。
en: Europeans rose to defend a vital principle; free speech, however vicious, retains a place in any democracy.

zh: 同样，尼罗河儿女所谓的西方难逃被伊斯兰兼并厄运的 “欧拉伯”预言根本就没有成为现实。
en: Likewise, “Eurabia,” Bat Ye’Or’s prophecy of Islamic doom for the West, simply is not emerging.

zh: 没有任何伊斯兰政党在欧洲议会占据席位；举足轻重的穆斯林人物在欧洲主要文化和政治权力中心发挥作用的少之又少；几乎没有任何阿拉伯人和穆斯林进入到欧盟机构当中。
en: No Islamic parties hold seats in European parliaments; few leading Muslim figures feature in Europe’s major centers of cultural and political power; and European Union institutions are practically bereft of Arabs and Muslims.

zh: 极端分子招募引诱年轻欧洲穆斯林并没有反映出伊斯兰主义者 — — 甚至是伊斯兰影响力在欧洲的传播势不可挡。
en: Efforts by radicals to recruit and indoctrinate young European Muslims do not reflect the inexorable rise of Islamist – or even Islamic – influence in Europe.

zh: 相反，它体现出极端分子疯狂地妄图影响欧洲地区，生活在这里的绝大多数穆斯林都渴望融入而非挑战现有秩序。
en: Rather, they highlight the radicals’ desperation to influence a region where the overwhelming majority of Muslims aspire to integrate into, rather than challenge, the established order.

zh: 欧洲真正受到威胁的是犹太人群体。
en: What is truly under threat in Europe is its Jewish community.

zh: 2006年，法国犹太人宜兰·哈里米被人绑架到地窖并残酷折磨了三个星期，导致其最终丧生的惨剧。
en: In 2006, the French Jew Ilan Halimi was kidnapped and brutally tortured in a cellar for three weeks, resulting in his death.

zh: 2012年，三名犹太学生和一位犹太教士在图卢兹被枪杀。
en: In 2012, three Jewish schoolchildren and a rabbi were gunned down in Toulouse.

zh: 还有去年4月，一对犹太情侣在巴黎郊区被劫，原因是袭击者认为“犹太人一定非常有钱 ” （ 但这并不能解释他们为什么之后强奸了那名妇女 ） 。
en: And last April, a Jewish couple in a Parisian suburb were robbed, because, as the attackers put it, “Jews must have money” (though that did not explain why they then raped the woman).

zh: 一个月后，一名法国圣战分子袭击了布鲁塞尔犹太博物馆，造成3人死亡、1人重伤的惨剧。
en: A month later, a French jihadist attacked the Jewish museum in Brussels, leaving three dead and one critically wounded.

zh: 几个月后，巴黎一间犹太教堂遭到了暴徒袭击。
en: A few months after that, a mob assaulted a synagogue in Paris.

zh: 上述事件所引发的公愤远没有最近几周那样强烈。
en: None of these events sparked anything remotely resembling the public outrage of recent weeks.

zh: 假设巴黎犹太超市四名犹太人遇害事件（假定肇事者就是被捕之前的《查理周刊》恐怖袭击团伙）发生在其他情况下，我们可以认定它不会引发捍卫法兰西共和国价值观的大规模运动。
en: Had the murder of four Jews at a kosher supermarket in Paris, carried out by a confederate of the Charlie Hebdo attackers prior to their capture, occurred in other circumstances, one can assume that it would not have fueled a widespread movement to defend the values of the French Republic.

zh: 有人认为巴勒斯坦困境是造成欧洲反犹暴力大幅增长的主要动机。
en: Some argue that the surge in anti-Semitic violence in Europe is motivated primarily by the plight of the Palestinians.

zh: 但是，2012年民意调查显示，更多欧洲人认为长久以来的反犹而非反以情绪助长了针对犹太人的暴力行为。
en: But, according to a 2012 poll, more Europeans believe that violence against Jews is fueled by long-standing anti-Semitic attitudes, rather than anti-Israel sentiment.

zh: 激进伊斯兰教早在犹太复国运动前就一直在宣扬仇犹主义，而且即使在巴勒斯坦建国以后这种活动也不会停止。
en: Radical Islam propagated hatred for Jews long before Zionism, and it will continue to do so after the creation of a Palestinian state.

zh: 有鉴于此，伊斯兰极端主义越来越高调（通过吸引欧洲和其他地方穆斯林男青年的注意力）导致针对犹太人的暴力活动愈演愈烈并没有什么值得稀奇。
en: Given this, it is not surprising that the increasing visibility of Islamist extremism has, by capturing the attention of frustrated young Muslim men in Europe and elsewhere, spurred increased violence against Jews.

zh: 但深层次问题无法解决给犹太人留下的印象是他们在欧洲没有未来。
en: But the problem runs deeper, giving Jews the impression that they have no future in Europe.

zh: 最近一次YouGov调查发现很大一部分英法民众抱有反犹主义观点。
en: A recent YouGov poll found that a substantial share of the French and British populations hold anti-Semitic views.

zh: 由华沙大学偏见研究中心进行的另外一次调查显示在2013年，大约63%的波兰人相信犹太人合谋控制银行体系和全球媒体。
en: Another poll, conducted by the Center for Research on Prejudice at Warsaw University, showed that, in 2013, some 63% of Poles believed Jews conspire to control the banking system and the world media.

zh: 这个问题不仅对犹太人、而且对整个欧洲造成了严重的影响。
en: This has serious implications not just for Jews, but for Europe as a whole.

zh: 正如汉娜·阿伦特六十年前曾经指出的那样，反犹主义兴起推动欧洲陷入极权主义。
en: As Hannah Arendt pointed out six decades ago, the rise of anti-Semitism fueled Europe’s descent into totalitarianism.

zh: 随着右翼极端主义和民粹主义运动在众多国家方兴未艾，欧洲的政治制度及其赖以存在的价值观正在遭受威胁。
en: With right-wing extremist and populist movements gaining traction in many countries, Europe’s political system – and the values that underpin it – is at risk.

zh: 法国总理曼努埃尔·瓦尔斯已经认识到其中的危险性。
en: French Prime Minister Manuel Valls recognizes this danger.

zh: 在最近国民议会纪念120年前左拉攻击仇犹情绪“盲目愚昧”的一次演讲中，瓦尔斯质问 ： “ 我们怎么能够接受在法国的大街上有人 . . . 呼喊“杀死犹太人 ” ？
en: In a recent speech at the National Assembly that recalled Emile Zola’s attack on the “blind stupidity” of Jew-hatred almost 120 years ago, he asked: “How can we accept that in France…shouts of “Death to the Jews!” can be heard in our streets?...How can we accept that French people can be murdered because they are Jewish?”

zh: 我们怎么能够接受法国人因其犹太身份而遭到杀戮？ ”之后他警告法国反犹主义（比方说把大屠杀写入法国教科书所引发的担忧）的复兴显示民主已经陷入危机。
en: He then warned that the revival of anti-Semitism in France – apparent, for example, in the anxiety over the Holocaust’s inclusion in the French school curriculum – indicates a crisis of democracy.

zh: 但瓦尔斯仍然是唯一一位强调上述危险已经迫在眉睫的欧洲政治家。
en: But Valls remains the only European politician to have highlighted the danger with the sense of urgency that it merits.

zh: 其他政治家现在要加快脚步，而且同时不应排除出台旨在影响以色列对巴政策的大胆策略。
en: It is time for his counterparts to step up, and doing so should not rule out bold policies, free of any complexes, aimed at influencing Israel’s policy toward Palestine.

zh: 与此同时，为欧洲 — — 和伊斯兰历史上 — — 根深蒂固的问题寻找解决办法，将其归咎于以巴冲突或受排斥的年轻穆斯林是一个危险的错误。
en: At the same time, it is a dangerous fallacy to seek redemption for a problem that is so deeply ingrained in Europe’s history – and in Islam’s – by blaming it on the Israel-Palestine conflict or on young, alienated Muslims.

zh: 如果想要避免再次陷入恐惧、仇恨和骇人听闻的政治魔掌，欧洲人必须认真审视自己的所作所为。
en: Europeans must take a good hard look at themselves if they are to avoid falling back into the clutches of fear, hatred, and appalling politics.

zh: 市场垄断与媒体反垄断
en: Trust in Markets and Antitrust in Media

zh: 伦敦—今年的达沃斯世界经济论坛年会正逢世界经济和金融精英的困惑时刻。
en: LONDON – This year’s World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in Davos came at a moment of puzzlement for the world’s economic and financial elites.

zh: 尽管全球经济最近表现很好，但选民仍在反抗他们。
en: Although the global economy has lately been doing rather well, voters have been rebelling against them.

zh: 尽管存在一些早已众人皆知的挑战和弱点，但最近几年以来经济好消息层出不穷。
en: Despite much-publicized challenges and weak points, there has been plenty of good economic news in recent years.

zh: 自2009年以来，在全球化和技术进步的支持下，全球人均GDP每年增长2.5 % — —比大衰退开始前要低，但从历史上看仍然是相当高的水平。
en: Globalization and technological progress have supported annual global per capita GDP growth of 2.5% since 2009 – lower than before the Great Recession, but still very high by historical standards.

zh: 在过去35年中，全世界生活在贫困中的人口比例从40%下降到只有10 % 。
en: In the last 35 years, the share of the world’s population living in poverty has fallen from 40% to just 10%.

zh: 或许过去一年中最大的怨恨来自不平等性。
en: Perhaps the biggest grievance of the past year has been inequality.

zh: 但从全球水平看，不平等性正在下降。
en: But, at the global level, inequality is falling.

zh: 而尽管一些发达经济体内部不平等性有所上升，但升幅并不十分剧烈，绝对水平也仍然比较合理。
en: And while inequality has risen within some advanced economies, the increase has not been particularly dramatic, and it remains at reasonable levels.

zh: 但这并不是普通公民看到的情景。
en: But that is not what the average citizen sees.

zh: 据欧洲复兴开发银行（EBRD）的最新转型报告 — — 该报告基于世界银行和EBRD（由我担任首席经济学家）进行的转型时期生活调查撰写 — — 人们所感受到的不平等性远远大于正式数据（通常基于家庭调查得出）所勾勒的现实。
en: According to the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development’s new Transition Report, based on the 2015-2016 Life in Transition Survey produced by the World Bank and the EBRD (where I am Chief Economist), the perceived increase in inequality far exceeds the reality described by official data, typically based on household surveys.

zh: 在34个有家庭受调查的国家中，有33个国家的绝大多数受访者认为过去几年中不平等性增加了。
en: In all but one of the 34 countries where households were surveyed, a majority of respondents reported that inequality has risen in just the last few years.

zh: 但正式数据小明基尼系数（不平等性的标准衡量指标）在此期间只是略有变动，其中大部分国家不平等性有所降低。
en: Yet the official data show very small changes in the Gini coefficient (a standard measure of inequality) over this period, with most countries having experienced a decrease in inequality.

zh: 你也许认为，当数据和感觉发生冲突时，获胜的总是数据。
en: One might assume that, in a clash between data and perception, data always win.

zh: 但是，在这个例子中，有可能是数据错了 — — 或者，更准确地说，是我们使用了错误的数据。
en: But, in this case, it may be the data that are wrong – or, more accurately, we may be using the wrong data.

zh: 与目睹街头的无家可归者和新闻中的亿万富翁的普通公民不同，作为计算不平等性指标的基础的家庭调查对收入分配中的最顶层和最底层的样本覆盖不够大。
en: Unlike ordinary citizens, who see the homeless in the street and the billionaires in the news, the household surveys that underpin inequality measurements may be under-sampling those at the very top and the very bottom of the income distribution.

zh: 由法国经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂（Thomas Piketty）收集的另一种数据或能提供关于当今不平等性的更加准确的图景：税收记录。
en: Another kind of data, gathered by the French economist Thomas Piketty, may provide a more accurate picture of inequality today: tax records.

zh: 这些数据表明，最近巨富人群的收入增长远快于其他人群。
en: Those data indicate that income growth among the super-rich has lately far exceeded that of the rest of the population.

zh: 哈佛大学和法兰西学院（College de France）菲利普·阿吉翁（Philippe Aghion）及其合作者进一步确认了这一发现，他们指出，尽管富裕国家底层99%的人口之间的不平等性没有增加，但顶层1%已经绝尘而去。
en: Philippe Aghion of Harvard and the College de France and his co-authors have reinforced this finding, showing that, while inequality has not increased among the bottom 99% of rich-country populations, the top 1% has pulled away from the pack.

zh: 皮凯蒂和其他人指出，财富向最顶层集中可能十分危险。
en: The concentration of wealth at the very top, point out Piketty and others, may be dangerous.

zh: 如果政治制度薄弱，富豪大亨就能挥舞金钱“俘虏”政府官员，让经济监管规则向他们倾斜。
en: If political institutions are weak, wealthy tycoons can use their money to “capture” government officials and tilt economic regulations in their own favor.

zh: 有了新近获得的比较优势，他们可以积累不恰当的利润，将不义之财再投资于攫取更多不公平的租金（rent ） 。
en: With their newly acquired competitive advantages, they can accrue undue profits, reinvesting part of their haul in acquiring even more unfair rents.

zh: 财富的集中将变得难以控制，假以时日，小企业家将被挤出。
en: The concentration of wealth would become difficult to limit, and, over time, smaller entrepreneurs would be crowded out.

zh: 当然，在政治制度足够强大的国家，即使是超级富豪也不能扭曲游戏规则。
en: Of course, if a country’s political institutions are strong enough, not even the super-rich can distort the rules of the game.

zh: 在这样的情况下，能积累最多财富的人是那些最有才华和最幸运的企业家，他们因为驱动惠及整个经济的创新和增长获得奖励。
en: In that case, those who accrue the most wealth are the most talented and luckiest entrepreneurs, who reap their rewards for driving innovation and growth that benefit the entire economy.

zh: 不幸的是，在EBRD的36个成员国中，大部分国家的政治制度没有强大到这种程度。
en: Unfortunately, in many of the EBRD’s 36 member countries, political institutions are not all that strong.

zh: 这反映在一个事实中：大宗商品和自然资源构成了EBRD国家大部分亿万富翁的财富，这表明资源租不仅是可以获得的，并且这些租没有被充分征税。
en: This is reflected in the fact that commodities and natural resources account for a majority of billionaires’ wealth in the EBRD countries, suggesting not just that resource rents are available, but also that those rents are being inadequately taxed.

zh: 显然，需要遏制巨富的不公平政治影响力。
en: There is a clear need to tackle the unfair political influence of the super-rich.

zh: 最直接地，这意味着让政治献金而更加透明，加强监管的严格性和有效性。
en: Most directly, this means making political financing more transparent, with stricter and more effective regulations.

zh: 但这也意味着杜绝寡头利用媒体操纵政治为自己牟利。
en: But it also means addressing the use of media by oligarchs to manipulate politics to their own benefit.

zh: 路易吉·津加莱斯（Luigi Zingales）在2012年时 指出，寡头可以利用媒体所有权来巩固他们的政治地位，利用政治地位确保租金，再用租金为媒体提供资金。
en: As Luigi Zingales pointed out in 2012, oligarchs can use media ownership to solidify their political positions, which they can then exploit to secure rents from which they can fund media.

zh: 津加莱斯说，意大利前总理贝卢斯科尼就是个中高手。
en: Former Italian Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi, Zingales argues, was masterful in this regard.

zh: 但许多前共产主义国家的寡头也在做同样的事。
en: But many oligarchs in the post-communist countries have done likewise.

zh: 一些寡头会说，他们拥有媒体比政府拥有媒体好，至少他们要与其他寡头竞争。
en: Some oligarchs would argue that it is better that they own the media than that the government does; at least they can compete with other oligarchs.

zh: 这是无稽之谈。
en: That is a red herring.

zh: 是的，让强盗或极权政府获得媒体所有权十分危险。
en: Yes, ownership of media by a kleptocratic or authoritarian government is dangerous.

zh: 但让可以互相勾结保护自身集体利益的寡头拥有媒体所有权同样危险 — — 他们的利益可能与社会其他成员截然不同。
en: But so is ownership of media by oligarchs who can collude with one another to protect their collective interests – interests that may differ sharply from those of the rest of society.

zh: 媒体是现代民主社会的基石。
en: Media lie at the foundation of modern democratic societies.

zh: 因此，媒体所有权应该是透明的，在理想情况下，媒体所有者应该禁止拥有其他资产。
en: That is why ownership should be transparent, with, ideally, media owners prohibited from owning other assets.

zh: 简言之，媒体应该受到与（比如）基础设施行业一样的反垄断政策的约束。
en: In short, media should be subject to the same kind of antitrust policy as, say, infrastructure industries.

zh: 当然，这一反垄断政策将面临巨大的政治抵制。
en: Of course, such an antitrust policy would face fierce political resistance.

zh: 而即使这一政策得到实施，大亨们也将继续致力于通过（比如）定价不合理的广告合同影响媒体。
en: And even if such a policy were implemented, tycoons would continue to work to influence the media through, say, mispriced advertising contracts.

zh: 并且，在一定程度上，一些媒体可能会欢迎寡头的补贴，以此作为应对传统商业模式所遇到的挑战的方式。
en: And, to some extent, some media might welcome oligarchic subsidies as a way to manage new challenges to traditional business models.

zh: 解决这些问题首先需要有强大的独立监管机关。
en: To address these problems requires, first and foremost, a strong independent regulator.

zh: 与此同时，透明和去政治化的公共补贴也有助于支持诚实的新闻媒体这一社会财富。
en: At the same time, transparent and de-politicized public subsidies can help to support the social good of honest news media.

zh: 实施有效的媒体反垄断框架绝非易事。
en: Implementing an effective media antitrust framework will not be easy.

zh: 但这仍要比与失去了对民主和开放市场的信念的日益不满的群众斗争容易。
en: But it will still be easier than contending with an increasingly dissatisfied public losing faith in democracy and open markets.

zh: 不完美的苏丹和平
en: An Ugly Peace for Sudan

zh: 发自斯坦福 — — 美国终于还是出手了。
en: STANFORD – Well, America is involved at last.

zh: 奥巴马总统派参议员约翰·克里携一份南北和平方案奔赴苏丹，而此举堪称避免该国重陷血腥冲突的一项重大举措，曾经历时20年的南北内战夺去了超过200万苏丹人的生命，一直到2005年才宣告终结，而如今却似乎又有死灰复燃之势。
en: President Barack Obama has dispatched Senator John Kerry to Sudan with a proposal for peace between the country’s North and South. It’s a giant step toward avoiding the kind of bloodshed that killed more than two million people in Sudan’s previous 20-year North-South civil war, which ended only in 2005 – and is threatening to erupt once again.

zh: 近几个月来，奥巴马进一步加大了其本人及属下高级官员对苏丹和平战略的干涉力度。
en: In recent months, Obama has stepped up his own involvement and that of senior figures in his administration in support of a peace strategy for Sudan.

zh: 作为总统代表，克里提出了一揽子解决方案，旨在打破当前南北之间的僵局，把双方从危险的悬崖边拉回来。
en: On his behalf, Kerry has delivered a package of proposals designed to break the logjam that has brought the North and South to a dangerous crossroads.

zh: 为此我们草拟了一份备忘录，列出几个在苏丹和平谈判中不可或缺的要素。
en: We have written a memo that spells out some of the essential elements of what a grand bargain for peace in Sudan could look like.

zh: 如果您对这一潜在和平协议的细节感兴趣的话 — — 或是可以用行动来支持它 — — 不妨到www.sudanactionnow.org 上面去看看。
en: If you’re interested in the specifics of a possible peace deal – and in actions that you can take to support it – go to www.sudanactionnow.org.

zh: 当前的形势已经迫在眉睫。
en: There is little time to waste.

zh: 居住在苏丹南部的人民将于2011年1月9日公投决定是否脱离北方独立，此举不但会把大概3/4的石油储量划归南方所有，更意味着数百万人将再度面临战乱之苦。
en: On January 9, 2011, the people of Southern Sudan will vote for independence from the North, taking with them up to three-quarters of the country’s known oil reserves and placing millions of civilians in the direct path of war.

zh: 另一方面，首都喀土穆（位于北部）的苏丹政府现正处于奥马尔·巴希尔的控制之下，这个恶贯满盈者不但策划指挥了南北内战，还一手推动了达尔富尔大屠杀，为此国际刑事法庭已经依据战争罪和种族屠杀罪向他发出了拘捕令。
en: The government in Khartoum (the capital in the North) is led by Omar al-Bashir, whose accomplishments, which include overseeing war crimes during the previous North-South war and engineering the atrocities in Darfur, have brought him arrest warrants for war crimes and genocide from the International Criminal Court.

zh: 然而苏丹内战的再度爆发并不是无法避免的。
en: And yet renewed war in Sudan is not inevitable.

zh: 如果利益各方能够更深入地参与到谈判之中，就能协商达成一份复杂但却可行的和平方案。
en: A complex but workable peace can be brokered if all interested parties become more deeply involved.

zh: 当前这种情况亟须一种现实主义的外交手腕 — — 就那种让你心里不是滋味，但却能实现目标的外交手段。
en: The current moment requires robust diplomacy – the kind that can leave a bad taste in your mouth, but that gets the job done.

zh: 我们相信克里是位足够老练的特使，定能令事件各方明白妥协的必要性。
en: We believe that Kerry is a skilled emissary and can help the parties find the compromises necessary for peace.

zh: 任何避免战争爆发的协议都必然牵涉到代表北方的全国大会党以及代表南方的苏丹人民解放运动。
en: Any agreement preventing a return to war would necessarily involve the National Congress Party, representing the North, and the Sudan People’s Liberation Movement, representing the South.

zh: 此外美国也应当参与其中，因为它在公投后与南北双方的关系对协议能否成功达成至关重要。
en: But it would also involve the United States, whose post-referendum relationship with the two parties will have enormous influence over whether a deal gets done.

zh: 我们认为，为了给南北双方长久和平打下基础，谈判各方必须做到以下几点：
en: We believe that a grand bargain to lay the foundation for lasting peace between the North and South would oblige the parties to:

zh: ·         苏丹南部的公投如期举行，并完全尊重和执行公投的结果。
en: ·        hold the Southern Sudan referendum on time and fully respect and implement the results;

zh: ·         就阿卜耶伊这一主要边界争议地区的领土问题达成一个令双方满意的协议。
en: ·        reach a mutually satisfactory agreement concerning the territory of Abyei, a key disputed border area;

zh: ·         制定一份长期的利润分成协议，确保阿卜耶伊和其他主要边界区域的石油收益在南北之间平等分配，并将小部分收益分配给居住在梅泽里亚（Misseriya）地区的各阿拉伯族部族以促进当地发展。
en: ·        craft a multi-year revenue-sharing arrangement in which the oil wealth of Abyei and key border areas could be divided equitably between the North and South, with a small percentage going to the Arab Misseriya border populations for development purposes;

zh: ·         对于其中80%的无争议边界，可以直接划定，而余下那20%则交由国际仲裁。
en: ·        demarcate the uncontested 80% of the border and refer the remaining 20% to binding international arbitration;

zh: ·         为少数民族提供认真有效的保护，并对特定人群的双重公民身份予以承认，一旦发生南方人在北方遭受袭击或相反的事件，国际社会都要对肇事方进行严厉惩罚。
en: ·        create serious protections for minority groups, with consideration of joint citizenship for certain populations, backed by significant international consequences for attacks on southerners in the North or northerners in the South.

zh: 美国作为协议的幕后第三方，要给喀土穆当局提供一系列激励性因素，以确保和平协议的达成和落实。
en: The US role as the invisible third party to the agreement involves a series of incentives offered to the regime in Khartoum to ensure agreement and implementation of a peace deal.

zh: 作为支持南北和达尔富尔和平进程的交换条件，美国将推行一个明确，连贯而有约束力的方案以实现两国关系正常化。
en: In exchange for action on the North-South and Darfur peace efforts, the US would implement a clear, sequenced, and binding path to normalization of relations.

zh: 其中包括 — — 按先后次序来说 — — 把苏丹从支持恐怖主义的国家名单中剔除，互派大使，解除单方面制裁，协助减免双边和多边债务，并与其他国际金融组织的相关经济手段相结合。
en: This would involve – in order – removal of Sudan from the State Sponsors of Terrorism list, exchange of ambassadors, lifting of unilateral sanctions, and support for bilateral and multilateral debt relief, together with other economic measures by international financial institutions.

zh: 相反，对试图把苏丹重新拖入战争泥潭的任何一方，美国必须第一个站出来，带领国际力量给于严惩。
en: Conversely, the US must be prepared to lead international efforts to impose severe consequences on any party that plunges the country back into war.

zh: 达尔富尔地区的和平与安全应成为美国与苏丹关系正常化的标志。
en: Peace and security in Darfur should be an essential benchmark for normalized relations between the US and Sudan.

zh: 在新一轮谈判中，奥巴马政府要坚定这一立场，并任命一位高级官员专门协调美国在达尔富尔的政策，确保当地的和平进程与南北双方的和平进程受到同等重视。
en: The Obama administration should hold firm on this through the coming rounds of negotiation, and should appoint a senior official to help coordinate US policy on Darfur in order to ensure that peace efforts there receive the same level of attention as the North-South efforts.

zh: 而目前最急需的则是政治决心（不仅仅来自于美国 ） 。
en: What is needed now is political will – and not only in the US – to sustain this diplomacy.

zh: 欧盟以及苏丹各邻国 — — 尤其是埃及，埃塞俄比亚，肯尼亚和乌干达 — — 也需要积极参与。
en: The European Union and Sudan’s neighbors – in particular Egypt, Ethiopia, Kenya, and Uganda – will also need to play a robust role.

zh: 而由于中国在苏丹进行了大规模投资以开发当地的石油资源，因此它所持的外交立场将成为一块试金石，考验该国是否真的希望在非洲以及全世界范围内成为一个负责任的利益相关者。
en: And China’s diplomacy in Sudan, where it has invested massively in developing the country’s oil resources, will be a test of whether or not it intends to be a responsible stakeholder in Africa and the wider world.

zh: 确保政府为实现和平而努力是您力所能及的事。
en: Ensuring that governments work toward peace is where you come in. Keep the pressure on them.

zh: 给政府施加压力，支持和平进程，您的呼声能制止一场战争。
en: Support the peace process. Your voice can prevent a war.

zh: 无需枪支，不用金钱，只要我们的呼声就足够了。
en: Not money. Just our voices.

zh: 实现苏丹和平的道路曲折，但前途是光明的。
en: The way to peace in Sudan is not simple, but it is achievable.

zh: 其中必须做出许多艰难的抉择。
en: There are hard choices to be made.

zh: 而我们可以选择现在就勇敢地面对，或是懦弱地告诉自己和平是高不可攀，遥不可及的，然后冷漠地站在一旁围观，任由成百上千的无辜男女和儿童白白丧命。
en: We can make those choices now, or we can persuade ourselves that peace is too hard or too complex, and then look on resignedly from the sidelines as hundreds of thousands of innocent men, women, and children needlessly die.

zh: 而这一切，都取决于我们如何选择。
en: It’s up to us.

zh: 兴都库什山脉的和平伙伴关系
en: A Partnership for Peace in the Hindu Kush

zh: 巴基斯坦西北边境省份，开伯尔山口－巴基斯坦总统佩尔韦兹·穆沙拉夫和阿富汗总统哈米德·卡尔扎伊从来没有共享的边境战略。
en: Khyber Pass, Northwest Frontier Province, Pakistan -- Pakistani President Pervez Musharraf and Afghan President Hamid Karzai never had a shared border strategy.

zh: 但是，当你站在开伯尔山口的至高点米奇尼哨所，注视着下面在兴都库什山脉的阴影中轰轰作响的成千的从阿富汗驶入巴基斯坦的卡车和公共汽车的时候，问题的答案是显而易见的：控制阿富汗－巴基斯坦边境需要一个同时关注阿富汗和巴基斯坦的反游击战和破坏的政策。
en: But, standing at Michni Post, the highest point of the Khyber Pass, staring down at the thousands of trucks and buses buzzing through Afghanistan into Pakistan under the shadows of the Hindu Kush, the answer is obvious: controlling the Afghan-Pakistan border requires a counterinsurgency policy that looks at Afghanistan and Pakistan together.

zh: 巴基斯坦的新政府非常有机会来做出这样的改变。
en: Pakistan’s new government has a great opportunity to make this change.

zh: 为了切断塔利班和基地组织的人员征募和物资供给，两个国家应该合力打击武装分子。
en: In order to cut off the Taliban and al-Qaeda’s recruitment and supplies, both countries should fight the militants in tandem.

zh: 这意味着，首先，从巴基斯坦驻扎在阿富汗1,600英里边境的有50,000人的战斗部队开始，提高边境部队的安全保卫训练。
en: That means, first, improving security training for the border forces, starting with Pakistan’s Frontier Corps, the 50,000-man combat force along the 1,600-mile Afghan border.

zh: 这些“大地之子”健康状况不佳。
en: These “sons of the soil” are in bad shape.

zh: 他们巡逻从25,000英尺高的山脉到光秃秃的沙漠地区的收入每天不到两美元。
en: They receive no more than two dollars a day to patrol the area, which ranges from 25,000-foot-high mountains to barren deserts.

zh: . 他们也不得不用老旧的武器战斗。
en: They also fight with old weapons.

zh: 正如一位高级指挥官告诉我的那样 ， “ 塔利班的武器装备更好并且火力更足。
en: As one senior commander told me, “the Taliban are better equipped and have more fire power.”

zh: ”他们没有空中武装力量，更糟的是，没有快速反应部队来支援他们。
en: They have no air mobility, and worse, no rapid reaction force to support them.

zh: 两个位于南瓦齐里斯坦省拉哈（Ladha）堡垒的边境军营在过去的几个月里不断的遭到袭击。
en: Two Frontier battalions have been under siege at Ladha Fort in South Waziristan for the past few months.

zh: 对边境沿线的护卫可以按照平行的轨道进行。
en: Security along the border can run on parallel tracks.

zh: 边境军队的监察长默罕默德·阿兰·卡塔克（Muhammad Alam Khattak）少将向我建议说 ， “ 把我们的边境部队带走，在一个地方训练他们然后再把他们带回来。
en: Major General Muhammad Alam Khattak, the Frontier Corps’ Inspector General, made a suggestion to me: “Take our Frontier Corps. Train them somewhere and bring them back.”

zh: ”阿富汗也应该作同样的事情。
en: Afghanistan should do just that.

zh: 通过北约的国际安全援助部队(ISAF)阿富汗国民军培训项目，阿富汗应该可以使边境部队和他们的普什图兄弟同时联动起来。
en: Through NATO’s International Security Assistance Force (ISAF) Afghan National Army training program, it should rotate the Frontier Corps battalions with their Pashtun brothers one at a time.

zh: 巴基斯坦为适当的装备和军队集结停供的额外支援－包括一支边境军团快速反应部队的建立－应当保证，这样在巴基斯坦的边境部队士兵就可以成为阿富汗需要的反游击战和破坏的伙伴。
en: Additional resources provided by Pakistan for proper equipment and force buildup – including the creation of a Frontier Corps Rapid Reaction Force – should be committed so that Frontier Corps soldiers become the counterinsurgency partners in Pakistan that Afghanistan needs.

zh: 其次，和叛乱分子的和解应以诱导他们叛变开始。
en: Second, reconciliation with the insurgents should begin by inducing defections.

zh: 一位美军高级指挥官推荐这个策略，他说“60%的叛乱行动可以通过和解来遏止住。
en: This was recommended by a senior US military commander, who said that “60% of insurgent activity could be curbed by reconciliation.”

zh: ”尽管人们对这个过程有压倒性的支持，但是却没有实现它的方法。
en: Despite overwhelming support for this process, methods to do so are absent.

zh: 在阿富汗的赫尔曼德（Helmand）省，2,000名塔利班武装分子被国际安全援助部队包围并接受审查，他们只有建议没有得到阿富汗中央政府支持的情况下才被放弃。
en: In Afghanistan’s Helmand Province, 2,000 Taliban fighters were rounded up and vetted by ISAF forces, only to be abandoned after the initiative was not supported by Afghanistan’s central government.

zh: 在霍斯特，许多来自部族地区的塔利班成员叛变，他们承诺无条件地放下手中的武器。
en: In Khost, dozens of former Taliban members from the Tribal Areas defected, promising to lay down their arms in exchange for – only to be given nothing.

zh: 在这两种情况中，叛变的武装人员都说了同样的事情：他们可以招募更多的人；他们需要的仅仅是诱导因素。
en: In both cases, the defecting insurgents said the same thing: they could recruit dozens more; they just need incentives.

zh: 巴基斯坦和阿富汗应该发展和执行一个针对中低层塔利班和基地组织指挥官的区域和解项目。
en: A regional reconciliation program targeting mid- and lower-tier Taliban and al-Qaeda commanders should be developed and implemented by Pakistan and Afghanistan.

zh: 第三，毒枭应被逮捕和拘留。
en: Third, the drug lords should be arrested and detained.

zh: 正如一位阿富汗政府官员说的那样 ， “ 如果你不能清除一个腐败的法官，你怎么能够对付塔利班呢？
en: As one senior Afghan government official said, “If you can’t remove a corrupt judge, how can you deal with the Taliban?”

zh: ”在阿富汗有一百个顶级毒枭。
en: There are a hundred top drug lords in Afghanistan.

zh: 每个人都知道他们是谁，但是他们中没有一个人被捕。
en: Everyone knows who they are. Yet none has been arrested.

zh: 因为担心不利反应而不这样做只会增强他们的势力。
en: Not doing so, due to fear of backlash, only enhances their power.

zh: 而且允许他们继续控制走私路线引发了省级官员和阿富汗国家警察资金腐败的连锁反应，这回过头来又滋长了叛乱。
en: And allowing them to continue to control the smuggling routes creates a ripple effect that bankrolls corruption of provincial officials and the Afghan National Police, which in turn feeds the insurgency.

zh: 最后，改革宗教学校系统。
en: Finally, reform the madrassa system.

zh: 不是所有的宗教学校都是恐怖分子训练的温床。
en: Not all madrassas are hotbeds of terrorist training.

zh: 但是问题是，在19或20岁后，对任何宗教教育而言，阿富汗的宗教学生就必须去巴基斯坦进行。
en: The problem is that Afghan religious students must go to Pakistan for any religious education after 19 or 20 years of age.

zh: 然后他们迅速被通过钱，宣传以及巴基斯坦毛拉的压力逼迫成为“坏塔利班 ” 。
en: They are then quickly pressured to become “bad Taliban” through money, propaganda, and pressure from Pakistani mullahs.

zh: 为了解决这个问题，阿富汗教育部长哈尼夫·阿特马尔－可能是最具改革头脑的政府成员－正在寻求在阿富汗建立34所新的用于高等教育的宗教学校（他的目标是2,000所 ） 。
en: To address this problem, Afghan Education Minister Hanif Atmar – perhaps the most reform-minded member of the government – is seeking to build 34 new madrassas (his goal is 2,000) in Afghanistan for higher learning.

zh: ，其针对课程改革以使其包括伊斯兰研究，性别研究，计算机科学以及英语的建议，应该会赢得巨大的支持。
en: His proposal, which aims to reform the curriculum to include Islamic studies, gender studies, computer science, and English, should receive overwhelming support.

zh: 随着从阿富汗进入巴基斯坦学生的减少，巴基斯坦可以把它的注意力集中到自己的宗教学校和将学生转变成自杀炸弹的毛拉上。
en: With fewer students from Afghanistan going to Pakistan, Pakistan could turn its attention to the country’s own madrassas and to the mullahs who convert students into suicide bombers.

zh: 根据阿特马尔部长的建议，两个国家的课程应该协同。
en: The curriculum for both countries, based on Minister Atmar’s proposal, should be coordinated.

zh: 符合这些课程标准的宗教学校应该注册，得到支持以及鼓励。
en: Madrassas that meet these curriculum standards should be registered, supported, and encouraged.

zh: 只有一个有效的阿富汗－巴基斯坦伙伴关系才能开始控制边境地区的叛乱。
en: Only an effective Afghan-Pakistan partnership can begin to control the insurgency in the border area.

zh: 没有这一点，在阿富汗的战争以及巴基斯坦的动荡都不会结束。
en: The war in Afghanistan, and destabilization in Pakistan, will not end without it.

zh: 欧洲雷区的安全小道
en: A Path through Europe’s Minefield

zh: 伦敦 — — 本周早些时候，近100位欧洲名流向欧元区所有17个成员国领导人发出了一封集体公开信。
en: LONDON – Earlier this week, a group of almost 100 prominent Europeans delivered an open letter to the leaders of all 17 eurozone countries.

zh: 信中直接了当地说出了欧洲领导人似乎已经心知肚明的道理：不能再继续使用“拖字诀”了。
en: The letter said, in so many words, what the leaders of Europe now appear to have understood: they cannot go on “kicking the can down the road.”

zh: 同样重要的是，他们还明白了，确保政府能够以合理利率发债是不够的，还必须提振欧洲疲软的银行体系。
en: And, just as importantly, they now understand that it is not enough to ensure that governments can finance their debt at reasonable interest rates; they must also address the weakness of Europe’s banking system.

zh: 事实上，欧洲银行问题和主权债务问题是相辅相成的。
en: Indeed, Europe’s banking and sovereign-debt problems are mutually self-reinforcing.

zh: 政府债券价格的下跌暴露出银行的资本不足问题，而政府不得不为银行资本重组提供资金的前景又推高了政府债券的风险溢价。
en: The decline in government bond prices has exposed the banks’ undercapitalization, while the prospect that governments will have to finance banks’ recapitalization has driven up risk premiums on government bonds.

zh: 如今，银行股价格还不到账面价值，欲在此时筹集新的资本会让银行产生用削减信贷额度、缩小贷款业务量的办法让资产负债表缩水的激励。
en: Facing the prospect of having to raise additional capital at a time when their shares are selling at a fraction of book value, banks have a powerful incentive to reduce their balance sheets by withdrawing credit lines and shrinking their loan portfolios.

zh: 欧洲领导人正在思考应对措施，他们的下一步动作将决定欧洲的命运 — — 要么让市场恢复平静，要么把市场推向新的极端。
en: Europe’s leaders are now contemplating what to do, and their next move will have fateful consequences, either calming the markets or driving them to new extremes.

zh: 所有人都同意希腊需要有序重组，因为无序违约可能让欧元区分崩离析。
en: All agree that Greece needs an orderly restructuring, because a disorderly default could cause a eurozone meltdown.

zh: 但是，当事情牵涉到银行时，我怀疑欧元区领导人正在考虑实施一些不适当的手段。
en: But, when it comes to the banks, I am afraid that the eurozone’s leaders are contemplating some inappropriate steps.

zh: 具体而言，他们大谈对银行体系进行资本重组的问题，而不准备向银行提供担保。
en: Specifically, they are talking about recapitalizing the banking system, rather than guaranteeing it.

zh: 此外，他们准备在国家层面，而不是在整个欧元区层面做这件事。
en: And they want to do it on a country-by-country basis, rather than on the basis of the eurozone as a whole.

zh: 这本无可厚非：德国人不愿意为法国银行的资本重组买单。
en: There is a good reason for this: Germany does not want to pay for recapitalizing French banks.

zh: 但是，德国总理默克尔固有千般理由坚持作如是观，却免不了因此走上错误的道路。
en: But, while Chancellor Angela Merkel is justified in insisting on this, it is driving her in the wrong direction.

zh: 我来详细地解释一下究竟怎样做才能为欧洲在密集雷区中辟出一条蹊径。
en: Let me stake out more precisely the narrow path that would allow Europe to pass through this minefield.

zh: 银行体系首先需要的是担保，然后才是资本重组。
en: The banking system needs to be guaranteed first, and recapitalized later.

zh: 政府无法承担现在就进行资本重组的成本，提供不了足够的资金应对主权债务问题。
en: Governments cannot afford to recapitalize the banks now; it would leave them with insufficient funds to deal with the sovereign-debt problem.

zh: 待到危机过去、政府债券和银行股价格回复常规水平之后再对银行进行资本重组成本要小得多。
en: It will cost much less to recapitalize the banks after the crisis has abated and both government bonds and bank shares have returned to more normal levels.

zh: 不过，政府有收税的权力，因此可以提供可信的担保。
en: Governments can, however, provide a credible guarantee, given their power to tax.

zh: 欧元区需要一个新的具有法律约束力的协议 — — 并非试图改变里斯本条约，这样障碍太多 — — 动员这一权力，而新条约的协商和批准需要时间。
en: A new, legally binding agreement – not a change to the Lisbon Treaty (which would encounter too many hurdles), but a new agreement – will be needed for the eurozone to mobilize that power, and such an accord will take time to negotiate and ratify.

zh: 但是，在此期间，各国政府可以要求欧洲央行有所动作 — — 欧洲央行正是由欧元区成员国按比例提供完全担保的。
en: But, in the meantime, governments can call upon the European Central Bank, which the eurozone member states already fully guarantee on a pro rata basis.

zh: 作为获得担保的交换条件，欧元区主要银行必须同意接受欧洲央行的指导。
en: In exchange for a guarantee, the eurozone’s major banks would have to agree to abide by the ECB’s instructions.

zh: 这一要求有些激进，但在如今的环境中不得不为。
en: This is a radical step, but a necessary one under the circumstances.

zh: 欧洲央行听从成员国指令，将获得足够的说服力：它可以对银行关闭贴现窗口，各国政府还可以制裁拒绝合作的金融机构。
en: Acting at the behest of the member states, the ECB has sufficient powers of persuasion: it could close its discount window to the banks, and the governments could seize institutions that refuse to cooperate.

zh: 然后，由欧洲央行要求银行维持信贷额度和贷款业务量，同时严格监控银行自有账户所承担的风险。
en: The ECB would then instruct the banks to maintain their credit lines and loan portfolios while strictly monitoring the risks they take for their own account.

zh: 这样就能消除导致当前市场动荡的两大动力中的一个。
en: This would remove one of the two main driving forces of the current market turmoil.

zh: 欧洲央行还能对付另一大动力，即主权债务融资不足的问题，办法是降低贴现率，鼓励受困政府发行国债，同时鼓励银行认购（这个想法源自托马索·帕多阿-斯基奥帕（Tommaso Padoa-Schioppa ） ） 。
en: The ECB could deal with the other driving force, the lack of financing for sovereign debt, by lowering its discount rate, encouraging distressed governments to issue treasury bills, and encouraging the banks to subscribe (an idea I owe to Tommaso Padoa-Schioppa).

zh: 这些国债可以在任何时候卖给欧洲央行，换取等额现金；但是，只要它们的收益率高于欧洲央行存款，银行持有国债就是有利可图的。
en: The T-bills could be sold to the ECB at any time, making them tantamount to cash; but, as long as they yield more than deposits with the ECB, the banks would find it advantageous to hold them.

zh: 在紧急状况期间，政府可以以极低成本融得不多于协议限额的资金，而欧洲央行也不会违反里斯本条约第123条。
en: Governments could meet their financing needs within agreed limits at very low cost during this emergency period, and the ECB would not violate Article 123 of the Lisbon Treaty.

zh: 这些措施足以安抚市场，让危机走出紧急期。
en: These measures would be sufficient to calm markets and bring the acute phase of the crisis to an end.

zh: 此时再进行银行资本重组也不迟；只有希腊债务重组所造成的漏洞需要立刻填补。
en: Recapitalization of the banks should wait until then; only the holes created by restructuring the Greek debt would have to be filled immediately.

zh: 按照德国的要求，追加的资本首先来自市场，然后来自各国政府，而欧洲金融稳定基金将在最后出场，因此不会浪费手中的弹药。
en: In conformity with Germany’s demand, the additional capital would come first from the market and then from individual governments – and from the European Financial Stability Facility only as a last resort, thereby preserving the EFSF’s firepower.

zh: 在较平稳���境下协商达成的新欧元区协议不仅可以将紧急时期行为法制化，而且可以作为经济增长战略的基础。
en: A new agreement for the eurozone, negotiated in a calmer atmosphere, should not only codify the practices established during the emergency, but also lay the groundwork for an economic-growth strategy.

zh: 在紧急时期，财政节省和紧缩是不可避免的；但从长期看，债务负担的可持续性问题，甚至欧盟本身的可持续性问题，都只有通过增长才能解决。
en: During the emergency period, fiscal retrenchment and austerity are unavoidable; but, in the longer term, the debt burden will become unsustainable without growth – and so will the European Union itself.

zh: 全球发展的和平日程
en: A Peace Agenda for Global Development

zh: 利比里亚蒙罗维亚—本周，2015年后发展日程高级别小组的27名成员将齐聚利比里亚蒙罗维亚，为联合国秘书长潘基文献策。
en: MONROVIA, LIBERIA – This week, the 27 members of the High-level Panel of Eminent Persons on the Post-2015 Development Agenda gather in Monrovia, Liberia, to advise United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon.

zh: 会上，该小组将成立“大胆而现实”的可持续发展联合行动愿景。
en: At the meeting, the Panel will establish a “bold yet practical” vision for joint action on sustainable development.

zh: 这场讨论由利比里亚总统、诺贝尔和平奖获得者瑟利夫、印度尼西亚总统苏西洛和英国首相卡梅伦主持，会议期间，附近的塞舌尔和大湖地区却仍受着暴力和冲突的困扰。
en: While these discussions – hosted by Liberian President and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Ellen Johnson Sirleaf, Indonesian President Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono, and British Prime Minister David Cameron – take place, the nearby Sahel and the Great Lakes region continue to be plagued by violence and conflict.

zh: 事实上，大规模的人民流离失所和深重的人道灾难正在许多非洲国家上演（更不用说叙利亚和其他地方了 ） ， 威胁着非洲大陆过去十年来前所未有的经济进步过程。
en: Indeed, large-scale displacement of people and unspeakable human suffering are occurring in many African countries (not to mention in Syria and elsewhere), threatening to reverse the continent’s unprecedented economic progress during the last decade.

zh: 该小组（我也是成员之一）必须抓住蒙罗维亚会议的机会，拿出一份全球发展日程，纠正妨碍经济活动、破坏人类福祉的冲突和贫困的恶性循环。
en: The Panel (of which I am a member) must seize the opportunity presented by the Monrovia meeting to contribute to a global development agenda that addresses the vicious cycle of conflict and poverty that hampers economic activity and undermines human well-being.

zh: 十多年来，联合国千年发展目标（将于两年后到期）为国际发展合作提供了框架，中心点是战胜全球平困。
en: For more than a decade, the Millennium Development Goals, which expire in two years, have provided the framework for international development cooperation, with a focus on combating poverty worldwide.

zh: 在开发新的全面赶超日程时，全球领导者必须认识到，千年发展目标已经让全世界千百万人脱离了文盲、疾病和饥饿，千年发展目标的影响还未充分显现，特别是在四分五裂的、保守冲突困扰的国家。
en: In developing a new, comprehensive follow-up agenda, global leaders should recognize that, although the MDGs have enabled millions of people worldwide to escape illiteracy, disease, and hunger, their overall impact has been inadequate, particularly in fragile, conflict-ridden countries.

zh: 世界银行数据表明，无冲突的低收入国家已经达到了单一千年发展目标，这表明这一安排不能有效解决由有组织暴力和缺乏安全带来的问题。
en: World Bank statistics show that no conflict-affected low-income country has achieved a single MDG, reflecting the framework’s failure to address problems caused by organized violence and insecurity effectively.

zh: 这就是为何2015年后日程必须以让和平、安全和自由从恐惧中脱颖而出为核心的原因。
en: That is why the post-2015 agenda should be centered on peace, security, and freedom from fear.

zh: 它应该把目标放在把公正和繁荣带给每一个人上。
en: It should aim to make justice and prosperity a reality for everyone.

zh: 它应该反映这样一种观念：没有和平就没有发展，没有发展就没有和平，而没有对人权和法治精神的尊重，持续和平和可持续发展都是空谈。
en: And it should reflect the understanding that development is impossible without peace, just as peace is impossible without development – and that lasting peace and sustainable development are impossible without respect for human rights and the rule of law.

zh: 此外，蒙罗维亚会议的主题“持续繁荣的国家建设基础”指出，2015年后全球发展项目应该强调对国家措施的支持，以实现坚挺、稳定、长期的繁荣。
en: Furthermore, as the Monrovia meeting’s theme, “National Building Blocks for Sustained Prosperity,” suggests, post-2015 global development initiatives should emphasize support for national efforts to achieve strong, stable, long-term prosperity.

zh: 有助于各国克服国内不安全和冲突、实现经济转型以及充分开发其潜力的战略包括加强治理制度和法治精神、确保多方参与、以及保证所有公民能够平等地获得公正。
en: Strategies that would help countries to overcome domestic insecurity and conflict, transform their economies, and, ultimately, meet their potential include strengthening governance institutions and the rule of law, ensuring multi-stakeholder participation, and guaranteeing that all citizens have equal access to justice.

zh: 对这方面努力的国际支持意味着给予非洲领导人和利益相关者战胜落后、刺激繁荣的机会和责任。
en: International support for such efforts would mean giving African leaders and stakeholders the opportunity – and the responsibility – to eliminate underdevelopment and boost prosperity.

zh: 此外，在消除贫困仍是2015年后关注要点之一的同时，中心点必须从国民平均水平转移到地方差异上来。
en: Moreover, while poverty eradication will remain a paramount concern after 2015, the focus must shift from national averages to local disparities.

zh: 衡量指标必须超越总体社会需求，刺激生产性就业创造和收入形成的部门进步。
en: Measures must move beyond overall social needs to bolster progress in productive job-creating and income-generating sectors.

zh: 受冲突困扰的国家必须花大力气促进和解，防止暴力死灰复燃。
en: And strong efforts must be made in conflict-affected countries to promote reconciliation and prevent the revival of violence.

zh: 最近，利比里亚在后冲突时代重建和人权发展方面取得了成功（此前该国经历了14年的内战 ） ， 因此是发展日程高级别小组会议的理想举办地。
en: Given Liberia’s recent success in post-conflict reconstruction and human development, following a 14-year civil war, it is a fitting setting for the Panel’s deliberations.

zh: 2003年以来，国内愿景和承诺与国际支持一起，让利比里亚得以举行了民主选举，重新建设了基本公共服务，重新建立了公共财政管理体系，并在纠正地方腐败、重建公共机构、振兴国家基础设施等方面取得了进步。
