en: Since 2003, domestic vision and commitment, together with international support, have enabled Liberia to hold democratic elections, reintroduce some essential public services, reestablish a public-finance management system, and make progress in addressing endemic corruption, rebuilding public institutions, and reconstructing national infrastructure.

zh: 该小组应该将利比里亚确保和平、维持稳定和引导经济和社会转型的持续努力作为成功后冲突时代转型的样本。
en: The Panel should view Liberia’s ongoing efforts to secure peace, maintain stability, and initiate economic and social transformation as a blueprint for successful post-conflict transition.

zh: 其他启发性模式还有卢旺达、莫桑比克和塞拉利昂。
en: Other inspiring models can be found in Rwanda, Mozambique, and Sierra Leone.

zh: 该小组将致力于形成大胆、明确而可行的可持续发展日程草案。
en: The Panel is committed to creating an ambitious, coherent, and practical proposal for a sustainable global development agenda.

zh: 整个过程将是开放、包容、透明的，将参考代表年轻人、妇女、老人、残疾人以及法律界、学界和跨政府行动者的专家和相关利益者的观点和经验。
en: The process will be open, inclusive, and transparent, and will be informed by the opinions and experiences of experts and stakeholders representing young people, women, the elderly, and the disabled, as well as legislative, academic, and inter-governmental actors.

zh: 该小组还会利用全面的在线和离线措施和全世界人民展开互动，吸取关于他们眼中的未来的洞见。
en: The Panel will also take advantage of extensive online and offline efforts to engage with people worldwide and gain insight into the future that they envision.

zh: 他们的观点将拓宽小组视野，有助于开发解决他们眼中的当务之急的日程。
en: Their perspectives will enrich efforts to develop an agenda that addresses their priorities.

zh: 在保守冲突困扰的世界中，发展努力总是不足的。
en: In a world roiled by conflict, development efforts will always fall short.

zh: 2015年后全球发展日程必须以全面的视角与消除贫困措施相结合，并辅之以有助于建设和平的经济转型方案和政策。
en: The post-2015 global development agenda must take a comprehensive approach, combining poverty-reduction measures with peace-building initiatives and strategies for economic transformation.

zh: 如此，全球领导人方能为世界繁荣、公正和可持续发展奠定基础。
en: In this way, global leaders can begin to lay the foundations for prosperity, justice, and sustainable development worldwide.

zh: 我们的子孙后代对此自会有公论。
en: Future generations are counting on it.

zh: 亚洲悖论
en: The Asian Paradox

zh: 首尔—亚太经济合作（Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation，APEC）论坛的21个成员国占了全球GDP的54%和世界贸易的44 % ， 因此本月APEC峰会的日程将引起全球关注。
en: SEOUL – Given that the 21 members of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum account for some 54% of global GDP and about 44% of world trade, the agenda for this month’s APEC summit should be drawing much global attention.

zh: 但所有人都兴趣盎然的唯一一个问题是中国国家主席习近平和日本首相安倍晋三是否会在场边举行会晤，如果会晤的话，是否会有缓解双边紧张态势的实质性讨论。
en: Yet the only issue in which anyone seems interested is whether or not Chinese President Xi Jinping and Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe will meet on the sidelines, and, if they do, whether a substantive discussion to ease bilateral tensions will take place.

zh: 当然，这并不完全是毫无道理的，因为两国对于决定东亚的未来至关重要。
en: Of course, this is not altogether unreasonable, given the two countries’ importance in shaping East Asia’s future.

zh: 事实上，APEC两大关键领导人是否会有交流的不确定性彰显出当今亚洲国际关系的严峻现实。
en: Indeed, the uncertainty about whether two of APEC’s key leaders will even speak to each other highlights the grim reality of Asian international relations today.

zh: 所谓的“亚洲世纪”饱受一个悖论的困扰：深刻的经济相互依存完全不能减轻战略不信任。
en: The supposed “Asian century” is being thwarted by a paradox: deep economic interdependence has done nothing to alleviate strategic mistrust.

zh: 最近，中日关系出现了恶化 — — 这一趋势在日本从其私人所有者手中购买钓鱼岛（日本称尖阁列岛）以防止日本民族主义者控制该群岛后有所加剧 — — 安倍出席峰会已经算得上是重大一步。
en: Given the recent deterioration of Sino-Japanese relations – a decline that accelerated in 2012, when Japan purchased the disputed Senkaku Islands (Diaoyu Islands in Chinese) from their private owner to prevent Japanese nationalists from taking control of them – the mere fact that Abe will attend the summit is a major step.

zh: 安倍晋三和习近平的悔悟 — — 两人上台后的第一次 — — 将给人们带来更大的希望。
en: A meeting between Abe and Xi – their first since either came to power – would offer concrete grounds for hope.

zh: 日本政府付出了很大的外交努力安排悔悟，前首相福田康夫于7月访问北京以缓和紧张关系。
en: The Japanese government has made significant diplomatic efforts to orchestrate a meeting, with former Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda visiting Beijing in July to try to ease tensions.

zh: 据一些媒体的报道，为了保证中国同意在APEC峰会期间参加悔悟，安倍甚至愿意承认日本对钓鱼岛的主张是有争议的。
en: According to some media reports, in order to secure China’s agreement to participate in a meeting during the APEC summit, Abe even agreed to acknowledge that Japan’s claim to the Senkaku Islands is disputed.

zh: 如此动作意味着中国对钓鱼岛的主张或许具有一些合法性，因此绝不是无关紧要的问题；这甚至可能意味着安倍同意与中国一起恢复过去的状态。
en: Given that such a move would imply that China’s claim to the islands may have some legitimacy, Abe’s possible concession on this point is no trivial matter; it could even mean that he will agree with China to restore the status quo ante.

zh: 果真如此的话，人们希望习近平能效仿邓小平的告诫，把问题“搁置一段时间 ” ， 让“更聪明”的下一代能够“找到各方都能接受的办法。 ”
en: In that case, one hopes that Xi will follow Deng Xiaoping’s counsel and allow the issue to be “shelved for some time” so that the “wiser” next generation can “find a solution acceptable to all.”

zh: 如今，这看起来颇有现实可能性。
en: That now seems to be a realistic possibility.

zh: 事实上，最近习近平的口风有所软化，外交路线也许也会如此。
en: Indeed, lately Xi seems to have softened his tone, if not necessarily his diplomatic line.

zh: 比如，他允许中国前国家主席之女李小林会晤安倍。 李小林和安倍晋三一起在东京观看了中国舞蹈团表演。
en: For example, he allowed Li Xiaolin, the daughter of a former Chinese president, to meet with Abe, with whom she watched a performance by a visiting Chinese dance troupe in Tokyo.

zh: 中国国务院总理李克强也在最近的米兰亚欧会议上和安倍握了手。
en: And Chinese Prime Minister Li Keqiang shook hands with Abe at the recent Asia-Europe Meeting in Milan.

zh: 安倍晋三和习近平最近表现出灵活姿态，这或许反映了两国国内政局的变化，保守派、民族主义阵营和更加国际导向的商业利益之间形成了更平等的平衡。
en: One reason for Abe and Xi’s newfound flexibility may be domestic political shifts in both countries, which have created a more equal balance between conservative, nationalist groups and more internationally-oriented business interests.

zh: 过去两年中，两位领导人都在克服国内反对派和巩固权力，如今他们或许已经有了形成妥协的信心。
en: With both leaders having spent the last two years overcoming domestic opponents and consolidating their power, they may have gained confidence in their ability to compromise.

zh: 在日本，安倍晋三内阁同意扩大自卫权，以此满足保守派支持者。
en: In Japan, Abe has satisfied his conservative supporters with cabinet resolutions to allow for expanded self-defense.

zh: 尽管日本国内对其新安全思想仍有诸多反对，但已没有有影响力的政治集团能够对安倍的方针形成有效挑战。
en: Despite domestic opposition to Japan’s new security doctrine, no politically influential group was able to organize an effective challenge to Abe’s approach.

zh: 如今，随着日本经济复苏势头停滞，日本商界开始向安倍政府施压要求更加努力地缓和与中国关系的恶化。
en: Now, as Japan’s economic recovery stalls, the country’s business sector seems to be pressuring Abe’s government to work harder to mitigate the impact of its deteriorating relationship with China.

zh: 中国政府报告称，2014年上半年日本对华直接投资比去年同期降低了近50 % — —这清楚地表明日本商界领袖十分担心日本第二大市场的未来。
en: According to a Chinese government report, in the first half of 2014, Japanese direct investment in China was almost 50% lower than during the same period last year – a clear sign that Japanese business leaders fear for the future in Japan’s second largest market.

zh: 与此同时，在中国，习近平通过其大规模反腐运动而获得了很大信心，对顶级军官的处罚表明他已经掌握了解放军控制权。
en: Meanwhile, in China, Xi has gained considerable confidence through his massive anti-corruption campaign, with the punishment of top military officers indicating that he has solidified his control over the People’s Liberation Army (PLA).

zh: 因此，习近平也许认为现在有了更多空间处理中国经济减速的问题，包括减轻因与日本交恶而导致的伤害。
en: As a result, Xi may believe that he now has more space to address the country’s economic slowdown, including by lessening the damage wrought by weakening ties with Japan.

zh: 如果这一分析正确，显然下一个问题是安倍晋三和习近平是否能朝着改善的方向走多远，取悦商界又不失去民族主义者的支持。 后者视中日双边关系为零和博弈。
en: If this assessment is accurate, the obvious next question is how much further Abe and Xi can move toward détente, thereby appeasing their business sectors, without losing the backing of nationalists, who tend to view the bilateral relationship as a zero-sum game.

zh: 对安倍晋三来说，他面临的选择是是否降温民族主义口风、软化在争议历史问题上的立场。
en: For Abe, the choice is whether to tone down his nationalist rhetoric and moderate his position on contentious historical issues.

zh: 这将包括停止前往有争议的靖国神社（供奉14名二战后被处决的甲级战犯 ） 、 放弃对被迫为日本皇军提供性服务的韩国“慰安妇”的修正主义立场。
en: This would include halting visits to the controversial Yasukuni shrine (which honors, among others, 14 Class A war criminals who were executed after World War II) and abandoning revisionism regarding the Korean “comfort women” who were forced to provide sexual services to the Japanese Imperial Army.

zh: 安倍会如何决定也许取决于他对其政治处境的信心。
en: How Abe decides is likely to depend on his confidence in his political position.

zh: 类似地，如果习近平对其控制解放军和名符其实地追求中国官方的“和平发展”政策有足够信心，他可以采取邓小平所提出的审慎方针。
en: Similarly, if Xi remains confident enough in his control of the PLA and truly follows China’s official policy of “peaceful development,” he will be able to take the kind of prudent approach that Deng advocated.

zh: 这将包括认清和尝试缓解中国崛起所引起的邻国恐慌（如俾斯麦在1871年德国统一后所做的那样 ） 。
en: This would entail recognizing and trying to assuage the fears that China’s rise is causing among its neighbors, as Otto von Bismarck did after German unification in 1871.

zh: 观察者将把他最近缓和对日本（还有越南）关系的措施视为真正的战略变化，而不仅是临时性战术调整。
en: Observers might then read his recent efforts to improve relations with Japan, not to mention Vietnam, as a genuine strategic shift, rather than a temporary tactical adjustment.

zh: 在这一不确定的环境下，APEC峰会将为人们提供急需的信息洞察安���晋三和习近平的意图，从而一窥中日关系乃至东亚未来走向的关键线索。
en: In this uncertain context, the APEC summit could shed much-needed light on the intentions of Abe and Xi, thereby providing crucial insight into the trajectory of Sino-Japanese relations – and thus the future of East Asia.

zh: 普罗大众的经济学
en: A People’s Economics

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 我们正置身于一场通俗经济学的大潮之中：一切关于经济学的书籍、文章，博客和演讲无不受到普罗大众的热烈追捧。
en: NEW HAVEN – We are in the midst of a boom in popular economics: books, articles, blogs, public lectures, all followed closely by the general public.

zh: 在最近召开的美国经济学会丹佛年会中，笔者恰好参与了一场关于该现象的小组讨论。
en: I recently participated in a panel discussion of this phenomenon at the American Economic Association annual meeting in Denver.

zh: 而小组成员们都意识到了某种矛盾现象：通俗经济学的兴起恰恰是与人们对专业经济学家的不信任同时出现的，因为绝大多数经济学家都未能预见（甚至仅仅是警觉）这场自大萧条以来最大规模的经济危机。
en: An apparent paradox emerged from the discussion: the boom in popular economics comes at a time when the general public seems to have lost faith in professional economists, because almost all of us failed to predict, or even warn of, the current economic crisis, the biggest since the Great Depression.

zh: 既然如此，大众又为何大肆购买由专业经济学家撰写的书籍呢？
en: So, why is the public buying more books by professional economists?

zh: 对此我听到的最有趣的解释是经济学之所以显得更有趣，是因为它似乎不再是一门完美和封闭的学科。
en: The most interesting explanation I heard was that economics has become more interesting, because it no longer seems to be a finished and closed discipline.

zh: 如果有一本书告诉你说经济预测最好交由电脑模型去完成，而作为一个普通读者，你必须拥有一个博士学位才能搞懂这些模型，那该是多么沉闷乏味啊。
en: It is no fun to read a book or article that says that economic forecasting is best left to computer models that you, the general reader, would need a Ph.D. to understand.

zh: 但事实上，公众是对的：虽然这些模型都或多或少地有科学依据支撑，但它们却依然铸成大错。
en: And, in truth, the public is right: while there is a somewhat scientific basis for these models, they can go spectacularly wrong.

zh: 可见有时我们最好关掉自动导航仪并动动自己的脑子，尤其是当危机降临时启用一下自身完美的人类智慧。
en: Sometimes we need to turn off autopilot and think for ourselves, and when a crisis occurs, use our best human intellect.

zh: 而有一点得到了在座所有讨论者的同意：通俗经济学已经成为了专业经济学家与普罗大众进行交流的媒介 — — 而这种交流正体现出前所未有的重要性。
en: The panelists all said, in one way or another, that popular economics facilitates an exchange between specialized economists and the broader public – a dialogue that has never been more important.

zh: 毕竟大多数经济学家之所以未能预见危机的来临，就是因为他们已经与真实世界中人们的想法和行动完全脱节了。
en: After all, most economists did not see this crisis coming in part because they had removed themselves from what real-world people were doing and thinking.

zh: 成功的通俗经济学实践将读者或者听众视为一个参与者。
en: Successful popular economics involves the reader or listener, in some sense, as a collaborator.

zh: 很显然，这意味着经济学家必须乐于接纳某些还未被专家学者们普遍认可的原创性理论。
en: That, of course, means that economists must be willing to include new and original theories that are not yet received doctrine among professional specialists.

zh: 直到最近，许多专业经济学家依然不愿提笔去写一本通俗读物。
en: Until recently, many professional economists would be reluctant to write a popular book.

zh: 毕竟这么一本东西显然无法成为获取教职或晋升的可靠依据。
en: Certainly, it would not be viewed favorably in considering a candidate for tenure or a promotion.

zh: 估计那些评审委员会的人会认为，由于书中并未包含任何方程或统计图表，因此也不能算是一项有学术价值的严谨工作。
en: Since it does not include equations or statistical tables, they would argue, it is not serious work that is worthy of scholarly attention.

zh: 更糟的是，直到最近，一个负责评价经济学家的委员会甚至认为撰写一本与经典理论有不同观点的通俗经济学读物在专业上是不道德的。
en: Worse than that, at least until recently, a committee evaluating an economist would likely think that writing a popular economics book that does not repeat the received wisdom of the discipline might even be professionally unethical.

zh: 当然，试想如果你是一个医学界专业人士，你会如何看待那些将某种未经权威部门认可的疗法向大众推广的同僚？
en: Imagine how the medical profession would view one of its members who recommended to the general public some therapy that had not yet passed scrutiny from the appropriate authorities.

zh: 无数看似前途无量的新疗法都在严谨研究中被证明无效甚至有害，这是行内共识。
en: Medical professionals know how often seemingly promising new therapies turn out, after careful study, not to work, or even to be harmful.

zh: 医学界对新疗法的有一套严谨慎密的学术评价机制，并与高水准的专业刊物紧密结合。
en: There is a rigorous process of scholarly review of proposed new therapies, associated with professional journals that uphold high research standards.

zh: 任何绕过该程序向公众推广未经测试的新理念的做法都是违反职业道德的。
en: Circumventing that process and promoting new, untested ideas to the general public is unprofessional.

zh: 而在这场危机爆发前的几十年间，经济学家们也用以上述标准来看待自己和本专业的，而研究趋势的发展也促进了这一点。
en: In the decades prior to the current financial crisis, economists gradually came to view themselves and their profession in the same way, encouraged by research trends.

zh: 比如说，当芝加哥大学在1960年发明了一个可以系统容纳数百万只股票的价格信息的通用计算机磁带之后，一大批科学研究开始利用该信息来证实“有效市场假说 ” 。
en: For example, after 1960, when the University of Chicago started creating a Univac computer tape that contained systematic information about millions of stock prices, a great deal of scientific research on the properties of stock prices was taken as confirming the “efficient markets hypothesis.”

zh: 科学家们发现某种存在于证券交易所中的竞争性力量似乎迫使所有股票价格向它们的真实价值靠拢。
en: The competitive forces that underlie stock exchanges were seen to force all securities prices to their true fundamental values.

zh: 于是所有不以此假说为基础的交易计划都被视为愚蠢或是居心不良。
en: All trading schemes not based on this hypothesis were labeled as either misguided or outright frauds.

zh: 科学在股票市场理论上大获全胜 — — 至少看上去是这样。
en: Science had triumphed over stock-market punditry – or so it seemed.

zh: 但随之而来的金融危机给那些过度自信的科学经济学家一个响亮的耳光。
en: The financial crisis delivered a fatal blow to that overconfidence in scientific economics.

zh: 问题不仅仅是专家们未能预测危机，而是他们那些模型有时甚至推算这么一场大灾是不可能发生的。
en: It is not just that the profession didn’t forecast the crisis. Their models, taken literally, sometimes suggested that a crisis of this magnitude couldn’t happen.

zh: 对此的一个解释就是经济学界并未充分理解经济中人的要素 — — 一种不能被简化为数学分析的要素。
en: One way to interpret this is that the economics profession was not fully accounting for the economy’s human element, an element that can’t be reduced to mathematical analysis.

zh: 而那一小部分对本次危机发出警告的专业经济学家则是这么一批人：他们不但饱读经济学文献，也不忘进行个人判断：凭直觉将当前状况与某些历史场景相比较；对投机买卖，价格泡沫和市场信心下结论；对经济参与者的道德目的进行衡量；发现市场已经过度自信，连监管者都松懈了。
en: The relatively few professional economists who warned of the current crisis were people, it seems, who not only read the scholarly economics literature, but also brought into play more personal judgment: intuitive comparisons with past historical episodes; conclusions about speculative trading, price bubbles, and the stability of confidence; evaluations of the moral purposes of economic actors; and impressions that complacency had set in, lulling watchdogs to sleep.

zh: 这些判断来自于那些熟知商界人士老底 — — 他们那些诡计、信条，花招和辩词 — — 的经济学家。
en: These were judgments made by economists who were familiar with our business leadership – their inspirations, beliefs, subterfuges, and rationalizations.

zh: 这些学者的观点永远不可能在学术刊物上发表，或者受到像新医学疗法那样的严谨待遇。
en: Their views could never be submitted to a scholarly journal and evaluated the way a new medical procedure is.

zh: 根本没有任何已有的科学程序能证明这些观点的有效性。
en: There is no established scientific procedure that could prove their validity.

zh: 当然，经济学在许多方面都确实是一门科学，而这些学者及其计算机程序的贡献也不可抹杀。
en: Of course, economics is in many ways a science, and the work of our scholars and their computer models really does matter.

zh: 但正如经济学家埃德温·R·A·塞利格曼在1889年所说的那样 ： “ 经济学是一门社会科学，换言之，它关注的是伦理（译者注：正如不同的社会发展形态产生不同的经济伦理）并因此是一门研究事物在某段时期内发展状况的科学 … … 它不属于自然科学，因此也不是一门严谨或者纯粹的抽象科学。 ”
en: But, as the economist Edwin R. A. Seligman put it in 1889, “Economics is a social science, i.e., it is an ethical and therefore an historical science….It is not a natural science, and therefore not an exact or purely abstract science.”

zh: 对笔者本人以及在座的其他论者来说，对经济学不确定一面的探索就是要与公众真诚地展开对话，深入他们的内心，从他们身上学习，阅读他们发来的邮件，并扪心自问：我最推崇的理论是否真的接近现实？
en: To me, and no doubt to the other panelists, part of the process of pursuing the inexact aspects of economics is speaking honestly to the broader public, looking them in the eye, learning from them, reading the emails they send, and then searching one’s soul to decide whether one’s favored theory is really close to the truth.

zh: 幽灵式的复苏?
en: A Phantom Recovery?

zh: 纽约 — —
en: One camp argued that the recession in the United States would be V-shaped – short and shallow. It would last only eight months, like the two previous recessions of 1990-1991 and 2001, and the world would decouple from the US contraction.

zh: 一种观点认为，此次危机是V型 — — 时间短，程度浅。 时间大概仅仅持续8个月。
en: Others, including me, argued that, given the excesses of private-sector leverage (in households, financial institutions, and corporate firms), this would be a U-shaped recession – long and deep.

zh: 就像1990-1991年和2001年发生的两次危机那样。 世界经济不会受到美国衰退的影响。
en: It would last about 24 months, and the world would not decouple from the US contraction.

zh: 另一种观点认为，这当然也包括我的看法，考虑到私营经济（例如家庭，金融机构和公司等）的金融杠杆过度使用，此次危机可能是U型 — — 这意味这持续的时间长而且程度很深。
en: Today, 20 months into the US recession – a recession that became global in the summer of 2008 with a massive re-coupling – the V-shaped decoupling view is out the window. This is the worst US and global recession in 60 years.

zh: 时间的跨度是24个月。 美国的衰退也将拖累整个世界的经济。
en: If the US recession were – as most likely - to be over at the end of the year, as is likely, it will have been three times as long and about fives times as deep – in term of the cumulative decline in output – as the previous two.

zh: 如今，在美国危机发生的20个月之后，从 2008年夏天开始，全球经济形势变得不可收拾，V型的观点不攻自破。 这也是美国乃至全球60年以来最糟糕的一次经济危机。
en: Today’s consensus among economists is that the recession is already over, that the US and global economy will rapidly return to growth, and that there is no risk of a relapse.

zh: 如果美国危机（很有可能在）在今年年底结束，那么和前两次的危机相比，此次危机持续的时间有3倍之长，如果以衰退的产值来计算的话，衰退的程度有5倍之深。
en: Unfortunately, this new consensus could be as wrong now as the defenders of the V-shaped scenario were for the past three years.

zh: 如今在经济界似乎有这么一种共识，大家都认为衰退已经过去。
en: Data from the US – rising unemployment, falling household consumption, still declining industrial production, and a weak housing market – suggest that America’s recession is not over yet.

zh: 美国乃至全球的经济将迅速复苏，不会再出现反复。
en: A similar analysis of many other advanced economies suggests that, as in the US, the bottom is quite close but it has not yet been reached.

zh: 不幸的是，这种共识同样是错误的，就像过去三年那种V型的观点那样。
en: Most emerging economies may be returning to growth, but they are performing well below their potential.

zh: 美国目前已经公布的数据 — — 这包括上升的失业率，下降的居民家庭消费，工业产品的产量仍然在下降，房市依然疲软 — — 显示美国的衰退目前还没有结束。 在其他一些工业国家的经济研究结果显示，目前美国的经济已经接近谷底，但还没有到最低点。
en: Moreover, for a number of reasons, growth in the advanced economies is likely to remain anemic and well below trend for at least a couple of years.

zh: 原因之一是：居民家庭需要减少透支，增加储蓄，这就会对拉动消费产生影响，从而会拖经济的后腿。
en: The first reason is likely to create a long-term drag on growth: households need to deleverage and save more, which will constrain consumption for years.

zh: 第二就是金融体系 — — 这包括银行和其他金融机构 — — 几近摧毁。
en: Second, the financial system – both banks and non-bank institutions – is severely damaged.

zh: 没有活跃信贷的支持，私营经济的消费和投资就是无本之源。
en: Lack of robust credit growth will hamper private consumption and investment spending.

zh: 第三，公司产品滞销，经济疲软导致利润缩水，通缩的压力仍然存在。
en: Third, the corporate sector faces a glut of capacity, and a weak recovery of profitability is likely if growth is anemic and deflationary pressures still persist.

zh: 投资自然不会好到那里去。
en: As a result, businesses are not likely to increase capital spending.

zh: 第四，政府以财政赤字和债务为代价拉动私营经济的复苏，不过这也不是长久之计。
en: Fourth, the re-leveraging of the public sector through large fiscal deficits and debt accumulation risks crowding out a recovery in private-sector spending.

zh: 到明年年初就会弹尽粮绝。 这就需要更大的内需来支持持续的增长。
en: The effects of the policy stimulus, moreover, will fizzle out by early next year, requiring greater private demand to support continued growth.

zh: 私人家庭的需求，特别是在消费方面，在过渡透支的国家（美英，西班牙，爱尔兰，澳大利亚，新西兰等）依然持续下滑，相当疲软。 对那些储蓄较高的国家（中国，亚洲，德国和日本等）来说，增长的速度也没有想象的那么快，没法弥补出口下滑带来的影响。
en: Domestic private demand, especially consumption, is now weak or falling in over-spending countries (the US, the United Kingdom, Spain, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, etc.), while not increasing fast enough in over-saving countries (China, Asia, Germany, Japan, etc.) to compensate for the reduction in these countries’ net exports.

zh: 全球性萧条加上产能过剩阻碍了经济的复苏。
en: Thus, there is a global slackening of aggregate demand relative to the glut of supply capacity, which will impede a robust global economic recovery.

zh: 如何避免第二次危机的发生，我们还有两个因素需要考虑。
en: There are also now two reasons to fear a double-dip recession.

zh: 第一，政府继续加大财政和金融的投资的问题，不管做与不做，都不会有什么好结果。
en: First, the exit strategy from monetary and fiscal easing could be botched, because policymakers are damned if they do and damned if they don’t.

zh: 如果为了消除巨额赤��而增税，减少支出，消除过度的信贷，这对微弱的复苏来说就是雪上加霜。
en: If they take their fiscal deficits (and a potential monetization of these deficits) seriously and raise taxes, reduce spending, and mop up excess liquidity, they could undermine the already weak recovery.

zh: 如果政府继续加大投入，财政赤字就会不断增加。 这么一来，债券市场就会出问题了。
en: But if they maintain large budget deficits and continue to monetize them, at some point – after the current deflationary forces become more subdued – bond markets will revolt.

zh: 通胀就会变得不可避免。 长期政府债券利率上升，复苏就无从谈起。
en: At this point, inflationary expectations will increase, long-term government bond yields will rise, and the recovery will be crowded out.

zh: 第二个问题是，在资金流向固定资产和投机的双重推动下，原油，能源和食品的价格持续上涨。
en: A second reason to fear a double-dip recession concerns the fact that oil, energy, and food prices may be rising faster than economic fundamentals warrant, and could be driven higher by the wall of liquidity chasing assets, as well as by speculative demand.

zh: 去年每桶145美元的油价对世界经济有很大的冲击，特别是对美国，欧洲，日本，中国，印度和其他石油进口国来说。
en: Last year, oil at $145 a barrel was a tipping point for the global economy, as it created a major income shock for the US, Europe, Japan, China, India, and other oil-importing economies.

zh: 对目前极其脆弱的经济来说，如果由于投机使得原油达到100美元一桶，那无疑是雪上加霜的打击。
en: The global economy, barely rising from its knees, could not withstand the contractionary shock if similar speculative forces were to drive oil rapidly towards $100 a barrel.

zh: 如此说来，全球萧条目前还没有结束，预计可能到今年年底有所好转。 对于发达国家而言，复苏的速度是缓慢的，而且危机很有可能再次发生。
en: So the end of this severe global recession will be closer at the end of this year than it is now, the recovery will be anemic rather than robust in advanced economies, and there is a rising risk of a double-dip recession.

zh: 目前，股市，商品市场和信贷市场的复苏可能比实体经济好一些。
en: The recent market rallies in stocks, commodities, and credit may have gotten ahead of the improvement in the real economy.

zh: 如果这样的话，全球经济的复苏就为期不远了。
en: If so, a correction cannot be too far behind.

zh: 以人民为轴心
en: A Pivot to the People

zh: 发自普林斯顿 — — 联合国安理会在2月1日召开会议，共同审议阿拉伯联盟要求制止叙利亚暴力行动的提案。
en: PRINCETON – On February 1, the United Nations Security Council met to consider the Arab League’s proposal to end the violence in Syria.

zh: 其中美国方面的与会代表是国务卿希拉里。
en: Secretary of State Hillary Clinton represented the United States.

zh: 在发言进行到一半的时候，她绕开在场的叙利亚大使甚至是叙利亚政府，开始直接向叙利亚人民喊话。
en: Midway through her remarks, she began speaking not to the Syrian ambassador, who was in the room, or even the Syrian government, but directly to the Syrian people.

zh: 她说发生在叙利亚的这场变革需要所有不同宗教信仰和民族的叙利亚人齐心协力，共同维护和尊重少数群体的权利
en: She said that change in Syria would require Syrians of every faith and ethnicity to work together, protecting and respecting the rights of minorities.

zh: 谈到这些少数群体时，她继续说 ： “ 我们听说了你们的恐惧和遭遇，更向你们的理想致以敬意。
en: Addressing those minorities, she continued: “We do hear your fears, and we do honor your aspirations.

zh: 不要让现政权借此将危机扩大化 ” 。
en: Do not let the current regime exploit them to extend this crisis.”

zh: 希拉里还提醒叙利亚商界，军队以及其他领域的大佬们，他们的未来取决于这个国家，而不是某个政权。
en: She told Syria’s business, military, and other leaders that they must recognize that their futures lie with the state, not with the regime.

zh: “叙利亚属于2300万叙利亚人民，而不是某个领导人及其家族。 ”
en: “Syria belongs to its 23 million citizens, not to one man or his family.”

zh: 直接向某个国家的民众喊话 — — 不但与该国政府对话，还与其民众交流 — — 可不仅仅是某种辩论手段。
en: Speaking directly to citizens – seeing a country’s people, as well as its government – is not just a rhetorical device.

zh: 当许多外交研究专家都在关注美国的“亚洲轴心”策略之时，希拉里同时也启动了一个曝光较少但重要性丝毫不减的“人民轴心”策略。
en: While many foreign-policy pundits have focused on the US “pivot to Asia,” Clinton has also executed a less-publicized, but no less important, pivot to the people.

zh: 在实施传统政府间外交的同时，她还引入了一系列鼓励政府-社会以及社会间外交的政策，项目以及机构改革。
en: She has introduced policies, programs, and institutional reforms designed to support government-to-society and society-to-society diplomacy, alongside traditional government-to-government relations.

zh: 这些动议并未得到媒体的大肆报道，却会逐渐令许多美国外交政策发生转变。
en: These initiatives do not get headlines, but they will gradually transform much of American foreign policy.

zh: 在今年1月，美国国务院创立了一个专责平民安全，民主和人权的新“超级办公室 ” ， 由国务卿助理玛利亚·奥特洛（Maria Otero）领导。
en: In January, the State Department unveiled a new “super-office” of Civilian Security, Democracy, and Human Rights, under the leadership of Under-Secretary Maria Otero.

zh: 该办公室把那些主要负责执行国际法，反恐事务和重建与维持稳定的机构与其他用于推动民主，人权和难（移）民人道主义援助的机构全部整合在了一起。
en: The office brings together agencies that focus on international law enforcement, counter-terrorism, and reconstruction and stabilization with those charged with advancing democracy, human rights, and humanitarian assistance to refugees and migrants.

zh: 奥特洛将设立此办公室的背后理念解释为“保护每一个个体 ” 。
en: Otero explains the logic behind the initiative in terms of “protecting individuals.”

zh: 这反过来意味着“不仅参于国与国之间层面（的互动 ） ” ，还要与“我们传统外交渠道之外的参与者们合作。 ”
en: That, in turn, requires “not just engaging state to state,” but also working “with players and actors outside of the traditional [channels] we’ve engaged in.”

zh: 从这个角度看，反恐就必须涵盖一个驳斥恐怖分子宣传的战略性沟通交流行动。
en: Viewed from this perspective, countering terrorism includes rebutting terrorist propaganda with a strategic communications campaign.

zh: 反贩毒帮派就意味着和墨西���电信大亨卡洛斯·斯利姆（Carlos Slim）合作，开发可以让普通市民匿名短信举报暴力行为并有利于警方定位罪行发生地点的通信手段。
en: Countering narco-gang violence includes working with Mexican telecommunications mogul Carlos Slim to develop tools that allow ordinary citizens to report violence anonymously by text message and enable police to map the results.

zh: 加强民主则要与肯尼亚程序开发者一同建立一个危机地图定位平台，让每一个有手机的民众都可以把选举舞弊行为或暴力事件发送短信报告给中央监控中心。
en: Strengthening democracy means working with the Kenyan developers of a crisis-mapping platform that allows anyone with a cell phone to text information about election fraud or violence to a central monitoring station.

zh: 在理解不同国家国情的基础上 ， “ 人民轴心”意味着不但要和执政的埃及武装力量最高委员会打交道，还要和民间的博客作者们交流；召集突尼斯，阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥等地的企业家并给予他们资助和指导；利用俄罗斯的社交媒体去反驳该国政府对美国大使的污蔑之辞。
en: On a country-by-country basis, pivoting to the people means engaging with Egypt’s bloggers as well as with the ruling Supreme Council of the Armed Forces; convening young entrepreneurs in Tunisia, Algeria, and Morocco and connecting them to funding and mentoring; and using social media in Russia to rebut government efforts to smear the US ambassador.

zh: 同时在官方层面还要和巴西一起联合建立“公开政府伙伴关系 ” ， 将那些致力于提升透明度，官员负责制和公民参与的政府集合在一起，利用互相监督以及公开报道来促使它们兑现自己的承诺。
en: And, working at an official level, it means co-sponsoring with Brazil the Open Government Partnership, which brings together governments committed to increasing transparency, accountability, and citizen participation, and uses mutual peer pressure and open reporting to hold them to their commitments.

zh: 利用这些综合性条件来分析那些国家也提供了一个截然不同的战略视角。
en: Thinking about countries in these comprehensive terms also provides a different strategic perspective.

zh: 希拉里在国务院设立了一系列新职位来鼓励与不同社会群体之间的沟通。
en: Clinton has created a raft of new positions at the State Department to spur outreach to different social segments.

zh: 比如全球妇女事务大使、全球青年事务特别顾问、公民社会及新兴民主国家高级顾问，穆斯林社区沟通特别代表、全球伙伴关系特别代表，还有商业与企业事务特别代表，而这些负责人所各自设立的战略和项目也往往能体现出美国完全不同的一个侧面。
en: The strategies and programs developed by the Ambassador for Global Women’s Issues, the Special Adviser for Global Youth Issues, the Senior Adviser for Civil Society and Emerging Democracies, the Special Representative for Outreach to Muslim Communities, the Special Representative for Global Partnerships, and the Special Representative for Commercial and Business Affairs often present a very different face of the US.

zh: 凭借着上述举措，希拉里发起了一场与公民社会的实质性战略对话。
en: As a result, Clinton has launched an actual strategic dialogue with civil society.

zh: 比如全球妇女事务大使梅兰妮·华威尔（Melanne Verveer）已经在全球范围内参加了超过1000场讨论从和平谈判到农业方面赋予妇女权力的会议。
en: For example, Ambassador Melanne Verveer has attended more than 1,000 events around the world focused on empowering women in areas ranging from peace negotiations to farming.

zh: 同样，她也发起了诸如“mWomen（移动女性 ） ” 这样的项目，致力于扩展和支持相关手机技术，使妇女可以借此提升自身独立地位和个人安全，并借手机了解医疗卫生和其他有用知识。
en: Similarly, she has launched programs such as mWomen, designed to expand and support mobile technology that increases women’s independence, security, and access to health care and vital knowledge.

zh: 全球青年事务办公室在所有美国大使馆都建立了一个本地青年委员会，负责提供顾问建议并帮助大使馆实施针对当地青年群体的政策项目。
en: The Office of Global Youth Affairs is building a local youth council at every US embassy around the world, to advise and help to implement embassy programming aimed at local youth.

zh: 大部分关注青年、妇女、企业家、国外犹太人，技术人员以及其他社会群体的规划都在一定程度上得到私人部门的资助和执行。
en: Much of the programming aimed at youth, women, entrepreneurs, diasporas, technologists, and other social groups is partly funded and conducted by the private sector.

zh: 事实上，奥巴马政府出台的《国家安全战略》中就不下30次地提到了“公私伙伴关系”这个词。
en: Indeed, the Obama administration’s National Security Strategy mentions “public-private partnerships” more than 30 times.

zh: 希拉里创设了全球伙伴关系计划去尽可能多地与企业、基金会、非政府组织，大学以及其他市民组织建立联盟，网络和伙伴关系。
en: Clinton created the Global Partnership Initiative to build as many coalitions, networks, and partnerships as possible with corporations, foundations, NGOs, universities, and other civic organizations.

zh: 当然 ， “ 人民轴心”也不会将美国人排除在外：美国商界和非营利组织的活力，创造性和资源已经遍布全球。
en: Here, the pivot to the people includes the American people: the dynamism, creativity, and resources of American business and non-profit organizations already engaged around the world.

zh: 一个由国务院牵头，私人资助的项目将于今年春天向日本运输300棵漆树并种植在受海啸影响的地域和东京，以表达美国人民对日本人民的支持和鼓励；另一个项目则会向东南亚各地派遣美国教师。
en: One privately-funded initiative spearheaded by the State Department will send 300 dogwood trees to Japan this spring, to be planted in the tsunami-affected region and in Tokyo to express the American people’s support for the Japanese people; another will send English teachers throughout Southeast Asia.

zh: 在参加了于突尼斯召开的“叙利亚之友”会议后，希拉里在一个市政厅里与突尼斯青年们进行了谈话。
en: After participating in the Friends of Syria conference in Tunis, Clinton convened a town hall meeting with Tunisian youth.

zh: 她在公开演讲中指出“年轻人才是当今宏大战略机遇和挑战的核心 ” ， 而在谈到自己倾其一生的“国际议程中的妇女赋权”事业时，她还加了一句 ： “ 是时候推动向青年人赋权了。
en: In her opening remarks, she told her audience that “young people are at the heart of today’s great strategic opportunities and challenges.” Speaking about her lifetime efforts to put “women’s empowerment on the international agenda,” she added, “It’s time to put youth empowerment there as well.”

zh: 上述所有行动的含义，也就是希拉里所说的“21世纪治国手段 ” ， 是极为深刻的。
en: The implications of all of this activity, which Clinton calls “twenty-first-century statecraft,” are profound.

zh: 从今往后，美国与其他国家的外交关系将包括与别国人民直接接触并尽可能地把他们和美国人民联系起来。
en: From now on, US diplomatic relations with other countries will engage directly with their people and connect them to the American people as much as possible.

zh: 从美国外交人员的视角来看，每个国家的人民都跟他们的政府拥有同样重要的地位。
en: From the perspective of US diplomats, the people of every country stand on the same footing as their government.

zh: 这一假设既是民主的核心；也是一场外交上的革命。
en: That assumption is the heart of democracy; it is a revolution for diplomacy.

zh: 属于所有人猿的星球
en: A Planet for All Apes

zh: 发自墨尔本 — — 本月上线的两部电影 — — 一部是科幻大片，另一部则是纪录片 — — 都涉及到大猩猩这种与我们人类亲缘最近的灵长类动物，并用戏剧手段将某些不应被忽视的感悟和教训昭示在我们面前。
en: MELBOURNE – Two new movies released this month – one a science-fiction blockbuster, the other a revealing documentary – raise the issue of our relations with our closest non-human relatives, the great apes. Both dramatize insights and lessons that should not be ignored.

zh: 鲁伯特·怀亚特执导的这部《人猿星球的崛起》是根据皮埃尔·布尔1963年发表的小说《人猿星球 》 — —讲述一个居住着高智商类人猿的世界 — — 改编的第七部电影，并将其宣传为“电影史上第一部由有知觉的动物担任主角，并通过其角度来讲述的实景拍摄电影。
en: Rupert Wyatt’s Rise of the Planet of the Apes is the seventh film in a series based on Pierre Boule’s 1963 novel, Planet of the Apes, about a world populated by highly intelligent simians. Publicity for the new film claims that it is “the first live-action film in the history of movies to star, and be told from the point of view of, a sentient animal.”

zh: ”但名为实拍，却没有一只真的猩猩参与演出。
en: Yet no live apes were used.

zh: 相反，最早为《阿凡达》所研发“动作捕捉技术”使一个像安迪·瑟金斯这样的人类演员不必再大费周章化妆成大猩猩，单凭做出动作和面部表情就可以扮演剧中的人猿“凯撒 ” ， 甚至连他眉毛的一丝抽动都能转换成人猿的相关动作。
en: Instead, “performance capture technology,” originally invented for the movie Avatar, enables a human actor, Andy Serkis, to play the role of the chimpanzee Caesar, not by dressing in a chimp suit, but by having every gesture and facial movement, even the twitch of an eyebrow, transformed into the movement of an ape.

zh: 当我上个月和怀亚特交流的时候，他承认不使用真正的大猩猩是有操作上的因素的。
en: When I spoke with Wyatt last month, he acknowledged that there were practical reasons for not using real apes in his movie.

zh: 但他同时也表示理解其中的伦理问题。
en: But he also understood the ethical issue.

zh: “有些东西是我不想触及的 ， ” 他对我说 ， “ 如果想让大猩猩听你的指挥，那么你就得支配它们；你必须操纵它们去表演，这是剥削行为。
en: “There are things I didn’t want to be involved in,” he told me. “To get apes to do anything you want them to do, you have to dominate them; you have to manipulate them into performing.
That’s exploitative.”

zh: 如果考虑到这部电影就是讲述人猿如何起义反对人类压迫的，那么就不难理解怀亚特对这种剥削大猩猩行为的犹豫不决。
en: Wyatt’s reluctance to join in the exploitation of great apes is understandable, given that the film itself tells the story of apes rising up in response to oppression from dominant humans.

zh: 片中最重要的人类角色威尔·罗德曼（由詹姆斯·弗朗克扮演）是一位用人猿作实验品来寻找老年痴呆症疗法的科学家。
en: The central human character, Will Rodman (played by James Franco), is a scientist seeking a cure for Alzheimer’s disease who experiments on apes.

zh: 许多电影都会对这样的科学家大加赞颂，并认为使用动物为此目标服务的做法理所当然。
en: Many films would have glorified a scientist seeking such a goal, and treated the use of animals for that purpose as obviously justified.

zh: 而《人猿星球的崛起》这部影片却借弗朗科的台词将罗德曼描绘成一个“冷漠，孤立的人 ” 。
en: Rise of the Planet of the Apes, however, portrays Rodman as, in Franco’s words, “a cold, isolated person.”

zh: 只有在上级撤销了相关实验，而罗德曼将幼小的大猩猩“凯撒”带回家时这位科学家才开始有了关爱之心。
en: Only when Rodman’s superiors cancel his experiments and he takes home Caesar, an infant chimpanzee, does the scientist begin to care about others.

zh: 随后情节一转，凯撒不断长大以致无法再住在人类家里，并将被送到一个名为灵长类动物庇护中心，实为由那些虐待动物的人类所经营，专门处理那些失去利用价值的大猩猩的地方。
en: The plot then takes another turn when Caesar becomes too big and aggressive to live in a human home, and is taken to what is supposed to be a primate sanctuary, but is in fact a dumping ground for unwanted apes, run by humans who display cruelty to the captive animals.

zh: 就大猩猩在片中所受到的待遇来看，这部电影的大部分内容都是来源于现实的，正如《尼姆计划》这部基于伊丽莎白·赫斯的著作《尼姆·猩猩斯基：一只可能是人类的黑猩猩》的记录片所明确表述的那样。
en: As far as the treatment of apes is concerned, much of the film is firmly grounded in reality, as a viewing of Project Nim, a documentary based on Elizabeth Hess’s book Nim Chimpsky: The Chimp Who Would be Human, clearly demonstrates.

zh: 片中的黑猩猩尼姆于1973年出生于美国俄克拉荷马州的一个灵长类动物庇护中心，出生10天都就被从它母亲手中夺走用以进行一项手语实验研究。
en: Nim was born in 1973, in a primate research facility in Oklahoma, and was taken from his mother when he was only ten days old, to be used in a sign-language experiment.

zh: 在一个人类家庭中养大的尼姆学会了使用100个美式聋哑人手语的手势。
en: Reared as part of a human family, he learned to use more than 100 signs from American Sign Language, the language used by Deaf Americans.

zh: 但随后它又被从第一个人类家庭移交到其他跟它缺乏养育关系的导师手里。
en: But he was taken from his first human family and handed over to other teachers with whom he did not have the same kind of bond.

zh: 结果它逐渐变得强壮和富有侵略性，甚至开始攻击自己的导师。
en: He grew stronger and more aggressive and began biting his teachers.

zh: 当时主持这个项目的哥伦比亚大学心理学家赫尔伯特·特雷斯决定终止这个项目并将尼姆送回俄克拉荷马的庇护中心。
en: Herbert Terrace, the Columbia University psychologist who was directing the project, decided to end it and sent Nim back to the primate facility in Oklahoma.

zh: 在那里，这只被人类养大，甚至在分辨人类和人猿图片时把自己的照片归在人类行列的黑猩猩被和其他同类锁在一个笼子里。
en: There, the pampered chimpanzee – who, when asked to sort photos of humans and apes, put his own photo among the humans – was locked in a cage with other chimps.

zh: 而它则用“我要出去”的手势向路过的人表明自己对那个情况的观感。
en: He demonstrated his view of that situation by signing “out” to passing humans.

zh: 在最终被释放到一个动物庇护中心前尼姆还遭受了其他不良待遇 — — 甚至差点在一次医学实验中感染肝炎。 它最终在2000年去世。
en: Nim suffered various other vicissitudes – and narrowly escaped being infected with hepatitis as part of a medical experiment – until he was eventually released to an animal sanctuary, where he died in 2000.

zh: 在1993年，帕奥拉·卡瓦利艾里和我联手成立了一名为“大猩猩计划”的组织，致力于使人们认识到大猩猩在本质上都是拥有自我意识的存在，是一种拥有思考能力且感情丰富而深刻的生命，同时也应当拥有与这种本质相适应的道德地位。
en: In 1993, Paola Cavalieri and I founded The Great Ape Project, an organization dedicated to the idea of recognizing that great apes have a moral status befitting their nature as self-aware beings who are capable of thought and have rich and deep emotional lives.

zh: 至少在最低限度上，无论其智力程度高低，这些大猩猩应当如同我们赋予人类所有成员的那样，拥有生存，自主和免遭折磨的权利。
en: At a minimum, they should have the rights to life, liberty, and protection from torture that we grant to all members of our own species, regardless of their intellectual abilities.

zh: 在组织成立以来的这些年，这一理念取得了长足的进步。
en: In the intervening years, that idea has made steady progress.

zh: 自2010年起欧盟彻底禁止利用大猩猩进行试验。
en: Since 2010, the European Union has essentially banned the use of great apes in experiments.

zh: 同类实验在新西兰，澳大利亚和日本都被彻底禁止或者严加监管。
en: Experiments on great apes are now either banned or severely restricted in New Zealand, Australia, and Japan.

zh: 在美国，一个跨党派国会议员团体正在推动立法禁止利用黑猩猩进行任何介入性实验。
en: In the United States, a bipartisan group of members of Congress is supporting legislation to end the use of chimpanzees in invasive research.

zh: 2008年西拔牙通过了一个议会决议敦促政府给于大猩猩某些（人类）基本权利，但政府至今未能实施此决议。
en: In Spain in 2008, a parliamentary resolution urged the government to grant some basic legal rights to great apes, but the Spanish government has yet to implement it.

zh: 或者这两部风格不同的影片的上映会进一步推动将大猩猩划归拥有道德和法定权利的生物范围。
en: Perhaps the release of these two very different films will lead to a further push to bring great apes within the circle of beings with moral and legal rights.

zh: 这样一来，这种与人类亲缘最近的生命才能帮助弥合我们自身与其他动物的道德鸿沟。
en: In that way, our closest relatives could serve to bridge the moral gulf that we have dug between ourselves and other animals.

zh: 以组合拳方式应对气候变化
en: A “Portfolio” Approach to Climate Change

zh: 全世界在《京都议定书》下为降低碳排放所进行的努力迄今为止成效甚微。
en: The world has tried with little success to cut carbon emissions under the Kyoto Protocol.

zh: 为了将《议定书》付诸实施而付出的巨大努力表明要达成预定将于2009年12月通过的下一份协定还将需要付出多少艰辛的工作。
en: The enormous effort expended to bring the Protocol into force nonetheless indicates how much work will be required to produce the next treaty, due to be agreed in Copenhagen in December 2009.

zh: 环保组织要求采取更为严厉和影响深远的政策，但是某些国家为了保证它们自身的经济活力而依然会强烈地抵制采取这些政策。
en: Campaigners will push for tough and far-reaching policies, but strong resistance will continue from countries concerned about their economic vitality.

zh: 新一轮的谈判相比以前所做的努力有一个优势，因为各国政府现在认识到需要在适应、减缓和研究气候变化方面采取组合拳的方式。
en: The new negotiations will have one advantage over the earlier efforts, because governments now understand the need for a portfolio of adaptation, mitigation, and research efforts.

zh: 我和我的同事为丹麦哥本哈根共识中心进行的新研究探讨了对这场全球挑战所采取的不同应对方式的有效性，但是以下几个原因表明采取组合拳方式更为有效。
en: New research that my colleagues and I undertook for the Copenhagen Consensus Center in Denmark explores the effectiveness of different responses to this global challenge, but it strongly supports the portfolio approach for several reasons.

zh: 首先，我们现在知道适应气候变化非常重要，因为即便我们明天就停止温室气体排放，到2100年全球温度还是会再上升0.6°C。
en: First, we now know that adaptation will be essential, because temperatures will rise by another 0.6°C by 2100 even if greenhouse gas emissions are eliminated tomorrow.

zh: 我们还知道气候变化的影响在全球并不是被平均地表现出来的。
en: We also know that the impact of climate change will not be evenly distributed across the globe.

zh: 在某些地区，如果附带产生的降水模式的变化不是负面的以及灌溉依然是可实施的，稍微暖一些的气温能够带来更高的粮食产量。
en: In some areas, modestly warmer temperatures could produce higher crop yields if associated changes in precipitation patterns are not adverse and/or irrigation remains viable.

zh: 即便温度只上升0.6°C，非洲和南亚的许多作物还是几乎会立即出现减产，并且最终会更容易受到传染病的侵袭。
en: Even with 0.6°C warming, however, Africa and South Asia will experience almost immediate reductions in the viability of many crops and, eventually, increased vulnerability to infectious disease.

zh: 这些影响对于这个星球上生活最贫困的那些人群所带来的打击显然最大，尽管这些“生活在底层的十亿人口”已经承受了疾病、贫困、战争冲突和营养不良等所带来的沉重负担。
en: These impacts will clearly hit the planet’s worst-off inhabitants hardest: the “bottom billion” who already bear the heaviest burden of disease, poverty, conflict and malnutrition.

zh: 确保适应能力被扩大和开发到最最需要的地方因而成为了我们所面临的一个重要挑战。
en: Ensuring that adaptive capacity is expanded and exploited where it is most needed is thus a key challenge.

zh: 长期的发展会增强各国减轻气候变化对环境和公民健康所带来的影响的能力，但是与此同时这个星球上最贫困的人口急切需要富裕人口的帮助。
en: Long-term development may give countries more capacity to soften the impact of climate change on the environment and citizens’ health, but in the meantime the planet’s poorest people will need help from the rich.

zh: 我们的分析探索了更加有针对性的政策在短期内所带来的好处：比如，为遭受气候变化影响的最贫穷国家的儿童购买可抵御蚊虫的蚊帐以及提供口服体液疟疾补充疗法，以便更加积极和前置性地应对全球变暖所带来的某些边缘健康影响。
en: Our analysis investigated, for example, the merits of more targeted policies for the near term: purchasing mosquito-resistant bed nets and oral re-hydration malaria therapy for children in the poorest nations affected by climate change. The goal was to deal aggressively and proactively with some of the marginal health impacts of global warming.

zh: 这样的工作几乎立即就会产生效益，但是随着经济的发展会慢慢减弱。
en: Benefits would appear almost immediately, but would dissipate over time as economies developed.

zh: 即便随着经济的发展各方面的条件得到改善，但是随着气候变化造成越来越严重的影响，减少碳排放从长期来看还是变得越来越重要。
en: Even as development improves conditions, however, reducing carbon emissions would become increasingly important over the longer term as the impact of climate change become more severe.

zh: 鉴于气候变化所产生的影响在全世界的许多地区都能够被观察到，如何减弱气候变化在全球各地都是有意义的。
en: Since the effects of climate change have been observed in many areas around the world, thinking about mitigation makes sense everywhere.

zh: 但是我们发现单单依靠减弱气候变化的影响并不能达到成本效益标准。
en: But we found that mitigation alone did not meet a standard cost-benefit test.

zh: 我们假定气候政策年成本的增长到2100年一直与全球GDP的增长保持同步，起始年成本基准为180亿美元。
en: We allowed specified annual costs of climate policy to grow in proportion with global GDP through 2100 from an initial annual benchmark of $18 billion.

zh: 那么固定年成本所产生的贴现费用共计8000亿美元，但是通过这种方式所避免的损害的总价值只有6850亿美元。
en: The discounted cost of the resulting stream of fixed annual costs totaled $800 billion, but damages avoided by this approach amounted to a discounted value of only $685 billion.

zh: 哥本哈根共识研究还测试了联合国政府间气候变化专业委员会大力宣扬的组合选择方案。
en: The Copenhagen Consensus study also examined a portfolio option of the sort heralded by the United Nations’ Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change.

zh: 我们假定为更环保的技术的研究投入500亿美元，因而减弱和适应气候变化的经济成本就只有7500亿美元可供利用。
en: We allocated $50 billion to research into greener technology, so that only $750 billion could be absorbed by the economic cost of adaptation and mitigation.

zh: 减少碳排放和碳排放技术之间的成本差别就被缩小了，而为减轻排放所设立的税收将变得更加有效。
en: The gap between the cost of carbon-free and carbon-emitting technology fell, and the taxes designed to mitigate emissions became more effective.

zh: 其结果是，研究和开发项目，而8000亿美元的投资所产生的总贴现利益超过2.1万亿美元。
en: As a result, the research and development program essentially paid for itself, and total discounted benefits for the $800 billion investment climbed to more than $2.1 trillion.

zh: 确保研究和开发成为世界应对气候变化的组合应对方式的一部分将使减弱气候变化的影响的努力变得更加有效，并且能够大大增强其在下一世纪减少碳排放的能力。
en: Ensuring that research and development is part of the world’s climate change response portfolio would make mitigation efforts more efficient and significantly enhance their ability to reduce carbon emissions over the next century.

zh: 但是这些有利的净效益反映的只是减排的时间表以及发达国家也“积极地行动起来”的非常保守的预计。
en: But these favorable net benefits reflect very conservative assumptions regarding the timing of emissions reductions and when the developing world would “come onboard.”

zh: 在长时间内优化组合的投资可以把贴现利益提高超过三分之一。
en: Optimizing investment in the portfolio over time would, for example, increase the discounted benefits by more than a factor of three.

zh: 如果我们把潜在对气候变化更高的敏感性会加重危害的因素考虑在内，那么预计产生的利益还会更高，尽管这样��们还必须把对气候变化的敏感性变低的同等可能性考虑进去，后者会导致相反的结果。
en: Expected benefits would increase further if we included the chance that potentially higher climate sensitivities would exacerbate damages, even though doing so would require including similarly plausible lower climate sensitivities, which would push in the opposite direction.

zh: 对抗气候变化是一项很有益的投资，尽管无论是减弱还是适应气候变化本身都不足以“解决”这一难题。
en: Fighting climate change can be a sound investment, even though neither mitigation nor adaptation alone will be enough to “solve” the problem.

zh: 要真正带来变化，尤其是在近期内，世界在努力减弱和适应气候变化的同时，还必须加大对减少碳排放和碳封存技术的研究和开发力度，而这反过来又要求设计和探索以市场为基础的激励机制。
en: To make a real difference, especially in the near term, the world must combine mitigation and adaptation with increased research and development into carbon-saving and sequestering technology, which in turn requires designing and exploiting market-based incentives.

zh: 后核武时代的欧洲大西洋安全秩序
en: A Post-Nuclear Euro-Atlantic Security Order

zh: 华盛顿 — — 随着2011年的到来，欧洲大西洋地区已经成为战略对比研究的课题。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – As we enter 2011, the Euro-Atlantic region is a study in strategic contrasts.

zh: 过去20年来，从大西洋到乌拉尔山的地缘政治领域发生了最翻天覆地的变化。
en: Over the past 20 years, no geo-political space has undergone as dramatic a transformation as that between the Atlantic and the Urals.

zh: 我们在有生之年亲眼见证了从冷战最黑暗的时期到一个崭新时代的令人欢欣鼓舞的过渡，冷战时期的欧洲面临着毁灭性常规及核战争的现实威胁，但现在类似这样的现实威胁已经解除。
en: In our lifetimes, we have seen a welcome change from the darkest days of the Cold War, when a devastating conventional and nuclear war in Europe was a real possibility, to a new era in which no state faces this type of existential threat.

zh: 但尽管事情在向好的方向转化，但美国和俄罗斯等两大地区强国仍然掌握着数以千计的核武器，占全世界核武器现有库存的超过90 % 。
en: But, despite these positive developments, the two largest powers in the region – the United States and Russia – each still possesses thousands of nuclear weapons, accounting for more than 90% of the world’s nuclear inventory.

zh: 其中很多武器仍然设计用于或部署在欧洲大西洋区域。
en: Many of these weapons remain deployed or designed for use within the Euro-Atlantic region.

zh: 削减并消除冷战核设施是过去那个时代遗留下来的最艰巨的任务。
en: Reduction and elimination of this Cold War-era nuclear infrastructure is the largest piece of unfinished business from that bygone time.

zh: 高度戒备的大规模战略核部队及部署在北约某些国家和俄罗斯的战术核武器造成了意外、私自或错误发射核武器的可能性，也有可能导致相关资产落入恐怖份子手中。
en: The continuing existence of large strategic nuclear forces deployed on high alert, and of tactical nuclear weapons deployed in certain NATO states and Russia, creates a risk of accidental, unauthorized, or mistaken use, and of terrorist groups acquiring these assets.

zh: 因此安全警戒就成为重中之重。
en: So security vigilance is essential.

zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们三人在2010年不扩散条约审议大会一致通过的行动计划基础上，为实现无核化的长远目标提出了一系列紧急但却实际的步骤。
en: To meet this challenge, the three of us – building on the action plan adopted by consensus at the 2010 Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT) Review Conference – have endorsed a series of urgent, practical steps towards the long-term goal of a world free of nuclear weapons.

zh: 其中包括：
en: These include:

zh: ·        延长核弹道导弹发射承诺的预警和决策时间；
en: ·        increasing assured warning and decision times for the launch of nuclear-armed ballistic missiles;

zh: ·        合作建立导弹防御和早期预警体系；
en: ·        developing cooperative missile-defense and early-warning systems;

zh: ·        确保对核武器及材料执行最高的安全标准；
en: ·        ensuring the highest possible standards of security for nuclear weapons and materials;

zh: ·        启动俄罗斯、美国和北约参与的战术核武器对话；
en: ·        beginning a dialogue on tactical nuclear weapons involving Russia, the US, and NATO;

zh: ·        启动促成《全面禁止核试验条约》生效的程序；
en: ·        adopting a process to bring the Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty into effect;

zh: ·        制定管理民用核燃料生产风险的国际和多边计划；
en: ·        developing international and multilateral approaches to manage the risks of fuel production for civilian nuclear power; and

zh: ·        推进美国和俄罗斯的核裁军进程。
en: ·        further reductions in US and Russian nuclear forces.

zh: 正如美国前国务卿乔治·P·舒尔茨、美国前国防部长威廉·J·佩里、美国前国务卿亨利·A·基辛格和美国前参议员山姆·纳恩在2007年所说的那样 ， “ 没有[无核世界]的大胆设想，相关措施的公平性和紧迫性就不会得到人们的充分认识。
en: As former US Secretary of State George P. Shultz, former US Secretary of Defense William J. Perry, former US Secretary of State Henry A. Kissinger, and former US Senator Sam Nunn put it in 2007, “Without the bold vision [of a nuclear weapons-free world], the actions will not be perceived as fair or urgent.

zh: 而相关措施如果无法到位，无核化设想就不具备现实性及可行性。 ”
en: Without the actions, the vision will not be perceived as realistic or possible.”

zh: 也许实现这一目标最关键的步骤是加倍努力解决产生新兴核国家的地区性对抗和冲突。
en: Perhaps the most crucial step toward realizing this vision is to redouble our efforts to resolve regional confrontations and conflicts that give rise to new nuclear powers.

zh: 从北美到欧洲再到俄罗斯的大片国家都能在稳定日益分裂紧张的国际秩序方面发挥至关重要的作用。
en: The great swath of states stretching from North America across Europe through Russia has a vital role to play in stabilizing an increasingly fragmented and stressed international order.

zh: 不过，这些国家只有先把自己所在的地理区域建设成为真正兼容并蓄而充满活力的安全共同体，这样的作用才能够充分发挥。
en: These states can play this role, however, only if first they transform this geographic space into a genuinely inclusive and vibrant security community.

zh: 否则（我们现在就没有做到 ） ， 欧洲大西洋国家及其组织将在应对二十一世纪的安全挑战，包括核扩散威胁方面退而求其次，而此类折衷方案其力度通常远远不够。
en: Failing that (and we are failing today) the Euro-Atlantic states and their organizations will settle for suboptimal – and too often utterly inadequate – responses to the twenty-first century’s security challenges, including the threat of nuclear proliferation.

zh: 近来，俄��斯、美国总统和北约秘书长等几位国家首脑已经开始接纳欧洲大西洋安全共同体的理念，并强调塑造更牢固、更兼容并蓄的欧洲安全秩序是多么重要。
en: Lately, several national leaders, including the Russian and US presidents and NATO secretary-general, have embraced the idea of a Euro-Atlantic security community, and begun stressing the importance of fashioning a stronger and more inclusive European security order.

zh: 上述变化来得正是时候，因为欧洲大西洋这个家庭已经进入了至关重要的时期。
en: The timing could not be better, as the Euro-Atlantic family has entered a critical period.

zh: 11月19－20日，北约国家首脑已经批准了将在今后十年指引组织方向的新的“战略理念 ” 。 与此同时，俄罗斯总统梅德韦杰夫及其北约伙伴发表联合声明，支持首次联合审核21世纪共同的安全挑战并决定恢复威胁导弹防御合作。
en: On November 19-20, NATO heads of states approved a new “strategic concept” to guide the organization for the next decade At the same time Russian President D. Medvedev and his NATO counterparts issued a joint statement, endorsing the first Joint Review of 21st Century Common Security Challenges and deciding to resume Threat Missile Defence Cooperation.

zh: 两周后，欧洲安全与合作组织（OSCE）的国家首脑齐聚哈萨克斯坦的阿斯塔纳，共同制定欧安组织下一阶段的发展蓝图。
en: Two weeks later, the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) heads of state assembled in Astana, Kazakhstan, to help shape the OSCE’s next stage of development.

zh: 共同行动缓解核威胁必须成为欧洲大西洋国家走向强大稳定、并行使急需的全球领导权的一项关键要素。
en: Joint action on nuclear-threat reduction must be a critical element in moving the Euro-Atlantic nations toward a level of stability and strength and allow them to exercise badly needed global leadership.

zh: 在导弹防御问题上出台真正的合作计划能应对我们的共同威胁，有助于消除阻碍安全共同体建立的担忧及疑虑。
en: Achieving a genuinely collaborative approach to missile-defense matters will address a common threat and help remove misgivings that are blocking progress toward a common security space.

zh: 同样，欧洲大西洋国家可以加强国际原子能机构的保障监督制度，从而保证和平核能计划不被转移至其他用途，这样做的目的是促成反对核恐怖主义威胁方面的合作，并设立新机制共同保护关键设施免遭网络攻击。
en: Similarly, the Euro-Atlantic states can mobilize behind efforts to strengthen the International Atomic Energy Agency’s safeguards system, which ensures the non-diversion of peaceful nuclear programs, in order to foster cooperation on countering the threat of nuclear terrorism, and to develop new mechanisms to protect jointly critical infrastructure from cyber attack.

zh: 上述举措对保护国家安全和缓和核威胁的全球努力都具有至关重要的意义。
en: Such actions are crucial to these states’ national security and global efforts to mitigate threats.

zh: 落实延长所有欧洲大西洋地区国家预警和决策时间的方案会为北约－俄罗斯关系增添稳定因素。
en: Pursuing arrangements that increase warning and decision-making time for all countries in the Euro-Atlantic region would introduce stability into the NATO-Russia relationship.

zh: 战略、战术和传统部队行动准则的调整会朝着两者军事化架构的终结迈出很大的一步。
en: Adjustments in operational doctrine, as applied to strategic, tactical, and conventional forces, would constitute a giant step toward ending the relationship’s militarized framework.

zh: 如果政府的确希望建设更有力、更兼容并蓄的欧洲安全秩序，缓解并最终消除核武器的后果和威胁，这只是部分必须要做的事。
en: This is only a partial list of what must be done if governments are serious about building a stronger, inclusive European security order, one where the roles and risks of nuclear weapons are reduced, and ultimately eliminated.

zh: 我们三人正和欧洲大西洋地区的著名组织合作制定上述和其他对建立真正安全共同体至关重要的具体步骤，范围涵盖了经济、能源和环境等领域。
en: The three of us are working with a distinguished group from all corners of the Euro-Atlantic region to develop these and other concrete steps that are essential to creating a genuine security community, including its economic, energy, and environmental dimensions.

zh: 上述理念和程序必须在今后几个月内得到北约、欧安组织和其他重要地区性机构实质性的支持。
en: NATO, OSCE, and other key regional institutions must give this concept and process their essential support.

zh: 重返缓和
en: Appeasement Revisited

zh: 布拉格的西方外交官在冷战期间陷入的那些有点滑稽、有点尴尬，又令人烦恼的困境，至今还让我记忆犹新。
en: I vividly remember the slightly ludicrous, slightly risqué, and somewhat distressing predicament in which Western diplomats in Prague found themselves during the Cold War.

zh: 他们经常会碰到是否要邀请77宪章缔约方、人权民主人士、共产党政府的批评者、流离失所的政治家、甚至是被禁作家、学者和记者来参加使馆庆祝活动的敏感问题¾这些人一般都是外交官们的朋友。
en: They regularly needed to resolve the delicate issue of whether to invite to their embassy celebrations various Charter 77 signatories, human rights activists, critics of the communist regime, displaced politicians, or even banned writers, scholars, and journalists – people with whom the diplomats were generally friends.

zh: 有时我们这些持不同政见者收到的不是邀请而是致歉、有时我们收到了邀请，但为了不给我们勇敢的外交官朋友带来麻烦，知趣地没有去参加。
en: Sometimes we dissidents were not invited, but received an apology, and sometimes we were invited, but did not accept the invitation so as not to complicate the lives of our courageous diplomat friends.

zh: 有时我们被邀请提早出席，希望我们能在官方代表到来之前就提早离开，这种方法有时管用，有时也会发生意外。
en: Or we were invited to come at an earlier hour in the hope that we would leave before the official representatives arrived, which sometimes worked and sometimes didn’t.

zh: 如果我们没来得及离开，那么或者官方代表看到我们就拂袖而去以示抗议，或者我们狼狈逃窜、或者我们都装着看不见对方，再或者¾虽然这种情况非常罕见¾我们开始相互交谈，这经常是除去我们双方法庭相遇的情况下，政府和反对派之间唯一的对话机会。
en: When it didn’t, either the official representatives left in protest at our presence, or we left hurriedly, or we all pretended not to notice each other, or – albeit on rare occasions – we started to converse with each other, which frequently were the only moments of dialogue between the regime and the opposition (not counting our courthouse encounters).

zh: 这些都发生在欧洲和世界被铁幕隔绝，划分为两大对立阵营的那个年代。
en: This all happened when the Iron Curtain divided Europe – and the world – into opposing camps.

zh: 西方外交官要考虑本国的经济利益，但他们和严格划分“持不同政见者或贸易”的苏联一方毕竟有所不同。
en: Western diplomats had their countries’ economic interests to consider, but, unlike the Soviet side, they took seriously the idea of “dissidents or trade.”

zh: 我想不起西方国家或组织（北约、欧盟等等）有哪次曾经公开发表呼吁、建议或法令，规定某些持独立思想的特定人群¾不管具体如何界定，都不能应邀参与外交聚会、庆祝会或招待活动。
en: I cannot recall any occasion at that time when the West or any of its organizations (NATO, the European Community, etc.) issued some public appeal, recommendation, or edict stating that some specific group of independently-minded people – however defined – were not to be invited to diplomatic parties, celebrations, or receptions.

zh: 但今天这种事却发生了。
en: But today this is happening.

zh: 全世界最强大有力的民主机构之一¾欧盟¾毫不犹豫地向古巴专制政府公开承诺要重新实行外交隔离。
en: One of the strongest and most powerful democratic institutions in the world – the European Union – has no qualms in making a public promise to the Cuban dictatorship that it will re-institute diplomatic Apartheid.

zh: 欧盟驻哈瓦那大使馆现在将按古巴政府的希望来制定客人名单。
en: The EU’s embassies in Havana will now craft their guest lists in accordance with the Cuban government’s wishes.

zh: 西班牙社会党首相萨帕特罗的短视行为如今却风行一时。
en: The shortsightedness of socialist Prime Minister José Zapatero of Spain has prevailed.

zh: 想想将会发生什么吧：每个欧洲大使馆都会指定专人来挨个筛选名单，评估所要审核者是否行为不受约束、或当众随意发表观点，他们在什么程度上批评政府、甚至他们是否当过政治犯。
en: Try to imagine what will happen: at each European embassy, someone will be appointed to screen the list, name by name, and assess whether and to what extent the persons in question behave freely or speak out freely in public, to what extent they criticize the regime, or even whether they are former political prisoners.

zh: 一部分人会从邀请名单中删除，名单也会越来越短，这样做还常常会删除负责审查工作的外交官的私人好友，删掉那些外交官们曾经在思想、政治或物质上无私援助过的人们。
en: Lists will be shortened and deletions made, and this will frequently entail eliminating even good personal friends of the diplomats in charge of the screening, people whom they have given various forms of intellectual, political, or material assistance.

zh: 如果欧盟国家企图借只请外交官参加古巴大使馆的庆祝活动来对筛选行为加以掩饰，那么情况可能会变得更糟。
en: It will be even worse if the EU countries try to mask their screening activities by inviting only diplomats to embassy celebrations in Cuba.

zh: 要想玷污欧盟与生俱来的自由、平等和人权等崇高的理想，再也没有比这个更好的办法了¾这些原则实际都包含在欧盟的宪法协议之中。
en: I can hardly think of a better way for the EU to dishonor the noble ideals of freedom, equality, and human rights that the Union espouses – indeed, principles that it reiterates in its constitutional agreement.

zh: 为了保护欧洲公司从哈瓦那酒店中赚取的利润，欧盟将会停止邀请思想开放的人士来到使馆，并会按照独裁者及其附庸们的脸色来判断他们究竟是什么人。
en: To protect European corporations’ profits from their Havana hotels, the Union will cease inviting open-minded people to EU embassies, and we will deduce who they are from the expression on the face of the dictator and his associates.

zh: 没有什么比这更为可耻的交易了。
en: It is hard to imagine a more shameful deal.

zh: 当然，没有西方的鸡尾酒会和招待会上的礼节性交谈，古巴的持不同政见者们也不会感到沮丧。
en: Cuba’s dissidents will, of course, happily do without Western cocktail parties and polite conversation at receptions.

zh: 这样的迫害虽然会给本已困难的斗争雪上加霜，但他们肯定挺得过去。
en: This persecution will admittedly aggravate their difficult struggle, but they will naturally survive it.

zh: 问题是欧盟能不能挺过去。
en: The question is whether the EU will survive it.

zh: 今天，欧盟在看菲德尔的脸色行事。
en: Today, the EU is dancing to Fidel’s tune.

zh: 也就是说明天它可能会参与在中华人民共和国沿海建立导弹基地工程的竞标，接着它可能会让自己在车臣问题上的决策受到俄国总统普京顾问们的影响。
en: That means that tomorrow it could bid for contracts to build missile bases on the coast of the People’s Republic of China. The following day it could allow its decisions on Chechnya to be dictated by Russian President Vladimir Putin’s advisers.

zh: 然后，出于某些不为人知的原因，它可能会把对自己对非洲的援助与那里最糟糕的独裁者的兄弟情谊联系起来。
en: Then, for some unknown reason, it could make its assistance to Africa conditional on fraternal ties with the worst African dictators.

zh: 哪里才是头呢？
en: Where will it end?

zh: 释放米洛舍维奇？
en: The release of Milosevic?

zh: 拒绝为俄罗斯人权活动家Sergey Kovalyov发放签证？
en: Denying a visa to Russian human rights activist Sergey Kovalyov?

zh: 向萨达姆·侯赛因道歉？
en: An apology to Saddam Hussein?

zh: 开始和基地组织的谈判？
en: The opening of peace talks with Al Qaida?

zh: 沿用欧洲最糟糕的政治传统对欧盟来讲无异于自杀，这些传统都有着安抚罪恶和认为对他人的自由不闻不问是维护和平最佳方式的共同特点。
en: It is suicidal for the EU to draw on Europe’s worst political traditions, the common denominator of which is the idea that evil must be appeased and that the best way to achieve peace is through indifference to the freedom of others.

zh: 但实际情况却恰恰相反：这样的政策暴露了对自身自由的无动于衷，为战争埋下了伏笔。
en: Just the opposite is true: such policies expose an indifference to one’s own freedom and pave the way for war.

zh: 毕竟，欧洲正在为捍卫自由和价值观携起手来，绝不能为了与独裁者的和平共处就牺牲这些理想，从而冒着被反民主思想逐渐渗透灵魂的危险。
en: After all, Europe is uniting in order to defend its freedom and values, not to sacrifice them to the ideal of harmonious coexistence with dictators and thus risk gradual infiltration of its soul by the anti-democratic mindset.

zh: 我坚信欧盟的新成员不会忘记自己曾经有过的极权主义和以非暴力方式对抗罪恶的经历，而他们在欧盟团体内的处事方式会体现出他们的上述经历。
en: I firmly believe that the new members of the EU will not forget their experience of totalitarianism and non-violent opposition to evil, and that that experience will be reflected in how they behave in EU bodies.

zh: 实际上，这也许是他们能够为团结的欧洲所拥��的共同精神、道德和政治基础做出的最大贡献。
en: Indeed, this could be the best contribution they can make to the common spiritual, moral, and political foundations of a united Europe.

zh: 苹果决战探员
en: Apple Versus the G-Men

zh: 弗吉尼亚海滩 — — 苹果拒绝解锁与12月加利福尼亚州圣贝纳迪诺极端分子袭击事件有关的iPhone已经引发了与美国司法部和联邦调查局的公开战斗 — — 上述争议对全球数据隐私将产生深远的影响。
en: VIRGINIA BEACH – Apple’s refusal to unlock the iPhone linked to the extremist attack in San Bernardino, California, in December has triggered a public battle with the US Justice Department and the FBI – a dispute with far-reaching implications for data privacy worldwide.

zh: 但情况绝非像看上去那样简单。
en: But the case is not as straightforward as it seems.

zh: 作为一名美国情报界资深服务人员，我认为联邦调查局已经获得了法鲁克的iPhone进入权限。
en: Speaking as someone with a long presence in the US intelligence community, I believe that the FBI has already gained access to Syed Rizwan Farook’s iPhone.

zh: 他所使用的苹果手机型号相对老旧，在其他案件中，已经有过遭到入侵的记录。
en: It is an older Apple model using technology that, in other contexts, has already been compromised.

zh: 联邦调查局对苹果所提的要求还有一点非常奇怪：美国政府为什么愿意就此问题屈尊进行公众辩论？
en: Here’s another strange thing about the FBI’s demand of Apple: Why would the United States government stoop to a public debate on this issue?

zh: 联邦调查局是美国最强势的执法机构，苹果最终将会被迫接受它的要求。
en: The FBI is the country’s most powerful law-enforcement organization, and Apple will ultimately be forced to comply with its request.

zh: （完全披露：我持有苹果的股票。 ）
en: (Full disclosure: I own Apple stock.)

zh: 联邦调查局已经表示此事不仅关乎一部电话。
en: The FBI has already said that this is not about just one phone.

zh: 但很少有人知道这并非利益对立的简单问题：而是公共安全与个人隐私权之争。
en: But few understand that this is not a simple matter of opposing interests: public safety versus an individual’s right to privacy.

zh: 为了更深入了解联邦调查局的要求，我们先要了解苹果的最新手机系列，这与法鲁克的旧型号有着本质的不同：其中包含由美国国家安全局开发并在其后与以色列人共享的新型芯片技术。
en: For a better understanding of the FBI’s demand, we need to look at Apple’s latest line of phones, which differ from Farook’s in a fundamental respect: They contain a new chip that was designed using a technique developed by the US National Security Agency and then shared with the Israelis.

zh: 这项技术现在正通过苹果的以色列芯片设计部门进入到苹果产品当中。
en: That technology is now finding its way into Apple products via the company’s Israeli chip-design division.

zh: 每个芯片都有独一无二的加密签名，并与用户的指纹配合使用。
en: Each of the new chips has a unique signature used for encryption, which is coupled with its user’s fingerprint.

zh: 没有签名就不可能在不对芯片内部进行物理接触的情况下解密苹果手机 — — 这种芯片本身不可能被攻破。
en: Without that signature, it is impossible to decrypt an Apple phone without physical access to the internals of its chip – which is itself impenetrable.

zh: 加密同样适用于手机发送到配对服务的任何信息，比方说苹果的邮件服务系统。
en: That encryption also applies to any information sent by the phone to a paired service, like Apple’s Messages system.

zh: 过去，即时访问电话设备对联邦调查局无关紧要，因为当局对进出电话的信息可以毫无限制的进行访问。
en: In the past, immediate access to telephony devices has been irrelevant to the FBI, because the authorities had unfettered access to communications as they traveled to and from a phone.

zh: 但凭借这种改进后的安全功能，苹果现在关闭了这扇大门。
en: But, with its new security improvements, Apple is now closing that door.

zh: 该公司不仅关闭了新的接入；就连现有接入也将很快受到威胁。
en: The company is not simply denying new access; it will soon take away existing access.

zh: 这让联邦调查局非常不安，因为收集证据是它的工作。
en: This bothers the FBI, because its job is to collect evidence.

zh: 有趣的是，国家安全局采取了不同的立场。
en: Interestingly, the NSA has taken a different stance.

zh: 国家安全局局长海军上将迈克·罗杰斯已经承认后门极具危险性，并表示“加密技术是未来的基础 ” 。
en: Backdoors have been acknowledged as dangerous by NSA Director Admiral Mike Rogers, who says that “encryption is foundational to the future.”

zh: 如果侵入私人通讯成为可能，任何人都可以为任何目的这样做。
en: When access to private communications is possible, anyone can use it for any purpose.

zh: 这让联邦调查局公共安全观点变得错综复杂。
en: This complicates the FBI’s argument about public safety.

zh: 比方说，我们是否真的希望恐怖组织能对总统或总理的私人信息进行访问？
en: For example, do we really want a terrorist group to be capable of accessing a president’s or prime minister’s private information?

zh: 如果手机里存在后门程序，只要有足够的动机任何人都可以打开 — — 包括不法分子、极端分子和政府。
en: If a phone has a backdoor, it can be opened by anyone with enough motivation – criminals, extremists, and governments alike.

zh: 比方说，如果苹果接受了联邦调查局的要求中国政府会很高兴。
en: The Chinese authorities, for example, would be delighted if Apple complied with the FBI’s request.

zh: 多年来，他们一直要求苹果提供后门。
en: They have been asking Apple for a backdoor for years.

zh: 苹果当前立场可能导致其在大中国市场受损 — — 如果接受政府的要求又将带来巨额利润。
en: Apple’s current stand could cause it to suffer in the massive Chinese market – or profit immensely if it complies.

zh: 联邦调查局的要求标志着一种新的控制企图。
en: The FBI’s request signals a new attempt at control.

zh: 该机构的请求往往密封传递，也就是说到现在仍然是保密的。
en: This is an organization that usually delivers its requests under seal, meaning they remain secret.

zh: 这一次，联邦调查局一反常态地公开自己的要求，目的是借“恐怖主义”的热点引发媒体的关注。
en: In this case, the FBI took the unusual step of making its demand public, so as to push the issue into the press by hitting the hot button of “terrorism.”

zh: 联邦调查局似乎意在迫使立法者回应公众的愤怒。
en: The FBI’s intent, it seems, is to prompt lawmakers to respond to public outrage.

zh: 反对解锁这部电话的多数法律论点都在引用宪法对于言论自由的保护。
en: Most legal arguments against “unlocking” this particular phone cite the constitutionally protected right to free speech.

zh: 但美国及其宪法条文规定的枪支所有权其实是更好的平行范例。
en: But a better parallel is the right to gun ownership in the US and the constitutional provisions that support it.

zh: 过去，美国的技术主要源于军事研发和战争服务，同时也起着维护社会秩序的作用。
en: In the past, technology in the US was primarily developed in a military context and justified in the service of war, but also to maintain civil order.

zh: 在18世纪末，枪支曾经是相关技术的典范。
en: At the end of the eighteenth century, the apotheosis of that technology was the firearm.

zh: 没有哪项技术比枪支技术更有效，因此美国宪法规定，枪支不能被用来限制言论（第一修正案）或剥夺公民拥有枪支的自由（第二修正案 ） ， 政府的枪支持有者不允许进入居民家中（第三修正案 ） 。
en: No other technology was as apt, so the US Constitution specified that it would not be used to curtail speech (First Amendment) or be denied to the citizenry (Second Amendment), and that government holders of firearms could not be placed in citizens’ homes (Third Amendment).

zh: 第九及第十修正案禁止利用枪支损害今后可能变为显性的其他隐性的公民权。
en: The Ninth and Tenth Amendments proscribe the use of firearms to compromise other implicit rights as they may become apparent.

zh: 涉及我们思想、关系和身体的信息已成为今天最强大的技术。
en: Today’s most powerful technologies relate to information concerning our thoughts, associations, and bodies.

zh: 如果美国的宪法制定者今天还活着并像当时那样受过良好的教育，那么人权法案很可能会集中关注平衡信息获取，以确保政府不��超权限运作。
en: If the framers of the US Constitution were alive today and as well educated as they were then, the Bill of Rights would likely be focused on balancing access to information to ensure that the government remains within bounds.

zh: 联邦调查局这次公开请求令人们开始关注民众和警方之间的平衡。
en: With this public request from the FBI, the balance between people and policing is being called into question.

zh: 随着辩论的展开，我们需要思考在法律或政策层面，让所有人 — — 包括执法机构、黑客和恐怖分子 — — 都能掌握或获取信息是否讲得通。
en: As the debate unfolds, we need to consider whether it makes sense, legally or as a matter of policy, for everyone – law enforcement, hackers, and terrorists – to be able to possess or access information.

zh: 苹果的案子将会影响到信息权力平衡，而目前天平倾斜的方向不利于公众。
en: The Apple case will affect the balance of informational power, and the scales currently are weighted against the citizen.

zh: 解决这个问题需要的不是歇斯底里的推特，而是美国政界人士更加深思熟虑的回应。
en: Resolving the case requires a more considered response from US politicians than hysterical tweeting.

zh: 鉴于信息在现代社会的力量，我们必须认真思考联邦调查局请求的法律后果。
en: In view of the modern power of information, they must think carefully about the legal ramifications of the FBI’s demand.

zh: 朝鲜问题上的现实主义
en: Realism on North Korea

zh: 柏林 — — 尽管朝鲜贫困而一败涂地，但世界并不能因此而更从容地面对它的武力威胁。
en: BERLIN – The world’s task in addressing North Korea’s saber rattling is made no easier by the fact that it confronts an impoverished and effectively defeated country.

zh: 相反，恰恰是在这种情况下，我们必须要做到冷静和深谋远虑。
en: On the contrary, it is in such circumstances that calm foresight is most necessary.

zh: 哈布斯堡帝国王子克莱门斯·冯·梅特涅在拿破仑战后建立国际新秩序的天才之处在于，他并没有将战败的法国逼入绝境。
en: The genius of the Habsburg Empire’s Prince Klemens von Metternich in framing a new international order after the Napoleonic Wars was that he did not push a defeated France into a corner.

zh: 尽管梅特涅竭力阻止法国复兴，但是他恢复了法国的战前边界。
en: Although Metternich sought to deter any possible French resurgence, he restored France’s prewar frontiers.

zh: 相反，恰如亨利·基辛格所说，一战的战胜国既未能遏制战败的德国，也未能鼓励它接受《凡尔赛条约 》 。
en: By contrast, as Henry Kissinger has argued, the victors in World War I could neither deter a defeated Germany nor provide it with incentives to accept the Versailles Treaty.

zh: 相反，他们提出了苛刻的条件，希望借此永久削弱德国的实力。
en: Instead, they imposed harsh terms, hoping to weaken Germany permanently.

zh: 我们都清楚结局如何。
en: We know how that plan ended.

zh: 约翰·F·肯尼迪是梅特涅的信徒。
en: John F. Kennedy was in the Metternich mold.

zh: 古巴导弹危机时他并未试图侮辱或彻底压制苏联，反而从尼基塔·赫鲁晓夫的角度出发，同意以暗中拆除土耳其和意大利境内的美国导弹来换取苏联将导弹撤离古巴。
en: During the Cuban missile crisis, he did not try to humiliate or win a total victory over the Soviet Union. Rather, he put himself in Nikita Khrushchev’s shoes and agreed to dismantle, secretly, American missiles in Turkey and Italy in exchange for withdrawal of Soviet missiles from Cuba.

zh: 肯尼迪的务实阻止了第三次世界大战的爆发。
en: Kennedy’s pragmatism prevented World War III.

zh: 可悲的是，朝鲜并没有遇见具备如此远见卓识的政治家。
en: Sadly, North Korea has not received such far-sighted statesmanship.

zh: 在朝鲜危险的核计划面前，我们应当扪心自问，如果过去20年来用梅特涅和肯尼迪的睿智来处理朝鲜问题，现在的情况将会如何？
en: Faced with the North’s dangerous nuclear game, we should ask what would have happened if, over the last 20 some years, the North Korea problem had been approached with the sagacity of Metternich and Kennedy.

zh: 当然，朝鲜不同于十九世纪初的法国和1962年的苏联。
en: Of course, North Korea is not early-nineteenth century France or the USSR of 1962.

zh: 西方（包括日本）领导人认为朝鲜不过区区弹丸之地，其糟糕的经济状况似乎永远处于自我毁灭的边缘。
en: In the eyes of Western (including Japanese) political leaders, it has never amounted to more than a small, fringe country whose economic failings made it appear to be poised perpetually on the edge of self-destruction.

zh: 多数情况下，世界领导人都不愿认真对待朝鲜问题，因此朝鲜每次制造安全问题他们的对策都是被动地敷衍应对。
en: For the most part, world leaders preferred not to be bothered with North Korea, and so reacted in an ad hoc way whenever it created a security problem.

zh: 可现在由于朝鲜核试验及弹道导弹能力的提升，我们必须要做出改变。
en: But now, following the North’s recent nuclear tests, and given its improving ballistic-missile capabilities, that approach is no longer tenable.

zh: 也许1991年苏联解体后是早期解决朝鲜问题的绝佳机会。
en: Perhaps the best chance to address the problem at an earlier stage was immediately after the Soviet Union’s collapse in 1991.

zh: 当时朝鲜创始人金日成面临经济崩溃、常规军力缩减和外交孤立等问题。
en: Back then, Kim Il-sung – the North’s founder – faced economic collapse, diminution of his conventional military forces, and diplomatic isolation.

zh: 在1992年3、4月接受《朝日新闻》和《华盛顿时报》采访时，金明确表示希望与美国建立外交关系。
en: In interviews with Asahi Shimbun and The Washington Times in March and April 1992, Kim clearly expressed a wish to establish diplomatic relations with the US.

zh: 但美韩领��人尚未做好准备接受金的提议。
en: But US and South Korean leaders were not ready to accommodate Kim’s overture.

zh: 对朝鲜的陈旧看法导致他们未能认清快速变化的政治现实。
en: Their received ideas about North Korea prevented them from recognizing a fast-changing political reality.

zh: 那十年中还错过了另外一次机会。
en: Another opportunity was missed later in the decade.

zh: 如果朝鲜在1999年5月美国特使威廉·佩里​​访问平壤后及时回访，那么比尔·克林顿总统对朝接触政策可能已经升级为外交关系正常化的努力。
en: If North Korea had reciprocated in a timely manner following US envoy William Perry’s visit to Pyongyang in May 1999, President Bill Clinton’s policy of engagement with the North might have been upgraded to a push for normalization of diplomatic relations.

zh: 相反，朝鲜却一拖再拖，直到2000年10月克林顿任期接近尾声时才派次帅赵明禄访美。
en: Instead, the North procrastinated, sending Vice Marshall Jo Myong-rok to the US only in October 2000, near the end of Clinton’s presidency.

zh: 几个月后，新当选总统乔治·W·布什推翻了克林顿的朝鲜政策。
en: A few months later, newly elected President George W. Bush reversed Clinton’s North Korea policy.

zh: 我还记得担任韩国外长时说服布什政府决策者同朝鲜谈判，而不是一味施压、坐等朝鲜投降的难度。
en: I still recall the difficulty that I faced, as South Korea’s foreign minister, in convincing Bush administration policymakers to negotiate with North Korea instead of merely applying pressure and waiting for the North to capitulate.

zh: 那时朝鲜重启宁边核设施进行钚生产，借此强化同美国的谈判能力。
en: Back then, North Korea was restarting its Yongbyon nuclear facility and producing plutonium, thus strengthening its bargaining position vis-à-vis the US.

zh: 2006年朝鲜首次核试之前的宝贵时间就这样被白白浪费。
en: Precious time was squandered before North Korea’s first nuclear test in 2006.

zh: 尽管几个月后布什开始接受对朝双边谈判政策，但金氏政权已经变得更加顽固。
en: Though Bush shifted his policy toward bilateral negotiations with the North a few months later, the Kim regime had become much more obstinate.

zh: 事实上，自此之后朝鲜的行为就更加无法预测。
en: Indeed, North Korea’s behavior has since become even more volatile.

zh: 2010年打沉韩国天安舰及炮击延坪岛等行为史无前例，朝韩之间的紧张局势也因此达到数十年来的顶峰。
en: Its sinking of the South Korean corvette Cheonan and the shelling of Yeonpyeong Island in 2010 were unprecedented, and raised inter-Korean tensions to their highest level in decades.

zh: 如今，第三次核试验后，朝鲜政权对外宣布永远不会放弃核手段，我们似乎也由此进入有史以来最危险的阶段。
en: Today, following the North’s third nuclear test, we seem to have entered the most precarious stage yet, with the regime declaring that it will never surrender its nuclear option.

zh: 我们究竟该怎么办？
en: So, what should be done?

zh: 首要选择是通过外交手段遏制进一步挑衅。
en: The first option should be deterrence of further aggression through diplomacy.

zh: 但中国的合作是实现外交威慑的必要条件，前提是必须承认中国的关键国家安全利益。
en: But achieving diplomatic deterrence will depend on China’s cooperation, and this requires that China’s vital national-security interests be recognized.

zh: 中国所担心的不仅是朝鲜爆炸的社会经济后果，还有朝韩统一的战略后果 — — 尤其是美军藉由美韩联盟控制对中朝边境领土进行控制。
en: China fears not only the social and economic consequences of a North Korean implosion, but also the strategic consequences of reunification – in particular, that the US military, through its alliance with South Korea, would gain access to territory on its border.

zh: 美国仅仅声明无意攫取这种军事优势无法缓解中国的忧虑。
en: A mere statement by the US that it has no intention to press this military advantage will not assuage China’s fears.

zh: 中国领导人清楚地记得美国曾承诺苏联总统米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫德国统一和东欧民主转型并不意味着北约东扩。
en: Chinese leaders recall that the US promised Soviet President Mikhail Gorbachev that German reunification and democratic transition in Eastern Europe would not mean eastward expansion of NATO.

zh: 因此有必要做出更为具体的承诺，保持韩国最基本的安全关注。
en: So a more concrete undertaking, one that preserves South Korea’s bedrock security concerns, is needed.

zh: 只有当自身安全得到保证后中国才有可能摆脱与朝鲜唇亡齿寒的互相依赖，加强对朝鲜行为的控制力度。
en: Only after its security is assured will China free itself from complicity in North Korean brinkmanship and be better able to control the North’s behavior.

zh: 中国的合作虽然必要，但仅靠它也解决不了朝鲜问题。
en: But Chinese cooperation, though necessary, will not resolve the North Korea problem on its own.

zh: 综合性方案必须意识到朝鲜的内部变化，尤其是普通朝鲜人思想的变化速度。
en: A comprehensive approach must recognize the speed of internal change, especially in the minds of ordinary North Koreans.

zh: 简单而言，朝鲜人已经不再像过去那样与世隔绝，因为与蓬勃发展的中国贸易扩大及联系日趋密切，他们对自身的贫困已经有越来越清醒的认识。
en: Simply put, North Koreans are not as isolated as they once were, and have a growing appreciation of their impoverishment, owing primarily to greater trade and closer connections with booming China.

zh: 这样的国内变化必须得到鼓励，因为事实证明它将比外部压力更有效地影响政府行为。
en: This internal change needs to be encouraged, because it will prove more effective than external pressure in influencing the regime’s behavior.

zh: 但鼓励变化时切忌激起以间接手段摧毁朝鲜的恐惧。 韩国总统朴槿惠在近期紧张局势升温的大背景下仍建议提供人道主义援助就是朝着正确方向的正确开始。
en: But such encouragement must be undertaken in ways that do not incite the North’s fears of being destroyed by indirect means.  South Korean President Park Geun-hye’s recent proposal to provide humanitarian assistance despite the recent spike in tension, is a start in the right direction.

zh: 普通朝鲜人生活问题的重要性丝毫不亚于朝鲜邻国的安全问题。
en: The lives of ordinary North Koreans matter as much as the security of North Korea’s neighbors.

zh: 国际社会需要制定综合解决方案 — — 方案必须同样关注人文及安全领域。
en: A comprehensive approach is required – one that focuses as much on the human dimension as on the security dimension.

zh: 我们仍需观察上述方案的远见和勇气是否超出当今韩国、西方和中国领导人所具备的能力。
en: It remains to be seen whether this approach requires more foresight and courage than today’s political leaders in South Korea, the West, and China can muster.

zh: 被告席上的总统
en: A President in the Dock

zh: 纽约—在某种程度上，国际法院(ICC)以在达尔富尔犯下的战争罪和反人类罪起诉苏丹总统巴希尔所造成的哗然令人意外。
en: NEW YORK – In a way, the stir aroused by the decision by the International Criminal Court (ICC) to indict Sudan’s President Omar al-Bashir for war crimes and crimes against humanity in Darfur is a surprise.

zh: 毕竟，国际法院自身无法在苏丹逮捕任何人，更不用说统领该国军队的国家元首。
en: After all, the Court has no means of its own to arrest anyone in Sudan, much less a head of state who commands the country’s armed forces.

zh: 第三方介入在苏丹执行逮捕的情况也不可能发生。
en: Nor is there any prospect that someone else will intervene in Sudan to make an arrest.

zh: 尽管ICC的总检察官Luis Moreno-Ocampo表示有信心将巴希尔绳之以法，但究竟如何操作还是个未知数。
en: While the ICC’s chief prosecutor, Luis Moreno-Ocampo, expresses confidence that Bashir will be brought to justice, it is unclear how this will happen.

zh: 但可能性还是存在的。
en: But it could.

zh: 尽管ICC看似软弱无力，但许多国家的领导人还是不遗余力地阻止起诉。
en: Despite the ICC’s seeming powerlessness, many governments’ leaders are engaged in strenuous efforts to block the indictment.

zh: 他们似乎并不在乎这些指控是否公正；而似乎是在显示与一位国家元首同一战壕的团结。
