en: They do not seem concerned that the charges are unfair; rather, they appear to be demonstrating solidarity with a fellow head of state.

zh: 那些谴责让巴希尔受审的企图的国家包括伊斯兰会议组织和非洲联盟阵营的大部分成员国以及中国和俄罗斯这样的强国。
en: Those denouncing the attempt to put Bashir on trial include the large blocs of countries that are members of the Organization of the Islamic Conference and the African Union, together with such powerful states as China and Russia.

zh: 人们只能猜测有些参与其中的元首是否是出于自身的顾虑，即他们有一天也可能面临ICC的法官们对巴希尔那样的指控。
en: One can only guess whether some of those joining this effort are motivated by concern that they themselves may some day face charges like those leveled at Bashir by the ICC judges.

zh: 虽然巴希尔可能仅仅通过限制他的国际旅行就能避免被捕，但对其起诉所造成的震荡却并非是非理性的。
en: Though Bashir may be able to avoid arrest simply by limiting his international travel, the commotion provoked by the indictment is not irrational.

zh: 针对他的指控具有很强大的舆论标签作用。
en: The charges against him have a powerful stigmatizing effect.

zh: 代表ICC成员方108个国家政府的法官团指控巴希尔应对过去6年来在达尔富尔犯下的罪行负首要责任。 这样的指控本身就会损害他继续执政的合法性。
en: The fact that a panel of judges representing the 108 governments that are parties to the ICC has accused Bashir of principal responsibility for the crimes committed in Darfur during the past six years undermines the legitimacy of his continued rule.

zh: 这些罪行已经造成30万人死亡，并使得270万人流离失所。
en: Those crimes have caused more than 300,000 deaths, and have forcibly displaced at least another 2.7 million people.

zh: 即便同情巴希尔的各国首脑们成功劝说联合国安理会延迟对其起诉—可能性极小—这些指控也会继续悬在巴希尔的头上挥之不去，除非（直到）他出庭受审。
en: Even if Bashir’s fellow heads of state succeed in their effort to persuade the United Nations Security Council to defer prosecution – which is highly unlikely – the charges will continue to hang over Bashir’s head unless and until he stands trial.

zh: 1999年，一个国际刑事法庭起诉了另一个在位的国家首脑，南斯拉夫联邦共和国的米洛舍维奇。
en: In 1999, an international criminal tribunal indicted another sitting head of state, Slobodan Milosevic of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.

zh: 虽然他当时似乎高枕无忧，但一年半以后还是被送到海牙受审。
en: Though he seemed secure at the time, a year and a half later he was sent to The Hague to stand trial.

zh: 无独有偶，2003年一个国际刑事法庭起诉了利比里亚当时的总统查尔斯•泰勒。
en: Similarly, in 2003, an international criminal tribunal indicted Liberia’s then president, Charles Taylor.

zh: 他不得不在数月后逃离利比里亚，起初在尼日利亚政治避难，可如今也在海牙受审。
en: He had to flee Liberia a few months later and initially received asylum in Nigeria, but is now on trial in The Hague.

zh: 当那些起诉书发出以后，没人能够预言事态的发展；回头看来，起诉书的（使）非法化作用产生了重要的后果。
en: When those indictments were issued, no one could have predicted how events would unfold; in retrospect, it is evident that the indictments’ delegitimizing effects had important consequences.

zh: 当然，ICC的检察官和法官们在起诉巴希尔时也冒了相当大的风险。
en: Of course, the ICC’s prosecutor and judges are themselves taking a substantial risk in the indictment of Bashir.

zh: 该法院羽翼未丰，惹恼众多与他同一条战线的国家首脑可能会危及其未来的发展。
en: The Court is still in its infancy, and antagonizing the many government leaders expressing solidarity with him could jeopardize its future.

zh: 然而我们也应该承认国际法院的相关人士也是在履行他们的职责。
en: Yet it should be recognized that the Court’s personnel are carrying out their duties.

zh: ICC的创始条约明确规定国家首脑不享有豁免权。
en: The treaty establishing the ICC explicitly states that heads of state do not enjoy immunity.

zh: 联合国安理会曾在2005年将达尔富尔一案提交ICC。
en: And the Security Council referred the Darfur case to the Court in 2005.

zh: 这是一项必须进行的调查，那些被发现对相关罪行负有最高责任的人必须受到起诉。
en: This was an investigation that had to be conducted, and those found to have the highest level of responsibility for the crimes had to be indicted.

zh: 许多现在反对起诉巴希尔的人也参与了导致该项诉讼的决议。
en: Many of those now objecting to the prosecution of Bashir participated in the decisions leading to the indictment.

zh: 如果ICC的起诉现在让他们不快，那只是因为他们没有预料到该法院会行使由他们赋予的职责。
en: If the ICC’s indictment now causes them discomfort, that is only because they did not anticipate that the Court would carry out the responsibilities that they themselves assigned to it.

zh: 流行病初探
en: A Primer for Pandemics

zh: 每年都有几次事件会提醒世界流行病的威胁无处不在。
en: A few times each year, the world is reminded that a pandemic threat is immanent.

zh: 在2003年，是SARS。
en: In 2003, it was SARS.

zh: 而现在则是一种潜在的鸟类病毒，其危险性和在1914年致使3千万人丧生的那一种病毒类似。
en: Today, it is a potential avian virus similar to the one that killed 30 million people after 1914.

zh: 事实已经证明“禽流感”可以由鸟类向人类传染，现在连猫类也不能幸免，这预示着它可能成为下一种全球性致命疾病。
en: “Bird flu” has already shown that it can jump from fowl to humans, and now even to cats, which indicates that it might be the next global killer.

zh: 然而，还有许多潜在的流行病，有些甚至都不是由病毒引起的。
en: But there are many other potential pandemics, and many are not even viruses.

zh: 细菌、prion蛋白、寄生虫甚至环境因素都可能发生致命的突变。
en: Bacteria, prions, parasites, and even environmental factors could suddenly change in a way that slays us.

zh: 科学预测普遍认为如果这样的情况发生，其所造成的经济和人类损失会超过此前任何一场战争。
en: It is widely predicted that when this happens, the economic and human losses will exceed that of any previous war.

zh: 的确，令我们羞愧的是，在历史的记忆中，最致命的入侵都是由单细胞有机体引起的。 比如霍乱、腹股沟腺炎和肺结核。
en: Indeed, it is humbling to remember that some of history’s most deadly invasions were carried out by single-cell organisms, such as cholera, bubonic plague, and tuberculosis.

zh: 拥有资源支持的国家都制定了对抗这些流行病的方案—可以保护其公民的有限战略。
en: Countries with the resources to do so are making resistance plans against pandemics – limited strategies that would protect their own citizens.

zh: 许多政府都希望及早确诊使他们有可能遏制流行病蔓延。
en: Most governments are hoping that early detection will make containment possible.

zh: 遏制战略高度依赖疫苗，但疫苗只是答案的一部分。
en: Containment depends heavily on vaccines, but vaccines are only part of the answer.

zh: 虽然它们对多种病毒都有好的防御作用，但每一种疫苗都有其非常特定的针对性。
en: While they are a good defense against many viruses, each vaccine is highly specific to the threat.

zh: 病毒是细胞的寄生物，每一种病毒都攻击一种特定的细胞。
en: Viruses are parasites to cells, and each virus attacks a particular type of cell.

zh: 某种病毒的形状使其能够钻入某种细胞特定的部分，并将自身的一部分注入其中，扰乱细胞的功能从而使其制造出更多的病毒，并且在这一过程中自我毁灭。
en: The virus is shaped so that it can drill into a particular feature of that cell and inject parts of itself inside, confusing the cell into making more viruses and destroying itself in the process.

zh: 病毒非常特定的形态，使得最有效的抗病毒疫苗必须针对窄范围的因素而设计。
en: With their very specific forms, the most effective anti-viral vaccines must be designed for a narrow range of factors.

zh: 有时病毒的特点对我们有利。
en: Sometimes the tailored nature of viruses works in our favor.

zh: 比如，它们要跨越不同物种交叉感染就很困难，因为要那样做它们就必须改变自身的结构。
en: For example, they usually find it difficult to jump between species, because they would have to change their structure.

zh: 但如果数量众多的宿主—比如鸟类—遭遇了众多的人类，那么病毒最终会找到在新型的细胞中繁殖的方法。
en: But if large numbers of a host – say, birds – encounter a great number of people, eventually the virus will find a way to prosper in a new type of cell.

zh: 鸟类是现在最令我们担心的物种，那只是因为它们的广泛分布是显而易见的。
en: Birds are the greatest concern today only because the spread is easy to see.

zh: 但艾滋病来自于猴类，而另有几种流感则来自于猪。
en: But AIDS jumped from monkeys and several types of flu jumped from swine.

zh: 任何致命的突变都需要被及时发现，以便我们能在病毒完全适应人体之前就能研制出有效的疫苗。
en: Deadly mutations of any kind need to be identified urgently, so that an effective vaccine can be designed before the strain becomes comfortable in the human body.

zh: 不幸的是，我们目前的诊测方法还不够灵敏。
en: Unfortunately our present methods of detection are not sensitive enough.

zh: 而当你意识到科学家们还应该同时监测细菌、prion蛋白和寄生虫时，就会更加忧心忡忡。
en: This is even more worrying when you realize that scientists should also be monitoring bacteria, prions, and parasites.

zh: 细菌的种类比任何生命形式都要多。
en: There are more bacteria than any other life form.

zh: 许多细菌无害地存在于我们身体里，并发挥有用的功能。
en: Many live harmlessly in our bodies and perform useful functions.

zh: 它们也很容易演化和适应，这就意味着他们能够在足够的时间里学会躲避我们的药物。
en: They evolve and adapt easily, which means that they learn to sidestep our drugs over time.

zh: 细菌的两种突变需要我们特别注意：以敌对形态发生，使他们具备超强抗药性的适应性突变；或是在“安全”的细菌群落中的致命性变种。
en: Bacteria should be checked for two types of mutation: adaptation by a hostile form that enables it to become super-immune to drugs, or a deadly mutant strain that appears in one of the multitude of “safe” bacteria.

zh: Prion蛋白是相对近期的新发现。
en: Prions are a relatively new discovery.

zh: 它们是由和健康机体使用的蛋白类似的蛋白质组成，这就意味着它们能够欺骗身体机能来制造更多的同类。
en: They are made from proteins similar to those that the body uses during healthy operations, which means that they are able to fool the body’s tools into making more prions.

zh: 它们最近才刚被确认为几种传染性疾病的病因。 其中包括疯牛病和克-雅氏病，后者通过排挤健康的脑细胞而致命。
en: They have only recently been recognized as the cause of several infectious diseases, including mad cow disease and Creutzfeldt-Jakob Disease, which kill by crowding out healthy brain cells.

zh: Prion蛋白还可能导致许多神经、呼吸和肌肉系统的疾病。
en: Many nerve, respiratory and muscle diseases might also be caused by prions.

zh: 最后，寄生虫，感染我们的简单动物，已经被划为流行病。
en: Finally, parasites, simple animals that infect us, are already classified as pandemics.

zh: 疟疾折磨着3亿人，也是全世界最大的儿童杀手。
en: Malaria afflicts 300 million people and is the world’s biggest killer of children.

zh: 许多寄生虫是蠕虫：钩虫（8亿人感染 ） ， 蛔虫（15亿人感染 ） ， 血吸虫（2亿人感染）还有引起象皮病的蠕虫（1.5亿人感染 ） 。
en: Many parasites are worms: hookworm (800 million people infected), roundworm (1.5 billion), schistosomes (200 million), and the worm that causes Elephantiasis (150 million).

zh: 还有目前被我们忽略的敌手。
en: There are also antagonists that are currently ignored.

zh: 环境中的化学元素和微粒可能在致病方面自成一派。
en: Environmental chemicals and particulates might warrant their own categories.

zh: 或者想想问题的结合，比如这些化学感染物和在空气中传播的花粉结合，就能使哮喘病例急剧增加。
en: Or consider combinations of problems, such as these chemical infectors mixing with airborne pollens, and apparently pushing up incidences of asthma.

zh: 新的真菌感染更为可怕，且更难治疗。
en: New fungal infections are even scarier and might be harder to treat.

zh: 说到底，我们不能预测威胁会在哪里出现，因此我们需要一种分布式、智能化的侦测系统。
en: The bottom line is that we can’t predict where the threat will emerge, so we need a distributed, intelligent detection system.

zh: 切实地讲，就是如何建立这样的系统。
en: In practical terms, how should it be built?

zh: “侦探们”必须是专家，有足够的能力知道一种看似平常的症状在何时会是一种紧急情况。
en: “Detectors” would have to be expert enough to know when an ordinary-looking symptom is actually an emergency.

zh: 他们应该被安排在各处，特别是在高危地区。
en: They would be located everywhere, with an emphasis on vulnerable regions.

zh: 流行性疾病的初始警报通常会出现在发展中国家，但诊测节点应该以尽可能低的代价在各国建立。
en: Initial warning signs of a pandemic are most likely to appear in the developing world, but detection nodes should be positioned in every country, with the least possible expense.

zh: 这没有听起来那么复杂。
en: This is not as difficult as it sounds.

zh: 关键是要充分利用现有基础设施。
en: The key is to harness existing infrastructure.

zh: 医疗设施在任何地方都以某种形式存在。
en: Medical infrastructure exists everywhere, in some form.

zh: 即便在腐败问题最严重的地方，它也通常是腐败程度最轻的一个机构。
en: It also tends to be the least corrupt of institutions in regions where that is a problem.

zh: 医疗中心和诊所被冀望能够在数量众多的病人当中调查病因，即便是在症状似乎寻常的情况下。
en: Medical centers and clinics would be expected to investigate the cause of ailments in a large number of their patients, even in cases where the symptoms seem common.

zh: 在公共医疗体系中只需要增加少量的科技专长和实验室设备就能满足一般的需求。
en: A small amount of additional scientific expertise and lab equipment would need to be added to a public health system that serves ordinary needs.

zh: 强化现有资源行之有效主要有两个原因：首先，城市医院比专业诊所更可能得到疾病报告。
en: Enhancing existing resources would be effective for two reasons. First, illness is more likely to be reported in a city hospital than at a specialist institute.

zh: 其次，这笔投资会推动该地区公共医疗潜力。
en: Second, the investment would boost latent public health in that region.

zh: 对贫困地区而言，对设备和培训的投入必须得到较富裕地区的支持。
en: For poor regions, investment in equipment and training would have to come from wealthier counterparts.

zh: 富国在这些方面投资的回报体现在及早发现重大威胁所能带来的利益上。
en: Rich countries could justify the expense in terms of the savings that would result from early detection of a major threat.

zh: 热带和城市贫民区是人类对抗流行病的前沿阵地，所以这些地区必须要有妥善的装备。
en: Tropical climates and urban slums are humanity’s front line against pandemics, and they should be equipped properly.

zh: 对于任何一个国家而言，公共医疗都是一笔重要资产。
en: Public health is an important asset for any nation.

zh: 在如此严峻的形势下，在每一处湿地、每一座城市、每一个公共市场和农场都设立岗哨是明智之举。
en: With so much at stake, it makes sense to place sentinels near every swamp, city, public market, and farmyard on earth.

zh: 一名囚犯的圣诞节
en: A Prisoner’s Christmas

zh: 发自基辅卢科亚尼夫斯卡监狱 — — 人家说在烽火连天的战场上不存在无神论者。
en: LUKYANIVSKA PRISON, KYIV – It has been said that there are no atheists in a foxhole.

zh: 而如今，在经历了公审和四个半月囚禁之后，我发现在监狱中也不会有无神论者存在。
en: Here, after my show trial and four and a half months in a cell, I have discovered that there are no atheists in prison, either.

zh: 当你强忍着巨大的痛楚承受连续数十个小时的审讯（即便在囚室内也不例外 ） ， 而统治当局的整个强制系统，包括其下属媒体，都试图彻底抹黑和毁掉你的时候，祈祷就成为一个人唯一私密，可信和安心的交流方式。
en: When, despite unbearable pain, you are interrogated – including in your cell – for dozens of hours without a break, and an authoritarian regime’s entire system of coercion, including its media, is trying to discredit and destroy you once and for all, prayer becomes the only intimate, trusting, and reassuring conversation that one can have.

zh: 你会觉得上帝才是你唯一的朋友和家人，因为在连一个可信赖的牧师都被禁止接触的时候，没有人能聆听你的忧虑和希冀。
en: God, one realizes, is one’s only friend and only available family, because – deprived even of access to a trusted priest – there is no one else in whom to confide one’s worries and hopes.

zh: 在这个洋溢着爱和天伦之乐的季节，身处囚室中的寂寞几乎让人无法忍受。
en: In this season of love and family, the loneliness of a prison cell is almost unbearable.

zh: 那些黯淡而死寂的夜（看守们还不时会透过铁门上的小孔窥视你 ） ， 有时囚犯们会突然发出尖啸，似乎要奋力挣脱自己的肉体，再加上那些郁闷而狂躁的狂吼，不知来自何处的窃窃私语和铁门的叮当声 — — 一切都让人难以入眠，或者焦躁不安，形同折磨。
en: The gray, dead silence of night (guards peer in voyeuristically through a slot in the door), the sudden, disembodied shrieks of prisoners, shrieks of distress and rage, the distant rattles and clangs of prison bolts: all make sleep impossible, or so restless as to be a torment.

zh: 但奇怪的是你的感官却并未被这个死寂而绝望的世界消磨殆尽，相反却得到了激发：你的思想从那些日常的念想中解脱了出来，不再局限于思考那些宏大的问题以及自己在问题中所扮演的角色 — — 精神的自由确实是这个圣诞节最意外的礼物。
en: But what is strange is that your senses are not dulled by this dead and dreadful world. On the contrary, they are ignited by it: your mind is set free from mundane concerns to ponder the inestimable and your place within it – a freedom of spirit that is a truly unexpected gift this Christmas season.

zh: 在囚室的黑暗中，我从上帝可能就在身边的意念中积累力量与希望。
en: In the cell’s darkness, I gather strength and hope from the fact that God somehow seems so near to me here.

zh: 救世主会跟那些遭受痛苦和迫害的人同在的。
en: For where else would Christ be but with those who suffer and are persecuted?

zh: 事实上，我最近正在读迪特里希·朋霍费尔令人赞叹且极具挑战性的《狱中书简》一书，他在书中渴望有一个能向世界（我们的世界）施恩的救世主，随后又能为了一个人的福祉而殉道。
en: Indeed, I have recently been reading Dietrich Bonhoeffer’s sublime and challenging Letters from Prison, in which he yearns for a Christ capable of offering mercy to a world, our world, then in the process of being martyred for a single man.

zh: 在一个希望很可能比肉体更早死亡的，狭窄，阴冷而腐臭的囚室中，朋霍费尔写出了一本充满了信念，开放性思维，可能性，当然还有希望的著作 — — 即便是在那个人类历史上最黑暗的时代。
en: Written in a cramped, dank, and putrid cell, where hope was meant to die before the body, Bonhoeffer crafted a book rich in faith, openness, possibility, and, yes, hope – even in humanity’s darkest hour.

zh: 在我对当前乌克兰的困境陷入沉思时书中的某一段话特别能产生共鸣 — — 在知道自己不久将被纳粹处决的时候，朋霍费尔在狱中写到 ： “ 这些（暴行）并未掩盖，而是揭露了 … … 世界对神的不敬畏，并因此产生了一道意料之外的光芒”
en: One particular passage resonates with me as I contemplate Ukraine’s plight. As he awaited his approaching execution by the Nazis, Bonhoeffer wrote that, in prison, “the godlessness of the world is not...concealed but, rather, revealed, and is thus exposed to an unexpected light.”

zh: 因此我在这个圣诞节得到了一丝宽慰，因为我知道当前这个基辅政权的对神的不敬，它们的暴虐和罪恶都被一道真真切切的光芒暴露在世人面前。
en: So I take some comfort this Christmas in knowing that the godlessness, inhumanity, and criminality of the regime that is now ruling in Kyiv is, at long last, being exposed to the world in a clear light.

zh: 它的民主外衣都被愤世疾俗的政治笑话所剥光，它那些带领国家加入欧盟的承诺沦为空话，而那些损公肥私者的贪婪性也暴露无疑。
en: Its democratic posturing has been unmasked as cynical political theater, its claim to desire a European future for Ukraine’s people revealed to be a lie, and the rapaciousness of its kleptocrats has been laid bare.

zh: 该政权对宪法和法治的蔑视如今已经无法掩盖，而且越发明显。
en: The regime’s contempt for the constitution and the rule of law is now undeniable, and that clarity is empowering.

zh: 更重要的是，乌克兰人民所遭受的苦难也更加广为人知，而我们也因此不再孤立。
en: More importantly, the suffering of Ukraine’s people has also become more widely known, and we are no longer so alone in our plight.

zh: 欧洲和全世界都将缓解乌克兰的痛苦当成一项正义事业来推动。
en: Alleviating it has been embraced as a just cause across Europe and around the world.

zh: 在乌克兰国内每天发生的压制人民权利，压制媒体言论，对商界的敲诈勒索都表明在欧洲的边界上存在着一个黑手党国家。
en: The everyday oppression, stifled media, and shakedowns and extortion of businesses for bribes all point to a mafia state on Europe’s border.

zh: 我们的欧洲朋友们虽然被迫要跟这个政权打交道，但如今它们也不再隐瞒该政权那种自以为是的可耻行径。
en: Now our European friends can no longer deny the smug vileness of the regime with which they are forced to deal.

zh: 而我也对圣诞节而感到欣慰，因为我可以相信民主欧洲不会再容忍这一事态。
en: And I am thankful this Christmas for being able to believe that democratic Europe will not tolerate this state of affairs.

zh: 乌克兰人也会强烈地感知到自己并非在孤军奋战。
en: Ukrainians will be strong knowing that they are not alone in their fight.

zh: 我不想把自己伪装成一个宗教信仰和精神价值观方面的专家。
en: I do not pretend to be an expert on religious faith and spiritual values.

zh: 我只是一个不愿意相信人类的存在只是宇宙中某个偶发意外的信徒。
en: I am only a believer who cannot accept that our existence is the result of some freak cosmic accident.

zh: 我相信，我们是一个神秘而完整的行为的一部分，而我们存在的原因，方向和目的虽然一时难以捉摸，却必定有着某种意义和目的 — — 即便是在高墙之内。
en: We are, I believe, part of a mysterious yet integral act, whose source, direction, and purpose, though difficult to grasp at times, does have meaning and purpose – even when one is confined behind prison bars.

zh: 我信仰我们的存在是有意义的，而我们所做的决定必须由其道德内容来判定，至此乌克兰人，乃至其他地方的人们才能找到走出过去两年所经历的痛苦，悲伤和绝望之路。
en: It is only faith in the idea that our lives matter, and that our decisions must be judged by their moral content, that we in Ukraine, and elsewhere, will be able to find our way out of the misery, unhappiness, and despair that has consumed us over the last two years.

zh: 我们有能力去恢复或者重振我们的自由和社会，不是依靠个人的力量，而是通过将全世界志同道合的人们联合起来。
en: It is within our power to recover or reinvigorate our freedoms and our societies, not by individual efforts, but by joining forces with likeminded people all over the world.

zh: 我知道我们将会做到这一点。
en: I know that we will manage this.

zh: 这个圣诞节，我告诉我的家人和朋友不要为我担心。
en: This Christmas, I ask my family and friends everywhere not to worry about me.

zh: 正如斯大林恐怖时期的伟大诗人安娜·阿赫马托娃所说 ： “ 我在这坟墓中活着。
en: As Anna Akhmatova, the great poetic chronicler of Stalin’s terror, said, “I am alive in this grave.”

zh: ”事实上，我知道自己比那些囚禁我的人更加鲜活。
en: Indeed, I am more alive, I know, than the men who have imprisoned me here.

zh: 圣诞节意味着一个所有人迎接新开端的可能。 而正如朋霍费尔在书中最后一段断言的那样��“这正是我 … … 生命的开端 . ”
en: Christmas is meant to mark the possibility of a new beginning for all men and women.

zh: 尤利娅·季莫申科，乌克兰政治反对派领袖，曾两度担任乌克兰总理。
en: As Bonhoeffer affirmed with his last words: “This is for me...the beginning of life.”

zh: 是个人私事吗？
en: A Private Affair?

zh: 公众人物可以有私生活吗？
en: Can a public figure have a private life?

zh: 最近发生在三个国家的事件突出了这一问题的重要性。
en: Recent events in three countries have highlighted the importance of this question.

zh: 在法国总统选举中，两名候选人都试图让他们的家庭事务从他们的竞选中分离开来。
en: In the French presidential election, both candidates tried to keep their domestic life separate from their campaign.

zh: 奥朗德是罗亚尔的四个孩子的父亲，但是罗亚尔并没有和他结婚。
en: Ségolène Royal is not married to François Hollande, the father of her four children.

zh: 当被问及他们是否是夫妻的时候，罗亚尔回答说 ： “ 我们的生活属于我们自己。
en: When asked whether they were a couple, Royal replied, “Our lives belong to us.”

zh: ”同样地，在应对当选总统萨尔科奇的妻子已经离他而去的传言时，萨尔科奇的一名发言人说 ： “ 这是一个私人问题。 ”
en: Similarly, in response to rumors that President-elect Nicholas Sarkozy’s wife had left him, a spokesman for Sarkozy said, “That’s a private matter.”

zh: 法国人具有尊重政治人物个人生活隐私的悠久传统，而法国的舆论也要比美国的更为宽宏大量。 在美国，一个没有结婚的四个孩子的母亲是没有机会被提名成为一个主要政党总统候选人的。
en: The French have a long tradition of respecting the privacy of their politicians’ personal lives, and French public opinion is more broad-minded than in the United States, where an unwed mother of four would have no chance of being nominated for the presidency by a major party.

zh: 实际上在上个月，美国国务院最高外国援助顾问脱拜尔斯在承认他使用了据称是提供“性爱幻想”的陪伴服务后辞职，尽管他说他只是接受了按摩。
en: Indeed, last month, Randall Tobias, the top foreign aid adviser in the US State Department, resigned after acknowledging that he had used an escort service described as providing “high-end erotic fantasy” – although Tobias said he only had a massage.

zh: 在英国，英国石油公司的首席执行官布朗爵士将该公司从一个二流的欧洲石油公司转变为一个全球性巨人。 他在承认他在法庭中就有关他如何遇上一位同性恋伴侣（很明显，他通过一个男性陪伴机构遇上他的）的问题上撒谎后辞职。
en: In Britain, Lord John Browne, the chief executive who transformed BP from a second-tier European oil company into a global giant, resigned after admitting he had lied in court about the circumstances in which he had met a gay companion (apparently, he met him through a male escort agency).

zh: 在辞职的时候，他说他一直认为他的性问题是个人事务，而且他对星期天邮报将此事公之于众感到失望。
en: In resigning, he said that he had always regarded his sexuality as a personal matter, and he was disappointed that a newspaper – The Mail on Sunday – had made it public.

zh: 人们应该用政策和业绩来评判公职竞选人以及那些占据较高行政或企业职位的人，而不是与他们如何履行公职无关的个人行为。
en: Candidates for public office, and those holding high administrative or corporate positions, should be judged on their policies and performance, not on private acts that are irrelevant to how well they carry out, or will carry out, their public duties.

zh: 当然，在某些时候这两者会重叠。
en: Sometimes, of course, the two overlap.

zh: 星期天邮报及其姐妹报纸每日邮报把表布朗前伴侣的披露材料，其理由是这些材料包括布朗允许他使用企业资源来为他的私人生意谋取利益。
en: The Mail on Sunday and its sister paper, The Daily Mail, justified their publication of revelations by Browne’s former companion on the grounds that they include allegations that Browne had allowed him to use corporate resources for the benefit of his own private business.

zh: 英国石油公司已经否认这些指控有何凭据。
en: The company denied that there was any substance to these allegations.

zh: 脱拜尔斯作为美国国际发展署署长落实了布什政府的政策，即要求想要获得美国援助的治疗预防艾滋病组织谴责卖淫。
en: As the administrator of the US Agency for International Development, Tobias implemented the Bush administration’s policy that requires organizations working against HIV/AIDS to condemn prostitution if they are to be eligible for US assistance.

zh: 这一政策使得帮助那些患上和传播艾滋病的性工作者更为困难，因而受到批评。
en: That policy has been criticized for making it more difficult to assist sex workers who are at high risk of contracting and spreading HIV/AIDS.

zh: 毫无疑问，知道落实这些政策的人们自己是否买春关系到公众的利益。
en: Arguably, the public has an interest in knowing if those who implement such policies are themselves paying for sexual services.

zh: 如果无法证明个人道德问题影响到企业执行官或政府官员业绩的时候，我们应当尊重那个人的隐私。
en: Where there is no suggestion that a matter of personal morality has had an impact on the performance of a business executive or government official, we should respect that person’s privacy.

zh: 但是对于政治领导者竞选人又当如何呢？
en: But what about candidates for political leadership?

zh: 由于政治人物要求我们对他们委以大权，也就可以说，我们应当对他们的道德尽可能地多了解。
en: Since politicians ask us to entrust them with sweeping powers, it can be argued that we should know as much as possible about their morality.

zh: 例如，我们可以合理地问他们是否缴纳他们所应缴纳的税款，或者询问他们的慈善捐款情况。
en: For example, we might reasonably ask whether they pay their fair share of taxes, or inquire about their charitable donations.

zh: 这些事情告诉我们一些有关他们对于公共福址的关切程度。
en: Such things tell us something about their concern for the public good.

zh: 同样地，三年前披露说当时的澳大利亚反对党领导人、希冀成为总理的黎敦因为出租车费争执而殴打出租车司机并打断了他的胳膊。 这对于那些相信国家领导人应道缓怒的人来说就是有关系的了。
en: Similarly, the revelation three years ago that the then-Australian opposition leader and aspiring prime minister, Mark Latham, had assaulted a taxi driver and broken his arm in a dispute about a fare was relevant for those who believe that a nation’s leader should be slow to anger.

zh: 但是，了解政治人物更多情况的合理利益是否延伸到个人关系上呢？
en: But does the legitimate interest in knowing more about a politician extend to details about personal relations?

zh: 在任何领域边上划出一条原则线并且确定获知这些情况是否会提供有关这一政治人物的道德本质是很困难的。
en: It is hard to draw a line of principle around any area and determine if knowledge of it will provide relevant information about a politician’s moral character.

zh: 问题是，媒体发表可以提高其读者量的信息关系到它们的利益，而私人情况、特别是有关性事的私人情况通常正好可以做到这一点。
en: The problem is that the media have an interest in publishing information that increases their audience, and personal information, especially of a sexual nature, will often do just that.

zh: 即使如此，人们是否决定结婚、他们是否是异性恋或是同性恋、甚至他们是否掏钱还是免费满足性幻想并不能告诉我们他们是否是可以委任以高职的好人，当然，除非他们言行不一。
en: Even so, whether people choose to marry or not, whether they are heterosexual or homosexual, even whether they pay to fulfill their erotic fantasies or have fantasies they can fulfill at no cost, tells us little about whether they are good people who can be trusted with high office – unless, of course, they say one thing while doing another.

zh: 如果我们能够培育对人类多样性更大的宽容，那么，政治人物、商界领导人以及行政官员将会不再如此惧怕“曝光 ” ， 因为他们将会认识到他们并没有做什么必须隐瞒的事情。
en: If we can cultivate a wider tolerance of human diversity, politicians, business leaders, and administrators would be less fearful of “exposure,” because they would realize that they have done nothing that they must hide.

zh: 卖淫在美国大部分地方是违法的，包括华盛顿特区，而这可能就是脱拜尔斯不得不辞职的原因之一。
en: Prostitution is illegal in most of the US, including Washington DC, and this could be one reason why Tobias had to resign.

zh: 但是，当新泽西州州长科尔金上个月卷入一起严重交通事故的时候，人们得知他没有系安全带，违反了他自己州的法律。
en: But when New Jersey Governor John Corzine was involved in a serious road accident last month, it became known that he violated his own state’s law by not wearing his seat belt.

zh: 根据任何衡量标准，科尔金的违法都要比脱拜尔斯的要更为严重。
en: By any sensible measure, Corzine’s violation of the law was more serious than that of Tobias.

zh: 要求系安全带的法律挽救了许多人的性命。
en: Laws requiring the wearing of seatbelts save many lives.

zh: 禁止卖淫的法律更本就没有什么明显的好处，还有可能有坏处。
en: Laws prohibiting prostitution do no evident good at all, and may well do harm.

zh: 但是没有人表示科尔金由于他的愚蠢和违法行为应当辞职。
en: Yet no one suggested that Corzine should resign because of his foolish and illegal act.

zh: 至少在美国，违背性关系的准则依旧带有与任何实际损害无关的道德骂名。
en: In the US, at least, breaching sexual norms still brings with it a moral opprobrium that is unrelated to any real harm it may do.

zh: 水都去哪儿了？
en: Where Has All the Water Gone?

zh: 马尼拉 — — 我们生活在一个炎热的星球上。
en: MANILA – We live on a parched planet.

zh: 农民在干旱的牧场上耕作，决策者为空空如也的水库、干枯的河流和焦渴的城市而心急火燎。
en: Farmers till arid pastureland, and policymakers fret over empty reservoirs, dry rivers, and thirsty cities.

zh: 而这还仅仅是触及了世界水问题的表面。
en: And that only scratches the surface – literally – of the world’s water problem.

zh: 起着世界蓄水箱作用的地下蓄水层同样正在干涸。
en: Subterranean aquifers, which amount to the world’s reserve water tank, are also running dry.

zh: 如果这种情况继续下去，特别是对水资源紧缺和经济发展迅速的亚洲国家来说，可能造成可怕的后果。
en: If this continues, the consequences could be dire, especially for water-stressed and fast-growing Asia.

zh: 地下蓄水层其实是深层地下水库，储存在可渗透的岩石、土壤和沙砾当中。
en: Subterranean aquifers are repositories of water located deep underground, in permeable rock, soil, or sand.

zh: 它们所含的水量是地球表面溪流、湖泊、河流和湿地所含水量的约100倍之多。
en: And they contain about 100 times the amount of water found on the earth’s surface, in streams, lakes, rivers, and wetlands.

zh: 如果你生活在中非、南美或欧洲某些区域，你脚下几百英尺深的地方可能就有地下蓄水层。
en: If you’re in central Africa, South America, or some parts of Europe, you’re probably standing just a few hundred feet above one.

zh: 地表水资源，包括脱盐海水和回收废水，弥补不了水资源供应和需求之间的全球差额 — — 预计到2030年水资源供应和需求之间将相差40%之多。
en: Surface water resources, such as desalinated seawater or recycled wastewater, will not close the global gap – predicted to reach 40% by 2030 – between water supply and demand.

zh: 因此地下蓄水层越来越多地被用于补充农业灌溉、发电和经济快速增长的城市地区的日常用水（亚洲城市人口每天增长约120，000人 ） 。
en: So subterranean aquifers are increasingly being exploited for agriculture, power generation, and daily use in fast-growing cities (urban Asia is growing at a rate of 120,000 people per day).

zh: 今天，全球液态淡水资源约30%来源于地下蓄水层。
en: Today, about 30% of the world’s liquid freshwater comes from subterranean aquifers.

zh: 2003到2013年间加利福尼亚大学所研究的37个最大规模蓄水层中有1/3已经严重干涸，而且几乎或根本得不到降雨的补充。
en: And one-third of the 37 largest aquifers studied by the University of California between 2003 and 2013 were severely depleted, receiving little or no replenishment from rainfall.

zh: 某些压力最大的蓄水层位于包括亚洲在内的最干旱区域，其中高达88%的地区水资源紧张。
en: Some of the most stressed aquifers are in the driest regions, including Asia, up to 88% of which is water-stressed.

zh: 亚洲拥有占全球1/3的地下水灌溉土地，其中印度、中国和巴基斯坦是最大的消费国。
en: Asia contains around one-third of the world’s land irrigated by groundwater, with India, China, and Pakistan being the biggest consumers.

zh: 仅南亚地区就占到全球地下水消费的一半左右。
en: South Asia alone accounts for half the groundwater used globally.

zh: 但亚洲地区的蓄水层 — — 其中许多蓄水层的形成还要追溯到几千年之前，当时中国北部地区的气候比现在更加潮湿 — — 已经无法再通过降雨得到定期补充。
en: But Asia’s aquifers – many of which were formed millennia ago, when areas like northern China had a more humid climate – are no longer being replenished regularly by rainfall.

zh: 相反，在钻孔越来越深的同时地下水位却在不断下降。
en: Instead, boreholes are getting deeper and water tables are falling.

zh: 在巴基斯坦的旁遮普省，过度抽水导致地下水位每年下降高达半米（二十英寸 ） ， 因为很难继续种植甘蔗和稻米这样的渴水植物而对今后的粮食和水安全构成威胁。
en: In Pakistan’s Punjab Province, over-pumping is lowering the water table by up to a half-meter (20 inches) per year, threatening future food and water security and making thirsty crops like sugarcane and rice tougher to grow.

zh: 亚洲的人口飙升 — — 到2050年亚洲人口可能增长25%并达到50亿左右 — — 将导致粮食、能源和水资源供应压力进一步加重。
en: Asia’s surging population – which could jump by 25%, topping five billion, by 2050 – will put even more stress on food, energy, and water supplies.

zh: 从全球范围看，到那时粮食需求将比现在多60 % ， 越来越稀缺的淡水资源将被农业吸收。
en: Globally, 60% more food will be needed by then, with agriculture soaking up increasingly scarce freshwater.

zh: 气候变化将进一步恶化现有状况。
en: Climate change will exacerbate conditions further.

zh: 但问题还不仅限于水资源消耗。
en: But the problem extends beyond water depletion.

zh: 过度抽取地下水导致土壤沉降，从而造成某些亚洲城市开始下沉。
en: Over-pumping of groundwater is already leading to soil subsidence, causing some Asian cities to sink.

zh: 到2030年，雅加达北部高达80%的地区可能沉降到海平面以下。
en: By 2030, as much as 80% of North Jakarta could be below sea level.

zh: 某些估计显示，北京的部分地区每年都会下沉几厘米。
en: Parts of Beijing are sinking by several centimeters per year, according to some estimates.

zh: 此外，靠近沿海地区枯竭的蓄水层很容易受到海水污染，从而造成土壤贫瘠化。
en: Moreover, depleted aquifers near coastlines are prone to contamination from saltwater, rendering land barren.

zh: 某些水库面临砷污染，砷污染会在地层深处自然而然的发生。
en: Some aquifers are contaminated by arsenic, which can occur naturally deep underground.

zh: 自然地球物理学估计印度恒河水库超过60%的地下水都遭受到某种程度的砷或海水污染。
en: Nature Geoscience estimates that more than 60% of groundwater in the Indo-Gangetic aquifer is contaminated by arsenic or salt.

zh: 在孟加拉，砷污染的水被指每年造成超过4万人死亡。
en: In Bangladesh, water tainted by arsenic is blamed for more than 40,000 deaths each year.

zh: 补救现状的第一步是准确估算究竟还剩多少地下水，以及所剩地下水正在如何使用 — — 做到这一点并不容易，但也不是完全不可能。
en: The first step toward remedying this situation is to establish precisely how much groundwater is left and how it is being used – not easy, but not impossible either.

zh: 美国航空航天局的重力恢复和气候试验卫星提供了因水量增减导致地球重力变化的信息。
en: NASA’s Gravity Recovery and Climate Experiment satellite provides information on changes in the earth’s gravity due to fluctuating water volumes.

zh: 通过将遥感技术运用到水文领域，我们可以确定还剩多少地表水以及所剩地表水的使用状况。
en: And by applying remote sensing technology to river basins, we can determine how much surface water is available and who is consuming what.

zh: 另外一个重要步骤是改善地下水定价。
en: Another important step is to improve the pricing of groundwater.

zh: 中国已经开展了一个农民超额用水需要额外付费的试点计划。
en: China has run a pilot program in which farmers had to pay extra if they pumped more than their allocation.

zh: 类似的举措在澳大利亚和墨西哥都收到了良好的效果。
en: Similar approaches have worked well in Australia and Mexico.

zh: 但这样的措施在政治上可能很难执行到位。
en: But such measures can be politically difficult to implement.

zh: 成功的关键在于不仅协助各国制定正确的政策，并且协助他们建立确立和执行这些政策所需的法律框架。
en: The key to success will be to help countries not only to design the right policies, but also to create the legal frameworks needed to establish and enforce them.

zh: 取消电力和天然气补贴的政治难度甚至更大。 相关补贴鼓励农民整天用地下水灌溉。
en: Even more politically difficult would be the elimination of electricity and gas subsidies, which encourage farmers to pump groundwater all day.

zh: 如果这样的补贴无法取消，我们有可以制止过度抽水的创新替代计划。
en: If such subsidies can’t be withdrawn, there are innovative alternatives that could curb over-pumping.

zh: 例如在印度古吉拉特邦，政府通过每天八小时供电来控制抽取地下水。
en: For example, in Gujarat, India, the government has reduced groundwater pumping by offering power for just eight hours per day.

zh: 农民可以得到他们所需的电能，但不能整天一刻不停的抽水。
en: Farmers have the power they need, but can’t pump all day long.

zh: 另外一个办法是从农民手中回购剩余电量并再次充回电网。
en: Another approach could be to buy back surplus power from farmers to feed into the grid.

zh: 这样做不仅可以减少过度抽水，还有利于补充农民收入。
en: That would not just reduce over-pumping, but also help to supplement rural incomes.

zh: 此外还可以采取补充蓄水层的举措。
en: Efforts to replenish aquifers could also be pursued.

zh: 印度北方邦的一个试点项目将多余的洪水收集到蓄水池中，让这些水从蓄水池中渗入到地下。
en: A pilot program in India’s Uttar Pradesh state collects excess floodwater in storage ponds, from which water seeps into the water table.

zh: 最后一步是改善地表水管理，从而在根本上抵制依靠地下水的诱惑。
en: The final step would be to improve management of surface water, thereby reducing the temptation to turn to groundwater in the first place.

zh: 约80%的废水没有经过任何处理就排入到河流并造成污染。
en: Around 80% of wastewater is returned untreated to rivers, often contaminating them.

zh: 采取强有力的措施制止这种行为无论从逻辑还是政治上都比保护地下水要简单得多。
en: Taking stronger action to stop this would be far simpler – including logistically and politically – than conserving groundwater.

zh: 地下蓄水层是人类最后的水库。
en: Subterranean aquifers should be the reservoir of last resort.

zh: 如果我们今天不善加保护，我们的子孙后代将付出沉重 — — 甚至是生存的 — — 代价。
en: If we don’t protect them today, future generations will pay a steep – or even an existential – price.

zh: 阿拉伯独裁陷阱
en: The Arab Autocracy Trap

zh: 特拉维夫—阿拉伯之春爆发已经过去六年多了，而大部分阿拉伯人的生活水平要比2011年时更加糟糕。
en: TEL AVIV – It has been more than six years since the start of the Arab Spring, and life for most Arabs is worse than it was in 2011.

zh: 中东和北非失业四肆虐，而那里的人口有三分之二年龄在15至29岁之间。
en: Unemployment is rife in the Middle East and North Africa, where two thirds of the population is between the ages of 15 and 29.

zh: 放眼整个地区，体制将政治表达渠道完全关闭，对于群众示威，体制的反应也越来越残暴。
en: And throughout the region, regimes have closed off channels for political expression, and responded to popular protests with increasing brutality.

zh: 埃及和沙特阿拉伯政府（在某种程度上，摩洛哥政府也是如此）可谓阿拉伯国家体制无力摆脱独裁陷阱的最佳写照 — — 即使目前的局势表明又一场群众觉醒就在眼前。
en: The governments of Egypt, Saudi Arabia, and, to some extent, Morocco, epitomize Arab regimes’ seeming inability to escape the autocracy trap – even as current circumstances suggest that another popular awakening is imminent.

zh: 埃及是革命如何以背叛收场的经典案例。
en: Egypt offers a classic example of how revolution often ends in betrayal.

zh: 总统西西的独裁甚至比强人穆巴拉克还要暴力，后者统治了埃及30年，在2011年的暴动中被推翻。
en: President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi’s dictatorship is even more violent than that of Hosni Mubarak, the strongman whose 30-year rule was ended by the 2011 uprising.

zh: 在被他本人称为 “百万黑帮”的警察部队的协助下，西西将镇压变成了体制最突出的组织原则。
en: With the help of a police force that he himself describes as a “million-man mafia,” Sisi has made repression the paramount organizing principle of his regime.

zh: 改革埃及经济、使之能够受惠于其9,500万人口（外加每年新增的两百万人 ） ， 对任何人来说都是一个异常艰巨的任务。
en: It would be a Herculean feat for anyone to reform Egypt’s economy so that it benefits the country’s 95 million people (plus the two million added every year).

zh: 而这个任务又是埃及领导人无可回避的，因为穆巴拉克时代的社会契约 — — 埃及人用自由换取不断扩张的福利国家和慷慨的补助 — — 已难以为继。
en: And it is a task that Egypt’s leaders cannot avoid, because the social contract of the Mubarak years, whereby Egyptians traded freedom for an expansive welfare state and generous subsidies, is no longer sustainable.

zh: 埃及年轻人失业率高达40 % ， 只有坚定的改革派总统能够将埃及从经济灾难的边缘拉回来。
en: With youth unemployment at 40%, only a bold reformist president could pull Egypt back from the brink of economic disaster.

zh: 悲哀的是，西西并未没有给六年前在开罗解放广场（Tahrir Square）示威的年轻一代埃及人带来希望，而是打击个人项目，让军队成为经济的主要行为方。
en: Sadly, rather than providing hope to the younger generation of Egyptians who protested in Tahrir Square six years ago, Sisi has stifled individual initiative and made the army the primary actor in the economy.

zh: 也许是担心导致更大的社会动荡，因此西西至今仍未满足去年11月国际货币基金组织（IMF）所提出的作为其120亿美元援助计划的一部分的条件。
en: Perhaps fearing even greater social unrest, Sisi has yet to meet the conditions set last November by the International Monetary Fund as part of a $12 billion bailout.

zh: 这些条件包括大幅削减埃及臃肿的公共部门（目前仍有六百万雇员，不包括军队和警察）的工资以及减少补贴（目前仍占国民预算的30 % ） 。
en: These include drastically reducing the wage bill for Egypt’s bloated public sector, which still employs six million people (not counting the army and police); and reducing subsidies, which still constitute 30% of the national budget.

zh: 此外，西西所提供的表达政治诉求的制度性渠道，甚至比穆巴拉克时代的一党制还要少。
en: Moreover, Sisi has offered even fewer institutional channels for political expression than existed under the Mubarak-era one-party system.

zh: 据埃及经济和社会权力中心（Egyptian Centre for Economic and Social Rights ） ， 2016年埃及街头抗议数量比阿拉伯之春前的平均水平多五倍。
en: According to the Egyptian Centre for Economic and Social Rights, there were five times more street protests in Egypt in 2016 than there were, on average, in the years preceding the Arab Spring.

zh: 一座社会火山正在形成，迟早会爆发。
en: A social volcano is forming; sooner or later, it will have to erupt.

zh: 在沙特阿拉伯，神权君主制相对轻松地抵挡住了阿拉伯之春，因为体制能够用慷慨施舍收买公民。
en: In Saudi Arabia, the monarchical-theocratic regime weathered the Arab Spring with relative ease, because it could lavish its citizens with largesse.

zh: 但由于石油价格下跌以及人口暴增（光是在过去的十年就增加了25 % ） ，沙特王国的社会契约 — — 和埃及一样 — — 已经难以为继。
en: But the kingdom’s social contract, like Egypt’s, has become unsustainable, owing to falling oil prices and a population that has grown by more than 25% in the last decade alone.

zh: 今年早些时候，沙特政府被迫削减了公共部门薪资和基本公共品补贴。
en: Earlier this year, the Saudi government was forced to cut public-sector salaries and subsidies on basic goods.

zh: 这对体制来说是一个巨大的风险（事实上，在四个城市爆发了示威之后，薪资削减很快又被加了回去 ） ， 原因之一是国家是沙特公民的最大雇主。
en: This represents a major risk for the regime (indeed, the salary cuts were quickly restored, after protests were called in four cities), not least because the state is the largest employer of Saudi citizens.

zh: 该地区的许多独裁者信奉非民主发展的“中国模式 ” 。
en: Many of the region’s autocrats have put their faith in the “China model” of non-democratic development.

zh: 但这一模式显然让他们一败涂地。
en: But that model has clearly failed them.

zh: 这一模式的社会和政治体制化要求远远超过了阿拉伯世界所具备的条件。
en: It requires far too much socioeconomic and political regimentation to be workable under prevailing conditions in the Arab world.

zh: 这意味着沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（Mohammed bin Salman）的雄心勃勃的计划面临着一个漫长而不确定的过程。 萨勒曼王储意欲将基于石油的沙特经济转型为现代工业经济。
en: This implies that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman’s ambitious plan to transform his country’s oil-based economy into a modern industrial economy will require a long and uncertain process.

zh: 经济改革想要成功，就必须辅之以深远的政治改革，而政治改革又必然会震动体制的基石。
en: Economic reforms will succeed only if they are coupled with far-reaching political reforms, which would inevitably shake the regime’s foundation.

zh: 和沙特阿拉伯一样，另一个君主国摩洛哥也在阿拉伯之春中基本安然无恙。
en: Like Saudi Arabia, Morocco, another monarchy, came through the Arab Spring largely unscathed.

zh: 当时，穆罕默德六世国王回应示威者说将进行宪政改革和选举。
en: At the time, King Mohammed VI wisely responded to protesters by offering constitutional reforms and elections.

zh: 但摩洛哥现在面临着自己的“突尼斯时刻 ” — —类似于2010年街头小贩博阿齐齐（Mohamed Bouazizi）为反对国家对自己的骚扰而自焚。
en: But Morocco is now facing its own “Tunisia moment,” reminiscent of the street vendor Mohamed Bouazizi’s self-immolation in 2010, in protest against state harassment.

zh: 博阿齐齐的绝望之举点燃了阿拉伯之春。
en: Bouazizi’s desperate act sparked the Arab Spring.

zh: 去年，摩洛哥也经历了可怕的类似一幕。 商人费克里（Mouhcine Fikri）在试图找回被当局没收的渔获时，被垃圾压缩机碾死。
en: And last year, Morocco experienced a gruesome echo of it when the merchant Mouhcine Fikri was crushed to death in a trash compactor while trying to retrieve fish confiscated by the authorities.

zh: 费克里致死引发了摩洛哥北部里夫（Rif，该地区有着长期叛乱史）的示威潮。
en: Fikri’s death triggered a wave of protests across the northern Rif, a region with a long history of rebelliousness.

zh: 革命的条件常常让此前默默无闻的领导人横空出世。
en: Revolutionary conditions often give rise to previously unknown leaders.

zh: 在里夫，一位名叫纳赛尔·泽夫扎菲（Nasser Zefzafi）的失业男子所领导的示威很快就蔓延到摩洛哥其他地区。
en: In the Rif, a 39-year-old unemployed man named Nasser Zefzafi led protests that quickly spread to other parts of the country.

zh: 通过在线视频，他用方言猛烈抨击政府腐败和摩洛哥的“独裁 ” 。
en: Through online videos, he delivered fiery speeches in the local vernacular against government corruption and Morocco’s “dictatorship.”

zh: 6月11日，首都拉巴特爆发了自阿拉伯之春以来最大规模的群众示威。
en: And on June 11, the capital, Rabat, was the site of the largest popular protest since the outbreak of the Arab Spring.

zh: 与其父哈桑二世国王不同，穆罕默德支持拉夫地区的本土柏柏尔（Berber）文化，并投入资金将里夫沿海地带改造为制造业枢纽。
en: Unlike his father, King Hassan II, Mohammed has supported the region’s indigenous Berber culture, and made investments to turn the Rif coastal region into a manufacturing hub.

zh: 但进步一波三折，因为君主牢牢掌握着所有政府领衔的经济项目。
en: But progress has been erratic, because the monarchy has maintained a tight grip on all government-led economic initiatives.

zh: 2015年许下的投资承诺至今仍未兑现。
en: Investments that were promised in 2015 have yet to materialize.

zh: 尽管如此，摩洛哥君主制在用深思熟虑的方法应对公众情绪时仍然要胜其他阿拉伯体制一筹。
en: Still, Morocco’s monarchy has always been a step ahead of other Arab regimes when it comes to devising calculated responses to the popular mood.

zh: 这一政治技巧，再加上摩洛哥不断改善的经济，有助于体制抵挡住当下的动荡和未来暴力剧变。
en: This political savvy, combined with the country’s improving economy, could help the regime weather today’s turbulence and the next violent upheaval.

zh: 但政府也必须落实其2011年所承诺的政治改革；放松对经济的把持；并促进包容性增长和繁荣，包括解决深刻的地区差异。
en: But the government will also have to follow through on the political reforms it promised in 2011; loosen its grip on the economy; and promote inclusive growth and prosperity, including by addressing deep regional disparities.

zh: 当自鸣得意的国王和“民选”独裁者不用自上而下的可控革命应对群众示威，就难免会面临更加猛烈的自下而上的革命。
en: When complacent kings and “elected” autocrats do not respond to public protests with a controlled revolution from above, they inevitably face a much fiercer revolution from below.

zh: 对阿拉伯各国来说，不管是补贴承诺，还是镇压威胁，都无法让政治的精灵重新回到瓶中。
en: For the Arab regimes, neither the promise of subsidies nor the threat of repression can squeeze the political genie back into its bottle.

zh: 实现阿拉伯在线教育
en: Bringing Arab Education Online

zh: 迪拜 — — 教育一直以来都是阿拉伯世界的难题，高质量学校教育严重缺乏导致技能差距扩大，致使许多年轻人（甚至包括大学毕业生）因找不到工作而丧失了生活的希望。
en: DUBAI – Education has long been a challenge in the Arab world, with inadequate access to high-quality schooling contributing to a widening skills gap that is leaving many young people, even graduates, unemployed and hopeless.

zh: 在一个受困于冲突和混乱的地区，解决上述问题绝非易事。
en: In a region plagued by conflict and disorder, addressing these problems will not be easy.

zh: 但如果本着大胆和创新的态度，这样的任务也是可以完成的。
en: But, with a bold and innovative approach, it can be done.

zh: 当然，没有哪种策略确保可以解决阿拉伯世界的教育难题。
en: Of course, no single strategy is guaranteed to resolve the Arab world’s educational challenges.

zh: 最近成立了阿卜杜拉·古赖尔教育基金，该基金拥有11亿美元资本，并承担着为阿拉伯青年提供奖学金而拓展其机会的任务。 我们对各种可能方法的效率 — — 和成本效益 — — 进行过深思熟虑。
en: At the newly created Abdulla Al Ghurair Foundation for Education, which has $1.1 billion and a mandate to broaden opportunities for young Arabs by providing them with scholarships, we have given a lot of thought to the effectiveness – and cost-effectiveness – of the various possible approaches.

zh: 结果有一种方案脱颖而出：那就是在线教育。
en: And one option stands out: online learning.

zh: 阿拉伯国家在扩大互联网接入方面进步迅速。
en: Already, Arab countries are making rapid progress in expanding Internet connectivity.

zh: 到2018年，阿拉伯世界预计将拥有2.26亿互联网用户，在总人口中占比超过55 % — —相比全球均值高出近7 % 。
en: By 2018, there are expected to be some 226 million Internet users in the Arab world, amounting to more than 55% of the population – almost 7% higher than the global average.

zh: 但绝大多数年轻人将互联网用于社交媒体、而非用于经济或教育目的。
en: But the vast majority of young people use the Internet for social media, rather than for economic or educational purposes.

zh: 从这个意义上讲，他们正在错失一次重大的机遇，尤其考虑到在提高在线教育效率和吸引力方面已经取得了长足的进步就更是如此。
en: In this sense, they are missing out on a major opportunity, especially given the strides that have been made in improving the effectiveness and appeal of online learning.

zh: 如今，世界一流大学都开设了计算机和工程学领域的在线课程。
en: Nowadays, the world’s top universities teach computer science and engineering classes online.

zh: 而且，与人们普遍的认知相反，这些课程并不是没有实用价值且长达两小时的在线讲座。
en: And, contrary to popular belief, these are not two-hour-long online lectures with no practical component.

zh: 相反，它们包含简短的视频教程、在实际场景中练习概念的互动讲解以及为学生提供有价值反馈的测验和同伴评估。
en: Rather, they comprise short video tutorials, interactive activities to practice concepts in realistic scenarios, and quizzes and peer assessments that provide valuable feedback to students.

zh: 多亏有了这些快速发展的模型，在线教育现在已经成为比传统教育更好的选择。
en: Thanks to this fast-evolving model, online learning is now a better alternative to traditional education than ever.

zh: 这的确是一则振奋人心的消息。
en: This is great news.

zh: 毕竟，通过网络技术提供教育可以解决当前阿拉伯国家教育体系所面临的某些核心问题。
en: After all, delivering education via Internet technologies resolves some core challenges facing Arab countries’ education systems today.

zh: 首先就是需要廉价教育的年轻人纯粹的数量问题。
en: For starters, there is the sheer number of young people who need affordable access to education.

zh: 一旦社区实现上网（阿拉伯世界在这方面进展越来越迅速 ） ， 就可以以相对低成本完成拓展在线学习范围，触及成百上千万处于失学状态或无法进入高质量教育机构的年轻人的任务。
en: Once a community has Internet access, as the Arab world increasingly does, scaling up online learning to reach the millions of young people who are currently out of school or do not have access to high-quality institutions can be done at relatively low cost.

zh: 阿拉伯世界仅有的几座高等教育学府肯定无法容纳那么多学生。
en: The Arab world’s few strong institutions of higher education certainly could not accommodate that many students.

zh: 而且即使有这个能力，它们也很可能拒绝做此选择。
en: And even if they could, they might choose not to.

zh: 我们曾亲眼目睹地区及世界各地大学如何对叙利亚及其他地区难民关上大门，迫使他们不得不克服巨大的官僚主义和财务障碍的事实。
en: We have seen firsthand how universities in the region and around the world have shut their doors in the faces of refugees from Syria and elsewhere, forcing them to overcome huge bureaucratic and financial hurdles.

zh: 第二个问题是目前提供的教育质量极低。
en: The second challenge is the low quality of education currently being delivered.

zh: 长久以来，地区高等教育机构不必向外界证明其所提供的教育服务符合国际质量标准和要求。
en: For far too long, the region’s post-secondary institutions have operated without having to prove that the education they provide aligns with global quality standards and expectations.

zh: 在线教育将大大降低衡量进展的难度，并确保学生们能够学到实用的知识和技能。
en: Through online learning, it would be far easier to measure progress and ensure that students are acquiring knowledge and skills they can actually use.

zh: 不仅如此，在线教育还可以促进创新教育及学习方法的引入。
en: Meanwhile, online learning can facilitate the introduction of new and innovative teaching and learning methods.

zh: 例如，传统授课和死记硬背的减少可以为各类自学及个性化的学习及评估工具创造空间，不少教授现在在大规模开放式在线课程平台及其他在线教育平台上采用这些工具。
en: For example, a reduction in traditional lecturing and rote learning could create space for the kinds of self-paced and personalized learning and assessment tools being used by professors delivering Massive Open Online Courses on EdX and other online educational platforms.

zh: 第三，阿拉伯世界面临着提供不间断教育服务的难题。
en: Third, the Arab world faces the challenge of delivering continuous learning.

zh: 要想适应当今快速变化的经济环境（也就是说技术的应用让很多岗位变得多余并且与此同时鼓励更高程度的专业化 ） ， 世界各地的工人必须持续升级并拓展他们的技能范围。
en: In order to thrive in today’s fast-changing economic environment, where technology is making many jobs redundant and rewarding greater specialization, workers everywhere must consistently upgrade or expand their skill sets.

zh: 目前的现状是，阿拉伯世界只有来自富裕家庭的年轻人因为无需承担家庭和工作方面的压力而能以获取一流大学研究生学历等方式进行不间断的学习。
en: As it stands, only wealthy young people in the Arab world, without personal commitments such as families and jobs, can pursue continuous learning, in the form of graduate degrees from top universities.

zh: 开放式在线课程可以提供得到专业人士接受的学历认证，从而通过创造公平的竞争环境提升个人的职业前途。
en: Open online courses can level the playing field by offering professionally recognized credentials that boost a person’s career prospects.

zh: 考虑到所有这一切，我们成立了古赖尔开放教学奖学金计划，旨在通过在线学位课程为阿拉伯年轻人提供世界最好的教育。
en: Taking all of this into consideration, we have created the Al Ghurair Open Learning Scholars Program, aimed at making some of the best education in the world available to Arab youth through online degree programs.

zh: 我们通过与麻省理工学院合作制定了很高的标准，后者是开放式在线教育领域的领导者。
en: We are setting the bar high, by establishing our first collaboration with MIT, a leader in open online learning.

zh: 麻省理工和开放教学奖学金计划一道将创办两项全新的“微硕士”计划，包括阿拉伯世界目前尚未讲授的所谓STEM（科学、技术、工程和数学）学科5项为期12周的课程。
en: Together, MIT and the Open Learning Scholars Program will create two new “MicroMasters” programs consisting of five 12-week courses in so-called STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics) that are not currently taught in the Arab world.

zh: 我们期待（对阿拉伯和其他国家青年开放的）上述计划能够显著调动学生的积极性，并能得到来自雇主的强有力的支持。
en: We expect these programs – accessible to young people in Arab countries and beyond – will attract significant interest from students and strong support from employers.

zh: 但为实现投资影响的最大化，我们还必须改变在线教育的观念，而这需要教育机构和私营部门的共同努力。
en: But, in order to maximize the impact of our investment, perceptions of online learning must change, which will require a joint effort by educational institutions, government, and the private sector.

zh: 的确，阿拉伯教育机构必须开始探索发展高质量在线计划的奥秘。
en: Indeed, Arab educational institutions must begin to explore the development of high-quality online programs.

zh: 就其本身而言，政府应当重新思考承认由可靠并经过国际认证的机构提供在线教育的立场。
en: For their part, governments should reconsider their position on recognizing online learning delivered by credible and internationally accredited institutions.

zh: 而就私营主体而言，关键在于对通过在线计划取得学位和证书的员工进行奖励。
en: As for private-sector actors, the key will be to reward employees with degrees and certifications received through online programs.

zh: 与此同时，阿卜杜拉·古赖尔教育基金将着手开展协调一致地行动，以便为阿拉伯青年提供世界一流大学颁发的创新STEM（科学、技术、工程和数学）学位。
en: In the meantime, the Abdulla Al Ghurair Foundation for Education will embark on a concerted effort to make innovative STEM degrees offered online by the world’s best universities available to Arab youth.

zh: 不这样做相当于允许绝大多数阿拉伯青年掉队。
en: Not to do so would risk allowing the majority of Arab young people to be left behind.

zh: 阿拉伯的父与子
en: Arab Fathers and Sons

zh: 1999-2000年，约旦、摩洛哥、巴林和叙利亚的领导人在短时间内相继去世，开始了一场世代的交替，而亚瑟·阿拉法特和阿联酋长期以来的领导人谢赫·宰德之死正是这场交替的延续。
en: The deaths of Yasir Arafat and of Sheikh Zayd, the long-standing ruler of the United Arab Emirates, continues the generational change that began in 1999-2000, when the leaders of Jordan, Morocco, Bahrain, and Syria died in quick succession.

zh: 整个中东的人口比世界平均水平年轻，但他们的政治领导人年龄却高于世界平均水平。
en: Across the Middle East people are younger, and their political leaders older, than the world average.

zh: 这种一代精英被下一代逐渐代替的过程可能是判断阿拉伯世界的改革是否有效的关键因素之一。
en: The gradual replacement of one generation of elites by another may be one of the key factors in determining whether or not effective reform takes place in the Arab world.

zh: 目前，这个地区的社会政治地图上有四代政治领导人共存。
en: At present, four political generations co-exist on the region’s socio-political map.

zh: 逐渐离任的一代领导人 — — 即阿拉法特、侯赛因国王或哈菲兹·阿萨德、法德国王和穆巴拉克总统一代 — — 出生于1935年以前，从20世纪70年代以来就决定着中东的事务。
en: The outgoing leadership generation – that of Arafat, King Hussein or Hafiz al-Assad, King Fahd and President Mubarak – was born before 1935 and has determined events in the Middle East since the 1970’s.

zh: 这一代领导人在去殖民化的时期成年，并开始职业生涯。
en: These leaders came of age and began their careers during the era of decolonization.

zh: 他们是在加麦尔·阿卜杜勒·纳赛的泛阿拉伯民族主义教育下长大的。 对他们来说，最重要的政治事件是1967年阿以战争中阿拉伯的失利。
en: They were weaned on Gamal Abdel-Nasser’s pan-Arab nationalism, and the crucial political event for them was the Arab defeat in the 1967 Arab-Israeli war.

zh: 这一代人寻求强有力的、能与以色列达到力量平衡的阿拉伯领袖。
en: Members of this generation sought a strong Arab leadership that would create a balance of power with Israel.

zh: 他们还相信 — — 或至少幻想过 — — 各种形式的社会主义和国家社会主义，民主和民权在他们看来并非首要问题。
en: They also believed in – or at least toyed with – forms of socialism and étatism, and did not consider democracy or civil rights to be priorities.

zh: 其后一代出生于1935到1955年之间，在很多方面都是“过渡性”的一代。
en: The next generation was born between 1935 and 1955, and in many respects represents a generation “in between.”

zh: 这一代人大多尝到了20世纪70年代石油剧增带来的经济增长和更多教育机会的好处。
en: Most benefited from the economic growth and expanded educational opportunities associated with the oil boom of the 1970’s.

zh: 同时，政坛仍然被上一代人所把持，而上一代人是决不会自愿放下手中的权力的。
en: At the same time, political participation remained blocked by the previous generation, which never intended to give up power voluntarily.

zh: 自然，这代人大多充满不满情绪，许多人开始寻求替代主流政治制度的伊斯兰制度。
en: Unsurprisingly, many in this generation grew dissatisfied, and not a few began to look for Islamic alternatives to the prevailing political systems.

zh: 然而，这代人不会在接下来的二三十年中决定事务，却极有可能被1955到1975年之间出生的下一代人赶下政治舞台。
en: Rather than determining events in the coming two or three decades, this generation is likely to be sidelined by the next cohort, born between 1955 and 1975.

zh: 这是叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德、约旦国王阿卜杜拉和摩洛哥国王穆罕默德六世的一代。
en: This is the generation of Syria’s President Bashar al-Assad, Jordan’s King Abdullah and Morocco’s King Muhammad VI.

zh: 有人把这一代称作“儿子的一代 ” — —那些数十年来领导各自国家的领导人的儿子。
en: Some call this the “generation of sons” – sons of leaders who led their states for decades.

zh: 这一代人没有怎么受到阿以战争或中东冲突的影响。
en: This age cohort was not much influenced by the Arab-Israeli wars or the East-West conflict.

zh: 相反，他们的政治教育中有1991年的海湾战争，也有20世纪90年代的阿以和平进程，包括其危机和破裂。
en: Instead, their political education included the Gulf War of 1991 and the Arab-Israeli peace process of the 1990’s, with its crises and breakdown.

zh: 除叙利亚和约旦的领导人外，入狱的西岸法塔赫领袖马尔万·巴尔古提也是这一代人的代表。
en: Jailed West Bank Fatah leader Marwan Barghouti is as representative of this group as the leaders of Syria and Jordan.

zh: 相对于社会主义和革命，这代人更熟悉全球化和经济改革的概念。
en: Members of this generation are better acquainted with notions of globalization and economic reform than with socialism and revolution.

zh: 除巴勒斯坦外，他们在各自的国家内一直过着独立和相对稳定的生活。
en: Except for the Palestinians, they have never known their countries other than as independent and comparatively stable states.

zh: 在巴勒斯坦范围内， jil al-intifada ， （ 第一、二次）巴勒斯坦起义的一代，大概会成为奠基的一代。
en: In the Palestinian territories, the jil al-intifada , the generation of the (first and second) Palestinian uprising, will likely become the founding generation.

zh: 但是阿拉伯世界世代问题的重要性在于第四代人。
en: But it is the fourth group that underscores the relevance of generational issues in the Arab world.

zh: 前三代人加起来也不过占整个阿拉伯人口的三分之一。
en: Even when combined, the first three generations make up barely one-third of the entire Arab population.

zh: 近60%的阿拉伯人都不到20岁，30岁以下的约有70 % 。
en: Almost 60% of all Arabs are younger than 20, with roughly 70% below the age of 30.

zh: 这就提出了一个关键性问题：如果目前开始掌权的一代人像穆巴拉克、阿萨德和侯赛因那一代人一样坚持不放手中的权力，这些在“婴儿潮”出生的阿拉伯人会怎样？
en: This raises a key question: what happens to these Arab “baby boomers” if the generation now coming to power clings to it as tenaciously as the generation of Mubarak, Assad, and Hussein?

zh: 与逐渐退出的一代领导人相比，巴沙尔·阿萨德、阿卜杜拉国王和加麦尔·穆巴拉克 — — 病痛缠身的埃及总统的儿子 — — 这一代政治人物的形象并没有那么一致。
en: The political generation of Bashar al-Assad, King Abdullah, and Gamal Mubarak – son of Egypt’s ailing president – forms a less coherent picture than that of the outgoing leadership.

zh: 老一代的人许多都从事着军事生涯，他们的很多助手和合作伙伴都是工程师和公仆。
en: In that elder generation, many had pursued military careers, and many of their aides and collaborators were engineers and civil servants.

zh: 新的精英们的社会职业背景要更广一些。
en: The socio-professional profile of the new elite is broader.

zh: 经济学家、银行家、企业家以及技术或通讯专家都很常见。
en: Economists, bankers, and entrepreneurs as well as of technology or communication experts are common.

zh: 同时也有更加传统的政客：代表特定社会或经济利益的人物，而不是不讲政治的技术统治论者。
en: There are also more traditional politicians: personalities who see themselves as representatives of particular social or economic interests, not as apolitical technocrats.

zh: 这个新的精英领导阶层在许多方面都比其前任更加具有全球性；他们的平均教育水平更高；有些还获得了国外学位。
en: This new leadership elite is in many ways more cosmopolitan than its predecessors; their average level of education is higher; a few have foreign degrees.

zh: 妇女的作用也多少有所增加。
en: Women also play a somewhat greater role.

zh: 摩洛哥、巴林和约旦的发展的确似乎暗示着领导层的变更有助于缓和刻板的政治结构，允许更多的人参与。
en: Developments in Morocco, Bahrain, and Jordan certainly seem to suggest that this changing of the guard can help soften rigid political structures and allow for broader participation.

zh: 但是世代的更替不一定伴随着经济改革和政治解放 — — 看看在金日成的儿子金正日的领导下的朝鲜。
en: But generational change need not be accompanied by economic reform and steps towards political liberalization – witness North Korea under Kim Il Sung’s son, Kim Jong Il.

zh: 的确，从经验看来，我们没有理由认为现代化的言谈方式、愿意解放经济的态度、以及敦促科技发展的做法就自动代表了民主化的趋势。
en: Indeed, experience gives little reason to presume that a modern way of speaking, willingness to liberalize the economy, and an urge for technological development automatically translates into a democratic opening.

zh: 要看到阿拉伯新的精英们会利用国家的权力机构消除经济议程的阻力，同时巩固其刚获得的权力，这才更实际。
en: It is more realistic to expect that the new Arab elites will make use of their states’ authoritarian institutions, both to overcome resistance to their economic agendas and to consolidate their newly acquired power.

zh: 这绝对不是一条没有风险的道路。
en: This is anything but a risk-free path.

zh: 如果不大幅度地增加参政议政的机会，包括真正具有竞争性的选举，那么，主要由年轻人构成的人口和世代基础狭隘的统治精英之间的裂痕就会加深。
en: Without a significant increase in opportunities for political participation, including genuinely competitive elections, the chasm between a predominantly young population and a ruling elite with a narrow generational base will widen.

zh: 这样持续的政治惰性最终将使越来越年轻化的阿拉伯人受到极端意识形态的吸引，同时驱使最有能力最聪明的人到其他地方寻求发展。
en: Such continuing political inertia leaves an increasingly young Arab population prey to the appeal of extremist ideologies, while driving the best and brightest to seek their fortune elsewhere.

zh: 阿拉伯的父亲和儿子们
en: Arab Fathers and Sons

zh: 阿拉伯世俗共和国的政权交接问题凸显了它们在转向后革命时代时所面临的困境，因为在未能建立强大制度的政体内进行的政权交接总是会引发体系的危机。
en: The problem of succession in the Arab secular republics highlights their predicament in the transition to a post-revolutionary phase, for succession in regimes that fail to build strong institutions always risks triggering a systemic crisis.

zh: 尽管某些倾向在家族内部进行交接的决定也许缺乏民主，但是却并非完全没有优点。
en: While the decision by some in favor of dynastic succession may be lacking in democracy, it is not entirely devoid of merit.

zh: 值得玩味的是，这样的选择有利于经济现代化、结束政治斗争以及进一步推进政治变革。
en: Arguably, it is a choice for economic modernization, for an end to the politics of conflict, and for positive political change further down the road.

zh: 受到西方支持的专制政权多年来把任何可能会取代在位的阿拉伯政权的成长中的自由主义运动都扼杀在襁褓之中，并且任何突然推行的自由选举都演变成伊斯兰民主危险的实施。
en: Years of Western-backed repressive authoritarianism nipped in the bud any potential growth of a liberal alternative to the incumbent Arab regimes, and turned any abrupt move to free elections into a dangerous exercise in Islamic democracy.

zh: 这样的民主产生了被哈马斯、真主党或穆斯林兄弟会所领导的政府，它们无可避免地会与西方对抗并且反对由美国所倡导的与以色列之间的“和平进程 ” 。
en: A democracy that produces governments led by Hamas, Hezbollah, or the Muslim Brotherhood is inevitably bound to be anti-Western and opposed to an American-inspired “peace process” with Israel.

zh: 叙利亚已经通过类似君主制的世袭继承来寻求确保政权的延续，哈菲兹·阿萨德把政权交给了他的儿子巴沙尔。
en: Syria has already sought to assure regime continuity through quasi-monarchic hereditary succession with the move from Hafez al-Assad to his son Bashar.

zh: 有迹象显示埃及也会步其后尘，穆巴拉克的儿子贾迈尔将会继位。
en: There are indications that Egypt might follow suit, with Hosni Mubarak’s son, Gamal, taking over.

zh: 同样地，利比亚的卡扎菲可能也会让他的儿子赛费尔·伊斯兰接班。
en: Likewise, Libya’s Muammar Khaddafi may be succeeded by his son, Seif el Islam.

zh: 作为革命军事政变的产物，这些世俗民族主义政权没能产生大众合法性，而是不得不退回到被他们所推翻的政权所实行的世袭继承中来。
en: As products of revolutionary military takeovers, these secular nationalist regimes failed to produce genuine popular legitimacy and have had to fall back on the dynastic succession practiced by the regimes they toppled.

zh: 世袭继承的中心在于寻求和平和稳定，这一点当哈菲兹·阿萨德同意以空前的亲善姿态带动巴拉克政府达成和平协议。
en: The centrality of hereditary succession in the quest for peace and stability was shown by Hafez al-Assad when he agreed to unprecedented good will gestures aimed at drawing Ehud Barak’s Israeli government into a peace deal.

zh: 作为一个几个月后就将辞世的年老体弱的人，他有一种要达成协议的紧迫感，以便让他缺乏经验的儿子不再受到为收回戈兰高地而进行斗争的压力。
en: An old and sick man who was to die a few months later, he acted with a sense of urgency to reach a deal that would relieve his inexperienced son of the burden of struggling for the recovery of the Golan Heights.

zh: 巴沙尔对他父亲的遗产基本保持了忠诚。
en: Bashar Assad remains essentially loyal to his father’s legacy.

zh: 与朝鲜和伊朗挑衅性的核战略不同，巴沙尔作为地区的“邪恶轴心”呼吁与美国进行对话，而不是使他们作出入侵的决定，以及与以色列达成妥协，而不是挑起与它的战争。
en: Not unlike North Korea’s and Iran’s defiant nuclear policies, Bashar’s membership in the region’s “axis of evil” is a call for dialogue with America, not an invitation to an invasion, and for a settlement with Israel, not a drive to wage war on it.

zh: 在埃及，穆巴拉克没有听从纳赛尔发起的革命那些玄虚的言论和它伟大的战略设计，他心里考虑的是稳定问题。
en: In Egypt, Mubarak turned his back on the lofty rhetoric of Gamal Abdel-Nasser’s revolution and its grand strategic designs. Stability is at the heart of his thinking.

zh: 因此，他无法接受美国笨拙的赞成民主的议程，而是更愿意占据阿拉伯外交支持安纳波利斯和平会议的中心舞台。
en: Hence, he could not accept America’s awkward pro-democracy agenda. But he was more than willing to occupy center stage in Arab diplomacy’s support of the Annapolis peace conference.

zh: 不管怎样，巴勒斯坦的困境在普通埃及民众中所唤起的同情是引发不稳定的危险根源。
en: After all, the passion that the Palestinians’ plight evokes among ordinary Egyptians is a dangerous source of instability.

zh: 穆巴拉克的接班问题是以一种特别复杂的方式来处理的。
en: Mubarak’s succession is being conducted in an especially sophisticated manner.

zh: 不像巴沙尔在他父亲去世前那样，他的儿子的继位问题还远远没有确定。
en: His son’s ascension, unlike that of Bashar on the eve of his father’s death, is anything but settled.

zh: 但是，执政党为了给后穆巴拉克时代做准备，他们让贾迈尔被允许获得大众合法性以及在政坛得到更高程度的接受，使他被战略性地推到可以有效地竞争总统宝座的位置。
en: But, by being allowed to acquire popular legitimacy and a high degree of acceptance within the political establishment as the driving force behind the ruling party’s preparations for the post-Mubarak era, Gamal is being positioned strategically to compete effectively for the presidency.

zh: 他得到广泛的信任为这个国家设定议程，并且是2004年以来使埃及经济发生高质量的腾飞的自由经济改革幕后的策划者。
en: He is widely credited for setting the country’s agenda, and for being the motor behind the liberal economic reforms that since 2004 have meant a qualitative leap in the Egyptian economy.

zh: 也许像穆巴拉克的批评者所说的那样，这种犹犹豫豫的民主化进程是为了阻止任何可能挑战贾迈尔地位的人。
en: It may be, as President Mubarak’s critics argue, that the faltering progress of democratization reflects the attempt to block all potential challengers to Gamal.

zh: 但是，随着世俗民族主义的式微和伊斯兰主义的崛起，穆斯林兄弟会隐藏的选举力量对这个政权以及它与西方的战略联盟都构成了致命的威胁。
en: But, with the decline of secular nationalism and Islamism’s rise, the hidden electoral power of the Muslim Brotherhood poses a mortal threat to the regime and its strategic alliance with the West.

zh: 其结果是，这个政权拒绝冒任何风险。
en: As a result, the regime refuses to take any chances.

zh: 卡扎菲决定不再被国际社会所排斥在外也并非完全与他希望留给他的儿子一个与世界和平相处的国家无关。
en: Nor was Muammar Khaddafi’s decision to stop being an international pariah entirely unrelated to his concern to bequeath to his son a state that lives in peace with the world.

zh: 他恶劣的人权记录并没有消除，但是这位奢华的“革命向导”停止不严肃地对待大规模杀伤性武器和全球恐怖主义问题以换取结束制裁和回到国际大家庭中来。
en: His abysmal human rights record remains, but the flamboyant “Guide of the Revolution” ceased flirting with weapons of mass destruction and global terrorism in exchange for the end of sanctions and international rehabilitation.

zh: 作为一个在国内的统治受到伊斯兰主义反对派挑战的病人，他认识到被国际社会所放逐加上国内的问题交给他那位被娇纵惯养的花花公子儿子来处理实在是太危险了。
en: A sick man whose rule at home is being challenged by Islamist opponents, he decided that international ostracism and domestic troubles is too explosive a combination for his son, a spoiled playboy, to handle.

zh: 阿尔及利亚的问题尤其困难。
en: Algeria is an especially difficult case.

zh: 作为革命一代最后一位幸存者，布特弗利卡总统必须想办法实现结束他的国家的内战的权力交接。
en: The last of the revolutionary generation, President Abdulaziz Buteflika must still conceive a succession that ends his country’s civil war.

zh: 尚处于襁褓之中的民主很可能会像1991年那样导致伊斯兰主义者的胜利。
en: Fully-fledged democracy might lead to victory for Islamists, as it did in 1991.

zh: 在过去通过革命产生的阿拉伯政权内部向民主的转化不能参照西方的模式，也不是F-16战斗机所能够强制实行的。
en: A transition to democracy in the old revolutionary Arab regimes will not correspond to a Western model, nor can it be imposed by American F-16’s.

zh: 但是，正如埃及、叙利亚和利比亚这些国家所表明的，世袭继承并非是一种内部的反应。
en: But, as countries like Egypt, Syria, and Lybia might be indicating, hereditary succession is not an inherently reactionary move.

zh: 相反，它意味着选择向后革命时代有控制的转变，而经济的现代化以及与国际社会的融合也许可以在未来迎来更大的政治变革。
en: Rather, it means opting for a controlled transition to a post-revolutionary phase in which economic modernization and international integration might usher in greater political change in the future.

zh: 沉默的阿拉伯多数派必须发声
en: The Silent Arab Majority Must Speak Up

zh: 阿尔及尔 — — 自从联合国发展计划署2001年开始编制阿拉伯人类发展报告（AHDR）以来，许多阿拉伯国家的状况可谓每况愈下。
en: ALGIERS – Since the United Nations Development Program began work on the Arab Human Development Reports (AHDR) in 2001, the situation in many Arab countries has gone from bad to worse.

zh: 事实上，今天该地区合作发布新报告已不太可能了。
en: In fact, today the region cannot even come together to publish a new report.

zh: 这样的情况非常不幸，因为为阿拉伯民众、尤其是阿拉伯年轻人制定新的共同目标是中东和北非实现和平繁荣的先决条件。
en: This is unfortunate, because finding a new shared vision for Arab people, especially Arab youth, is a prerequisite for ever achieving peace and prosperity in the Middle East and North Africa.

zh: 第一份阿拉伯人类发展报告发表于2002年，明确了阻碍中东地区的三大“发展赤字 ” ： 知识、女性授权和自由。
en: The first AHDR, published in 2002, identified three major “development deficits” holding the region back: knowledge, women’s empowerment, and freedom.

zh: 这份被誉为“阿拉伯人为阿拉伯人”编写的报告明确影响到地区发展前景及各国精英谈论社会问题的方式。
en: The report, described as “written by Arabs for Arabs,” had a clear influence on the regional development narrative and the way national elites talked about the problems facing their societies.

zh: 在首份阿拉伯人类发展报告发布前后，阿拉伯世界有理由对未来保持乐观。
en: Around the time of the first AHDR, the Arab world had reasons for optimism.

zh: 以色列继2000年从黎巴嫩撤军后，2005年再次从加沙撤军。
en: Israel, having withdrawn from Lebanon in 2000, withdrew from Gaza in 2005.

zh: 新任阿拉伯领导人 — — 如约旦的阿卜杜拉二世、摩洛哥的穆罕默德六世和叙利亚的巴沙尔·阿萨德 — — 都陆续上台，而且带来了变革的希望。
en: New Arab leaders – such as Abdullah II in Jordan, Mohammed VI in Morocco, and Bashar al-Assad in Syria – were coming to power and generating hope for change.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯于2003年宣布举行首次市政选举，并于2005年完成了投票。
en: Saudi Arabia announced its first municipal elections in 2003, and held them in 2005.

zh: 埃及和伊拉克两国都在2005年举行了民主选举。
en: Egypt and Iraq also both held (mostly) democratic elections in 2005.

zh: 多亏贯穿该时期始终的高油价，阿尔及利亚平息长期内乱的努力基本取得了成功。
en: And Algeria’s attempt to quell longstanding civil strife was largely successful, thanks in part to high oil prices throughout this period.

zh: 2010年12月爆发的阿拉伯之春革命在2011年始终呈燎原之势，在这场革命后，联合国开发计划署开始编制2015年阿拉伯人类发展报告，重点探讨阿拉伯青年的困境。
en: After the Arab Spring, which began in December 2010 and gained momentum through 2011, the UNDP began the 2015 AHDR, which focused specifically on the plight of Arab youth.

zh: 我本人曾是2015年阿拉伯人类发展报告编制小组成员，参与编制工作的还有约30名阿拉伯世界知识分子和活动人士。
en: I was a member of the 2015 AHDR team, along with around 30 intellectuals and activists from the Arab world.

zh: 2015年阿拉伯人类发展报告与2002年报告主题十分相似，但这次我们直接接触了有影响力的阿拉伯年轻人，以便获取尽可能详实的数据，并重点关注了吞噬阿拉伯地区的战争的后果。
en: The 2015 AHDR shared similar themes with its 2002 precursor, but this time we engaged more directly with influential Arab youth to compile the best data possible, and to put a spotlight on the effects of the wars engulfing the region.

zh: 2015年报告于2015年5月编制完成。
en: The 2015 report was finalized in May 2015.

zh: 但从那以后它就静静躺在纽约联合国开发计划署阿拉伯发展局的抽屉里，很大部分原因可能是由于对阿拉伯权力精英的严厉批评。
en: But it has lain in the drawers of the UNDP Arab Bureau in New York ever since, probably in no small part due to its harsh judgment of the Arab power elite.

zh: 2015年报告中我可以直接提到的一点是阿拉伯世界崛起了思维更自由的“沉默的多数派 ” ， 尤其是在年轻人当中。
en: One finding from the 2015 report that I can speak to directly is the emergence in the Arab world of a “silent majority” with a more liberal mindset, especially among the young.

zh: 全球民调的代际比较揭示了这一充满希望的趋势。
en: This promising trend reveals itself in generational comparisons of global opinion polls.

zh: 阿拉伯年轻人从外界获取信息的渠道比以往任何时候都多，而且他们正在接受其他国家年轻人共有的价值观。
en: Arab youth have more access to information from the outside world than ever before, and they are embracing values shared by other young people globally, rather than the values of their parents’ generation.

zh: 具体来讲，阿拉伯年轻人向往加入公民社会，从僵化的等级制度中得到解放并拥有更多的个人创造空间。
en: Specifically, Arab youth yearn for greater participation in civil society, emancipation from patriarchal hierarchies, and more space for individual creativity.

zh: 虽然因课程安排保守教育不像世界其他国家那样解放，但却无法束缚年轻人的思维。
en: While education did not emancipate as much as in the rest of the world, owing to the conservative curriculum, youth did.

zh: 鉴于这样的民调结果，2015年报告建议国家、地区和国际进步团体支持解放力量，而后者是确保找到高效执政、繁荣经济和弹性社会等多重挑战的国内解决方案的关键所在。
en: Given these findings, the 2015 report advises national, regional, and international progressive groups to support the forces of emancipation, which hold the key to finding homegrown solutions to the challenges of ensuring better governance, more productive economies, and more resilient societies.

zh: 阿拉伯世界大规模变革的唯一途径是启动创新和创造力 — — 而这需要无拘无束的民间社会。
en: The only route to large-scale change in the Arab world is to unleash innovation and creativity – and that demands an unbounded civil society.

zh: 必须建立起基本的公民权、辅以对教育体系的深刻改革、对家庭法的改革并赋予媒体和文化更多的开放空间。
en: Fundamental civil rights must be established, supported by deep changes in the education system, reforms of family law, and a more open space for media and culture.

zh: 我期待不久后即将发布的2015年报告能够鼓励理性和建设性的地区对话。
en: The 2015 report, which I hope will be published soon, should encourage a reasoned and constructive regional conversation.

zh: 报告开篇就是这样的警示 ： “ 导致年轻人边缘化的僵化的政权结构让年轻人的失望越来越深。
en: It begins with this warning: “The youth of the region are becoming continually more disenchanted with the ossified political power structures that marginalize them.

zh: 除非政府意识到这样的现实，否则他们要面对的远远不止是少数几个极端分子。 ”
en: Unless governments wake up to this blinding reality, they are going to have to deal with far more than a few extremists.”

zh: 旧秩序崩塌带来了政治真空，这样的真空被极端自杀性暗流所填补，而面对这样的暗流最坚固的防御力量是新生沉默的多数民众。
en: The new silent majority is the best defense against the radical and suicidal undercurrents that have filled the political vacuum created by the collapse of the old order.

zh: 秉承改革思维的阿拉伯人必须着力扩大中间派，而不是试图弥合极端派之间的鸿沟。
en: Reform-minded Arabs must aim to widen the center, rather than trying to bring together the fringes.

zh: 沉默的多数派必须打破沉默。
en: And the silent majority needs to break its silence.

zh: 否则，对无法接受的现状的反抗将继续由极端分子所主导，这些人只有怨恨，没有志向。
en: Otherwise, revolts against an unacceptable status quo will continue to be led by extremists, who have only grievances, not aspirations.

zh: 21世纪初的阿拉伯世界曾经充满希望，而今天我们看到希望又再次出现在年轻人身上。
en: The early 2000s held promise for the Arab world, and in today’s youth we can see it renewed.

zh: 阿拉伯民间社会改革者必须出来说话，否则就会冒险让又一代人失去希望。
en: Arab civil-society reformers must be encouraged to speak up now, or risk losing that promise for another generation.

zh: 阿拉伯之春后的经济增长
en: Economic Growth After the Arab Spring

zh: 坎布里奇—阿拉伯之春起义已经五年，埃及、约旦、摩洛哥和突尼斯都实现了相当程度的政治稳定。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Five years after the Arab Spring uprisings began, Egypt, Jordan, Morocco, and Tunisia have achieved reasonable levels of political stability.

zh: 但经济增长依然不如人意，国际货币基金组织（IMF）的今年预期人均GDP增长也不超过1.5 % 。
en: Yet economic growth remains tepid, and the International Monetary Fund does not expect the pace of expansion to exceed 1.5% per capita this year.

zh: 该地区赶超潜力巨大，也有大量年轻劳动力，你一定很奇怪为何会如此。
en: Given the region’s large catch-up potential and young workforces, one must ask why this is so.

zh: 一个显而易见的解释是，尽管在构建稳定政府方面取得了巨大进展，但这些国家仍然饱受让私人投资者望而却步的政治风险的影响。
en: One obvious explanation is that, despite significant progress in building stable governments, these countries remain subject to political risks that scare private investors.

zh: 但2011年之前这些风险便已经很高，私人投资也相当平庸。
en: But private investment was modest before the uprisings of 2011, when such risks were already high.

zh: 必定还有其他解释。
en: There must be more to the story.

zh: 看看这些国家的经济史，我们可以获得关于这个问题的洞见。
en: A look at these countries’ recent economic history offers insight into the problem.

zh: 市场经济对中东和北非来说是一件相对较新的事物，直到20实际80年代国家主导的经济增长因为效率低下（以及由此产生的债务）而垮台后才出现。
en: Market economies are relatively new to the Middle East and North Africa, having arisen only after the 1980s, when the model of state-directed economic growth collapsed under the weight of its inefficiencies (and resulting debt).

zh: 但是，和拉丁美洲或东欧不同，阿拉伯国家只自由化了经济，而没有自由化政治。
en: Unlike Latin America or Eastern Europe, however, Arab countries liberalized their economies without liberalizing their politics.

zh: 在西方力量的支持下，独裁根深蒂固。
en: Autocrats, supported by Western powers, remained firmly in place.

zh: 因此，即使20实际90年代的改革转变了国家的经济角色 — — 在埃及，国家支出占GDP之比从1980年的60%下降到20世纪90年代的30 % — —政治仍在左右市场。
en: As a result, even as the reforms of the 1990s rolled back the state’s economic role – in Egypt, state spending fell from 60% of GDP in 1980 to 30% of GDP in the 1990s – politics continued to shape markets.

zh: 经济特权阻挠了最终可能威胁到独裁控制的独立企业家的出现，而有利于能够几乎垄断全部自由化经济部门的企业。
en: With economic privileges doled out in a way that blocked the emergence of independent entrepreneurs that might eventually challenge the autocrats’ control, favored firms were able to acquire virtual monopolies over entire liberalized economic sectors.

zh: 比如，在埃及，32 位商人与前总统穆巴拉克关系紧密，2010年，他们获得了流向正式私人部门的总信用的80%以上，赚得60%的部门总利润，但只雇用了希腊劳动力总量的11 % 。
en: In Egypt, for example, the firms of 32 businessmen closely connected with then-President Hosni Mubarak received in 2010 more than 80% of the credit that went to the formal private sector and earned 60% of the sector’s overall profits, while employing only 11% of the country’s labor force.

zh: 在突尼斯，前总统本·阿里的亲朋好友获得了2010年私人部门总利润的21 % ， 尽管他们的企业只雇用了突尼斯劳动力总量的1 % 。
en: In Tunisia, former President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali’s cronies received 21% of all private-sector profits in 2010, though their firms employed only 1% of Tunisia’s labor force.

zh: 毫不奇怪，这一制度只能带来平庸的增长。
en: Unsurprisingly, this system generated only modest growth.

zh: 政治忠诚没有转化为经济效率，衷心耿耿于独裁领导人的人没能建立起有竞争力的世界级公司。
en: Political loyalty does not translate into economic efficiency, and autocratic leaders’ loyalists consistently failed to build competitive world-class corporations.

zh: 有能力的潜在竞争者处于极大的劣势，因此没有人有动力进行足够的创新或投资。
en: With talented potential competitors at such a distinct disadvantage, nobody was motivated to innovate or invest adequately.

zh: 而没能实现增长潜力不只限于传统寻租部门，如房地产和自然资源部门。
en: And it was not only traditional rent-filled sectors, such as real estate or natural resources, that failed to reach their growth potential.

zh: 在可贸易部门，如制造业和公用事业，租通过非关税保护和补贴制造出来，导致出口增长疲软。
en: In tradable sectors, such as manufacturing and utilities, rents were created through non-tariff protection and subsidies, leading to anemic export growth.

zh: 结果是正是部门就业岗位稀缺，雇用人数很少超过劳动力总量的20 % 。
en: The result was a dearth of jobs in the formal sector, which rarely employed more than 20% of the labor force.

zh: 极少数好工作只为关系集团保留，因此越来越多受过教育的年轻工人只能在非正式部门找到低质量工作。
en: With the few good jobs reserved for favored groups, a growing pool of educated young workers faced lower-quality jobs in the informal sector.

zh: 此外服务质量低下，社会流动也近乎停止。
en: Add to that poor-quality services, and social mobility ground to a halt.

zh: 日益恶化的社会不满又遇上了逐渐升级的镇压。
en: Intensifying social dissatisfaction was met with rising levels of repression.

zh: 随着政治风险提高，独裁者的亲信开始要求更高的回报。
en: As political risks rose, the autocrats’ cronies demanded higher returns.

zh: 最终，体制无法同时控制街头和私人部门，最终导致群众示威和政治革命。
en: Ultimately, the regimes’ inability to control both the street and the private sector culminated in popular protests and political revolutions.

zh: 从阿拉伯之春的废墟中崛起的政府继承了一套残破的封闭交易制度。
en: The governments that emerged from the Arab Spring’s wreckage inherited a broken system of closed deals.

zh: 不充分的产权保护阻碍着投资，但拜收入过低的官僚的小腐败和极端化的政治环境所赐，走向公平和执行有力的规则在当前环境下亦非现实前景。
en: Inadequate property-rights protection is impeding investment, but moving to fair and well-enforced rules is not a realistic prospect in the current environment, given the petty corruption of an underpaid bureaucracy and the polarized political environment.

zh: 这些国家可以试图复制2000—2010年间土耳其的经济成功，执政党和大量有活力的中小企业结成政治联盟，让出口增长了两倍。
en: These countries could try to replicate Turkey’s economic success in 2000-2010, when a political alliance between the ruling party and a broad group of dynamic small and medium-size enterprises (SMEs) contributed to a tripling of exports.

zh: 这里的挑战是找到能够刺激增长和创造就业，而不只是提供政治支持的正确的投资者。
en: The challenge here would be to find the right investors, who can spur growth and create jobs, not just provide political support.

zh: 在这方面，摩洛哥和约旦都取得了一些成功，它们的君主表现出管住提供政治默许和经济支持的精英的能力。
en: Here, Morocco and Jordan have had some success, with their monarchies proving capable of managing elites who offer both political acquiescence and economic sustenance.

zh: 但是，这些国家的政府固然在扩大业务联盟方面取得了一些成功，但传统的寻租集团正在遏制进步。
en: But, while these countries’ governments are having some success in broadening their business coalitions, traditional rent-seeking cronies are constraining progress.

zh: 对他们让步意味着降低可贸易部门的投资，从而大大拖累出口增长。
en: By undermining investment in tradable sectors, appeasing them means hampering export growth considerably.

zh: 突尼斯与摩洛哥模式不同，它通过吸引外国直接投资扩张出口部门，同时向本国中小企业开放国内服务业。
en: Tunisia could take a page out of Morocco’s playbook, expanding its export sector by attracting foreign direct investment, while opening up its domestic services sector to local SMEs.

zh: 但它仍需要面临经济自由化的挑战，工会保护效率低下的老牌企业免受竞争加剧的影响的压力日益增加。
en: But it would still have to face the challenge of liberalizing its economy, in the face of rising pressure from labor unions to protect inefficient incumbent firms from increased competition.

zh: 至于埃及，它依靠与军方关系密切的私人企业，以及来自海湾合作委员会（GCC）的融资支持经济。
en: For its part, Egypt is relying on public and private firms close to its army, together with finance from the Gulf Cooperation Council, to support its economy.

zh: 但是，由于GCC石油收入下降 — — 更不用说对该安排效率低下的失望了 — — 这条路未必行得通。
en: But, given the fall in GCC oil revenues – not to mention disappointment with the arrangement’s inefficiency – this route seems increasingly limited.

zh: 在所有四个国家中，就业增长在未来一段时间内仍将饱受掣肘。
en: In all four countries, employment growth will remain constrained for some time to come.

zh: 在不威胁政治领导人的情况下增进经济包容绝非易事，这需要建立更加包容的治理安排。
en: Improving economic inclusion without threatening political leaders will be no easy feat, as it demands the creation of more inclusive governance arrangements.

zh: 对摩洛哥和突尼斯来说，温和派伊斯兰教徒和自由派之间的利益趋同提供了一些希望。
en: For Morocco and Tunisia, the convergence of interests between moderate Islamists and liberals offers a ray of hope.

zh: 但这一希望目前在埃及和地区内其他国家难觅踪迹。
en: But such hope seems to be lacking for the moment in Egypt and elsewhere in the region.

zh: 为什么经济学家没有预见到阿拉伯之春
en: Why Economists Missed the Arab Spring

zh: 伦敦—今年是阿拉伯之春起义六周年，但是这个日子静悄悄地过去了，基本没有引起关注。
en: LONDON – The sixth anniversary of the Arab Spring uprisings this year came and went largely unnoticed.

zh: 与此前几年不同，没人评论这些震撼了阿拉伯世界、并似乎曾经给它带来变革憧憬的事件。
