en: Unlike in previous years, there was no torrent of commentary about the tumultuous events that shook the Arab world and seemed to promise a transformation of its politics.

zh: 当然，新鲜劲儿总是会随时间而消失。
en: Of course, novelty wears off over time.

zh: 但对阿拉伯起义的兴趣的消退反映了一个更深层次的变化：对新的、更具代议制性质的政治制度的希望不再，而随着预期中的革命演变成反革命、内战、国家失败和日益恶化的宗教极端主义，取而代之的是绝望。
en: But waning interest in the Arab uprisings reflects a deeper shift: hope for new, more representative political systems has given way to despair, as expectant revolutions have morphed into counter-revolution, civil war, failed states, and intensifying religious extremism.

zh: 但是，尽管到目前为止的结果令人无比失望，我们仍然必须关注阿拉伯之春起义，以发掘它们的根源。
en: And yet, as disagreeable as the outcomes may have been so far, we must continue to focus on the Arab Spring uprisings, in order to uncover their root causes.

zh: 与一切标志性事件一样，它们带来了新的难题。
en: Like any landmark event, they have posed new and difficult questions.

zh: 其中最重要的问题之一是为何经济学家没有预见到这场动乱。
en: And one of the most important is why economists failed to anticipate the unrest.

zh: 预测政治剧变绝非易事。
en: Forecasting political upheaval is no easy feat.

zh: 即使是在预测经济危机方面，经济学家的记录也不太光彩。
en: Economists have a less-than-impressive record when it comes to predicting even economic crises.

zh: 但这一预测失败也许反映了经济学假设和框架的一个更深层次的问题。
en: But this particular forecasting failure may reflect a deeper problem with economic assumptions and frameworks.

zh: 在倒台前夕，一些阿拉伯独裁者实际上一直被世界银行和国际货币基金组织（IMF）赞扬其在实施“正确的”经济政策方面的所谓的成功。
en: On the eve of their downfall, a few Arab autocrats were actually being lauded by the World Bank and International Monetary Fund for their supposed success in adopting the “right” economic policies.

zh: 阿拉伯之春爆发后，世界银行承认了错误，这清楚地表明，它们为阿拉伯旧政权所开出的政策药方大有问题。
en: The World Bank’s subsequent mea culpa is a clear indication that there may have been a problem with the policies they had prescribed for the Arab ancien régimes.

zh: 这引出了许多其他问题。
en: This raises a raft of other questions.

zh: 经济学家关注了错误的指标吗？
en: Were economists focused on the wrong indicators?

zh: 他们被错误的推断误导了吗？
en: Were they misled by false inferences?

zh: 还是他们没有对潜在的陷阱给予足够的关注？
en: Or were they not paying enough attention to potential pitfalls?

zh: 简言之，这是一个数据问题还是分析问题？
en: In short, was it a problem of data or analysis?

zh: 没能预见到政治革命，至少部分原因在于概念不足。
en: A failure to anticipate political revolutions reflects, at least partly, conceptual inadequacies.

zh: 主流经济学倾向于关注理性经济人受理性选择指引，寻找边际收益等于边际成本的均衡的行为。
en: Mainstream economics tends to focus on the equilibrium-seeking behavior of homo economicus, guided by rational choice, when marginal benefits equal marginal costs.

zh: 这一概念框架显然不能用来处理社会和政治剧变问题，这些问题根本不是边际性变化。
en: That conceptual framework is demonstrably ill equipped to deal with social and political upheavals, which can hardly be described as marginal changes.

zh: 实证经济学也要为这一预测失败负一定责任。
en: There are also empirical dimensions to this forecasting failure.

zh: 许多数据表明，中东和北非（MENA）的经济状况十分有利。
en: Many of the data painted quite a favorable picture of the economic situation in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA).

zh: 在阿拉伯之春起义爆发前的十年中，该地区经济体的真实年GDP增长率相当漂亮，达到了4—5%左右。
en: During the decade before the uprisings erupted, the region’s economies attained respectable real annual GDP growth rates of around 4-5%.

zh: 这些增长在一定程度上因为人口增长而被稀释，因此，真实人均GDP增长率徘徊在2—2.5%左右。
en: These gains were somewhat diluted by the population growth that accompanied them, with real per capita GDP-growth rates hovering around 2-2.5%.

zh: 尽管如此，仍然较20世纪80年代和90年代MENA经济体远远落后于其他地区的情况有了巨大改善。
en: Nonetheless, this represented a significant improvement from the 1980s and 1990s, when the MENA economies lagged far behind other regions.

zh: 从传统标准看，MENA国家的人力发展指标也有了相当大的改善，其中一些国家的不平等性有所下降。
en: There were also appreciable improvements in human-development indicators in the MENA countries and, judged by conventional criteria, inequality was declining in some of them.

zh: 比如，埃及基尼系数不断下降。
en: For example, the Gini coefficient was declining in Egypt.

zh: 此外，尽管数据不足，但MENA贫困率早已是发展中国家中最低的，而一些阿拉伯之春席卷的国家 — — 主要是突尼斯 — — 的贫困率在继续下降。
en: Moreover, despite the paucity of data, poverty ratios, already among the lowest in the developing world, were falling in some of the countries swept up by the Arab Spring – most notably, in Tunisia.

zh: MENA直接或间接地受益于多年来国际油价的有利趋势 — — 特别是2002—2008年，油价涨至创出历史记录的每桶147美元 — — 也受益于新近进入上升期的商业周期。
en: MENA countries had benefited, directly or indirectly, from years of favorable international oil prices – especially from 2002 to 2008, when prices reached a historic peak of about $147 per barrel – and benefited from a recent upswing in the business cycle.

zh: 当然，也不都是好消息。
en: But it was not all good news, of course.

zh: 革命爆发时，普通人 — — 特别是年轻人和受过教育的中产阶级 — — 有很多理由感到政治疏离。
en: When the revolutions erupted, there were plenty of reasons for ordinary people, especially the young and the educated middle classes, to feel politically alienated.

zh: 失业率 — — 特别是年轻人失业率 — — 非常高。
en: Unemployment rates – particularly youth unemployment rates – were very high.

zh: 独裁者都没有将社会正义列为工作重点。
en: And autocrats are not exactly known for placing a high priority on social justice.

zh: 尽管如此，事实仍然是，MENA国家正在相对繁荣中继续改善，而没有面临经济衰退或停滞。
en: Even so, the fact remains that the MENA countries were experiencing improvements in relative prosperity, not economic downturns or stagnation.

zh: 这等于打了许多常规思维的脸，这些思维认为群众因为经济困难而揭竿而起，相对繁荣的时期应该对应群众政治运动的安静期。
en: This flies in the face of much conventional thinking, which links mass revolts to economic hardship and assumes that periods of relative prosperity are correlated with mass political quiescence.

zh: 亚里士多德的《政治学》提出了关于经济表现和政治稳定之间的关系的截然不同的解读 ： “ 为了确保权力，暴君必须保持人口的贫困，让他们为糊口而奔波，没有闲暇考虑推密谋推翻暴君。
en: Aristotle’s Politics offers a radically different interpretation of the relationship between economic performance and political stability: “In order to secure his power, a tyrant must keep the population in poverty, so that the preoccupation with daily bread leaves them no leisure to conspire against the tyrant.”

zh: ”这并不是说革命是富人的特权，而是说相对繁荣的增长可能会引起更大的失去自由的感觉，引起对拙劣治理的反对。
en: This is not to say that revolutions are the privilege of the rich, but rather that growing relative prosperity might enable greater awareness of missing freedoms and stoke resistance against poor governance.

zh: 从某种程度上说，历史正是如此演绎。
en: To some extent, history bears this reading out.

zh: 1979年伊朗革命和阿拉伯之春起义一样，发生在十分有利的国际油价形势（1973—1974年翻了两番）带来前所未有的经济增长时期之后。
en: Iran’s 1979 Revolution, like the Arab Spring uprisings, followed unparalleled economic growth, driven by highly favorable international oil prices (which had quadrupled in 1973-1974).

zh: 即使是发生在经济衰退后的革命，此前的繁荣改善也可能起到一定的作用。
en: Even in cases when revolutions have been preceded by economic downturns, prior improvements in prosperity may have played a role.

zh: 据美国社会学家詹姆斯·戴维斯（James C. Davies）的所谓的J曲线理论，革命 — — 如1917年俄国革命和1952年埃及革命 — — 发生在长期经济和社会发展被猛烈而突然地逆转的时期。
en: According to the American sociologist James C. Davies’s so-called J-curve theory, revolutions – such as the Russian Revolution of 1917 and Egypt’s revolution of 1952 – occur when periods of prolonged economic and social development are sharply and suddenly reversed.

zh: 换句话说，不是直接的经济困难，而是预期和现实之间的令人沮丧的差距，唤醒了群众。
en: In other words, it is not straightforward economic hardship, but rather frustration with the disparity between expectation and reality that awakens the masses.

zh: 阿拉伯之春表明，不能把经济表现的改善当作防止政治动荡的政策。
en: The Arab Spring suggests that improved economic performance cannot be viewed as an insurance policy against political instability.

zh: 汲取这一教训或许有助于我们不至于对未来政治剧变目瞪口呆。
en: Learning that lesson may help us avoid being blindsided by future political upheaval.

zh: 它甚至可以令我们避免类似于阿拉伯之春所带来的失望和绝望。
en: It might even enable us to avoid the kind of disappointment and despair that the Arab Spring has brought.

zh: 阿拉伯的春天和西方的冬天
en: The Arab Spring and the Western Winter

zh: 贝鲁特 — — 2010年开始的阿拉伯之春运动、英国退欧公投、美国总统唐纳德·特朗普当选以及整个欧洲极右翼势力的复苏有着很多惊人的相似之处。
en: BEIRUT – There are many striking parallels between the “Arab Spring” that began in 2010 and the United Kingdom’s Brexit referendum, the election of US President Donald Trump, and the far-right resurgence across Europe.

zh: 每种情况都涉及旧秩序的塌陷，而进步党派势力又太过薄弱乃至抵挡不住专制和仇外等执政形式的进攻。
en: In each case, an old order fell, and progressive parties have been too weak to counter the emergence of authoritarian and xenophobic forms of governance.

zh: 2010-11年催生导致阿拉伯起义运动的日渐增加的对现状的不满其原因多种多样，而且反对派既采取了进步也采取了保守形式的反抗。
en: The growing discontent with the status quo that underlay the Arab uprisings of 2010-11 had many causes, and the opposition took both progressive and conservative forms.

zh: 中产阶级不满于在不负责任的精英手中丧失尊严。
en: Members of the middle class resented their loss of dignity at the hands of an unaccountable elite.

zh: 而年轻人则不满于相比他们父母一代未来变得尤其暗淡。
en: Young people decried a future that looked especially bleak when compared to the expectations of their parents’ generation.

zh: 伊斯兰教徒则煽动道德方面对社会伦理价值观丧失的抵抗。
en: And Islamists stoked moral opposition to the loss of ethical values in society.

zh: 在西方社会心怀不满的白人民众、流离失所的工人和沮丧的青年一代数量不断增加的情况下，这都是长期辩论中反复出现的主题。
en: These are all recurring themes in ongoing debates across the West, with its growing population of disaffected whites, displaced workers, and frustrated young people.

zh: 随着时间的推移，在经济自由主义挤出长久以来平等和社会团结原则的同时，造成了巨大的贫富差距，并因此侵蚀了许多西方国家的政治。
en: Over time, as economic liberalism has crowded out longstanding principles of equality and social solidarity, vast wealth disparities have emerged, corrupting many Western countries’ politics.

zh: 此外，全球化和技术创新对某些社会群体造成了巨大的负面影响，而公共政策却未能成功地缓解这种损害。
en: Meanwhile, globalization and technological innovation have had profoundly negative effects on certain social cohorts, and public policies have failed to mitigate the damage.

zh: 现在迫切需要对现行政策进行具有深远意义的调整，尤其因为气候变化正在对全球造成致命的威胁。
en: Far-reaching policy adjustments are now urgently needed, not least because of the deadly threat that climate change poses to the entire globe.

zh: 但需要做出什么样的调整，这些调整又该由谁来实施？
en: But what adjustments will be made, and who will carry out them out?

zh: 到目前为止，发生在街头和投票站点的民众反抗未能建立起一套能解决政治、社会和经济问题的可靠的替代管理框架，现在的西方和中东社会正在被这些问题所吞没。
en: Popular revolts – in the streets and at the ballot box – have so far failed to deliver an alternative governing framework that offers credible solutions to the political, social, and economic problems that have engulfed Western and Middle Eastern societies.

zh: 阿拉伯世界民众愤怒的爆发推翻了长期存在的政权系统。
en: In the Arab world, the explosion of popular anger dislodged long-entrenched regimes.

zh: 但老的独裁者竭尽全力防止就此产生有可靠力量的反对派。
en: But the old autocrats had worked hard to prevent a credible opposition from ever being conceived.

zh: 2010-11年革命缺乏领导，因此无法真正填补由此带来的政治空白。
en: The 2010-11 revolutions were leaderless, and thus could not fill the resulting political void.

zh: 相反，军队、部族势力、宗派团体和宗教派别迅速登上了舞台。
en: Instead, armies, tribes, sectarian groups, and religious parties quickly came to the fore.

zh: 埃及现在正在经历专制制度的复辟。
en: Egypt has now experienced an autocratic restoration.

zh: 也门、叙利亚和利比亚正深陷于内战的战火之中。
en: Yemen, Syria, and Libya are mired in civil war.

zh: 黎巴嫩和伊拉克四分五裂。
en: Lebanon and Iraq are fragmented.

zh: 试图用大量撒钱浇灭地区怒火的石油生产商正在陷入巨大的财政赤字。
en: And the oil producers that tried to extinguish the regional fire by pouring money on it are now running massive fiscal deficits.

zh: 土耳其也正在向强人执政靠拢；同时伊朗的进步力量也正在削弱。
en: Turkey, too, has moved toward strongman rule; and progressive forces in Iran have been weakened.

zh: 仍在向民主体制全面过渡的只有突尼斯；但即使在那里，经济改革也并不足以解决国家所面临的挑战。
en: Only Tunisia is still pursuing a messy transition toward democracy; even there, however, economic reforms have fallen short of addressing the challenges facing the country.

zh: 中东地区新的独裁者正在通过沿宗派和身份界限分化民众这种分而治之的策略来巩固政权。
en: The Middle East’s new autocrats are consolidating power with divide-and-rule tactics that have polarized citizens along sectarian and identity lines.

zh: 由于普遍缺乏个人安全感，许多民众选择了宗派团体，而不是保障社会和公民权利的安全。
en: Owing to widespread feelings of personal insecurity, many citizens have opted for sect over society, and for security over civil rights.

zh: 在当今的西方，没有真正建设美好未来实际计划的民粹主义政客正在仿效中东独裁者。
en: In the West today, populist politicians with no realistic plans for actually building a better future are emulating Middle Eastern autocrats.

zh: 他们通过煽动对“他人 ” — —包括难民、穆斯林或外国恐怖分子 — — 的恐惧并承诺以武力确保安全来攫取权力。
en: They win power by stoking fear of the “other” – refugees, Muslims, or foreign terrorists – and promising to establish security through force.

zh: 一旦成功掌权，他们就开始以同样的方式来巩固统治。
en: Once in power, they begin to consolidate their rule accordingly.

zh: 民主制度或许可以适应民粹主义执政；但就像我们已经在美国目睹的那样，这些机构很快将受到考验，并还没等到用尽各种手段就毫无悬念地遭到削弱。
en: Democratic institutions may be resilient to populist governance; but, as we are already witnessing in the US, these institutions will soon be tested, and undoubtedly weakened before all is said and done.

zh: 国际关系方面也同样如此。
en: The same parallel holds for international relations.

zh: 由伊朗和沙特等敌对国家挑起的跨越国境的什叶和逊尼派分裂正在重新绘制中东的地缘政治版图，同样影响地区实力分布的还有外部力量干涉地区冲突。
en: The geopolitical map of the Middle East is being redrawn by the transnational Shia-Sunni split – which is being stoked by rivals such as Iran and Saudi Arabia – and by outside intervention into regional conflicts.

zh: 同样，西方民粹主义领导者正在破坏他们国家相对于中国、俄罗斯、印度和北欧的利益，并在无法提供任何接近可行的替代方案的情况下，挑战后1945年国际秩序。
en: Similarly, Western populist leaders are disrupting their countries’ interests with respect to China, Russia, India, and Northern Europe, and challenging the post-1945 international order, without offering anything remotely resembling a viable alternative.

zh: 此外，进步政治势力也无法提供这样的替代选择。
en: Then there is the failure of progressive political forces to provide such an alternative.

zh: 在全球范围内占主导地位的理论已经发生变化。
en: The dominant narrative has already shifted worldwide.

zh: 多数民众不再相信以经济活力、全球一体化和社会民主等进步来定义的未来。
en: Most people no longer believe in a future defined by progress: economic dynamism, global integration, and social democracy.

zh: 更为悲观的看法已经占据主导，这种看法认为全球化、无法驾驭的市场、劳动节约型技术创新和全球变暖正在侵蚀我们的未来。
en: A more pessimistic view has taken hold, in which the future is corrupted by globalization, untamed markets, labor-saving technological innovations, and global warming.

zh: 能否在中东和西方重塑乐观主义将取决于知识分子、工会、进步党派和民间社会团体能否建立共同的政治基础并树立对未来的共同目标。
en: Restoring optimism, in both the Middle East and the West, will depend on whether intellectuals, unions, progressive parties, and civil-society groups can build a common political base and offer a shared vision for the future.

zh: 这不仅需要对不断出现的问题提出全新的解决方案，还需要有可靠的方法来落实相应的民主变革。
en: This will require not only novel solutions to emerging problems, but also a credible means to implement change democratically.

zh: 最低限度，这个抵抗和革命的全新时代已经导致过去在黑暗中不断酝酿的问题完全公开化。
en: At the very least, this new age of resistance and revolution has brought out into the open problems that were once left to fester in the dark.

zh: 我们因此了解经济政策应当以包容为导向；必须削减物质消费；同时保护民主制度不受财富集中和既得利益的负面影响。
en: As a result, we now know that economic policies should be geared toward inclusion; material consumption will have to be curtailed; and democracy must be protected from the malign influence of concentrated wealth and entrenched interests.

zh: 可以肯定这些都是巨大的挑战；但如果我们能有清醒的认识，就完全可以开始采取行动。
en: These are immense challenges, to be sure; but if we can identify them clearly, we can begin to take action.

zh: 而且某个地区的成功可能成为其他所有地区的榜样。
en: And an achievement in one place can be a model everywhere else.

zh: 下一次成百上千万人走上开罗街头和平呼吁表达的权利，背后的促成因素或许不是西迪·布兹德的自焚，而是伊斯坦布尔发生骚乱、弹劾美国总统或进步政党在欧洲取得选举胜利。
en: The next time millions of people march peacefully in Cairo to demand that their voices be heard, the trigger may not be a self-immolation in Sidi Bouzid, but a riot in Istanbul, the impeachment of a US president, or electoral victories for progressive parties in Europe.

zh: 阿拉伯世界如何避免坠入深渊？
en: How Can the Arab World Avoid the Abyss?

zh: 开罗 — — 11月发生的一系列令人震惊的事件凸显了阿拉伯世界的糟糕局面。
en: CAIRO – A series of startling events in November revealed the abysmal state of affairs in the Arab world.

zh: 黎巴嫩总理在国外宣布辞职，但后来又宣布收回声明。
en: The Lebanese prime minister announced his resignation abroad, but reversed the statement later.

zh: 一枚从也门发射的导弹射向沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得，沙特阿拉伯领导层展开了一场重大反腐运动并影响了数十位引人瞩目的人物。
en: A missile was launched from Yemen toward Saudi Arabia’s capital, Riyadh. Saudi Arabia’s leadership carried out a major anti-corruption campaign that affected dozens of high-profile personalities.

zh: 与此同时，埃及经历了记忆中最可怕的恐怖袭击，导致多达300余名平民死亡和受伤。
en: Egypt, meanwhile, experienced its worst terrorist attack in living memory, with more than 300 civilians killed and injured.

zh: 从利比亚流出的据称是奴隶拍卖的录像凸显了利比亚政府全面崩溃后持续不断的混乱和动荡。
en: Video footage of alleged slave auctions in Libya underscored the continuing chaos there amid the complete breakdown of the Libyan state.

zh: 针对伊斯兰国的军事斗争胜利以及加沙和西岸地区巴勒斯坦各派的和解并未成功缓和该地区的集体焦虑意识。
en: Military victories against the Islamic State and a rapprochement between Palestinian factions in Gaza and the West Bank have done little to ease a collective sense of anxiety in the region.

zh: 上述积极的事态发展也未能激发人们的信心，让民众相信阿拉伯世界能够摆脱坠入悬崖的命运。
en: Nor have these positive developments inspired much confidence that the Arab world will somehow pull itself back from the edge of the abyss.

zh: 叙利亚、黎巴嫩、伊拉克和也门遭受外国干预也已成为家常便饭。
en: Foreign interference has become routine in Syria, Lebanon, Iraq, and Yemen.

zh: 而有关身份政治和黎凡特边境问题的持续辩论仅仅标志着开始迎接未来严峻的挑战。
en: And ongoing debates over identity politics and borders in the Levant are a prelude to the grave, fundamental challenges ahead.

zh: 事实上，中东局势并不令人惊讶，因为近年来，不要说解决巴以问题，几乎没有哪个阿拉伯国家曾经试图解决利比亚、叙利亚和也门的持续冲突。
en: In fact, the situation in the Middle East is not surprising, given that in recent years no Arab country has led attempts to resolve the ongoing conflicts in Libya, Syria, and Yemen, let alone address the Palestine-Israel issue.

zh: 在许多冲突中，阿拉伯人的影响力还不如外国人大。
en: In many of these conflicts, foreigners have had far more influence than Arabs.

zh: 历史上，从十字军东征到欧洲殖民主义，中东一直是无数次外国侵略的目标。
en: Historically, the Middle East has been the target of numerous foreign invasions, from the Crusades to European colonialism.

zh: 这里的自然资源遭到贪婪的掠夺，而且在冷战期间曾经是代理战争的演武场。
en: Its natural resources have been greedily usurped, and it was a theater for proxy wars during the Cold War.

zh: 即使今天，阿拉伯领土仍在被占领当中。
en: Even today, Arab territories remain under occupation.

zh: 但尽管可以找到诸多理由指责外国势力应当对该地区的危险状态负责，但责怪别人 — — 甚或相互责怪 — — 却什么问题也解决不了。
en: But while there are many reasons to blame foreign powers for the region’s parlous state of affairs, blaming others – or even one another – will solve nothing.

zh: 毕竟，阿拉伯世界自身也存在许多问题，包括低效和无效治理、邪恶联盟和国家能力不发达。
en: After all, the Arab world has many homegrown problems, too, including inefficient and ineffective governance, unholy alliances, and undeveloped national capacities.

zh: 任何决定不了自己未来的地区只会面临灾难，绝大部分地区民众都感到自己的权利被剥夺。
en: Disaster awaits any region that is helpless to shape its own future, in which a majority of citizens feel disenfranchised.

zh: 尽管阿拉伯世界在传统上态度保守，但近70%的民众年龄都在35岁以下，而年轻人在绝大多数国家都沦为超高失业率的受害者。
en: Though the Arab world is traditionally conservative, almost 70% of its citizens are below the age of 35, and young people suffer from the highest rates of unemployment in most countries.

zh: 这不仅构成对资源的极大浪费，而且还成为造成严重、长期社会政治问题的源头。
en: This constitutes not only a tremendous waste of resources, but also a serious long-term sociopolitical problem.

zh: 而且这还仅仅是该地区所面临的诸多国内挑战中的一个。
en: And yet it is just one of the many domestic challenges facing the region.

zh: 阿拉伯人必须掌控自己的未来计划，将自己和祖国的未来牢牢掌控在自己的手中。
en: Arabs must take charge of their own agenda, and become the primary force defining their future and that of their countries.

zh: 当然，他们应继续与外界保持接触，并强化与外界的战略关系和联盟。
en: They should, of course, continue to engage with the outside world and strengthen their strategic relationships and alliances.

zh: 但他们必须学会不那么依赖外国人。
en: But they also must become less dependent on others.

zh: 首先，各国政府需要发展各自国内的国家安全能力，以防范威胁和阻止霸权扩张。
en: For starters, the region’s governments need to develop their own national-security capacities, to defend against non-existential threats and hegemonic expansionism.

zh: 这反过来又会增强其政治影响力，并赋予他们更多的外交手段来解决地区问题和防止军事冲突。
en: This, in turn, will enhance their political influence, and give them more diplomatic tools for addressing regional problems and preventing military conflicts.

zh: 此外，阿拉伯人必须捍卫自己的民族身份。
en: Moreover, Arabs must defend their national identities.

zh: 中东地区的民族国家体系仍有待完善，但却远远胜过有可能进一步威胁地区稳定的宗教或种族派别主义。
en: The Middle East’s nation-state system is not perfect, but it is far better than religious or ethnic sectarianism, which threaten to destabilize the region even further.

zh: 为避免出现这样的结果，该地区现有的民族国家将需要强有力的机构来提供社会包容和有效治理。
en: To avoid that outcome, the region’s existing nation-states will need strong institutions to provide for efficient governance and social inclusion.

zh: 不幸的是，绝大部分阿拉伯国家机构根本不具备完成任务的能力。
en: Unfortunately, most Arab countries’ institutions are nowhere near being able to meet this imperative.

zh: 展望未来，阿拉伯人应当认识到防止外国干预和维护国家利益的最佳途径是推行国内改革。
en: Looking ahead, Arabs should recognize that domestic reform is the best way to prevent foreign interference and defend national interests.

zh: 过去几年来，阿拉伯民众的觉醒体现了中立的中产阶级对变革的渴求。
en: The Arab awakenings over the last few years revealed a centrist middle-class yearning for change.

zh: 机会主义政党竭尽全力想从局势突变所造成的动荡环境中获益。
en: Opportunistic parties tried to benefit from the turbulent environment created by sudden change.

zh: 但这却无法改变这样一个事实，那就是这些运动是长期治理不善所激起的反弹，民众借此表达对阿拉伯领袖未能推进渐进式改革所引发的愤怒。
en: But this does not negate the fact that these movements were a response to perpetually bad governance and a failure on the part of Arab leaders to pursue gradual reforms.

zh: 阿拉伯人还需要制定更多经济、政治和安全方案，以此来适应不断变化的环境。
en: Arabs also need to give themselves a larger variety of economic, political, and security options, so that they can adapt to changing circumstances.

zh: 现在的世界格局不再是两极模式或欧洲中心。
en: The world is no longer bipolar or Eurocentric.

zh: 事实上，正在接受技术、经济和社会快速变化考验的不仅限于威斯特伐利亚国家体系本身，而且还包括战后建立的地缘政治模式。
en: In fact, it is the Westphalian state system itself, not just the postwar geopolitical paradigm, which is being tested by rapid technological, economic, and social changes.

zh: 最后，阿拉伯世界必须直面地区霸权和非法占领阿拉伯领土的问题。
en: Lastly, the Arab world needs to confront regional hegemonic attitudes and the illegitimate occupation of Arab lands.

zh: 当前问题的解决必须尊重人们对国家和主权的期待，同时又不仅仅停留在缓解短期困难的技术和交易性方式。
en: Solutions to current problems must respect people’s aspirations for statehood and sovereignty, while going beyond tactical or transactional approaches that provide only short-term relief.

zh: 归根结底，任何无法保护基本权利的政策都无法成功落实。
en: Ultimately, any policy that fails to protect basic rights will not succeed.

zh: 无论是单独还是作为一个群体，阿拉伯国家都需要制定一套完整的战略来应对今后几年威胁其主权和安全利益的与生死存亡息息相关的国外和国内威胁。
en: Arab countries, individually and collectively, will need a fully formed strategy to confront existential foreign and domestic threats to their sovereignty and security in the coming years.

zh: 阿拉伯领袖是时候描绘未来阿拉伯国家关系的愿景，并制定计划与非阿拉伯邻国合作迎接区域挑战和机会。
en: It is high time for Arab leaders to outline a vision for the future of inter-Arab relations, and a plan for engaging with their non-Arab neighbors on regional opportunities and challenges.

zh: 最后，但同样重要的是，阿拉伯领袖必须向外界表明他们如何为国内民众提供更好的国内治理。
en: Last but not least, Arab leaders must also explain how they will provide better domestic governance for their people.

zh: 如果阿拉伯世界想保留对自己未来的发言权，就不能对现状沾沾自喜。
en: If the Arab world wants to have a say in shaping its own future, it cannot remain complacent in the present.

zh: 阿拉伯世界的领导人和民众必须现在就着手进行计划的制定工作。
en: Its leaders and people must start planning now.

zh: 重新思考政府在阿拉伯经济中的作用
en: Rethinking the State’s Role in Arab Economies

zh: 华盛顿 — — 阿拉伯世界有着悠久的商业和企业传统。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The Arab world has a long tradition of commerce and enterprise.

zh: 但自独立以来，许多阿拉伯国家不约而同地采用了由政府主导的发展模式，从而导致经济活动过度依赖于政府。
en: Yet, since achieving independence, many Arab countries have adopted state-led development models that have left their economies overly reliant on the government.

zh: 这是一种不可持续的状况。
en: This is unsustainable.

zh: 尽管在20世纪90年代经历了重大挫折，但阿拉伯世界的经济模式却依然能够延续，这主要归功于政府雇佣了大量工人并且提供全民补贴。
en: The Arab world’s economic model has endured, despite major setbacks in the 1990s, largely because the state employs a large share of workers and provides universal subsidies.

zh: 这消除了民众经济生活中所面临的风险，在强化他们对政府依赖性的同时扼杀了创新和企业家精神。
en: This eliminates risk from citizens’ economic lives, entrenching their dependence on the government and stifling entrepreneurship and innovation.

zh: 它还破坏了公共服务的提供，从而引发了民众对于严重依赖的政府的不信任。
en: It also undermines the delivery of public services, stoking mistrust of the very government on which populations depend so heavily.

zh: 如今，阿拉伯世界的政府主导发展模式可能即将到达临界点，因为准备在未来数十年进入劳动力市场的有多达数以亿计的年轻人。
en: Now, the Arab world’s state-led development model may be set to reach a breaking point, as hundreds of millions of young people prepare to enter labor markets in the coming decades.

zh: 由于公共部门不太可能吸收这些新增劳动力，因此迫切需要建立一个充满活力的私营部门。 该部门不仅需要采纳、而且需要促成技术创新，并以此授权劳动者，从而实现包容和可持续的经济增长。
en: With the public sector unlikely to be able to absorb these new workers, there is an urgent need to create a dynamic private sector that not only adopts, but also generates technological innovations that empower workers and deliver durable and inclusive growth.

zh: 上述策略完全符合2015年由联合国所有成员国（包括阿拉伯国家在内）共同批准的可持续发展目标要求。
en: This approach is in line with the demands of the Sustainable Development Goals, which were approved by all United Nations member states – including all Arab countries – in 2015.

zh: 实现可持续发展目标 — — 相关目标涵盖从消除饥饿和贫困到保护环境 — — 将需要能够制定技术解决方案并愿意提供关键融资的充满活力的私营部门参与其中。
en: Achieving the SDGs – which range from eliminating hunger and poverty to protecting the environment – will require the involvement of dynamic private sectors that are capable of producing technological solutions and willing to provide critical financing.

zh: 由私人部门提供融资 — — 例如针对可持续发展的目标第九条所要求的基础设施项目 — — 对许多政府已不堪债务重负的阿拉伯世界尤为重要。
en: Private-sector financing – say, of the infrastructure projects demanded by SDG9 – is particularly important in the Arab world, where many governments are already burdened by debt.

zh: 为协助筹措基础设施融资，世界银行集团已经启动了最大规模的融资促发展（MFD）计划。
en: To help mobilize that financing, the World Bank Group has launched the Maximizing Finance for Development program.

zh: 当然政府还必须最大限度地利用其自身资源。
en: Of course, governments must also maximize their own resources.

zh: 过去，丰厚的投资和能源收入限制了税收推广的意愿。
en: In the past, abundant investment and energy revenues limited the incentive to mobilize tax revenues.

zh: 但随着政府资金日益枯竭，全世界税收效率最低的阿拉伯国家正面临越来越大的压力推进有意义的改革。
en: But, as government coffers are depleted, Arab countries – among the least efficient tax collectors in the world – are under growing pressure to pursue meaningful reform.

zh: 阿拉伯政府还必须提高支出效率。
en: Arab governments must also boost the efficiency of their spending.

zh: 目前，尽管多数阿拉伯国家支出金额相对其收入水平而言一直居高不下，但尤其是在医疗和教育领域，却未能取得较好的成果。
en: As it stands, while most Arab countries spend a fair amount relative to their income levels, they achieve relatively poor outcomes, especially in health and education.

zh: 为改善政府职能重新赢得民众信任 — — 如果能够取得上述进展即可有助于税收 — — 阿拉伯政府应当将“物有所值”的理念融入到公共行政当中。
en: To improve the state’s functioning and regain citizens’ trust – developments that could facilitate tax collection – Arab governments should apply the concept of “value for money” to public administration.

zh: 这样一种评估公共部门行为成本效益的框架要求以透明的方式从事数据的收集、评估和披露活动。
en: Such a framework for assessing cost-effectiveness of public-sector activities requires that data about those activities be collected, assessed, and disclosed in a transparent way.

zh: 然后，信息反馈循环等机制将允许当局发现质量问题并迅速加以纠正。
en: Mechanisms such as information-feedback loops would then enable authorities to identify quality issues and make improvements quickly.

zh: 在这一领域，世界银行集团同样在采取措施提供帮助。
en: Here, too, the World Bank Group is taking steps to help.

zh: 人力资本投资是政府所能采取的最重要的长期举措，因此人力资本项目的重点在于找出那些破坏该领域投资效率的因素。
en: Because investing in human capital is the most important long-term action a government can take, the Human Capital Project focuses on identifying the factors that are undermining the efficiency of investments in this area.

zh: 即使在取得全方位数据之前，某些改善公共支出和管理效率的方法也已经十分突出。
en: Even before comprehensive data are available, however, some approaches for improving the efficiency of public spending and administration stand out.

zh: 特别需要提到的是，阿拉伯国家可以强调发展本土化的目标。
en: In particular, Arab countries can emphasize the localization of development.

zh: 通过提高地方政府策划融资并提供包括医疗和教育服务在内的关键服务的能力，各国可以做到提升所耗费资金的价值，提振民众信心，并在实现可持续发展目标方面取得重大成果。
en: By improving the capacity of local governments to plan, finance, and deliver key services, including health and education, countries could boost value for money, build confidence among citizens, and make significant strides toward achieving the SDGs.

zh: 改革势在必行的最后一个领域是监管。
en: A final area where reform is imperative is regulation.

zh: 在许多阿拉伯国家，现有的公共和私营企业 — — 尤其是在金融服务、电讯和能源等关键部门 — — 均享有明显的优势，包括直接保护、阻止新参与主体进入市场的繁琐的监管，以及针对自然垄断的限制不足。
en: In many Arab countries, incumbent public and private firms – especially in critical sectors like financial services, telecommunications, and energy – enjoy significant advantages, including outright protection, onerous regulations that deter market entry by new players, and inadequate limits on natural monopolies.

zh: 这阻碍了市场争夺与市场竞争，阻碍了通用技术的传播，并阻碍了充满活力的私有部门所需要的适应和演变过程。
en: This impedes competition and contestability, undermines the diffusion of general-purpose technology, and blocks the type of adaptation and evolution that a dynamic private sector requires.

zh: 与其直接控制经济，阿拉伯政府应当促进建立能够改善经济效果的独立而负责的监管机构。
en: Rather than control the economy outright, Arab governments should foster the emergence of independent yet accountable regulators that can help ensure improved economic outcomes.

zh: 当然，如果历史能够提供任何借鉴，那么我们可以了解实现从国家统治到执行监管的转变是一个十分困难的过程。
en: Of course, if history is any indication, the shift from a dirigiste state to a regulatory one will not be easy.

zh: 但过去的经历为指导转型提供了有益的经验。
en: But past experience offers useful lessons to guide this process.

zh: 无论如何，我们绝不能选择将令阿拉伯年轻人陷入失业和权力剥夺囧境的维持现状的监管。
en: In any case, the regulatory status quo – which will condemn Arab youth to unemployment and disenfranchisement – is not an option.

zh: 值此脸书、亚马逊、腾讯和阿里巴巴等科技巨头正在借助以数字技术为基础的配对商业模式推动面向“超集中”的转变时，这种情况就更加明显。
en: This is all the more true at a time when tech giants like Facebook, Amazon, Tencent, and Alibaba – with matchmaking-based business models turbo-boosted by digital technology – are propelling a shift toward “ultra-concentration.”

zh: 在这样的背景下，建立一个能够为阿拉伯世界年轻劳动力提供机会的充满活力的私营部门将需要在智慧监管的框架下运作，从而建立起一套解决与数据收集和使用等问题相关的更加警惕和有效的监管机构。
en: In this context, building a dynamic private sector capable of providing opportunities to the Arab world’s young workers will require even more vigilant and effective regulators, operating within a smart regulatory framework that addresses issues relating to the collection and use of data.

zh: 人们常说，私营部门主导创新是促使发展中国家跨越未来的关键。
en: It is often said that private sector-led innovation is the key to enabling developing countries to leapfrog their way into the future.

zh: 但我们不能允许这种说法掩盖支持上述进步的智慧和创新法规的极端重要性。
en: But this narrative should not be allowed to obscure the paramount importance of smart and innovative regulations to support such progress.

zh: 政府在阿拉伯经济中所起的作用不是需要减少，而是必须改善。
en: The state’s role in Arab economies must improve, not diminish.

zh: 孤独的阿拉伯人群
en: The Lonely Arab Crowd

zh: 巴黎—哥伦比亚哲学家圣地亚哥·卡斯特罗-戈麦兹（Santiago Castro-Gomez）在《零点的狂妄 》 （ The Hubris of the Zero Point）中笛卡尔1637年所提出的“我思故我在”的口号描述为欧洲白人让自己凌驾于上帝之上、作为知识和真理的唯一仲裁者的时刻。
en: PARIS – In The Hubris of the Zero Point, the Colombian philosopher Santiago Castro-Gomez describes René Descartes’s 1637 declaration “I think, therefore I am” as the moment white Europeans installed themselves above God as the sole arbiters of knowledge and truth.

zh: 在这个转折点之后，他们开始自视为观察者，他们的科学方法、道德和伦理超然于其他文化之上。
en: With this turning point, they began to think of themselves as observers whose scientific methods, morals, and ethics overrode those of other cultures.

zh: 文化的“零点”是重要的，因为它们构成了一条分割线 — — 泾渭分明的“之前”和“之后 ” — —给私人和公共生活的发展造成了根本性影响。
en: Cultural “zero points” are important because they serve as a dividing line – a clear demarcation of “before” and “after” that holds fundamental implications for the development of private and public life.

zh: 因此，考察卡斯特罗-戈麦兹的概念对阿拉伯世界的影响很具有说明性。
en: So it is instructive to consider the implications of Castro-Gomez’s concept for the Arab world.

zh: 事实上，可以说，该地区的许多麻烦都要归因于缺少本土的“零点 ” ， 导致现代文化无法找到稳固的根基。
en: Indeed, it could be argued that much of the region’s troubles are attributable to the absence of an indigenous “zero point” onto which a modern culture could be sturdily pinned.

zh: 美国社会学家大卫·李斯曼（David Riesman）在《孤独的大众 》 （ The Lonely Crowd）中提出了三个广义的文化类型：传统指引型文化从传承的礼仪、道德和价值观中寻求指引；内心指引型文化让人们根据自我培养的价值观行动；他者指引型文化主要靠对外部规范和同侪影响的反应。
en: In The Lonely Crowd, the American sociologist David Riesman identified three broad cultural types: tradition-directed cultures that look to inherited rituals, morals, and values for guidance; inner-directed cultures, in which people behave according to self-nourished values; and other-directed cultures that react predominantly to external norms and peer influences.

zh: 李斯曼的框架在当今阿拉伯世界能够找到尤其多的共鸣，在当今阿拉伯世界，日益升高的识字率和通讯技术的迅速进步导致了互相竞争的文化叙事的乱战，这三类文化争相决定该地区的未来。
en: Riesman’s framework has particular resonance in the Arab world today, where rising literacy rates and rapid advances in communication technology have stirred a maelstrom of competing cultural narratives, with his three types competing to define the region’s future.

zh: 讽刺的是，正是这一识字率提高和现代技术的组合煽动着两类“改革者 ” — —宗教复兴派和西方导向的现代派之间的冲突之火。
en: Ironically, it is the combination of increased literacy and modern technology that is fanning the flames of conflict between the two types of “reformers” – religious revivalists and Western-oriented modernizers.

zh: 这两大阵营凭借它们大量制作并迅速传播古代宗教典籍和源自西方的文学的能力争夺者原本传统的社会的人心和思维。
en: Taking advantage of their ability to mass-produce and instantly disseminate ancient religious texts and Western-originating literature, the two camps battle for the hearts and minds of otherwise traditional societies.

zh: 但是，据黎巴嫩出版商扎伊德（Samar Abou-Zeid）的说法，宗教书籍是阿拉伯世界下载数量最多的文学作品之一。
en: According to the Lebanese publisher Samar Abou-Zeid, however, religious books are among the most downloaded works of literature in the Arab world.

zh: 麻烦在于，当今阿拉伯世界所使用的大部分宗教典籍面向的是已经不存在的专家，并且 — — 如李斯曼所警告的 — — 它们常常被曲解。
en: The trouble is that most religious texts consumed today in the Arab world address an audience of specialists that no longer exists and – as Riesman warned – they are often misconstrued.

zh: 这些典籍的作者和成书时间与今天阅读它们的人群截然不同。
en: The people and the times for which these texts were written are completely different from the people reading them today.

zh: 当然，虔诚的穆斯林自有自己的零点：公元610年，即天使加百利向先知穆罕默德传授古兰经第一首诗的时刻。
en: Devout Muslims, of course, have their own zero point: the year 610, when the Angel Gabriel revealed the Koran’s first verse to the Prophet Muhammad.

zh: 从此，许多穆斯林将自己视为��义真理和道德观的传播者，比其他人更高一等。
en: From then on, many Muslims have regarded themselves as the bearers of a righteous truth and moral vision that takes precedence over all others.

zh: 这难免让宗教复兴派站在了第二种争夺阿拉伯世界主导地位的文化类型 — — 接受西方教育的内心指引型现代派，他们将笛卡尔的口号作为参照点 — — 的对立面。
en: This has inevitably put religious revivalists in opposition to the second cultural type vying for preeminence in the Arab world: Western-educated, inner-directed modernists who hold Descartes’s declaration as their reference point.

zh: 这些阿拉伯人 — — 通常是经济精英 — — 所阅读、敬仰和消费的文化尽管宣称致力于“普世价值 ” ， 但却是严格的欧洲中心论，由基督教智识传统主导。
en: These Arabs – often the economic elite – read, admire, and consume products of a culture that, despite its proclaimed commitment to “universal values,” continues to be stingily Eurocentric and dominated by Christian intellectual tradition.

zh: 因此，他们在国内外都越来越有众叛亲离之感。
en: As a result, they are increasingly likely to feel like exiles both at home and abroad.

zh: 阿拉伯文化的最后一种类型 — — 他者导向型也许最有主导力：李斯曼称他们是“孤独的阿拉伯人群 ” 。
en: The final, other-directed strand of Arab culture is arguably the most dominant: those whom Riesman would have called the “lonely Arab crowd.”

zh: 他们不论根基和传统，沉溺于源自身边冲突的表面性，寻求消费主义、职业和生活方式的满足。
en: Free of roots or tradition, they take refuge in superficiality from the conflicts that surround them, seeking fulfillment in consumerism, careers, and lifestyles.

zh: 他们的零点是最新时尚。
en: Their zero point is the latest fad or fashion.

zh: 这一文化动荡的原因 — — 至少是部分原因 — — 是缺少土身土长的、能给阿拉伯社会带来基于本地价值观和现代观点的内心指引的智识传统。
en: This cultural turbulence is due – at least in part – to the absence of a contemporary homegrown intellectual tradition capable of providing Arab societies with an inner compass based on local values and modern perspectives.

zh: 这一文化真空的最佳写照便是该地区阅读习惯与出版业反应之间的不匹配。
en: This cultural vacuum is most evident in the mismatch between the region’s reading habits and the response of its publishing industry.

zh: 比如，埃及人平均每周阅读7.5小时，而美国为五小时42分钟。
en: Egyptians, for example, read for an average of 7.5 hours per week, compared to five hours and 42 minutes in the United States.

zh: 但在2012年，据扎伊德的数据，整个阿拉伯世界及其3.62亿居民只写了15,000部作品，与罗马尼亚（人口2,130万 ） 、 乌克兰（4,560万）或美国出版商企鹅兰登书屋差不多。
en: And yet in 2012, according to Abou-Zeid, the entire Arab world and its 362 million inhabitants produced just over 15,000 titles, putting it in the same league as Romania (with a population of 21.3 million), Ukraine (45.6 million), or the American publisher Penguin Random House.

zh: 按照人口比例计算，阿拉伯世界出版的作品应该比今天多10—20倍。
en: To maintain a similar proportion to population, the Arab world should be publishing 10-20 times more titles than it does today.

zh: 宗教典籍和西方作品的主宰让现代阿拉伯读者走向极端，无法形成他们自己的零点。
en: The dominance of old religious texts and Western-produced works has left modern Arab readers polarized, without a zero point of their own.

zh: 讽刺的是，识字率的增加和现代技术的蚕蛹并没有带来智识增长，而是带来了地区冲突。
en: It is ironic that increased literacy and adoption of modern technology have contributed not to intellectual growth, but to regional strife.

zh: 黎巴嫩是该地区首先提高识字率的国家之一，也是第一个陷入内战的国家，这也许不是巧合。
en: It may be no coincidence that Lebanon, one of the first countries in the region to boost literacy rates, was also the first to tumble into civil war.

zh: 除非阿拉伯和穆斯林社会重新发现、重新激活，并在某些方面上创造出土生土长的当代智识传统，否则结果将是文化漂移，或者更糟糕的，是血腥内部冲突继续下去。
en: Unless Arab and Muslim societies rediscover, revitalize, and in some respects create their homegrown contemporary intellectual tradition, the result will be cultural drift or, far worse, the continuation of bloody civil strife.

zh: 阿拉法特的鬼魂
en: Arafat's Ghost

zh: 比起其它领导人，历史赋予亚西尔·阿拉法特的时间要多很多。
en: History gave Yasir Arafat far more time than most leaders to achieve his mission.

zh: 毕竟，他死的时候已经当了整整35年的巴勒斯坦领袖。
en: After all, at the time of his death he had been leader of the Palestinians for 35 years.

zh: 可他却把自己的人民留在了水深火热之中，没有国家、面临一场失败的战争、经济也濒临崩溃的边缘。
en: Yet he left his people in a terrible situation, with no state, in the midst of a losing war, and with a bankrupt economy.

zh: 他的继任者能否实现复兴，完成巴勒斯坦的历史重任就取决于他们把什么作为自己的目标。
en: Whether his successors can revive and complete the Palestinians' historic mission depends on how they define their goal.

zh: 回顾他的一生，阿拉法特从未真正改变过自己的信仰：那就是把不惜一切手段毁灭以色列，代之以巴勒斯坦阿拉伯国家当作自己的终身目标。
en: Looking back at his career, Arafat never really veered from the belief that his life's mission was to destroy Israel by any means necessary and replace it with a Palestinian Arab state.

zh: 他对没有包括全部以色列领土的独立巴勒斯坦国根本不屑一顾。
en: An independent Palestinian state that did not include all of Israel held no appeal to him.

zh: 他也毫不关心人民的疾苦，以及如何建设真正可行的政治和经济体系。
en: He was equally indifferent to his people's material welfare and anything particular about the design of a viable political and economic system.

zh: 如今在后阿拉法特时代，巴勒斯坦人必须从若干策略中做出选择。
en: Now, in the post-Arafat era, Palestinians must choose one of several strategies.

zh: 不幸的是，绝大多数备选方案都呼吁继续使用暴力和恐怖主义。
en: Unfortunately, most of the alternatives call for the continued use of violence and terrorism.

zh: 较为缓和的策略把尽快成立巴勒斯坦国作为自己的目标，他们认为一旦消除了以色列的占领或暴力，巴勒斯坦人就可以集中力量进行建设，包括重新安置难民、改善人们的生活水平。
en: The moderate strategy seeks an independent Palestine state as quickly as possible, on the assumption that once there is no more Israeli presence or violence, the Palestinians can concentrate on constructive pursuits, including resettling refugees and improving living standards.

zh: 但这仅仅是前总理阿巴斯和穆罕默德·达赫兰等少数领导人的观点，他们都在加沙地带拥有自己的武装。
en: But this is the view of only a small minority of leaders, notably former Prime Minister Abu Mazin and Muhammad Dahlan, who heads his own militia in the Gaza Strip.

zh: 如果阿拉法特选择了另一条路－接受以色列的存在、结束恐怖、反对巴勒斯坦极端份子－那么这场冲突很早以前就已经结束了。
en: If Arafat had taken this road - accepting Israel's existence, ending terrorism, and confronting Palestinian extremists - the conflict would have ended long ago.

zh: 可没有唯一的全权领袖，任何继任者想要落实这样的艰难决策都绝非易事。
en: But, with no single all-powerful leader, it will be hard for any successor to force through the difficult decisions required by such an orientation.

zh: 强硬策略是传统的理想化路线，很多从西岸和加沙地带流放归来的法塔赫和巴解组织老兵都支持这样的立场，其中也包括阿拉法特本人。
en: The hard-line strategy is the traditional ideological approach championed by many Fatah and PLO veterans who returned from exile to the West Bank and Gaza Strip, including Arafat.

zh: 他们目前的领袖包括巴勒斯坦全国委员会主席萨利姆·扎农和法塔赫精神领袖哈巴什，他们坚持继续与以色列交战直至将其摧毁，而后就能在巴勒斯坦建立起相对稳固的民族主义政权。
en: Their current leaders include men like Palestine National Council head Salim al-Zanun and Fatah ideological chief Sakr Habash, who favor continuing to battle Israel until it is destroyed, at which point they will rule Palestine with a relatively secular nationalist regime.

zh: 他们瞧不起年轻的对手，还把伊斯兰教徒看作一种威胁。
en: They look down at younger challengers and view the Islamists as a threat.

zh: 在20世纪70年代末的起义中开始其政治生涯的新一代西岸巴勒斯坦人的领袖也持好战态度，在他们眼中，强硬派不过是一群疲惫不堪的老顽固，由于腐败而丧失了所有的力量。
en: The younger generation of indigenous West Bank Palestinians, whose leaders began political activity in the uprising of the late 1970's, embraces a militant strategy that views the hardliners as burned-out old fogies, enervated by corruption.

zh: 和强硬派世俗论者不同，好战份子最著名的领袖是领导法塔赫基层组织坦兹姆的巴库提，他们愿意与伊斯兰教徒进行合作。
en: Unlike the hard-line secularists, the militants, whose best-known leader is Marwan Barghuti, the head of the Tanzim grassroots grouping in Fatah, are willing to work with the Islamists.

zh: 好战份子宣称：打败以色列要分两步走。
en: The militants argue that a two-stage strategy is needed to defeat Israel.

zh: 首先要开展长期持续性的暴力活动，这会迫使以色列从被占领土上撤军。
en: First, long-term continuation of violence will force Israel to withdraw from the occupied territories.

zh: 而后，随着巴勒斯坦人占据上风，他们就可以进入第二阶段，也就是用武力征服以色列全境－开展针对平民的恐怖活动－这个过程还会持续很多年。
en: Then, with Palestinians gaining the upper hand, they can advance to a second stage in which all of Israel is conquered, implying armed struggle - which often takes the form of anti-civilian terrorism - for many more years.

zh: 最后，还有哈马斯支持的革命伊斯兰观，也就是继续战斗、继续使用恐怖主义，直到最终战胜以色列和巴勒斯坦民族主义者为止，他们根本不管要付出多长时间和多大代价。
en: Finally, there is the revolutionary Islamist vision espoused by Hamas, which seeks to continue fighting and using terrorism, regardless of how much time it takes and lives it costs, until it defeats both Israel and Palestinian secular nationalists.

zh: 这以后，巴勒斯坦会成为一个纯粹的伊斯兰国家，在这个国度里，温和派会遭到枪决、而旧的民族领袖被迫离职或以腐败罪名入狱。
en: Palestine will then be an Islamist state in which moderates would be shot and the old nationalist leadership forcibly retired or jailed for corruption.

zh: 但与此同时，哈马斯愿意与民族主义者、特别是法塔赫内部的好战主义者结成联盟。
en: In the meantime, however, Hamas is willing to form alliances with the nationalists, particularly the militant faction of Fatah.

zh: 巴勒斯坦温和派面临的问题非常清楚：任何愿意与以色列达成和平协议的领袖都会遭到反对－这种反对狂热甚至充满暴力－来自整个运动80%以上的力量。
en: The problem for Palestinian moderates is clear: any leader willing to agree a peace treaty with Israel would be opposed - passionately and even violently - by roughly 80% of the movement.

zh: 关键问题是厌烦了领导人无休止的争论、腐败和无能的巴勒斯坦民众是否能够让政府听到自己的愿望，结束这场已经让他们付出了太多代价的冲突。
en: A key question is whether the Palestinian masses, fed up with their leadership's bickering, corruption, and incompetence, could make their wishes known to find an end to a conflict that has cost them so much.

zh: 但没有一个主要派别提出要多听取广大民众的意见，阿拉法特也没有留下任何类似的机制。
en: But none of the main leadership factions are proposing that the masses be consulted very much. Nor did Arafat leave in place any institutional mechanisms for doing so.

zh: 此外，我们也不能低估激进宗教、观念和错误信息造成的巨大影响。
en: Moreover, the popular appeal of radical religion, ideology, and misinformation should not be underestimated.

zh: 4年前，阿拉法特曾拒绝成立一个面积相当于整个西岸和加沙地带的独立的巴勒斯坦国，外加超过200亿美元的难民赔款，可真正了解此事的巴勒斯坦人却寥寥无几。
en: Few Palestinians are even aware that four years ago Arafat turned down an independent state equal in size to the entire West Bank and Gaza Strip, in addition to more than $20 billion in refugee compensation.

zh: 阿拉法特留下的主要问题在于缺乏任何形式的领导。
en: The main problem left by Arafat is the lack of any leadership at all.

zh: 政治运动的创始人故意把自己的组织引向混乱，这种情况在历史上也极为罕见。
en: Rarely in history has a political movement been so deliberately set by its founder on a course toward chaos.

zh: 阿拉法特不仅没有留下继承人，也没有留下秩序。
en: Arafat not only left no successor, but no order.

zh: 几十年来，巴解组织已经形成了不守纪律的政治文化。
en: Over the decades, the movement has developed a political culture of indiscipline.

zh: 阿拉法特管理着一群混乱不堪的竞争对手，这不仅威胁到其它潜在领袖的地位，也确保了一切权力（和资金）都由阿拉法特本人亲自管理。
en: Arafat presided over a sort of anarchy, encouraging rivalries, undermining other potential leaders, and ensuring that all authority (and money) ran through his hands.

zh: 只有当后阿拉法特时代的领导人下定决心、真心希望在所有领域结束冲突、建立巴勒斯坦国，真正的和平机会才会出现。
en: Only if the post-Arafat movement decides that it really wants a Palestinian state in exchange for ending the conflict with Israel in every respect will there be a real chance of peace.

zh: 阿拉法特之死也可能预示着这一过程的开始，但向巴勒斯坦新领袖的过渡不仅需要很多年，而且也没什么能够保证这位新领袖一定会是温和派。
en: Arafat's death may well mark the beginning of that process, but the transition to a new Palestinian leadership could take years, and there is no assurance that it will be a moderate one.

zh: 阿拉法特最后的欢呼
en: Arafat’s Last Hurrrah

zh: 在长时间的死亡过程中，亚西尔·阿拉法特为巴勒斯坦解放事业尽了最后一份力量，这是他终身为之奋斗的事业。
en: In his protracted moment of death, Yasir Arafat performed his last act of duty to the Palestinian cause to which he devoted his entire life.

zh: 实际上，有关阿拉法特的一切都是一场持久战。
en: Everything about the man was, indeed, protracted.

zh: 他发起了一场旷日持久的国家解放战争，他经受了一系列长时间的围困－1970年的安曼之围、1982年的贝鲁特之围和2002到2004年的拉马拉之围。
en: He carried out a protracted war of national liberation. He withstood a series of protracted sieges – in Amman (1970), Beirut (1982), and in Ramallah (2002-2004).

zh: 和阿拉伯世界的领导人相比，阿拉法特的在位时间也是最长的，因为他的寿命超过了三任埃及总统（纳吉布、纳赛尔、萨达特，其任期还跨越了穆巴拉克执政的四分之一个世纪 ） 、 五任黎巴嫩总统、三任伊拉克总统、五任阿尔及利亚总统、三任叙利亚总统、三任沙特国王和两任摩洛哥国王，其它国家的领袖就更难望其项背，从美国的艾森豪维尔到布什、法国的戴高乐到希拉克、从中国的毛泽东到继任的三任领导人。
en: Arafat’s leadership was the most protracted among his counterparts in the Arab World, as he outlived three Egyptian Presidents (Naguib, Nasser, Sadat and spanned all of Mubarak’s quarter of a century), five Lebanese Presidents, three Iraqis, five Algerians, three Syrians, three Saudi Monarchs, and two in Morocco, not to mention other world leaders, from Eisenhower to Bush in the US, from de Gaulle to Chirac in France, and from Maó to three successors in China.

zh: 今天仍旧在世的政治领袖中，恐怕没有人像阿拉法特这样会见并经历过这么多的世界领袖。
en: Probably no other political figure alive today met and endured as many world leaders as Arafat.

zh: 但阿拉法特给我们留下的远远不只是耐力。
en: But there is much more to Arafat’s legacy than endurance.

zh: 很多人都说阿拉法特对自己的人民来讲是好坏参半的祝福。
en: It has been correctly said over and again that Arafat was a mixed blessing for his people.

zh: 他们的前途和命运紧紧联系在一起，有时两者会同时走到崩溃的边缘。
en: Their fate and destiny have been inextricably linked, to the near demise of both at times.

zh: 家园被强占后几十年过去了，巴勒斯坦人已经沦为了一群无家可归的难民，有些人继续留在新建国的以色列当二等公民，其它人则流落到阿拉伯乃至整个世界。
en: For several decades after the usurpation of their homeland, Palestinians were reduced to aggregates of refugees, some remaining in the newly-created state of Israel as second-class citizens, with others scattered over the Arab World and far beyond.

zh: 正是亚西尔·阿拉法特，用他一手创建的巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO ） ， 给了他们做人的最后一点尊严。
en: It was Yasir Arafat, through the Palestinian Liberation Organization (PLO) he founded, that gave them a sense of identity as a people.

zh: 最终效果姑且不论，巴解组织发起的武装斗争确实给了巴勒斯坦人生存的力量，把群体和自我的尊严深深地印在了他们心中。
en: Regardless of its effectiveness, the armed struggle waged by the PLO did empower the Palestinians and internalize a sense of collective dignity and self respect within them.

zh: 人们再也不能忽视他们的事业。
en: Their cause could no longer be ignored.

zh: 还没有任何现代事务能引来这么多联合国决议和国际外交的广泛关注。
en: No other modern issue has appropriated as many UN resolutions or as much international diplomacy.

zh: 如果政治斗争是一门妥协的艺术，那么阿拉法特是巴勒斯坦和阿拉伯人中当之无愧的大师。
en: If politics is defined as the art of compromise, Arafat was a master of it at the Palestinian and Arab levels.

zh: 四十年来他大权独揽，没有受到过任何真正严重的挑战。
en: He managed to stay at the helm for over forty years with no serious challengers.

zh: 在国际上，他却无法跟上冷战后时代的步伐。
en: Internationally, however, he was out of step with the post Cold War era.

zh: 不管是不是要由他承担全部责任，但2000年8月错过了戴维营历史和解的真正机会却是无可辩驳的事实，一年后连他自己也承认了这一点。
en: Whether or not he was solely to blame, a true opportunity for historical compromise was missed at Camp David in August 2000, and he himself acknowledged it a year later.

zh: 但那时却为时已晚，因为以色列和美国的领导人都已经更替，他们对团结他已经失去了兴趣。
en: By that time it was too late, as the leadership in both the US and Israel had changed and there was no interest to engage him.

zh: 在他生命的最后四年里，阿拉法特的公众空间大幅度缩小，无论从直接还是比喻意义上都不例外。
en: During the last four years of his life, Arafat’s public space was literally and metaphorically diminishing.

zh: 他无力再团结自己的以色列对手，也无力控制赞成自杀性袭击的巴勒斯坦好战分子。
en: He was unable to re-engage his Israeli adversaries or control his suicide-bound Palestinian militants.

zh: 他也无法遏制、更无法战胜巴权力机构内部愈演愈烈的腐败。
en: Nor was he able to contain let alone combat rampant corruption in the Palestinian Authority.

zh: 世界局势也朝着对阿拉法特不利的方向发展，人们把关注的焦点转向了布什在阿富汗和伊拉克发动的反恐战争。
en: Nor was Arafat helped by world events that shifted the spotlight to Bush’s wars on terrorism in Afghanistan and Iraq.

zh: 如果说有影响的话，那么无论对他还是他奋斗一生的事业产生的影响都十分不利。
en: If anything, they had adverse effects for him and his life-long cause.

zh: 阿拉法特熟悉的世界也像他自己的健康状况一样不可控制、也无法挽回的离他而去。
en: Like his own body, Arafat’s familiar world was steadily fading away with irreversible loss of control.

zh: 充满讽刺意味的是，在阿拉法特垂死之际，世界领袖和媒体重新发现了他作为领袖和个人的重要性。
en: Ironically however, as he was dying, world leaders and the media were rediscovering the importance of Arafat’s leadership if not his persona.

zh: 媒体给了他长时间、甚至是近乎饱和的关注，巴勒斯坦问题重新成了世界关注的焦点。
en: The sustained focus of the media on him, to the point of near saturation, focused world attention on the Palestinian Question once again.

zh: 托尼·布莱尔、雅克·希拉克、柯菲·安南和其它人在阿拉法特死后的讲话都迫切要求尽快结束冲突，这样的解决已经来得太迟了。
en: Statements by Tony Blair, Jacques Chirac, Kofi Annan and others on the occasion of Arafat’s death have been forceful in demanding a speedy and long overdue resolution of the conflict.

zh: 死去的阿拉法特却好像给了巴勒斯坦的人民在他活着的时候无法获得的机会－那就是对独立、民主的巴勒斯坦国的梦想。
en: It is as if in death, Arafat has given his people a chance to achieve what he could not achieve in life –the dream of an independent democratic Palestinian state.

zh: 这是阿拉法特生命中最后的欢呼。
en: It is Arafat’s last hurrah.

zh: 为何央行又开始做实验了？
en: Why Are Central Banks on Trial Again?

zh: 伦敦—过去十年，央行就像是在坐过山车，从英雄沦为狗熊，又从狗熊重新成为英雄。
en: LONDON – Central banks have been on a roller-coaster ride in the last decade, from heroes to zeroes and back again.

zh: 如今，它们的运气和名声是否又开始走下坡了？
en: Is another downswing in their fortunes and reputations now starting?

zh: 2006年，艾伦·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）从他干了18年的美联储主席任上退休，其时名誉如日中天。
en: In 2006, when Alan Greenspan retired after his 18-year reign as Chair of the US Federal Reserve Board, his reputation could hardly have been higher.

zh: 他引导美国经济穿越互联网枯荣循环，谨慎地渡过2001年9月11日恐怖袭击带来的潜在增长威胁，在任期间GDP和生产率增长迅猛。
en: He had steered the US economy through the dot-com boom and bust, had carefully navigated the potential threat to growth from the terror attacks of September 11, 2001, and presided over a period of rapid GDP and productivity growth.

zh: 在他的最后一次美联储理事会会议上，时任纽约联储主席蒂莫西·盖特纳（Timothy Geithner）对格林斯潘进行了如今看上去颇令人尴尬的高度赞扬，说格林斯潘的名誉在未来还会继续上升而不是下降。
en: At his final Board meeting, Timothy Geithner, then-President of the New York Fed, delivered what now seems an embarrassing encomium, saying that Greenspan’s stellar reputation was likely to grow, rather than diminish, in the future.

zh: 区区三年后，诺贝尔经济学奖获得者保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）借用巨蟒（Monty Python）的鹦鹉素描，说曾经的大师格林斯潘如今已经名誉扫地。
en: Only three years later, the Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman, borrowing from Monty Python’s parrot sketch, was able to say that Greenspan was an ex-maestro whose reputation was now pushing up daisies.

zh: 央行被广泛视为在本世纪最初的几年里玩忽职守。
en: Central banks were widely seen to have been dozing at the switch through the early years of this century.

zh: 它们放任全球失衡日积月累，亲切地看着巨大的信用泡沫产生，忽视按揭市场所闪现的危险信号，不假思索地赞美薪酬过高的投资银行家所创造的创新但有毒的金融产品。
en: They allowed global imbalances to build up, looked benignly on a massive credit bubble, ignored flashing danger signs in the mortgage market, and uncritically admired the innovative but toxic products devised by overpaid investment bankers.

zh: 央行对深化的危机的早期反应也是犹犹豫豫。
en: The early reactions by central banks to the deepening crisis were also unsure.

zh: 英格兰银行在银行体系分崩离析之际大谈道德风险，而在几乎所有经济学家都认为欧元区崩溃和相关信用动荡才是更大的风险时，欧洲央行继续与想象中的通胀恶龙搏斗。
en: The Bank of England (BoE) lectured on moral hazard while the banking system imploded around it, and the European Central Bank continued to slay imaginary inflation dragons when almost all economists saw far greater risks in a eurozone meltdown and associated credit crunch.

zh: 但是，尽管出现了这些错误举措，但当全世界政府考虑如何最好地响应危机的教训时，曾经被视为问题的一部分的央行被认为是解决办法的关键部分。
en: Yet, despite these missteps, when governments around the world considered how best to respond to the lessons of the crisis, central banks, once seen as part of the problem, came to be viewed as an essential part of the solution.

zh: 它们获得了新的监管金融体系的权力，并被鼓励采取新的、高度干预的政策来遏制萧条和通缩。
en: They were given new powers to regulate the financial system, and encouraged to adopt new and highly interventionist policies in an attempt to stave off depression and deflation.

zh: 央行资产负债表急剧扩张，新的法律大大加强了它们的权限。
en: Central banks’ balance sheets have expanded dramatically, and new laws have strengthened their hand enormously.

zh: 在美国，多德-弗兰克法案让美联储进入它从未涉足的金融体系监管领域，授予它接管和清算倒闭银行的权力。
en: In the United States, the Dodd-Frank Act has taken the Fed into areas of the financial system which it has never regulated, and given it powers to take over and resolve failing banks.

zh: 在英国，银行监管于1997年从英格兰银行的职能中剥离，2013年又重新加入，此外，英格兰银行还首次成为保险公司的审慎监督者 — — 其作用被大大扩大。
en: In the United Kingdom, bank regulation, which had been removed from the BoE in 1997, returned there in 2013, and the BoE also became for the first time the prudential supervisor of insurance companies – a big extension of its role.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲央行现在是80%以上欧盟银行部门的直接监督者。
en: The ECB, meanwhile, is now the direct supervisor of more than 80% of the European Union’s banking sector.

zh: 在过去五年中，央行成为西方世界增长最快的行业。
en: In the last five years, central banking has become one of the fastest-growing industries in the Western world.

zh: 央行似乎扭转了身受口诛笔伐之势，翻身成为大赢家。
en: The central banks seem to have turned the tables on their critics, emerging triumphant.

zh: 它们有时带点争议的创新措施帮助世界经济实现复苏。
en: Their innovative and sometimes controversial actions have helped the world economy recover.

zh: 但是，现在看来，这一权力扩张也许正在产生模棱两可的结果。
en: But there are now signs that this aggrandizement may be having ambiguous consequences.

zh: 事实上，一些央行开始担心其作用扩张过度，有可能适得其反。
en: Indeed, some central bankers are beginning to worry that their role has expanded too far, putting them at risk of a backlash.

zh: 相关危险有二。
en: There are two related dangers.

zh: 第一个危险可以用穆罕默德·艾利安（Mohamed El-Erian）的新书标题《唯一的游戏 》 （ The Only Game in Town）来概括。
en: The first is encapsulated in the title of Mohamed El-Erian’s latest book: The Only Game in Town.

zh: 人们期望央行承担更多危机后调整负担。
en: Central banks have been expected to shoulder the greater part of the burden of post-crisis adjustment.

zh: 它们的大规模资产购买操作是金融经济的续命丹。
en: Their massive asset purchases are a life-support system for the financial economy.

zh: 但它们本身无法解决全球失衡和巨额债务积压等根本问题。
en: Yet they cannot, by themselves, resolve the underlying problems of global imbalances and the huge debt overhang.

zh: 事实上，它们可能正在阻挠解决经济复苏的这些障碍所需要的其他调整，包括财政调整和结构调整。
en: Indeed, they may be preventing the other adjustments, whether fiscal or structural, that are needed to resolve those impediments to economic recovery.

zh: 欧洲尤其如此。
en: This is particularly true in Europe.

zh: 欧洲央行通过行长德拉吉所谓的“不惜一切代价”成功维系了欧元，但政府几乎什么都没有做。
en: While the ECB keeps the euro afloat by doing “whatever it takes” in ECB President Mario Draghi’s phrase, governments are doing little.

zh: 既然欧洲央行不断从其货币药栈里开出越来越重的剂量，为什么还要去做艰难决定呢？
en: Why take tough decisions if the ECB continues to administer heavier and heavier doses from its monetary drug cabinet?

zh: 第二个危险是有时被称为“过于强大的公民”的问题。
en: The second danger is a version of what is sometimes called the “over-mighty citizen” problem.

zh: 央行是否被授予过多的权力自说自话？
en: Have central banks been given too many powers for their own good?

zh: 量化宽松就是其中之一。
en: Quantitative easing is a case in point.

zh: 它模糊了货币和财政政策之间的界线 — — 财政政策显然是民选政府的管辖范围 — — 因此产生了不安。
en: Because it blurs the line between monetary and fiscal policy – which must surely be the province of elected governments – unease has grown.

zh: 我们可以在德国看到这一苗头，如今有很多德国人质疑欧洲央行是否过于强大、独立和不可问责。
en: We can see signs of this in Germany, where many now question whether the ECB is too powerful, independent, and unaccountable.

zh: 类似的批评也在驱动希望“审计美联储”的美国人 — — 他们常常要求规定货币政策受国会监督。
en: Similar criticism motivates those in the US who want to “audit the Fed” – often code for subjecting monetary policy to Congressional oversight.

zh: 还有关于金融监管的担心，特别是央行亮闪闪的新宏观审慎工具。
en: There are worries, too, about financial regulation, and especially central banks’ shiny new macroprudential instruments.

zh: 在新书《炼金术的终结 》 （ The End of Alchemy）中英格兰银行前行长默文·金（Mervyn King）指出，用抑制信用直接干预按揭市场应该接受政治决定的约束。
en: In his new book The End of Alchemy, former BoE Governor Mervyn King argues that direct intervention in the mortgage market by restraining credit should be subject to political decision.

zh: 也有人，主要是德国联邦银行前行长艾克赛尔·韦伯（Axel Weber ） ， 认为央行直接监督银行是危险的。
en: Others, notably Axel Weber, a former head of the Bundesbank, think it is dangerous for the central bank to supervise banks directly.

zh: 出问题的是金融市场，受指责的是监督者。
en: Things go wrong in financial markets, and the supervisors are blamed.

zh: 如果央行被推上第一线，就存在传染风险，以及货币政策信心缺失的风险。
en: There is a risk of contagion, and a loss of confidence in monetary policy, if the central bank is in the front line.

zh: 这就带来了最大的担忧。
en: That points to the biggest concern of all.

zh: 央行的货币政策独立性是好不容易才赢得的。
en: Central banks’ monetary-policy independence was a hard-won prize.

zh: 这种独立性给我们的经济带来了巨大的好处。
en: It has brought great benefits to our economies.

zh: 但一个用公共资金购买债券、决定按揭融资是否可得、以给股东带来沉重代价的方式关闭银行的机构，需要不同的政治问责形式。
en: But an institution buying bonds with public money, deciding on the availability of mortgage finance, and winding down banks at great cost to their shareholders demands a different form of political accountability.

zh: 危险在于危机后仓促地决定给央行增加职能可能带来不可预见的不良后果。
en: The danger is that hasty post-crisis decisions to load additional functions onto central banks may have unforeseen and unwelcome consequences.

zh: 特别是，加强对这些职能的政治监督可能影响到货币政策。
en: In particular, greater political oversight of these functions could affect monetary policy as well.

zh: 出于这一原因，不管采取怎样的新问责机制，都必须特别谨慎地进行设计。
en: For this reason, whatever new mechanisms of accountability are put in place will have to be designed with extraordinary care.

zh: 免疫最前沿
en: Immunization on the Front Line

zh: 马普托—关于莫桑比克的消息大多不会好 — — 贫困、疾病、冲突，还有洪水。
en: MAPUTO – Most of the news one hears coming out of Mozambique is bad – poverty, disease, conflict, and floods.

zh: 但我的祖国并不缺乏好事发生。
en: But there are a lot of good things happening in my country, too.

zh: 过去二十年来，莫桑比克已成为运转良好的民主国家，其农业部门有了成长，其识字率有了提高，其农村水电供应有所增加，其儿童死亡率大幅下降。 1990年，即内战结束前的倒数第二年，每1000名初生儿有219名会夭折；而到了2010年，这一数字下降至135人。
en: In the past two decades, Mozambique has become a functioning democracy; grown its agriculture sector; raised literacy rates; increased water supply and electricity in rural areas; and reduced child mortality dramatically, from 219 per 1,000 live births in 1990, two years before the civil war ended, to 135 per 1,000 in 2010.

zh: 最后一个成就令我感到尤其自豪，因为，我和我的莫桑比克免疫推广工作同事一直在努力，我认为我们对这一成就做出了贡献。
en: I am particularly proud of the last achievement, because, by working in partnership with my fellow Mozambicans to expand immunization coverage, I believe that I have played a part in bringing it about.

zh: 在我长大的年代，莫桑比克仍由葡萄牙人统治，殖民地社会的不平等性使我形成了一种观念，所有人都有权获得健康和医疗。
en: I grew up in Mozambique when the country was still under Portuguese rule, and the inequality in our colonial society shaped my view that all people have a right to health care.

zh: 我还记得我十来岁的时候在儿科病房工作，常常目睹儿童因小儿麻痹症、麻疹和破伤风丧命，而这些疾病可以简单地通过疫苗预防。
en: I remember working at a pediatric ward as a teenager and watching children die from diseases like polio, measles, and tetanus – all easily prevented by vaccines.

zh: 这一经历所造成的影响让我在此后40年中致力于确保莫桑比克的每一个孩子，不管他出身何族、身在何处，都能获得他所需要的、能给他带来健康长命的疫苗。
en: The impact of that experience led me to spend the next 40 years working to ensure that every child in Mozambique, regardless of her ethnicity or where she lives, gets the vaccines that she needs to help her lead a long and healthy life.

zh: 几天后，我将和300名全球领袖一起参加阿布扎比世界首届疫苗峰会 — — 该会议旨在足额包所有地区的所有儿童都能获得疫苗。
en: In a few days, I will join 300 global leaders in Abu Dhabi for the world’s first vaccine summit – a gathering dedicated to ensuring that all children everywhere have access to vaccines.

zh: 比尔·盖茨和科菲·安南的出席表明，免疫计划值得拥有充分的资金和政治支持。
en: People like Bill Gates and Kofi Annan will make the case that immunization programs deserve adequate funding and political support.

zh: 我的听众不可能像盖茨和安南那样多，但我也要在他们的基础上补充我自己的看法。
en: I don’t have an audience like Gates or Annan, but I would like to add my voice to theirs.

zh: 几百万像我和我同事那样的卫生工作者以免疫为自己的事业。
en: Millions of health workers like my colleagues and I make immunization their daily work.

zh: 我们在让更多儿童获得更多疫苗方面已经做出了巨大进步，这也是为何越来越多的儿童能够逃脱夭折命运的原因。
en: We have made tremendous strides in reaching more children with more vaccines, which is why more children are surviving than ever before.

zh: 但跟多的儿童还在等待拯救，我们的事业需要帮助。
en: But there are still even more children to save, and we need help to do our work on the ground.

zh: 如果父母拒绝给孩子接种，那么疫苗将毫无用处。 因此，我工作的一大重点是与高薪工作者、社区领袖、学校教师和地方政治人物合作对父母进行疫苗教育。
en: Because vaccines are useless if parents refuse to give them to their children, a big part of my job is to collaborate with health workers, community leaders, school teachers, and local political figures to educate parents about vaccines.

zh: 但获得社区支持是不够的。
en: But having the community’s support is not enough.

zh: 确保疫苗在正确的时间、正确的环境中出现在正确的地点也很关键。
en: It is also vital to ensure that vaccines get to the right place, at the right time, and in the right condition.

zh: 比如，为了防止短缺，我所效力的组织VillageReach帮助修正了���于预测每个卫生中心所需疫苗数量的人口数据。
en: For example, in order to prevent shortages, VillageReach, the organization for which I work, helped to correct the population figures used to forecast the number of vaccines needed in each health center.

zh: VillageReach还开设了一家公司负责为莫桑比克北部的卫生中心输送丙烷气，与莫桑比克的许多农村地区一样，那里的电力供应很不可靠，甚至根本无法获得用于冷藏疫苗的冰箱所需的电力。
en: VillageReach also started a company that delivers propane gas to health centers in northern Mozambique, where, like in many of the country’s rural areas, electricity is unreliable or completely unavailable to power the refrigerators that keep vaccines cool.

zh: 通过丙烷气，我们得以确保疫苗不会在从制造厂抵达母亲和儿童手中的过程中变质。
en: Through the use of propane, we can ensure that the vaccines do not spoil during the journey from manufacturer to mother and child.

zh: 每个月，我们都要确保卫生工作者完成“最后一英里 ” ， 将疫苗和其他卫生服务送到边远农村的母亲和儿童手中。
en: And once a month, we make sure that health workers deliver vaccines and other health services “the last mile” to mothers and children in remote rural areas.

zh: 最后，我明白一丝不苟的记录和测量结果对于让更多儿童获得疫苗来说是至关重要的。
en: Finally, I have learned that meticulous record-keeping and measuring results is critical to reaching more children.

zh: 这就是我们评估不同现场数据收集方法的原因，包括使用移动应用将纸面记录数字化。
en: That is why we are assessing different methods for gathering data from the field, including the use of mobile applications to digitize paper records.

zh: 打造常规免疫系统已让我们根除了小儿麻痹症和绝大部分麻疹（只有一种尚待根除 ） 。
en: Building these routine immunization systems has already helped us to eradicate diseases like polio and all but one type of measles.

zh: 本月早些时候，我们用常规免疫系统而儿童接种肺炎疫苗，这是莫桑比克历史上的首次，我们希望明年可以开始征服轮状病毒，该病毒所引起的痢疾是五岁以下幼儿的第一杀手。
en: Earlier this month, we used them to vaccinate children against pneumonia for the first time in Mozambique’s history, and we hope that next year we will begin to address rotavirus, which causes diarrhea and is the number one killer for children under five years old.

zh: 我们的长期目标是强化常规免疫系统，使其覆盖莫桑比克所有儿童，让他们获得基本疫苗和其他医疗服务。
en: Our longer-term goal is to strengthen these systems enough to reach all children in Mozambique with basic vaccines and other forms of health care.

zh: 我相信我们可以完成这一目标，因为尽管充满了艰辛，我们已经取得了重大进步。
en: I believe that we can achieve this goal, because I have witnessed how far we have come already, despite our struggles.

zh: 前方还有重大挑战，但我有信心，在全球社会的支持下，我有信心为我的孩子和社会带来一个每个人都拥有成功机会的繁荣过度。
en: Big challenges lie ahead, but I am confident that with the support of the global community, I can leave to my own children and community a thriving country where every person has the opportunity to prosper.

zh: 令所有人受益的复苏
en: A Recovery for All

zh: 纽约 — — 过去两年来，世界多数国家都选择扩大公共开支，缓冲全球金融危机给本国经济和民众带来的影响。
en: NEW YORK – Over the last two years, the majority of countries in the world chose to expand public spending in order to buffer the impact of the global financial crisis on their economies and populations.

zh: 但今年随着经济复苏的迹象开始出现，发达国家又迅速从财政刺激转向了财政整顿。
en: But, this year, with signs of economic recovery emerging, advanced countries have quickly shifted from fiscal stimulus to fiscal consolidation.

zh: 现在就连发展中国家也开始加入整顿的行列。
en: Now developing countries are also following the trend to consolidate.

zh: 联合国儿童基金会对126个国家的调查显示大量中低收入国家预计在2010－2011年削减公共开支。
en: A recent UNICEF survey of 126 countries shows that a significant number of low- and middle-income countries are expected to reduce public expenditures in 2010-2011.

zh: 现在整顿时机不对，因为各国政府刚刚在去年九月举行的联合国千年首脑会议上承诺实现减少贫困和降低新生儿死亡率等发展目标。
en: This comes at a bad time, just after world governments committed themselves to achieving the development goals, such as reducing poverty and infant mortality, agreed last September at the United Nations’ Millennium Summit.

zh: 对多数中低收入国家而言，刚刚开始的经济复苏不仅脆弱，也很不平衡。
en: For most low- and middle-income countries, the incipient economic recovery appears to be fragile and uneven.

zh: 事实上，很多中低收入国家很容易受到商品价格波动、金融系统缺陷、世界市场需求低迷、外部融资、海外发展援助和投资短缺的影响。
en: Indeed, many of these countries remain vulnerable to volatile commodity prices, financial-system weaknesses, depressed demand from world markets, and shortfalls in external finance, overseas development assistance, and investment.

zh: 更为重要的是，根据联合国及世界银行统计，全球经济危机的影响继续体现在饥饿、失业和社会动荡之中。
en: More importantly, according to the UN and the World Bank, the social impact of the global economic crisis continues to be felt in terms of rising hunger, unemployment, and social unrest.

zh: 粮食和燃料价格上涨与金融和经济危机共同削弱了贫困家庭的购买力，同时也对他们享受到的社会服务和雇佣机遇造成了影响。
en: The combination of rising food and fuel prices and the financial and economic crisis has reduced poor families’ purchasing power, access to social services, and employment opportunities.

zh: 此外，贫困家庭已经开始缩减粮食消费，据联合国粮农组织估计约有10亿人处在饥饿和营养不良的状态中。
en: Moreover, poor households have reduced food consumption, with the UN Food and Agricultural Organization estimating that nearly one billion people are hungry and malnourished.

zh: 除2008－09年度已经跌入贫困的成百上千万人外，金融危机的长期综合影响会使另外6400万人在2010年陷入极度贫困。
en: In addition to the millions already pushed into poverty in 2008-09, another 64 million could fall into extreme poverty during 2010 as a result of the combined, lingering effects of the crisis.

zh: 20世纪80年代，调整计划也曾迫使国家削减教育、医疗、供水、农业及其他领域等改变贫困家庭生存状况的公共开支。
en: In the 1980’s, adjustment programs required countries to cut back on their expenditures, including outlays on education, health, water, agriculture, and other sectors that make a difference to poor households.

zh: 正如已故坦桑尼亚总统朱利叶斯·尼雷尔当众提出的那样 ： “ 我们是不是必须为了还债而饿死我们的孩子？ ”
en: As the late Tanzanian President Julius Nyerere demanded publicly: “Must we starve our children to pay our debts?”

zh: 很多发展中国家低收入人群中新生儿死亡率上升，不平等现象也愈发严重。
en: Infant mortality rates rose among low-income groups in many developing countries, and inequality increased.

zh: 上述时期被称为“失去的十年。
en: This period came to be known as the “lost decade.”

zh: ” 联合国儿童基金会因此提出了人性化调整计划，提出儿童利益必须在经济危机中得到保护。
en: UNICEF responded with Adjustment with a Human Face, which argued that children must be protected during economic crises.

zh: 儿基会主张实行更为宽松的宏观经济政策，在为穷人创造就业和公共投资机会的同时建立社会保障体系。
en: It argued for more expansionary macroeconomic policies to generate employment, public-sector investments to serve the poor, and the establishment of social-protection systems.

zh: 相似的一幕在三十年后又再度重演，我们还应该采取同样的对策。
en: Thirty years later, déjà vu, the same message applies.

zh: 发展中国家对危机没有任何责任的穷人再次被迫承担危机最严重的后果。
en: The poor in developing countries are again being made to endure the worst consequences of a crisis that they played no part in creating.

zh: 关键是这次不能再演变为新一轮失去的十年，贫困家庭特别是儿童不能再像20世纪80年代那样备受煎熬。
en: It is critically important that this does not lead to a new lost decade of development, and that poor households – especially children – do not suffer as they did in the 1980‘s.

zh: 不过这种情况随时可能发生。
en: And yet that could very well happen.

zh: 联合国儿基会对126个发展中国家的调查表明在缩减公共开支的近半数国家中，常见的调整措施包括公共部门的减薪或限薪、取消粮食补贴和对已经少得可怜的社会保障体系进行限制和调整。
en: Our UNICEF survey of 126 developing countries found that among the nearly one-half that are reducing public expenditures, common adjustment measures include public-sector wage cuts or caps, withdrawal of food subsidies, and the targeting and rationalization of already meager social-protection systems.

zh: 这些调整措施往往没有对社会影响认真研究就开始付诸实行。
en: These adjustment measures are often adopted without carefully examining their social impact.

zh: 粮食和医疗服务匮乏会造成多少贫困儿童遭难或死亡？
en: How many poor children will suffer – or die – from lack of food and health care?

zh: 低工资造成的教师短缺或者贫困儿童被迫工作贴补家用会让多少孩子失去上学的机会？
en: How many children will miss out on education because teachers are absent due to low wages, or simply because poor children must work to supplement their family income?

zh: 调整公共支出增大了穷人在复苏中受到歧视的风险，从而进一步加剧发展中国家的不平等现象。
en: Adjustment of public expenditures raises the risk of a recovery that discriminates against the poor, and thus fuels greater inequities in developing countries.

zh: 过早的财政紧缩和/或取消反周期经济政策威胁着对促进受危机影响最严重群体恢复至关重要的公共财政支持政策。
en: Premature fiscal contraction and/or withdrawal of countercyclical measures threaten the public support that is essential to promoting recovery among those hardest hit by the crisis.

zh: 随着全球经济衰退的好转，让所有人享受复苏成果是最为迫切的需求，复苏必须照顾到所有人的利益，扩大就业机会、改善不平等现象并继续保持发展进程。
en: As the global recession ebbs, the most urgent imperative is recovery for all – a recovery that is inclusive, expands employment opportunities, reduces inequalities, and sustains development processes.

zh: 上述目标是可以实现的。
en: This can be achieved.

zh: 但需要保持对贫困国家的援助；需要政府关注支持就业和广义经济活动的扩张性宏观经济政策；需要制定扩大对贫困人口医疗服务和社会保护的新计划；还需要教育、供水、卫生、农业和粮食安全领域的投资得到它们所必须的支持。
en: It requires that aid to poor countries be sustained; that governments focus on expansionary macroeconomic policies that support employment and broad-based economic activities; that new schemes be introduced to extend health services and social protection for the poor; and that investments in education, water supply, sanitation, agriculture, and food security receive the support they need.

zh: 法西斯主义的春天
en: Springtime for Fascism?

zh: 纽约 — — 我们是否正看到法西斯主义新的曙光？
en: NEW YORK – Are we seeing a new dawn of fascism?

zh: 许多人都开始这样想。
en: Many people are beginning to think so.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普一直被比作法西斯主义者，同样的还有弗拉基米尔·普京和欧洲各式各样的煽动者和右翼大嘴巴。
en: Donald Trump has been compared to a fascist, as has Vladimir Putin and a variety of demagogues and right-wing loudmouths in Europe.

zh: 最近这股气势汹汹的独裁浪潮已经远播菲律宾，该国的当选总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特（外号“惩罚者 ” ） 发誓要将犯罪嫌疑人扔进马尼拉湾。
en: The recent tide of authoritarian bluster has reached as far as the Philippines, whose president-elect, Rodrigo (“The Punisher”) Duterte, has vowed to toss suspected criminals into Manila Bay.

zh: “法西斯主义”或“纳粹”等词汇的问题是它们被太多无知的人频繁使用，以至于在太多情况下早就失去了任何实质意义。
en: The problem with terms like “fascism” or “Nazi” is that so many ignorant people have used them so often, in so many situations, that they have long ago lost any real significance.

zh: 没有多少人还能真正理解法西斯主义实际的含义。
en: Few still know firsthand what fascism actually meant.

zh: 法西斯主义已经成为形容我们不喜欢的人或理念的包罗万象的短语。
en: It has become a catch-all phrase for people or ideas we don't like.

zh: 随意的说法不仅粗化了政治辩论、而且粗化了历史记忆。
en: Loose rhetoric has coarsened not only political debate, but historical memory, too.

zh: 当2014年一位共和党参议员候选人将美国财产税比作大屠杀，对犹太人的大规模谋杀被轻视到几乎毫无意义。
en: When a Republican politician compares US property taxes with the Holocaust, as one Senate candidate did in 2014, the mass murder of Jews is trivialized to the extent of becoming meaningless.

zh: 将特朗普比作希特勒或墨索里尼的情况也大致如此。
en: The same is roughly true when Trump is compared to Hitler or Mussolini.

zh: 结果是我们太过容易被从现代煽动的真正危险中转移注意力。
en: As a result, we are too easily distracted from the real dangers of modern demagoguery.

zh: 毕竟，特朗普 — — 荷兰的威尔德斯、普京或杜特尔特 — — 反驳法西斯分子和纳粹的指责并非难事。
en: After all, it is not hard for Trump – or the Netherlands’ Geert Wilders, or Putin, or Duterte – to refute accusations of being fascists or Nazis.

zh: 他们或许令人生厌，但他们并未组织身穿制服的冲锋队、建立集中营或呼吁成立企业政府。
en: They may be repulsive, but they are not organizing uniformed storm troopers, building concentration camps, or calling for the corporate state.

zh: 普京离纳粹差距最小，但即使他也不是希特勒。
en: Putin comes closest, but even he is not Hitler.

zh: 当然，对于过去的健忘或无知所起作用是双向的。
en: Of course, forgetfulness or ignorance about the past goes both ways.

zh: 当同情新民粹主义浪潮的一位年轻的荷兰作家对国内的“文化精英们”表达反感，指责他们宣传“无调音乐”和其他狂妄的丑恶形式而排斥普通人认可的健康美时，我不禁奇怪他是否知道纳粹曾对“堕落的艺术”发起攻击。
en: When a young Dutch writer, sympathetic to the new populist wave, expressed antipathy to his country’s “cultural elite,” for promoting “atonal music” and other arrogant forms of ugliness, instead of the wholesome beauty embraced by the common man, I wondered whether he knew about the Nazis’ attack on “degenerate art”?

zh: 没有曲调的音乐今天已算不上多么前卫，而这恰恰是希特勒的下属们厌恶 — — 并且最终取缔的东西。
en: Atonal music, hardly the cutting edge today, was precisely the kind of thing that Hitler’s minions loathed – and ultimately banned.

zh: 在当代政治夸夸其谈中还有些东西反映了我们最黑暗的历史，这样的元素在短短几十年前还注定会将敢于犯禁的任何政治家推向边缘化的境地。
en: There are other echoes of our darkest history in contemporary political bombast, which a few decades ago would still have cast any politician who used it to the margins.

zh: 煽动对少数族裔的仇恨、怒斥记者、挑起群众反对知识分子、金融家或任何掌握不止一门语言者曾无法进入主流的政治思想，因为有足够多的人依然明白上述说法的危险性。
en: Stoking hatred of minorities, fulminating against the press, stirring up the mob against intellectuals, financiers, or anyone who speaks more than one language, were not part of mainstream politics, because enough people still understood the dangers of such talk.

zh: 很显然，今天的煽动者不太在乎他们以嘲笑的口吻所称谓的“政治正确 ” 。
en: It is clear that today's demagogues don’t much care about what they derisively call “political correctness.”

zh: 我们不太清楚他们是否有足够的历史常识，明白自己正在唤醒一个后二战一代希望已经死去、但现在我们知道只是休眠的魔鬼，直到遗忘过去可以让它重新醒过来。
en: It is less clear whether they have enough historical sense to know that they are poking a monster that post-World War II generations hoped was dead but that we now know only lay dormant, until obliviousness to the past could enable it to be reawakened.

zh: 我并不是说民粹主义者所说的一切都没有道理。
en: This is not to say that everything the populists say is untrue.

zh: 希特勒当时同样也正确指出了德国的大规模失业现象。
en: Hitler, too, was right to grasp that mass unemployment was a problem in Germany.

zh: 许多煽动者所恐惧的现象的确都值得批评：欧盟缺乏透明度、华尔街银行家贪婪狡诈、人们不愿直面大规模移民所造成的问题，以及对深受经济全球化伤害的人缺少关注。
en: Many of the agitators’ bugbears are indeed worthy of criticism: the European Union’s opacity, the duplicitousness and greed of Wall Street bankers, the reluctance to tackle problems caused by mass immigration, the lack of concern for those hurt by economic globalization.

zh: 这些问题主流政党一直不愿或无法解决。
en: These are all problems that mainstream political parties have been unwilling or unable to solve.

zh: 但当今天的民粹主义者开始指责是“精英阶层 ” （ 无论精英阶层指的是什么）和不受欢迎的种族或宗教少数族裔造成了这些困难，他们的看法与20世纪30年代自由民主政体的敌人听上去惊人的相似。
en: But when today’s populists start blaming “the elites,” whoever they may be, and unpopular ethnic or religious minorities, for these difficulties, they sound uncomfortably close to the enemies of liberal democracy in the 1930s.

zh: 谈论“背叛”是狭隘煽动者真正的特色。
en: The true mark of the illiberal demagogue is talk of “betrayal.”

zh: 国际化精英们在背后捅“我们”一刀；我们的前面是无底深渊；我们的文化正在遭受外国人的破坏；一旦我们消灭叛徒、不让他们在媒体上说话并团结“沉默的大多数”重振健康的国家肌体，我们的国家就可以再次复兴。
en: The cosmopolitan elites have stabbed “us” in the back; we are facing an abyss; our culture is being undermined by aliens; our nation can become great again once we eliminate the traitors, shut down their voices in the media, and unite the “silent majority” to revive the healthy national organism.

zh: 采用这种表达方式的政治家及其支持者或许不是法西斯主义者，但他们的论调却与真正的法西斯惊人的相似。
en: Politicians and their boosters who express themselves in this manner may not be fascists; but they certainly talk like them.

zh: 20世纪30年代的法西斯和纳粹并非空穴来风。
en: The fascists and Nazis of the 1930s did not come from nowhere.

zh: 他们的很多理念也不是原创的。
en: Their ideas were hardly original.

zh: 多年来，知识分子、活动人士、记者和神职人员不停地灌输仇恨理念，从而为墨索里尼、希特勒及其在其他国家的模仿者打下了基础。
en: For many years, intellectuals, activists, journalists, and clerics had articulated hateful ideas that laid the groundwork for Mussolini, Hitler, and their imitators in other countries.

zh: 其中有些是厌恶世俗主义和个人权利的天主教反对派。
en: Some were Catholic reactionaries who detested secularism and individual rights.

zh: 有些则沉湎于所谓的犹太人统治全球。
en: Some were obsessed with the supposed global domination of Jews.

zh: 还有些是寻找不可或缺的种族或国家精神的理想主义者。
en: Some were romantics in search of an essential racial or national spirit.

zh: 就算绝大多数现代煽动者知道这样的先例，他们的了解也大抵非常模糊。
en: Most modern demagogues may be only vaguely aware of these precedents, if they know of them at all.

zh: 在匈牙利这样的中欧国家、甚或是在法国，他们实际可能非常了解个中关系，而且今天某些极右翼政客毫不避讳地公然抨击犹太人。
en: In Central European countries like Hungary, or indeed in France, they may actually understand the links quite well, and some of today’s far-right politicians are not shy about being openly anti-Semitic.

zh: 但在多数西欧国家，煽动者利用对以色列毫不隐讳的钦佩作为某种托词，并将种族主义仇恨指向穆斯林民众。
en: In most West European countries, however, such agitators use their professed admiration for Israel as a kind of alibi, and direct their racism at Muslims.

zh: 语言和思想都能够产生后果。
en: Words and ideas have consequences.

zh: 将今天的民粹主义领袖与并不遥远过去那些无情的独裁者相提并论到现在为止还并不恰当。
en: Today’s populist leaders should not yet be compared to murderous dictators of the fairly recent past.

zh: 但通过利用相同的民众情绪，他们正在营造一种有毒的氛围，并有可能因此令政治暴力再次成为社会主流。
en: But, by exploiting the same popular sentiments, they are contributing to a poisonous climate, which could bring political violence into the mainstream once again.

zh: 民主党真的对美国经济更好吗？
en: Are Democrats Really Better for America’s Economy?

zh: 坎布里奇—近几个月来，希拉里·克林顿反复声称，在民主党入主白宫时，美国经济表现显著更好。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Hillary Clinton has repeatedly claimed in recent months that the US economy does much better when a Democrat is in the White House.

zh: 这话从推定民主党总统提名人口中说出来，可能显得有些像是政治伎俩。
en: Coming from the presumptive Democratic presidential nominee, that probably sounds like political spin.

zh: 但真相是她的话绝对正确。
en: But the truth is that she is absolutely right.

zh: 毫无疑问，总统只是决定经济的诸多因素之一，一些总统也显然比其他总统更加幸运。
en: The president, no doubt, is but one of many factors shaping the economy, and some presidents have certainly been luckier than others.
