en: By contrast, in services, where market size is limited by domestic demand, continued success requires complementary and simultaneous gains in productivity in the rest of the economy.

zh: 专注于少数部门无法产生快速的繁荣机会。
en: Focusing on a few sectors yields no quick winning opportunities.

zh: 因此，增长不得不依赖速度缓慢得多的全经济产能 — — 人力资本和制度的积累。
en: Growth therefore must rely on the much slower accumulation of economy-wide capabilities in the form of human capital and institutions.

zh: 因此，我对服务业推动模式是否能够带来制造业曾经带来的快速增长和好岗位仍然表示怀疑。
en: So I remain skeptical that a services-led model can deliver rapid growth and good jobs in the way that manufacturing once did.

zh: 即使技术乐观派是对的，也难以看出这是否能让发展中国家保持过去几十年来所经历的快速增长。
en: Even if the technological optimists are right, it is difficult to see how that will enable developing countries to sustain the kind of growth they experienced over the last couple of decades.

zh: “重启”与欧洲后院各国的关系
en: A “Reset” Button for Europe’s Backyard

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 按下外交关系“重启”按钮成了今天一种时髦的做法。
en: STOCKHOLM – One year after the war in Georgia of last August, pushing the “reset” button on diplomatic relations is a popular endeavor nowadays.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马总统刚刚出访莫斯科 ， “ 重启”紧张的美俄关系。
en: President Barack Obama recently journeyed to Moscow in order to “reset” strained United States-Russian ties.

zh: 尽管欧盟与东部邻国间的关系还没有紧张到需要“重启”的程度，但深层次的战略重建也在悄然进行中。
en: The European Union, though not in need of a “reset” because of strained ties with its eastern neighbors, is involved in a deep strategic reconstruction of those relations.

zh: 欧盟在五月启动新的“东部伙伴计划 ” ， 目的是促成与亚美尼亚、阿塞拜疆、白俄罗斯、格鲁吉亚、摩尔多瓦和乌克兰等六大东部邻国的进一步融合。
en: When the EU launched its new “Eastern Partnership” in May, the purpose was to promote further integration with the Union’s six immediate eastern neighbors – Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, and Ukraine.

zh: 在全球金融危机的背景下，迫切需要制定与欧盟东部邻国更新、也更有力的政策。
en: The global financial crisis had made an updated and strengthened policy for the EU’s eastern neighborhood an urgent need.

zh: 同样重要的是，所有相关国家都表达了向欧盟靠拢的愿望。
en: Equally important was the fact that all the countries concerned expressed an ambition to move closer to the EU.

zh: 东部伙伴计划起源于一次波兰/瑞典联合行动，该计划邀请六国在关键领域中深化和加强与欧盟的合作。
en: The Eastern Partnership – originating from a Polish/Swedish initiative – offers to the six countries a substantial upgrading and deepening of relations with the EU in key areas.

zh: 在贸易和经济关系领域，它明确提出了在欧盟和各伙伴国间建立全面深入自由贸易区的目标。
en: In trade and economic relations, it clearly sets out the objective of establishing deep and comprehensive free-trade areas between the EU and the partner countries.

zh: 它在远期致力于实现全面签证自由化（同时还签订了签证促进协议 ） ， 承诺加强在能源安全、多样化和效率方面的合作，并制定了专门的计划和项目，协助东部邻国在上述领域的融合和改革计划。
en: It confirms full visa liberalization as a long-term goal (with visa facilitation agreements in the meantime), promises enhanced cooperation on energy security, diversification, and efficiency, and comes with dedicated programs and projects to help the neighbors in their integration and reform efforts in all these areas.

zh: 瑞典本月担任欧盟轮值主席有助于推动这项计划。
en: Sweden’s assumption of the EU Presidency this month should help these efforts.

zh: 但此时正值欧盟东部邻国面临严重挑战的时刻，很多伙伴国都遭受了金融和经济危机的沉重打击。
en: However, it comes at a time when the Union’s eastern neighborhood faces severe challenges, with the financial and economic crisis hitting many of the partner countries hard.

zh: 全球需求和贸易的急剧下降打击了乌克兰，严重破坏了该国的钢铁工业。
en: Ukraine suffers from the sharp drop in global demand and trade, severely undermining its steel industry.

zh: 格鲁吉亚的经济成就在很大程度上得益于直接外资，但今天直接外资已经没有了进一步投资的胃口。
en: Georgia’s economic success has been largely dependent on direct foreign investment, for which there is hardly any appetite today.

zh: 在与全球市场融合度较低的伙伴国，比如摩尔多瓦，危机的到来相对缓慢，但实际效果却可能同样糟糕，而且它们可能会更晚复苏。
en: Partner countries that are less integrated into the global market, such as Moldova, have seen the crisis arrive more slowly, but the real effect might be equally as bad, and they are likely to recover more slowly.

zh: 东部伙伴关系并不能迅速弥补危机造成的后果。
en: The Eastern Partnership does not offer any quick remedies to the crisis.

zh: 但它却能提供政治框架和制度建设支持，逐步改善导致这些国家易受危机影响的弱点：不完善的市场经济、软弱无力的国家体制和持续腐败。
en: But it can provide a political framework and institution-building support to improve the deficiencies that made these countries so vulnerable to the crisis: imperfect market economies, weak state institutions, and continued corruption.

zh: 东部伙伴关系在贸易和能源等领域与欧盟深层次融合的提议伴随着极大的转型力量。
en: The Eastern Partnership’s offer of deep integration with the EU in the areas such as trade and energy carries with it considerable transformational power.

zh: 绝大多数伙伴国也在经历着一场政治危机。
en: The other type of crisis that most of the partner countries are enduring is political.

zh: 在多数国家中，民主发展还没有达到让政府改变成为政治生活中的常规组成部分、可以在不威胁国家稳定的情况下悄然进行的程度。
en: In most of these countries, democratic development has not yet reached a point where a change in government is a routine part of political life and can take place without risking the country’s stability.

zh: 民主价值观、人权和法治是东部伙伴关系赖以建立的基础。
en: The Eastern Partnership is based on the profound values of democracy, human rights, and the rule of law.

zh: 与欧盟的政治结合，以及在伙伴关系下的融合进程将推动上述关键领域的改革。
en: Political association with the EU, and the process of integration under this Partnership, will promote reforms in these key areas.

zh: 瑞典任欧盟轮值主席将启动具体工作 — — 也就是伙伴关系的基本要素。
en: The Swedish EU Presidency will concentrate on starting up the concrete work – the nuts and bolts – of the Partnership.

zh: 旨在支持各伙伴国关键制度改革的“综合制度建设计划”应在年底前正式启动。
en: The establishment of “Comprehensive Institution-Building Programs,” designed to support reform of key institutions in each partner country, should take place before the year’s end.

zh: 欧盟委员会拟议中的某些旗舰计划也将最终问世，同时有可能制定新的项目和计划。
en: Some flagship initiatives proposed by the European Commission will finally see the light of day as well, and new projects and initiatives are likely to be developed.

zh: 瑞典将特别关注能效计划，因为类似计划不仅能改善能源安全，降低成本，而且能为应对气候变化做出重要贡献。
en: Here, Sweden will attach particular importance to energy efficiency programs, which will serve not only the purposes of enhancing energy security and reducing costs, but will also be an important contribution to the fight against climate change.

zh: 轮值主席瑞典和欧盟委员会一道，力图在今年秋组织召开东部伙伴关系民主社会论坛的首次会议。
en: The Swedish Presidency, together with the European Commission, intends to organize the first meeting of the Eastern Partnership Civil Society Forum this autumn.

zh: 我们希望启动议会合作，以及三十二个欧盟及伙伴国地方和区域当局的合作。
en: We hope to see the start of parliamentary cooperation, as well as exchanges between local and regional authorities of the thirty-three EU and partner countries.

zh: 今年年底，欧盟各国及六大伙伴国外长会议将评估迄今为止取得的进展，并进一步指导今后的行动。
en: At the end of the year, a meeting of EU foreign ministers and their colleagues from the six partners will assess the progress made so far and give guidance on the way ahead.

zh: 东部伙伴关系旨在推动欧盟融合，让六国贴近欧盟的价值观、法律和工作方式，并让欧盟支持和协助这种融合。
en: The Eastern Partnership is about EU integration, about the six countries moving closer to the EU’s values, legislation, and ways of working, and about the EU being there to support and help this convergence.

zh: 俄国有时会出现这样的看法，认为这种合作关系是与它作对。
en: In Russia, there is a perception that is sometimes fostered which suggests that the Partnership is directed against it.

zh: 但这当然是没有依据的。
en: But this, of course, is untrue.

zh: 相反，和土耳其一样，我们也欢迎俄国参与伙伴关系多边领域的相关活动。
en: On the contrary, Russia, like Turkey, will be welcome to take part in relevant activities within the Partnership’s multilateral dimensions.

zh: 东部伙伴关系无法解决六大伙伴国所面临的所有问题和困难。
en: The Eastern Partnership is not an answer to all the problems and difficulties that the six partners are facing.

zh: 但它的确代表了欧盟从政治经济各个领域支持其转型和改革的明确承诺 — — 这一进程理应为整个地区带来繁荣和稳定。
en: Nevertheless, it does represent a clear commitment by the EU to lend its political and economic support to their transition and reform – a process that should bring prosperity and stability to the whole region.

zh: 沙特人到底算不算狂热份子？
en: Are the Saudis Fanatics?

zh: 恐怖袭击不仅让很多人对沙特政府的生存前景产生了疑虑，甚至催生了这样的观点：沙特王国本身是否运转不良，成了一个破坏性的国家。
en: Terrorist attacks in Saudi Arabia have led many to question not only the ruling House of Saud's prospects for survival, but also whether the kingdom is fundamentally dysfunctional and destructive.

zh: 看起来，暴力狂热的逆流似乎在沙特社会中蔓延，而这股逆流的根源就是极端正统的宗教观念。
en: Somehow, it seems, Saudi society has produced a stream of violent fanaticism that draws its inspiration from extreme religious orthodoxy.

zh: 2001年9月11日袭击美国的19名劫机者中，居然有15名来自沙特。 这一事实使长久以来就存在的一种看法渐趋明朗：即沙特是独裁主义和极端观点的大本营。
en: The fact that 15 of the 19 hijackers in the September 11, 2001, attacks on the United States were Saudis crystallized a long-held view of the kingdom as a bastion of authoritarianism and intolerance.

zh: 某种程度上，上述观点并没有说错，但用来形容广大的沙特公众却并不合适。
en: In some respects, this perception is accurate, but it cannot be applied to the broad Saudi public.

zh: 恰恰相反，如果认为伊斯兰狂热主义界定了沙特宗教观念的全部内涵，那就犯下了极为严重的错误。
en: On the contrary, it would be a grave mistake to assume that fanatical Islamism fully defines Saudi attitudes toward religion.

zh: 2001到2003年间，我曾作为调研小组的一员，广泛调查了沙特阿拉伯、埃及、伊朗和约旦等国的价值观。
en: Between 2001 and 2003, I was part of a team that undertook an extensive survey of values in Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Iran, and Jordan.

zh: 调查的结果显示：沙特人的观点与人们的传统看法间有着很大的不同。
en: Our results provide a surprisingly nuanced picture of Saudi attitudes.

zh: 与其它中东国家的答卷者相比，沙特人总体上没那么信奉宗教，他们对民主和包办婚姻的看法也显示出一股涌动的暗流。
en: Compared to respondents in the other Middle Eastern countries, Saudis were less religious overall, and their attitudes toward democracy and arranged marriage also indicate a moderate undercurrent.

zh: 可以肯定的是，所有四个国家的宗教信仰都十分普遍，90%以上的受试者认为自己信奉神明、相信后世生活、也相信天堂和地狱。
en: To be sure, in all four countries, religiosity is widespread, with more than 90% of respondents collectively reporting that they believe in God, in life after death, and in heaven and hell.

zh: 但和其它穆斯林伙伴相比，沙特人似乎并没有那么虔诚。
en: But the Saudis appear to be less religious than their fellow Muslims.

zh: 62%的沙特人认为自己笃信神明，而在伊朗、约旦和埃及，这一比率分别为82 % 、 85%和98 % 。
en: Sixty-two percent of Saudis described themselves as religious, compared with 82% of Iranians, 85% of Jordanians, and 98% of Egyptians.

zh: 美国人好像也比沙特人虔诚得多，有81%的受试者都这么描述自己。
en: Americans also appear to be far more religious than Saudis, with 81% describing themselves that way.

zh: 有些不同源于不同国家对虔诚的不同理解，像美国人对虔诚的看法可能与中东人不同，他们并不像伊斯兰信徒那样强调对宗教的信仰。
en: Some of this variation may be explained by cross-national differences regarding what it means to be religious. For example, Americans may define religiosity differently than Middle Easterners, with perhaps a weaker attachment to religious beliefs than is true in Islamic countries.

zh: 上述原因也可以部分解释穆斯林国家之间的不同。
en: This might also account in part for the differences between Muslim countries.

zh: 但沙特人与伊朗人、约旦人和埃及人之间自我描述的虔诚程度相差如此之大，以致于对沙特阿拉伯作为高度保守和宗教社会的传统看法都构成了挑战。
en: But the gap in self-defined religiosity between Saudis, on the one hand, and Iranians, Jordanians, and Egyptians, on the other, is so great that it challenges the prevalent perception of Saudi Arabia as a highly conservative and religious society.

zh: 实际上，听其言不如观其行：只有28%的沙特人说自己参加每周的宗教仪式，而在伊朗、约旦和埃及，这一比率分别达到了27 % 、 44%和42 % ， 美国人的比例则是45 % 。
en: Indeed, actions speak louder than words: only 28% of Saudis said that they participate in weekly religious services, compared to 27% of Iranians, 44% of Jordanians, 42% of Egyptians, and 45% of Americans.

zh: 上述发现虽然与人们对沙特文化的普遍印象大相庭径，但实际结果却并不那么令人惊讶。
en: These findings, while running contrary to popular perceptions of Saudi culture, are less startling than they appear.

zh: 宗教社会学者早就指出：在奉行单一宗教、或宗教机构与国家联系非常紧密的环境里，公众的总体虔诚度会有所下降。
en: Sociologists of religion have long argued that in a monolithic religious environment, or when religious institutions are closely tied to the state, the overall religiosity of the public declines.

zh: 因此，有人认为由于国家当局执行了严格的行为准则，让人们产生了逆反心理，进而不再支持官方认可的宗教机构，这种看法也有它自己的道理。
en: It makes sense to think that when state authorities enforce strict codes of behavior, people tend to rebel and move away from officially sanctioned religious institutions.

zh: 因此，生活在不强制信奉宗教国度里的埃及人和约旦人，比不得不小心提防有国家撑腰的"操守警察"的沙特人或伊朗人，总的来讲表现出更多的虔诚，也没有什么值得大惊小怪的。
en: Little wonder, then, that Egyptians and Jordanians, who live in countries where the state does not enforce piety, are more religious than Iranians or Saudis, who must cope with local "virtue" police backed by the state.

zh: 即便在婚姻问题上，很多沙特人的观点之开放也令人震惊。
en: Even on marriage, many Saudis expressed surprisingly liberal views.

zh: 包办婚姻问题上，受试者几乎是一半一半，半数人认为婚姻理应遵从父母之命，另外48%则认为爱情才是婚姻的基础。
en: Respondents were nearly evenly split on the question of arranged marriages, with half supporting the idea that marriage should be based on parental consent, while 48% preferred love as the basis of matrimony.

zh: 在顽固的性别隔离和父权至上的环境下，这项发现似乎显示了传统的家庭决策中，对更多个人自由的非常强烈的向往。
en: Given entrenched gender segregation and paternal dominance, this finding appears to reveal a strong desire for greater individual choice in what has traditionally been a family-driven decision.

zh: 最后，结果还显示沙特人强烈支持民主，这再次与沙特保守主义的普遍看法形成了冲突。
en: Finally, the Saudis turn out to be strong supporters of democracy, once again contradicting a popular image of Saudi conservatism.

zh: 在被调查的沙特人中，58%认为民主是政府的最佳形式，23%不同意这样的观点，还有18%的人没表明态度。
en: Of the Saudis polled, 58% considered democracy the best form of government, 23% disagreed, and 18% did not express an opinion.

zh: 在沙特这样一个缺乏现实和历史背景的国家，民主获得了大多数人的支持似乎有点违背常识。
en: Majority support for democracy in a country with no prior secular and nationalist history seems counter-intuitive.

zh: 但事实上，支持民主与我们在沙特找到的其它几种自由观点非常吻合。
en: In fact, support for democracy corresponds with a number of other liberal attitudes that we found in Saudi Arabia.

zh: 民主支持者没有那么笃信宗教、更能够融入世俗，也更能够容忍他人。 他们对公共部门的表现更为挑剔，对西方文化的入侵也给予了更多的关注。
en: Supporters of democracy tend to be less religious, more secular, more tolerant of others, more critical of public-sector performance, and more concerned with Western cultural invasion.

zh: 除调查数据外，历史经验还显示：当专制君主与宗教设施联手统治时，自由的意愿会变得更为强烈。
en: Beyond the survey data, history has shown that liberal ideas become more popular when a despotic monarch governs people in alliance with a religious establishment.

zh: 在奥斯曼叙利亚帝国，苏丹阿布都哈米特的宗教专制使19世纪后期出现了强烈的自由主义思潮。
en: A strong current of liberalism appeared in the late nineteenth century in Ottoman Syria in response to the religious despotism of Sultan Abdulhamid.

zh: 与此同时，代表立宪主义的反神职世俗运动也在伊朗愈演愈烈－这项运动是对伊朗王Quajar和宗教机构专制主义联合的有力回击��
en: At the same time, an anti-clerical, secular movement on behalf of constitutionalism appeared in Iran - a reaction to the absolutist alliance between the Quajar Shahs and the religious establishment.

zh: 有了与沙特阿拉伯目前状况十分相似的历史先例，我们无法排除改革的可能。
en: In view of the similarities between those historical precedents and current conditions in Saudi Arabia, we ought not to rule out the possibility of reform.

zh: 现在，调查结果也表明：沙特人很可能开始要求更为透明的政治和干涉性不那么强的宗教。
en: Now survey data, too, suggest that Saudis may well begin demanding a more transparent politics and a less interventionist religion.

zh: 美国中产阶级收入真的在停滞吗？
en: Are US Middle-Class Incomes Really Stagnating?

zh: 美国剑桥—提高中产阶级家庭收入的挑战已成为美国总统选战的重要焦点。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The challenge of raising the incomes of middle-class families has emerged as an important focus of the presidential election campaign in the United States.

zh: 所有人都同意，得益于高科技教育和股价攀升带来的巨大收益，顶层人群的收入几十年来可谓狂飙突进。
en: Everyone agrees that incomes at the top have surged ahead in recent decades, helped by soaring rewards for those with a high-tech education and rising share prices.

zh: 改进帮助那些陷入贫穷之人的计划 — — 如食品券和基于经济调查的退休金 — — 也得到了总体支持。
en: And there is general support for improving programs – such as food stamps and means-tested retiree benefits – that help those who would otherwise be poor.

zh: 但公共争论的重点集中在如何帮助数量更加庞大（在政治上也更加重要）的中产阶级。
en: But the public debate is largely about how to help the more numerous (and politically more important) middle class.

zh: 在这方面，改进现有政府计划可以带来很大的助益：扩大贴近市场的培训、增加已婚妇女加入或回归劳动力大军的机会、降低社会保障规则中对继续聘用年长工人的惩罚条款、改变税收规则以提高生产率和工资等。
en: Here, much can be done by improving existing government programs: expanding market-relevant training, increasing opportunities for married women to join or rejoin the labor force, reducing the penalties in Social Security rules for continued employment by older workers, and changing tax rules in ways that will increase productivity and wages.

zh: 但是，尽管加强这些计划应该作为重点，但也不能忽视中产阶级家庭在过去几十年中的实际表现。
en: But, while strengthening such programs should be a high priority, we should not lose sight of how well middle-income families have actually done over the past few decades.

zh: 不幸的是，政治争论被误导性的统计数字所扭曲，这些数字从总体上低估了中产阶级家庭的得益。
en: Unfortunately, the political debate is distorted by misleading statistics that grossly understate these gains.

zh: 比如，人们常说，过去几十年来平均家庭收入增长十分缓慢（甚至停滞不前 ） 。
en: For example, it is frequently said that the average household income has risen only slightly, or not at all, for the past few decades.

zh: 一些美国人口普查数字似乎支持这一结论。
en: Some US Census figures seem to support that conclusion.

zh: 但更准确的政府数据表明，位于收入分布中端的家庭的实际收入自1980年以来增加了大约50 % 。
en: But more accurate government statistics imply that the real incomes of those at the middle of the income distribution have increased about 50% since 1980.

zh: 如果针对生活成本进行更合适的调整，那么中产阶级的的收益还会大大提高。
en: And a more appropriate adjustment for changes in the cost of living implies a substantially greater gain.

zh: 美国人口普查局测算家庭所有来源的总货币收入，并确定区别收入分布前50%和后50%的分界线。
en: The US Census Bureau estimates the money income that households receive from all sources and identifies the income level that divides the top and bottom halves of the distribution.

zh: 这就是中位家庭收入。
en: This is the median household income.

zh: 为了比较不同时间的中位家庭收入，当局将这些年收入的美元价值除以消费物价指数，得到实际中位家庭收入。
en: To compare median household incomes over time, the authorities divide these annual dollar values by the consumer price index to create annual real median household incomes.

zh: 这样获得的数字表明，从1984年到2013年的收入累计增长还不到10 % ， 相当于每年增长不到0.3 % 。
en: The resulting numbers imply that the cumulative increase from 1984 through 2013 was less than 10%, equivalent to less than 0.3% per year.

zh: 任何在此期间内生活在美国的成年人都会认识到，这个数字总体低估了普通家庭的收益。
en: Any adult who was alive in the US during these three decades realizes that this number grossly understates the gains of the typical household.

zh: 表明这一数字存在问题的一个指标是政府还估算非农商业部门雇员实际时薪从1985年到2015年提高了39 % 。
en: One indication that something is wrong with this figure is that the government also estimates that real hourly compensation of employees in the non-farm business sector rose 39% from 1985 to 2015.

zh: 官方人口普查测算存在三个重要问题。
en: The official Census estimate suffers from three important problems.

zh: 首先，它没有认识到人口组成的改变；今天的家庭与30年前的家庭区别很大。
en: For starters, it fails to recognize the changing composition of the population; the household of today is quite different from the household of 30 years ago.

zh: 此外，人口普查局的收入测算口径过窄，中产阶级家庭不但收到越来越多的政府转移支付，也从所得税率的降低中获益。
en: Moreover, the Census Bureau’s estimate of income is too narrow, given that middle-income families have received increasing government transfers while benefiting from lower income-tax rates.

zh: 最后，人口普查局所使用的物价指数没有体现新产品和产品改进对美国生活水平提高的重要贡献。
en: Finally, the price index used by the Census Bureau fails to capture the important contributions of new products and product improvements to Americans’ standard of living.

zh: 先来看家庭组成的变化。
en: Consider first the changing nature of households.

zh: 从1980年到2010年，有单身男女组成的“家庭”比例从26%增加到33 % ， 而包括成婚夫妇的家庭比例从60%下降到50 % 。
en: From 1980 to 2010, the share of “households” that consisted of just a single man or woman rose from 26% to 33%, while the share that contained married couples declined from 60% to 50%.

zh: 无党派的国会预算办公室（CBO）在进行1979—2011年间家庭收入变化的详细研究时，将收入的定义进行了扩展，食品券等非现金福利和医疗等实物福利也被计算在内。
en: When the nonpartisan Congressional Budget Office (CBO) conducted a detailed study of changes in household incomes from 1979 to 2011, it expanded the definition of income to include near-cash benefits like food stamps and in-kind benefits like health care.

zh: 该研究还扣除了联邦税，而联邦税占中产阶级家庭税前收入的比例1980年为19 % ， 2010年降至11.5 % 。
en: It also subtracted federal taxes, which fell from 19% of pretax income for middle-income households in 1980 to just 11.5% in 2010.

zh: 为了将年收入换算为实际收入，CBO使用了消费支出物价平减指数，许多人认为，在换算实际收入中，该指标优于消费物价指数。
en: To convert annual incomes to real incomes, the CBO used the price deflator for consumer expenditures, which many believe is better for this purpose than the consumer price index.

zh: CBO还单独进行了经家庭规模调整的分析。
en: The CBO also presented a separate analysis that adjusted for household size.

zh: 从传统货币收入定义出发，CBO发现实际中位家庭收入在1980—2010年间仅仅增加了15 % ， 与人口普查局的测算相当。
en: With the traditional definition of money income, the CBO found that real median household income rose by just 15% from 1980 to 2010, similar to the Census Bureau’s estimate.

zh: 但若把收入的定义扩大，将减税的收益包括进来时，CBO发现中位家庭实际收入增加了45 % 。
en: But when they expanded the definition of income to include benefits and subtracted taxes, they found that the median household’s real income rose by 45%.

zh: 经家庭规模调整的分析将这一收益进一步提高到53 % 。
en: Adjusting for household size boosted this gain to 53%.

zh: 而即使是这一大大提高了的增幅，也可能大大低估了实际生活水平的提高。
en: And, again, even this more substantial rise probably represents a substantial underestimate of the increase in the real standard of living.

zh: 在有关部门的测算中，美元收入通过一个反映现有商品和服务价格变化的物价指数换算为实际收入指标。
en: The authorities arrive at their estimates by converting dollar incomes into a measure of real income by using a price index that reflects the changes in the prices of existing goods and services.

zh: 但这一物价指数没有反映新产品或已有商品和服务的改进。
en: But that price index does not reflect new products or improvements to existing goods and services.

zh: 因此，如果所有人的货币收入较一年前增加了2 % ， 而所有商品和服务的价格也上涨了2 % ， 则官方测算将表明实际收入没有变化，即使新产品和重要质量改进增加了我们的福利。
en: Thus, if everyone’s money incomes rose by 2% from one year to the next, while the prices of all goods and services also rose by 2%, the official calculation would show no change in real incomes, even if new products and important quality improvements contributed to our wellbeing.

zh: 事实上，美国政府根本没有将谷歌和Facebook等互联网服务所创造的价值计算在内，因为这些服务没有被购买。
en: Indeed, the US government does not count the value created by Internet services like Google and Facebook as income at all, because these services are not purchased.

zh: 没人知道这些产品创新和改进给我们增加了多少福利。
en: No one knows how much such product innovations and improvements have added to our wellbeing.

zh: 但假设这些收益只相当于每年1 % ， 过去三十年累计下来也能造成35%的增长。
en: But if the gains have been worth just 1% a year, over the past 30 years that would cumulate to a gain of 35%.

zh: 将这个数字与CBO所测算的50%左右的收益相加，意味着实际中位家庭收入在过去30年的年增长率接近2.5 % 。
en: And combining that with the CBO estimate of a gain of about 50% would imply that the real income of the median household is up nearly 2.5% a year over the past 30 years.

zh: 因此美国中产阶级的表现比统计悲观派所认为的要好得多。
en: So the US middle class has been doing much better than the statistical pessimists assert.

zh: 而如果有更好的政策，这些家庭未来还会做得更好。
en: And with better policies, these households can do even better in the future.

zh: 五年的时间让我们更睿智了吗？
en: Are We Five Years Wiser?

zh: 在2001年9•11事件的五周年纪念日即将到来之际 ， “ 基地 ” （ al-Qaeda）针对美国的新的攻击也在临近。 我们应该借此机会来评估一下美国和国际社会对此的反应。
en: As the fifth anniversary of the September 11, 2001, attacks on the United States by al-Qaeda approaches, we should take the opportunity to assess the results of the response by the US and the international community.

zh: 这些攻击及其激发的反应已经造成了国际关系的突变，但我们却没有理由认为进一步的暴行发生的可能性较小。
en: The attacks and the response to them have obviously brought about a sea change in international relations, but it would be difficult to argue that further atrocities have become less likely as a result.

zh: 为什么我们现在的安全感并不比五年前有所增强呢？
en: Why are we no more secure than we were five years ago?

zh: 在袭击发生后的一周内，布什总统就宣布进行一场“反恐战争 ” 。
en: Within a week of the attacks, President George W. Bush declared a “war on terrorism.”

zh: 战争比喻的一个独特优势就是清楚而又强有力地引发美国所需要的猛烈反击。
en: The metaphor of war has the singular advantage that it clearly and strongly evokes the intensity of the counterattack that was called for.

zh: 另外，战争的比喻对于积极动员还有潜移默化的推动作用，而动员的对象不仅是遭受袭击的国家，还包括其盟友。
en: Moreover, the metaphor of war constitutes an implicit appeal to intense mobilization, not only by a country that comes under attack, but also by its friends and allies.

zh: 当然，没人会质疑美国捍卫自己的权利。
en: Naturally, no one questions America’s right to defend itself.

zh: 暴力反击的合法性从来就未被怀疑。
en: The legitimacy of a violent counterattack has never been in doubt.

zh: 但战争的比喻也有一个不可避免的内涵，即当被用于恐怖主义时，它具有误导性并且结果适得其反。
en: But the war metaphor also carries inevitable connotations that, when applied to terrorism, are misleading and counterproductive.

zh: 当我们诉诸战争时，它意味着一场针对民族、人民或国家的战斗。
en: Whenever war is invoked, it implies a fight against nations, peoples, or states.

zh: 它意味着整片领土和定居其上的人口都被认为是敌对方。
en: It implies that whole territories and the populations living there are to be considered hostile.

zh: 战争意味着不一定为人了解但却是公认的军队和指挥架构；在任何情况下，战争都必然需要与可识别敌方的军事对抗。
en: War implies armies and command structures that can be recognized, if not clearly known; in any case, war entails a military confrontation with an identifiable adversary .

zh: 在所有这几点上，战争的该概念，用美国国防部长拉姆斯菲尔德的话来讲，都是无益的。
en: On all of these points, the concept of war, to paraphrase US Defense Secretary Donald Rumsfeld, is not helpful.

zh: 即便是如9•11这样规模的，只有美国军方似乎才能够应对的挑战—在技术层面上，对付这种来自外国的，而不是国际的威胁应该使用警方专长而不是军事策略。
en: Even if the scale of the September 11 attack was of such a dimension that only the American army seemed able to face the challenge, in technical terms dealing with a threat that is extra-national rather than international is a matter of police techniques, not military tactics.

zh: 这种错误愿景所带来的消极后果很快便显现出来。
en: The negative consequences of this mistaken vision very quickly became apparent.

zh: 现在一个广为人知的事实就是美国政府很可能无意识地（在一定程度上）接受了“基地”是一个有着严密指挥体系的，等级森严的恐怖组织的形象—这正是一个美国军队可以攻击并摧毁的敌人原型。
en: It is now widely known that the US government, perhaps partly unconsciously, embraced a deeply distorted image of al-Qaeda that portrayed it as a hierarchical organization with a seamless command structure – the prototype of a foe that the American army could attack and destroy.

zh: 但al-Qaeda—这个词的意思是“基地”或“营地 ” ， 也就是说它仅仅是一个让人集中并受训的地点—更像是一个令人琢磨不透的影响力圈，其主要构成是个体成员和许多自行其是，除了大规模行动外，极少合作的小型本地基层组织。
en: But al-Qaeda – the word means “the base” or “the camp,” that is, nothing more or less than a point of gathering and training – is more like a blurred sphere of influence, comprising individuals and small local cells that act on their own initiative and cooperate very rarely, and only for large-scale operations.

zh: 至今没有证据表明“9•11”阴谋之后的若干年里发生在伦敦、马德里或巴厘岛的恐怖袭击，或在2000年对美国军舰“柯尔号”发动的袭击，反映了一个协调行动或下达行动指令的“中心”的存在。
en: It has not been proved that the attacks in London, Madrid, or Bali in the years since the September 11 plot, or the attack on America’s warship the USS Cole in 2000, reflected the existence of a “center” that coordinated the operations or gave orders to carry them out.

zh: 将伊斯兰恐怖主义与巴斯克人的“埃塔”组织（ETA ） 、 斯里兰卡的泰米尔猛虎组织或爱尔兰共和军混为一谈也是错误的。
en: It is also wrong to conflate Islamic terrorism with that of the Basque ETA, Sri Lanka’s Tamil Tigers, or the Irish Republican Army.

zh: 这些组织都有一个地区性的基地，并专注于民族目标的实现，而伊斯兰恐怖主义却似乎是由一小撮试图为穆斯林世界在若干世纪以来由于殖民化、经济发展缺失和政治羸弱所造成的“屈辱”实施报复而来。
en: Whereas these groups have a territorial base and are preoccupied with national aims, Islamic terrorism appears to be the work of a very small number of individuals who seek to avenge the centuries-long “humiliation” of the Muslim world, brought about by colonization, absence of economic development, and political weakness.

zh: 伊斯兰恐怖分子的目标无外乎就是摧毁西方世界的“霸权 ” 。 尽管许多穆斯林国家都希望与国际社会和平共处并在缔造有效的发展战略方面进行合作。
en: The goal of Islamic terrorists is nothing less than the destruction of the “hegemonic” Western world, despite most Muslim nations’ desire to live in peace within the international community and to cooperate in crafting effective development strategies.

zh: 对抗伊斯兰恐怖主义威胁最可行的战略曾是，也将继续是以相互合作的方式寻求广大穆斯林中、穆斯林国家领导人中的一致性。 这其中包括警方之间的合作，这是孤立、削弱或消灭他们中的武装分子所必需的。
en: The only viable strategy for confronting the threat of Islamic terrorism was, and continues to be, a search for agreement among Muslims, and among the leaders of Muslim nations, on the forms of mutual cooperation, including police cooperation, that are needed to isolate, weaken, or destroy the militants in their midst.

zh: 这是一项漫长而艰难的事业，但我们别无选择。
en: This is a long and difficult enterprise, but there remains no alternative.

zh: 可现实中，战争的比喻继续阐释着美国及其几个盟国的反应。
en: Instead, the war metaphor continues to define the US response and that of several of America’s allies.

zh: 这一比喻的吸引力可能应该归结到美国人不仅对其军队（这一点可以理解 ） ， 还对广义上的武力的过度信赖。 而后一点着实令人对这个富于智慧的民族感到费解。
en: The attraction of this metaphor may be attributable to the excessive trust that Americans place not only in their army, which is understandable, but in force in general, which is much less understandable in the case of an intelligent people.

zh: 不论在什么情况下，对恐怖主义宣战使得美国的政策制定者们加倍实施暴力的军事行动。 这种做法绝对不可能赢得穆斯林世界的人心，反而会令事与愿违。
en: Whatever the case, casting the fight against terrorism as a war has led American policymakers to multiply violent military operations that have absolutely no chance of winning hearts and minds in the Muslim world.

zh: 阿富汗是军事反应可以让人理解的唯一案例：其政府毕竟给了“基地”一个暂时的驻扎地。
en: Afghanistan was the only case where a military response was understandable: its government had, after all, given al-Qaeda a temporary territorial home.

zh: 但将与“基地”或9.11恐怖袭击全无瓜葛的伊拉克牵扯进来就大错特错了。 这一错误强化了伊斯兰极端分子的实力并很可能为其招募恐怖分子助了一臂之力。
en: But to implicate Iraq, which had nothing to do with al-Qaeda or the September 11 attacks, was a huge mistake, one that has strengthened Islamic extremists and has probably helped them recruit terrorists.

zh: 另外，美国的反应也��化了以色列对军事解决方式有效性的信心，从而导致了最近的黎巴嫩战争和对加沙的入侵。
en: Moreover, the US response has strengthened Israel’s belief in the effectiveness of military methods, leading to the recent war in Lebanon and the ongoing invasion of Gaza.

zh: 国际社会对此束手无策。
en: Powerless, the international community does nothing.

zh: 美国行动的僵化和残暴—造成的平民死亡人数比9.11袭击中高出许多倍—阻碍了阿尔及利亚、摩洛哥、约旦、沙特或阿联酋等国进行任何有益的干预。
en: The rigidity and brutality of America’s behavior – resulting in many times more civilian deaths than occurred on September 11 – have blocked any useful intervention by countries such as Algeria, Morocco, Jordan, Saudi Arabia, or the United Arab Emirates.

zh: 同样，战争的诉求也排除了以色列、叙利亚和黎巴嫩之间进行严肃谈判的前景。
en: Likewise, the appeal of war has ruled out the prospect of serious negotiations between Israel, Syria, and Lebanon.

zh: 由于一个接一个地攻击穆斯林国家，美国及其盟友给世界造成了这样一种印象，即伊斯兰教本身是他们的敌人，从而无情地导致美国口口声声想要避免的“文明的冲突 ” 。
en: By attacking one Muslim country after another, the US and its allies have created the impression that Islam itself is the enemy, leading inexorably to the “clash of civilizations” that America says it wants to avoid.

zh: 但美国的战略失败了。
en: But America’s strategy has failed.

zh: 武力不是万能的。
en: Force cannot accomplish everything.

zh: 国际社会必须明确表示伊斯兰教不是我们的敌人，抗击恐怖主义应该采取其他的方式。
en: The international community must say clearly that Islam is not our enemy and that terrorism must be fought in other ways.

zh: 而穆斯林的政治领导人们应该同样公开宣布恐怖主义不是他们的选择。
en: Muslim political leaders, for their part, should declare just as openly that terrorism is not their choice.

zh: 如果双方都能遏制杀人心态，那么文化和政治和解的希望就会重生。
en: If both sides can stifle their murderous deviances, the hope of cultural and political reconciliation will be reborn.

zh: 我们正（又一次）陷入石油危机吗？
en: Are We Running Out of Oil (Again)?

zh: 石油价格正快速攀升，远超过每桶50美元。 其部分原因是由于伊拉克冲突、尼日利亚劳资纠纷、俄罗斯政府和尤科斯石油公司之间的冲突以及最近飓风袭击佛罗里达所带来的短期石油供应震荡。
en: Oil prices are now running well above $50 a barrel, partly owing to short-run supply shocks, such as the Iraq conflict, Nigerian labor disputes, the conflict between Yukos Oil and the Russian government, and Florida's recent hurricanes.

zh: 一旦这些震荡因素消失以后，石油价格可能回落，但投机因素可能会使其保持在相对的高位，从而给世界经济和股票市场带来不利影响。
en: Oil prices may fall once these shocks dissipate, but speculative effects could keep them relatively high, weakening the world economy and depressing stock markets.

zh: 由于会引发社会反应，所以即使是暂时的油价飙升也可能会造成长期的后果。
en: Even a temporary spike in oil prices can have long-term effects because of the social reactions they provoke.

zh: 高昂的石油价格促使公众就未来的油价进行讨论。
en: High oil prices fuel public discussion about the future of oil prices.

zh: 任何一场公众讨论都不会产生一个明确的结论，但却有可能夸大那些暗示更高的石油价格所带来的风险的传闻。
en: The outcome of any public discussion can never be known with certainty, but chances are that it will amplify stories that imply risks of higher oil prices.

zh: 专家们或许会说最近的价格上涨是由于供给因素引起的，但价格的上涨无疑会给更骇人的长期传闻增加可信度。
en: Experts may say that short-run supply factors caused the recent price increases, but the price increases will nonetheless lend credibility to scarier long-term stories.

zh: 现时正被夸大的一个耸人传闻事关发展中国家，特别是经济飞速发展的中国和印度。 由于没有加入《京都议定书》对废气排放进行限制，两国都被看作是正在引起对石油的不可满足的需求。
en: The scary story that is being amplified now concerns the developing world, notably China and India, where rapid economic growth - and no restrictions on emissions under the Kyoto Protocol - are seen as creating insatiable demands for oil.

zh: 这一传闻的假定是：随着上述两国亿万人追逐大房子和跑车的梦想，我们会比预想更快地耗尽我们的石油资源。
en: The story's premise is that the world will run out of oil faster than we thought, as these billions of people chase their dreams of big houses and sport utility vehicles.

zh: 这样的假设有根据吗？
en: Is this plausible?

zh: 诚然，中国、印度和其他一些新兴国家正飞速发展。
en: Certainly, China, India, and some other emerging countries are developing fast.

zh: 但专家们发现很难确定这种发展形势对能源市场的长期影响。
en: But experts find it difficult to specify the long-run implications of this for the energy market.

zh: 许多因素仍然模糊：这些国家能源需求的增长率、新油田的发现、节油技术的发展和石油最终被其他能源所代替。
en: Too many factors remain fuzzy: the rate of growth of these countries' energy demand, discoveries of new oil reserves, developments in oil-saving technology, and the ultimate replacement of oil by other energy sources.

zh: 但就现在和可预见的将来而言，与油价相关的是人们对这一传闻的理解，而非其背后的不确定因素。
en: But what matters for oil prices now and in the foreseeable future is the perception of the story, not the ambiguities behind it.

zh: 如果人们认为未来的油价会更高，那么现在的油价也会相应更高。
en: If there is a perception that prices will be higher in the future, then prices will tend to be higher today.

zh: 这就是市场运作的规律。
en: That is how markets work.

zh: 如果人们总体上认为未来的石油价格会更高，那么油田的所有者就会推延在开发和扩大产能方面的巨额投资，而且还可能将石油产量压制在生产能力之下。
en: If it is generally thought that oil prices will be higher in the future, owners of oil reserves will tend to postpone costly investments in exploration and expansion of production capacity, and they may pump oil at below capacity.

zh: 他们宁愿在油价更高时才售油和投资，所以会遏制石油供应量的增长。
en: They would rather sell their oil and invest later, when prices are higher, so they restrain increases in supply.

zh: 这些预期成为可以自然实现的结果，油价上涨，投机的泡沫随之出现。
en: Expectations become self-fulfilling, oil prices rise, a speculative bubble is born.

zh: 但如果油田的所有者们认为油价在长期来看会呈下跌之势，他们现在便会有动力开发石油并扩大生产以求在跌价之前卖出更多的石油。
en: But if owners of oil reserves think that prices will fall in the long run, they gain an incentive to explore for oil and expand production now in order to sell as much oil as possible before the fall.

zh: 随之而来的石油供应增加会使油价下跌，从而强化进一步跌价的预期，并导致与投机泡沫全然相反的结果：油价崩溃。
en: The resulting supply surge drives down prices, reinforces expectations of further declines, and produces the inverse of a speculative bubble: a collapse in prices.

zh: 上诉的道理似乎显而易见，但我们却不愿认为石油价格是被对未来油价的预期所左右。
en: All of this may seem obvious, but we tend not to think of oil prices as being determined by expectations of future prices.

zh: 例如，在1974年1月第一次世界石油危机开始时，油价在几天内就翻了一番。
en: For example, in January 1974, when the first world oil crisis began, oil prices doubled in just days.

zh: 其直接原因被认为是以色列在"赎罪日之战"中大获全胜从而导致阿拉伯产油国以限制石油产出量作为报复。
en: The immediate cause was believed to have been Israel's stunning success in the Yom Kippur War, which led Arab oil producers to retaliate by choking off output.

zh: 1979年第二次危机，则被认为是受伊朗的伊斯兰革命和随后的两伊战争爆发给海湾的石油供应造成的影响。
en: The second crisis, in 1979, is usually attributed to supply disruptions from the Persian Gulf following the Islamic revolution in Iran and the subsequent start of the Iran-Iraq war.

zh: 那么，为什么剔除了通胀因素之后的实际石油价格直到1986年还维持在或高于其1974年的水平呢？
en: Why, then, did real inflation-corrected oil prices remain at or above their 1974 levels until 1986?

zh: 这很可能是投机的压力在发挥作用，影响了欧佩克和其他产油国。
en: Speculative pressures are likely to have been at work, influencing the decisions of OPEC and many others.

zh: 虽然市场心理的变化令人难以理解，但支撑这种非理性繁荣的主要因素却几乎总是明了的。
en: Although changes in market psychology are difficult to understand, the broad concerns that underlie such episodes of irrational exuberance are almost always clear.

zh: 例如，包括计算机的先驱杰伊 · · 弗莱斯特在内的一群麻省理工学院的科学家在1972年出版了《增长的极限》一书。
en: For example, in 1972, scientists at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, including computer pioneer Jay Forrester, published The Limits to Growth .

zh: 此书就世界是否会因为石油和其他自然资源短缺而面临严重的经济问题这一话题引发了国际性的辩论。 而18个月后欧佩克的石��减产似乎预示了这些问题的出现。
en: The book launched an international debate on whether the world would soon face immense economic problems due to shortages of oil and other natural resources - problems that seemed to be presaged by OPEC's production cuts eighteen months later.

zh: 第二次危机就发生在1979年3月宾西法尼亚州三哩岛核反应堆事故之后。 该事故重新激发了反原子能运动。
en: The second crisis was immediately preceded by the accident at the Three-Mile Island nuclear reactor in Pennsylvania in March 1979, which reinvigorated the anti-nuclear movement.

zh: 原子能-曾被认为是针对世界石油资源耗尽的主要技术防波堤-突然间受到了怀疑。 石油价格在年底再次翻番。
en: With nuclear power - regarded as the main technological bulwark against depletion of the world's oil supplies - suddenly suspect, oil prices doubled again by the year's end.

zh: 1979年之后，对于增长极限和原子能的恐惧消退了。
en: After 1979, fears about limits to growth and nuclear power ebbed.

zh: 石油价格逐渐回落，而股市也开始了向其2000年的高峰进发的上涨行情。
en: Oil prices gradually fell, and the stock market began its long climb towards its peak in 2000.

zh: 但目前的石油价格上涨反映了人们仍然急于相信"石油耗尽"的传闻-这一次归咎于中国和印度-即使这是受短期因素的影响。
en: But the current rise in oil prices shows that people are still eager to embrace "running out of oil" stories - this time focused on China and India - even when short-run factors are to blame.

zh: 的确，国际能源机构（IEA）注意到油价和存货水平之间的关系在今年9月脱钩，实际油价比该关系通常所提示的价格要高得多。
en: Indeed, the International Energy Agency noted in September that the usual relationship between oil prices and inventory levels has broken down, with prices much higher than the usual relationship would suggest.

zh: IEA的报告将这种脱钩称为"市场的结构性转变 " 。
en: The IEA's report calls this breakdown evidence of a "structural shift in the market."

zh: 但同样的油价变化在1973-4和1979-80的石油危机之后都有所发生。 在那两个时期，油价从最高峰回落之后却还保持了数年的高位，从而影响了股票市场、房屋市场和世界经济的成长。
en: But the same pattern followed the 1973-4 and 1979-80 oil crises, when prices dropped from their highest peaks, but stayed quite high for years, representing a drag on the stock market, the housing market, and the world economy.

zh: 让我们祈愿目前油价坚挺的影响不会长期持续。
en: Let's hope that the effects of the present spike will be more short-lived.

zh: 但也请不要屏住呼吸（但也请做好持久的准备-译者 ） 。
en: But don't hold your breath.

zh: 我们是否还在进化？
en: Are We Still Evolving?

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 许多公众政策决策都基于某种对“人性”的假设，而最近人们也非常热衷于谈论进化究竟是如何塑造人类行为和心理的。
en: NEW HAVEN – Many public-policy decisions are based on implicit assumptions about “human nature,” and it is currently popular to speculate about how evolution might have shaped human behavior and psychology.

zh: 但这也随之引出了若干重要问题：人类是否依然在进化 — — 如果是的话，我们的生物特性是否在不断改变？ — — 或者现代文明已经令我们的进化陷于停滞？
en: But this raises some important questions: are humans continuing to evolve – and, if so, is our basic biological nature changing – or has modern culture stopped evolution?

zh: 对于人类的某些特性，我们不需要去妄加猜测 — — 因为已经有覆盖几代人以及数千个样本的研究可供分析比较。
en: For some traits, we do not have to speculate – we can measure and compare on the basis of studies covering thousands of individuals over several generations.

zh: 虽然这类研究还未能涵盖人们感兴趣的大多数生理特性，但出于医学研究的需要，人们也开展了对其中一些特性的研究。
en: Such studies have not yet been done on most of the traits where speculation is popular, but they have been done on some traits of medical interest.

zh: 那么这些研究又揭示了什么呢？
en: What have we learned?

zh: 科学家们运用两种方法进行研究：一是提取出具有特定健康问题的人的特定基因DNA序列，将其与其他人群进行对比并找出两者的差异之处。
en: Scientists are taking two approaches. In one, they sequence the DNA of particular genes in many individuals with or without some determined health condition and look for differences between the two groups.

zh: 这种基因方法可以测量出那些经过数百甚至数千代人积累下来的进化效果，而且结果很明确：人类是在一个相对较短的时期内对这些特性进行进化的，有些人向这个方向进化，而另一些人则选择了不同的路径，这取决于他们的生存环境以及其他特殊情况。
en: This genetic approach measures effects that have accumulated over hundreds to thousands of generations, and the message is clear: humans have evolved in these respects fairly recently, some in one direction, some in another, depending on their environment and other conditions encountered.

zh: 通过这个手段，我们认识到成人消化牛奶的能力其实是在近1万年内的进化成果 — — 而且还发生了多次进化 — — 并源自于那些懂得驯养绵羊，山羊和牛的文明。
en: From this approach, we have learned, for example, that the ability to digest milk as adults evolved within the last 10,000 years – and several times – in cultures that domesticated sheep, goats, or cattle.

zh: 类似的研究也揭示出人类吸收酒精的敏感度，以及对疟疾和麻风病的免疫力也是最近几千年才进化出来的。
en: Similar studies have taught us that sensitivity to alcohol consumption and resistance to diseases like malaria and leprosy also evolved within the last several thousand years.

zh: 而包括我在内的一些科学家则选择了另一种方式。
en: Some scientists, myself included, have taken a different approach.

zh: 我们不是去寻找那些经过许多代人逐渐积累并最终显现的基因特征，而是直接对自然选择进行测量。
en: Instead of looking for changes in genes that take many generations to accumulate until they can be detected, we have measured natural selection directly.

zh: 这种方法可以揭示出那些正在发生的进化选择，而这种选择的发生时间可以缩短至一代人以内 — — 因此也可以用来回答现代文明是否令进化停滞的问题。
en: This method can reveal selection in action, working over periods of time as short as one generation – so that it can answer the question of whether modern culture has stopped evolution.

zh: 这个方式所传达的信息也非常明确：自然选择依然在现代文明内部持续进行着。
en: The message of this approach is also clear: natural selection continues to operate in modern cultures.

zh: 而这种选择是否能持续足够长久并最终引发重大的基因改变，只能由下一代人来回答。
en: Whether it will operate consistently enough for a long enough time to produce significant genetic change can be answered only by future generations.

zh: 不过观察自然选择会向着哪个方向塑造人类则是一件很有趣的事。
en: Nevertheless, it is interesting to see in what direction natural selection is starting to shape us.

zh: 有些答案甚至会令人大吃一惊。
en: Some of the answers are surprising.

zh: 我们在美国马萨诸塞州的佛明翰衡量妇女身上发生的自然选择，而依据则是该地对心脏病的长期医学研究。
en: We measured natural selection operating on women in Framingham, Massachusetts, where a long-term medical study on heart disease produced the data that we used.

zh: 我们抽取出生于1892年至1956年的妇女作为样本，从中发现了明显的自然选择因素并预计如果这个过程能持续十代人的话，妇女的身高将比现在矮两公分，而她们生下第一胎的时间也会提前5个月。
en: The women were born between 1892 and 1956. We found significant selection and projected that if it continued for ten generations, the women would evolve to be about two centimeters shorter and have their first child about five months earlier.

zh: 这个研究结论让人吃惊不已，因为由于更加良好的营养状况以及多种因素（文化因素也包含其中）影响下的推迟生育，发达国家的妇女身高正不断增加。
en: This is a surprising result, because women in developed countries have become taller thanks to better nutrition, and are having children later in life for many reasons, some of them cultural.

zh: 那么这个地方的妇女为何会出现这种现象？
en: So what is going on here?

zh: 原因有三：
en: Three things:

zh: 首先我们知道妇女生育头一胎的年龄越小，婴儿死亡率的风险也会随之而增加，但现代医学和保健学已经令这个概率大大降低，减少了低龄生育的风险。
en: First, we know that giving birth for the first time when younger carries a cost in increased infant mortality, but modern medicine and hygiene have strikingly reduced infant mortality, reducing the cost of younger age at first birth.

zh: 因此我们都会倾向于更早生育，因为相关风险几乎已经消失了 — — 这也是我们在佛明翰所发现的现象。
en: We therefore expect a shift toward earlier reproduction, because the costs previously associated with doing so have disappeared – exactly what we found in Framingham.

zh: 而我们之所以预计这些更早生育的妇女会变得更矮，原因就是她们的发育期也相应缩短了。
en: And we expect those younger women to be shorter simply because they have had less time to grow.

zh: 在另外5个研究项目中，科学家们在其中两个项目中发现更早发育成熟的发展中国家妇女身高变得更矮（另外三个项目并未测量身高 ） 。
en: In five other cases, scientists found women in developed countries maturing earlier, in two of them at smaller size (in the other three cases, size was not measured).

zh: 虽然断言这是个总体趋势还为时过早，但目前所有的迹象都指向了这一点。
en: It is too early to say that this is a general trend, but right now, all signs point that way.

zh: 其二，我们发现了一种自然选择效应，那就是那些更矮而且更早生育的妇女将生育更多儿女。
en: Second, we measured the effects of natural selection by noting that women who were shorter and first gave birth when younger had more children.

zh: 但基因只是众多影响身高和头胎生育年龄的因素之一。
en: But genes are only one of many factors that influence height and age at first birth.

zh: 个人选择，营养水平，收入层次，教育和宗教状况等各方面因素会最终组合成一种混合性因素。
en: Personal decisions, nutrition, income level, education, and religious affiliation all enter the mix.

zh: 当我们估算一个人体内发生的变异有多少是来自于生物因素的时候，答案可能是小于5 % 。
en: When we estimated how much of the variation among individuals could be attributed to biology, the answer was less than 5%.

zh: 这意味着95%的变异都来自于文化的影响和个人选择。
en: That left 95% of the variation to be explained by the effects of culture and individual decisions.

zh: 但对于生存于如此一个复杂现代文化中的人们来说，生物因素对某些特性的影响虽然微小，但在长期重复和积累之后必将最终显现出来。
en: But, while the effects of biology on the traits that we measured are relatively small for humans living in complex modern cultures, even small effects, when repeated consistently, will accumulate.

zh: 第三，这些特性通常都是基因与环境互相作用的结果。
en: Third, traits like these are always the result of interactions between genes and environment.

zh: 一位妇女身上可能携带着令她长得比同龄人更高的基因，但由于儿童时期缺乏营养，她可能最终会成为一个矮个子。
en: A woman could have genes that would tend to make her taller than average but end up shorter than average if she had been poorly nourished as a child.

zh: 即便进化的进程一直延续并最终改变了���响身高和头胎生育年龄的基因基础，但在10代人之后我们可能也无法看到更矮且更早发育成熟的妇女，因为营养和文化的因素可能会抵消甚至掩盖了基因的作用。
en: If evolution took its steady course and changed the genetic basis of height and age at first birth, we might not see women ten generations later who were shorter and matured earlier, for the effects of nutrition and culture could more than compensate for the genetic change. As a colleague of mine likes to put it, one good school-lunch program could be enough to obscure the biological effects.

zh: 由此可见，即使我们关注的是身高这么一个简单的物理特性，人类的自然选择依然会表现为一个多方面作用且差别极为细微的过程。
en: Even when we focus on a simple physical trait like height, natural selection in humans turns out to be a multifaceted and nuanced process.

zh: 那些影响人类行为和心理的因素则更为复杂，而且超出了我们的研究能力。
en: Similar studies on human behavior and psychology, where causation is more complex, remain beyond our grasp.

zh: 在这些方面，人类一思考，上帝就发笑。
en: In such cases, silence may be wiser than speculation.

zh: 阿根廷意外危机的根源
en: The Roots of Argentina’s Surprise Crisis

zh: 纽约—上个月阿根廷所经历的货币恐慌让许多人大跌眼镜。
en: NEW YORK – The currency scare that Argentina suffered last month caught many by surprise.

zh: 事实上，从2015年12月以来，阿根廷政府做出了一系列高风险动作，增加了国家的脆弱性。
en: In fact, a set of risky bets that Argentina’s government undertook starting in December 2015 increased the country’s vulnerability.

zh: 当时不清楚的是阿根廷经济何时会经受考验。
en: What was not clear was when Argentina’s economy would be put to the test.

zh: 当考验来临时，阿根廷没有通过。
en: When the test came, Argentina failed.

zh: 2015年地马克里总统走马上任时，阿根廷需要解决许多宏观经济失衡问题。
en: Argentina had to address a number of macroeconomic imbalances when President Mauricio Macri took office at the end of 2015.

zh: 早期措施包括取消汇率和资本管制以及降低商品出口税。
en: Early measures included the removal of exchange-rate and capital controls and the reduction of taxes on commodity exports.

zh: 在与所谓的兀鹫基金就持续了十年多的债务纠纷 实现和解后，阿根廷还重新回到了国际信用市场。
en: Argentina also recovered access to international credit markets following a settlement with so-called vulture funds over a debt dispute that had lasted more than a decade.

zh: 马克里政府的新宏观经济方针基于两大支柱：逐渐降低初级财政赤字，以及雄心勃勃的通胀目标机制，旨在让年物价涨幅在短短三年内下降到一位数。
en: The government undertook a new macroeconomic approach based on two pillars: gradual reduction of the primary fiscal deficit, and an ambitious inflation-targeting regime that was supposed to bring annual price growth down to a single-digit rate in just three years.

zh: 市场为之欢腾。
en: Markets cheered.

zh: 阿根廷政府急切推动的流行观点是它已经做了实现持续更快的经济增长所必须的事。
en: The prevailing view, eagerly promoted by Argentina’s government, was that the country had done what was necessary to achieve sustainably faster economic growth.

zh: 外国直接投资理应随之而来。
en: Presumably, foreign direct investment would flow in.

zh: 然而并没有。
en: But it did not.

zh: 相反，2016年阿根廷陷入了滞涨，随后2017年的复苏也是债务推动。
en: Instead, Argentina suffered stagflation in 2016, followed by a debt-based recovery in 2017.

zh: 这导致了进口激增，而出口并未相应增加，经常项目赤字扩大至GDP的4.6 % ， 也让人们开始怀疑新方针。
en: That led to a surge in imports that was not accompanied by a proportional increase in exports, widening the current-account deficit to 4.6% of GDP and sowing doubt about the virtues of the new approach.

zh: 接着，几周前，市场不再欢腾，预期急转直下，资本纷纷逃离。
en: Then, a few weeks ago, markets stopped cheering, expectations soured, and capital fled.

zh: 比索兑美元汇率在5月前三周暴跌19 % 。
en: The peso depreciated 19% against the US dollar in just the first three weeks of May.

zh: 与马克里的希望相反，他的改革吸引的主要债券形式的短期投资组合资本和融资，既有外币也有本币，而不是外国直接投资。
en: Contrary to Macri’s hopes, his reforms attracted mainly short-term portfolio capital and financing in the form of bonds, both in foreign and domestic currency, rather than foreign direct investment.

zh: 阿根廷央行要负主要责任，其政策对于让通胀降低到目标水平基本无效（年通胀率仍在25%左右 ） ， 高利率倒是带来了投机性资本的流入，从而恶化了其外部失衡，增加了阿根廷面对外部冲击的脆弱性。
en: Argentina’s central bank bears a significant share of the responsibility; while its approach proved largely ineffective in reducing inflation to the target level (the annual rate is still at about 25%), high interest rates encouraged inflows of speculative capital, which worsened the external imbalances and heightened Argentina’s vulnerability to external shocks.

zh: 作为通胀目标政策的一部分，阿根廷央行通过出售央行债券（LEBACS）对冲大部分货币基础扩张。
en: As part of their inflation-targeting approach, the central bank has been sterilizing a large share of the increases in the monetary base through the sale of central banks bonds (LEBACS).

zh: 这意味着公共部门实际上是通过发行短期央行债务来为规模巨大的初级财政赤字（2016和2017年分别达到GDP的4.2%和3.83 % ） 的大头融资。
en: This means that the public sector has been effectively financing through short-run central bank debt issuance the largest part of the sizable primary fiscal deficit (4.2% and 3.83% of GDP in 2016 and 2017, respectively).

zh: LEBCAS发行量巨大，自2015年12月以来膨胀了345 % 。
en: The issuance of LEBACS has been massive, soaring by 345% since December 2015.

zh: 如果早先对阿根廷的预期能够实现的话，这也许尚属于可持续范畴。
en: This might have been sustainable had early expectations of Argentina’s prospects been validated.

zh: 显然这里存在权衡问题。
en: There were obviously trade-offs.

zh: 不那么激进的对冲能够遏制目前看来相当危险的央行债务的增长，还能阻挡汇率升值压力；但也会导致更高的通胀。
en: Less aggressive sterilization would have contained the growth in central bank debt that has now proven to be so risky, and it would have prevented upward pressure on the exchange rate; but it would have led to higher inflation.

zh: 尽管如此，试图以相近的速度降低通胀和财政赤字应该是更审慎的方针。
en: Nonetheless, attempting to reduce inflation and the fiscal deficit at similar speeds would have been a more prudent approach.

zh: 毕竟，当达不到预期会带来高昂代价时，宏观经济政策决定不应该基于最乐观的情景做出。
en: After all, macroeconomic policy decisions should not be made on the basis of the most optimistic scenario when the cost of missed expectations is large.

zh: 最终，货币危机揭露了阿根廷的脆弱性。
en: The currency crisis finally revealed Argentina’s vulnerabilities.

zh: 展望未来，阿根廷将面临多重风险。
en: Looking ahead, the country will be exposed to several different sources of risk.

zh: 首先，LEBACS存量仍然巨大。
en: First, there is still a large stock of LEBACS.

zh: 每逢其中较大数量到期，阿根廷就不得不看金融市场的脸色。
en: And every time a significant portion of that debt falls due, Argentina will be a hostage of financial markets’ mood.

zh: 这将增加预期汇率波动性，为投机性金融投资制造机会，但不利于吸引实体经济投资。
en: This will increase the expected exchange-rate volatility, which may create opportunities for speculative financial investments, but will discourage investments in the real economy.

zh: 其次，由于公共部门外币计价债务比两年前增加了很多，汇率风险的上升也让公共部门债务的可持续性受到质疑。
en: Second, because the public sector’s foreign-currency-denominated debt is much higher than it was two years ago, the increase in exchange-rate risk will also call into question the sustainability of public-sector debt.

zh: 评估阿根廷危机后的可能前景必须强调其管理这场危机的几个显著特征。
en: To assess where Argentina is heading after the crisis requires highlighting several salient elements of how the episode was managed.

zh: 首先，央行在一个月内就失去了其外汇储备总存量的10 % 。
en: First, the central bank lost 10% of its total stock of foreign-exchange reserves in just a month.

zh: 其次，LEBACS年名义利率已经提高到40 % — —为世界最高，并 有可能导致央行债务如滚雪球般膨胀。
en: Second, the annual nominal interest rate on the LEBACS was raised to 40% – the highest in the world, and a move that risks creating a snowball of central-bank debt.

zh: 第三，对阿根廷冲击最大的是，马克里宣布阿根廷将寻求与国际货币基金组织（IMF）签订备用协定。
en: Third, and most shocking for Argentines, Macri announced that the country would seek a stand-by agreement with the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 因此，如果阿根廷公共部门在未来几年汇总刚遇到债务危机，就必须接受IMF的督导 — — IMF本身也是债权人，同时也受到国际债权人的主导。
en: Thus, if Argentina’s public sector falls into a state of debt distress in the coming years, it will have to submit to the tutelage of the IMF – a creditor in itself, but also an institution that is dominated by international creditors.

zh: 到那时，IMF所提出的融资交换条件常常会造成严重伤害。
en: At that point, the conditionality that the IMF typically imposes in exchange for financing could cause severe damage.

zh: 最令人担心的是，导致阿根廷外部失衡加剧的通胀目标方针被再次强调。
en: Most worrisome is that the inflation-targeting approach that has exacerbated Argentina’s external imbalances has been reaffirmed.

zh: 因此，如果2019年爆发新一轮真实汇率升值亦不足为奇。
en: It would thus not be surprising if a new cycle of real exchange-rate appreciation starts in 2019.

zh: 明年是总统选举年，这对于马克里来说是个好消息；但对阿根廷的未来并非如此。
en: With a presidential election next year, that would be good news for Macri; but it would not bode well for Argentina’s future.

zh: 说到底，由于到目前为止马克里为了让阿根廷经济回到持续增长道路的方法以失败告终，反而增加了阿根廷对国际债权人的依赖程度，其政府仍然需要避免债务危机。
en: Ultimately, because Macri’s approach to putting Argentina’s economy on a sustained growth path has so far failed, and has increased the country’s dependence on international creditors, his administration still faces the challenge of avoiding a debt crisis.

zh: 为了保护经济活动，解决脆弱性问题，逐步减少初级财政赤字的策略应该保留。
en: To protect economic activity and redress vulnerabilities, the strategy of gradually reducing the primary fiscal deficit should be maintained.

zh: 但是，要让阿根廷外部失衡不在加剧、影响到外部公共债务的可持续性，货币政策必须改变。
en: But, to save Argentina from an increase in external imbalances affecting the sustainability of external public debt, monetary policy must change.

zh: 这意味着最终承认试图以比降低财政赤字更快的速度境地通胀导致了代价高昂的风险。
en: That means finally recognizing that attempting to reduce inflation at a much faster rate than the fiscal deficit entails costly risks.

zh: 审慎方针还要求逐步降低LEBACS存量，认识到短期内更大的通胀压力是让外部失衡加剧和汇率进一步贬值的风险最小化的代价。
en: The prudent path also requires a gradual reduction in the stock of LEBACS, recognizing that greater inflationary pressure in the short term is the price of minimizing the risk of higher external imbalances and larger exchange-rate depreciations down the road.

zh: 而马克里政府所宣布的继续降低大豆出口税的做法显然是个错误。
en: And it would certainly be a mistake to continue reducing the tax on soybean exports, as Macri’s administration has announced it will do.

zh: 进一步减税将增加赤字，让已经享有租金的部门获益。
en: Further tax cuts would increase the deficit, while benefiting a sector that already enjoys rents.

zh: 宏观经济政策的改变不足以让阿根廷走上包容和持续的经济发展之路；但这是必要条件。
en: A change in macroeconomic policies is not sufficient to set Argentina on a path of inclusive and sustained economic development; but it is necessary.

zh: 马克里政府上台伊始，就有警告说他选择了高风险方针。
en: At the outset of Macri’s administration, there were warnings that he had chosen a high-risk approach.

zh: 不幸的是，这些警告被忽视了。
en: Unfortunately, those warnings were ignored.

zh: 我们所建议的策略也有其自身的风险。
en: The strategy we are recommending is not without its own risks.

zh: 但我们相信它提供了一个可行的、更可靠的前进方向。
en: But we are convinced that it offers a viable and sounder path forward.

zh: 阿根廷新危机的出路
en: The Way Out of Argentina’s New Crisis

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 麻省理工学院已故经济学家鲁迪格·多恩布什曾在20世纪80年代告诫自己的学生这个世界上有富国、穷国、日本和阿根廷这四种国家。
en: SANTIAGO – The late MIT economist Rüdiger Dornbusch used to tell his students in the 1980s that there are four kinds of countries: rich, poor, Japan, and Argentina.

zh: 现在已经没有人再担心日本人用钱买走世界的控制权。
en: No one frets anymore about Japan buying its way to world domination.

zh: 但世界正再次对阿根廷感到忧心忡忡。
en: But the world is worrying again about Argentina.

zh: 阿根廷货币刚刚遭受了另一场教科书式的攻击。
en: The country has just suffered another textbook attack on its currency.

zh: 4月24日，十年期美债收益率自2014年以来首次突破3 % 。
en: On April 24, the yield on ten-year US Treasury bonds broke 3% for the first time since 2014.

zh: 同日，投资者开始大量抛售阿根廷比索并买入飙升的美元以寻求避险。
en: On the same day, investors began dumping Argentine pesos and seeking the security of a surging dollar.

zh: 为了在比索大幅贬值后稳定汇率，阿根廷不得不将利率提高到40 % ， 同时寻求国际货币基金组织的帮助。
en: To stabilize its currency at a much-depreciated rate, Argentina had to jack up interest rates to 40% and seek help from the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 在经历了所有动荡后，市场平静了两周。
en: After all the turmoil, markets have been calm for a fortnight.

zh: 现在是时候评估哪里出了问题，以及这个国家可以 — — 而且必须 — — 做什么来防止再次出现不稳定。
en: Now is the time to assess what went wrong, and what the country can – and must – do to prevent instability from returning.

zh: 自从2015年12月，一位对市场持友好态度的改革者就一直管理着阿根廷。
en: Since December 2015, a market-friendly reformer has governed Argentina.

zh: 与之前任职的骗子和煽动家相比（就在不久前，其中一位还被人拍下在当地一家修道院的神坛后隐藏了数百万现金 ） ， 毛里西奥·马克里总统及其训练有素的技术官僚团队代表着巨大的进步。
en: Compared to the crooks and demagogues who preceded him in office (not long ago, one was filmed stashing millions in cash behind the altar of a local monastery), President Mauricio Macri and his team of well-trained technocrats are a massive improvement.

zh: 因为马克里的团队此前没有任何人担任过国家公职，分析师和投资者最初都低估了他们的政治能力。
en: Because none of Macri’s team had previously held national office, analysts and investors initially underestimated their political skills.

zh: 到目前为止，马克里已经向外界证明他既是一位精明的政治家又是一位有能力的管理者。
en: Until now, Macri has shown he can be an able administrator and an astute politician.

zh: 货币危机不可能发生在更好的人身上。
en: The currency crisis could not have happened to a nicer guy.

zh: 但它却的确发生了。
en: But it did.

zh: 这一切都始于去年12月一场注定会与霉运相伴的新闻发布会，在这场发布会上，2018年的通胀目标被从8~12%放宽至15 % 。
en: It all began with an ill-fated press conference last December, at which the 2018 inflation target was relaxed from 8-12% to 15%.

zh: 调整后的数字合理地承认了此前的目标在不破坏经济状况的情况下是不可能实现的。
en: The new figure was a reasonable admission that the earlier target could not be reached without wrecking the economy.

zh: 但因为马克里的幕僚长在经济团队公布消息的时候在座，因此引发了民众对政治干预的担忧。
en: But having Macri’s chief of staff seated at the table during the announcement, alongside the economic team, raised concerns of political meddling.

zh: 随后的两次降息，共计150个基点，都没能挽回相关的信誉损失。
en: Two subsequent interest-rate cuts, totaling 150 basis points, did not help credibility.

zh: 阿根廷基于通胀目标和浮动汇率制定货币政策。
en: Argentina’s monetary policy is based on inflation targeting and a floating exchange rate.

zh: 但3月下旬，由于担心货币走弱对通胀的影响，阿根廷央行再次开始干预，而且似乎将汇率固定在20比索兑一美元左右。
en: But in late March, concerned by the effect of a weakening currency on inflation, the central bank once again began intervening, and appeared to be fixing the exchange rate at around 20 pesos per dollar.

zh: 投资者自然会质疑这是否等同于政策机制的变化。
en: Investors naturally asked whether this amounted to a change in policy regime.

zh: 考虑到多次经济“休克疗法”失败的历史，马克里决定逐步解决他所接手的财政烂摊子。
en: Mindful of a long history of failed attempts at economic “shock therapy,” Macri decided to fix the fiscal mess he inherited only gradually.

zh: 他削减了燃料及电力补贴以及某些不必要的开支，但同时决定 — — 这种决定具有相当的合理性 — — 为刺激经济增长而降低出口税率。
en: He cut fuel and power subsidies and some unnecessary expenditures, but also decided – quite reasonably – to reduce export taxes in order to spur growth.

zh: 结果导致财政赤字虽然有所下降，但仍然徘徊在GDP的5.5 % 。
en: The result is that the fiscal deficit has fallen, but still hovers at 5.5% of GDP.

zh: 政府不得不大量借用国外资金来弥补这其中的差额。
en: The government has had to borrow abroad massively to cover the shortfall.

zh: 批评人士称财政调整太过缓慢无法安抚市场，而市场似乎并不关心在邻国巴西，总体预算差额为GDP的8%左右。
en: Critics claim that the fiscal adjustment was too slow for comfort, yet markets seem unconcerned that in neighboring Brazil the headline budget gap is 8% of GDP.

zh: 是的，阿根廷的经常账户赤字超过GDP的5 % ， 而巴西的外部头寸则基本接近于平衡。
en: Yes, Argentina’s current-account deficit exceeds 5% of GDP, while Brazil’s external position is nearly balanced.

zh: 但这仅仅表明阿根廷的私营部门正在将所储存资金用于投资，而巴西的私营企业则在快速去杠杆，投资很少甚至几乎不投。
en: But that only shows that  Argentina’s private sector is investing what it saves, while Brazil’s private firms are deleveraging fast and investing very little, if at all.

zh: 在阿根廷，直到美国利率飙升及美元暴涨之前，逐步实施财政调整似乎都是一种可行的对策。
en: In Argentina, gradual fiscal adjustment seemed like a plausible strategy until US interest rates spiked and the dollar surged.

zh: 由于外界再次担心新兴市场的可信度，最先遭到打击的是阿根廷和土耳其两国。
en: With concerns over emerging-market creditworthiness making a comeback, Argentina and Turkey were first in line to take the hit.

zh: 尽管土耳其政府陷入慌乱而该国局势也持续恶化，但阿根廷政府则咬紧牙关果断采取行动。
en: But while the Turkish government has dithered and the situation there continues to deteriorate, Argentine authorities bit the bullet and took decisive action.

zh: 向国际货币基金组织求助需要付出政治代价，但这件事必须要做：只有备足了资金弹药阿根廷才能说服投资者其有能力偿还债务，而且比索不会持续暴跌。
en: Going to the IMF imposes a political cost, but it had to be done: only with sufficient firepower can Argentina convince investors that debts will be paid and the currency will not keep plunging.

zh: 现在这场战役的代名词是震撼与威慑。
en: Shock and awe is now the name of the game.

zh: 国内利率大幅飙升不仅有助于稳定比索汇率，而且还可以吸引投资者将原定于5月初到期的大量比索债券进行展期。
en: The sharp rise in domestic interest rates was necessary not only to stabilize the currency, but also to make it attractive for investors to roll over large amounts of peso bonds coming due in early May.

zh: 展期操作取得了成功，比索与美元汇率稳定在25:1。
en: The rollover succeeded, and the peso stabilized at 25 per dollar.

zh: 接下来应当采取什么举措？
en: What comes next?

zh: 现在进行套利交易非常诱人，对长期债券而言尤其如此，因为这次的盈亏平衡点出现在几十年来实际汇率最低的时候。
en: The carry trade today is very attractive, especially for longer-maturity securities, because the break-even point occurs at the most depreciated real exchange rate in decades.

zh: 如果事实证明阿根廷比索表现比实际汇率更强（实际情况很可能是这样 ） ， 那么投资者获得的收益就会十分丰厚。
en: If the Argentine peso turns out to be stronger than that in real terms, which it probably will, investors stand to profit handsomely.

zh: 因此聪明的投资者现在赌的是比索升值，而不是相反。
en: So the smart money right now is betting on the peso, not against it.

zh: 但40%的利率无法维持很长时间而不损害信誉。
en: But interest rates at 40% cannot be sustained for long without harming credibility.

zh: 必须说服市场逐步降低利率既合理又是可持续的。
en: Markets must be persuaded that a gradual reduction in rates is both plausible and sustainable.

zh: 为避免滚起不可持续的雪球，央行很可能会在国际货币基金组织一揽子计划细节公布后逐步降低利率。
en: To avoid an unsustainable snowball, the central bank is likely to lower interest rates gradually after the details of the IMF package are announced.

zh: 一个好消息是国内债券的展期风险并不像某些媒体头条所报导的那样大，因为大部分债券的持有者是拥有巨额稳定流动性需求的当地银行和实体公共机构。
en: One bit of good news is that rollover risk on domestic bonds is not nearly as high as some newspaper headlines have suggested, because the lion’s share is held by local banks and public-sector entities that have large and stable liquidity needs.

zh: 国际货币基金组织必须尽快采取措施。
en: The IMF, for its part, must move quickly.

zh: 但它也必须理解太过突然的财政调整可能引发政治反弹，从而危及整个一揽子计划的信誉。
en: But it also must understand that too abrupt a fiscal adjustment can cause a political backlash that jeopardizes the credibility of the overall package.

zh: 截止到目前被成功削弱和分裂的庇隆主义反对派正希望通过引发针对预算缩减和进一步调整能源价格的抗议而获得卷土重来的契机。
en: The Peronist opposition, until now weakened and divided, is hoping to make a comeback by triggering protests against budget cuts and additional energy-price adjustments.

zh: 恰恰因为国际货币基金组织是超越地方政治的国际机构，因此就更应当保持谨慎，避免在2009年10月总统大选准备阶段给予竞选一方所需的一切弹药。
en: The Fund, precisely because it is an international institution that is above local politics, should be careful not to give one of the competing sides all the ammunition it needs in the run-up to the October 2019 presidential election.

zh: 这一切并不等于交给阿根廷当局一张空白支票。
en: None of this amounts to handing the Argentine authorities a blank check.

zh: 除进一步采取某些紧缩措施外，基金组织应当要求阿根廷当局在紧急情况逐渐消退的同时澄清汇率机制的规则。
en: In addition to some additional fiscal tightening, the Fund should insist that the authorities clarify the rules of the exchange-rate regime as the emergency recedes.

zh: 在通胀目标和浮动汇率下，在汇率严重失调时偶尔采取干预措施并不罕见。
en: Occasional interventions when the exchange rate is severely misaligned are not uncommon under inflation targeting and floating rates.

zh: 阿根廷央行有义务保证市场参与者理解这项规则。
en: It is incumbent upon the central bank to ensure that market participants understand this.

zh: 阿根廷自由主义改革的成功其实远远超越了该国的边界。
en: The success of a liberal reformist approach in Argentina matters far beyond the country’s borders.

zh: 左翼和右翼的民粹主义者，其中某些还带有独裁主义倾向，在巴西和墨西哥两国今年晚些时候举行总统大选前的民意调查中处于领先地位。
en: Populists of the right and the left, some with authoritarian leanings, lead opinion polls in Brazil and Mexico ahead of presidential elections in both countries later this year.

zh: 随着民粹主义者在美国、欧洲和亚洲的掌权，他们在两个人口最多的拉美国家的回归将产生全球影响力。
en: With populists already holding power in the US, Europe, and Asia, their return in Latin America’s two most populous countries would have global ramifications.

zh: 有了国际社会的正确政策和强力支持，阿根廷可以向世界证明还有另外一条可行的出路。
en: With the right policies and strong support from the international community, Argentina can show that another way is possible.

zh: 通货膨胀的破坏力
en: The Destructive Power of Inflation

zh: 坎布里奇—上周我在阿根廷的时候，领教了高通胀的破坏力。
en: CAMBRIDGE – When I was in Argentina last week, I was reminded of the devastating power of high inflation.

zh: 眼下阿根廷年通胀率在20%左右，而去年估算的通胀率有40%左右。
en: Argentina’s annual inflation rate is now about 20%, down from an estimated rate of about 40% last year.

zh: 阿根廷央行竭尽全力让经济去通胀，目标是三年后实现5%的通胀率。
en: The central bank is struggling to keep the economy on a disinflationary path, with a goal of achieving a 5% rate three years from now.

zh: 阿根廷通胀在过去要高得多。
en: Inflation in Argentina has been much higher in the past.

zh: 在1975年到1990年的15年中，年通胀率高达300 % ， 这意味着平均每过几个月物价水平就要翻番。
en: For the 15 years from 1975 to 1990, the annual rate averaged a remarkable 300%, meaning that the price level doubled every few months, on average.

zh: 1989年，物价上涨年率暴增至1,000 % ， 此后通胀终于受到控制。
en: Prices rose at an explosive annual rate of more than 1,000% in 1989, before inflation was finally brought under control.

zh: 事实上，通胀基本消失了。
en: In fact, inflation was all but extinguished.

zh: 我记得20世纪90年代中期在阿根廷时基本上没有通胀。
en: I remember being in Argentina in the mid-1990s, when there was virtually no inflation.

zh: 当时，阿根廷比索盯准美元，两种货币在布宜诺斯艾利斯街头平行流通。
en: Back then, the Argentine peso was pegged to the US dollar, and both currencies were used equally for day-to-day transactions on the streets of Buenos Aires.

zh: 但此后比索不再盯住美元，美元合同被迫按照非市场汇率转换为比索合同，这导致通胀飙升。
en: But the subsequent collapse of the peso’s dollar peg, and the forced conversion of dollar contracts into peso contracts at a non-market exchange rate, caused inflation to soar.

zh: 2003年，年通胀率达到了40 % 。
en: By 2003, the annual rate had increased to 40%.

zh: 随后几年下降到10 % 。
en: It then fell to 10% for a few years.

zh: 但在内斯托·基什内尔及其妻子兼继任者克里斯蒂娜·费尔南德兹担任总统期间，通胀又上升到25 % 。
en: But it rose again during the presidencies of Néstor Kirchner and his wife and successor, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, to 25%.

zh: 最后，2016年通胀率又回到40 % ， 与此同时，此前用来掩盖真实通胀率的扭曲性价格补贴也被取消。
en: It finally jumped back up to 40% in 2016, propelled by the removal of distortionary price subsidies that had previously been used to disguise the true inflation rate.

zh: 最近的高通胀率，以及公众对过去更高通胀率的记忆给阿根廷经济造成了巨大的伤害。
en: The recent high rates of inflation, and the public’s memory of even higher rates in the past, have severely harmed Argentina’s economy.

zh: 为了补偿高通胀，市场利率也随之上升，这导致即使是政府现在也必须为短期比索借贷支付25%左右的利率。
en: Because market interest rates rise to compensate for high inflation, even the government must now pay an interest rate of about 25% to borrow in pesos for short periods.

zh: 贷款人不愿意提供固定利率长期信用，因为通胀剧增将影响到他们的债券和贷款的价值。
en: Lenders are unwilling to provide long-term credit at fixed interest rates, because a jump in inflation would destroy the value of their bonds and loans.

zh: 家庭和企业不愿用短期贷款或可变利率贷款为长期投资融资，因为通胀剧增将导致它们的利息支出剧增。
en: Households and businesses are reluctant to finance long-term investments with short-term loans or with variable-interest-rate loans, because a jump in inflation would cause their interest payments to rise sharply.

zh: 事实上，阿根廷通胀高企而多变的历史已经毁掉了国内按揭市场，家庭无法通过按揭买房。
en: Indeed, Argentina’s history of high and variable inflation has destroyed the domestic mortgage market, making it impossible for a household to use a mortgage to buy a home.

zh: 企业也不愿借钱，因为它们还记得此前通胀 — — 从而利率 — — 剧增导致健康企业破产的情景。
en: Businesses are also reluctant to borrow, because they recall how previous increases in inflation – and thus in interest rates – pushed otherwise healthy companies into bankruptcy.

zh: 人寿保险业也受到高企而不确定的通胀的破坏。
en: The life insurance industry has been destroyed by high and uncertain inflation as well.

zh: 没人知道未来被索偿时比索价值几何，既然如此，还有谁会以今天的比索来购买保险呢？
en: Given that no one knows what the peso will be worth when future claims are paid, why would anyone buy insurance with today’s pesos?

zh: 经济学家的对策兴许是建议按揭、保险合同和其他协议可以进行物价水平指数化，根据当前通货膨胀率偿付。
en: Economists might respond by suggesting that mortgages, insurance contracts, and other agreements could be indexed to the price level, adjusting payments to the contemporary rate of inflation.

zh: 但当通胀率变化十分迅速时，甚至连当前通胀率都很难确定。
en: But when the inflation rate is changing rapidly, it is hard to know what the contemporary rate even is.

zh: 前任政府试图通过发布通胀估算来欺瞒公众，专家们一致认为政府发布的数字远低于真实的物价增长率。
en: The previous government tried to deceive the public by publishing inflation estimates that experts agreed were far lower than the true rate of price growth.

zh: 一位阿根廷朋友解释说，试图提供准确的通胀衡量手段的统计学家都会被政府炒鱿鱼，替之以能炮制低通胀数字的政治盟友。
en: As one Argentine friend explained, the government fired the statisticians who had tried to provide accurate measures of inflation and replaced them with political allies who would produce artificially low numbers.

zh: 他说，他们“将政府数据从技术问题变成行为艺术。 ”
en: As he put it, they “changed government statistics from a technical problem to a creative art.”

zh: 在政府允许阿根廷人将比索兑换成美元并携带出境的时候，拥有金融财产的人都将钱投资到了美国。
en: In the years when the government allowed Argentinians to convert their pesos into dollars and take them out of the country, people who had financial wealth moved their money into investments in the United States.

zh: 有人告诉我，投资美国的阿根廷财富比投资阿根廷的都多。
en: I am told that there is much more Argentinian investment wealth in the US than in Argentina.

zh: 拜这一资金流出所赐，阿根廷投资十分低迷，这拖累了生产率和增长。
en: As a result of this outflow of funds, investment in Argentina is low, holding down productivity and growth.

zh: 阿根廷总资本形成只占GDP的17 % ， 而中国和墨西哥占23 % 。
en: Gross capital formation represents only 17% of GDP in Argentina, compared to 23% in Chile and Mexico.

zh: 尽管总统马克里的新政府决心降低通胀、实现物价稳定，但这样做需要付出高昂的政治代价。
en: Although President Mauricio Macri’s new government is determined to reduce inflation and achieve price stability, it is politically costly to do so.

zh: 紧货币和高利率抑制了投资，导致真实GDP收缩。
en: Tight money and high interest rates depress demand and have caused real GDP to decline.

zh: 与此同时，通胀从20%变成15%对公众来说没有什么感觉。
en: At the same time, the public cannot perceive a reduction of inflation from 20% to 15%.

zh: 因���，政府必须付出短期政治代价才能实现长期经济收益。
en: So the government must pay a short-term political price to achieve a long-term economic gain.

zh: 阿根廷的经验为其他国家提供了两个关键教训。
en: Argentina’s experience holds two crucial lessons for other countries.

zh: 第一，物价稳定是脆弱的，通货膨胀率可能急剧升高。
en: First, price stability is fragile, and the inflation rate can rise rapidly.

zh: 第二，高通胀率会留在民众的记忆中，并造成长期的负面影响。
en: And, second, high rates of inflation remain in the public’s memory and have long-lasting adverse effects.

zh: 实现物价稳定非常重要，但通过管理货币政策、盯住低通货膨胀率目标来维持物价稳定同样重要。
en: It is important to achieve price stability; but it is just as important to maintain it, by continually managing monetary policy to target a low rate of inflation.

zh: 阿根廷担任G20主席国的憧憬和危险
en: Promise and Peril for Argentina’s G20 Presidency

zh: 华盛顿—2016年6月，阿根廷总统马克里似乎局势大好。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – It is June 2016, and things seem to be looking up for Argentine President Mauricio Macri.

zh: 跟听刚刚获准担任2018年G20主席国。
en: Argentina has just been approved to fill the G20 presidency in 2018.

zh: 美国总统竞选日趋激烈，但希拉里·克林顿（Hillary Clinton）将赢得民主党提名并在11月拿下大选似乎板上钉钉。
en: The US presidential race is heating up, but it seems all but certain that Hillary Clinton will win the Democratic nomination and sail to victory in November.

zh: 马克里对于能够与观念相近的盟友一起推动其国际日程感到乐观。
en: Macri is feeling optimistic about advancing his international agenda with a like-minded ally.

zh: 快进到今天。
en: Fast-forward to today.

zh: 马克里必须必须担心比他预期的更具挑战性的国际环境了。
en: Macri must be wringing his hands over an international environment that is far more challenging than he probably anticipated.

zh: 但是，阿根廷即将到来的G20主席国历程也并非布满荆棘。
en: Still, all is not lost for Argentina’s upcoming G20 presidency.

zh: 诚然，直面美国总统特朗普及其“美国优先”日程绝非易事。
en: To be sure, confronting US President Donald Trump and his “America First” agenda will not be easy.

zh: 在上个月的G20汉堡峰会上，特朗普就已经将自己与其他19位领导人（包括马克里在内）互相隔离，他坚决支持退出巴黎气候协定的决定 — — 而几乎整个国际社会都认为该协议是不可撤销的。
en: At the G20 Summit in Hamburg last month, Trump already managed to isolate himself from the 19 other leaders, including Macri, by standing behind his decision to withdraw from the Paris climate agreement – a deal that virtually the entire international community considers irreversible.

zh: 类似地，特朗普还要求重新谈判北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA ） 。
en: Similarly, Trump has demanded renegotiation of the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).

zh: 重新谈判过程从这个月开始，如果处理不当的话，不可能很快就能结束，美国与G20成员国墨西哥和加拿大的关系将受到影响。
en: That process, which begins this month, is unlikely to be resolved quickly and, if handled clumsily, could disrupt US relations with G20 members Mexico and Canada.

zh: 此外，特朗普并非马克里无法控制的、但会影响其主持G20的能力的唯一因素。
en: Moreover, Trump isn’t the only factor outside Macri’s control that may affect his ability to manage the G20 presidency.

zh: 很有可能，英国退欧谈判也无法按时完成，导致一个“没有协议”的结果，给英国，有可能也包括欧洲大陆，造成严重的经济冲击。
en: There is a strong chance that the Brexit negotiations will not be completed by the deadline, leading to a “no deal” scenario that generates a serious economic shock to Britain and possibly continental Europe.

zh: 类似地，中东的各种冲突、非洲的人道主义灾难，以及委内瑞拉局势的恶化，都有可能造成跨越国家边界的后果。
en: Likewise, the many conflicts in the Middle East, unfolding humanitarian disasters in Africa, and the deteriorating situation in Venezuela are having destabilizing consequences far beyond national borders.

zh: 拉丁美洲的G20成员国即将迎来选举，而这是另一个不确定性来源。
en: Upcoming elections in Latin America’s G20 members are another source of uncertainty.

zh: 阿根廷将在今年10月进行立法机关选举，墨西哥和巴西将在明年举行总统选举，预计民粹主义候选人将有抢眼的表现。
en: Argentina is set to hold legislative elections this October, and Mexico and Brazil will hold presidential elections next year, with populist candidates expected to perform well.

zh: 那么，马克里怎样才能让阿根廷成功主持G20的机会最大化？
en: So what can Macri do to maximize Argentina’s chances of a successful G20 presidency?

zh: 对于特朗普，他可以利用他们在跨入政界之前就结下的友谊。
en: When it comes to Trump, he may seek to capitalize on their friendship, which precedes their political careers.

zh: 但这一关系也会带来一些风险，这牵涉到特朗普在阿根廷的商业关系问题。
en: Yet this relationship carries some risks, owing to questions about Trump’s business relationships in Argentina.

zh: 比较让人感到憧憬的是，马克里可以也应该与公民社会团体和活动家紧密合作，确保充分的参与空间。
en: More promising, Macri can and should work closely with civil-society groups and activists to ensure sufficient space for participation.

zh: 在汉堡，与示威者的暴力冲突导致近200名警察受伤，德国保险公司也付出了1,200万欧元的赔偿金。
en: In Hamburg, violent clashes with protesters left nearly 200 police injured and German insurance companies with a €12 million ($14.2 million) bill.

zh: 阿根廷G20团队必须认识到干扰的可能性，特别是考虑到其政府的一些紧缩措施很不得人心，现在便已经造成了群众示威。
en: The Argentinian G20 Unit must recognize the possibility of disruption, especially given the unpopularity of some of the government’s austerity measures, which have already led to mass protests.

zh: 从广义上讲，阿根廷的G20主席国之旅仍然是推动马克里的强调国际合作的外交政策日程的一个重要机会。
en: More broadly, Argentina’s G20 presidency remains an important opportunity to advance Macri’s foreign-policy agenda, which stresses international cooperation.

zh: 墨西哥总统个涅托已经进入执政的最后一年，巴西总统特梅尔深陷丑闻，在这样的情况下，马克里可能意图将阿根廷定位为在G20上代表拉丁美洲视角的地区领导者。
en: With Mexico’s President Enrique Peña Nieto in his final year in office and Brazilian President Michel Temer hamstrung by scandals, Macri may wish to try to position Argentina as a regional leader in bringing Latin American perspectives to the G20.

zh: 这一领导角色可能让马克里能够重振萎靡中的南方共同市场。 南方共同市场包括多个拉美国家，能够支持通过增进贸易和投资减少贫困的国家计划。
en: Such leadership might enable Macri to rejuvenate the troubled Mercosur bloc, which includes several Latin American countries and could support national efforts to reduce poverty through increased trade and investment.

zh: 如果欧盟-南方共同市场贸易协定谈判能够在今年12月成功结束，这一计划 — — 以及阿根廷更广泛的G20日程 — — 将获得额外的助力。
en: This effort – and Argentina’s broader G20 agenda – would receive an added boost if negotiations on a European Union-Mercosur trade agreement are successfully concluded this December.

zh: 阿根廷也可以利用其担任G20主席国的机会，制定G19（不含美国）一致同意的气候和能源计划。
en: Argentina is also well placed to use its G20 presidency to build on the climate and energy plan agreed by the G19 (without the US).

zh: 马克里已经宣布2017年为“可再生能源年 ” ， 承诺阿根廷将兑现2025年20%的电力需求通过可再生能源满足的目标。
en: Macri has declared 2017 to be the “year of renewable energy,” and committed Argentina to meeting 20% of its electricity demand with renewable energy by 2025.

zh: 此外，阿根廷政府还加入了雄心联盟（High Ambition Coalition ） ， 该联盟是确保2015年巴黎气候协定缔结成功的重要因素。
en: Furthermore, the Argentine government now participates in the High Ambition Coalition, which was instrumental in securing the 2015 Paris climate accord.

zh: 这是一个非正式组织，成员包括德国、巴西、马绍尔群岛等，其宣布将“坚定不移”地恪守巴黎协定。
en: This informal group, comprising countries ranging from Germany and Brazil to the Marshall Islands, declared its “unshakeable” commitment to the accord.

zh: 阿根廷是第一个递交比巴黎协定的国家气候变化计划更加宏大的目标的国家。
en: And Argentina was the first country to submit a more ambitious national climate change plan as part of the Paris accord.

zh: 马克里应该利用这些动作带来的信誉 — — 当然，还必须得到阿根廷在可再生能源目标和减少滥采滥伐方面的进步的助力 — — 鼓励其他国家修订它们的承诺。
en: Macri should take advantage of the credibility established by these moves – which must, of course, be reinforced by progress toward Argentina’s renewable-energy targets and reducing deforestation – to encourage other countries to revise their pledges.

zh: 这一时机非常恰当。
en: The timing could not be better.

zh: 因为目前的承诺不足以将全球气温升高幅度限制在巴黎协定的“大大低于两摄氏度”的目标之内，联合国将在2018年举行特别对话，鼓励各国在2020年前做出更加宏大的承诺。
en: Because the current set of pledges is inadequate to limit the rise in global temperature to the Paris accord’s target of “well below two degrees Celsius,” the United Nations will hold a special dialogue in 2018 to encourage countries to submit more ambitious pledges before 2020.

zh: 阿根廷还可以将其G20就业和技术目标与构建低碳经济的目标联系起来。
en: Argentina can also link its G20 goals on jobs and technology with the objective of building a low-carbon economy.

zh: 若要将这些日程结合在一起，一个重要的要素是在2018年G20峰会前完成阿根廷长期低排放发展战略。
en: An important component of any effort to combine these agendas is the completion of Argentina’s long-term low-emission development strategy before the 2018 G20 summit.

zh: 毕竟，这些战略 — — 它们是巴黎协定的一部分 — — 方面的进展将给渴望降低气候相关风险、抓住可再生能源、电动汽车和电池等领域的新机会的投资者释放强烈的信号。
en: After all, progress on such strategies – part of the Paris agreement – sends a strong signal to investors seeking to mitigate climate-related risks and take advantage of new opportunities in renewables, electric vehicles, and batteries.

zh: 毫无疑问，全球动荡将影响到阿根廷担任G20主席国。
