en: Global volatility will undoubtedly affect Argentina’s G20 presidency.

zh: 但阿根廷自身的动作也会产生影响。
en: But so will Argentina’s own actions.

zh: 要让成功主持G20的机会最大化，马克里应该注重于阿根廷的欧洲和拉美盟友紧密合作，同时增强其政府在对全世界都至关重要的问题上的信誉。
en: To maximize the chances of a successful presidency, Macri should focus on working closely with Argentina’s European and Latin American allies, while reinforcing his government’s credibility on issues that are critical to all.

zh: 阿根廷不是气候领袖
en: Argentina is No Climate Leader

zh: 内乌肯—阿根廷总统马克里说，勘探阿根廷石油和天然气页岩储量 — — 位居世界第二 — — 不但对振兴阿根廷经济至关重要，也能提供一种“过桥燃料”支持气候转型。
en: NEUQUÉN – Argentinian President Mauricio Macri claims that exploiting his country’s oil and gas shale reserves – the second-largest in the world – is vital not only to lift the economy out of the doldrums, but also to provide a “bridge fuel” to support the climate transition.

zh: 但日益清楚的事实是，情况并不那么乐观。
en: The reality, which is already becoming apparent, is not nearly so rosy.

zh: 在阿根廷的主持下，G20在今年夏天能源部长签署了一份公报，强调天然气在“支持向低排放能源体系的转型”中的作用 ， “ 有望在未来几十年中大幅扩张 ” 。
en: Under Argentina’s leadership, G20 energy ministers signed a communiqué this summer highlighting the role of natural gas in “supporting transitions towards lower-emission energy systems,” with the “potential to expand significantly over the coming decades.”

zh: 马克里政府制定了一项计划，每年要在化石燃料领域吸引120亿美元投资，预测到2027年，来自石油天然气出口的收入将超过阿根廷目前的第一大出口部门农业。
en: And the Macri government has created a plan to attract $12 billion per year in fossil-fuel investments, predicting that revenues from oil and gas exports will surpass those from agriculture – currently Argentina’s leading export sector – by 2027.

zh: 阿根廷确实拥有巨大的储量有待开采：据测算有199亿桶原油、583万亿立方英尺天然气，都集中在瓦卡穆尔塔（Vaca Muerta）页岩层中。
en: Argentina certainly has massive reserves still to be exploited: an estimated 19.9 billion barrels of crude oil and 583 trillion cubic feet of gas, concentrated in the Vaca Muerta shale formation.

zh: 但利用这些资源能够带来环境方面的好处则完全是臆想。
en: But the notion that using these resources would have any environmental benefit is entirely illusory.

zh: 开发阿根廷页岩资源不但需要危险而昂贵的液压致裂技术；还会产生大约500亿吨二氧化碳排放。
en: Extracting Argentina’s shale resources would not only require dangerous and expensive hydraulic fracturing (fracking); exploiting them would result in around 50 billion tons of carbon dioxide emissions.

zh: 据石油变化国际组织（Oil Change International）的研究，勘探阿根廷页岩储备所排放的碳量，相当于将全球升温幅度限制在前工业化水平以上1.5℃以内 — — 这也是巴黎气候协定所制定的目标 — — 可用碳预算的15 % 。
en: According to research by Oil Change International, full exploitation of Argentina’s shale reserves would consume up to 15% of the entire world’s carbon budget for limiting global warming to less than 1.5° Celsius above pre-industrial levels – the target established by the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 联合国经济、社会和文化权利委员会建议阿根廷政府“重新考虑”勘探非常规碳氢化合物资源。
en: The United Nations Committee on Economic, Social, and Cultural Rights has recommended that Argentina’s government “reconsider” the exploitation of unconventional hydrocarbons.

zh: 但是，如果阿根廷获得足够投资建设让瓦卡穆尔塔页岩资源盈利所需要的基础设施 — — 管道、铁路、石英矿和废物站 — — 阿根廷有可能会因为充分开采而受困。
en: Yet, if Argentina receives sufficient investment to build the infrastructure – the pipelines, railways, silica mines, and waste sites – needed to make Vaca Muerta profitable, the country may become effectively locked into full exploitation.

zh: 国际大公司 — — 包括英国石油（BP，它拥有阿根廷第二大原油生产商泛美能源集团50%的股份 ） 、 道达尔（Total ） 、 壳牌（Shell ） 、 温特沙尔（Wintershall ） 、 挪威石油（Equinor ） 、 埃克森美孚（ExxonMobil ） 、 雪佛龙（Chevron ） 、 中海油、陶氏（Dow）和马来西亚石油（Petronas）等 — — 已经纷纷加入开采，这一情景的可能性越来越大。
en: With major international oil companies – including BP (which owns 50% of Pan American Energy Group, Argentina’s second-largest crude producer), Total, Shell, Wintershall, Equinor, ExxonMobil, Chevron, CNOOC, Dow, and Petronas – already getting involved, this scenario seems increasingly likely.

zh: 受到影响的也将不仅仅是气候。
en: And it is not just the climate that will suffer.

zh: 阿根廷天然气计划所造成的经济影响导致家庭、企业和国家资源大量向化石燃料公司转移。
en: Already, the economics of Argentina’s dash for gas has resulted in massive transfers from households, businesses, and the state to fossil-fuel corporations.

zh: 阿根廷政府为了兑现G20承诺，削减了私人天然气和石油取暖补贴。
en: Argentina’s government, in line with a G20 commitment, has been slashing subsidies for private gas and oil heating bills.

zh: 与此同时，马克里政府还提高（美元化）了天然气价格。
en: At the same time, the Macri administration has been hiking (dollarized) gas prices.

zh: 除此之外，比索急剧贬值（今年兑面源贬值超过50 % ） ，过去24个月中阿根廷家庭和企业面临的天然气价格平均上涨了1,300 % 。
en: Add to that a sharply depreciating peso (down by more than 50% against the US dollar this year), and the increase in gas prices faced by households and businesses, on average, amounts to 1,300% over the last 24 months.

zh: 毫不奇怪，许多公司和家庭已无力承担能源账单。
en: Unsurprisingly, many companies and households can no longer afford their energy bills.

zh: 价格的上涨破坏力极大，所有反对派联合起来，要求实施让关税回到2017年11月水平的法律。
en: The price hikes are so damaging that the entire opposition united behind a law to bring tariffs back to their November 2017 levels.

zh: 马克里在5月份否决了这项法律，随后更换了能源部长。
en: Macri vetoed the law in May, before replacing his energy minister.

zh: 家庭和企业蒙受了损失，而石油和天然气公司仍在赚钱。
en: While households and businesses suffer, oil and gas companies continue to profit.

zh: 事实上，有意勘探页岩储量的公司，获得了丰厚的补贴，还有其他好处：天然气计划（Plan Gas）保证了非常规天然的价格；每单位天然气开采地方政府费用的降低；以及与主要工会签订的降低用工成本的协议。
en: In fact, those wishing to exploit shale deposits are receiving shiny new subsidies of their own, along with other benefits: a guaranteed price through Plan Gas for unconventional gas, reduced regional government fees per unit of gas extracted, and an agreement with the main trade unions that lowers workforce costs.

zh: 这些“慷慨”的安排的一个结果是页岩气开采公司在没有实现承诺的经济收益的情况下，也能实现盈利。
en: As a result of these lavish arrangements, companies drilling for shale gas can turn a profit without providing the promised economic benefits.

zh: 阿根廷社会环境和能源正义联盟（Socio-environmental and Energy Justice Alliance）的研究表明，尽管2016年在瓦卡穆尔塔作业的天然气公司投资规模不如2015年，所提供的工作岗位也少了3,000个，但它们仍能得到更多的利润。
en: According to research by Argentina’s Socio-environmental and Energy Justice Alliance, although oil and gas companies operating in Vaca Muerta in 2016 invested less than they did in 2015 and provided 3,000 fewer jobs, they received higher earnings.

zh: 除了与工会的协议侵犯了劳工权利，页岩气开采还侵犯了土著社区的权利。
en: Beyond the labor-rights violations that deals with trade unions enable, shale-gas extraction violates the rights of indigenous communities.

zh: 比如，土著马普切人社区示威反对在他们事先不知情的情况下，在他们的领地钻井采气。
en: For example, indigenous Mapuche communities have protested wells drilled on their territory without prior informed consent.

zh: 此外，尽管有60个市通过了禁止钻井的地方法规，但法院裁定其中一些规定违宪，因为它们滥用了公共权力 — — 这页侵犯了地方民主。
en: Moreover, while more than 60 municipalities have passed local regulations to ban the drilling, the courts have declared several of these measures unconstitutional on the grounds that they exceed communal powers – a move that also undercuts local democracy.

zh: 因此，阿根廷的页岩大工程破坏了解决气候变化的措施，威胁到地方民主和土著权利，也不会带来支持者所承诺的经济收益。
en: So Argentina’s shale megaproject undermines efforts to address climate change, threatens local democracy and indigenous rights, and will not bring the economic benefits promised by its proponents.

zh: 与此同时，本周承办G20年度峰会的马克里政府一直利用G20论坛将天然气包装为可持续的能源替代品。
en: Meanwhile, Macri’s government, which is hosting the G20’s annual summit this week, has been using the body’s forums to promote gas as a sustainable energy alternative.

zh: 这可算不上气候领导力。
en: This is not climate leadership.

zh: 但在页岩气野心方面，阿根廷绝非“孤家寡人 ” 。
en: And yet, when it comes to shale-gas ambition, Argentina is hardly alone.

zh: 从中国到英国，G20政府都在制定以页岩气为核心的大规模产业战略。
en: G20 governments, from China to the United Kingdom, are devising large-scale industrial strategies centered on shale gas.

zh: 瓦卡穆尔塔的故事可以说是对它们的警告 — — 也包括其他考虑将页岩气作为强化经济、推动低碳能源转型的手段的国家。
en: The story of Vaca Muerta should serve as a warning to these and other countries considering shale gas as a means of strengthening their economies and advancing a low-carbon energy transition.

zh: 世界不应该勘探页岩储量，而需要停止新的化石燃料项目，逐步报废现有化石燃料项目，并实施宏大的清洁能源投资战略，专注于提供体面的工作机会和尊重社区掌控自身发展的权利。
en: Far from exploiting shale reserves, the world needs to halt new fossil-fuel projects, phase out existing ones, and implement ambitious clean-energy investment strategies focused on providing decent jobs and respecting communities’ rights to control development on their land.

zh: 唯有采取和推进这样的方针，阿根廷才能令人信服地表现出气候领导力。
en: Only by adopting and promoting such an approach could Argentina credibly claim to be showing climate leadership.

zh: 阿根廷经济大爆炸
en: Argentina’s Economic Big Bang

zh: 法兰克福—上周，新当选的阿根廷总统马克里启动了一项雄心勃勃的计划，意欲重振因为高通胀而饱受折磨、困难重重的经济。
en: FRANKFURT – Last week, the government of newly elected Argentine President Mauricio Macri launched a bold plan to revitalize a bruised and beleaguered economy plagued by high inflation.

zh: 在危机四伏的环境下，我们不可低估这一举动对阿根廷以及其他国家的重要性。 其他国家领导人正在密切观察如何应对自身经济困难的线索。
en: At a time of daunting crisis conditions, one should not underestimate the importance of this move not just for Argentina, but also for other countries, where leaders are watching closely for clues about how to deal with their own economic woes.

zh: 拜多年经济管理失当所赐，阿根廷经济数十年来一直表现萎靡。
en: Thanks to years of economic mismanagement, Argentina’s economy has been badly underperforming for decades.

zh: 前任政府试图想避免困难的政策选择，掩盖根本性问题，它们实施了无效的控制，导致资源大面积错配，破坏了阿根廷获得支付进口账单所需的外汇收入，导致国内短缺。
en: Previous governments sought to avoid difficult policy choices and obfuscate fundamental issues by implementing inefficient controls that grossly misallocated resources and undermined Argentina’s ability to generate the foreign-exchange earnings needed to cover its import bill, resulting in domestic shortages.

zh: 最近大宗商品价格的下跌加剧了这一情况，耗尽了阿根廷经济仅存的一点增长活力，同时恶化了通胀，深化了贫困，也扩散了经济不安全和金融动荡。
en: The recent drop in commodity prices has exacerbated the situation, depleting what little growth dynamism the economy had left, while fueling inflation, deepening poverty, and spreading economic insecurity and financial instability.

zh: 理论上，面临这一情况的政府有五个基本选择遏制危机，等待重振增长和就业引擎的措施起效。
en: In theory, governments in such a situation have five basic options to contain crisis conditions, pending the effects of measures to reinvigorate growth and employment engines.

zh: ·         消耗经济表现较好时所积累的金融储备和财富。
en: · Run down the financial reserves and wealth that were accumulated when the economy was doing better.

zh: ·         向国内外贷款人借钱。
en: · Borrow from foreign and domestic lenders.

zh: ·         直接削减公共部门支出，同时制造激励诱导降低私人部门支出。
en: · Cut public-sector spending directly, while creating incentives to induce lower private-sector expenditure.

zh: ·         通过提高税费产生收入，并增加海外收入。
en: · Generate revenues through higher taxes and fees, and earn more from abroad.

zh: ·         用价格机制加速整个经济以及与其他国家贸易和金融互动的调整。
en: · Use the price mechanism to accelerate adjustments throughout the economy, as well as in trade and financial interactions with other countries.

zh: 通过精心设计和排列，这五项措施不但有助于应对当下的经济和金融问题，还能为更高的长期增长、就业创造和金融稳定创造条件。
en: Through careful design and sequencing, these five measures can help not only to deal with immediate economic and financial problems, but also to create the conditions for higher growth, job creation, and financial stability in the longer term.

zh: 通过这样的安排，它们可以遏制经济困难在群众中蔓延，保护最脆弱人群，为子孙后代提供更好立足点。
en: In this manner, they can contain the spread of economic hardship among the population, protect the most vulnerable segments, and put future generations on a better footing.

zh: 但是，在实践中，政府常常面临制约这些措施的有效实施的复杂情况。
en: In practice, however, governments often face complications that undermine effective implementation of these measures.

zh: 如果决策者不够谨慎，那么特别是有两个问题可能互相强化，有可能导致经济脱轨。
en: If policymakers are not careful, two problems, in particular, can reinforce each other, potentially pushing the economy over the precipice.

zh: 第一个问题是具体因素 — — 不管是真实因素还是人们所认为的因素 — — 导致一些选项无法进入调整候选清单。
en: The first problem arises when specific factors, real or perceived, block some options from the adjustment menu.

zh: 一些措施有可能已经失去效果：该国可能没有任何财富或储备可用，其领导人可能意志力不足。
en: Some measures may already have been exhausted: the country may not have any wealth or reserves left to tap, and there may be a shortage of willing lenders.

zh: 其他措施，如财政调整，必须小心实施，以避免破坏增长目标。
en: Other measures, such as fiscal adjustment, must be implemented very carefully, in order to avoid torpedoing the growth objective.

zh: 第二个问题是时机问题，政府难以确保这些措施以正确的顺序起效。
en: The second problem is timing, with governments struggling to ensure that the measures take effect in the right sequence.

zh: 有效的实施需要理解经济和金融互动的关键特征，不但包括反馈机制，也包括私人部门反应的行为学角度。
en: Effective implementation requires understanding key features of economic and financial interactions, including not just feedback effects, but also the behavioral aspects of private-sector responses.

zh: 所有这些都必须与追求供给面改革密切协调。 供给面改革可以刺激鲁棒、持久、包容的增长。
en: And all of this must be closely coordinated with the pursuit of supply-side reforms that promote robust, durable, and inclusive growth.

zh: 这也是马克里政府的方针成为历史例外之处。
en: Here is where the Macri government’s approach is an historical exception.

zh: 马克里就任总统后的第一炮打得很响，抛出了一个大胆 — — 风险也很高 — — 的战略，将价格自由化和消除量化控制列为核心，位于与需求管理和金融协助有关的五项措施之前。
en: Macri took over the presidency with a bang, launching an audacious – and highly risky – strategy that places aggressive price liberalization and the removal of quantitative controls front and center, ahead of the five measures relating to demand management and financial assistance.

zh: 目前，出口税和货币管制已经取消，所得税已经削减，汇率已经放松，放任比索立刻贬值30 % 。
en: Already, most export taxes and currency controls have been scrapped, income taxes have been cut, and the exchange rate has been freed up, allowing for an immediate 30% depreciation of the peso.

zh: 历史上，很少有政府采取这样的顺序，更少有政府以如此力度执行；事实上，大部分政府都会犹豫不决，特别是在货币完全自由化问题上。
en: Historically, few governments have pursued this type of sequencing, much less with such fervor; indeed, most governments have hesitated, especially when it comes to full currency liberalization.

zh: 当其他政府采取类似的措施时，它们往往要等到提供金融注资和遏制需求的措施之后。
en: When governments have taken similar steps, they usually have done so after – or at least alongside – the provision of financial injections and efforts to restrain demand.

zh: 原因很显然：政府希望获得时间为自由化做准备，以此限制价格通胀的初始幅度，从而避免工资-价格螺旋，遏制资本外逃。
en: The reason is clear: by taking time to set the stage for liberalization, governments hoped to limit the initial spike in price inflation, thereby avoiding a wage-price spiral and curbing capital flight.

zh: 它们担心，如果出现这些问题，改革措施就会脱轨，继续改革所需要的公共支持就会受到影响。
en: They worried that, if these problems emerged, they would derail reform measures and erode the public support needed to press on.

zh: 要想持久、包容地重振阿根廷经济，马克里政府需要快速行动动员大规模外部金融支持，开辟新的国内资源，实施更深入的结构改革。
en: To revive the Argentine economy in a durable and inclusive manner, Macri’s government needs to act fast to mobilize sizeable external financial assistance, generate additional domestic resources, and implement deeper structural reforms.

zh: 如果做到这些，阿根廷的雄心勃勃的经济战略将成为其他国家的榜样，不管是现在还是将来。
en: If it does, Argentina’s bold economic strategy will become a model for other countries, both now and in the future.

zh: 但如果这一方针失败 — — 不管是因为不正确的顺序还是因为群众不满暴增 — — 其他国家在放松管制、实现货币完全自由化时就会更加犹豫。
en: But if the approach falters – whether because of incorrect sequencing or a surge of popular dissatisfaction – other countries will become even more hesitant to lift controls and fully liberalize their currencies.

zh: 由此带来的政策困惑对所有人都是件坏事。
en: The resulting policy confusion would be bad for everyone.

zh: 阿根廷总统马克里：令人失望的首年
en: Macri’s Disappointing First Year in Argentina

zh: 发自纽约 — — 阿根廷的经济正在困境中挣扎。
en: NEW YORK – Argentina’s economy is struggling.

zh: 去年，全国经济停滞不前，GDP下跌2.3％而通胀率却将近40 ％ 。
en: Last year, the country suffered stagflation, with GDP dropping by 2.3% and inflation reaching nearly 40%.

zh: 贫穷与不平等现象加剧；失业率上升；而外债却以惊人的速度增长而且没有改善的势头。
en: Poverty and inequality increased; unemployment rose; and foreign debt grew – and continues to grow – at an alarming rate.

zh: 至少对总统毛里奇奥·马克里（Mauricio Macri）来，他上任这一年的表现真是令人相当沮丧。
en: For President Mauricio Macri, it was a disheartening first year in office, to say the least.

zh: 无可否认，马克里在2015年12月上任时就面临着艰巨的挑战。
en: To be sure, Macri faced a daunting challenge when he took office in December 2015.

zh: 在前任总统克里斯蒂娜·费尔南德斯·德基什纳（Cristina Fernández de Kirchner）朝令夕改的宏观经济政策之下，国家经济已经落入了不可持续的轨道。
en: The economy was already on an unsustainable path, owing to the inconsistent macroeconomic policies that his predecessor, Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, had pursued.

zh: 这些政策导致的失衡状况削弱了经济竞争力和外汇储备，令国家向着国际收支危机越陷越深。
en: Those policies led to imbalances that eroded the economy’s competitiveness and foreign reserves, pushing the country toward a balance-of-payments crisis.

zh: 但是马克里也实施的宏观经济政策手段也有缺陷。
en: But Macri also pursued a flawed macroeconomic policy approach.

zh: 他的政府本应在解决财政和外部不平衡问题的同时不去破坏过去十年所取得的社会包容成果。
en: His administration needed to address the fiscal and external imbalances, without undoing the progress in social inclusion that had been made over the previous decade.

zh: 但他自身基于四个关键性支柱政策的做法却未能实现这一点。
en: His approach, based on four key pillars, has not achieved that.

zh: 首先，麦克里政府废除了汇率管制，并将阿根廷转向浮动货币制度，允许阿根廷比索在2016年相对美元贬值60 ％ 。
en: First, Macri’s government abolished exchange-rate controls and moved Argentina to a floating currency regime, with the Argentine peso allowed to depreciate by 60% against the US dollar in 2016.

zh: 第二，马克里政府降低了上届政府非常看重的商品出口税，并撤销了一些进口管制。
en: Second, Macri’s government reduced taxes on commodity exports, which had been important to Kirchner’s administration, and removed a number of import controls.

zh: 第三，阿根廷中央银行宣布将采取以控制通胀水平为目标的管理制度，而不是继续依赖税收来填补财政赤字。
en: Third, the Central Bank of Argentina announced that it would follow an inflation-targeting regime, instead of continuing to rely mainly on seigniorage to finance the fiscal deficit.

zh: 最后，马克里政府与十多年来一直阻止该国进入国际信贷市场的所谓秃鹰基金和其他死硬派债权人达成了协议。
en: Finally, Macri’s government reached a deal with the so-called vulture funds and other holdout creditors that for more than a decade had blocked the country from accessing international credit markets.

zh: 在协议生效后，这个新兴市场最大的债务问题就宣告结束，而阿根廷可以开始大举借入新的外部借款来协助解决其可观的财政赤字问题。
en: Once the deal was concluded, Argentina pursued massive new external borrowing, with the emerging world’s largest-ever debt issue, to help address its sizable fiscal deficit.

zh: 虽然阿根廷刚刚纽约的法律框架下（当年借款也是借助此框架）输掉了一场昂贵的官司，但为了降低借款成本，当局依然会选择在该框架下发行新的债务。
en: In the interest of lowering its borrowing costs, the authorities issued the new debt under New York law, despite the expensive battle that the country had just lost precisely because it had borrowed under that legal framework.

zh: 马克里的宏观经济政策手段，其中还包括松绑被前政府冻结的公共服务价格以及执行能为政府带来更多财政收入的税收大赦计划 — — 都构建于一些有争议的假设之上。
en: Macri’s macroeconomic policy approach – which also included increasing prices for public services that had been frozen by the previous government and implementing a tax amnesty program that provided the government with more fiscal revenues – rested on several controversial assumptions.

zh: 最重要的是，政策过程中的剧烈变化应当是能为动态性增长创造条件的。
en: Above all, the radical change in policy course was supposed to establish the conditions for dynamic growth.

zh: 在这些假设中，货币贬值可以在出口税下降的协助下鼓励贸易品的生产，从而解决外部收支失衡现象。
en: The currency depreciation, it was assumed, would address external imbalances, by encouraging, with the help of lower export taxes, increased production of tradable goods.

zh: 与秃鹰基金的交易应该可以降低融资成本，提振投资者的信心，从而吸引国外直接投资。
en: The deal with the vulture funds was supposed to reduce the cost of financing and boost investor confidence, thereby attracting inflows of foreign direct investment (FDI).

zh: 以投资主导的增长将扶助整个经济。
en: Investment-led growth would help the entire economy.

zh: 这些假设尚未得到证实。
en: These assumptions haven’t been borne out.

zh: 与政府的预期相反，比索的贬值对消费者价格产生了很大的影响 — — 正如评论家所警告的那样。
en: Contrary to the government’s expectations, the peso’s depreciation had a large impact on consumer prices – as critics had warned.

zh: 此举降低了家庭的购买力，削弱了总体需求，同时抵消了贬值对国家外部竞争力的整体影响。
en: This reduced households’ purchasing power and weakened aggregate demand, while diminishing the devaluation’s overall impact on the country’s external competitiveness.

zh: 央行对通胀的重新关注也不大可能有助于解决问题，因为这将破坏经济活动并加深那些最脆弱群体所承受的痛苦，对那些人来说，失业要比物价上涨更为难熬。
en: The central bank’s new focus on inflation is unlikely to help matters, either, because it will undermine economic activity and exacerbate the pain experienced by the most vulnerable, for whom unemployment may be worse than rising prices.

zh: 此外，由于经济衰退带来的政府收入下降，阿根廷财政赤字增加。
en: Moreover, Argentina’s fiscal deficit has increased, owing to the drop in revenues brought about by the recession.

zh: 正如麦克里的评论者们所提醒的那样，围绕其政策的不确定性阻碍了投资，因此外国直接投资的流入没有出现明显变化。
en: And there were no significant FDI inflows, because, as Macri’s critics had cautioned, the uncertainty surrounding his policies deterred investment.

zh: 但政府也做了一件正确的事情：它重新启动了在上届政府干预下声誉扫地的国家统计和人口普查局。
en: The government has done one thing right: it rebooted the National Institute of Statistics and Census, which had lost credibility after interventions by the previous administration.

zh: 但整体状况依然黯淡。
en: But the overall situation remains bleak.

zh: 在麦克里第一任职位结束时，阿根廷面临着与上任时相同的宏观经济失衡状况，而外债负担则明显增加。
en: At the end of Macri’s first year in office, Argentina faced the same macroeconomic imbalances that it did when he took office, but with significantly higher external indebtedness.

zh: 此外，民众的愤怒正在升温，因为马克里政策引发的再分配使财富离工薪阶层越来越远。
en: Furthermore, public anger is reaching fever pitch, owing to the effective redistribution of wealth away from workers brought about by Macri’s policies.

zh: 示威运动比比皆是，甚至导致开学日都被推迟。
en: Demonstrations abound, even causing the first day of school to be delayed.

zh: 4月6日，政府遭遇了上台以来第一次全国大罢工。
en: On April 6, the government faced its first nationwide general strike.

zh: 目前看来，阿根廷的前景充满着不确定性。
en: As it stands, Argentina’s prospects are uncertain.

zh: 外部借款正在成为一个严重的问题，而且可能加剧，因为美联储的持续加息加剧了债务偿还的成本。
en: External borrowing is becoming a serious problem – one that is likely to intensify, as continued interest-rate hikes by the US Federal Reserve raise the costs of rolling over debts.

zh: 不稳定的宏观经济动态正在再现与之前类似的失衡状态。
en: Unstable macroeconomic dynamics are reproducing the same imbalances as they did before.

zh: 例如与外部借款相关的资本流入正在推动比索升值，进而威胁到那些创造就业的重要经济部门。
en: For example, the capital inflows associated with external borrowing are putting upward pressure on the peso, threatening sectors that are important for job creation.

zh: 今年议会选举在即，马克里政府可以试图通过承担更多债务来刺激经济活动。
en: In the run-up to this year’s legislative elections, Macri’s government could try to stimulate economic activity by taking on more debt.

zh: 但这种债务型复苏注定无法长久，也会为今后更为严重的债务问题埋下了伏笔。
en: But a debt-based recovery would be short-lived, and would sow the seeds of more acute debt troubles in the future.

zh: 为了避免持续债务动荡，阿根廷必须减少财政赤字。
en: To escape its perverse debt dynamics, Argentina must reduce its fiscal deficit.

zh: 但只有在经济活动实现可持续和包容性复苏的背景下才能实现这一点 — — 而这需要更具竞争力的经济。
en: But it can do so only in the context of a sustainable and inclusive recovery of economic activity – and that requires a more competitive economy.

zh: 在当前情况下，企图通过财政收缩来解决问题只会加剧经济衰退。
en: Under current conditions, attempting to resolve the problem through a fiscal contraction would merely aggravate the recession.

zh: 麦克里政府应当采用一套可靠且没有争议的经济假设，并以此构建长期的宏观经济战略。
en: Macri’s government should be working to develop a long-term macroeconomic strategy based on credible, not controversial, assumptions.

zh: 否则在缺乏实质性的中期修正的情况下，阿根廷只会陷入一条破坏稳定的债务之路，万劫不复。
en: Without a substantial mid-course correction, Argentina will settle onto a destabilizing debt path that leads nowhere good.

zh: 公平对待主权债务
en: A Fair Hearing for Sovereign Debt

zh: 这一裁决反响激烈，影响了诸多地区发行的债券，这表明美国法院能够左右其他国家的合约执行。
en: The decision reverberated far and wide, affecting bonds issued in a variety of jurisdictions, suggesting that US courts held sway over contracts executed in other countries.

zh: 自此以后，律师和经济学家试图厘清格里萨裁决的影响。
en: Ever since, lawyers and economists have tried to untangle the befuddling implications of Griesa's decision.

zh: 美国法院的权威真的可以扩展到美国国界以外？
en: Does the authority of US courts really extend beyond America's borders?

zh: 这一决定是对似乎并不理解全球金融市场复杂性的美国法官的一系列决定的有益反驳。 它释放出一些重要信息。
en: The decision – a welcome break from a series of decisions by American judges who do not seem to understand the complexities of global financial markets – conveys some important messages.

zh: 首先也是最重要的是，阿根廷债务谈判被一家美国法院先发制人 — — 但随后被一家英国法院反制 — — 这一事实尖锐地提醒我们，基于市场的主权债务危机解决方案可能造成重大混乱。
en: First and foremost, the fact that the Argentine debt negotiations were preempted by an American court – which was then contradicted by a British court – is a stark reminder that market-based solutions to sovereign-debt crises have a high potential for chaos.

zh: 在格里萨违约前，人们常常错误地假设主权债务偿付问题的解决方案应该通过分散化的谈判实现，不必有强大额法律框架。
en: Before the Griesafault, it was often mistakenly assumed that solutions to sovereign-debt repayment problems could be achieved through decentralized negotiations, without a strong legal framework.

zh: 即使在事后，金融界和国际货币基金组织（IMF）仍希望仅仅通过调整债务合同、特别是所谓的集体行动条款（要求所有债权人按照绝对多数原则执行获通过的重组方案）为主权债券市场建立些许秩序。
en: Even afterwards, the financial community and the International Monetary Fund hoped to establish some order in sovereign-bond markets simply by tweaking debt contracts, particularly the terms of so-called collective-action clauses (which bind all creditors to a restructuring proposal approved by a supermajority).

zh: 但简单的改变，如合同修改，无法克服系统漏洞。
en: But simple modifications like contract amendments will not overcome the system's deficiencies.

zh: 多边债务有时会牵涉到不同司法辖区的相互矛盾的法律，债权人投票这一基本模式 — — 由基于市场的方法的支持者推行 — — 无助于解决复杂的讨价还价问题。
en: With multiple debts subject to a slew of sometimes-contradictory laws in different jurisdictions, a basic formula for adding the votes of creditors – which supporters of a market-based approach have promoted – would do little to resolve complicated bargaining problems.

zh: 它也无法确定用于给以不同货币发行的债务估值的汇率。
en: Nor would it establish the exchange rates to be used to value debt issued in different currencies.

zh: 如果这些问题留给市场去解决，那么强大的讨价还价实力而非效率或所有权因素将决定结果。
en: If these problems are left to markets to address, sheer bargaining power, not considerations of efficiency or equity, will determine the solutions.

zh: 这些缺陷带来的后果不仅是不便。
en: The consequences of these deficiencies are not mere inconveniences.

zh: 推迟完成债务重组可能加深和延长经济衰退，希腊就是明证。
en: Delays in concluding debt restructurings can make economic recessions deeper and more persistent, as the case of Greece illustrates.

zh: 这就引出了英国裁决的第二个教训。
en: This brings us to the second lesson of the British ruling.

zh: 兹事体大，系统破败，因此市场没有理由唯美国马首是瞻。
en: With the stakes so high and the system so broken, debt markets have little reason to remain in the US.

zh: 美国向来标榜其“法治”之强大，这一卖点让华尔街成为最大的主权债务市场。
en: America has always prided itself on the strength of its “rule of law," a selling point that has made Wall Street host to the largest sovereign-debt market.

zh: 但格里萨的裁决基于对阿根廷合同的某些条款的特殊解读 — — 在我们看来，这样的解读根本站不住脚 — — 这表明美国的商业利益可能左右法院判决。
en: But Griesa's ruling, based on a peculiar – and in our view, indefensible – interpretation of certain terms in Argentina's contract, showed that US commercial interests can dominate its courts' decisions.

zh: 浮夸的美国法治不再强健。
en: The vaunted American rule of law no longer looks so robust.

zh: 它保护强者、欺凌弱者。
en: Perversely, it protects the strong against the weak.

zh: 美国最好在主权债务市场抛弃纽约之前采取行动。
en: The US would be wise to react before the sovereign-debt market migrates from New York.

zh: 中国应该做好收拾局面的准备。
en: China should stand ready to pick up the slack.

zh: 如今，中国储蓄远超美国，并且正在竭力将上海打造成全球金融中心。
en: Its savings now far outstrip those of the US, and it is striving to make Shanghai a global financial center.

zh: 考虑到2008年金融危机后美国体系的信誉扫地，这一雄心的可行性更强了。
en: That ambition has become more attainable in view of the damage to the US system's credibility in the aftermath of the 2008 financial crisis.

zh: 但是，上海要想崛起成为主权借贷市场的领导者，中国应该了解其他地区法律框架的弱点，并设计出更高效、更公平的替代品。
en: But, if Shanghai is to emerge as a leader in sovereign lending markets, China should be aware of the shortcomings of legal frameworks elsewhere, and design a more efficient and equitable alternative.

zh: 英国法院判决的最后一个影响深远的意义所有国家都应该注意。
en: The final, overarching message of the British court's decision is one that all countries should heed.

zh: 联合国应该重新为主权债务重组建立一套多边法律框架，这一需要十分迫切。
en: There is an urgent need to renew the United Nations' efforts to create a multinational legal framework for sovereign-debt restructuring.

zh: 尽管美国正致力于搞破坏，但英国的判决提醒我们，美国法官不是世界的法官。
en: Though the US is striving to undermine these efforts, the UK ruling reminds us that America's judges are not the world's judges.

zh: 最后这个意义也许会令华尔街不快；但是，对全球许多依赖主权债务的国家来说，这是名副其实的好消息。
en: That last revelation may not make Wall Street happy; but, for the many countries around the world that rely on sovereign debt, it is very good news indeed.

zh: 阿根廷的颠簸之旅
en: Argentina’s Bumpy Ride

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 当我们的飞机即将进入阿根廷空域时，机长从驾驶室里传出指示 ： “ 请务必系好安全带，因为本段飞行会较为颠簸。
en: SANTIAGO – “Fasten your seat belts, because it should be a bumpy ride,” the captain warned from the cockpit.
We were about to enter Argentine airspace.

zh: 那些想在阿根廷做生意的投资者们也会经常听到类似的警告。
en: Investors looking to do business in Argentina have long been issued similar warnings.

zh: 这是一个被学者们视作金融危机研究范本的国度。
en: This is the country that scholars study when they want to understand financial crises.

zh: 该国2001爆发的最严重金融危机摧毁了整个本地银行体系并引发政府债务违约。
en: The country’s largest such crisis, in 2001, brought down the local banking system and caused the Argentine government to default on its debts.

zh: 当时总体经济规模剧减了18 % ， 而失业率则飙升到22%以上。
en: The economy contracted by a whopping 18%, and the unemployment rate peaked above 22%.

zh: 在经历了十年的平静之后，可怕的经济警报再度降临。 全球经济的预测都倒向悲观，而阿根廷这个出口依赖国的经济学家们更是千头万绪。
en: After a period of calm that has now lasted a decade, dire economic warnings are back.  Forecasts for the world economy are turning pessimistic, and economists in export-dependent Argentina are finding much to worry about.

zh: 拉美规模最大的巴西银行预测阿根廷明年的GDP增长只有3.2 % ， 大幅低于2011年的6 % 。
en: Itau, Latin America’s largest bank, is predicting GDP growth in Argentina of only 3.2% next year, down sharply from 6% in 2011.

zh: 另外还有通货膨胀的问题。
en: Inflation is another concern.

zh: 官方数据已经失去人民的信任，而私人分析机构则估计物价指数正以25%以上的年增长率不断攀升。
en: With official figures widely discredited, private analysts estimate that consumer prices are rising at an annual rate of 25% or more.

zh: 虽然上面那些都是严肃经济学家认真评估出来的结果，但你必须再次对这些经济预测持保留态度。
en: Those are careful estimates by serious economists. But, then again, one should take all economic forecasts about Argentina with a grain of salt.

zh: 自从十年前爆发经济危机之后，阿根廷的政策制定者们几乎违反了所有经济政策教科书中所必须遵守的原则。
en: In the decade since the last crisis, Argentine policymakers have broken almost every rule in the economic-policy playbook.

zh: 与此同时，本地和国外经济学家都警告说如果这种极端举动继续持续下去的话必将导致严重后果。
en: Again and again, local and international economists have issued dire warnings about what would happen if it persisted in its heterodoxy.

zh: 但阿根廷却实现了迅速增长，人均收入自2002年以来也已经翻了一番。
en: And yet Argentina has managed to grow fast, doubling per capita income since 2002.

zh: 能源政策恰好是政府决策失误的一个绝佳样本。
en: Energy policy is a perfect example of a wrongheaded strategy.

zh: 阿根廷政府在通胀不断的情况下坚持冻结了天然气价格。
en: The Argentine government fixed gas prices, despite ongoing inflation.

zh: 该价格被人为压低，以致消费者们根本不在意过多消耗，而投资者们则停止注资。
en: Gas became artificially cheap, consumers seldom bothered to turn the thermostat down, and producers stopped investing.

zh: 结果阿根廷这个曾经的天然气出口大国只能寻求天然气进口来填补国内短缺。
en: As a result Argentina, once a thriving gas exporter, had to seek imports to overcome domestic shortages.

zh: 而在过去十年帮了阿根廷一把的则是高度优越的外部环境。 高涨的全球商品价格和科技革新使农业产量大幅增长。
en: What saved Argentina over the last decade were highly favorable external conditions: sky-high global commodity prices and technological innovations that greatly increased farm yields.

zh: 邻国巴西的繁荣也提升了对各类阿根廷产品的需求。
en: Neighboring Brazil helped by undergoing a boom of its own, which pumped up demand for a wide range of Argentine products.

zh: 随着税收增加以及十年前违约之后卸掉了债务负担，政府开始了一场消费的狂欢：2002年后大部分时期实际公共支出都以两位数的速度增长。
en: With rising tax revenues and the burden of debt gone after the default a decade ago, the government went on a spending spree: real public expenditure grew at double-digit rates most years since 2002.

zh: 与此同时中央银行则维持低利率，因此贷款成本在考虑通胀因素后基本保持在零或是负数水平。
en: At the same time, the central bank kept interest rates low, so that the inflation-adjusted cost of loans is zero or negative.

zh: 在这个环境下，阿根廷消费者自然也开始大肆消费，而企业利润也因此上升。
en: In this environment, Argentine consumers naturally also went on a spending spree, and corporate profits rose accordingly.

zh: 就在不久之前我遇到了一批在阿根廷投资的外国投资者。
en: Not long ago, I met with a group of foreign investors in Argentina.

zh: 他们的项目从造纸厂到超市百货商店无所不包。
en: They owned everything from paper mills to department stores and supermarket chains.

zh: 在听完他们如何跟阿根廷政府那帮朝令夕改的官老爷们打交道的故事之后，我问他们为何要继续在阿根庭投资。
en: After they finished trading stories of endless red tape and arbitrary government decisions, I asked why they kept investing in Argentina.

zh: 而我得到的一致回答是“因为能赚大钱 ” 。
en: “Because we make a lot of money,” was the unanimous answer.

zh: 如今困扰阿根廷的问题则是这个繁荣时代是否已经走到了尽头。
en: The question making the rounds in Argentina nowadays is whether this period of plenty is coming to an end.

zh: 你无法在布宜诺斯艾利斯常年人头涌涌的商场里感受到任何恐慌的气氛，也无法通过选民的行为来推断这一点，因为他们似乎要在今年十月继续支持克里斯蒂娜·基什内尔连任总统。
en: You would not feel any such anxiety in Buenos Aires shopping malls, which are as crowded as ever. Nor could you infer it from the behavior of voters, who seem poised to re-elect President Cristina Kirchner in October.

zh: 但经济恶化的迹象其实已经有所显现了。
en: But the signs of economic deterioration are surely there.

zh: 一方面进口依然强劲，一方面商品价格由于全球增长放缓而下跌，阿根廷的大规模贸易顺差正在迅速缩水。
en: With imports still growing strongly and commodity prices beginning to fall as a result of the world slowdown, Argentina’s large trade surplus is disappearing quickly.

zh: 投资者们也如履薄冰，害怕阿根庭比索走弱的他们开始兑换美元。
en: Fearing a weaker peso, spooked investors demand dollars.

zh: 资本正不断流出这个国家，而政府储备也逐渐走向枯竭。
en: Capital is flowing out of the country, and official reserves are slowly being depleted.

zh: 为了遏制美元的流出，阿根庭中央银行很可能会提高利率。
en: To stem the outflow of dollars, the central bank may well be forced to raise interest rates.

zh: 而此举再加上悲观的国际预测以及必须在选举后转向紧缩的财政政策，阿根廷的经济增长将会放缓。
en: That, plus the gloomy international outlook and a fiscal policy that will have to become less expansionary after the election, will slow the economy down.

zh: 不过只要能平稳着陆的话，些许颠簸也是可以接受的。
en: A bumpy ride is acceptable as long as the landing is smooth.

zh: 而即将连任的克里斯蒂娜总统所面临的头等大事就是要确保稳定着陆。
en: Ensuring that outcome will be the number one job for a newly re-elected President Cristina Kirchner.

zh: 而对于那些掌舵人来说，这必将是一段充满挑战的时期。
en: It will prove a difficult period at the controls.

zh: 兀鹫的胜利
en: The Vultures’ Victory

zh: 纽约—美国上诉法院的最新决定可能会让全球主权债务市场天翻地覆，甚至会导致美国不再被视为发行主权债务的理想之地。
en: NEW YORK – A recent decision by a United States appeals court threatens to upend global sovereign-debt markets. It may even lead to the US no longer being viewed as a good place to issue sovereign debt.

zh: 从最轻的角度说，它让所有根据标准债务契约进行的债务重组都变得不可行。
en: At the very least, it renders non-viable all debt restructurings under the standard debt contracts.

zh: 在此过程中，当债务人无法偿还债权人时就需推倒重来这一现代资本主义的基本原则被颠覆了。
en: In the process, a basic principle of modern capitalism – that when debtors cannot pay back creditors, a fresh start is needed – has been overturned.

zh: 麻烦在十多年前就已经产生，当时阿根廷别无选择，只能贬值其货币和违约其债务。
en: The trouble began a dozen years ago, when Argentina had no choice but to devalue its currency and default on its debt.

zh: 在现有制度下，阿根廷处于如今为希腊和欧洲其他国家所熟知的快速下降螺旋中。
en: Under the existing regime, the country had been on a rapid downward spiral of the kind that has now become familiar in Greece and elsewhere in Europe.

zh: 失业率飙升，紧缩，而不是重塑财政平衡，只能放大经济下降之势。
en: Unemployment was soaring, and austerity, rather than restoring fiscal balance, simply exacerbated the economic downturn.

zh: 贬值和债务重组是有效的。
en: Devaluation and debt restructuring worked.

zh: 在此后几年中，直到2008年金融危机爆发前，阿根廷的年GDP增长率都保持8%或以上，为世界增长最快的国家之一。
en: In subsequent years, until the global financial crisis erupted in 2008, Argentina’s annual GDP growth was 8% or higher, one of the fastest rates in the world.

zh: 即便是此前的债权人，也从阿根廷的经济反弹中获了益。
en: Even former creditors benefited from this rebound.

zh: 阿根廷采取了极富创新精神的措施，用老债务换新债务 — — 大概是三折多一点的折算比例 — — 加上GDP指数债券。
en: In a highly innovative move, Argentina exchanged old debt for new debt – at about 30 cents on the dollar or a little more – plus a GDP-indexed bond.

zh: 阿根廷增长得越快，它偿付给前债权人的规模就越大。
en: The more Argentina grew, the more it paid to its former creditors.

zh: 阿根廷及其债权人的利益由此形成了一致：双方都希望增长。
en: Argentina’s interests and those of its creditors were thus aligned: both wanted growth.

zh: 这就好比是美国公司债务的“第十一章”重组，即用债券换股权，债券持有人成为新股东。
en: It was the equivalent of a “Chapter 11” restructuring of American corporate debt, in which debt is swapped for equity, with bondholders becoming new shareholders.

zh: 债务重组通常会造成不同利益人的冲突。
en: Debt restructurings often entail conflicts among different claimants.

zh: 这就是为何各国需要破产法和破产法庭来处理国内债务纠纷。
en: That is why, for domestic debt disputes, countries have bankruptcy laws and courts.

zh: 但在国际债务纠纷的裁定上就不存在这样一套制度。
en: But there is no such mechanism to adjudicate international debt disputes.

zh: 曾几何时，这样的契约由武力干预来强制实施，墨西哥、委内瑞拉、埃及和其他一些国家在十九世纪和二十世纪初以沉重的代价学到了这一教训。
en: Once upon a time, such contracts were enforced by armed intervention, as Mexico, Venezuela, Egypt, and a host of other countries learned at great cost in the nineteenth and early twentieth centuries.

zh: 阿根廷危机后，小布什政府否决了建立主权债务重组机制的方案。
en: After the Argentine crisis, President George W. Bush’s administration vetoed proposals to create a mechanism for sovereign-debt restructuring.

zh: 结果，我们就连试图进行公证有效的重组的姿态都不曾看到。
en: As a result, there is not even the pretense of attempting fair and efficient restructurings.

zh: 穷国在于多边贷款人讨价还价时处于严重劣势，后者往往有强大的本国政府撑腰。
en: Poor countries are typically at a huge disadvantage in bargaining with big multinational lenders, which are usually backed by powerful home-country governments.

zh: 通常，债务国会被紧逼还债，以至于隔几年后又要破产一次。
en: Often, debtor countries are squeezed so hard for payment that they are bankrupt again after a few years.

zh: 经济学家对阿根廷试图通过伴随GDP关联债权的深度重组避免这一结果赞不绝口。
en: Economists applauded Argentina’s attempt to avoid this outcome through a deep restructuring accompanied by the GDP-linked bonds.

zh: 但一些“兀鹫”基金 — — 特别是亿万富翁保罗·辛格（Paul E. Singer）领导的大名鼎鼎的对冲基金艾略特管理公司（Elliott Management ） — —将阿根廷的痛苦视为一次以阿根廷人民为代价攫取巨额利润的机会。
en: But a few “vulture” funds – most notoriously the hedge fund Elliott Management, headed by the billionaire Paul E. Singer – saw Argentina’s travails as an opportunity to make huge profits at the expense of the Argentine people.

zh: 他们以面值的几分之一买进老债券，然后通过诉讼迫使阿根廷十足偿付这些债券。
en: They bought the old bonds at a fraction of their face value, and then used litigation to try to force Argentina to pay 100 cents on the dollar.

zh: 美国人看到了金融企业如何将自身利益置于这些国家 — — 以及全世界 — — 之前。
en: Americans have seen how financial firms put their own interests ahead of those of the country – and the world.

zh: 兀鹫基金创造了贪婪的新境界。
en: The vulture funds have raised greed to a new level.

zh: 它们的诉讼战略利用了标准的契约条款（称为平权条款 ） ， 该条款的本意是确保所有债权人得到平等对待。
en: Their litigation strategy took advantage of a standard contractual clause (called pari passu) intended to ensure that all claimants are treated equally.

zh: 令人难以置信的是，美国纽约第二巡回上诉法院判决这意味着如果阿根廷十足偿付欠接受债务重组者的债务，那么它也必须十足偿付欠兀鹫基金的债务。
en: Incredibly, the US Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit in New York decided that this meant that if Argentina paid in full what it owed those who had accepted debt restructuring, it had to pay in full what it owed to the vultures.

zh: 如果这一原则推而广之，就不会有人接受重组。
en: If this principle prevails, no one would ever accept debt restructuring.

zh: 这绝不是推倒重来 — — 而是包含着无数令人不安的后果。
en: There would never be a fresh start – with all of the unpleasant consequences that this implies.

zh: 在债务危机中，人们的指责通常会落到债务人身上。
en: In debt crises, blame tends to fall on the debtors.

zh: 他们借得太多。
en: They borrowed too much.

zh: 但债权人的责任不亚于债务人 — — 它们贷得太多，太不谨慎。
en: But the creditors are equally to blame – they lent too much and imprudently.

zh: 事实上，贷款人理应是风险管理和评估专家，从这个角度讲，责任应该由他们承担。
en: Indeed, lenders are supposed to be experts on risk management and assessment, and in that sense, the onus should be on them.

zh: 违约或债务重组风险应该让债权人在贷款决策中更谨慎。
en: The risk of default or debt restructuring induces creditors to be more careful in their lending decisions.

zh: 这一显失公正的后果可能是长期的。
en: The repercussions of this miscarriage of justice may be felt for a long time.

zh: 毕竟，考虑人民长期利益的发展中国在准备通过美国金融系统发行债券时应该准备些什么？ 而美国法院 — — 及其政治体系内的其他许多部分 — — 似乎将坐视金融利益压倒公共利益。
en: After all, what developing country with its citizens’ long-term interests in mind will be prepared to issue bonds through the US financial system, when America’s courts – as so many other parts of its political system – seem to allow financial interests to trump the public interest?

zh: 各国将得到的一个好建议是在未来债务契约中不再加入平权条款，至少不会更具体地说明意图。
en: Countries would be well advised not to include pari passu clauses in future debt contracts, at least without specifying more fully what is intended.

zh: 契约还应该包括集体行动条款，使兀鹫基金无法作梗债务重组。
en: Such contracts should also include collective-action clauses, which make it impossible for vulture funds to hold up debt restructuring.

zh: 当足够比例的债权人批准重组计划时（在阿根廷的例子中，90%的该国债务持有人同意重组 ） ， 其他人也将被迫同意。
en: When a sufficient proportion of creditors agree to a restructuring plan (in the case of Argentina, the holders of more than 90% of the country’s debt did), the others can be forced to go along.

zh: IMF、美国司法部和减贫NGO都加入到反对兀鹫基金的行列这一事实很能说明问题。
en: The fact that the International Monetary Fund, the US Department of Justice, and anti-poverty NGOs all joined in opposing the vulture funds is revealing.

zh: 但是法庭的裁决也是如此，这对它们的观点没有什么作用。
en: But so, too, is the court’s decision, which evidently assigned little weight to their arguments.

zh: 对发展中和新兴市场国家的那些对发达国家怀恨在心的人来说，现在又有了新的理由反对用来保护富国利益（特别是其金融部门利益）的全球化。
en: For those in developing and emerging-market countries who harbor grievances against the advanced countries, there is now one more reason for discontent with a brand of globalization that has been managed to serve rich countries’ interests (especially their financial sectors’ interests).

zh: 全球金融危机爆发后，联合国国际货币和金融系统改革专家委员会敦促我们为重组主权债务设计有效而公平的制度。
en: In the aftermath of the global financial crisis, the United Nations Commission of Experts on Reforms of the International Monetary and Financial System urged that we design an efficient and fair system for the restructuring of sovereign debt.

zh: 美国法院带倾向性的裁决会带来沉重的经济代价，也显示了为什么我们现在需要这样一套制度。
en: The US court’s tendentious, economically dangerous ruling shows why we need such a system now.

zh: 阿根廷的能源难题
en: Argentina’s Energy Dilemma

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯—总统费尔南德斯以严厉的用词宣布没收西班牙雷普索尔公司（Repsol）在所持有的阿根廷能源生产商YPF的几乎全部股份，这在全世界拉响了法律警报。
en: BUENOS AIRES – The expropriation of nearly all of the Spanish company Repsol’s stake in Argentina’s energy producer YPF, announced in a vehement speech by President Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, has raised legal alarms worldwide.

zh: 事实上，在能源部门没有大规模投资流入的情况下，这并不能解决阿根廷的能源问题。
en: In fact, the move will not resolve the country’s energy problems in the absence of enormous inflows of investment to the sector.

zh: 雷普索尔于1999年收购了YPF的完全控股权；2008年2月，它将部分股权转让给了彼得森集团（Petersen Group ） ， 如今，后者持股量为25 % 。
en: Repsol acquired complete control of YPF in 1999; in February 2008, it transferred part of its shares to the Petersen Group, which today holds 25%.

zh: 雷普索尔现在则持有57%的股份，其余部分由股市投资者持有。
en: Repsol currently holds 57%, with the rest owned by stock-market investors.

zh: 阿根廷政府将没收51%的股份，这样普雷索尔将只持有6 % 。
en: The Argentine government intends to expropriate 51%, leaving Repsol with a 6% stake.

zh: 在2008年的股票发售中，两大主要股东同意将至少90%的未来利润以现金股利的形式发放。
en: In the 2008 sale of shares, the two majority stockholders agreed to distribute at least 90% of future profits in cash.

zh: 这一决定是为了让彼得森集团能够偿付对银行和普雷索尔债务。 在股票收购中，彼得森集团并没有付钱，而是赊账向普雷索尔进行了收购。
en: That decision was intended to allow the Petersen Group to service the debts to banks, and to Repsol itself, that it incurred with its share purchase, for which it made no initial payment.

zh: 如此分红在世界石油产业中可谓鹤立鸡群。
en: This is an extraordinarily high dividend in the world oil industry.

zh: 过去十年中，YPF的石油储备量大幅下降（其他大部分在阿根廷开展业务的石油公司也是如此 ） ， 因为石油勘探投资被大幅削减了。
en: In the past decade, YPF’s reserves diminished significantly, along with those of most oil companies operating in Argentina, because investment in exploration was greatly reduced.

zh: 与此同时，天然气占据了能源消费的51 % ， 石油占32 % ， 煤、可再生及水电核电占17 % 。
en: At the same time, natural gas accounts for 51% of energy consumption, compared to 32% for oil and barely 17% for coal, renewables, and hydroelectric and nuclear power.

zh: 从全世界看，天然气只占能源总消费量的四分之一左右 — — 比如在美国为27 % ， 在邻国巴西为9 % 。
en: Worldwide, gas accounts for barely a quarter of total energy consumption – for example, 27% in the United States and just 9% in neighboring Brazil.

zh: 阿根廷汽车使用压缩天然气为燃料的比例世界最高；家庭也大量使用天然气；大部分电力由天然气提供；石化行业也建立在天然气的基础上。
en: Argentina has the world’s largest fleet of vehicles running on compressed natural gas; families use gas intensively; most electricity is generated with gas; and the petrochemical industry is based on it.

zh: 当然，在某些别的国家（卡塔尔、阿尔及利亚、阿联酋、伊朗和俄罗斯 ） ， 天然气也占据能源消费的一半甚至六成以上。
en: Of course, in a few other countries (Qatar, Algeria, the United Arab Emirates, Iran, and Russia), gas also accounts for more than half – or even more than 60% – of energy consumption.

zh: 但它们的情况与阿根廷有着绝大不同：它们无不拥有至少够用70—100年的储量。
en: But there is an enormous difference: all of these countries have reserves that will last another 70-100 years.

zh: 而阿根廷作为高度依赖天然气的国家，其储量却在日渐减少，大概只相当于八年的产量。
en: Argentina, by contrast, is a highly gas-dependent country with diminishing reserves – equivalent to less than eight years of production.

zh: 用进口弥补储量的下降 — — 大约一半的天然气储量和五分之一石油储量已经被用掉了 — — 意味着每年要花去3000亿美元以上的成本。
en: Covering this drop in reserves – more than half of gas reserves and a fifth of oil reserves have been consumed – with imports implies an annual cost of more than $300 billion.

zh: 事实上，在经历了20年廉价充足的能源供应（甚至还有余量可供出口 ） ， 新的昂贵、稀缺、进口能源周期已经开始。 石油产量自1998年以来下降了三分之一，天然气产量自2004年以来下降了15 % 。
en: Indeed, after two decades of cheap, abundant energy and exports of surplus output, a new cycle of expensive, scarce, and imported energy has begun, as oil production has fallen by one-third since 1998, and gas production by 15% since 2004.

zh: 如今，阿根廷最大的挑战是通过大力投资陆上和大西洋矿井勘探保持自给自足。
en: Argentina’s greatest challenge today is to try to regain energy self-sufficiency through significant investment in exploration on land, as well as in the Atlantic Ocean.

zh: 与此同时，阿根廷还必须改变消费模式，更多地依靠水电、核能和风能。
en: At the same time, the country must modify its consumption model through greater reliance on hydroelectric, nuclear, and wind energy.

zh: 非常规资源潜力无限，但无不成本极高，需要在未来五年内每年拿出GDP的3%进行投资。
en: While there is great potential for new non-conventional resources, all of this is expensive, requiring annual investment of about 3% of GDP over the next five years.

zh: 极有可能的是，在短期内，增加液化天然气和其他冉柳的进口将继续增加变革压力。
en: It is very likely that, in the short term, growing imports of expensive liquid natural gas and other fuels will continue to exert pressure for change.

zh: 去年，外部能源赤字已达30亿美元以上，今年可能会继续翻番。
en: Last year, the external energy deficit was more than $3 billion, and this year it is expected to double.

zh: 一个重要的问题是，阿根廷政府将YPF51%的股权国有化的决定是不是石油和天然气生产重回自给自足的最佳办法，是不是吸引所需资本来进行常规能源储量勘探开发的最佳办法。
en: The important question is whether the Argentine government’s decision to nationalize 51% of YPF’s shares is the best way to recover self-sufficiency in oil and gas production, and to attract the capital needed for exploration and development of conventional reserves.

zh: 阿根廷也拥有生产非常规天然气资源的无穷潜力，因为它拥有仅次于中国和美国的世界第三大储量。
en: Argentina has particularly high potential for production of non-conventional gas resources as well, given that it holds the world’s third-highest level of such reserves, after China and the United States.

zh: 但是，这些资源和阿根廷的常规资源一起等待着开发，而不会自己冒出来。
en: But, as with the country’s conventional resources, these reserves will not produce themselves.

zh: 阿根廷对欧元区准逃兵发出的警告
en: Argentina’s Warning to Would-Be Euro Deserters

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯 — —
en: BUENOS AIRES – The tensions between the eurozone’s north and south, and the complex and politically costly transfers of money required to dampen the euro crisis, have led many people to think the unthinkable: saving Europe’s common currency may require that some countries abandon it. Indeed, talk about exiting the euro has intensified, particularly in southern eurozone countries that desperately need to regain competitiveness.

zh: 近来，欧元区南北国家的关系日趋紧张，手续复杂及政治繁琐的资金转移成本加重了欧元危机，这使得一些人开始考虑过去从未想过的选项：或许只有一些国家的退出才能拯救欧元。
en: Adopting a stronger currency (as in “euroization”) is neither difficult nor particularly unusual.

zh: 实际上，有关退出欧元区的讨论日趋激烈，特别是一些南欧国家，它们急需重新获得竞争力。 但首先我们先来看看退出欧元的真正代价。
en: Introducing a new, weaker national currency to substitute for a stronger one in times of financial distress is an altogether different matter, about which most economists know almost nothing.

zh: 但在金融乱局中引人一个全新贬值的国家货币来代替欧元则是完全是另一回事情，绝大多数经济学家对此一无所知。 回顾历史，和这个最为接近的恐怕是2002年的阿根廷退出锁定美元的汇率机制（连系汇率制度）自由浮动，阿根廷比索在头三个月内就贬值了300 % 。
en: The closest experiment along these lines is probably Argentina’s exit in 2002 from its dollar exchange-rate peg (embodied in its currency board) to a floating regime that depreciated the peso by 300% in the first three months.

zh: 虽然阿根廷和南欧经济体有着明显的区别，但阿根廷汇率过山车事件为欧洲的领导层提供了一个值得深思的借鉴。
en: Despite Argentina’s obvious differences from the eurozone’s troubled southern economies, the Argentine currency rollercoaster provides sobering lessons for European policymakers to ponder.

zh: 欧洲人是否也想有着自己版本的自由的“比索 ” ？
en: Do Europeans want to return to their own version of a flexible “peso”?

zh: 欧洲领导人至少应该做到（a ） “ 救赎”合同 ， （ b）对商业银行的业务严格限制 ， （ c）债务重组 ， （ d）对资本和汇率采取严格管控机制。
en: At the very least, European policymakers will need to be willing to (a) “pesify” contracts, (b) impose heavy restrictions on commercial banking operations, (c) restructure debts, and (d) introduce capital and exchange controls.

zh: 让我们来仔细推敲每一步，首先，新货币要和欧元建立兑换机制，以确立自身地位，这就需要通盘考虑物价，货币和金融合同等因素，强行制定出与欧元的汇率。
en: Consider each facet more closely. First, a new currency needs to create its own demand as a means in which to conduct commercial transactions by displacing the euro as sole legal tender and unit of account.

zh: 由于严重不对称的资产负债表而引发严重的混乱及巨大的财富再分配效应。
en: This, in turn, requires the forced redenomination of prices, wages, and financial contracts, which can create serious disruptions, owing to heavy and asymmetrical balance-sheet effects, as well as a massive redistributive impact.

zh: 阿根廷对银行存贷款的“整顿重组”是建立在牺牲广大储户利益之上，从而引发了社会动荡。
en: Argentina´s “pesification” of bank deposits and loans benefited debtors at the expense of depositors, inciting public upheaval.

zh: 第二，一旦有国家退出欧元区，就会引发银行恐慌，储户们争相挤兑和将手中的货币兑换成为外币并转移国外。
en: Second, should any eurozone country quit the euro, the anticipation of forced pesification is likely to set off a bank panic, as depositors quickly switch their pesified holdings back into foreign exchange in order to move them out of the system and probably abroad.

zh: 实际上，在阿根廷实现退出机制的一年之前，人们就开始纷纷提出存款。 资本的逃离又反过来加速了比索和美元的脱钩进程 — — 如果这发生在经济一体化的欧元区，这样的速度还会更快更疯狂。
en: In fact, in Argentina, people started to withdraw their deposits almost a year before the exit from the currency board, fueling capital flight and feeding back into market pressures to abandon the peg to the dollar – a dynamic that could be even faster and more furious in financially integrated European economies.

zh: 于是，有选择的冻结存款将是避免银行破产的唯一选项。
en: In these circumstances, a selective deposit freeze appears to be the only option to avoid bankrupting the banking sector.

zh: 这里，阿根廷就是一个正反面的例子。
en: Here, Argentina offers both a good and a bad example.

zh: 当2001年11月对所有的存款都采取冻结时，由于市场缺乏流动性而加重经济危机，最终导致政府下台。
en: When all deposit withdrawals were capped in November 2001, the resulting liquidity crunch deepened the recession and, eventually, brought down the government.

zh: 相反的，2002年1月对定期存款的重组减少对银行的挤兑，逐渐恢复正常取款业务，同时允许活期存款来满足比索的需求。
en: By contrast, the restructuring of term deposits in January 2002 attenuated the bank run and kept the payments system alive, while allowing so-called “sight deposits” – which can be withdrawn immediately without penalty – to help build demand for pesos.

zh: 第三，虽然“比索化”清除了资产负债表中的国内外汇债务损失，但外债却不能单方面重组。
en: Third, while pesification removes balance sheet losses from domestic foreign-currency debts, external contractual obligations cannot be redenominated unilaterally.

zh: 退出美元机制需要对国家和公司外债进行重组。
en: Thus, the exit from the dollar peg requires a restructuring of external debt, both sovereign and corporate.

zh: 实际上，阿根廷国债违约发生在货币局汇率制度撤销的同时，但公司债务的谈判是一个漫长的过程。
en: Indeed, Argentina’s sovereign default happened almost simultaneously with the demise of the currency board, but corporate renegotiations were a protracted affair.

zh: 最终，绝大多数公司没有破产，主要是由于阿根廷退出方案中的第四条：资本管制给公司外债争取到了时间和法律保护。
en: Eventually, most companies avoided bankruptcy, mainly owing to the fourth ingredient in Argentina´s exit toolkit: capital controls that provided the legal umbrella to stop external corporate debt servicing.

zh: 当然，管制是必须的。
en: Of course, controls are an inevitable ingredient in the exit mix.

zh: 贬值货币也是为了刺激出口，重新获得市场上的竞争力。
en: Adopting a weaker currency is predicated on the need to regain competitiveness and improve external accounts.

zh: 但短期来看，王朝的变更带来巨大的不确定性，无法进入资本市场会出现债务重新谈判，外汇极度紧缺，这都需要对资本流动采取相对大程度方方面面��管制，有些管制来的更为严格。
en: But, in the short run, given the huge uncertainties involved in a regime switch, and the loss of access to capital markets that follows a debt renegotiation, foreign exchange becomes scarce, requiring a plethora of traditional restrictions – some more distorting than others – on capital movements.

zh: 对欧洲来说，在冻结银行存款和货币兑换之后，对资本流动的控制是避免离岸金融的唯一手段。
en: In Europe, too, capital controls would be the only way to avoid the offshoring of financial settlements after the currency conversion and the freezing of bank deposits.

zh: 不管怎么说，退出欧元的同时而不管制资本流动是痴人说梦。
en: At any rate, experience indicates that exiting the euro while preserving the freedom of capital movements is little more than a fantasy.

zh: 一些观察人士建议，鉴于阿根廷事件的教训，在重新引入本国贬值货币时，只能将其运用在工资和一些特定产品的定价上，同时不能完全抛弃欧元。
en: Some observers suggest, based on Argentina’s precedent, that countries should introduce their own weaker currency to denominate wages and selected prices without leaving the euro.

zh: 我认为这不可行。
en: We believe this analogy is misconstrued.

zh: 当时的阿根廷在放弃连系汇率制度之前的2001年确实发行了一种代用货币，以此满足财政需求和保持兑美元的稳定汇率。
en: While Argentina did issue quasi-money in 2001 before abandoning the currency board, this money was conceived to meet fiscal needs and remained stable vis-à-vis the dollar.

zh: 实际上，可以想象，一旦代用货币贬值，这种双货币机制很难避免兑换成币值较低的可能性，这个想法最终以失败告终。
en: Indeed, it is hard to imagine how this dual-currency scheme could have avoided the consequences of converting to a weaker currency if the quasi-money had depreciated, as the idea’s current promoters intend.

zh: 阿根廷退出锁定美元事件是一场灾难，它导致大量的合同违约，财富重新分配，破产，储户挤兑存款，汇率限制，短期内对资本流动的严格限制。
en: Argentina’s exit from its dollar peg was a traumatic experience, concentrating contract violations, wealth redistribution, defaults, bank runs, exchange restrictions, and severe limitations on capital movements into a short period of time.

zh: 即便如此，这也会比引入一个新希腊“德拉克马”要好的多。
en: Even so, it was simpler than introducing a “new drachma” would be for, say, Greece.

zh: 因为阿根廷货币局从来没有取缔过比索，即便最糟糕的时候，比索的需求还是客观存在。
en: Because Argentina’s currency board never eliminated the peso as the main means of transactions, the basis for demand for it was there at the time of the blowup.

zh: 相比于退出欧元的国家而言，他们将不得不为新货币创造出需求 — — 这将是更加混乱糟糕的事情。
en: Euro defectors, by contrast, would need to promote demand for the new currency from scratch – a much messier and nastier process altogether.

zh: 里约成绩单
en: A Rio Report Card

zh: 纽约 — — 全世界优秀的科学出版物之一《自然》刚刚赶在下周举行的里约+20可持续发展首脑会议前公布了措辞严厉的成绩单。
en: NEW YORK – One of the world’s pre-eminent scientific publications, Nature, has just issued a scathing report card in advance of next week’s Rio+20 summit on sustainable development.

zh: 1992年首届里约地球峰会签署的三项伟大条约执行成绩如下：气候变化－F，生物多样性－F，防治荒漠化－F。 人类究竟还能否避免被开除球籍的厄运？
en: The grades for implementation of the three great treaties signed at the first Rio Earth Summit in 1992 were as follows: Climate Change – F; Biological Diversity – F; and Combating Desertification – F. Can humanity still avoid getting itself expelled?

zh: 整整一代人早已明白世界需要改变发展道路。
en: We have known for at least a generation that the world needs a course correction.

zh: 我们需要更多地利用风能、太阳能和地热发电等低碳替代能源，而不能继续依靠化石燃料来推动世界经济。
en: Instead of powering the world economy with fossil fuels, we need to mobilize much greater use of low-carbon alternatives such as wind, solar, and geothermal power.

zh: 我们需要调整农业及渔业生产以适应环境的承载能力，而不能在毫不顾忌对其他物种影响的情况下狩猎、捕鱼和砍伐树木。
en: Instead of hunting, fishing, and clearing land without regard for the impact on other species, we need to pace our agricultural production, fishing, and logging in line with the environment’s carrying capacity.

zh: 我们需要结束极端贫困并降低世界最贫困地区快速增长的生育率，而不能坐视全球最弱势群体得不到计划生育，教育和基本医疗保健等服务。
en: Instead of leaving the world’s most vulnerable people without access to family planning, education, and basic health care, we need to end extreme poverty and reduce the soaring fertility rates that persist in the poorest parts of the world.

zh: 简言之，我们需要认识到今天的70亿人口在本世纪中叶可能达到90亿，所有人在高科技驱使的能源密集型全球经济中都拥有非常密切的联系，因此我们作为整体掌握着前所未有的毁坏​​地球生命支持系统的能力。
en: In short, we need to recognize that with seven billion people today, and nine billion by mid-century, all inter-connected in a high-tech, energy-intensive global economy, our collective capacity to destroy the planet’s life-support systems is unprecedented.

zh: 但通常个人行为的后果离我们的日常生活如此遥远，以致于我们可能在浑然不觉中跌下悬崖摔得粉身碎骨。
en: Yet the consequences of our individual actions are typically so far removed from our daily awareness that we can go right over the cliff without even knowing it.

zh: 我们打开电脑和电灯时，并不了解会造成多少碳排放。
en: When we power our computers and lights, we are unaware of the carbon emissions that result.

zh: 我们用餐时，也不知道不可持续的耕作导致了多少森林砍伐。
en: When we eat our meals, we are unaware of the deforestation that has resulted from unsustainable farming.

zh: 当数十亿件微不足道的小事共同造成地球另一面爆发饥荒和洪水，折磨马里和肯尼亚等旱灾频发地区最贫困民众的时候，很少有人对全球网络的危险圈套有最基本的认识。
en: And when billions of our actions combine to create famines and floods halfway around the world, afflicting the poorest people in drought-prone Mali and Kenya, few of us are even dimly aware of the dangerous snares of global interconnectedness.

zh: 20年前，世界试图通过条约和国际法解决上述现实问题。
en: Twenty years ago, the world tried to address these realities through treaties and international law.

zh: 1992年首届里约峰会达成的协议用心良苦：深思熟虑、高瞻远瞩，热心公益，并集中关注全球重点问题。
en: The agreements that emerged in 1992 at the first Rio summit were good ones: thoughtful, far-sighted, public-spirited, and focused on global priorities.

zh: 但协议却没有能够拯救人类。
en: Yet they have not saved us.

zh: 上述条约笼罩在我们日常政治、幻想和媒体周期的阴影之下。 外交官年复一年地参与会议落实这些条约，但却摆脱不了忽视、延误和争论合法性的结果。
en: Those treaties lived in the shadow of our daily politics, imaginations, and media cycles.  Diplomats trudged off to conferences year after year to implement them, but the main results were neglect, delay, and bickering over legalities.

zh: 二十年来，我们付出的努力只换来三项不及格的成绩。
en: Twenty years on, we have only three failing grades to show for our efforts.

zh: 那还有没有其他方法？
en: Is there a different way?

zh: 国际法涉及律师和外交官，但却没有在可持续发展的前沿领域吸引工程师、科学家和社团领导人的参与。
en: The path through international law engages lawyers and diplomats, but not the engineers, scientists, and community leaders on the front lines of sustainable development.

zh: 到处充斥着有关监督、约束性义务、附件一及非附件一国家和成千上万其他法律条文的技术性条款，但却没有为人类提供一种语言来讨论自身的生存。
en: It is littered with technical arcana about monitoring, binding obligations, annex-I and non-annex-I countries, and thousands of other legalisms, but has failed to give humanity the language to discuss our own survival.

zh: 我们拥有数以千计的文件，但却无法坦率地进行沟通。
en: We have thousands of documents but a failure to speak plainly to one other.

zh: 我们想不想拯救自己和孩子？
en: Do we want to save ourselves and our children?

zh: 我们为什么不这样说？
en: Why didn’t we say so?

zh: 我们必须在里约+20峰会上果断地表述清楚，进而解决问题并采取行动，而不是继续喋喋不休地争吵和自我保护。
en: At Rio+20 we will have to say so, clearly, decisively, and in a way that leads to problem-solving and action, not to bickering and defensiveness.

zh: 由于政治家顺应民意而不是领导民意，因此不能指望当选官员在公众不知情的情况下拯救公众，而必须由公众自身明确地提出生存要求。
en: Since politicians follow public opinion rather than lead it, it must be the public itself that demands its own survival, not elected officials who are somehow supposed to save us despite ourselves.

zh: 政界没有几个人可以称得上英雄，因此根本不可能等待政治家做出决策。
en: There are few heroes in politics; waiting for the politicians would be to wait too long.

zh: 因此里约最重要的成果不是新条约、约束性条款或者政治承诺，而是呼吁在全世界采取行动。
en: The most important outcome in Rio, therefore, will not be a new treaty, binding clause, or political commitment. It will be a global call to action.

zh: 世界各国异口同声地要求将可持续发展置于全球思想和行动的中心，尤其是协助年轻人应对三重底线带来的挑战 — — 即经济福祉、环��可持续性和社会包容 — — 如何应对上述挑战将决定他们时代的特色。 里约+20峰会可以协助他们达到目的。
en: Around the world, the cry is rising to put sustainable development at the center of global thinking and action, especially to help young people to solve the triple-bottom-line challenge – economic well-being, environmental sustainability, and social inclusion – that will define their era. Rio+20 can help them to do it.

zh: 我们需要的不是新条约，而是里约+20峰会采用能激励一代人采取行动的全套可持续发展目标，也叫SDG。
en: Rather than a new treaty, let us adopt at Rio+20 a set of Sustainable Development Goals, or SDGs, that will inspire a generation to act.

zh: 正如千年发展目标让我们认识到极端贫困并促成了前所未有的抗击艾滋病、结核和疟疾的全球行动，SDG可以让今天的年轻人清醒地认识到气候变化、生物多样性丧失以及荒漠化灾害。
en: Just as the Millennium Development Goals opened our eyes to extreme poverty and promoted unprecedented global action to fight AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria, the SDGs can open the eyes of today’s youth to climate change, biodiversity loss, and the disasters of desertification.

zh: 通过敦促人们站在行动的前沿，我们仍然可以兑现之前签署的三项里约协议。
en: We can still make good on the three Rio treaties, by putting people at the forefront of the effort.

zh: 结束极端贫困；建设脱碳能源系统；放慢人口增长；促进可持续粮食供应；保护海洋、森林和旱地；以及纠正我们这个时代存在的不平等能够激励一代人去发挥价值，解决问题。 从硅谷到圣保罗到班加罗尔再到上海，工程师和技术高手对拯救世界的想法全都胸有成竹。
en: SDGs to end extreme poverty; decarbonize the energy system; slow population growth; promote sustainable food supplies; protect the oceans, forests, and drylands; and redress the inequalities of our time can galvanize a generation’s worth of problem-solving.  Engineers and technology wizards from Silicon Valley to São Paolo to Bangalore to Shanghai have world-saving ideas up their sleeves.

zh: 世界各地的大学是有意为各自所在的团体和国家解决实际问题的大批学生和教师的大本营。
en: Universities around the world are home to legions of students and faculty intent on solving practical problems in their communities and countries.

zh: 而至少好的企业知道除非自己成为解决方案的一部分，否则将无法蓬勃发展并激励自己的工人和消费者。
en: Businesses, at least the good ones, know that they can’t flourish and motivate their workers and consumers unless they are part of the solution.

zh: 世界正准备采取行动。
en: The world is poised to act.

zh: 里约+20峰会可以促成一代人迈出行动的脚步。
en: Rio+20 can help to unleash a generation of action.

zh: 我们勉强还有时间将F变成A，并通过这次人类的终极考试。
en: There is still time, just barely, to turn the F’s to A’s, and to pass humanity’s ultimate test.

zh: 武器，或是同盟？
en: Arms or Allies?

zh: 发自里加 — — 当许多拉托维亚人还在为法国向俄罗斯出售两栖攻击舰而吃惊不已时，其他欧盟成员国却已开始将俄罗斯视为潜在的军火买家了。
en: RIGA – It should surprise no one that many in Latvia view the sale by France of fully-equipped assault warships to Russia with grave concern. Other European Union member states seem to be looking increasingly towards Russia as a potential purchaser of military equipment.

zh: 但欧盟和北约成员国这种提升非盟国兵力投送能力的举动是否明智？
en: But is it wise for EU and NATO members to enhance the capacity of non-allies to project their military power?

zh: 毕竟俄罗斯入侵格鲁吉亚还仅仅是两年半以前的事，甚至至今仍占据着这个北约所谓“潜在未来成员国”的一部分领土。
en: After all, only two and a half years ago, Russia invaded Georgia, a country that NATO had named as a potential future member, and has occupied part of it ever since.

zh: 欧盟理事会针对武器出口行为的共同立场对所有成员国都具有法律约束力。
en: The EU Council’s common position on arms exports is legally binding on all EU states.

zh: 当然，对武器出口控制以及许可的权限和责任则属于成员国自身，而非欧盟机构。
en: Of course, competence and responsibility for arms-export controls and licensing rests with member states, not EU institutions.

zh: 事实上在“瓦森纳安排 ” （ 全球33个国家建立的常规武器和军/民双用途物资及技术出口控制机制）下，各成员国可以自行决定是否出口武器。
en: Indeed, under the Wassenaar Arrangement, a decision on exports is the sole responsibility of each participating state.

zh: 欧盟在武器出口方面的共同立场为我们带来了更多的信息交流，更高的透明度以及更密切的磋商，同时也协调了与武器出口控制相关的一系列条约和规程。
en: Implementation of the common EU position on arms exports has led to more exchanges of information, greater transparency, and closer consultation. It has also harmonized export-control arrangements and procedures.

zh: 但这一机制的潜力仍未能完全发挥出来。
en: But there are obvious limits to what can be achieved.

zh: 磋商目前还仅限于两国之间，同时缺乏指导磋商的相关行为准则 — — 也不要求达成任何关于武器出口决策的最后协议。
en: Consultations are currently a bilateral matter, with no rules governing how they should be conducted – and no requirement that any final agreement on arms-export decisions be reached.

zh: 因此这一磋商机制的有效性也极难评估。
en: The effectiveness of this consultation mechanism is difficult to evaluate.

zh: 依照共同立场条款，某一国颁发武器出口许可证之前必须与曾经拒绝颁发类似许可证的另一成员国进行磋商。
en: According to the common position’s provisions, before a member state grants an export license, it should consult with any member state that has previously denied a similar license.

zh: 但相关条款却并未明确说明这种磋商究竟要达到何种程度。
en: But the common position does not specify the extent to which another member state should be consulted.

zh: 更重要的是，它并不要求武器出口国与其他可能关注该项出口的国家进行磋商。
en: More importantly, it does not require the arms-exporting member state to consult with any other member state that might have concerns.

zh: 于是对第三国的武器出口问题就一直困扰着欧盟。
en: As a result, arms exports to third countries remain a contentious issue within the EU.

zh: 而该问题的核心则是各成员国之间的核心利益冲突 — — 欧洲各大武器厂商之间的竞争，还有防务市场的战略重要性（尤其是牵涉到各国外交政策的时候 ） — —以及特别强调增强团结与磋商机制的里斯本条约
en: At the heart of the matter is a conflict between the individual member states’ national interests – the competitiveness of European defense-related companies and the strategic importance of defense markets when linked to national foreign policy – and the Lisbon treaty, which refers specifically to enhanced solidarity and consultation.

zh: 如果我们希望遵重里斯本条约精神的话，那么团结必须被视为一个重要的政治工具，并以此实现一个服务于集体利益的欧洲防御政策。
en: If the Lisbon treaty is to be respected, solidarity must be viewed as a political tool for moving towards a European defense policy that works for the common good.

zh: 而各国在技术转让方面对各自国家政策的追求则与该目标背道而驰。
en: Pursuing solely national policies on technology transfer runs contrary to that goal.

zh: 因此必须出台相关法则来对磋商机制进行更清晰的阐述，而出口武器的欧盟成员国必须与所有利益相关成员国进行协商，而不仅限于那些曾签发（或禁止）类似许可证的国家。
en: Clearer rules for the consultation mechanism need to be elaborated, and arms-exporting EU member states should consult all other member governments that might have concerns, not only those that have previously issued or denied an export license.

zh: 通过各方对第三国行为的可预见性和稳定性达成共识的方式，欧盟可以最终构建一个共同的武器出口政策。
en: The EU could work towards a common arms-export policy by seeking a shared understanding of the predictability and stability of third-party countries.

zh: 但对第三国武器出口共同政策的制定进程不可孤立运行，同时还需要建立一个共有且具备国际竞争力的欧洲防务市场。
en: Developing a common policy on arms exports to such countries should go hand in hand with the creation of a common and internationally competitive European defense-equipment market.

zh: 这意味着与非欧盟成员国的合作不应对欧盟内部的团结和共同原则造成损害。
en: This means that cooperation with non-EU countries should not be to the detriment of solidarity and common rules within the EU.

zh: 尽早进行磋商有助于消弭误解 — — 这些误解通常会在媒体的添油加醋下不断加深，即便交易还远未达成 — — 并因此增强欧盟成员国之间的团结一致。
en: Consulting at an early stage would help manage misperceptions – often fueled by reports in the media long before deals are concluded – and thus strengthen convergence and unity among EU member states.

zh: 在各成员国意见不一的情况下，欧盟应当扮演一个更重要的角色。
en: Giving the EU a greater role in situations where member states’ views differ should also be considered.

zh: 比如成员国可以在政治和安全委员会内部就某些敏感或争议性事务进行协商。
en: For example, member states could consult on sensitive or contentious issues within the Political and Security Committee.

zh: 这将增强欧盟理事会共同立场的影响力，更何况这一立场已经对军事技术和设备的出口管制提出了大概的原则。
en: This would strengthen the EU Council’s common position, which already defines general rules for the control of exports of military technology and equipment.

zh: 对北约来说，盟国之间的磋商问题已经在《北大西洋公约》的第4条中进行了界定 ： “ 无论何时任何一缔约国认为缔约国中任何一国领土之完整，政治独立或安全遭受威胁，各缔约国应共同协商。 ”
en: As for NATO, the question of consultations among allies is addressed in Article 4 of the North Atlantic Treaty, which states that, “the Parties will consult together whenever, in the opinion of any of them, the territorial integrity, political independence, or security of any of the Parties is threatened.”

zh: 但上述第四条仅仅是针对即将到来的威胁。
en: But Article 4 does not relate only to imminent threats.

zh: 一个北约成员国的决策可以影响到其他盟国。
en: Decisions taken by a NATO country can have implications for other allies.

zh: 对第三国的军事装备和技术转让可能影响到区域安全，并因此要对威胁态势进行重新评估。
en: The transfer of military equipment and technology to third countries could affect regional security and prompt a revision of threat assessments.

zh: 北大西洋理事会显然可以作为一个增进成员国团结，消除成员国对各种威胁的恐惧并避免误解的论坛而存在。
en: The North Atlantic Council would seem an obvious forum within which to enhance solidarity among members, reassure member states that have perceptions of greater vulnerability, and avoid misperceptions.

zh: 在更底层级上，政治和伙伴关系委员会和/或国家军事力量主管会议可以用作初步磋商。
en: At a lower level, the Political and Partnership Committee and/or the Conference of National Armaments Directors could be used for initial consultations.

zh: 这些事务与所有盟国都利益攸关，因此讨论也不应局限于两个国家之间。
en: These issues are of concern to all allies, so discussions should not be confined to bilateral agendas.

zh: 武器贸易和技术转让无疑会引发众多道德和伦理问题，因此也必须在盟国之间进行公开且增强信心的讨论。
en: Arms sales and technology transfers inevitably raise complex moral and ethical questions. That is all the more reason to seek open, confidence-reinforcing discussions among allies.

zh: 如果众多重要机构都被排除在外的话，团结是无法实现的。
en: Solidarity cannot be achieved when our most important institutions are excluded.

zh: 事实上，欧盟和北约曾经做出的某些最危险的决策，都是那些事前未被公开讨论过的决定。
en: Indeed, some of the most dangerous decisions taken in both the EU and NATO are those that are not openly discussed beforehand.

zh: 迈向免疫的世界
en: Toward an Immunized World

zh: 阿布扎比/纽约—对一名孩子来说，接种疫苗只要几秒钟（大概还要搭上几滴眼泪 ） 。
en: ABU DHABI/NEW YORK – For a child, receiving a vaccine takes just a moment (and perhaps a few tears).

zh: 但这几秒种对于让他获得健康的生命起点、让全球健康和发展目标获得进步来说是至关重要的。
en: But such moments are crucial for getting children off to a healthy start in life, and for advancing progress on global health and development goals.

zh: 与阿布扎比太子阿勒纳哈扬（Mohamed bin Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan）一起，我们将论述第一届旨在确保所有儿童都能获得疫苗的全部好处的全球峰会的巨大意义。 此次峰会将于本周在阿布扎比举行。
en: Along with Mohamed bin Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan, Crown Prince of Abu Dhabi, we attach great importance to the world’s first global summit, being held this week in Abu Dhabi, aimed at ensuring that all children have access to the full benefits of vaccines.

zh: 疫苗为人们提供终生保护。
en: Vaccines protect people for a lifetime.

zh: 它们是改善世界的最廉价的投资。
en: They are one of the most cost-effective investments we can make to improve our world.

zh: 疫苗让我们根除了天花，几乎根除了小儿麻痹症，从麻疹、白喉、破伤风和其他致命致残疾病手中拯救了数百万儿童。
en: Vaccines have eradicated smallpox, pushed polio to the verge of eradication, and saved millions of children from measles, diphtheria, tetanus, and other deadly and disabling diseases.

zh: 由于疫苗的作用，5岁前夭折的儿童数量从1960年的2000万降至2011年的690万，而且这是在地球人口大量增长的条件下实现的。
en: Thanks in large part to the power of vaccines, the number of children dying before the age of five has fallen from 20 million in 1960 to 6.9 million in 2011, despite a large increase in global population.

zh: 疾病会侵蚀一国所拥有的最宝贵财富：人民的能量和天才。
en: Disease saps the greatest asset that any country possesses: the energy and talent of its people.

zh: 对于寻求立足全球经济的穷国来说，代价尤其沉重。
en: This is an especially harsh loss for poor countries seeking to gain a foothold in the global economy.

zh: 而若儿童健康，家庭就能从沉重的医疗负担中摆脱，将更多的钱用于食品和教育。
en: But when children are healthy, families are freed from the burden of costly medical care, allowing them to spend more on food and education.

zh: 健康的孩子能稳定地上学，获得更好的学习能力，将来成为生产率更高的成年人。
en: Healthy children attend school more regularly, are better able to learn, and become more productive adults.

zh: 新研究表明，疫苗能改善孩子的认知发展，提高劳动力生产率，有助于一国的总体经济增长。
en: New research shows that vaccines improve cognitive development in children, raise labor productivity, and contribute to a country’s overall economic growth.

zh: 但超过2200万的孩子缺少获得基本疫苗的手段，而基本疫苗在高收入国家已是理所当然的福利。
en: Yet more than 22 million children lack access to the basic vaccines that people in high-income countries take for granted.

zh: 这些孩子生活在最贫穷、最偏远的社区，患病风险也最高。
en: These children live in the poorest and most remote communities, where the risk of disease is highest.

zh: 生于低收入国家的孩子在5岁前夭折的可能性比高收入国家孩子高18倍。
en: A child born in a low-income country is 18 times more likely to die before reaching the age of five than a child in a high-income country.

zh: 结束这一不平等状况是历史上最大、最成功的减贫项目 — — 千年发展目标的核心。
en: Ending this inequity is at the heart of history’s largest and most successful anti-poverty push – the Millennium Development Goals.

zh: 2000年，各国领导人齐聚联合国，定下了八个千年发展目标，一致同意减少一半的极端贫困和饥饿、战胜病魔、改善水安全和卫生、扩大教育、赋予女孩和妇女更多权利。
en: The eight MDGs were adopted in the year 2000, when leaders meeting at the United Nations agreed to cut extreme poverty and hunger by half, fight disease, improve water safety and sanitation, expand education, and empower girls and women.

zh: 成就是斐然的，但仍有很多事情有待完成 — — 而现在距离2015年的最后时限已经不足1000天了。
en: There have been remarkable gains, but there is still much to do – and fewer than 1,000 days of action left until the 2015 deadline.

zh: 全球免疫覆盖面的增加将加速推动千年发展目标的实现并为2015年之后的发展日程的成功创造动力。
en: Raising global immunization coverage will speed progress toward the MDGs and generate momentum toward a successful post-2015 development agenda.

zh: 代表世界卫生组织194个成员国的世界卫生大会形成了一致的共同愿景 — — 被称为疫苗十年（Decade of Vaccines ） — —将打造没有疫苗可防疾病的世界，让免疫的全部好处抵达每一个人，不管他是谁、身处何方。
en: The World Health Assembly, representing the World Health Organization’s 194 member countries, has endorsed a shared vision – known as the Decade of Vaccines – of a world free from vaccine-preventable diseases, with the full benefits of immunization reaching all people, regardless of who they are or where they live.

zh: 根除小儿麻痹症将是实现这一愿景的一大里程碑。
en: Eradicating polio will be a milestone on our path to realizing this vision.

zh: 峰会将发布一个新的、全面的计划，世界将有一个明确的路线图在2018年建成没有小儿麻痹症的世界。
en: With a new, comprehensive plan to be introduced at the Summit, the world will have a clear roadmap for creating a polio-free world by 2018.

zh: 该计划将与我们提高麻疹、肺炎和冠状病毒等疾病的免疫覆盖面的总体努力齐头并进。
en: The plan works hand in hand with our overall efforts to raise immunization coverage against other diseases like measles, pneumonia, and rotavirus.

zh: 事实上，我们正在目睹强大的免疫系统保护我们在消灭小儿麻痹症的战争上的胜利，提供一个接触世界最脆弱母亲和儿童、为他们带去新疫苗和基本医疗服务的平台。
en: Indeed, we are seeing how strong immunization systems protect our gains against polio and provide a platform for reaching the world’s most vulnerable mothers and children with new vaccines and primary health care.

zh: 如果我们成功，到这个十年末，我们将拯救2000多万条生命，预防近10亿例疾病，光是治疗成本就能节省120亿美元。
en: If we are successful, by the end of the decade we will save more than 20 million lives, prevent nearly one billion cases of illness, and save almost $12 billion in treatment costs alone.

zh: 而在让人们摆脱疾病负担的过程中，我们还能解放不可估量的人类潜力。
en: And, in the process of freeing people from the burden of disease, we will unlock immeasurable human potential.

zh: 千年发展目标和疫苗十年证明，齐心合力的全球发展目标能产生深远不同。
en: The MDGs and the Decade of Vaccines prove that focused global development objectives can make a profound difference.

zh: 它们证明了把联合国、政府、发展机构、公民社会、基金会和私人部门联系在一起的合作的力量有多大。
en: They show the power of partnerships that bring together the United Nations, governments, development agencies, civil society, foundations, and the private sector.

zh: 在未来1000天里，我们的进步将以我们在拯救最贫困、最脆弱人类家庭成员方面做了些什么来衡量。
en: Over the next 1,000 days and beyond, our progress will be measured by what we have done to improve the lives of the poorest and most vulnerable members of the human family.

zh: 让我们从再次承诺实现所有孩子都能获得受疫苗保护的公平起点的共同愿景开始。
en: Let us start by recommitting ourselves to realizing the shared vision of a world in which all children get a fair start in life with the protection of vaccines.

zh: 这一代人会感谢我们 — — 未来一代又一代人亦然。
en: This generation will thank us – and so will many generations to come.

zh: 自大与权威
en: Arrogance and Authority

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 最近耳边充斥的都是各大欧美央行主管们对自身在2008~2010年危机中所作所为的评价 ： “ 咱们干得不错。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – It is increasingly common to hear prominent American and European central bankers proclaim, with respect to the crisis of 2008-2010, the following verdict: “We did well.”

zh: ”在他们眼里，正是一系列维护金融系统的政府行为协助稳定了整个局势。
en: Their view is that the various government actions to support the financial system helped to stabilize the situation.

zh: 而美联储的资产收购行为既然已经获得了盈利（并随后上缴了美国国库 ） ， 那又什么可指摘的呢？
en: Indeed, what could be wrong when the United States Federal Reserve’s asset purchases may have actually made money (which is then turned over to the US Treasury)?

zh: 但用这种思维来界定这一事务其实是有问题的：往轻了说，是被一时的错觉遮了耳目；往重了说，这将催生出一种傲慢自大的偏见，最终腐蚀中央银行得以构建其权威的基石 — — 公信力。
en: But to frame the issue in this way is, at best, to engage in delusion. At worst, however, it creates an image of arrogance that can only undermine the credibility on which central banks’ authority rests.

zh: 事实上，那场危机的真正成本根本无法用任何中央银行的账面盈亏来衡量 — — 也无法用美国财政部问题资产救助计划（Troubled Asset Relief Program）的一系列行动是赚是亏来进行评估。
en: The real cost of the crisis is not measured by the profit and loss statement of any central bank – or by whether or not the Troubled Asset Relief Program (TARP), run by the Treasury Department, made or lost money on its various activities.

zh: 如果要说真正的成本，那就是仅美国就失去了800万份工作，就业率也从最高峰下跌了6 % — —这也是与1945年后历次衰退最大的不同之处 — — 如今距离危机爆发已经过去31个月了，失业率依然徘徊在低于最高峰5%的水平上。
en: The cost is eight million jobs in the US alone, with employment falling 6% from its peak and – in a major departure from other post-1945 recessions – remaining 5% below that peak today, 31 months after the crisis broke in earnest.

zh: 另一项成本则是私人部门手中不断增加的联邦政府净债务额 — — 该指标是计算政府债务的最准确手段。
en: The cost is also the increase in net federal government debt held by the private sector – the most accurate measure of true government indebtedness.

zh: 对比美国国会预算办公室在危机前（2008年1月）和危机后发布的中期预测，这一债务的增加额相当于GDP的40 % ， 足以令人震惊不已了。
en: Comparing the US Congressional Budget Office’s medium-term forecasts before (in January 2008) and after the crisis, this debt increase is a staggering 40% of GDP.

zh: 事实上，导致美国如今的财政危机（以及可能进一步伤害许多民众的政府支出削减）的原因其实很简单：各大银行的危机使美国民众付出了巨大的代价，并在全球范围内造成了巨大的负面影响。
en: Indeed, the reason there is a perceived fiscal crisis in the US today – along with spending cuts that will further hurt many people – is simple: the banks blew themselves up at great cost to the American people, with major negative global implications.

zh: 美国和其他一些国家所出现的大部分公共债务并非源自于无节制的财政刺激政策，而是来自于本次衰退所引发的税收锐减（加上布什政府为最富有的那批人减税，经费不足的老年医疗保健药物财政补贴，还有靠借债维持的阿富汗和伊拉克战争都严重削弱了美国的远期财政前景 ） 。
en: Most of the public-debt increase in the US and elsewhere is not due to any kind of discretionary fiscal stimulus; it’s all about the loss of tax revenue that comes with a deep recession. (And the Bush administration’s tax cuts for the wealthiest, unfunded Medicare prescription benefit, and debt-financed wars in Afghanistan and Iraq have severely weakened the long-term fiscal outlook.)

zh: 最后一项成本则是数百万无家可归者和被扰乱的生活，有些影响甚至将持续一辈子。
en: Finally, the cost of the crisis is millions of homes lost and lives damaged, some permanently.

zh: 但问题不在于美联储或是其他中央银行是否应当设法阻止本国银行系统的崩溃。
