en: The issue is not whether the Fed, or any central bank, should seek to prevent the collapse of its country’s banking system.

zh: 如果想了解银行危机的恶劣影响，最佳的范例莫过于1930年代（也是伯南克担任美联储主席之前的研究领域 ） 。
en: To see the severe effects of a banking crisis, look no further than the 1930’s, a period that Ben Bernanke studied in detail before he became Fed chair.

zh: 如果在任何特定时期只有两个选择：要么政府出手，要么坐视其崩溃，那么前者将是必然的选择。
en: If the choice at any particular moment is to provide support or let the system collapse, you should choose support.

zh: 但在更广泛的意义上，正如亚特兰大联邦储备银行主席丹尼斯·洛克哈特（Dennis Lockhart）上星期在该机构组织的一个公共论坛上所指出的那样，我们不应试图运行一个构建在“私人得益公众受损”原则之上的银行系统，更可况这些损失大多由一些效率极低的行为方式所造成，而且毫无公平可言。
en: But, more broadly, as Dennis Lockhart, President of the Atlanta Federal Reserve Bank, said last week at a public conference organized by his institution, we should not seek to operate a system based on the principle of “private gains and public losses.” And these losses are massively skewed in ways that are grossly inefficient, in addition to being completely unfair.

zh: 相反私人得到的好处则可以通过管理人员津贴的数额来直接计算得出。
en: The private gains can be measured most directly in the form of executive compensation.

zh: 从2000年到2008年，全美前14家金融机构的管理者总共获得了大约26亿美元的现金津贴（包括工资，分红和股票出售在内 ） 。
en: From 2000 to 2008, the people running the top 14 US financial institutions received cash compensation (salary, bonus, and the value of stock sold) of around $2.6 billion.

zh: 到如今，前五位收入最高的人合共收取了近20亿美元，而他们恰巧也是构建了整个高风险资产架构并险些将金融系统推入深渊的始作俑者：山迪·维尔（建立了花旗集团，该集团在他离职不久后就爆发了危机 ） 、 汉克·保尔森（大规模扩展了高盛集团业务并说服国会允许投资银行采取更高投资杠杆，然后又摇身一变到美国财政部赴任去协助拯救这些银行 ） 、 安杰罗·莫兹洛（创立美国国家金融服务公司Countrywide financial corp . ， 是滥发抵���贷款的主要推手 ） ， 迪克·福德和杰米·卡尼（分别是雷曼兄弟和贝尔斯登的送葬者 ） 。
en: Of this amount, around $2 billion was received by the five best-paid individuals, who were also central to creating the highly risky asset structures that brought the financial system to the edge of the abyss: Sandy Weil (built Citigroup, which blew up shortly after he left); Hank Paulson (greatly expanded Goldman Sachs, lobbied for allowing more leverage in investment banks, then moved to the US Treasury and helped save them); Angelo Mozilo (built Countrywide, a central player in irresponsible mortgage lending); Dick Fuld (ran Lehman Brothers into the ground); and Jimmy Cayne (ran Bear Stearns into the ground).

zh: 相比之下公众的损失则极为巨大：如果仅仅用联邦政府的债务增长来评估的话，大概60亿美元。
en: The public losses are massive in comparison: roughly $6 trillion, if we limit ourselves just to the increase in federal government debt.

zh: 但那些银行大佬们却依然坚持自己应当被允许运营更高杠杆的全球业务，并基于企业股票回报率来向他们支付报酬 — — 无论出现任何风险。
en: And leading bank executives still insist that they should be allowed to run highly leveraged global businesses, in which they are paid based on their return on equity – unadjusted for any risk.

zh: 为此有一批全球最顶尖的独立金融研究者也正以长远而严谨的眼光观察这类事务，而我们近几年的研究显示情况比想象中更糟（详见斯坦福大学商学院教授安娜特·阿德玛蒂Anat Admati的网页 ） 。
en: The world’s top independent financial minds have looked long and hard at these arrangements, and, given what we have learned in recent years, have found them worse than wanting (see the Web page of Anat Admati at Stanford’s Graduate School of Business for the details).

zh: 在他们看来，大银行应具备更多的准备金 — — 大概应占其资本总额的30 % 。
en: In their view, the big banks should be funded much more with equity – perhaps as much as 30% of their capitalization.

zh: 但银行家们则强烈反对这一建议（因为这很可能减少他们的收入 ） ， 而中央银行管理者们也持有类似的立场（他们都被银行家的抗议所说服了 ） 。
en: But bankers strongly reject this approach (because it would likely lower their pay), as do central bankers (because they are too much persuaded by the protestation of bankers).

zh: 如能有一个由远离政界的专业人士来运作的独立中央银行，那是有许多好处的。
en: There are many advantages to having an independent central bank run by professionals who can keep their distance from politicians.

zh: 但当掌管这些金融机构的人都坚持自己在危机中做得很好，宣称所有问题都会解决，放任那些引发危机的金融巨鳄们逍遥法外，那么他们的公信力也将不可避免地受到损害。
en: But when the people at the apex of these institutions insist that the crisis response went well, and that everything will be fine, even as the financial behemoths that caused the crisis lumber forward, their credibility inevitably suffers.

zh: 这一切都应当令中央银行管理者们感到忧心，因为公信力就是他们的一切。
en: That should worry central bankers, because their credibility is pretty much all they have.

zh: 毕竟美国宪法并不保证美联储的独立。
en: The US Constitution, after all, does not guarantee the Fed’s independence.

zh: 国会创造了美联储，也可以解散它。
en: Congress created the Fed, which means that Congress can un-create it.

zh: 通过忽视高杠杆大银行所可能造成的危害，一场“坏事变好事”的危机神话带来的，仅仅是中央银行身上的不断累积政治压力而已。
en: By assuming away the damage that highly leveraged megabanks can do, the myth of a “good crisis” merely makes political pressure on central banks all the more likely.

zh: 人工智能和全球化
en: Artificial Intelligence and Globalization

zh: 今天的常规看法是：印度和中国的崛起将成为21世纪推动全球就业和薪酬的唯一重要因素。
en: Today’s conventional wisdom is that the rise of India and China will be the single biggest factor driving global jobs and wages over the twenty-first century.

zh: 富裕国家的高薪劳动者将会看到：自己的竞争优势在来自亚洲、拉美、甚至有一天也会包括非洲的极其吃苦耐劳的能干竞争者的侵蚀之下不断减弱。
en: High-wage workers in rich countries can expect to see their competitive advantage steadily eroded by competition from capable and fiercely hard-working competitors in Asia, Latin America, and maybe even some day Africa.

zh: 这是件好事，充分展现了权力政治和人类生活的戏剧性。
en: This is a good story, full of human drama and power politics.

zh: 但是我更想知道：今后几十年内，是否会有另外一个因素对我们的职业生涯造成更大的影响：这个因素就是人工智能应用的指数级增长。
en: But I wonder whether, even within the next few decades, another factor will influence our work lives even more: the exponential rise of applications of artificial intelligence.

zh: 我对人工智能的接触范围非常狭窄：那就是有着500多年历史的国际象棋运动。
en: My portal to the world of artificial intelligence is a narrow one: the more than 500-year-old game of chess.

zh: 你可能对早就被公认为终极智能运动的象棋毫无兴趣。
en: You may not care a whit about chess, long regarded as the ultimate intellectual sport.

zh: 即便如此，过去10年来国际象棋界令人惊叹的发展也足以引起你的关注。
en: But the stunning developments coming out of the chess world during the past decade should still command your attention.

zh: 国际象棋在人工智能的研究中一直是核心环节。
en: Chess has long been the centerpiece of research in artificial intelligence.

zh: 尽管从原则上看，国际象棋是可解的运动，但其计算的复杂程度几乎超出了所有人的想象。
en: While in principle, chess is solvable, the game’s computational complexity is almost incomprehensible.

zh: 如果有人说在国际象棋比赛中走棋的方法比宇宙中的原子还要多，也只是稍有夸张而已。
en: It is only a slight exaggeration to say there are more possible moves in a chess game than atoms in a universe.

zh: 20世纪大多数时候，程序员们在设计能与顶尖人类选手较量的国际象棋电脑时显然都未获成功。
en: For most of the twentieth century, programmers were patently unsuccessful in designing chess computers that could compete with the best humans.

zh: 人类国际象棋大师的直觉、想象和排序能力轻易就可以胜过电脑的横冲直撞。
en: A human chess master’s ability to intuit, visualize, and prioritize easily prevailed over the brute force approach of computers.

zh: 电脑在一点一滴地逐渐进步，但要与顶尖的人类高手较量似乎还相去甚远。
en: The computers gradually improved, but they still seemed far inferior to the top humans.

zh: 至少我们是这么认为的。
en: Or so we thought.

zh: 而后，在1997年，在那个注定要作为现代人类的丰碑载入史册的时刻，IBM的“深蓝”电脑战胜了世界象棋冠军卡斯帕罗夫（Gary Kasparov ） ， 令世界为之震惊。
en: Then, in 1997, in what will surely long be remembered as a historical milestone for modern man, IBM’s “Deep Blue” computer stunned the world by defeating the world champion Garry Kasparov.

zh: 也许骄傲的卡斯帕罗夫受到的震动比任何人都大，他一口咬定IBM的团队肯定做了手脚。
en: Proud Kasparov, who was perhaps more stunned than anyone, was sure that the IBM team must have cheated.

zh: 他以讽刺的口吻告诉记者，他感到“上帝之手”在指引着他的电脑对手。
en: He sarcastically told reporters that he sensed the “the hand of God” guiding his silicon opponent.

zh: 但IBM的团队没有作弊。
en: But the IBM team had not cheated.

zh: 相反，通过把独创性的软件和强大的平行运算能力结合在一起，他们成功地缔造出一台以硅晶片为介质的实体，这台机器掌握了如此精密微妙的运算技巧，以至于全世界所有的国际象棋大师（包括我本人在内）都大吃一惊。
en: Rather, through a combination of ingenious software and massive parallel computing power, they had produced a silicon-based entity capable of such finesse and subtlety, that international chess grandmasters worldwide (including me) were simply amazed.

zh: 1997年后，电脑已经如此进步，以至于程序员们可以把战胜人类当作小菜一碟。
en: Since 1997, the computers have only gotten better, to the point where computer programmers no longer find beating humans a great challenge.

zh: 你说这只是一场游戏？
en: Only a game, you say?

zh: 也许你是对的，但让我告诉你：30年前我专业从事国际象棋的时候（我曾经代表美国队参加国际象棋世界冠军循环赛 ） ， 我感到自己可以通过看别人的棋谱了解那个人的个性状况，国际象棋的业余爱好者也不例外。
en: Perhaps, but let me tell you this: when I played professional chess 30 years ago (I once represented the United States in the World Chess Championship cycle), I felt I could tell a lot about someone’s personality by seeing a sampling of their games, even those of an amateur.

zh: 不久以前，我还可以轻易地对电脑和真人对手加以区分。
en: Until a short while ago, I could certainly distinguish a computer from a human opponent.

zh: 如今一切都发生了变化。
en: Now everything changed like lightning.

zh: 电脑甚至可以模拟著名的真人棋手¾包括他们的缺点¾电脑都能模拟得惟妙惟肖，只有专业棋手（有时甚至只有另一台电脑！ ）才能看出其中的差别。
en: The machines can now even be set to imitate famous human players – including their flaws – so well that only an expert eye (and sometimes only another computer!) can tell the difference.

zh: 半个多世纪以前，人工智能领域的教父阿兰·图灵（Alan Turing）提出大脑的功能可以全部归结为数学运算，而且终有一天，电脑能够达到人类的智能。
en: More than half a century ago, the godfather of artificial intelligence, Alan Turing, argued that the brain’s function could all be reduced to mathematics and that, someday, a computer would rival human intelligence.

zh: 他提出实现终极人工智能的佐证是真人在进行对��时，无法知晓与自己对话的其实是一台电脑。
en: He claimed that the ultimate proof of artificial intelligence would be met if a human interrogator were unable to figure out that he was conversing with a computer.

zh: “图灵测试”被视作人工智能研究领域的圣杯。
en: The “Turing test” is the holy grail of artificial intelligence research.

zh: 对我来讲，象棋比赛是一种逻辑会话。
en: Well, for me, a chess game is a conversation of sorts.

zh: 而且在我看来，今天已有的电脑程序与图灵测试的要求几乎相差无几。
en: From my perspective, today’s off-the-shelf computer programs come awfully close to meeting Turing’s test.

zh: 从几次网上对弈所了解的情况看，我很难发现其中的差别。
en: Over the course of a small number of games on the Internet, I could not easily tell the difference.

zh: 没错，今天的电脑还没有达到斯坦利·库布里克（Stanley Kubrick）导演在其代表作《2001：太空漫游》中塑造的疯狂电脑HAL所能达到的水准，更不用说《终结者》系列影片中阿诺德·施瓦辛格（Arnold Schwarzenegger）式的机器人了。
en: True, today’s computers have not evolved to the level of the deranged chess-playing HAL in the filmmaker Stanley Kubrick’s masterpiece “2001: A Space Odyssey,” much less Arnold Schwarzenegger-like droids from the Terminator movies.

zh: 但电脑现有的水准已经足以令人毛骨悚然。
en: But the level that computers have reached already is scary enough.

zh: 接下来会发生什么？
en: What’s next?

zh: 我觉得自己作为经济学教授的地位一点都不稳固！
en: I certainly don’t feel safe as an economics professor!

zh: 我毫不怀疑地确信：本世纪晚些时候，人们可以买到袖珍教授¾没准还带有教授的全息影像¾就像今天购买袖珍卡斯帕罗夫象棋电脑那样易如反掌。
en: I have no doubt that sometime later this century, one will be able to buy pocket professors – perhaps with holographic images – as easily as one can buy a pocket Kasparov chess computer today.

zh: 让我们回头看看印度和中国。
en: So let’s go back to India and China.

zh: 全球化在上个世纪的多数时候都快速发展， 近20年来的发展更是尤为迅速。
en: Globalization proceeded at a rapid pace through much of the last century, and at a particularly accelerated rate during its last two decades.

zh: 但多数证据显示：技术变革能够比贸易更有效地推动全球薪酬格局的发展。
en: Yet the vast body of evidence suggests that technological changes were a much bigger driver in global wage patterns than trade.

zh: 也就是说，技术，而非贸易，才是21世纪经济的主题（当然，这两者相互影响，贸易刺激技术发展，推动技术传播，但这恐怕更多的是一种文字游戏 ） 。
en: That is, technology, not trade, was the big story of the twentieth-century economy (of course, the two interact, with trade helping to diffuse and stimulate technology, but this is a matter of semantics.)

zh: 我们能否确定这个世纪会发生变化？
en: Are we so sure that it will be different in this century?

zh: 人工智能能否彻底取代外包和制造业迁移所设下的咒语？
en: Or will artificial intelligence replace the mantra of outsourcing and manufacturing migration?

zh: 棋手们其实早已知道这个问题的答案。
en: Chess players already know the answer.

zh: 第二次机器时代的教育
en: Education in the Second Machine Age

zh: 慕尼黑—人工智能曾经仅限于科幻小说，但如今正在改变我们的生活。
en: MUNICH – Artificial intelligence, once confined to the realm of science fiction, is changing our lives.

zh: 汽车自己会驾驶。
en: Cars are driving themselves.

zh: 无人机可以设定程序用于递送包裹。
en: Drones are being programmed to deliver packages.

zh: 计算机正在学习诊断疾病。
en: Computers are learning to diagnose diseases.

zh: 经济学家埃里克·布莱恩约尔弗森（Erik Brynjolfsson）和安德鲁·迈克菲（Andrew McAfee）在他们的新书中将这些最新进步描述为他们所谓的“第二次机器时代”开始的例子。
en: In a recent book, the economists Erik Brynjolfsson and Andrew McAfee describe these recent advances as examples of the beginning of what they call “the second machine age.”

zh: 这个名字 — — 第一次机器时代是工业革命 — — 暗示了一个划时代的变化。
en: The very name – the first machine age was the Industrial Revolution – suggests an epochal shift.

zh: 事实上，如果预言可信，这些技术进步能够给我们的生活带来深远影响。
en: And, indeed, if the predictions are to be believed, these technological advances could have profound implications for the way we live.

zh: 一个普遍的预测是，随着越来越先进的机器人开始取代工人，劳动力成本将变得越来越不重要，制造业将回流富裕国家。
en: One common forecast is that as ever-more advanced robots substitute workers, the cost of labor will become less important, and manufacturing will move back to rich countries.

zh: 另一个预测是日益智能的机器将减少对高级技能的需求，拥有这些技能所带来的经济优势也将因此缩水。
en: Another is that increasingly intelligent machines will reduce the demand for advanced skills, and that the economic advantage of having these skills will decline as a result.

zh: 这两个假说的第一个仍然有些牵强。
en: The first of these two hypotheses remains far-fetched.

zh: 但有证据表明第二个假说正在成为现实，对现代经济面临全球化挑战的应对方式造成着巨大影响。
en: But there is evidence that the second has already started to come to pass, with serious implications for the way that modern economies have attempted to meet the challenges of globalization.

zh: 诚然，有大量非正式证据表明“回岸 ” （ reshoring）正在发生 — — 即就业岗位从低薪酬国家重新回到高薪酬国家。
en: To be sure, there has been plenty of anecdotal evidence of “reshoring” – the relocation of jobs from low-wage countries to high-wage economies.

zh: 苹果公司正在把一些制造业务从中国迁回硅谷；Airtex设计集团正在将一部分纺织生产从中国迁回美国。
en: Apple is shifting some manufacturing from China to Silicon Valley; Airtex Design Group is moving part of its textile production from China back to the United States.

zh: 普华永道管理咨询公司对384家欧元区企业的最新调查中，三分之二的受访者表示在过去一年中实施了一些回岸动作，50%的受访者表示准备在明年这样做。
en: In a recent survey of 384 firms in the eurozone by the management consultancy PricewaterhouseCoopers, two-thirds of the respondents said that they had reshored some activities during the past year, and 50% plan to do so in the next.

zh: 但数据并没有表现出回岸信号。
en: But when one looks at the data, there is no sign of reshoring.

zh: 事实上，趋势仍与回岸背道而驰。
en: Indeed, the trend is continuing in the opposite direction.

zh: 离岸自2008年全球金融危机引发大衰退以来有所下降，但随后马上发生了反弹，并加速超过了危机前水平。
en: Offshoring dropped during the Great Recession that followed the 2008 global financial crisis, but quickly rebounded, accelerating past pre-crisis levels.

zh: 眼下，制造业回归富裕国家仍然只是预言而不是结果。
en: For the moment, the return of manufacturing to rich countries remains a prediction, not an outcome.

zh: 评估第二个假说更加复杂。
en: Evaluating the second hypothesis is more complicated.

zh: 咋一看，证据支持对高级技能需求下降的可能性。
en: At first glance, the evidence supports the possibility that demand for advanced skills is falling.

zh: 在过去17年中，除了美国和德国，所有西方国家高技能工人和非高技能工人之间的薪酬差都有所缩小。
en: With the exceptions of the US and Germany, the wage gap between skilled and unskilled workers has been declining in all Western countries in the last 17 years.

zh: 一个可能的解释是欧洲教育水平超过了技术变化的速度，高级技能出现了过度供给。
en: One possible explanation is that education levels in Europe outstripped the pace of technological change, oversupplying the market for advanced skills.

zh: 在奥地利，拥有大学文凭或同等学力的人口比例在1996到2012年间增长了250 % 。
en: In Austria, the share of people with a university degree or its equivalent increased by 250% between 1996 and 2012.

zh: 在英国和意大利，这一比例接近翻番。
en: In the United Kingdom and Italy, it almost doubled.

zh: 在西班牙，该比例上升70 % ， 法国则是60 % 。
en: In Spain, it jumped by 70%, and in France by 60%.

zh: 相反，美国和德国高等教育学历拥有者比例只是略微升高了25 % 。
en: By comparison, in the US and Germany, the share of the population with a tertiary education rose by a more modest 25%.

zh: 但是，另一个可能是高技能和非高技能工人薪酬差距缩小体现了机器的日益智能化。
en: It is also possible, however, that the drop in the wage gap between skilled and unskilled workers represents competition from increasingly intelligent machines.

zh: 在这方面，美国是一个典型。
en: Here, the US is a case in point.

zh: 自世纪之交以来，美国的教育入学率只是略有增加，因此，我们应该预期薪酬差距会显著增加，就像20世纪八九十年代那样。
en: Because educational attainment has been advancing only modestly in the US since the turn of the century, we would expect the wage gap to be rising steeply, as it did in the 1980s and 1990s.

zh: 相反，薪酬差距基本保持不变，增加的是高技能工人的失业率，2000—2012年，该指标在美国和英国增加了一倍。
en: Instead, it has remained largely unchanged, and it is the unemployment rate among skilled workers that is on the rise, doubling in the US and the United Kingdom from 2000 to 2012.

zh: 20世纪80年代前，大约70%的收入属于劳动收入，30%为资本收入。
en: Until the 1980s, about 70% of income went to labor income and 30% to capital income.

zh: 但是，自此以后，收入归属劳动的比例在所有富裕国家都有所下降。
en: But, since then, the share of income going to labor has declined in all rich countries.

zh: 如今这一比例为GDP的58 % 。
en: It is now at about 58% of GDP.

zh: 根据经济学家卢卡斯·卡拉巴波尼斯（Loukas Karabarbounis）和布伦特·尼曼（Brent Neiman）的研究，这一下降有一半要归因于更加廉价的信息技术，信息技术的廉价化让企业得以用计算机取代工人。
en: According to research by the economists Loukas Karabarbounis and Brent Neiman, half of this decline is the result of cheaper information technology, which has enabled firms to replace workers with computers.

zh: 影响是严重的。
en: The implications are serious.

zh: 如果这些确实是第二次机器时代的第一批信号，有可能我们正在打一场错误的战争。
en: If these are indeed the first signs of the second machine age, it is possible that we have been fighting the wrong battle.

zh: 随着人力资本稀缺日益变得不重要，教育的快速��张也许并非如我们所愿的那样是全球化挑战的答案。
en: As the scarcity of human capital declines in importance, the rapid expansion of education may not be the answer to the challenges of globalization that we hoped it would be.

zh: 人工智能的前途和陷阱
en: The Promise and Pitfalls of AI

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 与任何革命性的趋势一样，人工智能（AI）的崛起同样带来了重大的机遇和难以应对的挑战。
en: BRUSSELS – Like any transformative trend, the rise of artificial intelligence (AI) poses both major opportunities and significant challenges.

zh: 但其中最严重的可能并不是最常讨论的风险。
en: But the gravest risks may not be the ones most often discussed.

zh: 据麦肯锡全球研究院（MGI）最新研究显示，人工智能具备显著提高整体经济生产率的潜能。
en: According to new research from the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI), AI has the potential to boost overall economic productivity significantly.

zh: 即使考虑到过渡成本和竞争效应，截至2030年它也可以使总产量增加13万亿美元，同时每年提高全球GDP 1.2%左右。
en: Even accounting for transition costs and competition effects, it could add some $13 trillion to total output by 2030 and boost global GDP by about 1.2% per year.

zh: 这将超过 — — 或至少也能与过去通用技术的经济影响力相媲美，包括19世纪的蒸汽动力、20世纪的工业制造以及21世纪的信息技术。
en: This is comparable to – or even larger than – the economic impact of past general-purpose technologies, such as steam power during the 1800s, industrial manufacturing in the 1900s, and information technology during the 2000s.

zh: 也许人工智能最让人们担忧的问题是其未来取代的岗位可能比创造的更多。
en: Perhaps the most discussed concern about AI is the prospect that intelligent machines will replace more jobs than they create.

zh: 但麦肯锡全球研究院的研究显示，长期来看，人工智能的采用或许并不会对净就业产生重大的影响。
en: But MGI’s research found that the adoption of AI may not have a significant effect on net employment in the long term.

zh: 截至2030年，对该行业的追加投资可以贡献5%的就业岗位，而其所创造的增量财富可以推升劳动力需求，实现就业率再提高12 % 。
en: Extra investment in the sector could contribute 5% to employment by 2030, and the additional wealth created could drive up labor demand, boosting employment by another 12%.

zh: 但尽管整体状况十分乐观，不好的消息也同样存在。
en: But while the overall picture is positive, the news is not all good.

zh: 首先，感受人工智能的好处可能需要时间 — — 尤其是在生产率方面。
en: For one thing, it is possible that it will take time for AI’s benefits – particularly with regard to productivity – to be felt.

zh: 事实上，麦肯锡全球研究院的研究表明截止2030年，人工智能对增长的贡献可能是今后五年的3到5倍。
en: Indeed, MGI’s research suggests that AI’s contribution to growth may be three or more times higher by 2030 than it is over the next five years.

zh: 上述结果与所谓的索洛计算机悖论相一致：生产率的提升落后于技术进步 — — 这是数字革命期间一个值得关注的现象。
en: This is in line with the so-called Solow computer paradox: productivity gains lag behind technological advances – a notable phenomenon during the digital revolution.

zh: 部分原因是，起初，经济体面临高额的落地和转型成本，而这种成本往往会被人工智能对经济影响的研究忽略掉。
en: This is partly because, initially, economies face high implementation and transition costs, which estimates of AI’s economic impact tend to ignore.

zh: 麦肯锡国际研究院的模拟研究表明，未来五年这些成本将占到潜在总收益的80 % ， 而到2030年却将下降至潜在总收益的1/3左右。
en: MGI’s simulation suggests that these costs will amount to 80% of gross potential gains in five years, but will decline to one-third of those gains by 2030.

zh: 人工智能革命另外一个令人不安的潜在特征是它所产生的效益不太可能得到公平的分配。
en: The more troubling potential feature of the AI revolution is that its benefits are not likely to be shared equitably.

zh: 由此带来的“人工智能差异”将进一步强化数字差异己经造成的经济不平等和破坏竞争的鸿沟。
en: The resulting “AI divides” will reinforce the digital divides that are already fueling economic inequality and undermining competition.

zh: 上述差异可能来源于三个领域。
en: These divides could emerge in three areas.

zh: 第一个差异很有可能出现在公司层面。
en: The first divide would emerge at the company level.

zh: 充分采用人工智能技术的创新型前沿企业可以在现在到2030年这段时间内实现现金流量翻倍 — — 这样的结果很有可能导致聘用更多工人。
en: Innovative, leading-edge companies that fully adopt AI technologies could double their cash flow between now and 2030 – an outcome that would likely entail hiring many more workers.

zh: 这些企业将远远抛下那些不愿或不能以同等速度采用人工智能技术的企业。
en: These companies would leave in the dust those that are unwilling or unable to implement AI technologies at the same rate.

zh: 事实上，完全不采用人工智能技术的企业可能因市场份额的丧失而面临20%左右的现金流下降，从而致使他们面临裁员的压力。
en: In fact, firms that do not adopt AI at all could experience a 20% decline in their cash flow as they lose market share, putting them under pressure to shed workers.

zh: 第二个差异关乎到技能。
en: The second divide concerns skills.

zh: 人工智能技术的普及将使劳动力需求从可以轻易实现自动化或平台外包的重复性任务过渡到更多依赖社交或认知驱动。
en: The proliferation of AI technologies will shift labor demand away from repetitive tasks that can more easily be automated or outsourced to platforms, toward socially or cognitively driven tasks.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院模型显示以重复性操作和低数字技术含量为特征的职务可能从占就业总人数的40%下降到2030年的仅30%左右。
en: MGI’s models indicate that job profiles characterized by repetitive tasks and little digital knowhow could fall from some 40% of total employment to near 30% by 2030.

zh: 同时，需要非重复性劳动或高水平数字技术的工作很可能从约40%上升至50%以上。
en: Meanwhile, the share of jobs entailing non-repetitive activities or requiring high-level digital skills is likely to rise from some 40% to more than 50%.

zh: 这样的转变可能导致工资差距拉大，约13%的工资总额可能转向需要高水平数字技术的非重复性工作，因为上述领域的收入增加。
en: This shift could contribute to an increase in wage differentials, with around 13% of the total wage bill potentially shifting to non-repetitive jobs requiring high-level digital skills, as incomes in those fields rise.

zh: 从事重复性和低数字技术类职务的员工可能遭遇到工资停滞甚至减少，导致他们在工资总额中的比率从33%下降到20%左右。
en: Workers in the repetitive and low-digital-skills categories may experience wage stagnation or even reduction, contributing to a decline in their share of the total wage bill from 33% to 20%.

zh: 第三项人工智能差异在不同国家间已经非常明显，并且势将进一步扩大。
en: The third AI divide – among countries – is already apparent, and seems set to widen further.

zh: 这些国家，其中绝大多数为发达国家，将自身定位为人工智能领导者，与今天相比可能获得20~25%的额外经济收入，而新兴经济体可能仅增加5~15 % 。
en: Those countries, mostly in the developed world, that establish themselves as AI leaders could capture an additional 20-25% in economic benefits compared with today, while emerging economies may accrue only an extra 5-15%.

zh: 发达经济体在人工智能应用方面具有显著的优势，因为他们在落实此前的数字技术方面能够更进一步。
en: The advanced economies have a clear advantage in adopting AI, because they are further along in the implementation of previous digital technologies.

zh: 他们还有极强的动机来采用人工智能技术：低生产率增长、人口老龄化和劳动力成本相对较高。
en: They also have powerful incentives to adopt AI: low productivity growth, aging populations, and relatively high labor costs.

zh: 相比之下，许多发展中经济体的数字设施严重不足，创新和投资能力薄弱，而且缺乏牢固的技术基础。
en: By contrast, many developing economies have insufficient digital infrastructure, weak innovation and investment capacity, and thin skills base.

zh: 再加上低工资的动机抑制效应和充足的生产力追赶空间，这些经济体似乎不太可能在人工智能应用领域与那些发达国家伙伴保持同步。
en: Add to that the motivation-dampening effects of low wages and ample space for productivity catch-up, and it seems unlikely that these economies will keep pace with their advanced counterparts in AI adoption.

zh: 这些人工智能差异的兴起和扩大并不是不可避免的。
en: The emergence or expansion of these AI divides is not inevitable.

zh: 尤其是发展中经济体可以选择采用前瞻性的思维方法，包括强化其数字基础并积极鼓励人工智能应用。
en: In particular, developing economies can choose to take a forward-thinking approach that includes strengthening their digital foundations and actively encouraging AI adoption.

zh: 同时，为了确保满足不断变化的工作需求，企业可以在支持低技术群体的教育升级和持续学习方面发挥更加积极的作用。
en: And, to ensure that their changing workplace needs are met, firms can take a more active role in supporting educational upgrading and continuous learning for lower-skill people.

zh: 而且，这些差异的存在也并不一定只起到消极作用。
en: Moreover, these divides are not necessarily a negative development.

zh: 将资源重新分配给业绩更好的企业可以使经济发展更加健康，从而使它们在面对来自其他国家的竞争时更具有竞争优势。
en: The reallocation of resources toward higher-performing companies makes economies healthier, potentially providing them with new competitive advantages vis-à-vis other countries.

zh: 但上述差异所造成的风险绝对不容低估。
en: But the risks posed by these divides should not be underestimated.

zh: 远见和毅力对于人工智能革命的成功至关重要，因为它在带来长期收益之前将会造成短期的痛苦。
en: Vision and perseverance are essential to make the AI revolution work, because it will bring short-term pain before long-term gains.

zh: 如果上述痛苦出现在人工智能收益分配不均且令民众倍感沮丧的背景下，可能就会引发对技术的强烈抵制，而同样的技术在不同的情况下本来是可以创造出提高生产率、增加收入和催生就业需求的良性循环的。
en: If that pain occurs against a backdrop of frustration with the unequal distribution of AI’s benefits, it may trigger a backlash against technologies that could otherwise produce a virtuous cycle of higher productivity, income growth, and employment-boosting demand.

zh: 发展中世界的AI憧憬
en: The Promise of AI in the Developing World

zh: 伦敦—数字趋势观察家们的一个常见误解是发展中国家消费者没有从技术进步中获益。
en: LONDON – A common misperception among observers of digital trends is that consumers in developing countries do not benefit from advances in technology.

zh: 不管是拥有最新款智能手机，还是“雇用”机器人清扫机，获得创新的能力是富国和穷国之间最醒目的差异之一。
en: Whether it is owning the latest smartphone or “employing” robot cleaners, the ability to access innovation is one of the most visible differences between rich and poor countries.

zh: 这一差距因为人工智能（AI）的出现而变得更加显著。
en: This gap has become even more pronounced since the advent of artificial intelligence (AI).

zh: 比如，绝大部分家用“智能音箱 ” ， 如亚马逊的Alexa，都销往了富裕国家。
en: For example, the vast majority of home “smart speaker” personal assistants, like Amazon’s Alexa, are shipped to wealthy countries.

zh: 2017年，超八成的全球智能音箱出货量销往北美。
en: In 2017, over 80% of global smart speaker shipments were to North America.

zh: 但尽管技术可能深化全球不平等，也有能力减轻全球不平等。
en: But while technology can deepen global inequality, it also has the potential to mitigate it.

zh: 这是因为，AI能够实现许多电器无法实现的功能；它还有可能掀起全球南方医疗、减灾、金融、物流、教育和商业服务的实现方式革命。
en: This is because AI can do much more than power appliances; it can also revolutionize the way health care, disaster relief, finance, logistics, education, and business services are delivered in the Global South.

zh: 放眼全球，AI已经开始改变发展中国家。
en: Around the world, AI is already transforming developing countries.

zh: 在尼泊尔，机器学习勾勒并分析震后重建需求。
en: In Nepal, machine learning is mapping and analyzing post-earthquake reconstruction needs.

zh: 在整个非洲，AI辅导帮助年轻学生追赶功课。
en: Across Africa, AI tutors are helping young students catch up on coursework.

zh: 人道主义援助机构运用大数据分析优化如何为逃离冲突和其他困境的难民实现供给。
en: Humanitarian aid agencies are using big data analytics to optimize the delivery of supplies for refugees fleeing conflict and other hardships.

zh: 在我的祖国印度，农民用AI应用改善庄家产量，提高利润。
en: And in my country, India, rural farmers use AI applications to improve crop yields and boost profits.

zh: 这些创新让我们越来越接近实现联合国在消除贫困、消除医疗不平等、提高入学普及、遏制全球变暖等关键问题上的可持续发展目标。
en: Innovations like these bring us closer to achieving the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals on issues like eradicating poverty, ending health-care inequality, increasing access to schooling, and combating global warming.

zh: 而AI可以为人类进步做出的贡献，人们只利用了九牛一毛。
en: And yet the world is just scratching the surface of what AI can do for human progress.

zh: 要充分利用AI的力量推动发展，我们必须找到新的应用方法。
en: To harness AI’s full power to advance development, we must find new ways to apply it.

zh: 比如，在正确的支持下，可以用无人机向发展中国家的偏远医院运送药品补给。
en: For example, with the right support, the skies above developing countries could be filled with drones delivering medical supplies to remote hospitals.

zh: 卢旺达农村已经在这么做，该国卫生部和硅谷科技初创企业Zipline进行了独到的合作，帮助难以进入地区的诊所实现短信预定血浆，并在几分钟内通过空投投送。
en: This is already happening in rural Rwanda, where a unique partnership between the health ministry and Zipline, a Silicon Valley-based tech startup, is giving doctors in hard-to-reach clinics the ability to order blood by text message, and then have it arrive by parachute in a matter of minutes.

zh: 该计划自2016年10月开始实施以来，投送时间已经缩短了五倍，拯救了数百人的生命。
en: Since the program launched in October 2016, delivery times have been cut by a factor of five, and hundreds of lives have been saved.

zh: 尽管如此，诸如此类的AI创新固然令人印象深刻，但绝非理所当然。
en: Still, while AI innovations like this one are impressive, we cannot take them for granted.

zh: 除非我们能够克服普遍存在的错误担忧 — — AI 弊大于利，否则科技公司为全球南方所带来的令人难以置信的进步将日益放缓。
en: Unless we counter the misplaced but well-publicized fears that AI disruptions will be worse than the rewards, the incredible progress that technology companies are making in the Global South will be slowed.

zh: 可以采取诸多措施避免这一结果。
en: There are a number of steps that can be taken to avoid this outcome.

zh: 首先，诸如联合国“良性AI”运动这样的计划，旨在实现关于如何通过技术让人道工作受益的对话，应该获得决策者的全力支持。
en: For starters, programs like the UN’s “AI for Good” campaign, which is aimed at fostering dialogue on the beneficial use of technology for humanitarian work, must receive the full support of policymakers.

zh: 我们这些参与技术开发的人士也必须不断地辨别哪些项目、计划、智库和组织能够从与AI企业的合作中获益，就像卢旺达的Zipline那样。
en: Those of us involved in technology development must also continue to identify the projects, initiatives, think tanks, and organizations that would benefit from cooperation with AI firms – like Zipline in Rwanda.

zh: 但最重要的是，关于出于人道主义目的的AI开发的对话，不能只在援助组织、慈善机构和政府间进行。
en: But, most important, conversations about developing AI for humanitarian purposes cannot be conducted in isolation by aid organizations, charities, and governments.

zh: 科技投资者也必须参与其中。
en: Technology investors must also have a seat at the table.

zh: 长期以来，科技创业家注意力集中在解决全球北方的问题，而忽视了传统上与发展中国家相关的问题。
en: For too long, technology entrepreneurs have focused on solving problems in the Global North, while ignoring issues traditionally associated with developing countries.

zh: 但移动技术正在开启新的机会大门，如今，将AI方案的目标对准西方国家之外的地区在人道和商业上都很有意义。
en: But mobile technology is opening new doors of opportunity, and it now makes humanitarian and business sense to target AI solutions far beyond Western countries.

zh: 因此，我成立了规模1亿美元的投资公司Rewired，支持参与解决重要社会问题的初创AI和机器人企业。
en: That is why I established Rewired, a $100 million investment vehicle that supports embryonic AI and robotics firms engaged in addressing important social issues.

zh: Rewired公司与机器知觉领先企业合作 — — 机器感知即机器人理解和解读物理世界的能力。
en: Rewired works with firms at the vanguard of machine perception – the ability of robots to understand and interpret the physical world.

zh: 我们投资的公司致力于复制人类嗅觉、开发平价灵敏假肢、创造改善制造流程的便携机器等领域。
en: We have invested in companies that are working to replicate human smell, to develop affordable and dexterous prosthetics, and to create portable machines designed to improve manufacturing processes.

zh: 我们的目标是为潜力企业提供资金，改善世界各国的生活质量。
en: Our goal is to fund technologies with the potential to enhance quality of life in every country around the world.

zh: 我相信，这将是AI的一致特征。
en: And that, I believe, will be AI’s unifying characteristic.

zh: 我们今天所创造的机器不但能够盈利；还能让我们距离解决某些世界最大挑战更近一步。
en: The machines we create today will not only be profitable; they will also bring us closer to solving some of the world’s biggest challenges.

zh: 经济学家和科学家对长期增长的不同看法
en: Economists vs. Scientists on Long-Term Growth

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 大多数经济预测者在很大程度上对人工智能方面的近期进展（例如去年12月DeepMind自学国际象棋程序所展示的巨大飞跃）不甚重视，认为这对长期趋势增长影响甚微。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Most economic forecasters have largely shrugged off recent advances in artificial intelligence (for example, the quantum leap demonstrated by DeepMind’s self-learning chess program last December), seeing little impact on longer-term trend growth.

zh: 即使美国十年期债券利率在过去几个月内已经上涨了0.5 % ， 但这种悲观情绪无疑是实际（排除通胀因素后）利率仍然极低的原因之一。
en: Such pessimism is surely one of the reasons why real (inflation-adjusted) interest rates remain extremely low, even if the bellwether US ten-year bond rate has ticked up half a percentage point in the last few months.

zh: 如果这种供给侧悲观情绪持续存在的话，美国最近的大规模税收和支出计划只可能会进一步提高通胀率，而不是提振投资。
en: If supply-side pessimism is appropriate, the recent massive tax and spending packages in the United States will likely do much more to raise inflation than to boost investment.

zh: 即使降低企业税率是有道理的（尽管在减税额方面仍然存在问题 ） ， 但依然有足够的理由去反对美国近期的财政政策。
en: There are plenty of reasons to object to recent US fiscal policy, even if lowering the corporate-tax rate made sense (albeit not by the amount enacted).

zh: 最重要的是，我们生活在一个不平等日益加重，劳动占收入份额相对资本不断下降的时代。
en: Above all, we live in an era of rising inequality and falling income shares for labor relative to capital.

zh: 政府需要做更多 — — 而不是更少 — — 来重新分配收入和财富。
en: Governments need to do more, not less, to redistribute income and wealth.

zh: 很难知道美国总统特朗普在宣称他的政策将实现高达6％的增长（除非他谈论的是物价而不是产量！ ）时脑子里究竟在想什么。
en: It is hard to know what US President Donald Trump is thinking when he boasts that his policies will deliver up to 6% growth (unless he is talking about prices, not output!).

zh: 但如果通胀压力真的变成了现实，目前的增长可能会比预测者和市​​场认定的持续长得多的时间。
en: But if inflationary pressures do indeed materialize, current growth might last significantly longer than forecasters and markets believe.

zh: 总之经济学家悲观情绪的着眼点就是长期增长。
en: In any case, the focus of economists’ pessimism is long-term growth.

zh: 他们的立场是基于这样的信念：发达经济体不可能重复美国1995~2005年（其他先进经济体也随后跟进）所享有的活力，更不用说1950和1960年代那种好日子了。
en: Their stance is underpinned by the belief that advanced economies cannot hope to repeat the dynamism that the US enjoyed from 1995-2005 (and other advanced economies a bit later), much less the salad days of the 1950s and 1960s.

zh: 但是怀疑者应该考虑这样一个事实：许多来自各个领域的科学家却不是这样看。
en: But the doubters ought to consider the fact that many scientists, across many disciplines, see things differently.

zh: 尤其是那些年轻的研究人员会认为，即使投入实际应用还需要很长时间，但基础知识的进步简直是在一日千里。
en: Young researchers, in particular, believe that advances in basic knowledge are coming as fast as ever, even if practical applications are taking a long time to develop.

zh: 事实上，一个微小但有影响力的群体一直在鼓吹匈牙利裔美国数学家约翰·冯·诺依曼的“奇点”理论 — — 有一天思维机器会变得如此复杂，以至于它们能够在没有任何人为干预的情况下发明其他机器，突然之间科技将呈现指数式的发展。
en: Indeed, a small but influential cult touts the Hungarian-American mathematician John von Neumann’s “singularity” theory. Someday, thinking machines will become so sophisticated that they will be able to invent other machines without any human intervention, and suddenly technology will advance exponentially.

zh: 如果是这样，或许我们更应该担心的是比人类精神所能接受程度更快的物质增长所带来的伦理和社会影响。
en: If so, perhaps we should be far more worried about the ethical and social implications of material growth that is faster than humans can spiritually absorb.

zh: 对人工智能的焦虑主要集中在不平等和工作的未来。
en: The angst over AI mostly focuses on inequality and the future of work.

zh: 但是正如科幻作家长期以来一直警告我们的那样，硅基“生命”形式诞生所带来的潜在威胁才是真正值得害怕的。
en: But as science fiction writers have long warned us, the potential threats arising from the birth of silicon-based “life” forms are truly frightening.

zh: 搞清楚谁才是对的绝非易事：在长期预测方面经济学家和科学家都出过洋相。
en: It is hard to know who is right: neither economists nor scientists have a great track record when it comes to making long-term predictions.

zh: 但眼下如果抛开人与机器之间存在你死我活斗争的可能性，未来五年生产率将大幅提升的预测似乎是站得住脚的。
en: But right now, and leaving aside the possibility of an existential battle between man and machine, it seems quite plausible to expect a significant pickup in productivity growth over the next five years.

zh: 鉴于经济增长的主要组成部分是劳动人口 ， （ 公共和私人）投资以及在新理念指导下“生产力 ” — —特定投入所能生产出的产品 — — 的提升。
en: Consider that the main components of economic growth are increases in the labor force, increases in investment (both public and private), and “productivity,” namely the output than can be produced with a given amount of inputs, thanks to new ideas.

zh: 在过去的10~15年中，发达经济体在这三个方面都乏善可陈。
en: Over the past 10-15 years, all three have been dismally low in the advanced economies.

zh: 由于出生率下降，劳动力增长急剧放缓，即使是特朗普上台之前的美国也无法依靠移民来弥补。
en: Labor force growth has slowed sharply, owing to declining birth rates, with immigration failing to compensate even in pre-Trump America.

zh: 妇女涌入劳动力队伍对促进二十世纪后半叶的增长发挥了重要作用。
en: The influx of women into the labor force played a major role in boosting growth in the latter part of the twentieth century.

zh: 虽然政府可以做更多的事情来支持女性参加工作和同工同酬，但是现在这种优势在很大程度上已经被发挥殆尽了。
en: But now that has largely played out, although governments could do more to support female labor force participation and pay equity.

zh: 同样，自2008年金融危机以来（除中国之外的）全球投资已经崩溃，拉低了潜在增长。
en: Similarly, global investment has collapsed since the 2008 financial crisis (though not in China), lowering potential growth.

zh: 同时各地的生产率增长纷纷下降，在美国相对1990年代中期的科技热潮时期大约下降了一半。
en: And measured productivity growth has declined everywhere, falling roughly by half in the US since the tech boom of the mid-1990s.

zh: 难怪全球实际利率如此之低，而危机后的巨额储蓄能找到的投资机会日益稀少了。
en: No wonder global real interest rates are so low, with high post-crisis savings chasing a smaller supply of investment opportunities.

zh: 不过，最好的选择是人工智能以及其他新技术最终将对增长产生比迄今为止更大的影响。
en: Still, the best bet is that AI and other new technologies will eventually come to have a much larger impact on growth than they have up to now.

zh: 众所周知，企业可能需要很长时间才能重新设计生产流程来利用新技术：铁路和电力是两个主要的例子。
en: It is well known that it can take a very long time for businesses to reimagine productive processes to exploit new technologies: railroads and electricity are two leading examples.

zh: 全球增长的抬头可能成为变革的催化剂，为企业投资和引进新技术创造激励机制，其中一些将取代劳动力，从而抵消劳动力增长放缓的影响。
en: The pickup in global growth is likely to be a catalyst for change, creating incentives for firms to invest and introduce new technologies, some of which will substitute for labor, offsetting the slowdown in the growth of the workforce.

zh: 随着金融危机的后遗症日渐消退，人工智能也许开始发力，未来几年美国产出增长趋势可能会保持强劲（当然出现经济衰退也是可能 ） 。
en: With the after-effects of the financial crisis fading, and AI perhaps starting to gain traction, trend US output growth can easily stay strong for the next several years (though, of course, a recession is also possible).

zh: 对于各国央行行长来说，实际全球利率可能因此产生的上涨将会非常棘手。
en: The likely corresponding rise in real global interest rates will be tricky for central bankers to navigate.

zh: 在最好的情况下，他们将能够“顺势而行 ” ， 正如艾伦·格林斯潘在1990年代的著名做法的那样，尽管这次可能会产生更多的通胀。
en: In the best case, they will be able to “ride the wave,” as Alan Greenspan famously did in the 1990s, though more inflation is likely this time.

zh: 而底线在于政策制定者和市场都不应认定过去十年的缓慢增长会被带入下一个阶段。
en: The bottom line is that neither policymakers nor markets should be betting on the slow growth of the past decade carrying over to the next.

zh: 但这可不是个一面倒的好消息。
en: But that might not be entirely welcome news.

zh: 如果科学家们是对的，我们可能会对自己所获得的增长感到后悔。
en: If the scientists are right, we may come to regret the growth we get.

zh: 勾勒人工智能的未来
en: Mapping the Future of AI

zh: 布莱顿—人工智能（AI）已经在人类经济和社会中起着重要作用，而在未来几年，它的作用还将更加重大。
en: BRIGHTON – Artificial intelligence already plays a major role in human economies and societies, and it will play an even bigger role in the coming years.

zh: 因此，思考AI的未来就是要承认未来就是AI。
en: To ponder the future of AI is thus to acknowledge that the future is AI.

zh: 这部分要归因于“深度学习”方面的进步。 深度学习使用20世纪80年代开始理论化的多层神经网络。
en: This will be partly owing to advances in “deep learning,” which uses multilayer neural networks that were first theorized in the 1980s.

zh: 有了当今更加强大的计算能力和储存容量，深度学习已经具备现实可行性。 2016年Go击败世界冠军，这让深度学习应用获得了全世界的关注。
en: With today’s greater computing power and storage, deep learning is now a practical possibility, and a deep-learning application gained worldwide attention in 2016 by beating the world champion in Go.

zh: 商业企业和政府都希望采用这项技术在各种“大数据”中寻找有用的模式。
en: Commercial enterprises and governments alike hope to adapt the technology to find useful patterns in “Big Data” of all kinds.

zh: 2011年，IBM的沃森（Watson）标志了另一座AI分水平，它在“危险！ ” （ Jeopardy ! ） 游戏中击败两位前冠军。
en: In 2011, IBM’s Watson marked another AI watershed, by beating two previous champions in Jeopardy!, a game that combines general knowledge with lateral thinking.

zh: 这项游戏需要结合一般知识和横向思考。 另一项更加重大的发展是“物联网”的出现，随着更多装置、家用电器、可穿戴设备和公共场合传感器连入网络、开始随时传播消息，物联网还将继续成长。
en: And yet another significant development is the emerging “Internet of Things,” which will continue to grow as more gadgets, home appliances, wearable devices, and publicly-sited sensors become connected and begin to broadcast messages around the clock.

zh: 老大哥不会看着你，但万亿小大哥也许会看着你。
en: Big Brother won’t be watching you; but a trillion little brothers might be.

zh: 除了这些创新，我们还可以期待看到无数我们曾经称为“专家系统”的例子：AI应用在各种专业领域辅助乃至取代人类专业人士。
en: Beyond these innovations, we can expect to see countless more examples of what were once called “expert systems”: AI applications that aid, or even replace, human professionals in various specialties.

zh: 类似地，机器人将胜任此前无法自动化的任务。
en: Similarly, robots will be able to perform tasks that could not be automated before.

zh: 目前，机器人已经可以完成人类在仓储方面的几乎所有工作。
en: Already, robots can carry out virtually every role that humans once filled on a warehouse floor.

zh: 考虑到这一趋势，毫不奇怪一些人预测将出现所谓的“奇点 ” ， AI系统将超越人类智能，智能化地改善自身。
en: Given this trend, it is not surprising that some people foresee a point known as the “Singularity,” when AI systems will exceed human intelligence, by intelligently improving themselves.

zh: 到了这一步 — — 不管是2030年还是本世纪末 — — 机器人将真正接管，而AI将把战争、贫困、疾病甚至死亡抛入历史的垃圾堆。
en: At that point, whether it is in 2030 or at the end of this century, the robots will truly have taken over, and AI will consign war, poverty, disease, and even death to the past.

zh: 对于所有这些，我要说的是：继续做梦。
en: To all of this, I say: Dream on.

zh: 人工一般智能（AGI）仍然是一个白日梦。
en: Artificial general intelligence (AGI) is still a pipe dream.

zh: 它太难掌握。
en: It’s simply too difficult to master.

zh: 尽管它有朝一日可能会成为现实，但显然不会是可预见的未来。
en: And while it may be achieved one of these days, it is certainly not in our foreseeable future.

zh: 但我们仍然可以看到不少重大发展，其中许多让我们对未来充满希望。
en: But there are still major developments on the horizon, many of which will give us hope for the future.

zh: 比如，AI可以为更多人提供可靠的法律建议，并且成本非常低廉。
en: For example, AI can make reliable legal advice available to more people, and at a very low cost.

zh: 它可以帮助我们治疗目前不可治愈的疾病，扩大可信医疗建议的普及面，而不需要增加医学专家人数。
en: And it can help us tackle currently incurable diseases and expand access to credible medical advice, without requiring additional medical specialists.

zh: 在其他领域，我们应该对未来保持审慎悲观 — — 不是说反乌托邦。
en: In other areas, we should be prudently pessimistic – not to say dystopian – about the future.

zh: AI对军事、个人隐私和就业造成了令人担忧的影响。
en: AI has worrying implications for the military, individual privacy, and employment.

zh: 自动武器已经存在，并且最终将具备自动遴选目标的能力。
en: Automated weapons already exist, and they could eventually be capable of autonomous target selection.

zh: 随着政府和跨国企业越来越容易获得大数据，我们的个人信息日益危险。
en: As Big Data becomes more accessible to governments and multinational corporations, our personal information is being increasingly compromised.

zh: 而随着AI接管更多的常规活动，许多职业将被去技能化（deskilled）和取代。
en: And as AI takes over more routine activities, many professionals will be deskilled and displaced.

zh: 工作本身的性质也将发生改变，我们可能需要考虑提供“全民收入 ” ， 如果税基仍然足够提供资金的话。
en: The nature of work itself will change, and we may need to consider providing a “universal income,” assuming there is still a sufficient tax base through which to fund it.

zh: AI的另一个不同但同样令人担忧的影响是它可能成为一对一人际联系的替代品。
en: A different but equally troubling implication of AI is that it could become a substitute for one-on-one human contact.

zh: 举一个日常的例子，想象一下你想打电话给一个真人，却被自动菜单转来转去。
en: To take a trivial example, think about the annoyance of trying to reach a real person on the phone, only to be passed along from one automated menu to another.

zh: 有时候，你之所以烦恼，只是因为你无法在没有人类智能干预的情况下获得你需要的答案。
en: Sometimes, this is vexing simply because you cannot get the answer you need without the intervention of human intelligence.

zh: 或者，这令你心情沮丧，因为你不再能够向人类同胞表达你的感觉，而人类能够理解你的情绪甚至与你感同身受。
en: Or, it may be emotionally frustrating, because you are barred from expressing your feelings to a fellow human being, who would understand, and might even share your sentiments.

zh: 其他例子没有那么日常，而我特别担心用来当作老年人“看护者”或“陪伴者”的计算机。
en: Other examples are less trivial, and I am particularly worried about computers being used as “carers” or “companions” for elderly people.

zh: 平心而论，连上互联网、提供个性化应用的AI系统可以提醒和娱乐孤独的人，也可以监测这些人的重要信号，在必要时向医生或家庭预警。
en: To be sure, AI systems that are linked to the Internet and furnished with personalized apps could inform and entertain a lonely person, as well as monitor their vital signs and alert physicians or family members when necessary.

zh: 居家机器人可以在从冰箱中取食物和完成其他家务方面派上巨大的用场。
en: Domestic robots could prove to be very useful for fetching food from the fridge and completing other household tasks.

zh: 但AI系统能否提供真正的看护或陪伴完全是另一个问题。
en: But whether an AI system can provide genuine care or companionship is another matter altogether.

zh: 认为这可能的人觉得自然语言处理可以胜任这一任务。
en: Those who believe that this is possible assume that natural-language processing will be up to the task.

zh: 但“任务”还包括关于个人记忆的充满感情的对话。
en: But “the task” would include having emotionally-laden conversations about people’s personal memories.

zh: AI系统或许能够从人的用语、声调、停顿和表情中识别有限的感情，但它不可能匹配合理的人类反应。
en: While an AI system might be able to recognize a limited range of emotions in someone’s vocabulary, intonation, pauses, or facial expressions, it will never be able to match an appropriate human response.

zh: 我可能说“很抱歉你伤心了 ， ” 或者“这真是太好了！
en: It might say, “I’m sorry you’re sad about that,” or, “What a lovely thing to have happened!”

zh: ”但这些语句在字面上毫无意义。
en: But either phrase would be literally meaningless.

zh: 一个焦躁不安的人可能被这些语句“安抚 ” ， 但他们的人格尊严会付出怎样的代价？
en: A demented person could be “comforted” by such words, but at what cost to their human dignity?

zh: 当然，另一条路是继续让人类扮演这些角色。
en: The alternative, of course, is to keep humans in these roles.

zh: 机器人不取代人，而是作为人的助手。
en: Rather than replacing humans, robots can be human aids.

zh: 如今，许多与身心看护有关人际互动岗位被低估了。
en: Today, many human-to-human jobs that involve physical and emotional caretaking are undervalued.

zh: 在理想情况下，这些岗位应该在未来获得更多的尊重和报酬。
en: Ideally, these jobs will gain more respect and remuneration in the future.

zh: 但也许这只是一厢情愿。
en: But perhaps that is wishful thinking.

zh: 说到底，AI的未来（future of AI ） — —我们的AI未来（AI future ） — —是光明的。
en: Ultimately, the future of AI – our AI future – is bright.

zh: 但它越是光明，投下的阴影也越大。
en: But the brighter it becomes, the more shadows it will cast.

zh: 来自古希腊的人工智能警钟
en: An AI Wake-Up Call From Ancient Greece

zh: 斯坦福—在关于人工智能（AI）的影响的讨论中，有人动辄拿出潘多拉魔盒的希腊神话。
en: STANFORD – In discussions about the implications of artificial intelligence (AI), someone almost always evokes the ancient Greek myth of Pandora’s box.

zh: 在这个故事的现代童话版里，潘多拉的形象是一位悲剧的好奇青年女子，打开了一个被封印的罐子，不小心放出了人类永恒的苦难。
en: In the modern fairytale version of the story, Pandora is depicted as a tragically curious young woman who opens a sealed urn and inadvertently releases eternal misery on humankind.

zh: 就像逃脱瓶中的妖怪，冲出谷仓的马匹，驶出站台的列车，这则神话也已经成为陈词滥调。
en: Like the genie that has escaped the bottle, the horse that has fled the barn, and the train that has left the station, the myth has become a cliché.

zh: 但是，真正的潘多拉的故事非常契合AI和机器学习的争论。
en: And yet the actual story of Pandora is far more apropos to debates about AI and machine learning than many realize.

zh: 它教导我们，最好听取关心人类未来的“普罗米修斯”的建议，而不是轻易被短期利益蒙蔽双眼的“厄庇墨透斯”的意见。
en: What it shows is that it is better to listen to “Prometheans” who are concerned about humanity’s future than “Epimetheans” who are easily dazzled by the prospect of short-term gains.

zh: 作为最古老的希腊神话之一，潘多拉的故事最早记录出现在距今2,500多年的荷马时代。
en: One of the oldest Greek myths, the story of Pandora was first recorded more than 2,500 years ago, in the time of Homer.

zh: 在最原始的叙事中，潘多拉并不是受到诱惑打开封禁之罐的纯真少女。
en: In the original telling, Pandora was not some innocent girl who succumbed to the temptation to open a forbidden jar.

zh: 相反，诗人赫西奥德告诉我们，潘多拉是“后天养成，而非先天生成。
en: Rather, as the poet Hesiod tells us, Pandora was “made, not born.”

zh: ”潘多拉是全能神宙斯的命令，指定发明之神赫淮斯托斯设计了残酷的范式，她是一个人形机器人，有一副迷人少女的外表。
en: Having been commissioned by all-powerful Zeus and designed to his cruel specifications by Hephaestus, the god of invention, Pandora was a lifelike android created to look like a bewitching maiden.

zh: 她的使命是诱骗凡人以显示劣根性 ： “ 红颜祸水 ” 。
en: Her purpose was to entrap mortals as a manifestation of kalon kakon: “evil hidden in beauty.”

zh: 潘多拉的名字意为“所有礼物 ” ， 表明她是众神共同的产物。
en: Pandora’s name means “all gifts,” and reflects the fact that all of the gods contributed to her composition.

zh: 她产生于赫淮斯托斯的炼炉，赫尔墨斯护送这位令人神魂颠倒的“女人”来到地球，把她包装成厄庇墨透斯的新娘。
en: After her creation in Hephaestus’s forge, Hermes escorted the ravishing young “woman” down to earth and presented her as a bride to Epimetheus.

zh: 她的嫁妆就是那个包含了更多“礼物”的封禁的命运之罐。
en: Her dowry was the fateful sealed jar containing more “gifts.”

zh: 厄庇墨透斯是普罗米修斯的兄弟。 反抗巨人普罗米修斯领导了 — — 也有故事说是他创造了 — — 人类。
en: Epimetheus was brother to Prometheus, the rebel titan who championed – and, by some accounts, created – humankind.

zh: 普罗米修斯担心人类显而易见的缺陷，因此教会男人和女人如何负责地使用火和其他工具。
en: Prometheus was concerned with humans’ obvious vulnerability, so he taught men and women how to use fire and other tools responsibly.

zh: 但这触怒了暴君宙斯，了不起的技术是他眼中的禁脔。
en: But this enraged Zeus, a merciless tyrant who jealously guarded his exclusive access to awesome technologies.

zh: 作为惩罚，宙斯将普罗米修斯绑在一块岩石上，派出他的无人机一样的老鹰 — — 也产生自赫淮斯托斯的熔炉 — — 啄食他的肝脏。
en: As punishment, Zeus bound Prometheus to a rock and sent his drone-like eagle – also forged by Hephaestus – to feed on his liver.

zh: 至于潘多拉，她被刻意设计出来惩罚人类接受普罗米修斯的礼物。
en: For her part, Pandora was deliberately devised to punish humankind for accepting the gift of fire from Prometheus.

zh: 本质上，她是一个迷人的雌性人工智能，没有父母，没有童年记忆，也没有任何情感，不会老也不会死。
en: Essentially a seductive AI fembot, she had no parents, childhood memories, or emotions of any kind, nor would she ever age or die.

zh: 她的设定要完成一个狠毒的任务：潜伏在人间，解除罐子的封印。
en: She was programmed to carry out one malevolent mission: to insinuate herself in an earthly setting and then unseal the jar.

zh: 但这尚不是故事的全部。
en: But that is still not the whole story.

zh: 帕累托告诉我们，普罗米修斯的名字意为“远见 ” ， 因为和他无忧无虑的兄弟厄庇墨透斯（名字意为“向后看 ” ） 不同，他永远向前看。
en: As Plato tells us, Prometheus’s name means “foresight,” because he was always looking ahead, unlike his carefree brother, Epimetheus, whose name means “hindsight.”

zh: 兄弟两人中，普罗米修斯更加理性，也显得更加偏执，他试图警告厄庇墨透斯不要接受宙斯的危险礼物。
en: As the more rational and justifiably paranoid of the two, Prometheus tried to warn his brother not to accept Zeus’s dangerous gift.

zh: 但厄庇墨透斯被潘多拉迷得神魂颠倒，毫无防备地让她走进了他的生活。
en: But Epimetheus was charmed by Pandora and heedlessly welcomed her into his life.

zh: 随后他才认识到自己犯了一个可怕的错误。
en: Only later did he come to realize his terrible error.

zh: 因此，潘多拉的流行形象 — — 惊恐地后退，看着各种妖魔鬼怪逃出罐子 — — 是现代的发明。
en: The popular image of Pandora reeling back in horror as a cloud of evil swarms out of the jar is thus a modern invention.

zh: 最后希望也从罐子中飞出安抚人类的灵魂的令人作呕的桥段亦然。
en: So, too, is the cloying image of Hope emerging from the vessel last to soothe men’s souls.

zh: 在古典希腊戏曲中，潘多拉形象是一台狡猾的机器：最著名的潘多拉瓶绘把她画成一位年轻女性，站姿僵硬，带着神秘莫测的微笑。
en: In classical Greek renditions, Pandora is depicted as a cunning automaton: the most famous vase painting of her shows a young woman standing stiffly with an uncanny smile.

zh: 此外，在古代，希望被人格化为一位名叫厄尔皮斯的年轻女性，常常意味着缺乏远见。
en: Moreover, in antiquity, Hope was personified as a young woman named Elpis, and usually stood for a lack of foresight.

zh: 希望绝不是什么福音，而是象征着无法向前看或在可能的结果中做出明智的选择；她代表着一厢情愿，而不是维持生活的乐观。
en: Rather than a boon, Hope signified an inability to look ahead or choose sensibly among possible outcomes; she represented wishful thinking, not life-sustaining optimism.

zh: 对希腊人来说，她无非是劣根性的另一种表象：释放到人类头上的美丽的魔鬼。
en: And for the Greeks, she was just another manifestation of kalos kakon: a beautiful evil that had been unleashed upon humans.

zh: 因此，至少有一位古代艺术家把厄尔皮斯/希望画得像极了潘多拉，带着傻笑。
en: Hence, at least one ancient artist depicted Elpis/Hope, much like Pandora, with a smirking grin.

zh: AI/机器学习正在迅速演变为技术“黑箱 ” ， 潘多拉的封禁之罐的象征也有了新的含义。
en: With AI/machine learning quickly evolving into a “black box” technology, the symbol of Pandora’s sealed jar has taken on new meaning.

zh: 要不了多久，AI决策系统的操作逻辑不但用户无法理解，就连创造者也无法理解。
en: Soon, the operational logic of AI decision-making systems will be inscrutable not just to their users, but also to their creators.

zh: 于其他威胁一样，AI系统被邪恶之徒入侵或被恐怖分子和暴君利用的可能性很大。
en: Among other threats, the possibility that AI systems will be hacked by malign actors, or deployed by terrorists and tyrants, now looms large.

zh: Facebook创始人马克·扎克伯格（Mark Zuckerberg）麻省理工学院的安德鲁·迈克菲（Andrew McAfee ） 、 微软的程丽丽（Lili Cheng）和其他AI乐观派像我们保证，AI会带来巨大的益处，但我们仍然会不经意地想起厄庇墨透斯和厄尔皮斯。
en: When Facebook founder Mark Zuckerberg, MIT’s Andrew McAfee, Lili Cheng of Microsoft, and other AI optimists assure us that AI will bring great benefits, one cannot help but think of Epimetheus and Elpis.

zh: 我们真的应该信任人类能调整和解决AI所造成的问题吗？
en: Should we really trust humanity to adjust and troubleshoot the problems posed by AI as they arise?

zh: 似乎更明智的做法是聆听当代普罗米修斯，如已故的史蒂芬·霍金、微软创始人比尔·盖茨，以及2017年发声讨论武器化AI和机器人的威胁的其他115位科技领袖。
en: It seems wiser to heed modern-day Promethean thinkers such as the late Stephen Hawking, Microsoft founder Bill Gates, and the 115 other tech leaders who in 2017 spoke out about the threat of weaponized AI and robotics.

zh: “留给我们行动的时间已经不多了 ， ” 他们警告 ， “ 一旦潘多拉的盒子被打开，就再也难以关上。
en: “We do not have long to act,” they warned. “Once this Pandora’s box is opened, it will be hard to close.”

zh: ”此外，这些普罗米修斯的担心收到了谷歌联合创始人谢尔盖·布林和乔安娜·布莱森（Joanna Bryson）和帕特里克·林（Patrick Lin）等人工智能伦理学家人的遥相呼应，他们警告不可贸然接受AI的礼物，必须先想好如何控制它们。
en: Moreover, these Prometheans’ concerns have been echoed by Google co-founder Sergey Brin and AI ethicists such as Joanna Bryson and Patrick Lin, who caution against recklessly accepting AI’s “gifts” before figuring out how to control them.

zh: 最新民调表明，真正在开发AI系统的人，对AI的潜在益处的乐观态度大幅下降。
en: Recent polls suggest that optimism about the potential benefits of AI has dropped significantly among those who are actually developing AI systems.

zh: 对AI工作原理的理解将带来更加现实的预期。
en: An understanding of how AI works would seem to correlate with more realistic expectations.

zh: 不是盲目的希望，而是基于知识和经验的远见应该决定我们如何管理这项技术及其于我们的关系的未来。
en: Rather than blind hope, foresight based on knowledge and experience should govern how we manage the future of this technology and our relationship with it.

zh: 站在人工智能革命的风口浪尖
en: On the Cusp of an AI Revolution

zh: 旧金山 — — 过去三十年来，消费者已经从激动人心的技术进步中获益匪浅。
en: SAN FRANCISCO – Over the last 30 years, consumers have reaped the benefits of dramatic technological advances.

zh: 在很多国家，大多数人揣在口袋里的个人电脑比二十世纪八十年代的大型计算机运算能力更强。
en: In many countries, most people now have in their pockets a personal computer more powerful than the mainframes of the 1980s.

zh: 高中时我用来开发游戏的Atari 800XL电脑其微处理器拥有3，500个晶体管；而今天我的iPhone 上运行的电脑其晶体管数达到20亿个之多。
en: The Atari 800XL computer that I developed games on when I was in high school was powered by a microprocessor with 3,500 transistors; the computer running on my iPhone today has two billion transistors.

zh: 当时，1GB的存储装置耗资100,000美元，而且有冰箱大小；今天它几乎不花钱，尺寸也以毫米计量。
en: Back then, a gigabyte of storage cost $100,000 and was the size of a refrigerator; today it’s basically free and is measured in millimeters.

zh: 即使取得了如此大的进步，我们仍然可以在整个星球 — — 包括所有人和物 — — 联网的过程中期待更快的进步。
en: Even with these massive gains, we can expect still faster progress as the entire planet – people and things – becomes connected.

zh: 已经有50亿人使用移动设备，超过 30亿人可以接入互联网。
en: Already, five billion people have access to a mobile device, and more than three billion people can access the Internet.

zh: 未来若干年，500亿件物品 — — 从灯泡到冰箱、道路、服装等诸如此类 — — 也将连接到互联网。
en: In the coming years, 50 billion things – from light bulbs to refrigerators, roads, clothing, and more – will be connected to the Internet as well.

zh: 每过一代人左右，新兴技术就会出现融合，某种革命性的技术因此而诞生。
en: Every generation or so, emerging technologies converge, and something revolutionary occurs.

zh: 比方说，成熟的互联网、廉价的带宽和文件压缩，以及苹果标志性的iPhone使得像Uber , 、 Airbnb、 YouTube、Facebook和Twitter这样的企业重新定义移动客户体验。
en: For example, a maturing Internet, affordable bandwidth and file-compression, and Apple’s iconic iPhone enabled companies such as Uber, Airbnb, YouTube, Facebook, and Twitter to redefine the mobile-customer experience.

zh: 现在我们正站在另一次大规模融合的风口浪尖上：大数据、机器学习和不断提高的计算能力将很快使人工智能（AI）无处不在。
en: Now we are on the cusp of another major convergence: big data, machine learning, and increased computing power will soon make artificial intelligence, or AI, ubiquitous.

zh: 人工智能符合爱因斯坦的那句格言，即天才能将复杂事物简单化。
en: AI follows Albert Einstein’s dictum that genius renders simplicity from complexity.

zh: 因此，在世界本身越来越复杂的同时，人工智能将成为21世纪的决定性技术，就像微处理器是二十世纪的决定性技术一样。
en: So, as the world itself becomes more complex, AI will become the defining technology of the twenty-first century, just as the microprocessor was in the twentieth century.

zh: 消费者已经每天都在与人工智能打交道。
en: Consumers already encounter AI on a daily basis.

zh: 谷歌利用机器学习来自动完成搜索查询，并且往往能够准确预测某个人要找什么。
en: Google uses machine learning to autocomplete search queries and often accurately predicts what someone is looking for.

zh: Facebook 和Amazon 利用预测算法在用户阅读或购买经历的基础上完成推荐工作。
en: Facebook and Amazon use predictive algorithms to make recommendations based on a user’s reading or purchasing history.

zh: 人工智能是无人驾驶汽车的核心部件 — — 无人驾驶技术现在可以避免碰撞和交通堵塞 — — 人工智能也是像谷歌DeepMind AlphaGo等游戏系统的核心部件，这台电脑年初在一场五局三胜制的比赛中击败了韩国围棋高手李世石。
en: AI is the central component in self-driving cars – which can now avoid collisions and traffic congestion – and in game-playing systems like Google DeepMind’s AlphaGo, a computer that beat South Korean Go master Lee Sedol in a five-game match earlier this year.

zh: 鉴于人工智能的广泛应用，今天的所有企业都必须要将它们融入自己的产品和服务；否则，他们将无法与利用数据搜集网络改善用户体验和辅助商业决策的企业展开竞争。
en: Given AI’s wide applications, all companies today face an imperative to integrate it into their products and services; otherwise, they will not be able to compete with companies that are using data-collection networks to improve customer experiences and inform business decisions.

zh: 下一代消费者将会与数字技术共同成长，他们会期望公司预见他们的需求，并实时、个性化地提供咨询服务。
en: The next generation of consumers will have grown up with digital technologies and will expect companies to anticipate their needs and provide instant, personalized responses to any query.

zh: 迄今为止，人工智能太过复杂昂贵，以致很多企业很难对其进行最佳应用。
en: So far, AI has been too costly or complex for many businesses to make optimal use of it.

zh: 将其融入企业现有业务难度很大，历史上一直需要掌握复杂技术的数据学家才能完成这项任务。
en: It can be difficult to integrate into a business’s existing operations, and historically it has required highly skilled data scientists.

zh: 结果导致很多企业仍然凭直觉而不是信息作出重要决策。
en: As a result, many businesses still make important decisions based on instinct instead of information.

zh: 今后几年这一切都将发生改变，随着人工智能越来越普及，可能使每间企业、每位员工都变得更加聪明、快速和高效。
en: This will change in the next few years, as AI becomes more pervasive, potentially making every company and every employee smarter, faster, and more productive.

zh: 机器学习算法可以分析数以十亿计的信号，从而将客户服务电话自动转接给最合适的代理人，或确定最有可能购买某种特定商品的某位客户。
en: Machine learning algorithms can analyze billions of signals to route customer service calls automatically to the most appropriate agent or determine which customers are most likely to purchase a particular product.

zh: 而且人工智能的应用不仅限于在线零售：据A.T. Kearney咨询公司统计，实体商店依然在零售行业中占据90%的份额。
en: And AI’s applications extend beyond online retail: Brick-and-mortar stores still account for 90% of retail sales, according to the consultancy A.T. Kearney.

zh: 很快，客户一进入实体店，互动式聊天机器人就会上前跟他们打招呼，机器人可以根据过往的购买历史推荐产品，提供特别折扣并处理客户服务事务。
en: Soon, when customers enter a physical store, they will be greeted by interactive chat-bots that can recommend products based on shopping history, offer special discounts, and handle customer-service issues.

zh: 所谓“深度学习 ” （ 模仿大脑神经网络的人工智能分支）领域的进步可以使智能数字助理在来自社交网络和其他数据来源的数以百万计的信号基础上以人类助理般的敏锐协助客户规划假期、或确定客户对某个品牌的反应。
en: Advances in so-called “deep learning,” a branch of AI modeled after the brain’s neural network, could enable intelligent digital assistants to help plan vacations with the acumen of a human assistant, or determine consumer sentiments toward a particular brand, based on millions of signals from social networks and other data sources.

zh: 在医疗保健领域，深度学习算法可以协助医生从世界的任何角落实时确定肿瘤细胞类型或颅内异常问题。
en: In health care, deep-learning algorithms could help doctors identify cancer-cell types or intracranial abnormalities from anywhere in the world in real time.

zh: 要想有效利用人工智能，企业必须对隐私和安全问题时刻保持关注。
en: To deploy AI effectively, companies will need to keep privacy and security in mind.

zh: 因为人工智��基于数据，机器了解的个人数据越多，代表客户预测其需求的准确度就越大。
en: Because AI is fueled by data, the more data the machine gains about an individual, the better it can predict their needs and act on their behalf.

zh: 但当然，这样的个人信息大规模流动可能违反客户的信任。
en: But, of course, that massive flow of personal data could be appropriated in ways that breach trust.

zh: 企业必须公开其个人数据的使用方式。
en: Companies will have to be transparent about how they use people’s personal data.

zh: 人工智能还可以检测并防御数字安全漏洞，并在保护用户隐私和建立信任时发挥关键作用。
en: AI can also detect and defend against digital security breaches, and will play a critical role in protecting user privacy and building trust.

zh: 就像过去的经济转型期一样，人工智能将释放新的生产力水平、强化个人和职业生涯并提出有关人和机器间古老关系的存在性问题。
en: As in past periods of economic transformation, AI will unleash new levels of productivity, augment our personal and professional lives, and pose existential questions about the age-old relationship between man and machine.

zh: 人工智能在自动完成任务时会扰乱行业和工人。
en: It will disrupt industries and dislocate workers as it automates more tasks.

zh: 但就像二十年前的互联网那样，人工智能将改善现有岗位并催生新的机遇。
en: But just as the Internet did 20 years ago, AI will also improve existing jobs and spawn new ones.

zh: 对此我们应当保持清醒的认识，并通过为明天的岗位提供培训和为落伍民众建立安全网来适应明天的环境。
en: We should expect this and adapt accordingly by providing training for the jobs of tomorrow, as well as safety nets for those who fall behind.

zh: 人工智能超越人类智慧还有很长的路要走。
en: AI is still a long way from surpassing human intelligence.

zh: 距离计算学家和人工智能之父约翰·麦卡锡在达特茅斯学院一次会议期间首次提出人工智能概念已经过去了六十年。 只有到了最近计算机才能识别YouTube视频中的猫或确定前往机场的最佳路线。
en: It has been 60 years since John McCarthy, a computer scientist and nominal father of AI, first introduced the term during a conference at Dartmouth College, and computers have only recently been able to detect cats in YouTube videos or determine the best route to the airport.

zh: 我们可以肯定今后的技术创新速度将超过前几代人。
en: We can count on technological innovation to continue at an even more rapid pace than in previous generations.

zh: 人工智能将像电流般 — — 无形无影，但却充斥着我们的生活。
en: AI will become like electrical current – invisible and augmenting almost every part of our lives.

zh: 从现在起三十年后，没有貌似心灵感应般的数字助理我们就不知道要怎样生活，就像今天每隔几分钟不看看口袋里那台的二十世纪八十年代的大型计算机就会令人觉得难以想象。
en: Thirty years from now, we will wonder how we ever got along without our seemingly telepathic digital assistants, just as today it’s already hard to imagine going more than a few minutes without checking the 1980s mainframe in one’s pocket.

zh: 人工智能时代的就业
en: Jobs in the Age of Artificial Intelligence

zh: 华盛顿—如今，紧迫的问题层出不穷。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The world has no shortage of pressing issues.

zh: 有16亿人生活在赤贫中；大约7.8亿成年人不识字。
en: There are 1.6 billion people living in acute poverty; an estimated 780 million adults are illiterate.

zh: 严峻的问题不仅局限于发展中世界：比如 ， “ 绝望的死亡”提高了美国白人男性的死亡率。
en: Serious problems are not confined to the developing world: “deaths of despair,” for example, are raising mortality among white males in the United States.

zh: 即使发达经济体实现了增长，也不是所有人都能受益。
en: Even when advanced economies grow, they are not lifting all boats.

zh: 较高收入群体越来越好，而较低收入家庭和少数群体一直落后。
en: Higher-income groups thrive while lower-income households and minority groups are consistently left behind.

zh: 一些分析家指出，新式电脑编程将加剧这些发展趋势，算法、机器人和自动驾驶汽车将摧毁中产阶级就业，恶化不平等性。
en: And now some analysts suggest that new forms of computer programming will compound these developments, as algorithms, robots, and self-driving cars destroy middle-class jobs and worsen inequality.

zh: 即使这类技术的总称 — — 人工智能，听起来也是来势汹汹。
en: Even the summary term for this technology, Artificial Intelligence, sounds ominous.

zh: 人脑可能是“已知宇宙中最复杂的物体 ” ， 但是，作为一个物种，我们并非总具有集体智慧。
en: The human brain may be the “most complex object in the known universe,” but, as a species, we are not always collectively very smart.

zh: 畅销科幻小说作家早就预测，总有一天我们会发明出毁掉我们的机器。
en: Best-selling science fiction writers have long predicted that we will one day invent the machines that destroy us.

zh: 创造这一反乌托邦未来的技术也许连影子都还没有。
en: The technology needed to create this dystopian future is not even on the horizon.

zh: 但最近在人工智能相关技术领域上的突破确实提供了从交通到教育和缉毒在内的一系列应用中爆发巨大积极进步的潜力。
en: But recent breakthroughs in AI-related technologies do offer enormous potential for positive advances in a range of applications from transportation to education and drug discovery.

zh: 我们的计算能力的提升能够帮助地球和最脆弱的地球公民。
en: Used wisely, this boost in our computational abilities can help the planet and some of its most vulnerable citizens.

zh: 现在，我们可以发现一些对人类观察者来说不那么容易发现的新模式 — — 这已经为我们带来降低能源消费和二氧化碳排放的方法。
en: We can now find new patterns that are not readily evident to the human observer – and this already suggests ways to lower energy consumption and carbon dioxide emissions.

zh: 我们可以增进工厂的效率，减少粮食浪费。
en: We can increase productivity in our factories and reduce food waste.

zh: 更广泛地说，我们可以改进预测结果，使之远远超过常规计算机的能力。
en: More broadly, we can improve prediction far beyond the ability of conventional computers.

zh: 在许多活动中，一秒钟的预警就可以起到巨大的作用，甚至拯救生命。
en: Think of the myriad activities in which a one-second warning would be useful or even lifesaving.

zh: 但恐惧依旧：这些改进是否意味着放弃所有就业岗位 — — 或大部分优质就业岗位？
en: And yet the fear remains: Won’t these same improvements entail giving up all of our jobs – or most of our good jobs?

zh: 事实上，出于三个原因，不会发生就业启示录。
en: In fact, there are three reasons why the jobs apocalypse is on hold.

zh: 首先是莫拉维茨（Moravec）悖论。
en: First, Moravec’s paradox applies.

zh: 汉斯莫拉维茨和其他计算机科学家在20世纪80年代时指出，对我们来说轻而易举的事情，对最先进的人工智能来说也是难于上青天；反之，人工智能常常能够轻松完成我们认为困难的事情。
en: Hans Moravec and other computer scientists pointed out in the 1980s that what is simple for us is hard for even the most sophisticated AI; conversely, AI often can do easily what we regard as difficult.

zh: 大部分人都能走路、操纵物体、在幼儿期就能理解复杂的语言，从来不必关注完成这些任务需要消耗多少计算量和能量。
en: Most humans can walk, manipulate objects, and understand complex language from an early age, never paying much attention to the amount of computation and energy needed to perform these tasks.

zh: 聪明的机器做起数学计算来要远远胜过人类，但它们无法轻松地站上椅子、开门和转动阀门。
en: Smart machines can perform mathematical calculations far exceeding a human’s capabilities, but they cannot easily climb stairs, open a door, and turn a valve.

zh: 也不能踢足球。
en: Or kick a soccer ball.

zh: 其次，今天的算法非常擅长模式识别，如果可以提供大数据集的话 — — 如在YouTube视频中找到目标或识别信用卡诈骗 — — 但它们如果遇到与常规模式不符的非常规环境，或者仅仅因为数据稀缺或有点“噪音 ” ， 效率就会大大降低。
en: Second, today’s algorithms are becoming very good at pattern recognition when they are provided with large data sets – finding objects in YouTube videos or detecting credit card fraud – but they are much less effective with unusual circumstances that do not fit the usual pattern, or simply when the data are scarce or a bit “noisy.”

zh: 要处理这样的状况，你需要熟练的人手，利用他的经验、直觉和社会意识。
en: To handle such cases, you need a skilled person, with his or her experience, intuition, and social awareness.

zh: 第三，最新的系统无法解释他们做了什么，或为什么他们建议采取某个行动。
en: Third, the latest systems cannot explain what they have done or why they are recommending a particular course of action.

zh: 在这些“黑箱”中，你无法阅读代码来分析正在发生什么或检查是否存在隐藏的偏误。
en: In these “black boxes,” you cannot simply read the code to analyze what is happening or to check if there is a hidden bias.

zh: 在可解释性非常重要的情况中 — — 比如在许多医学应用中 — — 你需要决策环中存在训练有素的人。
en: When interpretability is important – for example, in many medical applications – you need a trained human in the decision-making loop.

zh: 当然，这只是今天的技术状态 — — 而高企的投资率可能迅速改变可能性。
en: Of course, this is just the state of technology today – and high rates of investment may quickly change what is possible.

zh: 但工作的性质也会改变。
en: But the nature of work will also change.

zh: 今天的就业岗位与50乃至20年前相比已是天壤之别。
en: Jobs today look very different from jobs 50 or even 20 years ago.

zh: 并且新计算机算法需要时间充分深入到经济中。
en: And new computer algorithms will take time to penetrate the economy fully.

zh: 数据丰富的行业，如数字媒体和电子商务，也才刚刚开始释放人工智能所创造的能力。
en: Data-rich sectors such as digital media and e-commerce have just begun to unleash the capabilities AI has created.

zh: 可能影响到医疗、教育和建筑等行业就业的狭义人工智能应用的兴起可能需要非常长的时间才能扩散。
en: The multitude of narrow AI applications that could affect jobs in sectors such as health care, education, and construction will take much longer to spread.

zh: 事实上，这也许来的正是时候 — — 发达经济体人口老龄化意味着未来几十年中劳动力将减少 — — 而个人护理需求将增加。
en: In fact, this may come just in time – an aging population in developed economies implies a smaller workforce – and greater need for personal care services – in the coming decades.

zh: 公共政策讨论将影响到人工智能时代。
en: Public policy decisions will shape the AI era.

zh: 我们需要机会和竞争，而不是强大的垄断者的成长，这样才能使技术进步不会把大量人民落在身后。
en: We need opportunity and competition, not the growth of powerful monopolies, in order to promote technological progress in a way that does not leave a large number of people behind.

zh: 这需要改善各种形式教育的普及程度 — — 并且要以低成本乃至零成本推广教育。
en: This requires improving access to all forms of education – and at low or zero cost.

zh: 随着包括中国在内的发达经济体竞争者大力投资于人工智能，决策者应该加强支持基础研究，确保国家拥有需要的实物和人力资源发明和制造与这一新技术总目标相关的一切。
en: With developed economies’ competitors, including China, investing heavily in AI, policymakers should be increasing support for basic research and ensuring that their countries have the physical and human resources they need to invent and manufacture everything connected with this major new general purpose technology.

zh: 我们不应该低估人类给自己的社会、环境甚至整个地球带来伤害的能力。
en: We should not underestimate humans’ abilities to inflict damage on their community, their environment, and even the entire planet.

zh: 也许有朝一日，启示录小说作家将被证明是正确的。
en: Apocalyptic fiction writers may one day be proved correct.

zh: 但是，在眼下，我们拥有一个让全人类过上更好的生活的强大工具。
en: But, for now, we have a powerful new tool for enabling all people to live better lives.

zh: 我们应该明智地使用它。
en: We should use it wisely.

zh: 俄罗斯春天？
en: A Russian Spring?

zh: 巴黎 — — 俄罗斯不是埃及。
en: PARIS – Russia is not Egypt.

zh: 俄罗斯并不像一年前的开罗那样处在革命的爆发的前夕。
en: And Moscow is not on the eve of revolution as Cairo was less than a year ago.

zh: 事实上，俄罗斯政府拥有大量可支配财产，而埃及前总统穆巴拉克政权不具有这样雄厚的资产实力。
en: Indeed, Russia’s powerful have at their disposal assets that former Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak’s regime lacked.

zh: 俄罗斯是一个能源超级大国。 至少在某种来说，俄罗斯可以开启其“保险箱”去缓解国家最近伪造司法选举结果而使其公民所遭受到的羞辱感。
en: As an energy superpower, Russia can open its coffers to appease, at least in part, the humiliation that it has inflicted on its citizens by falsifying the country’s recent legislative election results.

zh: 而且，并不是所有的俄罗斯人都上街示威游行。 我们应该意识到“缩放效果 ” 。
en: And not all Russians are in the streets.

zh: 是这一效果使许多人认为开罗的卡利尔广场聚集的年轻示威者能够代表整个埃及社会。 他们并不能代表整个社会。
en: We should beware of the “zoom effect,” which made many people believe that the young protesters of Cairo’s Tahrir Square were fully representative of Egyptian society.

zh: 埃及的农村人民很像俄罗斯的农村人民。
en: They were not.

zh: 他们比那些年轻的精英们要保守得多得多。 那些年轻的精英们接住了社会媒体，通过抗议示威吸引住了全世界的注意力。
en: Rural Egypt, like rural Russia, is much more conservative than the young elites who seize the world’s imagination with their protests and embrace of modern social media.

zh: 再者，穆巴拉克年事已高又体弱多病，已经不再受到人民的信赖。
en: Furthermore, Mubarak was old and sick, and no longer enjoyed the trust of his people.

zh: 相比之下，普京身体健康，充满着活力和朝气。 他任然可能会说服许多俄罗斯社会不同阶层的人民，而这些人主要在乎的是国家的荣誉而并非其公民的幸福。
en: Vladimir Putin, by contrast, exudes energy and health, and may still reassure many segments of Russian society whose main concern is their country’s glory rather than its citizens’ happiness.

zh: 然而，普京可能过分地强调大男子主义的强硬态度。 这可能会适得其反，导致俄罗斯城市选民和更多接受过教育的选民的孤立。
en: Yet Putin may be overplaying the macho card so excessively that it could backfire and contribute to his isolation from Russia’s urban and more educated voters.

zh: 但是，即便成千上万示威者的示威者可能不会威胁到普京政权的存亡，但克林姆林宫当权应该变得明智，认真对待这些游行示威者。
en: But, even if the tens of thousands of demonstrators are unlikely to threaten the survival of Putin’s regime, the Kremlin would be wise to take them seriously.

zh: 目前示威者的表现一直比较温和，有节制。 残暴的镇压会成为极其危险的处理手段。
en: The protesters’ trademark so far has been moderation and restraint; nothing would be more dangerous than violent repression.

zh: 除了暴力问题，由于俄罗斯当局未能意识到公众日益增长的疏远感，其可能还会因此受到一项巨大的历史考验 ， 。
en: Beyond the issue of violence, the Russian authorities would take a huge historical risk by failing to register the public’s growing alienation.

zh: 在克林姆林宫高墙的屁护下，俄罗斯的领导人已经逐渐失去了对其普通百姓生活条件的了解（可能他们曾经有所了解 ） ， 他们似乎已经认为自己的生活方式既正常又长久。
en: Sheltered physically and metaphorically by the Kremlin’s high walls, and having progressively lost contact with the living conditions of ordinary people (if they ever had any), Russia’s leaders seem to consider their lifestyle to be both normal and eternal.

zh: 从满嘴谴责的精英群体的行为角度来看，至少在某种程度来说，俄罗斯的示威者引起了阿拉伯革命的参与者的反应。
en: From the standpoint of condemning elite behavior, Russian protesters evoke, at least partly, the actors of the Arab revolution.

zh: 他们公开谴责“苏维埃选举行为 ” ， 他们反对暴君统治和贪污腐败的结合体。 这恰恰是曾经的苏维埃政权和当今的俄罗斯政权所具有的典型特征。
en: In their denunciation of “Soviet electoral practices,” they reject the combination of despotism and corruption that characterized Soviet power yesterday and Russian power today – rhetoric familiar from Arab revolutionaries.

zh: 这和阿拉伯革命者的遭遇极其相似。 就像阿拉伯人民告诉利比亚、埃及、突尼斯、叙利亚，也门和其他阿拉伯国家领导人那样，这一代年轻的俄罗斯人正要求普京“下台 ” 。
en: As young Arabs told the rulers of Libya, Egypt, Tunisia, Syria, Yemen, and other Arab countries, this new generation of Russians is telling Putin: “Get Out!”

zh: 从满嘴谴责的精英群体的行为角度来看，至少在某种程度来说，俄罗斯的示威者引起了阿拉伯革命的参与者的反应。
en: But most participants hold few illusions about the efficacy of their protest.

zh: 他们公开谴责“苏维埃选举行为 ” ， 他们反对暴君统治和贪污腐败的结合体。 这恰恰是曾经的苏维埃政权和当今的俄罗斯政权所具有的典型特征。
en: They want to express to Russia’s rulers the extent of their frustration and determination.

zh: 这和阿拉伯革命者的遭遇极其相似。 就像阿拉伯人民告诉利比亚，埃及，突尼斯，叙利亚，也门和其他阿拉伯国家领导人那样，这一代年轻的俄罗斯人正要求普京“下台 ” 。
en: They may not expect regime change, but they expect at least some minimal reforms.

zh: 最重要的是，他们想要控制普京的权利。
en: Above all, they want to set limits on Putin’s power.

zh: 但是，他们的抗议可能会产生一个讽刺性的结果。 俄罗斯的两个最高政治任务，梅德韦杰夫一直采取较为缓和的态度，也不会像计划那样，重回首相位置。
en: But their protest’s ironic consequence may be that the more moderate of the two figures at the summit of Russian politics, Dmitri Medvedev, will not return to the post of prime minister, as had been planned.

zh: 在太多俄罗斯人民的眼里，这种政治“音乐交椅”的游戏玩得太过于频繁了。
en: A game of political musical chairs would simply be too much in the eyes of too many Russians.

zh: 这些示威游行者不仅使俄罗斯领导人大吃一惊，同样也使广大的俄罗斯公民感到颇为震惊。
en: The protests have caught the Kremlin’s masters, as well as the majority of Russia’s citizens, by surprise.

zh: 他们没有意识到全球化 - - -尤其是信息全球化 - - -已经使整个世界前所未有的透明和相互联系。 马德里的示威者是受到开罗示威者的影响。
en: They failed to recognize that globalization – particularly the global information revolution – has made the world more transparent and interdependent than ever.

zh: 而巴黎示威者本身有又为纽约和拉特维夫的游行者提供了灵感，紧接着这种灵感又传到了莫斯科。
en: The protesters of Madrid were inspired by those of Cairo, and were themselves a source of inspiration from New York to Tel Aviv – and, subsequently, to Moscow.

zh: 从中人们可以吸取一个教训。 一方面，随着经济危机不断恶化；另一方面，由于全球联系具有即时性；曾经被人们所接受的事情现在可能会被视作无法容忍。
en: A lesson emerges: with the deepening of the economic crisis, on the one hand, and instant global connectivity, on the other, what was accepted yesterday is regarded as intolerable today.

zh: 这同样对俄罗斯适用。
en: That applies to Russia, too.

zh: 长久以来，俄罗斯一直认为自己是一个“白色非洲 ” 。
en: For a long time, Russia has perceived itself as a “White Africa.”

zh: 俄罗斯的人口平均寿命稍稍低于60岁。 这一数字更接近非洲，而并非欧洲（或者说，即使连大多数亚洲国家也不如 ） 。
en: The average life expectancy of Russian men, slightly below 60, is more African than European (or even Asian, for the most part).

zh: 在许多俄罗斯的贵族群体中，贪污腐败屡见不鲜。 这中行为和许多在非洲具有同样地位人的灾难性习惯非常相似。
en: The corrupt enrichment of so many Russian elites mimics the disastrous habits of many of their African counterparts.

zh: 但是这种比喻也有局限性。
en: But this comparison has limits.

zh: 尽管非洲存在许多问题，非洲目前已经成为��一个充满希望的大陆。
en: Despite its many problems, Africa today has become a continent of hope.

zh: 其人口正在急速膨胀，经济增长率也正在爆炸式增长。
en: Its population is exploding, as are its economic-growth rates.

zh: 塞内加尔的公司在寻求方法帮助其西班牙商业合作伙伴。 同时，葡萄牙为石油资源丰富的安哥拉 - - -曾经是葡萄牙的殖民地的领导人举办了近乎皇室待遇的欢迎仪式。
en: Senegalese firms seek to help their Spanish business partners, while Portugal extends an almost royal welcome to the leaders of their former colony, newly oil-rich Angola.

zh: 非洲正在崛起，而俄罗斯正在走向衰落。
en: Africa is on the rise, while Russia is on the decline.

zh: 20年前，随着共产主义瓦解而产生的民主理想主义也已丧失殆尽。 在普京领导的数年间 ， “ 帝国骄傲”一定程度上得到恢复。
en: The democratic idealism that accompanied the fall of communism 20 years ago is gone, but the “imperial pride” recovered in part during the Putin years may not be enough to compensate for the contempt with which the Russian state treats its citizens.

zh: 但是，这可能并不足以抵消俄罗斯对其公民低劣的所作所为。 俄罗斯示威者的传达的信息很简单 ： “ 存在太多的贪污腐败和藐视人民，不公平过于严重了。
en: Russia’s demonstrators’ message is simple: “Too much corruption, disdain, and inequality is too much.”

zh: ”就像阿拉伯世界一样，俄罗斯需要现代化。
en: Russia, like the Arab world, wants modernity.

zh: 本·伯南克的全球遗产
en: Ben Bernanke’s Global Legacy

zh: 华盛顿—世界仍在艰难地消化艾伦·格林斯潘在1987—2006年美联储主席任上所留下的遗产。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The world is still struggling to digest Alan Greenspan’s mixed legacy as Chairman of the US Federal Reserve Board from 1987 to 2006.

zh: 因此，现在就对他的即将���任的继任者本·伯南克盖棺定论还为时尚早。
en: So it is too soon to assess whether his departing successor, Ben Bernanke, is headed for history’s chopping block or its pedestal.

zh: 但伯南克及美联储在他任职期间 — — 亦即国内经济弱势演变为美国全球领导力的相对萎靡期间 — — 所扮演的关键的国际角色不应该被忽视。
en: But the crucial international role that Bernanke and the Fed played during his tenure – a time when domestic economic weakness translated into relatively ineffective American global leadership – should not be overlooked.

zh: 在过去的五年中，世界被危机困扰，美联储通过两种方式影响了世界经济：积极地买入长期资产 — — 所谓的量化宽松（QE ） ； 以及很大程度上被忽视的提供国际流动性。
en: In these last five crisis-ridden years, the Fed has affected the world economy in two ways: through its hyperactive policy of purchasing long-term assets – so-called quantitative easing (QE) – and through its largely overlooked role in providing international liquidity.

zh: 我们来逐一考察。
en: Let us consider each.

zh: 不管QE对美国经济形成了什么影响，其对世界其他部分的影响总的来说是温和的。
en: Whatever the impact of QE on the US economy, its impact on the rest of the world has been, on balance, generally benign.

zh: 第一轮QE毫无疑问利大于弊，因为它最小化甚至消除了2008年9月雷曼兄弟公司倒闭后全球萧条的尾部风险。
en: The first round of QE was unambiguously beneficial, because it minimized, or even eliminated, the tail risk of a global depression after the collapse of Lehman Brothers in September 2008.

zh: 平心而论，美联储此后的动作在世界其余部分毁誉参半。
en: To be sure, subsequent action by the Fed received a mixed reception in the rest of the world.

zh: 2010年和2011年，QE让资本流向新兴市场，激起了关于美国在实施某种形式的货币操纵的指责。
en: In 2010 and 2011, when QE pushed capital to emerging markets, there were complaints that the US was practicing a form of currency manipulation.
