zh: 2013年5月，伯南克释放出可能退出QE的信号，这又让新兴经济体面临相反的压力：资本外流和汇率急剧波动。
en: Since May 2013, when Bernanke signaled the possibility of unwinding QE, emerging economies have faced the opposite type of pressure: capital outflows and sharp currency adjustments.

zh: 在这两个阶段，美联储所受到的指责大多反映了受影响国的宏观经济管理失误。
en: But in both cases, the problems for which blame was heaped on the Fed largely reflected macroeconomic mismanagement in the affected countries.

zh: 比如，巴西对资本内流的抱怨声最大，因为其货币在很短的时期里过度升值，但罪魁祸首其实是国内工资上涨和过热，而不是美联储的政策。
en: For example, Brazil complained most vocally about capital inflows, because its currency had over-appreciated in a short period of time; but the main culprits were domestic wage increases and overheating, not the Fed’s policies.

zh: 类似地，印度因为伯南克暗示美联储将“减弱”QE而严重受创，但这只是因为其经济出现了高通胀和庞大的预算和外部赤字。
en: Likewise, India was severely affected by Bernanke’s suggestion that the Fed would “taper” QE, but only because its economy was characterized by high inflation and large budget and external deficits.

zh: 新兴市场似乎忘了，它们容易受到美联储政策的影响，正是它们在加入金融全球化时所争取的东西。
en: It was as if the emerging markets had forgotten that exposure to Fed policies was part of the bargain they willingly made when they signed on to financial globalization.

zh: 与此同时，美联储对其国际责任也十分清楚，通过在极端金融压力时期增加美元流动性起到了建设性作用。
en: Meanwhile, the Fed has been mindful of its international responsibilities, playing a constructive role by increasing dollar liquidity in times of extreme financial stress.

zh: 雷曼兄弟倒闭后，美联储（通过互换安排）向巴西、墨西哥、新加坡和韩国央行提供了美元流动性。
en: It provideddollar liquidity (via swap lines) to the central banks of Brazil, Mexico, Singapore, and South Korea in the aftermath of the Lehman failure.

zh: 同时，它还向欧洲各央行和日本银行提供了近乎无限的相同的流动性。
en: And it has provided nearly unlimited amounts of similar liquidity to central banks in Europe and the Bank of Japan.

zh: 这些行动缓解了极端紧张的金融条件和相应的市场波动。
en: These actions contributed to easing extremely tight financial conditions and corresponding market volatility.

zh: 美联储对新兴市场央行的支持是令人瞩目的，因为这些国家大部分都没有从国际货币基金组织（IMF）贷款，在20世纪90年代的亚洲金融危机后，IMF被看做是美国霸权的工具。
en: The Fed’s support to emerging-market central banks was remarkable, because most of these countries chose not to borrow from the International Monetary Fund, which, in the aftermath of the Asian financial crisis in the 1990’s, had come to be considered an instrument of US hegemony.

zh: 这些国家更愿意通过美联储直接和美国打交道，而美联储显然没有重蹈IMF之耻的覆辙。
en: They preferred to deal directly with the United States via the Fed, to which the IMF stigma evidently did not extend.

zh: 事实上，美联储支持的速度、时机和效果让IMF也开始采取类似的机制。
en: In fact, the speed, timeliness, and effectiveness of Fed support have now led to efforts to institute similar mechanisms at the IMF.

zh: 美联储对欧洲的支持也令人瞩目，因为当时美国政府的其余部门事实上都是旁观者 — — 光说不练，并没有为欧元区受困经济体提供真金白银。
en: The Fed’s support for Europe was similarly remarkable, because the rest of the US government was an ineffective bystander at the time – able to offer cheap counsel but little hard cash to the eurozone’s distressed economies.

zh: 就连增加IMF资源的措施也因为美国政治僵局而不了了之。
en: Even efforts to augment the IMF’s resources floundered on the reef of American political dysfunction.

zh: 所有其他主要经济体，包括美国的重要盟友，都通过了强化IMF所需要的立法；但是，由于国会的抵制，美国自2010年以来从未产生过类似的动作。
en: All other major economies, including key US allies, have enacted the legislation needed to strengthen the IMF; in the US, however, there has been no comparable action since 2010, owing to Congressional resistance.

zh: 美联储为何能在美国国际领导力持续低迷的时期取得无与伦比的成就？ 原因很简单：尽管美国经济十分萎靡，并且美国政治因为两极分化而几近瘫痪，但美元需求仍在。
en: The explanation for the Fed’s exceptional role in the context of otherwise anemic American international leadership is simple: though the US economy is weak, and American politics is polarized to the point of paralysis, the dollar is still in demand.

zh: 在这样的情况下，伯南克有效地利用了他身为叫做“美联储”的强大的美元印钞机控制者的角色。
en: In these circumstances, Bernanke effectively leveraged his role as controller of the mighty dollar-printing machine known as the US Federal Reserve.

zh: 美元霸权不会永远持续下去，它已经开始日益受到人民币的挑战，我在我的著作《侵蚀：生活在中国经济主宰力的阴影下 》 （ Eclipse: Living in the Shadow of China’s Economic Dominance）对此已有描述。
en: Dollar supremacy will not last forever, and it is increasingly being challenged by the Chinese renminbi, as I describe in my book Eclipse: Living in the Shadow of China’s Economic Dominance.

zh: 但美国霸权的残存实力让伯南克成了建设性的高效国际领袖。
en: But that vestigial source of American supremacy made Bernanke a constructive and effective international leader.

zh: 随着他的离任，人们开始给予他“直升机本”的称号，因为它给美国经济注入了大量现金。
en: As he departs from office, the assessment of his performance as “Helicopter Ben,” who dropped piles of cash on the US economy, will begin in earnest.

zh: 但历史不会忘记“大使本”的关键性全球角色。
en: But history should not neglect “Ambassador Ben’s” crucial global role.

zh: 西班牙的人权困境
en: Spain’s Human-Rights Dilemma

zh: 纽约—西班牙国会议员们想要实施一项立法，阻止某些西班牙法官行使类似于流动许可证的权利，在西班牙法庭起诉世界各地发生的侵犯人权行为。
en: NEW YORK – Spanish MPs want to legislate restraints that would prevent a few of the country’s judges from exercising what has seemed like a roving license to prosecute in Spanish courts human-rights violations committed anywhere in the world.

zh: 在最近的一个案例中，一名西班牙法官要求获得针对中国前国家主席蒋泽明和前国务院总理李鹏的逮捕令，指控后两者在西藏犯有罪行。
en: In a current case, a Spanish judge is seeking arrest warrants against Jiang Zemin, the former president of China, and Li Peng, a former Chinese prime minister, for alleged crimes committed in Tibet.

zh: 没有迹象表明西班牙与此案有关。
en: There is no discernible Spanish connection to the case.

zh: 西班牙国会议员们提出了一个观点：允许一国检察官在与西班牙没有明确法律关系的别国选择起诉对象不啻于将起诉程序政治化。
en: The Spanish MPs have a point: Allowing the country’s prosecuting magistrates to select targets from anywhere in the world, without there being a clear legal nexus to Spain, is an invitation to politicize the process.

zh: 但捍卫作为这些起诉基础的核心原则也很重要，即普遍管辖权（universal jurisdiction）的概念。
en: But it is also important to preserve the core principle underlying these prosecutions: the concept of universal jurisdiction.

zh: 事实上，这一概念可谓源远流长，并且在全球人权保护行动中扮演着关键作用。
en: Indeed, it is a concept with ancient origins, and it plays a crucial role in the global protection of human rights.

zh: 普遍管辖权起源于希腊和罗马时代的清剿海盗的战争。
en: Universal jurisdiction originated in Greek and Roman times in the struggle against piracy.

zh: 由于海盗在公海实施犯罪，而公海不属于任何一个国家的领海，因此就产生了一种思想：他们是人类的公敌，任何国家头可以起诉他们。
en: Because pirates committed their crimes on the high seas, beyond the territory of any state, the idea developed that they were enemies of humanity whom any state could prosecute.

zh: 在十七世纪，荷兰学者雨果·格劳修斯（Hugo Grotius，他被认为是国际法的起草者）指出海盗可以在抓获他们的船上被起诉，不管他们的犯罪地点在哪里。
en: In the seventeenth century, the Dutch scholar Hugo Grotius, who is recognized for codifying international law, argued that pirates could be tried for their crimes, regardless of where they were committed, aboard the ships that captured them.

zh: 1814—1815年的维也纳会议规定蓄奴为犯罪行为，此后，一些国家将这一概念应用于奴隶贩子，奴隶贩子的许多罪行也是在国家法律辖区之外犯下的。
en: Following the 1814-1815 Congress of Vienna, with its condemnation of slavery, some states applied the concept to slave traders, who also committed many of their crimes outside national jurisdictions.

zh: 后来，纳粹罪行在普遍管辖权概念获得广泛接受方面起到了关键作用。
en: Later, the crimes of the Nazis played an essential part in winning widespread acceptance of the concept of universal jurisdiction.

zh: 二战结束时，纳粹领导人四散逃亡，散落于世界各地。
en: At the end of World War II, Nazi leaders fled, relocating all over the world.

zh: 加拿大和澳大利亚等国家为了明确表示这些大屠杀罪犯不可能在它们的国土上获得安全港，成立了国家机关在本国法庭上起诉这些嫌犯。
en: Countries like Canada and Australia, seeking certainty that those who had committed horrendous crimes would not find safe haven within their borders, established the authority to try suspects in their own courts.

zh: 此后，这一概念被写入了几乎所有国家投批准了的条约。
en: The concept has since been embodied in treaties that virtually every country in the world has ratified.

zh: 1949年日内瓦公约要求各国搜捕犯有战争罪行者，可以在本国法庭起诉他们，也可以把他们引渡给准备起诉他们的他国。
en: The 1949 Geneva Conventions require states to search for those who have committed war crimes and either prosecute them in their own courts or turn them over to another state that is prepared to try them.

zh: 类似地，1984年禁止酷刑公约（Convention Against Torture）要求各国建立各自的司法管辖权以起诉身在本国并没有引渡回犯罪实施国的罪犯。
en: Similarly, the 1984 Convention Against Torture requires states to establish their own jurisdiction to prosecute torture if an offender is on their territory and is not extradited to stand trial in the country where the crime was committed.

zh: 眼下，普遍管辖权正在塞内加尔经受一次关键考验，非洲残暴独裁者之一、1982—1990年乍得统治者侯赛因·哈布雷（Hissène Habré）即将被起诉。
en: A crucial test of universal jurisdiction is now moving forward in Senegal, where one of Africa’s cruelest dictators, Hissène Habré, who ruled Chad from 1982 to 1990, is set to be prosecuted.

zh: 一个调查委员会认为在其掌权期间，哈布雷政权犯有虐待行为，需要为大约40,000人的死亡负责。
en: A commission of inquiry established that, during its time in power, Habré’s regime carried out torture and was responsible for the deaths of an estimated 40,000 people.

zh: 哈布雷在被废黜时带着乍得的很大一部分国家财产逃到了塞内加尔，在塞内加尔与庞大的家族和重要支持者一起过着舒适的生活。
en: When Habré was deposed, he fled to Senegal with a substantial portion of the national treasury, living there in comfort with much of his extended family, as well as key supporters.

zh: 多年来，非洲人权活动家在人权观察组织（Human Rights Watch）的帮助下一直在致力于问责哈布雷。
en: For many years, African human-rights activists, aided by Human Rights Watch, struggled to hold him accountable.

zh: 如今，在非洲联盟的支持下，哈布雷终于要在所在国接受对其在乍得犯下的罪行的审判了。
en: Now, at long last, with the support of the African Union, he faces trial in his adopted home for the crimes he committed in Chad.

zh: 美国也采取了相关行动，他国人权犯罪的受害者对移民美国的施暴者提起民事诉讼。
en: A related practice has developed in the United States, where victims of human-rights crimes committed elsewhere file civil suits against immigrant perpetrators.

zh: 自20世纪80年代初以来的大量案件中，美国法院判决施害者向受害者提供补偿。
en: In a substantial number of cases since the early 1980’s, US courts have ordered the defendants to pay compensation to the victims.

zh: 普遍管辖权最常被援引的场合是被指控者犯有战争罪、违反人道罪或种族灭绝罪，但其犯罪地点和起诉地点不在同一个国家。
en: Most often, universal jurisdiction is invoked when the person alleged to have committed war crimes, crimes against humanity, or genocide in another country is present in the territory where he or she is to be tried.

zh: 这与这类罪犯不能获得安全港的原则相符。
en: This is consistent with the principle that there should be no safe haven for those who commit such crimes.

zh: 如果西班牙在法律中加入这一要求，并提供一些其他的合理关联（比如受害者中包括西班牙人 ） ， 就能克服法官触手伸得太远的弊端。
en: If Spain incorporates such a requirement in its law, and also provides for some other appropriate connection (such as the inclusion of Spaniards among the victims), it will overcome the tendency of a few of its judges to reach out too widely.

zh: 这样的改革仍符合作为普遍管辖权概念基础的公正原则。
en: Such a reform would remain faithful to the principles of justice that underlie the concept of universal jurisdiction.

zh: 中国的转变
en: As China Turns

zh: 邓小平在上世纪 70 年代末推动中国对外开放时说过一句名言 ： “ 不管黑猫白猫，抓住老鼠的就是好猫。
en: When Deng Xiaoping began to open China in the late 1970’s, he said, “It doesn’t matter if a cat is black or white. As long as it catches mice, it is a good cat.”

zh: ”而他这番话则催生了中国的现状：一个割裂了传统道德，并逐渐倒向物质主义，拜金主义的社会。
en: This motto helped catalyze China into becoming what it is today: an increasingly materialistic, money-worshipping society that has lost touch with traditional ethics.

zh: 对此，没有什么能比最近受中国观众热捧的电视连续剧《蜗居》更能生动地诠释这一点了。
en: Nothing captures this moral vacuum more vividly than the recent television drama, “Wo Ju” (“Crowded Spaces”), which has been riveting Chinese audiences.

zh: 剧中的主人翁郭海藻是一个貌美而单纯的少女， 25 岁，住在上海近郊。
en: The program’s “hero,” Guo Haizao, is a fair-skinned and innocent 25-year-old woman living near Shanghai.

zh: 一开始她尝试追随姐姐的生活轨迹去追寻自己的幸福生活，还考上了一所名牌大学。
en: Initially she follows in her older sister’s footsteps in quest of their common dream, to attend one of China’s top universities.

zh: 但在上海这个花花世界的生活状态却远远超出了她的想象。
en: But, even with a university degree, life in go-go Shanghai turns out not to be as she had imagined.

zh: “为什么这个世界那么不公平，人们总盯着这座城市光鲜的一面？ ”郭海藻有天晚上在为自己和姐姐买房的事发愁时这样想。
en: “Why is the world so full of unfairness, with the limelight only splashing on the prettiest spots in the city?” she wonders one night, as she worries about her and her sister’s struggle to buy a home.

zh: 紧接着宋思明 — — 一个相貌端正，仕途顺利，开着辆奥迪车的市长秘书 — — 出现了，他告诉郭海藻 ： “ 没人会注意那些藏污纳垢的角落。 ”
en: As Song Siming, a handsome, successful, and Audi-driving – but also married – secretary to the Mayor, tells her, “On those unsightly corners in the dark where dirt, flies, and rats wander, nobody's paying attention.”

zh: 宋思明是一个有魅力而且八面玲珑的人。
en: Song is a resourceful man who oozes charm.

zh: 而郭海藻则很快被他的热情和成功迷住了。
en: Guo soon becomes intoxicated by his air of can-do and success.

zh: 有时有什么困难宋思明一个电话就能办妥，也使得郭海藻逐渐为宋的魅力和办事能力所倾倒。
en: When problems arise, he makes a quick phone call and gets things “settled.” Little by little, Guo finds herself taken in by his charm and ability to get things done.

zh: 不久之后，她就背叛了自己的男友并投入了宋思明的怀抱。
en: Before long, she is cheating on her boyfriend and swooning into Song’s arms and bed.

zh: 当郭海藻无意间听到她姐姐夫妇二人在小出租屋里的争吵之后，她原本希望通过努力工作买一套房子，和自己的男友共同组建一个家庭的理想也逐渐破灭了。
en: When Guo overhears fights between her sister and brother-in-law in their crammed rented room, her aspirations to get an apartment through hard work, and to start a family with her boyfriend and soon-to-be husband, begin to fade.

zh: 她被宋思明所承诺的捷径所诱惑，以委身于他的代价换取一大笔钱和一套奢华公寓，没过多久她还怀孕了，由此可见，宋思明也深谙“抓老鼠”之道。
en: She is tempted by the shortcut Song promises and allows herself to be seduced by him in turn for a large sum of cash and luxury apartment. Soon she is even pregnant.

zh: 《蜗居》这部片其实是改编自一部小说，书中描述了当今不择手段追求财富的中国，城市 — — 尤其是上海 — — 房价飞涨以及房地产狂热对中国年轻一代的影响。
en: “Wo Ju” is an adaptation of a novel about recent skyrocketing housing prices in Chinese cities – especially in Shanghai – and the effect of real-estate fever on young Chinese men and women in today’s get-rich-by-any-means China.

zh: 通过这部剧集，观众能感受到中国人的梦想是如何从求学和爱情向物质转化的，而这一切又是如何（有时以某种惊人的方式）在改变中国社会的。
en: Through the soap opera, viewers get a sense of how the Chinese dream has begun to center around property ownership rather than education or love, and how this change has been transforming Chinese society, sometimes in startling ways.

zh: 这些变化在中国初入社会的一代人中制造了一种新的希望和绝望。
en: These changes have created a new kind of hope and despair among the generation of Chinese now coming of age.

zh: 但当然，潜台词是如果这种对地产的病态痴迷导致了一种爱情的实用主义，那么它同时也可能引发一场令许多经济学忧虑不已，担心会迅速爆破的地产泡沫。
en: But, of course, the sub-text is that if this fixation on property has also led to greater pragmatism in affairs of the heart, it has also led to a worrisome property bubble that many economists now fear could soon burst.

zh: 但说到底这毕竟是电视剧，最后宋思明在听闻他怀孕的情人出事后立刻驱车赶往医院 — — 后面还有纪检部门的车子紧追不舍 — — 最终在车祸中身亡。
en: Then, because this is a soap opera, Song suddenly dies in a car crash, just as he is rushing to the hospital – while being chased by corruption investigators! – to check on his sweetheart and their unborn baby boy.

zh: 而这一切都发生在郭海藻与宋思明的妻子发生了一场戏剧性的争执并秘密堕胎之后。
en: But, as it happens, only days before Guo secretly had an abortion, right after a dramatic fight with Song’s wife.

zh: 然而在曲折离奇的情节之外 ， 《 蜗居》其实真实地再现了当今中国社会的背后推动力：房产，金钱，性，车和权力。
en: As fantastic and convoluted as the plot sometimes gets, “Wo Ju” offers a truthful look at what animates contemporary Chinese society: property, money, sex, cars, and power.

zh: 或许是因为太过贴近现实，这部剧集取得了巨大的成功，甚至吸引了官方媒体审查部门的注意。
en: Perhaps because it captures the zeitgeist so well, the program has become hugely popular, so much so that it has recently caught the attention of media censors.

zh: 事实上，这部剧对丑陋现实的揭露以及当今中国精神空虚的描述直接导致其被禁止在北京某电视频道播放。
en: Indeed, its realistic use of profanity and its depiction of the spiritual vacuum that grips China got it banished from one of Beijing’s TV channels.

zh: 当官方媒体在电视电影上大肆鼓吹儒家道德，古代典故和尚武精神之时 ， 《 蜗居》则覆盖了当代中国社会中那些影响人们生活的阴暗面：官员腐败，包二奶甚至是房奴。
en: While the official media are flooding television and cinema screens with propaganda about Confucius, ancient fairytales, and kung fu epics, “Wo Ju” engages a broad cross-section of contemporary society, which sees in it troubling aspects of their own lives: official corruption, mistresses, even house slaves.

zh: 正如宋思明生前骄傲地跟郭海藻宣称 ： “ 只要钱能解决的问题都不是问题。 ”
en: As Song arrogantly says to Guo before he dies, “As long as it’s a problem that we can solve with money, then it’s not a big problem.”

zh: 这部剧集同时也引发了网上的热烈讨论。
en: The program has caused a tsunami of online reflection.

zh: 许多网站和论坛都发动类似“如果你是郭海藻，你会选择宋思明和一套房子，还是选择小贝（那个被抛弃的前男友）和真爱？
en: Many Web sites and bulletin boards have run surveys with questions like, “If you were Guo Haizao, would you choose Song Siming and an apartment or Xiaobei (the dumped boyfriend) and true love?”

zh: ”而其中一个大型网站的调查结果则显示，有 46% 的人选择了前者， 22% 选择了后者，这样的选择说明了如今新一代的价值观究竟落到了何处。
en: On one of China’s largest sites, 46% picked Song, while only 22% chose the young boyfriend, a choice that suggests where the new generation’s values now lay.

zh: 传统的“真爱”美德如今被实用主义和趁年轻当二奶和不择手段搞一套大公寓所代替。
en: The traditional virtues of “true love” have been replaced by pragmatism and a willingness to become a mistress before youth expires and all chances of getting a good apartment are lost.

zh: 毕竟有很多网民都提出，通过这一实用的做法不是可以少奋斗许多年么？
en: After all, many netizens now argue, does not such a practical course of action save many years of hard work?

zh: 最近还有一个从未露面的深圳千万富翁举办网上相亲，吸引了超过 1 万名年轻女性应征。
en: One recent Internet match-making effort attracted applications from more than 10,000 young women, all seeking a chance to marry a Shenzhen multi-millionaire sight unseen.

zh: 而在当今中国，这样的淘金婚姻肯定不是第一桩，也不会是最后一桩。
en: That was not the first lottery marriage in today’s China, and it surely will not be the last.

zh: 而跟《蜗居》有关的最有趣现象则是多数观众对宋思明这个操弄权势的市长秘书并不反感。
en: The most interesting thing about “Wo Ju” may be that most viewers do not dislike Song, the string-pulling mayor’s secretary.

zh: 事实上虽然宋思明在剧中是个反面人物，在现实中他却被视为一个“完美选择 ” 。
en: Indeed, while Song may be cast as an anti-hero, in contemporary China, he is considered a “good catch.”

zh: 越来越多的中国年轻女性正在做着这般现实的选择：把爱情放在一边，房子为重，把原则收起来，实用为先。
en: More and more young women are making just such practical choices: putting an apartment before love and pragmatism before principle.

zh: 可持续发展目标的科学方法
en: A Scientific Method for the SDGs

zh: 巴黎—最近全世界数万人举行了基于事实而非虚构的世界观的游行，这是群众支持科学的最新例证。
en: PARIS – In just the latest example of popular support for science, tens of thousands of people around the world recently marched to advocate for a worldview based on facts, not fiction.

zh: 他们明白，科学真的可以拯救世界，因为它可以帮助我们解决最大的健康和发展问题。
en: They understand that science could actually save the world, because it can help us solve our greatest health and development problems.

zh: 这些问题构成了联合国可持续发展目标（SDG）的核心。 2015年，国际社会就SDG达成一致，旨在到2030年建设一个更加繁荣、平等和健康的地球。
en: Those problems are at the heart of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, which the international community agreed to in 2015, with the aim of creating a more prosperous, equitable, and healthy planet by 2030.

zh: 十七项SDG包括了169个具体的小目标（target ） ， 它们构成了一个宏大的日程，意在解决从性别平等到可持续城市和气候变化在内的所有问题。
en: The 17 SDGs, which include 169 individual targets, constitute an ambitious agenda to address everything from gender equity to sustainable cities and climate change.

zh: 总而言之，它们为二十一世纪的可持续发展提供了一个包容性的愿景。
en: All told, they provide an inclusive vision of sustainable development for the twenty-first century.

zh: 但完整性可能需要以效率作为牺牲。
en: But comprehensiveness can come at the expense of effective action.

zh: 很少有人能够说出所有SDG项目，更不用说解释各国在未来13年如何实现它们了。
en: Few people can actually name all of the SDGs, much less explain how every country can achieve them over the next 13 years.

zh: 全世界的专家们 — — 包括本周齐聚纽约参加联合国海洋会议的专家 — — 正在为各自的小目标和大目标奔波。
en: Experts around the world – including all of those who have gathered in New York this week for the UN Ocean Conference – are wrestling with individual targets or goals.

zh: 将这些努力整合在在一起仍然是一个艰巨的挑战。
en: And yet integrating these efforts remains a formidable challenge.

zh: 如果我们的领导人真的想要实现SDG中的世界愿景，就需要一份引导他们安然度过复杂的决策领域的路线图。
en: If our leaders are ever to realize the world envisioned in the SDGs, they will need a roadmap for navigating the complex policymaking terrain.

zh: 科学家是提供这份路线图的理想人选，因为他们知道如何提出正确的问题、设计实验、形成基于证据的结论，并将新信息应用到已知的知识中。
en: Scientists are well positioned to provide this roadmap, because they know how to ask the right questions, design experiments, draw evidenced-based conclusions, and apply new information to existing knowledge.

zh: 更好的是，科学家乐于彼此分享发现。
en: Better still, scientists enjoy sharing their findings with others.

zh: 国际科学理事会（ICSU）最近召集了不同领域的22名科学家 — — 包括海洋学、流行病学、农学和能源经济学 — — 为世界领导人制定具体的SDG详解。
en: The International Council for Science (ICSU) recently brought together 22 scientists from various fields – including oceanography, epidemiology, agronomy, and energy economics – to come up with SDG-specific insights for world leaders to follow.

zh: 通过研究不同大目标和小目标如何彼此关联起来，我们开发了一个独立研究框架帮助领导人在各自国家制定优先政策。
en: By studying how different goals and targets relate to one another, we developed an independent analytical framework to help leaders prioritize policies within their own countries.

zh: 一些SDG是相互强化的关系，实现其中之一就能更加容易地实现其他。
en: Some SDGs have reinforcing relationships, whereby achieving one will make it easier to achieve others.

zh: 与此同时，也有一些SDG互相冲突，一个目标的进步可能以其他目标的退步为代价。
en: At the same time, some SDGs may be in conflict, if progress in one area comes at the expense of others.

zh: 尽管我们早已知道SDG之间是互相关联的，但ICSU的研究是第一次将这些关联系统地进行量化。
en: While we have long known that the SDGs interact with one another, the ICSU study is the first time that these interactions have been systematically quantified.

zh: 比如，我们选择了与饥饿、健康、能源和海洋有关的四个SDG，然后识别它们之间以及它们与其他大小目标之间的所有可能的互动。
en: For example, we selected the four SDGs relating to hunger, health, energy, and oceans, and then identified every possible interaction between them and the other goals and targets.

zh: 接下来，我们开发了一个七分的系统，+3表示一个给定的大目标或小目标能强烈推动另一个 ， - 3表示实现一个目标会导致另外一个目标几乎不可能实现。
en: We then developed a seven-point scale, ranging from +3 when a given goal or target strongly reinforces another, to -3 when achieving one goal makes it essentially impossible to reach another.

zh: 将这套评分系统应用到不同的SDG关系中，我们就能回答一些重要的问题。
en: By applying this scale to different SDG relationships, we were able to answer some important questions.

zh: 比如，我们可以确定，保护海洋是否会抑制某个国家和地区的经济增长和城市发展。
en: For example, we could determine if protecting the oceans will stifle economic growth and urban development in a particular country or region.

zh: 我们也可以确定，增加农业产出是否会导致自然资源更加难以管理；或者，扩大可再生能源资源是否会导致干旱地区的水供给耗竭。
en: And we could determine if increasing agricultural production would make it harder to manage natural resources; or if expanding renewable-energy sources would deplete the water supply in already-arid regions.

zh: 我们所得到的一个令人振奋的发现是，大部分SDG小目标其实是互相强化的。
en: One exciting discovery we’ve made is that most SDG targets actually do reinforce one another.

zh: 比如，帮助世界最贫困人口摆脱柴火、木炭和动物粪便等传统燃料能够大大地减少因空气污染导致的死亡和疾病，特别是妇女和儿童。
en: For example, helping the world’s poorest people shift away from traditional fuels such as firewood, charcoal, and animal dung would go a long way toward reducing deaths and illnesses from air pollution, especially among women and children.

zh: 而当不同的目标互不相容时，决策者可以根据需要进行调整。
en: And in cases where different goals do not align, policymakers can make adjustments as needed.

zh: 比如，我们发现，增加农业产量可能危害海洋，如果这加剧营养流失或其他形式的污染的话；而这反过来又可能危害到健康和长期粮食安全。
en: For example, we found that increased agricultural production can damage the oceans if it adds to nutrient run-off and other forms of pollution; and this, in turn, could undermine health and long-term food security.

zh: 此外，我们的方法所带来的好处不仅仅是一目了然的定量结果，因为它集合了来自不同学科的科学家为同一个目标而努力。
en: Moreover, our approach had benefits beyond the immediate quantitative findings, because it united scientists from different disciplines around a shared goal.

zh: 这不是容易的事：科学家是具有批判精神的信息消费者，他们并不总是同意彼此的意见。
en: This was no easy task: scientists are critical consumers of information, and they do not always agree with one another.

zh: 但是，由于SDG涵盖范围巨大，参与者们必须仔细斟酌差异，形成共同的话语制定最优前进方向。
en: But, owing to the sheer scale of the SDGs, the participants had to hash out their differences, and develop a common language to devise the best way forward.

zh: 打破学科间的藩篱，将不同的声音汇聚在一起，这本身就是一个了不起的成就。
en: Breaking down disciplinary silos and bringing together different voices is a significant achievement in itself.

zh: 它可以作为政府、企业和公民社会领导人所效仿的榜样。
en: It can serve as an example for leaders in government, business, and civil society to follow.

zh: 那么，我们可以从这里得到什么？
en: So, where do we go from here?

zh: 我们的分析框架可以帮助各国认清哪些SDG有利于其他目标，哪些则正好相反。
en: Our analytical framework can help countries figure out which SDGs benefit others, and which do not.

zh: 如此，决策者就可以制定重点目标和投资；厘清现有资源并发现预算缺口；以及建立跨部门数据和信息共享机制。
en: With it, policymakers can prioritize goals and investments; map existing resources and identify budget gaps; and establish mechanisms for sharing data and information across sectors.

zh: 更一般地说，每个国家都需要监控其朝各SDG的进步情况，并在需要时改变方针。
en: More generally, each country will need to monitor its progress toward each SDG, and revise its approach as needed.

zh: 这就需要所有决策者齐心协力。
en: This will require diligence from all policymakers.

zh: 但潜在的投资回报 — — 至少能让子孙后代获得一个更好的地球 — — 是巨大的。
en: But the potential return on investment, not least a better planet for generations to come, is enormous.

zh: 科学是否真的能够拯救世界还有待观察。
en: Whether science really will save the world remains to be seen.

zh: 但我们知道的是，科学家可以让我们走在正确的方向上。
en: But one thing we know is that scientists can point us in the right direction.

zh: 东盟50年
en: ASEAN at 50

zh: 新加坡—我们生活在一个麻烦的时代，在大部分地球最繁荣的地区，照样萦绕着悲观情绪。
en: SINGAPORE – We live in troubled times, with pessimism clouding even the most prosperous parts of the planet.

zh: 许多人认定国际秩序正在分崩离析。
en: Many are convinced that the international order is falling apart.

zh: 有人担心文明的交锋近在眼前，甚至已经开始了。
en: Some fear that a clash of civilizations is imminent, if it has not already begun.

zh: 但是，在一片黯淡中间，东南亚为人们提供了一丝希望的曙光。
en: Yet, amid the gloom, Southeast Asia offers an unexpected glimmer of hope.

zh: 该地区近几十年来进步巨大，实现了此前无法想象的和平与繁荣。
en: The region has made extraordinary progress in recent decades, achieving a level of peace and prosperity that was previously unimaginable.

zh: 而这一成功很大程度上要归因于东盟。 本月，东盟将迎来成立50周年。
en: And it owes much of this success to the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), which marks its 50th anniversary this month.

zh: 东南亚是全世界最多元化的地区之一。
en: Southeast Asia is one of the world’s most diverse regions.

zh: 其6.4亿人口中包括2.4亿穆斯林、1.2亿基督徒、1.5亿佛教徒，还有数以百万计的印度教徒、道教徒、儒家和共产主义者。
en: Its 640 million people include 240 million Muslims, 120 million Christians, 150 million Buddhists, and millions of Hindus, Taoists, Confucianists, and Communists.

zh: 域内人口最多的国家印度尼西亚有2.61亿人，而文莱只有45万人。
en: Its most populous country, Indonesia, is home to 261 million people, while Brunei has just 450,000.

zh: 新加坡人均收入高达每年52,960美元，是老挝（2,353美元）的22.5倍。
en: Singapore’s per capita income of $52,960 per annum is 22.5 times that of Laos ($2,353).

zh: 这一多样性让东南亚在形成域内合作方面处于严重的劣势。
en: This diversity puts Southeast Asia at a distinct disadvantage in terms of fostering regional cooperation.

zh: 1967年东盟成立时，许多专家认为其维持不了几年。
en: When ASEAN was founded in 1967, most experts expected it to die within a few years.

zh: 当时，东南亚是一个既贫穷，又问题重重的地区，英国历史学家费雪（C.A. Fisher）称之为亚洲的巴尔干。
en: At the time, Southeast Asia was a poor and deeply troubled region, which the British historian C.A. Fisher had described as the Balkans of Asia.

zh: 越南战争尚未结束，中越战争等着开打。
en: The Vietnam War was underway, and the Sino-Vietnamese War was yet to be fought.

zh: 许多人将成立东盟的五个非共产主义国家 — — 印尼、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和泰国 — — 视为多米诺骨牌，只要有一个邻国导向共产主义，或陷入内乱，这些国家就会逐个崩溃。
en: Many viewed the five non-Communist states that founded ASEAN – Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand – as dominoes, set to be tipped over by a neighbor’s fall to communism or descent into civil strife.

zh: 但东盟打破了这些预言，成为全世界第二成功的区域组织，仅次于欧盟。
en: But ASEAN defied expectations, becoming the world’s second most successful regional organization, after the European Union.

zh: 每年，东盟都要举行1,000次会议深化教育、卫生和外交等领域的合作。
en: Some 1,000 ASEAN meetings are held each year to deepen cooperation in areas such as education, health, and diplomacy.

zh: 东盟与中国、日本、印度、韩国、澳大利亚和新西兰签署了自由贸易协定（FTA ） ， 并成立了一个东盟经济共同体。
en: ASEAN has signed free-trade agreements (FTAs) with China, Japan, India, South Korea, Australia, and New Zealand, and established an ASEAN economic community.

zh: 如今，东盟是世界第七大经济体，有望在2050年跃居第四大经济体。
en: Today, ASEAN comprises the world’s seventh-largest economy, on track to become the fourth largest by 2050.

zh: 我在我的新书《东盟奇迹 》 （ The ASEAN Miracle）中指出，多重因素奠定了该地区的成功。
en: As I explain in my book The ASEAN Miracle, several factors have underpinned the bloc’s success.

zh: 首先，反共产主义提供了强大的合作激励。
en: At first, anti-communism provided a powerful incentive to collaborate.

zh: 强力领导人，如印尼的苏哈托、马来西亚前总理马哈蒂尔、新加坡国父李光耀，让这一组织保持团结。
en: Strong leaders, like Indonesia’s Suharto, former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohammed, and Singapore’s founding father Lee Kuan Yew, held the group together.

zh: 东盟在20世纪60年代末、70年代初起航的时机也恰到好处，美国、中国和域内成员国的战略利益形成了趋同。
en: It helped that as ASEAN was getting off the ground in the late 1960s and early 1970s, the strategic interests of America, China, and the bloc’s members converged.

zh: 但即使在冷战结束后，该地区也没有像巴尔干地区一样爆发冲突。
en: But even when the Cold War ended, the region did not erupt into conflict, as the real Balkans did.

zh: 东盟国家保持了合作的习惯，到20世纪70和80年代，合作已成为东南亚的常态。
en: ASEAN countries maintained the cooperative habits that had become established in Southeast Asia in the 1970s and 1980s.

zh: 事实上，东盟此前的共产主义敌人 — — 柬埔寨、老挝和越南都决定加入其中。
en: In fact, ASEAN’s erstwhile communist enemies – Cambodia, Laos, and Vietnam – decided to join the bloc.

zh: 结束了几十年的孤立的缅甸亦然。
en: So, too, did Myanmar, ending decades of isolation.

zh: 东盟接纳缅甸的政策导致了西方的批评，但帮助其奠定了和平结束军事统治的转型。
en: ASEAN’s policy of engaging Myanmar attracted criticism from the West, but it helped lay the groundwork for a peaceful transition from military rule.

zh: （与此形成鲜明对比的是，西方对叙利亚等国家采取了孤立的政策，这显然无法实现同样的结果。 ）
en: (Compare this to the West’s policy of isolation toward, say, Syria, which certainly won’t lead to a similar outcome.)

zh: 诚然，东盟绝非完美。
en: To be sure, ASEAN is far from perfect.

zh: 在短期看，它的行动像一只螃蟹 — — 前进两步，后退一步，再横着爬一步。
en: Over the short term, it seems to move like a crab – two steps forward, one step back, and one step sideways.

zh: 但东盟的长期成功是不容否认的。
en: Yet ASEAN’s long-term progress is undeniable.

zh: 其GDP总和从1970年的950亿美元增加到2014年的2.5万亿美元。
en: Its combined GDP has grown from $95 billion in 1970 to $2.5 trillion in 2014.

zh: 它也是亚太地区地缘政治的唯一可靠的平台，拥有召集全世界所有大国 — — 从美国和欧盟到中国和俄罗斯 — — 齐聚一堂的独特能力。
en: And it is the only reliable platform for geopolitical engagement in the Asia-Pacific region, unique in its ability to convene meetings attended by all of the world’s great powers, from the United States and the European Union to China and Russia.

zh: 东盟国家仍然面临着艰巨挑战。
en: ASEAN continues to face serious challenges.

zh: 南海领土纠纷制造了深刻的分歧，而美国和中国质检的地缘政治对立的加剧带来了更多的凝聚力威胁。
en: Territorial disputes in the South China Sea have created deep divisions, and the intensifying geopolitical rivalry between the US and China poses a further threat to cohesion.

zh: 马来西亚和泰国等成员国的国内政局也早日益混乱。
en: And domestic politics in several member states, including Malaysia and Thailand, is becoming increasingly chaotic.

zh: 但东盟的历史表明，该地区能够抵御这些风暴。
en: But ASEAN’s history suggests that the bloc can weather these storms.

zh: 其令人印象深刻的恢复力植根于印尼所引领的协商（musyawarah）和共识（mufakat）文化。
en: Its impressive resilience is rooted in the culture of musyawarah and mufakat (consultation and consensus) championed by Indonesia.

zh: 试想，如果其他地区组织，如海湾合作委员会、南亚地区合作协会等，如果能够坚守类似的规范，能够尝到多大的甜头。
en: Imagine how other regional organizations, such as the Gulf Cooperation Council or the South Asian Association of Regional Cooperation, could benefit from adherence to such norms.

zh: 欧盟曾经是地区合作的金本位。
en: The EU once amounted to the gold standard for regional cooperation.

zh: 但它似乎陷入了一系列没完没了的危机，经济增长萎靡。
en: But it continues to struggle with a seemingly never-ending series of crises and weak economic growth.

zh: 此外，英国即将从欧盟中脱离，看起来，寻求其他合作模式才是正途。
en: Add to that the impending departure of the United Kingdom, and it seems only prudent to seek other models of cooperation.

zh: 而东盟尽管存在各种缺陷，可以提供一个有吸引力的榜样。
en: ASEAN, however imperfect, provides an attractive one.

zh: 2012年，欧盟被授予诺贝尔和平奖。
en: The EU was awarded the Nobel Peace Prize in 2012.

zh: 但东盟的方针也许才代表着未来方向，让其他动乱地区也建立起稳固的合作联系。
en: But ASEAN’s approach may turn out to be the way of the future, enabling other fractious regions to develop sturdy bonds of cooperation, too.

zh: 破坏东盟名声
en: Trashing the ASEAN Brand

zh: 堪培拉—拥有诚信和正派的形象对于国际关系和对于职业和个人生涯一样重要。
en: CANBERRA – Having a reputation for integrity and decency matters as much in international relations as in professional and personal life.

zh: 拥有这一形象的国家总是拥有更大的分量 — — 斯堪的纳维亚国家就是明证。
en: States that are so regarded consistently punch above their weight – witness the Scandinavians.

zh: 相反，从未获得或者浪费这一形象的国家可能严重损害其自身利益，拖累贸易、旅游、外国投资、国际论坛和谈判中的政治支持以及本国国民的海外安全。
en: By contrast, those that never earn – or fritter away – such a reputation can seriously endanger their own interests, jeopardizing trade, tourism, foreign investment, political support in international forums and negotiations, and the security of their own nationals abroad.

zh: 三个最重要的东南亚国家 — — 马来西亚、泰国和现在的印度尼西亚 — — 最近几个月来在这方面给自己制造了麻烦。
en: Three of Southeast Asia's most important states – Malaysia, Thailand, and now Indonesia – have brought trouble on themselves in this respect in recent months.

zh: 所有这三个国家以不同的方式让世人严重怀疑他们对法治、司法制度的诚信和执法部门慈悲品德的承诺。
en: All three are raising serious doubts, in different ways, about their commitment to the rule of law, the integrity of their judicial systems, and the quality of mercy in the administration of justice.

zh: 上个月，马来西亚最高法院驳回了反对派领袖安瓦尔·易卜拉欣（Anwar Ibrahim）对其五年有期徒刑、剥夺五年政治权利的判决的上诉 — — 这一决定令人震惊，毫无道理可言。
en: In Malaysia, the country's highest court last month rejected opposition leader Anwar Ibrahim's appeal against a five-year prison sentence and a ban against running for public office for a further five years – a shocking and indefensible decision.

zh: 总理纳吉布政府以鸡奸罪名起诉安瓦尔显然是别有用心（马来西亚很少有人因此罪名被起诉 ） 。
en: Prime Minister Najib Razak's government was transparently vindictive in pursuing allegations of sodomy (a crime rarely prosecuted in Malaysia) against Anwar.

zh: 不利于安瓦尔的证据显然站不住脚；法院接受这样的证据是公然示弱。
en: The evidence against him was obviously inconclusive; and the court's acceptance of it was manifestly craven.

zh: 如果这个故事时法院只是根据其所见行使其司法职责，那么仍然可以保住正派形象：安瓦尔可以获得行政特赦。
en: If the fiction is maintained that the court was merely doing its judicial duty as it saw it, decency could still prevail: Anwar could be granted executive clemency.

zh: 但没有迹象表明纳吉布政府会建议这样做。
en: But there is no sign that Najib's government will advise such action.

zh: 安瓦尔的真正罪名是其反对由保守派穆斯林、世俗派和华人政党的执政联盟，这严重威胁到纳吉布的马来民族统一机构（United Malays National Organization，UMNO）六十年的主宰，2013年，他完全是因为公然改变选区的政策而输掉了选举。
en: Anwar's real crime was that his opposition coalition of conservative Muslim, secular, and Chinese parties was seriously challenging the six-decade supremacy of Najib's United Malays National Organization (UMNO), losing the 2013 election only because of a transparent gerrymander.

zh: 在泰国，前总理他信及其支持者的最大罪名是利用民粹主义选战运动赢得国家大选，而他们的选战运动威胁到老牌曼谷精英的利益。
en: In Thailand, the biggest crime of former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra and his supporters was to keep winning national elections with populist campaigns that threatened the interests of the country's long-established Bangkok-based elite.

zh: 当然，在此期间发生了严重的不当行为，包括贿赂和制度性腐败；但这些罪名根本不足以支撑去年的军事政变及随后的镇压。
en: Serious wrongdoing, involving bribery and institutional corruption, no doubt occurred along the way; but the scale of such offenses could hardly justify last year's military coup and the subsequent repression.

zh: 确保泰国的下一部宪法 — — 自1932年以来的第20部宪法 — — 成为名副其实的民主宪法符合军方建立的国家改革委员会和宪法起草委员会中的一些人的真正利益。
en: Some of those in the army-installed National Reform Council and Constitutional Drafting Committee have a real interest in ensuring that Thailand's next constitution – the 20th since 1932 – will be genuinely democratic.

zh: 许多人确实想一劳永逸地结束长期困扰泰国政坛两边的腐败和收买选票文化。
en: Many do want to end, once and for all, the corrupt, vote-buying culture that has long afflicted Thai politics on both sides.

zh: 但真正的改革只有通过妥协精神才能实现，而1月份军政府的野蛮地弹劾总理英拉（他信之妹）让这无从实现。 加在英拉头上的指控纯属捏造，就连她的顽固反对者也认为站不住脚。
en: But true reform can be achieved only in a spirit of reconciliation, and the military regime's crude impeachment of deposed Prime Minister Yingluck Shinawatra (Thaksin's sister) in January – on trumped-up charges that seemed flimsy even to many of her diehard opponents – has made that impossible.

zh: 法律再一次赤裸裸地遭到政治的操纵。
en: The law, once again, has been used for nakedly political ends.

zh: 印尼的情况与马来西亚和泰国不同，不如后两者极端，但也不利于国家形象。
en: Indonesia's case is different from the other two, and less extreme, but also troubling for the country's reputation.

zh: 去年以草根身份赢得选举胜利的总统“佐科维”佐科·维多多成功地巩固了印尼的民主转型，并让人们对人权和反复运动寄予了极大期望。
en: The grassroots-driven victory of President Joko “Jokowi" Widodo last year triumphantly consolidated the country's democratic transition, and raised high expectations for human-rights and anti-corruption campaigners.

zh: 但是，在国内，对佐科维治理腐败的能力和决心的信心随着他提名 — — 最近才收回 — — 以不干净手段致富并且拥有极大政治人脉的候选人为印尼警察总长而下滑。
en: But, domestically, confidence in Jokowi's capacity and will to tackle corruption has eroded with his nomination – only very belatedly withdrawn – of a suspiciously wealthy but politically well-connected candidate for National Police Chief.

zh: 国际社会日益担心佐科维所声称的决心 — — 在长期暂停后继续对多为定罪毒贩实施处决。
en: Internationally, concern has been growing about Jokowi's stated determination to allow – after a long moratorium – the executions of scores of convicted drug traffickers to proceed.

zh: 他的立场表明他根本不考虑这些个体案例是否能证明仁慈，也显然对日益增加的关于死刑案件的判决与案件本身的性质关联较少而与是否行贿关联较多的证据无动于衷。
en: His stance reflects no consideration of whether their individual cases might justify clemency, as well as apparent indifference to mounting evidence that sentencing in capital cases might have owed less to a case's merits than to the presence or absence of bribes.

zh: 按日程，两名澳大利亚毒贩已于本月被处决。
en: Two Australian drug traffickers have been scheduled for execution this month.

zh: 没人怀疑他们在十年前的合理定罪，但此后他们的行为，以及剥夺他们的生命而让其他人继续活下去的司法程序的诚信程度的怀疑已经构成了宽大处理 — — 不管是对他们还是对其他人 — — 的充分理由。
en: While no one doubts that they were properly convicted ten years ago, their behavior since – and questions about the integrity of the judicial process that condemned them to die but allowed others to live – has made a compelling case for the exercise of mercy, for them and for others.

zh: 佐科维尚未认识到 — — 或者其最随着尚未充分认识到 — — 的是拒绝考虑宽大处理印尼国内死囚、同时却在游说其他国家（特别是海湾国家）宽大处理200多名印尼籍死囚的不恰当性。
en: What does not yet seem to have registered with Jokowi, or with enough of his fellow citizens, is the incongruity of refusing even to consider clemency for those on Indonesia's death row, while lobbying passionately for clemency for more than 200 Indonesians condemned to die elsewhere, notably in the Gulf.

zh: 只有你自己做到了正派，才能令人信服地要求其他人正派。
en: Decency can be credibly demanded of others only if one practices it oneself.

zh: 印尼的这一行动不一致性很快就会给其带来痛处。
en: It seems only a matter of time before Indonesians start feeling the pain of this inconsistency.

zh: 马来西亚因为安瓦尔案已经受到了全世界的指责，泰国也因为最近的政变而失去了许多国际友邦，其最近追求联合国人权委员会席位受到重大挫折就是明证。
en: Malaysia has earned worldwide condemnation for its handling of the Anwar affair, and Thailand has lost many international friends since its latest coup, reflected in a humiliating loss in its recent bid for a seat on the UN Human Rights Council.

zh: 泰国外交官担心，泰国最近试图赢得联合国安理会席位的行动也会遭遇类似挫折。
en: Thai diplomats fear another such defeat in their country's current attempt to win a seat on the UN Security Council.

zh: 所有这些事件还会造成更大的地区后果。
en: There are some larger regional consequences in all of this.

zh: 东盟一直在为东南亚地缘政治要冲和亚太经济和安全外交重要行动方的地位而不懈斗争。
en: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) has tenaciously fought for its place as the geopolitical hinge between East and South Asia, and an important player in Asia-Pacific economic and security diplomacy.

zh: 在此过程中，它不得不一再与柬埔寨极权政权、缅甸民主转型斗争、越南根深蒂固的一党专政甚至无可挑剔地清廉的新加坡不定期滥用诽谤法排挤政治反对派等问题纠缠。
en: In doing so, it has had to repeatedly finesse issues like Cambodia's authoritarian leadership, Myanmar's struggle with democratic transition, Vietnam's stubbornly anachronistic one-party state, and even impeccably incorruptible Singapore's regular misuse of defamation laws to neutralize political opponents.

zh: 如今，东盟领导人必须扪心自问，可以让多少成员国同时以多大力度败坏东南亚的名声而不影响充分实现东南亚的经济增长和政治影响力抱负。
en: The question that ASEAN leaders must now ask themselves is just how much trashing of the Southeast Asian brand, by how many of its members simultaneously, the region can afford while still fully realizing its aspirations for economic growth and political influence.

zh: 声称内政部容他人干涉向来是诱惑力极大的说辞。
en: It is always tempting to claim that what happens behind sovereign borders is nobody else's business.

zh: 但在当今互联社会中已不再是如此。
en: But that is no longer true in today's interconnected world.

zh: 一些国家也许足够大、足够强，能够怙恶不悛而逍遥法外，但用好行为赢得尊重是远远更强大的经济和政治成功基础。
en: Some states may be big and powerful enough to get away with behaving badly, but winning respect for behaving well is a much stronger foundation for economic and political success.

zh: 解放东盟
en: Unshackling ASEAN

zh: 新加坡—明年是东盟成立五十周年。 东盟没能就中国的南海领土主张问题形成共识，这引起了整个地区的担忧。
en: SINGAPORE – As the Association of Southeast Asian Nations approaches its 50th anniversary next year, its failure to reach a consensus regarding Chinese territorial claims in the South China Sea has raised concerns throughout the region.

zh: 尽管所有决定都根据共识做出的要求让情况各异的成员国可以联合和保护国家利益两不误，但这也限制了东盟在应对新安全威胁方面的效率。
en: Although the requirement that all decisions be made by consensus enables disparate member states to unite while protecting their national interests, it also limits ASEAN’s effectiveness in dealing with emerging security threats.

zh: 共识规则解释了为何东盟没有在2001年9月11日美国遭遇恐怖袭击及随后美国领导的反恐战争中采取联合立场。
en: The consensus rule explains why ASEAN failed to present a united front after the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks in the United States, and in the subsequent US-led war on terror.

zh: 同理，对于朝鲜的挑衅 — — 如继续进行核试验以及2010年袭击韩国天安号护卫舰造成46名水兵丧生 — — 东盟也保持了沉默，因为一些成员国同情朝鲜政权。
en: Similarly, ASEAN’s response to North Korea’s provocations – such as ongoing nuclear tests and the 2010 attack that sunk the South Korean corvette Cheonan, killing 46 seamen – has been muted, owing to some ASEAN member states’ sympathy for the North Korean regime.

zh: 但南海领土纠纷最能体现东盟的共识原则如何限制了它的效率。 如何应对在地区内日益独断的中国？
en: The territorial disputes in the South China Sea are the strongest indicator yet that ASEAN’s consensus principle is limiting the organization’s effectiveness.

zh: 这一问题在东盟成员国之间造成的分裂远甚于此前任何一个问题。
en: The question of how to respond to growing Chinese assertiveness in the region has divided ASEAN member states more deeply than any previous issue has.

zh: 在2012年东盟部长会议上，东盟在历史上首次没能形成联合声明，因为柬埔寨不允许在其中提及任何中国在南海制造的事端。
en: At the ASEAN Ministerial Meeting in 2012, the organization failed to issue a joint statement for the first time in its history, because Cambodia refused to allow any mention of incidents caused by China in the South China Sea.

zh: 2016年7月，东盟外交部长会议在联合公报中也没有提到两周前国际仲裁庭所做出的不利于中国的标志性裁决。
en: In July 2016, ASEAN foreign ministers failed to mention in their joint communiqué the landmark ruling against China that had been issued just two weeks before by an international arbitral tribunal on the disputes.

zh: 东盟无法在南海问题上有所作为导致成员国政府和公民质疑该组织“维持和强化和平”的能力 — — 而这是东盟宪章开宗明义的第一目标。
en: ASEAN’s failure to act on the South China Sea issue is leading member-state governments and citizens to question the organization’s ability “to maintain and enhance peace” – the first purpose listed in its Charter.

zh: 此外，最近的僵局可能迫使一些成员国通过其他途径解决问题，最终影响到东盟的地区和国际重要性。
en: What’s more, the current stalemate will likely force certain member states to address the issue through other means, which will ultimately jeopardize ASEAN’s regional and international relevance.

zh: 东盟必须解决这一共识难题，要么通过程序改革，要么通过制度创新。
en: ASEAN must solve its consensus dilemma, through either procedural reforms or institutional innovations.

zh: 首先，东盟应该遵循2006年东盟资深顾问团（Eminent Persons Group）做出的建议，引入多数决策规则。
en: For starters, it should follow a previous suggestion, made by the ASEAN Eminent Persons Group in 2006, to introduce majority decision-making.

zh: 随着东盟活动范围的扩大，顾问团观察道，它应该“考虑其他灵活的决策机制 ， ” 包括投票。
en: With ASEAN’s range of activities broadening, the EPG observed, it should “consider alternative and flexible decision-making mechanisms,” including voting.

zh: 欧盟很早就采取了这一治理机制，而即便在东盟内部，也有多数投票决策的先例，特别是在地缘政治和安全问题上。
en: The European Union embraced this governance mechanism long ago, and even within ASEAN there is precedent for majority-vote decision-making, particularly on geopolitical and security issues.

zh: 比如 ， 《 1995年东南亚无核区条约》成立了委员会，在“无法形成共识”的情况下，可以按照三分之二多数原则决策。
en: For example, the 1995 Treaty on the Southeast Asia Nuclear Weapon-Free Zone established a commission that, “failing consensus,” can make decisions by a two-thirds majority.

zh: 当东盟国家无法形成共识时，它们应该区分两种类型的问题以决定怎样解决：对成员国主权、领土完整和独立自主构成显然影响的问题；以及对地区安全构成显然影响的问题。
en: When ASEAN member states cannot reach a consensus, they should distinguish between two types of issues to determine the path forward: those that have obvious implications for the sovereignty, territorial integrity, and domestic autonomy of a member state; and those that have obvious implications for regional security.

zh: 对前一种问题，东盟成员国应该寻求共识，除非当事国有别的决定。
en: ASEAN member states should seek consensus in the former case, unless the country in question decides otherwise.

zh: 但对后一种问题，它们应该可以选择多数票规则。
en: But in the latter case, they should have the option to conduct a majority vote.

zh: 据此，如果一个问题具有相当大的地区安全影响而不威胁到给定成员国的主权、领土完整和政治自主，那么就不应该允许这个国家阻碍其他所有成员国，牺牲地区安全。
en: Accordingly, if an issue has significant regional-security implications and does not concern a given member state’s sovereignty, territorial integrity, or political autonomy, that state should not be allowed to sideline all other member states’ interests at the expense of regional peace.

zh: 另一种克服共识难题的方法是采取新的制度框架。
en: Another way out of the consensus dilemma is to create new institutional frameworks.

zh: 比如，建立一个按照多数票规则运行的东盟南海纠纷管理委员会，这样能树立东盟在该问题上的立场，并在中国一同解决分歧。
en: For example, an ASEAN Commission for the Management of South China Sea Disputes, operating through majority voting, could establish ASEAN’s position on the issue and liaise with China to resolve disagreements when they arise.

zh: 或者，在南海有领土主张的东盟成员国可以结盟，并吸收无关利益的东盟成员国。
en: Alternatively, ASEAN member states with territorial claims in the South China Sea could align and include non-claimant ASEAN member states.

zh: 在东盟内部建立南海小组，在东盟相关会议之前形成其自身的共同立场，这样更有可能产生整个东盟的共识。
en: A South China Sea caucus within ASEAN could shape a common position among its own members ahead of ASEAN-related meetings, and make an ASEAN-wide consensus on the issue more likely.

zh: 如果这些选择失败，所有地区内立场相近的国家，不管它们是否在南海有领土主张或是否是东盟成员国，应该结成更大的小组，通过在东盟地区论坛和东亚峰会等地区级平台上展现共同立场来解决该问题。
en: If these options fail, all like-minded countries in the region, regardless of their South China Sea claims or ASEAN membership, should form a larger caucus to address the issue, by formulating a shared position in region-wide platforms such as the ASEAN Regional Forum and the East Asia Summit.

zh: 未来，如果环境允许，这一地区小组可能演化为更全面的地区安全安排，使东盟领导的机制更加完备。
en: In the future, this regional caucus could, if circumstances allowed, evolve into a more comprehensive regional security arrangement that supplements ASEAN-led mechanisms.

zh: 将非成员国纳入可能会影响到东盟的团结；但如果东盟成员国决定严格坚守共识决策原则，这是一个必须接受的权衡。
en: Including non-member countries could undermine ASEAN’s unity; but that is a tradeoff ASEAN member states will have to accept if they decide to adhere strictly to consensus decision-making.

zh: 尽管如此，共识原则不应该放弃。
en: That said, the consensus principle should not be abandoned.

zh: 在任何可能的时候就重要问题形成一致最符合东盟的利益 — — 包括南海纠纷，如果它并非地区和平的严重威胁的话。
en: It is in ASEAN’s best interest to reach a consensus on important issues whenever possible – including on the South China Sea dispute if it proves not to be a serious threat to regional peace.

zh: 在这方面，东盟成员国应该建立更多彼此之间以及与中国的信任、合作和对话。
en: To this end, ASEAN member states should foster more trust, cooperation, and dialogue among themselves, and with China.

zh: 所有东盟国家都必须在各���的国家利益和更大的地区利益之间达到平衡。
en: All ASEAN member states must strike a balance between their respective national interests and broader regional interests.

zh: 至于中国，它应该比东盟国家更敏感于安全问题，也更愿意将南海变为和平与繁荣的避风港，而不是紧张与对立的竞技场。
en: For its part, China should be more sensitive to ASEAN member states’ security concerns, and act to turn the South China Sea into a haven for peace and prosperity, rather than an arena for tensions and rivalry.

zh: 东盟对待缅甸的新方法
en: ASEAN’s New Approach to Myanmar

zh: 纽约 — — 缅甸政府不久前继续软禁民主运动领袖昂山素姬18个月的决策表明与该国执政的将军们打交道是何其困难。
en: NEW YORK – The recent decision by Myanmar’s government to sentence pro-democracy leader Aung San Suu Kyi to a further 18 months’ house arrest shows how difficult it is to deal with that country’s ruling generals.

zh: 但我们可能已经开辟了一条崭新的道路。
en: Yet the first steps toward a new approach may already have been taken.

zh: 最明显的迹象来自东南亚国家联盟，缅甸也是东盟成员国。
en: The clearest sign comes from the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), of which Myanmar is a member.

zh: 起初，东盟各国政府对判决的反应相对温和，表达了他们的“失望”情绪 — — 这一立场表明了东盟集团不干涉成员国内政的态度。
en: At first, most of ASEAN’s member governments responded mildly to the verdict, expressing their “disappointment” – a stance that reflects the group’s principle of noninterference in fellow members’ internal politics.

zh: 但泰国外长格实·披隆随即与柬埔寨、印尼、新加坡和越南等国的外长磋商。
en: But Thai Foreign Minister Kasit Piromya then consulted his counterparts in Cambodia, Indonesia, Singapore, and Vietnam.

zh: 他以现任东盟主席的身份传播着共同要求赦免昂山素姬的思想。
en: As current ASEAN chair, he floated the idea of concertedly requesting a pardon for Aung San Suu Kyi.

zh: 东盟政府官员此后曾会晤制定草案。
en: ASEAN government officials have since met to draft a text.

zh: 该草案可能在九月获得东盟外长的批准，并在十月提交东盟领导人进行表决。
en: Approval by the association’s foreign ministers may come in September, with ASEAN leaders tackling the issue in October.

zh: 当然，草案内容将会进行修订，出现反对的声音也在意料之中。
en: Of course, amendments and objections to the draft should be expected.

zh: 但仅就赦免要求本身而言已经至关重要。
en: But the pardon request is already significant.

zh: 草案试图达致细微的平衡，在尊重政府主权的同时温和地一致坚持邻国的主张。
en: It seeks to be finely balanced, respecting the regime’s sovereignty while subtly pressing home the point in unison, as neighboring states.

zh: 要求的措辞将不失礼貌，但也是替代幕后无声外交的另外一种形式的正式和公开交流。
en: The request would be politely worded, but it would also be an official and public mode of communication, instead of the usual behind-the-scenes quiet diplomacy.

zh: 无论是东盟的公开言论还是潜台词都不会立即带来变化。
en: What ASEAN says or does not say will not change things immediately.

zh: 愤世嫉俗者可能还要加上一句，即使昂山素姬真的被赦免，她可能仍然出于政治原因而遭到扣押，或者面临着其他种种障碍，其目的就是阻止她参与定于2010年举行的缅甸大选。
en: Cynics might add that even if Aung San Suu Kyi is pardoned, she may yet still be detained on political grounds or face other barriers aimed at preventing her from competing in the elections promised in Myanmar for 2010.

zh: 可西方的制裁也没有任何效果。
en: But Western sanctions have not worked, either.

zh: 从20世纪90年代的镇压行动后，破坏人权的行为就屡禁不止，最近一次是2007年对佛教僧侣所领导抗议活动的镇压。
en: Since the 1990’s crackdown, human rights violations have continued, most recently with the suppression of the protests led by Buddhist monks in 2007.

zh: 普通的平民百姓生活水平日益下降，而与统治者相关的利益集团则富得流油。
en: The average citizen has grown poorer, even as those close to the junta become ostentatiously rich.

zh: 西方制裁的作用却是为那些不在意人权记录的国家在缅甸投资铺平了道路 — — 起初是东盟邻国投资酒店和其他行业，不久前又新增了中国和印度，这两者就战略能源领域的项目和影响力展开了激烈的争夺。
en: Western sanctions instead paved the way for investments in Myanmar by those with less concern about human rights violations – first by ASEAN neighbors in hotels and other sectors, and more recently by China and India, which are vying for projects and influence in the strategic energy sector.

zh: 结果为缅甸的将军们提供了从中渔利的机会。
en: As a result, Myanmar’s generals have been able to play one side off against another.

zh: 但游戏规则可能正在发生变化。
en: The game, however, may now be changing.

zh: 东盟动议是该组织迈出的新的一步。
en: ASEAN’s initiative is a new step forward for the group.

zh: 尽管东盟拒绝了此前制裁、甚至是开除缅甸的呼吁，这一步骤表明它不会任由将军们胡作非为而完全无动于衷。
en: While ASEAN rejected previous calls to impose sanctions, or even to expel Myanmar, this step shows that it will not remain inert regardless of what the generals do.

zh: 此外，新加坡等某些东盟成员国已经明确呼吁允许昂山素姬参与2010年的大选争夺。
en: Moreover, some ASEAN member countries, like Singapore, have explicitly called for Aung San Suu Kyi to be allowed to participate in the 2010 elections.

zh: 除东盟努力外还有两大进展值得细数。
en: The ASEAN effort coincides with two other developments.

zh: 其一是美国决意重新考虑其制裁政策，目标是在坚持核心价值观和利益的同时处事更加灵活。
en: One is the decision by the United States to reconsider its policy of sanctions, becoming more flexible while remaining true to its values and interests.

zh: 某些活动人士对美国参议员吉姆·韦伯亲赴仰光，要求释放引发昂山素姬案的美国人约翰·耶特沃持批评态度。
en: Some activists have criticized US Senator Jim Webb’s journey to Yangon to obtain the release of John Yettaw, the American whose actions triggered the charges against Aung San Suu Kyi.

zh: 但这恰恰符合奥巴马内阁力求与不是美国朋友的国家展开对话的政策。
en: But this is consistent with the Obama administration’s policy of seeking a dialogue even with those who are not America’s friends.

zh: 这样的对话对防止缅甸发展核武器和像伊朗一样操纵选举至关重要。
en: Such dialogue is vital if Myanmar is to be prevented from possibly pursuing nuclear weapons and rigging elections, à la Iran.

zh: 另外一项进展相对较为隐蔽。
en: The other development is less obvious.

zh: 在法院宣布判决后，缅甸当局将刑期压缩了一半，并同意软禁昂山素姬，而不是将其投入条件最差的监狱。
en: After the court delivered its verdict, the regime halved the sentence and agreed to keep Aung San Suu Kyi under house arrest, rather than moving her to one of its worst jails.

zh: 这乍看上去似乎不像一种让步。
en: This may not seem like much of a concession.

zh: 但军政府似乎有意缓和外界的愤怒。
en: But the junta seems to be trying to cause less offense.

zh: 军政府将耶特沃交给韦伯参议员、以及它在纳尔吉斯台风袭击后与国际社会在人道主义援助问题上的合作也是需要考虑的因素。
en: Consider, too, the junta’s gesture in handing over Yettaw to Senator Webb, and its interaction with the international community on humanitarian assistance after Cyclone Nargis.

zh: 这会不会是缅甸的将军们意识到自己已经走进了死胡同？
en: Might it be possible that the generals in Myanmar recognize that they are in a cul de sac?

zh: 这会不会是缅甸当局在2010年大选前试图摆脱孤立的局面？
en: Could the regime be seeking ways out of its isolation in the run-up to the 2010 elections?

zh: 缅甸军政府会不会欢迎对话和接触？
en: Could it welcome dialogue and engagement?

zh: 将军们如何回应东盟的要求将成为测试当局意图的重要信号。
en: How the generals respond to the ASEAN request will be an important signal of the regime’s intentions.

zh: 即使当局确实愿意谈判，坚持谈判也不会比北朝鲜的情况轻松多少。
en: Even if the regime does want to begin talking, sustaining a dialogue will be no easier than has been the case with North Korea.

zh: 虽说为实现谈判目标，东盟作为由邻国构成的组织所起的作用至关重要，但美国的参与才是问题的关键所在，此外也少不了中国和印度。
en: ASEAN, as the organization of neighboring states, is important to achieving that goal, but US involvement is key, as is inclusion of China and India.

zh: 必须对中国和印度施加压力，使它们在看重缅甸的战略能源和其他自然资源机遇之外关注到其他目标。
en: They must be pressed to see more than the opportunity for strategic access to energy and other natural resources.

zh: 还有现在仍然是亚��最大的经济体和传统赞助国的日本也必须发挥作用。
en: Japan, too – still the largest Asian economy and a traditional donor to the region – must also play a role.

zh: 必须建立合乎道德但又讲求实际的国际组织，让所有成员国以一致的步调与缅甸打交道。
en: A moral but pragmatic community needs to be constructed, with all in agreement on how to deal with Myanmar.

zh: 即便不同国家像交响乐团那样使用不同乐器演奏不同的曲目，但乐曲的主题必须保持一致。
en: Even if, like an orchestra, different countries use different instruments and play different notes, the main theme must be consistent.

zh: 如果能做到这一点，在2010年大选举行前取得进展的机会将会增大。
en: If this can be done, the chances of progress in the run-up to the 2010 elections will be strengthened.

zh: 成功可能仍然遥远，但新一轮努力已经开始，取得成功的可能性也比以往更大。
en: Success may still prove elusive, but a new game with a greater possibility for success will have begun.

zh: 东盟的阴暗心理
en: The Dark Heart of ASEAN

zh: 华盛顿—在下周的加利福尼亚峰会上，美国总统奥巴马将回见亚洲最重要的地区集团东盟十国的领导人。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Next week, at a summit in California, US President Barack Obama will meet with the leaders of the ten countries of Asia’s most important regional grouping: the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.

zh: 这次会议是第一次在美国举行美国-东盟峰会，被吹捧为美国对东南亚兴趣日益增加的信号。
en: The event, the first-ever US-ASEAN summit on American soil, is being touted as a sign of America’s growing interest in Southeast Asia.

zh: 问题在于邀请了所有东盟成员国的美国是否会让利益压倒原则。
en: The question is whether the US, by inviting all members of ASEAN, has allowed its interests to overwhelm its principles.

zh: 这次即将到来的峰会是奥巴马政府战略性“转向”亚洲的最新证明。 转向亚洲是奥巴马的国家安全战略，美国的军事、经济和外交资源都将投向环太平洋国家。
en: The upcoming summit is the latest manifestation of the Obama administration’s strategic “pivot” toward Asia – a national security strategy that entails a shift of American military, economic, and diplomatic resources toward the Pacific Rim countries.

zh: 从很多方面讲，这一加强关系的转变具有重大意义。
en: In many ways, this move toward closer relations makes a lot of sense.

zh: 首先，一些东盟国家与中国的紧张关系正在升级，部分原因在于在习近平主席（邓小平以来最独裁的领导人）的领导下，中国在东南亚海域的争议性领土主张越来越咄咄逼人。
en: For starters, tensions between several Southeast Asian countries and China are on the rise, owing partly to the fact that China, under President Xi Jinping (its most autocratic leader since Deng Xiaoping), has been acting increasingly assertively in staking its contested territorial claims in the region’s waters.

zh: 最近，中国决定在越南主张领海的水域钻井开采石油。
en: Most recently, China decided to move an oil rig into waters claimed by Vietnam.

zh: 两年前的类似决定导致越南爆发大规模反华骚乱。
en: A similar decision two years ago led to deadly anti-China riots in Vietnam.

zh: 而担忧的不只是越南。
en: And it is not just Vietnam that’s worried.

zh: 马来西亚、新加坡和菲律宾都在试图升级海军和海岸防卫力量。
en: Malaysia, Singapore, and the Philippines are also trying to upgrade their navies and coast guards.

zh: 事实上，在将美国力量事实驱逐出本地军事基地二十年后，菲律宾迎回了美国军队，以此作为新军事合作协议的一部分。
en: Indeed, two decades after essentially tossing US forces out of local bases, the Philippines has welcomed back American troops as part of a new military cooperation deal.

zh: 就连经济上需要依赖中国的国家也深感担忧。
en: Even countries whose economies rely on China are worried.

zh: 中国是老挝最大的援助国和贸易伙伴；但在老挝执政的共产党上个月选出的新领导层据说没有一位亲华派。
en: China is Laos’s biggest aid donor and largest trading partner; yet Laos’s ruling communist party last month elected a new leadership reportedly devoid of any pro-China politicians.

zh: 缅甸也非常依赖中国援助和对华贸易，但害怕沦为中国卫星国是21世纪10年代初缅甸军政府将权力移交给文职政府的关键原因。
en: In Myanmar, which also depends heavily on Chinese aid and trade, the fear of becoming a Chinese satellite was a key reason why the military junta ceded power to a civilian government in the early 2010s.

zh: 除了安全挑战，美国在东南亚的经济利益也日渐增加。
en: Beyond security challenges, the US has a growing economic interest in Southeast Asia.

zh: 东盟诸国合在一起是美国第四大贸易伙伴。
en: Together, the ASEAN countries comprise America’s fourth-largest trading partner.

zh: 一些证据表明，新的东盟经济共同体（地区自由贸易协定框架）正在帮助东南亚国家抵御日益动荡的全球经济环境。
en: Some evidence also suggests that the new ASEAN Economic Community, a framework for a regional free-trade agreement, is helping Southeast Asian countries weather an increasingly turbulent global economic environment.

zh: 但即将到来的美国-东盟峰会有一个严重问题。
en: But there is one very serious problem with the upcoming US-ASEAN summit.

zh: 自美国从2011年开始实施转向亚洲战略以来，东南亚政治制度总体而言大幅倒退。
en: Since the US pivot to Asia was launched in 2011, Southeast Asia’s political systems have, on the whole, regressed significantly.

zh: 在过去几年中，泰国从有缺陷的民主变成军事统治，这一状况可能一直持续到2018年以后。
en: Over the last few years, Thailand has gone from flawed democracy to military rule, which could persist through 2018, or beyond.

zh: 类似地，2011年，马来西亚大有进入两党制民主之势。
en: Similarly, Malaysia appeared to be headed for a two-party democracy in 2011.

zh: 如今，反对派领导人伊布拉西姆（Anwar Ibrahim）因可疑的鸡奸指控入狱；政府通过了一项实质上授权它无限期拘捕批评者的立法；而总理纳吉也深陷多宗经济和政治丑闻。
en: Today, opposition leader Anwar Ibrahim is in jail on dubious sodomy charges; the government has passed legislation that essentially authorizes it to detain critics indefinitely; and Prime Minister Najib Razak remains embroiled in multiple economic and political scandals.

zh: 2013年，反对派联盟在柬埔寨大选中几乎获胜，柬埔寨似乎要迎来政治突破了。
en: Cambodia, too, seemed like it had reached a political breakthrough after the opposition coalition nearly won the 2013 general election.

zh: 但在过去两年中，柬埔寨首相洪森重新夺回了政治主宰地位。
en: But in the last two years, Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen has reasserted his political dominance.

zh: 反对派领导人沈良西因为害怕被捕而选择流亡。
en: Opposition leader Sam Rainsy, fearing arrest, has fled into exile.

zh: 还有缅甸。
en: Then there is Myanmar.

zh: 尽管奥巴马政府将它捧为民主变革的显例，但其实真正的民主仍然望尘莫及。
en: Although the Obama administration has touted the country as a shining example of democratic change, genuine democracy remains over the horizon.

zh: 诚然，长期以来的反对党全国民主联盟（National League for Democracy）赢得了去年11月的大选。
en: True, the longtime opposition party, the National League for Democracy, won last November’s general election.

zh: 但军方仍然控制着诸多政府部门和四分之一议会席位。
en: But the military still controls many ministries and a quarter of the seats in parliament.

zh: 此外，缅甸边境地区爆发内战，其西部则有黑帮和其他激进组织屠杀穆斯林。
en: Moreover, civil wars are erupting along Myanmar’s borders, and gangs and other radical groups are slaughtering Muslims in the country’s west.

zh: 老挝、越南和文莱都是世界上最专制的国家，毫无政治开放迹象。
en: Laos, Vietnam, and Brunei remain among the most repressive states in the world, with no evidence of political opening at all.

zh: 而尽管印尼、菲律宾和新加坡民主有所进步，但进步速度十分缓慢；在新加坡，执政党继续主宰着政治体系。
en: And though democracy has advanced in Indonesia, the Philippines, and Singapore, progress has been slow; in Singapore, the ruling party continues to dominate the political system.

zh: 东南亚民主式微的原因很多。
en: Many factors account for the weakening of democracy in Southeast Asia.

zh: 该地区第一代民选领导人，如泰国前总理他信，最后并不比利用大多数人的支持镇压反对派、抑制可用来作为变革工具的技术的民选独裁者更强。
en: The region’s first generation of elected leaders, like former Thai Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, often proved to be no more than elected autocrats who used their majorities to crush their opponents and suppress technologies that could be used as tools for change.

zh: 事实上，泰国网络压迫在军政府治下变本加厉，目前已经屏蔽了超过100,000个网站。
en: Indeed, Thailand, whose online repression has increased under the junta, now blocks more than 100,000 websites from its citizens.

zh: 弱制度意味着许多国家，比如马来西亚，难以解决政治危机；在泰国，军方接管已成为权宜之计。
en: Weak institutions mean many countries, such as Malaysia, struggle to resolve political crises; in Thailand, army takeovers have become the modus vivendi.

zh: 除此之外则有中国的影响 — — 巨肥民主变革力量 — — 东南亚民主倒退算不上多么惊人的事。
en: Add to that the influence of China – hardly a force for democratic change – and Southeast Asia’s democratic regression is not particularly shocking.

zh: 麻烦之处在于，奥巴马政府一直在加强与东南亚独裁者的联系，这强化了这一破坏性趋势。
en: What is troublesome is that the Obama administration has been reinforcing this damaging trend by bolstering ties with Southeast Asian autocrats.

zh: 奥巴马与马来西亚的纳吉保持着良好的关系（据说两人是高尔夫球友 ） 。
en: Obama has maintained close relations with Malaysia’s Najib (the two are reportedly golfing buddies).

zh: 去年，在奥巴马访问马来西亚期间，他对伊布拉西姆的入狱绝口不提。
en: When Obama visited Malaysia last year, he barely mentioned Anwar’s imprisonment.

zh: 奥巴马政府还刻意对文莱、老挝和越南的侵犯权利的行为保持沉默，去年7月还盛情邀请越南共产党总书记访问华盛顿。
en: The Obama administration also has been conspicuously quiet about abuses in Brunei, Laos, and Vietnam, inviting the head of Vietnam’s Communist Party to Washington, DC, last July for a showy and warm visit.

zh: 最近几个月来，奥巴马政府开始重建与泰国的联系，包括重启高层战略对话。 美泰关系自2014年5月政变后陷入冰点。
en: In recent months, the Obama administration has begun to restore links with Thailand that were put on ice after the May 2014 coup, including by resuming a high-level strategic dialogue.

zh: 但据人权观察组织（Human Rights Watch）的数据，去年“泰国军政府加紧把持权力，严重迫害基本权利 ” 。
en: Yet according to Human Rights Watch, “Thailand’s military junta tightened its grip on power and severely repressed fundamental rights” last year.

zh: 而到今年目前为止，泰国并未表现出改变这一做法的迹象。
en: And, so far this year, it has shown no signs of changing that approach.

zh: 即将到来的美国-东盟峰会的一些出席领导人 — — 如统治柬埔寨25年之久的洪森 — — 此前被奥巴马认为过于残酷和专制，不容踏上美国领土。
en: The upcoming US-ASEAN summit will include leaders – like Hun Sen, who has ruled Cambodia for 25 years – who were previously considered too ruthless and repressive to be received by the US president on American soil.

zh: 似乎如今安全和经济考虑已经超过了民主，成为美国东南亚外交政策的首要决定因素。
en: It seems that security and economic considerations have now usurped democracy as leading determinants of US foreign policy in the region.

zh: 对东南亚人民来说，这一方针最终造成更多的风险而不是收益。
en: For the people of Southeast Asia, this approach may ultimately create more risks than benefits.

zh: 东盟能将地缘战略及科技破坏因素转化为挑战吗？
en: Can ASEAN Turn Geostrategic and Technological Disruption into Opportunity?

zh: 发自日内瓦 — — 东南亚国家联盟是否拥有足够的适应能力，使其能够在当前的区域和全球变革中繁荣发展？
en: GENEVA – Is the Association of Southeast Asian Nations resilient enough to thrive amid the regional and global transformations taking place today?

zh: 虽然全球经济依然在进行广泛性的扩张，但破坏性的经济、地缘战略和技术力量可能会威胁到东盟近年来的增长。
en: While the global economy continues its broad-based expansion, disruptive economic, geostrategic, and technological forces may threaten ASEAN’s gains of recent years.

zh: 为了生存，东盟成员必须就该组织在区域事务中的作用做出重要决定。
en: To survive, ASEAN members must make important decisions about the role of their community in regional affairs.

zh: 而透过正确的选择，该地区可以将破坏因素转化为有适应性的未来。
en: With the right choices, the region can convert disruption into an opportunity for a resilient future.

zh: 在过去五十年中东盟经历了令人印象深刻的转变。
en: ASEAN has undergone an impressive turnaround in the past five decades.

zh: 那个1960年代动荡且充满冲突的不发达地区如今已是政治和经济上的成功样板之一。
en: A region of turbulence, disharmony, and underdevelopment in the 1960s is today one of relative peace and economic success.

zh: 这大部分归功于各国在东盟这把大伞下的社区建设努力。
en: Much of the credit belongs to the community-building efforts of the countries under the ASEAN umbrella.

zh: 但该地区也从二战后的全球架构和体制中受益匪浅，正是这两者促进了外来投资以及对外出口。
en: But the region also benefited strongly from the post-World War II global architecture and institutions that promoted inward flows of investment and outward flows of exports.

zh: 眼下这种全球背景又进入了一个深刻变革的状态。
en: Today, this global backdrop is in a state of profound transformation.

zh: 自由和开放贸易的好处遭到质疑，国际体制备受挑战，新的地缘政治力量冉冉升起，而全球经济会继续向新兴市场进一步倾斜（即便中间总有波折 ） 。
en: The benefits of free and open trade are being questioned, international institutions are being challenged, new geopolitical powers are rising, and – despite ups and downs – the global economy continues to tilt further toward emerging markets.

zh: 所有这一切都为打造一个关于如何运行和管理世界的新竞争性愿景创造了机会。
en: All of this creates an opportunity for new and competing visions of how the world should be organized and run.

zh: 在有增无减的地缘政治不确定性之外，东盟国家还必须应对第四次工业革命。
en: Alongside rising geopolitical uncertainty, ASEAN countries must grapple with the Fourth Industrial Revolution.

zh: 人工智能，先进机器人，精准医学和自动驾驶汽车等技术的指数式发展正在改变经济、企业和社会。
en: The exponential development of technologies such as artificial intelligence, advanced robotics, precision medicine, and autonomous vehicles is transforming economies, businesses, and societies.

zh: 东盟成员国将深刻感受到第四次工业革命的影响。
en: ASEAN members will feel the effects of the Fourth Industrial Revolution acutely.

zh: 以就业的发展趋势为例，欧盟每天增加1.1万适龄就业人口，并将在未来15年持续以这一速度增长。
en: Consider the future of jobs. The working-age population in the bloc is increasing by 11,000 people daily and will continue to grow at this rate for the next 15 years.

zh: 而在这种人口扩张正在发生的同时许多现有工作正在被智能自动化和人工智能所取代。
en: This demographic expansion is happening just as many existing jobs will be substituted by intelligent automation and AI.

zh: 以劳动收入为基础的税收制度将面临压力。
en: Systems of taxation that rely on labor income will come under pressure.

zh: 在东盟成员国必须追加投资重新培训劳动力队伍并为这一新时代开发基础设施的那一刻，国家预算必将受到挑战。
en: National budgets will be challenged at exactly the moment when ASEAN members must increase their investment in reskilling labor forces and developing infrastructure for this new age.

zh: 制造业的未来也是如此，3D打印和廉价工业机器人等技术使产品能够以小批量高度定制的形式制造，而不是大批量统一产品。
en: Or consider the future of manufacturing. Technologies such as 3D printing and cheap industrial robots are enabling products to be made in small, highly-customized forms rather than large batches of uniform goods.

zh: 对于东盟而言，从集中化全球供应链向本地化生产系统的转变可能对其出口收入以及相关投资产生严重影响。
en: For ASEAN, the shift from centralized global supply chains to localized production systems could have a serious impact on export revenues and the investment by which it is driven.

zh: 为了应对这些破坏性转变，东盟必须强化自己这个大社区的作用。
en: Faced with these disruptive shifts, ASEAN must strengthen its community.

zh: 在经济上，通过建立一个真正的单一市场可以加强区域适应力：东盟拥有6.3亿消费能力迅速上升的公民。
en: Economically, regional resilience can be bolstered by building a genuine single market: ASEAN has 630 million citizens with rapidly rising spending power.

zh: 而对东盟经济共同体的充分利用则是关键。
en: Fully implementing the ASEAN Economic Community will be key.

zh: 凭借强大的区域市场，东盟可以主宰自身经济命运而不是依赖外部市场的需求，并将更好地隔离潜在的保护主义冲击。
en: With a strong regional market, ASEAN can drive its own economic destiny, rather than relying on demand from external markets, and will be better insulated against potential protectionist shocks.

zh: 创建一个服务类的单一市场至关重要。
en: Creating a single market for services will be critical.

zh: 尤其在这方面东盟成员国必须应对第四次工业革命，解决诸如数据使用规则一致性等问题。
en: Here, especially, ASEAN members must respond to the Fourth Industrial Revolution, tackling issues such as harmonization of rules governing the use of data.

zh: 新技术 — — 包括数字平台，大数据分析和基于云的服务 — — 无法识别国家边界且只有在大规模应用时才能发挥最佳作用。
en: New technologies – including digital platforms, big-data analytics, and cloud-based services – do not recognize national borders and function best when they operate at scale.

zh: 通过单一的数字市场，东盟可以在金融，医疗，教育和电子商务方面开发真正的泛区域服务。
en: With a single digital market, ASEAN can develop truly pan-regional services in finance, health care, education, and e-commerce.

zh: 当然，东盟不应该建立一个将世界拒之门外的堡垒。
en: Of course, ASEAN should not build a fortress that keeps out the world.

zh: 事实上，东盟长期以来一直以其“开放的区域主义”而备受赞誉，因为它在成员国之间追求经济一体化的同时也不会歧视其他非东盟经济体。
en: Indeed, the bloc has long been praised for its “open regionalism,” whereby it pursues economic integration among member states without discriminating against non-ASEAN economies.

zh: 这种行事方式从一开始就是东盟经济战略不可或缺的一部分，并将继续延续下去，与即将建立的区域综合经济伙伴关系框架下将东盟与中国、日本、韩国、印度、澳大利亚和新西兰连结起来。
en: This approach has been integral to ASEAN’s economic strategy from the beginning, and continues with the soon-to-be concluded Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership joining ASEAN with China, Japan, South Korea, India, Australia, and New Zealand.

zh: 加强政治-安全社区也同样重要。
en: Strengthening the political-security community is equally essential.

zh: 随着全球治理架构受到挑战，东盟成员如果想要一个支持其利益的世界就必须发出自己的声音。
en: With the architecture of global governance being challenged, ASEAN members must make their voices heard if they want a world that supports their interests.

zh: 单个东南亚国家权重不大；但集合起来后它们几乎占了全球人口的1/10，占世界GDP的将近5 ％ 。
en: Individually, Southeast Asia’s countries carry little weight; collectively, however, they represent almost a tenth of the world’s population and nearly 5% of its GDP.

zh: 从历史上看东盟在促进区域关系方面发挥了关键作用，从而在亚洲产生了“东盟中心地位”的概念。
en: Historically, ASEAN has played a pivotal role in facilitating regional relationships, giving rise to the notion of “ASEAN centrality” in Asia.

zh: 1993年，该集团建立了东盟地区论坛（现有27个成员）以促进关于政治和安全问题的对话。
en: In 1993, the bloc established the ASEAN Regional Forum – now with 27 members – to foster dialogue on political and security concerns.

zh: 它还于2005年建立了东亚峰会，目前有18个成员国。
en: It established the East Asia Summit, currently with 18 member states, in 2005.

zh: 然而当前的地缘政治环境正在发生变化。
en: Today, however, the geopolitical context is evolving.

zh: 随着其他大国的崛起，东盟有可能失去对该地区共同愿景的集体承诺以及地缘政治问题的共同立场。
en: As other powers rise, ASEAN is at risk of losing its collective commitment to a shared vision for the region and a common stance on geopolitical issues.

zh: 许多观察家认为，其他国家正在通过在投资，贸易和援助基础上构建与个别国家的依赖性来破坏东盟的意见一致性。
en: Many observers believe that other countries are undermining ASEAN unanimity by developing dependencies with individual countries, built on investment, trade, and assistance.

zh: 除非东盟作为一个集团能保持团结，否则它将失去召集区域行动者，调解争端以及塑造国际行为和互动的能力。
en: Unless ASEAN remains united as a bloc, it will lose its ability to convene regional actors, mediate disputes, and shape principles of international behavior and interaction.

zh: 所谓的东盟道路 — — 特点是以共识为基础的决策和不干涉政策 — — 为东盟带来了极大的好处，因此就此放弃也是不明智的。
en: The so-called ASEAN way, characterized by consensus-based decision-making and non-interference, has served ASEAN well, and the bloc would be unwise to jettison it.

zh: 但是如果东盟要在区域事务上拥有强有力的发言权而非坐视集团内部的不同意见去阻止采取集体立场，则需要对此进行重新评估。
en: But a reassessment is needed if ASEAN is to speak with a strong voice on regional matters, rather than allowing dissenting voices within the group to prevent the adoption of collective positions.

zh: 鉴于现有全球体制正在受到挑战而亚洲在全球事务中不断崛起，东盟必须加强其影响政策辩论的能力。
en: Given that existing global institutions are being challenged, and given the rise of Asia in global affairs, ASEAN must reinforce its ability to influence the debate.

zh: 世界经济论坛东盟峰会将于9月11日至13日在越南河内举行，也为这一重新评估提供了机会。
en: The World Economic Forum on ASEAN will be held in Hanoi, Vietnam, on September 11-13 and will provide an opportunity for such a reassessment.

zh: 在一个日益不确定的世界中，东盟国家深化自身社区构建及其强化融合与协作承诺的必要性比以往任何时候都更加强烈。
en: In an increasingly uncertain world, the need for the countries of ASEAN to deepen their community and their commitment to integration and collaboration is stronger than ever.

zh: 为21世纪而生的安全战略
en: A Security Strategy for the 21st Century

zh: 发自马德里 — — “在吾国绵延至今的历史中，美国人民一再顺应并塑造了诸多历史性的转折，而今那些伟大的时刻，又将重现在我们面前。
en: MADRID – “Time and again in our Nation’s history, Americans have risen to meet –and to shape – moments of transition. This must be one of those moments.”

zh: ”这段文字是5月27日呈交给美国国会的《美国国家安全战略》报告的开篇语。
en: So begins the National Security Strategy of the United States of America, presented before Congress on May 27.

zh: 而这份报告的重点正是奥巴马政府执政16个月以来所追求的政治目标 — — 对话、国际承诺、核不扩散以及裁军。
en: As with the politics pursued in the Obama administration’s 16 months of office – dialogue, international commitment, nuclear non-proliferation and disarmament – the document’s strength lies in the position that it takes.

zh: 报告一方面展现了与前任政府截然不同的政策取向，另一方面则诠释了新总统自身对国家战略概念的更深刻理解。
en: The Security Strategy is a clear departure from that of its predecessor and offers a wider conception of what national security represents for US President Barack Obama.

zh: 面对当今世界上的各个重大挑战，奥巴马采取了一种更加综合性的立场。
en: In the face of the major challenges of our times, Obama has taken a stand with a comprehensive doctrine.

zh: 事实上，这份安全战略报告几乎就体现了美国的整个国家战略。
en: Indeed, the Security Strategy is almost a “National” Strategy.

zh: 它的目光超越了前任政府那种唯我独尊的单边主义行动模式，并加入了捍卫国际法的内容，这点尤其重要，须知在小布什执政期间，美国是拒绝签署任何关于成立国际刑事法庭以及常设战争罪行特别法庭的重大条约的。
en: Its thinking goes beyond the dominant, unilateral paradigm of its predecessor and includes a defense of international law. This is particularly noteworthy, given that none of the great treaties to create an international criminal court and a permanent war-crimes tribunal was signed by the US during George W. Bush’s presidency.

zh: 奥巴马实现国家安全的手段也得到了拓展，他的“3D理念”将防御（defense ） ， 外交（diplomacy）和发展（development）组成一个不可分割的整体。
en: Obama’s approach to security is broader as well, proposing the “three Ds” – defense, diplomacy, and development – as indivisible parts of a whole.

zh: 海外军事干涉行动失去了原有的优先地位，取而代之的则是派驻当地防范冲突，维持地区和平及稳定的代表团。
en: The military dimension of intervention abroad loses its privileged role, making way for the prevention of conflict and for peace-keeping and stabilization missions.

zh: 而在反恐方面，新战略摒弃了原本在反恐战争中占主导的军事斗争观，转而赋予了情报工作更重大的意义。
en: In the fight against terrorism, the Strategy abandons the predominantly military viewpoint underlying the war against terror, and embraces a more significant role for the intelligence services.

zh: 报告也首次对那些可能威胁美国安全的人员下了精确定义 — — 美国并不是在打一场反对恐怖主义的战争，而是在“对抗一个特殊的网络，那就是基地组织及其分支 ” 。
en: For the first time, precise reference is made to people liable to be a threat to US security. The US is not waging a war against terrorism; it is at “war against a specific network, al Qaida, and its affiliates.”

zh: 在这么一场战争中，情报资源就是关键。
en: In this war, information resources are particularly necessary.

zh: 为了确保国家安全，该战略不再偏向孤立主义，而是重视研究过往外交先例的战略价值，并提倡预先了解当地情况的重要性。
en: In order to guarantee national security, the Strategy is categorical – without giving in to the temptation of isolationism – in admitting the strategic value of the example and the importance of doing one’s homework first.

zh: 对此奥巴马避开了两类行为：以人权为目的的干涉行动，以及用武力输出民主的理念。
en: Obama steers clear both of interventions for humanitarian purposes and of attempting to export democracy by force.

zh: 事实上，输出民主价值观的最佳方法，莫过于令美国从内部更加强大起来。
en: There is no better way of exporting the values of democracy than by strengthening the US internally.

zh: 因此一个缓解美国债务和财政赤字的经济政策被放到了显眼的位置。
en: Thus, an economic policy that tackles America’s debt and deficit makes up the main portion of the Strategy.

zh: 通过支持有竞争力的教育体系、创新、科技，能源以及一个更高效且更贴心的健康医疗系统，奥巴马树立个人“招牌政策”的领导方式得到了补充和加强。
en: Backing competitive education, innovation, technology, energy, and a more efficient and accessible health-care system complements and reinforces Obama’s leadership approach of setting an example with one’s own policies.

zh: 而其中关塔那摩问题就是一个重要的例子，奥巴马上任伊始立刻提出的举措之一，就是将这个原本处于法律真空地带的监狱置于国际监管之下。
en: An important example is removing the US prison at Guantánamo Bay from international limbo – one of his first initiatives as president.

zh: 对于奥巴马的新领导方式，国际上的专家们各执己见。
en: This approach does not have unanimous support among international experts.

zh: 而主要的两种批评声音 — — 其一是认为报告缺乏战略清晰度，二是对权力的经典概念缺乏足够重视 — — 指出了美国在国际影响力，权力以及领导地位等方面的式微。
en: The two main criticisms – lack of strategic clarity and less emphasis on the classical concepts of power – point to America’s loss of influence, power, and leadership.

zh: 但这些批评实际��也反映了这些人对近年来武装冲突本质的错误理解，须知这些冲突已经不能再用传统的战争成败逻辑来评断了。
en: But these criticisms reflect an inability to contemplate the current nature of armed conflict, which no longer follows the classical logic of military victory or defeat.

zh: 而凸显了上述综合性手段重要性的，正是阿富汗战争以及当前伊拉克的复杂局势。
en: The war in Afghanistan and the complex situation in Iraq have highlighted the importance of a comprehensive approach.

zh: 军事行动不再是取得胜利的唯一手段，一个战略的成功必须借助民间行动来实现 — — 这也恰恰也是欧盟最近所提倡的模式。
en: Military action cannot be considered the only variable of success. A successful strategy should use civilian means – incidentally a model advocated by the European Union.

zh: 对此，我们需要塑造一个能同时对国家政府和民间社会起作用的，崭新的长期政策，这要求我们有足够的耐心和战略持续性。
en: We are faced with forging a new long-term policy that affects both states and societies. That task requires patience and strategic perseverance.

zh: 变化不会在短期内发生，但最终取得的成果将更为完美而且更具有可持续性。
en: Change will not occur from one day to the next, but the results obtained in the end will be better and more enduring.

zh: 与此同时，奥巴马依旧肩负着美国所承担着的历史任务 — — 维护全球安全。
en: Obama maintains the idea of service to a historical mission for the US: the important job of guaranteeing global security.

zh: 但与他那些前任不同的是，奥巴马的国家安全战略承认伙伴关系的价值；把更多的重点放在民间而不是军事上；强调对话的价值以及更强大的国际机制。
en: But, unlike his White House predecessors, Obama’s National Security Strategy recognizes the value of partnerships; attaches greater importance to the civilian dimension as opposed to the military; and stresses the value of dialogue and the need to reinforce international institutions.

zh: 这对于一个拥有不同权力中心和利益，而资源和合法性依然分散在各个民族国家手中，但却面临着气候变化，武装冲突，跨国疾病疫情以及跨国犯罪等诸多全球问题，从而急待各国联手解决的世界来说，是一个好兆头。
en: This is a good sign for a world with different power centers and interests, with resources and legitimacy remaining tied to the nation-state, but in which challenges (climate change, armed conflicts, pandemics, and transnational crime) are global and, therefore, require cooperation among states.

zh: 我们正处在一个时代的转折点上：正如全球经济危机所展现的那样，国际间的关联性不断增加，但确保政府间平稳运作的管理工具和机制却尚未形成。
