en: We are in a transition period: international interconnection is increasing, as the global economic crisis has shown, but the management tools and mechanisms to guarantee the smooth operation of governments are still not being shared.

zh: 而奥巴马的新国家安全策略则表达了一种政治意愿，希望能建立一个可以应对上述挑战的国际秩序。
en: Obama’s new National Security Strategy shows a political willingness to back an international order able to tackle these challenges.

zh: 前面的路注定坎坷，但这一策略在应对这些21世纪的挑战方面已经迈出了决定性的一步，并有助于我们共同迎接未来。
en: The road ahead is not free of difficulties, but the Strategy represents a decisive step towards solving the challenges of the twenty-first century and preparing us for the world of tomorrow.

zh: 一宗与地震有关的罪行
en: A Seismic Crime

zh: 发自纽约 — — 在一座名为拉奎拉的意大利小城里，有六位地震学家以及一位政府官员被送上了法庭。
en: NEW YORK – Few people outside Italy are aware that six seismologists and a government official are on trial in the small city of L’Aquila.

zh: 虽然此事在国外并未引起多大的注意，但它对科学家，工程师，行政管理者以及司法系统所造成的影响却是全球范围的。
en: But the story has implications for scientists, engineers, administrators, and legal systems far beyond Italy’s borders.

zh: 拉奎拉这座城市曾经在1461年和1703年遭到地震的严重破坏。
en: L’Aquila was largely destroyed by earthquakes in 1461 and 1703.

zh: 人们实施了灾后重建，将其最终发展成为一座拥有超过7.3万人的城市，并保持了300多年的稳定 — — 直到2008年10月重新出现微震为止，而在随后的2009年1月1日到4月5日间又发生了合共304次微震。
en: The city was rebuilt, eventually grew to more than 73,000 inhabitants, and remained stable for more than 300 years – until October 2008, when tremors began again. From January 1 through April 5, 2009, 304 additional tremors were reported.

zh: 而由上述7位受审者所组成的意大利国家大型灾害预防委员会于2009年3月31日在拉奎拉召开了一小时的地震评估会议。
en: Italy’s National Commission for Prediction and Prevention of Major Risks, which comprised the seven men now on trial, met in L’Aquila for one hour on March 31, 2009, to assess the earthquake swarms.

zh: 根据当时的会议记录，有人询问意大利国家地球物理学及火山学研究中心主任恩佐·波斯齐（Enzo Boschi）这些微震是否会是一场类似1703年地震的前兆。
en: According to the minutes, Enzo Boschi, President of the National Institute of Geophysics and Volcanology, was asked if they were precursors to an earthquake resembling the one in 1703.

zh: 波斯齐回答说 ： “ 短期来说不可能发生类似1703年那样的灾害，但也无法完全排除这种可能性。 ”
en: He replied: “It is unlikely that an earthquake like the one in 1703 could occur in the short term, but the possibility cannot be totally excluded.”

zh: 谁知就在几天后的4月6号，一场里氏6.3级的大地震袭击了拉奎拉城以及附近城镇，造成超过300人死亡1500多人受伤。
en: On April 6, 2009, a 6.3 magnitude earthquake struck L’Aquila and nearby towns, killing more than 300 people and injuring more than 1,500.

zh: 地震同时摧毁了近2万栋房屋，致使6.5万人无家可归。
en: The quake also destroyed roughly 20,000 buildings, temporarily displacing another 65,000 people.

zh: 在此次地震发生一年多之后的2010年7月，检查官法比奥·皮库迪（Fabio Picuti）以误杀和玩忽职守罪对委员会成员提起公诉，认为他们未能将如此迫近的危险告知公众。
en: More than a year later, in July 2010, prosecutor Fabio Picuti charged the Commission members with manslaughter and negligence for failing to warn the public of the impending risk.

zh: 法庭于去年9月年开庭，预计审理过程就算不超过一年，至少也将持续数月。
en: The trial began last September, and is expected to last for months, if not years.

zh: 在皮库迪在2010年6月公开此项起诉之时 ， 《 科学》杂志执行出版人艾伦·莱施纳（Alan Leshner）代表美国科学促进会向意大利总统乔治·纳波利塔诺（Giorgio Napolitano）递交了公开抗议信。
en: After Picuti made the charges public in June 2010, Alan Leshner, Executive Publisher of Science, sent an open letter of protest to Italian President Giorgio Napolitano on behalf of the American Association for the Advancement of Science.

zh: 他在信中写到 ： “ 对这些科学家的指控是不公平而且幼稚的 … … 对于地震的预测，目前并没有公认可靠的科学预警方法可以使民众避免一场即将降临的灾害。
en: He wrote that the “charges against these scientists are both unfair and naïve….[T]here is no accepted scientific method for earthquake prediction that can be reliably used to warn citizens of an impending disaster.”

zh: ”美国地球物理学联盟以及数千位科学家也反对这一指控行为。
en: The American Geophysical Union and thousands of other scientists also objected.

zh: 据报道，皮库迪回应说 ： “ 我并不是疯了。
en: Picuti reportedly responded: “I’m not crazy.

zh: 我知道他们无法预测地震。
en: I know they can’t predict earthquakes.

zh: 这些指控的依据也并不是因为他们未能预测地震。
en: The basis of the charges is not that they didn’t predict the earthquake.

zh: 但作为国家公职人员，他们承担着法律赋予的特殊责任：衡量并定义在拉奎拉所出现的那些风险。 ”
en: As functionaries of the state, they had certain duties imposed by law: to evaluate and characterize the risks that were present in L’Aquila.”

zh: 在1989年，一份名为《增强危机沟通》的美国国家研究委员会报告就建议使用一种“交换信息和意见的互动程序”来取代原先那种由专家来知会非专家的单向沟通方式。
en: In 1989, a United States National Research Council report, Improving Risk Communication, recommended that one-way communication from experts to non-experts be replaced with an “interactive process of exchange of information and opinion.”

zh: 报告认为由于可供利用的知识有限，只有在所有参与者都认为自己得到了相关事务充分信息的情况下才能实现危机沟通。
en: The report suggested that risk communication is successful only if those involved are satisfied that they are adequately informed about the relevant issues, given the limits of available knowledge.

zh: 但这种信息交换方式在超过20年后 — — 也不仅限于意大利 — — 依然未能完善。
en: Yet such information exchange remains a problem – and not only in Italy – more than 20 years later.

zh: 科学，技术和法律之间的互动正逐渐变得复杂。
en: The interactions between science, technology, and law are growing increasingly complex.

zh: 随着科学技术的介入，危机风险评估以及科学家与政府官员之间的对话也必须做出调整。
en: As science and technologies evolve, risk assessments and the dialogue between scientists and governments must adapt.

zh: 在灾难袭来之前，双方都必须持续评估当前的法律是否为科学家和官员们的分析和公共沟通提供了清晰可行的操作标准。
en: Both sides must continually determine, before disaster strikes, whether existing laws provide scientists and administrators with clear, realistic standards for their analyses and public communications.

zh: 如果做不到这一点，那么那些最优秀的科学家和行政管理者都将噤若寒蝉。
en: If they do not, the best qualified scientists and administrators might be frightened away.

zh: 在2011年，美国国家研究委员会以及联邦司法中心发布了厚达1016页的《科学证据参考手册》第三版。
en: In 2011, the National Research Council and the US Federal Judicial Center issued the 1,016-page third edition of the Reference Manual on Scientific Evidence.

zh: 虽然该手册的目的就是为了帮助法官和律师理解法律证据背后的科学依据，但其索引中却没有任何关于地震的条目。
en: Although its purpose is to help judges and attorneys to understand the science from which legal evidence is derived, its index contains no entry for earthquakes.

zh: 此外手册也只是在医疗证词方面粗略提到了一些与危机沟通有关的内容。
en: Furthermore, the manual mentions risk communication only briefly, in the context of medical testimony.

zh: 考虑到这些不足之处，必须在对法律界人士，政府官员和政策制订者们的核心培训和继续教育中加入关于科学工程以及其社会应用的内容。
en: Given such shortcomings, courses on science and engineering and their social applications should become part of the core training and continuing education of those in law, public administration, and official policymaking positions.

zh: 而立法者，检察官和法官也尤其应当明白自然科学，社会科学和工程学有其长处，但也不是万能的。
en: Legislators, prosecutors, and judges, in particular, need to understand what natural sciences, social sciences, and engineering can and cannot offer.

zh: 与此同时，自然科学家必须学会与工程师，公共行政管理者和社会科学家（比如经济学家，人口学家以及心理学家）更有效地进行合作并交流某些科学发现所可能揭示的后果，尤其是当这些发现关系到某些重大风险之时。
en: At the same time, natural scientists must become better educated to work effectively with engineers, public administrators, and social scientists (for example, economists, demographers, and psychologists) to communicate the consequences of scientific findings, especially when high risks are involved.

zh: 实际上，这些风险一直盘踞在我们身旁。
en: Those risks will not go away.

zh: 在2011年2月，新西兰克莱斯特彻奇市的里氏6.3级地震就造成了近200人死亡。
en: In February 2011, almost 200 people died when a 6.3-magnitude earthquake struck Christchurch, New Zealand.

zh: 而在随后的3月，日本东北大地震夺去了1.6万人的生命。
en: The following month, Japan’s Tōhoku earthquake killed almost 16,000 people.

zh: 在今年3月11日的大地震周年祭临近之时，日本科学家在2012年1月发表预测，认为在2016年以前在包括东京在内的京都南部地区有70%的可能会爆发另一场大地震。
en: As the anniversary of that earthquake approaches on March 11, Japanese researchers predicted in January 2012 that another major earthquake will strike the southern Kanto region, including Tokyo, by 2016 with 70% probability.

zh: 那么面对有朝一日可能袭击加利福尼亚的大地震，我们美国人又准备好了吗？
en: The Big One will one day strike California. Will we be ready?

zh: 欧元区选择面在收窄
en: The Eurozone’s Narrowing Window

zh: 普林斯顿—葡萄牙当局最近先发制人给该国债权人来了个下马威：它将不会履行2013年9月到期债权的偿还义务，而是将偿还期限延长到2015年。
en: PRINCETON – Portuguese authorities recently made a preemptive offer to their country’s creditors: Instead of redeeming bonds maturing in September 2013, the government would stretch its repayment commitment out to October 2015.

zh: 该计划在10月3日宣布，并被解读为葡国政府对市场的成功测试。
en: The deal was concluded on October 3, and has been interpreted as a successful market test for Portugal.

zh: 爱尔兰当局最近也宣布了类似的计划，用短期票据替换长期债券。
en: Ireland’s authorities have conducted similar recent operations, exchanging short-maturity paper for longer-term debt.

zh: 这些交易凸显了赢取时间的更大战略。
en: These transactions highlight the broader strategy of buying time.

zh: 为了不再依赖“三驾马车 ” （ 欧洲委员会、欧洲央行和IMF）所提供的正式“援助”资金，两国均在寻求为其握于私人手中的债务创造更长期、更便于管理的偿付结构。
en: Both countries are seeking to create a longer, more manageable repayment profile for their privately-held debt as they begin weaning themselves from dependence on official “bailout” funds provided by the “troika” (the European Commission, the European Central Bank, and the International Monetary Fund).

zh: 私人投资者也承认了偿还其可能会被拉长的现实，因为坚持按现有条款偿付将导致不可持续的债务偿付压力，造成不利的后果。
en: Private investors are acknowledging the reality that repayments will likely be drawn out, because insisting on existing terms could cause an untenable bunching of debt-service payments, with possibly unpleasant consequences.

zh: 该战略的成功有个前提：在此期间，经济增长能够提振债务偿付能力。
en: This strategy’s success presupposes that, in the interim, economic growth will strengthen the capacity to repay debt down the line.

zh: 据估计，爱尔兰和葡萄牙的债务比率将在2013年迎来高峰，达到GDP的120 % ， 此后则会下降。
en: The debt ratios for both Ireland and Portugal are expected to peak at about 120% of GDP in 2013, after which they are projected to fall.

zh: 峰值比率及其后的下降很大程度上取决于经济增长的速度。
en: The peak ratio and the subsequent downward trajectory depend crucially on the assumed pace of economic growth.

zh: 但增长前景并不乐观。
en: But growth prospects remain grim.

zh: 目前，人们预计葡萄牙经济将在2013年收缩1 % 。
en: The Portuguese economy is now expected to contract by 1% in 2013.

zh: 而6月末，IMF预计葡萄牙将略有增长。 再往前，2011年5月“援助”协议达成时，葡萄牙2013年GDP预期增长率为1.25 % 。
en: In late June, the IMF projected modest growth, and, at the time of the “bailout” agreement in May 2011, GDP in 2013 was expected to grow by 1.25%.

zh: 类似的增长预期连续向下修正已是家常便饭。
en: Such successive downward forecast revisions have become commonplace.

zh: 对意大利和西班牙的最新估计表明将出现深度衰退，并会延续到明年。
en: The latest estimates for Italy and Spain project a deeper contraction, prolonged into next year.

zh: 爱尔兰情况稍好，但其增长预期也被向下调整，2012年为0.5 % ， 明年则为1.4 % 。
en: Ireland is doing better, although its growth forecast has also been revised downward, to just under 0.5% in 2012 and 1.4% next year.

zh: 此外，爱尔兰GNP（其国民收入的增长量，在爱尔兰经营的外国公司收入不再计算内）继续萎缩。
en: Moreover, Irish GNP (the income accruing to its nationals, as distinct from foreign firms operating in Ireland) continues to shrink.

zh: 每一次向下修正都意味着债务/GDP比率高峰期会推迟到来。
en: Each downward revision implies postponement of the date on which the debt/GDP ratio will peak.

zh: 2013年之后，增长要么依赖结构性改革的万灵丹，要么依赖全球经济的复苏。
en: Beyond 2013, growth must depend on either the elixir of structural reforms, or a strong revival of the global economy.

zh: 但经济增长在短期内不太可能复苏。
en: But a revival of economic growth in the short term is unlikely.

zh: 对欧洲来说，关键在于最近几个月世界贸易几乎陷入了停止。
en: Crucially for Europe, world trade has been virtually stagnant in recent months.

zh: 全球贸易和欧元区经济表现似乎在互相拖后腿。
en: Global trade and economic performance in the eurozone appear to be dragging each other down.

zh: 潜在后果相当严重。
en: The potential consequences are serious.

zh: IMF眼中的最可能情景是爱尔兰和葡萄牙债务水平很快就会停止上升，但严重的下行风险��未消除。
en: While the IMF’s primary scenario is that Irish and Portuguese debt levels will soon stop rising, it comes with a chilling litany of downside risks.

zh: 预算赤字和债务目标无法达到的可能性在上升。
en: The likelihood that budget deficit and debt targets will be missed is rising.

zh: 因此，欧元区面临三大选择：重债国进行更多的紧缩、将全欧洲债务社会化，以及创造性的债务重组（这意味着投资者迟早会被迫接受损失 ） 。
en: Thus, the eurozone faces three choices: even more austerity for the heavily-indebted countries, socialization of the debt across Europe, or a creative re-profiling of debt, with investors forced to accept losses sooner or later.

zh: 光靠紧缩一招是不够的。
en: Austerity alone cannot do it.

zh: 一些国家面临越来越大的长期紧缩风险，而长期紧缩将进一步削弱增长，从而维持债务比率的高水平。
en: Some countries face the growing risk of near-perpetual belt-tightening, which would further dampen growth and thus keep debt ratios high.

zh: 毕竟，欲使一国债务/GDP比率在没有紧缩的情况下出现下降，该国对其债务所支付的利率就必须低于GDP增长率。
en: After all, if a country’s debt/GDP ratio is to decline without austerity, the interest rate that it pays on its debt must be lower than its GDP growth rate.

zh: 如果利率高于增长率，则必须实施紧缩；利率比增长率高得越多，所需的紧缩程度就越大。
en: If the interest rate is higher than the growth rate, austerity is required; the wider the gap, the more austerity is needed.

zh: 欧洲也认识到了紧缩的局限性，因此采取了不少欧洲解决方案。
en: Acknowledging the limits of austerity, several initiatives attempt a European resolution.

zh: 专门的欧洲便利机制和IMF一道以低于市场水平的利率提供贷款，这有助于降低所需的紧缩程度。
en: Special European facilities, along with the IMF, lend money at below-market interest rates, which reduces the extent of austerity required.

zh: 但便利机制的资源正在告罄，如果西班牙和意大利也需要寻求支持，其规模将肯定不够。
en: But the facilities’ resources are dwindling, and they certainly would not be sufficient if Spain and Italy were to seek support.

zh: 欧洲央行所宣布的购买主权债券的新计划压低了市场利率。
en: The ECB’s announcement of a new program to purchase sovereign bonds has lowered market interest rates.

zh: 但是，即使市场利率有所降低，许多国家的长期利率仍将高于未来几年的经济增长率。
en: But, even with that decline, many countries’ long-term interest rates will most likely remain higher than their growth rates for the next several years.

zh: 许多欧洲方案都纳入了更有雄心的泛欧洲计划。
en: More ambitious pan-European efforts are embodied in various Eurobond proposals.

zh: 这些机制都暗含了债务社会化 — — 欧洲其他国家的纳税人将共同承担某一国家的债务负担。
en: These schemes imply socialization of debt – taxpayers elsewhere in Europe would share a country’s debt burden.

zh: 这些计划曾经颇为流行，但现在举步维艰。
en: These proposals, once in great vogue, have receded.

zh: 毫不奇怪，此类债务共同化的政治阻力是巨大的。
en: Not surprisingly, the political opposition to such debt mutualization was intense.

zh: 持久紧缩是不可持续的，欧洲友邦援助之力又极为有限，因此，如果不能维持稳健增长，则方案选项会极为有限。
en: Given that perpetual austerity is untenable and others in Europe can only do so much, without robust growth the options will narrow quickly.

zh: 结果，欧洲央行就成了万众瞩目的救星 — — 其行动可以在多长时间内保持金融市场稳定？
en: As a result, much now hangs on the ECB’s actions – and how long they will be sufficient to maintain a truce with financial markets.

zh: 或许葡萄牙争取时间的战略点出了未来的方向。
en: Perhaps the Portuguese time-buying strategy points the way ahead.

zh: 但时间总会耗尽的。
en: But time eventually does run out.

zh: 如果争取时间仍不足以解决问题，最后债权人会被迫接受分担痛苦吗？
en: If buying time is not enough, will there finally be a greater call on bondholders to share the pain?

zh: 即将失去的十年
en: The Looming Lost Decade

zh: 发自普林斯顿 — — 2013年已经临近尾声，看起来全球经济将继续保持低速运转。
en: PRINCETON – As 2013 comes to an end, it looks like the world economy will remain stuck in low gear.

zh: 对于那些预测全球复苏的人来说，第三季度的GDP数据无法提供任何安慰。
en: For those reading the tea leaves of global recovery, the third-quarter GDP numbers offered no solace.

zh: 纵使美国处于领先地位，但它的一些收益可能很快就会消失，因为不断积压的库存开始侵蚀利润。
en: While the United States is ahead of the pack, some of its gains could soon be lost, as accumulating inventories begin eroding profits.

zh: 尽管希望的曙光初现，但欧元区和日本的年度经济增长还在奋力跨越1%的门槛。
en: Despite glimmers of hope, the eurozone and Japan are struggling to cross the 1% threshold for annual economic growth.

zh: 同时，主要新兴经济体都发展缓慢，其中俄罗斯几乎处于停滞状��。
en: And the major emerging economies are all slowing, with Russia practically at a standstill.

zh: 不出意外，如今经济政策的辩论的一个标题就是“长期停滞 ” ， 认为过度的储蓄会长期压抑需求。
en: Not surprisingly, a catchphrase in economic-policy debates nowadays is “secular stagnation,” the idea that excess savings chronically dampen demand.

zh: 经济学家罗伯特·戈登也认为世界缺乏经济上富有创造性的理念。
en: The economist Robert Gordon has also argued that the world is low on economically productive ideas.

zh: 但在绝望之前我们还有工作要做。
en: But before we despair, there is work to be done.

zh: 各国协同下的财政刺激手段在2009年经济危机中拯救了世界，但它也随着政府的注意力转向国内政治以及优先事项而很快消失。
en: The coordinated fiscal stimulus that saved the world from economic collapse in 2009 disappeared too quickly, with governments shifting their focus to domestic politics and priorities.

zh: 如今国内政策选择用尽，经济前景黯淡，必须把注意力重新放在刺激政策之上，并通过对刺激手段时机和内容的全球协同来对其进行扩充。
en: As domestic policy options have been exhausted, economic prospects have dimmed. A renewed emphasis on stimulus must be augmented by global coordination on the timing and content of stimulus measures.

zh: 危机仍然是全球性的。
en: The crisis was and remains global.

zh: 贸易数据告诉我们：在2008年之前那十年，世界贸易以每年7%左右的速度增长，但在2009年其降速却快于全球GDP的降速（也比大萧条时期更剧烈 ） 。
en: Trade data tell the story: after increasing by about 7% annually in the decade before 2008, world trade fell faster than global GDP in 2009 (and more sharply than during the Great Depression).

zh: 一旦短暂刺激推动的复苏消失，世界贸易的增长再次迅速放缓，在过去18个月内跟去年同期相比降到了2 % 。
en: Once the brief stimulus-fueled recovery faded, growth in world trade again slowed quickly, falling to 2% year on year over the past 18 months.

zh: 而出口业绩令人失望的主要原因则是近期经济增长前景减弱。
en: Disappointing export performance is largely responsible for the recent weakening of economic-growth prospects.

zh: 2008年底，当即将到来的经济破坏程度还没显现，国际货币基金组织的首席经济学家奥利维尔·布兰查德大胆呼吁全球性财政刺激方案，他指出在这些“非常时期 ” ， 国际货币基金组织的常用建议 — — 财政紧缩和减少公共债务 — — 是无效的。
en: At the end of 2008, when the scale of the impending economic destruction was not yet apparent, Olivier Blanchard, the International Monetary Fund’s chief economist, boldly called for a global fiscal stimulus, stating that, in these “not normal times,” the IMF’s usual advice – fiscal retrenchment and public-debt reduction – did not apply.

zh: 他警告说，如果国际社会不能走到一起，那将会出现“恶性循环”的通货紧缩，流动性陷阱以及越来越悲观的预期。
en: He warned that if the international community did not come together, “vicious cycles” of deflation, liquidity traps, and increasingly pessimistic expectations could take hold.

zh: 幸运的是，世界各国领导听取了建议，并在2009年的伦敦G20峰会上同意提供总额达5万亿美元的财政刺激。
en: Fortunately, world leaders listened, agreeing in April 2009 at the G-20 Summit in London to provide a total of $5 trillion in fiscal stimulus.

zh: 美国和德国还添加了相当于本国GDP2%的刺激政策。
en: The US and Germany added stimulus amounting to about 2% of GDP.

zh: 中国的银行注入了大量的信贷进入该国经济，使其维持进口需求，这是全球经济复苏的关键。
en: And China’s banks pumped massive amounts of credit into the country’s economy, enabling it to sustain import demand, which was critical to the global recovery.

zh: 但是骄傲情绪迅速滋生，狭隘利益接管了局势。
en: But hubris rapidly set in, and parochial interests took over.

zh: 在伤口完全愈合之前，治疗就被终止了。
en: Before the wounds had fully healed, the treatment was terminated.

zh: 罪魁祸首是美国和德国，为了维护自身的经济霸主地位，它们推卸了保护全球共同利益的责任。
en: The worst offenders were the US and Germany, which shirked the responsibility to protect the global common good that accompanies their status as economic hegemons.

zh: 英国为其财政紧缩所找的勉强理由也好不到哪里去。
en: The United Kingdom, with its contrived rationale for fiscal austerity, was not much better.

zh: 而这三个国家的财政刺激 — — 加上法国和中国贡献的较少力量 — — 本可以使得必需的治疗继续。
en: Fiscal stimulus by these three countries – together with smaller contributions from France and China – could have continued the necessary healing.

zh: 各国如今似乎都认为货币政策措施是它们唯一的选择。
en: Countries now seem to think that monetary-policy measures are their only option.

zh: 但在财政刺激促进国内外经济增长，通过世界贸易相互增强各国国力的时候，货币政策却主要受国内目标引导，在短期内一个国家的收益会是另一个国家的损失。
en: But, whereas fiscal stimulus boosts growth at home and abroad, enabling mutual reinforcement through world trade, monetary policy is guided primarily by domestic goals, and, in the short term, one country’s gain can be another’s loss.

zh: 而货币政策方面最具野心的国家是美国。
en: America leads the world in monetary-policy ambition.

zh: 据研究者芝加哥大学教授吴静和夏凡估计，美联储的无限期资产购买计划（所谓的量化宽松政策或QE）导致美国实际政策利率为-1.6 % 。
en: The researchers Cynthia Wu and Fan Dora Xia estimate that the US Federal Reserve’s open-ended asset purchases (so-called quantitative easing, or QE) have led to an effective US policy rate of -1.6%.

zh: 量化宽松政策通过削弱美元兑其他货币的汇率协助美国出口。
en: QE helped American exports by weakening the dollar relative to other currencies.

zh: 一旦日本启动自己的量化宽松政策之后领导日元迅速贬值，而那使得欧元走强。
en: Once the Japanese engineered their own QE, the yen promptly depreciated. That has kept the euro strong.

zh: “三大”发达经济体中最弱的 — — 欧元区 — — 也因此留下成为了最强的货币。
en: The weakest of the “big three” developed economies – the eurozone – has thus been left with the strongest currency.

zh: 在2013年第三季度德国的出口增长放缓而法国出口下跌。
en: In the third quarter of 2013, Germany’s export growth slowed and French exports fell.

zh: 经过年初的井喷，日本的出口也出现了收缩。
en: After a spike earlier in the year, Japan’s exports have also contracted.

zh: 只有美国的出口在美元的疲软下保持了一定的动力。
en: Only US exports have maintained some traction, thanks to the weaker dollar.

zh: 在20世纪30年代金本位崩溃后，全球领导人不可能再同意一致行动进行全球经济的通货再膨胀。
en: In the 1930’s, after the gold standard broke down, world leaders could not agree on coordinated reflation of the global economy.

zh: 对此经济学家巴里·艾肯格林在他的著作《黄金枷锁》中认为，缺乏协同行动拖累了全球复苏的进程。
en: In his book Golden Fetters, the economist Barry Eichengreen argued that the lack of coordinated action dragged out the global recovery process.

zh: 这样的延误是代价高昂的，并且可能冒上放任事态恶化的风险，进一步延长经济修复过程。
en: Such delays are costly, and risk allowing pathologies to fester, prolonging the healing process further.

zh: 现在，尽管政治环境不利，布兰查德应该进行更大胆的呼吁。
en: Now, despite unfavorable political circumstances, Blanchard should make an even bolder call.

zh: 现在仍是非“正常”的时代 ， “ 恶性循环”依旧存在。
en: These are still not “normal” times, and the “vicious cycles” persist.

zh: 另一项全球财政刺激 — — 集中在基础设施和教育方面 — — 将为强劲复苏提供所需的刺激。
en: Another global fiscal stimulus – focused on public investment in infrastructure and education – would deliver the adrenaline shot needed for a robust recovery.

zh: 祈愿有更多的公共投资。
en: More public investment is twice blessed.

zh: 它可以使世界摆脱混沌；它可以防止“长期停滞 ” 。
en: It can shake the world out of its stupor; and it can safeguard against “secular stagnation.”

zh: 美国，德国，英国，法国以及中国应共同采取行动和提供帮助。
en: The US, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, and China should act together to provide that boost.

zh: 否则，可持续的全球经济复苏可能仍然是难以捉摸的，在这种情况下，2014年将同样会以低增长告终。
en: Otherwise, a sustainable global recovery may remain elusive, in which case 2014 could end in low gear as well.

zh: IMF的伪善陈述
en: The IMF’s False Confession

zh: 普林斯顿 — “ 要不我跪下谢罪？ ”国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁拉加德如此问BBC的安德鲁·马尔（Andrew Marr ） 。
en: PRINCETON – “Do I have to go on my knees?” the International Monetary Fund’s managing director, Christine Lagarde, asked the BBC’s Andrew Marr.

zh: 拉加德在致歉，为IMF对英国近期经济表现预测失准，以及更严重的，为IMF对英国首相卡梅伦的财政紧缩措施的长期批评立场。
en: Lagarde was apologizing for the IMF’s poor forecasting of the United Kingdom’s recent economic performance, and, more seriously, for the Fund’s longer-standing criticism of the fiscal austerity pursued by Prime Minister David Cameron’s government.

zh: 如今，拉加德支持英国的紧缩措施，表示这提升了对英国经济前景的信心，从而刺激了目前的复苏。
en: Now endorsing British austerity, Lagarde said that it had increased confidence in the UK’s economic prospects, thereby spurring the recent recovery.

zh: 拉加德的致歉是前所未有的，是充满勇气的，也是错误的。
en: Lagarde’s apology was unprecedented, courageous, and wrong.

zh: 她的致歉表明IMF向一个学界压倒性支持的经济学原理低了头：信心“仙子”并不存在。
en: By issuing it, the IMF compromised on an economic principle that enjoys overwhelming academic support: The confidence “fairy” does not exist.

zh: 而向英国的压力低头表明IMF丧失了它的真正财富 — — 独立性。
en: And, by bowing to the UK’s pressure, the Fund undermined its only real asset – its independence.

zh: 到目前为止，IMF对其更严重的预测错误闪烁其词，包括未能预测到过去20年中的所有重大危机，从1994—1995年的墨西哥到2008年全球金融体系的几乎崩溃莫不如此。
en: The IMF has dodged responsibility for far more serious forecasting errors, including its failure to anticipate every major crisis of the last generation, from Mexico in 1994-1995 to the near-collapse of the global financial system in 2008.

zh: 事实上，在每一次危机爆发前6—12个月，IMF的预测都表明一切如常。
en: Indeed, in the 6-12 months prior to every crisis, the IMF’s forecasts implied business as usual.

zh: 有人声称IMF私下里对各国进行了预警，但担心公开警告会触发意欲避免的危机。
en: Some claim that the Fund counsels countries in private, lest public warnings trigger the very crisis that is to be avoided.

zh: 但是，IMF长期专职历史学家詹姆斯·波顿（James Boughton）发现，除了1997年的泰国可能是个例外，内部档案中也不存在有过此类警告的证据。
en: But, with the possible exception of Thailand in 1997, the IMF’s long-time resident historian, James Boughton, finds little evidence for that view in internal documents.

zh: IMF内部评估办公室（Internal Evaluation Office）更是在其评估报告中直接批评了IMF对美国次贷危机毫无警觉。
en: The IMF’s Internal Evaluation Office is more directly scathing in its assessment of the Fund’s obliviousness to the US subprime crisis as it emerged.

zh: IMF是全球金融稳定的法定监护人，预警和预防失败的问题远比其对英国紧缩的看法严重得多，前者会导致极大的代价，并且这些代价往往会影响到无数人，特别是最脆弱群体。
en: Given that the IMF is the world’s anointed guardian of financial stability, its failure to warn and preempt constitutes a far more grievous lapse than its position on British austerity, with huge costs borne by many, especially the most vulnerable.

zh: 对于这些失败，IMF从未致歉，至少没有过类似于拉加德最近表态那样的致歉。
en: For these failures, the Fund has never offered any apology, certainly not in the abject manner of Lagarde’s recent statement.

zh: IMF在反思错误方面做得挺好。
en: The Fund does well to reflect on its errors.

zh: 2003年9月，时任总裁科勒（Horst Köhler）在吉隆坡的讲话中承认临时性资本管制可能有助于世界其他地区免受高波动流入的影响。
en: In a September 2003 speech in Kuala Lumpur, then-Managing Director Horst Köhler conceded that temporary capital controls can provide relief against volatile inflows from the rest of the world.

zh: 这番话等于承认了IMF对马来西亚在亚洲危机顶峰时期采取资本管制的批评是错误的。
en: He was presumably acknowledging that the Fund had it wrong when it criticized Malaysia for imposing such controls at the height of the Asian crisis.

zh: 在受危机冲击的国家中，马来西亚没有向IMF求助，最后的结果并不比求助IMF的国家差。
en: Among the countries hurt by that crisis, Malaysia chose not to ask for the Fund’s help and emerged at least as well as others that did seek IMF assistance.

zh: 马来西亚实施资本管制的政策决定颇具争议。
en: Malaysia’s imposition of capital controls was a controversial policy decision.

zh: 而尽管IMF反对，不少著名经济学家 — — 包括克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman ） — —都支持资本管制。
en: And even as the Fund opposed them, prominent economists – among them Paul Krugman – endorsed their use.

zh: 科勒在讲话中说，IMF获得了第一手证据，并将会在未来的建议中予以考虑。
en: In his speech, Köhler reported that the Fund had taken the evidence on board and would incorporate it in its future advice.

zh: 但在最近的危机中，学术证据一边倒地表明财政紧缩带来了经济学教科书上所说的效果：紧缩越严厉，增长受累越大。
en: But in the current crisis, the academic evidence has overwhelmingly shown that fiscal austerity does what textbook economics says it will do: the more severe the austerity, the greater the drag on growth.

zh: 大量研究确认了这一说法，其中就包括IMF首席经济学布兰查德（Oliver Blanchard ） 。 这些研究经得起考验，结论明白无误。
en: A variety of studies confirming this proposition, including one by the IMF’s chief economist, Olivier Blanchard, have withstood considerable scrutiny and leave little room for ambiguity.

zh: 有两家公共机构支持紧缩的魔力，它们都是欧洲的官方机构：经合组织和欧盟委员会。
en: The two public voices arguing for the magical properties of austerity are official agencies based in Europe: the OECD and the European Commission.

zh: 尤其是欧盟委员会，它的立场非常坚定，支持根本没有证据证明的财政观点。
en: The Commission’s stance, in particular, is animated by an institutional commitment to a fiscal viewpoint that leaves no room for evidence.

zh: 在七国集团中，只有意大利在大衰退爆发后的表现比英国更差。
en: Among the G-7 economies, only Italy has done worse than the UK since the Great Recession began.

zh: 事实上，英国GDP才刚刚恢复2008年的水平，表现连法国都比不上。
en: Indeed, the UK’s GDP has only just regained its 2008 level, lagging behind even France.

zh: 考虑到英国的危机相对较为温和，这一点就更加引人注目了。
en: This is all the more remarkable given that the crisis in the UK was comparatively mild.

zh: 英国房地产价格的下跌比起爱尔兰和西班牙相对温和，而由于英国不存在建筑业繁荣，因此也没有建筑业衰败。
en: The fall in property prices was modest relative to Ireland and Spain, and, because there was no construction boom, there was no construction bust.

zh: 英国当局没有注意到诺森洛克（Northern Rock）银行的警示信号 — — 在2007年9月发生储户挤兑后，它需要英国政府的救助 — — 但和欧元区机构相反，它们迅速行动起来处置了英国的受困银行。
en: Having missed the warning signs about the bank Northern Rock, which needed to be bailed out by the UK government after a run on its deposits in September 2007, the British authorities, unlike their eurozone counterparts, quickly dealt with the economy’s distressed banks.

zh: 从这些方面看，英国应该会有迅速的复苏；相反，卡梅伦政府用毫无道理的紧缩扼杀了它。
en: For these reasons, the UK should have had a quick recovery; instead, the Cameron government’s gratuitous austerity stifled it.

zh: IMF的致歉是错误的，原因有二。
en: The IMF’s apology was a mistake for two reasons.

zh: 对学术证据嗤之以鼻永远不是好主意，但对于一个严重依赖技术能力和中立性信誉的机构来说尤其危险。
en: Thumbing one’s nose at scholarly evidence is always a bad idea, but it is especially damaging to an institution that relies so heavily on the credibility of its technical competence and neutrality.

zh: 如果IMF的经济学学得好一点，又怎么会为其政策建议辩护呢？
en: If the Fund embraces muddled economics, on what basis will it defend its policy advice?

zh: 此外，IMF选择奉承英国的错误政策，这确认了IMF为其大股东马首是瞻的本质。
en: Moreover, in choosing to flatter the UK’s misguided policy, the Fund has confirmed its deference to its major shareholders.

zh: 多年来，人们一直认为IMF是美国的外交政策工具。
en: For years, the view has been that the IMF is a foreign-policy instrument of the United States.

zh: 其对英国经济政策的年度评估态度之软弱也是众所周知的。
en: The softness in its annual surveillance of UK economic policy has also been well known.

zh: 但在做出了最新致歉姿态后，IMF再无脸面宣扬“真理的力量”了。
en: But in taking this latest step, the Fund has undermined – perhaps fatally – its ability to speak “truth to power.”

zh: 既然如此，一个根本性问题就变得不可避免：IMF为什么还要存在下去？ 为谁存在下去？
en: If so, a fundamental question may well become unavoidable: Why does the IMF exist, and for whom?

zh: 全球经济的欧洲土拨鼠日
en: The Global Economy’s Groundhog Day

zh: 新德里—在电影《土拨鼠日 》 （ Groundhog Day）中，比尔·穆雷（Bill Murray）扮演的电视天气预报员每天都会在早晨6点起来，过同一个日子。
en: NEW DELHI – In the movie “Groundhog Day,” a television weatherman, played by Bill Murray, awakes every morning at 6:00 to relive the same day.

zh: 自五年前全球经济危机爆发以来，经济预测界也是如此。
en: A similar sense of déjà vu has pervaded economic forecasting since the global economic crisis began a half-decade ago.

zh: 但决策者仍然自信地认为在危机前大行其道的经济增长模式仍是他们的最佳指南，至少在近期是如此。
en: Yet policymakers remain convinced that the economic-growth model that prevailed during the pre-crisis years is still their best guide, at least in the near future.

zh: 以国际货币进组织（IMF ） 《 世界经济展望 》 （ World Economic Outlook）的年中更新为例。 自2011年以来，该报告一直在讲同一个故事 ： “ 哦！
en: Consider the mid-year update of the International Monetary Fund’s World Economic Outlook, which has told the same story every year since 2011: “Oops!

zh: 世界经济没有像我们预期的那样表现。
en: The world economy did not perform as well as we expected.”

zh: ”接着，报告将矛头指向了未预料到的因素 — — 比如日本东北大地震和海啸、美国推出扩张性货币政策的不确定性、风险的“一次性”重新定价、美国天气恶劣，等等 — — 以此为预测失准开脱。
en: The reports go on to blame unanticipated factors – such as the Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami in Japan, uncertainty about America’s exit from expansionary monetary policy, a “one-time” re-pricing of risk, and severe weather in the United States – for the inaccuracies.

zh: 《世界经济展望》强调这些因素的暂时性质，认定尽管世界GDP增长在上半年只有大约3 % ， 但会在下半年加速。
en: Emphasizing the temporary nature of these factors, the reports insist that, though world GDP growth amounted to roughly 3% during the first half of the year, it will pick up in the second half.

zh: 受新动力推动，增长最终会在明年达到久违的4%水平。
en: Driven by this new momentum, growth will finally reach the long-elusive 4% rate next year.

zh: 如果事实并非如此，IMF搬出其他理由重复相同的主张。
en: When it does not, the IMF publishes another rendition of the same claims.

zh: 一系列的误判彰显出有必要做不同的思考。
en: This serial misjudgment highlights the need to think differently.

zh: 也许强调全球金融危机的破坏阻碍了人们关于发达经济体在经历了多年的奔腾增长后出现减速的自然转变的认识。
en: Perhaps the focus on the disruptions caused by the global financial crisis is obscuring a natural shift in developed economies to a lower gear following years of pumped-up growth.

zh: 此外，尽管新兴市场也在经历急剧的增长减速，但它们占全球经济的比重仍在继续上升。
en: Moreover, though emerging economies are also experiencing acute growth slowdowns, their share of the global economic pie will continue to grow.

zh: 简言之，更激烈的经济竞争、更慢的增长和低通胀可能继续存在下去。
en: In short, tougher economic competition, slower growth, and low inflation may be here to stay.

zh: 在美国，去年看上去出现了经济起飞的条件。
en: In the United States, conditions for an economic takeoff ostensibly have been present for the last year.

zh: 家庭债务和失业有所下降；公司利润和现金储备规模巨大；股市对未来相当乐观；银行做好了贷款准备；财政整合也不再制约需求。
en: Household debt and unemployment have fallen; corporate profits and cash reserves are large; the stock market is valuing the future generously; banks are ready to lend; and fiscal consolidation is no longer hampering demand.

zh: 但是，与预期相反，家庭消费数据仍然毫无亮点，企业也没有加大投资。
en: Yet, contrary to expectations, growth in household consumption has remained lackluster, and businesses have not ramped up investment.

zh: 今年前两季度，美国GDP并未超过去年年底的水平，增长的大头是由生产出来但尚未销售出去的商品贡献的。
en: In the first two quarters of this year, America’s GDP barely exceeded the level it attained at the end of last year, and much of the increase was driven by goods that have been produced but not yet sold.

zh: 流行的解释 — — 异常寒冷的冬季 — — 实在过于单薄，所有人都可以一眼看穿破绽。
en: The prevailing explanation – a brutally cold winter – is wearing so thin that everyone should be able to see through it.

zh: 美国消费者仍在舔舐危机留下的伤疤。
en: American consumers remain scarred by the crisis.

zh: 但还有另一个问题：在家里和单位里，对未来的兴奋感正在日益消失，尽管现在各种新奇小玩意唾手可得。
en: But there is another problem: in their homes and workplaces, the sense of excitement about the future is missing, despite all the gee-whiz gadgetry that now surrounds them.

zh: 而尽管美联储的量化宽松政策刺激了企业，也不能作为促进投资的热情和参与的替代品。
en: And while the US Federal Reserve’s policy of quantitative easing has propped up businesses, it is no substitute for the enthusiasm and anticipation needed to propel investment.

zh: 即使是向下修正的GDP增长预测（3.4 % ） ，也极有可能过于乐观了。
en: Even the reduced global forecast of 3.4% GDP growth for this year is likely to prove excessively optimistic.

zh: 危机前，世界贸易以每年6—8%的速度增长，远快于GDP。
en: Before the crisis, world trade grew at 6-8% annually – well faster than GDP.

zh: 但是，到今年目前为止，贸易增长只有3%左右。
en: But, so far this year, trade growth remains stuck at about 3%.

zh: 没有认识到正在发生的根本性减速使人们预期旧模式能够重振增长，而这一观念只能制造新的弱势。
en: Failure to recognize the fundamental slowdown that is occurring is reinforcing the expectation that old models can revive growth – an approach that will only create new fragilities.

zh: 阿提夫·米安（Atif Mian）和阿米尔·苏菲（Amir Sufi）警告说，美国消费者的汽车和其他耐用品消费受不可持续的“次级”借贷行为驱动，而这正是危机前刺激买房行为的因素。
en: Atif Mian and Amir Sufi warn that US consumers’ purchases of cars and other durables have been bolstered by the same unsustainable “subprime” lending practices that were used to finance home purchases before the crisis.

zh: 类似地，英格兰银行行长马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）认为英国的金融部门正在向塞浦路斯靠拢（规模相当于GDP的900 % ） 。
en: Similarly, Mark Carney, Governor of the Bank of England, envisages a Britain with a Cyprus-sized financial sector amounting to 900% of GDP.

zh: 经济学家迈克尔·佩蒂斯（Michael Pettis）警告说，中国每次陷入停滞都依靠政策刺激促使经济重新启动，这将导致宏观经济脆弱性逐渐积累。
en: And economist Michael Pettis cautions that China’s reliance on policy stimulus to kick-start the economy whenever it stalls will merely cause macroeconomic vulnerabilities to accumulate.

zh: 全球经济的两大构造变迁 — — GDP增长放缓和新兴市场竞争加剧 — — 形成了一条贯穿欧洲的断层线。
en: The two tectonic shifts in the global economy – slower GDP growth and increased emerging-market competition – have created a fault line that runs through Europe.

zh: 欧洲传统贸易经济所保持的技术优势正在消失，而工资竞争助长了通缩恐慌。
en: The technical lead held by Europe’s traditional trading economies is being eroded, while wage competition is encouraging fears of deflation.

zh: 此外，欧元区债务最重的经济体承受了这些变迁的主要影响，意大利更是首当其冲。
en: And, with the eurozone’s most debt-burdened economies bearing the brunt of these shifts, Italy is sitting directly atop the fault.

zh: 但是，欧洲央行无法凭一己之力重振欧元区增长。
en: The European Central Bank, however, is unable to revive eurozone growth on its own.

zh: 在全球经济（尤其是世界贸易）因此受到拖累的情况下，欧元的协调贬值符合全世界利益。
en: Given the resulting drag on the global economy – and especially on world trade – it is in the world’s interest to engineer a coordinated depreciation of the euro.

zh: 与此同时，需要全球协调的投资刺激创造新的增长机会。
en: At the same time, a globally coordinated investment stimulus is needed to create new opportunities for growth.

zh: 就像比尔·穆雷扮演的角色只有彻底改变生活才能摆脱土拨鼠日，我们也无法在不从根本上改变增长模式的情况下指望出现不同的经济结果。
en: Just as Bill Murray’s character could not escape Groundhog Day without radically changing his life, we cannot expect different economic outcomes without fundamentally different growth models.

zh: 不断加深的欧洲乱局
en: Europe’s Deepening Muddle

zh: 发自普林斯顿 — — 德国财政部长沃尔夫冈·朔伊布勒（Wolfgang Schäuble）最近宣称，欧盟已经“将主权转移到了欧洲层面 ” — —考虑到欧洲各国政府如今似乎比二战后任何时期都更偏重本国利益，部长的口气似乎有点太大了一点。
en: PRINCETON – German Finance Minister Wolfgang Schäuble recently declared that the European Union has “moved sovereignty to the European level” – a startling claim, given that European governments seem to be pursuing their national interests more aggressively than at any time since World War II.

zh: 朔伊布勒的声明应该作为号召欧洲更广泛融合的一个口号，还只是转移外界 — — 要求德国对欧元区经济复苏作出更大贡献 — — 呼声的伎俩？
en: Was Schäuble’s statement supposed to serve as a rallying cry for greater European solidarity? Or was it just a ploy to deflect calls for a larger German contribution to the eurozone’s recovery?

zh: 德国试图统领欧洲却不愿为此付费，而朔伊布勒正是其代表。
en: Schäuble is at the forefront of Germany’s efforts to lead Europe without having to pay its bills.

zh: 为了实现这一目的，他呼吁修改欧盟条约去建立一个欧洲“预算专员 ” ， 授予其动用共享的欧洲基金，并在成员国不遵守已有规则时否决其财政策略的权力。
en: To this end, he has called for EU treaty changes to establish a European “budget commissioner” with authority to spend shared European funds and reject member countries’ fiscal strategies when they do not comply with established rules.

zh: 朔伊布勒认为，关于此项改革的谈判应在5月欧洲议会选举结束后立即开始。
en: According to Schäuble, negotiations for such reforms should begin immediately after the European Parliament election in May.

zh: 朔伊布勒的策略可能听起来很吸引人，但充其量也是只一个伪装进步的象征性包装而已。
en: While Schäuble’s strategy may sound appealing, it is, at best, the symbolic garb of progress.

zh: 首先，共同基金相当微薄，并且没有增加的可能 — — 尤其是在德国的无情反对之下。
en: For starters, the common funds are meager, with no prospect of being increased – not least because of Germany’s unrelenting opposition.

zh: 同样，只要各成员国依然保有财政主权，一个便于对各国违反欧洲预算规则行为指手画脚的新机制将不会带来任何改变。
en: Likewise, so long as member countries maintain fiscal sovereignty, a new mechanism to facilitate finger-wagging at countries that defy European budget rules will change nothing.

zh: 正如过去二十年里，由于缺乏强制权力，一切用于管制欧盟财政违规行为的努力都失败了。
en: Over the last two decades, every effort to discipline the EU’s fiscal delinquents has failed, owing to the lack of enforcement authority.

zh: 当然，当一个国家走投无路时，它会与欧盟合作以获取救助资金。
en: Of course, when a country has run out of options, it will play along to gain access to official bailout funds.

zh: 但希腊的经验表明这并不总如计划般有效。
en: But, as Greece’s experience has demonstrated, this does not always work out as planned.

zh: 事实上，希腊的救助 — — 由欧盟和国际货币基金共同资助 — — 是灾难的开始，因为它推迟了一个迫在眉睫的债务重组及所需的严格紧缩。
en: Indeed, the Greek bailout – jointly funded by the EU and the International Monetary Fund – began disastrously as it delayed a much-needed debt-restructuring and demanded strict austerity.

zh: 结果是，极端政治势力的影响越来越大，同时公共卫生悲剧正在酝酿之中。
en: As a result, the influence of extremist political forces has grown, and a public-health tragedy is brewing.

zh: 然而，朔伊布勒似乎是为了无休止的追求更多的紧缩政策，而将希腊视为比乌克兰更倒霉的���型。
en: Yet Schäuble, in a seemingly interminable quest for more austerity, views Greece as a model for an even more hapless Ukraine.

zh: 欧洲现在一团糟。
en: Europe is in a muddle.

zh: 由于基本不可能进行债务重组，又缺乏一个足够规模且政治上认可的中央预算来缓解国家危机，欧洲人于是将德国选为他们假想的霸主。
en: With debt restructuring essentially ruled out and without a sizeable, politically-sanctioned central budget to relieve countries in distress, Europeans have anointed Germany as their presumptive hegemon.

zh: 德国对这个角色津津乐道，但却无法参与其中。
en: Germany relishes that role, but is not able to play the part.

zh: 简单来说，德国并不愿意花费纳税人的钱来支撑欧洲。
en: Simply put, Germany is unwilling to spend its taxpayers’ euros to bolster Europe.

zh: 此时德国经济的强大也仅仅是比记忆中的多那么一点而已。
en: The robust German economy is little more than a memory at this point.

zh: 2010年和2011年，由于中国经济的蓬勃发展仍然对德国机械和汽车保持着高需求，德国年均GDP增长超过3 % ； 但当中国GDP增长放缓，德国年增长率也随之下降到低于1 % 。
en: Annual GDP grew by more than 3% in 2010 and 2011, because a still-booming Chinese economy was sustaining high demand for German machines and cars; but, as China’s GDP growth has slowed, so has Germany’s, to an annual rate of less than 1%.

zh: 这可能会略有提高，但德国人口老龄化意味着其经济将长期保持较低的增长潜力。
en: This is likely to improve slightly, but Germany’s aging population means that its economy faces low potential growth in the long term.

zh: 由于德国缺乏支持欧洲经济的经济实力，其领导人也一直不愿冒政治风险。
en: With Germany lacking the economic dynamism to support Europe financially, its leaders have been unwilling to take political risks.

zh: 该国的两个主要政党 — — 基督教民主党和社会民主党 — — 在最终令两者组建执政联盟的2013年9月选举中都回避了关于欧洲的公开对话。
en: The country’s two major political parties – the Christian Democrats and the Social Democrats – sidestepped a public dialogue on Europe in the September 2013 election that produced their governing coalition.

zh: 更能说明问题的是，朔伊布勒为欧洲中央银行“直接货币交易”计划（这将允许欧洲央行无限量购买较弱欧元区国家的政府债券）的辩护。
en: More revealing is Schäuble’s defense of the European Central Bank’s “outright monetary transactions” scheme (which would permit the ECB to purchase unlimited amounts of weaker eurozone countries’ government bonds).

zh: 即使德国央行对 “直接货币交易”计划更多关注各国偿付能力，而非流动性风险 — — 从而可以建立一个秘密的财政联盟 — — 表示强烈（也是正确地）反对，但令政府欣慰的是，负责评估方案合法性的德国宪法法院最终把责任推给了欧洲法院。
en: Even as Germany’s Bundesbank fiercely (and rightly) opposed the OMT program for its focus on countries’ solvency, rather than liquidity risk – thus creating a backdoor fiscal union – the government was relieved that the German Constitutional Court, assessing the scheme’s legality, ultimately passed the buck to the European Court of Justice.

zh: 毕竟，建立一个真正的财政联盟需要强有力的政治承诺 — — 以及大量的调研工作。
en: After all, establishing a genuine fiscal union would require strong political commitment – and considerable legwork.

zh: 欧盟是一个振奋人心的，试图打破19世纪民族国家模式的政治架构。
en: The EU is an inspiring political structure that seeks to break the mold of the nineteenth-century nation-state.

zh: 但实现这一理想主义境界的进步不能持续依靠陈旧的象征符号。
en: But progress toward that idealistic vision cannot continue to depend on shopworn symbolism.

zh: 而欧元是那些符号当中最为鲁莽贸然的一个 — — 一个经济价值含糊不清，而且一直以来不断暴露其脆弱性的建构。
en: The euro was the most audacious of those symbols – a construct of dubious economic value, with well-documented fragilities.

zh: 其实施就是一个经济狂妄自大，施加成本远超出欧洲边界的表现。
en: Its adoption was an act of economic hubris that has imposed costs well beyond Europe’s borders.

zh: 今天，欧洲领导人沉溺于胜利，以当前经济的暂时安定作为自身失败跨国治理架构的表彰。
en: Today, European leaders are indulging in triumphalism, viewing the current economic reprieve as a validation of failed transnational governance structures.

zh: 但深刻而持续的危机暴露了欧元基础的脆弱性，并应引起警惕，当前技术层面的权宜之计也许不能抵御另一场冲击。
en: But the depth and persistence of the ongoing crisis have exposed the euro’s fundamental fragilities, and should serve as a warning that today’s technocratic Band-Aids may not hold in the face of another shock.

zh: 不幸的是，以大胆的行动来应对这些脆弱性似乎前所未有的遥远。
en: Unfortunately, bold action to address these fragilities seems more distant than ever.

zh: 放弃某些国家预算控制来实现财政一体化在政治上似乎是不可能的，而讨论修改条约 — — 即使它来自德国财政部长 — — 不过是些空洞的修辞包装而已。
en: Relinquishing some control over national budgets to achieve fiscal integration appears politically impossible, and talk of treaty changes – even if it comes from the German finance minister – amounts to little more than empty rhetorical finery.

zh: 采用欧元是一个错误。
en: Adopting the euro was a mistake.

zh: 但是损害已经造成，突然放弃共同货币只会使情况变得更糟糕。
en: But the damage is done, and precipitously abandoning the common currency would only make a bad situation worse.

zh: 由于国家不愿放弃主权，欧洲唯一的选择就是卸下集中协调的幌子，让各国和银行去应付和接受债权人的惩罚。
en: With countries unwilling to cede sovereignty, Europe’s only option is to dump the pretense of centralized coordination, leaving countries and banks to deal with – and be disciplined by – their creditors.

zh: 退回到这个更稳定的政策安排可能就是唯一的出路。
en: A step back to this more stable arrangement may offer the only way forward.

zh: 阿富汗战争后的亚洲
en: Asia After the Afghan War

zh: 发自东京 — — 美国与亚洲之间偶尔纠结的关系将在今年7月迎来两个里程碑。
en: TOKYO – July will mark two milestones in America’s sometimes-tortured relations with Asia.

zh: 首先，随着奥巴马总统宣布3万名驻阿富汗美军将在明年夏天以前陆续撤出，持续近十年之久的阿富汗战争 — — 也是美国历史上历时最长的一场战争 — — 终于迎来了落幕的时刻。
en: One is the beginning of the end of the nearly decade-long struggle in Afghanistan – the longest war in United States history – with President Barack Obama announcing the withdrawal of 30,000 US troops from the country by next summer.

zh: 其次，亨利·基辛格秘密访华40周年纪念也即将到来，当年基辛格的访问成为了冷战的一个转折点，也是中国迈向现代化的第一步 — — 同时也让整个亚洲，尤其是是日本，大为震惊。
en: The other is the 40th anniversary of Henry Kissinger’s secret mission to Beijing, a turning point in the Cold War and the first step on China’s road to modernization – but at the time a huge shock to Asia, particularly Japan.

zh: 至少对某些亚洲人来说，美国从阿富汗撤军的情形会令他们回想起另一件更为痛苦的往事：1975年4月，美国从西贡仓促逃离。
en: The looming Afghan withdrawal recalls, at least for some Asians, a third, even more traumatic event: America’s chaotic exit from Saigon in April 1975.

zh: 当时美国国民已经厌倦了战事，渴望重投孤立主义以寻找一丝安慰，因此美国在越南的溃败似乎意味着其将大规模收缩部署在亚洲的军队规模。
en: Back then, that debacle seemed to presage a broader US withdrawal from Asia, with a war-weary American public seeking the supposed comforts of isolationism.

zh: 如今孤立主义在美国国内再次抬头，阿富汗的稳定仍然堪忧，而在缺乏发亚洲共识或制度框架的情况下，中国却正如日东升，这一切都让亚洲坐立不安。
en: Today’s Asian nervousness exists not only because isolationism appears to be gaining ground once more in America, but also because Afghanistan’s stability remains in doubt, while China’s power is rising in the absence of any pan-Asian consensus or institutional structure.

zh: 事实上败走西贡后美国确实转向保守，而在1989年苏联撤出阿富汗后，美国人对这个国家的漠视则导致阿国内部陷入混乱，几乎让基地组织夺取了整个政权。
en: America did, indeed, turn inward following the fall of Saigon, and its neglect of Afghanistan following the Soviet withdrawal in 1989 led to chaos and Al Qaeda’s near-takeover of the country.

zh: 可见许多亚洲领导人对美国在撤军后继续对阿富汗承担什么样的责任表示怀疑就不足为奇了。
en: So it is not surprising that many Asian leaders are asking themselves what commitments the US will maintain once its troops leave Afghanistan.

zh: 而同样重要的是，许多亚洲人都在争论：在美国人收缩其军事存在后的亚洲是否还能重新实现战略均衡。
en: Perhaps equally important, many people in Asia are also debating whether the region would be able to rebalance itself should the US scale back its military presence.

zh: 幸运的是，美国国防部长罗伯特·盖茨已经向其亚洲友好国家和盟国做出保证：美国不会撤出该区域。
en: Fortunately, US Secretary of Defense Robert Gates has reassured America’s Asian friends and allies that regional disengagement is not being contemplated.

zh: 近日在新加坡举行的香格里拉对话会中 — — 中国国防部长梁光烈上将也有出席 — — 盖茨列出了他关于美国与亚洲的继续合作纲要。
en: At the recent Shangri La Dialogue in Singapore – indeed, in the presence of Chinese Minister of Defense General Liang Guanglie – Gates outlined his ideas for continuing US cooperation in and with Asia.

zh: 盖茨承诺，按照美国与新加坡战略框架协议的要求增加在新加坡的军力部署；增加美国海军在亚洲各港口的访问次数；举行更多的海军联合演习；同时促进多边军事合作。
en: Gates promised to increase the number of US warships deployed to Singapore as part of the US-Singapore Strategic Framework Agreement; increase the number of US Navy calls in Asian ports; hold more joint naval exercises; and improve multilateral military cooperation.

zh: 此外，盖茨还强调了美国未来亚洲战略的主要原则：自由开放的贸易；对法治以及亚洲各国权利，责任和主权的支持；亚洲和全球公海、领空和互联网的开放；各类冲突的和平解决。
en: Even more reassuring were the principles that will, according to Gates, guide America’s future Asian strategy: free and open commerce; support for the rule of law and the rights, responsibilities, and sovereignty of Asia’s states; open access to Asian and global sea lanes, airspace, and cyberspace; and peaceful resolution of all conflicts.

zh: 这些原则十分重要，因为澳洲、日本、韩国、泰国、菲律宾、印度、印尼、新加坡、马来西亚、新西兰，越南甚至是蒙古都把美国在亚洲的驻军作为制衡中国崛起的必要因素。
en: These principles matter, because Australia, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, the Philippines, India, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, New Zealand, Vietnam, and even Mongolia all regard America’s military presence in the region as essential to counterbalancing China’s increasing might.

zh: 但很不幸的是，盖茨很快就要离职了，鉴于奥巴马政府明显缺乏清晰的亚洲战略，因此盖茨的保证似乎也将命不久矣。
en: Gates, however, is due to step down from his post shortly, which is unfortunate, because the Obama administration’s apparent lack of any explicit Asia strategy means that Gates’s reassurances might not reassure for very long.

zh: 当今的美国亚洲政策需要有40年前指导基辛格与毛泽东和周恩来谈判的那种战略远景和洞察。
en: Nowadays, US policy on Asia needs the type of strategic vision and insight that guided Kissinger’s discussions with Mao Zedong and Zhou En-lai four decades ago.

zh: 但考虑到美国当前的经济困境，财政紧缩以及其他一些海外承诺，如果美国人不能拿出一份清晰且具有说服力的指导原则，那么亚洲的领导人们仍然会对美国维持亚洲军事主导地位的能力半信半疑。
en: Without a clear and convincing doctrine, at least some Asian leaders are likely to remain dubious of America’s ability to remain Asia’s dominant military force, particularly given its economic woes, projected fiscal retrenchment, and other overseas commitments.

zh: 同时如果中国领导人也因为这种战略清晰性的缺失而低估美国对亚洲承诺的长期效力，那么问题就更加严重了。
en: This lack of clarity may become particularly troublesome should China’s leaders underestimate the enduring quality of America’s Asian commitments.

zh: 当然，亚洲各国维持一个和平的结构不仅仅是美国的责任。
en: Securing a structure of peace in Asia, however, is not solely America’s responsibility.

zh: 美国的友好国家和盟国需要认真反思自己究竟想要形成一种什么样的区域秩序，并且必须同心协力为一个实现亚洲繁荣和安全的和平架构注入生命力。
en: America’s friends and allies need to think hard about what sort of regional order they want, and they must begin to collaborate in order to breathe life into a structure of peace within which all of Asia can prosper and feel secure.

zh: 日本尤其要制定一个具有连续性的亚洲战略并坚定贯彻执行，而不能在中美之间朝秦暮楚。
en: Japan’s government in particular needs to identify a coherent Asia strategy and stick to it, instead of leaning towards China one minute, and America the next.

zh: 此外在构建一个切实可行的战略时，日本必须优先考虑深化与诸如印度、印尼和韩国等亚洲民主国家的盟友关系。
en: In constructing a viable strategy, deepening Japan’s partnerships with Asia’s great democracies – India, Indonesia, and South Korea – must be a priority.

zh: 但最终重大的问题还是中国在亚洲统一秩序共识中的位置，以及中国是否愿意与其邻国和美国合作构建这样一种秩序。
en: But the biggest question concerns China’s place in a consensual Asian order, and its willingness to collaborate with its neighbors, as well as with the US, in creating it.

zh: 考虑到中国秘密提升军事力量的行为，以及其领导人在与印度，日本，菲律宾和越南的领土争端中日趋强硬的态度，我们就可以理解亚洲许多国家心中对中国真正意图的担忧并不是空穴来风。
en: The doubts that many Asians now hold about China’s intentions are well grounded, given the secretive nature of China’s military build-up, and its leaders’ increasingly aggressive tone in territorial disputes with India, Japan, the Philippines, and Vietnam.

zh: 此外，尽管朝鲜一再破坏区域和平，但中国对这个流氓政权却给于无条件支持，这也是导致其他国家对中国是否认真对待其邻国的国家安全有所保留的重要原因。
en: China’s unconditional support for North Korea’s wayward regime, despite its repeated crimes against peace, is also a cause for concern about whether China will treat its neighbors’ security concerns with respect.

zh: 今日的亚太地区已经成为了全球经济的焦点。
en: Today’s Asia-Pacific region has now become the focus of the global economy.

zh: 据世界银行报告，在今后十年里，世界五大经济体中有三个将在自亚洲（中国，日本和印度 ） 。
en: According to the World Bank, three of the top five economic powers (China, Japan, and India) will be Asian powers within this decade.

zh: 而正是美国在该区域的军事存在为该区域带来了稳定和清晰的预期，为亚洲带来了经济繁荣，最终促成了上述格局。
en: The boom that has brought this shift occurred because America’s military presence in the region provided stability and predictability.

zh: 因此美国的阿富汗撤军行动一定不能影响到这一稳定的存续。
en: America’s withdrawal from Afghanistan must not be allowed to call this stability into question.

zh: 随着美国开始撤军，阿富汗的后续发展将成为一块试金石，检验亚洲各国齐心协力构建区域安全秩序的意愿。
en: What happens in Afghanistan as America begins to draw down its troops will test the willingness of all of Asia’s powers to work together to build a secure regional order.

zh: 阿富汗国内稳定是亚洲各国共同的长远利益所在，毕竟没有任何一个国家 — — 包括中国 — — 希望看到该国再度沦为恐怖主义的避难所。
en: In Afghanistan, their long-term interests are essentially in harmony, as none – including China – wants to see Afghanistan become a haven for terrorism once again.

zh: 而只有关于阿富汗未来去向的坚定共识才能扭转该国新一轮政权抢夺的乱象。
en: But only a strong regional consensus on Afghanistan’s future can avert the prospect of a renewed struggle for mastery there.

zh: 一旦亚洲各国达成了这样的共识，那么，共同构建基于共识而非军事实力的泛亚洲秩序就有了基础。
en: If such a consensus can be forged, however, it will provide a foundation for further collaboration in building a pan-Asian order based on consent, not military might.

zh: 特朗普后的亚洲
en: Asia After Trump

zh: 新加坡—三方委员会（Trilateral Commission，一个由政治和商界领袖、记者和学者）最近召开了会议，许多人表示担心美国在亚洲领导力的衰落。
en: SINGAPORE – When the Trilateral Commission – a group of political and business leaders, journalists, and academics – met here recently, many expressed concern about the decline of American leadership in Asia.

zh: 目前各亚洲国家与中国的贸易额高于美国，且常常高出一倍以上。
en: Every Asian country now trades more with China than with the United States, often by a margin of two to one.

zh: 这一担忧因为特朗普总统最近的关税政策以及蔑视多边机构的言辞而愈加浓烈。
en: That concern has been exacerbated by President Donald Trump’s recent imposition of tariffs and expressions of contempt for multilateral institutions.

zh: 在新加坡，人们经常可以听到一个问题：美国的亚洲领导力能活到特朗普下台吗？
en: A frequently heard question in Singapore: Will US leadership in Asia survive the Trump years?

zh: 历史可以提供一些角度。
en: History provides some perspective.

zh: 1972年，尼克松总统在没有发出警告的情况下，单方面对美国盟友征收关税，违反了国际货币基金组织（IMF）框架，还发动了不受支持的越南战争。
en: In 1972, President Richard Nixon unilaterally imposed tariffs on America’s allies without warning, violated the framework of the International Monetary Fund, and pursued an unpopular war in Vietnam.

zh: 恐怖主义恐慌蔓延，专家们纷纷担心起民主的未来。
en: Fear of terrorism was widespread, and experts expressed concern about the future of democracy.

zh: 第二年，大卫·洛克菲勒（David Rockefeller）和兹比格纽·布热津斯基（Zbigniew Brzezinski）建立了三方委员会，每年一次开会讨论这一问题。
en: The following year, David Rockefeller and Zbigniew Brzezinski created the Trilateral Commission, which meets once a year to discuss such problems.

zh: 与阴谋论的内容相反，这个委员会没有什么权力；但和其他非正式的“蹊径”外交渠道一样，它使私人公民（private citizens）能够探索管理棘手问题的方法。
en: Contrary to conspiracy theories, the Commission has little power; but, like other informal channels of “track two” diplomacy, it allows private citizens to explore ways to manage thorny issues.

zh: 成果可见于它的出版物和它的网站。
en: The results can be found in its publications and on its website.

zh: 在新加坡，对于特朗普后的亚洲没有产生共识。
en: In Singapore, there was no consensus about Asia after Trump.

zh: 比如，印度和中国成员对于中国“一带一路”基础设施项目的作用持有不同观点。
en: For example, Indian and Chinese members held different positions about the role of China’s “Belt and Road” infrastructure projects.

zh: 一些亚洲人和美国人对成功解决朝鲜核危机，以及中美开战是否不可避免这一更大的问题意见相左。
en: Some Asians and Americans differed over the prospects for a successful resolution of the Korean nuclear crisis, as well as the larger question of whether a China-US war is inevitable.

zh: 一些欧洲人不清楚当前的全球不确定性是拜中国崛起还是特朗普上台所赐。
en: And some Europeans wondered whether the current global uncertainty reflects the rise of China or the rise of Trump.

zh: 我自己的猜测是 — — 我在会上警告我很有可能是错的 — — 美国能够在特朗普下台后恢复期领导力，如果它能够重温与他人一起运用实力和用实力凌驾于他人的教训的话。
en: My own guess, which I warned the group might be wrong, is that the US can recover its leadership after the Trump years if it relearns the lessons of using power with others as well as over others.

zh: 换句话说，美国需要运用其软实力建立网络和机构，实现与中国、印度、日本、欧洲和其他国家合作应对跨国问题 — — 如货币稳定、气候变化、恐怖主义和网络犯罪，这些问题没有一个国家可以单方面解决。
en: In other words, the US will have to use its soft power to create networks and institutions that will allow it to cooperate with China, India, Japan, Europe, and others to deal with transnational problems – for example, monetary stability, climate change, terrorism, and cyber-crime – that no country can solve unilaterally.

zh: 这需要克服伴随特朗普上台出现的单边政策和态度。
en: That will require overcoming the unilateral policies and attitudes associated with the rise of Trump.

zh: 对中国崛起问题，与当前的悲观论调相反，美国将保持重要的实力优势，即使特朗普连任，这一优势也回比他的八年任期持续得更久。
en: As for the rise of China, contrary to current pessimism, the US will retain important power advantages that will last longer than even an eight-year presidency, should Trump be reelected. The first is demography.

zh: 据联合国数据，美国是唯一一个2050年还能为全球人口贡献增量的发达国家。
en: According to United Nations data, the US is the only developed country expected to contribute to global population growth by 2050.

zh: 今天人口最多的国家中国预计将把这一宝座让给印度。
en: China, the most populous country now, is projected to lose the top spot to India.

zh: 第二个优势是能源。
en: The second advantage is energy.

zh: 十年前，美国对进口能源的依赖让人看不到希望。
en: A decade ago, the US seemed hopelessly dependent on imported energy.

zh: 如今，页岩革命将美国从能源进口国变为能源出口国，北美有望在未来十年中实现自给，而中国越来越依赖进口能源。
en: Now the shale revolution has transformed it from an energy importer to an exporter, and North America may be self-sufficient in the coming decade at the same time that China is becoming more dependent on energy imports.

zh: 科技是美国的第三大优势。
en: Technology is a third advantage for the US.

zh: 彰显本世纪实力的科技有生物技术、纳米技术和下一代信息技术（如人工智能和大数据 ） 。
en: Among the technologies that will convey power in this century are biotechnology, nanotechnology, and the next generation of information technology, such as artificial intelligence and big data.

zh: 大部分专家认为，尽管中国的实力在增强，但美国仍是这些技术的研究、开发和商业化的全球领导者。
en: According to most experts, while China’s capacity is improving, the US remains the world leader in research, development, and commercialization of these technologies.

zh: 此外，美国的第四个优势在研究基础上，即它的高等教育体系。
en: Moreover, in terms of the research base, America has a fourth advantage in its system of higher education.

zh: 据上海交通大学排名，世界大学前二十强美国占了十六席，没有一所来自中国。
en: According to a ranking by Shanghai Jiao Tong University, of the top 20 universities in the world, 16 are in the US, while none are in China.

zh: 美国有望延续到特朗普时代后的第五个优势是美元的角色。
en: A fifth American advantage that is likely to outlast the Trump era is the role of the dollar.

zh: 在世界各国政府所持有的外国储备中，只有1.1%是人民币，而有64%是美元。
en: Of the foreign reserves held by the world’s governments, just 1.1% are in renminbi, compared with 64% for the dollar.

zh: IMF将人民币纳入决定其账户单位特别提款权（SDR）价值的货币篮子，折让许多人认为美元的日子已经进入了倒数。
en: When the International Monetary Fund included the renminbi in the currency basket underpinning its unit of account, Special Drawing Rights, many believed the dollar’s days were numbered.

zh: 但人民币在国际支付中所占比重此后有所下滑。
en: But the renminbi’s share of international payments has slipped since then.

zh: 可信的储备货币要依赖有深度的资本市场、诚实的政府以及法治。
en: A credible reserve currency depends on deep capital markets, honest government, and the rule of law.

zh: 所有这些中国在近期未来都不具备。
en: None is likely in China in the near future.

zh: 第六，美国拥有中国所不具备的地理优势。
en: Sixth, the US has geographical advantages that China lacks.

zh: 美国被海洋环绕，尽管特朗普采取了错误的破坏北美自由贸易协定的政策，但美国与加拿大和墨西哥的关系仍然友好。
en: The US is surrounded by oceans, and Canada and Mexico remain friendly, despite Trump’s mistaken policy of undercutting the North American Free Trade Agreement.

zh: 另一方面，中国与14国相邻，并与其中一些最重要的邻国有领土纠纷，如印度、日本和越南。
en: China, on the other hand, has borders with 14 countries and territorial disputes with some of the most important, such as India, Japan, and Vietnam.

zh: 这限制了中国的软实力。
en: This limits China’s soft power.

zh: 尽管地理给了中国基于陆地、辐射南海的实力，但美国在南海没有领土主张，并在其余95%的世界海洋地带拥有海上支配权。
en: And while geography gives China land-based power projection over the South China Sea, the US has no territorial claims there and enjoys naval supremacy over the remaining 95% of the world’s oceans.

zh: 但最重要的是，美国和中国并非注定要开战。
en: But, most important, the US and China are not destined for war.

zh: 双方对对方都不构成生存威胁。
en: Neither poses an existential threat to the other.

zh: 一战爆发时，德国已经在1900年超越了英国，而英国人对德国人图谋的担忧引发了大战。
en: When World War I began, Germany had surpassed Britain in 1900, and British fear of German intentions contributed to the disaster.

zh: 相反，美国和中国有时间管理好彼此之间的诸多冲突，未必会陷入疯狂或恐惧。
en: By contrast, the US and China have time to manage their many conflicts and need not succumb to hysteria or fear.

zh: 美国不但拥有上述实力优势，还与日本和韩国是盟国。
en: The US retains not only the power advantages described above, but also its alliances with Japan and South Korea.

zh: 不论未来和朝鲜领导人金正恩展开如何对话，特朗普都必须谨防金氏政权削弱这些联盟关系的长期目标。
en: In any upcoming talks with North Korea’s leader, Kim Jong-un, Trump will have to take care to prevent the Kim regime from achieving its long-standing objective of weakening those alliances.

zh: 在新加坡，我引用了李光耀对我曾经问他的问题的回答。 我问他中国能否超过美国。
en: In Singapore, I quoted Lee Kuan Yew’s response to a question I once asked him about whether China would surpass the US.

zh: 他说“不能 ” ， 因为中国尽管有14亿人才可资利用，但美国的开放使它能够利用和联合75亿人的才华，比中国的创造力更强。
en: He said “no,” because while China had the talents of 1.4 billion people to draw upon, the openness of the US allowed it to tap and combine the talents of 7.5 billion people with greater creativity than China could.

zh: 只要这一开放性能保持，美国在亚洲以及其他地区的领导力也很有希望保持。
en: If that openness survives, American leadership in Asia, and elsewhere, will most likely survive as well.

zh: 东亚的新年决心
en: East Asia’s New Year Resolutions

zh: 首尔—如果第三次世界大战爆发，那么起源不会是中东、南亚和东欧，而会在东亚 — — 中国、美国以及它们的盟友的利益交汇点，这里是地缘政治重要性、外交紧张程度和全球爆发潜力最高的地区。
en: SEOUL – If World War III ever breaks out, its origins will not lie in the Middle East, South Asia, or Eastern Europe. It is in East Asia – where the strategic interests of China, the United States, and their respective partners intersect – that the geopolitical stakes, diplomatic tensions, and potential for a global explosion are highest.

zh: 显然，避免彻底冲突符合所有行动方的利益，因此我们看到了中国国家主席习近平与日本首相安倍晋三上个月在北京貌合神离地握了手。
en: Because it is so obviously in every player’s interest to avoid outright conflict, we have stony handshakes like that between Chinese President Xi Jinping and Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe in Beijing last month.

zh: 但如果真的要实现持久和平，该地区领导人就需要更努力、更大胆地实现这一目标。
en: But if there is to be a genuinely durable peace, the region’s leaders need to work harder and more courageously to achieve it.

zh: 他们都可以追求局面改变措施，但这要求他们拥有必要的政治家风度。
en: Each of them could pursue game-changing initiatives if only they could summon the necessary statesmanship.

zh: 因此，我带着最高的乐观情绪 — — 这未必是完全天真的愿望 — — 希望所有东亚领导人都能拿出2015年的新年决心。
en: So, here – in a spirit of supreme, but perhaps not totally naive, optimism – are the 2015 New Year’s resolutions that I would most like each of East Asia’s leaders to make.

zh: 习近平 ： “ 我将澄清，我们在南海的一切领土要求都只基于合理的特殊地貌主权主张及其根据《海洋法公约》所附带的权利。
en: Xi Jinping: “I will make it clear that any territorial claims we have in the South China Sea are based only on reasonable assertions of sovereignty over particular land features and the rights that accompany them under the Convention on the Law of the Sea.

zh: 我将停止谈论我们的‘历史领海 ’ ， 并将‘九段线’从中国护照地图上删除。
en: I will stop talking about our ‘historical waters,’ and order the removal of the ‘nine-dashed’ line from the map in Chinese passports.

zh: “我将澄清我们对香港的权力，寻找让香港人民拥有他们想要的地方领导人的办法。
en: “Having made our authority in Hong Kong clear, I will find a way to let the people there have the local leader they want.

zh: 在这方面给予一些灵活度也将有利于让焦虑的台湾感到中国真的可以协调差异。
en: A little flexibility here should also be a helpful message to those getting restless in Taiwan that China really can accommodate difference.

zh: “基于同样的精神，我还将欢迎达赖喇嘛来北京，与他的领导团队协商一揽子文化自治和有限的自治政府，一次性满足西藏人民的所有合理诉求。 ”
en: “Also in that spirit, I will welcome the Dalai Lama to Beijing and negotiate with his leadership team a package of cultural autonomy and limited self-government, satisfying once and for all the reasonable aspirations of the Tibetan people.”

zh: 安倍晋三 ： “ 我将邀请六方会谈全体领导任参加8月份的广岛或长崎原子弹爆炸周年祭，以促进东北亚无核武器区谈判，东北亚无核武器区将包括日本和朝鲜半岛两国，并由美国、中国和俄罗斯提供保障。
en: Shinzo Abe: “I will invite to Hiroshima or Nagasaki on the August A-bomb anniversary all six-party talks leaders to kick-start serious negotiations on a Northeast Asia Nuclear-Weapon-Free Zone, which will embrace Japan and both Koreas and be guaranteed by the US, China, and Russia.

zh: “2015年，我还将以积极方式结束我们与邻国的历史恩怨。
en: “And I will make 2015 the year that the historical grievances between us and our neighbors are buried for good.

zh: 我还记得1970年勃兰特在华沙犹太纪念碑前的下跪，我将以访问南京、承认日本对1937—1938年骇人听闻的大屠杀的责任的方式纪念第二次世界大战结束70周年。
en: Remembering the impact of Willy Brandt’s Kniefall at the Jewish ghetto site in Warsaw in 1970, I will commemorate the 70th anniversary of the end of World War II by visiting Nanjing and accepting Japanese responsibility for the terrible massacre of 1937-1938.

zh: “我还将竭尽全力将靖国神社游就馆中所有否认、质疑或对日本在20世纪三四十年代发动侵略战争、犯下残暴罪行无动于衷的陈列移除。
en: “I will also do everything I can to remove from the Yushukan Museum, on the grounds of the Yasukuni Shrine, all exhibits which deny, question, or are insensitive to Japan’s responsibility for waging aggressive war and committing atrocity crimes in the 1930s and 1940s.

zh: 首先我将把泰国-缅甸‘死亡铁路’上的蒸汽机车从基座上拆除，这个展品羞辱着100,000多在建设泰缅铁路过程中死于疾病、营养不良和虐待的战俘和被迫劳工。 ”
en: I will start by removing from its pedestal the steam locomotive that ran on the Thailand-Burma “Death Railway,” the display of which dishonors the more than 100,000 prisoners of war and forced laborers who perished from disease, malnutrition, or maltreatment in its construction.”

zh: 韩国总统朴槿惠 ： “ 我将取消我们在2010年朝鲜进行军事挑衅后对他们实行的‘5·24’制裁，因为这些制裁让我一直强调的构建信任和信心的必要条件无法成立。
en: South Korean President Park Geun-hye: “I will remove the ‘May 24’ sanctions we placed on North Korea after their military provocations in 2010, because they are making impossible nearly all of the measures to build trust and confidence that I keep saying are necessary.

zh: “当然，朝鲜应该继续因为其虐待人权和不恰当的核行为在联合国接受千夫所指。
en: “Of course the North should continue to be named and shamed in the United Nations for its human-rights abuses and nuclear misbehavior.

zh: 但流氓国家从来不会负责任地行动，而没有一个国家像我国那样在诱导金正恩政权正常化中起着如此重要的作用。
en: But pariah states never behave responsibly, and no state has a bigger role than we do in coaxing Kim Jong-un’s regime into normality.

zh: 对我来说，真正的重新融合在政治上十分艰难。
en: Serious re-engagement will be politically hard for me to deliver.

zh: 但如果我不尝试，我就站在了历史的对立面。 “
en: But if I do not, I will be on the wrong side of history.”

zh: 朝鲜的金正恩 ： “ 我将给所有人一个惊喜，冻结一切开发核武器和导弹的行动。 我还将证明我的诚意，开放我们的铀浓缩设施以供检查。
en: North Korea’s Kim Jong-un: “I will surprise everyone by freezing our efforts to develop nuclear weapons and missiles, and I will prove my seriousness by opening our uranium enrichment plants to inspection.

zh: 如此，任何人都不再有站得住的理由推迟六方会谈的重启。
en: That will leave no one with any credible reason to delay resumption of the six-party talks.

zh: “自20世纪90年代你以来我便知道，去核化方案是我们的体制的最佳保障。
en: “We have known since the 1990s that a denuclearization settlement is the best guarantee of our regime’s security.

zh: 我也许会有些形象问题，但我没有疯。
en: I may have image problems, but I am not crazy.

zh: 中国对我们已经无爱；我的人民对外部世界知道得太多；并且所有人都知道，使用我们的那一点点核武器无异于自杀。
en: China has fallen out of love with us; my people know too much about the wider world; and everyone knows that to use our handful of nuclear weapons would be suicidal.

zh: 是时候达成协议了。 ”
en: It is time to reach an agreement.”

zh: 美国总统奥巴马 ： “ 我将公开说出克林顿十年前私下里说的话。
en: US President Barack Obama: “I will say publicly what Bill Clinton was saying privately a decade ago.

zh: 这话也许对许多美国人来说很不中听，并且不会给我的反对者留下深刻印象。
en: It may be painful for many Americans to hear, and it will not impress my opponents.

zh: 但如果我可以以可信的方式说出这番话，就能为美国赢得更多的友善、尊重以及东亚和全世界的终极安全，这比我们耗资万亿美元的核武器现代化计划和一切不切实际、适得其反的导弹防御系统更有效。
en: But if I can make it believable, it will do more to win the US friendship, respect, and ultimate security in East Asia and around the world than our trillion-dollar nuclear-weapons modernization program or all the unworkable and counter-productive missile-defense systems at which we keep hurling money.

zh: “这番话很简单：美国不应该将其强大的军事和经济实力用于保持永恒的全球霸主地位。
en: “It is simply this: The US should not use its immense military and economic power to try to stay top dog on the global block in perpetuity.

zh: 相反，我们应该将这一实力用于创造一个即使我们不再是全球霸主仍能舒适地活在其中的世界。 “
en: Rather, we should be using that power to create a world in which we will be comfortable living when we are no longer top dog on the global block.”

zh: 或许这些决心中的所有内容在现实中都无异于童话。
en: Perhaps the idea that any of these resolutions will actually be made is fanciful.

zh: 我们也都明白新年决心的特点 — — 就算许了决心，也很少能够兑现。
en: And we all know that it is in the nature of New Year’s resolutions that, even when they are made, they are rarely kept.

zh: 但上述决心中实现任何一个，都能带来巨大的成果。
en: But should any one of the resolutions on my list come to pass, the result would be momentous.

zh: 累计起来，它们足以起到变革的效果。
en: Cumulatively, they would be transformative.

zh: 我们其他人理应希望这些决心的许诺和恪守，并且应该一直提醒他们，直到这些决心实现。
en: The rest of us should hope that they are made, and kept, and we should continue nagging until they are.

zh: 缓和亚洲军备竞赛
en: Defusing Asia’s Arms Race

zh: 曼谷—海牙常设仲裁庭（PCA）就中国在南海的领土主张做出不利于中国的裁决，该地区各国将因此大舒一口气。
en: BANGKOK – The ruling against China’s territorial claims in the South China Sea by the Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) in The Hague will be met with relief in the region’s capitals.

zh: 但这无法扭转亚洲最令人担忧的趋势之一：值得警惕的地区军备竞赛。
en: But it is unlikely to reverse one of Asia’s most worrying trends: an alarming regional arms build-up.

zh: 据斯托克霍姆国际和平研究所（Stockholm International Peace Research Institute）目前亚洲的军备开支占世界的近一半，比中东国家总开支多一倍多，更比欧洲多出四倍。
en: According to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, Asia now accounts for almost half of the world’s arms expenditure, which is more than twice the total expenditure of countries in the Middle East and four times greater than that of Europe.

zh: 1995年才与美国恢复邦交的越南目前增在考虑允许美国海军使用其金兰海军基地。 该基地由美国空军在越南战争期间建设和使用（后来苏联和俄罗斯海军也使用过 ） 。
en: Vietnam, which restored diplomatic relations with the United States only in 1995, is now considering allowing the US Navy to use its Cam Ranh Naval Base – which was built and used by the US Air Force during the Vietnam War (and then by the Soviet and Russian navies).

zh: 越南还采购了一批俄制潜艇，2011—2015年军备采购开支比此前五年增长八倍。
en: It has also purchased a clutch of Russian-made submarines, and it spent eight times more in arms procurement between 2011 and 2015 than it did in the previous five years.

zh: 泰国也希望为海军配备潜艇，尽管泰国湾深度很浅并且其在南海并无领土主张。
en: Thailand, too, wants submarines for its navy, despite having only shallow waters in the Gulf of Thailand and no territorial claims in the South China Sea.

zh: 将仲裁案提交海牙的菲律宾也在加强军力，从韩国采购战斗机并向海军新投资，不仅有美国支持，也有日本支持。
en: The Philippines, which brought the case against China in The Hague, is beefing up its military as well, with the procurement of fighter jets from South Korea and new investments in its navy, supported not only by the US, but also by Japan.

zh: 菲律宾还恢复了与美国的防务联盟，其态度较1991年将美国海军赶出苏比克湾基地时来了个一百八十度大转弯。
en: The Philippines has also rehabilitated its defense alliance with the US, marking a U-turn from its decision to expel the US Navy from its base at Subic Bay in 1991.

zh: 本着同样的精神，美国第七舰队打着航行自由（FONOP）的旗号开进南海。
en: In the same spirit, the American Seventh Fleet has stepped up its Freedom of Navigation Operational Patrols (FONOPs) in the South China Sea.

zh: 最近，日本通过修改战后“和平宪法”影响该地区。
en: Lastly, Japan is gaining influence in the region by inching away from its post-war “peace constitution.”

zh: 目前，日本首相安倍晋三政府已经重新解释了放弃战争权利的宪法第九条，允许日本参与盟国防务。
en: So far, Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s government has reinterpreted Article 9, which renounces war, to allow for Japan to come to the defense of its allies.

zh: 安倍政府还修订了安全法，允许向地区合作伙伴出口武器技术，以增强它们的防御力量。
en: The government has also revised security laws to allow exports of weapons technology to its partners in the region, thereby buttressing their defense capabilities.

zh: 所有这些国家都在应对迅速崛起为地区稳定最大威胁的中国。
en: All of these countries are responding to China’s rapid emergence as the foremost threat to regional stability.

zh: 在湄公河上游，中国建设了大坝，使下游的柬埔寨和越南无法获得重要的水资源。
en: On the headwaters of the Mekong River, China has constructed upriver dams that deprive downstream countries like Cambodia and Vietnam of vital water resources.

zh: 在南海，中国建设人工岛并修筑机场跑道和防务设施；此外，中国还通过其新生产、即将大量列装的运输机大秀海军肌肉。
en: In the South China Sea, China has built artificial islands and militarized them with airstrips and defense facilities; and it is flexing its naval muscles with a newly minted aircraft carrier group, with more on the way.

zh: 在PCA作出裁定的过程中，中国收买它进行投资的遥远的非洲国家以及东盟中比较容易影响的国家（如文莱、柬埔寨和老挝）支持它。
en: In the run-up to the PCA’s decision, China drummed up support in far-flung African countries, where it has investments, and among more easily influenced members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations, such as Brunei, Cambodia, and Laos.

zh: 中国的目标是防止东盟成员国一致对中，并削弱国际法在其寻求战略主宰地位的地区的作用。
en: China’s goal is to prevent ASEAN members from uniting against it and to diminish the role of international law in a region where it seeks strategic dominance.

zh: 更加令人担忧的是，中国完全无视仲裁程序，继续其在南海的活动，早就宣布不接受任何人为其领土主张无效的裁定。
en: More ominously, China ramped up its South China Sea activities in spite of the tribunal’s proceedings, vowing long ago to ignore any ruling that invalidated its claims.

zh: 亚洲军备竞赛是冷战以来规模最大的军备竞赛，在日益不利的国际背景下，这场竞赛还在不断加速。
en: Asia’s arms race is the biggest since the Cold War, and it is accelerating against an increasingly unfavorable international backdrop.

zh: 美国陷入了伊斯兰国和其他外部恐怖主义威胁，目前国内又处于总统选战期间。
en: The US is preoccupied with the Islamic State and other terrorist threats abroad, and now with the presidential campaign at home.

zh: 欧洲自英国投票脱离欧盟后陷入混乱，而在此前八年，欧洲经历了增长萎靡、紧缩和漫长的危机。
en: And Europe is in disarray after the United Kingdom’s vote to leave the European Union, which followed eight years of weak growth, austerity, and prolonged crises.

zh: 眼下理应成为亚洲扮演全球领导角色的时刻。
en: If anything, this should be Asia’s moment to assume a global leadership role.

zh: 悲哀的是，该地区尖锐的地缘政治对峙横亘其中，而这一对峙产生的原因乃是缺乏预防、遏制和解决领土纠纷的机构框架。
en: Sadly, the region’s bitter geopolitical rivalries stand in the way, owing to the absence of an institutional framework to prevent, mitigate, and settle territorial disputes.

zh: 除非这一安排得以确立，否则冲突风险将不断上升，阻碍近几十年来让十亿亚洲人摆脱贫困的地区经济转型。
en: Unless, and until, such arrangements are established, the risk of conflict will grow, jeopardizing the region’s economic transformation – which in recent decades has lifted a billion Asians out of poverty.

zh: 建立可行的地区安全框架绝非易事，因为亚洲存在大量难以弥合的地缘政治断层线。
en: Creating a viable regional security framework will not be easy, given the seeming intractability of many of Asia’s geopolitical fault lines.

zh: 其中包括印巴克什米尔僵局，南北朝鲜对峙，中国复杂的两岸关系，中国对日本和印度以及对菲律宾和越南主权领土的主张。
en: These include the standoff between India and Pakistan over Kashmir; the confrontation between North and South Korea; the tumultuous relationship between China and Taiwan; and China’s claims on the sovereign territory of Japan and India, in addition to that of the Philippines and Vietnam.

zh: 解决这些冲突至少需要一些基本游戏规则，而这些规则只有在多边基础上才能制定和实施，而不是中国所要求的双边方式。
en: Resolving such conflicts requires, at a minimum, some baseline rules of the game, which can be developed and implemented only on a multilateral basis, not in the unilateral way that China demands.

zh: 比如，东盟正在起草一份治理南海的行动准则；但由于中国的不让步而步履维艰。
en: For example, ASEAN is drafting a Code of Conduct to govern the South China Sea; but the effort has made little headway, owing to Chinese intransigence.

zh: 如果菲律宾不对海牙仲裁庭的胜利大做文章，并且其他利益相关方略作退步从而让中国有余地认识到其自身侵略的危险，中国领导人也许更有兴趣进行地区协定谈判。
en: If the Philippines does not overplay its victory at The Hague, and if other interested parties step back a little and give China space to recognize the dangers of its own aggression, Chinese leaders may yet become more willing to negotiate a regional agreement.

zh: 否则 — — 亚洲军备竞赛进一步升级 — — 不符合所有人的利益。
en: The alternative – further escalation of the Asian arms race – is in no one’s interest.

zh: 亚洲强人与其疲软的经济
en: Asia’s Strongmen and Their Weak Economies

zh: 发自新德里 — — 美国总统特朗普占据了最多的新闻头条，但对强人领袖的崇拜最为盛行的地方却是亚洲。
en: NEW DELHI – US President Donald Trump grabs the most headlines, but the cult of the strongman leader is most developed in Asia.

zh: 这片大陆上充斥着擅长集权的统治者 — — 包括印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪（Narendra Modi ） ， 菲律宾总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特（Rodrigo Duterte ） ， 土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安（Recep Tayyip Erdoğan ） ， 还有其中最强者，中国国家主席习近平。
en: The continent abounds with rulers – including Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte, Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, and the strongest of them all, Chinese President Xi Jinping – who make a virtue of centralizing power.

zh: 虽然其领导风格各不相同，但亚洲强人们都具备一个关键特征：他们都善于利用人们对经济的无知来获取公众支持，而且尤其喜欢借助一种流行的理念，认为那些集中政治权力的领导人可以更自由地带领经济增长。
en: But all of Asia’s strongmen share a key characteristic: they secure public support by preying on economic ignorance. In particular, they trade on the popular belief that leaders who concentrate political power are freer to guide economic growth.

zh: 在大多数情况下人们会接受这种说法，并期望获得经济利益和“发展”作为回报。
en: For the most part, people accept this claim, expecting that financial gain and “development” will be their reward.

zh: 而吊诡之处在于市场也接受了这种有缺陷的推理。
en: Curiously, markets have also accepted this flawed reasoning.

zh: 相对于不可预测的民主制度，全球投资者倾向于无视人权，也更喜欢那种追求稳定和专制的信念。
en: Global investors tend to overlook human rights, and to prefer stability and autocratic resolve to the unpredictability of democracy.

zh: 证券和货币市场经常会惩罚那些哪怕出现一丝政治动荡的国家，而拥有更多权力及更少制衡的统治者则被认为更有能力去确保有意义的“改革 ” 。
en: Equity and currency markets regularly punish countries for even a hint of political upheaval, whereas rulers with more power and fewer checks and balances are assumed to be more capable of ensuring meaningful “reforms.”

zh: 然而这种强大专制统治者能提供更佳经济表现的看法是错误的（或许习近平除外 ） 。
en: And yet, with the possible exception of Xi, the perception that strong autocratic rulers deliver better economic results is wrong.

zh: 事实是亚洲强人主导下的国家正变得越来越脆弱，而其经济甚至变得更加弱不禁风。
en: The truth is that Asia’s strongmen are presiding over increasingly vulnerable states and even more fragile economies.

zh: 这种脆弱性直到最近才得到了重视。
en: Until recently, these vulnerabilities went unnoticed.

zh: 全球新兴市场从2008年金融危机中迅速复苏，而其中那些亚洲国家的表现最为抢眼。
en: The world’s emerging markets recovered quickly from the 2008 financial crisis, and Asian economies were among the most dynamic.

zh: 然而只有少数观察人士敢于指出，这种快速逆转其实是由那些流动性过剩的全球资本主义核心地区孕育的套利交易操作推动下的信贷泡沫的结果。
en: Only a few observers dared to point out that this rapid reversal was the result of credit bubbles fueled by carry-trade operations hatched in overly liquid centers of global capitalism.

zh: 换句话说，亚洲的这场危机后盛宴（坦白说也是有史以来最为喧嚣的一场）将不得不在某一时刻落幕。
en: Put another way, Asia’s post-crisis party (which was, to be honest, never that raucous) had to end sometime.

zh: 自2018年初以来，同样一批新兴市场国家就一直饱受各种因素的巨大压力，首先是美联储促使资本回流美国的货币政策收紧。
en: Since the start of 2018, the same emerging markets have been under intense pressure from a combination of factors, beginning with the US Federal Reserve’s tightening of monetary policy, which pulled capital back to the United States.

zh: 美中之间正在进行的贸易战使这些压力进一步增大。
en: These stresses have been exacerbated by the ongoing trade war between the US and China.

zh: 由此导致的经济放缓也让亚洲经济体们露出了原本完美隐藏的马脚。
en: The resulting slowdown has exposed cracks in Asian economies that were once well hidden.

zh: 事实证明，大多数长期被金融市场追捧的亚洲领导人都是非常糟糕的经济管理者，而投资者也在逐步抛弃他们。
en: Most of the Asian leaders long feted by financial markets, it turns out, are really bad economic managers, and investors are beginning to recoil from them.

zh: 但最令人震惊之处莫过于市场花了很长时间才能得出这一结论。
en: But what is most striking is that it took markets so long to reach this conclusion.

zh: 毕竟原本那些错误的看法已经流传多年了。
en: After all, the writing has been on the wall for years.

zh: 例如，印度总理莫迪2016年11月实施的灾难性废钞行动就足以引起观察者的警觉。
en: For example, in India, Modi’s disastrous banknote demonetization in November 2016 should have been enough to alert observers.

zh: 此举在政治上对执政党来说是成功的，但在经济上却是毁灭性的，也对印度经济造成了巨大的破坏，导致 雇用了该国约81％劳动力的非正式部门陷入了瘫痪。
en: The move was politically successful for the ruling party but economically devastating, causing massive disruptions to the Indian economy and upending the informal sector, which employs some 81% of the country’s workforce.

zh: 但这还不够，计划不周且仓促实施的商品及服务税让莫迪的经济管理能力再受质疑。
en: As if that were not enough, the poorly planned and hastily implemented Goods and Services Tax should have impugned Modi’s economic stewardship.

zh: 此外还存在其他严重问题，例如过度依赖投机性短期资本流入来为不断增大的经常账户赤字提供资金，以及对提高生产性就业以及促进以工资主导型增长可能性的关注不足。
en: There have been other serious problems, too, like over-reliance on speculative short-term capital inflows to finance a growing current-account deficit, and inadequate attention to boosting productive employment and promoting wage-led growth possibilities.
