zh: 即便今时今日，这些缺陷中的大部分几乎都没有被讨论过。
en: Even today, most of these shortcomings are barely being discussed.

zh: 那么该如何解释这些亚洲强人的弱势经济表现？
en: What explains weak economic performances by Asia’s strongmen?

zh: 也许是不受约束的政治权力导致了大范围的经济错误。
en: Maybe untrammeled political power enables large-scale economic mistakes.

zh: 此外，虽然大多数独裁者都能在国内民众面前耀武扬威，但却只能对全球资本服软。
en: Furthermore, while most autocrats show strength to their own public, they become meek in the face of global capital.

zh: 即便统治者会反对那些会损害其民粹主义议程的政策 — — 如高利率 — — 但也常常会屈服于金融市场的压力。
en: Even when rulers rant against policies that will hurt their populist agendas – like high interest rates – they typically succumb to pressure from financial markets.

zh: 这是因为他们所追求的政策已经将其经济完全融入了全球贸易和金融体系 — — 但双方的地位是不对等的。
en: This is because the policies they have pursued have integrated their economies so completely into global trade and finance, on unequal terms.

zh: 因此虽然他们满嘴民族主义言论，可一旦经济风向逆转也极难改变方向。
en: Despite their nationalist rhetoric, when the economic winds blow against them, it can be hard to change direction.

zh: 唯一的例外是中国，其特立独行的政策和强大的国家干预手段使得经济更不容易受到外部冲击的影响。
en: The exception is China, where heterodox policies and significant state intervention have made the economy far less vulnerable to external shocks.

zh: 但尽管习近平目前有能力去应对日益复杂和敌对的外部经济环境，其国内依然存在着许多即将爆发的严重内部问题。
en: But while Xi has thus far managed to deal with an increasingly complex and hostile external economic environment, many serious internal concerns could easily erupt into bigger problems.

zh: 无论亚洲强人大批涌现的原因是什么，但人们和市场都已经犯下了足够长时间的错误。
en: Whatever the reason for Asia’s profusion of strongmen, people and markets have gotten it wrong for too long.

zh: 强人统治者不但对民主不利，对经济更是不利。
en: Strongman rulers are bad for democracy, and they are really bad for the economy.

zh: 抵御机器人、投资民众
en: To Resist the Robots, Invest in People

zh: 马尼拉 — — 孟加拉的一间针织厂汇聚了过去，现在和未来。
en: MANILA – A knitting factory in Bangladesh brings together the past, present, and future.

zh: 在其中一层，工人们在手编生产。
en: On one floor, workers knit by hand.

zh: 而在另一层，人和机器则在一起工作。
en: On another, people and machines do the work together.

zh: 而在第三层，只有机器人在工作。
en: And on a third floor, there are only robots.

zh: 这座建筑看似弄错了年代，因为人们普遍认为机器人将在纺织和其他许多行业顶替人的位置。
en: This building might seem like an anachronism, given the accepted wisdom that robots will replace humans in textiles and many other industries.

zh: 但这其实是对第四次工业革命如何在亚洲展开的明智回应。
en: But it is actually a savvy response to how the Fourth Industrial Revolution will likely play out in Asia.

zh: 像在其他地方一样，技术进步正在通过模糊物理、数字和生物世界之间的界限来实现行业和经济体的快速转型。
en: As is the case elsewhere, technological advances are rapidly transforming industries and economies, by blurring the boundaries between the physical, digital, and biological worlds.

zh: 但亚洲绝大部分地区还没有为机器人做好准备，个中理由不仅限于对大规模失业的担忧。
en: And yet much of Asia isn’t ready for robots, for reasons that go beyond fears of mass unemployment.

zh: 在2014年，中国非汽车行业每一万名员工中仅有11台机器人，而在汽车组装线上213台机器人则对应着每万名员工。
en: In 2014, China had just 11 robots per 10,000 employees in non-automotive industries, and just 213 per 10,000 employees on automotive assembly lines.

zh: 这比日本、美国或德国的状况少数百台还多。
en: That is hundreds fewer than in Japan, the United States, or Germany.

zh: 虽然中国正在通过加大机器人开支来缩小差距，贫困国家在采用新技术方面的确困难重重。
en: Although China is closing the gap by increasing its spending on robots, poorer countries face significant barriers to adopting new technologies.

zh: 不仅如此，该地区薪酬较低使得企业有动力保留人工。
en: Moreover, the region’s lower wages give firms an incentive to retain human workers.

zh: 在孟加拉国的工厂，工人可以在停电和设备故障致使机械设备无法工作时介入。
en: At the factory in Bangladesh, human workers can step in if power outages or equipment failures knock the machines offline.

zh: 与此同时，拥有完全自动化的生产部门可以在工人罢工时继续完成生产任务。
en: At the same time, having a fully automated section allows production to continue if workers go on strike.

zh: 传统观点认为这样的双轨制是不可持续的，中低技能工人归根结底会为机器人让路。
en: Conventional wisdom decrees that this dual-track approach isn’t sustainable, and that low- to middle-skilled workers will eventually make way for robots.

zh: 牛津大学卡尔·弗雷和迈克尔·奥斯伯恩在2013年所进行的一项标志性研究表明在今后几十年，自动化将威胁美国47%的就业总人数。
en: A landmark 2013 study by Carl Frey and Michael Osborne of Oxford University suggests that, in the coming decades, 47% of total US employment will be at risk of automation.

zh: 同样，据国际劳工组织警告 ，柬埔寨、印尼、菲律宾、泰国和越南就业总人数的56 % “ 将在未来十年或20年因为技术的发展而面临失业的威胁。 ”
en: Similarly, the International Labour Organization (ILO) has warned that 56% of total employment in Cambodia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam is “at high risk of displacement due to technology over the next decade or two.”

zh: 但上述严峻的预测忽视了这样一个事实，那就是绝大多数岗位都包含部分无法被自动化取代的系列任务。
en: But these grim predictions ignore the fact that most jobs comprise a bundle of tasks, some of which cannot be automated.

zh: 经合组织2016年按任务对职业进行分解的研究表明，在21个经合组织国家中仅有9%的工作岗位确实处在危险之中。
en: According to a 2016 OECD study that breaks down occupations by task, only 9% of jobs on average across 21 OECD countries are really at risk.

zh: 同样的逻辑也适用于亚洲。
en: The same logic applies to Asia.

zh: 例如在越南，如果考虑到该国规模庞大的非正规经济领域，面临威胁的工作岗位比例从国际劳工组织预测的70%下降到仅15 % 。
en: In Vietnam, for example, the share of jobs at risk falls from the ILO’s predicted 70% to just 15% when the country’s large informal economy is taken into account.

zh: 发展中国家的环卫工人面对的自动化威胁可能比发达国家要低，因为他们的工作机械化程度较低，而且工资也十分微薄。
en: Street sweepers in developing countries are arguably less threatened by automation than their counterparts in developed countries, because their jobs are less mechanized and lower paid.

zh: 但机器人仍然在该地区站稳了脚跟，尤其在中国和韩国这样的经济体就更是这样。
en: Still, robots are gaining a foothold in the region, particularly in economies such as China and South Korea.

zh: 2015年，亚洲地区的机器人销量增长了19 % — —这也是连续第四年打破记录。
en: In 2015, robot sales in Asia increased by 19% – the fourth record-breaking year in a row.

zh: 当亚洲欠发达国家最终融入技术潮流时，随之而来的必定是裁员的结果。
en: When less-developed Asian countries eventually join the technology bandwagon, layoffs will inevitably ensue.

zh: 为减轻这一打击，政府迫切需要从技术和职业教育培训开始（TVET ） ， 推动劳动力市场改革并彻底改革教育体系。
en: To soften the blow, governments urgently need to pursue labor-market reforms and overhaul their education systems, starting with technical and vocational education and training (TVET).

zh: 尽管技术和职业教育培训在亚洲发展中经济体越来越受欢迎，但教育的质量却往往相对低劣。
en: Although TVET is becoming increasingly popular in Asia’s developing economies, its quality is often poor.

zh: 政府应当确保职业技术教育培训更多地侧重于实用技能，并在突出重点的同时保持灵活性，以允许学生能在不牺牲收入的前提下学习新技能。
en: Governments should ensure that TVET courses focus on more relevant skills, while remaining flexible so that students can study without sacrificing income.

zh: 方法之一是扩大模块化短期课程的供应量，这种课程耗时更少，仅为特定任务而非整个岗位提供培训，同时对那些首先需要赚取收入的课程参与者来说能降低管理难度。
en: One option is to expand the availability of modular short courses, which take less time, train for specific tasks rather than entire jobs, and are more manageable for entrants who need, first and foremost, to earn money.

zh: 例如在缅甸，政府已经启动了一项针对该国每年失学的“百万失踪”学生的试点项目。
en: In Myanmar, for example, the government has launched a pilot program to target the country’s “missing million” students who drop out of school each year.

zh: 该项目开设有关焊接和其他技能的短期课程，以便教授学员学会修理农业机械。
en: The program offers short courses on welding and other skills needed to repair rural machinery.

zh: 鉴于亚洲拥有庞大的非正规劳动力，以能力为基础的评估系统也可能发挥特别的作用。
en: Competency-based assessment systems could also be particularly useful, given Asia’s large informal workforce.

zh: 根据自身的工作经验，为熟练工人提供考证机会的项目能够允许尚未得到认证的电工在机器人行业找到正式的工作。
en: Programs offering skilled workers a chance to earn certifications based on their work experience would allow for, say, uncertified electricians to find formal employment in robotics.

zh: 私营部门还可以协助提供更多具备就业技能的毕业生。
en: The private sector can also help produce more graduates with job-ready skills.

zh: 亚洲国家应当从印度国家技能开发公司的榜样中得到启示，它与私营培训企业合作匹配技能课程与行业需求。
en: Asian countries should take a cue from India’s National Skill Development Corporation, which works with private training firms to match skills curricula with industry needs.

zh: 到目前为止，印度项目已经协助培训了超过6，3000名民众。
en: So far, India’s program has helped train more than 63,000 people.

zh: 不仅如此，政府应当向那些投资于更适宜人类掌握的技术，如沟通和谈判技巧的企业提供补贴或税收激励。
en: Furthermore, governments should offer subsidies or tax incentives to companies that invest in the skills that humans master better than machines, such as communication and negotiation.

zh: 政府还应当采取更灵活的劳动规则，因为要价太高的技工不会得到企业的聘用。
en: They will also have to adopt more flexible labor regulations, because firms won’t hire skilled workers who cost too much.

zh: 归根结底，亚洲发展中国家需要支持工人而非岗位的各项政策。
en: At the end of the day, Asia’s developing countries need policies that support workers, rather than jobs.

zh: 灵活的合同以及终身学习和再培训的机会可以令各方受益无穷。
en: All parties can benefit from flexible contracts and lifelong learning and retraining opportunities.

zh: 再培训尤为重要，因为自动化将创造全新的行业和职业。
en: Retraining is particularly important, because automation will create entirely new industries and occupations.

zh: 据麦肯锡全球研究院估计自动化可以使全球生产率每年提高0.8-1.4 % ， 从而在为企业节约大笔经费的同时带来效益的提升。
en: The McKinsey Global Institute estimates that automation could boost global productivity growth by 0.8-1.4% annually, generating large savings and performance gains for businesses.

zh: 扩大获取培训和认证的机会将有助于各国利用这些进步并确保实现更公平的增长，并为工人提供处理新工作所需的技能。
en: Improving access to training and certification would help countries capitalize on these advances and ensure more equitable growth, by giving workers the skills needed to handle the new jobs.

zh: 这样的结果对工人和亚洲各国经济都有好处。
en: That outcome would be good for workers and for Asian economies.

zh: 这意味着像孟加拉工厂那样的企业可以只用机器人，而那些以前为这些企业工作的员工则可以在其他地方从事更有利可图的工作，而且很有可能是在目前还并不存在的工作岗位上。
en: It would mean that businesses like the factory in Bangladesh could operate solely with robots, while its former workers would be gainfully employed elsewhere, most likely in jobs that don’t even exist yet.

zh: 亚洲城市的无尽之夏
en: Asian Cities’ Endless Summer

zh: 波茨坦/米兰 — — 现在是亚洲的季风季 — — 季风季的到来标志着数月高温的结束。
en: POTSDAM/MANILA – It’s monsoon season in Asia – marking an end to months of scorching temperatures.

zh: 但极端热浪还会回来，城市将面临特别严重的状况。
en: But the extreme heat will return, with cities facing particularly brutal conditions.

zh: 亚洲城市地区的高温日数已经是农村地区的两倍 — — 到2100年甚至可能达到十倍之多。
en: Already, Asia’s urban areas experience twice as many hot days as its rural areas do – and could experience ten times as many by 2100.

zh: 真到那时，人们已经看不到逆转趋势的希望。
en: At that point, there will be no reversing the trend.

zh: 由亚洲开发银行（ADB）和波茨坦气候影响研究所（PIK）联合进行的亚洲气候风险首次详细评估表明亚洲城市正处在对抗气候变化战斗的第一线上。
en: The first detailed assessment of climate risk for Asia, carried out by the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and the Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK), makes clear that Asia’s cities stand at the frontline of the fight against climate change.

zh: 事实上，地球变热的诸多后果 — — 包括极端气候事件、海平面上升、环境移民和社会紧张局势加剧 — — 都将在城市地区出现相交。
en: Indeed, many consequences of a hotter planet – such as more extreme weather events, sea-level rise, environmental migration, and mounting social tensions – intersect in urban areas.

zh: 亚洲的情况尤其如此，那里的城市拥有近半数的人口并支撑着近80%的经济增长。
en: This is particularly true in Asia, where cities house more than half of the population and produce almost 80% of economic output.

zh: 截至2050年，亚洲地区的城市人口可能接近翻番，达30亿人以上。
en: By 2050, Asia’s urban population could nearly double, to three billion people.

zh: 如果不出台新的气候措施，该地区的城市有可能贡献今后20年全球温室气体排放增长的一半以上。
en: Without new climate initiatives, the region’s cities could contribute more than half of the increase in global greenhouse-gas emissions over the next 20 years.

zh: 这种情况通常被称为“一切照旧 ” 。
en: Such a scenario is often called “business as usual.”

zh: 但在现实中，一切照旧将会被气候变化的现实后果所打破，不受控制的温度变暖将阻碍甚至逆转亚洲近期的经济进步。
en: Yet, in reality, it is business as usual that would be disrupted by the consequences of climate change, with unfettered warming impeding or even reversing Asia’s recent economic progress.

zh: 我们解决气候难题等待的时间越长，就会造成越严重的破坏后果。
en: The longer we wait to address the climate challenge, the more devastating the disruption will be.

zh: 而且可能不会有太多警告，因为气候影响通常不会以线性方式逐渐演变，而是突然剧烈出现，一旦我们实现对某个临界点的突破。
en: And we may not get much warning, because climate effects generally do not evolve in a linear fashion, but rather emerge suddenly and powerfully, once certain tipping points have been reached.

zh: 到目前为止，评估亚洲气候变化影响的工作还做得远远不够，更不用说加强对脆弱地区的保护或减少温室气体排放。
en: So far, not nearly enough has been done to assess Asia’s exposure to climate impacts, much less to strengthen protections for vulnerable areas or reduce greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 亚洲地区需要减少土地、水资源和能源占用的低碳绿色经济增长战略。
en: The region needs low-carbon green growth strategies that use less land, water, and energy.

zh: 上述战略将有助于减缓快速城市化进程，减少密集建设、封闭道路和私家车辆 — — 而这一切一直是加剧“城市热岛”效应的罪魁祸首。
en: These strategies will help to slow rapid urbanization, which entails dense construction, sealed roads, and private cars – all of which contribute to the “urban heat island” effect.

zh: 如果我们继续延续目前的做法，到2100年，亚洲大陆的平均气温可能比前工业化阶段飙升超过6℃（10.8华氏度 ） 。
en: If we continue on our current path, the mean temperature over the Asian landmass could soar by more than 6°C (10.8°F), relative to pre-industrial levels, by 2100.

zh: 热应激或污染所引发的呼吸系统和其他疾病可能导致人们生病甚至死亡。
en: People may fall ill and even die from respiratory and other ailments caused by heat stress or pollution.

zh: 除人力成本外，温度升高还有可能对农业和工业效率造成影响。
en: Beyond the human costs, higher temperatures would undermine agricultural and industrial productivity.

zh: 气候造成的移民流动将导致亚洲城市面临更严峻的挑战。
en: Climate-driven migration flows will exacerbate the challenges Asian cities face.

zh: 除非创造足够数量的体面工作，否则气候移民就可能永久沦为底部阶层。
en: Unless a sufficient number of decent jobs are created, climate migrants could become a permanent underclass.

zh: 即使有足够的工作机会，越来越拥挤的城市所造成的环境压力也将对这些国家构成严重的威胁。
en: Even if jobs are available, the environmental pressure created by ever-more populated cities will pose a grave threat.

zh: 即便如此，对亚洲气候变化移民影响的预测性研究无论在数量、范围还是预测能力方面都仍然是严重不足的。
en: Yet projections of the impact of climate change on migration in Asia remain indefensibly limited in number, scope, and predictive power.

zh: 为了改善城市规划和医疗卫生服务，我们需要一种简单而准确的方式来对城市人口当前和未来的耐热能力进行评估。
en: In order to improve city planning and health-care services, we need a simple and accurate way to assess current and future heat-tolerance levels among urban populations.

zh: 我们还需要减少城市热应激反应的策略，包括转向多中心城市构造、实现经济和社会集中在多个区域中心周围，而不是集中在某个单一城市，并通过生态走廊和城市连接部的绿色空间来实现对自然资源的保护。
en: We also need strategies to decrease urban heat stress, including a shift toward polycentric urban configurations, with economies and societies built around multiple regional hubs, rather than concentrated around a single city, and natural assets maintained through eco-corridors and connected green spaces.

zh: 气温升高还远不是气候变化所造成的唯一风险。
en: But rising temperatures are far from the only threat posed by climate change.

zh: 从旱灾到洪灾的极端天气事件将更加频繁，而且造成的破坏将越来越严重。
en: Extreme weather events, from droughts to floods, will intensify and become more frequent.

zh: 在亚洲，降雨量增加和热带气旋恶化将严重破坏粮食生产，从而导致农村收入下降。
en: In Asia, increased rainfall and worsening tropical cyclones will wreak havoc on food production, driving down rural incomes.

zh: 比如，在斯里兰卡，稻米产量到2050年可能下降高达20 % ； 而在斐济，木薯产量可能暴跌36 % 。
en: In Sri Lanka, for example, rice yields could drop by up to 20% by 2050; in Fiji, cassava output could plummet by 36%.

zh: 这一切会因为海平面上升而进一步恶化，本世纪末海平面可能上升1.4米（4.6英尺 ） ， 可能导致诸多国家丧失超过总面积10%的领土。
en: All of this would be exacerbated by rising sea levels, which could be 1.4 meters (4.6 feet) higher by the end of the century, potentially causing many countries to lose more than 10% of their land area.

zh: 如果各国履行其在巴黎气候协定下所作出的承诺，海平面的上升幅度有可能被控制在一半左右，更雄心勃勃的计划甚至可能实现更高的目标。
en: If countries meet their commitments under the Paris climate agreement, the total sea-level rise could be halved, with more ambitious schemes promising even greater reductions.

zh: 但如果我们在今后数十年继续维持原来的状况，我们可能触发长达数百年的海平面上升，即使我们随后结束所有的温室气体排放仍将造成渐进但却无情的后果。
en: If, however, we continue on our current path for just a couple more decades, we could trigger centuries of rising sea levels, even if we subsequently ended all greenhouse-gas emissions. The effects would be gradual but merciless.

zh: 亚洲拥挤的海岸线可以说风险最大，那里有成百上千万民众面临着洪灾的威胁。
en: The risks are arguably highest on Asia’s crowded coastlines, where millions of people are exposed to flooding.

zh: 而且风险仍然在不断提升：在孟加拉、印度、菲律宾和越南等国，到2060年沿海地区人口预计将增长一倍。
en: And those risks continue to mount: in countries such as Bangladesh, India, the Philippines, and Vietnam, coastal populations are expected to double by 2060.

zh: 从现在到2050年间，预计将遭受最大幅度年度经济损失的20个全球城市中有13个都位于亚洲。
en: Asia is home to 13 of the 20 global cities expected to experience the sharpest increases in annual economic loss due to floods between now and 2050.

zh: 就目前而言，亚洲沿海城市中心海平面上升的风险仍没有得到充分的认识，更没有被充分融入到规划过程当中。
en: As it stands, the risks of sea-level rise for Asia’s coastal urban centers are still not sufficiently understood, nor have they been adequately integrated into planning processes.

zh: 我们必须改变这种状况。
en: This must change.

zh: 在易受洪灾影响的国家，城市规划方案应当综合运用包括排水系统、堤坝和海墙等灰色基础设施，以及湿地和森林保护等绿色举措。
en: In flood-prone countries, city-planning schemes should blend gray infrastructure, such as drainage systems, dikes, and sea walls, with green measures, like conservation of wetlands and forests.

zh: 改善气象观测和早期预警系统也可以提供很大帮助。
en: Improved meteorological observations and early-warning systems would also help substantially.

zh: 但在这方面，人们可能再次面临知识匮乏和准备不足。
en: But here, again, there is a lack of adequate knowledge and preparation.

zh: 对沿海设防相对于其他方法的经济成本和效益状况仍然缺乏系统的分析和比较。
en: There is no systematic analysis of the economic costs and benefits of coastal fortification relative to other approaches.

zh: “软性”干预措施，像加强土地使用规划和以生态系统为基础的方法得到了人们的广泛支持，但仅有少数小规模研究对其效果进行了评估。
en: “Softer” interventions, like better land-use planning and ecosystem-based approaches, are widely supported, but their effectiveness has been assessed in only a few small-scale studies.

zh: 洪水风险可能导致孟加拉和印度等国沿海城市的能源基础设施开发进一步复杂化。
en: Flood risks could complicate energy-infrastructure development in coastal cities in countries like Bangladesh and India.

zh: 至少在这方面，前进的方向是明确的：加强地区合作将有助于缓解电力短缺，而可再生和与气候相适应的供应网络所提供的离网能源将改善各国的能源安全状况。
en: Here, at least, the way forward is clearer: closer regional cooperation would help to offset power shortages, while off-grid energy from renewables and climate-resilient supply networks would help countries to enhance their energy security.

zh: 鉴于亚洲的地域面积、人口规模和经济重要性，它必须在缓解气候变化的全球工作中发挥核心的作用。
en: Given Asia’s massive size, population, and economic importance, it must be at the center of global efforts to mitigate climate change.

zh: 在许多方面，亚洲城市将决定地球的未来。
en: In many ways, Asia’s cities hold Earth’s future in their hands.

zh: 他们必须竭尽全力来保护它。
en: They must do their utmost to protect it.

zh: 亚洲的未来农场
en: Asia’s Future Farms

zh: 马尼拉 - - 粮食短缺对于许多亚洲人来说是一个遥远的记忆。
en: MANILA – Food shortages are a distant memory for many people in Asia.

zh: 但随着该地区难以为越来越多的人口提供足够的粮食和营养，粮食短缺将再次成为一个痛苦的生活现实。
en: But as the region struggles to feed and nourish a booming population, they could become a painful fact of life again.

zh: 亚洲已是世界最大的粮食市场，到2050年，亚洲人口预计将增加到五十亿 — — 即增加9亿人。
en: Asia is already the world’s largest food market, and by 2050 its population is expected to grow to five billion – an increase of 900 million people.

zh: 拜日益膨胀的中产阶级所赐，从现在到2030年，该地区年牛肉和禽肉消费量将占全球增量的一半，鱼肉消费量将占全球增量的四分之三以上。
en: Owing to its expanding middle class, the region will likely account for half of the global increase in annual beef and poultry consumption and over three quarters of the rise in fish consumption between now and 2030.

zh: 届时，发展中世界60%的谷物需求将来自南亚和东亚。
en: And by then, more than 60% of total cereal demand in the developing world will come from South and East Asia.

zh: 为了跟上这一日益增长的需求，粮食生产需要较十年前增加60—70 % 。
en: To keep up with this growing demand, food production will have to increase by 60-70% compared to a decade ago.

zh: 在理想情况下，亚洲的农场完全可以增加产量。
en: Ideally, Asia’s farms could simply expand their production.

zh: 但它们完全没有为实现这一目标做好准备。
en: But they are woefully ill-equipped to do so.

zh: 为了提供充足的粮食，亚洲的农场需要来一场二十一世纪的转型。
en: To produce a sufficient amount of food, Asia’s farms will need to undergo a twenty-first-century transformation.

zh: 帮助亚洲农民应对气候变化应该成为这一措施的核心。
en: Helping Asia’s farmers cope with climate change should be a central part of this effort.

zh: 地球变暖可以在某些地区增加农业产出，但也会在亚洲的其他地方严重限制产量，引发长期粮食危机。
en: Although a warming planet could boost agricultural output in a few areas, it will severely limit production, and possibly trigger prolonged food crises, throughout the rest of the region.

zh: 而在印度河-恒河平原等传统肥沃区，水量日益减少，海平面的升高将吞没大片良田。
en: As water becomes increasingly scarce in traditionally fertile zones such as the Indo-Gangetic Plain, rising seas will ruin vast swathes of farmland.

zh: 如果海平面上升一米，由此带来的盐潮将威胁到越南70%的沿海农田。
en: If sea levels were to rise by one meter, the resulting saltwater intrusion would threaten 70% of Vietnam’s coastal farmlands.

zh: 而随着水温升高和潮汐流动变化。 湄公河三角洲的广袤渔场产量也可能出现崩溃。
en: And as waters warm and tidal flows change, yields from the Mekong Delta’s vast fishing grounds could plummet.

zh: 据亚洲开发银行的研究，到2050年，灌溉稻田和麦田产量可能分别下降高达20%和44 % 。
en: According to Asian Development Bank research, by 2050, irrigated rice and wheat yields could fall by as much as 20% and 44%, respectively.

zh: 这将导致谷物、大豆和小麦价格上涨70 % ， 该地区营养不良儿童数量将上升1,100万人。
en: This would drive up the price for cereals, soybeans, and wheat by 70%, causing the number of malnourished children in the region to rise by 11 million.

zh: 但这并不是亚洲的宿命，如果亚洲农民能够做出调整的话。
en: But this doesn’t have to be Asia’s future, if its farmers can adapt.

zh: 如今，大部分农民以家庭为单位从事生产，缺少资金和专业知识提高生产率和作物品质。
en: Most farmers today oversee family-run subsistence plots, and lack the money and know-how to improve productivity and crop quality.

zh: 比如，在缅甸，只有16%的农民家庭使用微耕机和拖拉机犁地。
en: In Myanmar, for example, only 16% of farm households even use tillers or tractors to prepare the land for planting.

zh: 此外，环境破坏导致大量农田抛荒。
en: Moreover, environmental degradation has left huge swaths of land barren.

zh: 据联合国防治沙漠化公约的数据，近40%的亚洲总土地面积面临各种形式的沙漠化。
en: According to the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification, various forms of desertification affect nearly 40% of Asia’s total land area.

zh: 政府无法创造新的适耕土地，但它们能够 — — 也必须 — — 采取政策支持、整合和集中仍可耕种土地的农业作业。
en: While governments cannot create new arable land, they can – and must – pursue policies to support, consolidate, and intensify farming operations on the land that is still available.

zh: 首先，该地区各国政府可以推广农场合作社。
en: For starters, the region’s governments can promote farm cooperatives.

zh: 农场合作社不同于以往的集体农庄。 今天的合作社完全是商业的，以效率和利润为重。
en: Not to be confused with old-style collectivized farming, today’s cooperatives are thoroughly commercial, prioritizing efficiency and profits.

zh: 它们包括农业企业和农民，参与者将资源汇集起来，形成规模经济，降低成本，提高收入。
en: They comprise agricultural enterprises as well as farmers, all of whom pool their resources to create economies of scale, reduce costs, and lift incomes.

zh: 如果可以采取合作式大宗采购，肥料和农业机械等投入品就会更加便宜，收割依然。
en: When bought in bulk by a cooperative, inputs such as fertilizer and equipment are less expensive, as is the harvesting process.

zh: 印度和尼泊尔的合作社计划通过协调种植，让每个参与者的庄稼都可以用机器统一播种和收割，不再像以前那样需要人工操作。
en: By coming together to coordinate planting, cooperatives in India and Nepal have made it possible for every member’s crops to be sown and harvested together by a machine, rather than individually by hand.

zh: 合作社也能让作物的清洗、筛选、包装、储藏和运输变得更加便利，从而增加收获后的价值。
en: Cooperatives can also add value after the harvest, by streamlining crop cleaning, grading, packaging, storage, and transportation.

zh: 这能够增加粮食供给、提高农民收入，特别是在孟加拉国国家，目前三分之一以上的易腐坏作物还没有到达消费者之手就已经被糟蹋了。
en: This increases the supply of food and boosts farmers’ incomes, especially in places such as Bangladesh, where more than one-third of perishables spoil before ever reaching the consumer.

zh: 中国已经开始通过合作社实现农场现代化，还是用数字电商平台打入高端市场。
en: China is already modernizing farms through cooperatives, and by using digital e-commerce platforms to tap into high-value markets.

zh: 在越南，一项合作社计划改善了面向城市消费者的农产品的质量，将茶叶、水果和蔬菜收入提高了近三分之一。
en: In Vietnam, a cooperative program has improved the quality of produce for urban consumers, and boosted tea, fruit, and vegetable revenues by nearly one third.

zh: 尽管合作社正在亚洲逐渐铺开，但仍然需要更多的支持。
en: Although cooperatives are gradually catching on in Asia, they will need more support.

zh: 亚洲大部分地区的合作社十分脆弱，属于非正式安排。
en: Most of the region’s cooperatives are fragile, informal arrangements.

zh: 但如果能有正确的法律框架，它们可以大大提高效率和持续期。
en: But with the right legal framework in place, they could become far more efficient and durable.

zh: 2007年的中华人民共和国农民专业合作社法是一个非常好的模式。
en: China’s 2007 Farmers’ Cooperative Law serves as a good model.

zh: 该法律提供了增值税减免等激励措施，鼓励合作社和其他农业组织进行协作，创造规模经济。
en: By offering incentives such as value-added-tax exemptions, the law has encouraged cooperatives and other agricultural organizations to collaborate and create economies of scale.

zh: 该法律实施不出三年，中国的合作社数量增加了九倍，达到了400,000家。
en: Within three years of the law’s enactment, the number of cooperatives in China had increased ninefold, to nearly 400,000.

zh: 合作还能形成网络，让成员共享棘手的调整策略，如在盐潮影响地区从种庄稼改为捕鱼捞虾等，这有助于农民对抗气候变化的影响。
en: Cooperatives also help farmers manage the effects of climate change, by creating networks through which members can share knowledge about tricky adaptive strategies like switching from crops to fish or shrimp in saline-affected areas.

zh: 有了合作社提供的额外收入，农民可以购买温室以延长生产季、对抗不稳定的天气。
en: And with the extra income that cooperatives provide, farmers can buy greenhouses to prolong their production season, and shield against erratic weather.

zh: 合作社还能让农民从以前无法获得的技术中获益，比如灌溉施肥 — — 即用灌溉技术输送液体肥料。
en: Cooperatives also allow farmers to benefit from previously unavailable techniques such as fertigation – using irrigation to deliver liquid fertilizers.

zh: 最后，合作社让气候智能型技术变得更加平价。
en: Finally, cooperatives make climate-smart technologies more affordable.

zh: 有了新数字技术，农民能够更好地管理他们的土地、水和能源使用，为坏天气做好准备。
en: With new digital technologies, farmers can better manage their land, water, and energy use, and prepare for bad weather.

zh: 比如，菲律宾尝试推广向农民推送动植物病虫害消息、买卖农场产出的最佳场所的信息以及天气事件预警的应用。
en: For example, the Philippines has experimented with apps that give farmers news about plant and animal diseases, the best places to buy and sell farm supplies, and upcoming weather events.

zh: 通过更少使用劳动力、更多使用资本和技术，亚洲的未来农场能够种出足够的粮食养活亚洲地区的所有人。
en: By using less labor, and more capital and technology, Asia’s future farms can grow enough food to feed everyone in the region.

zh: 合作社是将这一愿景转化为现实的一个办法。
en: Cooperatives are one way to make this vision a reality.

zh: 惟其如此，粮食短缺才能真正成为历史。
en: Only then will food shortages truly be a thing of the past.

zh: 不愉快的亚洲周年庆
en: Asia’s Unhappy Anniversary

zh: 普罗旺斯的埃克斯—本月是亚洲金融危机 — — 或者更准确地说，是引发这场危机的事件，即泰铢贬值，爆发20周年。
en: AIX EN PROVENCE – This month marks the 20th anniversary of the Asian financial crisis – or, more precisely, of the event that triggered the crisis: the devaluation of Thailand’s baht.

zh: 这样的周年庆绝不是值得庆祝的理由，但它们至少提供了一个机会，让我们回顾这些年来有哪些事情发生了改变 — — 以及同样重要的，有哪些事情没有发生改变。
en: While such anniversaries are not exactly cause for celebration, they at least afford an opportunity to look back and examine what has changed – and, no less important, what hasn’t.

zh: 危机的原因在当时就众说纷纭，现在仍然如此。
en: The causes of the crisis were contested at the time, and they remain contested to this day.

zh: 西方观察者认为应该归咎于亚洲国家缺少透明度，以及过于紧密的政企关系 — — 他们称之为“裙带资本主义 ” 。
en: Western observers placed the blame on Asian countries’ lack of transparency and on overly close relations between firms and governments – what they described as “crony capitalism.”

zh: 而亚洲评论家批评对冲基金动摇了地区金融市场，而国际货币基金组织（IMF）开除的药方几乎将病人置于死地。
en: Asian commentators, for their part, blamed hedge funds for destabilizing regional financial markets and the International Monetary Fund for prescribing a course of treatment that nearly killed the patient.

zh: 两种观点都有一定的合理性。
en: There is some validity to both viewpoints.

zh: 泰国银行公开的资产负债表大夸大了它所能调用的外汇储备 — — 这对于金融透明度来说可不是什么好例子。
en: The Bank of Thailand’s published balance sheet wildly exaggerated its available foreign-exchange reserves – hardly a shining example of financial transparency.

zh: 外国投机客积极地下注做空泰铢，其中干部进包括对冲基金，也有投资银行，甚至有一家投资银行，同时也在向泰国政府提出如何保卫其货币的建议。
en: Foreign speculators actively bet against the baht, and the short sellers included not just hedge funds but also investment banks, including one that was simultaneously advising the Thai government on how to defend its currency.

zh: 而在向亚洲国家建议如何管理这场危机时，IMF也犯了错误 — — 应该指出，这绝不是它最后一次犯错 — — 它提出的财政紧缩过于严厉。
en: And when counseling Asian countries on how to manage the crisis, the IMF erred – not for the last time, it should be noted – in the direction of too much fiscal austerity.

zh: 在更加基本的层面上，这场危机反映了亚洲的历史增长模式与当前环境的错配。
en: At a more fundamental level, the crisis reflected the mismatch between Asia’s historic growth model and its current circumstances.

zh: 其历史增长模式强调汇率稳定，亚洲国家视汇率稳定为出口扩张的必要条件。
en: That model emphasized stable exchange rates, which were seen as necessary for the expansion of exports.

zh: 历史增长模式也强调投资 — — 不管两位数的增长需不需要投资。
en: It stressed investment – however much was required for double-digit growth.

zh: 历史增长模式还鼓励对外借贷，视之为位必要的资本形成水平融资的手段。
en: And it encouraged foreign borrowing as needed to finance the requisite level of capital formation.

zh: 但在1997年，东南亚经济体的发展阶段决定了光靠强力投资已经不足以保持高增长率。
en: But by 1997 the Southeast Asian economies had reached a stage of development at which brute-force investment alone was no longer enough to sustain high growth rates.

zh: 依赖对外借贷的增长模式忽视了风险。
en: In relying on foreign borrowing, their growth model neglected the risks.

zh: 与此同时，外部力量也加剧了问题。
en: External forces, meanwhile, compounded the problem.

zh: 经合组织接受韩国的要求是其政府取消资本管制，这让韩国经济暴露在短期“热钱”流入的风险下。
en: South Korea’s admission to the OECD required its government to dismantle capital controls, exposing the economy to inflows of short-term “hot money.”

zh: 更一般地说，各国都受到了IMF和美国财政部取消资本流动限制的压力，这放大了风险，也让维持盯住汇率制度的问题变得更大。
en: More generally, countries felt pressure from the IMF and the US Treasury to remove capital-flow restrictions, which magnified the risks and made maintaining pegged exchange rates still more problematic.

zh: 这一危机速写突显出此后20年所发生的巨大的变化。
en: This sketch of the crisis highlights how much has changed over the subsequent 20 years.

zh: 首先，危及国将投资率和增长预期降低到了可持续水平。
en: For starters, the crisis countries have ratcheted down their investment rates and growth expectations to sustainable levels.

zh: 亚洲各国政府仍然强调增长，但不再不惜一切代价。
en: Asian governments still emphasize growth, but not at any cost.

zh: 其次，东南亚国家现在的汇率制度灵活了许多。
en: Second, Southeast Asian countries now have more flexible exchange rates.

zh: 平心而论，完全弹性的汇率是不存在的，但该地区政府至少都排起了僵化的盯住美元政策。 盯住美元使得它们在1997年不堪一击。
en: None is perfectly flexible, to be sure, but the region’s governments have at least abandoned the rigid dollar pegs that were the source of such vulnerability in 1997.

zh: 第三，泰国这样的国家，曾经存在巨大的外部赤字，这加剧了它们对外部融资的依赖。
en: Third, countries like Thailand that were running large external deficits, heightening their dependence on foreign finance, are now running surpluses.

zh: 如今，它们处于盈余状态。 盈余帮助它们积累了外汇储备，可以作为一种保险。
en: Running surpluses has helped them accumulate foreign-exchange reserves, which serve as a form of insurance.

zh: 第四，亚洲国家正在合作为地区筑造防护墙。
en: Fourth, Asian countries are now working together to ring-fence the region.

zh: 2000年危机刚刚过去，它们就成立了清迈计划（Chiang Mai Initiative ） ， 这是一个地区性金融信用和互换网络。
en: In 2000, in the wake of the crisis, they created the Chiang Mai Initiative, a regional network of financial credits and swaps.

zh: 如今，它们还有亚洲基础设施投资银行进行发展融资的地区安排。
en: And now they have the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to regionalize the provision of development finance as well.

zh: 这些计划可以理解为亚洲对IMF带来的不愉快经历的反应。
en: These initiatives can be understood as a reaction to Asia’s unhappy experience with the IMF.

zh: 从更根本上说，它们反映了中国的崛起。
en: More fundamentally, they reflect the emergence of China.

zh: 1997年，中国尚未确定其地区角色，对于日本提出的亚洲货币基金（Asian Monetary Fund）计划不是很热衷。
en: In 1997, a China still uncertain of its regional role was not a vocal supporter of the Japanese plan for an Asian Monetary Fund.

zh: 由于缺少中国的支持，亚洲货币基金计划最终夭折。
en: Its lack of support ultimately sealed the fate of that proposal.

zh: 此后，中国自信心和领导力的增长助其在地区机构建设和合作中一马当先。
en: Subsequently, China’s growing self-confidence and leadership helped to spearhead regional institution building and cooperation.

zh: 这一变化的背景是20年来中国强劲的经济增长，也是危机后对亚洲影响最大的变化。
en: This change, occurring against the backdrop of 20 years of robust Chinese growth, is the most consequential change affecting Asia since the crisis.

zh: 但如果中国的崛起表明了变化的程度，那么它同样表明了没有变化的程度。
en: But if the emergence of China signifies how much has changed, it is also a reminder of how much remains the same.

zh: 中国的经济模式仍然强调增长目标，也仍然依靠高投资实现增长目标。
en: China is still wedded to a model that prioritizes a target rate of growth, and it still relies on high investment to hit that target.

zh: 只要又需要，中国政府就会保持流动性供应，以确保经济引擎不熄火，这让人想起了泰国在危机爆发前的做法。
en: The government maintains liquidity provision at whatever levels are needed to keep the economic engine humming, in a manner dangerously reminiscent of what Thailand was doing before its crisis.

zh: 中国政府对离岸借贷管制的放松速度已经超过了审慎的幅度，因此有政府关系的中国企业，外部债务水平很高。
en: Because China’s government relaxed restrictions on offshore borrowing faster than was prudent, Chinese enterprises with links to the government have high levels of foreign debt.

zh: 而中国仍然不愿意让人民币实现浮动，而这让中国企业更加不愿意杜绝大量积累外币计价负债。
en: And there is still a reluctance to let the currency float, something that would discourage Chinese firms from accumulating such large foreign-currency-denominated obligations.

zh: 如今，中国正处于其东南亚邻国在20年前所处的位置：和它们一样，中国的固有增长模式走得太远了。
en: China is now at the same point as its Southeast Asian neighbors 20 years ago: like them, it has outgrown its inherited growth model.

zh: 我们希望中国领导人能够汲取亚洲危机的教训。
en: We have to hope that Chinese leaders have studied the Asian crisis.

zh: 否则，他们必然会重蹈覆辙。
en: Otherwise they are doomed to repeat it.

zh: 东北亚内政之火在燃烧
en: Northeast Asia’s Home Fires Burning

zh: 东京—成功的外交峰会几乎总是周详备至的，会议的各个方面，从一开始的握手到最后的公报，都可以精确到分钟。
en: TOKYO – Successful diplomatic summits are almost always pre-cooked affairs, with every aspect of the meeting, from the initial handshakes to the final communiqué, minutely choreographed.

zh: 但下个月的亚太经济合作会议（APEC）北京峰会却似乎是一起高风险事件。
en: But next month’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Beijing looks like a high-risk enterprise.

zh: 甚至不清楚中国国家主席习近平是否会同意与其最重要的宾客之一日本首相安倍晋三会晤。
en: It is not even clear whether Chinese President Xi Jinping will agree to meet with one of his most important guests, Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe.

zh: 安倍是否能与韩国总统朴槿惠会晤也是个疑问。
en: It is also unclear whether Abe will be able to meet with South Korean President Park Geun-hye.

zh: 但也有很强的理由期待东北亚“三大”领导人之间不但会有正式的握手和双边会晤，还会有旨在缓和地区紧张局势的重要对话。
en: And yet there is considerable reason to hope not only for formal handshakes and bilateral meetings among Northeast Asia’s “Big Three” leaders, but also for substantive discussions aimed at lowering tensions in the region.

zh: 如此期待是因为这三位领导人都需要外交平静期以处理各自目前所面临的困难的国内挑战。
en: That hope is built on all three leaders’ need for a period of diplomatic quiet, owing to the difficult domestic challenges that each now faces.

zh: 习近平也许面临着最艰难的国内日程：设计相对平滑的转型过程，让经济结构从基于制造业和出口转向依靠国内消费和服务助推增长。
en: Xi may be confronting the most difficult domestic agenda: an effort to engineer a relatively smooth transition from an economic structure based on manufacturing and exports to one in which domestic consumption and services fuel growth.

zh: 这一结构转型不但导致了经济减速，还暴露了中国金融体系的深刻缺陷。
en: Not only has structural transformation caused the economy to slow; it has also exposed deep flaws in China’s financial system.

zh: 中国经济模式的转变即使在最佳环境下也是十分困难的。
en: The shift in the country’s economic model would be difficult in the best of circumstances.

zh: 但与此同时，中国还面临着自毛泽东时代以来最深刻的整风运动，习近平的目标直指各个级别的腐败官员。
en: But it is being undertaken simultaneously with the deepest political purge China has experienced since the days of Mao Zedong, with Xi targeting corrupt officials high and low.

zh: 眼下的焦点对准了解放军军官以及与已身陷囹圄的前重庆市委书记薄熙来和等待审判的前政治局常委周永康有关系的官员。
en: At the moment, the focus seems to be on People’s Liberation Army officers and those tied to now-imprisoned former Chongqing Communist Party boss Bo Xilai and the former Politburo security chief Zhou Yongkang, who is awaiting sentencing.

zh: 事实上，习近平的整风运动也许正在经历最危险的时刻 ， — —最近，成都军区副司令员被拿下，他的职位至关重要，因为成都军区需要负责地域广袤、桀骜不驯的藏区。
en: Indeed, the most perilous phase of Xi’s purge may now be underway, given the recent arrest of the deputy commander of the Sichuan Military District – a key post, given the district’s large and restive Tibetan population.

zh: 众所周知，安倍的国内麻烦来自二十年的经济停滞。
en: Abe’s domestic troubles, stemming from two decades of economic stagnation, are well known.

zh: 尽管他的经济战略 — — 所谓的“安倍经济学”似乎已经终止了通缩，但强劲增长还远未到来。
en: Although his economic strategy, known as “Abenomics,” appears to have ended deflation, vibrant growth is nowhere in sight.

zh: 此外，在一系列丑闻导致安倍新任命的内阁大臣纷纷下台后，有人担心他可能不再准备按部就班实施维持经济复苏所需要的自由化结构改革，即所谓的安倍经济学的“第三支箭 ” 。
en: Moreover, after a series of scandals cost Abe some newly appointed ministers, some fear that he may no longer be willing to follow through on the liberalizing structural reforms – the so-called “third arrow” of Abenomics – that sustained economic recovery requires.

zh: 朴槿惠的国内情况也许是三人中最好的，2014年二季度，韩国经济增长年率为3.2 % ， 只比市场预期略低。
en: Park may appear to face the least vexing domestic conditions, with South Korea’s economy growing at a 3.2% annual pace in the second quarter of 2014, only marginally lower than market forecasts.

zh: 但毫无疑问，朴槿惠并不认为她的国内环境很乐观；从很多角度看，这是她和她的国家多灾多难的一年。
en: But Park undoubtedly views her domestic circumstances as anything but rosy; in many ways, this has been an annus horribilis for her and her country.

zh: 事实上，今年韩国饱受灾难困扰，一开始是4月的岁月号（Sewol）客轮沉没，导致300人死亡，其中大部分是高中生。
en: Indeed, disaster has stalked South Korea this year, beginning in April with the sinking of the ferry Sewol, which claimed some 300 lives, most of them high school students.

zh: 岁月号船长的被捕、岁月号船东的死亡（显然是自杀 ） 、 以及一系列导致士兵死亡和自杀的虐待和殴打丑闻导致朴槿惠政府重要部长辞职，也造成了普遍的对其治国水平担忧。
en: The trial of the Sewol’s captain, the apparent suicide of its owner, and a series of scandals involving beatings and bullying leading to death and suicide among army conscripts have cost Park key ministerial resignations, and have created a pervasive sense of unease about how the country is governed.

zh: 让情况更加复杂的是朴槿惠需要找到可行的应对之道来对付常常毫无魅力可言的朝鲜领导人金正恩的外交魅力攻势。
en: Complicating matters further is the need for Park to devise a viable response to a new diplomatic charm offensive by North Korea’s usually charmless leader, Kim Jong-un.

zh: 朴槿惠正确地对金正恩的动机保持怀疑；但朝鲜二号人物在本月早些时候出现在亚运会的场景给人们带来了一丝兴奋之情 — — 也许小金真的希望改善朝韩关系。
en: Park remains, rightly, a skeptic concerning Kim’s motives; but the spectacle of the North’s second-highest-ranking official appearing suddenly at the Asian Games earlier this month created a frisson of excitement that perhaps Kim the Younger may actually want to improve relations.

zh: 面临这些国内问题的三位领导人需要暂时缓和在过去三年中让三国交恶的紧张局势。
en: Faced with these domestic concerns, all three leaders need a respite from the tensions that have bedeviled relations among their countries over the past three years.

zh: 但是，由于三方都对目前的紧张局势负有责任 — — 特别是与日本的紧张局势，中韩需要以此控制国内反对派 — — 实现这一必要的缓和也许十分困难。
en: But, because each has played on these tensions, particularly with Japan, in order to control their domestic opponents, achieving this necessary respite may prove difficult.

zh: 但有迹象表明三位领导人都明白APEC峰会也许是决定三国关系走向的时刻。
en: And yet there are signs that the three leaders understand that the APEC summit may be a make-or-break moment for their countries’ relations.

zh: 最近几周，中国电视屏幕上已不再有最糟糕的反日宣传，前日本首相福田康夫将在本周在北京与习近平举行会晤。
en: Much of the worst anti-Japanese bombast has disappeared from Chinese television in recent weeks, and former Japanese Prime Minister Yasuo Fukuda is due to meet with Xi in Beijing this week.

zh: 这并不意味着双边关系开始解冻，但确实表明习近平也许在寻求缓和，至少在中国经济立足更稳、其反腐运动进入收官阶段之前需要缓和。
en: This does not yet add up to a thaw in the bilateral relationship, but it does suggest that Xi may be seeking a respite, at least until China’s economy is on a more stable footing and his anti-corruption campaign begins to wind down.

zh: 朴槿惠也释放出希望缓和紧张局面的信号。
en: Park, too, has sent signals that she may want to ease tensions.

zh: 最近她与前日本财相额贺福志郎以及朝鲜国家安保室长金宽镇举行了会晤，最近与安倍国家安全顾问谷内正太郎举行了会晤。
en: She recently met with former Japanese finance minister Fukushiro Nukaga, and Kim Kwan-jin, the chief of South Korea’s National Security Office, recently met with Abe’s national security adviser, Shotaro Yachi.

zh: 安倍、朴槿惠和习近平都面临着各自国内的艰巨挑战，三国自身利益和国家利益的罕见趋同可能正在形成改善三国关系的良机。
en: With Abe, Park, and Xi each facing daunting domestic challenges, a rare convergence in each country of self-interest and national interest may be creating a chance for improved relations.

zh: 现在的问题是东北亚三大领导人是否能够克服旧立场，把手言欢，认真对待地区外交。
en: The question now is whether Northeast Asia’s Big Three leaders can overcome old positions, shake hands, and get serious about regional diplomacy.

zh: 动荡时期的亚洲经济增长
en: Asian Growth in Turbulent Times

zh: 新德里 — 新的现实正在出现。
en: NEW DELHI – A new reality is emerging in Asia.

zh: 近几十年来，许多亚洲经济体都实现了繁荣。
en: In recent decades, many of Asia’s economies have boomed.

zh: 该地区占全球GDP的比重从1990年的25％提高到目前的约40 ％ ， 对全球经济增长的贡献约为三分之二。
en: The region today accounts for about 40% of the world’s GDP – up from 25% in 1990 – and contributes about two-thirds of global economic growth.

zh: 不仅如此，亚洲在减贫和改善广义发展指标方面也取得了前所未有的进展。
en: There’s more. Asia has made unprecedented strides in reducing poverty and improving broad development indicators.

zh: 贫困率从1990年的55％下降到2010年的21 ％ ， 而教育和医疗卫生事业也显著改善。
en: The poverty rate fell from 55% in 1990 to 21% in 2010, while education and health outcomes have improved significantly.

zh: 在此过程中，数以亿计人口的生活水平得以提高。
en: Hundreds of millions of lives have been improved in the process.

zh: 展望未来，预计亚洲将继续保持年均5％的增速，引领全球经济扩张。
en: And, looking ahead, Asia is expected to continue to grow at an average annual rate of 5%, leading global economic expansion.

zh: 但如今，在新的经济形势中，该地区正面临挑战。
en: But today, the region is facing challenging new economic conditions.

zh: 发达经济体增长乏力，全球金融市场避险情绪上升，大宗商品的超级周期即将结束，全球经济形势对亚洲增长几无推动作用。
en: With growth in advanced economies tepid, risk aversion increasing in global financial markets, and the commodity super-cycle coming to an end, the world economy is providing little impetus to Asian growth.

zh: 与此同时，中国正向更可持续的增长模式转型，而这意味着增速将放缓。
en: At the same time, China is moving toward a more sustainable growth model that implies slower expansion.

zh: 鉴于中国与世界其他国家，特别是亚洲国家的联系日益密切，中国增速放缓将带来显著的溢出效应。
en: Given the growing links between China and the rest of the world, particularly Asia, the spillover effects are significant.

zh: 中国目前是大多数主要地区经济体，特别是东亚和东盟的第一大贸易伙伴。
en: Indeed, China is now the top trading partner of most major regional economies, particularly in East Asia and ASEAN.

zh: 基金组织即将在2016年4月期《亚太地区经济展望》中发布一份新研究，其指出：典型亚洲国家经济对中国GDP的敏感度在过去几十年翻了一番。
en: New research by the International Monetary Fund, to be published in next month’s Regional Economic Outlook for Asia and the Pacific, suggests that the median Asian country’s economic sensitivity to China’s GDP has doubled in the last couple of decades.

zh: 因而，中国经济放缓意味着整个亚洲的增速也将放缓。
en: So China’s slowdown means a slower pace of growth across Asia.

zh: 近几十年来亚洲的成绩是该地区人民辛勤劳动的印证，也归功于该地区许多国家政府自上世纪90年代末以来采取的稳健政策措施，包括改善货币政策和汇率框架、增加国际储备缓冲以及加强金融部门监管。
en: Asia’s achievements in recent decades attest to the hard work of the region’s people, as well as to the soundness of the policies that many Asian governments have adopted since the late 1990s, including improved monetary-policy and exchange-rate frameworks, increased international reserve buffers, and stronger financial sector regulation and supervision.

zh: 在此背景下，该地区吸引了大量的外国直接投资。
en: Against this backdrop, the region attracted vast amounts of foreign direct investment.

zh: 随着贸易联系日益紧密，一个更复杂的一体化供应链网络已经出现，为亚洲成为制造业巨擘以及出口更多服务创造了条件。
en: As trade links expanded, a sophisticated network of integrated supply chains emerged, creating the conditions for Asia to become a manufacturing powerhouse and, increasingly, an exporter of services as well.

zh: 最近，得益于有力的政策和充裕的储备，该地区迅速从全球金融危机中复苏。
en: More recently, thanks to strong policies and ample reserves, the region quickly recovered from the global financial crisis.

zh: 这些年中，亚洲也受益于全球强劲的利好因素，包括有利的外部融资条件以及中国经济的快速增长。
en: Asia also benefited during these years from strong global tailwinds, including favorable external financing conditions and the rapid expansion of the Chinese economy.

zh: 在亚洲面临新现实的考验时，我们不能忽视该地区面临的深刻而长期的结构性挑战。
en: Amid this new testing reality now dawning in Asia, we must not lose sight of the deep, and long term, structural challenges facing the region.

zh: 人口在迅速老龄化，在日本、韩国、新加坡和泰国等国家，人口甚至在下降，因此拖累了增长潜力，并给财政收支平衡造成压力。
en: Populations are rapidly aging and even declining in countries like Japan, Korea, Singapore, and Thailand, dragging down potential growth and putting pressure on fiscal balances.

zh: 收入不平等是另一个挑战。
en: Income inequality is a further challenge.

zh: 虽然马来西亚、泰国和菲律宾的收入不平等状况已经稳定或有所下降，但在该地区的许多地方，特别是在印度和中国（以及东亚其他国家 ） ， 收入不平等正在上升。
en: While inequality has remained stable or declined in Malaysia, Thailand, and the Philippines, it is rising in many parts of the region, most notably in India and China (as well as other parts of East Asia).

zh: 许多新兴市场和发展中国家还持续存在广泛的基础设施缺口，电力和运输领域尤甚。
en: In many emerging markets and developing countries, widespread infrastructure gaps persist, notably in power and transport.

zh: 在该地区其他地方，特别是小型的太平洋岛屿国家，对气候变化效应的脆弱性正在增加。
en: And, elsewhere in the region – the small Pacific islands in particular – vulnerability to the effects of climate change is increasing.

zh: 鉴于格局的这些转变，需在几个方面采取大胆行动。
en: This shifting landscape calls for bold action on several fronts.

zh: 具体应对措施无疑会因国而异，而一些建议可能会对大多数国家有所帮助：
en: While the response will certainly need to be tailored to each country’s specific circumstances, some recommendations could be helpful for most countries:

zh: •                     由于该地区大部分国家的通胀水平依然较低，货币政策应在下行风险出现时继续支持经济增长。
en: · Because inflation remains low across most of the region, monetary policy should remain supportive of growth in case downside risks materialize.

zh: •                     汇率灵活性和有针对性的宏观审慎政策应是风险管理工具箱的一部分。
en: · Exchange-rate flexibility and targeted macroprudential policies should be part of the risk-management toolkit.

zh: •                     各国需深化金融体系，引导国内和该地区的大量储蓄为发展需求融资；例如，消除该地区的基础设施缺口仍然至关重要。
en: · Countries need to deepen their financial systems to channel the large pool of domestic and regional savings toward financing their development needs; closing the region’s infrastructure gaps, for example, remains critical.

zh: •                     在财政政策的支持下，结构性改革应支持经济转型和再平衡调整，同时提高潜在增长和减贫。
en: · Structural reforms, aided by fiscal policy, should support the economic transitions and rebalancing, while boosting potential growth and alleviating poverty.

zh: 好的消息是，鉴于近年来经济表现强劲，亚洲能够应对上述挑战，在过去二十年所取得令人瞩目成就的基础上更上一层楼。
en: The good news is that Asia, as demonstrated by its strong performance in recent years, can meet these challenges and continue to build upon the significant achievements of the past two decades.

zh: 亚洲地区既拥有自然资源和人力资本，又具备缓冲和应变能力，更拥有进一步提高贸易和金融一体化的充足机会。
en: It has the resources and the people; it has the buffers and resilience; and it has ample opportunities for further trade and financial integration.

zh: 为讨论这些挑战，印度政府和基金组织将于3月11-13日在印度新德里举办一场题为 “推进亚洲发展”的会议，将邀请该地区的政策制定者和思想家参会。
en: To discuss these challenges, the government of India and the IMF are organizing the Advancing Asia conference in New Delhi on March 11-13, bringing together regional policymakers and thinkers.

zh: 作为困难时期新兴市场的一个亮点，印度的确是世界上增长最快的主要经济体，因此它是举办此次会议的一个吉祥场所。
en: India, a bright spot among emerging markets in these difficult times – indeed, the world’s fastest growing major economy – is an auspicious place to hold this gathering.

zh: 与亚洲的政策制定者齐聚一堂，我们有着明确的共同目标，其对亚洲乃至全球经济都至关重要：确保亚洲的增长依然强劲、可持续和具有包容性，从而使该地区在全球增长中继续保持强大的火车头作用。
en: Our mutual aim in convening with Asian policymakers is clear and critical, for Asia and for the global economy: to ensure that growth in Asia continues to be robust, sustainable, and inclusive, so that the region remains a powerful locomotive for global growth.

zh: 风暴袭向亚洲
en: Asia Enters the Storm

zh: 伯克利 — — 在2011年行将结束之际，有越来越多的迹象表明，亚洲正在陷入全球减速，该地区经济体可以与欧洲和美国复苏乏力的长时间衰退“脱钩”的希望越来越渺茫。
en: BERKELEY – As 2011 draws to a close, there are growing signs that Asia is becoming caught up in the global slowdown, dashing hopes that the region’s economies would “decouple” from the prolonged recession in Europe and America’s lackluster recovery.

zh: 中国出口增长正在下滑，主要原因是超越美国成为中国最大海外市场的欧洲的需求在消退。
en: China’s export growth is slipping, owing to faltering demand in Europe, which has surpassed the United States as China’s largest foreign market.

zh: 事实上，中国制造业活动出现了近3年来的首次下滑。
en: Indeed, China’s manufacturing activity is contracting for the first time in almost three years.

zh: 依赖中国生产者和欧美市场的其他新兴亚洲经济体的反应也相当强烈。
en: Reverberations are already evident in other emerging Asian economies that depend on exports both to China-based manufacturers and to the US and Europe.

zh: 2008年并没有发生脱钩，当时，在泛亚洲GDP（不含日本）中，出口要占大约45 % ， 随着世界贸易量的剧烈萎缩，该地区的所有新兴经济体都经历了大幅衰退。
en: Decoupling did not occur in 2008, when exports accounted for about 45% of pan-Asian GDP (excluding Japan) and every emerging country in the region experienced a sharp contraction in growth as world trade plummeted.

zh: 如今，脱钩也不可能发生，因为出口占该地区GDP的比重并为下降，且其中50%的出口对象是发达国家。
en: Nor is decoupling likely today, because exports still account for about the same share of the region’s GDP, and about 50% of these exports are still headed to developed countries.

zh: 因此，脱钩的构想完全是镜花水月。
en: So the idea of decoupling appears to be a chimera.

zh: 即使欧元危机得到了解决，欧洲的紧缩和美国的疲软仍意味着依赖出口的亚洲会减速。
en: Even if the euro crisis is resolved, austerity in Europe, along with anemic growth or worse in the US, will mean a slowdown in export-dependent Asia.

zh: 但亚洲经济体仍能以比发达西方快得多的速度增长，如果它们通过转向内需（特别是家庭消费）实现增长再平衡以应对出口的长期停滞的话。
en: But Asia’s economies can still grow much faster than the developed West if they respond to prolonged stagnation by rebalancing their growth toward internal demand, especially household consumption.

zh: 好消息是，这些经济体有很大的再平衡空间，也有足够的政策灵活度来实现它。
en: The good news is that these economies have substantial room for such rebalancing, as well as the policy flexibility to accomplish it.

zh: 这些经济体消费占GDP的比重从20世纪80年代初的60%多下降到了如今的不到50 % 。
en: The share of consumption in GDP in these economies fell from more than 60% in the early 1980’s to less than 50% today.

zh: 中国更是只有不到40 % ， 远低于世界主要经济体的平均水平，也低于处于可比发展阶段的亚洲经济体，虽然近年来其人均消费平均年增长率接近7 % 。
en: In China, it is less than 40% – far below the norm for the world’s major economies and for other Asian economies at a comparable stage of development – despite nearly 7% annual average growth in China’s per capita consumption in recent years.

zh: 亚洲经济体拥有35亿消费者，但它们的全球消费比重却依然很低，远不如其全球GDP比重。
en: The Asian economies are home to 3.5 billion consumers, but their share in global consumption remains small – much smaller than their share in global GDP.

zh: 中国一国就拥有20%的世界人口和11%的世界GDP，但其消费额只占全球的3 % 。
en: China alone accounts for 20% of the world’s population, nearly 11% of global GDP, but only 3% of global consumption.

zh: 中国和其他大部分新兴亚洲经济体都有着相当健康的政府资产负债表，预算赤字和公共债务占GDP的比重相对较小。
en: China and most of the other emerging Asian economies have strong government balance sheets – the GDP shares of their budget deficits and public debt are relatively small.

zh: 因此它们有的是财政实力通过提振消费减轻出口下降的影响。
en: As a result, they have the fiscal firepower to boost consumption in order to mitigate the effects of declining exports.

zh: 诚然，不少中国地方政府深受债务困扰，其中一些可能需要重组。
en: True, many local governments in China are saddled with debt, some of which may need to be restructured.

zh: 但中央政府去年财政收入增长高达28 % ， 而且握有超过3万亿美元的外汇储备。
en: But the central government enjoyed a 28% increase in revenues over the last year, and has more than $3 trillion in foreign-exchange reserves.

zh: 此外，全球经济放缓和商品市场冷却让通胀压力有所缓解，这将使中国和其他亚洲国家决策者能够将注意力从治理经济过热转向实现增长再平衡。
en: In addition, the moderation of inflationary pressure as a result of slower growth and cooling global commodity markets will allow Chinese and other Asian policymakers to shift their focus from containing economic overheating to rebalancing growth.

zh: 中国的通胀就出现了显著下降，货币政策也开始转向宽松。
en: In China, where inflation is falling sharply, monetary policy has already begun to ease.

zh: 不过，尽管有政策的大力支持，大部分小型亚洲经济体 — — 台湾、泰国、新加坡甚至包括韩国 — — 也无法向中国那样以内需替代外需。
en: Even with significant policy support, however, most of the smaller Asian economies – Taiwan, Thailand, Singapore, and even South Korea – will not be able to replace external demand with internal demand to the same extent that China can.

zh: 因此，即使实施了再平衡措施，出口仍将是这些国家的重要增长支柱，而中国已然成为了它们的主要出口市场。
en: So, even with rebalancing, exports will remain a significant determinant of their growth, and China is already their major export market.

zh: 这就是为何中国的再平衡不仅事关其自身的经济，也事关以中国为中心的亚洲。
en: That is why China’s rebalancing is so important not only for its own economy, but for all of China-centric Asia.

zh: 过去十年来，该地区内部贸易流出现了爆发式增长，但其主要模式是零件和半成品输入中国，再由中国组装后出口发达国家。
en: Intra-regional trade flows have surged during the last decade, but they have been concentrated in parts and components that go into finished products assembled in China for export to developed countries.

zh: 随着发达世界市场的萎缩，未来的地区内贸易将更多地依赖满足中国内需的出口。
en: With depressed markets in the developed world, intra-regional trade in the future will depend more on exports to satisfy Chinese domestic demand.

zh: 而在这一方面也存在乐观因素：近几年来，中国从亚洲经济体的进口增速要快于中国对美国的出口增速。
en: Again, there is cause for optimism: China’s imports from Asia have been growing faster than China’s exports to the US for the last several years.

zh: 为了应对2009年全球放缓，中国抛出了大规模财政和货币刺激，助长了国内和整个亚洲的投资拉动型快速复苏。
en: China responded to the 2009 global slowdown with dramatic fiscal and monetary stimulus, which fueled a rapid investment-led recovery at home and throughout Asia.

zh: 投资 — — 主要由容易获得银行融资的地方政府和国有企业进行 — — 占GDP的比重暴增到45 % ， 且主要集中在基础设施和房地产开发项目，这和中国的长期城市化战略是一致的。
en: Investment, mainly by local governments and state-owned companies with easy access to bank financing, soared to more than 45% of GDP, and, consistent with China’s long-run urbanization strategy, was concentrated in infrastructure and property-development projects.

zh: 假以时日，如此产能扩张总有一天能被吸收，因为据预计，未来十年每年会有1 500万人口从农村迁往城市。
en: Over time, much of the expansion in capacity will be absorbed, as an estimated 15 million people move from rural to urban areas each year over the next decade.

zh: 但是，眼下，许多投资项目并不能产生足够的收入偿付债务（有的甚至永远无法偿还 ） ， 而且造成了大量的产能过剩。
en: But, for now, many investment projects are not yet generating enough income to service their debts (some of them never will), and there is significant spare capacity.

zh: 在未来多年中，中国需要面对全球再次放缓、其出口市场进一步收缩的局面，因此必须不惜以冷却投资为代价提振消费，���不能依赖过度的信贷扩张来实现这一目标。
en: Confronted with another global slowdown that could depress its export markets for years, China needs to boost consumption even as it cools investment. And it needs to so in ways that do not rely on excessive credit expansion.

zh: 将于2012年开始产生效果的中国十二五规划认识到了这些政策的必要性，也提出了一些手段应对，包括城市工人的工资增加计划、农村家庭收入支持计划、中小企业（特别是欠发达的服务业）资本渠道融通计划以及实惠的社会福利计划，这些手段将降低中国家庭极高的预防性储蓄水平。
en: China’s 12th Five-Year Plan, which will take effect in 2012, recognizes these policy imperatives and calls for several measures to fulfill them, including wage increases for urban workers; income support for rural households; enhanced access to capital for small businesses, especially in the underbuilt services sector; and more generous social-welfare programs, which would reduce Chinese households’ high levels of precautionary saving.

zh: 这些手段均已进入了实施阶段，且中国领导人似乎下定了决心要推行能让中国人民和整个亚洲都能从中获益的新的增长战略。
en: All of these measures are already underway, and Chinese leaders appear committed to embracing a new growth strategy that will benefit both China’s population and Asia as a whole.

zh: 从短期看，亚洲经济体无望能与欧美经济困境脱钩。
en: The Asian economies should not count on being able to decouple from the economic woes of Europe and the US in the short run.

zh: 但假以时日，发达国家的困境很有可能会刺激亚洲转向更加健康的发展战略（尽管有些迟 ） ， 而中国将是其中的领军国家。
en: But there are promising signs that, over time, the advanced countries’ difficulties will trigger a healthy, if belated, shift in Asia’s development strategy, with China leading the way.

zh: 陷于危局的亚洲
en: Asia Exposed

zh: 纽黑文—不难理解，亚洲各国政府在2008—2009年金融危机后颇有些自鸣得意。
en: NEW HAVEN – Asian authorities were understandably smug in the aftermath of the financial crisis of 2008-2009.

zh: 该地区的增长迅速放缓，这并不出人意料，因为这些出口导向的经济体面对的是自20世纪30年代以来最严重的全球贸易崩溃。
en: Growth in the region slowed sharply, as might be expected of export-led economies confronted with the sharpest collapse in global trade since the 1930’s.

zh: 但是，除了日本这一显著的例外之外（它陷入了现代化以来最严重的衰退 ） ， 亚洲在整个艰难时期的表现极为出色。
en: But, with the notable exception of Japan, which suffered its deepest recession of the modern era, Asia came through an extraordinarily tough period in excellent shape.

zh: 但彼一时，此一时。
en: That was then.

zh: 不到四年后，亚洲再一次经受了严重的外部需求冲击。
en: For the second time in less than four years, Asia is being hit with a major external demand shock.

zh: 这一回冲击来自欧洲。 肆虐欧洲的主权债务危机似乎要把小规模衰退变成一场大危机：希腊可能退出欧元区，这将在整个欧元区引发动荡蔓延。
en: This time it is from Europe, where a raging sovereign-debt crisis threatens to turn a mild recession into something far worse: a possible Greek exit from the euro, which could trigger contagion across the eurozone.

zh: 对亚洲来说，兹事体大。
en: This is a big deal for Asia.

zh: 金融和贸易上的联系使得亚洲对欧洲的萎靡不振非常敏感。
en: Financial and trade linkages make Asia highly vulnerable to Europe’s malaise.

zh: 因此，对于亚洲来说，欧洲银行危机绝对不容小觑。
en: Owing to the former, the risks to Asia from a European banking crisis cannot be taken lightly.

zh: 亚洲缺乏发达的资本市场作为信用的替代来源，因此银行融资渠道对亚洲来说尤为重要。
en: Lacking well-developed capital markets as an alternative source of credit, bank-funding channels are especially vital in Asia.

zh: 事实上，亚洲开发银行估计欧洲银行提供了亚洲发展中国家9%的国内信用总量，是美资银行的三倍。
en: Indeed, the Asian Development Bank estimates that European banks fund about 9% of total domestic credit in developing Asia – three times the share of financing provided by banks based in the United States.

zh: 欧洲银行在亚洲两大金融中心 — — 新加坡和香港尤其重要。
en: The role of European banks is especially significant in Singapore and Hong Kong – the region’s two major financial centers.

zh: 这意味着与2008年几乎让美国银行系统陷入万劫不复的雷曼兄弟倒闭事件相比，眼下的危机给亚洲带来的风险要大得多。
en: That means that Asia is far more exposed to an offshore banking crisis today than it was in the aftermath of Lehman Brothers’ collapse in 2008, which led to a near-meltdown of the US banking system.

zh: 贸易联系的传递效应同样值得担忧。
en: The transmission effects through trade linkages are just as worrying.

zh: 从历史上看，美国是现代亚洲最大的外部需求源。
en: Historically, the US was modern Asia’s largest source of external demand.

zh: 但过去十年来，情况有变。
en: But that appears to have changed over the past decade.

zh: 在中国强劲经济增长的诱惑下，亚洲出口增长不再以美国为中心，而开始以中国为中心。
en: Seduced by China’s spectacular growth, the region shifted from US- to China-centric export growth.

zh: 看起来这似乎并不是一个坏变化。
en: That seemed like a good move.

zh: 2010年，亚洲发展中国家流向美国和欧洲的出口量占总量的比重为24 % ， 较1998—1999年的34%有了显著下降。 与此同时，亚洲的地区内出口依存度 — — 即地区内贸易流 — — 增长迅速，占总出口量比重从2998年的36%上升为2010年的44 % 。
en: Combined shipments to the US and Europe fell to 24% of developing Asia’s total exports in 2010 – down sharply from 34% in 1998-1999.  Meanwhile, over the same period, Asia’s dependence on intraregional exports – trade flows within the region – expanded sharply, from 36% of total exports in 1998 to 44% in 2010.

zh: 这些数字似乎表明，亚洲的独立性正在提高，能够更好地抵御西方世界一再发生的危机的冲击。
en: These numbers seem to paint a comforting picture of an increasingly autonomous Asia that can better withstand the blows from the West’s recurring crises.

zh: 但IMF的研究表明，深度挖掘可以看出，60—65%的地区内贸易流可以归为“中间产品”类别 — — 由韩国和台湾生产组件，由中国进行拼装，最后的制成品出口到西方。
en: But research by the International Monetary Fund shows that, beneath the veneer, 60-65% of all trade flows in the region can be classified as “intermediate goods” – components that are made in countries like Korea and Taiwan, assembled in China, and ultimately shipped out as finished goods to the West.

zh: 欧洲和美国仍然占据着中国终端产品出口的最大比重，因此紧密相连的亚洲以中国为中心的供给链并不能与主要发达国家的起伏脱钩。
en: With Europe and the US still accounting for the largest shares of China’s end-market exports, there can be no escaping the tight linkages of Asia’s China-centric supply chain to the ups and downs of demand in the major developed economies.

zh: 此外，在这些联系中还有一个令人担忧的重要扭曲：中国本身越来越依赖欧洲作为其外部需求的主要来源。
en: Moreover, there is an important and worrisome twist to those linkages: China itself has tilted increasingly toward Europe as its major source of external demand.

zh: 2007年，欧盟超过美国成为中国最大的出口市场。
en: In 2007, the European Union surpassed the US as China’s largest export market.

zh: 2010年，欧盟已占中国出口总量的20 % ， 美国只有18 % 。
en: By 2010, the EU accounted for 20% of total Chinese exports, while the US share was just 18%.

zh: 换句话说，以中国为中心的亚洲供给链是一场押注欧洲的豪赌，现在看来形势不妙。
en: In other words, a China-centric Asian supply chain has made a big bet on the grand European experiment – a bet that now appears to be backfiring.

zh: 事实上，在中国，熟悉的桥段正在再次上演 — — 国内增长因西方发达经济体的危机而减速。
en: Indeed, in China, a now-familiar pattern is playing out yet again – another slowdown in domestic growth stemming from a crisis in the advanced economies of the West.

zh: 而中国一减速，其他日渐一体化的亚洲国家也得跟着减速。
en: And, as goes China, so will go the rest of an increasingly integrated Asia.

zh: 好消息是，到目前为止，与2008年末到2009年初相比，减速趋势获得了更好的控制。
en: The good news is that, so far, the downside has been much better contained than was the case in late 2008 and early 2009.

zh: 当是时，中国的出口在7个月内发生了枯荣转换，从2008年7月的同比增长26%变为2009年2月的同比下降27 % 。
en: Back then, Chinese exports went from boom to bust in just seven months – from 26% annual growth in July 2008 to a 27% decline in February 2009.

zh: 这一回，同比出口增长从2011年的20%下降为2012年4月的5 % — —不可不谓是显著减速，单核前一次的大崩盘相比要好得多。
en: This time, the annual export gain has slowed from 20% in 2011 to 5% in April 2012 – a significant deceleration, to be sure, but one that stops well short of the previous outright collapse.

zh: 如果欧元发生无序崩溃，那么情况可能会有变，但只要不发生这一事件，有理由相信此次的形势更加乐观。
en: That could change in the event of a disorderly euro breakup, but, barring that outcome, there is reason to be more sanguine this time around.

zh: 坏消息是，一再发生的外部需求冲击似乎并没有让亚洲吸取教训。
en: The bad news is that Asia seems to be learning little from repeated external demand shocks.

zh: 说到底，只有内需才是最有效的抵抗外部脆弱性的手段。
en: In the end, internal demand is the only effective defense against external vulnerability.

zh: 但亚洲地区没能建起这一防火墙。
en: Yet the region has failed to construct that firewall.

zh: 相反，2010年，亚洲发展中国家的私人消费占GDP的比重创出了历史新低，只有45 % ， 比2002年下降了10个百分点。
en: On the contrary, private consumption fell to a record-low 45% of developing Asia’s GDP in 2010 – down ten percentage points from 2002.

zh: 在这种情况下，想要对外部冲击免疫 — — 即人们常说的“脱钩 ” — —只能是痴人说梦。
en: In these circumstances, immunity from external shocks – or “decoupling,” as it is often called – seems fanciful.

zh: 如今，与亚洲大部分事务一样，供应亚洲急需的消费需求的关键在于中国。
en: As with most things in Asia nowadays, China holds the key to supplying Asia’s missing consumer demand.

zh: 最新的十二五规划所提出的目标非常正确，有助于在东方的活力和饱受危机冲击的西方的风险之间建立起终极缓冲。
en: The recently enacted 12th Five-Year Plan (2011-15) has all the right ingredients to produce the ultimate buffer between the dynamism of the East and the perils of a crisis-battered West.

zh: 但是，欧洲危机导致中国经济在三年半后再一次出现减速表明，毫无疑问，支持消费的十二五规划再平衡措施已经显得有些晚了。
en: But, as the euro crisis causes China’s economy to slow for the second time in three and a half years, there can be little doubt that implementation of the Plan’s pro-consumption rebalancing is lagging.

zh: 在一个易受危机冲击的全球化世界中，不存在繁荣的绿洲。
en: There are no oases of prosperity in a crisis-prone globalized world.

zh: 作为世界增长最快地区的亚洲也不能例外。
en: That is equally true for Asia, the world’s fastest-growing region.

zh: 随着欧洲危机的深化，金融和贸易的双生渠道意味着亚洲经济也无法独善其身。
en: As Europe’s crisis deepens, the twin channels of financial and trade linkages have placed Asia’s economies in a vice.

zh: 再平衡是中国及其亚洲供给链伙伴的唯一生存之道。
en: Rebalancing is the only way out for China and its partners in the Asian supply chain.

zh: 惟其如此，紧扼亚洲咽喉之手才会松开。
en: Until that occurs, the vice now gripping Asia will only continue to tighten.

zh: 中国的亚洲？
en: China’s Asia?

zh: 克莱蒙特—区分外交辞令和官方政策向来不易。
en: CLAREMONT – Distinguishing diplomatic rhetoric from official policy is never easy.

zh: 但在中国特别困难，中国政府的行往往与它的言不一致。
en: But it is especially difficult in China, where the government’s actions so often fail to match its statements.

zh: 考虑到这一点，有必要问一问，中国官员最近常说的口号 — — “亚洲人民的亚洲”只是为了国内消费而采取的民族主义姿态，还是真正的政策转变信号？
en: Given this, it is worth asking whether the latest slogan adopted by Chinese officials – “Asia for Asians” – is merely nationalist posturing for domestic consumption or a signal of a genuine policy shift.

zh: 对“亚洲人民的亚洲”最权威的引述是5月中国国家主席习近平在亚洲相互协作与信任措施会议上的主旨演讲。
en: The most authoritative reference to an “Asia for Asians” occurred in May, during Chinese President Xi Jinping’s keynote speech at the Conference on Interaction and Confidence-Building Measures in Asia.

zh: 习近平以精心组织的辞令提出了中国的新地区安全秩序愿景 — — 顾名思义，在这个愿景中，亚洲人起着主导作用。
en: In a carefully crafted statement, Xi laid out China’s vision for a new regional security order – one in which, as the slogan suggests, Asians are in charge.

zh: 习近平说，在根本层面 ， “ 亚洲的事情要靠亚洲人民来办，亚洲的问题要靠亚洲人民来处理，亚洲的安全要靠亚洲人民来维护。
en: According to Xi, at the fundamental level, “it is for the people of Asia to run the affairs of Asia, solve the problems of Asia, and uphold the security of Asia.”

zh: ”幸运的是，他宣布他们有“能力和智慧”通过合作构建地区和平与安全。
en: Fortunately, he declared, they have the “capability and wisdom” to build peace and security in the region through cooperation.

zh: 当然，这一愿景包括了对亚洲安全结构的修正，美国的作用将大幅削弱。
en: This vision, of course, entails an overhaul of the Asian security structure, with a drastically reduced role for the United States.

zh: 事实上，习近平间接批评现有以美国为主导的亚洲安全格局仍处于冷战状态，称“针对第三方的军事联盟不利于维护地区共同安全 ” 。
en: Indeed, Xi implicitly criticized the existing US-dominated security architecture in Asia as stuck in the Cold War, and characterized “military alliance targeted at a third party” as “not conducive to maintaining common security.”

zh: 自此次演讲以来，底层官员和中国媒体一直以此为基调进行转述。
en: Since the speech, lower-level officials and the Chinese media have reiterated similar lines.

zh: 乍一看，这一愿景十分合理；毕竟，大部分国家都更愿意在没有外部势力指手画脚的情况下管理国内和地区事务。
en: At first glance, this vision seems entirely reasonable; after all, most countries prefer to manage domestic and regional affairs without the meddling of outside powers.

zh: 但习近平的辞令与中国长期以来对美国在亚太地区身影的立场背道而驰。
en: But Xi’s statement marked a significant departure from China’s long-standing position on America’s presence in the Asia-Pacific region.

zh: 自四十年前中美恢复邦交以来，中国美国的亚洲安全保障者角色一直刻意的暧昧。
en: Since the US-China rapprochement four decades ago, China has maintained a studied ambiguity regarding America’s role as the guarantor of Asia’s security.

zh: 中国的务实领导人知道，美国的存在有助于遏制苏联（以及随后的俄罗斯 ） 、 防止日本重新武装、保持海路开放。
en: China’s pragmatic leaders knew that the US presence helped to contain the Soviet Union (and subsequently Russia), prevented Japan from re-arming, and kept sea-lanes open.

zh: 他们也明白，他们缺少挑战美国领导的安全秩序或提供可行替代方案的实力。
en: They also recognized that they lacked the power to challenge the US-led security order or offer a feasible alternative.

zh: 这也许正在改变。
en: This may be changing.

zh: 尽管一些分析家仍认为习近平的“亚洲人民的亚洲”路线只是防空炮，目的是巩固他的民族主义者形象，但同样有理由认为这表明了真正的政策变化。
en: Though some analysts remain convinced that Xi’s “Asia for Asians” line is an empty attempt to bolster his nationalist credentials, an equally strong case can be made that it signifies a genuine policy shift.

zh: 尽管这一观点尚不足以令人信服，但也不能完全否认。
en: While the argument is not overwhelming, it should not be dismissed out of hand.

zh: 习近平准备挑战既成秩序，最有说服力的证据在于经济。
en: The most conclusive evidence of Xi’s readiness to challenge the established order lies in the economic sphere.

zh: 最引人注目的是，中国建立了不少新发展机构，包括亚洲基础设施投资银行和新丝绸之路基金，将向其中注入数百亿美金 — — 显然这是向西方主导的多边机构的挑战。
en: Most notably, China has established new development institutions, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the new Silk Road Fund, to which it will channel tens of billions of dollars – clear challenges to the established Western-dominated multilateral institutions.

zh: 但是，在安全方面，中国在将其“亚洲人民的亚洲”愿景转变为现实方面的动作就要少得多。
en: On the security front, however, China has made much less headway in turning its “Asia for Asians” vision into reality.

zh: 诚然，它已经拥有了一定的军事实力震慑美国队台湾海峡或南海的干预，并且通过上海合作组织强化了其与俄罗斯和中亚国家的安全合作。
en: To be sure, it has acquired some military capabilities to deter the US from intervening in the Taiwan Strait or the South China Sea, and it has improved its security cooperation with Russia and Central Asian countries through the Shanghai Cooperation Organization.

zh: 但这些轻微的进展往往被中国因为在地区领土争议中表现得咄咄逼人而带来的安全隐患所抵消。
en: But such modest gains are more than offset by the security setbacks that China has suffered as a result of its assertiveness in regional territorial disputes.

zh: 事实上，在多个月日渐升级的军事动作后 — — 最引人关注的便是单方面宣布了覆盖包括争议领土在内的广大南海海域的防空识别区 — — 中国与日本的关系降到了历史冰点。
en: Indeed, after many months of increasingly forceful military moves – most notably, the unilateral declaration of an air-defense identification zone covering a large swath of the South China Sea, including disputed territories – China’s ties with Japan reached an all-time low.

zh: 忧心忡忡的东南亚国家也恳求美国留在该地区制衡中国。
en: And concerned Southeast Asian countries have been entreating the US to remain in the region as a counterweight to China.

zh: 在“亚洲人民的亚洲”辞令的背后，中国也许认为美国 — — 而不是中国自己 — — 的行为要为邻国的反抗负责。
en: Underlying the “Asia for Asians” trope may be China’s belief that the US, not its own behavior, is to blame for its neighbors’ defiance.

zh: 一些中国战略家认为美国正在利用亚洲国家 — — 特别是日本、越南和菲律宾充当挡箭牌遏制中国。
en: Some Chinese strategists believe that the US is using Asian states, particularly Japan, Vietnam, and the Philippines, as pawns to contain China.

zh: 如果这一观点在国内政策争论中占得上风，包括习近平在内的中国领导人可能会形成一个重大结论，即，总而言之美国在亚洲安全事务上的身影直接威胁到中国的利益，必须将它除掉。
en: If this perspective has prevailed in the internal policy debate, Chinese leaders, including Xi, could have reached the fateful conclusion that, on balance, America’s security presence in Asia directly threatens Chinese interests and must be eliminated.

zh: 这将是一个可怕的战略错误，其根源是对亚洲安全动态存在根本性误解。
en: That would be a grave strategic error, based on a fundamental misreading of Asian security dynamics.

zh: 大部分中国的邻国，哪怕是朝鲜，都害怕不受遏制的中国霸权 — — 而如果美国的安全保障被去除，它们就将面临不受遏制的中国霸权。
en: Most of China’s neighbors, even North Korea, fear an unconstrained Chinese hegemon – and, if the US security presence were eliminated, that is precisely what they would face.

zh: “亚洲人民的亚洲”将变成“中国人民的亚洲 ” 。
en: “Asia for Asians” would be “Asia for the Chinese.”

zh: 很难想象以成熟和务实闻名的中国决策者回去追求不但不可能赢得亚洲邻国的支持、还必然会导致与美国的剧烈冲突的战略。
en: It is difficult to imagine that Chinese policymakers, known for their sophistication and realism, could be pursuing a strategy that is not only unlikely to gain support from fellow Asians, but also is guaranteed to spark conflict with the US.

zh: 基于此，有可能 — — 事实上，但愿如此 — — “亚洲人民的亚洲”将只是一个口号。
en: Given this, it is likely – indeed, desirable – that “Asia for Asians” will remain a mere slogan.

zh: 事实上，习近平最近在中国的目标问题上的口风也有所缓和，最近他对中共领导人说 ， “ 要提升我国软实力,讲好中国故事,做好对外宣传。 ”
en: In fact, Xi has lately toned down his description of China’s aims, recently telling Communist Party leaders that, “We should increase China’s soft power, give a good Chinese narrative, and better communicate China’s message to the world.”

zh: 但是，即使习近平这样说，但出于历史原因 ， “ 亚洲人民的亚洲”一词仍有问题。
en: But, even as rhetoric, the phrase “Asia for Asians” is problematic for historical reasons.

zh: 20世纪30年代，日本军国主义者以“大东亚共荣圈”作为帝国和征服野心的幌子。
en: In the 1930s, Japanese militarists used the idea of an “East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere” as a cover for their imperial ambitions and conquests.

zh: 这一口号受到了广泛的口诛笔伐，特别是在中国，因为它具有显而易见的荒谬性。
en: The slogan was widely ridiculed, particularly in China, for its transparent absurdity.

zh: 这有助于解释如今“亚洲人民的亚洲”概念为何会遭受冷遇。
en: This may help to explain the lukewarm reception that the concept of “Asia for Asians” has received this time around.

zh: 对中国领导人来说，最聪明的做法是一劳永逸地抛弃这一概念。
en: The smartest thing for Chinese leaders to do would be to drop it, once and for all.

zh: 亚洲的羞辱链
en: Asia’s Hierarchies of Humiliation

zh: 费城—印度和中国军队在多克拉（Doka La，不丹、中国和印度三国交界处）的对峙已经持续了近一个月，是两军自1962年以来维持时间最长的僵持。
en: PHILADELPHIA – Indian and Chinese troops have been locked in a standoff in Doka La – where the borders of Bhutan, China and India meet – for almost a month now, the longest such impasse between the two armies since 1962.

zh: 中国国防部发言人吴谦上校毫不讳言地援引印度惨败的上一次冲突，警告印度“吸取历史教训 ” 。
en: In a not-so-subtle reference to that last conflict, in which India suffered a disastrous defeat, the Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Colonel Wu Qian has warned India to “learn from historical lessons.”

zh: 但历史教训有一个奇怪的趋势，它会去适应援引教训的一方的角度。
en: But the lessons of history have a peculiar tendency to adapt to the perspective of those citing them.

zh: 中国现任领导层将1962年的冲突视为傲慢的邻国不屈从于其领土主张而必须付出的代价。
en: The current Chinese leadership sees in the 1962 conflict the price an uppity neighbor had to pay for not acceding to its territorial demands.

zh: 但对印度来说，这场冲突是一次羞辱，压在它的心头已经超过半个世纪。
en: But, for India, that conflict was a humiliation that has rankled the country for more than a half-century.

zh: 因此，提到这次冲突有可能会产生和吴谦预料中完全相反的效果。
en: The reminder of it is therefore likely to have the opposite effect than Wu anticipated.

zh: 在国际关系中，受辱要比难堪意义还要重大。
en: In international relations, to be humiliated means more than to be embarrassed.

zh: 这会导致与另一方的国际地位下降、地位要求不予承认，并形成明确的等级链。
en: It amounts to the public degradation of another actor, a denial of its bid for status, and the establishment of a clear hierarchy.

zh: 战争是赤裸裸的羞辱机会，因为在战场上的失败不但会带来奚落和嘲笑，还会导致明确的损失，特别是领土损失。
en: Wars provide the opportunity for humiliation in very stark ways, because defeat on the battlefield tends to bring not just ridicule and derision, but also clear losses, particularly of territory.

zh: 按理说，论羞辱的影响，没有国家比中国更加清楚。
en: If any country should understand the impact that such humiliations can have, it is China.

zh: 事实上，就在吴谦向印度传递信息的同时，中国国家主席习近平在香港回归祖国20周年庆典上表示，香港回归标志着英国1842年割占香港所带来的“耻辱和悲伤”的结束。
en: In fact, as Wu was relaying his message to India, Chinese President Xi Jinping was asserting, at the commemoration of the 20th anniversary of Hong Kong’s handover to China, that the move had ended the “humiliation and sorrow” inflicted by Britain when it took over the city in 1842.

zh: 中国共产党也广泛使用“耻辱的世纪”煽动复兴的民族主义。 这个耻辱的世纪自1949年中共建立中华人民共和国正式结束。
en: This reflects the Chinese Communist Party’s broader use of China’s “century of humiliation,” which allegedly ended only when the CCP established the People’s Republic in 1949, to fuel a resurgent nationalism.

zh: 在此期间，中国作为东亚第一强国的自我印象，被一系列战败撕得粉碎，被后起之秀日本入侵的历史尤其令人痛苦。
en: During that period, China’s self-image as East Asia’s preeminent power was shattered by a series of defeats, which were particularly painful when inflicted by the upstart Japan.

zh: 尽管中国对于自身受到的羞辱持久影响有着充分的认识，但常常不顾其自身过去的行为给其他国家造成的类似的感受。
en: Despite this acute awareness of the enduring impact of its own humiliations, China often fails to recognize how its own past actions might have spurred similar feelings in others.

zh: 1962年击败印度是这两个新近从殖民地状态崛起的新独立国家十年来对领导地位的争夺的顶峰。
en: Its 1962 defeat of India was the culmination of a decade-long competition for leadership of the newly independent countries that had emerged from decolonization.

zh: 因此，这对于印度成为无可争议地不结盟运动国家领袖的雄心来说，是一次致命打击。
en: It therefore amounted to a devastating blow to India’s aspirations to be the undisputed leader of the Non-Aligned Movement.

zh: 印度也绝非唯一一个受到中国羞辱的国家。
en: India is far from the only country that has been humiliated at the hands of China.

zh: 在越南 ， “ 被中国统治1,000年”和中国的“百年外辱”异曲同工。
en: In Vietnam, the phrase “1,000 Years of Chinese Domination” has as much resonance as “100 Years of Foreign Humiliation” has in China.

zh: 但中国也绝非唯一一个既遭到过羞辱，也反过来羞辱其他人的国家。
en: But China is not the only country to have been humiliated and humiliated others in turn.

zh: 尽管印度在1962年遭到了中国的羞辱，但九年后它入侵邻国巴基斯坦，给了巴基斯坦羞辱性的大败。
en: While India was humiliated by China in 1962, it also inflicted what its neighbor Pakistan remembers as a humiliating defeat nine years later.

zh: 1947年独立后，巴基斯坦一直自视为与印度地位等同的南亚国家，用加盟美国领导的联盟或倒向中国证明其战略重要性。
en: Since independence in 1947, Pakistan had vied to establish itself as India’s equal in South Asia, joining alliances led by the United States or cozying up to China to demonstrate its strategic relevance.

zh: 1971年的印巴战争将这一希望击得粉碎，也导致了东巴基斯坦（现在的孟加拉国）独立。
en: The 1971 Indo-Pakistani War, which led to the independence of East Pakistan (now Bangladesh), crushed those hopes.

zh: 但巴基斯坦也不曾关注其自身行为的羞辱作用：近四十年来，它一直干预阿富汗以确保“战略纵深 ” ， 让阿富汗在此后多年一直陷于混乱，这是俄罗斯的入侵都没有造成的结果。
en: Yet Pakistan, too, remains oblivious to the humiliating impact of its own actions: its nearly four-decade-long history of interference in Afghanistan to secure “strategic depth” will leave Afghanistan traumatized for years to come, in a way that Russia-inflicted losses did not.

zh: 前述所有羞辱都是如此：它们之所以令人特别痛苦，是因为入侵者是亚洲邻国，而不是遥远的列强。
en: The same is true of all the aforementioned humiliations: they are particularly painful because an Asian neighbor, not a distant power, inflicted them.

zh: 这些羞辱，如同我们在中国身上看到的那样，影响非常长远。
en: Such humiliations, as we have seen with China, have a long-lasting impact.

zh: 事实上，它们可能造成强烈的复仇欲望，压倒冷静的外交动机。
en: Indeed, they can create an all-consuming desire for vengeance that overwhelms more sober foreign-policy motivations.

zh: 比如，正因如此，巴基斯坦军方时刻准备着高举打击印度的旗号，破坏一切在法理上它应该捍卫的巴基斯坦制度。
en: That is why, for example, Pakistan’s army is prepared to undermine all other institutions in the country it is sworn to defend, in the name of wounding India.

zh: 在民族主义在亚洲全面崛起的今天，领导人有很强的激励炮制历史为其所用，而对于这个目的，很少有历史记忆能和痛苦的羞辱史一样有效。
en: With nationalism on the rise across Asia, leaders have strong incentives to craft a version of history that advances their cause, and few historical memories are as effective for this purpose as those of traumatic humiliation.

zh: 中国精于此道，但在其他国家也可以看到这样的做法，包括印度。
en: China has mastered this art, but it can be seen elsewhere, too, including in India.

zh: 关键在于要建立一套羞辱链，根据这个羞辱链，施加在本国头上的羞辱是最为重要的，而施加在他国头上的羞辱会被贬低，只有在重申地位等级链时会被想起。
en: The key is to create a hierarchy of humiliations, according to which those inflicted on one’s own country are regarded as vitally important, and those inflicted on others are diminished, remembered only to reaffirm the status hierarchy.

zh: 但是，没完没了的多卡拉纠纷清楚地表明，这套方法可能造成严重的风险。
en: Yet, as the ongoing dispute in Doka La makes clear, such an approach can create serious risks.

zh: 第一次世界大战后，欧洲没有充分解决羞辱的遗留问题，结果是灾难性的。
en: After World War I, when Europe failed to address adequately its legacy of humiliation, the results were catastrophic.

zh: 但是，第二次世界大战后，欧洲直面这一挑战，为前所未有的地区合作奠定了基础。
en: After World War II, however, Europe rose to the challenge, setting the stage for unprecedented regional cooperation.

zh: 我们希望亚洲也走上类似的道路 — — 而且要在历史耻辱的愤怒沸腾之前。
en: One hopes that Asia takes a similar tack – before simmering anger over historical humiliations boils over.

zh: 世界中的亚洲
en: Asia in the World

zh: 纽约 - - 在成为联合国秘书长之前，我一直是一名亚洲外交官。
en: NEW YORK – Before I became the UN’s Secretary-General, I was an Asian diplomat.

zh: 在我担任韩国外长的时候，我和我的政府极力主张与朝鲜缓和关系。
en: While I was foreign minister of the Republic of Korea, my Government and I strongly advocated détente with the North.

zh: 当世界上的某些人要求制裁以及惩罚性行动的时候，韩国则推动对话。
en: When some in the world called for sanctions and punitive action, South Korea pushed for dialogue.

zh: 对话不仅要求发言，也要求倾听。
en: That requires listening as well as speaking.

zh: 这意味着坚持原则，但是同时也努力理解另一方，而无论那一方有时看起来有多么的没有理性和不妥协。
en: It means sticking to principles, but also attempting to understand the other side, however irrational or intransigent it may sometimes appear.

zh: 这还是我在联合国的风格。
en: This remains my style at the United Nations.

zh: 我相信外交和接触的力量。
en: I believe in the power of diplomacy and engagement.
