zh: 我把对话置于辩论或者宣言之上。
en: I prioritize dialogue over debate or declaration.

zh: 最主要的，我寻求有所结果。
en: Above all, I seek results.

zh: 我们正在缅甸做着这件事。
en: We are doing that now in Myanmar.

zh: 我的特别顾问甘巴里已经回到了仰光。
en: My Special Adviser, Ibrahim Gambari, has been back in Yangon.

zh: 他的任务是诚实地居中，促使政府和反对派领导人、特别是昂山素季对话。
en: His brief is to be the honest broker, the facilitator of a dialogue between government and opposition leaders, particularly Aung San Suu Kyi.

zh: 目标就是让缅甸政府释放所有遭到逮捕的学生和示威者，与反对派接触，向民主社会转变并且重新加入国际社会。
en: The goal is for Myanmar’s Government to release all detained students and demonstrators, engage with the opposition, move toward a more democratic society, and rejoin the international community.

zh: 这一外交行动既不快捷也不容易。
en: This brand of diplomacy is not quick or easy.

zh: 很少得到赞扬，而且经常没有进展的迹象。
en: There is seldom applause, and often no outward evidence of movement.

zh: 这是幕后的、静悄悄以及充满艰辛的努力。
en: It is a quiet, painstaking slog behind the scenes.

zh: 人们要打电话，哄着各国领导人做这做那。
en: You have to work the phones, cajole world leaders to do this or that.

zh: 这是一场经常不是很和谐的交响乐，由微小的步伐组成，你希望这些步伐可以导致某些更大的成就。
en: It is a symphony – often not a very harmonious one – of small steps that you hope will lead to something greater.

zh: 你不指望什么。
en: You expect nothing.

zh: 你只能不断努力推动。
en: You can only keep trying, keep pushing.

zh: 也许奏效，也许不奏效。
en: Maybe it works, maybe not.

zh: 然后你再用另一种方式做努力，企图取得一些小的进展可以达到下一步。
en: Then you try some more, in a different way, aiming all the while for some small progress that makes the next step possible.

zh: 在达尔富尔问题上我们就是这样。
en: We are at this point in Darfur.

zh: 我已经花费了数以百计小时来同冲突各方进行幕后工作。 它们是苏丹政府、叛乱领导人、邻国以及非洲联盟夥伴。
en: I have spent hundreds of hours working behind closed doors with various parties to the conflict – Sudan’s Government, rebel leaders, neighbouring countries, and African Union partners.

zh: 同时，我们正在推动我们历史上最为复杂的维和行动，给几十万流离失所的人提供食物和保护，并且在利比亚鼓励困难的和平谈判。
en: Meanwhile, we are pushing ahead with one of the most complex peacekeeping operations in our history, feeding and protecting hundreds of thousands of displaced people, and sponsoring difficult peace negotiations in Libya.

zh: 但是即使我推行我的“亚洲”外交，有时候在国际社会外交舞台上还是不免感到有点孤单。
en: But even as I push my brand of “Asian” diplomacy, it can sometimes feel a bit lonely to be an Asian at the international community’s diplomatic roundtable.

zh: 我们亚洲人居住在世界上最大的大陆，拥有世界最多的人口以及增长最快的经济。
en: We Asians inhabit the world’s largest continent, with the world’s largest population and its fastest-growing economies.

zh: 我们历史悠久，文明古老。
en: We have a rich history and ancient cultures.

zh: 但是我们在国际事务中的作用还是差强人意。
en: Yet our role in international affairs is far less than it could, or should be.

zh: 亚洲对联合国的贡献尽管举足轻重，但是还可以更大。
en: Asia’s contribution to the UN, though significant, could be greater.

zh: 礼貌地说，其人道主义援助还不够慷慨。
en: Its humanitarian assistance, to put it politely, is less than generous.

zh: 亚洲是唯一还没有地区融合和共同市场的大陆。
en: We are the only continent where regional integration and common markets have not taken hold.

zh: 拉美以及北美构想建立自由贸易区。
en: Latin Americans and North Americans dream of creating a free-trade zone.

zh: 欧洲人谈论建立欧洲合众国。
en: Europeans speak of building a United States of Europe.

zh: 非洲联盟希望成为非洲合众国。
en: The African Union aspires to become a United States of Africa.

zh: 为何没有亚洲合众国呢？
en: Why no United States of Asia?

zh: 亚洲区别的理由很多：历史、文化多样性、尚未解决的领土和政治争议、缺乏多边经验以及一个或两个权力中心的控制。
en: There are many reasons why Asia is different: history, cultural diversity, unresolved territorial and political disputes, a lack of multilateral experience, and the predominance of one or two centers of power.

zh: 但是主要原因是我们还没有试图这样做。
en: But the main reason is that we have not tried.

zh: 亚洲没有充分发挥自身的能力。
en: Asia does not do itself justice.

zh: 作为来自亚洲的秘书长，我希望这一情况得到改变。
en: As an Asian Secretary-General, I hope to see this change.

zh: 我希望看到亚洲更为融合，更为在国际上接触。
en: I hope to see an Asia that is both better integrated and more internationally engaged.

zh: 我特别期望我的韩国同胞们有所作为。 韩国人民是非凡的人们，已经独立自主。
en: I expect particularly great things of my fellow Koreans, a remarkable people who have come into their own.

zh: 我希望韩国在世界上承担与其不断增长的经济实力相称的更大的责任，特别是在发展领域。 发展是联合国宪章的三大支柱之一。
en: I hope to see Korea assume more responsibility in the world, commensurate with its growing economic clout – especially in the area of development, one of the three pillars of the UN Charter.

zh: 韩国人需要站出来发言，做更多的事情，而这需要从更为慷慨的官方发展援助开始。
en: Koreans need to step up, speak out, and do more, and that should start with more generous official development assistance.

zh: 韩国人已经通过六方会谈展现出其对多边外交和解决问题的倾向。
en: Koreans have already shown their penchant for multi-lateral diplomacy and trouble shooting through the six-party talks.

zh: 现在，他们以及整个亚洲需要把他们的技能和成功发挥出来，为当今急迫的全球性问题发挥作用。
en: Now, they, and Asians at large, need to bring both their skills and their success to bear on the most pressing global issues of the day.

zh: 这不仅是我的希望，也是亚洲的义务。
en: This is not just my hope, it is also Asia’s obligation.

zh: 亚洲的全能中产阶级
en: Asia’s Almighty Middle Class

zh: 首尔 — — 尽管近期经济仍有不确定性，亚洲的中产阶级却在快速成长。
en: SEOUL – Despite recent economic uncertainty, Asia’s middle class is growing fast.

zh: 未来几十年，该新兴细分人口群体将成为地区经济政治发展的基石，对世界其他国家也将产生显著的影响。
en: In the coming decades, this burgeoning demographic segment will serve as a keystone for economic and political development in the region, with significant implications for the rest of the world.

zh: 据经合组织估计截止2030年全球中产阶级（定义为按2005年购买力平价计算，每人日均开支达10-100美元的家庭）将膨胀至49亿人，而2009年还仅有18亿的规模。
en: The OECD estimates that the global middle class (defined as households with daily expenditures of $10-100 per person, in 2005 purchasing power parity terms) will swell to 4.9 billion people by 2030, from 1.8 billion in 2009.

zh: 其中的三分之二将居住在亚洲，2009年上述比率仅为28 % ， 其中最大部分居住在中国。
en: Two-thirds are expected to reside in Asia, up from 28% in 2009, with China home to the largest share.

zh: 事实上，如果中国推行保持经济快速增长所需的结构改革和技术升级，相比于2009年的仅1.57亿，到2030年那里的中产阶级人口将达到10亿之多。
en: Indeed, if China pursues the structural reforms and technological upgrading needed to maintain rapid economic growth, its middle class should exceed one billion people in 2030, up from 157 million in 2009.

zh: 亚洲中产阶级的快速崛起将为国内国际企业创造新的市场机会，进而催生影响深远的经济变革。
en: The rapid emergence of Asia’s middle class will bring far-reaching economic change, creating new market opportunities for domestic and international companies.

zh: 该地区对耐用消费品的需求已有所增加，中国已成为全世界最大的汽车和手机市场。
en: Already, demand for consumer durables has increased in the region, with China becoming the world’s largest market for automobiles and mobile phones.

zh: 但随着发展中国家中产阶级购买力赶上发达国家，奢侈品和技术产品的消费仍有很大余地。
en: But there remains substantial room for more consumption in luxury goods and technological products, as the purchasing power of the developing world’s middle class catches up to that in the advanced countries.

zh: 上述融合将助力持续性更强的经济增长，亚洲经济围绕国内需求、尤其是居民消费实现再平衡，从而不那么容易受到外部冲击。
en: This convergence will contribute to more sustainable economic growth, with Asia’s economies rebalancing toward domestic demand, especially household consumption, and thereby becoming less vulnerable to external shocks.

zh: 鉴于全球经济危机爆发后出口需求下降，上述转变真可谓恰逢其时。
en: Given the decline in export demand since the global economic crisis, this shift could not be timelier.

zh: 而且也不仅亚洲会从中受益；随着地区进口增长，全球贸易失衡状况将有所缓和，从而提高全球经济增长的可持续性。
en: And the benefits will not be confined to Asia; as imports to the region increase, global trade imbalances will decline, improving the sustainability of economic growth worldwide.

zh: 事实上，亚洲不断壮大的中产阶级将把这座全球著名的制造业中心转变为消费重地。
en: Indeed, Asia’s growing middle class will transform a region known as a global manufacturing hub into a consumption powerhouse.

zh: 随着需求不断攀升，不仅亚洲会创造出更多更好的就业机会，全球范围内的供应链及整个生产网络也将会从中受益。
en: As demand rises, more and better jobs will be created not only in Asia, but also globally, along supply chains and across production networks.

zh: 繁荣之后教育和医疗升级随之而来，有望通过提高生产力推升长期经济发展水平。
en: With rising prosperity comes improved education and health care, which promise to help drive long-term economic growth by improving productivity.

zh: 中国的现有状况将发生显著改变，尽管数十年来已经在降低新生儿死亡率和提高受教育程度方面取得了长足的进步，但那里的贫困家庭儿童，特别是在农村地区，仍缺少营养和学校教育。
en: In China, this would represent a significant shift from prevailing conditions, in which the children of poor households, especially in rural areas, lag in terms of nutrition and school enrollment, despite significant progress in recent decades on lowering infant mortality and raising educational attainment.

zh: 有了高质量的教育，亚洲正在崛起的中产阶级会要求更高质量的公共服务。
en: Equipped with high-quality education, Asia’s rising middle class will demand higher-quality public services.

zh: 对国内政治制度和体制结构信心增强再加上更宽广的晋身空间将有助于加强法治。
en: Increased confidence in their country’s political systems and institutional structures, enhanced by improved perceptions of upward mobility, will help to strengthen the rule of law.

zh: 妇女会得到更多的学习和工作机会，从而缩小性别差距。
en: And there will be more opportunities for women to learn and work, leading to greater gender equality.

zh: 最重要的是，中产阶级崛起很可能伴随对政治自由和公民权利需求的不断增长，进而推动民主化进程。
en: Most important, the rise of the middle class is likely to be accompanied by growing demands for political freedom and civil liberties, thereby fostering democratization.

zh: 事实上，对十九到二十一世纪大量国家样本的考察显示受过良好教育的富裕民众 — — 特别是女性 — — 尤其是在那些欠发达国家，能够催生出对政治的更多参与和对民主的更强支持。
en: Indeed, an examination of a large sample of countries, from the nineteenth to the twenty-first centuries, reveals that a larger population of affluent, educated citizens – especially women – brings about more political participation and greater support for democracy, particularly in less-developed countries.

zh: 在西方，随着市场发展在削弱地主权力的同时增强劳工和中产阶级权力，资本主义和民主携手取得了长足进步。
en: In the West, capitalism and democracy progressed in tandem, as the development of markets reduced the power of landlords and increased that of the working and middle classes.

zh: 通过积极参政、在理性自利的基础上进行投票以及培养抵制独裁所需的节制感，中产阶级极大地推动了民主进程。
en: By participating actively in politics, basing their electoral choices on rational self-interest, and developing the sense of moderation needed to resist dictatorship, the middle class promotes democratic progress.

zh: 同时，与中产阶级崛起相关的民间组织成长防止国家机构垄断政治资源。
en: At the same time, the growth of private organizations associated with the rise of the middle class prevents state institutions from monopolizing political resources.

zh: 在亚洲，韩国也经历过类似的发展，经济的快速增长催生了庞大的中产阶级，进而在20世纪80年代推动了民主化的崛起。
en: In Asia, South Korea experienced a similar progression, with rapid economic growth spurring the rise of a large middle class, which in turn drove democratization in the 1980s.

zh: 中国或许过不多久就会重复这段历史。
en: That history may repeat in China before long.

zh: 鉴于庞大中产阶级的可观价值，亚洲各国应通过改善医疗保健、升级基础设施、投资大学和技术培训以及缩小收入和教育差距来对其进行培育。
en: Given the benefits of having a large middle class, Asian countries should be nurturing theirs by improving health care, upgrading infrastructure, investing in universities and technical training, and addressing income and educational disparities.

zh: 此外，应建立或加强社会安全网，以此来促进消费增长（目前仍受制于预防性存款 ） ， 协助保护中产阶级抵御负面冲击。
en: Moreover, social safety nets should be created or strengthened, in order to help safeguard the middle class from negative shocks and boost consumption growth (which continues to be hampered by precautionary saving).

zh: 最后，以强化法治、促进贸易和实现健全宏观经济管理为目标的公共政策对保持经济发展至关重要，并以此确保低收入家庭能持续拥有晋身余地。
en: Finally, public policies – aimed at strengthening the rule of law, promoting trade, and achieving sound macroeconomic management – are essential to sustain growth, thereby ensuring the continuous upward mobility of lower-income families.

zh: 这是保持中产阶级不断扩张及经济增长良性循环的关键因素。
en: That upward mobility is the key to keeping in motion a virtuous circle of middle-class expansion and economic growth.

zh: 亚洲央行应该做好提高利率的准备
en: Asia’s Central Banks Should Prepare to Raise Interest Rates

zh: 首尔—亚洲金融市场正准备迎接2018年金发女郎经济 — — 既不过热，也不过冷，增长强劲，物价稳定。
en: SEOUL – Financial markets around Asia are preparing for a Goldilocks economy in 2018 – not too hot, not too cold, with strong growth and stable prices.

zh: 该地区的出口导向型新兴经济体因为全球贸易的复苏而获益，而其中的荦荦大者 — — 中国、日本和印度 — — 则仍然保持着活力。
en: The region’s export-oriented emerging economies are benefiting from the recovery in global trade, while its largest players – China, Japan, and India – remain dynamic.

zh: 放眼整个亚洲地区，经济增长的加速，加上公司盈利正预期和不断的资本流入，正在推高股价。
en: Throughout the region, accelerating economic growth, together with positive corporate earnings expectations and persistent capital inflows, are driving up stock prices.

zh: 而通货膨胀仍将受到控制，主要原因是工资和进口品价格增长缓慢。
en: And inflation will remain in check, owing largely to the slow rise in wages and import prices.

zh: 但仍有很多方面值得担忧。
en: Yet there remains plenty of cause for concern.

zh: 一方面，亚洲市场肯定将面临资本流波动，背后的原因是发达经济体的货币政策。
en: For one thing, Asian markets will undoubtedly face capital-flow volatility, driven by the major advanced economies’ monetary policies.

zh: 另一方面，庞大的债务可能提升一些亚洲经济体的金融风险，破坏增长前景。
en: For another, large debts could increase financial risk in some Asian economies, damaging growth prospects.

zh: 亚洲央行是这些风险的不可或缺的管理者。
en: The region’s central banks will be integral to managing these risks.

zh: 全球经济危机爆发时，亚洲央行和它们的发达经济体同行一样，都在支持国内增长方面起着领导作用。
en: In the wake of the global economic crisis, Asia’s central banks, like their counterparts in the advanced economies, assumed a leading role in supporting domestic growth.

zh: 但是，随着全球经济复苏的起势，是时候开始收紧货币政策了。
en: But, as the global economic recovery gains momentum, the time has come to begin tightening monetary policy.

zh: 主要发发经济体央行已经开始这么做了。
en: The major advanced economies’ central banks are already on that path.

zh: 欧洲央行、英格兰银行和日本银行正在着手治理不断膨胀的资产负债表并提高利率。
en: The European Central Bank, the Bank of England, and the Bank of Japan are moving to rein in their swelling balance sheets and raise interest rates.

zh: 但一马当先的还是美联储。
en: But it is the US Federal Reserve that is leading the way.

zh: 工资和消费物价增长的低迷使通胀一直在低位运行，因此，美联储有可能继续渐进式升息。
en: With low growth in wages and consumer prices keeping inflation subdued, the Fed is likely to continue pursuing gradual interest-rate hikes.

zh: 但如果 — — 可能性相当大 — — 最近由特朗普总统和国会共和党推出的减税政策加快经济和物价增长，令经济产生过热风险，美联储就需要更加积极地升息。
en: But if, as is likely, the tax cuts recently enacted by President Donald Trump and congressional Republicans accelerate economic and price growth enough to raise the risk of economic overheating, the Fed will need to act more assertively.

zh: 这一广泛的货币紧缩将给亚洲新兴经济体带来深远影响。 亚洲新兴经济体高度融入了全球市场，因此对外国资本流国门洞开。
en: This broad monetary tightening will have a profound impact on Asia’s emerging economies, which are highly integrated into global markets and thus open to foreign capital flows.

zh: 特别是，全球流动性条件的变化可能让亚洲金融和外汇市场坐上“过山车 ” ， 助长跟随发达经济体升息的压力。
en: In particular, changes in global liquidity conditions are likely to send Asia’s financial and foreign-exchange markets on a roller-coaster ride, fueling pressure to keep up with interest-rate hikes in the advanced economies.

zh: 诚然，一些经济学家仍然认为，由于通胀始终低迷，亚洲央行应该保持低利率。
en: To be sure, some economists still argue that Asia’s central banks should maintain low interest rates, owing to persistently subdued inflation.

zh: 他们担心，在许多家庭和企业仍然背负巨额债务的时候，剧烈升息将影响消费和投资，有可能阻碍经济增长。
en: They worry that, at a time when many households and businesses remain laden with debt, a sharp rate hike would undermine consumption and investment, potentially impeding economic growth.

zh: 但真相是巨额债务和风险资产高估是由持续的货币扩张造成的。
en: But the truth is that large debts and overvalued risky assets are the result of sustained monetary expansion.

zh: 如果央行在相当长的一段时间内坚持不升息，资产泡沫可能会继续发展 — — 不仅仅是股市和房地产市场，还包括（比如）虚拟货币 — — 导致另一场金融危机。
en: If central banks continue to postpone interest-rate increases for much longer, asset bubbles might develop – not just in the stock and housing markets, but also in, say, virtual currencies – leading to another financial crisis.

zh: 避免这一结果的最好的办法是新兴亚洲经济体以渐进的、可预测的方式升息。
en: The best way to avoid such an outcome is for emerging Asian economies to increase rates gradually and predictably.

zh: 这并不意味着亚洲央行应该向外部压力低头。
en: This does not mean that Asia’s central banks should simply bow to external pressure.

zh: 相反，各央行应该的货币正常化节奏应该既能捍卫宏观经济稳定，又不会波及国内经济活动。
en: Rather, each central bank should pursue monetary-policy normalization at a rate appropriate to safeguarding macroeconomic stability without damaging domestic economic activity.

zh: 好消息是亚洲央行似乎认识到了这一点，并已经开始向紧缩转变，其中，韩国银行一马当先。
en: The good news is that Asia’s central banks seem to recognize this, and are already moving toward tightening, with the Bank of Korea in the lead.

zh: 11月30日，在家庭债务迅速积累、资本配置剧烈扭曲的背景下，韩国银行将利率自创纪录的低位1.25%调高25个基点。
en: On November 30, against a backdrop of rapidly accumulated household debt and distortions in capital allocation, the BOK raised rates by 25 basis points, from a record low of 1.25%.

zh: 预计马来西亚、台湾、泰国和菲律宾等地的货币当局也将跟进，根据经济装快来决定升息时机。
en: Monetary authorities in countries like Malaysia, Taiwan, Thailand, and the Philippines are expected to follow suit, timing their interest-rate hikes according to economic conditions.

zh: 中国也需要通过货币紧缩来回收过度的流动性并降低杠杆。
en: In China, too, monetary tightening will be needed to mop up excess liquidity and reduce leverage.

zh: 否则，中国人民银行行长周小川说，中国将面临“明斯基时刻 ” ， 即在过度乐观和债务融资投资的高潮中迎来金融危机。
en: Otherwise, according to Zhou Xiaochuan, the governor of the People’s Bank of China, the country might face a “Minsky moment,” in which excessive optimism and debt-financed investment culminate in financial crisis.

zh: 这一过程的主要潜在障碍是政治：极低利率是一种很容易实施的经济刺激 — — 远比（比如）劳动力、税收和监管改革容易 — — 因此政客会对央行施压延迟升息。
en: The main potential hitch in this process is political: because ultra-low interest rates amount to an easy form of economic stimulus – much easier than, say, labor, tax, or regulatory reforms – politicians might put pressure on central banks to delay rate hikes.

zh: 但央行必须凭借其好不容易赢得的独立性，抵制这一压力。
en: But central banks, leaning on their hard-won independence, must not succumb.

zh: 尽管自全球经济危机以来所采取的积极货币政策引起了一些关于央行独立性的担忧，但巴里·艾肯格林（Barry Eichengreen）指出，为了政治问责而让步等于是“将洗澡水和婴儿一起泼出去 ” 。
en: Though the active monetary policy used since the global economic crisis has caused some to question central-bank independence, compromising it for the sake of political accountability would, as Barry Eichengreen has put it, be tantamount to “throwing the baby out with the bathwater.”

zh: 抵制政客的压力对于央行官员来说也许并不容易，因为许多经济体（包括中国、印尼、日本、韩国和台湾）的央行行长都将在未来几个月中换任。
en: Standing up to politicians may not be easy for central bankers, not least because, in many countries (including China, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan), the central bank’s governor is due to be replaced or reappointed in the coming months.

zh: 新的领导者需要带着信心履新，面对大规模不确定性坚定做出决定。
en: The new leaders will need to enter their positions with confidence, and remain steadfast in their decision-making in the face of large-scale uncertainty.

zh: 尽管如此，支持低而稳定的通胀并保持金融稳定的责任不应该全部压在央行行长肩上。
en: That said, central bankers should not be solely responsible for supporting low and stable inflation and maintaining financial stability.

zh: 显然，不能指望他们来推动就业创造和长期产出增长。
en: They certainly cannot be expected to drive job creation and output growth in the long term.

zh: 因此，他们必须与决策者合作，包括财政当局和金融监管当局，来确保正确的货币和财政政策组合和结构性改革。
en: That is why they must cooperate with policymakers, including fiscal authorities and financial regulators, to ensure the right mix of monetary and fiscal policy, as well as structural reform.

zh: 全球经济危机爆发已经十年，世界经济正在向正常态靠拢 — — 这一状态要求亚洲和西方逐渐收紧货币政策。
en: A decade after the global economic crisis began, the world economy is on the path toward normalcy – a path that demands the gradual tightening of monetary policy in Asia and the West alike.

zh: 现在，央行需要满足这一要求，同时还不能扼杀复苏。
en: It is now up to central banks to meet that demand, without derailing the recovery.

zh: 短暂的亚洲世纪？
en: The Short Asian Century?

zh: 东京—英国马克思主义历史学家埃里克·霍布斯鲍姆（Eric Hobsbawm）曾经将1789年法国大革命至1914年第一次世界大战爆发期间的这一段时间称为“延长的十九世纪 ” 。
en: TOKYO – The British Marxist historian Eric Hobsbawm once called the epoch stretching from the French Revolution of 1789 to World War I’s outbreak in 1914 as the “long nineteenth century.”

zh: 十多年前，人们开始预测“亚洲世纪”即将出现，其背后的主要动力是不可阻挡的中国，而美国看似不可避免的衰退则提供了助力。
en: A little over a decade ago, people began to speculate about an emerging “Asian century,” driven by an unstoppable China and enabled by America’s supposed inevitable decline.

zh: 但中国经济陷入了动荡，重要的东亚“小龙”经济体（如马来西亚和泰国等）颓势尽显，甚至新加坡也面临着经济模式是否可行的问题，难道这个“亚洲世纪”即将夭折？
en: But with China’s economy in turmoil, key East Asian “tiger” economies like Malaysia and Thailand floundering, and even Singapore facing questions about the vitality of its economic model, is this “Asian century” coming to a premature end?

zh: 政治和经济麻烦从东向西困扰着整个地区。
en: Political and economic troubles plague the region from east to west.

zh: 在印度和印度尼西亚，莫迪和维多多分别当选总理和总统让人们寄希望于他们为如今看起来步履蹒跚经济改革带来新活力。
en: In India and Indonesia, hopes that the election of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and President Joko Widodo, respectively, would spark a new wave of economic reform now seem to be running into the sand.

zh: 类似地，在韩国，连续两位总统都没能兑现遏制财阀（家族控制的企业集团 ） 、 从而释放企业家精神的动物精神的承诺。
en: Similarly, in South Korea, two successive presidents have failed to follow through on their bold promises to rein in the chaebol, the country’s massive family-owned conglomerates, in order to unleash the animal spirits of entrepreneurship.

zh: 而在日本，尽管首相安倍晋三实施了深刻的改革，但仍未能重振经济活力，而解决因人口快速老化而带来的人口问题的措施甚至尚未开始。
en: And in Japan, although Prime Minister Shinzo Abe has implemented far-reaching reforms, they have yet to reignite economic dynamism, and efforts to address the demographic threat posed by a rapidly aging population have not even begun.

zh: 还有其他许多严重的政治和安全挑战，包括美国和中国之间日益严重的战略对峙、整个地区民族主义复兴的信号，以及香港“一国两制”政府模式的崩溃趋势。
en: Then there are Asia’s serious political and security challenges, including the growing strategic rivalry between the United States and China, signs of resurgent nationalism across the region, and the fracturing of Hong Kong’s “one country, two systems” mode of government.

zh: 更令人不安的是，中国在东海和南海以及印度阿鲁纳恰尔邦大肆主张领土权。
en: More destabilizing, China is making vast territorial claims in the East and South China Seas, as well as to the Indian province of Arunchal Pradesh.

zh: 而最危险的情况也许是与世隔绝又不可预测的朝鲜政权正在金正恩冒进的暴力领导下变得比以往任何时候都更加不稳定。
en: And, perhaps most dangerous, the isolated and unpredictable North Korean regime is becoming more unstable than ever under the callow and violent leadership of Kim Jong-un.

zh: 在缺少统一地区框架的情况下，毫不奇怪会产生互相敌对的结构。 美国领衔的跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP）将环太平洋12国联系起来，形成一个巨大的自由贸易区，并根据一套一致同意的事先确定的规则治理。
en: In the absence of coherent regional frameworks, it is no surprise that rival structures are being built, with the US championing the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP), which will link 12 Pacific Rim countries into a vast free-trade area, governed by an advanced set of agreed rules.

zh: 而中国也在致力于通过亚洲基础设施投资银行和“丝绸之路”计划构建一个以中国为中心的贸易区，这个贸易区将服务于其地区霸权和国家资本主义模式。
en: For its part, China is working to establish, through the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and its “Silk Road” initiative, a Sino-centric trade area that perpetuates not only its regional hegemony, but also its state-capitalist model.

zh: 所有这些不确定性彰显出亚洲安全基础存在关键缺陷 — — 这些缺陷被该地区的高速经济增长所掩盖，知道最近才显露出来。
en: All of this uncertainty reveals critical flaws in the Asian century’s foundations – flaws that, until recently, were masked by the region’s rapid economic growth.

zh: 事实上，将各国企业联系在一起的巨大生产链营造出一个独一无二的亚洲上层建筑的印象。
en: Indeed, vast production chains linking businesses across countries gave the impression of a uniquely Asian superstructure.

zh: 只要该地区各经济体继续欣欣向荣，就不会有人有动力认识 — — 更不用说纠正 — — 它们所面临的问题。
en: As long as the region’s economies were thriving, there was little incentive to identify – much less address – the problems facing them.

zh: 由此带来的政策惯性构成了该地区诸多新见经济问题的核心。
en: The resulting policy inertia lay at the heart of many of the region’s emerging economic troubles.

zh: 而这一顽疾难以治愈，部分是因为它已经深深嵌入了一些国家的政府系统。
en: And this torpor will be difficult to address, partly because it is built into some countries’ systems of government.

zh: 比如，印度的联邦制度对改革的阻碍作用远远大于莫迪的预计，邦政府对新的统一销售税和土地改革怨声载道，而这两项措施都是让印度构建以世界级基础设施为基础的统一的内部市场的关键。
en: India’s federal system, for example, has proved to be a much bigger roadblock to reform than Modi anticipated, with state governments balking at measures like a new unified sales tax and land reform – both crucial to enable India to build a unified internal market underpinned by world-class infrastructure.

zh: 越南面临着类似的政策无力问题，因为其共产党领导集体内部存在分歧。
en: Vietnam faces a similar problem of policy paralysis, owing to divisions within its collective communist-party leadership.

zh: 中国自上而下的国家资本主义使其避免了这一问题，执政的中国共产党在经济日程上相对统一。
en: China’s top-down state capitalism has enabled it to avoid this problem, with the ruling Chinese Communist Party relatively united on the economic agenda.

zh: 但中国经济在过去几十年中几乎不可遏制的增长制造了其他一些艰巨挑战 — — 即地球上其他任何地区都甘拜下风的环境破坏、巨大的地方政府债务以及大规模腐败。
en: But the economy’s virtually unchecked growth over the last few decades has created other huge challenges – namely, environmental degradation on a scale unseen anywhere else on the planet, a massive volume of local-government debt, and large-scale corruption.

zh: 所有这些问题现在都已公开爆发。
en: All have now burst into the open.

zh: 而中共处理这些问题的能力未必如人们所认为的那样坚挺，最近其处理股市波动的拙劣管理表现清楚地表明了这一点。
en: And the Party’s ability to address them cannot be taken for granted, as its muddled management of recent stock-market volatility made clear.

zh: 中国经济混乱到底有多深尚不清楚，因为其决策过程和关键统计数字仍然讳莫如深。
en: The actual depth of China’s economic woes is unclear, given that both decision-making and key statistics remain shrouded in secrecy.

zh: 清楚的是当局大受欢迎的向更可持续的贸易和消费驱动经济的转型需要深远的市场改革。
en: What is clear is that the authorities sought-after shift to a more sustainable services- and consumption-driven economy will require far-reaching market-oriented reforms.

zh: 这是中国执政者的生存选择，因为成功改革要求政府让出控制权，而这与国家主席习近平增强党对国家控制力的目标背道而驰。
en: This represents an existential choice for China’s rulers, as the ceding of government control that successful reform demands clashes directly with President Xi Jinping’s goal of strengthening the Party’s grip on the country.

zh: 马来西亚和泰国也面临着接近生死存亡的选择，一边是继续当前道路 — — 马来西亚是一党家族统治，泰国则是精英/军方统治 — — 另一边是开始政治妥协，让人口中为数巨大的边缘化人群也加入其中。
en: Malaysia and Thailand also face a near-existential choice between continuing on their current paths – one-party ethnocracy in Malaysia and elite/military rule in Thailand – and beginning a process of political reconciliation, aimed at bringing large, marginalized portions of their populations into the fold.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，两国领导人似乎都对他们所面临的选择视而不见。
en: So far, however, it seems that both countries’ leaders are blind to the choice facing them.

zh: 也许最有希望的是日本，二十年后，日本终于开始扭转根深蒂固的政��惯性。
en: Perhaps the most hopeful story is that of Japan, which, after two decades, has finally begun to reverse its entrenched policy inertia.

zh: 偏向农业、电力和其他经济部门的旧习惯正在成为众矢之的。
en: Old habits of coddling agriculture, electric power, and other economic sectors are being disregarded.

zh: 当然，日本还有更多的事要做，特别是签署TPP，该协议将为日本经济打开更多领域。
en: More needs to be done, of course, particularly ratification of the TPP, which will unshackle more areas of Japan’s economy.

zh: 安倍进三的方针相当果断，他也堪称是其他亚洲领导人的榜样 — — 特别是中国。
en: With his bold approach, Abe has emerged as a model for Asia’s other leaders – in particular, the Chinese.

zh: 如果亚洲世纪想要继续下去，这种果断是必不可少的。
en: If the Asian century is to endure, such boldness will be vital.

zh: 为实现亚洲世纪而联合起来
en: Uniting for an Asian Century

zh: 发自首尔 — — 毫无疑问，如今亚洲在全球经济中的地位要比以往任何时候都更重要。
en: SEOUL – There is no question that Asia’s standing in the global economy is stronger than ever.

zh: 根据购买力平价计算，该地区目前生产了全球GDP中的约40 % 。
en: The region now produces about 40% of the world’s GDP, measured according to purchasing power parity.

zh: 而在最近一次经济危机中，亚洲又贡献了全球GDP增长的一半以上。
en: During the recent economic crisis, Asia accounted for more than half of global GDP growth.

zh: 再加上庞大的人口以及不断扩大的政治影响力，亚洲似乎终于在长期由西方主导的世界舞台上显露出了领头羊的气象。
en: Add to that a massive population and growing political influence, and Asia finally appears ready to lead on a world stage long dominated by the West.

zh: 但现在庆祝还为时过早。
en: But it is too early to open the champagne.

zh: 美国和欧洲在全球战略影响力方面依然保持着优势，而亚洲各国则面临着重大的政治，经济和安全挑战。
en: The United States and Europe maintain an advantage, in terms of global strategic influence, while Asian countries are facing major political, economic, and security challenges.

zh: 事实上，亚洲的增长势头正在放缓。
en: In fact, Asia’s growth momentum is declining.

zh: 经过几十年的突破性扩张之后，中国正在奋力实现经济软着陆。
en: China is working overtime to achieve an economic soft landing, following decades of breakneck expansion.

zh: 日本急于脱离缓慢增长的泥潭并应对人口老龄化。
en: Japan is preoccupied with escaping slow growth and coping with population aging.

zh: 其他亚洲经济引擎 — — 印度，印尼和韩国 — — 都面临着各自的经济和政治问题。
en: Asia’s other economic powerhouses – India, Indonesia, and South Korea – each face their own set of economic and political problems.

zh: 整个地区不断扩大的收入不平等，金融不稳定和环境退化都在阻碍着发展。
en: Across the region, rising income inequality, financial instability, and environmental degradation are hampering development.

zh: 但问题在于，尽管该地区各国互相依存程度极深，但仍然难以实现集体行动。
en: More problematic, despite being deeply interdependent, the region’s countries struggle to act collectively.

zh: 势力对抗，历史不满和领土争端的持续存在，以及经济和军事力量上的显着差异都对区域一体化造成了实质性障碍。
en: The persistence of power rivalries, historical resentments, and territorial disputes, together with pronounced disparities in economic and military might, create substantial obstacles to unity.

zh: 近期中国强硬行动的激增，印度民族主义复兴，以及日本向保守主义的转变都加剧了这些挑战。
en: A recent surge in coercive behavior by China, a nationalist revival in India, and a shift toward conservatism in Japan have exacerbated these challenges.

zh: 但在这个西方国家走向孤立主义的时代 — — 以英国的脱欧公投和美国人选举特朗普为美国总统为标志 — — 区域内的贸易和投资会比以往任何时候都更重要。
en: But, at a time when Western countries are moving toward isolationism – exemplified by the Brexit vote in the United Kingdom and the election of Donald Trump as US president – intra-regional trade and investment are more important than ever.

zh: 除了经济效益之外一体化将产生重要的政治效益，令亚洲在国际舞台上更具影响力。
en: Beyond the economic benefits, integration would yield important political benefits, with an integrated Asia enjoying more influence on the international stage.

zh: 为了获得这些好处，亚洲必须减少区域内军事和政治冲突，并制定一套实现区域一体化的长期愿景。
en: To reap those benefits, Asia must mitigate regional military and political conflicts and develop a long-term vision for regional integration.

zh: 亚洲是世界上其中一些最危险的火药桶的所在地。
en: Asia is home to some of the world’s most dangerous flashpoints.

zh: 在东中国海和南中国海存在着武装冲突的危险，而朝鲜不顾美国和联合国的更严厉制裁持续研发核武器和弹道导弹。
en: There is a risk of armed clashes in the East and South China Seas, and North Korea continues to develop nuclear weapons and ballistic missiles, despite tougher sanctions pushed by the United States and the United Nations.

zh: 亚洲国家与国际社会加强合作可以缓解区域紧张局势，并令朝鲜放弃核武计划。
en: Stronger cooperation among Asian countries, together with the international community, could ease regional tensions and lead North Korea to abandon its nuclear weapons programs.

zh: 一些区域性架构，包括东南亚国家联盟（东盟 ） ， 东盟+3（东盟的十个成员加上中国，日本和韩国）和东亚峰会（EAS）都已经建立。
en: Some regional institutions have already been established, including the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), ASEAN+3 (the ten members of the ASEAN plus China, Japan, and South Korea) and the East Asia Summit (EAS).

zh: 这类架构将对解决冲突并建立一个能够支持区域繁荣和全球领导的和平框架至关重要。
en: Such institutions will be critical to resolving conflicts and establishing a framework for peace that can support regional prosperity and global leadership.

zh: 但这只是第一步，因为尚不能明确亚洲领导人是否拥有共同的区域一体化愿景。
en: But that is only the first step. And whether Asian leaders share a common vision for regional integration remains unclear.

zh: 根据欧洲的经验 — — 从1951年欧洲煤钢共同体成立到1993年欧洲联盟建立 — — 没有必要去匆忙推动整合，但这个过程确实要耗费极大的时间和精力。
en: Judging by Europe’s experience – from the creation of the European Coal and Steel Community in 1951 to the establishment of the European Union in 1993 – there is no need to rush the integration process. But it will take a lot of time and effort.

zh: 也许启动这一进程的最好方法是确定该地区可以在那些领域中率先通过整合获益，并采取一些能带来快速回报的措施。
en: Perhaps the best way to kick-start this process is to identify areas where the region can gain the most from integration, and take steps that will bring quick returns.

zh: 例如，亚洲国家可以走向单一市场，制定有关贸易和劳动者（特别是技术工人）自由流动的共同规则。
en: For example, Asian countries can move toward a single market with common rules governing trade and free movement of workers, especially skilled ones.

zh: 还有就是发起区域全面经济伙伴关系，目前由东盟及六个合作伙​​伴（澳大利亚，中国，印度，日本，韩国和新西兰）正在谈判的自由贸易协定将是朝这个方向迈出的重要一步。
en: Launching the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership, a free-trade agreement currently being negotiated by ASEAN and six partners (Australia, China, India, Japan, South Korea, and New Zealand), would be an important step in this direction.

zh: 鉴于跨境资本流动的脆弱性，亚洲还必须在金融监查，监督和监管问题上采取联合行动以预防和管理危机。
en: Given the vulnerability of cross-border capital flows, Asia must also pursue joint action on financial supervision, surveillance, and regulatory issues to prevent and manage crises.

zh: 一个具体目标应该是提升《清迈多边化倡议》这个总金额达2400亿美元的货币互换安排以及其附属监查机构东盟+3宏观经济研究办公室的职能。
en: One specific goal should be to improve the Chiang Mai Initiative Multilateralization, a $240 billion currency-swap arrangement, and its surveillance unit, the ASEAN+3 Macroeconomic Research Office.

zh: 另一个应该是建立一个实质上的亚洲货币基金并吸纳更广泛的成员。
en: Another should be to establish a de facto Asian Monetary Fund with a broader membership.

zh: 应当指出的是，这些努力都不是为了取代现有的次区域，区域和全球机构。
en: It should be noted that none of these efforts would aim to supplant existing sub-regional, regional, and global institutions.

zh: 相反，通过使亚洲成为更有效和统一的行动者，新的区域贸易和金融措施将能对当前的安排予以补充和加强。
en: Rather, by making Asia a more effective and united actor, new regional trade and financial measures would complement and strengthen current arrangements.

zh: 为了实现这一目标，官僚机构和私营部门，包括商界领袖和学术界，都必须积极支持针对一体化的高级别政治承诺。
en: For any of this to work, bureaucracies and the private sector, including business leaders and academics, must actively support high-level political commitments to integration.

zh: 把这种支持汇集起来不会太难。
en: Such support should not be too difficult to muster.

zh: 毕竟一体化将有助于交流从有效经济和社会政策到技术和科学见解的种种珍贵知识。
en: After all, integration would facilitate the exchange of valuable knowledge, from effective economic and social policies to technological and scientific insight.

zh: 关于区域公共物品的论坛和对话也可以证明是有价值的，因为它们可以促进对包括流行病，自然灾害和环境退化等跨边界挑战的合作。
en: Forums and dialogues on regional public goods could also prove valuable by promoting cooperation on cross-border challenges, including epidemics, natural disasters, and environmental degradation.

zh: 人与人之间的联系也有助于强调亚洲社会的文化共性和共同价值观，以推动在某些国家有所滞后的领域取得进展。
en: Person-to-person connections would help to highlight for Asian societies their cultural commonalities and shared values, fostering progress in areas where particular countries might lag.

zh: 在全球秩序日趋充满不确定性的时候，亚洲应该通过进行更密切的经济和政治区域合作来掌握自己的命运。
en: At a time when the global order is increasingly uncertain, Asia should take its fate into its own hands, by pursuing closer economic and political regional cooperation.

zh: 如果亚洲国家能够为经济共同体和政治联合体制定共同的愿景，那么这个世纪就将是它们的世纪。
en: If Asian countries can develop a shared vision for an economic community and a political association, this century could be theirs.

zh: 亚洲人在非洲留下的足迹
en: Asian Footsteps in Africa

zh: 剑桥 — — 看看当今社会，资本主义 — — 在那些“救助经济”横行的日子里 — — 正在无情地改变着非洲。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Don’t look now, but capitalism – maligned in these bailout-ridden recessionary days – is reshaping Africa inexorably.

zh: 如今，来自中国和印度的救助和那些传统的老牌资本主义国家比较起来，究竟又有什么区别呢？
en: What is different today is that it is emanating from China and India, rather than from the conventional bastions of capitalist prowess.

zh: 黛非·舍蒂，这位来自班加罗的著名心脏外科手术专家，通过他医院的Narayana计划给印度大众带来医疗拯救计划。
en: Devi Shetty, a celebrated cardiac surgeon in Bangalore, brings health relief to India’s masses through his Narayana group of hospitals.

zh: 我目睹了他早期在印度农村通过远程医疗救助边远地区，特别是在印度的卡纳塔克邦和孟加拉邦。
en: Some years ago, I witnessed his early experiments with rural telemedicine, especially in the Indian states of Karnataka and West Bengal.

zh: 去年我访问过他一次，在那里，我看到墙上挂着卡纳塔克邦的大幅地图。 上面用彩色图标插着彩旗，表明着他的医疗已经覆盖了遍及边远地区的卡纳塔克邦大部分的范围。
en: In my visit last month, the wall was adorned by a large map of Karnataka festooned with colored pins, to indicate that he now served most district capitals in the remotest parts of the state.

zh: 在另一张世界地图上，东非和南亚上的广大农村地区也标上了记号，说明了服务的范围已经向着全球化扩张。
en: Moreover, a world map showed outreach to rural areas of East Africa and Southeast Asia, and the room has been upgraded to reflect a still-expanding global reach.

zh: 所有的一切来源于精湛的技术 — — 技术上和社会学上的 — — 通过卫星的联结，利用远程通讯技术将专业的医疗服务提供出来。
en: All this comes from carefully acquired experience – technical and sociological – with delivering expert medical advice through teleconference facilities, aided by satellite links.

zh: 舍蒂团队已经在非洲14个国家的医院，通过远程医疗成功提供丰富多彩的长期的医疗教育。
en: Shetty’s team has successfully participated in telemedicine consultations – multi-specialty, non-stop availability, and supplemented by continuing education – with hospitals in 14 African countries.

zh: 以上的计划是印度总统阿卜杜尔•卡拉姆博士雄心勃勃的与非洲e-Network计划中的一部分，目的是将印度的第三代医疗技术提供给非洲53个首都的医院。
en: This effort is part of then Indian President A. P. J. Abdul Kalam’s ambitious pan-African e-Network project to link all 53 African capitals to tertiary care facilities across India.

zh: 舍蒂是一个医生和开拓者，同时他也是一个企业家。
en: Shetty is a healer, first and foremost.

zh: 他的目标是给世界上贫瘠的土地带来低成本高效能，最尖端的科技医疗服务。
en: But he is also an entrepreneur, and this is the latest in his many efforts to create successful, low-cost, but cutting-edge medical ecosystems in tough locations worldwide.

zh: 他把他的计划大胆的称为全球范围的“沃尔玛式”的医疗 — — 满足全球范围，特别是在非洲地区的极端匮乏医疗需求。 。
en: He aspires audaciously to what he calls the universal Walmartization of healthcare – a reshaping of medical care that the world’s indigent need, and in Africa more than most other locations.

zh: 务实主义者会认为印度在非洲的e-Network计划的目的 — — 换取非洲的自然资源。
en: Cynics say that India’s e-Network is currying favor with Africa in exchange for natural resources. Perhaps.

zh: 如果是这样的话，印度必须和他的邻居中国展开竞争。 后者目前在非洲更有实力和更有发言权。
en: But in that effort, India must contend with its neighbor, China, which speaks with a louder voice and carries a larger stick.

zh: 中国国家主席胡锦涛在非洲的“巡视”外交访问确保了中国人在非洲的主导地位。
en: Chinese Communist Party President Hu Jintao’s peripatetic diplomacy across Africa has ensured that the Chinese are omnipresent there.

zh: 中国在非洲 — — 除去安哥拉，苏丹和津巴布韦之外的国家 — — 的基础设施投入了大量的投资，以换取非洲的自然资源。
en: China has traded much investment in physical infrastructure in places otherwise shunned – Angola, Sudan, and Zimbabwe – for access to natural resources.

zh: 2006年，来自48个非洲国家的首脑和高级官员参加的北京会谈，更加说明了中国不可撼动的在非洲的地位。
en: Witness also an unprecedented convening of 48 African heads of state and senior officials in Beijing in 2006 to signal unequivocally that China would speak with the loudest voice.

zh: 印度也不甘示弱，在2008年的新德里也举办了一次印非峰会。
en: India tried to mimic the event, with an India-Africa summit in New Delhi in 2008.

zh: 会议有14个非洲国家参加，议题是关于粮食价格上涨，能源的需求等。
en: Fourteen countries attended to discuss food price inflation, energy needs, etc.

zh: 唉，印度的声音显得有点微弱，原因倒不是中国对印度的医疗教育的服务。 而是来自中国国有企业在非洲的基础设施的投资。
en: Alas, India’s voice was drowned out, not by China’s attempts to provide medicine and education to Africa, but by the sheer magnitude of Chinese state-owned enterprises’ investments in physical infrastructure.

zh: 但声音大并不表示就一定有效果。
en: But loud voices need not be the most effective.

zh: 印度的影响力在一些国家无可撼动，例如有大量印度侨民居住的南非，肯尼亚，坦桑尼亚和尼日利亚等。
en: Indian influence will no doubt exploit assets less available to others, particularly the Indian diaspora in countries like South Africa, Kenya, Tanzania, and Nigeria.

zh: 经过几个世纪的贸易，宗教以及长期互动，还有殖民政治之后的共同价值观。
en: India and Africa have been linked over the centuries by trade, religion, and post-imperial political consciousness.

zh: 甘地和不结盟运动也是一个重要的象征。
en: Gandhi and the Non-Aligned Movement remain important symbols.

zh: 印度和非洲的联系比中国更加有根基，原因是双方通过长期的“荣辱与共”而形成的。
en: Indians are more part of Africa’s social tapestry than are the Chinese, a fabric that has been strengthened through opportunity and adversity through the ages.

zh: 现在来看看总部位于新加坡，业务面向非洲的Olam国际农业公司，从巴西的马托格罗索的大豆农场到乌克兰的谷物，Olam公司在不同的领域都表现非凡。
en: Consider Olam, a Singapore-headquartered but Africa-centric global agribusiness company.  From the soybean farms of Brazil’s Matto Grosso to the granaries of Ukraine, Olam is prized for its ability to add value in disparate conditions.

zh: Olam公司的起源是在尼日利亚的印度人，如今在棉花，咖啡，腰果等领域还保持有着世界级的贸易水平。
en: Olam was started by Indians in Nigeria and remains a world-beating trader in cotton, coffee, cashews and the like.

zh: 为了成功，Olam国际不能不和一些“内陆国家 ” — —其实就是“远离港口的内陆城市”的代称 — — 由愿意在这里工作的印度人开展工作。
en: To succeed, Olam has had to work “up-country” ­– a euphemism for difficult conditions far from comfortable port cities – requiring it to rely on Indians’ familiarity with, and willingness to work in, Africa’s interior.

zh: 实际上，和Olam公司一样的模式就是�丰益国际公司，由一名来自南亚的海外华人创办，进军非洲后和Olam组成了合资公司。
en: Indeed, so competent is Olam that when Wilmar, a Southeast Asian firm run by overseas Chinese and a force in its own right in China and across Asia, sought to expand in Africa, it sought out Olam in a joint venture.

zh: 尼日利亚腰果农场主和黛非•舍蒂的儿科心脏手术计划一样，共同代表了分权制度的私人公司。 通过市场的竞争，而不是象由在达尔富尔及其他地区的那些中国政府控制的中石油和中石化这样的公司模式。
en: The connection between Nigerian cashew farmers and Devi Shetty’s pediatric cardiac surgery is that they both represent decentralized private activity, undertaken through the market, unlike the operations of the China National Petroleum Corporation, Sinopec, and others in Darfur and elsewhere.��They all add value, but decentralized market-based activity appears likelier to engender additional goodwill.

zh: 内在的互利互惠的原则导致很多变化正在悄然发生，不是来自政府的行政命令。
en: But there is more reshaping to come, again fostered by mutual self-interest, rather than by fiat.

zh: Olam和Wilmar合资公司的成立，在某种意义上来说，就是亚洲的资产对非洲经济的一种催化组合。
en: The Olam and Wilmar joint venture is, in a sense, symptomatic of the combination of assets from across Asia that can catalyze productive change in Africa.

zh: 这正是“Olam”这个单词在希伯莱语的意思 ： “ 超越国界”
en: It is fitting that Olam, in Hebrew, means “transcending boundaries.”

zh: 以上新生事物可以看作是对传统的挑战，当然，失败也是再所难免的，不过，在我看来，这种分权的实验模式要好与对国外援助的依赖。
en: Failures will result, surely. But, to my mind, for the most part, decentralized experimentation beats Africa’s partial addiction to aid.

zh: 亚洲民族主义的海上争端
en: Asian Nationalism at Sea

zh: 剑桥 — — 东亚海域会不会爆发战争？
en: CAMBRIDGE – Will war break out in the seas of East Asia?

zh: 在中日民族主义者针锋相对地占领中国称为钓鱼岛而日本称为尖阁列岛的不毛之地后，中国西南城市成都的示威者愤怒地高呼 ： “ 杀光所有日本人。 ”
en: After Chinese and Japanese nationalists staged competing occupations of the barren landmasses that China refers to as the Diaoyu Islands and Japan calls the Senkaku Islands, angry demonstrators in the southwestern Chinese city of Chengdu chanted, “We must kill all Japanese.”

zh: 同样，中菲船只在南海斯卡伯勒礁（黄岩岛）的对峙引发了马尼拉的抗议风潮。
en: Likewise, a standoff between Chinese and Philippine vessels in the Scarborough Shoal in the South China Sea led to protests in Manila.

zh: 韩国总统对韩国称为独岛、日本称为竹岛、而美国称为利扬库尔岩的荒芜岛礁的访问粉碎了韩日深化合作的希望。
en: And a long planned step forward in cooperation between South Korea and Japan was torpedoed when the South Korean president visited the barren island that Korea calls Dokdo, Japan calls Takeshima, and the United States calls the Liancourt Rocks.

zh: 但对局势的危险性也不应过分夸张。
en: One should not be too alarmist.

zh: 美国已经宣布《美日安保条约》涵盖尖阁列岛（1972年归还日本后由冲绳县负责管辖 ） 。
en: The US has declared that the Senkaku Islands (administered by the Okinawa Prefecture when it was returned to Japan in 1972) are covered by the US-Japan security treaty.

zh: 与此同时，斯卡伯勒礁的对峙也已经渐趋平静，而且虽然日本在独岛事件后召回了驻韩国大使，但两国开战的可能性不大。
en: Meanwhile, the standoff over the Scarborough Shoal has calmed down, and, while Japan recalled its ambassador from South Korea over the Dokdo incident, it is unlikely the two countries would come to blows.

zh: 但值得一提的是中国曾在1974年和1988年两次以致命武力驱走了西沙群岛的越南人。
en: But it is worth recalling that China used lethal force to expel Vietnamese from the Paracel Islands in 1974 and 1988.

zh: 中国还在今年柬埔寨召开的东盟峰会上成功阻止了呼吁制定南海行为准则的最后公报 — — 这是东盟十成员国四十年历史上首次未能发表公报。
en: And China prevailed upon the Cambodian host of this year’s ASEAN summit to block a final communiqué that would have called for a code of conduct in the South China Sea – the first time in the ten-member association’s four-decade history that it failed to issue a communiqué.

zh: 东亚极端民族主义的复兴既令人担忧但又在情理之中。
en: The revival of extreme nationalism in East Asia is both worrisome and understandable.

zh: 虽然希腊可能会抱怨德国的紧急融资支持计划，但二战后欧洲国家的联系已经比之前密切了许多。
en: In Europe, while Greeks may grumble about the terms of German backing for emergency financing, the period since World War II has seen enormous progress in knitting countries together.

zh: 但亚洲并没有出现类似的情况，二十世纪三四十年代的争端仍然悬而未决，满是偏见的教科书和政府政策又使争议问题进一步恶化。
en: Nothing similar has happened in Asia, and issues dating back to the 1930’s and 1940’s remain raw, a problem exacerbated by biased textbooks and government policies.

zh: 中国共产党已经不太信奉共产主义了。
en: The Chinese Communist Party is not very communist any more.

zh: 相反，快速经济增长和汉民族主义已经成为其合法统治的基础。
en: Instead, it bases its legitimacy on rapid economic growth and ethnic Han nationalism.

zh: 1894－1895年中日战争和二十世纪三十年代日本侵华在政治上非常有用，因为它与帝国主义迫害中国的宏观主题相切合。
en: Memories of the Sino-Japanese War of 1894-1895 and Japanese aggression in the 1930’s are politically useful and fit within a larger theme of Chinese victimization by imperialist forces.

zh: 美国某些国防分析人士认为中国的海洋战略显然具有攻击性。
en: Some American defense analysts view China’s maritime strategy as being clearly aggressive.

zh: 该战略试图扩大国防开支，推进导弹和潜艇技术的研发，以封锁从中国沿海到台湾日本的“第一岛链”所属海域。
en: They point to increasing defense expenditures and the development of missile and submarine technology designed to cordon off the seas extending from China’s coast to “the first island chain” of Taiwan and Japan.

zh: 也有人认为中国战略矛盾、混乱，充斥着自相矛盾的官僚利益。
en: Others, however, see a Chinese strategy that is confused, contradictory, and paralyzed by competing bureaucratic interests.

zh: 他们指出了2008年经济危机后中国高调政策的负面结果。
en: They point to the negative results of China’s more assertive policies since the economic crisis of 2008.

zh: 实际上，中国政策已经损害了它与几乎所有邻国的关系。
en: Indeed, China’s policies have damaged its relations with nearly all of its neighbors.

zh: 比方说2010年的尖阁事件，在日本逮捕了撞击海岸警卫队舰艇的中国船长之后，中国进一步升级了经济报复。
en: Consider the Senkaku incident in 2010, when, after Japan arrested the crew of a Chinese trawler that had rammed a Japanese coast guard vessel, China escalated its economic reprisals.

zh: 结果正像一位日本分析人士所说的那样 ， “ 中国自摆乌龙 ” ， 即刻扭转了执政民主党温和的双边政策。
en: The result, as one Japanese analyst put it, was that “China scored an own goal,” immediately reversing what had been a favorable trend in bilateral relations under the ruling Democratic Party of Japan.

zh: 总体而言，尽管中国耗资数十亿人民币提高其在亚洲的软实力，但它在南海的所作所为却与自己试图传递的信息相冲突。
en: More generally, while China spends billions of renminbi in efforts to increase its soft power in Asia, its behavior in the South China Sea contradicts its own message.

zh: 我也曾问过中国的朋友和官员中国为什么奉行如此适得其反的政策。
en: I have asked Chinese friends and officials why China follows such a counterproductive strategy.

zh: 他们给出的正式答案是中国沿袭了民国时期的地图画法和领土要求，图上的九条虚线几乎将整个南海囊括为中国领土。
en: The first and formal answer is that China inherited historical territorial claims, including a map from the Nationalist period that sketches a “nine-dotted line” encompassing virtually the entire South China Sea.

zh: 如今，随着水下技术的发展和相关海域渔业资源的开发，更不可能放弃这笔继承得来的财富。
en: Today, with technology making underwater as well as fisheries resources more exploitable in the area, it is impossible to abandon this patrimony.

zh: 2009-2010年，有些中层官员和评论员甚至将南海像台湾或西藏那样纳入中国核心利益的范畴。
en: In 2009-2010, some mid-ranking officials and commentators even referred to the South China Sea as a sovereign “core interest” like Taiwan or Tibet.

zh: 但中国领导人从未划定过“九条虚线”的确切位置，也没有明确过他们的要求是仅仅针对某些地貌，还是更为宽泛的海洋和大陆架。
en: But China’s leaders have never been clear about the exact location of the “nine-dotted line,” or about whether their claims refer only to certain land features, or also to more extensive continental shelves and seas.

zh: 当被问及中国为什么不澄清要求时，中方对话者有时会说这需要艰难的政治和官僚妥协，还有可能刺激国内的民族主义者。
en: When asked why they do not clarify their claims, my Chinese interlocutors sometimes say that to do so would require difficult political and bureaucratic compromises that would provoke domestic nationalists.

zh: 此外，他们有时会说中方不愿过早放弃筹码。
en: Moreover, sometimes they say that they do not want to give away a bargaining chip prematurely.

zh: 1995和2010年，美国宣布南海应服从《1982年联合国海洋公约法》的管辖（讽刺的是美国至今尚未批准这一公约 ） ， 但美国不对领土要求表明态度。
en: In 1995, and again in 2010, the US declared that the waters of the South China Sea should be governed by the 1982 United Nations Law of the Seas Treaty (which, ironically, the US has not yet ratified), but that the US takes no position on the territorial claims.

zh: 相反，美国敦促通过谈判解决冲突的领土要求。
en: Instead, the US urged that competing claims be resolved through negotiation.

zh: 2002年，中国和东盟达成了不具有法律约束力的冲突管理准则，但作为大国，中国认为与小国进行双边而非多边谈判能够获取更多利益。
en: In 2002, China and ASEAN agreed on a legally non-binding code of conduct for managing such disputes, but, as a large power, China believes that it will gain more in bilateral rather than multilateral negotiations with small countries.

zh: 本着这种信念，中国对柬埔寨施压阻止东盟夏天发表最后公报。
en: That belief was behind China’s pressure on Cambodia to block ASEAN’s final communiqué this summer.

zh: 但这是一项错误的政策。
en: But this is a mistaken strategy.

zh: 身为大国的中国在任何情况下都有很大的影响力，签署行为准则能够控制自我损伤。
en: As a large power, China will have great weight in any circumstance, and it can reduce its self-inflicted damage by agreeing to a code of conduct.

zh: 在尖阁/钓鱼岛问题上，最好的建议来自《经济学家 》 。
en: As for the Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands, the best proposal comes from The Economist.

zh: 中国应避免派遣官方船只进入日本海域，并开设对日热线管理民族主义“牛仔”造成的危机。
en: China should refrain from sending official vessels into Japanese waters, and use a hotline with Japan to manage crises generated by nationalist “cowboys.”

zh: 与此同时，两国应重新启动东海争议油气田共同开发框架，日本中央政府应向私人所有者购买这座荒岛，并宣布为国际海洋保护区。
en: At the same time, the two countries should revive a 2008 framework for joint development of disputed gas fields in the East China Sea, and Japan’s central government should purchase the barren islands from their private owner and declare them an international maritime protected area.

zh: 东亚各国应牢记丘吉尔的名言 ： “ 吵吵总比打打好。 ”
en: It is time for all countries in East Asia to remember Winston Churchill’s famous advice: “To jaw-jaw is always better than to war-war.”

zh: 亚洲随波逐流
en: Asia Adrift

zh: 新德里 — — 2012年在中国对东海和南海的恼人的主权要求中开始，但同时也存在着在东盟斡旋下达成行为准则，和平解决分歧的希望。
en: NEW DELHI – The year 2012 began with festering Chinese sovereignty claims in the South and East China Seas, but also with hope that a code of conduct brokered by the Association of Southeast Asian Nations would enable them to be resolved peacefully.

zh: 现在2012年已将近年尾，但希望却已成泡影，东盟国家也比以往更加四分五裂。
en: The year is ending, however, with those hopes dashed and ASEAN more divided than it has ever been.

zh: 其实，极少数东盟成员国现在似乎迫不及待地要在中国面前交出自己的国家利益和东盟利益。
en: Indeed, a handful of its members now seem eager to subordinate their national interests – and the interests of ASEAN – to those of China.

zh: 中国在提出领土要求时不断增强的自信造成以防御为核心的自民党在日本取得压倒性胜利，同时也导致保守的朴槿惠当选韩国有史以来第一任女总统。
en: China’s increasing assertiveness in staking its claims contributed to the landslide victory of the defense-minded Liberal Democrats in Japan, and to the conservative Park Geun-hye’s election as South Korea’s first-ever female president.

zh: 在地区紧张局势加剧的大背景下，奥巴马总统重新当选后不久就展开了对东南亚国家的访问。
en: Rising regional tensions also provided the backdrop to US President Barack Obama’s trip to Southeast Asia shortly after his re-election.

zh: 2012年1月奥巴马宣布美国战略“支点”向亚洲转移，以及从澳大利亚到印尼再到印度的一系列旋风式活动突显出贯穿全年的美国安全外交政策。
en: Obama announced the United States’ strategic “pivot” to the Asia-Pacific region in January 2012, and a whirlwind of activity there – from Australia to Indonesia to India – marked America’s security diplomacy throughout the year.

zh: 同样在日本，由中国自信所引发的忧虑变得如此强大，以致在三年前执政期间曾对美日同盟表现出相当大敌意的日本政府在面对中国对尖阁群岛（钓鱼岛）的主权要求时也开始四处宣扬同盟的共同防御承诺。
en: In Japan, too, worries about Chinese assertiveness have become so powerful that a government that showed considerable hostility to the US-Japan alliance when it came to power three years ago had, by November, begun to trumpet the alliance’s mutual-defense commitments as it confronted China’s claim to the Senkaku (Diaoyu) Islands.

zh: 促成这一外交政策的安全担忧引发了广泛的联盟，参与的不仅有区域民主国家，还有同样卷入以海上石油勘探为核心的对华领土争端的越南等国。
en: The security concerns that have animated this diplomacy are forging a broad coalition, bringing in not only the region’s democracies, but also countries like Vietnam, which is embroiled in its own territorial dispute with China that centers on maritime oil exploration.

zh: 就连一向对深化与美国安全关系持谨慎态度的印度现在也已接受地区双边防御的理念 — — 结盟对象不仅包括美国，也包括东亚国家和日本。
en: Even India, which has been cautious about deepening its security ties with the US, has now embraced the idea of regional mutual defense – not only with America, but also with Japan and other East Asian countries.

zh: 类似对地区安全的全新关注不仅局限于政府。
en: This new emphasis on regional security is not confined to governments.

zh: 对建立泛亚安全结构的公众支持不仅透过日韩选举可以看出端倪，透过最近奥巴马访问时缅甸欣喜若狂的群众也能够有所感悟。
en: Popular support for the creation of a pan-Asian security structure can be found not only in the election outcomes in Japan and South Korea, but also in the ecstatic crowds that greeted Obama in Myanmar (Burma) during his recent tour.

zh: 普通缅甸民众非常清楚中国对其自然资源过度需求所造成的反弹直接导致了该国的民主过渡。
en: Ordinary Burmese well understand that their country’s democratic transition is the direct result of its recoil from China’s excessive demands on its natural resources.

zh: 迄今为止，中国对所有新情况的反应是毫不妥协，坚持与在军事上远逊于自己的东盟成员国在双边基础上解决领土争端。
en: So far, China’s reaction to all of this new activity has been to dig in its heels and insist on addressing its territorial disputes with ASEAN’s militarily inferior members on a bilateral basis.

zh: 11月，中国挫败了东盟成员国成立多边论坛并签订共同行为准则规范南海经济安全活动的努力。
en: In November, China foiled ASEAN members’ efforts to create a multilateral forum and an agreed code of conduct to govern economic and security activity in the South China Sea.

zh: 这样不仅导致东盟集团陷入分裂，同时沉重打击了东盟到2015年底转化为类似欧盟的区域性集团的信心。
en: By doing so, it split the group and may well have thwarted ASEAN’s ambition to transform itself into a European Union-like regional bloc by the end of 2015.

zh: 中国争取到十一月东盟峰会主办国柬埔寨首相洪森，并借此成功达到了自己的目标。 洪森中断了对中国在南海高调表现的讨论，假称东盟成员国“一致同意”避免将上述问题“国际化 ” 。
en: China succeeded by winning over Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen, the host of November’s ASEAN summit, who cut off discussion of China’s assertive role in the South China Sea by falsely claiming that ASEAN’s members had reached a “consensus” against “internationalizing” the issue.

zh: （颇具讽刺意味的是1984年洪森任外长时，外交部曾出版一本名叫《中国统治者在柬埔寨所犯罪行》的书籍，一一历数了中国对奉行种族灭绝政策的红色高棉的支持。 ）
en: (Ironically, in 1984, when Hun Sen was Foreign Minister, the ministry published a book entitled The Chinese Rulers’ Crimes against Kampuchea, which documented China’s backing for the genocidal Khmer Rouge.)

zh: 东盟此次崩溃造成了严重的后果。
en: That ASEAN debacle has had serious consequences.

zh: 目前也正和中国发生激烈领土冲突的菲律宾外长不顾本国曾在日本占领中所受的痛苦，要求日本重新武装以维持对华的军事平衡。
en: The foreign minister of the Philippines, which is also currently engaged in a heated territorial conflict with China, called on Japan to rearm itself to balance China militarily, notwithstanding his country’s bitter legacy of Japanese occupation.

zh: 主张建立强大防御平台的安倍晋三在选举中获得压倒性的胜利，很可能导致日本不顾一切采取重建该国军事能力的举措。
en: The landslide election of Shinzo Abe, who campaigned on a robust defense platform, may well lead to a serious Japanese push to invigorate the country’s military capabilities.

zh: 中国负责管理所谓南海主权的海南省政府最近发表一项声明，可能进一步强化了上述冲动。
en: A recent announcement by the provincial government in Hainan, China, which has responsibility for the South China Sea territories claimed by China, has probably reinforced that impulse.

zh: 按照海南省政府的说法，从2013年1月1日起，中国警方将有权登船并扣留在所谓中国领海涉嫌“非法活动”的船舶。
en: According to the Hainan authorities, from January 1, 2013, China’s police will be authorized to board and detain ships that are suspected of “illegal activities” in what China claims are its territorial waters.

zh: 海南省政府并没有明确列出具体哪些将构成“非法”活动，但很多人担心这项命令将全权委托海警干涉中国南海的商业活动。
en: What constitutes “illegal” activity in the eyes of the Hainan authorities was not spelled out, but many worry that the order will give carte blanche to the maritime police to interfere with commercial activity in the South China Sea.

zh: 按照国际危机集团斯蒂芬妮·克莱阿尔布兰特的说法，这种作法似乎隶属于北京从“执行层面”更有力捍卫主权要求的总体战略。
en: This approach, according to Stephanie Kleine-Ahlbrandt of the International Crisis Group, appears to be “part of an overall strategy by Beijing to more forcefully defend its sovereignty claims” by “operational means.”

zh: 随着中国立场的渐趋强硬，东盟即将离任的秘书长素林·比素万表示亚洲正逐渐进入近年来“最有争议”的时期。
en: As a result of China’s hardening stance, Surin Pitsuwan, ASEAN’s outgoing secretary-general has said that Asia is entering its “most contentious” period in recent years.

zh: 事实上，他警告“南海问题可能演化为另一个巴勒斯坦 ” ， 除非各国更加努力地去化解，而不是加剧紧张局势。
en: Indeed, he warns that “the South China Sea could evolve into another Palestine,” unless countries try harder to defuse rather than inflame tensions.

zh: 期望局面不会失控的理由之一是中国与全球经济的深度整合。
en: One reason to hope that matters will not get out of hand is China’s deep integration into the global economy.

zh: 但在中国国内，正如美国政治学家安德鲁·内森和安德鲁·史考贝尔最近在《外交事务》上评论的那样，国内经济重点和中国领导人认为“中国的政治稳定和领土完整正受到国外势力威胁”之间的矛盾正日益加深。
en: But, within China, as the American political scientists Andrew Nathan and Andrew Scobell argued recently in Foreign Affairs, there is growing tension between domestic economic priorities and Chinese leaders’ belief that “China’s political stability and territorial integrity are threatened by foreign actors and forces.”

zh: 我怀疑中国领导人的担心对和平解决东海及南海海域的地区争端不是个好兆头。
en: The fears of China’s rulers, I suspect, do not bode well for reaching a peaceful resolution of its territorial disputes in the South and East China Seas.

zh: 某些中国学者最近所描述的一个“底层动荡、中产阶级心灰意冷、权力阶层失控”的国家可能将对外冒险看作维持国内团结的最佳手段。
en: A country that is “unstable at the grass roots, dejected in the middle strata and out of control at the top,” as a group of Chinese scholars recently put it, may see adventurism abroad as the best means of maintaining unity at home.

zh: 身居高位的亚洲女性
en: Asian Women on Top

zh: 发自纽约 — — 印度的英吉拉·甘地，斯里兰卡的班达拉奈克夫人，巴基斯坦的贝·布托，菲律宾的阿基诺夫人以及印尼的梅加瓦蒂 — — 这些女性领袖在过去四十年内的大部分时间统治着南亚和东南亚地区。
en: NEW YORK – India’s Indira Gandhi, Sri Lanka’s Sirimavo Bandaranaike, Pakistan’s Benazir Bhutto, Sheikh Hasina of Bangladesh, Corazon Aquino of the Philippines, and Megawati Sukarnoputri of Indonesia – these women leaders dominated South and South East Asia for much of the past four decades.

zh: 她们的父亲或者丈夫都曾是其所在国的创建者或者长期领导者，而当这种类似王朝传宗继位的联系将她们送上政治舞台时，支撑她们掌权的却不但是这一个因素。
en: Each belonged to a special class of women whose husbands or fathers were their country’s recognized founding father or longstanding political leader. But, while their dynastic links brought them to power, they were not the sole factor keeping them there.

zh: 在第一次当选时，这些女性中无一人拥有任何过硬的专业或者政治资历。
en: When first elected, none of these women had any serious professional or political qualifications.

zh: 对于其中一些女性来说，这个“短板”可以被视为优点，使她们可以在自己丈夫或父亲曾经的位置上塑造一个清白而纯洁，甚至是殉道者的形象。
en: For some, this “shortcoming” was seen as an advantage, enabling some of them to project an image of innocence and purity, even martyrdom, as they stood in the place of their deceased husbands or fathers.

zh: （至少在第一个任期内）也没有一位女性特别关注与妇女有关的议程，而研究证实农村妇女的地位在她们治下也缺乏改善。
en: None was particularly focused on a women’s agenda (at least not in their first terms in office), and studies show that rural women did not fare particularly well under their rule.

zh: 但2011年的亚洲却涌现了一些完全不同的事物。
en: But something very different emerged in Asia in 2011.

zh: 虽然仍有一些女性领导人是在某种程度上利用家族影响力登台，但她们如今却开始更自信地将妇女事务直接列为自身政治议程的核心。
en: We still have women leaders who came to power at least partly because of their family ties. But they now seem to use their positions with far more confidence in putting women and their concerns squarely at the center of their agendas.

zh: 而或许更重要的是，有越来越多的女性凭借着自己的政治天赋跻身各国政治高层。
en: And perhaps more importantly, a growing number of women are reaching for the highest political echelons in their countries by dint of their political talents alone.

zh: 索妮娅·甘地，这位出生在意大利的印度前总理拉吉夫·甘地之妻，已故领导人英迪拉·甘地的儿媳凭借着家世成为印度权力最大的女性，但同时也不断表现出自己也是一位精明强干的幕后政治能手。 她的主要任务增强印度国大党的力量，而她在20011年初再次当选党主席后已经是史无前例地第四次连任了。
en: Sonia Gandhi, the Italian-born wife of former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi and daughter-in-law of the late Indira Gandhi, became India’s most powerful woman for dynastic reasons but she has consistently demonstrated that she is a shrewd behind-the-scenes political operator.  For her, the main task at hand is to strengthen the Congress Party, which in early 2011 she was elected to lead for an unprecedented fourth term.

zh: 但索尼娅·甘地把相当大的精力放在推动妇女事务，尤其是推动妇女选举自身政治代表方面。
en: But she has also expended considerable energy on promoting women, particularly their representation in politics.

zh: 事实上她也对普拉蒂巴·帕蒂尔成为印度第一位女性总统出力甚多。
en: Indeed, she pushed hard in backing Pratibha Patil to become India’s first woman president.

zh: 类似的还有孟加拉总理谢赫·哈西娜，在遇刺父亲谢赫·拉赫曼的光环下，她成为了一位发展事务的热心推动者，并且特别将重点放在妇女及其需要方面。
en: Similarly Sheikh Hasina, Bangladesh’s prime minister, who carries the mantle of her assassinated father, has become a keen advocate of development issues, with a special emphasis on women and their needs.

zh: 这个议程虽然没有在她的第一个任期中出现，却占到了当前第二个任期的极大部分。
en: That agenda, missing in her first term, has dominated her current period in office.

zh: 东亚地区的妇女也在政治上不断崛起。
en: In East Asia, too, women are on the rise politically.

zh: 韩国前总统朴正熙之女朴槿惠目前是李明博卸任后的两大总统热门人选之一。
en: Park Geun-hye, daughter of Park Chung-hee, President of South Korea from 1961 to 1979, is now one of the two likely candidates to succeed President Lee Myung-bak.

zh: 虽然继承了祖荫，但朴槿惠已经证明了自己是个机敏而老练的政治家 — — 她历经20年才爬上韩国大国家党最高领导层并成为全国知名人物。
en: While Park derives some of her power from her family pedigree, she has proven to be an astute and seasoned politician – one who climbed the Grand National Party’s leadership ladder over the last two decades to emerge as a national figure.

zh: 她在推动一个大型妇女事务议程方面的作为使人们对亚洲新领袖权力的评估又增添了一个新视角。
en: Her role in championing an inclusive agenda for women provides a new lens through which to assess the power of Asia’s new leaders.

zh: 阿基诺夫人当选菲律宾总统时曾自称“只是一个家庭主妇，不是职业政治家或者老资格领导人 ” ， 而选民之所以投票给她也仅仅因为她是遇害反对派英雄贝尼尼奥·阿基诺的遗孀。
en: Compare Park to Corazon Aquino, who, when elected President of the Philippines, famously remarked that she was simply a housewife, not a professional politician or an experienced leader. It was clear that voters elected her because she was the widow of the slain opposition hero Benigno Aquino.

zh: 相比之下朴槿惠的专业资历则无可置疑。
en: By contrast, no one would deny Park’s professional credentials.

zh: 她对自身的经验和政治实力的关心也比家族的政治人脉更多。
en: She is taken seriously more for her own experience and political power than for her family connections.

zh: 即使是在日本也出现了类似的趋势，但却没有像往常那样插上家族势力的标签。
en: Even in Japan, a similar change is in the air, but with no hint of dynastic trappings.

zh: 曾任国防大臣和国家安全顾问的小池百合子就是该国政坛的其中一个实力派；事实上她有望成为下任日本首相。
en: Yuriko Koike, a former defense minister and national-security adviser, is one of the country’s most powerful figures; indeed, she could become Japan’s next prime minister.

zh: 与她所在的自民党其他成员不同的是，小池与各大政治人物都没有特别的亲缘关系。
en: Unlike many other leaders of her Liberal Democratic Party, Koike has no real family connection to any major political figure.

zh: 相反，她所持有的立场反映了其自身的特殊政治天赋：开罗大学阿拉伯研究的教育背景以及流利的英语，而这也赋予了小池百合子其同僚所缺乏的全球视野。
en: Instead, her standing reflects her unique political talents: an academic background in Arabic studies (she studied at Cairo University) and fluency in English, which give her a global perspective that most of her male colleagues lack.

zh: 小池百合子并不是第一个没有家族背景却有望跻身最高权力的亚洲女性。
en: Koike is not the only Asian woman without family ties forging a political career that may lead to the top.

zh: 曾任印尼财政部长，现为世界银行常务总监的斯莉•穆尔雅妮•英德拉瓦蒂就经常被认为是最受欢迎的总统人选。
en: Indonesia’s Sri Mulyani Indrawati, a former finance minister and currently a managing director of the World Bank, is often mentioned as a leading presidential candidate in her country.

zh: 事实上，印尼国内人士已经专门成立了一个政党以确保她能在2014年参选总统。
en: Indeed, a party has been formed specifically to entice her to run for president in 2014.

zh: 在台湾，蔡英文对即将在2012年1月卸任的现任总统构成了持续而有力的威胁。 有了参与起草规范两岸关系的“特殊国与国法案”并领导大陆事务委员会的经历，蔡英文有能力处理所有台湾领导人都会面对的棘手问题：与中国大陆的关系
en: In Taiwan, Tsai Ing-wen, is making a sustained and powerful challenge to the incumbent president in the election due in January 2012.  Having helped to draft Taiwan’s special state-to-state act that regulates relations with China, and then having headed the country’s Ministry for Mainland Affairs Council, she is well positioned to manage the thorniest issue any Taiwanese leader will face: the relationship with China.

zh: 另一个新近就任的领导人则是泰国女总理英拉·西那瓦。
en: Another newcomer to political leadership is Yingluck Shinawatra, Thailand’s Prime Minister.

zh: 很显然，她能在今年就任的一个原因就是她的哥哥，前总理他信·西那瓦，以及后者控制下的全国第一大政党。
en: Clearly, one reason she swept to power this year were her ties to her brother, exiled former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, who controls the country’s strongest political party.

zh: 但在选举过程中英拉已经明确显示了出自身的独立性：一位拥有专业学历的老练商界领袖。
en: But she made it clear during the campaign that she is her own person, a seasoned business leader with appropriate professional degrees.

zh: 当然还有诺贝尔和平奖获得者，缅甸国父的女儿昂山素姬。
en: Then, of course, there is the Burmese Nobel Peace Prize laureate Aung San Suu Kyi.

zh: 她目前或许正在进行自己光辉政治生涯中的一个最为精巧微妙的任务 — — 尝试在这个经历了数十年军政府独裁的国家推动真正的民主转型。
en: The daughter of the founder of independent Burma, Suu Kyi is now engaged in perhaps the most delicate task of her remarkable political career – trying to engineer a true democratic transition from decades of military dictatorship.

zh: 与借助家族势力登台的第一代亚洲女性领导人不同，新的一代更强势，更具自信，并准备用自己独有的方式来迎接领导国家的挑战。
en: Unlike the first generation of Asian women leaders, who gained power primarily because of their familial connections, the emerging crop are strong, confident, and ready to take on the challenge of leading their nations on their own terms.

zh: 她们的追随者似乎将其视为没有历史包袱的预言家，并将为他们的社会带来渴望已久的变革。
en: Their followers appear to see in them harbingers, unjaded by history, of the change for which their societies are clamoring.

zh: 在这个亚洲一方面实现经济增长，另一方面却出现大量社会和收入不平等，同时地区和平前景也充满不确定性的年代，用新方法解决问题的渴望极大地推动了女性领导人的崛起。
en: At a time when, despite economic growth in Asia, there is much social and income inequality, as well uncertainty about the durability of peace in the region, the desire to find fresh solutions to problems has given a powerful boost to women leaders.

zh: 她们也已经安定自若地在最高权力的圆桌旁占据了自己的位置 — — 甚至有望最终改变桌子的形状。
en: They are poised to take their seats at the top table – and perhaps to change its shape.

zh: 亚洲民主的审判
en: The Trials of Asian Democracy

zh: 东京—这是对越来越多的亚洲民主国进行审判的时刻 — — 在法庭上的真正审判。
en: TOKYO – These are times of trial – literally in the courts – for a growing number of Asia’s democracies.

zh: 该地区大国政治领导人面临着 — — 或即将面临 — — 刑事指控，其罪名之大足以让人怀疑民主本身能否在这些国家中生存下去。
en: The list of major national political leaders in the region who have faced, or are about to face, criminal charges has grown so extensive that it is plausible to wonder whether democracy itself can survive in a number of these countries.

zh: 也许最严重的指控针对的是孟加拉国反对派领导人齐亚（Khaleda Zia ） 。 他被指控一宗多年前的谋杀。
en: Perhaps the gravest allegations have been leveled at Bangladesh’s opposition leader Khaleda Zia, who has been charged with murder in a case going back many years.

zh: 不到一年前下台的印度前总理辛格（Manmohan Singh）正在接受检方质询，他卷入了其政府管理的煤矿私有化过程中的腐败弊案。
en: India’s former prime minister, Manmohan Singh, who lost power less than a year ago, is being questioned by prosecutors in connection with allegations of corruption in the privatization of coalmines under his government.

zh: 民选的泰国前总理英拉被军事政变推翻后，现在正面临大米补贴问题上的渎职指控。
en: Following a military coup that overthrew her democratically elected government, Thailand’s former prime minister, Yingluck Shinawatra, is facing charges of official malfeasance over rice subsidies.

zh: 还有马来西亚多年来的反对派领袖、前副总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣（Anwar Ibrahim ） 。
en: Then there is the long-running saga of Malaysia’s opposition leader and former Deputy Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim.

zh: 他因鸡奸而被定罪，五年内无法从政，而这正逢1958年马来西亚从大英帝国独立以来反对派对执政党马来民族统一组织（United Malays National Organization，UMNO）构成最严重的挑战之时。
en: His conviction on sodomy charges will effectively ban him from politics for five years, at a moment when the opposition is posing the most serious challenge to Malaysia’s ruling United Malays National Organization (UMNO) since the country gained its independence from the British Empire in 1958.

zh: 此外，安瓦尔之女也因为在马来西亚议会发表演讲质疑父亲判决的合理性而被羁押。 她凭借自己的努力当选为马来西亚议员。
en: Moreover, Anwar’s daughter has now been detained for questioning the integrity of her father’s trial in a speech in the Malay parliament, in which she is an elected member in her own right.

zh: 当然，这些政治上存在污点的审判原因各不相同。
en: Each of these politically tinged trials has different origins, of course.

zh: 每一次审判都是或将是在司法系统中执行，但这些司法系统的发达程度和独立程度大不相同。
en: And each was or will be conducted in court systems that vary greatly in terms of their development and independence.

zh: 但所有这些审判都或多或少都有问题，是各自国家法治和民主未来前景的阴影。
en: Yet all of them have called into question, to varying degrees, the rule of law and the prospect for a democratic future in each country.

zh: 辛格被政府检方质询也许是最不令人担心的，因为印度的民主很稳固，其司法系统也以独立性为世人所称道。
en: Singh’s questioning by government prosecutors is perhaps the least worrying case, because India’s democracy is rock-solid, and its judiciary is fearsomely jealous of its independence.

zh: 辛格的国内外支持者不必担心他的权利，也不必担心他的案子成为拖垮反对党国大党的工具。
en: His supporters at home and abroad should have no fear for his rights, or that his case will become some political plaything to keep the opposition Congress party down.

zh: 事实上，政治上相当精明的总理莫迪绝不会蠢到为了党派利益扭曲对辛格的调查，连想都不会这样想。
en: Indeed, the politically shrewd Prime Minister Narendra Modi is far too smart to even contemplate attempting to distort the investigation of Singh for partisan gain.

zh: 不幸的是，忠诚于司法独立和法治的情况在其他案子中难以彻底贯彻。
en: Sadly, fidelity to judicial independence and the rule of law cannot be guaranteed as thoroughly in the other cases.

zh: 世界第四大民主穆斯林国家孟加拉国在这方面的历史记录颇不检点，这表明齐亚案的政治干预可能很大，只要有官员想讨好总理哈希纳（Sheikh Hasina ） 。
en: Bangladesh, the world’s fourth largest Muslim democracy, has historically had a patchy record in this regard, suggesting scope for political intervention in the case against Zia, if only by officials eager to curry favor with Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

zh: 事实上，两位领导人的对立既久且盛。
en: Indeed, the two leaders’ mutual loathing is long and legendary.

zh: 两人都当过总理，在执政期间都试图利用法庭将另一位逐出权力甚至政坛 — — 并且大有不惜一切代价之势。
en: Each has been Prime Minister, and both have sought, while in office, to use the courts to keep the other out of power, even out of politics altogether – seemingly without regard to the cost.

zh: 针对齐亚的谋杀指控已经导致了示威游行，如果真的进入庭审，有可能导致大规模民变，破坏哈希纳治下孟加拉国所取得的经济成功。
en: The murder charges leveled against Zia have already spurred protests, and could incite massive civil disturbances if a trial actually takes place, jeopardizing the economic success that the country has had under Hasina’s rule.

zh: 但最终需要对总理负责的政府检察官仍在推进这宗案子。
en: And yet government prosecutors who are ultimately responsible to the prime minister are pressing ahead with the case.

zh: 泰国即将到来的英拉审判和马来西亚易卜拉欣的再度定罪甚至连司法独立的遮羞布也不要了。
en: Shinawatra’s looming trial in Thailand and Ibrahim’s repeat conviction in Malaysia lack even the fig leaf of judicial independence.

zh: 英拉被军方推翻显然是泰国将军们用武力结束英拉及其兄他信近15年来在泰国选举制度中不可撼动局面的措施。 他信本人亦曾担任总理，2006年被军事政变推翻。
en: Shinawatra’s overthrow by the military was clearly a bid by the country’s generals to end by force the electoral lock that she and her brother, Thaksin Shinawatra – himself a former prime minister who was deposed by a military coup in 2006 – have had on Thailand for almost 15 years.

zh: 因此，如今将军们和他们的曼谷精英盟友似乎决定要开倒车；即将到来的英拉审判将表明他信的支持率将彻底揭开泰国“有管理的”民主的真面目。
en: So now the generals and their allies in the Bangkok elite seem determined to turn back the clock; Yingluck’s looming trial appears to be a signal that the Thaksins’ popularity rules out anything more than “managed” democracy in Thailand.

zh: 但目前他信方力量的沉默不应该让任何人认为军方能够永远镇压泰国的民主而不受抵抗。
en: But the current quiescence of the pro-Thaksin forces should not encourage anyone to think that the military can suppress Thai democracy forever or without a fight.

zh: 不幸的是，马来西亚可能很快就陷入与近几年来的泰国同样的暴力示威和经济衰退。
en: Sadly, Malaysia may soon become prone to the same type of violent protest and economic decline that have gripped Thailand in recent years.

zh: 在马来西亚，UNMO的政治利益显然能够决定该国关键反对派领导人可以遭遇法治的真正民主根本不会考虑的指控，并根据独立的法庭绝不会接受的证据定罪。
en: Here, it seems clear that UNMO’s political interests have been allowed to dictate that the country’s key opposition leader should be tried on charges that no real democracy that embraces the rule of law would even consider leveling, and convicted on evidence that no truly independent court would accept.

zh: 泰国和马来西亚，以及该地区其他国家的政治领导人常常标榜新加坡国父和长期领导人、本月刚刚逝世的李光耀所创立的模式。
en: Political leaders in Thailand and Malaysia, and in other countries in the region, frequently tout the model pioneered by Singapore’s founder and longtime leader Lee Kuan Yew, who died this month.

zh: 但泰国和马来西亚所走的道路绝非李光耀的道路。
en: Yet the path on which both countries have embarked was not Lee’s path.

zh: 诚然，李光耀的制度让他能够掌权31年，他也确实用民事 — — 而非刑事 — — 法庭打击反对者。
en: Yes, Lee’s system enabled him to remain in power for 31 years, and he did use the civil – not criminal – courts to harry his opponents.

zh: 但更重要的是，李光耀也依靠民主竞争的要素保证英才制度胜过裙带关系。
en: But Lee, more importantly, also relied on elements of democratic contestation to ensure that meritocracy triumphed over patronage.

zh: 这一模式有助于快速巩固好政府，其基础是能够限制精英阶层“任性”权力的严格的官员行为准则。
en: This formula underpinned the rapid consolidation of good government, based on rigorous standards of official conduct that limited the elite’s arbitrary power.

zh: 将反对派送上刑事法庭不可能达到相同的结果。
en: Putting one’s opponents in the criminal dock seems unlikely to produce a similar result.

zh: 亚太性别平等的当务之急
en: The Asia-Pacific Gender-Parity Imperative

zh: 新加坡/孟买—性别平等对于任何国家都能带来巨大的经济机会。
en: SINGAPORE/MUMBAI – Gender equality offers a sizeable economic opportunity for any country.

zh: 希望在不充分利用妇女潜力的情况下实现强劲增长的政府好比是在格斗中自废一臂。
en: A government that hopes to achieve strong growth without tapping into women’s full potential is essentially fighting with one hand tied behind its back.

zh: 事实上，麦肯锡全球研究所（MGI）的新研究发现，只要能够加快性别平等方面的进展，那么到2025年，亚太经济体GDP总量每年可以提高4.5万亿美元。
en: In fact, new research from the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI) finds that Asia-Pacific economies could boost their collective GDP by $4.5 trillion per year by 2025, just by accelerating progress toward gender equality.

zh: 这相当于每年增加一个德国加上奥地利。
en: That would be the equivalent of adding an economy the combined size of Germany and Austria every year.

zh: 印度的机会尤其巨大，其GDP增速将高达18 % 。
en: The opportunity is especially large for India, where GDP would grow by as much as 18%.

zh: 性别平等从三个方面促进增长。
en: Gender equality contributes to growth in three ways.

zh: 据MGI的研究，58%的亚太地区收益将来自女-男劳动力参与比例的提高，17%来自妇女工作时间增长，其他25%来自更多妇女在生产率较高的部门工作。
en: According to MGI, 58% of the gains in the Asia-Pacific region would come from raising the female-to-male ratio of labor-force participation, 17% from increasing women’s work hours, and the remaining 25% from having more women working in higher-productivity sectors.

zh: 但职场性别平等与社会性别平等总是同步进退。
en: But equality at work goes hand in hand with gender equality in society.

zh: 尽管我们在改善女童教育和健康状况方面取得了令人瞩目的成本就，但亚太地区妇女仍然面临传统偏 — — 持家才是她们的主要角色。
en: While there have been notable advances in girls’ education and health, women across the region remain subject to traditional attitudes that define their primary role as being in the home.

zh: 结果是妇女常常无法获得开办或扩大企业所需的融资，也无法获得现代劳动力市场所需要的训练。
en: As a result, women often lack access to the financing needed to start or expand a business, and to the training needed for the modern labor market.

zh: 诚然，解决性别不平等问题是一个复杂的长期挑战，需要广泛的社会参与。
en: To be sure, tackling gender inequality is a complex, long-term challenge that requires broad social engagement.

zh: 但在亚太地区，有五个领域政府、公司和非政府组织可以取得有意义的进展。
en: But there are five areas in the Asia-Pacific region where governments, companies, and non-governmental organizations could start to make meaningful progress.

zh: 首先是高质量工作岗位的妇女参与度。
en: The first is women’s participation in higher-quality jobs.

zh: 目前，妇女占亚太地区人口的一半，但只贡献了36%的GDP。
en: While women currently account for half of the region’s population, they contribute just 36% of its GDP.

zh: 但她们在家中承担的无薪工作并未计入GDP，保守估计，这些工作的价值可以增加3.7万亿美元的经济产出。
en: But GDP does not account for the unpaid work that they do in the home, which could conservatively be valued at an additional $3.7 trillion of economic output.

zh: 全球而言，妇女无薪工作的价值是男性的三倍，而在亚太地区，则高达四倍。
en: Globally, the value of women’s unpaid work performed is three times higher than that of men, whereas in the Asia-Pacific region, it is four times higher.

zh: 在一些情形中，妇女在这些工作上花费时间是出于个人选择。
en: In some cases, the time that women spend on such tasks may be a personal choice.

zh: 但真正的机会平等并没有普及到许多想迈出家门去赚钱的妇女头上。
en: But true equality of opportunity eludes too many women who want to earn money outside the home.

zh: 这一问题可以通过多种方法解决，首先是要有更加灵活的职场政策、平价育儿服务，并扩大技能培训，特别是在STEM领域（科学、技术、工程和数学 ） 。
en: This problem can be addressed in a number of ways, starting with more flexible workplace policies, affordable childcare, and expanded skills training, particularly in STEM fields (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics).

zh: 此外，在印度和印度尼西亚等国家，基础设施和交通投资能够让更多妇女与生产性工作机会连接起来，从而产生红利。
en: Moreover, in countries such as India and Indonesia, investment in infrastructure and transportation can reap dividends by connecting more women to productive work opportunities.

zh: 第二项重点是解决妇女在商界领袖圈中比例畸低的问题。
en: A second priority is to address women’s underrepresentation in business leadership circles.

zh: 全球而言，领导岗位（包括政治领域）的男-女比超过100-40，而在亚太地区，这一数字达到了25-1左右。
en: Globally, there are fewer than 40 women for every 100 men in leadership positions (including in politics), and in the Asia-Pacific region, that figure falls to around 25.

zh: 尽管亚太地区妇女董事会成员的比例在2011—2016年间翻了一番，从6%增加到14 % ， 但这一比例仍然太小。
en: Though the share of women sitting on company boards across the region did double between 2011 and 2016, from 6% to 13%, it remains far too small.

zh: 打破亚太地区的玻璃天花板需要消除多个壁垒，包括妇女应该以孩子为主的文化预期、价廉物美的育儿服务的缺乏、职场的下意识歧视，以及角色榜样和“贵人”的稀缺。
en: Breaking the Asia-Pacific region’s glass ceiling will require dismantling several barriers, including cultural expectations that women should prioritize childcare over their careers, a lack of suitable or affordable childcare, unconscious bias in the workplace, and a scarcity of role models and sponsors.

zh: 但最贵关键的还是亚太地区能够提供灵活的工作选择的公司太少。
en: But, most critically, too few companies in the region offer flexible working options.

zh: 第三项重点是让妇女更容易掌握数字技术。 数字技术能够带来数不尽的经济（和社会）之门 — — 包括金融机会。
en: A third priority is to improve women’s access to digital technology, which can open countless economic (and social) doors – including into finance.

zh: 事实上，妇女已经在亚太地区的一些方兴未艾的数字产业出人头地。
en: In fact, women have already begun to thrive in some of the region’s burgeoning digital industries.

zh: 在印度最大的在线市场，妇女拥有的企业占了总收入的35 % 。
en: In Indonesia’s largest online marketplace, women-owned businesses account for 35% of total revenues.

zh: 在中国，新互联网企业有55%是妇女创办的。
en: And in China, women found 55% of new Internet businesses.

zh: 在这些成功的基础上更进一步需要加强妇女在运用数字技术方面的训练。
en: Building on these successes will require more training for women in the use of digital technologies.

zh: 在繁荣的亚洲互联网市场上，数字技术可能是一柄双刃剑：如果性别差距不缩小，妇女将被横扫整个地区的技术推动的革命抛在身后。
en: In Asia’s booming Internet market, digital technologies could be a double-edged sword: If the gender gap is not closed, women will be left on the sidelines of the technology-driven revolution sweeping the region.

zh: 第四项重点是改变性别角色的社会成见。
en: A fourth priority is to change social attitudes about gender roles.

zh: 传统观念认为妇女属于家庭，这也许是妇女在社会和职场上取得成就的最大障碍。
