en: The traditional view that women belong in the home is arguably the largest barrier to women’s advancement in both society and the workplace.

zh: 世界价值观调查（World Values Survey）对于这一问题在2010—2014年间发现的很有说明性。
en: The World Values Survey’s findings on this issue between 2010 and 2014 are revealing.

zh: 在整个亚太地区，44%的受访者说男性领导者比女性做得更好。
en: Across the Asia-Pacific region, 44% of respondents said that men make better leaders than women.

zh: 70%的印度受访者 — — 相比之下，澳大利亚受访者的这一比例只有21 % — —同意以下说法 ： “ 母亲出去赚钱，孩子就会受罪。
en: And 70% of Indian respondents – compared to just 21% of Australian respondents – agreed with the statement: “When a mother works for pay, the children suffer.”

zh: ”政府、企业、媒体和个体社区的领导人需要齐心协力改变这些观念。
en: Leaders in government, business, the media, and individual communities need to work together to change such views.

zh: 最后一项重点是加大地区合作实现性别平等。
en: The final priority is to pursue more regional collaboration to achieve gender equality.

zh: 公共和私人项目一般需要针对具体的社区和国家才能取得最佳加过。
en: Public and private initiatives tend to work best when they are tailored to specific communities and countries.

zh: 但围绕共同目标进行的地区合作能够为国际和地方措施提供更多动力。
en: But regional partnerships that are established around shared goals could give national and local efforts more momentum.

zh: 比如，亚太国家可以合作为性别平等项目提供更多资金，并鼓励更多基于性别的投资和预算。
en: For example, Asia-Pacific countries could come together to provide more financing for gender-equality initiatives, and to encourage more gender-based investment and budgeting.

zh: 此外，在更广泛的意义上，政府可以加大共享关于哪些方针最有效的力度。
en: And, more broadly, governments could do more to share knowledge about which approaches work best.

zh: 亚太地区坐落着不少全世界增长最快、创新力最强的经济体。
en: The Asia-Pacific region is home to some of the world’s fastest-growing and most innovative economies.

zh: 它正在铸就一个令人激动的新未来，扮演日益重要的全球角色。
en: It is forging an exciting new future, and assuming an ever-greater global role.

zh: 但妇女在这场大戏中并没有扮演平等的戏份，许多领导人已经认识到了这一点。
en: Yet women are not playing an equal part in this drama, as many leaders have come to realize.

zh: 现在，我们应该加快性别平等，释放妇女带来增长、改善社会福祉的力量。
en: Now is the time to accelerate progress toward gender parity, and to women’s power to deliver growth and improve social wellbeing.

zh: 把大部分亚洲老龄化人口利用起来
en: Making the Most of Asia’s Aging Populations

zh: 首尔—亚洲正在迅速变老：到2040年，该地区16%的人口将超过65岁，较2015年7.8%的比例翻一番多。
en: SEOUL – Asia is aging fast: by 2040, 16% of the region’s population will be older than 65, more than double the 7.8% share in 2015.

zh: 健康寿命预期的增加是一个积极的发展趋势，但这一人口变化为许多已经开始失去自生能力的经济体造成了严重的威胁。
en: While the rise in healthy life expectancy is a positive development, this demographic shift poses a serious threat to many economies, which are already losing vitality.

zh: 不间断地供应年轻熟练工人是过去三十年来亚洲实现迅速的经济赶超的关键原因。
en: A consistent supply of young, skilled workers was an essential ingredient of Asia’s rapid economic catch-up process over the last three decades.

zh: 但赶超过程还没有结束，中国和越南等中等收入国家现在面临着人口加速老化的局面。
en: But that process is not over, and middle-income countries like China and Vietnam are now facing accelerating population aging.

zh: 在韩国，工作年龄人口（15—64岁）将在2017—2030年间减少 10 % 。
en: In South Korea, the working-age population (15-64 years) will shrink by 10% from 2017 to 2030.

zh: 在这一背景下，保持劳动力供给的唯一办法 — — 除了移民之外 — — 是让人们在到达传统退休年龄后继续工作。
en: Against this background, the only way to sustain the labor supply – aside from immigration – is to keep people in employment beyond the traditional retirement age.

zh: 好消息是越来越多的亚洲年长者已经开始工作。
en: The good news is that a growing number of seniors in Asia are already working.

zh: 据经合组织数据，2016年65—69岁年龄段的韩国工作人口比例高达45 % ， 70—74岁年龄段高达33 % 。
en: According to the OECD, the share of working South Koreans aged 65-69 was as high as 45% in 2016; for 70-74-year-olds, the figure stands at 33%.

zh: 不幸的是，许多年长工作者从事的工作薪酬很低。
en: Unfortunately, many of the jobs performed by elderly workers are low-paid.

zh: 而韩国年轻人失业率不断上升的情况表明，年长者可能会夺走年轻同胞的饭碗，而不是和他们一起工作 — — 这严重不利于让更多年长韩国人参与劳动力大军的目的。
en: And, as South Korea’s rising youth unemployment rate suggests, seniors may be displacing their younger counterparts, instead of working alongside them – effectively defeating the purpose of including more elderly Koreans in the labor force.

zh: 一个问题是年轻工作者一般总比年长同胞生产率更高。
en: One problem is that younger workers tend to be more productive than their senior counterparts.

zh: 企业层面的研究表明，各地工人生产率最高的年龄段是30—45岁。
en: Firm-level studies indicate that workers everywhere are most productive between the ages of 30 and 45.

zh: 因此，年长劳动力比例的提高导致了美国州和全国总体生产率的下降。
en: A higher share of seniors in the workforce has thus resulted in lower overall productivity in US states and across countries.

zh: 这不难理解：出于他们丰富的经验，年长工作者固然可以提供很多贡献，包括沟通和解决问题等重要职场技能，但他们的体能和认知能力一般较差。
en: This makes sense: while older workers have plenty to offer, including critical job skills such as communication and problem-solving, owing to their extensive experience, their physical and cognitive capacities tend to decline.

zh: 此外，他们也缺乏信息和通讯技术技能等技术能力，这妨碍了他们适应日新月异的技术的能力，而技术是当今经济的生命线。
en: Together with a lack of technical capabilities such as ICT skills, this undermines their ability to adapt to the fast-changing technologies that are the lifeblood of today’s economies.

zh: 在这一背景下，不但要确保所有工作者，不论年轻年长都能找到高质量的工作，还要提高年长工作者的生产率，这一点至关重要 — — 新技术有助于实现这一目标。
en: Against this background, it is vital not only to ensure that there are enough quality jobs for all workers, old and young, but also to boost productivity among older workers – an objective that new technologies can help to achieve.

zh: 比如，医学和生物技术的发展有助于阻止工作者体能和认知能力的下降。
en: For example, advances in medical science and biotechnology are helping to stem workers’ physical and cognitive decline.

zh: 与此同时，机器人等技术正在日益取代人力，这意味着人类工作的体能要求降低了。
en: Meanwhile, technologies like robots are displacing a growing share of manual labor, leaving less physically demanding jobs for humans.

zh: 这些技术的潜力在德国、日本和韩国等国家尤其巨大，在这些国家，劳动力正在迅速变老，自动化的部署速度也特别迅速。
en: The potential of these technologies is not lost on countries such as Germany, Japan, and South Korea, where the workforce is aging the fastest, and where automation is being adopted particularly quickly.

zh: 但年长者要想在新经济中获得高质量工作岗位，就需要能获得更有效的终身学习计划，让他们能够不断地更新技能，跟上技术变化。
en: But if seniors are to occupy high-quality jobs in the new economy, they need access to more effective lifelong learning programs that enable them to upgrade their skills continuously in response to technological change.

zh: 这些培训可以在政府的支持下，通过各种渠道实现 — — 包括私人企业和工会。
en: Such training can be made available through various channels – including private firms and trade unions – with government support.

zh: 年长者应该得到鼓励去抓住这些机会，即便这要求他们暂别全职工作（尽管在职培训也是可取的选择 ） 。
en: Seniors need to be encouraged to seize these opportunities, even if it requires them to take a break from full-time employment, though on-the-job training is also a desirable option.

zh: 事实上，在日本和韩国，中年和年长工作者参加在职培训的比例目前要低于其他发达经济体，如美国和芬兰，这意味着存在改进空间。
en: In fact, participation in on-the-job training by middle-aged and elderly workers in Japan and Korea is currently lower than in other advanced economies, such as the United States and Finland, meaning that there should be space for improvement.

zh: 在这方面，政府可以考虑提供教育券，让工作者用来支付支持多重工作的培训，而不是专注于专门的职业或公司相关的技能。
en: To that end, governments might consider providing vouchers that workers can use to pay for training that will support progress in multiple jobs, rather than focusing on specific job- or company-related skills.

zh: 需要获得最新教育和培训计划的不仅仅是年长者。
en: It is not only seniors who need access to upgraded education and training programs.

zh: 年轻人也需要更好地为迅速变化的工作环境做好准备。
en: Young people, too, need to be better prepared for a fast-changing work environment.

zh: 低质量的基础教育让学生无法获得继续教育和技能培训的好处。
en: Poor-quality basic education prevents students from reaping the benefits of subsequent education and skills training.

zh: 在许多亚洲国家，正式教育系统常常无法产生满足劳动力市场所需要的认知能力和技术能力的毕业生。
en: In many Asian countries, formal education systems often fail to produce graduates with adequate cognitive abilities and technical competencies to fill the labor market’s needs.

zh: 要满足这些需求，各层次教育和培训需要为学生提供“明天的技能 ” 。
en: To meet those needs, all levels of education and training will have to provide students with the “skills of tomorrow.”

zh: 在人工智能时代，这必须包括非常规认知和人际能力 — — 解决问题、批判性思考、合作和沟通的能力 — — 许多年纪较长、经验较丰富的工作者已经具备。
en: In an era of artificial intelligence, that must include the non-routine cognitive and interpersonal skills – problem solving, critical thinking, collaboration, and communication – that many older, more experienced workers already possess.

zh: 人口迅速变老毫无疑问是亚洲长期经济前景的严重威胁。
en: Rapid population aging no doubt poses a serious threat to Asia’s long-term economic prospects.

zh: 但这也是一个扩大劳动力储备、利用年长工作者现有技能的重要机会。
en: But it also represents an important opportunity to expand the labor pool and capitalize on older workers’ existing skills.

zh: 只要采取正确的政策，亚洲国家能够降低人口老龄化的风险，让“银发红利”生产率更高、恢复力更强、活力更甚。
en: With the right policies, Asian countries can mitigate the risks of population aging and harness their “silver dividend” to become more productive, resilient, and dynamic than ever.

zh: 亚洲的新友好关系
en: Asia’s New Entente

zh: 珀斯—美国总统特朗普出访亚洲之际，正逢该地区安全局势白热化之时。
en: PERTH – US President Donald Trump is arriving in Asia at a moment when the region’s security situation is practically white-hot.

zh: 美国国务卿蒂勒森认识到世界“重心正在转向印度-太平洋心脏地带 ” ， 呼吁域内民主力量寻求“更大的参与和合作 ” 。
en: US Secretary of State Rex Tillerson, recognizing that the world’s “center of gravity is shifting to the heart of the Indo-Pacific,” called on the region’s democratic powers to pursue “greater engagement and cooperation.”

zh: 它们 — — 包括特朗普的美国 — — 应该遵循这一吁求。
en: They – including Trump’s US – should heed that call.

zh: 事实上，只有民主国家联合起来，才能确保这个全世界经济最有活力地区的基于规则的强大秩序和稳定的实力平衡。
en: In fact, only an alliance of democracies can ensure the emergence of a strong rules-based order and a stable balance of power in the world’s most economically dynamic region.

zh: 蒂勒森坦承，最近几年中国发动了“挑衅性行动 ” ， 如在南海等行为，这些行动挑战了国际法和规范。
en: In recent years, as Tillerson acknowledged, China has taken “provocative actions,” such as in the South China Sea, that challenge international law and norms.

zh: 并且这些行动必然会继续进行下去，甚至有所升级。
en: And this behavior is set to continue, if not escalate.

zh: 上个月的中共十九大事实上使中国国家主席习近平加冕了中国皇帝。 他主导了更加强势的外交政策，以推动其让中国成为全球超级大国的目标。
en: Last month’s 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China effectively crowned President Xi Jinping – who has spearheaded a more muscular foreign policy, in service of his goal of establishing China as a global superpower – as the country’s emperor.

zh: 正如德国在一战前的迅速崛起出城了法国、俄罗斯和英国之间的“三方友好 ” ， 中国日益侵略性的行动也在强力刺激亚太民主国家构建更加强大的联盟。
en: Just as Germany’s rapid ascent prior to World War I spurred a “triple entente” among France, Russia, and the United Kingdom, China’s increasingly assertive behavior is creating strong impetus for the Asia-Pacific democracies to build a more powerful coalition.

zh: 毕竟，最近在南海的经验清楚地表明，任何力量都无法单枪匹马让中国为其领海和领土修正主义付出足够代价，更不用说迫使中国领导人改变算盘了。
en: After all, as recent experience in the South China Sea has made clear, no single power can impose sufficient costs on China for its maritime and territorial revisionism, much less compel Chinese leaders to change course.

zh: 这不是说没有一个国家能够挑战中国。
en: This is not to say that no country has been able to challenge China.

zh: 今年夏天，印度与其耀武扬威的邻国进行了为期十周的边境对峙。
en: Just this summer, India stood up to its muscle-flexing neighbor in a ten-week border standoff.

zh: 中国利用建设计划改变位于偏远的喜马拉雅山区的洞朗的现状，一如其在南海所惯用的做法。
en: China has been using construction projects to change the status quo on the remote Himalayan plateau of Doklam, just as it has so often done in the South China Sea.

zh: 印度进行了干预，阻止了中国的建设活动。
en: India intervened, stalling China’s building activity.

zh: 如果美国总统奥巴马政府在南海也表现出类似的决心，也许中国现在就无法在南海拥有七座军事化的人工岛。
en: Had US President Barack Obama’s administration shown similar resolve in the South China Sea, perhaps China would not now be in possession of seven militarized artificial islands there.

zh: 无论如何，要保证中国外交政策发生总体性转变、稳定亚太地区实力动态，在任何一个问题上只有一个国家坚守底线是不够的。
en: In any case, securing a broader shift in China’s foreign policy and stabilizing the Asia-Pacific region’s power dynamics will require more than one country holding the line on any one issue.

zh: 愿意采取新措施的美国、更有信心的日本和印度，以及对中国干涉内政忍无可忍的澳大利亚必须联合起来约束中国。
en: A US that is willing to employ new tools, a more confident Japan and India, and an Australia vexed by China’s meddling in its domestic affairs must work together to constrain Chinese behavior.

zh: 好消息是友好关系已经在域内重要民主国家间开始浮现。
en: The good news is that an entente has already begun to emerge among the region’s key democracies.

zh: 特别是，美国与印度的关系一直在经历蒂勒森所谓的“重大转变 ” ， 两国“日益成为在战略上越来越趋同的全球合作伙伴 ” 。
en: America’s relationship with India, in particular, has been undergoing what Tillerson called a “profound transformation,” as the two countries become “increasingly global partners with growing strategic convergence.”

zh: 眼下，美国与印度进行的联合防御演习比任何其他国家都要多。
en: The US now holds more joint defense exercises with India than with any other country.

zh: 这一合作让两国处于非常有利的位置实现蒂勒森的成为“印度-太平洋东西两极”的愿景。
en: Such cooperation puts the two countries in a strong position to fulfill Tillerson’s vision of serving “as the eastern and western beacons of the Indo-Pacific.”

zh: 与日本的合作也在加深。
en: Engagement with Japan, too, has deepened.

zh: 今年的马拉巴（Malabar）演习 — — 美国、印度和日本联合参加的年度印度洋海军演习 — — 是其自四分之一个世纪开始以来规模最大、复杂程度最高的一次。
en: This year’s Malabar exercise – an annual naval exercise in the Indian Ocean involving the US, India, and Japan – was the largest and most complex since it began a quarter-century ago.

zh: 此次演习的重点是摧毁敌方潜艇，光是美国就派出了7,000多人，并且第一次出现了三国海军均派出航空母舰的情景：美国的核动力航母尼米兹号、日本的出云号直升机航母，以及印度的维克拉玛蒂亚号（Vikramaditya）航母。
en: Focused on destroying enemy submarines, it involved more than 7,000 personnel from the US alone, and featured for the first time aircraft carriers from all three navies: America’s nuclear-powered USS Nimitz, Japan’s Izumo helicopter carrier, and India’s aircraft carrier INS Vikramaditya.

zh: 蒂勒森指出，美国、印度和日本的三方参与已经产生了重要收益。
en: As Tillerson pointed out, this trilateral engagement among the US, India, and Japan is already bringing important benefits.

zh: 但“仍有空间邀请包括澳大利亚在内的其他国家加入进来，构建共同目标和计划。 ”
en: But “there is room to invite others, including Australia, to build on the shared objectives and initiatives.”

zh: 到目前为止，澳大利亚都避免在其安全盟友美国和主要经济伙伴中国之间选择站边。
en: So far, Australia has sought to avoid having to choose between its security ally, the US, and its main economic partner, China.

zh: 尽管其国防部长佩恩（Marise Payne）最近宣布“澳大利亚很有兴趣与印度、日本和美国组成四方联合 ” ， 但政府似乎想要寻求对冲。
en: Despite Defense Minister Marise Payne’s recent declaration that “Australia is very interested in a quadrilateral engagement with India, Japan, and the United States,” the government seems to be hedging its bets.

zh: 比如，今年它既寻求重新加入十年前为了取悦中国而退出的马拉巴军演，但只是以“观察员”的身份。
en: For example, while it sought this year to rejoin the Malabar exercise – from which it withdrew a decade ago to appease China – it sought to do so only as an “observer.”

zh: 这一方针是站不住脚的。
en: This approach is untenable.

zh: 如果澳大利亚想要彻底摆脱中国的干涉， 不但需要实施新的国内防御，还需要更加积极的参与捍卫国际（不论是陆上还是海上）规则与规范。
en: If Australia is to free itself of Chinese meddling, it will need to go beyond implementing new domestic safeguards to take a more active role in defending rules and norms beyond its borders, both on land and at sea.

zh: 在未来几年中，印度-太平洋实力平衡将首先由印度洋和东亚局势决定。
en: In the coming years, the Indo-Pacific power balance will be determined, first and foremost, by events in the Indian Ocean and East Asia.

zh: 因此，遏制中国首先需要致力于限制中国的海军活动 — — 如采取保护重要航道、构建海域改制（maritime domain awareness）等等 — — 其次要采取地缘-经济措施防止中国裹挟利用小国。
en: Containing China will therefore require, first, efforts to restrict the country’s maritime activities – such as measures to safeguard vital sea lines and build maritime domain awareness – and, second, geo-economic initiatives to counter China’s coercive leverage over smaller countries.

zh: 所有亚洲民主力量都必须团结起来。
en: All of Asia’s democratic powers must be on board.

zh: 由美国出面呼吁加紧合作有利于这一过程，尽管美国仍需要更专注于全球崛起和侵略性的中国，而不是衰落的俄罗斯。
en: Calls by the US for closer cooperation bode well for this process, though the US still needs to focus more on the globally ascendant and aggressive China than on a declining Russia.

zh: 日本首相安倍晋三 — — 他提出了构建亚太地区“民主安全钻石”的概念 — — 在最近举行的日本大选中大获全胜，这或许也有助于推动合作。
en: The overwhelming victory of Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe – who has touted the idea of establishing a “democratic security diamond” in the Asia-Pacific – in his country’s recent general election is also likely to help to drive cooperation forward.

zh: 平心而论，亚洲民主国家之间的友好无法以正式联盟的形式出现。
en: To be sure, any entente among Asian democracies is unlikely to take the shape of a formal alliance.

zh: 相反，其目标应该是让民主力量之间在共同价值观的基础上形成广泛的战略性谅解。
en: Rather, the objective should be for democratic powers to reach a broad strategic understanding, based on shared values.

zh: 毕竟，正是这些价值观让它们产生了分裂：蒂勒森承认，尽管即将到来的特朗普北京之旅肯定会吸引全球关注，但美国不能与不民主的中国产生与民主大国所能产生的那种关系。
en: It is those values, after all, that set them apart: as Tillerson recognized, while Trump’s upcoming visit to Beijing will undoubtedly draw much global attention, the US cannot have the kind of relationship with non-democratic China that it can have with a major democracy.

zh: 通过寻求合作，印度-太平洋民主力量能够巩固一个基于规则的包容性秩序，成为域内和平、繁荣、稳定和航行自由的基础。
en: By pursuing cooperation, the Indo-Pacific’s democratic powers can shore up an inclusive, rules-based order that underpins peace, prosperity, stability, and freedom of navigation in the region.

zh: 这是阻止中国成为反自由地区秩序霸权的唯一办法。
en: That is the only way to thwart China’s effort to establish itself as the hegemon of an illiberal regional order.

zh: 在迅速老龄化的亚洲保持增长
en: Maintaining Growth in a Fast-Aging Asia

zh: 新加坡—几十年来，亚洲一直是世界经济增长冠军，今年也不会例外。
en: SINGAPORE – Asia has been the world champion of economic growth for decades, and this year will be no exception.

zh: 据最新的国际货币基金组织（IMF）地区经济展望（REO ） ， 预计2017年亚太地区GDP增长为5.5 % ， 2018年为5.4 % 。
en: According to the latest International Monetary Fund Regional Economic Outlook (REO), the Asia-Pacific region’s GDP is projected to increase by 5.5% in 2017 and 5.4% in 2018.

zh: 尽管地缘政治紧张升级，但大部分域内国家都保持了经济动力。
en: Despite escalating geopolitical tensions, most countries in the region have maintained their economic momentum.

zh: 它们受益于中国和日本支持内需的政策，以及有利的全球环境。
en: They have benefited from policies supporting strong domestic demand in China and Japan, and from favorable global conditions.

zh: 许多发达和新兴市场经济体增长正在起势，金融市场也大多具有强大的恢复力。
en: Growth is picking up across many advanced and emerging market economies, and financial markets have, for the most part, proven to be resilient.

zh: 尽管如此，亚洲仍必须面临中期和长期的基本挑战，如人口老化 — — 这一问题对大部分决策者来说已是耳熟能详。
en: Nonetheless, Asia will still have to confront fundamental medium- and long-term challenges, not least the aging of its population – a problem that is well known to most policymakers.

zh: 在过去十年中，亚洲从其不断增加的年轻工作人口和强势增长政策中获得了人口红利。
en: In past decades, the region reaped a demographic dividend from its young, expanding workforce and strong growth policies.

zh: 但这一红利在日本和中国等“老”国家已经耗尽。
en: But this dividend has already run out for “old” countries such as Japan and China.

zh: 随着生育率的下降和寿命的提高，劳动力同时出现人数下降和年轻增长的情况。
en: With fertility rates declining and people living longer, the workforce is shrinking and getting older at the same time.

zh: 诚然，不同的亚洲国家老龄化速度各不相同。
en: To be sure, not all Asian countries are aging at the same rate.

zh: 在中国、日本、韩国和泰国，人口趋势将导致未来三十年年经济增长下降0.5到1个百分点不等。
en: In China, Japan, Korea, and Thailand, these demographic trends could subtract anywhere from 0.5 to a full percentage point from annual growth over the next three decades.

zh: 但在印度、印尼和菲律宾等“年轻”国家，工作年龄人口实际将有所增加，未来三十年可以让平均年增长提高1—1.5个百分点。
en: But in “young” countries such as India, Indonesia, and the Philippines, the working-age population will actually increase, adding from 1-1.5 percentage points to average annual growth over the same period.

zh: 但是，即使是这些年轻国家，也无法摆脱人口老龄化的影响。
en: And yet, even these young countries will not be spared from the effects of an aging population.

zh: 在今年的亚太REO中，我们指出了一个鲜为人知的事实：几乎所有亚洲国家都面临未富先老的风险。
en: In this year’s Asia-Pacific REO, we point out a little known fact: almost all of Asia is at risk of growing old before ever becoming rich.

zh: 为什么会这样？
en: Why is this occurring?

zh: 首先，尽管如今亚洲并不是世界老龄化最严重的地区，但其老龄化速度很快。
en: For starters, although Asia is not the most aged region in the world today, it is aging remarkably fast.

zh: 一个指标是老龄赡养比：即65岁及以上人口占比。
en: One indicator of this is the old-age dependency ratio: the share of the population that is 65 and older.

zh: 在欧洲，这一比例平均需要26年从15%提高到20 % ； 在美国则花了50多年。
en: In Europe, it took 26 years, on average, for this ratio to increase from 15% to 20%; in the United States, it took more than 50 years.

zh: 在亚洲国家中，只有澳大利亚和新西兰的老龄化速度与此相仿。
en: Among Asian countries, only Australia and New Zealand aged at similar speeds.

zh: 在其他大部分域内国家，这一转变只用了 — — 或将只用 — — 不到15年时间。
en: In most other countries in the region, this transition took – or will take – less than 15 years.

zh: 因此，成为世界增长冠军还不够。
en: So, being the world growth champion simply isn’t enough.

zh: 要究其原因，可以考虑各国的人均收入（以购买力平价衡量）在老龄赡养比达到或将达到峰值时的表现（以美国的经验为基准 ） 。
en: To see why, consider each country’s per capita income (in terms of purchasing power parity) when its old-age dependency ratio, benchmarked against the US experience, peaked or will peak.

zh: 上图表明，除了已经跻身富裕行列的澳大利亚、香港、日本和新加坡等经济体，其他亚洲经济体的人均收入要远低于 — — 或将远低于 — — 其他发达经济体在老龄化周期相近阶段的水平。
en: As the chart above shows, with the exception of already-rich Asian economies such as Australia, Hong Kong, Japan, and Singapore, per capita income in Asian economies falls, or will fall, far short of other advanced economies at similar stages of the aging cycle.

zh: 比如，中国在2011年达到其老龄人口峰值时，人均收入仍只有美国水平的20 % ； 越南在2014年达到老龄人口峰值时，人均收入只有美国的10 % 。
en: For example, when China reached its old-age-population peak in 2011, its per capita income was still only at 20% of the US level; and when Vietnam reached it in 2014, that figure was just 10%.

zh: 而尽管印度年轻人口数量增长强劲，其人均收入在2040年左右老龄人口达到峰值时仍将只能达到美国水平的45 % ； 而这需要乐观假设印度可以在未来几十年保持非常强劲的增长。
en: And despite its young population and strong growth, India’s per capita income will only have reached 45% of the US level when its old-age population peaks in or around 2040; and that assumes, optimistically, that India will maintain very strong growth over the next few decades.

zh: 这一人口趋势对于亚洲地区影响深远。
en: This demographic trend has far-reaching implications for the region.

zh: 亚洲国家可以用来准备向老龄化社会转型的时间远远短于发达经济体。
en: Asian countries will have significantly less time than advanced economies have had to prepare for the transition to an aged society.

zh: 更糟糕的是，它们必须在仍处于相对较穷水平时就面临高昂的老龄化财政成本，这将造成新的社会压力，在“老”亚洲国家中已经显现出来。
en: Worse, they will have to manage the high fiscal costs of aging while they are still relatively poor, which will create new social pressures, which are already apparent in the “old” Asian countries.

zh: 此外，生产率增长的放缓可能加剧亚洲的人口问题。
en: Moreover, slowing productivity growth could compound Asia’s demographic problem.

zh: 自2008年金融危机以来，亚洲发达经济体的生产率增长出现了减速，新兴经济体亦然，只是程度较低。
en: Since the 2008 financial crisis, productivity growth has decelerated in Asia’s advanced economies and, to a lesser extent, in its emerging economies, too.

zh: 因此，该地区赶超全球技术前沿国家的进程在过去十年出现了停滞。
en: Thus, the region’s push to catch up with countries at the global technology frontier has stalled over the past decade.

zh: 要提振未来生产率，亚洲各国政府需要在今天实施精准定向的结构性改革。
en: To boost productivity in the future, Asian governments will have to implement well-targeted structural reforms today.

zh: 考虑到亚洲人口迅速老化，这些改革措施必须包括保护老人、增强社会安全网和驱动长期增长的政策，这一点至关重要。
en: Considering Asia’s rapidly aging population, it is crucial that such reforms include policies to protect the elderly, enhance social safety nets, and drive long-term growth.

zh: 政府还必须让妇女和年长工人更加容易参与劳动力，这可以通过扩大育儿设施、为企业提供弹性退休年龄的激励等方式实现。
en: Governments will also need to make it easier for women and older workers to participate in the labor force, by expanding child-care facilities and creating incentives for firms to relax their retirement-age requirements.

zh: 澳大利亚、香港、新西兰和新加坡的经验表明，移民可以缓冲迅速老龄化的冲击。
en: As Australia, Hong Kong, New Zealand, and Singapore have shown, immigration can soften the blow from rapid aging.

zh: 而通过强化退休金制度，包括通过最低保障福利，政府可以为脆弱的老人群体提供安全网，降低预防性储蓄的激励。
en: And by strengthening pension systems, including through minimum guaranteed benefits, governments can provide a safety net for the vulnerable elderly and reduce incentives for precautionary savings.

zh: 这些政策应该辅之以提高生产率的改革。
en: These policies should be supplemented by productivity-enhancing reforms.

zh: 不同国家各有不同的重点，但都需要加大教育和终身培训的投资，同时推进劳动力和产品市场改革。
en: Different countries will have different priorities, but all will need to make larger investments in education and life-long training, while pressing ahead with labor- and product-market reforms.

zh: 最后，亚洲发达经济体应该注重改善创新 — — 通过更有效地配置研发支出以及提高服务业生产率实现。
en: Finally, advanced Asian economies should focus on improving innovation, by allocating research and development spending more effectively, and by raising productivity in the services sector.

zh: 新兴和发展中经济体则需要吸引更多的外国直接投资，提振国内投资，加强适应新技术的能力。
en: Emerging and developing countries, for their part, will need to attract more foreign direct investment, boost domestic investment, and expand their capacity to adopt new technologies.

zh: 亚洲的他信时代要到了？
en: Asia’s Age of Thaksin?

zh: 新加坡总理李光耀和马来西亚首相马哈蒂尔· 穆罕默德（Mahathir Mohamed）退出政治第一线后，东南亚失去了资深领导人。
en: The retirements from frontline politics of Singapore’s Lee Kuan Yew and Malaysia’s Mahathir Mohamed have deprived Southeast Asia of its senior leaders.

zh: 泰国总理他信（Thaksin Shinawatra）能够填补这一地区领袖的真空状态吗？
en: Can Thailand’s Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra fill the regional leadership vacuum?

zh: 在第一次任期内，他信推出了一系列外交政策方面的大胆举措，其中包括亚洲合作对话（ACD ） 、 东南亚大陆发展经济合作战略(ECS ) 、 及美国指定泰国为其“非北约主要盟国 ” ， 这些使他信成为了全球瞩目的中心。
en: A series of bold foreign-policy strokes – the Asia Cooperation Dialogue, the Economic Cooperation Strategy for the development of mainland Southeast Asia, and America’s designation of Thailand as a “major non-NATO ally” – turned the international spotlight on Thaksin during his first term.

zh: 去年,泰国南部地区(该地区以穆斯林人口为主)的暴力事件似乎对他信的雄心壮志有所打击，但其领导的泰爱泰党（TRT）在去年二月取得的压倒性胜利又重新鼓起了他争取地区领导人地位的信心。
en: Violence in Thailand’s predominantly Muslim south seemed to dent his ambitions last year, but his Thai Rak Thai (TRT) party’s landslide victory last February gave his bid for regional leadership a new lease on life.

zh: 由于泰爱泰党取得了下议院75%的席位，现在，他信在国内的政治地位也变得不可动摇。
en: With the TRT capturing over 75% of the seats in the lower house of parliament, Thaksin is now politically invincible at home.

zh: 事实上，他信在四年任满后，又再度被选为总理，领导着一党政府，这在泰国政坛上尚属首次。
en: Indeed, he has become the first elected Thai leader to finish a four-year term, be re-elected, and preside over a one-party government.

zh: 在泰国政坛上，他信的统治地位可说是前无古人。 面对着变化莫测的选民，他总能重获人心，这一能力也无人可及。
en: Thaksin’s dominance of Thai politics is unprecedented, and his resilient popularity in the face of a fickle electorate is unparalleled.

zh: 除了对国内政治的绝对控制外，他信还具备其他一些成为地区领袖不可或缺的条件。
en: Apart from his complete control of domestic politics, Thaksin commands other prerequisites of regional leadership.

zh: 在再度连任指日可待的情况下，他信还可依恃其政治寿命的优势，这点与马哈蒂尔22年的统治优势类似。
en: Already eyeing a third term, he can count on political longevity on the order of Mahathir’s 22-year rule.

zh: 尽管泰爱泰政党正在搞一党制，但在致力于民主促进的世界政坛里，他信还拥有民主合法性这一武器。 此外，他信英语说得也颇为地道，足以对全球听众宣扬他的观点和对未来的展望。
en: Notwithstanding the one-party system that the TRT is cultivating, Thaksin is armed with democratic legitimacy in a global arena bent on democracy promotion, and he speaks English decently enough to articulate his views and vision to a global audience.

zh: 他信甚至还有一套自己的发展战略，称为“他信经济学 ” 。 “他信经济学”自称能将新自由主义的出口导向型经济增长与国内基层民众的需要融为一体。
en: He even has his own development strategy, dubbed “Thaksinomics,” a self-styled approach that blends neo-liberal export-led growth with grassroots-based domestic demand.

zh: 在他信的监控下，泰国经济走出了1997年东南亚金融危机后的萧条状态，正以年增长率6%的速度稳步增长。
en: The Thai economy emerged out of its post-1997 crisis doldrums under Thaksin’s watch, and is now firmly positioned on a 6% annual growth trajectory.

zh: 在依赖高额补贴和现金发放的同时 ， “ 他信经济学”也把希望建立在进行结构改革以推动经济增长上。
en: While it relies on profligate subsidies and cash handouts, Thaksinomics also banks on structural reforms to propel economic growth.

zh: “他信经济学”最理想的前景是推动产业升级，促进利基产业的发展，推广以竞争为推动力的集群项目，这些项目目的是将泰国建设成为食品、时尚、旅游、汽车、保健方面的地区中心和国际中心。
en: The strategy’s most promising prospects include the promotion of industrial upgrading, niche industries, and competitiveness-boosting cluster projects that aim to make Thailand a global and regional hub for food, fashion, tourism, automobiles, and healthcare.

zh: 蓬勃繁荣的经济（在亚洲，泰国的国内生产总值增长仅次于中国）也是地区领导人不可或缺的条件之一。
en: A vibrant economy – GDP growth is second only to China’s in Asia – is indispensable for regional leadership.

zh: 在所有决定他信将在东南亚地区扮演什么角色的政策中，亚洲合作对话和经济合作战略脱颖而出。
en: Of the policies that will determine his future role in the region, the Asia Cooperation Dialogue and Economic Cooperation Strategy stand out.

zh: 新生的亚洲合作对话以“亚洲人的亚洲”这一理念为基础，其成员国横跨了亚洲大陆，从朝鲜半岛到中东地区。 而泰国地理位置正好居中。
en: Based on the concept of “Asia for Asians,” the nascent ACD’s membership straddles the Asian landmass from the Korean Peninsula to the Middle East, with Thailand at the geographic center.

zh: 尽管未来的方向还不明确，但这一拥有26个成员国的论坛已经胜过了亚太经合组织、东盟及包括中国、日本、韩国在内的东盟加三国。
en: Although its future directions are uncertain, this 26-member forum trumps Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation, the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN), and ASEAN Plus Three, which includes China, Japan, and South Korea.

zh: 1997年横扫整个东南亚的经济危机，自由贸易的迟滞不前，以及该地区脆弱的治安情况都让泰国意识到了东盟的局限性。
en: The region-wide crisis in 1997, weak progress on free trade, and the region’s security vulnerabilities have made Thaksin aware of ASEAN’s limitations.

zh: 印度尼西亚因为面积优势，自然成为了东盟领袖。 而亚洲合作对话则为他信提供了更为广阔的舞台，泰国的地理优势也在此舞台上得到了强调。
en: As Indonesia’s size makes it a natural leader of ASEAN, the ACD lends Thaksin a broader platform that stresses Thailand’s geographical advantages.

zh: 亚洲合作对话使他信可以大声宣扬泰国的战略目标和东南亚的主要问题。 有时，这些目标和问题会与西方的利益和要求相冲突。
en: It allows him to trumpet Thailand’s strategic objectives and the region’s major issues, sometimes in confrontation with the interests and the demands of the West.

zh: 去年，在亚洲合作对话框架内，他信发行了10亿美元的“亚洲债券 ” ， 以努力使亚洲金融资本适应亚洲的融资要求。
en: Within the ACD framework, Thaksin launched the $1 billion “Asia Bond” last year in an effort to match Asia’s financial capital with its financing requirements.

zh: 在规模较小的行动中，经济合作战略就柬埔寨、老挝、缅甸、和越南的经济发展提出了构想。
en: In a smaller sphere of operations, the ECS envisages economic development in Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, and Vietnam.

zh: 在他信的领导下，泰国逐渐摆脱了受援国的地位，首次成为赞助国，并拒绝了日本等国的发展援助。
en: Under Thaksin, Thailand graduated from aid recipient and became a donor country for the first time, having turned away development assistance from countries like Japan.

zh: 泰国还成立了100亿泰铢的援助基金，为经济合作战略成员国提供直接援助和低息贷款。
en: A Thai fund of 10 billion baht was established to provide outright aid and soft loans to the ECS members.

zh: 与亚洲合作对话一样，经济合作战略也将泰国的外交重点转移到了东南亚大陆，并强调泰国在其中扮演的角色和他信的精明领导。
en: Like the ACD, the ECS shifts Thai foreign policy priorities to the Southeast Asian mainland, highlighting Thailand’s role and Thaksin’s canny leadership.

zh: 还有两大障碍挡在他信面前。
en: Two major obstacles stand in Thaksin’s way.

zh: 过去15个月以来，泰国南部的大规模暴力冲突让他信非常难看，他提出了无数的战略、战术，却一再失败。
en: The raging violence in southern Thailand over the past 15 months has made him look bad, as his myriad strategies and tactics have failed repeatedly.

zh: 他的咆哮和坏脾气也于事无补。
en: Nor have his bluster and ill temper improved matters.

zh: 开始时，他信把这些暴力袭击当成土匪行为草草了事。
en: Thaksin initially dismissed the violent attacks as the work of bandits.

zh: 直到去年年末，他才承认南部穆斯林分裂主义才是引��这些暴力行动的原因。
en: Only late last year did he admit that southern Muslim separatism was the cause.

zh: 现在已经出现了一些迹象，表明地方分裂分子与地区恐怖分子具有共生性关系。
en: Signs of a symbiotic relationship between local separatists and regional terrorists have emerged.

zh: 如果暴力袭击从泰国最南部的三个省也拉（Yala ） 、 北大年（Pattani）和陶公府（Narathiwat）蔓延开去，他信成为东南亚领导人的机会将会减小。
en: If the attacks widen beyond the three southernmost provinces of Yala, Pattani, and Narathiwat, Thaksin’s regional leadership chances will be dimmed.

zh: 对这一点，他信非常清楚。
en: Thaksin knows this.

zh: 自从以压倒性优势连任后，他信就变得惊人地谦虚、大度。
en: Since his sweeping re-election, he has been surprisingly modest and magnanimous.

zh: 他指定泰国前总理，现为联合国改革小组组长的阿南·班雅拉春（Anand Panyarachun）组成全国蓝带委员会，并领导该委员会与南部分裂分子协商，以期重修旧好。
en: He has appointed Anand Panyarachun, a former Thai prime minister who recently headed a United Nations reform panel, to select and direct a blue-ribbon national commission to seek reconciliation with the southern separatists.

zh: 此外，如果国际社会打算接受他地区领袖的角色，他信愿意采取一些与缅甸有关的行动。
en: In addition, Thaksin will have to do something about Myanmar if the international community is to accept his wider role.

zh: 很多人认为，泰缅关系太过谨慎。
en: To many, Thai-Myanmar relations are too cozy.

zh: 批评者指责他信是出于利益冲突考虑，因为其家族拥有的电信集团在缅甸有巨额投资。
en: Critics accuse Thaksin of conflicts of interest, as his family-owned telecommunications conglomerate holds sizeable investments in Myanmar.

zh: 现在一切在很大程度上取决于他信自己。
en: It is now largely up to Thaksin himself.

zh: 如果他信足够开明，能改进与南部地区心怀不满的穆斯林之间的关系，能超越自己在缅甸的既得利益，那他还是大有机会成为亚洲的下一个代言人。
en: If he is enlightened enough to make amends with disaffected southerners and move beyond his vested interests in Myanmar, he retains a good shot at becoming Asia’s next spokesman.

zh: 碰壁的亚洲金砖国家
en: Asia’s BRICs Hit the Wall

zh: 发自新德里 — — 美国学者弗朗西斯·福山在二十多年前预言了“历史的终结 ” ， 认为人类将最终走向自由民主制度，但却对作为印度经济增长催化剂的民主制度印象不佳。
en: NEW DELHI –India’s democratic credentials do not impress Francis Fukuyama, who two decades ago prophesied the “end of history,” as being a catalyst for the country’s economic growth.

zh: 相反，他在印度看到了大范围的“庇护政治和顽固作风 ” — —而这些缺点恰恰与中国那种更具效率（但也谈不上廉洁）的政治系统形成鲜明对比。
en: Fukuyama finds excessive “patronage politics and fractiousness” in India – flaws that stand in stark contrast to China’s speedier, though not necessarily cleaner, political system.

zh: 但现实却与他的观点有些出入。
en: The reality is, however, somewhat different.

zh: 中国的地方政府在基建狂潮中欠下了堆积如山的债务，使人不得不忧心其潜在的债务违约风险。
en: China’s local governments have been accumulating mountains of debt to fund their construction binges, raising serious concerns about potential defaults.

zh: 连中国国家总理温家宝自己都承认必须尽快解决本国的不公平发展问题，呼吁设法“公平分配财富 ” ， 并以此弥补“夫人和穷人之间，城市和农村之间”不断扩大的贫富不均现象。
en: Premier Wen Jiabao himself recognizes the urgent need to address the country’s inequitable growth, calling for means to be found to “share prosperity evenly,” and thus to reduce the widening gaps between “rich and poor, cities and countryside.”

zh: 经济学家纽里埃·鲁比尼预测中国的增长将在2013至2015年间放缓，依据是该国占GDP近50%的固定资产投资需要收取社会和经济回报。
en: The economist Nouriel Roubini has predicted that China’s economy will most likely slow sometime between 2013 and 2015, the point at which its fixed-asset investments of nearly 50% of GDP will demand social and monetary returns.

zh: 鲁比尼认为，目前为止中国的出口导向型增长都依赖于“以世界其他地方无法比拟的价格，生产世界其他地方需要的东西”这一原则，而这也是廉价劳动力和世界经济产业链所催生的结果，但这种成本优势也正在迅速消失。
en: Until now, says Roubini, China’s export-led growth has depended on “making things that the rest of the world wants, at a price that no other country can match,” a consequence of cheap labor and economies of scale. This cost advantage is diminishing fast.

zh: 而印度面临的严重困难则与中国性质不同。
en: India is facing severe difficulties as well, but of a different nature.

zh: 比如说印度企业的对外投资正不断扩大。
en: For example, outward investment by Indian companies is expanding fast.

zh: 有人认为这是国家崛起的自然现象，但有也批评认为对外投资恰恰反映了国内投资机会的匮乏。
en: Some believe that this is a natural development for a rising power, but critics view outward investment as a reflection of the scarcity of opportunities at home.

zh: 印度不断提升的利率，高通胀以及严重的政策瓶颈，再加上大量的政府腐败丑闻都让国内外投资者望而却步，以致经济增长未能充分发挥其潜力。
en: Rising interest rates, high inflation, and severe policy gridlock amid a spate of government corruption scandals have impeded both foreign and domestic investment in India, thus slowing economic growth to a level that is below its potential.

zh: 朝令夕改的法律法规环境，落后的基础设施以及一个步履蹒跚，靠天吃饭的农业都使得经济雪上加霜。
en: An unpredictable regulatory environment, inadequate infrastructure, and a sluggish, monsoon-dependent agricultural sector are adding to the economy’s problems.

zh: 很显然，经济寒流正在席卷作为金砖四国（巴西、俄罗斯，印度和中国）巨头的两大亚洲经济体。
en: Clearly, economic turbulence is roiling both of Asia’s major economies, the giants of the so-called BRICs (Brazil, Russia, India, and China).

zh: 在通胀方面，中国人民银行在7月6日再次提升其基准利率，也是自2010年10月以来的第50次调整。
en: Consider inflation. On July 6, the People’s Bank of China raised its benchmark interest rate for the fifth time since October 2010.

zh: 而此举在房地产市场引发了忧虑，害怕地方政府将可能拖欠其1.65万亿美元债务中的一部分。
en: This has generated apprehension about property markets, and fear that local governments could default on part of their staggering debt of $1.65 trillion.

zh: 在印度，政府既无法控制物价，同时又没能推动积极经济结构改革、吸引外国直接投资、推动基础设施建设，控制支出并避免流动性紧缩，使之面对的诸多挑战进一步恶化。
en: In India, the government’s failure to contain rising prices, pursue structural economic reforms vigorously, attract foreign direct investment, advance infrastructure development, manage expenditure, and avoid liquidity crunches underscores the many challenges it faces.

zh: 此外政府和反对派之间的长时间僵持也拉低了政治效率，并随之危害到印度的增长前景。
en: Moreover, a continued standoff between the government and the opposition has weakened political effectiveness, further undermining India’s growth prospects.

zh: 事实上，印度的核心挑战依然是在政治方面。
en: Indeed, India’s core challenge remains political.

zh: 随着食品价格不断飙升，贫困人口受害最深，催生了更大程度的贫困，贫富不均和社会仇恨。
en: With food prices rising sharply, the poor are being hit the hardest, fueling greater poverty, inequality, and resentment.

zh: 而中国也存在着同样的问题：由于能源，食品和原材料价格上升，加上食品占家庭支出的比例在中印两国分别达到了33%和45 % ， 反通胀示威行动如今正在各地不断上演。
en: But the same is true in China: anti-inflation protests are now roiling both countries, owing mainly to rising energy, food, and raw-material prices, with food accounting for one-third of household spending in China and around 45% in India.

zh: 如今两国最害怕的就是这种通胀冲击将演变成自我强化的物价螺旋形上升。
en: The fear now in both countries is that inflation shocks could turn into a self-reinforcing price spiral.

zh: 正如国际货币基金组织警告的那样 ： “ 排除商品之外的核心通胀率已经从2%增加到3.75 % ， 意味着通胀的影响正不断扩大。 ”
en: As the IMF cautions, “core inflation – excluding commodities – has risen from 2% to 3.75%, suggesting that inflation is broadening.”

zh: 印度物价上升的其中一个原因就是基础设施增长依旧停滞不前。
en: One reason that Indian prices are rising is that infrastructure growth remains sluggish.

zh: 公路，铁路和发电项目都是稳定物价的要素，因为这些设施都有助于防止食品过早腐烂变质以及能源和商品不至于白白浪费。
en: Progress on roads, railways, and power projects – all of which could prevent food from perishing prematurely, and energy and commodities from being unnecessarily wasted – is essential to stabilizing prices.

zh: 而与此同时中国正站在一个关键的关口上。
en: China, meanwhile, finds itself at a critical juncture.

zh: 该国最高领导层将在明年换届，而偏偏收入不均状况又不断恶化，党内对如何制止这一态势缺乏共识。
en: Its leadership will change next year – at a time when income inequality is on the march and the Party lacks any consensus on how to stop it.

zh: 考虑到执政的中国共产党如今只有不到9%的党员是真正的“工人 ” ， 该政权的领导人面对收入分配不均状况显然更加如坐针毡。
en: Given that less than 9% of China’s ruling communist party members are actually “workers” nowadays, the regime’s leaders must be even more uncomfortable with growing inequality.

zh: 但如果缺乏切实的政治改革，收入不均现象将随着权贵资本主义的逐渐扎根而更加恶化。
en: But, in the absence of serious political reform, income inequality will widen as crony capitalism sinks its roots more deeply.

zh: 印中两国都需要重新推动体制改革来维持经济增长。
en: India and China both need a renewed commitment to structural reform to sustain their economic growth.

zh: 廉价劳动力和货币管理本身并不能带来成功。
en: Cheap labor and monetary management will not do the trick on their own.

zh: 而两国政府在2008年成功避过金融危机后攒下的信誉已经开始流失。
en: The credibility that both governments gained after their countries avoided the worst of the global financial crisis of 2008 is beginning to wear thin.

zh: 随着通胀恐惧在这两大金砖国家巨头不断滋长，人们开始质疑世界经济的中心是否真的能成功向两国转移。
en: For, as inflationary fears in the BRIC giants grow, second thoughts about the shift in the world economy’s center of gravity are beginning to gain currency.

zh: 印中两国一方面需要进行短期的纠错性调整，另一方面则需要实施长期的结构改革。
en: What both countries need are short-term corrections and long-term structural changes.

zh: 中国必须建设一个不依赖出口和低工资的经济。
en: China needs to prepare itself for an economy whose performance is not dependent on exports and low domestic wages.

zh: 印度则要找到除了新信息科技（虽然依然欢迎）之外的经济现代化驱动力。
en: India must find other drivers of economic modernization than new information technologies (as welcome as these are).

zh: 两国的工人如今都希望改善生活水平 — — 连中国这个对社会高度控制的政治系统都无法忽视这类呼声。
en: Workers in both countries are now demanding better living standards – a demand that even China’s tightly controlled political system cannot ignore.

zh: 而印��需要的是进一步开放其经济来利用人口快速增长以及全球经济结构性变革所带来的优势。
en: India, for its part, needs to open up its economy further in order to take advantage of its continuing rapid population growth and the ongoing changes in the structure of the global economy.

zh: 它必须再次承担起实现人民温饱的责任 — — 并因此实现其农业“第二次绿色革命”的既定目标。
en: It must recommit itself to feeding its population – and thus to attaining its stated objective of a “Second Green Revolution” in agriculture.

zh: 中国和印度分别使用了不同的政治模式去实现自己的GDP增长野心。
en: China and India have used very different political models to achieve their ambitious GDP-growth targets.

zh: 随着两国经济逐步走向成熟，结构性变革变得势在必行 — — 同时还要应对那些拖延已久的政治改革所带来的挑战。
en: Nonetheless, as their economies mature, both will need to embrace structural change – and to address the challenges of overdue political reforms.

zh: 世袭的亚洲
en: Dynastic Asia

zh: 新加坡 — — 从文化对政治影响的角度，东北亚近期频繁的领导层更迭表明亚洲社会即使不支持、也更能容忍世袭继承。
en: SINGAPORE – To the extent that culture matters in politics, the recent spate of leadership changes in Northeast Asia suggests that Asian societies are more tolerant – if not supportive – of dynastic succession.

zh: 最近当选的韩国总统朴槿惠是朴正熙之女，朴正熙在1961至1979年间曾在韩国执政。
en: South Korea’s recently elected president, Park Geun-hye, is the daughter of Park Chung Hee, who ruled the country from 1961 to 1979.

zh: 中国的新任主席习近平是前副总理习仲勋之子。
en: China’s incoming president, Xi Jinping, is the son of Xi Zhongxun, a former vice premier.

zh: 而日本新任首相安倍晋三则是两任前日本首相的孙子和侄孙。
en: Japan’s new prime minister, Shinzo Abe, is the grandson and grandnephew of two former Japanese prime ministers, and the son of a former foreign minister.

zh: 金正恩分别是朝鲜两位前任元首的子和孙。
en: Kim Jong-un is the son and grandson of his two predecessors in North Korea.

zh: 这种模式并不是东北亚的专利。
en: This pattern is not confined to Northeast Asia.

zh: 菲律宾总统阿基诺三世是前总统科拉松·阿基诺之子。
en: President Benigno Aquino III of the Philippines is the son of former President Corazon Aquino.

zh: 马来西亚和新加坡总理纳吉布·阿卜杜勒·拉扎克和李显龙的父亲都曾担任过总理一职。
en: Prime Ministers Najib Abdul Razak and Lee Hsien Loong of Malaysia and Singapore, respectively, are also sons of former prime ministers.

zh: 印度的拉胡尔·甘地正伺机而动，准备接过曾祖父贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁、祖母英迪拉·甘地和父亲拉吉夫·甘地的衣钵。
en: In India, Rahul Gandhi is waiting in the wings, preparing to step into the shoes of his great-grandfather (Jawaharlal Nehru), grandmother (Indira Gandhi), and father (Rajiv Gandhi).

zh: 在巴基斯坦，阿西夫·阿里·扎尔达里总统和遭遇暗杀的前总理贝·布托之子，同时也是前总理佐勒菲卡尔·阿里·布托之孙比拉瓦尔·布托·扎尔达里不久前刚刚上演了自己的政治首秀。
en: In Pakistan, Bilawal Bhutto Zardari – son of President Asif Ali Zardari and the assassinated former prime minister, Benazir Bhutto, and grandson of former Prime Minister Zulfikar Ali Bhutto – recently made his political debut.

zh: 世袭继承是否已成为整个亚洲地区的标准？
en: Is dynastic succession becoming the norm throughout Asia?

zh: 无可否认，显赫的家世使政治候选人有优势战胜对手。
en: There is no denying that a distinguished lineage gives political candidates an advantage over rivals.

zh: 但拥有知名亲属显然也不能保证成功。
en: But it is also clear that having distinguished relatives is no guarantee of success.

zh: 菲律宾前总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约一波三折的经历就是最好的证据。
en: Consider the checkered record of former Philippine President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo.

zh: 她的父亲是一位受人尊敬的总统，但她却很可能作为该国最腐败的总统之一而留名青史。
en: Her father was a respected president; yet she could well be remembered as one of the country’s most corrupt.

zh: 关键问题是执政时领导者的态度。
en: The key issue is leaders’ attitude when they assume office.

zh: 如果上任时自诩为前任领导人的后裔，那么他们的执政生涯就很可能像阿罗约那样以失败而告终。
en: If they do so with a sense of entitlement from their lineage, they are likely to fail, as Arroyo did.

zh: 幸运的是多数东亚领导人在执政时都秉承强烈的责任感和使命感来振兴自己的国家。
en: Fortunately for East Asia, most seem to approach power with a keen sense of duty and a commitment to strengthening their countries.

zh: 用“太子党”来形容中国的习近平可能并不恰当。
en: The term “princeling” is probably an unfair description of China’s Xi.

zh: 毕竟，他曾经的生活轨迹很难说令人羡慕。
en: After all, he hardly can be said to have led a charmed life.

zh: 其父遭毛泽东清洗后，他在1966-1976年的文化大革命爆发前就开始到乡下工作，并因此亲身体验到与他同代的很多人都曾经体验过的艰辛。
en: After his father was purged by Mao Zedong, he went to work in the countryside, even before the 1966-1976 Cultural Revolution, experiencing firsthand all of the hardships that many of his generation endured.

zh: 身居高位后他并没有感觉理所当然。
en: Having risen to the top, he feels no sense of entitlement.

zh: 无论从哪方面讲，他都感觉有责任证明自己是凭借实力身居高位，而不是仰赖父辈的余阴。
en: From all accounts, he feels an even greater sense of responsibility to prove that he gained his position on the basis of merit, not privilege.

zh: 习肯定已意识到中华人民共和国第二代领导人的子女已经因快速敛财而引起相当大的公愤。
en: Xi must also be aware that the children of the People’s Republic’s second generation of leaders face considerable public resentment, owing to their rapid accumulation of wealth.

zh: 这也解释了他着力反腐倡廉的原因。
en: That explains his focus on combating corruption.

zh: 如果没能完成任务他会被看作失败者，中国共产党的政治垄断也可能比任何人预期的都提早结束。
en: If he fails to do so, he will be deemed a failure, and the Chinese Communist Party’s political monopoly may end sooner than anyone anticipates.

zh: 习近平的肩上担子很重。
en: Xi carries a huge burden on his shoulders.

zh: 朴槿惠的状况也非常相似。
en: So does Park Geun-hye.

zh: 她凭借个人努力登上最高领导人的宝座。
en: Like Xi, she had to struggle to reach the top.

zh: 她的父亲帮助韩国脱贫并将其造就为经济小虎。
en: Her father lifted South Korea out of poverty and turned it into an economic tiger.

zh: 但他执政时也进行了残酷的镇压。
en: But his rule was also brutally repressive.

zh: 众多前任被认定为执政失败，更是令朴槿惠的境况雪上加霜。
en: To make matters worse for Park, many of her predecessors are perceived as failures.

zh: 两位前总统卢泰愚和全斗焕遭到起诉；还有一位卢武铉自杀身亡。
en: Two former presidents, Roh Tae-woo and Chun Doo-hwan, were prosecuted; another, Roh Moo-hyun, committed suicide.

zh: 围绕着即将离任的总统李明博也有很多并不友善的传言。
en: There are also unkind rumors swirling around outgoing President Lee Myung-bak.

zh: 韩国显然是个竭力寻找定位的成功国家。
en: South Korea is clearly a successful country that is struggling to define itself.

zh: 理论上韩国应当庆贺自己的经济文化成就。
en: In theory, it should be celebrating its economic and cultural achievements.

zh: 但实际上，作为身处混乱的一介小国，且与朝鲜长年关系紧张，致使韩国陷入深深的生存焦虑。
en: In practice, as a small country in a troubled neighborhood – and with North Korea a constant source of tension – it lives in existential anxiety.

zh: 朴槿惠的获胜并未减弱民众对她父亲的矛盾态度，她肯定知道弥合韩国显而易见的分歧绝非一项轻而易举的工作。
en: And Park, whose victory has not diminished her people’s ambivalent attitude toward her father, must know that healing the obvious divisions in South Korean society will not be easy.

zh: 摆在拉胡尔·甘地面前的是一项最艰巨的任务。
en: The most difficult job is the one that awaits Rahul Gandhi.

zh: 没有哪个党能像国大党那样主宰独立后的印度政治，这意味着印度未来必须走一条艰难而充满争吵的联盟之路。
en: No single party can dominate Indian politics as the Congress Party has done since independence, implying a future of difficult and quarrelsome coalitions.

zh: 在这种情况下，印度最需要一位果敢的领袖。
en: In these circumstances, India needs, above all, decisive leadership.

zh: 但拉胡尔却像哈姆雷特一样游移不定。
en: Yet, like Hamlet, Rahul seems uncertain.

zh: 如果下定决心，他几年前就可以担任这个职务。
en: He could have taken the job several years ago, if he had chosen to do so.

zh: 他的犹豫不决肯定反映出深深的焦虑。
en: His hesitation must reflect a deep anxiety.

zh: 不过他的犹豫也在情理之中。
en: Yet his reluctance is understandable.

zh: 必须再次强调世袭继承并不能确保成功。
en: Again, dynastic succession does not ensure success.

zh: 比方说马来西亚的拉扎克为将国家重新统一在“一个马来西亚”的旗帜下付出了巨大的努力。
en: Malaysia’s Razak, for example, has made an enormous effort to reunify his country with his “1Malaysia” message.

zh: 但所有迹象表明2013年他将面对一场选举恶战。
en: Yet all the indications are that he will face an extremely hard-fought election in 2013.

zh: 尽管机率不大，但他所在的国民阵线联盟的确存在土崩瓦解的可能。
en: Though unlikely, his Barisan Nasional coalition could fall apart.

zh: 他的前辈从未面临过这样的问题。
en: No such prospect faced his predecessors.

zh: 尽管家世显赫，但人们普遍认为日本的安倍在其2006-2007年的首届首相任期中并无上佳表现。
en: In Japan, Abe is universally regarded to have performed badly in his first stint as Prime Minister in 2006-2007, despite his distinguished lineage.

zh: 而现在他接手的国家面临着巨大的国内国际挑战。
en: Now he takes over an even more troubled country with huge domestic and external challenges.

zh: 极少有人押宝他能成功。
en: Few are betting on his succeeding.

zh: 总之，亚洲世袭继承的领导模式无法助其躲避世界其他地区所面临的挑战。
en: In short, Asia’s pattern of dynastic leadership does not render it immune from the challenges that the rest of the world faces.

zh: 值此亚洲创造全球最大的中产阶级之时 — — 预计到2020年中产阶级人数将增长超过三倍（从5百万增长到17.5亿 ） ， 公众要求更能干、更有责任心的政府的呼声亚洲也必须面对。
en: As Asia creates the world’s largest middle class – projected to grow more than three-fold, from 500 million to 1.75 billion, by 2020 – it will also have to cope with demands for more competent and more accountable governments.

zh: 在当今亚洲，当权者都生活在惴惴不安之中。
en: In Asia today, uneasy lies the head that wears the crown.

zh: 亚洲的前途
en: Asia’s Hard Road

zh: 马尼拉—对发展中亚洲来说，明年将出现重大挑战和新的责任，有政治上的，有经济上的，也有社会上的。
en: MANILA – Next year will present significant challenges and new responsibilities – political, economic, and social – for developing Asia.

zh: 通往可持续包容性增长的道路是艰难的，但也意味着亚洲和世界其他地区的令人振奋的机会。
en: The path to sustainable, inclusive economic growth will be difficult, but it will also entail exciting opportunities for Asia and the rest of the world.

zh: 进入大衰退五年已逾五年，但发达国家的复苏依然萎靡不振。
en: Five years into the Great Recession, recovery remains elusive in advanced economies.

zh: 欧洲领导人必须做出艰难决定，以解决欧元危机、重振增长。
en: Europe’s leaders must make tough decisions in order to resolve the euro crisis and revive growth.

zh: 而尽管美国开始显露出经济复苏信号，但它仍面临着所谓“财政悬崖”的政治僵局。
en: And, although the United States is beginning to show signs of economic recovery, the country faces a political stalemate over the so-called “fiscal cliff.”

zh: 事实上，尽管先行指标比前几年略有好转，但风险仍然极高。
en: Indeed, while leading indicators may be stronger than they were a year ago, risks have only intensified.

zh: 在亚洲，财政审慎使得重振2010年全球经济增长的刺激措施得以实施。
en: In Asia, fiscal prudence allowed the stimulus measures that were needed to revive global economic growth in 2010.

zh: 但过去几十年来的经济转型来到了十字路口。
en: But the economic transformation that has occurred over the last several decades has reached a crossroads.

zh: 一些低收入经济体赶了上来，但由于外部环境恶化和内部低迷，多年来两位数的GDP增长率将难以维系，特别是印度和中国。
en: Notwithstanding a few low-income economies catching up, the years of double-digit GDP growth are unlikely to continue – particularly in China and India – owing to the anemic external environment, together with internal weaknesses.

zh: 亚洲需要调整适应增长放缓的新时期，同时解决普遍存在的不平等问题、改善稳定性。
en: Asia needs to adjust to a new era of more moderate growth, while addressing widespread inequality and improving sustainability.

zh: 前所未有的经济扩张让千百万亚洲人摆脱了贫困，但也伴随着日益加剧的收入分化和严重的环境破坏。
en: The unprecedented economic expansion that has lifted millions out of poverty has been accompanied by widening income disparities, as well as serious environmental damage.

zh: 结果，如今的亚洲出现了两副面孔：繁荣的、不断成长的中产阶级；以及地区快速经济发展的弃儿，他们的健康和福利因空气和水污染等严峻问题而每况愈下。
en: As a result, Asia now has two faces: a prosperous and growing middle class, and those who have yet to benefit from the region’s rapid economic development – and whose health and well-being is being adversely affected by acute problems like air and water pollution.

zh: 简言之，今日亚洲面临的关键挑战是维持经济增长 — — 以有所降低但仍令人羡慕的速度，并改善增长质量。
en: In short, the key challenges facing Asia today are to sustain economic growth – at lower, but still enviable, rates – and to improve its quality.

zh: 亚洲需要强大的、包容性的、绿色的、知识推动的增长，这意味着需要实现经济动态资源的再平衡，强调国内、地区和跨地区“南南”需求。
en: Asia needs strong, inclusive, green, knowledge-led growth, which implies the need to rebalance the sources of economic dynamism to emphasize domestic, regional, and inter-regional “South-South” demand.

zh: 与西方的经济关系不会因这一变化而削弱。
en: Economic relations with the West would not be diluted by this shift.

zh: 正如西方为亚洲经济扩张提供了出口和专家，亚洲也为发达经济体提供了转变增长模式以应对全球化挑战的机会。
en: Just as the West has provided exports and expertise to bolster Asia’s economic expansion, Asia offers opportunities for advanced economies to transform their growth models to cope with the challenges of globalization.

zh: 事实上，从升级自身日程的问题看，明年将是发展中亚洲的良机，而这反过来将给予发达经济体所需要的满足其自身经济潜力的灵活性和机会。
en: Indeed, the coming year will mark a seminal moment for developing Asia in terms of advancing its own agenda, which, in turn, will give developed economies the flexibility and opportunities that they need to fulfill their own economic potential.

zh: 要想成功，亚洲领导人就必须排除外交干扰 — — 包括2012年有所加剧的地区领土纠纷 — — 进一步动摇已然不确定的经济和地缘政治环境。
en: To be successful, Asia’s leaders must not allow diplomatic distractions – including territorial disputes in the region, which intensified in 2012 – to destabilize further an already uncertain economic and geopolitical environment.

zh: 在当前全球经济充满不确定性的环境下，没有空间处理此类破坏。
en: Given current global economic uncertainties, there is no room for this kind of disruption.

zh: 持续的地缘政治动荡将推迟（如果不是阻挠的话）世界级新亚洲的崛起。
en: Continued geopolitical volatility will delay, if not obstruct, the emergence of a new, world-class Asia.

zh: 在这样的环境下，将在2013年掌权的亚洲新领导人 — — 如中国、日本和韩国领导人 — — 必须将加强地区经济和政治合作放在首位。
en: In this context, Asian leaders ascending to power in 2013 – for example, in China, Japan, and South Korea – must prioritize enhanced regional economic and political cooperation.

zh: 若全球经济环境恶化，这类关系将更加关键。
en: Such relationships will be all the more crucial if global economic conditions deteriorate.

zh: 不能让政治纠纷妨碍确保长期可持续发展所需要的调整。
en: Political disputes must not be allowed to hinder the adjustments needed to ensure long-term sustainable development.

zh: 这样的调整有很多。
en: And those adjustments are many.

zh: 过去20年来，亚洲经济繁荣主要由地区内制造业联系推动，中间产品和零部件由亚洲内部提供，组装成最终产品后出口发达市场，这让该地区获得了“亚洲工厂”的名声。
en: Over the last two decades, Asia’s economic boom was largely driven by intra-regional manufacturing linkages, in which intermediate goods and parts were sourced from within Asia to be assembled into final goods for export to developed markets – earning the region the moniker “factory Asia.”

zh: 但受全球放缓拖累，过度依赖出口的风险已显露无疑。
en: But the protracted global slowdown has highlighted the risks of excessive reliance on exports.

zh: 为了确保长期稳定，亚洲必须找到新的增长之源，提高生产率，改善效率。
en: In order to ensure long-term stability, Asia must find new sources of growth, increase productivity, and improve efficiency.

zh: 扩大南南贸易和投资联系能够增强地区增长潜力、刺激全球再平衡，从而有助于全球经济稳定性。
en: Expanding South-South trade and investment links could enhance the region’s growth potential and contribute to global economic stability by promoting worldwide rebalancing.

zh: 为了为此提供便利，发展中亚洲必须设法降低内部贸易和投资壁垒 — — 目前仍比工业化国家之间高 — — 并继续推进全球和地区一体化。
en: To facilitate this, developing Asia must work to reduce internal trade and investment barriers – which remain higher than those in place vis-à-vis industrialized nations – and continue to promote global and regional integration.

zh: 发展充满活力的服务部门也很关键。
en: Developing a vibrant service sector is also crucial.

zh: 随着制造业工资上升、劳动密集程度下降，亚洲需要更多地依赖服务业为每年新增的数百万劳动新军创造就业岗位。
en: As manufacturing wages rise and labor intensity falls, Asia will need to rely more on services to create jobs for the millions of people who join the workforce each year.

zh: 升级服务部门不需要多少投资，但取消过多的监管规定也需要强大的政治意愿。
en: While little investment is needed to upgrade the service sector, dismantling excessive regulations will require strong political will.

zh: 此外，最近的自然灾害凸显气候弹性作为改善生活质量方式的重要性。
en: Moreover, recent natural disasters have highlighted the importance of climate resilience as a means to improve quality of life.

zh: 保护穷人、治理城市移民将对这方面有所裨益，而这需要创新和公共韧性的巧妙组合。
en: Protecting the poor and managing urban migration would help in this regard, and requires a subtle mixture of innovation and public fortitude.

zh: 这方面的措施包括授予土地所有权、打倒恶地主、提供基本服务。
en: Measures should include issuing land titles, removing slumlords, and providing basic services.

zh: 亚洲的未竟转型 — — 其根源在于对公平、包容、越来越依靠知识推动的增长有助于减少贫困、为人民带去更大繁荣的长期认识 — — 要求旨在缓和由新冲击导致的全球经济减速的短期承诺，也要求通过再平衡亚洲自身增长资源减轻全球失衡的坚决措施。
en: Asia’s ongoing transformation – rooted in the long-term conviction that more equitable, inclusive, and increasingly knowledge-led growth will help to reduce poverty and offer greater prosperity to its citizens – requires a short-term commitment to mitigating any global economic slowdown caused by new shocks. It also demands determined efforts to reduce global imbalances by rebalancing Asia’s own sources of growth.

zh: 若能成功，那么从转型中新生的亚洲将不但繁荣，还将是世界和平 — — 终极全球公共商品的有力保障。
en: If successful, the Asia that emerges from this transformation will not only be prosperous; it will also be a bulwark of world peace – the ultimate global public good.

zh: 亚洲战略奇迹的终结？
en: The End of Asia’s Strategic Miracle?

zh: 东京 — — 现在还无法知道朝鲜核及导弹计划所造成的挑战将如何解决。
en: TOKYO – It is too soon to know whether and how the challenge posed by North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs will be resolved.

zh: 但是时候考虑这一挑战对曾在诸多方面书写历史的亚洲地区来说究竟意味着什么。
en: But it is not too early to consider what that challenge could mean for a part of the world that has in many ways defied history.

zh: “亚洲奇迹”这一名词在某种程度上说明了亚洲许多国家之前半个世纪的经济增长有多么特别。
en: The moniker “Asian Miracle” goes some way toward conveying just how extraordinary the last half-century of economic growth in many Asian countries has been.

zh: 领先起飞的亚洲经济体是日本，尽管近几十年来经历了增速放缓和人口减少，但仍然是全世界第三大经济体。
en: The first economy to take off was Japan, which, despite a slowdown in recent decades and a relatively small population, remains the world’s third-largest economy.

zh: 中国的地位攀升开始稍晚，但同样令人印象深刻：该国实现了30多年的双位数平均GDP增长，并成为当今世界第二大经济体。
en: China’s ascent began a bit later, but is no less impressive: the country achieved over three decades of double-digit average GDP growth, making it the world’s second-largest economy today.

zh: 很快就将成为全世界人口最多国家的印度近期也实现了7-8%的可观的年均GDP增长。
en: India, soon to be the world’s most populous country, has lately been experiencing an impressive 7-8% annual rate of GDP growth.

zh: 而东盟十国近年则实现了约5%的平均增长。
en: And the ten members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations averaged some 5% growth in recent years.

zh: 但当代亚州经济奇迹是以维护和平与秩序这样一个不大被人提及的战略奇迹为基础的。
en: But contemporary Asia’s economic miracle rests on a less-discussed strategic miracle: the maintenance of peace and order.

zh: 自从20世纪70年代中期越南战争结束以来，亚洲就一直没有发生过主要的国内和跨境冲突 — — 这样的成就使得亚洲从与非洲、欧洲、中东甚至是拉美等地的较量中脱颖而出。
en: Since the end of the Vietnam War in the mid-1970s, Asia has stood out for its lack of major conflicts within or across borders – an achievement that distinguishes it from Africa, Europe, the Middle East, and even Latin America.

zh: 由于亚洲有大量悬而未决的领土争端，这样的稳定就更加特殊。
en: This stability is all the more extraordinary because Asia is home to a large number of unresolved disputes.

zh: 1945年二战结束时，日本和俄罗斯并未签署和平协议，这在很大程度上是因为两国对南千岛群岛针锋相对的领土要求，该地区在日本被称之为北方四岛。
en: When World War II ended in 1945, Japan and Russia did not sign a peace treaty, owing largely to their competing claims over the Southern Kuril Islands, known in Japan as the Northern Territories.

zh: 八年后，朝鲜战争结束时也没有签订正式协议，留下了一个四分五裂、全副武装的朝鲜半岛。
en: Eight years later, the Korean War also ended without a formal peace treaty, leaving behind a divided and heavily armed peninsula.

zh: 今天，针锋相对的领土要求 — — 其中多数涉及中国 — — 继续导致亚洲局势紧张。
en: Today, competing territorial claims – mostly involving China – continue to stoke tension across Asia.

zh: 日本在东海卷入与中国的尖阁列岛（钓鱼岛）领土争端。
en: Japan is embroiled in a dispute with China over the Senkaku (Diaoyu) Islands in the East China Sea.

zh: 超过半打其他亚洲国家强烈反对中国对南海的领土要求。
en: More than half a dozen other Asian countries disagree vehemently with China’s territorial claims in the South China Sea.

zh: 而印度则因为长期以来所共有的喜马拉雅边界与中国发生冲突。
en: And India is at loggerheads with China over their long-shared Himalayan border.

zh: 尽管存在所有这些紧张因素，但亚洲一直在大体上维持了和平的局面，部分原因是没有哪个国家希望威胁经济增长并挑起冲突。
en: Despite all of these tensions, Asia has remained largely at peace, partly because no country has wanted to jeopardize economic growth by initiating a conflict.

zh: 邓小平是上述观点最明显的持有者。
en: This perspective is most clearly associated with Deng Xiaoping.

zh: 在领导20世纪70年代末到20世纪90年代初中国经济“改革开放”的过程中，邓明确强调保持外部环境稳定对促进国内经济发展有多重要。
en: In leading China’s process of economic “reform and opening-up” from the late 1970s to the early 1990s, Deng explicitly emphasized the importance of a stable external environment to facilitate internal economic development.

zh: 依赖区域贸易关系支持增长和就业为维持和平提供了另外一个主观因素。
en: The reliance on regional trade ties to support growth and employment has provided yet another incentive to sustain peace.

zh: 但经济很可能并非唯一的因素。
en: But economics was probably not the only factor at play.

zh: 多数亚洲国家均为具有较强民族认同感的相对同质化社会，因此爆发国内冲突并向境外蔓延的可能性是比较低的。
en: Because most Asian countries are host to relatively homogenous societies with strong national identities, the chance of civil conflicts erupting and spilling over national borders is relatively low.

zh: 最后但同样重要的是，美国在亚洲强大的军事存在 — — 这支撑了亚洲地区强大的区域联盟体制 — — 降低了亚洲国家发展本国大规模军事计划的必要性，并且强化了遏制武装冒险主义倾向的现状。
en: Last but certainly not least, America’s strong military presence in Asia – which underpins its robust regional alliance system – has reduced the need for Asian countries to develop large military programs of their own, and has reinforced a status quo that discourages armed adventurism.

zh: 上述因素促成了亚洲的和平与稳定，但它们不能被视为是理所当然的。
en: These factors have contributed to peace and stability in Asia, but they cannot be taken for granted.

zh: 事实上，它们现在所面临的压力越来越大 — — 威胁到促成亚洲经济奇迹的战略奇迹的健康。
en: Indeed, they are now coming under increasing pressure – putting the strategic miracle that has facilitated Asia’s economic miracle in jeopardy.

zh: 究竟哪些因素发生了改变？
en: What changed?

zh: 其一是，中国的经济崛起已经导致其军力扩张。
en: For one thing, China’s economic rise has allowed it to expand its military capabilities.

zh: 随着中国采取越来越自信的外交政策 — — 与印度的边境争端和对南海的领土要求就是很好的例子 — — 其他国家提升本国军事开支的动力也越来越强。
en: As China adopts an increasingly assertive foreign policy – exemplified by its border dispute with India and territorial claims in the South China Sea – other countries are increasingly motivated to boost their own military spending.

zh: 正因如此，分歧或事件更有可能升级为冲突。
en: As that happens, it becomes more likely that a disagreement or incident will escalate into a conflict.

zh: 此外，唯一有能力平衡中国的国家美国似乎正在退出其在亚洲所扮演的传统角色。
en: Meanwhile, the US – the only power with the capability to offset China – seems to be retreating from its traditional role in Asia.

zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府已经退出跨太平洋贸易伙伴关系，并因为国防开支和持续的贸易失衡与美国的盟友发生冲突。
en: Already, US President Donald Trump’s administration has withdrawn his country from the Trans-Pacific Partnership, and confronted US allies on their defense spending and persistent trade imbalances.

zh: 更广义的说，美国外交政策不断增强的不可预测性可能会削弱其威慑力，并促使盟国将安全掌握在自己的手中。
en: More generally, the growing unpredictability of US foreign policy could weaken deterrence and prompt allies to take their security into their own hands.

zh: 潜在动荡的最直接原因是朝鲜，该国现在不仅对韩国构成传统的军事威胁，而且核威慑所有的亚洲国家及美国。
en: The most immediate cause of potential instability is North Korea, which now poses not just a conventional military threat to South Korea, but also a nuclear threat to all of Asia, as well as to the US.

zh: 这可能引致美国发起破坏性的先发制人的打击。
en: This could invite a devastating preemptive strike from the US.

zh: 但即使美国避免采取军事行动，如果朝鲜真的发起打击，仍有可能造成灾难性的后果。
en: But, if the US refrains from military action, the results could also be catastrophic, if the North actually does strike.

zh: 即使仅仅是核打击威胁也有可能引发动荡，前提是上述威胁促使韩国和日本等美国相关盟国增加他们的军事开支并重新思考他们不拥核的立场。
en: Even just the threat of such a strike could be destabilizing, if it drives concerned US allies such as South Korea and Japan to increase their military spending and reconsider their non-nuclear postures.

zh: 如果上述设想中的任何一种真的发生，都会造成影响深远的后果。
en: Should any of these scenarios come to pass, the consequences would be far-reaching.

zh: 除人道主义代价外，它们可能威胁亚洲乃至整个世界的经济繁荣现状。
en: Beyond the human costs, they would threaten the economic prosperity of not only Asia, but the entire world.

zh: 尤其是美中之间如果爆发冲突都可能造成21世纪最重要的双边关系毒化。
en: A conflict between the US and China, in particular, could poison the single most important bilateral relationship of the twenty-first century.

zh: 好消息是所有这些都并非不可避免。
en: The good news is that none of this is inevitable.

zh: 各国政府还有时间来力行克制、探索外交，并重新思考有可能破坏稳定的政策。
en: There is still time for governments to embrace restraint, explore diplomacy, and reconsider policies that threaten to undermine stability.

zh: 不幸的是，我们生活的时代民族主义情绪高涨，领导人也越来越不负责。
en: Unfortunately, we are living in a time of rising nationalism and at times irresponsible leadership.

zh: 再加上地区政治军事安排不够充分，我们根本无法确定智慧能否战胜鲁莽，也无法确定亚洲独一无二的数十年和平能否继续惠及该地区民众。
en: Add to that inadequate regional political-military arrangements, and it is not at all certain that wisdom will triumph over recklessness, or that Asia’s unique decades-long peace will endure.

zh: 脆弱的亚洲特殊关系
en: Asia’s Fragile Special Relationship

zh: 发自新德里 — — 《论语》里记载，子禽问于子贡曰 ： “ 夫子至于是邦也，必闻其政，求之与？
en: NEW DELHI – “Tzu-Ch’in asked Tzu-Kung a few questions; Tzu-Kung answered: …Our Master gets things (done) by being cordial, frank, courteous, temperate, deferential.

zh: 抑与之与？
en: That is our…way.”

zh: ”子贡曰 ： “ 夫子温、良、恭、俭、让以得之。 ”那么中国国家总理温家宝又是否能在最近对印度的访问中遵照这部中国古代经典的准则行事呢？
en: But will Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao live up to that standard, as conveyed in the Analects of Confucius, on his current visit to India?

zh: 这个世界上存在着许多“特殊关系 ” 。
en: The world has a variety of “special relationships.”

zh: 在二战中孕育出来的美英伙伴关系算是其中之一，并成为了西方半个世纪以来的政治基础。
en: The United States’ partnership with the United Kingdom is one forged in war – and a pillar of the West for more than a half-century.

zh: 冷战期间的美苏敌对关系则影响了整个世界的命运，直到苏联解体为止。
en: The US-Soviet rivalry of the Cold War era was special in that relations between those two countries shaped the fate of the world until the USSR imploded.

zh: 而据说如今中美两国之间也开始培育一种新的特殊关系。
en: The US and China are said to be forging a new special relationship.

zh: 但在展望亚洲的未来（以及世界外交的未来）之时，真正能决定全球议程的其实是印度和中国 — — 两个世界上人口最多，同时也是最大的新兴经济体 — — 之间的关系。
en: But, in looking toward the future of Asia – and, indeed, the future of world diplomacy – it is the relationship between the world’s two most populous countries and largest emerging economies, India and China, which will increasingly set the global agenda.

zh: 日本近日出台的新防卫大纲对其军事原则做出了自冷战开始以来的首次修订 — — 这清晰地暗示中国已经成为该国最大的威胁 — — 这意味着中国领导人也是时候仔细审视一下自己的区域性战略了。
en: Japan’s change of military doctrine for the first time since the start of the Cold War – a shift that implicitly makes China the greatest threat – suggests that the Chinese leadership needs to take a hard look at its regional grand strategy.

zh: 温家宝此次访印的议题有着非常明确的先后次序：首先是贸易，其次是安全 … … 最后才是两国间的边界争端。
en: Wen’s priorities for his trip to India are clear: trade, security, and, far behind, the territorial disputes between the two countries.

zh: 如果没有幕后的那些摩擦的话，这样的安排在外交上堪称精妙。
en: Such an approach might make tactical diplomatic sense, as long as there is no background clatter.

zh: 但这样做却显然缺乏一个战略紧迫性，因为这种避重就轻的举动将不断加剧亚洲各国之间的紧张局势，并最终导致一起严重的战略失误。
en: But it lacks a sense of strategic urgency, which, given rising international tensions across Asia, amounts to a serious strategic blunder.

zh: 这些紧张局势的根源其实很清晰：朝鲜一方面对韩国延坪岛进行炮击，另一方面又明目张胆地披露自己的现代化核设施；以美国为首的舰队在南中国海和黄海横冲直撞；而中国则宣称南中国海与西藏一样，是关乎国家利益的重点区域。
en: The sources of those tensions are clear: North Korea’s shelling of South Korea’s Yeonpyeong Island and its flaunting of a modern, previously unknown, nuclear plant; the US-led armada now cruising through the South China and Yellow Sea; and China’s claim that the South China Sea is an area of vital national interest akin to Tibet.

zh: 在与印度的双边关系方面，中国的焦点从其宣称拥有主权的印度北部阿鲁纳恰尔邦（即中国藏南地区）延伸到查漠和克什米尔地区的动向也引起了广泛忧虑。
en: In its bilateral relations with India, China’s shift in focus from its claims on the Northeastern Indian state of Arunachal Pradesh to Jammu and Kashmir is enormously worrisome.

zh: 事实上，中国人民解放军已经大幅增加在该地区的军事存在。
en: Indeed, around Gilgit in Kashmir, China’s People’s Liberation Army has greatly enhanced its troop presence.

zh: 因此也不难想象：在温家宝访印前夕，中国驻新德里大使已经发现两国之间关系“非常脆弱，一触即溃，而且难以修复了 ” 。
en: Small wonder that, on the eve of Wen’s visit, China’s ambassador in New Delhi finds relations between the two countries to be “very fragile, easily damaged, and difficult to repair.”

zh: 但即便存在着如此程度的外交摩擦，温家宝依然带来了庞大的商业代表团。
en: But, despite all this diplomatic friction, Wen’s entourage for his visit is dominated by a large business delegation.

zh: 当前两国经济都在突飞猛进地发展，双方都渴望能拥有更多更大的市场。
en: Currently, both countries’ economies are thrusting confidently forward; both are thirsty for more and bigger markets.

zh: 印度的年增长率维持在9%左右，而中国则有10 % 。
en: India is growing at an annual rate of around 9%; China at around 10%.

zh: 因此两国之间的贸易机会其实极为庞大。
en: So the opportunities for trade between the two are certainly enormous.

zh: 但两国的经济增长却不是没有隐忧的。
en: But, for both countries, economic growth is not hurdle-free.

zh: 印度经济持续增长，但正面对着不断增加的通货膨胀，财政和经常账户赤字，农业发展减缓以及基础设施瓶颈。
en: India’s economy is continuing to grow, but faces rising inflation, fiscal and current-account deficits, a slowdown in agricultural growth, and infrastructure bottlenecks.

zh: 而中国的问题则是不断加剧的贫富差距，并因此爆发的前所未有的劳工骚乱 — — 虽然这不能被视为类似波兰团结工会的崛起以及共产党统治走向终结的先兆
en: China’s problems arise mainly from widening income disparities, which are inciting hitherto unheard of levels of labor unrest – though this should not be viewed as a precursor to change of the sort that marked the rise of the Solidarity trade union and the end of communism in Poland.

zh: 但劳工骚乱和维持10%增长率的意愿意味着中国应该带头解决朝鲜半岛和平问题并遏制任何有损经济发展的政治因素。
en: But labor unrest and the desire to maintain 10% growth suggest that China should be taking the lead in ensuring peace on the Korean peninsula and preventing other political developments from derailing its economy.

zh: 毕竟中国的领导人也明白只有持续的经济发展才能给政府留出足够的回旋余地，以便继续对人民币汇率进行调整。
en: After all, as the Chinese leadership knows, only continued strong growth will provide the government with the wriggle room it needs to begin to revalue the renminbi.

zh: 人民币的重新估值是非常有必要的，这在某种程度上是因为人为压低的人民币汇率已经成为亚洲地区的另一个冲突因素，许多国家如今都认为���国将其货币当作一个“政策武器”来东征西讨。
en: Revaluation of its currency is necessary in part because the undervalued renminbi has become yet another a source of friction in Asia, as many in the region now believe the Chinese are using their currency as a “policy weapon.”

zh: 而解开这团缠绕着人民币币值的乱麻则需要更加稳定的地区局势，而不是反其道而行之。
en: To untangle the complex policy web surrounding the renminbi’s value will demand greater regional stability, not less.

zh: 但中国目前的国家战略却似乎没有反映到这一点。
en: Yet China’s international grand strategy does not appear to reflect this.

zh: 相反，中国继续将重点放在东北亚、西藏，台湾和进军印度洋 — — 这条21世纪的全球贸易高速公路 — — 的野心之上。
en: Instead, it remains focused on Northeast Asia, Tibet, Taiwan, and on its aspirations to move into the Indian Ocean, that great global highway of trade in the twenty-first century.

zh: 中国领导人明白自己的国家需要时间，空间和和平来发展经济。
en: China’s leaders recognize that their country needs time, space, and peace for economic development.

zh: 但他们寻求主宰印度洋沿岸某些战略要点的举动却与发展经济的目标背道而驰，因为此举不但会导致与印度关系紧张，还牵动了亚洲其他势力和美国的神经。
en: Yet their pursuit of a dominant position on the strategic chokepoints in the Indian Ocean undermines these goals by raising tensions not only with India, but with Asia’s other powers and the US.

zh: 中国遏制印度的战略尤其是错误的，因为中国的核心利益（西藏，台湾和中国大陆中部地区）根本就不在印度大多数军事力量的打击范围之内。
en: Their focus on inhibiting India seems particularly misguided, given that China’s core interests (Tibet, Taiwan, and the heartland of the Chinese mainland) are far beyond the reach of most of India’s military capabilities.

zh: 与此相反，印度最重要的国家安全利益 — — 两国之间的边界争议，以及北京当局与巴基斯坦（经常以中国代理人的面目出现）的暧昧关系 — — 都与中国紧密相关：这两大因素都与中国对印度喜马拉雅地区的潜在威胁以及在该区域大肆建设的战略基础设施直接相关。
en: By contrast, India’s most important national security concerns – the unsettled border between the two countries, and Beijing’s ties with Pakistan, which often operates as a Chinese surrogate – are closely connected to China: Both factors are directly linked to China’s perceived threat to India’s Himalayan territory and its rapid development of strategic infrastructure in that region.

zh: 印度同时也密切关注着中国对巴基斯坦源源不断的武器供应，其中就包括了导弹和核武器技术。
en: India’s concerns also focus on China’s ongoing supply of arms, including missiles and nuclear weapons technology, to Pakistan.

zh: 再多的贸易会谈也无法回避中印两国之间的上述重大事务。
en: No amount of discussion over trade can obscure the true issues of vital concern between China and India.

zh: 中国可能依旧满足于讨论非核心议题，因为这意味着可以和印度展开一般层面的合作。
en: China may take comfort in remaining focused on non-core issues, because such an approach suggests tactical cooperation with India.

zh: 这是个外交上的便宜之策，但却未能彻底根除两国之间摩擦冲突的源头。
en: That is a convenient international ploy, but it leaves the sources of bilateral discord unattended.

zh: 这种只在对中国有利的领域进行合作，却忽视印度实质利益的理念是无法持久的，甚至在短期之内都不行。
en: The idea of collaboration only in areas of interest to China while neglecting issues of substance to India is untenable, even in the short term.

zh: 事实上，对核心冲突的忽视就是导致两国关系“极端脆弱”的原因。
en: Indeed, neglect of the core disputes is what has resulted in the relationship’s “extreme fragility.”

zh: 须知印度不可能为了实现贸易平衡而放弃其领土主权或者边境安全。
en: India cannot and will not abandon its territorial sovereignty, or its pursuit of secure land borders or a greater balance in trade.

zh: 所有这些挑战都亟需中国去认真面对，而不靠那套外交辞令来虚与委蛇。
en: These are challenges that cry out for clarity, not diplomatic fudges.

zh: 但我敢肯定的是，两大文明古国必能共同找到一条符合孔子“温、良、恭、俭、让”理念的道路。
en: But surely two great and ancient civilizations can find their way to the type of “cordial, frank, courteous, temperate, deferential…” relations that would have pleased Confucius.

zh: 亚洲巨人的海上碰撞？
en: Asia’s Giants Colliding at Sea?

zh: 新德里 — — 即使是消息能在一日之间就能传遍全球的时代，一些重要事件还是得等到过去很久才会展现在人们眼前。
en: NEW DELHI – Even in an age of 24-hour globalized news, some important events only come to light well after the fact.

zh: 几个月前在南中国海就发生过一次这样的事件，可能决定未来数年全世界人口最多的两个国家 — — 中国和印度 — — 的关系走向。
en: Something of this sort happened several months ago in the South China Sea – and may shape how relations between the world’s two most populous countries, China and India, develop in the years ahead.

zh: 7月末，一艘印度海军船只沿着被认为是国际水道的航线对越南进行了友好访问，但被公开电台“问候 ” ， 并被建议“离开”南中国海。
en: While returning in late July from a goodwill visit to Vietnam in waters recognized as international, an Indian naval ship was “hailed” on open radio and advised to “lay off” the South China Sea.

zh: 尽管中国及其近邻 — — 特别是越南、日本和菲律宾 — — 发生海事争端并不罕见，但将印度卷入其中还是第一回。
en: Although naval incidents between China and its near neighbors – particularly Vietnam, Japan, and the Philippines – are not unusual, this is the first one to involve India.

zh: 中国为何要干涉在公海航行的船只？
en: Why did China attempt to interfere with a ship sailing in open seas?

zh: 中国“仅仅”是在宣告其对南中国海再一次莫须有的主张，还是另有不可告人的目的？
en: Was this “merely” another of China’s unwarranted assertions of sovereignty over the whole South China Sea, or was something more malevolent afoot?

zh: 中国外交部发言人解释说 ： “ 我（们）反对任何在中国管制水域内进行油气勘探和开发的行为。
en: At China’s Foreign Ministry, a spokesperson explained: “[W]e are opposed to any country engaging in oil and gas exploration and development activities in waters under China’s jurisdiction.”

zh: ”接着他又顺带加了一句 ： “ 对于此区域之外的国家，我们希望 … … 尊重和支持此区域之内的国家 ” “ 通过双边渠道解决纠纷”的努力。
en: Then, in passing, he added that “countries outside the region, we hope…will respect and support countries in the region” in their efforts “to solve…dispute[s] through bilateral channels.”

zh: 印度政府立刻予以回应 ： “ 我们与越南或其他任何国家的合作一向遵循国际法律、规范和传统 ， ” 并宣称“与越南在能源领域的合作是十分重要的。
en: India’s government responded promptly: “Our cooperation with Vietnam or any other country is always as per international laws, norms, and conventions,” it declared, stating that “cooperation with Vietnam in the area of energy is very important.”

zh: ”事实上，印度公司在越南已有了大量投资，并在寻求进一步扩张经营范围。
en: Indeed, Indian companies already have invested heavily there, and are seeking to expand their operations.

zh: 尽管印度的态度已经表达得非常明显了，但仍有人抱有疑虑。
en: Although India’s statement is explicit enough, doubts persist.

zh: 中印两国的争论仅仅是关于谁来开发南中国海无尽的能源资源吗？ 还是说，我们已经开始了势力范围的争夺？
en: Is the two countries’ argument merely about who will develop the South China Sea’s untapped energy resources, or are we dealing with the beginning of a struggle for spheres of influence?

zh: 为了找到这个答案，需要对比两国的文明范式，这体现于两国所喜欢的博弈游戏。
en: To find an answer requires confronting civilizational norms, which are reflected in the intellectual games that the countries favor.

zh: 传统上，印度喜欢查帕德（chaupad，四人博弈游戏）和沙特兰伊（shatranj，国际象棋 ） ， 这些游戏的核心是竞争、征服和镇压。
en: India has traditionally favored the game of chaupad (four sides), or shatranj (chess), concentrating on contest, conquest, and subjugation.

zh: 而中国人所喜爱的围棋以战略包围为核心。
en: China, on the other hand, has wei qi (known in Japan as go), which focuses on strategic encirclement.

zh: 正如孙子在2 000年前所说的 ： “ 百战百胜，非善之善者也；不战而屈人之兵，善之善者也。 ”
en: As Sun Tzu advised many centuries ago, “Ultimate excellence lies…not in winning every battle, but in defeating the enemy, without ever fighting.”

zh: 最新的美国国防部文件《中国的军事和安全发展：2011年》指出 ， “ 受中国的‘近海’政策严重干扰的不仅有印度，还包括日本、澳大利亚、美国和东盟国家。
en: A recent US Defense Department paper, “China’s Military and Security Developments – 2011,” argued that “China’s ‘near sea’ politics has seriously disturbed not only India, but Japan, Australia, the US, and the ASEAN countries.”

zh: ”中国国防部则回应说“中国和印度不是敌人，也不互相反对，而是邻居和伙伴。 ”
en: In response, China’s Defense Ministry proclaimed that “China and India are not enemies, not opponents, but neighbors and partners.”

zh: 那么事实又是怎样？
en: So where do things stand?

zh: 显然，印度与越南在油气开发方面有着多年的合作，并不准备默许中国对南中国海的主张。
en: It is clear that India, given its years of cooperation with Vietnam on oil and gas development, is not about to acquiesce in China’s claim to the South China Sea.

zh: 此外，随着能源开采的开展，印度和越南已将签署新的谅解备忘录提上日程并将于今年晚些时候完成。
en: Moreover, as energy extraction begins, a new memorandum of understanding between India and Vietnam is scheduled to be signed later this year.

zh: 中国很可能因此指责印度侵入了它的领海。
en: China was most likely reacting to these developments by accusing India of violating its territorial waters.

zh: 印度则感到，争夺地区领导权的斗争越来越迫在眉睫。
en: For India, the sense that a struggle for regional mastery is occurring has become increasingly keen.

zh: 中国在巴基斯坦和缅甸的行动、中国在印度洋的港口协议的扩张（所谓的“珍珠链”战略 ） ， 以及中国在印度洋令人瞩目的海军行动极大地触动了印度的安全神经。
en: Chinese activity in Pakistan and Myanmar, the expansion of China’s port agreements in the Indian Ocean (the so-called “string of pearls”), and heightened Chinese naval activity in the Indian Ocean have jangled India’s security antennas.

zh: 事实上，中国官方报纸《环球时报》最近改变了一贯立场，提出阻止印度在南中国海地区的能源计划 ： “ 首先当然是讲道理，但如果印度一意孤行，中国应该动用一切可能的办法阻止 … … 这一幕发生。
en: Indeed, the official Chinese publication Global Times, altering its previous stance, recently called for putting a stop to India’s energy plans in the region. “Reasoning may be used first, but if India is persistent in this, China should try every means possible to stop this…from happening.”

zh: 该文随后又提到了西藏问题 ： “ 中国社会无不对印度干预达赖问题义愤填膺 ， ” 并提醒印度“注意其在南中国海的行径正在挑战中国的底线。
en: The same article then threw Tibet into the stew of accusations. “Chinese society,” it continued, “has…been indignant about India’s intervention in the Dalai [Lama] problem,” cautioning India to “bear in mind” that “its actions in the South China Sea will push China to the limit.”

zh: ” 《 环球时报》指出 ， “ 中国珍视中印友好，但这并不意味着中国将中印关系置于最高地位。 ”
en: According to Global Times, “China cherishes the Sino-Indian friendship, but this does not mean China values it above all else.”

zh: 还有口气更大、更令人不安的说法，显然与中国官方的和谐论背道而驰 ： “ 我们不能让世界产生中国只关注经济发展的印象，也不能追求‘和平大国’的名声，这样做对我们来说成本太大了。 ”
en: There was a more broader, more ominous message as well, one that belies China’s official rhetoric of harmony: “We should not leave the world with the impression that China is only focused on economic development, nor should we pursue the reputation” of being a “peaceful power, which would cost us dearly.”

zh: 印度必须面对的就是这一亨利·基辛格所谓的“必胜信念”外交政策。
