en: It is this “triumphalist” foreign policy, as Henry Kissinger calls it, with which India has to contend.

zh: 基辛格在其近著《论中国 》 （ On China）中写道“中国对世界秩序的看法”与西方的“外交均势”不同，这主要是因为中国“从未”在“国家主权平等”的基础上“与他国建立持久关系 ” 。
en: The “Chinese approach to world order,” writes Kissinger in his new book On China, is dissimilar to the Western system of “balance of power diplomacy,” primarily because China has “never engaged in sustained contact with another….” on the basis of the concept of the “sovereign equality of nations.”

zh: 作为中国通，基辛格指出 ： “ 中华帝国应该在世界诸邦中卓尔不群这一观念被视为自然规律，是上天的安排（Mandate of Heaven ） 。 ”
en: As Kissinger, a committed Sinophile, points out: “That the Chinese Empire should tower over its geographical sphere was taken virtually as a law of nature, an expression of the Mandate of Heaven.”

zh: 或许印度和其他国家可以借鉴孙子兵法来对抗中国的独断 ： “ 让敌人的周围形势对敌人不利，从而战胜敌人。
en: Perhaps India and others should contend with China’s assertiveness by heeding Sun Tzu’s counsel: “Contain an adversary through the leverage of converting the neighborhood of that adversary into hostiles.”

zh: ”印度是在效仿中国栽培巴基斯坦，将与越南越走越近作为其在亚洲战略棋盘上与中国争锋相对的一招吗？
en: Just as China has cultivated Pakistan, is India’s growing embrace of Vietnam a counter-move on Asia’s strategic chessboard?

zh: 也许是吧。
en: Perhaps.

zh: 毕竟，正如印度承认中国在西藏和台湾问题上的核心利益一样，中国也必须承认印度的国家利益。
en: After all, just as India recognizes China’s vital interests in Tibet and Taiwan, there must be reciprocal recognition of India’s national interests.

zh: 中国必须充分认识到，任何将印度进行战略包围的举动都会遭到反击。
en: China must fully accept that any effort at strategic encirclement of India will be countered.

zh: 这是印度国家安全的需要。
en: That is an Indian national-security imperative.

zh: 同样，克制和共同合作也是印度 — — 以及中国 — — 国家安全的需要。
en: So is restraint and mutual cooperation – as is true for China as well.

zh: 亚洲新轴心
en: Asia’s Next Axis

zh: 发自首尔 — — 中日韩三国领导人已经在上个月达成共识，同意在今年晚些时候启动与一项三边自由贸易有关的协议。
en: SEOUL – Last month, the leaders of China, Japan, and South Korea agreed to begin negotiations later this year on a trilateral free-trade agreement.

zh: 一旦该谈判取得成功，全球贸易版图都将被改写。
en: If the talks succeed, the global trade map will need to be redrawn.

zh: 这项包含世界第二大，第三大和第十二大经济体（以2011年购买力平价计算 ） ， 覆盖15亿人口的自由贸易协议将使欧盟以及涵盖美国，加拿大和墨西哥的北美自由贸易区相形见拙。
en: An FTA that encompasses, respectively, the world’s second, third, and 12th biggest economies (in purchasing power parity terms in 2011), with a population of 1.5 billion, would dwarf the European Union and the North American Free Trade Agreement, comprising the United States, Canada, and Mexico.

zh: 事实上，东北亚将成为继欧盟和北美自贸区之后全球区域经济整合的第三个主要轴心。
en: Indeed, Northeast Asia would become the third major axis of regional economic integration, following the EU and NAFTA.

zh: 但迄今为止，该区域都未能实现像欧洲和北美那样强大的制度化经济合作。
en: Until now, the region has been unable to institutionalize economic cooperation as vigorously as Europe and North America have.

zh: 如果上个月在北京讨论的方案能够实现的话，因此产生的自贸协议将在整合程度以及对世界经济的重要性方面超越北美自贸协议。
en: But if the proposals discussed in Beijing last month are realized, the resulting FTA could surpass NAFTA in its degree of integration and importance to the world economy.

zh: 此外，中日韩自贸协议将很可能引发一个连锁反应。
en: In addition, the formation of a China-Japan-South Korea FTA would most likely trigger a chain-reaction.

zh: 例如这股势头可能会向南发展并刺激与三国都分别签订有自贸协议的东南亚联盟加入这个更大的自贸协议。
en: For example, the momentum could expand southward and stimulate ASEAN, which has bilateral FTAs with all three countries, to join the group.

zh: 而这样的事件将等同于建立一个东亚自由贸易区 — — 正如“东盟+3”会议在十年前设想的那样。
en: Such a turn of events would be equivalent to establishing the East Asia Free Trade Area, which the ASEAN+3 envisioned about a decade ago.

zh: 如能实现这一点，其他国家 — — 澳大利亚，新西兰，以及最重要的：印度 — — 都会尝试投入这股大潮之中。
en: If that happened, other countries – Australia, New Zealand, and, most importantly, India – might seek to jump on the bandwagon.

zh: 当然，美国也需要对任何三边东北亚自贸协议的实现做出回应，以维护自身在全球贸易 — — 以及主宰亚洲经济的供应链中的角色。
en: The US would, of course, need to respond to the conclusion of any trilateral Northeast Asian FTA in order to preserve its own role in global trade – and in the supply chains that dominate the Asian economies.

zh: 该国很可能会试图扩大和深化目前尚处于襁褓之中的《跨太平洋伙伴关系协议 》 （ Trans-Pacific Partnership ） — —总统奥巴马去年已经开始将美国导入其中。
en: It would likely seek to expand and deepen the infant Trans-Pacific Partnership, the trade agreement that President Barack Obama committed the US to last year.

zh: 美国尤其会大力鼓励日本加入这一伙伴关系协议，因为前者希望构建一个联合的亚太经济体，而不是在亚洲和太平洋之间各自为政。
en: In particular, the US would strongly encourage Japan to join the TPP, because the US might want a united Asia-Pacific economic community, rather than a division between Asia and the Pacific.

zh: 而日本出于战略原因不会希望与美国断绝关系，它可能确实会接受美国的邀请。
en: Because Japan would not want to be disconnected from the US for strategic reasons, it might indeed accept America’s invitation.

zh: 在这个情况下，日韩两国都必须寻找一些方法来把以中国为中心的亚洲和以美国为中心的太平洋地区连接起来。
en: In this scenario, both Japan and South Korea would have to find some means to bridge a Sino-centric Asia and a US-centered Pacific.

zh: 虽然经济规模较小，但韩国似乎比日本更有准备去承担这一关键角色。
en: Despite its smaller economy, South Korea seems to be better prepared than Japan to play this critical role.

zh: 在数年的艰苦谈判后，韩国已经与美国签订了自贸协议，并准备在今年与中国洽谈一份双边自由贸易协议。
en: South Korea has already concluded an FTA with the US, after years of difficult negotiations, and plans to negotiate a bilateral FTA with China this year.

zh: 因此，关键问题就是日本是否愿意，同时愿意在多大程度上承担一个类似的桥梁角色。
en: Thus, the key question is whether and how much Japan will be willing to take on a similar bridging role.

zh: 日本的积极参与可以减轻亚太地区的多极化分裂态势，并为区域整合贡献构建的动力。
en: Robust Japanese participation would mitigate Asia-Pacific polarization and contribute to building momentum for regional integration.

zh: 但日本当前面对的国内挑战是如此之艰巨，使其领导人无力在国际上扮演一个积极的角色。
en: But the magnitude of domestic challenges that Japan faces nowadays seems too great for its political leaders to play a proactive international role.

zh: 近十年来的日本历届政府都非常脆弱短命，而目前针对提高增值税的讨论将为现任政府带来另一大挑战。
en: Japan’s governments have been fragile and short-lived for close to a decade, and the current debate over raising the value-added tax could cause another change of administration.

zh: 此外，日本国内强大的农业利益集团，尤其是日本全国农业协同组合中央会（Central Union of Agricultural Cooperatives）会加强阻挠与中韩达成三边协议以及与美国构建跨太平洋伙伴关系。
en: Moreover, Japan’s powerful agricultural interest groups, especially the Central Union of Agricultural Cooperatives, may strengthen their opposition to both a trilateral FTA with China and South Korea and the TPP with the US.

zh: 但日本领导人也受到了来自两个方面的压力。
en: But Japan’s leaders are being squeezed from both directions.

zh: 如果坐视韩国继续签定自贸协议，那日本就将丢掉美国和中国的市场。
en: If they do nothing while South Korea continues to conclude FTAs, Japan will lose markets in the US and China.

zh: 一旦有所行动，国内反对派又会把他们赶下台。
en: But if they act, domestic political opposition would likely be so severe as to drive them from power.

zh: 这就是为何日本首相野田佳彦最近为三边自贸协议鼓与呼，却难以达成该方案的主要原因。
en: This is the main reason why it will be difficult for Japan to conclude the proposed trilateral FTA, despite Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda’s recent endorsement of it.

zh: 事实上，只有一个不包含各国敏感经济部门的松散自贸协议才似乎是可行的。
en: Indeed, only a looser FTA that would exclude each country’s sensitive economic sectors appears to be viable.

zh: 对中国来说，政治考虑似乎是寻求达成东北亚自贸协议背后最强的动机。
en: For China, political considerations seem to be the strongest motivation for pursuing a Northeast Asian FTA.

zh: 但利用这个三边自贸协议来扩大其经济和政治影响力将需要中国增加其政治透明度，开放服务领域并撤销非关税壁垒。
en: But using the trilateral FTA to expand its economic and political influence would require China to increase transparency, open its service sector, and remove non-tariff barriers.

zh: 从根本上来说，它必须采用一个以规则为基础的机制来处理与两个邻国的关系，而也是中国政府对此患得患失的原因。
en: In essence, it would have to accept a rules-based system for its relations with its two neighbors, something of which China’s government has been wary.

zh: 但中国在实现自贸协议战略方面有一个优势，它依然是一个专制国家，因此也能比日韩政府更轻易地压制国内的反对声音。
en: One advantage for China, however, in pursuing an FTA strategy is that it is still an authoritarian state, and thus could overrule domestic opposition far more easily than could governments in Japan or South Korea.

zh: 最后，韩国这个几乎和全球所有重要经济参与者 — — 美国、欧盟、东盟，印度等各方 — — 都签订了自贸协定的国家，也比日本更好地做好了达成三方自贸协议的准备。
en: Finally, South Korea, which has concluded FTAs with almost every important economic actor in the world – the US, the EU, ASEAN, India, and others – may be better prepared to conclude a trilateral FTA than Japan.

zh: 但它也必须面对来自国内农业利益集团的强硬反抗，而且后者为此动员的力量可能要比当年反对与美国签订自贸协定时更强大。
en: But it, too, will have to face strong opposition from domestic agricultural interest groups and manufacturing sectors, which might mobilize even more strongly than they did in opposing the FTA with the US.

zh: 如果东北亚三边自贸协议能达成的话，中日韩三国就可以在西方需求疲软的情况下创造更多的国内市场需求。
en: If a trilateral Northeast Asian FTA can be concluded, the three countries would be able to generate more market demand domestically at a time of weak demand from the West, and would gain greater influence in the global political economy.

zh: 这一三方自贸协议也有助于稳定三国互相之间麻烦不断的政治关系，并为朝鲜最终的经济结构调整提供一个更优质的环境。
en: A trilateral FTA would also most likely contribute to stabilizing the three countries’ troublesome political relations with each other, and could provide a better environment for North Korea’s eventual economic reconstruction.

zh: 东北亚自贸协议的巨大好处是显而易见的。
en: The myriad benefits of a Northeast Asian FTA are clear.

zh: 问题在于，这是否有点太过好高骛远了？
en: The question is whether it is an ambition too far.

zh: 被忽略的亚洲强国
en: Asia’s Overlooked Great Power

zh: 谈及亚洲，大多数人认为这一地区令人神往，中国或印度这样的大国正在这里崛起。
en: Mention Asia, and most people think of the region’s fascinating, rising giants, China or India – or both.

zh: 也可能有人会想到朝鲜的核计划、一些恐怖事件，或者最近的地震、海啸带来的人道主义后果。
en: Or people think about North Korea’s nuclear program, some terrorist incident, or the humanitarian consequences of the latest earthquake or tsunami.

zh: 但人们往往忽视了日本，或至少是低估了日本。
en: But often overlooked – or at least underestimated – is Japan.

zh: 考虑到日本依然是世界第二大经济强国，GDP达到50,000亿美元，比中国和印度加起来还要多，忽视或低估日本就令人奇怪了。
en: This is odd, given that Japan is still the world’s second largest economy, with a GDP of $5 trillion – more than China and India combined.

zh: 尽管日本经济增长比率相对不高，但其人均GDP大约是3.8万美元，是中国或印度的十倍以上。
en: Despite Japan’s relatively modest rate of economic growth, its GDP per capita is roughly $38,000, more than ten times that of either China or India.

zh: 另外，日本在一些重要问题上争论非常激烈，这就意味着经济和安全领域可能会发生变化。
en: Moreover, there are important stirrings in Japan that suggest change on both the economic and security fronts.

zh: 二十世纪九十年代可能是迷失的十年，但日本的经济已开始复苏，现在以每年2%以上的速度增长，日本出现了若干真正意义上的全球化企业，这些企业全都获得了巨大成功。
en: The 1990’s may have been a lost decade, but Japan’s economy has begun to recover, now growing at more than 2% a year and boasting several firms that are truly global and hugely successful.

zh: 对外政策和国防政策的变化更为显著。
en: Changes in foreign and defense policy are more considerable.

zh: 日本自卫队于今年1月升级为一个完整的部门。
en: Japan’s self-defense agency was upgraded in January to a full ministry.

zh: 如今，日本每年的国防开销在400亿美元以上，并且依然是世界上兵种最多、装备最现代化的国家之一。
en: Japan now spends more than $40 billion a year on defense and maintains one of the world’s most diverse and modern militaries.

zh: 将近1,000名日本军人驻扎在伊拉克及其周边地区。
en: Approximately 1,000 Japanese forces serve in and around Iraq.

zh: 知识分子、记者和政治家都热衷于谈论日本在世界上的作用或撰写相关文章，如果倒退十年，很难想象日本的作用会有这么大。
en: Intellectuals, journalists, and politicians are now saying and writing things about Japan’s role in the world that were unthinkable a decade ago.

zh: 现在的问题不是日本是否需要修改宪法第9条，而是何时加以修改，在第九条的限制下，日本军队只能发挥自卫作用。
en: It is a question of when, not if, the Japanese amend Article IX of their constitution, which limits the role of Japan’s armed forces to self-defense.

zh: 并非每个人都对这些变化表示欢迎。
en: Not everyone will welcome these changes.

zh: 日本的邻国依然为第二次世界大战和日本不能正确对待历史问题而深感忧虑，日本民族主义的兴起令他们感到焦虑不安。
en: Japan’s neighbors, who continue to harbor concerns stemming from World War II and Japan’s failure to deal adequately with its history, will worry about Japanese nationalism.

zh: 然而，日本主动性的增强，能力的发展，再加上健全的民主和蓬勃的经济，对其邻国倒是大有裨益。
en: Nevertheless, a more active and more capable Japan, with a robust democracy and a thriving economy, is in its neighbors’ best interests.

zh: 危险的不是日本军国主义的复兴，而是日本不能或不愿为迎接亚洲所面临的地区和全球性挑战而承担起自己的责任。
en: The danger is not renewed Japanese militarism, but rather a Japan that is unable and unwilling to do its share to meet the regional and global challenges facing Asia.

zh: 日本自身需要继续推进经济改革和开放，提高军事能力，使军队能够承担强度小但人员密集的军事任务，这样的任务从预防种族屠杀、建设国家到维持和平，这些需求在泛中东和非洲地区正变得越来越迫切。
en: Japan, for its part, needs to continue to open and reform its economy, improve its military, and make its forces available for the sort of low-intensity but manpower-intensive missions, ranging from genocide prevention to nation-building to peacekeeping, that are increasingly required in the greater Middle East and Africa.

zh: 日本领导人还需要在采取行动时更加关注外界的反应。
en: Japanese leaders also need to act with sensitivity.

zh: 首相安倍晋三上任之初实行的政策很不均衡。
en: Prime Minister Shinzo Abe is off to an uneven start.

zh: 一方面，他做出了不去参拜为纪念数百万日本阵亡人员而修建的靖国神社的明智决定，因为敬国神社里供奉着14名甲级战犯。
en: On one hand, he is wise not to have visited the Yasukuni shrine, which honors millions of Japan’s war dead, including 14 Class A war criminals.

zh: 而另一方面，安倍却公开否认日本曾强迫中国和朝鲜妇女充当“慰安妇 ” ， 这样的做法往好里说是愚蠢，往差里说是对外界的反应漠不关心。
en: On the other hand, Abe’s public statements denying Japan���s coercion of “comfort women” in China and Korea have been clumsy at best, insensitive at worst.

zh: 至关重要的是，日本和中国建立了现代关系。
en: It is essential that Japan and China forge a modern relationship.

zh: 日益频繁的高层互访—安倍首相十月份访华，中国总理温家宝刚刚访问日本—显示出可喜的发展势头。
en: The increasing frequency of high-level visits – Prime Minister Abe went to China in October, and Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao was just in Japan – is a welcome development.

zh: 但还需要做更多工作。
en: But more is needed.

zh: 两国可以也应当扩大贸易和投资，这只有在政治关系改善的情况下才能实现。
en: Trade and investment flows can and should be expanded, which is likely only if political relations improve.

zh: 两国应致力于通过外交手段解决对近海资源控制权要求相互冲突的问题。
en: Both countries should commit themselves to a diplomatic resolution of competing claims to offshore resources.

zh: 军事、教育和旅游等各个领域的交流也应该得到促进。
en: Exchanges of every kind – military, educational, touristic – should be facilitated.

zh: 世界还要考虑到日本的重要性。
en: The world also needs to take into account Japan’s importance.

zh: 日本不应该再由于六十多年以前的事件而受到不公正的对待。
en: Japan should no longer be denied fair treatment because of events more than 60 years ago.

zh: 不允许日本在联合国安全理事会获得常任理事国席位是没有道理的。
en: There is no reason Japan should not hold a permanent seat in the United Nations Security Council.

zh: 日本还应全面参与亚洲的地区活动。
en: Japan should also be a full participant in Asian regional arrangements.

zh: 亚洲富于变化和活力，但相对欧洲而言，其政治、经济和安全机构的影响都比较薄弱；亚洲机构往往缺乏活力，而且复杂繁琐。
en: Asia is rich in dynamism, but relatively thin in influential political, economic, and security-related institutions, in contrast to Europe, which often lacks dynamism but is institution-heavy.

zh: 法德关系一直是二十世纪冲突中最重要的事件，如今也依然是现代欧洲关系的核心。
en: The Franco-German relationship, central to much twentieth-century conflict, now forms the core of modern Europe.

zh: 中国和日本也应该朝着这样的目标努力。
en: The goal should be the same for China and Japan.

zh: 实际上有无数的问题需要探讨，包括贸易和投资、能源和气候变化以及安全领域的信心建设。
en: The agenda is virtually limitless, including trade and investment, energy and climate change, and confidence-building in the security sphere.

zh: 新的地区机构既可以以现有机构为基础（如处理朝鲜核问题的六方会谈 ） ， 也可以白手起家，重新建设。
en: A new regional institution could be based on an existing one (such as the six-party arrangement used to manage North Korea’s nuclear challenge) or start afresh.

zh: 另外，就像继续在欧洲发挥重要作用一样，美国也可以成为亚洲稳定的保障者和地区繁荣的源泉。
en: Moreover, just as the United States continues to play a major role in Europe, so, too, should it act as a guarantor of Asia’s stability and a source of regional prosperity.

zh: 美日联盟是美国在亚洲的地位中最为核心的部分。
en: The US-Japan alliance is central to America’s position in Asia.

zh: 美日联盟的目的不是使日本加入反华联盟，而是加深美日合作的深度和广度。
en: The goal is not to enlist Japan in any anti-Chinese coalition, but rather to increase the depth and breadth of US-Japanese cooperation.

zh: 考虑到朝鲜的导弹和核计划、恐怖主义以及威胁世界稳定的诸多挑战，两国都有太多的理由来实现这一目标。
en: Both countries have many reasons to pursue this goal, considering North Korea’s missile and nuclear programs, terrorism, and the numerous challenges to stability around the world.

zh: 安倍四月底对华盛顿的访问是继续使形成于地缘政治时代的关系现代化的机遇。
en: Abe’s visit to Washington in late April is an opportunity to continue to modernize a relationship conceived in an earlier geopolitical era.

zh: 希望此次访问不会在国会要求日本为慰安妇问题道歉的呼声中变得黯然失色。
en: It is to be hoped that it will not be overshadowed by calls in Congress for Japan to apologize more formally than it already has for the comfort women.

zh: 相反，我们应该把重点放在未来，欢迎一个日益能够并愿意在应对地区和全球挑战中充当美国合作伙伴的日本的兴起。
en: Rather, the focus should be on the future and on welcoming the emergence of a Japan that is increasingly able and willing to act as a partner of the US in addressing regional and global challenges.

zh: 海啸后的亚洲未来
en: Asia’s Post-Tsunami Future

zh: 发生在亚洲的海啸给人类造成了巨大破坏，程度不可低估。
en: There can be no underestimating the scale of the human devastation wrought by Asia’s horrific tsunamis.

zh: 亲人离散，房屋遭毁，生灵涂炭。
en: Family members have been lost, homes destroyed, and livelihoods ruined.

zh: 正如以往所有的自然灾害一样，受难最深的还是穷苦百姓。
en: As is often the case in natural disasters, the poor are suffering the most.

zh: 虽然海啸破坏了诸如马路、铁路等基础设施，但对经济的整体影响预计不大。
en: And yet, even with damage to infrastructure such as road and rail links, the tsunamis’ overall economic impact is expected to be minor.

zh: 在印度、印度尼西亚、斯里兰卡和泰国的重灾区，内陆地区未受到影响，而受影响的海滨旅游业和养殖业只占这些国家国民生产总值的一小部分，因为自由化改革增进了经济的多元化进程，推进经济快速增长。
en: In the worst hit parts of India, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, and Thailand, the immediate interior was unaffected, while the tourism and fishing industries – the lifeblood of wrecked coastal areas – account for only a tiny share of these countries’ GDP, as liberalizing reforms have fueled economic diversification and rapid growth.

zh: 情况并非一直如此。
en: It was not always this way.

zh: 一直以来，尽管亚洲人常常是游戏的输家，但要说服亚洲人使他们明白国际贸易不是零和游戏却是件很困难的事情。
en: Historically, it has been difficult to convince Asians that international trade is not a zero-sum-game, with Asia invariably the losers.

zh: 这也解释了为何自毛泽东带领下的共产党1949年建国以来以及其他亚洲国家独立以后，大多数亚洲国家都采取了带有保护主义色彩的内需导向型经济政策，一心增强国力，排挤帝国主义，坚持自力更生。
en: This is one reason why, after Mao Zedong’s communists triumphed in China in 1949 and other Asian nations gained independence, most Asian countries adopted protectionist inward-looking economic policies aimed at building domestic strength, keeping the “imperialists” out, and achieving self-reliance.

zh: 但是历史事实引发了这个疑问。
en: Historical experience incites this suspicion.

zh: 1820年，也就是鸦片战争爆发前的20年，亚洲占全球国民生产总值的60 % ， 其中中国占了一半以上。
en: In 1820, Asia’s share of global GDP was 60%, with China accounting for slightly more than half. That was two decades before the first Opium War.

zh: 在随后的150年里，国际贸易兴起，亚洲的经济主导地位逐渐衰退。
en: With the emergence of truly global world trade over the ensuing century and a half, Asia’s economic dominance withered.

zh: 到1950年底，中国占世界国民生产总值的份额已经降到了5%以下，全亚洲也不过18 % ， 其中大部分还要归功于二战的战败国日本。
en: By 1950, China’s share of world GDP had fallen to under 5%, while all of Asia accounted for just 18%, the biggest chunk of which was attributable to Japan, despite its defeat in WWII.

zh: 约20年前，全球改革之风开始席卷亚洲，起于东亚，后至中国，并在20世纪90年代时登陆南亚，对印度影响尤为巨大。
en: The winds of global change began sweeping through Asia roughly two decades ago, first in East Asia, then engulfing China, and in the course of the 1990’s blowing on to South Asia, most importantly India.

zh: 我们所见证的不是崛起中的亚洲，而是这一占全人类人口60%的大陆的伟大复兴。
en: What we are witnessing is thus not “emerging” Asia, but the “re-emergence” of a continent that comprises 60% of humanity.

zh: 这块大陆上的两个巨人 — — 印度和中国，正如印度作家Ashutosh Sheshabalaya近日所说的那样“注定要回到他们在19世纪时的模样，占领世界经济出口的一半以上 ” 。
en: Its two giants, India and China, are especially determined, as Indian author Ashutosh Sheshabalaya recently put it, “to return to their nineteenth-century status, when they accounted for well over half of world economic output.”

zh: 为此，中国和印度正谋求对全球经济施加更大影响。
en: One result of this is that China and India are seeking to make a bigger impact on global economic policy.

zh: 这两个国家都是1948年关贸总协定的签署国（现在世界贸易组织的前身 ） ， 但是后来毛泽东的领导下的中国退出了协定。
en: Both countries were signatories of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT, the precursor to today’s World Trade Organization) in 1948, but China under Mao subsequently left.

zh: 尽管印度仍是关贸总协定的成员，但是常常扮演反叛角色。
en: Although India remained a member, it was often a recalcitrant one.

zh: 目前，亚洲占全球国民生产总值38 % ， 与它在1820年的份额相比，相差甚远。 但两个国家都觉得他们能够，而且必须参与到主导世界的行列中来。
en: Asia’s current share of global GDP (about 38%) is still far from what it was in 1820, but both countries feel that they can – and must – participate in calling the global shots.

zh: 中国政府花了漫长的16年进行谈判，申请重新加入世贸组织，而且很快与巴西、印度和南非一起领导20国集团，足见其决心勇气。 20国集团主要由充满活力的发展中国家组成，在2003年9月坎昆举行的世贸组织部长级会议上，他们向工业化强国提出挑战。
en: It took China’s government a protracted sixteen years to negotiate its re-entry into the GATT/WTO, but it soon showed its mettle by assuming joint leadership (along with Brazil, India, and South Africa) of the G-20, a group of primarily dynamic developing countries that threw down the gauntlet to the industrialized powers at the Cancún WTO ministerial meeting in September 2003.

zh: 因此，亚洲正在向我们走来：亚洲市场、亚洲国家、亚洲消费者、亚洲金融家（比如，亚洲中央银行负责为美国巨额预算赤字筹集资金 ） 、 亚洲科学家、亚洲工程师和亚洲公司。
en: So the Asians are coming: as markets, as states, as consumers, as financiers (Asian central banks, for example, are responsible for financing America’s whopping budget deficits), as scientists and engineers, and as corporations.

zh: 西方国家准备好了吗？
en: Is the West ready?

zh: 在《金融时报》2004年7月刊登的一篇文章中，英国渣打银行首席执行官 Mervyn Davies写道“西方社会开始认识到亚洲公司的野心如何巨大 ” 。
en: In an article in the Financial Times in July 2004, Standard Chartered CEO Mervyn Davies wrote, “westerners are realizing how big Asia’s corporate ambitions are.”

zh: 然而，在意识到可能的变化和做出相应的调整这两者之间还有很大的差别。
en: There is, however, a large difference between recognizing that change may be coming and making the necessary adjustments.

zh: 19世纪西方社会的崛起对亚洲大多数国家的经济而言是一个灾难。 相反，如今亚洲的复兴却能够给21世纪全球经济带来巨大的积极影响。
en: In contrast to the emergence of the West in the nineteenth century, which proved such an economic disaster for most of Asia, the continent’s re-emergence can have an immensely positive effect on the twenty-first century’s global economy, including, needless to say, the West.

zh: 毋庸置疑，西方社会也是受惠者之一。 但是这需要细致的准备、调整和管理。
en: But this requires careful preparation, adjustment and management.

zh: 这点极为重要，尤其在持续增长的亚洲人口问题方面。 在下一个15年中，印度、巴基斯坦和孟加拉国的居住人口将从14亿增长到17.3亿,而中国人口将从13亿增长到14.2亿。
en: This is of vital importance, especially in light of the fact that Asia’s populations are still booming: India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh will see an increase in the next fifteen years from 1.4 billion to 1.73 billion inhabitants, while China’s population will grow from 1.3 billion to 1.42 billion.

zh: 难怪这些国家亟需建立一个充满活力、开放、发展和创造就业的国际环境。
en: Little wonder, then that these countries accept the imperative of a dynamic, open, growth-oriented, and job-creating global environment.

zh: 尽管到处遍吹改革之风，旧制度仍然盛行。
en: Yet despite these gales of change, institutional atavism prevails.

zh: 全球经济政策的制定仍是西方社会的游戏。
en: Global economic policy-making remains very much a Western game.

zh: 其支持者坚信中国和印度不是七国首脑集团的成员。
en: It beggars belief that China and India are not members of the G-7.

zh: 布雷顿森林机构 — — 世界货币基金组织、世界银行和世界卫生组织在结构、思想和领导方式上仍是西方化的。
en: The Bretton Woods organizations – the IMF, the World Bank and the WTO – remain heavily Western in structure, leadership, and mentality.

zh: 尤其是世贸组织，美国和比利时政府似乎更关心如何保护从前的成绩和他们各自的土地，而不是与新成员国的合作。
en: This is especially true of the WTO, where Washington and Brussels seem more concerned at settling old scores and protecting their respective turfs than in engaging with the new players.

zh: 中国将很快成为全球最大的贸易国，然而世贸组织内部仍然充满了欧洲的内向性思想。
en: China will soon be the world’s biggest trading power. Yet euroatlantic introversion still permeates the WTO.

zh: 这种思想在西方政府、工业、商学院和媒体也普遍深入人心。
en: This mindset is also pervasive in Western governments, industry, business schools, and the media.

zh: 这些机构和行业没有一个愿意看到亚洲的复兴。
en: None of these institutions in the West is ready for Asia’s re-emergence.

zh: 正如上世纪不断上演的悲剧那样，当历史开始为深远巨变做出调整时，它往往并不鼓舞人心，新的人物不断涌现，权力平衡发生转移。
en: History is not particularly encouraging when it comes to adjusting to profound changes – new actors and shifting balances of power – as the twentieth century tragically and repeatedly demonstrated.

zh: 海啸破坏了亚洲大部分的地区，给所有的重要政府、行业、学术界、媒体和文明社会提供了一个机会去重新审视亚洲，审视由亚洲复兴所带来的挑战和机遇。
en: The tsunami that so devastated much of Asia has provided an opportunity for all key players – in government, industry, academia, the media, and civil society – to look at Asia anew, at both the challenges and the opportunities that have arisen from Asia’s resurgence.

zh: 我们要迅速抓住这些机会，就向世界对待亚洲悲剧采取的行动一样。
en: These opportunities need to be seized with as much alacrity as the world has responded to Asia’s sorrow.

zh: 处在压抑下的亚洲服务业
en: Asia’s Stifled Services

zh: 马尼拉 — — 欧元区危机过去数年来一直决策者的讨论主题，但亚洲两大巨头 — — 中华人民共和国和印度的经济放缓已经日益引发公众的担忧。
en: MANILA – The eurozone crisis has dominated discussion among policymakers over the last few years, but the economic slowdown in Asia’s two giants – the People’s Republic of China (PRC) and India – has become a source of growing public concern as well.

zh: 我们该如何看待全球经济面临更多阻力？
en: How worried should we be about an additional drag on the global economy?

zh: 在历经多年两位数的GDP增长之后，中国的经济正在减速。
en: After years of double-digit GDP growth, the PRC’s economy is decelerating.

zh: 我们亚洲开发银行预计中国的增长将从2011年的9.3%放缓至今年的7.7 % 。
en: At the Asian Development Bank, we predict that its growth will slow to 7.7% this year, from 9.3% in 2011.

zh: 中国人口开始老龄化，实际工资提升，增长率也正在放缓至相对可以持续的数字。
en: The PRC’s population is aging, real wages are rising, and growth is moderating toward more sustainable rates.

zh: 印度同样具有快速增长及受益于人口红利的巨大潜质，但结构改革问题一直是其拯待解决的。
en: India, too, has massive potential to grow fast and reap a demographic dividend, but it has been struggling with structural reform.

zh: 我们预计印度经济增长将从去年的6.5%放缓到2012年的5.6 % 。
en: We expect that India’s expansion will slow to 5.6% in 2012, from 6.5% last year.

zh: 外部需求疲软部分造成了经济增长下降，但投资放缓和消费停滞不前等内生性因素也对经济扩张起到了阻碍作用。
en: Weak external demand is partly responsible for the falloff in growth, but internal factors – namely, slowing investment and stagnating consumption – are also holding back economic expansion.

zh: 在全球经济放缓的大背景下保增长是一项艰巨的任务，要完成这项任务就必需重新思考“亚洲工厂”的未来。
en: Maintaining growth in the face of a global slowdown is a daunting task, and it requires rethinking the future of “factory Asia.”

zh: 区域内制造业联系在很大程度上推动了亚洲的繁荣：来自亚洲的零部件和中间产品被组装成最终产品出口到发达国家。
en: Asia’s boom was driven largely by intraregional manufacturing linkages: intermediate goods and parts were sourced from within Asia for assembly into final goods exported to advanced economies.

zh: 但随着世界各地预算缩紧，对亚洲的出口需求预计将会持续萎缩。
en: But, with budget-tightening around the world, demand for Asia’s exports is expected to continue to falter.

zh: 既然如此，亚洲今后的增长点究竟在哪里？
en: Where, then, should Asia look for another source of growth?

zh: 升级业务处理、旅游和医疗保健等服务业或许会在该地区的未来增长中发挥关键的作用。
en: Upgrading the service sector – for example, business processing, tourism, and health care – could play a critical role in the region’s future growth.

zh: 亚洲各国的服务业已经颇具规模，为经济增长和就业做出了显著的贡献。
en: Asia’s service sector is already large, contributing significantly to growth and employment.

zh: 2010年服务业占亚洲发展中国家GDP总额的接近一半，2000至2010年间占印度经济增长的三分之二，而同期在以制造业为主的中国则占经济增长总额的43 % 。
en: Services accounted for nearly half of developing Asia’s GDP in 2010, two-thirds of India’s growth from 2000 to 2010, and 43% of growth in the manufacturing-oriented PRC in the same period.

zh: 此外，服务人员在发展中亚洲国家占就业总人数的比例超过三分之一。
en: In addition, service workers comprise more than one-third of total employment in developing Asia.

zh: 如果这些国家重走发达经济体的发展之路，工业将逐步取代农业的主导地位，而工业的主导地位最终又会被范围进一步拓宽的服务业所取代。
en: If these countries follow the same path traveled by the advanced economies, agriculture’s dominance will give way to industry, which in turn will be supplanted by services, further broadening their role.

zh: 这其中当然不乏发展空间：亚洲发展中国家的工业出产份额2010年超过了经合组织的平均水平（41%比24 % ） ，但服务业份额却依然大幅落后（48%比75 % ） 。
en: There is certainly room to grow: the share of industry in developing Asia’s output surpassed the OECD average in 2010 (41% vs. 24%), but the share of services still lags by a wide margin (48% vs. 75%).

zh: 让亚洲服务业更有活力是未来经济发展的关键。
en: Making Asia’s service sector more dynamic is essential to future growth.

zh: 但传统服务业仍然占据着行业主导，比方说餐厅、出租车和理发店。
en: But the sector is still dominated by traditional services, such as restaurants, taxis, and barbers.

zh: 包括互联网接入技术、或金融、法律和其他专业商务服务在内的现代服务业在亚洲服务经济中占比不到10 % ， 这一比例远低于发达经济体20%至25%的份额。
en: Modern services – such as Internet connectivity technology, or financial, legal, and other professional business services – account for less than 10% of Asia’s service economy, well below the 20-25% in advanced economies.

zh: 虽然传统服务业能提供就业机会，但却带不来更多收入。
en: While traditional service industries are able to provide jobs, they do not generate much income.

zh: 劳动生产率也偏低：就该地区大多数经济体而言，服务业的劳动生产率还不及经合组织平均水平的20 % 。
en: Labor productivity is also quite low: For most economies in the region, service-sector productivity is less than 20% of the OECD average.

zh: 就连工业劳动生产率达到经合组织平均水平118%的韩国，其服务业的劳动生产率却只有经合组织平均水平的43 % 。
en: Even in South Korea, labor productivity in industry is 118% of the OECD figure, but only 43% of the average for services.

zh: 充满活力的服务业可以带来广泛的经济效益。
en: A vibrant service sector could have broad economic benefits.

zh: 服务业和工业的协同效应可以实现整体生产力的提升。
en: Synergies between services and industry could improve overall productivity.

zh: 比方说，工业设计、市场营销和法律服务可以促进投资和开发新的制成品。
en: For example, industrial design, marketing, and legal services could facilitate investment and development of new manufactured products.

zh: 服务业往往能更有效地创造就业机会，其中女性尤其会成为受益者，进而实现包容性增长的效果。
en: The service sector also tends to be more effective in job creation, particularly for women, thus supporting inclusive growth.

zh: 发展服务业可以多元化产业基础，从而提高经济抵抗力并强化经济增长动能。
en: Developing the service sector could also diversify the production base, thereby enhancing economic resilience and boosting growth momentum.

zh: 现代服务业的流通性越来越强，提供了全新的出口机遇。
en: Modern services are becoming increasingly tradable, providing new export opportunities.

zh: 如印度和菲律宾就已确立了在世界业务流程外包出口领域的领先地位。
en: India and the Philippines, for example, have established themselves as world leaders in the export of outsourced business processes.

zh: 技能差距和基础设施匮乏往往被视为限制亚洲服务业活力的要素。
en: Skills gaps and a lack of infrastructure are frequently cited as factors that hinder service-sector dynamism in Asia.

zh: 但其实繁琐的法规才是最大的障碍。
en: But burdensome regulations are the biggest barrier.

zh: 保护现有企业和其他既得利益者的过度规管有损市场竞争力并限制了生产率及效率的提高。
en: Excessive regulation that protects incumbent firms and other vested interests undermines market competitiveness and limits prospects for improved productivity and efficiency.

zh: 比方说富有的律师成为法律市场的主导，教师工会控制学校，强势医生影响整个医学界，由此导致的企业成本高企也对工业发展起到了阻碍作用。
en: For example, legal markets are dominated by rich lawyers, schools are controlled by teachers’ unions, and the medical sector is influenced by powerful doctors, resulting in high business costs that also hamper industrial development.

zh: 亚洲众多服务企业的所有权归属于公共部门，因此政府并不鼓励放开服务。
en: Many service firms in Asia are owned by the public sector, so governments have less incentive to deregulate services.

zh: 但同样这些政府已经为公共利益放开了经济的制造业及农��领域，甚至不惜以牺牲工人和农民等少数群体的利益为代价。
en: But the same authorities have already opened their economies’ manufacturing and agriculture sectors for the common good, even at the expense of minority groups like farmers and factory workers.

zh: 既然如此，他们为什么还要继续执行保护主宰服务业的特殊利益团体的政策？
en: Why, then, are they maintaining policies that protect the special-interest groups that dominate the service sector?

zh: 很多人认为管制可以保护国内小企业免受国外大公司不正当竞争的困扰。
en: Many argue that regulations protect small domestic firms against undue competition from large foreign firms.

zh: 但其实即使国内竞争也正在受到管制的扼杀。
en: But the truth is that regulations are stifling even for domestic competition.

zh: 比方说在印度，有人担心几个月后沃尔玛进入市场时家庭零售业将会被彻底击垮。
en: In India, for example, there is fear that small mom-and-pop retailers will be crushed when Wal-Mart enters the market in the next few months.

zh: 但决策者必须认识到有不用扼杀竞争就能保护小型零售业的方法。
en: But policymakers must recognize that there are ways to protect small retailers without stifling competition.

zh: 比方说政府可以制定分区政策帮助小型零售业发现专门的利基市场，也可以为转岗人员开设技能培训课。
en: The government can, say, impose zoning regulations, help small retailers find specialized niches in the market, or provide skills training to displaced workers.

zh: 个体零售企业的生存不应被用作制定或坚持商业法规，最终保护现有富裕阶层的借口。
en: The survival of artisanal retailers should not be used as an excuse to introduce or uphold business regulations that ultimately protect the incumbent rich.

zh: 亚洲决策者们必需牢记他们是通过竞争成功发展了制造业。
en: Asian policymakers must remember how they successfully developed their manufacturing sector – through competition.

zh: 服务业也应该适用相同的逻辑。
en: The same logic should be applied to services.

zh: 服务业升级对亚洲而言是触手可及的果实，因为不需要巨额投资就可以达到这样的效果。
en: Upgrading the service sector is low-hanging fruit for Asia, because tremendous investments are not required.

zh: 但由于缺乏破除既得利益所必需的政治意愿，服务业改革对亚洲地区而言仍然是遥不可及的。
en: And yet service-sector reform remains just out of reach for the region, owing to the absence of the political will needed to dismantle the vested interests that keep it there.

zh: 亚洲的紧缩教训
en: Asia’s Take on Austerity

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 对紧缩政策的讨论已成为本年度达沃斯世界经济论坛的热门话题。
en: NEW HAVEN – The austerity debate was the topic du jour at this year’s World Economic Forum in Davos. With good reason.

zh: 其中缘由不言自明：这边美国的复苏才刚有一点苗头，那边欧洲又开始重新滑向衰退。 这种局面对于整个财政巩固进程来说堪称一大祸害 — — 而该进程又是欧洲最为钟爱的。
en: Europe is slipping back into recession just when recovery in the United States is finally getting some traction.  That has undermined the case for fiscal consolidation, which is so heavily favored in Europe.

zh: 但笔者却得出了一个与达沃斯不同的结论。
en: Yet I took away a different conclusion from Davos.

zh: 在本次论坛中本人负责主持一个名为“东亚新语境”的议程，期间来自泰国、韩国、马来西亚，新加坡和日本的高级代表都发表了演讲 — — 除了日本代表外的所有人都拥有应对1990年代末期灾难性亚洲金融危机的第一手经验。
en: I moderated a session on “The New Context in East Asia,” addressed by a panel of senior representatives from Thailand, South Korea, Malaysia, Singapore, and Japan. With the exception of the Japanese participant, all had first-hand experience with the devastating Asian financial crisis of the late 1990’s.

zh: 作为主持人，笔者忍不住也把他们拉进了上面那场美欧之间的辩论。
en: I couldn't resist the temptation to draw Asia into the debate between Europe and the US.

zh: 但我并没有让与会者们去推导紧缩政策将对这些过度负债的西方发达国家造成何种影响，而是询问他们在1990年代末经济危机期间和之后的经历。
en: Rather than ask the Asian panelists to theorize about the impact of austerity in the overly indebted developed West, I asked them to assess their own experiences during and after the crisis of the late 1990’s.

zh: 坦白地说，我对我所听到的一切感到吃惊。
en: Frankly, I was surprised by what I heard.

zh: 与会者都同意以下两点：首先，他们一开始都对国际货币基金组织（IMF）所谓的有条件援助条款感到厌恶，韩国人至今依然充满鄙视地将这一痛苦的调整政策称之为“IMF式危机 ” 。
en: The panelists agreed on two points: first, they initially detested the wrenching adjustment programs dictated by the terms of the International Monetary Fund’s so-called conditional bailouts (the South Koreans still refer scornfully to the “IMF crisis” of the late 1990’s).

zh: 其次 — — 也是令人惊讶的地方 — — 就是他们都同意执行这一政策，而且从事后看来，这些极为痛苦的调整也是值得的，因为深受危机重创的各国经济都被迫实施结构性改革，并为当今亚洲的突出经济表现铺平了道路。
en: Second – and here’s where the surprise came – they all agreed that, with the benefit of hindsight, these excruciating adjustments were worth it, because their crisis-torn economies were forced to embrace structural reforms that paved the way for their spectacular economic performance today.

zh: 从表面上看，数字已经说明了一切。
en: On the surface, the numbers speak for themselves.

zh: 在1998年亚洲金融危机最为水深火热的时候，所谓东盟五国（印尼、马来西亚、菲律宾，泰国和越南）的总产值下跌了8.3 % 。
en: In 1998, during the depths of the Asian crisis, aggregate output in the so-called ASEAN-5 – Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Thailand, and Vietnam – plunged by 8.3%.

zh: 而在一直被视为亚洲新工业化国家龙头的韩国，当年实质GDP萎缩了5.7 % 。
en: Real GDP in South Korea – long considered the darling of Asia’s newly industrialized economies – contracted by 5.7% that year.

zh: 也就是在那时，世界货币基金组织那些条件严苛的援助和调整项目 — — 亚洲自己的紧缩政策 — — 开始启动了。
en: But then the tough conditionality of IMF bailouts and adjustment programs – Asia’s own dose of austerity – kicked in.

zh: 而在这些项目实施之后，各国的经常账户收支 — — 所谓东亚增长奇迹的阿喀琉斯之踵 — — 随之从逆差转为顺差。
en: In response, current-account balances – the Achilles’ heel of the so-called East Asian growth miracle – went from deficit to surplus.

zh: 在东盟五国方面，1996~1997年度平均相当于GDP4%的经常账户逆差戏剧性地逆转为1998~1999年度的6.8%顺差。
en: For the ASEAN-5, current-account deficits averaging 4% of GDP in 1996-97 swung dramatically into average surpluses of 6.8% of GDP in 1998-99.

zh: 而韩国也实现了类似的转变，从1996~1997年度相当于GDP的2.8%经常账户逆差变成1998~1999年度的8.6%顺差
en: A similar transformation occurred in South Korea, where a 2.8% current-account deficit in 1996-1997 became an 8.6% surplus in 1998-1999.

zh: 从那以后，各国就走上了一条康庄大道。
en: Since then, the region has never looked back.

zh: 在两年之内，亚洲大多数受灾经济体都重新恢复到了危机前水平，而且都不是临时性的回光返照。
en: Within two years, most of Asia’s crisis-ridden economies had regained their pre-crisis peaks. Nor was this a temporary rebound.

zh: 自1999年始，东盟五国经历了GDP年平均增长率达5%的十年（韩国则达到了5.5 % ） 。
en: Beginning in 1999, the ASEAN-5 began a ten-year spurt of 5% average annual GDP growth (5.5% in South Korea over the same period).

zh: 简而言之，这种短期的紧缩行为并不会导致长期性的负面效应，而且紧缩在某种程度上是灾后复原所必不可少的，事实证明，其带来的长期好处不仅持久，而且令人震惊。
en: In short, there were no lasting negative effects from the short-term dose of austerity, and, to the extent that austerity was essential to post-crisis healing, the long-term benefits have proven to be both enduring and astounding.

zh: 这让我们这些亚洲之外的人领悟到了三个教训：首先，有付出才有收获。
en: Three lessons for the rest of us come to mind. First, there is no gain without pain.

zh: 只有很少发达国家的人能体会到1998年受灾亚洲国家所经历的那种严峻的总产值收缩状况，更别说拿出将紧缩加诸于本国经济之上的勇气了。
en: Few of us in the developed world can fathom aggregate-output contractions on the scale that crisis-torn Asia suffered in 1998, let alone muster the political will to impose them on our economies.

zh: 事实上，那种经济紊乱以及对一个原本自信的国家的侮辱都是灾难性的（当今的希腊可以证实这一点 ） 。
en: The economic dislocations and the humiliation of proud nations were, indeed, devastating (as Greeks today can attest).

zh: 然而一旦那些泡沫被挤走，亚洲的后危机复苏也是强劲且可持续的。
en: But, once the excesses were purged, Asia’s post-crisis rebounds were both strong and sustainable.

zh: 其二，在亚洲后危机调整过程的初期阶段，货币将扮演一个泄压阀门的重要角色。
en: Second, currencies played an important role as an escape valve in the early days of Asia’s post-crisis adjustment process.

zh: 随着各国从固定汇率转向浮动汇率，亚洲货币汇率急跌 — — 韩元对美元下跌28 % ， 泰铢，马来西亚林吉特和菲律宾比索下跌约37 % ， 印尼盾下跌近80 % 。
en: As the region moved from hard exchange-rate pegs to floating rates, Asian currencies plunged – with drops against the dollar ranging from 28% in South Korea and roughly 37% in Thailand, Malaysia, and the Philippines to almost 80% in Indonesia.

zh: 最后，除了结构重整之外无路可走。
en: Finally, there is no substitute for restructuring.

zh: 在1990年代末的亚洲，虽然国际货币基金组织施加的结构调整项目主导了整个金融部门，但同时还有一些着眼于税制和支出改革的项目。
en: In Asia in the late 1990’s, measures aimed at the financial sector dominated IMF-imposed structural adjustment programs, but there were also programs that focused on tax and expenditure reforms, corporate governance, privatization, and business-debt restructuring.

zh: 即便这些项目并不全都遵照IMF的严格条款执行，却也在大幅增强亚洲竞争力方面扮演了关键角色。
en: While not all of these programs were implemented in strict compliance with IMF conditionality, they played a key role in promoting significant improvements in Asian competiveness.

zh: 美欧两方都不应该忽视上述任何一个教训。
en: None of these lessons should be lost on either Europe or the US.

zh: 虽然在一个货币联盟中单一国家很显然缺乏货币方面的灵活性 — — 而这也是欧洲与1990年代末的亚洲最明显而重要的区别 — — 但为了刺激整个区域的竞争力也不应阻止欧元贬值。
en: While individual countries obviously lack currency flexibility in a monetary union – one of Europe’s most obvious and important differences from Asia in the late 1990’s – there is nothing to prevent a depreciation of the euro from boosting pan-regional competitiveness.

zh: 而这一点当然也适用于美元。
en: The same, of course, is true of the US dollar.

zh: 但没有国家 — — 或者欧洲这样的国家集团 — — 能通过贬值的方式来重获繁荣。
en: But no country – or group of countries, in Europe’s case – has ever devalued its way back to prosperity.

zh: 因此亚洲的结构型教训对发达国家也是同样有益的。
en: So Asia’s structural lessons are equally important to the developed world.

zh: 事实上，德国的经济之所以能比欧洲其他国家拥有更强大的竞争力和增长率，在很大程度上都是得益于劳动力市场改革和放松管制。
en: Indeed, Germany’s economy is out-competing and out-growing the rest of Europe, largely owing to labor-market reforms and deregulation.

zh: 同样一剂药方或许也能在欧洲其他国家身上生效 — — 更别提正面临着严重竞争力危机的美国了。
en: The same medicine might prove equally beneficial to the rest of Europe – to say nothing of the US, which faces a major competitiveness challenge of its own.

zh: 最后，亚洲的发展中经济体在1990年代末其实已经走投无路，只能接受异常严苛的IMF策略来作为接受援助的代价。
en: In the end, Asia’s developing economies had no choice but to accept draconian measures as the price of bailouts in the late 1990’s.

zh: 因此富裕发展中国家是否能采取同一条路径还有待观察。
en: It remains to be seen if rich developed countries are willing to take the same route.

zh: 20年前，在保罗·沃尔克（Paul Volcker）和行天丰雄（Toyo Gyohten）合著的《时运变迁：国际货币及对美国领导地位的挑战》一书中就特别指出了在危机处理方案上那种显而易见的双重标准 ： “ 在为弱小的贫穷国家提供咨询时，那些小国只能俯首听命；当面对强国时，世界货币基金组织一转身又变成了仆人。
en: Two decades ago, in their book Changing Fortunes, Paul Volcker and Toyo Gyohten underscored the glaring double standard of crisis resolution: “When the [International Monetary] Fund consults with a poor and weak country, the country gets in line. When it consults with a strong country, the Fund gets in line.”

zh: 或许1990年代末亚洲危机给我们最关键的教训是：紧缩政策是有效的，但成败最终将取决于权力政治 — — 也就是说，一个介乎于短期权宜之计和长期战略之间的解决方案。 而这也是西方依然在纠结的地方。
en: Perhaps that is the key lesson from the Asian crisis of the late 1990’s: austerity can work.  But its success or failure ultimately boils down to power politics – namely, a resolution of the tension between short-term palliatives and the commitment to a long-term strategy.  That’s where the battle still rages in the West.

zh: 让亚洲的储蓄为亚洲做贡献
en: Putting Asia’s Savings to Work in Asia

zh: 香港—三十多年来，亚洲比其他地区经济增长更快。
en: HONG KONG – For more than three decades, Asia has experienced faster economic growth than any other region.

zh: 亚洲在发展成长的过程中，一方面通过对美国的贸易盈余输出其储蓄；另一方面又借助纽约和伦敦以直接投资与股票组合投资等形式重新将资本输回亚洲。 这一跨境迂回投资过程制造了严重但基本被忽视的地缘金融紧张局面。
en: As it has developed, Asia has been exporting its savings, through a trade surplus with the United States, and re-importing them, in the form of direct and portfolio investment via New York and London – a process that has created severe, though largely overlooked, financial tensions.

zh: 2015年年底，中国、香港、日本、韩国、新加坡和台湾的净对外资产头寸之和达到了7.3万亿美元 — — 几乎正好等于美国的净国际投资负债。
en: At the end of 2015, the combined net asset position of China, Hong Kong, Japan, Korea, Singapore, and Taiwan amounted to $7.3 trillion – almost exactly equivalent to the net international investment liability of the US.

zh: 这一失衡不可能在短期内消失。
en: And this imbalance is not likely to go away any time soon.

zh: 事实上，美国的净对外投资负债最近又有所增长 — — 到2016年9月底达到了7.8 万亿美元，主要原因是美国持续的经常项目赤字和汇率效应导致的净负债扩大。
en: In fact, the US’s net liabilities have grown lately – to $7.8 trillion at the end of September 2016 – owing largely to its continuing current-account deficit and stronger exchange-rate effects.

zh: 亚洲国家为什么不把自己的储蓄投资于本地区？
en: Why don’t Asian countries invest their savings within their own region?

zh: 一个显而易见的原因是美国主导着全球金融，特别是在股权投资和货币市场。
en: An obvious reason is that the US dominates global finance, particularly in the capital and currency markets.

zh: 在一篇2005年的论文中，皮埃尔-奥利佛·古林查斯（Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas）和伊莲·雷（Hélène Rey）指出，曾经是世界的银行家的美国，已经变成了世界的风险资本家，展开国际股权及债券投资，特别是在亚洲，而不只是银行借贷。
en: In a 2005 paper, Pierre-Olivier Gourinchas and Hélène Rey argued that the US, once the world’s banker, had become its venture capitalist, investing internationally, especially in Asia, instead of just borrowing and lending.

zh: 但这并不意味着亚洲国家投资西方的回报变得更好了，其中一个问题是2008年金融危机后兴起的套息交易。
en: But that doesn’t mean that Asian countries are better off investing in the West – not least because of the carry trade that took root after the 2008 financial crisis.

zh: 申铉松（Hyun Shin）和国际清算银行的其他经济学家指出，在纽约和伦敦的金融枢纽引领下，发达国家的低利率和弱势美元驱动着全球金融市场的套息游戏： 借入低息货币，投资于高息货币（通常是新兴市场国家货币 ） 。
en: As Hyun Shin and other economists at the Bank for International Settlements have argued, low developed-country interest rates and a weak dollar drove financial markets, led by the New York and London hubs, to borrow money in low-interest-rate currencies and invest in higher-interest-rate currencies.

zh: 这个金融游戏产生了深远的影响。
en: This financial game has had a far-reaching impact.

zh: 尽管传统观念认为贸易失衡驱动了汇率波动和资本跨境流动，但日本的金融账户状况表明实际情况并非如此。
en: While the conventional view is that trade imbalances drive exchange rates and capital flows, financial accounting in Japan, for example, tells a different story.

zh: 从2010年到2015年，累计经常项盈余只占日本对外投资头寸净变化的44 % 。
en: From 2010 to 2015, the cumulative external surplus accounted for just 44% of the net change in Japan’s investment position.

zh: 金融账户交易贡献了这一变化的32 % ， 变化的其他部分则可以用与汇率和利率有关的估值变化解释。
en: Financial-account transactions caused 32% of that change, while valuation changes relating to exchange and interest rates accounted for the rest.

zh: 日本的持续性经常项目盈余理应增加其净对外资产头寸。
en: Japan’s persistent current-account surpluses should have strengthened its net international asset positions.

zh: 但是，由于日元升值导致海外投资者持有的日本股票升值，日本的净对外资产头寸实际上有所恶化，从2012年底3.8万亿美元的最高值下降到2015年底的2.8万亿美元。
en: But, thanks to the appreciation of foreign holdings of Japanese equities, the country’s net international asset position actually deteriorated, from a peak of $3.8 trillion at the end of 2012 to $2.8 trillion at the end of 2015.

zh: 日本央行经济学家指出，日本投资者持仓的海外资产回报远不如海外投资者持仓的日本资产。
en: As Bank of Japan economists point out, Japanese holdings of foreign assets are less profitable than foreign holdings of Japanese assets.

zh: 日本应该做什么？ 应该更多地投资于高增长的亚洲。
en: What Japan should be doing is investing more in high-growth Asia.

zh: 2015年年底，其574.8万亿日元的总对外投资中只有10.1%留在了亚洲，而有70%流向了北美、欧洲和大洋洲。
en: At the end of 2015, only 10.1% of ¥574.8 trillion ($4.8 trillion) in gross outward investment remained in Asia, with 70% going to North America, Europe, and Oceania.

zh: 2015年底，日本股权组合投资占其总对外投资达到73.6 % ， 其组成更不平衡，只有3.5%投资于亚洲，而有72.4%流向了北美、欧洲和大洋洲。
en: The composition of Japan’s portfolio investments, which comprised 73.6% of the country’s total outward investment at the end of 2015, is even more uneven, with only 3.5% invested in Asia and 72.4% invested in North America, Europe, and Oceania.

zh: 就连中美洲和拉丁美洲，获得的日本股权组合投资量也要比亚洲多三分之一。
en: Even Central and Latin America received one-third more Japanese portfolio investment than Asia.

zh: 偏好投资于亚洲以外地区是亚洲主要高储蓄国家和地区，包括中国、香港、韩国、台湾所共有的特征，虽然亚洲的回报总体而言要高于其他地区。
en: This preference for investing outside Asia is shared by the region’s other major savers – namely, China, Hong Kong, South Korea, Taiwan, and Singapore – even though returns within Asia are generally higher than elsewhere.

zh: 后果是亚洲地区经济极易受到资本流动及汇率和利率波动的影响。
en: As a result, the region has been made hostage to volatility in capital flows, exchange rates, and interest rates.

zh: 问题在于，亚洲金融危机已经过去了二十年，但将储蓄引向本地区内高回报项目的亚洲金融中介的制度化改革进程几乎没有进展。
en: The problem is that, two decades after the Asian financial crisis, there has been little progress in institutionalizing Asian financial intermediaries that will channel savings to high-return projects within the region.

zh: 比如，印度的最大十家投资银行都来自美国和欧洲。
en: In India, for example, the top ten investment banks are from the US and Europe.

zh: 香港和新加坡的情况也差不多。
en: The situation is not much different in Hong Kong and Singapore.

zh: 即使是本地投资机构成长迅速的中国，引导资金流向高回报实体部门的能力仍然十分有限。
en: Even in China, where local investment institutions are growing rapidly, the ability to channel funds to the high-return real sector remains limited.

zh: 如今，随着资本充足率和监管约束的加强，以及美国加息和美元升值的概率上升，美国和欧洲银行开始退出亚洲，导致亚洲国家亡羊补牢的压力与日俱增。
en: Now that US and European banks – driven by capital and regulatory constraints, as well as the prospects of higher US interest rates and a strengthening dollar – are beginning to move away from Asia, the pressure to remedy the situation is stronger than ever.

zh: 但是，亚洲金融监管者并没有大力培育亚洲金融机构将本地储蓄配置到本地实体项目中去的能力，而是将精力集中在实施由美国和欧洲监管者推行的新全球金融监管标准上，而美国和欧洲的政客却在威胁要废除这些标准。
en: But, instead of supporting Asian financial institutions’ capacity to take over the intermediation of the region’s savings, Asian financial regulators are focused on adopting the new global financial regulatory standards being pushed by their American and European counterparts – standards that American and European politicians are threatening to unwind.

zh: 美国总统特朗普打出“美国第一”的口号后，亚洲决策监管层改变目前方针的紧迫性更加强大了 。
en: The imperative to change this approach is magnified by US President Donald Trump’s “America first” credo, which is almost certain to translate into protectionist policies.

zh: “美国第一”几乎肯定将转化为保护主义政策，这些政策将让亚洲投资进一步陷入美元陷阱，因为亚洲储蓄将被用于追逐地区之外的投机性的美元计价资产，而不是满足亚洲自身实体经济发展的需要。
en: Such policies will push Asian investment further into the dollar trap, because Asian savings will be used to chase speculative dollar-denominated assets outside the region, instead of to meet Asia’s own needs.

zh: 在长期，中国的“一带一路”计划，再加上人民币的国际化，将有助于削弱美元对亚洲的掣肘。
en: To be sure, in the longer term, China’s “one belt, one road” initiative, together with the internationalization of the renminbi, will help to weaken the dollar’s grip on Asia.

zh: 但这仍然是一个遥远的前景。
en: But that remains a distant prospect.

zh: 与此同时，亚洲主要盈余经济体（特别是中国和日本）的央行需要与世界其他主要央行（特别是欧洲央行和英格兰银行）合作改变高增长地区的过剩储蓄的使用方式。
en: In the meantime, the central banks of leading Asian surplus economies (particularly China and Japan) need to work with other major central banks (especially the European Central Bank and the Bank of England) to change how excess savings in high-growth regions are used.

zh: 目标应该定在确保盈余国 — — 包括德国，它的经常项目盈余比中国和日本还要大 — — 的储蓄得到明智的使用，能够帮助保持全球经济的增长动力。
en: The goal should be to ensure that savings in surplus countries – including, say, Germany, which has a larger current-account surplus than China and Japan – are used wisely, to help sustain growth throughout the world economy.

zh: 特朗普的“美国第一”计划听上去可能非常直接。
en: Trump’s plan to put America first may sound straightforward.

zh: 但它没有认识到，如果新兴经济体式微，所有人都要遭殃。
en: But it fails to recognize that, if the emerging economies falter, everyone will lose.

zh: 特朗普似乎不准备反思他的方针，因此亚洲及其国际伙伴必须做好准备，保护自己及其整个全球经济。
en: With Trump seemingly unwilling to rethink his approach, it is up to Asia and its international partners to gird themselves – and the entire global economy.

zh: 亚洲的美国威胁
en: Asia’s American Menace

zh: 新德里—美国总统特朗普的外交政策方针主要以策略和交易，而不是战略愿景为基础，这造成了一系列冲突。
en: NEW DELHI – US President Donald Trump’s approach to foreign policy – based on tactics and transactions, rather than strategic vision – has produced a series of dazzling flip-flops.

zh: 由于缺少指导性定策，遑论明确的重点，特朗普让美国盟友和战略伙伴感到无所适从 — — 特别是在亚洲 — — 这影响到了地区安全。
en: Lacking any guiding convictions, much less clear priorities, Trump has confounded America’s allies and strategic partners, particularly in Asia – jeopardizing regional security in the process.

zh: 平心而论，特朗普做了一些拨乱反正，让他更加接近于传统美国立场。
en: To be sure, some of Trump’s reversals have brought him closer to traditional US positions.

zh: 特别是他宣布北约“不再过时 ” ， 改变了选战期间的口风。
en: In particular, he has declared that NATO is “no longer obsolete,” as it supposedly was during his campaign.

zh: 这一变化让美国与欧洲的关系有所缓和。
en: That change has eased some of the strain on the US relationship with Europe.

zh: 但在面临严重安全、政治和经济挑战的亚洲，特朗普的反覆只能加剧地区动荡。
en: But in Asia – which faces serious security, political, and economic challenges – Trump’s reversals have only exacerbated regional volatility.

zh: 该地区布满了政治火药桶，稍有不慎就会引起暴力冲突，亚洲领导人最不希望看到的正是战略随心所欲。
en: With so many political flashpoints threatening to trigger violent conflict, the last thing Asia’s leaders need is another strategic wild card.

zh: 但特朗普正是如此。
en: Yet, in Trump, that is precisely what they have.

zh: 这位美国总统比口无遮拦的费率并总统杜特尔特和专制的中国国家主席习近平还要变幻莫测。
en: The US president has shown himself to be more mercurial than the foul-mouthed Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte or the autocratic Chinese President Xi Jinping.

zh: 相比之下，即便是以冲动任性闻名于世的朝鲜独裁者金正恩也显得比较容易预测。
en: Even the famously impulsive North Korean dictator Kim Jong-un seems almost predictable, by comparison.

zh: 也许特朗普外交政策中前后最一致的特征是他沉迷于获得短期有时。
en: Perhaps the most consistent feature of Trump’s foreign policy is his obsession with gaining short-term advantage.

zh: 在最近的推特中，他反问说，在中国正在与美国合作驯服朝鲜的时候，为什么应该给中国贴上货币操纵国的标签。
en: In one recent tweet, he asked why he should label China a currency manipulator, when the Chinese are working with the US to rein in North Korea.

zh: 而几天前，特朗普还说中国是货币操纵“世界冠军 ” 。
en: Just days earlier, Trump had called the Chinese the “world champions” of currency manipulation.

zh: 这条推特或许能够给特朗普的亚洲政策提供更多洞见。
en: That tweet may offer additional insight into Trump’s Asia policy.

zh: 首先，它强烈表明，朝鲜猛然崛起成为特朗普的主要外交政策挑战，这意味着前总统奥巴马所采取的战略容忍很有可能让位给容易引起“事故”的强硬战略政策。
en: For starters, it highlights North Korea’s sudden emergence as Trump’s main foreign-policy challenge, suggesting that the strategic patience pursued by former President Barack Obama could well be replaced by a more accident-prone policy of strategic tetchiness.

zh: 副总统彭斯宣布最近美军在叙利亚和阿富汗进行的低风险低收益打击表明了美国的“优势”和解决朝鲜的“决心 ” ， 这进一步强化了特朗普推特的含义。
en: This reading is reinforced by Vice President Mike Pence’s claims that the recent low-risk, low-reward US military strikes in Syria and Afghanistan demonstrate American “strength” and “resolve” against North Korea.

zh: 如此声明表明美国并不理解其在朝鲜问题上不具有可信的军事选择，因为任何美国打击都将立刻导致韩国人口中心城市遭到毁灭。
en: Such claims reflect a lack of understanding that, when it comes to North Korea, the US has no credible military option, because any US attack would result in the immediate devastation of South Korea’s main population centers.

zh: 特朗普政府目前的战略 — — 指望中国解决朝鲜问题 — — 也不会奏效。
en: The Trump administration’s current strategy – counting on China to address the North Korea challenge – won’t work, either.

zh: 毕竟，朝鲜最近一直在试图摆脱中国的控制，寻求直接与美国打交道。
en: After all, North Korea has lately been seeking to escape China’s clutches and pursue direct engagement with the US.

zh: 考虑到习近平和金正恩的不和，似乎特朗普的最佳赌注是他在选战中所提出的方案：直接与金正恩会面。
en: Given the bad blood between Xi and Kim, it seems that Trump’s best bet might be some version of what he proposed during the campaign: meeting with Kim over a hamburger.

zh: 朝鲜的核幽灵眼看就要逸出瓶中，去核化也许不再是可行的选项。
en: With the North Korean nuclear genie already out of the bottle, denuclearization may no longer be a plausible option.

zh: 但核冻结仍然能可谈。
en: But a nuclear freeze could still be negotiated.

zh: 特朗普依靠中国解决朝鲜问题根本无法起到效果；实际上，这对于亚洲来说可能更加危险。
en: Trump’s reliance on China to manage North Korea won’t just be ineffective; it could actually prove even more destabilizing for Asia.

zh: 特朗普一开始似乎渴望遏制中国的霸权野心，而如今好像准备对中国做出更多让步，这将重蹈奥巴马啊政府的主要外交政策错误，有过之而无不及。
en: Trump, who initially seemed eager to challenge China’s hegemonic ambitions, now seems poised to cede more ground to the country, compounding a major foreign-policy mistake on the part of the Obama administration.

zh: 在特朗普的所有反覆中，这一条地缘战略后果最为严重，因为中国肯定会充分利用它来推进自己的目标。
en: Of all of Trump’s reversals, this one has the greatest geostrategic significance, because China will undoubtedly take full advantage of it to advance its own objectives.

zh: 从加紧镇压政治异见者和少数民族，到试图改变亚洲领土现状，中国一直在测试它可以走得多远。
en: From its growing repression of political dissidents and ethnic minorities to its efforts to upend the territorial status quo in Asia, China constantly tests how far it can go.

zh: 在奥巴马执政期间，中国已经多次得逞。
en: Under Obama, it got away with a lot.

zh: 在特朗普治下，中国还会拿走更多领土。
en: Under Trump, it could get away with even more.

zh: 如今，特朗普把中国称为其政府的朋友和伙伴 — — 还似乎与习近平本人建立了私交。
en: Trump now calls China a friend and partner of his administration – and seems to have developed a fondness for Xi himself.

zh: “我们中间起了美妙的化学反应 ， ” 他说 ， “ 我们都很喜欢对方。
en: “We have a great chemistry together,” he says.

zh: 我很喜欢他。
en: “We like each other.
I like him a lot.”

zh: 这种私交绝非口是心非：特朗普的做法强化了习近平的立场 — — 也削弱了他自己的立场 — — 尽管他可能尚未认识到这一点。
en: That fondness extends beyond words: Trump’s actions have already strengthened Xi’s position – and undercut his own – though Trump probably didn’t realize it.

zh: 首先，特朗普收回了他不再尊重“一个中国”政策的威胁。
en: First, Trump backed down from his threat not to honor the “one China” policy.

zh: 最近，特朗普又在他的佛罗里达州庄园招待了习近平，在会晤期间没有提到任何中国停止不公平贸易和投资行为的要求，而他在选战期间对这些行为大加抨击。
en: More recently, Trump hosted Xi at his Florida resort, without requiring that China dismantle any of the unfair trade and investment practices that he railed against during the campaign.

zh: “习特会”帮助习近平在今年晚些时候的中共十九大之前提升了自己的国内形象。 习近平有可能利用十九大打破制度化的集体执政规则，掌握自毛泽东以来任何中国领导人都不曾有过的专制权。
en: The summit with Trump boosted Xi’s image at home ahead of the Chinese Communist Party’s 19th National Congress later this year, where Xi may manage to break free from institutionalized collective rule to wield power more autocratically than any Chinese leader since Mao Zedong.

zh: 习特会还表明，特朗普政府默许中国在南海开疆辟土。
en: It also indicated the Trump administration’s tacit acceptance of China’s territorial grabs in the South China Sea.

zh: 这不但将鼓励中国把南海的七个人工岛充分军事化，还将刺激中国在其他地区 — — 如东海和喜马拉雅山脉西麓 — — 采取领土修正主义。
en: This will embolden China not just to militarize fully its seven manmade islands there, but also to pursue territorial revisionism in other regions, from the East China Sea to the western Himalayas.

zh: 特朗普认为，由于他和习近平建立了“极好”的关系 ， “ 许多有可能变得非常糟糕的问题将迎刃而解 ” 。
en: Trump believes that “lots of very potentially bad problems will be going away,” owing to his relationship with the “terrific” Xi.

zh: 事实上，他的“让美国重新伟大”的承诺简直是习近平的“中华民族复兴”的“中国梦”的对偶。
en: In fact, his promise to “Make America Great Again” is antithetical to Xi’s “Chinese dream” of “rejuvenating the Chinese nation.”

zh: 特朗普稀里糊涂地支持了习近平的思想 — — 两国应该共同构建“新型大国关系 ” 。
en: Xi’s idea, which Trump is unwittingly endorsing, is that their countries should band together in a “new model of great power relations.”

zh: 但难以想象世界观如此截然相反的两个国家 — — 更不用说哈佛大学的格雷厄姆·艾利森（Graham Allison）所谓的“极端复杂性 ” — —能够有效治理全球事务。
en: But it is hard to imagine how two countries with such opposing worldviews – not to mention what Harvard University’s Graham Allison has called “extreme superiority complexes” – can oversee world affairs effectively.

zh: 可以想象，特朗普将在中国（或朝鲜）问题上再次反覆。
en: It is conceivable that Trump could flip again on China (or North Korea).

zh: 事实上，特朗普的政策反覆很可能要比他的实际政策更加危险。
en: Indeed, Trump’s policy reversals may well turn out to be more dangerous than his actual policies.

zh: 不断需要调整将给美国盟友和伙伴制造更大的焦虑，后两者的核心利益很有可能沦为讨价还价的筹码。
en: The need for constant adjustment will only stoke greater anxiety among America’s allies and partners, who now run the risk that their core interests will be used as bargaining chips.

zh: 如果这些焦虑促使一些国家组建军队，叶舟的战略图景将从根本上发生转变。
en: If those anxieties prompt some countries to build up their militaries, Asia’s strategic landscape will be fundamentally altered.

zh: 通往亚洲统一之路
en: The Road to Asian Unity

zh: 新德里—亚洲缺少减轻地区紧张局势的制度令人扼腕。
en: NEW DELHI – Asia’s lack of institutions to ameliorate regional tensions is often lamented.

zh: 但亚洲的进一步统一势头正在悄然出现，其形式便是气象一新的基础设施连接。
en: But greater Asian unity may be arising by the backdoor, in the form of new and impressive infrastructure links.

zh: 如今，扩大地区基础设施项目的努力最令人注目的一点是把受困于外交冲突、甚至有时候是公开冲突的国家也包括进来了。
en: Today’s efforts to expand regional infrastructure projects are all the more remarkable for linking even countries locked in diplomatic, and sometimes open, conflict.

zh: 印度和巴基斯坦的新巴士路线或许登不上报纸头条，但它们预示着互不信任的两国有了些许关系正常化的苗头。
en: New bus routes between India and Pakistan may not make headlines, but they deliver a degree of normalcy to relations riddled with mistrust.

zh: 在其他国家，中国和越南之间的铁路线、印度和孟加拉国之间的公路、以及缅甸和巴基斯坦的新机场、港口和管道正在铸就沿地区制造业供应链发展的新形式的经济统一。
en: Elsewhere, rail links between China and Vietnam, road developments connecting India and Bangladesh, and new ports, harbors, and pipelines in Myanmar and Pakistan are forging a new form of economic unity alongside the region’s manufacturing supply chains.

zh: 目前，亚洲版图上处处都是类似的工程，尽管边境纠纷和主权主张在助长动荡。
en: Such ventures now dot Asia’s geography, even as tensions over unsettled boundaries and sovereignty claims are fueling turbulence.

zh: 就拿阿富汗来说吧。 该国面临着新一轮内乱。
en: Consider Afghanistan, which faces yet another phase of internal dislocation.

zh: 尽管如此，印度仍在继续建设具战略意义的环阿富汗公路以及重要性不相上下的位于萨尔玛（Salma）的大坝。
en: There, India nonetheless continues to build a strategic ring road around the country, as well as a vitally important dam at Salma.

zh: 横穿土库曼斯坦至巴基斯坦的输气管道也在走向现实。
en: And a gas pipeline from Turkmenistan to Pakistan, which would traverse the country, is coming closer to reality.

zh: 还有孟加拉湾，中国基础设施投资将在缅甸海滨小城皎漂（Kyaukpyu）建立离岸油田，并建设通往云南省的输油管道，从而改变皎漂及其周边地区的落后面貌。
en: Then there is the Bay of Bengal, where Chinese infrastructure investment is set to transform the backward Myanmar seaside town of Kyaukpyu and the surrounding region by tapping offshore gas fields and constructing a pipeline to Yunnan Province in southern China.

zh: 这些工程不但反映了中国对自然资源和新贸易路线的无尽胃口，也是缅甸自身建设国内“小新加坡”的计划。
en: These initiatives reflect not only China’s voracious drive for natural resources and new trade routes, but also Myanmar’s own plans to create a “mini-Singapore” within its borders.

zh: 当然，中国投资这些基础设施不可能出于利他主义。
en: Of course, China is not investing in such infrastructure out of altruism.

zh: 即将卸任的中国国家主席胡锦涛在近十年前提出中国处于“马六甲困境 ” ， 这个位于马来半岛和印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛之间的海峡连接着印度洋和太平洋，是一个重大战略威胁。
en: Almost a decade ago, outgoing Chinese President Hu Jintao identified the country’s “Malacca Dilemma,” referring to the channel between the Malay Peninsula and the Indonesian island of Sumatra that connects the Indian and Pacific Oceans, as a grave strategic threat.

zh: 大约80%的中国能源进口通过这一几乎完全听命于美国海军的潜在阻塞点进入中国。
en: Roughly 80% of China’s energy imports pass through that potential chokepoint, which is mostly policed by the US Navy.

zh: 现在正在开发的缅甸油矿将让中国对马六甲海峡的依赖程度降低三分之一。
en: The links now being developed in Myanmar will reduce China’s dependence on the Strait of Malacca by more than one-third.

zh: 而缅甸的计划则凸显出其现实主义新观念。
en: The plans are illustrative of Myanmar’s pragmatic new outlook.

zh: 早些时候，夹在中印之间的缅甸叫停了中国支持的密松大坝的建设，但它有朝一日极有可能成为促进两个大国经济联系的节点。
en: Sandwiched between China and India, Myanmar, which had earlier suspended construction of the Chinese-backed Myitsone Dam, may one day be the link that facilitates closer economic ties between the two giants.

zh: 日本也不甘心在缅甸基础设施竞赛中落于人后，正在投资数十亿用于机场建设。
en: Japan, not wishing to be left out of the great infrastructure game in Myanmar, is investing billions in port reconstruction.

zh: 在西线的巴基斯坦，你可以沿着中国援建的公路莫克兰（Makran）海岸直达古老渔港瓜达尔（Gwadar ） ， 如今这里已是深水良港。
en: To the west, in Pakistan, one can travel on the Makran coast along a road built with Chinese assistance, eventually coming to the ancient fishing port of Gwadar, with its natural deep-water harbor.

zh: 新加坡港务局对瓜达尔港的开发计划失败，中国海外港口控股公司接手，这引起了印度、日本和美国的战略担忧。
en: With a development plan by the Port of Singapore Authority having fallen through, the China Overseas Ports Holding Company has taken over, raising strategic concerns in India, Japan, and the US.

zh: 事实上，尽管美国强烈反对，在瓜达尔工程后，中国可能很快和伊朗合作实施一项日送气量7.5亿立方英尺的管道铺设工程。
en: Indeed, despite intense opposition from the US, China’s project in Gwadar may soon be followed by a joint project with Iran to lay a pipeline carrying 750 million cubic feet of natural gas per day.

zh: 中国还在积极寻求建设泛亚铁路，一旦完工，将构成一个巨大的环形铁路圈。
en: China is also actively pursuing the construction of a Pan-Asia Railroad, which, when complete, will form an enormous circular route.

zh: 这条铁路以昆明为起点，穿过缅甸向南直达曼谷，并在曼谷越海经马来西亚到达新加坡。
en: Starting in Kunming in Yunnan Province, it will extend through Myanmar and south to Bangkok, where a spur will traverse Malaysia to Singapore.

zh: 从曼谷看是，这条铁路又将向东经过柬埔寨、向北经过越南到达河内，然后再穿越老挝回到昆明。
en: From Bangkok, the line will run east through Cambodia and north through Vietnam to Hanoi, then through Laos and back to Kunming.

zh: 听起来这是项伟大工程，事实也是如此；但是，不少铁路线已经存在（其中一些已有几十年历史 ） ， 因此这项工程的目标完工日在2015年。
en: This sounds like an enormous undertaking, and it is; but, with some rail lines already existing (some for many decades), the project could be completed by the 2015 target date.

zh: 东盟长期以来的统一梦想可能先在铁路事业上完成。
en: The Association of Southeast Asian Nations’ long-held dream of unity might first arrive by rail.

zh: 与此同时，印度也已开始连接东印度曼尼普尔邦至缅甸北部的公路建设，印度边境公路组织（Border Roads Organization）正在完成这条连接两国的第一条全天候公路。
en: Meanwhile, India has already opened up road communications linking the East Indian state of Manipur to North Myanmar, with India’s Border Roads Organization completing the first all-weather road connecting the two countries.

zh: 而在中亚，印度在塔吉克斯坦杜尚别附近建设了雅尼（Ayni）空军基地，包括一个经营中的野战医院（2001年9月9日，遇刺的阿富汗反苏战争领导人马苏德就逝世于这家医院 ） 。
en: And, in Central Asia, India has projects at Ayni Air Base near Dushanbe in Tajikistan, including a functioning field hospital (where the late Ahmed Shah Massoud, the leader of Afghanistan’s anti-Soviet war, died following an assassination attempt on September 9, 2001).

zh: 这些基础设施投资显然具有让亚洲走向前所未有的团结的潜力。
en: These infrastructure investments clearly hold the potential to bind Asia closer together than ever before.

zh: 但这场开发争夺战也蕴含着地缘政治风险。
en: But there are geopolitical risks in this scramble for development.

zh: 不难看出，西方正在加大援助，特别是对缅甸，仰光街头充斥着援助和政府发展机构（和投资者）的车流。
en: Predictably, the West is ramping up its aid, particularly in Myanmar, where the streets of Yangon are now choked with traffic created by aid and government development agencies (and investors).

zh: 当然，随着这些联系的发展，冲突或许也是不可避免的。
en: Of course, tension is probably unavoidable as these links develop.

zh: 缅甸亲民主领袖昂山素季在描述其祖国使，提到了“中国的近邻，美国的地理距离和印度的文化联系。
en: Tellingly, Myanmar’s pro-democracy leader Aung San Suu Kyi has spoken of her country in terms of the “vicinity of China, the geographical distance of the US, and the cultural linkages with India.”

zh: ”问题在于亚洲基础设施投资，特别是来自中国的投资，是会用于建设中央王国的亚洲卫星，还是成为大家平等使用的工具。
en: The question is whether Asia’s infrastructure investments, particularly those by China, will be used to create Asian satellites of the Middle Kingdom, or become tools to be used among equals.

zh: 亚洲可以利用其地理条件保持各国各自为政的状态，也可以互相交易，开发共同利益。
en: Asia can use its geography either to keep its states isolated, or to trade with one another and develop to the benefit of all.

zh: 在孤立和殖民地时期后，亚洲地区正在意识到更加统一的潜在好处。
en: After centuries of isolation and colonial slumber, the region is now awake to the potential benefits of greater unity.

zh: 基础设施建设可能还有别的目的，但这并没有关系，只要亚洲领导人着眼于繁荣而非只关注实力。
en: It will not matter that the infrastructure may not have been built solely for that purpose if Asia’s leaders keep their eyes on prosperity, rather than only on power.

zh: 打破亚洲数据荒
en: Breaking Asia’s Data Drought

zh: 马尼拉—亚洲大部受温度急剧升高和几十年来最严重的旱灾的困扰。
en: MANILA – Many parts of Asia have been gripped by searing temperatures and the worst drought in decades.

zh: 数百万人面临食物和水短缺，导致生命、生计、庄稼和牲口损失。
en: Millions of people face shortages of food or water, leading to the loss of lives, livelihoods, crops, and livestock.

zh: 水短缺拖累了生产率，降低了水电能源产出，减少了粮食出口，导致经济蒙受损失。
en: As water shortages depress productivity, reduce energy output at hydro plants, and cut food exports, economies are suffering.

zh: 要想摆脱这一困境，我们必须将目光投向天空 — — 但也许不是你预想中的方式。
en: To find relief, we must look to the skies – but not in the way one might expect.

zh: 降雨当然是令人欢迎的，但有一种应对极端天气的工具我们其实已经能够有所控制：卫星。
en: While rainfall would obviously be welcome, there is a tool for coping with extreme weather over which we actually have some control: satellites.

zh: 亚洲所面临的极端天气预计不会很快消失。
en: The extreme weather confronting Asia is not expected to abate anytime soon.

zh: 当前的旱灾部分可归因于异常强大的厄尔尼诺，拜其所赐，2015年年中以来太平洋海水一直在升温。
en: The current drought can be blamed partly on an unusually strong El Niño that has been warming the Pacific Ocean since mid-2015.

zh: 本世纪预计还将出现更多更强的厄尔尼诺，反映出气候变化的冲击。
en: More and stronger El Niños are expected this century, reflecting the impact of climate change.

zh: 这将加剧亚洲已然十分严重的水问题，拜快速城市化所赐，这一问题在城市尤其严重。
en: This will aggravate Asia’s already serious water problem, which is becoming particularly serious in cities, owing to rapid urbanization.

zh: 预计到2050年亚洲地区城市人口将翻一番，达到32亿，届时近四分之三的总人口都将面临水压力。
en: The region’s urban population is set to double, to 3.2 billion people, by 2050, by which time nearly three-quarters of its total population could face water stress.

zh: 控制这些因素看似不可能。
en: Controlling these forces may seem impossible.

zh: 但防止进一步水短缺并非如此。
en: But preventing further water shortages is not.

zh: 现在我们需要果断行动起来，改善对大自然和亚洲水危机规模的理解，从而强化应对能力。
en: What is needed now is bold action to improve our understanding of the nature and scale of Asia’s water crisis, thereby strengthening our capacity to respond to it.

zh: 缺少（比如）沿岸流的数据，包括多少水被分流用于农业和人类消费，阻碍着有效的资源管理。
en: A lack of data about, say, riparian flows, including how much water is diverted for agriculture and human consumption, undermines efficient resource management.

zh: 类似地，缺少详细降雨记录（特别是偏远地区）妨碍了对洪水和干旱风险的评估。
en: Likewise, the absence of detailed rainfall records, particularly in remote areas, impedes efforts to assess flood and drought risk.

zh: 设计正确的灌溉系统、大坝和堤岸 — — 更不用说在最有利于降低气候变化影响的地方建设这些设施 — — 也需要准确的数据。
en: Accurate data are also needed to design the right irrigation systems, dams, and embankments – not to mention building them where they will have the greatest impact in terms of mitigating the effects of climate change.

zh: 缺少数据以多种方式阻碍着可靠决策。 。
en: Missing data frustrate sound policymaking in myriad ways.

zh: 农业消费了亚洲淡水储量的约80 % ， 但大部分国家不能准确测量有多少水被用于种庄稼，其中又有多少水被下游重复利用。
en: Though agriculture consumes about 80% of freshwater stocks in Asia, most countries cannot correctly measure how much water is used to grow a crop, and how much of that water is re-used downstream.

zh: 厘清多少水进入和流出储水地以及用于何种用途能带来更加明智的政策，正如聪明的投资者需要依赖良好的财务会计。
en: Greater clarity about how much water enters and leaves catchments, and for what purposes, would enable smarter policies, just as savvy investors rely on good financial accounting.

zh: 一些水短缺国家，如澳大利亚，已经证明了此类统计有助于各国更有效地在农业和能源生产者以及城市消费者之间配置水资源。
en: As some water-scarce countries, such as Australia, have already shown, such accounting helps countries to allocate water more efficiently among agriculture and energy producers and urban consumers.

zh: 卫星技术可以在这方面起作用。
en: Here is where satellite technology comes in.

zh: 使用遥感技术定期扫描庄稼地好比是全身体检，能迅速收集关于降雨、土地温度乃至地下水位的信息，而用常规手段收集这些数据需要几个月之久。
en: Regular sweeps over cropped areas using remote sensing – something like a full-body health scan – can quickly gather information on rainfall, land temperature, and even groundwater levels that would otherwise take months to obtain.

zh: 配合地面实地测量，这些数据有助于政府获得更好的水资源统计，为干旱和洪水做好准备，并规划未来水用途。
en: When combined with physical measurements on the ground, these data can help governments gain a better accounting of water resources, prepare for droughts and floods, and plan future water use.

zh: 目前，由联合国教科文组织水教育学院、国际水管理研究所（International Water Management Institute）以及粮农组织开发的Water Accounting Plus软件系统使用开放获取遥感数据评估土地使用、降雨和温度。
en: Already, the Water Accounting Plus software system – developed by UNESCO-IHE, the International Water Management Institute, and the Food and Agriculture Organization – uses open-access remote-sensing data to assess land use, rainfall, and temperature.

zh: 该数据让系统能够确定某条河流流域有多少水，有多少正在用于各种目的，以及水用途如何随时间变化。
en: The data enable the system to determine how much water is available in a river basin, how much is being used for various purposes, and how water use has changed over time.

zh: 有了这些信息，柬埔寨和越南等国家能够面对水需求急剧增加的情况。
en: With such information, countries like Cambodia and Vietnam can confront the surge in water demand they face.

zh: 为了帮助它们实现这一目标，联合国教科文组织水教育学院在亚洲开放银行的支持下，与这些国家的政府 — — 以及印度、印尼、巴基斯坦、斯里兰卡和乌兹别克斯坦当局 — — 合作成立了一个实验性项目解决关于土地和水使用的关键问题。
en: To help propel them toward that goal, UNESCO-IHE, with support from the Asian Development Bank, has been working with their governments – as well as the authorities in India, Indonesia, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Uzbekistan – to create a pilot program to answer key questions about land and water use.

zh: 我们还需要更多类似的计划 — — 越快越好。
en: More such initiatives are needed – and quickly.

zh: 关注领域之一必须放在农业上。
en: One area of focus must be agriculture.

zh: 比如，越南饱受干旱之苦的中部高地和沿海省份急需增加“单位灌溉产量 ” 、 改善紧急情况响应。
en: In Vietnam’s parched central highlands and coastal provinces, for example, there is an urgent need to harvest “more crop per drop” and improve emergency responses.

zh: 如果卫星技术得到充分利用，农民可以通过手机收到关于何时可用多少水的实时信息。
en: If satellite technology is fully exploited, farmers could receive real-time information on their mobile phones about how much water to use and when.

zh: 此外，还可以识别该地区生产率更高的农民，鼓励他们与其他农民分享最佳实践。
en: Moreover, the region’s most productive farmers could be identified and encouraged to share their best practices with other farmers.

zh: 另一个关键措施是绘制全国水储存和使用地图，并将信息在线公开。
en: Another key step will be to map water stocks and usage across entire countries, and to make this information available online.

zh: 不能如过去那样将关键数据束之高阁，而必须扩大、更新和广泛分享它们，以使它们能够起作用。
en: Rather than allowing vital data to gather dust, as has occurred in the past, we must augment it, update it, and share it widely, so that it can be put to use.

zh: 打破数据荒本身不能终结亚洲水危机。
en: Breaking the data drought will not by itself end Asia’s water crisis.

zh: 但它是确保该地区的命运不被天气束缚的关键的第一步。
en: But it is a crucial first step to ensure that the region’s destiny is not dictated by its weather.

zh: 水之价值
en: What Water’s Worth

zh: 新加坡/亚特兰大—十九世纪初，拜伦勋爵在《唐璜 》 （ Don Juan）中写道 ， “ 不经痛苦怎知甜水之可贵。
en: SINGAPORE/ATLANTA – In the early nineteenth century, Lord Byron wrote in Don Juan that “Till taught by pain, men really know not what good water’s worth.”

zh: ”近两百年后，人类似乎仍然没有领会水的价值，几十年来无处不在的拙劣水管理和治理就是明证。
en: Nearly 200 years later, humanity still does not seem to understand water’s value, exemplified in decades of poor water management and governance practically everywhere.

zh: 但未来水危机正日益变得难以忽视 — — 特别是对于已经感受到其影响的人来说。
en: But the impending water crisis is becoming increasingly difficult to ignore – especially for those who are already feeling its effects.

zh: 平心而论，近几年来在水管理方面取得了一些进步。
en: To be sure, some improvements in water management have been made in recent years.

zh: 但只是量变性质，远没有达到有效解决问题的节奏。
en: But they have come incrementally, at far too slow a pace to address the problem effectively.

zh: 为了促进快速进步，雀巢、可口可乐、南非米勒（SABMiller）和联合利华等大型跨国公司正致力于改善水供应、质量和可持续性。 长期以来，它们一直向投资者强调谁稀缺对生意的影响，更不用说对它们开展经营业务的社区的影响了。
en: To help kick-start progress, major multinational companies like Nestlé, Coca-Cola, SABMiller, and Unilever – which have long emphasized to their investors the challenge that water scarcity poses for their businesses, not to mention the communities in which they operate – are working to improve water availability, quality, and sustainability.

zh: 它们的成功需要创新性战略颠覆根深蒂固的水相关问题的假设和方法。
en: Their success will require an innovative strategy that upends entrenched assumptions about – and approaches to – water-related problems.

zh: 比如，一个普遍的观点是世界需要好的水管理，这一观点尽管正确，但过于狭隘。
en: For example, the prevailing view that the world needs good water management, though accurate, is too narrow.

zh: 水管理不应该被视为终点 — — 或者单变量问题的单变量解决方案 — — 而应该被视为通往多个终点的途径，包括环境保护和社会经济发展等。
en: Water management should not be regarded as an end in itself – a single-variant solution for a single-variant problem – but as a means to several ends, including environmental conservation and social and economic development.

zh: 从这一更广泛的观点看来，许多目前所使用的社区水资源管理范式、实践和程序必须做出改变。
en: Viewed in this broader context, many of the paradigms, practices, and processes that are currently being used to manage communities’ water resources must change.

zh: 水资源竞争与粮食和能源等竞争不可分割，因此也不可能独立地解决。
en: Given that competition for water resources cannot be disentangled from competition for, say, food and energy, it cannot be addressed independently.

zh: 多变量问题需要多变量解决方案。
en: Multivariant problems demand multivariant solutions.

zh: 让情况更复杂的是，未来几十年中，由于人口结构变化、人口增加、城市化、国家内部移民、全球化、贸易自由化和发展中世界中产阶级的迅速扩张，这些问题的背景可能发生重大变化。
en: Complicating matters further, these problems’ backdrop is likely to change considerably over the next few decades, owing to demographic shifts, population growth, urbanization, migration within and among countries, globalization, trade liberalization, and rapid expansion of middle classes in the developing world.

zh: 这些变化将伴随着迅速的工业化和科技进步（特别是信息和通信技术 ） ， 并将改变饮食习惯和消费模式。
en: These shifts will accompany rapid industrialization and advances in science and technology (especially information and communications technology), and will transform dietary habits and consumption patterns.

zh: 因此，水消费模式也将发生重大变化，包括农业、能源和土地使用变化所带来的间接变化。
en: As a result, water-consumption patterns will change considerably, including indirectly, through shifts in agriculture, energy, and land use.

zh: 事实上，这些联系在世界很多地区已经显露无疑。
en: Indeed, these linkages are already evident in many parts of the world.

zh: 比如，在许多亚洲国家 — — 包括印度、中国和巴基斯坦 — — 由于过度开采和能源补贴，地下水水位以值得警惕的速度下降。
en: For example, in many Asian countries – including India, China, and Pakistan – groundwater levels are declining at an alarming rate, owing to over-extraction and energy subsidies.

zh: 印度的问题始于20世纪70年代，当时，各大出资人鼓励政府为农民提供免费的灌溉用电。
en: For India, the problem began in the 1970s, when major donors encouraged the government to provide farmers with free electricity for irrigation.

zh: 这一补贴在一开始还能管住，并在旁遮普、哈里亚纳、拉贾斯坦、古吉拉特和马哈拉施特拉等邦实现了提高粮食产量的目标。
en: The subsidies were manageable at first, and achieved their goal of boosting food production in states like Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Maharashtra.

zh: 但该政策使得农民不再有激励节约用水。
en: But the policy removed the incentive for farmers to limit the amount of water they pumped.

zh: 他们只要花点钱按一个水泵就万事大吉 — — 他们很乐意这样做，结果是如今水泵数量增加到了2,300万个。
en: They had to invest only in installing the actual pumps – and they did so willingly, resulting in a total of 23 million water pumps today.

zh: 如此挥霍给地下水位造成了严重影响，用于抽水的管井也不得不越打越深。
en: This profligacy has taken a serious toll on groundwater levels, forcing the tube-wells from which the water is pumped to be installed ever more deeply.

zh: 据第三世界水管理中心（Third World Center for Water Management）的数据，印度抽水所需电量在过去十年中增加了一倍 — — 有些地区甚至增加了两倍，而管井深度从10—15米延伸到200—400米。
en: According to the Third World Center for Water Management, the amount of electricity required to pump water in India has doubled – and, in some cases, even tripled – in the last decade alone, as tube-wells have moved from 10-15 meters (32-50 feet) to 200-400 meters (650-1300 feet) deep.

zh: 深度的增加让每次抽水所需电量增加3—4倍。
en: The increasing depth requires 3-4 times more horsepower for each pump.

zh: 在这一背景下，各邦水部门主管根本无从让地下水灌溉保持可持续状态。
en: Under these conditions, state water ministries have few options for making groundwater irrigation sustainable.

zh: 电力补贴的无节制增长让能源部门倍感压力，也使得实施有效政策阻止过度抽水难上加难。
en: With the relentless increase in electricity subsidies, which are squeezing the energy sector, it is difficult to devise effective policies to stem over-pumping.

zh: 水部门必须对能源和其他部门的发展做出反应，它们彼此之间尽管联系密切，控制力却极为有限。
en: The water sector will have to react to developments in the energy and other sectors, over which, despite close ties, it has very limited control.

zh: 有效协调多部门政策难于上青天。
en: Coordinating the various sectors’ policies effectively will be difficult, to say the least.

zh: 这听起来令人沮丧，但现实中这些挑战是可以克服的 — — 如果我们的领导人下决心处理好的话。
en: It may sound daunting, but the reality is that these challenges are surmountable – if, that is, our leaders commit to tackling them.

zh: 我们已经拥有了需要的技术、知识、专家甚至资金。
en: We already have the needed technology, know-how, experience, and even financing.

zh: 只要有强大的政治意愿、来自知情公众的持续的压力和水务专业人士和机构以“能做”态度追求跨部门合作，世界水管理问题就能得到有效解决。
en: With strong political will, sustained pressure from an informed public, and a “can do” attitude from water professionals and institutions pursuing intersectoral cooperation, the world’s water-management problems can be addressed effectively.

zh: 但我们必须马上行动起来。
en: But we must act now.

zh: 时间不等人，水也不等人。
en: Time – and water – is running out.

zh: 印度的自作孽粮食危机
en: India’s Homemade Food Crisis
