zh: 新加坡—根据最新估算，印度总人口将在2028年达到14.5亿，与中国2050年的人口（17亿）差不多，相当于今天中国和美国的总人口。
en: SINGAPORE – According to current estimates, India’s total population will reach 1.45 billion by 2028, similar to China’s, and 1.7 billion by 2050, equivalent to nearly the combined population of China and the United States today.

zh: 如今印度已经很难养活它的人口，目前的粮食危机将在未来十年大大恶化。
en: Given that India is already struggling to feed its population, its current food crisis could worsen significantly in the coming decades.

zh: 在2013年全球饥饿指数（Global Hunger Index，GHI）上，印度在78个最饥饿国家中名列第63名，低于相邻的斯里兰卡（第43名 ） 、 尼泊尔（第49名 ） 、 巴基斯坦（第57名）和孟加拉国（第58名 ） 。
en: According to the 2013 Global Hunger Index (GHI), India ranks 63rd, out of the 78 hungriest countries, significantly worse than neighboring Sri Lanka (43rd), Nepal (49th), Pakistan (57th), and Bangladesh (58th).

zh: 尽管印度的情况在过去四分之一世纪中得到了很大改观 — — 其GHI分从1990年的32.6增加到2013年的21.3 — — 但联合国粮农组织仍认为，17%的印度人仍处于营养过度不良状态，无法从事生产。
en: Despite India’s considerable improvement over the past quarter-century – its GHI rating has risen from 32.6 in 1990 to 21.3 in 2013 – the United Nations Food and Agricultural Organization believes that 17% of Indians are still too undernourished to lead a productive life.

zh: 事实上，全世界营养不良人群众有四分之一生活在印度，比撒哈拉以南非洲地区加起来还要多。
en: In fact, one-quarter of the world’s undernourished people live in India, more than in all of Sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 更糟糕的是，全世界三分之一营养不良儿童生活在印度。
en: More distressing, one-third of the world’s malnourished children live in India.

zh: 根据联合国儿童基金会的数据，47%的印度儿童体重不足，46%的三岁以下儿童体型相对年龄太小。
en: According to UNICEF, 47% of Indian children are underweight and 46% of those under three years old are too small for their age.

zh: 事实上，几乎一半的儿童夭折可以归因于营养不良，前总理辛格将这一状况称为“国耻 ” 。
en: Indeed, almost half of all childhood deaths can be attributed to malnutrition – a state of affairs that former Prime Minister Manmohan Singh called a “national shame.”

zh: 印度长期得不到粮食安全原因何在？
en: What accounts for India’s chronic food insecurity?

zh: 近几年来，农地产出频创新高，从2005—2006年的2.8亿吨增加到2013—2014年的2.63亿吨（预计值 ） 。
en: Farm output has been setting new records in recent years, having increased output from 208 million tons in 2005-2006 to an estimated 263 million tons in 2013-2014.

zh: 印度每年需要2.25—2.3亿吨粮食，因此即使按照目前的人口增长势头，粮食生产也显然不是主要问题。
en: India needs 225-230 million tons of food per year; so, even accounting for recent population growth, food production is clearly not the main issue.

zh: 最重要的因素 — — 也是决策者长期忽略的因素 — — 是印度所生产的粮食中有很大一部分从未到达消费者手中。
en: The most significant factor – one that policymakers have long ignored – is that a high proportion of the food that India produces never reaches consumers.

zh: 前农业部长沙拉得·帕瓦（Sharad Pawar）曾指出，价值83亿美元或相当于总年产量近40%的粮食是浪费掉的。
en: Sharad Pawar, a former agriculture minister, has noted that food worth $8.3 billion, or nearly 40% of the total value of annual production, is wasted.

zh: 这并没有抓住问题的全部：比如，肉类只占粮食浪费的4 % ， 但成本却要占20 % ； 而70%的水果和蔬菜产出被浪费，占总成本的40 % 。
en: This does not capture the full picture: for example, meat accounts for about 4% of food wastage but 20% of the costs, while 70% of fruit and vegetable output is wasted, accounting for 40% of the total cost.

zh: 印度也许是世界最大的牛奶生产国，水果和蔬菜产量则位居第二（仅次于中国 ） ， 但它也是世界第一大粮食浪费国。
en: India may be the world’s largest milk producer and grow the second largest quantity of fruits and vegetables (after China), but it is also the world’s biggest waster of food.

zh: 结果，水果和蔬菜价格比应有水平高了一倍，牛奶也高出50 % 。
en: As a result, fruit and vegetable prices are twice what they would be otherwise, and milk costs 50% more than it should.

zh: 被浪费掉的并非只有易腐败粮食。
en: It is not only perishable food that is squandered.

zh: 据估计，2,100万吨小麦 — — 相当于澳大利亚总年产量 — — 因为存储能力不足或政府经营的印度粮食公司（Food Corporation of India，FCI）管理不善而烂掉或被虫子吃掉。
en: An estimated 21 million tons of wheat – equivalent to Australia’s entire annual crop – rots or is eaten by insects, owing to inadequate storage and poor management at the government-run Food Corporation of India (FCI).

zh: 自2008—2009年以来，粮食价格通胀持续保持在10%以上（2010—2011年除外 ， “ 只有”6.2 % ） ；日常杂货占家庭预算31%的穷人受影响最大。
en: Food-price inflation since 2008-2009 has been consistently above 10%, (except for 2010-2011, when it was “only” 6.2%); the poor, whose grocery bills typically account for 31% of the household budget, have suffered the most.

zh: 如此多的易腐败粮食白白损失，原因是多重的，包括缺乏现代粮食分销链、冷藏中心和冷藏卡车数量过少、运输条件太差、电力供应不稳和缺少向该方面进行投资的激励等。
en: There are several reasons why so much perishable food is lost, including the absence of modern food distribution chains, too few cold-storage centers and refrigerated trucks, poor transportation facilities, erratic electricity supply, and the lack of incentives to invest in the sector.

zh: 加尔各答印度管理学院（Indian Institute of Management）估算，只有10%的易腐败粮食产品能进入冷藏设备，这意味着3.7亿吨的易腐败粮食产品白暴露在高风险之中。
en: The Indian Institute of Management in Kolkata estimates that cold-storage facilities are available for only 10% of perishable food products, leaving around 370 million tons of perishable products at risk.

zh: FCI成立于1964年，其主要目的是执行价格支持制度、促进全国分销以及维护小麦和大米等主食储备。
en: The FCI was established in 1964 primarily to implement price-support systems, facilitate nationwide distribution, and maintain buffer stocks of staples like wheat and rice.

zh: 但管理不善、监督不力和腐败肆虐导致每年消耗印度1%的GDP的FCI倒成了问题的一部分。
en: But mismanagement, poor oversight, and rampant corruption means that the FCI, which gobbles up 1% of GDP, is now part of the problem. Former Food Minister K. V. Thomas called it a “white elephant” that needs to be revamped “from top to bottom.”

zh: 前粮食部长托马斯（K. V. Thomas）称之为需要“彻底”推倒重来的“大白象 ” 。
en: But the government has instead tried to end shortages by increasing production, without considering that up to half of the food will be lost.

zh: 如果放任35—40%的粮食产出烂掉，印度将无法找到足够的适耕土地、灌溉和能源为印度未来17亿人口提供足够的营养全面的食物。
en: India will not have enough arable land, irrigation, or energy to provide enough nutritious food to India’s future 1.7 billion people if 35-40% of food output is left to rot.

zh: 因此，莫迪的新政府应该考虑另辟蹊径解决印度的粮食危机。
en: The new Modi government should therefore consider alternative ways to solve India’s food crisis.

zh: 第三世界的饮水问题
en: The Third World’s Drinking Problem

zh: 新加坡—最近，世界经济论坛在达沃斯发���了其第九期年度《全球风险 》 （ Global Risks）报告，该报告是在调查了700多位商界领袖、政府官员和非盈利组织官员关于未来十年世界最严峻风险的看法的基础上写成的。
en: SINGAPORE – During its recent gathering in Davos, the World Economic Forum released its ninth annual Global Risks report, which relies on a survey of more than 700 business leaders, government officials, and non-profit actors to identify the world’s most serious risks in the next decade.

zh: 也许最令人瞩目的是，今年的十大威胁中有四个与水有关。
en: Perhaps most remarkable, four of the ten threats listed this year are water-related.

zh: 这些风险包括因旱灾和洪灾造成的水危机、水质量恶化、水管理不力、无法遏制和适应气候变化、极端天气变化多发、粮食危机（至少部分因水短缺导致 ） 。
en: These risks include water crises stemming from droughts and floods, the deterioration of water quality, and poor water management; failure to mitigate and adapt to climate change; higher incidence of extreme weather events; and food crises, driven at least partly by water shortages.

zh: 但该报告没有列出最紧迫的与水有关的担忧：确保足够多的饮用水。
en: But the report fails to highlight the most pressing water-related concern: ensuring enough potable water.

zh: 此外，尽管国际组织意识到了这个问题，但它们纠正这一问题的方针是完全错误的。
en: Moreover, while international organizations recognize the problem, their approach to addressing it is entirely wrong.

zh: 2012年，联合国宣布千年发展目标（Millennium Development Goals）中关于让无法获得安全饮用水的人数减少一半的目标已经提前完成，目前只有7.83亿人仍然无法获得清洁水。
en: In 2012, the United Nations announced that the Millennium Development Goals’ target of halving the number of people without sustainable access to safe drinking water had been achieved well ahead of schedule, with only 783 million people still lacking access to clean water.

zh: 但第三世界水管理中心（Third World Center for Water Management）估计全世界至少有三十亿人仍在引诱质量可疑的水。
en: But the Third World Center for Water Management estimates that at least three billion people worldwide still drink water of dubious quality.

zh: 代表私人水务公司的AquaFed认为这一数字高达34亿人 — — 接近全球人口的一半。
en: AquaFed, which represents private water companies, puts this figure at 3.4 billion – nearly half the world’s population.

zh: 这表明联合国宣布胜利之举至少是操之过急了。
en: This suggests that the UN’s declaration of victory was premature, to say the least.

zh: 证据随处可见。
en: There is no shortage of evidence.

zh: 2011年，中国一大半大型湖泊和河流被认为不适合人类使用。
en: In 2011, more than half of China’s largest lakes and rivers were deemed unfit for human consumption.

zh: 去年，中国环保部承认“有毒有害化学污染导致众多环境灾害、减少了饮用水供给，甚至导致了‘癌症村’等严重的健康和社会问题。 ”
en: Last year, China’s Ministry of Environmental Protection admitted that “toxic and hazardous chemical pollution has caused many environmental disasters, cutting off drinking-water supplies and even leading to severe health and social problems, such as ‘cancer villages.’”

zh: 印度的情况也好不到哪里去，国家机构中央污染控制委员会（Central Pollution Control Board）报告，用化学需氧量（水的有机质量指标之一）和大肠杆菌数量衡量，去年全印度445条河流中的近一半污染过于严重，不再安全。
en: India’s situation is not much better, with the state-run Central Pollution Control Board reporting last year that nearly half of the country’s 445 rivers are too polluted in terms of biochemical oxygen demand (an indicator of the organic quality of water) and coliform bacteria to be safely consumed.

zh: 如果考虑其他污染物 — — 硝酸盐、氟化物、杀虫剂和重金属等 — — 这一数字将更加触目惊心。
en: If other pollutants – such as nitrates, fluorides, pesticides, and heavy metals – were considered, the figure would be significantly higher.

zh: 类似地，巴基斯坦国民大会指出，在去年该国水供应系统的抽样调查中，有72%不适合人类引用，77%的城市地下水和86%的农村地下水有害。
en: Likewise, Pakistan’s National Assembly was informed last year that 72% of samples collected from the country’s water-delivery systems were unfit for human consumption, with 77% of groundwater in urban areas and 86% in rural areas deemed hazardous.

zh: 在尼泊尔，给排水部（Department of Water Supply and Sewerage）指出，该国85%的传统水供给系统含有大量的细菌、铁、锰和氨。
en: In Nepal, the Department of Water Supply and Sewerage has concluded that 85% of its traditional water-supply systems are seriously contaminated with bacteria, iron, manganese, and ammonia.

zh: 与此同时，在墨西哥，2013年其近25,000座水厂中有90%在破产状态下运营。
en: Meanwhile, in Mexico, 90% of the country’s nearly 25,000 water utilities were operating in a state of bankruptcy in 2013.

zh: 国际组织方针的问题在于它们吧“改善的水源”这一模糊的概念和真正的清洁安全的饮用水混同起来。
en: The problem with international organizations’ approach is that they conflate the vague notion of “improved water sources” with genuinely clean, safe drinking water.

zh: 同理，它们还稀释了“改善的下水道”的目标。 这一目标的本意是收集、处理和安全排放废水，而国际组织的方针是改善居民家中的厕所。
en: In the same way, they have diluted the goal of “improved sanitation” – the process of collecting, treating, and safely discharging wastewater – by applying it to indoor toilets in people’s homes.

zh: 这掩盖了下水道和到位的肥水管理之间的重大差异。
en: This glosses over a major discrepancy between sanitation and adequate wastewater management.

zh: 印度德里地区的家庭中有90%据称拥有到位的下水道，因为它们拥有室内厕所，但几乎所有废水都不经处理即排入了亚穆纳河（Yamuna River ） ， 而该河是下游城市的饮用水源。
en: While nearly 90% of the households in the Indian region of Delhi are said to have adequate sanitation, because they have indoor toilets, nearly all of the untreated wastewater is discharged to the Yamuna River – a source of drinking water for cities downstream.

zh: 类似地，墨西哥城被认为下水道建设水平很高的城市，但该市下水道系统将富含病菌和有毒化学物质的未经处理的废水排入梅兹奎塔尔河谷（Mezquital Valley ） ， 然后被用于灌溉庄稼。
en: Likewise, Mexico City is considered to have a high level of sanitation, even though it transports untreated wastewater, loaded with pathogens and toxic chemicals, to the Mezquital Valley, where it is used to irrigate crops.

zh: 事实上，第三世界水管理中心估计，拉丁美洲的本地和工业废水中只有10—12%得到了合理的管理。
en: In fact, the Third World Center for Water Management estimates that only about 10-12% of domestic and industrial wastewater produced in Latin America is properly managed.

zh: 亚洲发展中国家的状况可能也是如此，非洲则更加糟糕。
en: The situation is probably very similar in developing countries in Asia, and likely worse in Africa.

zh: 2011年，印度中央污染委员会（Central Pollution Control Board of India）的一项调查显示，在其8,000个城镇中只有160个同时拥有排水系统和污水处理厂。
en: In 2011, a survey by the Central Pollution Control Board of India indicated that only 160 of 8,000 towns had both a sewerage system and a sewage-treatment plant.

zh: 此外，拜管理不力、维持工作不到位、设计不合理、电力供应跟不上以及员工的短缺、不胜任和玩忽职守等问题，大部分国有污水处理厂都无法正常运转，大部分时间是关着的。
en: Furthermore, most government-owned sewage plants are non-functional or closed most of the time, owing to bad management, poor maintenance, faulty design, lack of regular electricity supply, and absent, untrained, or uncaring employees.

zh: 类似地，2012年，中国住房和城乡建设部报告说，尽管647个城市中的640个以及73%的农村地区拥有废水处理设施，但377处一年内建成项目达不到国家要求，平均运行效率还不到60 % 。
en: Similarly, China’s Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development reported in 2012 that while 640 of 647 cities and roughly 73% of counties had wastewater-treatment facilities, 377 plants built in the course of one year did not meet national requirements, and that the average operating efficiency was less than 60%.

zh: 住房和城乡建设部还发现，只有12%的废水处理厂符合1A级标准。
en: The ministry also found that only 12% of the plants met Grade 1A standards.

zh: 个中原因并非知识、技术或专家的紧缺，也不是投资不足。
en: This does not reflect a dearth of knowledge, technology, or expertise. Nor can it be blamed on a lack of investment.

zh: 2006—2011年，中国投资了1,124亿美元用于水基础设施建设，印度也将大量公共资金用于亚穆纳河的清洁工作。
en: China spent $112.4 billion on water infrastructure in the 2006-2011 period, and India has channeled massive amounts of public funds toward cleaning up the Yamuna River.

zh: 但两国的水供给仍然污染严重。
en: Yet both countries’ water supplies remain highly polluted.

zh: 世界水和下水道挑战决不是不能克服的。
en: The world’s water and sanitation challenges are by no means insurmountable.

zh: 解决这两个问题需要保持政治意愿，政府应该组建强势水机构、保证公共资金的使用尽可能提高效率。
en: Resolving them will require sustained political will, with governments building strong water institutions and ensuring that public funds are used as effectively as possible.

zh: 与此同时，公众必须认识到他们可以获得更好的水服务，只要他们愿意通过税收、关税和转移支付贡献自己的力量。
en: At the same time, the public must recognize that they can have better water services, if they are willing to contribute through taxes, tariffs, and transfers.

zh: 媒体也应该强调功能健全的水供应和废水管理系统的好处 — — 并且在政客和官僚没能做好三分三时起到问责作用。
en: For their part, the media must stress the benefits of functional water-delivery and wastewater-management systems – and hold politicians and bureaucrats accountable if they fail to do their part.

zh: 最后，水专家应该将注意力从增加水供给转向更加可持续地供应更好的水。
en: Finally, water professionals need to shift their focus from providing more water to providing better water more sustainably.

zh: 不能在一代人的时间里解决好水挑战将带来前所未见的全球危机，采取行动刻不容缓。
en: Given that failing to address the water challenge would, within a generation, bring about a global crisis of unprecedented proportions, such efforts could not be more urgent.

zh: 塞浦路斯问题的立刻解决
en: A Solution Now for Cyprus

zh: 纽约 — —
en: NEW YORK – For four decades, Ledra Street in the heart of Nicosia had been a symbol of a divided Cyprus. And then, two years ago this April, the wall that split the capital into north and south was opened.

zh: 四十年来，位于尼科西亚市中心的莱德拉街始终是塞浦路斯分裂的象征；而在两年前的那个四月，将首都分为南北两部分的高墙终于被打开了缺口。
en: Last week, I visited the Ledra Street crossing. Officially, I was there to inaugurate a reconstruction plan for buildings that had fallen into disrepair in the old buffer zone.

zh: 慢慢地，四十四年来从未交往过的民众，终于能够开始重新塑造联系并再度认识对方。
en: More personally, I wanted to see for myself the divide that for too long had kept Greek Cypriots and Turkish Cypriots apart.

zh: 这条街道便是一个窗口，它向人们展示了未来所能带来的变化。
en: As I walked the street, people from both communities crowded around and began chanting, “Solution now! Solution now!”

zh: 上周，我访问了莱德拉街过境点。
en: As a Korean, I know only too well the pain of a land divided.

zh: 此行的官方目的是为一项重建计划揭幕，该计划旨在对老缓冲区内那些年久失修的建筑加以重建；而另一个更为私人的目的则是：我想亲眼见到这道在过去太长时间内、令希腊族塞浦路斯人与土耳其族塞浦路斯人无法往来的阻隔。
en: I also know how difficult reconciliation can be.

zh: 当我漫步街头时，来自两方的民众聚拢于此，并开始高喊 ： “ 立刻解决！ 立刻解决！
en: That is why I went to Cyprus – to show my personal support for the efforts to reunify the island, and to push for further progress.

zh: 身为韩国人，我对于分裂的痛苦再清楚不过；我也明白和解的难度之大。
en: Cyprus is at a critical juncture.

zh: 而这也正是我来到塞浦路斯的原因：我要对实现该岛统一的努力表达个人的支持，同时还要推动进一步的进展。
en: The Greek Cypriot leader, Demetris Christofias, and his Turkish Cypriot counterpart, Mehmet Ali Talat, are working hard to reach an agreement. But it will elude them without a further concerted push.

zh: 希腊族塞浦路斯人领袖季米特里斯赫里斯托菲亚斯与土耳其族塞浦路斯人领袖麦赫迈特·阿里·塔拉特正在为达成协议而艰苦努力；但若没有进一步的协力推动，双方恐将与成功失之交臂。
en: The United Nations is in Cyprus to help however it can.UN Peacekeepers have stood watch for more than 45 years. My envoy, Alexander Downer, is facilitating the negotiations.

zh: 联合国正在塞浦路斯提供一切可能的援助。
en: I had lengthy discussions with both leaders – individually and together – and told them that the destiny of Cyprus is entirely in their hands.

zh: 联合国维和人员执行监督任务已超过四十五年；而我的特使亚历山大·唐纳也正在推动谈判。
en: I believe that a solution is within reach.

zh: 我已与双方领导人进行了长时间的讨论（其中既包括单独讨论，也包括双方都在场的讨论 ） ， 我向他们说明：塞浦路斯的命运完全掌握在其手中。
en: First, there is a strong, shared commitment between Christofias and Talat. They have met almost 70 times over the past 16 months, including two weeks of intensive talks immediately prior to my visit.

zh: 首先，赫里斯托菲亚斯与塔拉特之间存在着强烈的共同责任感。
en: Second, negotiators are finding common ground.

zh: 双方在过去十六个月时间内有过近七十次会面；其中，就在我此次访问之前，双方还进行了为期两周的密集谈判。
en: While I was there, the leaders joined together in highlighting progress that they have already made on crucial issues such as governance and power-sharing.

zh: 其次，谈判者们正在寻找共同立场。
en: Third, both sides are staying at the table.

zh: 我在塞浦路斯期间，双方领导人共同强调了他们在诸如治理与权力分享等关键议题上所取得的进展。
en: As the leaders have said, “Time is not on the side of settlement.” That is why they have committed to continue their talks, rather than pause ahead of the upcoming elections in the north in April.

zh: 正如这些领导人所言 ： “ 解决问题，时不我待。 ”因此，他们已做出承诺：将不会在四月份塞浦路斯北部举行选举之前暂停谈判，谈判将继续进行。
en: Finally, Greece and Turkey – the two key regional actors – support the current talks and are willing to be helpful in finding a solution.

zh: 最后，希腊与土耳其这两个关键的区域行为体对目前的谈判给予了支持，并愿意为寻找解决方案提供一臂之力。
en: No one is under the illusion that any of this is easy – peace negotiations never are. The issues are exceedingly complex and embedded in a troubled history.

zh: 塞浦路斯所涉及的问题极为复杂，而这些问题又处于历史乱局的背景之中。 每一阶段都会出现怀疑者和批评者，我们还会遭遇到那些为了追求自身利益与目标、而试图令和平进程偏离方向或被迫中止的人士。
en: There will be skeptics and critics every step, and there will be those who seek to divert or derail the process in pursuit of their own interests and agendas.

zh: 领导人在追寻心中的正义之道时，勇气与信念必不可少。
en: Courage and conviction will be required of leaders to do what they know to be right.

zh: 他们所达成的任何一项协定，都将接受希、土两族塞浦路斯社群的公投考验。
en: Any agreement will face a popular referendum within both the Greek Cypriot and Turkish Cypriot communities.

zh: 不过显而易见的是，塞浦路斯问题的解决将极大地符合该岛民众的利益，南北双方都不例外。
en: Yet it is clear that a solution to the Cyprus problem would be overwhelmingly in the interests of the island’s people, North and South.

zh: 问题的解决也将向全世界发出一种信号：就连塞浦路斯这般漫长而复杂的纷争，都可以通过和平方式得到解决。
en: A settlement would also send a message to the world that disputes as long-standing and complex as that in Cyprus can be resolved peacefully.

zh: 因此，尽管障碍重重，但谈判者们仍必须在通向和平的道路上坚持前进。
en: That is why, despite all the obstacles, the negotiators must persevere along the road to peace.

zh: 民众在莱德拉街所发出的呼声，绝不能被人忽略。
en: The people’s call on Ledra Street must be heard.

zh: 对于塞浦路斯而言，目前正是一个“立刻解决”的时机。
en: For Cyprus, it is time for a “solution now.”

zh: 南亚的宏伟协议
en: A South Asian Grand Bargain

zh: 新德里—南亚充斥着多边对抗和相互怀疑。
en: NEW DELHI – South Asia is riddled with multiple antagonisms and mutual suspicions.

zh: 印度不相信巴基斯坦，反之亦然。
en: India mistrusts Pakistan, and vice versa.

zh: 阿富汗和巴基斯坦处于对立之中。
en: Afghanistan and Pakistan are at loggerheads.

zh: 在其他阵线上，中国、伊朗和俄罗斯无不出于自身利益和牵制美国的考虑对阿富汗虎视眈眈。
en: On the sidelines, China, Iran, and Russia look to Afghanistan for opportunities to help themselves, and crimp the United States.

zh: 与此同时，美国人正准备从打了十年仗的阿富汗山区和村庄中撤走。
en: The Americans, meanwhile, are preparing to retreat from a decade of war in the Afghan hills and valleys.

zh: 在这些敌对状况中，我认为唯一的地区和平和稳定之道并非日渐膨胀的协定，而是一份协调所有势力最高国家安全利益的“宏伟协议 ” 。
en: Given all of these rivalries, I believe that the only path to regional peace and stability runs not through incremental agreements, but through a “grand accord” that reconciles all of the powers’ deepest national-security interests.

zh: 但这样的协议可行吗？
en: But is such an accord feasible?

zh: 从表面上看不可行。
en: On the surface, one would not think so.

zh: 美国-巴基斯坦关系已经转恶，两国政府已开始相互攻讦。
en: US-Pakistan relations have turned poisonous, with blunt statements proliferating from both governments.

zh: 最近，在伊斯坦布尔，阿富汗的忧心忡忡的“邻居”们聚集在一起，最后只发布了一个不痛不痒的声明，为今年晚些时候的波恩会议做准备。
en: In Istanbul, a recent gathering of Afghanistan’s concerned “neighbors” produced only a rather anodyne statement in preparation for a meeting in Bonn later this year.

zh: 在如此外交乱象下，只有两个现实选择：要么任争端在各自领域闹到不可开交，要么在矛盾集中爆发前给该地区的冲突降温。
en: When confronted by such a diplomatic snarl, there are, in reality, only two options: either allow the disputes to boil in their own cauldrons, or lower the temperature on all of the region’s antagonisms before a cataclysmic explosion occurs.

zh: 显然，眼下的外交冷漠现状必须结束；要不然将给全球带来不可承受之重。
en: Clearly, today’s frozen regional diplomacy must end; far too much of global importance is at stake.

zh: 印度、巴基斯坦、阿富汗和美国组成了一个南亚关系矩形，而印度、中国和美国则组成了一个不仅包括南亚，同时也是全球斗争中心舞台的三角。
en: India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, and the US form a rectangle of relationships in South Asia, with India, China, and the US constituting a triangle that not only contains the South Asia region, but is also a major theater in an increasingly global struggle.

zh: 印度洋所浮现出的地缘政治向心力 — — 以其不断增长的世界贸易吞吐份额为表征 — — 是第三大复杂因素。
en: The emerging geopolitical centrality of the Indian Ocean, through which an ever-increasing share of world trade passes, is a third, complicating, factor.

zh: 解构这一网络并给施以合作秩序应当成为所有国家的日程重点。
en: Untangling this web, and imparting to it a cooperative order, should be high on the agenda of all countries involved.

zh: 以印度、巴基斯坦阿富汗和美国为例。
en: Consider India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, and the US.

zh: 这些关系可以转换为类似合作的关系吗？
en: Can these relationships be transformed into anything resembling a cooperative effort?

zh: 实事求是地说，美国-巴基斯坦关系正处于历史最低点。
en: To be sure, US-Pakistani relations now appear at an all-time low.

zh: 前参议长联席会议主席马伦（Mike Mullen）海军上将在国会听证会上猛烈抨击巴基斯坦背信弃义，支持恐怖主义，他的证词加深了双方的猜疑，即便是国务卿希拉里·克林顿对伊斯兰堡的高规格造访也没能让关系有所改善。
en: Bitter congressional testimony by former Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff Admiral Mike Mullen about Pakistani perfidy in supporting terrorism deepened suspicion on both sides, which a high-profile visit to Islamabad by Secretary of State Hillary Clinton did little to ameliorate.

zh: 另一方面，希拉里重申了早先的警告：巴基斯坦不要“蹚浑水 ” 。
en: On the contrary, Clinton reiterated an earlier warning to Pakistan against keeping “snakes in the backyard.”

zh: 毫不奇怪，巴基斯坦对这样的言论怒不可遏；巴基斯坦人收到了警示。
en: Not surprisingly, Pakistan has reacted angrily to such statements; they are also alarmed.

zh: 巴基斯坦军队总司令卡亚尼提醒美国不要干预北瓦济里斯坦的反恐事务。
en: General Ashfaq Parvez Kayani, Pakistan’s army chief, cautioned the US against intervening in the terrorist bastion of North Waziristan.

zh: “美国最好三思而后行 ” ， 他说。
en: “The US must think 10 times” before doing so, he said.

zh: 前巴基斯坦情报机构首脑古尔（Hamid Gul）更加犀利，警告美国“有挑起第三次世界大战的危险 ” 。
en: General Hamid Gul, a former head of Pakistan’s Inter-Services Intelligence, went further, warning the US of the “dangers of a third world war.”

zh: 乱上加乱的是阿富汗政府与塔利班的首席和平谈判员、前总统拉巴尼的遇刺。
en: In the midst of this turmoil came the assassination of the Afghan government’s chief peace negotiator with the Taliban, former President Burhanuddin Rabbani.

zh: 拉巴尼遇刺后不久，愤怒的总统卡尔扎伊与印度签署了“战略合作伙伴”协议（不过事后他又安慰性地说 ， “ 巴基斯坦是我们的同胞手足 ” ） 。
en: Soon after, an outraged President Hamid Karzai signed a “strategic partnership” agreement with India (though he added, as a placatory afterthought, that “Pakistan is our twin brother”).

zh: 长期战争可以通过三种方式结束：无条件投降和强迫和平；有条件和解（如朝鲜战争和越南战争 ） ； 以及协调各方利益的外交手段。
en: Long wars can end in one of three ways: unconditional surrender and an imposed peace; a conditional settlement, such as in Korea or Vietnam; or a diplomatic solution that reconciles all of the concerned parties’ interests.

zh: 如果南亚想踏上未来的和平和繁荣之路，最后一种方式是唯一可行的办法。
en: If South Asia is to begin to build a future of peace and prosperity, the latter option is the only viable way forward.

zh: 尽管美国和巴基斯坦之间冷眼相对、恶语相向，但分道扬镳对双方来说都是不可能的。
en: Despite the blunt rhetoric and cold stares between the US and Pakistan, a parting of ways between the two is simply not feasible.

zh: 美国正在撤出阿富汗，但并不是胜利班师。
en: America is leaving Afghanistan, but without victory.

zh: 因此与巴基斯坦这个与印度和阿富汗都能和平共存的国家达成一致是必须完成的任务。
en: So reaching some agreement with Pakistan, one that both India and Afghanistan can live with, is essential.

zh: 重塑南亚邻国间的和平和秩序，这符合印度和美国的直接利益（尽管有所不同 ） 。
en: Both India and the US have a direct – albeit different – interest in restoring peace and order to the South Asian neighborhood.

zh: 正如罗伯特·卡普兰（Robert Kaplan）所指出的 ： “ 稳定阿富汗局势比针对基地组织和塔利班的反恐战争更重要；这事关确保整个（地区的）未来繁荣，还能缓和印巴关系，促使它们通过共享能源管道实现和平共存。 ”
en: As Robert Kaplan argues: “stabilizing Afghanistan is about much more than just the anti-terrorist war against al-Qaeda and the Taliban; it is about securing the future prosperity of the whole [region], as well as easing India and Pakistan toward peaceful coexistence through the sharing of energy routes.”

zh: 不过，完整的地区和解方案需要处理好更广的利益圈。
en: A comprehensive regional settlement, however, requires dealing with a wider circle of interests.

zh: 特别是中印关系不能朝战略对峙越走越远。
en: Sino-Indian relations, in particular, can no longer be allowed to drift toward strategic antagonism.

zh: 但这正是两国关系的变化方向，因为中国正在寻求保证其在印度洋的海上霸权。
en: Yet that is where the bilateral relationship is headed, given China’s efforts to secure maritime supremacy in the Indian Ocean.

zh: 中国可能会指出，其印度洋海军建设只是为了确保输送中国经济所需资源的海运线的安全。
en: China may reason that its naval build-up in the Indian Ocean is only about protecting sea lanes vital to shipping the resources that its economy needs.

zh: 但印度等国难免会认为中国怀有其他不可告人的目的，真正意图是包围印度。
en: But others, like India, are bound to see something more sinister afoot, an effort at encirclement.

zh: 毕竟部署军力是为了潜在的使用，而不是为了证明其存在的合理性。
en: After all, military power is about its potential use, not the rationalizations for its existence.

zh: 随着双边贸易的发展和消除贫困的共同承诺，印度河中国可以找到共同目标，合作创造双方都能接受的南亚和印度洋地缘政治地图。
en: With their burgeoning bilateral trade and shared commitment to eradicating poverty, both India and China have common cause to cooperate in creating a mutually acceptable geopolitical map of South Asia and the Indian Ocean.

zh: 当然，这并不意味着印度和中国能够或应该停止竞争。
en: Of course, this is not to suggest that competition between India and China can or should cease.

zh: 但它们的商业和政治利益有诸多重叠之处，只要两国政府抓住机会，就大有形成妥协的希望。 中国在鼓励巴基斯坦与印度和美国就阿富汗的未来达成一致的问题上起到了推动作用，这是一个良好的开端，且压制恐怖分子使其无法经巴基斯坦或阿富汗向新疆自治区渗透对中国来说也不无裨益。
en: But their overlapping layers of commercial and political interests do offer hope for agreement – if the two governments seize the opportunity.  Chinese assistance in encouraging Pakistan to reach agreement with India and the US on Afghanistan’s future is a good place to start, and will also benefit Chinese security by crimping the ability of terrorists to infiltrate China’s Xinxiang province from either Pakistan or Afghanistan

zh: 希拉里最近抛出了“稳固而有建设性的印度、美国和中国关系”的愿景。
en: Clinton recently offered a vision of a “strong, constructive relationship among India, the US, and China.”

zh: 她现实地承认，建设这样的关系很困难，因为“在不少重大问题上我们彼此道不相同 ” 。
en: She admitted, realistically, that building one will be difficult because “there are important matters on which we all disagree.”

zh: 但她还指出了“具有共同利益的重要领域 ” ， 认为“如果我们想修正、治理或解决21世纪最紧迫的问题，印度、中国和美国就必须合作 … … 共事 ” 。
en: Yet she also pointed to “significant areas of common interest,” arguing that, “if we want to address, manage, or solve some of the most pressing issues of the twenty-first century, India, China, and the US will have to coordinate our…efforts.”

zh: 南亚的宏伟协议前景就摆在我们面前。
en: The prospect of a grand accord for South Asia is before us.

zh: 这一思想可谓正逢其时，因为你找不到其他摆脱冲突的替代方案。
en: It is an idea whose time has come, because there is no longer an alternative path from conflict.

zh: 驾驭特朗普时代
en: Navigating the Trumpscape

zh: 华盛顿—说美国总统特朗普的政府在执政的前几周掀起了一点波澜，这是太谦虚了。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – To say that US President Donald Trump’s administration made waves in its initial weeks would be an understatement.

zh: 从他发表就职演说开始，美国和全世界的大规模示威游行就没有断过。
en: Large protests across the United States and around the world attended his inauguration, and have continued since.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普已经向与他对立的美国媒体开战，与友邦领导人的电话也常常不欢而散。
en: Meanwhile, Trump has already declared war on the adversarial American press, and held acrimonious telephone conversations with friendly countries’ leaders.

zh: 但要领略新政府的总体表现，美国内外忧心忡忡又迷惑不解的观察家应该遵循五个一般原则，而不是过多地关注零散的事件。
en: But to make sense of the new administration’s overall performance, worried and perplexed observers inside the US and around the world should follow five general guidelines, rather than focus too much on discrete events.

zh: 首先，美国各届政府，履新时都会遭与混乱：它们会犯错误，制造困惑，说和做一些随后被自己推翻（至少后悔）的事情。
en: First, all new US administrations are messy at the beginning: they stumble, create confusion, and say and do things that they later retract, or at least regret.

zh: 一些官员不具备胜任能力，几个月后就会卸任。
en: Some officials will not be up to the job, and will leave the government after a few months.

zh: 总统任期伊始的诸多失着源自美国政治制度的一个缺陷。
en: Many of the missteps that occur early in a presidency stem from a flaw in the US political system.

zh: 新总统履新时，其团队还没有完全到位，必须等待内阁和其他官员 — — 真正管理政府的人 — — 提名人选获得确认。
en: New presidents take office without a full team in place, and must wait for their cabinet nominees and other officials – the people who actually run the government – to be confirmed.

zh: 在特朗普执政的前两周，他的班子只有白宫里的少数助手。
en: During Trump’s first two weeks, his administration consisted of just a few aides rattling around in the White House.

zh: 与前任政府一样，特朗普政府将部逐渐步入正轨 — — 除非它不这么做。
en: Like its predecessors, the Trump administration will settle down and settle in – unless it doesn’t.

zh: 第二个指导原则是紧盯外交政策。
en: A second guideline is to keep a close eye on foreign policy.

zh: 美国宪法规定了制衡制度，因此总统在如何干涉他国方面拥有远大于如何治理内政的自由度。
en: Owing to the checks and balances built into the American constitutional order, presidents have much wider latitude in how they engage with other countries than they do in steering domestic affairs.

zh: 平心而论，从特朗普上台的前几周看，他要给美国外交政策来一场颠覆。
en: To be sure, Trump’s first weeks portend disturbing changes to US foreign policy.

zh: 70年来，美国通过其盟友网络维持全球安全，通过自由贸易保持国际经济运行。
en: For 70 years, the US has maintained global security through its network of alliances, and kept the international economy humming through free trade.

zh: 选战期间，特朗普对这两个关键点都大肆抨击。
en: During the campaign, Trump attacked both of these crucial roles.

zh: 如果他的政府完全抛弃这两个原则的话，世界将变得更贫穷、更危险。
en: Should his administration abandon them entirely, the world will become a poorer, more dangerous place.

zh: 但新总统的大部分主要外交政策任命让人们感到有信心。
en: And yet most of the new president’s principal foreign-policy appointees inspire confidence.

zh: 国防部长詹姆斯·马蒂斯（James Mattis）是一名冷静持重、经验丰富、广受尊敬的前将军，具备国际视野。
en: Secretary of Defense James Mattis is a sober, experienced, and widely respected former general with an internationalist outlook.

zh: 国务卿蒂勒森尽管从未在政府中履职，但在担任大型跨国能源巨头埃克森美孚公司CEO期间积累了大量与其他国家打交道的经验。
en: Secretary of State Rex Tillerson, while never having served in government, gained extensive experience working with other countries when he was CEO of ExxonMobil, a large multinational energy company.

zh: 事实上，新政府保持连续性和国际稳定的能力将取决于它不因循前任。
en: In fact, the new administration’s ability to maintain continuity and international stability will depend on it not following the example set by its predecessor.

zh: 奥巴马担任总统该期间，高级官员被边缘化，外交政策主要由缺乏经验的总统和比他更加缺乏经验的年轻白宫助手们制定。
en: During Barack Obama’s presidency, senior officials were marginalized, and foreign policy was generally determined by an inexperienced president and his even less experienced young White House acolytes.

zh: 第三个需要时刻铭记的事实是特朗普面临的最棘手的反对不会来自叫嚣最厉害的反对者。
en: A third fact to keep in mind is that Trump’s most serious opposition will not come from his noisiest opponents.

zh: 公开示威不会让特朗普政府改变方针，反而有可能让它更加坚定地奉行反对声浪最大的政策。
en: Public demonstrations will not throw the Trump administration off course, and they could even steel its resolve to pursue the policies that have raised the most objections.

zh: 不要忘了，反越战示威运动比越战本身还要不受欢迎。
en: It is worth remembering that the protest movement against the Vietnam War was even more unpopular than the war itself.

zh: 和尼克松总统一样，特朗普可能会试图利用公众对破坏性、有时还会制造暴力的游行示威的反感来提高他的政策的支持度。
en: Like President Richard Nixon, Trump may try to exploit the public’s distaste for disruptive and occasionally violent protests to bolster support for his policies.

zh: 另一个最卖力的反对源头是主流媒体，它们攻讦特朗普政府比记忆中的任何一届政府都要更早、更强烈。
en: Another loud source of opposition is the mainstream press, which has attacked the Trump administration earlier and more forcefully than any new presidency in memory.

zh: 但是，媒体妨碍特朗普的能力有限，因为除了一直反对特朗普的沿海州和大都市地区，媒体在其他地区没什么信誉。
en: Still, the press’s capacity to stymie Trump is limited, because it lacks credibility outside of the coastal states and large metropolitan areas where people already oppose him.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普的正是反对者 — — 民主党 — — 力量孱弱，士气低落，还陷入了分裂。
en: Meanwhile, Trump’s formal opposition – the Democratic Party – is weak, demoralized, and divided.

zh: 但特朗普政府可能面临不同角度的强力反对。
en: But his administration could face formidable opposition from different quarters.

zh: 首先，他不可能脱离国会共和党来治国，而许多国会共和党将对他抛弃美国长期盟友的行为感到失望。
en: For starters, he cannot govern without Congressional Republicans, many of whom will frustrate any effort he makes to abandon America’s long-standing alliances.

zh: 特朗普可能还必须应对来自商业领袖的反对，他们目前基本保持沉默，但可能已经厌倦了特朗普“愤青”气质的推特。
en: Trump may also have to deal with opposition from business leaders, who have remained largely silent, but could grow tired of his wrathful tweets.

zh: 说到底，商业领袖有责任保持公司的健康，因此将竭力阻挠威胁公司健康的政策。
en: Ultimately, business leaders have a duty to their companies’ health, and they will try to block any policies that threaten it.

zh: 拥有大量海外业务的跨国公司将抵制可能引发贸易战的做法。
en: Multinational corporations with expansive international operations will resist initiatives that could spark trade wars.

zh: 总而言之，共和党政府不可能忽视美国产业和金融领头人的意见 — — 就连特朗普也不能。
en: At the end of the day, no Republican president – not even Trump – can afford to ignore the captains of American industry and finance.

zh: 第四个需要领会的教训是美国的民主不会消亡。
en: A fourth lesson to take to heart is that American democracy will survive.

zh: 有人充满恐怖地宣称法西斯正在萌芽（或已经发生 ） ， 这是不对的。
en: Fearful pronouncements about the rise of incipient (or actual) fascism are misplaced.

zh: 美国基本治理制度早已经历过远甚于特朗普所造成的挑战。
en: The basic institutions of American governance have survived greater challenges than any that Trump may pose.

zh: 尽管2017年的美国陷入了深度分裂，但美国人民仍然对民主的核心原则坚定不移：自由、公平、定期的选举以及对政治、宗教和经济自由的保护。
en: Although America in 2017 is deeply divided, Americans remain committed to the central tenets of democracy: free, fair, and regular elections and the protection of political, religious, and economic liberty.

zh: 特朗普不可能尝试颠覆这些原则中的任意一条；即使他真要尝试，也必将失败。
en: It is unlikely that Trump will attempt to overturn any of them; and even if he does try, he will fail.

zh: 在他离任的时候，美国将与他上任时没有什么本质区别：仍然是全世界最强大的民主国家。
en: When he leaves office, the US will essentially be what it was when he entered it: the world’s most powerful democracy.

zh: 最后一个需要考虑的关键问题是特朗普政府是否“正常 ” 。
en: Finally, a key question to consider is whether the Trump administration will be “normal.”

zh: 正常的总统采取投票给他的选民一般都会支持、不投票给他的选民一般都会反对的可预测的政策。
en: A normal president pursues predictable policies that are generally supported by those who voted for him, and opposed by those who did not.

zh: 特朗普的内阁和最高法院人选提名就符合这一情况。
en: Trump’s cabinet and Supreme Court nominations fit this description.

zh: 在正常范围内运行的政府将采取即使其支持者和对其怀有善意的人也会反对、将给美国以及全世界带来严重伤害的政策。
en: An administration operating outside the bounds of normality will pursue policies that even its supporters and well-wishers oppose, and which could do serious damage to the country, and the world generally.

zh: 特朗普会是一个正常的总统吗？
en: Will Trump’s presidency be normal?

zh: 从现在的情况看，我们还是得援引中国前总理周恩来在回答安德烈·马尔罗（André Malraux）关于对法国大革命看法的问题时所说的话 ： “ 现在下结论为时尚早。 ”
en: At this point, we must defer to the twentieth-century Chinese communist leader Zhou Enlai's purported response to André Malraux’s question about what he thought of the French Revolution: it’s “too early to say.”

zh: 占款的年代
en: The Bezzle Years

zh: 伦敦—半个多世纪前，约翰·肯尼斯·加尔布雷斯（John Kenneth Galbraith）用一部言简意赅的作品描写了1929年华尔街大崩盘。
en: LONDON – More than a half-century ago, John Kenneth Galbraith presented a definitive depiction of the Wall Street Crash of 1929 in a slim, elegantly written volume.

zh: 加尔布雷斯观察到，占款私用（embezzlement）有一种性质，即“罪行犯下和发现之间会有几周、几个月或几年的时滞。
en: Embezzlement, Galbraith observed, has the property that “weeks, months, or years elapse between the commission of the crime and its discovery.

zh: 顺便说一下，在这段时间里，私用者获得了收益，而被私用者没有感到损失。
en: This is the period, incidentally, when the embezzler has his gain and the man who has been embezzled feels no loss.

zh: 心里财富值存在一个净增长。
en: There is a net increase in psychic wealth.”

zh: ”加尔布雷斯将财富的这一增值称为“占款 ” （ bezzle ） 。
en: Galbraith described that increase in wealth as “the bezzle.”

zh: 沃伦·巴菲特的商业合伙人查理·芒格（Charlie Munger）写过一篇优美的文章，指出这一概念可以推而广之。
en: In a delightful essay, Warren Buffett’s business partner, Charlie Munger, pointed out that the concept can be extended much more widely.

zh: 这一心里财富可以在不违法的情况下创造出来：错误或自欺便已足够。
en: This psychic wealth can be created without illegality: mistake or self-delusion is enough.

zh: 芒格创造了“等价占款 ” （ febezzle）一词，或“占款的功能等价物 ” ， 来描述幻觉产生和毁灭期间所存在的财富。
en: Munger coined the term “febezzle,” or “functionally equivalent bezzle,” to describe the wealth that exists in the interval between the creation and the destruction of the illusion.

zh: 从这个角度讲，揭发假伦勃朗（Rembrandt）的批评家并没有为世界做出好事：这幅画作的拥有者蒙受了损失，潜在赏画者可能也“躺着中了枪 ” ， 但伦勃朗真迹的拥有者没有获得多少好处。
en: From this perspective, the critic who exposes a fake Rembrandt does the world no favor: The owner of the picture suffers a loss, as perhaps do potential viewers, and the owners of genuine Rembrandts gain little.

zh: 金融界对指出20世纪90年代末新经济（New Economy）泡沫，或者2008年全球金融危机前的信用扩张制造了规模巨大的等价占款的人可没有慈眉善目。
en: The finance sector did not look kindly on those who pointed out that the New Economy bubble of the late 1990s, or the credit expansion that preceded the 2008 global financial crisis, had created a large febezzle.

zh: 监管者和市场参与者都更容易从众。
en: It is easier for both regulators and market participants to follow the crowd.

zh: 只有勇敢的人才会站出来阻止期望通过彼此交易互联网股票致富的人，也只有勇敢的人才会否认人人都有拥有房子的机会，因为他们根本负担不起。
en: Only a brave person would stand in the way of those expecting to become rich by trading Internet stocks with one another, or would deny people the opportunity to own their own homes because they could not afford them.

zh: 占款的乐趣在于双方 — — 他们都不知道另一方的存在和角色 — — 可以享受同一笔财富。
en: The joy of the bezzle is that two people – each ignorant of the other’s existence and role – can enjoy the same wealth.

zh: 安然公司（Enron）的杰夫·斯基林（Jeff Skilling）为庆祝美国证券交易委员会（Securities and Exchange Commission）允许他用市场价值给长期能源合同记账而开的香槟是安然公司股东和债权人买的单，但他们直到十年后才知道这一点。
en: The champagne that Enron’s Jeff Skilling drank when the US Securities and Exchange Commission allowed him to mark long-term energy contracts to market was paid for by the company’s shareholders and creditors, but they would not know that until ten years later.

zh: 2006年，美国各大城市的家庭获得了他们根本无力偿还的按揭，而纳税人从未想过他们会被要求出手援助贷款人。
en: Households in US cities received mortgages in 2006 that they could never hope to repay, while taxpayers never dreamed that they would be called on to bail out the lenders.

zh: 银行股东绝不可能理解他们在2007年前所收到的股息实际上是他们从自己手中借的钱。
en: Shareholders in banks could not have understood that the dividends they received before 2007 were actually money that they had borrowed from themselves.

zh: 投资者们因为他们从价格高得离谱的互联网股票中所赚的利润而沾沾自喜。
en: Investors congratulated themselves on the profits they had earned from their vertiginously priced Internet stocks.

zh: 他们没有意识到，他们所赚到的钱会如同阳光下的冰雪一样融化殆尽。
en: They did not realize that the money they had made would melt away like snow in a warm spring.

zh: 当时，似乎每个人都真切地感受到被创造出来的短暂财富 — — 真到他们去花钱，真到伤及背负偿还这些财富的人受到伤害。
en: The stores of transitory wealth that were created seemed real enough to everyone at the time – real enough to spend, and real enough to hurt those who were obliged to pay them back.

zh: 公允价值会计成倍地放大了想象利润的机会，比如斯基林的天然气交易利润。
en: Fair value accounting has multiplied opportunities for imaginary earnings, such as Skilling’s profits on gas trading.

zh: 如果你用市值衡量利润，那么例如就是市场认为它将是多少。
en: If you measure profit by marking to market, then profit is what the market thinks it will be.

zh: 企业账户中所包含的信息 — — 应该是这些信息决定市场的看法 — — 将由市场本身得到。
en: The information contained in the accounts of the business – the information that should shape the market’s views – is to be derived from the market itself.

zh: 而市场容易受到暂时性群情激昂的影响 — — 对象可以是新兴市场债务，可以是互联网股票，可以是住房按揭支持证券，可以是希腊政府债务。
en: And the market is prone to temporary fits of shared enthusiasm – for emerging-market debt, for Internet stocks, for residential mortgage-backed securities, for Greek government debt.

zh: 交易员不需要等这些利润何时或是否实现。
en: Traders need not wait to see when or whether the profits materialize.

zh: 他们的口号是IGBYBG — — 什么都是浮云（I’ll be gone, you’ll be gone ） 。
en: IBGYBG, they say – I’ll be gone, you’ll be gone.

zh: 可谓条条大路通占款和等价占款。
en: There are numerous routes to bezzle and febezzle.

zh: 在庞氏骗局中，早期投资者盈利颇丰，他们的利润来自后来者的投入，直到参与者链断裂。
en: In a Ponzi scheme, early investors are handsomely rewarded at the expense of latecomers until the supply of participants is exhausted.

zh: 这类行为是非法的，比如伯纳德·麦道夫（Bernard Madoff）骗局，在功能上，它们与资产泡沫时期发生的事情是等价的。
en: Such practices, illegal as practiced by Bernard Madoff, are functionally equivalent to what happens during an asset-price bubble.

zh: 追尾，或在压路机前捡硬币，是另一种等价占款来源。
en: Tailgating, or picking up dimes in front of a steamroller, is another source of febezzle.

zh: 投资者寻找偶尔被大损失打断的稳定的小收益，一个例子是息差交易，比如投资者在德国和法国借入欧元，然后在希腊和葡萄牙贷出。
en: Investors search for regular small gains punctuated by occasional large losses, an approach exemplified by the carry trade by which investors borrowed euros in Germany and France to lend in Greece and Portugal.

zh: “鞅 ” （ martingale）策略让交易员加倍下注输掉的赌注，直到他们获胜 — — 或把钱输光。
en: The “martingale” doubles up on losing bets until the trader wins – or the money runs out.

zh: 被保安从交易桌旁架走的“流氓交易员”是典型的不成功的鞅策略的例子。
en: The “rogue traders” escorted from their desks by security guards are typically unsuccessful exponents of the martingale.

zh: 而在交易账户和银行账户之间切换的机会给了金融机构现成的实现利润和处置损失的机会。
en: And the opportunity to switch between the trading book and the banking book creates ready opportunities for financial institutions to realize gains and park losses.

zh: 2003-2007年期间的基本故事是，银行公告获得巨额盈利，并把其中相当大一部分用于奖励交易员和高级员工。
en: The essential story of the period from 2003 through 2007 is that banks announced large profits and paid a substantial share of them to their traders and senior employees.

zh: 然后它们发现这完全是一场错误，它们的股东或多或少损失惨重，并用纳税人的钱继续交易，直到达到报告利润的新水平。
en: Then they discovered that it had all been a mistake, more or less wiped out their shareholders, and used taxpayer money to trade their way through to new levels of reported profit.

zh: 欧元区危机的基本故事是，法国和德国银行对它们贷给南欧的钱报告利润，并将不良贷款转移给欧洲央行。
en: The essential story of the eurozone crisis is that banks in France and Germany reported profits on money they had lent to southern Europe and passed the bad loans to the European Central Bank.

zh: 在这两个故事中，交易员��从未来借钱。
en: In both narratives, traders borrowed money from the future.

zh: 接着未来成为现在（永远如此 ） ， 占款也露出了本质。
en: And then the future came, as it always does, turning the bezzle into a bummer.

zh: 美国会出什么问题？
en: What Could Go Wrong in America?

zh: 美国剑桥—尽管美国经济情况不错 — — 已经达到了事实上的充分就业，通胀率也接近2 % — —但充满不确定性的世界仍然值得我们考虑未来一年可能出现哪些状况。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Although the United States economy is in good shape – with essentially full employment and an inflation rate close to 2% – a world of uncertainty makes it worthwhile to consider what could go wrong in the year ahead.

zh: 毕竟，如果美国经济陷入大麻烦，就会对欧洲、日本和其他许多国家造成负面影响。
en: After all, if the US economy runs into serious trouble, there will be adverse consequences for Europe, Japan, and many other countries.

zh: 当然，经济问题可能源自国际政治事件。
en: Economic problems could of course originate from international political events.

zh: 俄罗斯一直在东欧和中欧玩火。
en: Russia has been acting dangerously in Eastern and Central Europe.

zh: 中国在东海和南海的领土主张及其在大东亚的政策正在增加地区不确定性。
en: China’s pursuit of territorial claims in the East and South China Seas, and its policies in East Asia more generally, is fueling regional uncertainty.

zh: 意大利的情况可能让欧元区陷入危机。
en: Events in Italy could precipitate a crisis in the eurozone.

zh: 但在美国国内，最大的风险是资产价格暴跌，这将累及家庭和企业，导致总需求崩塌。
en: But within the US, the greatest risk is a sharp decline in asset prices, which would squeeze households and firms, leading to a collapse of aggregate demand.

zh: 我并没有在预测会发生这样的情况。
en: I am not predicting that this will happen.

zh: 但随着资产价格涨势越来越脱离历史常态，情况也变得越来越危险。
en: But conditions are becoming more dangerous as asset prices rise further and further from historic norms.

zh: 用标准普尔500成分股市盈率衡量的股票价格目前比历史平均水平高出60 % 。
en: Equity prices, as measured by the price-earnings ratio of the S&P 500 stocks, are now nearly 60% above their historical average.

zh: 30年美国国债价格之高导致其收益率只有2.3 % ； 而考虑到当前的通胀预期，收益率应该比2.3%高出一倍。
en: The price of the 30-year Treasury bond is so high that it implies a yield of about 2.3%; given current inflation expectations, the yield should be about twice as high.

zh: 商业地产价格在过去五年中以每年10%的速度上涨。
en: Commercial real-estate prices have been rising at a 10% annual pace for the past five years.

zh: 这些资产价格的膨胀是近十年来异常宽松的货币政策的体现。
en: These inflated asset prices reflect the exceptionally easy monetary policy that has prevailed for almost a decade.

zh: 在极低利率环境中，投资者通过提高股票和其他投资资产的价格来追求收益。
en: In that ultra-low-interest environment, investors have been reaching for yield by bidding up the prices of equities and other investment assets.

zh: 由此带来的家庭财富的增长帮助经济复苏；但资产价格过高正在形成一个日益危险的环境。
en: The resulting increase in household wealth helped to bring about economic recovery; but overpriced assets are fostering an increasingly risky environment.

zh: 到底有多危险，我们来看一下。 如今美国家庭拥有21万亿美元股票，因此，股价下跌30%至历史平均水平意味着超过7.5万亿美元的损失。
en: To grasp how risky, consider this: US households now own $21 trillion of equities, so a 35% decline in equity prices to their historic average would involve a loss of more than $7.5 trillion.

zh: 退休基金和其他股票投资者将带来进一步损失。
en: Pension funds and other equity investors would incur further losses.

zh: 真实长期债券收益率向历史水平回归将给30年国债投资者带来大约30%的损失，短期债券投资者也将承受相应比例的损失。
en: A return of real long-term bond yields to their historic level would involve a loss of about 30% for investors in 30-year bonds and proportionately smaller losses for investors in shorter-duration bonds.

zh: 由于商业地产投资一般都伴随高杠杆，即使是相对较小的价格跌幅也可能给投资者带来巨大损失。
en: Because commercial real-estate investments are generally highly leveraged, even relatively small declines in prices could cause large losses for investors.

zh: 家庭财富的缩水将抑制支出，导致GDP下降。
en: The fall in household wealth would reduce spending and cause a decline in GDP.

zh: 粗略的经验法则表明，财富每缩水100美元，家庭支出将下降4美元。
en: A rough rule of thumb implies that every $100 decline in wealth leads to a $4 decline in household spending.

zh: 因此，资产价格回报率回归历史水平将导致消费支出下降4,000亿美元，约合GDP的2.5 % ， 这将开启一个收入和支出之间互相强化的下跌过程，导致GDP累计影响进一步扩大。
en: The return of asset prices to historic levels could therefore imply a decline of $400 billion in consumer spending, equal to about 2.5% of GDP, which would start a process of mutually reinforcing declines in incomes and spending leading to an even greater cumulative impact on GDP.

zh: 由于机构投资者应资产价格和资产收益率的国际差异而动，美国资产价格大跌将投射到其他发达国家资产价格上，使它们也发生类似的跌幅。
en: Because institutional investors respond to international differences in asset prices and asset yields, the large declines in US asset prices would be mirrored by similar declines in asset prices in other developed countries.

zh: 这些大跌将降低其他国家的收入和支出，其影响将通过进出口下降蔓延到全球。
en: Those price declines would reduce incomes and spending in other countries, with the impact spread globally through reduced imports and exports.

zh: 我必须强调，这一资产价格下跌过程及其所导致的经济活动的收缩是一种风险，而不是一个预测。
en: I must emphasize that this process of asset-price declines and the resulting contraction of economic activity is a risk, not a prediction.

zh: 有可能资产价格逐渐下跌，引起支出和经济活动减速而不是崩溃。
en: It is possible that asset prices will come down gradually, implying a slowdown rather than a collapse of spending and economic activity.

zh: 但关于触发资产价格暴跌的担忧是美联储不愿更快地的提高短期利率的重要原因之一。
en: But the fear of triggering a rapid decline in asset prices is one of the key reasons why the US Federal Reserve is reluctant to raise short-term interest rates more rapidly.

zh: 2015年12月，美联储将隔夜利率仅仅提高了0.25 % ， 2016年12月可能再次仅仅提高25个基点。
en: The Fed increased the overnight rate by just 0.25% in December 2015 and is likely to add just another 25 basis points in December 2016.

zh: 但联邦基金利率将仍保持在1%以下。
en: But that will still leave the federal funds rate at less than 1%.

zh: 在通胀率接近2%的情况下，真实联邦基金利率仍为负值。
en: With the inflation rate close to 2%, the real federal funds rate would still be negative.

zh: 市场参与者正在通过观察美联储判断利率正常化过程是否以及何时开始。
en: Market participants are watching the Fed to judge if and when the process of interest-rate normalization will begin.

zh: 历史经验表明，利率正常化将让长期利率提高大约两个百分点，导致债券、股票和商业地产价格发生剧烈调整。
en: Historical experience implies that normalization would raise long-term interest rates by about two percentage points, precipitating substantial corrections in the prices of bonds, stocks, and commercial real estate.

zh: 因此，美联储试图控制担心未来利率水平的预期，其办法就是指出人口和生产率趋势意味着未来利率会更低。
en: The Fed is therefore trying to tamp down expectations concerning future interest-rate levels, by suggesting that changes in demography and productivity trends imply lower real rates in the future.

zh: 如果美联储获得成功，那么资产价格���下跌也许微不足道。
en: If the Fed succeeds, the decline in asset prices may be diminished.

zh: 但资产价格暴跌并导致经济衰退的危险不容忽视。
en: But the danger of sharp asset-price declines that precipitate an economic downturn should not be ignored.

zh: 摩洛哥选择
en: The Morocco Option

zh: 拉巴特—阿拉伯之春爆发已经三年，民主世界对于如何应对变得更加迷茫了。
en: RABAT – Three years after the Arab Spring revolutions, the democratic world appears more confused than ever about how to respond.

zh: 美国国务卿克里再次启动了美国的中东调停计划，而美国与其最可靠伙伴之间分歧毕露：埃及军方领导人怨恨西方一开始支持穆斯林兄弟会的穆尔西任职总统；沙特阿拉伯担心与美国谈判的伊朗成为更有野心的地区霸权。
en: US Secretary of State John Kerry has re-launched American mediation efforts in the Middle East at a time when his country’s most reliable partners are estranged: Egypt’s military rulers resent the West’s early support for the Muslim Brotherhood’s Mohamed Morsi in his presidential tenure, and Saudi Arabia fears that an Iran that talks to the US may prove to be an even more ambitious regional hegemon.

zh: 在这样的背景下，摩洛哥国王穆罕默德六世召开了高规格会议 — — 圣城委员会（Al Quds Committee）并亲自主持。
en: It was against this background that Morocco’s King Mohammed VI recently convened a high-level meeting of the Al Quds Committee, which he chairs.

zh: 巴勒斯坦权力机构主席、与巴以和平进程有关的国家的高级外交官员、伊斯兰合作组织秘书长等人都将参加这次为期两天的峰会。
en: The Palestinian Authority’s president, senior diplomats of the countries involved in the Palestine-Israel peace process, and the secretary general of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation all attended the two-day summit.

zh: 在敏感地区的关键时刻召开的此次峰会将致力于重启谈判以及利用克里重启和平进程的努力。
en: Taking place at a critical moment for this sensitive region, the meeting constituted an effort to contribute to the renewed negotiations and build on Kerry’s efforts to revive the peace process.

zh: 摩洛哥是地区外交的理想场所。
en: Morocco is an ideal setting for regional diplomacy.

zh: 其渐进式改革、经济现代化和社会发展战略让它成为这片暴力和战略敌对地区的一片稳定绿洲 — — 因此也称为欧洲和美国在寻求影响北非和整个中东地区事态发展时的可靠伙伴。
en: Its strategy of gradual reform, economic modernization, and social development has made the country an oasis of stability in a region rife with violence and strategic rivalries – and thus a reliable partner for Europe and the United States as they seek to influence events in North Africa and across the Middle East.

zh: 事实上，毗邻欧洲让摩洛哥成为非洲的门户，其经济和地缘政治潜力尚未充分发掘。
en: Indeed, with Morocco’s proximity to Europe making it a gateway to Africa, its full economic and geopolitical potential has yet to be realized.

zh: 相反，埃及政府对被取缔的穆斯林兄弟会的镇压助长了无休止的动乱。
en: By contrast, the Egyptian government’s struggle to suppress the banned Muslim Brotherhood is fueling seemingly endless turmoil.

zh: 突尼斯仍没有选出首相领导看守政府，突尼斯总工会（Tunisian General Labor Union）所许诺居中调停的“国民对话”又将被推迟。
en: And Tunisia is still without a prime minister to head a caretaker government, further delaying the “national dialogue” that the Tunisian General Labor Union has agreed to mediate.

zh: 在革命爆发按年后，这两个国家仍没能起草被广泛接受的宪法。
en: Three years after the start of their revolutions, neither country has been able to draft a broadly acceptable constitution.

zh: 与此同时，阿尔及利亚将在4月进行总统选举，现任总统本特弗利卡（Abdelaziz Bouteflika）将再次参选。
en: Meanwhile, Algeria is preoccupied with the presidential election in April, in which the incumbent, Abdelaziz Bouteflika, will stand again.

zh: 毛里塔尼亚政坛陷入了两极分化，政府无法重塑信心。
en: Mauritanian politics is polarized, with the government unable to restore confidence.

zh: 利比亚正在内战边缘，并且陷入了事实上的分裂中。
en: Libya stands on the brink of civil war and de facto partition.

zh: 在更远的地方，叙利亚一片狼藉，人们看到的只有流血和哀嚎。
en: Farther afield, Syria is experiencing only bloodshed and sorrow.

zh: 摩洛哥改善国家福祉的渐进方针 — — 从十多年前开始悄然但坚决地开始了政治、经济和社会改革 — — 基础是压倒多数的公民支持。
en: Morocco’s evolutionary approach to improving the country’s well-being – quietly and resolutely building on the political, economic, and social reforms launched more than a decade ago – is backed by an overwhelming majority of citizens.

zh: 由国王提出并由2011年7月全民公投通过的新宪法建立了鲁棒的政治竞争。
en: A new constitution, proposed by the king and adopted in a referendum in July 2011, has already generated robust political competition.

zh: 与此同时，全国人本发展计划（National Initiative for Human Development）帮助摩洛哥最脆弱公民群体（特别是女性）摆脱贫困、融入社会。
en: Meanwhile, a new National Initiative for Human Development is helping to end poverty and social exclusion among Morocco’s most vulnerable citizens, especially women.

zh: 生活水平的提高和广泛的政治一致带来了刺激经济增长和多元化所需要的稳定。
en: Rising living standards and a broad political consensus have provided the stability needed to allow the economy to grow strongly and diversify.

zh: 摩洛哥国民收入逐渐但稳健地脱离了农业，从而让摩洛哥人不再会因为降雨和收成不足而受难。
en: Slowly but surely, national income is becoming less dependent on agriculture, thereby reducing Moroccans’ vulnerability to poor rainfall and failed harvests.

zh: 摩洛哥正在发展强大的加工业，特别是依托世界最大磷肥储量的肥料加工业。
en: The country is developing a strong processing industry, especially in fertilizers, based in part on having the world’s largest phosphate reserves.

zh: 纺织业也从欧洲危机所造成的减速中复苏，并正在渗透新的出口市场。
en: And the textiles industry, recovering from a slowdown caused by the European crisis, is penetrating new export markets.

zh: 旅游业也是如此。
en: A similar story can be told about tourism.

zh: 事实上，摩洛哥应该以其出口战略为傲。
en: Indeed, Morocco can be proud of its export strategy.

zh: 尽管全球经济状况萎靡，但摩洛哥的商品仍然行销全球，对法国、美国、巴西、海湾国家和中国的出口十分强劲。
en: Despite the weak global economy, Morocco sells its goods worldwide, with strong exports to France, the US, Brazil, the Gulf states, and China.

zh: 摩洛哥与欧洲、土耳其、约旦、阿联酋、埃及、突尼斯以及美国签署了自由贸易协议，也是该地区唯一一个与美国建立自由贸易关系的���家。
en: The country has free-trade agreements with Europe, Turkey, Jordan, the United Arab Emirates, Egypt, Tunisia, and – unique in the region – the US.

zh: 摩洛哥拥有可靠的基础设施条件、鲁棒的银行系统、坚挺的公共财政状况，通货膨胀率低，失业也处于可控水平。
en: Morocco boasts solid infrastructure, a robust banking system, sound public finances, low inflation, and manageable unemployment.

zh: 尽管资本纷纷流出该地区，但外国投资仍在持续流入。
en: Despite capital flight from much of the region, foreign investment continues to flow in.

zh: 显然，身处动荡地区的摩洛哥因为国内稳定而获益良多。
en: Clearly, Morocco is benefiting from being a stable country in a combustible region.

zh: 但其长期利益仍在于邻国的政治稳定和类似的经济改革，从而实现地区自由贸易，让整个地区都受益。
en: But its longer-term interests lie in having politically stable neighbors that embrace similar economic reforms, thereby opening the way for a free-trade area that would benefit the entire region.

zh: 地区前景自穆罕默德六世1999年继承王位以来已有所改善。
en: This regional perspective has been promoted ever since Mohammed acceded to the throne in 1999.

zh: 他的战略的一个重要组成部分是促进非洲内部经济关系。
en: One important part of his strategy has been to encourage intra-African economic relations.

zh: 摩洛哥向非洲大陆提供金融、通信、能源、农业和食品安全方面的专家；事实上，摩洛哥目前是非洲第二大投资者，仅次于南非。
en: Morocco already provides expertise in finance, telecoms, energy, agriculture, and food security across the continent; indeed, it is now Africa’s second-largest investor, after South Africa.

zh: 穆罕默德六世深谙地区文化和精神生活，这使他能够成为难得的顾问，特别是在伊斯兰教在现代社会中的角色这一问题上。
en: The king’s familiarity with the region’s cultural and spiritual life makes him an invaluable adviser, especially regarding the role of Islam in a modern society.

zh: 比如，摩洛哥提供开放伊斯兰教伊玛目的培训服务，目前，这一计划正在帮助马里走出最近的流血事件。
en: For example, Morocco helps train imams in a form of open Islam, which currently is helping Mali move on from its recent bloodletting.

zh: 这一宗教团结原则也扩展到摩洛哥的军事医院部署，不仅出现在马里，也出现在其他冲突地区，比如约旦就有服务叙利亚难民的摩洛哥军事医院。
en: This principle of regional solidarity extends to Morocco’s deployment of military hospitals not only in Mali but also in other conflict zones, such as one in Jordan that serves Syrian refugees.

zh: 摩洛哥是促进西北非和整个地区安全与发展的理想之选。
en: Morocco is well positioned to promote security and development across northwest Africa and beyond.

zh: 其稳定的政治、开放的经济和平衡的国际关系日益符合美国和欧洲的地区利益。
en: Its political stability, open economy, and balanced international relations are increasingly aligned with the regional interests of the US and Europe.

zh: 此外，摩洛哥也是美国长期、忠实的盟友。
en: Moreover, Morocco is a loyal and longstanding US ally.

zh: 在这个危险而复杂的地区的培养一个摩洛哥这样的天然盟友对西方来说是一个绝佳的开端。
en: The West would do well to start cultivating a natural partner in such a dangerous and complex region.

zh: 欧元区的备选方案
en: A Standby Program for the Eurozone

zh: 芝加哥 — — 未来几周，欧元区危机会如何发展？
en: CHICAGO – How will the eurozone crisis play out in the next few weeks?

zh: 幸运的话，意大利将很快出现一个国民一致拥护的可信政府，西班牙将在11月形成一个握有改革大权的新政府，希腊也会拿出足够的措施安抚市场。
en: With luck, Italy may soon get a credible government of national unity, Spain will obtain a new government in November with a mandate for change, and Greece will do enough to avoid roiling the markets.

zh: 但所有这些都不一定靠得住。
en: But none of this can be relied upon.

zh: 那么，人们应该做些什么呢？
en: So, what needs to be done?

zh: 首先，欧元区银行必须来个资本重组。
en: First, eurozone banks have to be recapitalized.

zh: 其次，如果意大利和西班牙在未来一年左右的时间无法从市场中融资，那么必须成立向它们提供足够资金的渠道。
en: Second, enough funding must be available to meet Italy’s and Spain’s needs over the next year or so if their market access dries up.

zh: 第三，必须治理好当前全欧洲最疲软的希腊，防止其他欧元区外围国家受到传染。
en: And, third, Greece, now the sickest man of Europe, must be treated in a way that does not spread the infection to the other countries on the eurozone’s periphery.

zh: 所有这些都要求资金 — — 光是银行资本重组一项就要求数千亿欧元（不过，如果欧元区大国主权债务能更健康的话，此项资金需求会有所减少 ） 。
en: All of this requires financing – bank recapitalization alone could require hundreds of billions of euros (though these needs would be mitigated somewhat if the sovereign debt of large eurozone countries looked healthier).

zh: 从短期看，德国（以及北欧）不会再为其他国家掏腰包了。
en: In the short run, it is unlikely that Germany (and Northern Europe more generally) will put up more money for the others.

zh: 德国对于自己被要求支持不愿调整的国家感到十分不安，这些国家和德国不同，德国用多年的痛苦换来了竞争力：低工资有所增长以吸收前东德的工作人口；劳动力和退休金也得到了深刻的改革。
en: Germans are upset at being asked to support countries that do not seem to want to adjust – unlike Germany, which is competitive because it endured years of pain: low wage increases to absorb the former East Germany’s workers and deep labor-market and pension reforms.

zh: 而希腊富人不愿纳税，意大利议员也不愿削减所享受的待遇，这些都证实了德国的担心。
en: The unwillingness of the Greek rich to pay taxes, or of Italian parliamentarians to cut their own perks, confirms Germans’ fears.

zh: 与此同时，德国政客也没能很好地向人民解释德国从欧元中获得了多少好处。
en: At the same time, German politicians have done a poor job explaining to their people how much they have gained from the euro.

zh: 但我们必须直面现实。
en: But we are where we are.

zh: 欧洲愿意将欧洲金融稳定基金（EFSF）用于各种想象得到的新用途 — — 比如用于股权投资或作为第一损失保险。
en: A glimmer of hope is Europe’s willingness to use the European Financial Stability Facility (EFSF) imaginatively – as equity or first-loss cover.

zh: 显然，EFSF的部分资金将不得不用于对无法从市场融资的银行进行资本重组。
en: Clearly, some of the EFSF funds will have to go to recapitalize banks that cannot raise money from the markets.

zh: 在剩下的资金中，尚未承诺用于外围国家的部分可以用于支持那些将转手贷给意大利和西班牙的贷款。
en: As for the rest, the amounts that are not already committed to the peripheral countries could be used to support borrowing that can be lent onward to Italy and Spain.

zh: 不过，关于如何操作的问题，目前还没有达成一致。
en: There is, however, no consensus about how to do this.

zh: 有人提出让欧洲央行纳入EFSF，从提高而后者的融资规模。
en: Some propose bringing in the European Central Bank to leverage the EFSF’s funds.

zh: 这样会适得其反。
en: This is a recipe for trouble.

zh: 让欧洲央行扮演准财政部的角色将威胁到它的信誉，即使从某种程度上说这样做不会给欧洲央行造成什么损失。
en: Giving the ECB a quasi-fiscal role, even if it is somewhat insulated from losses, risks undermining its credibility.

zh: 而如果意大利得到了援助，那么不管它是多么需要这笔援助，未来欧洲央行行长、意大利人德拉基（Mario Draghi）都将遭到口诛笔伐。
en: And if Italy were helped, the incoming ECB President, Mario Draghi, an Italian, would be criticized, no matter how dire Italy’s need.

zh: 此外，融资必将伴随条件，而这些机构既不具备专业技能，也无法与高风险国家保持必要距离，根本不能要求或强行施加合适条件。
en: Moreover, financing would have to be accompanied by conditionality, and these institutions have neither the requisite expertise nor the necessary distance from the countries at risk to apply and enforce appropriate conditions.

zh: 最后，说到底，EFSF和欧洲央行都得依赖相同的欧元区资源来保证财政实力。
en: Finally, both the EFSF and the ECB ultimately rely on the same eurozone resources for their financial strength.

zh: 如果市场产生了大规模欧元区违约恐慌，就可能怀疑德国即使愿意，也没有必要的能力支持EFSF-欧洲央行合体。
en: If markets start panicking about large eurozone defaults, they could question whether even a willing Germany has the necessary capacity to support the EFSF-ECB combine.

zh: 换句话说，这些机构并不能提供可信的、不会引起通胀的外部实力来源。
en: Put differently, these institutions do not offer a credible, non-inflationary, external source of strength.

zh: 事实上，欧元区的问题可能很快就会膨胀到其成员国无法解决的程度。
en: Indeed, the eurozone’s problems might soon become too big for its members to address.

zh: 欧元区如何决策事关全球福祉。
en: The world has a stake in their resolution.

zh: 有一个机构能够为援助提供渠道，那就是IMF。
en: And it has an institution that can channel help: the International Monetary Fund.

zh: IMF可以根据其新借贷安排（NAB）成立一个特殊机构，其资本结构可以以EFSF为第一损失缓冲，以IMF的资本作为第二损失缓冲。
en: The IMF could set up a special vehicle along the lines of its New Arrangements to Borrow (NAB), which would be capitalized by a first-loss layer from the EFSF with the IMF’s own capital comprising a second layer.

zh: NAB类型的机构在需要时可以从包括美国和中国在内的各国借款，也可以通过金融市场融资。
en: This NAB-like vehicle could borrow as needed from countries, including the United States and China, as well as tap financial markets.

zh: 它将向意大利等流动性缺失国提供大规模信贷额度，同时要求旨在帮助它们重新以合理成本得到市场融资的条件。
en: It would offer large lines of credit to illiquid countries like Italy, with conditionality intended to help such countries resume borrowing from markets at reasonable cost.

zh: 之所以需要成立特殊机构，是因为所要求的资金数量远远超过了IMF成员国通常可以获得的规模，同时，要让该机构具有合理性，就必须如此安排：如果欧元区想要设法让其成员国得到如此数量的资金，它就必须承受潜在损失的一大部分。
en: A special vehicle is required because the amounts that must be made available far exceed what IMF members can usually access, and it is only right that if the eurozone seeks such amounts for its members, it should bear a significant portion of any potential losses.

zh: 与此同时，如果由欧元区提供的第一损失缓冲告罄，IMF的资本资源将继续支持NAV；这样一来，市场就会明白，欧元区以外的力量也能够被调动起来。
en: At the same time, the Fund’s capital resources would back the vehicle if the first-loss buffer provided by the eurozone were eroded; that way, the market would understand that strength from outside the eurozone can be brought to bear.

zh: IMF并不是给人们带来温暖和希望的慈善机构，但也并非如人们所指责的那样是冷血的财政紧缩鼓吹者。
en: The IMF is not an institution that inspires warm and cuddly feelings.

zh: 它应该站出来担起领导处理危机的重任，而不是躲在大后方。
en: But it is also not the mindless preacher of fiscal austerity that it is accused of being – and it should start taking the lead in managing the crisis, rather than holding up the rear.

zh: 欧元区需要独立的外部评估来估计需要做什么，并抢在银行挤兑苗头发展成不可控制之势之前迅速落实。
en: The eurozone needs an independent outside assessment of what needs to be done, and rapid implementation, before it is too late and the incipient bank runs become uncontrollable.

zh: 当然，IMF的行动必须得到其主宰者（即几个大国）的首肯。
en: Of course, the IMF cannot act without the permission of its masters, the large countries.

zh: 欧元区不应该再死要面子活受罪，应该承认需要帮助，并马上兑现已经做出的承诺。
en: The eurozone should suppress any wounded pride, acknowledge that it needs help, and provide quickly what it has already promised.

zh: 美国应该继续大力推行解决方案。
en: The US should continue pushing hard for a solution.

zh: 新兴市场国家也不应该置身事外，因为这也包括了对它们自己国家货币的保护。
en: And the emerging-market countries should pitch in too, once some safeguards for their money are in place.

zh: 如果这场危机得不到解决，谁也别想独善其身。
en: Unresolved, the crisis will spare no one.

zh: 作为欧元危机的发源地，希腊的债务几乎肯定必须重组。
en: As for the birthplace of the euro crisis, Greece’s debt will almost surely have to be restructured.

zh: 但在做出任何决定之前，应该为意大利和西班牙留好充足的资金结构。
en: But adequate funding structures for Italy and Spain must be in place before any resolution.

zh: 因此，其他国家必须踊跃做好自己该做的部分，与此同时，如果希腊能够起死回生，对全世界都是件大好事。
en: So, while others have to step forward to do their part, it is best if Greece steps back from the brink.

zh: 被囚禁的明星
en: A Star is Jailed

zh: 曼谷 — — 被马尼拉的特别法庭裁定染指1500万美元的贿赂和回扣案后，含羞蒙耻的菲律宾前总统约瑟夫·埃斯特拉达（Joseph Estrada）可能会在监狱中渡过余生。
en: BANGKOK – Joseph Estrada, the disgraced former president of the Philippines, faces the prospect of spending his remaining years in prison after a special court in Manila found him guilty of amassing around US$15 million in bribes and kickbacks.

zh: 在从1998年中到2001年初统治菲律宾的30个月里，埃斯特拉达接受来自赌博巨头的贿赂 、 （ 以社会保险基金）人为操纵股票买卖，并将绝大多数利润存入了他个人的化名帐户。
en: During the 30 months he ruled his country, from mid-1998 to the start of 2001, Estrada accepted payoffs from gambling lords and orchestrated (with social security funds) sales of stocks, channeling much of the profits into his personal aliased account.

zh: 正是埃斯特拉达自己定义了“赃物”这个词的含义：20世纪90年代担任参议员时，他作为国会议员参与了宣判他有罪的法律的制定工作。
en: Estrada literally defined plunder: as a senator in the early 1990’s, he was a member of the congress that crafted the law under which he was convicted.

zh: 对于很多菲律宾人来讲，这里面有着太多的诗意，而且勿庸置疑比20世纪60年代埃斯特拉达主演的动作喜剧片具有更多的讽刺意味。
en: For many Filipinos, there is more than enough poetry in this fact, and certainly more irony than Estrada’s action-comedy movies of the 1960’s ever mustered.

zh: 法院一致裁定判处首位遭受刑事审判的菲律宾总统有罪的事实绝对不容小觑。
en: There is no underplaying the significance of the court’s unanimous decision to convict the first Philippine president ever to undergo a criminal trial.

zh: 这毕竟是在菲律宾，伊梅尔达·马科斯（Imelda Marcos）还在这片国土上轻松自由的生活。
en: This is, after all, the Philippines, where Imelda Marcos is still living free and easy.

zh: 尽管有大量证据表明她和已故的丈夫费迪南德·马科斯（Ferdinand Marcos）对大规模死亡、贫困、苦难和政府运转失常负有直接责任，但她所忍受的唯一一次真正的失望就是失掉了她参加的上一次总统选举。
en: Despite massive evidence of the widespread death, poverty, suffering, and dysfunction she and her late husband, the dictator Ferdinand Marcos, inflicted on the Philippines, the only real disappointment she has subsequently endured has been losing the last presidential election she was allowed to contest.

zh: 菲律宾并不是一个对权势人物遭受惩罚习以为常的国家。
en: The Philippines is not a country used to seeing powerful people punished.

zh: 当官员被指控或怀疑涉嫌腐败时，他们并不像在韩国或日本那样很快地辞去职务。
en: When officials are accused or suspected of corruption, they do not quickly resign, as in Korea or Japan.

zh: 恰恰相反，他们会通过参与总统选举来寻求豁免。
en: Instead, they often seek immunity by running for public office.

zh: 当针对科拉松·阿基诺（Corazon Aquino）初出茅庐的民主政府的血腥政变失败后，政变的领导者逃出了一所流动监狱 — — 而后成功当选参议员。
en: When a bloody coup against Corazon Aquino’s fledgling democratic government failed, the leader of the putsch escaped from a floating prison – and then successfully ran for senator.

zh: 菲律宾司法公正的车轮需要调整，这样的调整需求如此迫切，以至于该国的首席法官不久前召开了一次紧急会议，探讨在格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔·阿罗约（Gloria Macapagal Arroyo）总统统治下发生的对左翼人士、人权工作者和记者的不合法屠杀行为。
en: The wheels of Philippine justice need retooling, so much so that the country’s Chief Justice himself recently called for an emergency summit to discuss a rash of extra-judicial killings that have the claimed the lives of leftists, human rights workers, and journalists under President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo.

zh: 没有人被裁定要为这样的暴行负责。
en: There have been few convictions for these crimes.

zh: 但菲律宾人自己似乎根本无法想象将领导人送进监狱。
en: Yet Filipinos themselves simply cannot seem to imagine their leaders behind bars.

zh: 即便在法院宣布埃斯特拉达的判决结果前，民意调查仍显示有48%的菲律宾人希望阿罗约能给他特赦，至少也要对他从轻处理。
en: Even before Estrada’s conviction, opinion polls showed that 48% of Filipinos wanted clemency, if not a guaranteed pardon from Arroyo.

zh: 超过80%的民众表示不该让埃斯特拉达在豪华私人假期中郁郁不乐，过去六年中，他一直在私人宅邸等候判决结果的出台。
en: More than 80% said Estrada should be allowed to languish in a lush private family vacation home where he already spent the last six years awaiting his verdict.

zh: 对司法公正渴望的缺失是不是菲律宾文化、或者是后天行为的一个组成部分？
en: Is this lack of appetite for justice a part of Filipino culture, or learned behavior?

zh: 过度慈悲的天性是否阻碍了菲律宾人将这么多沉痛的历史篇章抛在脑后，还是因为每次作恶者都可以成功地逃避惩罚？
en: Has an overly forgiving nature prevented Filipinos from achieving closure in so many painful chapters of their history, or are the ravages of impunity to blame?

zh: 由于正义得以伸张的实例少之又少，而作恶者被轻易宽恕或者遗忘的例子却很多，也许菲律宾人无法要求自己根本无法想象的正义降临。
en: With so few examples of justice clearly dispensed, and overwhelmed by examples of villains so easily forgiven or forgotten, perhaps Filipinos could not bring themselves to demand what they could not imagine.

zh: 埃斯特拉达的判决向菲律宾民众展示了法治将带来怎样的社会结果。
en: Estrada’s conviction gives Filipinos the clearest illustration of what the rule of law may bring to their society.

zh: 埃斯特拉达至今仍然受到大众的喜爱，但截至目前为止公众对判决的反应非常柔和，几乎不带有任何暴力的色彩。
en: Estrada remains adored by the masses, but so far the public’s reaction to the verdict has been nonviolent and almost subdued.

zh: 尽管民意调查主张宽恕这位曾经的总统，但目前公众似乎不仅接受判决结果，而且把它当作公平系统的裁决结果而予以尊重。
en: Notwithstanding the opinion polls, it does seem as though the public not only accepts his conviction, but that they respect it as the outcome of a fair system that has been allowed to work.

zh: 这表明司法公正不仅在菲律宾仍有希望，同样重要的是表明菲律宾人会给予司法公正一个真正的发展机会。
en: This suggests not only that justice in the Philippines has a chance; equally important, it suggests that Filipinos will give justice a chance.

zh: 如果埃斯特拉达的传奇能带来尊严而切实的正义伸张，那么菲律宾人将会对同样的正义之举充满渴望。
en: If the Estrada saga leads to a firm yet dignified exercise of justice, Filipinos may discover a taste for more of the same.

zh: 失败的欧洲凯恩斯主义者
en: Europe’s Lost Keynesians

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 对欧元区所遭受的苦难来说，凯恩斯主义并不是什么灵丹妙药。
en: CAMBRIDGE – There is no magic Keynesian bullet for the eurozone’s woes.

zh: 而当前出现所谓过度紧缩正在扼杀欧洲的这种极端愚昧观点也毫不奇怪。
en: But the spectacularly muddle-headed argument nowadays that too much austerity is killing Europe is not surprising.

zh: 当“反紧缩”的民众显然相信有简单易行的周期性方法去解决困难的结构性问题时，评论家们被成为了政客的大棒，用以抨击所有可见的目标。
en: Commentators are consumed by politics, flailing away at any available target, while the “anti-austerity” masses apparently believe that there are easy cyclical solutions to tough structural problems.

zh: 我一直认为，欧元区的困难源自于欧洲的金融与货币一体化进程过度超前于实际的政治、财政和银行联盟。
en: The eurozone’s difficulties, I have long argued, stem from European financial and monetary integration having gotten too far ahead of actual political, fiscal, and banking union.

zh: 这并不是凯恩斯所熟悉的问题，更不是他试图要解决的那种问题。
en: This is not a problem with which Keynes was familiar, much less one that he sought to address.

zh: 首先，任何用来应对欧元区危机的可行策略都必须涉及大量外围国家债务的资产减值（或减免 ） 。
en: Above all, any realistic strategy for dealing with the eurozone crisis must involve massive write-downs (forgiveness) of peripheral countries’ debt.

zh: 而这些国家内部涉及大量银行及政府的合并债务 — — 这令欧洲各地的区别都变得模糊了 — — 使得快速可持续发展成为了一个不切实际的美梦。
en: These countries’ massive combined bank and government debt – the distinction everywhere in Europe has become blurred – makes rapid sustained growth a dream.

zh: 这绝不是我第一次强调要整体削减债务。
en: This is hardly the first time I have stressed the need for wholesale debt write-downs.

zh: 两年前，在一篇叫做“欧元的顽固大师们”的评论中，我写到 ： “ 欧洲处于宪政危机当中。
en: Two years ago, in a commentary called “The Euro’s Pig-Headed Masters,” I wrote that “Europe is in constitutional crisis.

zh: 似乎无人有权对其周边国家的债务危机强加可行的解决办法。
en: No one seems to have the power to impose a sensible resolution of its peripheral countries’ debt crisis.

zh: 政客和政策制定者们都在追求更庞大但其现实紧缩适用条件更加窄的救助方案，却不愿去大范围重整葡萄牙、爱尔兰和希腊（欧猪三国）显然不可持续的债务负担 ， 。 ”
en: Instead of restructuring the manifestly unsustainable debt burdens of Portugal, Ireland, and Greece (the PIGs), politicians and policymakers are pushing for ever-larger bailout packages with ever-less realistic austerity conditions.”

zh: 我以前的合著者卡门·莱恩哈特（Carmen Reinhart）也发表了类似的观点 — — 也许表达得更清晰。
en: My sometime co-author Carmen Reinhart makes the same point, perhaps even more clearly.

zh: 在2010年五月华盛顿邮报的一篇社论（与文森特·莱恩哈特合著）中，她描述了“与欧洲债务危机有关的五个谎言 ” — —其中第三个谎言就是：财政紧缩能解决欧洲的债务灾难。
en: In a May 2010 Washington Post editorial (co-authored with Vincent Reinhart), she described “Five Myths About the European Debt Crisis” – among them, “Myth #3: Fiscal austerity will solve Europe’s debt woes.”

zh: 我们在不同的情境下重复过好几十次这个说法，所有公正的观察家都可以证实这一点。
en: We have repeated the mantra dozens of times in various settings, as any fair observer would confirm.

zh: 在债务重整得过程中，欧元区北部国家（包括法国）将会看到好几千亿欧元化为乌有。
en: In a debt restructuring, the northern eurozone countries (including France) will see hundreds of billions of euros go up in smoke.

zh: 即使当局像其应该做的那样给硬性要求银行的大债权人承担大量损失，北部各国的纳税人也要被迫注入大量的资金到各大银行。
en: Northern taxpayers will be forced to inject massive amounts of capital into banks, even if the authorities impose significant losses on banks’ large and wholesale creditors, as well they should.

zh: 这好几千亿的欧元已经损失了，而假装它们没有消失的把戏不可能无限期地持续下去。
en: These hundreds of billions of euros are already lost, and the game of pretending otherwise cannot continue indefinitely.

zh: 要达到适度削减公共和私人债务负担的目的，一个比较温和的方法是让这些国家产生一段时期持续但温和的通货膨胀，正如2008年11月我在一篇名为“当前通货膨胀相对债务而言危害更小”的评论中所提议的一样。
en: A gentler way to achieve some modest reduction in public and private debt burdens would be to commit to a period of sustained but moderate inflation, as I recommended in December 2008 in a commentary entitled “Inflation is Now the Lesser Evil.”

zh: 持续温和通胀有助于更快降低房地产的实际价格，而且很可能会使德国的工资水平比欧元区外围国家上涨得更快。
en: Sustained moderate inflation would help to bring down the real value of real estate more quickly, and potentially make it easier for German wages to rise faster than those in peripheral countries.

zh: 在四年半前，这是一个妙策。
en: It would have been a great idea four and a half years ago.

zh: 现在也不失为一个好主意。
en: It remains a good idea today.

zh: 还需要做些什么呢？
en: What else needs to happen?

zh: 其它的步骤包括在国家层面进行经济调整以及欧元区的政治一体化。
en: The other steps involve economic restructuring at the national level and political integration of the eurozone.

zh: 在另一篇评论“无中心的欧元区行不通”中，我断定“如果没有进一步更深层次的政治和经济整合 — — 最终可能不会涵盖当前所有的欧元区成员国 — — 欧元甚至存活不到十年之后。 ”
en: In another commentary, “A Centerless Euro Cannot Hold,” I concluded that “without further profound political and economic integration – which may not end up including all current eurozone members – the euro may not make it even to the end of this decade.”

zh: 现在，所有人也许都在关注德国，但在决定欧元命运上起关键作用的其实是法国。
en: Here, all eyes may be on Germany, but today it is really France that will play the central role in deciding the euro’s fate.

zh: 德国无法长期单独背负起欧元的责任。
en: Germany cannot carry the euro on its shoulders alone indefinitely.

zh: 法国需要成为经济增长与稳定的第二个靠山。
en: France needs to become a second anchor of growth and stability.

zh: 暂时的凯恩斯需求方法也许有助于保持短期的内部增长，但它们不能解决法国长期的竞争力问题。
en: Temporary Keynesian demand measures may help to sustain short-run internal growth, but they will not solve France’s long-run competitiveness problems.

zh: 与此同时，法国和德国都必须就几十年内引起更大政治联盟的方法上达成一致。
en: At the same time, France and Germany must both come to terms with an approach that leads to far greater political union within a couple of decades.

zh: 否则，未来银行业联盟和财政转移支付将会无法取得必要的政治合法性。
en: Otherwise, the coming banking union and fiscal transfers will lack the necessary political legitimacy.

zh: 正如我的同事杰弗里·弗兰克尔（Jeffrey Frankel ）所说的一样，二十多年来，德国精英们都坚持认为欧元区不会成为一个转移支付联盟。
en: As my colleague Jeffrey Frankel has remarked, for more than 20 years, Germany’s elites have insisted that the eurozone will not be a transfer union.

zh: 但最终，事实证明普通德国民众是对的，而精英们错了。
en: But, in the end, ordinary Germans have been proved right, and the elites have been proved wrong.

zh: 确实，如果欧元区要生存下来，北部国家就需要用新的贷款来继续帮助其外围国家，直到这些国家可以再次从私人市场融资为止。
en: Indeed, if the eurozone is to survive, the northern countries will have to continue to help the periphery with new loans until access to private markets is restored.

zh: 所以，鉴于德国将会包揽更多的账单（无论欧元区是否能维持 ） ， 它如何能利用好其资产负债表的优势来减轻欧洲的经济增长问题？
en: So, given that Germany will be picking up many more bills (regardless of whether the eurozone survives), how can it best use the strength of its balance sheet to alleviate Europe’s growth problems?

zh: 当然，尽管它存在明显的隐性财政风险，德国也必须继续默许欧洲央行发挥更大的作用。
en: Certainly, Germany must continue to acquiesce in an ever-larger role for the European Central Bank, despite the obvious implicit fiscal risks.

zh: 没有人能保证前进的道路上会一路顺风。
en: There is no safe path forward.

zh: 现在广为流传着一些利用德国的低借贷成本来帮助其伙伴国家，而不是简单地扩大欧洲央行的资产负债表的方案。
en: There are a number of schemes floating around for leveraging Germany’s lower borrowing costs to help its partner countries, beyond simply expanding the ECB’s balance sheet.

zh: 然而，为了让责任分担起到作用，欧元区领导得停止幻想在没有更大的政治联盟的情况下单一货币还能存活二三十年。
en: For meaningful burden-sharing to work, however, eurozone leaders must stop dreaming that the single currency can survive another 20 or 30 years without much greater political union.

zh: 债务减免以及担保将不可避免地让德国政府债务膨胀起来，正如当局被迫拯救德国各大银行一样（很可能还有外围国家的银行 ） 。
en: Debt write-downs and guarantees will inevitably bloat Germany’s government debt, as the authorities are forced to bail out German banks (and probably some neighboring countries’ banks).

zh: 但对其行为背后的逻辑进行公开透明阐述并争取广泛认可的速度越快，长期成本就会越低。
en: But the sooner the underlying reality is made transparent and becomes widely recognized, the lower the long-run cost will be.

zh: 在我看来，利用德国资产负债表来直接援助其邻国比起假定中由德国主导的财政扩张所引发的“涓滴”效应更可能起作用。
en: To my mind, using Germany’s balance sheet to help its neighbors directly is far more likely to work than is the presumed “trickle-down” effect of a German-led fiscal expansion.

zh: 但不幸的是，近来关于欧洲的争论中正是缺乏这一点：不管反紧缩运动变得多么声势浩大，凯恩斯主义都不可能是解决单一货币债务和经济增长灾难的灵丹妙药。
en: This, unfortunately, is what has been lost in the debate about Europe of late: However loud and aggressive the anti-austerity movement becomes, there still will be no simple Keynesian cure for the single currency’s debt and growth woes.

zh: 欧元区求生指南
en: A Survival Strategy for the Eurozone

zh: 纽约 — — 继希腊、爱尔兰分别爆发危机之后，财政瘟疫传染到了葡萄牙、西班牙甚至意大利，欧元区已陷入严重危机之中。
en: NEW YORK – After the Greek and Irish crises and the spread of financial contagion to Portugal, Spain, and possibly even Italy, the eurozone is now in a serious crisis.

zh: 前景有三种可能：一是“蒙混过关 ” （ 继续现在的“贷款加祈祷 ” ） ；二是“分崩离析 ” （ 债务重组陷入无序状态，某些脆弱的成员国退出货币联盟 ） ； 三是“加强一体化 ” （ 预示着某种形式的财政联盟 ） 。
en: There are three possible scenarios: “muddle through,” based on the current approach of “lend and pray”; “break-up,” with disorderly debt restructurings and possible exit of weaker members; and “greater integration,” implying some form of fiscal union.

zh: 蒙混过关 — — 向困境中的成员国提供融资，附带财政调整和结构改革等条件，寄希望于它们仅仅是周转困难而非无力偿债 — — 只是一种不稳定非均衡状态。
en: The muddle-through scenario – with financing provided to member states in distress (conditional on fiscal adjustment and structural reforms), in the hope that they are illiquid but solvent – is an unstable disequilibrium.

zh: 说真的，如果体制改革和其他政策不能加强一体化程度，并很快恢复欧元区边缘国家的经济增长势头，这种非均衡状态就会转变为无序的分崩离析。
