en: Indeed, it could lead to the disorderly breakup scenario if institutional reforms and other policies leading to closer integration and restoration of growth in the eurozone’s periphery are not implemented soon.

zh: 危机的起因是私人部门过度负债和过高杠杆率，随着危机和衰退削弱财政状况，随着大部分私人亏损经由金融体系脱身计划而被摊派给全社会，私人债务危机演变为公共债务和公共赤字危机。
en: The crisis started with too much private debt and leverage, which became public debt and deficits as crisis and recession triggered fiscal deterioration and private losses were mostly socialized via bailouts of financial systems.

zh: 再后来，若干受到重创的政府（希腊和爱尔兰）丧失了市场融资能力，从国际货币基金（IMF）和欧盟得到救助。
en: Then, distressed sovereigns that had already lost market access – Greece and Ireland – were bailed out by the International Monetary Fund and the European Union.

zh: 但是，如果欧洲各国政府普遍陷入无力偿债的境地，又有谁来帮那些超政府机构脱身呢？
en: But no one will bail out these super-sovereigns if the sovereigns prove to be insolvent.

zh: 所以，眼下得过且过的办法很快会撞上南墙，到时候就需要另一套方案来拯救欧元区。
en: Thus, the current strategy of kicking the can down the road will soon reach its limits, and a different plan will be needed to save the eurozone.

zh: 机构改革已经迈出了第一步，其形式是建立一个官方资源的大池子，相当于一个准财政联盟。
en: The first institutional reform takes the form of a larger envelope of official resources, which would mean a quasi-fiscal union.

zh: 现有官方资源足够帮希腊、爱尔兰和葡萄牙脱困，但没办法防止市场对西班牙和其他欧元区问题成员国的短期国债和金融负债挤兑预期的自我实现。
en: Official resources currently are sufficient to bail out Greece, Ireland, and Portugal, but not to prevent a self-fulfilling run on the short-term sovereign and financial liabilities of Spain and other potentially distressed eurozone members.

zh: 所以，即使这些国家实施了必要的财政和结构改革，仍需要更多的官方资源。
en: So, even if these countries were to implement the necessary fiscal and structural reforms, an increase of official resources would nonetheless be needed.

zh: 紧张的投资者谁都不想沦为挤兑中的最后一名，如果官方资源不足，很可能出现无序争抢出路的情形。
en: Because nervous investors don’t want to be last in line in case of a run, a disorderly rush to the exits is likely when official resources are insufficient.

zh: 鉴于财政没有完全统一，也没有欧元区债券等替代形式，要增加官方资源可以通过大规模扩充欧洲金融稳定基金（European Financial Stability Facility）或由欧洲央行增持长期债、增加流动性操作等等方式来实现。
en: Short of full fiscal unification – or a variant of it in the form of eurozone bonds – this increase in official resources would occur through a much-enlarged European Financial Stability Facility and a much greater commitment by the European Central Bank to long-term bond purchases and liquidity operations to support banks.

zh: 由于准财政联盟意味着，欧元区核心经济体最终可能不得不系统性地帮边缘经济体脱困，只有边缘国家正式让渡部分财政主权 — — 承诺严守中长期财政纪律 — — 才能克服德国和其他核心国家目前的政治阻力。
en: Since quasi-fiscal union implies that the eurozone’s core economies could end up systematically bailing out those on the periphery, only a formal loss of fiscal sovereignty – a credible commitment by the peripheral countries to medium- and long-term fiscal discipline – could overcome the current political resistance of Germany and others.

zh: 可是，即便扩大官方资源池子也不足以解决希腊、爱尔兰以及葡萄牙和西班牙现存或潜在的无力偿债问题。
en: But even a larger envelope of official resources is not sufficient to stem the insolvency problems of Greece, Ireland, and, possibly, Portugal and Spain.

zh: 因此就需要第二轮政策和机构改革，来“打发”银行和其他金融机构的那些不安的债权人 — — 它们必须接受亏损的现实（也就是“割肉 ” ） 。
en: Thus, a second set of policies and institutional reforms requires that all unsecured creditors of banks and other financial institutions need to be “treated” – that is, they must accept losses (or “haircuts”) on their claims.

zh: 这是为了防止更多的私人债务被移入政府的资产负债表，造成新的财政冲击。
en: This is needed to prevent even more private debt being put on government balance sheets, causing a fiscal blowout.

zh: 如果这个过程中，需要建立一个新的跨境机制来清算资不抵债的欧洲银行，那就事不宜迟赶紧建立。
en: If orderly treatment of unsecured senior creditors requires a new cross-border regime to close down insolvent European banks, such a regime should be implemented without delay.

zh: 同样地，超政府机构不应继续救助那些资不抵债而不仅仅是周转不灵的政府了。
en: Similarly, super-sovereigns cannot continue to bail out distressed sovereigns that are insolvent rather than illiquid.

zh: 因此，在银行的有序解决机制之外，欧洲也应该尽早出台公债有序重组方案。
en: Thus, in addition to an orderly resolution regime for banks, Europe must also implement early orderly restructurings of distressed sovereigns’ public debt.

zh: 像德国总理默克尔提出的那样，等到2013年才来实施重组，会摧毁市场信心，因为那时候公债持有人不得不割掉更大的一块“肉 ” 。
en: Waiting until 2013 to implement these restructurings, as German Chancellor Angela Merkel proposes, will destroy confidence, as it implies a much larger haircut on residual private claims on sovereign borrowers.

zh: 因此，应当在2011年通过互换要约（exchange offers）执行有序的市场化重组。
en: Thus, orderly market-based restructurings via exchange offers need to occur in 2011.

zh: 如果做得够早，互换要约可以限制私人债权人的损失。
en: Such exchange offers can limit private creditors’ losses if they are done early.

zh: 通过提供延后到期且利率低于当前市场利率的新债券，可以避免现有债券面值的正式减计。
en: That way, formal haircuts on the face value of debt can be avoided via new bonds that include only a maturity extension and an interest-rate cap that is set below today’s unsustainable market rates.

zh: 坐等债务重组只会导致无序操作和私人债权人的沉重损失。
en: Waiting to restructure unsustainable debts would only lead to disorderly workouts and severe haircuts for some private creditors.

zh: 最后欧洲需要出台一系列政策，恢复欧元区边缘国家的出口竞争力和经济增长，这些国家的GDP要么仍在收缩（希腊、西班牙和爱尔兰 ） ， 要么增长乏力（意大利和葡萄牙 ） 。
en: Finally, Europe needs policies that restore competitiveness and growth to the eurozone’s periphery, where GDP is either still contracting (Greece, Spain, and Ireland) or barely growing (Italy and Portugal).

zh: 没有增长，就难以稳定公私债务和赤字的GDP占比 — — 财政稳定性的首要指标。
en: Without growth, it will be difficult to stabilize public and private debts and deficits as a share of GDP – the most important indicator of fiscal sustainability.

zh: 此外，没有增长，勒紧裤腰带的痛苦所激起的社会和政治抗议将最终瓦解财政瘦身和结构改革。
en: Moreover, without growth, the social and political backlash against painful belt-tightening will eventually undermine austerity and reform.

zh: 不幸的是，财政瘦身和结构改革具有引发衰退和通缩的效果 — — 至少短期上是如此。
en: Unfortunately, fiscal austerity and structural reforms are – at least in the short run – recessionary and deflationary.

zh: 所以需要有其他政策来重振增长。
en: So other policies are needed to restore growth.

zh: 欧洲央行应大大放松货币政策，推动一波增长，为启动改革做准备。
en: The ECB should pursue a much looser monetary policy to jump-start growth, with a weaker euro to help boost the periphery’s competitiveness.

zh: 此外，德国应延后本国的财政巩固，它应该维持若干年的减税政策，以促进本国经济增长，并通过贸易支持外围国家的增长。
en: In addition, Germany should delay its fiscal consolidation; if anything, it should cut taxes for a couple of years to boost its own growth and – via trade – that of the periphery.

zh: 今后的几个月内，我们将能看清，欧洲的决策者们是否能达成妥协，厉行改革，对抗危机，挽救欧元区。
en: In the next few months, it will become clear whether European policymakers can compromise and implement reforms that dampen the threat of a eurozone breakup.

zh: 欧洲要么走向更紧密的一体化（这是一个稳定均衡状态 ） ， 要么就得面对分崩离析的危险。
en: Either the EU moves in the direction of a more stable equilibrium of closer integration, or the risk of an unstable and disorderly breakup scenario will rise significantly.

zh: 可持续的复苏
en: A Sustainable Recovery

zh: 纽约－现在正在持续中的全球衰退，不仅仅是金融恐慌的结果，而且还是世界经济未来方向的更基本的不确定的结果。
en: NEW YORK – The global recession now underway is the result not only of a financial panic, but also of more basic uncertainty about the future direction of the world economy.

zh: 消费者在购买住房和汽车上紧缩开支，不仅仅是因为他们遭受了股票价格的下跌和房屋价值的下降对他们财富的冲击，也因为他们无所适从。
en: Consumers are pulling back from home and automobile purchases not only because they have suffered a blow to their wealth with declining stock prices and housing values, but also because they don’t know where to turn.

zh: 当汽油价格可能再次飙升的时候，消费者应该冒险买一辆新车吗？
en: Should they risk buying a new car when gasoline prices might soar again?

zh: 在今年可怕的食品价格上涨之后，消费者还有能力将食物放上餐桌吗？
en: Will they be able to put food on the table after this year’s terrifying rise in food prices?

zh: 有关商业投资的决定更为艰难。
en: Decisions about business investment are even starker.

zh: 各行业在消费者需求下降以及面临借款成本前所未有的风险损失时，都不愿意投资。 各种行业也面临着巨大的不确定性。
en: Businesses are reluctant to invest at a time when consumer demand is plummeting and they face unprecedented risk penalties on their borrowing costs.

zh: 在将来，什么样的发电站是可接受的呢？
en: They are also facing huge uncertainties.

zh: 这些发电站会被允许像过去那样排放二氧化碳吗？
en: What kinds of power plants will be acceptable in the future?

zh: 美国仍然支撑得住郊区的生活方式吗？
en: Will they be allowed to emit carbon dioxide as in the past?

zh: 在这种生活方式中，房子零乱地分布在遥远的社区里，人们返于工作地点和家之间需要长距离驾驶汽车。
en: Can the United States still afford a suburban lifestyle, with sprawling homes in far-flung communities that require long-distance automobile commutes?

zh: 在很大程度上，经济复苏将依赖于对未来经济变化方向更明确的感知。
en: To a large extent, economic recovery will depend on a much clearer sense of the direction of future economic change.

zh: 这主要是政府的责任。
en: That is largely the job of government.

zh: 在布什政府混乱而具有误导性的领导之后 — — 该政府没能给能源、健康、气候和金融政策任何清晰的路径，当选总统巴拉克·奥巴马将不得不开始一个确定美国经济未来方向的旅程。
en: After the confused and misguided leadership of the Bush administration, which failed to give any clear path to energy, health, climate, and financial policies, President-elect Barack Obama will have to start charting a course that defines the American economy’s future direction.

zh: 美国不是经济等式中唯一的经济体。
en: The US is not the only economy in this equation.

zh: 我们需要一个可持续经济复苏的全球视角，这一视角包括来自中国、印度、欧洲、拉丁美洲以及非洲 — — 对，长期从世界经济中边缘化，但是现在已经是其一部分的非洲 — — 的领导。
en: We need a global vision of sustainable recovery that includes leadership from China, India, Europe, Latin America, and, yes, even Africa, long marginalized from the world economy, but very much part of it now.

zh: 在巨大的不确定和混乱中，仍然有一些明确的观点。
en: There are a few clear points amidst the large uncertainties and confusions.

zh: 首先，美国再也不能像过去八年里那样向世界其他国家借贷了。
en: First, the US cannot continue borrowing from the rest of the world as it has for the past eight years.

zh: 美国的净出口将不得不增加，这意味着中国、日本和其他顺差国家的净出口将因此而减少。
en: America’s net exports will have to increase, meaning that the net exports of China, Japan, and other surplus countries will consequently decrease.

zh: 美国需要的调整相当于其经常账户大约7000亿美元的一个相当大的赤字－到－结余的转换，即约美国国民生产总值的5 % 。
en: The adjustments needed amount to a sizeable deficit-to-balance swing of around $700 billion in the US current account, or nearly 5% of US GNP.

zh: 中国的贸易顺差可能会减少上述数字的一半（贸易顺差的减少也会蔓延到世界其他地区 ） ， 这意味着中国国民生产总值向国内需求的转移，以及净出口占中国国民生产总值5%到10%的改变。
en: China’s trade surplus might shrink by half of that amount (with cuts in trade surpluses also spread over other global regions), meaning a shift in Chinese GNP toward internal demand and away from net exports equal to between 5% and 10% of China’s GNP.

zh: 幸运的是，中国正在推进一个重大的国内经济扩张计划。
en: Fortunately, China is promoting a major domestic expansion.

zh: 第二，美国消费的减少也应该会部分地被在美国投资的上升所抵消。
en: Second, the decline in US consumption should also be partly offset by a rise in US investment.

zh: 但是，除非有明确的经济政策方向，私营商业将不会逐步增加投资。
en: However, private business will not step up investment unless there is a clear policy direction for the economy.

zh: 奥巴马强调了“绿色复苏”的必要性，也就是说，建立在可持续技术，而不仅仅是消费支出基础上的经济复苏。
en: Obama has emphasized the need for a “green recovery,” that is, one based on sustainable technologies, not merely on consumption spending.

zh: 美国的汽车工业应该重组以生产低碳排放量的汽车，这种汽车可以是嵌入式混合动力或纯电池驱动的汽车。
en: The US auto industry should be re-tooled for low-carbon-emission automobiles, either plug-in hybrids or pure battery-operated vehicles.

zh: 这两种技术都将依赖使用低排放的发电能源 — — 例如风能、太阳能、核能或者能收集和储存二氧化碳排放的燃煤发电站的国家电网。
en: Either technology will depend on a national electricity grid that uses low-emission forms of power generation, such as wind, solar, nuclear, or coal-fired plants that capture and store the carbon-dioxide emissions.

zh: 所有这些技术都需要公共资金和私���投资。
en: All of these technologies will require public funding alongside private investment.

zh: 第三，除非有使政府自身的财政状况恢复良好状态的策略，否则，美国的复苏是不可靠的。
en: Third, the US recovery will not be credible unless there is also a strategy for getting the government’s own finances back in order.

zh: 乔治·沃克·布什经济政策的观念是，在增加战争支出的同时三次减税。
en: George W. Bush’s idea of economic policy was to cut taxes three times while boosting spending on war.

zh: 这样做的结果是巨大的预算赤字，预算赤字在接下来的一年内，会在更多的衰退、银行救援以及短期财政刺激措施的压力下变得数额巨大（或许会到1万亿美元 ） 。
en: The result is a massive budget deficit, which will expand to gargantuan proportions in the coming year (perhaps $1 trillion) under the added weight of recession, bank bailouts, and short-term fiscal stimulus measures.

zh: 奥巴马需要提出修复政府财政状况的中期财政计划。
en: Obama will need to put forward a medium-term fiscal plan that restores government finances.

zh: 该计划将包括结束在伊拉克的战争，增加富人的税费，以及逐步实施新消费税。
en: This will include ending the war in Iraq, raising taxes on the rich, and also gradually phasing in new consumption taxes.

zh: 美国现在在富裕国家中，对国民收入的征税比例最低。
en: The US currently collects the lowest ratio of taxes to national income among rich nations.

zh: 这一点将不得不发生改变。
en: This will have to change.

zh: 第四，世界的贫穷地区应该被看作是投资机会，而不应该被看作是威胁或应该忽略的地区。
en: Fourth, the world’s poor regions need to be seen as investment opportunities, not as threats or places to ignore.

zh: 在美国、欧洲和日本的主要基础设施建设公司存在严重的产能过剩的时候，世界银行、欧盟投资银行、美国进出口银行、非洲开发银行以及其他的公共投资基金应该为非洲进行大规模的基础设施建设支出贷款，以修建道路、发电厂、港口以及通信系统。
en: At a time when the major infrastructure companies of the US, Europe, and Japan will have serious excess capacity, the World Bank, the European Investment Bank, the US Export-Import Bank, the African Development Bank, and other public investment funds should be financing large-scale infrastructure spending in Africa, to build roads, power plants, ports, and telecommunications systems.

zh: 只要这样的贷款是长期的，并且利率适中（例如，25年的美元贷款，年利率5 % ） ，接受贷款的国家就能用在一代人的时间里大量增加的收入，来偿还贷款。
en: So long as the credits are long term and carry a modest interest rate (say, 25-year dollar loans at 5% per annum), the recipient countries could repay the loans out of the significant boost in incomes that would result over the course of a generation.

zh: 这对非洲和富裕国家来说，都有极大的好处 — — 可以使富裕国家的相关行业继续运转并使熟练工人回到工作岗位。
en: The benefits would be extraordinary, for both Africa and the rich countries, which would be putting their businesses and skilled workers back to work.

zh: 当然，在即使是蓝筹公司都不能隔夜借款，更不用说贷款期限长达25年的时候，这样的贷款需要重大的全球行动。
en: Such loans, of course, would require a major global initiative, at a time when even blue-chip companies cannot borrow overnight, much less for 25 years!

zh: 在典型的商业周期中，国家通常主要是独自处理经济复苏问题。
en: In typical business cycles, countries are usually left to manage the recovery largely on their own.

zh: 这次我们需要全球合作。
en: This time we will need global cooperation.

zh: 经济复苏需要在贸易不均衡、技术以及公共预算方面进行重大的改变。
en: Recovery will require major shifts in trade imbalances, technologies, and public budgets.

zh: 这些大规模的改变需要在主要经济体中协调起来，这样的协调即使是不紧密的，至少也要是非正式的。
en: These large-scale changes will have to be coordinated, at least informally if not tightly, among the major economies.

zh: 每个经济体都应该明白在国内层面和国际层面需要的变化的基本方向，所有的国家都应该分享新型可持续 技术的应用，以及分担在诸如增加非洲基础设施投资的全球责任中的共同出资。
en: Each should understand the basic directions of change that will be required at the national level and globally, and all nations must share in the deployment of new sustainable technologies and in the co-financing of global responsibilities, such as increased investments in African infrastructure.

zh: 我们已经身处历史上一个合作全球政治领导比任何时候都要重要的时刻。
en: We have arrived at a moment in history when cooperative global political leadership is more important than ever.

zh: 幸运的是，伴随着奥巴马的当选，美国已经向前迈出了巨大的一步。
en: Fortunately, the US has taken a huge step forward with Obama’s election.

zh: 现在是要采取行动的时候了。
en: Now to action.

zh: 美国经济的罗生门
en: A Tale of Two American Economies

zh: 纽约 — — 最新报告显示，美国第三季度GDP增长3.5 % ， 说明自大萧条以来最严重的衰退已经结束，尽管如此，美国经济实际上比数据所显示的情况差得多。
en: NEW YORK – While the United States recently reported 3.5% GDP growth in the third quarter, suggesting that the most severe recession since the Great Depression is over, the American economy is actually much weaker than official data suggest.

zh: 官方的统计数字很可能高估了经济增长水平，因为该统计忽略了一些重要事实，即小企业的经营情绪（business sentiment）极其低落，它们的产出仍在急剧下滑。
en: But official measures of GDP may grossly overstate growth in the economy as they don't capture the fact that business sentiment among small firms is abysmal and their output is still falling sharply.

zh: 如果根据这些因素加以修正，第三季度GDP增长本应只有2 % ， 而不是3.5 % 。
en: Third quarter GDP - properly corrected for these factors - may have been 2% rather than 3.5%.

zh: 说真的，美国经济说起来是一个经济，其实是两个经济。 其中一个比较小的经济是在慢慢复苏，而另一个较大的经济则仍在低谷中徘徊。
en: The story of the US is, indeed, one of two economies.  There is a smaller one that is slowly recovering and a larger one that is still in a deep and persistent downturn.

zh: 举两个例子就明白了。
en: Consider the following facts.

zh: 美国的官方失业率为10.2 % ， 已经够高了；但若把就业意愿丧失者（discouraged workers）和非全日制雇工也计算在内，该数字将跃升至17.5 % ， 可以说高得吓人。
en: While America’s official unemployment rate is already 10.2%, the figure jumps to a whopping 17.5% when discouraged workers and partially employed workers are included.

zh: 来自企业方面的调查数据显示，近三个月流失的工作岗位约有60万个；而来自家庭方面 — — 其中包括自由职业者和小企业主 — — 的调查结果则表明，工作岗位流失的数量超过200万。
en: And, while data from firms suggest that job losses in the last three months were about 600,000, household surveys, which include self-employed workers and small entrepreneurs, suggest that those losses were above two million.

zh: 此外，劳动收入（工作岗位数乘以平均小时工资）所受到的总体影响比工作岗位流失还要来得严重，很多企业靠缩短工时，批准休假或削减薪水把痛苦转嫁给员工。
en: Moreover, the total effect on labor income – the product of jobs times hours worked times average hourly wages – has been more severe than that implied by the job losses alone, because many firms are cutting their workers’ hours, placing them on furlough, or lowering their wages as a way to share the pain.

zh: 建筑业、金融业和外包制造与服务业中所流失的许多工作岗位是永久性丧失，最近的一些研究显示，随着时间的推移，美国有四分之一的工作岗位可能会完全转移到国外。
en: Many of the lost jobs – in construction, finance, and outsourced manufacturing and services – are gone forever, and recent studies suggest that a quarter of US jobs can be fully outsourced over time to other countries.

zh: 这样一来，劳动大军中就会有越来越多的人再也无法找到收入较高的工作，失业率（尤其是贫困、无技能的劳动者的失业率）将居高不下，比从前历次衰退都拖得久 — — 而这一部分人往往是被官方统计口径忽略掉的。
en: Thus, a growing proportion of the workforce – often below the radar screen of official statistics – is losing hope of finding gainful employment, while the unemployment rate (especially for poor, unskilled workers) will remain high for a much longer period of time than in previous recessions.

zh: 再想想信贷市场。
en: Consider also the credit markets.

zh: 拥有良好信用记录的优质借款人和被评为投资级的公司眼下没有信贷枯竭之虞，前者可以获得按揭贷款和消费贷款，后者可以在债券和股权市场上融资。
en: Prime borrowers with good credit scores and investment-grade firms are not experiencing a credit crunch at this point, as the former have access to mortgages and consumer credit while the latter have access to bond and equity markets.

zh: 可是涵盖三分之一美国家庭的非优质借款人没有太多机会获得按揭和信用卡贷款。
en: But non-prime borrowers – about one-third of US households – do not have much access to mortgages and credit cards.

zh: 他们只能靠工资来艰难度日，而且因为小时工资水平降低和工作时间缩短，那工资也会日益缩水。
en: They live from paycheck to paycheck – often a shrinking paycheck, owing to the decline in hourly wages and hours worked.

zh: 而被评为非投资级的公司和小公司，其融资通常是靠银行贷款而不是资本市场，它们仍然面临严峻的信贷枯竭形势。
en: And the credit crunch for non-investment-grade firms and smaller firms, which rely mostly on access to bank loans rather than capital markets, is still severe.

zh: 或者再想想家庭部门和企业部门的破产和违约情况。
en: Or consider bankruptcies and defaults by households and firms.

zh: 大公司，即便它们债台高筑，仍然能公开地或在私下里寻求到债务重组的方案。 但小企业正在以前所未有的数量走向破产。
en: Larger firms – even those with large debt problems – can refinance their excessive liabilities in court or out of court; but an unprecedented number of small businesses are going bankrupt.

zh: 家庭部门也一样，数以百万计的弱势、贫��借款人只能终止偿还其按揭贷款、信用卡贷款、汽车贷款、助学贷款以及其他形式的消费信贷。
en: The same holds for households, with millions of weaker and poorer borrowers defaulting on mortgages, credit cards, auto loans, student loans, and other forms of consumer credit.

zh: 还可以想想个人消费和零售业的处境。
en: Consider also what is happening to private consumption and retail sales.

zh: 最近的月度数据显示，零售业的销售额有所回升。
en: Recent monthly figures suggest a pick-up in retail sales.

zh: 但官方统计通常只考虑大零售商的销售额而排除数十万小商店和小买卖那不断下滑的销售额，所以销售的实际情况远不如表面显示的好。
en: But, because the official statistics capture mostly sales by larger retailers and exclude the fall in sales by hundreds of thousands of smaller stores and businesses that have failed, consumption looks better than it really is.

zh: 尽管高收入和富裕家庭的储蓄可以起到缓冲消费下滑的作用，它们也无须被迫进行储蓄，但低收入家庭则必须增加储蓄，因为银行和其他放贷人削减了房屋净值贷款，调低了信用卡额度。
en: And, while higher-income and wealthier households have a buffer of savings to smooth consumption and avoid having to increase savings, most lower-income households must save more, as banks and other lenders cut back on home-equity loans and lower limits on credit cards.

zh: 这就导致美国家庭部门的储蓄率由先前的零储蓄上升到可支配收入的4 % 。
en: As a result, the household savings rate has risen from zero to 4% of disposable income.

zh: 但该比率肯定还会继续上升，估计会上升至8 % ， 以降低家庭部门的高杠杆率。
en: But it must rise further, to 8%, in order to reduce the high leverage of household sector.

zh: 美国政府固然在增加预算赤字，以支撑需求。
en: To be sure, the US government is increasing its budget deficits to put a floor under demand.

zh: 但大多数州政府和地方政府的税收收入都遭遇暴跌，所以它们不得不大幅收缩开支，辞退警察、教师、消防队员，削减穷人的福利和社会服务。
en: But most state and local governments that have experienced a collapse in tax revenues must sharply retrench spending by firing policemen, teachers, and firefighters while also cutting welfare benefits and social services for the poor.

zh: 许多不那么富裕的州和地方的政府面临破产风险，除非联邦政府向提供大规模财政援助。
en: Many state and local governments in poorer regions of the country are at risk of bankruptcy unless the federal government undertakes a massive bailout of their finances.

zh: 此外，收入和财富不平等也再度扩大：贫困家庭面临更大的风险，失业、工资下降、工时削减都会造成劳动收入缩水；而华尔街那骇人听闻的奖金不但卷土重来，而且变本加厉。
en: Moreover, income and wealth inequality is rising again: poorer households are at greater risk of unemployment, falling wages, or reductions in hours worked, all leading to lower labor income, whereas on Wall Street outrageous bonuses have returned with a vengeance.

zh: 股价涨了，楼价还在跌；富人变得更富，中产阶级和贫困者则变得更穷，而且还被债务压得喘不过气来，因为他们的主要财富是房子而不是股票。
en: With the stock market rising while home prices are still falling, the wealthy are becoming richer, while the middle class and the poor – whose main wealth is a home rather than equities – are becoming poorer and being saddled with an unsustainable debt burden.

zh: 所以说，尽管美国经济的严重衰退从技术上说已接近尾声，但大多数美国人面临的是一个近乎萧条的悲观前景。
en: So, while the US may technically be close to the end of a severe recession, most of America is facing a near-depression.

zh: 在大多数美国人看来，当前美国经济是一只步履蹒跚的跛鸭，难怪很少有人会相信它是一只浴火重生的凤凰。
en: Little wonder, then, that few Americans believe that what walks like a duck and quacks like a duck is actually the phoenix of recovery.

zh: 关于两场选举的故事
en: A Tale of Two Elections

zh: 伦敦 — — 个人参与投票的选举不一定就是代表着民主，所以说在一个自由多元的社会里，投票箱虽然很重要，但也不能代表全部的民意。
en: LONDON – Individual elections do not always enhance democracy – a useful reminder that the ballot box is only one part, albeit a central one, in any free, plural society.

zh: 当然，也有一些有关选举正面的例子，淫威对社会的稳定和种族的和谐都有好处。
en: Of course, there are also magnificent examples of elections that strengthen both the stability and the institutions of a community.

zh: 我们刚刚见证了一个不一样的印度，作为世界上最大的和最伟大的民主体，国大党领导的政府赢得了由4亿2千万选民参加的选举，获得了压倒性的胜利。
en: We have just witnessed an example of the second kind in India, the world’s largest and greatest democracy, where 420 million voters there returned a Congress-led government with a solid majority.

zh: 从某些意义上来说，这也是印度总理曼莫汉·辛格的个人胜利。
en: It was in many respects a personal triumph for Prime Minister Manmohan Singh.

zh: 他的胜利表明，选举也可以通过有尊严，诚实和高智商地方式获得。
en: His victory shows that it is possible to succeed in politics through decency, honesty, and high intelligence.

zh: 为了推进在一个相互包容的多元社会的文明选举，而不是一个以阶层，种族，语言和宗教来分裂人群的选举，索尼娅·甘地和她的家族也有一定的贡献。
en: Sonia Gandhi and her family should also take credit for putting at the forefront of their campaign a vision of an inclusive society, which rejects divisions on the basis of caste, ethnicity, language, and religion.

zh: 这次选举的结果表明，印度经济发展将不受干扰，继续保持已有高成长性，它将为改善贫穷人口的生活水准质量继续努力。
en: The result should help India to continue – not without occasional turbulence – its journey toward becoming a high-growth economy that raises the standard and quality of life for the poor.

zh: 我希望在下个月举行的欧盟新一轮欧洲议员的选举中，能够有类似的良好局面出现。
en: I wish we could look forward in Europe to a similarly healthy democratic experience next month when voters throughout the European Union elect new members of the European Parliament.

zh: 自从1979年以来，欧洲议会的议员都是由各国的议会中直接而非间接选举产生。
en: Since 1979, these MEPs have been elected direct rather than indirectly from national parliaments.

zh: 但目前在一些欧盟国家中，此项选举投票率一直在下滑。
en: But turnout for these elections has been falling in several countries.

zh: 6月的选举的投票率有可能是有史以来最低的一次。
en: There is a danger that the number voting in June will be lower than ever before.

zh: 更有甚之，由于目前欧洲经济形势低迷，选民可能因此会放弃主流的执政党，而将手中的选票投给那些极端和非主流的政客。
en: Moreover, in the current grim economic conditions across Europe, voters who do turn out are all too likely to take the opportunity to punish the major parties and vote for fringe and even extremist politicians.

zh: 这里有一些潜在的思潮会影响到这次选举的结果。
en: There are particular circumstances that may encourage this electoral response.

zh: 首先，目前大家普遍的感觉是近期的经济增长只是少数个人从中受益，而随着经济泡沫的破灭，绝大多数人却为此买单。
en: First, everywhere there is a sense of disgust at the way the recent boom seemed to privatize gains while the subsequent bust socialized losses.

zh: 也就是说极少数富豪受益，而所有纳税人都受损。
en: A few rich individuals appeared to gain and all taxpayers to lose.

zh: 这就让人感到社会的不公平。
en: This has spread a sense of unfairness.

zh: 第二，全球化也成了目前一些人批评的靶子。
en: Second, globalization has been the target for populist criticism.

zh: 这些不满包括 — — 传统生活方式被改变，工作机会的丧失等。
en: It is usually defined to mean everything we dislike – from changes to our traditional way of life to loss of jobs.

zh: 这就更需要有勇气的政治家站出来指出，我们从自由贸易和开放市场中所获得的收益远远大于损失。
en: It is a brave politician who points out how much liberalizing trade and opening up markets have increased our overall prosperity.

zh: 第三，至少在英国，目前的政坛正受到一连串丑闻的困扰。 许多议员涉嫌滥用公务报销的权利。
en: Third, in Britain at least, the entire political class has been discredited by a sleazy scandal about the expenses that many parliamentarians have paid themselves.

zh: 有关此类新闻的负面报道充斥着英国报纸的 各个版面。
en: Analogies with pigs, snouts, and troughs fill the pages of British newspapers.

zh: 还有一些其他因素会导致对欧盟选举的漠视。
en: But there is another reason for the lack of interest in the EU elections.

zh: 例如，欧洲议会的议员们在处理有关选民的重大问题时，往往没有实际的权力。
en: The European Parliament has power, but it deals with issues that, while important to voters, do not top their list of concerns.

zh: 欧盟各成员国在一些敏感的政治议题，例如税收，健康教育，养老金，就业市场以及外交政策等方面，都有自己的决定权。
en: The EU’s member states retain power over the most sensitive political issues, including taxes, health, education, pensions, the labor market, and foreign policy.

zh: 各自国家的选举和欧洲议会选举似乎没什么关联
en: So the questions that dominate national campaigns have little impact on European elections.

zh: 在欧洲议会关心的重要问题上，例如贸易，泛欧洲共同市场的建立，以及重大的环境问题等议题上，各自的成员国也有权自行处置。
en: The European Parliament deals with the important areas where individual countries have pooled their sovereignty, like trade, the creation of a pan-European market, and the biggest environmental issues.

zh: 这些议题也都没有引起大家什么热烈的反响。
en: But these are not often the questions that trigger the most passionate interest.

zh: 另外，欧洲议会和各国议会的政治背离意味着其政治合法性的丧失。
en: In addition, the European Parliament’s detachment from national political debates means that it has less political legitimacy than is desirable.

zh: 那些担忧会出现欧洲大联盟国家的人可以休息了。
en: Indeed, those who worry about the creation of a European superstate can rest easy.

zh: 因为这里没有这样一个主体，也就没有一个欧洲选民的概念，只有法国选民，比利时选民，拉托维亚选民，希腊选民等。
en: There will be no such entity, because there is no European electorate; the electorate remains French, Belgian, Latvian, Greek, and so on.

zh: 他们都在同时投票，而且只选举自己的政府，例如，意大利人怎么会了解，或是会对英国的政治感兴趣么？
en: They all vote at the same time, for the same institution. But what does an Italian know – or care, for that matter – about British politics?

zh: 看看电视节目，我们对欧洲足球要比对欧洲政治的了解要多。
en: Look at our television programs. We know far more about Europe’s football than we do about Europe’s politics.

zh: 这些精彩的比赛相比欧洲议会来说，更能把人们吸引到一起，更能让大家感到可以信赖。
en: “The beautiful game” brings people together more effectively and reliably than the European Parliament is able to do.

zh: 当然，我们不能否认欧洲议会已经和正在作出的努力，他们也非常辛苦。
en: That is no criticism of those who work – often very hard – in the European Parliament.

zh: 我们创造了一个单一的欧洲政体模式，但是目前还没有一个让欧洲选民可以信赖的欧洲政体。
en: We have created a political body that has power to hold European institutions to account but has no obvious European electorate to which it can itself be held accountable.

zh: 在有关整个欧洲范围的议题上，很多欧洲选民对欧洲议会能否反映他们的呼声��感怀疑。
en: A parliament without a people inevitably increases the sense of frustration that many European voters feel about the process of making Europe-wide policy choices in their name.

zh: 今年晚一些时候，里斯本协定将被重新修订，我们应该增加各国议会参与欧洲事务决定权的比重。
en: If the Lisbon Treaty is ratified later this year, one of the changes should result in national parliaments becoming more involved in European decision-making.

zh: 应该根据各国的国情具体分析，如何将各自国家的议会和欧洲议会联系起来。
en: But we need to look country-by-country at what else we can do to tie Europe’s own parliament into national politics.

zh: 只有我们作出成绩出来，大家才会对欧盟选举感兴趣。 如果被选举出来的人只是来投反对票或是代表着欧洲黑暗势力的极端分子，那么整个欧洲民主的精神和进程都会蒙上阴影。
en: Unless we do that better, fewer people will vote for MEPs, more of them will be elected simply on a protest vote and represent Europe’s murky extremes, and the whole practice and principle of European democracy will be discredited.

zh: 双楼记
en: A Tale of Two Terminals

zh: 北京 — — 自从不久前启用以后，伦敦希斯罗机场5号航站楼就与失败结下了不解之缘。
en: BEIJING – Ever since it opened recently, Terminal 5 of London’s Heathrow Airport has been plagued with failures.

zh: 而在地球的另一端，比伦敦5号航站楼早一天全面启用的北京3号航站楼，运营情况几乎完美无瑕。
en: On the other side of the globe, Terminal 3 in Beijing, which opened for full operations just one day before Terminal 5, has been operating almost without a glitch.

zh: 不出所料，媒体对伦敦T5航站楼的失败大书特书，似乎已经无暇顾及北京T3航站楼的巨大成功。
en: The media, unsurprisingly, have feasted upon the failures of T5 in London, while neglecting the successes of T3 in Beijing.

zh: 无论以何种标准来衡量，北京T3航站楼与伦敦T5相比都有过之而无不及。
en: By all measures, Beijing’s T3 surpasses London’s T5.

zh: 伦敦T5每小时包裹处理能力可达12，000件（如果T5还能够处理包裹的话 ） ， 每年旅客吞吐量可达3000万人，而北京T3每小时包裹处理能力达到20，000件，旅客吞吐能力达到5000万人。
en: Whereas T5 can handle only 12,000 bags an hour (when it handles them at all) and 30 million passengers per year, T3 can handle 20,000 bags an hour and 50 million passengers.

zh: 伦敦T5主要为英航提供服务，而北京T3除了中国国航之外，还服务于其他二十几家航空公司。
en: While T5 will mostly service British Airways, T3 will service Air China and two dozen other airlines.

zh: 北京T3总面积达100万平米，为世界上最大的航站楼，但是建筑费用却远低于伦敦T5。
en: At one million square meters, T3 in Beijing is the largest terminal in the world, but was much less costly to build than T5 in London.

zh: 如果以最新汇率折算， 北京T3的总费用只有38.6亿美元，而伦敦T5却高达86亿美元之巨。
en: Using the most recent exchange rates, T3 cost only $3.86 billion compared with $8.6 billion for London’s T5.

zh: 不仅如此，北京T3从开工到完成只用了不到4年时间，而伦敦T5则耗用了几乎20年之久。
en: Furthermore, T3 took less than four years to complete, whereas T5 took almost 20 years.

zh: 但是如果简单地把北京T3称之为社会主义的成功、而把伦敦T5称之为资本主义的失败，恐怕失之偏颇。
en: But to call T3 a success for socialism and T5 a failure of capitalism would be to miss a fundamental point.

zh: 归根结底，中国的政治制度已经是“有中国特色的社会主义 ” ， 包含着越来越多的市场经济的成分，经济开放和透明度也在日益增加。
en: After all, if China’s political system can still be called socialism, it is at best “socialism with Chinese characteristics,” which embodies an increasing amount of market-oriented economic activity and greater economic openness and transparency.

zh: 如果单纯把北京T3的成功仅仅归功于中国也同样误人视听。
en: It would be similarly misleading to attribute T3’s success to China alone.

zh: 归根结底，北京T3的设计师有一位英国人，整个T3融入了世界最新的建筑和运营潮流、模式和标准。
en: After all, T3 was designed by a Briton, and has incorporated the most recent architectural and operational trends, styles, and standards in the world.

zh: 北京T3不过是中国近年来为改善交通基础设施而修建的众多项目中的一个。
en: T3 in Beijing is just one of many projects China has recently built to improve its transportation infrastructure.

zh: 中国不仅已成为世界工厂，中国的手机用户数已经超过了美国、英国、加拿大、澳大利亚和新西兰人口总和，中国互联网用户数也已经超过了美国。
en: In addition to having become the world’s industrial park, China now has more mobile phone subscribers than the combined populations of the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and New Zealand, and the number of Internet users has just surpassed that in the US.

zh: 所有这些都提出了一个根本性的问题：那就是我们应该如何解读已经成为中国新特色的爆炸式的生产率增长？
en: All of this development raises a fundamental question: how should we make sense of the explosive productivity growth that has become China’s new hallmark?

zh: 那些死抱着旧的意识形态不放的人们根本无法胜任这项工作，因为他们一方面声称中国的体制是失败的体制，另一方面却无法解释为什么中国能够取得如此快速的增长。
en: Those who cling to old ideological stereotypes face an almost impossible task in reconciling China’s rapid growth with what they condemn as China’s failing system.

zh: 事实上，自从20世纪70年代末以后，中国一直坚信和平与稳定是发展的最重要的前提。
en: The truth is that ever since the end of the 1970’s, China has become convinced that peace and stability are the most important preconditions for its development.

zh: 因此，任何可能打扰中国聚精会神推动和平、稳定和发展的事情，都会受到了中国的强烈抵制。
en: Thus, anything that may distract China from its focus on peace, stability, and development has been strongly resisted.

zh: 这或许可以有助于说明为什么北京T3航站楼是如此的成功，也有助于解释为什么中国目前空前团结，同声谴责任何出于某种不可告人的目的而挟持或者玷污奥运的企图
en: This may help explain why T3 in Beijing is such a success, and why Chinese are now more united than ever before in condemning attempts to hijack or sully the Olympics for ulterior motives.

zh: 我希望当千百万海外旅客路过北京T3航站楼的时候，包括北京奥运会期间路过此地的海外旅客，能够稍事停顿，思考一下中国改革开放三十年所走过的路程。 诚然，中国要走的路还很漫长，许多人还也会对这个国家的现状说三道四。
en: I hope that when millions of overseas passengers pass through T3, including those who do so during the Beijing Olympics, they will pause and reflect upon the distance China has traveled over the past three decades in its reform and opening to the outside world.  Granted, China still has further to go, and many people may find fault with much in the country.

zh: 可是他们不应该拒绝承认，中国通过和平与自由贸易把一个拥有13亿人口的贫困国家转变成发达国家的努力是人类历史上一部伟大、光荣而又艰巨的史诗。
en: But they should not refuse to acknowledge that China’s mission to turn a nation of 1.3 billion poor people into a developed country through peace and free trade is one of the great, honorable, and most difficult sagas in human history.

zh: 自从西藏骚乱和各地奥运火炬传递受扰事件以后，某些海外势力表现出一些漠视、诽谤、侮辱甚至试图分裂中国的情绪。
en: Following the disturbances in Tibet and the troubles affecting the Olympic torch’s progress around the world, some voices abroad are showing a greater inclination to dismiss, vilify, humiliate, or even split China.

zh: 但是最好所有人都能够稍事停顿，思考一下北京T3航站楼究竟意味着什么，思考一下这样一栋标志性建筑的迅速完工对于中国这样的新兴国家是什么样的成就。
en: But it would be best for all to pause a moment, contemplate T3 in Beijing, consider what it represents, and reflect on what an accomplishment the quick completion of such an iconic structure is for an emerging country like China.

zh: 泰国之春?
en: A Thai Spring?

zh: 发自曼谷 — — 对那些关注中东北非政治动荡的人来说，7月3日泰国大选所产生的震撼结果仿佛似曾相识。
en: BANGKOK – The thunderous results of Thailand’s general election on July 3 will seem familiar to anyone attuned to the political upheaval in the Middle East and North Africa.

zh: 随着信息技术进步、人口结构转换，人民期望上升以及冷战理念的逐渐淡化，世界上那些看似无法撼动的政权纷纷摇摇欲坠。
en: Entrenched incumbent regimes everywhere are under severe stress from advances in information technology, shifts in demographics, rising expectations, and the obsolescence of Cold War exigencies.

zh: 同时由于本身不具备使用暴力镇压的意愿和能力，这些政权只能依靠妥协，调整和周期性重塑自身来赢得生存。
en: In the absence of a willingness and ability to use violent repression, regime survival can be achieved only through concessions, accommodation, and periodic reinvention.

zh: 泰国近4700万选民中有3/4在本次选举中投下了选票，而选举的结果则对这个国家的古老政权提出了决定性的挑战。
en: With 47 million voters and turnout at 75%, Thailand’s latest election results pose a decisive challenge to the country’s long-established regime.

zh: 由流亡前总理他信最小的妹妹英拉·西那瓦领导的为泰党大胜，一举夺得下议院500个议席中的265席，反之目前执政的民主党只拿下159席。
en: The Pheu Thai party, led by Yingluck Shinawatra, the youngest sister of exiled fugitive former Prime Minister Thaksin Shinawatra, secured a resounding triumph, winning 265 seats in the 500-member assembly, while the ruling Democrat Party mustered just 159.

zh: 为泰党重夺政权的意义非常重大 — — 这不仅因为英拉将成为泰国第一位女总理。
en: The return to power of Pheu Thai is extraordinary – and not only because Yingluck will be Thailand’s first female prime minister.

zh: 须知与泰国王室等保守势力结盟的法庭曾两次解散了由该派系所组建的政府，并判处大批领导人5年之内不得从政。
en: The establishment-aligned courts dissolved the party’s two previous governments, and banned scores of its leading politicians from office for five years.

zh: 为泰党的胜利意味着一批原本被边缘化的选民如今已经完全觉醒。
en: Pheu Thai’s victory thus suggests that a previously marginalized electorate has been permanently awakened.

zh: 与他们类似的一大批人虽然历经一系列军事政变，政变宪法，司法干涉以及军队镇压，却依然在2001年1月，2005年2月，2005年4月和2007年12月为他信的政党及其维护穷人利益的平民主义政纲投下了赞成票。
en: A similar majority of the Thai electorate voted for Thaksin’s parties and their pro-poor populist platforms in January 2001, February 2005, April 2006, and December 2007, defying a military coup, a coup-induced constitution, judicial interventions, and army coercion and repression.

zh: 最近这场选举也意味着与过去那种政治状态的深刻决裂。
en: The recent election marked a profound break from the past.

zh: 在20世纪下半叶，泰国大选似乎总与军事政变交替出场。
en: In the second half of the twentieth century, Thai elections seemed to alternate with military coups.

zh: 选民像商品一样被肆意买卖，在选后也基本见不到议员的影子，因为后者都跑到曼谷贪污行贿去了 — — 自然会导致政府丧失合法性以及随后的军事政变。
en: Voters were bought and sold like commodities. After elections, voters hardly ever saw or heard from their MPs, who typically went on to engage in corruption and graft in Bangkok – eventually losing legitimacy and paving the way for military coups.

zh: 在随后颁布的新宪法及大选中种种乱象又会卷土重来，以致数十年来泰国政治就沉沦在这个政变，宪法和选举构成的邪恶轮回之中。
en: A new constitution and elections invariably ensued. This vicious cycle of coups, constitutions, and elections defined Thai politics for decades.

zh: 上述模式其实反映了冷战时期的诉求。
en: That pattern reflected Cold War imperatives.

zh: 泰国的支柱 — — 民族，宗教和国王 — — 支撑起一个联合统一的和谐状态，并带来有利于经济发展的稳定局面，同时还能在过于关注发展而导致民怨不断积聚时将共产主义拒之门外。
en: The pillars of the Thai state – nation, religion, and the king – struck a unifying, collective chord, and the resulting stability enabled economic development. While growth was so concentrated that popular resentment simmered, communism was kept at bay.

zh: 这个现行体制以军队-王室-官僚机构的三方联合体为根本，而对它的挑战则被一再遭到压制。
en: Challenges to the established order, with the military-monarchy-bureaucracy triumvirate as its anchor, were repeatedly put down.

zh: 在那时候，学生们每天早上都要唱军歌，泰国人也都知道自己在这个僵硬的精英主义阶级社会中所处的地位，而这种意识又不断被学校和家庭中的社会宣传和理念灌输所强化（所有媒体都是国营的 ） 。
en: Back then, Thai schoolchildren sang martial songs each morning, and Thais knew their place in the rigidly elitist pecking order, which was reinforced by socialization and indoctrination in classrooms and living rooms, where only state-controlled media could enter.

zh: 因此与其说泰国人是知情的公民，倒不如说是些服从的物体。
en: Thais were more like obedient subjects than informed citizens.

zh: 而那些与体制不满的观点也很少有人响应。
en: Dissenting views found little traction.

zh: 但他信的泰爱泰党在2001年的崛起挑战了这一切。
en: The rise of Thaksin’s Thai Rak Thai party in 2001 changed all that.

zh: 该党采用了一种科学的选举策略，花巨资聘请国外专家收集民意信息，并提供了清晰的政策议程和强势领导，同时也是战后第一个俘获了泰国人集体愿景的党派。
en: The party pursued a scientific approach to elections, relied on expensive polling by foreign experts, and offered a clear agenda and strong leadership. It was the first post-Cold War party to capture Thais’ collective imagination.

zh: 那些以往被无视的选民（尤其是北部和东北部农民）的呼声开始发挥威力。
en: The voices of neglected swaths of the electorate, particularly in the rural north and northeast of the country, began to count.

zh: 贿选行为日渐式微，而选民和政党之间的联系 — — 某种基于政策认同的联系 — — 则开始扎根。
en: Vote-buying became increasingly insufficient. A bond between party and voters – a bond based on policy – took root.

zh: 2001年时冷战已经变得遥远，因此当局再也无法借从事共产主义之名关押那些反对派政治领袖。
en: By 2001, the Cold War was long over. Political leaders who dissented from the status quo could no longer easily be jailed on communism-related charges.

zh: 互联网的发展扩大了信息来源也稀释了信息，使得政府宣传的效力大减，思想控制越发困难。
en: The advent of the Internet had made it harder for the authorities to shape Thai minds, as media sources multiplied and the resulting diffusion of information undermined the effectiveness of state propaganda.

zh: 此外新的国际准则也日渐通行，那么原本对政变，军事独裁和镇压睁一只眼闭一只眼的外部势力也加入了民主和人权的行列。
en: Moreover, new international norms had come to the fore: external powers that previously turned a blind eye to coups, military dictatorships, and repression now rallied around democracy and human rights.

zh: 泰国的人口结构同时也发生了改变。
en: Thailand’s demographics also changed.

zh: 冷战时那套号召团结与稳定的教条对孩子们已经不起作用，事实上如今许多大学生都是在冷战后出生的。
en: The Cold War curriculum of induced unity and stability has no relevance for today’s schoolchildren; indeed, most university students nowadays were born after the Cold War ended.

zh: 这些因素共同孕育了一个新的政治环境，而当时身为电信业大亨的他信则敏锐地抓住了这个机会。
en: These factors fostered a new political environment, and Thaksin, who was a telecommunications tycoon at the time, was well positioned to seize the opportunity.

zh: 他大胆创新，整肃官僚机构，向穷人传达自己的竞选承诺，制定国家工业战略，还重新设计了一个长期外交政策议程。
en: He overhauled the bureaucracy, delivered on his promises to the poor, mapped out an industrial strategy, and re-designed an overstretched foreign policy agenda, among other innovative measures.

zh: 当然，他信的统治也有其肮脏的一面：腐败、利益冲突、裙带关系，侵犯人权和滥用权力。
en: Of course, Thaksin’s rule had a dark underside: corruption, legislated conflicts of interest, cronyism, human rights violations, and abuse of power, among other evidence of misrule.

zh: 但这就是他信留下的复杂遗产。
en: Such is Thaksin’s mixed legacy.

zh: 向劳苦大众传递的机遇，希望和梦想以及对泰国未来的愿景和规划都与其自身的腐败纠缠不清。
en: The opportunities, hopes, and dreams delivered to the downtrodden and the vision and plans for Thailand’s future were enmeshed with his own venality.

zh: 但即便他信罪行累累，���最大的“善”就是改变了泰国人的思维和行为模式。
en: But, while Thaksin committed many infractions, his gravest “sin” was to have changed the way Thais think and behave.

zh: 有些人将这种改变视为篡夺王权，而其他人则认为这是为泰国迈向21世纪挣脱了枷锁。
en: Some see this change as usurpation; others view it as Thailand’s deliverance into the twenty-first century.

zh: 根深蒂固的统治当局当然不愿意接受他信的那套政策创新和民粹主义。
en: Thaksin’s adversaries in Thailand’s entrenched regime were unwilling to accede to his policy innovations and populism.

zh: 对他们来说这等于承认在泰国这个王道乐土中的大多数人之所以长期陷于贫困，原来是他人背后操纵的结果。
en: For them, doing so would be tantamount to admitting that most people in this hospitable, well-endowed kingdom had been kept poor by design all along.

zh: 他信试图将最近选举的胜利全部归功于自己。
en: For his part, Thaksin has sought to portray the recent election results as being all about him.

zh: 但我们最好将他视为一个怀着自利动机却无意中将泰国带入政治现代化的中间角色。
en: But he is best viewed as a self-serving, unwitting agent of political modernization.

zh: 而如果泰国要继续前进的话，当局就必须对这种构筑在日益自信的公民精神之上的二十一世纪动力和变革做出妥协和让步。
en: It is these twenty-first-century dynamics and changes, underpinned by an increasingly assertive citizenry, with which the Thai establishment must come to terms if the country is to move forward.

zh: 对抗俄罗斯的“第三种途径”
en: A “Third Way” for Confronting Russia

zh: 巴黎 － “ 让我们和俄罗斯接触如果可以，但是牵制它如果必须这样。
en: PARIS – “Let’s engage Russia if we can, but contain it if we must.”

zh: ” 在20世纪90年代中期，这两种选择已经定义了西方对俄罗斯的策略。
en: These two alternatives already defined Western strategy toward Russia in the mid-1990’s.

zh: 从那以后，俄罗斯可能已经发生了巨大的变化，但是这不是我们关注的问题。
en: Since then, Russia may have changed dramatically, but not our questions about it.

zh: 当你强大的邻居加大了存在在其欧洲文化和其变得越来越“亚洲”的政治体系 — — 至少在糟糕的“东方专制”的旧观念上如此 — — 之间的距离的时候，你会怎么做呢？
en: What do you do when your big neighbor widens the gap that exists between its culture, which is European, and its political system, which is becoming increasingly “Asian,” at least in the bad old sense of “Oriental despotism”?

zh: 对俄罗斯帝王野心回归的最好回答，应该是一个现代版的用于牵制世界新的叛逆者的稳定神圣同盟吗？
en: Should the best answer to the return of Russia’s imperial ambitions be a modern version of a Holy Alliance of stability designed to contain the world’s new maverick?

zh: 或者，一个目的是为了重新划定欧洲政治边界的现代雅尔塔会议，必要吗？
en: Or is a latter-day Yalta Conference, aimed at redrawing the political boundaries of Europe, necessary?

zh: 答案可能是两者兼而有之吗？
en: Could the answer be a bit of both?

zh: 如果俄罗斯正变成像拿破仑统治下的革命法国那样，或者回归到苏维埃的形态 — — 虽然被剥夺了极权主义的意识形态，但是具有征服和再征服的欲望 — — 需要的东西不是一些美国保守分子支持的“民主联盟 ” 。
en: If Russia is becoming what revolutionary France was under Napoleon, or reverting to Soviet form – shorn of a totalitarian ideology but with an appetite for conquest and re-conquest – what is needed is not the “league of democracies” advocated by some conservatives in America.

zh: 相反，需要的是包括像中国、印度这样的重要国家以及其他对经济增长要比对“破坏”国际体系更感兴趣的国家的“稳定联盟 ” 。
en: What is needed, instead, is a “stability league” that includes prominent actors like China, India, and other countries that are more interested in economic growth than in “rocking the boat” of the international system.

zh: 这样的策略意味着，首先，要和中国建立稳固的伙伴关系，这不是因为它正在向民主的方向发展，而是因为它是一个现存的强国。
en: Such a strategy implies, first of all, a solid partnership with China, not because it is evolving in the direction of democracy, but because it is a status-quo power.

zh: 这样的策略可以打开与伊朗的谈判之门，以及当然的北约内部的进一步团结。
en: Such a strategy could lead to the opening of negotiations with Iran, and of course to a further closing of ranks within NATO. The message to the Kremlin here would be crystal clear.

zh: 在这里向克里姆林宫传达的讯息是非常清楚的 ， “ 不要自欺欺人，民族主义和帝国主义不会有任何结果；你不可能在没有付出对你的经济增长和个人财富的严重损失的代价的情况下，进行领土扩展。
en: “Do not fool yourself. Nationalism and imperialism will lead you nowhere; you cannot expand geographically without serious costs to your economic growth and your personal enrichment.

zh: 欧洲可能很虚弱并且很分裂，美国可能不再是从前的美国，但是随着人口的下降以及除了石油和天然气之外的可悲的经济状况，你就是不具备成为全球强国联盟的成员的资格。
en: Europe may be weak and divided, America may no longer be what it was, but with your falling population and the sad state of your economy beyond oil and gas, you simply are not equipped to be in the league of great global powers.

zh: 中国具备这样的资格，你不具备。 ”
en: China is; you are not.”

zh: 但是，牵制政策的观点失败了，因为克里姆林宫仍然可以通过和叙利亚或委内瑞拉以不负责任的态度行为的方式，在世界范围内挑拨离间。
en: But the containment argument fails, because the Kremlin can still make mischief around the world by acting with Syria or Venezuela in an irresponsible manner.

zh: 更重要的是，号召全世界来对抗俄罗斯意味着将俄罗斯自命为强国太当回事了。
en: More importantly, rallying the world solely against Russia would mean taking Russia’s great power pretensions too seriously.

zh: 例如，许多亚洲人认为俄罗斯问题是欧洲的问题，不再是世界的问题。
en: For example, many Asians believe that Russia is a problem for Europe, but no longer for the world.

zh: 在冷战结束时，日本仍然被俄罗斯作为苏联的继承人的事实所困扰。
en: At the Cold War’s end, Japan remained obsessed with Russia as the heir to the Soviet Union.

zh: 现在，日本人是如此的关心中国以至于几乎没有时间来担心俄罗斯。
en: Today, the Japanese are so concerned with China that they have little time for fears about Russia.

zh: 对“牵制政策”复兴的另一个选择可能存在于接受俄罗斯的观点，或更准确地说，俄罗斯的“情感 ” 。
en: The other alternative to a rebirth of “containment” would consist in accepting the Russian argument, or more precisely, Russian “emotions.”

zh: 实际上，这可能意味着这样说 ， “ 我们在过去十年里不必要地羞辱了你。
en: It would mean saying, in effect, “We have unnecessarily humiliated you over the last ten years.

zh: 从北约的扩张到承认科索沃的独立，我们已经故意忽略了你的敏感和利益。
en: From NATO enlargement to the grant of independence to Kosovo, we have deliberately ignored your sensitivities and your interests.

zh: 让我们像丘吉尔、罗斯福和斯大林在雅尔塔那样坐下来，重新设计欧洲二十一世纪的版图。
en: Let’s sit down together like Churchill, Roosevelt, and Stalin at Yalta and redesign a twenty-first-century map of Europe.

zh: 你想要回什么？
en: What do you want back?

zh: 我们保留什么？ ”
en: What do we keep?”

zh: 这个途径可能会承认俄罗斯对高加索未来发展的监督权。
en: This approach might recognize Russia’s droit de regard on the future evolution of the Caucasus.

zh: 确实，在当前担任欧盟主席国的尼科拉斯·萨尔科奇法国政府的指导下，在口气强硬的同时，欧洲事实上已经听任了格鲁吉亚的被分割。
en: Indeed, while talking tough under the guidance of Nicolas Sarkozy’s France, which currently holds the EU presidency, Europe has de facto resigned itself to Georgia’s dismemberment.

zh: 俄罗斯军队会继续保留在南奧塞梯和阿布哈兹。
en: Russian troops are to remain in South Ossetia and Abkhazia.

zh: 西方也不打算为了格鲁吉亚向俄罗斯宣战，而格鲁吉亚的信誉因其总统不负责任的行为受到极大的侵蚀。
en: The West is not about to declare war on Russia for the sake of a Georgia whose credibility has been greatly eroded by its president’s irresponsible behavior.

zh: 对乌克兰来说，它可能有一天会成为欧盟的一部分，但是其未来不是北约。
en: As for Ukraine, it may one day become part of the European Union, but its future is not in NATO.

zh: 然而，在竭力牵制政策 — — 这一政策是不大可能，不够吸引人以及不现实的 — — 以及与会对欧洲的将来带来危险的与缓和相邻的迁就融合之间，必须找到建立在一些坚定的原则的基础上的第三种途径。
en: Yet, between all-out containment, which is very unlikely and not necessarily desirable or realistic, and accommodation which borders on appeasement, which would be dangerous for Europe’s future, a third way, based on a few firm principles, must be found.

zh: 这些原则是很清楚的。
en: These principles are clear.

zh: 首先，对乌克兰的领土完整是不能讨价还价的。
en: First, Ukraine’s territorial integrity is not negotiable.

zh: 这已经被说了很多次了，但是重复并不减弱其重要性。
en: This has been said many times, but repetition does not diminish its importance.

zh: 没有乌克兰的俄罗斯是一个可以控制的民族国家；拥有乌克兰的俄罗斯是一个无法控制的帝国。
en: Russia without Ukraine is a manageable nation-state; Russia with Ukraine is an unmanageable empire.

zh: 其次，即使西方谴责格鲁吉亚的不负责任，以及在其政策中考虑俄罗斯对其与前帝国领土有关的复杂的历史情感的敏感性，克里姆林宫无耻的野蛮行为也是不可接受的。
en: Second, even if the West condemns Georgia’s irresponsibility and incorporates into its policy Russia’s sensitivities on the complex historical feelings related to its ex-imperial territories, the Kremlin’s shameless brutality is unacceptable.

zh: 毕竟，现在的欧洲是二战后 过了六十年多年以及苏联垮台接近20年后的欧洲。
en: After all, this is Europe more than six decades after World War II, and nearly 20 years after the collapse of the Soviet Union.

zh: 使用武力清算旧怨并将一个国家的意志凌驾于另一个国家之上，是不能被顺从地接受的。
en: The use of force to settle scores and impose one nation’s will upon another cannot be accepted passively.

zh: 在短期来看，时间可能对俄罗斯有利。
en: In the short term, time may be on Russia’s side.

zh: 从长期来看，如果我们坚持我们的价值和原则，从经济、人口、政治和战略上来说，时间是对我们有利的。
en: In the long run – economically, demographically, politically, strategically – time is on “our” side, if we stick to our values and our principles.

zh: 在关塔纳摩湾监狱
en: At Home in Guantánamo Bay

zh: 关塔纳摩湾－这篇文章，是我在在没有遭到任何指控的情况下，却几乎把我关押了七年时间的关塔纳摩湾美国拘留中心，写下的。
en: GUANTÁNAMO BAY – I write this from the United States Detention Center at Guantánamo Bay, where I have been held without charge for almost seven years.

zh: 我被关押在关塔那摩是我在一个错误的时间出现在一个错误的地点的结果。
en: My detention here is the result of being in the wrong place at the wrong time.

zh: 在两年多前，有人告诉我，美国已经批准释放我了。
en: More than two years ago, I was notified that I was cleared for release.

zh: 如果我不是来自乌兹别克斯坦 — — 世界上人权记录最糟糕的国家之一，我可能会对这个消息感到高兴。
en: I would have been happy about this news if I did not come from Uzbekistan, a country with one of the worst human rights records in the world.

zh: 然而事实是，我却高兴不起来，因为对我来说，回到自己的祖国并不安全。
en: It is not safe for me to go home.

zh: 在我结束了在乌兹别克斯坦军队里的强制服役之后，在1998年12月份，我就开始了走向关塔纳摩的旅途了。
en: My journey to Guantánamo began in December 1998, after I finished my mandatory service in the Uzbek army.

zh: 曾是前苏联加盟共和国的乌兹别克斯坦，是一个贫穷的没有多少工作机会的国家。
en: Uzbekistan, a former Soviet Republic, is a poor country without many employment opportunities.

zh: 我结束了在乌兹别克斯坦军队的服役之后，花了几个月的时间找工作，最后，我和我的兄弟一起，在邻国塔吉克斯坦做起了买卖苹果、蜂蜜和其他货物的生意。
en: After several months of job hunting, I joined my brother in a business venture buying and selling apples, honey, and other goods in neighboring Tajikistan.

zh: 我住在塔吉克斯坦的一个乌兹别克人居住区，在此期间，遇到了我的妻子法第玛，她也是一个乌孜别克人 。
en: I lived in a community of Uzbeks, and met my wife, Fatima, another Uzbek, while living there.

zh: 不久之后，我们有了一个孩子，我的母亲也从乌兹别克斯坦来到了塔吉克斯坦，和我们一起生活。
en: We had a child, and my mother came from Uzbekistan to join us.

zh: 不幸的是，有些塔吉克斯坦人不喜欢有许多乌兹别克人生活在他们的国家。
en: Unfortunately, there were some in Tajikistan who didn’t like having a bunch of Uzbeks living in their country.

zh: 所以，在1999年11月的一天，塔吉克斯坦当局将200到300名乌兹别克人赶到了一起，说要将我们送回乌兹别克斯坦。
en: So, one day, in November 1999, the Tajik authorities rounded up 200-300 Uzbeks and said they were taking us back to Uzbekistan.

zh: 事实上，他们将我们扔在阿富汗就不管了。
en: Instead, they dumped us in Afghanistan.

zh: 在阿富汗，我们遇到了一群阿富汗乌兹别克人，他们帮助我们在马扎里沙里夫安顿下来。
en: There, we met a group of Afghan Uzbeks who helped us to settle in Mazar-i-Sharif.

zh: 我开始成为一个走街串巷的生意人，卖羊奶、鸡和羊。
en: I began working as a traveling salesman, selling goat’s milk, hens, roosters, and sheep.

zh: 在2001年秋天，当塔利班和北方联盟爆发战争的时候，我不能到处卖东西了，有一天还被困在了一个路边茶室里几个星期。
en: In the fall of 2001, when fighting broke out between the Taliban and the Northern Alliance, I could not travel and was stranded at a roadside teahouse for several weeks.

zh: 一天，北方联盟的士兵来到茶室，提出要用车将我送到马扎里沙里夫，但是事实上，他们将我送到了巴格拉姆空军基地，交给了驻扎在那里的美国人。
en: One day, Northern Alliance soldiers came to the teahouse and offered to give me a ride to Mazar-i-Sharif. Instead, they drove me to Bagram Air Base and handed me over to the Americans stationed there.

zh: 我后来知道，美国人会给那些抓获塔利班和“外国武装分子”的人几千美元的奖励。
en: I found out later that the Americans were offering bounties of several thousand dollars for Taliban and “foreign fighters.”

zh: 开始，我还比较高兴，因为我落到了美国人手里。
en: At first, I was happy to be in American hands.

zh: 我非常尊敬美国这个国家，认为美国人认识到我是无辜的并将我释放，是迟早的事情。
en: I held the US in high regard and figured that it would be only a matter of time before they realized that I was innocent and let me go.

zh: 但是，他们并没有将我释放。
en: But they didn’t.

zh: 他们开始将我关在巴格拉姆，然后转移到坎大哈，最后将我关到了关塔那摩湾。
en: They held me in Bagram, then Khandahar, and eventually Guantánamo Bay.

zh: 现在，美国人意识到我被关错了，告诉我他们要将我释放了。
en: The Americans now realize that I ended up here by mistake and have told me that they want to let me go.

zh: 但是，我能去哪里呢？
en: But where can I go?

zh: 乌兹别克斯坦安全部门的人来关塔那摩看过我，他们指控我是乌兹别克斯坦伊斯兰运动的成员。
en: Members of the Uzbek security service visited me here at Guantánamo and accused me of being a member of the Islamic Movement of Uzbekistan.

zh: 当我告诉他们我根本不知道与乌兹别克斯坦伊斯兰运动有关的任何事情的时候，他们警告我说，一旦我落到了他们的手中，他们就会让我合作的。
en: When I told them that I didn’t know anything about this group, they warned that once I was back in their custody, they would make me cooperate.

zh: 对他们让我合作的方法，并不难想象。
en: It is not hard to imagine what those ways are.

zh: 在乌兹别克斯坦，对被关押的人的折磨、拷打和其他的虐待行为非常普遍。
en: Torture, beating, and other mistreatment of Uzbek detainees are widespread.

zh: 有时候，有些人在乌兹别克斯坦被关押后，就音信全无了。
en: Sometimes people who are taken into Uzbek custody are never heard from again.

zh: 在关塔那摩，并不是只有我一个人的情况是这样的。
en: I am not alone.

zh: 因为从关塔那摩释放后回国可能遭受拷问和虐待，有几十个被关押在关塔那摩的人不能回到自己的国家，我就是他们中的一员。
en: I am one of several dozen of the Guantánamo who cannot return to our native countries because we would likely be tortured and abused.

zh: 我们走出这个监狱后的唯一希望是，有另一个国家决定为像我们这样的人 — — 我们这些没有做错任何事情，一开始就不应该被关押在这里的人 — — 提供安全的栖身之地。
en: Our only hope of getting out of this prison is that another country decides to provide safe haven to men like us – men who did nothing wrong and never should have been detained here in the first place.

zh: 建设正当时
en: A Time to Build

zh: 任何一个优秀的国际投资银行家都知道四月底不是一个叫卖服务的好时候。 因为这时正好是世界各国的财长们结束了在华盛顿举行的国际货币基金组织的各项会议返回本国的时候。
en: Any good international investment banker knows that the end of April is a bad time to come peddling his services, for that is when the world’s finance ministers return home from the IMF meetings in Washington, chastened that risks to the global economy could spill over into their own backyards.

zh: 此时的他们都对全球经济的风险可能蔓延到自家后院而忧心忡忡，正忙着抚慰自己备受折磨的心灵，所以无暇考虑为新的国际债券发行而付出巨额的费用。
en: Ministers are too busy recovering from their trauma to think about paying fat fees for big new international bond issues.

zh: 谁愿意在一场金融危机迫在眉睫的情况下举债呢？
en: Who wants to build up debt if there might be a financial crisis around the corner?

zh: 还不如继续囤积短期美国国库券，尽管其回报远低于其他大多数的投资项目。
en: Better to keep socking away US Treasury bills, even if the return is far lower than on most other investments.

zh: 果真如此吗？
en: Or is it?

zh: 随着当今的全球经济进入中可持续和愈渐平衡的增长态势，是不是到了考虑上升风险的时候了？
en: With today’s global economy in the middle of a sustained and increasingly balanced expansion, has the time come to start considering upside risks?

zh: 具体而言，各国政府，特别是那些正在无休止地增加美元储备的政府是否应该转而考虑如何修建道路、桥梁、港口、电网和其他基础设施了？
en: In particular, should governments, especially those that are endlessly building up dollar reserves, instead start thinking about how to build up their roads, bridges, ports, electric grids, and other infrastructure?

zh: 尤其对于那些还没有分享到当今经济繁荣的较贫困地区，是否到了应该为未来的可持续发展奠定基础的时候了？
en: Has the time come to start laying the groundwork to sustain future growth, especially in poorer regions that have not yet shared in today’s prosperity?

zh: 不要误解我的意思，我并不是在提倡财政挥霍。
en: Don’t get me wrong, I am not arguing for fiscal profligacy.

zh: 但过去几年以来，风险的平衡发生了转变。
en: But the balance of risks has shifted over the past few years.

zh: 是的，在未来的三至五年内，很可能会发生另一次全球性的经济衰退。
en: Yes, within the next three to five years, there will probably be another global recession.

zh: 对，很可能还会有一场金融危机在中欧突然爆发。 中欧现在的情形和1997年金融危机前的亚洲非常相似。
en: And, yes, there will probably be another rash of financial crises – perhaps in Central Europe, which now looks like Asia did before its 1997 crisis.

zh: 最近冰岛的巨额贸易赤字和巴西新任财政部长所引发的波澜，触动了世界的敏感神经，并提醒全球投资家们：虽然有很多新兴市场正逐渐向投资级的地位迈进，但大多数却仍然长路漫漫。
en: Recent jitters about Iceland’s gaping trade deficit and Brazil’s new finance minister rippled around the world, reminding global investors that while many emerging markets are gradually moving towards investment-grade status, most are not there yet.

zh: 但这些风险具有两面性。 健全的经济政策在利用繁荣时期和规避萧条时期方面因该双管齐下。
en: But the risks are two-sided, and sound economic policy is just as much about capitalizing on good times as avoiding bad ones.

zh: 身处世界银行等机构的经济巨擘们为各国提高经济增长率开出了一张冗长得可笑的方案清单（即所谓“延伸的华盛顿共识 ” ） 。
en: Economic gurus at places like the World Bank have developed a ridiculously long list of steps that countries should take to raise their growth rates (the so-called “extended Washington Consensus”).

zh: 就像要保持身体健康，仅注重某一方面是不够的。
en: Like maintaining good health, it is not enough to concentrate on a single component.

zh: 但如果说在某一方面的确存在明显的机遇，并且政策真的能够有所作为，那么这一定就是基础设施投资了。
en: But if there is one area where obvious opportunities exist, and where policy can really make a difference, it would have to be infrastructure investment.

zh: 印度的基础设施问题几乎具有传奇色彩，其机场和铁路等设施严重不足。
en: India’s infrastructure problems are legendary, with airports and railroads that are comically inadequate.

zh: 然而，除了少数几个国家—包括中国，当然还有西班牙—基础设施投资不足的问题普遍存在。
en: However, aside from a few countries – including China, of course, but also Spain – low infrastructure spending is epidemic.

zh: 甚至美国的某些基础设施也在被忽视状态中步履蹒跚：摇摇欲坠的桥梁和不堪负荷的电网。
en: Even the United States has infrastructure that is hobbled by neglect, with collapsing bridges and a dangerously overburdened electrical grid.

zh: 土地广袤的巴西也是研究投资不足的后果的案例。
en: Land-rich Brazil, too, is a case study in the consequences of under-investment.

zh: 它的基础设施体系可能足以支持其3-4%的温和经济增长率，但对于其在目前的全球性经济繁荣的大环境下能达到的6-7%的增速则爱莫能助。
en: Its infrastructure systems might be adequate to support the country’s tepid 3-4% growth rates, but they are hardly adequate to support the 6-7% rates that it ought to be enjoying amidst the current global boom.

zh: 俄罗斯尽管有着西伯利亚的巨大石油和天然气储量，却连支撑其能源工业健康发展的投资水平也保证不了，更别说在该国贫困地区（包括不幸的西伯利亚）的人力资源发展上的投资了。
en: Russia, despite Siberia’s massive oil and gas riches, isn’t even investing enough to support healthy growth in its energy industries, much less human development in the country’s impoverished areas (including hapless Siberia).

zh: 的确，政府在基础设施方面的支出时常被浪费。
en: True, government infrastructure spending is often wasted.

zh: 我的家乡波士顿最近花了令人叹为观止的150亿美金将几条公路移到地下。
en: My hometown of Boston recently managed to spend an astounding $15 billion dollars to move a few highways underground.

zh: 这场所谓的“大开掘”在经济效益上的示范作用似乎可以与日本那几座大而无当的桥梁媲美。
en: And that so-called “Big Dig” looks like a model of efficiency next to many of Japan’s infamous bridges to nowhere.

zh: 但我们可以有减少浪费的方法。
en: But there are ways to waste less.

zh: 确保采购过程的透明度就十分奏效。
en: Transparency in procurement works wonders.

zh: 同样有效的还有私营部门的介入。
en: So, too, does private sector involvement.

zh: 诺贝尔奖得主，经济学家William Vickery就不屈不挠地提倡私人投资修建收费公路。
en: The Nobel laureate economist William Vickrey argued tirelessly in favor of privately financed toll roads.

zh: 私人监督的结果通常是更好和更有效率的工程建设，并且在理论上讲收费道路有助于减缓交通阻塞。
en: Private oversight can often produce better and more efficient construction, and, in theory, toll roads help alleviate traffic congestion.

zh: （具有讽刺意味的是Vickery去世时正身陷交通堵塞之中。
en: (Ironically, Vickery died while sitting in a traffic jam.)

zh: ）甚至在过去五年里新修了五万多公里的道路和数十个机场的中国也采用了向私人融资的方式。
en: Even China, which has added more than 50,000 kilometers of roads and dozens of airports over the past five years, makes use of private financing.

zh: 确实，那些还没有清理过财政行为的国家，比如印度，决不能在没有实施确保可持续性的配套改革的情况下就轻率地投入到大型政府工程之中。
en: True, countries that have not cleaned up their fiscal act, such as India, must not recklessly plunge ahead with big government projects without counterbalancing reforms to ensure sustainability.

zh: 审慎的财政和稳定的通胀是当今相对健康的全球经济环境的基石。
en: Fiscal prudence and stable inflation rates are cornerstones of today’s relatively healthy global economic environment.

zh: 但对于那些有能力扩大投资的国家，特别是那些以毫无价值的短期美国国库券的形式持有过量的、可用于发展的宝贵美元的国家，是时候重新评估风险平衡了。
en: But for countries that have scope to invest more, particularly those that are holding a surfeit of precious development dollars in idle US Treasury bills, the time may be ripe to reassess the balance of risks.

zh: 国际货币基金组织每年四月提醒各国财长们下降风险是绝对正确的。
en: The IMF is absolutely right to remind ministers each April of downside risks.

zh: 需要更好基础设施的国家也不能将审慎抛诸脑后。
en: Countries’ need for better infrastructure is no license to throw prudence out the window.

zh: 但当世界各地的财长们从休克治疗中缓过劲来以后，还是需要多看看机遇。
en: But when the world’s finance ministers recover from their April shock therapy, they also need to look at the opportunities.

zh: 一个敢作敢为的时刻
en: A Time to Dare

zh: 纽约 — — 即将到来的G-20峰会是一个不成功则成仁性质的大会。
en: NEW YORK – The upcoming G-20 meeting is a make-or-break event.

zh: 如果它不能为支援处于全球金融系统边缘的国家提出实际的解决方案，全球金融市场将会遭受另一轮的衰退，就像美国财政部长蒂莫西·盖特纳（Timothy Geithner）二月没有提出实际的措施来调整美国银行系统的资本结构导致的结果一样。
en: Unless it introduces practical measures to support the countries at the periphery of the global financial system, global markets will suffer another round of decline, just as they did after United States Treasury Secretary Timothy Geithner’s failure in February to produce practical measures to recapitalize America’s banking system.

zh: 当前的金融危机不同于自二战以来我们经历过的所有金融危机。
en: The current financial crisis is different from all the others we have experienced since World War II.

zh: 以前的金融危机，金融系统无论何时濒临崩溃，政府都会齐心协力，把它从崩溃的边缘挽救回来。
en: On previous occasions, whenever the financial system came to the brink of a breakdown, the authorities got their act together and pulled it back from the brink.

zh: 这次，在去年9月莱曼兄弟投资公司倒闭之后，金融系统实际上已经崩盘，并且不得不借助人为的支持。
en: This time the system actually broke down in the aftermath of Lehman Brothers’ collapse last September, and it had to be put on artificial life support.

zh: 在其他措施中，欧洲和美国双方都曾有力地保证不再允许其他金融机构破产。
en: Among other measures, both Europe and the US have effectively guaranteed that no other important financial institution will be allowed to fail.

zh: 此项措施是必要的，但它却无意造成了不利后果：从东欧到拉丁美洲、非洲以及东南亚，许多国家无法同样提供令人信服的担保。
en: This step was necessary, but it produced unintended adverse consequences: many other countries, from Eastern Europe to Latin America, Africa, and Southeast Asia, could not offer similarly convincing guarantees.

zh: 由于受到世界经济中心各国金融机构决定保护自己的金融机构、资本领地免遭外围损害的怂恿，货币贬值，利率上升，信贷违约互换飙升。
en: Abetted by the determination of national financial authorities at the center of the world economy to protect their own institutions, capital fled from the periphery. Currencies fell, interest rates rose, and credit default swaps soared.

zh: 当这次金融危机被编入史册时，它将被如此记录下来：与大萧条期形成鲜明对比，保护主义首先在金融领域盛行，而不是贸易领域。
en: When the history of this crisis is written, it will be recorded that – in contrast to the Great Depression – protectionism first prevailed in finance rather than trade.

zh: 国际金融机构（IFIs）现在面临一项不同寻常的任务：保护外围国家免遭源自世界经济中心的金融风暴的损害。
en: The International Financial Institutions (IFIs) are now faced with a novel task: to protect the periphery countries from a storm that emanated from the center.

zh: 他们习惯了和各国政府打交道；现在他们必须学着处理私营部门的金融危机。
en: They are used to dealing with governments; now they must learn to deal with the collapse of the private sector.

zh: 如果他们失败了，外围的经济系统将比身处世界经济中心的国家遭受更多的损害。
en: If they fail to do so, the periphery economies will suffer even more than those at the center.

zh: 处于世界经济中心外围的国家与更为发达的国家相比往往更加贫穷，并比他们更加依赖商品贸易，而且他们单独2009年就必须偿还超过1.4万亿美元的银行贷款。 没有国际援助，这些贷款就无法周转。
en: Countries on the periphery tend to be poorer and more dependent on commodities than the more developed world, and they must repay more than $1.4 trillion in bank loans in 2009 alone.  These loans cannot be rolled over without international assistance.

zh: 英国首相戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）已经认识到这一问题，并把该问题提到G-20峰会议事日程上来。
en: British Prime Minister Gordon Brown recognized the problem and placed it on the G-20’s agenda.

zh: 但在准备的过程中，各国，尤其是美国与德国之间深刻的态度差异已经显现出来。
en: But, in the course of preparations, profound attitudinal differences have surfaced, particularly between the US and Germany.

zh: 美国已经承认，尽可能只使用国家信用就能逆转私营部门的信用危机。
en: The US has recognized that only using the credit of the state to the fullest extent possible can reverse the collapse of credit in the private sector.

zh: 德国因无法忘记20世纪20年代恶性通货膨胀及以随之发生的希特勒独裁统治的创伤，不愿承受太多的债务导致播下未来通货膨胀的种子。
en: Germany, traumatized by the memory of hyperinflation in the 1920’s and the consequent rise of Hitler in the 1930’s, is reluctant to sow the seeds of future inflation by incurring too much debt.

zh: 两国所持立场坚定，并且都可以获得从国家立场考虑这一正当理由的支持。
en: Both positions are firmly held and can be buttressed by arguments that are valid from the point of view of the country concerned. But the controversy threatens to disrupt the April 2 meeting.

zh: 在不放弃自己立场的前提下，各国尊敬别国的立场并找到一个共同点应该是能做得到的。
en: It should be possible for each side to respect the other’s position without abandoning its own and to find common ground.

zh: 放弃为经济刺激计划而设定的各国拿出2%的GDP目标，就外围国家需要国家援助保护他们的金融系统和参与反周期的各项政策达成共识���足可实现的。
en: Instead of setting a universal target of 2% of GDP for stimulus packages, it is enough to agree that the periphery countries need international assistance to protect their financial systems and engage in countercyclical policies.

zh: 因为那是各国的共同利益。
en: That is in the common interest.

zh: 如果外围的经济系统最终倒塌的话，发达国家也将受到损害。
en: If the periphery economies are allowed to collapse, developed countries will also be hurt.

zh: 照目前情况看，G-20峰会将会产生一些具体的结果：通过利用新借贷协议（NAB）的机制（如果没有解决国际金融机构重新分配投票权这一烦恼的问题，该协议可能会被激活 ） ， 国际货币基金组织的财力很可能会有效加倍。
en: As things stand now, the G-20 meeting will produce some concrete results: the resources of the International Monetary Fund are likely to be effectively doubled, mainly by using the mechanism of the New Arrangement to Borrow (NAB), which can be activated without resolving the vexing question of reapportioning voting rights in the IFIs.

zh: 这将足以促使国际货币基金组织对身处困境的特别国家伸出援助之手，但如果没有制约，它将不会提供一个系统性的解决方案。
en: This will be sufficient to enable the IMF to come to the aid of specific countries in trouble, but it will not provide a systemic solution without conditionality.

zh: 这样的解决方案以特别提款权（SDR）的形式是可用的。
en: Such a solution is readily available in the form of Special Drawing Rights (SDR).

zh: 这种机制早已存在，并已经被小规模的使用。
en: The mechanism exists and has already been used on a small scale.

zh: 特别提款权高度复杂并难以掌握，但他们都属于国际货币扩张行为。
en: SDRs are highly complicated and difficult to grasp, but they boil down to the international creation of money.

zh: 能够自己制造货币的国家不需要特别提款权，但边缘国家需要。
en: Countries that are in a position to create their own money do not need them, but the periphery countries do.

zh: 因而，富有的国家就应该把他们的货币配给量借给有需要的国家。
en: Rich countries should therefore lend their allocations to the countries in need.

zh: 这不会给富有的国家造成财政赤字。
en: This would not create a budget deficit for rich countries.

zh: 接受贷款的国家必须付给国际货币基金组织非常低的利息：所有可自由兑换货币的复合平均财政汇率。
en: Recipient countries would have to pay the IMF a very low interest rate: the composite average treasury bill rate of all convertible currencies.

zh: 他们可自由使用自己的货币配给量，但是国际金融机构会监督借来的配给量作何用处，以保证这些借来的资金得到有效利用。
en: They would have free use of their own allocations, but the IFIs would supervise how the borrowed allocations are used to ensure that the borrowed funds are well spent. It is difficult to think of a scheme where the cost/benefit ratio is so favorable.

zh: 国际货币基金组织财力除了过去的增长之外，只要全球经济衰退持续下去，就应该有大量的年度特别提款权收益，大约2500亿美元。
en: In addition to the one-time increase in the IMF’s resources, there ought to be substantial annual SDR issues, say, $250 billion, as long as the global recession lasts.

zh: 当全球经济过热时，为了实施反周期计划，特别提款权收益就可以部分随时支取。
en: To make the scheme counter-cyclical, the SDR issues could be callable in tranches when the global economy overheats.

zh: 在即将来临的G-20峰会上就发行特别提款权达成共识已经太迟，但如果能获得总统巴拉克·奥巴马（Barack Obama）的提议，以及大体上获得多数参会国的赞同，就能给市场带来足够鼓舞，就足以使得这次大会获得圆满成功。
en: It is too late to agree on issuing SDRs at the upcoming G-20 meeting, but if it were proposed by President Barack Obama and endorsed in principle by the majority of participants, it would be sufficient to give heart to the markets and make the meeting a resounding success.

zh: 增加支出的时机
en: A Time to Spend

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 英国经济学家约翰·斯图亚特·穆勒（John Stuart Mill）早在十九世纪初就道出了宏观经济的核心本质：一旦社会产生对金融资产的庞大需求，那么市面上几乎所有商品，服务和劳动力的供需都会由此产生巨大缺口，而这一基本事实则是大灾难的根源。
en: BERKELEY – The central insight of macroeconomics is a fact that was known to John Stuart Mill in the first third of the nineteenth century: there can be a large gap between supply and demand for pretty much all currently produced goods and services and types of labor if there is an equally large excess demand for financial assets. And this fundamental fact is a source of big trouble.

zh: 某一小类商品出现正常的供需缺口并不是什么大问题，因为其他商品的超量生产足以填补这一缺口。
en: A normal gap between supply and demand for some subset of currently produced commodities is not a serious problem, because it is balanced by excess demand for other currently produced commodities.

zh: 那些需求不足的行业削减员工，而那些供不应求的行业则雇佣他们。
en: As industries suffering from insufficient demand shed workers, industries benefiting from surplus demand hire them.

zh: 因此经济很快会再度恢复平衡，同时就业也全面复苏 — — 并最终使就业和生产都朝着更适应消费者需要的方向发展。
en: The economy rapidly rebalances itself and thus returns to full employment – and does so with a configuration of employment and production that is better adapted to current consumer preferences.

zh: 与此相反，由当前对金融资产过度需求所引发的供需缺口则是经济衰退之源。
en: By contrast, a gap between supply and demand when the corresponding excess demand is for financial assets is a recipe for economic meltdown.

zh: 毕竟那些失业工人无法轻易生产出那些金融市场无法足量提供的资产 — — 须知货币和债券都需要专业投资级别的知识。
en: There is, after all, no easy way that unemployed workers can start producing the assets – money and bonds that not only are rated investment-grade, but really are – that financial markets are not adequately supplying.

zh: 因此失业者的数量要多于重新就业的劳动者数量。
en: The flow of workers out of employment exceeds the flow back into employment.

zh: 而随着就业和收入下降，对商品的消费也进一步下跌，整个经济随之逐步陷入萧条。
en: And, as employment and incomes drop, spending on currently produced commodities drops further, and the economy spirals down into depression.

zh: 因此可以归纳出宏观经济政策的第一条原则：因为只有政府才能生产出萧条中紧缺的投资级别金融资产，所以它必须承担这一责任。
en: Thus, the first principle of macroeconomic policy is that because only the government can create the investment-grade financial assets that are in short supply in a depression, it is the government’s task to do so.

zh: 政府可以确保货币供应与充分就业所需的货币量相符合，并提供足够的安全储蓄工具以供投资者们安置他们的财富。
en: The government must ensure that the money supply matches the full-employment level of money demand, and that the supply of safe savings vehicles in which investors can park their wealth also meets demand.

zh: 那么这三年以来，世界各国的政府在这方面的表现又如何呢？
en: How well have the world’s governments performed this task over the past three years?

zh: 东亚地区（日本除外）的各国政府似乎都干得不错。
en: In East Asia (minus Japan), governments appear to have been doing rather well.

zh: 商品/服务需求短缺和大规模失业已不再是该地区最大的宏观经济问题。
en: Shortage of demand for currently produced goods and services and mass unemployment no longer loom as the region’s biggest macroeconomic problems.

zh: 通过提高经济体内部的流动性，维持有利于出口的汇率，直接出钱雇佣工人并供应足量安全储蓄工具等手段，东亚地区的大萧条状况比世界其他地区都更为轻微。
en: Flooding their economies with liquidity, maintaining export-friendly exchange rates, and spending to employ workers directly and boost the supply of safe savings vehicles have made the Great Recession in East Asia less dire than it has been elsewhere.

zh: 而北美地区的政府则属于侥幸蒙混过关的那类。
en: In North America, governments appear to have muddled through.

zh: 他们未能为银行提供足够的担保，在抵押贷款重新谈判方面也做得不够，也没能增加足够的政府支出或是资助足够的就业来实现金融市场的重新平衡，资产价格回复正常以及充分就业的迅速回归。
en: They have not provided enough bank guarantees, forced enough mortgage renegotiations, increased spending enough, or financed enough employment to rebalance financial markets, return asset prices to normal configurations, and facilitate a rapid return to full employment.

zh: 所幸当前的失业率依然只比10%高一点而已。
en: But unemployment has not climbed far above 10%, either.

zh: 当前问题最严重的地方则是欧洲。
en: The most serious problems right now are in Europe.

zh: 宏观经济的重新平衡需要增加安全储蓄工具的供应，但如何为那些高杠杆银行和过度杠杆的小国政府提供担保的不确定性却导致该工具供应量不断下降。
en: Uncertainty about how, exactly, the liabilities of highly leveraged banks and over-leveraged peripheral governments are to be guaranteed is shrinking the supply of safe savings vehicles at a time when macroeconomic rebalancing calls for it to be rising.

zh: 此外各国政府当前承诺的迅速削减预算赤字方案只会增加经济二次探底的可能性。
en: And the rapid reductions in budget deficits that European governments are now pledged to undertake can only increase the likelihood of a full double-dip recession.

zh: 上述事例所体现出的基本规律其实很简单：政府越是担心过度援助所引发的未来违约风险并试图遏制债务上升，经济的表现越差。
en: The broad pattern is clear: the more that governments have worried about enabling future moral hazard by excessive bailouts and sought to stem the rise in public debt, the worse their countries’ economies have performed.

zh: 政府越是推出能在短期内促进就业的政策，经济的表现越好。
en: The more that they have focused on policies to put people back to work in the short run, the better their economies have done.

zh: 估计穆勒和沃尔特·白芝浩��Walter Bagehot）这些十九世纪的经济学家也不会对这一规律感到惊讶，因为他们深知衰退的根源就是在财政部门。
en: This pattern would not have surprised nineteenth-century economists like Mill or Walter Bagehot, who understood the financial-sector origins of industrial depression.

zh: 但令人震惊的是，当今许多观察家和政策制定者却对此一无所知。
en: But it does seem to surprise not only a great many observers today, but also a large number of policymakers.

zh: 韩国成为有核国？
en: A Nuclear South Korea?

zh: 首尔 — — 韩国官员近来发现美国很可能设法阻止其搞铀浓缩及扩大导弹射程，而不是对上述问题进行外交搁置。
en: SEOUL – South Korean officials have recently realized that the United States is likely to try to forbid them from enriching uranium and expanding their country’s missile range, rather than leave these issues on the diplomatic back burner.

zh: 其实，美国在前不久的谨慎谈判中忽略了韩国对将于2014年3月到期的引发争议的美韩核合作协议进行补充的意愿，这表明对联盟未来的担心确有道理。
en: Indeed, recent discreet talks, in which the US has disregarded South Korean efforts to supplement the controversial US-South Korea Nuclear Cooperation Agreement, which expires in March 2014, suggest that there are reasons to be deeply worried about the alliance’s future.

zh: 美国谈判代表并不乐于促成韩国在原子能领域承担更多责任，尽管确实存在潜在的战略利益，但他们依然坚定地反对韩国提升防御能力和能源政策。
en: American negotiators – the reluctant midwives of South Korea’s increasing responsibility in the field of atomic energy – remain steadfast in their opposition to South Korea’s drive for improved defensive capabilities and a more advanced energy policy, despite the potential strategic benefits.

zh: 但在美国拿到更多筹码之前，美国的防扩散专家并不看好韩国能够为其优先政策赢取支持。
en: But American nonproliferation experts do not anticipate progress on South Korea’s efforts to win support for its preferred policies until the US gains more leverage.

zh: 这样的僵局已经算不上新鲜事。
en: Such a stalemate is not new.

zh: 韩美两国核谈判的特点往往是沟通不畅和缺乏了解。
en: Nuclear talks between the two countries have often been characterized by poor communication and a lack of understanding.

zh: 虽然韩国官员很少在公开场合明确自己的想法，但人们普遍认为美国的决策者目前缺乏与韩国政府和解的动力 — — 他们宁可扼杀韩国人越来越迫切的呼吁。
en: While South Korean officials rarely say in public what they really think, it is widely believed that US policymakers have little motivation to reconcile with South Korea’s government right now – they would prefer to stifle South Korea’s increasingly loud demands.

zh: 在美韩关系的全盛时期，美国政客曾把韩国形容为“美国伸出的手臂 ” 。
en: In the US-South Korea relationship’s heyday, American politicians considered the country an “extended arm of America.”

zh: 如此屈尊俯就的姿态在韩国军事独裁政权需要美国给予政治保护及安全保障时或许还勉强站得住脚，可现在韩国已经成为了东亚地区的民主范例。
en: Such condescension may have been defensible when South Korea’s military dictatorship needed America’s political protection and security guarantee, but now the country is a beacon of democracy in East Asia.

zh: 因此尽管韩国人理解妥协与合作的重要性，但他们仍然相信现在是时候建立更加平衡的伙伴关系。
en: So, while South Koreans understand the need for compromise and cooperation, they believe that the time is right for a more balanced partnership.

zh: 这样的看法并不代表韩国对不扩散问题抱有玩世不恭的态度。
en: This belief does not imply South Korean cynicism about nonproliferation.

zh: 相反，它反映出韩国对于朝鲜核问题的担忧，以及对近来美日导弹防御协议的关注。
en: Rather, it reflects concern about a nuclear North Korea, compounded by anxiety over the recent US-Japan missile-defense accord.

zh: 鉴于美韩两国对反映朝鲜核进展的情报做出了相同的评估，更不用说韩国在面临核威胁时表现出来的脆弱性，两国未能达成实际协议的确是非常令人不安的结果。
en: Given that the US and South Korea have the same assessment of the intelligence regarding North Korea’s nuclear progress, not to mention South Korea’s vulnerability, their failure to reach a practical agreement is troubling.

zh: 前外交部副部长千英宇曾在2010年警告美国官员，修改核合作协议或许很快会成为韩美关系中的“决定性要素 ” ， 并且正在吸引“大量的负面媒体关注 ” 。
en: Former Deputy Foreign Minister Chun Yung-woo warned an American official in 2010 that revising the Nuclear Cooperation Agreement could soon become a “defining issue” in South Korea-US relations, and that it was already attracting “significant amounts of negative press attention.”

zh: 千英宇认为因为韩国位列世界前五大核电生产国，韩国公众无法容忍日本得到优惠待遇。
en: Given South Korea’s status as one of the world’s top five nuclear-power producers, Chun argued, the South Korean public would not tolerate the perception that Japan was receiving preferential treatment.

zh: 其实，以执政新国家党郑梦准议员为代表的右翼领导人已经明确表达了对韩国现行无核化政策的疑虑，提出核武计划或许能够防止朝鲜半岛再次爆发战争。
en: Indeed, right-wing leaders like Representative Chung Mong-joon of the governing Saenuri Party have been vocal in expressing their doubts about South Korea’s current denuclearization policy, suggesting that a nuclear weapons program could prevent a second war on the peninsula.

zh: 保守派似乎认为美国对韩国的核保护已经成为过去式。
en: The conservatives seem to believe that American nuclear protection for South Korea is a thing of the past.

zh: 尽管面对朝鲜核威胁表现出强硬的态度，但韩国官员知道铀浓缩和乏燃料处理仍然只是遥不可及的可能性。
en: Despite their hawkish approach to North Korea’s nuclear threats, South Korean officials know that uranium enrichment and spent-fuel reprocessing remains only a distant possibility.

zh: 因此，他们对谈判抱有怀疑的态度，对本应成为联盟标志的相互义务并不怎样看重。
en: As a result, they are approaching negotiations skeptically, rather than emphasizing the sense of mutual obligation that should characterize the alliance.

zh: 但他们的悲观情绪并非毫无依据，因为阿拉伯联合酋长国已经与美国签署了类似协议，声明不会生产核燃料。
en: But their pessimism is hardly groundless, given that the United Arab Emirates has already signed a similar agreement with the US declaring that it would not produce nuclear fuel.

zh: 其实，韩国谈判代表似乎相信他们无法与美国就此问题取得任何进展。
en: Indeed, South Korean negotiators appear convinced that they will not be able to make any headway with the US on the issue.

zh: （可以肯定这一失败带来的问题不会太大，因为韩国科学家已经发表声明不会参与任何可用于军事目标的核计划。 ）
en: (To be sure, this failure may not matter much, given South Korean scientists’ past declaration that they will not contribute to any nuclear program that could be used for military purposes.)

zh: 美韩在核武器问题上的争议应该向双方表明他们长达59年的联盟政策迫切需要修正。
en: The US-South Korea debate over nuclear weapons should show both sides that their 59-year-old alliance urgently needs to be updated.

zh: 韩美联盟可以共同改善全球核不扩散前景，但前提是他们先要达成解决韩国现有及未来安全问题的大规模妥协。
