en: Together, the allies can improve global prospects for nuclear nonproliferation, but only if they hammer out a grand bargain that accounts for South Korea’s current – and future – security concerns.

zh: 向罪恶献贡
en: A Tribute to Evil

zh: 今年五月，全世界将在欧洲纪念二战结束60周年。
en: In May, the world will mark the 60th anniversary of the end of World War II in Europe.

zh: 但在喜庆地为此典礼筹划准备之时，15年前才刚刚重获二战中失去的主权的波罗的海三国：爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛，却颇为不安。
en: But instead of happily preparing for that occasion, the Baltic countries of Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania – which scarcely 15 years ago regained the independence they lost in WWII – are uneasy.

zh: 这三国首脑已被邀请参加即将在莫斯科举行的游行，庆祝苏联红军战胜德国纳粹。
en: The heads of state of all three countries have been invited to participate in the parades to be held in Moscow to celebrate the Red Army’s victory over Nazi Germany.

zh: 但是，正是这场庆典的东道主，俄罗斯，在苏联的名义下，发动了欧洲历史上最为血腥的战争，现在纪念的正是这场战争的结束。
en: But the host of the celebration, Russia, in the guise of the Soviet Union, itself caused the war – the bloodiest in European history – whose end is being commemorated.

zh: 当然，苏联与阿道夫·希特勒一前一后发动战争，但是它的责任无法推卸。
en: Of course, the USSR instigated the war in tandem with Adolf Hitler, but its responsibility is undeniable.

zh: 今日的俄罗斯通过在红场举行庆典，强调突出苏联的胜利，来庆祝他们在那场战争中的战利品。
en: By holding these celebrations in Red Square, and thus highlighting the Soviet victory, today’s Russia is also celebrating its gains in that war.

zh: 其中之一就是我的祖国，立陶宛。 在被吞并入斯大林帝国的过程中，伴随着她的是无数的人间悲剧。
en: One of those gains was my country, Lithuania, whose incorporation into Stalin’s empire was accompanied by countless tragedies.

zh: 与德国不同，俄罗斯从未承认过它对战争以及无数无辜平民的墓冢所应负的责任。
en: Unlike Germany, Russia has never recognized its responsibility for the war and the mass graves of the innocent.

zh: 就这样，一个曾被侵略国家现在被邀请去庆贺它的被侵历史。
en: Thus, a former captive nation is now being invited to celebrate its captivity.

zh: 这就是为什么所有的立陶宛人 — — 事实上大部分波罗的海国家的居民 — — 都对他们的国家领导人前去莫斯科参加这场纪念活动颇感不适。
en: This is why almost all Lithuanians – indeed, most residents of the Baltic countries – feel queasy at the prospect of their leaders marking this anniversary in Moscow.

zh: 但是欧洲内有相同感受的还不止爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛人。
en: But Estonians, Latvians, and Lithuanians are not the only Europeans who should feel this way.

zh: 斯大林在1939年春天为了向希特勒示好（原本根据Molotov-Ribbentrop秘密协定是在夏天 ） ， 保证在纳粹对西欧进攻中，其后方将不会受到东面攻击，也就是说将西欧完全留给希特勒为所欲为。
en: When Stalin offered Hitler his friendship in the spring of 1939 – formally concluded that summer in the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact – Nazi aggression was assured of not being knifed in the back from the East and so was left with free hands to do as Hitler pleased in the West.

zh: 该协定是在德国“水晶之夜”屠杀后制定的，所以该协议的苏联起草者非常清楚，根据1939年8月23日纳粹德国外交部长Ribbentrop和苏联外务委员会委员莫洛托夫Molotov签订的第一个秘密协议，他们把波兰和立陶宛的犹太人的命运交付给了希特勒。
en: The Pact came after the pogroms of “Kristallnacht” in Germany, so its Soviet initiators knew pretty well to what destiny they were consigning the Jews of Poland and Lithuania, which, in accord with the first secret Protocol signed by Ribbentrop and Molotov on August 23, 1939, were to go to Hitler.

zh: 一个月后，同样也是秘密地，希特勒将立陶宛卖给了斯大林。
en: A month later, in equal secrecy, Hitler sold Lithuania to Stalin.

zh: 地处德国与苏联之间的其他国家也相同地被判了亡国的死刑 — — 只是时间早晚的问题。
en: The other countries situated between Germany and the USSR were similarly sentenced to disappear as nations – sooner or later.

zh: 他们的民族被当作几乎不存在一样对待，入侵者唯一关心的就是领土。
en: Their peoples were treated practically as though they did not exist; the aggressors’ only concern was territory.

zh: 当时被强加于整个国家和几百万人民身上的死刑和折磨，现在看来，即将在今年5月9号在莫斯科再次被默默忍受并大张旗鼓地庆贺。
en: The death sentences and torturing that were then imposed on almost entire nations and millions of people are, it now appears, to be silently accepted and noisily celebrated on May 9 in Moscow.

zh: 一些俄罗斯官员还要揭幕一座斯大林纪念碑来庆贺这个盛典。
en: Some Russian officials want to unveil a monument Stalin to crown the festivities.

zh: 当希特勒的纳粹德国国防军进攻西欧时，苏联不失时机地支持德国对波兰、法国、比利时、荷兰、卢森堡、丹麦、挪威和英国发动战争。
en: When Hitler’s Wehrmacht struck West, the USSR duly supported Germany in its war against Poland, France, Belgium, the Netherlands, Luxembourg, Denmark, Norway, and the United Kingdom.

zh: 结果，这些国家中的城市被一一铲平，杀害平民的不仅有纳粹，还有入侵波兰为纳粹德国国防军提供西线战争所需物资的苏联军队。
en: As a result, cities in those countries were flattened and people killed not only by the Nazis, but also by their Soviet ally, which invaded Poland and supplied the Wehrmacht with the material it needed for its war against the West.

zh: 作为回报，斯大林的苏联得以全举进攻芬兰，占领爱沙尼亚、拉脱维亚和立陶宛，以及罗马尼亚一部分地区。
en: In return, Stalin’s USSR was given a free hand to attack Finland and to occupy Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania, as well as a part of Romania.

zh: 在法律中，当两个罪犯用受害人的鲜血密封一份契约时，这种行为已经构成犯罪，即使那两个罪犯后来发生争执举枪射杀彼此。
en: In law, when two criminals seal a contract with the blood of their victims, that act remains a crime, even if the two criminals later have a falling out and spray bullets at one another.

zh: 这也适用于二十世纪欧洲的两大罪人。
en: The same applies to the two greatest European criminals of the twentieth century.

zh: 我们决不能仅仅因为希特勒和斯大林后来反目成仇就忘记他们结成同盟时共同犯下的罪行。
en: We must not forget the crimes that Hitler and Stalin committed together as de facto allies only because they later turned on each other.

zh: 二战受害者的鲜血要求得到正义和公平，但是最重要的是要诚实以对这个问题：究竟是谁、什么导致了他们的悲惨命运。
en: The blood of WWII’s victims calls for justice and fairness, but most of all it demands honesty about who and what caused their tragic fate.

zh: 如果那些5月9日聚集在莫斯科的人们作了任何认可苏联战争罪行的事情，那么他们就是对二战中千百万的无辜亡灵沉默的呼喊声无动于衷。
en: If those who gather in Moscow on May 9 do anything to validate Soviet war crimes, they will show themselves insensitive to the silent cries of WWII’s tens of millions of dead innocents.

zh: 真正的唯一的赢家将会是那场罪恶背后的幽灵。
en: The only real winner would be the spirit of that evil.

zh: 感谢詹姆斯•沃尔芬森
en: A Tribute to James Wolfensohn

zh: 过去十年间，全球经济因为贸易发展、国际资金流动以及技术革新达到空前繁荣。
en: Over the past decade, the global economy has achieved unprecedented prosperity built on trade, international capital flows, and technological innovation.

zh: 然而，在不容否认的进步中，仍旧普遍存在着贫穷、疾病和文盲。
en: Amidst this undeniable progress, however, remain widespread poverty, disease, and illiteracy.

zh: 在被现代通讯、卫星电视、和因特网逐渐缩小的世界里，我们每天都将面临着发展的巨大挑战。
en: In a world made smaller by modern telecommunications, satellite TV, and the Internet, the vast challenges of development that we continue to face confront us everyday.

zh: 可能没有谁像即将离任的世界银行行长詹姆斯·沃尔芬森这样发出警告：他一方面由于众多的成功而声名雀起，另一方面又对尚未解决的问题了如指掌。
en: Perhaps no individual has done more to raise the alarm – earning deserved credit for many successes and understanding all too clearly the remaining shortcomings – than James Wolfensohn, the outgoing President of the World Bank.

zh: 作为国际货币基金组织的常务理事，我有幸和吉姆·沃尔芬森在工作上保持密切联系，从而得以近距离了解这个肩负着不断减少全球贫困的特殊使命的人。
en: As Managing Director of the IMF, I have had the privilege of working closely with Jim Wolfensohn, seeing up close a man with an extraordinary mission: the sustainable reduction of global poverty.

zh: 沃尔芬森放弃了辉煌的商业生涯，转而领导这场对抗贫困的全球性战役。
en: Wolfensohn left a successful business career to lead the global campaign against poverty.

zh: 在过去十年间，他的努力曾遭遇批评，但也受到过赞扬，这大概是体现他忠诚敬业和坚韧性情的最好证明。 因为在每次主要战役中，他都坚守在战场的中心，力图缓解我们这一代面临的每一次经济困境。
en: It is perhaps the ultimate tribute to his commitment and tenacity that his efforts over the past 10 years have attracted criticism as well as praise, for he has stood at the center of every major campaign aimed at alleviating the economic ills of our generation.

zh: 针对每次重要发展而展开的讨论中，沃尔芬森都带领世界银行走在最先面，在抗击艾滋病及其它威胁贫困国家的重大疾病的战斗中他也始终走在最前面。
en: Wolfensohn led the World Bank onto the cutting edge of every important development debate, and was at the forefront of the effort to combat HIV/AIDS, as well as other deadly diseases that threaten so many impoverished countries.

zh: 他曾是妇女权利的代言人，环境保护的支持者，也是不屈不挠为最大的负债国争取减免债务的倡导者。
en: He has been a forthright spokesman for women’s rights and a champion of environmental concerns, as well as a formidable advocate in arguing for debt reduction for the most heavily indebted nations.

zh: 他还带领世界银行付出了巨大的努力，帮助从波斯尼亚、塞拉里昂到东帝汶这些从内战中苏醒过来的国家进行重建。
en: He also has placed the World Bank at the center of the effort to help rebuild nations emerging from devastating civil conflict, from Bosnia to Sierra Leone to East Timor.

zh: 作为世界银行行长，沃尔芬森始终坚持：世界不应该被分成“富国”和“穷国 ” 。
en: As World Bank president, Wolfensohn argued consistently that the world cannot be divided into “haves” and “have-nots.”

zh: 一个地区出现贫穷，就意味着到处都是贫穷。 任何国家的稳定和安全都需要发展平衡。
en: Poverty anywhere means poverty everywhere, and equitable growth is needed for the stability and security of all.

zh: 的确，这才是“全球化”的内涵所在。
en: Indeed, that is the true meaning of globalization.

zh: 同时，沃尔芬森为发展问题做出了巨大贡献，他认为：我们必须把贫穷当作一个多维问题看待。
en: At the same time, Wolfensohn made a big contribution to development work by arguing that poverty must be treated as a multidimensional problem.

zh: 现在被普遍接受的观点是：单纯的经济援助并不能有效遏制贫困。
en: It is now widely accepted that financial assistance alone will not bring about effective poverty reduction.

zh: 可持续的、有利于穷人的经济增长才是关键。 而这需要政治稳定¾即对个体而言的和平与安定¾推行善政以及利益各方对政策的共同参与。
en: Rather, sustainable, pro-poor growth is the key, requiring political stability – that is, peace and security for individuals – good governance, and ownership of policies by all stakeholders.

zh: 在沃尔芬森的领导下，世界银行以具体行动坚持行进在这条全面与协作的道路上，有力打击了全球性贫困。
en: Under Wolfensohn, the World Bank followed through on this comprehensive and coordinated approach in a concrete fashion, making significant inroads into global poverty.

zh: 在过去十年间，世界银行一直是初级教育、基础卫生保健、抗击艾滋病计划以及保护环境和生态多样化最大的外部资助者。
en: In the last 10 years, the Bank was the largest external financier of primary education, basic health care, HIV/AIDS programs, and programs aimed at protecting the environment and biodiversity. This agenda goes to the heart of improving human dignity and maintaining sustainable development.

zh: 沃尔芬森认为腐败是发展进程的组成部分，又向前迈出了有价值的一步，因为过去在某些官僚圈子里，即使提一下“腐败”这个词似乎都是很忌讳的。
en: Wolfensohn’s insistence that corruption be confronted as part of the development process was another valuable step forward. It used to be that even mentioning corruption in some official circles was considered taboo.

zh: 但在许多国家，腐败成了阻碍发展唯一最大的障碍，尤其因为它侵占穷人的资源。
en: But corruption poses the single largest obstacle to growth and development in many countries, especially as it diverts resources from the poor.

zh: 世界银行坚持认为：腐败就像癌症，反对腐败就如同对抗贫困。
en: The World Bank insisted that corruption be seen as a cancer, and that fighting it be made synonymous with fighting poverty.

zh: 的确，直言不讳似乎是沃尔芬森任期期间的一大特点。
en: Indeed, outspokenness was a hallmark of Wolfensohn’s tenure.

zh: 许多政府部长、银行官员和非政府组织代表既遭遇过他生硬的批评，也受到过他慷慨的赞誉，国际货币基金组织自然也不例外。
en: Many a government minister, Bank officer and NGO representative has experienced his blunt criticism, as well as his effusive praise. The IMF has not been immune to this treatment.

zh: 布雷顿森林体系的力量来源于理念的多样化，另外沃尔芬森的正直以及他不懈推行银行资金合作的努力，也为基金组织提供了资金帮助。 这一合作正在过去的十年间日益深化。
en: The strength of the Bretton Woods institutions lies in intellectual diversity, and the Fund benefited from Wolfensohn’s honesty, as well as from his commitment to Bank-Fund cooperation, which progressively deepened during the past decade.

zh: 我们两大机构的工作¾涉及减少贫困、免除债务、以及前所未有的对成员国金融部门进行分析的合作项目¾巩固了全球经济发展。
en: The work of our two institutions — in areas as diverse as poverty reduction strategies, debt relief, and the unheralded joint program to analyze financial sectors in our member countries — strengthened the global economy.

zh: 从根本上说，发展是人的发展。
en: Ultimately, development is about people.

zh: 吉姆·沃尔芬森最强大的力量体现在他对世界贫穷人口的关注，他留给我们的是致力于消除世界贫困的世界银行。
en: Jim Wolfensohn’s greatest strength has been his genuine caring for the world’s poor. His legacy will include a World Bank that is firmly committed to a world free of poverty.

zh: 全世界的穷人会因为失去他而愈加困窘，因为沃尔芬森是他们的拥护者和支持者。
en: The poor around the world may feel poorer from losing him as their champion and advocate.

zh: 实际上，正是由于他过去十年的工作，他们的前景才变得明亮起来。
en: In fact, their prospects are brighter because of his work over the past decade.

zh: “老欧洲”的胜利
en: A Triumph for “Old Europe”

zh: 意大利可能击败了法国获得了世界杯，但是真正的赢家是曾经被拉姆斯菲尔德所诟病的“老欧洲 ” 。
en: Italy may have defeated France to win the World Cup, but the real winner was the “Old Europe” that Donald Rumsfeld once derided.

zh: 毕竟，谁会预料到世界杯冠军决赛在法国和意大利之间进行呢？
en: After all, who would have predicted a World Cup final between France and Italy?

zh: 这看起来好像是两个“欧洲病夫”的国家队觉得有义务改变它们国家在世界上的形象。
en: It looks as if the national teams of the two “sick men of Europe,” felt obliged to change their countries’ images in the world.

zh: 对于意大利而言，在几乎将意大利超级足球联赛毁于一旦的腐败丑闻之后，意大利国家队不得不在同胞们的心目中为这一运动平反。
en: In the Italian case, following the corruption scandals that have nearly sunk Il Calcio, Italy’s premier football league, the national team had to rehabilitate the game in the eyes of their fellow citizens.

zh: 但是，就更为全球化的范围而言，这好像是“老欧洲”决定现在是拨乱反正、证明自己比世界上的新兴力量更为富有活力的时候了。
en: More globally, however, it is as if “Old Europe” had decided that it was time to set the record straight and prove more dynamic than the world’s emerging forces.

zh: 确实，在新的全球平衡中，足球已经成为超越体育的项目，欧洲卷土重来，咄咄逼人。
en: Indeed, in the new global balance, where football has become much more than sport, Europe is back with a vengeance.

zh: 过去四周以来在我们眼前所展现的是一个现代和简化了的力量平衡体系版本。 这一体系在十八世纪和十九世纪统治着欧洲和世界。
en: What has been unfolding in front of our eyes in the last four weeks has been a modern and reduced version of the balance-of-power system that dominated Europe and the world in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries.

zh: 如果足球及其顶峰时刻的世界杯已经成为全球化时代的大一统的宗教，那么，这一宗教尤其如此，因为它以一种非精神的方式满足了人类本性中矛盾的本能。
en: If football and its culminating moment, the World Cup, has become the universal religion of the global age, this is above all because it fulfills, in a non-spiritual way, contradictory instincts in human nature.

zh: 足球渲染了个人崇拜以及对英雄的颂扬，但是，它同时又是对集体合作精神的赞美。
en: Football magnifies the cult of the individual and the glorification of the hero, but it is also a celebration of the cooperative team spirit.

zh: 足球要比其他任何集体活动更能够引导寻求占据当今时代的身份特征。
en: More than any other collective activity, it channels the search for identity and identification that dominates our age.

zh: 由于世界杯，人们成为了世界公民，和“足球星球”的其他几十亿人一同观赏壮观的比赛。
en: Thanks to the World Cup, one is a citizen of the world, enjoying a spectacle together with billions of others on “Planet Soccer.”

zh: 甚至当我在世界杯赛开始之际抵达华盛顿的时候，我在机场看到电视屏幕在转播比赛。
en: Even in Washington, where I arrived at the beginning of the tournament, I was greeted at the airport by television screens showing the game.

zh: 这是一个英语节目，但是广告却是西班牙语。
en: The program was in English, but the advertisements were in Spanish.

zh: 至少对于足球而言，西班牙裔社区的影响力把美国拉近了欧洲（当然，尽管不是美国队在足球场上的成绩 ） 。
en: In terms of football at least, the Hispanic community’s influence has brought the United States closer to Europe (though not, of course, in its team’s performance on the pitch).

zh: 与此同时，球迷们在世界杯期间不仅是全球一家，而且是独一无二。 他们可以无所顾忌地表达他们的不同，有时候以最为外露、攻击性以及有时不幸的是种族主义的方式进行。
en: At the same time, during the World Cup, fans are not only universal; they are also unique, and they can express their difference with impunity, sometimes in the most assertive, aggressive, and, unfortunately, occasionally racist manner.

zh: 在一个“多元身份”的世界里，选择自己的球队在某种部分上就是选择自己是谁。
en: In a world of “multiple identities,” to choose one’s team is in part to decide who one is.

zh: 根据这一观点，今年的世界杯不仅见证了欧洲国家的胜利，因为自从1982年以来第一次欧洲国家包揽全部半决赛队伍，而且，也没有哪怕一丝欧洲情感。
en: From this standpoint, this year’s World Cup has not only witnessed the triumph of European nations – all semi-finalists were European for the first time since 1982 – but also the absence of even a glimmer of European emotions.

zh: 在我的国家法国，大多数支持者们很明显更多地是受到后殖民因素、而非对欧洲的效忠的鼓动。
en: In my country, France, most supporters were clearly motivated more by post-colonial references than by European allegiance.

zh: 除了对手是法国队的情况下，球迷们比来自欧盟国家的队伍更偏好非洲球队。
en: African teams, except when they were playing against France, were favored over those from the European Union.

zh: 当我在大赛初期观看克罗地亚对澳大利亚比赛的时候，我也对自己感到惊奇，因为我意识到我的情绪在澳大利亚一边。 由于有如此多的克罗地亚人为澳大利亚队效力，这一感觉意味着很多事情。
en: As I watched the Croatia-Australia match early in the tournament, I surprised myself, too, as I realized that my emotions were with the Australian team, whatever that could mean, given that there were so many Croatians playing for Australia.

zh: 这一对身份的深刻的寻求不应当与简单的民族主义高涨相混淆。
en: This deep search for identification should not be confused with a simple surge of nationalism.

zh: 现实更为复杂。
en: Reality is more complex.

zh: 而且，这并不仅仅因为许多国家队的教练用美好的老时光的话来讲是“外国雇佣军 ” ， 包括日本和葡萄牙队的巴西教练、英格兰的瑞典教练以及突尼斯的法国教练。
en: And this is not only because many coaches of the national teams are, like in the good old days, “foreign mercenaries,” with this Cup’s Swiss guards including the Brazilian coaches of Japan and Portugal, the Swedish coach of England, and the French coach of Tunisia.

zh: 本届世界杯中民族主义爆发隐藏了更为残酷的现实。
en: The Cup’s explosions of proud nationalism hide more tortured realities.

zh: 怀旧已经不再是以前的东西了。
en: Nostalgia is not what it used to be.

zh: 当法国队在1998年第一次赢得世界杯的时候，人们连同法国国旗三色（蓝色、白色和红色）和另外三种法国队队员的颜色（黑色、白色以及出生在法国的北非移民后代的皮肤颜色）一同欢庆。
en: In 1998, when France won the Cup for the first time, the three colors of the French flag (blue, white, and red) were celebrated alongside with the three colors (“black, white, and beur, the skin color of North Africans born in France to immigrant parents) of the members of the French team.

zh: 但是，由于现在再也不可能颂扬法国融入模式的胜利，因此，这一纯真已经丧失了。
en: But that innocence has been lost because it is no longer possible to celebrate the triumph of the French model of integration.

zh: 的确，经过了去年的暴力事件，法国的移民社区有了一个大不相同的信息要传达给人们，那就是 ： “ 没有我们，你们不会有这次世界杯的成功。
en: Indeed, after the violent episodes of the last year, France’s immigrant communities have a very different message to deliver: “Without us, you would not have had this World Cup success.

zh: 你们还相信你们可以继续孤立产生你们的足球英雄的社区吗？ ”
en: Do you believe you can continue to ostracize the communities from which your soccer heroes come?”

zh: 从与中国的乒乓外交一直到德国队在1990年实际统一的比赛之前，体育成为政治发展进程的先兆，而各地的政治家们则抓住了世界杯的重要性。
en: From ping-pong diplomacy with China to the united German Olympic team that competed in 1990 before actual reunification, sport has prefigured political developments, and politicians everywhere have seized on the importance of the World Cup.

zh: 足球的成功已经成为各国“柔性力量”的一部分。
en: Football success has become part of countries’ “soft power.”

zh: 法国不一定具备美国的军事力量或者中印两国的经济增长率，但是它的足球队却进入世界杯决赛，从而在几十亿人的眼中提升了它的地位，也暂时解救了不受欢迎的法国政府。
en: France may not have the military might of the US or the growth rate of China and India, but its team reached the World Cup championship, raising its standing in the eyes of billions of people – and perhaps giving a reprieve to its unpopular government.

zh: 但是，体育也有可能成为一种巨大的分散注意的幕帐，恶劣的政权在这一幕帐后面从事令人发指的事情。 这是与奥林匹克和世界杯精神背道而驰的。
en: But sport can also become a kind of gigantic, distracting screen behind which nasty regimes do outrageous things – the very opposite of the Olympic and World Cup spirit.

zh: 正当全世界都在观看德国世界杯足球赛的时候，北韩却在试射远程导弹，而哈马斯政府的巴勒斯坦人对以色列发动攻击，促使了以色列对加沙地带的流血性入侵。
en: As the world was watching the football games in Germany, North Korea was testing long-range missiles and Palestinians in the governing Hamas launched attacks on Israel that prompted a bloody invasion of Gaza.

zh: 世界杯是戏剧、激愤以及梦想，但是它又是“全球性逃避现实”的一种形式。
en: The World Cup is drama, excitement, a dream, but it is also a form of “global escapism.”

zh: 足球可能可以解释这个世界，但是并无法改良世界。
en: Football may explain the world, but it does not improve it.

zh: 现在我们又回到了现实。
en: And now we are back to reality.

zh: 如何医治法国的无可救药
en: Attacking French Hopelessness

zh: 当骚乱席卷法国城市时，其他国家对法国的评价十分严厉。
en: As French cities have burned, other countries have been very severe in judging France.

zh: 各国使馆向旅游者和居住在法国的本国公民发出了警告；电视新闻节目连续数小时播放汽车燃烧的画面。
en: Embassies have issued warnings to tourists and their citizens living in France; television news programs have shown hours of footage of burning cars.

zh: 其他国家政府由于担心这一问题会波及到本国而看起来已经在同这一问题拉开距离。
en: Other countries’ governments, it seems, have been trying to distance themselves from the problem, fearing a contagion that they know is likely to spread.

zh: 但是，欧洲各国的市长们则对此作出了更为温和的反应，并同他们深受骚乱之苦的法国同行们团结一致。
en: Mayors across Europe, however, have responded more moderately, feeling and showing solidarity with the plight of their French colleagues.

zh: 他们知道，只要存在社会不平等的问题，包括边缘化和受到排挤的年轻人，他们的城市也有可能遭受城市暴力袭击。
en: They know that their cities are also vulnerable to urban violence, in so far as they have pockets of social inequality, including marginalized and excluded young people.

zh: 而法国的情况的特殊性在于，骚乱针对的是国家，更为准确地说是针对警察。
en: The specificity of the French situation is that the revolt is targeted against the state, and more precisely against the police forces.

zh: 英国最近的骚乱发生在种族之间，与此不同，在法国的对抗中，骚乱参与者与警察针锋相对。
en: Unlike recent riots in the United Kingdom, which were inter-ethnic, the confrontations in France put their participants face to face with the police.

zh: 实际上，尽管不同种族背景的年轻人参与了骚乱，这些骚乱中并没有特别的宗教或种族特征。
en: Indeed, there is no specific religious or ethnic character to these riots, in so far as youth from various ethnic backgrounds have taken part.

zh: 的确，在骚乱份子中，少数族裔的青年占据大多数。
en: Minority youth are, to be sure, over-represented among those involved.

zh: 他们在地理上隔离，失业率和辍学率高于他人，而且经常落入犯罪司法体系，其比例奇高无比。
en: This is easily explained by their geographic segregation, higher levels of unemployment, higher school dropout rates, and disproportionately frequent interactions with the criminal justice system.

zh: 但是，被判刑的年轻人目前为止成份多样。 有鉴于此，断言这些骚乱是穆斯林极端主义的结果是错误的。
en: But, in view of the diversity of the young people convicted so far, it would be a mistake to say that these riots are the result of Muslim radicalization.

zh: 目前为止，绝对没有迹象表明有组织的网络或宗教团体在操纵这些年轻人。
en: There is absolutely no indication so far that organized networks or religious groups are manipulating these youth.

zh: 当然，这并不是说，如果无法迅速找到满意的解决办法，穆斯林极端份子就不会混水摸鱼。
en: Of course, this is not to say that Muslim radicals will not exploit the disarray if a satisfying resolution is not found rapidly.

zh: 由于没有出现明显的领导人或政治要求，这场骚乱可能是没有组织的。
en: The rioting may not be organized - no clear leaders or political demands have emerged.

zh: 但是，这些暴力行为可以被视做政治冲突，因为，年轻人通过袭击国家的代表直接挑战国家。
en: Yet these violent acts can be viewed as a political conflict in the sense that young people are directly challenging the state by attacking its representatives.

zh: 这些被剥夺权利的年轻人感觉社会不公，缺乏机会表达心声。 这场暴力活动似乎与他们的感受成比例。
en: The violence seems to be proportional to these disenfranchised young people’s sense of perceived injustice and the lack of opportunities for them to express themselves.

zh: 在这一含义上，法国正在为它过去30年来的社会发展政策缺乏连续、协调一致以及适当的资助而付出代价。
en: In this sense, France is paying the price for the lack of continuity, coherence, and appropriate funding given to social development policies over the past 30 years.

zh: 尽管这些政策无疑帮助了处于不利地位的社区居民，但是，它们仍然雄心不足来抑制仇视。
en: Although these policies have undoubtedly helped residents of disadvantaged neighborhoods, they have not been sufficiently ambitious to dampen resentment.

zh: 过度软弱的政策的例子之一是有关警力问题。
en: One example of overly timid policies involves policing.

zh: 在过去几年中，法国因逐步放弃社区警力而与其他欧洲国家有所区别。 法国政府认为社区警力过于“社会化”而且注重防治。
en: In the last few years, France has distinguished itself from other European nations by gradually abandoning community-based policing, which the government considers too “social” and prevention-oriented.

zh: 欧洲其他国家的警察把防治作为第一要务，法国却把它作为边缘目标。
en: While European police forces place prevention at the top of their agendas, France has chosen to treat it as a marginal goal.

zh: 结果，警察日益被视为“外地局外人 ” ， 警察与居民之间的紧张关系达到前所未有的高度。
en: As a result, tensions between the police, who are increasingly perceived as “outsiders,” and residents have grown to all-time highs.

zh: 由于没有立足社区的解决办法，同执法机关的交往也就局限于紧张的、充满冲突的情况，进而加剧了反叛的年轻人和警察之间的对抗性气氛。
en: In the absence of a community-based approach, interactions with law-enforcement authorities are now limited to tense, conflict-ridden situations, reinforcing the confrontational atmosphere between rebellious youth and the police.

zh: 与此同时，警察必须干预他们所不熟悉的地方，严重阻碍了他们的效力。
en: At the same time, the fact that police agents must intervene in places with which they are not familiar severely impedes their effectiveness.

zh: 在当前的暴力事件中，警察不幸被置于国家的唯一代表的地位。
en: In the current violence, the police have unfortunately been placed in the position of sole representative of the state.

zh: 但是，不仅仅是警察，而且是所有的公共机关都必须对城市问题作出反应。
en: But all public actors, not just the police, must respond to urban problems.

zh: 首先，也是最为重要的是，应当调动起市长作为调解人，因为他们处于实施城市政策的第一线。
en: First and foremost, mayors should be mobilized as mediators, because they are on the front line in implementing urban policy.

zh: 当这些警察无计可施的时候，公民们也就拿市长们试问。
en: When these policies fail, citizens hold mayors responsible.

zh: 但是，市长们也对其社区内的沟通管道最为了解，因此也就最为有力地组织有效的合作伙伴来处理和解决当地的问题。
en: But mayors are also the most knowledgeable about communication links within their communities, and are thus the most capable of organizing effective partnerships to address and resolve local issues.

zh: 法国的事件还表明，必须在欧洲的层面上加强反对歧视、促进社会平等的政策。
en: The events in France also point to the need, at the European level, to reinforce policies against discrimination and that promote social equality.

zh: 尽管这些政策必须在地方层面实施，但必须由欧洲机构来加以促进和支持。
en: Although these policies must be implemented at a local level, they should be catalyzed and supported by European institutions.

zh: 已经有这一方面的尝试，但是扔亟待加强。
en: Efforts in this area already exist, but it has become increasingly urgent that these efforts be strengthened.

zh: 平等和社会协调构成欧洲城市的自由、正义和安全的基础。
en: Equality and social cohesion form the backbone of liberty, justice, and security for European cities.

zh: 这也就是为什么欧洲的市长们呼吁欧洲机构用目前为止处理难民和边境检查一样的承诺来集中处理社会协调问题。
en: This is why Europe’s mayors call upon European institutions to focus on social cohesion with the same commitment that has been invested until now in asylum and border controls.

zh: 基础设施融资的新手段
en: A New Approach to Infrastructure Finance

zh: 发自北京 — — 美国的立法者已经制定了一项新法案，该法案一旦颁布，就将创建一个新的开发融资机构来取代原有的海外私人投资公司（Overseas Private Investment Corporation ） 。
en: BEIJING – Lawmakers in the United States have introduced legislation that, if enacted, would create a new development finance institution (DFI) to replace the Overseas Private Investment Corporation.

zh: 新机构与其前身不同的地方在于能够进行股权投资，而这一改革反映出全球日益认识到股权已经成为了可持续发展融资的重要组成部分。
en: Unlike its predecessor, the new agency would be able to make equity investments, a reform that reflects growing global recognition that ownership stakes are an essential component of sustainable-development financing.

zh: 但美国以及其他地区在开发金融方面的这一转变纵使意义重大，却不能解决南半球不发达地区所面临的其中一项主要挑战：缺乏基础设施投资。
en: But, however important, this shift in development finance, in the US and elsewhere, will not solve one of the major challenges facing the Global South: a dearth of infrastructure investment.

zh: 对此我们可能需要一种全新的手段来弥补这一缺陷。
en: To address that shortcoming, an entirely new approach may be needed.

zh: 为实现联合国可持续发展目标，全球各大多边开发银行及其私营部门分支（开发融资机构）承诺在未来三年内将私营部门融资额增加35 ％ 。
en: To achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the world’s multilateral development banks (MDBs) and their private-sector branches, the DFIs, have committed to increasing private-sector finance by as much as 35% over the next three years.

zh: 为了支持基础设施投资，各多边发展银行在实施其他重要措施之外还扩大了提供给私人投资者的风险缓释工具。
en: To support infrastructure investment, MDBs have expanded their offers of risk-mitigation instruments for private investors, along with other important measures.

zh: 但它们并未对基础设施资产进行足够投资，将投资重点放在新兴市场的中小型企业上。
en: Yet they have made only limited investments in infrastructure equity, focusing such investment, instead, on small- and medium-size enterprises in emerging markets.

zh: 那么为何不把基础设施资产交到私营部门手里？
en: Why shouldn’t infrastructure equity be left to the private sector?

zh: 这是因为基础设施资产虽然能提供长期稳定的收入来源，但大多数大型项目的初期风险较高。
en: Although infrastructure assets have the advantage of providing steady, long-term income streams, the early stages of most big projects carry higher levels of risk.

zh: 一旦项目超出预算，延期完工，或者未能产生预期回报时，损失就只能由投资者来背。
en: When projects are over budget, fall behind schedule, or fail to generate projected returns, investors pay the price.

zh: 因此私人投资者倾向于将资金投向已经产生稳定运营收入的基础设施而不是新项目。
en: So, rather than investing in new projects, private investors tend to prefer to channel their money toward operational infrastructure that is already generating stable revenue.

zh: 出于对这类风险的厌恶，尽管投资者对基础设施投资的兴趣高涨并推高项目交易额，但近年来全球准备上马项目的总数依然不见增加。
en: Reflecting this aversion to risk, the total number of shovel-ready projects worldwide has held steady in recent years, even though investor interest in infrastructure investment has soared, causing deal values to increase.

zh: 此外根据麦肯锡公司的数据，近几十年来，私营部门基础设施投资的70%都投向了发达经济体。
en: Moreover, in recent decades more than 70% of private-sector investment in infrastructure has been channeled to advanced economies, according to McKinsey.

zh: 为了增加它们的影响，当私营部门投资较少时，多边开发银行和开发融资机构需要将更高比例的资金投入到那些处于筹备和建设阶段的基础设施项目上。
en: To increase their impact, MDBs and DFIs need to direct far more capital toward infrastructure projects in the preparation and construction stages, when the private sector invests less.

zh: 虽然有必要动用贷款和风险缓释工具来支持这一举措，但这还不够，因为它们通常在项目被完整记录在案并确认为“可贷款”之后才会到位。
en: While loans and risk-mitigation instruments are necessary to support this effort, they are not sufficient, because they are generally provided after a project is fully documented and confirmed as “bankable.”

zh: 相反，股权投资者经常会在项目的早期阶段 — — 最初的技术准备和财务架构搭建阶段 — — 发挥核心作用。
en: Equity investors, by contrast, frequently play a central role in the early stages of a project: the initial technical and financial structuring phase.

zh: 如果缺乏股权投资，潜在的盈利项目可能永远达不到可以确认债务融资和风险缓释的“可贷款”阶段。
en: If equity investment is lacking, potentially profitable projects may never reach the “bankable” stage at which debt financing and risk mitigation can be confirmed.

zh: 而由于股权投资者是在项目失败后最后得到偿付的人，他们承担的风险也就最大。
en: Yet, because equity investors are the last to be repaid in case of project failure, they carry the most risk.

zh: 为了提高新兴市场在基础设施投资中的份额，世界需要一些愿意承担这些早期风险并等待更长时间来让项目成熟的股权投资者来提供更多的“耐心资本 ” 。
en: To increase emerging markets’ share of infrastructure investment, the world needs more “patient capital” from equity investors willing to take those early risks and wait longer for their investments to mature.

zh: 如果私营部门不能填补这一空白，那么责任就落在了多边开发银行和开发融资机构身上，而根据定义，它们就是为此目的而存在的。
en: If the private sector won’t fill this void, then the onus is on MDBs and DFIs, which, by definition, exist for this purpose.

zh: 虽然有一些多边发展银行和开发融资机构融资可被用于早期基础设施投资 — — 包括中国的丝路基金，世界银行以及联合国国际金融公司 — — 但这类融资的供应却受到了需求不足的拖累。
en: Although some MDB and DFI financing is available for early-stage infrastructure investment – including from China’s Silk Road Fund, the World Bank, and the International Finance Corporation – the supply of such financing is dwarfed by demand.

zh: 为此这些多边开发银行和开发融资机构可以通过向已经从事这种投资的公共金融机构注入一部分资金来提升增加其贡献。
en: MDBs and DFIs could rapidly increase their contribution by channeling part of their capital through public financial institutions that already undertake this type of investment.

zh: 而一些战略投资基金可能就是答案。
en: Strategic investment funds may hold the answer.

zh: 这些由政府或其他公共机构全部或部分持有的基金根据“双重底线”进行投资，可以分别根据财务收支状况以及对社会和环境影响来衡量其绩效。
en: These funds, which are wholly or partly owned by governments or other public institutions, invest according to a “double bottom line,” which measures performance by financial success and by social and environmental impact.

zh: 在过去的十年中，全球包括印度，爱尔兰，菲律宾甚至塞内加尔等多个不同经济体已建立了近36个战略投资基金。
en: In the last decade, nearly three dozen strategic investment funds have been established around the world in economies as diverse as India, Ireland, the Philippines, and Senegal.

zh: 这些投资基金是扮演着私营部门和公共部门之间中介机构角色的股权投资者，通常独立运作，但执行的是政府定义的任务。
en: These investment funds are equity investors that operate as intermediaries between the private and public sectors, often independently, but adhering to a government-defined mandate.

zh: 基金主要由私营部门的专业人士组建，其中许多人已经实现了高水平的私营部门共同投资，从而扩大了可用于基础设施投资的资金池。
en: Staffed primarily by private-sector professionals, many have achieved high levels of private-sector co-investment, thereby expanding the pool of capital available for infrastructure investment.

zh: 例如2017年10月印度国家投资和基础设施基金就宣布与全球最大的主权财富基金之一的阿布扎比​​投资局达成一项价值10亿美元的交易。
en: For example, in October 2017, India’s National Investment and Infrastructure Fund announced a $1 billion deal with a unit of the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, one of the world’s largest sovereign wealth funds.

zh: 该协议将帮助印度资助一系列关键基础设施升级。
en: The agreement will help India finance critical infrastructure upgrades.

zh: 作为公共资本的持有者，多边发展银行和开发融资机构可以通过向各个运作良好的战略投资基金部署资本而将资产转换为“耐心股权 ” 。
en: As holders of public capital, MDBs and DFIs can convert assets into “patient equity” by deploying capital through well-performing strategic investment funds.

zh: 它们可以提供贷款帮助政府实现其战略投资基金的资本化，要么直接资本化，要么在项目层面共同投资。
en: They can provide loans to help governments capitalize their strategic investment funds, capitalize the funds directly, or co-invest at the project level.

zh: 通过把资金注入最强大的参与者，每个实体都可以提升专业度并鼓励竞争。
en: By directing capital to the strongest performers, each entity could promote integrity and encourage competition.

zh: 虽然包括亚洲开发银行和欧洲投资银行在内的一些开发融资机构已经在与战略投资基金合作，但仍有相当大的增长空间。
en: Although some DFIs, including the Asian Development Bank and the European Investment Bank, are already engaging with strategic investment funds, there remains considerable room for growth.

zh: 多边开发银行和开发融资机构明智地加大了动员私人资本的力度，而向基础设施早期阶段股权投资的转变以及与战略投资基金的接触可能会大大加强它们在这方面的能力，也增加了世界实现联合国可持续发展目标的可能性。
en: MDBs and DFIs have rightly increased their efforts to mobilize private capital. A shift toward early-stage equity investment in infrastructure, and engagement with strategic investment funds, could significantly strengthen their capacity on this front, and increase the likelihood of the world achieving the SDGs.

zh: 习近平在俄罗斯
en: Xi in Russia

zh: 莫斯科—习近平来俄罗斯访问 — — 这是他成为中国新主席后第一次出访 — — 所带来的热氛让我想起了20世纪50年代末儿提时代的口号 ： “ 中苏友谊世代相传 ” 。
en: MOSCOW – The atmospherics surrounding Xi Jinping’s coming trip to Russia – his first visit to a foreign country as China’s new president – remind me of a slogan from my early childhood in the late 1950’s: “Russia-China, Friendship Forever.”

zh: 讽刺的是，即使在口号漫天的时代，中苏关系也很快地恶化了，不到十年，西伯利亚黑龙江地区就交上了火。
en: The irony is that, even in that slogan’s heyday, Sino-Russian relations were deteriorating fast, culminating in spasms of combat along the Amur River in Siberia less than a decade later.

zh: 今天的口号会比当时更加真实吗？
en: Is that slogan more valid now?

zh: 中国经济开放以及苏联解体、俄罗斯诞生后，双边关系进入了新阶段。
en: After China opened up its economy and Russia emerged from the Soviet Union, bilateral relations entered a new stage.

zh: 如今双方都带着良好的意愿，但昔日的怀疑仍然存在，新的怀疑也在滋生。
en: Goodwill now prevails, but some of the old suspicions linger – and some new ones have emerged.

zh: 习近平的访问不会带来任何突破。
en: Xi’s visit is not expected to usher in any breakthroughs.

zh: 可以期待会有一些向中国出口石油产品的新合同，但不会有大惊喜。
en: A few deals to export Russian hydrocarbons to China can be expected, but not much more.

zh: 尽管如此，此次访问仍然彰显出双边关系的一些重要特点。
en: Nonetheless, the visit will highlight several important features of the bilateral relationship.

zh: 首先，俄罗斯和中国政府都有资本淡化它们与美国关系的重要性。
en: For starters, both the Russian and Chinese governments can afford to downplay the significance of their ties with the United States.

zh: 在与美国（尽管目前尚是盟友）日益升级的对峙中，中国将俄罗斯视为其战略后方甚至基地。
en: China views Russia as its strategic rear – and perhaps a base – in its escalating rivalry with the US (though not yet as an ally).

zh: 俄罗斯领导人将中美竞争视为增加俄罗斯战略分量的良机，与中国不同，俄罗斯的地位并没有因经济增长而增加。
en: Russia’s leaders view Sino-American competition as a welcome addition to their country’s strategic weight, which, unlike China’s, is not being augmented by robust economic growth.

zh: 美国越是挑战中国“安全边界”不可避免的扩张，对俄罗斯就越有利，至少克里姆林宫战略家是这样想的。
en: The more the US challenges the inevitable expansion of China’s “security perimeter,” the better for Russia, or so the Kremlin’s strategists appear to believe.

zh: 与此同时，中俄关系进入了前所未有的紧密期。
en: Meanwhile, the Sino-Russian relationship has achieved an unprecedented degree of warmth.

zh: 中国人几乎在竭尽所能缓解俄罗斯的顾虑。
en: The Chinese are doing almost everything possible to placate Russian concerns.

zh: 昔日的边界争端已经平息。
en: The old border disputes have been silenced.

zh: 贸易量在快速增长。
en: The volume of trade is growing rapidly.

zh: 此外，中国也没有对西伯利亚实施人口侵略，尽管许多记者和专家一直在宣扬这个计划。
en: Moreover, there has been no Chinese demographic expansion into Siberia, though many journalists and pundits have been peddling that story.

zh: 居住在俄罗斯的中国人 — — 包括合法和非法情况 — — 大约在30万人。
en: The number of Chinese residing in Russia – whether officially or clandestinely – amounts to 300,000.

zh: 1917年革命前居住在俄国的中国人要比这个数字多得多。
en: Many more Chinese lived in the Russian Empire before the 1917 revolution.

zh: 但是，在表面之下，双边关系存在着隐忧，这部分是拜历史因素所赐。
en: But, beneath the surface, unease in the bilateral relationship persists, partly for historical reasons.

zh: 中国的民族主义者一直铭记着帝俄的侵略，而许多俄罗斯人则有着病态的“黄祸”恐惧，尽管蒙古人征服并统治的是中国，而在俄罗斯，他们最终被驱赶出境了（更不用说中国人从未入侵过俄罗斯 ） 。
en: Nationalist Chinese remember imperial Russia’s conquests, while many Russians have a morbid fear of the “yellow peril,” even though the Mongols conquered and reigned in China, while they were eventually repelled from Russia (not to mention that the Chinese never invaded Russia).

zh: 隐忧更重要的原因是俄罗斯远东外贝加尔地区的人口负增长趋势以及对中国实力膨胀的担忧（这一点中国的所有邻国都感受得到 ） 。
en: The more important reasons for the unease are the negative demographic trends in Russia’s far-eastern Trans-Baikal region, and the fear – shared by all of China’s neighbors – of overweening Chinese power.

zh: 事实上，专家认为，如果西伯利亚维持当前近于停顿的经济趋势，那么世界将再一次经历大规模的芬兰化，这一次将发生在东方。
en: Indeed, the pundits have a point: if the current economic near-stagnation in Siberia persists, the world will witness a second, epic edition of Finlandization, this time in the east.

zh: 这或许并非一国所能遇到的最坏情形，但也不是俄罗斯��所面临的最乐观情景，因为俄罗斯人自视为超级大国的观念早已根深蒂固。
en: That might not be the worst scenario a country could face, but it is not the most pleasant prospect for Russians, given their deeply ingrained sense of their status as a great power.

zh: 这一情景并不是不可避免的，也必然不是习近平和俄罗斯总统普京在莫斯科会晤时的心中所愿。
en: This scenario is not inevitable, and it certainly will not be on the minds of Xi and Russian President Vladimir Putin when they meet in Moscow.

zh: 中国正面临着几乎不可避免的经济减速，经历着身份危机，需要实现新的增长模式。
en: China is in the throes of an identity crisis as it faces an almost inevitable economic slowdown and the need to implement a new growth model.

zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯显然正陷入更深刻的身份危机。
en: Russia, meanwhile, is clearly suffering from an even deeper identity crisis.

zh: 俄罗斯从后苏联时代的冲击中活了下来，现在已经复苏。
en: It somehow survived the post-Soviet shock, and has now recovered.

zh: 但是，过去六年来，俄罗斯一直处于混乱状态，没有战略，没有目标，精英阶层对未来也没有形成一致愿景。
en: Yet, for the last six years or so, Russia has been in a kind of limbo, with no strategy, no goals, and no elite consensus on a vision for the future.

zh: 对中俄关系来说，这一根本性不确定性或许是个好消息。
en: For Sino-Russian relations, such fundamental uncertainties may be a blessing.

zh: 双方领导人可以预期对方不会制造新问题，甚至可以给地缘政治问题带来消极支持。
en: Both leaders can count on the other not to create additional problems, and even to help passively on geopolitical questions.

zh: 比如，在叙利亚问题上，两国都向世界证明，我们生活在一个多极世界。
en: On Syria, for example, the two countries have shown that we are indeed living in a multipolar world.

zh: 新的油气合同也有助于两国经济。
en: And those new oil and gas deals will buttress both economies.

zh: 从长期看，中俄关系在很大程度上取决于俄罗斯能否走出当前僵局并（通过其他措施）开始开发外贝加尔地区的丰富水资源和其他资源。
en: In the long term, Sino-Russian relations will depend largely on whether Russia overcomes its current stagnation and, among other steps, starts to develop the vast water and other resources of the Trans-Baikal region.

zh: 果真如此的话，俄罗斯将不仅需要中国的资本和技术，也需要日本、韩国、美国和东南亚国家的资本和技术。
en: To do so, capital and technology will be needed not only from China, but also from Japan, South Korea, the US, and Southeast Asian countries.

zh: 相对而言，外贝加尔地区很容易发展与资源匮乏的亚洲经济体之间的关系，让所有各方都受益。
en: The Trans-Baikal region could relatively easily expand ties with the resource-hungry Asian economies, to the benefit of all.

zh: 即便是劳动力问题也是可以解决的，只要来自前苏联中亚地区 — — 甚至可能逐渐自由化的朝鲜 — — 的工人能够参与地区开发所需要的雄心勃勃的项目。
en: Even the labor problem is solvable, with millions of workers from former Soviet Central Asia – and perhaps from a gradually liberalizing North Korea – able to take part in the ambitious development that will be needed.

zh: 但第一步是开始在该地区创造条件，生活和工作对俄罗斯人产生吸引力。
en: But the first step is to start to create conditions in the region that make living and working there attractive to Russians.

zh: 今年的符拉迪沃斯托克亚太经济合作峰会只创造了一块发展飞地。
en: The Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Vladivostok last year created a mere enclave of development.

zh: 全地区增长战略还没有出台。
en: A growth strategy for the whole region is yet to come.

zh: 如果这一情况继续，当前的中俄互相谅解局面几乎肯定会变质。
en: If it does not, the current Sino-Russian entente cordiale is almost certain to sour.

zh: 俄罗斯将产生脆弱感，对于中国的图谋，要么陷入地缘政治冒险主义，要么陷入投降主义。
en: Russia will start to feel vulnerable, and will be pushed toward either geopolitical brinkmanship or submission to China’s will.

zh: 但是，此时此刻，中俄关系似乎比我儿提时代的虚幻友谊好得多。
en: At this point, however, relations between China and Russia appear to be far better than the mythical friendship of my childhood.

zh: 普京和习近平将竭尽全力强调这一点。
en: Putin and Xi will do everything to emphasize that.

zh: 审计美联储？
en: Audit the Fed?

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 本次共和党全国代表大会上通过的党纲中包含了若干引人注目的条款。
en: BERKELEY – The party platform adopted at the Republican National Convention includes a number of remarkable planks.

zh: 例如在一个货币经济学家看来，该党关于恢复某种金属货币本位制度的提议就诡异得就像一个几乎无法抗拒的（批判）目标。
en: To a monetary economist, for example, the party’s proposal to restore some kind of metallic monetary standard is so outlandish as to be an almost irresistible target.

zh: 更严重的是共和党人还提议对美联储进行年度审计。
en: More serious is the Republicans’ proposal for an annual audit of the United States Federal Reserve.

zh: 这跟重回金本位的条款一样，在某种程度上是为了吸引罗恩·保罗（Ron Paul）的自由论追随者 — — 这位德克萨斯州参议员以及多年总统候选人如今成为了共和党“茶党”系的宠儿。
en: This, like the gold-standard plank, is partly designed to appeal to the libertarian followers of Ron Paul, the Texas congressman and perennial presidential candidate who is hugely popular with the Republicans’ “Tea Party” wing.

zh: 虽然保罗可能会更进一步完全撤销美联储，但美国国会已经有几个法案对年度审计给予了授权；今年早些时候，众议院就通过了这样一个法案（但并未获参议院批准 ） 。
en: While Paul would go further, and abolish the Fed altogether, several bills in the US Congress have mandated an annual audit; earlier this year, one such bill was passed by the House of Representatives (but not the Senate).

zh: 共和党人对这个审计理念的采纳其实源自于自由论者对政府总体上的不信任。
en: The Republicans’ embrace of the audit idea taps into libertarians’ general distrust of government.

zh: 但对美联储的不信任还基于某些更具体的原因 — — 这种不信任远远超越茶党的层次。
en: But there is also distrust of the Fed on more specific grounds – distrust that extends well beyond the ranks of the Tea Party.

zh: 美联储的批评者抱怨它利用其巨大的权力实施一系列史无前例的经济干预来支持大型金融机构。
en: The Fed, its critics complain, has used its expansive powers to engage in a range of unprecedented interventions that have propped up large financial institutions.

zh: 因此他们认定金融当局必定是银行界权贵的囊中之物。
en: So the monetary authorities, they argue, must be in the pockets of powerful bankers.

zh: 无可否认，中央银行家们的行为应当接受民主问责。
en: To be sure, central bankers should be democratically accountable for their actions.

zh: 但通过审计来问责的做法可能存在巨大的风险。
en: But accountability by audit would carry significant risks.

zh: 因为这些由政客承担的审计可能会被他们视为赚取政治分数或让政策为自身利益服务的机会，其手段则是刻意泄露信息来向政策制定者施压。
en: Undertaken by politicians, an audit might be viewed as an opportunity to score political points or steer policy in self-serving directions, with delicate information leaked in order to pressure policymakers.

zh: 既然由独立官员来执行货币政策都难言完美，那么把实际控制交付给总想着下届选举的议员肯定会极其糟糕。
en: While monetary policy conducted by independent bureaucrats is imperfect, handing over effective control to congressmen with one eye on the next election would be infinitely worse.

zh: 共和党党纲提到说审计要“谨慎实施”以确保美联储不会受到政治压力影响。
en: The Republican platform notes that the audit would have to be “carefully implemented” to ensure that the Fed remains insulated from political pressures.

zh: 但事实上，影响肯定会有的。
en: Indeed, it would.

zh: 审计也会揭露更多关于金融市场干预行动的细节，比如2008年美联储从贝尔斯登公司和美国国际集团（AIG）处购买抵押贷款证券的情况。
en: An audit would also reveal more details about financial-market interventions like those in 2008, when the Fed purchased mortgage securities from Bear Stearns and AIG.

zh: 此处的风险在于实时提供过多关于美联储购买受助机构证券的信息会影响市场稳定。
en: The risk here is that providing too much information in real time about the securities that the Fed is buying and the institutions that it is helping could destabilize markets.

zh: 这种危险并不是凭空想象的。
en: This danger is not hypothetical.

zh: 上一次政府大规模干预美国金融市场时 — — 换句话说就是大萧条的时候 — — 就能发现这样的例子。
en: We saw an example of it the last time there were massive government interventions in US financial markets – namely, during the Great Depression.

zh: 1932年，美联储不愿出手稳定即将崩溃的银行系统。
en: In 1932, the Fed was unwilling to help stabilize a collapsing banking system.

zh: 但总得有人出来做点什么。
en: But someone had to do something.

zh: 所以时任总统的赫伯特·胡佛（Herbert Hoover）创立了一个名为复兴金融公司（Reconstruction Finance Corporation）的独立政府机构，用以援助缺乏流动资金但基础良好的银行。
en: So President Herbert Hoover created the Reconstruction Finance Corporation, an independent government agency, to aid illiquid but fundamentally sound banks.

zh: 1932年夏复兴金融公司数额最大的一笔贷款就是给前副总统查尔斯·道斯（Charles Dawes）经营的银行。
en: The RFC’s largest loan in the summer of 1932 was to a bank run by former Vice President Charles Dawes.

zh: 但道斯不仅和胡佛一样是名杰出的共和党人；他还是复兴金融公司的前任官员。
en: Not only was Dawes, like Hoover, a prominent Republican; he was also an ex-RFC official.

zh: 即使道斯在自家银行濒临绝境时仍然拒绝利用其政治人脉，复兴金融公司依然遭到了偏袒的指控。
en: Although Dawes refused to make use of his political connections when his bank was pushed to the brink, the RFC nonetheless faced accusations of favoritism.

zh: 国会的民粹派议员不出所料地暴跳如雷，要求实施审计，并坚持要该公司公布所有受援银行名录。
en: Populist members of Congress, predictably outraged, demanded an audit and insisted on publication of a list of all banks that the RFC had aided.

zh: 这份名单在1933年1月一经发布，公众立刻对那些被披露曾向政府借款的银行爆发了信任危机。
en: Publication of that list in January 1933 led to a crisis of confidence in banks that were revealed to have borrowed from the government.

zh: 各银行当即出现挤兑并顷刻席卷全国，结果出现了1933年的银行休假日 — — 也就是强制关闭整个美国银行系统。
en: Bank runs started almost immediately and quickly engulfed the country, resulting in the Bank Holiday of 1933 – that is, in the forced closure of the entire US banking system.

zh: 因此审计不仅仅要避免政治压力，还必须避免影响金融市场和机构的稳定。
en: So it is not just political pressure that an audit must avoid. It must also avoid destabilizing financial markets and institutions.

zh: 这就要求能将信息汇总起来综合处理并允许在发布前存在适当的延迟。
en: That requires aggregating information and allowing for suitable delay before publishing it.

zh: 我们能够相信政治家们（尤其是在选举年）去理解并遵守这一点吗？
en: Can we trust politicians to understand and respect this, especially in an election year?

zh: 国会在1932年 — — 也是一个总统选举年 — — 要求复兴金融公司公布接受贷款的银行名录，这可绝非巧合。
en: It is no coincidence that the demand by Congress for the list of RFC loans occurred in 1932, also a presidential election year.

zh: 美联储的官员明白只有在公众舆论的法庭上为自身行为���担责任，它才能保持独立。
en: Fed officials understand that their institution can remain independent only if it is accountable for its actions in the court of public opinion.

zh: 这也是美联储采取措施增加透明度的原因：它发布了美国联邦公开市场委员会会议记录以及在适当延迟后发布了会议的文字记录，同时委员会成员纷纷发言对自身观点进行了详细阐述。
en: That is why the Fed has been taking steps to become more transparent: it releases the minutes of Federal Open Market Committee meetings and publishes transcripts with appropriate delay, while FOMC members give speeches detailing their views.

zh: 此外，近期的革新则是美联储发布了委员会成员以及储备银行各总裁对通货膨胀和利率的预测。
en: Moreover, in a recent innovation, the Fed now publishes the inflation and interest-rate forecasts of FOMC members and Reserve Bank presidents.

zh: 美联储肯定会在提高透明度上走得更远。
en: The Fed almost certainly will move even further in the direction of transparency.

zh: 其他中央银行也在做同样的事情。
en: Other central banks are doing likewise.

zh: 要在一个民主社会实现独立和问责的协调一致就必须做到这些。
en: No less is required to reconcile independence with accountability in a democratic society.

zh: 但由政治家来监督的审计可不是一个正确的方法。
en: But an audit overseen by politicians is not the right way.

zh: 环球图书馆
en: A Universal Library

zh: 墨尔本 — — 一座网罗一切书面资料的环球图书馆早已是学者们的梦想。
en: MELBOURNE – Scholars have long dreamed of a universal library containing everything that has ever been written.

zh: 2004年，谷歌宣布将开始数字化扫描五大研究图书馆的全部馆藏。
en: Then, in 2004, Google announced that it would begin digitally scanning all the books held by five major research libraries.

zh: 突然间，乌托邦式的图书馆似乎已触手可及。
en: Suddenly, the library of utopia seemed within reach.

zh: 事实上，环球数字图书馆比此前思想家们想象的还要美好，因为任何人在任何地点、任何时间都可以查阅任何著作。
en: Indeed, a digital universal library would be even better than any earlier thinker could have imagined, because every work would be available to everyone, everywhere, at all times.

zh: 而且图书馆可能不仅涵盖书籍和文章，还收录绘画、音乐、电影和能以数字形式捕获的所有其他形式的创意表达。
en: And the library could include not only books and articles, but also paintings, music, films, and every other form of creative expression that can be captured in digital form.

zh: 但是谷歌的计划有一个漏洞。
en: But Google’s plan had a catch.

zh: 那些研究图书馆馆藏的多数作品版权限制依然生效。
en: Most of the works held by those research libraries are still in copyright.

zh: 谷歌说不管版权状况如何，它都将扫描整部书籍，但搜索版权书籍内容的用户只能看到这本书的片段内容。
en: Google said that it would scan the entire book, irrespective of its copyright status, but that users searching for something in copyrighted books would be shown only a snippet.

zh: 谷歌说这种方法“公平合理 ” ， 版权法也有类似的规定，可以从版权书籍中引用一两句话用于评论和探讨。
en: This, it argued, was “fair use” – and thus permitted under copyright laws in the same way that one may quote a sentence or two from a book for the purpose of a review or discussion.

zh: 这种观点无法得到出版商和作者的认同，有人起诉谷歌侵犯版权，最终同意以谷歌收入的一定份额作为补偿。
en: Publishers and authors disagreed, and some sued Google for breach of copyright, eventually agreeing to settle their claim in exchange for a share of Google’s revenue.

zh: 上个月，在曼哈顿法庭上，法官丹尼·金驳回了这样的解决方案，部分原因是对所谓“孤本”书籍数字版的实际垄断权将因此归属谷歌 — — 孤版书是指仍有版权限制、但已不再出版的作品，此类作品已经很难确定其版权归属。
en: Last month, in a Manhattan court, Judge Denny Chin rejected that proposed settlement, in part because it would have given Google a de facto monopoly over the digital versions of so-called “orphan” books – that is, books that are still in copyright, but no longer in print, and whose copyright ownership is difficult to determine.

zh: 金认为决定孤版书籍托管归属及其条件的合理机构是美国国会，而不是法院。
en: Chin held that the United States Congress, not a court, was the appropriate body to decide who should be entrusted with guardianship over orphan books, and on what terms.

zh: 至少在美国司法辖区内考虑问题的前提下，他无疑是对的。
en: He was surely right, at least in so far as we are considering matters within US jurisdiction.

zh: 这些带有普遍性的重要问题不仅关系到作者、出版商和谷歌，还关系到涉及知识和文化传播应用的所有人。
en: These are large and important issues that affect not only authors, publishers, and Google, but anyone with an interest in the diffusion and availability of knowledge and culture.

zh: 因此，虽然金的判决令环球图书馆暂时受挫，但正好可以借此机会重新思考该如何实现这一梦想。
en: So, while Chin’s decision is a temporary setback on the way to a universal library, it provides an opportunity to reconsider how the dream can best be realized.

zh: 核心问题在于：我们怎样在保护作者权利的同时，让所有人不止看到片段，而是看到完整的书籍和文章？
en: The central issue is this: how can we make books and articles – not just snippets, but entire works – available to everyone, while preserving the rights of the works’ creators?

zh: 当然要回答这个问题，首先要确定作者权利的内容。
en: To answer that, of course, we need to decide what those rights are.

zh: 正如发明人被授予专利进而可以在有限时间内利用其发明获利，著作人起初也只在相对较短的一段时间内拥有版权 — — 美国规定是自作品首次出版以后的14年。
en: Just as inventors are given patents so that they can profit from their inventions for a limited time, so, too, authors were originally given copyright for a relatively short period – in the US, it was initially only 14 years from the first publication of the work.

zh: 这段时间足够绝大多数著作人获得作品可能带来的绝大部分收入；之后，作品将进入公共领域。
en: For most authors, that would be enough time to earn the bulk of the income that they would ever receive from their writings; after that, the works would be in the public domain.

zh: 但版权是企业的获利基础，因此它们反复要求国会延长时限，现在美国已经延长到作者死后的70年。
en: But corporations build fortunes on copyright, and repeatedly pushed Congress to extend it, to the point that in the US it now lasts for 70 years after the creator’s death.

zh: （最后一次延期的1998年法案绰号“米老鼠保护法 ” ， 因为法案允许沃尔特·迪斯尼公司保留其著名卡通人物的版权。 ）
en: (The 1998 legislation responsible for the last extension was nicknamed the “Mickey Mouse Protection Act” because it allowed the Walt Disney Company to retain copyright of its famous cartoon character.)

zh: 正因为版权时间太长，以致于四分之三的图书馆藏书都沦为“孤版 ” 。
en: It is because copyright lasts so long that as many as three-quarters of all library books are “orphaned.”

zh: 如此海量的知识、文化和文学成果却无法为多数人所用。
en: This vast collection of knowledge, culture, and literary achievement is inaccessible to most people.

zh: 数字化将使所有网民都能看到这些作品。
en: Digitizing it would make it available to anyone with Internet access.

zh: 正如加州数字图书馆技术总监彼·勃兰特莱所说 ： “ 从道德上考虑，我们有义务检查图书馆的书架，找出所有孤版作品进行扫描。 ”
en: As Peter Brantley, Director of Technology for the California Digital Library, has put it: “We have a moral imperative to reach out to our library shelves, grab the material that is orphaned, and set it on top of scanners.”

zh: 哈佛大学图书馆馆长罗伯特·达顿已经提出了不同于谷歌的备选方案：在研究图书馆联盟之外，建立由联盟基金资助的数字公共图书馆。
en: Robert Darnton, Director of the Harvard University Library, has proposed an alternative to Google’s plans: a digital public library, funded by a coalition of foundations, working in tandem with a coalition of research libraries.

zh: 达顿的方案不能算是严格意义上的环球图书馆，因为在版和有版权限制的作品将被排除在外；但他认为国会可以将孤版书籍数字化授权给一家非商业目的的公共图书馆。
en: Darnton’s plan falls short of a universal library, because works in print and in copyright would be excluded; but he believes that Congress might grant a non-commercial public library the right to digitize orphan books.

zh: 那将是向正确方法迈出的一大步，但我们也不该放弃建设环球数字公共图书馆的梦想。
en: That would be a huge step in the right direction, but we should not give up the dream of a universal digital public library.

zh: 毕竟，在版书籍可能包含最有效的信息，这些信息最符合人们的阅读需要。
en: After all, books still in print are likely to be the ones that contain the most up-to-date information, and the ones that people most want to read.

zh: 很多欧洲国家，以及澳大利亚、加拿大、以色列和新西兰，已经通过了承认“公共借阅权”的法案，换句话说，政府认可让成百上千的人阅读书籍符合公共利益，但同时可能影响这本书籍的销售。
en: Many European countries, as well as Australia, Canada, Israel, and New Zealand, have adopted legislation that creates a “public lending right” – that is, the government recognizes that enabling hundreds of people to read a single copy of a book provides a public good, but that doing so is likely to reduce sales of the book.

zh: 环球公共图书馆可以对在版和仍有版权限制的书籍进行数字化，并根据数字版的阅读次数向出版商和作者支付费用。
en: The universal public library could be allowed to digitize even works that are in print and in copyright, in exchange for fees paid to the publisher and author based on the number of times the digital version is read.

zh: 如果我们可以登月和确定人类基因序列，就应该可以想方设法建成环球数字公共图书馆。
en: If we can put a man on the Moon and sequence the human genome, we should be able to devise something close to a universal digital public library.

zh: 那时我们将面对一个难度更大的道德目标：向全世界目前不到30%网民以外的人推广互联网应用。
en: At that point, we will face another moral imperative, one that will be even more difficult to fulfill: expanding Internet access beyond the less than 30% of the world’s population that currently has it.

zh: 普世革命
en: A Universal Revolution

zh: 纽约 - - 联合国大会在六十年前，也就是1948年12月10日通过了世界人权宣言。 这一文件最为重要的贡献就是宣告了一个强有力的观点，那就是人权是普世的。
en: NEW YORK – The most important contribution of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, adopted by the United Nations General Assembly 60 years ago, on December 10, 1948, was to assert a powerful idea: rights are universal.

zh: 人权并不取决于某一特别社区或者某一国家的国籍。
en: Rights do not depend on membership of a particular community or citizenship in a certain state.

zh: 人权并不来源于社会契约。
en: They do not derive from a social contract.

zh: 由于人权是普世的，因此就是人类的特征。
en: Rather, because rights are universal, they are attributes of all human beings.

zh: 确实，人权是我们之所以为人的原因。
en: Indeed, they are part of what makes us human.

zh: 我们每个人都可以享有人权。
en: Each of us may enjoy rights.

zh: 那些行使权力的人有所顾忌，而正是人权设定了这些顾忌和限制。
en: Those who exercise power may do so only in limited ways. The limits are set by rights.

zh: 当然，人们可以把普世人权的概念最早追溯到十七世纪英国自然法思想。 1789年的法国人权宣言部分地包含了这一概念。
en: It is, of course, possible to trace the concept of universal rights at least as far back as seventeenth-century English thinking about natural law.

zh: 杰菲逊在同一时代有关“不可分离的权利”的语言在更大程度上体现了这一观点。 这一观点也造就了英国十八世纪后期反对奴隶制斗争领导人的思维，而这一斗争成为第一场人权运动。
en: The concept was partially embraced in the French Declaration of Rights of 1789 and, to a greater extent, in Thomas Jefferson’s language in the same era about “inalienable rights.”  It also shaped the thinking of those in England who led the anti-slavery struggle of the second half of the eighteenth century, the first human rights movement.

zh: 然而，世界人权宣言还是向前迈进了一大步。 当时，除了苏联集团国家、沙特阿拉伯以及实行种族隔离制度的南非弃权以外，世界各国政府没有一个投票反对，一致同意人权应该高于国家权力。
en: Yet the Universal Declaration marked a giant step forward, as the world’s governments – with abstentions from the Soviet bloc states, Saudi Arabia, and apartheid South Africa, but with no votes in opposition – agreed that rights should take precedence over state power.

zh: 人们可以把世界人权宣言通过六十年的经历视为实践其诺言的斗争。
en: One way to think about the six decades that have elapsed since the adoption of the Universal Declaration is as a struggle to implement its promises.

zh: 很长时间以来，这一斗争都难以获胜，尤其是由于共产主义和反共极权的扩散。
en: For a long time, it was a losing struggle, marked especially by the spread of both communist and anti-communist tyrannies.

zh: 二十世纪八十年代，拉丁美洲和菲律宾和南韩等东亚国家的军事独裁者纷纷倒台，苏联帝国中越来越多的人参与争取人权的斗争，这时候形势开始变化。
en: Things began to change in the 1980’s with the fall of military dictatorships in Latin America and in such East Asian countries as the Philippines and South Korea, and with the growing number of people engaged in the struggle for human rights in the Soviet empire.

zh: 到了八十年代末，许多苏联集团政权已经倒台了。
en: By the end of the decade, many Soviet bloc regimes had collapsed.

zh: 导致其倒台的一个因素就是思维的改变把东西方冲突从强调经济制度转移开来。 正是极权制度和尊重人权的对比让依附莫斯科的政权们完全丧失信誉并最终让它们垮台。
en: A factor that contributed to their demise was a shift in thinking that transformed the conflict between East and West away from one that emphasized economic systems.  Instead, it was the contrast between totalitarianism and respect for rights that completely discredited the oppressive regimes linked to Moscow and helped to bring them down.

zh: 九十年代早期南非平稳地向多种族民主转型进一步推动了人权。
en: South Africa’s largely peaceful transition to a multi-racial democracy in the early 1990’s was a further advance for rights.

zh: 但是二十世纪的最后十年还是由于前南斯拉夫以及卢旺达的种族灭绝而蒙垢。 在现今的十年中，潮流好像逆转对人权事业不利。
en: But the last decade of the twentieth century was also indelibly stained by ethnic cleansing in ex-Yugoslavia and genocide in Rwanda, and during the current decade the tide has seemed to turn against the rights cause.

zh: 中国、俄国等强国不仅在国内实行极权统制，而且支持其他国家的极权制度。
en: Powerful states such as China and Russia are not limiting themselves to authoritarian rule at home, but are also supporting those in other countries engaged in similar practices.

zh: 伊朗和委内瑞拉等小国也是如此。
en: The same is true of lesser powers such as Iran and Venezuela.

zh: 而且，美国在国际上浪费了大量促进人权的能力。 美国针对发生在自己领土上的9/11恐怖袭击采用了未经指控延长拘押、缺乏合理程序的军事审判以及包括酷刑在内羞辱在押人员等手段。
en: Moreover, the United States has been squandering much of its capacity to promote human rights internationally.  In responding to the terrorist attacks on its own soil on September 11, 2001, the US has resorted to such measures as prolonged indefinite detention without charges, trials before military commissions lacking due process safeguards, and cruel, inhuman, and degrading treatment of detainees, including torture.

zh: 其他国家政府和国际组织也没有填补美国留下的空白。
en: Other governments and intergovernmental bodies have not filled the gap left by the US.

zh: 人们希望，新成立的联合国人权理事会要比其受到非议的前联合国人权委员会更为坚持立场和具有效力。
en: The new UN Human Rights Council has so far disappointed those who hoped that it would be a more principled and effective body than its discredited predecessor, the UN Human Rights Commission.

zh: 但是他们还是大失所望。 欧盟积极推动申请入盟国家的人权，但是并没有表现出它有能力在全世界施加影响力。
en: The European Union has been a positive force in promoting rights in those countries aspiring to membership, but it has not demonstrated a capacity to exercise influence worldwide.

zh: 如今，促进人权最为有效的力量是全球舆论。 大规模和不断成长的非政府人权运动动员这些舆论并且提供信息。
en: Today, the most effective force promoting human rights is global public opinion, informed and mobilized by the large and growing nongovernmental human rights movement, which, as in the recent war between Georgia and Russia, has focused international attention on violations of the laws of armed conflict that protect noncombatants.

zh: 在最近格鲁吉亚和俄国的战争中，这些人权运动让国际社会关注违反保护非作战人员的武装冲突法的事例。
en: It has also led the way in creating international criminal tribunals that prosecute and punish those who commit war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide.

zh: 它们还主导建立了国际刑事法庭，起诉和惩罚那些犯下战争罪、反人类罪以及种族灭绝罪行的人。 它们的成就并不是阻止战争，而是减少伴随武装冲突而来的骇人听闻的违反人权事例。
en: These achievements are not stopping war, but they are reducing the number of terrible human rights violations that accompany armed conflict.

zh: 当然，世界人权宣言通过六十年后还有如此多的国家不顾自己早就支持的原则的确令人痛心。
en: It is, of course, dismaying that 60 years after the adoption of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, so many governments disregard the principles that they endorsed so long ago.

zh: 但是，如果没有从世界人权宣言引发的合法性及其促进遵守的作用，非政府人权组织是无法发展成为全球势力的。
en: Yet without the legitimacy derived from the Universal Declaration and its role in promoting compliance, the nongovernmental human rights movement could not have developed into a global force.

zh: 当各国政府在1948年宣布人权是普世的时候，其成就具有长久的意义。 人权运动即使在困难时期依旧取得进展这一事实说明了这一点。
en: The fact that the movement continues to secure advances even in difficult times is an indication of the enduring significance of what was achieved in 1948 when the world’s governments declared that rights are universal.

zh: 美中气候关系激流涌动
en: A US-China Climate Surge

zh: 利弗莫尔，加利福尼亚 — — 美中关系纷繁多样，某些方面目前还争吵不休，其他则协同合作。
en: LIVERMORE, CALIFORNIA – There are numerous aspects to the United States-China relationship – some currently contentious, others cooperative.

zh: 而能源政策与气候变化领域，就显现出合作契机，概因两国煤炭消耗量超过全球总量一半，与此同时，两国合起来也占据了全球温室气体排放量与世界经济总量的40 % 。
en: One area that presents an opportunity for cooperation is energy policy and climate change, because the two countries’ account for more than 50% of total coal consumption, while their combined share of both global greenhouse-gas emissions and the world economy is 40%.

zh: 若一项旨在维护全球气候公约的国际协议达成，美国方面须采取更大行动削减二氧化碳排放量，而中国方面也应履行承诺削减其碳排放量。
en: If an international agreement to protect the world’s climate is to be reached, much greater action to reduce CO2 emissions will be needed on the part of the US, as well as  binding commitments on China’s part to reduce its carbon burden.

zh: 但若美中最终不合作，全球气候协议将受到挟制。
en: Ultimately, though, without US-China cooperation, a global climate agreement will be held hostage.

zh: 因此，美中僵局是一个世界问题。
en: That is why a US-China standoff is a worldwide problem.

zh: 全球致力于降低总排量，中国却一向极不情愿参与。
en: China has engaged only very reluctantly in the global effort to bring down overall emissions.

zh: 美国国会在通过气候法案上态度相当保留，中国的立场加剧了这种状况，尤其是像一些将其温室气体排放量纳入国际监管问责机制的问题，中国认为这是对其主权的冒犯。
en: The US Congress’s deep reservations regarding the passage of a climate bill has been exacerbated by China’s positions, especially on issues such as international monitoring and accountability for its emissions, which China considers an affront to its sovereignty.

zh: 不过毋庸置疑的是：尽管中国在多边努力上所起的作用缺乏建设性，但其在能源与环境问题上却并未坐视不动。
en: But make no mistake: despite its less-than-constructive role in multilateral efforts, China is not just sitting still on energy and environmental issues.

zh: 在下一个十年内，中国将建造10万兆瓦的风力发电厂（是美国总量的十倍 ） ， 5万兆瓦核电站，1万兆瓦太阳能光伏电站以及1万兆瓦太阳能热电站。
en: Within the next ten years, China will build 100,000 megawatts of wind-power generation plants (10 times the US amount), 50,000 MW of nuclear capacity, 10,000 MW of solar photovoltaic power, and 10,000 MW of solar thermal power.

zh: 此外，中国将降低40%的能源密集度，在清洁能源技术上投入4400亿美元，并每月在能源研发上投入90亿美元。 而在煤炭转化、太阳能、风能与碳吸附方面，中国正尝试规模宏大的新技术。
en: Moreover, China will cut its energy intensity by 40% and is investing $440 billion in clean-energy technology, as well as $9 billion per month in energy R&D. The Chinese are testing on a grand scale novel technologies in coal conversion, solar, wind, and carbon sequestration.

zh: 这些努力令美国预计采取的行动相形见绌。
en: These efforts dwarf expected US initiatives.

zh: 然而在不远的将来，中国还会建造50万兆瓦的燃煤电厂（比美国现有的发电总量还多 ） ， 这对全球大气与环境风险巨大。
en: Nevertheless, in the near future, China also will build 500,000 MW of coal-fired power plants (more than the entire existing US stock), at great risk to the global atmosphere and environment.

zh: 大气中温室气体累积的数学计算严酷无情，根本不容许再失去一个十年。
en: The harsh mathematics of greenhouse gas accumulations in the atmosphere simply does not allow for another lost decade.

zh: 为了通过这个十年的种种挑战，世界，尤其是美国，必须同中国在温室气体排量削减上创建一个牢固而持续的伙伴关系。
en: To get past these challenges this decade, the world – and especially the US – must create a strong and sustaining partnership with China concerning emissions reduction.

zh: 实现这一目标的最佳途径，是建立基于信任及深入理解彼此需求与能力的机构关系。
en: This can best be achieved through institutional relationships based on trust, as well as deep understanding of each other’s needs and capabilities.

zh: 奥巴马与胡锦涛在华盛顿的会晤，似乎已经改善了正在进行的气候协商氛围。 不过，鉴于两国在能源技术上存在直接而激烈的竞争，要利用这一优势，将要求两国在围绕实现大气稳定的共同目标上，也应找到新途径。
en: The Obama/Hu meetings in Washington appear to have improved the atmosphere for the ongoing discussions on climate.  But, given the two countries’ direct and stiff competition in energy technology, taking advantage of this will require them also to find new ways to coalesce around joint goals for atmospheric stabilization, even as they seek to meet their own undeniable national needs.

zh: 总之，需要两国在创新、应用科学、发展与示范方面，发起一个联合倡议。
en: In short, what is needed is a massive, joint initiative in innovation, applied science, development, and demonstration.

zh: 美国方面要做的，是参与一项针对清洁能源发展、持续不断的新运动，该运动涉及大小公司、国家实验室、高校及非政府组织（这是按照奥巴马经济刺激法案条款、美国能源部能源投资一种持续而扩大的形式 ） 。
en: The US component should involve a new, sustained campaign for clean-energy development that involves large and small companies, national laboratories, universities, and non-governmental organizations (a sustained and expanded version of the Department of Energy’s energy investments under Obama’s stimulus legislation).

zh: 该项目是，加快开发并审查下一代清洁能源技术，并满足减少温室气体污染所必须要求削减的能源水平。
en: The object should be to accelerate and vet the next generation of clean-energy technologies, as well as to meet the level of demand reductions that will be necessary to reduce greenhouse-gas pollution.

zh: 由于花费不菲，这个倡议将有助于给予公司和银行担保，他们需要这种担保来投入清洁能源技术所需的资金。
en: While expensive, such an initiative would help give companies and banks the surety they need to invest the capital that these emerging technologies require.

zh: 若进行如此激励，则廉价低碳能源的国内能源市场，将是美国或任何国家经济中的一个巨大力量，会令收益倍增。
en: If so stimulated, the domestic energy market for cheap, low-carbon energy would be a massive force multiplier in the US – or any – economy.

zh: 一项由美国提出、尚未确保政府会支持的倡议，远远不够，只有美国与中国结为伙伴关系，才能获得足够的规模与速度来迎接挑战。
en: A US initiative that is not assured of gaining government support would be insufficient, and only if the US forms a partnership with China would adequate scale and speed be attained to meet the challenge.

zh: 因为现实就是，在美国建造第一家发电厂之前，中国将建造第N家。
en: For the reality is that China will build its “nth” plant before the US builds its first.

zh: 这意味着美国的团体机构甚至政府部门，必须与中国公司机构合作 — — 有时甚至要为其提供资金。
en: This means that US groups, institutions, and even government agencies must begin sharing with – and sometimes even funding – Chinese companies and organizations.

zh: 这种伙伴关系，将为美国减少一半的实验学术成本跟时间，还会避免冗余浪费。
en: Such partnerships would cut by half the cost and time of experimenting and learning for the US, while avoiding redundancy and waste.

zh: 这种努力的成本，甚至只是美国在一个大型示范项目上花费的一部分。
en: The cost of this effort would be a fraction of what the US would spend on even a single large-scale demonstration project.

zh: 不过从长远来看，或许更为重要的是，若世界要达成一项更大的全球气候协议，这种伙伴关系将创建必需的合作与信任框架。
en: But, perhaps more importantly in the long run, it would create the framework of collaboration and trust that is required if the world is to achieve a larger global climate agreement.

zh: 国际能源技术市场竞争残酷。
en: The international energy-technology market is brutal and competitive.

zh: 各国都必须不顾他人，采取一种突飞猛进的技术来赢得优势。
en: Every country must selfishly use a surge strategy to gain advantage.

zh: 但全球自然环境却不会对这种单打独斗各自为政做出应对。
en: But the global environment will not respond to isolated national efforts alone.

zh: 它需要一种崭新而深入的合作方式，而美中就是这幅需要拼贴组合的大型��赛克蓝图上，最重要的部分。
en: It requires new and deeper forms of collaboration, and the US and China are the most important pieces in the larger mosaic that needs to be assembled.

zh: 欧洲应该采用液压致裂法吗？
en: Should Europe be Fracking?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—国际能源业因“液压破碎法”而欢欣鼓舞，这项新技术可以用于开采蕴藏于页岩层之下的天然气。
en: BRUSSELS – The global energy community is abuzz with excitement about hydraulic fracturing, or “fracking,” a newish technology that has opened formerly inaccessible reserves of gas trapped in underground shale formations.

zh: 所谓的页岩气产量的激增能够让美国天然气基本实现自给。
en: The boom in this so-called shale-gas production has allowed the United States to become almost self-sufficient in natural gas.

zh: 相反，欧洲显然落后了。
en: Europe, by contrast, is clearly lagging.

zh: 勘探工作进行得犹犹豫豫，页岩气的生产更是八字都没有一撇，这让许多观察者哀叹，欧洲就要输掉下一场能源革命了。
en: Exploration is proceeding only hesitantly and shale-gas production has not even started, prompting many observers to lament that Europe is about to miss the next energy revolution.

zh: 欧洲应该因此担忧吗？
en: Should Europeans be worried?

zh: 关于欧洲显然缺乏对液压致裂法的热情的批评忽略了两大关键要点。
en: Critics of Europe’s apparent lack of enthusiasm for fracking miss two key points.

zh: 首先，欧洲抵制结构于美国不同。
en: First, Europe’s geology is different from that of America.

zh: 蕴藏于大规模页岩层中的潜在储量和可以以经济的方式生产的可开采储备是截然不同的。
en: There is a huge difference between potential deposits hidden somewhere in large shale formations and recoverable reserves that can actually be produced economically.

zh: 事实上，国际能源署的估计表明，大部分可开采页岩气储量在美国和中国，而不是欧洲，此外，这一估计无非就是有点根据的猜测，因为几十年内只有美国的页岩气进行了密集开采。
en: In fact, estimates by the International Energy Agency suggest that the most significant recoverable reserves of shale gas are in the US and China, not Europe. Moreover, even these estimates are really not much more than educated guesses, because only in the US have shale formations been subject to intense exploration over a period of decades.

zh: 欧洲的开采过程则刚刚开始。
en: This process is starting in Europe only now.

zh: 波兰的地质结构是欧洲最优的，有望在十年后成为欧洲主要页岩气生产国。
en: Poland appears to have Europe’s most favorable geology, and it might become a significant producer on a local scale in about ten years.

zh: 这是个幸运的巧合，因为页岩气的生产将使停止波兰在经济和环境上都不划算的煤炭生产（和消费）补贴变得更具政治可行性。
en: This is a fortunate coincidence, because shale-gas production would probably make it politically easier to phase out Poland’s economically and environmentally irrational subsidies to local coal production (and consumption).

zh: 液压致裂法也将具有战略利益，因为这能够降低波兰对俄罗斯的天然气依赖。
en: Fracking would also be a strategic boon, because it would diminish the country’s dependence on Russia for gas.

zh: 但支持欧盟进行页岩气开采的批评还忽略了第二点：欧盟没有权力在欧洲开发页岩气。
en: But pro-fracking critics of the European Union miss a second point: the EU has no authority over the development of shale gas in Europe.

zh: 开采和生产的许可和管制权属于国家层面的权力。
en: Licensing and regulation of exploration and production are decided at the national level.

zh: 但是，必须承认，在欧洲 ， “ 邻避”现象（别在我的后院中搞）的阻碍作用比美国大得多。
en: One must admit, however, that in Europe the “Nimby” phenomenon (not in my backyard) is a much more serious obstacle than it is in the US.

zh: 欧洲人或许确实对环境问题太过敏感，但激励在其中也起到了作用。
en: While it might be true that Europeans are too sensitive to environmental concerns, incentives also play a role.

zh: 特别是，在美国，天然资源的所有权通常归该资源所在土地的所有者所有，而在欧洲，这一所有权是国家的。
en: In particular, whereas ownership rights over natural resources in the US typically belong to the individual owner of the land under which the resources lie, in Europe ownership belongs to the state.

zh: 因此，欧洲人既担心环境后果，有得不到任何开采的好处，故而会反对在自家附近开采页岩气。
en: As a result, Europeans, facing uncertain environmental consequences while receiving none of the revenues, tend to oppose fracking nearby.

zh: 相反，在美国，本地居民可以从向天然气公司出售页岩气所有权获得巨大的好处 — — 这在很大程度上可以抵消对环境成本的担忧。
en: In the US, by contrast, local residents benefit handsomely from being able to sell their ownership rights to gas companies – a strong counter-balance to fears of environmental costs.

zh: 但自然资源的私人所有权和国家所有权之争并不是美国天然气繁荣的唯一制度性因素。
en: But private versus state ownership of natural resources is not the only institutional factor underlying the US gas boom.

zh: 一个鲜被提及的原因是美国的页岩气开发有重要的税收激励 — — 对此欧洲无需模仿。
en: A seldom-mentioned reason is that shale-gas development in the US has benefited from important tax incentives – a model that Europe has no reason to emulate.

zh: 政府显然应该在支持新技术的开发中扮演角色，液压致裂法就是一例；但是，当技术已经成熟时，就没有理由要求某种天然气的生产方式应该通过税收减免的形式予以补贴。
en: Governments certainly have a role to play in supporting the development of new technologies, such as fracking; but, once the technology has been developed, there is no reason why one form of gas production should be subsidized via tax breaks.

zh: 但关于液压致裂法���最关键（通常也总是被忽略）的一个要点是页岩气和其他碳氢化合物一样，都是不可再生的。
en: But the most crucial – and almost always overlooked – point about fracking is that shale gas, like all hydrocarbons, can be used only once.

zh: 因此，真正的问题不在于欧洲应不应该开采页岩气，而在于什么时候开采：现在还是将来。
en: The real issue is thus not whether shale gas should be developed in Europe, but when it should be used: today or tomorrow.

zh: 欧洲已经是天然气的大用户，但消费量正在（与经济一起）陷入停滞。
en: Europe is already a heavy user of gas, but its consumption is stagnating (along with its economy).

zh: 尽管人们对页岩气革命兴奋不已，但开采（在岸）传统天然气的成本仍在页岩气之下。
en: Despite the hype about the shale-gas revolution, the extraction cost of (onshore) conventional gas remains below that of shale gas.

zh: 此外，现有输气管道网意味着传统天然气可以以较低的边际成本运往欧洲。
en: Moreover, an existing pipeline network implies that this conventional gas can be brought to Europe at a low marginal cost.

zh: 从经济（以及环境）的角度看，液压致裂法并不会给欧洲带来大的好处：页岩气只能对充足的传统天然气起到补充作用。
en: From an economic (and environmental) standpoint, fracking is thus unlikely to bring large benefits for Europe: shale gas might simply substitute for plentiful conventional gas.

zh: 在利率极低的环境下，动作迟缓的经济成本很低。
en: In an environment of ultra-low interest rates, the economic cost of being late is low.

zh: 欧洲的最佳选择或许是等待，让市场来选择。
en: The best option for Europe might be to wait and let the market operate.

zh: 液压致裂法还不是成熟的技术，因此很有可能会随时间的推移而改善。
en: Fracking is not yet a mature technology, and thus it is very likely to improve over time.

zh: 或许在美国页岩气储量开采殆尽的时候，欧洲会成为“高级液压致裂法”的领先者。
en: Maybe Europe will become a leader in “advanced fracking” when the shale-gas deposits in the US have already been exhausted.

zh: 财政紧缩下的增长？
en: Austere Growth?

zh: 华盛顿 — — 法国新任总统弗朗索瓦·奥朗德提倡施行更多促进经济增长的政策，德国政府对此的回应是，欧元区的紧缩项目不能做任何改变。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The German government’s reaction to newly elected French President François Hollande’s call for more growth-oriented policies was to say that there should be no change in the eurozone’s austerity programs.

zh: 不过，促进增长的配套措施，如，欧洲投资银行提供更多贷款或是发行联合担保债券来给具体的投资提供资金，这些政策可以“添加”到紧缩项目里。
en: Rather, growth-supporting measures, such as more lending by the European Investment Bank or issuance of jointly guaranteed project bonds to finance specific investments, could be “added” to these programs.

zh: 许多德国的内部和外界人士都宣称，财政紧缩和更多的增长都是必要的，而且重视增长并不意味着在削弱紧缩政策。
en: Many inside and outside of Germany declare that both austerity and more growth are needed, and that more emphasis on growth does not mean any decrease in austerity.

zh: 正在上演欧元区危机主要集中在欧洲，但是紧缩和增长的论战如何在那里收场，这关系到更多的国家，包括美国。
en: The drama of the ongoing eurozone crisis has focused attention on Europe, but how the austerity-growth debate plays out there is more broadly relevant, including for the United States.

zh: 有三个重点需要明确。
en: Three essential points need to be established.

zh: 第一，在失业和产能过剩普遍存在的情形下，短期的产量则主要是由需求而不是由供给决定。
en: First, in a situation of widespread unemployment and excess capacity, short-run output is determined primarily by demand, not supply.

zh: 在欧元区的成员国中，只有财政政策是国家级的，可以有各国自己决定，因为欧洲银行控制着货币政策。
en: In the eurozone’s member countries, only fiscal policy is possible at the national level, because the European Central Bank controls monetary policy.

zh: 所以，是的，更直接的增长确实需要缓慢地减少财政赤字。
en: So, yes, more immediate growth does require slower reduction in fiscal deficits.

zh: 唯一的反驳观点是，缓慢的财政调整，将会进一步减少消费信心，导致私人消费更低，从而使财政调整计划泡汤。
en: The only counterargument is that slower fiscal adjustment would further reduce confidence and thereby defeat the purpose by resulting in lower private spending.

zh: 如果一个国家完全放弃财政整顿计划以及国际支持，这种情况的确会成真。 但是，如果一个国家决定与国际货币基金组织磋商，延长财政调整期限，这种情况就不可能发生。
en: This might be true if a country were to declare that it was basically giving up on fiscal consolidation plans and the international support associated with it, but it is highly unlikely if a country decides to lengthen the period of fiscal adjustment in consultation with supporting institutions such as the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 事实上，国际货币基金组织在2012年的《世界经济展望》报告中明确建议西班牙进行缓慢的财政整顿。
en: Indeed, the IMF explicitly recommended slower fiscal consolidation for Spain in its 2012 World Economic Outlook.

zh: 没有更多的短期有效需求的支持，处于危机中的许多国家面临着多种螺旋式下跌，缩减预算，降低产量，更高的失业率，更严重的赤字，这些都是由经济“安全网”投入的增加和税收收入的下降导致的，这些税收的减少与产量和就业率的降低息息相关。
en: Without greater short-term support for effective demand, many countries in crisis could face a downward spiral of spending cuts, reduced output, higher unemployment, and even greater deficits, owing to an increase in safety-net expenditures and a decline in tax revenues associated with falling output and employment.

zh: 第二，虽说不容易，但是选择一些更有利于经济增长的财政调整一揽子计划也不是不可能的。
en: Second, it is possible, though not easy, to choose fiscal-consolidation packages that are more growth-friendly than others.

zh: 投资支出和经常支出有着很明显的区别，意大利总理马里奥·蒙蒂如是强调。
en: There is the obvious distinction between investment spending and current expenditure, which Italian Prime Minister Mario Monti has emphasized.

zh: 前者，如果设计合理，将可能为更长期的发展奠定基础。
en: The former, if well designed, can lay the foundations for longer-term growth.

zh: 那些具有倍数效应的政府开支，例如，对低收入却高消费群体的支援，与对富人的减税也是有区别的，相当一部分支出是没有必要的。
en: There is also the distinction between government spending with high multiplier effects, such as support to lower-income groups with a high propensity to spend, and tax reductions for the rich, a substantial portion of which would likely be saved.

zh: 最后一项要点是，长期的体制改革，如，劳动力市场改革，增加了市场灵活性却并未导致大规模的裁员（这种模式在德国成功施行 ） 。
en: Last but not least, there are longer-term structural reforms, such as labor-market reforms that increase flexibility without leading to large-scale lay-offs (a model rather successfully implemented by Germany).

zh: 同样，退休金和养老金改革，可以促进长期的财政稳定，而不带来社会冲突。
en: Similarly, retirement and pension reforms can increase long-term fiscal sustainability without generating social conflict.

zh: 如果工作有了灵活性，一个健康的老年人很有可能会喜欢做一些兼职。
en: A healthy older person may well appreciate part-time work if it comes with flexibility.

zh: 关键任务就是在合理的管理和激励下，将这种工作与劳动力市场的全面运作相融合。
en: The task is to integrate such work into the overall functioning of the labor market with the help of appropriate regulation and incentives.

zh: 最后，尤其是在欧洲，各国被贸易紧密地联合在一起。 这种为财政调整提供更多时间并形成有利于经济增长政策的协调战略，与单个国家战略相比，将会产生大量的益处，这些益处来源于正面溢出效应（同时避免了某些国家的偏见 ） 。
en: Finally, particularly in Europe, where countries are closely linked by trade, a coordinated strategy that allows more time for fiscal consolidation and formulates growth-friendly policies would yield substantial benefits compared to individual countries’ strategies, owing to positive spillovers (and avoidance of stigmatization of particular countries).

zh: 所需要的是欧洲经济增长策略，而不是西班牙，意大利，或是爱尔兰战略。
en: There should be a European growth strategy, rather than Spanish, Italian, or Irish strategies.
