zh: 中国转型为巨大的建筑工地、新兴城市几乎在一夜间崛起的原因之一就是这推动了列宁主义政党统治下炙热的高度腐败经济，统治者通过资产剥离和建设实现了政权货币化的目的。
en: One reason China has been transformed into a gigantic building site, with huge new cities emerging almost overnight, is that this drives a red-hot and highly corrupt economy, ruled by a Leninist party that has monetized political power by asset-stripping and construction.

zh: 弗拉基米尔·普京总统的统一俄罗斯党并未像中共那样宣扬任何形式的马克思主义意识形态根本没有关系。
en: It is irrelevant that President Vladimir Putin’s United Russia Party, unlike the CCP, makes no claim to any form of Marxist ideology.

zh: 两国政府的运作方式非常相似：政党老板、富豪和分赃的腐败份子，宣扬“传统价值观 ” （ 无论是东正教还是儒学） 和沙文主义。
en: The way both governments operate is quite similar: party bosses, tycoons, and corrupt bureaucrats divide the spoils, while promoting chauvinism and “traditional values” – whether those of the Orthodox Church or Confucianism.

zh: 法官遭到收买或恐吓以确保老板们能够高高凌驾于法律。
en: Judges are bought or intimidated to ensure that bosses remain above the law.

zh: 普京的政党在俄大选中当选，这与土耳其总统雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安的正义与发展党、匈牙利总理欧尔班·维克托的青年民主联盟和埃及总统阿卜杜勒 - 法塔赫·塞西的军事政权非常相似。
en: Putin’s party was elected in Russia, as was President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s Justice and Development Party in Turkey, Prime Minister Viktor Orbán’s Fidesz in Hungary, and President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi’s military regime in Egypt.

zh: 但中国共产党却并非如此。
en: The CCP was not.

zh: 但这也基本没有关系。
en: But this, too, is largely irrelevant.

zh: 上述政府的共同点是把资本主义企业和政治威权融合在一起。
en: What these governments share is the fusion of capitalist enterprise and political authoritarianism.

zh: 这种政治模式现在被视作美国式自由民主的强劲对手，或许事实也的确如此。
en: This political model is now seen as a serious rival to American-style liberal democracy, and perhaps it is.

zh: 但是在冷战时期，专制资本主义，往往是在军事政权领导下，通常积极反共并与美国站在一起。
en: But during the Cold War, authoritarian capitalism, usually under military regimes, was anti-Communist and very much on America’s side.

zh: 韩国强人、现任总统朴槿惠的父亲朴正熙在多种意义上是我们现在在中国和俄罗斯所看���的类型社会的先驱。
en: South Korea’s strongman, Park Chung-hee, current President Park Geun-hye’s father, was in many ways a pioneer of the type of society that we now see in China and Russia.

zh: 智利将军奥古斯托·皮诺切特也同样如此。
en: So was Chile’s General Augusto Pinochet.

zh: 因为冷战结束在某种意义上也结束了美国附庸国的独裁统治并代之以自由民主政权，很多人就天真地相信自由民主和资本主义会理所当然 — — 甚至不可避免地 — — 在所有地方走到一起。
en: Because the dictatorships in America’s client states ended more or less when the Cold War did, and were replaced by liberal democracies, many were lulled into the comforting belief that liberal democracy and capitalism would naturally – even inevitably – come together everywhere.

zh: 政治自由对企业有利，反过来也同样如此。
en: Political freedom is good for business, and vice versa.

zh: 这个不可一世的二十世纪神话现在已经被打得粉碎。
en: This great twentieth century myth has now been shattered.

zh: 欧尔班曾在年初声称自由民主不再是一种可行的模式。
en: Orbán claimed earlier this year that liberal democracy was no longer a viable model.

zh: 他认为中国和俄罗斯更为成功，这并非出于意识形态，而是欧尔班认为它们在当今世界更具竞争力。
en: He cited China and Russia as more successful countries, not for ideological reasons, but because he thinks that they are more competitive in today’s world.

zh: 当然有理由对此表示质疑。
en: There are reasons to doubt this, of course.

zh: 俄国经济过分依赖石油和其他自然资源，而中国一党体制的合法性可能会在经济危机中迅速解体。
en: The Russian economy is far too dependent on oil and other natural resources, and the legitimacy of China’s one-party system could collapse quickly in an economic crisis.

zh: 非自由政权出于自身目的利用法律的事实无法激起投资者的信心 — — 至少从长远来看理应如此。
en: The way that illiberal regimes use the law for their own ends will not inspire the confidence of investors, either – at least not in the long run.

zh: 但就目前而言，在《利维坦》和《天注定》中被如此尖刻嘲讽的社会仍然在许多对欧洲经济停滞和美国政治混乱倍感失望的人眼中充满吸引力。
en: And yet, for now, the societies depicted so acidly in Leviathan and A Touch of Sin continue to look good in the eyes of many people who are disillusioned with Europe’s economic stagnation and America’s political dysfunction.

zh: 西方商人、艺术家、建筑师和其他需要大资金建设昂贵项目的人喜欢与能“把事情做好”的独裁政权合作。
en: Western businessmen, artists, architects, and others who need large amounts of money for expensive projects enjoy working with authoritarian regimes that “get things done.”

zh: 极左和极右两翼的专制思想家对敢于与美国为敌的强人充满敬意。
en: Illiberal thinkers on the far right and left admire strongmen who stand up to America.

zh: 《天注定》已经在世界各国上映并广受好评，但唯独在中国不是。
en: A Touch of Sin has been shown to great acclaim all over the world, but not in China.

zh: 相比之下 ， 《 利维坦》已正式代表俄罗斯参与对奥斯卡奖的角逐。
en: Leviathan, by contrast, has been submitted as the official Russian entry for the Oscars.

zh: 也许中国统治者不像普京那样对自己充满信心。
en: Perhaps China’s rulers are less sure of themselves than Putin.

zh: 又或者普京只是更加精明狡诈而已。
en: Or perhaps Putin is just a bit cannier.

zh: 他在俄国的追随者不太可能看到这部艺术电影，更不用说受其影响，而这层俄罗斯言论自由的镀金或许只会说服外国人普京的独裁民主 — — 至少在成为支离破碎的幻觉之前依然残存着少许自由主义。
en: His followers in Russia are unlikely to see, let alone be influenced by, an art film, and this sliver of Russian free expression might just persuade foreigners that there is still some liberalism left in Putin’s authoritarian democracy – at least until that, too, ends up as a shattered illusion.

zh: 强硬派的艰难时刻
en: Tough Times for the Tough Guys

zh: 塔恩，法国—强人领袖之间的共同点似乎在减少。
en: TARN, FRANCE – Shares in strongman leaders seem to be falling.

zh: 市场尚未看空，但独裁者也没有理由自觉“牛气 ” 。
en: The market has not yet turned bearish, but autocrats have little reason to feel bullish.

zh: 以中国为例。
en: Consider China.

zh: 中共内部权力博弈以密不透风闻名，政治内斗很少达到无法掩盖的地步。
en: The internal power games of the Communist Party of China (CPC) are notoriously opaque, and rarely does political infighting reach the level at which it cannot be covered up.

zh: 但焦虑的声音振聋发聩。
en: And yet rumbles of disquiet can clearly be heard.

zh: 本月，习近平主席和他的高级顾问们从北戴度假归来，有流言称习近平在普通党员中间大搞个人崇拜的引起了越来越多的批评。
en: This month, as President Xi Jinping and his senior advisers retreated to the seaside resort of Beidaihe, rumors were circulating about growing criticism of Xi’s personality cult among the CPC rank and file.

zh: 从流言判断，习近平应该扪心自问在邓小平改革基础上倒退的是否明智，无视江泽民和胡锦涛等中共前领导人树立的先例是否明智。
en: Judging by the rumors, Xi should be asking himself if it was wise to roll back Deng Xiaoping’s reforms, and to ignore the precedents set by former CPC leaders such as Jiang Zemin and Hu Jintao.

zh: 从美国总统特朗普的民族主义敏感性和保护主义霸凌，他也许还想反思一下他的必胜姿态。
en: He might also want to reconsider his triumphalist rhetoric, given US President Donald Trump’s nationalist sensitivities and protectionist bullying.

zh: 最后，他可能想重新评估他的主要政策一带一路计划，该政策被越来越多的人屁为中国向其他负债国输出债务的机制，通常是通过没有意义或值得怀疑的项目的投资实现。
en: Lastly, he may want to reassess his signature policy, the Belt and Road Initiative, which is increasingly being criticized as a mechanism for China to export its debt to other indebted countries, often through investments in white elephants and other dubious projects.

zh: 与此同时，习近平的新好朋友、俄罗斯总统普京在政治上仍然不可撼动。
en: Meanwhile, Xi’s new best friend, Russian President Vladimir Putin, remains politically impregnable.

zh: 但是，一位福克斯新闻台记者最近指出，这也许是因为他的批评者“最后都死了 ” 。
en: But, as one Fox News reporter suggested, that might be because so many of his critics “end up dead.”

zh: 俄罗斯政府收入仍有40%依靠石油和天然气，而其经济因为企业家活力和外国投资丧失殆尽，一直死气沉沉。
en: Russia’s government still depends on oil and gas for 40% of its revenue, and the economy, deprived of both entrepreneurial dynamism and foreign investment, remains moribund.

zh: 看看你的家里，除了伏特加、能源、托尔斯泰作品，有哪些俄罗斯货。
en: Look around your home and see if you can find anything that came from Russia, aside from vodka, energy, or the works of Tolstoy.

zh: 但普京和习近平的强人麻烦与土耳其总统埃尔多安和特朗普比起来只是小巫见大巫。 眼下特朗普正在被他深陷联邦重罪的长期合作律师和“擦屁股的人”纠缠。
en: But Putin and Xi’s strongman troubles pale in comparison to those of Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan and Trump, who has now been implicated by his longtime lawyer and “fixer” in the commission of a federal felony.

zh: 十五年前，埃尔多安在一场外汇危机后上台掌权，如今，他似乎准备炮制一场属于他自己的新危机。
en: Fifteen years after coming to power on the back of a foreign-exchange crisis, Erdoğan now seems intent on manufacturing a new crisis of his own.

zh: 今年，土耳其里拉兑美元汇率已经跌去 38 % ， 而这一局面几乎完全是因为埃尔多安不懂经济、任人唯亲、刚愎自用。
en: The Turkish lira has lost 38% of its value against the dollar this year, owing almost entirely to Erdoğan’s economic illiteracy, cronyism, and deafness to alternative viewpoints.

zh: 和他的前任总统居尔不同，埃尔多安从未为了成为整个国家的领袖而付出巨大的努力。
en: Unlike his predecessor as president, Abdullah Gül, Erdoğan has never made much of an effort to be a leader for the whole country.

zh: 他的傲慢风格和自利政策加深了富裕的世俗派和他的“基本盘 ” 、 较贫穷的农村穆斯林之间的裂痕。
en: His overbearing manner and self-serving policies have deepened the divisions between affluent secularists and the poorer, rural Muslims who form his base.

zh: 土耳其最近的危机原本不必发声，这更增加了它的悲剧性。
en: Turkey’s latest crisis is all the more tragic for being unnecessary.

zh: 土耳其是一个重要的地区枢纽，拥有8,100万人口，扼守着西方、中东和中亚之间的交通要津。
en: The country is an important regional hub, home to 81 million people, and a bridge between the West, the Middle East, and Central Asia.

zh: 它具有成为经济发动机的潜力。
en: It has the potential to be an economic dynamo.

zh: 但埃尔多安的政策正在将土耳其经济拖入黑洞。
en: But Erdoğan’s policies are dragging Turkey’s economy into a hole.

zh: 尽管里拉暴跌、通胀高企，但埃尔多安仍然施压央行不许升息，担心增长放缓会影响到他的政党在明年的地方选举中的前景，特别是在土耳其城市地区。
en: Though the lira is in freefall and inflation is soaring, Erdoğan has pressured the central bank not to raise interest rates, for fear that a growth slowdown will hurt his party’s prospects in next year’s local elections, especially in Turkey’s cities.

zh: 但在未来12个月中，他需要解决日益扩大的经常项目赤字和堆积如山的美元计价债务。
en: But over the next 12 months, he will have to deal with a widening current-account deficit and a mountain of dollar-denominated debt.

zh: 更糟糕的是，埃尔多安最近认命了他根本不够格的女婿比拉特·阿尔贝拉克（Berat Albayrak ） — —安卡拉的加雷德·库什纳（Jared Kushner ） — —为金融和财政部长，进一步动摇了市场。
en: Making matters worse, Erdoğan recently appointed his unqualified son-in-law, Berat Albayrak – the Jared Kushner of Ankara – as Minister of Finance and Treasury, further unsettling the markets.

zh: 他还升级了与美国的外交和贸易纠纷，起因是一位被控参与了2016年针对埃尔多安的政变的被捕美国牧师。
en: And he has engaged in an escalating diplomatic and trade dispute with the US over the arrest of an American pastor accused of complicity in the 2016 coup attempt against Erdoğan.

zh: 至于特朗普，已将解救牧师作为自己的个人十字军东征，极有可能在11月的美国中期选举期间起到团结他的福音派票仓的作用。
en: Trump, for his part, has made freeing the pastor a personal crusade, most likely as a sop to his evangelical base in the run-up to the US midterm elections this November.

zh: 为此，他最近宣布将美国对土钢铝关税提高一倍。
en: To that end, he recently announced that he will double US levies on Turkish aluminum and steel.

zh: 特朗普急切地想要证明他不会受任何人（普京除外）的摆布。
en: Trump’s desperation to prove that he cannot be pushed around by anyone (except Putin) is well known.

zh: 在与土耳其的纠纷中，他毫不犹豫地把关税作为狂欢节糖果那样洒出，丝毫不顾它可能对美国企业和消费者造成的反作用。
en: In the dispute with Turkey, he did not hesitate to throw tariffs around like confetti, regardless of the potential blowback on US businesses and consumers.

zh: 土耳其是重要的北约盟友也无济于事。
en: Never mind that Turkey is an important NATO ally.

zh: 特朗普似乎想要把它踢出联盟，推向俄罗斯和中国的怀抱。
en: Trump seems intent on pushing it out of the alliance and into the arms of Russia and China.

zh: 尽管遇到了各种法律问题，合法性日益受到质疑，但特朗普仍在破坏着美国帮助建立的战后国际秩序。
en: Despite his mounting legal problems and increasingly dubious legitimacy, Trump has continued to wreck the post-war international order that America helped to create.

zh: 更糟糕的是，他的自私本土论正在亚洲和欧洲蔓延，扰乱了意大利、匈牙利、波兰甚至英国政坛。
en: Worse still, his brand of selfish nativism is spreading through Asia and Europe, upending politics in Italy, Hungary, Poland, and even the United Kingdom.

zh: 在英国，新任外事大臣杰里米·亨特（Jeremy Hunt）指出，英国退欧背后的运动与其他国家的民粹主义民族主义是不同的。
en: In Britain, the new foreign secretary, Jeremy Hunt, has argued that the movement behind the Brexit campaign is different from the populist nationalism in other countries.

zh: 并非如此。
en: It isn’t.

zh: 身陷重围的死硬退欧派显然热衷于攻击移民和外国人。
en: Beleaguered Brexit hardliners are clearly animated by hostility toward immigrants and foreigners.

zh: 但凡亨特对此有任何质疑，只需要看看他的前任鲍里斯·约翰逊（Boris Johnson ） ， 他最近撰文  嘲弄身穿布卡的穆斯林妇女
en: If Hunt has any doubt about that, he need look no further than his predecessor, Boris Johnson, who recently wrote a commentary mocking Muslim women who wear burqas.

zh: 与今天抱负满满的强人不同，真正强硬的领导人应该支持国际合作，寻求说服选民国际合作的重要性。
en: Unlike today’s aspiring strongmen, a truly tough leader would stand up for international cooperation, and seek to persuade voters why it matters.

zh: 但愿法国总统马克龙、德国总理默克尔和日本首相安倍晋三能够在未来几个月中完成这一任务。
en: One hopes that French President Emmanuel Macron, German Chancellor Angela Merkel, and Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe will do precisely that in the coming months.

zh: 与此同时，但愿想成为强硬派的特朗普和埃尔多安等人不会给各自的国家，以及我们这些其他人带来太多伤害。
en: In the meantime, we must pray that wannabe tough guys like Trump and Erdoğan do not do too much damage to their respective countries, and to the rest of us.

zh: 应该让合作再次伟大。
en: It is time to make cooperation great again.

zh: 自动储蓄
en: Automatic Savers

zh: 财富让人入迷。
en: People are fascinated by wealth.

zh: 人们喜欢看富有之人，心里想着他们的豪宅、豪华度假、精致汽车以及美食。
en: They enjoy watching the wealthy, savoring the thought of their fine homes, luxurious vacations, fancy cars, and gourmet dining.

zh: 但是如果你从这一点得出结论说人们花大量时间对自己财富的终生积累做出规划，那么你就错了。
en: But if you infer from this that people spend a lot of time planning the lifetime accumulation of their own wealth, you would be wrong.

zh: 大多数人好像并不认真思考他们应该从收入中拿出多少用于储蓄，或者如果他们仅仅是现在调整储蓄水平，他们老来财富的差别可以有多大。
en: Most people do not seem to think very hard about how much to save from their income, or about how big the differences in their wealth could be in their later years if they just adjusted their saving rate today.

zh: 大多数人仅仅是偿还房屋按揭贷款，交纳法定的国家或者私人养老金(如果他们有的话 ) ， 再有存一些钱用于不时之需。
en: Most people just pay off their mortgage, make the mandatory contributions to their state or private pension (if they have one), and keep some money for short-run contingencies.

zh: 大体就是如此。
en: That’s about it.

zh: 经济学家拉姆茨在其1928年发表的一篇著名文章中说到，人们对于他们今天的行为如何影响其自身的未来“缺乏想像 ” 。
en: The economist Frank Ramsey, in a famous article published in 1928, said that people have a “weakness of the imagination” about how their actions today affect their own future.

zh: 他说，如果人们正确考虑这一问题，他们就会得出结论说他们应当把收入的一半用于储蓄。
en: He said that if people thought about it correctly, they might well conclude that they should save half their income.

zh: 这样，积累下来的财富会让他们老来十分幸福。
en: That way, the accumulated wealth might make them very happy in their later years.

zh: 但是，在大多数情况下，他们甚至根本就不考虑这一可能性。
en: But, mostly, they don’t even think about that possibility.

zh: 当代经济学家泰勒在1980年谈到“基金效应 ” 。
en: Richard Thaler, a contemporary economist, spoke in 1980 of an “endowment effect.”

zh: 即使人们可能崇尚其他东西，但是他们做起事来好像是安于现状，并且缺乏考虑真正改变的意志。
en: Even though people may admire other things, they act as if they are mostly happy enough with whatever they already have, and lack the will to consider real change.

zh: 各国政府面对的最大的挑战之一就是人们对于未来储蓄无动于衷。
en: One of the biggest challenges governments face is humans’ apathy about future saving.

zh: 深谋远虑的政治人物认识到这一问题确实存在，无法忽略。
en: Thoughtful leaders recognize that the problem is there and tangible, not to be ignored.

zh: 但是却难以把解决方案适用于传统的自由派或者传统保守派理念之中。
en: Yet it is hard to fit solutions into either a traditional liberal or traditional conservative political philosophy.

zh: 从1955年以来，新加坡采取了直接措施，也就是强制性的全国储蓄计划，这一计划具有很高的储蓄利息。
en: Since 1955, Singapore has taken a direct approach: a compulsory national saving plan, which generates very high saving rates.

zh: 对于高收入人士，交纳中央节俭基金的比例达到34.5 % 。
en: The contribution rate for the Central Provident Fund is now 34.5% for people with higher incomes.

zh: 美国没有强制性的储蓄计划，而且其个人储蓄水平极为低下，实际上是负数。
en: The United States has no compulsory saving plan, and it has an abysmally low – in fact, negative – personal saving rate.

zh: 但是美国政府却不愿意考虑强制性储蓄计划。
en: But the government is loath to consider a mandatory saving plan.

zh: 相反，它却采取措施克服阻碍储蓄的个人惰性。
en: Instead, it is taking steps to overcome the individual inertia that inhibits saving.

zh: 美国2006年养老金保护法案鼓励雇主将雇员自动吸纳到老年个人储蓄计划之中。
en: The US Pension Protection Act of 2006 encourages employers to enroll employees automatically in a personal saving plan for old age.

zh: 这与新加坡的根本不同，因为并不要求雇主这样做。 参加计划的雇员的工资不经其同意就可以抵扣，他们可以自己要求退出计划。
en: This differs fundamentally from Singapore’s scheme, since employers are not required to do so, and, while enrolled employees’ paychecks are deducted without their consent, they can drop out of the plan at their own request.

zh: 新西兰最近退出的“维基储蓄”以及英国2007年的养老金法案同样也基于雇员自动参加，但有自由退出条款。
en: New Zealand’s recent “KiwiSaver” plan and the United Kingdom’s Pensions Act of 2007 are similarly based on automatic enrollment for employees with free opt-out provisions.

zh: 但是，哈佛大学教授马德琳认为，即使雇员完全可以自由退出，自动参加储蓄计划也是极为重要的。
en: Nevertheless, according to Brigitte Madrian of Harvard University, automatic enrollment in savings plans is critically important, even if the employee is completely free to drop out.

zh: 如果雇主告诉他们的雇员说现在有一项养老金储蓄计划，甚至保证也交纳和雇员同样多的钱，很大一部分雇员依旧不会参加。
en: If employers tell their new employees that a pension saving plan is available, and even promise to match employees’ contributions, a significant fraction of employees still will not participate.

zh: 但是如果雇主实际上自动把雇员吸纳进计划之中，告诉他们说他们只要通知雇主就可以随时退出，那么雇员的大多数就将会接受这一计划。
en: But if employers actually enroll their employees automatically in the plan, telling them that they can drop out at any time simply by notifying the employer, a large majority of employees will just accept the plan.

zh: 而且，无论雇主选择多少交纳数额，好像雇员会消极地接受，这就像接受确立的投资分配一样(比如股票和债券 ) 。
en: Moreover, it appears that whatever contribution rate the employer chooses tends to be accepted passively by the employee, as does whatever investment allocation (between stocks and bonds, for example) is established.

zh: 马德琳和她的同事们提出，新的养老金计划将会在得到采纳的国家提高储蓄。
en: The research of Madrian and her colleagues suggests that the new pension plans will improve saving in the countries that adopt them.

zh: 或许这些国家采纳强制性的储蓄计划将会更好，但是它们不会这样做。
en: Maybe these countries could do even better by adopting a compulsory saving plan, but they are not about to do so.

zh: 所以，尽管它们无法把储蓄水平提高到新加坡那样的高度，但是它们还是可以取得实际的进展。
en: So, although they won’t succeed in raising saving on the scale that Singapore has, they can make real progress.

zh: 不强制实行储蓄计划的最佳理由是，不同的人面对只有他们自己才清楚的不同情况。
en: The best reason not to make savings plans compulsory is that different people face very different circumstances that only they know about.

zh: 有些人喜欢他们的工作，而且永远不想退休；对于他们而言，储蓄并不如此重要。
en: Some people love their work, and never want to retire; for them, saving is less important.

zh: 有些人想要在教育、心理治疗或者任何对于他们现在是重要的事情上花大钱，所以就想推迟储蓄。
en: Some people want to spend a lot now on education, or psychotherapy, or whatever else is important to them now, and so want to postpone saving until later.

zh: 根本问题是，尽管某些人出于合理的理由而推迟储蓄并在以后恢复储蓄，还有许多其他人没有什么好的理由而没有储蓄，而且也不大会将来补偿。
en: The fundamental problem is that while some people postpone saving for sensible reasons, and will resume saving later, many others fail to save for no good reason, and are unlikely to make up for it later.

zh: 建立在自动而非强制性参加的政府储蓄计划可以处理这一问题，即使它不是尽善尽美。
en: A government saving plan that is based on automatic, though not compulsory, enrollment has the ability to deal with this problem, if only imperfectly.

zh: 自动参加建立对于普通人而言合理的储蓄计划。
en: Automatic enrollment creates a saving plan that is sensible for the typical person.

zh: 没有留心也不积极的人可以随便留在计划之中，而那些确实想退出的人可以通过写封信就退出。
en: People who are not paying attention and are just not active will simply remain in the plan, while those who want badly enough to opt out can do so by writing a letter.

zh: 这些储蓄计划标明，除了完全强制性的手段以外还有其他方法来克服人的惰性。
en: These saving plans show that there are methods other than outright compulsion to overcome human inertia.

zh: 人们希望，将来会在足够大的规模上采纳这样的计划，如此我们就可以设计出众多新的项目，让懒惰和积极的人都各得其所。
en: One hopes that, in the future, such plans will be adopted on a large enough scale that we can devise a variety of new programs that serve both inertial and active individuals well.

zh: 机器所引发的愤怒？
en: Rage Against the Machine?

zh: 伯克利 — — 遍布整个世界，智能机器正在改变我们生产、工作、学习和生活的方式。
en: BERKELEY – Intelligent machines are transforming the way we produce, work, learn, and live throughout the world.

zh: 我们经济的几乎方方面面都将发生彻底的变革。
en: Almost every aspect of our economies will be radically altered.

zh: 大型物流企业和个人司机正在利用新技术来优化路线规划。
en: Major logistics companies and individual drivers are using new technologies to optimize their route planning.

zh: 像宝马和特斯拉这样的企业已经发布了汽车自动驾驶功能，人类是在精密机器人的协助下实现这一目标的。
en: Companies like BMW and Tesla have already released self-driving features in their automobiles, which are produced with the help of sophisticated robots.

zh: 美联社正在利用人工智能协助撰写新闻报道。
en: The Associated Press is using artificial intelligence to help write news stories.

zh: 人们正在使用3D打印机生产用于更换的零部件 — — 无论是用在机器还是人类身上。
en: 3D printers are being used to produce replacement parts – for both machines and humans.

zh: 美国电话电报公司与优达学城合作，正在提供数据分析领域的在线“纳米学位 ” 。
en: AT&T, in collaboration with Udacity, is offering online “nanodegrees” in data analytics.

zh: 无人机正在将卫生用品运送到贫困国家的边远地区。
en: Drones are delivering health supplies to remote locations in poor countries.

zh: 这些奇妙的新技术可以提高生产率、提升效率，同时也可以使生产活动更加安全、方便和灵活。
en: These marvelous new technologies promise higher productivity, greater efficiency, and more safety, flexibility, and convenience.

zh: 但它们也引发了新技术对岗位、技能和薪酬影响的担忧 。
en: But they are also stoking fears about their effects on jobs, skills, and wages.

zh: 最近牛津大学卡尔·佛雷和迈克尔·奥斯本以及麦肯锡全球研究院（MGI）所发布的另一项研究成果加深了人们的恐惧，这两项研究发现发达和发展中国家大量的就业机会在技术上均可通过自动化来完成。
en: Feeding these fears is a recent study by the University of Oxford’s Carl Frey and Michael Osborne, and another by the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI), which find that large shares of employment in both developing and developed countries could technically be automated.

zh: 但历史和经济理论表明人们对技术失业问题（这个词由约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯在近一个世纪前发明）的焦虑是没有道理的。
en: History and economic theory, however, suggest that anxieties about technological unemployment, a term coined by John Maynard Keynes nearly a century ago, are misplaced.

zh: 未来其实与过去一样，技术变革很可能会促进生产率提高和收入增长，同时拉动对劳动力的需求。
en: In the future, as in the past, technological change is likely to fuel productivity gains and income growth, boosting demand for labor.

zh: 再加上价格的下降和质量的提升，对商品和服务的需求也将是上升的。
en: Add to that lower prices and rising quality, and demand for goods and services will also increase.

zh: 许多新技术创造的工作今天甚至无法想象，就像一个世纪前，很少有人能够预料到汽车的普及会催生免停车外卖餐厅和路边汽车旅馆一样。
en: Many of the jobs created cannot even be imagined today, just as few people a century ago could have anticipated that automobiles would give rise to drive-through restaurants and roadside motels.

zh: 一份新的麦肯锡全球研究报告发现在自动化发展速度和广度相对温和的情况下，从现在起到2030年，全球大约15%的劳动力（约4亿人）可能会失去工作。
en: A new MGI report finds that under a moderate scenario for the speed and breadth of automation, about 15% of the global workforce, or 400 million workers, could be displaced between now and 2030.

zh: 如果自动化速度加快可能导致更多人失去工作。
en: A faster pace of automation would trigger greater displacement.

zh: 好消息是由于预计商品和服务需求增加 — — 背后的推动力量主要是收入增加、老龄化人口的卫生保健需求增加以及在基础设施、能源效率和可再生能源领域的投资 — — 很可能会创造出足够数量的新工作以弥补原有工作岗位的损失。
en: The good news is that as a result of projected increases in demand for goods and services – driven primarily by rising incomes, the growing health-care needs of aging populations, and investment in infrastructure, energy efficiency, and renewables – enough new jobs are likely to be created to offset job losses.

zh: 但新工作却与被自动化所取代的旧工作差异巨大，从而将痛苦的转型成本强加在工人、企业和社团身上。
en: But the new jobs will differ mightily from the jobs displaced by automation, imposing painful transition costs on workers, businesses, and communities.

zh: 根据自动化的速度，到2030年，共有7，500万-3亿7，500万劳动者，也就是3~14%的全球劳动人口需要完成职业类别转型。
en: Depending on the pace of automation, 75-375 million workers, or 3-14% of the global workforce, will need to change occupational categories by 2030.

zh: 在可能更快实现自动化的美国和其他发达经济体，9~32%的劳动者可能需要转换职业类别和与之相适应的技能。
en: In the United States and other developed economies where automation is likely to occur more rapidly, 9-32% of the workforce may need to change occupational categories and the skills associated with them.

zh: 在这些国家，生产及办公室支持等领域主要的职业岗位，以及需要高中及以下学历就能胜任的岗位很可能会逐步下降，而像医疗保健服务、教育、建筑和管理等职业类别的工作岗位，以及需要大学或高等学历才能胜任的工作岗位，将会逐渐增加。
en: In these countries, jobs in major occupational categories like production and office support, and jobs requiring a high school education or less, are likely to decline, while jobs in occupational categories like health and care provision, education, construction, and management, and jobs requiring a college or advanced degree, will increase.

zh: 一份近期调查结果显示，绝大多数美国人担心自动化会加剧收入不平等。
en: According to one recent survey, the majority of Americans are concerned that automation will increase income inequality.

zh: 他们的担忧似乎是有道理的。
en: Their concern appears warranted.

zh: 随着许多中等薪酬职业让位于自动化，美国和其他发达国家很可能会继续上演收入两极分化的状况。
en: As many middle-wage occupations succumb to automation, income polarization in the US and other developed countries is likely to continue.

zh: 如果因自动化而被取代的工人无法很快找到新工作，那么摩擦性失业将会上升，从而对工资产生下行压力。
en: If workers displaced by automation are unable to find new jobs quickly, frictional unemployment will rise, putting downward pressure on wages.

zh: 那么，我们应采取哪些措施来加速及缓解自动化所带来的职业转型呢？
en: So, what can be done to speed and ease the occupational transitions that automation will compel?

zh: 首先，保持充分就业和总需求的财政和货币政策至关重要。
en: For starters, fiscal and monetary policies to sustain full-employment levels of aggregate demand are critical.

zh: 促进基础设施、住房建设、替代能源和儿童及老人看护服务的投资可以加强经济竞争力及促进包容性增长，同时还可以在自动化可能拓展、而非替代的职业领域创造数以百万计的就业机会。
en: Policies to promote investment in infrastructure, housing, alternative energy, and care for the young and the aging can boost economic competitiveness and inclusive growth, while creating millions of jobs in occupations likely to be augmented, rather than displaced, by automation.

zh: 还有一项对策应当是对劳动者培训计划的大幅拓展和重新设计。
en: A second response must be a dramatic expansion and redesign of workforce training programs.

zh: 在过去20年中，绝大多数经合组织国家政府的技能培训和劳动力市场调整支出均呈下降趋势。
en: Over the past two decades, government outlays for skills training and labor-market adjustment have fallen in most OECD countries.

zh: 伴随上述趋势的还有美国企业培训支出的大幅下降。
en: That has been compounded in the US by a sizeable decline in business spending on training as well.

zh: 我们必须扭转这样的趋势。
en: These trends must be reversed.

zh: 终身学习需要成为现实。
en: Lifelong learning needs to become a reality.

zh: 随着机器接管某些工作，人类的工作岗位会发生改变，而人类活动则会需要截然不同的技术。
en: Jobs will change as machines take over some tasks, and human activities will require different skills.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院的分析表明高级认知能力 — — 如逻辑推理、强大的沟通技巧以及社交和情感技巧 — — 将在重要性上大幅提升，而机器则将逐步取代当今工作场所随处可见的常规能力，包括数据搜集和处理等认知类工作。
en: MGI’s analysis shows that higher-level cognitive abilities – such as logical reasoning, stronger communication skills, and enhanced social and emotional skills – will become more important, while machines take over routine capabilities common in the workplace today, including in cognitive tasks like data collection and processing.

zh: 对已有子女、抵押贷款和其他财务责任的中年劳动者来说，必须接受以周或月、而非年计的培训，同时接受上述培训的资金支持也是不可或缺的。
en: For mid-career workers with children, mortgages, and other financial responsibilities, training that is measured in weeks and months, not in years, will be necessary, as will financial support to undertake such training.

zh: 不能像我们所习惯的那样让人们自费攻读两年学位。
en: Sending people for two-year degrees at their own expense is not the answer.

zh: 相反，纳米学位和可拓展证书可能越来越重要。
en: Instead, nanodegrees and stackable credentials are likely to gain in importance.

zh: 德国式的学徒制结合课堂作业和实际操作，可以让参与者在拿工资的同时不断学习，即使对中年失业的劳动者而言也可以成为重要的出路。
en: German-style apprenticeships combining classroom work and practical work, and enabling participants to earn a salary while learning, could be important solutions even for middle-aged displaced workers.

zh: 美国电话电报公司（本文一名作者为该公司董事会成员 ） 、 星巴克和其他企业所展现的企业与教育机构之间的合作可以为工人提供所需的强化新技术。
en: Collaboration between companies and educational institutions, as AT&T (on whose board one of the authors serves), Starbucks, and other firms are showing, can provide workers with the new or enhanced skills that are increasingly needed.

zh: 鼓励更多企业（尤其是中小型企业）对劳动力培训投资的税收和其他激励机制可能是必须的。
en: Tax and other incentives to encourage more business investment in workforce training, especially by small and medium-size companies, may be necessary.

zh: 政府也需要提供全面和方便的医疗、育儿和退休保障等社会福利，以及为劳动者提供转型支持，协助他们更换岗位、职业和雇主。
en: Governments will also need to offer universal and portable social benefits like health care, child care, and retirement security, as well as transition support, to workers who are forced to change jobs, occupations, and employers frequently.

zh: 由私营部门运营并由企业工资税出资的瑞典职业安全委员会为失业工人提供全套的收入支持、培训、指导和社会工作人员评估等服务。
en: Sweden’s job-security councils, run by the private sector and funded by a payroll tax on companies, provide displaced workers with a comprehensive suite of income support, training, coaching, and assessment with caseworkers.

zh: 像此前的技术一样，今天的自动化有望实现重大的生产力提升，从而使个人、团体和社会受益。
en: Like previous technologies, automation today promises major productivity gains, benefiting individuals, communities, and societies.

zh: 但对数以百万计的劳动者而言，通往自动化未来之路可能是艰苦而漫长的。
en: But, for millions of workers, the path to an increasingly automated future could be long and difficult.

zh: 我们应当做出政策和投资选择，缓解转型期所带来的痛苦，降低转型成本，并确保收入的增长部分在各团体间得到公平分配。
en: It is up to us to make the policy and investment choices that can ease the transition, reduce its costs, and ensure that the income gains are equitably shared.

zh: 迎接新自动化时代
en: Embracing the New Age of Automation

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 自十九世纪初手工纺织工人摧毁威胁自身生计的机械织机以来，关于自动化的争论总会让人联想关于未来就业的黯淡情景。
en: LONDON – Ever since early-nineteenth-century textile workers destroyed the mechanical looms that threatened their livelihoods, debates over automation have conjured gloom-and-doom scenarios about the future of work.

zh: 那么在另一个自动化时代降临之际，我们又该对自己未来的生计感到多焦虑呢？
en: With another era of automation upon us, how nervous about the future of our own livelihoods should we be?

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院最近发布的一份报告估计，根据一个国家的发展水平，自动化的进步将在2030年令全球3~14％的劳动者改变职业或提升自身技能。
en: A recent report by the McKinsey Global Institute estimates that, depending on a country’s level of development, advances in automation will require 3-14% of workers worldwide to change occupations or upgrade their skills by the year 2030.

zh: 而自1990年以来的第一波日常工作技术变革期间欧洲已经有大约10％的工作已经消失。
en: Already, about 10% of all jobs in Europe have disappeared since 1990 during the first wave of routine-based technological change.

zh: 随着影响更广泛任务的人工智能技术不断进步，这一比例可能在未来几年再翻一番。
en: And with advances in artificial intelligence (AI), which affects a broader range of tasks, that share could double in the coming years.

zh: 历史上的就业转移都是一波波出现的，首先是由农业向制造业转变，接着是从制造业向服务业转移。
en: Historically, job displacement has occurred in waves, first with the structural shift from agriculture to manufacturing, and then with the move from manufacturing to services.

zh: 但在整个过程中，生产力所获得的提升都会被再次投资以创造新的创新，就业和产业，随着更老式且生产力较低的工作被更先进的职业所取代，经济增长也得到了推动。
en: But throughout that process, productivity gains have been reinvested to create new innovations, jobs, and industries, driving economic growth as older, less productive jobs are replaced with more advanced occupations.

zh: 例如内燃机车虽然淘汰了马车夫，但却催生了从汽车经销商到汽车旅馆等一系列新行业；1980年代计算机消灭了打字员，可从呼叫中心服务代表到软件开发人员等许多新职业也应运而生。
en: The internal combustion engine, for example, wiped out horse-drawn carriages, but gave rise to many new industries, from car dealerships to motels. In the 1980s, computers killed typewriters, but created a host of new occupations, from call-center service representatives to software developers.

zh: 由于新技术所带来的深远经济和社会效益往往比失业更少受到关注，所以必须特别指出自动化技术早已展现出了改善人们生活的能力。
en: Because the far-reaching economic and social benefits of new technologies tend to receive less attention than job losses, it is worth noting that automation technologies are already demonstrating a capacity to improve lives.

zh: 去年11月斯坦福大学的研究人员就证明人工智能系统在肺部X光检测肺炎方面优于放射科专家。
en: This past November, Stanford University researchers showed that an AI system outperforms expert radiologists in detecting pneumonia from lung X-rays.

zh: 在中国，德国以及其他地方陷入生产力增长停滞且适龄劳动人口减少的时代，自动化可以提供急需的经济增长。
en: In an era of stalled productivity growth and declining working-age populations in China, Germany, and elsewhere, automation could provide a badly needed economic boost.

zh: 更高的生产率意味着更快速的经济增长，更多的消费支出，更多的劳动力需求，从而创造更多的就业机会。
en: Higher productivity implies faster economic growth, more consumer spending, increased labor demand, and thus greater job creation.

zh: 尽管如此，所有关于人工智能自动化的讨论也必须考虑到公众的焦虑情绪。
en: Nonetheless, any discussion about AI-based automation must also take public anxieties into account.

zh: 即使新的职业可能会取代那些因自动化流失的职业，工资水平也可能需要一段时间才能追赶上劳动生产率提高的现实。
en: Even though new occupations will likely replace those lost to automation, wages may take time to catch up to the reality of higher labor productivity.

zh: 在十九世纪初，工资水平停滞了将近50年之后才重新抬头。
en: In the early nineteenth century, wages stagnated for almost 50 years before picking up again.

zh: 这个状况可能有点极端，但对于低技能劳动者来说，当前的过渡期可能同样令人沮丧。
en: That may have been an extreme situation. But for lower-skilled workers, the transition underway today could prove just as wrenching.

zh: 由于人们对不平等现象日益严重的忧虑不断增加，政府得重新开始研究为失业劳动者提供收入和工作转换支持的政策。
en: With fears of increased inequality already growing, governments will need to rethink policies for providing income and job-transition support to displaced workers.

zh: 展望未来，政策制定者和企业应牢记五大要务。
en: Looking ahead, policymakers and businesses should keep five imperatives in mind.

zh: 首先是要毫不犹豫地拥抱人工智能和自动化。
en: The first is to embrace AI and automation without hesitation.

zh: 即便有办法去减缓变革的脚步，但屈服于这种（安于现状的）诱惑也会是一个错误。
en: Even if it were possible to slow the pace of change, succumbing to that temptation would be a mistake.

zh: 在全球竞争的影响之下，阻碍技术在一个领域内的扩散只会阻碍整体繁荣。
en: Owing to the effects of global competition, hampering technological diffusion in one domain would simply dampen overall prosperity.

zh: 事实上我们最近的估算就显示，如果各北欧经济体无法在人工智能推广上跟上邻国的步伐，那么其GDP年增长率可能会下降0.5个百分点。
en: In fact, we recently estimated that northern European economies could lose 0.5 percentage points of annual GDP growth if they do not keep pace with their neighbors in adopting AI.

zh: 第二个当务之急是要让员工具备正确的技能。
en: The second imperative is to equip workers with the right skills.

zh: 关于工作未来的辩论往往忽略了劳动力市场将如何演变，以及此举究竟是改善还是加剧了在发达国家本已非常严峻的技能错配问题。
en: Future-of-work debates often overlook the question of how the labor market will evolve and either improve or exacerbate the skills mismatch that is already acute in developed countries.

zh: 根据经合组织最近的研究，发达经济体中有高达1/3的劳动者未能充分发挥其技能或无法履行现有职责。
en: According to recent OECD research as much as one-third of workers in advanced economies are either underutilized or unable to handle their current duties.

zh: 未来的工作不仅需要更多的认知技能，还需要更多的创造力和社会技能 — — 比如培训辅导。
en: The jobs of the future will require not just more cognitive skills, but also more creativity and social skills, such as coaching.

zh: 据我们估计，除非劳动者的技能组合能实现升级，否则今天的不匹配状况在十年内可能会加倍，导致生产力大幅度下降以及更严重的不平等状况。
en: We estimate that, unless workers’ skill sets are upgraded, today’s mismatch could double in severity within ten years, resulting in major productivity losses and higher levels of inequality.

zh: 大规模提升技能需要父母、教育从业者、政府，雇主和雇员之间的协调，并把重点放在低技能人士身上。
en: Upgrading skills on a large scale will require coordination among parents, educators, governments, employers, and employees, with a focus on lower-skilled individuals.

zh: 不幸的是，在过去20年中，针对劳动力市场的公共开支相对于GDP的比率在美国下降了0.5个百分点，在加拿大，德国和斯堪的纳维亚半岛地区下降了超过3个百分点。
en: Unfortunately, in the past two decades, public spending on labor markets, relative to GDP, has declined by 0.5 percentage points in the United States, and by more than three percentage points in Canada, Germany, and Scandinavia.

zh: 第三个要点是关注劳动力拓展的机会。
en: The third imperative is to focus on augmented-labor opportunities.

zh: 与旧的工业机器人不同，新的技术可以与人类安全有效地进行交互，而人类有时需要对机器进行培训，并将越来越多地与算法和机器密切协作，比如诊断算法就将大大提升医生的行医水平。
en: Unlike older industrial robots, newer technologies can interact safely and efficiently with humans, who sometimes need to train them and will increasingly have to work seamlessly with algorithms and machines. For example, a doctor’s practice will be greatly enhanced by diagnostic algorithms.

zh: 政策制定者和企业都应该寻求在所有部门之间最大限度地发挥这种互补性。
en: Policymakers and businesses should seek to maximize this kind of complementarity across all sectors.

zh: 第四，人力任务被替代的速度有多块，企业就必须多快地进行创新和新市场机会开发。
en: Fourth, businesses will need to innovate and capitalize on new market opportunities at the same pace that human tasks are being replaced.

zh: 例如在第一波机器人技术浪潮中，德国，瑞典等国家采用CAD（计算机辅助设计）机器人来替代汽车行业职位，但他们同时又从亚洲回流了其他的工作，甚至创造了新的电子下游就业。
en: For example, in the first wave of robotics, countries such as Germany and Sweden displaced auto-sector jobs by adopting CAD (computer-aided design) robots; but they simultaneously brought other jobs back from Asia, and even created new downstream jobs in electronics.

zh: 同样人工智能提供了无数创新并进入全球价值链的机遇。
en: Similarly, AI offers countless opportunities for innovation and tapping into global value chains.

zh: 只有快速抓住这些机会我们才可以确保新老工作能顺利过渡。
en: By seizing these opportunities quickly, we can ensure a smoother transition from old to new jobs.

zh: 最后，我们必须将人工智能带来的生产力收益再投资于尽可能多的经济部门。
en: Finally, it is imperative that we reinvest AI-driven productivity gains in as many economic sectors as possible.

zh: 而这种再投资也正是过去那些技术变革能有利于就业的主要原因。
en: Such reinvestment is the primary reason why technological change has benefited employment in the past.

zh: 但如果没有强大的本地人工智能生态系统，今天的生产力提高可能不会再以一种促进消费和拉动对劳动力需求的方式进行再投资。
en: But without a strong local AI ecosystem, today’s productivity gains may not be reinvested in a way that fuels spending and boosts demand for labor.

zh: 对此政策制定者必须尽快确保有强劲的再投资激励措施能实施到位。
en: Policymakers urgently need to ensure that strong incentives for reinvestment are in place.

zh: 自动化已经被扣上了就业杀手的坏名声。
en: Automation has been given a bad rap as a job killer.

zh: 尽管如此，为了确保其产生的收益能超过其潜在的破坏性，私营和公共部门行为者必须发挥强有力的联合领导作用 — — 并将自动化新时代的五个必要条件放在议程的首要位置。
en: Nevertheless, to ensure that its benefits outweigh its potential disruptions, private- and public-sector actors must exercise strong joint leadership – and keep the five imperatives for the new age of automation at the top of the agenda.

zh: 自动化时代的劳动力市场
en: Labor Markets in the Age of Automation

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 人工智能和机器人技术的进步正在推动新一波的自动化浪潮，使得机器可以匹配或超越人类的任务范畴急剧扩大，包括执行一些需要复杂认知能力和高级学位才能胜任的任务。
en: BERKELEY – Advances in artificial intelligence and robotics are powering a new wave of automation, with machines matching or outperforming humans in a fast-growing range of tasks, including some that require complex cognitive capabilities and advanced degrees.

zh: 这一进程超越了专家的期望；不出意外，其对就业数量和质量产生的潜在不利影响也引发了人们的严重关切。
en: This process has outpaced the expectations of experts; not surprisingly, its possible adverse effects on both the quantity and quality of employment have raised serious concerns.

zh: 而按照特朗普当局的说法，你可能会认为贸易依然是造成美国制造业就业流失的主要原因。
en: To listen to President Donald Trump’s administration, one might think that trade remains the primary reason for the loss of manufacturing jobs in the United States.

zh: 特朗普的财政部长史蒂文·莫尼辛（Steven Mnuchin）宣称因为技术对工人的取代“甚至不在[行政部门]的视野之内。
en: Trump’s treasury secretary, Steven Mnuchin, has declared that the possible technological displacement of workers is “not even on [the administration’s] radar screen.”

zh: 然而经济学家的共识是，过去三十年来，美国制造业就业的流失约有80％是由节约劳动力及提高生产率的技术变革导致的，而贸易的影响只能远远地屈居第二。
en: Among economists, however, the consensus is that about 80% of the loss in US manufacturing jobs over the last three decades was a result of labor-saving and productivity-enhancing technological change, with trade coming a distant second.

zh: 那么问题在于，我们是否走向一个失业的未来，即科技令许多人丢掉工作，还是“大规模失业的未来 ” ， 也就是越来越多的劳动者，无论教育水平和技能如何，都无法再获得一份中产阶级收入。
en: The question, then, is whether we are headed toward a jobless future, in which technology leaves many unemployed, or a “good-jobless future,” in which a growing number of workers can no longer earn a middle-class income, regardless of their education and skills.

zh: 答案可能是两者各占一部分。
en: The answer may be some of both.

zh: 一项关于该课题的最新重大研究发现，在1990~2007年间，正是工业机器人 — — 自主运行，自动控制，可重复编程以及多用途的机器 — — 对行业的渗透削弱了就业和工资水平。
en: The most recent major study on the topic found that, from 1990 to 2007, the penetration of industrial robots – defined as autonomous, automatically controlled, reprogrammable, and multipurpose machines – undermined both employment and wages.

zh: 根据该研究的模拟测算，机器人可能令美国每年流失约40万个就业机会，其中许多是中等收入的制造业职位，尤其是在汽车，塑料化工和制药行业。
en: Based on the study’s simulations, robots probably cost about 400,000 US jobs each year, many of them middle-income manufacturing jobs, especially in industries like automobiles, plastics, and pharmaceuticals.

zh: 当然，正如智库机构经济政策研究所最近发布的一份报告所指出的那样，相对于美国劳动力市场的整体规模，这些数字并不算大。
en: Of course, as a recent Economic Policy Institute report points out, these are not large numbers, relative to the overall size of the US labor market.

zh: 但这种本地工作流失已经产生了影响：许多受影响最严重的社区都分布在投票给特朗普的中西部和南部各州 — — 主要是被他的保护主义，反贸易承诺所吸引。
en: But local job losses have had an impact: many of the most affected communities were in the Midwestern and southern states that voted for Trump, largely because of his protectionist, anti-trade promises.

zh: 随着自动化在越来越多的工种中逐渐代替人力，对就业的数量和质量的影响将会加剧。
en: As automation substitutes for labor in a growing number of occupations, the impact on the quantity and quality of jobs will intensify.

zh: 而且正如近期麦肯锡全球研究所的研究显示，类似的取代还有很大的延伸空间。
en: And, as a recent McKinsey Global Institute study shows, there is plenty more room for such substitution.

zh: 这项涵盖了46个国家和80％全球劳动力的研究发现虽然可以被完全自动化的职业不多 — — 不到5 % ， 但根据目前展现出来的技术，大约60％的职业中至少有30％的基础任务或活动将被自动化。
en: The study, which encompassed 46 countries and 80% of the global labor force, found that relatively few occupations – less than 5% – could be fully automated. But some 60% of all occupations could have at least 30% of their constitutive tasks or activities automated, based on current demonstrated technologies.

zh: 在短期内最容易受到自动化影响的活动是那些常规的认知任务，比如数据收集和处理，以及在结构化，可预测环境中的常规手工和体力活动。
en: The activities most susceptible to automation in the near term are routine cognitive tasks like data collection and data processing, as well as routine manual and physical activities in structured, predictable environments.

zh: 这些活动现在占美国工资总额的51 ％ ， 而且在雇用大量工人的行业中最为普遍，包括酒店和餐饮服务业，制造业和零售业。
en: Such activities now account for 51% of US wages, and are most prevalent in sectors that employ large numbers of workers, including hotel and food services, manufacturing, and retail trade.

zh: 麦肯锡报告还发现，工作职位的薪酬一方面与所需技能水平正相关，另一方面也与这项工作实现自动化的潜力之间存在负相关。
en: The McKinsey report also found a negative correlation between tasks’ wages and required skill levels on the one hand, and the potential for their automation on the other.

zh: 总而言之，自动化会降低那些低工资重复性工作对中低技能劳动力的需求，同时增加了对高技能，高收入劳动力的需求，因为后者可以执行需要技术和问题解决技能的抽象任务。
en: On balance, automation reduces demand for low- and middle-skill labor in lower-paying routine tasks, while increasing demand for high-skill, high-earning labor performing abstract tasks that require technical and problem-solving skills.

zh: 简而言之，技术变革是技能偏向型的。
en: Simply put, technological change is skill-biased.

zh: 在过去30年间偏向技能的技术变革推动了就业和工资两方面的两极分化，导致中层劳动者实际工资水平停滞不前，无大学文凭劳动者的实际收入大幅下降。
en: Over the last 30 years or so, skill-biased technological change has fueled the polarization of both employment and wages, with median workers facing real wage stagnation and non-college-educated workers suffering a significant decline in their real earnings.

zh: 这种极化现象促使劳动收入分配的不平等状况加剧，从而推动了总体收入不平等的恶化 — — 许多经济学家，从大卫·诺托（Thomas Autor）到托马斯·皮凯蒂（Thomas Piketty）都着重指出了这一动向。
en: Such polarization fuels rising inequality in the distribution of labor income, which in turn drives growth in overall income inequality – a dynamic that many economists, from David Autor to Thomas Piketty, have emphasized.

zh: 正如迈克尔·斯宾塞（Michael Spence）和笔者最近联合发表的一篇论文中所提到的那样，偏向技能且取代劳动力的智能机器和自动化技术正在以其他几种方式推动收入差距的扩大，其中包括为超级巨星和最幸运的一小撮人带来巨大收益的赢家通吃效应，以及网络系统中因竞争不足和先发优势而产生的租金。
en: As Michael Spence and I argue in a recent paper, skill-biased and labor-displacing intelligent machines and automation drive income inequality in several other ways, including winner-take-all effects that bring massive benefits to superstars and the luckiest few, as well as rents from imperfect competition and first-mover advantages in networked systems.

zh: 数字资本的回报往往超过实物资本并呈现出幂率分布现象（power-law distribution ） ， 使绝大部分的收益再次累积到少数参与者的腰包。
en: Returns to digital capital tend to exceed the returns to physical capital and reflect power-law distributions, with an outsize share of returns again accruing to relatively few actors.

zh: 我们认为技术变革还存在着另一个强化不平等的后果：它通过使企业能够快速，廉价地在相隔遥远的地点之间采购，监测和协调生产过程以利用较低的劳动力成本，从而对全球化产生了“涡轮增压式”的加速效应。
en: Technological change, Spence and I point out, has also had another inequality-enhancing consequence: it has “turbo-charged” globalization by enabling companies to source, monitor, and coordinate production processes at far-flung locations quickly and cheaply, in order to take advantage of lower labor costs.

zh: 有鉴于此，也就难以区分发达国家中就业，工资和收入不均的状况究竟是源自于技术还是全球化效应。
en: Given this, it is difficult to distinguish between the effects of technology and the effects of globalization on employment, wages, and income inequality in developed countries.

zh: 我们的分析结论是这两股力量其实是在相互强化，并助推资本占国民收入比率的提升 — — 这也是皮凯蒂财富不均理论的一个关键变量。
en: Our analysis concludes that the two forces reinforce each other, and have helped to fuel the rise in capital’s share of national income – a key variable in Piketty’s theory of wealth inequality.

zh: 2017年4月国际货币基金组织发布的《世界经济展望》也得出了类似结论，将导致劳动在各发达经济体国民收入中所占比率持续30年下滑的其中一半因素归于技术的影响，同时也将相近的另一半因素归于全球化。
en: The April 2017 IMF World Economic Outlook reaches a similar conclusion, attributing about 50% of the 30-year decline in labor’s share of national income in the developed economies to the impact of technology. Globalization, the IMF estimates, contributed about half that much to the decline.

zh: 人们对飞速智能化的工具对就业，工资以及收入不均的潜在影响日益感到忧虑，也因此呼吁出台某些减缓自动化步伐政策，例如对机器人征税。
en: Mounting anxiety about the potential effects of increasingly intelligent tools on employment, wages, and income inequality has led to calls for policies to slow the pace of automation, such as a tax on robots.

zh: 但这些政策又会破坏创新和生产率的增长，而生产率增长则是生活水平提高的主要推动力。
en: Such policies, however, would undermine innovation and productivity growth, the primary force behind rising living standards.

zh: 而政策制定者对应着眼于对失业者进行扶助，比如推出教育和培训项目，收入支持和社会保障网，包括工资保险，终生再培训贷款，流动型医疗和养老金等措施。
en: Rather than cage the golden goose of technological progress, policymakers should focus on measures that help those who are displaced, such as education and training programs, and income support and social safety nets, including wage insurance, lifetime retraining loans, and portable health and pension benefits.

zh: 此外将需要实施更积极的税收和转移支付政策以确保自动化的收入和财富收益能被更公平地分享。
en: More progressive tax and transfer policies will also be needed, in order to ensure that the income and wealth gains from automation are more equitably shared.

zh: 三年前，我认为智能机器所带来的好处能否被广泛分享并非取决于其自身功能设计，而是依赖于围绕它们的政策设计。
en: Three years ago, I argued that whether the benefits of smart machines are distributed broadly will depend not on their design, but on the design of the policies surrounding them.

zh: 从那以后我的观点得到了越来越多人的响应。
en: Since then, I have not been alone.

zh: 但不幸的是特朗普的团队似乎还没有收到这个消息。
en: Unfortunately, Trump’s team hasn’t gotten the message.

zh: 与机器竞赛
en: Racing the Machine

zh: 伦敦—减轻机器人焦虑已经成为商业辩护学的一个主要焦点。
en: LONDON – Dispelling anxiety about robots has become a major preoccupation of business apologetics.

zh: 常识认为，越多工作岗位被自动化，就越少的人的有工作。 这样的看法绝非愚蠢。
en: The commonsense – and far from foolish – view is that the more jobs are automated, the fewer there will be for humans to perform.

zh: 一个显著的例子是无人驾驶汽车。
en: The headline example is the driverless car.

zh: 如果汽车可以自己驾驶，司机和的士司机等职业会怎么样？
en: If cars can drive themselves, what will happen to chauffeurs, taxi drivers, and so on?

zh: 经济理论告诉我们，这是杞人忧天。
en: Economic theory tells us that our worries are groundless.

zh: 给工人配属机器能增加他们每一小时的产出。
en: Attaching machines to workers increases their output for each hour they work.

zh: 然后便是不可避免的选择：工资不变，工作减少，或工作时间不变，工资增加。
en: They then have an enviable choice: work less for the same wage as before, or work the same number of hours for more pay.

zh: 而随着现有商品价格的下降，消费者将有更多的钱用于买更多商品或不同的东西。
en: And as the cost of existing goods falls, consumers will have more money to spend on more of the same goods or different ones.

zh: 无论如何，都没有理由认为会出现人类工作岗位的净损失 — — 或发生除了生活标准改善之外的任何情况。
en: Either way, there is no reason to expect a net loss of human jobs – or anything but continual improvements in living standards.

zh: 历史经验亦然。
en: History suggests as much.

zh: 过去两百年来，生产率稳步上升，特别是在西方。
en: For the last 200 years or so, productivity has been steadily rising, especially in the West.

zh: 西方人选择了更多的闲暇和更高的收入。
en: The people who live in the West have chosen both more leisure and higher income.

zh: 1870年以来，富裕国家的工作时间减少了一半，而真实人均收入上升了五倍。
en: Hours of work in rich countries have halved since 1870, while real per capita income has risen by a factor of five.

zh: 有多少现有人类工作岗位真的因为机器人而“面临风险 ” ？
en: How many existing human jobs are actually “at risk” to robots?

zh: 据麦肯锡全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）的一份重磅报告，在当今全球经济中，大约50%的人类工作活动时间理论上都可以自动化，但照目前的趋势，到2030年最多实现30%的自动化，主要的影响因素是采用新技术的速度。
en: According to an invaluable report by the McKinsey Global Institute, about 50% of time spent on human work activities in the global economy could theoretically be automated today, though current trends suggest a maximum of 30% by 2030, depending mainly on the speed of adoption of new technology.

zh: 报告中点预测是：德国24 % ； 日本26 % ； 美国23 % ； 中国16 % ； 印度9 % ； 墨西哥13 % 。
en: The report’s midpoint predictions are: Germany, 24%; Japan, 26%; the United States, 23%; China, 16%; India, 9%; and Mexico, 13%.

zh: 到2030年，有4亿到8亿个人需要寻找新工作，其中一些工作现在还不知道在哪里。
en: By 2030, MGI estimates, 400-800 million individuals will need to find new occupations, some of which don’t yet exist.

zh: 工作岗位的流失速率和此前的时代相比并不离谱。
en: This rate of job displacement is not far out of line with previous periods.

zh: 今天的自动化之所以如此可怕，一个原因是未来在过去更为不可知：我们缺乏数据做出预警。
en: One reason why automation is so frightening today is that the future was more unknowable in the past: we lacked the data for alarmist forecasts.

zh: 更深层次的原因是当前的自动化前景预示着，对许多此前被认为专属于人类的工作岗位，未来也极有可能被机器取代。
en: The more profound reason is that current automation prospects herald a future in which machines can plausibly replace humans in many spheres of work where it was thought that only we could do the job.

zh: 经济学家一直相信，此前的工作岗位毁灭潮会形成一个劳动力市场的新供求平衡，在这个平衡上，就业和收入都会比以前更高。
en: Economists have always believed that previous waves of job destruction led to an equilibrium between supply and demand in the labor market at a higher level of both employment and earnings.

zh: 但如果机器人真的能够取代人类（replace humans ） — —而不仅仅是让人换岗（displace humans ） — —那么在人类本身变得过多之前，很难看到均衡点。
en: But if robots can actually replace, not just displace, humans, it is hard to see an equilibrium point until the human race itself becomes redundant.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所的报告认为不会出现如此悲观的情况。
en: The MGI report rejects such a gloomy conclusion.

zh: 在长期，经济能够作出调整，为所有想要的人提供满意的工作。
en: In the long run, the economy can adjust to provide satisfying work for everyone who wants it.

zh: “对于作为一个整体的社会，机器可以从事常规、危险或肮脏的工作，并有望让我们更加充分地运用人类固有才能，享受更多闲暇。 ”
en: “For society as a whole, machines can take on work that is routine, dangerous, or dirty, and may allow us to use our intrinsically human talents more fully and enjoy more leisure.”

zh: 这和商业经济学的看法一样好。
en: This is about as good as it gets in business economics.

zh: 但其论点存在一些重大缺陷。
en: Yet there are some serious gaps in the argument.

zh: 第一个问题是从人力经济到自动化经济的转型的长度和规模。
en: The first concerns the length and scope of the transition from the human to the automated economy.

zh: 对于这个问题，过去的指导作用并不像我们认为的那样可靠，因为过去的技术变迁速度较慢，这意味着工作岗位的取代能跟得上工作岗位的变换。
en: Here, the past may be a less reliable guide than we think, because the slower pace of technological change meant that job replacement kept up with job displacement.

zh: 如今，换岗 — — 即干扰 — — 要迅速得多，因为技术的发明和扩散比以前快得多。
en: Today, displacement – and thus disruption – will be much faster, because technology is being invented and diffused much faster.

zh: “在发达经济体，所有情景 ， ” 麦肯锡写道 ， “ 都表明到2030年将实现充分就业，但转型可能包括失业率高企和[趋于下降的]工资调整时期 ， ” 这取决于适应的速度。
en: “In advanced economies, all scenarios,” McKinsey writes, “result in full employment by 2030, but transition may include periods of higher unemployment and [downward] wage adjustments,” depending on the speed of adaptation.

zh: 这让决策者面临一个困境。
en: This poses a dilemma for policymakers.

zh: 新技术引入得越快，吞噬的就业岗位就越多，但它的收益憧憬实现得也越迅速。
en: The faster the new technology is introduced, the more jobs it eats up, but the quicker its promised benefits are realized.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所（MGI）的报告认为不应该限制自动化的规模和速度，否则将“削弱这些技术给商业活力和经济增长做出的贡献 ” 。
en: The MGI report rejects attempts to limit the scope and pace of automation, which would “curtail the contributions that these technologies make to business dynamism and economic growth.”

zh: 根据这一轻重缓急的顺序，主要政策响应手段便自动浮出了水面：以“马歇尔计划的规模”大量投资于教育和劳动力训练，以确保人们获得关键技能的培训，从而能够应对这一转型。
en: Given this priority, the main policy response follows automatically: massive investment, on a “Marshall Plan scale,” in education and workforce training to ensure that humans are taught the critical skills to enable them to cope with the transition.

zh: 报告还认识到需要确保“工资与生产率的提高挂钩，从而让繁荣被所有人所共享。
en: The report also recognizes the need to ensure that “wages are linked to rising productivity, so that prosperity is shared with all.”

zh: ”但这忽视了一个事实：最近的生产率增长基本上只令极少数群体受益。
en: But it ignores the fact that recent productivity gains have overwhelmingly benefited a small minority.

zh: 结果，对于如何面向所有人有效做出经济学家所许诺的工作和闲暇之间的选择的问题，很少有人关注。
en: Consequently, it pays scant attention to how the choice between work and leisure promised by economists can be made effective for all.

zh: 最后，报告全文贯穿着一个假设，即自动化不仅值得可求，并且不可逆转。
en: Finally, there is the assumption running through the report that automation is not just desirable, but irreversible.

zh: 一旦我们学会了如何（以更低的成本）更有效率地做事，便没有可能回到效率更低的做事方式。
en: Once we have learned to do something more efficiently (at lower cost), there is no possibility of going back to doing it less efficiently.

zh: 剩下的唯一的问题是人类如何最好地适应更高的效率标准。
en: The only question left is how humans can best adapt to the demands of a higher standard of efficiency.

zh: 从哲学层面看，这令人困惑，因为这结合了更有效地做事和更好地做事。
en: Philosophically, this is confused, because it conflates doing something more efficiently with doing it better.

zh: 它混合了技术问题和道德问题。
en: It mixes up a technical argument with a moral one.

zh: 对于技术的使徒许给我们世界，有可能、也有必要问一问：这是个好世界吗？
en: Of the world promised us by the apostles of technology, it is both possible and necessary to ask: Is it good?

zh: 一个我们注定要与机器竞赛生产越来越大数量的消费的世界真的是值得拥有的吗？
en: Is a world in which we are condemned to race with machines to produce ever-larger quantities of consumption goods a world worth having?

zh: 如果我们没有希望控制这个世界，生而为人还有什么价值？
en: And if we cannot hope to control this world, what is the value of being human?

zh: 这些问题，麦肯锡的报告都没有回答，但不能把它们排除在公共讨论的界限之外。
en: These questions may be outside McKinsey remit, but they should not be off limits to public discussion.

zh: 自动化、生产率和增长
en: Automation, Productivity, and Growth

zh: 柏林—如果一家企业投资于自动化，那么这家企业的劳动力 — — 尽管可能有所缩减 — — 就会更具生产力，这似乎是不言自明的。
en: BERLIN – It seems obvious that if a business invests in automation, its workforce – though possibly reduced – will be more productive.

zh: 那么，为何统计数据显示并非如此？
en: So why do the statistics tell a different story?

zh: 在发达经济体，大量行业有资金也愿意投资于自动化，但生产率增长（用每员工或每工时所产生的增加值衡量）已经至少低迷了15年。
en: In advanced economies, where plenty of sectors have both the money and the will to invest in automation, growth in productivity (measured by value added per employee or hours worked) has been low for at least 15 years.

zh: 此外，自2008年全球金融危机以来，这些国家的总体经济增长也十分疲软 — — 平均不超过4 % 。
en: And, in the years since the 2008 global financial crisis, these countries’ overall economic growth has been meager, too – just 4% or less on average.

zh: 一个解释是发达经济体背负了过多的债务，需要去杠杆，这导致了公共部门投资不足，也抑制了消费和私人投资。
en: One explanation is that the advanced economies had taken on too much debt and needed to deleverage, contributing to a pattern of public-sector underinvestment and depressing consumption and private investment as well.

zh: 但去杠杆只是暂时的过程，而不会永远制约增长。
en: But deleveraging is a temporary process, not one that limits growth indefinitely.

zh: 从长期看，总体经济增长取决于劳动力及其生产率的增长。
en: In the long term, overall economic growth depends on growth in the labor force and its productivity.

zh: 政客和经济学家所想的问题也是如此：生产率减速是一个持久性条件和增长的约束，还只是一个过渡现象？
en: Hence the question on the minds of politicians and economists alike: Is the productivity slowdown a permanent condition and constraint on growth, or is it a transitional phenomenon?

zh: 这个问题没有简单的答案 — — 因为决定这一趋势的因素范围甚广。
en: There is no easy answer – not least because of the wide range of factors contributing to the trend.

zh: 除了公共部门投资不足，还有货币政策 — — 不管货币政策成本收益如何，它促使公司用现金进行股票回购，而实际投资依然萎靡。
en: Beyond public-sector underinvestment, there is monetary policy, which, whatever its benefits and costs, has shifted corporate use of cash toward stock buy-backs, while real investment has remained subdued.

zh: 与此同时，信息技术和数字网络让许多白领和蓝领工作实现了自动化。
en: Meanwhile, information technology and digital networks have automated a range of white- and blue-collar jobs.

zh: 你也许已经预料到了这一转型 — — 对美国来说，2000年是这一转型关键的一年 — — 导致了失业（至少在经济进行了调整之前是如此 ） ， 并伴随生产率的提高。
en: One might have expected this transition, which reached its pivotal year in the United States in 2000, to cause unemployment (at least until the economy adjusted), accompanied by a rise in productivity.

zh: 但是，在2008年危机前几年，美国的数据显示生产率存在下降趋势；并且，直到危机之前，失业并未大幅上升。
en: But, in the years leading up to the 2008 crisis, US data show that productivity trended downward; and, until the crisis, unemployment did not rise significantly.

zh: 一个解释是，在危机前的几年中，就业因为信用刺激的需求而得到了支持。
en: One explanation is that employment in the years before the crisis was being propped up by credit-fueled demand.

zh: 直到信用泡沫破裂 — — 并引发了剧烈的调整而不是正常情况下的技能和人力资本逐渐调整 — — 数百万工人突然发现自己丢掉了工作。
en: Only when the credit bubble burst – triggering an abrupt adjustment, rather than the gradual adaptation of skills and human capital that would have occurred in more normal times – did millions of workers suddenly find themselves unemployed.

zh: 其影响是自动化等于生产率提高的经济逻辑并没有失效；只是证明时间延迟了。
en: The implication is that the economic logic equating automation with increased productivity has not been invalidated; its proof has merely been delayed.

zh: 但生产率之谜并不只是在2008年危机后才出现。
en: But there is more to the productivity conundrum than the 2008 crisis.

zh: 在危机前的二十年中，美国经济中生产国际可贸易商品和服务（占总产出的三分之一）的部门没有增加任何就业岗位，即使用增加值衡量，其增长比不可贸易部门更快。
en: In the two decades that preceded the crisis, the sector of the US economy that produces internationally tradable goods and services – one-third of overall output – failed to generate any increase in jobs, even though it was growing faster than the non-tradable sector in terms of value added.

zh: 可贸易部门的就业岗位损失大部分发生在制造业，特别是2000年后。
en: Most of the job losses in the tradable sector were in manufacturing industries, especially after the year 2000.

zh: 尽管一些损失是拜信息技术和数字化所带来的生产率进步所赐，但也有许多损失的原因是公司将供应链的细分部分转移到了全球经济的其他地方，特别是中国。
en: Although some of the losses may have resulted from productivity gains from information technology and digitization, many occurred when companies shifted segments of their supply chains to other parts of the global economy, particularly China.

zh: 相反，美国的不可贸易部门（占经济的三分之二）在2008年前的几年中增加了大量就业岗位。
en: By contrast, the US non-tradable sector – two-thirds of the economy – recorded large increases in employment in the years before 2008.

zh: 但是，这些就业岗位（通常是国内服务业岗位）所带来的增加值往往低于消失的制造业岗位。
en: However, these jobs – often in domestic services – usually generated lower value added than the manufacturing jobs that had disappeared.

zh: 部分原因在于可贸易部门日渐向拥有高水平技能和教育程度的员工倾斜。
en: This is partly because the tradable sector was shifting toward employees with high levels of skill and education.

zh: 从这个角度讲，可贸易部门生产率有所提高，尽管其中全球经济的结构变化的重要性不亚于员工做同样工作的效率得到提高。
en: In that sense, productivity rose in the tradable sector, although structural shifts in the global economy were surely as important as employees becoming more efficient at doing the same things.

zh: 对发达经济体来说，不幸的是可贸易部门的人均增加值提升不足以抵消劳动力从制造业岗位转向不可贸易的服务业岗位（其中许多岗位能够存在的唯一原因是2008年前的繁荣日子里信用刺激内需大幅增长）所造成的影响。
en: Unfortunately for advanced economies, the gains in per capita value added in the tradable sector were not large enough to overcome the effect of moving labor from manufacturing jobs to non-tradable service jobs (many of which existed only because of credit-fueled domestic demand in the halcyon days before 2008).

zh: 因此，总体生产率增长缓慢。
en: Hence the muted overall productivity gains.

zh: 与此同时，随着发展中国家逐渐变富，它们也会投资于技术以应对劳动力成本的提高（在中国，这一趋势已相当明显 ） 。
en: Meanwhile, as developing economies become richer, they, too, will invest in technology in order to cope with rising labor costs (a trend already evident in China).

zh: 结果，全球生产率和GDP增长的高峰也许已经到达了。
en: As a result, the high-water mark for global productivity and GDP growth may have been reached.

zh: 在战后的大部分时间里，全球供应链的组织原则一直是生产向低成本劳动力大军转移，因为劳动力曾是、现在也是流动性最差的经济因素（劳动力、资本和知识 ） 。
en: The organizing principle of global supply chains for most of the post-war period has been to move production toward low-cost pools of labor, because labor was and is the least mobile of economic factors (labor, capital, and knowledge).

zh: 不容易自动化的高增加值服务业仍然如此。
en: That will remain true for high-value-added services that defy automation.

zh: 但对于资本密集型数字技术，这一组织原则将发生改变：生产将向最终市场转移，而最终市场将越来越多地不仅出现在发达国家，也出现在中产阶级不断扩大的新兴经济体。
en: But for capital-intensive digital technologies, the organizing principle will change: production will move toward final markets, which will increasingly be found not just in advanced countries, but also in emerging economies as their middle classes expand.

zh: 马丁·贝利（Martin Baily）和詹姆斯·曼尼卡（James Manyika）最近指出，我们早已经领教过了这一点。
en: Martin Baily and James Manyika recently pointed out that we have seen this movie before.

zh: 20世纪80年代，罗伯特·索洛（Robert Solow）和史蒂芬·罗奇（Stephen Roach）各自指出，IT投资没有表现出对生产率有什么影响。
en: In the 1980’s, Robert Solow and Stephen Roach separately argued that IT investment was showing no impact on productivity.

zh: 接着，互联网大行其道，企业重新组织了自身和供应链，而生产率也随之加速。
en: Then the Internet became generally available, businesses reorganized themselves and their global supply chains, and productivity accelerated.

zh: 20世纪90年代末的互联网泡沫错在算错了数字革命的时间而不是程度。
en: The dot-com bubble of the late 1990s was a misestimate of the timing, not the magnitude, of the digital revolution.

zh: 类似地，曼尼卡和贝利指出，人们热议的“物联网”也许需要再过多年才能体现在给总生产率数据中。
en: Likewise, Manyika and Baily argue that the much-discussed “Internet of Things” is probably some years away from showing up in aggregate productivity data.

zh: 组织、企业和人都必须适应技术推动的经济结构变化。
en: Organizations, businesses, and people all have to adapt to the technologically driven shifts in our economies’ structure.

zh: 这些过渡将会很长，一些人将会得利，而另一些人被迫进行艰难的调整，它们的生产率效应需要相当时间才会体现在总数据中。
en: These transitions will be lengthy, rewarding some and forcing difficult adjustments on others, and their productivity effects will not appear in aggregate data for some time.

zh: 但最先行动的人可能获得最大的好处。
en: But those who move first are likely to benefit the most.

zh: 不落下任何人
en: No Worker Left Behind

zh: 伯克利 — — 几乎每周都会传出新的反面乌托邦寓言，预测会爆发由技术导致的大规模失业现象。
en: BERKELEY – A week rarely goes by without a new dystopian prediction about technologically driven mass unemployment.

zh: 随着人工智能（AI）和机器人技术进步之快甚至超过了本行业研发人员的想象，研究发现原本雇用人员的许多任务和职业已经可以实现自动化目标。
en: As artificial intelligence (AI) and robotic technologies advance faster than even their own developers expected, studies are finding that many of the tasks and occupations that employ people can already be automated.

zh: 对自动化就业份额的估算差别很大，从经合组织国家所有岗位的14%到美国所有岗位近50%的份额。
en: Estimates of the share of automatable employment vary widely, from 14% of all jobs in OECD countries to nearly 50% of all jobs in the US.

zh: 据麦肯锡全球研究院数据显示，发达经济体中9~32%的劳动者可能在未来十年面临失业。
en: According to the McKinsey Global Institute, 9-32% of the workforce in developed economies could be displaced within the next decade.

zh: 在所有国家，需要接受较少正规教育的低技能岗位最易受到自动化的影响，而需要接受专业培训和/或高等教育的职位受到的威胁则相对较小，至少目前的情况仍然是这样。
en: Across all countries, low-skilled occupations that require less formal education will be the most susceptible to automation, whereas jobs requiring professional training and/or tertiary education will be less threatened, at least for now.

zh: 无论如何，我们都迫切需要用新技术来武装员工，以适应未来劳动力市场的需要。
en: Either way, we urgently need to start furnishing workers with new skills to meet future labor-market demands.

zh: 为此，美国企业、教育机构、非政府组织以及各州和地方政府已经开始重新思考教育和培训政策。
en: To that end, US businesses, educational institutions, nongovernmental organizations, and state and local governments have begun to rethink education and training policies.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下的联邦政府正在推卸这一领域的责任，这使得他们的工作显得更加紧迫。
en: Their work is made more urgent by the fact that the federal government under President Donald Trump is shirking its responsibilities in this area.

zh: 迎接技术挑战需要对劳动力学习和培训进行史诗级别的改造。
en: Meeting the skills challenge will require an epic reinvention of workforce learning and training.

zh: 所采取的对策必须与一个世纪前完成普及中等教育、以及开始于20世纪60年代的大学教育普及运动具有同等的规模。
en: The response must be on par with the establishment of universal secondary education a century ago, or with the “college for all” movement that began in the 1960s.

zh: 但这次速度一定要大幅加快，而且必须由公私合作机构出面牵头。
en: But it must be much faster, and it will have to be spearheaded by public-private partnerships.

zh: 美国被迫面对大规模劳动力市场动荡已经不是第一次了。
en: This is not the first time the US has had to adapt to vast labor-market disruptions.

zh: 150多年前，1862年的莫里尔法案宣布成立“政府赠地大学 ” ， 并授权这些大学在与工业革命相关的农业、科技、工程和其他领域对美国人开展教育工作。
en: More than 150 years ago, the Morrill Act of 1862 established and endowed “land-grant universities” to educate Americans in agriculture, science, engineering, and other fields relevant to the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 内战结束后，莫里尔法案逐渐拓展到前邦联各州。
en: After the Civil War, the Morrill Act was extended to the former confederate states.

zh: 由此建立的系统逐渐演变为世界上最大的后中等教育体系，其中包括一百多所综合性大学和专科院校。
en: The system it created would evolve into the world’s largest post-secondary education system, encompassing more than 100 colleges and universities.

zh: 经济学家预测技术变革所创造的岗位最终将可以媲美所摧毁的岗位。
en: Economists predict that technological change will eventually create as many jobs as it destroys. But there will be significant hurdles along the way.

zh: 但就目前而言，太多的美国工人没有能力在未来找到好的工作。
en: As things stand, too many US workers lack the skills needed for the good jobs of the future.

zh: 尽管约1/3的美国成年人拥有四年制大学本科学位 — — 这一比例在有史以来已经高居榜首 — — 但同样比例的美国人学位仅仅停留在高中。
en: Though around one-third of US adults have a four-year college degree – the highest proportion on record – an equal share has no more than a high-school diploma.

zh: 对所有教育水平的员工来说，学习更多技术跟上由技术驱动的职业变化不需要那么多“坐在传统课堂”里的学习时间，而是需要员工培训形式更加灵活。
en: For workers at all educational levels, acquiring additional skills to stay abreast of technologically driven occupational changes will require less “seat-time” in traditional classrooms, and more dynamic forms of workforce training.

zh: 上述培训的一个典型范例是Skillful，这是一家由马克尔基金会、微软、LinkedIn和科罗拉多州共同支持的非营利性创业企业。
en: A good example of such training is offered by Skillful, a nonprofit venture supported by the Markle Foundation, Microsoft, LinkedIn, and the state of Colorado.

zh: Skillful正在科罗拉多州开展一个试点项目，即协助没有大学学历的员工升级和营销他们的技能。
en: Skillful is running a pilot project in Colorado to help workers without a college degree upgrade and market their skills.

zh: 项目的宗旨是同时关注求职者和雇主，而项目与学位相比更看重技术。
en: The idea is to focus both on job seekers and employers, and on skills rather than degrees.

zh: 对Skillful首席执行官贝思·科伯特而言，目的是要让雇主开始既接受木工或网页设计等“硬”技术，又能欣赏沟通能力或领导力等“软”技术，即使上述技术并非通过正式场合获得，同时对员工未来的发展潜力表示认可。
en: For Skillful CEO Beth Cobert, the goal is to get employers to start appreciating “hard” skills, such as carpentry or web design, and “soft” skills in communication or leadership, even if such skills weren’t acquired in a formal setting, and to recognize workers’ potential for future development.

zh: 员工可以通过新型培训获得这些技术，如有针对性的认证计划、技术“训练营 ” 、 学徒制和在职课程。
en: Workers can acquire many of these skills through new forms of training such as targeted certification programs, technology “boot camps,” apprenticeships, and on-the-job classes.

zh: Skillful提出的方案以真正的技术导向劳动力市场需要参与者多方合作的现实为基础。
en: Skillful’s approach is premised on the fact that a true skills-based labor market requires collaboration among many players.

zh: 雇主与行业组织需要密切与教育机构的联系，以确保市场上提供的技术能满足当前和未来的需求。
en: Employers and industry groups need to be in closer contact with educational institutions so that the skills being supplied meet current and future demand.

zh: 而各州及地方政府应当采取更多措施来聚焦各自辖区内的竞争优势和新兴机遇。
en: And state and local governments should do more to shine a spotlight on their jurisdictions’ competitive strengths and emerging opportunities.

zh: “我们正试图将所有参与者融入劳动力市场 ， ” 科伯特谈到，而且他们之间“往往不会彼此交流 ” 。
en: “We’re trying to integrate all these participants in the labor market,” says Cobert, and they “typically aren’t talking that much with each other.”

zh: 经合组织统计显示，没有大学学历的员工不太可能参与任何形式的劳动力培训项目。
en: According to the OECD, workers without a college degree are less likely to participate in any type of workforce training.

zh: 这就解释了为什么Skillful正在利用行业和地理数据来协助劳动者发掘本身已经具备的符合市场需要的技能、锁定他们可能想从事的职业，以及可以追求进一步职业发展或新职位的场合。
en: That is why Skillful is leveraging industry and geographical data to help workers discover marketable skills they already have, careers they might want, and places where they can pursue further professional development or new employment.

zh: 确保这些信息能够轻松在线获取对鼓励那些职务风险最大的员工充分利用所面临的培训选项会起到至关重要的作用。
en: Making such information easily available online is crucial to encourage workers whose jobs are most at risk to explore their training options.

zh: 此外，Skillful和科罗拉多州州长约翰·希肯鲁柏已经启动了一项培训职业训导员的深入计划，而后再由他们协助个体员工确定其理想职位所需的培训和技术。
en: Moreover, Skillful and Colorado Governor John Hickenlooper have launched an intensive program to train career coaches, who will then help individual workers identify the skills and training they need for the jobs they want.

zh: 共和及民主两党20位州长已经创建了Skillful州际网络，合作开展劳动力发展方面的创新工作。
en: And 20 state governors, both Republicans and Democrats, have created a Skillful State Network to collaborate on innovations in workforce development.

zh: 现阶段不存在策略对错，看到各州就不同计划展开实验并分享经验非常令人鼓舞。
en: At this point, there are no right or wrong strategies, and it is heartening to see that many states are experimenting with different initiatives and sharing lessons learned.

zh: 这表明渐进式联邦制即使在“红色 ” （ 共和党）主导的州也能做到行之有效。
en: They are showing that progressive federalism can work even in “red” (Republican) states.

zh: 举例而言，北卡罗来纳州已经出台了支持低技术成人和失学青年培训工作的衔接计划。
en: For example, North Carolina has created a pathway program to support training for low-skill adults and out-of-school youth.

zh: 在俄亥俄，高中毕业生可以获得涵盖15个技术领域的严格的“职业资格”认证。
en: In Ohio, high-school graduates can obtain a rigorous “Professional Readiness” certification covering 15 skill areas.

zh: 蒙大拿州近期推出了制造业学徒计划。
en: Montana recently introduced a manufacturing apprenticeship program.

zh: 而印第安纳州的下一级计划为雇主培训“中等职业”技能（高于高中学历但同时低于两年专科学历）的员工提供拨款资助。
en: And Indiana’s “NextLevel” initiative provides grants to employers to train workers in “middle-skill” occupations (those requiring more than a high-school diploma but less than a two-year associate degree).

zh: 20年前，美国西部19个州的州长创办了西部州长大学，实现了符合需求的职业能力的在线传授。
en: Twenty years ago, the governors of 19 states in the American West created Western Governors University to teach in-demand competencies online.

zh: 今天该计划拥有近10万名注册学员，而加利福尼亚州政府还在提议建立一所在线社区大学，为陷入困境的员工服务。
en: Today, nearly 100,000 students are enrolled, and California’s government is also proposing an online community college to serve “stranded workers.”

zh: 鉴于数百万员工将受此影响，我们实施这样的计划其实是别无选择。
en: Given the high stakes for millions of workers, there is no alternative to such initiatives.

zh: 决策者应当遵从那些已经加强教育和成人学习计划者的引导，避免任何员工被自动化大潮所抛弃。
en: Policymakers should follow the lead of those who are already strengthening education and adult-learning programs so that no workers are left behind by the driving force of automation.

zh: 《阿凡达》与美利坚帝国
en: Avatar and Empire

zh: 发自纽约 — — 国家是否也如同个人一样，拥有心理过程呢？ — 甚至是像弗洛伊德所描述的那种过程，诸如会受伤的集体意识，以及被压抑的、隐藏于集体无意识之中的负罪感？
en: NEW YORK – Do nations have psychological processes – even Freudian processes, such as collective egos that can be injured, and repressed guilt feelings that can well up from the collective unconscious – just as individuals do?

zh: 我认为是有的。
en: I believe that they do.

zh: 而 我也相信，正如个人的梦境和说错话反映了他 / 她的潜意识一样，一种文化的“梦境 ” — — 电影，流行音乐，视觉艺术，甚至包括共同的笑话，卡通以及广告形象 — — 也会反映出某个集体的潜意识。
en: I also believe that just as an individual’s dreams and slips of the tongue reveal his or her repressed knowledge, so a culture’s “dreamwork” – its films, pop music, visual arts, and even in the resonant jokes, cartoons and advertising images – reveal the signs of this collective unconscious.

zh: 而一个国家的“非理性的梦境”通常比其“自我 ” — — 比如官方声明，外交宣言和各种宣传 — — 更能反映其现实情况。
en: Moreover, a nation’s “irrational dreamwork” often reflects its actual condition more truthfully than its “ego” – its official pronouncements, diplomatic statements, and propaganda.

zh: 因此，请带着这种理论来欣赏詹姆斯·卡梅隆所拍摄的电影《阿凡达 》 ， 并留意其中反映的两个主题：一是在“反恐战争”和后企业帝国主义语境下，美国集体潜意识的粗鄙，罪恶的样板，二是在世界其他国家眼中美国所扮演的批判性形象 — — 这在好莱坞大片中还是头一次出现。
en: So take this theory with you when you see James Cameron’s Avatar , and watch for two revealing themes: the raw, guilty template of the American unconscious in the context of the “war on terror” and late-stage corporate imperialism, and a critical portrayal of America – for the first time ever in a Hollywood blockbuster – from the point of view of the rest of the world.

zh: 当然，在好莱坞电影的传统中，那些被迫与土著作战的美国英雄通常都是些纯洁无瑕，道德高尚的人，为未开化的野蛮人带来民主，或至少是正义。
en: In the Hollywood tradition, of course, the American hero fighting an indigenous enemy is innocent and moral, a reluctant warrior bringing democracy, or at least justice, to feral savages.

zh: 但在《阿凡达》片中处处闪烁的核心主题却与美国人基于本国外交政策的自我认知背道而驰。
en: In Avatar , the core themes highlight everything that has gone wrong with Americans’ view of themselves in relation to their country’s foreign policy.

zh: 剧中的英雄，杰克·苏利在此前一次为美国执行的战斗中残废了，但他的国家却并未因此给予其应有的照顾；而如果他能够很好地完成交给他的种族大屠杀任务的话，那么“公司”就会好好奖励他一番，给予他所需的治疗。
en: The hero, Jake Sully, is crippled from combat in a previous American conflict, but is not well cared for by his own country; if he does his job of genocide properly, “the corporation” will reward him with proper medical treatment.

zh: 基本上，此人是以一位公司合同承包者的身份签约的 — — 这不禁使人联想起黑水公司在巴格达的尼苏尔广场对当地平民进行的大屠杀。
en: He signs on, essentially, as a corporate contractor – shades of Blackwater’s massacre of civilians in Baghdad’s Nisour Square.

zh: 这间“公司”本身就是一个“任务 ” ， 而受雇于这间公司的士兵不是为了“自由”而战，而是为了“收入”而战。
en: The enterprise is a “mission” in which the soldiers fight not “for freedom” but “for a paycheck.”

zh: 他们遵从公司官僚对当地居民发动攻击的指示，而动机则是因为要不惜一切代价夺取蕴藏在当地居民的神圣土地下面 的珍稀矿物元素“ unobtainium ” 。
en: They take their direction from corporate bureaucrats in waging war against the indigenous people, whose sacred land is sited on vast reserves of “unobtainium,” which the corporation wishes to secure at all costs.

zh: 电影里，这些士兵被描述为是受他们的领导人 — — 这些人运用恶毒的种族主义和宗教嘲讽 — — 所指挥而对当地毫无侵略性的“敌人”展开无情的攻击。
en: The soldiers are portrayed as being manipulated by their leaders – through vicious racism and religious derision – into brutal action against the non-aggressive “hostiles.”

zh: 当剧中作为反派的美国攻击部队领导人计划炸平当地人的森林时，他傲慢地说打算在这些人的“种族记忆”中炸出一个巨大的裂口，让这些人再也不敢靠近该地一千步的范围之内。
en: When the villain, the American military leader of the attack, plans to bomb flat the indigenous people’s sacred tree, he boasts that he will blow such a massive hole in their “racial memory” that they won’t come “within a thousand clicks” of the place again.

zh: 甚至美国军队在该片的战争场面中所使用的武器也没有被描述为史诗般的壮观。
en: Even the machinery of US military combat is portrayed non-heroically.

zh: 与美国骑兵勇敢地扫平野蛮的敌人，或整齐的美国步兵英勇地扫荡了法西斯老巢的传统形象不同，无聊的技术官僚，由庞大的防护层保护着，一边喝着咖啡，随意触按着显示屏，一边轰炸着绿色山谷，屠杀着敌人的战士和毫无防卫能力的妇女和小孩。
en: Instead of the classic images of the US Cavalry courageously sweeping down on the savages, or of decent American doughboys bravely clearing out nests of Nazis, bored technocrats, insulated by immense layers of technology, firebomb green valleys, slaughtering enemy warriors and defenseless women and babies while sipping coffee and casually fiddling with touch screens.

zh: 而主角的台词（当中所有的引用都是恰如其分的）也仍是那些不会揭穿美国在关于伊拉克和阿富汗问题上的利己主义外表的套话。
en: The characters’ lines (all quotes are approximate) are those that never pierce the bubble of American self-regard with respect to Iraq and Afghanistan.

zh: 剧中的土著女英雄，最终成为主角恋人的内特丽说“你本不该来！ ” ， 仿佛她在说这话时所面对的是所有的美国海外企业。
en: “You should not be here!” exclaims the indigenous heroine, and eventual love interest, Neytiri, as if she is speaking of the entire US enterprise overseas.

zh: “你就像个婴儿一样 ， ” 在指着由那位破坏巨大，但却自我感觉良好的英雄在“转向土著一方之前”所造成的严重伤害时，她说 ： “ 这都是你的错。
en: “You are like a baby.” Gesturing at the mayhem caused by the destructive but self-regarding hero, before he “goes native,” she says, “This is your fault.

zh: 他们本不该死。 ”
en: They should never have had to die.”

zh: 后来，随着苏利变得同情那些他本要背叛的人，他告诉公司的官僚说 ： “ 只是因为他们居住在你想要的东西上，你就要把他们当成敌人。
en: Later, as Sully starts to become sympathetic towards those whom he has been sent to betray, he tells the bureaucrats: “If people are sitting on something you want, you call them the enemy.”

zh: ”当他完全明白了那些官僚的动机后，他转而加入了一场堪称是反抗进攻的行动中，那甚至可以称之为圣战。 （ “ 让那些天空中的〔美国〕人看看这是谁的土地！
en: When he has fully identified himself with their cause, he joins a movement that is essentially a counterinsurgency, even a jihad (“Let’s show the Sky People [the US] whose land this is!”).

zh: ” ） 。 他和他的美国小队被当成了“叛国者”并被关进了 关塔那摩式的小隔间里。
en: He and his small band of Americans are even locked in a small Guantánamo-style cell and called “traitors.”

zh: 剧中那些土著居民是最近美国深受困扰的集体意识对帝国所进行的所有伟大战争��反响的综合体。
en: The indigenous people are an amalgam of echoes from all the great wars of empire that have troubled the recent American conscience.

zh: 尽管在形体上，他们是一种蓝色皮肤和猫科动物动作的科幻混合，但在文化上，他们却是美国本土人和越南人的综合，再加上一点阿拉伯口音。
en: Although they are physically a fantasy sci-fi mix of blue skin and cat-like movement, they are culturally a mix of Native Americans and Vietnamese, with Arabic accents thrown in.

zh: 那些人拥有一些美国人要好好学习的特质。
en: They have qualities that Americans would do well to emulate.

zh: 他们尊重他们的生活环境，而美国人则必须“为一个濒死的星球承担起应有的责任 ” ， 因为，正如剧中的土著人所说 ， “ 他们亲手杀死了他们的母亲。 ”
en: They respect their environment, whereas the Americans must “return to a dying planet,” because, as the indigenous people put it, “they have killed their own mother.”

zh: 苏利的历程不是一次侵略的过程，而是对他以及他的同胞们与其他国家人民的关系的一次唤醒。 一开始，他笑着说“我是谁，是坏人吗？
en: Sully’s journey is not one of conquest but of awakening to his and his people’s true relationship to others: “What am I, the bad guy?” he laughs at first, as if that were impossible.

zh: ” ， 仿佛在说着个天大的笑话。 但到了最后，他努力警告他所带领的帝国军队，他们所使用的暴行最终只会是徒劳的，他说 ： “ 我们究竟要给他们些什么？
en: In the end, however, he tries to warn his own imperialist team of the futility of their brutal approach: “What do we have to offer them?

zh: 啤酒？
en: Light beer?

zh: 牛仔裤？
en: Blue Jeans?

zh: 他们永远不会离开他们树上的家〔他们神圣的土地 〕 。
en: They will never leave the Hometree [their sacred land].

zh: 我们没有他们想要的东西。 ”
en: We have nothing that they want.”

zh: 讽刺的是，电影《阿凡达》将比任何的社论，大学课程，甚至来自美国国外的抗议更能让美国认识到，在面对其在世界其他地区里压迫性存在的形象时，它所使用的国家神话是如此的肤浅。
en: Ironically, Avatar will probably do more to exhume Americans’ suppressed knowledge about the shallowness of their national mythology in the face of their oppressive presence in the rest of the world than any amount of editorializing, college courses, or even protest from outside America’s borders.

zh: 不过，我并不打算对此进行埋怨。
en: But I am not complaining about this.

zh: 毕竟，好莱坞是多么的强大啊。
en: Hollywood is that powerful.

zh: 只是，在电影《阿凡达》这件事中，美国电影制作的力量首度指向了美国的自我认知，而不是逃避现实。
en: But, in the case of Avatar , the power of American filmmaking has for once been directed toward American self-knowledge rather than American escapism.

zh: 一场事关气候的“天鹅绒革命 ” ？
en: A Velvet Climate Revolution?

zh: 发自布达佩斯 — — 从哥本哈根当下的讨论中可以得知，我们这个地球的气候问题已经到了最危险的时候。
