en: BUDAPEST – In the discussions now underway in Copenhagen, the fate of Earth’s climate is at stake.

zh: 而虽然许多参与者都意识到了问题的严重性，但他们的所作所为却似乎预示着一切照旧就行了。
en: Although many of the participants recognize the urgency, the actions of many of them suggest that a business-as-usual approach will suffice.

zh: 然而这种方法是行不通的。
en: But it will not.

zh: 这个世界需要与自己的过去来一场果断的决裂，而且这种决裂必须立刻启动。
en: The world needs a decisive break with the past, and that break needs to start now.

zh: 幸运的是，我们已经有了一些彻底颠覆国家经济和政治图景的先例 — — 比如在和平的气氛和民众的激情支持下，20年前中东欧共产主义体制的崩溃以及新的民主政治和市场经济的建立，就堪称一个与过去决裂的，有正面效果的决定性事件。
en: Fortunately, we have recent precedents for changes that fundamentally alter the economic and political landscape – i.e., of revolutionary change undertaken peacefully and with enthusiastic popular support. The collapse of communism in Central and Eastern Europe 20 years ago, and the establishment of new democratic polities with market economies, was precisely such a decisive and positive rupture with the past.

zh: 这种政权更替不仅要求人们改变自己的生活方式，同时也要对其思维方式加以革新。
en: Those regime changes required people to change not only their way of life, but also their habits of mind.

zh: 而目前全世界所需要的生态革命 — — 向低碳经济和低碳生活方式的转变 — — 也需要这么一种综合性的变革。
en: The ecological revolution that the world demands today – a transition to a low-carbon global economy and a low-carbon way of daily life – will require a similarly comprehensive change.

zh: 很明显，这样来对两者进行比较有其局限性。
en: Obviously, such a comparison has its limits.

zh: 而当人们手中缺乏现成的模式来运作一个有效率的低碳经济时，共产主义阵营的政权更替就恰恰提供了这么一个人所共知的模式（至少在我们看来是这样的 ） 。
en: The regime change that took place in the communist world introduced a well-known model (or so we thought), whereas there is no existing model at hand for a low-carbon and yet efficient economy.

zh: 在20年前的中东欧地区，一场全面的变革要求人们抛弃，更换或者重新建立所有的政治和经济体制；这意味着把全部整个社会的“硬件”换一遍。
en: In Central and Eastern Europe 20 years ago, comprehensive change demanded that all political and economic institutions be discarded, altered, or built anew; a complete change in society’s “hardware” was required.

zh: 但生态革命并不需要创立那么多的新体制，反而更需要一种新的思维方式 — — 新版本的“软件 ” （ 当然有效的绿色科技“硬件”也是必须的）
en: But the ecological revolution has less need for new institutions. Rather, what is needed most is a new way of thinking – new “software” (though effective “hard” green technologies also are essential).

zh: 正如我们在共产主义后期的世界所看到的那样，心态的变革通常是最困难的。
en: As we saw in the postcommunist world, changing attitudes is often the hardest problem of all.

zh: 人们迅速接受了民主制度的形式，但忍让和妥协这些民主进程的核心价值则需要时间去培养，而我们今天最需要的正是这种发自内心深处的革命。
en: People quickly embraced formal democracy, but the tolerance and compromise that is at the heart of the democratic process took time to take root. And it is this very change in mindset that we most need today.

zh: 然而1989年东欧剧变和未来的绿色革命之间除了某些显而易见的差异之外，还存在着令人惊讶的相似之处。
en: Yet, apart from the clear differences between the revolution of 1989 and the green revolution that is to come, there are striking similarities.

zh: 首先，需要有一个彻底取代性旧体制的，高度复杂的系统来保护世界气候，正如20年前在后共产主义国家中所需要的那种颠覆性的变革。
en: First, a thoroughgoing alteration of highly complex systems will be needed to preserve the world’s climate, just as such root-and-branch changes were needed 20 years ago in the postcommunist countries.

zh: 其次，必须用一种平和的态度来处理今日的危机，这也是我们在1989年时的目标 — — 这在异见人士希望通过谈判协商来寻求政权更替的惊天构想中可见一斑。
en: Second, the crisis of today must be managed in a peaceful manner, which was also our goal in 1989 – reflected in dissidents’ startling idea of regime change through negotiation.

zh: 最后，今天的综合性变革将可能在很短时间内发生，这跟1989年的经验如出一辙。
en: Finally, today, too, comprehensive transformation is supposed to occur in a very short time, which 1989 taught us is eminently possible.

zh: 当年我们所使用的变革方式 — — 我现在也推荐使用的 — — 摒弃了暴力并将社会付出的成本最小化。
en: The method of change that we followed then – and which I recommend now – precludes violence and minimizes costs.

zh: 而实现这一点的工具则依然是达成协议，而且这个协议要抢在设立基本变革目标和指引利益攸关的各方的路线图之前拿出来。
en: The tool for achieving it was – and remains – agreement in advance on the fundamental goals of change and on a roadmap to guide the interested parties.

zh: 其中不可或缺的一点就就是必须从一开始就做出实施根本性变革的决定（当然也需要与各方密切联系沟通！ ） 。
en: The essence is that the decision to carry out fundamental change must be made (and clearly communicated to everyone involved!) at the outset.

zh: 所谓“维新”或者在没有决定性变化的情况下改良旧体制的想法都必须在整个进程开始之前就彻底排除。
en: The idea of “reforming” or adapting the old system without decisive change must be rejected before the process begins.

zh: 匈牙利和波兰两国的执政共产党和反对党都在和平演变之前通过一系列协商达成了协议。
en: Hungary and Poland reached agreement on the rules for peaceful transformation through a series of negotiations between the ruling communist parties and the opposition organizations.

zh: 这在气候会议上也能找到相似之处，发达国家，发展中国家和贫穷国家都在同一张桌子前坐下来，尝试为一个共同的目标 — — 某项削减二氧化碳排放的合理模式 — — 达成协议。
en: This bears a similarity to climate conferences where countries – developed, emerging, or poor – sit down at the same table and try to reach agreement on a common goal: a fair model for reducing CO2 emissions.

zh: 当年中东欧的人民需要的仅仅是民主和繁荣 — — 但国家的精英们必须说服民众接受许多无法预料的伴生性事件，而做到这点是相当不容易的。
en: The people of Central and Eastern Europe simply wanted democracy and prosperity – but the elite had to be able to convince them to accept many unforeseen concurrent events, which was by no means easy.

zh: 在可持续发展，缩减能源消耗以及确保平等方面的类似行动也需要有所有利益相关者的参与，并得到他们的认可。
en: Similar acts of compromise on sustainability, measures to limit consumption, and to ensure equality will require the involvement of all stakeholders in order to gain their acceptance.

zh: 而这对于那些有志于领导并左右这些变革的人来说意味着巨大的责任。
en: This underlines the huge responsibility of those charged with guiding and managing these changes.

zh: 即使整场转变不可能在事先就完全计划好，但在一开始就坚持某些关键点是必须的。
en: Even though the transformation cannot be fully planned in advance, insisting on certain key points at the start is a basic requirement.

zh: 1989年演变的其中一个基本要求就是尽可能少地缩小体制以保证法治的建立：自由选举，公民自由以及独立的司法体系。
en: One such requirement during the changes in 1989 concerned the creation of minimum institutions to guarantee the rule of law: free elections, civil liberty, and an independent judiciary.

zh: 而推动生态变革的各个因素 — — 比如气候，生物多样性，不公平性 — — 都不能被孤立地看待。
en: The factors forcing ecological regime change – climate, biodiversity, injustice – cannot be managed in isolation from one another.

zh: 尽管如此，一个关键的组成部分必须得到优先处理：那就是减少气候变化所造成的影响，并适应它。
en: Nevertheless, a key component must have priority: reducing the effects of and adjusting to climate change.

zh: 贸易战能被逆转吗？
en: Can a Trade War be Averted?

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 近期各国经济学家最常被问到的问题可能是 ： “ 贸易战是否已经开打了？
en: BERKELEY – Probably the question most frequently asked of international economists these days is: “Are we seeing the start of a trade war?”

zh: ”这可不是一个简单用“是”或“否”就能回答的问题。
en: This is not a question that admits of a simple yes-or-no answer.

zh: 与打仗不同，各国政府都并未发表任何声明来宣示敌对行动的正式爆发。
en: In contrast to a shooting war, there’s no government declaration to mark the official outbreak of hostilities.

zh: 而关税这东西其实有史以来都不断基于各种原由 — — 不管是好是坏 — — 而起起落落的。
en: Tariffs have been raised and lowered throughout history, for reasons both good and bad.

zh: 而即便是基于某些坏的理由，加关税并不一定会引起别国的报复。
en: Even when the reasons are bad, moreover, tariff increases do not always provoke foreign retaliation.

zh: 例如理查德·尼克松总统就曾在1971年宣布全面征收10％进口附加费，虽说此举违反了关税和贸易总协定（世界贸易组织的前身）和美国法律，但却并未遭致报复。
en: There was no retaliation, for example, when President Richard Nixon imposed a 10% across-the-board import surcharge in 1971, arguably in violation of both the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (the forerunner to the World Trade Organization) and United States law.

zh: 但事件总会有失控的时候。
en: But there’s always the danger of events spiraling out of control.

zh: 中国已经明确表示会回应美国的行为，从而提升了特朗普这位反复无常的美国领导人将事件升级的风险。
en: China has clearly indicated its intention of responding to US actions, raising the risk of escalation by an erratic US leader.

zh: 由于中国对其早先行动的反应，特朗普在4月5日威胁要对另外价值1000亿美元的中国出口商品加征额外关税，这表明这一威胁正在升级。
en: President Donald Trump’s threat on April 5 to impose tariffs on an additional $100 billion of Chinese exports, provoked by China’s response to his own earlier action, points to just this threat of escalation.

zh: 但即便如此，我们仍然有理由寄望理智会占上风。
en: That said, there are still reasons to hope that sanity will prevail.

zh: 首先，特朗普被迫改变了他之前的一些行动。
en: First, Trump has been forced to nuance some of his earlier actions.

zh: 他免除了阿根廷、澳大利亚、巴西、加拿大、欧盟，墨西哥和韩国的钢铁和铝关税，尽可能减少了对这些国家以及利用这类金属的本国行业的影响。
en: He exempted Argentina, Australia, Brazil, Canada, the European Union, Mexico, and South Korea from his steel and aluminum tariffs, minimizing the impact on those countries and also on domestic metal-using industries.

zh: 外国政府和国内企业都对最初的全面关税提出了反对，股票市场也是如此，通过这种负面反馈，市场将在一定程度上对总统施加适度的影响。
en: Foreign governments and domestic businesses objected to the initial across-the-board tariff, and so did the stock market, through its negative reaction. The market will exercise a moderating influence on the president, if anything can.

zh: 其次，中国迄今为止的反应都经过仔细拿捏，每次应对都基本跟美国行动的广度相对应。
en: Second, China’s response so far has been carefully calibrated, in each case almost exactly matching the breadth of US action.

zh: 面对美国的挑衅，做少了就会被认为是示弱，而多了则会被视作危险的升级。
en: Doing less would have been seen as lying down in the face of US provocation. Doing more would have been seen as a dangerous escalation.

zh: 有人说中国领导人别无选择，只能保持克制。
en: Some say that China’s leaders have no choice but to exercise restraint.

zh: 因为它对美国存在顺差，一旦双边贸易停滞中国就会出问题。
en: Because it runs a surplus with the US, China stands to lose if bilateral trade grinds to a halt.

zh: 但这就好比是说在相互削减核武器时一个国家必定会比另一个国家损失更多。
en: But that’s like saying that one country stands to lose more than another in an exchange of nuclear weapons.

zh: 事实上，中国决策者有着更广泛的动机。
en: In fact, Chinese policymakers have broader motives.

zh: 由于中国的出口占GDP的比率高于美国，因此它更关心要如何去维护全球贸易体系；通过避免升级，中国也避免了去危害这一体系。
en: Because China has a higher export-to-GDP ratio than the US, they are more concerned with preserving the global trading system; by eschewing escalation, China avoids jeopardizing it.

zh: 它通过向世贸组织申诉的方式将自己定义为自由和开放贸易的支持者。
en: And by appealing to the WTO, it positions itself as a champion of free and open trade.

zh: 它展现了自身对多边体系的建设性领导作用。
en: It demonstrates constructive leadership of the multilateral system.

zh: 如果其他国家在某种程度上需要依靠中国来维护贸易体系，那么它们也相对不太可能反对中国在南中国海以及其他地区的其他战略举措。
en: To the extent that other countries rely on China for preserving the trading system, they are correspondingly less likely to object to China’s other strategic initiatives, in the South China Sea and elsewhere.

zh: 然后是比较棘手的部分。
en: Now comes the hard part.

zh: 4月3日特朗普政府宣布打算对价值500亿美元的中国出口产品额外加征关税，以回应对方的工业间谍活动，许可证及其他知识产权问题。
en: On April 3, the Trump administration announced its intention to impose tariffs on $50 billion of Chinese exports, in response to industrial espionage, licensing, and other intellectual-property concerns.

zh: 显然，这些贸易行为比那些影响中国那30亿美元铝和钢铁出口的行为要严重得多，也更危险。
en: Obviously, these trade actions are much larger and more dangerous than those affecting $3 billion of Chinese aluminum and steel.

zh: 而讽刺之处在于美国对这些知识产权问题的关注是合理的。
en: The irony is that US intellectual-property concerns are valid.

zh: 但这些担忧和中国的报复都不会为美国赢得任何同情，因为美国政府这一最新行动是紧接着其所谓国家安全理由之下的冒牌钢铁和铝关税后出台的。
en: But neither those concerns nor Chinese retaliation will win the US any sympathy, because the administration’s latest action comes on the heels of bogus US steel and aluminum tariffs, trumped up, as it were, on national security grounds.

zh: 这种对关税工具的连串和鲁莽使用会导致观察员们将那些完全合理的忧虑视为假新闻。
en: This sequencing and reckless use of the tariff instrument encourage observers to dismiss even valid concerns as fake news.

zh: 那么还有可能去避免最坏的状况吗？
en: Is it still possible to avoid the worst?

zh: 政府提议的500亿美元关税最快可以在60天的意见征询期结束时生效。
en: The soonest the administration’s $50 billion of proposed tariffs can come into effect is at the end of a 60-day comment period.

zh: 这会给外国政府，企业和股市留出时间来组织反击。
en: This gives foreign governments, business, and the stock market time to push back.

zh: 有见及此，特朗普政府可以选择细化其知识产权政策，就像它对钢铁和铝的差异性措施那样。
en: Feeling the heat, the Trump administration could choose to nuance its intellectual-property policy, just as it nuanced its steel and aluminum measures.

zh: 它可以度身定制其处理知识产权纠纷的行为，而非强制执行大幅度关税。
en: Rather than imposing sweeping tariffs, it could tailor its actions to the intellectual-property dispute.

zh: 它可以利用美国外国投资委员会去拒绝中国公司对某些美国拥有宝贵知识产权的特定行业进行投标。
en: It could use the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States to reject bids by Chinese companies in specific sectors where the U.S. possesses valuable intellectual property.

zh: 它可以通过WTO去发起投诉。
en: It could pursue its complaints through the WTO.

zh: 那些质疑政府是否有意走这条路线的人应该注意到，事实上，它确实在3月份向WTO提交了一份对某些中国技术许可行为的投诉。
en: Those who question whether the administration has any inclination of going this route should note that it did, in fact, file a WTO complaint against Chinese technology licensing practices in March.

zh: 中国应该保持冷静并稳扎稳打。
en: For its part, China should maintain its calm and steady hand.

zh: 但当美国采取以WTO为基础的方式来处理一些合理的关切时 — — 例如放宽其合资规则并加强其知识产权保护，中国也应当表达其解决问题的意愿。
en: But it should also show a willingness to address valid US concerns when the US takes a WTO-based approach to pursuing them – for example, by relaxing its joint-venture rules and strengthening its intellectual-property protections.

zh: 而对于那些仍然抱着希望的人来说，好消息是美国和中国依然保持着私底下的沟通。
en: For those still hoping against hope, the good news is that, behind the scenes, the US and China are still talking.

zh: 我们能养活世界吗？
en: Can We Feed the World?

zh: 伦敦—20世纪60年代，绿色革命 — — 包括开发高产庄家品种、扩大灌溉基础设施以及将现代肥料和杀虫剂推广到发展中国家 — — 刺激了全球农业产品产量。
en: LONDON – In the 1960’s, the Green Revolution – which included the development of high-yielding crop varieties, the expansion of irrigation infrastructure, and the distribution of modern fertilizers and pesticides to developing-country farmers – bolstered agricultural production worldwide.

zh: 但饥饿阴影依然挥之不去，其中影响最大的因素是短缺和粮食价格波动。
en: But chronic hunger remains pervasive, particularly in developing countries, which are affected most by crop shortages and food-price volatility.

zh: 据预计，2050年全球人口将突破90亿。
en: By 2050, the global human population is expected to exceed nine billion.

zh: 获得食品安全意味着保证所有人都可以以负担得起的方式持续地获得合适的营养，不管土地和水资源的限制、气候变化和随着收入升高而逐渐流行的西方式资源密集型餐饮。
en: Achieving food security means ensuring that all people have consistent, affordable access to the right nutrients, despite land and water limitations, climate change, and the growing prevalence of resource-intensive Western-style diets that accompany rising incomes.

zh: 征服这些挑战绝不容易。
en: Surmounting these challenges will not be easy.

zh: 但是，发展中国家可以通过协作鼓励创新、增强市场联系和支持小农和妇女建立高生产率、稳定、坚韧而平等的农业部门，实现可持续经济增长，保证所有人的粮食安全。
en: But, by taking concerted action to encourage innovation, strengthen market linkages, and support smallholder farmers and women, developing countries can build productive, stable, resilient, and equitable agricultural sectors, achieve sustainable economic growth, and guarantee food security for all.

zh: 首先，公私部门必须增加研发投入，扩张和采用高效、易得、可负担的技术 — — 不管是常规技术、中介技术还是新平台 — — 满足各个国家和地区的具体需要。
en: First, the public and private sectors must ramp up investment in research and development, as well as in the extension and adoption of effective, accessible, and affordable technologies – whether conventional, intermediate, or new platform – according to each country or region’s individual needs.

zh: 由于未使用适宜土地已所剩无几，现有农地日益受到风化和流失，因此可持续集约化十分关键（即在提高庄稼产量的同时使用更少资源、最小化环境破坏 ） 。
en: Given that little suitable land remains unused, and that much of what is being farmed is increasingly degraded and eroded, investment in sustainable intensification (systems for increasing crop yields, while using fewer resources and minimizing environmental damage) is crucial.

zh: 比如，保护性农业 — — 旨在降低甚至消除破坏性和劳动密集性干涉，比如机械化耕作 — — 可以在增加产量的同时保护脆弱土地免遭流失，并改善土壤肥力。
en: For example, conservation agriculture, which aims to reduce or eliminate the need for damaging and labor-intensive interventions like mechanical soil tillage, can increase yields while protecting vulnerable areas from erosion and improving soil fertility.

zh: 在赞比亚，当地政府与私人扶贫慈善组织关爱世界（Concern Worldwide）一起开发了新的杂交种子，可以使每公顷玉米产量达到四五吨，而非洲的平均公顷产量只有一吨。
en: In Zambia, research conducted by local governments, in collaboration with the anti-poverty charity Concern Worldwide, found that new hybrid seeds produced roughly four to five tons of maize per hectare, compared to Africa’s average of one ton per hectare.

zh: 此外，小农 — — 他们是高生产率、稳定、坚韧而平等的农业发展的关键 — — 应该获得必要的工具和支持，从而在价值链中获得更多的好处，同时降低风险。
en: Moreover, smallholder farmers – who are essential to productive, stable, resilient, and equitable agricultural development – should be given the needed tools and support to capture more benefits from value chains, while minimizing risk.

zh: 这要求建立和维持公平、高效的投入和产出市场，让他们有机会和大农一样进入实体和虚拟市场，从而增加收入。
en: This requires building and maintaining fair and efficient input and output markets that connect them – as well as larger-scale farmers – physically and virtually to opportunities to increase their incomes.

zh: 非洲绿色革命联盟（Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa）与政府、国际组织、慈善基金会、私人产业和农民团体合作培训和支持了东部和西部非洲的五千多农业经营商，他们已开始以可负担的小包装销售关键投入品。
en: The Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa has worked with governments, international organizations, charitable foundations, private industry, and farmers’ groups to train and support more than 5,000 agrodealers in eastern and western Africa as they open stores to sell key inputs in small, affordable quantities.

zh: 结果，农民不再需要长途跋涉才能获得必需的供应。
en: As a result, farmers can travel shorter distances to acquire needed supplies.

zh: 在肯尼亚某地区，2004年时农民需要走17公里才能找到农业经营商，而在3年后，只需要走4公里。
en: In one area of Kenya, farmers who had to travel 17 kilometers to reach an agrodealer in 2004 had to travel only four kilometers three years later.

zh: 与此同时，小农还需要进入市场以公平价格出售收成的便利，而不是坐等中间商和低效政府机构盘剥。
en: At the same time, smallholder farmers need easier access to markets to sell their crops for a fair price, rather than relying on expensive middlemen or inefficient government bodies.

zh: 一种办法是建立某种形式的基于合同的农业合作组织去商谈公平价格。
en: An alternative would be to establish some form of cooperative or contract-based farm association that can negotiate fair prices.

zh: 政府也必须开发和实施政策以保证通常被正式食品工业边缘化的群体 — — 妇女、年轻人、少数族裔和无地者 — — 有可靠的方法得到足够的营养和参与农业生产的机会。
en: Governments must also develop and implement policies aimed at ensuring that those who are typically marginalized from the formal food industry – women, young people, ethnic minorities, and non-landowners – have reliable access to adequate nutrition and opportunities to participate in agricultural production.

zh: 作为农民、母亲、教育者和创新者，妇女是粮食生产、消费和未来粮食安全之间的关键纽带。
en: As farmers, mothers, educators, and innovators, women provide a critical link between food production, consumption, and future progress on food security.

zh: 事实上，让女性农民得到与男性一样多的资源能减少全世界1—1.5亿营养不良者。
en: Indeed, giving female farmers access to the same resources as their male counterparts could reduce the number of undernourished people worldwide by 100-150 million.

zh: 最后，政治领袖必须在国际、地区、国家和地方层面不懈地最求这一日程。
en: Finally, political leaders must consistently pursue this agenda at the international, regional, national, and local levels.

zh: 为此他们必须信守在G8、G20和非盟等国际机构中许下的承诺，增加农业发展投资，击败全球饥饿。
en: To that end, they must honor their commitments – made through international institutions, such as the G-8, the G-20, and the African Union – to increasing investment in agricultural development and to combating global hunger.

zh: 类似地，他们必须为国家激励提供持续支持，从而鼓励进一步投资和合作。
en: Likewise, they must offer sustained support to ongoing national initiatives, thus encouraging further investment and cooperation.

zh: 2001—2009年在任的加纳总统库福尔（John Kufuor）堪称领导力的典范，他提振了在农业研究、农民教育和基础设施项目方面（如公路、仓库和冷库）的投资。
en: John Kufuor, Ghana’s president from 2001 to 2009, exemplified such leadership, boosting investment in agricultural research, farmer education, and infrastructure projects, such as roads, warehouses, and cold storage.

zh: 结果，加纳的贫困人口比例从1991—92年的51.8%下降为2005—06年的28.5 % 。
en: As a result, the proportion of people living in poverty fell from 51% in 1991-92 to 28.5% in 2005-06.

zh: 在过去25年中，加纳农业部门平均年增长率高达5 % 。
en: Over the last 25 years, Ghana’s agricultural sector has grown at an average annual rate of 5%.

zh: 加纳的经验让我们有了乐观的理由。
en: Such experiences provide grounds for optimism.

zh: 通过投资和传播创新技术、增强市场联系、鼓励远见卓识的领导并将目标定位在最需要帮助（童儿也是最有潜力）的群体，我们就能养活全世界。
en: By investing in and spreading innovative technologies, strengthening market linkages, encouraging visionary leadership, and targeting those most in need – and thus with the most potential – we can feed the world.

zh: 少一点混帐规定
en: Less of an Ass

zh: 巴黎 — — “如果法律做出这种假设 ” ， 《雾都孤儿》中的班布尔先生说 ， “ 那法律就是混蛋、白痴。
en: PARIS – “If the law supposes that,” says Mr. Bumble in Oliver Twist, “the law is a ass – a idiot.”

zh: ”几十年来，英国的反诽谤法辜负了班布尔先生的期望。
en: For decades, Britain’s libel laws had been living down to Mr. Bumble’s expectations.

zh: 但今年四月议会通过立法修改反诽谤法推动世界言论自由有了长足的进步，而此举也在一定程度上恢复了英国人通情达理的名声。
en: But freedom of expression worldwide received a boost – and Britain’s reputation for commonsense was somewhat restored – in April, when Parliament adopted legislation revising the country’s libel law.

zh: 之前，即便原告或涉嫌诽谤者和英国毫无瓜葛，世界各地自称受到诽谤的企业和个人也会向英国法院提起诽谤诉讼。
en: Previously, corporations and individuals all over the world who claimed that they had been defamed – even if those suing or those who allegedly defamed them had little or no connection to the United Kingdom – would bring lawsuits for libel in the British courts.

zh: 人们普遍将这种做法称之为“诽谤游。 ”
en: The practice was widely known as “libel tourism.”

zh: 俄国乌克兰寡头、阿拉伯王子、非洲独裁者和无良老板等很多提起诉讼的原告鲜有机会能够占得上风。
en: Many plaintiffs who brought such lawsuits – Russian and Ukrainian oligarchs, Arab princes, African dictators, and unscrupulous bosses – had little chance to prevail.

zh: 但他们的目的并非是官司的输赢。
en: But the point was not to win.

zh: 他们的起诉对象往往并不那么多金，而这意味着即使打不赢官司，要求双方大笔砸钱的诽谤诉讼也能让批评者不敢出声。
en: Often, their targets had much fewer resources, which meant that a libel suit requiring both sides to spend substantial amounts could be effective in silencing critics even if it did not succeed.

zh: 在英国国内，该法案导致很多重要问题都无法展开讨论。
en: Within the United Kingdom itself, the law meant that many important issues could not be fully debated.

zh: 反诽谤法改革顺利通过得益于由作家协会性质的英国笔会；四十年来监督各地审查行为并出版受审查作品的双月刊杂志《查禁目录 》 ； 以及宣传科学知识和科学意识的“科学智识”等三家机构在三年前共同发起的一项活动。
en: The passage of libel reform is attributable to a campaign launched more than three years ago by three organizations: English PEN, a writers association; Index on Censorship, a bimonthly journal that has monitored censorship worldwide and published the works of censored writers for the past four decades; and Sense About Science, an organization that promotes scientific knowledge and understanding.

zh: 科学杂志和科学家对骗子有针对性的揭露是赢得公众对英国反诽谤法改革支持的最重要因素。
en: The targeting of scientific journals and scientists for exposing charlatans was a leading factor in generating public support for reform of the UK’s libel law.

zh: 牵涉科技领域的官司包括起诉世界最著名也最受爱戴的《自然》杂志的一场耗资巨大的诉讼。
en: The cases involving science included a costly lawsuit against Nature, one of the world’s best-known and most widely respected scientific journals.

zh: 《自然》杂志迫于无奈应诉这场反诽谤官司，指出某物理杂志编辑发表的多篇文章均未经同行审核。
en: Nature had to contend with a libel suit for pointing out that a physics journal had published many articles by its editor, and that these articles had not been subjected to peer review.

zh: 尽管《自然》杂志最后成功辩护，但为这场官司耗费的人力物力却无法胜数。
en: Though Nature defended itself successfully, the suit cost it a lot of money and tied up many of its staff members for long periods.

zh: 此外还有涉及未经证实的癌症疗法的诉讼。
en: Other libel suits involved unproven cancer therapies.

zh: 英国整脊治疗协会因为2008年《卫报》发表的一篇探讨“伪疗法”的文章而对科普作家西蒙·辛格提出的诉讼在此次运动中起了最大的作用。
en: The science case that probably played the most significant role in the campaign was a suit filed by the British Chiropractic Association against science writer Simon Singh for an article he published in The Guardian in 2008, in which he discussed “bogus treatments.”

zh: 辛格打赢了这场官司，但却付出了大量的时间和法律费用。
en: Singh won his case, but it cost him dearly in time and legal expenses.

zh: 受法律鼓励“诽谤游”的代表官司之一是一名沙特商人起诉一名美国作家，该作家称这名沙特商人为基地组织提供经济援助。
en: One of the cases that illustrated the kind of “tourism” encouraged by the law involved a suit by a Saudi businessman against an American author who said in her book that the businessman had provided financial support to Al Qaeda.

zh: 该著作在英国仅售出23本，但已足以让英国法院接受管辖权诉讼。
en: Apparently, 23 copies of the book were sold in the United Kingdom. That provided a sufficient nexus for the British courts to accept jurisdiction.

zh: 这位未雇请英国律师在英国为自己辩护的美国作家仍被判支付赔偿金，并因此在美国触犯众怒。
en: Though the American author did not hire British counsel and did not try to defend herself in the UK, she was ordered to pay damages, arousing outrage in the United States.

zh: 美国国会通过由奥巴马总统签署的立法，规定上述判决在美国法院无效。
en: The US Congress adopted legislation, signed by President Barack Obama, making such judgments unenforceable in American courts.

zh: 修订后的英国法律依然由被告承担举证责任。
en: The revised British law continues to place the burden of proof on the defense.

zh: 不过却对必须满��的标准做出了改动。
en: But the standard that must be met has been changed.

zh: 新法允许被指控作家或出版商援引“公共利益”为自己辩护。
en: The new law permits an author or publisher who is sued to invoke a “public interest” defense.

zh: 此外，企业、慈善组织和其他机构现在必须证明受到经济损失才可以提起诽谤诉讼。
en: Moreover, corporations, charities, and other institutions filing libel suits will now have to show that they suffered financial damage.

zh: 辛格认为这一要求本身就可以阻止英国整脊协会对他提起诉讼。
en: Singh argues that this requirement by itself would have prevented the suit against him by the British Chiropractic Association from going forward.

zh: 如果无法证明英国是提起诉讼的最佳地点，排除欧盟以外诉讼的新规则可以对诽谤游起到明显的抑制作用。
en: And libel tourism will be drastically reduced by a new rule that excludes suits from outside the European Union if it cannot be shown that the UK is the most appropriate place to bring the case.

zh: 显而易见因代理全世界诽谤案原告而获利颇丰的英国律师事务所拼命游说阻止新法通过。
en: British law firms that have apparently made a lot of money representing libel plaintiffs from around the world impeded adoption of the new law through intense lobbying.

zh: 领导这项运动的科学家、作家和反审查活动家得到了2010年推出无公职议员法案的知名英国公民自由律师莱斯特勋爵的帮助，并最终通过了三大主要政党的审核。
en: The scientists, writers, and anti-censorship activists who led the campaign were assisted in Parliament by Lord Lester, a well-known British civil liberties lawyer, who introduced a Private Members’ Bill in 2010, and eventually by endorsement of reform by all three major political parties.

zh: 距今近400年前的1644年，约翰·弥尔顿发表了谴责议会审核抑制批评出版物的文章论出版自由。
en: Nearly 400 years ago, in 1644, John Milton published his Areopagitica, an essay denouncing a measure in Parliament for licensing the press that was intended, among other things, to suppress libelous publications.

zh: 人们普遍认为该文在全球范围内开创言论及出版自由的先河。
en: That essay is widely regarded as the start of the worldwide movement for freedom of speech and the press.

zh: 上个月科学家、作家和反审查活动家的胜利表明由米尔顿发起的这场运动仍然在他自己的祖国有着顽强的生命力。
en: Last month’s victory by scientists, writers, and anti-censorship campaigners suggests that the movement launched by Milton still has life in his own country.

zh: 一个至关重要经久不息的联盟
en: A Vital and Enduring Alliance

zh: 最近几年，许多专家和评论家都说，大西洋联盟濒临崩溃或将变得不再重要。
en: In recent years, many experts and commentators have said that the Atlantic Alliance would crumble or become irrelevant.

zh: 作为前美国驻北大西洋公约组织大使，我可以说，根据我的经验，这种可怕的预言没什么新鲜之处。
en: As a former ambassador to the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO), I can say from experience that such dire predictions are nothing new.

zh: 作为现任美国国防部部长，我很清楚，跨大西洋的合作和以往一样必要且重要。
en: As America’s current Secretary of Defense, it is clear to me that the transatlantic partnership is as relevant and essential as ever.

zh: 想想在过去几年中发生的那些历史性事件以及美国和欧洲所扮演的角色。
en: Consider the historic events that have taken place in the past year and the role played by the United States and Europe.

zh: 北约新增了7个成员国 — — 这些国家渴望着为北约注入新能量。
en: NATO added seven new members – nations eager to contribute to the Alliance in powerful ways.

zh: 在阿富汗，八百万名投票者，其中40%是妇女，5000年来第一次民主地选举出他们的总统。
en: In Afghanistan, eight million voters, 40% of them women, chose their first democratically elected President in 5,000 years.

zh: 在巴勒斯坦，一个由民主选举产生的总统给新的和平机会带来了希望。
en: In the Palestinian Authority, a democratically elected president offers the hope of a new chance for peace.

zh: 在乌克兰，市民们通过游行示威表达他们对一个自由公正的选举的强烈意愿。
en: In Ukraine, ordinary citizens demonstrated the depth of their commitment to free and fair elections.

zh: 在伊拉克，曾在萨达姆·侯赛因统治下的人们不畏威胁，第一次为一场由70个政党平均享有机会而非一个政党独霸大权的选举投票。
en: In Iraq, Saddam Hussein’s former subjects braved threats and voted for the first time with ballots that offered a choice of 70 political parties, rather than only one.

zh: 全国各地的投票者们，路经着那些危言耸听地写着“投票者死”的海报，撑着拐杖、坐着毛驴拖车纷纷到达投票站点。
en: Across the country, voters arrived on crutches and in donkey carts, passing by posters that threatened: “You vote, you die.”

zh: 投票者们明确反对极端主义分子的意识形态的态度给极端主义分子一个毁灭性的打击。
en: What a damaging blow to the extremists, whose ideology the voters so clearly rejected.

zh: 当然，在伊拉克问题上存有不同看法，这种老朋友之间的争论也不是新鲜事情。
en: While there have been differences over Iraq, such issues among longtime friends are not new.

zh: 想想在过去几十年中北约联盟内部出现的一些分裂。
en: Consider just a few of the divisions that have come up among NATO allies over the past decades.

zh: 上世纪60年代，法国决定脱离北约的集体指挥并要求北约军队离开其领土。
en: In the 1960’s, France decided to pull out of the NATO integrated command and asked NATO forces to leave its territory.

zh: 在1980年代，由于美国总统罗纳德·里根决定要在欧洲部署中程导弹，而与欧洲产生深刻矛盾争执不休。
en: In the 1980’s there was profound disagreement and controversy over President Ronald Reagan’s decision to deploy medium-range missiles in Europe.

zh: 事实上，作为1970年代期间美国驻北约大使，我不得不在冷战中期飞回美国作证反对美国国会通过从欧洲撤回美国军队的议案。
en: In fact, as NATO Ambassador in the 1970’s, I had to fly back to testify against legislation in the US Congress to withdraw America’s forces from Europe in the middle of the Cold War.

zh: 我们的大西洋联盟在过去几年中已经穿越了许多波涛汹涌的海浪，但我们总能够化险为夷解决棘手问题。
en: Our Atlantic Alliance has navigated through some choppy seas over the years, but we have always been able to resolve the toughest issues.

zh: 那是因为有太多的东西将我们紧紧连在一起：相同的价值观、共享的历史以及对于民主永恒的信念。
en: That is because there is so much that unites us: common values, shared histories, and an abiding faith in democracy.

zh: 今天，我们又共同面对一个敌人。
en: Today, we also share a common enemy.

zh: 极端主义分子已经瞄准全球的文明社会：在纽约和华盛顿；伊斯坦布尔；马德里；别斯兰；巴厘等等。
en: Extremists have targeted all civilized societies across the globe: in New York and Washington; Istanbul; Madrid; Beslan; Bali; and more.

zh: 他们所要寻求的不是与文明世界的停战，他们也不愿意商讨一个分立和平。
en: They do not seek an armistice with the civilized world. They will not negotiate a separate peace.

zh: 他们最希望的就是美国和欧洲分歧重重，而不是协力而作。
en: They would like nothing better than for America and Europe to be at odds, rather than working together.

zh: 上个月法国与德国逮捕大量恐怖主义分子嫌疑犯的举动清楚地表明，单靠一个国家难以在反恐怖主义斗争中做到制胜的关键一步。
en: The arrests of numerous terrorist suspects last month by French and German authorities made clear that no one nation can do the critical work necessary to win the struggle against extremists.

zh: 美国和欧洲通常悄悄共享情报、抓获恐怖分子以及捣毁他们的资金来源。
en: Often quietly, America and European nations are sharing intelligence, capturing terrorists, and disrupting their finances.

zh: 结果就是，四分之三的已知基地组织领导人被杀或被捕，其余的在逃。
en: As a result, some three-quarters of known al-Qaeda leaders have been killed or captured, and others are on the run.

zh: 单靠一个国家也无法使任何一个国家停止生产危险武器。
en: Nor can any one nation stop the proliferation of dangerous weapons.

zh: 这就是为什么60多个国家加入了《防扩散安全倡议 》 ， 以防止恐怖政权拥有致命性武器。
en: This is why some 60 nations have joined the Proliferation Security Initiative in an effort to keep deadly weapons from dangerous regimes.

zh: 2003年，德国、意大利、英国和美国政府没收了即将运往黎波利的核武器，此举导致了利比亚决定向联合国原子能机构特派员公开他们的武器清单。
en: In 2003, German, Italian, British, and American authorities confiscated nuclear equipment bound for Tripoli, leading to Libya’s decision to open its weapons inventories to inspectors.

zh: 每个北约国家都向驻扎阿富汗的国际安全援助部队派出人员，该部队的司令权刚从一名法国将军手中交到一位土耳其将军手中。
en: Every NATO nation has personnel serving in the International Security Assistance Force in Afghanistan, which just changed command from a French to a Turkish general.

zh: 北约最新的成员，立陶宛，正带领着一支省区重建队伍 — — 与其他欧洲国家一起，为阿富汗的稳定和进步作着贡献。
en: One of NATO’s newest members, Lithuania, is taking leadership of a Provincial Reconstruction Team – joining other European nations in contributing to Afghanistan’s stability and progress.

zh: 其实，一半以上的北约国家都在阿富汗和伊拉克部署了军力。
en: Indeed, more than half of all NATO nations have had forces in both Afghanistan and Iraq.

zh: 随着伊拉克人民渐渐走上一条颇具挑战性的民主之路，越来越多的北约国家已经同意通过资金或设备以及建立战争学院和国防大学来帮��伊拉克人训练安全部队。
en: As the Iraqi people take more steps along the challenging road to democracy, more NATO countries have agreed to help train Iraqi security personnel by providing funds or equipment and by establishing a war college and military academies.

zh: 北约各国共享的不仅仅是一个联盟：相同的血脉和目标、自由的传统以及直面极端主义分子暴力行为 — — 并打败他们的呼喊声将我们联系在一起。
en: Members of NATO share much more than an alliance; we are united by ties of blood and purpose, a heritage of liberty, and a calling to confront extremists’ violence – and defeat it.

zh: 自二战结束后60年来，我们在危机四伏、充满挑战的年代中相互依靠。
en: In the 60 years since World War II came to an end, we have counted on each other in times of peril and challenge.

zh: 我的年迈让我能够记得柏林墙的砌起和倒塌、纳粹、法西斯主义和苏联共产主义的崛起和土崩瓦解，以及北约成员国如何帮助保护科索沃以及最近为灾难性海啸中的难民带去的援助。
en: I am old enough to remember both the rise and fall of the Berlin Wall, and the ascent and collapse of Nazism, of Fascism, and of Soviet Communism. Together the members of NATO have helped to protect Kosovo and recently brought aid to the victims of a devastating tsunami.

zh: 当大西洋共同体团结一心时，就能完成伟大之举。
en: Great achievements are possible when the Atlantic community is united.

zh: 这种团结不需要战术上或观点上的步调一致，而是目标上一致。
en: That unity need not mean a uniformity of tactics or views, but rather a union of purpose.

zh: 那些珍惜自由政治体系和自由经济体系的人们有着相同的希望。
en: Those who cherish free political systems and free economic systems share similar hopes.

zh: 只要共同协作，那些希望就会在更多的人的手中变成现实。
en: Working together, those hopes can become realities for many more people.

zh: 投票反对巴基斯坦选举
en: A Vote against Voting in Pakistan

zh: 伊斯兰堡 - - 当巴基斯坦准备2月18日的议会选举之际，许多观察家希望这一次投票将会通过给予政府合法性而迎来平稳的时期。
en: ISLAMABAD -- As Pakistan gears up for its parliamentary election on February 18, many observers hope that the vote will usher in a period of stability and calm by lending popular legitimacy to the government.

zh: 但是有时最好通过拒绝参与来帮助民主。
en: But sometimes democracy is best served by refusing to participate.

zh: 即将到来的选举将根据11月3日穆沙拉夫总统宣布紧急状态颁布的非法临时宪法令而举行，这就是这样一个实例。 这就是为何我的党派及其联合夥伴们将会抵制投票。
en: The upcoming election, to be held under the illegal Provisional Constitutional Order (PCO) implemented following President Pervez Musharraf’s state of emergency on November 3, is such a case, which is why my party and its coalition partners are boycotting the vote.

zh: 的确，积极投入选举将会给我的政党一个很好的让民众参与有关问题的机会。
en: To be sure, contesting the election would provide my party with a great opportunity to take issues to the people.

zh: 实际上，我的政党的支持率一直在上升，民意调查现在显示它是前线省份第二最受欢迎的政党，并且在其他每一个省份都获得越来越多的支持。
en: In fact, my party’s support has been growing, with opinion polls now indicating that it is the second most popular in the frontier province – and gaining ground in every other province.

zh: 但是选举本身并不会带来民主。
en: But elections by themselves don’t bring democracy.

zh: 津巴布韦总统穆加贝喜爱选举。
en: Zimbabwe’s president, Robert Mugabe, loves elections.

zh: 埃及总统穆巴拉克举行选举已经27年了。
en: Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak has been holding elections for 27 years.

zh: 乌兹别克斯坦的卡里莫夫当权已经30年，最近再一次“当选”担任总统七年。
en: Uzbekistan’s Islam Karimov has been in power for 30 years, and has just been “elected” to a fresh seven-year presidential term.

zh: 只有人们感觉到选举是自由和公正的时候它们才有意义，而这就要求独立的裁判。
en: Elections are meaningful only if they are perceived to be free and fair, which requires independent referees.

zh: 我的政党七年前成立的时候，我们自称为正义运动。
en: When my party started eleven years ago, we called ourselves the Movement For Justice.

zh: 我们要求司法独立，因为我们相信没有法治民主和繁荣是不可能的，而法治则要求具有限制政府的司法机制。
en: We demanded an independent judiciary, because we believed that democracy and prosperity are impossible without the rule of law, and that the rule of law requires a judiciary that can act as a constraint on the government.

zh: 我们曾经在西方国家大学里留学，受到美国制衡制度的启发。
en: Having gone to university in western countries, we were inspired by the American system of check and balances.

zh: 因此，美国国务院一直谈论自由和公正的选举并且废除紧急状态而不谈及恢复被穆沙拉夫非法解职的法官、包括最高法院首席法官的职务，我们深感惊讶。
en: So it is a shock to us that the US State Department keeps talking about free and fair elections and abolishing the state of emergency, but without mentioning the reinstatement of the judges – including the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court – that Musharraf illegally dismissed.

zh: 如果法官不能恢复原职，怎样才会有自由和公正的选举？
en: If the judges are not reinstated, how can there be free and fair elections?

zh: 谁决定什么是自由和公正的呢？
en: Who decides what is free and fair?

zh: 是穆沙拉夫吗？
en: Musharraf?

zh: 这就是斗争要点，也是决定国家未来的地方。
en: This is where the battle lines are now drawn, and where the future of the country will be decided.

zh: 如果恢复首席法官和其他法官的职务，我们就可以朝向真正的民主制度迈进。
en: If the Chief Justice and the judges are reinstated, we can move toward a genuine democratic system.

zh: 但是如果穆沙拉夫把自己临时宪法令的法官安插在国家之中，那么我们就会走向动荡时期。
en: But if Musharraf manages to get his own PCO judges established in the country, then we will head toward a period of turmoil.

zh: 毕竟，一个只有5%支持率的政党在不舞弊的情况下现在如何赢得选举呢？
en: After all, how can the party of a man who has less than 5% support win the election now without rigging it?

zh: 不幸的是，大多数政党没有坚持民主进程。
en: Unfortunately, most of the political parties have failed to stand up for the democratic process.

zh: 在已故布托的人民当决定参选后，像谢里夫的巴基斯坦穆斯林联盟等主要党派已经决定参选。
en: Major parties like the Pakistan Muslim League (Nawaz) have decided to participate, following the lead of the late Benazir Bhutto’s People’s Party.

zh: 而且，所有参选的主要党派中只有穆斯林联盟要求恢复法官职务。
en: And, of all the major parties that are contesting the election, only the PMLN is demanding the reinstatement of the judges.

zh: 所幸的是，包括学生、主导民意者以及最主要的是律师在内的巴基斯坦人民挺身支持法官，他们在做本来应该由政党来做的工作。
en: Fortunately, the people of Pakistan – students, opinion makers, and, above all, lawyers – are standing up for the judges, doing the work that should have been done by political parties.

zh: 我们看到律师游行，被殴打，投入监狱但是依然坚定不移。
en: We see lawyers marching, getting beaten up, filling the jails, and yet remaining resolute.

zh: 他们抵制出庭而遭受了巨大的经济损失，但是他们却决心首席法官一定要恢复原职。
en: They are suffering huge financial losses by boycotting the courts, and yet they are determined that the Chief Justice must be reinstated.

zh: 所以，巴基斯坦的分歧并不在自由派和极端派者之间，而是在那些支持现状和反对现状的人之间。
en: So the dividing line in Pakistan is not between liberals and extremists, but between those who support the status quo and those who oppose it.

zh: 自称为民主的政党不仅仅是在这一舞弊的选举中与穆沙拉夫合作，而且还在帮助恢复现状。
en: Parties that call themselves democratic are not only going along with Musharraf in this fraudulent election, but are also helping to restore the status quo.

zh: 解决运转不良的民主的办法并非是军事独裁，而是更多的民主。
en: The solution to dysfunctional democracy is not military dictatorship, but more democracy.

zh: 巴基斯坦人理解民主，因为我们具有民主的文化。
en: Pakistanis understand democracy, because we have a democratic culture.

zh: 我们的建国者是一个伟大的宪法派人士，而且巴基斯坦是通过投票成立的。
en: Our founder was a great constitutionalist, and Pakistan came into being through the vote.

zh: 问题是，因为我们缺乏司法独立，我们一直没有独立的选举委员会。
en: The problem has been that because we have lacked an independent judiciary, we have not had an independent election commission.

zh: 所以除了1970年的那次，我们所有的选举都是舞弊的。
en: So all our elections, except for one in 1970, have been rigged.

zh: 印度和巴基斯坦具有类似的背景，经历了40年一党专制的运转不良的民主。
en: India, with which Pakistan shares a similar background, went through 40 years of dysfunctional democracy with a one-party system.

zh: 但是在过去16年里，它开始收获真正民主竞争的果实，因为独立司法和选举委员会给予人民信心，也就是他们的选票可以有所作为。
en: But in the last 16 years it has begun to reap the fruits of genuine democratic competition, because an independent judiciary and electoral commission gives people confidence that their vote can make a difference.

zh: 在我们巴基斯坦有同样的司法独立前，选举是不会自由和公正的。
en: Until we have the same in Pakistan, no election can be free and fair.

zh: 过去两年半以来，我支持穆沙拉夫并且相信他把真正的民主带入巴基斯坦的诺言。
en: For two and a half years, I supported Musharraf and believed his promises to bring genuine democracy to Pakistan.

zh: 我已经看透了穆沙拉夫。
en: I’ve learned my lesson about Musharraf.

zh: 但是更为重要的是，没有一个军事独裁者可以在穆沙拉夫失败的地方成功。
en: But, more importantly, no military dictator can succeed where Musharraf has so clearly failed.

zh: 丘吉尔曾说，战争事大，不应由由将军左右。
en: Winston Churchill once said, “War is too serious a business for generals.”

zh: 这对于民主而言也是如此。
en: The same is true of democracy.

zh: 从特朗普制造的噩梦中醒来
en: Awakening from the Trump Nightmare

zh: 巴黎 — — 美国民众可以以三种方式中的一种避开唐纳德·特朗普的总统任期。
en: PARIS – The American people can escape from the ordeal of Donald Trump’s presidency in one of three ways.

zh: 但他们是否会这样做以及何时会这样做是一个不以法律几率为转移的无法简化的政治问题。
en: But if and when they do is an irreducibly political question, not one that hinges on legal possibilities.

zh: 首先，是尼克松式的方式，被斗争折磨得筋疲力尽的总统因为害怕和不愿接受身边愈演愈烈的诉讼而干脆辞职。
en: First, there’s the Nixonian method, in which the president, worn down by the fight, simply resigns, scared and unwilling to submit to the proceedings that he sees mounting around him.

zh: 但这能否真的成为特朗普的退出方式？
en: But could that really be the exit taken by Trump?

zh: 他是否与这位很久以前的共和党前任一样有着忧郁的特质？
en: Does he share with his distant Republican predecessor a strong enough predisposition to melancholy?

zh: 是否能够想象一个孩子气、冲动和自恋的男人不经过一番挣扎就放弃地球上最强大国家的最高领袖这样一个意义超乎生命的玩具？
en: Can one picture a childish man, compulsive and narcissistic, surrendering without a fight the larger-than-life toy that is the top job in the most powerful country on the planet?

zh: 我对此深表怀疑。
en: I doubt it.

zh: 其次，1967年批准的宪法第25条修正案第4款规定了副总统和内阁可以采取行动，取代因死亡或健康原因无法继续执政的总统的程序。
en: Second, there is Article 4 of the 25th Amendment to the Constitution, ratified in 1967, which spells out a process by which the vice president and cabinet can act to replace a president who has died or is prevented by reasons of health from governing.

zh: 约翰·F·肯尼迪被刺后，如果没有因伤死亡，那么就有可能按照这项程序的规定提前四年结束任期。
en: Such might have been the case, four years earlier, following the assassination of John F. Kennedy, had Kennedy not died from his wounds.

zh: 当罗纳德·里根总统开始表现出阿尔茨海默症的早期迹象时，在短暂的时间内再次出现了这样的可能性。
en: The possibility briefly resurfaced when President Ronald Reagan began to show the first signs of Alzheimer’s disease.

zh: 但当前情况并不类似于上述案例。
en: But the current situation does not resemble those cases.

zh: 特朗普可能像他的诋毁者所说的那样反复无常、不适合执政。
en: Trump may be unstable and unfit to govern, as his detractors claim.

zh: 但他现在是不是比美国民众选他的时候情况更糟？
en: But is he any more so now than he was when the American people elected him?

zh: 或许并非如此。
en: Probably not.

zh: 最后还有弹劾这种补救办法，这些日子这种办法在华盛顿引发了越来越公开的讨论，伴随这样的讨论还流行一本书，那就是艾伦·J·里奇曼的弹劾案例。
en: Finally, there remains the remedy of impeachment, which is being discussed more and more openly in Washington these days, accompanied (in a sign of the times) by a book, The Case for Impeachment, by Allan J. Lichtman.

zh: （里奇曼是一位政治历史学家，他因为设计了一个成功预测从罗纳德·里根到唐纳德·特朗普的所有当选总统的模型而闻名于世。 ）
en: (A political historian, Lichtman is famous for having devised a model that has enabled him to predict the election of every American president from Ronald Reagan to Donald Trump.)

zh: 宪法第二条的弹劾程序适用于对被怀疑犯有“叛国、受贿或其他严重罪行和不端行为的总统、副总统或其他最高行政官员（或法官）的免职。
en: Impeachment, set out in Article 2 of the Constitution, is a procedure for the removal from office of a president, vice president, or other top executive official (or judge) suspected of “treason, bribery, or other high crimes and misdemeanors.”

zh: ”上述过程十分复杂，一般分为两个阶段：首先，众议院必须以简单多数决定指控是否严重到需要进行审判；其次，全面审判将在参议院进行，必须达到2/3的多数才能认定某位官员有罪并即刻触发撤职程序。
en: It is a complex process that unfolds in two phases: first, the House of Representatives must decide, by a simple majority, that the charges are serious enough to be tried; second, a full-fledged trial is conducted in the Senate, which must reach a two-thirds majority to convict the official and trigger immediate removal from office.

zh: 有两个主要理由质疑弹劾能使世界摆脱特朗普。
en: There are two main reasons to doubt that impeachment would rid the world of Trump.

zh: 首先是参议院的权力平衡。
en: First, there is the balance of power in the Senate.

zh: 至少19名共和党参议员需要加入民主党阵营才能认定特朗普有罪。
en: At least 19 Republican senators would have to join the Democrats to convict Trump.

zh: 目前，可以有把握这样做的只有五个人。
en: At the moment, at most five can be counted on to do so.

zh: 唯一两例总统弹劾的先例（包括1868年弹劾安德鲁·约翰逊滥用权力，以及1998年弹劾比尔·克林顿作伪证和妨碍司法）其结果均不尽如人意：这两者最终都被参议院无罪开释。
en: The only two presidential precedents (Andrew Johnson, impeached in 1868 for abuse of power, and Bill Clinton, impeached in 1998 for perjury and obstruction of justice) are hardly encouraging: both ended in acquittal by the Senate.

zh: 其次，民主党大佬们不愿看到超级保守的副总统迈克·彭斯接替特朗普倒下后所空出的职位。
en: Second, there is the reluctance of Democratic Party bosses to see ultraconservative Vice President Mike Pence assume the place vacated by a fallen Trump.

zh: 他难道不会享受在特殊情况下入主椭圆形办公室的近期副总统（林登·约翰逊接替肯尼迪；杰拉尔德·福特接替尼克松）所享有的同样恩惠？
en: Wouldn’t he enjoy the same state of grace enjoyed by recent vice presidents who entered the Oval Office under exceptional circumstances (Lyndon Johnson after Kennedy; Gerald Ford after Nixon)?

zh: 而且如果他继续任职，不仅完成特朗普余下的任期，而且再次依靠自己的力量获得四年连任？
en: And what if he remained in office, not only for the remainder of Trump’s term, but for two four-year terms of his own?

zh: 所有这一切都合乎逻辑。
en: All of this is logical enough.

zh: 但从约翰逊、福特甚至克林顿之后情况已经发生了变化。
en: But times have changed since Johnson, Ford, and even Clinton.

zh: 在后现代民主国家，有且只有一个大佬：那就是公众舆论。
en: In post-modern democracies, there is one and only one boss: public opinion.

zh: 而且公众舆论有其自身的运作逻辑。
en: And public opinion operates according to its own logic.

zh: 美国公众对几乎每天爆出的利益冲突新证据究竟能忍受多久，首先是向中国投资者发放许可证，而后在总统初选的高潮期间，授权特朗普品牌被用于水疗、豪华酒店和其他房地产项目？
en: How long will the American public tolerate the almost-daily doses of new evidence of conflicts of interest, starting with the licensing to Chinese investors, at the height of the presidential primary, of the Trump brand for use on spas, luxury hotels, and other real-estate projects?

zh: 该如何处理特朗普及其同伴（包括特朗普的前国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林及其前竞选经理保罗·马纳福特）与俄罗斯的金融联系？
en: What about Trump’s financial ties with Russia, and those of his associates, including his former national security adviser, Michael Flynn, and his former campaign manager, Paul Manafort?

zh: 俄罗斯寡头可以挥舞什么样的筹码，2004年，特朗普陷入破产时，俄寡头代替将其列入黑名单的美国银行对他的公司进行资本重组并在事先未亲临现场的情况下高价收购了特朗普世界大厦的豪华公寓？
en: What leverage can be wielded by the Russian oligarchs who, in 2004, when Trump was mired in one of his bankruptcies, stepped in for the American banks that had blacklisted him to recapitalize his companies and bought – sight unseen and at premium prices – luxury apartments in Trump World Tower?

zh: 难道所有这一切最终都不会带来损失？
en: Won’t all of this eventually take its toll?

zh: 最后还有解雇联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米所代表的严重妨碍司法，后者的主要过错似乎是拒绝将特朗普从他对2016年竞选期间克里姆林宫干涉罪行的调查中排除出去。
en: And, finally, there is the gross obstruction of justice represented by the firing of FBI director James Comey, whose main offense seems to have been his refusal to exclude Trump from his investigation of the Kremlin’s criminal interference in the 2016 campaign.

zh: 选民们将如何解释注定要浮出水面的该死真相，现在科米的前任罗伯特·米勒已经被任命为调查俄罗斯和特朗普竞选活动联系的特别顾问。
en: What will voters make of the damning revelations that are sure to come to light, now that Comey’s predecessor, Robert Mueller, has been appointed as special counsel to investigate the ties between Russia and Trump’s election campaign?

zh: 公众的厌恶情绪正在不断累积。
en: The signs of public disgust are mounting.

zh: 由马萨诸塞州律师约翰·博尼法兹组织的弹劾特朗普的请愿活动已经搜集了超过一百万个签名。
en: A petition drive to impeach Trump, organized by Massachusetts lawyer John Bonifaz, has gathered more than a million signatures.

zh: 民意调查显示大多数选民在有事实证明特朗普的竞选活动与俄国共谋影响选举结果的情况下希望看到特朗普辞职。
en: Polls indicate that a majority of the electorate would favor Trump’s resignation if it were proved that his campaign colluded with Russia to sway the election.

zh: 越来越多的选民现在正在告诉他们的代表，这些代表如果想要避免危及自身的当选机会迟早不得不开始倾听。
en: And growing numbers of voters are now saying as much to their representatives, who, sooner or later, will have to start listening if they want to avoid imperiling their own electoral chances.

zh: 对特朗普而言，真正的危险将会在被他迷惑和俘虏的选民开始攻击他时降临。
en: For Trump, the real danger will come as the crowd he captivated and captured during the campaign begins to turn on him.

zh: 正如从柏拉图到托克维尔等精明的政治观察家所充分证明的那样，越受这样的群体掌控他们就愈加如影随形。
en: That crowd, as astute political observers from Plato to de Tocqueville amply demonstrated, becomes harder to evade the more you make it master.

zh: 最坏的情况永远不是不可避免。
en: The worst case is never inevitable.

zh: 但愿民粹主义浪潮的乌合之众再次成为伟大的美国民众和市民。
en: May the mob of the populist tide become once again the great American people, a people of citizens.

zh: 当这一天真的到来，特朗普将成为历史。
en: When that happens, Trump will be history.

zh: 废煤
en: Dethroning King Coal

zh: 墨尔本—今年早些时候，大气中的二氧化碳浓度达到了百万分之400（ppm ） 。
en: MELBOURNE – Earlier this year, the concentration of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere reached 400 parts per million (ppm).

zh: 大气二氧化碳浓度上一次达到如此高水平是在300万年前，当时的海平面比现在高24米。
en: The last time there was that much CO2 in our atmosphere was three million years ago, when sea levels were 24 meters higher than they are today.

zh: 如今，海平面正在再次上升。
en: Now sea levels are rising again.

zh: 去年9月，北冰洋冰盖面积创下了有记录以来新低。
en: Last September, Arctic sea ice covered the smallest area ever recorded.

zh: 自1880年有全球记录以来，十个最热年份中的九个出现在21世纪。
en: All but one of the ten warmest years since 1880, when global records began to be kept, have occurred in the twenty-first century.

zh: 一些气象学家认为400 ppm的大气二氧化碳浓度已经超过了气候灾难触发点，数十亿人有成为难民的危险。
en: Some climate scientists believe that 400 ppm of CO2 in the atmosphere is already enough to take us past the tipping point at which we risk a climate catastrophe that will turn billions of people into refugees.

zh: 他们说，我们需要让大气二氧化碳水平下降至350 ppm。
en: They say that we need to get the amount of atmospheric CO2 back down to 350 ppm.

zh: 这个数字被写入了草根运动350.org的名字，188个国家的志愿者参与了这个旨在解决气候变化问题的组织。
en: That figure lies behind the name taken by 350.org, a grassroots movement with volunteers in 188 countries trying to solve the problem of climate change.

zh: 其他气候学家则更加乐观：他们指出，如果我们让大气二氧化碳上升至450 ppm，并由此带来2摄氏度的气温升高，我们仍有66.6%的机会避免灾难。
en: Other climate scientists are more optimistic: they argue that if we allow atmospheric CO2 to rise to 450 ppm, a level associated with a two-degree Celsius temperature rise, we have a 66.6% chance of avoiding catastrophe.

zh: 这意味着仍有三分之一的可能爆发灾难 — — 比俄罗斯轮盘赌的风险还高。
en: That still leaves a one-in-three chance of catastrophe – worse odds than playing Russian roulette.

zh: 据预计，我们将在2038年超过450 ppm。
en: And we are forecast to surpass 450 ppm by 2038.

zh: 有一点是显而易见的：如果我们对地球气候并非不管不顾，就不能把我们已有的煤、石油和天然气都烧了。
en: One thing is clear: if we are not to be totally reckless with our planet’s climate, we cannot burn all the coal, oil, and natural gas that we have already located.

zh: 这些东西大约80 % — —特别是煤，它燃烧时释放的二氧化碳最多 — — 必须呆在地里。
en: About 80% of it – especially the coal, which emits the most CO2 when burned – will have to stay in the ground.

zh: 6月份，美国总统奥巴马对乔治敦大学的学生说，他不会让他们和他们的子孙后代活在“无法修复的地球上 ” 。
en: In June, US President Barack Obama told students at Georgetown University that he refused to condemn them and their children and grandchildren to “a planet that’s beyond fixing.”

zh: 他说气候变化无法等待国会克服其“党派僵局 ” ， 宣布将使用其行政权力采取限制二氧化碳排放的措施，首先是限制新造化石燃料发电厂，其次是限制已有发电厂。
en: Saying that climate change cannot wait for Congress to overcome its “partisan gridlock,” he announced measures using his executive power to limit CO2 emissions, first from new fossil-fuel power plants, and then from existing ones.

zh: 奥巴马还呼吁停止给新建海外火电厂提供公共资金，除非采取脱碳技术（目前这项技术尚不具经济可行性 ） ， 否则的话，他说 ， “ 最穷国家就没有其他办法发电了。 ”
en: Obama also called for an end to public financing of new coal plants overseas, unless they deploy carbon-capture technologies (which are not yet economically viable), or else there is, he said, “no other viable way for the poorest countries to generate electricity.”

zh: 哈佛大学环境中心主任、向奥巴马提供气候变化咨询的总统科学委员会成员施拉格（Daniel Schrag）指出 ： “ 政治上，白宫对向煤宣战还有所顾忌。
en: According to Daniel Schrag, Director of Harvard University’s Center for the Environment and a member of a presidential science panel that has helped to advise Obama on climate change, “Politically, the White House is hesitant to say they’re having a war on coal.

zh: 另一方面，对煤宣战正是我们所需要的。 ”
en: On the other hand, a war on coal is exactly what’s needed.”

zh: 施拉格说的没错。
en: Schrag is right.

zh: 他的大学和我和其他很多人的大学一样，都有削减温室气体排放的计划。
en: His university, like mine and many others, has a plan to reduce its greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 但这些大学，包括施拉格和我的大学，仍在把数十亿美元规模的捐赠基金的一部分投资于炼煤和卖煤的公司。
en: Yet most of them, including Schrag’s and mine, continue to invest part of their multi-billion-dollar endowments in companies that extract and sell coal.

zh: 但像教育机构施压使其停止投资化石燃料的运动已经开始。
en: But pressure on educational institutions to stop investing in fossil fuels is beginning to build.

zh: 许多学校都成立了学生团体，不少学院和大学已经承诺停止对化石燃料的投资。
en: Student groups have formed on many campuses, and a handful of colleges and universities have already pledged to end their investment in fossil fuels.

zh: 旧金山和西雅图等美国城市也同意这样做。
en: Several US cities, including San Francisco and Seattle, have agreed to do the same.

zh: 如今，金融机构也在因为投资化石燃料而遭受口诛笔伐。
en: Now financial institutions, too, are coming under fire for their involvement with fossil fuels.

zh: 6月，我和一群澳大利亚名人签署了一份公开信，要求澳大利亚最大银行停止贷款给新的化石燃料提炼项目并卖出其所持有的参与这一行为的公司的股票。
en: In June, I was part of a group of prominent Australians who signed an open letter to the heads of the country’s biggest banks asking them to stop lending to new fossil-fuel extraction projects, and to sell their stakes in companies engaged in such activities.

zh: 今年早些时候，前美国副总统戈尔在哈佛演讲时赞扬了一个学生团体，这个团体要求哈佛大学卖出其在化石燃料公司的投资。 戈尔将他们的行动与20世纪80年代撤除投资促使南非结束种族隔离政策的行动相提并论。
en: Speaking at Harvard earlier this year, former US Vice President Al Gore praised a student group that was pushing the university to sell its investments in fossil-fuel companies, and compared their activities to the divestment campaign in the 1980’s that helped to end South Africa’s racist apartheid policy.

zh: 如此比较公平吗？
en: How fair is that comparison?

zh: 其分界线可能不如种族隔离政策清晰，但我们持续的高水平温室气体排放量保护的是一个群体的人口 — — 活在世上的丰裕人口 — — 的利益，而受害的是其他群体。
en: The dividing lines may be less sharp than they were with apartheid, but our continued high level of greenhouse-gas emissions protects the interests of one group of humans – mainly affluent people who are alive today – at the cost of others.

zh: （与世界上大部分人口相比，即使美国和澳大利亚煤矿工人因为产业关闭而丢掉了工作，他们也属于丰裕人口。
en: (Compared to most of the world’s population, even the American and Australian coal miners who would lose their jobs if the industry shut down are affluent.)

zh: ）我们的行为完全没有顾及世界上大部分穷人以及今后几百年生活在地球上的所有人。
en: Our behavior disregards most of the world’s poor, and everyone who will live on this planet in centuries to come.

zh: 放眼世界，穷人的碳排放最小，但受气候变化的影响最大。
en: Worldwide, the poor leave a very small carbon footprint, but they will suffer the most from climate change.

zh: 许多生活在炎热地区的人需要忍受更热的天气，他们当中有数亿自耕农，仰仗雨水灌溉庄稼。
en: Many live in hot places that are getting even hotter, and hundreds of millions of them are subsistence farmers who depend on rainfall to grow their crops.

zh: 降雨模式飘忽不定，而亚洲季风也变得越来越不可靠。
en: Rainfall patterns will vary, and the Asian monsoon will become less reliable.

zh: 未来几百年的地球居民将居住在更热的世界中，面临更高的海平面，更少的适耕土地和更极端的飓风、干旱和洪水。
en: Those who live on this planet in future centuries will live in a hotter world, with higher sea levels, less arable land, and more extreme hurricanes, droughts, and floods.

zh: 在如此环境下，开发新的煤炭项目是不道德的，而投资于这些项目不啻于这一不道德行为的共谋。
en: In these circumstances, to develop new coal projects is unethical, and to invest in them is to be complicit in this unethical activity.

zh: 这一道理在某种程度上可以推广到所有化石燃料，但开始改变我们行为的最佳方式是减少煤消费。
en: While this applies, to some extent, to all fossil fuels, the best way to begin to change our behavior is by reducing coal consumption.

zh: 用天然气代替煤确能降低碳排放，尽管从长期看天然气本身亦非可持续能源。
en: Replacing coal with natural gas does reduce greenhouse-gas emissions, even if natural gas itself is not sustainable in the long term.

zh: 眼下，不再投资于煤产业是正确的做法。
en: Right now, ending investment in the coal industry is the right thing to do.

zh: 对宽容的战争
en: A War on Tolerance

zh: 阿姆斯特丹 - - 当“宽容”成为像荷兰那样地方的一个滥用的名词时候，人们就会知道出现了大问题。
en: AMSTERDAM -- When “tolerance” becomes a term of abuse in a place like the Netherlands, you know that something has gone seriously wrong.

zh: 荷兰人总是以作为地球上最为宽容的人而自豪。
en: The Dutch always took pride in being the most tolerant people on earth.

zh: 在平常的年份，没有人会反对女王贝娅特丽克丝去年圣诞节的讲话。 当时，她呼吁宽容并且“尊重少数人群 ” 。
en: In less feverish times than these, no one could possibly have taken exception to Queen Beatrix’s speech last Christmas, when she pleaded for tolerance and “respect for minorities.”

zh: 但是，荷兰右翼反穆斯林的自由党领导人怀德对于荷兰女王的“多元文化废话”极为反感，乃至于他想剥夺女王在政府中的宪法地位。
en: But Geert Wilders, leader of the right-wing, anti-Muslim Freedom Party, was so disgusted by the Dutch queen’s “multi-cultural rubbish” that he wanted her to be stripped of her constitutional role in the government.

zh: 怀德是一个受人追捧的蛊惑人心者，其领导的党派在荷兰议会中占据九个席位。 他把可兰经和希特勒的<<我的奋斗>>一书相提并论，想要禁止穆斯林移民到荷兰，并且叫嚣说那些已经在荷兰国内的穆斯林如果想要留下来的话就应该撕掉一半的可兰经。
en: Wilders, a popular rabble-rouser whose party occupies nine seats in the Dutch parliament, compares the Koran to Hitler’s Mein Kampf, wants to stop Muslims from moving to the Netherlands, and thunders that those who are already in the country should tear up half the Koran if they wish to stay.

zh: 在他的眼里，对伊斯兰的宽容就是绥靖。
en: Tolerance towards Islam is cowardly appeasement in his eyes.

zh: 他认为，欧洲有被“伊斯兰化”的危险。
en: He thinks that Europe is in peril of being “Islamized.”

zh: 他说，如果真正的欧洲人没有胆量站起来拯救西方文明的话，那么 ， “ 清真寺马上就要比教堂还要多了。 ”
en: “There will soon be more mosques than churches,” he says, if true Europeans don’t have the guts to stand up and save Western civilization.

zh: 尽管怀德呼吁禁止可兰经，但是他和他的崇拜者们却声称相信言论自由是西方世界与生俱来的一个权利。
en: Notwithstanding his call to ban the Koran, Wilders and his admirers claim to believe in unfettered free speech as a Western birthright.

zh: 贝娅特丽克丝女王声明，言论自由的权利并不自动意味着冒犯他人的权利。
en: Beatrix stated that the right to free speech does not automatically mean the right to offend.

zh: 怀德不同意。
en: Wilders disagrees.

zh: 他说，对于伊斯兰的批评无论有多么冒犯都不应当受到政治正确性的妨碍。
en: No criticism of Islam, however offensive, should ever be hampered by political correctness.

zh: 怀德利用一切机会来检验穆斯林经常是很有限的宽容。
en: Wilders uses every opportunity to test Muslims’ (often very limited) tolerance.

zh: 他最近的挑衅行为是一部抨击伊斯兰的电影短片。 这部电影还没有上演，但是已经在各地造成了恐慌。
en: His latest provocation is a short film denouncing Islam, which is yet to be shown, but has already caused panic all around.

zh: 怀德古怪滑稽的动作在全世界得到了报导。 这对于一个没有什么资历的荷兰政坛人物是不同寻常的。
en: Remarkably for a Dutch politician – and a minor one, at that – news of Wilders’s antics has reached the world press.

zh: 因此，荷兰在各国的大使馆正在准备暴力抗议，而政府则在考虑特殊的安全措施。
en: So Dutch embassies are bracing themselves for violent demonstrations, and the government is considering special security measures.

zh: 有些评论家说，怀德是在荷兰的一个地方小镇出生长大的天主教徒。 他像他的穆斯林敌人一样也是一个虔诚的信徒，受到维持欧洲“犹太教和基督教”本质的目标的驱使。
en: Some commentators suggest that Wilders, born and raised as a Catholic in a provincial Dutch town, is, like his Muslim enemies, a true believer, driven by the goal of keeping Europe “Judeo-Christian.”

zh: 也许如此，但是这可能是混淆视听。
en: Perhaps, but this is probably a red herring.

zh: 他反对伊斯兰的战争也是、或许主要是对文化和政治精英、荷兰知识分子阶层、欧盟官僚以及持自由派观点的女王的战争。
en: His war on Islam is also, and perhaps even mainly, a war on the cultural and political elites, the Dutch intellectual establishment, the Eurocrats of Brussels, and the liberal-minded queen.

zh: 确实，他的言论指向了对那些与普通人的感受脱节的傲慢精英们。
en: Indeed, his speeches are studded with references to arrogant elites who are out of touch with the feelings of the common man.

zh: “宽容”被视为软弱和充满精英色彩，是那些远离街头残酷现实的人常见的东西。 在那里，暴力和无法无天的外国人威胁到耿直的荷兰民众。
en: “Tolerance” is seen as weak and elitist, typical of people who live far removed from the harsh realities of the street, where violent and unruly foreigners menace upstanding Dutch folks.

zh: 这一精英式的绥靖者观点并不限于荷兰。
en: This notion of the elitist appeaser is not confined to the Netherlands.

zh: 在以色列，批评以色列对巴勒斯坦人的镇压的受过良好教育的犹太活动份子，相信谈判要比暴力好、甚至阿拉伯人也有权利的反战份子被人讥笑地称为“美丽心灵 ” 。
en: In Israel, the educated Jewish activists who criticize Israeli abuses against Palestinians, the peaceniks who believe that negotiation is better than violence and that even Arabs have rights, are called, with a knowing sneer, “beautiful souls.”

zh: 扎根于现实世界的普通人理应更为清楚，那就是，毫不妥协的强硬路线是取得结果的唯一途径。
en: The common man, rooted in the real world, supposedly knows better: uncompromising toughness, the hard line, is the only way to get results.

zh: 在美国，从受到欢迎的电台主持人和右翼政治人物那里说出来的“自由”一词已经几乎和“精疲力尽的东岸小人”或者更糟的“纽约知识分子”同义了。
en: In the United States, the word “liberal,” in the mouths of populist radio hosts and right-wing politicians, has become almost synonymous with “effete East Coast snob” or, worse, “New York intellectual.”

zh: 根据这一观点，自由派不仅软弱，而且不知怎地明显非美国。
en: Liberals, in this view, are not only soft, but are somehow distinctly un-American.

zh: 把精英们和外国、宽容以及大都市联系起来并不是什么新鲜的东西。
en: The association of elites with foreignness, tolerance, and metropolitan cities is nothing new.

zh: 精英们经常说外语，而大城市对混居的人群通常更为宽容和开放。
en: Elites often can speak foreign languages, and big cities are traditionally more tolerant and open to mixed populations.

zh: 美国的政坛人物反对或者假装反对首都华盛顿的权贵，或者法国民粹派呼吁“深度法国 ” 。 以上两种现代民粹主义必定对首都或者大城市抱有敌意。
en: Modern populism – American politicians running, or pretending to run, “against Washington,” or French populists speaking for “deep France” – is invariably hostile to capital cities.

zh: 欧盟首都布鲁塞尔代表了不分左右的民粹派所憎恨的东西。
en: Brussels, the capital of the European Union, stands for everything populists, whether left or right, hate.

zh: 而穆斯林移民则居住在阿姆斯特丹、伦敦或者马赛，不是那种右翼民粹派拥有大多数支持的小城市里。
en: And Muslim immigrants live in Amsterdam, London, or Marseilles, not in the kind of small towns where right-wing populists find most of their support.

zh: 然而，憎恨政治如果与现实恐惧结合就会有最佳效果。
en: Still, the politics of resentment works best when it can tap into real fears.

zh: 人们有理由对经济全球化、泛欧官僚、大量移民涌入管理不善以及极端政治伊斯兰的入侵感到焦虑。
en: There are reasons for people to feel anxious about economic globalization, pan-European bureaucracy, the huge and not always effectively controlled influx of immigrants, and the aggression of radical political Islam.

zh: 而这些焦虑经常受到忽略。
en: These anxieties have too often been ignored.

zh: 不仅是荷兰人，而且许多欧洲人都有这样一种感觉，那就是它们在一个快速改变的世界中被抛弃了，跨国公司比民族国家更为强大，城市里的富人和受过良好教育的人日子过得不错而外省的普通百姓则艰难度日。 民选政治人物不仅庸庸碌碌，而且对那些威胁普通人的更为强大的势力低头。
en: There is a sense among many Europeans, not just in the Netherlands, that they have been abandoned in a fast-changing world, that multi-national corporations are more powerful than nation-states, that the urban rich and highly educated do fine and ordinary folks in the provinces languish, while democratically elected politicians are not only powerless, but have abjectly surrendered to these larger forces that threaten the common man.

zh: 宽容不仅被视为软弱，而且也是背叛。
en: Tolerance is seen as not just weak, but as a betrayal.

zh: 当然，穆斯林威胁并非一个幻影。
en: The Muslim threat is, of course, not a fantasy.

zh: 一小部分意识形态极端主义份子已经以伊斯兰的名义制造了实际的暴力，而且将会继续如此。
en: A small number of ideological extremists has inflicted real violence in the name of Islam, and will continue to do so.

zh: 但是大众对于伊斯兰的憎恨更为深远。
en: But the popular resentment of Islam goes deeper and wider.

zh: 怀德以及像他那样的人并不仅仅是在攻击伊斯兰极端份子。
en: Wilders, and others like him, are not just attacking Islamic extremists.

zh: 他的成功建立在宽容即为背叛的感觉之上。
en: His success is based on that sense of tolerance as betrayal.

zh: 而且，正如经常发生的那样，对精英的厌恶已经在对局外人的厌恶上找到了发泄的地方。 那些局外人外表不一样而且行为方式古怪。
en: And, as so often happens, the loathing of elites has found an outlet in the loathing of outsiders, who look different and whose ways are strange.

zh: 我们必须与伊斯兰极端主义作斗争，但是方式并不是利用没有头脑的乱众最为黑暗的冲动感觉。
en: We must fight Islamic extremism, but not by tapping into the darkest gut feelings of the unthinking mob.

zh: 这样做就不会有好结果。
en: Nothing good ever came from that.

zh: 虚伪的逮捕令
en: A Warrant of Hypocrisy

zh: 伦敦—本月早些时候，国际刑事法院（ICC）支持本院的首席检察官的要求，向苏丹总统奥马尔·艾尔—巴希尔（音译，中文标准翻译是奥马尔·哈桑·艾哈迈德·巴希尔或奥马尔·巴希尔）发出逮捕令，指控他犯了战争罪和反人类罪。
en: LONDON – Earlier this month, the International Criminal Court (ICC) upheld the request of the court’s chief prosecutor to issue an arrest warrant for Omar el-Bashir, the President of Sudan, charging him with war crimes and crimes against humanity.

zh: 巴希尔的回应是将在达尔富尔照管难民营事务的外国援助机构驱逐出境。
en: Bashir responded by expelling foreign aid agencies looking after the refugee camps in Darfur.

zh: 国家的现任领导人被指犯下了战争罪，这还是第一次。 全世界的反应主要分做两种：有些人欢呼这一举措是向着国际正义迈出的一大步，还有些人指责这是殖民主义。
en: This is the first time that a sitting head of state has been indicted for war crimes, with reaction around the world mainly divided between those who hailed the move as a great step for international justice and those who condemned it as colonialism.

zh: 而这两种立场都已经完全地陷入了智力和道德的迷雾。
en: Both positions are hopelessly buried in intellectual and moral fog.

zh: 逮捕令并不是向前的一大步。
en: The warrant was no leap forward.

zh: 从法律的观点来看，被告是现任国家领导人还是卸任国家领导人并没有区别。
en: From the legal point of view, it makes no difference whether the accused is a sitting or former head of state.

zh: 然而在实际中两种情况大不相同：在任的统治者将来能给他的人民造成的伤害要远比卸任统治者严重，因此不应该刺激在任统治者采取报复行为。
en: But it makes an enormous practical difference that an incumbent ruler can do a lot more future damage to his people than an ex-ruler, and therefore should be given no incentive to retaliate.

zh: 巴希尔政策的后果之一，是造成达尔富尔地区估计有30万人死亡，270万人流离失所。
en: As a result of Bashir’s policies, 300,000 people are estimated to have died and 2.7 million displaced in Darfur.

zh: 驱逐援助机构则使100万达尔富尔人身处流行病和饥饿的危险之中。
en: The expulsion of the aid agencies has put over a million Darfuris at risk of epidemics and starvation.

zh: 根据国际刑事法院的建立规约，检察官需要确保起诉是基于被害者的利益并出于正义。
en: According to the statute that established the ICC, the prosecutor is required to ensure that any prosecution is in the interests of the victims as well as of justice.

zh: 但是，对于国际刑事法院公诉人之类的律师们来说，抽象的正义要求比起任何具体的保护责任来更有吸引力。
en: But, to lawyers like the ICC prosecutor, the abstract claims of justice are more vivid than any concrete duty of protection.

zh: 在这样的情况下，正义是伴着毒箭到来的。
en: In this case, justice comes with poisoned arrows.

zh: 既然有逮捕令和它所暗示的国际支持来壮胆（虽然这种暗示难以捉摸 ） ， 达尔富尔叛军“公正与平等运动”就已经停止了和苏丹政府的和平谈判。
en: Emboldened by the warrant and its elusive suggestion of international support, the Darfuri rebels, the Justice and Equality Movement, have walked out of peace talks with Sudan’s government.

zh: 与此同时，巴希尔也几乎毫发不伤，而且毫无疑问他将抓住这个机会攻击他的敌人。
en: Meanwhile, Bashir, with little to lose, will no doubt take the opportunity to attack his enemies.

zh: 反驳论据说威胁控告统治者将会阻止他们继续作恶。
en: The counter-argument is that the threat of indictment will deter rulers from wicked behavior.

zh: 但是法律只有在制裁可靠的情况下才能起到威慑作用。
en: But the law will deter only if its sanctions are credible.

zh: 一条无法执行的法律谁也吓不倒。
en: A law that cannot be enforced deters no one.

zh: 实际上它还削弱了对法律的尊敬。
en: In fact, it weakens respect for law.

zh: 而且，对拖往海牙的恐惧之情可能会在威慑统治者方面发挥一些作用，让他停止犯下反人类罪行；但是宣称针对巴希尔的逮捕令将会阻止现在大量的人权侵犯者则荒谬可笑。
en: Moreover, while the fear of being hauled off to The Hague may have some effect in deterring rulers from committing crimes against humanity, the claim that the Bashir warrant will deter the current crop of human rights’ violators is derisory.

zh: 实际上，这可能将会延长作恶的体制。
en: Indeed, it is likely to prolong wicked regimes.

zh: 例如罗伯特·穆加贝就因为害怕受审而拒绝离任，让津巴布韦人民吃足了苦头。
en: Robert Mugabe, for example, refuses to leave office – at great cost to Zimbabwe’s people – for fear of being put on trial.

zh: 无论让犯罪分子“无处藏身，不管引发什么后果”听起来如何诱人，当犯罪分子是国家领导人的时候，我们不能忽略后果。
en: Whatever the attractions of giving criminals “nowhere to hide, whatever the consequences,” the consequences cannot be ignored when the criminals are heads of state.

zh: 在数百或数千条生命危在旦夕之时，不能把绝不和恐怖分子谈判的政策扩大到国家层面。
en: The policy of never negotiating with terrorists cannot be scaled up to state level when hundreds of thousands of lives are at stake.

zh: 与此同时，有关殖民主义的指责完全是不加思索，脱口而出：殖民主义已经不存在了。
en: The charge of colonialism, meanwhile, is simply reflex: colonialism no longer exists.

zh: 指责国际法只是“西方法律”也不过废话而已。
en: The charge that international law is just “western law” is also rubbish.

zh: 国际法是人类的良知。
en: International law is the conscience of mankind.

zh: 但是认为法律执行是有选择性的，这种观点倒碰巧没错。
en: But the perception that the law is selectively applied happens to be true.

zh: 1946年的纽伦堡审判奠定了当代国际法的基础。 当时针对纳粹领导人的主要指控是“策划和发动了侵略战争 ” 。
en: In the Nuremberg trial of 1946, which laid the basis of current international law, the main charge against the Nazi leaders was that of “planning and waging aggressive war.”

zh: 《联合国宪章》禁止战争，自卫战争除外。
en: Prohibition of war except for self-defense is embedded in the United Nations Charter.

zh: 纽伦堡国际军事法庭将发动侵略战争列为“最严重的国际罪行 ” ， 但是国际刑事法院的创立者们认为，发动侵略战争在本庭的管辖之外。
en: But the ICC’s creators deemed the waging of aggressive war – which the International Military Tribunal at Nuremberg called “the supreme international crime” – to be outside the court’s jurisdiction.

zh: 这就使得发动侵略伊拉克战争的领导者们不受法律���束。
en: This guaranteed legal immunity for the leaders who carried out the invasion of Iraq.

zh: 指责应用法律具有选择性同样也适用于发给巴希尔的逮捕令。
en: The charge of selective application also applies to the Bashir warrant.

zh: 巴希尔被控犯了战争罪和反人类罪。
en: Bashir stands accused of war crimes and crimes against humanity.

zh: 反人类罪最初在1950年的纽伦堡原则中被定义为包含了“谋杀、灭绝、奴役、驱逐出境”和“其他非人道行为 ” 。
en: The latter were first defined in the Nuremberg principles of 1950 to include murder, extermination, enslavement, deportation and “other inhumane acts.”

zh: 1998年，这些其他行为被清楚地界定为非法监禁、折磨、强奸和迫害一个团体，强迫人员失踪和种族隔离。
en: In 1998, these other acts were clarified to mean false imprisonment, torture, rape, persecution of a group, enforced disappearance of persons, and apartheid.

zh: 因此，在《阿拉伯新闻》上读到对巴希尔的逮捕令“散发着虚伪的气味”并不让人吃惊。
en: It comes as no surprise, then, to read in the Arab News that Bashir’s warrant “reeks of hypocrisy.”

zh: 确实，布什和切尼的逮捕令在什么地方？
en: Where, indeed, are the arrest warrants for Bush and Cheney?

zh: 难道极端引渡行为不该被视为“强迫人员失踪”吗？
en: Does extraordinary rendition not count as “enforced disappearance of persons”?

zh: 难道哈立德·谢赫·穆罕默德所遭受的水刑不该被当作是一种折磨吗？
en: Does the waterboarding of Khalid Sheikh Mohammed not count as torture?

zh: 为什么弗拉基米尔·普京没有因为在车臣的战争罪受审？
en: Why is Vladimir Putin not standing trial for war crimes in Chechnya?

zh: 答案很简单：只要联合国安理会成员国或是他们旗下某一国的利益面临危险，法庭的司法管辖权就终止了。
en: The answer is simple: where the interests of a UN Security Council member or one of their clients are at stake, the court’s jurisdiction ends.

zh: 国际刑事法院就象一张蜘蛛网：小苍蝇被抓住了，胡蜂和大黄蜂破网而出。
en: The ICC is like a cobweb: small flies get stuck, but wasps and hornets get through.

zh: 除非美国修改国际刑事法院的条约，很多人肯定会认为这个法院不过是个政治化的袋鼠法庭。
en: Until the United States ratifies the ICC treaty, the Court is bound to seem to many to be little more than a politicized kangaroo court.

zh: 而没有美国的支持，它就很难获得合法性，更别提有效完成工作了。
en: Without American support, it has little hope of earning legitimacy, let alone doing its job effectively.

zh: 安理会有权将对巴希尔的逮捕令推迟一年，这种推迟还是可以延续的。
en: The Security Council has the power to defer the warrant for Bashir’s arrest for renewable periods of one year.

zh: 它能无限期地推迟逮捕令， 而且似乎就要这样做。
en: It can do this indefinitely, and it seems likely that it will.

zh: 这一举动的含义是：推迟逮捕令将会赋予安理会对苏丹的影响力。
en: The idea is that deferring the warrant will give the Security Council leverage over Sudan.

zh: 澳大利亚前外长加雷斯·埃文斯已经认为逮捕令是“强有力的外交工具 ” ， 《华盛顿邮报》则表示可以把逮捕令当成“和巴希尔先生以及他的中国和阿拉伯盟友讨价还价的筹码”来使用。
en: Gareth Evans, a former Australian Foreign Minister, has called it “a powerful diplomatic tool,” while the Washington Post has called for the warrant to be used “as a bargaining chip with Mr. Bashir and his Chinese and Arab allies.”

zh: 他们相信被捕的威胁可以用来迫使巴希尔改进他的方法。
en: They believe that the threat of arrest can be used to force Bashir to mend his ways.

zh: 如果证明的确如此，那么国际刑事法院及其发起者就已经把正义和外交混为一谈。
en: If this proves true, the ICC and its sponsors have muddled justice with diplomacy.

zh: 如果世界只能通过牺牲弱者，利于强者的方式来执行正义，它就该坚持使用更为古老的预防犯罪工具：强权和谈判，而把正义排除在外。
en: If the world can dispense justice only at the expense of the weak and to the advantage of the strong, it should stick to the older tools of crime prevention: force and negotiation, and leave justice out of it.

zh: 美国应该采取“分水岭”主义
en: A Watershed Doctrine for America

zh: 洛杉矶 — — 只要美国一日不能安稳应对国内经济挑战，世界就一日不得太平。
en: LOS ANGELES – As the United States stumbles through its economic challenges at home, the pressure of world events will not subside.

zh: 但美国安内的能力已经发生了变化。
en: But America’s ability to address them has changed.

zh: 财政疲软制约了美国作为全球警察的行动力。
en: Its fiscal weakness limits its ability to act as global policeman.

zh: 尽管推翻卡扎菲政权几乎没有让美国破费一分钱，但长期干预阿富汗和伊拉克局势已经大大削弱了美国公众对积极外交政策的容忍度。
en: Despite the relatively costless overthrow of the Qaddafi regime, America’s prolonged interventions in Afghanistan and Iraq have severely strained the public’s tolerance for an active foreign policy.

zh: 尽管如此，在可预见的未来，美国似乎仍然注定是全世界最重要的角色。
en: Nonetheless, the US seems destined to remain the world’s most important actor for the foreseeable future.

zh: 但如今，美国成了没头的苍蝇，它缺乏一个类似于冷战时期“遏制”政策的战略优先事项指南。
en: But today it is an actor without a script – it lacks a strategic guide comparable to the Cold War’s containment doctrine to prioritize policy.

zh: 显而易见，过去20年来干预巴尔干、索马里、东南亚和中东的临时决策无法成为新的局限时代的决策指南。
en: Quite simply, the ad hoc policymaking that directed interventions in the Balkans, Somalia, southwest Asia, and the Middle East in the past two decades will not suffice in this new era of limitations.

zh: 这表明，美国必须决定新的总体战略，来约束其发动战争或卷入他人建国过程的冲动。
en: This suggests that the US should seek out an overarching strategy to discipline its impulses to fight wars of choice or engage in nation-building efforts.

zh: 奥巴马总统在《2010年国防战略》中提出了广泛的政策愿景 — — “现在，我们必须将美国置于领导不同国家和民族间共同利益的地位。
en: President Barack Obama’s 2010 National Security Strategy nurtures broad policy aspirations – “[n]ow we must position the United States to champion mutual interests among nations and peoples” – but falls short as a practical guide. I suggest an alternative strategy, one already embedded in America history, though largely unrecognized.

zh: ”但这还不足以成为实践指南。
en: But making explicit what lies implicit can sharpen US decision-making.

zh: 我将这一战略称为“分水岭主义 ” 。
en: I call this strategy the “Watershed Doctrine.”

zh: 分水岭可以是触发点，可以是转折点，也可以是博弈局势变换器。
en: A watershed is a tipping point, a turning point, a game changer.

zh: 当美国面临“消极分水岭 ” — —即致命国家安全威胁 — — 时，它应该动员财政和人力资源来消除风险。
en: When the US has confronted a “negative watershed” – a lethal threat to the country – it committed meaningful financial and human resources in order to address the risks.

zh: 积极分水岭 — — 即能对国际或地区政局产生地震偏移影响、走向建立新生国家的机会；或是可使用经济和军事援助以防止可信消极分水岭的机会 — — 也要求同等的承诺。
en: Positive watersheds – opportunities to engineer seismic shifts in international or regional political affairs through nation-building, or to use economic and military assistance to prevent plausible negative watersheds – demand an equal level of commitment.

zh: 分水岭这个概念为决策者提供了可用 — — 至少是可议 — — 的标准。
en: The Watershed concept provides policymakers with a standard to use – or at the very least to debate.

zh: 它是一种决策组织工具：某项国际挑战是否属于分水岭？
en: It is an organizing tool for policymaking: Is an international challenge a watershed or not?

zh: 如果是，就介入；如果不是，就袖手旁观。
en: If so, get involved. If not, stay out.

zh: 我们研究了美国历史上的分水岭。
en: We find watersheds throughout American history.

zh: 1812年战争和内战是显著的例子。
en: The War of 1812 and the Civil War are clear examples.

zh: 如果美国武装未能在一开始就把英国人驱逐出美国领土，如果林肯和联邦未能在内战中获胜，那么美国早已分崩离析，绝无可能成为20世纪的超级大国。
en: Had American forces not expelled the British from US territory in the first, and had Abraham Lincoln and the Union not prevailed in the second, the country would have been balkanized and unable to become the dominant power of the twentieth century.

zh: 相反，美西战争时期一时兴起的殖民主义、20世纪在墨西哥、中美洲和加勒比地区的介入，以及第一次世界大战（该事件颇可商榷）对美国来说并非分水岭。
en: By contrast, America’s flirtation with colonialism in the Spanish American War, its involvement in Mexico, Central America, and the Caribbean throughout the twentieth century, and, arguably, World War I, were not watersheds for the US.

zh: 但美国在一战之后的凡尔赛会议中未能压倒旧世界政治以及国内出现的孤立主义均属于坐失积极分水岭良机的例子。
en: But America’s inability after the Great War to overcome Old World politics at Versailles and isolationism at home marked a failed opportunity to promote a positive watershed.

zh: 由于美国的坐失良机，世界走上了通往消极分水岭的道路 — — 纳粹主义德国和帝国主义日本崛起了。
en: That failure placed the world on the path to the negative watershed posed by Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan.

zh: 美国及其盟友最后胜出并非事先注定之事。
en: Nothing foreordained that the US and its allies would prevail.

zh: 如果轴心国消极分水岭最后胜出，那么美国将成为与现在远不相同的国家。
en: Had the Axis’s negative watershed succeeded, the US would have become a far different country.

zh: 如今有一大未被注意到的积极分水岭，该分水岭从二战结束后就立刻出现了，那就是德国和日本的转型。
en: A positive watershed, under-appreciated today, developed in the years immediately after World War II with the political transformation of Germany and Japan.

zh: 美国对德日转型投入了巨大的资源，让两国变为稳定、和平的民主国家，从而消除了它们成为敌国的可能，将它们塑造为抵御下一个潜在消极分水岭 — — 苏联的桥头堡。
en: America’s remarkable investment of resources in this outcome made both countries stable, peaceful democracies, thereby eliminating them as adversaries and turning them into vital bulwarks against the next harbinger of a negative watershed, the Soviet Union.

zh: 与对轴心国的战争不同，美国在冷战上采取了多种战术、全面开花，并持续了几十年之久 — — 使用了政治、经济以及核威慑，也使用了有限武力，以保证对苏联的遏制。
en: Unlike the battle against the Axis, the US fought the Cold War in many ways, on many fronts, and over many decades – using politics, economics, and nuclear deterrence, as well as limited armed action, to ensure the USSR’s containment.

zh: 美国必须及时接受这样一个概念：任何政治和军事战争的失利都不是分水岭，只要其在欧洲、远东和拉美的核心利益不受损失。
en: In time, the US had to accept that each political contest or military battle lost was not a watershed as long as its core interests in Europe, the Far East, and Latin America were not threatened. Through trial and error – backed by a durable political and economic system – the US prevailed and the Soviet Union disintegrated.

zh: 伊斯兰原教旨主义的崛起代表着有一大历史挑战，虽然这一挑战与美国历史上所面临的那些挑战相比还只能说是萌而未发。
en: The rise of Islamic fundamentalism poses another historic challenge, though one that is far more inchoate than any that the US has faced before.

zh: 在过去，这样的挑战甚至不会被称为是分水岭。
en: In other times, the challenge would not even be called a watershed.

zh: 但大规模杀伤性武器可能被用于对付美国这一风险让它成了分水岭。
en: But the risk that weapons of mass destruction could be turned against the US makes it so.

zh: 其次则是“阿拉伯之春 ” ， 这是潜在积极分水岭，美国应该评估一下，为了追求积极结果，应该投入多少政治、经济和军事力量。
en: Then there is the “Arab Spring,” a potential positive watershed that calls upon the US to decide how deep a political, economic, and military commitment it ought to make to nurture positive results.

zh: 如今，美国比后冷战时代全盛期更加冷静现实了。
en: Today, the US is a more sober and realistic country than it was in the heyday of the early post-Cold War period.

zh: 但是，由于美国在其所干预的地区受到了诸多挫折，而国内则正在饱受经济低迷之苦，因此在如何应对国际局势变化上，美国需要面临诸多不确定性。
en: But, in the aftermath of setbacks in regions where it intervened, and with heightened economic distress at home, the US finds itself uncertain about how to respond to changing global events.

zh: “分水岭主义”可能可以为美国提供正确的道路。
en: Pursuing a “Watershed Doctrine” might provide the right answer.

zh: 新核武条约的艰难起步
en: A Weak Start for START

zh: 发自洛杉矶 — — 随着美国参议院就是否批准美俄新《削减战略武器条约 》 （ Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty）的辩论日渐升温，某种似曾相识的奇异感觉又开始笼罩在华盛顿上空了。
en: LOS ANGELES – A strange sense of déjà vu is gripping Washington these days, as the debate over ratification by the United States Senate of the New Strategic Arms Reduction Treaty (New START) with Russia heats up.

zh: 舌战在奥巴马政府、未来总统竞争者，参议员和武器防空专家之间展开，而在辩论中我们虽然看不到任何对冷战的怀念，但却能觉察到：那个年代的思维又回来了。
