en: Spats have broken out between the Obama administration, future presidential contenders, senators, and arms control and defense experts. There may not be nostalgia for the Cold War in any of this, but much of that era’s mindset can be perceived again in the arguments being knocked about.

zh: 参议院必须决定新条约究竟能否提高美国的国防安全。
en: The Senate must decide whether New START enhances American security.

zh: 不幸的是，虽然决议限期被推迟到秋末 — — 好让奥巴马政府能有时间去争取更多支持 — — 但不管结论如何，美俄两国政府依然会在可见的未来把核导弹互相指向对方。
en: Unfortunately, whatever the decision -- which has been delayed perhaps until late Fall to allow Obama’s administration more time to muster support for the treaty -- the US and Russian governments will continue to place each other in the nuclear crosshairs for the foreseeable future.

zh: 新条约是建立在1970年代限制战略核武器的政治遗产之上的。
en: New START builds on a legacy of strategic nuclear arms limitation that goes back to the 1970’s.

zh: 而前美国国务卿亨利·基辛格最近的证词则吸引了大家的眼球，他说 ： “ 对于那些拥有最为庞大且最具破坏力的军火库，却又矛盾地想通过谈判来避免承受自己（发射）决定的最终后果的人来说，核武器控制问题已经超出了他们原先设想的范畴。 ”
en: Former US Secretary of State Henry Kissinger captured the allure in recent testimony: “The subject of nuclear arms control grew out of the seemingly paradoxical effort of those who had created the largest and most destructive arsenals to avoid by negotiation the ultimate consequences of their own decisions.”

zh: 在那个年代，美俄双方一方面要通过限制来避免基辛格所说的“最终后果 ” ， 另一方面却对二战中遭受突袭的惨痛经历记忆犹新。
en: Over the years “avoiding…the ultimate consequences” through limitations butted against the bitter legacy of the surprise attacks suffered by both the US and Russia in World War II.

zh: 两国在二战后都制定了某种防御突袭的政策，为了达到威慑对方的目的，双方还投资了数万亿美元来制造大量永备性，机动性和隐蔽性的核武设施。
en: After the war, each adopted a “never be surprised again” policy, and so went on to invest trillions of dollars in a multitude of hardened, mobile, and concealed nuclear weapons to deter the other.

zh: 而这些政策的成果就是数万枚核弹头。
en: The result produced tens of thousands of nuclear warheads.

zh: 在那个年代，战略武器控制条约上的进展就是衡量两国关系的标尺。
en: In time, strategic arms control treaties became the measure of the political relationship.

zh: 随着苏联解体，一个终结核武竞赛的绝佳机会出现在人们眼前。
en: With the Soviet Union’s collapse, a unique opportunity to end the nuclear competition emerged.

zh: 但当某些前苏联加盟共和国着手销毁核武器之时，克里姆林宫却将核武器库 — — 这个俄罗斯前超级大国地位的最后一点遗产 — — 紧紧地抱在了怀里。
en: While elimination did take place in the former Soviet Republics, the Kremlin hung on to its nuclear arsenal – the last vestige of Russia’s former superpower status.

zh: 无独有偶，美国政府也不愿意放弃自己的核武器。
en: Likewise, US administrations have remained wedded to the Bomb.

zh: 于是冷战时期的“核人质”关系继续维持了下来，最终在2002年的《削减战略进攻性核武器条约》中告一段落，商定各自于2012年将核弹头数量减少到2200枚。
en: As a result, the “nuclear hostage” relationship of the Cold War continued, capped in 2002 by the Strategic Offensive Reduction Treaty, which set the upper limit on warheads at 2,200 by 2012.

zh: 在2009年春的布拉格讲话中，奥巴马提出了一个更具野心的建议：无核世界。
en: In the spring of 2009, speaking in Prague, Obama advanced a bold ambition: a world without nuclear weapons.

zh: 但他的大胆建议却生不逢时，因为核武器依然是许多国家威慑战略的核心。
en: But his audacity confronted a world in which the Bomb remained at the heart of many countries’ deterrence strategies.

zh: 这令奥巴马都不免感到气馁，只得承认说他并不认为这一想法能在自己有生之年成为现实。
en: Obama muddled his message further by admitting that he did not expect to see abolition in his lifetime.

zh: 但即便如此，新条约其实是向核裁军方面迈进的新一步。
en: Nonetheless, New START marks a step in the direction of disarmament.

zh: 它会将双方的战略核弹头数量削减到1550枚，发射车数量减少到700辆。
en: It would limit each country to 1,550 strategic warheads on 700 deployed delivery vehicles.

zh: 而验证方式则依靠对双方部署区域的18次检查，对核武器的服役/退役情况，导弹发射测试以及其他信息的互相告知，并成立一个商议委员会来平息争端。
en: Verification relies on 18 on-site inspections, notification of forces in and out of service, missile-test flight information and other data exchanges, plus a consultative commission to iron out compliance.

zh: 新条约的支持者们宣称，如果参议院未能通过的话，美国将难以预测俄罗斯未来的核活动，并以此产生更多的不信任和误判，最终令双方都更不安全。
en: Were the US Senate to fail to ratify New START, the treaty’s proponents argue that the US would lose predictability about Russia’s nuclear activities, resulting in greater distrust and risk of miscalculation, making both sides less secure.

zh: 但那些对武器削减持怀疑态度的人可不这样认为：在整个冷战期间，他们将美国对发展和部署核武器的限制视为对国家安全的出卖。
en: But arms-control skeptics take issue with this. Throughout the Cold War, they viewed restraints on America’s development and fielding of nuclear weapons as compromising national security.

zh: 那些对苏联可能使诈的忧虑有力地支持了他们的观点，而两个超级大国之间的关系确实也曾因背叛而遭到损害。
en: Fears that the Soviet Union would cheat reinforced their position. And cheating did indeed upset the broader superpower relationship.

zh: 时至今日，同样的忧虑也对新条约构成了障碍。
en: Today, similar apprehensions stoke opposition to New START.

zh: 为了安抚这些忧虑，奥巴马承诺逐年增加对美军核武器研究所的经费支持。
en: To allay such concerns, the Obama administration committed to a multi-year increase in the budgets of the US military’s nuclear-weapons laboratories.

zh: 而在4月10日发布的《核态势研究报告》中，政府也警告那些试图破坏《核不扩散条约》的国家不要轻举妄动，因为他们依然会是美国核导弹的目标。
en: And in the April 10 release of the Nuclear Posture Review, Obama’s administration warned nuclear-armed states and others tempted to violate the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty that they would remain nuclear targets.

zh: 另一方面，导弹防御也成为了另一个争论焦点。
en: Missile defense has become another bone of contention.

zh: 在新条约的序言中列明：条约“不会减低双方战略进行性核武器的和可使用性和使用效果 ” 。
en: The language in the preamble to New START states that the agreement will not “undermine the viability and effectiveness of the strategic offensive arms of the Parties.”

zh: 加上俄罗斯方面威胁说如果美国的防御能力太过强大的话，它将单方面退出条约，因此有批评认为条约本身就赋予了俄方阻挠美国部署任何战略防御系统的口实。
en: Critics contend that the clause, along with the Kremlin’s implied warning that it could withdraw from the treaty unilaterally were America’s defenses to become too robust, provides the Kremlin with leverage to impede deployment of any strategic missile-defense system.

zh: 奥巴马政府反复地驳斥了上述批评，同时也否定了对条约核查规定不完备的担心。
en: The Obama administration repeatedly denies such claims, along with others that the treaty’s verification provisions remain insufficient.

zh: 有人指出俄罗斯可能用多弹头导弹��者新轨道导弹运载工具来蒙蔽美国，但政府却不以为然，认为克里姆林宫也担心美国会以牙还牙。
en: It scoffs at assertions that Russia would cheat by multiplying warheads on bombers or new rail-based missile carriers, arguing that the Kremlin would want to avoid America’s compensatory response.

zh: 但奥巴马政府确实承认了一点：那就是新条约无法削弱俄罗斯在战术核武器方面的巨大优势。
en: But Obama’s team does concede one point: New START fails to curtail Russia’s large numerical advantage in tactical nuclear weapons.

zh: 但政府也认为这种短程的武器显然无法威胁美国本土，并打算在随后的谈判中向俄罗斯施压。
en: Arguing that short-range devices pose no risk to the American homeland, US negotiators plan to press for reductions in follow-on talks.

zh: 虽然布什和奥巴马政府都宣称美俄双方已经不再是敌人，但双边关系的回暖似乎并没有结束彼此之间的核对峙态势。
en: Despite the claims by both the Bush and Obama administrations that Russia and the US are no longer adversaries, it seems that the rapprochement has not translated into elimination of mutual nuclear targeting.

zh: 这一结果，即便新条约获得批准，也无法令任何人满意。
en: The result, even if new START is ratified, should satisfy no one.

zh: 实现欧洲防卫宏图的时间之窗
en: A Window of Opportunity for European Defense

zh: 发自马德里 — — 随着欧洲各国预算的逐渐收紧，人们对欧洲防务状况的担忧也与日俱增。
en: MADRID – With budgets exceptionally tight in Europe nowadays, worries about European defense have been growing.

zh: 但出人意料的是，各国在2010年所取得的进展却为未来带来了希望的曙光。
en: Paradoxically, however, developments in 2010 offer hope for the future.

zh: 英法两国于今年11月签署的防卫协议由两部分条约组成，内容涵盖了两国常规武装力量的联合部署，核威慑方面的合作，以及改进装备和沟通机制。
en: The defense agreement signed in November by France and the United Kingdom is composed of two treaties, which cover joint deployment of their armed forces, nuclear deterrence, and improved equipment and communications.

zh: 两国领袖都对这一创举予以坚定支持，而协议也高度体现了双方携手应对共同威胁的决心。
en: This initiative has the firm political backing of both countries’ leaders, and expresses a clear determination to unite against common threats.

zh: 倘若条约能被正确执行下去的话，这将为整个欧盟提供一个成功的范例。
en: Implemented correctly, these treaties could become a hopeful precedent for the entire European Union.

zh: 通过跨越国家之间的严格界限，条约为欧洲防务指明了未来的道路，还会影响欧洲与美国及北约关系的发展进程。
en: By transcending strictly national limits, these treaties chart the future path of European defense and will help determine the course of Europe’s relations with the United States and NATO.

zh: 如果要更好地阐明这些条约的意义，那就必须先回溯它们所产生的背景。
en: To better judge the treaties’ worth, we must remember the context in which they were conceived.

zh: 1998年，法国总统雅克·希拉克和英国首相托尼·布莱尔共同发表了《圣马洛宣言 》 ， 表达了两国增强欧盟安全和防卫能力的决心。
en: In 1998, the Saint Malo Declaration by French President Jacques Chirac and British Prime Minister Tony Blair indicated both countries’ determination to reinforce the EU’s security and defense capabilities.

zh: 英国人原本不怎么愿意接受一个拥有独立军事力量的欧洲，但科索沃事件使他们意识到欧盟必须拥有这么一支力量以便迅速有效地对危机做出反应。
en: Originally reluctant to accept a Europe with autonomous military capacity, the United Kingdom had learned from the intervention in Kosovo that the EU must be able to respond to crises rapidly and efficiently.

zh: 《圣马洛宣言》显示出欧盟各大军事强国正准备独立发展其防卫政策，即便该政策还未能完全脱离北约而存在。
en: The Saint Malo Declaration signaled that the EU’s leading military powers were prepared to develop their own defense policy, though one not fully autonomous of NATO.

zh: 事实上，在允许利用北约资源执行欧洲安全与防卫政策（European Defense and Security Policy，ESDP）任务的《柏林补充协议》签订之后，北约已经承认了ESDP在历经几十年发展后的最终成形。
en: Indeed, through the Berlin Plus agreements, which facilitate use of NATO resources for missions undertaken under the European Defense and Security Policy (ESDP), NATO recognized the ESDP’s maturation over the past decade.

zh: 欧盟目前已经在欧亚非三个大洲执行了24个性质，范围和目标各不相同的任务，并实现了军事和民间手段的结合使用。
en: Indeed, the EU has undertaken 24 missions in Europe, Africa, and Asia, differing in nature, scope, and aims, and combining military and civilian means.

zh: 在如今的逆境之下，欧盟依然要执行众多复杂的任务。
en: Today, the EU is being asked to conduct complex missions in adverse circumstances.

zh: 为实现这一点，它必须从过去的成功中吸取经验。
en: In doing so, Europe must draw on the lessons of its past successes.

zh: 防卫任务必须具有更强的适应能力，更快的反应速度，更多的国家间合作，而使用的手段也必须更加丰富立体。
en: We Europeans need to respond favorably, quickly, and effectively. Defense missions must be more adaptable, prompt, multinational, and multi-instrumental.

zh: 无论当地安全形势如何，或者冲突的本质是什么，任务的重点都必须放在稳定与安全之上。
en: They must be focused on stability and security, regardless of the security situation or the nature of the conflict.

zh: 但欧洲防务目前只能在恶劣的财政状况下挣扎求存。
en: Yet it is clear that European defense is now struggling mightily with public financing.

zh: 此外最新的欧洲民意调查也显示：防卫是人们最不重视的一项事务。
en: Moreover, the latest Eurobarometer poll shows that defense is the last thing that Europeans are worried about.

zh: 而这也是英法协议为何如此重要的原因。
en: It is precisely here that the Franco-British agreement becomes vitally important.

zh: 经济危机、财政巩固政策、大规模防御手段升级、国家间依存度不断提高以及全球威胁（从恐怖主义、核扩散、气候变化，资源缺乏以及流行病）都不可能由各国独自应对，在此背景下，欧洲领导人尝试利用该协议在实际行动和理想之间实现某种平衡。
en: The treaties mark an attempt to balance action and ambition in a context of economic crisis, fiscal consolidation, large-scale defense transformations, increasing interdependencies, and global threats – from terrorism and nuclear proliferation to climate change, resource scarcity, and epidemics – that are impossible to tackle unilaterally.

zh: 对英国来说，这同样也是树立了一个范例，好让未来的首相能进一步推动这一进程。
en: It also sets a precedent for the UK, preparing the way for future prime ministers to make advances in this direction.

zh: 增强两国的军事实力实际上也是间接增强了欧盟的军事实力，条约所暗含的对协同和效率的要求将成为欧洲防务局（European Defense Agency）背后的驱动力。
en: Reinforcing both countries’ military capacities indirectly reinforces those of the EU. The quest for synergies and efficiency that is implied by the agreement could well become a driving force for the European Defense Agency.

zh: 当前英国人可能认为防务局是个虚耗国防支出的累赘，但如果能更好地定位其职能的话，它将成为每个欧盟国家节省国防经费的源头。
en: The British may now consider the EDA a defense expenditure, but, when better defined, it could represent a source of savings for every EU country.

zh: 此外，协议也预示着在网络安全、恐怖主义，卫星通信和航海安全方面的合作，而这几个方面也是《里斯本条约》的关键内容。
en: Moreover, the agreements foresee cooperation on cyber-security, terrorism, satellite communications, and maritime security, which are also key elements of the Lisbon Treaty.

zh: 与此同时，依据条约所设立��联合派遣部队将最终催生一个更宏大的架构，因为他们已经将“与北约、欧盟，联合国或者其他行动之间的多边合作”考虑在内了。
en: Likewise, the joint expeditionary forces established under the treaties could lead to the eventual creation of a wider structure, as they already contemplate “bilateral cooperation with NATO, the European Union, the United Nations, or other operations.”

zh: 围绕着某些政治目标的团结一致已成为我们这个时代的迫切问题。
en: Solidarity and agreement on political objectives are the pressing concerns of our age.

zh: 而英法新协议将成为迈向合理安排国防支出而非解除欧洲武装的历史性步骤。
en: The new pact between France and the UK could be a historic step toward rationalizing defense spending rather than toward demilitarizing Europe.

zh: 须知最终的走向将由我们选择的路线所决定。
en: It all depends on the path chosen.

zh: 在金融危机之下，各欧盟成员国已不再可能增加国防开支。
en: In times of financial crisis, EU member states are unlikely to increase defense spending.

zh: 但如果法国和英国能意识到自身武装力量的投送能力的大小将关系到整个欧洲，如果它们都能从合作中获益并将其扩展到其他欧洲国家（依照条约所包含的模式 ） ， 我们将最终看到一个足以承担国际社会所赋予的防卫角色的欧盟。
en: But if France and the UK understand how much their projection of power is linked to that of Europe, if they make cooperation reciprocal and expand it to other European countries – according to the formula foreseen in the treaties – we could eventually see an EU with the ability to assume the defense role expected of it by the global community.

zh: 通过推进更高效率和更深入合作，经济危机这类坏事也能催生出好的结果。
en: By forcing greater efficiency and collaboration, misfortune can yield benefit.

zh: 这条道路也可以减少美国对欧洲国防预算缩水的担忧。
en: This path can also ease US concerns about lower European defense spending.

zh: 英法协议并不影响两国对北约的承诺，须知作为美国的一项核心利益，任何驻外欧洲部队的削减都不可避免地意味着美国更沉重的财政负担。
en: The Franco-British treaties do not address commitments to NATO, a key US interest, because any reduction in the number of European troops deployed abroad inevitably implies a greater economic burden for the US.

zh: 但英法协议显示出欧洲在联合军事行动（无论是在欧洲内部还是全球范围）方面的进步，这将对美国产生鼓舞作用。
en: The Franco-British agreement does, however, imply progress toward joint European military action, both in Europe and on the international scene, which will encourage the US.

zh: 而这一创举来自于欧洲两大重要军事强国（两国军费开支占全欧军费总额的一半 ） ， 更何况两国还都是联合国安理会常任理事国。
en: So will the fact that the initiative comes from Europe’s two major military powers (whose combined defense spending represents half of the Continent’s total), both of which have permanent seats on the UN Security Council.

zh: 所有这一切都是跨大西洋国家集团持续转型过程的其中一部分：由一系列专为防御某个已知入侵者设计的组织，转向应对某些更加灵活机动的威胁。
en: All of this is part of the transatlantic community’s continuing transformation from a set of organizations designed to defend territory against a known aggressor to something more flexible and dynamic.

zh: 建立联合管理机制和削减常规防卫力量将成为两大长期挑战：在功能上颠覆了传统防卫组织以国家为组成元素的构成机制；而在政治上则必须对某些国家主权做出让渡。
en: Establishing joint management and overhauling conventional defense capacities will be a two-pronged challenge: functional, owing to the traditional schema of defense organizations, and political, inasmuch as a cession of state sovereignty will be required.

zh: 另一个同样重要的挑战则是北约与俄罗斯之间的合作，双方于今年11月的北约里斯本峰会上同意在导弹防御系统上展开合作。
en: Another, equally important challenge is cooperation between NATO and Russia, which agreed at NATO’s Lisbon summit in November to collaborate on the Alliance’s anti-missile defenses.

zh: 这个关系必须建立在双方互助互利，以及对某些共同的治理和不干涉理念的尊重之上。
en: This relationship must be based on cooperation that benefits both sides, and that respects certain common principals of governance and non-interference.

zh: 但合作和分享将有助于双方应对新形式的冲突。
en: But coordinating and sharing capacities can help both partners deal with the new nature of conflicts.

zh: 在这方面欧盟可以锻炼自己的领导能力，因为这个政治进程才刚刚开始。
en: Here, the EU can exercise leadership, for this is a political process that has only just begun.

zh: 正如英国首相戴维·卡梅隆对于法国协议的评价 ： “ 这一切是某种新生事物的开端，而非为了协议而协议 ” — —此番言论其实也是欧元缔造者之一的让·莫内当年对西欧合作的评价类似，莫内当时说 ： “ 我们不是为了拥有欧元而创设欧元，而是通往一个更有秩序，不再步向毁灭的世界的开端。
en: As British Prime Minister David Cameron said of the agreement with France: “This is the beginning of something new, not an end in itself” – words that echo those of Jean Monet, one of the Union’s founding fathers, on cooperation in the West. “This is not an end in itself,” Monet said.
“It is the beginning of the path toward a more ordered world that we must attain if we want to escape destruction.”

zh: 2010年签订的英法协议是2011年及未来的一个希望之象：实现更高程度欧洲安全的这条道路虽然艰辛，但却是非常必要的，而协议本身则是在这条道路上迈出的坚实一步。
en: The Franco-British agreement in 2010 was one hopeful sign for 2011 and beyond: a step along the arduous but necessary path toward greater European security.

zh: 新世界需要新世行
en: A World Bank for a New World

zh: 纽约—世界正站在十字路口。
en: NEW YORK – The world is at a crossroads.

zh: 国际社会要么团结起来，共同应对贫困、资源耗尽和气候变化，要么下一代将面临资源战争、政治动荡和环境崩溃。
en: Either the global community will join together to fight poverty, resource depletion, and climate change, or it will face a generation of resource wars, political instability, and environmental ruin.

zh: 世界银行如果能够担当起合适的领导角色，将能在消除这些威胁及其隐含风险方面起到关键作用。
en: The World Bank, if properly led, can play a key role in averting these threats and the risks that they imply.

zh: 因此，世界银行的187各成员国今春如何选择将于7月卸任的罗伯特·佐利克的新行长，将事关全球重大利益。
en: The global stakes are thus very high this spring as the Bank’s 187 member countries choose a new president to succeed Robert Zoellick, whose term ends in July.

zh: 世界银行成立于1944年，初衷是促进经济发展，如今，基本上所有国家都已成为它的成员。
en: The World Bank was established in 1944 to promote economic development, and virtually every country is now a member.

zh: 其核心任务是消除世界贫困以及确保环境友好、社会普惠的全球发展。
en: Its central mission is to reduce global poverty and ensure that global development is environmentally sound and socially inclusive.

zh: 实现这些目标不仅能够改善数十亿人民的生活，还能将因贫困、饥荒和争夺稀缺资源而引发的暴力冲突扼杀于未萌。
en: Achieving these goals would not only improve the lives of billions of people, but would also forestall violent conflicts that are stoked by poverty, famine, and struggles over scarce resources.

zh: 美国官员习惯于将世界银行视为美国外交政策和商业利益的延伸。
en: American officials have traditionally viewed the World Bank as an extension of United States foreign policy and commercial interests.

zh: 世行坐落于华盛顿宾夕法尼亚大道，与白宫只隔着两个街区，因此美国人一直主导着这个机构也就不足为奇了。
en: With the Bank just two blocks away from the White House on Pennsylvania Avenue, it has been all too easy for the US to dominate the institution.

zh: 如今，不少成员国 — — 包括巴西、中国、印度和数个非洲国家 — — 正在发声支持合议领导以及改善世行战略使之适用于所有成员国。
en: Now many members, including Brazil, China, India, and several African countries, are raising their voices in support of more collegial leadership and an improved strategy that works for all.

zh: 自世行成立至今，一直有一条不成文的规矩：行长人选由美国政府决定。 成立至今的11位行长均是美国人，而且没有一位是世行核心责任 — — 经济发展方面的专家，也没有一位拥有扶贫或促进环境可持续性的职业经验。
en: From the Bank’s establishment until today, the unwritten rule has been that the US government simply designates each new president: all 11 have been Americans, and not a single one has been an expert in economic development, the Bank’s core responsibility, or had a career in fighting poverty or promoting environmental sustainability.

zh: 相反，美国总是选择华尔街银行家和政客来担任这一职务，大概是为了保证世行政策能够符合美国商业和政治利益吧。
en: Instead, the US has selected Wall Street bankers and politicians, presumably to ensure that the Bank’s policies are suitably friendly to US commercial and political interests.

zh: 但这一政策却令美国弄巧成拙，也严重地伤害了全世界。
en: Yet the policy is backfiring on the US and badly hurting the world.

zh: 由于世行最高层长期缺乏战略上的专业知识和技能，因此该行一直没有明确的方向。
en: Because of a long-standing lack of strategic expertise at the top, the Bank has lacked a clear direction.

zh: 许多项目与其说是为了可持续发展，不如说是为了迎合美国公司的利益。
en: Many projects have catered to US corporate interests rather than to sustainable development.

zh: 世行弄砸了大量的发展项目，解决的全球问题却少之又少。
en: The Bank has cut a lot of ribbons on development projects, but has solved far too few global problems.

zh: 长久以来，在世行的领导下，许多完全不适合最贫困过家及其中的最贫困人口的美国式概念被强加于他们头上。
en: For too long, the Bank’s leadership has imposed US concepts that are often utterly inappropriate for the poorest countries and their poorest people.

zh: 比如，世行完全没能处理好20世纪90年代艾滋病、结核病和疟疾的大爆发，没能给予疾病暴发、数百万生命危在旦夕的国家足够的帮助。
en: For example, the Bank completely fumbled the exploding pandemics of AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria during the 1990’s, failing to get help to where it was needed to curb these outbreaks and save millions of lives.

zh: 更糟糕的是，世行主张采取使用者付费和“覆盖成本”的医疗服务，这导致穷国的最贫困人口 — — 最需要服务的人群 — — 根本无法获得赖以救命的医疗服务。
en: Even worse, the Bank advocated user fees and “cost recovery” for health services, thereby putting life-saving health care beyond the reach of the poorest of the poor – precisely those most in need of it.

zh: 2000年，在德班艾滋病峰会上，我建议成立新的“全球基金”来对抗这些疾病，而我之所以如此建议，正是因为世行的不作为。
en: In 2000, at the Durban AIDS Summit, I recommended a new “Global Fund” to fight these diseases, precisely on the grounds that the World Bank was not doing its job.

zh: 全球艾滋病、结核病和疟疾对抗基金（Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria）成立了，并挽救了数百万的生命，光是在非洲，疟疾致死率就至少降低30 % 。
en: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, TB, and Malaria emerged, and has since saved millions of lives, with malaria deaths in Africa alone falling by at least 30%.

zh: 类似地，世行错失了在非洲、亚洲和拉美贫困农村地区支持自耕小农、普及促进农村综合发展的关键机会。
en: The Bank similarly missed crucial opportunities to support smallholder subsistence farmers and to promote integrated rural development more generally in impoverished rural communities in Africa, Asia, and Latin America.

zh: 从1985年到2005年的近20年时间里，世行一直拒绝使用已被证明效果良好的定向小地主支持项目以帮助贫困自耕农提高产量、走出贫困。
en: For around 20 years, roughly from 1985 to 2005, the Bank resisted the well-proven use of targeted support for small landholders to enable impoverished subsistence farmers to improve yields and break out of poverty.

zh: 而在最近，世行已增加了其对小农的支持，但距离它所能做到也应该做到的还差得很远。
en: More recently, the Bank has increased its support for smallholders, but there is still far more that it can and should do.

zh: 世行的工作人员是高度职业化的，只要摆脱狭隘的美国利益和视角的束缚，他们能够取得更大的成就。
en: The Bank’s staff is highly professional, and would accomplish much more if freed from the dominance of narrow US interests and viewpoints.

zh: 世行具有成为催化决定世界未来的关键领域进步的潜力。
en: The Bank has the potential to be a catalyst of progress in key areas that will shape the world’s future.

zh: 其优先项目应该包括农业生产率、为可持续发展动员信息技术、开发低碳能源体系以及促进有教无类式的平等教育（更多地依靠新型通讯手段让数以百万计的原本得不到优质教育的学生获得优质教育来实现 ） 。
en: Its priorities should include agricultural productivity; mobilization of information technologies for sustainable development; deployment of low-carbon energy systems; and quality education for all, with greater reliance on new forms of communication to reach hundreds of millions of under-served students.

zh: 世行的行动目前涉及到所有这些领域，但没有在其中任何一个起到实质上的领导作用。
en: The Bank’s activities currently touch on all of these areas, but it fails to lead effectively on any of them.

zh: 尽管其工作人员想到那个优秀，但世行缺乏战略眼光，也不够灵活，无法担起变革代理人的责任。
en: Despite the excellence of its staff, the Bank has not been strategic or agile enough to be an effective agent of change.

zh: 让世行做该做的事需要艰苦的努力，要求其最高层具有专家知识和技能。
en: Getting the Bank’s role right will be hard work, requiring expertise at the top.

zh: 最重要的是，世行的新行长应该具有应对发展挑战方面的第一首职业经验。
en: Most importantly, the Bank’s new president should have first-hand professional experience regarding the range of pressing development challenges.

zh: 世界不应该甘于现状。
en: The world should not accept the status quo.

zh: 地球需要创造性的解决方案来应对复杂的发展挑战，又一位来自华尔街或美国政坛的世行行长将是对地球的重大打击。
en: A World Bank leader who once again comes from Wall Street or from US politics would be a heavy blow for a planet in need of creative solutions to complex development challenges.

zh: 世行需要一位成就卓著的专业人士，他从上任的第一天起就必须做好应对可持续发展的重大挑战的准备。
en: The Bank needs an accomplished professional who is ready to tackle the great challenges of sustainable development from day one.

zh: 趋同的世界
en: A World of Convergence

zh: 华盛顿—从大约1800年开始，近两个世界以来，全球经济大体上是一部平均收入逐渐分化的历史。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – For almost two centuries, starting around 1800, the history of the global economy was broadly one of divergence in average incomes.

zh: 从相对值看，发达国家越来越富。
en: In relative terms, rich countries got even richer.

zh: 穷国也有经济增长，但比不上发达国家，发达国家和贫困国家之间的繁荣差距越拉越大。
en: There was growth in the poorer countries, too, but it was slower than rich-country growth, and the discrepancy in prosperity between rich and poor countries increased.

zh: “分化”在殖民地时代便已十分显著。
en: This “divergence” was very pronounced in colonial times.

zh: 20世纪40年代以后，分化之势有所放缓，但直到1990年前后，新的趋势才开始浮现 — — 即发达国家的平均收入和世界其他部分开始趋同。
en: It slowed after the 1940’s, but it was only around 1990 that an entirely new trend could be observed – convergence between average incomes in the group of rich countries and the rest of the world.

zh: 从1990年到2010年，新兴和发展中国家平均人均收入比欧洲、北美和日本增长快出两倍，而在此前近两个世纪中，一直是后者胜出或打成平手。
en: From 1990 to 2010, average per capita income in the emerging and developing countries grew almost three times as fast as average income in Europe, North America, and Japan, compared to lower or, at most, equal growth rates for almost two centuries.

zh: 这是一个革命性的变化，但这20年来的趋势会持续下去吗？
en: This has been a revolutionary change, but will this 20-year-old trend continue?

zh: 趋同会保持现在的快进趋势，还是会成为世界经济史上被翻过去的一页？
en: Will convergence remain rapid, or will it be a passing phase in world economic history?

zh: 基于短期趋势的长期预测通常是错误的。
en: Long-term projections based on short-term trends have often been mistaken.

zh: 在20世纪50年代末，苏联发射了第一艘宇宙飞船后，西方经济学名家纷纷预测苏联收入在几十年内就能超过美国。
en: In the late 1950’s, after the Soviet Union launched the first spacecraft, eminent Western economists predicted that Soviet income would overtake that of the United States in a few decades.

zh: 毕竟，苏联将其GDP的近40%用于投资，这一比例是西方的两倍。
en: After all, the Soviet Union was investing close to 40% of its GDP, twice the ratio in the West.

zh: 接着，在20世纪80年代，日本强劲的增长让一些人预测它将超过美国 — — 不仅是人均水平，也包括某些衡量“经济实力”的指标。
en: Later, in the 1980’s, Japan’s spectacular growth led some to predict that it would overtake the US, not only in per capita terms, but even in terms of some measures of “economic power.”

zh: 这类预测通常基于简单的指数趋势外推。
en: These kinds of projections have often been based on simple extrapolations of exponential trends.

zh: 在20或30年的时界上，复合增长率的重大差异能很快造成经济规模和人均收入上的巨大变化。
en: Over two or three decades, substantial differences in compound growth rates quickly generate huge changes in economic size or per capita income.

zh: 当前全球快速持续趋同的预测也会想往常那样以失败告终吗？ 还是说，大部分新兴国家会持续大幅为正的增长差，从而极大地接近发达经济体的收入水平？
en: Will the recent predictions of rapid ongoing global convergence similarly turn out to be wrong, or will most of the emerging countries sustain a large positive growth differential and get much closer to the advanced economies’ income levels?

zh: 理解“赶超”增长现象是回答这一问题的关键。
en: Understanding the phenomenon of “catch-up” growth is key to answering this question.

zh: 贸易和外国直接投资使得新兴市场更易吸收和适应发达经济体所发明的实用技术。
en: Trade and foreign direct investment have made it much easier for emerging countries to absorb and adapt best-practice technology invented in the advanced economies.

zh: 信息革命使得知识的获得和扩散变得更加容易，从而加速了这一过程。
en: The information revolution, allowing much easier access to and diffusion of knowledge, has accelerated the process.

zh: 一旦它们发展出市场经济所需要的基本制度、学会如何避免严重宏观经济政策失误，新兴国家就开始从赶超增长中获益。
en: Once they developed the basic institutions needed for a market economy and learned how to avoid serious macroeconomic policy mistakes, emerging countries started benefiting from catch-up growth.

zh: 投资率极高的国家（大多在亚洲）获得了比投资率较低的国家更快的增长；但是，总体而言，赶超增长使得许多新兴和发展中国家年增长率提高了2—4个百分点。
en: Those with very high investment rates, mostly in East Asia, grew faster than those with lower investment rates; but, overall, catch-up growth probably has been adding 2-4 percentage points to many emerging and developing countries’ annual growth rates.

zh: 与此同时，人口增长在下降，从而进一步推高了人均增长速度。
en: At the same time, population growth decreased, adding at least another point to the pace of per capita growth.

zh: 这一过程可能还会持续一二十年，取决于具体国家的具体状况。
en: This process will likely continue for another decade or two, depending on where in the process particular countries are.

zh: 哈佛大学的丹尼·罗德里克（Dani Rodrik）最近正确地指出，相比其他部门，赶超增长在制造业更容易实现，而新兴国家的某些表现卓著的企业可能已经用尽了赶超增长在制造业的潜力。
en: It is true that catch-up growth is easier in manufacturing than in other sectors, a point recently emphasized by Dani Rodrik of Harvard University, and it may be that a good portion of it has been exhausted in manufacturing by the best-performing firms in emerging countries.

zh: 但随着效率较低的国内企业对高效企业的竞争力有所提高，还有大量“内部”空间可用于赶超增长。
en: But there is still a lot of “internal” room for catch-up growth, as less efficient domestic firms become more competitive with more efficient ones.

zh: 新兴国家内部的“全要素生产率 ” — —即资本和劳动的联合生产率 — — 的分散度很大。
en: The dispersion of “total factor productivity” – the joint productivity of capital and labor – inside emerging countries has been found to be large.

zh: 此外，农业、能源、运���和贸易等部门也具有赶超增长潜力，可以通过进技术口、制度诀窍和组织模式实现。
en: Moreover, sectors such as agriculture, energy, transport, and trade also have catch-up-growth potential, through imports of technology, institutional know-how, and organizational models.

zh: 当然，暂时性的动荡、全球收支失衡恶化以及宏观经济政策失误（包括哪些源自发达经济体但影响到全世界经济的失误）可能会破坏全球增长。
en: Of course, temporary disturbances, a worsening of global payments imbalances, or macroeconomic policy mistakes, including those made in advanced economies and affecting the entire world economy, could undermine global growth.

zh: 但赶超增长所带来的基本的“趋同差”可能将继续减少老牌发达经济体和新兴市场国家间的收入差距。
en: But the underlying “convergence differential,” owing to catch-up growth, is likely to continue to reduce the income gap between the old advanced economies and emerging-market countries.

zh: 苏联一直没有能够建立能实现赶超增长的制度。
en: The Soviet Union never was able to build the institutions to allow for catch-up economic growth.

zh: 日本在基本实现赶超后速度就慢了下来。
en: Japan slowed down after it had basically caught up.

zh: 中国、印度、巴西、土耳其和其他国家可能会有经营水平接近世界技术前沿的企业，但它们仍拥有大量待开发赶超潜力。
en: China, India, Brazil, Turkey, and others may have firms operating close to the world’s technological frontier, but they still have a lot of unused catch-up potential.

zh: 这些国家在确保宏观经济稳定和收支平衡可持续的基础上投资得越多，它们适应新技术和新生产程序就越快。
en: The more that these countries can invest while ensuring macroeconomic stability and balance-of-payments sustainability, the faster they can adopt better technology and production processes.

zh: 这样，它们就能继续赶超，至少在未来十年二十年内是如此。
en: In that case, they can continue to catch up, at least for the next decade or more.

zh: 趋同过程迟早会放缓，但还不是现在。
en: The convergence process is going to slow, but not yet.

zh: 区域化的世界
en: A World of Regions

zh: 发自纽约 — — 在世界上几乎每一处地方，那些长期存在的顽固问题都可以通过邻近国家之间的紧密合作而得以解决。
en: NEW YORK – In almost every part of the world, long-festering problems can be solved through closer cooperation among neighboring countries.

zh: 在这方面欧盟堪称最佳范例，证明那些历史上斗争不断的国家是可以联合起来实现共同利益的。
en: The European Union provides the best model for how neighbors that have long fought each other can come together for mutual benefit.

zh: 而讽刺的是，如今美国全球实力的衰退则会引发更多富有成效的区域合作。
en: Ironically, today’s decline in American global power may lead to more effective regional cooperation.

zh: 在希腊、西班牙，葡萄牙和爱尔兰经济危机的背景下去夸奖欧盟似乎有点不合时宜。
en: This may seem an odd time to praise the EU, given the economic crises in Greece, Spain, Portugal, and Ireland.

zh: 实际上欧洲也依然未能成功平衡在那些北欧强势经济体和南部弱势经济体之间的利益。
en: Europe has not solved the problem of balancing the interests of strong economies in the North and those of weaker economies in the South.

zh: 但相比当前所面临的困难，欧盟所取得的成显然更加意义重大。
en: Still, the EU’s accomplishments vastly outweigh its current difficulties.

zh: 欧盟成功在一个曾经反复被战争蹂躏的区域内创造了和平，同时也为东欧和西欧的重新联合提供了制度框架，还推动了区域内部的基础设施建设。
en: The EU has created a zone of peace where once there was relentless war. It has provided the institutional framework for reuniting Western and Eastern Europe.

zh: 内部的单一市场对欧盟得以成为全球最繁荣区域至关重要，而在环境可持续发展方面欧盟在世界上也扮演着领导角色。
en: The single market has been crucial to making Europe one of the most prosperous places on the planet. And the EU has been a global leader on environmental sustainability.

zh: 因此欧洲也为那些依旧在冲突、贫困，基础设施缺乏和环境危机中挣扎的区域提供了一个独特的范例。
en: For these reasons, the EU provides a unique model for other regions that remain stuck in a mire of conflict, poverty, lack of infrastructure, and environmental crisis.

zh: 新的区域性组织，比如非洲联盟，将欧盟视为解决区域性问题以及国家间整合的榜样。
en: New regional organizations, such as the African Union, look to the EU as a role model for regional problem-solving and integration.

zh: 但时至今日，大多数区域性组织依然太过弱势，无法解决其成员国所面对的紧迫问题。
en: Yet, to this day, most regional groupings remain too weak to solve their members’ pressing problems.

zh: 在其他大部分区域，现有的政治分歧往往来自于冷战或者是殖民时期，当时各国之间通过“站队”的方式来互相竞争 — — 就是宣称自己属于苏联阵营或者美国阵营。
en: In most other regions, ongoing political divisions have their roots in the Cold War or the colonial era. During the Cold War, neighbors often competed with each other by “choosing sides” – allying themselves with either the United States or the Soviet Union.  Pakistan tilted towards the Americans; India towards the Soviets.

zh: 巴基斯坦站在苏联一边，印度则于美国为伍。 只要能享受到苏联或者美国的财政援助，各国就缺乏动力去和邻国握手言和。
en: Countries had little incentive to make peace with their neighbors as long as they enjoyed the financial support of the US or the USSR.

zh: 相反，卷入长期冲突的国家还能受到更多资助。
en: On the contrary, continued conflict often led directly to more financial aid.

zh: 其实当年美国和欧洲还经常阻挠区域整合，因为这会影响他们作为权力调停者的角色。
en: Indeed, the US and Europe often acted to undermine regional integration, which they believed would limit their roles as power brokers.

zh: 因此当埃及前总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔在1950年代开始呼吁阿拉伯国家联合时，美欧都将其视为威胁。 美国害怕自己从此失去对中东的影响力，于是暗中破坏纳赛尔实现阿拉伯国家紧密合作和鼓动民族主义的努力。
en: Thus, when Gamal Abdel Nasser launched a call for Arab unity in the 1950’s, the US and Europe viewed him as a threat.  The US undercut his call for strong Arab cooperation and nationalism, fearing a loss of American influence in the Middle East.

zh: 于是纳赛尔逐渐向苏联靠拢，最终也无法实现阿拉伯国家整体利益的整合。
en: As a result, Nasser increasingly aligned Egypt with the Soviet Union, and ultimately failed in the quest to unite Arab interests.

zh: 而如今的现实则是这些强国已经无力（尽管依然想方设法）去分裂和征服其他区域了。
en: Today’s reality, however, is that great powers can no longer divide and conquer other regions, even if they try.

zh: 殖民时代已成往事，现在美国作为全球霸主的时代也正渐行渐远。
en: The age of colonialism is finished, and we are now moving beyond the age of US global dominance.

zh: 最近在中东和中亚地区发生的事件则明显反映出美国影响力的衰退。
en: Recent events in the Middle East and Central Asia, for example, clearly reflect the decline of US influence.

zh: 美国无法通过在伊拉克和阿富汗用兵来获取任何长期地缘政治优势的事实暴露了其全球实力的局限性，而预算危机又迫使其在短期内削减军事资源。
en: America’s failure to win any lasting geopolitical advantage through the use of military force in Iraq and Afghanistan underscore the limits of its power, while its budget crisis ensures that it will cut its military resources sooner rather than later.

zh: 同样，美国在中东政治革命中也未能发挥任何作用，至今都未能对该事件作出任何明确的政治回应。
en: Similarly, the US played no role in the political revolutions underway in the Arab world, and still has not demonstrated any clear policy response to them.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马最近针对中东的讲话则进一步反映了美国影响力减弱的事实。
en: President Barack Obama’s recent speech on the Middle East is a further display of America’s declining influence in the region.

zh: 讲话大部分内容都是呼吁以色列退回到1967年边界，但其效果在遭到以色列断然回绝后大打折扣。
en: The speech drew the most attention for calling on Israel to return to its 1967 borders, but the effect was undercut when Israel flatly rejected the US position.

zh: 全世界都将发现美国将不会实施任何后续动作。
en: The world could see that there would be little practical follow-up.

zh: 而公众关注更少的讲话余下部分更有说服力。
en: The rest of the speech was even more revealing, though it drew little public notice.

zh: 当奥巴马说到阿拉伯政治剧变时，他提到了经济发展的重要性。
en: When Obama discussed the Arab political upheavals, he noted the importance of economic development.

zh: 但当轮到美国出手的时候，美国最大限度仅能减免埃及一亿美元债务，提供一亿美元贷款担保以及对私人投资的更多保险保障。
en: Yet when it came to US action, the most that the US could offer financially was slight debt relief for Egypt ($1 billion), scant loan guarantees ($1 billion), and some insurance coverage for private investments.

zh: 其中传达的真实信息就是美国政府在该区域经济复苏方面只能提供极少的经济援助。
en: The real message was that the US government would contribute very little financially to the region’s economic recovery.

zh: 可见那些国家依靠大规模美援的时代也一去不返了。
en: The days when a country could depend on large-scale American financing are over.

zh: 简而言之，我们正在进入一个多极世界。
en: We are, in short, moving to a multi-polar world.

zh: 冷战的结束并未引发美国全球统治力的上涨，反而将这股力量分散到了各个区域。 东亚、南亚，拉美和中东都分别获得了新的地缘政治和经济影响力。
en: The Cold War’s end has not led to greater US dominance, but rather to the dissemination of global power to many regions.  East Asia, South Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East have new geopolitical and economic influence.

zh: 各个区域也将逐渐找到了实现自身经济发展，能源和食品安全，以及基础设施建设的路径，也必须在这个面临着气候变化和能源短缺威胁的世界上立刻着手整合。
en: Each region, increasingly, must find its own path to economic development, energy and food security, and effective infrastructure, and must do so in a world threatened by climate change and resource scarcity.

zh: 因此每个区域都必须确保自身的未来发展。
en: Each region, therefore, will have to secure its own future.

zh: 当然，这也应该在区域间合作以及区域内合作的背景下实现。
en: Of course, this should occur in a context of cooperation across regions as well as within them.

zh: 对此中东地区在扶助自身方面拥有巨大优势。
en: The Middle East is in a strong position to help itself.

zh: 埃及和其他富裕产油国之间存在着高度的经济互补。
en: There is a high degree of economic complementarity between Egypt and the oil-rich Gulf States.

zh: 埃及能为阿拉伯地区提供技科技，人力以及大量的专业技能，而海湾国家则提供能源和资金还有某些领域的专业人士。
en: Egypt can supply technology, manpower, and considerable expertise for the Arab region, while the Gulf provides energy and finance, as well as some specialists.

zh: 长期搁置的阿拉伯经济整合前景也应该被重新摆在谈判桌上。
en: The long-delayed vision of Arab economic unity should be returned to the table.

zh: 以色列也应该意识到自身的长治久安和繁荣只能在成为一个经济繁荣区域的一部分后才能得到加强。
en: Israel, too, should recognize that its long-term security and prosperity will be enhanced as part of an economically stronger region.

zh: 为了确保其国家利益，以色列必须与其邻国达成协议。
en: For the sake of its own national interests, Israel must come to terms with its neighbors.

zh: 其他区域也将发现美国实力的衰退增加了各邻国进行更紧密合作的紧迫性。
en: Other regions also will find that the decline of US power increases the urgency of stronger cooperation between neighbors.

zh: 某些世界上最紧张的对立关系 — — 比如印度和巴基斯坦，朝鲜和韩国 — — 都应该被作为区域强化的一部份而得到解决。
en: Some of the greatest tensions in the world – say India and Pakistan, or North and South Korea – should be defused as part of region-wide strengthening.

zh: 正如欧盟所体现的那样，只要一个区域能把目光面向未来着手处理其长远需要，而不是倒退到长期存在的对立和冲突，历史上的敌意和战线是可以转化为互利合作的。
en: As the EU shows, ancient enmities and battle lines can be turned into mutually beneficial cooperation if a region looks forward, to resolving its long-term needs, rather than backward, to its long-standing rivalries and conflicts.

zh: 一个充满烦恼的世界
en: A World of Trouble

zh: 那么在你看来，今年已经够糟的了。
en: So you thought this year was bad!

zh: 2009年的大幕，是在加沙城毁于炮火这一序曲中拉开的。
en: 2009 began with the flattening of Gaza.

zh: 现在尽管我们已能觉察到经济从衰退走向复苏的第一丝信号，但不少国家的失业率却正在快速攀升；与此同时，许多银行家却仿佛什么事情也没有发生过那样，又开始重操旧业；贪婪之心只不过曾被一时收起而已。
en: Unemployment is surging in many countries, even though we can detect the first signs of recovery from the recession. Many bankers, meanwhile, are back to the trough as though nothing had happened.

zh: 巴基斯坦在塔利班的凶猛攻势面前深受重创；北约士兵则在阿富汗伤亡惨重；而中东地区所谓“和平进程”只是矛盾修饰法在国际关系中的一大应用这一点，也变得更加清晰了。
en: Pakistan is hit hard by a wave of monstrous Taleban attacks, and in Afghanistan NATO troops die and are terribly injured in large numbers. The “Peace Process” in the Middle East becomes ever more clearly the great oxymoron in international relations.

zh: 为将于哥本哈根举行的气候变化大会所进行的准备工作，正被彼此间的唇枪舌战所主导，甚至连被人们期望能带来奇迹的巴拉克·奥巴马总统，也被证明只不过是一个颇具才干的凡人而已；在他或许能使来年变得更好的期待中，奥巴马获得了诺贝尔和平奖；接下来，他肯定有的忙了。
en: Preparations for the climate change conference in Copenhagen are dominated by charges and recriminations. Even President Barack Obama, of whom miracles were expected, turns out to be no more than a very talented mortal.

zh: 2010年，是将会出现V型或W型的经济复苏，还是将会在萎靡中滑向好日子遥遥无期的境地呢？
en: Will 2010 see a recovery shaped like a “V” or a “W,” or will there simply be an anemic tilt towards a very distant prospect of better times?

zh: 我怀疑后一种情况将成为现实，因为在欧洲大部分地区以及美国，失业问题和公共开支的削减将使经济方面的信心难以得到提振；而这又会导致解决全球失衡这一政治任务变得愈加棘手。
en: I suspect the latter, with unemployment and cuts in public spending – certainly in much of Europe and the United States – constraining economic confidence. That will make the politics of dealing with global imbalances all the more difficult.

zh: 让我们先来弄清正在发生的一切。
en: Let’s be clear about what is happening.

zh: 人民币被人为低估以及美元的贬值，给欧盟成员国以及加拿大和墨西哥等其他国家的出口前景蒙上了阴影；而中国或明或暗的出口补贴与进口壁垒，更令情况雪上加霜。
en: The deliberate undervaluation of China’s currency, and the fall in the dollar, are both putting a squeeze on the export prospects of the European Union members and other countries like Canada and Mexico, and China’s covert and not so covert export subsidies and import barriers exacerbate the problem.

zh: 可能是由于其大量借款的需求（其中有许多便借自中国 ） ， 美国的怒火被抑于胸中。
en: American exasperation has probably been curbed by its need to borrow so much money – much of it from China.

zh: 不过奥巴马近期对轮胎进口加征关税之举，或许是一个情况将发生变化的信号。
en: But Obama’s recent tariffs on tire imports may be a sign of things to come.

zh: 对于我们这些身处欧美、却为中国的经济成功感到欣喜、并支持自由贸易的人士而言，中国的行为将会给我们带来不断增大的政治压力；较弱的经济体也将感受到这份紧张。
en: Chinese behavior will put increasing political pressure on those of us in Europe and the US who are delighted about China’s economic success and who argue for free trade. Weaker economies will also feel the pinch.

zh: 我希望中国精明的经济管理者们能够明白：中国必须改变其做法，如若不能，则世界或将面临巨大的贸易冲突以及全球商业的混乱景象。
en: I hope that China’s sophisticated economic managers understand that either their country’s behavior will have to change, or we are likely to face a massive trade conflict and disruption of global commerce.

zh: 即便是自由贸易者，也将在2010年逐渐失去耐心。
en: The patience even of free traders will wear thin in 2010.

zh: 就应对气候变化之短期成本所进行的争吵，并不会令各国继续讨价还价变得更为简单。
en: Rows about the short-term costs of dealing with climate change won’t make it any easier to keep markets open.

zh: 但现在若无所作为，只会在未来的某一时刻、使我们为受到延误的行动付出更高的代价。
en: But failure to act now will only raise the price of delayed action at some moment in the future.

zh: 尽管哥本哈根峰会原本最有希望实现的成果（一份限制碳排放的全球协定 ） ， 目前已几乎无望成为现实；但其次优结果（关于具体措施的谈判将在普遍善意之框架内继续进行）也并不很糟。
en: While the most hopeful outcome of the Copenhagen summit – a global pact limiting carbon emissions – has now been all but ruled out, the second-best outcome – negotiations on specific measures continue within a framework of general goodwill – would not be a disaster.

zh: 若连后一种情况也无法实现的话，那么情况就非常糟糕了。
en: Anything short of that would be very bad news.

zh: 在这两种更为乐观的情景之中，将会出现这样一种结果：巨额资金被发达国家（实际或假定地）转移给新兴国家或发展中国家，以对后者在减少排放及保护环境方面的开支提供部分补偿。
en: In either of these two more optimistic scenarios, one consequence will be the transfer – actual or putative – of considerable sums of money from developed to emerging or developing countries to cover some of their costs for emissions abatement and environmental protection.

zh: 现在就让我们设想一下，发达民主国家的立法者在必须就为何一方面中国被人为低估的货币正使发达国家的选民失去工作、另一方面这些国家却将数以十亿计的美金与欧元交给中国作出解释时，所将面对的难题吧。
en: Now just imagine the problems that legislators in developed democracies will face when they must explain why billions of dollars and euros should be handed over to China, whose deliberately undervalued currency is costing their constituents their jobs.

zh: 奥巴马对于实质性核裁军的承诺，为2010年核不扩散条约审议大会带来了福音。
en: Obama’s commitment to substantial nuclear disarmament bodes well for the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty Renewal Conference in 2010.

zh: 不过纵使大会取得了进展，朝鲜与伊朗核武器研发威胁所带来的问题却依然存在。
en: But, even with progress there, the problems created by the threat of nuclear weapons development in North Korea and Iran will remain.

zh: 美欧与伊朗的外交接触受人欢迎；但若外交接触无法令伊朗就不将核能用于军事目的作出承诺，或无法使伊朗同意就此承诺的履行状况接受严格监督的话，情况又会变成什么样呢？
en: American and European diplomatic engagement with Iran is welcome. But what happens if this brings either no Iranian commitment to refrain from weaponizing nuclear power, or no acceptance of tough monitoring of such a pledge?

zh: 如果外交努力失败，中俄两国看起来不太可能为针对伊朗的进一步制裁提供支持。
en: China and Russia seem unlikely to support any further sanctions against Iran if diplomacy fails.

zh: 中国与伊朗的能源关系正愈发紧密，而俄国继续将尽力在一切可能的地区制造麻烦视为其国际使命。
en: China’s energy relationship with Iran grows ever stronger, and Russia continues to see its mission internationally as making trouble wherever it can.

zh: 以上仅仅是2010年可能正在等着我们的巨大麻烦之冰山一角，还有很多问题没有谈到，比如以色列在西岸的定居点建设问题、巴基斯坦对抗嗜杀成性的极端分子的斗争、以及北约为支撑起一个声名狼藉、且腐化成风的阿富汗政权（此举旨在防止阿富汗重新落入塔利班与基地组织之手）所需面对的血腥困难等等。
en: This is just a little of what 2010 perhaps has in store – and no mention yet of Israeli settlement building on the West Bank, Pakistan’s struggle against murderous extremists, and NATO’s bloody difficulties in propping up a discredited and corrupt Afghan regime in order to prevent the country from falling back into the hands of the Taliban and Al-Qaeda.

zh: 然而无论前景多么黯淡，我们蹒跚前行的脚步却不能停下 — — 因为鸟语花香、清风拂树之景如常，笑容也依旧会绽放在孩子们的脸上。
en: Still, however gloomy the outlook, we do stagger on – the flowers still bloom, the breeze stirs the trees, the birds sing, and children laugh.

zh: 当奥巴马担起重负之时，其他人尽可享受生活。
en: The rest of us can enjoy life while Obama does the heavy lifting.

zh: 具有纪念意义和不确定性的一年
en: A Year of Anniversaries and Uncertainties

zh: 阿尔伯塔 — — 随着中国迈入“牛年 ” ， 我们要思考过去12个月中的许多问题，即将到来的一年则有更多的问题需要深思熟虑。
en: ALBERTA – As China enters the “Year of the Ox,” there is much to reflect on from the past 12 months and even more to speculate about regarding the coming year.

zh: 2008年伊始的破坏性暴风雪致使中国中南部多数交通系统陷入瘫痪、人们的生活陷入中断并导致了严重的物质损失。
en: 2008 began with devastating snowstorms that paralyzed most of central and southern China’s transport system, interrupting lives and causing severe material damage.

zh: 接下来在政府猝不及防的时刻爆发了西藏叛乱，而后若干西方和亚洲国家又在中国的奥运火炬传递仪式上演出了令人尴尬的抗议问题。
en: Then came the riots in Tibet, which caught the government off guard, followed by embarrassing protests over China’s Olympic torch relay in several Western and Asian countries.

zh: 而后，正当中国人奇怪2008年这个以幸运数字8结尾的人们眼中的幸运年份为什么一开始就会发生一连串的不幸，致命的地震又在四川省发生，这次地震夺去了80，000人的生命，致使数百万人无家可归。
en: Then, as Chinese were wondering why 2008, a year of supposed good fortune marked by the lucky number eight, had started with so much misfortune, a deadly earthquake struck Sichuan province, killing 80,000 people and leaving millions homeless.

zh: 这次悲剧让中国人更加团结一心，中国在期盼已久的奥运上欢迎世界各国的人民，奥运会取得了令人赞叹的成功，但很快却又被乳制品的污染丑闻所取代，这次乳制品污染事件导致许多婴儿生病，甚至夺去了一些婴儿的生命。
en: Emerging more united from this tragedy, the country welcomed the world to the long-anticipated Olympics, which were remarkably successful, but were soon superseded by the tainted-dairy-product scandal in which many babies became ill, and some died.

zh: 去年那次反常的暴风雪阻断了人们回家庆祝农历新年的旅程，而今年则恰恰相反，数以百万计的离乡民工已经回到了他们在农村的家中。
en: In contrast to last year, when the rush home for the lunar New Year celebration was hampered by freak storms, this year millions of migrant workers have already returned to their rural homes.

zh: 许多人将会留在家里，因为全球经济放缓给中国造成了沉重的打击，致使他们失去了工作。
en: Many will be staying there, because the global economic downturn has hit China hard, costing them their jobs.

zh: 夹杂着一系列极为敏感的纪念日，2009年可能会被事实证明比2008年更难预测，也更富戏剧性。
en: Littered with a host of extremely sensitive anniversaries, 2009 could prove even more dramatic and unpredictable than 2008.

zh: 很快到来的不仅是去年西藏三月动乱的纪念日，西藏1959年动乱的50周年纪念日也紧随其后，达赖喇嘛及其支持者在那次动乱以后开始了国外流亡生活。
en: Fast approaching is not only the March anniversary of last year’s disturbances in Tibet, but also the 50th anniversary of the Tibetan unrest in 1959 that led to the exile of the Dalai Lama and his supporters.

zh: 去年春天的暴乱以后，中国政府已经采取了许多积极的措施，甚至设立了一个“农奴解放日 ” ， 以捍卫过去50年中其在西藏的记录，并继续与达赖喇嘛的代表进行谈判。
en: Since the riots last spring, China’s government has taken many pro-active measures, even adopting a “Serf Liberation Day,” to defend its record in Tibet of the past 50 years, while continuing to talk with the Dalai Lama’s representatives.

zh: 与此同时中国政府也实行了严厉的政策和军事控制。
en: But it has also implemented heavy-handed police and military controls.

zh: 接下来是天安门广场镇压六四学生示威活动的20周年纪念日。
en: Then comes the 20th anniversary of the June 4 crackdown on the Tiananmen Square student demonstrations.

zh: 胡锦涛主席和温家宝总理7年前就职时，就开始听到重新评价官方应对措施的呼吁。
en: Calls to re-evaluate the official response began when President Hu Jintao and Premier Wen Jiabao came to power seven years ago.

zh: 但最近这种压力有所增大，特别是在“08宪章”发表之后，这是一份由数百名中国学者、记者、律师和普通公民签署的宣言，谴责政府的人权记录并要求实行更多的民主改革、言论自由、政府透明和社会开放的政策。
en: But recently the pressure has intensified, especially with the publication of “Charter 08,” a manifesto signed by hundreds of Chinese intellectuals, journalists, lawyers, and ordinary citizens, condemning the government’s human rights record and demanding more democratic reform, press freedom, governmental transparency, and societal openness.

zh: 尽管胡温都没有直接参与镇压行动，但他们也必须在处理问题时保持谨慎。
en: Although neither Hu nor Wen were directly involved in the crackdown, they nonetheless must tread carefully.

zh: 尽一切力量避免1989年的一幕重演很可能是共产党领导层在2009年的首要任务。
en: Doing everything possible to avoid a repeat of the 1989 scenario may well be the Communist Party leadership’s top priority in 2009.

zh: 同时，由于经济放缓、收入差距拉大、失业率升高和腐败引起的民怨加大，中国领导人将面临着严峻的任务。
en: And, given the economic slowdown, widening income disparity, rising unemployment, and growing popular discontent over corruption, China’s leaders will have their hands full.

zh: 当然，中国几乎一切政治改革运动的灵感都来自于1919年的五四运动，当时的中国学生抗议腐败虚弱的政府，呼吁追求两个关键的西方理想：民主和科学，从而增强自己的实力。
en: Of course, the inspiration for almost every political reform movement in China is the May 4th Movement of 1919, when Chinese students protested against a weak and corrupt government and called for China to strengthen itself by adopting two key Western ideals: democracy and science.

zh: 在纪念五四运动九十周年之际，中国在科学领域已经取得了长足的进步，但在民主领域却还有很长的路要走。
en: As the 90th anniversary approaches, China has made great strides in science, but still has a long way to go in terms of democracy.

zh: 今年也是大跃进50周年，有2000－4000万中国人在大跃进中饿死。 还有政府取缔法轮功10周年，这个自封的宗教和冥想组织挑战了共产党的合法性。
en: This year also marks the 50th anniversary of the Great Leap Forward, when 20-40 million Chinese died of starvation, as well as the tenth anniversary of the government’s ban on Falun gong, an organization of self-claimed religious and meditation practitioners that has challenged the Communist Party’s legitimacy.

zh: 尽管在国内基本上已经声名狼藉，这个好战组织仍然在世界各地有一批追随者，而且可能以意想不到的形式在任何时候爆发进一步的抗议活动。
en: Though largely discredited inside the country, this militant movement still has a following around the world, and further protests may come at any time and in unpredictable forms.

zh: 尽管中国领导人必须面对的诸多纪念日中有些可能会威胁到稳定，但也有几个纪念日能为政府所用。
en: While some of the plethora of anniversaries that China’s leaders must confront are potentially very destabilizing, several have, and will, work in their favor.

zh: 比如，今年1月就举行了中国改革开放30周年纪念日和中美建交纪念日的大规模庆祝活动。
en: For example, the 30th anniversary of China’s reform movement and the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the United States has been a much-celebrated event this January.

zh: 更为重要的是，10月将迎来中华人民共和国成立60周年，党会举办盛大的活动来纪念这一时刻。
en: More importantly, October will mark the 60th anniversary of the founding of the Peoples’ Republic of China, an occasion that the Party will commemorate in grand style.

zh: 归根结底，中国已经作为世界第三大经济体（不久前刚刚取代了德国的位置）重新崛起、成功地将宇航员送入了太空、向非洲之角派遣了先进的海军驱逐舰、并且成为持有美国外债最多的债主。
en: After all, the Middle Kingdom has re-emerged as the world’s third-largest economy (having recently replaced Germany), sent astronauts into space, dispatched advanced naval destroyers to the Horn of Africa, and become the largest holder of US foreign debt.

zh: 中国将要展示自己的力量，同时向全世界宣告党给中国民众带来了好处，实现了国家的强大与繁荣。
en: China will want to flex its muscles and proclaim to the world that the Party has delivered the goods to its people, while making the country strong and prosperous.

zh: 随着从20世纪30年代以来最严重经济衰退的深入，美国和中国的经济肯定会遇到更多的难题。
en: As the worst recession since the1930’s continues, both the American and Chinese economies are bound to suffer further setbacks.

zh: 我们无法确保美国的保护主义和仇外情绪不会影响到中美关系，也无法确保经济下行不会在中国引发新的动荡。
en: There is no guarantee that protectionist and xenophobic sentiment in America will not hit China-US relations, or that the economic downturn will not fuel new unrest in China.

zh: 但世界不该错误地估计这些麻烦在中国产生的效果。
en: The world should not misjudge the effect of such troubles on China.

zh: 人们也不该忘记西方在抗议奥运火炬接力时中国民族主义情绪的强烈展示、四川地震时席卷中国的非同寻常的爱国主义浪潮，以及奥运会向外界展示的中国的民族自豪感。
en: Nor should it forget China’s fierce display of nationalism in response to Western protests of the Olympic touch relay, the extraordinary patriotism that swept the country in response to the Sichuan earthquake, and the national pride evinced by the Olympic Games.

zh: 可是，在2009年，中国领导人如果关注继续向世界兑现其“和平崛起”承诺的必要性，并大胆解决今年一系列纪念日将进一步凸显的悬而未决的问题，将不会给国家的发展带来任何坏处。
en: But, in 2009, it would not hurt if China’s leadership also took note of the need to continue assuring the world of its commitment to a “peaceful rise,” and to do so by boldly addressing some of the unresolved issues that this year’s anniversaries will highlight.

zh: 中美纷争的一年？
en: A Year of US-China Discord?

zh: 发自纽约 — — 就在2009年 ， 《 福布斯》杂志把美国总统奥巴马和中国国家主席胡锦涛并列为“世界最有权势的人 ” 。
en: NEW YORK – In 2009, Forbes magazine named US President Barack Obama and Chinese President Hu Jintao the “world’s most powerful people.”

zh: 然而到了2010年，我们会发现这两位都无法将中美关系维持在一个正常的轨道上。
en: In 2010, we will discover that neither has the power to keep US-Chinese relations on track.

zh: 这对于那些将中美合作视为重振全球经济，迎接气候变化挑战，遏制核扩散威胁，以及跨国合作应对各类难题所必不可少的前提的人来说，这是个坏消息。
en: That is bad news for those who believe that US-China cooperation is essential for reviving the global economy, meeting the challenge of climate change, containing threats of nuclear proliferation, and managing a host of other problems without borders.

zh: 而与此同时，这对中美两国来说，也是一个坏消息。
en: It is also bad news for America and China.

zh: 10是个值得关注的数字：美国10%的失业率和中国10%的潜在GDP增长注定了两国要发生摩擦，正如不同气候相遇会产生风暴一样。
en: Ten is the number to watch: America's 10% unemployment and China’s potential 10% GDP growth are set to collide like weather fronts generating a storm.

zh: 美国的民粹主义将与中国的傲慢态度直接碰撞，而由美国中期大选所营造的狂热政治气氛则意味着，世界上最重要的双边关系将在今年走向真正的动荡。
en: American populism will meet Chinese pride. And the fevered political climate created by US mid-term elections means that the world’s most important bilateral relationship is headed for real turbulence this year.

zh: 中美双方目前无疑正处于一种相互毁灭的经济关系之下，而双方领导人对此也都心知肚明。
en: America and China now live with a kind of mutually assured economic destruction, and both presidents know it.

zh: 美国需要中国为其巨额债务融资，而中国则需要美国人购买“中国制造 ” 。
en: The US needs China to finance its mounting debt, and China needs Americans to buy its products.

zh: 事实上，中国受到来自金融危机的短暂而又猛烈的冲击证明了一点，那就是该国的经济增长仍然依赖来自美国，欧洲和日本的消费需求 — — 而且这种态势还将持续一段时间。
en: Indeed, the short, sharp shock that China absorbed from the financial crisis has proven that its economic growth still depends on consumer demand in America, Europe, and Japan – and will for some time to come.

zh: 中国领导人期望能把中国的经济增长模式更多地向内需方面转化，但这是一个长期的工程。
en: Chinese leaders would like to shift China’s growth model toward greater reliance on domestic consumption, but that is a long-term project.

zh: 在可预见的未来，他们将依靠国内生产者来创造就业，以维护其发展目标以及共产党对国内政权的垄断。
en: For the foreseeable future, they will depend on local manufacturers to create the jobs that protect both China’s development goals and the Communist Party’s monopoly on domestic political power.

zh: 出于对工厂倒闭和降薪的忧虑，去年，中国政府启动了大规模的刺激计划以保证就业和经济增长的恢复。
en: Fear of shuttered factories and lost wages pushed China’s government last year to launch a massive stimulus program to protect jobs and restore growth.

zh: 这套计划很奏效，由于跟西方相比中国国内银行的有毒资产较少，当美国刚刚才从危机中直起腰来来的时候，中国已经再次上路了。
en: It worked. China, with much less exposure than the West to toxic banking assets, is off to the races again as America struggles to its feet.

zh: 对此在最近一次的佩尤民调中，有44%的美国受访者认为中国是“世界经济的领导者 ” 。
en: In a recent Pew Poll, 44% of US respondents named China as “the world’s leading economic power.”

zh: 只有27%的受访者仍坚持认为领导者是美国。
en: Just 27% chose America.

zh: 可以肯定，美国经济毫无疑问会最终复原，但就业增长的恢复通常都要耗费更长的时间。
en: To be sure, an eventual US recovery is inevitable, but job growth usually takes longer to recover.

zh: 只要选民对他们的收入���到忧虑，民主党和共和党就必将争相捍卫美国工人的利益。
en: As long as voters are worried about their wallets, Democrats and Republicans will compete to defend American workers.

zh: 随着11月大选的临近，许多美国立法者都会要求这个失业率达到10%的国家去劝服那个经济增长10%的国家，好让后者停止扭曲贸易规则和操纵货币币值。
en: As November’s elections approach, many US lawmakers will demand that the country with 10% unemployment persuade the country with 10% growth to stop bending trade rules and manipulating the value of its currency.

zh: 而在中国领导人这方面，他们会好奇为什么身处华盛顿的自由市场领导者会威胁要颁布更多的保护主义政策。
en: China’s leadership, for its part, will want to know why free-market champions in Washington are threatening more protectionism.

zh: 那是因为随着中国经济增长的加速，贸易失衡将增加美国的挫折感，加上选举临近，美国两大政党的立法者都会在各个议题上威胁对中国采取惩罚性行动。
en: For, as China’s growth accelerates, trade imbalances heighten US frustrations, and elections loom, lawmakers of both US political parties will threaten punitive action against China on a variety of subjects.

zh: 但尽管奥巴马政府已经对中国出口的轮胎和钢管采取抵制行动，今年的冲突还是会远远超出贸易的范畴。
en: The Obama administration has already moved against Chinese exports of tires and steel pipes, but this year’s confrontation will extend well beyond trade.

zh: 比如当美国国会就气候变化问题展开辩论，其中一些立法者呼吁建立一个温室气体总量限制和排放交易系统时，那么另一些立法者就要问，为什么在中国声言拒绝的同时美国却要接受一个有约束力的承诺方案呢？
en: When Congress takes up the debate over climate change, for example, and some lawmakers call for a cap-and-trade system, others will demand to know why America should accept binding commitments to limit emissions while the Chinese refuse.

zh: 不过中国的领导人可没有心情扮演替罪羊，他们将利用国内民众膨胀的自尊来支撑其在谈判中的地位并增加谈判筹码。
en: China’s leaders, in no mood to play the scapegoat, will use surging national pride to bolster their position and strengthen their hand in negotiations.

zh: 近年以来，中国政府大量投资于国有企业以及国内排名前列的私有企业，其目的主要是想在确保中国能从市场力量中获利的同时领导阶层也能捞到尽可能多的好处。
en: The Chinese government has invested heavily in recent years in state-owned companies and privately-owned “national champions,” mainly to ensure that China profits from the power of markets while the leadership controls as much of the spoils as possible.

zh: 为了扶持这些国有强势集团增加其市场权重，政府通常以牺牲外国竞争对手为代价来支持他们，而美国恶意的言辞和贸易行动将给中国领导人提供扩大这种趋势的口实。
en: To help these domestic powerhouses increase their market leverage, the government often favors them at the expense of foreign competitors. Hostile US rhetoric and trade action will give China’s leaders an excuse to accelerate this trend.

zh: 奥巴马政府也希望中国能承担更多世界领导者的责任。
en: The Obama administration also wants China to share more of the burdens of international leadership.

zh: 这包括了协助美国向诸如伊朗，苏丹和缅甸这类中国国有企业已经在当地建立了利润可观的商业联系的，为中国政府的经济和政治利益服务，同时又不断藐视国际社会意志的国家施加压力。
en: This includes helping the US to apply pressure on countries like Iran, Sudan, and Myanmar that continue to defy the will of the international community – and with which those Chinese state-owned companies have established lucrative commercial relationships that serve the Chinese government’s economic and political interests.

zh: 而中国的领导人也不愿意在任何会损害其国内发展目标的议题上做出屈服，故而将继续采取抵制的态度。
en: China’s leaders, unwilling to compromise on any issue that might undermine their domestic goals, continue to resist.

zh: 全面的贸易战看来不大可能爆发，因为两国政府都深知其中蕴含的风险对各自经济来说都太大了，所以，奥巴马和胡锦涛将继续努力使事态向建设性的方向上发展。
en: A full-scale trade war is unlikely. Both governments know the stakes are too high for both economies, and Obama and Hu will continue to work hard to try to keep things moving in a constructive direction.

zh: 但双方的领导人都无法保证在此过程中就不会出现指责和批评。
en: But neither president can guarantee that recrimination and reproach will not take on a life of its own.

zh: 比如说，如果中国出口产品的安全问题再次出现在美国报刊头条的话，那么民众的情绪可能很快就会从失望发展到彻底愤怒。
en: For example, if another product-safety issue involving Chinese imports makes headlines in the US, things could move quickly from disappointment to real anger.

zh: 虽然大部分美国人都不关心中国的货币政策或者其对保护知识产权的立场，但如果中国制造的产品威胁到了他们的健康和安全，那么可以肯定，必定会有善于投机的立法者准备好出来煽风点火了。
en: Most Americans care little about China's currency policy or its stance on intellectual property rights. But if Chinese-made products threaten their health and safety, there are sure to be opportunistic lawmakers ready to fan the flames.

zh: 因此，2008年的美国大选将会是最后一场绝大部分美国选民既不了解也不关心候选人对中国的立场的选举。
en: The 2008 US presidential election was the last in which the overwhelming majority of American voters neither knew nor cared about where the candidates stood on China.

zh: 而对美国批评越来越敏感的北京官员也将证明自己已经准备好跟对方在贸易指控上你来我往，就像两国从前互相交易商品和服务或好点子那样。
en: Officials in Beijing, increasingly sensitive to US criticism, will prove as ready to trade accusations as goods and services or good ideas.

zh: 这也是为什么两位“世界最有权势的人”现在更加难以合作来应对当今最棘手挑战的原因。
en: That is why the “world’s most powerful people” will now have a much harder time working together to meet today’s toughest challenges.

zh: 规范共享经济
en: Disciplining the Sharing Economy

zh: 新加坡—人们通过在线平台直接交换商品、服务和劳动的恩呢管理越来越强，这改变了现代经济的运转方式。
en: SINGAPORE – The increasing ability of people to exchange goods, services, and labor directly, via online platforms, is transforming how modern economies operate.

zh: 但为了保证“共享经济”的崛起有效进行并能够改善所有各方的境况，需要一些监管来约束它。
en: But to ensure that the rise of the “sharing economy” works efficiently and improves conditions for all parties, some regulation is needed.

zh: 如今，人们可以绕过许多传统服务企业。
en: People can now circumvent many traditional service businesses.

zh: 人们可以使用Uber、 Lyft或 RelayRides共享交通工具；通过Airbnb提供住宿；通过TaskRabbit、 Fiverr或 Mechanical Turk提供家政服务；使用Favor 和 Instacart安排送货上门。
en: They can share transport, using Uber, Lyft, or RelayRides; provide accommodation through Airbnb; tender household chores via TaskRabbit, Fiverr, or Mechanical Turk; and arrange their grocery deliveries using Favor and Instacart.

zh: 类似地，Kickstarter和 Lending Club等众筹平台让创业企业得以从普罗大众手中筹集援助金、贷款或投资，而不需要依靠金融中介。
en: Similarly, crowdfunding platforms, such as Kickstarter and Lending Club, allow start-ups to raise grants, loans, or investment from the general population, rather than relying on a financial intermediary.

zh: 这些在线平台绕过了中介，让个人大展身手，降低了交易成本，创造了更加包容的经济。
en: By cutting out the middleman, these online platforms empower individuals, reduce transaction costs, and create a more inclusive economy.

zh: 但它们的演变绝不是直来直去的，要想繁荣，这类服务中有许多需要小心监管 — — 欧洲针对Uber的示威和不利裁决就是明证。
en: But their evolution is far from straightforward, and many such services will require careful regulation if they are to flourish – as protests and court rulings in Europe against Uber demonstrate.

zh: Uber和其他共享经济先锋为何如此具有破坏力？ 一个原因是代表着一种效率极高的点对点资本主义形式。
en: One reason why Uber and other sharing-economy pioneers are so disruptive is that they represent a highly efficient form of peer-to-peer capitalism.

zh: 买家和卖家可以就每笔交易直接商谈价格，商业声誉取决于透明的客户反馈，这带来了持续不断的改善表现的压力。
en: Buyers and sellers can agree directly on the price of every transaction, and business reputations depend on transparent customer feedback, generating continuous pressure to improve performance.

zh: 共享经济还刺激了企业家精神，不断有人发现新的填补市场空白的方式。
en: The sharing economy also boosts entrepreneurship, as people see new ways to fill gaps in the market.

zh: 起出只不过是让家庭提高收入的简单方法 — — 让你出租公寓或汽车 — — 后来演变为可怕的破坏力量。
en: What began as a simple way for households to boost incomes – by renting out one’s apartment or car – has become a formidable disruptive force.

zh: 《福布斯》杂志估计，2013年共享经济总收入在35亿美元以上。
en: Forbes magazine estimates that the sharing economy’s 2013 revenues topped $3.5 billion.

zh: 2014年世界杯期间，10万多人通过住房共享网站在饭店房间长期短缺的巴西找到了住宿场所。
en: During the 2014 soccer World Cup in Brazil, a country with a chronic shortage of hotel rooms, more than 100,000 people used home-sharing Web sites to find accommodation.

zh: 买卖机会也变得更加包容：一半的Airbnb美国房东处于中低收入水平，而全球90%的房东出租的是他们的主宅。
en: The opportunity to buy or sell has also become much more inclusive: half of Airbnb hosts in the United States have low to moderate incomes, and 90% of hosts globally rent their primary residence.

zh: 不少城市已认识到促进共享经济所带来的好处。
en: Several cities have recognized the benefits to be gained from promoting a sharing economy.

zh: 比如，西雅图减少了交通和饭店业的管制，这对该市出租车和饭店垄断商构成了挑战。
en: Seattle, for example, has deregulated its transportation and hospitality sectors, challenging the city’s taxi and hotel monopolies.

zh: 但如此程度的经济变化难免会招致反对者，其中一些是出于法律担忧。
en: But economic change of this magnitude inevitably has its opponents, some with legitimate concerns.

zh: 不用纳税的点对点商业是否会因此削弱现有商家？
en: Do peer-to-peer businesses undercut incumbents by not paying similar taxes?

zh: 点对点商家 — — 风险资本的宠儿 — — 是否在亏本运营争夺市场份额？
en: Are such businesses – flush with venture capital – running their operations at a loss in order to capture market share?

zh: 是否应该允许这些企业获得通信数据研究客户习惯和动作，从而获得不公平的优势？
en: And should these firms be allowed to access telecoms data to learn about customers’ habits and movements, thus giving them an unfair advantage?

zh: 一些企业已经设定了自己的业务标准。
en: Some firms have set their own operating standards.

zh: 组装宜家家具等家政职位的转包商TaskRabbit要求参与者支付最低工资，并成立了保险制度以保护美国工人。
en: TaskRabbit, which subcontracts household jobs like assembling Ikea furniture, requires participants to pay a minimum wage, and has launched an insurance scheme to protect its US workers.

zh: 另一方面，使用“算法调度”将工人的变化和时间与商业周期自动匹配的高科技平台仍在破坏家庭生活，引起不必要的压力。
en: On the other hand, technology platforms that use “algorithmic scheduling” to align workers’ shifts and hours with business cycles automatically, continue to disrupt family life and cause unnecessary stress.

zh: 决策者应该超前于这些共享经济趋势。
en: Policymakers need to stay ahead of these sharing-economy trends.

zh: 由于服务和软件的趋同，公共官员必须加强技术技能、与私人部门共同保证市场公平和效率。
en: As services and software converge, public officials must enhance their technical skills and work with the private sector to ensure market fairness and efficiency.

zh: 比如，他们必须阻止操纵评价和其他误导试图了解某公司服务质量的消费者的行为。
en: For example, they must prevent the manipulation of reviews and other practices that mislead consumers trying to assess the quality of a company’s service.

zh: Airbnb和在线旅行社Expedia只允许实际使用过服务的客户评价；这有可能成为整个共享经济的监管规范。
en: Airbnb and the online travel agent Expedia allow reviews only by customers who have actually used their services; that could become a regulatory norm throughout the sharing economy.

zh: 政府也可以起到更广的作用。
en: Governments also have a broader role to play.

zh: 随着跟多的人拥有了“职业生涯组合 ” — —依靠多重收入源而不仅仅是一个工作 — — 收集和分析劳动力市场数据变得更加困难。
en: As more people adopt “portfolio careers” – relying on several sources of income, rather than a single job – it becomes harder to collect and analyze labor-market data.

zh: 政府需要新的会计和报告准则来计算工资、预测收入、在归类越来越多各种的自由职业者。
en: Governments will need new accounting and reporting standards to calculate wages, forecast incomes, and categorize workers within the growing ranks of the self-employed.

zh: 这些准则加上数据共享指导原则能有助于确定何时对共享经济交易征税、征多少税。
en: Such standards, coupled with data-sharing guidelines, will help determine when, and how much, to tax sharing-economy transactions.

zh: 所有这些都不容易。
en: None of this will be easy.

zh: 尽管自由职业和兼职劳动并非新鲜事，但共享经济不同，因为它让自由职业者变成了“纳米工人 ” （ nano-worker ） ， 他们改换雇主不是以月乃至于周计算，而是以日计算。
en: Though self-employment and part-time labor are hardly new, the sharing economy is different, because it allows freelancers to become “nano-workers,” shifting among employers not just monthly or even weekly, but several times a day.

zh: 美国和欧洲的失业率仍处于高位，工资也停滞不前，因此人们越来越多地依靠这些多样化收入源。
en: As US and European unemployment rates remain high and wages stagnate, people increasingly rely on such diverse income streams.

zh: 如今，近2,700万美国人靠兼职和临时项目收入过活。
en: Today, almost 27 million Americans survive on part-time and project-based incomes.

zh: 经合组织国家有近一半的服务业岗位面临被自动化的局面，共享经济能够让造成工人失业的破坏平滑发生，使他们能从容更新技能。
en: With nearly half of all services jobs in the OECD at risk of automation, the sharing economy can smooth the disruption caused to displaced workers as they upgrade their skills.

zh: 事实上，共享经济数据有助于政府识别风险最高的工人，为他们提供再培训支持。
en: Indeed, sharing-economy data can help governments identify those workers at greatest risk and support their retraining.

zh: 共享经济反映了企业家精神和技术连通性的趋同。
en: The sharing economy reflects the convergence of entrepreneurialism and technological connectivity.

zh: 出租车司机和饭店所有者也许会感到威胁，但共享经济有可能在陷入贫困和不平等陷阱的城市增加收入、改变收入分配。
en: Taxi drivers and hotel owners may feel threatened, but the sharing economy has the potential to increase and redistribute earnings in cities that are already struggling with poverty and inequality.

zh: 共享经济有望带来更繁荣、更包容的社会，在这样的社会里，失业工人的前景要光明得多。
en: Those who are displaced will have far better prospects in the more prosperous and inclusive environment that the sharing economy promises to create.

zh: 投给欧洲怀疑主义的
en: A "Yes" Vote for Euroskepticism

zh: 很多政府在不久前的欧盟议会选举中遭受重创使它们筹备本周欧盟峰会的工作变得困难重重。
en: The drubbing that many governments suffered in the recent elections to the European Union Parliament places them in a difficult position as they maneuver ahead of this week's EU Summit.

zh: 只有无可救药的乐观主义者才寄希望于峰会给它们带来荣耀。
en: Only an incurable optimist can hope that the summit will bring glory to any of them.

zh: 这次峰会有双重目标：最终确定新的欧盟宪法，和任命下一任委员会主席。
en: The summit has two purposes: to finalize the text of a new EU Constitution, and to appoint the next President of the Commission.

zh: 考虑到几个重要政府对投票抱有顽固的批评立场，以及若干成员国内部抗议和欧洲怀疑主义党派的势力陡增，将要进行的谈判面临着巨大的困难。
en: These negotiations will be much harder in view of the spectacular repudiation of a number of key governments at the ballot box, together with the potent rise of protest and Euroskeptic parties in several member states.

zh: 欧洲领导人面临的问题是：他们在投票中的失败并不一定与欧洲怀疑主义党派的崛起传递的信息相同。
en: The problem for Europe's leaders is that their own repudiation by voters does not necessarily carry the same message as the rise of the Euroskeptic parties.

zh: 德国选举中格哈德·施罗德领导的社民党创记录的一落千丈与它的欧洲政策没多大关系，但却与经济政策的失败和国内长期以来的低增长和高失业率密切相关。
en: The record slump in the vote for Gerhard Schröder's governing Social Democrats in Germany has little to do with his policy towards Europe, but a great deal to do with the perceived failure of his economic policies - and the persistence of low growth and high unemployment - at home.

zh: 尽管国民党在法国取得了胜利，雅克·希拉克总统领导下的中右翼党派的失败也源于此因。
en: Despite nationalist parties' success in France, the same is true of the setback for President Jacques Chirac's centre-right party.

zh: 那里的经济增长强劲，失业率也维持在较低的水平。 导致执政的工党在选举中一败涂地的主要因素是：人们对托尼·布莱尔与乔治·布什在伊拉克并肩作战的决定满怀愤怒。
en: In Britain, by contrast, where the economy is strong and unemployment low, the main factor behind the collapse in the vote for the governing Labor Party has been anger with Tony Blair's determination to go to war in Iraq beside George Bush.

zh: 无论怎样，欧洲怀疑主义党派在英、法、比利时、波兰和捷克共和国崛起的涵义令人忧虑，对以逐步稳定地促进欧洲融合为己任的本届峰会更是如此。
en: Nevertheless, the rise of Euroskeptic parties, in a number of countries including Britain, France, Belgium, Poland, and the Czech Republic, has worrying implications for a summit meeting whose purpose is to take European integration a small but unmistakable step forward.

zh: 特别是在英国，英国独立党（UKIP）蔚为壮观的崛起只能使政府久已隐藏的欧洲怀疑主义暴露出来。
en: In Britain, in particular, the spectacular surge of the UK Independence Party (UKIP) can only strengthen the government's long-standing latent Euroskepticism.

zh: 拟议中的宪法将包含《基本权利宪章 》 ， 旨在提高欧盟政治和道德的合法性。
en: The proposed constitution will contain a Charter of Fundamental Rights, which is intended to enhance the political and moral legitimacy of the EU.

zh: 但《宪章》真的能改善欧盟公民的权利吗？
en: But will it really enhance the rights of EU citizens?

zh: 还是像英国政府强调的那样，沦为一部重复成员国现有法律规定权利的文件声明？
en: Or, as the British government insists, will it merely be a declaratory document that only describes rights already existing under national legislation in the member states.

zh: 宪法草案将通过增强部长理事会的多数票机制和欧洲议会所起的作用，改善欧盟组织的决策能力。
en: The draft constitution would enhance the policymaking powers of the Union, with a bit more majority voting in the Council of Ministers, and a stronger role for the European Parliament.

zh: 但尽管托尼·布莱尔曾经宣布他会把英国变成"欧洲的中心 " ， 但仍然发自内心地反对深层次融合，阻止在税收、外交和欧盟预算等"红线区域"内对英国主权的新一轮侵蚀。
en: But, despite Tony Blair's one-time declaration that he would take Britain "into the heart of Europe," he remains viscerally opposed to the prospect of further integration, and he will resist any new encroachment on British sovereignty in his "red line" areas of tax, foreign policy, and EU budget finance.

zh: 布莱尔的欧洲怀疑主义与英国的总体情绪相互一致，因此很容易被人理解。
en: Blair's Euroskepticism is understandable insofar as it chimes with the British mood.

zh: 民意调查一直显示：英国选民对欧盟缺乏热情，这一点也被欧洲民意调查局随后的调查所证实，最近由15国扩展到25国之前，这次调查在原有15国的范围内广泛进行。
en: Opinion polls consistently show that British voters are unenthusiastic about the EU, and the picture is confirmed by the latest Eurobarometer poll, conducted throughout the Union for the Commission - but before the recent enlargement from 15 to 25 member states.

zh: 上述调查中始终涉及的一个问题是：选民们是否相信像国家议会、国民政府和欧洲联盟这样的政治机构。
en: One question always asked in this poll is whether voters tend to trust or mistrust different institutions, such as national parliaments, national governments, and the European Union.

zh: 总的来讲，对欧盟的信任程度并不算高：只有41%的选民选择信任欧盟，而有42%的人不愿信任它。
en: Overall, the general level of trust in the European Union is not high: only 41% of voters tend to trust the EU, whereas 42% tend not to trust it.

zh: 英国的数字却大不相同：只有19%的被调查者相信欧盟，而55%的人选择了不信任。
en: But in Britain, the figures are dramatically different: only 19% trust the EU, while 55% distrust it.

zh: 相对来讲，欧洲议会从总体上比欧盟更具信誉：欧洲内部对议会的平均信任比率高达54 % ， 即便英国也达到了30 % 。
en: By contrast, the European Parliament has a better reputation than the EU as a whole: the average EU-wide level of trust in the European Parliament is 54%, whereas in Britain it is 30%.

zh: 在欧盟内部，48%的被调查者认为成为欧盟成员是件好事，而在英国，这个数字降到了29 % 。
en: Across the EU, 48% think EU membership is a good thing; in Britain, this figure falls to 29%.

zh: 几乎在所有问题上，英国选民都比其它国家的选民更缺乏热情。
en: On virtually every question, British voters are less enthusiastic about the EU than voters in any other country.

zh: 有人可能认为：英国人讨厌欧盟，可能更支持国内机构。
en: One might think that Britons' aversion to the EU would be reflected in support for, and pride in, their national institutions.

zh: 事实并非如此。
en: Not so.

zh: 英国选民对欧洲议会的信任率可能维持在30 % ， 但对威斯敏斯特议会的信任率可能更低，只有19 % ， 创下了欧盟的最低记录。
en: British trust in the European Parliament may stand at only 30%; but trust in the Westminster Parliament is much lower, at only 19% - the lowest figure in the EU.

zh: 对国家政府的信任率略有升高，但也只达到25 % ， 而对国家政党的信任率只有可怜的10 % 。
en: Trust in the national government is a bit higher, but still only 25%, while trust in national political parties is only 10%.

zh: 这两个数字也创下了欧盟国家的最低记录。
en: Both figures are, again, the lowest in the EU.

zh: 其它国家的选民对欧盟机构更有信心，但对本国机构的信任度也令人忧虑。
en: Voters in other states have more confidence in EU institutions, but their opinion of their own institutions is also low.

zh: 在法国，57%的选民信任欧洲议会，但信任法国议会的只有29 % ， 而德国的两个数字分别为51%和23 % 。
en: In France, 57% trust the European Parliament, but only 29% trust the French parliament; while the corresponding figures for Germany are 51% and 23%.

zh: 但调查结果令人不解的地方是：即便欧洲选民对欧盟及其现存机构缺乏热情，但65%的人支持统一欧洲外交政策，72%的人支持统一国防和安全政策，即便在英国，支持共同防卫政策的比例也有52 % 。
en: But the puzzle in the poll is that, even if Europe's voters are unenthusiastic about the EU and its existing institutions as they stand now, 65% of them would support a common foreign policy for Europe, and 72% would support a common defense and security policy; even in Britain, there is 52% support for the idea of a common defense policy.

zh: 这可能是对美国领导的对伊战争做出的反应，但正因为此托尼·布莱尔一定会投票否决，而统一的欧洲防卫政策如果没有英国的参与会变得毫无意义。
en: This may be a reaction to the American-led war in Iraq; but Tony Blair will exclude it precisely for that reason, and a common European defense policy without Britain makes little sense.

zh: 本周峰会上欧洲领导人的困境是身处欧洲不稳定融合进程的风口浪尖。
en: The predicament for Europe's leaders at this week's summit is that they stand at the cusp of an unstable process of European integration.

zh: 随着10个新成员的最终加入，欧盟要想发挥作用就必须加速融合。
en: With the accession of 10 new members, the EU must become more integrated if it is to function.

zh: 但支持融合进程的政府根本没有把握说服国内倍感失望的选民。
en: But it is not at all clear that those governments that would normally support more integration can sell it to their disillusioned electorates.

zh: 托尼·布莱尔承诺举行欧盟新宪法的全民公决，在全民公决中他根本不可能有获胜的把握。
en: Tony Blair has promised a referendum on the new EU constitution, which he cannot possibly win.

zh: 现在的核心问题是：欧洲领导人是否在飞蛾扑火，保持问题自行消失的不切实际的希望。
en: The central question will be whether Europe's "leaders" deliberately play for failure, in the hope that the problem will go away.

zh: 拉丁美洲的狐狸式领导人
en: Latin America’s Foxy Leaders

zh: 圣地亚哥 — “ 什么样的国家配什么样的领导人 ， ” 法国反革命分子约瑟夫·德梅斯特尔（Joseph de Maistre）嘲讽道。
en: SANTIAGO – “Every country gets the leaders it deserves,” the French counter-revolutionary Joseph de Maistre quipped.

zh: 他错了。
en: He was wrong.

zh: 拉丁美洲口若悬河的煽动家和铁腕将军配不上拉丁美洲国家，但直到最近，他们常常把持着政府职位。
en: The countries of Latin America did not deserve the blustering demagogues and iron-fisted generals who, until recently, often occupied the seats of government.

zh: 委内瑞拉和尼加拉瓜的情况提醒我们，煽动家和民促主义者没有消失。
en: A look at Venezuela or Nicaragua reminds us that the demagogues and the populists are not yet gone.

zh: 但一种新的领导人 — — 他们温和，知书达理，常常采取渐进主义 — — 自20世纪90年代以来取得了优势。
en: But a new kind of leader – moderate, intellectually humble, and prone to gradualism – has been in ascendance since the 1990s.

zh: 这才是真正配得上拉丁美洲的领导力类型。
en: This is the kind of leadership Latin America does indeed deserve.

zh: 这一代务实主义者的老大哥上周逝世了。
en: The elder statesman of this generation of pragmatists died last week.

zh: 在这个领导人喜欢高谈阔论的大洲，20世纪90年代领导智利从独裁走向民主的埃尔文（Patricio Aylwin）是一个异类：他是一位轻声细语的教授，热爱研究更加艰深的行政法。
en: In a continent of loud-mouthed leaders, Patricio Aylwin, who led Chile from dictatorship to democracy in 1990, was an oddity: a soft-spoken professor whose great love was the study of the more abstruse aspects of administrative law.

zh: 他的遗产是一盏明灯，为拉丁美洲温和派领导人指出了想要成功必须怎么做。
en: His legacy sheds light on what moderate leaders in Latin America must do if they are to succeed.

zh: 埃尔文面临着任何新建立的民主国家的领导人所面临的最艰难的道德选择之一：对在皮诺切特将军独裁期间绑架、虐待和杀害成千上万智利人的人的起诉应该进行到何种程度。
en: Aylwin faced one of the toughest moral choices any leader of a newly re-established democracy can confront: how far to push prosecution of those who had abducted, tortured, and killed thousands of Chileans during General Augusto Pinochet’s dictatorship.

zh: 他的答案至今仍有争议。
en: His answer remains controversial to this day.

zh: 他说，他将追求“尽可能大”的正义。
en: He would, he said, pursue justice “to the extent [that it is] possible.”

zh: 乍一看，这一思想令人震惊：难道正义不是绝对的道德使命吗？
en: At first, the idea seems shocking: Isn’t justice supposed to be an absolute moral imperative?

zh: 是的。
en: It is.

zh: 但历史表明这是一个并不总是能够完美实现的使命。
en: But history shows that it is an imperative that cannot always be perfectly achieved.

zh: 实现正义，不管多么不完美，其本身即是一个道德目标。
en: Obtaining justice, however imperfect, is itself a moral goal.

zh: 埃尔文明白这一点，并据此行动。
en: Aylwin understood this, and acted accordingly.

zh: 他所领导的联盟勇敢地接受了皮诺切特的挑战，参与到1988年关于延长其统治的全民公决，排除万难赢得胜利，并在1990年将独裁者赶下台。
en: The coalition he led boldly took up Pinochet’s challenge to participate in a 1988 referendum on extending his rule, won the vote against all odds, and in 1990 removed the dictator from office.

zh: 如果说曾经有独裁者是被有力的笔而不是剑赶下台，智利就是其中之一。
en: If there was ever a case of a dictator going not by the sword, but by the mighty pen, this was it.

zh: 上台执政后，新的民主政府决定，在可以给出惩罚前，应该弄清楚关于侵害人权的全部事实。
en: Once in office, the new democratic government decided that before punishment could be meted out, the whole truth about the violation of human rights should be established.

zh: 智利“真相和协调委员会 ” （ Truth and Reconciliation Commission）成为20世纪90年代南非和全世界其他国家成立的类似机构的榜样。
en: Chile’s “Truth and Reconciliation Commission” became a model for similar bodies established in the 1990s in South Africa and other countries worldwide.

zh: 埃尔文现身电视，与公民分享残酷的事实。
en: Aylwin went on television to share the grim truth with citizens.

zh: 他声音哽咽地代表国家为犯下的罪行致歉。
en: His voice breaking, he apologized on behalf of the state for the crimes committed.

zh: 我这一代智利人回忆起这一时刻无不眼含热泪。
en: The voices of Chileans of my generation still break when we recall that moment.

zh: 法庭尽到了责任。
en: The courts did their job.

zh: 皮诺切特从未进班房，但他的许多爪牙 — — 包括秘密警察头子 — — 被判长期徒刑。
