en: Pinochet never saw the inside of a cell, but many of his henchmen – including the head of his secret police – served long sentences.

zh: 有多少从黑暗极权统治走出的国家（你可以想到俄罗斯、东德、西班牙、葡萄牙或巴西）能做到这一点？
en: How many countries emerging from dark authoritarian rule (one thinks of Russia, East Germany, Spain, Portugal, or Brazil) can claim the same?

zh: 埃尔文的智利的正义尽可能地得到了伸张，但这没什么好嘲笑的。
en: Justice in Aylwin’s Chile was carried out to the extent possible, but it was nothing to scoff at.

zh: 埃尔文属于基督教民主党（Christian Democratic Party ） ， 在智利，该党从旧保守党的废墟的基础上建立。
en: Aylwin belonged to the Christian Democratic Party, which in Chile emerged from the ashes of the old Conservative Party.

zh: 他是一个身体力行的天主教徒。
en: He was a practicing Catholic.

zh: 他不可能喜欢被称为自由派。
en: He would not have liked to be called a liberal.

zh: 但他的治国风格属于哲学家以赛亚·柏林所谓的自由派狐狸（知道很多事 ） ， 而不是柏林所谓的刺猬（知道一样大事 ） 。
en: Yet he governed in the style of the philosopher Isaiah Berlin’s liberal fox, who knows many things, as opposed to Berlin’s hedgehog, who knows one big thing.

zh: 在拉丁美洲和其他地区，民粹主义者永远是刺猬。
en: Populists, in Latin America and elsewhere, are always hedgehogs.

zh: 他们十分教条。
en: They are dogmatic.

zh: 世界必须适应他们的一整套意识形态，而不是反过来。
en: The world has to adapt to their monolithic ideology, not vice versa.

zh: 务实主义、政策实验、渐进学习 — — 这些都不是他们的“菜 ” 。
en: Pragmatism, policy experimentation, gradual learning – this is not their thing.

zh: “当事实改变时，我改变我的思维。
en: “When the facts change, I change my mind.

zh: 您呢，先生？
en: What do you do, sir?”

zh: ”这一据说是凯恩斯所说的俏皮话背后的精神与民粹主义阵营背道而驰，但以埃尔文为缩影的一代拉丁美洲务实主义者并非如此。
en: The spirit behind this famous quip, attributed to John Maynard Keynes, would be alien to the populist camp, but not to the generation of Latin American pragmatists epitomized by Aylwin.

zh: 他是反民粹主义者。
en: He was the anti-populist.

zh: 在经历了17年的右翼极权统治后上台执政，慷慨承诺、大手支出的诱惑是巨大的。
en: Coming to office after 17 years of right-wing authoritarian rule, the temptation to promise handsomely and spend lavishly was enormous.

zh: 但他采取了务实的财政紧缩，带来了智利人的尊严，加上汗水和劳动（但不是血水和泪水 ） 。
en: Instead, he practiced fiscal austerity and offered Chileans dignity, plus sweat and toil (though no blood or tears).

zh: 埃尔文本能地警惕市场，曾经骄傲地宣称从未踏进购物城一步。
en: Aylwin was instinctively wary of markets and once proudly claimed never to have set foot in a shopping mall.

zh: 但是，在成为总统后，他不仅仅保持了智利的自由市场制度；还进行了深化，与诸多国家签署了自由贸易协定。
en: Yet, upon becoming president, he did not simply maintain Chile’s free-market system; he deepened it, signing free-trade agreements with a slew of countries.

zh: 与此同时，他���政府提高了税收，增加了社会支出，在与工会的协议中加强了集体讨价还价。
en: At the same time, his government raised taxes, increased social expenditures, and strengthened collective bargaining in a deal with the unions.

zh: 他是最好的狐狸式领导者。
en: His was foxy leadership at its best.

zh: 结果令人振奋。
en: The results were encouraging.

zh: 自1990年以来，智利人均收入增加了两倍。
en: In the years since 1990, per capita income in Chile has tripled.

zh: 1990年，40%的智利人生活在贫困线以下；今天，这一数字是10%左右。
en: Back then, 40% of Chileans lived below the poverty line; today, the figure is around 10%.

zh: 不平等性没有下降，但与一些批评者所宣称的不同，也没有上升。
en: Inequality has not fallen; but, contrary to what some critics claim, it has not increased either.

zh: 经济学家艾尔伯特·赫希曼（Albert O. Hirschman）也许是过去半个世纪中对拉丁美洲政治观察最深刻的外部人士，他对被他称为“急于求成 ” （ la rage de vouloir conclure，福楼拜语，即某些拉丁美洲领导人热衷于立刻让所有事情都有个结果）持批评态度。
en: The economist Albert O. Hirschman, arguably the most insightful outside observer of Latin American politics in the last half-century, was critical of what he called – borrowing from Flaubert – la rage de vouloir conclure, or the obsession of some Latin American leaders to try to bring everything to an immediate conclusion.

zh: 赫希曼呼吁领导人要“对可能性有激情 ” ， 要耐心地参与“兜售改革 ” 。
en: In its place, Hirschman called for leaders who had a “passion for the possible,” and who would patiently engage in “reform-mongering.”

zh: 埃尔文回应了这一呼吁。
en: Aylwin answered this call.

zh: 巴西的卡多佐（Fernando Henrique Cardoso ） 、 秘鲁的加西亚（Alan García ） 、 墨西哥的赛迪罗（Ernesto Zedillo ） 、 哥伦比亚的桑托斯（Juan Manuel Santos ） 、 智利的拉各斯（Ricardo Lagos）和乌拉圭的桑吉内蒂（Julio María Sanguinetti）亦然。
en: So did Fernando Henrique Cardoso of Brazil, Alan García of Peru, Ernesto Zedillo of Mexico, Juan Manuel Santos of Colombia, Ricardo Lagos of Chile, and Julio María Sanguinetti of Uruguay.

zh: 曾几何时，巴西的卢拉似乎也加入了这一集团。
en: For a while, Brazil’s Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva seemed to be part of the group.

zh: 阿根廷的马克里表现也相当抢眼，但他上台执政才几个月，现在下定论为时尚早。
en: Argentina’s Mauricio Macri is a strong applicant, but after only a few months in office it is too early to tell.

zh: “可能主义 ” （ possibilism）和自满不一样。
en: “Possibilism” is not the same as complacency.

zh: 相反，用赫希曼的话说，可能主义旨在“扩大可能或被认为可能的事情的极限 ” 。
en: On the contrary, it aims, in Hirschman’s words, “to widen the limits of what is or is perceived to be possible.”

zh: 曾几何时，拉丁美洲似乎不可能得到良好的治理。
en: Once upon a time, it did not seem possible for Latin America to be well governed.

zh: 今天，我们知道绝非如此。
en: Today we know otherwise.

zh: 对此我们应该感谢埃尔文这样的领导人。
en: For that, we should thank leaders like Patricio Aylwin.

zh: 剖析尤科斯事件
en: A Yukos Autopsy

zh: 尤科斯，俄罗斯一度最大的石油公司和国际投资者最看好的对象，现在正经历着死亡前的阵痛。
en: Yukos, once Russia’s leading oil company and a favorite of international investors, is in its death throes.

zh: 在那次许多人看来存在舞弊的拍卖上，该公司的核心资产被廉价卖给一个名不见经传的出价者，现在又转回到俄罗斯政府手中。
en: At what many perceived to be a rigged auction, the company’s best assets were sold off to a previously unknown bidder and are now back in the hands of the Russian state.

zh: 剩下的空壳儿仍然继续考验着公司的命运，特别是在休斯顿、德克萨斯的法庭上。
en: The shell of what remains continues to challenge the company’s fate, notably in a Houston, Texas courtroom.

zh: 但这些阵痛不会让尸体起死回生。
en: But these spasms will not revive the corpse.

zh: 要紧的是俄罗斯经济是否会遭遇与尤科斯集团相同的命运。
en: What matters now is whether Russia’s economy will share Yukos’s fate.

zh: 尤科斯事件给俄罗斯经济增长前景带来的损害也许是暂时的，只要其它公司不再重蹈覆辙。
en: The damage to Russia’s economic growth prospects from the Yukos affair may yet prove temporary, barring a repeat performance with other companies.

zh: 但是尤科斯事件是否像克里姆林宫所坚持认为的那样，只是个案而已，就要对俄罗斯总统普京的动机进行解读了。
en: But whether the Yukos affair proves to be an isolated case, as the Kremlin insists, depends on a reading of Russian President Vladimir Putin’s motives.

zh: 一种可能性是普京关于十年内把俄罗斯国民生产总值翻一番的目标并不真诚。
en: One possibility is that Putin is not sincere about his aim of doubling Russia’s GDP in a decade.

zh: 最近的民意调查显示这是很多不满的俄罗斯民众的看法。
en: Recent opinion polls suggest that this is the view of much of Russia’s cynical public.

zh: 在这些民众看来，上个世纪九十年代的私有化仅仅是一场服务于当权者的骗局。
en: On this view, the privatizations of the 1990’s were a scam serving only the powers that be.

zh: 但是，任何私有化的逆转行为¾正像尤科斯集团的米哈伊尔·霍多尔科夫斯基和他在梅纳特普银行集团的商业伙伴行之有效的移交股权的行为一样¾也并没给社会公正带来曙光，而只是如同列宁曾说的，一个新的财团“征用了原所有者的财富”而已。
en: But any reversal of those privatizations – such as the effective expropriation of Mikhail Khodorkovsky and his Menatep partners in Yukos – signifies not the dawn of social justice but rather a new group of bosses “expropriating the expropriators,” as Lenin used to say.

zh: 稍微温和一些的说法认为尤科斯事件首先显现的是普京一系列随机应变的策略，而不是一个系统连贯的议程。
en: A less nihilistic view is that the Yukos affair suggests above all a series of improvisations by Putin rather than a coherent agenda.

zh: 这倒让人感到安心一些。
en: This is somewhat reassuring.

zh: 更多的迹象表明：该事件的起因并不在于俄罗斯想实施系统的国有化计划，而是因为克里姆林宫察觉到霍多尔科夫斯基旨在用他的财富完成对俄罗斯国有经济的私有化。
en: Much evidence points to the affair originating not in a systematic nationalization project, but rather in the Kremlin’s perception that Khodorkovsky aimed to use his wealth to privatize the Russian state itself.

zh: 类似的“侵吞国有经济”行为曾在上世纪90年代的俄罗斯出现过，也在邻邦乌克兰的库奇马政权下以更大规模出现过。 有意思的是，普京当时还曾试图予以保护。
en: Such “state capture” occurred in Russia in the late 1990’s and to an even greater extent under the Kuchma regime in neighboring Ukraine which, ironically, Putin tried to preserve.

zh: 压制来自霍多尔科夫斯基的潜在威胁就意味着通过把梅纳特普银行集团从尤克斯集团未来的现金流转中分离出来，以使他丧失成就野心的能力。
en: Neutralizing the perceived threat from Khodorkovsky meant depriving him of the means to achieve his ambitions by separating his Menatep Group from Yukos’s future cash flows.

zh: 针对尤科斯开出的巨额税单实际上是手段，而非目的。
en: The massive tax claims against Yukos used for this purpose were precisely that – the means rather than the end.

zh: 如果其目的只在于追偿所欠税款，就没有必要进一步瓦解该公司¾这些巨额债务，尤科斯集团本可以通过分期偿还逐步解决的。
en: Had the goal been mere recovery of tax arrears, there would have been no need to break up the company: Yukos could have settled even these colossal liabilities on a civilized installment schedule.

zh: 可以肯定的是，梅纳特普集团的股权分离使得这个截至2003年还是俄罗斯境内吸引国内外资金最多的尤科斯集团的股票一文不值。
en: To be sure, expropriating Menatep made shares in Yukos – a company that by 2003 attracted more domestic and foreign savings than any other in Russia – virtually worthless.

zh: 但这对于追求高于一切的政治目标来说，更是一种间接损失。
en: But this seems like collateral damage from the pursuit of an overriding political objective.

zh: 现在具有关键性意义的是正在政府掌控下的尤科斯集团的核心资产¾尤甘斯克公司¾是否会遭受同样的结局，尤甘斯克的剩余资产看来必将被收归国有。
en: Much now depends on whether the same is true of the other major outcome, which is that Yukos’s principal asset – Yuganskneftegaz – is now in state hands, while its remaining units appear doomed to nationalization.

zh: 这难道是向霍多尔科夫斯基发起的战役中偶然获得的另外一件副产品吗，或者它是克里姆林宫核心议程的一部分？
en: Is this another incidental by-product of the campaign against Khodorkovsky, or is it part of the core Kremlin agenda?

zh: 国有化当然会吸引来实力雄厚的集团，包括普京从前在克格勃的同事以及他在圣彼得堡的旧交，其中一人去年出任俄罗斯国有石油公司（Rosneft）主席。 这家完全国营性质的公司并购了尤甘斯克公司。
en: Nationalization certainly seems to appeal to the powerful faction comprising Putin’s former KGB colleagues and associates from his native St. Petersburg, one of whom last year became the chairman of Rosneft, the wholly state-owned oil company which acquired Yuganskneftegaz.

zh: 但是倘若这些所谓“有权力的人 ” （ 指上文“普京从前在克格勃的同事以及他在圣彼得堡的旧交 ” ） 肆意利用自身的影响力，另外几家公司也会受到类似的攻击。
en: But if the influence of these so-called siloviki was unbridled, similar attacks would have been launched against other major companies by now.

zh: 实际上，即使罗曼·阿布拉莫维奇（俄罗斯石油大亨 ） （ 在西伯利亚的）的Sibneft石油公司¾这个因为寡头垄断以及实施与毁掉尤科斯集团相同的偷税阴谋而最易受到攻击的公司，需要对付的麻烦也仅仅是初步的清偿税款。
en: As it is, even Roman Abramovich’s Sibneft – potentially the most vulnerable company due to its oligarch ownership and its use of the same tax minimization schemes that were the undoing of Yukos – merely faces a preliminary claim for back taxes.

zh: 与尤克斯集团形成鲜明对比，对其追偿的税金没有超出该公司账面上的现金数额，因此并没有威胁它的存活。
en: In contrast to Yukos, the claim does not exceed the company’s cash on hand and so poses no threat to its existence.

zh: 考虑到把尤科斯的资产转给国内私营企业主（即垄断财阀）存在明显的政治障碍，而转给外国投资者又涉及法律及国家声誉问题，对尤科斯资产的国有化或许仅仅反映出：除了政府并没有其它买主。
en: Even the nationalization of Yukos’s assets may reflect little more than the absence of alternative buyers, given the obvious political obstacle passing those assets on to other domestic private-sector players (i.e., oligarchs), and the legal and reputational barriers to foreign investors.

zh: 因此到目前为止与事实最相符的解释就是：把霍多尔科夫斯基和梅纳特普银行集团从尤科斯集团分离出去的政治目的在事实上导致将其国有化，但国有化并不是最根本的目的所在。
en: So the interpretation that best fits the facts so far is that the political aim of separating Khodorkovsky and Menatep from Yukos led in practice to nationalization, but that this was not the underlying goal.

zh: 正在控制尤甘斯克公司的克里姆林宫的内部和周边并没有开启绿灯，使机会主义分子得以任意攫取其它公司的资产。
en: There is no green light for opportunistic predators in and around the Kremlin who now control Yuganskneftegaz to grab other companies’ assets at will.

zh: 如果是这样的话，尤科斯事件造成的损失将是最小的。
en: If so, the damage caused by the Yukos affair should be minimal.

zh: 然而，即使我们假设普京没有将主要的自然能源公司国有化的计划，他也显然是想对这些高高在上的公司实施强硬的政府控制。
en: Yet, even on the assumption that Putin has no plans to nationalize key natural resource companies, he clearly desires strong state control over these “commanding heights” of the economy.

zh: 这在本质上会导致国民生产总值的整体跌落出乎意料，因为受政府控制或影响的大公司生产力相对较低，并且存在较严重的腐败问题。
en: That in itself will result in overall GDP growth falling below potential, owing to the inferior productivity and greater corruption in the major companies that the state controls or heavily influences.

zh: 2003年，普京在庆祝国家天然气公司Gazprom建立十周年的讲话中明确了他的立场，称该公司是继苏���解体之后保留下来的为数不多的强有力的地缘政治杠杆之一。
en: In a speech marking the state gas monopoly Gazprom’s tenth anniversary in 2003, Putin stated his position explicitly, speaking of the company as one of the few strong geopolitical levers left to Russia after the Soviet collapse.

zh: 普京地缘政治的当务之急本可以通过保留碳氢工业管道建设的国家所有权和允许私有企业提炼、加工、出售俄罗斯的石油和天然气来实现。
en: Putin’s geopolitical preoccupations could be accommodated by sensibly preserving state ownership of pipeline infrastructure in the hydrocarbons sector, while allowing private companies to extract, process, and sell Russia’s oil and gas.

zh: 然而，普京却允许Gazprom公司自主经营，以阻止他自己政府早先提出的解散公司的建议。
en: Instead, Putin has allowed Gazprom’s management to block proposals from his own government on the long overdue unbundling of the company.

zh: 普京已经探索出一套即使在程度上不同，却在性质上与中国经济繁荣轨道类似的改革方案。
en: Putin has sought an economic transformation of Russia similar in kind, if not in degree, to China’s boom.

zh: 这会提高长期经历苦难的俄罗斯人民的生活水平，并恢复俄罗斯的国际声誉。
en: The prize is higher living standards for Russia’s long-suffering people and a recovery in the country’s international standing.

zh: 尽管普京的意图何在还不好说，这样的回报还是指日可待的。
en: Despite uncertainty about Putin’s intentions, that prize is not out of reach.

zh: 确实，在这个节骨眼上，唯一比尤科斯事件更加糟糕的事情莫过于再次发生类似的事件。
en: Indeed, at this point the only action more harmful than the Yukos affair would be another Yukos affair.

zh: 结束了，婴儿潮一代
en: It’s All Over Now, Baby Boom

zh: 慕尼黑 — — 卡洛斯·巴兰托斯三世出生于1964年12月31日晚6：45分檀香山西北几英里处。
en: MUNICH – Carlos Barientos III was born at 6:45 on the evening of December 31, 1964, a few miles northwest of Honolulu.

zh: 今年他即将年届五旬，很可能是美国“婴儿潮”一代最晚年届半百者。
en: This year, he will turn 50, quite possibly making him the last member of the US “baby boom” to do so.

zh: 即使有人可能认为他们在心智上还没有完全成熟，但曾经被人视为活力、狂热甚至令人恼火的青年一代代名词的这代人已即将正式步入“老年”行列。
en: The generation that once seemed to define for the world the energy, excitement, and even irritating nature of youth will officially be “old” – even if, some might say, not entirely grown up.

zh: 但这究竟有什么意义？
en: But what does this really mean?

zh: “婴儿潮一代”特指二战后生长在美国的一代人，但同期生长在欧洲、加拿大、澳大利亚和其他地方的人同样也属于婴儿潮一代。 战后经济快速发展和出生率大幅飙升是这个时代的特征。
en: The “baby boomers” are the generation that grew up in the United States, in particular, but also in Europe, Canada, Australia, and elsewhere, after World War II, when rapid economic growth was accompanied by rising birth rates.

zh: 从1945到1964年这19年间出生的人组成了这个世界上最为庞大、繁荣、受过良好教育、并且按照某些人的说法，最被溺爱和放纵的一代。
en: Those born during that 19-year period – from 1945 to 1964 – were part of the largest, most prosperous, best-educated and, some might say, most indulged and indulgent generation that the world has ever seen.

zh: 从性、毒品、摇滚、民权运动到互联网和房地产泡沫，无论好坏，婴儿潮一代奠定了现代社会的基础。
en: From sex, drugs, and rock ‘n’ roll to the civil rights movements to the dot-com and housing bubbles, for better or worse, the boomer generation has shaped modern society.

zh: 现在入主白宫的就是婴儿潮一代相对年轻的成员，而唐宁街、爱丽舍宫和德国总理府同样也是这代人入主。 婴儿潮一代仍将影响我们未来的道路。
en: And with one of its younger members currently in the White House, and others at Downing Street, the Élysée Palace, and the German Chancellery, it will continue to do so for years to come.

zh: 但同是婴儿潮一代也有着显著的不同。
en: But there are stark differences within the boomer generation.

zh: 早期成员 — — 从凯瑟琳·凯西-克希林开始，她在1946年新年午夜钟声后一秒落地使她成为了不大不小的名人 — — 嬉皮文化、披头士和鲍勃·迪伦的音乐以及越南战争构成了她的成长环境。
en: Early boomers – beginning with Kathleen Casey-Kirschling, whose birth one second past midnight on New Year’s Day, 1946, has made her a minor celebrity – grew up surrounded by the hippie counterculture, the music of the Beatles and Bob Dylan, and the Vietnam war.

zh: 相比之下，巴兰托斯和1964年出生的婴儿潮一代喜欢玩电子游戏、听迪斯科音乐 — — 或者如果他们的口味与巴兰托斯相近，他们更崇尚加里·穆尔、瘦林奇和范海伦的重口味。
en: By contrast, Barientos and the other boomers of 1964 grew up playing video games and listening to disco music – or, if their tastes were closer to those of Barientos, the heavier sounds of Gary Moore, Thin Lizzy, and Van Halen.

zh: 事实上，与父亲一道开吉他店的巴兰托斯并不认可自己是婴儿潮的一员；他感觉自己与之后的“X一代”更有相似之处。
en: In fact, Barientos, who owns and runs his own guitar shop with his father, does not readily identify himself as a baby boomer; he feels closer to the “Generation X” that followed.

zh: 但巴兰托斯与像克希林这样的婴儿潮一代还不止是兴趣上的不同。
en: But Barientos’s interests are not all that set him apart from the likes of Casey-Kirschling.

zh: 虽然较早出生的婴儿潮一代已经在舒适地享受退休生活，享受医疗保险、社会保障和免税退休账户支付，但巴兰托斯仍然正当盛年 — — 并且很不放心自己的退休生活。
en: While many of the early US baby boomers are now comfortably retired, enjoying the benefits of Medicare, Social Security, and tax-free Roth IRA disbursements, Barientos is still in his prime – and concerned about his retirement.

zh: 与2013年仅有13%相比，到2031年巴兰托斯和婴儿潮一代余下的成员退休时，超过20%的美国人口都将达到65岁以上。
en: By 2031, when Barientos and the rest of the baby boomers are retired, more than 20% of the US population will be at least 65 years old, compared with only 13% in 2010.

zh: 因此老年抚养比（65岁或以上人口与劳动年龄人口之比）势必从1：5升至1：3。
en: As a result, the old-age dependency ratio (the number of people aged 65 or over relative to the working-age population) is set to rise from 1:5 to 1:3.

zh: 国家养老基金和医疗保健系统所受的压力将因此大幅增加。
en: This will intensify pressure on state pension funds and health-care systems considerably.

zh: 正如巴兰托斯所说 ， “ 我们不像我父亲那代，工作一段时间、存点钱之后就停止工作。
en: As Barientos puts it, “It’s not like my dad’s generation, where you worked a job for a certain amount of time, saved some money, and then stopped working.”

zh: ”相反，他解释说 ， “ 我们只是竭尽所能 . . . 一直向前走。
en: Instead, he explains, “we just do what we can…and keep moving forward.”

zh: 但这并不是说巴兰托斯愿意和父亲易地而处。
en: Not that Barientos would swap places with his father.

zh: “我觉得自己比之前几代人都要幸运 ， ” 他说。
en: “I think I’ve been blessed in comparison to previous generations,” he says.

zh: “即便与同代当中的年长者相比，我都不必拼命去争取自由。
en: “Even compared to older members of my generation, I haven’t had to fight for my freedom.

zh: 我不必去越南打仗。
en: I didn’t have to go to Vietnam.

zh: 前辈的辛勤工作让我能在某种程度上分享他们的成果。 ”
en: I’ve been able to benefit from the hard work of people before me.”

zh: 各国对战后婴儿潮一代的定义各不相同。
en: Definitions of the post-war baby boom vary by country.

zh: 巴兰托斯据称是夏威夷岛最后出生的婴儿潮成员，位于美国最西端的夏威夷岛比同时区的太平洋沿岸晚两个小时。
en: Barientos’s claim to be the last US boomer rests on Hawaii’s position as America’s most westerly state in a time zone two hours behind the Pacific coast.

zh: 但这也意味着他的生活与大陆同龄人相比有许多不同。
en: It also means, though, that he lives a life that is somewhat different from that of many of his peers on the mainland.

zh: “食物、语言、天气 — — 夏威夷都与美国其他地方有很大差异。
en: “The food, the language, the weather – Hawaii isn’t like the rest of the US,” he notes.

zh: ”巴兰托斯说 ， “ 第一次离开夏威夷时我年仅25岁。
en: “The first time I left Hawaii, I was 25 years old.

zh: 我到马里兰州拜访一位朋友，本来只打算待两星期，结果却因为太喜欢那里而待了五年之久。 ”
en: I went to Maryland to visit a friend for two weeks and ended up staying five years because I loved it so much.”

zh: 如果有钱，巴兰托斯称自己可能变成一只“雪鸟 ” — —在美国本土避暑，而后到夏威夷过冬。
en: If he had the money, Barientos says he would probably be a “snow bird” – spending summers on the US mainland and winter in Hawaii.

zh: “有些想和家人一起做的事在这儿根本做不了，比方说参观博物馆、游乐园，或观看大型体育赛事。
en: “There are things I’d like to do with my family that we just can’t do here, such as [going to] museums, amusement parks, or large sporting events.”

zh: ”可永远离开这里他也做不到 — — 故乡有太多东西令人无法割舍。
en: He could not leave permanently, though – there are too many things to enjoy at home.

zh: “我爱这里的人、爱这里的文化 — — 这里的一切都让我魂牵梦绕。 ”
en: “I love the people, the culture – pretty much everything.”

zh: 当巴兰托斯和家人涌向海滩与邻居们共庆新年前夜之际，他根本不会想到自己有多大。
en: When Barientos and his family spill out onto the beach to celebrate New Year’s Eve with the whole neighborhood, one of the last things he will think about is his age.

zh: “我没时间担心这些！ ”他说。
en: “I don’t have time to be worrying about that!” he says.

zh: 他如何看待自己是一代人中的最后一个？
en: What about his status as the last of a generation?

zh: “我不清楚是不是婴儿潮最后出生的成员 ， ” 巴兰托斯沉吟道。
en: “I don’t know whether I’m the last baby boomer or not,” Barientos muses.

zh: “如果1964年12月31日 6:45分后夏威夷还有人出生，那我就不是最后一个。
en: “If there was anyone born in Hawaii later than 6:45 on December 31, 1964, then they’ve got me beat.

zh: 不过， 如果这意味着我能交到新朋友，跟他们聊天，那当然没有什么不好。 ”
en: But, you know what, if it means I get to meet some new people and talk about it, then it’s definitely cool.”

zh: 对中国的反弹
en: The China Backlash

zh: 发自香港 — — 在最近对中国的正式访问中，马来西亚总理马哈蒂尔批评东道国利用重大基础设施项目 — — 以及难以偿还的贷款 — — 来对其他较小国家施加影响力。
en: HONG KONG – On a recent official visit to China, Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad criticized his host country’s use of major infrastructure projects – and difficult-to-repay loans – to assert its influence over smaller countries.

zh: 虽然马哈蒂尔在北京发出的反对“新版殖民主义”警告因大胆而引人注目，但它们反映了对中国这种重商主义贸易，投资和贷款行为的一种更广泛抵制。
en: While Mahathir’s warnings in Beijing against “a new version of colonialism” stood out for their boldness, they reflect a broader pushback against China’s mercantilist trade, investment, and lending practices.

zh: 自2013年以来，中国一直在“一带一路”倡议框架下四处资助和建设大型基础设施项目，以使各国的利益与自己保持一致，在战略要地获取政治立足点，以及出口其工业多余产能。
en: Since 2013, under the umbrella of its “Belt and Road Initiative,” China has been funding and implementing large infrastructure projects in countries around the world, in order to help align their interests with its own, gain a political foothold in strategic locations, and export its industrial surpluses.

zh: 但中国对“一带一路”项目的投标程序一直保持着封闭和不透明状态，使其经常能夸大其价值，致使受援国背负上难以偿还的债务。
en: By keeping bidding on BRI projects closed and opaque, China often massively inflates their value, leaving countries struggling to repay their debts.

zh: 一旦各国陷入了中国的债务陷阱，它们可能最终被迫签署一些更糟糕的交易以填补其无法偿还的债务。
en: Once countries become ensnared in China’s debt traps, they can end up being forced into even worse deals to compensate their creditor for lack of repayment.

zh: 最值得注意的是，由于无法偿还其债务，去年12月斯里兰卡被迫将中国兴建的战略港口汉班托塔港以99年的殖民地租约形式转到中国手中。
en: Most notably, last December, Sri Lanka was compelled to transfer the Chinese-built strategic port of Hambantota to China on a 99-year, colonial-style lease, because it could longer afford its debt payments.

zh: 斯里兰卡的遭遇为那些背负了过多中国贷款的国家敲响了警钟。
en: Sri Lanka’s experience was a wake-up call for other countries with outsize debts to China.

zh: 由于担心战略资产流失，各国现在正试图废弃，缩减规模或重新谈判自己与中国的交易。
en: Fearing that they, too, could lose strategic assets, they are now attempting to scrap, scale back, or renegotiate their deals.

zh: 而此前为中国对马来西亚投资铺平道路的马哈蒂尔则通过取消价值近230亿美元的中国项目来结束自己的北京之行。
en: Mahathir, who previously cleared the way for Chinese investment in Malaysia, ended his trip to Beijing by canceling Chinese projects worth almost $23 billion.

zh: 孟加拉国，匈牙利和坦桑尼亚等几个不同的国家也取消或缩减了“一带一路”项目。
en: Countries as diverse as Bangladesh, Hungary, and Tanzania have also canceled or scaled back BRI projects.

zh: 缅甸希望获得所需的基础设施，但又不想被中国拖入债务陷阱，于是以取消项目作威胁，通过谈判将皎漂港的计划建造成本从73亿美元降至13亿美元。
en: Myanmar, hoping to secure needed infrastructure without becoming caught up in a Chinese debt trap, has used the threat of cancellation to negotiate a reduction in the cost of its planned Kyaukpyu port from $7.3 billion to $1.3 billion.

zh: 即便是中国最亲密的合作伙伴现在也对“一带一路”倡议持谨慎态度。
en: Even China’s closest partners are now wary of the BRI.

zh: 巴基斯坦长期以来一直与中国合作遏制印度，同时也是最大的“一带一路”融资接受国，但军方支持的新政府已经试图审查或重新谈判项目以应对日益恶化的债务危机。
en: In Pakistan, which has long worked with China to contain India and is the largest recipient of BRI financing, the new military-backed government has sought to review or renegotiate projects in response to a worsening debt crisis.

zh: 而在另一个中国贷款的主要接受者柬埔寨则日益忧虑自己会沦为事实上的中国殖民地。
en: In Cambodia, another leading recipient of Chinese loans, fears of effectively becoming a Chinese colony are on the rise.

zh: 对中国的抵制也可以在其他地方看到。
en: The backlash against China can be seen elsewhere, too.

zh: 最近举行的太平洋岛屿年度论坛会议是其历史上最具争议的会议之一。
en: The recent annual Pacific Islands Forum meeting was one of the most contentious in its history.

zh: 中国对该地区的政策，再加上中国代表团领导人在此次活动中的行为本身，促使瑙鲁总统 — — 他统治着世界上最小的共和国，只有1.1万名居民 — — 谴责中国在南太平洋的“傲慢”存在，并宣称中国不能“向我们发号施令 ” 。
en: Chinese policies in the region, together with the Chinese delegation leader’s behavior at the event itself, drove the president of Nauru – the world’s smallest republic, with just 11,000 inhabitants – to condemn China’s “arrogant” presence in the South Pacific. China cannot, he declared, “dictate things to us.”

zh: 在贸易方面，美国总统特朗普不断升级的对华贸易战升级正在占据新闻头条，但特朗普在远非批评中国的唯一一人。
en: When it comes to trade, US President Donald Trump’s escalating trade war with China is grabbing headlines, but Trump is far from alone in criticizing China.

zh: 照哈佛大学教授格雷厄姆·艾利森（Graham Allison）的话说，借助出口补贴和非关税壁垒等政策，知识产权盗窃以及向中国企业倾斜的国内市场，中国代表着“世界上最为保护主义，重商主义和掠夺性的主要经济体 ” 。 “ 。
en: With policies ranging from export subsidies and nontariff barriers to intellectual-property piracy and tilting the domestic market in favor of Chinese companies, China represents, in the words of Harvard’s Graham Allison, the “most protectionist, mercantilist, and predatory major economy in the world.”

zh: 作为世界上最大的商品出口国，中国是许多国家最大的贸易伙伴。
en: As the largest merchandise exporter in the world, China is many countries’ biggest trading partner.

zh: 借助这一地位，北京会利用贸易来惩罚那些拒绝听从其号令的国家，包括对特定产品实施进口禁令，停止战略性出口（如稀土矿产 ） ， 减少中国游客数量以及鼓励国内消费者抵制或抗议外国企业。
en: Beijing has leveraged this role by employing trade to punish those that refuse to toe its line, including by imposing import bans on specific products, halting strategic exports (such as rare-earth minerals), cutting off tourism from China, and encouraging domestic consumer boycotts or protests against foreign businesses.

zh: 事实上，中国正是通过藐视国际贸易规则而变得强大和富裕的。
en: The fact is that China has grown strong and rich by flouting international trade rules.

zh: 然而因果循环，报应不爽，越来越多的国家开始对中国商品征收反倾销或惩罚性关税。
en: But now its chickens are coming home to roost, with a growing number of countries imposing antidumping or punitive duties on Chinese goods.

zh: 随着各国日益提防中国借助债务陷阱使它们屈服于其意志 ， “ 一带一路”也没法再那么一帆风顺了。
en: And as countries worry about China bending them to its will by luring them into debt traps, it is no longer smooth sailing for the BRI.

zh: 除了特朗普的关税外，欧盟还向世界贸易组织提出了一项申诉，投诉中国将强制技术转让作为市场准入的条件。
en: Beyond Trump’s tariffs, the European Union has filed a complaint with the World Trade Organization about China’s practices of forcing technology transfer as a condition of market access.

zh: 中国的出口补贴和其他扭曲性贸易操作也将遭遇更大的国际抵制。
en: China’s export subsidies and other trade-distorting practices are set to encounter greater international resistance.

zh: 根据世贸组织规则，各国可对那些损害国内产业的海外补贴商品征收关税。
en: Under WTO rules, countries may impose tariffs on subsidized goods from overseas that harm domestic industries.

zh: 现在，中国国家主席习近平发现自己不仅要捍卫“一带一路”这个标志性外交政策倡议，而且还要面对国内的批评（无论多么微弱 ） ， 指责他为了炫耀中国的全球野心从而引发以美国为首的国际抵制。
en: Now, Chinese President Xi Jinping finds himself not only defending the BRI, his signature foreign-policy initiative, but also confronting domestic criticism, however muted, for flaunting China’s global ambitions and thereby inviting a US-led international backlash.

zh: 习近平已经抛弃了中国前核心领导人邓小平最著名的一句箴言 ： “ 韬光养晦，争取时间 ” ， 相反他选择采取一种毫不掩饰的激进战略，许多人都在质疑中国是否正在成长为一股新帝国主义势力。
en: Xi has discarded one of former Chinese strongman Deng Xiaoping’s most famous dicta: “Hide your strength, bide your time.” Instead, Xi has chosen to pursue an unabashedly aggressive strategy that has many asking whether China is emerging as a new kind of imperialist power.

zh: 国际贸易给中国带来了巨大的利益，使中国成为世界第二大经济体，同时使数亿人摆脱贫困。
en: International trade has afforded China enormous benefits, enabling the country to become the world’s second-largest economy, while lifting hundreds of millions of people out of poverty.

zh: 如果因为其不公平的贸易和投资做法招致国际强烈反对而失去这些好处，对于这个国家来说是无法承受的。
en: The country cannot afford to lose those benefits to an international backlash against its unfair trade and investment practices.

zh: 中国依赖大量贸易顺差和外汇储备来扩大其全球存在的做法使其更容易受到当前抵制的影响。
en: China’s reliance on large trade surpluses and foreign-exchange reserves to fund the expansion of its global footprint makes it all the more vulnerable to the current pushback.

zh: 事实上即使中国改变战略并尊崇国际规则，其贸易顺差和外汇储备也会受到影响。
en: In fact, even if China shifts its strategy and adheres to international rules, its trade surplus and foreign-currency reserves will be affected.

zh: 简而言之，无论选择哪条道路，中国的搭便车之旅都行将结束。
en: In short, whichever path it chooses, China’s free ride could be coming to an end.

zh: 直面民主的全球威胁
en: Confronting the Global Threat to Democracy

zh: 牛津 — — 在世界各地，民粹主义者正借助在全球化严峻现实中保护普通民众的承诺来吸引投票者。
en: OXFORD – Across the world, populists are attracting votes with their promises to protect ordinary people from the harsh realities of globalization.

zh: 他们扬言民主机制完不成这项任务，因为民主体系忙于保护富人 — — 全球化只不过强化了这样的做法。
en: The democratic establishment, they assert, cannot be trusted to fulfill this purpose, as it is too busy protecting the wealthy – a habit that globalization has only intensified.

zh: 几十年来，全球化承诺为所有人带来好处。
en: For decades, globalization promised to bring benefits to all.

zh: 在国际范围内，它促成了亚洲四小龙和金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）的崛起，推动了非洲大陆经济快速增长，并促进了2007年前发达国家的繁荣。
en: On an international scale, it facilitated the rise of the Asian tigers and the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa), produced rapid growth across Africa, and facilitated the boom in developed countries through 2007.

zh: 全球化还创造新机遇并促成了国内经济发展；但从2008年经济崩溃后，很多富裕国家已深陷紧缩；亚洲经济体增长放缓；金砖国家陷入发展停滞；并且很多非洲国家再次深陷到债务当中。
en: It also created new opportunities and augmented growth within countries. But since the 2008 crash, many rich countries have been locked into austerity; the Asian economies have been slowing; the BRICS’ progress has been stalling; and many African countries have fallen back into debt.

zh: 所有这一切都导致了日益严重的不平等，而不平等正在导致不满情绪滋生。
en: All of this has contributed to rising inequality, which is now fueling discontent.

zh: 伊曼纽尔·赛斯和加布里埃尔·祖克曼计算出美国的贫富差距已经超过了大萧条以来的任何时候，1%的最富裕家庭现在几乎把持着国家财富的一半。
en: Emmanuel Saez and Gabriel Zucman calculate that in the United States, the wealth gap is already wider than at any time since the Great Depression, with the richest 1% of households now holding almost half the country’s wealth.

zh: 英国国家统计局报告从2012到2014年间，10%的最富家庭拥有家庭合计财富总额的45 % 。
en: In the United Kingdom, the Office for National Statistics reports that in the period from 2012 to 2014, the wealthiest 10% of households owned 45% of total aggregate household wealth.

zh: 从2010年7月以来，前10%富人的财产增长比后50%速度快3倍。
en: Since July 2010, the top decile’s wealth has increased three times faster than that of the bottom 50% of the population.

zh: 2000年来尼日利亚年均7%的惊人经济增长很有可能减少了该国西南地区的贫困；但在该国东北部地区（极端组织博科圣地最活跃的地区 ） ， 令人震惊的财富不平等和贫困水平已经出现。
en: In Nigeria, astonishing economic growth, averaging 7% per year since 2000, may well have reduced poverty in the southwest of the country; but in the northeast (where the extremist group Boko Haram is most active), shocking levels of wealth inequality and poverty have emerged.

zh: 从中国到埃及再到希腊，同样的趋势都十分明显。
en: Similar trends are apparent from China to Egypt to Greece.

zh: 除了不平等，公众信任的不断降低引发人们对全球化和民主制度的反抗。
en: Alongside inequality, declining public trust fuels the revolt against globalization and democracy.

zh: 无论在发达国家还是发展中国家，很多人怀疑富人变得更富是因为他们不必像其他人那样遵守规则。
en: Across the developed and developing worlds, many suspect that the rich are getting richer because they are not held to the same rules as everyone else.

zh: 不难看出这是为了什么。
en: It’s not hard to see why.

zh: 随着全球经济放缓，上层人士背弃信任的行为变得一目了然。
en: As the global economy slows, breaches of trust by those at the top become more apparent.

zh: 在英国，亚马逊、星巴克和谷歌2013年因利用漏洞逃税迫使英国政府牵头发表旨在减少逃税和避税现象的G8税务公告而引发了公众愤怒。
en: In the United Kingdom, Amazon, Starbucks, and Google attracted public outrage in 2013 for using loopholes to pay almost no tax, prompting the UK government to lead a G8 tax announcement aimed at reducing tax evasion and avoidance.

zh: 2015年，对尼日利亚国家石油公司的审计显示这家企业从未将上届政府执政期间约200亿美元的石油收入汇给政府。
en: In 2015, an audit of the state-owned Nigerian National Petroleum Corporation revealed that about $20 billion in revenue was never remitted to the authorities under the previous administration.

zh: 问题似乎涉及方方面面。
en: And the problem appears to be systemic.

zh: 今年，巴拿马论文揭露了全球富豪如何开设秘密海外企业，从而规避财务监管和税收。
en: This year, the Panama Papers exposed how the global rich create secretive offshore companies, permitting them to avoid financial scrutiny and taxation.

zh: 而近年来世界规模最大的银行全都因为公然违法而接到过前所未有的罚单。
en: And the world’s largest banks have faced unprecedented fines in recent years for brazen violations of the law.

zh: 但尽管上述案件造成了巨大的负面影响，公众却几乎没有看到任何人为此而担责。
en: But, despite the negative publicity generated by such cases, the public has seen virtually no one held to account.

zh: 2008年全球金融危机近10年后，进监狱的只有一家银行的高管。
en: Almost a decade after the global financial crisis of 2008, only one bank executive has gone to prison.

zh: 相反很多银行家走上了类似苏格兰英国皇家银行负责人弗雷德·古德温的道路，在古德温任职期间该银行积累了241亿英镑（合342亿美元）的亏损，但古德温自己却拿着巨额养老金退休。
en: Many bankers instead followed a path similar to Fred Goodwin, the head of Britain’s Royal Bank of Scotland, who racked up £24.1 billion ($34.2 billion) in losses, then resigned with a huge pension.

zh: 普通民众 — — 像2015年9月英国3个孩子的父亲因累计500,000英镑的赌债而入狱 — — 却不可能像这样免于惩罚。
en: Ordinary people – like the father of three who was imprisoned in the UK in September 2015 for accumulating £500,000 in gambling debts – do not enjoy such impunity.

zh: 所有这一切都有助于解释反体制运动为什么在世界各地不断深入。
en: All of this helps explain why anti-establishment movements are gaining momentum around the world.

zh: 普通民众感到公民权利被剥夺是这些运动的共同点 — — 人们感到“体制”未能将“公平待遇”赋予普通民众。
en: These movements share a sense of disenfranchisement – a sense that the “establishment” is failing to give ordinary citizens a “fair shake.”

zh: 他们指责特殊利益群体“购买”选举结果、受到操纵的神秘的法律和法规框架为富人带来好处，以及只有大型机构才能利用银行法和秘密谈判的投资协定。
en: They point to election results “bought” by special interests, and to arcane legal and regulatory frameworks that seem rigged to benefit the rich, such as banking regulations that only large institutions can navigate and investment treaties negotiated in secret.

zh: 政府已经准许全球化 — — 和逍遥的财富所有者 — — 超越他们前进的步伐。
en: Governments have permitted globalization – and peripatetic wealth-holders – to outpace them. Globalization requires regulation and management.

zh: 全球化需要规范和管理；需要负责任的企业领导人；以及深入有效的全球合作。
en: It requires responsible business leaders. And it requires deep and effective global cooperation.

zh: 当政府未能在20世纪30年代达成合作，全球化陷入到崩溃式的停滞当中。
en: When governments failed to cooperate in the 1930s, globalization came to a crashing halt.

zh: 二次大战后各国采取了一系列审慎措施开放世界经济，允许全球化再次腾飞。
en: It took a series of careful, highly managed efforts after World War II to open up the world economy and permit globalization to take off again.

zh: 但很多国家在解放贸易的同时，靠资本管制保证“热钱”无法在本国自由地流入流出。
en: Still, while many countries liberalized trade, capital controls ensured that “hot money” could not race in and out of their economies.

zh: 不仅如此，政府将经济发展收益投向能让更多人受益的高质量教育、医疗及福利制度。
en: Meanwhile, governments invested the returns on growth in high-quality education, health care, and welfare systems that benefited the many.

zh: 随着政府责任的增长，政府所掌握的资源也随之不断扩大。
en: As the business of government grew, so did the resources put into it.

zh: 到20世纪70年代，富裕国家的政府和企业领袖全都变得得意洋洋。
en: By the 1970s, wealthy countries’ leaders in both government and business had become complacent.

zh: 他们相信自我平衡、自我约束的市场能带来持续的经济增长。
en: They took on faith the promise of self-equilibrating, self-restraining markets that would deliver continued growth.

zh: 到这种新传统扩散到杠杆化的金融行业时，世界已经走上了崩溃的轨道。
en: By the time this new orthodoxy spread to the leveraged financial sector, the world was on a crash course.

zh: 不幸的是，许多政府已经无力管理他们所释放的力量，而企业领导人也已丧失了责任感，不再关注为他们创造繁荣环境的社会福利制度。
en: Unfortunately, many governments had already lost the capacity to manage the forces they had unleashed, and business leaders had lost their sense of responsibility for the welfare of the societies within which they were flourishing.

zh: 2016年，我们重新认识到在政治上，全球化的管理不仅需要允许胜者获胜，还要确保他们不作弊、也不忽略社会责任感。
en: In 2016, we are re-learning that, politically, globalization needs to be managed not just to permit the winners to win, but also to ensure that they do not cheat or neglect their responsibilities to their societies.

zh: 绝不能允许腐败的政客去迎合腐败的企业领袖。
en: There is no place for corrupt politicians pandering to corrupt business leaders.

zh: 重建信心将异常困难。
en: Restoring confidence will be difficult.

zh: 企业领袖需要从整个社会获取“经营许可证 ” ， 并为确保其繁荣的社会条件做出显著的贡献。
en: Business leaders will need to secure a “license to operate” from society at large, and contribute visibly to sustaining the conditions that support their prosperity.

zh: 第一步应该是缴纳税收。
en: They can start by paying their taxes.

zh: 政府必须与不履行义务的企业坚决疏远。
en: Governments will need to distance themselves from the companies that fail to do their part.

zh: 不仅如此，他们必须调整自己的作为，以证明其自身的公正性。
en: Moreover, they must overhaul their own operations, to prove their impartiality.

zh: 稳健的监管需要大幅投资于政府能力以及相关的法律服务。
en: Robust regulation will require significant investment in government capacity and the legal services that support it.

zh: 最后，全球合作将至关重要。
en: Finally, global cooperation will be crucial.

zh: 已经完成的全球化不能走回头路。
en: Globalization cannot be undone.

zh: 但凭借共同的有力承诺，我们可以完成对全球化的监管任务。
en: But with a strong, shared commitment, it can be managed.

zh: 囹圄中的土耳其言论自由
en: Turkey’s Imprisoned Press

zh: 巴黎—据两份土耳其亲政府报纸《星报 》 （ Star）和《新瓦基特报 》 （ Yeni Akit）报道及土耳其总理埃尔多安本人的说法，谴责土耳其言论自由状况者属于“恐怖分子 ” 。
en: PARIS – According to two pro-government newspapers in Turkey, Star and Yeni Akit, as well as Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan himself, those who denounce the state of press freedom in Turkey are “terrorists.”

zh: 他们在上周用这个词所指的是纽约的保护记者委员会（Committee to Protect Journalists，CPJ）和巴黎的无国界记者（Reporters Sans Frontières ） ， 这两家机构报道说，在土耳其遭羁押的记者甚至比伊朗和中国还要多。
en: That is the term that they were using last week to denounce the New York-based Committee to Protect Journalists and the Paris-based Reporters Sans Frontières, both of which have issued reports saying that Turkey has imprisoned even more journalists than Iran and China.

zh: 去年10月，CPJ报道说76名记者在土耳其遭到羁押，其中61人因新闻工作而被拘禁。
en: Last October, the CPJ reported that there were 76 journalists imprisoned in Turkey, including 61 who were in jail for their journalistic work.

zh: 12月，在法庭无罪释放了一批人后，这一数字降为49人，但仍有大量记者被关在监狱中。
en: While the latter number declined to 49 by December, after some of those held were freed by the courts, that is still a lot of journalists to hold in prison.

zh: 多年来，在埃尔多安的领导下，土耳其的人权状况一直在显著改善，出现这样的状况令人无比沮丧。
en: The situation is especially dismaying, given that, for several years, Turkey’s human-rights performance had been improving dramatically under Erdoğan’s leadership.

zh: 用刑的情况有了显著下降。
en: The use of torture had declined sharply.

zh: 人数众多的少数派库尔德人的文化权利（包括使用自己的语言的权利）有了很大进步。
en: The cultural rights of the large Kurdish minority, including the right to use their own language, had advanced greatly.

zh: 军方对文职政府的控制早已寿终正寝。
en: Military control over the civilian government had been ended.

zh: 这些只是人权状况改善的部分例子。
en: And more.

zh: 但是，随着埃尔多安及其温和派伊斯兰正义和发展党巩固了手中的权力和对国家的掌控力，他们对异见人士的容忍度有所下降。
en: Yet, as Erdoğan and his moderate Islamist Justice and Development Party have consolidated their power and their control of the country, their tolerance for dissent has declined.

zh: 如今，互联网自由已基本消失。
en: Today, Internet freedom has largely disappeared.

zh: 法律授权政府对互联网内容予以过滤，大量网站被屏蔽，原因包括助长毒品使用或援引刑法攻击阿塔图尔克（现代土耳其国父、土耳其民族英雄 ） 。
en: Legislation provides for mandatory filtering of content, and many Web sites have been blocked for reasons that range from facilitating the use of drugs or stimulants to offenses under the Law on Crimes against Atatürk (the founder of the modern Turkish state and Turkey’s national hero).

zh: 尽管土耳其政府才是言论自由状况急转直下的罪魁祸首，但欧盟和美国的政策也脱不了干系。
en: Though it is the Turkish government that is to blame for the precipitous decline in press freedom, the policies of the European Union and the United States have been contributing factors.

zh: 欧盟曾表态说人权问题上的表现将是是否承认土耳其为成员国的关键决定因素。
en: The EU had indicated that performance on human rights would be a key factor in determining whether Turkey would be admitted as a member.

zh: 但在土耳其人权状况快速进步的时期，欧洲并没有伸出橄榄枝。
en: Yet it was during the period of rapid progress on human rights that Europe seemed to turn its back on the country.

zh: 这让支持土耳其人权改革之人感到十分沮丧。
en: This outcome undermined those in Turkey who had promoted human-rights reforms.

zh: 他们所宣称的人权状况进步将使土耳其进入欧盟的前景成了水中之月，土耳其官员也失去了一大重要激励。
en: Their claims that progress would lead to accession were shown to be false, and an important incentive for officials was eliminated.

zh: 如果通往欧盟的程序重回正轨，则将极大地有助于确保土耳其成为开放社会的努力。
en: If the process leading to EU accession is put back on track, it will greatly aid the effort to ensure that Turkey becomes an open society.

zh: 至于美国政府，在土耳其出现侵犯人权行为时，它总是说些无关痛痒的话。
en: The US government, for its part, tends to speak softly when it comes to human-rights abuses in Turkey.

zh: 冷战期间，作为苏联的近邻，土耳其的战略价值压倒了其他问题。
en: During the Cold War, Turkey’s strategic value, given its geographic proximity to the Soviet Union, outweighed other concerns.

zh: 如今，地理因素仍起着作用，尽管让美国不愿就其言论自由状况大做文章的原因已不再是苏联，而是叙利亚、伊拉克和伊朗。
en: Today, geography still plays a role, though it is Turkey’s contiguity with Syria, Iraq, and Iran that has left the US reluctant to make a fuss about press freedom.

zh: 美国曾支持土耳其加入欧盟，但若能敦促土耳其补足其短处，那么它的支持就会在欧洲拥有更高的信誉。
en: The US has supported Turkey’s accession to the EU, but its efforts would have more credibility in Europe if it also pressed Turkey to address its shortcomings.

zh: 情况还远未到达无望的程度。
en: The situation is far from hopeless.

zh: 土耳其是一个生机勃勃的公民社会，它拥有引以为豪的独立机构，其中不乏声誉卓著的大学。
en: Turkey has a lively civil society, with proudly independent institutions that include some renowned universities.

zh: 快速进步的时期过去没多久。
en: The period of rapid progress is not in the distant past.

zh: 如果土耳其成为欧盟成员国，那么欧洲从经济和军事上都能得到加强，而如果土耳其满足了包括言论自由在内的政治标准，那么它应该获得和其他成员国一致的准入谈判。
en: Europe would strengthen itself economically and militarily if Turkey became a member, and it should revive accession negotiations on the same basis as other member states if Turkey meets the political criteria, including press freedom.

zh: 随着新任国务卿约翰·克里的来访，美国应该认识到，像土耳其这样的四邻麻烦重重的伊斯兰大国应该展现出在人权问题上的领导力。
en: With John Kerry’s arrival as Secretary of State, the US ought to recognize that such a large Islamic country in a troubled neighborhood should show leadership on human-rights issues.

zh: 作为地区样板，土耳其应该有言论自由这一点是至关重要的。
en: As a role model for the region, it is especially important that Turkey should practice press freedom.

zh: 如果欧洲和美国做好了分内工作，就可能说服埃尔多安重新成为人权改革者，这也是他在成为总理后最初几年所扮演的角色。
en: If Europe and the US do their part, Erdoğan may be persuaded to resume the role of human-rights reformer that he played during his first several years in office.

zh: 回到阿富汗
en: Back to Afghanistan

zh: 正当伊拉克持续不断的暴力紧紧抓住全球媒体的头条新闻之时，阿富汗仍旧在为和平而挣扎。
en: While the unremitting violence in Iraq grabs the world’s headlines, Afghanistan still struggles for peace.

zh: 该国的议会充斥着军阀，毒品交易猖獗，而且暴力正在升级。
en: The country’s parliament is packed with warlords, the drug trade is thriving, and violence is on the rise.

zh: 本周，世界领导人们聚会英国伦敦，与阿富汗签订一项新协议，从而有机会将进展引入一个新的、更为充满希望的途径上来。
en: This week, world leaders have an opportunity to steer developments onto a new and more hopeful path when they meet in London to forge a new compact with Afghanistan.

zh: 这项协议将建立在2001年波恩协议基础之上。 波恩协议为民主阿富汗制定了框架，但是，在克服这一饱受战乱之苦的国家悲剧性的遗产上仍然有所欠缺。
en: The compact builds on the 2001 Bonn Agreement, which laid the framework for a democratic Afghanistan but left much to be done to overcome that war-torn country’s tragic legacy.

zh: 现在急需重新把注意力集中到阿富汗上。
en: The need for renewed attention to Afghanistan could hardly be greater.

zh: 长达几十年的漠不关心，加之外国干预使得该国民不聊生，并在全世界引发影响。
en: Decades of neglect coupled with foreign intervention left the country in ruins, with reverberations across the world.

zh: 现在，帮助重建阿富汗符合每个人的利益。
en: It is now in everyone’s interest to help Afghanistan rebuild.

zh: 毒品交易就是该国国内不稳定造成的深远影响的例证。
en: The drug trade exemplifies the far-reaching impact of domestic instability.

zh: 阿富汗是全球最大的鸦片制剂供应者。 据估计，去年在阿富汗生产的毒品价值高达国民生产总值的25 ％ 。
en: Last year, the value of drugs produced in Afghanistan – the world’s largest supplier of opiates – is estimated to have reached up to 25% of GDP.

zh: 安全同样也还是令人忧心。
en: Security, too, remains a serious concern.

zh: 2005年，超过125名联合部队士兵被杀，而人肉炸弹涌现成为一个新的、而且是日益常见的叛乱战术。
en: In 2005, more than 125 Coalition troops were killed, while suicide bombing emerged as a new and increasingly common tactic of the insurgency.

zh: 腐败盛行，政府官员被指控任人唯亲以及贩毒。
en: Corruption is rampant, with government officials accused of cronyism and drug trafficking.

zh: 几个新近当选的议会议员是世人皆知的军阀，血债累累。
en: Several members of the newly elected parliament are known warlords with bloody records.

zh: 由于国际援助协调不善，美国正在削减其军队力量。 许多阿富汗人相信，外部世界正在抛弃他们。
en: With international aid poorly coordinated and the United States reducing its troop strength, many Afghans believe that the outside world is abandoning them.

zh: 但是，阿富汗面对的重重挑战不应当掩盖其积极性变化的机遇。
en: But the massive scale of the challenges facing Afghanistan should not overshadow the opportunities for positive change.

zh: 波恩进程建立了民主负责制的原则，给了阿富汗第一个直选的总统，提供了一部在真切的辩论和妥协后批准的新宪法，并且建立了一个合法的中央政府。
en: The Bonn process established the principle of democratic accountability, gave Afghanistan its first directly elected president, and provided a new constitution that – approved after genuine debate and compromise – created a legitimate central government.

zh: 它还为议会铺平了道路，超过四分之一的议员是妇女。 仅仅在五年前，该国的妇女还不准在没有男性亲属陪同的情况下离开家门。
en: It also paved the way for a parliament in which over a quarter of the members are women – this in a country where, just five years ago, women were not even allowed to leave the house without a male relative.

zh: 而且，两万个村落委员会中的大多数都是通过秘密投票选举产生的。
en: Moreover, most of the 20,000 village councils were elected through secret ballot.

zh: 世界银行及其伙伴们首肯了这些委员会在最基层实现变革的重要性，并且制定了一个极为创新的项目来通过这些委员会发放农村发展援助。 最近，这些委员会被授权决定如何使用这些资金。
en: In a nod to the importance of the councils to realizing change at the most local level, the World Bank and its partners have adopted a highly innovative program that channels rural development aid through the councils, which have been empowered to decide how the funds will be spent.

zh: 在全国性的层面上，政府最近批准了一项高瞻远瞩的新发展战略。 该战略为阿富汗的未来稳定和增长提供了远景构想。
en: At the national level, the government recently approved a new development strategy that goes far to advance a vision for Afghanistan’s future stability and growth.

zh: 舆论反映出对最新变革的广泛支持。
en: Public opinion reflects widespread support for the latest changes.

zh: 最近的一项民意调查显示，绝大多数阿富汗人赞成该国的新走向，也就是支持妇女参与公众生活以及针对基地组织、塔利班以及毒品经济的国际干预。
en: A recent poll shows that Afghans overwhelmingly favor their country’s new direction – backing the participation of women in public life and international intervention against al Qaeda, the Taliban, and the drug economy.

zh: 但是，阿富汗潜在的进步必须得到协调一致的国际行动支持。
en: But Afghanistan’s potential for progress must be bolstered by concerted international action.

zh: 世界领导人在伦敦会议上应当支持由阿富汗政府最近批准的反毒品战略。 这一战略将减少对鸦片生产的经济依赖，惩罚毒贩和经销人，并且为罂粟种植农提供可持续的经济性替代。
en: At the London Conference, world leaders should support the counter-narcotics strategy recently approved by the Afghan government, which would reduce economic dependence on opium production, punish traffickers and dealers, and provide sustainable economic alternatives for poppy farmers.

zh: 阿富汗正在应付全世界最大的毒品问题，捐助国必须为一项长期的毒品控制战略作出承诺。
en: Afghanistan is grappling with the world’s biggest narcotics problem and donors must commit to a long-term drug control strategy.

zh: 这一会议应当落实由欧洲议会通过的一项决议，即考虑阿富汗是否应该成为获得许可为医学目的生产鸦片的国家之一。
en: The conference should follow up on a resolution by the European Parliament to consider whether Afghanistan should become one of the countries licensed to produce opium for medical purposes.

zh: 而且，伦敦会议应当力争帮助实现阿富汗政府为年轻人提供带领该国走向未来和平与繁荣所必需的技能和教育的基准，而不是把数以亿计美元投入技术援助和短期能力建设项目之中。
en: Furthermore, instead of pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into technical assistance and short-term capacity-building programs, the London conference should strive to help meet the Afghan government’s benchmark for equipping young people with the skills and education necessary to lead their nation to a future of peace and prosperity.

zh: 国际支持可以帮助每年在诸如工程、管理、农业、法律以及经济等急需的领域教育四万名阿富汗人。
en: International support could help educate 40,000 Afghans each year in urgently needed fields, such as engineering, management, agriculture, law, and economics.

zh: 司法改革也是另一项急迫问题。
en: Judicial reform is another pressing issue.

zh: 目前，该国司法体系无法审理小额的偷盗案件，更不用提保障人权。
en: Currently, the judiciary is incapable of trying a case of petty theft much less of ensuring human rights.

zh: 由保守派别控制的最高法院挑选法官和检察官。 而且，该国的体制允许控制司法的地方指挥官为所欲为，阿富汗人在这一体制中基本得不到法律赔偿。
en: A Supreme Court dominated by conservative factions has selected judges and prosecutors, and Afghans have little legal redress in a system that allows local commanders, who hold sway over the judiciary, to act with impunity.

zh: 没有可以存活的法律体系就无法留住外国投资。
en: Without a viable legal system, foreign investment will remain elusive.

zh: 移居海湾国家的阿富汗人已经在地区和全球贸易网络中投资了大约50亿美元，但即使是他们也不愿意在祖国投资。
en: Even Afghan expatriates in the Gulf states, who have invested roughly $5 billion in regional and global trading networks, are reluctant to invest in their homeland.

zh: 但是，改革毫无疑问是可能的。
en: Reform is nonetheless clearly possible.

zh: 上个月，尽管不情愿，但是阿富汗领导层还是批准了一项过渡期司法规划。 这一规划将剥夺那些在过去五年中巩固了对该国控制的最大战犯们的权力。
en: Last month, the Afghan leadership finally adopted – albeit half-heartedly – a transitional justice plan that could remove from power the biggest war criminals who have consolidated their grip on the country over the past five years.

zh: 实施这一规划不仅会极大地促进法制，而且会增强安全并导向更好的管制。
en: Implementation of this plan would not only give a boost to the rule of law, but also would enhance security and lead to better governance.

zh: 无所作为意味着背叛阿富汗人民。 他们在2001年把美国和北约军队当作解放者来欢迎。
en: Failure to act would mean a betrayal of the Afghan people, who in 2001 welcomed the US army and NATO forces as liberators.

zh: 为了他们、也是为了我们起见，我们不应该让他们失望。
en: For their sake, and ours, we must not let them down.

zh: 给美国国会的返校信
en: Back-to-School Letter to the US Congress

zh: 纽波特海滩—如果现在纷纷结束夏季休假的美国国会议员们收到来自焦虑的公民的“返校”信会怎样？
en: NEWPORT BEACH – What if members of the United States Congress, now returning from their summer recess, were to receive a “back to school” letter from concerned citizens?

zh: 这封信的大概会是这样子的。
en: Here is what a first draft might look like.

zh: 亲爱的国会议员：
en: Dear Member of Congress:

zh: 欢迎回到国会大厦。
en: Welcome back to the Capitol.

zh: 我们希望你们刚刚度过了一个愉快的夏季休假，现在你们回到了华盛顿，不但身心放松，而且充满了能量，做好了处理我们国家的重重经济挑战的准备。
en: We hope that you had a good summer break, and that you return to Washington not just rested, but also energized to take on our country’s mounting economic challenges.

zh: 在你们们离开国会大厦期间，各路消息喜忧参半。
en: The news has been mixed during your absence.

zh: 经济数据存在一些改善，但并不足以表明我们离决定性地克服此次低增长、高失业时期迈进了一步。
en: We have seen some improvement in economic data, but not enough to suggest that we are any closer to overcoming decisively this painful period of low growth and high unemployment.

zh: 此外，随着自我形成的财政悬崖步步逼近 — — 可能将我们国家重新推向衰退，并将世界其他地区也拖下水 — — 企业不愿招聘，也不愿投资新的资本品。
en: And, with a self-inflicted fiscal cliff looming – one that could send our country back into recession, pulling the rest of the world with us – businesses are reluctant to hire and invest in new capital goods.

zh: 幸运的是，美联储释放了继续积极的信号，但它的政策工具对我们所面临的挑战作用有限。
en: Fortunately, the Federal Reserve has signaled its intention to remain active, but its policy tools are poorly suited to the challenges that we face.

zh: 与此同时，全球困难仍然很大。
en: Meanwhile, global difficulties remain substantial.

zh: 我们仍然面临着巨大的阻力 — — 既来自深化中的欧债危机，也来自中东的地缘政治紧张局势。
en: We continue to face strong headwinds originating from the deepening European debt crisis, as well as geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.

zh: 中国 — — 曾经不可阻挡的世界增长引擎 — — 正在减速。
en: China, once the world’s unstoppable growth engine, is slowing.

zh: 而尽管表面一团和气，但多边政策合作基本上等于零。
en: And, despite all the happy talk, multilateral policy coordination is essentially non-existent.

zh: 所有这些都表明需要果断勇敢、远见卓识的经济领导；否则的话，我们的问题会恶化和增长，而解决方案会变得更加复杂。
en: All of this calls for courageous and visionary economic leadership; otherwise, our problems will fester and grow, and the solutions will become even more complex.

zh: 我们经济中的太多困难 — — 包括年轻人失业和长期失业的可怕趋势 — — 正在演变为结构性问题。
en: Already, too many of our economy’s difficulties, including worrisome trends in youth joblessness and long-term unemployment, risk becoming structurally embedded.

zh: 毫无疑问，你们已经注意到，在距离11月总统大选已不到十周之际，我们的国家牢牢地掌握在丑陋的政治把戏手中。
en: No doubt you have also noticed that, with less than ten weeks to go until the November presidential election, our country is in the grip of an increasingly ugly political campaign.

zh: 因此，在经济和政治的双重暗淡局面下，我们需要你们们提供方向和领导。
en: So, with this combination of bad economics and bad politics, we look to you for direction and leadership.

zh: 就这么简单、这么重要。
en: It is that simple, and that important.

zh: 我们需要你们克服旷日持久的国会扯皮和两极分化，从而治愈我们国家的顽疾。
en: We need you to overcome a prolonged period of congressional paralysis and polarization in order to address the country’s malaise.

zh: 我们需要你们的改革方案从战术思维转变为战略思维，从周期思维转变为长期思维，从局部思维转变为整体思维，从按部就班思维转变为同时推进思维。
en: We need you to pivot in your responses from the tactical to the strategic, from the cyclical to the secular, from the partial to the comprehensive, and from sequential to simultaneous reforms.

zh: 如果这一国家责任的呼吁还不够，那么我们还可以加上你们们的自身利益。
en: If this call to national duty is not enough, we would remind you of your own self-interest.

zh: 根据最新的NBC新闻 / 《 华尔街日报》调查，我们选民对你们的支持度只有12 % 。
en: According to the latest NBC News/Wall Street Journal poll, your support among us, the electorate, stands at just 12%.

zh: 我们认为，没有什么魔法能够克服我们国家的问题。
en: We concede that there is no magic wand to overcome our country’s problems.

zh: 毕竟，在迈向全球金融危机的这么多年中，美国的增长是通过资产负债表杠杆化而不是 “买”来和“借”来的，而不是通过增加竞争力“赚”来的。
en: After all, for too many years leading up to the global financial crisis, America “bought” and “borrowed” its growth by leveraging balance sheets, rather than “earning” it through increased competitiveness.

zh: 其结果是大规模人力资源配置不当、基础设施投资不足、对授信的过度依赖，当然还有不可持续的债务。
en: The result was massive misallocation of human resources, insufficient infrastructure investment, over-reliance on credit entitlements, and, of course, unsustainable debt.

zh: 让情况更糟糕的是，与此同时，在贸易和其他全球化位面的推动下，具系统重要性的新兴国家步入了它们的“发展突破阶段 ” 。
en: To make matters worse, this occurred at a time when systemically important emerging economies hit their “developmental breakout phase,” powered by trade and other aspects of globalization.

zh: 我们不指望你们一夜之间就解决美国的问题。
en: We do not expect you to solve America’s problems overnight.

zh: 但我们希望你们能给出合理而可持续的政策路径。
en: Instead, we look to you to embark on an appropriate and sustainable policy path.

zh: 因此，当你们放下包裹、结交新朋友、树立新敌人时，请谨记以下事项。
en: So, as you unpack your bags and renew old friendships and rivalries, please keep the following in mind.

zh: 改变国运要求你们和总统一起与我们 — — 社���公众开展更开放、更一致的经济对话，探讨我们所面临的挑战。
en: Changing course requires that you, together with the president, have a much more open and consistent economic dialogue with us, the general public, about the challenges that we face.

zh: 它还要求你们和总统形成统一的多目标多年政策计划，该计划至少要同时顾及六个关键领域：
en: It also requires that you and the president converge on a multi-prong, multi-year policy initiative that, at a minimum, makes simultaneous advances in six critical areas:

zh: ·         财政改革：我们迫切需要你们来消除税收制度和福利制度中期改革环境中的财政悬崖。
en: ·         Fiscal reform: We desperately need you to eliminate the looming fiscal cliff in the context of medium-term reforms of both the tax system and entitlements.

zh: 这也有利于当其他总需求成分开始减速时出台更大的财政刺激。
en: This would also allow for greater fiscal stimulus at a time when other components of aggregate demand are slowing.

zh: ·         劳动市场改革：持续的高失业和大量劳动力的退出向来都是劳动市场出现故障、需要通过更好的培训和再评寻予以支持的信号。
en: ·         Labor-market reform: Persistently high unemployment and large-scale withdrawal from the labor force are a constant reminder of a malfunctioning labor market that needs support through better training and retooling.

zh: 改革还必须解决与此相关的挑战：教育制度落后以及社会安全网不足。
en: Reform must also address the related challenges of a lagging education system and an insufficient social safety net.

zh: ·         房地产和房地产金融：萎靡不振的美国房地产市场是全球金融危机的根源，并仍然是经济的重负之一。
en: ·         Housing and housing finance: At the root of the global financial crisis, the troubled US housing market continues to act as a millstone around the economy’s neck.

zh: 房地产问题拖得越久，消费者和企业情绪的压力就越大，失业者找到和被配置到新就业机会的机会就越小。
en: The longer the problems persist, the greater the pressure on consumer and business sentiment, and the harder it is for the unemployed to find and relocate to new job opportunities.

zh: ·         信用渠道不畅：银行资产负债表仍在收缩，太多中小规模企业无法动员足够的信用用于投资和增长。
en: ·         Clogged credit pipes: With banks’ balance sheets contracting, too many small and medium-size companies are unable to mobilize credit for investment and growth.

zh: 意识到银行稳下来需要几年才能实现，美国需要打造新的信用渠道。
en: Recognizing that it will take years until banks are properly stabilized, America needs to build new conduits for credit.

zh: ·         基础设施：你们出国旅行过就会明白，我们的基础设施正大大落后于越来越多的国家。
en: ·         Infrastructure: Those of you who have traveled abroad know that our infrastructure is desperately lagging that of a growing number of countries.

zh: 这让我们国家的公司竞争和发展难上加难。
en: This makes it even harder for our companies to compete and prosper.

zh: ·         全球政策合作：随着我们的问题让我们变得更孤立、更内向，近几年来美国的传统领导地位不复存在。
en: ·         Global policy coordination: America’s traditional leadership role has evaporated in recent years as our problems have made us more insular and inward-looking.

zh: 如果由此产生的真空被填补，那么这并不是一个问题。
en: This would not be a major problem if the resulting vacuum had been filled.

zh: 但事实并非如此。
en: But that has not happened.

zh: 相反，G7已名存实亡，IMF因代表和正当性问题而被削弱，而G20还没有站稳脚跟。
en: On the contrary, the G-7 has lost relevance, the International Monetary Fund is hampered by its representation and legitimacy deficits, and the G-20 is still finding its feet.

zh: 出台这样一个日程并不是不可能完成的任务。
en: Engineering such an agenda is not an overwhelming challenge.

zh: 但如果你们 — — 我们选出来的代表 — — 不能精诚合作的话，这一点并不能令人放心。
en: But that will provide little comfort if you, our elected representatives, do not collaborate effectively.

zh: 国会在这个任期中的选择很简单：要么解决美国面临的挑战；要么背上因犹豫不决而使子孙后代过得连祖先都不如的恶名。
en: The choice Congress faces this term is simple: either address head on America’s challenges, or risk being remembered as the body whose dithering condemned future generations to being worse off than their parents.

zh: 此致
en: Yours sincerely,

zh: 焦虑的公民
en: Concerned citizens

zh: 乌克兰重临深渊
en: Back to the Brink in Ukraine

zh: 乌克兰9月30日的国会大选还没有开始，总理维克托·亚努科维奇就已经在想法暗渡陈仓。
en: The campaign for Ukraine’s parliamentary election of September 30th is scarcely underway and yet Prime Minister Viktor Yanukovych is already trying to steal it.

zh: 2004年的总统大选结果亚努科维奇就曾试图弄虚作假，结果激起了橙色革命，最后因为乌克兰总统列昂尼德·库奇马没有理会亚努科维奇的要求用暴力保住作弊赢得的大选，才得以取得一个和平、真实的结果。
en: Yanukovych was the man who sought to falsify the result of the presidential election of 2004, inciting the Orange Revolution. Back then, a peaceful and honest result was reached in the end because Ukraine’s President Leonid Kuchma refused to heed Yanukovych’s call to use violence to defend his rigged election.

zh: 这一次，为了保住权势，亚努科维奇似乎准备无所不用其极。
en: This time it appears that Yanukovych is prepared to do anything to remain in power.

zh: 他的卑鄙手段始于8月11日午夜，乌克兰的中央选举委员会（里面挤满了亚努科维奇的走狗）拒绝让最大的反对党（前总理尤丽雅·季莫申科的政治团体）参与竞选。
en: The dirty tricks began in the midnight hours of August 11th, when Ukraine’s Central Election Commission (which is packed with Yanukovych placemen) refused to certify the largest opposition party, the bloc of former Prime Minister Yuliya Tymoshenko, to participate in the election.

zh: 委员会援引的技术细节几近荒谬可笑，而其可能造成的后果则极具煽动性：委员会反对季莫申科集团的理由是其候选人在政党名单上只列出了各自的籍贯，没有写明具体的街道地址。
en: The technicality the commission cited would be absurdly funny if its potential results were not so incendiary: the CEC objected to the fact that the Tymoshenko bloc candidates listed only their home towns on the party list, not their precise street address.

zh: 然而季莫申科的政党曾在2006年3月的选举中成功地提交名单，格式一模一样，这说明选举委员会的政治偏向有多么明显。
en: But Tymoshenko’s party successfully submitted its list in the very same format at the March 2006 election, which demonstrates the glaringly partisan nature of the election commission’s ruling.

zh: 为了不择手段地保住权力，亚努科维奇很可能带来一场大洪水。
en: By seeking to cling to power by hook or by crook, Yanukovych is likely to bring on the deluge.

zh: 在乌克兰，这不仅意味着暴动，还有经济滑坡和新一轮的压迫，最终可能导致橙色革命那种大规模的街头抗议活动，以及暴力镇压企图。
en: In Ukraine that means not only violent unrest, but economic decline and renewed repression. At the end of the day it could lead to the sort of huge street protests that marked the Orange Revolution, and their attempted violent suppression.

zh: 近代史上到处是令人惊惧的独裁者，以及不愿承认自己的辉煌已经结束的潜在独裁者。
en: Recent history is replete with alarming examples of dictators and would be dictators who refuse to recognize when their time has run out.

zh: 然而，过去二十年来，他们明目张胆的政治欺骗遭到了一股有力的新生力量的抵抗：那些不愿在恐吓面前屈服的普通人联合起来发出的声音。
en: But for the past twenty years their blatant political chicanery has been met with a potent new force: the massed voices of ordinary people who refuse to be cowed.

zh: 从1986年菲律宾推倒费迪南德·马科斯的“人民权力”革命，到1991年8月叶利钦反抗针对戈尔巴乔夫的政变阴谋，再到近年来的玫瑰革命、橙色革命和雪杉革命，只要有足够的人站出来，独裁者只能被迫承认失败。
en: From the “People Power” revolution that toppled Ferdinand Marcos in the Philippines in 1986 to Boris Yeltsin’s defiance of the attempted coup against Mikhail Gorbachev of August 1991, to the Rose, Orange, and Cedar Revolutions of recent years, dictators have been forced to admit defeat when enough people stand up to them.

zh: 乌克兰人是否真的必须再次发动橙色革命，聚集数百万人反抗亚努科维奇（此人进入政坛之前曾两次因暴力获罪 ） ， 才能改变事态？
en: Will it really be necessary for Ukrainians to repeat the Orange Revolution by again gathering in their millions to shame Yanukovych (a twice convicted violent felon before he entered politics) to change course?

zh: 有一个人或许可以迫使亚努科维奇退回民主准则，从而阻止这样的抗议 — — 俄罗斯总统普京。
en: There is a person who might compel Yanukovych to retreat to democratic norms and thus hold off such protests -- Russia’s President Vladimir Putin.

zh: 帮助俄罗斯最大的邻国避免混乱肯定符合该国的国家利益。
en: It is certainly in Russia’s national interest to prevent chaos in the country’s big next door neighbor.

zh: 但是，根据普京心目中的俄罗斯国家利益，这样的干预不大可能发生。
en: But Putin’s idea of what constitutes Russia’s national interest makes that type of intervention unlikely.

zh: 弱小的邻国可以为克里姆林宫所控制，因此，如果可以使这个国家重新回到普京的掌中，何不让乌克兰陷入纷争和无政府状态，从而扩大俄罗斯的权威？
en: Weak neighbors are states that the Kremlin can control, so why not expand Russian power by letting Ukraine slide into protest and anarchy if by doing so it brings that country back under Putin’s thumb?

zh: 而且，普京本人也在抑制俄罗斯的民主进程。 他亲手挑选自己的继任者，授意法院和选举委员会阻挠对手参与政治（通常是给对方泼上叛国者的污水 ） 。
en: Moreover, Putin himself is in the business of sterilizing Russia’s democratic processes by handpicking his successor and having his courts and electoral commissions block his opponents from political participation, often tarring them as traitors.

zh: 一个如此藐视本国人民民主权利的人，怎么可能捍卫外国人的民权？
en: Someone with such contempt for the democratic rights of his own people is unlikely to champion them abroad.

zh: 在乌克兰问题上，这位前克格勃情报人员故伎重施，老奸巨猾，不过如果他以为偏袒亚努科维奇可以让俄罗斯重新称霸乌克兰，那他就是在妄想。
en: As is usual with this ex-KGB man, Putin is being cunning about Ukraine, but he is deluding himself if he thinks that siding with Yanukovych will bring back effective Russian overlordship of Ukraine.

zh: 不管石油和天然气给俄罗斯带来多大的财富，帝国的时代已经结束。
en: The days of empire are over, no matter how much wealth oil and gas is bringing to Russia.

zh: 乌克兰只有保持独立，才能打破俄罗斯精英阶层的帝国梦。
en: Only if Ukraine maintains its independence will the imperial nostalgia of Russia’s elites be shattered.

zh: 因此，乌克兰需要其他方面的压力，主要来自欧盟和美国。
en: So other pressure will need to be applied, primarily by the European Union and the United States.

zh: 2004年，欧盟和美国对于声援乌克兰的民主人士都显得不情不愿，直到数百万聚集在基辅市中心的乌克兰百姓展现的勇气唤醒了世界舆论，美国和欧盟才站出来捍卫真实的选举结果。
en: In 2004, both the EU and US were tardy in speaking in defense of Ukraine’s democrats. Only when the courage of millions of ordinary Ukrainians gathered in central Kyiv galvanized world opinion did the US and EU marshal the courage to stand up for an honest election result.

zh: 而当时自始至终一直站在乌克兰身边的国家波兰，由于其当前领导人的偏执行为，如今已惹恼了欧盟的许多人，特别是德国。
en: And the one state that did stand with Ukraine from the start back then, Poland, has now antagonized much of EU opinion, particularly in Germany, because of the paranoid behavior of its current leaders.

zh: 因此波兰在欧盟委员会上的影响力已跌倒谷底。
en: So Polish influence in Union councils is at rock bottom.

zh: 幸运的是，欧洲最大三个国家的领导人已不是2004年的那些人。
en: Luckily, the leaders of Europe’s three biggest states are different people than in 2004.

zh: 安格拉·默克尔、尼古拉·萨科奇和戈登·布朗似乎更加清楚欧盟东部的安全问题，因此或许愿意立即采取决定性的行动，而不是像2004年乌克兰陷入危机时他们的前任那样不知所措。
en: Angela Merkel, Nicolas Sarkozy, and Gordon Brown appear to have a clearer appreciation of the Union’s security problems to its east, and so may find the will to act decisively now, rather than dither as their predecessors did when Ukraine moved into crisis in 2004.

zh: 除非乌克兰的民主势力获准参与竞选，否则一场新的危机迫在眉睫。
en: Unless Ukraine’s democratic opposition is allowed to take part in the election, a new crisis is certain.

zh: 经历了三次刺杀而不倒的季莫申科可不是会因为技术细节而放弃竞选的女性。
en: Tymoshenko, who has survived three assassination attempts, is not the type of woman to surrender her campaign on a technicality.

zh: 橙色革命使乌克兰老百姓的权利意识空前高涨，但仅靠革命无法保证这些权利在接下来的几周里得到维护。
en: While the Orange Revolution made ordinary Ukrainians more conscious of their rights than ever before, this alone cannot guarantee that they are certain to see those rights vindicated in the coming weeks.

zh: 不过，要镇压他们也将变得更加困难。
en: However, it will make the job of repressing them much harder.

zh: 这不正是民主斗争的目的吗？
en: And isn’t that what the battle for democracy is all about?

zh: 回到金融史上的解决方案
en: Back to the Future in Finance

zh: 佛罗伦萨 — — 美国总统奥巴马最近出台的银行业“大修”草案，其核心思想来自美联储前主席保罗·沃尔克。
en: FLORENCE – Former Federal Reserve Board Chairman Paul Volcker provided the central inspiration for President Barack Obama’s proposal for overhauling banking.

zh: 沃尔克无疑是 20 世纪最成功的中央银行家，从很早起，他就一直在警告人们，那个“光鲜的金融新体系”存在种种问题。
en: Without question the most successful central banker of the twentieth century, Volcker was an early and persistent voice warning of the problems of what he called “the bright new financial system.”

zh: 但沃尔克也是批评货币波动性危险的代表人物之一。
en: But Volcker has also been a prominent critic of the dangers of currency volatility.

zh: 他一方面缅怀昔日那种较为简单、低风险的银行体系，另一方面试图重建一种带有旧时代痕迹的货币体系，在这两者之间存在什么关联呢？
en: What is the link between nostalgia for a simplified and less risky banking sector and the wish to reintroduce a currency system that also seems a relic of the past?

zh: 1 月 21 日，奥巴马以极富戏剧性和战斗姿态的方式宣布了改革草案，在此之前，关于是否要恢复 20 世纪 30 年代式的银行监管制度，已有大量讨论。
en: There was already much discussion about reviving 1930’s-style regulation of banks before Obama’s dramatic and combative announcement on January 21.

zh: 该草案主张的是所谓“沃尔克法则 ” ： 禁止自营交易、不让银行“拥有、投资或资助”对冲基金或私募股权基金，可谓是格拉斯 — 斯蒂格尔法案的一个升级版。 该法案于 1933 年在美国通过，旨在令投资银行和商业银行分业经营。
en: The proposals for what is now called the “Volcker rule,” which would ban proprietary trading and prevent banks from “owning, investing in, or sponsoring” hedge funds or private equity funds, is an updated version of the Glass-Steagall Act, the law enacted in the United States in 1933 to separate investment banking from commercial banking.

zh: 20 世纪 30 年代时，许多国家都想要限制银行业活动。
en: The drive in the 1930’s to restrict banking activities occurred in many countries.

zh: 虽然在 19 世纪早期就建立起第一个全能银行，比利时当时也勒令投行和商行业务分开。
en: In Belgium, where the first universal banks had been established in the early nineteenth century, investment and commercial banking were also separated.

zh: 意大利的银行则不许持有工业企业证券。
en: Italian banks were banned from holding securities in industrial corporations.

zh: 当年主张分业经营的理由与今日不同，不是要拆分某些“大到不能倒”的银行，而是要防止银行蒙骗客户。
en: The argument of the 1930’s was cast less in terms of banks that were “too big to fail” than as a response to the faulty advice that banks had offered their clients.

zh: 当时的投行经常搞的一个勾当是，把自己承销的（尤其是外国企业和政府所发行的）股票和债券卖给自己的零售客户，从而转嫁风险，并赚取高额佣金。
en: Investment banks had sold shares and bonds (especially for foreign corporations and governments) to their retail customers, offloaded their own risk, and created a large revenue stream of fees for themselves.

zh: 跟现在一样的是，当时也有许多人要求惩处涉嫌舞弊的银行和银行家。
en: Then, as now, many people demanded some punishment for the banks and bankers.

zh: 但他们也要求银行配置更多资金于国内投资和产业领域。
en: But they also wanted banks to direct more resources to financing domestic investments and industry.

zh: 当年的银行改革的确惩处了不少银行家，但在促进银行放贷方面却乏善可陈。
en: The bank reforms generally did punish the bankers, but they were not successful in promoting new bank lending.

zh: 今日讨论的焦点主要不是银行给客户造成的危险，而是给纳税人造成的风险。
en: Today’s discussion focuses less on the danger that banks pose to their customers than on the risks they create for taxpayers.

zh: 为自营交易辩护者，不说它能给银行带来巨额利润（这一块利润的确丰厚 ） ， 而是说它有做市功能，能够为那些罕有人交易的金融工具提供流动性。
en: Proprietary trading was justified not because it created large profits for banks (it did), but because it was supposed to create markets and provide liquidity for rarely traded instruments.

zh: 据说，银行建立起来的市场实际上是它们的内测市场，主要功能是方便银行及其客户对某些金融工具进行定价 — — 没有市场交易，这种定价通常是不可能的。
en: The banks themselves established what in effect were their own substitute markets, which allowed their customers and themselves to price instruments that would otherwise have been impossible to value.

zh: 而由此得来的巨额利润则被说成是提供一种公共服务所应得回报。
en: The huge profits were supposed to be the reward for the provision of a public service.

zh: 大银行之所以有用，是因为光靠小银行是无法做市的。
en: Such large banks are needed because small players alone cannot make a market.

zh: 在国际货币市场上，大市场也是主要玩家，它们或者通过支行间的操作，或是以一种坚实的货币为基础，积累起巨大的外汇头寸。
en: Big banks are also major players in international currency markets, and accumulate major foreign-exchange positions both between their subsidiaries and on a consolidated basis.

zh: 如果说现代的银行规模太大太危险，是因为它们太脆弱；要把它们改造得更安全，最直接一个办法是提高法定资本金。
en: If modern banks are too big and too dangerous because they are too vulnerable, the most obvious way to make them safer is to demand higher capital requirements.

zh: 历史上的讨论多数是遵循这个思路。
en: Historically, that was the course advocated in most international discussions.

zh: 然而不幸的是，这个最直接的办法会削弱银行的放贷。
en: But, unfortunately, the most obvious way for banks to increase their capital ratios is to curtail their lending.

zh: 在经济下行期，这是最不受欢迎的一个结果。
en: In an economic downturn, that is the last thing that businesses need or want.

zh: 走出这个两难困境的新思路是，立法规定哪些种类的业务应被剔除。
en: The new answer to the dilemma is to legislate what sorts of activity should be cut out completely.

zh: 这个思路希望重新界定金融活动的重点，修剪枝蔓，从而促进核心领域的放贷。
en: The hope is that refocusing financial activities in this way will revive other types of lending.

zh: 在 20 世纪 30 年代，伴随着银行管制的加强，资本流管制日益趋紧，最终迎来了固定汇率。
en: In the 1930’s, the control of banks went hand in hand with the control of capital movements and in the end with the fixing of exchange rates.

zh: 有一些经济学家，尤其是奥地利人哥特弗里德·哈勃勒（ Gottfried Haberler ）曾经构想了一套替代方案：由大金融机构和浮动汇率促成持续的资本流动，但是政治上的响应者寥寥。
en: The alternative of continued capital movements, facilitated by major financial institutions, and flexible exchange rates was set out by a few economists, notably the Austrian Gottfried Haberler, but found no political resonance.

zh: 1944 年布雷顿森林协议签署，创立了战后世界金融构架，时任美国财政部长的亨利·摩根索（ Henry Morgenthau ）在布雷顿森林会议的闭幕演讲上呼吁，建立一个更有效的银行体系，以更优惠的条件提供信贷 ： “ 其效果将是 ， . . . . . . 只把高利贷者逐出国际金融的圣殿。
en: In celebrating the conclusion of the 1944 Bretton Woods agreement, which created the post-war world’s financial architecture, US Treasury Secretary Henry Morgenthau’s used his closing address to the conference to call for a more effective banking system that provided more money on cheaper terms: “The effect would be …to drive only the usurious money lenders from the temple of international finance.”

zh: 自从 20 世纪 70 年代早期布雷顿森林汇率制度崩溃以来，人们普遍认为浮动汇率体系能带来更高的稳定性。
en: After the collapse of the Bretton Woods exchange-rate regime in the early 1970’s, it was widely supposed that a flexible currency system would bring more stability.

zh: 尽管我们直到最近才明白，金融巨无霸也会导致金融动荡，但是长期以来，外汇市场的特点就是波动性与不确定性。
en: But, whereas we only recently learned that financial behemoths create financial instability, foreign-exchange markets for a long time were characterized by volatility and uncertainty.

zh: 这些市场需要大银行充当稳定器和交易对家。
en: These markets needed the big banks to act as stabilizers and take the other side of bets.

zh: 一旦大银行不再能够扮演这一角色，被迫收缩规模，市场波动的概率就会上升。
en: When large banks are unable to play this role, and are forced to retrench, the likelihood of market volatility increases.

zh: 本轮危机如果持续下去，就可能导致更多外汇危机，因为各国政府的信用跟它们国家银行的风险敞口紧密相关。
en: The continuation of the current crisis is likely to produce more foreign-exchange crises, as governments’ creditworthiness and the position of their banks go hand in hand.

zh: 1992 年，当危机冲击欧洲货币体系之际，法国财政部长，米歇尔·萨潘（ Michel Sapin ）对议会说起，法国大革命是如何用断头台对付投机客。
en: In 1992, during the crisis that rocked the European Monetary System, France’s finance minister, Michel Sapin, spoke in parliament about how the French Revolution had used the guillotine on speculators.

zh: 我们是否能够回到 1944 年，吸取 20 世纪 30 年代的国际教训，再一次确立固定汇率？
en: Could we go back to 1944, when the lessons of the 1930’s were drawn at an international level, and fix exchange rates once more?

zh: 那可能同一切现代经济学的理论背道而驰，但如果我们回顾金融解决方案的历史，它也并非不可考虑。
en: That would run counter to almost every argument of modern economics, but, at a moment when we are looking to the past for financial solutions, it is no longer unthinkable.

zh: 重回哈萨克斯坦的大棋局
en: Back to the Great Game in Kazakhstan

zh: 布鲁塞尔 - - 那些反对与哈萨克斯坦和好的人指出该国缺乏政治权利和人权。
en: BRUSSELS – Those who oppose Western rapprochement with Kazakhstan cite the country’s lack of political and human rights.

zh: 但是，尽管哈萨克斯坦并非像乌克兰和格鲁吉亚等其他后苏联共和国那样走向民主的“颜色革命”之路，其在改革上的软弱并不应当为孤立该国提供理由。
en: But, while Kazakhstan has not gone down the “color revolution” route to democracy that other post-Soviet republics like Ukraine and Georgia have followed, its timidity about reform does not justify isolation.

zh: 毕竟，西方在与专制的俄罗斯和共产主义中国打交道上丝毫并不怯步。
en: After all, the West is not deterred in the slightest from dealing with authoritarian Russia and communist China.

zh: 而且，哈萨克斯坦尽管是一个穆斯林占多数的国家，但是它建立了一种世俗、多种族以及宗教多元的政治体制，而这种体制正是西方想要在整个穆斯林世界加以鼓励的。
en: Moreover, Kazakhstan, though a Muslim majority country, has established the type of secular, multi-ethnic, and multi religious polity that the West is seeking to encourage throughout the Muslim world.

zh: 但是西方不得孤立哈萨克斯坦的主要原因是地理政治上的。
en: But the principal reasons for the West not to isolate Kazakhstan are geostrategic.

zh: 正当欧盟急于想要摆脱其对俄国石油供应依赖的时候，哈萨克斯坦乐意向西方出售其石油和天然气。
en: The Kazakhs are keen to sell their oil and gas to the West at the very moment that the European Union is anxious to shed its dependence on Russian supplies.

zh: 但是欧盟和哈萨克斯坦夥伴关系的机遇之窗可能正在关闭。
en: Yet the window of opportunity for an EU-Kazakh partnership may be closing.

zh: 哈萨克斯坦与俄国的历史联系及其与中国在地理上的接近造成这两国相互竞争获得对哈萨克斯坦的影响力。
en: Kazakhstan’s historical ties to Russia and its geographical proximity to China have caused a keen competition between those two countries for influence.

zh: 因此，欧洲加入这一获得影响力的“大棋局”并且把哈萨克斯坦的政治取向向西方转移极为重要。
en: It is vital that Europe join in this “great game” for influence and draw Kazakhstan’s political orientation westwards.

zh: 现在有迹象表明欧洲终于看到了哈萨克斯坦提供的可能性。
en: There are signs that Europe is finally waking up to the possibilities that Kazakhstan offers.

zh: 确实，最近的两个事态可以帮助把哈萨克斯坦稳定为西方的一个盟国。
en: Indeed, two recent developments may help anchor Kazakhstan as a Western ally.

zh: 第一是该国当选为欧洲安全与合作组织2010年度的轮值主席国。
en: The first is the country’s election to the annual rotating chairmanship of the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) in 2010.

zh: 哈萨克斯坦不顾英国和其他欧洲国家的强烈反对，多年来一直争取这一机会。
en: Kazakhstan had lobbied for years for this opportunity in the face of fierce opposition from Britain and other EU countries.

zh: 它当选领导欧安组织被认为是对纳扎尔巴耶夫总统与西方接触政策的奖励。
en: Its selection to lead the OSCE is seen as a reward for President Nursultan Nazarbayev’s policy of engagement with the West.

zh: 俄国极为怀疑欧安组织，克里姆林宫最近限制了欧安组织前往俄国选举的观察员人数，所以哈萨克斯坦将来主持欧安组织表明该国急于接近西方，并且并不害怕挑战其原先克里姆林宫的主子。
en: Russia is deeply suspicious of the OSCE – the Kremlin recently restricted the number of OSCE observers for Russian elections – so Kazakhstan’s future stewardship hints that the Kazahks are anxious to move closer to the West, and unafraid to challenge their former masters in the Kremlin.

zh: 长远而言，作为欧盟与其近邻国家关系的蓝图的欧洲邻国政策提供了培植这一关系的最佳机会。
en: In the long term, the European Neighborhood Policy (ENP), the EU’s blueprint for relations with states on its periphery, offers the best chance for nurturing this relationship.

zh: 这一政策是用来在安全、经济发展、法治以及尊重人权的基础等共同利益的基础上在欧盟周围建立“朋友圈 ” 。
en: The ENP is designed to forge a “circle of friends” around the EU based on shared interests in security, economic development, the rule of law, and respect for human rights.

zh: 欧洲议会目前已经拒绝了哈萨克斯坦未来一天成为欧洲邻国政策成员国的可能。
en: The European Parliament has, for now, rejected the idea that Kazakhstan could one day become an ENP member.

zh: 但是，如果不让哈萨克斯坦被拖入中国或俄国轨道，就要克服这一狭隘的观点。
en: But this narrowness of vision will have to be overcome if Kazakhstan is not to be lured into either the Chinese or Russian orbits.

zh: 在所有方面，哈萨克斯坦都是这一政策合适的夥伴。
en: Kazakhstan is a suitable partner for the ENP in every respect.

zh: 该国西南边境与南高加索和土耳其处于同一纬度，这两个国家都已经是这一政策的国家，而土耳其还是欧盟成员候选国。
en: The country’s southwest edge is on the same longitude as the countries of the south Caucasus and Turkey, all of which are already ENP countries or in the case of Turkey an EU candidate.

zh: 仅仅是这一点就足以在地理上应该让哈萨克斯坦成为欧洲邻国政策成员国。
en: This alone makes a strong geographical case for Kazakhstan’s ENP status.

zh: 当然，人们担心言论自由以及缺乏媒体的多样性，但是哈萨克斯坦的情况并不比其土耳其兄弟的阿塞拜疆差，而阿塞拜疆则是这一政策完全成员国。
en: There are of course concerns about freedom of speech and a lack of media diversity, but conditions in Kazakhstan are no worse than in, say, Azerbaijan, its ethnic Turkic cousin, which is fully in the ENP.

zh: 而且，哈萨克斯坦已经与欧盟就其人权问题正式谈判。
en: Moreover, Kazakhstan is already in formal talks with the EU about human rights issues.

zh: 但是，鉴于哈萨克斯坦处于伊斯兰动荡新月的边缘，正是其从其苏联历史继承下来的强大世俗传统以及很大的欧洲基督教少数人口(占其1520万人口的大约40 % ) 才让它成为一个西方想要鼓励的社会。
en: But it is Kazakhstan’s strong secular tradition, inherited from its Soviet past, and a very large European Christian minority (approximately 40% of its 15.2 million people) that make it a society that the West needs to encourage, given the Islamic arc of instability upon which it sits.

zh: 把哈萨克斯坦拖向西方将会巩固这一世俗传统。
en: Drawing Kazakhstan westward would help embed this secular tradition.

zh: 挑战是一目了然的。
en: The challenge is clear.

zh: 俄国和中国不会等待欧盟决定哈萨克斯坦是否是一个有价值的夥伴。
en: Russia and China will not wait for the EU to make up its mind about whether Kazakhstan is a worthy partner.

zh: 哈萨克斯坦已经在上海合作组织中发挥关键作用。 上合组织包含中亚国家以及俄国和中国。
en: Kazakhstan already plays a key role in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO), a group that comprises Central Asian countries, along with Russia and China.

zh: 上合组织很像欧安组织和欧盟，关注于地区安全、经济联系以及文化团结。
en: The SCO focuses on regional security, economic ties, and cultural cohesion in much the same way as the OSCE and EU do.

zh: 毫无疑问，上合组织是俄国和中国用来对抗美国战略霸权的地区安全集团基础上建立多极世界的工具。
en: There is little doubt that the SCO is an instrument for Russia and China to make the case for a multi-polar world based on regional security blocs that counterbalance American strategic hegemony.

zh: 因此，如果欧盟坐失把哈萨克斯坦紧密联系到西方的机遇，那将会是悲剧。
en: It would therefore be tragic if the EU missed the opportunity to tie Kazakhstan firmly to the West.

zh: 将来或许不会有这么多机会了。
en: There may not be many more chances.

zh: 回归对文化绝望的政治
en: Back to the Politics of Cultural Despair

zh: 若干年前，历史学家弗里茨·施特恩写过一本有关德国的书，书名是《对文化绝望的政治 》 。
en: Some years ago the historian Fritz Stern wrote a book about Germany entitled The Politics of Cultural Despair.

zh: 书中列举了十九世纪末二十世纪初三位畅销书作家（现在已经少有人知了 ） ， 来说明很多德国人对现代世界，特别是市场经济和民主政治的切齿憎恶。
en: He used the example of three (now forgotten) bestselling authors of the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries to show the deep aversion of many Germans to the modern world, notably to market economics and democratic politics.

zh: 施特恩认为，正是在这样的文化土壤之上国家社会主义得以滋生。
