en: For Stern, this was part of the cultural soil in which National Socialism flourished.

zh: 纳粹时代以后发生了巨大的变化。
en: Much has changed since the Nazi era.

zh: 对文化绝望的政治经历了自杀式的疯狂和血腥的失败，随后诞生了经济奇迹，德国也成了世界上最繁荣的国家之一，近60年来德国的民主制度也日益巩固。
en: The murderous triumph and bloody defeat of the politics of cultural despair was followed by an economic miracle that made Germany one of the world’s most prosperous countries, with nearly six decades of increasingly stable democracy.

zh: 尽管如此，有些德国人仍然认为现代经济令人厌恶，向世界各国开放经济令人毛骨悚然。
en: Yet there are still traces within Germany of an attitude that finds modern economics distasteful and the opening of all frontiers to a globalized world frightening.

zh: “纯粹的资本主义”和“全球化”唤起了人们可怕的遐想。
en: “Pure capitalism” and “globalization” evoke horrific images.

zh: 引用执政的社会民主党主席弗兰茨·明特费林在前不久一次演讲中所打的一个不幸的比喻：成群结队的资本主义“蝗虫”马上会扑到毫无防备的劳苦大众身上。
en: Swarms of capitalist “locusts” threaten to descend on defenseless, hardworking people, to quote the unfortunate metaphor used in a recent speech by Franz Müntefering, the chairman of the governing Social Democrats.

zh: 当然，对自由经济和全球市场的厌恶并不仅限于德国。
en: Of course, revulsion for liberal economies and global markets is not confined to Germany.

zh: 法国，也许甚至是荷兰否决欧盟《宪法条约》的动机中都有类似的情感在作祟，在某些人看来，欧盟《宪法条约》的经济自由主义有着太多的盎格鲁撒克逊式内容。
en: A similar sentiment formed one of the motives for the French and perhaps even the Dutch to reject the European Union’s Constitutional Treaty, which some regarded as too “Anglo-Saxon” in its economic liberalism.

zh: 在很多人的心目中，代替资本主义和全球化的是“欧洲社会模型”式的田园图画，尽管谁都未曾见过这幅图画的庐山真面目。
en: For many, the alternative to capitalism and globalization is an idyllic image of a “European social model,” which no one has yet defined.

zh: 实际上，要想看清这幅景象真的非常困难。
en: Indeed, it would be difficult to do so.

zh: 和其它政策领域一样，欧洲各国的社会政策也千差万别，而在流行的观点中社会政策涵盖很广，从疲惫保护主义到某些“老牌”欧洲国家的补贴要求，再到欧盟西部新成员（爱尔兰和葡萄牙）和东部新成员（波兰和斯洛伐克）们高涨的自由市场热情。
en: Social policies in Europe – like everything else – vary widely, and popular attitudes cover a spectrum, from tired protectionism and longing for subsidies in some of “old Europe” to the free-market enthusiasm of more recent EU members in the West (Ireland and Portugal) and the East (Poland and Slovakia).

zh: 事实上，欧洲大肆鼓吹的社会模式更像是个梦，而不像现实。 在人们梦中的温暖世界，慈善的国家会照顾每个人的需求。
en: In fact, Europe’s much-vaunted social model is more a dream than a reality, the dream of a cozy world in which a benevolent state looks after us.

zh: 但由于人口数量太大，这样的世界已经不再可能，援助申请者的数量激增，国家已经拿不出这笔费用。
en: This world has ceased to be viable in large part for reasons of demography, as ever more claimants for assistance make costs unaffordable.

zh: 有些人¾甚至还有些政治家¾已经得出了正确的结论。
en: Some people – and even a few politicians – are drawing the right conclusions from this.

zh: 他们知道，我们最终必须依靠自己的才华和力量，而他们则利用开放市场带来的机会。
en: They know that ultimately we all must rely on our own initiative and effort, and they make use of the opportunities of open markets.

zh: 但其它欧洲人的态度活脱脱像张漫画，漫画的法语或德语标题是 ： “ 依靠自己太有必要了，但我们需要政府帮忙实现。 ”
en: But others in Europe treat such attitudes like a cartoon whose caption could be in French or German: “Self-reliance is absolutely important, we depend on politics for it”.

zh: 在这些分歧的背后隐藏着深刻的政治和文化传统，内容是国家在日常生活中所起的作用。
en: Behind such differences lie deep political and cultural traditions concerning the role of the state in everyday life.

zh: 正是在这一点上，美国与法国和德国有着本质的不同，而英国与美国却非常相似，他们都不信任国家，更不会依靠国家。
en: This is where the United States really is different from France and Germany, while Britain has a similar tradition of distrusting the state rather than relying on it.

zh: 虽然在方式上略有不同，但意大利确实也是这样。
en: In a different way, this is true of Italy as well.

zh: 很久以来，意大利的共产主义势力十分强大，左翼党派很可能再次掌权，但却对资本主义鼓励的自由丝毫没有感到抵触。
en: Italy has long had a large Communist Party, and the left may be in power again; but there is no gut antagonism to the freedoms that capitalism encourages.

zh: 个人热情高涨的另外一个国家是波兰¾甚至连假冒的“波兰管道工”都煞有介事地总结全球化会给法国带来哪些威胁。
en: Poland is another country in which individual initiative flourishes – to the point that the apocryphal “Polish plumber” came to epitomize the threats posed by globalization in France.

zh: 勿需多说，在亚洲很多高速增长的国家中根本不存在这样的障碍。
en: Needless to say, there are no such hang-ups in many of the high-growth economies of Asia.

zh: 没错，印度必须克服费边社会主义在当地造成的长期影响，但他们已经做到了。
en: True, in India the inertia of an indigenous version of Fabian socialism had to be overcome; but this has happened.

zh: 实际上，完成经济增长、社会凝聚和政治自由等高难度任务的新模型可能会在抓住了全球化外衣的某些国家中最先显现。
en: In fact, new models to square the circle of economic growth, social cohesion, and political liberty may be emerging in some of the countries that have grasped the mantle of globalization.

zh: 其它地方根深蒂固的反资本主义、反全球化情绪也很值得关注。
en: The entrenched anti-capitalist, anti-globalization mood elsewhere is a source of concern.

zh: 毕竟，弗里茨·施特恩在他的著作中警告了对现代事务罗曼蒂克的憎恨所带来的危险。
en: After all, Fritz Stern wrote his book to warn of the dangers posed by a romantic abhorrence of modernity.

zh: 失业率长期居高不下和缩减社会福利培养，却没有造就这样的观点，深层次的文化根源远比现实因素重要得多。
en: High, often long-term unemployment and cuts in social benefits nurture, but do not cause such attitudes; their deep-seated cultural roots matter far more.

zh: 从后果上来讲也是如此。
en: So do their consequences.

zh: 反资本主义、反全球化情绪产生的挫折感带来了田园美梦和残酷事实的致命组合，充满魅力的右翼领导人（法国的让-马利-勒庞）和左翼领导人（拉方丹及其德国新党 ） 。
en: A sense of frustration that results from anti-capitalist, anti-globalization sentiment leads to a lethal combination of Arcadian dreams (“France to the French”) and the reality of ruthless, if seductive, leaders on the right (Jean-Marie Le Pen in France) and the left (Oskar Lafontaine and his new party in Germany).

zh: 繁荣和自由将成为牺牲品，除非那些抓住新世界机遇的人能获得成功。
en: Prosperity and liberty will be the victims, unless those who grasp the opportunities of the new world prevail.

zh: 时光倒流50年
en: Back to the Sixties

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 虽然美国国内未有一丝通胀的迹象，但对美国货币政策助推通胀的抱怨早已喧嚣尘上了。
en: BERKELEY – Complaints about the inflationary effects of American monetary policy are rampant, despite there being barely a hint of inflation in the United States.

zh: 各大新兴经济体都竭力避免被汹涌流入的资本冲垮。
en: Rapidly growing catch-up economies are paddling furiously to avoid being dragged down by a torrent of capital inflows.

zh: 而那些高明的政策制定者们则殚精竭虑，誓为美国问题丛生的货币系统找一个替代品，甚至暗示要回归金本位了。
en: Prominent policymakers, desperate for alternatives to America’s malfunctioning monetary system, have gone so far as to allude to a return to the gold standard.

zh: 请注意，我说的可不是2011年，而是1964年，历史又一次重演了。
en: I am not talking about 2011, but about 1964. We have been here before.

zh: 当年对美联储怨声载道的是一批发展迅猛，大有赶超美国之势的欧洲国家。
en: In 1964, it was the rapidly growing economies of Europe, still catching up to the US, that were howling about the Federal Reserve.

zh: 各国一致认为随着美国货币政策的剧烈扩张，国外资金将充斥各国，美国人正在“输出通胀 ” 。
en: As a result of a recklessly expansionary American policy, they argued, they were being flooded with imported finance. The US was “exporting inflation.”

zh: 对此美方官员则反驳说资金流入其实反映了欧洲资本市场的不成熟状况。
en: American officials countered that the financial inflows reflected Europe’s underdeveloped capital markets.

zh: 通胀其实是各国央行不愿进一步收紧货币政策所产生的副作用，此外欧洲长期奉行的出口型增长政策也导致各国在本国货币升值问题上踌躇不定。
en: Europe’s inflation problem was a byproduct of its central banks’ reluctance to tighten policy more aggressively, and European countries’ hesitancy to let their currencies rise, reflecting their long-standing commitment to export-led growth.

zh: 正如一句法国谚语所说：Plus ça change（万变不离其宗 ） 。
en: Plus ça change, as the French would say.

zh: 当年戴高乐治下的法国建议废除以政府信用担保的法定货币，以金本位制度取而代之，最终迫使美国收紧财政政策。
en: What the French under General Charles de Gaulle actually did say was that fiat monies should be jettisoned in favor of the gold standard. The US would then be subject to tighter policy discipline.

zh: 但法国人从未明确说明究竟要在何种程度上回复到金本位制度，也没能解释该做法如何有助于实现物价和金融稳定，因为1930年代黄金市场的剧烈波动及其对金本位制度的灾难性影响（法国尤甚）足已令大家对此满腹狐疑了。
en: But the French never explained exactly how restoration of the gold standard might be accomplished, or how it would translate into price and economic stability, given gold markets’ volatility and the disastrous consequences of the gold standard – not least in France – in the 1930’s.

zh: 换句话说，类似的争论不但糊弄了前人，也令今人迷惑不已。
en: The debate, in other words, was as confused and confusing as it is today.

zh: 它的积极影响就是启动了一场改革国际货币系统的运动。
en: Its one positive effect was to launch an effort to reform the international monetary system.

zh: 因此当如今的法国政府（又是这帮法国人！ ）承诺将在2011年担任G20集团轮值主席国时将国际货币改革作为核心任务时，自当检讨一下1960年代的教训。
en: So now that the French government – not them again! – has committed to making international monetary reform the centerpiece of its G-20 presidency in 2011, it is worth recalling the cautionary tale of the 1960’s.

zh: 当年国际货币外交主要集中在创设一个新型国际储备，并最终演化成为国际货币基金组织的特别提款权（Special Drawing Rights ） 。
en: Back then, international monetary diplomacy focused on creating a new form of international reserves, what became the International Monetary Fund’s Special Drawing Rights.

zh: 该理念认为通过特别提款权的发行，国际货币基金组织可以给那些只能不断囤积美元的新兴经济体提供另一种增加储备的方式，而美国也无法“毫不心疼地”运行在贸易赤字之上，一方面遏制美国货币政策的扩张，另一方面也不至于使全球经济面临流动性枯竭的局面。
en: The idea was that by issuing SDRs, the IMF would provide catch-up economies seeking to accumulate reserves with an alternative to piling up dollars. The US could no longer run balance-of-payments deficits “without tears.��� American policy could be reined in without starving the global economy of liquidity.

zh: 这些努力最终一败涂地。
en: The effort failed completely.

zh: 特别提款权从未成为一种有吸引力的美元替代品，只是在国际间中作为美元和其他国家货币的补充物存在。
en: Special Drawing Rights never became an attractive alternative to the dollar, only modestly supplementing dollars and other national units in international use.

zh: 世界货币基金组织的成员国都不信该组织能承担全球中央银行的重任，因此为特别提款权的创设设置了极高的门槛。
en: Because they did not trust the IMF to assume the powers of a global central bank, the Fund’s members established high hurdles to creating SDRs.

zh: 用特别提款权作为结算工具的私人市场同样也无法发展起来，于是也抹杀了其对各国央行的吸引力。
en: Private markets in SDR-denominated instruments similarly failed to develop, in turn limiting their appeal to central banks.

zh: 1960年代的另一个国际争论焦点是增加汇率的灵活性。
en: The other focus of negotiations in the 1960’s was an effort to enhance exchange-rate flexibility.

zh: 相关计划方案 — — 主要是针对德国和意大利两国的持续贸易盈余以及美国的持续赤字 — — 在特别提款权谈判于1968年落下帷幕后越来越引人注目。
en: Proposals to this effect – a response to the emergence of chronic surpluses in Germany and Italy, and chronic deficits in the US – attracted growing attention once the SDR negotiations sputtered to a close in 1968.

zh: 但另外一些出口导向型经济体都已在紧盯美元的情况下享受了20年的好时光，谁也不愿意搅乱了大好局面。
en: But, with other countries having enjoyed two decades of export-led growth as a result of pegging their currencies to the dollar, there was a reluctance to mess with success.

zh: 虽然国际货币基金组织在1970年中期发布了一份关于汇率问题的高级别报告，并承诺实施更高汇率灵活性的相关原则，但它既未提出任何新理念去吸引各国加入，也未对那些拒绝加入的国家制定任何新的制裁方案。
en: While the IMF, in a high-profile report on exchange rates in mid-1970, endorsed the principle of greater flexibility, it offered no new ideas for getting countries to move in this direction and proposed no new sanctions against countries that resisted.

zh: 结果国际贸易失衡状况持续恶化，直到该系统在1971-1973年间轰然倒塌。
en: International imbalances continued to mount until the system came crashing down in 1971-1973.

zh: 法国政府最近对2011年改革方案的相关暗示显示出：相对于早前的猜测，它并未集中精力在增加特别提款权的角色方面。
en: The French government’s recent hints about its reform agenda for 2011 suggest that, contrary to earlier speculation, an enhanced role for the SDR will not be at the center of its efforts.

zh: 相反，萨科齐政府试图发展另一套机制，争取实现向一个美元，欧元和人民币同时扮演全球重要角色的过渡。
en: Rather, the Sarkozy administration will seek to develop mechanisms for managing the transition to an international currency system in which the dollar, the euro, and the renminbi all play consequential global roles.

zh: 这堪称正确的一步，也说明他们确实从历史中吸收了教训。
en: This is a step forward, one that reflects real learning from history.

zh: 但法国人也没有提出会对那些不愿调整本国货币的长期贸易盈余国家实施制裁。
en: But the French have not indicated that they will push for sanctions against chronic surplus countries that fail to adjust their currencies.

zh: 而制裁的缺失恰恰是布雷顿森林体系的最关键弱点，而它也体现了我们自身的某个重要弱点 — — 而不仅仅是意味着下一个布雷顿森林体系。
en: The absence of such sanctions was a critical weakness of the original Bretton Woods system, and it remains a central weakness of our own – not coincidentally referred to as Bretton Woods 2.

zh: 如果缺乏相应的制裁手段去规范全球贸易失衡的话，法国人的进步之举将把我们带到一个沉闷的分歧点上。
en: Without sanctions to police global imbalances, the French step forward will take us halfway across a yawning chasm.

zh: 孤悬半空，既缺乏坚实的基础，又缺乏向上的动力，这可不是全球经济想达到的局面。
en: In mid-air, with neither firm ground below nor enough momentum to make it to the other side, is not where the global economy should be.

zh: 回归乌托邦?
en: Back to Utopia?

zh: 发自巴黎 — — 法国早已不再屹立于世界历史舞台的中心，但却依然拥有超越自身国界的影响力。
en: PARIS – France no longer claims center stage in world history, but it remains influential beyond its national borders.

zh: 从18世纪至今 — — 期间涵盖了夏尔·戴高乐在二战中扮演的伟大角色，非洲的去殖民化，以及1968年5月的学生运动 — — 法国一直都是全欧各类深刻社会变革的引领者。
en: From the eighteenth century on – including Charles de Gaulle’s epic role in World War II, decolonization in Africa, and the May 1968 student revolt – France has been a frequent bellwether of deep societal changes across Europe.

zh: 那么最近选出来的新法国总统又是否将延续这一传统？
en: Will its recent presidential election continue that tradition?

zh: 弗朗索瓦·奥朗德（François Hollande ） ， 性清寡淡，有点官僚，其竞选承诺就是要做一个“平平常常的”总统，而这也是他与花蝴蝶般的现任总统尼古拉·萨科齐 — — 事实上，跟法兰西第五共和国自1959年成立以来的历任总统 — — 截然不同的地方。
en: François Hollande, bland and bureaucratic, campaigned on a promise to be a “normal” president, unlike the colorful incumbent, Nicolas Sarkozy – and, indeed, unlike all of his predecessors since the Fifth Republic was established in 1959. Hollande’s victory thus may be a sign that democratic countries have become reluctant to be led by flamboyant or charismatic presidents or prime ministers.

zh: 其实在当今的欧洲大地，没有一个民主国家处于一个强硬或者魅力型领导人的领导之下。
en: Indeed, across Europe, no democracy is currently led by a strong or charismatic personality.

zh: 意大利虽然依然是过渡政府，但那里的选民似乎都不愿选择一位为人如洛可可建筑般浮夸的领袖。
en: Italy remains under an interim administration, but there, too, voters appear to have turned their backs on a rococo ruler.

zh: 欧洲没有了萨科齐或者贝卢斯科尼，也没有了英国前首相撒切尔夫人，德国前总统赫尔穆特·科尔以及西班牙前首相何塞·玛丽亚·阿斯纳尔这样的人。
en: Europe has no Sarkozy or Silvio Berlusconi, but also no Margaret Thatcher, Helmut Kohl, or José Maria Aznar.

zh: 在欧洲遭遇经济和体制危机的时候，所有的欧洲领导人看上去 … … 没错 … … 都极端平常。
en: At a time of economic and institutional crisis in Europe, all European leaders appear to be, well, extremely normal.

zh: 对许多人来说，这场平常对魅力的胜利无疑是值得庆祝的。
en: For many, the victory of normalcy over charisma should be cause for celebration.

zh: 民主制度，其实就是平常的公民选举出些平常的男女，让他们在既定的规则下领导大家一段有限的时间。
en: Democracy is about normal citizens electing normal men and women to lead them for a limited period according to established rules.

zh: 但欧洲领导人中这股向平常化发展的趋势同时也伴随着显而易见的远见和战略缺失。
en: But the trend toward normalcy among European leaders coincides with a remarkable absence of vision and strategy.

zh: 就算这帮平常的欧洲领导人中有任何一位身怀欧洲长期战略（你能想象欧盟委员会主席范龙佩或者欧盟外交政策舵手凯瑟琳·阿什顿身上有这东西吗？ ） ， 他们显然也无法将其传达出来。
en: If any of these normal leaders have a long-term strategy for Europe (can anyone imagine such a thing from EU Council President Herman Van Rompuy or the Union’s foreign-policy supremo, Catherine Ashton?), they are remarkably unable to convey it.

zh: 而如果说到奥朗德的全面远景规划，粗看之下会令人想起1960年代法国成功的社会民主制度：一个强大的福利国家，拥有充足的公共投资去复苏增长并推动就业。
en: In Hollande’s case, the rare glimpses of a comprehensive vision recall France’s successful social democracy of the 1960’s: a strong welfare state, together with abundant public investment to revive economic growth and boost employment.

zh: 奥朗德的参照点似乎是他年轻时那种二战后的田园牧歌，一个飞速增长的时代，人口年龄分布恢复到合理水平，没什么移民，也缺乏全球竞争。
en: Hollande’s reference point seems to be the post-war idyll of his youth, a time of rapid growth, demographic recovery, scarce immigration, and scant global competition.

zh: 换句话说，奥朗德正在尝试用一个早已不复存在的世界图景来诱惑其他欧洲领导人。
en: In other words, Hollande will try to entice other European leaders with a vision for a world that no longer exists.

zh: 这种怀旧政治很有问题，不仅因为法国和欧洲都正面临着严峻的经济挑战，还由于法国和其他民主国家都在面对着对自身合法性的真正挑战。
en: This politics of nostalgia is troubling, not only because France and Europe confront severe economic challenges, but also because France and other democracies are confronted with real challenges to their legitimacy.

zh: 如果在很多年后再回首，2012年这场法国总统选举最令人难忘的可不是奥朗德的胜利以及平常派的登顶，而是民粹主义政党长久以来向权力进发的决定性一步。
en: In hindsight, the 2012 French Presidential election could well be remembered not so much for Hollande’s victory and the triumph of normalcy, but as the decisive step in populist parties’ long march to power.

zh: 在第一轮选举中，极左派这个混杂着反资本主义者和极端环保主义者的杂牌军获得了14%的选票。
en: In the first round of the French presidential election, the far left, a motley collection of anti-capitalists and radical environmentalists garnered 14% of the vote.

zh: 而在极右那一侧，马琳·勒庞的国民阵线，这个法国法西斯主义的政治继承人，夺得了18%的选票，也是该党有史以来最高的得票率。
en: On the far right, Marine Le Pen’s National Front, the political heir of French fascism, won 18%, the party’s best result ever.

zh: 换句话说，1/3的法国选民都被持有极端意识形态，共同反对欧元，资本主义和全球化等自由主义理念的候选人所吸引。
en: In other words, one-third of French voters are now attracted to candidates with extreme ideologies that share an anti-liberal rejection of the euro, capitalism, and globalization.

zh: 两派都能在一个理想化的历史中找到自己的根据：极左那边，是法国大革命及其平等主义承诺，极右那边则是法兰西帝国及其对所有非白色人种的统治。
en: Both sides find their roots in an idealized past: the French Revolution and its egalitarian promise for the far left, and the French Empire and its domination of the world’s non-white peoples for the far right.

zh: 此外，两派都是强硬的民族主义者，都使用法国要单独行动，封闭本国经济防止外国竞争，打压金融市场以及遣返移民这一套说辞来说服选民。
en: Moreover, both extremes are strongly nationalistic. Persuaded as they are that France should act alone, they would close the economy to foreign competition, suppress financial markets, and send immigrants back to their homelands.

zh: 虽然两派的政治议程同属胡说八道，但在这方面的一致程度却有过之而无不及。
en: The convergence goes beyond their agendas’ common irrationality.

zh: 极左极右都能在大批经济上缺乏安全感，政治上感觉被夺权的法国人身上找到自己的核心支持者 — — 本质上，也就是那批自觉在一个公开社会中无法找到机会的人。
en: Both the far left and the far right find their core constituency among the vast number of French who feel economically insecure and politically disenfranchised – in essence, all those who perceive themselves as having no opportunity in an open society.

zh: 奥朗德的“平常”招牌对这些民粹主义选民不起作用。
en: Hollande’s brand of normalcy does not appeal to these populist voters.

zh: 但忽略这些人也是不明智的做法，因为他们的乌托邦愿望正是构建于真实且合理的恐慌之上。
en: But to dismiss them would be unwise, because their utopian aspirations are based on genuine and legitimate anxieties.

zh: 低增长以及全球化已经将所有欧洲社会 — — 以及美国 — — 分化成了两个新的阶层：一批人拥有足够的教育和社会资本去应对当今的全球化经济，另一批人则挣扎在低收入泥潭中，只能找到些临时工干干 — — 因此来自合法和非法移民的竞争对他们的直接影响也更大。
en: Slow growth and globalization have divided all European societies – and the United States – into two new classes: those whose education and social capital enable them to cope with today’s globalized economy, and those stuck in low-paid, often transient jobs (and thus most directly affected by competition from legal and illegal immigrants).

zh: 没有一个主流的欧洲领袖，包括奥朗德，提到过这种新的分化。
en: No mainstream European leader, including Hollande, even mentions this new division.

zh: 事实上，无论是奥朗德还是萨科齐都代表着那些适应全球化的群体，并将在此之外的人视为一批可供引诱的选民，而不是一个新的下层阶级。
en: Indeed, both Hollande and Sarkozy represented those adapted to globalization and viewed the rest as a reservoir of voters to be seduced, not as a new underclass.

zh: 这种对民粹主义的肤浅理解使得法国总统选举成为了欧洲瞎指挥的一个不祥症状。
en: This superficial understanding of populism makes the French presidential election an ominous symptom of Europe’s blind leadership.

zh: 而一个平常化的外表也无法抵御那些威胁欧洲社会基础的真正危险。
en: A façade of normalcy cannot withstand the real dangers threatening the foundations of European societies.

zh: 重写货币政策的范式
en: Rewriting the Monetary-Policy Script

zh: 发自慕尼黑 — — 各大国中央银行继续盲目依靠僵硬规则来控制通胀和刺激增长的做法还要持续多久？
en: MUNICH – How long will major central banks blindly rely on rigid rules to control inflation and stimulate growth?

zh: 鉴于灵活货币政策的好处如此明显，中央银行家们需要开阔自己的视野，拥抱灵活所带来的可能性。
en: Given the clear benefits of nimble monetary policy, central bankers need to open their eyes to the possibilities that flexibility affords.

zh: 一直以来，货币政策制定者的黄金法则都是一旦发现通货膨胀低于官方目标范围，就立刻将短期利率设定为一定水平来促进支出和投资。
en: The rule of thumb for monetary policymakers has long been that if inflation is below official target ranges, short-term interest rates should be set at a level that spurs spending and investment.

zh: 但这种做法意味着一旦利率达到或接近零，央行立马无路可走，只能靠激活大规模资产购买计划以寄望能刺激需求。
en: This approach has meant that once interest rates reach or approach zero, central banks have little choice but to activate large asset-purchase programs that are supposed to stimulate demand.

zh: 当形势需要时，决策者只得默认选择新凯恩斯主义经济模式的预定脚本。
en: When circumstances call for it, policymakers default to the predetermined scripts of neo-Keynesian economic models.

zh: 但在许多情况下这些脚本会让我们走了弯路，因为它们认为货币政策会对需求和通货膨胀产生可衡量的和可预见的影响，而我们却有许多理由去怀疑这一假设。
en: But in too many cases, those scripts have led us astray, because they assume that monetary policy has a measurable and foreseeable impact on demand and inflation. There is plenty of reason to question this assumption.

zh: 首先，民众并未通过减少储蓄并增加支出来应对超低利率。
en: For starters, households have not responded to ultra-low interest rates by saving less and spending more.

zh: 如果储蓄不再产生回报，人们就无力购买大件物品或支撑未来的退休生活。
en: If savings no longer yield a return, people can’t afford big-ticket items or pay for retirement down the road.

zh: 同样，企业当前面临着诸多不确定性和风险，即便资本成本不断降低也不足以促使它们增加投资。
en: Likewise, companies today are faced with so much uncertainty and so many risks that ever-lower costs of capital have not enticed them to invest more.

zh: 但虽然数据不甚亮丽，也很容易理解预定的公式为何对货币政策制定者如此具有吸引力。
en: It’s easy to see why, despite the data, predetermined formulas are attractive to monetary policymakers.

zh: 一般经验认为要使通货膨胀率恢复到理想水平，就必须将经济中的所有闲置部分都动员起来，这就需要尽可能低的利率。
en: The prevailing wisdom holds that in order to return the inflation rate to a preferred level, any slack in the economy must be eliminated.

zh: 而当政策已经按计划实施了之后（比如利率下降到了负值 ） ， 就必须实施如“量化宽松”这类非常规工具以激活增长和通胀。
en: This requires pushing interest rates as low as possible, and when these policies have run their course (such as when rates dip toward the negative), unconventional instruments like “quantitative easing” must be deployed to revive growth and inflation.

zh: 这一范式的接受程度是如此普遍 — — 而支撑中央银行决策的模型模拟又变得如此复杂 — — 以致很少有人愿意去质疑它。
en: The paradigm has become so universally accepted – and the model simulations underpinning central banks’ decisions have become so complex – that few are willing to question it.

zh: 而对中央银行或经济学家个人来说，质疑这一点也是很丢脸的事。
en: For individual central banks or economists, to do so would be sacrilege.

zh: 央行并不完全否认这些政策所带来的经济成本：比如金融市场的繁荣，养老金制度的资金缺口，以及更严重的财富不平等。
en: Central banks do not completely deny the economic costs that these policies imply: exuberance in financial markets, financing gaps in funded pension systems, and deeper wealth inequality, to name just a few.

zh: 但是这些成本被视为达到明确通货膨胀水平而可以接受的代价。
en: But these costs are deemed an acceptable price to pay to reach the clearly defined inflation level.

zh: 而近年所实施的政策也没有令一些无形状况 — — 不稳定的政治环境，地缘政治震动，或金融市场风险上升 — — 催生矫正模型走向的可能性。
en: Yet the policies pursued in recent years have given no room for the intangibles – unstable political environments, geopolitical tremors, or rising risks on financial markets – that can send models off course.

zh: 正如2008年金融危机所显示的那样，风险的正态分布对于预测来说是毫无用处的。
en: As the 2008 financial crisis illustrated, the normal distribution of risk was useless for predictions.

zh: 凯恩斯从不认为如果不确定性大到足以动摇消费者和投资者的期望，货币政策就会变得无效。
en: Keynes never tired of arguing that monetary policy becomes ineffective if uncertainty is sufficient to destabilize the expectations of consumers and investors.

zh: 不幸的是许多中央银行都忘了这一点。
en: Unfortunately, many central banks have forgotten this.

zh: 日本央行，英格兰银行和欧洲央行都依此制定了相当严格的政策规则。
en: The Bank of Japan, the Bank of England, and the European Central Bank all hone to rather rigid policy rules.

zh: 如果扩张性政策未能将通胀提高到约2％的预期水平，它们去不质疑自己的模型；而是增加政策力度 — — 而这正是市场期望的。
en: If expansionary policies fail to have the desired effect of lifting inflation to the predefined level of around 2%, they do not question their models; they simply increase the policy dosage – which is just what markets expect.

zh: 目前美联储在主要中央银行中拥有最为灵活的工具选项。
en: For now, the US Federal Reserve has the most flexible toolkit among the major central banks.

zh: 除了通胀压力之外，美联储的货币政策还必须考虑就业统计，增长数据以及金融市场的稳定性。
en: In addition to inflationary pressure, the Fed’s monetary policy must also take into account employment statistics, growth data, and the stability of financial markets.

zh: 但即使是美联储的灵活性也遭到了围攻。
en: But even the Fed’s flexibility is under siege.

zh: 共和党立法者正在讨论如何将美联储限制在更加僵化的政策规则之下来管理通货膨胀（使用一种称为泰勒规则的公式，依照通胀率以及产出的缺口来预先决定联邦资金利率的变化 ） 。
en: Republican lawmakers are discussing how to bind the Fed to more scripted policy rules to manage inflation (using a formula known as the Taylor rule, which predetermines changes in the federal funds rate in relation to inflation and an output gap).

zh: 这一举动毫无疑问是错的。
en: Needless to say, such a move would be a mistake.

zh: 那些高度依赖新凯恩斯主义理论的中央银行（更不用说立法者）都忽视了过往几十年货币政策实验的一个重要教训：对货币政策效果的预测是无法实现高度确定性或准确性的。
en: Central banks (not to mention lawmakers), with their strong attachment to neo-Keynesian theory, are ignoring a major lesson from decades of monetary-policy experimentation: the impact of monetary policy cannot be predicted with a high degree of certainty or accuracy.

zh: 但对预测准确性的迷信却对当前标准通货膨胀目标的可信度来说至关重要。
en: But the belief that it can is essential to the credibility of the now-standard inflation targets.

zh: 如果央行不断错过这些相当不起眼的标记 （ “ 低于，但接近2 ％ ” ） ， 它们最终就会陷入一个预期陷阱，市场会希望它们疯狂地尝试达到既定目标，甚至不惜中动用更高剂量的货币猛药。
en: If central banks keep missing these rather narrow marks (“below, but close to 2%”), they end up in an expectations trap, whereby markets expect them to dispense ever higher doses of monetary medicine in a frantic attempt to reach their target.

zh: 很显然，这些货币政策为经济带来了日益高昂的成本和风险。
en: Clearly, such monetary policies create soaring costs and risks for the economy.

zh: 而央行本身则变得越来越像财务代理人，这是极为危险的，因为会破坏它们的合法性。
en: And central banks themselves are coming dangerously close to looking like fiscal agents, which could undermine their legitimacy.

zh: 一个全新且更现实的货币模式将抛弃那种认定货币政策总是有效的僵化规则。
en: A new and more realistic monetary paradigm would discard overly rigid rules that embody the fallacy that monetary policy is always effective.

zh: 这将使中央银行有更多的空间来容纳货币政策的风险和成本。
en: It would give central banks more room to incorporate the risks and costs of monetary policies.

zh: 在此范式之下，央行就能抛弃负利率和大规模资产购买行为，同时更灵活地定义其通货膨胀目标，以避免在“不确定性 ” （ 如油价下跌或工资调整导致通货膨胀上升或低于2 ％ ） 时被迫采取行动。
en: With such a paradigm, central banks could move away from negative interest rates and large-scale asset purchases. They would define their inflation targets more flexibly, to avoid being forced into action whenever “uncertainties” such as declining oil prices or required wage adjustments cause inflation to move above or below 2%.

zh: 也许最重要的是，这种新范式将承认央行的能力和预见性都是有局限的。
en: Perhaps most important, a new paradigm would acknowledge the limits of central banks’ power and foresight.

zh: 这样政府就不能再以此为借口不去实施那些对实现长期增长真正重要的结构性改革。
en: That would remove an alibi that governments too often hide behind to avoid introducing the structural reforms that really matter for long-term growth.

zh: 坏钱·好钱
en: Bad Money, Good Money

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 英国喜剧天才斯帕克·米利根 ( Spike Milligan ) 曾经说，他很高兴自己能有机会去发现一件事，那就是钱这玩意并不能给他带来快乐。
en: London – The British comic genius Spike Milligan once observed that he would love to have the opportunity to discover that money wouldn’t make him happy.

zh: 据说那些巨额彩票的中奖者最终都晚景凄凉，但实际调查研究却显示当手握一张百万美元支票的时候 ， 那些人跟你我一样兴高采烈 。
en: Big lottery winners, it is claimed, end up miserable, though real-life research suggests that they are as happy as you and I would be with a check for a million dollars.

zh: 此外，钱还能激发人类所有的情感 — — 比如火暴的脾气 .
en: Money, however, can trigger all sorts of other emotions – like rage, for example.

zh: 而 这恰好也是人们面对银行家巨额分红时的反应 , 尤其在 2007-2008 年的大海啸将银行 , 企业 , 股东的积蓄 , 国家的增长和人们的工作毁于一旦的时候。
en: That is pretty much how most people reacted to the stories about bankers’ bonuses, when the great crash of 2007-2008 wiped out banks, businesses, shareholders’ savings, growth, and jobs.

zh: 正如一位银行家面带笑容地坦白说，银行家的收入和银行的亏损之间，确实有“一点”不平衡 .
en: There was, as one banker charmingly conceded, a bit of asymmetry between what bankers were being paid and what their banks had lost.

zh: 对此 1998 年诺贝尔经济学奖得主阿马蒂亚·森 (Amartya Sen) 在其最新著作《正义的理念 》 （ The Idea of Justice ）中指出，当人们意识到在自己的付出和回报之间存在某种联系的时候，就会认为这个程序是公平的。
en: The Nobel Laureate Amartya Sen notes in his latest magisterial book The Idea of Justice that most people understand that a process is fair when they can detect a connection between effort and reward.

zh: 但可耻的是，银行家们却未能通过这个原则的检验。
en: The bankers failed this test dismally.

zh: 当时我们咬紧牙关，一心为自己国家经济的利益着想，支持我们的政府用纳税人的钱去拯救那些银行。
en: We gritted our teeth and for the sake of our national economies supported our governments as they bailed out the banks with public money.

zh: 虽然这一做法令人恼火，但为了把国家从一场经济大灾难中拉出来，就是必须的。
en: It was a necessary, if infuriating, act of salvation to avoid economic disaster.

zh: 在年景好的时候，公众眼巴巴地看着银行家赚得盘满钵满，后来出了问题，却又被迫要为银行的损失买单，如今人们的怒气又开始喷发出来，因为新闻上说纳税人一手救活的银行如今又开始往“食槽”里倒满了“粮食 ” ， 而那群“猪”则意气风发，埋头吃得正欢。
en: Having socialized banks’ losses after we had seen the privatization of their gains, our rage quotient has shot up once more at the news that the banks we saved are again filling the troughs into which all those snouts are enthusiastically dipped.

zh: 这种巨大的反差不仅吸引眼球，更令人血压急升。
en: The sheer unseemliness of what is happening raises blood pressure as well as eyebrows.

zh: 公众不禁要问：这些人怎么能这样呢？
en: How do they have the nerve?

zh: 然而我们不能任由这种愤怒进一步扭曲为对个人财富的全面指责。
en: We should not, however, allow this sentiment to turn into an all-purpose rant against personal wealth.

zh: 因为有时财富的拥有者散尽千金，只为了大众的福祉。
en: Sometimes its owners use it in hugely generous amounts for great public gain.

zh: 比如 两位世界级的大慈善家，乔治·索罗斯 (George Soros) 和莫· 易卜拉辛 （ Mo Ibrahim ） 。
en: Consider the cases of two of the world’s biggest philanthropists, George Soros and Mo Ibrahim.

zh: 作为一位威名赫赫的投资家，乔治·索罗斯将其大部分财富都花在了“开放社会研究院（ Open Society Institute ） ” 上，而成立这个机构的目的，就是为了帮助巩固中东欧地区的民主革命成果，并在全世界范围内促进人权的保护。
en: George Soros, the enormously successful investor, has used much of his own wealth to establish the Open Society Institute, which has helped to underpin the democratic revolution in Central and Eastern Europe and to press for human rights worldwide.

zh: 而莫·易卜拉辛则是非洲地区最负盛名的企业家，一手执掌着一个覆盖科技，软件和移动通讯的庞大商业帝国。
en: Mo Ibrahim is one of Africa’s most distinguished entrepreneurs. He built a business empire on technology, software, and mobile telecommunications.

zh: 他成立了一个基金会，致力于提高非洲大陆的政府治理水平。
en: Ibrahim has established a foundation whose main purpose is to raise standards of governance in Africa.

zh: 而这也是非洲大陆目前所急需倾听的呼声。
en: The continent certainly needs to pay heed.

zh: 作为一片拥有 50 个国家， 10 亿人口的大陆，非洲贫困缠身，且许多的地方都留有被战争所撕裂的伤口。
en: With a billion people living in more than 50 countries, Africa is wracked by poverty and, in too many places, torn apart by war.

zh: 牛津大学的发展经济学家保罗·科利尔（ Paul Collier ）估计全世界最贫困的人口中有 75% 生活在那些刚刚从冲突中复原或者依然深陷于冲突之中的国家，而非洲国家就占了绝大多数。
en: The Oxford development economist Paul Collier reckons that 75% of the poorest people in the world live in countries that have only recently recovered from conflict or are still in conflict. Most of them are in Africa.

zh: 在非洲这个地方，发动一场暴动似乎比开一家公司更顺手。
en: These are countries where it sometimes seems easier to start an uprising than to start a business.

zh: 比如几内亚，这个残暴的军政府统治下的国家目前正徘徊在灾难的边缘。
en: Guinea, with a nasty military junta in power, is on the brink of disaster.

zh: 在苏丹，达尔富尔冲突依然没能得到解决，而南北双方的分歧一再对和平构成威胁，因为南部地区声称要在 2011 年发动独立公投。
en: In Sudan, the Darfur conflict is unresolved and divisions between the north and the south once again threaten peace, with a promised referendum on southern independence due by 2011.

zh: 在军阀割据的索马里，成百上千无家可归的人们蜷缩在难民营里。
en: Hundreds of thousands of displaced people huddle in camps in Somalia, where warlords rule.

zh: 除了这几个国家之外，类似的情况在非洲简直数不胜数。
en: The list, alas, goes on.

zh: 但这并不是因为非洲国家的政府缺乏善治的资源或者能力。
en: It is not as though Africa lacked resources or the ability to govern itself well.

zh: 因为平静祥和的博茨瓦纳就是一个成功的范例。
en: Peaceful Botswana is a good example of what can be achieved.

zh: 而当人们将混乱的原因归咎于气候，地理以及历史上的殖民统治时，其实绝大部分的责任都在那些胡作非为的非洲国家政府身上。
en: While climate, geography, and the colonial past share some of the blame for today’s misery, most of the responsibility belongs to those African governments that have behaved so badly.

zh: 易卜拉辛希望驱除腐败，希望看到法治之光普照各国，培养出鼓励商业生长繁荣的政策土壤，并加强女性的作用。
en: Ibrahim wants to stamp out corruption, to see the rule of law applied everywhere, to foster policy environments that encourage businesses to start up and thrive, and to strengthen the role of women.

zh: 他希望奖励那些支持多元主义民主，拥护公民社会以及媒体自由的人，而易卜拉辛基金会也深入地参与到与全球变暖的斗争当中。
en: He wants to reward those who support pluralist democracy and is a champion of civil society and a free press, and the Ibrahim Foundation is also deeply involved in the fight against global warming.

zh: 易卜拉辛同时也指出非洲各国之间的贸易额只占全非洲贸易总额不到 5 % 。
en: He also points out that less than 5% of total trade in Africa is undertaken between African countries.

zh: 这对于这个大洲的区域经济整合来说是一个有力的论据，这种整合包括了消除贸易壁垒，供用发电厂等���施，允许人员，货物和资金的自由流动等措施。
en: There is a powerful argument for regional economic integration on the continent, abolishing trade barriers, sharing infrastructure like power generation, and allowing free movement of people, goods, money, and jobs.

zh: 而东非的一些国家已经开始从自身考虑开展相关的尝试了。
en: Some countries in East Africa are now trying to do something about that for themselves.

zh: 像莫·易卜拉辛和乔治·索罗斯这样的慈善家 — — 或者是比尔·盖茨和沃伦·巴菲特 — — 可以用自己的财富去令这个世界变得更美好。
en: Philanthropists like Mo Ibrahim and George Soros – or Bill Gates and Warren Buffett – can use their fortunes to make the world a better place.

zh: 因此我们也不能让自己对银行家的愤怒演变成一种对财富创造行为的野蛮攻击。
en: We shouldn’t allow our exasperation with bankers to morph into an assault on the creation of wealth.

zh: 正如斯帕克·米利根所未能发现的那样，钱确实可以令人们变得更快乐，制造出一个能为那些贫苦大众提供出更多机会的，更公平的世界。
en: As Spike Mulligan was unable to discover for himself, money really can make people happier, producing a more just world with greater opportunity for the poor and disadvantaged.

zh: 让我们在 2010 新的一年，向着这个方向奋进吧！
en: Let’s hope that we move in that direction in 2010.

zh: 救市的忧虑
en: Bailout Blues

zh: 纽约 — — 不需要多有天才就能看出美国金融体系 — — 实际上是全球金融体系 — — 陷入了危机。
en: NEW YORK – It doesn’t take a genius to figure out that the United States’ financial system – indeed, global finance – is in a mess.

zh: 而现在随着美国众议院否决布什政府提出的7000亿美元救市计划，很显然我们在如何解决危机方面也没有达成共识。
en: And now, with the US House of Representatives having rejected the Bush administration’s proposed $700 billion bailout plan, it is also obvious that there is no consensus on how to fix it.

zh: 几年来，美国的经济和金融体系一直存在问题。
en: The problems in the US economy and financial system have been apparent for years.

zh: 可那并没有阻止美国领导人向这场危机的始作俑者求助，这些人在危机将我们带到又一次大萧条的边缘之前根本看不到问题的存在，现在却提出一个又一个救市计划想救我们于水火之中。
en: But that didn’t prevent America’s leaders from turning to the same people who helped create the mess, who didn’t see the problems until they brought us to the brink of another Great Depression, and who have been veering from one bail-out to another, to rescue us.

zh: 随着全球市场迅速滑落，救市计划几乎肯定要再次提交国会投票表决。 这个计划也许救得了华尔街，但能否救得了经济？
en: As global markets plummet, some version of the rescue plan will almost certainly be put to another vote in Congress.  Unless the plan is markedly different from the current one, while it may help Wall Street,  what about the economy?

zh: 纳税人又怎么办？ 他们已经被史无前例的赤字所困扰，到现在仍然背负着基础设施衰退和两场战争的债务负担。
en: What about taxpayers, already beleaguered by unprecedented deficits, and with bills still to pay for decaying infrastructure and two wars?

zh: 在这种情况下， 任何一项 救市计划真能起作用吗？
en: In such circumstances, is there any bailout plan that can work?

zh: 可以肯定，刚刚被否决的救市计划确实比布什政府原来的提议要好很多。
en: To be sure, the rescue plan that was just defeated was far better than what the Bush administration originally proposed.

zh: 但救市的基本方法仍然存在着致命的缺陷。
en: But its basic approach remained critically flawed.

zh: 首先，它再次依赖涓滴经济学：由于某种原因，向华尔街砸进足够的钞票就能惠及社会民众，帮助普通工人和房屋业主。
en: First, it relied – once again – on trickle-down economics: somehow, throwing enough money at Wall Street would trickle down to Main Street, helping ordinary workers and homeowners.

zh: 涓滴经济学几乎从来没有发挥过作用，而这次的效果恐怕也不会比以前更好。
en: Trickle-down economics almost never works, and it is no more likely to work this time.

zh: 此外，救市计划假定根本的问题是信心丧失。
en: Moreover, the plan assumed that the fundamental problem was one of confidence.

zh: 这无疑的确是问题的 一部分 ，但深层次的问题却是金融市场发放的一些贷款质量很差。
en: That is no doubt part of the problem; but the underlying problem is that financial markets made some very bad loans.

zh: 当时出现了住房泡沫，而这些贷款正是基于被抬高以后的住房价格。
en: There was a housing bubble, and loans were made on the basis of inflated prices.

zh: 现在泡沫已经破灭。
en: That bubble has burst.

zh: 住宅价格也许会进一步下跌，更多抵押品赎回权也因此会被取消。
en: House prices probably will fall further, so there will be more foreclosures, and no amount of talking up the market is going to change that.

zh: 市场无论怎样坐而论道都无法改变这样的现状。
en: The bad loans, in turn, have created massive holes in banks’ balance sheets, which have to be repaired.

zh: 这些坏账又反过来导致银行的资产负债表出现亏空，必须要对这些亏空进行弥补。
en: Any government bailout that pays fair value for these assets will do nothing to repair that hole.

zh: 可这样做就像是为内出血的病人大量输血，根本无法收到根本的疗效。
en: On the contrary, it would be like providing massive blood transfusions to a patient suffering from vast internal hemorrhaging.

zh: 就算救市计划可以立即实施 — — 这种可能性似乎越来越小 — — 也无法避免一定程度的信贷收缩。
en: Even if a bailout plan were implemented quickly – which appears increasingly unlikely – there would be some credit contraction.

zh: 过度借贷所带来的消费繁荣一直维持着美国经济的发展，这种情况无法再继续下去。
en: The US economy has been sustained by a consumption boom fueled by excessive borrowing, and that will be curtailed.

zh: 中央和地方都在缩减开支。
en: States and localities are cutting back expenditures.

zh: 家庭的资产负债情况更加脆弱。
en: Household balance sheets are weaker.

zh: 经济发展放缓将加剧所有的金融问题。
en: An economic slowdown will exacerbate all our financial problems.

zh: 我们可以用更少的钱取得更好的效果。
en: We could do more with less money.

zh: 我们可以用透明的方式来填补金融机构资产负债表上的亏空。
en: The holes in financial institutions’ balance sheets should be filled in a transparent way.

zh: 斯堪地纳维亚国家20年前就为我们做出了榜样。
en: The Scandinavian countries showed the way two decades ago.

zh: 沃伦·巴菲特向高盛注资为我们指明了另一种方法。
en: Warren Buffet showed another way, in providing equity to Goldman Sachs.

zh: 通过发行有担保的优先股（期权 ） ， 我们可以抵消市场向下的风险，共同创造一种向上的可能。
en: By issuing preferred shares with warrants (options), one reduces the public’s downside risk and ensures that they participate in some of the upside potential.

zh: 这种方法不但被事实证明有效，而且还提供了恢复信贷的积极性和必要的资金。
en: This approach is not only proven, but it also provides both the incentives and wherewithal needed for lending to resume.

zh: 它避免了为成百上千万复杂抵押贷款和作为其载体的更复杂的金融产品估价，而且也解决了可能导致政府被最差或最高估的资产套牢的“失败”问题。
en: It avoids the hopeless task of trying to value millions of complex mortgages and the even more complex financial products in which they are embedded, and it deals with the “lemons” problem – the government gets stuck with the worst or most overpriced assets.

zh: 最后，这种方法的推进速度更快。
en: Finally, it can be done far more quickly.

zh: 同时，可以采取几项措施来限制取消赎回权的操作。
en: At the same time, several steps can be taken to reduce foreclosures.

zh: 首先，可以通过将抵押品的贬值转化为可变现的税收信贷来降低中低收入美国人购买住宅的价格。
en: First, housing can be made more affordable for poor and middle-income Americans by converting the mortgage deduction into a cashable tax credit.

zh: 政府实际上为高收入美国人支付了50%的抵押利息和不动产税，却没有向穷人提供任何帮助。
en: The government effectively pays 50% of the mortgage interest and real estate taxes for upper-income Americans, yet does nothing for the poor.

zh: 其次，需要进行破产改革来允许房主减记自有住房的账面价值，同时继续住在房子里。
en: Second, bankruptcy reform is needed to allow homeowners to write down the value of their homes and stay in their houses.

zh: 第三，政府可以承担部分抵押贷款的偿付义务，充分利用借款时低廉的信贷利率。
en: Third, government could assume part of a mortgage, taking advantage of its lower borrowing costs.

zh: 恰恰相反，美国财长亨利·保尔森的办法是使美国陷入危机的骗局的又一个实例。
en: By contrast, US Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson’s approach is another example of the kind of shell games that got America into its mess.

zh: 投资银行和信贷评级机构相信金融点金术 — — 也就是认为拆分债券可以创造巨大的价值。
en: Investment banks and credit rating agencies believed in financial alchemy – the notion that significant value could be created by slicing and dicing securities.

zh: 现在新的提法是解除拆分可以创造真实的价值 — — 具体的做法是从金融体系中剥离这些资产，并把它��交由政府掌握。
en: The new view is that real value can be created by un-slicing and un-dicing – pulling these assets out of the financial system and turning them over to the government.

zh: 但那样做需要政府为这些资产付出过高的代价，只有银行能够从中受益。
en: But turning them over to the government at market value doesn’t improve banks’ balance sheet; to do that requires overpaying for the assets, a transfer of wealth from ordinary taxpayers to the banks..

zh: 最后，如果这项计划最终得以采纳，很可能要由美国的纳税人来收拾残局。
en: In the end, there is a high likelihood that if such a plan is ultimately adopted, American taxpayers will be left on the hook.

zh: 在环境经济学中有一个基本原则，叫做“由污染者出资治理 ” 。
en: In environmental economics, there is a basic principle, called “the polluter pays principle.”

zh: 这个问题关乎资金和效率。
en: It is a matter of both equity and efficiency.

zh: 华尔街用有毒的抵押贷款污染了经济，应该由它来承担清理的开支。
en: Wall Street has polluted the economy with toxic mortgages. It should pay for the cleanup.

zh: 以保尔森计划为基础的任何救市计划都不会产生效果，经济学家们越来越就这一点达成共识。
en: There is a growing consensus among economists that any $750 billion bailout based on Paulson’s plan won’t by itself do the trick of resuscitating our economy.

zh: 如果被不幸言中，那么国家债务的巨额增长和即便7000亿美元也不足以挽救美国经济的认识将进一步侵蚀人们的信心，加剧经济的疲弱态势。
en: If so, the huge increase in the national debt and the realization that even $700 billion is not enough to rescue the US economy will erode confidence further and aggravate its weakness.

zh: 但政治家们不可能在这样一场危机中什么也不做。
en: But it is impossible for politicians to do nothing in such a crisis.

zh: 因此我们可能应该祈祷由导致这场危机的特殊利益、错误经济理论和右翼意识形态等毒素混合而成的这份协议能够以某种方式制定出正确的救市计划 — — 至少这个计划如果失败不会造成太大的损失。
en: So we may have to pray that a agreement crafted with the toxic mix of special interests, misguided economics, and right-wing ideologies that produced the crisis can somehow produce a rescue plan that works – or whose failure doesn’t do too much damage.

zh: 做出正确的决策 — — 包括建立新的监管体系降低危机再次爆发的风险 — — 是下届政府将要完成的任务之一。
en: Getting things right – including a new regulatory system that reduces the likelihood that such a crisis will recur – is one of the many tasks to be left to the next administration.

zh: 平衡国家与市场
en: Balancing the State and the Market

zh: 柏林 — —
en: BERLIN – The financial and economic crisis that erupted in 2008 will, in retrospect, be regarded as a transformative moment, because it raised fundamental questions about the future shape of our economic systems. These questions are not so much about the end of capitalism – as some perceive or even desire – but rather about the different ways in which capitalism is understood in different countries.

zh: 当人们回首往昔之时，爆发于2008年的金融与经济危机将会被视为一个变革性的时刻，这是因为这场危机就经济体系的未来形态提出了具有根本意义的问题。
en: What we are witnessing today is a reversal of the debates of the 1980’s. Back then, Ronald Reagan used to joke: “The nine most terrifying words in the English language are: I’m from the government and I’m here to help!”

zh: 这些问题并不像某些人所认为、甚至所期望的那样，与资本主义的终结有多大关联，而是与不同国家对资本主义的不同理解方式有关。
en: Now that governments have spent trillions of dollars, euros, yen, and pounds on stabilizing financial markets and the economy in general, those words seem far less terrifying.

zh: 我们如今所见到的景象，正是上世纪八十年代那些争论的相反版本。
en: In fact, faith in the market has been dented, while trust in government and regulation is increasing.

zh: 彼时，罗纳德·里根常常戏称 ： “ 英语中最可怕的九个词是：我来自政府，我来帮你！ ”现在，政府为稳定金融市场和整体经济已经投入了数万亿美元、欧元、日元和英镑，那九个字也显得远没有那么可怕了。
en: After decades of consensus that the state should set the rules and otherwise leave the private sector alone, the state is now widely seen as a beneficial force that should play an active role in the economy.

zh: 事实上，人们对市场所抱有的信念已被削弱，而对政府和规制的信任却与日俱增。
en: This is happening despite the lack of a clear indication of the superiority of the state.

zh: 数十年来，存在着一种国家应当订立规则、而后放任私营部门自行发展的共识；而在此之后，国家正被普遍视为一种应当在经济中发挥积极作用的有益力量。
en: On the contrary, the US government’s heavy intervention in the American housing market is probably the most pertinent example of the state’s shortcomings, one that no doubt contributed significantly to the crisis.

zh: 上述情况发生的同时，却没有明确迹象能显示国家具有优越性。
en: I sense a growing willingness to forego the benefits of innovation – not least financial innovation – in exchange for a slower pace of change, which is assumed to be more controllable.

zh: 相反，美国政府对该国房地产市场的大力干涉，或许正是国家缺陷的最恰当例证，毫无疑问，这种做法对于危机的发生有着重大的推动作用。
en: This shift will not only impede future growth, but could bring other dangers as well.

zh: 我察觉到这样一种意愿正在日渐增强，即我们应舍弃创新带来的好处（特别是金融创新 ） ， 以换取较慢的变革速度，后者被认为更易为人们所控制。
en: The fiscal balances of the G-20 economies will deteriorate dramatically as a result of the crisis. Deficits will improve somewhat as economies recover and support measures are withdrawn.

zh: 这种意愿的变化不但会阻碍未来的增长，同时它还会带来其他的风险。
en: Most governments have used their stimulus packages to serve vested interests as well. The accumulated debt will constitute a lasting burden on public finances.

zh: 这场危机将会导致二十国集团经济体的财政平衡状况大幅恶化。 随着经济走向复苏、政府取消支持措施，财政赤字状况将会有所改观，但并非所有的措施都是一时之计、或在经济方面具有合理性。
en: Moreover, we must remember that budgets were already strained before the crisis, and that governments’ balances do not reflect all aspects of reality.

zh: 大部分政府也将其一揽子刺激方案用来服务于既得利益者。 日积月累的债务将会构成公共财政的长久负担。
en: In Germany, for example, overall debt jumps from the current 65% of GDP to 250% when pension liabilities are included.

zh: 此外我们还需牢记，预算在危机爆发之前便已吃紧；而且政府的财政平衡状况并不能反映出现实的所有方面。
en: Interest payments account for an ever-larger share of budgets – and will continue to grow when interest rates start to rise again.

zh: 比如在德国，若将养老金债务计入其中，则整体负债与国内生产总值之比将从目前的65%跃升为250 % 。
en: In the absence of strong political commitment and credible plans for gradual fiscal consolidation, there is a distinct risk that at some point sovereign yields will rise markedly – with negative implications for the economy and politics.

zh: 利息偿付在预算中的比重正不断增大，而当利率再次开始上升之际，其比例还将继续上升。
en: The second danger is that governments will continue to see it as their duty to decide which firms to save and which to let fail.

zh: 如果政府在财政稳固方面没有强有力的政治承诺和可信的计划，那么还存在着这样一种明显风险：即某一时刻，主权债务的收益率将会显著上升，这将会给经济和政治两方面带来不利影响。
en: A line must be drawn between a time of crisis, when emergency measures are needed to avert economic collapse, and normal circumstances, in which the full force of market mechanisms applies.

zh: 第二个风险则在于，政府将会继续以决定哪些公司应被救助、哪些可以任其破产为己任。
en: The instinct of governments, however, may be to revert to the idea of protecting national champions or reasserting national sovereignty in some sectors.

zh: 人们必须划清危机时期与普通情况间的界线，在前一时期，我们需要紧急措施以避免经济崩溃；而在后一种情况下，则应由市场机制完全发挥作用。
en: But instinct is not necessarily a sound basis for decision-making. And in times of globalization, distinguishing between “national” and “foreign” is neither appropriate nor feasible.

zh: 然而，政府的本能或许将是回归这样一种理念，即保护本国领头企业、或在某些领域重新伸张国家主权。
en: In order to preserve the state’s ability to act while avoiding competitive distortions between and within industries, we should establish criteria to guide future decisions in this area.

zh: 不过，本能并不一定是决策的可靠基础，而且在全球化的时代里，区分“本国”和“外国”的做法既不合适、也不可行。
en: As a matter of principle, companies that were in trouble prior to a severe economic crisis should not be eligible for state assistance of the type that the world recently witnessed. Moreover, aid must be limited, lest firms become addicted to it.

zh: 为了在避免出现产业间或产业内竞争性扭曲的同时、保持国家的行动能力，我们应当在这一领域制定出指导未来决策的标准。
en: Governments should also be aware of the long-term costs: large-scale state interference in market processes will produce its own set of corporate winners and losers.

zh: 其中一种原则是，在严重经济危机爆发前便身陷困境的公司，不应有资格获得近来世人所见到的那种国家援助。 此外，援助必须有限，以免公司对此上瘾。
en: Structural change may be delayed, depriving us of the opportunities offered by the crisis to build more competitive and dynamic industries – and accelerating the relative global decline of mature economies.

zh: 政府也应意识到此举的长期代价：国家在市场进程中的大规模干涉，将会造就出自己的一套企业赢家与败者。
en: Indeed, the third danger is that greater state intervention in the economy entails a shift away from globalization, paving the way for various forms of national protectionism.

zh: 结构变化或将受到延误，这会使我们失去由危机所提供的、构建更具竞争力、且更有活力的产业之机会，同时加速全球成熟经济体的相对衰落速度。
en: We can see this in the financial industry, where increased state ownership has led to a distinct danger of re-nationalization and re-fragmentation of financial markets.

zh: 事实上，第三种风险还在于：国家在经济领域更大规模的干预将导致世界偏离全球化的方向，为五花八门的国家保护主义铺平道路。
en: Many financial institutions that received government funds have concentrated on their respective home markets and scaled back their activities abroad.

zh: 金融产业便是例证，在这一产业中，更高的国有程度带来了金融市场重新国有化与重新碎片化的明显风险。
en: Similarly, there is a risk that new regulation may, either deliberately or as an unintended side effect, lead to re-nationalization of markets.

zh: 许多接受政府资金的金融机构已经专注于各自的母国市场，并削减其海外运作规模。
en: It is understandable that governments seek solace in the presumed safety of national markets. But the shelter that national markets provide is illusory: the only way to increase the resilience of financial markets and to ensure that recurrence of this kind of crisis becomes less likely is to build a regulatory framework that is commensurate with integrated markets.

zh: 同样，无论是刻意为之还是无心插柳，都存在着新规制导致市场重新国有化的可能。
en: We need global (or at least European) rules, and we need strong institutional structures to enforce these rules – a requirement that is not necessarily limited to the financial markets.

zh: 政府在本国市场假定具有的安全性中寻求慰藉的做法是可以理解的，但本国市场所提供的庇护却是水中之月：强化金融市场稳健程度、并确保降低此类危机重演概率的唯一方法仍在于，建构一种与一体化市场相称的规制框架。
en: We must resist the temptation to believe that a meddling, paternalistic state is the way of the future. Not only business, but also society as a whole, would lose out if we moved in that direction.

zh: 我们为此需要制定出全球范围的（或至少是欧洲范围的）规则，我们还需要强有力的机制结构以执行这些规则，而且这种需求也不一定局限在金融市场这一方面。
en: Or, as has been said by many: “A government big enough to give you everything you want is strong enough to take everything you have.”

zh: 如果我们向着这种方向前进的话，则受损的将不只是商业，还包括整个社会。 抑或像许多人曾经说过的那样 ： “ 一个大到足以赐予你一切所求之物的政府，也强到足以剥夺你所拥有的一切。
en: This text is an abridgment of a keynote address given at a Berlin conference on post-crisis economic policies, hosted by the Center on Capitalism and Society, Columbia University, 11-12 December 2009.

zh: 平衡失衡的世界贸易
en: Balancing the World’s Imbalances

zh: 现在绝对是全球经济的美好时光，但是美时光很少会使人们真正主动去解决困难的问题。
en: Good times – and these are good times for the global economy – are rarely the moment for concrete initiatives to deal with difficult problems.

zh: 正是在这种背景下我很高兴地看到本周末几大经济体联合作出声明，表示它们在保持经济强劲增长的同时，将共同努力寻求有序解决全球贸易失衡的问题。
en: It is against this backdrop that I find welcome this weekend’s announcement by a group of major economies acknowledging their shared responsibility for the orderly resolution of global imbalances while sustaining robust growth.

zh: 在过去一年里，中国、欧元区、日本、沙特阿拉伯和美国相互之间以及与国际货币基金组织讨论了这些方案。
en: For the past year, China, the euro zone, Japan, Saudi Arabia, and the United States have been discussing these plans among themselves and with the IMF.

zh: 在多少有些令人生畏的“多边商讨”的标签背后，它们进行了第一次此类形式的讨论，并且这被证明是处理全球重大问题的一个行之有效的手段。
en: Behind the somewhat forbidding label of “multilateral consultation” are discussions that are the first of their kind, and that have proved to be a promising tool for dealing with an issue of global importance.

zh: 这五大经济体以不同的方式与当前的全球贸易失衡有关联。 要么因为它们当前的经常项目逆差或顺差，要么它们的产值在世界上占据了很大的比重。
en: These five economies are relevant to global imbalances in different ways: either on account of their current account deficits or surpluses, or because they represent a very large share of world output.

zh: 它们一致同意解决这种失衡的状况符合它们自身的利益。
en: They all agree that resolving these imbalances is in each of their interests.

zh: 但是它们同时也认识到这对它们是一个多边挑战，它们应共同担负责任。
en: But they also recognize that it is a multilateral challenge and a shared responsibility for them all.

zh: 过去的一年，部分源于这些国家过去所采取的政策，全球贸易的失衡显示出常态化的迹象，事实上，甚至有所改善。
en: Over the last year, partly reflecting past policies in these countries, the imbalances have shown signs of stabilizing and, indeed, even of improving slightly.

zh: 但是这些国家必须向人们发出这样的信息，就是它们所实行的政策在保持经济增长的同时，也将确保不断并且有序地减少贸易的不平衡。
en: But these countries must signal that policies will continue to ensure a progressive and orderly reduction in imbalances together with sustained growth.

zh: 否则，全球的经济将继续面临新保护主义压力的威胁，或者因某些经济或政治事件而触发对贸易失衡的无序的解决方案以及破坏经济的增长。
en: Otherwise, the global economy will remain at risk from renewed protectionist pressures and economic or political events that might trigger a disorderly resolution of the imbalances and undermine growth.

zh: 五大经济体在国际货币基金组织成员国的半年会上非常详细地阐述了它们的政策计划，从而受到了各国的一致好评。
en: The five economies spelled out their policy plans in considerable detail to the semi-annual meeting of the IMF’s membership, which gave them a warm welcome.

zh: 这是第一次这样的计划被放在一起进行阐述。
en: This is the first time such plans have been presented together.

zh: 正如国际货币基金组织国际货币和金融委员会主席戈登·布朗所说的，这些计划完全与国际货币基金组织的成员国一直支持的解决贸易不平衡的中期方案相一致。
en: As Gordon Brown, the chairman of the Fund’s International Monetary and Financial Committee, noted, these plans are fully in line with the medium-term approach to solving imbalances that the Fund’s membership has consistently supported:

zh: 中国已经把减少外部的不平衡上升到其在2007年国家要实现的一个重要目标的地位。
en: China has elevated the reduction of external imbalances to a major national objective in 2007.

zh: 它准备大力扩大内需，并且承诺将逐步推进货币实现更大的浮动幅度。
en: It intends to boost domestic demand and is committed to moving gradually toward greater exchange rate flexibility.

zh: 欧元区国家再次重申了它们决心继续在广泛的领域内，包括产品、劳动力和金融市场，推进结构改革。
en: Euro-zone countries reaffirmed their intention to press ahead with structural reforms across a broad front, in product, labor, and financial markets.

zh: 日本计划加快其劳动力市场的改革，强化竞争，并且促进财政稳固从而保持国民的信心。
en: Japan plans to accelerate labor market reforms, strengthen competition, and advance fiscal consolidation to sustain domestic confidence.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯将大大增加其在社会和基础设施上投资的力度，并且将扩大石油的产能。
en: Saudi Arabia is boosting its spending on social and infrastructure investments substantially, as well as expanding oil sector capacity.

zh: 而美国将采取步骤平衡预算，促进私人储蓄，以及改善其能源的使用效率。
en: And the US is taking steps to balance its budget, boost private savings, and enhance energy efficiency.

zh: 同时美国还准备强化资本市场的竞争性，确保其依然能吸引大量的外国投资。
en: The US also intends to strengthen capital market competitiveness and ensure that it remains an attractive environment for foreign investment.

zh: 正如全球的贸易不平衡不是一天内造就的，它也不可能很快得到解决。
en: Just as global imbalances were not built up overnight, nor will they be solved quickly.

zh: 多边商讨的目的并不是为了一蹴而就地解决贸易不平衡，而是为了达成一个中期的解决方案，慢慢地减少贸易的不平衡。
en: The aim of multilateral consultation was not to seek to solve imbalances in one fell swoop, but rather to solidify agreement on a medium-term approach that could reduce imbalances gradually over time.

zh: 协议各方所描述的政策一旦得到实施，将会成为朝解决这一问题迈出的坚实步伐。
en: The policies outlined by the participants will, when implemented, constitute a step in that direction.

zh: 它们公布计划的举动表明了它们所作出的承诺，同时也为评估其进展提供了一个颇有价值的路线图，从而有助于使所有努力减少贸易不平衡的国家建立起信心。
en: Publication of their plans sends an additional signal of their commitment and provides a valuable roadmap with which to assess progress, and thus help build confidence that all countries are working to reduce imbalances.

zh: 而国际货币基金组织按照其提供政策分析和建议的职责，将定期监督这些计划的实施情况。
en: The IMF, for its part, will monitor these plans regularly as part of our responsibility to provide policy analysis and advice.

zh: 这些国家已经清楚地表明它们未来所采取的政策计划将继续与国际货币基金组织的成员国所呼吁的战略保持一致。
en: The countries have made it clear that their future policy plans will continue to be consistent with the strategy called for by the IMF’s membership.

zh: 五大经济体和其他的成员国以及国际货币基金组织本身一致认为这是一个富有成果的实践。
en: The five participants and the rest of our members, as well as we at the Fund, all agree that this has been a fruitful exercise.

zh: 其成功的一个标志就是各国正在商讨要进行第二次多边讨论，以推动关于金融全球化和金融创新怎样影响了世界经济的增长和稳定的对话。
en: An indicator of success is that a second multilateral consultation, aimed at fostering dialogue on how financial globalization and innovation influence growth and stability, is under consideration.

zh: 像第一轮会谈一样，这一讨论将在与这一问题有紧密联系的经济体之间进行。
en: Like the first round of talks, this consultation would occur between a group of economies that have special relevance to the issue.

zh: 竞争阵营间的巴尔干半岛
en: The Balkans Between Competing Poles

zh: 马德里 — — 世界没有几个地区比巴尔干半岛的文化和政治局势更加复杂。
en: MADRID – Few world regions are more culturally and politically complex than the Balkans.

zh: 没有什么比巴尔干地区最优秀儿子一生的经历和死后的传统更能体现这一地区沉重的过去和现在：他就是物理学家兼发明家尼古拉·特斯拉。
en: And there may be no clearer illustration of the region’s freighted past and present than the life and legacy of one of its exceptional sons: the physicist and inventor Nikola Tesla.

zh: 1856年出生在目前克罗地亚境内一个东正教塞尔维亚家庭，特斯拉的国籍到现在仍然是巴尔干地区争论的对象。
en: Born into an Orthodox Serbian family in 1856 in a town that is now part of Croatia, Tesla’s nationality remains an object of debate in the region.

zh: 特斯拉相信科学进步应当建立国家之间的桥梁，并最终实现全球和平的梦想。
en: Tesla believed that scientific advances should be used to build bridges between countries, and ultimately to achieve universal peace.

zh: 但在克罗地亚和塞尔维亚总有人想要扭曲特斯拉的遗产来达到自己的目标。
en: But there are some in both Croatia and Serbia who want to appropriate his legacy in ways that do not do it justice.

zh: 就连特斯拉在物理学领域所做出的贡献也激起了其国内复杂的政治争斗。
en: Even Tesla’s contributions to the field of physics have evoked the complicated political dynamics of his native land.

zh: 在国际单位制中，特斯拉被用来测量磁场通量密度。
en: In the International System of Units, a tesla is a measurement for the flux density of a magnetic field.

zh: 而欧盟外交及安全政策高级代表费代丽卡·莫盖里尼于数月前指出 ， “ 巴尔干地区很容易成为大国操纵的棋局。
en: And as Federica Mogherini, the High Representative of the European Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy, pointed out a few months ago, “The Balkans can easily become one of the chessboards where the big power game can be played.”

zh: ”事实上，该地区一直处在相互敌视的阵营之间，这些阵营各自通过相互交织的经济、政治、历史和文化联系来投射力量。
en: Indeed, the region has always been situated between competing poles, each projecting power through interwoven economic, political, historical, and cultural links.

zh: 对欧盟而言，伴随20世纪90年代南斯拉夫解体所爆发的战争标志着其战略的彻底失败。
en: For the EU, the wars that accompanied the breakup of Yugoslavia in the 1990s signified an utter failure.

zh: 在暴力活动逐渐消退后，欧盟曾试图利用其自身磁场通过重建及和解进程将前南地区团结在一起。
en: After the violence subsided, the EU tried to use its own magnetic pull to bring the former Yugoslav territories together through a process of reconstruction and reconciliation.

zh: 但上述策略产生的结果是不均衡的。
en: But this strategy has produced uneven results.

zh: 尽管某些东正教多数国家 — — 包括希腊、保加利亚和罗马尼亚 — — 已经加入欧盟，但克罗地亚和斯洛文尼亚等唯一加入欧盟的后南斯拉夫国家均以信仰天主教为主，这样的现实助长了负面解读。
en: Although some Eastern Orthodox-majority countries – Greece, Bulgaria, and Romania – have acceded to the EU, the only post-Yugoslav countries to join – Croatia and Slovenia – are predominantly Catholic, a reality that feeds a counterproductive narrative.

zh: 当德国和梵蒂冈于1991和1992年迅速承认克罗地亚和斯洛文尼亚时，他们实际加深了已故政治学家塞缪尔·亨廷顿随后提出的所谓“文明冲突”的印象。
en: When Germany and the Vatican quickly recognized Croatia and Slovenia in 1991 and 1992, they reinforced the sense of what the late political scientist Samuel P. Huntington subsequently called a “clash of civilizations.”

zh: 在亨廷顿看来，南斯拉夫战争完全符合他的简单模式 — — 一方是以天主教和新教为代表的西方基督教，而信仰其他宗教的欧洲区域则构成了另一方。
en: For Huntington, the Yugoslav wars fit his simplistic paradigm perfectly, with Western Christianity – Catholicism and Protestantism – on one side, and the rest of Europe’s religions on the other.

zh: 克罗地亚和斯洛文尼亚都要求将“西巴尔干六国 ” — —包括阿尔巴尼亚、波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那、科索沃、马其顿、黑山和塞尔维亚 — — 纳入到欧盟体系。
en: Croatia and Slovenia have both demanded that the “Western Balkans 6” – Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kosovo, Macedonia, Montenegro, and Serbia – be incorporated into the EU as well.

zh: 但进展受到了一系列西巴尔干及欧盟国家间双边政治纠纷的阻挠，这与斯洛文尼亚利用欧盟成员资格暂时阻止克罗地亚加入产生了类似的效果。
en: But progress has been hampered by a congeries of bilateral political disputes between Western Balkan and EU countries, similar to when Slovenia, taking advantage of EU membership, temporarily blocked Croatia’s accession.

zh: 不仅如此，欧盟内部情况 — — 近年来经济危机的爆发和仇外政治党派的崛起 — — 同样 影响了欧盟东扩政策的进度，欧盟委员会主席让·克洛德·容克曾在2014年宣布2019年前不接受任何新成员国加入。
en: Moreover, circumstances within the EU itself – economic crises and the rise of xenophobic political parties in recent years – have put its enlargement policy on the back burner, with European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker announcing in 2014 that no new members would be accepted before 2019.

zh: 同时，西巴尔干地区的民主规范和制度一直在恶化。
en: At the same time, democratic norms and institutions in the Western Balkans have been eroding.

zh: 而其他对巴尔干地区有着强大影响力的国家 — — 尤其是俄罗斯、土耳其和匈牙利（欧盟未能阻止匈牙利在维克托·奥尔班总理执政期间向威权主义逐步过渡 ）正在为西巴尔干国家提供更多的政治模式选项。
en: Other countries with a strong influence in the region – not least Russia, Turkey, and Hungary, where the EU has failed to prevent a drift toward authoritarianism under Prime Minister Viktor Orbán – are offering alternative political models for Western Balkan countries to follow.

zh: 以塞尔维亚和俄罗斯之间的关系为例。
en: Consider the relationship between Serbia and Russia.

zh: 在2014年访问贝尔格莱德期间，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京甚至表示 ， “ 俄罗斯就像过去一样，会一直把塞尔维亚视为我们最亲密的战友。
en: During a visit to Belgrade in 2014, Russian President Vladimir Putin went so far as to say that, “Russia, just as it was in the past, will always see Serbia as our closest ally.”

zh: ”除与俄罗斯有着长期的文化联系外，塞尔维亚完全依赖俄罗斯的能源供应，以及俄罗斯作为联合国安理会常任理事国的否决权。
en: In addition to its longstanding cultural ties with Russia, Serbia depends on Russian energy supplies, as well as Russia’s veto power as a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council.

zh: 只要塞尔维亚仍处在俄罗斯的庇护之下，它就能阻止科索沃加入联合国的进程。
en: As long as Serbia remains in Russia’s good graces, it can block Kosovo from joining the UN.

zh: 这些因素解释了塞尔维亚为什么不加入欧盟在2014年3月俄罗斯吞并克里米亚后对其实施制裁。
en: These factors explain why Serbia did not join the EU in imposing sanctions against Russia after it annexed Crimea in March 2014.

zh: 波斯尼亚和马其顿同样选择不参与欧盟制裁，而北约成员国阿尔巴尼亚和黑山则与欧盟保持了一致的步调。
en: Bosnia and Macedonia also chose not to participate in the EU sanctions, while NATO members Albania and Montenegro did.

zh: 但巴尔干国家并不仅仅是被周边磁极所吸引的粒子。
en: Still, the Balkan countries are not simply particles drawn passively toward the magnetic poles around them.

zh: 例如，塞尔维亚的灵感来源于铁托元帅所留下的传统，铁托曾在冷战绝大部分期间担任南斯拉夫总统。
en: Serbia, for example, finds inspiration in the legacy of Marshal Tito, who was president of Yugoslavia for much of the Cold War.

zh: 铁托不仅不是苏联最亲密的战友，反而是不结盟运动的创始人，十分擅长挑起美国和苏联之间的争斗。
en: Far from being the Soviet Union’s closest ally, Tito was a founder of the Non-Aligned Movement, and excelled at playing the United States and the Soviet Union off against each other.

zh: 同样，塞尔维亚今天被正式指定为中立国。
en: Similarly, Serbia today is officially designated as a neutral state.

zh: 但它通过和平伙伴关系与北约密切合作，但同时又与俄罗斯军队开展联合军演等活动。
en: But it collaborates closely with NATO through its Partnership for Peace, while at the same time hosting military exercises with the Russian army.

zh: 同样，尽管塞尔维亚总统阿莱克桑达尔·武契奇声称坚定支持欧盟一体化，但他并未表现出任何意愿要疏远俄国。
en: Likewise, while Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić claims to be firmly in favor of European integration, he has displayed no willingness to distance himself from Russia.

zh: 当然除俄国外，中国也反对承认科索沃。
en: Of course, in addition to Russia, China has also opposed recognizing Kosovo.

zh: 借助一带一路计划，中国展示其发达的经济肌肉， 投资成百上千万美元用于塞尔维亚和地区其他国家的基础设施建设。
en: Through its “Belt and Road Initiative,” China has flexed its economic muscle, investing millions of dollars in infrastructure projects in Serbia and other parts of the region.

zh: 中国的举措之一是在贝尔格莱德和布达佩斯之间修建高速铁路线，其目的是连接希腊的比雷埃夫斯港和中欧。
en: One initiative is a high-speed rail line between Belgrade and Budapest, which is meant to connect the Greek port of Piraeus with Central Europe.

zh: 欧盟委员会目前正在调查贝尔格莱德和布达佩斯铁路线是否违反欧盟招标规则。
en: The European Commission is currently investigating the Belgrade-Budapest line for possible violations of EU tendering rules.

zh: 上述调查揭示了一种潜在的趋势：尽管中国并不抱有和俄罗斯同样的破坏野心，但其所作所为很有可能导致西巴尔干国家质疑它们为什么要努力符合欧盟的制度模式和与之相伴的规则。
en: The inquiry hints at an underlying trend: though China does not harbor Russia’s disruptive ambitions, its actions may well leave the Western Balkans questioning their incentive to converge with the EU’s institutional model and accompanying rules.

zh: 尽管存在这些挑战，欧盟在西巴尔干问题上仍然是有优势的。
en: Despite these challenges, the EU maintains a favorable position vis-à-vis the Western Balkans.

zh: 除克罗地亚外，西巴尔干国家贸易总量的74%对象是欧盟，而中国仅有6 % ， 俄罗斯5 % ， 土耳其4 % 。
en: Excluding Croatia, 74% of Western Balkan countries’ total trade is with the EU, compared to only 6% with China, 5% with Russia, and 4% with Turkey.

zh: 在这种情况下，欧盟不应允许现有挑战削弱其整体扩张战略。
en: In this context, the EU should not permit current challenges to weaken its overall enlargement strategy.

zh: 上月举行的西巴尔干国家首脑会议迈出了积极的一步，前提是这些国家仍然渴望加入欧盟，并且认识到有必要进行深入的改革。
en: The Western Balkans Summit last month was a positive step, provided that the countries still eager to join the EU do not lose sight of the need to enact deep reforms.

zh: 欧盟不应辜负特斯拉曾经对其抱有的希望。
en: The EU must not fall short of the expectations that Tesla undoubtedly would have had for it.

zh: 所有欧洲人都应当有机会加入欧洲计划，并从其变革潜力中得到好处。
en: All Europeans should be afforded the opportunity to participate in the European project and benefit from its transformative potential.

zh: 这恰恰符合绝大部分巴尔干人的期望。
en: That is precisely what a large segment of the Balkan population still wants.

zh: 欧盟领导人不能保证加入欧盟的过程迅速和容易。
en: EU leaders cannot guarantee that the process of joining the bloc will be quick and easy.

zh: 但只有他们能够保证加入欧盟绝对值得。
en: But only they can ensure that the journey will be worth it.

zh: 赋权孟加拉国纺织女工
en: Empowering Bangladesh’s Female Garment Workers

zh: 达卡—四十年来，纺织业让孟加拉国经济变得强大，比其他任何行业提供的工作岗位都要多。
en: DHAKA – For four decades, the garment industry has powered Bangladesh’s economy and put more people to work than any other sector.

zh: 女性尤其从这一就业繁荣中获益。 如今，纺织业纺织业四百万工人中一大半是女性。
en: Women in particular have benefited from this hiring boom, and today, a majority of the industry’s four million employees are female.

zh: 但尽管纺织贸易让女性荷包渐鼓，也挑战了家长式社会的发展，但经济赋权并未大大改善性别平等和女性福利。
en: But while the textile trade has put money in women’s purses and challenged a patriarchal society to evolve, economic empowerment has not greatly improved gender equality and female wellbeing.

zh: 相反，孟加拉国最大产业的女工人们面临着两方面的危险：家庭和职场。
en: On the contrary, women with jobs in Bangladesh’s largest industry are now imperiled on two fronts – at home and at work.

zh: 关于纺织业的剥削的文章不可胜数，但很少有勾勒该行业女性所受到的健康和安全的影响的数据。
en: While much has been written about exploitation in the garment industry, there is a paucity of data on the health and safety implications for women in this sector.

zh: 我们的组织icddr,b（国际痢疾疾病研究孟加拉国中心）致力于改变这一状况。
en: Our organization, icddr,b (International Centre for Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh), is working to change this.

zh: 在一系列最新研究中，我们探索了制衣女工所面临的她们永远承受不起的健康和福利问题 — — 包括生理上和心理上。
en: In a series of recent studies, we explored the health and welfare issues – both physical and emotional – faced by women who produce clothing that they will never be able to afford.

zh: 我们所交谈的女性大多都有惊人类似的故事。
en: The women we spoke with shared markedly similar stories.

zh: 大部分人都结婚了或结过婚，教育程度很低，从孟加拉国赤贫之家来到城市工作供养家庭。
en: Most were or had been married, are poorly educated, and migrated to cities from poverty-stricken households in Bangladesh to work and support their families.

zh: 大部分受访者说每天都要工作至少十小时，没有休息天。
en: Most interviewees reported working at least ten hours per day, every day.

zh: 许多人需要超时间工作才能完成每小时100件衬衣的每日生产定额。
en: Many work overtime to meet their daily production quota of 100 shirts per hour.

zh: 取决于她们的职位，她们的工作需要在整个过程中保持站立（如果是质检员 ） 、 坐下（如果是机器操作员）或来回走动（如果是车间帮工 ） 。
en: And, depending on their position, they spend the entirety of their shifts either standing (if they are quality inspectors), sitting (if they are machine operators), or moving (if they are factory-floor helpers).

zh: 但让我们的研究变得独特的是我们收集到关于她们工作后会发生什么的信息。
en: But what makes our studies unique is the information we collected about what happens after work.

zh: 这方面的数据更加令人震惊。
en: And here, the data are even more striking.

zh: 首先，大部分已婚女工的工作日并不因为下班而结束。
en: For starters, most married female workers’ workdays don’t end when their shift at the factory does.

zh: 回到家后，她们还要做饭、搞卫生、干其他家务 — — 下班后额外的工作让她们筋疲力尽，很容易生病。
en: Back at home, they are expected to cook, clean, and perform other household chores – work on top of work that leaves them exhausted and prone to illness.

zh: 孕妇尤其容易因为残酷的工作日程而受到严重的健康问题，比如高血压。
en: Pregnant women in particular suffer significant health problems, such as hypertension, owing to their brutal schedules.

zh: 但大部分妇女因为需要收入而继续从事工作、尽量隐瞒自己怀孕的状况，害怕工头会因为发现她们怀孕而辞退她们。
en: And yet most women, needing the income, continue working and hide their pregnancies as long as possible, out of fear that supervisors will fire them when they find out.

zh: 这也造成了心理问题。
en: This also takes an emotional toll.

zh: 来自农村的职业母亲纷纷表示因为常常需要把孩子留在村里而感到很有负罪感、焦虑和压力，而她们之所以要撇下孩子，原因在于承担不起在达卡养孩子的时间和费用。
en: Working mothers from rural villages report experiencing high levels of guilt, anxiety, and stress caused by being away from the children whom they often have to leave in their home village, because they cannot afford – in terms of time or money – to care for them in Dhaka.

zh: 五分之二的女工表现出自杀倾向。
en: Two out of five workers show suicidal tendencies.

zh: 但我们所研究的工厂医疗体系并不将心理疾病视为严重问题。
en: Yet the factory health-care systems that we have studied do not treat mental illness as a serious problem.

zh: 事实上，大部分工厂不为全体员工提供任何心理健康服务。
en: In fact, most factories do not have any mental-health-care provisions at all for their workers.

zh: 结果，大部分妇女的苦无人知晓。
en: As a result, most women suffer in silence.

zh: 最后，我们的研究发现在纺织业就业和针对女性的暴力（生理、心理和性暴力）之间存在令人不安的相关性。
en: Finally, our research identified a disturbing correlation between employment in the garment industry and violence (physical, emotional, and sexual) against women.

zh: 高达43%的受访者说她们在过去的一年中被配偶性侵。
en: A staggering 43% of respondents said they had been sexually assaulted by a spouse during the previous year.

zh: 根据这个数字做一个合理的推断，这种形式的暴力的全国平均水平为13 % 。
en: To put this figure in perspective, the national average for this form of violence is 13%.

zh: 我们没有数据做出关于为何虐待率在纺织贸易中如此之高的结论性评估，但数据与流行的观点一致：该领域妇女与性工作和乱交有一定联系。
en: While we don’t have the data for a conclusive assessment of why rates of abuse are so high in the garment trade, the data are consistent with the prevailing popular view that women in this field are somehow associated with sex work and sexual promiscuity.

zh: 毫无疑问，孟加拉国妇女通过参与纺织业赢得了一定程度的自主和财务独立。
en: There is no doubt that women in Bangladesh have earned a degree of autonomy and financial independence from their participation in the garment industry.

zh: 但我们的数据表明，这些进步是有代价的。
en: But, as our data illustrate, these gains have come at a cost.

zh: 尽管活动价和行业内部人士认识到针对女工人的态度和虐待行为必须改变，但目前尚未形成关于如何推进的共识。
en: And, although activists and industry insiders recognize that attitudes and abusive practices toward female workers must change, there is currently no consensus about how to proceed.

zh: 我们认为应该从现在开始改变，一个很好的起点是促使跨国公司将性别平等作为工作重点。
en: We think it is time to change that, and a good place to start would be by pushing multinational firms to make gender equality a high priority.

zh: 许多依靠孟加拉国工厂的全球品牌已经在办公室中推动性别平等。
en: Many of the global brands that rely on Bangladesh’s factories have committed to gender parity in their corporate offices.

zh: 它们还应该在生产端做同样的事情，生产端的管理岗位几乎全部被男性垄断，这一不平等现象加剧了社会其他方面的性别失衡。
en: They should do the same on the production side, where managerial positions are occupied almost exclusively by men, a disparity that reinforces the gender imbalance elsewhere in society.

zh: 但也许最重要的变化是要让男性参与到性别对话中来。
en: But perhaps the most important change to be made is to engage men in a dialogue on gender.

zh: 在一些非洲国家，性别敏感化（gender-sensitization）项目减少了针对女性的歧视和暴力。
en: In several African countries, gender-sensitization initiatives have reduced discrimination and violence against women.

zh: 比如，一项西非计划让夫妻们一起参加调解“对话会 ” ， 以改善女性在财务决策中的作用。
en: One program in West Africa, for example, brings husbands and wives together for mediated “dialogue sessions” to improve women’s role in financial decision-making.

zh: 要在孟加拉国也实现类似的进步，必须进行深远的政策和计划改革。
en: To make similar gains in Bangladesh, profound changes in policies and programs are needed.

zh: 纺织业和全体男性必须致力于女性赋权目标。
en: The garment industry and men more broadly must commit to the goal of women’s empowerment.

zh: 孟加拉国妇女用近40年的工作助推孟加拉国最重要的产业。
en: After nearly 40 years on the job, women are the driving force behind Bangladesh’s most important industry.

zh: 但此时此刻，她们付出的生理和心理代价过于高昂。
en: But at the moment, they are paying too high a physical and emotional price.

zh: 改造孟加拉国的制衣业
en: Mending Bangladesh’s Garment Industry

zh: 吉隆坡 — — 四年前，孟加拉国拉纳广场制衣企业的致命灾难掀起了全球制衣业雇用黑幕。
en: KUALA LUMPUR – Four years ago, the deadly collapse of the Rana Plaza garment factory in Bangladesh pulled back the curtain on the employment practices of the global apparel industry.

zh: 我们曾经期望这次造成超过1，100名工人死亡的制衣史上最致命的事故悲剧能在真正意义上变革这个长期野蛮生长的行业。
en: We had hoped that the tragedy, which killed more than 1,100 workers – the deadliest accident in the industry’s history – would have brought meaningful change to a business long left to its own devices.

zh: 不幸的是，我们的研究表明，真实情况恰恰相反。
en: Unfortunately, our research suggests the opposite has happened.

zh: 媒体报道凸显了孟加拉国制衣业持续的犯罪行为，特别是持续依赖童工的现象。
en: Media reports highlight the industry’s ongoing transgressions in Bangladesh, in particular the persistent reliance on child labor.

zh: 2014年，英国时事新闻计划曝光发现证据，证明年仅十三岁的儿童在（非常恶劣的工作条件下）为给英国零售商生产服装而在工厂里工作。
en: In 2014, the British current-affairs program Exposure found evidence of children as young as 13 working in factories (often under harsh conditions) producing clothes for retailers in the United Kingdom.

zh: CBS新闻的另一则秘密报道采访了一位年仅十二岁的女孩，她用一张伪造的年龄证书得到了一份制衣厂的工作。
en: Another undercover report by CBS News interviewed a 12-year-old girl who obtained a factory job using a certificate that falsified her age.

zh: 澳大利亚妇女周刊的记者发现十岁大的女孩为顶级澳大利亚品牌缝制衣物。
en: And journalists from The Australian Women’s Weekly found girls as young as ten stitching clothes for top Australian brands.

zh: 尽管媒体报道令人不安，但它们并没有反应整体状况。
en: While the media reports are troubling, they do not provide the entire picture.

zh: 工厂总共雇用了多少未成年和青少年少女？
en: How many minors and adolescent girls are employed overall in factory jobs?

zh: 更重要的是，是否应当完全禁止她们参与这样的工作?
en: More important, should they be barred from such jobs entirely?

zh: 进厂工作有年龄限制，但多数员工不会在工作场合透露她们的实际年龄。
en: Access to factories is restricted, and most employees will not disclose their actual age in the workplace.

zh: 事实上，记者在报道侵权行为时往往掩盖她们的身份。
en: Indeed, journalists often mask their identity to document abuses.

zh: 我们改变了制衣业未成年员工比例的评估方法，并以此来确定制衣业对孟加拉国的社会价值。
en: We took a different approach to assess the prevalence of underage workers in the garment industry, and to determine the sector’s value to Bangladeshi society.

zh: 作为最近全国人口普查的一部分，我们搜集了成衣厂集中率最高的孟加拉国三个工业区数千名母亲和女童的数据（尤其是那些位于Ashulia、Gazipur和Narayanganj这三个出口加工区以外的成衣厂的数据 ） 。
en: As part of a recent nationwide census, we collected data from thousands of mothers and girls in Bangladesh’s three industrial districts with the highest concentration of ready-made garment factories (particularly those operating outside the Export Processing Zones): Ashulia, Gazipur, and Narayanganj.

zh: 该国大部分女性制衣工人都集中在上述区域。
en: The majority of the country’s female garment workers are concentrated in these areas.

zh: 为了比较，我们还在58个城市区域进行了采访，这些区域都没有开设制衣企业。
en: For comparison, we also carried out interviews in 58 urban areas where garment factories are not located.

zh: 在研究中，我们确认调查区内有3，367名女性和女童承认她们受雇于制衣业。
en: During our research, we identified 3,367 women and girls in the survey areas who reported being employed in the apparel industry.

zh: 在她们当中，3%的人年龄在10到13岁之间，11%的人为14到17岁。
en: Of them, 3% were between the ages of ten and 13, and 11% were 14-17 years old.

zh: 在十八岁以下从事任何工作的861名少女当中，28%的人表示他们受雇于服装企业。
en: Of the 861 girls below the age of 18 who were engaged in any kind of work, 28% said they worked in the garment industry.

zh: 基于上述证据，孟加拉国制衣厂雇用童工（尤其是年轻女童）的现象似乎比最耸人听闻的媒体所报道的更加严重。
en: Based on this evidence, it would appear that Bangladesh’s garment factories are using child labor (particularly that of young girls) more pervasively than even the most sensational media reports suggest.

zh: 但对我们来说，真正的问题在于是否应当彻底禁止或改革这种现象。
en: But for us, the real question is whether this practice should be eradicated or reformed.

zh: 依赖廉价劳工的全球品牌已经承诺禁止这种现象。
en: Global brands relying on cheap labor have promised eradication.

zh: 1992年，约10%的制衣业员工年龄在 十四岁以下。
en: In 1992, about 10% of the garment sector’s workforce was below the age of 14.

zh: 第二年，在美国实行童工抑制法案 — — 也就是所谓禁止美国进口童工生产产品的“哈金法案”后 — — 约有 50,000 名未成年工人被赶出工厂。
en: The following year, after the introduction of the Child Labor Deterrence Act in the United States – the so-called Harkin Bill, which barred US imports of products made with child labor – some 50,000 underage workers were removed from the factory floor.

zh: 此外，孟加拉国服装制造和出口协会已经承诺要逐步淘汰使用童工的陋习，并让孩子们重返学校 — — 女性入学率在制衣业雇佣率高的地区尤其低 — — 禁止雇用的目的是维护2010年禁止雇用十四岁以下童工的一项法律。
en: Meanwhile, the Bangladesh Garment Manufacturers and Exporters Association has pledged to phase out child labor and put children back in school – female school enrollment is typically lower in areas of high garment-industry employment than in other areas – upholding a 2010 law prohibiting employment of children under 14.

zh: 显而易见，我们的数据表明制衣业并没有兑现它们的承诺（虽然孟加拉国政府声称服装加工企业目前“不存在雇用童工”的现象 ） 。
en: Clearly, our data suggest that the industry’s promises have yet to be fulfilled (though the government of Bangladesh claims that there currently is “no child labor” in garment processing units).

zh: 但那对孟加拉国未成年女性员工来说也许并不完全是坏现象。
en: But that may not be entirely bad for underage female workers in Bangladesh.

zh: 由于拉纳广场灾后制衣企业所面临的压力，该行业最低工资提高了77 % ， 达到每月68美元。
en: Thanks to pressure on garment manufacturers in the wake of the Rana Plaza disaster, the industry’s minimum wage was increased 77%, to $68 a month.

zh: 这导致年轻少女在该行业从事有报酬劳动更具吸引力，而尽管十分矛盾，但这却具备一定的社会效益。
en: This has made it more attractive for young girls to take up paid employment in the sector, which, paradoxically, does have some social benefit.

zh: 在孟加拉国工作的少女主要来自贫困家庭。
en: The majority of young girls who are working in Bangladesh are from poor families.

zh: 即使在成衣制造区，相对富裕的家庭也很少将她们的女儿送去工厂工作。
en: Even in garment manufacturing areas, relatively better-off families rarely send their daughters to work in factories.

zh: 尽管近期的举措降低了女童上学的成本（通过发放现金补助和取消学费 ） ， 但许多少女仍然从中学退学，即使她们找不到能赚取工资的工作。
en: Although recent initiatives have lowered the cost of schooling for girls (through cash stipends and the elimination of school fees), many young women still drop out of secondary school, even without the opportunity to engage in paid work.

zh: 这种情况往往造成女孩只剩下婚姻一个选择。
en: That often leaves girls with one option: marriage.

zh: 而且在一个很少执行最低结婚年龄规定的国家，赚取工资是避免过早结婚的最佳方式。
en: And in a country where minimum marriage-age laws are rarely implemented, earning a paycheck is the best way to avoid a premature wedding day.

zh: 在这样的情况下，因为许多少女必须在工厂工作和嫁人之间作出选择，禁止工厂雇用十八岁以下少女带来的坏处可能多于好处。
en: In such a situation, when many young girls must choose between factory work and marrying young, banning factory employment for girls under 18 would do more harm than good.

zh: 为帮助少女避免这种选择，并减少制衣厂雇用未成年人和少女，需要更加强调农村地区的减贫工作。
en: To help young girls avoid this choice, and to reduce the presence of minors and young girls in factories, requires greater emphasis on poverty reduction in rural areas.

zh: 孟加拉国服装业预计将在未来二十年内翻两番，并吸引成百上千万成年和青年女性员工到工厂工作。
en: Bangladesh’s garment industry is expected to quadruple in size over the next two decades, attracting millions more female workers, young and old, to the production floor.

zh: 根据我们的估算，这些新员工的1/10将在10到17岁。
