en: According to our estimates, one of every ten of these new employees will be between 10-17 years of age.

zh: 世界各地的消费者拒绝接受童工生产的服装，这是值得赞扬的举动。
en: Consumers around the world reject clothing stitched by child labor, which is commendable.

zh: 十八岁以下儿童应当在学校学习重要的生存技能，而不是在艰苦的条件下长时间工作。
en: Children under 18 should be in school and learning important life skills, not working long hours under difficult conditions.

zh: 但2013年拉纳广场悲剧的教训比多数国际媒体所总结的更加复杂。
en: But the lessons from the 2013 tragedy at Rana Plaza are more complicated than much of the international media make them out to be.

zh: 服装行业的确需要改革；但在目前情况下，如果不想让女性和少女更多无谓的受苦，承诺彻底禁止童工可能不是正确的选择。
en: The garment industry does need to reform; but, for the time being, if women and girls are not to suffer needlessly again, promising to eradicate child labor may not be the right answer.

zh: 孟加拉国走上塔利班之路
en: Bangladesh Goes Taliban

zh: 孟加拉国正在被带向一个已经吞噬了塔利班统治下的阿富汗的黑洞吗？
en: Is Bangladesh headed into the black hole that consumed Afghanistan under the Taliban?

zh: 当官方和原教旨主义力量毫无顾忌地发挥作用，当当地警察、孟加拉国民族主义党（BNP）和当地政权公开对此表示支持之时，恐惧正在不断加剧。
en: Fears are mounting, as official and fundamentalist religious forces now seem to operate with impunity – and the apparent support of local police, the ruling Bangladeshi National Party, and local authorities.

zh: 多年来，孟加拉国一直是伊斯兰世界的一个例外，用一种和平的、世俗主义的民主方式追求着独立事业。
en: For many years Bangladesh was an exception in the Islamic world, pursuing an independent course in a peaceful, secular, and democratic fashion.

zh: 从传统来看，在Bengali Sufi神秘的宗义教导下，大部分穆斯林人与其他宗教信仰者和平相处，并且孟加拉国在妇女教育和妇女人权方面拥有良好纪录。
en: Traditionally, under Bengali Sufi mystical teachings, the majority Muslim population lived peacefully with other religions, and Bangladesh had a good record on education and civil rights for women.

zh: 然而最近， 穆斯林原教旨主义却因诸如“al-Badr”和“Razaker”等曾在1971年内战中支持过残害平民暴行的民兵组织而蒙羞。
en: Until recently, Muslim fundamentalists were discredited, because militias such as “al-Badr” and “Razakar” had supported atrocities against civilians during the civil war of 1971.

zh: 当2001年孟加拉国总理卡莉达·齐亚（Begum Khaleda Zia ） — —遇刺的军事铁腕人物齐亚将军的遗孀，用“阿拉的主权”取代了宪法中的宗教和世俗分离的世俗主义，那个改变由此开端。
en: That began to change in 2001, when Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia, the widow of the assassinated military strongman General Zia, replaced secularism in the Constitution with the “Sovereignty of Allah.”

zh: 在这种改变的驱使下，BNP的下级联盟伙伴、与民兵组织有一定关系并一直与巴基斯坦保持亲密关系的伊斯兰大会党（Jamaat-e-Islami ） ， 一直呼吁强制实行Sharia（伊斯兰法律 ） 。
en: Encouraged by this change the BNP’s junior coalition partner, Jamaat-e-Islami, which has links with the militias and remains close to Pakistan, has been calling for imposition of Sharia (Islamic law).

zh: BNP似乎将宗教极端主义看作一个打破反对党 — — 受到世俗主义的城市中产阶级大力支持的孟加拉国人民联盟（Awami League）权力的武器。
en: The BNP appears to view religious extremism as a tool to break the power of the opposition Awami League, which is largely supported by the secular and urban middle classes.

zh: 同样地，在沙特和海湾国家的资助下，madrassas（伊斯兰学校）数量的大幅增长是为改变孟加拉国宗教忍让文化的明确行动的一部分。 现在madrassas总数已经高达约64,000所，并在激发过塔利班的同一个原教旨Deobandi伊斯兰教下运作。
en: Similarly, the massive rise in the number of madrassas (religious schools) financed by Saudi and Gulf money – totalling roughly 64,000 and operating under the same fundamentalist Deobandi Islam that inspired the Taliban – is part of a clear effort to change Bangladesh’s culture of religious tolerance.

zh: 孟加拉国独立事业内在的危险是真实的。
en: The danger inherent in Bangladesh’s course is very real.

zh: 印度情报官员宣称BNP某联盟伙伴领导人，Mufti Fazlul Haque Amini与被取缔的伊斯兰武装团体孟加拉伊斯兰圣战运动 （Huji）保持着联系，而该组织又与基地组织关系密切。
en: Indian intelligence officials allege that the leader of a BNP coalition partner, Mufti Fazlul Haque Amini, maintains ties to the banned armed Islamist group Harkat-ul-Jihad-al-Islami, or Huji, which in turn is allegedly linked to Al Qaeda.

zh: 1999年，Huji成员试图用一把斧子刺杀温和派诗人Shamshur Rahman。
en: In 1999, Huji members attempted to assassinate the moderate poet Shamshur Rahman with an axe.

zh: 44名Huji成员遭到逮捕，其中2名据称是由奥索玛·本·拉登（Osama Bin Laden）从南非和巴基斯坦派来将钱分发给极端主义madrassas的。
en: Forty-four Huji members were arrested, two of whom claimed to have been sent from South Africa and Pakistan by Osama Bin Laden to distribute money to the extremist madrassas.

zh: 那些在海湾国家当移民的孟加拉国工人带着激进的瓦哈比（Wahhabi）和Salafi所教授的思想回到祖国，愈加地煽风点火。
en: Bangladeshi migrant workers in the Gulf States who return home imbued with radical Wahhabi and Salafi teachings fan the fires even more.

zh: 2004年，在为获得激进伊斯兰领导人中最大影响力而竞争的Bangla Bhai在几个与印度接壤的地区发起伊斯兰革命。
en: Competing for influence among radical Islamist leaders in northwestern Bangladesh is Bangla Bhai, who in 2004 attempted an Islamist revolution in several provinces bordering India.

zh: 由于受到当地警察和10,0000余名追随者的支持下，这场叛乱直到政府镇压后才宣告结束。
en: Supported by local police and 10,000 followers, the rebellion ended only after a government crackdown.

zh: 非政府组织的反刑罚工作组已经证明了超过500宗激进伊斯兰分子的刑罚和胁迫案件，他们曾谋杀过诸如Abdul Kayyam Badshah之类的共产党支持者。
en: The NGO Taskforce against Torture has documented over 500 cases of torture and intimidation by radical Islamists, who also have murdered supporters of the Communist Party, such as Abdul Kayyam Badshah.

zh: 事实上，印度教徒、基督教和佛教徒也被他们视为目标，并且宗教极端分子最近还袭击了被奉若神明的Sufi圣地，甚至还攻击了孟加拉国联合了各宗教以共同名义举行的文化活动。
en: Indeed, Hindus, Christians, and Buddhists have been targeted as well, and religious extremists more recently have attacked Sufi shrines deemed to be idolatrous, and even Bengali cultural events that unite all religions in a common identity.

zh: 例如，在去年10月的Ramadan祷告中，1,000人的暴徒之众将一个Ahmadiyya穆斯林团体的清真寺夷为平地。
en: For example, during Ramadan prayers last October, a mob of a 1,000 people razed a mosque of the Ahmadiyya Muslim community.

zh: 这个穆斯林教派的100,000名相信Muhammad并非最后一位先知的成员被认为是异教徒，并且，直到孟加拉国高级法院推翻这个宣判之前，他们的出版物一直被政府宣布为不合法刊物。
en: The 100,000 members of this Muslim sect, which believes that Muhammad was not the last prophet, have been declared infidels, and the government outlawed their publications until the ban was reversed by the Bangladeshi High Court.

zh: 印度教教徒、Ahmadiyyas教徒以及居于Chittagong山的部落民族出于对他们人身安全的担忧，正成群结队地离开孟加拉国。
en: Hindus, Ahmadiyyas, and tribal people in the Chittagong hills, fearful for their safety, have been leaving the country in droves.

zh: 暴力氛围在其他方面也很明显。
en: The atmosphere of violence is palpable in other ways.

zh: Sheikh Hasina — — 孟加拉国人民联盟领导人兼孟加拉国建国之父的女儿，在去年一场导致约20人死亡、百来人受伤的手榴弹袭击中死里逃生，凶手却至今未被缉获。
en: Sheikh Hasina, the Awami League’s leader and the daughter of the Bangladesh’s founding father, survived a grenade attack last summer that killed at least 20 people and injured hundreds more. The killers have never been apprehended.

zh: 英国驻孟加拉国高级大使也在今年5月一场类似的炸弹袭击中受伤。
en: Britain’s High Commissioner in Bangladesh was wounded in a similar bomb attack this May.

zh: 虽然孟加拉国政府受到捐助国的重重压力，但好就好在他们已经感觉到他们的国家正在滑向一条失败国家之路，为此他们正尽最大的努力以逮捕伊斯兰凶犯，尽管这些凶手中有些还是统治联盟中的成员。
en: To its credit – albeit under pressure from donor countries – the Bengali authorities seem to sense that their country is drifting toward becoming a failed state and are making greater efforts to arrest Islamist killers, despite some of them being part of the ruling coalition.

zh: 两个激进伊斯兰团体已经被取缔。
en: Two radical Islamist groups have also been banned.

zh: 但是，如若不相容的文化得以根深蒂固，一一捕获这些凶手也不足以扭转孟加拉国的下滑趋势。
en: But piecemeal arrests will not be enough to reverse the drift if a culture of intolerance is allowed to fester.

zh: 一个令人鼓舞的消息是，过去几年中孟加拉国的经济年增长率一直稳定地保持在5 % 。
en: One encouraging note is that annual economic growth has been a steady 5% for the past few years.

zh: 但是现在，由于继去年结束配额制之后中国纺织品的无限量进口，许多孟加拉国人对他们生计十分担忧。
en: But now many Bangladeshis fears for their livelihoods, owing to unlimited Chinese textile imports following the end of quotas last year.

zh: 孟加拉国的经济恶化将不仅加剧了种族间的紧张关系并为吉哈德分子（jihadis）提供了一个适宜的成长环境，但是能够阻止这种下滑趋势所必需的改革却通常被政治混战和反对联合抵制所阻扰。
en: Economic deterioration in Bangladesh would only worsen inter-communal tensions and provide a fertile breeding ground for jihadis, but the reforms needed to head off decline are often blocked by political infighting and opposition boycotts.

zh: 这个世界无法承受在孟加拉国出现第二个阿富汗，据信孟加拉伊斯兰圣战运动（Huji）成员在那里为政权垮台后的许多塔利班分子提供了避难所。
en: The world cannot afford a second Afghanistan in Bangladesh, where Huji members are believed to have given sanctuary to many Taliban fighters after the fall of their regime.

zh: 印度施加的压力还不足以迫使孟加拉国政府坚持该国在寻求独立的前三百年过程中所奉行的伊斯兰教容忍性。
en: Pressure from India will not be enough to force the Bengali government to adhere to the tolerant form of Islam that the country pursued during its first three decades of independence.

zh: 亚洲所有的力量，包括中国和日本，将会为阻止孟加拉国滑向狂热和混乱出一份力。
en: All of Asia’s powers, including China and Japan, will have to play a part in stopping Bangladesh’s drift into fanaticism and chaos.

zh: 世界其他国家也应该在为时已晚之前支持他们。
en: The rest of the world should support them before it is too late.

zh: 驱逐饥饿
en: Banishing Starvation

zh: 发自维也纳 — — 在全世界70亿人口中约有10亿人正遭受着饥饿的折磨，这一方面是由于各地发生的一连串不幸事件和状况，另一方面则源自于不断增加的粮食需求，无法预测的天气状况以及低下的财政管理手段。
en: VIENNA – Of the world’s almost seven billion people, about one billion are starving, owing to a long list of unfortunate local events and circumstances, together with steadily increasing demand, unpredictable weather patterns, and poor financial management.

zh: 而随着全球人口预计将在2050年左右达到90亿，粮食短缺问题很可能会进一步恶化。
en: And food shortages could grow much worse, as world population is expected to reach nine billion by 2050 or earlier.

zh: 但只要实施了合理的政策项目，我们其实是可以为所有人提供足够食物的。
en: But, with the right programs, we can produce enough food for everyone.

zh: 事实上只要立即采取恰当的行动，我们就能完全根除饥饿。
en: Indeed, by taking the right actions now, we can eradicate starvation.

zh: 全球粮食供应量必须增加50%来满足未来20年内的需求。
en: To meet expected demand over the next 20 years, global food supplies must increase by an estimated 50%.

zh: 因此我们在着手增加发展中国家贫困农民收入的同时也需要建立可持续的农业发展来增加粮食供应，并将价格维持在民众可承受的水平。
en: So we need sustainable agriculture-led growth to increase supplies and keep prices affordable while also boosting the incomes of poor farmers in developing countries.

zh: 对于那些种田为生的农民来说，这类项目不但能提高其生产力，减低他们对气候的依赖程度，还能提供简单的金融工具鼓励他们投资新技术设备，购买土地并增加当地市场渠道。
en: This can be achieved through a program for subsistence farmers that not only improves productivity, but also reduces weather dependency and provides simple financing instruments to encourage investment in new technologies and equipment, increased land ownership, and easier access to local markets.

zh: 而帮助这些农民摆脱原来的不利境地就等同于将饥饿人口的数量减半。
en: Lifting subsistence farmers out of their precarious position would be equivalent to halving the number of hungry people.

zh: 但这些项目只有在联合国粮食及农业组织（FAO）这类国际组织能与各国政府与私人捐赠者/合作伙伴的携手合作下才能实现。
en: But it’s a program that can be achieved only if international organizations like the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) work hand-in-hand with national governments and with private donors and partners.

zh: 欧盟以及其其它发达国家已决心解决全球粮食安全的问题，也很容易来将自身的方案结合到更宏大的项目之中。
en: The European Union and other developed countries are already intent on tackling the problem of global food security, and could easily tailor their own schemes to become part of this wider program.

zh: 比如欧盟就是通过两种政策工具来支持农业增长和农村地区发展的。
en: For example, the EU supports the growth of agriculture and rural development through two types of instruments.

zh: 第一种是地理概念上的机制，例如欧洲开发基金（EDF）就专门扶持农业政策在非洲，加勒比海地区和太平洋岛国的推行 — — 欧盟的发展合作机制（DCI）也对拉美，亚洲国家以及南非提供类似扶持。
en: Geographical initiatives, like the European Development Fund (EDF), support implementation of agricultural policies in the African, Caribbean, and Pacific countries (the Development Cooperation Instrument provides similar support in Latin America, Asia, and South Africa).

zh: 而这类项目也已实现了巨额投资 — — 仅仅是在非洲，计划于2007年~2013年间运作的本轮欧洲开发基金项目就拨付了超过10亿欧元来支持农业进步，农村地区发展以及粮食安全项目。
en: Such programs already add up to significant spending – the current EDF, which runs from 2007-2013, has set aside more than €1 billion to support agriculture, rural development, and food security in Africa alone.

zh: 第二种政策工具则是应对自然灾害，市场崩溃或者政治危机这类突发事件的紧急专款。
en: The second type of instrument is emergency funding to deal with unforeseen events, such as natural disasters, market breakdowns, and political instability.

zh: 在此欧盟专门为应对发展中国家粮食价格飞涨而在2008年创立的10亿欧元临时食品基金就是一个绝佳范例。
en: The EU’s ad hoc €1 billion Food Facility, created in 2008 for rapid response to soaring food prices in developing countries, is a good example.

zh: 而这类政策工具的目的也包括了在特定国家推动中短期的农业发展。
en: Its objectives also include boosting agriculture in the short to medium term in selected countries.

zh: 作为联合国粮农组织布基纳法索项目的一部分，欧盟食品基金为10万名小农提供了优质粮食种子，使70万人得以在萨赫勒（Sahel）地区不断加剧的粮食危机中幸免于难。
en: As part of an FAO project in Burkina Faso, the EU’s Food Facility has helped to provide high-quality seeds to 100,000 vulnerable farmers, benefiting roughly 700,000 people amid the growing food crisis in the Sahel region.

zh: 在欧盟约合1800万欧元的支持下，该行动将提升近86万农村家庭（约600万人）的食品安全水平。
en: With EU support worth €18 million, this operation will improve food security for around 860,000 rural households, or more than six million people.

zh: 与此同时，约值250万欧元的两个莫桑比克食品基金项目也增加了农业产量，提高商业化农产品质量并解决了影响农村家庭的食品安全事务，使5万农民以和30万农村家庭得到了实惠。
en: Similarly, two Food Facility projects in Mozambique, worth a total of €2.5 million, are benefiting almost 50,000 farmers and nearly 300,000 rural families by increasing agricultural production, improving conditions for commercializing products, and addressing food security issues that affect rural households.

zh: 除了这些金融工具之外，我们还需要通过投资现代化农业并降低减产风险的方式来改善现状。
en: Beyond these financial instruments, we need to improve on the status quo by investing in the research and development needed to modernize agriculture and reduce the risk of crop failures.

zh: 对此必须研究发展出更合理也更加可持续的禽畜饲养方式，同时也必须增加在产能建设，服务训练，市场渠道和强化供应链方面的投资。
en: Better, environmentally sustainable livestock production systems need to be developed, and we must boost investment in capacity-building, services training, market access, and efforts to strengthen supply chains.

zh: 同样重要的还有研究对付跨区域动植物病害的最有效手段。
en: Equally important is research into the most effective measures to combat cross-border animal and plant diseases.

zh: 毕竟农业必须被放到一个更宏大的生态系统来进行研究，而这就意味着发展更有力手段来保护土地，森林和鱼业资源。
en: Agriculture, after all, must be viewed in the context of the wider eco-system, which also means developing improved methods for conserving resources such as soil, forests, and fisheries.

zh: 为了成功应对全球食品安全问题，我们必须改变自己处理农村发展的方式，而这就意味我们必须采取一个更加至下而上的手段。
en: To tackle global food security successfully, we must change the way we treat rural development, which requires adopting a much more bottom-up approach.

zh: 另一方面，我认为欧洲在这方面是起表率作用的，因为他们协助发展中国家推行开发政策，而该政策恰好就是通过增加基本农作物产量并提高效率的方式来促进基础更加广泛的农村经济发展。
en: Again, I think that the EU is leading the way in developing countries with development policies that promote broad-based rural economic growth by boosting primary production and increasing its efficiency. Indeed, by promoting agricultural practices and technologies that are environmentally sustainable and raise rural incomes, these policies also stimulate rural non-farm activities.

zh: 但粮食系统的首要问题也必须得到解决。
en: But problems at the top of the food system must be addressed as well.

zh: 而其中的重要步骤就是合理监管全球金融市场，避免金融衍生品投机行为不断推高粮食价格。
en: An important step would be better regulation of global financial markets in order to end the derivatives speculation that forces food prices up.

zh: 此外世界贸易组织多哈回合谈判必须取得成果，而欧盟对此也提议改革其内部出口补贴制度，为推动回合圆满完成贡献了一系列积极举动。
en: Moreover, the World Trade Organization’s Doha Round of global trade negotiations desperately needs to be concluded, and the EU has made a number of positive moves in this direction by proposing vast changes to its export subsidies regime.

zh: 近年来欧洲在出口补贴/退税方面的支出已经显著减少 — — 从1990年代占农业总支出的30%下降到今天的不足1 % （ 农村发展资金除外 ） ， 而这种大幅削减其实就是欧盟向世贸组织以及其他国家做出承诺并成功改革《共同农业政策》的成果。
en: European spending on export refunds has declined considerably in recent years – from 30% of agricultural expenditure in the early 1990’s to less than 1% today (if rural development is excluded). This huge drop results from successive reforms of the EU’s Common Agricultural Policy, owing to commitments made by the EU to the WTO and to other developments on world markets.

zh: 去年欧盟的农业补贴额比2009年下降了超过40 % 。 只有约4亿欧元。
en: Last year, Europe’s spending on export refunds dropped by more than 40% from 2009, to just €400 million.

zh: 随着越来越多农民被他们无法控制的力量驱逐出自己的土地，我们需要找到一个更好的方式来平衡农村和城市人口之间的需求和权利。
en: With more and more subsistence farmers being driven off their land by pressures far beyond their control, we need to find better ways to balance the needs and rights of rural and urban populations.

zh: 除非我们立刻行动起来，否则下一代人将无法有尊严地生活在一个环境可持续的世界之上。
en: Unless we begin to do so, succeeding generations will fail to realize an environmentally sustainable world where people live in dignity.

zh: 不可指望银行的破产
en: Don’t Bank on Bankruptcy for Banks

zh: 坎布里奇—下个月，美国财政部将决定是否寻求用完全基于法院的机制取代2010年多德-弗兰克法案（Dodd-Frank Act）规定的由监管者主导破产大型银行处置的流程。
en: CAMBRIDGE – In the next month, the US Treasury Department is expected to decide whether to seek to replace the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act’s regulator-led process for resolving failed mega-banks with a solely court-based mechanism.

zh: 这一变化将是一个可能造成未来危机的错误。
en: Such a change would be a mistake of potentially crisis-size proportions.

zh: 诚然，建立更顺畅的破产程序能够降低银行破产的影响，破产法官也是重要重组任务的专家。
en: Yes, creating a more streamlined bankruptcy process can reduce the decibel level of a bank’s failure, and bankruptcy judges are experts at important restructuring tasks.

zh: 但有一些关键性因素不可忽视。
en: But there are critical factors that cannot be ignored.

zh: 重组一家大型银行需要事先规划、熟悉银行的优势和劣势、了解如何在高波动的经济中确定合理的破产时机，以及能够与外国监管者协调。
en: Restructuring a mega-bank requires pre-planning, familiarity with the bank’s strengths and weaknesses, knowledge of how to time the bankruptcy properly in a volatile economy, and the capacity to coordinate with foreign regulators.

zh: 法院无法单独胜任这些任务，特别是在所考虑的方案时间有限 — — 周末的48小时 — — 的时候。
en: The courts cannot fulfill these tasks alone, especially in the time the proposal under consideration has allotted – a 48-hour weekend.

zh: 无法事先规划意味着法院将在不熟悉银行的情况下进入重组流程。
en: Unable to plan ahead, the courts would enter into the restructuring process unfamiliar with the bank.

zh: 此外，如果多家大银行同时倒闭，将引发整个经济的危机，而法院无法处置这类危机。
en: Moreover, the courts cannot manage the kind of economy-wide crisis that would arise if multiple mega-banks sank simultaneously.

zh: 他们也无法与外国监管者协调。
en: And they cannot coordinate with foreign regulators.

zh: 简言之，完整的合理重组流程需要监管者的参与，包括事先规划、建议和协调等方面。
en: In short, completing a proper restructuring would require contributions from regulators, including pre-planning, advice, and coordination.

zh: 但是，目前的计划非但没有考虑监管者的这些作用，反而要让他们隔绝在破产流程之外。
en: Yet, far from accepting these contributions, the plan would largely cut regulators out of the process.

zh: 比如，财政部将禁止监管者发动大银行的破产流程，破产流程将完全成为银行管理层的自由裁量权。
en: For example, the plan would bar regulators from initiating a mega-bank’s bankruptcy, leaving it to the discretion of the bank’s own managers.

zh: 在非金融部门，倒闭的公司常常要等太久才能宣布破产，因此债权人可能介入，甚至迫使倒闭企业进入破产流程。
en: In the nonfinancial sector, failing companies often wait too long before declaring bankruptcy, so creditors may step in to do some pushing, potentially even forcing a bankruptcy of a failed firm.

zh: 监管者也拥有推动银行破产的工具，但它们最有效的工具还是在对经济最有利的时机启动破产程序。
en: While bank regulators have tools to push banks similarly, their most effective one is the power to initiate a bankruptcy when it is best for the economy.

zh: 取缔这个工具可能带来严重的负面后果。
en: Taking this tool away could have severe adverse consequences.

zh: 和倒闭的产业企业高管一样，银行高管也有理由“祈祷和拖延 ” ， 以期新的发展趋势能够拯救他们。
en: Bank executives, like sinking industrial firm executives, have reason to “pray and delay,” hoping that some new development will save them.

zh: 但如果倒闭大银行在这一拖延过程中耗尽现金，就有可能陷入无序破产 — — 2008年的雷曼兄弟（Lehman Brothers）就是如此 — — 并给实体经济造成严重破坏。
en: But if a failing mega-bank runs out of cash during such a delay, the risk that its bankruptcy will be disorderly – as with Lehman Brothers in 2008 – rises, as does the potential that it will wreak havoc on the real economy.

zh: 简单的事实是政府监管者能够做一些法院不能做的事。
en: The simple fact is that government regulators can do things that courts cannot.

zh: 法院缺少人手和专业知识制定全国性的复苏计划。
en: Courts lack the staff and expertise to come up with a nation-wide recovery plan.

zh: 此外，它们也无法给现金不足的濒临倒闭的银行贷款直到它能够自立。
en: Moreover, they cannot lend to a cash-poor wobbly bank until it can stand on its own.

zh: 政府可以做到这些 — — 还能确保银行将偿还贷款（通过要求优质抵押品实现 ） ， 或者金融业整体能够覆盖贷款偿还额（多德-弗兰克法案授权并要求这样做 ） 。
en: The government can do that – and it can make sure that either the bank will repay the loans (by getting good collateral) or that the financial sector overall will cover the repayment (as Dodd-Frank authorized and required).

zh: 法院在主持非金融业破产案时，它们依靠私人贷款人提供紧急流动性。
en: When courts preside over nonfinancial bankruptcies, they depend on private lenders to provide emergency liquidity.

zh: 但在金融危机中，虚弱的银行无法贷款，这意味着政府必须承担最后贷款人的角色。
en: But in a financial crisis, weakened banks cannot lend, meaning that the government must serve as the lender of last resort.

zh: 要想扮演好这一角色，政府必须深度参与到破产流程中，从而能够在需要时挺身而出。
en: And to play that role well, the government must be deeply involved in the bankruptcy process, so that it can jump in if needed.

zh: 当前的方案 — — 它已经在众议院通过 — — 还有其他严重缺陷。
en: The current proposal, which the US House of Representatives has already passed, has other major flaws.

zh: 首先，美国大银行在全世界都有经营，通常在伦敦和其他金融中心都有很大的分支。
en: For starters, American mega-banks operate worldwide, typically with a significant presence in London and other financial centers.

zh: 如果一家倒闭美国大银行的海外分行的债权人和存款人挤兑他们存在那里的现金，或者如果外国监管者关闭了该分行，那么这家美国银行将陷入无法挽回的境地。
en: If creditors and depositors of a failed American mega-bank’s foreign affiliate run off with the cash they held there, or if a foreign regulator shuts down that affiliate, the US bank would be in an untenable position.

zh: 但法院无法与外国监管者协商谅解。
en: Yet courts cannot negotiate understandings with foreign regulators.

zh: 美国监管者可以，但只有在它们能够控制破产时机（或者要么参与到破产流程中）时才可以。
en: American regulators can, but only if they can control the timing of the bankruptcy, and otherwise engage in the process.

zh: 平心而论，现行破产法案是有用的。
en: To be sure, the bankruptcy bill now in play is useful.

zh: 但它不够强大。
en: But it is not robust.

zh: 它不允许大范围的全面破产，在这类破产中，倒闭的业务将在法院保护下关闭，有盈利能力的业务将被出售，债务将围绕公司资产负债表进行重组。
en: It would not allow broad-spectrum, full-scale bankruptcies, in which failing operations are closed under the court’s aegis, viable operations are sold, and debts are restructured up and down a company’s balance sheet.

zh: 相反，当前方案构想了一个规模有限的周末重组，这要求准确的贷款结构在几年前就已经准备就绪。
en: Rather, the current proposal envisages a limited-scale weekend restructuring, requiring that a precise loan structure be put in place years ahead of time.

zh: 银行将在星期五晚上关门，在周末期间卸下预先确定的缩水债务，然后在星期一早上重新开张，而不必（在最佳情景中）需要政府援助。
en: The bank would be closed on Friday evening, unburdened of pre-positioned evaporating debts over the weekend, and reopened on Monday morning, without (in the best-case scenario) needing a government bailout.

zh: 如果取得成功，这种速战速决式破产流程很有价值。
en: If successful, this kind of rapid-fire bankruptcy process would be valuable.

zh: 但它从未实行过。
en: But it has never been tried.

zh: 要想在星期一早晨有机会重新开张，破产银行的数十亿美元长期债务需要事先组织，从而让破产法院能够在周末消除它。
en: To have any chance of re-opening on Monday morning, a bankrupt bank’s billions of dollars in long-term debt would already have to be structured in such a way that a bankruptcy court could eliminate it over a weekend.

zh: 但破产法官无法实现获得关于一家银行债务的知识，短短一个周末也不足以让他们确定债务是否能够被合理消除。
en: But bankruptcy judges would have no knowledge in advance of a bank’s debt, and they would need more than a weekend to determine whether that debt could be properly stripped out.

zh: 另一方面，政府监管者能够事先做好这些。
en: Government regulators, on the other hand, could do this in advance.

zh: 然而，在当前方案中，它们这样做的官方手段被严重制约了。
en: And yet, under the current proposal, their official means of doing so would be sharply rolled back.

zh: 能够见效的话，破产是实现倒闭企业重组或分解的好办法。
en: Bankruptcy, if it works, is a good way for a failing firm to restructure or shrink.

zh: 但如果倒闭的大银行无法在星期一早晨开门营业，金融体系就需要支持。
en: But if a failing mega-bank cannot open on Monday morning, the financial system will need backup.

zh: 根据当前方案，缺乏监管安全网可能导致 — — 如果周末重组失败的话 — — 全球性的混乱崩盘，一如2008年雷曼兄弟破产后的情景。
en: Under the current proposal, the absence of a regulatory safety net could result, if the weekend restructuring fails, in a global chaotic free-for-all, just like the one that followed the 2008 Lehman Brothers bankruptcy.

zh: 在危机中保持金融稳定对于我们无比重要，因此不能将希望寄托在狭窄的破产渠道上。
en: Maintaining financial stability in a crisis is too important for us to pin our hopes on a narrow bankruptcy channel.

zh: 法院能起到帮助作用，特别是在它们制定出一套常规化的银行重组流程之后 — — 就像它们对航空公司重组所做的那样。
en: The courts can help, especially after they have developed a routinized process for restructuring banks, as they have done with airline restructurings.

zh: 但我们应该对依靠法院来完成它们此前从未被要求完成的任务保持谨慎。
en: But we should be wary about relying on courts to do things they have never been asked to do before.

zh: 众议院已经仓促投票支持用更弱的法院领导的安排取代监管者领导的重组制度。
en: The House already voted, precipitously, to replace the regulator-led restructuring system with a weaker court-led setup.

zh: 但愿在财政部，更清醒的头脑能够胜出。
en: Let’s hope that wiser heads at the Treasury Department prevail.

zh: 120名破产、银行监管、金融或这三方面兼顾的专家学者联署了一份相同的结论并致信国会。
en: A letter to Congress with a similar conclusion was signed by 120 academics with expertise in bankruptcy, banking regulation, finance, or all three.

zh: 下一轮全球繁荣 — — 和破灭
en: The Next Global Boom – and Bust

zh: 华盛顿—本月早些时候在这里举行的国际货币基金组织（IMF ） - 世界银行春季会议的情绪是阴沉的。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The mood at the International Monetary Fund-World Bank spring meetings here earlier this month was grim.

zh: 最新IMF全球增长预测再次调低 — — 认为今年和2017年世界年增长率将只能略高于3 % 。
en: The latest IMF forecast for global growth has been revised downward yet again – suggesting the world will grow at an annual rate of just over 3% this year and again in 2017.

zh: 如果成为现实的话，这将是非常糟糕的表现。
en: If realized, this would be a dismal performance.

zh: 2007年前，全球增长（用IMF的方法）落在4.5—5%区间，其基础是工业国生产率稳步改善以及中国、巴西和俄罗斯等新兴市场生活水平的迅速提高。
en: Before 2007, global growth (using the IMF’s methodology) was in the 4.5-5% range, based on steady productivity improvements in industrial countries and rapidly rising living standards in large emerging markets such as China, Brazil, and Russia.

zh: 如今，美国面临总统选举的不确定性，欧元区疲软部分仍在挣扎，日本徘徊在全面经济萎缩边缘。
en: Now the US faces the uncertainty of a presidential election, weaker parts of the eurozone continue to struggle, and Japan is teetering on the edge of outright economic contraction.

zh: 巴西陷入了政治危机，中国正在处置长期财政扩张和影子银行体系的爆发式增长带来的后遗症，而大宗商品价格低迷正在动摇许多其他新兴市场的经济表现。
en: Brazil is in the midst of a political crisis, China is dealing with the aftereffects of prolonged fiscal expansion and explosive growth in its shadow banking system, and lower commodity prices are undermining economic performance in many other emerging markets.

zh: 除了所有这些情况，英国可能在6月投票脱离欧盟。
en: On top of all this, the British may vote in June to leave the European Union.

zh: 经济活动受信心的影响：消费者相信他们的收入可能上升（或者能够保住）吗？ 公司相信未来增长足够强劲，能保证当前投资的回报吗？
en: Economic activity is affected by confidence: Do consumers believe their incomes are likely to rise (or even prove secure), and do companies believe that future growth will be buoyant enough to warrant current investment?

zh: 而今天的宏观情绪是普遍悲观。
en: And today’s macro mood is shared pessimism.

zh: 但中期不可能出现全球停滞。
en: Yet the medium-term scenario is unlikely to be global stagnation.

zh: 新技术不断发明，数十亿人想要通过教育和努力工作提高生活水平。
en: New technologies continue to be invented, and billions of people aspire to improve their standard of living through education and hard work.

zh: 领先工业经济体在面临过去十年巨大的消极金融部门冲击，表现出令人瞩目的恢复力 — — 比如中国。
en: Leading industrial economies have demonstrated remarkable resilience in the face of large negative financial-sector shocks over the past decade – as has China.

zh: 美国失业率下降至5 % ， 欧洲也有一些部分表现良好。
en: Unemployment in the United States is down to 5%, and parts of Europe are doing fine.

zh: 而大宗商品价格周期最重要的一点是它是货真价实的周期：大宗商品需求有起有落，而供给变化缓慢。
en: And the most important point about the commodity price cycle is that it is indeed a cycle: Demand for commodities rises and falls, while supply changes only slowly.

zh: 我们应该预料到大宗商品价格的波动 — — 石油亦然。
en: We should expect volatility in commodity prices – as well as in the price of oil.

zh: 最大的问题是我们能否摆脱经济过山车，回归强劲增长而不靠债务推动的过度消费（如2008年前的美国 ） 、 过度投资（如中国）和政府支出过度扩张（至今依然是欧洲一些国家的问题 ） 。
en: The biggest question is whether we can get off the economic roller coaster and return to robust global growth without debt-fueled overconsumption (as seen in the pre-2008 US), overinvestment (as in China), and overexpansion of government spending (still an issue in some parts of Europe).

zh: 债务可以为生产性投资和人力资本的改善提供资金。
en: Debt can fund productive investments and improvement in human capital.

zh: 但我们为何总是表现出过度喜爱债务？
en: But why do we always seem to like it too much?

zh: 部分原因在于税收制度，一些国家的税制允许消费者利息支出（如美国的按揭）从应税收入中扣除。
en: Part of the reason stems from tax systems, which in some countries allow some consumer interest payments (for example, mortgages in the US) to be deducted from taxable income.

zh: 公司利息收入通常也可以抵扣。
en: Corporate interest payments are typically deductible, too.

zh: 但债务的主要魅力在于它是非常简单的契约：你要么支付约定数额，要么不支付。
en: But the main appeal of debt is that it is a very simple contract: Either you pay the agreed amount or you don’t.

zh: 光景好时，高杠杆单位 — — 公司或你的房子 — — 能带来不错的股本回报。
en: And when things go well, a highly leveraged enterprise – a company or your house – will show a great return on equity.

zh: 但这些回报未经风险调整，这意味着当经济衰退时，会出现巨大的损失 — — 2008年美国房主就领教了这一点。 韩国财团在1997年也领教过，而新兴市场政府更是反复领教这一点。
en: But those returns are not risk-adjusted, which means that when the economy slumps, big losses are allocated – as American homeowners learned in 2008, Korean conglomerates learned in 1997, and governments in emerging markets learn repeatedly.

zh: 决策者知道，过度负债当然会带来金融脆弱，而过去十年中也采取了一些旨在降低杠杆的改革尝试。
en: Policymakers know that excessive debt brings financial fragility, of course, and some efforts at reform over the past decade have aimed to scale back leverage.

zh: 但金融改革在衰退期间很难推行，这时的主要任务是重振增长。
en: But financial reform is hard to do during a slump, when the main task is to revive growth.

zh: 官方目标常常保持不变，而政治领导人往往发现保持现有规则、激励和担保体系不变更容易。
en: Official intentions often remain just that; time and again, political leaders find it easier simply to keep in place the existing system of rules, incentives, and guarantees.

zh: 而由于大金融企业动用大量杠杆而表现非常出现，它们也一直投入充足的游说资源抵制确保它们资本更加充足（增加股本相对资产负债表总规模的比例）的政策。
en: And, because large financial firms do very well with a great deal of leverage, they continue to devote abundant lobbying resources to resisting efforts to ensure that they are better capitalized (with more shareholder equity relative to their total balance sheets).

zh: 事实上，美国大银行 — — 大部分其他国家也是如此 — — 如今比2008年前 更大了。
en: Indeed, the largest banks in the US – but also in most other countries – are even bigger today than they were before 2008.

zh: 所有公开账户都表明它们的内部激励没有发生多少变化，而随着全球经济增长的恢复，对它们的行为的余数也不太可能有效。
en: All candid accounts indicate their internal incentives are not much changed, and restrictions on their activities are unlikely to prove effective as global growth picks up.

zh: 在美国，官员们希望大金融企业最终会被迫遵守2010年多德-弗兰克金融改革立法中订立可信的“生前遗嘱”的条款。
en: In the US, officials hold out hope that the largest financial firms will eventually be forced to comply with a provision of the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial reform legislation requiring that they draw up credible “living wills.”

zh: 但大部分大银行一直没有给出可靠的计划解释它们如何在不接受政府援助、不伤害世界经济的情况下倒闭，并且没有一���银行因为不遵守立法而面临实质后果。
en: Yet most big banks have repeatedly failed to produce plausible plans explaining how they could fail in bankruptcy without any government assistance and without damaging the world economy, and none has faced meaningful consequences for noncompliance.

zh: 增长会回来。
en: Growth will return.

zh: 企业家仍在创办新公司，它们将通过风险资本基金提供的股权投资为他们的冒险融资。
en: Entrepreneurs will start new companies, and they will fund their risk-taking with equity investments provided by venture capital funds.

zh: 老牌非金融企业已沉痛的教训领教了它们需要谨慎对待杠杆，保持大量现金缓冲。
en: Established nonfinancial firms have learned the hard way that they need to be careful with leverage and keep large cash cushions.

zh: 而大银行仍然偏好高杠杆。
en: It’s the big banks that continue to prefer being highly leveraged.

zh: 太多的决策者屈从于它们。
en: And too many policymakers are deferring to them.

zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，这意味着我们正在走向另一场翻江倒海的全球经济波动。
en: Like it or not, that means we are in line for another stomach-turning round on the global economy’s wild ride.

zh: 无国界银行家
en: Bankers without Borders

zh: 法兰克福 — — 在2008—2009金融危机顶峰时期，人们都以为西方银行要卷起海外股份回国了，金融市场要陷入各回各家之局了。
en: FRANKFURT – At the height of the financial crisis in 2008-2009, it seemed as if Western banks would pull up their foreign stakes and go home, leaving financial markets much more fragmented along national lines.

zh: 但是，德意志银行研究所的一份最新报告显示，银行跨国业务（不管是直接业务还是通过分行和子公司进行的业务）大体上已经企稳了。
en: But, as a new report by Deutsche Bank Research shows, banks’ cross-border business – direct or via branches or subsidiaries – has now broadly stabilized.

zh: 在危机中，传统私人部门贷款等资本密集型领域的银行活动积极度下降得最为厉害。
en: During the crisis, the level of banking activity fell particularly strongly in capital-intensive areas such as traditional lending to the private sector.

zh: 其中又以贷向非金融企业的贷款受创最重，而家庭贷款 — — 传统上这一领域国际化程度较低 — — 则依然活跃。
en: The effect was especially pronounced in lending to non-financial companies, whereas lending to households – an area with traditionally lower internationalization – remained more robust.

zh: 银行活动积极度的下降部分要归因于外国公债持有量相对私人债务的上升。
en: In part, the decline was due to increased holdings of foreign public debt relative to private debt.

zh: 危机前，银行通常是外国国债的净卖方，但在2008—2009年却在大举买入。
en: Prior to the crisis, banks had often been net sellers of foreign government bonds, but they significantly increased their purchases during 2008-2009.

zh: 2010年，随着欧洲主权债务危机开始发酵，银行对公债的兴趣再次减退。
en: With the onset of the European sovereign-debt crisis in 2010, banks’ appetite for public debt fell again.

zh: 与贷款活动形成对比的是，就纯中介业务（比如投资银行业务和资产管理业务）而言，各大银行的外国市场动作基本上没有受到任何影响。
en: In contrast to lending activities, banks’ commitment to foreign markets has remained virtually unaffected with respect to purely intermediary activities such as investment banking and asset management.

zh: 与投资银行业务一样，银行业的同业关系早已进入了高度国际化。
en: Interbank relationships, as well as investment-banking operations, are already highly international.

zh: 金融机构之间的深度跨国联系以及活跃投行在全球范围内的积极活动在金融危机中并未受到多大影响。
en: The deep cross-border links between financial institutions and the activity of globally active investment banks only took a brief hit from the crisis.

zh: 相比之下，外国市场对资产管理者的重要性依然相当有限，自2007年以来并无显著变化。
en: By contrast, the importance of foreign markets for asset managers remains very limited and has not changed significantly since 2007.

zh: 尽管最近遭遇了些许挫折，但如今银行在外国市场上的形象要比几年前更加高大。
en: Despite the recent setback, banks’ presence in foreign markets today is much greater overall than it was a few years ago.

zh: 原因之一是宏观经济增长通常总会带来收入增长，而当前新兴市场国家经济涨势正盛，与许多银行的西方母国形成了鲜明对比。
en: One reason is that revenue growth usually goes hand-in-hand with macroeconomic growth, which increasingly is found in emerging-market countries, rather than in many banks’ mature Western home markets.

zh: 此外，新兴市场的私人和公共部门债务也显著低于西方国家。
en: Moreover, private and public-sector debt levels tend to be much lower in the emerging economies.

zh: 与此同时，即使是在全球危机期间，布局多样化的机构也取得了卓越的表现，这是因为它们受单一地区衰退的影响很小。
en: At the same time, geographically diversified institutions outperformed even during the recent global crisis, because they were less vulnerable to downturns in individual regions.

zh: 规模经济和范围经济至少在进入到某一增长阶段之前都会存在，而向外扩张通常是唯一的扩大规模之路 — — 因为国内市场早已饱和了。
en: And, at least until a certain stage of growth, economies of scale and scope beckon, with expansion abroad often the only way to increase size, given already-saturated domestic markets.

zh: 当然，一体化的金融市场也会使银行客户受益，因为金融机构可以提供更全面、更优质、更廉价的金融服务。
en: Of course, integrated financial markets also benefit banks’ clients by enabling institutions to provide broader and higher-quality financial services at lower prices.

zh: 此外，牢固的国际金融伙伴关系对跨国公司来说是不可或缺的 — — 它们通常需要全球化的现金管理和大规模交易支持。
en: Furthermore, strong international financial partners are indispensable to multinational corporations, which often need global cash management or support for large-scale transactions.

zh: 这些优势的存在使得银行业快速地实现了国际化。
en: Given these advantages, the pace of internationalization has been swift.

zh: 2001年，欧洲最大20家银行的年营收额有一大半来自国内。
en: As recently as 2001, Europe’s top 20 banks still generated more than half of their revenues at home.

zh: 到了2010年，这一比重下降了10个百分点，变为42 % — —降幅令人瞩目，金融危机也只是略微干扰了一下这一趋势。
en: By 2010, this share had fallen by 10 percentage points, to 42% – a remarkable decline that was interrupted only briefly by the financial crisis.

zh: 有趣的是，大多数欧洲大银行的主要投资目标是其他欧洲市场，而不是世界其他地区，这使得欧洲市场对总营收额的贡献达到了近30 % ， 而十年前这一数字为20 % 。
en: Interestingly, most large European banks’ prime investment destination was other European markets, not other parts of the world, raising Europe’s contribution to total revenue to nearly 30%, from less than 20% a decade ago.

zh: 造成这一现象的原因有二。
en: There may be two explanations for this: for one thing, Asia’s share in European banks’ revenues has probably risen.

zh: 一方面，亚洲在欧洲银行营收额中所占的比重可能在上升，但被来自美国的收入的下降抵消了。
en: But this may have been offset by a decline in the proportion of earnings coming from the US.

zh: 这一现象反映了相对重要性的变化，但欧洲银行美国业务量的绝对值仍然是上升的，只是幅度必其他地区低。
en: And, while this reflects changes in relative importance, European banks’ business volumes might have increased in absolute terms even in the US, though at a slower pace than elsewhere.

zh: 总的来说，后危机时代国际银行业的前景已变得较为乐观。
en: Overall, the outlook for post-crisis international banking has turned positive.

zh: 但监管可能改变这一状况。
en: But regulation could change that.

zh: 在当前环境下，人们的关注点重新回到了对市场、机构和金融工具的监管上。 不同地区的监管规模、范围和新规则难免会有所不同。
en: In the current environment, with a renewed focus on regulating markets, institutions, and financial instruments, some international differences in scale, scope, and application of the new rules may be inevitable.

zh: 但是，如果没有广泛的一致方法，可能会出现各国监管各自为政的局面，跨国银行业务将因此变得效率更低、价格更高、也更难以驾驭。
en: But, without a broadly consistent approach, the authorities risk creating a legal patchwork that would make cross-border banking less efficient, more expensive, and more difficult to conduct.

zh: 除了限制银行对外投资之外，对外国银行的市场准入实行完全限制也不是不可能。
en: Apart from discouraging banks from investing abroad, outright restrictions on foreign banks’ market access cannot be ruled out, either.

zh: 过去十年来，欧洲内部银行业关系的发展十分迅速，之所以如此，很大程度上要归功于废除了针对外国服务供应商的正式和非正式壁垒。
en: The rapid growth in intra-European banking relations in the past decade was made possible to a large extent by the abolition of formal and informal barriers to foreign service providers.

zh: 从根本上说，这一环境暂时还安然无恙，但目前的趋势 — — 提高国际银行的资本要求 — — 反映出人们有意要求建立拥有自有资本和流动性池子的独立子公司，让人深感忧虑
en: Though this environment may not be fundamentally at risk, the current trend towards increasing capital requirements for international banks – reflected, for example, in calls for the establishment of independent subsidiaries with autonomous capital and liquidity pools – is clearly worrisome.

zh: 尽管如此，跨国银行业的前景还是令人欣喜的，因此西方国家在新兴市场的形象或许会得到进一步巩固，而当地银行也许也可能会考虑走出国门。
en: Nonetheless, given the relatively favorable outlook for cross-border banking, Western banks’ presence in emerging markets could strengthen further, while banks domiciled in these regions might start looking beyond national borders.

zh: 传统贷款和存款业务仍然是增长的一大源泉，而且在新的监管制度下，存贷款业务或许比投资银行和资产管理更具吸引力。
en: Traditional lending and deposit-taking still offers much growth potential – and may become more attractive relative to investment banking or asset management as a result of new regulation.

zh: 果真如此的话，银行业将变得与其他产业更为相似 — — 通过打造真正意义上的全球网络实现自己和客户的双赢。
en: In that case, banking will become more like other industries that have benefited themselves and their customers by evolving into truly global networks.

zh: 海地的新希望
en: New Hope for Haiti

zh: 纽约—我最近访问了海地帕尔马斯（Los Palmas）的农村社区，在那里，我有机会与受到霍乱疫情直接影响的家庭对话。 自2010年地震以来，霍乱一直困扰着海地。
en: NEW YORK – During a recent visit to the rural community of Los Palmas, Haiti, I had the opportunity to talk with families directly affected by the cholera epidemic that has been afflicting the country since the 2010 earthquake.

zh: 一位男性告诉我，霍乱不但夺走了他的妹妹，他的岳母也因为在医院周边晃荡了几个小时而染病身亡。
en: One man explained that not only had the disease killed his sister, but his mother-in-law had also perished as she undertook the hours-long walk to the nearest hospital.

zh: 他和他的妻子目前需要照顾五个沦为孤儿的侄辈和甥辈
en: He and his wife are now caring for five orphaned nieces and nephews.

zh: 在今天的海地，这样的故事绝非孤例。
en: In Haiti today, stories like this are not uncommon.

zh: 事实上，这个国家有数千人都经历了类似的惨剧。
en: Indeed, thousands of people across the country have endured similar trials and tragedies.

zh: 但仍能看到希望。
en: But there are also signs of hope.

zh: 更多的社区参与和卫生实践的改变让帕尔马斯和相邻的雅各布村（Jacob）的女性、男性和儿童远离霍乱 — — 极大地扭转了过去几年的形势 — — 也降低了他们罹患其他水媒疾病。
en: Increased community engagement and changes in hygiene practices have freed the women, men, and children of Los Palmas and the neighboring village of Jacob of cholera – a dramatic reversal from the last few years – and reduced their risk of contracting other water-borne diseases.

zh: 比如，我所拜访的一户人家骄傲地像我展示了一个新的滤水器。
en: One family I met, for example, proudly showed me a new water filter.

zh: 这一社区领导方针将是海地总理拉模特（Laurent Lamothe ）和我在我访问帕尔马斯期间所提出的“总体卫生运动”获得成功的关键。
en: This community-led approach will be critical to the success of the “total sanitation campaign,” which Haitian Prime Minister Laurent Lamothe and I launched in Los Palmas during my visit.

zh: 该项目鼓励家��投资持久、卫生的厕所、提供改良的平价卫生产品和服务，并确保学校和健康中心拥有足够的水和卫生基础设施，以此改善三百万生活于高危地区的人群在未来五年中的健康状况。
en: By encouraging household investment in durable, hygienic latrines, providing improved sanitation products and services at affordable prices, and ensuring that schools and health centers have adequate water and sanitation infrastructures, the initiative will improve health conditions for three million people in high-risk areas over the next five years.

zh: 在离开帕尔马斯村之前，我们为新的安全水源举行了奠基仪式。
en: Just before leaving the village, we laid the symbolic first stone of a new secure water source.

zh: 总体卫生运动是联合国为消灭海地霍乱疫情而进行的全面计划的最新一步。
en: The campaign is the latest step in a comprehensive United Nations-supported operation to eliminate cholera from Haiti.

zh: 联合国和海地政府最近成立了一个高规格委员会，旨在实施覆盖霍乱预防和治理的全方位战略，包括扩大对家庭和社区的支持。
en: The UN and the Haitian government recently created a high-level committee tasked with implementing a comprehensive strategy that covers all aspects of cholera prevention and response, including scaled-up assistance for families and communities.

zh: 此外，海地卫生部长和泛美卫生组织/世界卫生组织 正开始实施联合国资助的疫苗计划的第二阶段，该计划的目标受众是霍乱疫区的600,000人；其中200,000人将在未来几个月内接种疫苗，300,000人将在今年年底前接种疫苗。
en: Moreover, Haiti’s Ministry of Health and the Pan-American Health Organization/World Health Organization are beginning the second phase of a UN-financed vaccination initiative that is targeting 600,000 people in areas where cholera persists; 200,000 people are set to be vaccinated in the next couple of months, with another 300,000 to follow by the end of this year.

zh: 在去年的第一阶段中，有100,000人接种了疫苗。
en: During the first phase last year, 100,000 people were vaccinated.

zh: 这些努力已经极大地降低了霍乱感染率。
en: These efforts have already reduced the toll of the epidemic significantly.

zh: 今年前几个月中，霍乱发病数和死亡数较2013年同期下降了75 % ， 为疫情爆发以来最低水平。
en: During the first few months of this year, the number of cholera cases and deaths declined by some 75% compared to the same period of 2013, reaching the lowest level since the outbreak began.

zh: 诚然，海地的疑似霍乱病例数仍是西半球之最 — — 在知识和财富如此丰富的今天，这是不可接受的。
en: To be sure, Haiti still hosts the largest number of suspected cholera cases in the Western hemisphere – unacceptable in a world of such vast knowledge and wealth.

zh: 但海地正在走向成功。
en: But the country is on a trajectory toward success.

zh: 正如霍乱已在世界其他不同环境中被消灭，海地也可以消灭它。
en: Just as cholera has been eliminated from other difficult environments worldwide, it can be eliminated from Haiti.

zh: 海地在其他方面的前景也在改善，这部分要归功于联合国对海地的承诺。
en: Haiti’s prospects are improving in other areas as well, owing partly to the UN’s commitment to the country.

zh: 2004年以来，联合国海地稳定特派团（Stabilization Mission in Haiti，MINUSTAH）一直致力于改善安全环境、支持政治进程、强化政府机构和保护人权，并将继续在2010年地震灾后稳定和重建中起到重要作用。
en: Since 2004, the UN’s Stabilization Mission in Haiti (MINUSTAH) has been working to improve the security environment, support the political process, strengthen government institutions, and protect human rights. It also played a major role in stabilizing and rebuilding the country after the 2010 earthquake.

zh: 在MINUSTAH以及其他联合国机构的努力下，安全状况有了很大改观，这要归功于司法制度的强化和国民警察部队效率的提高。
en: As a result of MINUSTAH’s efforts – and those of other UN agencies – the security situation has improved considerably, underpinned by a stronger judiciary and a more effective national police force.

zh: 与此同时，小学入学率也有了显著增长，从1993年的47%提高到今天的90 % 。
en: Meanwhile, primary-school enrollments rates have soared, from 47% in 1993 to nearly 90% today.

zh: 考虑到持续不断的政治和社会分裂、疲软的经济和饱受掣肘的金融状况，海地能否继续取得进步充满着不确定。
en: Given enduring political and social fragility, a weak economy, and severely constrained finances, Haiti’s continued progress remains far from certain.

zh: 为了增加实现发展目标的机会，海地必须贯彻其去年举行早该举行的立法和地方选举的计划，并在明年举行总统选举。
en: In order to improve its chances of achieving its development goals, Haiti must follow through on its plans to hold long-overdue legislative and local elections later this year, followed by a presidential election next year.

zh: 海地领导人，不管其政治立场如何，都必须克服分歧，确保选举过程公平，从而促进法治精神、捍卫人权、巩固海地的民主基础。
en: Haitian leaders across the political spectrum must rise above their differences to ensure that the electoral process is conducted fairly, thereby advancing the rule of law, safeguarding human rights, and consolidating the country’s democratic foundations.

zh: 国际社会的继续支持也将至关重要。
en: The international community’s continued support also will remain essential.

zh: 最紧迫的是，海地需要为其22亿美元规模、为期十年的消灭霍乱全国计划（National Cholera Elimination Plan）寻找融资帮助。
en: Most urgent, Haiti needs help funding its $2.2 billion ten-year National Cholera Elimination Plan.

zh: 头两年在早期预警、快速响应、水、卫生和疫苗等方面的投资需要4.48亿美元，目前只动员到47 % ， 并且只有10%的总量有了着落。
en: So far, just 40% of the $448 million that will be needed in the first two years for investments in early warning, rapid response, water, sanitation, and vaccines has been mobilized, and only 10% of the total has been pledged.

zh: 海地人民拥有克服霍乱疫情、实现包容经济发展的热情和决心。
en: The Haitian people possess all of the compassion and determination needed to overcome the cholera epidemic and achieve inclusive economic development.

zh: 但国际社会 — — 特别是在该地区展开工作的国际金融机构 — — 必须站出来帮助他们。
en: But the international community – in particular, international financial institutions working in the region – must step up and support them.

zh: 我在帕尔马斯所感受到的好客和热情令我十分感动。
en: I was profoundly moved by the hospitality and compassion that I saw in Los Palmas.

zh: 但我也理解海地人民期待政府和联合国兑现许下的承诺。
en: But I also understand that Haitians expect their government and the UN to deliver on the promises made that day.

zh: 如果所有各方都做好自己的分内事，我们可以给海地人民带去他们应得的更健康、更繁荣的未来。
en: If everyone does their part, we can give Haitians the healthier, more prosperous future that they deserve.

zh: 看你的啦，IMF!
en: Banking on the IMF

zh: 发自芝加哥 — — 对于世界经济来说，最大的金融噩梦莫过于某家大型跨国银行的破产。
en: CHICAGO – The biggest financial nightmare looming over the world economy is the insolvency of a large international bank.

zh: 只要爆发主权违约，又或是由于过度自信的会计规则而积累了大量的亏损，一家大型跨国银行（尤其是欧洲银行）出现资不抵债的状况是完全有可能的。
en: Be it because of a sovereign default or because of large losses accumulated under complacent accounting rules, the insolvency of a large bank (particularly a European bank) is far from a remote possibility.

zh: 而即便这一可能性非常微小，但2008年的经济危机已经告诉我们：再微小的可能也不是没可能的。
en: Even if it were a remote possibility, the 2008 financial crisis has taught us that rare events occur.

zh: 而这一比2008年雷曼倒闭更糟的经济噩梦之所以成为可能，就是因为人们担心许多主权国家已经耗尽了所有的资源，因此无力再采取介入行动。
en: What makes this possibility the financial nightmare of choice, worse than the collapse of Lehman Brothers in 2008, is the fear that many sovereign states have already shot all their bullets and would thus be powerless to intervene.

zh: 我们看到南欧地区各主要银行的信用违约互换（Credit default swaps ，CDS）交易价格都比其所属国家的CDS价格还要稍低一点，意味着市场预期政府将无法对银行予以支撑。
en: Credit default swaps (CDS) of major southern European banks trade slightly lower than the CDS of their sovereign states, indicating that the market does not perceive the latter as able to support the former.

zh: 但不幸的是，在雷曼破产近两年后，在应对这些风险方面的措施依然很少。
en: Unfortunately, almost two years after Lehman’s collapse, little has been done to address this risk.

zh: 美国国会即将起草完成一项法案，计划新组建一个涵盖整个金融系统的委员会，并授权其处理和美国各大财政机构有关的解救方案。
en: The United States Congress is about to finalize a bill that will grant resolution authority over major US financial institutions to a newly formed systemic council.

zh: 然而触发这一介入行动的程序如此复杂，而救助资金来源又如此模糊不清，以致这项法案不但无法消除大型银行破产（即便是美国国内的金融机构）所产生的间接破坏效应，更遑论那些涉及各国合作，且各国分支机构的偿付能力都不尽相同的跨国银行了。
en: The procedures to trigger this intervention, however, are complex and the funding is sufficiently opaque that the bill will not eliminate collateral damage from a large bank failure even for US institutions, let alone for international ones, whose unwinding would require coordination by several states, with varying degree of solvency.

zh: 因此，为了尽量降低连锁崩溃所产生的风险，有必要去制定一个有权管辖所有大型国际金融机构的国际性救助机制。
en: To minimize the risk of an unruly collapse, it is necessary to approve an international resolution mechanism with authority over all major international financial institutions.

zh: 推行此举的目的不是要拯救银行及其债权人，而是要将一个失去控制的违约所造成的破坏降到最低。
en: The goal would not be to rescue banks and their creditors, but to minimize the disruption that an uncontrolled default might cause.

zh: 该机构应该是美国破产法第十一章的国际版本。
en: This institution should be an international version of the US Chapter 11 Bankruptcy Code.

zh: 但当第十一章立足于保存破产公司的现有价值之时，国际救助机制的目标则恰恰相反，是保存那些破产金融机构的相对方的现有价值。
en: But, while the goal of Chapter 11 is to save the ongoing value of a firm, the goal of the international resolution mechanism should be to preserve the ongoing value of the counterparties of insolvent financial institutions.

zh: 而要实施这一机制，首先要解决的问题就是应该授权给谁。
en: The first problem to resolve in approving this mechanism is who should have this authority.

zh: 答案很明显 — — 国际货币基金组织（IMF ） 。
en: The obvious answer is the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 作为一个二战后成立的组织，世界货币基金组织最初的作用是在一个固定汇率系统中资助各成员国之间的暂时不平衡，而自从1971年美元固定汇率系统终止之后，该组织也一直在找寻自身存在的意义。
en: Created after WWII to finance temporary imbalances of the members of a fixed-exchange rate system, the IMF has been in search of a cause since the demise of the dollar exchange-rate system in 1971.

zh: 更重要的是，在拯救过许多主权国家的过程中，世界货币基金组织在债务重组方面变得更加专业，同时也积攒了手段强硬，不偏不倚的好名声。
en: More importantly, through its numerous rescues of sovereign states, the IMF has acquired expertise in debt restructuring, while developing a reputation for toughness and impartiality, which would be very useful in these situations.

zh: 世界货币基金组织另一个独特的优势就是它是国际储备的唯一托管人。
en: The IMF also has the unique advantage of being the only depositary of international reserves.

zh: 在国际权威财政机构缺失的情况下，世界货币基金组织就是与其性质最相近的组织。
en: In the absence of an international fiscal authority, the IMF is the organization that comes closest to being one.

zh: 当一个大型金融机构陷入资不抵债的时候，世界货币基金组织应该接管该机构，保证履行其短期义务，并在该机构偿还了其他债权人（包括世界货币基金组织自身）之后才处理股东和长期债权人的问题。
en: When a large financial institution is insolvent, the IMF should take it over, guaranteeing its short-term obligations, but wiping out the shareholders and repaying the long-term creditors only after all the other creditors (including the IMF itself) are repaid.

zh: 有些人会惊呼这等同于国有化，但要说国有化的话，没有任何行为能比美国破产法第十一章更加彻底。
en: Some people would scream that this is tantamount to nationalization, but it is no more a nationalization that the US Chapter 11 bankruptcy process is.

zh: 而相对于一个国内解决方案来说，被一个国际组织接管至少有三个好处：首先，可以确保整个救援成本（如果亏损超出了权益加上长期债务的总量的话）由整个国际社会而不仅仅是机构所在国承担，因此在主权国家无能为力之时，介入行为将变得更加可靠。
en: Takeover by an international organization has three advantages over a domestic solution. First, it makes certain that the cost (if the losses exceed the combined value of equity and long-term debt) is shared by the international community and not only by the country where the institution is located, making the intervention credible even when the sovereign state is not.

zh: 其二，通过将决策权从金融机构所在国剥离出来，可以避免银行当事人游说本国议会所造成的潜在的扭曲效应。
en: Second, by removing decision-making power from the national government that hosts an insolvent institution, this solution minimizes the potential distortions created by the lobbying power of the incumbent bankers.

zh: 你相信希腊政府在接管一间希腊银行后能杜绝腐败吗？
en: Would you trust the Greek government to run a Greek bank in a non-corrupt way after a government takeover?

zh: 在这方面，世界货币基金组织就能做得更好。
en: The IMF would be better.

zh: 最后，有了世界货币基金组织的介入，即便是那些不怎么发达的国家都有机会借助国际智囊来解决问题。
en: Finally, thanks to IMF involvement, even less advanced countries would be able to take advantage of the best international expertise to address the problem.

zh: 如果一场发生在海地的重大原油泄漏事故正在威胁墨西哥湾，我们难道不希望有最尖端的科技（而不仅仅是海地当地的技术）来尝试阻止泄漏？
en: If a major oil spill in Haiti were threatening the Gulf of Mexico, wouldn’t we want the best technology (and not just the technology available in Haiti) to try to contain it?

zh: 为什么不能在金融市场上使用类似的手段呢？
en: Why should it be any different in financial markets?

zh: 最后要解决的问题则是介入行动的触发机制问题。
en: The last problem to be resolved is the trigger.

zh: 在美国拯救金融机构的案例中，这是一个非常有争议性的问题。
en: In the case of the US resolution authority, this has been a very controversial issue.

zh: 人们担心那些权势巨大的银行将滥用本国政府的救助，过早地要求政府介入。
en: The fear was that powerful banks would exploit national government help, asking for intervention too soon.

zh: 在国际语境下，有两重保护来避免这个问题。
en: Two safeguards can avoid this problem in the international context.

zh: 首先，银行家最害怕的就是损害股东和长期债权人利益的严格管制政策。
en: First, rigid rules that wipe out shareholders and penalize long-term creditors are a clear deterrent from bankers’ point of view.

zh: 第二，由于世界货币基金组织的介入将减少国内利益集团的影响力，因此这些集团都不欢迎过早的国际介入。
en: Second, because IMF intervention would reduce the influence of powerful domestic insiders, early intervention would be less attractive to them.

zh: 真正的触发点应该是当地政府本身，因为对于所有面临着大型银行崩溃的政府来说，在这些事件中拒绝国际救助无异于政治自杀。
en: The trigger should be the domestic government itself. Refusing international help in such instances would mean electoral suicide for any government that faces a major bank collapse.

zh: 其实政府介入在某些领域还是有用的：比如减少银行挤提所造成的灾难性影响。
en: There are few areas in which government intervention is known to create value: reducing the devastating effects of a bank run is one.

zh: 但只有一个在管治权威和偿付能力方面足够强大的政府才能做到这一点。
en: Only a government that is sufficiently powerful, in terms of legal authority and solvency, can do so.

zh: 不幸的是，世界上还几乎没有能满足这两点的国家。
en: Unfortunately, in the international arena these two conditions are almost never met.

zh: 因此授权世界货币基金组织去接管陷入困境的跨国银行可以满足这些条件 — — 并且令这场最糟糕的噩梦离我们而去。
en: Empowering the IMF to take over failed international banks would fill this gap – and chase away our worst nightmare.

zh: 赢得“太大而不能倒”之战
en: Winning the Too-Big-to-Fail Battle

zh: 美国剑桥—关于银行给金融体系造成的风险的新闻继续占据着财经头条。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Headlines about banks’ risks to the financial system continue to dominate the financial news.

zh: 美国银行在美联储金融压力测试中表现差劲，而监管者则在批评高盛和摩根大通的融资计划，导致两者调低了计划中的分红和股票回购。
en: Bank of America performed poorly on the US Federal Reserve’s financial stress tests, and regulators criticized Goldman Sachs’ and JPMorgan Chase’s financing plans, leading both to lower their planned dividends and share buybacks.

zh: 花旗银行大张旗鼓地建设期金融交易业务则激起了关于其风险控制是否得当的质疑。
en: And Citibank’s hefty buildup of its financial trading business raises doubts about whether it is controlling risk properly.

zh: 这些结果表明，某些大银行仍然存在风险。
en: These results suggest that some of the biggest banks remain at risk.

zh: 但银行家坚持危机后加强监管、建立更安全的金融体系的任务已经接近完成，其中一些人援引最新银行安全性研究支持这一观点。
en: And yet bankers are insisting that the post-crisis task of strengthening regulation and building a safer financial system has nearly been completed, with some citing recent studies of bank safety to support this argument.

zh: 那么，哪种说法才是正确的：银行仍然存在风险？
en: So which is it: Are banks still at risk?

zh: 还是危机后监管改革已经完成了使命？
en: Or has post-crisis regulatory reform done its job?

zh: 2008年金融危机凸显出当今金融体系的两大危险特征。
en: The 2008 financial crisis highlighted two dangerous features of today’s financial system.

zh: 首先，政府会出手援助大银行而不是让它们倒闭并伤害经济。
en: First, governments will bail out the largest banks rather than let them collapse and damage the economy.

zh: 其次也是更糟糕的是，太大而不能倒让大银行变得更加庞大，而债权人和交易对手方更愿意与拥有隐性政府担保的银行打交道。
en: Second, and worse, being too big to fail helps large banks grow even larger, as creditors and trading partners prefer to work with banks that have an implicit government guarantee.

zh: 太大而不能倒的银行享受着比中等规模银行更低的债务利率，因为贷款人相信这些银行的债券和交易合同能够获得偿付，哪怕银行本身倒闭。
en: Too-big-to-fail banks enjoy lower interest rates on debt than their mid-size counterparts, because lenders know that the bonds or trading contracts that such banks issue will be paid, even if the bank itself fails.

zh: 在2007—2008年金融危机之前、之中和刚刚结束阶段，这所带来的优势相当于美国大银行股本价值的三分之一强。
en: Before, during, and just after the 2007-2008 financial crisis, this provided an advantage equivalent to more than one-third of the largest US banks’ equity value.

zh: 经济学家、决策者和纳税人都不支持援助太大而不能倒的银行，他们对于与金融大亨做特殊交易深恶痛绝。
en: Bailouts of too-big-to-fail banks are unpopular among economists, policymakers, and taxpayers, who resent special deals for financial bigwigs.

zh: 金融危机后，公众愤怒让美国和其他地区的监管者的措施 — — 提高资本和其他安全性要求获得了广泛的支持。
en: Public anger gave regulators in the United States and elsewhere widespread support after the financial crisis to set higher capital and other safety requirements.

zh: 更多的监管改变也开始运作。
en: And more regulatory changes are in the works.

zh: 新的研究，包括国际货币基金组织（IMF）和美国政府问责局（US Government Accountability Office）的中药研究，确实表明，花旗集团、摩根大通和美国银行等太大而不能倒的银行所获得的支持较危机前水平有所下降。
en: New studies, including important ones from the International Monetary Fund and the US Government Accountability Office, do indeed show that the long-term boost afforded to too-big-to-fail banks like Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, and Bank of America is declining from its pre-crisis high.

zh: 这是好消息。
en: This is good news.

zh: 坏消息则是美国银行代表在财经媒体、想必还有他们所中意的国会议员面前援引这些研究，论证太大而不能倒现象已经得到了遏制，监管者是时候收手了。
en: The bad news is that US bank representatives cite these studies when claiming, in the financial media and presumably to their favorite members of Congress, that the too-big-to-fail phenomenon has been contained and that the time has come for regulators to back off.

zh: 这是一个危险的观点，原因不一而足。
en: This is a dangerous idea, for several reasons.

zh: 首先。 IMF的研究和类似研究表明，现在银行所发行的债券整个生命周期中获得援助的可能性确实更低了。
en: For starters, the IMF’s research and similar studies show that the likelihood of a bailout over the life of the bonds already issued by banks is indeed now lower.

zh: 但这些研究没有具体说明原因。
en: But the studies do not specify why.

zh: 援助风险的下降可能反映出人们认为现有监管已经到位并且完整。
en: Lower bailout risk could reflect the perception that the regulation already in place is appropriate and complete.

zh: 或者债券市场参与者预期新的监管手段，如压力测试，能够完成使命。
en: Or bond-market participants may expect that new regulations, like the stress tests, will finish the job.

zh: 研究可能告诉我们，投资者认为监管者已经插手，并且有足够的政治支持实施进一步安全措施。
en: The studies could be telling us that investors believe that regulators are on the case and have enough political support to implement further safeguards.

zh: 或者他们可能认为目前经济已足够强势，银行在几年后债券偿还之前不会有倒闭之虞。
en: Or they could think that the economy is currently strong enough that the banks will not fail before the bonds are paid off in a few years.

zh: 研究不应该让监管者停止思考的第二个原因是这些研究集中在长期债券。
en: The second reason why such studies should not deter regulators from continued intelligent action is that the research focuses on long-term debt.

zh: 但在眼下这并非正确的着眼点，因为监管者让长期债券在危机中承受冲击，而让银行利润最高 — — 波动性也远远更高 — — 的短期债务和交易操作有更大的足额偿付把握。
en: But that is not the right place to look nowadays, because regulators are positioning long-term debt to take the hit in a meltdown, while making banks’ extremely profitable – and far more volatile – short-term debt and trading operations more certain to be paid in full.

zh: 结果，交易员们选择太大而不能倒的银行而非中等规模机构作为短期交易的对手方，这导致大银行交易规模急剧膨胀，利润也水涨船高。
en: As a result, traders choose too-big-to-fail banks, rather than mid-size institutions, as counter-parties for their short-term trades, causing the large banks’ trading books – and, hence, their profits – to surge.

zh: 衡量短期债务增长并不容易。
en: Measuring the boost to short-term debt is not easy.

zh: 但数量很有可能非常大。
en: But it is most likely quite large.

zh: 最近，以花旗集团为首的大银行说服国会撤消了2010年多德-弗兰克华尔街改革和消费者保护法（Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act）的一项关键条款。 该条款要求银行将大量短期交易划归关系疏远的附属机构（不在“太大而不能倒”之列 ） 。
en: The major banks’ recent effort, led by Citigroup, to convince the US Congress to repeal a key provision of the 2010 Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act that would have pushed much of their short-term trading to distant affiliates (which are not too big to fail) reinforces this interpretation.

zh: 大银行的这一做法强化了这一解读。 银行知道，如果它们在受政府支持最大的公司集团中运营交易部门，将能够获得更多业务。
en: The banks know that they will receive more business if they run their trading desks from the part of their corporate group that has the strongest government backing.

zh: 担心银行家信心满满地表示监管工作已经完成的第三个原因是一旦他们持有这一观点，就会据此行动 — — 不再那么害怕倒闭，因此承担更多风险。
en: The third reason to be wary of bankers’ confidence that the regulatory job is complete is that once they believe it, they will behave accordingly – less frightened of failure and thus willing to take on more risk.

zh: 这似乎正是金融危机的覆辙，也没有商业或心理上的理由认为这不会再次发生。
en: That seems to have been the case before the financial crisis, and there is no business or psychological reason to think that it will not happen again.

zh: 监管者决不能屈从于银行游说，也不能被某些研究迷惑。 这些研究既没有衡量银行的太大而不能倒的地位给它们带来的短期提振作用，也没有衡量安全感的增加中有多少可以归因于已落实的监管措施和对增加良好监管的预期。
en: Regulators must not be deterred by bank lobbying or studies that measure neither the short-term boost afforded by a bank’s too-big-to-fail status nor how much of the perception of increased safety can be attributed to the regulations in place and the expectation of additional good regulation.

zh: 如果没有这些研究，监管者必须依靠自己的判断和知识。
en: In the absence of such studies, regulators must use their own judgment and intelligence.

zh: 如果“太大而不能倒”也意味着“太大而不能监管 ” ， 那么安全感的增加不会维持多久。
en: If “too big to fail” also means “too big to regulate,” the perception of increased safety will not last long.

zh: 拒绝的经济学家
en: Economists in Denial

zh: 伦敦—上个月初，英格兰银行首席经济学家安迪·霍尔丹（Andy Haldane）指责“不理性的行为”是英格兰银行最新预测模型失败的原因。
en: LONDON – Early last month, Andy Haldane, Chief Economist at the Bank of England, blamed “irrational behavior” for the failure of the BoE’s recent forecasting models.

zh: 没能预见到这一不理性导致决策者预测英国经济会因为去年6月的退欧公投而减速。
en: The failure to spot this irrationality had led policymakers to forecast that the British economy would slow in the wake of last June’s Brexit referendum.

zh: 相反，自退欧投票结束以来，英国消费者就掀起了一股热情的消费潮；同样诡异的是，兼职也、制造业和服务业也纷纷复苏。
en: Instead, British consumers have been on a heedless spending spree since the vote to leave the European Union; and, no less illogically, construction, manufacturing, and services have recovered.

zh: 霍尔丹没有对这一非理性行为的大爆发作出解释。
en: Haldane offers no explanation for this burst of irrational behavior.

zh: 他也没办法解释：对他来说，不理性无非意味着行为与英格兰银行的模型所推测的不一致。
en: Nor can he: to him, irrationality simply means behavior that is inconsistent with the forecasts derived from the BoE’s model.

zh: 不仅霍尔丹或英格兰银行是如此。
en: It’s not just Haldane or the BoE.

zh: 主流经学家在说不理性行为时，所说的不是你我所认为的。
en: What mainstream economists mean by rational behavior is not what you or I mean.

zh: 在大白话里，理性行为就是放在具体环境中显得合理的行为。
en: In ordinary language, rational behavior is that which is reasonable under the circumstances.

zh: 但在新古典预测模型的阳春白雪中，它的意思是，掌握了关于自身、周边环境以及所要面临的未来的详细知识的人，会采取实现他们的目标的最优行动。
en: But in the rarefied world of neoclassical forecasting models, it means that people, equipped with detailed knowledge of themselves, their surroundings, and the future they face, act optimally to achieve their goals.

zh: 也就是说，理性行动就是与经济学家的理性行为模型一致的行动。
en: That is, to act rationally is to act in a manner consistent with economists’ models of rational behavior.

zh: 如果碰到相反的行为，经济学家的反应就像是抱怨客户与他们新裁的衣服不合的裁缝。
en: Faced with contrary behavior, the economist reacts like the tailor who blames the customer for not fitting their newly tailored suit.

zh: 但是，有趣的事实是，基于相当不现实的前提和假设的预测在许多情形中有可能非常完美。
en: Yet the curious fact is that forecasts based on wildly unrealistic premises and assumptions may be perfectly serviceable in many situations.

zh: 原因在于大部分人是习惯生物。
en: The reason is that most people are creatures of habit.

zh: 由于他们的偏好和环境不会每天都发生变化，并且他们也确实会在买东西时尽量讨价还价，所以他们的行为会表现出相当高的规律性。
en: Because their preferences and circumstances don’t in fact shift from day to day, and because they do try to get the best bargain when they shop around, their behavior will exhibit a high degree of regularity.

zh: 这就使他们的行为有了可预测性。
en: This makes it predictable.

zh: 你不需要了解多少经济学就能知道，如果你所钟爱的牙膏品牌涨价了，你就很有可能转投更便宜的品牌。
en: You don’t need much economics to know that if the price of your preferred brand of toothpaste goes up, you are more likely to switch to a cheaper brand.

zh: 中央银行的预测模型本质上也使用相同的逻辑。
en: Central banks’ forecasting models essentially use the same logic.

zh: 比如，英格兰银行（正确地）预测英国退欧投票后英镑会下跌。
en: For example, the BoE (correctly) predicted a fall in the sterling exchange rate following the Brexit vote.

zh: 这将导致物价上涨 — — 从而放缓消费支出。
en: This would cause prices to rise – and therefore consumer spending to slow.

zh: 霍尔丹仍然认为会发生这样的事情；英格兰银行的错误更多的是“择时”错误，而非逻辑错误。
en: Haldane still believes this will happen; the BoE’s mistake was more a matter of “timing” than of logic.

zh: 这等于说英国退欧投票并未改变任何基本面。
en: This is equivalent to saying that the Brexit vote changed nothing fundamental.

zh: 人们将继续完全地按照模型的假设行动，只不过面对的价格集发生了变化。
en: People would go on behaving exactly as the model assumed, only with a different set of prices.

zh: 但一切基于经常性行为模式的预测，都会在发生了真正的新情况的时候失灵。
en: But any prediction based on recurring patterns of behavior will fail when something genuinely new happens.

zh: 非常规变化导致非常规行为。
en: Non-routine change causes behavior to become non-routine.

zh: 但非常规并不意味着不理性。
en: But non-routine does not mean irrational.

zh: 用经济学的行话讲，这意味着参数发生了变化。
en: It means, in economics-speak, that the parameters have shifted.

zh: 明天将和今天大同小异，这样的保证已经不复存在。
en: The assurance that tomorrow will be much like today has vanished.

zh: 我们的可量化风险模型在面对剧烈的不确定性时就会失灵。
en: Our models of quantifiable risk fail when faced with radical uncertainty.

zh: 英格兰银行承认，英国退欧会造成一段时期的不确定性，而这对商业不利。
en: The BoE conceded that Brexit would create a period of uncertainty, which would be bad for business.

zh: 但英国退欧所造成的新状况实际上与早已习惯于几乎只盯着伦敦金融城动向的决策者所预期的大不相同。
en: But the new situation created by Brexit was actually very different from what policymakers, their ears attuned almost entirely to the City of London, expected.

zh: 大部分“退欧派”选民的感觉并没有转坏 （ “ 理性地”看，理应转坏才对 ） ， 反而认为境况会有所好转。
en: Instead of feeling worse off (as “rationally” they should), most “Leave” voters believe they will be better off.

zh: 不管有没有原因，关于这一情绪的重要事实是它的存在。
en: Justified or not, the important fact about such sentiment is that it exists.

zh: 1940年法国投降德国后，经济学家凯恩斯立即写信给记者说 ： “ 就我个人而言，现在我第一次有十足的信心，我们将赢得战争。
en: In 1940, immediately after the fall of France to the Germans, the economist John Maynard Keynes wrote to a correspondent: “Speaking for myself I now feel completely confident for the first time that we will win the war.”

zh: ”类似地，许多英国人现在对未来充满了信心。
en: Likewise, many Brits are now more confident about the future.

zh: 那么，这就是英格兰银行的预测模型的问题 — — 霍尔丹看到了但不能承认。
en: This, then, is the problem – which Haldane glimpsed but could not admit – with the BoE’s forecasting models.

zh: 影响经济学家的重要事件发生在经济学模型的自洽范围之外。
en: The important things affecting economies take place outside the self-contained limits of economic models.

zh: 只要海面不是风平浪静，宏观经济学预测就会撞上礁石，就是这个道理。
en: That is why macroeconomic forecasts end up on the rocks when the sea is not completely flat.

zh: 挑战在于发展能够胜任风暴环境的宏观经济模型：它们要考虑极端不确定性，进而考虑人类行为的高度不可预测性。
en: The challenge is to develop macroeconomic models that can work in stormy conditions: models that incorporate radical uncertainty and therefore a high degree of unpredictability in human behavior.

zh: 凯恩斯经济学是关于不确定情况下的选择逻辑的经济学。
en: Keynes’s economics was about the logic of choice under uncertainty.

zh: 他希望扩展经济理性的思想，将面临极端不确定性时的行为纳入其中，即我们不但面临未知，还要面临不可知的未知的时候的行为。
en: He wanted to extend the idea of economic rationality to include behavior in the face of radical uncertainty, when we face not just unknowns, but unknowable unknowns.

zh: 与我们可以非常合理地预期未来与过去大同小异的世界相比，这显然会给政策带来更加严重的冲击。
en: This of course has much severer implications for policy than a world in which we can reasonably expect the future to be much like the past.

zh: 已经有了一些面对这一挑战的零星的尝试。
en: There have been a few scattered attempts to meet the challenge.

zh: 在2011年的书《超越机械市场 》 （ Beyond Mechanical Markets）中，纽约大学的罗曼·弗里德曼（Roman Frydman）和新罕布什尔大学的迈克尔·高德堡（Michael Goldberg）强有力地指出，经济学家的模型应该尝试“纳入心理学因素，不要假定市场参与者的行为是理性的。
en: In their 2011 book Beyond Mechanical Markets, the economists Roman Frydman of New York University and Michael Goldberg of the University of New Hampshire argued powerfully that economists’ models should try to “incorporate psychological factors without presuming that market participants behave irrationally.”

zh: ”他们提出了另一种经济建模方法，称之为“不完美知识经济学 ” ， 敦促他们的同事们不要做“犀利的预测 ” ， 认为决策者应该依靠基于历史基准的“指导范围”来抵消资产价格的“过度”波动。
en: Proposing an alternative approach to economic modeling that they call “imperfect knowledge economics,” they urge their colleagues to refrain from offering “sharp predictions” and argue that policymakers should rely on “guidance ranges,” based on historical benchmarks, to counter “excessive” swings in asset prices.

zh: 俄罗斯数学家弗拉基米尔·马斯奇（Vladimir Masch）设计了一个巧妙的“风险约束优化”机制，该机制明确允许存在一个“不确定性区 ” 。
en: The Russian mathematician Vladimir Masch has produced an ingenious scheme of “Risk-Constrained Optimization,” which makes explicit allowance for the existence of a “zone of uncertainty.”

zh: 经济学家应该做出“相当近似的猜测 ” ， 要求“只是略作建模和计算 ” 。
en: Economics should offer “very approximate guesstimates,” requiring “only modest amounts of modeling and computational effort.”

zh: 但这些将极端不确定性纳入经济学模型的努力尽管勇气可嘉，但面临一个不可能完成的任务：用数学（马斯奇的例子）和计算机科学来解决模糊性。
en: But such efforts to incorporate radical uncertainty into economic models, valiant though they are, suffer from the impossible dream of taming ambiguity with math and (in Masch’s case) with computer science.

zh: 霍尔丹似乎也信仰大数据集。
en: Haldane, too, seems to put his faith in larger data sets.

zh: 而凯恩斯完全不这么认为。
en: Keynes, for his part, didn’t think this way at all.

zh: 他想要的经济学给我们完全的判断余地，不但可以用数学和统计学来丰富它，也可以用伦理学、哲学、政治学和历史学来丰富它 — — 而这些学科已经从当代经济学训练计划中剔除，只剩下数学和计算的骨架。
en: He wanted an economics that would give full scope for judgment, enriched not only by mathematics and statistics, but also by ethics, philosophy, politics, and history – subjects dropped from contemporary economists’ training, leaving a mathematical and computational skeleton.

zh: 要对世界做出有意义的描述，凯恩斯常说，经济学家必须是通才。
en: To offer meaningful descriptions of the world, economists, he often said, must be well educated.

zh: 中央银行机密
en: Central Bank Confidential

zh: 伦敦—1993年，经济学家阿尔贝托·阿莱西纳（Alberto Alesina）和拉里·萨默斯（Larry Summers）发表了一篇开创性论文，论文指出，央行独立让通胀得以控制，并且对经济表现没有消极影响。
en: LONDON – In 1993, the economists Alberto Alesina and Larry Summers published a seminal paper that argued that central bank independence keeps inflation in check, with no adverse consequences for economic performance.

zh: 自此以后，全球各国纷纷让央行独立。
en: Since then, countries around the world have made their central banks independent.

zh: 没有一个国家反其道而行之，而只要有政府表现出重新用政治控制利率的意图，比如最近的印度，就会引起金融市场的警报和经济学家的愤怒。
en: None has reversed course, and any hint that governments might reassert political control over interest rates, as happened recently in India, are met with alarm in financial markets and outrage among economists.

zh: 但是，事实上，独立有许多种程度，并且并非所有名义独立的央行都以相同的方式运行。
en: In truth, however, there are many degrees of independence, and not all nominally independent central banks operate in the same way.

zh: 一些货币当局，比如欧洲央行，制定它们自己的目标。
en: Some monetary authorities, like the European Central Bank, set their own target.

zh: 另一些，比如英格兰银行，拥有完全的工具独立性 — — 控制短期利率，但需要满足政府制定的通胀目标。
en: Others, like the Bank of England (BoE), have full instrument independence – control over short-term interest rates – but must meet an inflation target set by the government.

zh: 在如何组织央行以实现这些目标方面也存在不同。
en: There are differences, too, in how central banks are organized to deliver their objectives.

zh: 在新西兰，央行行长是唯一的决策者。
en: In New Zealand, the bank’s governor is the sole decision-maker.

zh: 在美联储，决策由联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）做出，而FOMC成员 — — 由七位理事和五位美联储地区储备银行行长组成 — — 的独立程度各不相同。
en: At the US Federal Reserve, decisions are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), whose members – seven governors and five presidents of the Fed’s regional reserve banks – enjoy varying degrees of independence.

zh: 欧洲央行不发布投票记录，并且在总理事会（General Council）会议上寻求达成共识。
en: The ECB does not publish voting records and seeks consensus at the meetings of its General Council.

zh: 相反，英格兰银行货币政策委员会（MPC）有九名成员，其中四名在英格兰银行外部人士中任命，所有成员的投票都会必须个人做出，不得代表机构观点。
en: By contrast, the BoE’s Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) has nine members, four of whom are appointed from outside the bank, and all votes are individually recorded; nobody is allowed to hide behind an institutional view.

zh: 美联储不保留投票记录，但其主要决策的“持异见者”会被披露（在艾伦·格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）任美联储主席期间几乎没有持异见者，而在最近持异见者变得普遍起来 ） 。
en: The Fed does not keep a voting record, but “dissents” from its major decisions are noted (these were almost unheard of when Alan Greenspan was Chairman, but have since become more common).

zh: 决策者和他们的央行工作人员之间的关系也各不相同，这也影响着央行的独立性。
en: There are differences, too, in the relationship between policymakers and their staff, which also influences a central bank’s independence.

zh: 在美联储，工作人员向FOMC报告他们自己的经济预测，这些预测不采用制定利率的决策者的观点。
en: At the Fed, the staff present their own economic forecasts to the FOMC, without input from the policymakers who set the interest rate.

zh: 在英格兰银行，MPC负责官方预测，并发表在其《通胀报告 》 （ Inflation Reports）中。
en: At the BoE, the MPC is responsible for official forecasts, which it publishes in its Inflation Reports.

zh: 这有助于影响预期，因为央行观点不同可能让私人部门产生困惑；但风险是导致机构集体思维（groupthink ） 。
en: That is helpful in influencing expectations, because a range of different views from the central bank could confuse the private sector; but it carries the risk of institutional groupthink.

zh: 如果央行同时也是银行监督者，那么集体思维就特别危险，2008年全球金融危机证明了这一点。
en: Groupthink can be particularly dangerous if the central bank is also the banking supervisor, as the 2008 global financial crisis demonstrated.

zh: 2006年，所有央行发布金融稳定性报告的央行（也就是说，大部分央行）认为它们的国家银行体系结构合理：资本充沛，治理强健，风险管理强大。
en: In 2006, every central bank that published a financial stability report (in other words, most of them) concluded that their country’s banking system was in fine shape: well-capitalized and endowed with robust governance and strong risk management.

zh: 没有一位央行分析师对当时的信用和杠杆大幅增加的现象表示哪怕一丁点担忧，这看起来不可思议。
en: It seems unlikely that not a single central bank analyst was the least bit worried about the massive growth in credit and leverage at the time.

zh: 国际清算银行 — — 央行的组织 — — 的经济学家们非常尖锐地指出了风险。
en: Economists at the Bank for International Settlements – an organization of central banks – were laying out the risks very starkly.

zh: 然而，全世界央行经济学家小分队却没有发出任何异见。
en: And yet not a dissenting voice was heard from the world’s small army of central bank economists.

zh: 央行也许相对��家政府实现了独立，但其内部仍极难摆脱党派立场。
en: Central banks may have been independent vis-à-vis their countries’ governments, but internally it was very difficult to stray from the party line.

zh: 当然，在严格的机构纪律和“百花齐放”之间需要达到平衡。
en: There is, of course, a balance to be struck between tight institutional discipline and letting a hundred intellectual flowers bloom.

zh: 央行不是大学经济学系，多样化并不总是优势来源。
en: A central bank is not a university economics department, where diversity is almost invariably a source of strength.

zh: 外部观察者必然会通过一切公开发布的字里行间解读政策信息，而这也许不利于央行实现目标。
en: External observers are bound to try to read policy messages between the lines of any publication, which may not always help the bank to achieve its objectives.

zh: 尽管如此，显然仍有空间容下另类思维（heterodox thinking ） 。
en: That said, there is clearly room for allowing more heterodox thinking.

zh: 因此，英格兰银行正在试验一个让更广泛的观点发出声音的新平台，这值得鼓励。 这一平台是一个叫做“地下银行 ” （ Bank Underground）的博客（这个名字来自银行总部地下的地铁站 ） ， 供挑战 — — 或支持 — — 现行政策的初级员工发表观点。
en: So it is encouraging that the BoE is experimenting with a platform that enables a wider variety of views to be heard: a blog called Bank Underground (a reference to the Tube station beneath the Bank’s headquarters) that publishes posts by junior staff challenging – or supporting – prevailing policy.

zh: 不出几周，地下银行便已成为煽动性观点的温床。
en: In a matter of weeks, Bank Underground already has established itself as a fertile source of provocative ideas.

zh: 8月中旬（当时英格兰银行的大佬们显然不知道到哪里去了，老虎不在，猴子便称王）发布的一篇帖子指出了英格兰银行内部资本模型的一些缺点，而这些模型是巴塞尔3资本要求制度的核心。
en: One post in the middle of August (when the Bank’s top cats were certainly away, allowing free rein to the mice) pointed to some of the weaknesses in banks’ internal capital models, which are at the heart of the Basel 3 capital-requirements regime.

zh: 帖子的作者是一位名叫托比亚斯·纽曼（Tobias Neumann）的英格兰银行员工，他认为，在模型中使用过多数据可能导致噪声增加，弄错重要的信号。
en: The author, a BoE employee named Tobias Neumann, argued that incorporating more data into the models could lead them to pick up noise and mistake it for an important signal.

zh: 结果，他说，高度复杂的模型可能时常产生误导性信息。
en: As a result, he concluded, highly complex models may regularly yield misleading information.

zh: 7月份发布的另一篇帖子矛头直指英格兰银行的“官方”观点 — — 随着经济的复苏，我们可以预期非金融公司开始削减现金余额，出资投资。
en: Another post, published in July, explicitly challenged the BoE’s “official” view that as the economy recovers, we can expect non-financial companies to begin to run down their cash balances to fund investment.

zh: 该帖子的作者凯迪·法兰特（Katie Farrant）和玛格达·鲁特科夫斯卡（Magda Rutkowska）认为，公司行为可能因为金融危机而已经发生了改变，难以获得银行融资导致他们永久性增加想现金缓冲。
en: The authors, Katie Farrant and Magda Rutkowska, suggest that corporate behavior may have changed as a result of the financial crisis, as difficulties in accessing bank financing led them to increase their cash buffers permanently.

zh: 果真如此的话，这将对金融体系特别是银行形成重大影响。
en: If true, this has important implications for the financial system, and especially for banks.

zh: 建立时间不长的地下银行已经证明了它的价值。
en: In its short life, Bank Underground has already proved its worth.

zh: 英格兰银行行长马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）让我们得以通过地下银行一窥针线大街老妪（Old Lady of Threadneedle Street ） ， 应该受到赞扬（当然，假设该博客并非完全是未经许可的自说自话！ ） 。
en: The BoE’s governor, Mark Carney, deserves great credit for allowing us to peer through a small crack in the Old Lady of Threadneedle Street’s façade (assuming, of course, that the blog is not a wholly unlicensed initiative!).

zh: 也许我们最终会看到与之对立的地铁美联储（Fed Subway）博客，尽管我对于很快出现地铁欧洲央行（ECB U-Bahn）并不乐观。
en: Perhaps we will eventually see the emergence of a rival Fed Subway blog, though I am not optimistic about the prospects for an ECB U-Bahn blog anytime soon.

zh: 与此同时，我打算在地下花更多的时间。
en: In the meantime, I plan to spend more time underground.

zh: 看起来那里的光线更好。
en: The light seems to be better there.

zh: 英格兰银行要盯住增长的原因
en: Why the Bank of England Should Target Growth

zh: 发自牛津 — — 英格兰银行在本月将利率提高至0.75 ％ ， 因为它确信通胀会在大概两年时间超过其受委任订立的2％目标。
en: OXFORD – The Bank of England raised interest rates to 0.75% this month, in the belief that inflation will exceed its mandated 2% target in about two years.

zh: 但提高利率往往会抑制经济活动，而英国的经济增长向来都无甚起色。
en: But raising interest rates tends to dampen economic activity, and growth is hardly rampaging in the United Kingdom.

zh: 那么英国央行是否应当考虑改变其委任内容，从而将经济增长包括在内？
en: Should the BoE consider a change to its mandate to include economic growth?

zh: 在美国，美联储有双重任务：稳定价格以及最大化就业。
en: In the United States, the Federal Reserve has a dual mandate: price stability and maximum employment.

zh: 没错美联储今年也加了息；但美国经济正在以超过4％的速度增长，预计今年的GDP增长会在3％左右。
