en: Of course, the Fed has also raised interest rates this year; but the US economy is growing at over 4% and GDP is expected to be around 3% higher this year.

zh: 相比之下，今年第一季度英国经济仅增长0.2 ％ 。
en: By contrast, the UK economy grew just 0.2% in the first quarter of this year.

zh: 虽然英国央行预计经济增长将在今年反弹并最终达到1.5％左右，但它将这一速度描述为“最高限速 ” 。
en: While the BoE expects growth to rebound and end up at around 1.5% for the year, it describes this rate as the “speed limit.”

zh: 更快的增长将加剧通胀压力。
en: Faster growth would fuel inflationary pressures.

zh: 而英国失业率为4.2 ％ — —与英国央行眼中的充分就业水平一致 — — 因此招聘人手就意味着要支付更高的工资。
en: With UK unemployment at 4.2% – a level consistent with full employment in the BoE’s view – hiring workers will mean higher wages.

zh: 同时由于价格增幅本身是工资加上一个加成的函数，可见通胀率也会上升。
en: And, because price increases are a function of wages plus a mark-up, inflation will rise.

zh: 而英国央行在经济增长缓慢之下依然加息的决定则反映出其对实现2％通胀目标的担忧。
en: The BoE’s decision to raise interest rates despite slow economic growth reflected its concern for its 2% inflation target.

zh: 鉴于英国经济在1980~2007年间平均增长率达2.5 ％ ， 英国央行当前预计的1.5％潜在增长率已经是极大退步了。
en: Given that the British economy grew at an average of 2.5% between 1980 and 2007, the BoE’s projection of 1.5% potential growth amounts to a significant downgrade.

zh: 而罪魁祸首则是生产力增长疲软。
en: The culprit is poor productivity growth.

zh: 从1998年到2008年全球金融危机爆发之前，英国年均生产率增长率平均有2.25 ％ ， 而英国央行现在认为该比率大概在1~1.25％之间。
en: From 1998 until the 2008 global financial crisis, annual productivity growth averaged 2.25%. The BoE now believes the rate to be closer to 1-1.25%.

zh: 基于一些尚未明确的原因 — — 不利的人口趋势，较低的投资需求或是任何其他可能的解释，发达经济体都出现了生产率放缓的情况。
en: This productivity slowdown has occurred across advanced economies, for reasons – adverse demographic trends, lower investment demand, or any of a slew of other possible explanations – that remain unclear.

zh: 但英国的受灾状况尤为严重。 而更低的经济增长则会引发对更低利率的预期。
en: But Britain is the worst affected. And slower economic growth leads to an expectation of lower interest rates.

zh: 根据其增长预测，英国央行首次对“新常态”利率的水平进行了估算。
en: For the first time, the BoE has produced an estimate of what the “new normal” interest rate is likely to be, in line with its growth forecasts.

zh: 英国央行现在希望利率能维持在2~3％的水平，而不是银行业危机前那几十年的平均5 ％ ， 这意味着实际（排除通胀因素的）利率将低于1 ％ 。
en: Rather than the 5% average rate that prevailed in the decades before the banking crisis, the BoE now expects interest rates to be 2-3%, implying a real (inflation-adjusted) interest rate of below 1%.

zh: 这与其他正经历生产率放缓的发达经济体所估算的利率基本一致。
en: That is not out of line with estimates of where interest rates might be for other advanced economies experiencing a productivity slowdown.

zh: 但由于英国央行认为经济已经充分发挥其潜力，所以尽管GDP增长缓慢且估计从现在到2021年（其预测期的最后一年）间仅能实现1.7~1.8％的年均增长率，它仍毅然选择加息。
en: But, because the BoE believes the economy is already growing at its full potential, it has raised interest rates now, even though GDP growth is slow and is estimated to only reach 1.7-1.8% between now and 2021, the end of its forecast period.

zh: 这就是英国央行的最新举措为何看起来相当古怪的原因。
en: This is why the BoE’s latest move looks curious.

zh: 难道他们不知道更高利率对借贷，支出及家庭/企业投资的影响会导致增长更为缓慢吗？
en: Won’t the effects of higher rates on borrowing, spending, and investment by households and firms lead to even slower growth?

zh: 当然，货币政策影响的是商业周期而不是经济的长期前景，因为后者取决于技术创新和劳动力技能等其他因素。
en: Of course, monetary policy affects the business cycle, not the economy’s long-term prospects, which depend on, among other things, technological innovation and the skills of the workforce.

zh: 因此英国央行的行动不会改变英国经济的潜在增长率。
en: So the BoE’s actions will not change the British economy’s potential growth rate.

zh: 然而在经济已经增长乏力的情况下，订立一个委任增长任务是否会让英国央行在加息前耐心等待更长一段时间？
en: But would a growth mandate give the BoE greater pause before raising rates when growth is anemic?

zh: 试想如果英国央行接受了一个尽可能加快经济增长并达到2％通胀目标的委任任务。
en: Consider a scenario in which the BoE were given a mandate to maximize economic growth and meet a 2% inflation target.

zh: 如果政策制定者预计通胀率将达到2％但经济增长率将在两年内低于2 ％ ， 那么他们就要拿捏提升利率及其对经济的抑制作用。
en: If policymakers expected inflation to reach 2%, but economic growth to be less than 2%, in two years, then they would need to balance how much economic dampening a rate rise would bring about.

zh: 换句话说，他们的通胀目标可能会得到满足，但如果经济增长不温不火，那么两个目标之间的权衡可能会让英国央行在相当长的一段时间内按兵不动 — — 正如虽然货币政策并不会真正影响长期增长，但美联储依然关注着就业那样。
en: In other words, their inflation target may be met, but if growth is tepid, confronting a trade-off between the two targets might stay the BoE’s hand for a while longer – just as the Fed keeps an eye on employment, even though monetary policy doesn’t really affect long-run growth.

zh: 使这一点变得棘手之处在于很难去预测经济的潜在增长率，因为这一比率是会变化的。
en: What makes this tricky is that it is hard to estimate an economy’s potential growth rate, which can change.

zh: 如果生产率增长回升，那么2.5％的GDP增长可能再次成为“最高限速 ” 。
en: If productivity growth picked up, then 2.5% GDP growth could again be the “speed limit.”

zh: 因此一个领受了增长任务的央行就会更加小心翼翼，以免其行动抑制了那些可能会使国家产出有所提升的活动。
en: So, a central bank with a growth mandate may tread a bit more carefully in case its actions dampened activity that could increase national output to its new potential rate.

zh: 而英国央行应当考虑涵盖经济增长在内的委任任务的另一个原因则是通胀与其他经济指标之间的关系正在减弱。
en: Another reason for the BoE to consider a mandate that includes economic growth is the weakening relationship between inflation and the rest of the economy.

zh: 换句话说物价增长已经不像过去那样与失业或产出密切相关了。
en: In other words, unlike in the past, price growth is not that closely related to unemployment or output.

zh: 例如在2008年危机爆发后那段时间通货膨胀率居高不下，这表明英国经济出现了虚假繁荣；当时的失业率也相当高。
en: For example, inflation was high in the immediate aftermath of the 2008 crisis, suggesting that the UK economy was booming when it wasn’t; unemployment was fairly high then as well.

zh: 物价也有所上涨，这是因为英镑疲软，进口成本上升，加上全球油价居高不下。
en: Prices were rising because the pound was weak, boosting the cost of imports, and global oil prices were high.

zh: 在此期间，英国央行经常无法兑现其通胀目标，导致外界批评其无能。
en: During this period, the BoE often missed its inflation target, fueling criticism that the target was ineffectual.

zh: 然而不提高利率的原因也显而易见：经济正在应对大衰退的余震。
en: The reason not to raise rates, however, was evident: the economy was coping with the aftermath of the Great Recession.

zh: 如果能将经济增长作为其委任任务的明确组成部分，在这种情况下英国央行就可以更好地为自己辩解 — — 并更好地维护其稳定物价承诺的可信度。
en: With economic growth as an explicit part of its mandate, the BoE could explain itself better in such circumstances – and better maintain the credibility of its commitment to price stability.

zh: 当通胀还是商业周期的更可靠标志物之时，仅仅把目标定在物价稳定可能会有作用。
en: Targeting price stability alone may have worked when inflation was a more reliable proxy of the business cycle.

zh: 但如今这样已经行不通了，英国央行 — — 也许还有其他央行 — — 也应该考虑去改变自身委任内容，把增长目标囊括在内。
en: Now that it isn’t, the BoE – and perhaps other central banks – should consider a change in mandate to target growth as well.

zh: 日本银行的真相时刻
en: The Bank of Japan’s Moment of Truth

zh: 东京—日本经济已连续七个季度实现正增长，平均年增长率达到了1.9 % 。
en: TOKYO – The Japanese economy has enjoyed seven consecutive quarters of positive growth, with the average annual rate reaching 1.9%.

zh: 总需求超过潜在产出1 % ， 日本的“GDP缺口”现在已是正数。
en: With aggregate demand exceeding potential output by 1%, the country’s “GDP gap” is now positive.

zh: 失业率下降至2.7 % ， 为1993年以来的最低水平，岗位招募-申请比例达到了1.56，为1974年以来的最高水平，导致包括建筑、零售、快递等多个部门出现劳动力急剧短缺。
en: Unemployment is down to 2.7%, the lowest level since 1993, and the job-opening-to-application ratio is 1.56, its highest level since 1974, resulting in acute labor shortages in several sectors, including construction, retail, and package delivery.

zh: 今年1月，日经股票平均价格突破24,000日元，为1991年以来的最高水平。
en: And in January this year, the Nikkei Stock Average rose above ¥24,000 ($216), its highest level since 1991.

zh: 但是，尽管这些指标现实日本终于走出了二十多年的停滞、通缩和经济不安全状态，但标题通货膨胀率仍然只有0.6 % ， 远低于日本银行2%的目标。
en: But, while these indicators suggest that Japan is finally out of the woods of more than two decades of stagnation, deflation, and economic insecurity, the headline inflation rate, at just 0.6%, remains far below the Bank of Japan’s 2% target.

zh: 此外，引人注目的是，尽管日本银行将低通胀归因于能源价格下跌，但如今能源对通胀的贡献实为正数。
en: And, notably, while the BOJ had been attributing low inflation to falling energy prices, energy is now contributing positively to inflation.

zh: 若将新鲜食物剔除出物价指数，则通胀率将升至0.9 % ， 但若将能源剔除，通胀率将降至0.3 % 。
en: When fresh food is excluded from the price index, the rate rises to 0.9%, but falls to 0.3% when also excluding energy.

zh: 考虑到当前劳动力短缺的情况，为何日本没有出现健康的工资-通胀螺旋始终是一个谜。
en: Considering the current labor shortages, why Japan has not experienced a healthy wage-inflation spiral remains a mystery.

zh: 诚然，美国和欧洲也难觅通胀踪影。
en: To be sure, inflation is also missing in the United States and Europe.

zh: 但日本的情况尤其突出。
en: But the Japanese case is particularly striking.

zh: 多年来，日本实体经济一直依靠高达GDP的6%的财政赤字，以及由日本银行行长黑田东彦于2013年4月开始实施的巨量量化宽松（QE）的支撑。
en: Japan’s real economy has been supported for years by fiscal deficits as high as 6% of GDP, and by extraordinary quantitative easing (QE), which BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda introduced in April 2013.

zh: 此后，债务-GDP比率升至230 % ， 日本银行持有了超过40%的未到期政府债券（JGB ） 。
en: The debt-to-GDP ratio has since risen to 230%, and the BOJ has assumed ownership of more than 40% of outstanding government bonds (JGBs).

zh: 日本银行通过每年购入80万亿日元JGB和6万亿日元股票来保持负政策利率和0%的十年期债券收益率。
en: The BOJ has maintained its negative policy rate and 0% ten-year-bond rate by purchasing annually ¥80 trillion in JGBs and ¥6 trillion in equities.

zh: 但最近，日本银行将十年期债券收益率保持在0.0—0.1 % ， 同时将新购JGB规模降至50万亿日元左右，有人将此视为秘密减磅（stealth tapering）
en: But, more recently, it has kept the ten-year-bond rate at 0.0-0.1%, while reducing the pace of new purchases of JGBs to around ¥50 trillion, in what some regard as a stealth tapering.

zh: 黑田东彦的任期将在4月份结束，两方面的批评日嚣尘上。
en: With Kuroda’s term ending in early April, two camps of critics have become increasingly vocal.

zh: 第一个方面的批评者认为实体经济才要紧，希望日本银行停止提供刺激并开始考虑资产负债表膨胀的问题。
en: The first camp, arguing that the real economy is what matters, wants the BOJ to stop providing stimulus and start worrying about its bloated balance sheet.

zh: 随着通货膨胀率向目标日一靠近，日本银行将不得不在不调整资产负债表规模的情况下开始提高政策和长期利率 — — 美联储已经开始这么做了。
en: When the inflation rate moves closer to the target, the BOJ will have to start raising its policy and long-term rates without adjusting the size of its balance sheet – which is exactly what the US Federal Reserve is already doing.

zh: 在资产端长期债券平均息票率低迷的情况下，收益率曲线的上升将至少会暂时导致日本银行的损失 （ “ 负铸币税 ” ） 。
en: Given the low average coupon rate of asset-side long-term bonds, the upward shift of the yield curve will result in a loss for the BOJ (“negative seigniorage”), at least temporarily.

zh: 在最坏的情形中，日本银行可能耗尽资本，要求财政注入，这可能危及其独立性。
en: In the worst-case scenario, the BOJ could exhaust its capital and require a fiscal injection, which could jeopardize its independence.

zh: 因此，第一方面阵营认为通胀目标可以下调至1 % 。
en: Accordingly, the first camp believes the inflation target should be lowered to 1%.

zh: 如此，通胀将符合目标，日本银行可以缩小QE的规模。
en: Inflation would then be on target, and the BOJ could wind down its QE program.

zh: 这一方针的主要缺点是它会导致日元急剧升值，对实体经济产生冲击。
en: The major drawback of this approach is that it would cause the yen to appreciate sharply, striking a blow to the real economy.

zh: 第二方面阵营认为需要采取更多刺激，2014年4月提高消费税（VAT）和秘密减磅一样都是巨大的错误。
en: The second camp believes that more stimulus is needed, and that increasing the consumption-tax (VAT) rate in April 2014 was a huge mistake, as is stealth tapering.

zh: 相反，QEHE和扩张性财政政策应该继续保持“火力全开 ” ， 直到2%的通胀目标实现。
en: Instead, QE and expansionary fiscal policies should remain at full throttle until the 2% inflation target is reached.

zh: 这意味着通过发行更多JGB来增加政府支出，由日本银行负责购买 — — 这又称为“直升飞机撒钱 ” 。
en: That means more government expenditure through more JGB issues, to be purchased by the BOJ – also known as “helicopter money.”

zh: 问题在于刻意提高财政赤字会增加未来财政危机的风险，而无助于实体经济。
en: The problem is that intentionally blowing up the budget deficit will increase the risk of a fiscal crisis down the road, without helping the real economy.

zh: 1月22—23日日本银行举行新一期政策制定会议时，维持了它已经实施了一年多的方针。
en: When the BOJ held its latest policy-setting meeting on January 22-23, it maintained the approach it has followed for more than a year.

zh: 黑田东彦和他的副手们也许希望实体经济的强劲表现能够很快转化为更高的通胀。
en: Kuroda and his deputy governors are probably hoping that the real economy’s strong performance will translate into higher inflation soon.

zh: 会吗？
en: But will it?

zh: 一般而言，提高通胀的三个关键是工资增长（源自劳动力的稀缺 ） 、 公众未来通胀预期升高，以及有利的外部环境。
en: Generally, three keys to higher inflation are wage increases, resulting from labor scarcity; expectations of higher future inflation among the public; and a favorable external environment.

zh: 在工资问题上，日本首相安倍晋三政府一直在施压大公司提薪3%或更多。
en: With respect to wages, Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s government has been pressuring major corporations to raise wages by 3% or more.

zh: 这应该是可以达到的，因为很多公司都取得了创纪录的利润。
en: That should be manageable, considering that many corporations are enjoying record profits.

zh: 但日本的工会一直很弱，工人也因为15年的通缩而噤若寒蝉。
en: And yet unions in Japan remain timid, and workers remain traumatized from 15 years of deflation.

zh: 结果，许多人宁要工作保障，不要加薪。
en: As a result, many choose job security over pay hikes.

zh: 他们担心，要求更高的工资等于给了公司借口将业务转移到海外或采用劳动力取代性技术。
en: Demanding higher wages, they fear, would give companies an excuse to move operations abroad or adopt labor-replacing technologies.

zh: 至于第二个要素，日本银行坦承，它在2013年4月引入QE计划时低估了影响预期的难度。
en: As for the second ingredient, the BOJ has admitted that it underestimated the difficulty of influencing inflation expectations when it introduced its QE program in April 2013.

zh: 在日本，不管用什么方法衡量，预期通胀率总是跟随实际通胀率，尽管会有一些滞后。
en: In Japan, the expected inflation rate, however it is measured, tends to track the actual inflation rate, albeit with some lag.

zh: 这有助于解释为何简单地宣布2%的通胀目标无法向美国那样锚定公众预期。
en: This helps to explain why simply announcing a 2% target has not anchored the public’s expectations, as it has in the US.

zh: 与此同时，外部环境倒是有利。
en: At the same time, the external environment is promising.

zh: 几乎所有其他发达经济体都在经历稳定同步的增长。
en: Almost every other advanced economy is experiencing steady, synchronized growth.

zh: 新兴经济体，尤其是中国，也重现强势。
en: And emerging economies, especially China, have also regained strength.

zh: 至少在全球经济层面，形势十分有利于日本、美国和欧元区实现2%的目标通胀率。
en: At the level of the global economy at least, the stars seem to be aligned for inflation to reach the 2% target rate in Japan, the US, and the eurozone.

zh: 日本的菲利普斯曲线趋近于L型。
en: In Japan, the Phillips curve tends to be L-shaped.

zh: 目前，经济十分接近于“L”的转弯处，即被称为不会加快通胀的失业率（NAIRU）的那一点。
en: Right now, the economy is very close to the kink in the “L,” the point known as the non-accelerating inflation rate of unemployment (NAIRU).

zh: 任何垂直移动的迹象（表明在NAIRU水平的失业率上通胀出现上升 ） ， 而不是水平移动迹象（失业率下降而不出现CPI通胀 ） ， 对于日本银行来说都是好事，对总体经济亦然。
en: Any sign of a vertical move (implying higher inflation with an unemployment rate at NAIRU), rather than a horizontal one (a lower unemployment rate without CPI inflation), will be welcomed by the BOJ, and good for the economy at large.

zh: 破产逼近中国
en: Bankruptcy Comes to China

zh: 发自北京 — — 中国的商人们从来都不缺乏卷土重来的能力，但如今他们必须开始习惯去面对破产的阴云了。
en: BEIJING – China’s businessmen have always needed resilience, but now they must become accustomed to the specter of bankruptcy.

zh: 因为中国已经拥有了一套行之有效的破产法，而法院正积极推进这一法律的实施。
en: For China now has a bankruptcy code with teeth, and the country’s courts are beginning to enforce it with rigor.

zh: 中国对破产的立法始于邓小平在30年前启动市场化改革之后。
en: Bankruptcy legislation in China started right after Deng Xiaoping launched his pro-market reforms three decades ago.

zh: 而这部法律的第一个版本则是在1986年颁布实施的《企业破产法（试行 ） 》 。
en: The Law on Enterprise Bankruptcy (Trial Implementation), the first of its kind, was enacted in 1986.

zh: 但这部法律的执行却受制于种种原因，包括其过度狭窄的应用范围，指导企业重组的相关法律的缺失，政府的过度干预，与当时的政策性破产程序的冲突，技术上的失误，以及宏观上无法使法律具有可操作性。
en: Its execution, however, was crippled by its very narrow scope for application, the absence of corresponding laws governing corporate restructuring, excessive government intervention, incompatibility with the policy-based bankruptcy procedure then in place, technical errors, and a general inability to make the code operational.

zh: 直到2006年这部法律的修订版面世，这在中国致力于建立一个有效的法律体系，从而向市场经济迈进的过程中具有历程碑的意义。
en: So, in 2006, a revised version of the law was enacted, marking an important milestone in China’s efforts to build an effective legal system as it moves towards a market economy.

zh: 与最初版本的破产法相比较，2006年的法律是牢牢扎根于市场经济的。
en: Compared with the original bankruptcy code, the 2006 code is firmly rooted in the needs of a market economy.

zh: 首先，当债务人在财务上丧失债务偿付能力时，该法旨在确保相关的责任得到公平及平均地承担。
en: First, it aims to ensure that obligations are fairly and regularly met when a debtor becomes financially insolvent.

zh: 可见，它致力于保护债权人和债务人和双方的合法权利。
en: Thus, it seeks to protect the lawful rights of both creditors and debtors.

zh: 同时，该法也为废除“政策性破产 ” — —这是国务院为清盘亏损的国有企业和安置下岗工人而采取的一种做法 — — 设定了最后期限。
en: The legislation also imposed a deadline to abolish “policy-based bankruptcy” – the practice adopted by the State Council to liquidate loss-making state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and resettle laid-off employees.

zh: 与《企业破产法》不同，这一行政程序拥有不一样的清盘优先次序：破产的国有企业拖欠工人的部分以及再安置的费用必须在其总资产中首先和最大限度得到安排，这其中还包括企业担保的部分，这样做是为了减少其对地方政府预算的依赖。
en: Unlike the Bankruptcy Law, the administrative procedure has a different hierarchy of liquidation priorities: what a bankrupt SOE owes to its employees and the resettlement charges must be covered first and foremost by its total assets, including the enterprise’s collateral, in order to reduce dependence on local governmental budgets.

zh: 然而，这一程序对债权人的权利毫无保障，从而受到了广泛批评。
en: Yet this process leaves the rights of creditors undefended, eliciting widespread criticism.

zh: 新《企业破产法》重新界定了其适用范围，从而消除了其与其他诸如《社会保障法》和《劳动法》相重叠的部分。 事实上，国企职工下岗的再安置，以及下岗带来的其他影响现在都主要由政府通过社会保障体系来处理，而不是作为破产程序的一部分来处理。
en: The new Enterprise Bankruptcy Law redefines its scope of application to preclude overlap with other laws like the Social Security Law and the Labor Law.  Indeed, resettlement of laid-off SOE employees, and other social implications of layoffs, should now be addressed primarily by government through the social safety net, rather than as part of the bankruptcy process.

zh: 新的法律还引入了“管理接管”的概念，藉此，律师，注册会计师，和其他中介机构可以出任破产企业的管理人员。
en: The new code also introduces the concept of “administrative receivership,” whereby lawyers, certified accountants, and other intermediaries act as managers of enterprises undergoing bankruptcy.

zh: 这一程序废除了清盘小组这一历史悠久的组织，该组织以其无理，粗暴的行政干预，业余以及不可靠著称。
en: The procedure abolishes the Liquidation Team, a long-standing regime that many alleged was unjust, aggressive in administrative intervention, unprofessional, and unaccountable.

zh: 为了促进这一部分法律的实施，最高人民法院对谁能成为一间公司的破产案产业管理人，接管的程度以及他们可以获得的补偿发布了司法解释。
en: In order for this part of the law to go ahead, the Supreme People’s Court issued judicial interpretations that set out who can be designated a company receiver and the amount and type of compensation they can be paid.

zh: 直到目前为止，有2520间机构和388位个人拥有成为破产案产业管理人的资格。
en: Up to now, some 2,520 agencies and 388 individuals have been included on the list of receivers.

zh: 然而，问题仍然存在。
en: Yet problems remain.

zh: 例如，在有限资产公司的案例中，破产受益人只获得了很不合理的少量补偿。 而且，随意地，不加选择地任命破产案产业管理人造成了有时组织臃肿，有时又人手不足的困境。
en: For example, receivers are paid unreasonably poorly in cases of limited assets; furthermore, the random, indiscriminate appointment of receivers sometimes leaves cases over- or understaffed.

zh: 结果是，尽管他们都承担了严格的责任，但相对其报酬来讲，破产案产业管理人工作的风险是很高的。
en: Consequently, the job of receiver, though it carries strict liabilities, is highly risky in terms of reward.

zh: 如果找不到可行的解决办法，没有机构或个人会愿意在一般的破产案中担任破产案产业管理人的角色。
en: If no viable solution is found, no agency or individual will be willing to serve as the receiver in ordinary bankruptcy cases.

zh: 新版破产法的另一个重要创新是根据其他国家的经验引入了重组的程序。
en: Another important innovation is the adoption of restructuring procedures based on other countries’ experiences.

zh: 重组的可能使得各方的利益都得到了平衡，并且在存在或可能存在紧急援助的情况下，能够运用法律保护来帮助具有潜在风险的企业防止或避免破产。
en: The possibility of restructuring balances the interests of stakeholders and uses legal protections to help potentially risky enterprises prevent or avoid bankruptcy if a bailout is worthwhile or possible.

zh: 不过，法院需要建立更严格、更合理的标准以审批重组计划。
en: But stricter and more reasonable standards should be established for courts’ approval of restructuring plans.

zh: 例如，如果法定多数的股东采纳了这样一个重组计划，那么法院即应该保护反对这一计划的少数债权人的权利。
en: For example, if the required majority of shareholders adopts such a plan, the court should protect the rights of the minority of creditors who may have opposed it.

zh: 而如果债权人一般要求的清盘赔偿率被界定为不低于重组计划初稿提交审批时的赔偿率的话，那么在支付延迟的情况下，就要考虑给予赔偿金了。
en: And if the liquidation rate for creditors’ common claims is defined as no lower than that at the time the draft restructuring plan was submitted for approval, compensation must be considered in the event that payment is delayed.

zh: 进一步来说，破产法，公司法以及社会保障法应该要相互协调，相辅相成。
en: Moreover, the Bankruptcy Law, the Company Law, and the Securities Law should be well coordinated and mutually reinforcing.

zh: 比如说，在无法按照公司法和社会保障法的要求，满足诸如盈利和净资产值等传统标准时，一间正在重组的公司如何发行债券以融资呢？
en: How can an enterprise being restructured, say, find a way to issue securities for financing if it cannot meet conventional standards such as profitability and net asset value, as required by the Company Law and the Securities Law?

zh: 相关的法律必须包含有针对这类问题的具体安排，以确保上市公司重组成功。
en: The law must contain specific provisions regarding such matters in order to ensure successful listing of restructuring firms.

zh: 为避免欺诈这一过去敏感的问题，新法引入了“撤销权 ” ， 藉此，在破产申请被接受以及资产回收之前的规定期限内，破产案产业管理人可以要求法院撤销债务人任何牵涉到欺诈，逃避或不公平的清盘等的行为。
en: To prevent fraud, an acute problem in the past, the new law established a “right of rescission,” whereby the receiver can ask courts to rescind any action by a debtor that involves fraud, evasion, or unfair liquidation in the prescribed period before a bankruptcy petition is accepted and assets recovered.

zh: 可见，当前的法律系统强调公平清盘。
en: The system now holds the key to fairness liquidation.

zh: 而且，现在破产欺诈是属于中华人民共和国刑法的范畴。
en: Moreover, the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China now includes bankruptcy fraud.

zh: 中国重新修订后的破产法的成功实施取决于其有效的执行以及在以前版本下形成的思维模式和行为模式的废除，特别是在政策性破产时期形成的思维模式和行为模式的废除。
en: The successful implementation of China’s revised Bankruptcy Law hinges on its effective enforcement and abandonment of the mindset and practices shaped under the old version, especially in the era of policy-based bankruptcy.

zh: 尽管困难重重，但中国的破产法正慢慢适应市场经济；这一趋势是不可逆转的。
en: Despite the difficulties that remain, China’s bankruptcy legislation is increasingly adapted to the market economy; the trend is irreversible.

zh: 禁止炸弹试验
en: Ban the Bomb Tests

zh: 华盛顿—本月早些时候在华盛顿结束的核安全峰会过程表明了当政治领导人齐聚一堂关注一个全球问题是能够取得什么成果。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The Nuclear Security Summit process, which concluded earlier this month in Washington, DC, shows what can be achieved when political leaders come together to concentrate on a global problem.

zh: 着重于防止核恐怖主义的六年计划在危险核与放射性材料的销毁、最少化和安全方面形成了重要结果。
en: The six-year initiative, focused on preventing nuclear terrorism, produced important outcomes on eliminating, minimizing, and securing dangerous nuclear and radiological materials.

zh: 但是，不幸的是，核威胁仍然远远没有消除。
en: Unfortunately, however, the nuclear threat is still far from being neutralized.

zh: 恐怖组织所带来的危险正在增加，源自有核国家之间的竞争和冲突的风险亦然。
en: The dangers posed by terrorist groups are growing, as are the risks from competition and conflict between nuclear-armed states.

zh: 强大的领导力和全球合作还必须用于解决其他紧迫的核威胁上，特别是进一步试验和扩散核武器的威胁。
en: Strong leadership and global cooperation must also be deployed to address other urgent nuclear dangers, particularly the threat of further testing and proliferation of weapons.

zh: 希望之光渺茫。
en: There are few bright signs on the horizon.

zh: 相反，几乎所有有核国家要么在扩张，要么在升级其核武库。
en: On the contrary, almost every nuclear-armed state is either expanding or upgrading its nuclear arsenal.

zh: 没有积极的谈判推动监管、限制或进一步减少核库存。
en: There are no active negotiations to regulate, cap, or further reduce nuclear stockpiles.

zh: 俄罗斯和美国各自通过数百部潜艇、轰炸机和导弹部署了超过1,800枚战略弹头 — — 远远多于核打击威慑所需要的量。
en: Russia and the United States have each deployed more than 1,800 strategic warheads on several hundred submarines, bombers, and missiles – far more than is necessary to deter a nuclear attack.

zh: 这些武器中许多可以在几分钟内发射，这增加了误算的风险。
en: Many of these weapons can be launched within minutes, increasing the risk of miscalculation.

zh: 与此同时，朝鲜可能很快就能装备核弹头弹道导弹，这将给整个亚洲带来巨大的威胁。
en: Meanwhile, North Korea could soon be able to arm ballistic missiles with nuclear warheads, a development that would pose a significant threat to all of Asia.

zh: 考虑到如此严重的危险，停止进一步核竞赛、消除全世界15,000发核武器存量所带来的风险符合所有国家的利益。
en: Given the grave dangers, it is in every country’s interest to halt further nuclear competition and eliminate the risks associated with the world’s remaining stockpiles of some 15,000 nuclear weapons.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马和哈萨克斯坦总统纳扎尔巴耶夫在核安全峰会补充声明中指出，有效的全球降低风险战略的一个关键要素是让1996年全面禁止核试验条约（CTBT）生效。
en: As US President Barack Obama and Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarbayev noted in separate statements during the Nuclear Security Summit, a key element of an effective global risk-reduction strategy must be to bring the 1996 Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty (CTBT) into force.

zh: 如果现有核力量无法进行核试验，就无法测试新的、更先进的弹头设计。
en: If existing nuclear powers cannot conduct tests, they will not be able to try out new, more sophisticated warhead designs.

zh: 类似地，如果不进行试爆，新有核国家开发测试更小型、更容易实现的弹头也会困难得多。
en: Similarly, without test explosions, newer nuclear-armed states will have a far more difficult time developing and fielding smaller, more easily deliverable warheads.

zh: CTBT获得了几乎一致的支持。
en: The CTBT has near-universal support.

zh: 该条约共有183个签署国，并且实现了事实上的禁止核试验，是国际核不扩散体系的关键要素。
en: With 183 state signatories and a de facto test ban in place, the treaty is now a key component of the international nuclear nonproliferation system.

zh: 它建立了核试验禁区（只有朝鲜在1998年违反了CTBT ） ， 并延缓了全球军备竞赛。
en: It has established a taboo against testing (violated since 1998 only by North Korea) and slowed the global arms race.

zh: 但是，CTBT被联合国大会通过已经过去了近20年，却仍没有成为生效的国际法 — — 主要是因为美国不批准它。
en: And yet, nearly 20 years after its adoption by the United Nations General Assembly, the CTBT is not valid international law – largely because the US has not ratified it.

zh: 美国参议院在1999年草率地做出不予批准的带有浓重党派色彩的决定，并且此后一直没有重新考虑该条约，这给了其他七个必须批准CTBT的国家拖延的借口。
en: The US Senate’s rushed and highly partisan 1999 vote against ratification – and its failure to reconsider the treaty since then – has given the seven other states that must ratify the CTBT a reason for delay.

zh: 结果，进一步核试验的大门仍然敞开着。
en: As a result, the door to further nuclear testing remains open.

zh: 去年秋天，美国能源部长莫尼兹（Ernest Moniz）和美国国务卿克里表示参议院将再次讨论该问题。
en: Last fall, US Secretary of Energy Ernest Moniz and US Secretary of State John Kerry suggested that the Senate revisit the issue.

zh: 不幸的是，总统奥巴马剩下的任期不足以启动让参议院重新对CTBT投票所需要进行的费时的教育和宣传运动。
en: Unfortunately, President Barack Obama does not have enough time left in office to launch the time-consuming education and outreach campaign needed before bringing the CTBT to the Senate for another vote.

zh: 但他的政府可以在他离任前加强必要的准备工作 — — 展示新信息、回答具体问题，澄清旧神话和错误概念。
en: But his administration could intensify the necessary preparatory work – for presenting new information, answering detailed questions, and dispelling old myths and misconceptions – before he leaves office.

zh: 即使下一任美国总统和参议院果真重新��虑批准CTBT的问题，也需要好几年时间。
en: Even if the next US president and Senate do reconsider ratification of the CTBT, a vote may not happen for several years.

zh: 与此同时，世界领导人找到办法鼓励其他尚未批准CTBT的国家完成批准工作，并加强事实上已经存在的全球试验暂停至关重要。
en: In the meantime, it is essential that world leaders seek ways to encourage ratification by other CTBT holdout states and to reinforce the de facto global moratorium on testing.

zh: 4月11日，G-7外长在广岛宣布“所有国家都不应该进行核试爆，所有国家都应该毫不迟疑地签署并批准CTBT ” ， 这是一个良好的开端。
en: The G-7 foreign ministers’ declaration on April 11 in Hiroshima – “No state should conduct a nuclear test explosion and all states should sign and ratify the CTBT without delay” – is a good start.

zh: 日本和哈萨克斯坦最明白禁止核试验的重要性，它们经历过核爆炸的可怕影响。
en: No one knows that better than Japan and Kazakhstan, which have suffered from the terrible effects of nuclear detonations.

zh: 两国外长岸田文雄和伊德里索夫（Erlan Idrissov）在9月份警告说，老方一帖是不够的。
en: As their respective foreign ministers, Fumio Kishida and Erlan Idrissov, warned in September, business as usual will not suffice.

zh: 岸田文雄和伊德里索夫邀请同侪在6月13日前往维也纳举行部长级会议探讨让CTBT生效的选择。
en: Kishida and Idrissov have invited their counterparts to a ministerial-level meeting in Vienna on June 13 to explore options for bringing the CTBT into force.

zh: 他们将鼓励主要未签署国重申它们对全球禁止核试验的支持，并承诺将“尽可能早”地考虑批准CTBT。
en: They will encourage key holdout states to reaffirm their support for the global testing taboo and to pledge that they will consider ratification “at the earliest possible time.”

zh: 随着CTBT签署二十周年的临近，联合国安理会和联合国大会成员可以采取进一步措施确保禁止核试验。
en: As we approach the 20th anniversary of the CTBT, members of the UN Security Council and the General Assembly can take further steps to ensure that nuclear testing remains off-limits.

zh: 比如，它们可以寻求实施新的安理会决议，同时联合国大会采取措施要求所有国家克制核试验，并敦促迅速采取行动批准CTBT。
en: For example, they could pursue the adoption of a new Security Council resolution and a parallel General Assembly measure calling on all states to refrain from testing and urging quick action on ratification.

zh: 这一行动将强化反对核试验的全球规范，刺激未签署CTBT国家的行动。
en: Such an initiative would reinforce the global norm against testing and stimulate movement by holdout states.

zh: 正如领导人们在核安全峰会上合作防止核恐怖主义，我们需要全新的合作和领导力来一劳永逸地结束核试验。
en: Just as leaders have cooperated at the Nuclear Security Summit to prevent nuclear terrorism, we need renewed cooperation and leadership to end nuclear testing once and for all.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马和美国实力
en: Barack Obama and American Power

zh: 剑桥－巴拉克·奥巴马总统将要面临的首要挑战之一，是仍在持续过程中的金融危机所造成的后果，这场危机已经使人们对美国未来的实力产生了怀疑。
en: CAMBRIDGE – One of the first challenges that President Barack Obama will face is the effects of the ongoing financial crisis, which has called into question the future of American power.

zh: 《远东经济评论》上的一篇文章宣称 ， “ 华尔街的崩溃预示着一个全球性的结构变化：美国的实力开始衰落 ” 。
en: An article in The Far Eastern Economic Review proclaims that “Wall Street’s crack-up presages a global tectonic shift: the beginning of the decline of American power.”

zh: 俄罗斯总统德米特里·梅德韦杰夫将危机看作是美国的全球领导地位终结的标志，委内瑞拉总统雨果·查韦斯断言现在北京比纽约更为重要。
en: Russian President Dmitri Medvedev sees the crisis as a sign that America’s global leadership is coming to an end, and Venezuelan President Hugo Chávez has declared that Beijing is now much more relevant than New York.

zh: 然而，作为美国金融实力象征的美元，在最近却上涨了，而不是下跌了。
en: Yet the dollar, a symbol of American financial power, has surged rather than declined.

zh: 像哈佛大学教授兼国际货币基金组织前首席经济学家肯尼斯·罗格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）提到的那样 ， “ 考虑到我们刚刚将事情搞得一团糟，外国人将更多的钱投到我们这里的反应，是很讽刺的。
en: As Kenneth Rogoff, a Harvard professor and former chief economist of the IMF notes, “It is ironic, given that we just messed up big-time, that the response of foreigners is to pour more money into us.

zh: 他们不知道钱还有什么其他地方可以去。
en: They’re not sure where else to go.

zh: 他们似乎比我们自己对我们解决问题的能力更有信心。 ”
en: They seem to have more confidence in our ability to solve our problems than we do.”

zh: 过去人们常说，美国打个喷嚏，世界其他地方就会感冒。
en: It used to be said that when America sneezed, the rest of the world caught a cold.

zh: 最近，许多人声称，伴随着中国和石油国家的崛起，美国经济减速对世界其他地区的冲击可以被抵消。
en: More recently, many claimed that with the rise of China and the petro-states, an American slowdown could be decoupled from the rest of the world.

zh: 但是，当美国得了金融感冒时，其他国家也得了。
en: But when the United States caught the financial flu, others followed.

zh: 许多外国领导人迅速从幸灾乐祸转向担忧 — — 以及对美国国库券安全的关注。
en: Many foreign leaders quickly switched from schadenfreude to fear – and to the security of US treasury bills.

zh: 危机经常驳倒了传统观点；这场危机显示美国经济潜在的实力仍然很强。
en: Crises often refute conventional wisdom, and this one reveals that the underlying strength of the American economy remains impressive.

zh: 华尔街和美国监管者的糟糕表现，已经给美国经济模式的吸引力这样的软实力造成了重大损失，如果美国和20世界90年代的日本相比，能够成功消化损失并降低危害，当前的金融危机的打击不一定是致命的。
en: The poor performance of Wall Street and America regulators has cost America a good deal in terms of the soft power of its economic model’s attractiveness, but the blow need not be fatal if, in contrast to Japan in the 1990’s, the US manages to absorb the losses and limit the damage.

zh: 因为其劳动力市场的弹性，较高的教育水平，政治稳定以及对创新的接受能力，世界经济论坛仍然将美国经济评为世界上最有竞争力的经济体。
en: The World Economic Forum still rates the American economy as the world’s most competitive, owing to its labor-market flexibility, higher education, political stability, and openness to innovation.

zh: 更大的问题影响着将来很长时期内的美国实力。
en: The larger question concerns the long-term future of American power.

zh: 美国国家情报委员会的一份新的对2025年的预测推断，美国的优势将会被极大的削弱，而且，美国持续具有优势的一个关键领域 — — 军事实力 — — 在将来的竞争社会中不如现在这么重要。
en: A new forecast for 2025 being prepared by the US National Intelligence Council projects that American dominance will be “much diminished,” and that the one key area of continued American superiority – military power – will be less significant in the competitive world of the future.

zh: 这并不完全是一个“其他国家崛起 ” ， 美国衰落的问题。
en: This is not so much a question of American decline as “the rise of the rest.”

zh: 实力总是依赖于一定的环境，并且在当今的世界，实力是以一个与复杂的三维国际象棋比赛类似的模式分布的。
en: Power always depends on context, and in today’s world, it is distributed in a pattern that resembles a complex three-dimensional chess game.

zh: 在顶端的棋盘上，世界军事实力在很大程度上是单极的，并且很可能在短期内继续如此。
en: On the top chessboard, military power is largely unipolar and likely to remain so for a while.

zh: 但是，在中间的棋盘上，世界经济实力已经多极化了，其中，美国、欧洲、日本和中国是主要的参与者，而其他国家的重要性正在增加。
en: But on the middle chessboard, economic power is already multi-polar, with the US, Europe, Japan and China as the major players, and others gaining in importance.

zh: 在底部的棋盘上，是在政府控制之外的跨越国界的跨国关系领域。
en: The bottom chessboard is the realm of transnational relations that cross borders outside of government control.

zh: 这一领域包括了用电子转账转移比许多国家的预算还要多的钱的银行家，以及转移武器的恐怖分子或者破坏因特网运行的电脑黑客等各种各样的参与者。
en: It includes actors as diverse as bankers electronically transferring sums larger than most national budgets, as well as terrorists transferring weapons or hackers disrupting Internet operations.

zh: 它也包括像流行疾病和气候变化这样的新挑战。
en: It also includes new challenges like pandemics and climate change.

zh: 在这个底部棋盘上，权力极度分散，谈论单极，多极或者霸权是没有意义的。
en: On this bottom board, power is widely dispersed, and it makes no sense to speak of unipolarity, multipolarity, or hegemony.

zh: 即使在金融危机发生之后，技术变化令人眼花缭乱的步伐很可能会继续驱动全球化向前发展，但是，对一个由国家组成的世界和一个由非国家参与者组成的世界来说，其政治影响将会是不同的。
en: Even in the aftermath of the financial crisis, the giddy pace of technological change is likely to continue to drive globalization, but the political effects will be different for the world of nation-states and the world of non-state actors.

zh: 在国家间政治中，最重要的因素将会是持续的“亚洲回归 ” 。
en: In inter-state politics, the most important factor will be the continuing “return of Asia.”

zh: 在1750年，亚洲拥有世界五分之三的人口，经济产量占世界的五分之三。
en: In 1750, Asia had three-fifths of the world population and three-fifths of the world’s economic output.

zh: 到1900年，在欧洲和美国的工业革命后，亚洲只占世界经济产量的五分之一。
en: By 1900, after the industrial revolution in Europe and America, Asia accounted for just one-fifth of world output.

zh: 到2040年，亚洲的经济产量将会再次占到世界的五分之三。
en: By 2040, Asia will be well on its way back to its historical share.

zh: 中国和印度的崛起可能会带来不稳定，但是这是一个有先例的问题，并且我们可以从历史中学习政策能怎样影响结果。
en: The rise of China and India may create instability, but it is a problem with precedents, and we can learn from history about how policies can affect the outcome.

zh: 一个世纪前，英国在没有爆发冲突的情况下应对了美国的崛起，但是，世界应对德国崛起的失败却导致了两场破坏性的世界战争。
en: A century ago, Britain managed the rise of American power without conflict, but the world’s failure to manage the rise of German power led to two devastating world wars.

zh: 国际社会也应该应对非国家势力的崛起。
en: The rise of non-state actors also must be managed.

zh: 在2001年，一个非国家团体杀死的美国人比日本政府在珍珠港杀死的美国人还要多。
en: In 2001, a non-state group killed more Americans than the government of Japan killed at Pearl Harbor.

zh: 由鸟类或喷气式飞机上的旅客传播引起的一场流行疾病所造成的死亡人数，可能比第一次世界大战或者第二次世界大战中死亡的人数还要多。
en: A pandemic spread by birds or travelers on jet aircraft could kill more people than perished in World Wars I or II.

zh: 权力分散（与国家无关）所带来的问题可能成为比权力在国家之间转移所引起的问题，更加难以解决。
en: The problems of the diffusion of power (away from states) may turn out to be more difficult than shifts in power between states.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马面临的挑战是，即使是最强大的国家，也有越来越多的问题处在其控制之外。
en: The challenge for Barack Obama is that more and more issues and problems are outside the control of even the most powerful state.

zh: 虽然美国在传统的权力手段上表现不错，但是，由于信息革命和全球化，世界政治正在以一种阻止美国人通过单独行动达成他们的国际目标的方式，发生着变化，所以这些手段越来越无法掌握确定世界政治的许多因素。
en: Although the US does well on the traditional measures of power, those measures increasingly fail to capture much of what defines world politics, which, owing to the information revolution and globalization, is changing in a way that prevents Americans from achieving all their international goals by acting alone.

zh: 例如，国际金融稳定对美国的繁荣至关重要，但是，美国却需要其他国家的合作来保证金融稳定。
en: For example, international financial stability is vital to American prosperity, but the US needs the cooperation of others to ensure it.

zh: 全球气候变化也会影响生活质量，但是，美国却无法单独应对这个问题。
en: Global climate change, too, will affect the quality of life, but the US cannot manage the problem alone.

zh: 而且，在一个从毒品到传染病和恐怖主义等等越来越容易渗透过边界的世界里，美国必须动员国际合作来解决共同面对的威胁和挑战。
en: And, in a world where borders are becoming increasingly porous to everything from drugs to infectious diseases to terrorism, America must mobilize international coalitions to address shared threats and challenges.

zh: 作为世界上最大的经济体，美国的领导仍然 至关重要。
en: As the world’s largest economy, American leadership will remain crucial.

zh: 金融危机之后的美国实力的问题，不是一个美国实力衰落的问题，而是认识到即使是最强大的国家，也不能在没有其他人的帮助下达成目标的问题。
en: The problem of American power in the wake of the financial crisis is not one of decline, but of a realization that even the most powerful country cannot achieve its aims without the help of others.

zh: 幸运的是，巴拉克·奥巴马明白这一点。
en: Fortunately, Barack Obama understands that.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马，以色列真正的朋友
en: Barack Obama, Israel’s True Friend

zh: 海法 — — 怎样才能分辨真朋友？
en: HAIFA – How do you tell a true friend?

zh: 真朋友信任你、对你有信心、注重你真实的需求、坦诚地指出你的错误、并帮助你改正。
en: By the fact that he believes and has confidence in you, cares about your true needs, and honestly tells you your mistakes, which he tries to help you correct.

zh: 这才是我想要的朋友，而不是我做什么都点头称是，到处告诉别人他爱我，并且接受我的错误。
en: That is the kind of friend I want at my side, not one who automatically approves of whatever I do, declares his love for me, and accepts me as I am.

zh: 自从1967年在六日战争中大获全胜，击退公然叫嚣要摧毁犹太国家的埃及、叙利亚和约旦联军后，以色列就陷入到一场由征服所引起的意识和军事紊乱的痛苦磨难之中。
en: Ever since its great military victory in the Six-Day War of 1967, when it repelled the combined armies of Egypt, Syria, and Jordan, which had openly proclaimed their desire to destroy the Jewish state, Israel has been in the throes of an ideological and military confusion resulting from the conquests it made during that conflict.

zh: 六日战争后，以色列并没有把被占领土作为筹码来换取和平，促使阿拉伯世界和巴勒斯坦人承认他们的合法地位，并在归还被占领土后实现巴勒斯坦领土的非军事化进程。
en: Following the Six-Day War, Israel did not consider the conquered lands as something to be traded for peace, and thus induce the Arab world and the Palestinians to recognize its legitimacy and ensure the demilitarization of Palestinian territories after their restitution.

zh: 相反，因为对敌人及其尊重未来和平协议承诺的不信任，或者受到吞并某些领土的欲望的驱使 — — 以色列开始推行所谓的定居点政策。
en: Instead, Israel – either because of its distrust of its enemies and of their commitment to respect any future peace agreement, or because of a desire to annex some of the territories – began to pursue a policy of settlements.

zh: 但以色列的这种做法造成了难以改变的现实。
en: But, in doing so, it created a reality that is difficult to reverse.

zh: 以色列的非军事定居点过去和现在都与国家安全没有任何关系。
en: Israel’s non-military settlements are, and have always been, irrelevant to the country’s security.

zh: 相反，因为定居点处在巴勒斯坦人口的核心地带，反而成了恐怖袭击最便捷的目标，需要采取特别的防御措施加以保护，包括部署大批军力进行巡逻和监督。
en: On the contrary, because the settlements are located in the heart of the Palestinian population, they are convenient targets for terrorist attacks and require special defensive measures, including the deployment of large military forces engaged in patrolling and surveillance.

zh: 即使在没有叙利亚势力存在的格兰高地上，仅仅离开叙利亚兵营几公里远的定居点也造成了沉重的负担，因为在战争爆发的情况下，以色列军队不得不迅速将他们撤离，1973年10月爆发的赎罪日战争就是一例。
en: Even on the Golan Heights, where there is no Syrian presence, the settlements, located only a few kilometers from enormous Syrian troop concentrations, create a heavy burden, because, in the event of war, the Israeli army would be forced to evacuate them quickly, as was the case during the Yom Kippur war of October 1973.

zh: 定居点激化了巴勒斯坦人对于以色列人的仇恨。
en: The settlements intensify Palestinian hatred toward Israel.

zh: 除占领巴勒斯坦人土地、占用水资源、限制他们自由迁徙的权利外，建立定居点还象征着以色列留在当地的意愿，表明它不愿承认巴勒斯坦人独立的事实。 即使巴勒斯坦人承认以色列的合法地位，表明愿意与以色列和平共处也改变不了什么。
en: In addition to occupying Palestinians’ land, using their water, and imposing limits on their freedom of movement, the settlements symbolize Israel’s intention to remain, and thus its reluctance to concede independence to the Palestinian people, even if they were to recognize Israel’s legitimacy and show themselves disposed to peaceful coexistence.

zh: 以色列在定居点投入了大笔资金，这种投入通常是以忽视以色列国内需求为代价的。
en: Israel has invested great financial resources in the settlements, often ignoring important needs in Israel proper.

zh: 居住在定居点的主要是宗教民族运动支持者和相关党派，他们在与以色列当局的相处中常常标榜一种唯我独尊的态度，他们不仅装作在巴勒斯坦人面前有特殊地位，而且在其他以色列人面前也高人一筹。
en: The settlers, predominantly supporters of religious-nationalist movements and parties, often flaunt an attitude of superiority in their relations with Israeli authorities, pretending to have a special status with respect not only to Palestinians, but also to other Israeli citizens.

zh: 事实上，很多定居点里的以色列居民甚至对以色列国家的司法权威不予认可。
en: Indeed, a substantial number of them don’t even recognize the Israeli state’s legal authority.

zh: 定居点最大的问题是如果继续扩张下去，两国分治的解决方案迟早都会受到威胁，从而导致单一国家的既成事实 — — 这个国家在约旦河和地中海之间存在着两大民族团体。
en: The greatest problem with the settlements is that if they continue to expand, the two-state solution will be compromised and, sooner or later, lead to a unitary state – one populated by two ethnic groups – between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean Sea.

zh: 因为单纯的人口统计方法说明巴勒斯坦人将逐渐占据多数，因此单一国家意味着以色列的末日。
en: Because simple demographic implies that Palestinians would gradually come to constitute a majority, a unitary state is a recipe for the end of Israel.

zh: 绝大多数以色列人都明白这个道理。
en: The majority of Israelis understand this.

zh: 但就像不可救药的吸毒者一样，他们不具备说出“够了，我们犯了错误，必须在还来得及的时候加以纠正”的能力。
en: But, like an incorrigible drug addict, they are unable to say, “Enough. We have made a mistake, and we have to remedy it before it’s too late.”

zh: 可以肯定，在与埃及签订和平条约的时候，犹太定居者不得不被迫撤离西奈。
en: To be sure, when a peace treaty was signed with Egypt, Jewish settlers were forcibly evacuated from the Sinai.

zh: 同样，当没有办法为加沙地带的犹太人群体提供支持的时候，右翼党派领导人阿里埃勒·沙龙赶走了与150万巴勒斯坦人杂居的9，000名犹太定居者 — — 这一戏剧性的事件在双方民众心里都留下了深深的创伤。
en: Similarly, when Jewish communities in the Gaza Strip became unsupportable, the leader of the right, Ariel Sharon, forced out the 9,000 settlers who lived there among 1.5 million Palestinians – a dramatic event that has left deep scars on both sides.

zh: 但西岸居住着250，000位以色列定居者。
en: But there are 250,000 Israeli settlers in the West Bank.

zh: 任何迫使他们撤离的举动都可能升级为一场内战。
en: Any attempt to evacuate them could escalate into a civil war.

zh: 全世界，包括美国在内，都不赞成以色列修建定居点的做法。
en: The world, including the United States, disapproves of the Israeli settlements.

zh: 但是，尽管过去美国政府有过施加影响的机会，但他们更愿意让以色列这个友好盟国尽情地为所欲为。
en: But, despite past US administrations’ opportunity to make their influence felt, they preferred to permit Israel, an allied, friendly state, to do what it wanted.

zh: 现在到了面对现实的时刻。
en: So a moment of truth has arrived.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马这位智慧勇敢的领导人关注的不仅是改善美国在穆斯林世界的形象，我对这一点毫不怀疑。
en: Barack Obama, a wise and courageous leader, is – I have no doubt about it – not merely interested in improving America’s image in the eyes of the Muslim world.

zh: 他还追求以色列的安全和福祉，并且大声疾呼 ， “ 够了。
en: He also seeks Israel’s welfare and security, and says to us, “Enough.

zh: 别再损害你们的未来和你们自己的利益。
en: Stop harming yourselves and your own future.

zh: 即便你们不相信巴勒斯坦人渴望和平的真实愿望，不相信他们能够消灭恐怖组织，不相信他们放弃所谓回归权的承诺，你们也一定可以依靠在巴勒斯坦领地驻军来保卫自己的安全，而不是拓展毫无意义的移民定居点，对未来的和平以及两国分治的解决方案造成威胁。 ”
en: Even if you don’t believe in Palestinians’ real desire for peace, their capacity to hold terrorist organizations at bay, or their renunciation of the alleged right of return, you can always protect your security with a military presence in Palestinian territories rather than prejudicing the future peace and the two-state solution by expanding useless settlements.”

zh: 借助对以色列政府明确而直截了当的呼吁，美国总统不只是说出了一个多数以色列人知道的事实。
en: With such a clear and direct appeal to the Israeli government, America’s president not only expresses what a majority of Israelis know.

zh: 他也向犹太国家奉献了自己意味深长的友谊。
en: He also proves his profound friendship for the Jewish state.

zh: 巴拉克•奥巴马的美国革命
en: Barack Obama’s American Revolution

zh: 八年以来，乔治•W•布什成功地继承和强化了世界对美国的所有偏见和成见。
en: For eight years, George W. Bush has managed to incarnate and reinforce all the prejudices and negative stereotypes the world has of the US.

zh: 他比任何一位前任都更善于和世界对抗，以对“硬实力”的低效滥用，严重损害了美国的“软实力 ” 。
en: He has antagonized the world more than any other American president before him, seriously damaging America’s “soft” power by inefficient and excessive use of its “hard” power.

zh: 因此让美国同自己并与世界和解应成为下一任美国总统的两项头等大事。
en: Reconciling the United States with itself and the world should thus be the twin priorities for America’s next president.

zh: 如果说有一位候选人能够做到这一点，能够在顷刻之间帮助美国重塑国际声誉，那么这个人就是巴拉克•奥巴马。
en: If there is one candidate who can accomplish this, who can contribute, in a split second, to restoring America’s international reputation, it is Barack Obama.

zh: 时势造英雄。
en: Exceptional periods sometimes create exceptional leaders.

zh: 如果没有法国大革命，拿破仑•波拿巴将仍然是一位怀才不遇的初级军官。
en: Without the French Revolution, Napoleon Bonaparte would have remained a gifted and frustrated junior military officer.

zh: 同样，现在的美国及其与世界的关系正处在一个非常时期，需要一位领导人能从根本上挑战全球大多数人的观点，即美国已变得傲慢、无能和自私。
en: Likewise, the current period in America and its relations with the world have been truly exceptional, requiring a leader who can fundamentally challenge a global majority’s view that America has become arrogant, impotent, and selfish.

zh: 当然反美的死硬派永不会被说服，但可能除了在穆斯林世界，他们毕竟是少数。
en: Of course, diehard anti-Americans will never be persuaded, but they remain a minority, with the possible exception of the Muslim world.

zh: 沉默的大多数都等待着布什之后仍有希望的证明。
en: The silent majority is ready to be convinced that there is life after Bush.

zh: 为什么说奥巴马与其他总统候选人如此不同？ 他如何能在国际上发挥不同凡响的作用呢？
en: Why is Obama so different from the other presidential candidates, and why could he make such a large difference internationally?

zh: 毕竟，在外交政策方面，下一任总统的发挥空间很小。
en: After all, in foreign policy matters, the next president’s room for maneuver will be very small.

zh: 他（或她）将会继续留守伊拉克，继续以支持以色列的姿态介入以巴冲突，应对更为强悍的俄罗斯和更有雄心的中国，并面对全球变暖的挑战。
en: He (or she) will have to stay in Iraq, engage in the Israel-Palestine conflict on the side of Israel, confront a tougher Russia, deal with an ever more ambitious China, and face the challenge of global warming.

zh: 如果奥巴马能有不同的作为，这不是因为他的政策选择，而是因为他的个人特质。
en: If Obama can make a difference, it is not because of his policy choices, but because of what he is.

zh: 当他面带微笑、展露荣光地出现在全世界的电视荧屏上的那一刻，美国的形象和软实力会如同经历一场哥白尼革命。
en: The very moment he appears on the world’s television screens, victorious and smiling, America’s image and soft power would experience something like a Copernican revolution.

zh: 想象一下他当选会给非洲、亚洲、东方甚至欧洲带来什么样的印象。
en: Think of the impression his election would make not only in Africa, but in Asia, the Middle East, and even Europe.

zh: 随着美国获得全球霸主地位，它也成为西方的化身，而西方被看作是“白”的。
en: With its rise to global supremacy, America had become the incarnation of the West, and the West was seen as “white.”

zh: 美国权力的更替首先是从东海岸到西海岸，然后到达南方。
en: Power in America shifted first from the East Coast to the West Coast, and then to the South.

zh: 但如果这种跨越美国种族分割的变化还不具有真正的革命性，那什么才具有呢？
en: But if a shift across America’s racial divide is not truly revolutionary, then what is?

zh: 当然，将奥巴马的肤色作为他的最大优势是一种严重的简单化，即便他也竭力强调自己的“黑色之根 ” 。
en: Of course, to reduce Obama to the color of his skin is a grave oversimplification, even if he has been keen to emphasize his “black roots.”

zh: 事实上，非洲裔的美国人也不全都支持他。
en: In fact, African-Americans do not fully support him.

zh: 有着白人母亲和黑人父亲的他不同于任何一位非洲裔美国人的先例。
en: With his white mother and his African father, he does not fit any African-American precedent.

zh: 但这正是奥巴马的另一个非同寻常之处：他身份的复杂性使他具有真正的世界性，成为全球化时代的一位全球化候选人。
en: But that is another reason why Obama is exceptional: the complexity of his identity makes him truly universal, a global candidate for a global age.

zh: 通过独特的个人经历，他能够沟通非洲、美洲，甚至亚洲—年幼时他曾在那里的一所穆斯林学校学习—从而重塑美国的世界形象和讯息。
en: By virtue of his unique personal history, he can bridge Africa, America, and even Asia – where he studied as a young boy in a Muslim school – thereby reviving the universal image and message of America.

zh: 但有鉴于美国在布什年代的经历，使奥巴马与众不同的最重要原因是他所承载的讯息。 他的著述的书名是对这一讯息的最佳总结 — 《 希望无惧 》 （ The Audacity of Hope ） 。
en: But, above all, what makes Obama unique, given what the US has been through during the Bush years, is the nature of the message he embodies, which is best summed up in the title of his book The Audacity of Hope .

zh: 如果美国能从恐惧的文化迈进到希望的文化—并再一次为世界而继承这种希望—这就需要一位承载着美国梦想的领导人：既现代而又深得人文主义的宗教真谛，这与充斥着布什执政基础的焦虑的非理性主义和基督教保守运动形成鲜明的对比。
en: If America can move from a culture of fear to one of hope – and again incarnate hope for the world – it will require a leader who embodies the American dream: modern and armed with a humanistic religious message, in contrast to the anxious irrationalism of the Christian conservative movement that fueled Bush’s political base.

zh: 不论奥巴马是否能够实现他的诺言，美国都不会重新获得其在1941-2000年间所拥有的地位。
en: Regardless of whether Obama can deliver on his promises, America will not regain the stature it had between 1941 and 2000.

zh: 不论有没有奥巴马 ， “ 美国世纪”都将不会重现。
en: With or without Obama, the “American century” will not be repeated.

zh: 但奥巴马能够从吉米•卡特在1970年代中期所犯的早期错误中汲取教训。
en: But Obama can learn from the early mistakes made by Jimmy Carter in the mid-1970’s.

zh: 新孤立主义不是出路，只有基于自信和智慧的克制才是。
en: Neo-isolationism is not an option, but restraint – based on confidence and wisdom – is.

zh: 世界需要一个更为谦逊和自信的美国。
en: The world needs a more modest and confident America.

zh: 对我这样一个为美国在过去十年中的演变忧心忡忡、深感不安的欧���人而言，在所有已宣布的总统候选人当中，奥巴马似乎最能代言这样的美国。
en: For a European who has been deeply troubled and saddened by America’s evolution in the last decade, Obama, of all the declared presidential candidates, seems to come closest to incarnating such an America.

zh: 吉米·卡特·奥巴马
en: Jimmy Carter Obama

zh: 巴黎 — “ 教皇有几个分身？
en: PARIS – “How many divisions does the Pope have?”

zh: ”在被告知当心梵蒂冈时，斯大林讽刺道。
en: Joseph Stalin famously quipped when told to be mindful of the Vatican.

zh: 如今这一幕有了现实政治版，俄罗斯总理普京最近愉快地将教皇方济各视为共同反对美国军事干预叙利亚的盟友。
en: In an updated lesson in realpolitik, Russian President Vladimir Putin recently was happy to count Pope Francis as an ally in opposing American military intervention in Syria.

zh: 普京摆出充当国际法最后支柱的姿态，给美国 — — 特别是总统奥巴马 — — 上了一堂伦理课。
en: Presenting himself as the last pillar of respect for international law, Putin offered ethics lessons to the United States – and specifically to President Barack Obama.

zh: 9月14日，美国和俄罗斯在日内瓦签订协议，将叙利亚化学武器问题置于国际控制之下，俄罗斯凭此重回国际舞台 — — 这一回决不是仅仅作为反角。
en: With the US-Russian agreement, signed in Geneva on September 14, to place Syria’s chemical weapons under international control, Russia has returned to the global scene – and not only because of its nuisance value.

zh: 普京有可能像奥巴马那样获得诺贝尔和平奖吗？
en: Could Putin one day receive, like Obama before him, a Nobel Peace Prize?

zh: 促成该协议的俄罗斯外交部长拉夫罗夫已经可以进入俄罗斯外交名人堂、与卡尔·内斯尔罗德（Karl NEsselrode，1814—1815年维也纳会议和1856年巴黎和会俄国全权公使）平起平坐了吗？
en: Has not Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, who proposed the deal, already entered the pantheon of great Russian diplomats, as the successor of Karl Nesselrode, the Russian envoy to the 1814-1815 Congress of Vienna and to the Congress of Paris in 1856?

zh: 当然，俄罗斯外交最近表现极为出色，但这并不是全由其自身优点带来的。
en: Of course, Russian diplomacy has performed extremely well recently, but it does not stand on its own merits alone.

zh: 要不是美国外交政策昏招频出（这是拜奥巴马的犹豫不决和美国人民不愿再牵涉任何军事行动所赐 ） 、 欧洲陷入了深度分裂，俄罗斯外交官原本也取得不了多少成就。
en: Russia’s diplomats would have gained little without America’s foreign-policy malaise – a victim of Obama’s vacillation and of Americans’ hostility to any new military adventure, however limited its scope – and Europe’s deep internal divisions.

zh: 是的，俄罗斯正在从苏联解体后的耻辱中重新崛起。
en: Yes, Russia is emerging from its humiliation following the collapse of the Soviet Union.

zh: 继承了决定其国民性的帝国传统的俄罗斯正在重新树立其在中东的地位和作用，堪与帝俄时代和斯大林时代相媲美。
en: Heir to an imperial tradition that has shaped its national identity, Russia is resuming in the Middle East a role and status more in tune with the one it had from the Czarist era to Soviet times.

zh: 但俄罗斯军力不如美国，经济不如中国，软实力更是基本为零。
en: But Russia is no match for the US militarily and no match for China economically, and its soft power is virtually non-existent.

zh: 如果说俄罗斯能够挑衅美国 — — 比如，不管是授予“叛国者”斯诺登政治庇护，还是抵抗西方在中东的外交攻势 — — 那也不是因为它重新成为超级大国，而仅仅是因为美国已不再是曾经的超级大国。
en: If Russia can provoke America – whether by granting political asylum to the “traitor” Edward Snowden, for example, or by resisting Western diplomacy in the Middle East – it is not because it has become a great power once again, but simply because America is no longer the great power that it once was.

zh: 叙利亚危机十分清楚地说明了这一点。
en: The Syrian crisis has made that plain.

zh: 美国最近的外交举措非常业余而幼稚。
en: Recent US diplomacy has seemed amateurish and naive.

zh: 奥巴马对叙利亚危机的处理越来越像33年前吉米·卡特对伊朗人质危机的处理，尤其是1980年的拯救行动（1979年11月美国大使馆遭袭，美国人被劫为人质 ） 。
en: Obama’s handling of the Syrian crisis increasingly evokes Jimmy Carter’s handling of the Iranian hostage crisis 33 years ago, particularly the failed operation in 1980 to rescue the Americans abducted following the takeover of the US embassy in November 1979.

zh: 接着，犹豫胜过了决心，整个任务以失败告终。
en: Then, too, hesitation seemed to prevail over determination, contributing to the failure of the mission.

zh: 卡特是个无聊枯燥的工程师，而奥巴马是魅力超凡的律师。
en: Carter was a somewhat bland engineer, whereas Obama is a charismatic lawyer.

zh: 但他们在对待全球事务方面表现出相似的根本性的犹豫。
en: Yet they seem to share a fundamental indecisiveness in their approach to world affairs.

zh: 卡特难以在其国家安全顾问布热津斯基的强硬路线和国务卿万斯的温和路线之间做出抉择。
en: Carter had difficulty choosing between the muscular line of his national security adviser, Zbigniew Brzezinski, and the more moderate approach of his secretary of state, Cyrus Vance.

zh: 相反，奥巴马的外交政策亲信 — — 国家安全顾问苏珊·赖斯、接替赖斯出任美国驻联合国大使的萨曼莎·鲍威尔和国务卿约翰·克里之间并没有根本性分歧。
en: By contrast, there are no fundamental disagreements among Obama’s closest foreign-policy advisers – Susan Rice, the national security adviser, Samantha Power, who succeeded Rice as US Ambassador to the United Nations, and Secretary of State John Kerry.

zh: 相反，是奥巴马本人老是犹犹豫豫。
en: Instead, it is Obama himself who seems to be constantly hesitating.

zh: 分歧不在于他的顾问，而在于他自己的思维。
en: The divisions are not among his advisers, but within his own mind.

zh: 作为一名优秀的律师，奥巴马权衡利弊，明白在叙利亚问题上无动于衷是不行的，但在内心深处，他有不愿意卷入对外纠缠，这会导致他无法专注于国内改革日程。
en: As a good lawyer, Obama weighs the pros and cons, aware that it is impossible to do nothing in the Syrian crisis but remaining viscerally disinclined to leap into any foreign entanglement that would distract attention from his agenda of domestic reform.

zh: 更重要的是，他似乎对美国的全球角色缺少长期战略愿景。
en: More important, he seems to lack a coherent long-term strategic vision of America’s role in the world.

zh: 无论是眼下大热的“亚洲支点”还是四年前的“俄罗斯重启”都不足以作为宏大计划的开端。
en: Neither the currently fashionable “Asian pivot” nor the “Russian reset” four years ago constitute the beginning of a grand plan.

zh: 在这样的环境下，全球现实政治的回归只能有利于俄罗斯而有损于美国，尽管美国在硬实力和软实力方面拥有大量优势。
en: In such a context, the return of global realpolitik can only benefit Russia and harm the US, despite America’s many advantages in terms of hard and soft power.

zh: 俄罗斯和美国就叙利亚���学武器问题达成的协议将来或许会作为在武器控制方面的重大突破而被人铭记。
en: The agreement on Syria’s chemical weapons struck by Russia and the US could one day be remembered as a spectacular breakthrough in the field of arms control.

zh: 但更有可能的情形是，它会被认为是一个大骗局 — — 不是因为有助于叙利亚人民，而是作为美国国际地位日薄西山的信号而被记住。
en: But it is more likely to be perceived as a grand deception – remembered not for helping Syria’s people, but mainly as a sign of America’s growing international weakness.

zh: 果真如此的话，该协议不但有损于美国的名誉，也破坏了全球稳定。
en: In that case, the agreement will not only damage America’s reputation, but will also undermine global stability.

zh: 弱点就是弱点，不管它在莫斯科、北京、德黑兰还是平壤身上。
en: Weakness is weakness, whether one is in Moscow, Beijing, Tehran, or Pyongyang.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马错失的自由议程
en: Barack Obama’s Missing Freedom Agenda

zh: 在他就任的第二天，总统巴拉克·奥巴马为恢复宪法和法治做出了重要姿态：他签署了两道行政命令，一条关闭了关塔纳摩湾的监狱，另一条通过关闭所谓的“黑色据点”让美国重回到文明国家的行列中，这些据点促使国家批准的酷刑得以执行。
en: On his second full day in office, President Barack Obama made a major gesture toward restoring the Constitution and the rule of law by signing two executive orders: one closed the prison at Guantánamo Bay, and the other restored America to the company of civilized nations by closing so-called “black sites” that facilitated state-sanctioned torture.

zh: 这是个好的开始，奥巴马和数百万冒着危险站出来反对集体暴行的美国人都获得了荣誉。
en: Nice start, and the credit goes both to Obama and to the millions of Americans who stood up and took risks to fight against gathering tyranny.

zh: 但是这还不够。
en: But it is not enough.

zh: 我们需要听到这样一次演说，它将详述五项任务。 为了弥补前一任政府对自由造成的损失，奥巴马必须象他处理最先两条行政命令那样来迅速执行这五项任务。
en: There is a speech that we still need to hear, detailing five tasks that, in order to repair the damage to liberty caused by the previous administration, he must pursue as quickly as he handled the first two executive orders.

zh: 它的本质应该象这个样子：
en: Its substance should be something like the following:

zh: 我的美国民众们，开国先贤借助智慧利用许多方式来保证我们的自由。
en: “My fellow Americans, the Founders had the wisdom to guarantee our freedoms in many ways.

zh: 但这些方式不能保证我们的灵魂。
en: They could not guarantee our souls.

zh: 这取决于我们自己以及我们如何行事。
en: That is up to us and how we act.

zh: 在主要的每种宗教中，都问及了这样一个问题：如果我们丧失了道德价值，获得财富和权力又将如何造福我们呢？
en: “In every major religion, a version of the following question is asked: what does it profit us to gain wealth and power if we lose our moral values?

zh: 在过去八年中，我们已经和那些把我们的国家灵魂处于危险之中的行动勾结在一起。
en: In the past eight years, we have colluded with acts that jeopardized the very soul of our nation.

zh: 我们犯下或是容忍的最大罪行就是粗暴对待我们所珍惜的宪法。
en: The greatest crime we committed or tolerated was the savaging of our cherished Constitution.

zh: 没有我们的宪法，美国就是另外一个这样的世界大国，它之所以强大是因为财富和武器而不是因为价值和信念；所以当我们缺乏财富和武器的时候，就处于崩溃的危险之中。
en: “Without our Constitution, America is just another world power made great by wealth and weapons instead of by values and convictions; so we are at risk of collapse when our wealth and weapons fail us.

zh: 我们的宪法才是我们真正的财富，才能确保我们的国家得以持久。
en: It is our Constitution that is our true wealth and the true guarantee of our nation’s endurance.

zh: 在关闭关塔纳摩，禁止酷刑之后，我们必须撤销《爱国者法案 》 ， 从而恢复宪法对于毫无法律根据的窃听和监视的约束力。
en: “After closing Guantánamo Bay and forbidding torture, we must repeal the Patriot Act, thereby restoring the Constitution’s restraints against warrantless wiretapping and surveillance.

zh: 第二，尽管我们已经关闭了监狱，我们必须寻求我们的伙伴国家原谅我们所制造的或是我们与之串谋的恐惧，后者是通过执行国家批准的酷刑和将被拘押者“极端引渡”到折磨他们的国家得以实现的。
en: “Second, though we have closed the prisons, we must seek the forgiveness of our fellow nations for the horrors that we committed or with which we colluded by engaging in state-sanctioned torture and “extraordinary rendition” of detainees to countries that torture.

zh: 我将指派一个专门委员会来启动真相和和解进程，在我们的良知和世界面前来清算这些恐惧。
en: I am appointing a commission to establish a truth and reconciliation process to put the accounting of these horrors before our own consciences and before the world.

zh: 第三，我们必须有一位特别公诉人来起诉那些该负责任的人。
en: “Third, we must have a special prosecutor to prosecute the culpable.

zh: 许多服务于军界或情报界的人现在害怕要为采取的行动承担刑事责任，而这些行动是处于指挥链最上方的人命令他们采取的。
en: Many in the military or the intelligence services now fear criminal liability for actions they took at the behest of those at the top of the chain of command.

zh: 但是，行动的正确程序应该象纽伦堡，海牙，塞拉利昂和波斯利亚的冲突之后采取的那样：起诉那些设计，批准，实施虐待和引渡政策的人，无论涉及链条里面地位多高的人物—包括那些律师，他们为导致虐待和谋杀的法律滥用进行辩护；而不是把目标对准那些处于命令链低端的人。
en: But the proper course of action is that taken in Nuremberg, The Hague, Sierra Leone, and after the Bosnian conflict: prosecute those who designed, approved, and implemented the policy of torture and rendition, however high the chain of commission goes – including the lawyers who justified legal perversions that led to torture and murder – rather than targeting those farther down the chain of command.

zh: 第四，让我们再次宣布军队出现在我们的街道上是非法的，就像开国先贤计划的那样。
en: “Fourth, let us once again outlaw the presence of the military on our streets, as the Founders intended.

zh: 在2008年10月7日，超过3000名美军从伊拉克撤出后被部署在美国，这违反了《地方保安队法 》 ， 这部法律一个世纪以来保护我们不受军队管理。 这些部署还违反了《叛乱条例 》 ， 它在《地方保安队法》施行的前一个世纪保护了我们。
en: On October 7, 2008, more than 3,000 American troops were deployed from Iraq to the United States, in violation of Posse Comitatus, which has protected us from military policing for a century, and in violation of the Insurrection Act, which protected us for the century before that.

zh: 今天，我们的街道上有20000名士兵，他们不是向民众负责而仅仅是向行政当局负责。
en: Today, there are 20,000 soldiers – not accountable to the people, but only to the executive – on our streets.

zh: 这种局势的危害就是开国先贤采取第二修正案的原因。 第二修正案意味着把维持国内治安的责任局限在民兵身上：即国民警卫队和和民警，而民兵是向民众负责的。
en: “The danger of that situation is why the Founders adopted the Second Amendment, which is meant to restrict domestic policing to militia – the National Guard and civilian police – that are answerable to the people.

zh: 美国既非战场也非警察国家，所以我们应该把我们的战士送回真正的前线，或者送回家里和他们家人团聚。
en: America is neither a battlefield nor a police state, so we should send our soldiers to the actual front or else back home to their families.

zh: 最后，我们必须确保黑暗不会再次降临。
en: “Finally, we must ensure that this darkness never descends again.

zh: 美国有一半孩子成长的时候没有接受公民教育。
en: Half of American children grow up with no civic education.

zh: 有一半的州在中学里不再教授公民学，这门学科研究我们的共和国以及它是如何运转的。
en: Half of states no longer teach civics – the study of our Republic and how it works – in middle school.

zh: 所以，美国有一半新晋的大学生不知道我们的民主是什么，更不用提当民主受到威胁的时候如何来保卫它。
en: So half of incoming American college students don’t know what our democracy is, let alone how to defend it when it is threatened.

zh: 我号召全国各州重新开始美国公民学的研究，以便我们将培养出这样的公民：他们懂得我们的遗产，并能在宪法和自由受到威胁的时候保卫它们。
en: I call on states throughout the land to re-institute the study of US civics so that we will produce citizens who understand our legacy and can defend liberty and the Constitution when it is threatened.

zh: 加入我的行列来完成这五项任务。 我们能够在镜中再次看到自己，认识到我们自己是真正的美国人。
en: “Join me in accomplishing these next five tasks, and we can look at ourselves in the mirror again, recognizing ourselves as true Americans.”

zh: 卡扎菲的巨大阴影
en: Qaddafi’s Long Shadow

zh: 安塔利亚 — — 最近由哈利法·塔希夫塔将军领导的利比亚政变终于彻底戳穿了该国政令出不了首都的黎波里的孱弱中央政府能够有效执政的幻觉。
en: ANTALYA – The recent coup attempt in Libya, led by General Khalifa Hiftar, has finally pierced the illusion that the country’s dysfunctional central government, whose power is limited to the capital, Tripoli, can rule effectively.

zh: 但确定如何为利比亚割裂极深的社会带去和平与稳定不仅需要评估本届政府的失误；还需要思考前任领袖卡扎菲上校有哪些失败和成功之处。
en: But determining how to bring peace and stability to Libya’s deeply fragmented society will require more than an assessment of this government’s mistakes; it will demand careful consideration of former leader Colonel Muammar el-Qaddafi’s failures – and his successes.

zh: 塔希夫塔认为解决利比亚众多危机的关键在于建设一支有能力战胜破坏国家稳定的伊斯兰主义的强大军队。
en: Hiftar believes that the key to solving Libya’s myriad crises lies in establishing a strong national army capable of subduing the Islamists who are destabilizing the country.

zh: 也有人继续宣传民族和解才能解决问题。
en: Others continue to advocate for national reconciliation.

zh: 但这两种方法都没有解决驱动利比亚局势的卡扎菲主义这一真正问题。
en: But neither solution addresses what is really driving events in Libya: the legacy of Qaddafism.

zh: 鉴于卡扎菲统治利比亚超过四十年，他所留下的传统不能被简单忽略。
en: Given that Qaddafi ruled Libya for more than four decades, his is a legacy that cannot simply be ignored.

zh: 这意味着不仅要承认卡扎菲政策及当前问题间有着重要的联系，而且还要确保不会在抹去卡扎菲记忆的仓促浪潮中牺牲本应被保留的东西。
en: That means not only recognizing the vital link between his policies and today’s problems, but also ensuring that what should be preserved is not sacrificed in the rush to efface his memory.

zh: 卡扎菲利用强大的安全机构及准军事革命委员会来捍卫自己的统治，致使国家机构在运行不畅的同时四分五裂。
en: Qaddafi used strong security services and paramilitary revolutionary committees to safeguard his rule, leaving state institutions dysfunctional and fragmented.

zh: 事实上，卡扎菲确信官僚主义阻碍其向民众传达讯息的想法促使他定期破坏部委，并把特权阶层的个人关系凌驾于地方机构之上。
en: Indeed, Qaddafi’s belief that the bureaucracy impeded the transmission of his message to the masses spurred him to dismantle ministries periodically and place privileged personal relationships above institutional hierarchies.

zh: 由于缺乏统一领导，利比亚牺牲了民族认同感，恢复了部落和地区效忠制。
en: Lacking unified leadership, Libyans reverted to tribal and regional allegiances, at the expense of a shared national identity.

zh: 国家和社会的这种零散化继续破坏利比亚建立有效可信政府的能力。
en: This atomization of the state and society continues to impede Libya’s ability to establish effective and credible government.

zh: 但如果方法正确希望依然存在。
en: With the right approach, however, there is hope.

zh: 问题是利比亚领导人迄今为止更多是去固化分裂和混乱状况，而不是去改善它。
en: The problem is that Libya’s leaders have so far done more to perpetuate fragmentation and dysfunction than to ameliorate it.

zh: 在执政两年间，利比亚国民议会（GNC）将权力交给国家以外的主体，各部委绕过军队委派民兵执行安全任务。 塔希夫塔意识到这种方法有问题。
en: In its two years in power, the parliament, known as the General National Congress (GNC), has empowered non-state actors, with ministries bypassing the army to task militias with security operations.

zh: 事实上，这是他发动本次政变的促成因素；但他提出的解决方案同样有缺陷。
en: Hiftar recognizes the problem with this approach – indeed, it spurred him to initiate the coup; but his proposed solution is equally flawed.

zh: 毕竟，事实已经证明利比亚安全部队更有可能助长而不是反对任人唯亲。
en: After all, Libya’s security forces have already proved to be more likely to facilitate than fight cronyism.

zh: 不仅如此，卡扎菲的继任者不仅没有消灭、反而全盘继承了卡扎菲高度政治化的司法体制 — — 比方说由革命委员会管辖的独立法院，有权不经正当程序对任何利比亚人进行审理。
en: Moreover, instead of eliminating Qaddafi’s highly politicized judicial system – for example, separate courts, administered by the revolutionary committees, could try any Libyan without due process – his successors have embraced it.

zh: 2012年，联合国一份报告显示约8,000名与冲突有关的被拘留者绝大多数不属于国家的管辖范围。
en: In 2012, a United Nations report revealed that “the vast majority” of an estimated 8,000 conflict-related detainees were being held outside of the state’s purview.

zh: 民兵利用上述体系迫使检察官签发逮捕令。
en: Militias have taken advantage of this system to strong-arm prosecutors into issuing arrest warrants.

zh: 驻扎在津坦市的民兵依然拒绝将卡扎菲的儿子赛义夫·伊斯兰移交给中央政府。
en: And militias based in the city of Zintan continue to refuse to hand over Qaddafi’s son, Saif al-Islam, to the central authorities.

zh: 最后，卡扎菲执政时期曾流行的腐败依然流行，政府官员依然在签订合同时收受贿赂。
en: Finally, the corruption that was endemic in Qaddafi’s regime endures, with ministry officials accepting bribes, for example, in exchange for contracts.

zh: 推翻卡扎菲的民兵组织收取赎金释放囚犯。
en: For their part, the militias that overthrew Qaddafi have released prisoners in exchange for ransom payments.

zh: 如果想走出目前的困境，利比亚领导人就必须改变卡扎菲留下的治理结构，建设以法治为基础的公平可信的治理系统。
en: If Libya is to escape its current predicament, its leaders must transform the governance structures that Qaddafi built to create a fair and credible system based on the rule of law.

zh: 这首先需要以西方为榜样增强机构实力并实现其现代化。
en: That requires, first and foremost, efforts to strengthen and modernize institutions, guided by Western examples.

zh: 与此同时，利比亚领导人也必须挖掘和借鉴卡扎菲主义有限的积极因素。
en: At the same time, Libya’s leaders must recognize and build upon the few positive aspects of Qaddafism.

zh: 首先，卡扎菲成功实现了自公元前七世纪希腊入侵以来一直处于分裂状态的国家的统一，统一与大片地中海盆地相连的狭长沿海地带和孤立腹地的丰功伟绩就连墨索里尼的残暴政权都没有做到。
en: For starters, Qaddafi managed to unify a country that, since the Greek invasion in the seventh century BC, had been divided between a coastal strip linked to the larger Mediterranean basin and an isolated hinterland that even Benito Mussolini’s brutal regime could not secure.

zh: 卡扎菲借此有意无意地迈出了建设现代化民族国家的第一步。
en: Qaddafi thus took the first step – intentional or not – toward creating a modern nation-state.

zh: 现在要做的是弥合民众间存在的分歧 — — 这在像利比亚这样一个以少数民族和隐居部落为主要人口的地广人稀的国家并不容易做到。
en: The challenge now is to overcome the divisions that remain within the population – no easy task in a vast country with a sparsely inhabited interior populated mostly by ethnic minorities and reclusive tribes.

zh: 但卡扎菲传统最重要的积极因素是妇女的部分解放。
en: The most important positive component of Qaddafi’s legacy, however, was the partial emancipation of women.

zh: 身为设法动员所有民众的现代化主义者，卡扎菲通过实行扩大女童教育、赋���女性离婚权及任命女性法官部长等举措推动女性的社会及经济融入。
en: As a modernizer seeking to mobilize his entire population, Qaddafi promoted women’s social and economic inclusion by expanding education for girls, granting women the right to divorce, and appointing female judges and ministers.

zh: 虽然卡扎菲的女保镖被当作他古怪的证据而备受嘲笑，但她们却在事实上代表了他解放妇女的意愿。
en: Though Qaddafi’s female guards were mocked as the trappings of his eccentricity, they actually represented his desire to liberate women.

zh: 卡扎菲的接班人在这个问题上也没有处理好。
en: Here, too, Qaddafi’s successors have failed.

zh: 比方说早在2012年，临时政府领导人穆斯塔法·阿卜杜勒-贾利勒就宣布了取消限制反对一夫多妻制的意向。
en: Back in 2012, for example, the head of the interim government, Mustafa Abdel-Jalil, declared his intention to lift restrictions against polygamy.

zh: 后来，他却仅仅因为国民议会权力移交仪式主持人Sarah Elmesallati没有戴头巾而命令她在讲话讲到一半时中途离场。
en: Later, he ordered Sarah Elmesallati, the host of the ceremony at which power was transferred to the GNC, to leave the stage halfway through her presentation because she was not wearing a headscarf.

zh: 普通利比亚人同样主张对女性进行束缚。
en: Ordinary Libyans have also advocated keeping women on a short leash.

zh: 一名大学年纪的利比亚女性的父亲最近仅仅因为自己不能陪女儿出国，就剥夺了她接受美国国务院奖学金参加在华盛顿举办的培训班的机会。
en: A college-age Libyan woman’s father recently denied her the opportunity to accept a scholarship from the US State Department to attend a training workshop in Washington, DC, because he could not accompany her overseas.

zh: 利比亚领导人及其西方赞助者别无选择，只能思考卡扎菲传统对公众态度和官方行为有何种影响。
en: Libya’s leaders – and their Western benefactors – have no choice but to consider and address the effects of Qaddafi’s legacy on public attitudes and official behavior.

zh: 但他们也必须承认虽然卡扎菲的追求有些变态，但只有实现利比亚国家和社会的现代化才能确保国家生存下去。
en: But they must also accept that only modernization of Libya’s state and society – the agenda that Qaddafi pursued, albeit in a perverted form – will ensure the country’s survival.

zh: 移民是福是祸
en: Barbarians or Geniuses at the Gate?

zh: 慕尼黑 - - 欧洲东西部之间正在进行一场巨大的人口迁徙。
en: MUNICH – Europe is currently experiencing a huge wave of migration between its east and west.

zh: 这一人口移动足以与四世纪和六世纪间席卷欧洲的大迁徙相比。
en: This movement resembles the Great Migrations (Völkerwanderung) that marked Europe between the fourth to sixth centuries.

zh: 例如，2007年1月1日罗马尼亚加入欧盟后一年之内，大约一百万罗马尼亚人迁移到了意大利和西班牙。
en: Within the first year of Romania’s accession to the EU on January 1, 2007, for example, roughly a million Romanians migrated to Italy and Spain.

zh: 在过去四年多的时间里，八十多万东欧人在英国工作，他们大多数来自波兰。
en: More than 800,000 East Europeans have become workers in the United Kingdom over the past four years, most coming from Poland.

zh: 实际上，仅仅在过去两年中，一百五十万波兰人迁移外国。 自从波兰在2004年加入欧盟以来总共大约有两百万人移居国外。
en: Indeed, in the last two years alone, 1.5 million Poles emigrated, and overall probably more than two million have done so since Poland’s EU accession in 2004.

zh: 在比较小的程度内，乌克兰人移居到捷克，保加利亚人移居到土耳其，而英国人移居到西班牙这些现象也是引人瞩目的。
en: On a smaller scale, the migration of Ukrainians to the Czech Republic, Bulgarians to Turkey, and British citizens to Spain is also noteworthy.

zh: 由于德国依旧限制东欧欧盟国家的养靠工人移民，其大多数移民都是自雇人士或者没有什么经济能力的人。
en: Because Germany still restricts the immigration of dependent workers from eastern EU countries, most of its immigrants come as self-employed or economically inactive people.

zh: 在慕尼黑，自雇的瓦盖工人从2004年的119人增加到2005年的970人，这正好是首批欧盟东扩的头两年。
en: In Munich, the number of self-employed tilers increased in 2004 and 2005, the first two years after the first eastern enlargement wave, from 119 to 970.

zh: 但是尽管有限制，到了2005年，德国已经吸收了欧盟东扩前后来自东欧的所有移民的35 % ， 而意大利吸纳22 % ， 希腊11 % ， 瑞士8 % ， 而英国只有3 % 。
en: But despite restrictions, by 2005 Germany had absorbed 37% of all migrants from Eastern Europe that came before and after eastern EU enlargement, whereas Italy had absorbed 22%, Greece 11%, Switzerland 8%, and the UK only 3%.

zh: 同年，居住在德国的人口中的13%是在外国出生，超过英国的10 % ， 法国的7 % ， 西班牙的5%或者意大利的3 % 。
en: In the same year, 13% of the population living in Germany was foreign born, more than in Britain (10%), France (7%), Spain (5%), or Italy (3%).

zh: 过去两年前往英国、西班牙以及意大利的移民潮应当大幅度改变这些数据，但是更新统计数字的信息还不具备。
en: The immigration waves of the last two years to Britain, Spain, and Italy will have significantly changed these figures, but the information needed to update the statistics is not yet available.

zh: 现今，人们移动的速度要超过统计人员的工作速度。
en: Nowadays, people move faster than statistical offices can count them.

zh: 在欧盟东扩以前，许多研究都预计到了可能随之而来的移民潮。
en: Before the EU’s eastern enlargement, many studies predicted the likely migration waves.

zh: 预计在15年内东欧人移民到西欧的比例是2.5%到6 % 。
en: The forecasts of the proportion of East Europeans who were expected to move west within a 15 years ranged from 2.5% to 6%.

zh: 尽管吸纳移民主要国家采取限制移民措施，但是鉴于在仅仅4年之内波兰移民人口就达到大约5 % ， 因此这些估计过于谨慎。
en: Given that about 5% of the Polish population has now emigrated within a period of only four years, despite immigration restrictions by important target countries, these estimates were much too cautious.

zh: 欧盟东扩前，谈论可能涌向西欧的移民潮在政治上是错误的，因为欧盟的政治人物认为这是对欧盟扩大进程的阻碍。
en: Before enlargement, it was politically incorrect to discuss possible waves of migration to the West, as EU politicians saw this as an obstacle to the enlargement process.

zh: 现在东扩已经实现，客观地讨论移民问题就容易一点了。
en: Now that enlargement has taken place, it is easier to discuss migration objectively.

zh: 尽管规模相当，但是意大利人把过去的大迁徙称为野蛮人入侵。
en: This immigration is not an invasioni barbariche, as Italians refer to the Völkerwanderung, although the orders of magnitude are comparable.

zh: 由于移民在不同的市场之间移动并且拥有明确的产权，因此在原则上，移民现象对于移民本身以及接纳移民的国家都是有益的。
en: As migrants move between markets with well-defined property rights, immigration in principle is beneficial for both the immigrants and the target country.

zh: 移民要比在原籍国家得到更高的工资，接纳国家则从便宜的劳力获益，这样创造的价值就大于成本。
en: The immigrant receives a higher wage than at home, and the target country benefits from cheap labor, which creates more value than it costs.

zh: 但是实际上，移民并非如此有益，因为接收国家的工资体系僵硬，阻碍了创造让移民就业所需要的工作机会。
en: But in practice, immigration is often not as beneficial as it could be, because the target country has a rigid wage structure that prevents the additional jobs needed to employ the immigrants from being created.

zh: 比如，如果某一接收国家提供最低工资保障以及国内失业者的安置收入，移民就会迫使国内居民领取国家福利。
en: If, for example, a target country provides minimum wage guarantees and replacement incomes for the domestic unemployed, immigrants simply force domestic residents into the care of the welfare state.

zh: 这并非是移民本身的问题，而是国内社会和劳动力市场机构不合理造成的。
en: This is not a problem of immigration as such, but of poorly designed domestic social and labor market institutions.

zh: 为了保险起见，接收国家经常试图把移民限制在具有一技之长的工人上，因为他们加入到劳动力市场部分之中，而这些部分中足够的压低工资灵活度给移民提供了额外的就业机会。
en: To be on the safe side, host countries often try to limit immigration to skilled workers, because they join segments of the labor market in which sufficient downward wage flexibility provides immigrants with additional jobs.

zh: 但是各国目前在吸引具有技能的移民上成效不一。
en: But countries have so far had mixed success in attracting skilled immigrants.

zh: 这一方面最为成功的都是盎格鲁撒克逊国家(按照顺序是加拿大、���尔兰、澳大利亚、美国以及英国 ) ， 还有丹麦和挪威。
en: The most successful countries in this regard have been the Anglo-Saxon countries (Canada, Ireland, Australia, the United States, and the UK, in that order), as well as Denmark and Norway.

zh: 这些国家的移民中超过三分之一的具有大学教育水平，加拿大和爱尔兰达到45 % 。
en: More than one-third of immigrants to these countries have tertiary education, with Canada and Ireland at 45%.

zh: 在那些并不十分成功的国家中，也就是意大利、奥地利、德国、法国、葡萄牙和荷兰，具有大学教育水平的移民比例低于25 % 。
en: In the more unsuccessful countries – Italy, Austria, Germany, France, Portugal, and the Netherlands – the proportion of immigrants with a tertiary education is below a quarter.

zh: 在意大利，这一比例只有11 % ， 是所有统计中最低的。
en: In Italy, the share is just 11% – the lowest in the available statistics.

zh: 流向盎格鲁萨克斯国家、特别是美国的人材令人惊讶。
en: The brain drain to the Anglo-Saxon countries, the US in particular, is astounding.

zh: 美国顶尖大学毕业生中充满了外国学生，如今在美国行医的医生中有27%来自外国。
en: The graduating classes of top American universities are packed with foreign students, and 27% of physicians practicing in the US today come from abroad.

zh: 美国战后的增长和活力大多数来自具有一技之长的移民。
en: America’s postwar growth and dynamism largely resulted from skilled immigrants.

zh: 在第二次世界大战前后，许多有一技之长的人来自欧洲，特别是德国。 在最近几十年中，亚洲统领移民，以印度、巴基斯坦以及菲律宾居多。
en: Before and after World War II, many skilled people came from Europe, Germany in particular; in recent decades, Asian immigrants dominate, with India, Pakistan, and the Philippines occupying the top ranks.

zh: 如今的人材外流并不仅仅是从新兴和发展中国家流向富裕国家，而且也从欧洲流向美国。
en: Today’s brain drain is not only from emerging and developing countries to richer countries, but also from European countries to the US.

zh: 在大多数研究领域中，欧洲出生的“超级明星”们在美国工作和教书，而不是在欧洲。 吉列圣保罗的研究表明，正是那些超级明星为国家创造经济增长和繁荣。
en: In most research disciplines, European-born “superstars” work and teach in the US rather than in Europe, and, according to a study by Gilles Saint-Paul, it is the superstars in particular who generate growth and prosperity for a country.

zh: 当然，拥有体面大学教育水平的人对于国家的经济也很重要。 在这一点上，某些欧洲国家的损失很严重。
en: Of course, people with a decent tertiary education are also important for a country’s economy, and here the loss of some European countries is substantial.

zh: 西班牙和法国拥有大学教育水平的人分别只有3%和4%居住在国外，意大利和德国分别是7%以及9 % 。
en: While only 3% of Spanish and 4% of French people with tertiary education live abroad, 7% of Italians and 9% of Germans do.

zh: 令人惊讶的是，爱尔兰和英国在这一点上居于领先地位，分别是34%和17 % 。
en: Surprisingly, Ireland and the UK lead in this category, with 34% and 17%, respectively.

zh: 这可能反映了盎格鲁撒克逊国家之间高度相互交流，或者国内具有技能人士移民前往其他盎格鲁萨克斯国家，而其他地方有一技之长的人又过来填充。
en: This may reflect the high interchange in both directions between the Anglo-Saxon countries, or replacement migration in which skilled people arrive from elsewhere as the domestic skilled migrate to other Anglo-Saxon countries.

zh: 正如史上的大迁移时期一样，欧洲的景观在本世纪内将会快速变化。
en: The European landscape will change as rapidly in the course of this century as it did at the time of the Völkerwanderung.

zh: 历史将会留下许多故事来讲述这对欧洲大陆意味着什么。
en: History will have many tales to tell about what this really meant for the Continent.

zh: 但是目前，不经意的观察人士还是不得其所。
en: At the moment, though, the casual observer is still rather clueless.

zh: 桶、蒲式耳和债券
en: Barrels, Bushels, and Bonds

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 碳氢化合物、原材料和农业商品的价格真称得上是大起大落。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The prices of hydrocarbons, minerals, and agricultural commodities have been on a veritable roller coaster.

zh: 商品价格总是比制成品和服务价格波动更大，但过去五年的商品市场波动性之巨颇为反常，可谓前所未有。
en: While commodity prices are always more variable than those for manufactured goods and services, commodity markets over the last five years have seen extraordinary, almost unprecedented, volatility.

zh: 专门从事原油、铜、铁矿石、小麦、咖啡和其他商品出口的国家获得了繁荣，但它们经不起折腾。
en: Countries that specialize in the export of oil, copper, iron ore, wheat, coffee, or other commodities have been booming, but they are highly vulnerable.

zh: 美元商品价格随时随地都可能因新衰退到来、美国真实利率上升、气候波动和随机部门因素而崩溃。
