en: Dollar commodity prices could plunge at any time, as a result of a new recession, an increase in real interest rates in the United States, fluctuations in climate, or random sector-specific factors.

zh: 有着未了结美元或其他外币债务的国家尤其脆弱。
en: Countries that have outstanding debt in dollars or other foreign currencies are especially vulnerable.

zh: 如果它们的出口收入相对于债务维持成本发生崩溃，结果将是重演1982年的拉美悲剧或1997—1998年的亚洲和俄罗斯货币危机。
en: If their export revenues were to plunge relative to their debt-service obligations, the result could be crises reminiscent of Latin America’s in 1982 or the Asian and Russian currency crises of 1997-1998.

zh: 20世纪90年代以来，许多发展中国家在将美元债务转换为外国直接投资和其他形式的资本流入或削减总债务方面取得了相当的进展。
en: Many developing countries have made progress since the 1990’s in shifting from dollar-denominated debt toward foreign direct investment and other types of capital inflows, or in paying down their liabilities altogether.

zh: 但一些商品出口国仍在寻求不会让它们陷入过度风险的借款方式。
en: But some commodity exporters still seek ways to borrow that won’t expose them to excessive risk.

zh: 商品债券可以提供绕过这些风险的好办法。
en: Commodity bonds may offer a neat way to circumvent these risks.

zh: 无论哪种商品，其出口国都可以发行以商品价格计价（而不是以美元或其他货币计价）的债务。
en: Exporters of any particular commodity should issue debt that is denominated in terms of the price of that commodity, rather than in dollars or any other currency.

zh: 比如，牙买加可以发行铝债券；尼日利亚可以发行石油债券；塞拉利昂可以发行铁矿石债券；蒙古可以发行铜债券。
en: Jamaica, for example, would issue aluminum bonds; Nigeria would issue oil bonds; Sierra Leone would issue iron-ore bonds; and Mongolia would issue copper bonds.

zh: 投资者可以购买危地马拉的咖啡债券、科特迪瓦的可可债券、利比里亚的橡胶债券、马里的棉花债券和加纳的黄金债券。
en: Investors would be able to buy Guatemala’s coffee bonds, Côte d’Ivoire’s cocoa bonds, Liberia’s rubber bonds, Mali’s cotton bonds, and Ghana’s gold bonds.

zh: 这些债券的好处在于，当基础商品的世界价格下跌时，债务-出口比率不一定会上升。
en: The advantage of such bonds is that in the event of a decline in the world price of the underlying commodity, the debt-to-export ratio need not rise.

zh: 债务维持成本可以自动调整而不会因失去信心、爆发危机和债务重组之类的事情产生重大后果。
en: The cost of debt service adjusts automatically, without the severe disruption that results from loss of confidence, crisis, debt restructuring, and so forth.

zh: 这并非新思想。
en: The idea is not new.

zh: 但为什么以前没有尝试呢？
en: So, why has it not been tried before?

zh: 当你问及商品出口债务国财政部长时，他们总是会回答，他们担心商品债券需求不够。
en: When one asks finance ministers in commodity-exporting debtor countries, they frequently reply that they fear insufficient demand for commodity bonds.

zh: 这个答案颇令人吃惊，因为商品债券显然拥有潜在市场，这是由实体经济基础决定的。
en: That is a surprising proposition, given that commodity bonds have an obvious latent market, rooted in real economic fundamentals.

zh: 说到底，钢铁公司天生需要对冲铁矿石价格的波动，而航空公司和公用事业公司天生需要对冲石油价格的波动。
en: After all, steel companies have an inherent need to hedge against fluctuations in the price of iron ore, just as airlines and utilities have an inherent need to hedge against fluctuations in the price of oil.

zh: 对大公司来说，所有商品都是重要的投入品。
en: Each of these commodities is an important input for major corporations.

zh: 毫无疑问，商品债券的天然需求绝不会亚于信用违约互换以及某些目前正在交易的奇特复杂的衍生品！
en: Surely there is at least as much natural demand for commodity bonds as there is for credit-default swaps and some of the bizarrely complicated derivatives that are currently traded!

zh: 流动性是市场成功必不可少的要素，一个市场要成功，就必须超过某个临界规模。
en: It takes liquidity to make a market successful, and it can be difficult to get a new one started until it achieves a certain critical mass.

zh: 问题可能在于，愿意同时持有原油和尼日利亚信用风险多头头寸的投资者不够多。
en: The problem may be that there are not many investors who want to take a long position on oil and Nigerian credit risk simultaneously.

zh: 世界银行等多边机构可以在打造商品债券市场方面起到关键作用。
en: A multilateral agency such as the World Bank could play a critical role in launching a market in commodity bonds.

zh: 那些已成为世界银行借款国的国家所出产的商品可以作为基础商品的合适候选。
en: The fit would be particularly good in those countries where the Bank is already lending money.

zh: 可以如此操作。
en: Here is how it would work.

zh: 世界银行不向尼日利亚发放美元贷款，而是用石油价格来为贷款标价，同时发行相同数量用石油计价的债券，以此消除世界石油价格波动的风险。
en: Instead of denominating a loan to Nigeria in terms of dollars, the Bank would denominate it in terms of the price of oil and lay off its exposure to the world oil price by issuing that same quantity of bonds denominated in oil.

zh: 如果世界银行向多个石油出口国发放贷款，它就能造成一个规模甚大、流动性甚好的石油债券市场。
en: If the Bank lends to multiple oil-exporting countries, the market for oil bonds that it creates would be that much larger and more liquid.

zh: 有的商品（比如石油和咖啡）具有多种级别和种类，价格可能会趋异，从而造成出口国之间的重大差异。 对于这样的商品，这一汇集功能就显得尤其重要了。
en: This pooling function would be particularly important in cases where there are different grades or varieties of the product (as with oil or coffee), and where prices can diverge enough to make an important difference to the exporters.

zh: 对于某些商品出口国来说，替代方案是通过在期货市场上卖出来对冲风险。
en: An alternative for some commodity exporters is to hedge their risk by selling on the futures market.

zh: 但衍生品有个重大缺陷：它们的存在期限太短了。
en: But an important disadvantage of derivatives is their short maturity.

zh: 发现了新石油储量的西非国家需要为开采、钻进和管道建设融资，这意味着它的对冲期长达10—20年，而不是区区90天。
en: A West African country with newly discovered oil reserves needs to finance exploration, drilling, and pipeline construction, which means that it needs to hedge at a time horizon of 10-20 years, not 90 days.

zh: 衍生品的另一大劣势是其操作需要高超的技术和政治技巧。
en: Another disadvantage of derivatives is that they require a high degree of sophistication –both technical and political.

zh: 如果商品价格上涨，在利用期货市场进行出口价格对冲方面做得很好的财政部长会猛然发现自己正在受千夫所指，说他败光了国家财产。
en: In the event of an increase in a commodity’s price, a finance minister who has done a perfect job of hedging export-price risk on the futures market will suddenly find himself accused of having gambled away the national patrimony.

zh: 这一委托-代理问题可以通过商品债券得到彻底解决。
en: This principal-agent problem is much diminished in the case of commodity bonds.

zh: 如果国际金融天才们能够团结起来马上将这一思想付诸实践，商品出口国就能在其商品的全球价格出现又一次崩盘时免于陷入灾难。
en: If the international financial wizards can get together and act on this idea now, commodity exporters might be able to avoid calamity the next time the world price of their product takes a plunge.

zh: 世界银行应该承担起责任来。
en: The World Bank should take up the cause.

zh: 抛弃巴罗索吗？
en: Barroso Overboard?

zh: 布鲁塞尔 - - 现在巴罗索应该推销自己了。
en: BRUSSELS – It is time for José Manuel Barroso to start selling himself.

zh: 他能否再度被任命为欧盟委员会主席取决于他所提供的理由。
en: His chances of being re-appointed as President of the European Commission depend on the case he makes.

zh: 在全球金融危机爆发以前，巴罗索看起来很有可能得到第二个五年任期。
en: Until the global financial crisis broke, Barroso looked fairly certain to get a second five-year term.

zh: 现在越发难以找到支持他的外交官或者决策者了。
en: Now, it is becoming increasingly hard to find diplomats or policymakers who support him.

zh: 法国总统萨尔科奇据说对巴罗索在去年秋天金融系统崩溃中的表现感到失望，而德国总理默克尔也对他的前途开始沉默了。
en: French President Nicolas Sarkozy is said to have been disappointed by Barroso’s performance during last autumn's financial meltdown, and German Chancellor Angela Merkel also seems to have fallen silent on the matter of his future.

zh: 没有人怀疑巴罗索处在一个尴尬的境地。
en: No one doubts that Barroso is in an awkward position.

zh: 欧盟委员会自己没有什么权力在衰退席卷欧盟的时候进行应对，大多数权力属于欧洲中央银行。
en: The European Commission has few powers of its own with which to confront the recession as it spreads throughout the European Union; most powers belong to the European Central Bank.

zh: 但是委员会确实可以发出声音来团结民众，而正式由于它默不作声才使得巴罗索及其委员们受到批评。
en: But the Commission does have a voice with which to rally people, and it is for their silence that Barroso and his fellow commissioners are being rebuked.

zh: 在这一不断深化的经济不景气背景下，欧盟委员会被人视为缺乏领导能力仅仅是冰山的一角。
en: The perceived lack of leadership from the Commission at this time of deepening economic gloom is just the tip of the iceberg.

zh: 最近几个月来的事件表明了更多深刻的担忧。
en: The events of recent months have crystallized more deep-seated concerns.

zh: 当葡萄牙前总理巴罗索被各国首脑推举为主席的时候，他好像是一个充满动力的扫把，要清除他的前任、意大利普罗迪遗留下来的烂摊子。
en: When Barroso, the former Portuguese prime minister, was awarded the EU post by his fellow heads of government, he appeared to be a dynamic new broom who would sweep away the cobwebs left by his predecessor, Italy’s Romano Prodi.

zh: 但是随着时间的推移，巴罗索领导的欧盟委员会由于缺乏勇气和魄力而受到指责。
en: But, with the passage of time, the Barroso-led Commission has also come under fire for being unadventurous and lacklustre.

zh: 即使在衰退的阴云开始聚集之前，欧洲怀疑派就在上升，而欧盟委员会被人指责未能贴近群众。
en: Even before the clouds of recession began to gather, Euroskepticism was on the rise, with the Commission blamed, rightly or wrongly, for the EU’s failure “to reach out to the citizen.”

zh: 欧盟委员会主席是世界上最难当的。
en: The job of Commission President is arguably among the most difficult in the world.

zh: 由于欧洲议会地位的上升以及欧盟各国政府在巩固自身作为欧盟实际立法者权力并且削弱委员会势力，欧盟委员会几乎以难以察觉地衰落已经将近二十年了。
en: The institution has been in near-imperceptible decline for almost 20 years, thanks to the rise of the European Parliament and the way EU member governments have whittled away its authority while consolidating their own powers as the EU’s true legislators.

zh: 然而委员会主席却被要求成为欧洲积极有力的公共形象。
en: Yet the head of the Commission is called upon to be the dynamic public face of Europe.

zh: 委员会自身谨小慎微和官僚的内部文化也是一种限制，布鲁塞尔没有人愿意多谈。
en: The Commission’s own internal culture of cautiousness and red tape is a constraint that nobody in Brussels much likes to talk about.

zh: 这一结构并不有利于政治成就，而且委员会的大多数工作就是没完没了的制定欧盟法规以及重新制定法规。
en: It is not a structure that is conducive to political coups de theâtre , and most of the Commission’s work is the relentless grind of EU regulation and re-regulation.

zh: 但是基本问题就是，当每个人都在问“欧洲在忙些什么”的时候，委员会的反应似乎不够。
en: But the bottom line is that at a time when everyone is asking, “What is Europe doing?”, the Commission’s responses have seemed inadequate.

zh: 由于并不明显的原因，委员会主席必须从现任或者前任总理之中产生，这已经成为不定之规。
en: For reasons that are now obscure, there is an unwritten rule that Commission presidents must be drawn from the ranks of past or current prime ministers.

zh: 这也是巴罗索很有希望获得第二个任期的原因。
en: This has in large part accounted for Barroso’s high hopes of getting a second term.

zh: 好像没有其他可靠的候选人对他提出挑战。
en: There was, it appeared, no other credible candidate to challenge him.

zh: 在巴罗索自己这方面，他好像在2008年避免了争议，从而不冒犯任何一个国家政府以便不阻挠他的连任。
en: For his part, Barroso is widely seen as having avoided controversy throughout 2008 in order not to risk offending any governments that might have been inclined to block his reappointment.

zh: 这一看似不思进取现在成了他最大的问题。
en: That seeming passivity is now his greatest problem.

zh: 2008年法国担任欧盟的轮值主席表明，充满动力的领导是欧洲公众所广泛欣赏的素质。
en: France’s presidency of the EU during the second half of 2008 showed that dynamic leadership is a quality widely appreciated by the European public.

zh: 萨尔科奇具有作秀意识，在八月份处理俄国和格鲁吉亚危机以及欧盟应付随后在秋天银行接二连三的倒闭危机中几乎毫不费力地压过了巴罗索。
en: With his sense of showmanship, Sarkozy almost effortlessly eclipsed Barroso when handling the Russia-Georgia crisis in August, followed by the EU’s responses to the autumn crisis of cascading bank collapses.

zh: 欧盟委员会靠边站了。
en: The Commission was left on the sidelines.

zh: 需要做什么工作呢？
en: What is to be done?

zh: 法国成功地担任欧盟主席国加剧了对欧盟委员会及其主席有效性的怀疑，以至于甚至在巴黎人们表达出担忧，也就是布鲁塞尔的这一行政机关必须予以加强，否则将会沦为一个秘书处而已。
en: France’s successful presidency has intensified doubts about the effectiveness of the Commission and its president, so much so that even in Paris concerns are being voiced that the Brussels executive must somehow be strengthened if it is not to become a mere secretariat.

zh: 欧盟各国政府一直想要一个圆滑的委员会，但是现在的代价就是保护欧盟不受民族摩擦的“共同体方式”的灭亡。
en: EU governments have wanted a pliable Commission, but now the cost could be the death of the “community method” that protects the EU against national frictions.

zh: 巴罗索需要对这些怀疑做出反应。
en: Barroso needs to respond to all these doubts.

zh: 如果他要向欧盟各国领导人保证他们应该重新任命他的话，那么他就需要表明他的第二个任期会给人以新的希望。
en: If he is to reassure EU national leaders that they should re-appoint him, then he needs to signal that his second term can hold out fresh promise.

zh: 他善于做出激动人心的演说，但是这还不够。
en: He is good at giving upbeat speeches, but this will not be enough.

zh: 还需要有某种计划。
en: Some sort of plan is needed.

zh: 当巴罗索在2004年上任的时候，人们一再询问他是否对欧洲未来有雄伟规划。
en: When he arrived in Brussels in 2004, Barroso was repeatedly asked whether he had a “big idea” for Europe’s future.

zh: 那时候，他不需要有人感到失望。
en: Back then, he did not need one to be appointed.

zh: 这一次，如果他还想要保住职位的话���他就要讲出来。
en: This time, he must produce one if he is to save his skin.

zh: 重组债务重组
en: Restructuring Debt Restructuring

zh: 伯克利—有时，坏心也能办成好事。
en: BERKELEY – Sometimes the worst intentions yield the best results.

zh: 阿根廷债务问题就出人意料地产生了这样的结果。
en: So it is, unexpectedly, with Argentine debt.

zh: 故事从2001—2002年阿根廷金融危机开始。
en: The story begins with Argentina’s financial crisis in 2001-2002.

zh: 毫无疑问，这场危机导致阿根廷无力偿还债务。
en: There is no question that the crisis left the country unable to service its debts.

zh: 但阿根廷花了四年时间与债权人谈判，并提出了比不上此前债务重组标准的和解条件，结果以失败告终。
en: But Argentina made no friends by waiting four years to negotiate with its creditors and then offering settlement terms that were stingy by the standards of previous debt restructurings.

zh: 不过，对于绝大部分阿根廷债券人来说，条件是可以接受的，他们可以打三折后将旧债券换成新债券。
en: Still, the terms were acceptable to the vast majority of the country’s creditors, who exchanged their old claims for new ones worth 30 cents on the dollar.

zh: 所有债权人都接受了这一条件，除了一小撮顽固派 — — 他们廉价收购剩余债券，然后诉诸法庭要求足额偿付，美国纽约南区地方法院受理了此案。
en: All, that is, except for a few holdouts who bought up the remaining bonds on the cheap and went to court, specifically to the US District Court of the Southern District of New York, asking to be paid in full.

zh: 这一异想天开的战略取得了出人意料的成功，联邦法官托马斯·葛里萨（Thomas Griesa）做出了有利于顽固派的裁决。
en: This quixotic strategy met with unexpected success when Federal Judge Thomas Griesa ruled in the holdouts’ favor.

zh: 葛里萨对债务合同中的“平等对待”条款做出了独特的解释，认为这意味着拒绝参与早先的债务转换的“兀鹫”基金不应该获得三折偿付，而应该获得足额偿付。
en: Griesa idiosyncratically reinterpreted the pari passu, or equal treatment, clause in the debt contracts to mean that “vulture” funds refusing to participate in the earlier debt exchange should receive not 30 but 100 cents on the dollar.

zh: 葛里萨的裁决意味着，如果阿根廷政府代理人纽约梅隆银行（Bank of New York Mellon）偿还其他债券持有者而不偿还兀鹫基金，就要承担藐视法庭的责任。
en: Griesa’s ruling threatened to hold the Bank of New York Mellon, the Argentine government’s agent, in contempt if it paid other bondholders without also paying the vultures.

zh: 事实上，阿根廷已被禁止按谈成条件偿付债务，除了再次违约之外基本别无选择。
en: Effectively barred from servicing its debt on the renegotiated terms, Argentina had little choice but to default again.

zh: 这绝不是皆大欢喜的结局。
en: This was not an episode from which anyone emerged smelling like a rose.

zh: 阿根廷的强硬策略和摇摆政策使它在投资者中间相当不受欢迎。
en: Argentina’s hardball tactics and erratic policies did not endear it to investors.

zh: 兀鹫投资者对于牺牲阿根廷纳税人为自己谋取利润的做法毫无愧色。
en: The vultures showed no scruples in profiting at the expense of Argentine taxpayers.

zh: 如今他们正在对世界上最贫穷的国家之一 — — 刚果民主共和国故技重施。
en: They are now deploying the same strategy against the Democratic Republic of the Congo, one of the world’s poorest countries.

zh: 至于葛里萨，他对于颠覆金融秩序也没有感到丝毫愧疚。 在旧金融秩序中，基于市场的旧债券换新债券常被用于重组无力偿债的国家的债务。
en: Griesa, for his part, showed no compunction about upending a financial order in which market-based exchanges of old bonds for new ones are used to restructure the debts of countries unable to pay.

zh: 葛里萨让主权债务人无从进行重组，事实上也断绝了它们在美国融资的门路。
en: By making it impossible for sovereigns to restructure, he effectively rendered them unable to borrow in the United States.

zh: 他无视先例和一切经济常识，让国际金融市场陷入了混乱。
en: Ignoring previous precedent and all economic common sense, he threw international financial markets into turmoil.

zh: 这促使产生了大量改革主权债务市场的建议。
en: This prompted various suggestions for reforming sovereign-debt markets.

zh: 一些专家重新提出了上一次阿根廷为月时所出现的观点，建议在IMF成立国际破产法庭。
en: Resuscitating ideas advanced in the wake of Argentina’s earlier default, some experts proposed creating an international bankruptcy court in the IMF.

zh: 也有人建议阿根廷根据欧洲法律（甚至本国法律）发行债券。
en: Others suggested that Argentina might issue bonds under European – or even domestic – law.

zh: 但是，经验表明，债券持有人不会把他们所拥有的债券的命运交给未经检验的国际破产法庭。
en: But experience has shown that bondholders are not inclined to subordinate their claims to some untested international bankruptcy court.

zh: 要说还有什么让他们更加讨厌的话，那么只有法庭可以像操纵阿根廷债务一样容易地强制执行的债务了。
en: The only thing they would like less are obligations whose terms were enforced by courts as easy to manipulate as Argentina’s.

zh: 至于以欧洲货币借钱，葛里萨迅速宣布他的裁决亦可覆盖这类债券。
en: As for borrowing in European currencies, Griesa was quick to declare that his rulings would cover such bonds as well.

zh: 幸运的是，对于这些问题有一个简单的解决办法。
en: Fortunately, there is a simple solution to these problems.

zh: 投资者可以形成协议，在债权合同中加入兀鹫基金难以钻空子的条款。
en: Investors could agree to insert language into bond contracts that leaves no room for vulture funds.

zh: 首先，他们可以阐明平等对待条款，规定其用来保证现有债券持有人之间的可比对待，而不适用于现有债券持有人和债权已经消灭了的前债券持有人之间。
en: First, they could clarify the pari passu clause, specifying that it guaranteed comparable treatment for existing bondholders, not for existing bondholders and earlier bondholders whose claims were already extinguished.

zh: 其次，发���人可以增加“总数条款 ” ， 规定有足够多数的某国债券持有人（比如三分之二）支持，就可以形成可约束所有债券持有人的协议。
en: Second, issuers could add “aggregation clauses” specifying that an agreement supported by a qualified majority of a country’s bondholders, say, two-thirds, would bind one and all.

zh: 在阿根廷上一次违约后，已经有人行动起来增加“集体行动条款 ” — —允许某次债券发行的持有人发起具法律约束力的投票以接受重组计划。
en: There was already movement after Argentina’s earlier default to add “collective-action clauses” that allowed the holders of an individual bond issue to take a binding vote to accept a restructuring offer.

zh: 但兀鹫基金仍可以通过买入某次债券发行的三分之一存量阻止集体行动程序。
en: But this still allowed the vultures to block the process by buying up a third of a particular bond issue.

zh: 相反，买入一国总债务存量的三分之一 — — 如果所有债券持有人一起投票，就必须如此才能获得否决权 — — 的难度要大得多。
en: By contrast, purchasing a third of a country’s entire debt stock, as required for a blocking position when all bondholders vote together, is an altogether more costly proposition.

zh: 2003年，阿肖卡·莫迪（Ashoka Mody）和我在《美国经济评论 》 （ American Economic Review）发表了一篇文章，论证了这些办法。
en: In 2003, in an article in the American Economic Review, Ashoka Mody and I made the case for these provisions.

zh: 这也是由主要投资者和发行人组成的国际资本市场协会（International Capital Market Association）所同意采取的基本方针，还有一些细节在这里不必讨论。
en: They are basically what the International Capital Market Association of leading investors and issuers has now agreed to implement, subject to some additional details that need not be examined here.

zh: 为什么这来的这么晚？
en: Why didn’t it happen sooner?

zh: 答案是让投资者形成一致就像是把猫聚集成群。
en: The answer is that getting investors to agree is like herding cats.

zh: 这需要美国财政部在背后的强力领导。
en: In this case, it required strong behind-the-scenes leadership from the US Treasury.

zh: 这一协议并不完美，问题依然存在，因为新合同条款并不容易适用于旧债券，因此要花多年时间才能让所有债券存量都受这些条款约束。
en: The agreement is not perfect, and problems remain. Because new contractual provisions are not easily retrofitted into old bonds, it will take years before the clauses are included in the entire stock of debt.

zh: 建立国际破产法听是更有效的方案，但不可行。
en: Establishing an international bankruptcy court would be a far more efficient solution, but that doesn’t make it feasible.

zh: 投资者很聪明，他们知道在国际资本市场，完美是优秀的敌人。
en: Investors were wise to acknowledge that, in international capital markets, the perfect is the enemy of the good.

zh: 美元和已经造成的伤害
en: The Dollar and the Damage Done

zh: 伯克利—很多人指责美联储造成了最近的新兴市场大动荡。
en: BERKELEY – The US Federal Reserve is being widely blamed for the recent eruption of volatility in emerging markets.

zh: 但美联储是否只是随手抓到的替罪羊？
en: But is the Fed just a convenient whipping boy?

zh: 指责美联储为当今全球经济问题负责比指责中国的长期减速（反映了中国官员值得赞赏的实现经济再平衡的努力）更容易。
en: It is easier to blame the Fed for today’s global economic problems than it is to blame China’s secular slowdown, which reflects Chinese officials’ laudable efforts to rebalance their economy.

zh: 类似地，尽管日本的“安倍经济学”让日元贬值从而复杂化了邻国的决策，但也是一项为了结束长期存在通缩的值得赞赏的措施。
en: Likewise, though Japan’s “Abenomics,” by depressing the yen, complicates policymaking for the country’s neighbors, it also constitutes a commendable effort to bring deflation to a long-overdue end.

zh: 因此，同样是指责美联储更容易。
en: So, again, it is easier to blame the Fed.

zh: 此外，对受影响的新兴经济体来说，指责美联储逐渐退出其大规模月度长期资产购买计划 — — 即所谓的量化宽松（QE ） — —显然比指责它们自身没能加快经济改革更容易。
en: And, for the affected emerging economies, the Fed’s tapering of its massive monthly purchases of long-term assets – so-called quantitative easing (QE) – is certainly easier to blame than their own failure to move faster on economic reform.

zh: 尽管如此，美联储也不能说毫无责任。
en: Still, the Fed should not be absolved of all guilt.

zh: 美国利率走高的前景削弱了投资者不加甄别地投资新兴经济体的激励。
en: The prospect of higher interest rates in the US weakens the incentive for investors to pour capital into emerging economies indiscriminately.

zh: 尽管影响新兴市场的是多种因素的综合效果，但美联储的逐渐退出QE显然也是其中之一。
en: Though a confluence of factors may have combined to upset the emerging-market applecart, Fed tapering is certainly one of them.

zh: 因此，美联储并没有考虑到它的政策会对新兴市场造成影响以及新兴市场会反作用于美国，这实在令人震惊。
en: It is striking, therefore, that the Fed has made no effort to take into account the impact of its policies on emerging economies or the blowback from emerging markets on the US.

zh: 新兴市场产出了全球GDP的三分之二以上。
en: Emerging markets comprise more than a third of global GDP.

zh: 近几年来，它们贡献了三分之一以上的全球增长。
en: They have contributed considerably more than a third of global growth in recent years.

zh: 新兴市场的形势并不只关乎新兴市场，而是日益影响着美国。
en: What happens in emerging markets does not stay in emerging markets. Increasingly, what happens there has the capacity to affect the US.

zh: 然而美联储官员尽管大谈他们意欲逐渐退出QE，却从未提到这样做对新兴市场的影响。
en: Yet Fed officials, while commenting copiously about their motives for tapering QE, have said nothing about the impact of doing so on emerging markets.

zh: 没有迹象表明他们明白美国货币政策也会影响到他们这世界一隅之外的形势。
en: They have given no indication of being aware that US monetary policy can affect events outside of their narrow corner of the world.

zh: 让这一沉默更加引人注目的是华盛顿的两大最近趋势。
en: This silence is all the more remarkable in view of two other recent developments in Washington, DC.

zh: 首先，美国国会拒绝授权美国增加国际货币基金组织（IMF）份额的认购，这是政府最新预算协议的一部分。
en: First, the US Congress, as part of the government’s recent budget deal, refused to authorize an increase in America’s quota subscription to the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 这一金融承诺从根本上说只是象征性的，但却是首尔G-20领导人峰会所达成的更大的协议 — — 改变IMF的出资结构，让新兴经济体用有更大的代表权 — — 的一部分。
en: The financial commitment was essentially symbolic, but it was part of a larger agreement reached at the Seoul Summit of G-20 leaders to regularize the IMF’s resources and enhance the representation of emerging economies.

zh: 如此食言而肥不啻于揭开了旧伤疤，也引出了一个麻烦的问题，即带着深刻历史烙印的机构被一小撮发达国家主导是否合理。
en: This failure to follow through reopens old wounds and raises troubling questions about the legitimacy of an institution that, reflecting the long shadow of history, is dominated by a handful of advanced countries.

zh: 新兴市场官员越来越不愿意向IMF寻求建议和帮助，这制约了IMF扮演积极全球角色的能力。
en: Emerging-market officials have been increasingly reluctant to turn to the IMF for advice and assistance, undermining its ability to play an effective global role.

zh: 另一个发展趋势是决定将美联储、欧洲央行、以及加拿大、英国、瑞士和日本央行在金融危机期间推出的美元互换安排永久化。
en: The other development was the decision to make permanent the dollar swap arrangements put in place during the financial crisis by the Fed, the European Central Bank, and the central banks of Canada, the United Kingdom, Switzerland, and Japan.

zh: 根据这些安排，美联储时刻准备着为这一小撮外国央行提供美元 — — 间接表明了美元在国际金融市场上的独特地为。
en: Under these arrangements, the Fed stands ready to provide dollars to this handful of favored foreign central banks – an acknowledgment of the dollar’s unique role in international financial markets.

zh: 由于国际银行不管位居何处都喜欢用美元借贷，因此这些互换安排相当于让外国中央银行能够在紧急情况时向本地银行提供美元贷款。
en: Because international banks, wherever they are located, tend to borrow in dollars, the swap arrangements allow foreign central banks to lend dollars to their local banks in times of emergency.

zh: 这三件事 — — 逐渐退出QE、破坏IMF改革和美元互换安排的坐实 — — 合在一起让人看到的是美国将国际最后贷款人功能国家化了。
en: Put these three events – the tapering of QE, the torpedoing of IMF reform, and the entrenchment of dollar swaps – together and what you get is a US that has renationalized the international lender-of-last-resort function.

zh: 简言之，美联储是现存唯一的美元紧急流动性提供源。
en: Simply put, the Fed is the only emergency source of dollar liquidity still standing.

zh: 但美国只愿意向一小撮特权国家提供美元。
en: But the US has offered to provide dollars only to a privileged few.

zh: 在其政策说明和实践中，它拒绝承担保证世界经济稳定的更大的责任。
en: And in its policy statements and actions, it has refused to acknowledge its broader responsibility for the stability of the world economy.

zh: 那么，美联储应该怎么做？
en: So what should the Fed do differently?

zh: 首先，它应该立刻与韩国、智利、墨西哥、印度和巴西等国家谈判永久性美元互换安排。
en: First, it should immediately negotiate permanent dollar swap lines with countries such as South Korea, Chile, Mexico, India, and Brazil.

zh: 其次，美联储应该改变口风，并在必要时改变政策以反映其行动会极大地影响他国从而反过来影响美国经济的事实。
en: Second, the Fed should adjust its rhetoric and, if necessary, its policies to reflect the fact that its actions disproportionately affect other countries, with repercussions on the US economy.

zh: 这有可能意味着美联储应该放慢退出QE的节奏吗？
en: Might this mean that the Fed should slow the pace of its tapering of QE?

zh: 是的，有可能。
en: Yes, it might.

zh: 美联储可能会对扩大额外互换额犹豫不决，因为这样做可能导致它遭受汇率损失。
en: The Fed may hesitate to extend additional swap lines, because to do so could expose it to losses on foreign currencies.

zh: 此外，美联储可能担心没有得到这一便利的国家的反弹；而如果其言论和政策承认了它的全球责任，国会也有可能批评它越权。
en: Moreover, it may worry about antagonizing countries that are not offered such facilities; and it may fear criticism from Congress for overstepping the bounds of its mandate if its talk and policies acknowledge its global responsibilities.

zh: 如果美国决策者担心这些问题，那么唯一的选择就是同意提高IMF认购额，从而让维护国际金融稳定的责任回到它的所属之处：合法的国际组织手中。
en: If US policymakers are worried about these issues, their only option is to agree to quota increases for the IMF, thereby allowing responsibility for international financial stability to migrate back to where it belongs: the hands of a legitimate international organization.

zh: 人民币的壮游
en: The Renminbi’s Grand Tour

zh: 雷克雅未克—近几周来，欧洲和中国官员宣布了两件要事。
en: REYKJAVIK – European and Chinese officials have made two notable announcements in recent weeks.

zh: 6月18日，中国第二大金融机构 — — 中国建设银行被指定为伦敦官方人民币清算行。
en: On June 18, China’s second largest financial institution, China Construction Bank, was designated as the official renminbi clearing bank for London.

zh: 第二天，中国最大商业银行 — — 中国银行【原文如此】法兰克福银行被指定为欧元区官方人民币清算行。
en: The next day, the Frankfurt branch of the Bank of China, the country’s largest commercial bank, received the same designation for the eurozone.

zh: 这两件事均引起赞声一片。
en: Both announcements were greeted with great acclaim.

zh: 英国财政大臣奥斯本（George Osborne）赞美成立伦敦清算行对伦敦金融城的未来“极其重要 ” 。
en: British Chancellor George Osborne hailed the creation of a London clearing bank as “hugely important” for the financial future of the City.

zh: 德国央行的纳高（Joachim Nagel）赞美中国银行受到指定是“通往建立法兰克福人民币交易中心之路上的里程碑 ” 。
en: Joachim Nagel of the German Bundesbank lauded the Bank of China announcement as a “milestone on the road toward creating a renminbi trading center in Frankfurt.”

zh: 我们不难预料欧洲官员对这两件事的热情洋溢，他们急切地需要好消息，不管来自哪里。
en: We should expect these kinds of enthusiastic pronouncements from European officials, who are desperate for good news, whatever its source.

zh: 但我们其他人关心这些事吗？
en: But should the rest of us care?

zh: 毕竟，银行、企业甚至个人早已能够用人民币兑换他们的英镑和欧元。
en: After all, banks, firms, and even individuals already can buy renminbi for their pounds and euros.

zh: 一些金融机构（包括地方金融机构和香港金融机构）早已准备好提供这一服务。
en: A range of financial institutions, both locally and in Hong Kong, have long stood ready to provide this service.

zh: 唯一的区别是两家中国大银行在伦敦和法兰克福开展业务时将被允许在外国客户有需求时从中国本国购买人民币。
en: The only difference is that the two big Chinese banks, when doing business in London and Frankfurt, will be permitted to purchase renminbi in China itself when their foreign customers demand it.

zh: 中国人民银行将授予它们这一操作的配额。
en: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC) will give them a quota for this purpose.

zh: 其他银行在向客户提供人民币时只能通过离岸流通的固定供给。
en: Other banks, when seeking to provide renminbi to their clients, are limited to bidding for the fixed supplies that circulate offshore.

zh: 这增加了它们的成本，也限制了它们的服务的需求。
en: This raises their costs and limits demand for their services.

zh: 因此，通过允许两家清算行获得在岸人民币，中国官员实际上在补贴其伦敦和法兰克福的机构，以及鼓励直接英镑和欧元交易。
en: Thus, by permitting two clearing banks to access renminbi onshore, Chinese officials are effectively subsidizing their London and Frankfurt operations and encouraging direct sterling and euro trades.

zh: 但伦敦和法兰克福如果寄希望于人民币交易的迅速增长，那将是有失偏颇的。
en: But London and Frankfurt would be reckless to bank on rapid growth in their renminbi transactions.

zh: 国际清算银行2013年4月的最新外汇市场调查发现，人民币-美元贸易平均交易量为每天1,130亿美元，而直接人民币-欧元交易量总共只有10亿美元，直接人民币-英镑交易量则更加稀少。
en: In its most recent survey of foreign-exchange markets, in April 2013, the Bank for International Settlements found that renminbi-dollar trades averaged $113 billion a day, whereas direct renminbi-euro trades totaled a mere $1 billion, while direct renminbi-sterling trades amounted to even less.

zh: 在实践中，当欧洲人想要中国货币时，他们会用欧元和英镑买入美元，然后再用美元买入人民币。
en: In practice, when Europeans want China’s currency, they use their euros and pounds to buy dollars, and then use those dollars to buy renminbi.

zh: 这反映出一个事实，即美元计价资产市场具有相当的深度和流动性，从而能够限制交易成本。
en: This reflects the fact that the market in dollar-denominated assets is exceptionally deep and liquid, which limits transaction costs.

zh: 换句话说，欧洲人的实践行为反映出美元作为唯一真正全球货币、被中国和全世界货币交易这和投资者无条件接受的“过度特权 ” 。
en: In other words, European practice reflects the dollar’s “exorbitant privilege” as the only true global currency, freely accepted by currency traders and investors in China and around the world.

zh: 中国官员想必认为这一局面会随时间而改变。
en: Chinese officials presumably believe that this situation will change over time.

zh: 一旦银行提供以人民币计价的新资产，就会有更多客户被吸引到市场中，从而增加流动性，降低用欧洲货币买入人民币的交易成本。
en: Once banks offer new assets denominated in renminbi, more customers will be drawn into the market, thereby adding liquidity and reducing transaction costs for purchases of renminbi in European currencies.

zh: 美元拥有超然的不对称地位。
en: The dollar’s asymmetric role will be superseded.

zh: 在这一点上，人民币、欧元和英镑都只不过扮演着间接的国际��色。
en: At that point, the renminbi, the euro, and sterling will all play consequential international roles.

zh: 因此，指定伦敦和法兰克福人民币清算行的决定实际上只不过是中国促进建立由多种而非一种全球货币组成的国际货币体系的又一步骤。
en: Thus, the decision to designate renminbi clearing banks in London and Frankfurt is, in effect, one more step by China to foster the emergence of an international monetary system with several global currencies, not just one.

zh: 这是通往更好地匹配我们的多极全球经济及其货币和金融体系的一步 — — 从而也使通往结束世界经济依赖美元的一步。 欧洲和中国决策者自2008年全球金融危机爆发以来一直在抱怨美元依赖。
en: It is a step toward creating a better match between our multipolar global economy and its monetary and financial system – and thus a step toward ending the world economy’s dependence on the dollar, which European and Chinese policymakers have complained about since the global financial crisis erupted in 2008.

zh: 但这只是一步。
en: But it is only a step.

zh: 深化而流动的市场不是一天建成的。
en: Deep and liquid markets are not built in a day.

zh: 2013年6月，当中国人民银行出人意外地收紧货币政策时，国内银行间利率飙升至 25 % 。
en: In June 2013, when the PBOC unexpectedly tightened monetary policy, domestic interbank interest rates shot up to 25%.

zh: 因此，即使配额允许离岸清算银行从中国国内获得资金，也不能保证能够以合适价格得到资金。
en: Thus, even a quota that permits an offshore clearing bank to tap funding in China does not guarantee that it can obtain that funding at a reasonable price.

zh: 此外，如果中国产生金融问题，资本外流就可能加速。
en: Moreover, if China develops financial problems, capital outflows may accelerate.

zh: 中国当局可能被迫收紧清算行所能获得的配额。
en: The Chinese authorities may then be forced to tighten the quotas made available to the clearing banks.

zh: 市场流动性也会受到拖累。
en: Market liquidity would be a casualty.

zh: 你还可能质疑欧洲投资者会对人民币计价金融资产表现出多大的胃口。
en: One can also question how much appetite European investors will display for renminbi-denominated financial assets.

zh: 在过去，对这类资产的需求一直由人民币继续升值的预期推动。
en: In the past, demand for such assets has been fed by the expectation that the renminbi will continue to appreciate.

zh: 如果中国增长减速，这一预期就可能消失。
en: If Chinese growth slows, such expectations might well dissolve.

zh: 毫无疑问，假以时日，人民币将起到更重要的国际作用。
en: There is no doubt that, with time, the renminbi will acquire a more consequential international role.

zh: 二十一世纪金融技术将有利于多种不同货币的直接交易，消除几乎所有国际交易都通过美元进行的需要和习惯。
en: Twenty-first-century financial technology will facilitate direct trading in a variety of different currencies, eliminating the need and custom of routing virtually all international transactions through the dollar.

zh: 这最终将终结美国的“过度特权 ” 。
en: Ultimately this will spell the end of America’s “exorbitant privilege.”

zh: 但不是现在。
en: Just not yet.

zh: 也不会是近期。
en: And not anytime soon.

zh: 迷失的利率
en: Losing Interest

zh: 伯克利—世界最重要的两大经济机构 — — 国际货币基金组织（IMF）和前美国财政部张拉里·萨默斯（Larry Summers）最近警告说，全球经济可能面临延长低利率期的局面。
en: BERKELEY – Two of the world’s most prominent economic institutions, the International Monetary Fund and Former US Treasury Secretary Larry Summers, recently warned that the global economy may be facing an extended period of low interest rates.

zh: 为什么这是件坏事？ 我们又可以对此做些什么？
en: Why is that a bad thing, and what can be done about it?

zh: 经通胀调整后，利率已经下降了三十年，当前的低水平刺激投资者追寻收益率，冒了过多的风险。
en: Adjusted for inflation, interest rates have been falling for three decades, and their current low level encourages investors, searching for yield, to take on additional risk.

zh: 低利率还还束缚了央行在经济减速时采取货币扩张的空间，因为名义利率不能降到零以下。
en: Low rates also leave central banks little room for loosening monetary policy in a slowdown, because nominal interest cannot fall below zero.

zh: 这些都是经济状况不佳的症候。
en: And they are symptomatic of an economy that is out of sorts.

zh: 为了找出问题而不去乱开药方，就需要诊断出根本原因。
en: Identifying the problem, much less prescribing solutions, requires diagnosing underlying causes.

zh: 不幸的是，在这方面经济学家没有形成共识。
en: And here, unfortunately, economists do not agree.

zh: 一些经济学家认为原因在于全球储蓄的增加，将矛头指向了高储蓄的新兴市场。
en: Some point to an increase in global saving, attributable mainly to high-saving emerging markets.

zh: 读者们可以看到“储蓄过剩”论在近十年前开始大行其道，前美联储主席艾伦·格林斯潘和本·伯南克都持有这一观点。
en: Readers will detect here echoes of the “savings glut” argument popularized nearly a decade ago by the likes of former US Federal Reserve Board Chairmen Alan Greenspan and Ben Bernanke.

zh: 只有一个问题：从数据中基本找不出储蓄过剩的证据。
en: There is only one problem: the data show little evidence of a savings glut.

zh: 自1980年以来，全球储蓄占世界GDP之比一直在22%至24%波动，极少超出这一区间。
en: Since 1980, global savings have fluctuated between 22% and 24% of world GDP, with little tendency to trend up or down.

zh: 虽然2014年全球储蓄略微超出了世界GDP的24 % ， 但不太可能长时间维持这一高位。
en: Even if global saving slightly exceeds 24% of world GDP in 2014, it is unlikely to remain that high for long.

zh: 中国的储蓄将随着其GDP增速回落而下降，中国当局放松了对银行存款利率的管制，中国经济也在向消费再平衡。
en: China’s saving will come down as its GDP growth slows, the authorities decontrol interest rates on bank deposit, and the economy rebalances toward consumption.

zh: 其他新兴市场也是如此，它们的增长率也纷纷从上一个十年末尾的峰值开始下降。
en: That will be true of other emerging markets as well, as their growth rates similarly fall from the exceptional peaks scaled at the end of the last decade.

zh: 同样的实证证据也可以用来反驳将低利率归因于收入和财富集中者。
en: The same empirical objection applies to arguments that blame low interest rates on the increasing concentration of income and wealth.

zh: 富人消费占收入比更小的观点貌似很有道理，而在大部分人看来，最近的收入和财富分配趋势显然也颇可忧虑。
en: It is plausible that the wealthy consume smaller shares of their income, and recent trends in income and wealth distribution certainly are troubling on many grounds.

zh: 但要对全球利率产生影响，这些趋势必须让全球储蓄有所增加。
en: But to affect global interest rates, these trends have to translate into increased global savings.

zh: 而这方面找不到证据。
en: And the evidence is not there.

zh: 低利率的第二个解释是高吸引力投资机会稀少。
en: A second explanation for low interest rates is a dearth of attractive investment projects.

zh: 但股市，尤其是美国股市，并不符合这一诊断，美国股市目前已经创出了历史新高。
en: But this does not appear to be the diagnosis of stock markets, notably in the United States, where equities are trading at record-high prices.

zh: 风险资本家投资将新科技商业化的企业的热情也如火如荼。
en: And it sits uneasily with the enthusiasm with which venture capitalists are investing in firms commercializing new technologies.

zh: 以西北大学的罗伯特·戈登（Robert Gordon）为首的一些经济学家指出，股市估值不论，所有伟大发明都已做出。
en: Some economists, led by Northwestern’s Robert Gordon, argue that, stock market valuations notwithstanding, all the great inventions have been made.

zh: 互联网、人类基因组工程、和机器人的商业潜力与多轴纺织机、蒸汽机和自来水一比就显得相形见绌了。
en: The commercial potential of the Internet, the human genome project, and robotics pales in comparison with that of the spinning jenny, the steam engine, and indoor plumbing.

zh: 或许如此，但值得注意的是，科技怀疑派200年来一直是错的。
en: Maybe so, but it is worth observing that technology skeptics have been consistently wrong for 200 years.

zh: 历史表明，尽管我们不知道未来高回报发明会是什么，但我们可以很有信心的指出它必将出现。
en: History suggests that, while we may not know what the high-return inventions of the future will be, we can be confident that there will be some.

zh: 还有一些人，比如美联储现任主席珍妮特·耶伦认为投资和利率因为大衰退给经济和劳动力带来的伤害而受到了抑制。
en: Still others, like the Fed’s current leader, Janet Yellen, suggest that investment and interest rates are depressed as a result of the damage done to the economy and the labor force during the Great Recession.

zh: 具体而言，长期失业者的技能和士气都受到了打击。
en: Specifically, the skills and morale of the long-term unemployed have been eroded.

zh: 他们与劳动力市场脱节，没钱可花；而长期失业带来的耻辱使得他们无法成为有吸引力的员工。
en: Detached from the labor market, they lack incomes to spend; and, stigmatized by long-term unemployment, they are not regarded as attractive employees.

zh: 结果，企业产品需求不足，同时流水线上又找不到合格的工人。
en: As a result, firms see inadequate demand for their products, and a shortage of qualified workers to staff their assembly lines.

zh: 于是就导致了资本支出水平低下，这也成了最近的复苏的一个显著反常点，并反过来解释了复苏的其他麻烦点（如增长缓慢和低利率 ） 。
en: The result is low capital spending, one of the striking anomalies of the current recovery, which in turn can explain other troubling aspects of the recovery, from slow growth to low interest rates.

zh: 这一观点不无道理。
en: This argument has considerable merit.

zh: 但是，尽管它能够解释为何过去三年中资本支出萎靡不振、利率保持低位，但却不能解释为何资本支出不足以防止利率下降超过三十年。
en: But, though it can explain why capital spending has been weak and interest rates have been low for the last three years, it cannot account for why capital expenditure has been insufficient to prevent rates from trending down for more than three decades.

zh: 在这方面，唯一的解释仍然是经济活动成分开始远离资本密集型生产（如制造 ） ， 转向资本密集度较低的活动（如服务 ） 。
en: Here, the only explanation still standing is the shift in the composition of activity away from capital-intensive forms of production, like manufacturing, to less capital-intensive activities, like services.

zh: 如果这一无序具有多重根源，那么就应该多管齐下才能解决。
en: If the disorder has multiple causes, then there should be multiple treatments.

zh: 应该采取企业税收激励以刺激它们雇用长期失业者；增加基础设施、教育和研究方面的公共支出以弥补私人资本指出缺口；以及提高银行资本要求、强化非银行金融机构监管以防止过度冒险。
en: There should be tax incentives for firms to hire the long-term unemployed; more public spending on infrastructure, education, and research to compensate for the shortfall in private capital spending; and still higher capital requirements for banks and strengthened regulation of nonbank financial institutions to prevent them from excessive risk-taking.

zh: 最后，中央银行应该设置更高的通胀目标，这能让它们有更大的余地削减名义利率应对未来减速。
en: Finally, central banks should set a higher inflation target, which would give them more room to cut nominal interest rates in response to a future slowdown.

zh: 这可不是刚刚履新、急切地想树立其反通胀诚意的美联储主席所大声承诺的。
en: This is not something that a new Fed chair, anxious to establish her anti-inflation bona fides, can say out loud.

zh: 但这是她的观点所暗示的。
en: But that is what her arguments imply.

zh: 最后学习者
en: Leaners of Last Resort

zh: 奥斯陆—随着5月底杰里米·斯特恩（Jeremy Stein）回哈佛任教，美联储理事会也失去了支持货币政策应该遏制金融过度（financial excess）的观点的领军人物。
en: OSLO – With Jeremy Stein’s return to his academic post at Harvard at the end of May, the US Federal Reserve Board lost its leading proponent of the view that monetary policy should be used to lean against financial excesses.

zh: 斯特恩的观点在今年春天早些时候的一次演讲中表露无遗，即在金融风险高企的环境中，央行不应该太积极地追求充分就业目标。
en: Stein’s view, expressed in a speech earlier this spring, is that central banks should be less aggressive in their pursuit of full employment in an environment of heightened financial risk.

zh: 他的立场与前美联储主席格林斯潘的教条针锋相对。 格林斯潘认为中央银行不应该因为金融部门出现过剩而调整政策，而应该集中于对随后产生的任何问题做出反应。
en: His position is a refutation of former Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan’s doctrine that the central bank should not adjust policy in response to financial-sector excesses, but instead should concentrate on reacting to any problems that subsequently arise.

zh: 问题在于斯特恩的新观点是否能够得到论证。
en: The question is whether Stein’s new view is justified.

zh: 理论上，答案是直观的。
en: In principle, the answer is straightforward.

zh: 如果中央银行有两个政策目标，那么就需要两种工具：货币政策影响总需求；监管政策限制金融风险。
en: If a central bank has two policy targets, then it needs two instruments: monetary policy to influence aggregate demand, and regulatory policy to limit financial risks.

zh: 但是，在实践中，答案更加复杂，因为这个问题有多重成分。
en: In practice, however, the answer is more complicated, because the question has several components.

zh: 当监管者不作为时，货币决策这应该怎么办？
en: What should monetary policymakers do when regulators are prone to falling down on the job?

zh: 特别是，他们应该提高利率吗？
en: In particular, should they raise interest rates?

zh: 在决定监管者是否不作为时，他们应该盯住什么指标？
en: To what indicators should they look when determining whether regulators have failed to do their part?

zh: 还有，在解决由此产生的风险时，货币政策是否是足够灵活的工具？
en: And is monetary policy a sufficiently subtle instrument to address the resulting risks?

zh: 全球信用危机爆发时，第一个问题的答案毋庸置疑。
en: In the wake of the global credit crisis, the answer to the first question is not in doubt.

zh: “抑制与救济 ” （ lean versus clean）之争的胜者是显而易见的。
en: There is a clear victor in the “lean versus clean” debate.

zh: 央行不可能只关注危机后的救济工作；金融动荡的代价太高昂了。
en: Central banks cannot concentrate only on cleaning up after crises; the costs of financial instability are too high.

zh: 相反，最近的事件充分表明，货币当局必须在过度发展过程中抑制它。
en: Rather, as recent events have amply shown, the monetary authority must lean against excesses as they develop.

zh: 这就引出了一个问题：如何确定过度的程度以及如何对策。
en: That leaves the question of how to detect the existence of excesses, and the question of what, exactly, to do about them.

zh: 斯特恩提出应该专注于债券市场的风险溢价。
en: Stein proposes focusing on risk premiums in the bond market.

zh: 当高风险债券收益率向安全资产下跌靠拢时，他指出，就可以认为有人在过度冒险。
en: When yields on risky bonds decline toward those on safe assets, it is fair to conclude, he argues, that someone is taking on excessive risk.

zh: 于是，问题就变味如何确定风险溢价太低。
en: The problem, then, is how to determine exactly when risk premiums are too low.

zh: 有人建议专注于流向非金融私人部门的银行和非银行的贷款量，将此作为贷款风险增加的指标。
en: Some suggest focusing on rapid increases in the volume of bank and nonbank lending to the non-financial private sector as an indicator that lending is growing riskier.

zh: 也有人建议监测杠杆率，特别是银行系统的资本-资产比率，因为银行是整个金融链的薄弱环节。
en: Others recommend monitoring the leverage ratio, particularly the ratio of capital to assets in the banking system, on the grounds that banks are the weak link in the financial chain.

zh: 这些建议都表明央行有将复杂的决策简化为简单规则的内在倾向。
en: These suggestions are all indicative of central bankers’ instinctual desire to reduce complex decision-making to simple rules.

zh: 但专家之间的分歧表明追寻简单规则是无用功。
en: But the disagreement among experts shows that the search for simple rules is futile.

zh: 世界各地的央行行长们别无选择，只能参考大背景并依赖他们的判断。
en: Here as elsewhere, central bankers have no alternative but to consider the broader context and rely on their judgment.

zh: 最后一个问题是是货币政策是否是应对源自金融动荡的风险的正确工具，若是，又应该在什么程度上使用。
en: Finally, there is the question of whether monetary policy is the right instrument to use in response to the risks arising from financial instability and, if so, how aggressively to use it.

zh: 答案不可避免地受到美国在1929年的经验的影响。 当时，美联储认为华尔街存在过度问题，因此收紧了货币政策，结果导致经济陷入大萧条。
en: Inevitably, the answers are colored by the United States’ experience in 1929, when the Fed tightened policy in response to what it perceived as excesses on Wall Street, only to plunge the economy into the Great Depression.

zh: 事实上，同样的争论在当时也曾经闹得不可开交。
en: In fact, exactly the same debate raged then.

zh: 争论的一方是美联储理事，他们认为唯一有效的治理金融过度之法是提高利率。
en: On one side were Fed governors who argued that the only effective way to rein in financial excesses was to raise interest rates.

zh: 另一方是美联储官员，如纽约联储银行的乔治·哈里森（George Harrison ） ， 他们担心整体经济受到影响，更偏向于使用其他工具解决金融失衡。
en: On the other side were officials, like George Harrison of the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, who worried about the impact on the broader economy and preferred to use other instruments to address financial imbalances.

zh: 哈里森提出的方案是“直接压�� ” （ direct pressure ） — —即利用美联储的监管权力和道德劝告说服成员银行减少向股市的贷款。
en: Harrison’s alternative was “direct pressure” – that is, using the Fed’s regulatory powers and moral suasion to persuade member banks to curtail their lending to the stock market.

zh: 在两种观点中，哈里森的观点更加成熟。
en: Of the two views, Harrison’s was the more sophisticated.

zh: 问题在于美联储的宏观审慎工具尚不完善。
en: The problem was that the Fed’s macro-prudential instruments were undeveloped.

zh: 美联储成员银行一限制它们对证券买家的信用供给，非成员银行、保险公司和信托公司就会开足马力填补空白，让股市继续节节攀升。
en: No sooner did the Federal Reserve System’s member banks limit their provision of credit to purchasers of securities than non-member banks, insurance companies, and trust companies ramped up their lending, allowing the stock market to race ahead.

zh: 在这场失败的实验中，即使哈里森也被迫承认驯服市场需要决策者提高整个金融部门的贷款利率。
en: In the wake of this failed experiment, even Harrison was forced to acknowledge that reining in the market required policymakers to make lending more expensive for the financial sector as a whole.

zh: 接着，美联储在1929年夏天提高了其政策利率，随后的故事大家都知道了。
en: The Fed then raised its policy rates in the summer of 1929 – and the rest, as they say, is history.

zh: 其中的含义是明确的：央行应该专注于开发更有效的宏观审慎工具。
en: The implication is clear: Central banks should focus on developing more effective macro-prudential instruments.

zh: 它们应该扩大监管视野 — — 即应该让非银行金融部门也归入它们的监管范围。
en: They should widen the regulatory perimeter – that is, they should work to bring nonbank financial institutions under their regulatory umbrella.

zh: 它们应该先发制人地使用由此产生的工具和权力。
en: They should use the resulting instruments and powers preemptively.

zh: 它们还应该将调整货币政策以纠正潜在金融风险作为最后手段，而不是第一道防线。
en: And they should adjust monetary policy to address potential financial risks as a last resort, not as their first line of defense.

zh: 依赖金砖五国
en: Banking on the BRICS

zh: 伯克利 — — 对金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）领导人而言，7月份创立“全新开发银行 ” （ NDB）和“应急储备安排 ” （ CRA）的公告不啻于一场公关政变。
en: BERKELEY – For the leaders of the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa), the announcement in July of their agreement to establish a “New Development Bank” (NDB) and a “Contingent Reserve Arrangement” (CRA) was a public-relations coup.

zh: 巴西总统迪尔玛•罗塞夫因巴西在世界杯上不光彩的失败和国内经济低迷而特别欢迎这样有凯旋意味的合影机会，鉴于俄政府支持乌克兰叛军所引发的国际反应，俄罗斯总统普京也特别需要这样的事件。
en: The opportunity for a triumphal group photo was especially welcome for Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff, in light of her country’s ignominious World Cup defeat and slack economy, and for Russia’s President Vladimir Putin, given the international reaction against his government’s support of the rebels in Ukraine.

zh: 这份协议也给了金砖五国重申不满世界银行、国际货币基金组织和美元在全球货币体系中所扮演角色的机会。
en: The agreement was also an opportunity for the five countries to reiterate their dissatisfaction with the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund, and the role of the dollar in the global monetary system.

zh: 金砖国家仅握有国际货币基金11%的投票权，却占据全球经济活动的20%以上。
en: The BRICS possess just 11% of the votes in the IMF, despite accounting for more than 20% of global economic activity.

zh: 美国会拒绝批准2010年达成的协议，纠正这种失衡的状态。
en: The US Congress refuses to ratify the agreement reached in 2010 to correct this skewed state of affairs.

zh: 同时美国也不愿放弃任命世行总裁的过时权限。
en: And the United States has displayed no willingness to renounce its anachronistic privilege of nominating the World Bank’s president.

zh: 此外，美元在全球外汇储备中所占的份额仍然超过60 % 。 而超过85%的全球外汇交易都要用到美元。
en: Meanwhile, the share of the dollar in global foreign-exchange reserves remains more than 60%, while 85% of global foreign-exchange transactions involve dollars.

zh: 鉴于代表名额不足的国家不愿签署IMF的预防性信贷额度，央行急需美元时只能从美联储申请贷款。
en: Given the reluctance of underrepresented countries to sign up for the IMF’s precautionary credit lines, central banks desperate for dollars can obtain them only from the Federal Reserve.

zh: 美联储在2008年危机中对提供美元互换基本持合作态度；但未来是否仍会如此谁也不知道。
en: The Fed was reasonably forthcoming in providing dollar swaps in the last crisis in 2008; but there is no guarantee that it will behave similarly in the future.

zh: 因此，金砖四国对现状不满是可以理解的。
en: Thus, the BRICS’ dissatisfaction with the status quo is understandable.

zh: 问题在于他们的“全新开发银行 ” （ NDB）和“应急储备安排 ” （ CRA）是否能改变现状。
en: The question is whether their NDB and CRA will make a difference.

zh: “全新开发银行”具有令人信服的逻辑。
en: The logic for the NDB is compelling.

zh: 金砖国家和一般发展中国家都有巨大的基础设施需求。
en: The BRICS, and developing countries generally, have immense infrastructure needs.

zh: 中国可能没有基础设施欠账，但却有大型建筑企业急于到国外承接更多的项目。
en: China may not have an infrastructure deficit, but it has something else: large construction companies that welcome the opportunity to undertake additional projects abroad.

zh: 于是“全新开发银行”的潜在债权人和借款人愉快地实现了合作。
en: Hence the incentives of the NDB’s prospective creditors and borrowers are happily aligned.

zh: 此外，从美洲开发银行到亚洲开发银行再到资本更小的非洲开发银行，区域性开发银行已经遍地都是。
en: Moreover, there already is a proliferation of regional development banks, from the Inter-American Development Bank and the Asian Development Bank to the more modestly capitalized African Development Bank.

zh: 上述机构与世界银行合作。
en: These institutions cooperate with the World Bank.

zh: 它们的存在对布雷顿森林并不构成重大威胁。
en: Their existence creates no major problems for the Bretton Woods institutions.

zh: “全新开发银行”也没有构成威胁的理由。
en: There is no reason why the NDB should create problems, either.

zh: 仅仅1000亿美元的初始资金根本不足以满足全球基础设施所需。
en: With initial capital of just $100 billion, it is too small to make a major contribution to global infrastructure needs.

zh: 但时间或许可以逐渐改变资本金的不足。
en: But inadequate capitalization can be corrected over time.

zh: 旨在削减金砖国家对美联储和美元依赖的“应急储备安排”则完全是另一回事。
en: The CRA – intended to lessen the BRICS’ dependence on the Fed and the dollar – is another story.

zh: 与会五国同意拨付1000亿美元的外汇储备，所有相关国家均有权提取由此构成的互换额度。
en: The five participants agreed to earmark $100 billion of their foreign-exchange reserves for swap lines on which all members are entitled to draw.

zh: 但这里未来借款人和贷款人的利益并不明显契合。
en: But here the interests of prospective borrowers and lenders are not obviously compatible.

zh: 下一个陷入危机的金砖国家需要提取“应急储��安排 ” 。
en: The next BRICS country experiencing a crisis will want to draw on the CRA.

zh: 但尤其当无法确定借款方能否还款的情况下，其他成员国可能只愿借出象征性的数目。
en: But the other members will hesitate to lend more than token amounts, especially if there are repayment doubts.

zh: 相对于开发融资，潜在贷款人和借款人的激励机制并不一致。
en: In contrast to development finance, the incentives of potential lenders and borrowers are not aligned.

zh: 允许贷款人对借款人提出政策条件并督促其遵照实行可以解决上述问题。
en: Permitting the lenders to impose policy conditions on borrowers, and to monitor their compliance, can redress this problem.

zh: 但对主权国家提条件非常棘手 — — 尤其当所涉国家像金砖成员国那样广阔、多样并引以为豪。
en: But imposing conditionality on sovereign states is a delicate matter – especially when the countries involved are as large, proud, and diverse as the BRICS.

zh: 比方说，很难想象巴西会接受中国提出的政策条件。
en: It is difficult to imagine Brazil, for example, accepting policy conditions laid down by China.

zh: 同样的问题困扰着其他建立换汇和信贷额度的努力，比方说亚洲危机爆发后提出的清迈倡议。
en: Other attempts to establish networks of swap lines and credits, such as the Chiang Mai Initiative, which was negotiated in the wake of the Asian crisis, have been bedeviled by the same problem.

zh: 清迈倡议涉及的国家甚至比“应急储备安排”更广。
en: The Chiang Mai network is even larger than the CRA.

zh: 但由于贷款人和借款人的利益分歧，清迈倡议从未付诸实施 — — 就连2008年全球金融危机达到顶峰时都从未实施过。
en: But, given the divergent interests of lenders and borrowers, it has never been used – not even in 2008, at the height of the global financial crisis.

zh: 清迈倡议的设计者解决问题的方法是要求提取超过30%互换额度的国家与国际货币基金组织谈判一项计划。
en: The architects of the Chiang Mai Initiative attempted to finesse the problem by requiring countries that draw more than 30% of their swaps to negotiate a program with the IMF.

zh: 讽刺的是 ， “ 金砖应急储备安排创立协议”也提出了一模一样的要求。
en: Ironically, the “Treaty for the Establishment of a BRICS Contingent Reserve Arrangement” contains exactly the same provision.

zh: 因此 ， “ 应急储备安排”不可能取代IMF。
en: So much, then, for the CRA as an alternative to the IMF.

zh: 而且如果上述条款还不够发人深省，金砖国家对“应急储备安排”的缴款居然是以美元为单位的。
en: And, if inclusion of that provision was not revealing enough, then there is the fact that the BRICS’ commitments to the CRA are expressed in US dollars.

zh: “全新开发银行”对金砖国家具有实际意义。
en: The NDB makes sense for the BRICS, and it has a future.

zh: 但“应急储备安排”却只有象征意义，这一点肯定会被历史记住。
en: But the CRA is empty symbolism, and that is how it will be remembered.

zh: 全球失衡安魂曲
en: A Requiem for Global Imbalances

zh: 伯克利—2014年是我们开始担心全球失衡问题，特别是美国和中国之间长期存在的贸易和经常项目失衡的第十个年头。
en: BERKELEY – The start of 2014 marks ten years since we began fretting about global imbalances, and specifically about the chronic trade and current-account imbalances of the United States and China.

zh: 十年后，我们可以愉快地宣布，全球失衡结束了。
en: A decade later, we can happily declare that the era of global imbalances is over.

zh: 因此，现在应该从这段时间吸取正确的教训。
en: So now is the time to draw the right lessons from that period.

zh: 2006年，美国经常项目赤字达到了令人警惕的GDP的5.8 % ， 如今这一数字下降至GDP的2.7 % — —美国可以轻松地用版税收入和先期对外投资回报来弥补这一赤字，而不会增加新的外债。
en: America’s current-account deficit, which was an alarming 5.8% of GDP as recently as 2006, has now shrunk to just 2.7% of GDP – a level that the US can easily finance from its royalty income and returns on prior foreign investments without incurring additional foreign debt. Even more impressive, China’s current-account surplus, which reached an extraordinary 10% of GDP in 2007, is now barely 2.5% of national income.

zh: 仍有一些国家存在令人担忧的巨大盈余或赤字。
en: There are still a few countries with worrisomely large surpluses and deficits.

zh: 尤其是德国和土耳其。
en: Germany and Turkey stand out.

zh: 但德国相当于GDP的6%的盈余大体上是一个欧洲问题，而土耳其相当于GDP的7.4%的赤字大体上是土耳其的问题。
en: But Germany’s 6%-of-GDP surplus is mainly a problem for Europe, while Turkey’s 7.4% deficit is mainly a problem for Turkey.

zh: 换句话说，它们都不是全球问题。
en: In other words, theirs are not global problems.

zh: 2004年，关于全球失衡存在两大思维派别。
en: Back in 2004, there were two schools of thought on global imbalances.

zh: 乐观派认为失衡无关紧要 — — 无非反映了新兴经济体需要美国才能提供的美元储备，而美国消费者对廉价进口商品也有着无穷尽的胃口。
en: The Dr. Pangloss school dismissed them as benign – a mere reflection of emerging economies’ demand for dollar reserves, which only the US could provide, and American consumers’ insatiable appetite for cheap merchandise imports.

zh: 用安全资产换取廉价商品对全世界都有利。
en: Trading safe assets for cheap merchandise was the best of all worlds.

zh: 这是一个可以永远持续下去的愉快的均衡。
en: It was a happy equilibrium that could last indefinitely.

zh: 相反，悲观派警告说，全球失衡是一场随时都有可能发生的事故。
en: By contrast, adherents of the Dr. Doom school warned that global imbalances were an accident waiting to happen.

zh: 在某个时点，新兴市场对美国资产的需求会得到满足。
en: At some point, emerging-market demand for US assets would be sated.

zh: 更糟糕的是，新兴市场将认为美国资产不再安全。
en: Worse, emerging markets would conclude that US assets were no longer safe.

zh: 为美国经常项目赤字融资将成为明日黄花。
en: Financing for America’s current-account deficit would dry up.

zh: 美元将崩溃。
en: The dollar would crash.

zh: 金融机构将措手不及，危机将爆发。
en: Financial institutions would be caught wrong-footed, and a crisis would result.

zh: 现在我们知道，两种观点都是错误的。
en: We now know that both views were wrong.

zh: 全球失衡并没有无限持续下去。
en: Global imbalances did not continue indefinitely.

zh: 中国的安全资产需求得到了满足，便转向了风险更高的对外投资。
en: As China satisfied its demand for safe assets, it turned to riskier foreign investments.

zh: 它已开始实现经济从储蓄转向消费、从出口转向内需的再平衡。
en: It began rebalancing its economy from saving to consumption and from exports to domestic demand.

zh: 与此同时，美国也认识到了过度负债和杠杆的危害。
en: The US, meanwhile, acknowledged the dangers of excessive debt and leverage.

zh: 它开始减少负债、增加储蓄。
en: It began taking steps to reduce its indebtedness and increase its savings.

zh: 为了适应支出模式的变化，美元开始贬值，这增加了美国的出口。
en: To accommodate this change in spending patterns, the dollar weakened, enabling the US to export more.

zh: 与此同时，人民币开始升值，反映出中国居民不断高涨的消费渴望。
en: The renminbi, meanwhile, strengthened, reflecting Chinese residents’ increased desire to consume.

zh: 危机确实发生了，但并不是全球失衡危机。
en: There was a crisis, to be sure, but it was not a crisis of global imbalances.

zh: 美国金融问题重重，但为外债融资已不再是其中之一。
en: Although the US had plenty of financial problems, financing its external deficit was not one of them.

zh: 相反，美元成为极少数显而易见的危机受益者之一，因为急切地渴望流动性的外国投资者纷纷涌向美国国债。
en: On the contrary, the dollar was one of the few clear beneficiaries of the crisis, as foreign investors, desperate for liquidity, piled into US Treasury bonds.

zh: 危机的罪魁是美国金融机构和市场监督和监���太松，这导致了太多的鲁莽行为和过度融资。
en: The principal culprits in the crisis were, rather, lax supervision and regulation of US financial institutions and markets, which allowed unsound practices and financial excesses to build up.

zh: 中国并没有导致金融危机；美国导致了金融危机（其他发达经济体则是帮凶 ） 。
en: China did not cause the financial crisis; America did (with help from other advanced economies).

zh: 这并不是要否认国际资本流的推波助澜作用。
en: This is not to deny the enabling role of international capital flows.

zh: 但重要的资本流不是来自世界其余部分、为美国经常项目赤字提供了融资的净资本流；而是美国流向欧洲、让欧洲银行提高资产负债表杠杆的毛金融流以及与之对应的从欧洲银行流向与有毒美国按揭相关证券的资金流。
en: But the flows that mattered were not the net flows of capital from the rest of the world that financed America’s current-account deficit. Rather, they were the gross flows of finance from the US to Europe that allowed European banks to leverage their balance sheets, and the large, matching flows of money from European banks into toxic US subprime-linked securities.

zh: 全球失衡的批评者和辩护者都几乎完全忽略了北大西洋的这两股相向而动的毛资本流。
en: Both critics and defenders of global imbalances almost entirely overlooked these gross flows in both directions across the North Atlantic.

zh: 下一次全球失衡卷土重来时，分析者将直到（但愿如此）要透过表面看到本质。
en: The next time that global imbalances develop, analysts will – we must hope – know to look beneath their surface.

zh: 但还会有下一次吗？
en: But will there be a next time?

zh: 几年前，预测家信誓旦旦地表示全球失衡将在危机过去之后重现。
en: A couple of years ago, forecasters were confident that global imbalances would reemerge once the crisis passed.

zh: 现在看来这基本上不可能：中国和美国都没有回归危机前的增长率或支出模式。
en: That now seems unlikely: Neither the US nor China is going back to its pre-crisis growth rate or spending pattern.

zh: 此前的贸易平衡也不太可能重现。
en: Nor are earlier trade balances about to reemerge.

zh: 美国的贸易地位将因为带来能源自给的页岩气革命和刺激制造业生产回流的生产率提高而增强。
en: America’s trade position will be strengthened by the shale-gas revolution, which promises energy self-sufficiency, and by increases in productivity that auger further re-shoring of manufacturing production.

zh: 至于新兴市场，它们已经知道出口盈余并非快速增长的保证。
en: Emerging markets, for their part, have learned that export surpluses are no guarantee of rapid growth.

zh: 巨量国际储备也不能保证金融稳定。
en: Nor do large international reserves guarantee financial stability.

zh: 有更好的办法可以增强稳定，如加强审慎监管、控制破坏性资本流并对之课税、采取浮动调节等。
en: There are better ways to enhance stability, from strengthening prudential supervision to taxing and controlling destabilizing capital flows and letting the exchange rate adjust.

zh: 所有这些表明，新兴和发展中国家囤积外汇储备 — — 这又是一个被说烂了的现象 — — 可能已经达到了顶峰。
en: All of this suggests that the accumulation of foreign reserves by emerging and developing countries – another phenomenon over which much ink has been spilled – may be about to peak.

zh: 这将是下一个成为历史的问题。
en: Then it will be just another problem laid to rest.

zh: 中国的工业化和它的不满
en: Chinese Industrialization and its Discontents

zh: 东京—随着中共十八大三中全会的召开，中国站在了十字路口。
en: TOKYO – As the Third Plenum of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party convenes in Beijing, China stands at a crossroads.

zh: 它的最新增长记录是惊人的，历史上没有哪个国家可以与之媲美。
en: Its recent growth record is stupendous; no country in history can match it.

zh: 但中国经济失衡同样惊人。
en: But China’s economic imbalances are also stupendous.

zh: 中国的产出增长是用投资整整一半的GDP来维持的，尽管没有哪个国家可以在相当长的时间里将国民收入的三分之一以上用于投资还能保证生产率。
en: The country has sustained its output growth by investing fully one-half of GDP, though no country can productively invest more than a third of national income for an extended period.

zh: 家庭消费只有GDP的三分之一，而一般经济要占到三分之二。
en: Household consumption accounts for only one-third of GDP, compared to two-thirds in a normal economy.

zh: 与如此低水平的消费相伴而生的是日益恶化的不平等性 — — 既存在于城乡之间，也存在于政治精英和普罗大众之间。
en: Associated with this low level of consumption is widening inequality – between the countryside and the cities, and between the political elites and the masses.

zh: 心高气傲的大学毕业生无法找到中意的白领工作，又不愿意接受录用他们的蓝领职位。
en: University graduates with rising aspirations cannot find the office jobs that they seek and will not accept the factory jobs that they are offered.

zh: 社会动荡 — — 不论是在博客上表达不满还是大规模示威 — — 愈演愈烈。
en: Social unrest, whether expressed in blogs or spontaneous demonstrations, is mounting.

zh: 中国领导人对此心知肚明。
en: China’s leaders understand all of this.

zh: 他们成人需要实现经济从投资到消费的再平衡，也认识到这意味着发展可以提供白领岗位的服务部门。
en: They acknowledge the need to rebalance the economy from investment to consumption, and they recognize that this means developing the service sector, where good white-collar jobs will be found.

zh: 他们还明白需要建立社会安全网、强化农村产权。
en: They also appreciate the need to build a social safety net and strengthen rural property rights.

zh: 但中国官员担心从投资到消费以及从制造到服务的转型意味着增长减速。
en: But Chinese officials worry that the shift from investment to consumption, and from manufacturing to services, will mean slower growth.

zh: 投资减少将意味着更少的资本深化。
en: Less investment will mean less capital deepening.

zh: 扩张生产率尚低的服务部门会拖累总产出。
en: Expanding the service sector, where productivity is low, will hold back aggregate output.

zh: 而如果增长进一步减速 — — 年增长率已从10%降至7.5 % — —社会动荡可能还会加剧。
en: And if growth decelerates further – the annual rate has already dropped from 10% to 7.5% – social unrest may increase.

zh: 了解了这一点，中国领导人可能会踯躅于推行必要的改革，导致失衡继续发展。
en: Knowing this, Chinese leaders may hesitate to move ahead with needed reforms, causing imbalances to continue to rise.

zh: 但这不可能永远持续下去。
en: But this cannot go on indefinitely.

zh: 定时炸弹迟早要爆炸，增长率将会崩溃。
en: At some point, the ticking time bomb will explode, and the growth rate will crash.

zh: 那么，中国领导人应该着眼于何处应对这些挑战？
en: So where should Chinese leaders look for help in meeting these challenges?

zh: 看似不可能的是，他们可以从英国找到指南。
en: It may seem improbable, but they can find guidance from the United Kingdom.

zh: 正如中国的工业化是前所未有的 — — 没有哪个发展中国家可以在整整二十年的时间里不间断地保持每年10%以上的增长，200年前英国的工业化也是前无古人。
en: Just as Chinese industrialization is unprecedented – no developing country has grown by more than 10% per year without interruption for two full decades – Britain’s industrialization 200 years ago was similarly unparalleled.

zh: 当然，英国是工业革命的故乡。
en: Britain was, of course, the homeland of the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 其经济增长比当时人类有史以来任何一个经济体都要快。
en: Its economic growth was faster than that of any economy in human history up to that time.

zh: 但英国的快速增长造成了严重的问题。
en: But Britain’s rapid growth created severe problems.

zh: 不平等性日益加剧，直至最近还有所谓的“生活水平争论”的学术问题。
en: There was growing inequality, or so it appears from recent scholarly contributions to the so-called “standard-of-living debate.”

zh: 家庭产权保护极为不力，发生了所谓的“圈地运动 ” 。
en: There was the alienation of smallholders’ property, in what was known as the “enclosure movement.”

zh: 此外还有关于城市污染和不人道的工厂环境的抱怨，威廉·布莱克（William Blake）称之为“黑暗作坊 ” 。
en: And there were complaints about urban pollution and inhumane factory conditions in what William Blake called Britain’s “dark Satanic mills.”

zh: 不可避免地，英国爆发了社会动荡。
en: Inevitably, there were eruptions of social unrest.

zh: 比如应十九世纪初纺织业机械化而起、摧毁新技术的卢德派和工人摧毁打谷机的施荣暴动（Swing Riots ） 。
en: Recall the Luddites, who responded to the early nineteenth-century mechanization of the textile industry by smashing the new technology, and the Swing Riots, in which workers destroyed threshing machines.

zh: 英国政治家的应对措施是改革社会安全网。
en: British politicians responded by reforming the social safety net.

zh: 1834年 ， 《 新济贫法 》 （ New Poor Law）规定了社会福利的国家标准。
en: In 1834, the New Poor Law established national standards for social benefits.

zh: 尽管争议重重，但穷人仍可以获得补助而不必进入压抑的救济所。
en: In the face of considerable controversy, assistance continued to be provided without requiring the poor to enter oppressive workhouses.

zh: 另一个方案，即所谓的户外救济（outdoor relief）也获得了扩大，成为解决贫困问题的成本最低的方法。
en: Outdoor relief, as the alternative was known, was expanded as the most cost-effective way to address the poverty problem.

zh: 其次，政治改革让崛起的中产阶级得以发声。
en: Second, political reform gave voice to the rising middle classes.

zh: 1832年《改革法案 》 （ Reform Act）授予财产不少于10英镑的个人投票权 — — 平心而论标准不低，但已足以让中产阶级获得选举权。
en: The 1832 Reform Act gave the vote to individuals with at least £10 of property – not an inconsequential sum, to be sure, but low enough to enfranchise the middle class.

zh: 该法案还建立了特别法庭制度仲裁关于选民注册的纠纷。
en: The act also created a system of special courts to adjudicate disputes over voter registration.

zh: 此外，随政治改革到来的还有旨在再平衡经济的政策变化。
en: Moreover, along with political reform came policy changes aimed at rebalancing the economy.

zh: 1846年 ， 《 谷物法 》 （ Corn Laws）被废，这拯救了衰落的农业部门，促进了结构转变，先是转向了制造业，后来又转向服务业（特别是金��业 ） 。
en: Abolition in 1846 of the Corn Laws, which had propped up the declining agricultural sector, facilitated structural shifts, first toward manufacturing and then toward services, notably financial services.

zh: 最后，英国政治家并没有寻求维持该国世界增长最快经济体的地位。
en: Finally, British politicians did not seek to maintain at any cost their country’s position as the world’s fastest-growing economy.

zh: 诚然，当美国、德国和其他国家在十九世纪末超过英国时，他们受到了批评。
en: Admittedly, they faced criticism when the United States, Germany, and other countries overtook Britain in the late nineteenth century.

zh: 但是，他们并没有试图抵挡经济从农业进步到工业再进步到服务业的自然演化，而是成功地让英国获得了整整一百年的持续经济增长。
en: But, by not standing in the way of the economy’s natural evolution from agriculture to industry and then to services, they enabled the United Kingdom to enjoy a full century of sustained economic growth.

zh: 中国可能认为这个偏居欧洲大陆西北一隅的岛国在十九世纪的经验作为他山之石难以接受。
en: China may regard the nineteenth-century experience of a windswept island off the northwest coast of Europe as an odd source of inspiration.

zh: 但如果中国领导人可以在三中全会上取得十九世纪英国先行者一半的成果，便已着实不错了。
en: But if Chinese leaders meeting at their party plenum accomplish half as much as their nineteenth-century English predecessors, they will have done very well indeed.

zh: 欧洲的漫长危机
en: Europe’s Crisis Treadmill

zh: 伯克利—本月是2010年5月希腊金融援助四周年。
en: BERKELEY – This month marks the fourth anniversary of the May 2010 financial rescue of Greece.

zh: 此前，欧元区成员国从国际基金组织以及欧盟委员会和欧洲央行寻求紧急援助的情景是不可想象的。
en: Previously, the idea that a eurozone member would seek emergency assistance from the International Monetary Fund, along with the European Commission and the European Central Bank, was unthinkable.

zh: 因此，援助希腊标志着欧洲滑向全面危机。
en: The rescue thus marked Europe’s descent into full-blown crisis.

zh: 四年后，欧洲官员向全世界表明危机已经结束了。
en: Four years later, European officials are assuring everyone that the crisis is over.

zh: IMF将今年欧元区增长预测提高到1.2 % 。
en: The IMF has raised its forecast for eurozone growth this year to 1.2%.

zh: 即使是希腊，今年预计也将略有增长，但幅度不大，为0.6 % 。
en: Even Greece is forecast to grow by a modest but not insignificant 0.6%.

zh: 债券市场也表明危机已经结束。
en: Bond markets, too, are indicating that the crisis is over.

zh: 爱尔兰政府债券收益率已降至3%以下。
en: Yields on Irish government bonds have fallen below 3%.

zh: 上个月，葡萄牙得以以3.57%的利率发行十年期债券。
en: Last month, Portugal was able to issue ten-year bonds at 3.57%.

zh: 即使是希腊，也能够以不到5%的利率出售五年期债券。
en: Even Greece has been able to sell five-year bonds at rates below 5%.

zh: 显然，预测欧元区马上就会解体的专家这次失算了。
en: Clearly, the supposed experts who predicted the imminent disintegration of the eurozone have been proved wrong.

zh: 但极有可能现在就宣布危机已经结束的专家也失算了。
en: But it is equally likely that those now declaring that the crisis is over will be proved wrong as well.

zh: 如果我们可以从过去四年学到什么，那就是欧盟缺少果断行动力。
en: If we have learned one thing from the last four years, it is that the European Union lacks the capacity to act decisively.

zh: 欧盟有28个成员国，其决策过程琐碎又冗长。
en: With 28 member countries, decision-making processes are tedious and time-consuming.

zh: 共同利益很难界定，导致分担协议难产。
en: Common interests are difficult to define, making burden-sharing agreements difficult to reach.

zh: 有些国家比其他国家更迫切地需要行动。
en: Action is regarded as more urgent in some quarters than in others.

zh: 此外，信心也远未恢复。
en: Moreover, the patient is far from cured.

zh: 爱尔兰、葡萄牙、西班牙、希腊在将相对德国的单位劳动力成本降至1999年水平方面取得了可观的进步。
en: Ireland, Portugal, Spain, and Greece have made considerable progress in lowering their unit labor costs to 1999 levels relative to Germany.

zh: 问题在于降到1999年水平并不够，因为现在它们需要面对中国和其他新兴市场的竞争。
en: The problem is that 1999 levels are not enough, because producers now have China and other emerging markets with which to contend.

zh: 与此同时，意大利和法国在改善国际竞争力方面进展极其缓慢。
en: Italy and France, meanwhile, have made considerably less progress on improving their international competitiveness.

zh: 危机国能否找到它们所需要的需求也未可知。
en: Nor is it clear where the crisis countries will find the demand that they need.

zh: 在国内支出不振的情况下，它们一直依赖出口。
en: With domestic spending subdued, they have been relying on exports.

zh: 但如今新兴市场增长有所放缓，导致它们的出口市场萎靡。
en: But now that growth in emerging markets has slowed, their export markets are weakening.

zh: 一直保持上升势头的西班牙出口出现了停滞。
en: Spanish exports, on a positive trend until recently, have stopped rising.

zh: 西班牙可能只是预警瓦斯浓度的金丝雀。
en: And Spain may be the proverbial canary in a coalmine.

zh: 欧洲央行依旧在支持需求方面无所作为。
en: The ECB, for its part, continues to do too little to support demand.

zh: 自2011年以来，其表现一直落后。
en: It has been behind the curve since 2011.

zh: 即使它最终在6月采取量化宽松，步子也不会很大，因为欧洲央行行长德拉吉及其团队不愿采取可能惊动他们的政治主子的大手笔。
en: If it finally turns to quantitative easing in June, it will take only baby steps down this path, because ECB President Mario Draghi and his team remain reluctant to embrace the kind of radical measures that would shock their political masters.

zh: 在预算方面，法国和意大利新总理瓦尔斯和兰奇提出对低收入工人及其雇主减税。
en: On the budgetary front, the new French and Italian prime ministers, Manuel Valls and Matteo Renzi, respectively, have proposed cutting taxes for low-paid workers and their employers.

zh: 这对于纾缓受失业危机影响最严重人群的困境来说是积极的一步。
en: This is a positive step toward addressing the plight of those who have suffered the most from the unemployment crisis.

zh: 但瓦尔斯和兰奇还计划通过减支阻止预算赤字上升，这意味着他们的计划无法提振需求。
en: But Valls and Renzi also plan to cut spending to prevent their budget deficits from rising, which means that their initiatives will not boost demand.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲银行危机仍未解决。
en: Meanwhile, Europe’s banking crisis is unresolved.

zh: 流向固定资产投资的贷款继续下降。
en: Loans to finance fixed investment continue to fall.

zh: 令人瞩目的是，欧洲银行监督局（European Banking Authority）的最新欧元区银行压力测试并未考虑不利情景的通缩可能。
en: Remarkably, the European Banking Authority’s latest stress test for the eurozone’s banks does not contemplate the possibility of deflation in its adverse scenario.

zh: 其含义是显而易见的：银行资本短缺问题被低估，要求它们筹集的新资本量是不够的。
en: The implication is clear: The banks’ capital shortfall will be understated, and the amount of new capital they will be required to raise will be inadequate.

zh: 如果目标是重塑信心、让银行系统马力全开，那么这样做完全是错误的。
en: If the goal is to restore confidence and get the banking system firing on all cylinders, this is not how to go about it.

zh: 而所有人知道，声势浩大的欧洲银行联盟漏洞百出。
en: And everyone knows that Europe’s much vaunted banking union is deeply flawed.

zh: 银行联盟建立了一个单一监督机构，但只是针对最大的银行。
en: It creates a single supervisor, but only for the largest banks.

zh: 银行联盟协调了存款保险，但并没有建立共同存款保险基金。
en: It harmonizes deposit-insurance coverage but does not provide a common deposit-insurance fund.

zh: 坏银行清算机制很不完善，无法运转。
en: The resolution mechanism for bad banks is incomprehensible and unworkable.

zh: 相应的清算基金资本金只有550亿欧元，而欧洲银行账面负债高达1万亿欧元。
en: The associated resolution fund will possess only €55 billion ($76.6 billion) of its own capital, whereas European bank liabilities are on the order of €1 trillion.

zh: 最后还有公债这一棘手问题。 目前公债水平已达到欧元区GDP的90 % 。
en: Finally, there is that pesky matter of public debt, which is still 90% of eurozone GDP.

zh: 欧洲官员计划在二十年内将这一比例���低到60 % 。
en: European officials propose to work this down to their target of 60% over a couple of decades.

zh: 你没有看错。
en: You read that right.

zh: 不妨等到2034年看看他们做得怎样。
en: Check back to see how they’ve done in 2034.

zh: 所有这些都让人无法做出乐观预期。
en: All of this has the makings of a dismal prognosis.

zh: 但欧洲就是这样进步的。
en: But it is how Europe progresses.

zh: 其银行联盟或许存在漏洞，但至少有了一个银行联盟，假以时日，漏洞可以弥补。
en: Its banking union may be flawed, but at least it exists, and over time those flaws can be fixed.

zh: 压力测试或许存在漏洞，但至少总比前两次压力测试强一些。
en: The stress tests may be flawed, but at least they are better than Europe’s two previous attempts.

zh: 欧洲央行在今年夏天的动作或许不够大，但至少欧元区货币政策官员会有所动作。
en: ECB action this summer may underwhelm, but at least the eurozone’s monetary-policy officials will do something.

zh: 欧元区不会在今年崩溃，但它的麻烦也远未结束。
en: The eurozone will not collapse this year, but its troubles are far from over.

zh: 欧洲不需要与欧洲划断。
en: Europe will not draw a line under its crisis.

zh: 果断不是欧盟的风格。
en: Decisiveness is not the EU way.

zh: 最后一轮巴塞尔谈判？
en: The Last Basel Round?

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 在经历了漫长且不时令人痛苦，将许多国家的中央银行家和监管者之间私人关系考验到极致的谈判后，巴塞尔银行监管委员会终于在12月酝酿出了一个期望已久的成果。
en: LONDON – After long and sometimes painful negotiations, which stress-tested the personal relationships between many countries’ central bankers and regulators to the limit, the Basel Committee laid a long-expected egg in December.

zh: 而这个据说总括了2008年后全球银行体系改革的一揽子计划也宣告了巴塞尔协议3进程的落幕。
en: Described as a package that finalizes the post-2008 reforms to the global regime for bank capital, it brings to an end the process known as Basel 3.

zh: 银行家将这一成果称之为“巴塞尔协议4 ” ， 认为最终方案包含了许多新制定且更繁重的要求。
en: Bankers have dubbed the result “Basel 4,” arguing that the final package contains many new and more burdensome requirements.

zh: 但委员会坚决认为在全球金融危机后这套新规则应被视为2009年启动之改革方案的一个组成模块，坚持说巴塞尔协议4或许某一天会到来，但绝不是这一份。
en: But the Committee is adamant that the new rules should be regarded as part and parcel of the reform program begun in 2009, in the wake of the global financial crisis. Basel 4 may come one day, but this is not it, they insist.

zh: 那么新一揽子计划究竟试图要解决什么问题？
en: What problem does the new package seek to resolve?

zh: 在序言部分，监管机构提到“银行在定义和计算‘风险加权资产’方面的随意性令人担忧。
en: In the preamble, the regulators refer to “a worrying degree of variability in banks’ calculations of [risk-weighted assets].”

zh: ”他们发现将各主要银行使用的不同内部模型在应用于相同贷款组合时会产生非常不同的数字，这意味着一些银行在承担相同量级风险的情况下准备的资本明显少于其他银行。
en: They have found that applying the major banks’ different internal models to the same portfolio of loans can produce very different numbers, meaning that some banks would be carrying significantly less capital than others for the same quantum of assumed risk.

zh: 人们可能会认为对这个问题的逻辑应对方式是仔细考察各个模型，看看是哪些部分促成了这种差异，并对导致资产过度减少的部分进行校准。
en: The logical answer to that problem, one might think, is to interrogate the models closely, to see what is driving the differences, and demand calibration changes where the resultant asset reductions are deemed excessive.

zh: 但监管机构显然觉得自己没能力深入探究到银行内部模型的核心之处；所以他们实行了所谓的“产出底线 ” 。
en: But the regulators clearly doubt their capacity to penetrate the dark recesses of banks’ internal models; so, instead, they have imposed a so-called “output floor.”

zh: 换句话说，无论模型如何减少风险加权资产，产生的减值都不得超过27.5 ％ 。
en: In other words, however much your model reduces risk-weighted assets, you cannot take credit for more than a 27.5% cut.

zh: 因此产出底线被确定为一个72.5％的净数字，低于此数就是违规。
en: The output floor is expressed as a net figure, of 72.5%, below which you cannot go.

zh: 那么为何会精确到72.5 ％ ？
en: Why the unusually precise figure of 72.5%? The answer is obvious.

zh: 答案是显而易见的 — — 谈判中美国要求定在75％而法国要求70 ％ ， 最后一人让了一步。
en: It is half way between 75%, which was the final US bid, and 70%, which was the French offer. They agreed to split the difference.

zh: 虽然这可能没什么意义，但即便受影响的银行也认为有协议总比没协议好。
en: Although this may make no sense, even affected banks had come to the view that some kind of agreement was better than none.

zh: 由于持续的不确定性使得资本规划变得非常困难，所以银行家们希望能达成一个协议，也接受协议的结果 — — 只求这确实是整个进程的终结。
en: Continuing uncertainty made capital planning very difficult. So bankers favored a deal, and will live with the outcome, if it is genuinely the end of the program.

zh: 不幸的是，这个新协议不太可能为这场资本辩论划清界限。
en: Unfortunately, this new agreement is unlikely to draw a line under the capital debate.

zh: 尽管像英国央行行长兼金融稳定委员会主席马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）这样的高级别中央银行家认为银行体系目前已经拥有足够的资本，但许多人不同意他的看法。
en: Even though senior central bankers like Mark Carney, the Governor of the Bank of England and Chair of the Financial Stability Board, think there is now enough capital in the banking system, many do not share his view.

zh: 斯坦福大学教授阿纳特·阿德玛蒂（Anat Admati）希望资本比率远高于20 ％ 。
en: Anat Admati of Stanford would like capital ratios well above 20%.

zh: 而《金融时报》的马丁·沃尔夫（Martin Wolf）也提出了类似的建议，因为他认为银行仍然处于危险的不稳定状态。
en: Martin Wolf of the Financial Times makes a similar case. He thinks banks are still dangerously unstable.

zh: 英国央行的安迪·霍尔丹（Andy Haldane）指出，鉴于银行净资产的定价较低，在计入市场因素的基础上银行可并不像看起来那样强大。
en: Andy Haldane of the Bank of England points out that, given the low pricing of bank equity, on a market-adjusted basis banks are not as strong as they seem.

zh: 相反，银行家则指出净资产成本已经很高，并认为强迫银行进一步筹资将增加该成本进而减少可用信贷。
en: Bankers, by contrast, point to the high cost of equity and argue that forcing banks to raise even more will increase the cost and decrease the availability of credit.

zh: 在欧洲，大约一半的资本比率改善来自贷款减少而非增加新股权的增加。
en: In Europe, around half of the improvement in capital ratios has come from reducing lending rather than raising new equity.

zh: 对此两个阵营的想法之间基本上没有什么交集。
en: There is little meeting of minds between the two camps.

zh: 对此威廉·克莱恩（William Cline）试图为银行资本的适当水平提供一个理论基础而撰写的《银行的正确平衡》一书为我们缓解了焦虑。
en: So it was a relief to encounter William Cline’s book The Right Balance for Banks, which attempts to produce a rationale for the appropriate level of bank capital.

zh: 在进行了广泛的研究和市场分析后，克莱恩认为要求银行持有更多资本确实会在一定程度上增加信贷成本。
en: Drawing on a wide range of research and market analysis, Cline argues that requiring banks to hold more capital does indeed increase the cost of credit to some extent.

zh: 虽然有证据表明在净资产较高的情况下银行贷款会更便宜，也是符合逻辑的，但是这种成本降低并不是一一对应的。
en: Although there is some evidence that bank debt is cheaper if equity backing is high, which one would expect, the reduction is not one for one.

zh: 而信贷成本的增加却可能会抑制增长并导致福利损失。
en: And an increase in the cost of credit is likely to depress growth and generate welfare losses.

zh: 另一方面，银行净资产的提高会降低银行破产的发生率，而倒闭会给经济和个人带来极高成本。
en: On the other hand, higher equity for banks will reduce the incidence of bank failures, which impose high costs on the economy and on individuals.

zh: 减少危机的数量和严重程度显然是人们所期望的。
en: Reducing the number and severity of crises is evidently desirable.

zh: 因此克莱恩试图在认识到将银行破产风险降低到零可能带来非理性高成本的情况下计算出最佳平衡点在哪里。
en: So Cline attempts to calculate where the optimal balance might lie, recognizing that to reduce the risk of bank failure to zero might carry irrationally high costs.

zh: 他的结论是“最佳资本比率是总资产的7％到8 ％ ， 相当于风险加权资产的12％到14 ％ （ 使用风险加权资产与欧元区及美国各大银行总资产的比率 ） ” 。
en: Cline’s conclusion is that “the optimal capital ratio is 7% to 8% of total assets, corresponding to 12% to 14% of risk-weighted assets (using the ratio of risk-weighted assets to total assets in euro area and US banks).”

zh: 实际上，这些数字与各国监管机构在巴塞尔新要求下制定的比率非常接近。
