en: These figures are, in fact, quite close to the numbers underlying the new Basel requirements as implemented by national regulators.

zh: 例如，大多数英国的银行现在都把标准定在13％这个比率，而且通常会多持有一点资本来“保平安 ” 。
en: Most British banks, for example, are now targeting a requirement of 13%, and typically carry a bit more “for luck.”

zh: 克莱恩的方法在直觉上很吸引人。
en: Cline’s approach is intuitively appealing.

zh: 他认识到这个比率可能会顺理成章地被应用到那些因“太大而不能倒”而臭名昭著的系统重要性银行身上。
en: He recognizes that the ratio might reasonably be shaded up for systemically important banks, those famously dubbed “too big to fail.”

zh: 在我受训的监管学校 — — 英格兰银行 — — 我们被告知永远不要使用那个致命的短语，担心因此产生我们恰恰希望避免的道德风险。
en: In the regulatory school where I was trained – the Bank of England – we were told never to use that fatal phrase, for fear of generating precisely the moral hazard we wished to avoid.

zh: 但是危机后的世界却仍未摆脱这个短语所带来的风险。
en: But there is no getting away from it in the post-crisis world.

zh: 克莱恩的辛勤工作会终结这场辩论吗？
en: Will Cline’s hard work end the debate?

zh: 我对此表示怀疑。
en: I doubt it.

zh: 即使是现在，我还会听到清算被制止，统计模型被重新计算。
en: Even now, I hear axes being ground, and statistical models being recalculated.

zh: 同时也没有人会赞成去缓解大银行的压力。
en: And there are still no votes in taking the pressure off big banks.

zh: 中央银行家需要打醒精神，银行家们也得管好自己，否则一个真正的巴塞尔4就可能会在莱茵河边降临。
en: The central bankers will need to hold their nerve, and the bankers themselves to behave, or a genuine Basel 4 may hove into view on the banks of the Rhine.

zh: 最低工资还是过活所得？
en: Minimum Wage or Living Income?

zh: 伦敦—如今，大部分富裕国家都存在几百万“工作的穷人 ” — —工作收入无法让他们生活在贫困线以上，因此必须领国家补贴的人。
en: LONDON – Most rich countries now have millions of “working poor” – people whose jobs do not pay enough to keep them above the poverty line, and whose wages therefore have to be subsidized by the state.

zh: 这些补贴以税收优惠的形式发放。
en: These subsidies take the form of tax credits.

zh: 这一思想由来已久。
en: The idea is a very old one.

zh: 英国在拿破仑战争期间就实行了“斯宾汉兰 ” （ Speenhamland）制度，这是一种户外救济（outdoor relief ） ， 旨在抵消面包涨价的影响。
en: England implemented its “Speenhamland” system – a form of outdoor relief intended to offset rising bread prices – during the Napoleonic Wars.

zh: 1795年，斯宾汉兰（位于伯克夏的一个村庄）当局批准了一项根据资产状况调查发放的按比例工资补贴方案。
en: In 1795, the authorities of Speenhamland, a village in Berkshire, authorized a means-tested sliding scale of wage supplements.

zh: 家庭所获补贴额根据孩子数量和面包价格的不同而不同。
en: The supplements that families received varied with the number of children and the price of bread.

zh: 但该机制受到了批评，被认为这让雇主支付低于生存水平线的工资，因为纳税人会补偿差额。
en: But the scheme was criticized for allowing employers to pay below-subsistence wages, because the taxpayer would make up the difference.

zh: 1834年，斯宾汉兰制度被新济贫法（New Poor Law）取代，新济贫法规定救济只限于救济院，并且需要满足非常苛刻的条件以迫使人们回到劳动力市场。
en: In 1834, the Speenhamland system was replaced by the New Poor Law, which confined relief to workhouses, under conditions sufficiently odious to force people back into the labor market.

zh: 接着，在二十世纪，斯宾汉兰原则复兴 — — 推动者不是别人，正是自由市场自由派米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman ） 。
en: Then, in the twentieth century, the Speenhamland principle was revived – and by none other than the free-market liberal Milton Friedman.

zh: 1962年，弗里德曼提出实施一种“负所得税 ” ， 收入低于一定阈值的人从政府获得补偿性收入而无需为缴纳所得税。
en: In 1962, Friedman proposed a “negative income tax,” whereby people earning below a certain threshold would receive supplemental income from the government, rather than paying taxes to it.

zh: 他的思想是让人们不再去领救济而是回去工作。
en: The idea was to get people off the dole and back to work.

zh: 该思想在美国和英国分别以“劳动所得税抵扣 ” （ Earned Income Tax Credit）和“工作家庭税收减免 ” （ Working Families Tax Credit）的形式实施。
en: It was implemented as the Earned Income Tax Credit in the United States and the Working Families Tax Credit in the United Kingdom.

zh: 与此同时，人们还采取措施通过设立最低工资法提高劳动所得。
en: At the same time, there have been efforts to raise the level of earned income by setting minimum-wage legislation.

zh: 但最低工资从未达到“过活所得”下限，因此也从未很好地降低工资补贴规模。
en: But the minimum wage has never reached the floor set for a “living income” and has not, therefore, appreciably reduced the bill for wage subsidies.

zh: 2008年，大约550万英国工作家庭获得税收减免，包括工作和儿童减免、住房补贴和地税补贴。
en: In 2008, about 5.5 million working families in the UK received tax credits, including working and child credits, housing benefits, and local tax benefits.

zh: 紧缩政策将这一人群的数量减少到430万。
en: Austerity policies have reduced this number to 4.3 million.

zh: 2012年英国工作家庭数为1,140万户，因此这意味着有令人吃惊的38%的家庭无法获得“过活工资 ” 。
en: Given that there were 11.4 million working households in the UK in 2012, this means that an astonishing 38% did not receive a “living wage.”

zh: 或者，换句话说，市场出清工资水平无法为38%的工作家庭提供过活所得。
en: Or, to put it another way: the market-clearing wage was unable to provide a living income for 38% of working families.

zh: 他们是“工作的穷人 ” 。
en: These are the “working poor.”

zh: 在7月8日的预算公告中，英国财政大臣奥斯本（George Osborne）提出要在未来四年削减120英镑福利支出，作为其削减赤字计划的一部分。
en: In his July 8 budget announcement, Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne proposed to cut £12 billion ($18.6 billion) from the welfare bill over the next four years as part of his deficit-cutting plan.

zh: 其中90亿英镑将来自工作家庭税收补贴削减。
en: Of this, £9 billion will come from cutting the tax subsidies for working families.

zh: 为了抵消这一削减的影响，奥斯本计划将同期最低工资从时薪6.50英镑提高到9英镑。
en: To offset this cut, Osborne proposed to raise the minimum wage from £6.50 per hour to £9 per hour over the same period.

zh: 这一提薪的成本将由雇主而非公家承担，因此税收减免和福利的净削减等于是国库的净增��。
en: The increase will fall on employers, not the public purse, and so the reduction in credits and benefits is a net gain for Her Majesty’s Treasury.

zh: 财政研究中心（Institute for Fiscal Studies，IFS）的分析认为，国库将节约120亿英镑，而提高最低工资所导致的薪酬总增量仅为40亿英镑。
en: An analysis by the Institute for Fiscal Studies has concluded that while the Treasury will save £12 billion, the gross increase in pay from the higher minimum wage amounts to only £4 billion.

zh: IFS主管保罗·约翰逊（Paul Johnson）说 ： “ 投入新最低工资的钱远远无法达到能够用现金补偿人们税收减免损失的程度。 ”
en: As Paul Johnson, head of the IFS, put it: “There is simply not enough money going into the new minimum wage to anywhere near compensate in cash terms people on tax credits.”

zh: 但即使最低工资提高到足以抵消取消税收减免的影响的程度，将更多的劳动力成本从纳税人头上转嫁到雇主头上也是错误的战略。
en: But even if the minimum wage were raised sufficiently to offset the withdrawal of tax credits, transferring more of the cost of labor from taxpayers to employers would be the wrong strategy.

zh: 原因在于，对许多人 — — 也许是大部分人来说，工作是一个日薄西山的收入源。
en: The reason is that for many – perhaps most – people, work will be a declining source of income.

zh: 毕竟，一个关于我们放心依赖什么的预言说，自动化将进军越来越多的人类工作领域。
en: After all, one prediction on which we can confidently rely is that automation will make increasingly large inroads into the world of human work.

zh: 最高有50%的现有工作可能在未来20年内告急。
en: Up to 50% of existing jobs may be at risk in the next 20 years.

zh: 能否找到足够多的新岗位替代他们，或者，仅仅为了向人类提供工资越来越少的就业机会而继续生产越来越多的产品是否值得追求，这个问题还不好说。
en: It is at least an open question whether enough new jobs can be found to replace them, or, indeed, whether it is desirable to continue producing more and more products simply to provide human employment at ever shrinking wages.

zh: 随着机器人日益取代人类劳动，人类需要取代劳动所得的收入源。
en: As robots increasingly replace human labor, humans will need incomes to replace wages from work. Whereas tax credits point in the direction of replacement incomes, raising the minimum wage points in the opposite direction, by making income more dependent on jobs.

zh: 税收减免指向替代性所得，而提高最低工资的指向与此正好相反，让所得更加依赖于工作。
en: In fact, focusing on the minimum wage would almost certainly speed up the automation process. Previous evidence that minimum-wage legislation does not reduce the demand for labor might not stand up against the rapidly falling cost of automating the production of goods and services.

zh: 简言之，如果奥斯本认真对待其为所有人提供“过活所得”的承诺，他就应该致力于推广独立于就业市场的“基本”或“公民”所得。
en: In short, if Osborne is serious about his pledge to provide a “living income” for all, he should be moving toward the idea of a “basic” or “citizen’s” income, independent of the job market.

zh: 一个简单的方法是向所有公民提供无条件税收减免，该政策可以随着工作收入的逐渐下降而建立起来。
en: A simple way forward would be to provide all citizens an unconditional tax credit, which could be built up gradually as the rewards from work fall.

zh: 长期以来，自由市场和社会主义思想家都在鼓吹实施基本所得机制。
en: Both free-market and socialist thinkers have long advocated implementing a basic-income scheme.

zh: 但该思想永远面临着两个局限：社会太穷，负担不起这样的机制；并且这样的机制会鼓励人不去工作。
en: But the idea has always fallen foul of two objections: societies are too poor to afford it, and it would be a disincentive to work.

zh: 第一个局限显然已经不适用于发达经济体，而第二个局限无关紧要，因为目标不是激励人们去工作，而是让人们可以脱离工作生活。
en: The first objection is surely no longer true of the advanced economies, while the second is irrelevant, given that the goal is not to strengthen the incentive to work, but to enable people to live without work.

zh: 无条件基本所得能够让兼职工作成为许多目前必须在无法过活的工资水平上从事全职工作的人的一种可能。
en: An unconditional basic income would make part-time work a possibility for many who now have to work full-time at non-living wages.

zh: 而所有工人都可以开始获得做出关于工作多少、在什么环境下工作的选择的自由。 这一自由如今为大量资本所有者所独有。
en: And all workers would begin to gain the freedom to make the same choices regarding how much to work, and under what conditions, that owners of substantial capital now have.

zh: 天上掉馅饼的全民基本收入设想
en: The Pie-in-the-Sky UBI

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 硅谷的流行观点认为机器人将很快蚕食掉所有人的工作，而为全民发放基本收入的政策将因此变得必要。
en: BERKELEY – According to the conventional wisdom in Silicon Valley, robots will soon eat everyone’s job, and a universal basic income will become necessary.

zh: 最近，各大科技巨头都在大肆吹捧一个肯尼亚全民基本收入试点项目的成果，而该项目主要是由硅谷慈善家资助的。
en: Lately, tech titans are especially eager to extol the results of a UBI pilot project in Kenya that is being funded largely by Silicon Valley philanthropists.

zh: 虽然全民基本收入的想法经常会在经济和社会压力山大的时期冒头，但上述项目才是对其的第一次实测。
en: While the idea of UBI often arises during periods of economic and social stress, this is the first true test of it.

zh: 肯尼亚项目为测试者提供了一个足以摆脱贫困的收入。
en: The Kenya project provides a guaranteed poverty-ending income for those who receive it.

zh: 分属40个偏远贫困村的6,000名成年人每天能领取75美分（没错，是美分 ） — —折合每月22美元 — — 连续领12年。
en: In 40 poor, remote villages, 6,000 adults are now receiving 75 cents (yes, cents) per day – or $22 per month for 12 years.

zh: 我们希望在肯尼亚的实验能够成功。
en: We hope that the experiment in Kenya works.

zh: 现金援助在消除发展中国家极端贫困方面的表现出很大的前景。
en: Cash assistance shows much promise for eliminating extreme poverty in developing countries.

zh: 但是如果要确保有效，就必须在持续的时间段内将足够的金额直接发放给那些有需要的人。
en: But, to be effective, it must be delivered directly to those in need over a sustained period of time, and in adequate amounts.

zh: 在贫穷的发展中国家，全民基本收入项目可以胜过那些既不能满足目标人群需求又往往遭到腐败政权阻挠的昂贵援助计划。
en: In poor developing countries, a UBI can disintermediate expensive aid programs that fail to address the targeted population’s needs, and that are often undermined by corrupt regimes.

zh: 不过硅谷的巨头应该稍微遏制自身的热情。
en: Still, Silicon Valley’s titans should curb their enthusiasm.

zh: 肯尼亚的全民基本收入项目依赖M-Pesa系统 — — 它是一个在对外援助，私人企业和前瞻性政府 — — 而非善意慈善家 — — 的支持下构建的盈利性移动银行系统。
en: The Kenya UBI relies on M-Pesa, a for-profit mobile banking system that was built with the support of foreign aid, private companies, and a forward-looking government – not well-meaning philanthropists.

zh: 即使全民基本收入项目能在未来12年中在肯尼亚取得成功，也并非解决当前美国经济中紧迫问题的办法。
en: And even if a UBI succeeds in Kenya over the next 12 years, it is not a solution to pressing problems in the US economy today.

zh: 在美国搞全民基本收入项目就像特朗普总统的边界墙一样天马行空：一方面昂贵到无力维持；另一方面又无法解决其想要解决的问题。
en: A UBI for the United States is as fanciful as President Donald Trump’s border wall: it would be prohibitively expensive; and it would not solve the problems that it is meant to address.

zh: 最糟糕的是，全民基本收入的提案会导致人们故意去忽略一些紧迫问题：诸如在儿童和少数种族和民族群体中的持续贫困状况；大多数家庭实际（计入通胀后）工资和收入的停滞不前；收入差距的持续扩大；社会流动性下降；教育机会的不平等；还有伴随不稳定就业而产生的收入不稳定。
en: Worst of all, UBI proposals are disingenuous distractions from such immediate problems as persistent poverty, especially for children and racial and ethnic minorities; stagnant real (inflation-adjusted) wages and incomes for most households; expanding income inequality; declining social mobility; inequalities in educational opportunities; and the income volatility that comes with erratic employment.

zh: 技术的进步还未显著减少美国的总体就业岗位，但肯定降低了数百万劳动者的工作质量。
en: Technology has not yet significantly reduced the overall number of jobs in the US, but it has certainly undermined job quality for millions of workers.

zh: 新技术正逐步消灭那些常规性的手工和中等认知技能工作，加剧了劳动收入的不平等，也是总体收入不平等的最重要来源。
en: New technologies are wiping out routine manual and cognitive middle-skill jobs, and exacerbating labor-income inequalities, the most important source of overall income inequalities.

zh: 但是这一系列问题是否就表明每个美国人，包括那些技能和收入已经被高度依赖技巧且节省劳动力的技术变革所补足和提升的硅谷“超级巨星”们，都该得到一份基本收入？
en: But does this litany of problems justify a basic income for every working American, including Silicon Valley “superstars,” whose skills and incomes have been complemented and enhanced by skill-biased, labor-saving technological change?

zh: 即使为每个美国成年人的全民基本收入是个理想的目标，也没有人提出过资助其实施的严肃提案。
en: Even if a UBI for every American adult was a desirable goal, no serious proposal for funding it exists.

zh: 在肯尼亚，每月22美元的付款可能已经可以很好地消除贫困；但在将成年人贫困线定在年收入1.27万美元（2016年官方标准）的美国，这点钱根本不算钱。
en: In Kenya, a $22 monthly payment might very well eradicate poverty; but it would be “chump change” in the US, where the official poverty line for an adult in 2016 was $12,700 per year.

zh: 如果每年要每个美国成年人发放1万美元的基本收入，总费用将高达3万亿美元以上，相当于花掉了联邦年度预算的3/4。
en: Each year, a $10,000 basic income for every American adult would cost more than $3 trillion, consuming more than three-quarters of the annual federal budget.

zh: 这将需要有史以来最高昂的税收体系，但我们很少听到富裕的全民基本收入倡导者呼吁为自己加税。
en: This would require historically high taxes, and yet we rarely hear wealthy UBI advocates calling for their taxes to be raised.

zh: 他们更有可能主张削减现有的社会福利支出，例如那些令包括儿童在内的占总人口数量2/5的底层民众受益的社会保障和其他计划。
en: They are more likely to advocate cutting existing social-welfare spending, such as Social Security and other programs that benefit the bottom two-fifths of the population, including children.

zh: 在我们等待肯尼亚全民基本收入试点的结果并预测智能机器人将来会消灭工作的同时，我们需要对那些应对工人当前面临挑战的现有项目进行升级和强化。
en: While we await the results of the Kenyan UBI pilot and anticipate the future destruction of jobs by intelligent robots, we need to modernize and strengthen existing programs that address the challenges workers face today.

zh: 包括与就业相关的培训和终身学习机会在内的各层次优质教育体系对于培养那些劳动力市场急需但需要大量投资的技能至关重要。
en: Quality education at all levels, including job-relevant training and lifelong learning opportunities, are critical to provide the skills that labor markets demand, but require significant investment.

zh: 此外还需要一些转型援助项目来帮助工人及其家庭应付就业和收入上的波动。
en: Transition-assistance programs, to help workers and their families cope with employment and income disruptions, also will be needed.

zh: 在硅谷 ， “ 破坏”意味着积极的变化；但在现实中，破坏意味着那些生计受到新技术影响的人将遭受实质性的痛苦。
en: In Silicon Valley, “disruption” connotes positive change; in reality, disruption inflicts substantial pain on those whose livelihoods are upended by new technology.

zh: 美国当前的保障项目 — — 如医疗补助，失业补偿，营养补充援助计划和有需要家庭临时援助 — — 也应该加大力度。
en: In the US, current programs – such as Medicaid, unemployment compensation, the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), and Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) – should be made more generous.

zh: 此外，美国应制定一个国家层面的全民收入保险计划，以帮助因失业，残疾，疾病或家庭成员死亡而面临财政困境的人。
en: In addition, the US should develop a national, universal income-insurance program to assist those facing financial insecurity as a result of unemployment, disability, illness, or the death of a family member.

zh: 同时，随着越来越多劳动者从事独立工作，就有需要用一个覆盖所有工人（无论有没雇主）的流动性福利体系来取代当前以雇佣为基础的福利体系。
en: Meanwhile, as a larger share of the workforce engages in independent work, the current employment-based benefits system will need to be replaced with a portable benefits system that covers all workers, regardless of employer.

zh: 美国还需要提高联邦最低工资额。
en: Americans also need a higher federal minimum wage.

zh: 如果要实现最低工资与生产率同步增长的话，今天的工资应当接近19美元每小时，而不是7.25美元。
en: Had the minimum wage kept pace with rising productivity, it would be nearly $19 per hour today, instead of $7.25.

zh: 在获得最低工资的工人中，一半以上是妇女，其中许多人的大部分收入来源是小费，因为政府允许餐馆支付令人震惊的2.13美元/小时最低工资。
en: Among workers earning the minimum wage, more than half are women, and many of them depend on tipping for the bulk of their income, as restaurants are permitted to pay a shockingly low minimum wage of $2.13 per hour.

zh: 大多数美国人都支持提高最低工资，有7位诺贝尔经济学奖得主也表示赞成；希望硅谷的那些全民基本收入倡导者们也能如此。
en: A majority of Americans support raising the minimum wage, as do seven Nobel laureates in economics; one hopes that Silicon Valley’s UBI proselytizers do, too.

zh: 最后，美国应该开始为那些因自动化而丢失工作或扣减工资的工人研究制定一个包含经济状况调查的收入补贴计划。
en: Finally, America should start to develop a means-tested income supplement for workers whose jobs are displaced, or whose wages are undercut, by automation.

zh: 为此，以收入为基础的所得税应该被慷慨的负所得税所取代，这是经济学家米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）几十年前提出的一个想法 — — 当时机器人还只是科幻小说里的玩意儿。
en: To that end, the earned-income tax credit should be replaced by a generous negative income tax – an idea that the economist Milton Friedman proposed decades ago, when robots were still the stuff of science fiction.

zh: 与全民基本收入不一样的是，负所得税会催生强大的工作激励，可以提升数百万低工资劳动者的实际收入。
en: A negative income tax – which, unlike a UBI, provides a powerful incentive to work – could raise the take-home pay of millions of workers employed in low-wage jobs.

zh: 其中许多是“护理”和其他“个人服务类”工作，这些工作预计将是未来十年增长最快的职业之一，而机器人也不可能“消灭”它们。
en: Many of these are “care” and other “personal services” jobs, which are projected to be among the fastest-growing occupations in the next decade – and which robots are unlikely to “disrupt.”

zh: 正如泰迪·罗斯福所说 ， “ 生活所能提供的最好奖励就是有机会在一份有意义的工作中努力奋斗。
en: As Teddy Roosevelt said, “Far and away the best prize that life offers is the chance to work hard at work worth doing.”

zh: ”今天的政策重点应该是那些支付足量工资的有价值工作，而不是针对后工作时代的不切实际方案。
en: The focus of policy today should be on worthwhile work that pays a living wage, not starry-eyed proposals for a post-work future.

zh: 在罗马尼亚猎熊
en: Bear Hunting in Romania

zh: 纽约 — — 尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库酷爱猎熊。
en: NEW YORK – Nicolae Ceausescu liked to hunt bear.

zh: 他常常和随行人员一道躲进特兰西瓦尼亚的小木屋，从那里全副武装出发去猎熊。
en: With his retinue, he would retreat to a lodge in Transylvania and sally forth, locked and loaded.

zh: 因为事先采取了周密的防范措施，他已经习惯了好运随身。
en: He was accustomed to good fortune, for his huntsmen took precautions.

zh: 工作人员会把一头可怜的动物绑在树上，事先麻醉以防止它乱动，然后自己躲进射击死角，静候着伟人开枪猎熊。
en: They would chain some poor beast to a tree, drug it to keep it still, and conceal themselves around the blind from which the Great Man would shoot.

zh: 有一天，他们在执行任务时出现了险情。
en: One day, they did their job haphazardly.

zh: 齐奥塞斯库举枪瞄准，但没有完全麻醉的熊后腿立起像要发动进攻，齐奥塞斯库仰面朝天跌倒在地。
en: Ceausescu took aim, then fell backward when the bear, inadequately sedated, reared on its hind legs as if to attack.

zh: 他猎枪里的子弹飞上了树梢，与此同时却有三颗子弹射入了黑熊的心脏，开枪的是保护独裁者安全的狙击手。
en: His shot flew into the treetops, even as three bullets entered the bear’s heart from the snipers who guaranteed the dictator’s marksmanship.

zh: 今天，我从一位声称目睹了事件全过程的护林人口中了解了事情的真相，齐奥塞斯库并没有对随行人员的精彩表现予以嘉奖。
en: This day, I was told by a forester who claimed to have witnessed the incident, Ceausescu did not acknowledge the applause of his retainers.

zh: 这个故事与20年前的罗马尼亚革命非常相像。
en: This could be the story of the Romanian revolution, 20 years ago.

zh: 黑熊代表了这个国家被奴役的民众。
en: The bear is the country’s enslaved people.

zh: 他们从沉睡中醒来。
en: They rise up from slumber.

zh: 大吃一惊的君主疯狂射击，却没有打中目标。
en: The emperor, alarmed, fires wildly and misses his mark.

zh: 隐藏在森林里的神枪手瞄准开枪，只是这一次他们的目标不是黑熊，而是齐奥塞斯库本人。
en: The sharpshooters hidden in the forest take aim and fire, only this time their target is not the bear, but Ceausescu himself.

zh: 与法国大革命以恐怖告终如出一辙的是，1989年这个神奇的东欧年份也以血腥收场。
en: Just as the glory of the French Revolution ended in the Terror, so Eastern Europe’s miracle year of 1989 ended in blood.

zh: 在其他国家，共产党政府几乎都是仓惶出逃。
en: Elsewhere, communist regimes seemed almost to run from power.

zh: 将他们赶下台的民众为庆祝这几乎兵不血刃得来的胜利而载歌载舞。
en: The people who deposed them celebrated largely painless victories.

zh: 但在罗马尼亚却不是这样。
en: Not so in Romania.

zh: 这个国家的共产党领导人命令安全部队对民众开枪。
en: There, the country’s communist masters ordered the security forces to fire on the people.

zh: 军队服从了他们的命令。
en: They obeyed.

zh: 罗马尼亚陷入了短暂的内战。
en: A civil war was fought, albeit briefly.

zh: 革命演变为一次秘密的军事政变。
en: Revolution transmuted into a crypto-coup d’état.

zh: 政变始于12月中旬蒂米什瓦拉这个靠近匈牙利边境的工业重镇。
en: It began in mid-December in the gritty industrial town of Timisoara, close to the Hungarian border.

zh: 当齐奥塞斯库命令军队向敢于反抗者展示力量时，指挥官们按照字面意思执行了指令：他们组织了一次检阅，让军队在军乐团的鼓点中行进。
en: When Ceausescu ordered the military to stage a show of force against those who dared oppose him, commanders took him literally: they put on a parade, complete with marching band.

zh: 在独裁者的怒火面前闹剧迅速演变成为一场悲剧。
en: Farce quickly turned to tragedy in the face of the dictator’s rage.

zh: “我指的是坦克，你们这帮笨蛋 ， ” 他对尤利安·弗拉德将军说，甚至威胁如果敢于违抗命令就将其就地正法。
en: “I meant tanks, you fool,” he said, in effect, to Gen. Iulian Vlad, threatening to put him in front of a firing squad if he did not comply.

zh: 那一晚，大概100多名罗马尼亚公民死在了街上，此外还有数百人受伤。
en: That night, roughly a hundred Romanian citizens died in the streets, and hundreds more were wounded.

zh: 接下来就是那段尽人皆知的历史。
en: The rest is well-known history.

zh: 12月21日清晨，齐奥塞斯库站在布加勒斯特市中心中央委员会的阳台上发表群众讲话 — — 罗马尼亚工人骨干按照惯例集中起来，在接到信号时欢呼鼓掌。
en: On the morning of December 21, Ceausescu stepped onto the balcony of the Central Committee in the heart of Bucharest to address the people – cadres of state workers assembled, as was customary, to cheer on cue.

zh: 但这一次计划并未执行得天衣无缝。
en: But something went wrong.

zh: 从人群的后方传来呐喊 ： “ 蒂米什瓦拉！
en: From the rear of the huge crowd came shouts: “Ti-mi-soara!

zh: 蒂米什瓦拉！
en: Ti-mi-soara!”

zh: ”接着传来了致命的呐喊，开始时可能只有一两个人，但很快其他人就开始加入喊话 ： “ 打倒齐奥塞斯库！ ”
en: Then came the fateful call, shouted by perhaps one or two people but soon picked up by others: “Down with Ceausescu!”

zh: 齐奥塞斯库从未听到过类似的口号。
en: Never had Ceausescu heard anything like it.

zh: 他的脸越拉越长。
en: His face sagged.

zh: 他在慌乱中停止了讲话，胆怯而迷惑不解地挥舞着臂膀，这是江湖骗子虚弱而徒劳的姿态。
en: Flustered, he stopped speaking, waved his arms in timid bewilderment, the weak and ineffectual gestures of an imposter.

zh: 真相大爆发的时刻只持续了几秒钟，但已经足够了。
en: This moment of truth lasted only a few seconds, but it was enough.

zh: 他毫无掩饰地站在当场。
en: He stood revealed.

zh: 亲临广场和收看电视转播的每一个人都看得清清楚楚。
en: Everyone on the square and everyone watching on national TV saw clearly.

zh: 皇帝被剥光了新装。
en: The emperor had no clothes.

zh: 第二天，反抗运动蔓延到所有的重要城市。
en: By the next day, rebellion had spread to all major cities.

zh: 齐奥塞斯库和他的夫人，臭名昭著的埃列娜·齐奥塞斯库在人群如潮水般涌入中央委员会时乘坐一架白色直升机从屋顶出逃。
en: Ceausescu and his wife, the infamous Elena, fled from the roof of the Central Committee aboard a white helicopter as crowds stormed the building.

zh: 支持民众的部队和忠于齐奥塞斯库的秘密警察部队爆发了枪战。
en: Fighting erupted between the army, siding with the people, and elements of the secret police loyal to Ceausescu.

zh: 狙击手从屋顶开枪射击，坦克在今天的革命广场爆炸，致使国家图书馆失火。
en: Snipers shot from the rooftops, and tanks blasted away in what today is Revolution Square, setting the national library ablaze.

zh: 经过三天的追捕行动，在圣诞节当天，独裁者和他的夫人被捕并接受了袋鼠“人民法院”的审判，而后被迅速执行枪决。
en: After a three-day chase, on Christmas Day, the dictator and his wife were captured, tried, and summarily executed by a kangaroo “people’s court.”

zh: 革命或许从来就不是看起来的样子，但罗马尼亚这场革命尤其模糊。
en: Revolutions are probably never as they seem, but Romania’s was especially ambiguous.

zh: 因为从齐奥塞斯库讲话那一刻起，革命就分成了两条支线 — — 一条在街道上公开上演，另一条则是精英人士为争权夺利上演的一场不为人知的深层次战斗。
en: For, at the moment of Ceausescu’s speech, it became in effect two revolutions – one that played out publicly in the streets, and the other a deep and behind-the-scenes struggle for power among elites.

zh: 12月26日革命已经蔓延到布加勒斯特。
en: I sensed this arriving in Bucharest on December 26.

zh: 在走访被名为救国阵线的临时政府所占领的电视台时，我发现革命领袖的身份令人奇怪的鱼龙混杂。
en: Visiting the television station, seized by a new provisional government called the National Salvation Front, I found an odd mélange of revolutionary leaders.

zh: 我能理解他们中有诗人、学生、持不同政见者和所谓不满的政府官员。
en: I could understand the poets, students, dissidents, and allegedly disaffected government officials.

zh: 但怎么会有在蒂米什瓦拉指挥军队的陆军参谋长斯特凡·格鲁泽？
en: But Gen. Stefan Gruse, the army chief of staff who commanded the troops in Timisoara?

zh: 新任命的总统伊利埃斯库居然曾经负责齐奥塞斯库的宣传工作？
en: The newly appointed president, Ion Iliescu, who was Ceausescu’s former chief propagandist?

zh: 也许最不协调的是将军维克托·斯滕库列斯库，他是齐奥塞斯库最宠信的人物，就在几天前，他还被报导组织了从中央委员会楼顶的撤退活动。
en: Perhaps the most incongruous presence was Gen. Victor Stanculescu, a favorite of the Ceausescu’s who only days before had reportedly organized their evacuation from the rooftop of the Central Committee.

zh: 其他报导称他其后组织了齐奥塞斯库夫妇的审判并安排了行刑小组 — — 当时法律程序甚至还没有正式启动。
en: Other reports credited him with subsequently organizing both their trial and a firing squad – even before the legal proceedings began.

zh: “审判”本身持续时间不到1个小时。
en: The “trial” itself lasted less than an hour.

zh: 在宣读判决仅仅7分钟后，行刑者就枪决了齐奥塞斯库夫妇。
en: Scarcely seven minutes after the sentence was read out, had the executioners done their work.

zh: 有人对这次审判过程进行了录像，第二天在惊得目瞪口呆的公众面前播出，但在一片混乱中摄影师的电线被从墙上拉下，当时宣判完毕的齐奥塞斯库夫妇正被拖到室外的空场上。
en: The event was videotaped, to be aired to an astonished nation the next day, but in the rush the cameraman’s power cable was yanked from the wall as the convicted couple was dragged out to an open-air courtyard.

zh: 等到摄影师赶上的时候，士兵们已经在开枪。
en: By the time he caught up, soldiers were already shooting.

zh: 尼古拉·齐奥塞斯库仰面朝天躺在地上，身上穿着逃跑时穿的外衣和套装。 他的蓝眼睛毫无神采地盯着天空。
en: Nicolae Ceausescu lay on his back, in the overcoat and suit in which he had fled, his blue-grey eyes staring vacantly at the sky.

zh: 埃列娜已经昏死过去，就在昏倒的地方被行刑者开枪处决。
en: Elena had fainted and was shot where she lay.

zh: 以邻为壑外汇政策？
en: Beggar-Thy-Neighbor Exchange Rates?

zh: 日内瓦报道－当瑞士国家银行（简称“瑞行 ” ） 最近将利率下调到0.25 % ， 该行宣布其将实行“定额放松”政策，实则是在紧跟美联储与英格兰银行所实行的措施。
en: GENEVA – When the Swiss National Bank (SNB) recently brought its interest rate down to 0.25%, it announced that it would engage in “quantitative easing,” following in the footsteps of the United States Federal Reserve and the Bank of England.

zh: 更让人吃惊的是，瑞行同时宣布其将干涉外汇市场，旨在逆转瑞士法郎的升值问题。
en: More surprising was the simultaneous announcement that it was intervening on the foreign-exchange market with the aim of reversing the appreciation of the franc.

zh: 在目前这场货币竞相贬值的战争中，瑞行的措施能成为发起攻势的先行者吗？
en: Will this be the first salvo in a war of competitive devaluations?

zh: 一贯以来，瑞士的利率就不高。
en: Interest rates are traditionally low in Switzerland.

zh: 如同其它在经济萧条中抗争的国家中央银行，瑞行将其政策性的利率一路降到零利率下限。
en: Like most other central banks confronted with the recession, the SNB has reduced its policy interest rate all the way to the zero lower bound.

zh: 一旦出现这种情况，惯常实行的货币政策就无法抵抗危机，因为利率工具不再发挥其作用。
en: Once there, traditional monetary policy becomes impotent, as the interest-rate tool is no longer usable.

zh: 这也是为什么各国的中央银行现在都在想方设法采取新的方法。
en: This is why central banks are now searching for new instruments.

zh: “定额放松”就代表这样一种尝试。
en: Quantitative easing represents one such attempt.

zh: 但该措施能够有效地恢复某些货币政策的影响力，还需继续观察。
en: It remains to be seen whether it can effectively restore some monetary-policy influence.

zh: 然而，一个重要的问题却很少被提到：在小而开放的经济体（这种描述适合于几乎任何国家，除了美国）中，货币政策的主要渠道是汇率。
en: However, an important issue is rarely mentioned: in small, open economies – a description that applies to almost every country except the US – the main channel of monetary policy is the exchange rate.

zh: 这种渠道被忽略，其中有个很好的理由，即从根本上讲，汇率政策实际上就是“以邻为壑”政策。
en: This channel is ignored for one good reason: exchange-rate policies are fundamentally of the beggar-thy-neighbor variety.

zh: 从专业上来讲，旨在弱化汇率的各项非传统政策是又可能达到零利率的，并且在单个（非联盟）国家更能发挥其作用。
en: Unconventional policies that aim at weakening the exchange rate are technically possible even at zero interest rates, and they are quite likely to be effective at the level of individual countries.

zh: 通过汇率贬值来加强货币竞争在世界贸易快速萎缩的情况下也许无法提升出口额，但这种措施能通过将需求转化到对本国产品与服务上，从而减少经济打击的力度。
en: Boosting competitiveness through exchange-rate depreciation may not succeed in raising exports in a situation where world trade is rapidly contracting, but it can cushion the blow by switching demand toward domestically produced goods and services.

zh: 这其中的风险是，在转化过程中蒙受损失的那些国家最终还是要以货币贬值为代价。
en: The risk is that those countries that suffer from the switch retaliate and depreciate their own currencies.

zh: 这样就会容易引发一场由货币竞相贬值而向大萧条时代的回归，这是最让人担惊受怕的。
en: That could easily trigger a return to the much-feared competitive depreciations that contributed to the Great Depression.

zh: 这样将引发一些损失。
en: The first casualty would be whatever small scope remains for international policy coordination.

zh: 首先是那些需要进行国际政策协作的小范围的国家，其次则是世界货币体系。
en: The second would be the world international monetary system.

zh: 事实上，成立国际货币基金组织的主要一个原因是其能够监控汇率的发展情势，也就是要阻止任何国家实行“以邻为壑”政策。
en: In fact, one key reason for the creation of the International Monetary Fund was to monitor exchange-rate developments with the explicit aim of preventing beggar-thy-neighbor policies.

zh: 这也是瑞士给人带来吃惊的原因。
en: This is why the Swiss move comes as a surprise.

zh: 自从2007年8月经济危机爆发之时起，瑞士法郎就实际上升了8 % 。
en: It is true that the franc has appreciated in real terms by 8% since the crisis started in August 2007.

zh: 这一般归因于瑞士法郎的名声，即在困难时期能成为安全的避风港。
en: This is commonly attributed to the currency reputation as a safe haven during troubled times.

zh: 然而其真正的意义是，货币的升值不是货币政策的结果，也不是其它通常因素的结果。
en: What this really means is that the appreciation is neither a consequence of monetary policy nor the other usual factors.

zh: 无论如何，尽管瑞士当局在当前情况下感到不适能被人理解，但其决定仍令人担忧。
en: In any case, while the Swiss authorities’ discomfort with the situation is understandable, their decision is disquieting.

zh: 最近几个月以来，瑞士法郎并不是唯一升值的货币。
en: The Swiss franc is not the only currency that has appreciated in recent months.

zh: 其它的小经济体也经历了急剧的货币升值。
en: Other small economies have undergone even sharper real appreciations.

zh: 比如说，波兰与捷克共和国各自的货币就几乎升值了30%与15 % 。
en: For example, Poland and the Czech Republic have seen their currencies go up by close to 30% and 15%, respectively.

zh: 主要的一些国家同样经历了货币升值：日本的货币升值约30 % ， 中国的货币升值约15 % 。
en: Major countries also have undergone currency appreciations – 30% for Japan and 15% for China.

zh: 这些国家也都面临经济萧条，而当其利率还未达到零下限时，这些国家在不久的将来可能出炉货币贬值的刺激政策。
en: These countries, too, are facing a recession, and, while the interest rate has not yet reached its zero bound everywhere, incentives to depreciate might grow in the near future.

zh: 事实上，刺激政策已经开始执行。
en: In fact, the incentives are already there.

zh: 一些相当大的国家（韩国、瑞典与英国，举行而言）已经经历了非常大幅的货币贬值。
en: Some fairly large countries – Korea, Sweden, and the United Kingdom, to name a few – have already undergone some very large depreciations.

zh: 实际上，波兰的货币最近也开始贬值。
en: In fact, Poland’s currency recently started to depreciate.

zh: 这些国家的中央银行都未曾表示要对其货币实行贬值。
en: None of these countries’ central banks has indicated that it was involved in depreciating its currency.

zh: 当然，陈述与动机也许无法相关联。
en: Of course, statements and intentions may not be identical.

zh: 可能瑞行只是承认了其它中央银行没有承认的事实。
en: It may be that the SNB merely acknowledges what other central banks do not.

zh: 然而，在这样做的时候，瑞行违反了一种忌讳 ： “ 你不该参与竞相贬值活动 ” 。
en: In doing so, however, the SNB is violating a taboo: “Thou shall not engage in competitive depreciations.”

zh: 或者，瑞行可能主要希望能让瑞士法郎稍作贬值来打破安全避风港效应。
en: Alternatively, it may be that the SNB mostly wishes to talk the franc down to break the safe-haven effect.

zh: 快速地获得货币贬值，它也许能达到这个目的。
en: Having promptly achieved depreciation, it may have succeeded.

zh: 在这种情况下，瑞士法郎贬值与升值都不会很大，这样就无需瑞行对汇率进行干涉。
en: In that case, the franc will not move much more, in any direction, and there will be no need for further interventions.

zh: 然而，对于瑞行的措施受限的反应还是让人有些吃惊的。
en: Nevertheless, the limited reaction to the SNB move is somewhat surprising.

zh: 瑞行的措施是在国际货币基金组织决定其对瑞士进行视察的年度第四项条款之后出台的，而这个报告还没有公开发行；该文件读起来会非同寻常的有趣。
en: The move came one week after the IMF concluded its annual Article IV visit to Switzerland, and the report has yet to be released; it could make for unusually interesting reading.

zh: 其它国家的中央银行没有发表任何观点，这也许表明他们至少在现阶段不打算对货币采取回弹政策。
en: Other central banks have not expressed any view, which may suggest that they do not intend to retaliate, at least at this stage.

zh: 瑞行的官方报告指出，货币升值代表了“对货币情形不加适宜地加紧控制 ” ， 而且国家政策的实施只是为了能“阻止瑞士法郎针对欧元再次升值 ” — —这样也许让其它央行再次放心瑞行的政策。
en: They may have been reassured by the SNB’s official statement that the appreciation represented “an inappropriate tightening of monetary conditions,” and that the policy move merely aims “to prevent any further appreciation of the Swiss franc against the euro.”

zh: 也许是因为瑞行注意到了先前危机的危害，而且那些打算使用这些信息对未来行动进行支持的当局不愿对此提出评论意见。
en: It may also be that notice has been taken of the precedent, and that those authorities that intend to use it to justify future moves are loathe to criticize it.

zh: 在这种情况下，各国齐心一致的沉默说明，所有其它央行更愿意采用这种最令人不安的选择。
en: In that case, the generalized silence could indicate that all other central banks entertain the possibility of using that option, which would be most worrisome.

zh: 无烟中国
en: Smokeless China

zh: 北京 — — 短短几周内，北京将在餐馆及办公室等全市所有室内公共场所实行禁烟措施。 户外、公交及多种媒体形式的烟草广告也将被同时禁止。
en: BEIJING – In a few weeks, Beijing will implement a city-wide ban on smoking in all indoor public spaces, such as restaurants and offices, as well as on tobacco advertising outdoors, on public transportation, and in most forms of media.

zh: 如果去年底市人大批准的举措成功实施，中国有可能在全国范围内强制实行类似的禁烟措施。
en: If the initiative, agreed late last year by the municipal people’s congress, is successful, China may impose a similar ban nationwide.

zh: 吸烟人数显著下降无疑会给中国带来不可估量的公共健康利益。
en: A significant decline in smoking would undoubtedly bring enormous public-health benefits to China.

zh: 但问题是这样做是否现实？
en: But is it feasible?

zh: 拥有约3亿烟民的中国占世界烟民总数的三分之一，平均每天约有2，700人因为吸烟引发的疾病致死。
en: With an estimated 300 million smokers, China represents one-third of the world’s total and accounts for an average of roughly 2,700 tobacco-related deaths per day.

zh: 治疗与吸烟有关疾病的费用，更不要说相关的生产力损失是非常惊人的。
en: The costs of treating smoking-related diseases, not to mention the associated productivity losses, are considerable.

zh: 但中国迄今为止在减少吸烟或有效执行禁令方面的进展并不顺利。
en: But China has so far struggled to reduce smoking or enforce bans effectively.

zh: 事实上，尽管在2005年批准了世卫组织的烟草控制框架公约，中国未能兑现其到2011年禁止室内吸烟的承诺。
en: Indeed, despite ratifying the World Health Organization’s Framework Convention to Tobacco Control in 2005, China failed to fulfill its commitment to ban indoor smoking by 2011.

zh: 不仅如此，烟草产量还增加了32 % 。
en: Moreover, tobacco output increased 32%.

zh: 其后禁令在上海、杭州和广州等 14个中国城市得以实施。
en: Bans have since been implemented in 14 Chinese cities, including Shanghai, Hangzhou, and Guangzhou.

zh: 但因为执行不力和75%的中国成年人认为吸烟不会造成严重危害，导致禁烟并未取得显著的效果。
en: But they have done little to reduce smoking, owing not only to weak enforcement, but also to the prevailing view, held by 75% of Chinese adults, that smoking does not cause serious harm.

zh: （据报有意戒烟的中国烟民仅占16 % 。
en: (Only about 16% of Chinese smokers report an intention to quit.)

zh: ）在这样的背景下，北京市政当局对公共场所吸烟高达200人民币（相当于32美元）的罚款计划似乎充其量也没有太大意义。
en: Against this background, the Beijing municipal authorities’ plan to fine smokers up to CN¥200 ($32) for lighting up in public places appears unpromising at best.

zh: 最明显的问题是为什么在其他领域不吝推行家长式政策的中国政府不干脆禁止烟草的生产和使用。
en: The obvious question is why China’s government, which is not known to be shy about imposing paternalistic policies in other areas, does not simply ban cigarette production and use altogether.

zh: 毕竟，从斯堪的纳维亚到纽约的其他国家和地区已经在多数公共场所开辟了吸烟违法且付出昂贵代价的先例。
en: After all, other countries and localities, from Scandinavia to New York City, have made smoking prohibitively expensive and illegal in most public places.

zh: 中国没有采取上述措施的原因在于烟草行业所能提供的就业机会和收入。
en: The reason why China has not taken this path lies in the jobs and revenue that the industry provides.

zh: 国内消费的几乎所有香烟均由国有的中国烟草总公司负责销售；事实上，该公司是全世界最大的卷烟制造企业，年供应量高达2，5000亿，实现人民币8，160亿元（占国内生产总值7-10 % ） 的销售收入。
en: The state-owned China National Tobacco Corporation sells almost all of the cigarettes consumed in the country; indeed, it is the world’s largest cigarette manufacturer, supplying 2.5 trillion annually, which in turn generates CN¥816 billion (7-10% of GDP) in revenue.

zh: 事实上，烟草带来的财政收入相当于某些省级政府财政预算的半数 。
en: Indeed, tobacco receipts finance as much as half of some provincial governments’ budgets.

zh: 即使在中国这样的专制国家，如此巨额的收入损失、更不用说3亿烟民对禁烟的不满会给禁烟工作带来巨大的难度。
en: Even in an authoritarian country like China, the loss of so much income, not to mention the ire of 300 million addicts, would make prohibition a huge challenge.

zh: 但电子烟替代法有助于缓解彻底禁烟所带来的收入损失和平息民众愤怒。
en: But there is an alternative that could help appease angry citizens and mitigate the revenue loss from an outright ban on smoking: electronic cigarettes.

zh: 鉴于电子烟只是加热尼古丁溶液产生可吸入蒸汽，不释放吸烟所产生的致癌焦油物质，���得其成为吸烟或被迫减少或停止烟草摄入者理想的尼古丁输送系统。
en: Given that e-cigarettes merely heat a nicotine solution to produce an inhalable vapor, they release none of the carcinogenic tar of cigarette smoke, making them the ideal nicotine-delivery system for smokers seeking – or being forced – to reduce or halt their tobacco intake.

zh: 电子烟不仅危害远小于香烟，而且于2003年由中国自主发明并自产自销。
en: Aside from being far less damaging than cigarettes, e-cigarettes are a homegrown product, invented in China in 2003.

zh: 但尽管中国电子烟行业取得了长足的进步 — — 2013年，深圳市拥有900家电子烟制造企业，比2012年增长200 % ， 占到全球电子烟生产超过95%的份额 — — 传统的香烟制品依然垄断着中国市场。
en: But, despite considerable progress in China’s e-cigarette industry – in 2013, Shenzhen province housed 900 manufacturers of the devices, up 200% from 2012, and accounted for over 95% of global e-cigarette production – traditional cigarettes still dominate the Chinese market.

zh: 就像外交关系委员会委员黄严忠最近指出的那样 ， “ 只有有1％的中国吸烟人口转向电子烟，就意味着约350万用户的庞大电子香烟市场。
en: As Yanzhong Huang of the Council on Foreign Relations recently pointed out, “If only 1% of China’s smoking population turned to e-cigarettes, it would mean a market of about 3.5 million e-cigarette users.”

zh: 中国烟草总公司可能成为世界上最大的电子烟制造商。
en: The China National Tobacco Corporation could become the world’s largest e-cigarette maker.

zh: 中国未能成功挖掘电子烟行业巨大潜力的原因之一是监管的缺乏。
en: One reason China has not managed to tap the e-cigarette industry’s enormous potential is a lack of adequate regulation.

zh: 进入门槛低导致的激烈竞争严重侵蚀了生产者的利润，较低的生产标准导致伪劣产品四处开花。
en: Low entry barriers enable intense competition that diminishes producers’ profit margins, and shoddy products are rife, owing to low manufacturing standards.

zh: 要想让电子烟代替传统香烟弥补失去的烟草收入，政府必须更认真地规范行业以确保安全和质量。
en: If e-cigarettes are to replace traditional cigarettes and offset lost tobacco revenues, the government must regulate the industry more carefully to ensure safety and quality.

zh: 但民众观念如果未能转变上述努力的意义就不大。
en: But such efforts will mean little without a shift in people’s attitudes.

zh: 这里，2013年实行的党和政府官员公共场合或公务活动吸烟禁令可能会有所帮助。
en: Here, the ban on smoking in public places or during official activities imposed in 2013 on Chinese Communist Party and government officials could be helpful.

zh: 黄严忠解释说，如果更多官员转向电子烟，普通民众可能会受到启发纷纷效仿。
en: As Huang explains, if more officials turn to e-cigarettes, ordinary people might be inspired to follow suit.

zh: 到目前为止，似乎中国烟草总公司的董事们遵守了政府强制实施的禁烟规定。
en: Already, it seems that the directors of the China National Tobacco Corporation have complied with a government-mandated ban on cigarette smoking.

zh: 他们是否已经成为电子烟“拥趸”还有待考证。
en: Whether they have become e-cigarette “vapers” is not known.

zh: 受益于生产率提高和巨额医疗费用节约的无烟中国可能看起来像一个白日梦。
en: A smoke-free China – one that benefits from rising productivity and massive health-care savings – may seem like a pipe dream.

zh: 但全国禁烟加之可靠的电子烟行业（为烟民和财政）提供替代方案指明了把梦想变为现实的有吸引力的道路。
en: But a country-wide ban on smoking, with a reliable e-cigarette industry providing an alternative (both to smokers and to budgets), offers an intriguing way to turn the dream into reality.

zh: 北京对决亿万富翁
en: Beijing Versus the Billionaire

zh: 曼谷 — — 中国政府和香港第一大富豪、备受推崇的李嘉诚正在进行一场激烈的争吵 — — 而且在小报上越来越像一次激烈的离婚。
en: BANGKOK – China’s government and Hong Kong’s wealthiest man, the much-admired Li Ka-shing, have been waging an acidic spat – one that increasingly looks like a bitter divorce being played out in tabloid newspapers.

zh: 事实上，中国媒体近来一直在尖刻地评论李嘉诚。
en: Indeed, Chinese media have lately been directing a relentless stream of vitriol at Li.

zh: 他犯了什么“罪 ” ？
en: His “crime”?

zh: 像投资者那样在欧洲低价买入在中国高价卖出。
en: Buying low in Europe and selling high in China – that is, acting like an investor.

zh: 引发这波轻蔑谴责的是李抛售在上海的某些高端物业，还把公司注册地从香港转到开曼群岛。
en: The trigger for this wave of scorn was Li’s sell-off of some of his prime Shanghai properties, after relocating his corporate registry from Hong Kong to the Cayman Islands.

zh: 这完全是普通而理性的商业决策，目的是最大限度地减轻税收负担。
en: This is a completely mundane and rational business decision, aimed at minimizing tax obligations.

zh: 事实上，约70%的香港上市公司都在加勒比地区进行过注册，就连包括互联网巨头阿里巴巴在内的一些大型内地企业也在海外避税天堂注册以求避税。
en: Indeed, some 70% of all Hong Kong-listed companies have a Caribbean registry, and even a number of major mainland companies, including the Internet giant Alibaba, are registered in offshore tax havens.

zh: 但在中国媒体幼稚的文章中，此举暴露了李的“不爱国”和“忘恩负义 ” 。
en: But, in the Chinese media’s puerile narrative, the move exposes Li as “ungrateful” and “unpatriotic.”

zh: 当中国最需要他的时候，他却抛弃了这个使他从极端贫困成长为世界首富的国度。
en: He is “abandoning” China – which, it is claimed, enabled him to rise from extreme poverty to become one of the world’s wealthiest men – when the country needs him most.

zh: 这种荒谬的说法忽略了一个事实，即李嘉诚在投资中国前就已经栖身世界首富之列。
en: This absurd account neglects the fact that Li was already one of the world’s wealthiest people before he ever invested in China.

zh: 或许更重要的是，它未能意识到李在中国的土地储备仍然高达2，000万平方米（2.15亿平方英尺 ） — —几乎是曼哈顿面积的四分之一 — — 而且他在中国拥有的零售渠道数量在两年内增长了70 % 。
en: Perhaps more important, it fails to recognize that Li’s Chinese land holdings still amount to more than 20 million square meters (215 million square feet) – nearly a quarter of the size of Manhattan – and that the number of retail outlets he owns in China has increased by 70% in two years.

zh: 但事实无关紧要。
en: But the facts are irrelevant.

zh: 这是个政治问题。
en: This is a matter of politics.

zh: 随着中国意图加强对香港控制和李日益表现出我行我素，中国相信自上而下控制且忠实于共产主义根源的执政者一点也不喜欢他的所作所为。
en: As China attempts to tighten its grip on Hong Kong, Li is showing independence, and China’s new rulers – who, true to their communist roots, believe firmly in top-down control – do not like it one bit.

zh: 此次争吵反映出李和中国政府关系的重大转变。
en: The ongoing squabble represents a significant shift in Li’s relationship with China’s government.

zh: 曾任邓小平顾问和前主席江泽民（其政治影响力正不断减弱）密友的李嘉诚，曾是1989年天安门广场屠杀事件后首批在中国的投资者。
en: A former adviser to Deng Xiaoping and confidante of former President Jiang Zemin (whose political influence is now waning), Li was among the first to invest in China after the Tiananmen Square massacre of 1989.

zh: 他的座右铭是 ， “ 我不做任何违背中国利益的事，不说任何有损中国声誉的话。 ”
en: He long touted the motto, “I don’t do anything against China’s interest, and I don’t say anything that may hurt China’s reputation.”

zh: 2012年梁振英被任命为香港行政长官时这一切都发生了改变。
en: That changed in 2012, when Leung Chun-ying was appointed as Hong Kong’s chief executive.

zh: 中国任命担任特首职务的首选唐英年因为私行不检和让妻子为划区违规担责的丑闻而被迫退出竞争。
en: China’s first choice for the position, Henry Tang, was forced to withdraw because of private indiscretions and a disgraceful bid to have his wife take the fall for a zoning violation.

zh: 梁振英成了中国在香港的代表，负责执行中国政府政策 — — 包括对学生和知识分子的民主抗议活动采取强硬措施。
en: Leung became China’s man in Hong Kong, responsible for doing the Chinese government’s bidding – including taking an uncompromising position against pro-democracy protests by students and intellectuals.

zh: 事实上，即便中国在香港的政策变得日益强硬 — — 因此在当地不受欢迎 — — 梁依然证明自己绝对忠诚于中国执政者。
en: Indeed, even as China’s agenda in Hong Kong has become increasingly tough – and thus unpopular locally – Leung has proved himself to be absolutely loyal to China’s rulers.

zh: 而李则加入了唐英年的阵营。
en: Li, however, stood by Tang.

zh: 更有问题的是，他偶尔会对梁各项错误政策公开表示反对。
en: More problematic, he has occasionally dissented publicly from Leung’s various misguided policies.

zh: 中华人民共和国的学生都知道，表达政治不同意见无论多么温和都可以致命。
en: As any student of the People’s Republic knows, expressions of political disagreement, however mild, can be lethal.

zh: 在中国没有“同意保留意见”的余地，一旦领导人下达命令，唯一的选择就只有“执行 ” 。
en: There is no “agree to disagree” in China; once the leader has spoken, there is only “obey.”

zh: 李所涉及的利益尤其巨大。
en: In Li’s case, the stakes are particularly high.

zh: 和多数只关注政治权宜之计的香港大亨不同，李被视为有良心的人，值得尊敬。
en: Unlike most of Hong Kong’s tycoons, who are considered excessively focused on political expedience, Li is viewed as a person of strong conscience and thus worthy of considerable respect.

zh: 别人甚至给他起了绰号叫“超人 ” 。
en: He even enjoys the affectionate nickname “Superman.”

zh: 但现在中国执政者正通过梁振英推行可能是灾难性的政策，按照中国共产党的说法是启动香港的“去殖民化”进程。
en: But now, China’s rulers, through Leung, are pushing potentially disastrous policies aimed, in Chinese Communist Party parlance, at “de-colonizing” Hong Kong.

zh: 比如官方最近宣布司法独立和分权是应该抛弃的“殖民地”产物，并由中国政府和香港首席执行官、而非地方法院来做出决定。
en: For example, officials recently declared that judicial independence and the separation of powers are “colonial” legacies that should be discarded, with China’s government and Hong Kong’s chief executive, not the local courts, calling all the shots.

zh: 在这样的过渡时期，像李这种人的不同意见会带来中国领导人担心的不稳定。
en: In this moment of transition, dissent from someone of Li’s standing could have precisely the kind of destabilizing impact that China’s leaders fear.

zh: 因此必须对李实施“去神化论 ” 。
en: So Li has to be “de-deified.”

zh: 中国的攻击迫使李在近三周的沉寂之后，开始做他从未做过的事情：反击。
en: China’s attacks have pushed Li, after almost three weeks of stony silence, to do something he had never done before: strike back.

zh: 他不仅指出所有关于他抛弃中国的指责错误，还公开指责中国利用文化大革命留下的对策让他“恐惧”得不寒而栗。
en: Not only did he point out that all of the accusations about his intentions to abandon China were false; he openly accused China of using tactics from the Cultural Revolution that left him “trembling with fear” and sent “shivers down the spine.”

zh: 李用中国古代唐宋两位诗人的三句诗来结束自己的声明，称家让他感到安全。
en: Li concluded his statement with the message, delivered via three lines by two canonical Chinese poets from the ancient Tang and Song dynasties, that his home was where he felt safe.

zh: 其中的潜台词十分明确 ： “ 中国可能是我的祖国，但我是自由人，我有权选择把家安在哪里。 ”
en: The subtext to any literate Chinese was clear: “China may be my ancestral country, but I am a free man, free to choose my home.”

zh: 李是世界历史和文学的狂热爱好者，但显然未能吸取1949年后很多中国人通过巨大的个人悲剧所得到的教训。
en: Li, an avid reader of world history and literature, has apparently not taken to heart the lesson that so many Chinese have learned, through great personal tragedies, since 1949.

zh: 中国政府的核心价值不是来自唐宋诗人的人道文明，而是来自扭曲的马克思列宁主义辩证法和依然珍视自身粗野暴力执政习惯的违反道德的军国主义传统党派。
en: The core values of China’s government are not informed by the humane civility of Tang or Song poets, but by the twisted dialectics of Marxism-Leninism and the amoral militaristic tradition of a party that still cherishes its often brutish and violent habits of governance.

zh: 随着中国领导人继续加强对香港的控制，不寒而栗有可能日益成为那里生活的常态。
en: As China’s leaders continue to push for more control over Hong Kong, spinal shivers are likely to become an increasingly common feature of life there.

zh: 伯南克的天上人间
en: Ben Bernanke’s Dream World

zh: 伯克利 — — 美联储董事会主席本·伯南克并没像他的前任艾伦·格林斯潘在金融危机前那样被人们称为圣人。
en: BERKELEY – US Federal Reserve Board Chairman Ben Bernanke is not regarded as an oracle in the way that his predecessor, Alan Greenspan, was before the financial crisis.

zh: 但8月26日，他在怀俄明州杰克森霍尔的讲话让市场十分纠结。 市场听到的是混乱的信号。
en: But financial markets were glued to the speech he gave in Jackson Hole, Wyoming on August 26.  What they heard was a bit of a muddle.

zh: 首先，伯南克并未表示会实施任何进一步的宽松货币政策来支持停滞不前的复苏（或者还不如说是复而不苏 ） 。
en: First of all, Bernanke did not propose any further easing of monetary policy to support the stalled recovery – or, rather, the non-recovery.

zh: 其次，他向听众保证“我们预期温和复苏会持续，事实上，复苏会有所增强。
en: Second, he assured his listeners that “we expect a moderate recovery to continue and indeed to strengthen.”

zh: ”这是“因为家庭在修复资产负债表上面也取得了一些进展，他们储蓄增加了，贷款减少了，利息和债务负担也在减少。
en: This is because “[h]ouseholds also have made some progress in repairing their balance sheets – saving more, borrowing less, and reducing their burdens of interest payments and debt.”

zh: ”此外，商品价格下跌也会“有助于增加家庭购买力。 ”
en: Moreover, falling commodity prices will also “help increase household purchasing power.”

zh: 最后，伯南克宣称“过去四年来的冲击并未永久性改变美国经济增长基本面。 ”
en: Finally, Bernanke claimed that “the growth fundamentals of the United States do not appear to have been permanently altered by the shocks of the past four years.”

zh: 坦白说，我不明白伯南克为何能在现在说出这样的话。
en: Frankly, I do not understand how Bernanke can say any of these things right now.

zh: 如果两个月前他和美联储公开市场委员会的其他成员认为美国名义支出预期增长率处在不错的复苏势头中，那么如今他们已不再持有这一观点。
en: If he and the rest of the Federal Open Market Committee thought that the projected growth of nominal spending in the US was on an appropriate recovery path two months ago, they cannot believe that today.

zh: 两个月以来，经济坏消息频频，资产市场对未来的估值大幅下挫（这还会造成未来增长减缓，因为资产价格的下跌将导致企业收缩投资规模 ） ， 这意味着60天前还非常合适的政策如今已苍白无力。
en: Two months of bad economic news, coupled with asset markets’ severe revaluations of the future – which also cause slower future growth, as falling asset prices lead firms to scale back investment – mean that a policy that was appropriate just 60 days ago is much too austere today.

zh: 但让我把关注点集中在伯南克的第四个观点上。
en: But let me focus on Bernanke’s fourth statement.

zh: 即使如今这次小萧条已经结束，预计将出现相对迅速的经济复苏，美国也将经历一次至少4万亿美元的投资不足。
en: Even if we project a relatively rapid economic recovery, by the time this lesser depression is over, the US will have experienced an investment shortfall of at least $4 trillion.

zh: 除非该投资不足被弥补，否则资本缺失将把美国真实GDP增长率压低整整2个百分点。
en: Until that investment shortfall is made up, the missing capital will serve to depress the level of real GDP in the US by two full percentage points.

zh: 美国的增长潜力将比金融危机被成功消除、小型萧条被成功避免的情形低2 % 。
en: America’s growth trajectory will be 2% below what it would have been had the financial crisis been successfully finessed and the lesser depression avoided.

zh: 这还不算完：州和地方预算削减已经拖累了美国人力资本和基础设施投资速度，这将使美国长期增长趋势再缩水1个百分点。
en: There is more: state and local budget-cutting has slowed America’s pace of investment in human capital and infrastructure, adding a third percentage point to the downward shift in the country’s long-term growth trajectory.

zh: 20世纪30年代大萧条结束后，二战期间工业产能投资潮弥补了失去的十年留下的空缺。
en: After the Great Depression of the 1930’s, the vast wave of investment in industrial capacity during World War II made up the shortfall of the lost decade.

zh: 因此大萧条并未给未来增长留下阴影，或者说，大萧条的阴影被为对抗纳粹德国和日本帝国的总体战而动员起来的5年现代化所发出的强光一扫而空。
en: As a result, the Depression did not cast a shadow on future growth – or, rather, the shadow was overwhelmed by the blinding floodlights of five years of mobilization for total war against Nazi Germany and Imperial Japan.

zh: 如今，小萧条也留下了阴影，但我们却找不到类似的强光。
en: There is no analogous set of floodlights being deployed to erase the shadow that is currently being cast by the lesser depression.

zh: 相反，由于缺少有效政策来让整个经济的名义支出流重回往日轨道，每过去一天，这一阴影就延长几分。
en: On the contrary, the shadow is lengthening with each passing day, owing to the absence of effective policies to get the flow of economy-wide nominal spending back on its previous track.

zh: 此外，还存在进一步拖后腿的因素。
en: Moreover, there is an additional source of drag.

zh: 在后二战时代，有一个强力因素减少了风险感知并鼓励了投资和创业，那就是所谓的“罗斯福看跌期权 ” 。
en: A powerful factor that diminished perceived risk and encouraged investment and enterprise in the post-WWII era was the so-called “Roosevelt put.”

zh: 如今，全世界工业国政府都将对抗萧条作为其首要和最高的经济政策考虑目标，因此储蓄者和企业不必担心1873、1884和1929年之后的艰难时世会重现。
en: Industrial-country governments all around the world now took fighting depression to be their first and highest economic priority, so that savers and businesses had no reason to worry that the hard times that followed 1873, 1884, or 1929 would return.

zh: 这一点已不再成立。
en: That is no longer true.

zh: 未来世界的风险将比我们所认为的更高，这并不是因为政府将不再给出一开始就不应该给出的担保，而是因为长期萧条使得客户流失的真实风险卷土重来。
en: The world in the future will be a riskier place than we thought it was – not because government will no longer offer guarantees that it should never have offered in the first place, but rather because the real risk that one’s customers might vanish in a prolonged depression is back.

zh: 我不知道这一额外风险会对美国和全球经济增长造成怎样的阻碍作用。
en: I do not know by how much this extra risk will impede the growth of the US and global economies.

zh: 无需复杂计算就能看出，50年一遇的5年小萧条将会导致经济���力降低10 % ， 这将抑制平均投资回报和私人投资，使每年的经济增长率下降0.2个百分点。
en: A back-of-the-envelope estimate suggests that a five-year lesser depression every 50 years that pushes the economy an extra 10% below its potential would reduce average investment returns and retard private investment by enough to shave two-tenths of a percentage point from economic growth every year.

zh: 因此，美国的经济将不会仅仅下降3 % ， 空缺会持续增长，到2035年增长到7 % ， 到2055年增长到11 % 。
en: As a result, America would not just end this episode 3% poorer than it might have been; the gap would grow – to 7% by 2035 and 11% by 2055.

zh: 这就是我们将要面对的未来，如果现在不采取措施以使经济从小萧条中快速复苏、然后继之以实施刺激私人资本、基础设施和教育投资重回趋势水平的政策的话。
en: This is the shape of things to come if steps are not taken now to recover rapidly from this lesser depression, and then to implement policies to boost private capital, infrastructure, and education investment back up to trend.

zh: 或许这已足够使所有人认识到，政客们当前对长期衰退的默认态度是个危险的错误，决不能让他们一错再错。
en: Perhaps that would be enough to reassure everyone that policymakers’ current acquiescence in a prolonged slump was a horrible mistake that will not be repeated.

zh: 让世界不只有光
en: Let There Be More Than Light

zh: 布拉格 — — 事关全世界富国和穷国的福祉，充足的能源供应丰富了人类的生活，不仅为人们带来光明、新鲜食物和清洁饮水，还推动科技研发，并协助人类实现温度控制。
en: PRAGUE – For the well-off in both rich and poor countries around the world, lives are enriched by plentiful access to energy that provides light, fresh food, and clean water, and that powers technology and allows the ability to control the temperature.

zh: 充足的能源可以提供与数百名仆人等价的改变生活的劳动力：如果没有冰箱，我们需要每天寻找新鲜食物，储藏架将保持半空，许多食物都会在我们食用之前变质 — — 这也是1930年胃癌是美国最主要癌症的一个原因。
en: Abundant energy provides the same life-transforming labor as hundreds of servants: Without a refrigerator, we would need to locate fresh food daily, store shelves would be half-empty, and a lot of food would go bad before we could eat it – one reason why, in 1930, stomach cancer was the leading cancer in the United States.

zh: 如果没有几乎完全以化石燃料为原料的合成肥料，全世界一半粮食消费都将受到威胁。
en: Without synthetic fertilizer, which is produced almost entirely with fossil fuels, half the world’s food consumption would be imperiled.

zh: 没有现代化的炉具和加热设备，我们就需要自己寻找柴火，而且有可能在自己家里因为严重的空气污染而中毒。
en: Without modern stoves and heaters, we would need to find our own firewood, and we would risk being poisoned in our own houses by killer air pollution.

zh: 如果没有燃油卡车、船舶和机械，几乎所有的艰苦劳动都要由人类自己来完成。
en: And without fuel-powered trucks, ships, and machines, humans would need to do nearly all the hard labor.

zh: 化石燃料生产了全世界电力的2/3，核电和水电占到另外27%的份额。
en: Worldwide, fossil fuels produce two-thirds of all electricity, with nuclear and hydro producing another 27%.

zh: 国际能源署（IEA）数据显示，太阳能、风能、波能和生物能仅占经合组织国家电力总产量的9.8 % ， 即便如此这还仅仅是因为存在仅今年一年就累计超过1，600亿美元的巨额补助。
en: According to the International Energy Agency (IEA), solar, wind, wave, and bio-energy produce just 9.8% of electricity in the OECD, and this is possible only because of huge subsidies, cumulatively totaling more than $160 billion this year.

zh: 就连极具环保意识的德国其超过一半的电力生产仍然依靠化石燃料。
en: Even ultra-environmentally aware Germany still produces more than half its electricity with fossil fuels.

zh: 但现在西方兴起了一项令人不安的运动，试图告诉那些仍然享受不到电力带来的无数好处的人他们应当安于现状。
en: Yet there is a disturbing movement in the West to tell the 1.1 billion people who still lack these myriad benefits that they should go without.

zh: 一种令人似曾相识的说法是贫困国家不应使用肮脏的煤炭发电，相反，他们应当直接“跃升到”离网太阳能技术等更加清洁的能源。
en: A familiar refrain suggests that instead of dirty, coal-fired power plants, poor countries should “leapfrog” straight to cleaner energy sources like off-grid solar technology.

zh: 颇具影响力的捐助者 — — 甚至包括不再为煤炭能源项目提供资金的世界银行 — — 也支持这种观点。
en: Influential donors – including even the World Bank, which no longer funds coal energy projects – endorse this view.

zh: 其中的潜在动机可以理解：决策者必须应对全球变暖。
en: The underlying motivation is understandable: policymakers must address global warming.

zh: 最终摆脱化石燃料至关重要，但要使绿色能源更加廉价和可靠还需要一个创新的过程。
en: Eventually moving away from fossil fuels is crucial, and innovation is required to make green energy cheap and reliable.

zh: 而这种做法向全世界穷人传递的信息虚伪而又危险。
en: But this message to the world’s poor is hypocritical and dangerous.

zh: 虽然化石燃料可以造成全球变暖，但它也能带来增长、福祉和繁荣。
en: While fossil fuels contribute to global warming, they also contribute to prosperity, growth, and wellbeing.

zh: 能源和贫困之间存在很强的直接联系：前者越多，后者就越少。
en: There is a strong, direct connection between power and poverty: the more of the former, the less of the latter.

zh: 孟加拉国的一项研究表明网络电气化对家庭收入、支出和教育已经产生了显著的积极影响。
en: A study in Bangladesh showed that grid electrification has significant positive effects on household income, expenditure, and education.

zh: 电气化家庭每年收入增长高达21 % ， 而每年的贫困家庭数则减少1.5 % 。
en: Electrified households experienced a jump of up to 21% in income and a 1.5% reduction in poverty each year.

zh: 对煤炭的依赖并不会很快结束。
en: Reliance on coal is not ending soon.

zh: 虽然我们并不希望如此，但煤炭仍然在所有能源中最廉价、也最可靠：国际能源机构估计即使征收巨额碳税，但到2040年，煤炭的平均价格仍然比太阳能和风能更廉价。
en: While we would wish otherwise, it often remains the cheapest, most dependable energy source: the IEA estimates that, by 2040, coal will still be cheaper, on average, than solar and wind energy, even with a sizeable carbon tax.

zh: 过去16年来，几乎每个用上电的人都是通过接入电网，而化石燃料则是发电的主要原料。
en: Over the past 16 years, nearly every person who gained access to electricity did so through a grid connection, mostly powered by fossil fuels.

zh: 但捐助者却表示仍未用上电的11亿民众许多人应当试用太阳能电池板。
en: And yet donors say that many of the 1.1 billion people who are still without electricity should instead try solar panels.

zh: 相较于耗资昂贵的电网建设，提供离网太阳能电池非常廉价。
en: Compared with expensive grid expansion, providing an off-grid, solar cell is very cheap.

zh: 但对于接受方而言，这一替代选项却非常糟糕。
en: But for the recipient, it is a poor substitute.

zh: 它只能提供足够的电力来让灯泡发光和为手机充电，这好过什么都没有 — — 但却好得十分勉强。
en: It offers just enough power to keep a lightbulb going, and to recharge a mobile phone, which is better than nothing – but only barely.

zh: 国际能源署预计使用离网太阳能的1.95亿人每人每年仅能获得一百七十千瓦时的电量 — — 相当于美国一台平板电视半年的耗电量。
en: The IEA expects that each of the 195 million people with off-grid solar will get just 170kWh per year – or half of what one US flat-screen TV uses in a year.

zh: 也许这并不令人惊讶，关于太阳能电池板对贫困人口生活影响的首次严格测试发现，尽管穷人多获得了一点电力，但却并未对他们的生活造成可以衡量的影响：他们没有增加储蓄或开支，没有承接更多工作或开展更多业务，其子女的学习时间也没有增加。
en: Perhaps not surprisingly, the first rigorous test published on the impact of solar panels on the lives of poor people found that while they got a little more electricity, there was no measurable impact on their lives: they did not increase savings or spending, they did not work more or start more businesses, and their children did not study more.

zh: 难怪情况会是这样：170千瓦时离绝大多数人认为的用上电相去甚远。
en: Little wonder: 170kWh is not what most of us would consider real access to electricity.

zh: 这种级别的离网能源永远无法支撑一座工厂或农场，因此也无法减少贫困或创造工作。
en: Off-grid energy at this level will never power a factory or a farm, so it cannot reduce poverty or create jobs.

zh: 它也无法对抗室内空气污染这一全世界最大的环境杀手。 造成室内空气污染的主要原因是每年造成380万人死亡的由点燃木材、纸板和粪便所引发的明火。
en: And it will not help fight the world’s biggest environmental killer: indoor air pollution, which is mostly caused by open fires fueled by wood, cardboard, and dung, and claims 3.8 million lives annually.

zh: 这在富裕国家根本就不是问题，因为那里炉具和加热设备全部实现了联网；但因为太阳能太弱无法为炉具和烤箱供电，离网太阳能电池板的用户将继续遭受痛苦。
en: This is not a concern in rich countries, where stoves and heaters are hooked up to the grid; but because solar is too weak to power stoves and ovens, recipients of off-grid solar panels will continue suffering.

zh: 2016年，尼日利亚财政部长呼吁西方停止试图阻止非洲利用煤炭来解决其能源短缺问题的“虚伪行动 ” 。
en: In 2016, the Nigerian finance minister called out the West for its “hypocrisy” in attempting to block Africa from using coal to solve its power shortages.

zh: “在污染环境长达数百年后 ” ， 她说 ， “ 现在非洲想要使用煤炭，但他们却不让。 ”
en: “After polluting the environment for hundreds of years,” she said, “now that Africa wants to use coal, they deny us.”

zh: 在孟加拉进行的一项哥本哈根共识研究显示未来15年内，在那里建设新的燃煤电厂将造成全球气候破坏，并最终造成约5.92亿美元的经济损失。
en: A Copenhagen Consensus study for Bangladesh found that building new coal-fired power plants there would, over the next 15 years, generate global climate damage eventually costing around $592 million.

zh: 但通过电气化提升经济增长的收益几乎达到损失金额的500倍，也就是2，580亿美元 — — 相当于该国整整一年的GDP。
en: But the benefits from electrification through higher economic growth would be almost 500 times greater, at $258 billion – equivalent to more than an entire year of the country’s GDP.

zh: 到2030年，孟加拉人的平均生活水平将提高16 % 。
en: By 2030, the average Bangladeshi would be 16% better off.

zh: 以抗击全球变暖之名否定孟加拉国的能源利益意味着我们要求孟加拉人为避免23美分的全球气候损失而放弃100美元的发展好处 — — 而孟加拉国的能源短缺所致GDP损失约为0.5 % ， 约有2，100万人每天仅靠不到1.25美元生活。
en: Denying Bangladesh this benefit in the name of combating global warming means to focus on avoiding 23 cents of global climate costs for every $100 of development benefits we ask Bangladeshis to forgo – and this in a country where energy shortages cost an estimated 0.5% of GDP, and around 21 million people survive on less than $1.25 per day.

zh: 人类没有选择：我们必须应对能源贫困和气候变化。
en: There is no choice: we must fight energy poverty and fix climate change.

zh: 但这需要大幅增加绿色能源的研发力度，以便清洁能源最终能够战胜化石燃料。
en: But that requires a huge increase in green-energy research and development, so that clean sources eventually outcompete fossil fuels.

zh: 同时这意味着这个世界上永远不会接受仅靠少量能源生活的富人要求世界最贫困人口减少能源使用是伪善的。
en: And it means recognizing that it is hypocritical for the world’s wealthy, who would never accept survival on a tiny amount of power, to demand this from the world’s poorest.

zh: 被忽略的污染威胁
en: The Neglected Menace of Pollution

zh: 纽约—污染是二十一世纪的重大生存挑战之一。
en: NEW YORK – Pollution is one of the great existential challenges of the twenty-first century.

zh: 它威胁到生态系统的稳定，制约经济发展，影响数十亿人的健康。
en: It threatens the stability of ecosystems, undermines economic development, and compromises the health of billions of people.

zh: 但这个问题常常被各国增长战略或对外援助预算（如欧盟和美国国际开发署）忽视。
en: Yet it is often overlooked, whether in countries’ growth strategies or in foreign-aid budgets, like those of the European Commission and the US Agency for International Development.

zh: 结果是这一威胁愈演愈烈。
en: As a result, the threat continues to grow.

zh: 要动员必要的资源、领导力和公民参与以尽量减小污染威胁，首先要做的是将对污染的认识提升到应有水平。
en: The first step toward mobilizing the resources, leadership, and civic engagement needed to minimize the pollution threat is to raise awareness of its true scale.

zh: 因此，我们组建了关注污染和健康的柳叶刀委员会（Lancet Commission ） ， 来整理关于污染对健康的影响的全面数据，评估其经济成本，探寻其余贫困的联系，并提出解决问题的具体方法建议。
en: That is why we formed the LancetCommission on pollution and health: to marshal comprehensive data on pollution’s health effects, estimate its economic costs, pinpoint its links to poverty, and propose concrete approaches to addressing it.

zh: 去年10月，我们发布了一份这方面的报告。
en: Last October, we published a report that does just that.

zh: 我们发现，污染每年导致九百万人死亡，相当于全球死亡总人数的16 % 。
en: We found that pollution is responsible for nine million deaths per year, or 16% of all deaths globally.

zh: 这个数字三倍于艾滋病、结核病和疟疾致死人数的总和，15倍于所有战争、恐怖主义和其他形式暴力致死人数总和。
en: That is three times more than AIDS, tuberculosis, and malaria combined, and 15 times more than all wars, terrorism, and other forms of violence.

zh: 在受影响最严重的国家，污染致死占了总死亡人数的四分之一强。
en: In the most severely affected countries, pollution is responsible for more than one in four deaths.

zh: 这些死亡的具体原因各不相同，体现了污染成分的变化。
en: The specific causes of such deaths vary, reflecting the changing composition of pollution.

zh: 随着国家的发展，室内空气和水污染 — — 与严重贫困相关的古老的污染形式 — — 会越来越少。
en: As countries develop, household air and water pollution – ancient forms of pollution linked to severe poverty – decline.

zh: 但与经济发展有关的现象 — — 即城市化、全球化以及有毒化学和石油物质的扩散 — — 导致了室外空气、化学、职场和土壤污染日趋严重，发展中国家受到的影响尤重。
en: But phenomena associated with economic development – namely, urbanization, globalization, and the proliferation of toxic chemicals and petroleum-powered vehicles – cause ambient air, chemical, occupational, and soil pollution to rise, with cities in developing countries hit particularly hard.

zh: 毫不奇怪，穷人承担了大部分负担。
en: Unsurprisingly, the poor bear the brunt of the burden.

zh: 近92%的污染相关死亡发生在中低收入国家。
en: Nearly 92% of pollution-related deaths occur in low- and middle-income countries.

zh: 在每一个收入水平上，污染导致的死亡在少数群体、边缘群体和其他脆弱群体中最为普遍。
en: In countries at every income level, disease caused by pollution is most prevalent among minorities, members of marginalized groups, and those who are otherwise vulnerable.

zh: 这是全球规模的环境不公。
en: This is environmental injustice on a global scale.

zh: 除了人力成本，污染相关死亡还导致生产率损失，发展中国家GDP因此每年减少高达2 % 。
en: Beyond the human costs, pollution-related diseases cause productivity losses that reduce developing countries’ GDP by up to 2% per year.

zh: 污染相关死亡消耗了高收入国家医疗支出的1.7 % ， 中低收入国家医疗支出的7 % 。
en: They account for 1.7% of health-care spending in high-income countries, and up to 7% in low- and middle-income countries.

zh: 与污染有关的福利损失每年高达4.6万亿美元 — — 相当于全球经济产出的6.2 % 。
en: Welfare losses due to pollution amount to $4.6 trillion per year – 6.2% of global economic output.

zh: 这其中尚未包括气候变化的巨大成本，燃烧高污染的化石燃料对气候变化的主要原因。
en: And that does not take into account the massive costs of climate change, to which the combustion of highly polluting fossil fuels is the leading contributor.

zh: 尽管损失巨大，但问题还有可能继续恶化。
en: Despite these losses, the problem is set to worsen.

zh: 如果不进行果断干预，光是室外空气污染致死，就有可能到2050年增加50 % 。
en: Without aggressive intervention, deaths from ambient air pollution alone could increase 50% by 2050.

zh: 化学污染是另一个日益艰巨的挑战，自1950年以来，大约有140,000种化合物被发明出来，其中受过安全性或毒性测试的寥寥无几。
en: Chemical pollution is another growing challenge, with an estimated 140,000 new compounds having been invented since 1950, far too few of which have been tested for safety or toxicity.

zh: 婴儿和幼儿尤其容易受到伤害。
en: Infants and young children are especially vulnerable.

zh: 污染并非经济发展难以摆脱的“必要的恶 ” 。
en: Pollution is not some “necessary evil” that inevitably accompanies economic development.

zh: 投入领导力、资源和巧妙的数据驱动方针，污染可以实现最小化，并且可行的策略早已被制定出来，并在中高收入国家经受了实地测试，证明了有效性。
en: With leadership, resources, and a well-formulated data-driven approach, pollution can be minimized, and viable strategies have already been developed, field-tested, and proven effective in high- and middle-income countries.

zh: 这些策略平衡了法律、政策和技术方案。
en: These strategies balance legal, policy, and technological solutions.

zh: 比如，根据“谁污染，谁买单”的原则，污染行业的税收优惠和补贴被取消。
en: For example, following the “polluter pays” principle, they include the elimination of tax breaks and subsidies for polluting industries.

zh: 此外，这些策略绑定了明确的目标和时间表，根据这些内容随时进行评估，并受到强力执行。
en: Moreover, such strategies adhere to clear targets and timetables, against which they are continuously evaluated, and are subject to strong enforcement.

zh: 它们可以引进到全球各个收入水平的城市和国家。
en: And they can be exported to cities and countries at every income level around the world.

zh: 仔细规划、资源充足的污染控制策略应用能让发展中国家避免过去的经济增长所伴随的最糟糕的人道和生态灾难。
en: Careful planning and well-resourced application of pollution-control strategies can enable developing countries to avoid the worst kinds of human and ecological disasters that have accompanied economic growth in the past.

zh: 穷国必须在通往繁荣之路上忍受一个污染和疾病阶段这一老黄历可以寿终正寝了。
en: The old assumption that poor countries must endure a phase of pollution and disease on the path to prosperity can finally be put to rest.

zh: 不管对富国还是穷国，这些策略都会带来更加可持续的GDP增长。
en: For rich and poor countries alike, such strategies would lead to more sustainable GDP growth.

zh: 无铅汽油减少了认知缺陷，提高了生产率，从而为全世界带来数十亿美元的经济回报。
en: The removal of lead from gasoline has returned billions of dollars to economies around the world, as reduced exposure implies lower cognitive impairment and higher productivity.

zh: 在美国，每一美元的空气质量改善投资都能产生30美元收益，自1970年以来所投入的650亿美元共产生1.5万亿美元的总回报。
en: In the United States, air-quality improvements have yielded $30 for every dollar invested, for an aggregate return of $1.5 trillion on a $65 billion investment since 1970.

zh: 因此，减少污染是刺激经济增长的巨大机会，同时 — — 也更重要的是 — — 保护了全世界人民的生命和健康。
en: Reducing pollution thus creates enormous opportunities to boost economic growth, while – more importantly – protecting the lives and health of people worldwide.

zh: 柳叶刀委员会要求各国和市政政府、国际捐助人、重要基金会、公民社会群体以及卫生界人士将控制污染作为一项更重要的工作来抓。
en: The Lancet Commission calls on national and municipal governments, international donors, major foundations, civil-society groups, and health professionals to make pollution control a much higher priority than it is now.

zh: 这要求大幅提高投入中低收入国家污染防治的资金，不管是国家预算投入还是捐赠援助资金。
en: This demands a substantial increase in the funding allocated to pollution prevention in low- and middle-income countries, both from national budgets and donor aid.

zh: 在国际层面，这可以通过扩大现有计划或建立新的专门基金 — — 如艾滋病、结核病和疟疾全球防治基金（Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria ） — —实现。
en: This can be achieved on the international level by expanding existing programs or establishing new stand-alone funds, analogous to the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria.

zh: 这些计划应该对国家拨款形成刺激和补充作用，同时提供技术援助和支持性研究。
en: Such programs should kick-start and complement national contributions, while providing technical assistance and supporting research.

zh: 国际资金还可以用于支持建立“全球污染观察台 ” 。
en: International funding can also be used to back the creation of a “global pollution observatory.”

zh: 有效的污染防控还意味着要在所有未来增长和发展战略中纳入预防战略，认识到只有社会改变生产、消费和交通模式，我们才有可能取得成功。
en: Effective pollution control also means embedding strategies for prevention in all future growth and development strategies, recognizing that success is possible only if societies change their patterns of production, consumption, and transportation.

zh: 这方面的关键措施包括提供朝向无污染能量来源的大转型的激励；取消污染者获得补贴和税收优惠；奖励回收、再利用和修复；用安全替代品取代危险物质；鼓励公共和动态交通等。
en: Key steps here include creating incentives for a broad transition to non-polluting sources of energy; ending subsidies and tax breaks for polluters; rewarding recycling, re-use, and repair; replacing hazardous materials with safer substitutes; and encouraging both public and active transportation.

zh: 转向更少污染的系统绝非易事，全世界既得利益一定会严重反对。
en: The transition to less polluting systems will not be easy, and will meet fierce opposition worldwide from vested interests.

zh: 但柳叶刀委员会报告指出，低污染转型对于我们的社会的健康、福利和繁荣至关重要。
en: But, as the Lancet Commission report shows, the low-pollution transition is essential to the health, wellbeing, and prosperity of our societies.

zh: 我们决不能继续忽视这一全球威胁了。
en: We cannot afford to neglect this global menace any longer.

zh: 乌克兰危机中的切尔诺贝利因素
en: The Chernobyl Factor in the Ukraine Crisis

zh: 洛杉矶 — — 切尔诺贝利核电站爆炸后二十八年，别样的核幽灵出现在乌克兰面前：乌克兰的反应堆可能会在俄罗斯军事入侵中遭受打击。
en: LOS ANGELES – Twenty-eight years after its Chernobyl nuclear plant exploded, Ukraine confronts a nuclear specter of a different kind: the possibility that the country’s reactors could become military targets in the event of a Russian invasion.

zh: 乌克兰代理外长杰舍察在三月海牙召开的核安全峰会上讲话时表示如果局势恶化导致公开战争爆发 ， “ 很多核设施都有可能受到威胁 ” 。
en: Speaking at the Nuclear Security Summit in The Hague in March, Andrii Deshchytsia, Ukraine’s acting foreign minister, cited the “potential threat to many nuclear facilities” should events deteriorate into open warfare.

zh: 本月初，乌克兰驻国际原子能机构大使伊霍尔·普罗科普丘克向管理委员会递交了一封信件，警告军事入侵可能给“乌克兰及邻国领土带来辐射污染威胁 ” 。
en: Earlier in the month, Ihor Prokopchuk, Ukraine’s ambassador to the International Atomic Energy Agency, circulated a letter to the organization’s board of governors warning that an invasion could bring a “threat of radiation contamination on the territory of Ukraine and the territory of neighboring states.”

zh: 基辅的乌克兰议会呼吁国际监察员协助保护核设施，同时囊中羞涩的政府也在尽一切努力完成这项任务。
en: In Kyiv, Ukraine’s parliament responded by calling for international monitors to help protect the plants as the cash-strapped government attempts to boost its own efforts.

zh: 乌克兰的担忧仅仅是一种夸张、如克里姆林所言是“恶意诽谤 ” ， 还是理应引起国际社会的重视？
en: Are Ukraine’s concerns mere hyperbole – a “malicious slander,” as the Kremlin puts it – or should we take them seriously?

zh: 乌克兰政府焦虑的确是不争的事实。
en: For Ukraine’s government, the angst is real.

zh: 就连1986年以后出生的乌克兰人也清楚战争带来的切尔诺贝利式灾难可能造成什么样的后果。
en: Even Ukrainians born after 1986 understand what a Chernobyl-type disaster brought about by battle could look like.

zh: 历史鲜有提供交战国家是否会避免破坏核设施的先例。
en: History offers little guidance as to whether warring countries would avoid damaging nuclear sites.

zh: 除20世纪90年代巴尔干冲突外，还没有对有核国家发动战争或国内作战的先例。
en: With the exception of the 1990’s Balkan conflict, wars have not been fought against or within countries with nuclear reactors.

zh: 在巴尔干冲突中，塞尔维亚军用飞机在冲突刚刚爆发时以威胁的姿态飞越斯洛文尼亚克尔什科核电站，同时激进的塞尔维亚民族主义分子呼吁袭击核电站释放放射性物质。
en: In the case of the Balkans, Serbian military jets overflew Slovenia’s Krško nuclear power plant in a threatening gesture early in the conflict, while radical Serbian nationalists called for attacks to release the radioactive contents.

zh: 塞尔维亚随后呼吁北约不要对其设在贝尔格莱德的大型研究核反应堆展开轰炸。
en: Serbia itself later issued a plea to NATO not to bomb its large research reactor in Belgrade.

zh: 幸运的是，上述两个反应堆都没有遭受袭击战争就结束了。
en: Fortunately, the war ended with both reactors untouched.

zh: 虽然这个例子告诉我们军事政治领导人在袭击核反应堆前应当会三思后行，但仅仅是乌克兰核设施的庞大规模就需要全球更多的注意力。
en: While that case provides some assurance that military and political leaders will think twice about attacking nuclear reactors, the sheer scale of Ukraine’s nuclear enterprise calls for far greater global concern.

zh: 今天，15座老化电厂所发的电量占乌克兰总电量的40 % 。
en: Today, 15 aging plants provide 40% of Ukraine’s electricity.

zh: （毗邻遭到损坏的切尔诺贝利反应堆的几座核反应堆几年前曾被乌克兰下令关闭。
en: (Ukraine shut several reactors operating adjacent to the damaged Chernobyl reactor years ago.)

zh: ）主要集中在四地的乌克兰压水反应堆不同于低稳定性的切尔诺贝利核电站RBMK设计，但如果保障失效依然可能会泄漏放射性物质。
en: Concentrated in four locations, Ukraine’s pressurized water reactors differ from the less stable Chernobyl RBMK design, yet still remain capable of releasing radioactive contents should safeguards fail.

zh: 鉴于俄罗斯领教过切尔诺贝利事故的严重后果，我们希望克里姆林宫不会有故意轰炸核电厂的想法。
en: Given that Russia, too, suffered serious consequences from the Chernobyl accident, it is to be hoped that the Kremlin would recoil at the idea of bombing the plants intentionally.

zh: 但战争充满意外和人为错误，而一旦核电厂出事就可能导致灾难性的效果。
en: But warfare is rife with accidents and human error, and such an event involving a nuclear plant could cause a meltdown.

zh: 比方说异地供电中断就应当引起人们的重视。
en: A loss of off-site power, for example, could be an issue of serious concern.

zh: 虽然核电厂本身产出大量电能，但还需要其他来源为其供电才能维持正常运作。
en: Although nuclear plants are copious producers of electricity, they also require electrical power from other sources to operate.

zh: 没有外来供电冷却泵将会停止运转，从反应堆堆芯带走热量的水循环系统（即使反应堆处于关闭状态也必须正常运转）将会停止运作。
en: Without incoming energy, cooling pumps will cease functioning and the flow of water that carries heat away from the reactor core – required even when the reactor is in shutdown mode – will stop.

zh: 为了防范这一风险，核电厂全部配备有可以运行长达数天直至燃料耗尽的大型应急柴油发电机组。
en: To meet that risk, nuclear plants maintain large emergency diesel generators, which can operate for days – until their fuel runs out.

zh: 2011年日本福岛第一发电站反应堆熔毁表明了主要和应急操作电��同时切断时会产生什么后果。
en: The reactor meltdowns at Japan’s Fukushima Daiichi power station in 2011 demonstrated what happens when primary and emergency operating power are cut.

zh: 这样的漏洞在战争期间会导致令人不安的后果。
en: Such vulnerabilities raise troubling questions in the event of a war.

zh: 战斗可能破坏异地电厂或反应堆输电线路，还可能导致柴油无法运抵完成备用发电机的能量补给工作。
en: Fighting could disrupt off-site power plants or transmission lines servicing the reactor, and could also prevent diesel fuel from reaching the plant to replenish standby generators.

zh: 电厂工作人员可能会在战斗临近时逃离岗位。
en: Operators could abandon their posts should violence encroach.

zh: 此外，战斗人员可能会侵入电厂，威胁破坏电厂释放放射性元素以恐吓对手。
en: Moreover, combatants could invade nuclear plants and threaten sabotage to release radioactive elements to intimidate their opponents.

zh: 还有人可能会到电厂避难，并因此形成僵持不下的危险局势。
en: Others might take refuge there, creating a dangerous standoff.

zh: 军事指挥及控制失灵或战争的硝烟可能使电厂遭受轰炸。
en: A failure of military command and control or the fog of war could bring plants under bombardment.

zh: 严重的放射性污染可能导致上述各种状况。
en: Serious radiological contamination could result in each of these scenarios.

zh: 而且虽然没有人能从释放放射物质中获得好处，但如果战争爆发，我们必须想到会出现意外情况。
en: And, though no one stands to gain from a radioactive release, if war breaks out, we must anticipate the unexpected.

zh: 乌克兰的核放射量可能会超过切尔诺贝利及福岛两座核电站。
en: In Ukraine, nuclear emissions could exceed both Chernobyl and Fukushima.

zh: 战时条件会阻止救援人员在反应堆安全壳失效的情况下抵达问题电厂控制放射性污染。
en: Wartime conditions would prevent emergency crews from getting to an affected plant to contain radiological releases should reactor containments fail.

zh: 而且因为战时政府停止提供社会服务，意图躲避放射性污染的平民会不知道该做什么或去哪里才能自我保护。
en: And, with government services shut down in the midst of fighting, civilians attempting to escape radioactive contamination would not know what to do or where to go to protect themselves.

zh: 上述危险可能是俄总统弗拉基米尔·普京对下令军事入侵乌克兰三思而后行的原因。
en: Such risks might be one reason for Russian President Vladimir Putin to think twice about ordering a military invasion of Ukraine.

zh: 但如果战争爆发，作战者必须尽一切力量让冲突远离核设施以及为其供电的异地电厂。
en: But, should war come, combatants must do all they can to keep conflict away from the nuclear sites and the off-site power sources feeding them.

zh: 电厂工作人员应当储备柴油以保障应急发电机正常运转。
en: Plant operators should stockpile diesel fuel to keep emergency generators operating.

zh: 他们应当检查并维护发电机，保障发电机处于正常状态。
en: They should perform review and maintenance of generators to ensure that they are set to go.

zh: 如果反应堆附近发生战斗，西方应当运送部队保护电厂并保持发电机正常运转；而且西方应在危机发生时召集两国政府展开停火谈判。
en: In the event of fighting near reactors, the West should prepare to ferry forces to secure the plants and keep the generators operating; and, in the event of a meltdown, the West should rally both governments to initiate a cease-fire to deal with the disaster.

zh: 鉴于核问题事关重大，我们不得不做好最坏的打算。
en: Given the stakes, failure to prepare for the worst is not an option.

zh: 新的核危险
en: The New Loose Nukes

zh: 洛杉矶 — — 没有人会否认掌握核资产本身是件危险的事。
en: LOS ANGELES – Nobody would dispute the danger inherent in possessing nuclear assets.

zh: 但这种危险在战区进一步加剧，核材料和武器面临被盗的危险，而反应堆则有可能成为轰炸的目标。
en: But that danger becomes far more acute in a combat zone, where nuclear materials and weapons are at risk of theft, and reactors can become bombing targets.

zh: 这些危险因素（在今天陷入混乱的中东地区多数都非常明显）导致全球动荡国家的核资产安全问题变得令人担忧。
en: These risks – most apparent in today’s chaos-ridden Middle East – raise troubling questions about the security of nuclear assets in volatile countries everywhere.

zh: 最近发生的两起事件显示了其中的利害关系。
en: Two recent events demonstrate what is at stake.

zh: 7月9日，被外界称之为“伊斯兰国家”的武装组织在伊拉克摩苏尔大学得到了40千克（合88磅）铀化合物。
en: On July 9, the militant group now known as the Islamic State captured 40 kilograms (88 pounds) of uranium compounds at Mosul University in Iraq.

zh: 他们手中的铀并非武器级材料；国际核查人员在1991年海湾战争后将所有敏感材料运出了伊拉克（2003年美国入侵时也因此没有找到任何敏感材料 ） 。
en: The captured uranium was not weapons-grade; international inspectors removed all sensitive material from Iraq following the 1991 Gulf War (which is why it was absent when the United States invaded in 2003).

zh: 但如果敏感材料库存丰富，国际社会又该作何反应呢？
en: But what international response, if any, would have been initiated if the cache had been highly enriched?

zh: 就在同一天，哈马斯瞄准以色列迪莫纳反应堆从加沙发射了三枚威力强大的伊朗制火箭。
en: On the same day, Hamas launched three powerful Iranian-designed rockets from Gaza at Israel’s Dimona reactor.

zh: 幸运的是，其中两枚未能击中目标，而第三枚则被以色列成功拦截。
en: Luckily, two missed the target, and Israel managed to intercept the third.

zh: 但此次事件显示敌对行动严重升级，提醒人们战区核反应堆有多么脆弱。
en: But the episode represented a serious escalation of hostilities and served as an important reminder of the vulnerability of nuclear reactors in warzones.
