zh: 其实，哈马斯早在2012年就曾对迪莫纳反应堆发动过类似的袭击，1991年伊拉克也进行过同样的努力，目的是释放该反应堆内容物，从而对以色列民众造成辐射。
en: In fact, Hamas made similar attempts to attack the Dimona complex in 2012, as did Iraq in 1991, with the aim of releasing the site’s contents to inflict radiological damage on Israel’s population.

zh: （肇事者似乎完全不清楚特定天气条件会使放射性碎片集中在以巴勒斯坦人为主的约旦河西岸地区。 ）
en: (The perpetrators appeared clueless to the fact that certain weather conditions would have concentrated the radioactive debris in the Palestinian-majority West Bank.)

zh: 当然，上述事件也有可能只是意外。
en: Of course, it is possible that these events are an aberration.

zh: 毕竟，到目前为止当局对敏感核材料失控的唯一例子是20世纪90年代的格鲁吉亚 - 阿布哈兹战争，当时一股不明身份的部队冲进一家研究所抢走了少量高浓缩铀。
en: After all, the only conflict so far in which authorities have lost control of sensitive nuclear materials was the Georgia-Abkhazia War in the 1990s, when unknown forces seized a small amount of highly enriched uranium from a research institute.

zh: 同样，虽然对在建核反应堆已经发生过多次袭击，但对以色列之外战区业已投入使用的核反应堆的唯一一次袭击发生在前南斯拉夫战争刚刚开始时。 当时塞尔维亚民族主义份子曾考虑派战机轰炸斯洛文尼亚克尔什科电厂。
en: Likewise, though there have been numerous attacks on nuclear reactors under construction, the sole threat to an operating plant in a combat zone outside of Israel occurred at the start of the fighting in ex-Yugoslavia, when Serbian nationalists considered attacking Slovenia’s Krško power plant and sent warplanes over the site.

zh: 电厂运营方暂停发电以遏制核泄漏风险，但那次威胁最后无疾而终。
en: The plant’s operators temporarily halted electricity generation to curb the risk of a radiation release, but nothing came of the threat.

zh: 事实上，每当核资产最为危险的时刻 — — 比方说苏联解体、中国文革和阿尔及尔政变（当时一群叛乱退役将领曾将目光投向法国正在阿尔及利亚沙漠测试的核设施 ） — —最后这些设施都并未遭到攻陷。
en: Indeed, whenever nuclear assets have been least secure – during the Soviet Union’s collapse, China’s Cultural Revolution, and the Algiers putsch (when a group of mutinous retired generals set their sights on a nuclear device that France was testing in the Algerian desert) – they have not been compromised.

zh: 即使在今天的乌克兰，尽管国内冲突不断升级，但该国的15座核电站却并未遭到威胁（虽然乌克兰官员已经采取了新的防御措施，但这种情况随时有可能改变 ） 。
en: Even in Ukraine today, despite the escalating civil conflict, the country’s 15 nuclear power plants have remained untouched (though even with new defensive measures taken by Ukrainian officials, this could easily change).

zh: 我们不可能知道这样的良性模式能否继续下去。
en: It is impossible to know whether this benign pattern will hold.

zh: 但中东近期的事态发展表明人们有理由担心巴基斯坦、北朝鲜和伊朗等其他动荡国家的核设施。
en: But recent developments in the Middle East suggest that there are grounds for concern in other volatile countries, namely Pakistan, North Korea, and Iran.

zh: 巴基斯坦大范围圣战叛乱威胁该国大规模核武器计划，圣战份子之前曾袭击过涉嫌保管核资产的军事基地。
en: Pakistan has a large nuclear weapons program and faces an expansive jihadi insurgency, which previously attacked military bases suspected of housing nuclear assets.

zh: 虽然巴基斯坦迄今为止尚未出现过核泄漏，且政府坚持采取严密的保护措施，但国内日益频繁而严重的动荡局面使未来面临着严重的问题。
en: Though Pakistan has not experienced a nuclear breach, and the government insists that safeguards remain robust, the country’s increasingly frequent and severe bouts of instability raise serious questions about the future.

zh: 虽然北朝鲜核武库规模很小，但对政权可持续性的疑虑却引发了人们强烈的忧虑。
en: While North Korea’s nuclear arsenal is much smaller, persistent doubts about the regime’s sustainability make it a matter of grave concern.

zh: 如果北朝鲜政权崩溃 — — 这种可能性并不小 — — 人们很难阻止转移核资产，甚至使用核武器。
en: In the event of the regime’s collapse – a distinct possibility – it would be difficult to prevent the diversion of its assets, or even the use of its weapons.

zh: 就其本身而言，伊朗似乎相对稳定，至少与邻国相比暂时如此。
en: For its part, Iran seems relatively stable, at least compared to its neighbors.

zh: 但伊朗国内政治确定性很低。
en: But it faces an uncertain political future.

zh: 如果权力斗争浮出水面，那么大型的布什尔反应堆可能被作为讨价还价的筹码。
en: If a power struggle emerges, the large Bushehr reactor could be used as a bargaining chip.

zh: 为了减轻上述风险，国际社会可以保持其传统的观望政策，寄希望于各国政府保持对核设施的控制。
en: To mitigate such risks, the international community could maintain its traditional policy of sitting tight and hoping that governments retain control of their nuclear infrastructure.

zh: 但比如美国就不再满足于这样的政策。
en: But the United States, for one, is no longer satisfied with this approach.

zh: 据媒体报道，美国已经制定策略部署特种部队，在巴基斯坦政府失控的情况下销毁巴基斯坦的核武器。
en: According to media reports, it has devised a strategy for deploying Special Forces to neutralize Pakistan’s nuclear arsenal in the event that its authorities lose control.

zh: 同时某些有政府关系的智库已经在研究一旦朝鲜政权崩溃部署美国作战部队应对核危险问题。
en: And some government-connected think tanks have explored the possibility of deploying US combat forces to address nuclear risks in North Korea if the regime crumbles.

zh: 但这样的计划绝非万无一失 — — 这不仅因为很难发现隐蔽的核资产，而且还因为很难对反应堆采取保护措施。
en: Such plans, however, are by no means foolproof – not least owing to the difficulties of finding concealed nuclear assets and safeguarding reactors.

zh: 此外，即便根据最乐观的估计，美国公众是否愿意在加强国内安全或许就能解决问题的情况下卷入另一次军事冒险也很值得怀疑。
en: Moreover, the American public’s willingness to become enmeshed in yet another risky military venture, when boosting homeland security could suffice, is dubious, at best.

zh: 与其坐等重大的事态变化逼迫我们匆忙采取行动，世界大国应当展开大规模讨论，确定应对动荡国家核危险的最佳方式，并在必要时进行合作。
en: Instead of waiting for a major development to force hurried action, the world’s major powers should engage in a full-throated debate to determine the best approach to address nuclear risks in volatile countries, seeking ways to cooperate whenever necessary.

zh: 归根结底，即使像中美或印度巴基斯坦那样的对手也在上述领域拥有共同利益，阻止全世界最危险的武器落入狂热份子之手对所有人都有益。
en: After all, even rival powers like China and the US or India and Pakistan share an interest in preventing the world’s most dangerous weapons from falling under the control of its most fanatical minds.

zh: 伊朗的核困境
en: Iran’s Nuclear Quandary

zh: 洛杉矶—11月7日和8日，美国及其盟友重新开启了关于伊朗核计划的对话，认真地开始完成将伊朗最新的提议落实为永久性协议的艰巨任务。
en: LOS ANGELES – When the United States and its allies resume talks over Iran’s nuclear program on November 7-8, the vexing task of crafting Iran’s recent proposal into an enduring agreement will begin in earnest.

zh: 通往协议之路障碍甚多，但被人们研究最少的是利比亚和朝鲜去核努力的后果。
en: There are many obstacles to an agreement, but among the least examined is the legacy of nuclear-disarmament efforts involving Libya and North Korea.

zh: 这两个国家所出现的问题是伊朗和美国都不愿意重复的，但要避免也绝非易事。
en: Both cases raise issues that neither Iran nor the US wants to see repeated – but that both will have difficulty avoiding.

zh: 对美国来说，朝鲜显示了一个野心勃勃的穷国是如何通过玩弄对话把戏、争取时间开发核弹的。
en: For the US, North Korea illustrates how a poor but ambitious country developed the bomb by gaming talks and gaining time.

zh: 对伊朗来说，2003年卡扎菲交出利比亚大规模杀伤性武器表明，一个政权在外交关系正常化后仍然会被国际社会视为不受欢迎者，卡扎菲之所以在2011年被推翻，很大程度上是因为他放弃了建立核威慑的机会。
en: For Iran, Muammar el-Qaddafi’s 2003 relinquishment of Libya’s weapons of mass destruction demonstrates how a regime, still considered a bête noire by the international community even after normalization of diplomatic relations, arguably forfeited its survival in 2011 by forgoing the chance to build a nuclear deterrent.

zh: 深入挖掘这两个例子就可以发现伊朗及其国际对话者所面临的的挑战。
en: Digging further into each case illuminates the challenges faced by Iran and its international interlocutors.

zh: 让朝鲜先例变得特别棘手的是伊朗在多大程度上模仿着平壤政权。
en: What makes the North Korea precedent particularly troubling is how much Iran has mimicked the regime in Pyongyang.

zh: 这自然而然的衍生出一个问题：伊朗是否在利用当前谈判回合为掩护继续开发核武器。
en: This naturally prompts questions about whether Iran is using the current round of negotiations as a façade for an ongoing effort to develop nuclear weapons.

zh: 想想再十年前的先例。
en: Consider parallels ten years apart.

zh: 1993年6月，在与美国对华和威胁退出核不扩散条约（NPT）后，朝鲜允许国际原子能机构（IAEA）进行有限度的“保障活动 ” 。
en: In June 1993, following talks with the US and a threat to withdraw from the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT), North Korea allowed the International Atomic Energy Agency to conduct limited “safeguards activities.”

zh: 接着，在1994年10月，美国和朝鲜进入冻结朝鲜核计划的协议框架。
en: Then, in October 1994, the US and North Korea entered into the Agreed Framework to freeze North Korea’s nuclear program.

zh: 类似地，2003年12月，在对IAEA隐藏了纳坦兹铀浓缩设施和其他核项目后，伊朗同意签署 — — 但并未批准 — — 所谓的附加协议，允许更广范围的IAEA监督保障。
en: Similarly, in December 2003, after hiding construction of the Natanz uranium-enrichment facility and other plants from the IAEA, Iran agreed to sign – but not ratify – the so-called Additional Protocol, allowing broader application of IAEA safeguards.

zh: 接着，在2004年11月与欧洲代表的谈判中，伊朗同意暂停核浓缩。
en: Then, in November 2004, in negotiations with European representatives, Iran agreed to suspend nuclear enrichment.

zh: 这两个协定均没有维持太长时间。
en: Neither agreement lasted long.

zh: 1996年3月，IAEA报告说朝鲜并未遵守规定配合对宁边核设施钚元素的检查。
en: In March 1996, the IAEA reported that North Korea was not complying with efforts to verify plutonium held at the Yongbyon nuclear facility.

zh: 2006年10月9日，朝鲜引爆了第一个核武器，联合国安理会通过1718号决议要求朝鲜放弃核计划并重新加入去核化谈判。
en: On October 9, 2006, North Korea detonated its first nuclear weapon, and the United Nations Security Council adopted Resolution 1718 calling on the country to abandon its program and re-join international denuclearization talks.

zh: 自此以后，朝鲜对日渐紧迫的国际制裁的应对措施是两次新的核试验，其中最后一次是在新领袖金正恩的领导下在今年进行的。
en: Since then, North Korea has responded to incremental tightening of international sanctions with two more nuclear tests, the latest this year under the new leadership of Kim Jong-un.

zh: 类似地，2006年1月，在与欧洲使节谈判破裂后，伊朗撕毁了IAEA对纳坦兹核设施设备和储存区的封条。
en: Likewise, in January 2006, following the collapse of negotiations with European emissaries, Iran broke the IAEA seals on the Natanz facility’s equipment and storage areas.

zh: 2月，IAEA向安理会报告伊朗没有坦白其核计划。
en: The following month, the IAEA reported the Islamic Republic to the Security Council for its failure to be forthright about its nuclear program.

zh: 自此以后，伊朗对日渐紧迫的国际制裁的应对措施是建设更多的离心机。
en: Since then, Iran has responded to incremental tightening of international sanctions by building more centrifuges.

zh: 现在的问题是朝鲜-伊朗的亦步亦趋模式是否会在伊朗新总统鲁哈尼手中结束。
en: The question now is whether the North Korea-Iran parallel stops with Iran’s new president, Hassan Rouhani.

zh: 利比亚先例也是伊朗所面临的难题。
en: The Libyan legacy confronts Iran with its own conundrum.

zh: 与伊朗一样，在试图开��大规模杀伤性武器期间，卡扎菲的利比亚经受了多年的经济和政治孤立。
en: Like Iran, Qaddafi’s Libya suffered economic and political isolation for many years during which it attempted to advance a WMD program.

zh: 20世纪90年代末，利比亚已经支撑不住了。
en: By the late 1990’s, however, it had had enough.

zh: 英国和美国谈判员秘密会晤了利比亚人员，商讨如何解决1988年泛美航空103航班在苏格兰洛克比上空的爆炸事件以及其他恐怖主义事件。
en: British and American negotiators secretly met with Libyan counterparts to resolve the case of the 1988 bombing of Pan Am Flight 103 over Lockerbie, Scotland, and other terrorism issues.

zh: 在随后达成的让步条件中，卡扎菲同意取消其尚在雏形中的核计划以换取不再受到歧视待遇。
en: In the quid pro quo that followed, Qaddafi agreed to eliminate his nascent nuclear program in exchange for an end to pariah status.

zh: 除此之外还有一个关键性要求：美国必须承诺不寻求推翻卡扎菲政权。
en: This was coupled with a critical demand: no deal without America’s commitment to eschew regime change.

zh: 2003年12月9日，利比亚正式宣布放弃所有大规模杀伤性武器。
en: On December 19, 2003, Libya formally renounced all WMD efforts.

zh: 八年后，在美国掠食者无人机和法国空军的打击下，卡扎菲倒台。
en: Eight years later, pinned down by a US Predator drone and French airstrikes, Qaddafi met his demise.

zh: 由于没有核威慑力，他的政权对美国撕毁协议毫无办法 — — 朝鲜没有重蹈这一覆辙。
en: Without a nuclear deterrent, his regime was helpless when the US reneged on the deal – a lesson that has not been lost on North Korea.

zh: 考虑到这段历史，伊朗有强大的激励至少保留核突围的选择权（这意味着完成所有除武器化之外的步骤 ） 。
en: Given this history, Iran has a strong incentive to retain at least a nuclear-breakout option (which would mean completing all but the final steps to weaponization).

zh: 当然，伊朗领导人也许认为经济孤立是政权的最大危险。
en: Of course, Iran’s leaders may believe that economic isolation is the greatest danger to the regime.

zh: 但利比亚的下场让他们担心，如果没有足够的威慑，他们也难逃卡扎菲的命运。
en: But what happened in Libya has made them fear that Qaddafi’s fate could be theirs, too, without an adequate deterrent.

zh: 事实上，2011年在评论卡扎菲的困境时，最高领袖哈梅内伊说 ： “ 卡扎菲先生把所有核设施一股脑儿打包装船运往西方人，对他们说 ： ‘ 拿走吧！
en: Indeed, commenting on Qaddafi’s plight in 2011, Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei said, “[T]his gentleman wrapped up all his nuclear facilities, packed them on a ship and delivered them to the West and said, ‘Take them!’

zh: ’看看我们，在看看他们现在的状况。 ”
en: Look where we are, and in what position they are now.”

zh: 但在两年后的今天，伊朗必须再一次看看自己。
en: But today, two years later, Iran must look again at where it is.

zh: 只要严厉的经济制裁保持下去，伊朗政府最终无法拥有核武器并享受核武器带来的好处。
en: As long as crippling economic sanctions remain in place, the government will be unable to have its yellowcake and eat it, too.

zh: 允许伊朗保有一些低层次浓缩能力或许是可行的让步 — — 也能让伊朗领导人保住颜面 — — 但伊朗必须实打实地向IAEA披露所有核活动并确认停止所有有利于武器化的设施。
en: Allowing Iran to retain some low-grade enrichment capacity would be a plausible concession – and one that would allow the country’s leaders to save face – but only if linked to Iran’s unfettered disclosure of all nuclear activities to the IAEA and confirmed cessation of any capability that contributes to weaponization.

zh: 此外，考虑到兹事体大，与伊朗的国际协定必须有白纸黑字的作弊应对措施，包括采取军事行动。
en: And, given the stakes, any international agreement with Iran must come with an assured response to cheating, including military action.

zh: 伊朗领导人没有多少回旋余地，只有两个选择。
en: With little leverage, Iran’s leaders would then have two options.

zh: 他们可以效仿朝鲜，牺牲经济繁荣换取核突破，然后寄希望于美国和以色列要求把“所有选择”摆上台面以阻止他们的动作是纸老虎；或者他们可以追求经济繁荣，放弃核武器能力，然后寄希望于利比亚式的叛乱不会席卷全国、让政权重蹈卡扎菲覆辙。
en: They could follow North Korea by sacrificing economic prosperity for nuclear breakout, and hope that US and Israeli talk of “all options” being on the table to stop their efforts is a bluff; or they could pursue economic prosperity by forgoing a nuclear-weapons capacity, and hope that a Libya-style revolt does not envelope the country and doom the regime to a fate like that of Qaddafi.

zh: 这不是一个容易的选择，但伊朗领导人无法将这一选择拖延多久。
en: It is not an easy choice, but it is one that Iran’s leaders cannot postpone for much longer.

zh: 肯尼亚的索马里悖论
en: Kenya’s Somali Contradiction

zh: 内罗毕—上周，索马里青年军（al-Shabaab）袭击了内罗毕韦斯特盖特（Westgate）购物中心，导致70多人丧生，这是对肯尼亚干预索马里的惩罚。
en: NAIROBI – The attack that killed more than 70 people at Nairobi’s Westgate shopping mall last week was, according to al-Shabaab, the Somali Islamist militant group that carried it out, retribution for Kenya’s intervention in Somalia.

zh: 这带来了一个简单的问题：肯尼亚在索马里做了什么？ 值得为此付出如此代价吗？
en: That raises a simple question: What is Kenya doing in Somalia, and is it worth the price?

zh: 自两年前肯尼亚军队入侵其东北方邻国以来，政府告诉肯尼亚人民他们是在和索马里青年军打仗。
en: Since Kenya’s army invaded its northeastern neighbor two years ago, the government has told Kenyans that they were going to war against al-Shabaab.

zh: 但是，正如大部分肯尼亚官方公告所说的，这只是部分事实。
en: But, as with most official pronouncements in Kenya, that story was only partly true.

zh: 2011年10月15日晚，我躺在床上，睡意全无，听到肯尼亚军车隆隆驶过边境小镇达达布（Dadaab）进入索马里，这是肯尼亚历史上第一次对外用兵。
en: On the night of October 15, 2011, I lay awake listening to the Kenyan military convoys passing through the border town of Dadaab on their way to Somalia to launch the first foreign military campaign in Kenya’s history.

zh: 肯尼亚出兵的直接原因是达达布周边巨大的难民营中的两名西班牙医务人员遭到劫持。
en: The proximate cause was the abduction of two Spanish aid workers from the vast refugee camps that encircle Dadaab.

zh: 对肯尼亚当局来说，此前已发生过一系列西方人被索马里青年军劫持事件，此次事件让他们忍无可忍；为了停止索马里青年军的侵犯，他们发动了这次军方领袖相信很快就可以结束的行动 ， 。
en: For the Kenyan authorities, it was the final straw after a series of abductions of Westerners by al-Shabaab; to stop the incursions, they launched what military leaders believed would be a quick campaign.

zh: 过去两年中，表面上取得了一些进展。
en: Over the last two years, some progress has ostensibly been made.

zh: 两名西班牙医务人员于去年7月被释放，此后索马里青年军劫持事件也只发生了一起。
en: The two Spanish aid workers were released last July, and al-Shabaab has attempted only one abduction since.

zh: 此外，叛军被逐出了其主要基地、索马里南部的基斯马约（Kismayo）港。
en: Moreover, the rebels have been dislodged from the southern Somali port of Kismayo, which was once their main base.

zh: 但索马里青年军仍控制着索马里大部，仍有能力袭击首都摩加迪休和内罗毕。
en: But al-Shabaab retains control of the majority of Somalia and remains capable of striking Mogadishu, the capital, as well as Nairobi.

zh: 考虑到这一点，如果肯尼亚政府的目的如其所说是摧毁索马里青年军，那么这场军事干预就是彻头彻尾的失败。
en: Given this, if the Kenyan government’s aim was, as it claimed, to destroy al-Shabaab, the intervention has been a spectacular failure.

zh: 但这并不是故事的全部。
en: But there is much more to the story.

zh: 事实上，报复该军事组织无非是发动所谓的朱巴兰计划（Jubaland Initiative）的蹩脚借口，其目的在索马里南部扶植一个半自治附庸国以保护肯尼亚的安全和经济利益。
en: In fact, retaliation against the militant group was little more than a convenient excuse to launch the so-called Jubaland Initiative, a plan to protect Kenya’s security and economic interests by carving out a semi-autonomous client state in southern Somalia.

zh: 尽管关于该计划的情报一开始仅限于肯尼亚政府官员知道，但其轮廓很快就浮出了水面。
en: While knowledge of the plan was initially confined largely to Kenyan government officials, it was not long before its contours began to be revealed.

zh: 肯尼亚在基斯马约悄悄地复制了一个附庸政权，对新政府提供支持，为使朱巴兰成为半自治地区做准备。 随着索马里的分裂，出现了普特兰（Puntland ） 、 索马里兰（Somaliland）和其他许多自称雏形国家的半自治省。
en: Kenya has installed a client regime in Kismayo, and has supported the new government in its quest to make Jubaland a semi-autonomous region, along the lines of Puntland, Somaliland, and the many other self-declared proto-states that have emerged as Somalia has unraveled.

zh: 这样的缓冲国除了可以防止索马里暴力溢出到肯尼亚、破坏其安全和基于旅游业的经济，还可以强迫其接受目前住在达达布难民营的50万索马里难民。
en: Beyond preventing Somalia’s violence from spilling over into Kenya and undermining its security and its tourist-driven economy, such a buffer state could be forced to absorb the half-million Somali refugees who now live in Dadaab’s refugee camps.

zh: 从这个角度看，朱巴兰计划是再好不过的种族分离计划，索马里青年军可以借此良机在肯尼亚招兵买马。
en: In this sense, the Jubaland Initiative is a policy of stunning racial profiling – and a gift to al-Shabaab recruiters in Kenya.

zh: 此外，与保卫基斯马约让索马里青年军处于劣势的说法相反，联合国索马里和厄立特里亚监督小组在7月份报告说，肯尼亚国防军实际上在于索马里青年军做交易。
en: Furthermore, contrary to claims that securing Kismayo put al-Shabaab at a disadvantage, the United Nations Monitoring Group on Somalia and Eritrea reported in July that the Kenyan Defense Forces have actually gone into business with al-Shabaab.

zh: 肯尼亚控制基斯马约后，索马里青年军在基斯马约木炭（可能还有象牙）出口中获得的利润有所增加。
en: The group’s profits from illicit charcoal (and possibly ivory) exported from Kismayo have grown since Kenya took control.

zh: 这凸显出一个根本性问题：肯尼亚的腐败顽疾一直在拖累决策者的目标。
en: This highlights a fundamental problem: the Kenyan state’s endemic corruption constantly undermines its policymakers’ goals.

zh: 事实上，在基斯马约，肯尼亚官员早已故态重萌 — — 追逐私利。
en: Indeed, in Kismayo, Kenyan officials have reverted to their default occupation – the pursuit of private profit.

zh: 肯尼亚军队、政客和关系深广的商人并没有致力于实现击败索马里青年军的外交目标，而是在为自己的腰包奋斗。
en: Instead of working to achieve the diplomatic objective of defeating al-Shabaab, Kenya’s military, politicians, and well-connected businessmen have been lining their own pockets.

zh: 此外，肯尼亚渴望扶植一个缓冲国与索马里政府统一全国的目标冲突。
en: Moreover, Kenya’s desire to carve out a buffer state conflicts with the Somali government’s goal of uniting the country.

zh: 事实上，摩加迪休政府最不愿意看到的便是又一个挑战其权威的半自治地区 — — 或又一个别有用心蚕食其南部领土的国家。
en: Indeed, the last thing the government in Mogadishu wants is another semi-autonomous region challenging its authority – or another country annexing southern Somalia for its own purposes.

zh: 美国和欧盟 — — 它们为非盟干预索马里提供了资金并支持摩加迪休政府 — — 企图掩盖与肯尼亚在朱巴兰计划上的分歧，尽管这有可能助长进一步冲突。
en: The United States and the European Union – which are bankrolling the African Union’s intervention in Somalia to support the Mogadishu-based government – have attempted to paper over the disagreement with Kenya over the Jubaland Initiative, despite its potential to fuel further conflict.

zh: 事实上，今年早些时候，肯尼亚支持的朱巴兰军队与索马里政府军在基斯马约交过火。
en: In fact, Kenya-backed Jubaland forces clashed with Somali government troops in Kismayo earlier this year.

zh: 韦斯特盖特袭击案应该会刺激肯尼亚领导人反思其索马里政策。
en: The Westgate attack should spur Kenya’s leaders to re-think their approach toward Somalia.

zh: 更明确的战略应该包括切断索马里青年军的财源和遏制让索马里青年军壮大的怨气 — — 比如针对索马里人的人权侵害、歧视穆斯林、对索马里的外部势力干预以及腐败。
en: A more coherent strategy would involve cutting off al-Shabaab’s funding and addressing the grievances – such as human-rights abuses against Somalis, discrimination against Muslims, foreign meddling in Somalia, and corruption – that motivate its recruits.

zh: 极度扭曲的索马里青年军甚至表示支持国际刑事法庭起诉肯尼亚领导人在2007—2008年选举后发生的流血事件中的罪行。
en: In a bizarre twist, al-Shabaab even called on Kenyans to prosecute their leaders for post-election bloodletting in 2007-2008.

zh: 在冲天怨气的作用下 — — 更重要的是肯尼亚国家的孱弱和腐败 — — 暴力循环难以打破。
en: Given these intractable grievances – and, more important, the weakness and corruption of the Kenyan state – the cycle of violence will be very difficult to break.

zh: 这就是韦斯特盖特购物中心袭击案绝不可能是最后的悲剧的原因。
en: That is why the attack on the Westgate mall is unlikely to be the last such tragedy.

zh: 恐怖威胁下的突尼斯
en: Terrorized Tunisia

zh: 突尼斯 — — 最近针对柏林圣诞市场的恐怖袭击 — — 此次袭击造成十二人死亡、超过五十人受伤 — — 为今年欧洲各地的假日庆祝活动蒙上了一层阴影。
en: TUNIS – The recent terror attack on Berlin’s Christmas market – which killed 12 and injured more than 50 – cast a pall over this year’s holiday celebrations across Europe.

zh: 恐怖袭击时我碰巧在突尼斯，在突尼斯人看来，这次袭击同样产生了重大、尽管截然不同的影响。
en: Viewed from Tunis, where I happened to be during the fallout, the attack has also had a major, albeit different, impact.

zh: 突尼斯毕竟是被控罪犯阿尼斯·阿米尔的祖国。
en: Tunisia, after all, is the home country of Anis Amri, the alleged perpetrator.

zh: 像欧洲人一样，突尼斯人害怕恐怖主义。
en: Like Europeans, Tunisians fear terrorism.

zh: 但他们所害怕的不仅是像2015年发生在突尼斯巴尔多博物馆和苏斯海滩那样的个人恐怖袭击，甚至是从2011年政权更迭开始后屡次发生的政治暗杀。
en: But they fear not just individual terrorist attacks, like those in the Bardo museum in Tunis and on the beach in Sousse in 2015, or even the numerous political assassinations it has faced since its regime change began in 2011.

zh: 突尼斯人担心社会动荡或将破坏他们令人赞叹但却依然脆弱的年轻的民主体制。
en: Tunisians worry that social upheaval will destroy their remarkable but fragile young democracy.

zh: 邻国利比亚提供了体制被破坏所产生的恐怖后果的鲜明例子。
en: Neighboring Libya offers a stark illustration of what that could look like.

zh: 突尼斯政府试图单枪匹马控制局面的前景并不乐观。
en: The prospect of Tunisia’s government attempting to manage the situation alone is not an attractive one.

zh: 突尼斯人知道他们的国家非常脆弱，无法真正保护他们。
en: Tunisians know that their state is weak and cannot really protect them.

zh: 他们最终可能像埃及一样，埃及正在成为一个警察国家，或者走上阿尔及利亚所走的道路，25年前在与政治伊斯兰主义有过一段短暂的调情后，阿尔及利亚局势最终陷入专制镇压和多年的暴力冲突。
en: They could end up like Egypt, which is becoming a police state, or move in the direction taken by Algeria, where a brief flirtation with political Islam 25 years ago gave way to an authoritarian clampdown and years of violent conflict.

zh: 更糟的是，恐怖主义所引发的担忧几乎扼杀了突尼斯的大规模旅游业，严重削弱了其国内经济。
en: Making matters worse, concerns about terrorism have all but killed off Tunisia’s large tourism industry, severely weakening the economy.

zh: 结果导致这个已经在接受国际货币基金组织援助的国家还在试图通过增加国家就业来购买社会稳定。
en: As a result, a country that already receives International Monetary Fund support is trying to buy social stability by increasing state employment.

zh: 为了抑制不断扩张的预算赤字，这个国家选择增加税收，从而进一步削弱了增长前景。
en: To contain the bulging budget deficit, it has opted to increase taxes, further reducing growth.

zh: 因为主要工会组织固执己见且民间团体感到心灰意冷，导致这样的经济衰退螺旋开始制度化。
en: This downward spiral has become institutionalized, as the main unions have dug in their heels and civil society has become disillusioned.

zh: 尤其是年轻人对机构缺乏信任 — — 这在一个38%的人口还不到25岁的国家造成了严重的问题。
en: Young people, in particular, lack trust in institutions – a serious problem in a country where 38% of the population is under 25 years old.

zh: 我在突尼斯遇到的来自不同政治背景的年轻人因为英国非政府组织前瞻思考所做的工作而走到一起，这是一家促进世俗和宗教世界观之间相互理解的非政府组织。
en: The young people I met in Tunis, brought together by the British NGO Forward Thinking, which promotes understanding between between secular and religious worldviews, come from across the political spectrum.

zh: 但他们都有一个共同点：就是把自己视为全球化的受害者。
en: But they have one thing in common: they view themselves as victims of globalization.

zh: 国际社会在他们眼中合谋反对他们，破坏他们找到工作和组建家庭的机会。
en: The international community is, in their view, conspiring against them, undermining their chances to find employment and form families.

zh: 这种看法为恐怖份子招募者创造了肥沃的土壤；突尼斯派往叙利亚和伊拉克作战的圣战者比其他任何国家都多。
en: This perception has created fertile ground for terrorist recruiters; Tunisia has sent more jihadis than any other country to fight in Syria and Iraq.

zh: 突尼斯的跨境恐怖主义威胁已经吸引了国际关注。
en: The threat of cross-border terrorism has attracted international attention to Tunisia.

zh: 但这并不是我们关心该国命运的唯一理由。
en: But it is not the only reason we should care about the country’s fate.

zh: 突尼斯仍然是一座希望的灯塔，不懈地追求地区民主和政治自由。
en: Tunisia remains a beacon of hope for democracy and political freedom in the region.

zh: 我与一位前乌克兰官员一道访问突尼斯，乌克兰尽管有着不同的历史和文化，但却与突尼斯有许多共同之处。
en: I visited Tunis with a former official from Ukraine, a country that, despite having a very different history and culture, has a lot in common with Tunisia.

zh: 乌克兰也经历了一场导致前任领袖流亡的革命，不料竟面对备受推崇的改革陷入停滞的结果。
en: Ukraine, too, experienced a revolution that drove its former leader into exile, only to see sought-after reforms stall.

zh: 突尼斯和乌克兰同样面临战争的严重破坏（突尼斯所受的战争破坏来自利比亚 ） ， 包括大量流离失所人口的涌入（大约有200万难民涌入上述两国 ） 。
en: And both have faced serious disruptions from war (in Tunisia’s case, in Libya), including an influx of displaced people (each country is home to around two million refugees).

zh: 国际社会必须确保突尼斯和乌克兰的革命潜力得到充分发挥。
en: The international community must help to ensure that both Tunisia and Ukraine can fulfill their revolutions’ potential.

zh: 这必须包括协助解决难民问题，以及 — — 更重要的是 — — 支持强化政府力量的广泛改革。
en: This must include help in dealing with refugees, as well as – and more important – support for broad state-strengthening reforms.

zh: 尽管存在种种问题，但多亏伊斯兰复兴党运动和非宗教议会政党，在突尼斯已经启动的政治对话成功地将这个国家从政治深渊的边缘拉了回来。
en: For all of its flaws, the political dialogue that has been initiated in Tunisia, thanks to the Islamist movement Ennahda and the non-religious parliamentary parties, has saved the country from the political abyss.

zh: 但除非政府能够实现改革，否则对话 — — 还有突尼斯年轻人的未来 — — 迟早会崩溃。
en: But unless the government can deliver on reforms, that dialogue will collapse – and so will the prospects of Tunisia’s young people.

zh: 乌克兰在这个问题上也应当吸取教训。
en: Ukraine holds a lesson here as well.

zh: 在外部势力的强势支持下，其国内改革进程已经取得了成功。
en: Its reform process has taken hold, thanks partly to significant outside support.

zh: 但既得利益仍然阻碍国家的进步。
en: But entrenched interests are still resisting progress.

zh: 尽管改革必须得到国内支持，外部势力 — — 尤其是欧盟 — — 可以通过指明可行的体制改革道路来强化当地人的目标。
en: While reforms must be owned domestically, outsiders – in particular, the European Union – can help to reinforce the local vision by providing a viable path of institutional change.

zh: 伸出援手符合欧盟自身的利益。
en: Extending a helping hand is in the EU’s self-interest.

zh: 欧盟也同样面临难民危机，如果没有有效的合作关系就很难解决好。
en: It, too, is facing a refugee crisis, which it cannot address without effective partnerships.

zh: 例如，欧洲机构和西班牙政府成功地控制了直布罗陀海峡两岸的移民流动。
en: For example, European institutions and the Spanish government have succeeded in containing the flow of migrants across the Strait of Gibraltar.

zh: 为控制移民危机进一步恶化，同时降低移民自身所面临的风险，必须与可信的伙伴国达成更多协议。
en: To get a handle on the wider migration crisis, while making migration less hazardous for the migrants themselves, more deals with credible partners must be made.

zh: 突尼斯在这方面可以发挥积极作用。
en: And here, Tunisia is a good candidate.

zh: 欧洲已经成功地与突尼斯谈判限制移民流动，并遣返那些庇护申请被拒绝的民众。
en: Europe already has been able to negotiate arrangements with Tunisia to restrict migrant flows and to return those who have been denied asylum.

zh: ���柏林袭击凸显了该国体制能力的局限性。
en: Yet the Berlin attack highlights the limits of the country’s institutional capacity.

zh: 显而易见，阿米尔从德国的驱逐出境被迫推迟，因为突尼斯官僚体制在确认其公民身份的过程中效率低下。
en: Apparently, Amri’s expulsion from Germany was postponed, owing to the Tunisian bureaucracy’s slowness in confirming his citizenship.

zh: 这也是国际社会为什么必须为突尼斯提供资源强化其国家机构和民间社会，以及与欧盟进一步融合，并像对乌克兰那样指导其国内政治改革的理由。
en: That is why the international community must also offer Tunisia resources to strengthen its state agencies and civil society alike, as well as a vision of closer integration with the EU to help direct the political process, much as it has done in Ukraine.

zh: 这无关欧盟成员资格，而是需要开放市场和放松签证限制（显然在柏林大屠杀发生后推行这样的政策很有难度 ） 。
en: This is not about EU membership, but about opening up markets and relaxing visa restrictions (admittedly a hard sell after the Berlin massacre).

zh: 突尼斯和乌克兰的恐惧在于欧洲会进一步采取封闭政策。
en: The fear, in both Tunisia and Ukraine, is that Europe will close its doors further.

zh: 在英国投票退出欧盟后我看到了乌克兰改革者眼中的痛苦，而在柏林，袭击者身份曝光后我感受到同样的痛苦也出现在突尼斯人眼中。
en: I saw the distress in the eyes of Ukrainian reformers after the United Kingdom’s vote to leave the EU, and I sensed a similar reaction in Tunisia when the Berlin attacker’s identity emerged.

zh: 通过努力令自身与外界隔绝，欧洲最终只会剥夺这些国家民众在国内更好生活的希望。
en: By attempting to insulate itself from the outside world, Europe would only end up depriving these countries’ citizens of any hope of better lives at home.

zh: 美国的贝卢斯科尼
en: America’s Berlusconi

zh: 伦敦 — — 过去几周来，在经历了一次矛盾声明层出不穷的漫长的竞选活动后，世界各国一直在猜测美国当选总统唐纳德·特朗普在任职期间将作何表现以及他将实行什么样的政策。
en: LONDON – For the past couple of weeks, the world has been guessing at how US President-elect Donald Trump will behave in office and what policies he will pursue, following a long campaign full of contradictory statements.

zh: 美国上一任商界总统沃伦·哈丁和赫伯特·胡佛任职期间已经过于久远，很难提供太多的具体线索。
en: America’s previous businessman-presidents – Warren G. Harding and Herbert Hoover – were around too long ago to provide much guidance.

zh: 但近期欧洲却有一个先例：那就是意大利的西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼。
en: There is, however, a recent European precedent: Italy’s Silvio Berlusconi.

zh: 特朗普的成绩，曾经是贝卢斯科尼的创造。
en: What Trump has achieved, Berlusconi pioneered.

zh: 像特朗普一样，贝卢斯科尼是在房地产领域掘到第一桶金的商界巨子。
en: Like Trump, Berlusconi is a businessman who made his first fortune in real estate.

zh: 当1994年步入政坛时，他被视为局外人，虽然也像特朗普一样，一直与很多内部人士保持着密切的关系。
en: When he entered politics in 1994, he was an outsider, albeit one who, also like Trump, had long been close to plenty of insiders.

zh: 相似之处还不止于此。
en: The similarities don’t end there.

zh: 特朗普和贝卢斯科尼都非常熟悉法庭内部事务；参选以来，特朗普迅速采取措施解决了针对特朗普大学的欺诈诉讼，但仍有针对他本人及其企业的其他七十宗诉讼处在审理过程之中。
en: Both Trump and Berlusconi are intimately familiar with the insides of courtrooms; Trump has moved fast since the election to settle fraud lawsuits against Trump University, but has about 70 other suits outstanding against him and his businesses.

zh: 而且由于拥有大型企业帝国，他们都与政府首脑角色有着一系列利益冲突。
en: And both have an array of conflicts of interest with their role as head of government, thanks to their large business empires.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼像特朗普一样，成功地把自己塑造为富人和民粹主义者。
en: Berlusconi, like Trump, managed to present himself as a rich man and a populist.

zh: 他乐于与民众直接沟通，绕过传统媒体和党派机构。
en: He preferred to communicate directly with the people, bypassing traditional media and party structures.

zh: 他喜欢追求豪宅和美女在某种程度上增强了他对民众的吸引力。
en: His propensity for glamorous women and glitzy homes somehow enhanced his popular appeal.

zh: 特朗普和贝卢斯科尼之间的比较还远远不能停留在表象上。
en: The comparison between Trump and Berlusconi is far from superficial.

zh: 事实上，贝卢斯科尼在意大利的表现 — — 他在本国也被称之为骑士 — — 为美国和世界对特朗普的期待提供了六大明确的线索。
en: In fact, Italy’s experience with Berlusconi – or Il Cavaliere (the Knight), as he is known in his country – provides six clear lessons for Americans and the world on what to expect from Trump.

zh: 首先，任何人都不应低估下一任美国总统。
en: First, no one should underestimate the next US president.

zh: 特朗普已经一再出人意料；认为他能赢得共和党初选的人都少之又少。
en: Already, Trump has defied expectations; few expected him even to win the Republican primary.

zh: 但许多观察家仍然预测他即将到来的倒台，推测他即使在四年任期届满之前未遭弹劾，在白宫任职也很难超过四年之久。
en: Yet many observers continue to predict his imminent downfall, assuming that he will last only four years in the White House, if he is not impeached before that.

zh: 但贝卢斯科尼的经历却与人们的想象截然不同。
en: Berlusconi’s experience tells a different story.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼也一直被他的竞争对手所低估。
en: Berlusconi, too, has been consistently underestimated by his opponents.

zh: 评论家认为他因过于无知和缺乏经验而难以胜任总理，推测他无法在政治的短兵相接和政府压力下持续存活。
en: Commentators deemed him too ignorant and inexperienced to last as prime minister, assuming that he would not survive the cut and thrust of politics or the pressures of government.

zh: 但贝卢斯科尼却仍然是意大利政界的主要人物。
en: Yet Berlusconi remains one of the kingpins of Italian politics.

zh: 过去22年，他曾经赢得三次大选，并在九年时间里担任总理职务。
en: In the last 22 years, he has won three general elections and served as prime minister for nine years.

zh: 每次记者和知识分子试图在公开辩论中同贝卢斯科尼较量，他们都落于下风。
en: Every time journalists or intellectuals have tried to take him on in public debate, they have lost.

zh: 特朗普的批评者 — — 其实包括所有美国观察家 — — 都应该牢记这种情况。
en: Trump’s critics – indeed, all US observers – should keep that in mind.

zh: 第二个教训是特朗普很可能实行本质上永无止境的政治竞选，让自己直接融入对话的主题当中。
en: The second lesson is that Trump will probably pursue what is essentially a permanent political campaign, injecting himself directly into conversations.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼常常利用电视（尤其是他自己的商业频道）来实现这一目标。
en: Berlusconi has often used television, especially his own commercial channels, to that end.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼不去接受他无法控制的采访，而是经常与关系密切的追随者合作，或者直接面对摄像机。
en: Instead of giving interviews he cannot control, Berlusconi has often worked with favored acolytes, or simply talked directly to the camera.

zh: 许多政治脱口秀都曾被总理要求发表意见的电话所打断过。
en: When he was in office, many a political talk show was interrupted by a phone call from the prime minister demanding to have his say.

zh: 从特朗普身上，我们不仅会看到持续密集的推特攻势，还会看到他利用电视、包括脱口秀和其他渠道直接向民众发表谈话。
en: From Trump, we should expect not just a continued Twitter barrage, but also the use of TV, including talk shows, and other channels to speak directly to the people.

zh: 特朗普决定不召开新闻发布会，而是发布时长两分半的YouTube视频来阐述他的政策重点进一步强化了这种解读。
en: Trump’s decision to release a two-and-a-half-minute YouTube video laying out his priorities, in lieu of a press conference, reinforces this reading.

zh: 虽然这种做法似乎离总统有些距离，但至少在一个能迅速随意玩弄事实的营销大师操纵下，这种方法能够发挥不错的效果。
en: While the approach may not seem very presidential, it works, at least when carried out by a master marketer who plays fast and loose with the facts.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼成功背后的第三个教训是即使非常富裕和有权有势的人也可以有效地借助受害者陈述。
en: The third lesson from Berlusconi’s success is that even a very wealthy and powerful person can wield the victim narrative effectively.

zh: 事实上，即使在执政期间，贝卢斯科尼也一直声称自己是司法机构、商业竞争对手 、 “ 共产主义分子”和政治机构的攻击对象。
en: Indeed, even while in office, Berlusconi consistently claimed that he was being attacked by the judiciary, by rival businessmen, by “communists,” by the political establishment.

zh: 情况危急时，特朗普也会这样做。
en: When the chips are down, expect Trump to do the same.

zh: 不要以为他是亿万富翁、出生在富裕家庭、或者在下一次竞选中他的身份将是现任总统。
en: Never mind that he is a billionaire, born to a wealthy family, or that, in the next election, he will be the incumbent.

zh: 他将自始至终把自己描绘成处在谋求自我利益敌人的包围之中。
en: He will consistently portray himself as besieged by self-serving enemies.

zh: 第四个教训是污蔑必然发生。
en: The fourth lesson is that mudslinging is bound to happen.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼随意利用自己的电视台和新闻媒体来抹黑对手，以致作家罗伯特·萨维亚诺将其称之为他的“抹黑机器 ” 。
en: Berlusconi’s used his TV stations and newspapers so liberally to smear his opponents that the writer Roberto Saviano called them his macchina del fango or “mud machine.”

zh: 特朗普往往通过推特来攻击媒体、就像他“放开”诽谤法的竞选口号一样都是类似的前兆。
en: Trump’s attacks on the media, often carried out via Twitter, are a precursor to this, as are his campaign vows to “open up” libel laws.

zh: 特朗普的首席抹黑专家可能是新任命的首席战略家斯蒂芬·班农，班农曾担任极右翼布莱巴特新闻的主席职务。
en: His chief mud-slinger is likely to be his newly appointed chief strategist, Stephen Bannon, the former chair of the ultra right-wing Breitbart News.

zh: 第五个教训是像贝卢斯科尼一样，特朗普很可能继续在政府中遵循忠诚高于一切的原则。
en: The fifth lesson is that Trump will probably continue to prize loyalty above all else in his administration, just as Berlusconi has.

zh: 特朗普已经安排他年龄最大的三个子女 — — 他们本应在他竞选总统期间经营他的企业 — — 成为他竞选和过渡时期的关键力量。
en: Already, Trump has made his three oldest children – who are supposed to run his business during his presidency – key players in his campaign and transition.

zh: 联邦法律可能禁止特朗普任命其子女担任政府职务，但他们无疑将成为决策的核心力量。
en: Federal law may prohibit Trump from appointing his children to government posts, but they will surely remain at the center of his decision-making.

zh: 他的女儿伊万卡·特朗普及其丈夫贾里德·库什纳已经与一位政府首脑 — — 日本的安倍晋三 — — 一道参与了特朗普的首次会议。
en: Already, his daughter, Ivanka Trump, and her husband, Jared Kushner, attended Trump’s first meeting with a head of government, Japan’s Shinzo Abe.

zh: 就连特朗普家人以外的任命 — — 往往是在特朗普内阁外不太可能有位置的争议或激进人物 — — 反映出他对个人忠诚的强调。
en: Even Trump’s non-family appointments – often controversial or radical figures who would not have a place in any administration except his – reflect an emphasis on personal loyalty.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼教训的最后一课是应当重视对像俄罗斯总统普京这样强人政府的崇敬表达。
en: The final lesson of Berlusconi is that expressions of admiration for strongmen like Russian President Vladimir Putin should be taken seriously.

zh: 像贝卢斯科尼和特朗普这样孤独而自恋的游侠习惯于进行个人交易，并喜爱与其他强人对话。
en: Narcissistic lone rangers like Berlusconi and Trump are accustomed to making personal deals, and prefer other strongmen as their interlocutors.

zh: 特朗普任职期间最期待的海外出访是到普京的乡间别墅及利比亚独裁者卡扎菲上校的帐篷，而不是到无聊的欧洲理事会会议或G20峰会上。
en: Berlusconi’s favorite overseas visits while in office were to Putin’s dacha and former Libyan dictator Colonel Muammar el-Qaddafi’s tent, not to boring European Council meetings or G20 summits.

zh: 但归根结底，西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼和唐纳德·特朗普之间只有一个关键不同。
en: In the end, however, there is one key difference between Silvio Berlusconi and Donald Trump.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼任职期间除通过向其支持者提供资源和好处来推动其商业和个人利益以及培养个人势力外并无真正的政策目标。
en: Berlusconi had no real agenda while in office, except to further his business and personal interests and nurture his own power by providing resources and favors to his supporters.

zh: 他对意大利最大的伤害是在经济停滞时期不作为，但至少他没有让情况变得更加糟糕。
en: His greatest disservice to Italians was his inaction in the face of economic stagnation, but at least he didn’t make it worse.

zh: 相比之下，无论多么难以理解，特朗普的确存在政策目标。
en: Trump, by contrast, does have an agenda, however hard to read.

zh: 特朗普的议程会让局势好转抑或恶化仍有待观察。
en: Whether it will make things better or worse remains to be seen.

zh: 热锅上的贝卢斯科尼
en: Berlusconi on the Boil

zh: 在宣扬通过减税和开放重振经济的竞选活动后，西尔维奥·贝卢斯科尼当选为意大利总理。
en: Silvio Berlusconi was elected as Italy's prime minister after campaigning on a platform of reinvigorating the economy through tax cuts and liberalization.

zh: 就任3年后，他没能实现自己的经济理想，以他为首的政府也开始风雨飘摇。
en: After three years in office, he has not delivered on his economic agenda and his government is in shambles.

zh: 问题究竟出在哪里？
en: What went wrong?

zh: 意大利的经济痼疾尽人皆知。
en: Italy's economic ills are well known.

zh: 如果不惮简陋，大致可以归结为3个方面：
en: At the risk of over-simplifying, they can be grouped under three headings:

zh: · 公共财政薄弱 。
en: · Weak public finances .

zh: 意大利加入欧洲货币联盟之时，其主要预算盈余（除利息支付外超过政府开支的纳税收入）只占国民收入的5 % 。
en: When Italy joined the European Monetary Union, its primary budget surplus (tax receipts in excess of government spending, excluding interest payments) was about 5% of national income.

zh: 到贝卢斯科尼承诺减税的前一年，也就是2004年，上述盈余将进一步缩减至约1.5 % 。
en: In 2004, the surplus will shrink to about 1.5% - before the tax cuts that Berlusconi promised for next year.

zh: 过度的社会福利开支（主要是公共养老金）和偿付国债的费用将资源从高效的政府开支领域抽走，形成了高额的税收负担。
en: Excessive social welfare spending (mainly public pensions) and the cost of servicing the public debt drain resources from more productive government spending and impose a high tax burden.

zh: 政府未能采取任何有意义的行动，导致问题日益恶化。
en: The government has failed to take any meaningful action, and the problem is getting worse.

zh: 因此，不久前标准普尔评级机构降低了意大利国债的信用等级，其实并不让人感到奇怪。
en: Unsurprisingly, the rating agency Standard & Poor's recently downgraded Italian public debt.

zh: · 竞争力下降 。
en: · Declining competitiveness .

zh: 意大利最具活力的企业是传统行业的小型制造公司，技术含量相对较低。
en: Italy's most dynamic producers are small manufacturing firms in traditional sectors with relatively low technological content.

zh: 目前这些公司面临着来自亚洲和东欧低成本制造企业的国际竞争，意大利的国际出口份额近年来也有所下降。
en: With these firms now exposed to foreign competition from low-cost producers in Asia and Eastern Europe, Italy's share of world exports has been shrinking in recent years.

zh: 意大利有几家大公司，主要处于服务、公用事业或存在竞争保护的领域。
en: Italy has a few large corporations, mainly in services, utilities, or sectors shielded from competition.

zh: 这些垄断企业成为其余经济部门变相的经济负担。
en: These monopolistic producers act like a distorting tax on the rest of the economy.

zh: 规模较小但更有竞争力的制造公司缺少在高科技领域扩张所需的资源。
en: Smaller but more competitive manufacturing firms lack the resources to expand in more advanced technological sectors.

zh: 私有和公共的研发开支处在工业国家中最低的水平。
en: The volume of private and public R&D spending is one of the lowest among industrial countries.

zh: 因此，意大利接收的移民技能相对有限，而本国很多年轻毕业生又移民到美、英或其它欧洲国家。
en: As a result, Italy is receiving immigrants with relatively low skills, while many of its most productive young graduates emigrate to the US, the UK, or other European countries.

zh: 政府在这方面没什么建树。
en: The government has done little to remedy this.

zh: 能源和公共事业部门的自由化改革进展缓慢，可能是因为政府也从公共企业获得垄断利润。
en: Liberalization attempts in energy and public utilities have faltered, perhaps also because the government pockets monopoly rents through dividends from public enterprises.

zh: 私有化改革也停步不前。
en: Privatization has stalled.

zh: · 意大利南部地区。
en: · The Mezzogiorno .

zh: 传统上，意大利南部的劳动生产率大大低于其它地区，但集中谈判强制不同地区采取同样的薪酬政策。
en: Labor productivity is traditionally much lower in Italy's south than in the rest of the country. But centralized wage negotiations impose the same salary everywhere.

zh: 因此，南部有很多人贫困失业，年青人尤其如此。
en: So many in the South remain poor and out of work, particularly the young.

zh: 早些时候，政府提出过加大劳动力市场灵活性、放松解雇限制的议案，但分裂工会的策略没有奏效，导致有些提案被最终撤回。
en: Early on, the government proposed legislation to increase labor market flexibility and relax constraints on firing rules. But its strategy of dividing the trade unions failed and some of the proposed legislation was eventually withdrawn.

zh: 尽管拥有议会的多数支持、人民的广泛赞同和媒体的全力拥护，政府为什么还是鲜有成果？
en: Why has the government achieved so little, despite a large majority in Parliament, widespread backing among the population, and supportive media?

zh: 主要原因是政府的内部争斗。
en: The main reason is government infighting.

zh: 在运转正常的民主社会，政府和反对派之间的选举竞争促使政府采取有效的政策，但在意大利却并非如此，因为这里的选举竞争主要发生在执政联盟的内部。
en: In a well functioning democracy, electoral competition between government and opposition induces the government to pursue efficient policies. Not so in Italy, where the main site of electoral competition has always been within the governing coalition.

zh: 每个政党都怕因联盟伙伴而丢失选票，这无形中破坏或阻止了政府采取行动。
en: Each government party is afraid of losing votes to its coalition partners, and undermines or blocks whatever the government is trying to do.

zh: 结果造成政策瘫痪，浪费了非常宝贵的时间。
en: The result is policy paralysis, until time has run out for everyone.

zh: 同样的问题导致了前任政府的失败（现任欧盟执委会主协普罗迪领导的左翼联盟 ） ， 并且如果左翼联盟在下届大选中获胜，同样的问题肯定会再度出现。
en: The same problems led to the collapse of the previous government (a left-wing coalition led by current EU Commission President Romano Prodi), and they would certainly continue under a new government if a left-wing coalition was voted into office at the next election.

zh: 不稳定的联盟政府是战后意大利政治的典型产物。
en: Unstable coalition governments have been typical of Italy's postwar politics.

zh: 为解决这一问题，20世纪90年代早期曾引入混合选举制度，即同一选区内四分之三的席位仍由多数规则确定，而其余则按比例代表制产生。
en: In an attempt to solve the problem, a mixed electoral system was introduced in the early 1990's, with about three quarters of the seats assigned under plurality rule in single member districts and the rest allocated under proportional representation.

zh: 但借此增加稳定性的愿望并没有实现。
en: But the hope that this would ensure greater stability has been unfulfilled.

zh: 选举制度的剩余比例规定使很多政党得以继续生存。
en: The residual proportional component of the electoral system has kept many political parties alive.

zh: 由于所有人都拼命争夺比例席位，政府的内部争斗仍然异常激烈。
en: Because all of them compete for these proportional seats, government infighting remains acute.

zh: 合理的解决方法是将选举制度的剩余比例部分捏合在一起，果断地在严格多数选举中实行两党制，但这种可能性并不太大。
en: A logical solution would be to scrap the proportional component of the electoral system altogether, and move decisively toward a two-party political system under fully majoritarian elections. But that is unlikely.

zh: 恰恰相反，刚在欧洲议会选举中获胜的小规模温和派正在呼吁比例代表制的全面恢复。
en: On the contrary, the smaller centrist parties that scored a victory in the recent European Parliament elections are now demanding a return to full proportionality.

zh: 如果成功，局面就会更加恶化。
en: If they get it, matters will most likely go from bad to worse.

zh: 现有体制下的意大利政府虽然效率低下，但至少还算稳定。
en: Under the current system, Italian governments achieve little, but at least they last longer.

zh: 恢复比例代表制可能意味着恢复政府的迅速更迭，而这意味着政策前景会愈加短暂。
en: A return to full proportionality would probably mean a return to rapid government turnover, which carries with it the risk that policy horizons will also become shorter.

zh: 意大利人再清楚不过，政府的不稳定必将带来严重的金融动荡。
en: As Italians know all too well, government instability inevitably breeds financial volatility.

zh: 意大利的征税选举
en: Italy’s Taxing Election

zh: 米兰 — — 意大利人一向不喜欢冬季选举。
en: MILAN – A winter election is not to Italian tastes.

zh: 但今年的2月24－25日，多达5000万选民将投票选出新一届议会，并组成65年来意大利的第62届政府。
en: But, on February 24-25, up to 50 million voters will go to the polls to elect a new parliament, delivering Italy’s 62nd government in the last 65 years.

zh: 2011年11月以来，领导意大利的不是政治家，而是经济学家兼前欧盟委员马里奥·蒙蒂。
en: Since November 2011, Italy has been led not by a politician, but by an academic economist and a former European Union commissioner, Mario Monti.

zh: 蒙蒂的应急技术派政府得到了左右两派的一致支持，是即将卸任的总统乔治·纳波利塔诺的建功立业之举。
en: His emergency technocratic government, supported by the left and right, was a masterstroke of outgoing President Giorgio Napolitano.

zh: 纳波利塔诺此举非常关键，以一位在国际上备受尊敬的人物取代低效、丑闻缠身且已失去其他领导人及全球市场信任的贝卢斯科尼。
en: Napolitano’s move was crucial, filling Italy’s need to replace the inefficient and scandal-ridden Silvio Berlusconi, in whom fellow leaders and global markets had lost all confidence, with an internationally respected figure.

zh: 在蒙蒂的领导下，改革进程终于开始并成功平复了市场情绪。
en: Under Monti’s leadership, reforms were finally initiated and markets were calmed.

zh: 为提升公共财政可信度，蒙蒂政府在维持创纪录所得税率的同时大幅增加税收，尤其是针对房地产领域。
en: To enhance the credibility of public finances, Monti’s government substantially increased taxes, particularly on real estate, while preserving the already record-high income-tax rate.

zh: 该税收计划强调意大利和日本一样以公债和私产为特色。
en: The tax plan highlighted that Italy, like Japan, is a country of public debt and private wealth.

zh: 经济学家马可·福蒂斯指出，即使排名在不久后发生变化，但意大利的家庭财富依然在欧洲首屈一指。
en: As the economist Marco Fortis points out, Italian family wealth is still, if not for long, second to none in Europe.

zh: 除国际信誉逐步恢复外，意大利政治格局的两大变化也决定了竞选活动的走势。
en: Beyond growing international credibility, two major changes to the Italian political landscape have shaped the election campaign.

zh: 其一是蒙蒂在失去贝卢斯科尼政党支持后于去年12月突然宣布辞职。
en: The first is Monti’s surprise resignation in December, after losing the backing of Berlusconi’s party.

zh: 虽然不再以候选人身份参选（蒙蒂已被授予终身参议员职位 ） ， 但他成立了（既不隶属于左派也不隶属于右派的）中间派别联盟，并宣称若联盟获胜他愿意继续担任领袖。
en: While he will not run as a candidate (he is already a senator for life), he formed a centrist coalition – affiliated with neither the left nor the right – to contest the election, and has declared his willingness to resume his leadership role if the coalition is victorious.

zh: 其二是在为建立中间偏左及中间偏右政党主导的可行政治制度奋斗近二十年后，意大利的党派力量正在逐步分散。
en: The second change is that, after almost two decades of striving for a workable political system dominated by the center-left and center-right parties, Italy is experiencing a remarkable dispersion of forces.

zh: 几十个竞争党派将参与选举，其中多数因2005年选举法规定至少要4%的全国选票才能进入众议院（下院）及8%的地区选票才能进入参议院而无缘赢得议会席位。
en: The ballot will include dozens of competing parties, most of which will not win parliamentary seats, owing to a 2005 electoral law requiring at least 4% of the national vote to enter the Chamber of Deputies (the lower house) and 8% on a regional basis to enter the Senate.

zh: 民调结果显示，由贝尔萨尼领导的中间偏左民主党及某些更为左倾的合作伙伴共同赢得了约33%的选民支持，这一数据比一月下旬有所下降，而同一阶段对贝卢斯科尼中间偏右联盟的支持率已经上升至28 % 。
en: According to public-opinion polls, the center-left Democratic Party, led by Pier Luigi Bersani, along with some more left-leaning allies, has the support of roughly 33% of the electorate, down since late January, while backing for Berlusconi’s center-right coalition has risen to 28%.

zh: 此外，蒙蒂的中间团体仅获16%的支持率，而喜剧演员毕普·格里罗于2009年成立的民粹主义五星运动的支持率则为17 % ， 如果居家人士决定投票抗议这一数字还有可能增加。
en: Meanwhile, Monti’s centrist grouping has only 16% support, while the populist Five Star Movement, founded by the comedian Beppe Grillo in 2009, has 17% backing – a figure that could go higher if those who previously stayed at home decide to cast a protest vote.

zh: 因此真正的角逐将在贝尔萨尼和贝卢斯科尼联盟之间展开。
en: The real battle, therefore, is between the Bersani and Berlusconi coalitions.

zh: 多数观察家认为贝尔萨尼将最终获胜，因为无论多少人参与投票及优势多么微弱，只要贝尔萨尼能赢得多数，那么根据饱受诟病的选举法他就可以控制下院。
en: Most observers believe that Bersani will carry the day, thanks to the much-criticized electoral law, which will give him control of the lower chamber if he wins a majority – regardless of how many people vote or how slim the margin.

zh: 选举法曾在2008年帮助贝卢斯科尼赢得选举，而这次贝尔萨尼很可能成为受益者。
en: The law favored Berlusconi in 2008; it is likely to benefit Bersani now.

zh: 不过贝尔萨尼必须控制参众两院才能掌控政局，但他不太可能得到50.1%的参议院席位。
en: But, in order to govern, Bersani would need both chambers, and he is unlikely to muster 50.1% in the Senate.

zh: 同时蒙蒂联盟因经典资产阶级政党在意大利向来缺乏吸引力而功亏一篑，因此许多观察家都好奇他将在下届政府中扮演何种角色。
en: At the same time, with Monti’s coalition failing to gain traction, reflecting the historically limited appeal of classic bourgeois parties in Italy, many observers are wondering what his role in the next government will be.

zh: 对贝尔萨尼而言，与蒙蒂结成联盟很可能是取得上议院控制权、并藉此控制政府的关键因素。
en: For Bersani, creating a coalition with Monti may well be the key to gaining control of the upper house and, in turn, of the government.

zh: 虽然有众多的计划和预测，但一场不断发酵的银行丑闻提醒意大利人运气有时在政治领域会成为决定因素。
en: Amid these plans and predictions, a growing banking scandal has reminded Italians that, in politics, luck can sometimes make the difference.

zh: 当意大利第三大银行锡耶纳银行披露因2006－2009年期间进行的复杂衍生品交易而面临高达7亿2千万（合9亿7千万美元）的亏损，民主党因为与该行有长期关系而影响了贝尔萨尼联盟的支持率。
en: When Monte dei Paschi di Siena – Italy’s third-largest bank – revealed that it faced losses of up to €720 million ($970 million) from complex derivatives deals carried out in 2006-2009, support for Bersani’s coalition slipped, owing to the PD’s long-standing ties to the bank.

zh: 由于意大利人倾向于因突发事件投出反对票而不是赞成票，对民主党的不信任已导致贝卢斯科尼联盟的支持率上升。
en: Given that Italians tend to vote against, rather than for, issues, mistrust of the PD has translated into increased support for Berlusconi’s coalition.

zh: 鼓吹新征财产税是可能影响民主党选举的另一个问题。
en: Another issue with the potential to undermine the PD’s standing is the party’s advocacy of a new wealth tax.

zh: 意大利人的税收负担已经相当繁重：一名年收入50,000欧元的纳税人需缴纳15,000欧元的所得税；有两个孩子的纳税人税额仅减少1,000欧元。
en: Italians already shoulder heavy taxes: an individual taxpayer with annual income of €50,000 pays €15,000 in income tax; with two children, that total drops by only €1,000.

zh: 相比之下，法国一名同等收入的纳税人仅需缴纳9,000欧元所得税；有两个孩子的纳税人税额则骤降至3,000欧元，也就是说在法国拥有150万欧元财产仅需额外缴纳4,230欧元的财产税。
en: By contrast, a French taxpayer with the same income pays only €9,000; with two children, the tax bill plummets to €3,000, and a €1.5 million fortune would mean an additional wealth tax of only €4,230.

zh: 换言之，无论有没有子女，法国公民的年纳税额均小于拥有同等财产的意大利纳税人。
en: In other words, with or without children, the French citizen’s annual tax payment would be smaller than that of the Italian taxpayer with no additional wealth.

zh: 鉴于上述情况，新增财产税对民主党而言可能是一项危险的倡议。
en: In this context, a new wealth tax could be a dangerous proposition for the PD.

zh: 意大利动荡政局有一个特点一直保持不变：那就是由既得利益群体掌握控制权，并由臃肿低效的官僚机构占据统治地位。
en: One feature of Italy’s turbulent politics remains consistent: the control exercised by entrenched interests, and the dominance of a bloated and inefficient bureaucracy.

zh: 意大利人口不及美国的五分之一，但议员数量却达到美国的两倍，而且议员所拥有的薪酬和特权在世界各国均处于领先地位。
en: With less than one-fifth of the population of the United States, Italy’s parliament has twice as many members as the US Congress, and they are among the world’s best-compensated and most privileged MPs.

zh: 此外，经合组织数据显示，意大利高官享受有史以来的最高薪酬，某些退休官员的退休金甚至超过了美国前任总统。
en: Meanwhile, Italy’s top bureaucrats are the highest paid in history, according to OECD data, with several retired officials drawing larger pensions than former US presidents receive.

zh: 意大利军队参谋长和警察局长的工资几乎达到美国同僚的三倍。
en: The salaries of Italy’s military chiefs of staff and chief of police are almost triple those of their American counterparts.

zh: 但人们很难乐观看待政治改革的前景。
en: But prospects for political reform do not inspire optimism.

zh: 尽管格里罗的支持者可能放几个月焰火抗议上述镀金赠品，但真正推动改革的持续性努力却似乎希望渺茫。
en: While Grillo’s supporters may ignite fireworks in protest of these gilded giveaways for a few months, a consistent assault leading to genuine reform seems doubtful.

zh: 从广义上看，尽管影响的性质无法确定，但意大利选举结果无疑将对脆弱的欧元区产生深远的影响 — — 除非贝卢斯科尼重新掌权，如果那样将出现昭然若揭的后果。
en: More broadly, the outcome of Italy’s election will undoubtedly have a far-reaching impact on a still-fragile eurozone, though the nature of that impact remains impossible to predict – unless Berlusconi returns to power, in which case the consequences will be all too clear.

zh: 解码伯南克
en: Decoding Bernanke

zh: 美国剑桥—自5月22日在美国国会听证以来，美联储主席本·伯南克一直在设法给出关于美联储未来政策的明确信号。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke has been struggling to deliver a clear message about the future of Fed policy ever since his May 22 testimony to the US Congress.

zh: 事实上，时隔两个月，金融市场参与者仍然不明白他的信号对美国货币政和方向市场利率意味着什么。
en: Indeed, two months later, financial-market participants remain confused about what his message means for the direction of US monetary policy and market interest rates.

zh: 伯南克关于美联储两大非常规政策的正式说辞是明确的。
en: Bernanke’s formal statements about the Fed’s two unconventional policies have been clear.

zh: 首先，美联储试图给出关于联邦基金利率（商业银行同业拆借隔夜利率）未来路径的相对具体的指导。
en: First, the Fed is trying to give relatively specific guidance about the future path of the federal funds rate (the overnight rate at which commercial banks lend to each other).

zh: 其次，美联储暗示了使其开始收缩月度债券购买计划规模并最终停止该计划的条件。
en: Second, the Fed is indicating the conditions that will cause it to start reducing its massive monthly bond-buying program and eventually bring it to an end.

zh: 伯南克强调，这两大政策轨迹互相独立，响应经济表现的不同指标。
en: Bernanke has emphasized that these two policies are on separate tracks and will respond to different indicators of the economy’s performance.

zh: 由美联储高级官员和地区联邦储备银行行长组成的联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）一致认为，联邦基金利率将维持在目前的近零水平直至失业率下降至6.5%并且可预期继续下降。
en: The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC), comprising the Fed governors and the presidents of the regional Federal Reserve banks, has agreed that the federal funds rate will remain at its current near-zero level until the unemployment rate drops to 6.5% and can be expected to remain there or decline even further.

zh: 目前失业率为7.6 % ， 且下降缓慢，因此美联储可能不会在2015年之前提高联邦基金利率。
en: With unemployment now at 7.6% and falling only slowly, the Fed may not be ready to raise the federal funds rate until 2015.

zh: 但这一前瞻性指引也存在暧昧之处，让人摸不着头脑。
en: But there are caveats that make this forward guidance ambiguous – and therefore uninformative.

zh: 美联储警告说，它可能提高联邦基金利率，如果预期年度通货膨胀率从目前的略低于2%升高到2.5%以上的话。
en: The Fed warns that it might increase the federal funds rate if the anticipated annual inflation rate rises from its current level of a bit less than 2% to more than 2.5%.

zh: 但是，它并未给出如何决定“预期未来通货膨胀率”的方法。
en: There is no clue, however, about how that “anticipated future inflation rate” will be determined.

zh: 因此，原则上美联储可能在失业率尚未到达6.5%时就提高联邦基金利率。
en: So the Fed could, in principle, decide to raise the federal funds rate even before the unemployment rate reaches 6.5%.

zh: 此外，美联储认为过去一年中失业下降的很大一部分原因是大量人口不再寻找工作（于是不再计算为失业人口 ） 。
en: Moreover, the Fed recognizes that a substantial part of the decline in the unemployment rate in the past year reflects the large number of people who stopped looking for work (and who therefore are no longer counted as unemployed).

zh: 因此，如果失业率因为劳动力参与的继续下降而降至6.5 % ， 或者因为企业增加兼职员工的相对数量（这意味着总工时数并未增长 ） ， 美联储可能不会提高联邦基金利率。
en: So, if the unemployment rate is deemed to have fallen below 6.5% because of continuing declines in labor-force participation, or because firms increase the relative number of part-time workers (which would imply no increase in the aggregate number of hours worked), the Fed may not raise the federal funds rate.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪市场会对未来24个月的联邦基金利率走向毫无头绪。
en: As a result, it is not surprising that the market is confused about the likely path of the federal funds rate over the next 24 months.

zh: 而这一点十分重要，因为联邦基金利率的提高将使其他相对更长期的利率也有所提高。
en: And that is important, because a rise in the federal funds rate will cause other, somewhat longer interest rates to increase as well.

zh: 更大的政策不确定性在于，从更短的前景看，美联储可能马上就会收缩期长期资产购买计划，即所谓的量化宽松。
en: The bigger policy uncertainty is about the more immediate prospect that the Fed may soon reduce its purchases of long-term assets – so-called quantitative easing.

zh: 伯南克继续强调，债券购买节奏的变化取决于经济表现如何。
en: Bernanke continues to stress that shifts in the pace of bond buying will depend on how well the economy is doing.

zh: 但他近来让市场颇为慌张的说法是FOMC对增长走强的预期可能导致今年下半年购买节奏放缓并于2014年年中结束资产购买。
en: But he startled markets recently by saying that the FOMC’s expected path of stronger growth could lead to a slower pace of buying later this year and an end to the asset purchases by mid-2014.

zh: 伯南克在论证这一立场时首先指出量化宽松的目的“主要是增加经济的近期动能 ” ， 暗示动能增强意味着减少资产购买。
en: Bernanke justified his position by stating that quantitative easing is intended “primarily to increase the near-term momentum of the economy,” suggesting that stronger momentum would justify less asset buying.

zh: 但是，现实是自量化宽松开始以来，经济近期动能一直在下降，并且随着购买规模的增加下降得更快了。
en: The reality, however, is that the economy’s near-term momentum has actually been decreasing ever since quantitative easing began – and has decreased more rapidly as the size of the program has grown.

zh: 实际GDP增长从2010年。 2.4%降至2011年的2 % ， 接着又降至2012年的1.7 % 。
en: The pace of real GDP growth fell from 2.4% in 2010 to 2% in the next four quarters, and then to 1.7% in 2012.

zh: 2013年第二季度的首个正式GDP增长数字将于7月31日披露，有可能连1%都不到，这意味着今年上半年的年度GDP增长远低于2012年。
en: The first official estimate of GDP growth in the second quarter of 2013, to be released on July 31, is likely to be less than 1%, implying that annual GDP growth in the first half of this year was considerably slower than in 2012.

zh: 那么，这对美联储“降低”资产购买节奏的意愿意味着什么？
en: So what does this imply about the Fed’s willingness to “taper” its pace of asset purchases?

zh: 讽刺的是，这有助于论证在今年年底前开始收缩资产购买计划的决定。
en: Ironically, it might help to rationalize the decision to begin tapering before the end of the year.

zh: 首先，量化宽松和GDP之间并无多少相关性，这表明资产购买节奏可以在增长速度放缓时降低。
en: First, the lack of correlation between quantitative easing and GDP growth suggests that the pace of asset buying could be reduced without slowing the pace of growth.

zh: 即使与伯南克及其他一些FOMC成员假设的相反，利率会随购买节奏降低而升高，这一点也成立。
en: That is true even though, contrary to the assumption of Bernanke and some other FOMC members, interest rates will rise as the pace of purchases declines.

zh: 其次，如果在第二季度的极端萎靡之后，第三季度GDP增长能够略有提高，达到2 % ， 那么美联储可能会宣布它观察到了增长改善之势 — — 即其开始降低资产购买节奏的必要条件。
en: Second, if the extreme weakness in the second quarter is followed by a return to a sluggish growth rate of around 2% in the third quarter, the Fed could declare that it is observing the pick-up in growth that it has said is necessary to justify the beginning of tapering.

zh: 极低长期利率政策目前弊大于利，因为它促使贷款人和投资者承担过多的风险以获得更高的回报。
en: The policy of extremely low long-term rates is now doing more harm than good by driving lenders and investors to take inappropriate risks in order to achieve higher returns.

zh: 伯南克和FOMC应该意识到这一点，并咋未来12个月中逐渐退出债券购买计划。
en: Bernanke and the FOMC should recognize this and gradually bring the bond-buying program to an end during the next 12 months.

zh: 他们将因量化宽松所取得的成就并且没有被经济未来表现所绑架而获得好评。
en: They can take credit for what quantitative easing has achieved without holding its termination hostage to the economy’s future performance.

zh: 有一点非常重要 — — 伯南克将在2014年初卸任。
en: It is significant that Bernanke will be stepping down at the beginning of 2014.

zh: 他在2008—2009年的危机期间非常出色地应对了金融市场功能失调的局面。
en: He did a remarkably good job in dealing with dysfunctional financial markets during the crisis years of 2008 and 2009.

zh: 当金融市场再次正常运转但经济增长速度远不尽如人意时，他抛出了非常规货币政策降低长期利率、加速房地产市场复苏。
en: When the financial markets were working again but the economy was still growing much too slowly, he turned to unconventional monetary policies to reduce long-term interest rates and accelerate the housing market’s recovery.

zh: 因此，即使经济目前仍比其他人所希望的萎靡，他也可以开始在他告别美联储之前开始退出非常规政策，以此为自己的美联储主席生涯画上句号。
en: So, although the economy is now weaker than he or anyone else would like, he may want to complete his policy legacy by beginning the exit from unconventional policies before he leaves the Fed.

zh: 伯南克会见媒体
en: Bernanke Meets the Press

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 在美联储最近也是头一次的新闻发布会上，主席本·伯南克为本机构饱受诟病的大规模购买美国政府债券（也就是所谓的“量化宽松 ” ） 政策大力辩护。
en: CAMBRIDGE – At the United States Federal Reserve’s recent and first-ever public press conference, Chairman Ben Bernanke gave a spirited defense of the Fed’s much-criticized policy of mass purchases of US government bonds, also known as “quantitative easing.”

zh: 那么他的理由有说服力吗？
en: But was his justification persuasive?

zh: 大多数经济学家认为伯南克干的不错。
en: Most economists viewed his performance as masterful.

zh: 但美元持续下滑而黄金不断上升的事实也反映出市场对此的怀疑态度。
en: But the fact that the dollar has continued to slide while gold prices have continued to rise suggests considerable skepticism from markets.

zh: 对于中央银行来说，最困难的事莫过于投资者们听到的信息往往与央行想传达的截然不同。
en: One of the hardest things in central banking is that investors often hear a very different message from that which the central bank intends to send.

zh: 很显然，美联储是在交易者的呼吁下被迫采用“量化宽松”政策的，因为原本一直用来对通胀和增长进行微调的隔夜利率已经下降到近乎零了，但美国经济却依然停滞不前，又被挥之不去的高失业率所困扰。
en: The Fed, of course, has been forced to turn to “QE,” as traders call it, because its normal tool for fine-tuning inflation and growth, the overnight interest rate, is already zero. Yet US economic growth remains sluggish, and is accompanied by stubbornly high unemployment.

zh: 人们把一切问题都归咎于量化宽松政策，从资产价格泡沫到食品暴乱甚至连脓包病都没有漏下。
en: QE has been blamed for everything from asset-price bubbles to food riots to impetigo.

zh: 包括外国财政部长到政治漫画家（请参见网上一段名为“量化宽松答疑”的动画视频）以及前共和党总统候选人萨拉·佩林在内的所有人都争相对政策发表自己的高见。
en: Everyone from foreign finance ministers to cartoon satirists (check out the video “quantitative easing explained”) to Sarah Palin has ripped into the policy.

zh: 批评认为量化宽松政策拉开了全球金融系统灭亡的序幕，甚至关系到整个文明。
en: Critics insist that QE is the beginning of the end of the global financial system, if not of civilization itself.

zh: 他们最有说服力的抱怨就是人们对量化宽松究竟如何运作知之甚少，因此美联储冒着可能毁灭全球金融系统的巨大风险换来的只是对美国经济的一点推动作用。
en: Their most telling complaint is that too little is known about how quantitative easing works, and that the Fed is therefore taking undue risks with the global financial system to achieve a modest juicing of the US economy.

zh: 不论这一观点是对是错，有一点是相当明确的：随着美联储与其他各国央行的货币紧缩周期政策背道而驰，加上各大评级机构纷纷考虑调低美国的信用评级，美元的购买力相对于美国的贸易伙伴来说已经下降到了前所未有的低点。
en: Whether or not the critics are right, one thing is clear: with the Fed lagging other global central banks in the monetary-tightening cycle, and with rating agencies contemplating a downgrade of America’s credit score, the US dollar’s purchasing power has sunk to an all-time low against the currencies of America’s trading partners.

zh: 伯南克的辩词其实是站得住脚的。
en: Bernanke’s defense was robust and unequivocal.

zh: 他指出量化宽松政策完全不是批评所说的“非常规行为 ” 。
en: He argued that QE is not nearly as unconventional as its critics claim.

zh: 如果从该政策对包括长期利率，波动性和股价等金融状况的影响来看，它与我们自以为很熟悉的常规利率调整政策非常相似。
en: If one looks at how it has affected financial conditions, including long-term interest rates, volatility, and stock prices, QE looks an awful lot like conventional interest-rate policy, which we think we understand.

zh: 因此对量化宽松政策潜在负面影响效应的担忧其实是被过度放大了，况且如果最终想逆向回收这一政策的话也没有太大的难度。
en: Thus, concerns about QE’s supposed ill effects are wildly overblown, and there is nothing especially challenging about eventually reversing course, either.

zh: 伯南克否定了那些关于商品价格和新兴市场通胀的抱怨，认为这些状况更多地来源于对货币政策的错误运用以及那些高速发展经济体过度僵化的汇率管制。
en: Bernanke dismissed complaints about commodity prices and emerging-market inflation, arguing that these phenomena had far more to do with lax monetary policies and overly rigid exchange rates in fast-growing developing economies.

zh: 主席的这番评论恰好是选在一个关键和敏感的时间点来发表的。
en: The Fed chairman’s comments come at a critical and sensitive moment.

zh: 在未来几年间，美联储将可能进入一个货币紧缩周期，并稳步提高利率。
en: Over the next year or so, the Fed is likely to enter a tightening cycle, raising interest rates on a steady and sustained basis.

zh: 美���储无意高歌猛进，因为美国经济依旧虚弱，今年第一季度的增长率也只有可怜的1.8 % 。
en: It does not want to rush, because the US economy is still weak, with first-quarter growth a lackluster 1.8%.

zh: 但同时该机构也可能不能长期按兵不动，以免通胀预期上升到一个危险的程度，最终迫使其使出强硬手段，在付出极大经济代价的情况下去遏制通胀。
en: But it cannot wait too long, lest inflation expectations drift to a dangerously high level, forcing the Fed to move aggressively – and at the cost of considerable economic pain – to wring inflation out of the system.

zh: 在逐步脱离量化宽送政策方面，伯南克必须小心另外一个陷阱，那就是资产价格的意外崩溃。
en: In unwinding QE, Bernanke must avoid another landmine, namely an unwelcome collapse in asset prices.

zh: 许多华尔街交易老手都确信量化宽松政策只不过是旧有“格林斯潘对策”的放大版。
en: Many savvy Wall Street traders are convinced that QE is just the old “Greenspan put” on steroids.

zh: 这种对“格林斯潘对策”的迷信源自于这位前美联储主席一条众所周知的理念：美联储不应尝试压制一个快速上涨的股票市场，除非市场已经发展到了危及一般商品长期价格稳定性的程度。
en: The cult of the “Greenspan put” stemmed from the previous Fed chairman’s avowed belief that the Fed should not try to resist a sharply rising stock market, except to the extent that such a market undermines the long-term stability of prices for ordinary goods.

zh: 但如果股票市场过快下跌的话，美联储应当小心衰退的可能性并使出强硬手段来缓冲下跌。
en: But if the stock market collapses too quickly, the Fed should worry about a recession and react aggressively to cushion the fall.

zh: 那么这些交易员的观点又是对是错？
en: Are traders right?

zh: 量化宽松政策是否就是“格林斯潘对策”的翻版？
en: Is QE merely the sequel to the “Greenspan put”?

zh: 当前极低的利率促使投资者将资金投向一些高风险资产。
en: It is certainly the case that today’s super-low interest rates encourage investors to pour funds into risky assets.

zh: 虽然货币政策也必须考虑到这些因素，但美联储可能会认为监管者有责任去确保资产泡沫不会导致过度借贷并最终引发债务危机。
en: The Fed probably would argue that it is the job of regulators to make sure that asset bubbles do not induce too much borrowing and an eventual debt crisis, though of course monetary policy has to be in the mix.

zh: 考虑到当前不甚乐观的复苏态势，伯南克甚至可以进一步认为只有美联储走对了路子。
en: Given the sluggish recovery, Bernanke could have gone even further and argued that the Fed is the one who has it right.

zh: 包括欧洲央行在内的其他发达经济体货币管理机构可能是对短期的通胀波动性反应过度了。
en: Other advanced-economy monetary authorities, such as the European Central Bank, might be over-reacting to short term inflation volatility.

zh: 但或许是不想冒犯自己的外国同行，伯南克采取了一个更为谨慎的对策，仅仅坚持美联储的政策是对美国有利的选择。
en: However, perhaps not wanting to cause problems for his foreign counterparts, Bernanke took a more cautious approach, merely defending the Fed’s policy as the right choice for America.

zh: 在为美联储政策辩护的过程中，伯南克必须小心不要发表一些可能引发投资者过度恐慌的言论。
en: In defending the Fed’s policy, Bernanke had to be careful not to say anything that might overly alarm investors.

zh: 事实上，投资者已经有足够的理由去恐慌：毕竟美联储对金融的大幅放宽最终将以非常痛苦的紧缩作为结尾。
en: Indeed, there is already reason enough for them to be nervous: after all, the Fed’s epic easing of financial conditions must eventually be followed by exceptionally painful tightening.

zh: 那么美国经济是否已经准备好迎接这一时刻？
en: Will the economy be ready when the time comes?

zh: 跟解释量化宽松的特殊调节措施比起来，解释这场向紧缩政策的必然转化显然更有难度。
en: Explaining the inevitable shift to tightening could prove a far greater challenge than explaining the exceptional accommodation of quantitative easing.

zh: 美联储应当牢记：无论它的分析有多冷静或者多合理，但自己却是与一个最缺乏冷静和理性的市场打交道。
en: The Fed must always remember that no matter how calm and rational its analysis may be, it is dealing with markets that can be anything but calm and rational.

zh: 恰恰由于已经有如此多的情绪被投入到了量化宽松政策之上，因此回复常态所带来的心理冲击可能是极为危险且出乎意料的。
en: Precisely because so much emotion has been invested in QE, the psychological effects of returning to normalcy are going to be perilous and unpredictable.

zh: 本·伯南克的悲剧
en: The Tragedy of Ben Bernanke

zh: 伯克利—阅读美联储前主席本·伯南克的新自传《行动的勇气 》 （ The Courage to Act ） ， 除了悲剧之外再难有别的感觉。
en: BERKELEY – It is difficult to read former US Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke’s new memoir, The Courage to Act, as anything other than a tragedy.

zh: 这是一个关于一个男人的故事，他是全世界最适合做给他的任务的人，但很快就发现力不从心，只能明知不可为而为之。
en: It is the story of a man who may have been the best-prepared person in the world for the job he was given, but who soon found himself outmatched by its challenges, quickly falling behind the curve and never quite managing to catch up.

zh: 2007—2008年的冲击没有引发又一场大萧条，这笔功劳要记在伯南克身上。
en: It is to Bernanke’s great credit that the shock of 2007-2008 did not trigger another Great Depression.

zh: 但他在危机后的反应出人意料地令人失望。
en: But his response to its aftermath was unexpectedly disappointing.

zh: 2000年，伯南克指出，有足够意愿的央行“永远”可以至少在中期通过量化宽松重塑充分繁荣。
en: In 2000, Bernanke had argued that a central bank with sufficient will could “always,” in the medium term at least, restore full prosperity via quantitative easing.

zh: 如果央行印钱并大规模购买金融资产，人们就会开始增加支出。
en: If a central bank printed money and bought financial assets on a large-enough scale, people would begin to step up their spending.

zh: 即使人们相信只有一小部分量化宽松是持久的，即使支出激励十分微小，央行也可以让经济重新起步。
en: Even if people believed that only a fraction of quantitative easing was permanent, and even if the incentive to spend was low, the central bank could restart the economy.

zh: 但是，最后伯南克并没有实现这一点。
en: In the end however, Bernanke did not deliver.

zh: 尽管美联储和其他许多央行印钞数量之大远远超过了经济学家所认为的抵消金融危机影响所需要的量，但充分繁荣至今没能重建。
en: Even though the Fed and many other central banks printed much more money than economists would have thought necessary to offset the impact of the financial crisis, full prosperity has yet to be restored.

zh: 伯南克将美国货币基础扩大了四倍，从8,000亿美元扩大到4,0000亿。
en: Bernanke increased the US monetary base five-fold, from $800 billion to $4 trillion.

zh: 但这还不够。
en: But it wasn’t enough.

zh: 接着，他失去了信心，采取了又一次“大跃进 ” ： 将货币基础再扩大一倍多，达到9万亿美元。
en: And then, his courage failing, he balked at taking the next leap: more than doubling the monetary base to $9 trillion.

zh: 在担任美联储主席的最后一年，伯南克甚至开始徒劳地乞求国会采取财政扩张。
en: In his last years in office, Bernanke was reduced to begging in vain for Congress to institute fiscal expansion.

zh: 那么，哪里出了问题？
en: So what went wrong?

zh: 一如往常，答案取决于你对哪个经济学家问这个问题。
en: The answer, as is often the case, depends on which economist you ask.

zh: 如果我对伯南克的理解正确，那么他会说，基本面没有问题，暂时的储蓄过剩人为地拉长了激进货币扩张重建充分繁荣所需要的时间。
en: If I understand Bernanke correctly, he would argue that nothing fundamental went wrong, and that a temporary savings glut has artificially lengthened the time it takes for aggressive monetary expansion to restore full prosperity.

zh: 厌恶损失的主权财富基金、把钱存在美国和欧洲的新兴市场富豪以及寻求确保行动自由的政府持续性地拉低了充分繁荣利率，延长了冲击消散所需要的时间。
en: Loss-adverse sovereign wealth funds, emerging-market millionaires parking their money in the US and Europe, and governments seeking to ensure freedom of action have pushed full-prosperity interest rates down substantially and extended the time it takes for shocks to dissipate.

zh: 哈佛大学的肯尼斯·罗格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）持不同看法：伯南克的主要错误是过于狭隘地关注货币供给。
en: Harvard’s Kenneth Rogoff holds a different view: Bernanke’s cardinal error was to focus too narrowly on the money supply.

zh: 根据简单的经济学模型，当货币市场处于充分繁荣均衡时，债务市场也是如此。
en: According to simple economic models, when the money market is in full-prosperity equilibrium, the debt market is too.

zh: 但在真实世界中，对政府来说也许回购高风险债务、促使贷款人减记损失更有效。
en: But in the real world, it might have been more effective for governments to buy back risky debts and induce lenders to write off losses.

zh: 这将比放松货币政策更加能够提振私人支出和快速重建充分繁荣。
en: This, more than loose monetary policy, would have boosted private spending and rapidly restored full prosperity.

zh: 还有一些经济学家会说，如果美联储承诺将年通胀目标定在高于2%的水平，或承诺实现这一目标需要多少量化宽松就实施多少量化宽松就好了，这样货币动作就足够了。
en: Still others would make the case that monetary action would have been enough, if only the Fed had committed to a target for annual inflation that was higher than 2% and vowed to do as much quantitative easing as necessary to reach that goal.

zh: 这一简单的承诺 — — 如果取得信誉的话 — — 将远比大大增加量化宽松量更有效。
en: This simple promise – were it to be made credible – would have been far more effective than much larger amounts of quantitative easing.

zh: 最后，是第四种观点，以拉里·萨默斯（Larry Summers）和保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）为首。
en: Finally, there is a fourth view, championed most prominently by Larry Summers and Paul Krugman.

zh: 他们指出，没有证据表明货币政策能够重建充分繁荣。
en: They argue that there is little evidence that monetary policy will ever restore full prosperity.

zh: 根据这一观点，米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）的梦想 — — 用战略性货币干预抵消经济冲击终究只是一个梦想。
en: In this view, Milton Friedman’s dream of using strategic monetary interventions to offset economic shocks remains just that: a dream.

zh: 过去半个世纪中欧洲和美国的特殊环境 — — 最引人注目的是快速的人口和生产率增长 — — 让他的观点看似可行。
en: It was only the unique circumstance in Europe and the US over the last half-century – most notably rapid demographic and productivity growth – that made his ideas seem plausible.

zh: “如果没人相信通胀会上升，它就不会上升 ， ” 克鲁格曼如是说 ， “ 最安全的提高通胀的唯一方法是用大规��财政刺激替换货币机制。
en: “If nobody believes that inflation will rise, it won’t,” is how Krugman put it. “The only way to be at all sure of raising inflation is to accompany a changed monetary regime with a burst of fiscal stimulus.”

zh: 我不知道这四个观点哪个是正确的。
en: I do not claim to know which of these views is the correct one.

zh: 但我确实认为，自凯恩斯在20世纪30年代与类似的问题角力以来，这场讨论是宏观经济学领域最重要的争论。
en: But I do think that this discussion is the most important debate in the field of macroeconomics since John Maynard Keynes wrestled with similar questions in the 1930s.

zh: 对凯恩斯来说，答案是明确的，这个答案与萨默斯和克鲁格曼的观点比较接近；事实上，正是这一结论让凯恩斯从货币主义者变成了凯恩斯主义者。
en: For Keynes, the answer was clear, and it was something close to what is being argued by Summers and Krugman; indeed, his conclusions are what transformed him from a monetarist into a Keynesian.

zh: “关于利率的[货币]政策凭借其本身产生足够的影响力，这似乎是不可能的 ， ” 凯恩斯在1936年写道 ， “ 因此，我相信，某种程度的投资的全面社会化将是确保接近充分就业的唯一办法。
en: “It seems unlikely that the influence of [monetary] policy on the rate of interest will be sufficient by itself,” Keynes wrote in 1936. “I conceive, therefore, that a somewhat comprehensive socialization of investment will prove the only means of securing an approximation to full employment.”

zh: ”下一次我们发现需要鼓起勇气采取行动时，仍值得考虑这些话。
en: Those are words worth considering the next time we find ourselves needing the courage to act.

zh: 新哈里发帝国？
en: A New Caliphate?

zh: 普林斯顿—军事组织伊拉克和叙利亚伊斯兰国（Islamic State in Iraq and Syria，ISIS）最近宣言要建立一个哈里发帝国，这是现代社会前所未有的事件。
en: PRINCETON – The recent declaration of a caliphate by the militant group the Islamic State in Iraq and Syria (ISIS) is an unprecedented event in modern times.

zh: 不管此事如何发酵，有一点是明确的：暴力圣战主义如今已成为阿拉伯政治版图上根深蒂固的特征。
en: Regardless of how it turns out, one thing is clear: violent jihadism is now an entrenched feature of the Arab political landscape.

zh: 自1924年土耳其共和国废除奥斯曼哈里发帝国以来，从未有控制领土的穆斯林集团提出如此宏伟的主张。
en: Not since the Turkish Republic abolished the Ottoman caliphate in 1924 has any Muslim group in control of territory made such a bid.

zh: 即使是基地组织和塔利班，在建立酋长国方面的要求也不多见，而他们的目标正是最终通过联合诸酋长国建立一个哈里发帝国。
en: Even Al Qaeda and the Taliban have limited their demands to the creation of statelets (emirates), which they hope will eventually coalesce into a caliphate.

zh: 这一犹豫态度至少部分可以用一个事实来解释：不管是本·拉登还是奥马尔（塔利班领袖 ） ， 都无法满足成为哈里发的条件，因为这必须追溯到先知穆罕默德所在的古莱什（Quraysh）部落。
en: This hesitation can be explained, at least partly, by the fact that neither Osama bin Laden nor Mullah Omar (the Taliban’s leader) can fulfill the conditions for being a caliph, one of which is proof of descent from the Prophet Muhammad’s tribe, the Quraysh.

zh: 而新的哈里发帝国主张者 — — ISIS埃米尔巴格达迪（Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi）可以。
en: The new caliphal claimant, the Islamic State’s emir Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi, can.

zh: 在伊斯兰政治思想中，哈里发帝国与常规民族国家不同，并不局限于固定国界。
en: As conceived in Islamic political thought, a caliphate, unlike a conventional nation-state, is not subject to fixed borders.

zh: 相反，哈里发帝国专注于通过圣战或武装斗争捍卫和扩张穆斯林信仰的支配权。
en: Instead, it is focused on defending and expanding the dominion of the Muslim faith through jihad, or armed struggle.

zh: 题为《这是真主的承诺 》 （ “This is the Promise of Allah ” ） 的新哈里发帝国建国宣言发布于伊斯兰神圣的斋月的第一天，并提出了重组阿拉伯世界的激进愿景。
en: The statement announcing the new caliphate, entitled “This is the Promise of Allah,” was issued on the first day of the Islamic holy month of Ramadan, and lays out a radical vision for reconfiguring the Arab world.

zh: 首先，宣言宣布ISIS将去除徒具虚名的“伊拉克和叙利亚”定语，只保留“伊斯兰国 ” ， 这意味着它的目光已经转向他国，特别是约旦和沙特阿拉伯，或许还有黎巴嫩。
en: First, it declares that ISIS will drop its titular reference to “Iraq and Syria” to become simply the Islamic State, implying that it has its sights set on other countries, especially Jordan, Saudi Arabia, and possibly Lebanon.

zh: 宣言的其他部分则充斥着古兰经的神谕，其中不少说神指定其“真正信徒”摄政人间，授予他们羞辱和打败他的“敌人”的权力，目前这些敌人包括什叶派穆斯林、民主人士、民族主义者、穆斯林兄弟会、犹太人和基督徒。
en: The rest of the statement is replete with injunctions from the Koran, several of which refer to God deputizing the “true believers” as his regents on earth, empowering them to humiliate and defeat his “enemies,” who now include Shia Muslims, democrats, nationalists, the Muslim Brotherhood, Jews, and Christians.

zh: 宣言继续说，这些信徒目前正在伊斯兰国的大旗下展开行动。 伊斯兰国��前控制着从叙利亚的阿勒颇到伊拉克的迪亚拉（Diyala）之间的领土，并且已经建立了雏形国家的结构：法院、税收体系、安全和社会服务俱全。
en: These believers are now operating, the statement continues, under the banner of the Islamic State, which currently controls the territory between Aleppo in Syria and Diyala in Iraq, where it has already established the structures of a proto-state: courts, a tax system, and security and social services.

zh: 伊斯兰国指出，所有穆斯林，包括所有圣战组织，如果不想生活在罪恶中，就必须承认哈里发是他们的领导者。
en: The Islamic State argues that all Muslims, including all jihadist factions, must acknowledge the caliph as their leader if they are not to live in sin.

zh: 尽管这一集体宗教义务观大致上与传统伊斯兰法相符，但大部分穆斯林认为这些禁令已与现时代格格不入。
en: Though this notion of a collective religious obligation is largely consistent with traditional Islamic law, most Muslims consider such injunctions irrelevant in the modern age.

zh: 尽管如此，以巴格达迪为首的伊斯兰国认为，其新哈里发意志将 — — 事实上，是想必将 — — 不断壮大。
en: Nonetheless, with al-Baghdadi at its helm, the Islamic State is convinced that its new caliphate will – indeed, is supposed to – flourish.

zh: 巴格达迪真名Ibrahim Awwad Ibrahim Ali al-Badri al-Samarrai，来自伊拉克巴格达以北的萨马拉（Samarra ） ， 今年四十多岁。
en: Al-Baghdadi, whose real name is Ibrahim Awwad Ibrahim Ali al-Badri al-Samarrai, is a 40-something Iraqi from Samarra, north of Baghdad.

zh: 他是个神秘莫测的人物，拥有伊斯兰教研究的高等学位，也是天赋异禀的战略家和演讲家。
en: A fairly enigmatic figure, he has a higher degree in Islamic studies, and is a gifted strategist and orator.

zh: 巴格达迪成功地与伊拉克逊尼派部落达成了大量协议，没有他们的支持，他就无法如此迅速地征服如此广袤的领土。
en: Al-Baghdadi has managed to strike numerous deals with the Sunni tribes of Iraq, without whom he could not have conquered so much territory so quickly.

zh: 而在目前公布的为数极少的有记录文件中，他表现出对阿拉伯古语的精通。
en: And, in the few recorded statements that have been released, he displays a mastery of classical Arabic.

zh: 这些都有助于他实现他的目标 — — 继任本·拉登成为针对异教徒势力的全球圣战的领袖。
en: All of this will help him to achieve his goal of succeeding Osama bin Laden as the leader of the global jihad against the forces of nonbelief.

zh: 但是，宣布建立新哈里发帝国是否会掀起巨大的政治动荡还有待观察。
en: Whether the announcement of the new caliphate turns out to be politically significant, however, remains to be seen.

zh: 其影响力的持续取决于两个因素。
en: Its enduring influence will depend on two factors.

zh: 首先是伊斯兰国继续在军事上取得成功，以及有能力保持和巩固领土控制。
en: The first is the Islamic State’s continued military success, and its ability to maintain and consolidate its control of territory.

zh: 目前，圣战的成功大部分依靠阿拉伯国家内部的分裂和政府的孱弱 — — 特别是利比亚、埃及、叙利亚、伊拉克和也门五国 — — 这导致政府失去了国家领土大部的控制权。
