en: So far, jihadist success has depended largely on the divisions within Arab countries and the weakness of their governments, particularly the five – Libya, Egypt, Syria, Iraq, and Yemen – that have lost control over significant portions of their territory.

zh: 这些国家也没有任何稳定下来的信号。
en: And these countries are showing no signs of stabilizing.

zh: 尽管重画国界仍不太可能，但圣战主义控制大片领土渐成常态的实施将让圣战势力扩大资金源、吸引新战士变得更加容易。
en: While it is unlikely that national borders will be redrawn, the fact that large jihadi-controlled territories are becoming the norm will only make it easier for such forces to augment their financial resources and attract new recruits.

zh: 第二个因素是伊斯兰国保证足够支持的能力。
en: The second factor is the Islamic State’s ability to secure sufficient support.

zh: 如今，征战主义的根本分歧之严重前所未有。
en: Today, jihadism is more fundamentally divided than ever before.

zh: 甚至基地组织当前领袖扎瓦西里（Ayman al-Zawahiri）也罢巴格达迪视为极端主义者，并采取行动让基地组织与伊斯兰国保持距离。
en: Even Ayman al-Zawahiri, Al Qaeda’s current leader, views al-Baghdadi as an extremist, and has taken steps to distance his group from the Islamic State.

zh: 但许多圣战组织和个人，特别是年轻人，表现出对哈里发帝国的支持。
en: But many jihadi groups and individuals, particularly young people, have signaled their support for the caliphate.

zh: 伊斯兰国的宣言在YouTube上已被观赏187,000多次，在Twitter和Facebook上也有数不清的转帖，吸引着积极评论。
en: The Islamic State’s statement has already been viewed more than 187,000 times on YouTube, and has been posted innumerable times on Twitter and Facebook, attracting positive comments.

zh: 一个更加不妙的发展趋势是出现了一个叫做耶路撒冷伊斯兰国支持者（Supporters of the Islamic State in Jerusalem）的组织，该组织宣布为杀害三名被绑架以色列少年负责，并说这是为新哈里发帝国的献礼。 三名以色列少年的遗体最近在约旦河西岸被发现。
en: A more ominous development is the emergence of a group called the Supporters of the Islamic State in Jerusalem, which has claimed responsibility for murdering – as a gift to the new caliph – the three kidnapped Israeli teenagers whose bodies were recently found in the West Bank.

zh: 圣战主义显然十分活跃，并且遍布整个阿拉伯世界。
en: Jihadism is clearly alive and well across the Arab world.

zh: 在经历了几十年的不公和低效统治后（更不用说悲剧性的外国干预了 ） ， 有大量被剥夺公民权、生活无望的人民可供伊斯兰国这样的组织招募利用。
en: After decades of unjust and ineffective rule, not to mention tragic foreign interventions, there is no shortage of disenfranchised and frustrated citizens for organizations like the Islamic State to recruit.

zh: 不管新哈里发帝国能否成功，阿拉伯世界的宗教暴力在好转之前还将进一步恶化。
en: Whether this new caliphate succeeds or not, religious violence in the Arab world will likely get worse before it gets better.

zh: 重新想象中国的城镇未来
en: Reimagining China’s Urban Future

zh: 北京—大约1亿中国人生活于极端贫困之下，大约2.75亿人每日开销不到2美元。
en: BEIJING – Around 100 million Chinese live in extreme poverty, and roughly 275 million spend less than $2 a day.

zh: 绝大部分中国穷人生活在农村地区，并且大部分希望获得更美好的城市生活 — — 在城市中更容易找到薪水丰厚的工作。
en: The overwhelming majority of China’s poor live in rural areas, and, for most, hope for a better life lies in the cities, where better-paying jobs are easier to find.

zh: 事实上，过去三十五年来，令人瞩目的五亿中国人实现了这一愿望，中国城镇人口��重从1980年的不到20%增加到今天的一半。
en: Indeed, over the past three and a half decades, a staggering half-billion Chinese have already made the move, raising the urban share of the country’s population from less than 20% in 1980 to one-half today.

zh: 到2030年，70%的中国人将生活在城市中。
en: By 2030, 70% of all Chinese are expected to live in cities.

zh: 毫无疑问，城镇化支撑了中国令人瞩目的增长和快速经济转型。
en: China’s urbanization has undoubtedly supported the country’s impressive growth and rapid economic transformation.

zh: 其城市供应了廉价土地和充足的劳动力，而地方政府也急切地想吸引投资、创造就业。
en: Its cities have provided cheap land and abundant labor, while local governments have been eager to attract investment and create jobs.

zh: 但制约因素正在浮现。
en: But strains are starting to show.

zh: 中国主要靠投资和出口推动的增长模式正在失去动力。
en: China’s growth model, driven by investment and exports, is running out of steam.

zh: 城镇扩张和拥堵正在蔓延，这加剧了认为失地补偿太少的农民的不安，而他们的土地已成为地方政府债务（目前占GDP的30 % ） 的重要抵押品来源。
en: Urban sprawl and congestion are spreading, fueling unrest among farmers who feel undercompensated for the loss of their land – a vital source of collateral for local-government debt (which now amounts to 30% of GDP).

zh: 此外，日益扩大的城镇-农村差距增加了中国的收入和财富不平等。
en: Moreover, the widening urban-rural divide has increased the country’s income and wealth disparities.

zh: 剧烈的不平等性也存在于城市内部，主要是有户口者和无户口农民工之间。
en: Stark inequalities also exist within cities, mainly between those with a hukou (a record in China’s official household-registration system) and migrants without one.

zh: 尽管农民工资现在已经赶了上来，但公共服务（需要城镇户口才能获得）方面的不平等意味着这一差距仍然存在，影响了农民工子女的前景和福利，也阻碍了未来移民。
en: Although migrant wages have now caught up, inequality in public services (access to which requires an urban hukou) ensures that this divide persists, risking migrant children’s lifetime prospects and welfare, and deterring future migration.

zh: 环境压力也在加剧。
en: Environmental pressures are also worsening.

zh: 尽管城镇治污措施有了改进，但城镇化仍让许多人饱受恶劣空气影响，增加了人力和经济总成本。
en: Although some measures of urban pollution are improving, urbanization exposes many more people to bad air, increasing the total human and economic cost.

zh: 当局清除这些问题，也宣布了新的“以人为本”城镇化计划。 这一新型城镇化将更高效、更包容、更环境可持续。
en: The authorities are aware of these issues and have announced plans for a new, “people-oriented” urbanization model that would be more efficient, inclusive, and environmentally sustainable.

zh: 一份世界银行和中国国务院发展研究中心的联合报告列出了如何将这一计划转变为现实。
en: A joint report by the World Bank and the Development Research Center of China’s State Council recently outlined how to make this plan a reality.

zh: 其成功实施将毫无疑问在中国城镇化新阶段中改善穷人的境况。
en: Its successful implementation would undoubtedly improve conditions for the poor during China’s next phase of urbanization.

zh: 首先也是最重要的，该计划将改革土地政策。
en: First, and foremost, the plan would reform land policies.

zh: 根据中国宪法，土地城镇土地由国家所有，农村土地由集体所有。
en: Under China’s constitution, urban land is owned by the state, and rural land by collectives.

zh: 尽管过去三十年的土地改革承认个人和企业的产权，但相对城镇地区的法律环境，农村地权仍然很弱。
en: Though land reforms over the last three decades have recognized property rights for individuals and enterprises, rural land rights remain weak relative to legal conditions in urban areas.

zh: 通过加强农民产权、限制地方政府为城镇增长而征地的权力，城市将变得更紧致、更高效，特别是在能源利用方面。
en: By strengthening farmers’ property rights, and restricting local governments’ power to expropriate land for urban growth, cities would become more compact and efficient, especially in terms of energy use.

zh: 改革还将有助于整合农地、推进更好的农业技术。
en: Reform would also help to consolidate farmland, facilitating better agricultural techniques.

zh: 土地改革还将有助于财富扩散，因为更强的产权将提振农村地价。
en: Land reform would also help to spread wealth, because stronger property rights boost rural land prices.

zh: 据估算，过去20年中农民获得的土地补偿金总数比市场价值低了2万亿元，相当于2013年中国GDP的4 % 。
en: According to one estimate, the total compensation that farmers received for their land over the last 20 years was ¥2 trillion ($322 billion) below market value, equivalent to 4% of China’s 2013 GDP.

zh: 若将这笔钱用于投资并获得与GDP增长率相同的回报，则未偿付土地赔偿金将价值5万亿元，或GDP的近10 % 。
en: If invested at rates in line with China’s GDP growth, that unpaid compensation would now be worth some ¥5 trillion, or almost 10% of GDP.

zh: 其次，户口制度改革能够提高劳动生产率、降低收入不平等度、加速城镇化。
en: Second, reform of the hukou system could increase labor productivity, reduce income inequality, and accelerate urbanization.

zh: 尽管目前农村移民率已经相当高，但考虑到中国的规模和收入水平，仍低于可预期的水平。
en: Despite the high level of rural-urban migration so far, it is still below what could be expected, given China’s size and income level.

zh: 阻止三分之一的无户口城镇定居者获得公共服务最终意味着太多人虽然离开了农村，但仍被绑定在土地上。
en: Preventing the one-third of city dwellers who lack an urban hukou from accessing public services ultimately means that too many people who would have left rural areas remain tied to the land.

zh: 这不利于鼓励人们寻找城市中的高薪岗位，同时也让农村劳动生产率和工资难以提高。
en: This discourages people from seeking higher incomes in the cities, while keeping rural labor productivity and wages low.

zh: 尽管快速扩张的城市会遇到公共服务瓶颈，但这是可以克服的。
en: While any rapidly expanding city experiences public-service bottlenecks, these can be overcome.

zh: 比如，日本和韩国都在没有人口流动限制的情况下将公共服务扩大到了快速增长的城镇区域中。
en: Japan and South Korea, for example, extended public services in their fast-growing urban areas without restricting mobility.

zh: 世界银行和国务院发展研究中心的报告指出，中国可以通过将公共服务与定居地而不是户口所在地挂钩实现做到这一点。
en: As the World Bank-DRC report points out, China can do the same by linking public services to place of residency rather than to place of origin.

zh: 此外，当农民工子女能够来到城市与父母团聚并获得良好的教育，下一代也将有更好的机会摆脱贫困。
en: Moreover, when migrant children are able to join their parents in the cities and get a good education, the next generation will have a better chance to escape poverty, too.

zh: 让人口流动变得更容易不仅打开了城市的机会；也能加速农业转型，因为日益减少的农业工人需要掌握新技术以提高生产率和工资。
en: Making migration easier would not only open up opportunities in the cities; it would also accelerate agricultural transformation, as the fewer remaining agricultural workers would need to acquire new skills to raise productivity and wages.

zh: 但是，要实施土地和户口改革，中国的财政制度必须有所修正。
en: However, in order to implement land and hukou reforms, China’s fiscal system must be overhauled.

zh: 强化农民地权将减少城市当局的土地转换收入，而它们需要这笔收入向新城镇移民提供公共服务。
en: Stronger land rights for farmers will deprive city authorities of the land-conversion revenues needed to provide public services to new urban migrants.

zh: 而更多的人口迁徙意味着更多的公共服务需求。
en: And more migration will mean more demand for those services.

zh: 因此，城市将必须寻找新的收入源。
en: Cities will therefore have to find new revenue sources.

zh: 物业税或地方个人所得税将以从城镇生活中获得最大好处的人群为目标。
en: A property tax or a local surcharge on personal income taxes would target those who most benefit from urban living.

zh: 环境税费 — — 如提高汽车注册费、污染费和改善公用设施成本覆盖 — — 也有所助益，还能同时纠正城镇环境问题。
en: Environmental charges and levies – such as higher registration fees for motor vehicles, pollution charges, and improved cost recovery on utilities – might also help, while simultaneously addressing urban environmental problems.

zh: 还有巨大的节流潜力可挖。
en: There are big potential savings to be gained, too.

zh: 据预测，中国城市将在未来15年中投入5.3万亿元用于基础设施建设；但更密集、更高效的城市将节省1.4万亿元（相当于2013年GDP的15 % ） 成本。
en: China’s cities are forecast to spend around $5.3 trillion on infrastructure over the next 15 years; but denser, more efficient cities would save around $1.4 trillion (15% of 2013 GDP) of these costs.

zh: 这笔钱可以用于补贴农民工所需要的医疗、教育和低收入住房。
en: This money could then help to finance the additional health care, education, and low-income housing required by new migrants.

zh: 中国人民，特别是穷人，将受益于政府政策从城市和基础设施的实体规模扩张向更好、更公平地分配公共服务的转变。
en: China’s citizens, especially its poor, would benefit from a shift in government policy from the physical expansion of cities and infrastructure to the delivery of better, more fairly distributed public services.

zh: 实现这一转变将真正体现当局所追求的以人为本的城镇化。
en: Achieving this would truly represent the people-oriented urbanization that the authorities seek to achieve.

zh: 松绑基础设施
en: Infrastructure Unbound

zh: 华盛顿—考虑一个简单的统计数字。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Consider a simple statistic.

zh: 每个月，发展中世界有五百多万人迁往城市地区，因为那里的就业、教育和各种机会都更容易找到。
en: Every month in the developing world, more than five million people migrate to urban areas, where jobs, schools, and opportunities of all kinds are often easier to find.

zh: 但在迁徙时，基本服务需要 — — 水、电和交通等 — — 也随着一起流动，基础设施需求也应运而生。
en: But when people migrate, the need for basic services – water, power, and transport – goes with them, highlighting the boom in infrastructure demand.

zh: 从肯尼亚到基里巴斯，这一现实是显而易见的 — — 不论哪个地区，只要处于快速的城市化过程中，支持贸易和企业家精神的需要以及解决气候变化挑战的努力就暴露出巨大的基础设施赤字。
en: The reality is evident from Kenya to Kiribati – everywhere where rapid urbanization, the need to support trade and entrepreneurship, and efforts to confront the challenges of climate change have exposed a wide infrastructure deficit.

zh: 这一赤字在发达经济体也存在。
en: And it is a deficit that confronts advanced economies as well.

zh: 简言之，全球基础设施建设和现代化应该成为长期全球增长战略的一部分。
en: Simply put, infrastructure construction and modernization worldwide needs to be part of a strategy for long-term global growth.

zh: 正因如此，二十国集团财政部长最近在澳大利亚悉尼举行了今年第一次会晤，将基础设施投资列为确保强劲、可持续和平衡复苏的关键要素。
en: That is why G-20 finance ministers, meeting recently for the first time this year in Sydney, Australia, singled out investment in infrastructure as one of the elements vital to ensuring a strong, sustainable, and balanced recovery.

zh: 但是，在二十国集团财政部长准备下个月在华盛顿重新聚首之时，我们看到了一个值得注意的问题：光是增加基础设施投资并不足以提振增长和就业创造。
en: But, with G-20 finance ministers preparing to meet again in Washington, DC, next month, a note of caution is in order: Simply increasing infrastructure investment is not enough to foster growth and job creation.

zh: 金融危机开始时，发达和新兴市场经济体将大量投资于“准备就绪”的基础设施工程以提振短期经济增长和创造就业。
en: At the start of the financial crisis, both advanced and emerging-market economies pumped money into “shovel-ready” infrastructure projects to boost short-term economic growth and create jobs. Now, in the wake of the crisis, the infrastructure challenge has become more difficult to address.

zh: 在新兴和发展中国经济体，政府预算饱受掣肘，而私人部门平均只占基础设施投资总量的不到15 % 。
en: In emerging and developing economies, government budgets are constrained, while the private sector accounts for less than 15% of total infrastructure investment on average.

zh: 事实上，新兴经济体所面临的一个 关键性基础设施投资融资挑战是许多以往在这方面扮演重要角色的商业银行（主要是欧洲银行）开始撤退 — — 并且在其受损于危机的资产负债表得到修复、筹集到符合提高了的监管标准的资本之前不会回到这一领域中。
en: Indeed, a key challenge in financing infrastructure investment in emerging economies is that many of the commercial banks (mainly European) that had a significant presence in the past have withdrawn – and are unlikely to return until they repair their crisis-hit balance sheets and build capital to meet strengthened regulatory standards.

zh: 这导致了巨大的未满足融资需要。
en: That leaves huge unmet financing needs.

zh: 在新兴和发展中经济体，据估计到2020年每年需要增加1—1.5万亿美元投资才能实现增长目标。
en: In emerging and developing economies, it is estimated that an additional $1-1.5 trillion in annual investment will be required through 2020 to meet growth targets.

zh: 如果考虑减少温室气体排放或适应气候变化问题，则每年的基础设施需求成本还要在增加1,700—2,200亿美元。
en: Factoring in additional spending for reducing greenhouse-gas emissions or adapting to climate change could add $170-220 billion each year to the cost of these countries’ infrastructure needs.

zh: 显然，二十国集团强调满足这一需要对无数人来说至关重要是正确的。
en: Obviously, the G-20 is right to emphasize how important meeting these needs is to how many people.

zh: 比如，超过69%的撒哈拉以南非洲人口得不到电；65%的南亚人口得不到简单的蹲厕；40%的拉美和加勒比地区农村人口无法获得全天候道路。
en: For example, more than 69% of Sub-Saharan Africa’s population lack access to electricity; 65% of people in South Asia lack access to a simple pit latrine; and 40% of rural people in Latin America and the Caribbean lack access to all-weather roads.

zh: 但我们也知道，促进基础设施投资需要的不只是钱。
en: But we also know that promoting infrastructure investment requires more than money.

zh: 一些国家从基础设施投资中获得了巨大的增长好处，有的国家则没有见到任何回报。
en: Some countries generate massive growth benefits from their infrastructure spending, while others hardly see a return.

zh: 世界银行集团为二十国集团所准备的背景资料指出，政府应该花更大的力气用于遴选、筛选和管理基础设施项目，并更多地致力于基本投资气候质量问题。
en: As a background note prepared by the World Bank Group for the G-20 explains, governments should pay more attention to the selection, quality, and management of infrastructure projects, as well as to the quality of the underlying investment climate.

zh: 优先投资、良好规划和可靠的项目设计能够极大地增加新型现代化基础设施对增长和就业创造的影响力，同时提高稀缺资源的回报。
en: Prioritizing investments, good planning, and sound project design can significantly boost the impact of new and modernized infrastructure on growth and job creation, as well as raise returns on scarce resources.

zh: 更好的投资规划有助于避免让基础设施陷入低效率、不“绿色”科技泥淖。
en: Better investment planning can also help to avoid locking infrastructure into inefficient and less “green” technologies.

zh: 是的，所有这些都是说起来容易做起来难。
en: Yes, all of that is easier said than done.

zh: 我在悉尼听说，许多发展中国家在选择、准备和实施项目方面面临着实际困难。
en: As I heard in Sydney, many developing countries face real difficulties in identifying, preparing, and implementing projects.

zh: 技术、金融、经济和环境可行性研究以及长期规划的成本可能很高，甚至达到数百万美元。
en: The price tag for technical, financial, economic, and environmental feasibility studies and long-term plans can be high, running into the millions of dollars.

zh: 世界银行集团一直在帮助发展中国家建设这方面的能力。
en: The World Bank Group has been helping developing countries build up their capacity in these areas.

zh: 但需要做更多的事帮助各国发展鲁棒的计划渠道以支持更强的公共投资项目，这是从私人部门吸引大量资源的关键。
en: But more must be done to enable countries to develop a robust project pipeline that supports a stronger public-investment program, which is critical to any strategy to attract substantial resources from the private sector.

zh: 此外，在今天的经济气候下，吸引私人融资至关重要，因为光靠公共资金断然无法弥补基础设施缺口。
en: And, in today’s economic climate, attracting private financing is essential, because there is simply no way that public funding alone can close the infrastructure gap.

zh: 这还需要确保良好的治理、可预测的价格结构以及可信的监管环境。
en: Doing so will also require ensuring appropriate governance, predictable pricing structures, and a credible regulatory environment.

zh: 各国已没有时间可供浪费。
en: Countries have no time to waste.

zh: 我们的城市正在不断成长，基础设施在帮助为穷人提供基本服务、创造就业和机会、增加进入市场的机会以及确保可持续发增长方面有着独一无二的作用，而要起到这一作用，就需要决策者快速果断地行动起来。
en: The unique role of infrastructure in helping to provide basic services for poor people, creating jobs and opportunity, facilitating access to markets, and ensuring sustainable growth in our ever-growing cities requires policymakers to act quickly and decisively.

zh: 抗击极端贫困的最好方式
en: The Best Ways to Fight Extreme Poverty

zh: 哥本哈根 — — 1950年，韩国和巴基斯坦民众每年所得相差无几。
en: COPENHAGEN – In 1950, people in South Korea and Pakistan earned roughly the same amount of money annually.

zh: 而今天，这两个国家几乎不具有可比性。
en: Today, the two countries are scarcely comparable.

zh: 韩国的人均收入从那以后增长了23倍，而巴基斯坦却只增长了三倍。
en: South Korean’s per capita income has grown 23-fold since then, while Pakistan has experienced only a three-fold increase.

zh: 我们怎样才能帮助世界更多最贫困国家效仿韩国的成功是当今世界面临的最重要问题之一。
en: How we can help more of the world’s poorest countries emulate South Korea’s success is one of the most important questions facing the world today.

zh: 改善经济成果意味着赋予所有人更强健的体魄、更优质的教育，更长的寿命和更强的战胜自然灾害能力。
en: Better economic outcomes mean empowering entire populations with better health, more education, longer life, and less vulnerability to challenges like natural disasters.

zh: 减贫是联合国提出未来15年169项发展目标中最常见的核心目标。
en: Many of the United Nations’ proposed 169 development targets for the next 15 years are, at their heart, concerned with poverty reduction.

zh: 但并不是所有目标都能带来同等效益。
en: But not all targets are equally good.

zh: 我领导的哥本哈根共识中心最近委托60组经济学家评估上述目标的成本效益状况。 上述拟议中的目标将取代千年发展目标于9月生效。
en: The Copenhagen Consensus Center, of which I am director, recently asked 60 teams of economists to evaluate the benefits and costs of these proposed targets, which will come into force to replace the Millennium Development Goals in September.

zh: 其中一个最不理想的目标乍看似乎最值得称赞：那就是实现全民就业。
en: One of the least desirable targets seems laudable at first: full employment for all.

zh: 不幸的是，这只是梦想而非目标。
en: Unfortunately, this is a dream, not a target.

zh: 经济发展需要让一些人失业以便实现岗位转换，而且多数政府已经在着力创造就业机会。
en: Economies need some unemployment to allow workers to change jobs, and most governments already focus on job creation.

zh: 研究表明政客和利益集团会利用全民就业支持代价昂贵的保护主义政策，在为部分人带来好工作的同时却让更多人进入非正式经济队伍。
en: Research suggests that politicians and interest groups would use a full-employment target to support expensive, protectionist policies that generate great jobs for some but drive many into the informal economy.

zh: 因此这项目标带来的效益可能还不及成本，肯定不是削减极端贫困的最佳方式。
en: So it would probably end up doing less good than it would cost, and it is certainly not the way to reduce extreme poverty.

zh: 全世界约14.5%的人口，也就是十亿人，每天仅靠不到1.25美元生活。
en: About 14.5% of the world’s population, or one billion people, live on less than $1.25 a day.

zh: 那么为什么不干脆给这十亿人转款，让他们的生活费至少每天达到1.26美元？
en: So why not end extreme poverty by simply transferring enough resources to this billion people to get them to at least $1.26 a day?

zh: 这样全世界最贫困民众就能更好地抚养教育子女及改善健康。
en: The world’s poorest would be able to feed and educate their children better and become healthier.

zh: 但除去财务成本，还会带来腐败、体制缺陷和巨大的管理难题。
en: But, in addition to the financial cost, there would be huge administrative challenges, along with corruption and institutional deficiencies.

zh: 权衡这些因素和在货币方面产生的效益，以现金支付形式每花一美元结束极端贫困都将产生5美元的社会价值。
en: When these factors are weighed against the benefits in monetary terms, each dollar spent ending extreme poverty with cash transfers would achieve about $5 worth of social value.

zh: 这样的回报一点不差，但还有更好的提供帮助方式。
en: That is not a bad return at all, but there are many better ways to help.

zh: 一种可能性是将发展中国家移动宽带普及率提高3倍。
en: One possibility is to triple mobile broadband penetration in developing countries.

zh: 农民和���民等小商人可以借此了解市场信息，以最高价格出售产品 — — 从而改善生产力、提高效率、创造更多就业机会。
en: This would provide small-scale businesspeople such as farmers and fishermen with market information, enabling them to sell their goods at the highest price – and to boost productivity, increase efficiency, and generate more jobs.

zh: 我们的研究表明上述效益加起来相当于每花1美元收益17美元 — — 这使之成为非常诱人的发展目标。
en: Our research shows that the benefits, added up, would be worth $17 for every dollar spent – making it a very good development target.

zh: 改进干预方式能够解决移民问题。
en: An even better intervention addresses migration.

zh: 今天有超过2亿人在国外工作。
en: More than 200 million people today work outside their home countries.

zh: 随着富裕国家不断老龄化，他们需要更多劳动力。
en: As rich countries age, they need more workers.

zh: 与此同时，发展中国家民众在发达国家能提高工作效率。
en: At the same time, people from developing countries are more productive in a developed country.

zh: 放宽移民限制能使发展中国家年轻人补充工业化国家不断缩减的劳动力 — — 同时产生支付养老费用所需的税赋。
en: Easing restrictions on migration would allow young people from developing countries to expand industrialized economies’ diminishing workforces – and generate the taxes needed to pay for care for the elderly.

zh: 这样的移民对发展中国家也非常有利，因为外来务工人员能将挣来的报酬汇回家去。
en: Such migration would also be good for the developing countries, because migrant workers send home remittances.

zh: 总的来讲，每耗费一美元扩大移民就能产生超过45美元 — — 甚至可能超过300美元的社会效益。
en: In total, every dollar spent on increased migration would produce more than $45 of social good – possibly more than $300.

zh: 尽管扩大移民在当今政治气候下或许难以实现，但应该指出移民对帮助世界最贫困人口多么有价值。
en: While in today’s political climate, increasing migration might be difficult to achieve, it is worth pointing out how effectively it could help the world’s poorest.

zh: 完成多哈回合贸易谈判是对全球繁荣最具影响的单一发展目标。
en: The single development target that would have the biggest impact on global prosperity would be the completion of the Doha trade round.

zh: 降低贸易壁垒意味着所有国家都能集中精力做最擅长的工作，让所有人过得更好。
en: Lowering trade barriers would mean that all countries could focus on doing what they do best, making everyone better off.

zh: 此外，因为创新增加和知识交流，自由贸易得以加速经济增长。
en: Moreover, freer trade would accelerate economic growth, owing to increased innovation and knowledge exchange.

zh: 严重依赖全球市场贸易是韩国发展如此之快的主要原因之一，过去65年来该国基本实现了根除贫困的目标。
en: Heavy reliance on trading in a global market was one of the main reasons that South Korea has developed so rapidly and essentially eradicated its poverty in the last 65 years.

zh: 经济模型表明成功的多哈回合谈判将使全球经济到2030年每年增加11万亿美元财富，其中多数收益将流向发展中国家。
en: Economic models indicate that a successful Doha round would make the global economy $11 trillion richer each year by 2030, with most of the benefits going to developing countries.

zh: 发展中国家每人每年平均收入增加1，000美元。
en: Each person in the developing world would earn $1,000 more per year, on average.

zh: 极端贫困人数将下降1.6亿。
en: The number of people living in extreme poverty would fall by 160 million.

zh: 这方面每投入1美元（主要用于支付阻碍谈判的西方农场主 ） ， 世界能够实现超过2，000美元收益，使得对自由贸易的投资效率惊人。
en: For every dollar spent, mostly to pay off Western farmers blocking the current negotiations, the world would achieve more than $2,000 of benefits, making free trade a phenomenal investment.

zh: 所有计划 — — 全民就业、现金转移支付、宽带推广、放宽移民和降低贸易壁垒 — — 全部包含在联合国169项发展目标之中。
en: Each of these proposals – full employment, cash transfers, broadband rollout, freer migration, and lower trade barriers – is covered by at least one of the UN’s 169 development targets.

zh: 问题就在这里。
en: And herein lies the problem.

zh: 试图同时完成169项任务是有勇无谋。
en: Trying to do 169 different things at once would be foolhardy.

zh: 这意味着在低效目标上浪费过多时间和金钱，而不是全力实现对全球穷人产生最大影响的目标。
en: It would mean spending too much time and resources on lower-return priorities, instead of focusing on the targets that promise the biggest impact on the world’s poorest.

zh: 事实上，我们的研究显示像自由贸易一样，应该集中精力优先完成其中19项非同凡响的目标。
en: In fact, our research shows that there are 19 phenomenal targets that – like freer trade – should be prioritized above all of the others.

zh: 那些目标成为全球政策的最终决策将对今后15年价值数万亿美元的资金流动产生影响。
en: The final decision about which targets will become global policy will affect the flow of trillions of dollars over the next 15 years.

zh: 9月，当世界领导人齐聚纽约，他们要对推动全球繁荣的明智方式进行重点探讨。
en: In September, when world leaders gather in New York, they need to focus on the smartest ways to boost global prosperity.

zh: 这样做将帮助更多国家步韩国之后尘，实现民众脱贫致富的目标。
en: Doing so would help more countries take South Korea’s path and lift their populations out of poverty.

zh: 来自伯利恒的希望之音
en: Bethlehem’s Message of Hope

zh: 伯利恒 — — 只有走在街道上才能充分欣赏伯利恒的悠久历史。
en: BETHLEHEM – Bethlehem’s rich history can be fully appreciated only by walking its streets.

zh: 每年，这座城市都以耶稣降生的卑微的马槽形象深入到全世界的百万家庭。
en: Every year, the city enters millions of homes worldwide through the image of the humble manger where Jesus was born.

zh: 但图片绝不等同于亲身体验这座老城。
en: But that image does not compare to experiencing the Old City firsthand.

zh: 来到伯利恒是一种独一无二的体验，我认为值得所有人追寻。
en: Coming to Bethlehem is a unique experience that I would encourage everyone to pursue.

zh: 不幸的是，尽管过去一年伯利恒的游客数量有所增长，但许多人却无法尽情地探索这座古城。
en: Unfortunately, while visitors to Bethlehem have increased in number during the past year, many are unable to explore the city properly.

zh: 在以色列占领下，阻碍巴勒斯坦旅游业正常发展的障碍导致数千人无法充分体验伯利恒的一草一木。
en: Under Israeli occupation, obstacles hindering the normal development of tourism in Palestine have prevented thousands of people from experiencing what Bethlehem has to offer.

zh: 例如，我常听巴勒斯坦牧师说 ， “ 在这片土地上，我们接待了许多游客，但却没有几个朝圣者。
en: For example, I often hear from Palestinian priests that, “In this land, we receive many tourists yet very few pilgrims.”

zh: ”换言之，有更多游客想要观光这座石槽，但却很少有人愿意深度体验鲜活的石槽是什么样子。
en: In other words, there are more visitors interested in seeing the stones than in meeting the living stones.

zh: 这是以色列垄断旅游业的后果之一。
en: This is one consequence of Israel’s monopoly over the tourist industry.

zh: 以色列人没有兴趣鼓励游客了解巴勒斯坦人的遗产或与巴勒斯坦人互动。
en: Israel has little interest in encouraging visitors to interact with Palestinians or to learn about their heritage.

zh: 很难想象信仰或历史感驱动下的游客不想见一见他们所访问圣地的管事。
en: It is hard to imagine that visitors motivated by faith or a sense of history would not want to meet the stewards of the holy sites they are visiting.

zh: 教皇圣保罗二世2000年朝圣时的表达最为贴切，当时他在访问德伊舍难民营时告诉那里的巴勒斯坦人 ， “ 伯利恒的牧师和守护者或许就是你们的祖先和前辈。 ”
en: Pope John Paul II said it best during his pilgrimage in 2000, when he told Palestinians during a visit to the Dheisheh Refugee Camp that, “Probably the pastors and shepherds of Bethlehem were your predecessors, your ancestors.”

zh: 圣诞教堂对所有基督教徒而言都具有重要意义，无论他们来自什么样的教派。
en: The Church of the Nativity is of seminal importance to all Christians, whatever their denomination.

zh: 但我们仍然必须竭尽全力说服人们去参观它。
en: And yet we still must go to great lengths to persuade people to visit it.

zh: 更令人震惊的是，当我们试图申请让这座教堂进入联合国教科文组织世界遗产名录时，某些国家屈服于以色列和美国的压力，反对为这座教堂正名。
en: Even more shocking, when we sought to list the church as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, some countries, succumbing to Israeli and American pressure, opposed the designation.

zh: 但我们仍然取得了成功，现在我们正在忙于修复这座珍贵的遗址。
en: Still, we succeeded, and we are now busy with the important work of preserving this cherished site.

zh: 我自豪的告诉大家，这将是教堂修缮工作大功告成之前的最后一个圣诞节。
en: I am proud to say that this will be the last Christmas before the restoration of the church is complete.

zh: 很快，游客就可以参观新发现的马赛克和这座教堂的原始楼层，所有这一切都可以追溯到公元四世纪。
en: Soon, visitors will be able to see newly discovered mosaics and the church’s original floor, all of which date back to the fourth century.

zh: 参观过后，他们还可以游览老城的其他地标，包括星街、约瑟夫和玛丽曾经走过的朝圣之路，这里在我们改造完成后已经充满生机。
en: After that, they can visit other landmarks of the Old City, including Star Street, the pilgrimage route taken by Joseph and Mary, which we are transforming into a place full of life.

zh: 事实上，伯利恒的文化遗产远不限于圣诞教堂的四壁。
en: Indeed, Bethlehem’s cultural heritage extends well beyond the walls of the Church of the Nativity.

zh: 很久以前的文献资料就记载了这座城市的繁华，来源包括19世纪造访这里的欧洲探险者。
en: The richness of the city has long been documented, including by European explorers who visited in the nineteenth century.

zh: 在法国人维克多·介朗1875年出版的对巴勒斯坦的描述中，向人们展现了一座充满生机的城市，这座城市至少分为八个区。
en: In the Frenchman Victor Guérin’s Description of Palestine, published in 1875, one finds a city full of life, and divided into at least eight quarters.

zh: 映入游客眼帘的是阿纳托区的辉煌建筑，还可以了解巴勒斯坦历史最悠久的仍在运营的学校，创办于1598年的Terra Sancta大学。
en: Visitors encountered the splendid architecture of the Anatra quarter, and learned about Palestine’s oldest still-functioning school, the Terra Sancta College, which dates back to 1598.

zh: 今天的绝大多数游客都无法享受到这样的际遇。
en: The same cannot be said for most visitors today.

zh: 伯利恒的美食同样是一座宝藏。
en: Bethlehem’s cuisine is also a treasure.

zh: 从新鲜烘培食品、沙拉三明治和鹰嘴豆沙到摆满了来自拜提尔花园各式特产的厨师餐桌，鲜有小城拥有伯利恒这样丰富的菜式。
en: From fresh baked goods, falafel, and hummus to a chef’s table stocked with produce from the Battir Gardens, Bethlehem’s richness of fare is rare for a small city.

zh: 离市中心仅15分钟车程的另一座世界遗址拜提尔花园能让人享受到激动人心的梯田、徒步远足小径、葡萄和橄榄树，能让人暂时忘却丑陋的以色列定居点和环绕这座城市的围墙。
en: Battir Gardens, another World Heritage Site just 15 minutes from the city center, offers breathtaking agricultural terraces, hiking trails, vines, and olives that offset the ugly Israeli settlements and walls encircling the city.

zh: 因为这些定居点的存在，巴勒斯坦政府的管辖权仅限于该地区总土地面积的13 % 。
en: As a result of those settlements, the Palestinian government’s remit applies to a mere 13% of the district’s total land area.

zh: 伯利恒需要面对一切巴勒斯坦正在面对的挑战。
en: Bethlehem is no stranger to the challenges facing all of Palestine.

zh: 特朗普政府承认耶路撒冷为以色列首都已经鼓励以色列政府加强其在东耶路撒冷及其周边的殖民统治，而这严重地影响了伯利恒。
en: The Trump administration’s recognition of Jerusalem as Israel’s capital has encouraged the Israeli government to increase colonization in and around East Jerusalem, which severely affects Bethlehem.

zh: 随着种族主义法律令我们的家庭越来越四分五裂，有些人已经对政治解决彻底丧失了希望，因此选择移民。
en: With racist laws increasingly dividing our families, some have lost all hope for a political solution, and opted for emigration instead.

zh: 但占领的伤痕并不能代表这里的一切。
en: But the scars of occupation do not tell the whole story.

zh: 成千上万名留在伯利恒的巴勒斯坦人在不断斗争的同时，仍然构成了一个蓬勃发展且颇具创造力的公民社会，包括以希望的名义继续寻求机会的艺术家、人权机构和商人。
en: The thousands of Palestinians who have stayed in Bethlehem, despite the constant struggle, comprise a thriving and creative civil society, including artists, human rights organizations and businesspeople who continue to pursue opportunities in the name of hope.

zh: 耶利米书中的一个段落完美地体现了当今巴勒斯坦的现实 ： “ 和平、和平，他们不断呼吁，当我们看不到和平。
en: The reality for Palestinians today is captured perfectly in a passage from the Book of Jeremiah: “‘Peace, peace,’ they say, when there is no peace.”

zh: ”我们可以对这句话进行补充 ， “ 希望、希望，当希望丧失殆尽 ， ” 因为让希望保留下去是我们的责任。
en: To that we might add, “‘Hope, hope’ when there is no hope,” because it is our responsibility to keep hope alive.

zh: 希望的精神令伯利恒焕发出耀眼的光芒，即使仍处在占领的黑暗中。
en: The spirit of hope is what keeps Bethlehem shining brightly, even in the darkness of occupation.

zh: 尽管像美国副总统迈克·彭斯那样的基督教犹太复国主义者险恶地利用圣经来为压迫巴勒斯坦人寻找借口，就好像剥夺我们的权利是一项神圣的使命，但我们仍然坚决支持基督教的正义、爱与和平。
en: Though Christian Zionists like US Vice President Mike Pence make cynical use of the Bible to justify oppression of the Palestinians, as if denying our rights is a divine mandate, we are nonetheless determined to stand up for Christ’s message of justice, love, and peace.

zh: 我们身边出现的种族主义制度毫无神圣之处。
en: There is nothing divine about the system of apartheid emerging around us.

zh: 贯穿我们城市中心的非法隔离墙恰恰是正义和自由的对立面。
en: The illegal wall that has been built through the heart of our city is antithetical to justice and freedom.

zh: 它的拆除将成为一种福音。
en: Its dismantling would be a blessing.

zh: 对世界其他地方而言，伯利恒仍然而且必须继续成为一种希望的象征。
en: For the rest of the world, Bethlehem is and must remain a symbol of hope.

zh: 作为具有数百年悠久历史的大都会建筑和数十座各式教派教堂的所在地，这座城市是一座包容的大本营。
en: As home to centuries-old cosmopolitan architecture and dozens of churches of various denominations, the city is a bastion of inclusion.

zh: 贝克萨奥的牧人旷野、圣尼古拉斯教堂和彼特杰拉的赫雷米桑谷地、卡德尔的圣乔治修道院和马萨巴修道院都代表着没有狂热的信仰。
en: Shepherds Field in Beit Sahour, Saint Nicholas Church and the Cremisan Valley in Beit Jala, St. George’s Monastery in Al Khader, and Mar Saba all embody faith without fanaticism.

zh: 但为了避免我们忘记，伯利恒还设有三座难民营，它时刻提醒我们在大灾难（Nakba）期间巴勒斯坦民众所承受的不公，当时数十万巴勒斯坦民众于1948年被赶出自己的家园，在这里形成了难民营。
en: But, lest we forget, Bethlehem also hosts three refugee camps, which is a reminder of the injustice visited upon Palestinians during the Nakba (catastrophe), when hundreds of thousands of Palestinians, expelled from their homes in 1948, sought refuge here.

zh: 经历了漫长的2000年后，伯利恒从未改变向世界传递希望的福音。
en: After more than 2,000 years, Bethlehem’s message of hope to the world remains unchanged.

zh: 欢迎所有人来这里亲自体验一下这座小城。
en: All are invited to come experience it firsthand.

zh: 数据驱动的性别平等
en: Data-Driven Gender Equality

zh: 纽约 — — 本周即将召开的联合国大会年会重要议程是评估可持续发展目标（SDGs）的全球进展状况，可持续发展目标是联合国就解决截止2030年全球最重大挑战的发展蓝图所达成的一致目标。
en: NEW YORK – A key agenda item at this year’s annual meeting of the United Nations General Assembly, under way this week, will be to assess global progress on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), the UN’s consensus roadmap for solving the world’s biggest challenges by 2030.

zh: 我本人参与过协助制定千年发展目标的联合国团队，千年发展目标是出台可持续发展目标之前的版本。
en: I was part of the UN team that helped create the Millennium Development Goals, which preceded the SDGs.

zh: 到2015年千年发展目标计划结束时，它已经成功推动了全世界有史以来最迅速和广泛的全球卫生和发展增长。
en: By the time the MDGs concluded in 2015, they had fueled some of the fastest and most extensive gains in global health and development the world has ever seen.

zh: 千年发展目标为可持续发展目标题铺平了道路，我本人也因为全球社会对实现后2015年发展议程所表现出来的坚定决心而感到鼓舞。
en: The MDGs paved the way for the SDGs, and I have been encouraged by the commitment the global community has shown to sustaining the post-2015 development agenda.

zh: 但我和其他人也明确认识到，如果没有对妇女和女童需求以数据为基础的深思熟虑的重点关注，实现一系列目标的进展状况将会受到影响。
en: But it has also become clear to me and others that without a more deliberate, data-driven focus on the needs of women and girls in particular, progress toward a wide range of objectives will suffer.

zh: 如果我们无法实现普遍的性别平等，我们就无法实现从结束贫困到确保身体健康在内的很多其他目标。
en: If we fail to achieve universal gender equality, we will fall short of many other goals, from ending poverty to ensuring good health.

zh: 我个人对千年发展目标的一个不满之处是性别平等更多地停留在一种言辞而非行动。
en: One of my personal frustrations with the MDGs was that gender equality was more a matter of rhetoric than of action.

zh: 尽管承诺赋予权力，但千年发展目标并没有充分解决妇女和女童所面临的许多最重大挑战，比如基于性别的暴力和经济歧视等现象。
en: Despite their promise of empowerment, the MDGs didn’t adequately target many of the biggest challenges that women and girls face, such as gender-based violence and economic discrimination.

zh: 这样的不足之处一直延续到现在，因为在20世纪90年代制定千年发展目标时，包括我本人在内的大多数人对问题的规模和复杂性并没有充分认识到。
en: These gaps have persisted, because in the 1990s, when the MDGs were being formulated, most people, including me, did not adequately understand the scale or complexity of the problem.

zh: 我们必须避免可持续发展目标遭遇同样的命运。
en: We must avoid a similar fate with the SDGs.

zh: 实现两性平等不仅仅是一代人的机遇；同时也是推动所有可持续发展目标取得进展、并建设一个所有人都能繁荣兴旺的世界的最佳方式。
en: Achieving gender equality is more than a once-in-a-generation opportunity; it is also the best way to make progress on nearly all of the SDGs, and to build a world where everyone can thrive.

zh: 就像比尔和梅林达盖茨将在下周纽约举行的世界领导人会议上讨论并在一份新报告中所阐述的那样，我们需要采取集体行动来改善各个方面的性别不平等并推动进步。
en: As Bill and Melinda Gates will discuss at a gathering of world leaders next week in New York, and show in a new report, collective action is needed to address the various dimensions of gender inequality and drive progress.

zh: 这方面最大的障碍是在严重影响妇女和女童的土地权、教育权、计划生育权和医疗卫生权等方面欠缺对高质量数据的掌握。
en: One of the biggest impediments is a dearth of good data on issues that disproportionately affect women and girls, such as land rights, access to education, family planning, or health care.

zh: 数据对理解效果和跟踪进展起到了至关重要的作用。
en: Data are essential to understanding what is working and how to track progress.

zh: 但17个可持续发展目标中制定专项指标评估最新数据进展的仅占一小部分 — — 其中也包括与性别平等直接相关的超过40个指标。
en: Yet up-to-date data exist for only a small fraction of the indicators that were developed to assess progress on the 17 SDGs – including the more than 40 that directly relate to gender equality.

zh: 在与主要性别平等目标（可持续发展目标第5条）相关的14个评估指标中，多数国家仅评估其中的三个指标。
en: Of the 14 indicators of progress associated with the primary gender equity goal, SDG 5, most countries are measuring just three.

zh: 为填补这些重要空白，比尔和梅林达盖茨基金会创立了一项8，000万美元的三年行动计划，目的是搜集更为可靠的数据，改善项目和政策干预的设计和目标导向。
en: To help fill these critical gaps, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation has created a three-year, $80 million initiative to generate more reliable data that can improve the design and targeting of programs and policy interventions.

zh: 作为这项工作的组成部分，该基金会最近与联合国妇女组织共同发起了一项1，000万美元的协助各国改善所搜集性别数据质量的合作计划。
en: As part of that effort, the foundation recently launched a $10 million partnership with UN Women to help countries improve the quality of the gender-specific data they collect.

zh: 该基金会还支持2030年平等措施，该计划授权倡导者和民间社会团体充分利用便于获得的证据，以评估目标的进展状况并跟踪妇女和女童可持续发展目标的完成状况。
en: The foundation is also supporting Equal Measures 2030, an initiative to empower advocates and civil-society groups with easy-to-use evidence to assess progress toward targets and keep the SDGs for women and girls on track.

zh: 性别平等倡导者和决策者将从上述和其他项目中获得关于阻碍妇女和女童发展的社会和经济障碍性质和规模的更为准确的信息，并有助于明确性别平等计划遗漏了哪些对象。
en: These and other efforts will provide gender-equality advocates and decision-makers with better information about the nature and scale of the social and economic barriers holding women and girls back, and help identify who is falling through the cracks.

zh: 现有证据显示授权妇女和女童可以加速推动进步。
en: We know from existing evidence that empowering women and girls can accelerate progress.

zh: 比方说，如果女孩儿有机会上高中（可持续发展目标第4条 ） ， 她们涉及童婚的可能性仅为原来的六分之一不到。
en: For example, when girls attend secondary school (SDG 4), they are up to six times less likely to be married as a child.

zh: 花季少女的识字率越高，生育率就越低，健康状况也越好（可持续发展目标第3条 ） 。
en: And higher literacy rates among adolescent girls are associated with lower adolescent birth rates and improved health (SDG 3).

zh: 同样，妇女将剩余收入投入改善子女生活的可能性比男性大得多。
en: Likewise, women are much more likely than men to invest surplus income in ways that improve the lives of their children.

zh: 当妇女能获得基本的金融服务，如开立信贷和储蓄账户时，性别平等的好处也是显而易见的。 这使得她们能够开办企业，并存钱用于家庭生活必需品的采购。
en: The benefits of gender equity are also apparent when women have access to basic financial services, like credit and savings accounts, which enable them to start businesses and save money for family essentials.

zh: 此外，消除农业领域的性别差距也能对发展中国家的家庭和生产效率产生深远的影响。
en: Closing the gender gap in agriculture, meanwhile, could have an even more profound impact on families and productivity in the developing world.

zh: 比方说，今天在撒哈拉以南非洲，妇女仅占农业劳动力的半数不到。
en: Today, for example, women make up nearly half of the agricultural workforce in Sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 但她们通常耕作的土地比男性面积小、产量差，而且往往无法获得最好培训机会、种子和肥料。
en: Yet, they typically work smaller, less productive plots of land than men, and often lack access to the best seeds, fertilizer, credit, and training opportunities.

zh: 研究表明在经营性资产领域授予妇女更多的决策权有可能提高农业产量超过20 % ， 这对到2030年“消除一切形式的贫困 ” （ 可持续发展目标第1条）将起到至关重要的作用。
en: Studies show that giving women more decision-making power over productive assets has the potential to increase farm yields by more than 20%, which is essential to “end poverty in all its forms everywhere” by 2030 (SDG 1).

zh: 当我们消除社会最弱势群体所面临的障碍时，将会产生革命性的效果。
en: When we remove the barriers confronting the most vulnerable in society, the effects are transformational.

zh: 但要实现上述目标，捐助者、发展伙伴、政府和私营部门必须投资，搜集按年龄和性别分类的更多更好的数据以用于决策。
en: But to do that, donors, development partners, governments, and the private sector must invest in more and better data that are sorted by age and sex.

zh: 这样做将使项目能够适应世界各地妇女和女童的需要。
en: Doing so will allow programs to be tailored to the needs of women and girls everywhere.

zh: 我们的挑战和机遇是克服阻碍妇女和女童发展的根深蒂固的障碍。
en: Our challenge – and opportunity – is to overcome the deeply entrenched barriers that impede progress for women and girls.

zh: 可持续发展目标是朝这个方向迈出的重要步骤。
en: The SDGs are a huge step in that direction.

zh: 但没有可行战略支撑的目标仅仅是良好的愿望。
en: But goals without actionable strategies are just good intentions.

zh: 可持续发展目标制定了结束贫困、为所有人创造更好、更健康、更安全世界的发展蓝图。
en: The SDGs provide the roadmap to ending poverty and creating a better, healthier, more secure world for everyone.

zh: 确保没有任何人掉队的最佳方式就是确保高质量的数据掌握在我们手中。
en: Ensuring that we have quality data is the best way to ensure that no one gets lost along the way.

zh: 从更好的赌局中更好地学习
en: Better Learning Through Better Betting

zh: 费城—公共争论的过程令人抑郁地熟悉。
en: PHILADELPHIA – The course of public debate has become depressingly familiar.

zh: 它常常从惊奇开始 — — 比如，转型电视真人秀明星的房地产大亨唐纳德·特朗普令人大跌眼镜地成为美国共和党总统提名代表。
en: It often begins with a surprise – for example, Donald Trump, the real-estate tycoon turned reality TV star, defies the odds to become the US Republican Party’s presumptive presidential nominee.

zh: 然后，专家出场。
en: The pundits dive in.

zh: 为什么会这样？
en: Why is it happening?

zh: 这意味着什么？
en: What does it mean?

zh: 接下去会怎样？
en: What will come next?

zh: 一段时间后，作为争论对象的未来会水落石出。
en: After a time, the future that was being debated is revealed.

zh: 在理想的世界里，每个人都会看到哪个预测是正确的。
en: In an ideal world, everyone would acknowledge which forecast proved correct. Lessons would be learned.

zh: 人们将学习教训，据此改变思维。
en: People would change their thinking accordingly.

zh: 集体而言，我们都会变得更聪明一点。
en: Collectively, we would all be a little wiser.

zh: 但这是不那么理想的世界。
en: But this is a less-than-ideal world.

zh: 常常，专家并不学习教训，而只是继续争论。
en: All too often, instead of learning lessons, the pundits just continue arguing.

zh: 他们争论发生的事情。
en: They dispute what happened.

zh: 他们不承认谁预测了哪个结果。
en: They disagree about who predicted which outcome.

zh: 没人改变思维。
en: No minds are changed.

zh: 集体而言，我们没有变聪明。
en: Collectively, we become no wiser.

zh: 对那些认为我们可以做得更好的人来说，一个解决方法是对我们的预测下注。
en: For those who think we can do better, one solution is to make bets on our predictions.

zh: 2014年初，经济学家泰勒·科文（Tyler Cowen）和布莱恩·卡普兰（Bryan Caplan）就这么做了。
en: In early 2014, the economists Tyler Cowen and Bryan Caplan did just that.

zh: 科文对美国的失业擒故康感到失望，因此他和卡普兰打赌失业率在未来20年里不会低于5 % 。
en: Cowen was pessimistic about unemployment in the United States, so he bet Caplan that the rate would not fall below 5% during the following 20 years.

zh: 两年后，失业率降到了4.9 % 。
en: Two years later, unemployment had dropped to 4.9%.

zh: 卡普兰获得无可非议的胜利。
en: Caplan had won a clear victory.

zh: 这种无可非议性正是下注预言所要获得的。
en: It is exactly that sort of clarity that betting on predictions seeks to obtain.

zh: 专家不用面对诘难，他们往往使用模糊的字眼，比如“失业将保持高企多年”或“特朗普的支持率将大跌 ” 。
en: Left unchallenged, pundits routinely use vague language, such as “unemployment will remain high for years” or “Trump’s support will slide.”

zh: 在电视上，这听起来很不错，但并没有形成无可争议的可检验的结果。
en: These sound good on television, but they do not produce an indisputable, testable result.

zh: （多少年是“多年 ” ？
en: (How many years is “many”?

zh: 下降多少算得上“大跌 ” ？
en: How much decline qualifies as a “slide”?)

zh: ）下注迫使双方就定义明确的条件形成一致 — — 让人们能够显而易见的看出谁对谁错。
en: Bets force the two parties to agree to well-defined terms – making it obvious to everyone who was right and who was wrong.

zh: 当然，下注的目的不在于宣布谁胜谁负；而是为了通过明确定义谁对现实的理解更加接近真实来取代又臭又长、毫无意义的争论。
en: The purpose of betting, of course, is not to declare winners and losers; it is to replace endless, pointless arguments with a clear determination of whose understanding of reality is closer to the truth.

zh: 其最终目的是为了让我们所有人变得更聪明。
en: The ultimate goal is to make us all a little wiser.

zh: 但不幸的是，在实现这一目的方面，下注一贯是失败的。
en: And yet, unfortunately, when it comes to achieving that goal, betting has consistently failed.

zh: 以科文对他输掉与卡普兰的赌局的反应为例。
en: Take Cowen’s response to losing his bet with Caplan.

zh: 根据赌注的条件，他很快就承认他输了。
en: He quickly acknowledged that he had lost, according to the terms of the bet.

zh: 但他仍坚持这并不证明卡普兰是对的。
en: But he nonetheless insisted that this did not prove Caplan right.

zh: 科文指出，尽管失业率有所下降，但就业-人口比并未发生多少变化。
en: Cowen noted that while the unemployment rate had fallen, the employment-to-population ratio had barely budged.

zh: 在对结果的评述中，科文总结道 ： “ 我觉得我才是赢得赌局的人。
en: In his evaluation of the outcome, Cowen concluded that, “I feel I’m the one who won the bet.”

zh: ”他们的赌注根本毫无意义可言。
en: Their wager had settled absolutely nothing.

zh: 不幸的是，这是人们就复杂争论进行简单下注的常见结果。
en: Unfortunately, that is what typically happens when people make simple bets on complex debates.

zh: 1980年，生物学家保罗·欧利希（Paul Ehrlich）和经济学家朱利安·西蒙（Julian Simon）进行了另一场著名的赌局 — — 十年后五种金属的价格。
en: In 1980, the biologist Paul Ehrlich and the economist Julian Simon made another famous wager – on the price of five metals ten years later.

zh: 最后西蒙赢得无可非议的胜利，但欧利希对结果嗤之以鼻。
en: Their bet ended with a clear win for Simon, but Ehrlich shrugged off the outcome as meaningless.

zh: 他也没有错。
en: And he was not wrong.

zh: 如果两位科学家选择不同的起始年份，那么欧利希很有可能成为胜利者。
en: If the two scientists had chosen a different starting year, Ehrlich might well have been the winner.

zh: 类似赌局的问题在于它们过于简单，无法评判其背后的复杂争论。
en: The problem with bets like these is that they are far too simple to settle the complex debates that underlie them.

zh: 几种金属的价格无法评判枝节横生的马尔萨斯对丰饶（Malthus vs. Cornucopia）的争论，正如一个简单的失业数据无法权威判定科文和卡普兰之间的争议。
en: A handful of metal prices cannot settle a sprawling Malthus vs. Cornucopia argument, just as a single data point for unemployment cannot be the final word in the dispute between Cowen and Caplan.

zh: 但彻底放弃赌局也不合理。
en: And yet it would be a shame to abandon bets altogether.

zh: 这样做只能让重要争论所针对的问题变成一片狼藉。
en: Doing so would leave only the squalid food fights into which so many important debates devolve.

zh: 解决办法是大幅提高赌局的严重性��扩展它们，让它们具备能够以让大部分理性观察者满意的程度评判争论的能力。
en: The solution is to take bets far more seriously, to expand them, and to design them to be capable of settling debates to the satisfaction of most reasonable observers.

zh: 在理想情况下，赌局应使用和它所要评判的争论一样大的问题。
en: Ideally, a bet would use a question as big as the debate it means to settle.

zh: 但这并不管用，因为大问题 — — “人口增长会超越资源，从而威胁到文明吗？ ” — —无法产生可容易地衡量的结果。
en: But that will not work, because big questions – “Will population growth outstrip resources and threaten civilization?” – do not produce easily measurable outcomes.

zh: 相反，关键在于提出许多精确的小问题。
en: The key, instead, is to ask many small, precise questions.

zh: 科文和卡普兰不应该仅仅依靠失业率一个数字；他们还应该纳入就业-人口比和其他他们一致认为具有诊断价值的指标。
en: Cowen and Caplan should not have relied on the unemployment rate alone; they should have included the employment-to-population ratio and other metrics they agreed would have diagnostic value.

zh: 欧利希应该扩大预测的范围，使之包括金属价格、粮食产量、空气质量和其他因素。
en: Ehrlich and Simon should have made a wider array of predictions, on metal prices, food production, air quality, and other factors.

zh: 使用问题组的方法可应用于几乎所有重要争论。
en: This approach, using question clusters, could be applied to virtually any important debate.

zh: 比如，最近我们正在把伊核协议的鹰派-鸽派争论作为预测检验的对象。
en: Right now, for example we are putting the hawks-versus-doves argument about the Iran nuclear deal to the forecasting test.

zh: 自然地，使用多重问题可能导致两可的决定。
en: Naturally, using many questions could result in split decisions.

zh: 但如果我们的目标是学习，那么这是利而不是弊。
en: But if our goal is to learn, that is a feature, not a bug.

zh: 两可的决定意味着所有下注者对现实的理解都不完全正确，事实介于两者之间。
en: A split decision would suggest that neither bettor’s understanding of reality is perfectly accurate and that the truth lies somewhere between.

zh: 这是一个富有启发性的结果，特别是在公共争论被极端立场所主导时 — — 欧利希和西蒙的赌局就是经典的例子。
en: That would be an enlightening result particularly when public debates are dominated by extreme positions – the clash between Ehrlich and Simon being a classic illustration.

zh: 当然，如果参与赌局者不愿共同思考如何评判他们的分歧，这一切都无从谈起。
en: Of course, none of this is possible if those involved are not willing to think together about how to settle their disagreement.

zh: 含蓄地讲，这并不总是很容易。
en: This is not always easy, to say the least.

zh: 在他们的著名赌局结束后，西蒙和欧利希曾考虑过进行第二次赌局，对象包括了范围甚广的一揽子指标；但这场赌局从未成行，部分是因为两人互不买账。
en: After their famous bet, Simon and Ehrlich considered a second bet involving a large basket of measures; but it never came about, partly because of personal antipathy between the two men.

zh: 我们需要一个中立方或仲裁者 — — （比如）智库就很适合这个角色。
en: What is needed is a neutral party and arbiter – a role that think tanks, for example, are well positioned to play.

zh: 但是，无论有什么困难，公共争论的质量都能从设计合理的赌局中获益良多。
en: But, whatever the difficulties, the quality of public debate stands to benefit enormously from well-structured wagers.

zh: 在学习了解世界方面，下注于结果总比什么都解决不了的争论强。
en: When it comes to learning about the world, betting on outcomes beats arguments that settle nothing.

zh: 赤字要比没命好吗？
en: Better Red than Dead?

zh: 全世界医疗费用的猛升会不会在某一天对现代资本主义构成重大挑战呢？
en: Will the inexorable rise in medical costs around the world someday pose a major challenge to contemporary capitalism?

zh: 我预计在不远的将来，当原本平均主义的医疗体系面临不断上升的费用之时，资本主义的道德、社会以及政治支持将会受到严重挑战。
en: I submit that in the not-so-distant future, moral, social, and political support for capitalism will be severely tested as would-be egalitarian health systems face ever-rising costs.

zh: 在美国，收入增加、人口老化以及延续生命和提高生命质量的新技术在几十年中让医疗费用上升超过总体收入3.5 % 。
en: Rising incomes, population aging, and new technologies for extending and enhancing life, have caused health costs to rise 3.5% faster than overall income for many decades now in the United States.

zh: 医疗费用已经占到美国经济的16 % 。 某些主要的经济学家估计，到2030年，医疗费用将会占国民生产总值的30 % ， 到本世纪末期有可能达到50 % 。
en: Some leading economists project that health expenditures, which already constitute 16% of the US economy, will rise to 30% of GDP by 2030, and perhaps approach 50% later in the century.

zh: 其他富有和中等收入国家尽管现在一般只花费美国的一半，也不会相差太远。
en: Other rich and middle-income countries, although typically spending only half what the US does today, won’t lag far behind.

zh: 欧洲以及其他地区国家通过借助美国的技术进步让它们的公民们免受部分上升之苦。
en: Countries in Europe and elsewhere have shielded their citizens from a part of this rise by piggybacking on US technological advances.

zh: 但是，它们最终还是面临费用上升的压力。
en: Ultimately, though, they face the same upward cost pressures.

zh: 二十一世纪伊始，随着中国原始资本主义给欧洲和其他地方更为柔和的制度施加压力，是否标志着其他所有意识形态的死亡呢？
en: Hasn’t the start of the twenty-first century marked the death of all other ideologies, with China’s raw capitalism putting pressure on gentler forms in Europe and elsewhere?

zh: 问题是对医疗的态度迥然不同。
en: The problem is that attitudes towards healthcare are fundamentally different.

zh: 许多社会把医疗视为一项权利，而非奢侈品。
en: Many societies view healthcare as a right, not a luxury.

zh: 当50年前医疗费用通常只占收入的一小部分的时候，以平均主义对待医疗是一个小小的奢侈。
en: When medical expenses constituted only a small percentage of income, as was typically the case 50 years ago, an egalitarian approach to healthcare was a small extravagance.

zh: 直接和间接的费用相对较小而且可以承受。
en: The direct and indirect costs were relatively minor and affordable.

zh: 但是，随着医疗费用占据国民收入的三分之一的时候，医疗社会主义开始成为赤裸裸的各取所需的马克思主义了。
en: But as health expenses start taking up a third of national income, healthcare socialism starts becoming just plain Marxism: to each according to his needs.

zh: 中国的农村人口缺医少药，最终将会揭竿而起。 其专制资本主义也会随之在某一天感到压力。
en: Even China’s authoritarian capitalism will someday feel the pressure, as its rural populations, who currently have little access to doctors or hospitals, eventually explode with discontent.

zh: 人们经常听说政府预算预计中医疗费用上升，在未来几年中，老年人的医疗费用预计将会控制政府的开支。
en: One often hears about rising healthcare costs in the context of future government budget projections, with old-age health costs expected to dominate growth in government expenditures in coming years.

zh: 但是如果仔细看一看美国国会预算办公室的预计就会发现，我们的社会老龄化只不过是问题的一部分，而且还不是较大的部分。
en: But a careful look at the projections by, say, the US Congressional Budget Office, show that the aging of our societies is only a part of the problem, and not the larger part.

zh: 真正的问题是各国社会是否愿意向老年人一视同仁地提供日新月异的医疗技术。
en: The real issue is whether societies are willing to provide elderly people with equal access to ever newer and improved medical techniques.

zh: 个人化医疗是一新近的变化。 这将会使得目前的摩擦加剧。
en: A change on the horizon that will exacerbate current frictions is the growing importance of individualized health care.

zh: 对于大多数现代社会而言，相对便宜的公共医疗预防措施，例如提供清洁饮水和固定的疫苗是推进寿命预期的主要因素。
en: For most of modern history, relatively inexpensive public health precautions, such as providing clean drinking water and routine vaccinations, have been the main factor pushing up life expectancy.

zh: 公共医疗手段已经超过了个人化护理的重要性。
en: Public health measures have trumped the importance of individual care.

zh: 但是如今，天平正在移动。
en: But today, the balance is shifting.

zh: 在许多富有国家，心脏手术已经是延长生命的一个主要因素。
en: Heart operations are already a major factor in extending life in many rich countries.

zh: 像CT扫描那样先进的X光诊断技术可以在可治疗阶段检查出许多癌症。
en: Sophisticated X-ray diagnostic techniques such as CT scans make it possible to detect many cancers at a treatable stage.

zh: 某些药品研究人员预计，随着对人类基因组理解不断加深，医生最终可以提前15年到20年预测疾病，并且立即开始预防疾病治疗。
en: Some drug researchers predict that with continuing advances in understanding the human genome, doctors may eventually be able to predict illnesses 15-20 years in advance, and begin prophylactic treatment immediately.

zh: (某些专家预计，到本世纪中叶，人一般可以活到110岁到115岁。 也许有人会思考这对于像婚姻那样的其他社会习俗产生什么影响，但是我以后再讨论这一问题。
en: (With some experts predicting that individuals will routinely live beyond 110-115 years by mid-century, one might wonder what all this will do to other social conventions such as marriage, but I will leave this thought to another day.)

zh: 除了减少死亡率，新的医疗技术还可以对生活质量产生巨大影响。
en: In addition to reducing mortality, new medical techniques can also have a huge effect on the quality of life.

zh: 美国每年进行大约25万个髋部更换手术。
en: Roughly 250,000 hip replacements are performed in the US each year.

zh: 随着更加新颖的人工关节证明有能力承受更为积极的生活方式，60岁不到的病人正在变得越发重要。
en: Under-60 patients are becoming more important as newer artificial joints prove their capacity to withstand more active lifestyles.

zh: 髋部更换手术的平均费用是6千美元，这只是七十年代中期流行电视片“身价六百万”中植入仿生胳膊、眼睛以及两条腿费用的十分之一。
en: At $6,000, the average cost of a hip replacement is only a thousandth the cost of what it supposedly took to implant a bionic arm, eye, and two legs on the fictional “The Six Million Dollar Man” in the popular mid-1970’s TV show.

zh: 当然，髋部更换病人并不会有超人的速度、力量和视力，至少目前还没有。
en: Of course, hip replacement patients don’t get super-human speed, strength, and vision – at least not yet.

zh: 如果环法自行车赛官员认为他们现在的麻烦是类固醇，那就再等五年再看吧。
en: If Tour de France officials think they have big problems now with steroids, just wait ten years.

zh: 原则上，更多地使用市场机制来分配医疗会减慢甚至暂时逆转医疗费用的上升。
en: In principle, greater use of market mechanisms to allocate health care can slow or even temporarily reverse the rise in healthcare costs.

zh: 但是改进的效率毕竟还有限度。
en: But improved efficiency has its limits.

zh: 最终，证据表明社会随着时间的推移在医疗上花费越来越多的收入部分。 随着各国变得富有，相对食品花费就会下降。
en: Ultimately, the evidence suggests that societies spend ever-larger fractions of their income on health over time, in contrast to food expenditures, for example, which fall as countries become wealthier.

zh: 花销的压力反过来导致创新的加速。
en: Spending pressures, in turn, lead to acceleration of innovation.

zh: 这就提高了全世界的福祉，但是却加剧了短期不平等和摩擦。
en: This raises long-term well being all around, but exacerbates short-term inequalities and frictions.

zh: 我并不是在反对医疗资本主义，而是在警告说，对此的支持将会变得脆弱，要比当今对于全球化的支持还要脆弱。
en: I am not arguing against healthcare capitalism, but warning that support will become fragile, far more so than for, say, globalization nowadays.

zh: 大多数国家过多地依赖于命令和控制，并且没有提供什么激励手段让病人和医疗单位做出高效的选择。
en: Most countries rely far too much on command and control, and provide far too few incentives for patients and providers to make efficient choices.

zh: 但是，医疗压力最终是否会让目前的自由(以及更为自由)的市场资本主义潮流逆转，而经济中的很大部分转向更为社会主义的体制，这还有待观察。
en: Nevertheless, it remains to be seen whether healthcare pressures will ultimately cause the current trend towards free (and freer) market capitalism to reverse, with a very large chunk of the economy reverting to a more socialist system.

zh: 某些社会或许会认为赤字要比没命好。
en: Some societies might decide that it is better to be red than dead.

zh: 改善巴塞尔
en: Better than Basel

zh: 罗马—巴塞尔协议本是为了保护储户和普罗大众免受银行不当行为的伤害，但也加重了2008年金融危机所触发的经济颓势。
en: ROME – The Basel Accords – meant to protect depositors and the public in general from bad banking practices – exacerbated the downward economic spiral triggered by the financial crisis of 2008.

zh: 在整个危机中，随着商业信心的蒸发，银行被迫出售资产、削减信贷，以维持巴塞尔协议规定的资本要求。
en: Throughout the crisis, as business confidence evaporated, banks were forced to sell assets and cut lending in order to maintain capital requirements stipulated by the Accords.

zh: 信贷冻结导致了GDP和就业率的暴跌，而资产大甩卖则造成了进一步的衰退。
en: This lending squeeze resulted in a sharp drop in GDP and employment, while the sharp sell-off in assets ensured further declines.

zh: 我和卡马西（Jacopo Carmassi）的最新研究《设置银行监管权正逢其时 》 （ Time to Set Banking Regulation Right）指出，巴塞尔银行规则允许大型国际银行使用过度杠杆、承担过多风险 — — 在某些案例中，银行可以累积相当于权益资本四五十倍之多的总负债 — — 这不但埋下了危机的种子，而且颇为讽刺地起到了火上加油之效。
en: My recent study with Jacopo Carmassi, Time to Set Banking Regulation Right, shows that by permitting excessive leverage and risk-taking by large international banks – in some cases allowing banks to accumulate total liabilities up to 40, or even 50, times their equity capital – the Basel banking rules not only enabled, but, ironically, intensified the crisis.

zh: 危机过去后，世界领导人和央行行长改善了银行监管，最主要的措施就是修订巴塞尔审慎规则。
en: After the crisis, world leaders and central bankers overhauled banking regulations, first and foremost by rectifying the Basel prudential rules.

zh: 不幸的是，新的巴塞尔III协议及其后的欧盟资本要求指令（EU Capital Requirements Directive）并没能纠正国际审慎规则的两大主要缺陷 — — 即对用银行风险管理模型计算资本要求的依赖以及对监督者缺乏可问责性。
en: Unfortunately, the new Basel III Accord and the ensuing EU Capital Requirements Directive have failed to correct the two main shortcomings of international prudential rules – namely, their reliance on banks’ risk-management models for the calculation of capital requirements, and the lack of supervisory accountability.

zh: 这一缺陷的最新写照是比利时-法国联营的德夏（Dexia）银行在2011年的倒闭 — — 彼时它刚刚胜利通过欧洲银监局的压力测试。
en: The latest example highlighting this flaw is Dexia, the Belgian-French banking group that failed in 2011 – just after passing the European Banking Authority’s stress test with flying colors.

zh: 银行的偿债能力比率透明度太低，这使得监管者干脆闭上双眼任由银行承担过度风险。
en: The stunning opacity of solvency ratios encouraged regulators to turn a blind eye to banks’ excessive risk-taking.

zh: 问题在于，巴塞尔资本规则 — — 不论是巴塞尔I、II还是III — — 都对识别疲软银行和坚挺银行毫无帮助。
en: The problem is that the Basel capital rules – whether Basel I, II, or III – are of no help in separating the weak banks from the sound ones.

zh: 事实上，在2008年金融危机中接受援助的银行中不乏偿债能力比率好于不需援助银行者。
en: Indeed, more often than not, the banks that failed or had to be rescued in the wake of the 2008 financial crisis had solvency ratios higher than those of banks that remained standing without assistance.

zh: 让问题更加复杂的是，银行资本比率的多样性也表明了国际竞争平台的重大扭曲 — — 金融市场的竞争条件越来越多地给予各国应用规则的自由裁量权。
en: Compounding the problem, the diversity in banks’ capital ratios also indicates a dramatic distortion of the international playing field, as increasingly competitive conditions in financial markets have led to national discretion in applying the rules.

zh: 与此同时，资本指标的不透明导致市场纪律无法起作用。
en: Meanwhile, the opacity of capital indicators has made market discipline impossible to impose.

zh: 于是，大银行可以继续持有过少的资本、承担过度的风险，增加金融不稳定性再次爆发的可能性。
en: Thus, large banks are likely to continue to hold too little capital and to take excessive risks, raising the prospect of renewed bouts of financial instability.

zh: 为了克服这些国际银行监管方面的缺陷，我们需要采取三大补救措施。
en: In order to overcome these shortcomings in international banking regulations, three remedies are needed.

zh: 首先，资本要求应该被设置为普通股对总资产的直观比率，从而避免参考银行自己的风险模型。
en: First, capital requirements should be set as a straightforward ratio of common equity to total assets, thereby abandoning all reference to banks’ own risk-management models.

zh: 新资本比率要求应该被设为总资产的7—10 % ， 以抑制银行家承担风险的冲动并将随银行系统信心缺失而来的大规模去杠杆化的实际经济冲击最小化。
en: The new capital ratio should be raised to 7-10% of total assets in order to dampen risk-taking by bankers and minimize the real economic impact of large-scale deleveraging following a loss of confidence in the banking system.

zh: 其次，新资本比率要求应设置多个递减的资本阈值，各阈值触发递增的严厉纠正动作，以此作为新的指令性监督行动系统。
en: Second, new capital ratios with multiple and decreasing capital thresholds, which trigger increasingly intrusive corrective action, should serve as the basis for a new system of mandated supervisory action.

zh: 监督者应受到他们将采取行动的假设的制约。
en: Supervisors should be bound by a presumption that they will act.

zh: 他们可以争辩说在某具体案例中必须要采取行动，但必须公开作如是论，从而为他们的不作为负责。
en: They could argue that action is not necessary in a specific case, but they would have to do so publicly, thus becoming accountable for their inaction.

zh: 为了根除道德风险，新系统必须有一个在银行资本不能满足最低阈值时将其关闭的方案程序。
en: In order to eradicate moral hazard, the system must have a resolution procedure to close banks when their capital falls below a minimum threshold.

zh: 最后，偿债能力比率应该有所补充 — — 通过让银行承担发行大量无抵押可转换债务（100%由其自有资本做支持）的义务来实现。
en: Finally, solvency rules should be complemented by an obligation that banks issue a substantial amount of non-collateralized debt – on the order of 100% of their capital – that is convertible into equity.

zh: 这笔信用债的设计应该为银行管理者和股东提供极大的发行股票而不是接受债转股的激励。
en: These debentures should be designed to create a strong incentive for bank managers and shareholders to issue equity rather than suffer conversion.

zh: 这三项措施如能对所有银行适用，将能消除出台治理流动性和融资的特别规则的需要（将受监督者审查，但没有强制性约束 ） ， 对银行活动和经营的特别限制也将失去必要性。
en: These three measures, if applied to all banks, would eliminate the need for special rules governing liquidity or funding (which would remain open to supervisory review, but not to binding constraints). There would also be no need for special restrictions on banking activities and operations.

zh: 目前，审慎银行规则的政策考虑的最显著特征是委托巴塞尔银行监督委员会和银行本身来制定规则，这两者都是现行系统的既得利益者。
en: The most remarkable feature of the policy deliberations on prudential banking rules so far has been their delegation to the Basel Committee of Banking Supervisors and the banks themselves, both of which have a vested interest in preserving the existing system.

zh: 各国政府和议会有义务对巴塞尔规则予以彻底审视，要求他们做出与公共利益一致的修订。
en: Governments and parliaments have an obligation to launch a thorough review of the Basel rules, and to demand revisions that align them with the public interest.

zh: 下注房产
en: Betting the House

zh: 全世界的私房拥有者都乐此不疲地加入到房价的赌博当中。
en: Homeowners around the world effectively gamble on home prices.

zh: 由于伦敦、巴黎、马德里、罗马、伊斯坦布尔、莫斯科、上海、杭州、悉尼、墨尔本、温哥华、洛杉矶、拉斯维加斯、波士顿、纽约、华盛顿特区和迈阿密等魅力都市都存在房地产泡沫，所以这场赌博的风险很大。
en: Their risks today are often big due to real estate bubbles in such glamour cities as London, Paris, Madrid, Rome, Istanbul, Moscow, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Sydney, Melbourne, Vancouver, Los Angeles, Las Vegas, Boston, New York, Washington, D.C., and Miami. Those bubbles may keep expanding, or may burst, leaving many homeowners mired in debt.

zh: 经历了泡沫之后的房价风险是实实在在的。
en: The risk to home prices in the aftermath of a bubble is real and substantial.

zh: 在上一轮的房地产泡沫破裂之后，伦敦的实际房价（折算通胀后的）在1988-95年间下跌了46 % ， 洛杉矶在1989-97年间下跌了41 % ， 巴黎在1991-98年间房价跌幅为43 % ， 莫斯科在1993-97年间跌幅为67 % ， 上海在1995-99年间的跌幅为38 % 。
en: In the last cycle of real estate busts, real (inflation-corrected) home prices fell 46% in London in 1988-95, 41% in Los Angeles in 1989-1997, 43% in Paris in 1991-98, 67% in Moscow in 1993-97, and 38% in Shanghai in 1995-1999.

zh: 所有的下跌最终都有所反弹，而最近房地产市场在上述地区又进入了繁荣期。
en: All of these drops were eventually reversed, and all of these markets have boomed recently.

zh: 但这并不能保证未来的房价下跌会带来同样的后果。
en: But this does not guarantee that future drops will have a similar outcome.

zh: 相反，从根本上讲，我们房产的未来真正价值还是未知数。
en: On the contrary, the future real value of our homes is fundamentally uncertain.

zh: 大多数的私房拥有者参与房价赌博并不是为了娱乐。
en: Most homeowners are not gambling for pleasure.

zh: 他们购置不动产时出于实际的需要。
en: They are just buying real estate because they need it.

zh: 然而，由于他们没有采取任何防范不动产价格风险的措施来保护自己，因而他们又是不自知的赌博者。
en: But, because they do nothing to protect themselves against their real estate price risks, they are unwitting gamblers.

zh: 实际上，大多数国家的购房者都没有采取任何的自我保护措施—除了出售他们的房产以外—因为他们无计可施。
en: In fact, home buyers in most countries do nothing to protect themselves – short of selling their homes – because there is nothing to be done.

zh: 能够平衡这些风险的不动产衍生品市场也仅仅是雏形初现。
en: A market for real estate derivatives that can help balance these risks is only just beginning to appear.

zh: 高度发达的不动产衍生品市场能够让私房拥有者放弃赌博的习惯。
en: Well-developed markets for real estate derivatives would allow homeowners to kick the gambling habit.

zh: 一个基于城市房价指数的有流动性、以现金结算的期货市场可以让当地的私房所有者通过在期货市场上的售出而保护自己。
en: A liquid, cash-settled futures market that is based on an index of home prices in a city would enable a homeowner living there to sell in a futures market to protect himself.

zh: 如果该城市的房价大幅下跌，房产价值的跌损会由期货合同价值的上升来抵销。
en: If home prices fall sharply in that city, the drop in the value of the home would be offset by an increase in the value of the futures contract.

zh: 这就是为金融专业人士们所熟知的高级风险管理。
en: That is how advanced risk management works, as financial professionals know.

zh: 但用于规避这些风险的工具应该能被所有人利用。
en: But the tools needed to hedge such risks should be made available to everyone.

zh: 建立不动产衍生品市场的努力迄今为止也只取得了有限的成功。
en: Attempts to set up derivatives markets for real estate have -- so far -- all met with only limited success.

zh: 高盛公司于2003年5月开始在英国推出针对房价的现金备兑认股权证（cash-settled covered warrants ） 。 这一产品是基于“Halifax房价指数”开发的，并在伦敦股票交易所进行交易。
en: In May 2003, Goldman, Sachs & Co. began offering cash-settled covered warrants on house prices in the United Kingdom, based on the Halifax House Price Index and traded on the London Stock Exchange.

zh: 在2004年10月，Hedgestreet.com开始提供针对美国城市不动产价格的“hedgelets ” — 一种当基于“OFHEO房价指数”的房价增长率达到某一既定幅度时就会赔付的合同。
en: In October 2004, Hedgestreet.com began offering “hedgelets” on real estate prices in US cities – contracts that pay out if the rate of increase in home prices based on the OFHEO Home Price Index falls within a pre-specified range.

zh: 我从前的学生Allan Weiss和我自1999年以来就一直在为建立更好的不动产风险管理机构而奔波。
en: My former student Allan Weiss and I have been campaigning since 1990 for better risk management institutions for real estate.

zh: 在1999年，我们共同创建了一家名为Macro Securities Research, LLC的公司旨在促进这些机构的发展。 我们与美国证券交易所（American Stock Exchange）合作开发能够让人们管理不动产和其他风险的有价证券品种。
en: In 1999, we co-founded a firm, Macro Securities Research, LLC, to promote the development of such institutions, working with the American Stock Exchange to create securities that would allow people to manage real estate as well as other risks.

zh: 这些长期证券和股票一样定期派发红利。 它们的价值与某种不动产价格指数成正负关联的关系。
en: These will be long-term securities that pay regular dividends, like stocks, whose value is tied – either positively or negatively ­– to a real estate price index.

zh: 本月早些时候，芝加哥商品交易所也宣布将与我们合作开发基于美国都市区房产价格的期货市场。
en: Early this month, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange announced that it will also work with us to explore the development of futures markets in US metropolitan-area home prices.

zh: 我们也希望能够为其他国家创建这样的市场助一臂之力。
en: We hope to facilitate the creation of such markets in other countries as well.

zh: 由于即使是许多具备金融知识的私房拥有者也会对直接参与衍生品市场望而生畏，所以开发不动产风险管理的下一步将会是创造合适的零售产品。
en: Because even many financially sophisticated homeowners will find direct participation in derivative markets too daunting, the next stage in the development of real estate risk management will be to create suitable retail products.

zh: 例如，衍生品市场应该营造一种环境，鼓励保险公司开发房产股票保险。 该险种不但对投保人进行破产保险，也针对房产市场价值的下跌提供保险。
en: For example, the derivative markets should create an environment that encourages insurers to develop home equity insurance, which insures homeowners not just against a bust but also against drops in the market value of the home.

zh: 如果将这样的险种作为已有险种的附加险，那么它们对于私房拥有者应该是颇具吸引力的。
en: Such insurance ­should be attractive to homeowners if it is offered as an add-on to their existing insurance policies.

zh: 不动产衍生品市场也应该为创建旨在帮助私房所有者管理风险的按揭贷款方式提供便利。 这种贷款方式能在房产价值下跌时让按揭人减少欠款。
en: Derivatives markets for real estate should also facilitate the creation of mortgage loans that help homeowners manage risks by, say, reducing the amount owed if a home’s value drops.

zh: 这样的产品在按揭最初被核准时对购房者应该是有吸���力的。
en: Such products should appeal to homebuyers when the mortgage is first issued.

zh: 保险公司和按揭贷款公司如果能在具有流动性的衍生品市场上规避房价风险，那么它们应该愿意提供这样的产品。
en: Insurance companies and mortgage companies ought to be willing to offer such products if they can hedge the home-price risks in liquid derivative markets.

zh: 开发这样的零售产品需要时间、尝试和一些真正的创新。
en: Creating these retail products will require time, experimentation, and some real innovation.

zh: 在未来十年，我们可能会期望有更广泛的保险、贷款和证券公司加入这一行列。
en: Over the next decade, we might expect that a broad spectrum of insurance, lending, and securities companies will become involved.

zh: 随着这些零售产品开始成形，它们会刺激衍生品市场的发展。
en: As these retail products start to take shape, they will spur increased activity in the derivative markets.

zh: 在新的风险管理业发展过程当中，其不同门类之间也会相辅相成。
en: As the new risk-management industry develops, its components will gradually boost each other.

zh: 这些新发展让现在和未来的私房拥有者们看到了从对不动产市场起起落落的担忧中解脱出来的希望。
en: These developments offer hope that current and future homeowners will be spared the agony of worrying about the vicissitudes of the real estate market.

zh: 他们将能把买卖不动产的游戏交给专业人士打理而安享自己从房产中所聚敛的价值。
en: They will be able to leave the game of real estate speculation to professionals and rest assured about the value that they have accumulated in their homes.

zh: 这是个好消息，因为我们极有可能在未来几年见证全球一些城市房价的大幅下跌。 这样的跌幅会给许多私房拥有者造成真正的痛苦。
en: That is good news, because there is a pretty strong chance that we are going to see major price declines in a number of cities around the globe in the next few years, and these price declines will cause real pain to many homeowners.

zh: 但如果更好的风险管理以现有态势继续发展，这就会是房屋所有者无法保护自己的最后一个不动产市场循环。
en: But if the momentum toward better risk management continues, it will be the last real estate cycle in which homeowners are unable to protect themselves.

zh: 举债豪赌
en: Betting With the House’s Money

zh: 许多人都在问为何美元还没有崩溃。
en: Many people have been asking why the dollar hasn’t crashed yet.

zh: 美国会为十数年以来那一连串巨大的贸易逆差买单吗？
en: Will the United States ever face a bill for the string of massive trade deficits that it has been running for more than a decade?

zh: 加上过往的逆差所产生的利息，仅2006年的账单就超过8000亿美金—约为美国国民生产总值的6.5 % 。
en: Including interest payments on past deficits, the tab for 2006 alone was over $800 billion dollars – roughly 6.5% of US gross national product.

zh: 更令人吃惊的是，美国的负债相当于包括中国、日本、德国和欧佩克国家等在内的所有贸易顺差国家储蓄总余额的三分之二强。
en: Even more staggeringly, US borrowing now soaks up more than two-thirds of the combined excess savings of all the surplus countries in the world, including China, Japan, Germany, and the OPEC states.

zh: 外国人在美国的投资罕有丰厚回报。
en: Foreigners are hardly reaping great returns on investing in the US.

zh: 正相反，他们所获得的回报通常比投资国外的美国人所得要低得多。
en: On the contrary, they typically get significantly lower returns than Americans get on their investments abroad.

zh: 在这个股价和房价疯长的时代，日本和中国的央行正掌握着价值两兆美金的低息债券。
en: In an era in which stock and housing prices are soaring, the central banks of Japan and China are holding almost two trillion dollars worth of low-interest bonds.

zh: 其中大部分是美国国库券和抵押贷款。
en: A very large share of these are US treasury bonds and mortgages.

zh: 这项对美国纳税人的巨额补贴，在很多方面堪称世界上最大规模的外国援助项目。
en: This enormous subsidy to American taxpayers is, in many ways, the world’s largest foreign aid program.

zh: 如果美国的竞争优势如此虚弱，那么又是什么魔力在支持美元呢？
en: If America’s competitive position is so weak, what magic is holding up the dollar?

zh: 大多数头脑清楚的分析家都一直预测着美元相对其贸易伙伴国货币的稳定贬值趋势，特别是相对于亚洲和新兴市场国家的货币。
en: Most sober analysts have long been projecting a steady trend decline in the dollar against the currencies of America’s trading partners, especially in Asia and emerging markets.

zh: 那么，为什么还没有出现更多的调整呢？
en: So why hasn’t more adjustment taken place already?

zh: 当然，第一个答案就是贸易加权的美元已经贬值—自其高峰的2002年初以来已实际贬值15 % 。
en: The first answer, of course, is that the trade-weighted dollar has fallen – by more than 15% in real terms since its peak in early 2002.

zh: 然而，美国的赤字仍然居高不下，甚至自那时起还有所上升。
en: Yet the US deficits have persisted, and even risen, since then.

zh: 真正的驱动因素有两层。
en: The real driving force has been two-fold.

zh: 第一层，也是最重要的，是美国政府和消费者已经陷入了一场从不停歇的消费狂潮。
en: First and foremost, America’s government and consumers have been engaged in a never-ending consumption binge.

zh: 在消费者方面，这是不难理解的。
en: On the consumer side, this is quite understandable.

zh: 随着置业率超过80 % ， 房价在过去十年里的历史性成长的事实已经广泛深入美国中产阶级。
en: With over 80% home ownership, the epic boom in housing prices of the last ten years has spread deep into the American middle class.

zh: 虽然股权更为集中化，但许多美国中产阶级仍然从他们的养老金中间接获益。
en: Equity holdings are somewhat more concentrated, but many middle class Americans have still benefited indirectly through their pension funds.

zh: 总体上看，经过了近25年令人难以置信的繁荣（其间只被两次轻微的经济衰退打断 ） ， 大多数美国人对他们的经济情况充满信心。
en: Overall, after almost 25 years of stunning prosperity, punctuated by only two mild recessions, most Americans feel pretty confident about their economic situation.

zh: 失业率处在周期性的低点，经济情况也比现代历史上的任何时候都要稳定。
en: Unemployment is at a cyclical low, and the economy appears to be less volatile than at any point in modern history.

zh: 所以即便是在美国经济增长渐入低速期时，私人消费仍然旺盛的情况也就不足为奇了。
en: So it is not surprising that private consumption continues to hold up even as US economic growth has shifted into lower gear.

zh: 人们在过去十几年来享受了如此丰厚的资本收益，以至于他们似乎感觉像只赢不陪的赌徒。
en: People have enjoyed such huge capital gains over the past decade that most feel like gamblers on a long winning streak.

zh: 现在，他们认为自己是在用赌场（或“他们”赌场）的钱赌博。
en: By now, they see themselves as playing with the house’s (or their houses’) money.

zh: 要明白为什么美国政府在周期性经济繁荣的情况下依然继续保持预算赤字就不那么容易了。
en: It is less easy to rationalize why the US government is continuing to run budget deficits despite a cyclical boom.

zh: 当一个财政上负责的政府发动战争时，它通常会缩减国内支出，并提高税收。
en: When a fiscally responsible government launches a war, it typically cuts back on other domestic expenditures and raises taxes.

zh: 而布什政府却反其道而行之。
en: The Bush administration did the opposite.

zh: 这可能不是好的经济学手段，但在一定时期内却是一项不错的政治战略。
en: It may not be good economics, but the strategy proved to be good politics, for a time.

zh: 不幸的是，新的民主党主导的国会似乎对此不以为然。
en: Unfortunately, it is unlikely the new Democratic majority in Congress will do much about it.

zh: 当然，孤掌难鸣。
en: Of course, it takes two to tango.

zh: 为了让美国经济在世界上带赤字运行，其它国家必须愿意提供能自动抵销的等量储蓄。
en: In order for the US economy to run deficits with the world, other countries must be willing to spin off a counterbalancing supply of savings.

zh: 美联储主席Ben Bernanke的一句名言曾将美国全部的经常账目赤字归罪于“全球性的储蓄过剩 ” 。
en: Ben Bernanke, the US Federal Reserve chairman, once famously pinned the whole US current account deficit on a “global savings glut.”

zh: 但更为准确的说法是全球投资不足，虽然全球经济增长趋向放慢，但投资却趋向提升。
en: But it would be more accurate to say that there is global investment shortfall, with investment trending downwards despite the upward trend in global growth.

zh: 造成这种投资不足的因素有很多，但可能最主要的一点是在向许多发展中国家投资的过程中有不少中期的制度性障碍。 在这些国家里现在似乎长期投资的回报最高。
en: This investment shortfall is due to many factors, but perhaps the main one is that there are substantial medium-term institutional roadblocks to investment in many developing countries, where long-term returns now seem to be by far the highest.

zh: 其直接的结果就是资金被暂时停泊在低投资回报率的美国，虽然这不会是一个长期趋势。
en: The net result is that money is being parked temporarily in low-yield investments in the US, although this cannot be the long-run trend.

zh: 那么，美元的未来趋��如何？
en: What then is future of the dollar?

zh: 只要现在的情况持续下去，再加上强劲的全球经济增长和惊人的宏观经济稳定性，美国就能够继续举债并维持贸易赤字而不会马上遭遇后果。
en: As long as the status quo persists, with strong global growth and stunning macroeconomic stability, the US can continue to borrow and run trade deficits without immediate consequence.

zh: 随着时间的推移，美元仍会贬值，但幅度可能不会大于每年两个百分点。
en: Over time, the dollar will still decline, but perhaps by no more than a couple of percent per year.

zh: 但不论如何也不难想象美元崩溃的情景。
en: Nevertheless, it is not hard to imagine scenarios in which the dollar collapses.

zh: 恐怖主义、中国经济增长放缓、或中东暴力冲突的突然升级都可能完全破坏现有的经济局面。
en: Nuclear terrorism, a slowdown in China, or a sharp escalation of violence in the Middle East could all blow the lid off the current economic dynamic.

zh: 从原则上讲，我们也可以想象美元升值的情况。 但总体上看，这不大可能出现。
en: In principle, one can also think of scenarios in which the dollar shoots up, but overall these seem less likely.

zh: 总而言之，美国贸易平衡多年以来逆风运行的情况，也同样可能发生在美元上。
en: In sum, the fact that the US trade balance has defied gravity for so many years has made it possible for the dollar to do so, too.

zh: 但总有一天，美国还是得要节俭度日。
en: But some day, the US may well have to pay the bill for its spendthrift ways.

zh: 当那一天到来时，美国人最好祈祷他们的债主们还会像今天一样乐于接受美元。
en: When that day arrives, Americans had better pray that their creditors will be as happy to accept dollars as they are now.

zh: 谨防俄罗斯笑里藏刀
en: Beware of Smiling Bears

zh: 华沙 — —
en: WARSAW – Remember the Partnership and Cooperation Agreement (PCA), aimed at enshrining “commonly-shared values” between Russia and the European Community? Signed in 1994 during the hopeful early days of Russia’s first-ever democracy, the PCA was bolstered in 1999 by the creation of the European Union’s Common Security Defense Policy (CSDP).

zh: 还记得旨在发扬俄罗斯与欧共体“共同价值”的《伙伴关系与合作协定 》 （ Partnership and Cooperation Agreement，PCA）吗？
en: Both sides often refer to this desire to forge closer relations as a “strategic partnership.”

zh: 该协定签订于1994年，彼时俄国刚刚进入民主社会，充满着希望。 1999年，PCA因欧盟共同安全和防务政策（Common Security Defense Policy，CSDP）的建立而得到进一步强化。
en: But as French President Nicolas Sarkozy and German Chancellor Angela Merkel meet Russian President Dmitri Medvedev in Deauville, it would be wise to recognize that the Kremlin appears to be changing the terms of this nascent relationship.

zh: 缔约双方都意欲打造更加紧密的“战略合作伙伴”关系。 但从法国总统萨科齐和德国总理默克尔与俄罗斯总统梅德韦杰夫在多维尔（Deauville）的会面中不难看出，俄罗斯对于这一诞生没多久的关系已经发生了态度转变。
en: In the wake of Russia’s apparent departure from democratization during Vladimir Putin’s presidency, and of the wars in Chechnya and Georgia, the EU has adopted increasingly cautious language, sounding less optimistic about the prospects of a real partnership.

zh: 在普京总统任期内，俄罗斯发生了明显的去民主化，对车臣和格鲁吉亚战火连连，这使得欧盟对俄罗斯的态度越来越谨慎，对双方实质关系的前景也不再像以前那样乐观。
en: Thus, the European Security Strategy, adopted in 2004, says only that, “we should continue to work for closer relations with Russia, a major factor in our security and prosperity. Respect for common values will reinforce progress towards a strategic partnership.”

zh: 因此，2004年生效的欧洲安全战略（European Security Strategy）仅仅提到“我们就应该继续致力于加强与俄罗斯的紧密关系，这是关系到我们安全与繁荣的一大重要因素。 尊重共同价值有利于促使双方缔结战略合作伙伴关系。
en: Russia’s August 2008 invasion of Georgia produced a sterner variation: “No strategic partnership is possible if the values of democracy, respect for human rights, and the rule of law are not fully shared and respected.”

zh: 俄罗斯在2008年8月对格鲁吉亚出兵使形势急转直下。
en: Russians, meanwhile, are struggling to reconcile their disparate views on Europe. Some profess to be “sick and tired of dealing with Brussels bureaucrats.”

zh: “如果民主的价值、人权的尊重、法治的精神不能得到完全的承认和尊重，就不可能建立任何战略合作伙伴关系。 ”
en: As Konstantin Kosachev, chairman of the Russian Duma’s foreign relations committee, put it, “In Germany, Italy, France, we can achieve much more.”

zh: 而俄罗斯则忙于调和自己与欧洲迥异的价值观。
