zh: 种系基因编辑根据国际法是不允许的：欧洲人权和生物医学公约（尽管英国不是签署国）和联合国教科文组织的人类基因组和人权世界宣言都禁止这种行为。
en: Germline gene editing is not approved under international law: both the Council of Europe’s Convention on Human Rights and Biomedicine (although the UK is not a signatory) and UNESCO’s Universal Declaration on the Human Genome and Human Rights prohibit the practice.

zh: 此外，绝大多数曾经考虑过将其合法化的国家，最终都完全拒绝了这一概念，也没有计划改变立场。
en: Moreover, the overwhelming majority of countries that have ever considered legalizing it have eventually rejected the idea outright and have no plans to change their position.

zh: 只有英国快要改变立场。
en: Only the UK has come close.

zh: 2015年，英国立法者批准了一种叫做“线粒体捐赠”的种系转基因 — — 通常也称为“三亲”体外受精（IVF ） 。
en: In 2015, British lawmakers approved a form of germline modification known as “mitochondrial donation” – commonly referred to as “three-parent” in vitro fertilization (IVF).

zh: 消除未来子孙后代体内因基因造成的问题也许是一个好目标，特别是对于有家族病史的夫妇来说。
en: Eliminating genetically caused conditions in future children might seem a welcome goal, particularly to couples with a family history of such diseases.

zh: 但是，我们已经拥有了可以阻止患儿出生的胚胎技术 — — 如“植入前基因诊断 ” 。
en: However, we already have techniques – such as “preimplantation genetic diagnosis” of embryos – which can prevent affected children from being born.

zh: 种系基因编辑能够做到的也不过如此：它无法治愈疾病或拯救生命。
en: That is all germline genetic editing can do: it cannot cure disease or save lives.

zh: 为了获得这些有限的好处，我们必须承受“不相干编辑”等重大风险。
en: Against these limited benefits, we must weigh major risks such as “off-target edits.”

zh: 一些观察者将种系基因编辑与电脑中的“查找和全部替换”相提并论。
en: Some observers have likened germline genetic editing to hitting “find and replace all” on a computer.

zh: 但我们不仅不具备认识所有未来风险情景的能力；也没有“撤销”键。
en: Yet not only do we lack an understanding of all future risk scenarios; there is no “undo” button.

zh: 我们将子孙后代绑定在了我们不完全的知识状态上。
en: We are binding future generations to our own state of incomplete knowledge.

zh: 我并不是唯一表达这些观点的人。
en: I am not alone in expressing these views.

zh: 2017年12月，皇家学会就基因测序和基因组编辑问题发布了一份公众态度调查。
en: In December 2017, the Royal Society published a survey of public attitudes toward DNA sequencing and genome editing.

zh: 总体而言，受访者支持治疗有生命危险的疾病的流程，但许多人坚持要求，基因组编辑必须在所有可行选项都已经尝试无用之后才能尝试。
en: While respondents were generally supportive of procedures for the treatment of life-threatening illnesses, many were adamant that every available option should be exhausted before genome editing was tried.

zh: 人们还质疑基因技术将如何影响社会不平等以及各国如何阻止“公司型垄断”的出现。
en: People also wondered how genetic technologies might affect social inequality and how countries would guard against the emergence of “corporate-type monopolies.”

zh: 和此前的一些基因编辑类型不同，新CRISPR技术相对便宜，如果当前的禁令放松，生物科技企业有可能会竞相填补市场。
en: The new CRISPR technique, unlike some previous types of gene editing, is relatively cheap, and if current bans were relaxed, biotechnology firms would likely rush to fill the market.

zh: 类似的“使命渐变”和商业化促使美国食品药品监督局谴责美国达尔文生命公司（Darwin Life）将其三人IVF技术用于范围更大的年龄导致不孕不育市场。
en: Similar “mission creep” and commercialization prompted the US Food and Drug Administration to reprimand the American company Darwin Life for promoting its three-person IVF techniques for the much wider market of age-related infertility.

zh: 事实上，如果英国不保持谨慎的话，基因编辑可能会走上整容外科之路。
en: In fact, if the UK is not careful, gene editing could follow the trajectory of cosmetic surgery.

zh: 整容外科一开始是为了真正的医学需要而发展 — — 如为伤兵实施再造术 — — 但最后演变为一个规模数十亿美元的基本不受监管的行业。
en: First developed for genuine medical needs – such as reconstructive surgery for wounded soldiers – it has morphed into a largely unregulated business worth billions.

zh: 尽管纳菲尔德报告并未明确建议放松英国监管体系，但也没有充分解决消费者选择、区间官话和商业化的压力。
en: Although the Nuffield Report does not explicitly recommend relaxing the UK regulatory system, it does not adequately address the pressures toward consumer choice, deregulation, and commercialization.

zh: 文化压力已在促使人们支持对子孙后代做一些特别的安排；比如，在美国，卵子市场买家可以选择身高、发色和智商。
en: Cultural pressure is already pushing people to favor particular traits in their offspring; in the United States, for example, buyers in the market for human eggs can shop for height, hair color, and intelligence.

zh: 我们甚至看到出现了“基因富裕”和“基因匮乏”群体：尽管CRISPR本身是一项低成本方法，但它要求女性经历复杂、昂贵、有时十分危险的IVF流程。
en: We could even see the rise of “gene-rich” and “gene-poor” populations: although CRISPR itself is a low-cost method, it requires women to undergo the complex, expensive, and sometimes risky procedures of IVF.

zh: 为了论证自己的建议，纳菲尔德报告的作者们提出了两条最高原则，作为基因编辑的指南。
en: To justify its recommendations, the authors of the Nuffield report suggested two overarching principles that should guide the use of genetic editing.

zh: 首先，基因组编辑必须“旨在确保 — — 并符合 — — 因此而出生的人的福利。
en: First, genome editing must be “intended to secure, and [be] consistent with, the welfare of a person who may be born as a consequence.”

zh: ”但没人提出应该允许有害种系基因干预。
en: But no one is suggesting that harmful germline genetic interventions should be permitted.

zh: 第二项原则 — — 编辑“不应产生或加剧社会分歧，或让社会中的某些群体边缘化或弱势化 ” — —平心而论确实将争论范围扩大到了个体父母的选择之外。
en: The second principle – that editing “should not produce or exacerbate social division, or marginalize or disadvantage groups in society” – does, in fairness, move the debate beyond the choice of individual parents.

zh: 但报告也基本没有提出解决方案，也不承认治疗和增强应用之间的组别，这意味着这些技术有可能被滥用于整形目的。
en: But, again, the report offers little in the way of solutions, and it largely rejects the distinction between therapeutic and enhancement applications, which leaves open the possibility that such technologies could be misused for cosmetic purposes.

zh: 几十年来，国际社会基本遵守了1997年通过的联合国教科文组织宣言，2015年，该宣言又增加了内容，所有国家“都应该杜绝独自开展”种系基因疗法的可能。
en: For decades, the international community has largely adhered to the UNESCO declaration, adopted in 1997, which was updated in 2015 with the injunction that all countries “should renounce the possibility of going it alone” on germline gene therapy.

zh: 但纳菲尔德报告允许英国政府这样做。
en: But the Nuffield Report allows the UK to do just that.

zh: 尽管报告对国际合作这一方向持首肯态度，但它违反了国际共识，增加了不可逆转的基因改变风险和新的不平等形式。
en: Although the report nods in the direction of international cooperation, it breaches an international consensus in a way that increases the risks of irreversible genetic alterations and new forms of inequality.

zh: 打击耐药性的伦理学
en: The Ethics of Fighting Drug Resistance

zh: 哥德堡—2014年，世界卫生组织报告，耐药性 — — 特别是抗生素耐药性 — — 正在日益成为人类健康、食品安全和“现代医学成就”的威胁。
en: GOTHENBURG – In 2014, the World Health Organization reported that drug resistance – especially resistance to antibiotics – is a growing threat to human health, food security, and “the achievements of modern medicine.”

zh: 这绝不是“末日幻想 ， ” 世卫组织说，反之，后抗生素时代“是二十一世纪的一个非常切实的可能。 ”
en: Far from being an “apocalyptic fantasy,” the WHO said, a post-antibiotic era “is instead a very real possibility for the twenty-first century.”

zh: 耐药性威胁着越来越多传染病的有效治疗 — — 如细菌感染到病毒和真菌性疾病。
en: Drug resistance threatens the effective treatment of a growing list of communicable diseases – from bacterial infections to viral to and fungal diseases.

zh: 当人们乱用抗生素来治疗普通感冒时，当农民用抗生素来提高牲畜产量时，当制药公司将抗生素排入环境来降低生产成本时，本来应该被药品杀死的细菌就会获得免疫力。
en: When people recklessly use antibiotics to fight a common cold, when farmers use antibiotics to boost livestock productivity, or when pharmacological factories emit antibiotics into the environment to cut production costs, the bacteria that the drugs are designed to kill become immune.

zh: 抗生素被使用和排放得越多，耐药性就发展得越快，导致产生“超级病菌 ” ， 威胁人类健康 — — 既提高了大面积致死传染病的风险，也让外科手术和癌症治疗等依靠有效抗生素的医疗服务效果打折。
en: The more antibiotics consumed and emitted, the faster resistance develops, leading to “superbugs” that jeopardize human health, both by raising the risk of massive deadly epidemics and by compromising medical services, such as surgery and cancer treatment, that rely on effective antibiotics.

zh: 这一令人恐怖的现实令卫生专家束手无策。
en: This scary reality continues to frustrate health-care professionals.

zh: 平心而论，对于耐药性危机有一些解决办法：限制抗生素使用、改善诊断和疾病监控、加强新药的临床开发就是其中之三。
en: To be sure, there are solutions to the drug resistance crisis: restricted consumption, better diagnostics and disease surveillance, and expanded clinical development of new drugs are three.

zh: 一些初步的协调行动也已经被纳入世卫组织全球行动计划。
en: And some initial coordinated action has been taken in the WHO global action plan.

zh: 但每一种办法都存在伦理因素，而在世卫组织的评估报告做出四年之后，解决这一医学紧急情况的伦理路线图仍然模糊不清，这非常危险。
en: But every fix has an ethical component, and four years after the WHO’s assessment, the ethical roadmap for addressing this medical emergency remains dangerously ill-defined.

zh: 着眼于长期目标的卫生政策常常会产生短期的人类、动物和环境福利成本。
en: Health-care policies that pursue long-term goals often have short-term costs for human, animal, and environmental wellbeing.

zh: 比如，限制某些群体使用抗生素可能导致多病者丢掉工作。
en: For example, restricting antibiotic consumption in certain populations could lead to job losses for those prone to illness.

zh: 防治传染病的行动也有可能侵犯个人隐私，因为流行病学家要识别并追踪耐药细菌携带者。
en: Actions taken to prevent infections may also infringe on personal privacy, as epidemiologists seek to identify and track people who carry resistant bacteria.

zh: 防控措施甚至有可能需要抑制个体自由，如阻止他们去医院或上飞机。
en: Controls may even require curbing individual freedoms, like accessing hospitals or getting on airplanes.

zh: 此外，限制抗生素的使用可能推高药价，威胁到需要药品的人。
en: Moreover, capping antibiotic use could lead to higher drug prices, threatening access for those who need the medication.

zh: 此外，尽管许多人可能偏好于现状方针 — — 保持当前的使用状况，同时加快新抗生素的开发，但这个办法也有自己的伦理考虑 — — 比如如何和何时缩短临床试验长度。
en: And, while many people might prefer a status quo approach that speeds up the development of new antibiotics while leaving current consumption unchanged, this solution brings its own set of ethical considerations – such as how and when to reduce the length of clinical trials.

zh: 出于所有这些原因，伦理学家、卫生研究者和社会科学家开始考察如何最好地确保应对耐药性的策略具有伦理合理性。
en: For all of these reasons, ethicists, health-care researchers, and social scientists have begun to examine how best to ensure that strategies for tackling drug resistance are ethically responsible.

zh: 2015年，即世卫组织发布报告的一年后 ， 《 公共卫生伦理学 》 （ Public Health Ethics）杂志发行了一期关于这一话题的专刊。
en: In 2015, the year after the release of the WHO’s report, the journal Public Health Ethics published a special issue devoted entirely to this topic.

zh: 2017年11月，我所在大学的抗生素耐药性研究中心（CARe）举办了这一话题的首次大型研讨会，经济学、伦理学、法律、政策、社会科学和卫生等领域的著名学者齐聚一堂。
en: Then, in November 2017, the Centre for Antibiotic Resistance Research (CARe) at my own university held the first-ever major symposium on the topic, bringing together leading scholars in economics, ethics, law, policy, social science, and health care.

zh: 为期两天的会议为集体协作的发展提供了一个平台，其研究成果预计将发表在《生物伦理学 》 （ Bioethics）杂志上。
en: The two-day conference provided a platform for the development of collaborative synergies, and the research output is scheduled to appear in the journal Bioethics.

zh: 这些学术会议有助于激发对耐药性的伦理问题的学术兴趣，但远远不足以帮助世界安全度过近在眼前的道德雷区。
en: These scholarly gatherings have helped to foster academic interest in the ethical considerations of drug resistance, but represent only a tiny fraction of what is needed to help the world safely navigate the looming moral minefield.

zh: 限制抗生素使用、监管食品和药品行业、改变人类行为的努力 — — 即当前正在讨论的所有策略 — — 都需要复杂的伦理考量和分析。
en: Any effort to restrict antibiotic consumption, regulate the food and pharmaceutical industries, or change human behaviors – all strategies that are currently being discussed – will require complex ethical reflection and analysis.

zh: 第一个伦理障碍是形成一个关于如何定义耐药性的共识。
en: The first ethical hurdle is to reach a consensus on how to characterize drug resistance.

zh: 许多伦理学家将它视为一个“集体行动问题 ” ， 一个必须通过有组织的全盘考虑解决的公共卫生问题。
en: Many ethicists see it as a “collective action problem,” a public-health concern that must be addressed in an organized, holistic manner.

zh: 但是，对于它属于哪类集体行动问题，则没有达成什么一致。
en: There is less agreement, however, on what kind of collective action problem is it.

zh: 它是不是类似于气候变化、贫困、不平等性等其他全球性问题？
en: Is it similar to other global challenges like climate change, poverty, or inequality?

zh: 还是说，它在更大程度上是一个国家问题，最好由主权当局去解决？
en: Or is it more of a national issue, best left to sovereign authorities?

zh: 我们如何定义问题将决定人们和政府准备采取怎样的权衡。
en: How we define the problem will determine what trade-offs people and governments are willing to make.

zh: CARe研讨会的一些与会者强调这个问题，指出要成功实施耐药性策略，政府必须在全球医疗责任和本地公共品之间达成一个平衡。
en: Several participants at the CARe symposium highlighted this problem, noting that to implement drug-resistance strategies successfully, governments must strike a balance between global medical responsibility and local public good.

zh: 一种在会上被提出的思维是对在生产过程中使用抗生素的肉制品课税，这一方针或能改变动物农业，使之更加可持续。
en: One idea that has been proposed is to tax meat produced with antibiotics, an approach that could move animal agriculture in a more sustainable direction.

zh: 尽管肉制品成本可能会上升，但牲畜耐药性会下降，负面环境影响也会减弱。
en: While meat costs might climb, drug resistance in livestock would decline, as would adverse environmental effects.

zh: 伦理问题是类似这样的方案是否能做到全球层面的公平，特别是在它会导致食品更加昂贵的情况下。
en: The ethical question is whether a solution like this would be fair on a global level, especially if the result is more expensive food.

zh: 随着耐药性相关挑战变得日益紧迫，你可能会认为伦理学争论是一种奢侈。
en: As drug resistance-related challenges become more urgent, one might think that ethical debates are an unaffordable luxury.

zh: 但考虑到实施考虑欠周的方案所可能造成的风险，仔细斟酌耐药性策略的伦理影响是不可或缺的。
en: But, given the risks implied by deploying ill-considered solutions, careful consideration of the ethical implications of drug resistance strategies is essential.

zh: 欧洲自产的能源安全
en: Homegrown Energy Security for Europe

zh: 哥本哈根 — — 欧盟高度依赖国外石油。
en: COPENHAGEN – The European Union is highly dependent on foreign oil.

zh: 欧盟消费的每百升石油中有90升为进口。
en: For every 100 liters consumed within the EU, 90 are imported.

zh: 与此同时，国内石油产量过去10年出现了超过50%的跌幅。
en: Meanwhile, domestic oil production is plummeting, down more than 50% over the last decade.

zh: 据国际能源机构统计，除非欧盟改变策略并增加为其长期忽视的生物燃料等其他替代能源产量，否则到2030年约95%的石油将从国外进口。
en: Unless the EU changes course and increases its production of alternative energy – including biofuels, an option the EU has long neglected – some 95% of its oil will come from foreign sources by 2030, according to the International Energy Agency.

zh: 目前的状况依然是欧盟的阿喀琉斯之踵，因为这意味着需要依赖从不稳定独裁政权的石油进口。
en: The current state of affairs remains the EU’s Achilles’ heel, because it implies dependence on imports from unstable, authoritarian regimes.

zh: 2014年，欧盟成员国耗费了超过保加利亚、匈牙利、斯洛伐克和斯洛文尼亚四国GDP总和的惊人的2710亿欧元从国外进口原油。
en: In 2014, EU member states spent a staggering €271 billion on foreign crude oil – more than the combined GDP of Bulgaria, Hungary, Slovakia, and Slovenia.

zh: 这些钱中约有半数流向了俄罗斯、北非和中东。
en: Roughly half of this money went to Russia, the Middle East, and North Africa.

zh: 因此，欧盟不仅冒着全球供应中断的危险；还发挥了支撑独裁政府、授权敌对政权、限制其自身协调有效应对威胁挑衅能力的作用。
en: Thus, not only is the EU exposed to global supply disruptions; it is also helping to prop up authoritarian governments and empower hostile regimes, which limits its own ability to provide effective, coordinated responses to threats and provocations.

zh: 欧盟无力制定协调一致的政治和经济战略应对俄罗斯入侵乌克兰和中东炼狱所带来的挑战就是个很好的例子。
en: The EU’s struggle to devise coherent political and economic strategies to confront the challenges posed by Russian aggression in Ukraine and the inferno in the Middle East is a case in point.

zh: 英国最近提高国防开支的决策彰显出人们越来越明确地认识到需要强大的军力维护欧洲的安全和主权。
en: The United Kingdom’s recent decision to boost defense spending highlights the growing recognition that strong military capabilities will be needed to uphold Europe’s security and sovereignty.

zh: 但只要对外石油依赖依然存在，欧盟就不可能达到它所需要的强度。
en: But as long as its dependence on foreign oil persists, the EU will remain far weaker than it needs to be.

zh: 拟议修建的北溪天然气管道II会将更多天然气从俄罗斯输送到德国 — — 只可能导致现有局势进一步恶化。
en: The proposed Nord Stream II pipeline – which would funnel even more gas from Russia to Germany – is only likely to aggravate the situation.

zh: 随着2016年国际政局持续动荡，未来几个月欧洲的能源安全可能再度成为人们关注的焦点。
en: Europe’s energy security is likely to gain salience in the coming months, as 2016 shapes up to be another turbulent year in international politics.

zh: 本年度还有可能成立欧盟能源联盟，目的是确保能源供应安全，争取能源价格适中、气候友好。
en: This year is also likely to see the completion of the EU’s Energy Union, established to ensure secure supplies of affordable, climate-friendly energy.

zh: 不幸的是，欧洲石油对外依存度已经被排除出讨论的范畴。
en: Unfortunately, Europe’s dependence on foreign oil has been left out of the discussion.

zh: 欧盟成员国要想研发替代能源，必须由欧洲委员会为其指明方向。
en: The European Commission must provide clear direction if EU member states are to develop alternative sources of energy.

zh: 风能和太阳能等可再生能源无疑可以为控制欧盟能源脆弱性发挥积极的作用。
en: Renewable energy from wind and sun can certainly play a role in decreasing the EU’s energy vulnerability.

zh: 上述能源已经降低了欧盟电力生产对煤炭和天然气的依赖程度。
en: Such sources are already helping to reduce dependence on coal and gas for electricity production.

zh: 但涉及到以石油为基础的能源生产 — — 最主要的是汽车燃料 — — 风能和太阳能提供可以利用的替代能源可能还需要很多年以后。
en: However, when it comes to energy production from oil – most notably fuel for cars – it is likely to be years before wind or solar energy can provide viable alternatives.

zh: 欧盟应当效仿大西洋那边的伙伴，努力降低对国外原油的依存程度。
en: The EU should follow the example set across the Atlantic, where countries have worked to reduce their reliance on foreign oil.

zh: 比如美国就制定了投资替代燃料的激励政策。
en: The United States, for example, has created incentives for investment in alternative fuels.

zh: 事实上，美国是全世界最大的生物乙醇生产国，加之页岩气的生产 — — 已经在降低二氧化碳排放及创造当地就业机会的同时，减少了至少25%的国外石油进口。
en: Indeed, the US is the world’s largest producer of bioethanol, which – along with the production of shale gas – has helped reduce foreign oil imports by at least 25%, while lowering carbon dioxide emissions and creating local jobs.

zh: 巴西本身也是非常明显的例子，该国自20世纪70年代石油危机后就已经尽力减少对进口能源的依赖程度。
en: Brazil, too, provides a compelling example, having worked since the oil crises of the 1970s to reduce its reliance on imported energy.

zh: 今天，巴西已经成为石油净出口国和世界第二大生物乙醇生产国，替代了过去国���超过四分之一的汽油用量。
en: Today, Brazil is a net oil exporter and the world’s second-largest producer of bioethanol, which has replaced more than one-quarter of the gasoline once used in the country.

zh: 不幸的是，欧盟有关生物燃料政策的讨论往往由导致食品价格上涨等过时观点来占据主导。
en: Unfortunately, much of the policy discussion surrounding biofuels in the EU is dominated by outdated arguments linking them with rising food prices.

zh: 反对者坚持认为粮食不应被用于汽车燃料。
en: Food should not be used to fuel cars, opponents insist.

zh: 但今天，先进的生物燃料已经并非来源于粮食，而是来源于工农业和家庭废弃物。
en: Today, however, advanced biofuels are not based on food, but on waste from industry, agriculture, and private households.

zh: 按照联合国粮农组织总干事 何塞·格拉齐亚诺·达席尔瓦的话讲，生物燃料“可以成为强化粮食安全的有效途径。
en: In the words of José Graziano da Silva, Director-General of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, biofuels “can be an effective means to increase food security.”

zh: ”只要方式正确，生物燃料发展可以意味着“更多燃料、更多粮食和所有人能够共享的更大繁荣。 ”
en: Done right, their development would mean “more fuel, more food, and greater prosperity for all.”

zh: 生物燃料技术其实一石四鸟：改善能源安全、促进垃圾回收、减少温室气体排放和（往往在农村地区）创造就业机会。
en: Biofuel technology kills four birds with one stone: It improves energy security, recycles waste, reduces greenhouse-gas emissions, and produces jobs (often in rural areas).

zh: 因此用本土能源替代进口石油是今天的欧洲人可以留给明日欧洲的一笔最重要、意义也最深远的财富。
en: That is why replacing imported oil with homegrown energy is one of the most important and far-reaching legacies today’s Europeans could leave to the Europe of tomorrow.

zh: 生物燃料时代的粮食
en: Food in the Age of Biofuels

zh: 罗马—过去几年来，生物燃料成了争论的焦点。
en: ROME – Over the past several years, biofuels have become a bone of contention.

zh: 一些人认为，来自有机物的可再生能源资源如同对抗气候变化的魔法棒。
en: For some, a renewable energy source produced from organic matter amounts to a magic wand in the fight against climate change.

zh: 但其他人把生物燃料当成生存威胁，因为用于生产它们的农地和水本来可以用于种植粮食。
en: But others view biofuels as an existential threat, because the plants used to create them compete for agricultural land and water that would otherwise be used to grow food.

zh: 但这是错误的两分法。
en: But this is a false dichotomy.

zh: 不存在粮食和燃料之间的选择。
en: The choice cannot be between food and fuel.

zh: 我们可以鱼和熊掌兼得。
en: We can make good use of both.

zh: 只要有正确的条件，生物燃料可以为贫困农民提供可持续的廉价能源资源，从而成为增进粮食安全的有效办法。
en: Given the right conditions, biofuels can be an effective means to increase food security by providing poor farmers with a sustainable and affordable energy source.

zh: 在一些非洲内陆国家，汽油成本是全球平均水平的三倍，这导致燃料价格成为农业增长的主要瓶颈。
en: In some land-locked African countries, gasoline costs three times the global average, making fuel prices one of the main barriers to agricultural growth.

zh: 扩大生物燃料在这些地区的使用能够提振生产率、创造新的就业机会，特别是在农村地区。
en: Extending the use of biofuels in these regions could boost productivity and create new employment opportunities, especially in rural areas.

zh: 如果生物燃料所带来的原料需求增加可以通过家庭农庄和小规模生产商满足，效果将会更好。
en: The effect could be made even stronger if the additional demand for feedstock created by biofuels was met by family farmers and small-scale producers.

zh: 生物燃料已成为无法改变的事实，它们的使用预计将继续稳步攀升。
en: Biofuels have become a fact of life, and their use is expected to continue to increase steadily.

zh: 据联合国粮农组织和经合组织的报告，2013年生物燃料贡献了全球交通燃料使用总量的3 % 。
en: In 2013, biofuels accounted for 3% of the total transport fuel used around the world, according to a report by the Food and Agricultural Organization and the OECD.

zh: 这一比例预计将保持稳定，但尽管如此，可以期待生物燃料产量的绝对值将随着全球交通燃料市场的扩大而增加。
en: While this percentage is expected to remain steady, we can nonetheless expect the production of biofuels to grow in absolute terms as the global market for transport fuels also expands.

zh: 事实上，到2023年，全球生物燃料生产预计将在2007年水平的基础上翻一番。
en: Indeed, global biofuel production is projected to be double by 2023 relative to its level in 2007.

zh: 如果这一预测正确，那么生物燃料将消耗全球12%的谷物、28%的甘蔗、14%的植物油。
en: If that prediction is borne out, biofuels will consume 12% of the world’s coarse grain, 28% of its sugar cane, and 14% of its vegetable oil.

zh: 随着这些燃料产量的增加，我们需要能够确保可持续使用它们的政策、计划和能力，不对粮食市场造成扭曲或牺牲粮食安全。 粮食安全始终是排在第一位的要务。
en: As production of these fuels grows, we will require policies, programs, and capacities that ensure that they are used sustainably, without distorting food markets or compromising food security, which will always be the first priority.

zh: 生物燃料的先驱也许会惊讶于生物燃料在当今世界燃料供给中占比如此之小。
en: The pioneers of biofuels would probably be surprised by how little they contribute to the total world fuel supply today.

zh: 鲁道夫·迪塞尔（Rudolph Diesel）在19世纪初就设计出了花生油燃料发动机。
en: Rudolf Diesel’s first engine, designed in the late 1800s, ran on fuel derived from peanut oil.

zh: 亨利·福特曾经走遍佛罗里达州，希望买地种植甘蔗，因为他认为美国无法忍受燃烧化石燃料所造成的污染和进口石油生产汽油所造成的能源依赖。
en: Henry Ford once scouted Florida in hopes of buying tracts of land to plant sugar cane, convinced that the United States would not tolerate the pollution from burning fossil fuels or the dependency implicit in importing oil to produce gasoline.

zh: 直到最近几十年来，生物燃料才重新获得吸引力，这是因为我们需要确保平价能源、制造收入、降低福特所警告的能源依赖。
en: Only in recent decades have biofuels regained their original appeal, owing to efforts to secure affordable energy, generate income, and mitigate the dependency of which Ford warned.

zh: 最近，关���污染、气候变化和化石燃料的有限性的担忧成为生物燃料需求的推动力 — — 目前已需要对这一需求进行管理。
en: More recently, concerns about pollution, climate change, and the finite nature of fossil fuels has driven a spike in demand – one that must now be managed.

zh: 在利用世界日益依赖生物燃料的机会提高农业生产率、加快农村开发、增进食品安全方面，灵活性至关重要。
en: Flexibility is key to efforts to leverage the world’s growing reliance on biofuels to boost agricultural productivity, accelerate rural development, and increase food security.

zh: 比如，决策者必须通过制定遏制基本粮食作物价格波动的机制平息粮食和燃料之间的竞争压力。
en: For example, policymakers must defuse the competitive pressures between food and fuel by designing schemes to counter price volatility for basic foodstuffs.

zh: 当局可以要求生物燃料与传统燃料之比在粮食价格下跌时增加，在粮食价格上涨时下降。
en: Authorities could require that the percentage of biofuels blended with conventional fuel be increased when food prices drop and cut when they rise.

zh: 这可以起到自动稳定器的作用。
en: This would serve as a sort of automatic stabilizer.

zh: 贫困农民将在粮食价格下跌时继续享受到强健的产品需求，而消费者也可以获得价格过快过度上涨的保护。
en: Poor farmers would continue to enjoy robust demand for their products even when food prices dropped, and consumers would be protected from rapid or excessive price increases.

zh: 国家目标也可以定得更灵活一些。
en: National targets could also be made more flexible.

zh: 如果关于生物燃料使用的指标分几年而不是一年完成，决策者就可以通过影响需求而使粮食价格压力最小化。
en: If mandates for biofuel use were applied over several years, instead of only one, policymakers could influence demand in order to minimize pressure on food prices.

zh: 最后，在个人层面，可以在加油站体现灵活因素 — — 通过推广（比如）已经在巴西投入使用的灵活燃料（flex-fuel）汽车。
en: Finally, at the individual level, greater flexibility could also be built in at the pump, through the promotion of flex-fuel vehicles of the type already in use in Brazil.

zh: 如果汽车发动机既可以使用传统燃料，也可以参杂高比例化石燃料，消费者就可以在两者之间切换以适应价格波动。
en: If cars are equipped with engines that can run on conventional fossil fuels or blends with high percentages of biofuels, consumers can adapt to changes in prices by switching between one or the other.

zh: 寻找正确的平衡绝非易事。
en: Finding the right balance will not be easy.

zh: 但如果我们利用我们的集体知识，在这个问题上将发展中国的小农也考虑进来，并保持对减少贫困和保护弱势群体的关注，我们就可以拥有更多燃料、更多粮食，为所有人创造更大的繁荣。
en: But if we harness our collective knowledge, include developing countries’ smallholder farmers in this effort, and maintain our focus on reducing poverty and protecting the vulnerable, we can have more fuel, more food, and greater prosperity for all.

zh: 打造更好的难民卫生服务
en: Engineering Better Refugee Health Care

zh: 发自波士顿 — — 世界各国本土保护主义和仇外心理的复苏为那些逃离地缘政治危机的人们创造了一个有害的环境。
en: BOSTON – A resurgence of nativism and xenophobia in countries around the world has created a toxic environment for those fleeing from geopolitical crises.

zh: 而在等待重新安置的难民所面临的众多挑战之中，寻求获取高质量身心健康服务的渠道是最为亟待解决的问题。
en: But among the many challenges that refugees must confront while they await resettlement, finding access to high-quality physical and mental health care tops the list.

zh: 这个挑战不仅需要得到医生，护士，非政府组织和其他相关行动者的更多关注，还跟工程师有关系 — — 他们也可以为全球公共卫生做出不可或缺的贡献，而这些贡献则与难民高度相关。
en: It is a challenge that demands more attention not just from doctors, nurses, non-governmental organizations, and other relevant actors, but also from engineers, who can make indispensable contributions to global public health. Those contributions are highly relevant to refugees.

zh: 除了架桥建屋和创造工具之外，工程师还可以通过开发能更快诊断疾病和提供医疗服务的手段来协助提高全球卫生保健质量以及降低患者负担。
en: Beyond building bridges and creating gadgets, engineers can help improve the quality and affordability of health care around the world, by developing faster methods for diagnosing diseases and delivering medical services.

zh: 在我自身研究领域，科学家和工程师已经发明了可以帮助体弱婴儿呼吸更顺畅，在战区检测疟疾和艾滋病毒，以及将假药清除出农村地区的众多设备。
en: Scientists and engineers in my own research area have already invented devices to help vulnerable babies breathe easier, detect malaria and HIV in war zones, and keep counterfeit medicines out of rural areas.

zh: 然而，随着越来越多的民众不得不逃离冲突和自然灾害，各个难民定居点容纳的人口不断增加，但与之相配套的工程技术还不足够。
en: Still, not enough engineering expertise has been brought to bear in refugee settlements, whose populations have swelled in recent years as more people have had to flee from conflicts and natural disasters.

zh: 联合国估计当今世界上有超过6500万被迫流离失所者，而生活在正式和非正式营地的难民数量则比以往任何时期都更多。
en: The UN estimates that there are more than 65 million forcibly displaced people in the world today, and that more refugees live in formal and informal encampments than ever before.

zh: 虽然政府和非政府组织致力于向难民提供基本医疗保健，但要真正做到这一点可不容易。
en: Although governments and NGOs have made efforts to provide basic health care to refugees, they have struggled to do so reliably.

zh: 而对此工程师既有机会也有责任去缩小存在于当前系统中的关键性差距。
en: Engineers have both an opportunity and a responsibility to close crucial gaps in the current system.

zh: 应对这一挑战需要对三个关键领域给予更多重视。
en: Tackling this challenge will require greater attention in three key areas.

zh: 第一个是学校 — — 我们应该继续提高针对难民面临的卫生保健挑战的意识 — — 特别是在生物医学工程领域。
en: The first is the classroom, where we should continue to raise awareness – particularly in the field of biomedical engineering – of the health-care challenges that refugees face.

zh: 此外，有兴趣为全球健康问题创设适当解决方案的教师，学生，研究人员和从业者都应该得到付诸实践的机会。
en: Moreover, faculty, students, researchers, and practitioners who have an interest in developing appropriate solutions to global health problems should be afforded the opportunity to do so.

zh: 目前专门针对与危机有关的生物医学工程问题的教育项目还太少。
en: At the moment, there are too few educational programs that focus specifically on crisis-related biomedical engineering issues.

zh: 但是幸运的是，已经有一些已有的模式可以遵循。
en: Fortunately, however, there are existing models to follow.

zh: 例如，在伦敦卫生和热带医学学院，免费在线课程《人道主义危机中的卫生问题》将这一问题呈现到了全球工程界学生面前。
en: At the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine, for example, the free online course “Health in Humanitarian Crises” is bringing the issue to students in engineering departments globally.

zh: 在贝鲁特美国大学，夏季课程的学生最近引入了帮助流离失所者的工程策略。
en: At the American University of Beirut, summer school students recently introduced engineering strategies for helping displaced people.

zh: 而在我所属的波士顿大学，我们研究改善发展中国家医药质量和应用的方法。
en: And at my institution, Boston University, we research ways to improve the quality and practice of medicine in the developing world.

zh: 2012年，我的同事和我创设出一种名为PharmaChk的便携式设备，让医生可以用来一些在难以到达的偏远地区检测假冒或者无效的药物。
en: In 2012, my colleagues and I created PharmaChk, a portable device that doctors can use to detect fake or ineffective medications in hard-to-reach places.

zh: 第二，致力于难民工作的政府和非政府组织可以做更多的工作去将医疗工程专业人员涵盖进来。
en: Second, governments and NGOs that work with refugees can do more to include medical engineering professionals in their efforts.

zh: 比尔和梅琳达·盖茨基金会，美国国家开发署和加拿大大型挑战基金（Grand Challenges Canada）等私人和公共机构已经与工程师展开合作在全球卫生领域制定严谨，合乎道德且可扩展的医疗解决方案，而对流离失所者也应该做到这一点。
en: Private and public entities such as the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, USAID, and Grand Challenges Canada have worked with engineers to produce rigorous, ethically sound, and scalable medical solutions in global health, and the same should be done with respect to displaced people.

zh: 第三，也许也是最重要的一点，就是工程师们自身需要加强与难民危机前线工作人员和团体的接触。
en: Third, and perhaps most important, engineers themselves need to step up their engagement with people and groups working on the front lines of the refugee crisis.

zh: 这意味着与当地的医院，诊所，宗教团体和卫生保健提供者合作，这可以作为传播生物工程专业知识的关键渠道。
en: That means working with local hospitals, clinics, ministries, and health-care providers, which can serve as key conduits for bioengineering expertise.

zh: 跨学科的学习不仅对于传播意识极为重要，也是可以提高技术创新的经济可持续性和可扩展性。
en: Cross-disciplinary learning is important not only for spreading awareness, but also for improving the financial sustainability and scalability of technological innovations.

zh: 有几个生物工程初创企业和援助团体，如无国界工程师，已开始在难民社区解决与健康有关的问题。
en: A handful of bioengineering startups and aid groups, such as Engineers Without Borders, have begun to tackle health-related problems in refugee communities.

zh: 这些努力一般侧重于改进供水卫生和能源输送的方法。
en: These efforts have generally focused on methods for improving water sanitation and energy delivery.

zh: 而其他类似远程医疗这类通过手机提供临床医疗咨询的举措也已成为许多社区的生命线。
en: Other initiatives, such as telemedicine, in which clinical medical advice is delivered through mobile phones, have become a lifeline for many communities.

zh: 除了这些例子之外，在难民社区打造卫生保健工程解决方案的努力依然有限。
en: Beyond these examples, efforts to engineer health-care solutions in refugee communities have been limited.

zh: 为了将生物医学工程应用于难民健康挑战，学生，专家和从业者需要去熟悉难民定居点的条件，并加深对困难难民所受复杂创伤的理解。
en: To apply biomedical engineering to refugee health challenges, students, experts, and practitioners need to familiarize themselves with conditions in refugee settlements, and deepen their understanding of the complex traumas that afflict refugees.

zh: 难民营需要健全的护理解决方案，这些解决方案不仅要有效，还得关注难民的文化特质并具有社会责任感。
en: Refugee camps need robust point-of-care solutions that are not just effective, but also culturally sensitive and socially responsible.

zh: 纵观历史，工程师一直是社会的问题解决者。
en: Throughout history, engineers have been society’s problem solvers.

zh: 如今我们需要创造性思维来缓解被迫流离失所者的困境。
en: Today, creative thinking is needed to mitigate the plight of those who have been forcibly displaced from their homes.

zh: 事实证明国际社会无法终结那些不断制造出难民的危机，但生物医学工程师至少可以确保这些人能得到他们所需的护理。
en: The international community has proved incapable of ending the crises that are currently sending refugees in search of safety. But biomedical engineers can at least ensure that they receive the care they need.

zh: 生物医学的民主革命
en: Biomedicine’s Democratic Revolution

zh: 西雅图—很快，我们就能以非常经济的方式获得人类基因序列并收集大量不同类型的健康数据作为标准医疗手段。
en: SEATTLE – Very soon, it will be economically feasible to sequence human genomes and collect massive amounts of different types of health data as standard medical practice.

zh: 已经有不少令人瞩目的例子表明，这些新的基因数据正在改变我们对疾病和诊断的看法。
en: Already, there are remarkable examples of how these new genetic data are changing our thinking about disease and diagnosis.

zh: 比如比利（Beery）双胞胎。
en: Consider the Beery twins, born in 1996 in San Diego, California.

zh: 他们于1996年出生于加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，身患慢性呕吐、癫痫和肌无力。 他们和他们的父母长期进行着没完没了的体检和测试。
en: They suffered from chronic vomiting, seizures, and muscle weakness, sending them and their parents on an odyssey of medical examinations and tests.

zh: 一开始，他们被诊断为脑瘫。
en: The first diagnosis was cerebral palsy.

zh: 接着又被诊断为张力肌障碍，一种罕见的神经疾病。
en: Then they received a diagnosis of dystonia, a rare neurological disorder.

zh: 但基于这些诊断的治疗并没有消除这两个孩子的症状。
en: But treatments based on these diagnoses did not alleviate the children’s symptoms.

zh: 沮丧的父母给双胞胎进行了基因排序。
en: Frustrated, their parents had the twins’ genomes sequenced.

zh: 排序结果表明，他们的诊断有欠全面。
en: The results revealed that the twins had been incompletely diagnosed.

zh: 先前被查出的张力肌障碍是由干扰了神经传导血清素的基因突变引起的。
en: Their previously diagnosed dystonia was being caused by a genetic mutation that was interfering with the neurotransmitter serotonin.

zh: 医生发现，双胞胎的张力肌障碍可以用已有的血清素替换疗法彻底治愈。
en: The twins’ doctors found that the dystonia could be fully treated with a readily available serotonin replacement.

zh: 那么，比利双胞胎这样的成功案例加上互联网的力量以及越来越廉价的分子数据收集工作为什么没有形成关于疾病的知识网络呢？
en: So why haven’t success stories like that of the Beery twins, together with the Internet’s power and increasingly affordable collection of molecular data, led to the construction of a knowledge network of disease?

zh: 为什么科学家和医生没有大量使用数据密集型科学以建设更好的“疾病地图”呢？
en: Why aren’t scientists and doctors turning in droves to data-intensive science in order to build better “disease maps”?

zh: 一个可能的答案是仍然存在技术上的壁垒阻挡了这类网络的建设和使用。
en: One possible answer is that there are still technical barriers that block the construction and use of such networks.

zh: 我们打造不断扩大的分子数据海洋的能力在日渐成长，当前数据容量已经达到了ZB级别（即1后面跟21个0 ） ， 随之而来的问题是如何储存和破译这些信息。
en: With our ability to generate ever-rising oceans of molecular data – now approaching the zetabyte scale (that’s a one followed by 21 zeros) – comes the challenge of storing and deciphering this information.

zh: 但科学家和软件工程师遇到此类棘手问题可谓家常便饭，且现代生物药学研究由DNA作为参考语言，建设疾病网络的技术壁垒不消多久就能攻克。
en: But scientists and software engineers regularly face such daunting challenges, and, with DNA serving as the reference language of modern biomedical research, the technical barriers to constructing disease networks will be short-lived.

zh: 文化壁垒才是真正的障碍。
en: Cultural barriers are the real stumbling block.

zh: 作为人类，我们是高度进化的，因此能够适应我们的环境：我们倾向于接受一种文化（不管相不相信 ） ， 并盲目地认为这种文化不会崩溃。
en: As humans, we are highly evolved to adjust to our surroundings: we tend to adapt to a culture, well-conceived or not, and lose sight of its failings.

zh: 但若我们稍稍开阔一下眼界，就会发现，我们的文化中的不足之处（甚至可以说是愚不可及之处）就会立刻变得昭然若揭，而这可能导致文化变迁、集体行动和变革。
en: But when we glimpse an alternative, our culture’s inadequacies (and even insanities) are immediately apparent, which may prompt a cultural shift, collective action, and change.

zh: 1989年11月柏林墙的倒塌以及最近的阿拉伯之春便是这种动态链的明证。
en: The fall of the Berlin Wall in November 1989 and, more recently, the Arab Spring are clear examples of this dynamic.

zh: 类似地，比利双胞胎的例子表明，存在一种可替代基于症状的疗法的方案等着我们去实现：基因组技术的降临不但可以改变我们的知识，更重要的是，还可以我们对自己的看法。
en: Similarly, the example of the Beery twins shows us that an alternative to symptom-based medicine can be realized: the advent of genomics technology can change not just what is known, but, more importantly, how we think of ourselves.

zh: 但是，为了建设未来疾病网络，我们还需要超越现有科学和科学家研究工作的线性方法。
en: But, in order to build the disease networks of tomorrow, we will need to move beyond the current linear approaches to science and to how scientists work.

zh: 我们都喜欢好消息以直观的方式展现在我们面前，但疾病信息并不是通过多节信息网络展现的（就像空中交通管制员跟踪大机场上空的痕迹那样 ） 。
en: We all like a good story that unfolds in a straightforward way, but the story of disease plays out across a poly-nodal information network, similar to what an air traffic controller might track in the skies above a major airport.

zh: 生物医学研究者的“钥匙和锁”和线性表示是不完善的，必须补充以可用分子数据建设的疾病地图。
en: Biomedical researchers’ “lock and key” and linear-pathway representations are incomplete, and should be supplemented with disease maps that can now be built using molecular data.

zh: 我们还必须建设共享基础设施、培养在基础研究者、执业医生、药品研发者甚至普罗大众间共享疾病地图所需要的关系。
en: We must also build the infrastructure and cultivate the relationships needed to share disease maps with basic researchers, practicing doctors, drug developers, and even the public at large.

zh: 而这可能要困难得多，因为当前医学信息系统是封闭的，其自我导向的激励结构阻碍了信息的分享。
en: And that could prove to be even more difficult, because the current closed nature of the medical-information system and its self-directed incentive structure block such sharing.

zh: 专利、商标和资源竞争（人才、资金和荣誉）让信息成为了秘辛，阻止了人们分析和共享分子数据。
en: Patents, trademarks, and competition for resources (people, money, and accolades) seal off information and prevent molecular data from being analyzed and shared.

zh: 生物医学奖项被授予“独行侠 ” ， 而只有多功能团队才能完成的工作却得不到承认。
en: Rewards in biomedical research go to “solo workers,” and do nothing to acknowledge the work that can be done only by multi-functional groups.

zh: 尽管有重重障碍需要克服，我们仍然有理由相信，文化变迁正在发生：来自相隔千里的不同实验室的研究者正在形成非传统的“联盟 ” ， 将彼此的数据集联合起来，在此基础上展开合作，并将结果提供给其他科学家分析。
en: Despite these imposing obstacles to progress, there are reasons to believe that a cultural shift is afoot: researchers from geographically distant labs are forming non-traditional “federations” to combine their data sets, work on them collaboratively, and post the results for other scientists to analyze.

zh: 众源（crowd-sourced）竞赛，如DREAM Challengers和FoldIt，表明重要的科学发现可以产生于大学和制药公司之外。
en: Crowd-sourced competitions like DREAM Challenges and FoldIt show that important scientific findings can emerge from outside of universities and pharmaceutical companies.

zh: 药品研发者、基础研究者和病人之间共享信息的竞争前（pre-competitive）公私合作已成为将科学发现转化为潜在的有意义的临床效果的越来越普遍的方式。
en: And public-private partnerships between drug developers, basic researchers, and patient groups that share information pre-competitively (that is, with no or limited patent filings) are an increasingly popular way to translate scientific findings into potentially meaningful clinical benefits.

zh: 但少数成功联盟、竞赛和合作���能还不足以改变生物医学研究。
en: But a few successful federations, competitions, and partnerships may not be enough to transform biomedical research.

zh: 我们也许需要破坏性变革，在这方面，我们每个人都有可能造成深远影响。
en: Disruptive change may be required, and here each of us can make a profound difference.

zh: 病人已经被组织起来；病人组织成员可以在线报告自己的症状，并自我注册为临床试验对象。
en: Patient groups are already organized; their members can report their symptoms online and self-enroll in clinical trials.

zh: 我们已经可以获得某些我们自身基因的信息，用之作出信息完全的医疗决策，加入已有的病人组织或成立新组织。
en: We can already obtain portions of our own genetic information and use it to make informed medical decisions, join existing patient groups, or create new ones.

zh: 我们可以为数据驱动实验提供自己的基因样本，以了解我们对特定疗法可能出现的反应。
en: We can provide our genetic samples to data-driven trials to learn about our likelihood to respond to particular therapies.

zh: 我们甚至可以组织自我融资的未来研究，或只参加给予我们决定我们的数据如何使用、用在哪里的法定权利的研究。
en: We can even organize to self-fund future studies or join only those studies that give us the legal right to say how and where our data are used.

zh: 换句话说，病人可以也应该不在只充当被动的“患者 ” ， 而是积极参与，给医生、研究者和药物研发者不适应就淘汰的压力。
en: In other words, patients can and should stop being the passive “sick” and actively engage to pressure clinicians, researchers, and drug developers to adapt or perish.

zh: 民主化的医疗代表着生物医学革命最灿烂的结果。
en: Democratized medicine represents the fullest flowering of the biomedical information revolution.

zh: 没有什么比公民病患积极参与管理其自身健康更值得追求的未来目标了。
en: There are few worthier goals than a future in which citizen-patients are active participants in managing their own health.

zh: 生物制药的革命和反动
en: Revolution and Reaction in Biopharming

zh: 斯坦福—从植物中获得药物并非新鲜事。
en: STANFORD – Obtaining medicines from plants is not new.

zh: 阿司匹林最初就是在十八世纪从柳树皮中分离出来的。
en: Aspirin was first isolated from the bark of the willow tree in the eighteenth century.

zh: 其他许多常规药物，包括吗啡、可待因纤维补充剂美达施（Metamucil）都是由植物提纯而来。
en: And many other common pharmaceuticals, including morphine, codeine, and the fiber supplement Metamucil, are purified from the world’s flora.

zh: 更晚近一些，科学家发展出将这一过程更进一步的技术，使用基因工程将农作物合成为高价值药物。
en: More recently, scientists have developed techniques that take this process a step further, using genetic engineering to induce agricultural crops to synthesize high-value pharmaceuticals.

zh: 这一技术的远大前景被称为“生物制药 ” ， 出现在大约15年前，始于从香蕉、番茄和烟草中生产的疫苗和药物的临床试验。
en: Known as “biopharming,” the great promise of this technology emerged about 15 years ago, with clinical trials of vaccines and drugs produced in bananas, tomatoes, and tobacco.

zh: 不幸的是，由于监管者过于厌恶风险，生物制药的进步此后一直陷于停顿。
en: Unfortunately, progress has since stalled, owing to the vehement risk-aversion of regulators.

zh: 一个生物制药的早期例子是文特里亚生物科技公司（Ventria Bioscience）所生产的一种水稻，这种水稻包含两种人类蛋白质：乳铁蛋白和溶解酵素。
en: One early example of biopharming was the production by the biotech company Ventria Bioscience of rice that contained two human proteins, lactoferrin and lysozyme.

zh: 这种水稻种植和收获后，对其谷粒进行加工，提炼和提纯这两种蛋白质就可以用于治疗痢疾的口服补液。 在发展中国家，痢疾是仅次于呼吸道疾病的第二大五岁以下儿童流行病杀手。
en: Once grown and harvested, the rice kernel is processed to extract and purify the proteins for use in oral rehydration solution for treating diarrhea, which is surpassed only by respiratory diseases as the leading infectious killer of children under the age of five in developing countries.

zh: 这两种蛋白质的结构和功能特性与母乳中的蛋白质完全一样，而提纯过程与从细菌和酵母中提炼药用蛋白质类似。
en: The proteins have the same structure and functional properties as those found in natural breast milk, and the process for extracting them is analogous to that used routinely for the production of therapeutic proteins from organisms like bacteria and yeast.

zh: 秘鲁的研究表明用提炼自文特里亚公司的水稻的蛋白质强化口服补液疗法能大大缩短痢疾的持续期和复发率 — — 这对于发展中世界的人们来说是一项不可思议的进步。
en: Research in Peru showed that fortifying an oral-rehydration solution with the proteins extracted from Ventria’s rice substantially lessens the duration of diarrhea and reduces the rate of recurrence – a near-miraculous advance for people in the developing world.

zh: 但监管者扼杀了这一奇迹，他们经常这样。
en: But regulators can undo miracles, and they regularly do.

zh: 2010年，文特里亚公司向美国食品药品监管局（Food and Drug Administration，FDA）申请承认这些蛋白质“总体安全 ” （ 一个艺术性的监管用词 ） ， 结果没有得到��何回复。
en: When Ventria approached the US Food and Drug Administration in 2010 for recognition that these proteins are “generally recognized as safe” (a regulatory term of art), it received no response.

zh: 没有FDA的承认，该公司也不愿推广这一产品，因此至今我们仍买不到它，悲剧地剥夺了发展中国家儿童的救命药。
en: Without an endorsement by the FDA, the company was unwilling to market the product, and so it remains unavailable, tragically depriving children in developing countries of a life-saving therapy.

zh: 就连生物制药作物的田间试验也大有问题。
en: Even field testing biopharmed plants has proved problematic.

zh: 2003年，美国农业部发布了关于以制药目的开发的作物的繁琐测试新规。
en: In 2003, the US Department of Agriculture announced onerous new rules for testing crops engineered to produce pharmaceuticals.

zh: 从表面上看，这一规则的目标是避免食品供应受到药品污染，特别是在用适用作物生产它们的情况下。
en: The ostensible objective of the regulation is to avoid contaminating food supplies with drugs, especially when edible crops are used to produce them.

zh: 但食品业的担忧 — — 生物制药作物污染它们的产品 — — 有过度之嫌。
en: But the food industry’s worries that biopharmed plants could contaminate their products are overblown.

zh: 无论如何，风险可以用多种方法降低，最显而易见的便是使用烟草等非粮食作物。
en: And in any case, the risk can be mitigated in several ways, most obviously by using non-food plants like tobacco.

zh: 事实上，即使生物制药作物污染粮食作物，消费者通过玉米片、意大利面或豆腐摄入有害量处方药的可能性也非常低。
en: In fact, even if biopharmed plants were to contaminate food crops, the likelihood that consumers would end up with harmful amounts of prescription drugs in their corn flakes, pasta, or tofu is very small.

zh: 基因流是一个由来已久的过程，农民对此有着深刻的理解。 农民种植数百种作物，几乎每一种都通过各种技术进行过基因改造。
en: Gene flow is an age-old process that is well understood by farmers, who grow hundreds of crops, virtually all of which have been genetically improved in some way with a variety of techniques.

zh: 因此，他们小心翼翼地发展了各种防止田间花粉交叉感染的策略 — — 只要在商业上有必要。
en: As a result, they have developed meticulous strategies for preventing pollen cross-contamination in the field – when and if it is necessary for commercial reasons.

zh: 即使一些作物被污染，活跃药物成分出现以足够大量出现在最终食品产品中、足以给人类健康造成负面影响的概率也十分低。
en: Even if some crops were to become contaminated, the chances that active drug substances would be present in the final food product at sufficient levels to have an adverse effect on human health would remain very small.

zh: 生物制药作物将与各种作物混杂在一起，其药用成分将大大稀释。
en: The biopharmed plant would be pooled into a large harvest, where its pharmaceuticals would be heavily diluted.

zh: 活跃成分还将经历研磨和其他处理过程，然后被烹饪，还需要在口腔中就见效（orally active，大部分蛋白质药物不具备这一性质 ） ， 因为在胃中它们会被消化。
en: The active agent would then need to survive milling and other processing, and then cooking, and it would need to be orally active, which protein drugs most often are not, because they are digested in the stomach.

zh: 当然，所有这些条件都具备的可能性也不是零。
en: The chance of all of this occurring is not zero, of course.

zh: 但是，各种因素的组合 — — 包括自然选择、农民追求其自身商业利益以及责任问题 — — 都不利于这一可能，发生几率很低，影响也几乎肯定非常小。
en: But, with a combination of factors – including natural selection, farmers’ pursuit of their commercial self-interest, and liability concerns – militating against such a possibility, the odds are very long, and the impact would almost certainly be very low.

zh: 与开发制药业的“下一个大事件”的可能性相比，或者与以低成本成产高价值成分的可能性相比，监管者斤斤计较于这种可能性极低的事件是极不合理的。
en: When you weigh this against the possibility of the development of the drug industry’s Next Big Thing or, at the very least, a new method to produce high-value compounds at low cost, regulators’ preoccupation with such unlikely events appears to be misplaced.

zh: 生物制药能给我们带来很大的裨益。
en: Biopharming has much to offer us.

zh: 但是，要想从我们能够播种的东西中有所收获，我们需要全世界监管者采取基于科学的合理政策。
en: If we are to reap what we can sow, however, we will need reasonable, science-based policies from regulators worldwide.

zh: 悲哀的是，借用诺贝尔经济学奖获得者米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）的话说，这就好比是希望猫能吠一样。
en: Sadly, to borrow a phrase from the late Nobel laureate economist Milton Friedman, that is like wishing that our cats could bark.

zh: 货币空间的野蛮人
en: Barbarians at the Monetary Gate

zh: 香港—眼下，金融市场兴旺发达。
en: HONG KONG – Financial markets today are thriving.

zh: 因投资者在普遍的不确定性中寻找稳定性，道琼斯工业平均指数、标准普尔500指数和纳斯达克综合指数最近纷纷创出历史新高，新兴经济体金融市场表现也很强劲。
en: The Dow Jones industrial average, the S&P 500, and the Nasdaq composite index have all reached record highs lately, with emerging-economy financial markets also performing strongly, as investors search for stability amid widespread uncertainty.

zh: 但是，这一强劲表现不是基于市场基本面，因此是不可持续的，也是非常危险的。
en: But, because this performance is not based on market fundamentals, it is unsustainable – and very risky.

zh: 穆罕默德·艾利安（Mohamed El-Erian）指出，人们没有从2007年金融危机汲取的教训是，当前的经济增长模式“过于依赖流动性和杠杆 — — 先是来自私营金融机构，然后来自央行 ” 。
en: According to Mohamed El-Erian, the lost lesson of the 2007 financial crisis is that current economic-growth models are “overly reliant on liquidity and leverage – from private financial institutions, and then from central banks.”

zh: 而事实上，当前金融市场表现背后的一个关键因素是人们预期央行流动性还会继续保持充裕。
en: And, indeed, a key driver of financial markets’ performance today is the expectation of continued central-bank liquidity.

zh: 上个月，美联储决定保持利率不变，此后道琼斯工业平均指数频频创出日内和收盘新高；纳斯达克综合指数也创造了历史新高。
en: After the US Federal Reserved revealed its decision last month to leave interest rates unchanged, the Dow Jones industrial average set intraday and closing records; the Nasdaq, too, reached all-time highs.

zh: 目前，金融市场正等待在怀俄明州杰克森霍尔（Jackson Hole）举行的世界主要央行行长会议的信号。
en: Now, financial markets are waiting for signals from this year’s meeting of the world’s major central bankers in Jackson Hole, Wyoming.

zh: 但另一个因素可能会进一步动摇已经摇摇欲坠的基于杠杆和流动性的全球金融系统，这就是数字货币。
en: But there is another factor that could further destabilize an already-tenuous leverage- and liquidity-based system: digital currencies.

zh: 在这方面，决策者和监管者还远远不能掌控局面。
en: And, on this front, policymakers and regulators have far less control.

zh: 私密货币的概念产生于对官方货币的不信任。
en: The concept of private cryptocurrencies was born of mistrust of official money.

zh: 2008年，神秘的比特币（第一种分散化的数字货币）创造者中本聪（Satoshi Nakamoto）把比特币说成是“点对点版的电子现金 ” ， 它“让在线支付由一方直接支付给另一方，而不必经过金融机构。 ”
en: In 2008, Satoshi Nakamoto – the mysterious creator of bitcoin, the first decentralized digital currency – described it as a “purely peer-to-peer version of electronic cash,” which “would allow online payments to be sent directly from one party to another without going through a financial institution.”

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）的一篇2016年工作论文将数字货币（可以数字化的法定货币）和虚拟货币（非法定货币）做了区分。
en: A 2016 working paper by the International Monetary Fund distinguished digital currency (legal tender that could be digitized) from virtual currency (non-legal tender).

zh: 比特币是私密货币，或者说是一种用加密算法和分布式记账（区块链）来保证交易公开和完全匿名的虚拟货币。
en: Bitcoin is a cryptocurrency, or a kind of virtual currency that uses cryptography and distributed ledgers (the blockchain) to keep transactions both public and fully anonymous.

zh: 不管你如何剖析，事实就是，在中本聪发明比特币九年后，私密电子货币的概念大有让金融市场改头换面之势。
en: However you slice it, the fact is that, nine years after Nakamoto introduced bitcoin, the concept of private electronic money is poised to transform the financial-market landscape.

zh: 本月，比特币币值达到了4,483美元，总市值达到了745亿美元，比2017年年初增加了五倍多。
en: This month, the value of bitcoin reached $4,483, with a market cap of $74.5 billion, more than five times larger than at the beginning of 2017.

zh: 不论这是一个注定将破灭的泡沫，还是一个货币概念发生更彻底的变化的预兆，其对中央银行业务和金融稳定的影响都将是深远的。
en: Whether this is a bubble, destined to collapse, or a sign of a more radical shift in the concept of money, the implications for central banking and financial stability will be profound.

zh: 一开始，央行和监管者对以比特币以及作为比特币基础的区块链为代表的创新相当支持。
en: At first, central bankers and regulators were rather supportive of the innovation represented by bitcoin and the blockchain that underpins it.

zh: 很难论证不应该允许人们用私人创造的资产，在没有国家介入的情况下结算交易。
en: It is difficult to argue that people should not be allowed to use a privately created asset to settle transactions without the involvement of the state.

zh: 但监管当局担心这种资产可能用于非法交易，比如一家名为丝路（Silk Road）的基于比特币的暗网市场里就有毒品交易。
en: But national authorities were wary of potential illegal uses of such assets, reflected in the bitcoin-enabled, dark-web marketplace called Silk Road, a clearinghouse for, among other things, illicit drugs.

zh: 丝路在2013年被取缔，但此后有更多的类似市场涌现。
en: Silk Road was shut down in 2013, but more such marketplaces have sprung up.

zh: 2014年，比特币交易所Mt.
en: When the bitcoin exchange Mt.

zh: Gox倒闭，中国人民银行等一些央行开始阻击比特币的使用。
en: Gox failed in 2014, some central banks, such as the People’s Bank of China, started discouraging the use of bitcoin.

zh: 到2015年11月，由十家主要央行组建的国际清算银行支付和市场基础设施委员会（Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures）进行了对数字货币的深度考察。
en: By November 2015, the Bank for International Settlements’ Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures, made up of ten major central banks, launched an in-depth examination of digital currencies.

zh: 但私密货币的威胁不仅在于它为非法活动提供了便利，而且，和传统纸币一样，私密电子货币不具有内在价值。
en: But the danger of cryptocurrencies extends beyond facilitation of illegal activities. Like conventional currencies, cryptocurrencies have no intrinsic value.

zh: 但和官方纸币不同，它们也没有相应的负债，这意味着不存在类似于央行的机构来维持其币值的义务及相应利益。
en: But, unlike official money, they also have no corresponding liability, meaning that there is no institution like a central bank with a vested interest in sustaining their value.

zh: 相反，私密货币的功能是基于人们参与交易、接受它们的价值的意愿。
en: Instead, cryptocurrencies function based on the willingness of people engaged in transactions to treat them as valuable.

zh: 加密货币的价值主张依赖于吸引越来越多的用户，因此也就具备庞氏骗局的特征。
en: With the value of the proposition depending on attracting more and more users, cryptocurrencies take on the quality of a Ponzi scheme.

zh: 随着私密货币使用量的扩大，崩溃的潜在后果也更加严重。
en: As the scale of cryptocurrency usage expands, so do the potential consequences of a collapse.

zh: 目前，私密货币的市值已经接近官方实物黄金存量价值的十分之一，拜其交易成本低的特点所赐，私密货币能够处理规模大得多的支付操作。
en: Already, the market capitalization of cryptocurrencies amounts to nearly one tenth the value of the physical stock of official gold, with the capability to handle significantly larger payment operations, owing to low transaction costs.

zh: 这意味着私密货币在规模上已经具有系统性影响。
en: That means that cryptocurrencies are already systemic in scale.

zh: 这一趋势还会走多远不得而知。
en: There is no telling how far this trend will go.

zh: 技术上，私密货币的供给是无限的：比特币的上限是2,100万个单位，但如果绝大多数“矿工 ” （ 向公开账目上增加分布式记账记录的人）同意，这一上限可以提高。
en: Technically, the supply of cryptocurrencies is infinite: bitcoin is capped at 21 million units, but this can be increased if a majority of “miners” (who add transaction records to the public ledger) agree.

zh: 需求取决于人们对常规价值储藏手段的不信任程度。
en: Demand is related to mistrust of conventional stores of value.

zh: 如果人们担心过度的税收、监管或社会和金融动荡威胁到他们的资产，他们就越多地囤积私密货币。
en: If people fear that excessive taxation, regulation, or social or financial instability places their assets at risk, they will increasingly turn to cryptocurrencies.

zh: 去年的IMF报告表明，在中国、塞浦路斯、希腊和委内瑞拉，私密货币已经被用来规避外汇和资本管制。
en: Last year’s IMF report indicated that cryptocurrencies have already been used to circumvent exchange and capital controls in China, Cyprus, Greece, and Venezuela.

zh: 对面临政治不确定性和社会动荡的国家来说，私密货币提供了很有吸引力的资本出逃机制，加剧了保持国内金融稳定的困难。
en: For countries subject to political uncertainty or social unrest, cryptocurrencies offer an attractive mechanism of capital flight, exacerbating the difficulties of maintaining domestic financial stability.

zh: 此外，尽管国家在管理私密货币方面还没有什么作用，但它却需要负责为可能的泡沫破裂收拾残局。
en: Moreover, while the state has no role in managing cryptocurrencies, it will be responsible for cleaning up any mess left by a burst bubble.

zh: 此外，取决于泡沫在哪里以及在何时破灭，留下的残局可能很难收拾。
en: And, depending on where and when a bubble bursts, the mess could be substantial.

zh: 在拥有储备货币的发达经济体，央行可能能够更容易减轻伤害。
en: In advanced economies with reserve currencies, central banks may be able to mitigate the damage.

zh: 而对新兴经济体来说就未必如此了。
en: The same may not be true for emerging economies.

zh: 一种新的入侵物种不会立即给森林中最大的树木造成威胁。
en: An invasive new species does not pose an immediate threat to the largest trees in the forest.

zh: 但要不了多久，欠发达系统 — — 森林底层的幼苗 — — 就会感受到影响。
en: But it doesn’t take long for less-developed systems – the saplings on the forest floor – to feel the effects.

zh: 对私密货币不能停留在仅仅饶有兴致地去观察一个新物种， 央行必须马上行动起来，遏制它们可能造成的实实在在的威胁。
en: Cryptocurrencies are not merely new species to watch with interest; central banks must act now to rein in the very real threats they pose.

zh: 加密愚人金？
en: Crypto-Fool’s Gold?

zh: 坎布里奇—加密货币比特币是当今世上最大的泡沫，还是押注于尖端新金融技术的伟达投资？
en: CAMBRIDGE – Is the cryptocurrency Bitcoin the biggest bubble in the world today, or a great investment bet on the cutting edge of new-age financial technology?

zh: 我的最佳猜测是，从长期看，这项技术会繁荣，但比特币价格也会崩溃。
en: My best guess is that in the long run, the technology will thrive, but that the price of Bitcoin will collapse.

zh: 如果你还不了解比特币的故事的话，它是这样的：比特币价格在过去12个月里上涨了600 % ， 在过去24个月里上涨了1,600 % 。
en: If you haven’t been following the Bitcoin story, its price is up 600% over the past 12 months, and 1,600% in the past 24 months.

zh: 如今，这种虚拟货币每个单位价格超过4,200美元（10月5日价格 ） ， 是一盎司黄金价格的三倍多。
en: At over $4,200 (as of October 5), a single unit of the virtual currency is now worth more than three times an ounce of gold.

zh: 一些比特币拥趸认为它还会在未来几年大幅上涨。
en: Some Bitcoin evangelists see it going far higher in the next few years.

zh: 到底会怎样，在很大程度上取决于政府怎么做。
en: What happens from here will depend a lot on how governments react.

zh: 政府会容忍方便避税和犯罪的匿名支付系统吗？
en: Will they tolerate anonymous payment systems that facilitate tax evasion and crime?

zh: 政府会创造自己的数字货币吗？
en: Will they create digital currencies of their own?

zh: 另一个关键问题是比特币的众多“另类货币”竞争对手们能够在多大呈上渗透这个市场。
en: Another key question is how successfully Bitcoin’s numerous “alt-coin” competitors can penetrate the market.

zh: 理论上，克隆或改进比特币技术非常容易。
en: In principle, it is supremely easy to clone or improve on Bitcoin’s technology.

zh: 不容易之处是复制比特币所建立的领先的信誉以及围绕它所建立起来的庞大的应用生态系统。
en: What is not so easy is to duplicate Bitcoin’s established lead in credibility and the large ecosystem of applications that have built up around it.

zh: 目前，监管环境仍然非常自由。
en: For now, the regulatory environment remains a free-for-all.

zh: 中国政府担心比特币用于资本外逃和避税，最近禁止了比特币交易。
en: China’s government, concerned about the use of Bitcoin in capital flight and tax evasion, has recently banned Bitcoin exchanges.

zh: 另一方面，日本将比特币列为法定货币，显然希望借此成为全球金融技术中心。
en: Japan, on the other hand, has enshrined Bitcoin as legal tender, in an apparent bid to become the global center of fintech.

zh: 美国也跟随日本的脚步，对监管金融技术做出了一些尝试，但结果到底怎样仍不清楚。
en: The United States is taking tentative steps to follow Japan in regulating fintech, though the endgame is far from clear.

zh: 重要的是，比特币并不需要在每条战线上都取得胜利才能证明它值高价。
en: Importantly, Bitcoin does not need to win every battle to justify a sky-high price.

zh: 作为世界第三大经济体，日本的货币-收入比非常高（达到了20%左右 ） ， 因此比特币在日本取得成功是一场重大胜利。
en: Japan, the world’s third largest economy, has an extraordinarily high currency-to-income ratio (roughly 20%), so Bitcoin’s success there is a major triumph.

zh: 在硅谷，垂涎三尺的高管们同时投资于比特币和它的竞争对手们。
en: In Silicon Valley, drooling executives are both investing in Bitcoin and pouring money into competitors.

zh: 除了比特币，最重要的以太坊（Ethereum ） 。
en: After Bitcoin, the most important is Ethereum.

zh: 以太坊有着亚马逊式的横扫一切的雄心，意欲让用户使用一样的通用技术，为一切东西谈判和制定“智能合同 ” 。
en: The sweeping, Amazon-like ambition of Ethereum is to allow its users to employ the same general technology to negotiate and write “smart contracts” for just about anything.

zh: 10月初，以太坊市值大约为280亿美元，而比特币为720亿美元。
en: As of early October, Ethereum’s market capitalization stood at $28 billion, versus $72 billon for Bitcoin.

zh: 由银行部门建立、可大幅降低同业和海外转账交易成本的平台Ripple名列第三，但遥遥落后，市值只有90亿美元。
en: Ripple, a platform championed by the banking sector to slash transaction costs for interbank and overseas transfers, is a distant third at $9 billion.

zh: 前三强之后还有数十家新晋竞争者。
en: Behind the top three are dozens of fledgling competitors.

zh: 大部分专家都认为，虚拟货币背后的精妙科技可以在网络安全方面起到广泛作用。 目前，网络安全是全球金融体系所面临的最大额稳定性挑战之一。
en: Most experts agree that the ingenious technology behind virtual currencies may have broad applications for cyber security, which currently poses one of the biggest challenges to the stability of the global financial system.

zh: 对许多开发者来说，实现更廉价、更安全的支付机制已经替代了比特币取代美元的野心。
en: For many developers, the goal of achieving a cheaper, more secure payments mechanism has supplanted Bitcoin’s ambition of replacing dollars.

zh: 但你如果认为比特币有望成为央行发行货币的补充，那就失之愚蠢了。
en: But it is folly to think that Bitcoin will ever be allowed to supplant central-bank-issued money.

zh: 政府允许用虚拟货币进行小型匿名交易，这是一回事，事实上，这是值得追求的事。
en: It is one thing for governments to allow small anonymous transactions with virtual currencies; indeed, this would be desirable.

zh: 但政府允许大规模匿名支付，从而让征税和打击犯罪活动变得极其困难，这就是截然不同的另一回事了。
en: But it is an entirely different matter for governments to allow large-scale anonymous payments, which would make it extremely difficult to collect taxes or counter criminal activity.

zh: 当然，我在关于过去、现在和未来的货币的近著中指出，发行大额钞票的政府也有可能会便利避税和犯罪。
en: Of course, as I note in my recent book on past, present, and future currencies, governments that issue large-denomination bills also risk aiding tax evasion and crime.

zh: 但现金和虚拟货币不同，它至少是实物存在。
en: But cash at least has bulk, unlike virtual currency.

zh: 看看日本的试验如何演进将是一件饶有兴致的事情。
en: It will be interesting to see how the Japanese experiment evolves.

zh: 日本政府已经表明，它将强制要求比特币交易所接受犯罪行为监控并要收集关于比特币存款持有者的信息。
en: The government has indicated that it will force Bitcoin exchanges to be on the lookout for criminal activity and to collect information on deposit holders.

zh: 尽管如此，我们仍然可以确定，全球避税者会设法匿名从国外获取比特币，然后通过日本账户将钱漂白。
en: Still, one can be sure that global tax evaders will seek ways to acquire Bitcoin anonymously abroad and then launder their money through Japanese accounts.

zh: 携带纸币进出一个国家对于避税者和罪犯来说代价高昂；接受虚拟货币的日本有可能成为瑞士式的避税港 — — 银行保密法让位给了技术。
en: Carrying paper currency in and out of a country is a major cost for tax evaders and criminals; by embracing virtual currencies, Japan risks becoming a Switzerland-like tax haven – with the bank secrecy laws baked into the technology.

zh: 如果比特币失去了几乎匿名的特点，其当前价格便很难支撑。
en: Were Bitcoin stripped of its near-anonymity, it would be hard to justify its current price.

zh: 也许比特币投机客是下注于永远会找到流氓国家联盟允许使用匿名的比特币，甚至有朝鲜这样的国家会利用比特币。
en: Perhaps Bitcoin speculators are betting that there will always be a consortium of rogue states allowing anonymous Bitcoin usage, or even state actors such as North Korea that will exploit it.

zh: 如果政府能够完美地观察到交易情况，比特币价格是否会归零？
en: Would the price of Bitcoin drop to zero if governments could perfectly observe transactions?

zh: 也许不会。
en: Perhaps not.

zh: 即使比特币交易需要大量电力，但只要稍加改进，比特币就能击败大银行对信用卡和借记卡所收的2%的费用。
en: Even though Bitcoin transactions require an exorbitant amount of electricity, with some improvements, Bitcoin might still beat the 2% fees the big banks charge on credit and debit cards.

zh: 最后，很难说有什么东西能够阻止央行创造自己的数字货币，并用监管手段给予它们竞争地位，直到它们胜出。
en: Finally, it is hard to see what would stop central banks from creating their own digital currencies and using regulation to tilt the playing field until they win.

zh: 漫长的货币史告诉我们，对于私人部门的创新发明，国家最终都会监管并收归己有。
en: The long history of currency tells us that what the private sector innovates, the state eventually regulates and appropriates.

zh: 我不知道未来几年比特币价格会达到什么程度，但没有理由认为虚拟货币能逃脱同样的命运。
en: I have no idea where Bitcoin’s price will go over the next couple years, but there is no reason to expect virtual currency to avoid a similar fate.

zh: 对印度机构的攻击
en: An Assault on India’s Institutions

zh: 新德里—在印度卡他塔克邦，邦长支持印度人民党（BJP）组建邦政府，尽管反对联盟在邦立法机关赢得了更多席位。
en: NEW DELHI – In India’s Karnataka state, the governor is favoring the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) to form a government, despite an opposition coalition having won more seats in the state legislature.

zh: 这场正在进行中的争论引发人们关注宪法地位是如何降低到服务于印度执政党的政治利益的。
en: The ongoing controversy has drawn attention to the way in which a constitutional position has been reduced to serving the political interests of India’s ruling party.

zh: 能够超然于激烈的政治斗争运行的强大的公共机构是民主的关键。
en: Strong public institutions that operate above the cut and thrust of the political fray are vital to any democracy.

zh: 但在过去四年中，在全世界最大的民主国家印度，这些堪称无价之宝的机构无不经受着威胁，因为咄咄逼人的BJP印度教沙文主义政府要巩固自己的权威。
en: Yet in the last four years, every such priceless institution in the world’s largest democracy, India, has come under threat, as the BJP’s assertive Hindu-chauvinist government works to consolidate its own authority.

zh: 我们先把邦长放在一边（BJP在2014年赢得选举后马上要求所有邦长辞职，以便为政治任命让路 ） ， 先从司法系统开始，自1月份以来，司法系统一直饱受关注，最高法院的四位最高级别法官举行了一次前所未有的新闻发布会，质疑司法部长迪帕克·米斯拉（Dipak Misra）的案件分派。
en: Leave aside governors (the BJP asked all to resign to make way for political appointees soon after its 2014 election victory) and start with the judicial system, which has come under scrutiny since January, when the Supreme Court’s four most senior judges held an unprecedented press conference to question Chief Justice Dipak Misra’s allocation of cases.

zh: 他们的评论暗指米斯拉把案件分派给他偏向的法官，据说（尽管从未公开宣称）这是为了确保结果有利于政府。
en: Misra, their comments implied, was assigning cases to his preferred judges, presumably (though this was never stated) in an effort to secure outcomes favoring the government.

zh: 三个月后，一些反对党发动了一场在联邦院（议会上演）弹劾米斯拉的运动。
en: Three months later, several opposition parties circulated an impeachment motion against Misra in the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of parliament.

zh: 联邦院主席、印度副总统奈杜拒绝了弹劾，两位议员要求最高法院挑战这一决定。
en: After the Rajya Sabha’s chairman, Indian Vice President Venkaiah Naidu, rejected the motion, two MPs asked the Supreme Court to challenge that decision.

zh: 但米斯拉制定了一位看上去最有利于他的法官来听取上诉 — — 促使议员收回了成命。
en: But Misra named a bench seemingly favorable to him to hear their appeal – prompting the MPs to withdraw their case.

zh: 米斯拉也许安全了，但司法部的形象因此受到了难以恢复的伤害。
en: Misra may be safe, but the judiciary’s image has taken a beating from which it will not easily recover.

zh: 去年，印度选举委员会（EC）也曝出了名誉扫地的事件。 几十年来，EC致力于组织自由公平的选举，尽管其成员大多是政府任命的固定任期的退休公务员。
en: The reputation of India’s Election Commission (EC) – which has a decades-long record of conducting free and fair elections, despite comprising largely retired civil servants appointed by the government for fixed tenures – also took a severe blow last year.

zh: BJP任命的时任EC主席阿查尔·库马尔·乔迪（Achal Kumar Jyoti）违反EC章程，宣布喜马偕尔邦和古吉拉特邦的选举日期相隔13天，尽管着两个邦通常都同时举行选举。
en: In a break from its Code of Conduct, the EC’s BJP-appointed then-chief, Achal Kumar Jyoti, announced the dates for elections in Himachal Pradesh and Gujarat 13 days apart, even though the two states normally go to the polls simultaneously.

zh: EC宣称推迟古吉拉特邦选举是为了不让选举章程（它限制政府对邦的支出）影响到抗洪救灾工作。
en: The EC claimed that it delayed the announcement on Gujarat so that the electoral Code of Conduct (which would restrict government spending in the state) would not impede flood relief.

zh: 但大部分印度人认为BJP施压EC尽可能推迟选举，以便其通过最后的赠品吸引选民 — — 这与抗洪救灾完全没有关系。
en: But most Indians believe that the BJP pressured the EC to delay the announcement as long as possible, so that it could attract voters with last-minute giveaways that had nothing to do with flood relief.

zh: 古吉拉特邦政府、甚至总理莫迪随后都宣布了多项类似机制。
en: The Gujarat government and even Prime Minister Narendra Modi subsequently announced several such schemes.

zh: 前选举委员们一致谴责EC的这一决定，但完全是徒劳的。
en: Former election commissioners unanimously condemned the EC’s decision, to no avail.

zh: 更糟糕的是，1月份EC以技术问题为由，决定取消德里立法机关的20位平民党（Aam Aadmi Party）委员的资格 — — 如果进行补选的话，结果有可能令BJP获益。
en: Making matters worse, the EC decided in January to disqualify 20 Aam Aadmi Party members of the Delhi Legislature on technical grounds – an action that could have benefited the BJP if by-elections to their seats had followed.

zh: 德里高等法院推翻了这一决定，说其“不合法 ” ， 也“违反了自然正义原则。
en: The Delhi High Court overruled that decision, calling it “bad in law” and “violating principles of natural justice.”

zh: ”但是，和司法部的案例一样，伤害已经造成：曾经的印度民主程序的刚正不阿的监护人，在BJP的压力下，扭曲了自己的角色，削弱了自己在印度人民中的地位。
en: But, as in the case of the judiciary, the damage was done: what was once the impartial custodian of India’s democratic process has – under BJP pressure – distorted its role, weakening its standing among Indians.

zh: 下一个日益名誉扫地的银都机构是印度储备银行（RBI ） 。
en: The list of increasingly discredited Indian institutions continues with the Reserve Bank of India.

zh: 2016年11月推出的灾难性的禁钞过程引起了人们广泛的批评，认为RBI没能行使自己的信托责任。
en: The disastrous demonetization process of November 2016 spurred widespread criticism of the RBI for failing to perform its fiduciary duties.

zh: 平心而论，当BJP做出这一决定时，并没有恰当地咨询RBI。
en: To be sure, the RBI did not appear to have been properly consulted when the BJP made its decision.

zh: 尽管如此，RBI完全没能预料到该机制会导致的问题，也没有使用其自治权改善实施工作和尽量减少消极影响。
en: Nonetheless, it roundly failed to anticipate the problems that the scheme would cause, and to use its autonomy to improve implementation and minimize negative effects.

zh: 相反，RBI在70天里发布了138项关于禁钞过程的通知，每一次新通知都会修改早前的通知，比如可能会收回多少钱、截止到何日等。
en: Instead, the RBI issued 138 notifications about the demonetization process over 70 days, with each new announcement amounting to a tweak of an earlier declaration about, for example, how much money could be withdrawn and by when.

zh: 看上去RBI已经沦为了傀儡，完全受BJP政府的摆布。
en: It was as if the RBI had been reduced to a puppet, with the BJP government pulling its strings.

zh: 去年1月，储备银行官员和员工联合论坛（United Forum of Reserve Bank Officers and Employees）致信政府强调了“操作失误 ” ， 指出这些失误“削弱了RBI的自治权，对RBI的名誉造成了不可修复的伤害。
en: In January of last year, the United Forum of Reserve Bank Officers and Employees wrote to the government to highlight “operational mismanagement,” which they argued had “dented the RBI’s autonomy and reputation beyond repair.”

zh: ”RBI行长厄尔吉特·帕特尔（Urjit Patel）像一只沉默的羔羊一样一言不发。
en: The silence of the RBI’s governor, Urjit Patel, reduced him to a lamb.

zh: 但在这个案例中，这只“沉默的羔羊”也给RBI本身 — — 再一次 — — 造成了长期后果。
en: But, in this case, the “silence of the lamb” was cannibalizing the RBI itself, with – yet again – long-lasting consequences.

zh: 莫迪政府还喜欢将安全机构政治化。
en: Modi’s government has been similarly willing to politicize security institutions.

zh: 比如，其搁置两位军衔更高的将领，任命毕平·拉瓦特（Bipin Rawat）中将为陆军参谋长，完全无视历史悠久的晋升传统。
en: For example, in appointing Lieutenant General Bipin Rawat as Chief of Army Staff, the government bypassed two higher-ranking generals, flouting time-honored principles of seniority.

zh: 此外，莫迪政府多次在政治宣传中使用军队，公开此前的整个福保密的行动细节（如宣布对巴基斯坦控制领土上的恐怖分子基地实施“精确打击 ” ） 。
en: Moreover, the government has repeatedly used the military in its political propaganda, making public operational details that previous governments had kept secret (such as announcing a “surgical strike” on terrorist bases in Pakistani-controlled territory).

zh: 在最近的卡纳塔克邦选举中，莫迪本人明目张胆地用印度军队满足自己的短期利益，以辱骂两位来自该邦的陆军首长为由，撤了第一副总理的职。
en: During the recent Karnataka state elections, Modi himself flagrantly exploited the Indian military for his own short-term ends, by denouncing India’s first prime minister for allegedly having insulted two army chiefs from the state, though this never, occurred.

zh: 德里警察和联邦调查机关 — — 特别是中央调查局（CBI ） — —也不能免于政治化。
en: The Delhi police and the federal investigative agencies – in particular, the Central Bureau of Investigation – are not safe from politicization, either.

zh: 在BJP治下，CBI甚至被人说成是“笼中鹦鹉 ” ， 其工作曾经被视为印度打击犯罪的黄金标准，现在常常被视为怀有政治动机。
en: The CBI has even been described as a “caged parrot” under the BJP, with its work, once considered the gold standard in Indian crime-fighting, now often viewed as politically motivated.

zh: 旨在确保透明度和可问责性的信息权利法（Right to Information Act）在政府的拖拉下变成了一纸空文，国家监察官至今没有任命，而距离创设这一职位的法律获得通过已经过去了近五年。
en: The Right to Information Act, intended to ensure transparency and accountability, has been hollowed out by government foot-dragging, and a national Ombudsman, or Lokpal, has not yet been appointed, nearly five years after a law was passed to create the position.

zh: 自从一家国立中学曝出试题泄露、迫使160万学生重新考试以来，中学教育中央委员会的诚信一直饱受质疑。
en: Doubt has also been cast on the integrity of the Central Board of Secondary Education, after questions for a national school exam were leaked, forcing 1.6 million students to re-sit the test.

zh: 类似的问题在法律和医学入学考试和文官招聘考试中也发生过。
en: Similar problems have arisen over admissions tests to study law and medicine, as well as exams for clerical positions.

zh: 如今，工作岗位的数量远远低于工人，对竞争性考试制度可以作为公平评估学生的手段的信任度的下降有可能威胁到社会和平。
en: At a time when there are far fewer jobs than workers, declining faith in the competitive examination system as a fair means of evaluating students could undermine social peace.

zh: 甚至印度议会 — — “民主的庙堂 ” — —也是闹剧频出，2018年4月，BJP盟友和支持者故意让人民院（议会下院）的预算会议陷入僵局。
en: Even the Indian parliament – the “temple of democracy” – has seen its work reduced to a farce, as BJP allies and supporters purposely brought the budget session of the Lok Sabha (the lower house) to a standstill in April 2018.

zh: BJP任命的议长宣布她无法在喧闹中清点人头，反对党针对政府的不信任运动甚至没有得到讨论。
en: With the BJP-appointed speaker claiming that she could not count heads in the din, opposition parties’ motion of no confidence against the government was not even debated.

zh: 这些行为受到对最后的关键制度 — — 新闻自由的攻击的助推，目前，新闻媒体面对政府唯我独尊的权力噤若寒蝉，更不用说政府赤裸裸的恐吓和选择主流媒体的行为了。
en: Such behavior is being facilitated by an assault on a final critical institution: the free press, which now seems largely to have been cowed by the government’s overweening power, not to mention its explicit intimidation and co-opting of mainstream outlets.

zh: 如果坐视这一对印度公共机构的攻击继续下去的话，公众将失去对一整套制度的信任。
en: If this assault on India’s institutions is allowed to continue, the public could lose faith in the system altogether.

zh: 这将给印度最宝贵的资产 — — 民主造成不可估量的后果。
en: This would carry incalculable consequences for India’s most valuable asset: its democracy.

zh: 为发展而生的能源
en: The Power to Develop

zh: 发自堪培拉 — — 取舍是人生固有的一个部分，而我们都从自己的私人预算安排中认识到了这一点。
en: CANBERRA – Trade-offs are an inherent part of life. We all recognize this from our private budgets.

zh: 为了翻修屋顶，暑假度假的支出可能不得不减少一点；点了便宜一些的葡萄酒，就可以上一些更昂贵的甜点。
en: To fix the roof, we may have to accept a less extravagant summer vacation. When we pick a cheaper wine, we can splurge on dessert.

zh: 取舍在环境政策中也很普遍：如果在削减某一类污染物上投入较多，那么留给解决其他问题的资源就会相应减少。
en: Trade-offs also pervade environmental policy: Cutting more of one pollutant, for example, leaves fewer resources to address other issues.

zh: 比如说煤炭造成了惊人的污染，但它也提供了廉价和可靠的电力去推动发展。
en: For example, coal is phenomenally polluting, but it also provides for cheap and reliable power, which drives development.

zh: 在过去的30年中，中国主要借助燃煤就使6.8亿人摆脱了贫困。
en: Over the past 30 years, China has lifted 680 million people out of poverty, mostly through the use of coal.

zh: 其人均富裕程度也比过去增长了13倍有多。
en: The average Chinese has become more than 13 times richer.

zh: 与此同时，北京以及中国许多大城市正遭遇着致病的雾霾，让人不禁联想到1950年代的伦敦。
en: At the same time, Beijing and numerous other Chinese metropolises are experiencing debilitating smog, reminiscent of London in the 1950’s.

zh: 每年约有120万中国人因室外空气污染过早死亡。
en: About 1.2 million Chinese die prematurely each year because of outdoor air pollution.

zh: 北京的空气测量数据表明，空气污染成分中有超过16%来自煤炭。
en: Measurements from Beijing show that upwards of 16% of the air pollution comes from coal.

zh: 世界银行估计，中国的年度总空气污染成本 — — 由中国人表示愿意为降低死亡风险而支付的金额计算得出 — — 竟相当于国内生产总值的4 % 。
en: The World Bank estimates that China’s total annual air-pollution costs – based on what Chinese themselves indicate they are willing to pay to reduce their risk of dying – could be as high as 4% of GDP.

zh: 然而，中国的取舍带来非常大的收益。
en: And yet the Chinese trade-off has been phenomenally beneficial.

zh: 1982年中国人均年薪为585美元，去年已经达到了7958美元。
en: In 1982, the average Chinese earned $585 a year; last year, she earned $7,958.

zh: 而同时产生的人均环境成本则为318美元。
en: Meanwhile, the annual per capita environmental cost is $318.

zh: 因此不出所料，大多数发展中国家都会乐于抓住机会复制中国的增长模式 — — 包括污染。
en: So, not surprisingly, most other developing countries would gratefully seize the opportunity to replicate China’s growth pattern – including its pollution.

zh: 当然，中国可以实施更多的举措去减少空气污染。
en: Of course, the Chinese could do more to cut air pollution.

zh: 据估计如果能符合世界卫生组织暂时设立的标准，中国的人均环境损失将可减少80美元。
en: It is estimated that meeting the World Health Organization’s interim standards could reduce damages by $80 per capita.

zh: 但相比于2013年人均收入600美元的增长，这个数字就不值一提了。
en: But that pales in comparison to the $600 increase in per capita income in 2013.

zh: 尽管如此，许多生活在富裕国家的人依然会自信地宣称这种取舍是不利于穷人的。
en: Nonetheless, many who live in rich countries confidently declare that this trade-off is not in the interest of the poor.

zh: 今年，美国，英国和其他欧洲国家宣布将不再为发展中国家建设燃煤电厂提供国际金融支持。
en: The United States, the United Kingdom, and other European countries announced this year that they will not support international finance for coal-fired power plants in developing countries.

zh: 当世界银行于2010年资助南非兴建迈德匹燃煤发电厂时，这些国家投了弃��票。
en: These countries abstained in 2010 when the World Bank helped finance South Africa’s Medupi coal-fired power plant.

zh: 如今，它们则会投否决票。
en: Today, they would vote it down.

zh: 但迈德匹将提供南非10%的电力并防止反复停电。
en: But Medupi will provide 10% of South Africa’s electricity and prevent rolling blackouts.

zh: 南非财政部长普拉温·戈尔丹（Pravin Gordhan）解释说 ， “ 为了保持增长，我们需要创造工作机会，除了建立新的发电能力，我们别无选择 — — 而这依赖于当前我们最丰富和负担得起的能源：煤炭。
en: As the South African finance minister, Pravin Gordhan, explained, “to sustain the growth rates we need to create jobs, we have no choice but to build new generating capacity – relying on what, for now, remains our most abundant and affordable energy source: coal.”

zh: ”美国政府甚至承认如果没有燃煤发电厂，南非的“经济复苏，电气化，就业以及社会指标都将受到不利影响。 ”
en: The US government even acknowledged that, without a coal-fired power plant, South Africa’s “economic recovery will suffer, adversely impacting electrification, job creation, and social indicators.”

zh: 能源匮乏对三十亿人 — — 也就是几乎一半的世界人口 — — 来说甚至更为严峻，他们在室内烧牲畜粪便，纸板和树枝来做饭和取暖。
en: Energy poverty is even more acute for the three billion people – almost half of the world’s population – who burn dung, cardboard, and twigs indoors to cook and keep warm.

zh: 世界卫生组织估计，在发展中国家城市的室外空气污染可能比发达国家城市高十倍，而通过燃烧木材和粪便造成的平均室内空气污染会高出一百倍。
en: The WHO estimates that while outdoor air pollution in developing-country cities may be ten times higher than in advanced-country cities, average indoor air pollution, caused by burning wood and dung, is a hundred times higher.

zh: 事实上，室内空气污染每年造成350万人死亡，使其成为世界上最严重的环境问题。
en: Indeed, indoor air pollution kills 3.5 million people each year, making it the world’s deadliest environmental problem.

zh: 世界上三十亿缺乏能源的人需要廉价的电力来做饭和取暖。
en: The world’s three billion energy-poor people need cheap electricity to cook and keep warm.

zh: 而且，在可预见的将来，电力将由化石燃料产生。
en: And, for the foreseeable future, that electricity will be generated by fossil fuels.

zh: 一些环保人士呼吁采用更清洁燃烧的炉灶。
en: Some environmental campaigners argue for cleaner stoves.

zh: 虽然这可能是解决方案的一部分，但它本质上也就是告诉穷人使用较小污染的明火在自己家中生活。
en: But, while this might be part of the solution, it is essentially telling the poor to live with slightly less polluting open fires in their homes.

zh: 此外研究也表明，在高度空气污染环境下即便显著降低空气污染也只能产生轻微的影响。
en: Moreover, studies indicate that even significant air-pollution reduction starting at high levels will have only a minor impact.

zh: 其他人认为，可再生能源是必由之路。
en: Others claim that renewables are the way to go.

zh: 绿色能源，特别是风能，的确可以帮助非洲国家，例如为边远地区提供一些电力；而电网将使大多数人受益。
en: Green energy, especially wind, can indeed help African countries, for example, get some electricity to remote, rural areas; but the grid will do the most good for the most people.

zh: 根据世界银行最近一项研究，分布式可再生能源“将是非洲少数家庭成本最低的选择，即使有可能考虑在未来20年削减成本。
en: According to a recent World Bank study, distributed renewable energy “will be the lowest cost option for a minority of households in Africa, even when likely cost reductions over the next 20 years are considered.”

zh: ”受欢迎的太阳能灯成本约2美元每千瓦时。
en: Popular solar lights cost almost $2 per kWh.

zh: 如果使用水力，天然气和石油为埃塞俄比亚，加纳和肯尼亚的主要人口中心供电，电网成本可能是0.16-25美元每千瓦时。
en: Using hydro, gas, and oil, the grid cost for the main population centers in Ethiopia, Ghana, and Kenya will likely be $0.16-25 per kWh.

zh: 在南非，90%的电力来自煤炭，而成本仅为0.09美元每千瓦时。
en: In South Africa, where coal powers 90% of electricity, the cost is just $0.09 per kWh.

zh: 没错，煤炭发电将导致额外的空气污染。
en: True, electricity from coal will cause extra air pollution.

zh: 但室内空气污染将因电气化而消失 — — 这种污染占了室外空气污染的16 % 。
en: But pollution from indoor air pollution, which would disappear with electrification, accounts for 16% of outdoor air pollution.

zh: 即使（不切实际地）假设煤炭导致了世界上所有的空气污染，我们可以使用煤炭每年为三十亿能源缺乏者生产每人250千瓦时电力，而且最终还能降低空气污染。
en: Even assuming (unrealistically) that coal produces all of the world’s air pollution, we could generate 250 kWh/year with coal for every one of the three billion energy-poor people and still end up with lower air pollution.

zh: 此外通过清洁技术的应用，还可以轻易且低成本地减少90%甚至更多的煤污染。
en: Moreover, it is easy and fairly cheap to cut coal pollution 90% or more with scrubbers.

zh: 对于很多燃煤反对者来说，全球变暖才是关键问题。
en: For many opponents of coal, the issue is global warming.

zh: 根据联合国气象主席克里斯蒂安娜·菲格雷斯（Christiana Figueres）所说，煤作为燃料的发展“对环境和人类健康的成本高得令人无法接受。
en: According to Christiana Figueres, the United Nations climate chief, coal-fueled development has “an unacceptably high cost to human and environmental health.”

zh: ”她认为，我们需要关闭地球上75%的燃煤发电厂，包括南非所有的燃煤发电厂，因为它们排出过多的二氧化碳。
