en: This is a classic example of what I call “block thinking,” which seems to have made huge strides in Europe in recent years.

zh: 约翰·鲍文的近作《为什么法国不喜欢头巾》就记录了这种转变。
en: John Bowen’s recent book Why the French Don’t Like Headscarves documents this shift.

zh: 思维一律把各不相同的现实都融进一个牢不可破的联合体中，用的两种方式。
en: Block thinking fuses a varied reality into one indissoluble unity, and in two ways.

zh: 第一种是对伊斯兰教的虔诚或文化的不同表现被看成是以不同的方式表达了同一核心理念。
en: First, different manifestations of Islamic piety or culture are seen as alternative ways of expressing the same core meaning.

zh: 第二种方式是所有的穆斯林人都被看成是支持这些核心理念的。
en: Second, all Muslims are then seen as endorsing these core meanings.

zh: 一个女孩佩戴头巾事实上可能是对她父母以及 他们 所奉行的那种伊斯兰教的反抗，而另一些女孩可能对伊斯兰教非常虔诚同时对性别歧视或暴力极度反感。 但是人们从来不去关心这些可能性。
en: The possibility that a girl wearing a headscarf might in fact be rebelling against her parents and their kind of Islam, and that others might be deeply pious while being utterly revolted by gender discrimination or violence, is lost from view.

zh: 思维一律的现象早已有之，并且我们每个人都有某种程度的思维一律。
en: Block thinking is an age-old phenomenon, and we all do it to some degree.

zh: 但是，在另一个时代我们也许会很宽容它所带来的后果，今天它却可能带有爆炸性的潜在力量，因为以这种方式思考的人最有可能按照萨默尔·亨廷顿的“文明冲突论”的观点来看这个世界。
en: But, while in another age we might have been indulgent about its consequences, today it has explosive potential, because people who think in this manner are prime recruits for seeing the world in terms of Samuel Huntington’s theory of the “clash of civilizations.”

zh: 更糟糕的是，以这种方式思考的人随后采取的行动会更把我们推向亨廷顿所描绘的恶梦般的局面。
en: What’s worse, the way such people then act tends to edge us closer to Huntington’s nightmare scenario.

zh: 他们把持有不同观点的所有伊斯兰教徒都统统看成是对西方的威胁，使得穆斯林更难站出来批评他们自己的思维一律者 — — 就像本·拉登，后者正在树立他们自己的由“基督教徒和犹太教徒”组成的联合敌人。
en: By treating all the varied segments of Islam as nothing more than parts of a unified threat to the West, they make it harder for Muslims to stand out and criticize their own block thinkers – people like Osama bin Laden, who are building their own unified enemy, composed of “Christians and Jews.”

zh: 两方的思维一律者都给另一方的思维一律者以援助和安慰，而伴随这边每一次变动他们把我们推向了更深的深渊。
en: Block thinkers on each side give aid and comfort to block thinkers on the other side, and with each exchange they pull us closer toward an abyss.

zh: 那么我们怎样才能制止这种极度愚蠢的思维方式呢？
en: So how can we stop this madness?

zh: 思维一律者之所以如此顽固部分是因为一方对其的批评者并不为另一方对其的批评者所知晓。
en: Block thought persists in part because its critics on each side are unknown to those on the other side.

zh: 事实上，欧洲思维一律者的批评者经常会碰到这样的回答 ： “ 但是哪里有批评极端伊斯兰的穆斯林呢？ ”
en: Indeed, how many times does a critic of European block thought meet this kind of response: “But where are the Muslims who are criticizing extremist Islam?”

zh: 当然，你不太可能在巴黎记者或者更广泛的欧洲职业政治阶层的客厅里碰到他们。
en: Of course, one isn’t likely to meet them in the drawing rooms of Paris journalists or the wider European professional political class.

zh: 但是对思维一律者解释这一点永远不会起到让他们真正接触在另一面真实发生着的多层面的讨论那样的作用。
en: But explaining that to block thinkers will never have the impact of a real connection to the multi-faceted discourse that is actually taking place on the other side.

zh: 那么，真正的问题就是：能够提供迫切需要的接触的横跨两面的人在哪里呢？
en: The real question, then, is this: Where are the crossover figures who can provide that urgently needed connection?

zh: BMW与中国的司法公正
en: BMW's and Chinese Justice

zh: 在世界的大多数地方 ， " BMW" 代表着华贵奢侈和与众不同。
en: In most places, the name "BMW" implies luxury and exclusivity.

zh: 但在中国，这一品牌却无意间卷入了一些非常事件。 这些事件反映了普通的中国老百姓面对权势和腐败的无奈。
en: But in China, the brand has unwittingly found itself enmeshed in tales that illustrate the powerlessness of ordinary Chinese against the powerful and corrupt.

zh: 第一桩丑闻发生在去年的哈尔滨，其起因是一辆满载着大葱的拖拉机与一辆BMW擦挂。
en: The first scandal occurred last year, after a tractor filled with green onions scraped the side of a BMW in Harbin.

zh: 拖拉机和镀着银灰色金属漆的豪华轿车的驾驶者都是45岁的妇女，但她们之间的共同点也仅止于此了：前者是位农妇，而后者则是一位富商之妻。
en: The drivers of both the tractor and the metallic-silver luxury car were 45-year-old women, but any similarity between them ended there: the former was a peasant, the latter the wife of a wealthy businessman.

zh: 在一番对峙之后，富商之妻驾车冲进街沿上越来越多的围观者，将农妇当场撞死并撞伤了12个围观者。
en: After a confrontation between the two, the wealthy wife drove her BMW into the growing crowd of spectators on the roadside, killing the peasant woman and injuring 12 others.

zh: 这一案件在地方法院进行审理，法官的判决结果是"意外扰乱交通秩序 " ， 撞人者被判入狱两年并缓期执行。
en: The case went to the local court, where the judge ruled it an "accidental traffic disturbance" and gave the driver a two-year suspended sentence.

zh: 法官的判决使得流言四起，其内容都是说法官对肇事者手下留情是因为此人的丈夫与省里的高官有关系。
en: The judge's ruling spurred rumors that he went easy on her because her husband was related to senior provincial officials.

zh: 该案很快就演变成一个"富对贫"的故事并被人们广泛引用为高层腐败的写照。
en: It quickly became a story of "rich versus poor," widely cited as an example of high-level corruption.

zh: 在接下来的几个月里，由于报纸和电视台对该事件滚雪球般地报道使其成为一个全国上下共同关注的话题。
en: Over the next few months, newspapers and television stations ran with the story as it snowballed into a national obsession.

zh: 在公众舆论的压力下，哈尔滨地方法院重新开庭审理了该案，但在今年三月结案时的结论也只是维持缓刑的原判。
en: Alarmed by the public reaction, the Harbin magistrate ordered the case reopened, only to have the suspended sentence confirmed when the case was closed this March.

zh: 此时，另一个发生在2003年末的，与BMW相关的事件也在几乎永远退出公众视线之前，再次悄然浮现。
en: The big BMW story of late 2003 resurfaced quietly, before being buried again forever.

zh: 就在同一个月，一桩彩票抽奖丑闻再一次让BMW这一品牌成为公众关注的焦点。
en: That same month, a lottery scandal threw the BMW brand into the limelight once again.

zh: 陕西省负责彩票发行的官员以造假为由拒绝兑现一张中了头奖的彩票。 这张彩票的持有人是17岁的保安刘亮，他应获的奖品是一辆价值58，000美金的BMW轿车和120，000元现金（约合14，510美金 ） 。
en: Lottery officials in Shaanxi province rejected a winning ticket, calling it a fake and denying its bearer, a 17-year-old security guard named Liu Liang, the grand prize of a $58,000 BMW and 120,000 yuan ($14,510) in cash.

zh: 被控造假和领奖被拒使刘亮怒不可遏，以至于他爬上一块广告牌并威胁要纵身跳下以示清白。
en: Liu became so angry about being accused of fraud and denied the car that he climbed atop a high advertising billboard and threatened to jump as a show of innocence.

zh: 但故事并没有以他被警察劝服而结束。
en: But the story didn't end when police officers managed to talk him down.

zh: 新闻媒介仍报导着他坚持自己没有伪造彩票的事实和 彩票中心合法拒奖的声明。
en: News broadcasts covered his continued insistence that he did not forge his ticket, along with the lottery center's claims that their rejection of the ticket was legitimate.

zh: 警方终于介入了这一事件，并在一番仔细调查之后宣布查出了真正的祸首：杨永明，一个与当地彩票发行部门签约负责组织彩票销售的个体商人。
en: The police finally stepped in and, after a careful investigation, announced that they had found the true criminal: Yang Yongming, a private businessman whom the local lottery administration had contracted to organize ticket sales.

zh: 杨与一些政府官员合谋操纵抽奖试图诈骗头奖奖品。 这些官员也因渎职而被捕。
en: Yang had conspired with the government officials directing the lottery, who were arrested for malfeasance, to fraudulently obtain the top prizes.

zh: 在今年6月，刘亮终于得到了他应得的奖品-一辆BMW-325i型轿车和来自彩票中心的诚挚歉意。
en: In June Liu Liang finally got what he deserved - a BMW-325i sedan and a sincere apology from the lottery center.

zh: 如果说第一桩丑闻是个悲剧，那么第二桩则更像是出闹剧。
en: If the first scandal was a tragedy, the second was more like a farce.

zh: 但两个事件都为我们提供了了解当代中国人心态的机会。
en: But both offer keys to understanding contemporary Chinese psychology.

zh: 在第一桩BMW案发生之后，民间呼声并不在于法庭对富商之妻的判刑太轻而在于普通民众对中国的司法制度缺乏信心。
en: The outcry after the first BMW case was not really about the light sentence given to a rich woman, but about the lack of confidence ordinary people have in China's judicial system.

zh: 在中国，权力、金钱和关系凌驾于法律之上。
en: In China, power, money, and connections trump the law.

zh: 即便是在人们越来越习惯于诉诸法律的情况下，许多中国人也认为面对权势他们不可能获得司法公正。
en: Even as they are becoming ever more litigious, many Chinese believe that they have no hope of securing justice against the powerful.

zh: 这种心态从死亡农妇的丈夫在得到10，000美金的赔偿时无动于衷的反应中可见一斑。
en: The apathetic response of the dead peasant woman's husband to the $10,000 in compensation he received was telling.

zh: 他表示 ： " 我不在乎法院的判决，也不在乎它是否公正。 "
en: "I don't care about the verdict and whether it is justice or not," he said.

zh: 最为不利的后果是公众对司法体系丧失了信任。
en: The most harmful consequence is the public's loss of trust in the system.

zh: 社会信任不是用金钱可以买到的。
en: Social trust is not something you can buy with money.

zh: 如果整个社会都认为不能依靠法律维权-而必须依靠与那些有权有势的人所建立的关系网-那么这样的社会是否是人们愿意归属的社会就成为一个问题。
en: If an entire society believes that you cannot depend on legal rights for protection - that one must instead rely on a web of relationships with those who have power and influence - questions about whether such a society is livable or desirable will remain.

zh: 同样，在第二桩BMW案中，人们没有谴责一个腐败的商人；他们将过失归咎于彩票中心，一个政府机构。
en: Similarly, in the second BMW case, people didn't blame a corrupt businessman; they ascribed culpability to the lottery center, a government body.

zh: 因此他们开始怀疑一个机构，而不是某位个人-他们甚至怀疑政府本身。
en: So instead of mistrusting one person, they grew suspicious of an institution - even of government itself.

zh: 所以，当一位执拗的青年孤身挑战拥有众多审计员、公证员和借口的彩票机构时，让人们钦佩的真正胜利者就是他这个人，而不是司法制度。
en: When a stubborn teenager went up against the mighty lottery authority with its army of auditors and inspectors and initial alibis, this individual, not the system, was the clear winner of the public's admiration.

zh: 刘亮或许只是一个工人阶层的小孩，但他的话语中却透出睿智。 他说仍然有一群"沉默的大多数"可以影响脆弱的中国社会的运转方式。
en: Liu Liang may have been just a working-class kid, but there was wisdom in his words that there is still a "silent majority" who can affect the workings of China's fragile society.

zh: 他拒绝了私下调解，因为他相信如果他放过了腐败的政府官员 ， " 他们会继续欺骗公众。
en: He refused to settle privately, because he believed that if he let corrupt government officials off the hook, "they'll keep scamming the public."

zh: "在他的不懈努力及媒体的调查下，这场骗局终于真相大白。
en: Thanks to his perseverance and the media's investigation, the fraud was laid bare.

zh: 权力的腐败随处可见，但像Liu这样的个体的中国人已经形成了一股与之对抗的力量。
en: Power corrupts everywhere, but individuals in China such as Liu have come to form a countervailing force.

zh: 可即便如此，这种边缘的力量还没有能形成一种纠正社会不公的制度。
en: Even so, such marginal forces do not yet constitute a system for redressing grievances.

zh: 中国的流行音乐爱好者们能够听任何想听的音乐，包括麦当娜所唱的"我会动摇整个体制 " 。 普通的中国人也需要勇气呐喊这样的讯息。
en: While pop music fans in China can listen to whatever they like, including Madonna singing "I'm gonna shake up the system," ordinary Chinese need courage to speak such messages aloud.

zh: 有一句话说得好 ： " 中国人现在需要的不是良知，而是勇气。 "
en: As one saying goes, "There is not want of conscience in Chinese, but there is want of courage."

zh: 从透明罩到桥梁
en: From Bubbles to Bridges

zh: 伦敦—随着上市公司年度股东大会召开季的推进，一个一直存在的问题是公司官员和大众之间缺乏真正的对话。
en: LONDON – As the season in which public companies hold their annual general meetings progresses, one persistent issue is the lack of genuine dialogue between company officials and the general public.

zh: 在投资者、高管、员工以及社区展开激烈争论和讨论的场合，都给人一种各说各的感觉，一群人围坐在董事会会议桌周围，另一群人则集中在餐桌四周。
en: In place of robust debate and discussion among investors, executives, the workforce, and the community at large, the conversation seems to be taking place in different silos, with one group sitting around the boardroom table and another gathered at the kitchen table.

zh: 从外部看来，董事会常常像是一个透明罩，在这个罩子里，平庸刻板之士做出影响成千上万人生活的重大决定。
en: From the outside, a boardroom is all too often viewed as a kind of bubble where big decisions that influence thousands of lives are made by faceless people.

zh: 人们对董事会的印象是，在这里，大笔奖金被授予高管；讨价还价和人际关系比功绩和努力工作更重要。
en: They are perceived as places where big bonuses are awarded to chief executives and where horse-trading and old boy networks are more important than merit or hard work.

zh: 随着董事会外部人日益要求能够问责董事会成员，开启沟通渠道现已成为公司长期成功的关键。
en: With people outside the boardroom increasingly demanding to hold those inside it to account, opening up avenues of communication is now critical to companies’ long-term success.

zh: 这一转变的一个重要特征将是高层管理人员认识到他们无法再用“你根本不懂”为借口将批评拒之门外。
en: An important feature of this shift will be the realization by high-profile executives that they can no longer afford to brush off criticism with the you-just-don’t-understand defense.

zh: 他的言辞引申出一种更广泛的感觉：CEO们“不食人间烟火 ” ， 不愿或无法就尖锐问题给出真诚的回答。
en: His words tapped into a wider feeling that CEOs are out of touch and unwilling, or unable, to respond to tough questions with sincere answers.

zh: 就连广受尊敬的投资者巴菲特也无法免俗，他说沃伦“如果少点怒气和妖魔化会更好。 ”
en: Even the widely respected investor Warren Buffett missed the mark when he said that Warren “would do better if she was less angry and demonized less.”

zh: 在工资差异、企业的社会责任、数据隐私以及无法提供正确的努力工作的激励或充分惩罚失败的奖金文化等问题上缺少真正的对话，难怪会产生担忧和不信任。
en: In the absence of genuine dialogue about issues like wage discrepancy, corporate social responsibility, data privacy, and a bonus culture that does not seem to provide the right incentives for hard work or to adequately penalize failure, worries and mistrust are guaranteed to fester.

zh: 透明度不足、缺少明确性，以及缺少答案催生了一种感觉：公司常常进行可疑的交易，无法信任。
en: Lack of transparency, absence of clarity, and a paucity of answers feeds into the perception that companies are too often engaged in dodgy dealings and can’t be trusted.

zh: 最糟糕的是，沟通破裂让董事会和餐桌的人都失去了认识到他们在讨论类似的问题，有着类似的找到这些问题解决办法的渴望的机会。
en: Worst of all, the breakdown in communication deprives those around both the boardroom and kitchen tables of the opportunity to realize that they are talking about similar problems and share similar desires to find solutions to them.

zh: 高管和董事需要将与他们互动的人当成是对话者而不是听众。
en: Chief executives and board chairs need to think of those with whom they interact as people to talk with rather than at.

zh: 能说的领导人固然好，但懂得听的领导人更优秀。
en: Leaders who can talk are fine; but those who can listen are even better.

zh: 企业高管需要认识到，如果他们不以投资者、监管者、工人和消费者能够理解的方式解释他们的决策，那么他们 — — 而不是他们的对话者 — — 才是问题。
en: Business executives need to realize that if they cannot explain their decisions in ways that investors, regulators, workers, and consumers can understand, then they – not the people with whom they are talking – are the problem.

zh: 当积极投资者希望探一探公司究竟时，董事会的本能不应该是结成利益共同体，召集顾问对付积极投资者。
en: When activist investors want to take a look at a company, the boardroom instinct should not be to circle the wagons and call in consultants to do battle.

zh: 相反，董事会和高管团队需要扪心自问，随什么他们的公司会成为目标，是否存在合理的疑虑需要解决。
en: Instead, boards and executive teams need to ask themselves why their company has become a target and whether there are legitimate concerns to be addressed.

zh: 股东年会提供了理想的机会直面和回答尖锐问题 — — 投资者和社区成员应该确保这一机会不被浪费。
en: Annual general meetings provide an ideal opportunity to stand up and ask hard questions – an opportunity that investors and community members should make certain is not wasted.

zh: 在最近的雅虎年会上，董事会被问及一系列问题；但是，除了一两个与阿里巴巴有关的问题外，董事会几乎没有解决任何公司现在所面临的实际问题。
en: At Yahoo!’s recent annual meeting, the board was asked a wide range of questions; but, with the exception of a question or two about Alibaba, few of them addressed any of the real issues facing the company today.

zh: CEO玛丽萨·梅耶（Marissa Mayer）被问及的问题包括为何雅虎邮箱取消了格式选项中的“下划线”图标、雅虎财经为何有如此多的垃圾邮件等。
en: CEO Marissa Mayer was asked questions like why the “underline” icon had been removed from the formatting options in Yahoo! Mail and why there was so much spam in Yahoo!

zh: 如果雅虎这样的公司想从这样的场合中获益，个人和机构投资者需要动真格，在股东年会这样的开放论坛中问问真正触及业务的问题，而不是只在闭门会议中提出疑虑。
en: Finance. If companies like Yahoo! are to benefit from occasions like this, individual and institutional investors alike need to up their game and ask real questions about the business in the open forum of the annual general meeting instead of airing their concerns behind closed doors.

zh: 但是，对话要想真正有效，就必须在年会间隔期间继续展开。
en: For the conversation to be truly effective, however, it must continue between annual meetings.

zh: 聪明的企业领袖必须经常提供机会交换观点和关注。
en: Smart business leaders must provide frequent opportunities for the exchange of ideas and expressions of concern.

zh: 各说各的情况必须打破，透明罩必须戳穿，架设沟通的桥梁。
en: Silos must be knocked down and bubbles must be pierced, with bridges being built in their place.

zh: 未来的成功高管将是那些抓住机会参与真正对话并从群众中汲取智慧的人。
en: Tomorrow’s successful executives will be those who take the opportunity to join a real conversation and draw wisdom from the crowd.

zh: 博比·费舍尔的时代
en: The Age of Bobby Fischer

zh: 美国剑桥—好莱坞新大片《弃卒 》 （ Pawn Sacrifice）讲述的是国际象棋天才“博比”罗伯特·詹姆斯·费舍尔（Robert James “Bobby” Fischer）跌宕起伏的一生，从传奇般的早年岁月到1972年29岁与俄罗斯世界冠军鲍里斯·斯帕斯基（Boris Spaasky）的历史名局尽在其中。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The brilliant new Hollywood movie “Pawn Sacrifice” portrays the life of tormented chess genius Robert James “Bobby” Fischer from his early days as a prodigy to his historic 1972 match, at age 29, with Russian world champion Boris Spassky.

zh: 影星托比·马奎尔（Toby Maguire）的表演足以以假乱真 — — 对我们这些目睹费舍尔全盛期的人来说，马奎尔的表演可谓完美演绎。
en: Actor Toby Maguire portrays Fischer with remarkable authenticity – indeed, pitch-perfect for those of us who met Fischer in his prime.

zh: 影片讲述了一个已成为冷战期间俄美标志性事件的对局。
en: The film depicts a match that became a signature event in the Cold War between Russia and the United States.

zh: 影片也让我们怀疑，一个像费舍尔那样虽然麻烦重重但仍能在棋盘上化腐朽为神奇的充满创造力的天才，是否能够在当今无情的网络世界中生存。
en: It also makes one wonder whether a creative genius like Fischer, deeply troubled yet supremely functional at the chessboard, would be able to exist in today’s unforgiving online world.

zh: 当时的费舍尔当然引起了人们的关注，但那时的信息过滤机制和今天截然不同。
en: Fischer certainly got attention back then, but information was filtered very differently than it is today.

zh: 当时的记者引领着舆论，而不是像今天那样在肤浅的互联网信息流中随波逐流。
en: Journalists used to lead the way, rather than slavishly following the flow of superficial Internet traffic.

zh: 一个漂泊不定的布鲁克林的孩子在堪称苏联国技的项目上扳倒斯帕斯基，对于深谙此事件重要意义的记者来说，这是绝好的素材。
en: The story of an erratic kid from Brooklyn taking on the Soviet empire in its national sport made good copy for journalists, who understood the significance of the event.

zh: 这个对局在长达两个月的时间里占据着全世界各主要报纸的头版，每一天，都有评论员对对局做出长达五小时的逐步分析。
en: The match garnered front-page headlines in major newspapers around the world on a daily basis for two months, with commentators providing live move-by-move analysis for up to five hours each day.

zh: 当时，电视频道也寥寥无几。
en: Back then, there were only a few television channels.

zh: 没有DVD播放机，也没有按次计费收看服务。
en: There were no DVD players or pay-per-view services.

zh: 但是，这绝非人们执着地守在电视机前观看这场对局的唯一原因。
en: Still, that was not the only reason people remained glued to their TV sets to watch the match.

zh: 超现实主义环境、绝妙的棋路和冷战背景让费舍尔成为那个夏天全世界最出名的人物之一。
en: The surreal environment, the amazing chess turns, and the Cold War backdrop made Fischer one of the most famous people in the world that summer.

zh: 我不会自我幽默地说是棋局分析吸引着人们的关注，尽管我是关键的第13局的公共转播评论员。
en: I won’t humor myself that it was the chess analysis that drew attention, although I was a commentator for public television on the pivotal 13th game.

zh: 对美国冠军费舍尔来说，这场对局是他从以神童身份出道以来二十年追求头衔生涯的高潮。
en: For the American champion, the match was the consummation of two decades of chasing the title, starting from his days as a child prodigy.

zh: 对一个超级巨星来说（他甚至经常出现在主要刊物的封面上 ） ， 费舍尔的生活可谓穷困潦倒，如今，他终于坐在了价值250,000美元的对局边上。
en: After a lifetime of living in relative poverty for a superstar (even though he frequently appeared on the cover of major magazines), Fischer finally found himself playing in a match with a $250,000 purse.

zh: 当然，这与1971年阿里和弗雷泽（Frazier）拳王争霸战双方都能保证获得的250万美元来说只是九牛一毛。
en: Of course, it was a pittance compared to the $2.5 million that each fighter was guaranteed in the 1971 Ali-Frazier fight.

zh: 但费舍尔知道，在美国文化中，一切不产生大钱的运动项目都会被边缘化，因此他将这六位数的现金奖金视为国际象棋运动取得进展的终极标志。
en: But Fischer recognized that US culture marginalizes any pursuit that does not produce big money, so he viewed the six-figure cash prize as the ultimate symbol of advancement in his sport.

zh: 对俄罗斯来说，这一对局并非事关金钱，而是事关心与智。
en: For Russia, the match was not about money; it was about hearts and minds.

zh: 长期以来，国际象棋是证明共产主义制度优越性的完美战场。
en: The chess world had long been the perfect battleground on which to prove the superiority of the Communist system.

zh: 尽管如今大部分西方人都装作我们早就知道俄式共产主义迟早要失败，但当时绝非如此。
en: Although most Westerners today pretend that we always knew that Russian-style Communism would fail, it was not so obvious back then.

zh: ��时最通用的经济学概论教科书，即诺贝尔经济学奖获得者保罗·萨缪尔逊（Paul Samuelson）的《经济学 》 ， 仍预测俄罗斯可能超过美国成为世界最大经济体。
en: The leading introductory economic textbook of the time, by Nobel laurate Paul Samuelson, was still predicting that Russia might overtake the US as the world’s largest economy.

zh: 平心而论，俄国人非常看重国际象棋，即使它并不会带来很多收入。
en: To be fair, Russians valued chess enormously, even if it did not produce a lot of income.

zh: 从多种角度看，国际象棋是俄罗斯的国技。
en: In many ways, chess was Russia’s national sport.

zh: 毫不奇怪，费舍尔追求国际象棋世界冠军的堂吉诃德式举动惊动了美国政策智囊亨利·基辛格，基辛格打电话给费舍尔，敦促他不要退出（他曾经威胁要退出 ） 。
en: No wonder Fischer’s quixotic pursuit of the championship led American policy mastermind Henry Kissinger to call Fischer and urge him not to back out, as he had threatened to do.

zh: 不管他在美国的地位如何，费舍尔绝对是最受俄罗斯人爱戴的美国人。
en: Whatever his status in the US, Fischer was certainly the most beloved American in Russia.

zh: 普通俄罗斯人都可以欣赏和理解国际象棋的内在之美，而费舍尔的棋艺足以战胜俄国的宣传。
en: The majesty of his play transcended propaganda in a country where everyday people could appreciate and understand the innate beauty of the game.

zh: 在赢得冠军的征途中，费舍尔以前所未闻的6比0的比分横扫两位强大的对手，这在许多特级大师对局以和局告终的当时令人嗔目结舌。
en: In the run-up to the championship, Fischer trounced two very good opponents with unheard of 6-0 scores, an astonishing result when so many grandmaster games end in draws.

zh: 俄国棋迷因为费舍尔前所未有的成就而兴奋不已，据说莫斯科电话线路因为他们纷纷打电话了解相关信息而陷入了瘫痪。
en: Russian fans were so excited by Fischer’s unprecedented achievement that they reportedly jammed Moscow telephone exchanges to get information.

zh: 电话打进去后好一会儿，你才能听到接线员接起电话，说“6比0 ” ， 然后挂掉。
en: After a while, operators would simply pick up the line and say “6-0” and hang up.

zh: 最终，就连斯帕斯基也沦为了费舍尔天赋异禀的最高祭品，在费舍尔以妙到颠毫的手笔赢得第六局的胜利时，他于观众一起为他鼓掌，电影中也描述了这一幕。
en: In the end, even Spassky paid the ultimate tribute to Fischer’s genius, clapping along with the audience after Fischer’s inspired sixth-game victory, as portrayed in the movie.

zh: 费舍尔也许是国际象棋的终极天才，而斯帕斯基与他等量齐观。
en: The American might have been the ultimate chess genius, but the Russian was the class act.

zh: 导演爱德华·齐维克（Edward Zwick）并没有回避折磨费舍尔的恶魔。
en: Director Edward Zwick does not shirk from showing the demons that plagued Fischer.

zh: 他不无道理地担心俄国人会无所不用其极地阻止他赢得冠军，但最终合理的顾虑转变为妄想症，而费舍尔也开始疏远亲朋好友。
en: He was justly concerned that the Russians would go to great lengths to prevent him from being champion, but ultimately rational concerns tipped into paranoia, and Fischer started to turn on his closest friends and confidants.

zh: 他成了反犹人士，尽管他自己正是犹太人。
en: He became anti-Semitic, despite being Jewish himself.

zh: 你会怀疑，在当今的网络世界，费舍尔的妄想症和人格缺陷在他还远远没有成为世界冠军前就会毁了他。
en: One suspects that in today’s online world, Fischer’s paranoia and personal flaws would have tripped him up long before he became champion.

zh: 费舍尔成为冠军后便不再参加象棋比赛，他的精神病迅速恶化。
en: After Fischer became champion and simply stopped playing competitive chess, his mental illness became much worse.

zh: 尽管我们不能原谅费舍尔晚年的恶毒攻击和黑暗思想（他死于2008年 ） ， 但意识到创造力和天才如此发达的人，一个通过棋局激励了无数人的人，若放在今天有可能早就结束了他的职业生涯，这着实令人悲伤。
en: Though no one can condone Fischer’s virulent rants and dark thoughts in his later years (he died in 2008), it is sad to realize that someone of such towering creativity and genius, who inspired so many people through his chess, might have had his career ended at a much earlier stage today.

zh: 我们生活在一个不同的世界。
en: We live in a different world.

zh: 《弃卒》则回忆了一个费舍尔有可能建功立业的世界。
en: “Pawn Sacrifice” recalls the world in which Fischer’s feats were possible.

zh: 博纳冲击
en: The Boehner Shock

zh: 华盛顿 — — 自2008年金融危机爆发以来，媒体和专家投入了大量精力来预测其对全球经济的负面冲击。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Ever since the financial crisis erupted in 2008, media outlets and specialists alike have devoted much attention to anticipating negative shocks to the global economy.

zh: 今天的焦点是中国的经济状况、美联储利率正常化的时机和美国总统竞选所讨论的各项政策。
en: Today the focus is on the state of the Chinese economy, the timing of the US Federal Reserve’s normalization of interest rates, and the various policies under discussion in the United States’ presidential election campaign.

zh: 但最具破坏力的冲击却往往被人忽视 — — 而后却在几乎所有人都认为能够实现稳定的时候准确出击。
en: But the most damaging shocks often hide in plain sight – and then hit precisely when and where almost everyone thought stability would prevail.

zh: 风险之一是党派之争将再次破坏美国联邦政府财政，削弱美国经济并造成全球金融市场动荡不安。
en: One such risk is that political partisanship will cause another disruption to the US federal government’s finances, weakening the American economy and roiling world financial markets.

zh: 上述警告看似有些奇怪。
en: This warning may seem strange.

zh: 毕竟，挑起上次政府财政和提高债务限额两党之争（2013年）的共和党除对其自身的责任信誉造成重大损害外，其实从那次混乱中收获甚微。
en: After all, the last big partisan fight (in 2013) over funding the government and raising the debt limit gained little for the Republicans who instigated it – other than significant damage to their reputation for responsibility.

zh: 目前的共和党领导层急于加强该党在2016年的选举机会，非常希望以清醒理智的良好形象出现在公众面前。
en: And the current Republican leadership, eager to strengthen their party’s electoral chances in 2016, very much wants to project an image of sober good sense.

zh: 但公共财政领域的大规模对抗现在看似乎不可避免，尤其是众议院议长约翰·博纳意外宣布他将于10月底辞去议会席位及职务。
en: Yet a major and destabilizing confrontation over public finance now seems unavoidable, particularly following House Speaker John Boehner’s surprise announcement that he will resign his position and his seat in Congress at the end of October.

zh: 理解个中个原因只需看看众议院筹款委员会，该委员会现任主席保罗·瑞安是强硬派共和党反对者，他嘲笑博纳太容易向总统巴拉克·奥巴马及众议院民主党人妥协。
en: To see why, one need look no further than the House Ways and Means Committee, whose current chairman, Paul Ryan, is a leader of the hardline Republican insurgents who had scorned Boehner for being too willing to compromise with President Barack Obama and House Democrats.

zh: 瑞安的委员会在制定美国财政计划时起着重要的作用，反映了税收法案源起众议院的宪法要求和政治现实（众院传统上不像参院那样摩擦不断 ） 。
en: Ryan’s committee plays an important role in setting America’s fiscal agenda, reflecting both the constitutional requirement that revenue bills originate in the House of Representatives and political realities (the House is traditionally less fractious than the Senate).

zh: 与2013年不同，瑞安及其盟友此次的策略不太可能包含对联邦政府债务直接的违约威胁。
en: Unlike in 2013, the strategy of Ryan and his allies this time around is unlikely to include a threat to default directly on federal government debt.

zh: 该委员会内部的共和党声称将按时支付社会保障费用。
en: And Republicans on the committee claim that social security payments will be made on time.

zh: 那么他们计划拒绝支付哪些费用，并以此在政府财政立法问题上摊牌？
en: So what other bills do they plan not to pay as part of a showdown over legislation to keep the government funded?

zh: 事实上，很难说清威胁究竟是什么，这其实恰恰造成了部分问题。
en: In fact, it is difficult to say exactly what the threat is – and that is part of the problem.

zh: 政府合同和各项支付的不确定性可以广泛影响到国内经济。
en: Uncertainty about government contracts and various kinds of payments can have a broad impact on the economy.

zh: 难以确定全面经济影响恰恰阻碍了消费者进行购物并导致企业推迟投资。
en: The difficulty of working through the full economic implications is precisely what discourages consumers from making purchases and causes firms to postpone investment.

zh: 美国政府问责局（GAO）7月发布了一份有效报告，罗列了2013年债务上限对抗的部分后果 — — 包括其如何推高政府借贷成本及如何负面影响经济。
en: The US Government Accountability Office (GAO) published a helpful report in July that spelled out some of the consequences of the 2013 confrontation over the debt ceiling – including how it pushed up the government’s borrowing costs and the negative impact this had on the economy.

zh: 但国会里的多数共和党根本不注意这种明智的分析。
en: But the Republican majority in Congress simply ignores this type of sensible analysis.

zh: 如果共和党强制执行某种形式的政府支付排序，完全可能造成政府部分关闭的后果。 有些人将拿到欠款、有些人则不能。
en: As a result, a partial government shutdown is entirely possible, with the Republicans imposing a form of prioritization on government payments: some people will be paid what they are owed, and others will not.

zh: 这将推升不确定性、削弱经济信心、而且几乎肯定会影响2016年共和党总统选举。
en: This will fuel uncertainty, sap economic confidence, and almost certainly hurt the Republicans at the polls in 2016.

zh: 那么为什么这种情况有可能发生呢？
en: So why is it likely to happen?

zh: 原因之一是美国政治的分散性，当选官员相比之下无需对党派领袖负责。
en: One reason is to be found in the decentralized nature of American politics, which leaves elected officials relatively unbeholden to party leaders.

zh: 近几十年来某些共和党的支持者和捐赠者已明显向右翼转移。
en: Some Republican supporters and donors have obviously moved to the right in recent decades.

zh: 但正如詹姆斯·夸克和我在合著的美国财政政策著作《燃烧的白宫》中所诠释的那样，共和党右翼青睐负责任预算和财务稳定的时代早已过去。
en: But, as James Kwak and I explained in our book on US fiscal policy, White House Burning, the time when the Republican right favored responsible budgets and financial stability has long since passed.

zh: 现在的右翼越来越迎合南方农村白人选民 — — 只关心如何削弱联邦政府，且近年来一直将关闭政府或威胁不支付拖欠债务作为“饿死官僚巨兽”的一种方式。
en: Now the right – increasingly catering to a Southern, rural, and white constituency – cares much more about shrinking the federal government, and in recent years has viewed shutting it down or threatening nonpayment of debts as a way to “starve the beast.”

zh: 此外，共和党国会代表团不少议员坚持必须将停止资助主要服务于女性的医疗提供商计划生育组织作为达成任何预算协议的先决条件，这也再次凸显了共和党的不妥协立场。
en: Moreover, the Republicans’ uncompromising stance has been reinforced by the extreme position taken by many within its congressional delegation that Planned Parenthood – a health-care provider that primarily serves women – must be defunded as a condition of any budget deal.

zh: 博纳的辞职虽然被某些人视为为达成政府短期结算协议扫清了障碍，但实际只是凸显了任何“负责任”的共和党领导人只能有限度地控制党内越来越强的原教旨主义倾向。
en: Boehner’s resignation, though viewed by some as clearing the way for a short-term deal to fund the government, merely underscores the limited ability of any “responsible” Republican leader to control the party’s increasingly fundamentalist caucus.

zh: 在美国和其他地方，财政政策辩论应做到公开透明，明确替代目标和平衡评估如何以最佳方式支付政府费用。
en: In the US, as elsewhere, debates about fiscal policy should be open, with clear statements of alternative goals and balanced assessments of how best to pay for what government does.

zh: 不幸的是，辩论和随之而来的妥协并不符合共和党人的想法。
en: Unfortunately, a debate and the compromises that follow are not what the Republicans have in mind.

zh: 博纳的被迫离开前所未有地增强了这样的可能性 — — 即美国和世界将很快面临另一次自己造成的经济冲击，而这种冲击完全是由共和党的焦土预算战术造成的。
en: Boehner’s forced departure makes it likelier than ever that the US – and the world – will soon face the prospect of another self-inflicted economic shock, caused entirely by the Republicans’ scorched-earth budget tactics.

zh: 日本：比零更低
en: Less than Zero in Japan

zh: 东京—日本银行采取大动作要让日本经济重新实现通货膨胀，如今，它已将存款利率压到了负区间。
en: TOKYO – In a bold attempt to reflate the Japanese economy, the Bank of Japan has now pushed interest rates on deposits into negative territory.

zh: 这一政策并不新鲜 — — 欧洲央行、瑞典银行、瑞士国民银行和其他央行都已在实施这一政策 — — 但对日本银行来说，这是个未知领域。
en: Though this policy is not new – it is already being pursued by the European Central Bank, the Bank of Sweden, the Swiss National Bank, and others – it is uncharted ground for the BOJ.

zh: 不幸的是，市场的反应和预期的不一样。
en: And, unfortunately, markets have not responded as expected.

zh: 理论上负利率迫使商业银行实际上需要付钱给中央银行才能把钱存在那里，因此理应刺激面向公司的贷款，公司得到贷款就会增加支出，包括雇用更多员工。
en: In theory, negative rates, by forcing commercial banks essentially to pay the central bank to be able to park their money, should spur increased lending to companies, which would then spend more, including on hiring more employees.

zh: 这应该刺激股市反弹，提振家庭消费，遏制日元汇率，并结束通缩。
en: This should spur a stock-market rebound, boost household consumption, weaken the yen’s exchange rate, and halt deflation.

zh: 但理论并不总能成为现实；尽管日本银行引入负利率几乎立刻如预期那样降低了利率结构，但这一政策对日元和股市的影响并不令人愉快。
en: But theory does not always translate into practice; while the BOJ’s introduction of negative rates almost immediately pushed the interest-rate structure lower, as expected, the policy’s effects on the yen and the stock market have been an unpleasant surprise.

zh: 原因之一是人们普遍对日本经济感到悲观，而这一点因为中国的波动、美国的货币紧缩以及世界石油价格的暴跌更加严重了。
en: One reason for this is widespread pessimism about Japan’s economy, reinforced by volatility in China, monetary tightening in the United States, and the collapse in world oil prices.

zh: 但是，日本银行行长黑田东彦最近向众议院报告说，日本经济基本面总体良好，悲观的预测过于夸张。
en: But, as BOJ Governor Haruhiko Kuroda recently reported to the House of Councillors, Japan’s economic fundamentals are generally sound, and pessimistic predictions are greatly exaggerated.

zh: 事实上，首相安倍晋三的经济战略 — — 所谓的“安倍经济学”成功地让日本在高度不确定时期走在相当积极的路径上，经济表现出从几十年的停滞状态稳步复苏的迹象。
en: In fact, Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s economy strategy – so-called “Abenomics” – has enabled Japan to stay on a reasonably positive path in highly uncertain times, with the economy showing signs of steady recovery from its decades of stagnation.

zh: 自2012年安倍上台以来，创造了150万个工作岗位，失业率从4.6%下降到3.3 % 。
en: Since Abe took office in 2012, 1.5 million jobs have been created, and the unemployment rate has fallen from 4.6% to 3.3%.

zh: 此外，旅游业增长迅猛，公司和政府收入也快速增加。
en: Moreover, tourism has surged, and both company and government revenues have been rising rapidly.

zh: 就连日本的外部挑战也不再那么糟糕。
en: Even Japan’s external challenges may not be such bad news.

zh: 首先，和采取弹性利率机制的新兴经济体一样，日本也可以从美国货币紧缩中获益，因为美元升值让日本出口品更具竞争力。
en: For starters, Japan, like emerging economies with flexible exchange-rate regimes, may actually benefit from America’s monetary tightening, as an appreciating dollar makes Japanese exports more competitive.

zh: 类似地，由于日本最多只能满足6%的自身能源需求，廉价的石油也是天大利好 — — 并且可能维持一段时间。
en: Similarly, because Japan can meet at most 6% of its own energy needs, cheap oil is a true blessing – one that may well endure for some time to come.

zh: 至于中国的经济状况，这毫无疑问是一个担忧点。
en: As for the economic situation in China, there is certainly reason for concern.

zh: 问题在于，尽管自40年前邓小平启动“改革开放”政策以来，中国经济的“硬件”有了大幅提升，但其经济决策的“软件”仍然受到过度的国家管理的掣肘。
en: The problem is that, while the “hardware” of the Chinese economy has advanced substantially since Deng Xiaoping initiated his “reform and opening up” policy almost four decades ago, the “software” of economic policymaking is constrained by excessive state management.

zh: 因此，中国难以转向以繁荣的服务业和强劲的国内消费为基础的更加可持续的增长模式。
en: As a result, the country is struggling to shift to a more sustainable growth model, underpinned by a thriving services sector and strong domestic consumption.

zh: 在中国开始反思执政的共产党对经济命脉的控制之前，它都将是回荡在整个全球经济头上的市场不确定性的来源。
en: Until China reckons with the ruling Communist Party’s stranglehold on key levers of the economy, it will be a source of market uncertainty that reverberates throughout the global economy.

zh: 但即便如此，日本的情况也不像很多人想象的那样糟糕，因为日本对中国的风险暴露有限；比如，对华出口只占日本GDP的3 % 。
en: But even here Japan’s situation is not as dire as many seem to think, owing to its limited exposure to China; for example, exports to China amount to only 3% of Japan’s GDP.

zh: 基于此，没有理由认为东京股市应该跟在上海股市后面亦步亦趋。
en: Given this, there is no reason why the Tokyo stock market should gyrate whenever the Shanghai market shakes.

zh: 传统对冲经济策略应该是做空上海股票，做多东京股票。
en: The conventional hedge-fund strategy should be going short on Shanghai stocks and long on Tokyo stocks.

zh: 但是，即使日本经济状况远远算不上悲观，引入负利率的政策也没有得到公正的待遇：放松货币政策的手段。
en: And yet, even though Japan’s economic situation is far from dire, introducing negative interest rates has not been treated as what it is: a maneuver to loosen monetary policy.

zh: 相反，日本股市将负利率视为金融风险上升的先兆，而投机者仍然看多日元。
en: Instead, the Japanese stock market regarded negative rates as a harbinger of greater financial risk, and speculators have remained bullish on the yen.

zh: 统计学家兼经济学家高桥洋一（Yoichi Takahashi）对我说，2月份，日元在短短十天内升值8 % ， 这是反常现象，应属投机性袭击。
en: The statistician and economist Yoichi Takahashi tells me that the yen’s 8% appreciation over just ten days in February is abnormal, and probably fueled by speculative attacks.

zh: 在他看来，财务省应该对外汇市场的采取一些干预措遏制过度波动。
en: In his opinion, some interventions in the exchange market by the Ministry of Finance may need to be pursued to contain the extraordinary fluctuations.

zh: 2003—2004年，日本财务省购买了大量美元，从而在日本银行不愿采取公开市场操作的情况下放松了货币条件。
en: From 2003 to 2004, the Japanese treasury purchased a large amount of dollars, thereby easing monetary conditions at a time when the BOJ was reluctant to pursue open market operations.

zh: 但是，近几年来，日元汇率由货币政策决定，而不是通过干预操控。
en: In recent years, however, the yen’s exchange rate has been determined through monetary policy, not manipulated by intervention.

zh: 总体而言，我支持这一新方针，因此不建议用大规模干预改变日元汇率方向。
en: In general, I welcome this new approach, and thus do not recommend major interventions to change the direction of the yen exchange rate.

zh: 但是，我也确实相信需要采取偶尔为之的干预以惩罚利用暂时性市场心理让日元大大高于市场价值的投机者。
en: I do, however, believe that sporadic interventions may be needed to punish speculators who are taking advantage of temporary market psychology to keep the yen far above its market value.

zh: 尼日利亚动乱因贫困而起
en: Nigeria’s Poverty-Powered Insurgency

zh: 拉各斯—最近，尼日利亚安全部队夷平了一座北部渔村，近200人丧命，2000间屋子被毁，而这只是为了根除一小撮伊斯兰极端派系博科圣地（Boko Haram）分子。
en: LAGOS – Nigerian security forces recently razed a northeastern fishing village, leaving almost 200 people dead and destroying some 2,000 homes, in order to root out just a few members of the radical Islamist sect Boko Haram.

zh: 此次袭击凸显出过去四年来军方因为极端主义者的多次袭击而恼羞成怒。
en: The assault reflected the military’s growing frustration with the extremists who have staged scores of attacks in the last four years.

zh: 尽管尼日利亚总统乔纳森（Goodluck Jonathan）He联合国秘书长潘基文谴责军方的重拳出击方式，但这绝非与极端主义者的对峙造成严重附带伤害 — — 也几乎肯定不会是最后一次。
en: While Nigerian President Goodluck Jonathan and United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon have condemned the army’s heavy-handed approach, this is not the first time that clashes with extremists have caused significant collateral damage – and it almost certainly will not be the last.

zh: 博科圣地的主要目标是迫使尼日利亚接受伊斯兰教法，自2009年因军方处决其领袖尤素夫（Mohammed Yusuf）而向政府宣战以来，该组织表现出极强的韧性。
en: Boko Haram, whose primary objective is to compel Nigeria to adopt Sharia law, has proved surprisingly resilient since declaring war on the government in 2009, in response to the military’s execution of its leader, Mohammed Yusuf.

zh: 博科圣地采用打一枪换一地的游击战术和自杀式人肉炸弹袭击过警局、政府大楼和教堂，造成数千人丧生。
en: Using hit-and-run guerilla tactics and suicide bombers, Boko Haram has attacked police stations, government buildings, and churches, killing thousands.

zh: 尽管军方特种部队与博科圣地在博尔诺州和约贝州发生过暴力交火，但博科圣地在其活动活跃的北方各州仍然相当强健。
en: Despite violent clashes with a special military task force in Borno and Yobe, the northern states where the sect is most active, Boko Haram remains robust.

zh: 以穆斯林为多数人口的北方的政治敏感型迫使作为南方基督徒的乔纳森不得不小心翼翼地试图遏制博科圣地。
en: Political sensitivities in the predominantly Muslim north have forced Jonathan, a Christian southerner, to tread lightly in his efforts to contain Boko Haram.

zh: 许多北方人怨恨总统宝座在仅仅一个任期之后又回到了南方人手中（一项不成文的约定规定总统应该每隔两届由南方和北方轮流坐庄 ） 。
en: Many northerners resent that the presidency was returned to a southerner after only one term with a northerner in office (an informal agreement mandates that the presidency should alternate between north and south every two terms).

zh: 北方政客和埃米尔（传统穆斯林领袖）利用持续叛乱破坏乔纳森的信誉，从而强化他们让总统宝座回归北方的图谋。
en: Northern politicians and emirs (traditional Muslim leaders) have used the ongoing insurgency to damage Jonathan’s credibility, thereby strengthening their campaign to return the presidency to the north.

zh: 首先，他们要求乔纳森解散军事任务行动部队，宣称它在占领北方、干扰人民。
en: First, they ordered that Jonathan disband the military task force, claiming that it was occupying the north and harassing civilians.

zh: 接着，他们要求乔纳森扩大对博科圣地成员的赦免并展开对话。
en: They then called on Jonathan to extend amnesty to Boko Haram’s members and to initiate a dialogue.

zh: 乔纳森一开始拒绝了他们的要求，上个月，他表示不能与“鬼”谈判。
en: Jonathan initially refused their requests, stating last month that he could not negotiate with “ghosts.”

zh: 但是，随着赦免呼声越来越高，乔纳森屈服了。
en: But, with the clamor for amnesty reaching a deafening crescendo, Jonathan relented.

zh: 上周，他组建了北方对话和和平解决安全挑战总统委员会（Presidential Committee on Dialogue and Peaceful Resolution of Security Challenges in the North ） ， 该委员会由26名成员组成，大多为北方领袖。 委员会的任务是与博科圣地组织展开公开对话，并制定赦免条件和叛乱受害者补偿方案。
en: Last week, he inaugurated the Presidential Committee on Dialogue and Peaceful Resolution of Security Challenges in the North, a 26-member committee composed mainly of northern leaders tasked with opening a dialogue with Boko Haram and working out the terms of amnesty and compensation for victims of the insurgency.

zh: 但是，政府还没有宣布这一决定之，博科圣地领袖谢考（Abubakar Shekau）就拒绝了它。
en: But, before the government had even announced its decision, Boko Haram’s leader, Abubakar Shekau, rejected the offer.

zh: 在本月早些时候发给记者的电台录音中，他声称博科圣地组织不会为了赦免而做出保证。
en: In an audio recording that he sent to journalists earlier this month, he stated that the organization had done nothing to warrant an amnesty.

zh: 据谢考的说法，尼日利亚政府才是邪恶的一方，博科圣地不会放弃斗争。
en: According to Shekau, the Nigerian government is the iniquitous party, and Boko Haram will not give up the fight.

zh: 如此蔑视体现了博科圣地的强势地位。
en: This defiance reflects Boko Haram’s strong position.

zh: 正如最新的美国国务院报告所指出的，尼日利亚人民“对贫穷、政府和安全部队 腐败以及警察逍遥法外和恣意横行的不满（已经）为博科圣地组织吸收新成员创造了温床。 ”
en: As a recent US State Department report points out, Nigerian citizens’ “grievances regarding poverty, government and security-force corruption, and police impunity and brutality [have] created a fertile ground for recruiting Boko Haram members.”

zh: 最近几年来，来自亚洲的竞争削弱了曾经繁荣的北方纺织业，导致成千上万人失业；干旱摧毁了该地区的农业；服务部门也得不到发展。
en: In recent years, competition from Asia has weakened the north’s once-prosperous textile industry, leaving thousands unemployed; drought has devastated the region’s agriculture; and the service sector has remained underdeveloped.

zh: 数百万穷困失业年轻人正在寻求另类活路，而这正是猛烈抨击国家领导人乃是全人口麻烦的罪魁的博科圣地可以提供的。
en: Millions of impoverished, unemployed young people now seek an alternative, which Boko Haram, with its incendiary rhetoric blaming the country’s leaders for the population’s troubles, can provide.

zh: 成千上万人涌向博科圣地的募集中心，博科圣地从不缺乏志愿战士来维持其与尼日利亚政府的消耗战。
en: With people flocking to its recruiting centers by the thousands, Boko Haram faces no shortage of willing soldiers to continue its war of attrition against the Nigerian government.

zh: 认识到最有效的削弱博科圣地组织之道乃是解决北方深刻的经济和社会问题，乔纳森已开始支持一项在北方建设新学校的计划。 该计划将为年轻人带去宝贵的技能。
en: Recognizing that the most effective approach to thinning Boko Haram’s ranks is to address the north’s deepening economic and social problems, Jonathan has backed an initiative to build new schools in the north that will equip young people with valuable skills.

zh: 关于如何振兴地区经济的研究已经展开。
en: Studies of how to revive the region’s economy have been commissioned.

zh: 但这些努力需要假以时日才能取得成果。
en: But such efforts will take time to yield results.

zh: 此外，北方的麻烦只是全国失业飙升、年轻人焦躁不安、腐败横行和无助感与日俱增的一个侧面。
en: Moreover, the north’s troubles are only part of a wider national story of surging unemployment, restless young people, endemic corruption, and a growing sense of hopelessness.

zh: 乔纳森似乎无力处理好官员腐败问题 — — 美国报告强调，腐败在尼日利亚已是无孔不入，从警察到法院皆无法幸免。
en: Jonathan appears to be incapable of tackling the official corruption that, as the US report emphasized, pervades all sectors, from the police to the courts.

zh: 在14年的权力生涯中，人民民主党没能给出能为尼日利亚人民带来新目标的计划和政策。
en: In its 14 years in power, the People’s Democratic Party has failed to articulate programs and policies that offer Nigerians a new sense of purpose.

zh: 大部分尼日利亚���预计2015年大选所产生的无非是一群新的自利政客，他们对改善现状不会有多大兴趣。
en: Most Nigerians expect the general election in 2015 to bring in a new set of self-serving politicians with little interest in improving the situation.

zh: 如果他们是对的，博科圣地组织将继续繁荣。
en: If they are right, Boko Haram will continue to thrive.

zh: 聪明地征税
en: Smart Taxation

zh: 罗马—能保证国内收入充足的有效的税收政策是一国追求发展政策能力的关键决定因素。
en: ROME – An effective tax policy that ensures adequate domestic revenue is a crucial determinant of a country’s ability to pursue development policies.

zh: 但大部分发达国家的税收收入很低，这阻碍了通往更平衡、更包容、更可持续的经济发展之路，而后者又是改善公共卫生、提升生活标准的方法。
en: But tax revenues in most developing countries are low, impeding progress toward more balanced, inclusive, and sustainable economic development that can improve public health and raise standards of living.

zh: 尽管非税收入可能占一国GDP总量相当大的比重，但低收入和中低收入国家的平均税收/GDP比率分别在15%和19%左右，显著低于经合组织的平均水平35 % 。
en: Although non-tax revenue may contribute significantly to some countries’ total GDP, the average tax/GDP ratios in low-income and lower-middle-income countries are roughly 15% and 19%, respectively – significantly lower than the OECD average of more than 35%.

zh: 为了给发展项目融资，穷国和中低收入国家必须设计和实施增加国内收入的税收战略。
en: To finance development projects, poor and lower-middle-income countries must devise and implement tax strategies to increase domestic revenue.

zh: 这要求抛弃流行的教条 — — 税收只有在绝对必要时才能增加。
en: This entails abandoning the prevailing dogma that taxes should only be increased when absolutely necessary.

zh: 这一立场假设更低的税率通过确保税法更好的执行而使税收/GDP比率升高，并有利于间接税（如增值税）以扩大税基，将收入不高的人群也纳入税基。
en: This stance assumes that lower tax rates raise the tax/GDP ratio by ensuring better compliance with tax laws, and favors indirect taxation (such as value-added taxes) in order to broaden the tax base to include those with modest incomes.

zh: 与此同时，公司和个人直接税总是趋于降低 — — 尽管更低的直接税确保了投资和增长的说法还有待争议。
en: Meanwhile, direct taxation of corporations and individuals has tended to decline – despite the moot claim that lower direct taxation ensures investment and growth.

zh: 结果，大部分撒哈拉以南非洲和拉丁美洲国家的税收/GDP比率停滞不前甚至出现下降。
en: As a result, the tax/GDP ratio in most countries in Sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America has stagnated or even fallen.

zh: 在许多发展中国家，税收总收入有三个主要来源：对商品和服务收取的国内税（销售税和消费税 ） 、 直接税（主要对公司收取）以及最重要的对外贸易税（进口关税 ） 。
en: In many developing countries, total tax revenue is derived from three main sources: domestic taxes on goods and services (sales and excise taxes), direct taxes (primarily on corporations), and, most important, taxes on foreign trade (import duties).

zh: 但是，随着贸易自由化降低了关税，贸易税的比重有所降低，���其他收入源又不足以补偿贸易税收入的下降。
en: But, as trade liberalization has lowered tariffs and duties, the share of trade taxes has declined, while other sources have not compensated for falling trade revenue.

zh: 相反，在高收入国家，所得税（主要对个人收取）构成了税收收入的最大头（约占36 % ） ，对商品和服务征收的国内税和社会保障费用只占四分之一略多。
en: By contrast, in high-income countries, income taxes (primarily on individuals) comprise the largest proportion of tax revenue (roughly 36%), while domestic taxes on goods and services and social-security contributions each account for slightly more than one-quarter.

zh: 此外，贸易税的比重通常很低。
en: Moreover, the share of trade taxes is typically low.

zh: 当然，发展中国家不应该照搬发达国家的税收制度。
en: Of course, developing countries should not simply mimic developed economies’ tax systems.

zh: 毕竟，放之四海而皆准的方法是不存在的，即使是放之发展中国家而皆准的方法也是不存在的。
en: After all, no one-size-fits-all approach exists, even among developing countries.

zh: 税收政策必须随经济环境的改变而改变。
en: And tax policy must evolve with changing economic circumstances.

zh: 但在设计满足可操作性、方便性和稳定性等基本要求的税收政策时，发展中国家领导人必须从发达国家和其他发展中国家汲取经验。
en: Instead, developing-country leaders must draw on the experiences of both developed countries and their peers to design tax policies that meet the basic requirements of operability, buoyancy, and stability.

zh: 这也许包括扩大税基、打击偷税漏税、改善征税方式以及开发新的合作性国际税收战略。
en: This can include broadening the tax base, reducing tax avoidance and evasion, improving tax collection, and developing new, cooperative international taxation strategies.

zh: 在许多国家，税收改革使直接税占总收入的比重大幅提高。
en: In many countries, tax reform has already significantly increased the share of direct taxes in overall revenue.

zh: 提高最富国民的税率以形成更具累进性的所得税框架有助于这一进程。
en: Raising tax rates for the wealthiest citizens in developing a more progressive income tax framework would bolster this progress.

zh: 政府还应该致力于改善税法执行、减少偷漏税，这要求限制收税官的自由裁量权。
en: Governments should also work to improve tax compliance and reduce evasion, which requires limiting tax officials’ discretionary authority.

zh: 比如，税收管理的计算机化能增加篡改记录的难度，从而有助于限制腐败。
en: Computerizing tax administration, for example, could help to limit corruption by making it more difficult to tamper with records.

zh: 为了增加个人所得税在总收入中的比重，发展中国家已在用创新手法改进它们的税收部门，特别是针对难以课税的公民。
en: In order to increase personal-income taxes’ share of total revenue, developing countries are already improving their tax administrations in innovative ways, particularly to reach hard-to-tax citizens.

zh: 它们还能做得更多：每个拥有房子或车子、或身为某俱乐部会员、或持有信用卡、护照、驾照和其他身份证件的个人、或电话安装户都可以要求他们填写报税单。
en: More can be done: Every individual who owns a house or a vehicle, is a member of a club, holds a credit card, passport, driver’s license, or other identity card, or subscribes to a telephone service can be required to file a tax return.

zh: 此外，在发展中国家，消费税是传统税源，因为该税主要针对酒、烟、汽油、汽车和配件征收，这些东西生产厂家少、消费量大、需求弹性低，而且易于观察。
en: Moreover, excise taxes are a convenient source of revenue in developing countries, as they are primarily levied on products such as alcohol, tobacco, gas, vehicles, and spare parts, which involve few producers, large sales volumes, relatively inelastic demand, and easy observability.

zh: 消费税可以在商品出厂或抵港时征收，简化测量、收税和监控，同时确保税收覆盖、限制偷漏税。
en: Excise taxes may be levied when goods leave a factory or arrive at a port, simplifying measurement, collection, and monitoring, while ensuring coverage and limiting evasion.

zh: 但是，尽管该税税基稳固，收税成本低，但在低收入国家中，消费税只占GDP的2%以下，而高收入国家则要占GDP的3%左右。
en: But, despite their robust base and low administrative costs, excise taxes currently amount to less than 2% of low-income countries’ GDP, compared to roughly 3% in high-income countries.

zh: 发展中国家还必须把抵消全球化后果作为目标。
en: Developing countries must also aim to offset the consequences of globalization.

zh: 比如，资本流动性增加了偷漏税的机会，因为税收当局监控公民海外收入的能力有限，而一些政府和金融机构也在系统性地隐瞒相关信息。
en: For example, capital mobility increases opportunities for tax evasion, given that tax authorities’ capacity to monitor their citizens’ overseas incomes is limited, and some governments and financial institutions systematically conceal relevant information.

zh: 如果股息、利息、版税和管理费没有在支付发生国被课税，那么在居住国它们很容易就能逃脱关注。
en: If dividends, interest, royalties, and management fees are not taxed in the country in which they are paid, they more easily escape notice in the country of residence.

zh: 事实上，一些国家 — — 包括美国 — — 对非居民外国人的大银行存款利息并不课税。
en: Indeed, some countries – including the United States – impose no taxes on interest from large bank deposits by non-resident aliens.

zh: 全球化还有利于合法避税。
en: Globalization may also facilitate legal tax avoidance.

zh: 比如，跨国公司利用转移定价（对同一公司各分公司或子公司之间的商品、服务和资源转移的簿记）的方式实现国际营业利润税负的最小化。
en: For example, multinational corporations use methods like transfer pricing (book-keeping of goods, services, and resources transferred between a single company’s branches or subsidiaries) to minimize tax liability on their profits from international operations.

zh: 公司纳税人利用规则和税率差异，选择在税法最有利（或最宽松）的国家做生意。
en: Corporate taxpayers take advantage of discrepancies in rules and rates, choosing to do business in countries with more favorable – or lax – tax regimes.

zh: 最后，吸引外国直接投资的国际竞争可能导致政府向外国投资者让步，降低税率。
en: Finally, international competition for inward foreign direct investment may lead governments to reduce tax rates and increase concessions for foreign investors.

zh: 有证据表明，某些税收政策改变会引起突发性资本外流，因此政府不愿提高所得税率 — — 自20世纪70年代末以来，所得税率显著下降 — — 也不愿对股息和利息收入征税，以防资本外逃。
en: With evidence of sudden capital outflows in response to certain tax-policy changes, governments are reluctant to raise income-tax rates – which have fallen sharply since the late 1970’s – or to tax dividend and interest income, for fear of capital flight.

zh: 但是， 直接税优惠对国际投资多样化影响甚微，更不用说吸引国际投资流了，这纯粹是毫无必要的收入损失。
en: But, as direct-tax concessions have little or no effect in diverting international investment, let alone in attracting such flows, they constitute an unnecessary loss of revenue.

zh: 以邻为壑政策会导致所有发展中国家损失收入，同时破坏平衡、包容、可持续发展的可能性。
en: Beggar-thy-neighbor policies will lead to revenue losses for all developing countries, while undermining the possibility of balanced, inclusive, and sustainable development.

zh: 发展中国家财政部和税收当局必须相互之间并于经合组织国家精诚合作，堵住现存漏洞，建立高效的税收政策以支持共同利益。
en: Developing-country finance ministries and tax authorities must cooperate with one another and with their OECD counterparts to close existing loopholes and establish effective tax policies that support their shared interests.

zh: 全球性公债增长正在为全球经济复苏制造财政约束（既有真实的，也有想象的 ） ， 合作的紧迫性前所未有。
en: With rising public debt worldwide placing fiscal constraints (real and imagined) on global economic recovery, such cooperation is more urgent than ever.

zh: 核弹轰炸
en: Bombs Away

zh: 伦敦 — — 将全球23，000枚核武器、核武器生产者及迫不及待想使用核武器的人对全人类造成的威胁漫不经心地推到政治的边缘是当今国际争论最令人沮丧的特点之一。
en: LONDON – One of the most dispiriting features of today’s international debates is that the threat to humanity posed by the world’s 23,000 nuclear weapons – and by those who would build more of them, or be only too willing to use them – has been consigned to the margin of politics.

zh: 美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马2009年的布拉格讲话确实引起了全球的关注，这次讲话令人信服地强调了建设无核武器世界的重要性。
en: US President Barack Obama did capture global attention with his Prague speech in 2009, which made a compelling case for a nuclear weapon-free world.

zh: 奥巴马也的确与俄罗斯签订了大规模全新削减武器条约，并且举办了一次应对核武器及材料被盗或偏离危险的首脑峰会。
en: And he did deliver on a major new arms-reduction treaty with Russia, and hosted a summit aimed at reducing the vulnerability of nuclear weapons and materials to theft or diversion.

zh: 但是核问题仍然没能在公众和政界引起足够的重视。
en: But nuclear issues still struggle for public resonance and political traction.

zh: 只有大胆的赌徒才敢于押宝美国参议院将在近期批准《全面核禁试条约 》 。
en: It would take a brave gambler to bet on ratification of the Comprehensive Test Ban Treaty by the US Senate any time soon.

zh: 《难以忽视的真相》一片获得了奥斯卡金像奖，阿尔·戈尔也因此成为诺贝尔奖得主，气候变化的灾难性后果由此引起了国际社会的广泛关注。
en: The film An Inconvenient Truth won an Academy Award, led to a Nobel Prize for Al Gore, and attracted huge international attention to the disastrous impact of climate change.

zh: 但由同一支制作团队出品的一部同样引人注目的纪录片《倒计时》令人震惊地告诉人们世界多么频繁地被推向核灾难的边缘，但这部影片却未能引起人们足够的重视。
en: But Countdown to Zero, an equally compelling documentary, made by the same production team and making shockingly clear how close and how often the world has come to nuclear catastrophe, has come and gone almost without trace.

zh: 沾沾自喜压倒忧虑成为当今世界的普遍趋势。
en: Complacency trumps anxiety almost everywhere.

zh: 日本的福岛灾难引发了一场有关核能安全性的大讨论，其中却没有涉及核武器领域。
en: Japan’s Fukushima disaster has generated a massive debate about the safety of nuclear power, but not about nuclear weapons.

zh: 冷战的结束似乎消除了人们对核毁灭的恐惧。
en: Fear of a nuclear holocaust seems to have ended with the Cold War.

zh: 事实上，广岛和长崎似乎已成为遥远的记忆；新核武器国家的诞生也没有带来世界末日；恐怖分子掌握的核装备并未威胁世界主要城市；在有核国家看来，拥有核武器似乎更多地带来安慰和骄傲，而不是尴尬和忧虑。
en: Indeed, Hiroshima and Nagasaki seem an eternity ago; new nuclear-weapons states have emerged without the world ending; no terrorist nuclear device has threatened a major city; and possession of nuclear weapons, for the states that have them, seems to be a source of comfort and pride rather than concern or embarrassment.

zh: 除少数人之外，目前这代政治领导人似乎对核裁军及不扩散事宜提不起多大兴趣。
en: With only a handful of exceptions, the current generation of political leaders shows little interest in disarmament, and not much more in non-proliferation.

zh: 而他们治下的公众也没有在这方面给他们太多压力。
en: And their publics are not pressuring them to behave otherwise.

zh: 为让世界认清真相付出最大努力的非美国前国务卿亨利·基辛格和乔治·舒尔茨、美国前国防部长威廉·佩里和美国前参议员山姆·纳恩这四巨头莫属，他们是有史以来曾出任政府要职的最不屈不挠的现实主义者。
en: Few have worked harder to shake the world out of its complacency than four of the hardest-nosed realists ever to hold public office: former US Secretaries of State Henry Kissinger and George Shultz, former US Secretary of Defense William Perry, and former US Senator Sam Nunn.

zh: 过去五年来在一系列评论文章中，他们反复警告核武器在当今安全环境下的风险超过了任何可能的收益。
en: In a series of opinion articles over the last five years, they have repeatedly sounded the alarm that the risks of nuclear weapons outweigh any possible usefulness in today’s security environment.

zh: 此外，他们还呼吁重新思考威慑战略，以便尽可能减少并最终摆脱人类对有史以来最不分青红皂白的破坏性武器的依赖。
en: Moreover, they have called for a complete rethinking of deterrence strategy, in order to minimize, and ultimately eliminate, reliance on the most indiscriminately destructive weapons ever invented.

zh: 上周在伦敦 ， “ 四巨头”与最有影响力的智库研究员和世界各地有共同担忧和目标的约30位前外交及国防部长、将军和大使召开了一次私人会议。
en: Last week in London, the “gang of four” convened a private meeting with leading think-tank researchers and a worldwide cast of some 30 former foreign and defense ministers, generals, and ambassadors who share their concern and commitment.

zh: 但我们的平均年龄超过65岁，前英国国防部长德斯·布朗准确形容了我们影响力的有限性 ： “ 曾经掌权的人确实想解决核问题。
en: But our average age was over 65, and the limits of our effectiveness were neatly described by former British Defence Minister Des Browne: “People who used to be something really want to tackle this issue.

zh: 可正在掌权的人却并非如此。 ”
en: The trouble is that those who are something don’t.”

zh: 没有捷径能够扭转目前的颓势。
en: No quick fix will turn all this around.

zh: 让伦敦会议信息在公众和政界深入人心注定像在硬板上打孔一样缓慢而又乏味。
en: Getting the kind of messages that emerged from the London meeting embedded in public and political consciousness is going to be slow boring through hard boards.

zh: 但核问题必须引起关注，我们只能不断钻下去。
en: But the messages demand attention, and we simply have to keep drilling.

zh: 最重要的信息是核武器威胁令人震惊的切实存在着。
en: The first message is that the threat of a nuclear weapons catastrophe remains alarmingly real.

zh: 现有的全球核库存破坏力相当于150，000颗广岛原子弹，处理过程中很可能出现人为差错、系统故障或者因压力过大造成的误判。
en: Existing global stockpiles have a destructive capacity equal to 150,000 Hiroshima bombs, and in handling them there is an omnipresent potential for human error, system error, or misjudgment under stress.

zh: 巴基斯坦和印度矛盾随时有可能升级为破坏性冲突，而北朝鲜和伊朗的不稳定局势仍然令人关切。
en: Pakistan versus India is a devastating conflict-in-waiting, and North Korea and Iran remain volatile sources of concern.

zh: 我们知道恐怖组织有能力制造核武器，并成功地在任何地方引爆；我们只是无法确信能让他们永远得不到为核武器提供燃料的可裂变物质。
en: We know that terrorist groups have the capacity to engineer nuclear devices and would explode them anywhere they could; we simply cannot be confident that we can forever deny them access to the fissile material they need to fuel them.

zh: 其次是冷战时期的核威慑论已经无关乎当今世界。
en: The second message is that Cold War nuclear-deterrence doctrine is irrelevant to today’s world.

zh: 只要核武器依然存在，各国就可以名正言顺地保留最基本的核威慑力。
en: So long as nuclear weapons remain, states can justify maintaining a minimum nuclear-deterrent capability.

zh: 但做到这点不需要让核武器处在高度戒备状态，美俄两国需要大幅降低核武器库存，而其他有核国家充其量可以保持目前的核武器状况。
en: But that can be done without weapons on high alert, and with drastically reduced arsenals in the case of the US and Russia, and, at worst, at current levels for the other nuclear-armed states.

zh: 另外就是如果现有核国家真心希望阻止别国加入到有核俱乐部，他们就不能继续借口防卫其他大规模杀伤性武器（特别是生物武器或常规武器）为自己和盟国拥有核武器进行辩护。
en: The third message is that if the existing nuclear powers sincerely want to prevent others from joining their club, they cannot keep justifying the possession of nuclear weapons as a means of protection for themselves or their allies against other weapons of mass destruction, especially biological weapons, or conventional weapons.

zh: 事实上，巴基斯坦和印度之间、以及俄罗斯和中国与美国之间开展大规模裁军行动的首要抑制因素是常规武器力量的不平衡，而相应的解决办法也必须尽快提上政治议程。
en: Indeed, the single most difficult issue inhibiting serious movement toward disarmament – certainly in the case of Pakistan versus India, and Russia and China versus the US – are conventional arms imbalances, and ways of addressing them must rise to the top of the policy agenda.

zh: 最后还要注意零星改革和空喊口号都无助于实现目标。
en: The final message is that neither piecemeal change nor sloganeering will do the job.

zh: 核裁军、不扩散、反恐和民用核能风险控制之间相互密不可分，需要制定综合议程及详细计划并不断付出努力。
en: Nuclear disarmament, non-proliferation, counter-terrorism, and civil nuclear-energy risk reduction are inextricably connected, and they call for sustained commitment around a comprehensive agenda, and detailed argument.

zh: 时断时续的讲话和议论不太可能实现核救赎的目标。
en: Sound bites and tweets are an unlikely route to nuclear salvation.

zh: 基辛格并不是理想主义偶像。
en: Kissinger is no idealist icon.

zh: 但他的意见值得我们听取，特别是在他已经强调了多年的问题上：当下一次核武器灾难注定发生时，世界将被迫做出巨大改变。
en: But he’s always worth listening to, and never more so than with respect to the question that he has been asking for years: When the next nuclear-weapons catastrophe happens, as it surely will, the world will have to respond dramatically.

zh: 那么改变为什么不能从现在开始呢？
en: Why can’t we start right now?

zh: 炸弹、书本和美元
en: Bombs, Books, and Bucks

zh: 为伊拉克和阿富汗的美军行动所提供的总额价值820亿美元的紧急拨款法案使美国花在军事力量上的钱比每年允许全世界每个孩子在十年内接受小学和中学教育所需的还要多。
en: The $82 billion “emergency supplemental” bill to finance American military operations in Iraq and Afghanistan leaves the United States spending more money on military power than is needed on a yearly basis to permit every child in the world to receive, within one decade, both primary and secondary education.

zh: 显然，问题不在于全球教育是否承担得起，而是美国和全世界是否能够忽略让全球目前约38,000万失学儿童接受教育所带来的政治、经济、社会和健康益处。
en: Clearly, the question is not whether universal education is affordable, but whether America and the world can afford to neglect the political, economic, social, and health benefits of educating the roughly 380 million children around the globe who currently do not attend school.

zh: 教育，和军事力量一样，是一种安全需要，因为它帮助全世界 — — 无论个人还是社会 — — 避免普遍贫困、高速人口增长、环境问题以及社会不公等带来的后果。
en: Education, no less than military might, is a security imperative, for it helps the world – both individuals and societies – to escape the consequences of widespread poverty, rapid population growth, environmental problems, and social injustices.

zh: 教育加强了社会和文化资本，这有助于保持强大稳定的政体。
en: Education strengthens social and cultural capital, which contributes to strong and stable polities.

zh: 它改善了人类健康，延长了人类寿命并降低生育率。
en: It improves human health, increases life expectancy, and lowers fertility rates.

zh: 除了这些显而易见的好处之外，教育也是一种广泛认同的慈善义务和一种国际认可的人权。
en: Aside from these obvious benefits, education is also a widely accepted humanitarian obligation and an internationally mandated human right.

zh: 但是这种权利在占全世界28%的那些失学的学龄儿童身上并没有得到体现。
en: But this right is unrealized for the 28% of the world’s school-age children who are not enrolled in school.

zh: 他们大部分目不识之丁，生活极其贫困。
en: Most are illiterate and live in absolute poverty.

zh: 这些孩子中大部分是女孩。
en: The majority of these children are female.

zh: 在那些发展中国家内进入小学学习的孩子中，超过四分之一的孩子在完成扫盲之前就已经辍学。
en: Of those who enter primary school in developing countries, more than one in four drops out before attaining literacy.

zh: 此外，入学并不一定意味着上学，上学也不肯定意味着教育，教育也不必然意味着高质量的教育。
en: Moreover, enrollment does not necessarily mean attendance, attendance does not necessarily mean education, and education does not necessarily mean good education.

zh: 2000年，全世界立志要在2015年前在全球普及初等教育（UPE ） 。
en: In 2000, the global community pledged to achieve universal primary education (UPE) by 2015.

zh: 许多贫困国家在完成这个目标的途中远远地偏离了轨道。
en: Many poor countries are wildly off track when it comes to meeting this goal.

zh: 就目前的教育普及率来看，在2015年将有11,800万儿童无法进入小学，约这个数字两倍的儿童将无法接受中学教育。
en: At the current rate of educational expansion, an estimated 118 million children will be absent from primary school in 2015. Nearly twice that number will not attend secondary school.

zh: 世界银行、联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）和联合国教科文组织（UNESCO）预计，在2015年前达到UPE的目标所需的花费将比发展中国家每年用于初等教育的约820亿美元高出65亿至350亿美元。
en: The World Bank, UNICEF, and UNESCO have estimated that achieving UPE by 2015 will entail annual expenditures of between $6.5 billion and $35 billion, on top of the approximately $82 billion that developing countries spend each year on primary education.

zh: 这笔基金将用于学校、教师、教师培训、材料和设备、管理以及评估。
en: These funds will be needed for schools, teachers, teacher training, materials and equipment, administration, and assessments.

zh: 以我们在美国国家艺术和科学院引领的五年计划为基础，我们相信UPE目标还不够雄伟：全世界应该，也能够，像普及全球初等教育一样普及全球中等教育。
en: Based on a five-year project that we led at the American Academy of Arts and Sciences, we believe that the UPE goal is not ambitious enough: the world should aim for, and can achieve, high-quality, universal secondary education, as well as universal primary education.

zh: 发展中国家每年在中等教育上花费约930亿美元。
en: Developing countries spend approximately $93 billion per year on secondary education.

zh: 如果从现在开始到2015年采取循序渐进的方式，把中等教育向每个儿童普及的花费将有可能以每年270亿美元至340美元的速度增加。
en: If a gradual approach is taken between now and 2015, the annual additional cost of extending secondary education to every child will likely be between $27 billion and $34 billion.

zh: 我们需要大量的投资为普及入学创造一个必要的环境。
en: Creating the necessary space to accommodate universal enrollment will require significant investment.

zh: 这些基金将在最大程度上改善 — — 而不是削减 — — 在获得教育途径和教育质量上所普遍存在的全球性差距。
en: These funds would at best ameliorate – not eliminate – prevailing global disparities in educational access and quality.

zh: 这还不包括其他能鼓励儿童上学的改善所需的花费，诸如用餐、学费补贴，以及更有效率、精力更为充沛、更有学识的老师。
en: Not included is the cost of other improvements needed to encourage children to attend school, such as meals, tuition subsidies, and more effective, dynamic, and knowledgeable teachers.

zh: 这也不包括改善国家政府收集数据和执行并检查教育改革的能力所需的花费。
en: Nor does this include the cost of improving national governments’ capacity to collect data and to implement and oversee educational reforms.

zh: 尽管更多的资金至关重要，但这还不够。
en: Though more money is essential, it is not sufficient.

zh: 在某些地区，文化禁忌禁止女孩以及语言、宗教和少数民主接受教育。
en: In some regions, cultural barriers inhibit schooling of girls and of linguistic, religious, and ethnic minorities.

zh: 扩大和改革教育所需的政治力量难以在世界最富裕的国家中集聚起来。
en: The political energy required for expanding and reforming education is difficult to muster in the world’s wealthiest nations.

zh: 保证所有的孩子能接受高质量的教育需要一场公开讨论，讨论包括教育目标、改进其有效性和经济效率的国际义务、将中等教育向所有儿童普及的必要性以及对教育多样性和改变援助政策以适应当地情况的认识。
en: Ensuring high-quality education for all children requires an open discussion of educational goals, an international commitment to improving its effectiveness and economic efficiency, recognition of the need to extend secondary education to all children, and acknowledgment of educational diversity and the need to adapt aid policies to local contexts.

zh: 如果无法对发展中国家所提供的资金进行补充，这些任务就无法完成。
en: None of these tasks is possible without supplementing the funding already provided by developing countries.

zh: 全世界，或甚至美国一国，都具有提供所需额外资金的能力。
en: The world, or even the US by itself, has the ability to provide the additional funds needed.

zh: 当八国首脑在齐聚于苏格兰时，很难想象他们会对我们共同的未来提出一个更好的投资方案。
en: As the G8 leaders gather in Scotland, it is hard to imagine them coming up with a better investment in our common future.

zh: 债券市场有多可怕
en: How Scary Is the Bond Market?

zh: 纽黑文—近几年来，长期政府债券价格价格十分高（也就是说收益率十分低 ） 。
en: NEW HAVEN – The prices of long-term government bonds have been running very high in recent years (that is, their yields have been very low).

zh: 在美国，30年国债收益率在1月30日创下了2.25%的历史低点（自1972年美联储系列债券诞生以来 ） 。
en: In the United States, the 30-year Treasury bond yield reached a record low (since the Federal Reserve series began in 1972) of 2.25% on January 30. The yield on the United Kingdom's 30-year government bond fell to 2.04% on the same day.

zh: 1月20日日本20年政府债券收益率低达0.87 % 。
en: The Japanese 20-year government bond yielded just 0.87% on January 20.

zh: 此后，这些收益率均略有回升，但仍然非常低。
en: All of these yields have since moved slightly higher, but they remain exceptionally low.

zh: 这令人奇怪，也不可持续 — — 人们锁定他们的资金20年或30年，还赚不到利息或赚不到比央行2%的年度通胀目标更高的利息。
en: It seems puzzling – and unsustainable – that people would tie up their money for 20 or 30 years to earn little or nothing more than these central banks' 2% target rate for annual inflation.

zh: 因此，债券市场似乎即将迎来重大调整，许多人认为可能发生市场崩盘，拉低其他长期资产如房地产和股票的价格。
en: So, with the bond market appearing ripe for a dramatic correction, many are wondering whether a crash could drag down markets for other long-term assets, such as housing and equities.

zh: 我在各种讨论班和会议上一再提出这一问题。
en: It is a question that I am repeatedly asked at seminars and conferences.

zh: 毕竟，房产和股票市场的参与者参照债券市场价格观点确定价格，因此从一种长期市场到另一种长期市场的传染可能性相当大。
en: After all, participants in the housing and equity markets set prices with a view to prices in the bond market, so contagion from one long-term market to another seems like a real possibility.

zh: 我思考债券市场问题已有很长时间。
en: I have been thinking about the bond market for a long time.

zh: 事实上，长期债券市场是我1972 年博士论文和第二年首次发表的学术作品（与我的导师弗朗哥·莫迪利亚尼（Franco Modigliani）合作）的主题。
en: In fact, the long-term bond market was the subject of my 1972 PhD dissertation and my first-ever academic publication the following year, co-authored with my academic adviser, Franco Modigliani.

zh: 我们的工作用1952—1971年的数据证明了当时的长期债券市场情况相当简单。
en: Our work with data for the years 1952-1971 showed that the long-term bond market back then was pretty easy to describe.

zh: 任意给定日期的长期利率可以用过去18个季度通货膨胀和过去18个季度的短期真实利率的加权平均很好地解释。
en: Long-term interest rates on any given date could be explained quite well as a certain weighted average of the last 18 quarters of inflation and the last 18 quarters of short-term real interest rates.

zh: 当通胀或短期真实利率上升时，长期利率也会上升。
en: When either inflation or short-term real interest rates went up, long-term rates rose.

zh: 当两者之一下降时，长期利率也会下降。
en: When either fell, so did long-term rates.

zh: 如今，我们增加了40多年的数据，因此我研究了以下我们的理论是否仍能有很好的预测能力。
en: We now have more than 40 years of additional data, so I took a look to see if our theory still predicts well.

zh: 情况表明，如果用后来的数据，我们当时的估计在我们的成果发表后20年内都能很好地起作用；但从20世纪90年代中期开始，我们的理论开始失准。
en: It turns out that our estimates then, if applied to subsequent data, predicted long-term rates extremely well for the 20 years after we published; but then, in the mid-1990s, our theory started to overpredict.

zh: 根据我们的模型，美国长期利率应该比现在更低，因为通胀和短期真实利率都达到了近零甚至负水平。
en: According to our model, long-term rates in the US should be even lower than they are now, because both inflation and short-term real interest rates are practically zero or negative.

zh: 即使考虑到2008年以来的量化宽松的影响，长期利率仍显著高于预期。
en: Even taking into account the impact of quantitative easing since 2008, long-term rates are higher than expected.

zh: 但我们很久以前所发展的解释仍相当合适，这足以让我们相信我们不会看到债券市场崩溃，只要中央银行不急剧（通过提高短期利率）收���货币政策或通胀不出现大幅上升。
en: But the explanation that we developed so long ago still fits well enough to encourage the belief that we will not see a crash in the bond market unless central banks tighten monetary policy very sharply (by hiking short-term interest rates) or there is a major spike in inflation.

zh: 债券市场崩盘其实相对来说比较罕见和温和。
en: Bond-market crashes have actually been relatively rare and mild.

zh: 在美国，穆迪（Moody’s）30年公司债券月度总回报指数（可追溯至1857年）的全球金融数据（Global Financial Data，GFD）扩展的最大啊单年跌幅为12.5 % ， 发生在1979年3月—1980年2月。
en: In the US, the biggest one-year drop in the Global Financial Data extension of Moody's monthly total return index for 30-year corporate bonds (going back to 1857) was 12.5% in the 12 months ending in February 1980.

zh: 与股市比较：GFD标普500月度总回报指数在1931年4月—1932年3月的一年（大萧条期间）中损失了67.8 % ， 自1990年以来出现过23次年损失超12.5%的情况。
en: Compare that to the stock market: According to the GFD monthly S&P 500 total return index, an annual loss of 67.8% occurred in the year ending in May 1932, during the Great Depression, and one-year losses have exceeded 12.5% in 23 separate episodes since 1900.

zh: 另一个值得注意之处是什么事件才能导致长期债券市场出现12.5%的崩盘。
en: It is also worth noting what kind of event is needed to produce a 12.5% crash in the long-term bond market.

zh: 1980年2月的年度跌幅出现在保罗·沃尔克（Paul Volcker）1979年出任美联储主席后。
en: The one-year drop in February 1980 came immediately after Paul Volcker took the helm of the Federal Reserve in 1979.

zh: 1979年盖洛普调查（Gallup Poll）表明62%的美国人认为通胀时“国家面临的最重要的问题 ” 。
en: A 1979 Gallup Poll had shown that 62% of Americans regarded inflation as the “most important problem facing the nation."

zh: 沃尔克采取了激进措施解决这一问题，大幅提高了短期利率以至于制造出异常大衰退。
en: Volcker took radical steps to deal with it, hiking short-term interest rates so high that he created a major recession.

zh: 他还因此树敌（甚至面临死亡威胁 ） 。
en: He also created enemies (and even faced death threats).

zh: 人们怀疑他的政治生命是否会就此终结，或者遭遇弹劾。
en: People wondered whether he would get away with it politically, or be impeached.

zh: 在股票市场和房产市场，随时可能发生大幅向下调整。
en: Regarding the stock market and the housing market, there may well be a major downward correction someday.

zh: 但这可能与债券市场崩盘没有什么关系。
en: But it probably will have little to do with a bond-market crash.

zh: 过去一百年中美国股市的最大调整走势（1970、1929、1973、2000、2007年后）和美国房产市场的所有调整走势（1979、1989、2006年后）都是如此。
en: That was the case with the biggest US stock-market corrections of the last century (after 1907, 1929, 1973, 2000, and 2007) and the biggest US housing-market corrections of all time (after 1979, 1989, and 2006).

zh: 诚然，反常低的债券收益率不符合历史经验。
en: It is true that extraordinarily low long-term bond yields put us outside the range of historical experience.

zh: 但债券市场突然崩盘拉低股票和房产价格也不符合历史经验。
en: But so would a scenario in which a sudden bond-market crash drags down prices of stocks and housing.

zh: 当一个事件从未发生过时，你不可能装出自信的模样预测它发生。
en: When an event has never occurred, it cannot be predicted with any semblance of confidence.

zh: 抓住气候团结的机会
en: Capitalizing on Climate Unity

zh: 波恩—一年前，特朗普当选为美国总统的时候，有人说巴黎气候协定的末日就在眼前了。
en: BONN – When Donald Trump was elected US president a year ago, some said the end of the Paris climate agreement was nigh.

zh: 但是，在德国波恩举行的最新一轮全球气候谈判表明，世界政治领导人对该协议的决心比以往任何时候多要坚定。
en: Yet, as the latest round of global climate talks in Bonn, Germany, has shown, the world’s political leaders are more committed to the deal than ever.

zh: 这是好消息，但事实是，各国的决心还不足以扭转潮流 — — 而我们在气候变化问题上采取有效行动的机会窗口正在迅速关闭。
en: This is good news, but the fact remains that countries’ commitments do not yet add up to enough to turn the tide – and our window of opportunity to act effectively on climate change is rapidly closing.

zh: 特朗普让美国 — — 全世界历史最大排放国退出巴黎协定的决定给巴黎协定带来了沉重一击。
en: Trump’s decision to withdraw the United States – the world’s largest historical carbon dioxide emitter – from the Paris agreement dealt the accord a major blow.

zh: 许多美国最紧密的盟友 — — 包括我们两人的祖国马绍尔群岛和澳大利亚 — — 对此深表失望，这是一个短视的决定，不管对美国还是对世界都是如此。
en: Many of America’s closest allies – including both of our countries, the Marshall Islands and Australia – were deeply disappointed by the move, which was shortsighted, for both America and the world.

zh: 但特朗普的决定很显然也激发了美国内外的新一波全球决心。
en: But it is hard not to take heart from the fresh wave of global resolve Trump’s decision has unleashed, both globally and within the US itself.

zh: 几乎所有美国州、城市和公司都承诺要做更多事确保美国兑现承诺，尽管特朗普政府已经翻脸不认人。
en: Almost every major US state, city, and company has now pledged to do more to ensure that their country can meet its commitments, despite the Trump administration’s opposition.

zh: 气候行动是现今世界最大的经济机会，这一事实显然大有助益。
en: The fact that climate action is now the worlds’ biggest economic opportunity has certainly helped.

zh: 据特朗普政府自己分析，如今在太阳能产业工作的美国人，比煤炭、石油和天然气行业加起来还要多一倍多。
en: According to the Trump administration’s own analysis, more than twice as many Americans are now working in the solar industry than in coal, oil, and gas combined.

zh: 今年早些时候，经合组织表示，将气候与全球日程联系起来每年能够带来5%的全球增长提振。
en: And earlier this year, the OECD indicated that we could boost global growth by 5% per year by 2050, simply by linking the climate and growth agendas.

zh: 没有时间可以浪费；气候变化已经到来。
en: There is no time to waste; climate change has already arrived.

zh: 今年马绍尔群岛创纪录的干旱、加勒比海地区毁天灭地的风暴，以及孟加拉国和美国灾难性的洪水都证明了这一点。
en: This year’s record-breaking drought in the Marshall Islands, apocalyptic storms in the Caribbean, and devastating floods in Bangladesh and the US demonstrate this.

zh: 联合国环境规划署提醒我们，即使每个国家都实现现有2030年减排目标，我们也无法将变暖限制在前工业化水平以上1.5℃以内。 巴黎协定认为，如果超过1.5℃的阈值的话，气候变化的影响将大幅增加。
en: As the United Nations Environment Programme recently reminded us, even if every country hits its existing 2030 emissions-reduction targets, we will be unable to limit warming to below 1.5° Celsius above preindustrial levels – the threshold, recognized in the Paris agreement, beyond which the impact of climate change becomes far greater.

zh: 即使是实现更保守和更危险的升温上限 — — 2℃希望也不甚乐观。
en: Our chances even of staying within the more conservative – and dangerous – 2° Celsius limit will be slim.

zh: 忽视这一现实就是在拿许多岛国的未来生存赌博，更不用说全球经济的繁荣了。
en: To ignore this reality is to gamble with the existential future of many island countries, not to mention the prosperity of the global economy.

zh: 如果全世界不携手提高2020年减排目标，我们就无法拯救全世界最脆弱的国家。
en: Without a sharp rise in global ambition for emissions reductions by 2020, we will be unable to save the world’s most vulnerable countries.

zh: 而一旦气候变化失控之势形成，没有国家能够独善其身。
en: And if runaway climate change takes hold, no country will be immune to its effects.

zh: 不幸的是，情况在发生好转之前还将先大大恶化。
en: Unfortunately, things will get a lot worse before they get better.

zh: 因此，我们必须努力提高我们面对无可避免的气候影响的恢复力，并解决相关的安全问题。
en: That is why we must step up our efforts to boost our resilience to the climate effects we won’t be able to avoid, and address the associated security consequences.

zh: 与此同时，我们必须尽快提高我们的气候承诺的目标。
en: In the meantime, we must urgently increase the ambition of our climate commitments.

zh: 幸运的是，一些即将到来的会议为此提供了机会。
en: Fortunately, several upcoming events offer an opportunity to do just that.

zh: 我们使出浑身解数抓住这个机会。
en: We need to seize that opportunity with both hands.

zh: 下个月，法国总统马克龙将主持巴黎协定两周年会议。
en: Next month, French President Emmanuel Macron will host a conference to mark the two-year anniversary of the Paris agreement.

zh: 明年9月，加利福尼亚州州长杰瑞·布朗（Jerry Brown）将主持峰会推动城市、公司和其他非国家行动方的动作。
en: And next September, California Governor Jerry Brown will host his own summit to galvanize greater action by cities, companies, and other non-state actors.

zh: 但最大的机会将发生在2019年，联合国秘书长古特雷斯将在纽约与全世界领导人召开自巴黎谈判以来最大规模的气候会议。
en: The biggest opportunity, however, will come in 2019, when UN Secretary-General António Guterres convenes world leaders in New York for the biggest climate gathering since the Paris talks.

zh: 用我们的朋友、已故的马绍尔群岛外交部长、巴黎会议上的不屈不挠的气候斗士托尼·德布鲁姆（Tony de Brum）的话说，我们必须利用这些会议，树立一个雄心之弧（an arc of ambition ） ， 给最脆弱群体一条生路。
en: We need to build an arc of ambition across these events that can, in the words of our friend Tony de Brum, the late Marshallese foreign minister and untiring climate warrior at the Paris conference, deliver a pathway to survival for the most vulnerable.

zh: 一些主要行动方已经做出了超过承诺的努力。
en: Some significant players are already going above and beyond their pledges.

zh: 其他许多行动方，包括马绍尔群岛在内，准备在2020年推出新目标，扩展目前只延续到2025年的目标。
en: A number of others, including the Marshall Islands, are set to bring forward new targets by 2020, to augment their current targets, which reach only as far as 2025.

zh: 还有一些行动方 — — 包括法国、印度和新西兰 — — 则非正式地表示希望能做得更多。
en: Still others – including France, India, and New Zealand – have said informally that they are eager to do more.

zh: 事实是，几乎所有国家都有能力做得更多，特别是当它们能够获得支持并认识到机会的时候。
en: The truth is that almost all countries have the capacity to do more, especially if the support is there and the opportunities are identified.

zh: 现在的要务是创造正确的政治条件动员和便利行动。
en: The imperative now is to create the right political conditions both to motivate and facilitate action.

zh: 随着越来越多的国家表现出提高承诺目标的能力，还会有更多国家跟进。
en: As more countries signal their ability to increase the ambition of their commitments, still more will follow.

zh: 与此同时，我们必须确保所有行业，以及所有国家，都承担公平的责任。
en: At the same time, we must ensure that every sector, as well as every country, does its fair share.

zh: 这其中包括（比如）国际航运业，如果把它视为一个国家，那么它将是世界第六大排放国。
en: This includes, for example, international shipping, which, if it were a country, would be the world’s sixth-largest emitter.

zh: 明年的“塔拉诺阿对话 ” （ Talanoa Dialogue）将帮助各国认识它们如何实现在巴黎协定所定下的目标。 塔拉诺阿对话将在斐济召开，上周，斐济刚刚成为第一个担任联合国气候对话主席国的岛国。
en: Next year’s “Talanoa Dialogue” – to be convened by Fiji, which last week became the first island state to chair UN climate talks – will help countries identify exactly how they can achieve the goals set in the Paris agreement.

zh: 各国应该怀着良好的意愿参加此次对话，务必使其成为更进一步行动的跳板。
en: That dialogue, which countries should approach in good faith, must be a springboard for further action.

zh: 在这方面，气候变化政府间委员会的最新报告将是一个关键。 该报告提出了将升温幅度限制在1.5℃阈值内的方法。
en: To that end, the recent Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change report laying out pathways for keeping the temperature rise below the 1.5°C threshold will be crucial.

zh: 科学仍然是关键。
en: The science remains key.

zh: 巴黎谈判证明，政治成功是可能的，如果领导人能够获得正确的平台、公民社会能够在他们身后动员起来、世界能够团结行动的话。
en: The Paris talks proved that political success is possible, if leaders are given the right platform, if civil society mobilizes behind them, and if the world acts in unison.

zh: 要满足通往可持续未来之路的剩余条件的话，我们必须再次运用这一教训。
en: To get the rest of the way to a sustainable future, we must apply this lesson again.
