zh: 波恩会议的口号是“更远，更快，更团结 ” 。
en: The catchphrase at the Bonn conference was “further, faster, and together.”

zh: 我们的集体挑战就是将响亮的口号转化为现实。
en: Our collective challenge is to translate a nice-sounding slogan into reality.

zh: 美国经济繁荣背后的风险
en: The Risks to America’s Booming Economy

zh: 坎布里奇—在经历了漫长而缓慢的从十年前开始的衰退中的复苏之后，目前美国经济正在繁荣。
en: CAMBRIDGE – After a long and slow recovery from the recession that began a decade ago, the United States economy is now booming.

zh: 劳动力市场实现了充分就业，通货膨胀率上升，家庭态度乐观。
en: The labor market is at full employment, the inflation rate is rising, and households are optimistic.

zh: 制造业企业和建筑商从经济活动的活跃中获益。
en: Manufacturing firms and homebuilders are benefiting from increasing activity.

zh: 明年经济预计能够实现更加强劲的增长。
en: The economy is poised for stronger growth in the year ahead.

zh: 我们不再听到有人担心长期停滞。
en: We no longer hear worries about secular stagnation.

zh: 总体失业率只有4.7 % ， 而大学毕业生失业率更是低至2.4 % 。
en: The overall unemployment rate is just 4.7%, while unemployment among college graduates is only 2.4%.

zh: 平均时薪比一年前提高了2.8 % 。
en: Average hourly earnings are 2.8% higher than they were a year ago.

zh: 趋紧的劳动力市场和上涨的工资使得一些此前放弃寻找工作的人再次加入劳动力大军，从而刺激了劳动参与率。
en: The tight labor market and rising wages are inducing some individuals who had stopped looking for work to return to the labor force, boosting the participation rate.

zh: 一个经济处于充分就业状态的明确信号是通胀率正在上升。
en: A clear indication that the economy is at full employment is that the rate of inflation is increasing.

zh: “核心”消费物价指数（不含波动较大的能源和食品价格）达到了2.2%的年率，显著高于此前三年1.8%的平均水平。
en: The “core” consumer price index (which omits volatile energy and food prices) has reached an annual rate of 2.2%, substantially higher than the 1.8% average during the previous three years.

zh: 在最近三个月中，核心通胀以2.8%的年率上涨。
en: During the most recent three months, core inflation rose at a 2.8% annual rate.

zh: 家庭财富也在增加。
en: Household wealth is also increasing.

zh: 住房是美国家庭最重要的资产，其价格在最近12个月上涨了5 % 。
en: The price of homes, the most important asset for US households, rose by 5% during the most recent 12 months.

zh: 股市走牛使得广义净财富指标上升更快。
en: The rising stock market has caused the broader measure of net worth to increase even faster.

zh: 消费者态度调查表明人们的感觉非常积极。
en: Surveys of consumer attitudes point to strong positive feelings.

zh: 密歇根大学消费情绪指数最近达到了17年来的高点。
en: The University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index recently reached a 17-year high.

zh: 类似地，美国谘商会（Conference Board）消费者信心指数也在2月份达到了15年来的高点。
en: Likewise, the Conference Board Consumer Confidence Index hit a 15-year high in February.

zh: 制造业企业在过去六个月中的每个月都实现了产出增加。
en: Manufacturing firms have increased output in each of the last six months.

zh: 建筑商也在努力跟上需求，新独栋住房开工量在过去12个月中增加了6%多。
en: Homebuilders are racing to keep up with demand, reflected in an increase of more than 6% in the number of new single-family houses in the past 12 months.

zh: 所有这些都表明2017年真实（经通胀调整的）GDP增长将快于最近几年。
en: All of this suggests that real (inflation-adjusted) GDP will rise more quickly in 2017 than it did in the recent past.

zh: 尽管波动的贸易和库存数字抑制了最新GDP数据，但更基础的私人购买者终端销售数字（按真实值计算）以大约2.5%的年率增长。
en: While volatile trade and inventory numbers have depressed the recent GDP figures, the more fundamental measure of final sales to private purchasers has been rising in real terms at an annual rate of about 2.5%.

zh: 2017年全年总GDP增长可能也在这一水平左右。
en: Overall GDP is likely to increase at a similar rate for 2017 as a whole.

zh: 但尽管当前经济相当健康，仍然比较脆弱。
en: But, although the economy currently is healthy, it is also fragile.

zh: 美国经历了为期十年的极低利率时期，这导致投资者和贷款人通过太高所有类型的资产和进行高风险贷款活动寻找更高的收益率。
en: The US has experienced a decade of excessively low interest rates, which have caused investors and lenders to seek higher yields by bidding up the prices of all types of assets and making risky loans.

zh: 其风险在于定价过高的资产和高风险贷款可能出现价值损失，引起经济衰退。
en: The danger is that overpriced assets and high-risk loans could lose value and cause an economic downturn.

zh: 标准普尔500指数市盈率目前要比历史平均水平高出近70 % 。
en: The price-earnings ratio of the Standard & Poor’s 500 Index is now nearly 70% above its historic average.

zh: 回归市盈率历史均值将意味着股价下跌40 % ， 合9万亿美元损失，相当于总GDP的近一半。
en: A return of the price-earnings ratio to its historic average would cause share prices to decline by 40%, implying a loss of more than $9 trillion, an amount equal to nearly half of total GDP.

zh: 十年期国债收益率目前只有2.5 % 。
en: Ten-year Treasury bonds now yield just 2.5%.

zh: 在当前通胀率超过2 % 、 市场预期在较长期（从五年远期通胀预期看）也将保持这一通胀率的情况下，十年期国债收益率应该高于4 % 。
en: With the current inflation rate of more than 2% and markets anticipating a similar inflation rate over the longer term (as measured by five-year five-year-forward inflation expectations), the yield on ten-year Treasury bonds should be above 4%.

zh: 十年期收益率上升到4%将大大降低这些债券的价值。
en: A rise of the ten-year yield to 4% would reduce the value of those bonds substantially.

zh: 其他长期债券 — — 不论是政府债券还是公司债券 — — 也将发生类似的跌幅。
en: Other long-term bonds – both government bonds and corporate bonds – would suffer similar declines.

zh: 寻找收益率也导致高等级债券和高风险国内和新兴市场债券利差缩小。
en: Reaching for yield has also narrowed credit spreads between high-grade bonds and riskier domestic and emerging-market bonds.

zh: 商业不动产价格也已经被推高到可能无法持续的水平。
en: And commercial real-estate prices have been bid up to levels that are probably not sustainable.

zh: 与此同时，银行和其他贷款人发放了很多利率无法反映借款人风险程度的贷款。
en: At the same time, banks and other lenders have extended loans bearing interest rates that do not reflect the riskiness of the borrowers.

zh: 而由于这些低条件（covenant-light）贷款对借款人的要求较低，因此，当经济环境恶化时，它们的违约率也会更高。
en: And, because these covenant-light loans impose fewer conditions on the borrowers, they are more susceptible to default if economic conditions deteriorate.

zh: 但坏结果并非不可避免。
en: But a bad outcome is not inevitable.

zh: 我所描述的风险都没有成为现实。
en: None of the risks I have described may materialize.

zh: 利率可能会回到正常水平，而资产价格可以逐渐纠正。
en: Interest rates may return to normal levels, and asset prices may gradually correct.

zh: 但一个显而易见的风险是十年来的过低利率将导致资产价格崩盘和经济衰退。
en: But there is a clear risk that a decade of excessively low interest rates will cause a collapse of asset prices and an economic downturn.

zh: 这将是美联储和特朗普政府在今后一年中所面临的一个重大挑战。
en: This will be a major challenge to the US Federal Reserve and the Trump administration in the year ahead.

zh: 大脱钩
en: The Great Disconnect

zh: 巴黎—自2012年下半年以来，全世界金融市场强势复苏。
en: PARIS – Since the second half of 2012, financial markets have recovered strongly worldwide.

zh: 事实上，在美国，道琼斯工业平均指数在3月初创出史上新高，自去年9月一阿莱上涨近9 % 。
en: Indeed, in the United States, the Dow Jones industrial average reached an all-time high in early March, having risen by close to 9% since September.

zh: 在欧洲，欧洲央行行长德拉吉的“八月火力 ” （ guns of August）也相当强劲。
en: In Europe, European Central Bank President Mario Draghi’s “guns of August” turned out to be remarkably effective.

zh: 德拉吉承诺潜在的无限量购买成员国国债，这扭转了欧元的颓势。
en: Draghi reversed the euro’s slide into oblivion by promising potentially unlimited purchases of member governments’ bonds.

zh: 9月1日至2月22日，FTSEruofirst指数上涨近7 % 。
en: Between September 1 and February 22, the FTSEurofirst index rose by almost 7%.

zh: 亚洲金融市场自去年9月以来也有所上涨，特别是日本。
en: In Asia, too, financial markets are up since September, most dramatically in Japan.

zh: 就连2月末的意大利选举也没有给市场带来多大不安（至少到目前为止是如此 ） 。
en: Even the Italian elections in late February seem not to have upset markets too much (at least so far).

zh: 尽管意大利和西班牙十年期债券相对德国的利差在结果公布后扩大了30—50个基点，但随后减小至300—350个基点，而在欧洲央行的“直接货币交易”计划决定之前，利差高达500—600个基点。
en: Although interest-rate spreads for Italian and Spanish ten-year bonds relative to German bonds briefly jumped 30-50 basis points after the results were announced, they then eased to 300-350 basis points, compared to 500-600 basis points before the ECB’s decision to establish its “outright monetary transactions” program.

zh: 但金融市场的欢腾与政治和实体经济指标并不相符。
en: But this financial market buoyancy is at odds with political events and real economic indicators.

zh: 在美国，2012年的经济表现只是略有好转，GDP增长率从2011年的1.8%增至2.3 % 。
en: In the US, economic performance improved only marginally in 2012, with annual GDP rising by 2.3%, up from 1.8% in 2011.

zh: 失业率仍然很高，2012年末水平为7.8 % ， 且过去数年来真实工资几无增长。
en: Unemployment remained high, at 7.8% at the end of 2012, and there has been almost no real wage growth over the last few years.

zh: 美国的中位家庭收入低于2007年水平 — — 事实上，与20年前的水平差不多 — — 危机前美国收入增长总值的约九成落入了最顶端1%家庭的腰包。
en: Median household income in the US is still below its 2007 level – indeed, close to its level two decades ago – and roughly 90% of all US income gains in the post-crisis period have accrued to the top 1% of households.

zh: 欧元区的指标更加糟糕。
en: Indicators for the eurozone are even worse.

zh: 2012年出现了经济收缩和工资下降，尽管德国和一些北欧国家有所增加。
en: The economy contracted in 2012, and wages declined, despite increases in Germany and some northern countries.

zh: 可靠的数据仍然无法获得，但南欧的贫困情况出现了几十年来的首次恶化。
en: Reliable statistics are not yet available, but poverty in Europe’s south is increasing for the first time in decades.

zh: 在政治方面，美国面临着几乎全面的立法僵局，看不到形成可能催生最优政策组合（提振有效需求的短期支持和长期结构性改革和财政整固）的信号。
en: On the political front, the US faces a near-complete legislative stalemate, with no sign of a compromise that could lead to the optimal policy mix: short-term support to boost effective demand and long-term structural reforms and fiscal consolidation.

zh: 在欧洲，希腊到目前为止尚能维持议会多数支持联合政府，但（不仅是希腊）极端民粹主义政党势头渐长。
en: In Europe, Greece has been able – so far – to maintain a parliamentary majority in support of the coalition government, but there, and elsewhere, hyper-populist parties are gaining ground.

zh: 意大利选举结果或许是欧洲的先声。
en: The Italian election results could be a bellwether for Europe.

zh: 格里洛（Beppe Grillo）的民粹主义五星运动（Five Star Movement）获得了25%的选票，是支持率最高的政党。
en: Beppe Grillo’s populist Five Star Movement emerged with 25% of the popular vote – the highest support for any single party.

zh: 前总理贝卢斯科尼令那些预测他已被政治打倒的人大跌眼镜，在民粹主义右翼联盟中独占鳌头，仅仅比获胜所需的支持率低了0.3 % 。
en: Former Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi, confounding those who had forecast his political demise, re-emerged at the head of a populist-rightist coalition that ended up only 0.3 percentage points away from winning.

zh: 简言之，我们正在经历金融市场和包容性社会和经济福利的快速脱钩。
en: In short, we are witnessing a rapid decoupling between financial markets and inclusive social and economic well-being.

zh: 在美国和其他许多国家，公司利润占国民收入的比重处于几十年来的高点，部分是因为在诸多部门采取了节约劳动力的技术。
en: In the US and many other places, corporate profits as a share of national income are at a decades-long high, in part owing to labor-saving technology in a multitude of sectors.

zh: 此外，大公司能够充分利用全球化（比如在税收制度间套利以实现薪酬支付最小化 ） 。
en: Moreover, large corporations are able to take full advantage of globalization (for example, by arbitraging tax regimes to minimize their payments).

zh: 结果，全球精英的收入快速增加，并日渐独立于总产出和就业增长。
en: As a result, the income of the global elite is growing both rapidly and independently of what is happening in terms of overall output and employment growth.

zh: 奢侈品需求暴涨，而较低收入群体的消费商品和服务需求疲软。
en: Demand for luxury goods is booming, alongside weak demand for goods and services consumed by lower-income groups.

zh: 所有这些都发生在极度扩张性的货币政策和近零利率环境中，除了那些直接面临危机的国家。
en: All of this is happening in the midst of extremely expansionary monetary policies and near-zero interest rates, except in the countries facing immediate crisis.

zh: 收入向顶端的结构性集中正在与宽松的货币政策和追逐收益率相结合，推高股市。
en: Structural concentration of incomes at the top is combining with easy money and a chase for yield, driving equity prices upward.

zh: 而尽管关于贫困、失业、不平等性和收入和财富的极端集中的担忧和焦虑在不断蔓延，我们却找不到替代增长模式。
en: And yet, despite widespread concern and anxiety about poverty, unemployment, inequality, and extreme concentration of incomes and wealth, no alternative growth model has emerged.

zh: 在欧洲，对主流的反对分裂为两个阵营，一是“老式”左派，已脱节于21世纪的现实；二是右翼民粹主义、排外主义甚至直截了当的法西斯政党。
en: The opposition to the dominant mainstream in Europe is split between what is still too often an “old” left that has trouble adjusting to twenty-first-century realities, and populist, anti-foreigner, and sometimes outright fascist parties on the right.

zh: 在美国，极右翼与欧洲民粹主义有着诸多相似之处。
en: In the US, the far right shares many of the characteristics of its populist European counterparts.

zh: 但由于美国两党制对政治团结的巨大作用，尽管茶党在大声疾呼，极端势力仍处于边缘地位。
en: But it is a tribute to the American two-party system’s capacity for political integration that extremist forces remain marginalized, despite the rhetoric of the Tea Party.

zh: 特别是，总统奥巴马仍有能力以兼为左翼自由主义理想派和中间道路理想主义派的身份赢得支持，这是他能够在经济疲软、劳动力市场更加疲软的情况下赢得连任。
en: President Barack Obama, in particular, has been able to attract support as a liberal-left idealist and as a centrist-realist at the same time, which enabled him to win re-election in the face of a weak economy and an even weaker labor market.

zh: 尽管如此，除非实行深刻的社会经济改革，否则美国GDP增长将不可能加快，而其政治制度将陷入瘫痪。
en: Nonetheless, without deep socio-economic reforms, America’s GDP growth is likely to be slow at best, while its political system seems paralyzed.

zh: 没有可信的计划来限制财富和权力的集中、通过穷人真实收入的强劲增长扩大经济收益，并维持宏观经济稳定。
en: Nowhere is there a credible plan to limit the concentration of wealth and power, broaden economic gains through strong real-income growth for the poor, and maintain macroeconomic stability.

zh: 美国（和欧洲）的缺少这样一个计划是金融市场脱钩于包容性经济进步的一个原因，因为这表明当前趋势在政治上是可持续的。
en: The absence of such a plan in the US (and in Europe) has contributed to the decoupling of financial markets from inclusive economic progress, because it suggests that current trends are politically sustainable.

zh: 但是，尽管在没有替代方案的情况下，这一脱钩可能持续一段时间，但金融市场表现和大部分人的福利之间的巨大差异不可能长期维持。
en: But, while this disconnect could continue for some time if no alternative program emerges, the huge gap between financial markets’ performance and most people’s well-being is unlikely to persist in the longer term.

zh: 超越现实的资产价格别无去向，最终只能往下走。
en: When asset prices overshoot reality, eventually they have nowhere to go but down.

zh: 经济刺激为何失败？
en: Why Stimulus Has Failed

zh: 新德里 — — 两大基本信念驱动着全球各国近些年的经济政策。
en: NEW DELHI – Two fundamental beliefs have driven economic policy around the world in recent years.

zh: 其一，相对于总供给，全球总需求短缺；其二，货币和财政刺激将填补此一缺口。
en: The first is that the world suffers from a shortage of aggregate demand relative to supply; the second is that monetary and fiscal stimulus will close the gap.

zh: 有没有可能是这样：前一条做出的诊断是对的，而后一条开出的药方错了？
en: Is it possible that the diagnosis is right, but that the remedy is wrong?

zh: 这似乎可以解释，为什么我们努力想让经济复苏到危机前的水平，但迄今为止进展不大。
en: That would explain why we have made little headway so far in restoring growth to pre-crisis levels.

zh: 这也表明，我们需要反思药方是不是有问题。
en: And it would also indicate that we must rethink our remedies.

zh: 非自愿失业水平在发达经济体普遍居高不下，说明需求落后于潜在供给。
en: High levels of involuntary unemployment throughout the advanced economies suggest that demand lags behind potential supply.

zh: 特别高的失业率固然集中在那些危机前的繁荣行业里，如美国的建筑业，但高失业率依然是更多行业的普遍现象，这也支持了必须以扩大需求重振就业的观点。
en: While unemployment is significantly higher in sectors that were booming before the crisis, such as construction in the United States, it is more widespread, underpinning the view that greater demand is necessary to restore full employment.

zh: 最初，政策制定者依靠政府支出和低利率来保需求。
en: Policymakers initially resorted to government spending and low interest rates to boost demand.

zh: 等到政府债台高筑、利率低得不能再低，各国央行又全力以赴地创新政策以促进需求。
en: As government debt has ballooned and policy interest rates have hit rock bottom, central banks have focused on increasingly innovative policy to boost demand.

zh: 但增长依然惨淡。
en: Yet growth continues to be painfully slow.

zh: 为什么？
en: Why?

zh: 人们假定，创造需求的效果是均等的，但如果这个假定本身错了呢？
en: What if the problem is the assumption that all demand is created equal?

zh: 我们知道，危机前的需求是由大规模借贷支撑的。
en: We know that pre-crisis demand was boosted by massive amounts of borrowing.

zh: 随着借贷门槛降低，增加消费的并非富人群体，他们的支出本不受收入制约；增加消费的主要是贫穷和年轻的家庭，他们的梦想超出了他们的收入。
en: When borrowing becomes easier, it is not the well-to-do, whose spending is not constrained by their incomes, who increase their consumption; rather, the increase comes from poorer and younger families whose needs and dreams far outpace their incomes.

zh: 他们的需求与富人不同。
en: Their needs can be different from those of the rich.

zh: 此外，这部分人群最倾向于购买的是可以充当抵押品的货物 — — 房子、车子，而不是易损耗品。
en: Moreover, the goods that are easiest to buy are those that are easy to post as collateral – houses and cars, rather than perishables.

zh: 而某些地区的房价上涨使得借款人有更多余力购买纸尿裤和婴儿用品等日用品。
en: And rising house prices in some regions make it easier to borrow even more to spend on other daily needs such as diapers and baby food.

zh: 事情的要害在于，举债维持的需求，集中于特定地区的特定人群，针对特定货物。
en: The point is that debt-fueled demand emanates from particular households in particular regions for particular goods.

zh: 虽然它也会带动其他需求 — — 房地产热使上年纪的管道工业务增加，让他可以花更多的钱去集邮 — — 但说大部分举债维持的需求是较为集中的并无不妥。
en: While it catalyzes a more generalized demand – the elderly plumber who works longer hours in the boom spends more on his stamp collection – it is not unreasonable to believe that much of debt-fueled demand is more focused.

zh: 所以，一旦贷款枯竭，举债消费的家庭再也无钱开销，对特定货物的需求便以超常的方式崩塌，特别是在早前繁荣的那些地区。
en: So, as lending dries up, borrowing households can no longer spend, and demand for certain goods changes disproportionately, especially in areas that boomed earlier.

zh: 当然，由此产生的效应渗透了整个经济 — — 汽车需求下滑，带动钢铁需求下滑、钢铁工人下岗。
en: Of course, the effects spread through the economy – as demand for cars falls, demand for steel also falls, and steel workers are laid off.

zh: 但失业问题最严重的还是建筑业和汽车制造业，或者是那些原先房价上涨速度太离谱的地方。
en: But unemployment is most pronounced in the construction and automobile sectors, or in regions where house prices rose particularly rapidly.

zh: 不难理解，对需求的一般刺激，例如减征工资税，在重振就业方面效果不好。
en: It is easy to see why a general stimulus to demand, such as a cut in payroll taxes, may be ineffective in restoring the economy to full employment.

zh: 一般刺激针对的是所有人，而不是之前的举债人。
en: The general stimulus goes to everyone, not just the former borrowers.

zh: 而人与人的支出模式是不同的 — — 老人、富人会去买蒂梵尼的珠宝，而不是GM的汽车。
en: And everyone’s spending patterns differ – the older, wealthier household buys jewelry from Tiffany, rather than a car from General Motors.

zh: 而原先的举债人也不太会再用刺激资金去买房 — — 他们的房产梦早已幻灭了。
en: And even the former borrowers are unlikely to use their stimulus money to pay for more housing – they have soured on the dreams that housing held out.

zh: 说真的，由于借贷可能性已发生改变，需求模式也变了，在不引发通胀的情况下经济能够增长的速度也降低了。
en: Indeed, because the pattern of demand that is expressible has shifted with the change in access to borrowing, the pace at which the economy can grow without inflation may also fall.

zh: 由于建筑工人太多而珠宝买主很少，所以总体需求的增加将主要反映为珠宝价格的上涨而不是国民经济产出的增加。
en: With too many construction workers and too few jewelers, greater demand may result in higher jewelry prices rather than more output.

zh: 换言之，继多年举债维持的繁荣而来的泡沫破灭造成了这样一种经济：同已变化的需求格格不入的那些货物太多了。
en: Put differently, the bust that follows years of a debt-fueled boom leaves behind an economy that supplies too much of the wrong kind of good relative to the changed demand.

zh: 这种衰退不同于普通的周期性衰退，在普通的周期性衰退里，需求下滑是普遍的，而复苏也仅需重新雇佣原先被解雇的工人就可以了。 信贷泡沫破灭后的经济复苏，往往需要依靠劳动力的跨行业转移。
en: Unlike a normal cyclical recession, in which demand falls across the board and recovery requires merely rehiring laid-off workers to resume their old jobs, economic recovery following a lending bust typically requires workers to move across industries and to new locations.

zh: 所以，在我的举债驱动型需求观和新凯恩斯主义之间就存在一种微妙然而重要的差别。 新凯恩斯主义认为，去杠杆化过程（吃了苦头的借款人进行存款）或债务后遗症（被债务压得喘不过气来的借款人无力支出）要为危机后低迷的增长率负责。
en: There is thus a subtle but important difference between my debt-driven demand view and the neo-Keynesian explanation that deleveraging (saving by chastened borrowers) or debt overhang (the inability of debt-laden borrowers to spend) is responsible for slow post-crisis growth.

zh: 两种观点都承认，总需求疲软的主要原因是原先借款人需求的消失。
en: Both views accept that the central source of weak aggregate demand is the disappearance of demand from former borrowers.

zh: 但它们开出的解决方案不同。
en: But they differ on solutions.

zh: 新凯恩斯主义经济学家想要一般地提振需求。
en: The neo-Keynesian economist wants to boost demand generally.

zh: 但如果我们相信债务驱动型需求有其特殊性，那我们就得承认需求刺激政策最多是治标不治本。
en: But if we believe that debt-driven demand is different, demand stimulus will at best be a palliative.

zh: 为了恢复原有的需求模式，对原借款���的债务进行减记，效果固然比一般性刺激略好，但这种策略也很难让需求恢复到危机前的水平。
en: Writing down former borrowers’ debt may be slightly more effective in producing the old pattern of demand, but it will probably not restore it to the pre-crisis level.

zh: 更何况，我们真的想让原先的那些借款人再度陷入泥潭吗？
en: In any case, do we really want the former borrowers to borrow themselves into trouble again?

zh: 唯一具有可持续性的解决方案是，允许供给端进行调整，以适应更普通更有持续性的需求 — — 对建筑工人和汽车工人进行重新培训，以便利其转向高增长产业。
en: The only sustainable solution is to allow the supply side to adjust to more normal and sustainable sources of demand – to ease the way for construction workers and autoworkers to retrain for faster-growing industries.

zh: 政府所能做的最差的一件事则是，支持末路企业，用廉价信贷维持末路产业的需求，图一时之效，妨碍劳动力转移之路。
en: The worst thing that governments can do is to stand in the way by propping up unviable firms or by sustaining demand in unviable industries through easy credit.

zh: 供给端调整需要时间，而在持续衰退5年之后，经济稍稍有了些起色。
en: Supply-side adjustments take time, and, after five years of recession, economies have made some headway.

zh: 但长时间“误诊”的影响还会持续一段时间。
en: But continued misdiagnosis will have lasting effects.

zh: 发达经济体将付出几十年的时间消化高企的公债负担，而其央行也将不得不放松臃肿的资产负债表，并且放弃支持市场的承诺，令后者无所适从。
en: The advanced countries will spend decades working off high public-debt loads, while their central banks will have to unwind bloated balance sheets and back off from promises of support that markets have come to rely on.

zh: 可怕的是，日本新一届政府仍在应对该国持续20年之久的泡沫破灭后遗症。
en: Frighteningly, the new Japanese government is still trying to deal with the aftermath of the country’s two-decade-old property bust.

zh: 我们只能希望，它不要再搞支出扩张了，这条路已经证明是走不通的，而且让日本成了经合组织中债务负担最高的国家（约为GDP的230 % ） 。
en: One can only hope that it will not indulge in more of the kind of spending that already has proven so ineffective – and that has left Japan with the highest debt burden (around 230% of GDP) in the OECD.

zh: 不幸的是，从日本的历史来看，我们没有什么理由对此感到乐观。
en: Unfortunately, history provides little cause for optimism.

zh: 塑料废物的污点
en: The Dirt on Plastic Waste

zh: 纽瓦克，新泽西—塑料在生活中随处可见。
en: NEWARK, NJ – Plastics are everywhere.

zh: 不管是被用于盛装废物、保持医院设备无菌状态，还是用于房屋隔热，塑料都以其可塑性、耐久性和低成本拥有无可比拟的优势。
en: Whether used to store leftovers, keep hospital equipment sterile, or insulate a home, plastics are unmatched for their adaptability, durability, and low cost.

zh: 塑料的好处无穷尽，因此毫不奇怪，它取代诸多部门的传统材料 — — 比如用于汽车的钢材、用于包装的纸材和玻璃、用于家具的木头等。
en: Given their seemingly boundless benefits, it is unsurprising that plastics have replaced traditional materials in many sectors – for example, steel in cars, paper and glass in packaging, and wood in furniture.

zh: 结果，全世界塑料的年消费量从20世纪50年代的500万吨增加到今天的2.8亿吨。
en: As a result, annual plastics consumption worldwide has increased from five million tons in the 1950’s to around 280 million tons today.

zh: 大约一半的塑料制品 — — 比如包装盒 — — 是一次性用品，其使用前保质期很短（不到半年 ） 。
en: Roughly half of plastic products, such as packaging, are intended for one-time, short-lifespan (less than six months) applications prior to disposal.

zh: 这些东西大多不可生物降解，也不可回收，因此塑料废物激增，带来了严重的环境后果。
en: Given that most of these items are not biodegradable, and are not recycled, plastics waste is building up – with serious environmental consequences.

zh: 尽管政府已开始实施新的（通常相当严格）旨在治理塑料废物的监管 — — 比如中国在2008年开始禁止使用轻质塑料购物袋 — — 但并不足以解决越来越严重的塑料废物问题。
en: While governments have begun to implement new (and often quite strict) regulations aimed at managing plastics waste – for example, China banned lightweight plastic shopping bags in 2008 – they are inadequate to address the world’s growing plastics-waste problem.

zh: 此外，大部分塑料制品源自所谓的“基于石油的商品热塑性塑料 ” 。
en: Moreover, most plastic products are made from so-called “petroleum-based commodity thermoplastics.”

zh: 由于许多塑料制品 — — 大部分使用时间很短 — — 来自不可再生资源，当前的塑料使用模式是不可持续的。
en: Given that a non-renewable resource forms the basis of many plastic products – most of which will not last long – current plastics usage patterns are not sustainable.

zh: 因此，闭环循环 — — 用塑料废物生产其他产品 — — 能带来极大的环境好处，比如减少能源和石油消费。
en: Closed-loop recycling, in which plastics waste is used to make another product, thus carries significant environmental benefits, such as reduced energy and oil consumption.

zh: 但分离基于石油的可循环塑料和其他种类的塑料和固体废物十分困难、成本高昂且属于劳动密集型工作，因此只有少部分塑料得到了循环利用。
en: But the process of separating the petroleum-based recyclable plastics from other kinds of plastics and solid waste is difficult, costly, and labor-intensive, so only a small proportion is recycled.

zh: 1988年，美国塑料行业协会（SPI）制定了一套规则，每种树脂都被标以1—7中的一个数字以方便储存。
en: In 1988, the United States Society of Plastics Industry (SPI) developed a coding system in which each kind of resin is labeled with a number, 1-7, to facilitate sorting.

zh: 这一制度也为加拿大和瑞士等其他国家所用，但并未在全世界普及，也容易混淆消费者。
en: The system has also been used elsewhere, including in Canada and Switzerland, but has not been adopted worldwide and is still confusing to some consumers.

zh: 如果消费者懂得在有条件时按数字收集和分类家庭塑料，那么由此带来的对塑料循环利用的刺激作用将向政府和行业证明存在可持续方法，减轻对石油价格上涨的风险暴露，并支撑日渐增加的全球塑料需求。
en: If consumers knew to collect and separate household plastics based on their number, when available, the resulting boost to recycling efforts would demonstrate to government and industry the viability of a more sustainable approach, reduce exposure to rising oil prices, and support growing global demand for plastics.

zh: 塑料循环利用有四种形式：初级循环，即塑料重新用于相同用途；二级循环，即（被混合或受污染的）材料用于要求较低的用途；三级循环，即用回收塑料提炼单体和化学物质；四级循环，即焚烧并利用从中产生的能量。
en: There are four categories of plastics recycling: primary recycling, in which the plastic is re-used in the same application; secondary recycling, in which material (mixed or contaminated) is used in less demanding applications; tertiary recycling, in which the plastic is converted into monomers or chemicals; and quaternary recycling, in which only energy is recovered through incineration.

zh: 每种方式利用的塑料制品内含能量不同。
en: Each of these methods recovers a different amount of the embodied energy of the plastic item.

zh: （如果塑料被填埋 — — 这是世界普遍采用的处理方式 — — 则其内含能量将完全浪费。 ）
en: (All of the embodied energy is lost if the plastics are landfilled, a common disposal method worldwide.)

zh: 由于分离塑料费力费钱，因此最划算的办法通常是对少数商品热塑性塑料予以二级循环利用 — — 其中大部分是瓶子，其收集基础设施已经建成。
en: Given the difficulty and expense of separating plastics, the most economically viable option is often secondary recycling of a few commodity thermoplastics – mostly bottles, for which collection infrastructure is already in place.

zh: 更经济的分离办法对于扩大塑料循环利用范围来说是至关重要的，同样重要的还有指出回收品的新的潜在市场。
en: More economical separation methods are crucial to expanding the scope of plastics recycling, as is the identification of new potential markets for the recyclates.

zh: 这样的发展将鼓励产业界循环和再利用更多的部分。
en: Such developments would encourage industry to re-use or recycle more parts.

zh: 尽管北美汽车业所用的40种塑料都可以循环利用，但分离和清洁塑料的需要导致循环利用的成本比使用全新塑料树脂更高。
en: Although all 40 kinds of plastics used in a North American automobile can be recycled, the need to separate and clean them makes using them more expensive than using virgin plastic resins.

zh: 这导致报废汽车中的塑料残余（塑料和非塑料的受污混合物，通常用填埋、焚化和二级循环的混合方法处理）比例较高。
en: This translates into a higher proportion of plastics in the remnants of shredded end-of-life automobiles – a contaminated mixture of plastics and non-plastics that is usually disposed of through some combination of landfilling, incineration, and secondary recycling.

zh: 提高再利用塑料是迈向可持续塑料消费的关键一步。
en: Increasing the proportion of re-used plastics is a crucial step toward more sustainable plastics consumption.

zh: 在这方面，一些汽车制造商已经调整了设计方案，让兼容塑料制成的部件变得容易拆卸，政府也设置了报废汽车循环利用比例目标。
en: To this end, some automobile manufacturers have adjusted their designs to allow for easy disassembly of parts made of compatible plastics, while governments have set recycling target proportions for end-of-life vehicles.

zh: 这些措施应该得到强化。
en: Such efforts should be intensified.

zh: 此外，产业界应该为可循环利用材料寻找新的应用，同时最小化新材料的使用。
en: Furthermore, industry should seek new applications for recycled materials, while minimizing the amount of virgin material used.

zh: 在可能的条件下，制造商应该“向下加料 ” （ 即把部件做得更薄 ） 。
en: And, where possible, manufacturers should “down-gauge” materials (make parts thinner).

zh: 政府立法应该支持这些措施，并要求塑料制造商参与塑料制品的处置 — — 在欧洲，这一责任长期以来被强加给了包装品制造商。
en: Government legislation can be enacted to support such measures, as well as to require plastics manufacturers to get involved in the disposal of plastic items – a responsibility long imposed on packaged-goods manufacturers in Europe.

zh: 成功废物管理的一个例子是将PET瓶子（聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯制品）处理成聚酯纤维。
en: An example of successful waste management is the reprocessing of PET bottles (made of polyethylene terephthalate) into polyester fibers.

zh: 过去十年中，日本通过了数项法律，强制企业和个人分离塑料废物。
en: In the last decade, Japan passed several laws obliging both businesses and individuals to separate plastics waste.

zh: 这与填埋场所的短缺和人口的增加一道，正在加强塑料循环利用措施。
en: This, combined with a lack of landfill space and the country’s expanding population, has enhanced plastics recycling efforts.

zh: 结果，到2010年，日本循环利用了72%的PET瓶子，而美国和欧洲分别只有30%和48 % 。
en: As a result, in 2010, Japan recycled 72% of PET bottles, compared to roughly 30% in the US and 48% in Europe.

zh: 焚化和填埋仍然是处理塑料废物的方式，但高循环率���显了定向政策的积极效果。
en: While incineration and landfilling are still practiced, such high recycling rates underscore the positive impact of targeted policies.

zh: 另一个令人振奋的发展是生物塑料。 过去二十年来，在某些短寿命应用领域（如包装和农业 ） ， 生物塑料已开始与基于石油的产品竞争。
en: Another promising development is bioplastics, which have begun to compete with petroleum-based products in certain short-lifespan applications – such as packaging and agriculture – over the last two decades.

zh: 生物塑料是用“基于生物”的可再生资源（纤维素、淀粉和葡萄糖）和（在某些情况下）微生物发酵过程制成的，其碳迹更低、对全球变暖影响更小，并能通过生物降解变成小分子。
en: Given that bioplastics are produced from renewable or “bio-based” sources (cellulose, starch, and glucose) – and, in some cases, through microbial fermentation – they have a lower carbon footprint, contribute less to global warming, and biodegrade to small molecules.

zh: 但生物塑料并不是塑料废物管理的万灵丹。
en: But bioplastics are not a silver bullet for managing plastics waste.

zh: 事实上，它可能威胁基于石油的塑料的二级循环，因为在混合使用过程中会出现污染。
en: In fact, they may threaten the secondary recycling of petroleum-based plastics, owing to possible contamination during sorting of mixed streams.

zh: 批评者还担心以工业目的（如塑料和乙醇产品）种植的玉米和其他作物会带来环境问题，更不用说对全球粮食价格的潜在影响了。
en: And critics have expressed concern about the environmental impact of corn and other crops grown for industrial purposes, such as plastics and ethanol production, not to mention the potential effects on global food prices.

zh: 在这个依赖塑料的世界中，更加可持续的塑料制品生产、消费和处理至关重要。
en: In a world that is reliant on plastics, more sustainable production, consumption, and disposal of plastic products is crucial.

zh: 公民社会、产业界和政府必须精诚合作，提高可循环利用塑料的比重，从而确保塑料成本不会超过它的好处。
en: Civil society, industry, and government must work together to increase the share of recycled plastics, thereby ensuring that plastics’ costs do not outweigh their benefits.

zh: 韩国能生更多婴儿吗？
en: Can South Korea Make More Babies?

zh: 首尔—韩国正面临严重的人口挑战。
en: SEOUL – South Korea is facing major demographic challenges.

zh: 总体生育率（每位妇女生孩子的数量）仅2.14，位居世界最低行列，也远远低于不需要移民就可以维持人口规模的水平2.1。
en: The total fertility rate (the number of children per woman), at 1.24, is one of the lowest in the world, and well below the level – 2.1 children per woman – needed to sustain a population without immigration.

zh: 结果，韩国人口迅速老化，而政府尽管使出了浑身解数，却束手无策。
en: As a result, the population is aging fast, and the government, despite its best efforts, seems to have no answer.

zh: 低生育率是工业化国家所面临的共同现象。
en: A low birthrate is common in industrialized countries.

zh: 韩国经济繁荣之前 — — 从前韩国人认为孩子越多越安全 — — 生育率要高得多，1960年前平均达6以上。
en: Before South Korea’s economic boom – a time when having more children was viewed as a source of security in old age – the fertility rate was much higher, averaging more than six until 1960.

zh: 但是，随着韩国经济的发展，育儿成本的提高，女性劳动力参与率的上升，生育率显著下降，20世纪80年代降低到2以下。
en: But, as South Korea’s economy advanced, child-rearing costs rose, and female labor-force participation increased, the fertility rate declined dramatically, dropping below two in the 1980s.

zh: 一开始，生育率下降对经济有利，因为家庭能存更多的钱并投资于孩子的发展。
en: At first, falling fertility rates were an economic blessing, as households saved more and invested in children’s development.

zh: 2015年，女性大学就读率达到了81 % ， 而1980年只有6 % 。
en: In 2015, the college enrollment rate for women hit 81%, compared to just 6% in 1980.

zh: 但劳动力主力大军的减少最近开始制约经济增长，并有可能让公共退休金系统不堪重负。
en: But the decline of the prime working-age population has lately been undercutting economic growth, and threatens to place excessive pressure on the public pension system down the road.

zh: 韩国政府进行了一系列措施试图刺激生育率，从而解决这一挑战。
en: South Korea’s government has attempted to address these challenges with a series of measures aimed at boosting fertility rates.

zh: 最新方案包括增加产假、第三个孩子优先在公共育儿机构注册、生育医疗补贴等。
en: A recent package includes more paternity leave, priority enrollment in public childcare facilities for third children, and subsidies for infertility treatment.

zh: 但这些措施是否能提高生育率颇可怀疑，原因很简单：它们无法充分消除导致韩国人推迟或放弃要孩子的沉重的经济障碍。
en: But whether these measures will lead to higher fertility rates is dubious, for a simple reason: they fail to tackle sufficiently the high economic hurdles that are causing South Koreans to delay or forego having children.

zh: 这些障碍之一是教育成本。
en: One of those hurdles is the cost of education.

zh: 韩国家长愿意投入重金为仅有的孩子提供最好的发展机会。
en: South Korean parents are willing to invest heavily in giving their few children the best chance of prospering.

zh: 2015年，他们花了可支配收入的近7%用于小学和初中家教。
en: In 2015, they spent almost 7% of their disposable income on private tutoring for their children in primary and secondary education.

zh: 他们还花费巨资让孩子上大学，而上大学早已不是出人头地的保证。
en: They also pay an absurdly high price for their children’s college education, which no longer guarantees prosperity in life.

zh: 事实上，韩国大学教育私人支出为经合组织国家中最高的之一，甚至比美国还高。
en: In fact, South Korea’s share of private spending for college education is the highest among OECD countries, even ahead of the United States.

zh: 这让很多孩子的家长不堪重负。
en: That limits how many children parents may feel they can afford to raise.

zh: 对许多韩国年轻人来说，拜住房成本和年轻人失业率等因素所赐，如今连结婚也未必结得起，即使是大学毕业生也是如此。
en: For many young South Koreans, even marriage is economically unfeasible nowadays, owing to factors like high housing costs and youth unemployment, even among university graduates.

zh: 韩国新人数量从1996年的435,000人下降到2015年的302,800人。
en: The number of weddings in South Korea plunged from 435,000 in 1996 to 302,800 in 2015.

zh: 韩国非婚生比率只有2 % ， 因此这一趋势严重影响了生育率。
en: In a country where only 2% of children are born outside marriage, this trend has a powerful impact on fertility rates.

zh: 女性所面临的的提高生育率壁垒最为严重。
en: Women confront the highest barriers to increased fertility.

zh: 普遍的性别不平等以及缺少平价品质儿童看护服务让许多韩国女性在婚后或产后退出劳动力大军。
en: Pervasive gender inequality, together with a lack of affordable, high-quality childcare, causes many South Korean women to withdraw from the labor market after marriage or childbirth.

zh: 男性工作时间漫长又缺乏弹性，女性承担了大部分家政责任。
en: While men work long, inflexible hours, women assume the lion’s share of the responsibility for family care.

zh: 2014年的调查表明韩国女性平均每天要花3小时28分钟用于家务和家政，而男性仅为47分钟。 2015年男性产假只占总量的5.6 % 。
en: A 2014 survey indicated that South Korean women spent, on average, three hours and 28 minutes daily on household activities and family care, compared to just 47 minutes for men, who also accounted for only 5.6% of those who took parental leave in 2015.

zh: 新措施旨在提高这一比例，但还不够。
en: Though the new measures aim to boost this share, it will not be enough.

zh: 毕竟，女性不但难以安心完整的休产假；许多人在产后彻底退出了工作。
en: After all, women are not just struggling to cope with uneven parental leave; many are leaving their jobs altogether after childbirth.

zh: 许多人并不想这样。
en: And many of them do not wish to do so.

zh: 韩国工业联合会的一份最新调查显示，38%的单身女性受访者称自己不想要孩子，大部分是因为担心要了孩子就无法胜任工作或失去工作。
en: In a recent survey by the Federation of Korean Industries, 38% of the single female respondents said that they do not want children, mostly because they fear that they will struggle to keep up at work or lose their jobs.

zh: 只有三分之一的受访者对政府刺激生育率的措施持肯定态度。
en: Only one-third responded positively to the government’s program for promoting fertility.

zh: 韩国政府必须采取更加全面的方案，以降低一些育儿壁垒为目标。
en: South Korea’s government must pursue a more comprehensive policy package aimed at lowering some of the barriers to childbirth.

zh: 特别是女性需要更大的支持，从而让她们不必面临职业和家庭的二选一问题。
en: Women, in particular, need greater support, in order to eliminate the binary choice between career and family.

zh: 关键是采取灵活的工作安排、构建更加包容的公司文化，以及确保育儿服务（包括公共和私营服务）的普及。
en: The key is to provide more flexible work arrangements, to build a more accepting corporate culture, and to ensure accessible childcare, both public and private.

zh: 在这方面，引入外国家政人员和儿童看护人员将大有裨益。
en: To this end, allowing the migration of foreign housekeepers and caregivers could be very helpful.

zh: 韩国对于授予外族人永久居留权仍然十分保守。
en: South Korea remains conservative about offering permanent residency to foreign nationals.

zh: 但现实是，在育儿和家政市场服务普及的发达经济体中，教育程度较高的女性倾向于要更多的孩子，特别是当她们年纪较大时。
en: But the reality is that, in advanced economies where market services for childcare and households are available, highly educated women tend to have more children, especially at older ages.

zh: 比如，日本成功地将其极低的生育率 — — 2005年达到1.26的最低值提高到了2015年的1.46，他们的办法是持之以恒地降低育儿成本和改变公司文化。
en: Japan, for its part, has managed to boost its ultra-low fertility rate – which bottomed out in 2005 at 1.26 – to 1.46 in 2015, through consistent efforts to reduce childrearing costs and change the corporate culture.

zh: 为了保持这一复苏势头，日本最近决定采取措施吸引更多外国家政人员。
en: To sustain this recovery, it has recently decided to take initiatives to attract more foreign housekeepers.

zh: 这些变化体现了日本首相安倍晋三阻止日本人口下降到1亿以下的承诺。
en: These changes reflect Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s commitment to prevent the population from falling below 100 million.

zh: 即使外来家政工作者没有提高生育率，也可以让更多女性在要了孩子后继续工作。
en: Even where foreign household workers do not raise the fertility rate, they enable more women to continue working after having children.

zh: 比如，新加坡家庭常常雇用来自包括菲律宾和印尼等邻国的住家保姆来做家务和看孩子。
en: In Singapore, for example, families often hire live-in maids from neighboring countries, including the Philippines and Indonesia, to take care of the housework and childcare.

zh: 尽管新加坡生育率只有1.3 — — 为全世界最低之一 — — 但这一政策让新加坡得以吸引外国人才填补人口空白和维持经济。
en: Though Singapore’s fertility rate stands at just 1.3 – one of the lowest in the world – this policy enables the country to attract foreign talents to fill the population gap and sustain the economy.

zh: 在某种程度上，人口变化是难免的，其变革性经济影响亦然。
en: To some extent, demographic change is inevitable, as is its transformative economic impact.

zh: 但政府可以采取措施影响人口趋势，遏制消极效应。
en: But there are steps that governments can take to shape demographic trends and blunt their negative effects.

zh: 如果韩国营造出家庭能够快乐生活和工作的环境，那么家庭会变得更大。
en: If South Korea creates an environment in which families can live and work happily, those families will grow larger.

zh: 发展援助私人化
en: Privatizing Development Aid

zh: 伦敦—过去五十年来，官方发展援助（ODA）改变了很多。
en: LONDON – Much has changed about official development assistance (ODA) over the last 50 years.

zh: ODA起源于冷战，其时经合组织发展援助委员会每年拿出约600亿美元资金（苏联毫无疑问可以与之匹敌 ） ， 接受国被称为“后进国家 ” 、 “发展中国家 ” 、 “南方国家 ” ， 最近则被称为“新兴国家 ” 。
en: Since it originated during the Cold War, when members of the OECD’s Development Assistance Committee spent roughly $60 billion annually (an amount that the Soviet Union undoubtedly matched), recipient countries have been called “backward,” “developing,” “southern,” and, lately, “emerging.”

zh: 事实上，近几年来，如何定义受助国变得越来越值得商榷。
en: Indeed, what defines a recipient country has increasingly been called into question in recent years.

zh: 英国在讨论是否停止对印度的援助，后者是当今第三大资本流入国，也是英国最大制造业雇主塔塔集团（Tata Group）的母国。
en: The United Kingdom is debating whether to discontinue aid to India, the third-largest recipient of capital inflows and the home of the UK’s largest manufacturing employer, the Tata Group.

zh: 类似地，欧元区国家眼巴巴地望着中国帮助它们克服债务危机，而中国是老牌受助国，如今持有2.5万亿美元美国国债。
en: Likewise, eurozone countries have been looking to long-time aid recipient China, which holds $2.5 trillion of US government debt, to help them overcome their own debt crisis.

zh: 此外，发展本身也被重新定义，政策焦点转移到良好治理、透明度、可问责性和人权上。
en: Furthermore, development itself has been redefined, with the policy focus shifting to good governance, transparency, accountability, and human rights.

zh: 结果，旨在改善卫生、教育和性别平等的计划取代了大规模建设项目。
en: As a result, initiatives aimed at improving health, education, and gender equality have replaced large-scale construction projects.

zh: 如今，是时候重新审视ODA体系了。
en: Now it is time to re-examine the ODA system.

zh: 毕竟，援助国受困于债务和停滞，而受助国的增长速度比援助国快7—7倍。
en: After all, donor countries are mired in debt and stagnation, while some recipient economies are growing 5-7 times faster than they are.

zh: 1969年，加拿大前首相皮尔逊建议，到1975年，发达国家应该将GDP的0.5%用于ODA，并将这一比例逐渐增加到1 % 。
en: In 1969, Canada’s former prime minister, Lester Pearson, recommended that developed countries should spend 0.7% of their GDP on ODA by 1975, and that they should eventually increase the proportion to 1%.

zh: 尽管挪威、瑞典、丹麦荷兰和卢森堡已经实现0.7%的目标，但就全球平均水平而言，这一比例从1960年的0.5%下降到了今天的0.3 % 。
en: Although Norway, Sweden, Denmark, the Netherlands, and Luxembourg have achieved the 0.7% target, the global average has actually declined, from 0.5% of GDP in 1960 to 0.3% today.

zh: 英国承诺拿出国民生总收入（GNI）的0.7 % ， 但在援助谁的问题上争论不休。
en: The UK has pledged 0.7% of its gross national income, but is debating who will receive it.

zh: 美国每年援助规模为300亿美元，绝对数量为世界之最，但占GNI的比重还不到0.25 % 。
en: America’s annual contribution of $30 billion, the world’s highest in absolute terms, amounts to less than 0.25% of its GNI.

zh: 但是，尽管国际组织鼓励增加ODA支出，援助国国民却越来越抵制。
en: But, while international organizations encourage additional ODA spending, donor-country citizens are increasingly resistant.

zh: 批评者指出，这笔钱并没有达到真正需要它们的人手中；援助造成了依赖从而有害于受助国；国内也需要援助；援助的主要作用是鼓了顾问和来源国既得利益者的腰包。
en: Critics argue that the money does not reach those who truly need it; that it creates dependency, and thus harms recipient countries; that it is needed at home; and that it generates income primarily for consultants and source-country vested interests.

zh: 平心而论，一个被广泛接受的观点是救灾援助和冲突援助十分有效。
en: To be sure, it is widely agreed that aid for disaster relief and assistance to conflict-affected countries are effective.

zh: 此外，ODA总量中有近10%用于人道主义救济，这也应该是毫无争议的领域。
en: Moreover, almost 10% of total ODA is allotted for humanitarian relief, which should be similarly uncontroversial.

zh: 但ODA的总体影响仍然值得质疑。
en: But the overall impact of ODA remains dubious.

zh: 在去年3月的一份报告中，英国上议院经济事务委员会援引了专家在这一问题上的分歧 — — ODA对受助国年GDP增长的提振作用众说纷纭，有人说可达0.5 % ， 有人说根本毫无作用。
en: In a report released last March, the UK’s House of Lords Select Committee on Economic Affairs cited disagreement among experts on the issue, with estimates ranging from a 0.5% boost to annual GDP growth in recipient countries to no effect on growth at all.

zh: 有三个原因或能解释发展援助并不总能转变为GDP增长这一事实。
en: There are several possible explanations for the fact that development aid has not always translated into GDP growth.

zh: 受助国政府可能滥用援助致使援助无法抵达支出或投资者手中；援助金可能存在条件，必须花在来自援助国的商品和服务上。
en: Recipient governments might misuse the aid, preventing it from trickling down to those who would spend or invest it, or the money may be given on the condition that it is spent on goods or services from the donor country.

zh: 此外，即使发展援助确实刺激了GDP增长，也不一定会为最贫困人民带来更好的生活，特别是在短期。
en: And, even if development aid does spur GDP growth, this does not necessarily lead to better lives for the poorest citizens, especially in the short term.

zh: 消灭极端贫困毫无疑问是紧迫的道德驱动力，但ODA或许并非达到此目标的最佳手段。
en: While eliminating extreme poverty is undoubtedly an urgent moral imperative, ODA may not be the best way to achieve it.

zh: 事实上，有充分的理由应该让私人部门参与发展援助。
en: In fact, there is a strong case for involving the private sector in development assistance.

zh: 过去二十年来 — — 在此期间，全球化开放了世界金融体系 — — 私人资本流对发展中经济体增长的贡献大于ODA。
en: Over the last two decades – a period when globalization opened up the world financial system – private capital flows have contributed more to developing economies’ growth than has ODA.

zh: 事实上，2009年，1万多亿美元私人资本流向了发展中国家，比援助总量多九倍。
en: Indeed, in 2009, more than $1 trillion in private capital flowed to developing countries – nine times more than total aid.

zh: 此外，乐施会（Oxfam）和无国界医生（Medecins Sans Frontières）等私人出资组织配置资源的效率高于政府，真正做到了将援助送到最需要的人手里。
en: Moreover, privately funded organizations like Oxfam or Medecins Sans Frontières (Doctors Without Borders) tend to allocate resources more effectively than governments, delivering genuine gains where they are needed most.

zh: 根据这一模式，国家援助预算可以开放接受发展非政府组织的竞标，让后者负责尽可能有效的配置和资金发放 — — 以及要求提供如何花钱的详细核算。
en: Following this model, countries’ aid budgets could be opened up for bids from development NGOs, which would assume responsibility for allocating and delivering the funds as efficiently as possible – and would be required to provide a careful accounting of how they spent the money.

zh: 更大胆的计划是直接把现金送到贫困人口手中。
en: A bolder solution would be direct cash transfers to the poor.

zh: 全球援助总量大约在1300亿美元，这意味着13亿生活在极端贫困（每天花费少于1美元）的人口每人可以获得100美元现金。
en: With global aid totaling roughly $130 billon, each of the 1.3 billion people living in extreme poverty (less than $1 per day) worldwide would receive $100 in cash.

zh: 一些国家一开始实验这一计划，印度正准备向其3亿贫困人口提供现金转移支付。
en: Some countries have already experimented with such programs, and India is preparing to begin providing cash transfers to its 300 million poor citizens.

zh: 换句话说，全球现金转移支付机制可以非常高效，而且可行 — — 如果援助国把援助预算集合起来的话。
en: In other words, a global cash-transfer scheme could be very effective, and would be feasible if donor countries pooled their aid budgets.

zh: 最简单也最彻底的办法是停止所有官方援助支付。
en: The simplest – and most radical – solution would be to stop all official aid payments.

zh: 反之，这笔钱可以通过减税或收入转移支付返还给援助国人民，让他们决定如何帮助需要者。
en: Instead, the money could be returned to donor-country citizens through tax deductions or income transfers, and they could decide how to help those in need.

zh: 由于贫困和疾病的普遍性，很多人会有动力为全球减贫事业做出贡献。
en: Given the prevalence of poverty and disease, many of these citizens would be motivated to contribute to global poverty-reduction efforts.

zh: 让人民选择如何援助或有助于解决政客滥用ODA国家的腐败问题，也能防止浪费和不切实际的项目。
en: Allowing citizens to choose how to donate may help to tackle corruption in countries where politicians often misappropriate ODA, while discouraging wasteful or impractical projects.

zh: 此外，如果由自己决定资金去向，人们将更少抱怨自己的钱被浪费或滥用。
en: In addition, people would be far less likely to complain that their money is being wasted or misused if they chose where it went.

zh: ODA只能说是差强人意。
en: ODA has, at best, a patchy record.

zh: 在经历了50年的低效率后，是时候尝试新变化了。
en: After 50 years of inefficiency, it is time to try something new.

zh: 至少从短期看，现金转移支付是最佳选择。
en: In the near term, at least, cash transfers seem to be the best option.

zh: 只有让每一位受助者决定如何最佳地花钱，我们才能确保发展援助真正让全球最贫困人口改善了生活。
en: Only by allowing each recipient to decide how best to use the money can we ensure that development aid actually enables the world’s poorest citizens to improve their lives.

zh: 美国的坏边境税
en: America’s Bad Border Tax

zh: 纽约—美国也许即将开始实施边境调节税。
en: NEW YORK – The United States may be about to implement a border adjustment tax.

zh: 目前控制立法和行政机关的共和党将边境调节税视为公司税改革的重要要素。 边境调节税将以税收减免的形式有效地补贴美国出口商，惩罚进口商品的美国公司。
en: The Republican Party, now in control of the legislative and executive branches, views a BAT – which would effectively subsidize US exporters, by giving them tax breaks, while penalizing US companies that import goods – as an important element of corporate-tax reform.

zh: 据说它能改善美国的贸易平衡，同时刺激国内生产、投资和就业。
en: They claim that it would improve the US trade balance, while boosting domestic production, investment, and employment.

zh: 这是不对的。
en: They are wrong.

zh: 真相是共和党的计划有很大问题。
en: The truth is that the Republicans’ plan is highly problematic.

zh: 再加上其他改革方案，边境调节税将把美国公司税变成公司现金流税（带边境调节 ） ， 这将给美国公司的竞争力和盈利能力带来深远影响。
en: Along with other proposed reforms, the BAT would turn the US corporate income tax into a tax on corporate cash flow (with border adjustment), implying far-reaching consequences for US companies’ competitiveness and profitability.

zh: 一些行业和企业 — — 特别是与严重依靠进口的行业和企业，比如零售商 — — 将面临税负的急剧增加；在一些例子中，税负的增加将超过税前利润。
en: Some sectors or firms – especially those that rely heavily on imports, such as US retailers – would face sharp increases in their tax liabilities; in some cases, these increases would be even greater than their pre-tax profits.

zh: 与此同时，出口行业和企业，如制造业，税收负担将大量降低。
en: Meanwhile, sectors or firms that export, like those in manufacturing, would enjoy significant reductions in their tax burden.

zh: 这一分化既无必要，也不公平。
en: This divergence seems both unwarranted and unfair.

zh: 边境调节税还将带来其他分配影响。
en: The BAT would have other distributional implications, too.

zh: 研究表明，受其影响最大的将是收入最低的10 % 。
en: Studies indicate that it may hit consumers among the bottom 10% of income earners hardest.

zh: 但它却被包装成抵消也是共和党提出的削减公司税的影响的应对措施 — — 公司税的削减最终有利于收入分配的顶层。
en: Yet it has been promoted as a way to offset the corporate-tax cuts that Republicans are also pushing – cuts that would ultimately benefit those at the top of the income distribution.

zh: 更糟糕的是，边境调节税其实不能保护美国企业抵抗外国竞争。
en: Making matters worse, the BAT would not actually protect US firms from foreign competition.

zh: 经济学理论认为，理论上边境调节税可以让美元价值升高等于税收的幅度，从而完全抵消其对进口和出口的相对竞争力的影响。
en: Economic theory suggests that, in principle, a BAT could push up the value of the dollar by as much as the tax, thereby nullifying its effects on the relative competitiveness of imports and exports.

zh: 此外，美元升值的资产负债表效应将相当大。
en: Moreover, the balance-sheet effects of dollar appreciation would be large.

zh: 由于大部分美国投资者持有的外国资产为外币计价，这些资产的价值总量也将蒸发数万亿美元。
en: Because most foreign assets held by US investors are denominated in a foreign currency, the value of those assets could be reduced by several trillion dollars, in total.

zh: 与此同时，高负债的新兴经济体将面临急剧膨胀的美元债务，可能引发金融风险乃至危机。
en: Meanwhile, the highly indebted emerging economies would face ballooning dollar liabilities, which could cause financial distress and even crises.

zh: 即使美元升值幅度小于边境调节税，税收从进口到国内价格的传导也将导致通货膨胀率暂时但持久的上升。
en: Even if the US dollar appreciated less than the BAT, the pass-through from the tax on imports to domestic prices would imply a temporary but persistent rise in the inflation rate.

zh: 一些研究认为，在边境调节税的第一年，这项新税收将使美国通胀率升高1%甚至更多。
en: Some studies suggest that, in the BAT’s first year, the new tax could push up US inflation by 1%, or even more.

zh: 美联储可能因此提高政策利率，而这最终又将导致长期利率的升高，给美元汇率造成进一步升值压力。
en: The US Federal Reserve may respond to such an increase by hiking its policy rate, a move that would ultimately lead to a rise in long-term interest rates and place further upward pressure on the dollar’s exchange rate.

zh: 但边境调节税的另外一个问题是它将给全球供应链造成大面积破坏，而全球供应链是过去几十年来美国公司部门赖以生存的基础。
en: Yet another problem with the BAT is that it would create massive disruptions in the global supply chains that the US corporate sector has built over the last few decades.

zh: 边境调节税将破坏公司实现劳动力和资本配置效率最大化的能力 — — 这是离岸化的主要动机 — — 从而给美国和全球经济带来巨大的福利损失。
en: By undermining companies’ capacity to maximize the efficiency of labor and capital allocation – the driving motivation behind offshoring – the BAT would produce large welfare costs for the US and the global economy.

zh: 边境调节税的最后一个大问题是它违反了世贸组织规则。 世贸组织规则规定边境调节只能用在间接税上，比如增值税，而不能用在直接税上，如公司所得税。
en: The final major problem with the BAT is that it violates World Trade Organization rules, which allow border adjustment only on indirect taxation, such as value-added tax, not on direct taxes, like those levied on corporate income.

zh: 因此，世贸组织可能会裁定边境调节税为非法。
en: Given this, the WTO would probably rule the BAT illegal.

zh: 果真如此的话，如果美国一意孤行，将可能面临价值高达4,000亿美元的报复措施。
en: In that case, the US could face retaliatory measures worth up to $400 billion per year if it didn’t repeal the tax.

zh: 这将给美国和全球GDP增长造成严重打击。
en: That would deal a serious blow to US and global GDP growth.

zh: 那么美国实施边境调节税的可能性多大？
en: So how likely is the US to enact the BAT?

zh: 该方案已经获得共和党占多数的众议院的支持，但许多共和党参议员可能投票反对。
en: The proposal has the support of the Republican majority in the House of Representatives, but a number of Senate Republicans are likely to vote against it.

zh: 两院的民主党可能会投票反对整套公司税改革方案，包括边境调节税。
en: Democrats in both houses of Congress are likely to vote against the entire proposed corporate-tax reform, including the BAT.

zh: 行政机关也处于分歧状态，总统特朗普的较为保护主义的顾问支持边境调节税，较为国际主义的幕僚则反对。
en: The executive branch is also split on the issue, with President Donald Trump’s more protectionist advisers supporting it and his more internationalist counselors opposing it.

zh: 特朗普本人的态度模棱两可。
en: Trump himself has sent mixed signals.

zh: 关于边境调节税的分歧也出现在商业界，出口多于进口的企业支持边境调节税，反之则反是。
en: Disagreement over the BAT extends to business as well, with firms that export more than they import supporting it, and vice versa.

zh: 至于民众，中低收入家庭应该反对边境调节税，因为它将提高他们目前消费贷的非常便宜的进口商品的价格，尽管特朗普的蓝领票仓，特别是制造业工人，可能会支持边境调节税。
en: As for the general public, low- and middle-income households should oppose the BAT, which would drive up prices of the now-cheap imported goods that these groups currently consume, though Trump’s blue-collar constituents, particularly those who work in manufacturing, may support the measure.

zh: 说到底，支持边境调节税的理由较弱 — — 远弱于反对理由。
en: Ultimately, the case for the BAT is relatively weak – far weaker than the case against it.

zh: 尽管这有可能足以保证边境调节税无法获得通过，但美国政府中不乏强大的保护主义力量大力支持边境调节税和类似政策。
en: While this may be enough to ensure that it doesn’t pass, there are strong protectionist forces in the US government pushing hard for it and similar policies.

zh: 即使边境调节税被拒绝，特朗普政府挑起破坏性的全球贸易战的风险依然很高。
en: Even if the BAT is rejected, the risk of a damaging global trade war triggered by the Trump administration will continue to loom large.

zh: 欧洲需要的危机
en: The Crisis Europe Needs

zh: 伯克利—对欧洲，你很难抱以乐观。
en: BERKELEY – It’s hard to be optimistic about Europe.

zh: 去年夏天，一场德国和希腊之间的牢笼战（cage match）险些让欧盟分崩离析。
en: Last summer, a political cage match between Germany and Greece threatened to tear the European Union apart.

zh: 极端主义政党正在一国又一国赢得选民。
en: In country after country, extremist political parties are gaining ground.

zh: 俄罗斯总统普京入侵欧盟后院乌克兰则让欧洲共同外交和安全政策成了一个笑话。
en: And Russian President Vladimir Putin’s incursion into Ukraine, in the EU’s backyard, has turned the common European foreign and security policy into a punch line.

zh: 现在又爆发了难民危机。
en: Now comes the refugee crisis.

zh: 欧盟28个成员国正在就如何分配120,000难民而争吵不休，而光是在2015年前九个月，就有三倍多于这个数字的难民穿越地中海来到欧洲。
en: The EU’s 28 member states are quibbling over how to distribute 120,000 refugees, when more than three times that number crossed the Mediterranean in the first nine months of 2015 alone.

zh: 难民从陆路和海路进入欧洲。
en: Refugees are coming by land as well as sea.

zh: 光是德国，预计今年就将接受多达一百万寻求庇护者。
en: Germany alone expects as many as a million asylum-seekers this year.

zh: 认为欧洲政府仍能驱逐，或用外交辞令说，能“遣返”大部分这些到来者是荒谬的。
en: It is risible to think that European governments will be able to deport, or “repatriate” in diplomacy-speak, any substantial fraction of these arrivals.

zh: 他们就像是橡皮球，必然会弹回来。
en: Like a rubber ball, they will only come bouncing back.

zh: 对于如何处理这股涌入的人流也没有形成一致。
en: Nor is there agreement on how to handle this flood of humanity.

zh: 德国总理默克尔先是宣布，她的国家有着吸收难民的历史义务，随后不得不在政治批评面前低头。
en: German Chancellor Angela Merkel first declared that her country had a historical obligation to absorb refugees, before backing down in the face of political criticism.

zh: 匈牙利开放了边境，希望人流只是过境，但随后建起了铁丝网隔离障，因为情况表明受欢迎的目的地太少了。
en: Hungary opened its borders, hoping that the human tide would flow onward, but then erected a razor-wire fence when it turned out that there were too few welcoming destinations.

zh: 欧盟的东欧成员国一开始拒绝分担接受120,000难民的义务，但是，它们需要仰仗欧盟较富裕国家的财政转移支付，因此，在经历了与希腊类似的外交施压后，它们也被迫就范。
en: The EU’s Eastern European members initially resisted taking their share of the 120,000; but, dependent on fiscal transfers from the EU’s wealthier members, they fell into line after diplomatic arm-twisting similar to that administered to Greece.

zh: 除了关于欧洲领导人的能力和团结的质疑日益增加之外，这场危机还动摇了欧盟的标志性成就 — — 单一市场。 单一市场保证了商品、服务、资本和人的自由流动。
en: Besides raising doubts about European leaders’ competence and solidarity, this crisis jeopardizes the EU’s signal achievement, the single market, which ensures freedom of movement for goods, services, capital, and people.

zh: 申根协定规定人可以免签证流动，让人的迁徙自由变得有意义。
en: The Schengen Agreement providing for passport-free transit is what makes freedom of movement for people meaningful.

zh: 但是，由于参与国无法控制它们与非欧盟国家的边境线，德国和其他申根成员国临时恢复了边境控制。
en: But, given the inability of participating states to control their borders with non-EU countries, Germany and other Schengen members have temporarily reinstated controls.

zh: 事实上，这一动作可能并非临时，如今，要求取消申根协定的声音颇有影响力。
en: Indeed, this move could be more than temporary, with influential voices now calling for Schengen’s demise.

zh: 废除申根协定将是一次巨大的经济退步。
en: Dismantling Schengen would be a significant economic setback.

zh: 让卡车和火车在欧盟内部各国之间畅行无阻不但便利了贸易，也鼓励了地区供应链和生产网络的发展。
en: Allowing trucks and trains to cross the EU’s internal borders without interruption not only facilitates trade; it also encourages the development of regional supply chains and production networks.

zh: 汽车部件可以在一个成员国生产，在另一个成员国组装，然后将最终产品运往市场。
en: Motor vehicle parts can be produced in one member state and assembled in another, after which the final product can be delivered to market.

zh: 眼下，欧洲正在竭尽全力提振生产率和竞争力，收紧边境控制将是对这些努力的沉重打击。
en: At a time when Europe is struggling to boost productivity and competitiveness, reinstating border controls would come as a serious blow.

zh: 讽刺的是，欧盟正是为了解决这种类型的危机而建立的。
en: The irony is that this is precisely the type of crisis that the EU was created to address.

zh: 解决边境安全问题要求欧洲各国齐心协力。
en: Solving the border-security problem requires European countries to work together.

zh: 目前，希腊等个体国家没什么动力投资于边境控制，因为对它们来说，难民只是过境。
en: Individual countries like Greece have limited incentive to invest in controls insofar as refugees are only passing through.

zh: 与此同时，匈牙利等国家的单方面行动甚至连过境移民都不准备接受，其结果只是移民改变流动方向。
en: At the same time, unilateral action by countries, like Hungary, that are unprepared to countenance even transiting migrants, merely ends up diverting the flow.

zh: 欧盟有一个叫做边防局（Frontex）的机构，用以协调和强化国家边境控制政策。
en: The EU has an agency called Frontex to coordinate and strengthen national border-control policies.

zh: 但欧洲各国政府尚未允许它对国家机构发布指令。
en: But governments have not allowed it to issue directives to national agencies.

zh: 要想解决这场危机，这一点就必须改变。
en: If the crisis is to be solved, this will have to change.

zh: 安置问题也是如此。
en: The same goes for resettlement.

zh: 不能期望德国和瑞典接受所有到达的难民。
en: Germany and Sweden cannot be expected to be the only destinations for all refugee arrivals.

zh: 要想让代价可以承受，就必须分担负担。
en: Burden sharing is essential if the costs are to be tolerable.

zh: 理论上，协议的大纲不难确定。
en: In principle, the outlines of a deal are not difficult to formulate.

zh: 德国可以提供财力人力捍卫欧盟外部边境。
en: Germany can provide money and manpower to secure the EU’s external borders.

zh: 其邻国应该同意接受更多的难民，并提供真正的经济机会促使他们留下。
en: Its neighbors can then agree to accept more refugees and to offer them real economic opportunity as an incentive to stay.

zh: 建立机构强化边境安全和安置难民需要欧洲朝着深化政治一体化迈出新的步子，决定应该在欧盟而非国家层面做出。
en: Creating institutions to enhance border security and resettle refugees will require Europe to take another step toward deeper political integration, with decisions made at the EU, not the national, level.

zh: 也许有些人不愿意考虑这一点，但如果欧洲想要解决问题，就别无选择。
en: There may be a reluctance to contemplate this, but there is no choice if Europe is to have a hope of solving the problem.

zh: 在边境建立更多铁丝网是不够的。
en: More razor wire at the border is not an adequate answer.

zh: 欧洲还需要改变驱使饱受战争摧残和贫困折磨的国家的居民逃离祖国的环境。
en: Europe also needs to address the conditions driving residents of war-torn and poverty-stricken countries to flee.

zh: 目前，欧盟在通过援助、外交手段和部署地面部队解决非洲和中东冲突等方面几乎毫无建树。
en: So far, the EU has been singularly ineffectual in deploying aid, diplomacy, and boots on the ground to address conflicts in Africa and the Middle East.

zh: 特别是，欧盟最大的国家德国在贡献部队、资金甚至战略建议方面显得颇为犹豫，这反映了其黑暗的军事史。
en: In particular, Germany, the EU’s largest country, has hesitated to contribute forces, funds, and even strategic advice, reflecting its dark military history.

zh: 除了参与乌克兰危机谈判外，默克尔顺从了德国民众对陷入对外事务纠缠的根深蒂固的反对。
en: Merkel, her involvement in negotiations over Ukraine aside, has deferred to the German public’s historically rooted objections to deeper foreign entanglements.

zh: 如此沉默寡言已不合时宜。
en: Such reticence is no longer acceptable.

zh: 欧洲工程的一大立足点一直是让德国在更广泛的欧盟外交政策环境下构建外交和军事力量。
en: One rationale for the European project has always been to allow Germany to project diplomatic and military force in the context of a larger, EU-wide foreign policy.

zh: 这样，德国人和其他欧洲人都可以相信德国成为改变局面的积极力量。
en: That way, both Germans and other Europeans can trust Germany to be a positive force for change.

zh: 此时不动，更待何时？
en: If not now, one might ask, then when?

zh: 反革命鲍里斯·约翰逊
en: Boris Johnson the Counter-Revolutionary

zh: 伦敦—如果历史重复自己 — — 先是悲剧，然后是闹剧 — — 那么下一个出场的是鲍里斯·约翰逊（Boris Johnson ） 。
en: LONDON – If history repeats itself – first tragedy, then farce – what comes next is Boris Johnson, a shape-shifting politician who embodies the contradictions of our age.

zh: 约翰逊是一位将现时代矛盾表现得淋漓尽致的百变政客。 他是生于1%特权家族的护民官；他是一位鼓吹关闭边境的移民之子；他是想要颠覆政治秩序的保守党；他是一位嘲笑专家的博学之士；他是偶尔将黑人称为“黑小孩”的世界大同论者。
en: Johnson is a tribune of the people who grew up with the privileges of the 1%; a child of immigrants who campaigned for closed borders; a Conservative who wants to upend the political order; an erudite man who mocks expertise; and a cosmopolitan who casually calls black people “piccaninnies.”

zh: 约翰逊在葬送英国的欧洲未来方面无出其右者；但他的八面玲珑又可能成为它的救世主。
en: Johnson did more than anyone to bury Britain’s European future; but his ultra-flexibility may yet prove to be its salvation.

zh: 在被任命为外交大臣的首次公开露脸中，约翰逊比较了英国脱欧投票和法国大革命。
en: In his first public appearance after being appointed Foreign Secretary, Johnson compared the Brexit vote to the French Revolution.

zh: 他在法国大使馆国庆日庆典上欢呼雀跃地将公投称为“一次针对令人窒息的官僚主义旧体制的伟大的群众起义，这个体制的民主特征早已难以辨别。 ”引起一片嘘声。
en: Provoking boos at the French Embassy’s Bastille Day celebration, he hailed the referendum as “a great popular uprising against a stifling bureaucratic ancient regime (sic) whose democratic credentials had become very far from obvious.”

zh: 但英国脱欧投票 — — 及其重建昔日英国的许诺 — — 与其说是革命，不如说是反革命。
en: But the Brexit vote – with its promise to recreate the Britain of yesterday – is less revolution than counter-revolution.

zh: 鲍里斯及其脱欧派同道更像是颠覆法兰西共和国、重建君主制的拿破仑三世，而不是丹东或罗伯斯庇尔。
en: Boris and his band of Brexiteers have more in common with Louis Napoleon Bonaparte, who overturned the French republic to create a new monarchy, than with Danton or Robespierre.

zh: 如果说有人可以宣称代表了1789年的进步理想的话，也是欧盟。
en: If anyone or anything has a claim to embody the progressive ideals of 1789, it is the EU.

zh: 欧盟政治家和官员将模糊的自由、平等、博爱三位一体塑造为一个实在：涵盖了从床头到车间的各种权利和规则的80,000页法律。
en: Its politicians and officials have translated the vague trinity of liberty, equality, and fraternity into a concrete form: 80,000 pages of laws that cover rights and regulations from the bedroom to the factory floor.

zh: 而这些规则的实施帮助一波又一波的国家 — — 从希腊和西班牙到爱沙尼亚和波兰 — — 摆脱专制，走向民主。
en: And the application of these rules helped waves of countries – from Greece and Spain to Estonia and Poland – move from autocracy to democracy.

zh: 欧盟推动了一场各国如何共存的革命 — — 推进个体权利、国际法和主权集合。
en: The EU has driven a revolution in how countries live together – advancing individual rights, international law, and the pooling of sovereignty.

zh: 其变革力量来自未来成员资格承诺、输出欧洲价值观的“周边政策”及其为全球机构建设和效仿性地区融合所提供的便利。
en: Its transformative power springs from the promise of potential membership, a “neighborhood policy” that exports European values, and its facilitation of global institution-building and copycat regional integration.

zh: 如今，拜反革命结果所赐，欧盟俱乐部正在解体而不是成长。
en: Now, as a result of the counter-revolution, the EU club is shrinking, rather than growing.

zh: 欧盟没有在重塑世界形象，而是担心输出混乱而不是输入价值观的邻国。
en: Rather than remaking the world in its image, the EU fears neighbors that export chaos rather than import values.

zh: 互相依存导致而不是结束了欧洲内部冲突。
en: Interdependence causes, rather than ends, intra-European conflict.

zh: 欧洲概念也成为整个大陆的政治反对焦点。
en: And the European idea has become a focus of political opposition across the continent.

zh: 事实上，对于当今欧洲来说，最麻烦的事情不是英国脱离，而是剩余27国的脆弱性和离心离德，欧洲民主共识已经蒸发殆尽。
en: Indeed, the most troubling thing about Europe today is not the United Kingdom’s departure, but the fragility and disunity of the remaining 27 states, where the domestic consensus for Europe has all but evaporated.

zh: 英国“脱欧”阵营引导了广泛存在的重建昔日确定性而非树立新权利的渴望。
en: The UK’s “Leave” campaign channeled a widely felt desire to restore past certainties, not to establish new rights.

zh: 而新政治力量利用改变政治局面的公投作为人民和自私的精英之间的斗争，以此利用所有成员国都在面对的经济不安全、文化焦虑和政治疏离。
en: And all member states are subject to the economic insecurity, cultural anxiety, and political alienation that new political forces are exploiting by using referenda to recast politics as a fight between the people and self-serving elites.

zh: 英国公投后的经济和政治阵痛将让其他欧盟成员国在进行成员资格投票前三思而后行。
en: Britain’s post-referendum economic and political travails will make other EU member states think twice before holding their own popular votes on membership.

zh: 但不要搞错了：欧盟绝对已经进入了解体时代。
en: But make no mistake: the EU is well into an era of disintegration.

zh: 缓慢地滑向不可治理与解体一样糟糕。
en: A slow slide into ungovernability can be just as devastating as a breakup.

zh: 一些欧盟决定已经在受到国家公投的挑战，如匈牙利总理欧尔班计划就难民配额进行公投。
en: Some EU decisions are already being challenged by national referenda, such as Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán’s planned plebiscite on refugee quotas.

zh: 在法国，所谓的派遣劳务指令（Posted Workers Dircetive，允许雇主向借调人员支付不高于所在国最低工资的薪酬）也许得不到实施。
en: In France, the so-called Posted Workers Directive (which allows employers to pay seconded workers no more than the minimum rate in the host country) may not be implemented.

zh: 而欧盟委员会也在改变一些有利项目，比如与加拿大的自由贸易协议。
en: And the European Commission is backtracking on favored projects such as a free-trade deal with Canada.

zh: 新挑战无不将欧盟分裂为更小的团体，而不是将欧盟绑在一起。
en: Rather than banding together, each new challenge has divided the EU into ever-smaller groups.

zh: 欧元造成南北分裂；乌克兰和难民危机造成东西分裂。
en: The euro has divided north and south; Ukraine and the refugee crisis have divided east and west.

zh: 亲欧派需要战胜不满的根源，并反思欧洲理想的表达形式。
en: Pro-Europeans need to engage with the sources of discontent and rethink the forms used to express the European ideal.

zh: 欧盟是基于一个机械的概念 — — 互相依存能减少冲突。
en: The EU was based on a mechanical idea that interdependence would reduce conflict.

zh: 欧盟希望将欧洲的生产方式联系在一起 — — 首先是通过欧洲煤钢共同体，后来是通过共同市场和欧元 — — 以此让欧洲国家实现紧密团结，彼此之间的战争永远消弭。
en: By linking European means of production together – first through the European coal and steel community, and later through the common market and the euro – the EU hoped to bind Europe’s states together so closely that war between them would no longer be an option.

zh: 诚然，创造了大量财富之后，如今欧洲爆发战争基本上已经难以想象。
en: True, war in Europe is now mostly unthinkable, with much wealth created.

zh: 但不可否认的是，反对相互依存 — — 不管是通过欧盟、自由迁徙还是恐怖主义 — — 的力量仍然存在。
en: But the backlash against interdependence – whether through the euro, free movement, or terrorism – is undeniable.

zh: 要想拯救欧盟，欧洲领导人必须专注于让人们感到相互依存的安全性。
en: To save the EU, European leaders should focus on making people feel safe with interdependence.

zh: 这意味着将自由迁徙的经济收益中拿出一些重新分配给承担自由迁徙负担的国家；强化外部边境控制和反恐合作；确保增加欧元区一体化和移民的灵活性；以及回归欧盟机构的最高使命是捍卫欧洲民族国家而不是发展自身权力的概念。
en: That means redistributing some of the economic benefits of free movement to communities bearing the burden of it; strengthening control of external borders and cooperation against terrorism; ensuring greater flexibility for eurozone integration and migration; and returning to the idea that EU institutions’ highest calling is to defend Europe’s nation-states, not to develop their own power.

zh: 英国脱欧危机给了其余欧盟成员国一次反思欧洲工程的机会。
en: The Brexit crisis gives the remaining EU members a chance to reconceive the European project.

zh: 如果成功，英国最终还会想要重新加入。
en: If they succeed, the UK may even eventually want to rejoin.

zh: 当然，这绝非英国脱欧派及其其他地区的盟友想要的结果。
en: Of course, that is not what the Brexiteers or their allies elsewhere are seeking.

zh: 他们可以成功解散欧盟，但他们不可能实现重建昨日世界的承诺，更不用说建设更美好的未来了。
en: They may succeed in unraveling the EU, but they are unlikely to deliver on their promise of recreating the world of yesterday, much less a better future.

zh: 事实上，他们可能在不经意间摧毁人民最珍视的欧洲一体化的好处。
en: In fact, they could inadvertently destroy the benefits of European integration that people most value.

zh: 支持英国脱欧的选民也许并不同意马克思论拿破仑三世的反革命的话 ： “ 整个民族，想象着它已经通过一场革命而为自己注入了加速的运动力量，突然发现自己被送回了一个死去的时代。
en: Voters who supported Brexit may yet echo what Marx said of Louis Napoleon’s counter-revolution: “A whole people, that imagines it has imparted to itself accelerated powers of motion through a revolution, suddenly finds itself transferred back to a dead epoch.”

zh: ”他们发现他们所颠覆的并不是旧制度的苛政，而是“通过数百年的斗争从它手中获得的让步。 ”
en: They discover that what they overthrew was not the tyranny of the ancien régime, but “the concessions that were wrung from it by centuries of struggle.”

zh: 约翰逊的政治异装最后的面目也许正是如此。
en: That is where Johnson’s political cross-dressing may come into its own.

zh: 如果英国陷入严重衰退，无法兑现脱欧阵营的承诺，许多选民可能宁可留在单一市场乃至欧盟本身。
en: If the UK enters a deep recession and struggles to deliver on the Leave campaign’s promises, many voters may yet want to remain in the single market, or even the EU itself.

zh: 如此大转变对于大部分脱欧阵营来说是不可能的，对他们来说，主权之梦压倒了经济崩溃的威胁。
en: That sort of volte-face would be impossible for most of the Brexit camp, for whom the dream of sovereignty trumps the threat of economic collapse.

zh: 但约翰逊在文化上与欧洲很融洽，有时候似乎与他所领导的脱欧阵营才是矛盾体。
en: But Johnson is culturally at ease with Europe and at times seemed ambivalent about the Leave campaign that he led.

zh: 约翰逊推翻自己先前的说法的能力将启发逃脱大师（Houdini ） 。
en: Johnson’s ability to escape the shackles of his previous statements would inspire Houdini.

zh: 如果欧盟成功改革，而英国经济问题深化，那么一切坚固无比的东西 — — 特别是约翰逊的欧洲怀疑论 — — 都可能烟消云散。
en: If the EU manages to reform and the UK’s economic problems deepen, all that seems solid – particularly Johnson’s Euroskepticism – could melt into air.

zh: 信誉卓著的穷国？
en: The Creditworthy Poor?

zh: 华盛顿—过去五年来，一些低收入国家，如卢旺达和洪都拉斯，首次在伦敦和纽约向私人外国投资者发行了债券。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Over the last five years, several low-income countries, such as Rwanda and Honduras, have issued their first-ever bonds to private foreign investors in London and New York.

zh: 在此以前，这几乎是不可想象的，因此这些新借款人的债券首发应该被视为投资者信心坚挺的信号。
en: Until recently, that might have been unthinkable, so the new borrowers’ initial bond issue should be viewed as a sign of great investor confidence.

zh: 但这也拉响了熟悉的警报。
en: But it should also sound some familiar warning bells.

zh: 大约20笔“首发”筹集到大约120亿美元，平均利润只比五年或更长期限的美国国债高4.5个百分点。
en: Some 20 “debut issues” have raised around $12 billion at interest rates that, on average, are just 4.5 percentage points above what the United States government pays at maturities of five or more years.

zh: 这只是全球金融大局的一个小变化；但是，考虑到这些借款人中有许多十年前曾经历过困难和违约，并且需要债务豁免，因此这应该被视为令人瞩目的大转折。
en: This is small change in the grand scheme of global finance; but, given that many of these borrowers were in distress or default just a decade ago, and needed debt forgiveness, theirs is an especially impressive turnaround.

zh: 但低收入国家得以接触私人贷款人也带来了风险，这一风险从一开始 — — 在它们演变为重大威胁之前 — — 就应该得到高度重视。
en: But low-income countries’ access to private lenders comes with risks that should be highlighted at the outset, before they grow into imminent threats.

zh: 首先是延期风险。
en: For starters, there is rollover risk.

zh: 这些债券必须用外币偿付，通常是用美元“一次性”还本付息。
en: The bonds have to be repaid in a foreign currency, usually US dollars, in a single “bullet” payment.

zh: 这些还本付息额可能相当巨大，特别是与过去的债务或未来的出口收入相比。
en: These bullets can be big, especially when compared with past debt obligations or future export earnings.

zh: 追踪20世纪70年代以来发展中国家债务演化的世界银行数据表明，如果一国的偿付额等于或大于其出口额的十分之一，其陷入债务困境的概率就会增加九倍（达到五分之一 ） — —今天的新发行国中每三个就有一个在债券到期时面临这一情景。
en: World Bank data tracking the evolution of developing-country debt since the 1970s show that the probability of a country falling into debt distress increases nine-fold (to a one-in-five chance) if its repayments are equivalent to more than one-tenth of its exports – a situation that one in three of today’s new issuers could face when their bonds come due.

zh: 穷借款国是否能避免这一金融困局取决于几个因素。
en: Whether poor borrowers can avoid such a financial squeeze will depend on several factors.

zh: 一是它们是否能够在债券到期日临近时发行更多债券用于偿付。
en: One is whether they will be able to issue more bonds to pay off those coming due.

zh: 其二是它们能否审慎地将资金用于投资，从而能够利落地偿付。
en: Another is whether they invest the money prudently, thereby enabling prompt repayment.

zh: 三是收入波动较大的国家，特别是那些依赖自然资源的国家，是否能在收入较高时将钱存起来。
en: And it will also depend on whether countries with volatile incomes, especially those reliant on natural resources, put money aside when earnings are high.

zh: 第二个中期风险是资本流逆转。
en: A second, medium-term risk involves capital-flow reversals.

zh: 贷款人对低收入国家债券的胃口之所以增加，很大程度上是受2008—2009年全球金融危机依赖发达经济体流动性充裕和利率接近于零的推动。
en: Lenders’ appetite for low-income-country bonds has been fueled in large part by a combination of abundant liquidity and near-zero interest rates in developed economies since the 2008-2009 global financial crisis.

zh: 在国内只能获得可怜的收益率，这促使投资者着眼于风险较高的“前沿”市场追求更高回报。
en: With only paltry yields on offer at home, investors have looked to riskier, “frontier” markets for higher returns.

zh: 但是，发达经济体早晚要回归较���的货币政策，这将让发展中国家债券吸引力缩水。
en: Sooner or later, however, developed economies will revert to tighter monetary policy, which will make developing-country bonds less attractive.

zh: 那些宏观政策可靠的借款人可能仍能对全球金融市场保持吸引力；但不太审慎的政府将突然发现自己已被踢出了局。
en: Those borrowers with sound macroeconomic policies will probably retain some appeal for global financial markets; but less prudent governments might suddenly find themselves cut off.

zh: 不幸的是，新债券发行国的债务管理实践质量参差不齐。
en: Unfortunately, the quality of debt-management practices among the new bond issuers is uneven.

zh: 明智的债务战略、专业而独立的债务部门以及明确的公共借贷法律框架比以往任何时候都更加重要。
en: Sensible debt strategies, a professional and independent debt office, and a clear legal framework for public borrowing have become more important than ever.

zh: 平心而论，过去十年中，这方面有了长足的进步，其中富裕国家的资金支持功不可没。
en: To be sure, there has been significant progress on this front over the past decade, much of it funded by rich-country assistance.

zh: 但在这一新借贷潮变得太大而难以管理或者蔓延至饱受行政能力不足困扰的州和地方政府之前，可以也应该做更多事情。
en: But more can and should be done before this new borrowing wave becomes too large to manage, or spreads to state and municipal governments that suffer from weaker administrative capacity.

zh: 值得注意的是，一国债务管理实践的质量与其债务困境风险之间存在强烈的负相关关系，90%的低风险国家都表现出良好的实践水平。
en: It is worth noting the strong negative correlation between the quality of a country’s debt-management practices and its risk of debt distress, with 90% of low-risk countries demonstrating good practices.

zh: 第三个风险是未来债务解决方案（debt workouts）将更难形成一致。
en: A third risk is that future debt workouts will become harder to agree.

zh: 传统上，低收入国家的债权人是富裕国家政府和多边机构，如果索债意味着借款国必须削减教育和卫生等关键公共服务，就会饱受政治压力。
en: Traditionally, low-income countries’ creditors were rich-world governments and multilateral organizations that found it politically unfeasible to call in debts if this meant that borrowers had to cut vital public services such as education or health.

zh: 在已经进行了15年 — — 并且还没有完成 — — 的过程中，35个高负债穷国的债务获得了豁免，其代价超过1,000亿美元。
en: In a process that has already taken 15 years – and remains unfinished – the debts of 35 highly indebted poor countries (HIPCs) have been forgiven, at a cost of more than $100 billion.

zh: 但是，现如今许多昔日的高负债穷国正在全球市场上向私人投资者出售债券，而最近几个月以来，美国法院裁定债券持有人可以拒绝债务解决方案并起诉要求足额偿付，其风险也因此大大增加了。
en: Now, however, many former HIPCs are selling bonds in the global market to private investors, which has become significantly riskier in recent months, in the wake of court rulings in the United States that permit bondholders to reject debt workouts and sue for full payment.

zh: 人们必须寄希望于筹得资金能够得到很好地利用，偿付不会要求做出重大牺牲，因为目前没有大家都同意的机制用于重组（更不用说取消）新债务。
en: One must hope that the funds raised will be put to good use, and that repayments will not require major sacrifices, as there is currently no agreed mechanism to restructure, let alone cancel, the new debts.

zh: 你或许会问，为何偏偏是承担风险的私人全球投资者要担心延期、流向逆转、债务管理和债务解决方案风险。
en: One might ask why anyone but the private global investors taking the risk should care about roll-overs, reversals, debt management, and workouts.

zh: 原因在于公共债务困境最伤害的是一国最贫穷的公民，他们没有关于债务发行的知识，也没有选择。
en: The reason is that public-debt distress most harms a country’s poorest citizens, who have little knowledge, and no choice, about issuing bonds.

zh: 当一国违约时，经济伤害将让穷人数量增加，并使他们的生活条件恶化。
en: When a country defaults, the economic damage swells the number of poor people and worsens their living conditions.

zh: 2001年阿根廷违约时，五分之一的公民落入了贫困线以下。
en: When Argentina defaulted in 2001, one in five citizens fell under the poverty line.

zh: 事实上，可靠的债务管理就是可靠的社会政策 — — 在债务产生之前，借款国和贷款国都应该汲取一个教训：如果管理不当，情况会变得比一开始想象的更复杂，造成比所有人所能想到的更大的麻烦。
en: Sound debt management is, in effect, sound social policy – a lesson that borrowers and lenders alike should heed as they enter into debts that, if not properly managed, can turn out to be more complicated than first assumed and more troublesome than anyone expected.

zh: 博茨瓦纳的死刑悖论
en: The Paradox of Botswana’s Death Penalty

zh: 伦敦 — — 在撒哈拉以南非洲，一个从来不乏发展挑战的地区，博茨瓦纳因其强劲的经济、稳定的民主和对法治的承诺脱颖而出。
en: LONDON – In Sub-Saharan Africa, a region with no shortage of development challenges, Botswana stands out for its strong economy, stable democracy, and commitment to the rule of law.

zh: 但有一项指标 — — 即该国对死刑的支持 — — 显示出博茨瓦纳的思想狭隘到惊人的地步。
en: But by one measure – its support for capital punishment – Botswana is frighteningly narrow-minded.

zh: 如果我所出生的国家想保住其作为非洲最自由国家的声誉，必须直面它与绞刑架的密切关系。
en: If the country of my birth is to retain its reputation as one of Africa’s most liberal states, it must confront its affinity for the gallows.

zh: 根据国际特赦组织的说法，绝大多数非洲国家都在放弃死刑。
en: According to Amnesty International, most of Africa is abandoning the death penalty.

zh: 今天，允许死刑判决的非洲国家仅有十个，而真正执行死刑的非洲国家更是寥寥无几。
en: Today, just ten African countries allow for capital punishment, and only a handful ever use it.

zh: 富裕的内陆钻石出口国博茨瓦纳就是最主要的特例之一。
en: Botswana – an affluent, landlocked, diamond-exporting state – is among the leading exceptions.

zh: 在2017年的杀戮平息后，博茨瓦纳已经恢复对被定罪的杀人犯执行死刑；28岁的约瑟夫·特拉亚罗纳于今年2月被处决，而37岁的乌亚普·伯罗克则于今年5月被执行死刑。
en: After a lull in killings in 2017, Botswana has resumed executing convicted murderers; Joseph Tselayarona, 28, was executed in February, while Uyapo Poloko, 37, was put to death in May.

zh: 英国及罗马-荷兰普通法是博茨瓦纳法律体系 — — 以及死刑基础的起源。
en: Botswana’s legal system – and the basis for capital punishment – is rooted in English and Roman-Dutch common law.

zh: 根据该国的刑法法典，对谋杀的首选刑罚是绞刑。
en: According to the country’s penal code, the preferred punishment for murder is death by hanging.

zh: 而虽然宪法保护公民的“生命权 ” ， 但按照“法庭判决执行死刑”而结束生命则是例外。
en: And, while the constitution protects a citizen’s “right to life,” it makes an exception when the termination of a life is “in execution of the sentence of a court.”

zh: 但博茨瓦纳与死刑的关系早于现行的法律法规。
en: But the country’s relationship to the death penalty predates its current legal statutes.

zh: 早在前殖民时代，被称为kgosi的部落酋长就对谋杀、巫术、乱伦和阴谋等罪行执行死刑。
en: In the pre-colonial era, tribal chiefs – known as kgosi – imposed the penalty for crimes such as murder, sorcery, incest, and conspiracy.

zh: 时至今日，人们还常常利用历史来为现状辨白。
en: To this day, history is often invoked to defend the status quo.

zh: 在2012年的一份判决中，博茨瓦纳上诉法院写道死刑“自无法追溯的远古时代起就一直存在 ” ， 而“取消死刑将违背公认的行为规范 ” 。
en: In a 2012 judgment, the Botswana Court of Appeals wrote that capital punishment has been imposed “since time immemorial,” and “its abolition would be a departure from the accepted norm.”

zh: 在特拉亚罗纳遭到处决后，政府甚至在推特上发表了一张时任总统伊恩·卡马的照片，并配以“死刑符合国家利益”的标题说明。
