en: After Tselayarona was executed, the government even tweeted a photo of then-President Ian Khama under a caption that read, “Death penalty serves nation well.”

zh: 可以肯定，博茨瓦纳的死刑执行数量较之世界死刑大国相形见绌。
en: To be sure, the number of executions in Botswana pales in comparison to the world’s leaders.

zh: 国际特赦组织去年记录在案的993起处决中有84%由伊朗、沙特阿拉伯、伊拉克和巴基斯坦等四个国家执行。
en: Of the 993 executions recorded by Amnesty International last year, 84% were carried out by just four countries – Iran, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, and Pakistan.

zh: 上述执行总数还不包括中国，因为那里的死刑数据被列为国家机密，中国据信是全世界最大的死刑执行国。
en: The total does not include China, believed to be the world’s largest executioner, because death-penalty data there are classified as a state secret.

zh: 相比之下，自1966年独立以来，博茨瓦纳已经对大约50人完成了处决。
en: By contrast, Botswana has executed roughly 50 people since independence in 1966.

zh: 但死刑的存在仍然是国家的污点，直到将死刑彻底废除。
en: And yet the very existence of capital punishment will remain a stain on the country until it is abolished.

zh: 据国际特赦组织统计，已有142个国家废除了死刑。
en: According to Amnesty International, 142 countries have abolished the death penalty.

zh: 在最近一次死刑调查中，该组织指出撒哈拉以南非洲是一座“希望的灯塔 ” ， 可以引领世界各国废除死刑。
en: In its most recent death-penalty survey, the group pointed to Sub-Saharan Africa as a “beacon of hope” in the global effort to eradicate the practice.

zh: 去年，肯尼亚积极采取步骤，终止了谋杀死刑的强制执行。
en: Last year, Kenya took a positive step by ending mandatory imposition of the death penalty for murder.

zh: 几内亚则成为该地区彻底废除死刑的第20个国家。
en: And Guinea became the 20th country in the region to abolish capital punishment for all crimes.

zh: 博茨瓦纳何时才能够仿效执行？
en: When will Botswana follow suit?

zh: 博茨瓦纳此前曾一直充当人权问题的先锋。
en: Botswana has been in the vanguard on human-rights issues before.

zh: 例如，2016年10月南非威胁退出国际刑事法庭后，博茨瓦纳的领导人为国际刑事法庭辩护并重申其对国际法的支持。
en: For example, after South Africa’s threat to withdraw from the International Criminal Court in October 2016, Botswana’s leaders defended the ICC and reaffirmed their commitment to international law.

zh: 而后在2018年2月，卡马最先打破非洲领导人的沉默，呼吁民主刚果共和国专制总统约瑟夫·卡比拉“交权。
en: Then, in February 2018, Khama broke the silence among African leaders and called for Joseph Kabila, the autocratic president of the Democratic Republic of Congo, to “relinquish power.”

zh: ”同月，博茨瓦纳政府批评联合国安理会未能处理好叙利亚危机。
en: The same month, the Botswana government criticized the UN Security Council for its handling of the crisis in Syria.

zh: 对死刑采取进步立场看似博茨瓦纳自由议程演进的自然步骤。
en: Taking a progressive stance on the death penalty would seem a natural step in the evolution of Botswana’s liberal agenda.

zh: 但政府仅触碰深层次矛盾的国际法表明博茨瓦纳并没有受到改变路线的巨大压力。
en: But the government has only dug in deeper, and contradictory international laws mean that Botswana is under no great pressure to change course.

zh: 尽管非洲人权和人民权利宪章及世界人权宣言均含有事实上的死刑禁令，但公民和政治权利国际公约（ICCPR）认可国家有权保留死刑。
en: While both the African Charter on Human and Peoples’ Rights and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights contain de facto prohibitions on capital punishment, the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights (ICCPR) recognizes a state’s authority to retain the practice.

zh: 1989年通过的一项公民和政治权利国际公约可选辅助修正案曾试图弥补这一漏洞，但博茨瓦纳没有签署这项协议。
en: An “optional” auxiliary amendment to the ICCPR, adopted in 1989, sought to close this loophole, but Botswana did not sign it.

zh: 公众舆论同样赞成维持现状。
en: Public opinion also favors preserving the status quo.

zh: 全国性报纸《报道者》所进行的一项在线调查显示，选民对死刑的支持率依然很高，这也解释了为什么死刑问题从未在国会引起关注。
en: According to an online survey conducted by the national newspaper Mmegi, support for capital punishment remains high among voters, which explains why the issue has never gained traction in Parliament.

zh: 但当局有关死刑降低暴力犯罪率的观点根本就没有证据支撑。
en: And yet there is simply no evidence to support the authorities’ argument that the death penalty lowers rates of violent crime.

zh: 只有有远见的领袖才能让公众接受这一观点，更不要说解决迫使法院对上述问题引起重视并进行辩论的进一步的法律难题。
en: Convincing the public of this will require visionary leadership, not to mention more legal challenges that force the courts to take up and debate the issue.

zh: 博茨瓦纳未来的死刑废除主义者无需到遥远的地方寻找激励。
en: Botswana’s would-be abolitionists need not look far for inspiration.

zh: 当南非宪法法院于1995年结束死刑时，决策的反对者认为法院并未充分听取公众意见；甚至有人要求举行全民公决。
en: When South Africa’s Constitutional Court ended capital punishment in 1995, opponents of the decision argued that the court was not in tune with public opinion; some even called for a referendum.

zh: 但1997年生效的后种族隔离宪法的制定者们坚守阵地并废除了死刑。
en: But the framers of South Africa’s post-apartheid constitution, which entered into force in 1997, held their ground and the practice was abolished.

zh: 南非法院在意见中写道 ： “ 包括最可恶的人在内的所有人都拥有生命权。
en: As the South African court wrote in its opinion: “Everyone, including the most abominable of human beings, has the right to life.”

zh: ”博茨瓦纳领导人必须说服选民 — — 也说服自己 — — 接受这种情绪的普遍性。
en: The goal for leaders in Botswana must be to convince their constituents – and perhaps also themselves – to embrace the universality of that sentiment.

zh: 美元的底线
en: Bottom Dollar

zh: 美元价值不会急剧下跌，市场力量也无法缩小美国经常账户赤字，该赤字今年很可能达到10,000亿美元。 随着时间的推移，出现了两种截然对立的反应。
en: As more time passes with neither the value of the dollar declining sharply nor market forces beginning to shrink America’s current-account deficit – which may well reach $1 trillion this year – two diametrically opposed reactions are emerging.

zh: 大多数国际金融经济学家越来越担心可能出现重大国际金融危机。
en: Most international finance economists are becoming increasingly frightened that a major international financial crisis could erupt.

zh: 确实，他们害怕该潜在危机的规模会越变越大。
en: Indeed, they fear that the scale of that potential crisis is becoming larger and larger.

zh: 其他人（特别是金融资产管理者）则越来越认为经济学家知之甚少，而且他们所知晓的那点东西对自己这样的商人毫无用处。
en: Others – especially managers of financial assets – are becoming increasingly convinced that economists don’t know very much, and that what they do know is of no use to traders like themselves.

zh: 他们认为，没有理由相信流动资产价值和贸易流是不可持续的。
en: They see little reason to believe that current asset values and trade flows are not sustainable.

zh: 毕竟，他们（或其中一些人）认为，美国实际GDP每年增长4,000亿美元，其中约2,700亿美元用于劳动力，1,300亿美元用作资本。
en: After all, they (or some of them) argue, the real GDP of the United States is growing by $400 billion per year, with about $270 billion going to labor and $130 billion to capital.

zh: 甚至在美元贬值之后，1,300亿美元的额外年收入资本化为15,000亿美元的资产，这样，经常账户赤字即便达到10,000亿美元，数额也不算特别大。
en: Even after depreciation, that $130 billion of extra annual income is capitalized at about $1.5 trillion of wealth, so the current-account deficit, even at $1 trillion, is not overwhelmingly large.

zh: 我们美国人可以卖掉三分之二的资产增量用于资助进口，今年依然能比去年富余5,000亿美元。
en: We Americans can sell off two-thirds of the increment to our wealth to finance imports and still be $500 billion better off this year than we were last year.

zh: 另外，每年从美国人向其他国家借款10,000亿美元所收取的年利息为大约5000亿美元—仅占年度经济增长的八分之一，而资本价值的增长就完全能平衡贸易赤字。
en: Moreover, the annual interest charged on the extra $1 trillion per year that Americans borrow from the rest of the world is about $50 billion – just one-eighth of annual economic growth, while the trade deficit is financed out of the growth of the value of capital.

zh: 那么还有什么不可持续的呢？
en: So what’s unsustainable?

zh: 为什么美国经常账户赤字不能无限期地保持在2006年的数额呢？
en: Why can’t the US current-account deficit remain at its 2006 value indefinitely?

zh: 反驳错误观点的论据取决于经常账户赤字和贸易赤字之间的差异。
en: The counterargument hinges on the difference between the current-account deficit and the trade deficit.

zh: 经常账户赤字相当于贸易赤字加上维持国际资产净值地位的费用：即所欠的在美国投入资本的外国人的净租金、利息和股息。
en: The current-account deficit is equal to the trade deficit plus the cost of servicing the net international asset position: the net rent, interest, and dividends owed to foreigners who have invested their capital in the US.

zh: 随着时间的推移，赤字累加。
en: As time passes, deficits accumulate.

zh: 由于赤字累加，维持国际资产净值地位的费用相应增加。
en: As deficits accumulate, the cost of servicing the net international asset position grows.

zh: 因此，为了保持经常账户赤字稳定，必需缩减贸易赤字。
en: Thus, in order to keep the current-account deficit stable, the trade deficit must shrink.

zh: 大幅度缩减贸易赤字的惟一方法是进口净值下降，这就要求要么相对急剧地降低美元价值从而提高进口价格，要么美国出现经济萧条。
en: And the only way for the trade deficit to shrink substantially is for net imports to fall, which requires either a relatively sharp decline in the value of the dollar, thereby raising import prices, or a depression in the US.

zh: 两种结果都会使美国人感觉自己没有足够的经济实力从而削弱对外国货物的需求。
en: Both outcomes would weaken demand for foreign goods by making Americans feel that they are too poor to buy them.

zh: 因此，美元计价的资产持有人应该预计到两种可能的情景。
en: As a result, holders of dollar-denominated assets should be looking forward to two alternative scenarios.

zh: 一种情景是，美元价值降低；另一种是，美国出现萧条。
en: In one, the value of the dollar will be low; in the other, the US will be in a depression.

zh: 无论出现哪种情况，现在再持有大量美元计价的资产都没多大意义。
en: In neither scenario does it make sense to hold huge amounts of dollar-denominated assets today.

zh: 因此，外国投机者在任何时候都应当将其美元计价的资产向市场倾销，而这样一来就会出现他们所害怕的美元贬值。
en: Therefore, foreign speculators should, any day now, dump their dollar-denominated assets onto the market, and so bring about the dollar decline that they so fear.

zh: 但是，外币投机者和国际投资者并不期待出现任何一种情况。
en: But foreign-currency speculators and international investors are not looking forward to either of these scenarios.

zh: 他们继续在美元计价的资产中占据大量份额，如果美国面临美元贬值或大萧条，他们将无可奈何。
en: They continue to hold very large positions in dollar-denominated assets, which they would not do if they thought the US faced a choice between a cheap dollar and a deep depression.

zh: 那么，根据市场的预计会出现什么状况呢？
en: So, what alternative does the market see?

zh: 为什么市场与国际金融经济学家的预测大不相同呢？
en: And why is it so different from the possible scenarios that international financial economists see?

zh: 答案似乎在于，纽约、伦敦、东京、法兰克福和香港金融中心的人们似乎认为赌注未来资金从美元的抽逃不是他们的事情。
en: The answer appears to be that there is nobody in the financial centers of New York, London, Tokyo, Frankfurt, and Hong Kong who thinks it is their business to bet on a future flight from the dollar.

zh: 特别是在发生危机时—美国进口量急剧下降显示，危机对于亚洲和欧洲出口商较之美国要严重得多—美元是他们趋之若骛、而不是避之不及的货币。
en: Especially in times of crisis – and a sharp fall in US imports would imply a much more severe crisis for Asian and European exporters than it would for the US – the dollar is a currency that you run to, not from.

zh: 乔治·索罗斯可以赌英镑危机，泰国进出口公司可以通过加快美元收入，延迟美元支出来赌泰铢危机。
en: George Soros can bet on a run on the British pound. Thai import-export firms can bet on a run on the baht by accelerating their dollar receipts and delaying their dollar payouts.

zh: 每个人都可以赌阿根廷比索危机—这是国际金融投机者这一个半世纪以来最喜欢做的事情了。
en: Everyone can bet on a run on the Argentine peso – a favorite sport of international financial speculators for a century and a half.

zh: 但不是美元，至少现在还不到时候。
en: But not the dollar. Not yet.

zh: 换句话说，市场把赌注押在美元在接下来五年内会逐渐贬值，美国经常账户赤字将缩减，但不会发生金融危机。
en: In other words, the market is betting that the dollar will fall gradually in the next five years, and that the US current-account deficit will narrow without a financial crisis.

zh: 那就是二十世纪八十年代末和七十年代末所发生的事情。
en: That is what happened in the late 1980’s, and in the late 1970’s, too.

zh: 毕竟，据说，上帝保护儿童、傻瓜、狗及美利坚合众国。
en: After all, God, it is said, protects children, fools, dogs, and the United States of America.

zh: 但软着陆的可能性随时间的推移而正在加大。
en: But the odds on a soft landing are lengthening with each passing day.

zh: 中国反腐改革的全球借鉴
en: The Global Stake in China’s Anti-Corruption Reform

zh: 斯坦福—最近，对薄熙来的庭审凸显出当代中国面临的最大挑战：某些党和政府官员的腐败和权力滥用。
en: STANFORD – The recent trial of Bo Xilai highlighted the biggest challenge facing contemporary China: the corruption and abuse of power by some government and party officials.

zh: 倒台前，薄熙来是政治局委员、重庆（有3000万人口的超级大都市）市委书记，也是中共中央政治局七常委的潜在人选之一。
en: Until his fall, Bo, a former Politburo member and party leader of Chongqing, a megacity of 30 million people, was a potential candidate for China’s ruling seven-member Politburo Standing Committee.

zh: 薄熙来的庭审发生于中国的关键时刻。
en: Bo’s trial occurred at what is a critical moment for China.

zh: 在中国，每年有数百万农村人口涌向城市寻找工作；但中国的出口导向型增长 — — 此前掩盖了腐败和国家过度干预的宏观经济成本 — — 正在减速。
en: Millions of rural Chinese annually flood into the country’s cities in search of employment; but China’s export-led growth, which previously masked the macroeconomic costs of corruption and excessive state intervention, is slowing.

zh: 随着来自其他低成本国家的竞争日益激烈，中国进入了增长较低时期，这一伤害也将变得日益明显和具有破坏性。
en: As China enters an era of more subdued growth amid increased competition from other low-cost countries, this damage will become increasingly apparent – and increasingly destructive.

zh: 经济成功的中国可以起到稳定作用，为地缘政治贡献建设性力量；而遇到严重经济问题的中国则会适得其反，且作为首个成为全球强国的发展中经济体，它遇到严重经济问题将引致系统性风险。
en: An economically successful China is more likely to be stable and geopolitically constructive; a China beset by serious economic problems would be far less so, and, as the first-ever developing economy to become a global power, could even become a source of systemic risk.

zh: 中国的制造装配线是全球众多产品供应链的一环。
en: Chinese manufacturing assembly is integral to global supply chains for many products.

zh: 此外，中国是美国国债最大的持有者（除美联储之外 ） ， 也持有巨量欧元，极有可能马上成为美国最大贸易伙伴，同时也是许多欧洲和亚洲经济体的贸易伙伴。
en: Moreover, China is the largest holder of US Treasury securities (aside from the Federal Reserve), has significant euro holdings, is likely soon to become America’s largest trade partner, and looms large in trade with many European and Asian economies.

zh: 研究表明，强力推行产权和稳定、可预计、非没收性的税收和监管制度是长期经济繁荣的必要条件。
en: Research reveals that strong enforcement of property rights and stable, predictable, and non-confiscatory tax and regulatory regimes are essential to long-run economic prosperity.

zh: 中国改革的关键，也是中国人民最希望看到的，是约翰·亚当斯（John Adams）的“法治而不是人治的政府 ” — —即合理法律约束下的公平治理，而不是一小撮人的禁脔。
en: The key to China’s reform, and what the Chinese people want most, is John Adams’s “government of laws, not men” – even-handed administration of reasonable laws, not special favors for the connected few.

zh: 事实上，财政部长楼继伟的话也响应了亚当斯（和亚当·斯密 ） ： “ … …资源应该通过价格和市场而不是政府官员配置。 ”
en: Indeed, Finance Minister Lou Jiwei echoed Adams (and Adam Smith) when he proclaimed, “…resources should be allocated by prices and markets, not government officials.”

zh: 中国国家主席习近平说，打击腐败是当务之急，一定要“老虎”和“苍蝇”一起打，否则在今年早些时候让他成为新一代领导人的平稳交接班可能无法再现。
en: Chinese President Xi Jinping has said that a crackdown on corruption is a top priority, and that unless it reaches both “tigers” (higher-ups) and “flies” (lower-level officials), there may well not be another orderly leadership transition of the type that brought him to power earlier this year.

zh: 事实上，如果中国想像日本、韩国、新加坡、香港、台湾等经济体那样摆脱阻挠了无数发展中国家进入发达经济体行列的“中产阶级陷阱 ” ， 打击腐败具有根本重要性。
en: Indeed, reducing corruption is essential if China is to join the small list of developing economies – Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Taiwan – that have escaped the “middle-income trap” that ensnares most developing countries and prevents them from attaining advanced-economy status.

zh: 这，而不是许多官员行为的放任恣睢，才是习近平打击腐败运动的真正要害之处。
en: More than the unseemliness and capriciousness of many officials’ behavior, this is what is really at stake in Xi’s anti-corruption campaign.

zh: 中国未来的繁荣需要限制政府官员的行政自由裁量权，减少国有企业的权力和补贴，通过发展独立司法强化法治精神。
en: China’s future prosperity requires restricting government officials’ administrative discretion, reducing state-owned enterprises’ power and subsidies, and strengthening the rule of law by developing an independent judiciary.

zh: 但这些改革都意味着文化和激励的变革。
en: But these reforms imply a change in culture and incentives.

zh: 一些官员利用可观的自由裁量权发放执照和许可、签订合同，从中中饱私囊。
en: Some officials use their considerable discretion in granting licenses, permits, and contracts to solicit favors and side payments.

zh: 薄熙来之妻所积累的财富（利用代理人，特别是亲属是腐败官员的惯用伎俩，全世界都是如此）凸显出关系深厚者所能获得的机会。
en: The fortune accumulated by Bo’s wife (reliance on proxies, especially relatives, is a common tactic of corrupt officials everywhere) highlights the opportunities for the well connected to get ahead.

zh: 许多中国人对此已习以为常，并据此行动。
en: Many Chinese, regarding this as just the way things are, behave accordingly.

zh: 平心而论，寻租和唯亲腐败在每个国家都或多或少地存在，但发展中国家比发达国家更普遍，资源富裕国和/或中央计划经济体比资本主义民主国家更普遍。
en: To be sure, rent-seeking and favor-dispensing corruption exist to some degree everywhere; but they are more widespread in developing than developed countries and in resource-rich and/or centrally planned economies than in capitalist democracies.

zh: 个人和企业用于获得政府垂青的时间和其他资源若能用于生产商品和服务将有大得多的价值。
en: The time and other resources that individuals and firms devote to seeking government favors would be far more valuable if redirected to producing goods and services.

zh: 中国历史上不乏成功的反��思想先例，比如明朝和现代香港。
en: Some promising anti-corruption ideas have successful antecedents in Chinese history, from the Ming Dynasty to modern Hong Kong.

zh: 在明朝，地方官必须来自其他省份，且调动频繁。
en: Under the Ming Dynasty, the emperor’s officials came from other provinces and were frequently rotated.

zh: 为了保护中国央行不受地方政治压力，1990年代改革主义前总理朱镕基在我和其他人的建议下重组了中国人民银行的地方机构，采取了类似于美联储的地区银行制度。
en: To protect China’s central bank from local political pressure, reformist Premier Zhu Rongji, on my and others’ advice in the 1990’s, reorganized the People’s Bank of China along regional lines, similar to the Federal Reserve’s district banks.

zh: 1970年代末的香港腐败横行，如果你家着火了，必须贿赂消防队才能让他们泵水救火！ 这带来了独立的反腐机构廉政公署，专门从事对公私腐败的调查和起诉。
en: In Hong Kong, corruption was so pervasive as late as the 1970’s – if your house was on fire, the fire department demanded payment before pumping water! – that an independent anti-corruption commission was appointed specifically to investigate and prosecute both public and private corruption.

zh: 香港通过大赦、提薪和要求官员披露财务状况有效地抑制了腐败、改善了政府。
en: Hong Kong greatly reduced corruption and improved administration with an amnesty, pay increases, and financial-disclosure requirements for officials.

zh: 中国的现任领导人应该仔细研究这些先例。
en: China’s current leaders should revisit these precedents.

zh: 真正独立的司法需要时间才能建立，但部分法官可以由中央政府而不是地方官员任命和支薪，并直接向中央政府报告。
en: A truly independent judiciary will take time to establish, but some judges can be appointed and paid by – and report to – the central government rather than local officials.

zh: 此外，与明朝一样，法官和其他官员可以每隔几年调动一次。
en: And, as in Ming China, judges and other officials could be rotated every few years.

zh: 类似地，与香港一样，中国可以实施大赦（罪大恶极除外 ） ， 但需以财务披露和对“来源不明的财产”课以罚款为条件，从而解决历史包袱。
en: Likewise, as in Hong Kong, an amnesty could be granted, conditional on financial disclosure and a fine for “unexplainable wealth,” for all but the most egregious behavior, thereby leaving the past behind.

zh: 接着可以将法官和政府官员的薪酬提高到具有竞争力的水平，从而降低继续腐败的激励 — — 特别是当官员必须定期上交财务披露报告、隐瞒信息将受到惩罚时。
en: At that point, judges’ and government officials’ pay could be raised to competitive levels, which would weaken the incentive to continue corrupt practices – particularly if officials must regularly file financial-disclosure statements and are penalized for withholding information.

zh: 我们希望，当前普通中国人要求公开惩治腐败的愿望是一个预兆，将促使新领导人采取真正的反腐改革。
en: The recent willingness of ordinary Chinese to condemn corruption publicly is a harbinger, one hopes, of real anti-corruption reforms from the country’s new leadership.

zh: 在美国和大部分发达资本主义民主国家，独立司法、政府官员财务披露和其他独立机构是限制和预防 — — 尽管不能完全消除 — — 腐败的关键。
en: An independent judiciary, financial disclosure by government officials, and other independent institutions have been essential to limiting and forestalling – though not fully eliminating – corruption in the United States and most other advanced capitalist democracies.

zh: 中国需要以远比某些政治既得利益精英感到舒服的速度这些吸取教训。
en: That is a lesson that China needs to learn far more quickly than some members of its entrenched elite will find comfortable.

zh: 尖端保护
en: Cutting-Edge Conservation

zh: 波恩—一架小飞机要着陆了。
en: BONN – A small airplane makes its final approach to land.

zh: 但没有机场、没有跑到，也没有飞行员操纵它着陆。
en: But there is no airport, no landing strip, nor even a pilot to guide it down.

zh: 这是一个无人驾驶飞行器（Unmanned Aerial Vehicle）正在从任务返回：不是猎杀恐怖分子或侦探外国领土，而是监控犀牛数量、跟踪老虎偷猎者。
en: This is an Unmanned Aerial Vehicle returning from its mission: not hunting down terrorists or spying on foreign lands, but monitoring populations of rhinos and scouting for tiger poachers.

zh: 这架无人机没有装备罗尔斯罗伊斯喷气发动机和孔径雷达；只是安装了谷歌地区界面、摄像头和红外线传感器。
en: This drone is not fitted with turbo Rolls Royce jet engines or aperture radar; instead, it features a Google Map interface, cameras, and simple infrared sensors.

zh: 其价格比普通笔记本电脑还便宜。
en: And it is no more expensive than an average laptop computer.

zh: 这类廉价新科技正在改变保护的面貌；对负责管理迁徙野生动物物种保护公约（Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals）的联合国环境署（UNEP）来说，这些新保护工具可谓天降甘霖。
en: Such cheap new technologies are changing the face of conservation; and, for the United Nations Environment Program (UNEP), which administers the Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals, these new conservation tools cannot come soon enough.

zh: 它们填补了我们关于海龟、鲨鱼、大象和鸟类的物种长距离迁徙的知识空白。
en: They fill the gaps in our knowledge about long-distance migration by species such as turtles, sharks, elephants, and birds.

zh: 搜集到的数据随后被用于为不同物种定制保护战略。
en: The data gathered are then used to develop tailored conservation strategies for these different species.

zh: 跨洋跨洲迁徙的物种最容易受到威胁，因为如此长的迁徙过程中充满了危险，它们因此成为能让科学家了解它们的行为的技术的受益者。
en: Because species that migrate across oceans and continents tend to be the most endangered, owing to the threats that such long journeys involve, they benefit from any technologies that allow scientists to learn about their behavior.

zh: 比如，用作定位器的超轻型邦环让科学家得以追踪小型陆禽的难以置信的迁徙之旅。
en: For example, an ultra-light band that acts as a geo-locator now allows scientists to track small land birds during their incredible journeys.

zh: 科学家最近发现红颈瓣蹼鹬的迁徙之旅始于苏格兰设得兰群岛，经冰岛和格陵兰穿越大西洋，延美国东海岸向南飞过加勒比和墨西哥，最终到达厄瓜多尔或秘鲁海岸。
en: Scientists recently discovered that the red-necked phalarope starts its migration from Scotland’s Shetland Islands, crosses the Atlantic via Iceland and Greenland, flies south along the United States’ eastern seaboard to the Caribbean and Mexico, and ends its journey off the coast of Ecuador or Peru.

zh: 动物研究使用空间国际合作组织（International Cooperation for Animal Research Using Space，ICARUS）正在开发绕地球运动的遥感平台，让全世界科学家能够追踪小型生命体，在大区域实施观察和实验。
en: The International Cooperation for Animal Research Using Space (ICARUS) is developing a remote sensing platform that will orbit the earth, allowing scientists worldwide to track small organisms and carry out observations and experiments over large areas.

zh: 科学家将很快因此能够追踪和更好地理解蠵龟等物种的超常迁徙之旅。 蠵龟在澳大利亚孵化，成长数年后经太平洋迁往智利、厄瓜多尔或秘鲁。
en: As a result, scientists will soon be able to track and better understand extraordinary journeys such as those of loggerhead sea turtles, which are hatched in Australia, where they remain for a few years before migrating across the Pacific Ocean to Chile, Ecuador, or Peru.

zh: 三十年后，它们会回到出生地。
en: Thirty years later, they return to their birthplace.

zh: 新科技在打击偷猎方面也有巨大的价值。
en: New technologies are also proving invaluable for combating illegal poaching.

zh: 除了使用无人机，保护员现在还装备了热感相机和军用直升机，可以追踪大象和犀牛偷猎者，后者据说使用类似的科技（以及自动武器）追踪猎物。
en: In addition to the use of drones, conservation rangers are now equipped with heat-detecting thermal cameras and military helicopters, and can track elephant and rhino poachers, who reportedly use similar technologies (as well as automatic weapons) in pursuing their prey.

zh: 保护员还用热感移动探头和夜视仪发发现非法捕鸟者，他们用手机播放电子鸟鸣诱捕小型鸣禽，开着四驱车横跨数百公里捕鸟。
en: Rangers are also using heat-seeking motion detectors and night-vision goggles to take on illegal bird trappers, who ensnare small songbirds using mobile phones that emit electronic bird calls, and 4x4 vehicles to check hundreds of kilometers of netting.

zh: 此外，德国联邦自然保护部和世界自然基金会（World Wide Fund for Nature）与美因茨约翰尼斯古腾堡大学（Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz）合作开发了检测象牙样本中的同位素以追溯其来源的方法。
en: Moreover, Germany’s Federal Ministry of Nature Conservation and the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), in collaboration with Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz, have developed a way to measure the isotope in ivory samples to trace their provenance.

zh: 这能让海关官员和警方确定没收象牙的来源，从而精确定位走私地。
en: This will allow customs officials and police to ascertain the origins of confiscated ivory so that they can pinpoint trafficking locations.

zh: 另一项重要的科技应用是减少“人兽冲突”频率。 人兽冲突是指无意中造成的伤害，如意外在渔网中国捕获鲨鱼、蝠鲼、海龟、海豚、鲸鱼和海龟。
en: Another important use of technology is in reducing the frequency of “human-animal conflict” – inadvertent harm such as the unintended trapping of sharks, manta rays, marine turtles, dolphins, whales, and sea turtles in fishing nets.

zh: 保护主义者一直在寻找不会给渔民造成麻烦的保护海洋动物之法。
en: Conservationists have long sought to protect marine life in ways that do not create problems for fishermen.

zh: 最新测试表明，用紫外线照射水下渔网探测这些物种不会影响捕鱼。
en: Recent tests have shown that shining ultraviolet lights against the submerged nets deters these species without affecting the fishing catch.

zh: 其他形式的人兽冲突可以通过简单的手机应用避免。
en: Other forms of human-animal conflict can be avoided with simple, mobile-phone apps.

zh: 比如，美国鱼类和野生动物服务局用GPS跟踪系统向佛罗里达内河水路船只播送可能碰撞海牛的预警。
en: The US Fish and Wildlife Service, for example, uses a GPS tracking system to alert boaters on Florida’s inland waterways to potential collisions with manatees.

zh: 在西澳大利亚，一项应用可以警告游泳者附近有鲨鱼。
en: In Western Australia, an app now warns swimmers of nearby sharks.

zh: 类似地，更好的迁徙路线追踪技术和传感器的使用可以让我们更了解鲨鱼的运动和栖息地，从而帮助我们回避它们。
en: Similarly, better tracking of migration routes and the use of sensors could teach us more about sharks’ movements and habitats, and thus help us to avoid them.

zh: 尽管光靠科技无法保护所有的珍惜迁徙物种，但它可以提供重要的知识，并有助于实施重要的国际法和监管，如迁徙物种公约（Convention on Migratory Species）和国际濒危物种交易公约（Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species ） 。
en: Although technology alone may not be able to protect all precious migratory species, it can provide vital knowledge and help to enforce important international laws and regulations, such as the Convention on Migratory Species, and the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species.

zh: 此外，科技能够改善我们对地球脆弱性的了解和理解，从而让人类与动物更和谐地共存。
en: Moreover, technology can improve our understanding and appreciation of our planet’s fragility, and allow humans and animals to coexist more harmoniously.

zh: 天皇的新目标
en: The Emperor’s New Goal

zh: 新德里—日本明仁天皇和皇后美智子将罕见地出国访问，于11月30日来到印度城市新德里和金奈。
en: NEW DELHI – Japanese Emperor Akihito and Empress Michiko, in a rare overseas trip, are scheduled to begin a tour of the Indian cities of New Delhi and Chennai on November 30.

zh: 天皇夫妇为期一周的出访有可能标志着印日关系的里程碑，在亚洲两大民主国家间塑造更紧密的经济和安全联系，寻求更加多元、稳定的亚洲秩序。
en: The imperial couple’s weeklong visit is likely to mark a defining moment in Indo-Japanese relations, fostering closer economic and security ties between Asia’s two leading democracies as they seek a pluralistic, stable Asian order.

zh: 传统上，日本天皇的访问 — — 除加冕礼和皇室周年庆典以外 — — 标志着双边关系的转折点。
en: Traditionally, a visit from the Japanese emperor – except for a coronation or royal anniversary celebration – signified a turning point in a bilateral relationship.

zh: 根据美国为日本制定的战后宪法，天皇仅仅是“国家的象征 ” ， 但他仍具有重大的影响力，因为日本人十分崇敬帝国皇朝 — — 世界上最古老的持续世袭君主制，其源头可追溯到公元前660年。
en: While the emperor is merely the “symbol of the state” under Japan’s US-imposed postwar constitution, he retains significant influence, owing to Japanese veneration of the imperial dynasty – the world’s oldest continuous hereditary monarchy, the origins of which can be traced to 660 BC.

zh: 事实上，日本天皇的出国访问仍有着深刻的政治意义，决定着日本外交政策的节奏甚至日程。
en: Indeed, the emperor’s overseas visits remain deeply political, setting the tone – if not the agenda – for Japan’s foreign policy.

zh: 就拿明仁天皇1992年出访中国来说吧，这是日本天皇第一次出访。
en: Consider Akihito’s 1992 visit to China – the first such visit by any Japanese emperor.

zh: 中国领导人邓小平的政府 — — 感谢日本没有就1989年天安门大屠杀采取惩罚性制裁，并急切地渴望获得国际认可，更不用说期盼日本的资本和商业技术了 — — 在两年的时间里七次发出邀请。
en: Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping’s government – grateful for Japan’s reluctance to maintain punitive sanctions over the 1989 Tiananmen Square massacre and eager for international recognition, not to mention Japanese capital and commercial technologies – had extended seven invitations over two years.

zh: 明仁天皇的到访标志着日本亲中外交政策的顶峰，随之而来的日本援助、投资和技术转移的增长，也造就了日本在中国崛起中的作用。
en: Akihito’s trip, which came at the height of Japan’s pro-China foreign policy, was followed by increased Japanese aid, investment, and technology transfer, thereby cementing Japan’s role in China’s economic rise.

zh: 改善的双边关系一直持续到最近的领土和其他双边纠纷。
en: The improved diplomatic relationship lasted until the recent flare-up of territorial and other bilateral disputes.

zh: 尽管此前从未有日本天皇到访印度，但印日双边关系十分深刻。
en: Although no Japanese emperor has visited India before, the bilateral relationship runs deep.

zh: 在传统日本文化中，印度被称为天竺国（天堂之国 ） 。
en: In traditional Japanese culture, India is Tenjiku (the country of heaven).

zh: 如今，日本是印度最大的援助国，并且在支持印度基础设施开发方面起着关键作用，为西部货运专线（Western Dedicated Freight Corridor ） 、 德里-孟买产业走廊和班加罗尔地铁工程提供资金。
en: Today, Japan is India’s largest source of aid and has secured a key role in supporting infrastructure development, financing projects like the Western Dedicated Freight Corridor, the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor, and the Bangalore Metro Rail Project.

zh: 两大天然盟友寻求在快速发展的关系中添加战略成分，明仁天皇的访问是近几年来最重磅的外国领导人来访。
en: With these natural allies seeking to add strategic bulk to their rapidly multiplying ties, Akihito’s tour is the most significant visit to India by any foreign leader in recent years.

zh: 事实上，预计这次访问是这位79岁高龄、在过去十年中经历了数次重大手术的天皇的最后出访之一。
en: Indeed, it is expected to be one of the last foreign trips for the 79-year-old emperor, who has undergone several major surgeries in the past decade.

zh: 明仁天皇的行程与印度总理辛格形成了鲜明对比。
en: Akihito’s travel schedule contrasts sharply with that of Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh.

zh: 尽管辛格在第一个任期中经历了体外循环心脏手术，但这位81岁的印度领导人仍寻求通过出访抵消自己国内政治资本不足的劣势，光是在过去六个月，其海外行程就超过100万公里，出访对象包括日本、中国、印尼、俄罗斯、泰国和美国。
en: Despite having had open-heart surgery during his first term, India’s 81-year-old leader has sought to offset his low domestic political stock by flying more than one million kilometers on overseas trips – including visits to Japan, China, Indonesia, Russia, Thailand, and the United States in the last six months alone.

zh: 明仁天皇到访（辛格派了一位部长级特使负责准备工作）的矛盾之处在于，日本投入了巨大的政治资本寻求与印度政府建立强大、长期的合作关系，而印度正处在政策瘫痪中。
en: The paradox of Akihito’s tour – for which Singh has appointed a special envoy with ministerial rank to oversee preparations – is that Japan is investing substantial political capital to build a strong, long-term partnership with India’s government at a time when India is gripped by policy paralysis.

zh: 也许日本领导人寄望于印度战略政策的持续性，而这要求明年大选产生的印度新政府保持合作势头。
en: Japan’s leaders are perhaps counting on the continuity of India’s strategic policies, which would require the Indian government that emerges from next year’s general election to sustain the momentum of cooperation.

zh: 但是，更重要的是，日本正在作出调整以应对快速变化的地区环境的挑战，其特征是来自中国的地缘政治竞争日渐激烈。
en: But, more important, Japan is adjusting to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing regional environment, characterized by rising geopolitical competition with China.

zh: 历史发生了逆转，日本发现，自己在前殖民地和老对手日益强硬的外交政策下已经处于被动。
en: In a historical reversal, Japan has found itself on the defensive against the increasingly muscular foreign policy of its former colony and old rival.

zh: 这一局面正在迫使日本政府反思其战后和平主义，重新修订其防务战略，并增加军事支出。
en: This situation is forcing the Japanese government to reconsider its postwar pacifism, revise its defense strategy, and increase its military spending.

zh: 在这样的背景下，日本知道，与印度开展更深层次的战略合作是上上之策，而印度也在寻求遏制来自中国的日益增加的军事压力。
en: In this context, Japan knows that a deeper strategic collaboration with India – which is also seeking to blunt increasing military pressure from China – is its best move.

zh: 在现代历史上，日本在亚洲鹤立鸡群，遥遥领先。
en: In modern history, Japan has had the distinction of consistently staying ahead of the rest of Asia.

zh: 在明治时代，十九世纪下半叶，日本成为亚洲第一个现代化国家。
en: During the Meiji era, in the second half of the nineteenth century, it became the first Asian country to modernize.

zh: 它还是亚洲第一个成为世界列强的国家，在战争中打败了清朝和沙皇俄国。
en: It was also the first Asian country to emerge as a world power, defeating Manchu-ruled China and Czarist Russia in separate wars.

zh: 二战战败后，日本从废墟中崛起，成为亚洲第一个世界经济强国。
en: And after its defeat in World War II, Japan rose from the ashes to become Asia’s first global economic powerhouse.

zh: 日本的人均GDP超过37000美元，仍是世界最大的国家之一。 日本专长于全球供应链的高价值环节。
en: With per capita GDP of more than $37,000, Japan still ranks among the world’s richest countries, specializing in the highest-value links of global supply chains.

zh: 日本的收入不平等程度是亚洲最低的。
en: And income inequality in Japan ranks among the lowest in Asia.

zh: 尽管如此，近二十年的经济停滞削弱了日本的地区影响力。
en: Nonetheless, almost two decades of economic stagnation have eroded Japan’s regional clout.

zh: 这引起了一个疑问：日本当前的问题 — — 增长停滞、公共债务高企和快速老龄化 — — 是否预示着整个东亚都将步入这一状态。
en: This raises the question of whether Japan’s current problems –sluggish growth, high public debt, and rapid population aging – presage a similar trend across East Asia.

zh: 相似的问题也已出现于韩国，而中国已开始放松其独生子女政策、展开了旨在重振增长的经济改革。
en: Similar problems are already appearing in South Korea, while China has been driven to loosen its one-child policy and unveil plans for economic reforms aimed at reviving growth.

zh: 对印度来说，日本是不可或缺的经济和安全合作伙伴。
en: For India, Japan is indispensable as both an economic and a security partner.

zh: 日本是印度“向东看”政策的核心，而“向东看”已越来越有“向东行动”的趋势，最初的政策经济逻辑因为确保叶舟稳定和地区实力均衡这一更大的地缘政治目标而放大了。
en: It is central to India’s “Look East” policy, which has evolved into more of an “Act East” policy, whereby the original strategy’s economic logic has been amplified by the larger geopolitical objective of ensuring Asian stability and a regional balance of power.

zh: 明仁天皇对印度的历史性访问也应该在这一背景的基础上来看待。
en: It is in this light that Akihito’s historic visit should be viewed.

zh: 印度的安倍晋三
en: India’s Shinzo Abe

zh: 新德里—在经历了旷日持久的政治转变和瘫痪后，印度新政府将迎来以果断著称的领袖。
en: NEW DELHI – After a prolonged period of political drift and paralysis, India’s new government will be led by a man known for his decisiveness.

zh: 正如日本首相安倍晋三在2012年的重掌大权反映了日本在经历了六年政治动荡后重塑竞争力和信心的决心，纳兰德拉·莫迪的选举胜利也反映了印度人对充满活力、自信果敢的领袖帮助印度的经济和安全重获动力的渴望。
en: Just as Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s return to power in late 2012, after six years of political instability, reflected Japan’s determination to reinvent itself as a more competitive and confident country, Narendra Modi’s election victory reflects Indians’ desire for a dynamic, assertive leader to help revitalize their country’s economy and security.

zh: 与安倍一样，预计莫迪的重点将是重振印度经济财富，同时巩固其国防、强化其与观念相近国家的战略合作，从而促进地区稳定、阻止以中国为中心的亚洲的出现。
en: Like Abe, Modi is expected to focus on reviving India’s economic fortunes while simultaneously bolstering its defenses and strengthening its strategic partnerships with likeminded states, thereby promoting regional stability and blocking the rise of a Sino-centric Asia.

zh: 莫迪魅力超凡 — — 他是国内外商业领袖的宠儿 — — 他承诺重塑告诉增长，表示投资者“只会受到热烈欢迎，不会面临繁文缛节。 ”
en: The charismatic Modi – a darling of business leaders at home and abroad – has promised to restore rapid economic growth, saying there should be “no red tape, only red carpet” for investors.

zh: 63岁的莫迪在软民族主义、市场经济和新亚洲主义等方面都与安倍一致，寻求与亚洲民主国家展开密切合作，创造严丝合缝的战略合作网。
en: The 63-year-old Modi mirrors Abe’s soft nationalism, market-oriented economics, and new Asianism, seeking close ties with Asian democracies to create a web of interlocking strategic partnerships.

zh: 印度的政治领袖平均年龄与公民平均年龄之差为世界之最，而莫迪将是印度第一位出生于1947年独立后的总理。
en: In a country where the gap between the average age of political leaders and citizens is one of the world’s widest, Modi will be the first prime minister born after India gained independence in 1947.

zh: 这构成了与安倍的另一个相似点 — — 安倍是日本第一位出生于二战后的首相。
en: This constitutes another parallel with Abe, who is Japan’s first prime minister born after World War II.

zh: 但是，两位领导人的成长过程大相径庭。 莫迪以低微的出身成为世界最大民主国家的领导人，而安倍的外公和外叔公都曾是首相，父亲是前外交大臣，可谓政治世家。
en: There is, however, an important difference in terms of the two leaders’ upbringing: While Modi rose from humble beginnings to lead the world’s largest democracy, Abe – the grandson and grandnephew of two former Japanese prime ministers and the son of a former foreign minister – boasts a distinguished political lineage.

zh: 事实上，莫迪是踩着甘地家的拉胡尔·甘地（Rahul Gandhi）问鼎总理宝座的。 拉胡尔既没有提出明确的观点，也没有表现出足以深孚印度选民对果敢的政府的众望。
en: In fact, Modi rode to victory by crushing the dynastic aspirations of Rahul Gandhi, whose failure to articulate clear views or demonstrate leadership ran counter to the Indian electorate’s yearning for an era of decisive government.

zh: 与安倍一样，莫迪面临着重大外交政策挑战。
en: Modi, like Abe, faces major foreign-policy challenges.

zh: 印度拥有全球人口的六分之一强，但影响力与此颇不相称。
en: India is home to more than one-sixth of the world’s population, yet it punches far below its weight.

zh: 2013年 ， 《 外交事务 》 （ Foreign Affairs）刊登了一篇题为《印度的拙劣外交政策 》 （ India’s Feeble Foreign Policy）的文章，探讨了印度是如何阻碍自己崛起的，新德里政坛的乌烟瘴气让印度成了自己最大的敌人。
en: A 2013 essay in the journal Foreign Affairs, titled “India’s Feeble Foreign Policy,” focused on how the country is resisting its own rise, as if the political miasma in New Delhi had turned the country into its own worst enemy.

zh: 许多印度人希望，在眼下印度和中国的国际地位差距显著拉大之际，莫迪能够指引新的国际关系方向。
en: Many Indians want Modi to give a new direction to foreign relations at a time when the gap between India and China in terms of international stature has grown significantly.

zh: 印度在其后院的影响力 — — 包括尼泊尔、斯里兰卡和马尔代夫 — — 江河日下。
en: India’s influence in its own backyard – including Nepal, Sri Lanka, and the Maldives – has shrunk.

zh: 事实上，不丹仍是印度唯一一个南亚战略禁脔。
en: Indeed, Bhutan remains India’s sole pocket of strategic clout in South Asia.

zh: 印度还面临着其两大有核地区对手 — — 中国和巴基斯坦越走越近的局面，中巴两国都对大片印度领土有主权主张，并且继续在大规模杀伤性武器方面有着合作。
en: India also confronts the strengthening nexus between its two nuclear-armed regional adversaries, China and Pakistan, both of which have staked claims to substantial swaths of Indian territory and continue to collaborate on weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 在对付这些国家方面，莫迪将面临萦绕他的前任们的相同的困境：中国和巴基斯坦外交部都是弱势部门。
en: In dealing with these countries, Modi will face the same dilemma that has haunted previous Indian governments: the Chinese and Pakistani foreign ministries are weak actors.

zh: 在中国，中共和军方决定着外交政策，而巴基斯坦则是军队和情报机构，并且仍利用恐怖组织作为代理人。
en: The Communist Party and the military shape Chinese foreign policy, while Pakistan relies on its army and intelligence services, which still use terror groups as proxies.

zh: 莫迪政府不可能放任巴基斯坦再次炮制孟买式的恐怖袭击而不予惩罚，至少要采取非军事报复措施。
en: The Modi government is unlikely to let another Mumbai-style terrorist attack staged from Pakistan go unpunished, employing at least non-military retaliatory options.

zh: 重塑对美关系前进动力是另一个紧迫挑战。 美印关系因为尖锐的外交矛盾和贸易纠纷而受损。
en: Restoring momentum to the relationship with the United States – damaged recently by grating diplomatic tensions and trade disputes – is another pressing challenge.

zh: 但莫迪承诺的亲市场经济政策和防务现代化有望给美国企业带来新机会，将双边关系推上新台阶。
en: But Modi’s commitment to pro-market economic policies and defense modernization is likely to yield new opportunities for US businesses and lift the bilateral relationship to a new level of engagement.

zh: 美国战略利益将因可能的新防务合作和贸易可以提振美国的军售、为双边军事协作带来新方式而受益。
en: America’s strategic interests will be advanced by likely new defense cooperation and trade that boosts US arms sales and creates avenues for joint military coordination.

zh: 美国与印度的联合军演比其他任何国家都要多。
en: The US already conducts more military exercises with India than with any other country.

zh: 莫迪是能够有助于美印关系回到正轨并促进合作的领导人。
en: Modi is the sort of leader who can help put US-India ties back on track and boost cooperation.

zh: 但有一个风险：他和美国的选至少在一开始只能是在商言商而不可能热情洋溢，因为美国曾给过他难以忘记的怠慢。
en: Yet there is a risk that his relations with the US, at least initially, could be more businesslike than warm, owing to an American slight that is hard for him to forget.

zh: 2005年，美国政府因为未经证实的指控 — — 他在担任古吉拉特邦首席部长期间与2002年印度教-穆斯林冲突有染 — — 而吊销了他的签证。
en: In 2005, the US government revoked his visa over unproven allegations that he connived in Hindu-Muslim riots in 2002, when he was Chief Minister of Gujarat.

zh: 即使在印度最高法院认定没有证据表明莫迪与暴力活动有涉后，美国仍拒绝他入境，直到最近的选举前夕才改变了主意。
en: Even after India’s Supreme Court found no evidence to link Modi to the violence, the US continued to ostracize him, reaching out to him only on the eve of the recent election.

zh: 美国对吊销他的签证一事没有丝毫悔改之心，因此，莫迪不可能以出访白宫的形式表示与美国的友好。
en: With the US having expressed no regret for its revocation of his visa, Modi is unlikely to go out of his way to befriend the US by seeking a White House visit.

zh: 相反，预计他会等美国官员主动示好。
en: Instead, he is expected to wait for US officials to come calling.

zh: 相反，莫迪更有可能记住在美国针对他时向他示好的国家，如日本和以色列。
en: By contrast, Modi is likely to remember states, such as Japan and Israel, that courted him even as the US targeted him.

zh: 莫迪在2007年和2012年两度访日，为日本在商业友好的古吉拉特邦的投资开启了新大门。
en: Modi’s 2007 and 2012 visits to Japan opened new avenues for Japanese investment in business-friendly Gujarat.

zh: 此外，莫迪与日本有着特别的关系，与安倍私交也不错。
en: Moreover, Modi has forged a special relationship with Japan and built personal rapport with Abe.

zh: 安倍重新成为首相时，莫迪打电话给安倍以示祝贺。
en: When Abe returned to power, Modi congratulated him with a telephone call.

zh: 莫迪的胜利或许是印日关系的转折点，将这一亚洲发展最快的双边关系作为印度“向东看 ” （ Look East）战略的主要推动力。 在美国的支持下，向东看战略寻求强化与美国的东亚和东南亚盟友和伙伴国的经济和战略合作。
en: Modi’s victory is likely to turn Indo-Japanese ties – Asia’s fastest-developing bilateral relationship – into the main driver of India’s “Look East” strategy, which, with America’s blessing, seeks to strengthen economic and strategic cooperation with US allies and partners in East and Southeast Asia.

zh: 安倍也寻求在现有以美国为中心的框架之外为日本建立新的安全选项，他也认为日本与印度的关系“是世界任何地方的任何一个双边关系中潜力最大的 ” 。
en: Abe, who has sought to build security options for Japan beyond the current US-centric framework, has argued that his country’s ties with India hold “the greatest potential of any bilateral relationship anywhere in the world.”

zh: 安倍和莫迪领导下的日本-印度深度协作将从根本上改变亚洲的战略图景。
en: A deeper Japan-India entente under Abe and Modi could potentially reshape the Asian strategic landscape.

zh: 无怪乎安倍要为莫迪的胜利欢呼。
en: It is no surprise that Abe rooted for a Modi victory.

zh: 中国的边境好战性
en: China’s Borderline Belligerence

zh: 新德里—近几年来，解放军一直在利用其日益增强的政治影响力，进犯中国和印度在喜马拉雅山区的漫长的争议边界，挑起局部冲突。
en: NEW DELHI – In recent years, the People’s Liberation Army has been taking advantage of its rising political clout to provoke localized skirmishes and standoffs with India by breaching the two countries’ long and disputed Himalayan frontier.

zh: 最近，解放军的这种进犯边界的行为的加剧对国家主席习近平即将进行的访印之旅 — — 以及两国关系的未来 — — 具有重要影响。
en: The PLA’s recent intensification of such border violations holds important implications for President Xi Jinping’s upcoming visit to India – and for the future of the bilateral relationship.

zh: 事实上，这样的挑衅行为在中国领导人访问印度前经常发生。
en: In fact, such provocations have often preceded visits to India by Chinese leaders.

zh: 事实上，2006年胡锦涛主席访问印度前夕，中国重新声称其对印度东北部大邦 — — 阿鲁纳恰尔邦拥有主权。
en: Indeed, it was just before President Hu Jintao’s 2006 visit that China resurrected its claim to India’s large northeastern state of Arunachal Pradesh.

zh: 类似地，2010年温家宝总理访问印度前，中国开始为持有克什米尔护照的居民发放进入中国的签证 — — 这是对印度主权的间接挑战。
en: Likewise, prior to Premier Wen Jiabao’s trip to India in 2010, China began issuing visas on loose sheets of paper stapled into the passports of Kashmir residents applying to enter China – an indirect challenge to India’s sovereignty.

zh: 此外，中国突然不再承认1,597公里长的印控克什米尔和中控克什米尔分界线，缩短了其与印度的边界长度。
en: Moreover, China abruptly shortened the length of its border with India by rescinding its recognition of the 1,597-kilometer (992-mile) line separating Indian Kashmir from Chinese-held Kashmir.

zh: 去年5月，李克强总理访问印度之前，解放军曾深入到印度的拉达克地区，似乎是为了表示中国对印度姗姗来迟的加强边界防卫措施行为的愤怒。
en: And Premier Li Keqiang’s visit last May followed a deep PLA incursion into India’s Ladakh region, seemingly intended to convey China’s anger over India’s belated efforts to fortify its border defenses.

zh: 如今，中国故技重施，入侵范围包括中国、印度和巴基斯坦三国的边界点 — — 即去年解放军深入其中并导致三周军事对峙的地方。
en: Now, China is at it again, including near the convergence point of China, India, and Pakistan – the same place last year’s PLA encroachment triggered a three-week military standoff.

zh: 这一模式表明，中国领导人访问印度的核心目标不是增进共同日程上的合作，而是主张中国自身利益，首先就是领土主张。
en: This pattern suggests that the central objective of Chinese leaders’ visits to India is not to advance cooperation on a shared agenda, but to reinforce China’s own interests, beginning with its territorial claims.

zh: 甚至颇为诱人的对印贸易的高速增长也没有让它减弱领土主张。
en: Even China’s highly lucrative and fast-growing trade with India has not curbed its rising territorial assertiveness.

zh: 相反，自尼赫鲁以来，历任印度总理去中国总是带着良好意愿和战略礼物。
en: By contrast, Indian prime ministers since Jawaharlal Nehru have traveled to China to express goodwill and deliver strategic gifts.

zh: 毫不奇怪，印度在双边交易中总是吃亏的一方。
en: Unsurprisingly, India has often ended up losing out in bilateral deals.

zh: 特别令人蒙羞的是2003年瓦杰帕伊总理将印度的西藏牌拱手让出。
en: Particularly egregious was Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee’s 2003 surrender of India’s Tibet card.

zh: 瓦杰帕伊软弱到什么程度？ 他是第一个使用“承认”这一法律术语，接受中国将西藏自治区称为“中华人民共和国领土的一部分 ” 。
en: Vajpayee went so far as to use, for the first time, the legal term “recognize” to accept what China calls the Tibet Autonomous Region (TAR) as “part of the territory of the People’s Republic of China.”

zh: 这为中国打开了大门，随后中国将阿鲁纳恰尔邦（面积三倍于台湾）称为“南西藏 ” ， 并加强了中国在领土问题上的立场：它所占领的地区都是中国领土，它所做出的领土主张必须建立在“互谅互让”的基础上。
en: That opened the way for China to claim Arunachal Pradesh (three times the size of Taiwan) as “South Tibet” and reinforced China’s view of territorial issues: Whatever area it occupies is Chinese territory, and whatever territorial claims it makes must be settled on the basis of “mutual accommodation and understanding.”

zh: 瓦杰帕伊的失招加剧了1954年尼赫鲁犯下的错误。 尼赫鲁在《潘查希拉条约 》 （ Panchsheel Treaty）中间接接受了中国对西藏的吞并以及不保证（甚至寻求）承认当时的印度-西藏边界。
en: Vajpayee’s blunder compounded Nehru’s 1954 mistake in implicitly accepting, in the Panchsheel Treaty, China’s annexation of Tibet, without securing (or even seeking) recognition of the then-existing Indo-Tibetan border.

zh: 事实上，根据该条约，印度丧失了一切其从大英帝国那里所继承的西藏治外法权和特权。
en: In fact, under the treaty, India forfeited all of the extraterritorial rights and privileges in Tibet that it had inherited from imperial Britain.

zh: 根据条约，印度从西藏撤回“军事防卫 ” ， 并以“合理”的价格向中国政府让渡印度政府在“中国西藏地区”所经营的邮政、电报和公共电话服务。
en: As agreed in the pact, India withdrew its “military escorts” from Tibet, and conceded to the Chinese government, at a “reasonable” price, the postal, telegraph, and public telephone services operated by the Indian government in the “Tibet region of China.”

zh: 而中国一再违反八年契约，最终在1962年跨过喜马拉雅山入侵印度。
en: For its part, China repeatedly violated the eight-year pact, ultimately mounting the trans-Himalayan invasion of 1962.

zh: 简言之，中国利用《潘查希拉条约》欺骗和羞辱印度。
en: In short, China used the Panchsheel Treaty to outwit and humiliate India.

zh: 但是，就在今年夏天，莫迪总理的新政府还派副总统安萨里（Hamid Ansari）赴北京出席该条约签署60周年庆典。
en: Yet, just this summer, Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s new government sent Vice President Hamid Ansari to Beijing to participate in the treaty’s 60th anniversary celebrations.

zh: 与安萨里同行的还有商务部长西萨拉曼（Nirmala Sitharaman ） ， 访问中国期间，她签署了一份协议，允许中国在不做出任何交换条件的情况下在印度建立工业园区。
en: Ansari was accompanied by Commerce Minister Nirmala Sitharaman, who, during her stay, signed an agreement allowing China – without any quid pro quo – to establish industrial parks in India.

zh: 这将加剧现有的双边贸易关系失衡 — — 目前中国对印出口是其从印度进口的四倍，其中大部分进口品是原材料 — — 从而让印度承受更大的战略压力，阻止印度成为旗鼓相当的竞争对手，令中国受益。
en: This will exacerbate existing imbalances in the bilateral trade relationship – China currently exports to India three times more than it imports from the country, with most of these imports being raw materials –thereby exposing India to increased strategic pressure and serving China’s interest in preventing India’s rise as a peer competitor.

zh: 如今的焦点是中国的西藏相关主张对象直至阿鲁纳恰尔邦，而不是西藏的地位，这一事实表明中国主宰着双边日程。
en: The fact that the spotlight is now on China’s Tibet-linked claim to Arunachal Pradesh, rather than on Tibet’s status, underscores China’s dominance in setting the bilateral agenda.

zh: 由于印度需要依赖来自西藏的跨国河流，它最终将付出沉重代价。
en: Given India’s dependence on cross-border water flows from Tibet, it could end up paying a heavy price.

zh: 印度因为中国不断的边界入侵而十分难堪 — — 根据印度内政部长里吉朱（Kiren Rijiju）的说法，在今年的前216天中发生了334次 — — 最近在“越界”和“闯入”之间划了一条暧昧的分界线，从而把所有的侵犯边界行为都归为越界。
en: Embarrassed by China’s relentless border violations – according to Indian Minister of State for Home Affairs Kiren Rijiju, there were 334 in the first 216 days of this year – India has recently drawn a specious distinction between “transgressions” and “intrusions” that enables it to list all of the breaches simply as transgressions.

zh: 但这对印度来说于事无补。
en: But word play will get India nowhere.

zh: 在这方面，今年7月的金砖国家峰会是一个提醒。 在巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非出席的这次峰会上，中国再一次压倒了印度。
en: A reminder of that came at July’s BRICS summit of Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, when, yet again, China emerged ahead of India.

zh: 金砖国家的新开发银行总部将设在上海而不是新德里；而印度得到的安慰是该银行的首任行长将由印度人出任。
en: The BRICS’ New Development Bank, it was announced, will be headquartered in Shanghai, not New Delhi; India’s consolation prize was that an Indian will serve as the Bank’s first president.

zh: 在顽固地想要恢复失地的中国的压力下，印度迫切地需要一个审慎的、精心调整的遏制战略。
en: Under pressure from an unyielding and revanchist China, India urgently needs to craft a prudent and carefully calibrated counter-strategy.

zh: 首先，印度可以撤销其对中国西藏主权的承认，同时通过贸易施加经济压力，正如中国在日本和菲律宾挑战其领土主张一样。
en: For starters, India could rescind its recognition of Chinese sovereignty over Tibet, while applying economic pressure through trade, as China has done to Japan and the Philippines when they have challenged its territorial claims.

zh: 印度可以通过将中国的市场准入与解决政治、领土和水纠纷的进展挂钩，从而阻止中国变本加厉。
en: By hinging China’s market access on progress in resolving political, territorial, and water disputes, India can prevent China from fortifying its leverage.

zh: 此外，印度必须准备着以向中控战略领土派遣军队作为对中国乳清的回应。
en: Moreover, India must be willing to respond to Chinese incursions by sending troops into strategic Chinese-held territory.

zh: 这将增加中国冒犯边界的代价，从而增强威慑。
en: This would raise the stakes for Chinese border violations, thereby boosting deterrence.

zh: 最后，印度必须仔细考虑其通过贸易和金砖国家协议与中国形成的伙伴关系的伪善性 — — 至少在形成更加平衡的双边关系前是如此。
en: Finally, India must consider carefully the pretense of partnership with China that it is forming through trade and BRICS agreements – at least until a more balanced bilateral relationship emerges.

zh: 毕竟，贸易繁荣和加入金砖国家俱乐部都不能让印度免于欺凌。
en: After all, neither booming trade nor membership in the BRICS club offers protection from bullying.

zh: 国际法暴政
en: The International Misrule of Law

zh: 新德里 — — 表面上，中国不久前宣布在其实际控制区外设立防空识别区（ADIZ）与美国因涉嫌克扣印度管家而逮捕一名驻纽约印度外交官并对其进行搜身似乎毫无关联之处。
en: NEW DELHI – On the face of it, China’s recent declaration of an air defense identification zone (ADIZ) extending to territories that it does not control has nothing in common with America’s arrest and strip-search of a New York-based Indian diplomat for allegedly underpaying a housekeeper she had brought with her from India.

zh: 其实，上述事件集中体现了两个大国所奉行的单边主义国际法。
en: In fact, these episodes epitomize both powers’ unilateralist approach to international law.

zh: 大国一贯吹嘘建立在规则基础上的公正的全球秩序对国际和平与安全至关重要。
en: A just, rules-based global order has long been touted by powerful states as essential for international peace and security.

zh: 但实际上大国却一边藐视国际法，一边借国际法来惩罚其他国家。
en: Yet there is a long history of major powers flouting international law while using it against other states.

zh: 国联解体就是因为无法惩罚或遏止这样的作法。
en: The League of Nations failed because it could not punish or deter such behavior.

zh: 今天，美中两国是国际关系中奉行单边主义作法的典型代表，即使两国都信誓旦旦支持强化全球制度和规则。
en: Today, the United States and China serve as prime examples of a unilateralist approach to international relations, even as they aver support for strengthening global rules and institutions.

zh: 以美国为例，美国一直拒绝签署重要的国际公约 — — 其中包括1982年的联合国海洋法公约（UNCLOS ） 、 1997年的联合国国际水道非航行使用法公约（该公约目前尚未生效 ） ， 以及1998年的国际刑事法院规约。
en: Consider the US, which has refused to join key international treaties – for example, the 1982 United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), the 1997 UN Convention on the Law of the Non-Navigational Uses of International Watercourses (which has not yet entered into force), and the 1998 International Criminal Court Statute.

zh: 事实上，单边主义依然是美国外交政策的主旋律，这也体现在包括网络战、监控、无人机袭击或者以政权更迭为目的的国际干预行动之中。
en: Indeed, unilateralism remains the leitmotif of US foreign policy, and this is also reflected in its international interventions, whether cyber warfare and surveillance, drone attacks, or efforts to bring about regime change.

zh: 同时，中国地缘政治重要性日渐增长已导致其无视国际规则炫耀武力和在亚洲提出领土要求。
en: Meanwhile, China’s growing geopolitical heft has led to muscle-flexing and territorial claims in Asia that disregard international norms.

zh: 中国和美国一样拒绝签署某些协议，包括国际刑事法院规约和联合国国际水道非航行使用法公约（这是明确跨国河流、湖泊及地下蓄水层资源共享规则的首部国际法 ） 。
en: China rejects some of the same treaties that the US has declined to join, including the International Criminal Court Statute and the Convention on the Law of the Non-Navigational Uses of International Watercourses (the first law to establish rules on the shared resources of transnational rivers, lakes, and aquifers).

zh: 事实上，尽管在地缘政治问题上分歧颇多，世界最大的民主国家和世界最大的独裁国家却在对待国际法的问题上有很多共同之处。
en: Indeed, despite their geopolitical dissonance, the world’s most-powerful democracy and its most powerful autocracy have much in common when it comes to how they approach international law.

zh: 比方说，由美国开创的尼加拉瓜国际法庭案先例在中国仍能引发共鸣，凸显强权依然是国际关系的正确规则。
en: For example, the precedent that the US set in a 1984 International Court of Justice (ICJ) case filed by Nicaragua still resonates in China, underscoring that might remains right in international relations.

zh: 当时国际法庭裁定美国支持尼反政府武装叛乱推翻尼加拉瓜政府和在尼加拉瓜港口布雷的行为均违反国际法。
en: The ICJ held that America violated international law both by supporting the contras in their insurrection against the Nicaraguan government and by mining Nicaragua’s harbors.

zh: 但联合国安理会呼吁执行国际法院判决的决议却遭到美国否决，致使尼加拉瓜未能得到任何补偿。
en: But the US prevented Nicaragua from obtaining any compensation by vetoing UN Security Council resolutions that called for enforcement of the ICJ’s judgment.

zh: 中国依然坚信毛泽东“枪杆子里面出政权”的信仰。
en: China still hews to Mao Zedong’s belief that “power grows out of the barrel of a gun.”

zh: 事实上，中国虽然批准了联合国海洋法公约，但随即重新解释该公约规定，为其对东南中国海的版图侵略寻找理由。
en: Indeed, while China ratified UNCLOS, it then reinterpreted the provisions to justify cartographic aggression in the South and East China Seas.

zh: 更糟的是，中国一直拒绝承认联合国海洋法公约的争端解决机制，从而可以继续无拘无束地改变现状。
en: Worse still, China has refused to accept the UNCLOS dispute-settlement mechanism, thereby remaining unfettered in altering facts on the ground.

zh: 菲律宾已经在国际海洋法法庭对中国提起诉讼。
en: The Philippines has filed a complaint against China with the International Tribunal for the Law of the Sea.

zh: 但中国根本不参与诉讼，就好像自己凌驾于国际法之上。
en: China, however, has simply refused to participate in the proceedings, as if it were above international law.

zh: 无论法院如何裁决，中国人都可以置之不理。
en: Whatever the tribunal’s decision, China will simply shrug it off.

zh: 只有安理会有权对不服从国家执行裁决。
en: Only the Security Council can enforce an international tribunal’s judgment on a noncompliant state.

zh: 但中国手握否决权，可以像美国在尼加拉瓜案中一样阻止执行不利的判决。
en: But China wields a veto there and will block enforcement of an adverse ruling, just as the US did in the Nicaragua case.

zh: 中国新设立的防空识别区旨在巩固对日韩所占领土的主权要求，新航空识别区因为延伸到中国实际控制区外而同样具有挑衅性，并在国际关系领域开创了危险的先例。
en: China’s new ADIZ, while aimed at solidifying its claims to territories held by Japan and South Korea, is similarly provocative, because it extends to areas that China does not control, setting a dangerous precedent in international relations.

zh: 日本要求其航空公司无视中国有关航班预先通知的要求，中国要求一切航班均需预先通知，即使这些航班只是途径新识别区，而不是飞往中国领空。
en: Japan has asked its airlines to ignore China’s demand for advance notification of flights, even if they are merely transiting the new zone and not heading toward Chinese territorial airspace.

zh: 相反，美国却已通知美国航母服从中国预先通知的要求。
en: By contrast, the US has advised American carriers to obey China’s prior-notification demand.

zh: 这里面有个缘故：虽然美国政策中预先通知原则仅适用于飞往美国空域的飞行器，但实际操作中美方却要求途经其防空识别区的所有航班无论目的地是哪里都要预先通报。
en: There is a reason for this: Although the prior-notification rule in American policy applies only to aircraft headed for US national airspace, in practice the US demands advance notification of all flights through its ADIZ, regardless of their intended destination.

zh: 如果其他国家模仿中美先例单方面主张国际空域，那么将会导致非常危险的后果。
en: If other countries emulated the example set by China and the US by establishing unilateral claims to international airspace, a dangerous situation would result.

zh: 因此必须制定强制性国际规则，以确保快速发展的商业航空安全性。
en: Binding international rules are thus imperative in order to ensure the safety of fast-growing commercial air traffic.

zh: 但中美在这个问题上采取单边主义做法，那么谁又能在这个问题上带头？
en: But who is supposed to take the lead when China and the US have pursued a unilateralist approach on this issue?

zh: 现在回到印度外交官科巴拉加德的案例，她所受到的待遇被印度安全顾问形容为“卑鄙而野蛮 ” 。
en: Now consider the case of the Indian diplomat, Devyani Khobragade, whose treatment India’s national security adviser called “despicable and barbaric.”

zh: 诚然，身为一名领事馆外交官，科巴拉加德按照1963年维也纳领事关系公约仅享有有限的外交豁免权。
en: True, as a consulate-based diplomat, Khobragade enjoyed only limited diplomatic immunity under the 1963 Vienna Convention on Consular Relations.

zh: 但该公约规定只要所犯不属于严重罪行，在对外交官进行审判和定罪前不得予以拘留。
en: But this convention guarantees freedom from detention until trial and conviction, except for “grave offenses.”

zh: 工资纠纷是不是应该遭到逮捕羞辱的“严重罪行 ” ？
en: Can a wage dispute qualify as a “grave offense” warranting arrest and humiliation?

zh: 美国能否容忍以同样方式对待自己的领事官员？
en: Would the US tolerate similar treatment of one of its consular officers?

zh: 严峻的现实是美国在国内对维也纳公约进行限制性解释，而在海外却严格执行，甚至用于保护其派遣出境的军事及情报承包商。
en: The harsh truth is that the US interprets the Vienna Convention restrictively at home but liberally overseas, in order to shield even the military and intelligence contractors that it sends abroad.

zh: 一个经典案例涉及中情局承包商雷蒙德·戴维斯，戴维斯2011年在巴基斯坦拉合尔打死两名男性。
en: A classic case involved the CIA contractor Raymond Davis, who fatally shot two men in 2011 in Lahore, Pakistan.

zh: 美国声称戴维斯是其拉合尔领事馆事实上的外交官，指控巴基斯坦对其进行“非法拘禁 ” ， 美国总统奥巴马称戴维斯为“驻巴基斯坦的我方外交官。 ”
en: Claiming that Davis was a bona fide diplomat with its Lahore consulate, and thus enjoyed immunity from prosecution, the US accused Pakistan of “illegally detaining” him, with President Barack Obama defending him as “our diplomat in Pakistan.”

zh: 虽然普遍认为当前国际体系建立在规则基础之上，但事实是大国是规则的制定者和执行者，但却不是规则的遵守者。
en: Despite a widely held belief that the current international system is based on rules, the fact is that major powers are rule makers and rule imposers, not rule takers.

zh: 他们一般在符合自身利益时违反或操纵国际法。
en: They have a propensity to violate or manipulate international law when it is in their interest to do so.

zh: 如果说所有国家遵守以规则为基础的国际法目前仍然遥不可及，那么重要原因是本应领导这项事业的国家却仍然往往像流氓国家般行事。
en: If universal conformity to a rules-based international order still seems like a distant prospect, an important reason is that countries that should be leading the charge still so often behave like rogue states.

zh: 日本的奥巴马问题
en: Japan’s Obama Problem

zh: 东京—当日本首相安倍晋三拜访存在争议的东京靖国神社时，中国领导人如意料之中谴责安倍瞻仰“侵华战争”背后的人。
en: TOKYO – When Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe visited Tokyo’s controversial Yasukuni Shrine last month, Chinese leaders predictably condemned his decision to honor those behind “the war of aggression against China.”

zh: 但安倍也在向日本的主要盟友和保护人美国释放信号。
en: But Abe was also sending a message to Japan’s main ally and defender, the United States.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马不愿意挑战中国在亚洲的耀武扬威和领土野心 — — 近期日本和美国在中国新划定的防空识别区问题上的反差就是明证 — — 这让越来越焦急的安倍被迫通知两国，克制不可能是单方面的。
en: Faced with US President Barack Obama’s reluctance to challenge China’s muscle-flexing and territorial ambitions in Asia – reflected in Japan’s recent split with the US over China’s new Air Defense Identification Zone (ADIZ) – an increasingly desperate Abe was compelled to let both countries know that restraint cannot be one-sided.

zh: 对中国和韩国来说，供奉14名在二战后被处死的甲级战犯的靖国神社是日本战前军国主义的化身，安倍一直没有访问靖国神社，包括在他第一次担任首相期间。
en: For China and South Korea, the Yasukuni Shrine’s inclusion of 14 Class A war criminals who were executed after World War II has made it a potent symbol of Japan’s prewar militarism, and Abe had long refrained from visiting it – including during his previous stint as prime minister.

zh: 如果中国不划定防空识别区 — — 这是一个不祥的预兆，侵占了东海上空非中方控制区域的国际空域 — — 安倍也许将继续保持原来的立场。
en: He may well have maintained that stance had China not established the ADIZ, which set an ominous new precedent by usurping international airspace over the East China Sea, including areas that China does not control.

zh: （安倍应该没有考虑他参拜靖国神社最终会加深韩国对日本的敌意、从而有利于中国的可能性。 ）
en: (Abe does not appear to have considered the possibility that his pilgrimage to Yasukuni might end up helping China by deepening South Korea’s antagonism toward Japan.)

zh: 奥巴马政府一直在敦促安倍不要因为参拜靖国神社加剧地区紧张 — — 副总统拜登在访问北京之旅中特意经停东京，重申这一要求。
en: The Obama administration had been pressing Abe not to aggravate regional tensions by visiting Yasukuni – an entreaty reiterated by Vice President Joe Biden during a recent stopover in Tokyo on his way to Beijing.

zh: 事实上，拜登之旅加深了日本的安全担心，因为这强调了美国重在平衡其在东亚的关系，即使这意味着容忍���张主义的中国，把它视为与盟友日本一样重要的战略考虑点。
en: In fact, Biden’s tour deepened Japan’s security concerns, because it highlighted America’s focus on balancing its relationships in East Asia, even if that means tolerating an expansionist China as the strategic equivalent of an allied Japan.

zh: 美国并没有取消拜登的北京之行以表明不承认中国新划定的防空识别区，反而建议美国商业航空公司尊重中国的这一举动。 而日本要求它的飞机忽视中国关于通过防空识别区的航班预先递交飞行计划的要求。
en: Instead of postponing Biden’s trip to Beijing to demonstrate disapproval of China’s new ADIZ, the US advised its commercial airlines to respect it, whereas Japan asked its carriers to ignore China’s demand that they file their flight plans through the zone in advance.

zh: 美国要求日本保持克制，这加剧了日本的焦虑，也没有赢得中国的让步。
en: By calling for Japanese restraint, the US stoked Japan’s anxiety, without winning any concessions from China.

zh: 如今，美日之间日益扩大的裂痕已经清晰可见。
en: Now, the widening rift between the US and Japan has become starkly apparent.

zh: 安倍感觉被奥巴马不就防空识别区问题采取强硬立场的决定出卖了。 划定防空识别区是中国逆转东海现状的一系列侵略性动作的最新一步。
en: Abe feels let down by Obama’s decision not to take a firm stand on the ADIZ – the latest in a series of aggressive moves by China to upend the status quo in the East China Sea.

zh: 而美国政府一反常态地公开批评安倍参拜靖国神社，其驻日大使发表声明称美国“对日本领导人采取会加深日本与邻国紧张的行为表示失望 ” 。
en: For its part, the US government openly – and uncharacteristically – criticized Abe’s Yasukuni visit, with its embassy in Japan releasing a statement saying that the US was “disappointed that Japan’s leadership has taken an action that will exacerbate tensions with Japan’s neighbors.”

zh: 如此反诘并不意味着日美同盟 — — 美国在亚洲的积极军事部署的基石 — — 马上会受到损害。
en: Such recriminations do not mean that the US-Japan alliance – the bedrock of America’s forward military deployment in Asia – is in immediate jeopardy.

zh: 日本仍是模范盟友，国土上驻有大量美国军队，甚至负责驻日美军的维持费用。
en: Japan remains a model ally that hosts a large US troop presence, even paying for the upkeep of American forces on its soil.

zh: 事实上，在参拜靖国神社前一天，他刚刚完成了长期未能完成的美国所支持的双边协议，将美国驻冲绳空军基地迁往冲绳岛人口较少的地区。
en: Indeed, Abe’s visit to Yasukuni came only a day after he completed a long-elusive, US-backed bilateral deal to relocate America’s airbase in Okinawa to a less populous area of the island.

zh: 安倍也支持日本加入美国领衔的、不含中国的新兴地区贸易协定跨太平洋合作伙伴关系。
en: And he supports Japan’s entry into the US-led Trans-Pacific Partnership, an emerging regional trading bloc that will exclude China.

zh: 尽管如此，安倍和奥巴马政府之间的心理分裂正在逐渐发展。
en: Nonetheless, a psychological schism between the Abe and Obama administrations has gradually developed.

zh: 美国担心安倍针对中国和韩国的民族主义立场，与此同时，日本官员也不再掩饰他们对奥巴马在其联盟承诺和中美关系渴望之间取得平衡的努力的不安。
en: While the US frets about Abe’s nationalistic stance vis-à-vis China and South Korea, Japanese officials have stopped trying to conceal their uneasiness over Obama’s effort to strike a balance between its alliance commitments and its desire for Sino-American ties.

zh: 拜登与中国国家主席习近平对话讨论的时间是比与安倍多一倍。
en: Biden spent more than twice as much time in discussions with Chinese President Xi Jinping as he did with Abe.

zh: 矛盾之处在于，尽管对中国日益自信的担忧让美国重新回到亚洲地缘政治的中心并强化其在亚太地区的安全安排，但并没有带来旨在遏制中国扩张政策的行动。
en: The paradox is that while anxiety over China’s growing assertiveness has returned the US to the center of Asian geopolitics and enabled it to strengthen its security arrangements in the region, this has not led to action aimed at quelling China’s expansionary policies.

zh: 结果，日本对于美国是否愿意在中国袭击日本控制之下的钓鱼岛时予以军事支持产生了怀疑。
en: As a result, Japan is becoming skeptical about America’s willingness to support it militarily in the event of a Chinese attack on the Japanese-controlled Senkaku Islands (called the Diaoyu Islands in China).

zh: 奥巴马政府的矛盾说辞 — — 确认美日安全条约覆盖钓鱼岛，但在钓鱼岛的主权问题上又不持立场 — — 于事无补。
en: The Obama administration’s contradictory rhetoric – affirming that the US-Japan security treaty covers the Senkakus, while refusing to take a position on the islands’ sovereignty – has not helped.

zh: 让日本清醒过来的是2012年奥巴马在中国占领菲律宾专属经济区海域的黄岩岛事件上的不作为。
en: A wake-up call for Japan was Obama’s inaction in 2012, when China captured the Scarborough Shoal, part of the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone.

zh: 为了结束紧张的僵局，美国牵线搭桥形成了一个协议，中菲两国同意从该海域撤军。
en: In an effort to end a tense standoff, the US brokered a deal in which both countries agreed to withdraw their maritime vessels from the area.

zh: 但是，在菲律宾海军舰只撤出后，中国占领了黄岩岛，而尽管美国和菲律宾签订了共同防务条约，美国对此几乎无动于衷。
en: But, after the Philippines withdrew, China occupied the shoal – and, despite a mutual-defense treaty between the US and the Philippines, the US did little in response.

zh: 这让中国放大了胆子，又在存在争议的南沙群岛侵占了第二个菲律宾主张主权的岛礁。
en: This emboldened China effectively to seize a second Philippine-claimed shoal, part of the disputed Spratly Islands.

zh: 地理距离和经济互赖等因素让美国对于涉足亚洲领土争端慎之又慎。
en: Factors like geographical distance and economic interdependence have made the US wary of entanglement in Asia’s territorial feuds.

zh: 而与亚洲国家不同，美国不会因为中国的“门罗主义 ” — —中国不会接受对亚洲的任何外部干预 — — 而真正受损。
en: And, unlike Asian countries, America would not really suffer from a Chinese “Monroe Doctrine” declaring that China would not accept any outside intervention in Asia.

zh: 但美国在主权争端上的中立有可能影响到它的双边安全联盟（而防止日本等国家转向军国主义，美国实际上是在为中国的利益服务 ） 。
en: But America’s neutrality on sovereignty disputes threatens to undermine its bilateral security alliances (which, by preventing countries like Japan from turning toward militarism, actually serve Chinese interests).

zh: 奥巴马政府的亚洲平衡策略让中国最近的举动所呈现的广义实力考验变得模糊了。
en: The Obama administration’s Asian balancing act obfuscates the broader test of power that China’s recent actions represent.

zh: 此事非但关于东海和南海上的几个岛屿，也关乎基于规则的地区秩序、航海和航空自由、海洋资源和亚洲实力平衡。
en: What is at stake are not merely islands in the East and South China Seas, but a rules-based regional order, freedom of navigation of the seas and skies, access to maritime resources, and balanced power dynamics in Asia.

zh: 美国的政策加剧了日本的不安全感，有可能导致美国旨在防止的结果 — — 军国主义。
en: By fueling Japanese insecurity, US policy risks bringing about the very outcome – a return to militarism – that it aims to prevent.

zh: 亚洲的警钟
en: Alarm Bells in Asia

zh: 新德里—乌克兰局势的恶化和俄美之间的日益紧张大有葬送美国总统奥巴马将“重心”转向全世界最具活力的大陆 — — 亚洲的计划之势。
en: NEW DELHI – The deteriorating situation in Ukraine and rising tensions between Russia and the United States threaten to bury US President Barack Obama’s floundering “pivot” toward Asia – the world’s most vibrant (but also possibly its most combustible) continent.

zh: 奥巴马即将对日本、韩国、马来西亚和菲律宾进行访问，此次访问基本无助于挽救亚洲重心或稳固他的地区外交政策。
en: Obama’s tour of Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, and the Philippines will do little to rescue the pivot or put his regional foreign policy on a sound footing.

zh: 事实上，俄罗斯入侵乌克兰只是亚洲重心 — — 已经被重新包装为“再平衡 ” — —失势的最新原因。
en: In fact, Russia’s aggression in Ukraine is just the latest reason that the pivot – which has been rebranded as a “rebalancing” – has failed to gain traction.

zh: 一系列其他因素 — — 包括美国外交政策焦点再次聚集于穆斯林世界、奥巴马不愿挑战日益强硬的中国、美国防务开支下降以及美国在世界舞台领导力下降等 — — 早已不利于亚洲重心论。
en: A slew of other factors – including America’s foreign-policy preoccupation with the Muslim world, Obama’s reluctance to challenge an increasingly assertive China, declining US defense outlays, and diminished US leadership on the world stage – were already working against it.

zh: 现实是，亚洲国家对中国日益强硬的外交政策越来越担心，这给了美国一个重要的机会 — — 它可以通过强化旧盟友关系和建设新伙伴关系重新赢得在该地区的核心地位。
en: The reality is that rising anxiety among Asian countries about China’s increasingly muscular foreign policy has presented the US with an important opportunity to recapture its central role in the region by strengthening old alliances and building new partnerships.

zh: 但美国却白白浪费了这一机会，让中国继续扩大着自己的领土主张。
en: But the US has largely squandered its chance, allowing China to continue to broaden its territorial claims.

zh: 事实上，过去两年来，美国的亚洲盟友和伙伴收到过三次刺耳的警报声，每一次都传达了相同的明确信号：在遏制中国有效崛起的问题上，美国已不再可靠。
en: Indeed, over the last two years, America’s Asian allies and partners have received three jarring wake-up calls, all of which have delivered the same clear message: the US cannot be relied upon to manage China’s rise effectively.

zh: 第一次信号发生在2012年7月，中国从菲律宾手中夺走了存在争议的黄岩岛，而奥巴马对此不发一词。
en: The first such signal came in the form of Obama’s silence when China seized the disputed Scarborough Shoal from the Philippines in July 2012.

zh: 这一举动为日后中国侵占其他争议领土树立了榜样，并且是在美国牵线、中菲两国达成从该海域撤出舰船的协议的情况下发生的。
en: The move – which established a model for China to annex other disputed territories – occurred despite a US-brokered deal for a mutual withdrawal of Chinese and Philippine vessels from the area.

zh: 奥巴马显然对美国在1951年共同防御条约中向菲律宾做出（并在2011年重申）的承诺毫不在意，这鼓励了中国进一步夺走了同样是菲律宾宣示主权的仁爱礁。
en: Obama’s apparent indifference to America’s commitment to the Philippines under the 1951 mutual-defense treaty, which it reaffirmed in 2011, encouraged China to seize the Second Thomas Shoal, which is also claimed by the Philippines.

zh: 美国的亚洲盟友所得到的第二次警报是中国单方面设立了防空识别区。 该区域覆盖了中国所主张（但未控制）的东海领空，是国际关系中的一次危险先例。
en: America’s Asian allies received a second wake-up call when China unilaterally established an air defense identification zone (ADIZ) covering territories that it claims (but does not control) in the East China Sea – a dangerous new precedent in international relations.

zh: 接着，中国要求所有飞经该区域的飞机 — — 不管是否要飞入中国领空 — — 提前报告飞行计划。
en: China then demanded that all aircraft transiting the zone – whether headed for Chinese airspace or not – submit flight plans in advance.

zh: 美国政府非但没有中止其副总统拜登访问北京之旅以示不满，反而建议商业航班尊重中国单方面宣布的防空识别区。
en: Instead of demonstrating its disapproval by postponing Vice President Joe Biden’s trip to Beijing, the US government advised commercial airlines to respect China’s self-declared ADIZ.

zh: 相反，日本告知它的航空公司不要理会中国的要求 — — 这表明美日关系在渐行渐远。
en: Japan, by contrast, told its carriers to disregard China’s demand – an indication of the growing disconnect in US-Japanese relations.

zh: 第三次警报来自乌克兰。
en: The third wake-up call comes from Ukraine.

zh: 美国对俄罗斯吞并克里米亚的反应是让自己远离“布达佩斯备忘录 ” （ Budapest Memorandum ） 。 布达佩斯备忘录由美国总统克林顿在1994年签署，美国承诺保护乌克兰的领土完整，换取乌方放弃核武器。
en: The US has responded to Russia’s illegal annexation of Crimea by distancing itself from the “Budapest Memorandum,” the pact that US President Bill Clinton signed in 1994 committing the US to safeguard Ukraine’s territorial integrity in exchange for relinquishing its nuclear arsenal.

zh: 前两次警报凸显出奥巴马政府不愿意冒任何风险干扰它与中国的密切关系。 如今中国已是美国的核心利益。
en: The first two wake-up calls highlighted the Obama administration’s unwillingness to do anything that could disrupt its close engagement with China, a country that is now central to US interests.

zh: 第三次警报甚至更加令人担心：只有在事关自身的关键利益时，美国才有必要捍卫另一个国家的领土完整，即便美国曾经承诺保护这个国家。
en: The third was even more ominous: America’s own vital interests must be directly at stake for it to do what is necessary to uphold another country’s territorial integrity – even a country that it has pledged to protect.

zh: 世界正在眼睁睁看着野蛮实力在二十一世纪胜出。
en: The world is witnessing the triumph of brute power in the twenty-first century.

zh: 奥巴马很快就排除了美国对俄罗斯吞并克里米亚的行为采取军事行动。
en: Obama was quick to rule out any US military response to Russia’s Crimea takeover.

zh: 类似地，当中国采取措施改变地区现状时 — — 不管是领土还是领海 — — 美国也犹豫了，没有采取措施安抚紧张不安的亚洲盟友。
en: Likewise, as China has stepped up efforts to upend the regional status quo – both territorial and riparian – the US has dithered, doing little to reassure its jittery Asian allies.

zh: 相反，美国追求了中立方针，希望以此避免卷入各国领土主张冲突所导致的军事对峙。
en: Instead, the US has pursued a neutral course, which it hopes will enable it to avoid being dragged into a military confrontation over countries’ conflicting territorial claims.

zh: 在这方面，美国不但要求中国保持克制，也要求其盟友保持克制。
en: To this end, the US has addressed its calls for restraint not only to China, but also to its own allies.

zh: 但美国自身的克制 — — 不管是对俄罗斯暴力吞并克里米亚，还是对中国渐进隐蔽的战争行为 — — 对其盟友毫无好处可言。
en: But America’s own restraint – whether in response to Russia’s forcible absorption of Crimea or to China’s creeping, covert warfare – has brought no benefits to its allies.

zh: 事实上，其不惜一切代价避免对峙的做法将在不经意间刺激着改变局面的地缘政治发展，甚至可能造成动荡。
en: In fact, its efforts to avoid confrontation at all costs could inadvertently spur game-changing – and potentially destabilizing – geopolitical developments.

zh: 最重要的是，美国对俄罗斯的制裁推动政策可能迫使克里姆林宫也将重心转向亚洲 — — 特别是手握重金、渴望能源的中国。
en: Most important, America’s sanctions-driven policy toward Russia is likely to force the Kremlin to initiate its own pivot toward Asia – particularly toward energy-hungry, cash-rich China.

zh: 与此同时，与俄罗斯摊牌将迫使美国更积极地接近中国。
en: At the same time, a showdown with Russia will compel the US to court China more actively.

zh: 在新冷战情形下，中国将因此成为大赢家，赢得广泛的外交空间追求其领土野心。
en: In a new Cold War scenario, China would thus be the big winner, gaining a wide diplomatic berth to pursue its territorial ambitions.

zh: 尽管美国要安抚中国，但日本、印度、菲律宾和越南等国家却被迫接受需要自力更生与中国的军事侵略对抗。
en: While the US propitiates China, countries like Japan, India, the Philippines, and Vietnam are being forced to accept that they will have to contend with Chinese military incursions on their own.

zh: 诊因如此，它们正在采取行动建立可靠的军力。
en: That is why they are stepping up efforts to build credible military capabilities.

zh: 这一趋势可能导致军事独立但仍与美国保持紧密战略盟友关系的亚洲强国重现。
en: This trend could lead to the resurgence of militarily independent Asian powers that remain close strategic friends of the US.

zh: 在这方面，它们将遵循美国两大最紧密盟友 — — 英国和法国的经验，建设可怕的威慑力，而不是将安全委托给美国。
en: In this sense, they would be following in the footsteps of two of America’s closest allies – the United Kingdom and France – which have built formidable deterrent capacities, rather than entrust their security to the US.

zh: 这对亚洲、美国和全世界来说都将是局面改变因素。
en: This would be a game-changing development for Asia, the US, and the entire world.

zh: 武装大象
en: Arming the Elephant

zh: 新德里—美国对印军售增长被广泛解读为两国深化防务关系的证据。
en: NEW DELHI – The rise in US arms sales to India is being widely cited as evidence of the two countries’ deepening defense relationship.

zh: 但这一关系的长期可持续性 — — 印度更多地是客户而不是合作伙伴 — — 仍是印度心头的深深疑虑。
en: But the long-term sustainability of the relationship, in which India is more a client than a partner, remains a deep concern for Indians.

zh: 最近的防务合作联合声明（Joint Declaration on Defense Cooperation，确定了超越武器销售、迈向军事硬件合作生产的方向）标志了一个转折点，还是仅仅是对印怀柔策略？
en: Does the recently issued Joint Declaration on Defense Cooperation, which establishes intent to move beyond weapons sales to the co-production of military hardware,mark a turning point, or is it merely a contrivance to placate India?

zh: 推动战略关系发展的因素显而易见。
en: The factors driving the strategic relationship’s development are obvious.

zh: 自2006年以来，双边贸易翻了四倍，今年达到了约1000亿美元。
en: Since 2006, bilateral trade has quadrupled, reaching roughly $100 billion this year.

zh: 此外，在过去十年中，美国对印防务年出口从1亿美元猛增到数十亿美元。
en: And, over the last decade, US defense exports to India have skyrocketed from just $100 million to billions of dollars annually.

zh: 随着美国军事支出减缓和其他出口市场依然紧张，美国防务企业急切地欲扩张对印销量，后者现在是世界第二大武器进口国。
en: With US military spending slowing and other export markets remaining tight, American defense firms are eager to expand sales to India, which is now the world’s largest arms importer.

zh: 政治环境也有利于它们的算盘：印度与美国进行的联合军演次数超过了其他任何一个国家。
en: And the political environment is amenable to their plans: India now conducts more joint military exercises with the US than with any other country.

zh: 对美国来说，取代俄罗斯成为印度第一大武器供应商是一次重大外交胜利，不亚于冷战期间埃及从苏联盟友（以及武器供应）阵营跳到美国阵营。
en: For the US, displacing Russia as India’s leading arms supplier was a major diplomatic triumph, akin to Egypt’s decision during the Cold War to shift its allegiance – and its arms supplier – from the Soviet Union to America.

zh: 区别在于印度能够为其购买的武器付出真金白银。
en: The difference is that India can actually pay for the weapons that it acquires.

zh: 订单是巨大的。
en: And the bills are substantial.

zh: 最近几年，印度向美国订购了价值约90亿美元的武器。
en: In recent years, India has ordered American arms worth roughly $9 billion.

zh: 眼下它还在购买更多的美国武器系统 — — 22架阿帕奇攻击直升机、六架C-130J涡轮军事运输机、15架支奴干起重直升机、145台M-777超轻型榴弹炮 — — 价值50亿美元。
en: It is now purchasing additional US weapons systems – 22 Apache attack helicopters, six C-130J turbo military transport aircraft, 15 Chinook heavy-lift helicopters, and 145 M-777 ultra-light howitzers – worth $5 billion.

zh: 印度与美国企业签订的武器合同的价值超过了除以色列以外的任何一个国家。
en: The value of India’s arms contracts with US firms exceeds that of American military aid to any country except Israel.

zh: 印度驻美国大使拉奥（Nirupama Rao）称这些防务交易为美印关系“新前沿 ” ， 且“前途十分光明 ” 。
en: Nirupama Rao, India’s ambassador to the US, has called such defense transactions “the new frontier” in US-India relations and “a very promising one at that.”

zh: 但是，尽管对美国来说这毫无疑问是积极的，但对印度来说，这代表了新的依赖性。
en: But, while it is certainly a positive development for the US, for India, it represents a new frontier of dependency.

zh: 问题在于印度防务部门几乎没有可以卖给美国的东西。
en: The problem is that India’s defense sector has virtually nothing that it can sell to the US.

zh: 印度还没有发展出与（比如）日本类似的可靠的武器生产基础，日本已可以与美国合作开发先进的武器系统。
en: The country has yet to develop a credible armament-production base like that of, say, Japan, which is co-developing advanced weapons systems with the US.

zh: 事实上，甚至是基本防务需要，印度也依赖进口 — — 不仅从美国和俄罗斯等主要供应国进口，也从世界第六大武器出口国以色列进口。
en: In fact, India depends on imports – not only from major suppliers like the US and Russia, but also from Israel, the world’s sixth-largest arms exporter – to meet even basic defense needs.

zh: 此外，印度领导人并未利用大量购买所带来的议价能力争取国家利益。
en: Moreover, India’s leaders have not leveraged the bargaining power afforded by its massive arms purchases to advance national interests.

zh: 比如，他们本可以试图说服美国停止向巴基斯坦军售，或要求让印度竞争力很强但面临着新的非关税壁垒的IT和制药部门更好地进入美国市场。
en: They could, for example, try to persuade the US to stop selling arms to Pakistan, or secure better access to the American market for India’s highly competitive IT and pharmaceutical sectors, which are facing new US non-tariff barriers.

zh: 最新的防务合作声明的运用起来并非易事。
en: Applying the recent declaration on defense cooperation will not be easy.

zh: 比如，认识武器相关合作工程的具体机会的努力将根据“国家政策和程序”进行。
en: For example, efforts to identify specific opportunities for collaborative weapons-related projects are to be pursued in accordance with “national policies and procedures.”

zh: 但双方不可能真正“彼此将对方置于与最紧密伙伴相同的地位 ” ， 除非国家政策和程序 — — 特别是美国 — — 充分发展。
en: But the two sides cannot truly “place each other at the same level as their closest partners” unless national policies and procedures – especially in the US – evolve sufficiently.

zh: 类似地，声明仅仅反复强调美国的立场 — — 支持印度在美国领导的四大技术控制机制 — — 瓦森纳协定（Wassenaar Arrangement ） 、 核供应国集团（Nuclear Suppliers Group ） 、 导弹技术控制制度（Missile Technology Control Regime）和澳大利亚集团（Australia Group）中的“完全成员”地位。
en: Similarly, the declaration merely reiterates America’s position that it supports India’s “full membership” in the four US-led technology-control regimes: the Wassenaar Arrangement, the Nuclear Suppliers Group, the Missile Technology Control Regime, and the Australia Group.

zh: 美国的政策是不向这些机制之外的国家提供敏感技术，因此印度的进入将极大地有利于技术共享。
en: Given that US policy is to deny sensitive technologies to those outside these regimes, India’s admission would make all the difference in facilitating technology sharing.

zh: 但声明并未包括任何美国加快印度进入的承诺。
en: But the declaration does not include any commitment from the US to expedite India’s admission.

zh: 所有这些表明美国在迎合印度对更平等的防务关系的渴望。
