en: All of this suggests that the US is pandering to India’s desire for a more equal defense relationship.

zh: 美国愿意与印度合作生产某些小型防务系统，如“标枪”反坦克导弹，从而为几十亿美元的美制系统大单铺平道路。
en: It is willing to co-produce with India some smaller defensive systems, such as Javelin anti-tank missiles, in order to pave the way for more multi-billion-dollar deals for US-made systems.

zh: 印度媒体也在煽风点火制造进展幻觉，紧紧抓住“最紧密合作伙伴”一词为协议喝彩。
en: The Indian media are doing their part to strengthen the illusion of progress, latching onto the phrase “closest partners” in their acclaim for the agreement.

zh: 讽刺之处在于，尽管美国之所以寻求与印度的更强的防务关系，其目的很大程度上是遏制日益专横的中国，但美国总统奥巴马却在中印争端中采取了中立立场。
en: The irony is that, while America’s pursuit of a stronger defense relationship with India is aimed largely at offsetting an increasingly assertive China, US President Barack Obama has charted a neutral course in Sino-Indian disputes.

zh: 比如，美国拒绝在印度东北部的阿鲁纳恰尔邦（中国自2006年以来称之为“藏南 ” ） 采取联合军事行动。
en: For example, the US has declined to hold joint military exercises in the northeastern Indian state of Arunachal Pradesh, which China has claimed as “South Tibet” since 2006.

zh: 可以这样说，美国主要向印度出售防御性武器系统，而（比如）俄罗斯向印度提供进攻性武器，包括战略轰炸机、航空母舰和核潜艇租赁。
en: As it stands, the US sells mainly defensive weapons systems to India, while Russia, for example, offers India offensive weapons, including strategic bombers, an aircraft carrier, and a lease on a nuclear submarine.

zh: 美国会愿意向印度出售进攻性武器 — — 包括高精确度常规武器、反潜系统和长程空基和地基巡航导弹 — — 以有助于威慑中国的军事先发制人吗？
en: Would the US be willing to sell India offensive weapons – including high-precision conventional arms, anti-submarine systems, and long-range air- and sea-launched cruise missiles – that could help to deter Chinese military preemption?

zh: 随着美印防务合作的扩展，这个问题也会变得越来越大。
en: As US-India defense cooperation broadens, this question will loom ever larger.

zh: 蚕食的中国
en: Creeping China

zh: 新德里—中国日渐增加的地缘政治分量正在助长其在亚洲的领土蚕食。
en: NEW DELHI – China’s growing geopolitical heft is emboldening its territorial creep in Asia.

zh: 既宣布对80%的南海拥有主权后，中国又刚刚划定了所谓的东海防空识别区，其与日本发生武装冲突的可能性增加了，也威胁到了海上和空中航行的自由原则。
en: After laying claim to 80% of the South China Sea, it has just established a so-called air defense identification zone in the East China Sea, raising the odds of armed conflict with Japan and threatening the principle of freedom of navigation of the seas and skies.

zh: 与此同时，中国继续在喜马拉雅地区与印度的漫长接壤地带“稍稍蚕食”领土。
en: Meanwhile, the People’s Republic continues to nibble furtively at territory across the long, disputed Himalayan border with India.

zh: 很少有人清楚中国准备同时挑衅几个邻国背后的逻辑。
en: Few seem to fathom the logic behind China’s readiness to take on several neighbors simultaneously.

zh: 中国正在试图逐渐改变现状，这是其扩大对战略地区和资源控制的髙赌注行动的一部分。
en: China is seeking to alter the status quo gradually as part of a high-stakes effort to extend its control to strategic areas and resources.

zh: 习近平主席承诺要建设伟大国家 — — 他所提出的“中国梦”即是明证 — — 对于这个目标，实现地区霸权与实现国内进步同样重要。
en: President Xi Jinping’s promise of national greatness – embodied in the catchphrase “China dream” – is tied as much to achieving regional hegemony as to internal progress.

zh: 中国的方针体现了中国将军张召忠今年所提出的“卷心菜”战略：发出领土主张，并逐渐以多层次安全带包围主张地区，从而阻止对手进入。
en: China’s approach reflects what the Chinese general Zhang Zhaozhong this year called a “cabbage” strategy: assert a territorial claim and gradually surround the area with multiple layers of security, thus denying access to a rival.

zh: 该战略需要步步智胜对手，创造关于主张地区的新的事实。
en: The strategy relies on a steady progression of steps to outwit opponents and create new facts on the ground.

zh: 该方针让对手国家的威慑计划摸不着头脑，难以采取合理或有效制衡措施，从而严重制约它们的选择。
en: This approach severely limits rival states’ options by confounding their deterrence plans and making it difficult for them to devise proportionate or effective counter-measures.

zh: 这部分是因为尽管该战略包含了现代中国边缘政策的所有要素 — — 包括采取秘密行动、发动惊吓和无视军事冲突升级的风险 — — 但其目的仍是确保主动权掌握在中国手中。
en: This is partly because the strategy – while bearing all the hallmarks of modern Chinese brinkmanship, including reliance on stealth, surprise, and a disregard for the risks of military escalation – seeks to ensure that the initiative remains with China.

zh: 这一伎俩我们已经耳熟能详：构造纠纷、通过周期性的占领发出管辖权主张，然后增加侵入的频率和持续时间，从而建立驻军或迫使对手国家按中国的条件达成协议。
en: The pattern has become familiar: construct a dispute, initiate a jurisdictional claim through periodic incursions, and then increase the frequency and duration of such intrusions, thereby establishing a military presence or pressuring a rival to cut a deal on China’s terms.

zh: 中国的主张永远是，我的就是我的，你的可以商量。
en: What is ours is ours, the Chinese invariably claim, and what is yours is negotiable.

zh: 比如，中国宣称和日本“没什么好说的 ” ， 除非日本停止在无人居住的钓鱼岛的领土争端上收声。
en: For example, China says “no foundation for dialogue” with Japan exists unless the Japanese accept the existence of a territorial dispute over the uninhabited Senkaku Islands.

zh: 在这里（其他地方也一样 ） ， 中国将对手国家描述成碍事者。
en: Here, as elsewhere, China has painted its rival as the obstructionist party.

zh: 正如中国外交部长王毅所说 ， “ 日本首先需要承认存在争议。
en: As Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi put it, “Japan needs to recognize that there is such a dispute.

zh: 全世界都知道存在争议。
en: The whole world knows that there is a dispute.”

zh: ”但之所以存在争议，完全是因为近几年来中国通过推广这些岛屿的中文名称 （ “ 钓鱼 ” ） 并侵入其领海和领空改变了现状。
en: But there is a dispute only because China has succeeded in shaking the status quo in recent years by popularizing the islands’ Chinese name (“Diaoyu”) and staging incursions into their territorial waters and airspace.

zh: 自2012年9月以来，中国的侵入频率开始稳步增加，接着，中国最近又开始增加侵入持续期。
en: After steadily increasing the frequency of those incursions since September 2012, China has recently begun increasing their duration.

zh: 覆盖钓鱼岛的新设立的防空识别区是中国卷心菜式安全的最新一“层 ” — —这是一种单方面权力攫取，美国国防部长哈格尔（Chuck Hagel）马上将此称为“为了改变地区现状的破坏稳定的举动 ” 。
en: The establishment of a new air defense identification zone extending over the islands is its latest cabbage-style security “layer” – a unilateral power grab that US Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel quickly branded “a destabilizing attempt to alter the status quo in the region.”

zh: 防空识别区甚至覆盖了苏岩礁（韩国和中国都有领土主张的水下礁石）空域。
en: The zone even covers the sky over the Leodo (Suyan) Reef, a submerged rock that both South Korea and China claim.

zh: 中国升级了其针对态度坚决的日本的消耗战，武装冲突（不管由于事故还是误判引起）的风险随之增加。
en: As China escalates its campaign of attrition against a resolute Japan, it increases the risk of armed conflict, whether by accident or miscalculation.

zh: 中国的战略对于较弱的菲律宾更加成功，也没有引起严重风险。 中国去年有效地占领黄岩岛即是明证。
en: China’s strategy has had more success – without provoking serious risks – against the weaker Philippines.

zh: 黄岩岛完全位于菲律宾专属经济区。 另一个例证是今年中国船只对仁爱礁的控制。
en: This is apparent from China’s effective seizure last year of Scarborough Shoal, located well within the Philippines’ exclusive economic zone, and the controlling presence of Chinese vessels this year around the Second Thomas Shoal, part of the disputed Spratly Islands.

zh: 仁爱礁是存在争议的南沙群岛的一部分。 中国尚未采取措施驱逐仍生活在仁爱礁上的八名菲律宾海军，但张召忠已经把仁爱礁列入了中国在南海的“一系列成就”之中。
en: China has not yet tried to evict the eight Filipino marines still living on the Second Thomas Shoal, but Zhang has included this shoal in the country’s “series of achievements” in the South China Sea.

zh: 中国的目标不仅仅是控制几片岛礁或其他不起眼的小岛；它的目标是从战略上主宰南海和东海，垄断海洋资源（包括海地矿产 ） 。
en: China is not aiming for control of just a few shoals or other tiny outcroppings; it seeks to dominate the South and East China Seas strategically and corner maritime resources, including seabed minerals.

zh: 钓鱼岛和南沙群岛总陆地面积大概只有11平方公里；但这些岛屿周围有着丰富的碳氢化合物储量。
en: The combined land area of the Senkaku and Spratly Islands amounts to barely 11 square kilometers; but the islands are surrounded by rich hydrocarbon reserves.

zh: 中国正在试图逐渐将军事控制范围扩大到它所主张的80%多南海海域，与此同时，中国在东海的目标是打破所谓的“第一岛链 ” 。 第一岛链是位于东海的一系列群岛，其中包括钓鱼岛和台湾岛。
en: While seeking to enlarge incrementally its military footprint in the more than 80% of the South China Sea that it claims, China’s aim in the East China Sea is to break out of the so-called “first island chain,” a string of archipelagos along the East Asian coast that includes the Senkaku Islands and Taiwan.

zh: 相反，在资源丰富的喜马拉雅地区，争议领土面积巨大。
en: By contrast, vast tracts of disputed land are at stake in the resource-rich Himalayan region.

zh: 在这里，中国也在增加了侵入频率后，现在开始间歇性地增加占领时间。
en: Here, too, China’s incursions, after increasing in frequency, are now being staged intermittently for longer periods.

zh: 不要弄错了，中国的领土蚕食增加了亚洲的不安全程度，助长了政治紧张，也导致世界最有经济活力的大洲成为全球冲突热点。
en: Make no mistake: China’s territorial creep is contributing to Asian insecurity, fueling political tension, and turning the world’s economically most vibrant continent into a potentially global hot spot.

zh: 平心而论，中国小心翼翼地避免可能自动成为宣战事件的大动作。
en: To be sure, China is careful to avoid any dramatic action that could become a casus belli by itself.

zh: 事实上，中国再三使用化整为零的伎俩，将其战略分解为多个部分，分别推进，使各不同部分的推进所遇到的阻力最小化。
en: Indeed, it has repeatedly shown a knack for disaggregating its strategy into multiple parts and then pursuing each element separately in such a manner as to allow the different pieces to fall into place with minimal resistance.

zh: 这一巧妙安排不但稳住了反对者；也破坏了美国对盟友的安全保障的信誉，降低了在亚洲建立制衡中国的战略伙伴的价值。
en: This shrewdness not only keeps opponents off balance; it also undercuts the relevance of US security assurances to allies and the value of building countervailing strategic partnerships in Asia.

zh: 事实上，中国将侵犯伪装成防御，把开战的包袱丢给了对手，与此同时步步为营建立中央王国霸权。
en: In fact, by camouflaging offense as defense, China casts the burden of starting a war on an opponent, while it seeks to lay the foundation – brick by brick – of a hegemonic Middle Kingdom.

zh: 中国领导人所谓的和平解决地区争议意义仅在于不会用开枪的方式实现其强硬立场。
en: Chinese leaders’ stated desire to resolve territorial disputes peacefully simply means achieving a position strong enough to get their way without having to fire a shot.

zh: 美国从未结束的战争
en: America’s Never-Ending War

zh: 新德里—官方消息：美国总统、诺贝尔和平奖获得者奥巴马又要打仗了。
en: NEW DELHI – It is official: US President and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Barack Obama is at war again.

zh: 在推翻利比亚统治者卡扎菲、轰炸索马里和也门目标后，奥巴马发动了对伊拉克北部的空袭，向伊斯兰国事实宣战 — — 这一战争决定将影响叙利亚的主权甚至致其分崩离析。
en: After toppling Libyan ruler Muammar el-Qaddafi and bombing targets in Somalia and Yemen, Obama has initiated airstrikes in the Syria-Iraq belt, effectively declaring war on the Islamic State – a decision that will involve infringing on the sovereign, if disintegrating, state of Syria.

zh: 在他的干预热情中，奥巴马再次违反了美国和国际法 — — 他既没有征得美国国会的同意，也没有获得联合国安理会的批准。
en: In his zeal to intervene, Obama is again disregarding US and international law by seeking approval from neither the US Congress nor the United Nations Security Council.

zh: 奥巴马的前任小布什发动了所谓的“反恐战争”以打击他所坚称的意在“建立从西班牙一直延伸到印度尼西亚的极端伊斯兰帝国”的组织。
en: Obama’s predecessor, George W. Bush, launched America’s so-called “war on terror” to defeat groups that he insisted wanted to “establish a radical Islamic empire that spans from Spain to Indonesia.”

zh: 但布什对伊拉克的入侵和占领引起了巨大争议，甚至破坏了全球反恐战争共识，关塔那摩湾监狱以及对嫌犯的引渡和虐待无不象征着这场战争的过犹不及。
en: But Bush’s invasion and occupation of Iraq was so controversial that it fractured the global consensus to fight terror, with the Guantánamo Bay detention center and the rendition and torture of suspects coming to symbolize the war’s excesses.

zh: 奥巴马上台后，选择了更温和、更微妙的基调。
en: After Obama took office, he sought to introduce a gentler, subtler tone.

zh: 在“用词很重要”的2009的采访中，他将反恐战争改名为“斗争”和“战略挑战 ” 。
en: Contending in a 2009 interview that “the language we use matters,” he rebranded the war on terror as a “struggle” and a “strategic challenge.”

zh: 但修辞的变化并没有带来战略改变，奥巴马政府仍然超越了安全顾虑的边界，利用其反恐活动为美国更宽泛的地缘政治利益服务。
en: But the rhetorical shift did not translate into a change in strategy, with the Obama administration moving beyond security concerns to use its anti-terrorism activities to advance America’s broader geopolitical interests.

zh: 因此，奥巴马政府没有将2011年清除本·拉登的行动视为布什所发动的反恐“斗争”的顶峰，反而增加了对“好”叛军（如利比亚）的支持，同时采取包括“定点清除”在内的手段更猛烈地追杀“坏”恐怖分子。
en: Thus, instead of viewing the elimination of Osama bin Laden in 2011 as the culmination of the anti-terror “struggle” that Bush launched, the Obama administration increased aid to “good” rebels (such as those in Libya), while pursuing “bad” terrorists more vehemently, including through a “targeted killing” program.

zh: 但是，在恐怖活动方面，要划定界线是很困难的。
en: When it comes to terrorist activity, however, such lines are difficult to draw.

zh: 比如，奥巴马一开始将伊斯兰国归为“好”的一类，因为它破坏了叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿达的的统治和伊朗在叙利亚和伊拉克的利益。
en: For example, Obama initially placed the Islamic State in the “good” category, as it undermined Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s rule and Iran’s interests in Syria and Iraq.

zh: 他的立场直到伊斯兰国威胁要颠覆伊拉克库尔德地区首付埃尔比勒（Erbil，美国军事、情报、外交和商业设施所在地）才有所改变。
en: His position changed only after the Islamic State threatened to overrun Iraq’s Kurdish regional capital, Erbil – home to US military, intelligence, diplomatic, and business facilities.

zh: 加之两名美国记者突然遭遇斩首，因此奥巴马团队突然开始采用布什��战争言辞，宣布美国将“以与对待基地组织及其全球同伙同样的方式”和伊斯兰国开战。
en: Add to that the beheadings of two American journalists, and suddenly Obama’s team was using Bush’s war rhetoric, declaring that the US is at war with the Islamic State “in the same way that we are at war with Al Qaeda and its affiliates all around the globe.”

zh: 如今，美国的反恐战争有可能演变为一场持久战争，对手的名单越来越长 — — 并且往往来自其自身政策的副作用。
en: America’s war on terror now risks becoming a permanent war against an expanding list of enemies – often inadvertently created by its own policies.

zh: 正如20世纪80年代对阿富汗的反苏叛军的秘密援助导致了基地组织的崛起 — — 希拉里·克林顿在担任奥巴马的国务卿期间也承认了这一点 — — 2011年叙利亚叛军出现后美国及其盟友对他们援助也导致了伊斯兰国的崛起。
en: Just as covert aid to Afghanistan’s anti-Soviet rebels in the 1980s contributed to Al Qaeda’s emergence – something that Hillary Clinton acknowledged when she was Obama’s secretary of state – the help that the US and its allies provided to Syrian insurgents after they emerged in 2011 contributed to the rise of the Islamic State.

zh: 2001年，美国返回阿富汗，开始了至今仍未结束的战争。 其对手 — — 圣战主义者越打越多。
en: The US returned to Afghanistan in 2001 to wage an as-yet-unfinished war on the jihadists whom its actions had spawned.

zh: 类似地，如今美国所发动的伊拉克和叙利亚战争的对手正是布什强迫巴格达政权发生更迭和奥巴马颠覆巴沙尔的失误政策所造成的。
en: Likewise, it is now launching a war in Iraq and Syria against the offspring of Bush’s forced regime change in Baghdad and Obama’s ill-conceived plan to topple Assad.

zh: 美国应该认识到，自其发动反恐战争以来，兵灾越打越盛。
en: It is time for the US to recognize that since it launched its war on terror, the scourge has only spread.

zh: 阿富汗-巴基斯坦一带仍是跨国恐怖主义的“原爆点 ” ， 而曾经稳定的利比亚、伊拉克和叙利亚等国家则成了新的枢纽。
en: The Afghanistan-Pakistan belt has remained “ground zero” for transnational terrorism, and once-stable countries like Libya, Iraq, and Syria have emerged as new hubs.

zh: 奥巴马想与阿富汗塔利班达成浮士德式的交易，而后者最高领袖在巴基斯坦逍遥法外，这表明他更想将恐怖主义限制在中东，而不是击溃恐怖主义 — — 即使这意味着印度将成为恐怖主义的首当其冲者。
en: Obama’s effort to strike a Faustian bargain with the Afghan Taliban, whose top leaders enjoy sanctuary in Pakistan, indicates that he is more interested in confining terrorism to the Middle East than defeating it – even if it means leaving India to bear the brunt of terrorist activity.

zh: （事实上，迄今仍在进行的巴基斯坦与印度的反恐战争也源于美国在阿富汗的反苏行动 — — 这也是中央情报局历史上规模最大的行动 — — 因为巴基斯坦三军情报局（Pakistani Inter-Services Intelligence）随后继承了给阿富汗叛军的数十亿美元军事援助的大头。 ）
en: (In fact, Pakistan’s ongoing war of terror against India also sprang from America’s anti-Soviet operation in Afghanistan – the largest in the CIA’s history – as the Pakistani Inter-Services Intelligence siphoned off a large share of the billions of dollars in military aid for the Afghan rebels.)

zh: 类似地，奥巴马的伊斯兰国战略也只是意图限制野蛮中世纪秩序的蔓延。
en: Similarly, Obama’s strategy toward the Islamic State seeks merely to limit the reach of a barbaric medieval order.

zh: 在宣布要“击溃和摧毁”该集团后不久，应记者澄清要要求，奥巴马表示他的真正目标是将伊斯兰国变为“可管理的问题 ” 。
en: Moments after declaring his intention to “degrade and destroy” the group, Obama responded to a reporter’s request for clarification by stating that his real goal is to turn the Islamic State into a “manageable problem.”

zh: 更糟糕的是，奥巴马计划用导致伊斯兰国崛起的策略与伊斯兰国斗争：授权中央情报局在该地区几个 石油酋长的协助下训练和武装数千叙利亚叛军。
en: Making matters worse, Obama plans to use the same tactics to fight the Islamic State that led to its emergence: authorizing the CIA, aided by some of the region’s oil sheikhdoms, to train and arm thousands of Syrian rebels.

zh: 不难看到，用更多武装更精良的战士让叙利亚流血漂橹是十分危险的。
en: It is not difficult to see the risks inherent in flooding the Syrian killing fields with even more and better-armed fighters.

zh: 美国也许拥有世界上最好的智库、教育程度最高的脑袋。
en: The US may have some of the world’s top think tanks and most highly educated minds.

zh: 但它一直无视过去的错误的教训，因此一再重蹈覆辙。
en: But it consistently ignores the lessons of its past blunders – and so repeats them.

zh: 美国领导的伊斯兰世界政策之所以能够防止文明之间的冲突，完全是因为它滋长了从根本上削弱地区和国际安全的文明内部的冲突。
en: US-led policies toward the Islamic world have prevented a clash between civilizations only by fueling a clash within a civilization that has fundamentally weakened regional and international security.

zh: 美国与其所帮助培养的敌人的无尽的战争不可能获得稳定的国际支持或带来持久性结果。
en: An endless war waged on America’s terms against the enemies that it helped to create is unlikely to secure either steady international support or lasting results.

zh: 阿拉伯和土耳其对于美国试图建立国际联盟支持奥巴马政府承认可能持续多年的针对伊斯兰国的军事打击反应冷淡就是最好的证明。
en: Nowhere is this more apparent than in the tepid Arab and Turkish response to America’s effort to assemble an international coalition in support of what the Obama administration admits will be a multiyear military offensive against the Islamic State.

zh: 帝国傲慢可能再一次助长而不是遏制伊斯兰恐怖主义，这一风险是实实在在的。
en: The risk that imperial hubris accelerates, rather than stems, Islamist terror is all too real – yet again.

zh: 一个阿富汗人的阿富汗
en: An Afghan Afghanistan

zh: 新德里—在即将迎来总统大选之际，阿富汗再一次面临关键时刻，在经历了35年的残酷战争后，它的统一和领土完整正处于紧要关头。
en: NEW DELHI – As it braces for its upcoming presidential election, Afghanistan finds itself at another critical juncture, with its unity and territorial integrity at stake after 35 years of relentless war.

zh: 阿富汗人能够最终摆脱困扰了他三十多年的交战和外国干预循环吗？
en: Can Afghanistan finally escape the cycle of militancy and foreign intervention that has plagued it for more than three decades?

zh: 两大关键问题左右着2014年之后阿富汗的走势。
en: Two key questions are shaping discussions about Afghanistan’s post-2014 trajectory.

zh: 第一个问题是巴基斯坦会在多大程度上干扰阿富汗事务，比如支持和教唆阿富汗塔利班及其盟友哈卡尼（Haqqani）网络和希克马蒂亚尔（Gulbuddin Hekmatyar）义勇军等。
en: The first concerns the extent to which Pakistan will interfere in Afghan affairs, such as by aiding and abetting the Afghan Taliban and its main allies, including the Haqqani network and Gulbuddin Hekmatyar’s militia.

zh: 这将取决于美国是否会用慷慨援助为条件换取急需现金的阿富汗人不干预阿富汗。
en: This will depend on whether the United States conditions its generous aid to cash-strapped Pakistan on noninterference in Afghanistan.

zh: 第二个问题是以美国为首的北约军队是否会继续在阿富汗起作用。
en: The second question is whether US-led NATO forces will continue to play any role in Afghanistan.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马希望美军继续留在阿富汗早已不是秘密 — — 这与他2009年宣布美国不寻求在阿富汗保留军事基地的说法相反。
en: It is no secret that US President Barack Obama wants to maintain an American military presence in the country – a reversal of his declaration in 2009 that the US sought no military bases there.

zh: 事实上，几个月来，美国和阿富汗政府进行了痛苦的谈判以确定可以让美国几乎无限制地在阿富汗保留军事基地的安全协议。
en: Indeed, for several months, the US has been involved in painstaking negotiations with the Afghan government to conclude a bilateral security agreement that would enable the US to maintain bases in Afghanistan virtually indefinitely.

zh: 原本的阿富汗闹剧尾声最后成了关于美国新军事基地战略的新博弈。
en: What was supposed to be an endgame for Afghanistan has turned into a new game over America’s basing strategy.

zh: 但是，尽管最终完成了协议条款，但奥巴马没能说服即将卸任的阿富汗总统卡尔扎伊在协议上签字。
en: But, despite having finalized the terms of the agreement, Obama failed to persuade Afghanistan’s outgoing president, Hamid Karzai, to sign it.

zh: 这意味着美国在阿富汗的角色只有在5月阿富汗新总统履新后才能敲定。
en: That means that America’s role in the country can be settled only after the new Afghan president assumes office in May.

zh: 而大选的结果非常不确定。
en: And the election’s outcome is far from certain.

zh: 八位总统候选人都宣称支持安全协议，但这并不能令美国安心，因为大部分候选人过去都曾直接反对美国的利益 — — 更不用说其中一些还是前任或现任军阀了。
en: While all eight Afghan presidential candidates claim to support the security accord, this may offer little comfort to the US, given that most of the candidates have directly opposed US interests in the past – not to mention that several of them are former or current warlords.

zh: 此外，还有一个问题是以美国为首的留驻军队（即使规模不小）是否能给阿富汗带来不同，因为原先大得多的军队也没有在过去13年里确保明确的胜利。
en: Moreover, there remains the question of how a residual American-led force, even if sizable, could make a difference in Afghanistan, given that a much larger force failed to secure a clear victory over the past 13 years.

zh: 奥巴马并未给出答案。
en: Obama has offered no answer.

zh: 尽管如此，美国两党都十分支持保留阿富汗军事基地，以此彰显其硬实力，而美俄在乌克兰问题上日趋紧张的冲突更大大增加了这一方案的支持度。
en: Nonetheless, there is strong bipartisan support in the US for maintaining military bases in Afghanistan, as a means of projecting hard power, and the increasingly charged confrontation between the US and Russia over Ukraine has boosted that support considerably.

zh: 事实上，前国务卿赖斯明确地将俄罗斯在乌克兰的行动与“阿富汗撤军谈判”挂钩 ， “ 不论从安全局势看这是否必要 ” 。
en: In fact, former Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice explicitly linked Russia’s actions in Ukraine with “talk of withdrawal from Afghanistan, whether the security situation warrants it or not.”

zh: 按照赖斯的说法，只要留驻军队少于10,000人，其所释放的信号就是美国对于帮助稳定阿富汗局势并不上心 — — 而这一信号会让俄罗斯总统普京更加肆无忌惮。
en: According to Rice, anything less than a residual force of 10,000 American troops will send the message that the US is not serious about helping to stabilize Afghanistan – a message that would embolden Russian President Vladimir Putin further.

zh: 她似乎没有认识到，美国与俄罗斯关系的恶化可能削弱这一驻军战略 — — 俄罗斯是美国向阿富汗提供军事供给的主要渠道。
en: What she does not seem to recognize is that America’s deteriorating ties with Russia – a key conduit for US military supplies to Afghanistan – could undercut its basing strategy.

zh: 美国显然认定在阿富汗保留驻军符合其利益。
en: The US is clearly convinced that a continued military presence in Afghanistan is in its interests.

zh: 但这对长期饱受国内军事集团和外国势力摧残的阿富汗意味着什么？
en: But what would it mean for Afghanistan, a country that has long suffered at the hands of homegrown militant groups and foreign forces alike?

zh: 阿富汗自1979年以来便一直处于战争状态。 1979年，苏联人发动了长达八年的针对跨国反对集团的军事行动。
en: Afghanistan has been at war since 1979, when Soviet forces launched a disastrous eight-year military campaign against multinational insurgent groups.

zh: 这场干预 — — 以及美国和沙特政府通过巴基斯坦三军情报局为阿富汗反苏游击队提供武装 — — 导致了战争和恐怖主义的蔓延，并在后来的美国军事干预期间存活下来。
en: That intervention – together with the US and Saudi governments’ provision of arms to Afghanistan’s anti-Soviet guerrillas through Pakistan’s Inter-Services Intelligence agency – helped spread militancy and terrorism, which the subsequent US military intervention has kept alive.

zh: 结果，阿富汗现在极有可能陷入种族和部族分裂，割据势力或军阀控制的飞地将遍地开花。
en: As a result, Afghanistan is now at risk of becoming partitioned along ethnic and tribal lines, with militia- or warlord-controlled enclaves proliferating.

zh: 简单讲，外国对阿富汗的干预到目前为止都未能产生积极结果。
en: In short, foreign involvement in Afghanistan has so far failed to produce positive results.

zh: 因此，阿富汗的政治和安全转型更应该专注于三大关键国内因素：
en: That is why Afghanistan’s political and security transition would be better served by focusing on three key internal factors:

zh: ·         被广泛视为反映了阿富汗人民争取和平未来的自由而公平的选举。
en: ·         Free and fair elections that are widely viewed as reflecting the will of the Afghan people to chart a peaceful future.

zh: ·         卡尔扎伊的继任者须有能力统一各自为政的种族和政治集团 — — 这一艰巨使命只有信誉卓著、广受尊敬的领袖才能实现。
en: ·         The ability of Karzai’s successor to unite disparate ethnic and political groups – a tall order that can be filled only by a credible and widely respected leader.

zh: ·         阿富汗政府成功地建立多种族的阿富汗安全部队。
en: ·         The government’s success in building up Afghanistan’s multi-ethnic security forces.

zh: 下个月的总统大选结果如何十分关键。
en: How next month’s presidential election plays out is crucial.

zh: 如果塔利班的威胁和暴力阻止太多的阿富汗人投出选票，那么选举结果的合法性就会受到质疑，可能带来进一步的动荡，刚刚建立的阿富汗安全部队将难以应付。
en: If threats and violence from the Taliban prevent too many Afghans from casting their vote, the legitimacy of the outcome could be questioned, possibly inciting even more turmoil, which Afghanistan’s fledging security forces would struggle to contain.

zh: 平心而论，到目前为止，阿富汗安全部队表现尚可，阻止了多起暗杀，也大体维持了喀布尔的安全。
en: To be sure, the security forces have, so far, mostly held their ground, deterring assassinations and keeping Kabul largely secure.

zh: 但他们也没有取得重大成就，美国计划削减援助将让他们更加难有作为。
en: But they have also failed to make significant gains, and US plans to cut aid will make progress even more difficult.

zh: 如果无法在援助减少的情况下维持当前力量，阿富汗政府将不得不试图让他们“更加短小精悍 ” 。
en: Unable to sustain the current force with reduced aid, the Afghan government will have to try to make it “leaner and meaner.”

zh: 是否能够成功远未可知。
en: Whether it will succeed is far from certain.

zh: 这进一步增加了留驻军队的压力，即使这也不可能为阿富汗带来和平。
en: That only increases the pressure to maintain a foreign military presence, even though it is unlikely to bring peace to Afghanistan.

zh: 事实上，在阿富汗保留军事基地可能让美国陷入针对军阀和割据势力的长期低强度战争，其风险或许比由此带来的地缘政治优势更大。
en: In fact, the risk of becoming locked in a protracted, low-intensity war against militancy and warlordism is likely to outweigh any geopolitical advantages that the US would gain from military bases in the country.

zh: 毕竟，巴基斯坦才是恐怖分子避难所和阿富汗叛军指挥控制中心，这令2001年以来美国搜寻阿富汗塔利班的军事行动大受掣肘。
en: After all, the terrorist havens and command-and-control centers for the Afghan insurgency are located in Pakistan – undercutting the US military effort to rout the Afghan Taliban since 2001.

zh: 所有这些都指向一个明确的结论：阿富汗的未来必须最终由阿富汗人掌握。
en: All of this points to a clear conclusion: Afghanistan’s future must finally be put in the hands of Afghans.

zh: 外部资源应该用于建设统一阿富汗并保持其大体和平的治理能力上。
en: Outside resources should be devoted to building the governing capacity needed to keep the country united and largely peaceful.

zh: 巴西的阿根廷时刻
en: Brazil’s Argentina Moment

zh: 坎布里奇—巴西经济出现了断崖式暴跌，这是多年来经济管理不当和大面积腐败丑闻的结果。 经济管理不当和大面积腐败丑闻吞噬了巴西的政治和商业建制派 — — 现在眼看着快要将第二任总统拉下马了。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Brazil’s economy has been in free fall, a casualty of years of economic mismanagement and the vast corruption scandal that has engulfed the country’s political and business establishment – and which now threatens to bring down the second president in as many years.

zh: 在政治和经济动荡时期，你很难专注于政策发展，但事实仍然是，巴西如果想要打好可是增长的基础，就必须克服基本挑战。
en: It may seem hard to focus on policy developments amid the political and economic turmoil, but the fact remains that Brazil must overcome fundamental challenges if it is to lay the groundwork for sustainable growth.

zh: 而最大的基本挑战就是财政萎靡。
en: Few loom as large as the country’s fiscal woes.

zh: 很容易认为，巴西过多的政府融资长期以来一直拖累的经济。
en: There is a strong argument that Brazil’s overstretched government finances have long held back the economy.

zh: 政府支出占GDP之比高达36 % ， 是收入水平相近国家中最高的。
en: At 36%, the ratio of government spending to GDP is one of the highest among countries at a similar income level.

zh: 多年来的财政放纵导致巴西积累了巨大的社会安全负债，而大宗商品价格低迷又大大放大的问题 — — 现在还要加上政治危机 — — 债务现已达到GDP的70%左右，政府不堪重负。
en: Years of fiscal laxity, mounting social security obligations, and low commodity prices have greatly magnified concerns – now compounded by the political crisis – about the government’s debt burden, which now stands at about 70% of GDP.

zh: 财政状况告急导致融资利率高企，这反过来让财政状况更加危险：更高的利息支付是巴西和同类国家之间的利差的最大原因。
en: The high interest rates required to finance the perilous fiscal position aggravates it further: higher interest payments account for much of the difference in spending between Brazil and peer countries.

zh: 在这样的背景下，巴西国民议会试图重振市场信心，在去年12月批准了前所未有的宪法修正案，为非利息政府支出设置了一个至少为期十年的上限，这个上限与前一年的通货膨胀率挂钩。
en: Against this background, Brazil’s National Congress, seeking to regain market confidence, approved an unprecedented constitutional amendment last December that imposes a ceiling on non-interest government expenditures, indexed to the previous year’s inflation rate, for a period of at least ten years.

zh: 如果能够坚持贯彻的话，这一支出上限将保证，只要国民收入能够取得真实增长，政府（除利息支出外的）占国民收入之比就将下降。
en: As long as it holds, the spending cap ensures that the size of the government (excluding interest payments) will shrink as a share of national income in every year that the economy experiences real growth.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）当时予以热烈支持，称之为可能的财政“局面改变因素 ” 。
en: The International Monetary Fund enthusiastically endorsed it at the time, calling it a potential fiscal “game changer.”

zh: 但真的是这样吗？
en: But is it?

zh: 乍一看，支出上限的经济原因非常弱。
en: Taken at face value, the economic justification for a spending cap is surprisingly weak.

zh: 经济理论并不支持在长达十年的时间里保持真实政府支出不变。
en: Nothing in economic theory supports keeping real government spending constant over a period as long as a decade.

zh: 规模大如巴西政府，根本不存在能够确保持续增长的政府支出-GDP之比的魔法数字。
en: As large as the size of Brazil’s government is, there is no magic ratio of spending to GDP that would ensure sustained growth.

zh: 此外，支出上限不区分政府消费和政府投资。
en: Furthermore, the ceiling does not distinguish between government consumption and investment.

zh: 而在实践中，这可能成为除了支出上限之外的又一个目标，从而扼杀在未来衰退时期采取反周期财政政策的空间。
en: And, in practice, it is likely to become more of a target than a ceiling, thereby removing room for countercyclical fiscal policy during a future downturn.

zh: 即使作为市场信心的信号，未来支出上限的概念也存在重大弱点。
en: Even as a signal for market confidence, the idea of a cap on future spending has important weaknesses.

zh: 只要经济处于收缩状态，支出上限实际上并不会带来多少纪律；它不能迫使政府和经济同步收缩。
en: As long as the economy contracts, a spending cap in fact does not impart much discipline; it does not force the government to shrink in step with the economy.

zh: 从阿根廷的传统看，财政收缩会被延迟到未来 — — 从而起不到信心提振器的作用。
en: Fiscal contraction is, in Augustinian fashion, deferred to the future – not exactly a confidence booster.

zh: 事实上，IMF认为光有支出上限是不不够的，并敦促巴西采取更多的前置财政调整。
en: Indeed, the IMF, arguing that the spending cap is inadequate, has pushed for additional frontloaded fiscal adjustment.

zh: 也许非常时期需要非常手段。
en: Perhaps desperate times call for desperate measures.

zh: 巴西的计划效仿了1991年的阿根廷可兑换计划。 可兑换计划取消了所有货币管制，将阿根廷比索盯住美元。
en: Brazil’s move resembles Argentina’s convertibility plan of 1991, which abolished all currency controls and pegged the Argentine peso to the US dollar.

zh: 面对恶性通胀和市场信心消失殆尽的局面，阿根廷政府试图通过让货币政策进入“自动驾驶”模式来获得信誉。
en: Facing hyperinflation and a complete loss of market confidence, the government sought to buy credibility by placing monetary policy on automatic pilot.

zh: 阿根廷释放出的市场信号是“看，这样我就管不了货币政策了。
en: Argentina’s message to markets was, “look, we have no discretion over monetary policy.”

zh: ”类似地，巴西在告诉市场，它将收缩政府（只要经济在增长 ） 。
en: Similarly, Brazil is telling markets it will shrink the government (as long as the economy is growing).

zh: 两者的承诺都有法律甚至宪法背书。
en: In both cases, the promises are backed up by legal or even constitutional changes.

zh: 当信誉成为经济复苏的最大瓶颈时，这样的措施是有意义的 — — 只要它们对市场信心起到了预想的效果。
en: When credibility becomes the binding constraint on economic recovery, measures such as these may make sense – as long as they have the intended effect on market confidence.

zh: 事实上，巴西政府债券的长期利率自修正案通过后大幅下降了（尽管很难厘清这个规则的因果效应 ） ， 并且保持在远低于修正案前的水平，尽管在总统特梅尔被曝光授权非法拨款给身陷囹圄的议员后曾经一度短暂上升。
en: In fact, long-term interest rates on Brazilian government bonds have come down significantly since the amendment was passed (though it is hard to pinpoint the causal impact of the rule itself), and remain well below pre-amendment levels, despite the short-lived spike that followed the release of a recording of President Michel Temer allegedly authorizing illegal payments to a jailed congressman.

zh: 但正如阿根廷在随后几年中所发现的，约束性财政立法本身可能成为经济复苏的巨大障碍。
en: But as Argentina found out several years down the line, binding fiscal legislation can itself become a powerful constraint on economic recovery.

zh: 到20世纪90年代末，阿根廷的主要问题已是货币高估。
en: By the late 1990s, Argentina’s overwhelming problem had become an overvalued currency.

zh: 一届又一届政府因为害怕失去信誉而严守可兑换法，但这只能加剧阿根廷经济的竞争力危机。
en: Successive governments stuck with the convertibility law for fear of losing credibility, but aggravated the economy’s competitiveness crisis as a result.

zh: 最终，在街头暴动和政治骚乱中，阿根廷在2002年放弃了货币盯住。
en: Eventually, amid street riots and political mayhem, Argentina abandoned the currency peg in 2002.

zh: 从阿根廷的经验看，巴西的支出上限看上去也很有问题 — — 特别是考虑到可预见的未来政治动荡仍将持续的情况。
en: Viewed with Argentina’s experience in mind, Brazil’s spending cap looks problematic – all the more so against a backdrop of political turmoil that is set to continue for the foreseeable future.

zh: 而一旦巴西开始复苏（迟早总会的 ） ， 支出上限可能引起更大政治争议。
en: The cap will likely become even more politically controversial once Brazil recovers, as it will.

zh: 不难想象，下一任政府 — — 不管来自哪里 — — 将认定支出上限已是经济增长提速的障碍。
en: It is not hard to imagine the next administration – whenever it comes about – perceiving the cap as an obstacle to faster economic growth.

zh: 支出上限的捍卫者提出的理由将不再令人信服，因为其经济论据在信誉问题已不再极端的时候根本不堪一击。
en: The cap’s defenders will sound unconvincing, because the economic case for it is weak in the absence of extreme credibility problems.

zh: 事实上，支出上限将继续自我破坏，因为它成功地解决了信誉问题。
en: Indeed, the cap will undermine itself to the extent that it succeeds in addressing the credibility issue.

zh: 巴西可能沦为政策作为承诺机制的图腾价值（即使它早就已经失去了这一用途）的囚徒。
en: Brazil could become a prisoner of the policy’s totemic value as a commitment device, even as it outlives its usefulness as such.

zh: 投资者或阿根廷人不会忘记其中的讽刺之处：可以轻易地将支出上限写入宪法的国家，也可以同样轻易地将它移除。
en: The irony will not be lost on investors or Argentines: countries that can write a spending cap into the Constitution on short notice are also those where it could be just as easily removed.

zh: 民主国家有时会自缚双手或委托决策，这有很好的理由。
en: There are good reasons why democracies sometimes tie their hands or delegate decision-making.

zh: 比如，独立央行或财政委员会能帮助政府克服牺牲长期利益短期操纵经济的诱惑。
en: Independent central banks or fiscal commissions, for example, can help governments overcome the temptation of short-term manipulation of the economy at longer-term cost.

zh: 但巴西的支出上限看上去不像是可持续的解决方案。
en: But Brazil’s spending cap does not look like a sustainable solution.

zh: 它确实诞生于财政紧迫感，但其最大的风险是它最终煽动围绕这一上限本身的政治冲突，而不能促进关于必须做出的艰难的财政选择的深思熟虑。
en: While born of a real sense of fiscal urgency, the biggest risk is that it will eventually fuel political conflict around the ceiling itself, rather than foster deliberation about the difficult fiscal choices that must be made.

zh: IMF的巴西药方
en: IMF Therapy for Brazil

zh: 蒙德维的亚—巴西经济已经进入了重症监护阶段。
en: MONTEVIDEO – Brazil’s economy is in intensive care.

zh: 其严重的政治危机正在让人们深切忧虑谁能够为它提供急需的治疗。 目前，总统罗塞夫正面临弹劾程序，据称她使用了非法会计手段粉饰预算赤字规模。
en: And its intensifying political crisis – impeachment proceedings have now been initiated against President Dilma Rousseff for allegedly using irregular accounting maneuvers to disguise the size of the budget deficit – is raising serious questions about who can provide the much-needed treatment.

zh: 情况毫无疑问相当严重。
en: The situation is certainly serious.

zh: 产出正在收缩；财政收入日益下降；预算赤字已超过GDP的9 % 。
en: Output is contracting; fiscal revenues are faltering; and the budget deficit exceeds 9% of GDP.

zh: 通货膨胀超过了两位数，迫使央行提高利率 — — 由于深度衰退和迅速增长的债务维持成本的日益膨胀，这一政策不具备可持续性。
en: Inflation has surpassed the double-digit mark, forcing the central bank to raise interest rates – an approach that is unsustainable, given the deepening recession and the ballooning cost of servicing Brazil’s rapidly growing debt.

zh: 事实上，巴西的信誉正在快速恶化，其主权债务的利差正在向阿根廷靠拢。
en: Indeed, with Brazil’s creditworthiness deteriorating fast, interest-rate spreads on its sovereign debt are reaching Argentine levels.

zh: 其国际储备头寸为3,700亿美元，曾经貌似坚固无比，但现在看来不堪一击。
en: And its international reserve position of $370 billion, which once seemed unassailable, looks increasingly vulnerable.

zh: 当外汇互换名义值（1,150亿美元）用完时，可由国际储备覆盖的短期（对外和对内）公共债务的比重将低于100%的临界值。
en: When the notional value of foreign-exchange swaps ($115 billion) is netted out, the share of short-term public debt (foreign and domestic) covered by international reserves is below the critical threshold of 100%.

zh: 今年初，当罗塞夫正式开始其第二个总统任期时，她的政府的重点一目了然：实施可信的财政调整计划，使初级预算平衡（不含利息支付）稳稳地回归盈余并让公共债务增长率回到可持续水平。
en: At the beginning of the year, when Rousseff’s second presidential term officially began, her administration’s priorities were clear: implement a credible fiscal-adjustment program that would take the primary budget balance (which excludes interest payments) comfortably back into surplus and reduce the growth rate of public debt to sustainable levels.

zh: 罗塞夫很快就认命了一个正统财政派经济团队负责这些政策。
en: Rousseff soon appointed an economic team associated with fiscal orthodoxy to lead the effort.

zh: 但情况每况愈下，部分是因为中国经济减速、大宗商品繁荣结束、国际金融条件趋紧、全球增长萎靡和多年来的政策管理不善。
en: But the situation has only deteriorated, owing partly to China’s economic slowdown, the end of the commodity boom, tighter international financial conditions, weak global growth, and a years-long legacy of policy mismanagement.

zh: 但国内政治让糟糕的情况大大恶化了；事实上，今年经济复苏的最大障碍是国有石油巨头巴西石油（Petrobras）大规模腐败丑闻。
en: But domestic politics has made a bad situation much worse; indeed, the biggest obstacle to economic recovery this year came in the form of a massive corruption scandal at the state-owned oil giant Petrobras.

zh: 丑闻爆发于去年，但最近矛头和证据大量指向了传统政治党派高官和商界要人。
en: Although the scandal broke last year, allegations and evidence have more recently been mounting against senior officials of the traditional political parties, as well as prominent businessmen.

zh: 此外，与20世纪90年代意大利的“净手 ” （ mani pulite）调查类似，巴西石油丑闻扰乱了巴西政坛。
en: And, like Italy’s mani pulite (“clean hands”) investigations in the 1990s, the Petrobras scandal has thrown Brazilian politics into disarray.

zh: 首次有在任参议员因为腐败指控而被捕。
en: A sitting senator has, for the first time, been arrested on corruption charges.

zh: 针对罗塞夫的弹劾程序必然会让情况进一步复杂化。
en: Impeachment proceedings against Rousseff will only complicate the situation further.

zh: 如今，巴西陷入了一个恶性循环，或经济学家所谓的“坏均衡 ” 。
en: Brazil is now trapped in a vicious circle, or what economists call a “bad equilibrium.”

zh: 即使政府愿意也能够实施必要的财政调整，巴西石油事件所造成的政治震动也严重伤害了巴西的信誉。
en: Even if there were a government willing and able to carry out the necessary fiscal adjustment, the political fallout of the Petrobras affair has damaged Brazil’s credibility severely.

zh: 信誉需要很长时间才能恢复 — — 而时间正是巴西所不具备的奢侈品。
en: That credibility will take time to recover – and time is a luxury that Brazil does not have.

zh: 失去了市场信誉，利率和信用利差就将保持高企，掣肘财政调整政策，迫使巴西经济进入下降螺旋。
en: Without market credibility, interest rates and credit spreads will remain high and hijack the fiscal-adjustment effort, forcing the economy into a downward spiral.

zh: 此外，预算压力将让巴西央行日益难以提高短期利率以履行其遏制过度通胀的职责。
en: Moreover, budgetary pressures will make it increasingly difficult for the central bank to raise short-term interest rates to fulfill its mandate of curbing excess inflation.

zh: 简言之，巴西失去了可信的财政和货币锚。
en: In short, Brazil lacks a credible fiscal and monetary anchor.

zh: 如果巴西想要迅速重新赢回信誉，就需要来自国际社会的支持。
en: If Brazil is to regain its credibility swiftly, it will need the support of the international community.

zh: 巴西没有类似于欧洲央行的机构可以“不惜一切代价”在追求财政和结构调整的同时以合理利率重新获得信用。
en: Brazil doesn’t have the institutional equivalent of the European Central Bank to do “whatever it takes” to retain access to credit at reasonable interest rates as it pursues fiscal and structural adjustment.

zh: 巴西所具备的最接近于欧洲央行的是国际货币基金组织（IMF ） ， 它应该和IMF商谈调整计划。
en: The closest thing Brazil has is the International Monetary Fund, with which it should negotiate an adjustment program.

zh: 这一计划应该包括在中期将初级盈余增加到GDP的2—3 % ； 约束政府支出（税收负担已经畸高 ） ； 并取消让支出过于僵化的指数化规则。
en: Such a program would include increasing the primary surplus to 2-3% of GDP over the medium term; constraining government expenditures (the tax burden is already sky high); and eliminating indexing rules that make spending overly rigid.

zh: 此外，巴西必须让收入和支出脱钩 — — 巴西预算的这一特点让其难以在逆境时合理地进行管理。
en: Moreover, Brazil would have to delink revenues and expenditures – a feature of the country’s budget that renders it difficult to manage properly in times of distress.

zh: 此外，该计划还必须逐渐取消对BNDES（巴西开发银行）的财政补贴 — — 并更多地使用市场利率作为BNDES贷款的参考利率，从而协助重塑财政健康、去除金融中介的扭曲。
en: And it would gradually have to phase out treasury subsidies to BNDES – the country’s development bank – and increase the use of market-based references for BNDES’s lending rates, thereby helping to restore fiscal health and eliminate distortions in financial intermediation.

zh: 至于IMF，它应该批准巴西的调整计划，并随时提供自身资源，以使巴西在一段合理的时间内不必求助于国际资本市场。
en: For its part, the IMF would give the adjustment program its stamp of approval and make its own resources available, so that Brazil does not have to tap international capital markets for a reasonable period.

zh: 这将大大增加巴西的成功机会。
en: This would greatly enhance Brazil’s chances of success.

zh: 诚然，要求IMF帮助是一个很大的羞辱。
en: To be sure, calling in the IMF carries a considerable stigma.

zh: 但现实是，帮助境况类似于巴西的国家正是IMF这样的全球金融机构能够起到建设性作用的领域。 应该指出，今天的IMF比十年前更加灵活和开放。
en: But the reality is that helping countries in situations like Brazil’s is an area where global financial institutions like the IMF – which, it should be noted, is more flexible and open today than it was a decade ago – can play a constructive role.

zh: 此外，巴西已经没有了好选择 — — 更不用说容易的选择了。
en: More to the point, Brazil has run out of good – let alone easy – options.

zh: 除了IMF计划，唯一的其他办法是进入通胀螺旋以降低债务和其他名义负债的实际价值；或者进入会导致债务重组的经济衰退螺旋。
en: The only alternatives to an IMF program are an inflationary spiral to dilute the real value of debt and other nominal liabilities, or a downward economic spiral that may cause a need for debt restructuring.

zh: 无论如何，结果都将威胁到自1994年雷亚尔稳定计划实施以来所取得的改革和社会成果。
en: Either outcome would threaten the reforms and social gains that the country has made since the Plano Real stabilization program was launched in 1994.

zh: 因此，尽管可能导致政治困境和社会反弹，但巴西别无选择，只能追求IMF支持的调整计划。
en: Given this, and despite the potential political difficulties and the risk of a social backlash, Brazil has little choice but to pursue an IMF-sponsored adjustment program.

zh: 这也许是一个苦涩的选择，但只有IMF才能提供巴西所需要的医药。
en: It may taste bitter, but only the IMF can provide the medicine Brazil needs.

zh: 巴西的出路
en: Brazil’s Way Out

zh: 华盛顿—被弹劾的巴西总统罗塞夫已经下台，清理巴西宏观经济乱局的担子落在了新掌权的总统特梅尔政府肩上。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Now that impeached Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff is out of office, it is up to the newly empowered administration of President Michel Temer to clean up Brazil’s macroeconomic mess.

zh: 特梅尔政府能够拯救步履维艰的巴西经济吗？
en: Can Temer’s government save Brazil’s crumbling economy?

zh: 情况不可不谓惨淡。
en: The situation is certainly dire.

zh: 事实上，巴西最近正在经历近年来最强力的经济收缩。
en: In fact, Brazil has lately been experiencing the most powerful economic contraction in its recent history.

zh: 人均GDP比2013年下降了10%以上。
en: Its per capita GDP will be more than 10% smaller this year than it was in 2013.

zh: 失业飙升到11%以上，比2015年1月高了四个百分点。
en: And unemployment has soared to more than 11%, up four percentage points from January 2015.

zh: 巴西复苏之路漫漫，原因很简单：当前的乱局源头是近年来其长期存在的经济弱点不断恶化 — — 特别是财政挥霍和生产率增长低迷。
en: Brazil has no easy route to recovery for a simple reason: the current rout derives from the intensification in recent years of long-standing economic vulnerabilities – in particular, fiscal profligacy and anemic productivity growth.

zh: 以财政状况为例。 巴西财政自2011年以来迅速恶化，从占GDP的3.1%的盈余变为占GDP的2.7%的赤字，总预算赤字更是接近GDP的10 % 。
en: Consider Brazil’s fiscal position, which has deteriorated rapidly since 2011, with a 3.1%-of-GDP primary surplus giving way to a deficit of more than 2.7% of GDP, leading to an overall budget deficit of close to 10% of GDP.

zh: 事实上，恶化的根源很久以前就已经种下。
en: In fact, the groundwork for that deterioration was laid a long time ago.

zh: 巴西初级政府支出占GDP之比从1991年的22%增加到2014年的36 % 。
en: Brazil’s primary government expenditures as a proportion of GDP rose from 22% in 1991 to 36% in 2014.

zh: 这笔支出中有很大一部分用于治理贫穷 — — 其中包括世界最大规模的有条件现金转移项目等 — — 同时巴西境况较好的公民的特权并没有被削弱。
en: Much of that spending can be explained by a commitment to tackling endemic poverty – an effort that included the world’s largest conditional cash-transfer program, among other things – without reducing the privileges enjoyed by Brazil’s better-off citizens.

zh: 有一段时间，巴西政府能够通过税收收入为支出增加筹集资金，税收收入因为消费的增加和劳动力市场正规化而增加。
en: For some time, Brazil’s government was able to fund higher expenditure with tax revenues, which also rose as a result of levies on rising consumption and labor-market formalization.

zh: 而高企的全球大宗商品价格帮助巴西GDP增长率在2003—2010年期间保持在每年4.5%的水平，这也提振了政府收入。
en: And high global commodity prices helped sustain GDP growth of around 4.5% per year from 2003 to 2010, which also bolstered government revenues.

zh: 但是，正规的劳动力市场当然不可能永远扩张，大宗商品也终有下跌的一天。
en: But, of course, the formal labor force cannot expand forever, and commodity prices always fall eventually.

zh: 不幸的是，巴西没有利用高景气时期实现生产率增长。
en: Unfortunately, Brazil failed to take advantage of the good times to reap productivity growth.

zh: 事实上，2002—2014年间巴西GDP增长中只有10%可归因于全要素生产率改善，而三分之二是教育程度比以往略高的工人进入劳动力市场带来的结果。
en: Indeed, only 10% of Brazil’s GDP growth in 2002-2014 can be attributed to total factor productivity gains, while two-thirds was the result of an increase in slightly better-educated workers entering the labor force.

zh: 因此，当巴西税收收入刺激因素最终消失时，增加公共支出的法定义务迅速让巴西走向了财政悬崖。
en: So when Brazil’s tax-revenue boosters finally collapsed, legally mandated increases in public spending drove Brazil rapidly toward a fiscal cliff.

zh: 如今，反周期政策不再是选项之一；根本没有足够的财政或货币空间。
en: Today, counter-cyclical policies are not an option; there simply isn’t enough fiscal or monetary space.

zh: 这让巴西政府只剩下一个重塑企业信心和复兴经济增长的真正选项：治理巴西的结构性弱点。
en: This leaves Brazil’s government with only one real option for restoring business confidence and reviving economic growth: tackling Brazil’s structural weaknesses.

zh: 好消息是特梅尔政府似乎认识到这一当务之急。
en: The good news is that Temer’s government seems to recognize this imperative.

zh: 目前，政府已经建议巴西国会修订宪法禁止名义公共支出（包括次国家级公共支出）在未来20年中出现超过前一年通货膨胀率的增长。
en: Already, it has proposed to Brazil’s Congress a constitutional amendment forbidding for the next 20 years nominal annual increases in public expenditures, including at the subnational level, that exceed the previous year’s inflation rate.

zh: 假设通货膨胀稳定在某个较低水平，那么，只要经济再次开始增长，这一上限就能立刻让公共支出占GDP之比开始下降。
en: Provided that inflation stabilizes at some lower level, such a cap would cause public expenditure as a share of GDP to decline as soon as the economy began to grow again.

zh: 如果税收收入跟着GDP增长一起增加，财政失衡和公共债务的积累问题将自动得到解决。
en: If increases in tax revenues accompany GDP growth, fiscal imbalances and the accumulation of public debt would automatically be addressed.

zh: 在巴西预算已没有灵活余地的时候，这一规则可以起到财政局面改变因素的作用。
en: At a time when Brazil has little flexibility in its budget, such a rule could turn out to be a fiscal game changer.

zh: 当然，支出增长上限本身无法消除解决现有的预算僵化问题的需要。
en: Of course, a cap on expenditure growth would not by itself eliminate the need to address existing budget rigidities.

zh: 特梅尔政府已宣布准备以此为由向国会提交养老金改革计划。
en: Temer’s government has declared its intention to present to Congress a pension reform plan for precisely this reason.

zh: 至于生产率问题，政府的重点是减少近几十年来基础设施建设不足所造成的浪费。
en: As for productivity, the government is focused on reducing waste caused by insufficient infrastructure construction in recent decades.

zh: 扩大基础设施投资还能刺激其他部门的私人投资。
en: Scaling up infrastructure investment also promises to spur private investment in other sectors.

zh: 关键是理顺基础设施服务的诸多细分的私人和公共部门责任分工 — — 包括独立的监管机构。
en: The key will be to fine-tune the division of responsibilities between the private and public sectors – including independent regulatory agencies – in the various segments of infrastructure services.

zh: 特梅尔政府还希望增加人力资本投资，以此作为生产率增长的源泉。
en: Temer’s government also hopes to tap investment in human capital as a source of productivity growth.

zh: 目前，巴西私营企业的人事培训投资要低于人均收入相当的其他国家，主要原因在于税收和劳动法激励不足 — — 特梅尔政府准备改变这些激励。
en: As it stands, private companies in Brazil invest less in personnel training than those in other countries with similar per capita incomes, owing largely to disincentives embedded in tax and labor laws – incentives that Temer’s government has proposed to change.

zh: 为了让这些措施影响最大化，特梅尔政府还应该关注与营商环境有关的问题所造成的私人部门的浪费。
en: To maximize the impact of these efforts, Temer’s government should also focus on reducing waste in the private sector caused by other problems with the business environment.

zh: 人力和物质资源的使用效率越高，企业的竞争力就越好，巴西全要素生成率也能得到提振，特别是在巴西人力资本得到增强的情况下。
en: The more efficient use of human and material resources would make firms more competitive and boost Brazil’s total-factor productivity, especially if Brazil’s human capital were enhanced.

zh: 除此之外还要采取便利对外贸易的措施，巴西的企业家“动物精神”也要得到释放，以使巴西摆脱当前危机，走向更加繁荣的未来。
en: Add to that efforts to facilitate foreign trade, and Brazil’s “animal spirits” of entrepreneurship could be unleashed, enabling Brazil to escape the current crisis and move toward a more prosperous future.

zh: 本文仅代表作者本人观点，不代表世界银行或其供职的政府的立场。
en: The views expressed here are the author’s own and do not necessarily reflect those of the World Bank or any of the governments he represents.

zh: 如何修复巴西经济
en: How to Fix Brazil’s Economy

zh: 圣保罗—巴西即将举行其三十年前军事统治结束以来影响最大的选举。
en: SÃO PAULO – Brazil is approaching its most consequential election since the end of military rule more than three decades ago.

zh: 尽管巴西政治饱受失能影响，但选拒结果仍将取决于未来政府的经济改革日程。
en: But while the country’s politics are plagued by dysfunction, the election’s outcome will hinge on the next government’s economic reform agenda.

zh: 巴西最严峻的经济挑战之一是生产率增长萎靡，这阻碍了巴西的增长潜力。
en: One of Brazil’s most serious economic challenges is anemic productivity growth, which has been undermining the country’s growth potential.

zh: 自20世纪90年代中期以来，每员工产出平均每年只能增加0.7 % ， 过去二十年人均收入增长的一大半要归因于经济活跃人口比例的上升。
en: With output per employee increasing by just 0.7% per year, on average, since the mid-1990s, more than half of per capita income growth over the last two decades has resulted from an increase in the share of the economically active population.

zh: 但随着人口迅速老化，这一收入增长引擎很快就会熄火。
en: But that engine of income growth will soon stall, owing to rapid population aging.

zh: 生产率增长萎靡部分是因为贸易开放度不足，这制约了巴西企业获得国外投入品和技术，也阻碍了有效的国内竞争。
en: Weak productivity growth partly reflects a lack of trade openness, which limits Brazilian firms’ access to foreign inputs and technologies, as well as barriers to effective domestic competition.

zh: 此外，拙劣的物流基础设施、彼此不同的州税制，以及特殊企业的补贴让效率低下的公司能够存活下来并占据资源，拉低了平均生产率。
en: Moreover, weak logistics infrastructure, differentiated state tax regimes, and subsidies to specific firms enable less efficient companies to survive and retain resources, lowering average productivity.

zh: 为了解决这一问题，决策者必须通过强化先进技术的采用和扩散来支持私人部门，而不是为高企的内部成本提供补偿。
en: To address this, policymakers must support the private sector by strengthening the adoption and diffusion of advanced technologies, rather than by offering compensation for high internal costs.

zh: 此外，营商环境要更加有利于企业家，这可以通过改革复杂又不平衡的税收系统实现。
en: Moreover, the business environment should be made more favorable for entrepreneurs, including through reform of the complex and imbalanced tax system.

zh: 同时也需要提高基础设施投资，以及金融中介改革，从而让融资条件与投资项目更加匹配。
en: Increased infrastructure investment is also needed, as is reform of financial intermediation, so that financing terms are better aligned with investment projects.

zh: 此外，提高公共资源的灵活性以及各州、市之间更多的经验分享有利于提高教育质量以及人力资本的形成。 一些州和市的成功经验可以应用到其他地区。
en: And the quality of education and the formation of human capital could benefit from less rigid allocation of public resources and more experience-sharing among states and municipalities, some of which have made progress using measures that could be applied elsewhere.

zh: 巴西还需要重大财政调整。
en: Brazil also needs significant fiscal adjustment.

zh: 即使生产率和经济增长潜力增长缓慢，真实（经通胀调整的）公共支出仍然迅速膨胀。
en: Even as productivity and economic-growth potential have increased at a snail’s pace, real (inflation-adjusted) public spending has risen sharply.

zh: 公共支出占GDP之比从20世纪80年代的不到30%增加到了2017年的40%左右，其中2006—2017年增加了68 % 。
en: Public expenditure increased from less than 30% of GDP in the 1980s to about 40% in 2017, including 68% growth from 2006 to 2017.

zh: 但公共投资（包括基础设施投资）有所下降，去年还不到GDP的0.7 % 。
en: And yet public investment (including in infrastructure) has declined, amounting to less than 0.7% of GDP last year.

zh: 2015—2016年间GDP的萎缩以及随后的宏观经济复苏乏力影响了税收收入，初级预算平衡（相对GDP水平）恶化了超过四个百分点。
en: With tax revenues affected by the decline in GDP in 2015-2016 and the subsequent fragile macroeconomic recovery, the primary budget balance, relative to GDP, deteriorated by more than four percentage points.

zh: 这导致公共债务从2012年占GDP的54%增加到2017年的74 % 。
en: This caused public debt to rise from 54% of GDP in 2012 to 74% in 2017.

zh: 为了解决高企的债务，2016年巴西批准了宪法修正案，为未来20年公共支出设定了上限。
en: To address skyrocketing debt, in 2016, Brazil approved a constitutional amendment imposing a ceiling on public spending for the next 20 years.

zh: 如果当局成功遵守这一规则 — — 或者将减支与税收收入相结合，以实现公共部门初级平衡每年改善0.6%的GDP — — 那么公共债务趋势将在十年内再次变得可持续。
en: If the authorities manage to adhere to this rule – or combine spending cuts with tax revenues to obtain an improvement of 0.6% of GDP per year in the public-sector primary balance – the trajectory of public debt could become sustainable again within a decade.

zh: 当然，成功的关键在于明智的减支。
en: The key to success, of course, will be smart spending cuts.

zh: 我担任执行董事的世界银行已经列出了可以减支的领域：社会保障、公职人员，以及补贴和免税。
en: The World Bank, where I am an executive director, has already identified areas where such cuts can be made: social security, public-sector payrolls, and subsidies and tax exemptions.

zh: 通过放松公共预算约束，这些领域的减支甚至能够为其他生产率更高的公共支出创造空间。
en: By easing the strain on the public budget, spending cuts in these areas could even create space for other, more productive types of public expenditure.

zh: 关键是，这些减支几乎不会对巴西穷人造成影响。
en: Crucially, such cuts would have only minimal consequences for poorer Brazilians.

zh: 事实上，就税收改革而言，有办法既改善营商环境，又有助于降低缠绕当前制度挥之不去的社会不平等性。
en: In fact, when it comes to tax reform, there are steps that could not only contribute to improving the business environment, but also help to reduce the social inequities embedded in the current system.

zh: 在寻求改善生产率、实现财政再平衡的过程中，巴西领导人还必须改革公共部门治理。
en: In the quest to improve productivity and achieve fiscal rebalancing, Brazil’s leaders must also reform public-sector governance.

zh: 目前，各领域的公共服务的供给 — — 包括卫生、教育、暴力、基础设施、交通和物流以及水资源管理 — — 都非常低效。
en: As it stands, the provision of public services in a wide range of areas – including health, education, violence, infrastructure, transportation and logistics, and the management of water resources – is highly inefficient.

zh: 原因不一而足。
en: The reasons are wide-ranging.

zh: 巴西受制于令预算僵化的过多的规则；服务供给的碎片化；拙劣的项目和政策规划、监控和评估；缺少积极的公职人员表现激励；政策制定的司法化；以及官僚体系对风险的日益厌恶。
en: Brazil suffers from an excess of rules, which contribute to budget rigidity; fragmentation of service delivery; poor planning, monitoring, and evaluation of projects and policies; a lack of positive performance incentives for public-sector workers; the judicialization of policymaking; and an increasingly risk-averse bureaucracy.

zh: 因此，巴西需要改善从计划和项目的规划到执行的政策一致性，更注重于监控和评估结果。
en: Brazil thus needs to improve policy consistency, from planning through execution of programs and projects, and focus more on monitoring and evaluating results.

zh: 改善公共和私人部门之间的协作也有利于改善公共支出能够更好地改善社会经济结果。
en: Better coordination between the public and private sectors would also improve the capacity of public expenditure to contribute more to improving socioeconomic outcomes.

zh: 巴西的未来取决于是否能够实施明智、渐进、一致的经济改革，促进生产率增长，让国家走向财政可持续。
en: Brazil’s future hinges on the implementation of smart, gradual, and coherent economic reforms that facilitate productivity growth and put the country on the path toward fiscal sustainability.

zh: 不论谁赢得即将到来的选举，都有责任解决这一紧迫问题。
en: Whoever wins the upcoming election has a responsibility to address that imperative.

zh: 产业政策之巴西经验
en: Brazilian Lessons for Industrial Policy

zh: 圣保罗 — — 没有多少经济理念像产业政策那样备受赞美和斥责。
en: SAO PAULO – Few economic ideas are more lauded and reviled than that of industrial policy.

zh: 研究东亚经济崛起的支持者们对其推崇备至。
en: Proponents, such as those who studied the rise of the East Asian economies, swear by it.

zh: 而反对者则是乍闻其名就勃然大怒。
en: Opponents see red at its very mention.

zh: 前者直指行业政策带来经济发展，而后者则坚持行业政策浪费了成百上千亿美元。
en: The former point to economic development; the latter maintain that tens, even hundreds, of billions of dollars have been squandered.

zh: 可再生燃料是（不）满意的最新演示场。
en: One recent theatre of (dis)content is that of renewable fuels.

zh: 在全球范围内，用于推动洁净能源发展的公共刺激计划投资高达1840亿美元，其中美国居于首位（670亿美元 ） ， 中国紧随其后（470亿美元 ） 。
en: Worldwide, $184 billion is being allocated in public stimulus investments to promote clean energy, led by the United States ($67 billion) and China ($47 billion).

zh: 毋庸置疑，洁净能源领域也取得了一些进展 — — 比如风能满足了丹麦20%的能源需求，在西班牙和葡萄牙总能耗中的占比也达到了15 % — —尽管如此，取得成功的秘诀仍然难以捉摸。
en: Of course, there is some progress – wind power meets 20% of the electricity demand in Denmark and about 15% in Spain and Portugal, for example – but the recipe for success remains elusive.

zh: 在这样的背景下，巴西20世纪70年代开始的推动可再生燃料发展的经验直接关系到今天对行业政策截然相反的观点。
en: In this vein, Brazil’s experience at promoting renewable fuels, beginning in the 1970’s, is directly relevant to today’s polarized views of industrial policy.

zh: 一项名为“Pro-álcool ”的十年期行业政策计划在可再生能源的发展中起到了关键的作用。
en: A 10-year industrial policy program called Pro-álcool was crucial in the development of the industry.

zh: 今天，巴西已经成为全球以生物乙醇为基础的可再生燃料最具竞争力的生产国。
en: Today, Brazil is the world’s most competitive producer of renewable fuels, based primarily on bioethanol.

zh: 乙醇占到了巴西国内轻型车燃料需求的50%以上，巴西能源巨头、拉美最大的企业之一巴西国家石油公司预测这一比例到2020年会增长到80%以上。
en: Ethanol accounts for more than 50% of current light-vehicle fuel demand in the country, and Petrobras – Brazil’s energy giant and one of the largest companies in Latin America – expects this share to increase to more than 80% by 2020.

zh: 我们的研究结果表明行业政策成功地推动了巴西颇具竞争力的生物乙醇行业。
en: Our research shows that industrial policy was successful in promoting a competitive bioethanol industry in Brazil.

zh: 一项由20世纪70年代油价上涨引发的巨额刺激计划催生了一个全新的行业。
en: A massive stimulus package, prompted by the 1970’s rise in oil prices, gave rise to an entirely new industry.

zh: 但如果没有竞争所发挥的关键作用，这个行业也不会取得成功。
en: But it would not have worked without the crucial role played by competition.

zh: 巴西当时力求实现能源自给自足的方式与其它国家现在的所为颇为相似。
en: Brazil was attempting to become energy self-sufficient in a manner similar to modern efforts by other countries.

zh: 但正像行业政策的反对者提醒我们的那样，免费的东西永远不会带来好结果。
en: But, as opponents of industrial policy are right to remind us, freebies never lead to a good outcome.

zh: 这一次，经济停滞所造成的后果扮演了至关重要的角色。
en: The aftermath was the key.

zh: 随着世界能源价格的崩溃，巴西在这一偶然因素的作用下关闭了补贴的龙头，一场残酷的达尔文式的生存混战随之发生。
en: As world energy prices collapsed, Brazil fortuitously turned off its subsidy tap, whereupon a brutal Darwinian free-for-all ensued.

zh: 这种竞争合理化在政策成功中发挥了关键的作用。
en: This competitive rationalization was the key to the policy’s success.

zh: Pro-álcool 计划的相关规定刺激各方进入到新兴行业，如果没有刺激计划他们可能会选择置身事外。
en: The details of Pro-álcool involved providing incentives to several parties to participate, without which they would have sat on the sidelines.

zh: 巴西政府为建设蒸馏企业提供低息贷款和信用担保，同时为购买乙醇燃料汽车提供了税收优惠。
en: The Brazilian state offered low-interest loans and credit guarantees for the construction of distilleries, as well as tax incentives for the purchase of ethanol-powered vehicles.

zh: 乙醇的价格受到人为干预，使其与汽油相比成为一项有吸引力的选择。
en: Ethanol prices were manipulated to make it an attractive alternative to gasoline.

zh: 此外，政府还诱导巴西国家石油公司参与可再生燃料的销售。
en: In addition, the government induced Petrobras to distribute the renewable fuel.

zh: 加油站都装备了乙醇燃料泵。
en: Gas stations installed ethanol pumps.

zh: 政府与主要汽车企业签订协议，鼓励生产100%乙醇燃料汽车。
en: The government signed agreements with the major automobile companies to provide incentives to make vehicles that could run on 100% ethanol.

zh: 到访巴西的游客今天能够随时看到混合燃料动力车。
en: A visitor to Brazil today will see these flex-fuel cars everywhere.

zh: 加满汽车燃料箱是一种新奇的体验。
en: The experience of filling these vehicles’ tanks is curious.

zh: 驶入加油站前，巴西的驾车族会计算传统汽油和乙醇燃料哪个更便宜（生物乙醇比传统汽油的能源含量低30%左右 ） ， 然后在汽油和乙醇泵之间作出选择。
en: Just before entering a gas station, Brazilian drivers calculate whether conventional gasoline or ethanol is cheaper (bioethanol has 30% less energy content than traditional gasoline), then choose between a gasoline and an ethanol pump.

zh: 刚一开始，巴西的政策就吸引了各式各样的创业者。
en: At the outset, Brazil’s policies attracted entrepreneurs of all sorts.

zh: 其中有些人颇具才干，相信新的补贴和奖励使针对这个行业的长期投资颇具吸引力。
en: Some were talented and believed that the new subsidies and incentives rendered long-term investments in the industry highly attractive.

zh: 多亏了国家的慷慨计划，素质可疑的创业者们当然也大量涌入。
en: Entrepreneurs of dubious quality no doubt entered as well, thanks to the generosity of the state.

zh: 幸运的是，政府并没有试图完成分辨成功者和失败者这个不可能完成的任务。
en: Fortunately, the government did not attempt the impossible task of trying to separate winners from losers.

zh: 到20世纪90年代，政府取消了主要的补贴和政策，解除了行业管制。
en: By the 1990’s, the major subsidies and policies were abolished, and the industry was deregulated.

zh: 我们掌握的巴西乙醇业进入及退出模式的分析统计结果表明，低效企业被高效企业所兼并。
en: Our statistical analysis of the entry and exit patterns of entrepreneurs in the Brazilian ethanol industry shows that the more efficient acquired the less efficient.

zh: 多数业绩不佳的乙醇企业宣告破产，被拥有高效经营成功经验的企业所兼并。
en: Most underperforming ethanol companies went bankrupt or were taken over by entrepreneurs who had successful track records in running efficient operations.

zh: 政府并没有挽救表现不佳的企业，而是任由市场力量在后补贴阶段对行业进行重组。
en: The government did not bail out the underperformers, allowing market forces to restructure the industry during the post-subsidy phase.

zh: 当然，Pro-álcool补贴的受益者们游说政府在行业政策已经丧失了促进行业发展的作用之后继续实行保护性的政策。
en: Certainly, the beneficiaries of Pro-álcool’s subsidies lobbied the state to continue the protective policies even after their usefulness – inducing the development of the industry – had expired.

zh: 幸运的是，政府并没有为之所动。
en: Fortunately, the government was not persuaded.

zh: 巴西的发展历程可��总结出国家推行可再生能源计划的三条重要经验 ： （ 1）政府政策必须连贯、简单、有持续性，能够为潜在创业者提供长期投资的信心保证 ； （ 2）人为挑选获胜者是过度热情的官僚们常犯的错误，这种情况必须被控制在最低限度 ； （ 3）政府必须在补贴已经失效的情况下坚决地将其取消。
en: Brazil’s experience offers three important lessons for nations implementing renewable energy initiatives: (1) government policies must be consistent, simple, and long-lasting, providing assurance to would-be entrepreneurs that they can invest for the long haul; (2) picking winners, the familiar weakness of overenthusiastic bureaucrats, must be kept to a minimum; and (3) the state must have the discipline to dismantle subsidies when the need for them has passed.

zh: 如果汲取这些经验，市场力量就能在行业政策退出后继续发挥作用。
en: If these lessons are implemented, market forces can pick up where industrial policy leaves off.

zh: 随着行业政策在世界各国的复苏，相信无论它的拥护者还是反对者都乐于接受这样的目标。
en: As industrial policy returns to the scene in countries around the world, that is a goal that advocates and opponents alike should be happy to embrace.

zh: 巴西、伊朗和通往安理会之路
en: Brazil, Iran, and the Road to the Security Council

zh: 圣保罗 — — 巴西政府参与关于伊朗核问题国际谈判的强烈意愿可以被称为“联合国安理会常任理事国候选手册 ” 。
en: SAO PAULO – The attempt by Brazil’s government to participate in the international negotiations over Iran’s nuclear program could well be called “A Manual for Candidates to a Permanent Membership of the United Nations Security Council.”

zh: 国际社会怀疑伊朗为军事目的研发核能，而巴西在伊朗问题上的外交努力始于巴拉克·奥巴马总统和巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦的一次会面，这次会面的地点是意大利拉奎拉召开的“八加五国”峰会。
en: Brazil’s diplomatic efforts with Iran – a country suspected of developing nuclear energy for military purposes – began at a meeting last year between President Barack Obama and Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva during the G8+5 summit in L’Aquila, Italy.

zh: 按照奥巴马新闻发言人罗伯特·吉布斯和巴西政府的说法，奥巴马表示不反对卢拉对话伊朗总统马哈茂德·艾哈迈迪内贾德。
en: According to Robert Gibbs, Obama’s press spokesman, and Brazilian authorities, Obama said he had no objections whatsoever to Lula talking to Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad.

zh: 但奥巴马建议卢拉利用两国之间的商务关系告诉伊朗领导人，要求他效仿巴西的范例（禁止将核能用于军事目的的禁令已经载入巴西宪法 ） 。
en: But Obama suggested using the weight of commercial relations between the two countries to tell the Iranian leader that he should follow Brazil’s example (in Brazil, the ban on nuclear energy for military purposes is enshrined in the Constitution).

zh: 卢拉和艾哈迈迪内贾德上次会面是在2009年6月，当时奥巴马对这位阿亚图拉仍然持友好态度。
en: Lula and Ahmadinejad met in June 2009, when Obama was still holding out a hand to the ayatollahs.

zh: 卢拉在巴西利亚接待艾哈迈德内贾德时听从了奥巴马的建议。
en: Lula acted according to Obama’s suggestion when he received Ahmadinejad in Brasilia.

zh: 他首先像所有人一样承认“伊朗有权发展核计划用于和平目的 ， ” 但随后立即要求艾哈迈德内贾德“尊重国际协定 ” ， 并强调“这也是巴西选择的道路。 ”
en: He acknowledged – as everyone does – “Iran’s right to pursue a nuclear program with peaceful intentions,” but immediately asked for “respect for the international agreements” and underlined the fact that “this is the road Brazil is following.”

zh: 此外，他还敦促艾哈迈德内贾德“继续与力求公正和平地解决伊朗核问题的国家保持接触。 ”
en: Furthermore, he urged Ahmadinejad “to continue to engage countries interested in finding a fair and balanced solution to Iran’s nuclear question.”

zh: “接触”是整个事件的关键词。
en: “Engagement” is the key word in this affair.

zh: 人们用它来形容奥巴马的美国新政，特别是与伊朗关系，至少在去年夏天伊朗备受争议的大选和随之而来的国内危机恶化之前“接触”是主基调。
en: It was used to describe Obama’s new American diplomacy, particularly with regard to Iran, at least until the disputed elections in Iran last summer and the worsening domestic crisis that has ensued.

zh: 卢拉与艾哈迈德内贾德的会面涉及了后者反复否认大屠杀史实的敏感问题。
en: In Lula’s meeting with Ahmadinejad, the delicate subject of Ahmadinejad’s repeated denials of the Holocaust came up.

zh: 卢拉告诉他的伊朗伙伴否认大屠杀是错误的作法，即便对伊朗自身而言也同样如此。
en: Lula told his Iranian counterpart that to deny the Holocaust was bad, even for Iran itself.

zh: 艾哈迈德内贾德回答他并没有否认大屠杀，只是批评以色列在“政治上利用”这个问题。
en: Ahmadinejad replied that he did not deny it, but only criticized what he considered Israel’s “political use” of it.

zh: 即便如此，卢拉也坚持他应该改变态度。
en: Even so, Lula insisted that he should change his attitude.

zh: ”一位巴西高级外交官这样询问，目的是证明受到巴西犹太居民强烈批评的那次对话有其自身的价值。 巴西犹太裔居民断然反对卢拉预定5月出访德黑兰的计划。
en: “Who else is in a position to say such things to Iran’s president?” asked a top Brazilian diplomat by way of justifying a dialogue that has been sharply criticized by Brazil’s Jewish community, which is emphatically opposed to Lula’s proposed trip to Teheran, scheduled for May.

zh: 自从艾哈迈德内贾德去年访问巴西以后，伊朗与就核问题展开谈判的国家间的关系就发生了恶化。 在艾哈迈德内贾德颇受争议地再次当选之后，这种恶化就发生了。
en: Relations between Iran and the countries that are negotiating the nuclear question have deteriorated since Ahmadinejad’s visit to Brazil last year, which came soon after his disputed re-election.

zh: 结果是法国总统尼古拉·萨科奇和卢拉、以及卢拉和德国总理安格拉·默克尔之间在伊朗问题上的公开分歧。
en: One result is the open difference of opinion on Iran between French President Nicolas Sarkozy and Lula, or between Lula and German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

zh: 去年12月与默克尔的柏林会晤中，卢拉坚持巴西政府的传统立场：即像美国拼命鼓吹的那种制裁不会有任何结果，取得进展的最佳方式是展开对话。
en: During his meeting in Berlin with Merkel last December, Lula insisted on the Brazilian government’s traditional position: sanctions, such as those that the United States strongly advocates, lead to nothing; the best way forward is dialogue.

zh: 巴西总统要求“更耐心”地与伊朗进行对话。
en: The Brazilian president asked for “more patience” in the talks with Iran.

zh: 德国总理回答在“四年毫无进展的谈判之后 ” ， 她对伊朗领导人已经“失去了耐心 ” 。
en: The German chancellor replied that she was “losing” her patience” with Iranian leaders after “four years of negotiations in which no progress was made.”

zh: 但巴西坚持要走对话的道路，并开始和伊朗问题上的其他利益相关方进行谈判。 土耳其就是其中之一，其外交部长艾哈迈德·达武特奥卢不久前也表达了相似的立场。
en: But Brazil insisted on the path of dialogue and began talking with other stakeholders in the Iranian question, such as Turkey, whose foreign minister, Ahmet Davutoglu, recently staked out a similar position.

zh: 达武特奥卢在一次对德黑兰的访问之后说 ， “ 我们希望中东能够实现繁荣稳定，让政治对话和外交手段占据主流。
en: “We want the Middle East to be prosperous and stable, governed by political dialogue and diplomacy,” Davutoglu said after a visit to Teheran.

zh: ” “ 要想实现这一目标，伊朗的努力会起到��关重要的作用。 ”
en: “Iran’s contribution will be very important in bringing this about.”

zh: 尽管声音还十分微弱，但巴西政府也已开始批评伊朗在人权领域的所作所为最初，卢拉尽可能淡化艾哈迈德内贾德再次当选后所爆发事件的严重性，甚至把那次事件比作球迷之间的冲突。
en: But Brazil’s government has also begun to criticize, albeit weakly, Iran’s performance on human rights. At first, Lula minimized the seriousness of the incidents that occurred after Ahmadinejad’s re-election and went so far as to compare them to a dispute between football fanatics.

zh: 这一比喻导致卢拉访问巴黎时与萨科奇发生争执，当时伊朗大选之后的危机才刚刚开始。
en: This led to a clash with Sarkozy when Lula visited Paris soon after Iran’s post-election crisis began.

zh: 尽管卢拉没有再重复他有关球赛的比喻，但他也没有像萨科奇那样强烈指责伊朗对人权的压迫。
en: While Lula didn’t repeat his comparison with a football game, neither did he criticize the repression, unlike Sarkozy, who did so strongly.

zh: 巴西目前对伊朗提出批评并要求与反对派进行对话，虽然声音十分微弱，但却显示巴西已经改变了立场，它反应了巴西外交的绝对重心：争取成为安理会常任理事国。
en: Brazil’s current criticisms of Iran, along with a request for dialogue with the opposition, weak as they may be, represent a change of position, which reflects the absolute priority of Brazilian diplomacy: permanent membership of the Security Council.

zh: 巴西官员知道只有这样做才能实现自己的目标 — — 但不能太过偏离目前常任理事国所认定的立场。
en: Brazilian officials know that they can achieve this goal only by acting independently – but without diverging too far from the positions of the current permanent members.

zh: 他们也知道除中国之外，其他常任理事国都对伊朗持批评态度，并决意在“失去耐心”的情况下找到核问题的解决方法，无论通过对话还是其他某些手段，就像默克尔所提出的那样。
en: They also know that, except for China, all of them are critics of Iran, and are determined to find a solution to the nuclear question, whether through dialogue or some other means, if “patience is lost,” as Merkel suggested.

zh: 巴西的制度摇摆
en: Brazil’s Institutional Limbo

zh: 圣保罗—国际投资者正在密切关注将于10月26日举行的巴西总统选举第二轮投票。
en: SÃO PAULO – International investors are watching closely as Brazilians prepare to vote in the second round of the presidential election on October 26.

zh: 巴西人的选票不但将决定下一任总统；也许还将决定巴西中央银行的未来，从而也将决定巴西宏观经济的轨迹。
en: Their vote will not only decide who will be the country’s next president; it may also determine the future of the Central Bank of Brazil (BCB), and therefore the country’s macroeconomic trajectory.

zh: 现任总统罗塞夫支持巴西央行当前的制度框架，但反对货币政策受政治干预、最好的解决办法是授予巴西央行更大自主权的主张。
en: While the incumbent president, Dilma Rousseff, supports the BCB’s existing institutional framework, her opponents contend that monetary policy is plagued by political interference, which would best be addressed by giving the BCB greater autonomy.

zh: 但两名候选人都没有提出减少政治干预程度、同时又确保更大的可问责性和促进金融稳定的改革方案。
en: But no candidate has yet advanced a proposal for reform that would reduce the scope for political interference while ensuring greater accountability and promoting financial stability.

zh: 如果巴西想要保持强劲稳定的经济增长，其中央银行就必须进行大修。
en: If Brazil is to sustain strong and stable economic growth, the central bank will need an overhaul.

zh: 在巴西政坛，货币政策长期扮演着重要角色。
en: Monetary policy has long played an important role in Brazilian politics.

zh: 20世纪八九十年代民主化过程中，历任政府试图驯服恶性通胀（1993年曾达到2,477 % ） 。
en: During the democratization process of the 1980s and 1990s, successive governments tried to tame hyperinflation, which reached 2,477% in 1993.

zh: 1994年实施的“里亚尔计划”成功地在第二年将年度价格涨幅抑制在“可接受”的22 % 。
en: The introduction of the “Real plan,” launched in 1994, managed to suppress annual price growth to an “acceptable” 22% by the following year.

zh: 凭借该计划成功的东风，其提出者、前经济部长卡多佐连续两次当选总统（1994年和1998年 ） ， 彰显出选民对价格稳定的重视。
en: Riding on the plan’s success, its architect, Fernando Henrique Cardoso, a former economy minister, was twice elected President (in 1994 and 1998), underscoring voter concern about price stability.

zh: 如今，发达国家央行担心通缩，而巴西政客再次被迫就普遍的增长放缓和高通胀回归做出反应。
en: Today, as central bankers in developed countries fret about the threat of deflation, Brazilian politicians are once again forced to respond to widespread fears about slowing growth and a return to high inflation.

zh: 不幸的是，总统候选人的对巴西央行的计划不足以满足需要。
en: Unfortunately, the presidential candidates’ plans for the BCB fall short of what is required.

zh: 历史上，罗塞夫的劳工党（Worker’s Party）一直拒绝给予巴西央行正式的独立地位，而她在选战中一直打着鲜明的民粹主义旗号，认为把巴西央行的独立会导致过多的控制权落入私人银行家之手。
en: Historically, Rousseff’s Workers’ Party (PT) has resisted giving the bank formal autonomy, and she has played a distinctly populist card during the campaign, arguing that BCB autonomy would hand too much control to private bankers.

zh: 社会党（Socialist Party）候选人席尔瓦（Marina Silva）要求巴西央行正式独立 — — 该主张随后被社会民主党（Social Democratic Party）候选人内维斯（Aécio Neves）采纳，他将在第二轮选举中与罗塞夫一决高下。
en: Marina Silva, the Socialist Party’s candidate, demanded formal bank independence – an argument subsequently adopted by the Social Democratic Party (PSDB) candidate, Aécio Neves, who now faces Rousseff in the election run-off.

zh: 但内维斯想要的是事实而非正式的操作自主权。
en: But Neves wants de facto, rather than formal, operational autonomy for the BCB.

zh: 与卡多佐一样，内维斯承诺采取通胀目标、建立基本盈余和维持浮动汇率。
en: Like Cardoso, Neves is committed to inflation targeting, creating a primary surplus, and maintaining a floating exchange rate.

zh: 尽管这些政策或有助于价格稳定，但他的方案忽略了巴西央行问题最重要的两个方面：法律自主权和保证公民问责权的制度改革。
en: While such policies may promote price stability, his proposal neglects the two most important issues for the BCB: legal autonomy and institutional reforms that ensure accountability to citizens.

zh: 法律授权巴西央行独立将有助于货币信心，这是非正式独立不能带来的。
en: A legal commitment to BCB autonomy would contribute to currency confidence in a way that informal autonomy cannot.

zh: 法律结构对通胀预期有直接影响，因为法律可以提供公共品（如价格和金融稳定）的制度性保护。
en: Legal structures have a direct impact on inflation expectations, because law can provide institutional protection to public goods, such as price and financial stability.

zh: 精心设计、合理实施的制度改革还能增加巴西央行的总体社会可问责性，同时抵御过度政治干预和大银行的游说。
en: Properly designed and executed, institutional reform could also increase BCB accountability to society at large while guarding against undue political influence and lobbying by the big banks.

zh: 巴西央行的改革时机已经成熟。
en: The BCB is ripe for reform.

zh: 巴西央行是一家有着50年历史的技术官僚机构，成立于军事独裁时期，几乎没有政治和社会问责的法律约束。
en: It is a 50-year-old technocratic bureaucracy established under a military dictatorship, with few legal instruments for political and social accountability.

zh: 因此，制度改革必须超越巴西央行不充分的价格稳定目标 — — 该目标基于不能反映普通巴西消费者体验的狭义通胀指数制定。
en: Institutional reform must therefore move beyond the BCB’s inadequate price-stability target, which is set according to a narrow inflation index that fails to reflect the experiences of ordinary Brazilian consumers.

zh: 比如，2013年的��告通胀率是5.9 % （ 目标为4.5 % ） ；但占大部分家庭预算大头的食品价格上涨了8.4 % ， 穷人受到的冲击尤其严重。
en: For example, the reported 2013 inflation rate was 5.9% (compared to a 4.5% target); but prices for food, a major share of most households’ budgets, rose by 8.4%, hitting the poor especially hard.

zh: 罗塞夫政府通过压制国家服务价格人为压低报告通胀率。
en: The Rousseff administration has kept the reported inflation rate artificially low by suppressing prices for state-run services.

zh: 价格稳定应该伴随其他目标，特别是金融稳定，也可以包括就业。
en: Price stability should be accompanied by other targets, especially financial stability, but also, possibly, employment.

zh: 2011年，罗塞夫成功抵抗了国会引入这些目标的尝试，当然，应该小心设计这些目标以避免过去的错误。
en: Rousseff thwarted Congress’s attempts to introduce such targets in 2011, and they would, of course, need to be carefully designed to avoid past mistakes.

zh: 但是，如果做得对的话，扩大评估巴西央行政策的标准的范围可以加强问责性，从而强化授予决策者法律独立地位的合法性。
en: But, done right, an expanded range of criteria by which to assess BCB policies, by enhancing accountability, would strengthen the legitimacy of granting policymakers legal autonomy.

zh: 在促进金融稳定性方面也存在制度改革空间。
en: There is also scope for institutional reform to promote greater financial stability.

zh: 2008年金融危机及其后果凸显出巴西央行制度设计过时的弊端。
en: The 2008 financial crisis and its aftermath highlighted the consequences of the BCB’s outdated institutional design.

zh: 巴西央行得不到足够的法律支持采取稳定金融体系所需要的行动。
en: The Bank had insufficient legal backing for action needed to stabilize the financial system.

zh: 这让时任总统卢拉采取了一系列非常措施，包括使用存款保险基金和国有银行援助倒闭金融机构。
en: This left then-President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, to resort to a series of dramatic measures, including the use of the deposit-insurance fund and state-owned banks to bail out failed financial institutions.

zh: 卢拉声称这一权宜之计让巴西获得了其他国家所没有的一定程度的灵活性；但如他所声称，这也不是没有代价的，并且成效并不持久。
en: Lula claimed that this ad hoc approach gave Brazil a degree of flexibility lacking in other countries; but it was not cost-free, as he claimed, and the results did not endure.

zh: 私人债务的迅速扩张引起了另一个更大的忧虑。
en: Rapid expansion of private debt raises other, larger concerns.

zh: 其他中央银行认识到采取新工具保证金融稳定的需要；巴西央行也必须如此。
en: Other central banks have recognized the need for new instruments to ensure financial stability; so must the BCB.

zh: 制度上明确巴西央行的金融稳定权力以及它所能使用的工具有助于巴西避免未来危机 — — 或至少更有效地抵御危机。
en: Institutional clarity on the BCB’s mandate for financial stability and the instruments at its disposal could help Brazil avoid future crises – or at least weather them more effectively.

zh: 巴西总统选举似乎带来了两个无法令人满意的选项：继续现状，巴西央行在罗塞夫任上受到政治影响；或者巴西央行在内维斯任上根据过时的制度框架获得非正式独立地位。
en: Brazil’s presidential election appears to offer two unsatisfying choices: a continuation of the status quo, with the BCB subject to political influence, under Rousseff; or an informally autonomous BCB with an outdated institutional apparatus, under Neves.

zh: 只有席尔瓦最初的方案要求采取货币政策和金融监管的制度改革；而她对内维斯的支持是否能在后者获胜后改变他的观点还远未可知。
en: Only Silva’s initial proposal included calls for institutional reform of monetary policy and financial regulation; and it is far from certain that her endorsement of Neves in the run-off will sway his view should he win.

zh: 巴西经济革命
en: Brazil’s Economic Revolution

zh: 巴西利亚—在过去的一年中，大型新兴经济体纷纷因发达国家危机引起欧洲的衰退和美国复苏乏力而遭受重创，特别是上半年。
en: BRASILIA – Large emerging economies were hit hard in the past year – particularly in the first half – by the crisis in developed countries, with Europe in recession and the United States staging only a meager recovery.

zh: 但2012年仍将成为巴西经济史上被人铭记的一年，这一年，巴西经济结构性变革得到了巩固。
en: But 2012 will also be remembered as the year when structural changes in the Brazilian economy were consolidated.

zh: 2008年开始的全球经济危机类似于20世纪30年代的大萧条，这么说不仅是因为深度和持续时间，也是因为发达国家面对危机的政策错误和犹豫。
en: The global economic crisis that began in 2008 is similar to the Great Depression of the 1930’s not only in terms of its depth and duration, but also in view of advanced countries’ policy errors and hesitation.

zh: 令人担心的是，欧洲领导人总是无法就财政调整政策达成一致，从而为重振经济增长所必须的刺激措施创造空间。
en: It is worrying that European leaders find it so difficult to agree on fiscal adjustment policies that make room for the stimulus measures needed to revive economic growth.

zh: 到目前为止，仍有财政余地的欧洲国家要求支出和投资的削减，这与增税一道抑制了经济活动，增加了失业，最终破坏了税收 — — 因而也拖累了财政整固。
en: Until now, European countries with fiscal leeway have insisted on spending and investment cuts that, together with tax increases, have reduced economic activity and increased unemployment, ultimately compromising tax collection – and thus fiscal consolidation.

zh: 在美国，尽管情况有些许改善，但不确定性仍未消除。
en: In the US, despite a slight improvement, uncertainty lingers.

zh: 除了2013年坠下“财政悬崖”的风险，主要问题依旧：缺少有效的反周期财政政策（如公共投资计划）以提振经济活动。
en: In addition to the risk posed by the “fiscal cliff” in 2013, the main problem remains: the lack of effective counter-cyclical fiscal policies – for example, a public-investment program – to boost economic activity.

zh: 相反，美国把全部力量用在了货币宽松上，发动了我所谓的货币战争，在这场战争中，全球投资者为了追寻高收益，纷纷涌向新兴市场，推高了它们的汇率。
en: Instead, the US has placed all of its chips on monetary easing, unleashing what I have called a currency war, in which global investors, chasing higher yields, flood into emerging countries, driving up their exchange rates.

zh: 糟糕的国际环境主要通过外贸、加剧巴西市场竞争和造成在发达国家普遍存在的负预期冲击了巴西经济。
en: The poor international environment hit Brazil’s economy mainly via foreign trade, aggressive competition in the Brazilian market, and echoes of the negative expectations prevailing in advanced countries.

zh: 为了抗击衰退，巴西政府实施了一系列政策，目前已经收到了明显的效果。
en: To combat the downturn, Brazil’s government implemented measures that are now yielding clear dividends.

zh: 主要变革是利率下降，与此一同下降的还有通胀目标框架，这促成了更具竞争力的汇率政策。
en: The main change was a large reduction in interest rates, in line with an inflation-targeting framework, which has led to a more competitive exchange-rate policy.

zh: 这些政策与反周期财政政策一道，使巴西赤字和公债水平处于可控状态。
en: This was combined with a counter-cyclical fiscal policy has that kept deficits and public debt under control.
