en: In addition, Brexit would undermine London’s position as Europe’s financial center.

zh: 欧元计价的金融交易的主要中心位于欧元区之外，这相当反常。
en: It is quite extraordinary that the principal center for euro-denominated financial transactions is outside the eurozone.

zh: 这证明了欧盟禁止单一市场内部歧视的监管非常严格。
en: This attests to the strength of EU regulations prohibiting discrimination within the Single Market.

zh: 但在英国退出后，就无法再阻止法兰克福和巴黎采取有利于其自身银行和交易所而不利于伦敦的措施。
en: But in a post-Brexit world, Frankfurt and Paris would no longer be prevented from imposing measures that favored their banks and exchanges over London’s.

zh: 伦敦金融城也是严重依赖外来劳动力的行业的典型。
en: The City is also an example of a sector that relies heavily on foreign labor.

zh: 在银行、金融和保险业，多达15%的员工出生于海外。
en: Upwards of 15% of workers in banking, finance, and insurance were born abroad.

zh: 吸引和留住这些外国人才在英国退出后将变得更加困难，流向英国的欧盟公认不再能够随身转移养老金权利，其他单一市场的便利条件也将失去。
en: Attracting and retaining this foreign talent will become harder after Brexit, when EU workers moving to Britain will no longer be able to take their pension rights with them, and the other conveniences of a single labor market are lost.

zh: 英国退出可能给英国带来更加普通但非常惹人注目的影响。
en: Brexit could have more mundane, but highly noticeable, effects on Britain.

zh: 任何人只要在英国住过，就知道在过去一代人的时间里，生活质量提升最大的方面在于食物的丰富性。
en: Anyone who has spent time in the UK knows that the single greatest gain in the quality of life over the last generation has been in the caliber of the food.

zh: 想象一下法国和意大利大厨纷纷离开后的英国厨房景象，令人不寒而栗。
en: One shudders to imagine the culinary landscape of a UK abandoned by its French and Italian chefs.

zh: 稍稍更重要的是，仅仅作为又一股中间力量的英国将不再像现在那样，与欧盟一起在全球施加军事和外交影响力。
en: Somewhat more weightily, a Britain that is just another middle power would be less able to project military and diplomatic influence globally than it currently is, working in concert with the EU.

zh: 尽管英国将仍然是北约成员国，但我们尚未看到该联盟在美国霸权结束后的时代如何运转。
en: Although the UK would remain a member of NATO, we have yet to see how functional the Alliance will be in the era after US hegemony.

zh: 尽管欧盟尚未形成一致的外角和安全政策，但眼下的难民危机清楚地表明，欧盟必须朝这一方向努力。
en: While the EU has yet to develop a coherent foreign and security policy, the ongoing refugee crisis makes clear that it will have to move in that direction.

zh: 事实上，这是英国退出争论中最具讽刺性的一个角度。
en: Indeed, this is the single most ironic aspect of the Brexit debate.

zh: 毕竟，一开始，英国民意在1956年苏伊士入侵失败后是支持加入欧盟的，这场失败让英国知道，帝国解体后，它不再能够独力执行有效的外交政策。
en: After all, British public opinion first began to turn in favor of EU membership after the failed Suez invasion of 1956, which taught the country that, bereft of empire, it could no longer execute an effective foreign policy on its own.

zh: 所有这些不禁让人感到疑惑：英国退出的支持者到底在想什么？
en: All of which leads one to ask: What can Brexit’s proponents possibly be thinking?

zh: 答案他们根本没有在想。
en: The answer is that they are not – thinking, that is.

zh: 英国退出阵营的初始情绪和美国的唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）一样。
en: The Brexit campaign is tapping into the same primordial sentiments as Donald Trump is in the US.

zh: 大部分英国退出支持者是认为自己被抛在别人身后的愤怒不满的选民。
en: Most Brexit supporters are angry, disaffected voters who feel left behind.

zh: 欧盟成员地位意味着英国暴露在国际贸易和金融之下，这总体而言有利于英国，但未必符合所有个体的利益。
en: Exposure to international trade and finance, which is what EU membership entails, may have benefited the UK as a whole, but it has not worked to every individual’s advantage.

zh: 因此，处境不利者破口大骂 — — 骂贸易，骂移民，骂传统政客没能解决他们的难处。
en: So the disadvantaged are lashing out – against trade, against immigration, and against the failure of conventional politicians to address their woes.

zh: 从根本上说，支持英国退出就是反对首相卡梅伦、财政大臣奥斯本（George Osborne）和全体政治主流。
en: Fundamentally, a vote for Brexit is a vote against Prime Minister David Cameron, Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne, and the political mainstream generally.

zh: 显然，真正的问题不是欧盟；而是英国政治阶级没能为全球化的受害者提供有意义的帮助。
en: The real problem, obviously, is not the EU; it is the failure of the British political class to provide meaningful help to the casualties of globalization.

zh: 上个月，就业和养老金大臣史密斯（Iain Duncan Smith）辞职抗议政府削减福利的方案。
en: Within the last month, Work and Pensions Secretary Iain Duncan Smith resigned in protest over the government’s proposed cuts to welfare benefits.

zh: 4月1日，最低工资获得提高。
en: And on April 1, the minimum wage was raised.

zh: 也许愤怒不满的群众的声音终于被听到了。
en: Maybe the voices of the angry and disaffected are finally being heard.

zh: 果真如此的话，英国退出争论倒也不是完全没有意义。
en: If so, the Brexit debate will not have been pointless after all.

zh: 英国人在移民问题上确实软化了吗？
en: Are Britons Really Softening on Immigration?

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 在英国，新的流行看法是民众对移民的态度正在软化。
en: LONDON – In the United Kingdom, the new conventional wisdom is that attitudes toward immigration are softening.

zh: 英国《金融时报》今年7月的一篇头条新闻指出“脱欧后的英国对移民的负面态度大幅下降 ” 。
en: A headline in the Financial Times this July stated that “negativity about immigration falls sharply in Brexit Britain.”

zh: 同样，英国移民咨询委员会最近的一份报告称 ， “ 英国或许会发现自己处于终结人员自由流动的（有利）位置，因为在这一动作之下公众对移民流的关注会有所下降。 “
en: Likewise, a recent report by the UK Migration Advisory Committee surmises that “the UK may find itself in the position of ending free movement just as public concern falls about the migration flows that result from it.”

zh: 上述言论值得我们留意，要知道出于公众对不受控移民的强烈反对而令英国脱欧公投“脱”派得胜也仅仅不过是两年前的事而已。
en: This is notable, considering that it has been only two years since a widespread public backlash against uncontrolled immigration delivered a victory to “Leave” in the Brexit referendum.

zh: 此外英国的移民政策并未出现重大变化，英国目前还在欧盟，欧盟公民仍然可以自由移居英国。
en: Moreover, there have been no major changes to immigration policy. Britain is still in the European Union, and EU citizens are still free to move to the UK.

zh: 尽管移民数量有所下降，但按历史标准来看这一数字依然非常高，远远超过政府的“低于数万人”的净移民目标。
en: And though migration levels have dropped somewhat, they remain extraordinarily high by historic standards, far exceeding the government’s net immigration target of “below tens of thousands.”

zh: 然而民意调查数据已经无可否认地发生了变化。
en: Still, opinion polls have undeniably changed.

zh: 受访者现在对移民带来的经济和文化影响态度更加积极，也没那么多人将移民称为英国面临的最重要问题之一。
en: Survey respondents are now more positive about the economic and cultural effects of immigration, and fewer people now name immigration as one of the most important issues facing the UK.

zh: 此外，这种趋势出现在整个政治和社会光谱内，也同样出现在留欧者和脱欧者之间。
en: Moreover, this trend appears across the political and social spectrum, and equally among Remainers and Leavers.

zh: 虽然自世纪之交以来实际上已经可以观察到这一点，但英国退欧公投却赋予了它新的动力。
en: And while it has actually been observable since the turn of the millennium, it has gained momentum since the Brexit vote.

zh: 这种推动英国退欧态度与民意调查态度之间的明显脱节现象亟需研究。
en: The apparent disconnect between the attitudes that fueled Brexit and the attitudes that show up in opinion polls cries out for investigation.

zh: 在我们了解到推动这些意外变化的因素之前，我们需要注意这些调查结果的呈现方式，以及它们如何为政策制定提供信息。
en: Until we understand what’s driving these unexpected changes, we need to be mindful of how survey findings are presented, and how they inform policymaking decisions.

zh: 为此，笔者所属的智库机构国家经济和社会研究所最近检视了英国人对移民的社会态度随时间推移的现有证据。
en: To that end, we at the National Institute of Economic and Social Research (NIESR) recently assessed the available evidence of Britons’ social attitudes toward immigration over time.

zh: 在一项新的研究中，我们发现对于这一事项的大幅民意调查转向存在着几种可能的解释。
en: In a new study, we show that there are several possible explanations for the extraordinary shifts in the polls on this issue.

zh: 首先，英国终于就移民进行了对话。
en: For starters, the UK is finally having a conversation about migration.

zh: 虽然这种对话经常存在对抗性且受到极端观点所支配，但它可能促使一些人去思考移民的正面影响 — — 而不仅仅是缺点。
en: And while this conversation has often been confrontational and dominated by extreme views, it may have prompted some people to consider the pros, rather than just the cons.

zh: 毕竟有充分的证据表明移民使英国在经济上受益。
en: After all, there is ample evidence to show that immigration has benefited the UK economically.

zh: 同样，自退欧公投以来关于已经移居英国的欧盟公民所享有权利的辩论，以及最近关于所谓“风驰一代 ” （ Windrush generation）加勒比海移民的争议，都吸引到了公众对移民的支持。
en: Similarly, since the Brexit vote, the debate over the rights of EU citizens already residing in the UK, along with the recent controversy over the so-called Windrush generation of immigrants from the Caribbean, has attracted public support for migrants.

zh: 这些对话似乎触及到了人们的某种公平感。
en: These conversations seem to have tapped into people’s sense of fairness.

zh: 以往公平原则都是被用来对付移民的，比如当申请庇护者被指控试图钻英国福利制度的空子时。
en: Previously, the principle of fairness had been used against migrants, such as when asylum seekers are accused of trying to exploit the British welfare system.

zh: 另一种解释是，一些英国人在目睹了近年来一面倒的移民负面公开辩论后改变了自己的观点。
en: An alternative explanation is that some Britons have modified their views after witnessing an overwhelmingly negative public debate on immigration in recent years.

zh: 以前就算是对移民的轻微质疑都会被视为是反移民，可一旦认识到其他人的观点更为极端可能会让人们认为自己更倾向于移民。
en: Previously, even slight skepticism toward migration was perceived to be anti-immigrant. But the realization that others hold more extreme views may have led people to see themselves as more positively inclined toward immigration.

zh: 为此人们相应调整了对调查问题的答案，即使他们的观点其实并没有多大变化。
en: They have adjusted their responses to survey questions accordingly, even though their views have remained essentially the same.

zh: 同样，一些移民怀疑论者或那些“焦虑中间派”人士可能会在极端观点主导的公开辩论中感到自己被错误代表或曲解了。
en: Similarly, some immigration skeptics, or those belonging to the “anxious middle,” may feel misrepresented or misinterpreted in a public debate dominated by extreme views.

zh: 如果是这样，他们可能会在最近的调查回复中调整自己对移民的立场。
en: If so, they may have moderated their position on immigration in recent survey responses.

zh: 或者，如果他们认为自身的忧虑已经得到解决（尽管这种情况可能会随着他们再度开始怀疑而迅速消失 ） ， 那么移民怀疑论者可能会出现一种“安慰效应 ” 。
en: Alternatively, there may be a “reassurance effect” among immigration skeptics if they feel that their concerns are already being addressed (though this could disappear rapidly if they start to suspect otherwise).

zh: 出于同样的原因，脱欧投票以及近年来民族主义英国独立党的崛起也可能将移民自由主义者调动了起来。
en: By the same token, immigration liberals may have been galvanized by the Brexit vote and the rise of the nationalist UK Independence Party in recent years.

zh: 最后，受访者心目中的移民形象近年来可能已经发生了变化，现在欧盟移民和“风驰一代”已经主导了媒体报道。
en: Lastly, the image of immigrants that survey respondents have in mind may have changed in recent years, now that EU migration and the Windrush generation have dominated the media coverage.

zh: 因此在回答调查问题时普通英国人可能会更多地考虑这些群体，比如寻求庇护者以及逃离中东和北非冲突的难民。
en: When answering survey questions, the average Briton may be thinking more about these cohorts than, say, asylum seekers and refugees fleeing from conflicts in the Middle East and North Africa.

zh: 换句话说，人们对普通移民看法的改变可能使他们总体上更加支持移民。
en: In other words, a change in people’s idea of the average immigrant may have made them more supportive of immigration generally.

zh: 还有许多其他因素可以解释民意调查在这个问题上的转变。
en: Many other factors could explain the shift in the polls on this issue.

zh: 但正如上面概述的一些可能性所示，调查反馈的变化并不一定意味着公众对移民的态度会弱化。
en: But as some of the possibilities outlined above show, the change in survey responses does not necessarily imply a softening of public attitudes toward immigration.

zh: 相反，它提醒我们必须改进对公众情绪的理解。
en: Rather, it tells us that our knowledge about public sentiment needs to improve.

zh: 正如智库组织英国未来的全国移民问题论坛和国家经济和社会研究所自身与肯特地区众多关注组织的合作工作所表明的那样，人们对移民的看法是微妙而多面的。
en: As British Future’s National Conversation on Immigration and NIESR’s own work with focus groups in Kent have shown, people’s views on migration are nuanced and multifaceted.

zh: 随着英国政策制定者着手设计一项新的脱欧后移民政策，我们必须继续深化自身对人们持有和表达意见成因的理解。
en: As British policymakers set out to design a new post-Brexit immigration policy, it is very important that we continue to develop our understanding of why people hold and express the views that they do.

zh: 而简单地假设我们已经知道答案可不是一个正确的选项。
en: Simply assuming that we already know the answer is not an option.

zh: 英国银行业的英国退出
en: The Brexit of UK Banking

zh: 伦敦—20世纪90年代中期，当我出任英国银行监督部门主管时，我的朋友们觉得这不是一个光荣或令人激动的差事。
en: LONDON – When I became the head of banking supervision in the United Kingdom in the mid-1990s, my friends did not see it as a glamorous or exciting career move.

zh: 银行监管是一个默默无闻的任务，就像清洗下水道：它很重要，但不太可能成为头条热点。
en: Banking regulation was an obscure task, like cleaning sewers: essential, perhaps, but hardly front-page news.

zh: 有些人表示对我如何打发工作时间表示好奇，这通常只是友好的礼貌信号，而不是真正感兴趣。
en: Expressions of curiosity about how I spent my working hours were typically a sign of friendly politeness rather than genuine interest.

zh: 二十年后，欧洲银行监管结构已经上升为伦敦政治日程的重中之重。
en: Twenty years later, the structure of banking regulation in Europe has risen to the top of the political agenda in London.

zh: 它是首相卡梅伦与欧盟重新谈判英国成员资格条件的关键点之一。
en: It is one of the key points in Prime Minister David Cameron’s renegotiation of the UK’s terms of membership of the European Union.

zh: 卡梅伦对欧盟的四个主要要求之一是英国可以背离统一规则的要素。 欧洲央行正在寻求将统一规则纳入欧元区银行联盟，以保证各国方针的一致性。
en: One of Cameron’s four major demands of the EU is a national derogation from elements of the uniform rulebook which the European Central Bank is seeking to introduce in the eurozone’s banking union to ensure a consistent approach across countries.

zh: 法国和其他国家担心这一背离可能让英国为了赢得竞争优势而放松伦敦的金融监管，尽管最新证据表明，目前伦敦对银行资本要求和其他控制银行活动的要求实际上要比欧洲其他地方更加严格。
en: The French and others fear that this derogation could permit the UK, in search of competitive advantage, to loosen financial regulation in London, even though recent evidence suggests that bank capital requirements, and other controls on banks’ activities, are in fact now tighter in London than elsewhere in Europe.

zh: 比如，英国要求“隔离”零售和商业银行业务，而欧洲层面不存在这一要求，法国和德国政府的反对意味着不可能出现这样的欧洲规则。
en: For example, there is no European equivalent of the British requirement to “ring-fence” retail and commercial banking, and the French and German governments’ opposition suggests that there is unlikely to be one.

zh: 当然，银行监督 — — 以及更一般的金融监管 — — 现在为何具备了更高的政治重要性的原因显而易见：2008年金融危机表明银行倒闭可能给整体经济带来灾难性后果。
en: Of course, the reason why banking supervision – and financial regulation more generally – has higher political salience now is obvious: The financial crisis of 2008 showed that bank failures could have catastrophic consequences for the economy as a whole.

zh: 这场危机之后迎来了金融业的迅速增长，特别是欧洲。
en: That crisis followed a period during which the financial sector grew dramatically, especially in Europe.

zh: 英国和德国的银行-市场比率 — — 银行业占股市和债市的比重 — — 在短短十年间上升了一倍，而美国则保持稳定并且远低于英国和德国。
en: The bank-market ratio – the size of the banking sector relative to the size of equity and bond markets – roughly doubled in the UK and Germany in little more than a decade, while the ratio remained stable in the US, and at a much lower level.

zh: 欧元区的区别尤其显著，三分之二的欧元区非金融企业的外部融资来自银行贷款。
en: The difference is particularly marked in the eurozone, where two-thirds of non-financial firms’ external financing comes from bank loans.

zh: 美国的可比数字为接近20 % ， 和英国一样，在美国股票和债务资本市场对企业投资融资的作用比银行贷款重要得多。
en: The comparable figure is nearer 20% in the US, where, as in the UK, equity and debt capital markets play a much more important role in financing business investment.

zh: 短期后果是2008年开始的信用动荡对严重依赖银行的欧洲经济体造成的影响要严重得多，也更加长期，因为银行削减了贷款以维持和重塑资本比率。
en: The short-term consequence was that the credit crunch that began in 2008 had a more serious and longer-term impact on Europe’s heavily bank-based economies, as banks curtailed lending to preserve and rebuild their capital ratios.

zh: 这一过程在一些欧洲大陆国家仍在进行，尽管英国的银行贷款已经有所恢复。
en: That process is still under way in parts of continental Europe, though business lending by banks has recovered in the UK.

zh: 但欧洲央行的山姆·朗菲尔德（Sam Langfield）和那不勒斯大学的马可·帕加诺（Marco Pagano）的一份新研究指出，长期影响要比此前所怀疑的更有破坏性。
en: But a new study by Sam Langfield of the ECB and Marco Pagano of the University of Naples suggests that the longer-term implications are even more damaging than was previously suspected.

zh: 朗菲尔德和帕加诺指出，在危机爆发以来的八年中，欧盟GDP只增长了2 % ， 而美国超过9 % ， 这一差异的原因是大西洋两岸金融结构的区别。
en: Langfield and Pagano point out that in the eight years since the crisis, the European Union’s GDP has grown by only 2%, compared to more than 9% in the US, and attribute this differential to transatlantic differences in financial structure.

zh: 在分析了来自大量国家数据后，他们发现“一国银行业相对股市和私人���券市场的规模的扩张伴随着随后五年更低的GDP增长。 ”
en: Analyzing data for a large number of countries, they find that “an increase in the size of a country’s banking sector relative to stock and private bond market capitalization is associated with lower GDP growth in the subsequent five-year period.”

zh: 他们所评估的影响的程度也颇为可观。
en: And the magnitude of the impact they assess is considerable.

zh: 欧洲银行-市场比率在1990年时为3.2；但在2011年，上升到3.8。
en: Europe’s bank-market ratio was 3.2 in 1990; by 2011, it had risen to 3.8.

zh: 根据他们的模型，如此规模的上升伴随着年GDP增长下降0.3个百分点，而在住房市场危机期间，影响会翻番，因为按揭贷款在欧盟银行资产负债表中占比很高。
en: An increase on that scale is associated in their model with a 0.3-percentage-point reduction in annual growth, and twice that in a housing-market crisis, given the high proportion of mortgage lending on EU banks’ balance sheets.

zh: 许多欧洲国家，特别是爱尔兰和西班牙，确实在2008年后经历了住房价格崩溃。
en: Many EU countries, notably Ireland and Spain, did experience a collapse in house prices after 2008.

zh: 因此，欧盟银行的相对规模可能解释了与美国增长差距的一半。
en: So the relative size of EU banks might account for roughly half of the growth gap vis-à-vis the US.

zh: 这解释了为何欧洲央行，以及一些欧盟政府，热衷于资本市场联盟工程，这项工程的目标是找到办法刺激整个欧洲的非银行融资渠道的增长。
en: That explains why the ECB, and some EU governments, are keen on the Capital Markets Union project, which aims to find ways to stimulate the growth of non-bank financing channels across the continent.

zh: 这方面取得的进展将减轻危险的过度依赖银行的状况。
en: Progress would reduce dangerous over-reliance on banks.

zh: 和往常一样，英国的情况介于美国和欧洲大陆之间。
en: The UK, as ever, is to be found somewhere in the middle of the Atlantic.

zh: 其2008—2015年间累计经济增长为6 % 。
en: Cumulative economic growth from 2008 to 2015 was 6%.

zh: 这略接近于美国而非欧洲其余部分，尽管仍属于较弱的深度萧条反弹。
en: A little closer to the US than to the rest of Europe, though still a relatively weak rebound from a deep recession.

zh: 英国股市相对经济的规模比大部分欧洲股价更大。
en: The UK’s stock market is larger relative to its economy than most others in Europe.

zh: 其银行体系庞大且集中，尽管新进入者和新融资渠道正在改变这一局面。
en: Its banking system is large and concentrated, though new entrants and new financing channels are changing that.

zh: 点对点贷款的扩张速度快于欧洲其他地区。
en: Peer-to-peer lending has expanded faster than elsewhere in Europe.

zh: 平均而言，英国银行业更加偏向于非欧洲市场，这让其银行业看上去更大。
en: UK banks are also, on average, more oriented toward non-European markets, which makes the banking sector seem larger.

zh: 英国银行业三分之一资产实际上持有在非欧盟银行手中。
en: And a third of the UK banking sector’s assets are in fact held by non-EU banks.

zh: 只有卢森堡的情况与英国接近，这一比例略低于20 % ， 而法国、德国和意大利，国内市场的海外持有量可以忽略不计。
en: Only Luxembourg comes close, at just below 20%, while in France, Germany, and Italy, the overseas share of their domestic markets is negligible.

zh: 这些差异部分解释了为何英国不愿参与欧洲银行联盟，而一些其他非欧元区国家则急切地想加入其中，担心若非如此，它们可能被实际排除在欧洲央行决策之外。
en: These differences may partly explain the UK’s reluctance to participate in the European banking union, while some other non-eurozone countries are keen to join it, fearing that, otherwise, they might be effectively excluded from ECB policymaking.

zh: 在伦敦，即使是亲欧洲派也更愿意在国家层面上解决英国仍然面临的金融业挑战；结构上的差异意味着这是一个可以理解的选择。
en: In London, even pro-Europeans prefer to address Britain’s remaining financial-sector challenges on a national basis; the differences in structure make that an understandable choice.

zh: 英国脱欧的商业面
en: The Business Side of Brexit

zh: 伦敦—将近一年前，英国人以52%对48%的结果投票决定脱离欧盟。
en: LONDON – Nearly a year ago, the British voted – 52% to 48% – to leave the European Union.

zh: 许多人预测这一投票结果将带来严重的经济波动。
en: Many expected the vote to produce severe economic volatility.

zh: 但到目前为止，英国经济岿然不动，尽管随着本周提前举行的大选日益临近，出现了通胀抬头影响到消费者和一些企业的迹象。
en: But the economy, so far, has proved resilient, though as we head into this week’s snap general election, there are signs that higher inflation is taking its toll on consumers and some businesses.

zh: 问题在于，英国经济是否能够在实际“离婚”过程中安然无恙。
en: The question is whether the economy can withstand the actual divorce proceedings.

zh: 随着英国脱欧投票的进行，英格兰银行也改变了策略，帮助冷静了金融市场，保持了信用流动。
en: In the wake of the Brexit vote, swift action by the Bank of England helped to calm financial markets and keep credit flowing.

zh: 与2008年全球金融危机期间不同，英国脱欧投票后大部分英国企业和家庭的信用成本没有上升；甚至有的还有所下降。
en: Unlike during the global financial crisis of 2008, the cost of credit for most firms and families in the United Kingdom hasn’t risen; if anything, it has fallen.

zh: 英国消费者也在继续做他们最擅长的事情：在商店和网上花钱。
en: All the while, British consumers have done what they do best: spend their money in stores and online.

zh: 家庭支出支持去年总体增长率接近2 % 。
en: Household spending supported overall growth close to 2% last year.

zh: 金融市场的巨大变化来自英镑价值的大幅下跌。
en: The big change in financial markets has been the steep decline in the value of the pound.

zh: 汇率贬值有利于位于英国的出口商的竞争优势。
en: The weaker exchange rate has helped UK-based exporters’ competitiveness.

zh: 由英国工业联合会（Confederation of British Industry，我在其中担任首席经济学家）进行的4月产业趋势调查表明，制造业出口订单出现了2011年以来的最强劲增长。
en: The April industrial trends survey, conducted by the Confederation of British Industry (of which I am chief economist), showed the strongest rise in manufacturing export orders since 2011.

zh: 但这是一柄双刃剑：拜进口价格上升所赐，英国制造商也面临2011年以来最快的平均单位成本增长。
en: But this is a double-edge sword: British manufacturers also face the fastest rise in average unit costs since 2011, owing to the rising prices of imports.

zh: 英镑价值的下跌可能也已经开始影响到家庭。
en: The decline in the pound’s value may also start to hurt households.

zh: 消费物价通胀预计今年将达到接近3%的峰值。
en: Consumer price inflation is set to peak at close to 3% this year.

zh: 但是，考虑到劳动力市场动态的变化和生产率增长乏力的情况，平均工资增长很难高于2.5 % 。
en: Yet, given the changing dynamics of the labor market and subdued productivity growth, average wage gains are not likely to be much more than 2.5%.

zh: 因此，从真实值看，平均家庭收入可能保持不变甚至下降，从而影响英国经济至关重要的消费支出引擎。
en: In real terms, therefore, average household incomes are likely to remain flat or even shrink, undermining the UK economy’s crucial consumer-spending engine.

zh: 更糟糕的是，这些迫在眉睫的经济挑战与即将到来的脱欧谈判所造成的挑战相比，也许根本不值一提，尽管个中原因未必如你所料。
en: Worse, these impending macroeconomic challenges may well be dwarfed by those arising from the coming Brexit negotiations, though perhaps not for the reason one might expect.

zh: 对企业来说 — — 一位建筑工程企业领导人告诉我 — — 主要危险是为所有可能的脱欧情形未雨绸缪令人精疲力竭，导致公司无法将注意力集中在更大的战略目标上。
en: The key danger for businesses, as the leader of a construction-engineering firm put it to me, is that planning for all of the possible Brexit scenarios can become an all-consuming affair, causing companies to lose sight of their larger strategic goals.

zh: 好消息是，到目前为止商界仍然信心十足。
en: The good news is that, so far, the business community seems confident.

zh: 企业家和CEO有充足的在不确定环境中决策的经验。
en: Entrepreneurs and CEOs have plenty of experience making decisions in an uncertain world.

zh: 因此，尽管面临英国脱欧的未知情况，他们仍在继续投资于未来导向的领域，如云计算、人工智能和数据分析等。
en: So, despite the Brexit unknowns, they are continuing to invest in future-oriented areas like cloud computing, artificial intelligence, and data analytics.

zh: 真相是技术革命和亚洲消费的崛起 — — 而不是英国与欧盟的关系 — — 才是未来几十年推动营商方式改变的因素。
en: The truth is that it is the technological revolution and the surge in consumption in Asia – not the UK’s relationship with the EU – that will transform the way business is done over the next couple of decades.

zh: 随着英国-欧盟谈判的启动，对企业来说至关重要的是要时刻牢记这一点，紧紧关注脱欧工作组，而企业的其他管理层要专注于商业大战略。
en: As the UK-EU negotiations get underway, it is critical that companies bear this in mind, by ring-fencing Brexit working groups and keeping the rest of the firm’s management focused on broader business strategy.

zh: 当然，这比不是说我们应该害怕摆在面前的任务的复杂性，更不是要无视脱欧带来的挑战。
en: This is not to say, of course, that we should shrink from the complexity of the task ahead, much less disregard the challenges that Brexit will bring.

zh: 相反，我们必须直面这些挑战，包括面对一些硬事实，要求尽快做出一些艰难的决定。
en: On the contrary, we must confront those challenges head-on, including by facing some hard truths and demanding that some difficult decisions are made as soon as possible.

zh: 从企业角度，与英国脱欧有关的一个最大的忧虑是人力。
en: From a business perspective, one of the biggest Brexit-related concerns relates to people.

zh: 目前，英国经济饱受技能短缺掣肘：三分之二以上的企业对于未来3—5年填补高技能岗位空白信心不足。
en: As it stands, the UK economy is beset with skills shortages: more than two-thirds of firms are not confident they can fill vacancies for high-skill jobs over the next 3-5 years.

zh: 长期解决方案是加强英国的教育和技能培训。
en: The long-term solution is better education and skills training throughout the UK.

zh: 但在短期，必须依靠移民。
en: But, in the short term, migration must play a role.

zh: 目前，欧盟移民 — — 从采摘水果和蔬菜的季节性临时工到扩下一代眼界的学者和保护我们的健康的医生护士 — — 为英国经济做出了重大贡献。
en: Already, EU migrants – from seasonal workers harvesting fruit and vegetables to academics broadening the minds of the next generation and doctors and nurses protecting our health –make a major contribution to the UK economy.

zh: 在许多组织和企业中，欧盟公民占员工的40%以上。
en: In many organizations and firms, EU citizens comprise more than 40% of employees.

zh: 这些欧盟公民和他们的家庭现在面临着真正的不确定性。
en: These EU citizens and their families are now facing real uncertainty.

zh: 企业界大多支持立即保证目前在英国工作的欧盟公民能够继续工作下去。
en: The business community, by and large, advocates the immediate guarantee that EU citizens currently working in the UK will be able to continue doing so.

zh: 类似地，在欧盟工作的英国公民也应该被授予继续留在那里的权利。
en: Likewise, UK citizens working across the EU should be granted the right to remain where they are.

zh: 这不但是正确的事；也是明智的经济政策，因为劳动力的技能和才华将是未来几十年推动公司向前的引擎。
en: This is not only the right thing to do; it is the smart economic play, as the skills and talents of the workforce will be the engine that propels companies forward in the coming decades.

zh: 光靠已经身在英国的欧盟公民自身无法向这个引擎注入动力。
en: But EU citizens already in the UK will not be sufficient, on their own, to power that engine.

zh: 因此，英国还需要基于证据的新移民制度 — — 并且要尽快。
en: That is why the UK also needs a new, evidence-based immigration system – and fast.

zh: 企业、工人和家庭需要在今年年底前了解这套制度的具体内容，包括准入标准。
en: Businesses, workers, and families need to know by the end of this year what such a system will look like, including the criteria for entry.

zh: 另一个必须现在就做出的关键性决定是“没有协议”不是一个选项。
en: Another critical decision that must be made now is that “no deal” is not an option.

zh: 首相梅的政府目前表示这是一个开放的可能性，但英国和欧盟决不能让它成为可能，而是必须致力于在监管问题上达成明确的协议，从而确保英吉利海峡两岸的公司能够继续做生意。
en: Far from keeping that possibility open, as Prime Minister Theresa May’s government has done, the UK and the EU must commit to establishing a clear agreement on regulatory issues, thereby ensuring that companies on both sides of the English Channel can continue to do business.

zh: “悬崖边缘”情景 — — 在为期两年的谈判阶段的最后，监管机制突然来一个转向不明确甚至不确定的变化 — — 必须不惜一切代价避免。
en: A “cliff-edge” scenario – in which the end of the two-year negotiating period brings a sudden change to an unclear or even undecided regulatory regime – must be avoided at all costs.

zh: 如果英国经济要像淡定地面对脱欧投票那样面对英国脱欧，那么英国政府和企业一样，必须通过有效地管理不确定性来让不确定性的影响最小化。
en: If the British economy is to cope with Brexit as well as it has coped with the Brexit vote, the government, like businesses, must minimize the impact of uncertainty by managing that uncertainty effectively.

zh: 不管推迟严肃的脱欧谈判有多么充分的政治原因，都不能允许它压倒推动这一对话的经济原因。
en: Whatever the political case for delaying the start of serious Brexit negotiations, it must not be allowed to overshadow the economic case for moving the conversation forward.

zh: 英国后公投时期的议程
en: A Post-Referendum Agenda for Britain

zh: 伦敦 — — 罔顾我们在世界各地盟友的建议游说英国退出欧盟的猥琐运动离结束只剩下不到一个月。
en: LONDON – The end of the wretched campaign to take the United Kingdom out of the European Union against the advice of our friends around the world is less than a month away.

zh: 这些所谓的英国退欧势力否认英国离开欧盟会为自身带来经济损失的一切证据。
en: The Brexiteers, as they have come to be called, deny all evidence of the economic damage that the UK would do to itself by leaving.

zh: 他们对理性和现实的漠视像极了那位真人秀电视明星兼共和党总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普，此人的政治风格似乎借着一张廉价的机票越过了大西洋。
en: Their disregard for reason and facts resembles that of Donald Trump, the reality-TV star and Republican presidential candidate, whose political style seems to have crossed the Atlantic on a cheap ticket.

zh: 民众选择离开欧盟的代价是满盘皆输；英国将落入无边的黑暗。
en: If voters choose to leave the EU, all bets are off; the UK will be taking a leap in the dark.

zh: 幸运的是，越来越多的博彩公司预测选民们将会决定留在欧盟。
en: Fortunately, the bookies are increasingly predicting that voters will decide to remain.

zh: 但即便理智占据了上风，英国退欧 — — 结合了狂热野心（尤其体现在前伦敦市长鲍里斯·约翰逊的身上 ） 、 自欺欺人和满口谎言的有毒组合 — — 也势必会在结果公布后的很长一段时间内继续造成影响。
en: But even if sanity prevails, the effects of Brexitosis – a toxic combination of manic ambition (on the part of former London Mayor Boris Johnson, in particular), self-delusion, and mendacity – will linger long after the result is announced.

zh: 卡梅伦首相将面临再次团结保守党的艰巨任务。
en: Prime Minister David Cameron will face the unenviable task of trying to pull his Conservative Party together again.

zh: 他必须在宽宏大量和强势领导力之间找到平衡。
en: He will need to balance magnanimity with forceful assertion of leadership.

zh: 向缺乏忠诚度的议员输送利益肯定不管用；给他们一个面包，他们几乎马上会回来再要另外一个。
en: One thing that never works is to pay Danegeld to disloyal members of parliament; give them one bun, and they will come back almost immediately for another.

zh: 能否说服失利的一方接受选民的裁决、而不是躲到一边谋划另一次叛乱对卡梅伦的未来至关重要。
en: What will matter most for Cameron’s future is whether he can convince the losers to accept the voters’ verdict, instead of slinking away to plot another insurrection.

zh: 即使卡梅伦认定今年夏天他最不愿解决欧洲问题也可以理解。
en: It would be understandable if Cameron were to conclude that Europe was the last thing he wants to spend time on this summer.

zh: 但为了自己的国家、也为了欧洲，卡梅伦应当带头制定遏制大规模移民的可靠政策。
en: But, for the sake of his country, and of Europe, Cameron should take the lead in trying to put in place a credible policy for dealing with mass migration.

zh: 这绝非是叙利亚和阿富汗冲突驱动的短期事务；而是今后几十年欧洲都要面临的难题。
en: This is not just a short-term issue, driven by the conflicts in Syria and Afghanistan; it is a challenge that Europe will confront for decades.

zh: 19世纪，伴随欧洲人口从世界总人口的1/5增长到1/4，数百万人离开自己的祖国奔赴其他大陆。
en: During the nineteenth century, as Europe’s population grew from one-fifth to one-quarter of the world’s total population, millions left their native countries for other continents.

zh: 1815至1932年间，欧洲移民人数达到约6，000万。
en: Between 1815 and 1932, some 60 million Europeans emigrated.

zh: 一战开始时，近2/5的世界人口拥有欧洲血统。
en: At the beginning of World War I, almost two out of every five people worldwide had European ancestry.

zh: 今天，人口的天平已经完全逆转。
en: Today, the balance has been completely reversed.

zh: 欧洲人口已下降到全球总人口的10%以下，而且随着别国人口的猛增，欧洲人口还将进一步下降。
en: Europe’s population has fallen to well below 10% of the global total, and it will fall much further as populations skyrocket elsewhere.

zh: 例如，过去40年来，埃及人口已经从3900万上升到9300万。
en: Over the last 40 years, for example, Egypt’s population has increased from 39 million to 93 million.

zh: 在可比时期内，埃塞俄比亚人口增长超过3倍至1010万。
en: During a comparable period, Ethiopia’s population more than tripled, to 101 million.

zh: 目前拥有超过1.86亿人口的尼日利亚也走上了类似的轨道；其人口预计将在2050年增长至5亿。
en: Nigeria, now home to more than 186 million people, has followed a similar trajectory; its population is predicted to rise to a half-billion by 2050.

zh: 21世纪上半叶，非洲人口总数预计将从10亿上升到25亿之多。
en: During the first half of the twenty-first century, the population of Africa as a whole is expected to grow from about one billion to 2.5 billion.

zh: 失败国家，据我们了解，会出口他们的问题 — — 以及他们的人口。
en: Failing states, as we have learned, export their problems – and their people.

zh: 世界最贫困国家正在经历最快速的人口增长。
en: The world’s poorest countries are experiencing the fastest population growth.

zh: 他们的人口最为年轻，而且很多时候，出现执政崩溃的可能性也最大。
en: They have the youngest populations, and, all too often, are among the most likely to see a breakdown in governance.

zh: 由此导致的人口流动会使发达国家承受极大的压力 — — 其中尤以欧洲承受的压力最大。
en: The resulting flows of people will put developed countries under extreme pressure – nowhere more so than in Europe.

zh: 架设更多铁丝网根本谈不上是恰当的对策。
en: Erecting more razor wire will not come close to being an adequate response.

zh: 可悲的是，地中海已经成为某些人的坟墓 — — 但却很少有人将此视为畏途。
en: The Mediterranean has become, tragically, a cemetery for some – but a barrier only for a few.

zh: 如果各国自行其是，就连英国这样的岛国也无法解决移民难题。
en: Not even island countries like the UK can meet the migration challenge acting on their own.

zh: 我们需要的是我们的邻国和美国探讨并达成一项长期计划。
en: What we require is a long-term program discussed and agreed upon by our neighbors and the United States.

zh: 我们需要协调外交、安全和发展政策，以实现防止无法控制的大规模移民的目标。 这种现象会导致众多移民死于非命，并在他们的目的地国掀起仇外的浪潮。
en: We need to coordinate our foreign, security, and development policies in order to prevent uncontrollable, unmanageable mass migration – a phenomenon that will lead to many migrant deaths and stoke xenophobia in the countries they try to reach.

zh: 我们必须达成一致，帮助失败国家重新站起来。
en: We need to agree on how we deal with failed states and help to put them back on their feet.

zh: 我们必须从战略角度出发分配发展援助，协助贫困国家经济发展并为其民众提供留在国内的理由。
en: We have to use our development assistance strategically, to help poor countries grow and provide their citizens a reason for staying at home.

zh: 我们还需要针对人口走私制定更为积极的政策，并在必要的情况下寻求联合国安理会决议的支持。
en: We also need more aggressive policies to tackle people smuggling, supported by United Nations Security Council resolutions where necessary.

zh: 我们必须在地中海部署更多的海军资源，并增加用于欧洲边境安全的经费。
en: And we have to deploy more naval resources in the Mediterranean and spend more on Europe’s border security.

zh: 这项工作符合所有人的利益，尤其是非洲和西亚的穷人。
en: Such an effort would be in the interest of everyone, not least the poor in Africa and West Asia.

zh: 在卡梅伦以欧盟成员国的掌舵人身份调查6月底四分五裂的政治制度时，承担起这项工作的责任同样能为他带来好处。
en: As Cameron surveys the broken political crockery at the end of June, taking responsibility for such an effort – at the helm of a country that is an integral part of the EU – would be very much in his interest as well.

zh: 值得为欧洲努力吗？
en: Is Europe Worth the Effort?

zh: 巴黎—1973年，当英国加入当时的欧洲经济共同体时，它是欧洲一体化的殿军。
en: PARIS – When the United Kingdom joined the then-European Economic Community in 1973, it was at the rearguard of European integration.

zh: 即将举行的英国是否保留欧盟成员资格的全民公决所提出的问题则是现在的英国是否是欧洲解体的先锋。
en: The question raised by the UK’s upcoming referendum on continued European Union membership is whether Britain is now at the forefront of Europe’s disintegration.

zh: 这一问题与英国首相卡梅伦最近与其欧盟同侪所达成的无关紧要的协议没有什么关系。
en: The issue has little to do with the insignificant accord that Prime Minister David Cameron recently reached with his EU colleagues.

zh: 事实上，难以置信这一协议会左右6月的英国命运选择。
en: Indeed, it is hard to believe that this agreement will determine Britain’s fateful choice in June.

zh: 根本问题是欧盟成员资格是否仍然能够产生足够多的利益，压倒其所隐含的主权损失。
en: The fundamental issue is whether EU membership still yields large enough benefits to outweigh the loss of sovereignty that it entails.

zh: 这不仅仅是英国需要讨论的问题。
en: This is not a matter for discussion in Britain only.

zh: 但是，对于许多欧盟人来说，这是一个难以启齿的问题，因为欧洲仍然充满着感情色彩。
en: For many in the EU, however, it is a very difficult question to ask, because Europe remains emotionally loaded.

zh: 只有在英国，才会发生来自将它带进欧盟的政党的内阁部长要求离开欧盟的情况。
en: Only in Britain could a cabinet minister from the same party that brought the country into the EU call for exiting it.

zh: 主流德国、法国或西班牙政客都没有胆子公开谈论这一问题，更不用说鼓吹脱离欧盟了。
en: No mainstream German, French, or Spanish politician would dare discuss the matter openly, let alone advocate divorce.

zh: 但这一问题不容忽视。
en: But the question cannot be ignored.

zh: 在大部分欧盟国家，很多人对联盟表示不满，越来越认同民族主义诉求。
en: In most EU countries, large segments of public opinion are dissatisfied with the Union and increasingly sympathetic to nationalistic appeals.

zh: 因此，许多政客的反应是口头上支持欧洲，实际上只注重国家方案。
en: In response, many politicians pay lip service to Europe while emphasizing purely national solutions.

zh: 这一不一致 — — 并且常常相当犬儒主义 — — 的立场让欧洲陷入了一个令人不快的均衡：它不能后退，也无法前进，不能令任何人满意。
en: This inconsistent – and often simply cynical – stance has mired Europe in an unhappy equilibrium: It cannot move backward, it cannot move forward, and it satisfies no one.

zh: 人们希望，激烈的欧盟成员资格争论既然已经开始，那就但愿它是诚实的，能让所有人汲取教训。
en: One hopes that the fierce EU membership debate, now that it has begun, will be honest enough for everyone to learn from it.

zh: 特别是，欧盟成员资格的经济利益是值得严肃讨论的话题。
en: In particular, the economic benefits of EU membership are a matter for serious discussion.

zh: 经济学家将地区一体化描述为规模经济和偏好多样性之间的权衡。
en: Economists describe regional integration as a tradeoff between economies of scale and the diversity of preferences.

zh: 加入一体化进程的国家获得效率和影响力，代价则是在并不十分匹配于它们的选择上做出侦测妥协。
en: By joining, countries gain efficiency and influence, at the cost of having to settle on policies that do not exactly match their choices.

zh: 比如，企业得以进入更大的市场，消费者享受到更低的价格，但监管不再那么遂自己的意。
en: For example, businesses get access to a larger market, and consumers benefit from lower prices, but regulations are less attuned to their liking.

zh: 这就像是分享公寓：你降低了成本，但必须适应室友的习惯。
en: It is like sharing an apartment: you reduce your costs, but you have to adapt to your roommates’ habits.

zh: 在欧洲，偏好的多样性比几十年前降低了不少。
en: In Europe, preferences today are arguably much less dissimilar than they were a few decades ago.

zh: 英国前首相撒切尔夫人和法国前总统密特朗的意识形态分歧远远大于他们的现任继任者。
en: Former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher and former French President François Mitterrand were much further apart ideologically than their current successors.

zh: 诚然，英国人仍然比法国人更倾向于自由市场，但他们之间的差异已经小了很多。
en: True, the British are still more inclined toward free markets than the French, but the gap between them has become much narrower.

zh: 认为20世纪80年代以来我们是越来越看不惯对方的室友是与事实不符的。
en: There is no factual basis for claiming that we have become unhappier roommates since the 1980s.

zh: 欧盟也没有冒险进入不产生增加值的领域。
en: Nor has the EU ventured into domains where it produces no value added.

zh: 第一任卡梅伦政府在2012年进行了一次欧盟资格评估，以确定哪些有利于欧盟，哪些有利于英国。
en: The first Cameron government launched a review of EU competences in 2012 to determine which lie with the EU and which with the UK.

zh: 在进行了全面的公共协商和32次详细报告后，评估结果表明完全没有重要理由应该收回成员资格。
en: A comprehensive public consultation and 32 thorough reports later, the audit has not resulted in any request for significant competence repatriation.

zh: 也许是出于这个原因，英国退出的支持者常常把重点放在地区一体化收益的日益递减上，提出英国自己玩自己的���处要大得多。
en: Perhaps for this reason, Brexit advocates often focus on the diminishing benefits of regional integration and claim that Britain would be much better off playing its cards alone.

zh: 当英国可以与全世界做贸易时，为什么还要和欧洲大陆伙伴谈判？
en: Why bother negotiating with continental partners, when the UK can trade with the whole world?

zh: 新加坡这样的小型开放经济不是活得风生水起吗？
en: Aren’t small, open economies like Singapore thriving?

zh: 对于这一论点，有一些严肃的反对理由。
en: There are serious objections to this argument.

zh: 首先，自由贸易有利于卖衬衫，但服务贸易牵涉到执行的立法和机构（如行业监管当局 ） 。
en: For starters, free trade suffices for selling shirts, but trade in services requires detailed legislation and institutions (such as sector-specific authorities) to enforce it.

zh: 缺少全面的监管规则的话，金融或医疗服务（以及其他）就无法贸易。
en: Absent a comprehensive regulatory apparatus, financial or health-care services, among others, cannot be traded.

zh: 因此，需要的只是消除关税和官样文章的概念完全站不住脚。
en: So the notion that all that is needed is to eliminate tariffs and bureaucratic red tape is pure fiction.

zh: 长于服务业的英国需要欧盟单一市场的机构框架远甚于长于制造业的（比如）波兰。
en: The UK, which is strong in services, needs the institutional framework of the EU single market much more than, say, Poland, which is stronger in goods.

zh: 其次，全球贸易框架本身麻烦重重。
en: Second, the global trading framework is itself in serious trouble.

zh: 最新全球贸易协议乌拉圭回合完成于1994年。
en: The Uruguay Round, the latest global trade agreement, was completed in 1994.

zh: 其公认的后续协议，即多哈发展回合，至今认为结束，可能永远都不会有终点。
en: Its putative successor, the Doha Development Round, has not been completed and probably never will be.

zh: 全球贸易日益依赖双边或地区协议。
en: Global trade increasingly relies on bilateral or regional arrangements.

zh: 据世界贸易组织的数据，目前由267个类似协议已经生效，其中49个包括欧盟。
en: According to the World Trade Organization, 267 such agreements are in force, including 49 involving the EU.

zh: 与流行的感觉相反，全球化并没有让地区安排变得无关紧要，相反，全球化主要依赖的正是地区安排。
en: Contrary to popular perception, globalization has not made regional arrangements irrelevant; on the contrary, it largely relies on them.

zh: 此外，事实上全球化十分脆弱 — — 并且日甚一日。
en: Furthermore, globalization is in fact fragile – and increasingly so.

zh: 二战战后几十年中，美国的领导支持着全球化；但美国本身已不再是多边规则的捍卫者。
en: American leadership buttressed it in the decades after World War II; but the United States no longer regards itself as the guardian of multilateral rules.

zh: 美国试图打造两个大型地区自由贸易区 — — 跨太平洋合作伙伴关系和跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系，两者均不包括中国 — — 这彰显出美国的重点。
en: The US effort to create two mega-regional free-trade zones – the Trans-Pacific Partnership and the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership, neither of which includes China – is indicative of America’s priorities.

zh: 其他主要行动方，从中国到大宗商品生产国，也不耻于动用经济实力。
en: And the other big players, from China to the commodity producers, are not shy about wielding their economic power.

zh: 欧盟固然弱点重重，但它仍然是决定世界形势的主要经济行动方。
en: For all its weaknesses, the EU is a big economic player that participates in shaping the world around it.

zh: 作为标准制定者、谈判者和规则执行者，欧盟的影响力远远大于它的反对者的认识。
en: As a standard-setter, a negotiator, and a rule enforcer, it has considerably more influence than its opponents recognize.

zh: 欧盟本身便是基于规则而成立，因此它是基于规则的经济互相依存的最大支持者。
en: Because it is itself based on rules, it is the strongest champion of rules-based economic interdependence.

zh: 光是出于这些原因，脱离欧盟就必然是非常冒险的赌注。
en: For these reasons alone, to dispense with it would be an adventurous gamble.

zh: 既然理性不支持脱离欧盟，为什么还会出现这个问题？
en: If rational arguments do not support leaving the EU, why has the question arisen?

zh: 部分原因在于欧盟感到沮丧。
en: In part, it is because the EU has disappointed.

zh: 但这应该改革欧盟的理由，而不是离开它的理由。
en: But this is an argument for reforming it, rather than leaving it.

zh: 部分原因在于没有实现跨国民主。
en: In part, it is because transnational democracy has not delivered.

zh: 但解决之道不是放弃，而是让民主起作用。
en: But the answer is not to give up on it, but to make it work.

zh: 部分原因在于将欧洲凝聚在一起的情感纽带不再。
en: In part, it is because the emotional glue binding Europe together has dried up.

zh: 但这是做出变革的理由，而不是回归狭隘的理由。
en: But this a reason to make change, not to pander to parochialism.

zh: 世界的进和退
en: The World’s Ins and Outs

zh: 伦敦 — — 随着英国退欧辩论的日渐升级 ， “ 留欧”和“退欧”已经成为下周举行英国退欧公投所面临的严峻选择。
en: LONDON – As the United Kingdom’s debate about whether to withdraw from the European Union has heated up, “in” and “out” have come to define the stark choice facing voters in next week’s “Brexit” referendum.

zh: 面临这种状况的并非只有英国：世界各国的心态都在支持“退出”和“留下”的宣传攻势中日趋分化。
en: The British are not alone: the world is increasingly divided between the mentalities underpinning support for the “Leave” and “Remain” campaigns.

zh: 民众及其领袖是愿意相信合作将会带来更多的安全与繁荣，还是认定躲在有形或虚拟的高墙之后就能让自己的生活变得更好？
en: Do citizens and their leaders want to work with others toward greater security and prosperity, or do they think that they are better served by isolating themselves behind real or virtual walls?

zh: 秉持“退出”心态的人通过霍布斯镜头观察世界，目睹到处都是被某种力量推动要对他们造成损害的失控的热情。
en: Those with an “out” mindset view the world through a Hobbesian lens, seeing everywhere the danger of people with unregulated passions, driven to do them harm.

zh: 只有无所不能的庞然大物才能保障安全和秩序。
en: Only an omnipotent Leviathan can ensure order and security.

zh: 这其实就是奥地利自由党、希腊金色黎明、英国独立党、匈牙利执政的青年民主党以及遍布欧洲和西方世界的类似势力、更不要说全世界专制和赤裸裸的独裁者所秉承的世界观（虽然极端主义的层次各不相同 ） 。
en: This is essentially the worldview – gradations of extremism notwithstanding – of Austria’s Freedom Party, Greece’s Golden Dawn, the UK Independence Party, Hungary’s ruling Fidesz party, and similar forces throughout Europe and the West, not to mention the world’s autocracies and outright dictatorships.

zh: 恐怖政治及存在于所有社会的极端主义势力是他们的代表。
en: Theirs is a politics of fear and dog-whistle incitement of the extremist forces that exist in every society.

zh: 而且，就像我们在英国退欧辩论和美国总统竞选活动中所目睹的那样，无论是事实还是理性都不能阻止坚决想要“退出”的投票者。
en: And, as we’ve seen in both the UK’s Brexit debate and the United States’ presidential election campaign, neither facts nor reason will dissuade voters with an “out” mindset.

zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖得主丹尼尔·卡尼曼最近对英国退欧阵营的观察结果是 ， “ 他们的理由看起来非常奇怪：主要是基于刺激和愤怒所作出的短期决策。
en: As the Nobel laureate economist Daniel Kahneman recently observed of Britain’s Leave camp, “The arguments look odd: they look short-term and based on irritation and anger.”

zh: ”但这招却可以充分发挥效果。
en: And yet they work.

zh: 在美国总统大选中，选择假定民主党提名人希拉里·克林顿及其共和党对手唐纳德·特朗普反映出“留下”和“退出”之间明白无误的战斗。
en: In the US presidential election, the choice between Hillary Clinton, the presumptive Democratic nominee, and her Republican counterpart, Donald Trump, reflects an unambiguous battle between “in” and “out.”

zh: 在回应不久前奥兰多一家同性恋夜总会发生的大规模枪击事件时，特朗普吹嘘自己在“极端伊斯兰恐怖主义”造成的威胁方面一直是对的。
en: In response to the recent mass shooting at an LGBT nightclub in Orlando, Trump boasted that he had been right all along about the threat posed by “radical Islamic terrorism.”

zh: 而克林顿则恰恰相反，她用英语和西班牙语在演讲中对受害者表达了支持，并进一步强调社团和枪支管控。
en: Clinton, by contrast, offered words of support – in English and Spanish – to the victims, and focused on the community and on the need for gun control.

zh: 凭借仇外言论和对俄罗斯总统普京等独裁者（一位欺压甚至入侵其邻国的煽动者）的喜爱，特朗普成为“退出”心态的卓越代表：夸张、恶意、华而不实并对敌视或违抗者充满敌意（不管对方是他严厉指责并试图打压的媒体，还是审理其诉讼的法官都是这样 ） 。
en: With his xenophobic rhetoric and fondness for despots like Russian President Vladimir Putin (a demagogue who bullies the neighbors he doesn’t invade), Trump epitomizes the “out” mindset: hyperbolic, malicious, pompous, and hostile to all who defy or disagree with him (be it the press, which he berates and tries to block, or judges who preside over his lawsuits).

zh: 值得赞扬的是，某些资深共和党人对这种领导美国人走上孤立和偏执悬崖的努力做出了谴责。
en: Some senior Republicans, to their credit, have disavowed this Pied Piper’s effort to lead Americans over a cliff of isolation and bigotry.

zh: 但还有许多人在面对他对拉丁裔、穆斯林和女性源源不断的侮辱的时候，似乎已经完全无视自己的良心。
en: But many others, confronted with his steady stream of insults directed at Latinos, Muslims, and women, seem to have walled off their consciences.

zh: 众议院议长保罗·瑞安将特朗普的评论形容为种族主义，但却继续为其背书。
en: Paul Ryan, Speaker of the House of Representatives, has called Trump’s comments racist, but continues to endorse him.

zh: 参议院多数党领袖麦康奈尔也同样如此，最引人瞩目的或许莫过于2008年共和党总统提名人约翰·麦凯恩，麦凯恩的服役经历曾遭到特朗普的诽谤，特朗普称麦凯恩“英雄般”地从越南凯旋仅仅是“因为他成了俘虏 ” ， 并声称“我更喜欢那些没有当俘虏的人。 ”
en: So does Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell and, perhaps most remarkably, John McCain, the party’s 2008 presidential nominee, whose military service Trump denigrated, saying that McCain returned from Vietnam “a war hero” only “because he was captured,” adding, “I like people who weren’t captured.”

zh: 另一方面，尽管克林顿被外界普遍视为外交政策领域的“鹰派 ” ， 但她仍然能够理解“融合 ” — —她理解贸易、谈判和妥协的价值。
en: Clinton, on the other hand, though widely perceived as a foreign-policy “hawk,” is still of the “in” mindset – someone who knows the value of trade, discussion, and compromise.

zh: 她还理解“巧实力 ” — —即炸弹并不总是实现目标的最有效的方法。
en: She also understands the value of “smart power” – that bombs aren’t always the most valuable tools to use in pursuit of one’s goals.

zh: 她大概率会继续推动奥巴马总统建立的传统，后者今年来对越南、古巴和日本的访问专注于从困难重重的过去走向充满希望的崭新未来。
en: She would presumably seek to advance the legacy established by President Barack Obama, whose trips to Vietnam, Cuba, and Japan this year focused on moving on from a very difficult past to a new, more hopeful future.

zh: 这种“融入”的心态一次又一次地证明了其自身的价值。
en: This “in” mindset has proved its worth time and again.

zh: 世界从签署条约和接纳合作性安排中获益。
en: The world benefits from entering into treaties and embracing cooperative arrangements.

zh: 通过���其他国家并借助全球机构协力合作，世界各国变得更加安全也更加繁荣。
en: By working in concert with other countries and through global institutions, countries become safer and more prosperous.

zh: 而“退出”心态的获胜似乎将同情、真理和统一视之为退化的肢体 — — 就算从最乐观的角度看也是得不偿失的。
en: A victory for the “out” mindset – which seems to regard compassion, truth, and integrity as if they were vestigial limbs – would be Pyrrhic, at best.

zh: 经济将会萎缩、暴力冲突增加、妇女、少数族裔和记者将受累于“退欧”运动利用恐吓策略鼓动他们之中的极端者。
en: Economies would wither, violent conflict would increase, and women, minorities, and journalists would suffer as “out” movements use scare tactics that encourage the extreme among them.

zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，上述问题发生的同时长期被批评为内向、孤立和自我迷恋的硅谷和其他地方的技术型企业正在以最快的速度“融入 ” 。
en: The irony is that all of this is coming at a time when technology companies in Silicon Valley and beyond, long criticized as inward-looking, isolationist, and self-obsessed, are moving as fast as they can to be “in.”

zh: 蒂姆·库克今年五月也因此成为苹果公司首任出访印度的首席执行官，微软首席执行官萨蒂亚·纳德拉也紧随其后。
en: That’s why Tim Cook in May became Apple’s first CEO to journey to India, and a trip by Microsoft’s CEO, Satya Nadella, followed.

zh: 同样，Facebook首席执行官马克·扎克伯格在3月出访中国前投入了大量的精力来学习普通话。
en: Likewise, Facebook’s CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, devoted considerable effort to learning Mandarin ahead of his trip to China in March.

zh: 企业投资于研发更高效的翻译软件，以便实现在任何地点与任何人都能简单无缝的合作。
en: Companies are investing in building more efficient translation software to make working anywhere, with anyone, simple and seamless.

zh: 全球跨国公司知道要想实现成长和繁荣，它们就必须对本国境外的市场和关系进行建设。
en: Multinationals worldwide know that, to grow and thrive, they must look to markets and relationships beyond their own home countries’ borders.

zh: 适用于全球企业的规律同样适用于国家：那些拒绝“融入”的主体将不可避免地被最终排除。
en: And what is true of global companies applies to countries: those that are not “in” will inevitably be left out.

zh: 英国的民主失败
en: Britain’s Democratic Failure

zh: 坎布里奇—英国投票决定脱离欧盟的真正疯狂之处不在于英国领导人敢于让老百姓权衡欧元成员资格的好处和由此导致的移民压力，而在于这个退出障碍低得可笑，只需要简单多数。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The real lunacy of the United Kingdom’s vote to leave the European Union was not that British leaders dared to ask their populace to weigh the benefits of membership against the immigration pressures it presents. Rather, it was the absurdly low bar for exit, requiring only a simple majority.

zh: 由于投票率只有70%左右，这意味着脱欧阵营只需要36%的合格选民支持就可以得逞。
en: Given voter turnout of 70%, this meant that the leave campaign won with only 36% of eligible voters backing it.

zh: 这不是民主；这是共和政体的俄罗斯轮盘赌。
en: This isn’t democracy; it is Russian roulette for republics.

zh: 一个有着巨大后果的决定 — — 远比修订一国宪法（当然，英国没有成文宪法）后果更大 — — 在没有合适制衡的情况下做出了。
en: A decision of enormous consequence – far greater even than amending a country’s constitution (of course, the United Kingdom lacks a written one) – has been made without any appropriate checks and balances.

zh: 需要一年后再进行一次投票以确认结果吗？
en: Does the vote have to be repeated after a year to be sure?

zh: 不。
en: No.

zh: 需要议会多数支持英国退出吗？
en: Does a majority in Parliament have to support Brexit?

zh: 显然不。
en: Apparently not.

zh: 英国民众真的知道他们在投什么票吗？
en: Did the UK’s population really know what they were voting on?

zh: 显然不。
en: Absolutely not.

zh: 事实上，没人对后果有任何了解，不管是对全球贸易体系中的英国，还是对国内政治稳定的影响。
en: Indeed, no one has any idea of the consequences, both for the UK in the global trading system, or the effect on domestic political stability.

zh: 这恐怕绝非美妙图景。
en: I am afraid it is not going to be a pretty picture.

zh: 提醒一下，天佑西方公民生活在和平时代：改变环境和重点可以通过民主程序而不是对外和对内战争实现。
en: Mind you, citizens of the West are blessed to live in a time of peace: changing circumstances and priorities can be addressed through democratic processes instead of foreign and civil wars.

zh: 但对于不可撤销的、给予国家定义的决定，什么才是民主程序？
en: But what, exactly, is a fair, democratic process for making irreversible, nation-defining decisions?

zh: 在一个雨天以52%的支持率实现脱离真的足够了吗？
en: Is it really enough to get 52% to vote for breakup on a rainy day?

zh: 就持久性和确定偏好（conviction of preferences）而言，大部分社会为寻求离婚的夫妻设置的障碍都要大于首相卡梅伦政府给脱离欧盟的决定所设置的障碍。
en: In terms of durability and conviction of preferences, most societies place greater hurdles in the way of a couple seeking a divorce than Prime Minister David Cameron’s government did on the decision to leave the EU.

zh: 英国退出派不是这一游戏的发明者；此前有过多次先例，包括2014年的苏格兰和1995年的魁北克。
en: Brexiteers did not invent this game; there is ample precedent, including Scotland in 2014 and Quebec in 1995.

zh: 但是，此前俄罗斯轮盘从未转到过子弹。
en: But, until now, the gun’s cylinder never stopped on the bullet.

zh: 这一次转到了子弹，因此是时候反思游戏规则了。
en: Now that it has, it is time to rethink the rules of the game.

zh: 无论如何，在任何时候，通过多数规则达成的任何决定必然是“民主”的，这一思想是对民主的曲解。
en: The idea that somehow any decision reached anytime by majority rule is necessarily “democratic” is a perversion of the term.

zh: 现代民主已经演化出制衡制度以保护少数人的利益和避免做出能带来灾难性后果的信息不足的决定。
en: Modern democracies have evolved systems of checks and balances to protect the interests of minorities and to avoid making uninformed decisions with catastrophic consequences.

zh: 决定越是重大和持久，决策障碍越高。
en: The greater and more lasting the decision, the higher the hurdles.

zh: 因此 ， （ 比如）修订宪法索要克服的障碍一般而言远高于通过支出法案。
en: That’s why enacting, say, a constitutional amendment generally requires clearing far higher hurdles than passing a spending bill.

zh: 但目前脱离与一个国家的国际标准似乎远远要比降低饮酒年龄要低。
en: Yet the current international standard for breaking up a country is arguably less demanding than a vote for lowering the drinking age.

zh: 如今，欧洲面临着一系列后续脱欧投票，一个紧迫的问题是是否有更好的办法做出这些决定。
en: With Europe now facing the risk of a slew of further breakup votes, an urgent question is whether there is a better way to make these decisions.

zh: 我调查了不少著名政治学家，想搞清楚是否存在学术上的共识。 不幸的是，简单的回答是否定的。
en: I polled several leading political scientists to see whether there is any academic consensus; unfortunately, the short answer is no.

zh: 一方面，英国退出决定可能在投票箱中看起来十分简单，但事实上没人知道脱离的结果会带来什么。
en: For one thing, the Brexit decision may have looked simple on the ballot, but in truth no one knows what comes next after a leave vote.

zh: 我们知道的是，在实践中，大部分国家的国家定义决定需要“压倒性多数 ” ， 而不仅仅是51 % 。
en: What we do know is that, in practice, most countries require a “supermajority” for nation-defining decisions, not a mere 51%.

zh: 没有普遍的标准（如60 % ） ，但一般的原则是，最低限度至少要保证多数具有确然稳定性。
en: There is no universal figure like 60%, but the general principle is that, at a bare minimum, the majority ought to be demonstrably stable.

zh: 一个国家不应该基于极其微弱、情绪窗口的短���变化就可以推翻的差距来做出不可推翻的根本性决定。
en: A country should not be making fundamental, irreversible changes based on a razor-thin minority that might prevail only during a brief window of emotion.

zh: 即便此次投票后英国经济不陷入全面衰退（英镑贬值或能缓冲最初的冲击 ） ， 由此产生的经济和政治失序也很有可能让一些投票支持脱欧者感到“买家的后悔 ” 。
en: Even if the UK economy does not fall into outright recession after this vote (the pound’s decline might cushion the initial blow), there is every chance that the resulting economic and political disorder will give some who voted to leave “buyers’ remorse.”

zh: 自远古时代以来，哲学家便试图设计制度以实现多数规则的强度与确保信息灵通的群体在关键性决定中有更大的发言权（更不用说让少数群体的生意被听见）的需要之间的平衡。
en: Since ancient times, philosophers have tried to devise systems to try to balance the strengths of majority rule against the need to ensure that informed parties get a larger say in critical decisions, not to mention that minority voices are heard.

zh: 在古希腊斯巴达的国民大会上，投票通过喝彩声音的高低来体现。
en: In the Spartan assemblies of ancient Greece, votes were cast by acclamation.

zh: 人们通过声音的高低来体现他们的偏好强弱，由一位主持会议的官员仔细聆听，然后宣布结果。
en: People could modulate their voice to reflect the intensity of their preferences, with a presiding officer carefully listening and then declaring the outcome.

zh: 这种方法不完美，但也许比英国公投要好一点。
en: It was imperfect, but maybe better than what just happened in the UK.

zh: 从某些方面看，斯巴达的姊妹城邦雅典堪称最纯粹的民主历史榜样。
en: By some accounts, Sparta’s sister state, Athens, had implemented the purest historical example of democracy.

zh: 所有阶级都拥有平等的选票（尽管只授予男性 ） 。
en: All classes were given equal votes (albeit only males).

zh: 但最终，在一些灾难性战争决定后，雅典人发现需要将更多权力授予独立机构。
en: Ultimately, though, after some catastrophic war decisions, Athenians saw a need to give more power to independent bodies.

zh: 如果要求回答欧元成员资格问题（顺便说一句，其实并没有这一要求 ） ， 英国会怎么做？
en: What should the UK have done if the question of EU membership had to be asked (which by the way, it didn’t)?

zh: 显然，障碍会显著提高；比如，英国退出应该要求（比方说）两次群众投票，相隔至少两年，并随后在下议院以60%以上多数通过。
en: Surely, the hurdle should have been a lot higher; for example, Brexit should have required, say, two popular votes spaced out over at least two years, followed by a 60% vote in the House of Commons.

zh: 如果英国退出仍然获胜，至少我们可以知道这不是民意分裂的一时写照。
en: If Brexit still prevailed, at least we could know it was not just a one-time snapshot of a fragment of the population.

zh: 英国的公投让欧洲陷入了混乱。
en: The UK vote has thrown Europe into turmoil.

zh: 很多事情将取决于世界如何反应以及英国政府如何重组自身。
en: A lot will depend on how the world reacts and how the UK government manages to reconstitute itself.

zh: 一个要点是是不但要盘点结果，也要盘点过程。
en: It is important to take stock not just of the outcome, though, but of the process.

zh: 任何重新制定关于一国边界的长期存在的安排的行动都绝不应该仅仅要求一次性简单多数投票。
en: Any action to redefine a long-standing arrangement on a country’s borders ought to require a lot more than a simple majority in a one-time vote.

zh: 如我们刚刚看到的，当前国际简单多数的规则不啻致乱法宝。
en: The current international norm of simple majority rule is, as we have just seen, a formula for chaos.

zh: 欧洲大众民主的崛起
en: The Rise of Demotic Democracy in Europe

zh: 伦敦—英国投票脱离欧盟的冲击还有待消化。
en: LONDON – The shock of the British vote to leave the European Union has yet to sink in.

zh: 但欧洲领导人必须做好准备迎接后果。
en: Yet European leaders must steel themselves for what is to come.

zh: 事实上，英国退出也许只是未来几年欧洲全民公决狂潮的序曲。
en: In fact, Brexit might be the initial tremor that triggers a tsunami of referenda in Europe in the coming years.

zh: 放眼欧洲，有47个反对党正在扰动政坛。
en: Across Europe, there are 47 insurgent parties turning politics on its head.

zh: 它们正在赢得对政治日程的控制，根据自己的利益来制定日程 — — 并在此过程中赢得权力。
en: They are gaining control of the political agenda, shaping it according to their interests – and winning power in the process.

zh: 在三分之一的欧盟成员国，这类政党已跻身执政联盟，它们的成功驱使主流政党接受了它们的一些立场。
en: In one-third of EU member states, such parties are members of coalition governments, and their success has driven mainstream parties to adopt some of their positions.

zh: 这些政党根基各异，但有一点相同：它们都试图颠覆几十年来决定着欧洲的性质的外交政策共识。
en: Though these parties have very different roots, they all have one thing in common: all are trying to upend the foreign-policy consensus that has defined Europe for several decades.

zh: 它们是疑欧派；它们唾弃北约；它们想关闭边境并停止自由贸易。
en: They are Euroskeptic; they spurn NATO; they want to close their borders and stop free trade.

zh: 它们正在改变政坛面貌，用自身的激愤本土主义对抗它们所鄙夷的精英的世界主义，以此取代传统左右之争。
en: They are changing the face of politics, replacing traditional left-right battles with clashes pitting their own angry nativism against the cosmopolitanism of the elites they disdain.

zh: 这些政党的选择武器便是全民公决，通过全民公决，它们可以激发对它们所钟爱的问题的群众支持。
en: These parties’ weapon of choice is the referendum, with which they can whip up popular support for their pet issues.

zh: 据欧洲外交关系委员会数据，整个欧盟由18个国家存在32项全民公决要求。
en: According to the European Council on Foreign Relations, 32 referenda are being demanded in 18 countries across the EU.

zh: 其中一些，如丹麦人民党（People’s Party ） ， 希望效仿英国榜样举行欧盟成员资格公决。
en: Some, such as the Danish People’s Party, want to follow the United Kingdom’s lead and hold a vote on EU membership.

zh: 也有一些希望退出欧元区，阻挠与美国的跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系（TTIP ） ， 或限制劳动力流动。
en: Others want to escape from the eurozone, block the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP) with the United States, or restrict labor mobility.

zh: 欧盟难民安置机制是一个特别巨大的分歧因素。
en: The EU’s refugee relocation scheme has proved to be particularly divisive.

zh: 匈牙利总理欧尔班已经宣布将举行全民公决来裁定配额方案。
en: Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán has declared that he will hold a referendum on the proposed quotas.

zh: 波兰反对党Kukiz ’15正在为其自身的该问题全民公决征集签名。
en: And the Polish opposition party Kukiz ’15 has been collecting signatures for its own referendum on the issue.

zh: 通过直接民主将权力还给群众也许是这些政党最具革命性的计划。
en: Handing power back to the masses through direct democracy may well be these parties’ most revolutionary proposition.

zh: 事实上，这反映出人们理解最近几年推动全球群众反抗浪潮的不满，在阿拉伯世界，这些反抗引发了真正的革命。
en: Indeed, it reflects an understanding of the frustrations that have driven a global wave of popular protests in recent years – protests that, in the Arab world, sparked actual revolutions.

zh: 同样的反抗精神驱使（比如）西班牙人、希腊人和纽约人走上街头 — — 当然，要求有所不同 — — 它正在助长对这些新全民公决以及提出公决的新兴政党的支持。
en: The same spirit of protest that drove, say, Spaniards, Greeks, and New Yorkers to take to the streets – with different demands, to be sure – is fueling support for these new referenda and the insurgent parties that are bringing them about.

zh: 这是一场噩梦，不但对老牌政党是如此，对民主治理也是如此。
en: This is a nightmare not only for established parties, but also for democratic governance.

zh: 加利福尼亚州的全民公决经验表明，公众常常会支持互相矛盾的东西 — — 比如降低税收和增加福利项目；或环境保护和更加廉价的汽油。
en: As California’s experience with referenda has shown, the public will often vote for contradictory things – for example, lower taxes and more welfare programs, or environmental protection and cheaper gas.

zh: 但对欧盟来说，这一动态的挑战性要显著得多；事实上，这颠覆了欧盟的根基。
en: But for the EU, this dynamic is exponentially more challenging; indeed, it overturns the EU’s foundations.

zh: 毕竟，欧盟是代议制民主的终极表达。
en: The EU is, after all, the ultimate expression of representative democracy.

zh: 它是一个开明机构，将个体权利、少数群体保护和市场经济作为其核心自由价值。
en: It is an enlightened body that places at its core liberal values such as individual rights, the protection of minorities, and a market-based economy.

zh: 带欧盟所依赖的代表的层次造成了一种感觉，即某种“超精英”在主宰，远远超然于普通民众之上。
en: But the layers of representation on which the EU relies have created the sense that a kind of “Über-elite” is running things, far removed from ordinary citizens.

zh: 这给了民族主义政党的反欧盟活动以完美的目标。
en: This has given nationalist parties the perfect target for their anti-EU campaigns.

zh: 此外，恐慌制造了移民和贸易等问题，这些问题吸引沮丧或焦虑选民的力量十分强大。
en: Add to that fear mongering about issues like immigration and trade, and their ability to attract frustrated or anxious voters is strong.

zh: 两个版本的欧洲 — — 外交（diplomatic）和大众（demotic ） — —正在针锋相对。
en: Two visions of Europe – the diplomatic and the demotic – are now facing off against each other.

zh: 外交的欧洲由欧盟之父让·莫内提出，它将敏感的大问题拿到群众政治范围之外，将它们缩小为可管理的技术性问题，外交官能够通过闭门商谈的官僚妥协解决。
en: The diplomatic Europe, incarnated by EU founding father Jean Monnet, took big, sensitive questions out of the sphere of popular politics and reduced them to manageable technical issues that diplomats could address through bureaucratic compromises behind closed doors.

zh: 大众欧洲的代表是领衔英国退出运动的英国独立党（Independence Party ） ， 它们就像莫内的反面，抓住TTIP或乌克兰入盟协定等外交妥协，将它们内部政治化。
en: The demotic Europe, exemplified by the UK Independence Party, which helped spearhead Brexit, is like Monnet in reverse, taking diplomatic compromises like the TTIP or the association agreement with Ukraine, and intentionally politicizing them.

zh: 外交的欧洲事关寻找妥协，而大众的欧洲事关极端化。
en: Whereas diplomatic Europe is about finding reconciliation, demotic Europe is about polarization.

zh: 外交是双赢，直接民主是零和。
en: Diplomacy is win-win; direct democracy is zero-sum.

zh: 外交试图降低温度；大众范式则提高温度。
en: Diplomacy tries to lower the temperature; the demotic paradigm raises it.

zh: 外交官可以彼此合作，全民公决则是两分和固定的，没有政治回旋余地和解决政治问题所需要的创造性妥协的空间。
en: Diplomats can work with one another; referenda are binary and fixed, leaving none of the political wiggle room and scope for creative compromise needed to resolve political problems.

zh: 在大众的欧洲，凝聚力无从谈起。
en: In demotic Europe, solidarity is impossible.

zh: 欧洲背离外交始于十多年前，建立欧洲宪法的条约被法国和荷兰的群众公决所拒绝。
en: Europe’s shift away from diplomacy began more than a decade ago, when the Treaty establishing a Constitution for Europe was rejected in popular referenda in France and the Netherlands.

zh: 这一结果可能让欧盟彻底告别了条约签订，这意味着未来一体化的希望大为渺茫。
en: That outcome may have put the EU out of the treaty-making business altogether, meaning that hopes of future integration may well be dashed.

zh: 但是，在英国退出的情况下，未来一体化已不再是欧洲最大的担忧，相反，欧盟必须与日益强大的破坏既有一体化成就、试图让欧洲开倒车的力量角力。
en: But, in the wake of Brexit, future integration is not Europe’s biggest concern. Instead, it must contend with the increasingly powerful forces undermining the integration that has been achieved, attempting to push Europe backward.

zh: 当然，你只要回忆一下欧盟成立之前的情况，就可以意识到这条路有多危险。
en: Of course, one need only recall what was there before the EU to realize just how dangerous this path may be.

zh: 在新的“否决政体”时代的欧洲，作为开明前瞻的欧洲工程创立之基的外交不可能起作用，这让欧盟变得不可治理。
en: In this new era of “vetocracy” in Europe, the diplomacy that underpinned the creation of the enlightened and forward-looking European project cannot function, leaving the EU ungovernable.

zh: 疑欧派已经在英国得逞，否决政体将因此变得更加强大。
en: Now that the Euroskeptics have gotten their way in the UK, vetocracy will become stronger than ever.

zh: 在贸易规则或移民政策等问题上进行直接投票将伤及欧洲代议制民主，正如在成员资格问题上直接投票伤及欧盟本身。
en: Direct votes on issues like trade rules or immigration policy will gut Europe’s representative democracy, just as direct votes on membership threaten to gut the EU itself.

zh: 诺贝尔文学奖得主萨拉马戈（José Saramago）写过一篇流行的小说，在这篇小说中，伊比利亚半岛脱离欧洲大陆漂走了。
en: In a popular novel by the Nobel laureate José Saramago, the Iberian Peninsula breaks off from the European mainland and drifts away.

zh: 随着全民公决的海啸席卷欧洲，也许这将成为先见之明。
en: With a tsunami of plebiscites bearing down on the continent, this may turn out to be a prescient metaphor.

zh: 英国退出欧盟的经济后果
en: The Economic Consequences of Brexit

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 那些力争英国退出欧盟的人声称，此举会令他们的国家都更自由也更富裕。
en: LONDON – Those campaigning for Britain to exit the European Union claim that doing so would make their country both freer and richer.

zh: 他们断言脱盟之后，英国可能很快与欧盟谈妥一项专属协议，可以在享受所自由贸易优势的同时摒除作为欧盟成员国所产生的成本；与其他国家签订更有利的贸易协定；并获得摆脱繁琐欧盟法规所产生的巨大好处。
en: They assert that after “Brexit”, the UK could quickly negotiate a bespoke agreement with the EU that offers all the benefits of free trade without the costs of EU membership; strike better trade deals with other countries; and reap huge benefits from scrapping burdensome EU regulations.

zh: 但这，仅仅是种错觉。
en: But this is a delusion.

zh: 事实上，脱盟将为英国带来巨大的经济成本。
en: In fact, Brexit would entail big economic costs for Britain.

zh: 旷日持久且必定严苛的分离程序所导致的不确定性和破坏会抑制投资和增长。
en: The uncertainty and disruption of drawn-out and doubtless acrimonious divorce proceedings would depress investment and growth.

zh: 永久分离会减少贸易，外商投资和人口迁移，从而对竞争力，生产力增长和生活水平造成负面影响。
en: Permanent separation would reduce trade, foreign investment, and migration, hurting competition, productivity growth, and living standards.

zh: 此外“独立”还将剥夺英国对未来欧盟改革 — — 包括单一服务业市场的最终构建 — — 的影响力，这些都是英国本该从中受益的改革。
en: And “independence” would deprive Britain of influence over future EU reforms – notably, the completion of the single market in services – from which it would benefit.

zh: 根据伦敦政治经济学院经济绩效研究中心的估算，英国因减少对欧盟贸易而产生的长期成本可能相当于GDP的9.5 ％ ， 而外国投资下降的影响则可能超过GDP的3.4 ％ 。
en: The London School of Economics’ Centre for Economic Performance calculates that the long-term costs to Britain of lower trade with the EU could be as high as 9.5% of GDP, while the fall in foreign investment could cost 3.4% of GDP or more.

zh: 仅仅这两项成本就将缩小脱盟的潜在收益。
en: Those costs alone dwarf the potential gains from Brexit.

zh: 英国对欧盟预算的净贡献额只相当于去年GDP的0.35 ％ ， 而由于英国的劳动力和产品市场本来就已经享有极高的自由度，因此摆脱欧盟法规会带来的好处也极为有限。
en: Britain’s net contribution to the EU budget amounted to only 0.35% of GDP last year, and scrapping EU regulation would bring limited benefits, because the UK’s labor and product markets are already among the freest in the world.

zh: 退出进程也将产生长期的不确定性，官方程序上这个“长期”指得是两年。
en: The exit process would generate prolonged uncertainty. Officially, it is meant to take two years.

zh: 但它可能需要更长的时间。
en: But it would probably take much longer.

zh: 在上世纪80年代，格陵兰岛（5万人口）的退出谈判就花了三年时间，而且只存在渔业这么一个争议点。
en: In the 1980s, it took three years to negotiate the exit of Greenland (population: 50,000), and the only controversial issue was fish.

zh: 而英国这个拥有6400万人口的欧盟第二大经济体如果要退出，情况肯定会更为复杂。
en: Extricating Britain (the EU’s second-largest economy, with a population of 64 million) would be far more complex.

zh: 此外，与英国签订的任何新经济关系协议都将需要余下的27个欧盟成员国达成一致。
en: Moreover, any agreement on a new economic relationship with the UK would require unanimity among the EU’s 27 remaining members.

zh: 同时英国也不得不重新 — — 而且是从头开始 — — 与欧盟就50多项贸易协议展开谈判。
en: And Britain would also have to renegotiate – from scratch – the 50-plus trade deals that the EU has with other countries.

zh: 所有这一切都需要很长的时间。
en: All of this would take a long time.

zh: 在此期间，英国的贸易规则和国内规章都难以落地，投资和就业决策都将被推迟或取消，英镑直线下跌。
en: In the meantime, Britain’s trading rules and domestic regulations would be up in the air. Investment and employment decisions would be postponed or canceled.

zh: 那些投钱支撑英国经常账户赤字 — — 在去年最后一个季度达到GDP的7 ％ — —的外国投资者可能会推高对英国资产的风险溢价，而更糟糕的情况则是撤离。
en: The pound would plummet. The foreign investors financing Britain’s current-account deficit – which hit 7% of GDP in the final quarter of last year – might drive up the risk premium on UK assets or, worse, pull out.

zh: 所有这些都将削弱经济增长，破坏政府的财政计划。
en: All of that would weaken economic growth, jeopardizing the government’s fiscal plans.

zh: 一旦协议签订下来，英国与欧盟和全球市场对接的渠道将恶化。
en: Once the agreements were made, Britain would have worse access to both EU and global markets.

zh: 在经济上，最少痛苦的选择是寻求像挪威，冰岛和列支敦士登那样成为欧洲经济区成员。
en: Economically, the least painful option would be to seek membership of the European Economic Area, along with Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein.

zh: 尽管存在海关管制以及其他类似原产地规则这样的贸易壁垒，但这将提供一条进入欧洲单一市场（不参与的欧盟农业和渔业政策）的近乎全方位的渠道。
en: That would provide almost full access to the single market (with opt-outs from EU agriculture and fisheries policies), albeit with customs controls and other trade barriers such as rules-of-origin requirements.

zh: 但在政治上，欧洲经济区成员资格将是一项不公正的待遇，因为英国将必须在诸如消费者保护，环境和社会政策领域遵守单一市场规则和立法 — — 而在制定这些法律法规的过程中不享有任何发言权。
en: Politically, though, EEA membership would be a raw deal. Britain would have to comply with single-market rules and legislation in areas such as consumer protection, the environment, and social policy – rules that it would have no say in creating.

zh: 英国还必须缴纳欧盟预算，却无法享受任何支出返还。
en: It would also have to contribute to the EU budget, without receiving any spending in return.

zh: 它还必须允许欧盟公民自由进入，这在政治上足以令大多数脱盟支持者苦恼不已。
en: And it would have to allow EU citizens free entry, a political bugbear for most Brexit supporters.

zh: 鉴于脱盟的关键动机是恢复该国所谓丧失了的主权，一场英国没有发言权却必须掏钱和服从的交易显然让人难以接受。
en: Given that the key motivation for Brexit is to restore the country’s supposedly lost sovereignty, a deal that gives the UK no say, but requires that it pay and obey, would be deeply unpalatable.

zh: 如果像美国和中国那样根据世界贸易组织规则与欧盟进行交易的话会受到最少的政治约束。
en: Trading with the EU according to World Trade Organization rules, as the United States and China do, would involve the fewest political constraints.

zh: 英国将可以任意将吃苦耐劳且纳税的欧盟移民拒之门外，但欧盟也会反过来限制英国移民进出，一来一去就对英国人造成了两道伤害。
en: Britain would be free to keep out hard-working, taxpaying EU migrants. But this would entail reciprocal EU controls on UK migrants, harming Britons twice over.

zh: 这种做法也将意味着欧盟对英国商品征收进口关税 — — 包括10％的汽车出口关税 — — 以及非关税壁垒。
en: This approach would also entail import tariffs on British goods – including a 10% duty on its car exports to the EU – as well as non-tariff barriers.

zh: 总部设在英国的金融机构将失去自由进入欧盟的权利。
en: UK-based financial institutions would lose their passport to export freely to the EU.

zh: 一旦英国丧失了通往拥有16万亿美元规模和5亿消费者的欧盟单一市场的全面路径，外国投资将下降。
en: And without full access to the $16 trillion EU single market, with its 500 million consumers, foreign investment would drop.

zh: 连类似瑞士到加拿大模式这类中转选项都比英国更具吸引力。
en: Intermediate options, from the Swiss to the Canadian model, are scarcely more appealing.

zh: 脱盟支持者声称英国可以签订专属协议，只选择那些有利于自身的规定。
en: Brexit supporters claim that Britain could strike its own special deal, cherry picking the provisions it likes.

zh: 他们认为英国有谈判的优势，因为它从欧盟的进口额超过了出口额。
en: The UK would have the whip hand, they argue, because it buys more from the EU than it sells in return.

zh: 但这也不过是种妄想。
en: But this, too, is a delusion.

zh: 美国也存在与欧盟的贸易赤字，但也未能在跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系协定谈判中占据统治地位。
en: The US also has a trade deficit with the EU, yet it doesn’t get to dictate terms in the negotiations over the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership.

zh: 此外，英国对欧盟的出口占了自身GDP的13 ％ ， 显然比欧盟对英国的出口（占GDP的3 ％ ） 更要紧。
en: Moreover, exports to the EU, at 13% of GDP, matter more to the UK than exports to Britain (just 3% of GDP) do to the EU.

zh: 总之，主导权在欧盟手里 — — 而且肯定会处处为难英国。
en: In short, the EU would call the shots – and doubtless be tough with the UK.

zh: 其它许多经济参与者 — — 德国的汽车制造商，法国的农民以及欧盟内部的各大金融中心 — — 无不想阻挠他们的英国竞争对手。
en: Many economic actors – from German car manufacturers to French farmers to financial centers around the EU – would want to hamper their British competitors.

zh: 而欧盟各国政府都会想惩罚英国，因为他们知道与英国天鹅绒式和平分手将令法国极右翼国民阵线党 — — 该党已经号召要举行脱盟公投 — — 这类反欧盟政党士气大涨。
en: For their part, EU governments would want to punish Britain, not least because they know that a velvet divorce with Britain would bolster anti-EU parties, such as France’s far-right National Front, which has already called for a referendum on EU membership.

zh: 此外英国在与非欧盟国家的新贸易谈判上也很可能遭遇更严苛的条款。
en: Britain’s new trade deals with non-EU countries would also probably involve worse terms.

zh: 虽然英国将不会受到欧盟经济保护主义利益的束缚，但其更小规模的经济，很大程度上开放的市场，以及对交易的渴望都将削弱其影响力。
en: While the UK wouldn’t be hamstrung by protectionist interests in the EU, its smaller economy, largely open markets, and desperation for deals would weaken its clout.

zh: 事实上美国已表示自身不存在与英国谈判贸易协定的迫切意愿。
en: Indeed, the US has stated that it has no immediate interest in negotiating a trade deal with Britain.

zh: 而当前美国总统竞选活动中的保护主义基调表明，未来几年内都不会看到太多的贸易自由化举措。
en: And the protectionist tone of the current US presidential election campaign suggests that the next few years will not see much trade liberalization.

zh: 考虑脱盟所产生的所有经济影响是相当复杂的。
en: Thinking through all the economic implications of Brexit is complicated.

zh: 但底线很简单：离开欧盟只会让英国的境况变得更糟。
en: But the bottom line is simple: Leaving the EU would make Britain much worse off.

zh: 英国退出与欧洲的未来
en: Brexit and the Future of Europe

zh: 纽约—我认为，英国与欧盟之间的协议已是最为有利的了，它身为共同市场成员而不属于欧元区，并且保有诸多其他不实行欧盟规则的选择权。
en: NEW YORK – Britain, I believe, had the best of all possible deals with the European Union, being a member of the common market without belonging to the euro and having secured a number of other opt-outs from EU rules.

zh: 饶是如此，仍不足以阻止英国选民选择脱离。
en: And yet that was not enough to stop the United Kingdom’s electorate from voting to leave.

zh: 为什么？
en: Why?

zh: 答案可以从“英国退出”全民公决前几个月所进行的民意调查中一窥端倪。
en: The answer could be seen in opinion polls in the months leading up to the “Brexit” referendum.

zh: 欧洲移民危机和英国退出互相强化。
en: The European migration crisis and the Brexit debate fed on each other.

zh: “脱欧”阵营抓住恶化的难民状况 — — 成千上万寻求庇护者在加莱集中，不惜一切代价要进入英国，诸如此类符号化的骇人图片 — — 煽动对来自其他欧盟成员国的“失控”的移民的恐慌。
en: The “Leave” campaign exploited the deteriorating refugee situation – symbolized by frightening images of thousands of asylum-seekers concentrating in Calais, desperate to enter Britain by any means necessary – to stoke fear of “uncontrolled” immigration from other EU member states.

zh: 而欧洲当局推迟了重要的难民政策决定，以避免对英国全民公决造成消极影响，从而让加莱等地的乱象持久持续。
en: And the European authorities delayed important decisions on refugee policy in order to avoid a negative effect on the British referendum vote, thereby perpetuating scenes of chaos like the one in Calais.

zh: 德国总理默克尔决定洞开国门迎接难民，这是一个鼓舞人心的姿态，但考虑欠妥，因为这样做没有考虑到拉动因素。
en: German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s decision to open her country’s doors wide to refugees was an inspiring gesture, but it was not properly thought out, because it ignored the pull factor.

zh: 寻求庇护者的猛然涌入干扰了全体欧盟人民的日常生活。
en: A sudden influx of asylum-seekers disrupted people in their everyday lives across the EU.

zh: 此外，控制力不足还造成了恐慌，影响到所有人：本地居民，负责公共安全的当局、以及难民本身。
en: The lack of adequate controls, moreover, created panic, affecting everyone: the local population, the authorities in charge of public safety, and the refugees themselves.

zh: 这也为仇外反欧政党的迅速崛起创造了条件 — — 比如英国脱欧阵营领袖独立党（Independence Party ） — —因为国家政府和欧洲机构似乎无力应对这场危机。
en: It has also paved the way for the rapid rise of xenophobic anti-European parties – such as the UK Independence Party, which spearheaded the Leave campaign – as national governments and European institutions seem incapable of handling the crisis.

zh: 如今，许多人所担心的灾难情景成为了现实，欧盟解体实际已经无可挽回。
en: Now the catastrophic scenario that many feared has materialized, making the disintegration of the EU practically irreversible.

zh: 退出欧盟的英国可能会比其他国家相对状况好一些，也可能差一些，但在短期和中期，其经济和人民必定会蒙受巨大的损失。
en: Britain eventually may or may not be relatively better off than other countries by leaving the EU, but its economy and people stand to suffer significantly in the short to medium term.

zh: 公决之后，英镑立即下跌至三十多年来的最低水平，在漫长而复杂的脱欧政治和经济谈判进行期间，全球金融市场可能一直保持动荡。
en: The pound plunged to its lowest level in more than three decades immediately after the vote, and financial markets worldwide are likely to remain in turmoil as the long, complicated process of political and economic divorce from the EU is negotiated.

zh: 对实体经济所造成的后果只有2007—2008年的金融危机才能与之相提并论。
en: The consequences for the real economy will be comparable only to the financial crisis of 2007-2008.

zh: 这一过程必然还将充满进一步的不确定性和政治风险，因为它所牵涉到的不仅仅是英国的实际或想象中的优势，而是整个欧洲工程的存亡。
en: That process is sure to be fraught with further uncertainty and political risk, because what is at stake was never only some real or imaginary advantage for Britain, but the very survival of the European project.

zh: 英国退出将打开欧盟内部其他反欧力量的防洪门。
en: Brexit will open the floodgates for other anti-European forces within the Union.

zh: 事实上，英国公决结果一公布，法国国民阵线就提出要“法国退出 ” ， 而荷兰民粹主义者吉尔特·怀尔德斯（Geert Wilder）也在鼓吹“荷兰退出 ” 。
en: Indeed, no sooner was the referendum’s outcome announced than France’s National Front issued a call for “Frexit,” while Dutch populist Geert Wilders promoted “Nexit.”

zh: 此外，英国本身亦有可能不保。
en: Moreover, the UK itself may not survive.

zh: 苏格兰人一边倒地支持留在欧盟，可以预期，它将再次争取独立，而在同样支持留欧的北爱尔兰，一些官员已经提出要和爱尔兰共和国合并。
en: Scotland, which voted overwhelmingly to remain in the EU, can be expected to make another attempt to gain its independence, and some officials in Northern Ireland, where voters also backed Remain, have already called for unification with the Republic of Ireland.

zh: 欧盟对英国退出的反应很有可能是另一个隐患。
en: The EU’s response to Brexit could well prove to be another pitfall.

zh: 欧洲领导人急切地想打消其他成员国效仿英国的念头，可能不会向英国提供有助于减轻脱欧痛苦的条件 — — 特别是在进入欧洲统一市场方面。
en: European leaders, eager to deter other member states from following suit, may be in no mood to offer the UK terms – particularly concerning access to Europe’s single market – that would soften the pain of leaving.

zh: 欧盟贡献了英国贸易额的半壁江山，出口商受到的影响可能将是灾难性的（尽管拥有更具竞争力的汇率 ） 。
en: With the EU accounting for half of British trade turnover, the impact on exporters could be devastating (despite a more competitive exchange rate).

zh: 此外，未来几年金融机构也将把业务和人手调往欧元区金融枢纽，伦敦金融城（以及伦敦房地产市场）将无法避免阵痛。
en: And, with financial institutions relocating their operations and staff to eurozone hubs in the coming years, the City of London (and London’s housing market) will not be spared the pain.

zh: 但对欧洲的影响可能要糟糕得多。
en: But the implications for Europe could be far worse.

zh: 成员国之间的紧张状况已经达到了一个极限，不仅是因为难民问题，也是因为欧元区内部债权国和债务国之间的极端对立。
en: Tensions among member states have reached a breaking point, not only over refugees, but also as a result of exceptional strains between creditor and debtor countries within the eurozone.

zh: 与此同时，法国和德国的弱势领导人现在全部精力都集中在国内问题上。
en: At the same time, weakened leaders in France and Germany are now squarely focused on domestic problems.

zh: 在意大利，英国退出公决导致股市下跌10 % ， 这清楚地表明它极易受到全面银行危机的冲击 — — 这很可能导致民粹主义的五星运动（Five Star Movement，刚刚赢得罗马市长选举）早至明年就上台掌权。
en: In Italy, a 10% fall in the stock market following the Brexit vote clearly signals the country’s vulnerability to a full-blown banking crisis – which could well bring the populist Five Star Movement, which has just won the mayoralty in Rome, to power as early as next year.

zh: 所有这些对于严肃的欧盟改革计划来说都不是好兆头。 欧盟改革计划必须包括一个真正的银行联盟，一个有限的财政联盟，以及大大增强的民主问责机制。
en: None of this bodes well for a serious program of eurozone reform, which would have to include a genuine banking union, a limited fiscal union, and much stronger mechanisms of democratic accountability.

zh: 时间也不利于欧洲，因为来自土耳其和俄罗斯（两国都在利用欧洲的不和）等国的外部压力将让欧洲内部政治冲突更加复杂。
en: And time is not on Europe’s side, as external pressures from the likes of Turkey and Russia – both of which are exploiting the discord to their advantage – compound Europe’s internal political strife.

zh: 这就是我们今天的处境。
en: That is where we are today.

zh: 全体欧洲，包括英国，都将因为失去共同市场和成立欧盟来保护的共同价值而蒙受损失。
