en: All of Europe, including Britain, would suffer from the loss of the common market and the loss of common values that the EU was designed to protect.

zh: 但欧盟实际已经残缺，不再满足公民的需要和渴望。
en: Yet the EU truly has broken down and ceased to satisfy its citizens’ needs and aspirations.

zh: 欧盟正在走向无序解体，将让欧洲面临比欧盟从未存在过更加糟糕的境地。
en: It is heading for a disorderly disintegration that will leave Europe worse off than where it would have been had the EU not been brought into existence.

zh: 但我们决不能放弃。
en: But we must not give up.

zh: 诚然，欧盟是一个有缺陷的结构。
en: Admittedly, the EU is a flawed construction.

zh: 英国退出后，所有坚信作为欧盟建立基础的价值和原则的人都必须同心协力，通过彻底的结构重组来拯救欧盟。
en: After Brexit, all of us who believe in the values and principles that the EU was designed to uphold must band together to save it by thoroughly reconstructing it.

zh: 我相信，随着未来几周和几个月英国退出的后果逐渐显现，更多的人将加入我们的行列。
en: I am convinced that as the consequences of Brexit unfold in the weeks and months ahead, more and more people will join us.

zh: 有无英国参加的欧洲一体化
en: European Integration With or Without Britain

zh: 华盛顿 — — 在英国首相戴维·卡梅伦2月与欧盟就经过修改的英国成员资格达成一致时，他坚持要求欧盟应获得“多币种联盟”的正式承认。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – When British Prime Minister David Cameron agreed with the European Union in February on revised terms for the United Kingdom’s membership, he insisted that the EU be recognized officially as a “multi-currency union.”

zh: 因为欧洲一体化在货币和其他问题上都存在明确的限制，卡梅伦认为他应当可以赢得多数民众对这项协议的支持 — — 从而在6月23日英国举行的全民公投中达到留在欧盟的目的。
en: With clear limits on European integration in place, on currency and other issues, Cameron believed that he would be able to win a popular majority in favor of the deal – and thus of remaining in the EU – when the UK holds its referendum on June 23.

zh: 但协议不仅没有在这方面做出明确的表述，反而用扭曲的语言来避免发布这样的正式声明 — — 以及随之而来的必不可少的解释。
en: Yet, rather than providing such clarity, the pact uses contorted language to avoid such an official declaration – and the explanations that would have to come with it.

zh: 可以肯定，2月决议的确给了卡梅伦足够的筹码组织反对英国退欧的活动。
en: To be sure, the February decision did give Cameron enough to enable him to campaign against Brexit.

zh: 因为特别指出英国和丹麦没有义务采用欧元，卡梅伦的同行们确实有效确认了欧盟作为“多货币联盟”的地位。
en: By specifying that the UK and Denmark are under no obligation to adopt the euro, Cameron’s counterparts did effectively confirm the EU’s status as a multi-currency union.

zh: 但决议同时重申了建立“以欧元为货币的”欧盟的目标，并再次重申了条约规定，要求其他非欧元区国家（如保加利亚和波兰）必须在满足预设条件时采用欧元。
en: But the decision also reiterated the goal of creating an EU “whose currency is the euro,” and reaffirmed treaty provisions stipulating that other non-euro states, such as Bulgaria and Poland, must adopt the euro when they meet the pre-determined conditions.

zh: （瑞典并没有永久退出，并且已经满足了采用欧元的条件，却不知何故成功地避免了加入货币联盟。 ）
en: (Sweden has no permanent opt-out, and does meet the conditions for euro adoption, yet somehow manages to avoid joining the monetary union.)

zh: 这样的模棱两可是因为不愿或不能清晰描述多货币联盟将如何发挥长期作用。
en: That ambiguity was born of an unwillingness – or inability – to provide a clear description of how a multi-currency union will function in the long term.

zh: 这是个很难但却必须回答的问题，无论公投最终得出什么样的结果。
en: It is a tough question – one that will have to be addressed, regardless of the referendum’s outcome.

zh: 毕竟，如果英国选民选择退出欧盟，那么让英国留在统一市场的类似问题还将在后“英国退欧”谈判中涉及到。
en: After all, if British voters choose to leave the EU, a similar problem would arise in any post-“Brexit” negotiation to keep the UK in the single market.

zh: 现在已经达成普遍共识，即承认随着时间的推移，欧元区将要建立更加一体化的经济治理系统。
en: There is now a general consensus that, over time, the eurozone will need to build more integrated economic governance systems.

zh: 事实上，多数经济学家认同任何货币联盟所需要的不仅是银行业联盟（上述联盟目前在欧元区已经成立 ） ， 并且还需要更大规模的财政政策协调，以弥补独立货币政策和灵活汇率政策缺失的不足。
en: Indeed, most economists agree that any monetary union needs not only a banking union, which is now being established in the eurozone, but also greater fiscal-policy coordination, to compensate for the lack of independent monetary policies and flexible exchange rates.

zh: 政界人士，至少那些代表主流温和派的政界人士同样支持朝着财政一体化的转型。
en: Politicians, too, support the shift toward greater fiscal integration – at least those who represent the moderate mainstream.

zh: 德国保守派财政部长沃尔夫冈·朔伊布勒，法国中左翼经济部长马克隆和意大利中间派财政部长帕多安都曾提出任命统一欧元区财政部长的不同版本。
en: Germany’s conservative finance minister, Wolfgang Schäuble, France’s center-left Economy Minister Emmanuel Macron, and Italy’s centrist Finance Minister Pier Carlo Padoan, have all called for versions of a common eurozone finance minister.

zh: 分歧主要在于一体化应采取何种形式。
en: Where the disagreement lies is in the form integration should take.

zh: 德国认为强制落实行为准则的关键是财政协调，而法国和意大利则认为应更多建立普遍的风险管理机制，如欧洲债券或分摊成本的失业保险。
en: Germany considers fiscal coordination to be critical to enforcing firm rules of conduct, while France and Italy would like to include more mechanisms for common risk management, such as Eurobonds or cost sharing for unemployment insurance.

zh: 显然，需要就这个问题找到平衡点。
en: Clearly, a balance will need to be struck.

zh: 要想满足德国的要求，就必须以强大的财政规则作为扩大一体化的基础。
en: To satisfy Germany, stronger fiscal rules must form the foundation of greater integration.

zh: 但上述规则必须强化逆周期性和平衡性，从而迫使顺差国和逆差国同步削减不平衡现象。
en: But such rules must entail greater counter-cyclicality and more symmetry, forcing surplus and deficit countries alike to reduce imbalances.

zh: 不仅如此，上述管理架构还必须支持有效的风险分担并制定明确的欧元区预算，以此来满足南部欧洲成员国的要求。
en: Moreover, the framework will need to support more effective risk sharing and a distinct eurozone budget, as the southern member states demand.

zh: 此外还需进行制度和法律改革，包括成立某种形式的欧元区议会及财政部，以便为这项事业提供合法性。
en: Institutional and legal changes, including the establishment of some kind of eurozone parliament and treasury, will also be needed, in order to provide legitimacy to the endeavor.

zh: 实现这一切是确保欧盟成为有效多币种联盟的关键。
en: Achieving all of this is essential to enable the EU to function as an effective multi-currency union.

zh: 卡梅伦像其前任 — — 参与欧盟创立但却阻止英国加入的戈登·布朗一样，承认哪怕仅仅为了英国最重要的出口市场经济表现强劲对英国有利，也有必要推进欧元区的进一步融合。
en: Cameron, like his predecessor Gordon Brown, who was present at the euro’s creation, but kept the UK out, recognizes the need for further eurozone integration, if only because the UK has an interest in better economic performance in its most important export market.

zh: 但在拒绝加入的情况下有效接触更加统一的欧元区却并非易事。
en: But engaging effectively with a more deeply integrated eurozone, without joining it, will be no easy feat.

zh: 实现两个关键目标才能确保英国的成功。
en: To be successful, the UK will need to pursue two key objectives.

zh: 首先，它必须在其他关键事务上与欧盟开展强劲的合作，比如安全、外交和气候政策。
en: First, it must establish strong cooperation with the EU on other key issues, such as security, foreign, and climate policy.

zh: 其次，它还必须确保一体化程度不断增强的欧元区无权单方面出台财政和监管决策，通过重塑统一市场或金融行业而严重影响到英国。
en: Second, it must ensure that an increasingly integrated eurozone does not gain the authority to make unilaterally fiscal and regulatory decisions that, by reshaping the single market or the financial sector, have significant implications for the UK.

zh: 而就欧元区这方面而言，则必须在一体化过程中考虑到英国的利益，同时还不能让英国导致一体化进程放缓。
en: The eurozone, for its part, must regard British interests in the integration process, without allowing the UK to slow it down.

zh: 尽管欧元区一体化和多币种联盟相关事务并未成为英国退欧辩论的核心（英国退欧辩论主要关注移民问题 ） ， 但无论英国退欧与否，上述事务都将是决定欧盟未来的关键。
en: While issues relating to eurozone integration and the multi-currency union have not been central to the Brexit debate, which has tended to focus on immigration, they remain vital to the future of the EU, with or without the UK.

zh: 尽管英国继续保留欧盟成员国资格从本质上讲与欧盟一体化并不矛盾（本质上这就是我所提出的两个欧洲合一 ） ， 但创建能够支持永久性多币种联盟的体制将构成极大的政治和法律挑战。
en: Though Britain’s continued EU membership is not fundamentally incompatible with a more integrated eurozone, creating institutions that can support a permanent multi-currency union – essentially, as I have argued, two Europes in one – will be politically and legally challenging.

zh: 因为未能确定清晰的目标，2月所公布的协议未能为克服上述挑战开创有效的先例。
en: In its failure to put forward a clear vision, the deal announced in February did not set a strong precedent for overcoming these challenges.

zh: 如果欧洲想在加强稳定和繁荣方面切实取得进展，就必须时刻不忘保证透明度和合法性。
en: If Europe is to make genuine progress toward greater stability and prosperity, it will need to ensure transparency and legitimacy every step of the way.

zh: 只有建立起能在正常及危机时刻同样引导政策的明确的政治目标和体制，欧盟才能重新实现繁荣。
en: Only with a clear political vision and institutions that can steer policy during crises and in normal times alike will the EU be able to prosper again.

zh: 如果英国决定留下，欧盟不仅不能回归常态，还必须争分夺秒找到合法多币种联盟的有效运作方法。
en: If the UK stays, the EU must urgently work out how a legitimate multi-currency union will function, instead of reverting to business as usual.

zh: 如果英国决定退出，欧盟同样要解决上述问题，当然不同之处是英国将失去所有的筹码。
en: If the UK leaves, the same basic problems must be solved, with the difference, however, that the UK will have lost all leverage.

zh: 英国脱欧与全球经济
en: Brexit and the Global Economy

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 脱欧这一个问题已经足足耗费了英国两年半的时间。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The singular issue of Brexit has consumed the United Kingdom for two and a half years.

zh: 在入盟数十年后，关于该国“是否 ” ， “如何”以及“何时”退出欧盟的讨论不出意外地占据了绝大部分新闻头条，导致几乎所有其他政策辩论只能靠边站。
en: The “if,” “how,” and “when” of the country’s withdrawal from the European Union, after decades of membership, has understandably dominated news coverage, and sidelined almost every other policy debate.

zh: 其中就包括关于英国在眼下这个全球经济和金融高速流动的时刻应该如何提高生产率和竞争力的重要讨论。
en: Lost in the mix, for example, has been any serious discussion of how the UK should boost productivity and competitiveness at a time of global economic and financial fluidity.

zh: 与此同时，世界其他国家对英国脱欧的关注度也理所当然地减弱了。
en: At the same time, the rest of the world’s interest in Brexit has understandably waned.

zh: 英国与欧盟的谈判以似曾相识的方式一次又一次地遭到了拖延，而人们也已经达成了共识：英国所遭受的经济下行冲击将远超欧盟，更别说其他国家了。
en: The UK’s negotiations with the EU have dragged on through multiple déjà vu moments, and the consensus is that the economic fallout will be felt far more acutely in Britain than in the EU, let alone in countries elsewhere.

zh: 当然世界其他国家也都面临着自身的深刻挑战。
en: Still, the rest of the world is facing profound challenges of its own.

zh: 政治和经济体系正在经历深远的结构性变革，其中许多是由技术、贸易、气候变化，高度不平等以及日益增长的政治愤怒所驱动的。
en: Political and economic systems are undergoing far-reaching structural changes, many of them driven by technology, trade, climate change, high inequality, and mounting political anger.

zh: 而在解决这些问题时，世界各地的决策者都应好好借鉴一下英国脱欧的经验教训。
en: In addressing these issues, policymakers around the world would do well to heed the lessons of the UK’s Brexit experience.

zh: 当英国人以51.9％比48.1％的细微差距投票同意脱欧时，这一决定令专家，权威人士以及保守党和工党领袖都深感震惊，因为他们低估了“身份定义”在2016年6月公投背后所发挥的驱动作用。
en: When Britons voted by a margin of 51.9% to 48.1% to leave the EU, the decision came as a shock to experts, pundits, and Conservative and Labour Party leaders alike. They had underappreciated the role of “identity” as a driving force behind the June 2016 referendum.

zh: 但如今选民们对身份定义的深刻理解，无论是真实的还是感知的，都不能再被忽视。
en: But now, voters’ deeply held ideas about identity, whether real or perceived, can no longer be dismissed.

zh: 虽然今天的破坏性政治都受到经济上的落差和挫折所推动，但身份才是矛的尖锐之处，正是它暴露和加深了那些既棘手又让人难以忍受的政治和社会分歧。
en: Though today’s disruptive politics are fueled by economic disappointment and frustration, identity is the tip of the spear. It has exposed and deepened political and social divisions that are as uncomfortable as they are intractable.

zh: 当时专家们还预测2016年公投后英国经济将当即出现大幅下跌。
en: Experts also predicted that the UK economy would suffer an immediate and significant fall in output following the 2016 referendum.

zh: 但在这一事件中他们误解了经济学家所谓的“骤停式”动态 — — 即经济中某个关键部门的突然、灾难性功能障碍。
en: In the event, they misunderstood the dynamics of what economists call a “sudden stop” – that is, abrupt, catastrophic dysfunction in a key sector of the economy.

zh: 一个完美的例子是2008年全球金融危机，当时金融市场因运行混乱以及支付和结算系统失去互信而陷入了困境。
en: A perfect example is the 2008 global financial crisis, when financial markets seized up as a result of operational dislocations and a loss of mutual confidence in the payments and settlement system.

zh: 但脱欧是不同的。
en: Brexit was different.

zh: 由于没有什么替代品可以拿来取代原有的东西，因此英国-欧盟贸易没有立即中断。
en: Because you cannot replace something with nothing, there was no immediate break in British-EU trade.

zh: 由于无法明确的英国最终将以何种形式脱欧，经济关系只得“照样”存在，也避免了当即的中断。
en: In the absence of clarity on what type of Brexit would ultimately materialize, the economic relationship simply continued “as is,” and an immediate disruption was averted.

zh: 事实证明，到目前为止对英国脱欧进行宏观经济和市场预测时 ， “ 短期与长期”比“软脱欧与硬脱欧”更为重要 （ “ 硬脱欧”指的是英国全面且很可能无序地退出欧洲单一市场和关税同盟 ） 。
en: It turns out that when making macroeconomic and market projections for Brexit so far, “short versus long” has been more important than “soft versus hard” (with “hard” referring to the UK’s full, and most likely disorderly, withdrawal from the European single market and customs union).

zh: 问题不在于英国是否会面临相当大的经济冲击，而是何时。
en: The question is not whether the UK will face a considerable economic reckoning, but when.

zh: 尽管如此，英国经济已经在经历缓慢的结构变化。
en: Nonetheless, the UK economy is already experiencing slow-moving structural change.

zh: 有证据表明外国投资水平正在下降，并因此导致了令人失望的整体经济投资水平。
en: There is evidence of falling foreign investment and this is contributing to the economy’s disappointing level of investment overall.

zh: 此外这一趋势也在加剧与生产率增长疲软相关的挑战。
en: Moreover, this trend is accentuating the challenges associated with weak productivity growth.

zh: 还有迹象表明，在经过长时间的等待，计划以及更多等待之后，那些在英国拥有业务的企业已开始触发其脱欧应急计划。
en: There are also signs that companies with UK-based operations have begun to trigger their Brexit contingency plans after a prolonged period of waiting, planning, and more waiting.

zh: 除了将投资转出英国之外，企业还开始重新安置就业岗位。
en: In addition to shifting investments out of the UK, firms will also start to relocate jobs.

zh: 即使英国首相特蕾莎·梅（Theresa May）设法让议会通过了其提出的脱欧协议，这一过程也可能加速。
en: And this process will likely accelerate even if British Prime Minister Theresa May manages to get her proposed exit deal through Parliament.

zh: 因此英国的脱欧流程展现了那些与经济和政治碎片化相关的风险，并预示了如果这种情况持续下去一个日益崩溃的全球经济所能产生的后果：即经济互动效率下降，抵御能力降低，跨境金融流动更加复杂以及灵活性下降。
en: The Brexit process thus showcases the risks associated with economic and political fragmentation, and provides a preview of what awaits an increasingly fractured global economy if this continues: namely, less efficient economic interactions, less resilience, more complicated cross-border financial flows, and less agility.

zh: 在这种情况下，耗资巨大的自我保险将取代当前系统所具备的一些集合保险机制。
en: In this context, costly self-insurance will come to replace some of the current system’s pooled-insurance mechanisms.

zh: 维持全球规范和标准将变得更加困难，更不用说国际政策的协调和协调了。
en: And it will be much harder to maintain global norms and standards, let alone pursue international policy harmonization and coordination.

zh: 同时税收和监管套利行为也可能变得日益普遍。
en: Tax and regulatory arbitrage are likely to become increasingly common as well.

zh: 经济政策制定将成为解决国家安全问题（无论真实或是臆想）的工具。
en: And economic policymaking will become a tool for addressing national security concerns (real or imagined).

zh: 而这种做法对现有地缘政治和军事安排的影响仍有待观察。
en: How this approach will affect existing geopolitical and military arrangements remains to be seen.

zh: 最后各国构建自身经济的方式也将发生变化。
en: Lastly, there will also be a change in how countries seek to structure their economies.

zh: 过去英国和其他国家将自己称之为“小型开放经济体 ” ， 通过与欧洲和世界其他地区之间建立精明且高效的联系来发挥其国内优势。
en: In the past, Britain and other countries prided themselves as “small open economies” that could leverage their domestic advantages through shrewd and efficient links with Europe and the rest of the world.

zh: 但如今一个相对封闭的大型经济体可能开始变得更具吸引力。
en: But now, being a large and relatively closed economy might start to seem more attractive.

zh: 对于没有这种选择的国家 — — 例如较小的东亚经济体 — — 紧密结合的区域集团或许能提供一种可行的替代方案。
en: And for countries that do not have that option – such as smaller economies in East Asia – tightly knit regional blocs might provide a serviceable alternative.

zh: 英国政党政治的混乱使得英国的脱欧进程看起来像是一场有时让世界其他国家感觉不可理喻的国内争端。
en: The messiness of British party politics has made the Brexit process look like a domestic dispute that is sometimes inscrutable to the rest of the world.

zh: 但英国脱欧对全球经济有且意味着一系列重要的教训。
en: But Brexit holds important lessons for and about the global economy.

zh: 经济和金融加速全球化且相关增长模式几乎不容置疑的日子已经一去不复返了，我们也正处在一个存在高度科技和政治流动性的时代。
en: Gone are the days when accelerating economic and financial globalization and correlated growth patterns went almost unquestioned. We are also in an era of considerable technological and political fluidity.

zh: 增长和流动性的前景可能会比当前更加不确定，也更具差异。
en: The outlooks for growth and liquidity will likely become even more uncertain and divergent than they already are.

zh: 从英国退出到未来
en: From Brexit to the Future

zh: 纽约—消化“英国退出”公投的全部影响要耗费英国、欧洲和全世界很长时间。
en: NEW YORK – Digesting the full implications of the United Kingdom’s “Brexit” referendum will take Britain, Europe, and the world a long time.

zh: 当然，影响最为深远的后果取决于欧盟如何响应英国的退出。
en: The most profound consequences will, of course, depend on the European Union’s response to the UK’s withdrawal.

zh: 大部分人一开始认定欧盟不会“为了惩罚脸而割掉鼻子 ” ： 毕竟，友好离婚似乎符合所有人的利益。
en: Most people initially assumed that the EU would not “cut off its nose to spite its face”: after all, an amicable divorce seems to be in everyone’s interest.

zh: 但这场离婚 — — 和许多人一样 — — 可能变成一地鸡毛。
en: But the divorce – as many do – could become messy.

zh: 英国和欧盟之间的贸易和经济一体化的收益是互相的，如果欧盟认真对待其经济一体化越紧密越好的信念，其领导人就应该寻求确保各种环境下最大程度的紧密度。
en: The benefits of trade and economic integration between the UK and EU are mutual, and if the EU took seriously its belief that closer economic integration is better, its leaders would seek to ensure the closest ties possible under the circumstances.

zh: 但卢森堡大规模公司税避税机制的设计者、现任欧盟委员会主席容克却采取了强硬立场 ： “ 退出就是退出 ， ” 他说。
en: But Jean-Claude Juncker, the architect of Luxembourg’s massive corporate tax avoidance schemes and now President of the European Commission, is taking a hard line: “Out means out,” he says.

zh: 这一膝跳反应也许不难理解，因为容克可能作为欧盟解体初期的领导者而被人铭记。
en: That kneejerk reaction is perhaps understandable, given that Juncker may be remembered as the person who presided over the EU’s initial stage of dissolution.

zh: 他指出，为了威慑其他想要脱欧的国家，欧盟决不能让步，不能向英国提供多于世贸组织协定所规定的东西。
en: He argues that, to deter other countries from leaving, the EU must be uncompromising, offering the UK little more than what it is guaranteed under World Trade Organization agreements.

zh: 换句话说，欧洲不再通过收益凝聚在一起 — — 这一收益要远远高于成本。
en: In other words, Europe is not to be held together by its benefits, which far exceed the costs.

zh: 根据容克的说法，经济繁荣、凝聚感以及身为欧洲人的自豪感是不够的。
en: Economic prosperity, the sense of solidarity, and the pride of being a European are not enough, according to Juncker.

zh: 不，欧洲要通过威胁、恐吓和恐惧凝聚在一起。
en: No, Europe is to be held together by threats, intimidation, and fear.

zh: 这一立场忽视了英国退出投票和美国共和党初选所揭示的教训：人口中有很大部分不做好事。
en: That position ignores a lesson seen in both the Brexit vote and America’s Republican Party primary: large portions of the population have not been doing well.

zh: 过去四十年的新自由主义日程对最顶层1%有益，而对其他人无益。
en: The neoliberal agenda of the last four decades may have been good for the top 1%, but not for the rest.

zh: 我早就预测，这一停止最终将导致政治后果。
en: I had long predicted that this stagnation would eventually have political consequences.

zh: 现在，这一天来了。
en: That day is now upon us.

zh: 在大西洋两岸，公民将贸易协定视为灾难的根源。
en: On both sides of the Atlantic, citizens are seizing upon trade agreements as a source of their woes.

zh: 这固然过度简化了，但也可以理解。
en: While this is an over-simplification, it is understandable.

zh: 今天的贸易��定由秘密谈判商定，公司部门的利益得到了很好的体现，但普通人或工人被完全无视了。
en: Today’s trade agreements are negotiated in secret, with corporate interests well represented, but ordinary citizens or workers completely shut out.

zh: 毫不奇怪，结果是单边的：工人的讨价还价地位进一步削弱，这将强了支持工会和雇员权利的立法的效果。
en: Not surprisingly, the results have been one-sided: workers’ bargaining position has been weakened further, compounding the effects of legislation undermining unions and employees’ rights.

zh: 贸易协定在这一不平等性形成的过程中起到了一些作用，但其他许多因素也助推政治平衡导向资本。
en: While trade agreements played a role in creating this inequality, much else contributed to tilting the political balance toward capital.

zh: 比如，知识产权规则增加了制药公司提价的权力。
en: Intellectual property rules, for example, have increased pharmaceutical companies’ power to raise prices.

zh: 但公司市场权力的任何提高事实上都是在降低真实工资 — — 这一不平等性已经成为当今大部分发达国家的显著特征。
en: But any increase in corporations’ market power is de facto a lowering of real wages – an increase in the inequality that has become a hallmark of most advanced countries today.

zh: 许多部门的行业集中度都在增加 — — 市场权力亦然。
en: Across many sectors, industrial concentration is increasing – and so is market power.

zh: 停滞和下降的真实工资的效果与紧缩相结合，导致许多中低收入工人赖以生存的公共服务被削减。
en: The effects of stagnant and declining real wages have combined with those of austerity, threatening cutbacks in public services upon which so many middle- and low-income workers depend.

zh: 由此带来的工人的经济不确定性与移民问题相结合，酿成了一壶毒酒。
en: The resulting economic uncertainty for workers, when combined with migration, created a toxic brew.

zh: 许多难民是西方造成的战争和压迫的牺牲品。
en: Many refugees are victims of war and oppression to which the West contributed.

zh: 提供帮助是所有人的道德责任，但尤其是前殖民列强的道德责任。
en: Providing help is a moral responsibility of all, but especially of the ex-colonial powers.

zh: 但是，尽管许多人可能否认，但低技能劳动力供给的增加导致了均衡工资的降低 — — 只要需求曲线是正常的向下倾斜形状。
en: And yet, while many might deny it, an increase in the supply of low-skill labor leads – so long as there are normal downward-sloping demand curves – to lower equilibrium wages.

zh: 而当工资无法或不再降低，失业就会升高。
en: And when wages can’t or won’t be lowered, unemployment increases.

zh: 对于经济管理不善已经导致总体失业水平高企的国家来说，这是个最可担忧的问题。
en: This is of most concern in countries where economic mismanagement has already led to a high level of overall unemployment.

zh: 欧洲，特别是欧元区，近几十年来经济管理非常糟糕，平均失业水平已经高达两位数。
en: Europe, especially the eurozone, has been badly mismanaged in recent decades, to the point that its average unemployment is in double digits.

zh: 欧洲内部的自由迁移意味着在降低失业方面表现较为出色国家最终将承担高于公平比例的难民。
en: Free migration within Europe means that countries that have done a better job at reducing unemployment will predictably end up with more than their fair share of refugees.

zh: 这些国家的工人承担了工资抑制和失业升高的成本，而雇主从更廉价的劳动力中获益。
en: Workers in these countries bear the cost in depressed wages and higher unemployment, while employers benefit from cheaper labor.

zh: 毫不奇怪，难民的成本由承受力最低的人承担了。
en: The burden of refugees, no surprise, falls on those least able to bear it.

zh: 当然，关于内向移民的净收益很有讨论的余地。
en: Of course, there is much talk about the net benefits of inward migration.

zh: 对于全民保障福利 — — 社会保护、教育、医疗等 — — 提供水平较低的国家，或许如此。
en: For a country providing a low level of guaranteed benefits – social protection, education, health care, and so forth – to all citizens, that may be the case.

zh: 但对于提供体面的社会安全网的国家，情况正好相反。
en: But for countries that provide a decent social safety net, the opposite is true.

zh: 所有这些工资下行压力和公共服务削减的结果是中产阶级损失惨重，大西洋两岸后果类似。
en: The result of all this downward pressure on wages and cutbacks in public services has been the evisceration of the middle class, with similar consequences on both sides of the Atlantic.

zh: 中产阶级和工作阶级家庭没有获得经济增长的好处。
en: Middle- and working-class households haven’t received the benefits of economic growth.

zh: 他们知道是银行造成了2008年危机；但随后他们看着数十亿美元用于拯救银行，而用于拯救他们的家园和工作的资金却寥寥无几。
en: They understand that banks had caused the 2008 crisis; but then they saw billions going to save the banks, and trivial amounts to save their homes and jobs.

zh: 美国全职男性工人中位真实（经通胀调整的）收入比四十年前更低，选民群情激奋一点都不令人奇怪。
en: With median real (inflation-adjusted) income for a full-time male worker in the US lower than it was four decades ago, an angry electorate should come as no surprise.

zh: 此外，承诺变化的政客并没有兑现预期。
en: Politicians who promised change, moreover, didn’t deliver what was expected.

zh: 普通公民知道制度不公，但后来发现操纵比他们想象的还要严重，于是他们对建制政客纠正不公的能力或意愿仅剩一点信任也消失殆尽。
en: Ordinary citizens knew that the system was unfair, but they came to see it as even more rigged than they had imagined, losing what little trust they had left in establishment politicians’ capacity or will to correct it.

zh: 这也不难理解：新政客与那些承诺全球化会令所有人受益的政客见解相似。
en: That, too, is understandable: the new politicians shared the outlook of those who had promised that globalization would benefit all.

zh: 但带着怒气投票无法解决问题，倒是有可能产生更加糟糕的政治和经济局面。
en: But voting in anger does not solve problems, and it may bring about a political and economic situation that is even worse.

zh: 响应带着怒气的投票亦然。
en: The same is true of responding to a vote in anger.

zh: 让过去的事情过去，这是经济学的一个基本原理。
en: Letting bygones be bygones is a basic principle in economics.

zh: 在英吉利海峡两岸，眼下政治方向应该是理解民主政体中的政治建制为何对于解决如此多公民所关注的问题如此无作为。
en: On both sides of the English Channel, politics should now be directed at understanding how, in a democracy, the political establishment could have done so little to address the concerns of so many citizens.

zh: 如今，所有欧盟国家政府都必须将改善普通公民的福祉作为主要目标。
en: Every EU government must now regard improving ordinary citizens’ wellbeing as its primary goal.

zh: 更多的新自由主义意识形态无助于事。
en: More neoliberal ideology won’t help.

zh: 我们还应该停止用手段混淆目的：比如，管理良好的自由贸易可能带来更大的共同繁荣；但如果得不到良好的管理，它就将降低许多 — — 也许是大部分 — — 公民的生活水平。
en: And we should stop confusing ends with means: for example, free trade, if well managed, might bring greater shared prosperity; but if it is not well managed, it will lower the living standards of many – possibly a majority – of citizens.

zh: 对于当前的新自由主义安排，存在一些替代方案能够创造共同繁荣，正如也存在一些替代方案 — — 如美国总统奥巴马提出的与欧盟的跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系 — — 将带来更多的伤害。
en: There are alternatives to the current neoliberal arrangements that can create shared prosperity, just as there are alternatives – like US President Barack Obama’s proposed Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership deal with the EU – that would cause much more harm.

zh: 如今的挑战是汲取历史教训，追求前者，避免后者。
en: The challenge today is to learn from the past, in order to embrace the former and avert the latter.

zh: 英国脱欧和欧洲的未来
en: Brexit and the Future of Europe

zh: 巴黎 — — 没有人知道英国准备何时提交其脱欧谈判的议程。
en: PARIS – No one yet knows when the United Kingdom will present an agenda for negotiating its withdrawal from the European Union.

zh: 但毫无疑问英国脱欧必将重塑欧洲的版图。
en: But it is already clear that Brexit will reshape the map of Europe.

zh: 而且，尤其鉴于英国对其自身决策后果令人惊叹的毫无准备 — — 英国的战略、优先事项甚至脱欧时间表都依然无法确定 — — 这意味着欧盟必须开始思考如何争取最好的结果。
en: And, especially given Britain’s stunning unpreparedness for the consequences of its own decision – its strategy, priorities, and even its timetable remain uncertain – that means that the EU must start figuring out how to make the best of it.

zh: 下面谈谈应该怎么做。
en: Here’s how.

zh: 让我们从唯一的确定性开始：英国脱欧谈判必将长期、复杂和激烈，而英欧离异必将产生意义深远的地缘政治后果。
en: Let’s start with the only certainties: the Brexit negotiations will be long, complex, and acrimonious, and the divorce will have far-reaching geopolitical effects.

zh: 最直接的影响是逆转长达六十年的整合势头。
en: The immediate impact is a halt to 60 years of integration momentum.

zh: 欧洲在中短期同样将会蒙受损失，因为未来五年当欧盟需要集中精力应对内外威胁时，却不得不分出大量政治精力投入英国脱欧的谈判工作。
en: Europe will suffer in the short and medium term as well, as considerable political energy is likely to be devoted to Brexit for the next five years, at a time when the EU needs the strength to confront internal and external dangers.

zh: 从长远看，英国脱欧很可能会加速欧洲从全球顶级决策网络的退出。
en: Over the longer term, Brexit is likely to accelerate Europe’s exit from the top table of global decision-making.

zh: 英国同样无法逃脱这些后果。
en: Britain will not escape these consequences.

zh: 虽然英国可以退出欧盟，但却显然无法搬离欧洲。
en: Whereas it can leave the EU, it cannot relocate away from Europe.

zh: 因此，尽管英国的欧洲伙伴从未选择英国脱欧，但却必须成功地对其后果进行管理，而这需要平衡两大优先项目。
en: That is why, though Britain’s European partners did not choose Brexit, they must manage its consequences successfully, which requires balancing two priorities.

zh: 他们的战术目标必然是与英国达成维护欧盟统一的协议。
en: Their tactical goal must be to reach a deal with the UK that maintains the integrity of the EU.

zh: 协议必须以保持欧洲的繁荣和影响力为战略目标。
en: The strategic goal is to preserve Europe’s prosperity and influence.

zh: 正是在上述想法的基础上我与若干欧洲同仁携手 — — 我们每个人都是以个人名义 — — 最近联合撰写了一份为未来10到20年的欧洲提出理念的论文：那就是建设新型大陆伙伴关系，为继续与英国开展经济、外交及安全合作奠定新的基础。
en: It is with these ideas in mind that I, together with several European colleagues – all of us acting in an individual capacity – recently co-authored a paper proposing a concept for Europe in 10-20 years: a continental partnership that would create a new basis for continued economic, foreign policy, and security cooperation with the UK.

zh: 建立深度远低于欧盟成员国，但密切度远高于自由贸易协定的基本经济理念是新型关系的基础。
en: The basic economic idea is a template for a relationship that is considerably less deep than EU membership, but rather closer than a free-trade agreement.

zh: 如果上述目标得以实现，英国和欧盟不仅能够保持经济关系，而且还能为欧盟与不太可能在近期加入的邻国（包括挪威、瑞士、土耳其、乌克兰，最后还有地中海南部国家）建设未来关系提供新的模型。 。
en: If adopted, Britain and the EU could not only preserve their economic ties, but also provide a new model for the future relationship between the EU and neighbors that will not join it anytime soon: Norway, Switzerland, Turkey, Ukraine, and eventually southern Mediterranean countries.

zh: 有关欧盟英国关系未来的一切提案都必须以解释英国脱欧公投的含义为先决条件。
en: Any proposal regarding the future of the EU-UK relationship must start from an interpretation of the Brexit referendum’s meaning.

zh: 我们认为英国选民拒绝接受限制欧盟工人流入和共同主权原则两方面的法律不可能。
en: Ours assumes that UK voters rejected both the legal impossibility of limiting inflows of workers from the EU and the principle of pooled sovereignty.

zh: 上述两方面的政治限制应当被视为先决条件。
en: These two political constraints should be taken as a given.

zh: 第一条意味着英欧长期安排不得包含劳动力自由流动。
en: The first implies that a lasting arrangement between Britain and the EU cannot include free movement of labor.

zh: 第二条则排除了参与共同政策，因此意味着必须以政府间协议为基础来开展任何合作。
en: The second rules out participation in a common polity, and thus implies that any cooperation must be based on intergovernmental agreements.

zh: 第一条限制是一块沉重的绊脚石，因为欧盟的基础是商品、服务、资金和人员的自由流动。
en: The first constraint is a serious stumbling block, because the EU is based on the free movement of goods, services, capital, and workers.

zh: 英国的欧洲伙伴国坚称上述四种自由不可分割，如果英国想要维持其数据处理和金融服务业对大陆市场的自由准入，那么就必须接受波兰或爱尔兰工人自由进入其劳动力��场。
en: The UK’s European partners adamantly claim that these four freedoms are indivisible, and that if Britain wants to maintain free access to the continental market for its data processing and financial services, it must accept unlimited access to its labor market for Polish or Irish workers.

zh: 人员自由流动无疑是欧盟不可或缺的因素。
en: Freedom of movement of workers is undoubtedly integral to the EU.

zh: 事实上，无需征得许可而在其他国家定居和谋生的基本权利在全球其他任何地方都是不存在的。
en: Indeed, the fundamental right to settle and earn one’s living in another country without asking for permission does not exist anywhere else in the world.

zh: 对成百上千万人而言，上述权利最充分的体现了欧盟的价值观。
en: For millions, this right most fully embodies what the EU stands for.

zh: 但英国已经做出了选择，现在的问题是能否在保持密切经济联系的同时控制人员的自由流动。
en: But Britain has made its choice, and the right question to ask now is whether strong economic links can be preserved without free movement of labor.

zh: 从经济的角度讲答案是肯定的：深度融合的商品、服务和资本市场并不需要劳动力的完全流动。
en: From an economic standpoint, the answer is yes: a deeply integrated market for goods, services, and capital does not require full labor mobility.

zh: 必不可少的只是支撑统一服务市场的临时性人员流动。
en: What is needed is only enough temporary mobility to accompany the integration of services markets.

zh: 换言之，人员自由流动在政治上对欧盟不可或缺，但涉及第三国关系时在经济上却是可以舍弃的。
en: In other words, freedom of movement of workers is politically essential within the EU, but economically dispensable when dealing with third countries.

zh: 与英国签署的经济协议不必非要包括人员自由流动。
en: An economic agreement with Britain does not need to include it.

zh: 第二种限制因素性质不同。
en: The second constraint is of a different nature.

zh: 与实体商品市场不同，金融或信息服务市场必须以确保公平竞争及消费者保护的详细的法规为基础。
en: Unlike a market for nails or screws, a market for financial or information services must be based on detailed legislation that ensures fair competition and protects customers.

zh: 制定上述法规是欧盟的主要任务。
en: A large part of the EU’s task is to prepare this legislation.

zh: 因此问题就变成了如果英国制造商不再是法规制定者将如何继续进入欧盟市场（反之亦然 ） 。
en: So the question here is how British producers can retain access to the EU market (and vice versa) if they are no longer party to the legislation.

zh: 解决这一难题将是大陆伙伴关系的主要目的之一。
en: Solving this conundrum would be one of the main purposes of the continental partnership.

zh: 在上述进程中，英国将参与欧盟立法草案的多边顾问进程，并有权提出关切的问题和修改意见，以确保进程的结果尽可能得到双方的认同。
en: Through it, Britain would participate in a multilateral process of consultation on draft EU legislation and would have the right to raise concerns and propose amendments, so that the outcome of the process would remain as far as possible consensual.

zh: 双方都有政治义务聆听对方的心声。
en: Both sides would be politically committed to listening to the other.

zh: 但欧盟将掌握最终发言权，从而确保其法律得到应用和执行。
en: The EU, however, would have the final say, so that its laws would apply and be enforced.

zh: 为享受欧盟市场的全面准入，英国将需要就保持统一市场正常运作的一揽子关键政策（包括如竞争规则、消费者保护和基本社会权利等）或许还有为避免不久前苹果做法所代表的扭曲的最低计税规则达成认同。
en: To enjoy full access to the EU market, Britain would need to agree on a package of policies essential to the proper functioning of an integrated market: competition rules, consumer protection, and fundamental social rights, for example, and perhaps also minimum tax rules to avoid distortions of the type recently exemplified by Apple’s practices.

zh: 英国还需要向欧盟预算缴费，发展基金（单一市场准入的对立面）主要由欧盟预算提供。
en: Britain would also need to contribute to the EU budget, from which development funds (the counterpart to single-market access) are delivered.

zh: 有人反驳称这样的协议苛刻到让英国难以接受。
en: Some object that the deal would be too harsh for Britain to accept.

zh: 但彻底失去主要贸易伙伴的市场准入是否是更好的选择？
en: But would the UK be better off losing access to the market of its main trading partner?

zh: 还有人担心如果征询外人的意见欧盟是否会交出其决策权。
en: Others worry that the EU would surrender its decision-making powers were it to consult with outsiders.

zh: 但我看不出不掌握投票权的少数国家 — — 包括英国和其他几个国家在内 — — 怎样才能主导有投票权的多数？
en: But how would the few without a vote – Britain and others – dominate the many with a vote?

zh: 还有人称这样的安排会对英国做出太多让步，迫使其他国家瞄准类似的地位并造成欧盟解体。
en: Still others claim that such an arrangement would concede too much to Britain, compelling other countries to aim at a similar status and causing the EU to unravel.

zh: 但为什么遵守规则及缴纳欧盟预算却不掌握对政策设计的投票权对欧盟成员国更有好处？
en: But why would an EU member be better off abiding by rules and paying into the EU budget without having a vote on the design of policies?

zh: 而且，与削弱欧盟一体化相去甚远的是，大陆伙伴关系可以支持欧盟核心力量的整合。
en: And, far from undermining European integration, a continental partnership could support the consolidation of the EU’s core.

zh: 的确，所有人都将付出代价。
en: True, there would be a price to pay for everyone.

zh: 但这样的代价却比因未能构建大陆伙伴关系而丧失繁荣和全球影响力要小得多。
en: But it would be far lower than the price, in terms of lost prosperity and diminished global influence, of failing to create a continental partnership.

zh: 英国退出和实力平衡
en: Brexit and the Balance of Power

zh: 剑桥—1973年，英国加入了日后的欧盟。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Britain joined what became the European Union in 1973.

zh: 今年6月23日，英国将进行是否脱离的全民公决。
en: This year, on June 23, it will hold a referendum on whether to leave.

zh: 应该这样做吗？
en: Should it?

zh: 最新民调显示选民意见十分接近。
en: Current polls show a closely divided electorate.

zh: 首相卡梅伦宣称他已经赢得英国欧盟伙伴国的让步，这应该消除公众对于向布鲁塞尔让渡主权和东欧工人涌入英国的担忧。
en: Prime Minister David Cameron claims that the concessions he has won from Britain’s EU partners should lay to rest popular concerns about a loss of sovereignty to Brussels and an influx of foreign workers from Eastern Europe.

zh: 但卡梅伦的保守党及其自身的内阁也陷入了深深的分歧，而伦敦的民粹主义市长鲍里斯·约翰逊（Boris Johnson）已经加入支持英国退出阵营。
en: But Cameron’s Conservative Party and his own cabinet are deeply divided, while London’s populist mayor, Boris Johnson, has joined the supporters of British exit.

zh: 英国的欧盟成员资格的成本和收益问题也让英国媒体一分为二。
en: The question of the costs and benefits of British membership in the EU divides the British press as well.

zh: 许多发行量很大的刊物支持“英国退出 ” ， 而财经媒体支持继续留在欧元区。
en: Many mass-circulation publications support “Brexit,” whereas the financial press supports continued membership.

zh: 比如 ， 《 经济学人》指出，英国出口中有45%流向其他欧盟国家，而谈判英国退出后贸易协议的氛围相当严峻。
en: The Economist, for example, points out that some 45% of British exports go to other EU countries, and that the atmosphere for negotiating a post-Brexit trade deal would likely be frosty.

zh: 此外，欧盟已向挪威和瑞士等非成员国明确表示，要想进入欧盟单一市场，唯有接受其大部分规则，包括人员自由流动和为欧盟预算出资。
en: Moreover, the EU has made clear to non-members such as Norway and Switzerland that they can have full access to the single market only if they accept most of its rules, including the free movement of people, and contribute to the EU budget.

zh: 换句话说，身处欧盟外的英国在“主权”方面不会获得多少收益；相反，它将失去其参与单一市场条件的投票权和影响力。
en: In other words, a Britain outside the Union would gain little in terms of “sovereignty”; on the contrary, it would lose its vote and influence over the terms of its participation in the single market.

zh: 与此同时，作为竞争对手的金融中心，如巴黎和法兰克福，将抓住机会制定有助于它们从伦敦夺回业务的规则。
en: Meanwhile, rival financial centers such as Paris and Frankfurt would seize the chance to establish rules that would help them win back business from London.

zh: 另一个复杂问题是政治：苏格兰民族主义的兴起以及英国退出对英国生存的影响。
en: Another complication is political: the rise of nationalism in Scotland and the effect of Brexit on the survival of the United Kingdom.

zh: 2014年，苏格兰进行了自己的全民公决，决定留在英国；但在八个月后的大选中，民族主义者赢得了几乎所有苏格兰议席。
en: In 2014, Scotland voted in its own referendum to remain in the UK; but the nationalists won almost all of Scotland’s seats in the general election eight months later.

zh: 苏格兰的民意远比英格兰更加亲欧，许多人认为英国退出将导致苏格兰再次进行独立公决。
en: With Scottish opinion much more pro-European than in England, many believe that Brexit would lead to another referendum on independence.

zh: 卡梅伦也许会因为p帮助英国（也许还有欧洲）分裂而被铭记的首相。
en: Cameron could be remembered as the prime minister who helped break up the UK (and possibly Europe).

zh: 在美国，总统奥巴马政府明确表示相信英国和欧洲携手才能共进。
en: In the United States, President Barack Obama’s administration has stated clearly its belief that Britain and Europe are both stronger together.

zh: 用与美国的特殊关系取代欧洲影响的幻觉是错误的。
en: Illusions of a special relationship with the US replacing the influence of Europe are mistaken.

zh: 但英国人将权衡是否支持英国退出，而美国大规模插手可能适得其反。
en: But the British people will weigh whether to support Brexit, and an American hand on the scale could be counter-productive.

zh: 与此同时，用前工党影子外交大臣道格拉斯·亚历山大（Douglas Alexander）的话说 ， “ 自二战结束以来，美国一直是基于强大而稳定的跨大西洋联盟的国际秩序的系统操作员，而支持这一跨大西洋联盟的两大支柱是北约和欧盟。
en: At the same time, in the words of Douglas Alexander, the former Labour shadow foreign secretary, “since the end of World War II, America has been the system operator of international order built on a strong, stable Transatlantic Alliance supported by the twin pillars of NATO and the EU.

zh: 如果英国脱离欧盟，美国的最紧密盟友将被边缘化 … … 并且整个欧洲工程也可能分崩离析，而与此同时，西方正在面临新的经济和安全威胁。
en: If Britain leaves the EU, America’s closest ally would be marginalized….and the whole European project at risk of unraveling at precisely the time new economic and security threats confront the West.”

zh: ”毫不奇怪，普京的克里姆林宫将欢迎英国退出，并参与欧洲各国国内政策以试图削弱欧盟。
en: It is no wonder that Vladimir Putin’s Kremlin would welcome Brexit and meddles in European countries’ domestic politics to try to weaken the EU.

zh: 英国退出的地缘政治后果不会马上显露出来。
en: The geopolitical consequences of Brexit might not appear immediately.

zh: 一开始，欧盟可能会变得更加紧密。
en: The EU might even temporarily pull together.

zh: 但这将危害欧洲的使命感及其吸引力软实力。
en: But there would be damage to Europe’s sense of mission and its soft power of attraction.

zh: 确保金融稳定和管理移民也将变得更加困难。
en: Ensuring financial stability and managing immigration would be much more difficult as well.

zh: 除了苏格兰分裂主义的复兴，英国最近几年中出现的内向（inward turn）也可能加速。
en: In addition to a revival of Scottish separatism, Britain’s inward turn in recent years could accelerate.

zh: 而在长期，对全球实力平衡和自由国际秩序 — — 英国在其中有着强大的国家利益 — — 的影响也有将是消极的。
en: And over the longer run, the effects on the global balance of power and the liberal international order – in which Britain has a strong national interest – would be negative.

zh: 作为一个行动实体，欧洲是世界上最大的经济体，其近5亿的人口也显著高于美国的3.25亿。
en: When it acts as an entity, Europe is the largest economy in the world, and its population of nearly 500 million is considerably larger than America’s 325 million.

zh: 它拥有世界上最大的市场，占世界贸易的17 % ， 贡献世界对外援助的半壁江山。
en: It has the world’s largest market, represents 17% of world trade, and dispenses half of the world’s foreign assistance.

zh: 它还拥有27所名列世界前一百位的大学，其创新产业创造了GDP的约70 % 。
en: It also has 27 universities ranked in the top 100 worldwide, and its creative industries contribute about 7% to its GDP.

zh: 美国人均收入更高，但在人力资本、技术和出口方面，欧洲都可以与美国一较高下。
en: American per capita income is higher, but in terms of human capital, technology, and exports, Europe is very much an economic peer.

zh: 在军事支出方面，欧洲仅次于美国，占世界总量的15 % ， 而中国为12 % ， 俄罗斯为5 % 。
en: In terms of military expenditure, Europe is second only to the US, accounting for 15% of the world total, compared to 12% for China and 5% for Russia.

zh: 当然，这一数字有一些误导，因为欧洲的军事一体化程度较为欠缺。
en: Of course, that number is somewhat misleading, given Europe’s lack of military integration.

zh: 法国和英国是欧洲最主要的两支远征力量。
en: France and Britain are the two major sources of European expeditionary power.

zh: 欧洲和美国的资源是相互强化的。
en: European and US resources are mutually reinforcing.

zh: 双向直接投资都高于与亚洲的水平，而美国-欧洲贸易也比美国-亚洲贸易更加平衡。
en: Direct investment in both directions is higher than with Asia, and US-European trade is more balanced than US trade with Asia.

zh: 在文化层面，美国人和欧洲人有着共同的民主和人权价值，这一点强于世界其他任何地区。
en: At the cultural level, Americans and Europeans share the values of democracy and human rights more with each other than with any other world regions.

zh: 面临崛起的中国、衰落但乐于冒险的俄罗斯，以及中东动荡延长的前景，紧密的跨大西洋合作将是保持长期自由国际秩序的关键。
en: Faced with a rising China, a declining but risk-inclined Russia, and the prospect of prolonged turmoil in the Middle East, close transatlantic cooperation will be crucial to maintaining a liberal international order over the long term.

zh: 认识到英国退出将削弱欧洲和英国，从而让国际体系面临更大的失序风险，将有助于让天平向保持现状倾斜。
en: Recognizing that Brexit, by weakening both Europe and Britain, would make a disorderly international system more likely, should tip the balance in favor of maintaining the status quo.

zh: 英国脱离欧盟对世界经济的影响
en: Brexit’s Impact on the World Economy

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 金融市场在英国在 6 月 23 日决定是否继续留在欧盟的全民公决之前的动荡表现显示：这场事件的结果对世界各地经济和政治形势所造成的影响将远远超出英国占全球 GDP的约 2.4%份额 ，而造成这一巨大影响的原因有以下三点：
en: LONDON – The febrile behavior of financial markets ahead of the United Kingdom’s referendum on June 23 on whether to remain in the European Union shows that the outcome will influence economic and political conditions around the world far more profoundly than Britain’s roughly 2.4% share of global GDP might suggest. There are three reasons for this outsize impact.

zh: 首先 ， “ 脱盟（Brexit ） ” 公投其实是一种全球性现象的组成部分：民粹主义对成熟政党体制的抵制，一大批年龄较大，经济状况较差或低学历选民的愤怒情绪被激发起来，足以推翻现行体制并抵制“体制内”政治家和经济专家。
en: First, the “Brexit” referendum is part of a global phenomenon: populist revolts against established political parties, predominantly by older, poorer, or less-educated voters angry enough to tear down existing institutions and defy “establishment” politicians and economic experts.

zh: 事实上，脱盟潜在支持者的人口构成状况与美国的唐纳德·特朗普粉丝以及法国国民阵线党的信徒存在着惊人的相似性。
en: Indeed, the demographic profile of potential Brexit voters is strikingly similar to that of American supporters of Donald Trump and French adherents of the National Front.

zh: 各项民意测验显示，支持“脱盟”运动的英国选民比例偏离幅度较大，从65%至35%都有，尤以未能完成高中，年逾 60 岁，或者从事“D、E类”蓝领工作的群体为高。
en: Opinion polls indicate that British voters back the “Leave”campaign by a wide margin, 65% to 35%, if they did not complete high school, are over 60, or have “D, E” blue-collar occupations.

zh: 相比之下，拥有大学学历者，40岁以下选民和从事“A、B类”职业的专业人士阶层则有60%至40%以上选择“留下 ” 。
en: By contrast, university graduates, voters under 40, and members of the “A, B” professional classes plan to vote “Remain” by similar margins of 60% to 40% and higher.

zh: 英美德三国的民粹主义回潮不仅受到相似的不满和民族主义情绪煽动，还也都发生在相近的经济条件下。
en: In Britain, the United States, and Germany, the populist rebellions are not only fueled by similar perceived grievances and nationalist sentiments, but also are occurring in similar economic conditions.

zh: 三个国家都已或多或少地实现充分就业，失业率约为 5 % 。
en: All three countries have returned to more or less full employment, with unemployment rates of around 5%.

zh: 但许多工作岗位工资较低，而近期以来移民已经取代银行家成为了所有社会弊病的替罪羊。
en: But many of the jobs created pay low wages, and immigrants have recently displaced bankers as scapegoats for all social ills.

zh: 对商界领袖、 主流政治家和专家经济学家的不信任情绪已经相当明显，以至于选民都扭头忽略了他们关于颠覆现状将会危及复苏的警告。
en: The degree of mistrust of business leaders, mainstream politicians, and expert economists is evident in the extent to which voters are ignoring their warnings not to endanger the gradual restoration of prosperity by upending the status quo.

zh: 在英国，在针对脱盟问题辩论了三个月之后，只有37%的选民同意英国经济将在脱盟后变得更糟 — — 比一年前的38%还少。
en: In Britain, after three months of debate about Brexit, only 37% of voters agree that Britain would be worse off economically if it left the EU – down from 38% a year ago.

zh: 换句话说，国际货币基金组织、 经合组织、 世界银行，英国政府以及英格兰银行等机构撰写了汗牛充栋的报告，异口同声地警告退盟将引发重大损失，最终却遭到了人们的漠视。
en: In other words, all the voluminous reports – by the International Monetary Fund, the OECD, the World Bank, and the British government and the Bank of England – unanimously warning of significant losses from Brexit have been disregarded.

zh: 脱盟运动的领袖鲍里斯·约翰逊（Boris Johnson）也没有试图用详尽的分析来反驳专家的警告，而是用咆哮以及与特朗普反政治宣言类似的口号来回击 ： “ 谁还对脱盟心存顾虑？
en: Rather than trying to rebut the experts’ warnings with detailed analyses, Boris Johnson, the leader of the Leave campaign, has responded with bluster and rhetoric identical to Trump’s anti-politics: “Who is remotely apprehensive about leaving?

zh: 相信我，一切都会没事的。
en: Oh believe me, it will be fine.”

zh: ”言下之意就是这帮所谓的专家过去错了，现在也对不了。
en: In other words, the so-called experts were wrong in the past, and they are wrong now.

zh: 最近的脱盟民意调查显示这种对政治精英的迎面袭击在英国出人意料地大受欢迎。
en: This kind of frontal attack on political elites has been surprisingly successful in Britain, judging by the latest Brexit polling.

zh: 但只有在计票完成后我们才会知道人们对民意测验专家说的话是否能和实际的投票行为对得上。
en: But only after the votes are counted will we know whether opinions expressed to pollsters predicted actual voting behavior.

zh: 脱盟公投的结果将在全球引发回响的第二个原因是公投将会是首场大型测试，看专家/市场和民意调查两者谁才能更正确地认识民粹主义热潮的背后动力。
en: This is the second reason why the Brexit result will echo around the world. The referendum will be the first big test of whether it is the experts and markets, or the opinion polls, that have been closer to the truth about the strength of the populist upsurge.

zh: 目前大西洋两岸的政治学者和金融市场也许会过分自信地假设愤怒的选民告诉民调机构的话并不能反映他们实际会如何投票。
en: For now, political pundits and financial markets on both sides of the Atlantic assume, perhaps complacently, that what angry voters tell pollsters does not reflect how they will actually vote.

zh: 分析师和投资者一贯依然都认定脱盟胜利是低概率事件：在五月下旬，博彩市场和电脑推演模型都只把特朗普胜选和脱盟成功概率定在25%左右，尽管民意调查显示两个事件都获得了近乎50%的支持率。
en: Analysts and investors have consistently assigned low odds to insurgent victories: in late May, betting markets and computerized models put the probabilities of Trump’s election and of Brexit at only around 25%, despite the fact that opinion polls showed almost 50% support for both.

zh: 假如 6 月 23 日脱盟成功，专家和金融市场对欧美民粹主义回潮的低概率判断立刻会显得站不住脚，而民意调查所提出的更高概率将呈现更大的可信度。
en: If Brexit wins on June 23, the low odds accorded by experts and financial markets to successful populist revolts in America and Europe will immediately look suspect, while the higher probabilities suggested by opinion polls will gain greater credibility.

zh: 这不是因为美国选民将受到英国的影响；他们肯定不会的。
en: This is not because US voters will be influenced by Britain; of course they will not be.

zh: 但在所有经济，人口结构和社会的相似性之外，民意调查如今在英美两国都面临着非常类似的挑战和不确定性，因为传统政治忠诚和两党主导体系都在分崩离析。
en: But, in addition to all the economic, demographic, and social similarities, opinion polling in the US and Britain now face very similar challenges and uncertainties, owing to the breakdown of traditional political allegiances and dominant two-party systems.

zh: 统计理论甚至令我们能够量化分析出美国总统选举的期望将如何跟随英国脱盟成功而发生改变。
en: Statistical theory even allows us to quantify how expectations about the US presidential election should shift if Brexit wins in Britain.

zh: 为简单起见，假设我们同时相信民调显示民众对脱盟和特朗普当选存在近50%的支持率与专家认为只有25%成功率这两种观点。
en: Suppose, for the sake of simplicity, that we start by giving equal credibility to opinion polls showing Brexit and Trump with almost 50% support and expert opinions, which gave them only a 25% chance.

zh: 现在假设脱盟获胜。
en: Now suppose that Brexit wins.

zh: 一个称为贝叶斯定理的统计公式将显示民众对民意测验中的信任度会从 50%增至 67 % ， 而专家意见的信誉则由50%下降到33 % 。
en: A statistical formula called Bayes’ theorem then shows that belief in opinion polls would increase from 50% to 67%, while the credibility of expert opinion would fall from 50% to 33%.

zh: 这将导致英国公投的第三次也是最令人担忧的影响。
en: This leads to the third, and most worrying, implication of the British vote.

zh: 如果脱盟在英国这么一个稳定和政治冷漠的国家都能实现，金融市场和世界各地的企业都会在欧洲其他地区和美国的民粹主义回潮忐忑不安。
en: If Brexit wins in a country as stable and politically phlegmatic as Britain, financial markets and businesses around the world will be shaken out of their complacency about populist insurgencies in the rest of Europe and the US.

zh: 这些市场担忧的加剧将反过来改变经济现实。
en: These heightened market concerns will, in turn, change economic reality.

zh: 正如在2008 年那样，金融市场会放大经济焦虑，助长更多的反体制愤怒以及对政治反抗的更高期望。
en: As in 2008, financial markets will amplify economic anxiety, breeding more anti-establishment anger and fueling still-higher expectations of political revolt.

zh: 这种危机蔓延的威胁意味着脱盟公投可能是另一场全球危机的催化剂。
en: The threat of such contagion means a Brexit vote could be the catalyst for another global crisis.

zh: 然而这次那些失去工作的工人、 失去储蓄的退休者和负资产业主都无法归罪于“银行家 ” 。
en: This time, however, the workers who lose their jobs, the pensioners who lose their savings, and the homeowners who are trapped in negative equity will not be able to blame “the bankers.”

zh: 当革命最终走入歧途时，那些投票支持民粹主义剧变的人就只能怪罪自己了。
en: Those who vote for populist upheavals will have no one but themselves to blame when their revolutions go wrong.

zh: 脱离欧盟的贸易成本
en: The Trade Costs of Leaving the EU

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 那些想让英国退出欧盟的“脱盟论者（Brexiteers ） ” 认定他们所追求的目标几乎不会产生任何成本，也不会影响英国的全球贸易。
en: BRUSSELS – The “Brexiteers” – those who want Britain to leave the European Union – argue that their goal would be virtually cost-free and have no effect on the United Kingdom’s global trade.

zh: 他们错了。
en: They are wrong.

zh: 当6月23日英国的选民就该问题的全民公决投下一票之时，他们需要考虑脱离欧盟的举措中究竟包含了什么 — — 以及在脱欧之后如何才能把现在享有（且觉得理所当然）的自由贸易利益维持下去。
en: On June 23, when voters in Britain cast their ballots in the referendum on the question, they need to consider what is actually involved in leaving the EU – and how the free-trade benefits they now enjoy (and take for granted) could be maintained after Brexit.

zh: 让我们从最基本的一点开始：离开欧盟意味着英国将退出关税同盟，这是欧盟28个成员国之间实施跨境自由贸易（并与外部其他国家实施共同对外关税​​）的基础。
en: Start with the basics. Leaving the EU means that the UK would exit the EU’s Customs Union, which is the basis for cross-border free trade among the EU’s 28 members (and establishes a common external tariff vis-à-vis third countries).

zh: 这也意味着退出欧洲单一市场 — — 商品和服务在欧盟成员国之间自由流动的基础。
en: It also means exit from the Single Market – the basis for the free movement of goods and services among EU members.

zh: 根据定义，非欧盟成员国不能参加单一市场。
en: By definition, non-members of the EU cannot belong to the Single Market.

zh: 那么一旦脱盟通过后会出现什么情况？
en: So what would happen next?

zh: 在最终完全脱离欧盟之前的两年时间内，英国与欧盟之间将针对多项问题展开谈判 — — 主权，法律秩序，移民，财政以及经济事务。
en: During the two-year period before Britain’s withdrawal takes final effect, there would be UK-EU negotiations on many points – sovereignty, the legal order, immigration, finances, and economic matters.

zh: 在人们的设想中英国一项至关重要的目标就是与欧盟谈妥一整套尽可能接近当前自贸关系的贸易条款。
en: The assumption is that a crucial goal for Britain would be to negotiate a trading relationship as close as possible to the free-trade relationships that exist today.

zh: 但这事说来容易做来难，最好的结果莫过于所有参与者都同意维持当前的自由贸易状况，同时英国在免税的基础上设置一个新的对外关税，适用于所有欧盟成员国。
en: That is easier said than done. The best result would be if all players agreed to maintain the free trade already achieved, with the UK setting a new external tariff on a duty-free basis, applicable to all comers.

zh: 这正是1970年代英国和丹麦脱离欧洲自由贸易联盟时所发生的状况：两国一方面与各欧洲自由贸易联盟成员国展开自贸协定谈判，一方面又与欧盟（时为欧洲经济共同体）进行谈判。
en: This is what happened in the 1970s after Britain and Denmark left the European Free Trade Association: Free-trade agreements were negotiated among EFTA members and between them and the EU (or the EEC as it was then known).

zh: 但脱盟论者应该认识到：没人能保证上述状况必定重演 — — 而且无论怎样总会出点状况。
en: But Brexiteers should realize that there is no guarantee that this would happen again – and, in any case, there would be complications.

zh: 虽然这种解决方案将有利于占英国出口量45％的出口欧盟产品，但也会将对英国工业的保护降到零。
en: While this solution would be good for the 45% of British exports that are sold in EU markets, it would reduce protection for British industries to zero.

zh: 因为根据WTO规则，同样的进口关税必须适用于所有WTO参与者 — — 这意味着，如果英国向欧盟的出口商品提供免税待遇，也就必须对来自世界其他地区的出口商品一视同仁。
en: Under the rules of the World Trade Organization, the same import duties must be applied to all WTO participants – which means that if Britain’s imports from the EU are duty-free, its imports from the rest of the world must be, too.

zh: 另一套方案则是英国出口商接受欧盟的共同对外关税，同时英国创设自身的进口关税并适用于所有（包括来自欧盟的）进口商品。
en: The alternative would be for UK exporters to accept the EU’s common external tariff, and for the UK to create its own import tariff, applied to all imports, including from the EU.

zh: 因为欧盟在工业和渔业产品方面的共同关税处于相对较低的水平，这可能不会对英国出口产品造成难以逾越的障碍，也可以在保护英国公司免受进口冲击方面有一定的灵活性。
en: Because the common tariff is at a relatively low level on industrial and fishery products, this might not be an insuperable barrier for UK exports, and it would allow some flexibility in protecting UK companies from imports.

zh: 潜在的缺陷是一旦英国将关税上调至高于欧盟的水平，就可能面临第三国在WTO组织提出索赔的风险。
en: The potential pitfall is that any British tariff increase above the EU level would expose the UK to claims for compensation from third countries in the WTO.

zh: 脱盟论者需要回答的更大问题是如何保住进入欧盟内部市场的高规格渠道。
en: The bigger question that the Brexiteers need to answer is how to secure a high level of access to the EU’s internal market.

zh: 这对英国的服务业（尤其是伦敦金融城的金融服务出口）非常重要。
en: This is vitally important for Britain’s service industries, particularly for the City of London’s exports of financial services.

zh: 对此只有一个非欧盟成员国通过谈判获取相当于欧盟成员国同等渠道的先例：欧盟与挪威，冰岛，列支敦士登三国于1992年签订的欧洲经济区协议。
en: There is only one precedent for non-EU members being able to negotiate access to the internal market equivalent to that enjoyed by EU members. This is the European Economic Area agreement concluded with the EU by Norway, Iceland, and Liechtenstein in 1992.

zh: 虽然在包括我在内的许多观察家眼中，借助欧洲经济区协议进入单一市场的渠道已不复存在，但如果我们错了呢？
en: In the view of many observers, including me, access to the Single Market through the EEA is no longer available. But what if we’re wrong?

zh: 问题的关键是在于这一协议将违背脱盟论者所有的本意（以及说辞 ） ， 因为这将意味着接受欧盟的“四大自由 ” ： 不仅是商品，服务和资本的自由流动 — — 还包括人。
en: The point is that such a deal would go against all the instincts (and rhetoric) of the Brexiteers, because it would mean accepting the EU’s “four freedoms”: not just the free movement of goods, services, and capital – but of people, too.

zh: 这显然难以与脱盟论者“把控英国边境”的诉求相契合。
en: That would be hard to square with the Brexit objective of “controlling our borders.”

zh: 同时欧洲经济区这类协议也会要求英国继续缴纳欧盟预算，这就足以让脱盟论者望而却步了。
en: The Brexiteers would also blanch at Britain’s obligation under an EEA-type agreement to continue contributing to the EU budget.

zh: 当然也有可能有针对特殊部门的具体安排。
en: Of course, there could be specific arrangements for particular sectors.

zh: 但这样的安排似乎不太可能出现在金融服务和各大专业服务（包括医生，建筑师和律师服务 ） ， 因为这些都是英国的欧洲竞争对手看重的地方。
en: But it seems unlikely that such arrangements would be possible in financial services and the major professional services (including doctors, architects, and lawyers), which are important for Britain’s competitors in Europe.

zh: 事实上，欧盟可能会将采取强硬的重商主义姿态：如果你想享受特权渠道，就得留在圈子里。
en: Indeed, it is possible that the EU would adopt a tough mercantilist stance: If you want privileged access, you should stay in the club.

zh: 脱盟的最终结果是英国将与第三国签署的众多自贸协议都将失效，因为这些协议都是在欧盟自2000年以来各项协议的框架下运行的。
en: The final consequence of Brexit is that the UK would lose its free-trade arrangements with third countries under the many trade agreements that the EU has signed since 2000.

zh: 用新的双边协议来取代这些协议将需要时间。
en: Replacing these agreements with bilateral deals would take time.

zh: 谁也不能保证欧盟会同意暂时延续自由贸易，而且似乎可以肯定的是英国对第三国的出口将面临较前欧盟伙伴更高的关税（导致英国出口商处于竞争劣势 ） 。
en: There is no guarantee that the EU would agree to an interim continuation of free trade, and it seems certain that UK exports would face higher tariffs than its former EU partners in those third countries (placing British exporters at a competitive disadvantage).

zh: 相当长的一段时间以来脱盟论者都试图让我们相信那些世界上最杰出的领导人，无论是否来自欧洲，都错误地理解了脱盟的影响。
en: It’s a big stretch for the Brexiteers to ask us to believe that the world’s most prominent leaders, European or not, have all got the impact of Brexit wrong.

zh: 在贸易的辩论中，我们听到世界货币基金组织，美国总统奥巴马和经合组织 — — 而非英国财政部 — — 都告诉英国人投票脱离欧盟对经济是没好处的。
en: In the trade debate, we have had the International Monetary Fund, US President Barack Obama, and the OECD – quite apart from the UK Treasury – telling Britons that a vote to leave would be bad for the economy.

zh: 至于那些指责经合组织“拿了欧盟的钱 ” ， 或者说奥巴马的反英情绪是受了他那位曾遭受英国殖民统治的肯尼亚父亲的影响的说法都不值一驳。
en: It is not much of a reply to argue that the OECD is “in the pay of the EU” or that Obama is anti-British because he had a Kenyan father in British colonial days.

zh: 经济预测是门充满不确定性的科学。
en: Economic forecasting is an uncertain science.

zh: 但是当几乎所有的预测指向同一个方向 — — 脱盟将对英国造成极大损害 — — 那就是时候决定哪些是可信的而哪些不是。
en: But when almost all projections point in the same direction – that Brexit would be hugely damaging to the UK – it is time to decide what is credible and what is not.

zh: 英国退出对美国的利弊
en: Will America Win or Lose From Brexit?

zh: 华盛顿—英国投票脱离欧盟震撼了全球金融市场。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The British vote to leave the European Union has shaken world financial markets.

zh: 英国即期和中期经济增长前景受到严重破坏，对欧洲其余部分的影响也将十分消极。
en: The immediate and medium-term prospects for economic growth in the United Kingdom are severely diminished, and the impact on the rest of Europe will be negative.

zh: 显而易见的英国退出政治赢家包括不喜欢西欧的人和不喜欢现状的人。
en: Some of the obvious political winners from Brexit are people who do not like Western Europe and what it stands for.

zh: 讽刺的是，美国 — — 欧洲最大的盟友、欧盟最大的贸易伙伴 — — 最后也可能从中获益，但如果推定共和党提名人唐纳德·特朗普赢得11月总统大选的话，美国就可能无法获得好处。
en: Ironically, the United States – Europe’s greatest ally and the EU’s largest trading partner – may also end up as a beneficiary, though not if Donald Trump, the presumptive Republican nominee, wins the presidential election in November.

zh: 英国人口略多于6,500万，至少到星期四为止，它是全世界第五大国家经济体，年GDP总量接近3万亿美元。
en: Britain has a population of just over 65 million people and what was, at least until Thursday, the world’s fifth-largest national economy, with annual GDP totaling nearly $3 trillion.

zh: 在75万亿美元规模的全球经济中，英国其中一个规模相对较小的开放经济体，严重依赖对外贸易 — — 每年出口常常占经济活动的28—30 % 。
en: In the context of a $75 trillion global economy, Britain’s is a relatively small, open one that relies heavily on foreign trade – annual exports are typically in the range of 28%-30% of economic activity.

zh: 如今，这一局面可能发生变化。
en: That is now likely to change.

zh: 欧盟占了英国出口的一半左右，而继续获得完全的市场准入的前景渺茫。
en: The EU accounts for about half of Britain’s exports, and the prospects for continued full market access are dim.

zh: 商品贸易可能受到影响，但对服务业包括金融服务业出口的冲击将更加严重。
en: Trade in goods may be affected, but the impact on exports of services – including financial services – will be more severe.

zh: 理论上，英国现在可以就大量市场准入问题进行谈判，但几乎肯定需要接受布鲁塞尔所制定的规则 — — 而这正是英国选民所投票反对的。
en: In principle, Britain could now negotiate a great deal of market access, but this would almost certainly require accepting rules made in Brussels – which is just what the British voted against.

zh: 因此，英国增长将在相当长的一段时间里保持低迷。
en: Growth in the UK will consequently be lower and for a long period of time.

zh: 对世界经济的直接影响可能因为其他国家或多或少从英国的损失中获益这一事实而显得 有限。
en: The direct impact on the world economy is likely to be limited by the fact that other countries will to some extent gain from Britain’s loss.

zh: 比如，到目前为止，英国是外国直接投资最大的目的国之一，而这正是因为公司将英国视为进入西欧其余部分的理想基地。
en: For example, the UK was until recently one of the top destinations for foreign direct investment, precisely because companies saw it as a good base from which to sell into the rest of Western Europe.

zh: 英国的吸引力 — — 以及由此带来的新增优质工作岗位 — — 现在将会下降。
en: The UK’s attractiveness – and the creation of good jobs that resulted from it – will now decline.

zh: 整治大输家显然是欧盟本身，失去了当前GDP的六分之一，欧盟在世界经济中的排位将从仅次于美国下降到约等于 — — 有人说将不如 — — 中国（用当前汇率衡量 ） 。
en: The big political loser is obviously the EU itself, which, without one-sixth of its current GDP, will fall in the economic rankings from just below the US to around – or some would say below – the level of China (measured using current exchange rates).

zh: 欧盟领导人会采取怎样的具体政策反应尚不清楚；但是，从2010年欧元区危机处置失当的情况看，恢复更有活力的增长不太可能。
en: The precise policy reaction of EU leaders is unclear; but, given the inept way the eurozone crisis has been handled since 2010, a return to more dynamic growth seems unlikely.

zh: 疲软的欧洲对世界不利 — — 而普京等蔑视民主的人今天毫无疑问在微笑。
en: A weaker Europe is bad for the world – and people like Vladimir Putin who hold democracy in contempt are undoubtedly smiling today.

zh: 但许多极权政权的资金来自自然资源出口。
en: But many authoritarian regimes are funded by the export of natural resources.

zh: 全球增长放缓及由此导致的低油价对于普京和俄罗斯和伊朗等国家来说并非好事。
en: Slower global growth and consequently lower oil prices are not good for countries such as Putin’s Russia and Iran.

zh: 中国经济增长仍然主要基于向富裕国家出口制造品，因此英国和欧盟放缓对中国也是不利的。
en: And China remains an economy where growth is very much based on the export of manufactured goods to richer countries, so a slowdown in the UK and the EU does not favor the Chinese, either.

zh: 在地缘政治和经济方面，美国是欧盟解体最大的潜在赢家。
en: In geopolitical and economic terms, the US is potentially the biggest winner from the disintegration of the EU.

zh: 随着欧洲人自相残杀、帝国纷纷衰落，美国崛起成为全球霸主。
en: The US rose to global predominance as Europeans fought one another and their empires declined.

zh: 1945年后，美国的角色首先受到苏联的挑战 — — 一度构成了真正的技术挑战。
en: The post-1945 US role was challenged first by the Soviet Union, which, for a time, posed a real technological challenge.

zh: 如今俄罗斯经济规模小 — — 并且正在收缩 — — 人口也在下降。
en: Today, Russia has a small – and shrinking – economy and a population in decline.

zh: 接下来是20世纪80年代的日本，其凭借的是创新管理实践和经营出色的公司。
en: Next up was 1980s Japan, with its innovative management practices and well-run companies.

zh: 如今，日本比俄罗斯富裕得多，但它也陷入了经济萎靡，可能陷入持久的人口下降螺旋。
en: Japan is much richer than Russia today, but it, too, remains mired in economic malaise and may be trapped in a perpetual downward demographic spiral.

zh: 最近一段时间，欧洲领导人自视为美国在全球舞台上的对手。
en: Leaders of the EU have, in recent times, seen themselves as a rival to the US on the global stage.

zh: 现在的问题是欧洲的哪些部分可以凭借怎样的基础坚持下去。
en: The question now is which parts of Europe will stick together and on what basis.

zh: 繁荣的基础是人和思想。
en: Prosperity is based on people and ideas.

zh: 谁能吸引最有才华的人，教育他们和他们的孩子，并给予尽量多的人产生工作成果的机会？
en: Who can attract the most talented people, educate them and their children, and give as many individuals as possible the opportunity to work productively?

zh: 美国有一些严重问题，但200多年来吸引移民和鼓励创新一直是其主要优势。
en: The US has some serious problems, but absorbing immigrants and encouraging creativity have been among its main strengths for more than 200 years.

zh: 近几十年中，英国也是一个相对开放的社会，许多英国年轻人希望这一状况继续下去。
en: The UK has also been a relatively open society in recent decades, and many of its younger people would like that to continue.

zh: 但生活在大城市地区之外的年纪教长的人反而支持竖起藩篱并 — — 在相当大的程度上 — — 尝试将英国与世界其他部分隔离。
en: But older people, living outside large urban areas, have voted instead to build barriers and – to a significant extent – attempt to close off the country from the rest of the world.

zh: 英国总统选举政治显然与英国的英国退出争论大相径庭。
en: The politics of the US presidential election are obviously quite different from those of the UK’s Brexit debate.

zh: 但特朗普提出了与英国独立党党魁法拉奇（Nigel Farage）惊人地相似的愿景，而在星期五，两人都对英国公投的结果表现出同样的欣喜。
en: But Trump is offering a strikingly similar vision to that of Nigel Farage, head of the UK Independence Party – and on Friday both of them seemed equally delighted with the outcome of the referendum.

zh: 如今，11月美国所要做出的选择焦点更加明确了。
en: The choice that Americans will make in November now comes into clearer focus.

zh: 选民会听从特朗普的诱惑 — — 通过接受自我毁灭式的闭关锁国政策给美国经济和世界造成严重伤害吗？
en: Will voters heed the siren song of Trump – and do great damage to the US economy and to the world by embracing a self-destructive effort to wall themselves off from the world?

zh: 还是会选择繁荣和全球领导角色？
en: Or will they choose prosperity and a leading global role?

zh: 欧洲的英国退出问题
en: Brexit’s Questions for Europe

zh: 马德里—三个月后，英国公民必须决定是否留在欧盟。
en: MADRID – In three months, British citizens will have to decide whether or not to remain in the European Union.

zh: 但他们不是唯一必须考虑政治未来的一群人。
en: But they are not the only ones who must consider their political future.

zh: 即将到来的全民公决也给欧洲其他国家带来了两个重要问题。
en: The upcoming referendum also poses two important questions for the rest of Europe.

zh: 第一个问题是欧洲人将偏好和应该偏好哪个结果。
en: The first question is which outcome Europeans would and should prefer.

zh: 一些人已经把英国一笔勾销，声称考虑离开的伙伴已经不是他们想要的伙伴了。
en: Some have already written off the United Kingdom, claiming that a partner that would consider leaving is not the kind of partner they want, anyway.

zh: 不管你是否赞同这一观点，它的要点值得思考。
en: Whether or not one shares this opinion, the point is worth studying.

zh: 事实上，不问一问保留一个挑战欧洲一体化原则的成员是否真的符合欧盟的最佳利益是幼稚的。
en: Indeed, it would be naive not to ask whether retaining a member that is challenging the very principle of European integration would really be in the EU’s best interests.

zh: 现实是，英国公众对主权问题的争论不会因为投票而结束。
en: The reality is that the British public debate on sovereignty will not end when the votes are counted.

zh: 毕竟，即使大部分人对欧盟投“是”票，一定比例 — — 根据民调，这个比例不小 — — 的人口仍然认为英国退出对英国更有利。
en: After all, even if the majority says “yes” to the EU, a share of the population – a substantial one, according to the polls – will remain convinced that Brexit would have been much better for the UK.

zh: 基于此，英国及其欧洲伙伴的争论和谈判将继续在围绕欧盟成员资格的限制和条件上存在深刻分歧。
en: Given this, debates and negotiations involving the UK and its European partners will continue to feature deep disagreements over the restrictions and conditions that accompany membership in the EU.

zh: 在多年的时间里，英国人将要求不断地确认他们做出了正确的选择。
en: For years to come, the British will demand a constant drumbeat of reaffirmation that they made the right choice.

zh: 这是一个重要的考虑，不应该置之不理。
en: This is an important consideration that should not be dismissed out of hand.

zh: 但也不应该因此导致欧洲其他地区偏向英国退出。
en: But it should not lead the rest of Europe to favor Brexit.

zh: 事实上，如果大部分英国选民决定放弃欧盟，那么每个人都要承受后果。
en: Indeed, if the majority of British voters decided to abandon the EU, everyone would suffer the consequences.

zh: 首先，英国退出将给英国和欧盟都带来巨大的经济打击。
en: For starters, Brexit would deal a major economic blow to the UK and the EU alike.

zh: 但这不是全部。
en: But that is not all.

zh: 英国退出还会削弱双方的安全、外交政策和国际地位。
en: It would also weaken the security, foreign policy, and international standing of both parties.

zh: 在面临大规模移民危机、欧洲边界冲突和残忍的伊斯兰国的情况下 — — 这些安全威胁影响全欧洲，不可能由任何国家单独面对 — — 共同的欧盟外交和安全政策的必要性比任何时候都要明确。
en: In the face of a large-scale migration crisis, conflict on Europe’s borders, and the brutality of the Islamic State – security threats that affect all Europeans, and that cannot be confronted by any country alone – the need for a common EU foreign and security policy is clearer than ever.

zh: 但欧洲国家依旧难以就外交政策手段形成一致 — — 这一失败正在危及它们的国际影响。
en: Yet European countries continue to struggle to reach consensus on foreign-policy measures – a failure that is undermining their international influence.

zh: 事实上，多年来欧盟的主要精力都花在了应对经济危机上，其在某些国际决策竞技场上的影响力和领导力有所消失。
en: Indeed, after spending several years focused on coping with economic crises, the EU’s influence and leadership in certain international decision-making arenas have waned.

zh: 与此同时，欧盟成员国 — — 包括欧洲最大军事力量英国，传统上它 一直致力于国际视角的政策 — — 一直在削减防务开支。
en: Meanwhile, member countries – including the UK, Europe’s greatest military power, which has traditionally been committed to international-minded policies – have been downsizing their defense expenditures.

zh: 英国退出将加剧对欧洲一体化的疑虑。 进一步降低欧盟成员国的合作意愿，导致安全和剩余国际影响力下降。
en: By intensifying doubts about European integration, Brexit would further reduce the willingness of EU members to cooperate, resulting in the deterioration of both their security and their remaining international influence.

zh: 对欧洲来说，失去如此重要的安全伙伴显然是不利的。
en: For Europe, the loss of such an important security partner would clearly be detrimental.

zh: 但英国 — — 它必须因此单独面对全球威胁，手段和伙伴都会减少 — — 也会变得更加脆弱。
en: But the UK ��� left to confront global threats on its own, with less means and fewer partners – would be more vulnerable as well.

zh: 全民公决给欧洲人带来的第二个问题和英国正在解决的问题一样：欧盟成员资格值得追求吗？
en: The second question that the referendum poses for Europeans is the same one that the British are addressing: Is EU membership worthwhile?

zh: 如今，欧盟中的离心力比以往任何时候都要大，不但英吉利海峡两岸是如此，欧洲大陆也是如此。
en: Centrifugal forces in the EU are stronger today than ever before, not only across the English Channel, but throughout the continent.

zh: 许多国家都存在寻求“恢复”主权要素的政治运动和政党 — — 尽管势头不尽相同 — — 给共同行动在成掣肘。
en: Many countries have political movements and parties – some stronger than others – that are seeking to “recover” elements of sovereignty, to the detriment of common action.

zh: 一些政府甚至采取了与欧盟决定相悖的单边措施。
en: Some governments have even taken unilateral measures contrary to EU decisions.

zh: 简言之，成员国之间缺乏团结助长了削弱作为欧盟立盟基础的价值观和原则，许多人支持将民族国家作为一切问题解决办法的观点。
en: Simply put, the lack of solidarity among member states has fueled efforts to weaken the values and principles on which the EU was founded, with many favoring a view that holds out the nation-state as the solution to every problem.

zh: 英国退出将强化这一趋势，提振欧洲民族主义和欧元怀疑派力量。
en: Brexit would reinforce this trend, bolstering Europe’s nationalist and Euroskeptic forces.

zh: 明年，法国和德国将举行大选，反欧洲力量可能在政治上得势或许将带来严重的长期影响。
en: With a presidential election in France and federal elections in Germany next year, the potential political boost to anti-European forces could have serious long-term consequences.

zh: 从这个意义上讲，德国的最新地区选举是一个警告。
en: In this sense, Germany’s recent regional elections should serve as a warning.

zh: 必须弄清楚：推动这些运动的观点 — — 欧盟是从经济困难到难民危机的欧洲诸多问题的根源，退盟（或单边行动）是解决这些问题的唯���办法 — — 大错特错。
en: Let us be clear: The view driving these movements – that the EU is at the root of Europe’s myriad problems, from economic hardship to the refugee crisis, and that withdrawal (or unilateral action) is the only way to resolve them – is patently false.

zh: 我们所面临的问题不是因为欧洲一体化而产生的。
en: The problems we are facing did not arise because of European integration.

zh: 全球经济挑战和移民和寻求避难者浪潮将继续朝欧洲边界涌来，不管欧洲是不是统一。
en: Global economic challenges and the flood of migrants and asylum-seekers will continue to reach Europe’s borders, whether it is united or not.

zh: 重要的是欧洲如何应对它们。
en: What matters is how Europe responds to them.

zh: 一体化的理由是集体行动远比单边行动有效。
en: The rationale for integration is that collective action is far more effective than unilateral efforts.

zh: 当然，要不了多久，民族主义方针的愚蠢性就会表露无遗。
en: Of course, it would not take long for the folly in the nationalistic approach to become apparent.

zh: 但它们造成的危害可能十分严重。
en: But the damage caused by then could be severe.

zh: 因此，欧洲一体化运动不应该局限于机械地重申欧盟给其成员国带来的好处，更不能安抚欧元怀疑派。
en: Given this, campaigns for European integration should not be limited to a rote affirmation of the benefits the EU has brought to its members, much less to efforts to appease Euroskeptics.

zh: 相反，欧盟应该作为有吸引力的政治工程得到重申。
en: Rather, the EU should be reaffirmed as an attractive political project.

zh: 这一欧盟的微妙时刻需要欧洲果断朝更有效、更一体化、更令人渴望的联盟迈进。
en: This delicate moment for the EU demands decisive progress toward a more effective, more integrated, and more desirable union.

zh: 英国脱盟的大背景
en: Brexit in Context

zh: 发自米兰 — — 我从不认为外国人（注：作者是美国人）在当一个国家的公民（或像欧盟这类较大实体中的民众）面对一个重要政治选择时所发表的强烈意见会产生多少有用的贡献。
en: MILAN – I do not believe that foreigners contribute usefully by issuing strong opinions about how a country’s citizens, or those of a larger unit like the European Union, should decide when faced with an important political choice.

zh: 我们构建于国际经验之上的见解有时会有所帮助；但也不应混淆了各人所扮演角色的不对称性。
en: Our insights, based on international experience, may sometimes be helpful; but there should never be any confusion about the asymmetry of roles.

zh: 这点在英国是否继续留在欧盟的全民公决上显得尤为突出。
en: This is particularly true of the British referendum on whether to remain in the EU.

zh: 距离表决仅有数日，正反两派势均力敌，也存在着足够数量的中间派选民来影响其最终走向。
en: Just days before the vote, the outcome is too close to call, and there appear to be enough undecided voters to tip it either way.

zh: 但由于这场与政治和社会的分裂已经远远扩展到了欧洲以外，我们这些外国人也许能够对事情的重点部分补充一些观点。
en: But, with political and social fragmentation extending well beyond Europe, outsiders may be able to add some perspective on what is really at issue.

zh: 首先，毫无疑问，在收入，财富的分配以及被动性结构变革的成本和收益方面，大多数发达国家的增长模式在过去20年间都是存在问题的。
en: First, it will come as no surprise that, in terms of the distribution of income, wealth, and the costs and benefits of forced structural change, growth patterns in most of the developed world have been problematic for the past 20 years.

zh: 此外我们也都会意识到全球化和某些数字化技术 — — 尤其是与自动化和去中介化（disintermediation）相关的 — — 导致了工作和收入的两极分化，对各个国家的中产阶级都造成了持续的压力。
en: We know that globalization and some aspects of digital technology (particularly those related to automation and disintermediation) have contributed to job and income polarization, placing sustained pressure on the middle class in every country.

zh: 其二，欧洲的危机（更像是某种慢性病）导致长期低增长以及高得惊人的失业率 — — 尤其是青年失业问题。
en: Second, Europe’s ongoing crisis (more like a chronic condition) has kept growth far too low and unemployment – especially youth unemployment – unacceptably high.

zh: 这不仅仅是欧洲的问题，在美国，虽然名义失业率有所下降，但大规模的就业人口流失问题令人们 — — 无论是左派还是右派 — — 也对那些看似过分偏袒社会顶端阶层的经济增长模式和政策甚为不满。
en: And Europe is not alone. In the United States, while the formal unemployment rate has fallen, large-scale failures in terms of inclusiveness have fueled disenchantment – on both the left and the right – at growth patterns and policies that seem to benefit those at the top disproportionately.

zh: 在近期的经济冲击之下，如果能看到各方共同努力来解决这些问题的迹象 — — 且基于真诚合理的责任分担 — — 发达国家的公民们可能会感觉没那么失望。
en: Given the magnitude of recent economic shocks, developed countries’ citizens might be less unhappy were there evidence of a concerted effort – based on genuine burden sharing – to address these issues.

zh: 而在欧洲的语境下，这就意味着多国协同努力。
en: In the context of Europe, that would mean a multinational effort.

zh: 无奈大部分的有效应对措施都依然无影无踪 — — 这在整个发达世界已经不是第一次了。
en: But, for the most part – and again throughout the developed world – effective responses have been missing.

zh: 各大中央银行都被指派了一些其手中工具和手段都无力达成的政策目标，而一部分精英则在等待机会将经济表现疲弱的罪责推到货币政策制定者身上。
en: Central banks have been left largely alone with objectives that exceed the capacity of their tools and instruments, while elements of the elite wait for a chance to blame monetary policymakers for weak economic performance.

zh: 当需要针对某些重大挑战作出非货币政策性反应，且这种反应要么不做，要么或多或少存在些缺陷的情况下，一个民主体制所作出的自然反应就是更换一批决策者并尝试些不同的策略。
en: In the face of non-monetary policy responses that are somewhere between deficient and non-existent relative to the magnitude of the challenges we face, the natural response in a democracy is to replace the decision-makers and try something different.

zh: 毕竟民主就是一个反复实验以及让公民表达意愿的体系。
en: After all, democracy is a system for experimentation, as well for the expression of citizens’ will.

zh: 当然“新的”不一定就是好的，可能会更糟 — — 甚至可能糟糕得多。
en: Of course, the “new” may not be better and could be worse – perhaps significantly worse.

zh: 第三，欧盟面对的是大多数发达国家所面临的一个问题，且程度更为严重：有股凌驾在民选官员权力之上的强大力量塑造了公民的生活，令他们产生了深深的无力感。
en: Third, the EU is confronting, in more severe form, a problem facing much of the developed world: powerful forces operating beyond the control of elected officials are shaping citizens’ lives, leaving them feeling powerless.

zh: 即便所有国家都必须应对全球化和技术变革的挑战，但欧盟的重要治理元素却是超出民主体制之外的，至少那些人们理解和接触的方面就是如此。
en: But while all countries must deal with the challenges of globalization and technological change, important elements of governance in the EU are beyond the reach of democratic institutions, at least those that people understand and relate to.

zh: 这并不是说各国自治就不存在问题。
en: This is not to say that local governance is problem-free.

zh: 它也存在着腐败，特殊利益集团和完全失能等常见问题。
en: It isn’t. Corruption, special interests, and sheer incompetence are common problems.

zh: 但民主的治理在原则上是可修复的，也确实存在体制性的防御手段和针对性措施。
en: But democratic governance is in principle fixable, and institutional defenses and countermeasures do exist.

zh: 欧元区的情况尤为不稳定，一方面公民与那些相隔遥远的技术官僚精英日益疏远；另一方面缺乏汇率，通货膨胀和公共投资等常规经济调整机制；另外对财政转移支付这种能传达真正的凝聚力界限信号的强大手段则限制过多。
en: The situation in the eurozone is particularly unstable, owing to citizens’ growing alienation from a distant, technocratic elite; the absence of conventional economic adjustment mechanisms (exchange rates, inflation, public investment, and so on); and tight limits on fiscal transfers, which send powerful signals about the real boundaries of cohesion.

zh: 英国“脱盟”就是这场宏大闹剧的其中一幕。
en: Brexit is a part of this larger drama.

zh: 它的重点在于治理而非经济。
en: It is primarily about governance, not economics.

zh: 从严格的经济学角度来看，英国和欧盟其他的风险几乎完全处于下行趋势。
en: From a strictly economic point of view, the risks for both the United Kingdom and the rest of the EU are almost entirely on the downside.

zh: 但如果这就是问题的全部的���，留在欧盟就会是早就确定的事了。
en: But if that was all there was to the issue, the outcome would be a foregone conclusion in favor of staying.

zh: 真正的问题 — — 有效和包容性的自我治理 — — 在任何地方都不是一个简单的问题，因为技术性分化这样的力量根本不在意什么国界。
en: The real issue – effective and inclusive self-governance – is not an easy one to tackle anywhere, because forces such as technological disruption do not respect national boundaries.

zh: 英国人现在表决的是留在欧盟能否增强或减弱自身在这些动荡水域中导航的能力。
en: In part, Britons are voting on whether their capacity to navigate in these turbulent waters is enhanced or diminished by continued EU membership.

zh: 但政治认同这个更根本问题也是考虑因素 — — 正如2014年苏格兰独立公投所体现的那样。
en: But a more fundamental question of political identity is also at stake – just as it was in Scotland’s independence referendum in 2014.

zh: 一些英国人（或许甚至是大多数）和许多其他欧盟国家公民仍然会希望自己的下一代（尽管拥有一个令人自豪的英国，德语或西班牙血统）自认为欧洲人并准备好再次改革欧洲的治理结构，也有理由认定如果有一个团结民主的欧洲作为实现稳定和变革的主要力量的话这个世界将变得更为美好。
en: Some Britons (perhaps even a majority), and many other EU citizens, still want future generations to think of themselves as Europeans (albeit with a proud British, German, or Spanish origin), and are prepared to take another shot at reforming Europe’s governance structures. And they are right to think that the world would be a far better place with a united, democratic Europe as a major force for both stability and change.

zh: 这是我的希望，尽管可能更多是一厢情愿。
en: That is my hope, though it may border on wishful thinking.

zh: 但无论“脱盟”公投的结果如何（跟许多局外人一样，我希望英国人能投票决定留下来，并提倡从内部启动改革 ） ， 英国的投票，以及在其他地区展现的类似强离心政治趋势，应该引起对欧洲治理结构和制度安排的主要反思，其目标应该是重建民众的控制感和对选区负责的精神。
en: Regardless of the outcome of the Brexit referendum (like many outsiders, I hope Britain votes to stay and advocates for reform from within), the British vote, along with similar strong centrifugal political trends elsewhere, should bring about a major rethink of European governance structures and institutional arrangements. The goal should be to restore a sense of control and responsibility to the electorates.

zh: 从长远来看这会是一个好的结果。
en: That would be a good outcome in the long run.

zh: 它将要求在欧洲的各个层面 — — 包括政府、商界，劳工组织和公民社会 — — 都展现出卓越的领导能力，同时重新致力于诚信、包容，责任和慷慨。
en: It would require inspired leadership from all corners of Europe – including government, business, organized labor, and civil society as well as a renewed commitment to integrity, inclusiveness, responsibility, and generosity.

zh: 这是一个艰巨的任务;但它并不是一个不可能完成的难题。
en: That is a tall order; but it is not an impossible one to fill.

zh: 英国脱欧逆转？
en: Brexit In Reverse?

zh: 伦敦—经济现实正在开始追上许多英国人错误的希望。
