en: A second reason for the disaster is the fragmentation of Britain’s two main political parties.

zh: 多年来，反欧情绪就一直侵蚀着保守党。
en: For years, anti-European sentiment has corroded the authority of Conservative leaders.

zh: 此外，随着信仰坚定的保守党支持者锐减，任何党纪和忠诚的概念早在数年前就不复存在了。
en: Moreover, any notion of party discipline and loyalty collapsed years ago, as the number of committed Conservative supporters dwindled.

zh: 更可怕的是工党阵营，他们的传统支持者是许多工薪阶层区域高票“脱欧”的始作俑者。
en: Worse is what has happened in the Labour Party, whose traditional supporters provided the impetus behind the big “Leave” votes in many working-class areas.

zh: 随着英国退欧，我们现在目睹了唐纳德·特朗普式的民粹主义来到英国。
en: With Brexit, we have now seen Donald Trump-style populism come to Britain.

zh: 显而易见，人们对被民粹主义愤怒海啸裹挟而来的针对“体制成员”的敌意是十分普遍的。
en: Obviously, there is widespread hostility, submerged in a tsunami of populist bile, to anyone deemed a member of the “establishment.”

zh: 像司法大臣迈克尔·戈夫那样的退欧支持者将所有专家都斥之为有产阶级针对无产阶级的自私自利的阴谋。
en: Brexit campaigners like Justice Secretary Michael Gove rejected every expert as part of a self-serving conspiracy of the haves against the have-nots.

zh: 因此，无论英格兰银行行长、坎特伯雷大主教还是美国总统，他们的建议都是一文不值的。
en: So, whether it was the governor of the Bank of England, the Archbishop of Canterbury, or the President of the United States, their advice counted for nothing.

zh: 所有人都被描绘成另一个世界的代表，那个世界丝毫无关于普通英国民众的生活。
en: All were portrayed as representatives of another world, with no relationship to the lives of ordinary British people.

zh: 由此推导出脱欧投票的第三个原因：日益严重的社会不公平现象已经导致了对所谓都市精英阶层的反叛运动。
en: That points to a third reason for the pro-Brexit vote: growing social inequity has contributed to a revolt against a perceived metropolitan elite.

zh: 以桑德兰和曼彻斯特为代表的古老的工业英格兰对更加富裕的伦敦投了反对票。
en: Old industrial England, in cities like Sunderland and Manchester, voted against better-off London.

zh: 这些选民认为全球化只惠及了顶层精英 — — 他们与其他国家的民众合作导致其他人的利益受到损伤。
en: Globalization, these voters were told, benefits only those at the top – comfortable working with the rest of the world – at the expense of everyone else.

zh: 此外，多年来几乎没人为英国的欧盟成员资格说话也没起到好作用。
en: Beyond these reasons, it doesn’t help that for years hardly anyone has vigorously defended British membership in the EU.

zh: 这种现象造成某种真空，人们坐视妄想和欺骗抹杀了欧洲合作的一切好处，并促使民众认为英国已经投靠布鲁塞尔为奴。
en: This created a vacuum, allowing delusion and deception to blot out the benefits of European cooperation, and encouraging the view that the British had become the slaves of Brussels.

zh: 脱欧选民被灌输了荒唐的主权概念，从而导致他们选择荒唐的独立而弃国家利益于不顾。
en: Pro-Brexit voters were fed a ludicrous conception of sovereignty, leading them to choose pantomime independence over the national interest.

zh: 但呻吟和撕心裂肺现在起不了任何作用。
en: But moaning and rending one’s garments won’t do any good now.

zh: 在严峻的情况下，有关各方必须光明正大地为英国的利益服务。
en: In grim circumstances, concerned parties must honorably try to secure what is best for the UK.

zh: 人们希望退欧支持者至少有对的一面，尽管这种情况看似很难想象。
en: One hopes the Brexiteers were at least half right, as difficult as that is to imagine.

zh: 无论如何，人们必须尽一切可能面对现状。
en: At any rate, one must make the best of the hand that has been dealt.

zh: 不过，还需要面对三项直接挑战。
en: Still, three immediate challenges come to mind.

zh: 首先，现在戴维·卡梅伦已宣布将要辞职，保守党右翼和某些令人生厌的党员将主导新一届政府。
en: First, now that David Cameron has made clear that he will resign, the Conservative Party’s right wing and some of its sourer members will dominate the new government.

zh: 卡梅伦没有选择。
en: Cameron had no choice.

zh: 他不可能前往布鲁塞尔代表口蜜腹剑的同事谈判他根本不支持的事务。
en: He could not possibly have gone to Brussels on behalf of his backstabbing colleagues to negotiate something he didn’t support.

zh: 如果他的继任者是某位退欧领袖，那么英国将接受过去十周谎言传播者的领导。
en: If his successor is a Brexit leader, Britain can look forward to being led by someone who has spent the last ten weeks spreading lies.

zh: 其次，将英国 — — 特别是均已投票留欧的苏格兰和北爱尔兰 — — 联系在一起的纽带将在很大程度上承压。
en: Second, the bonds that hold the UK together – particularly Scotland and Northern Ireland, which both voted to stay in Europe – will come under great strain.

zh: 我希望英国退欧的反叛活动最终不会导致分裂英国的投票，但那样的结果无疑是有可能的。
en: I hope the Brexit revolt will not lead inevitably to a vote for the breakup of the UK, but that outcome is certainly a possibility.

zh: 第三，英国将要很快开始谈判退出事宜。
en: Third, Britain will need to begin negotiating its exit very soon.

zh: 很难想象英国与欧盟的关系可能比现在更好。
en: It is difficult to see how it can possibly end up with a better relationship with the EU than it has now.

zh: 所有英国人都要说服世界各国的朋友，他们没有丧失最基本的常识。
en: All Britons will have their work cut out for them to convince their friends around the world that they have not taken leave of their moderate senses.

zh: 公投活动重振了民族政治，而民族政治归根结底关乎种族、移民和阴谋。
en: The referendum campaign revived nationalist politics, which in the end is always about race, immigration, and conspiracies.

zh: 我们亲欧盟阵营所有人面对的共同任务是遏制英国退欧所释放的力量，并宣扬过去曾赢得全球盟友和崇拜者尊重的价值。
en: A task we all have in the pro-Europe camp is to try to contain the forces that Brexit has unleashed, and to assert the sort of values that have in the past earned us so many friends and admirers around the world.

zh: 所有这些始于20世纪40年代温斯顿·丘吉尔的欧洲目标。
en: All of this began in the 1940s, with Winston Churchill and his vision of Europe.

zh: 可以用丘吉尔的另一句名言来描绘它的结束 ： “ 政治自杀的问题在于你会活着看到自杀的后果。 ”
en: The way it will end can be described by one of Churchill’s more famous aphorisms: “The trouble with committing political suicide is that you live to regret it.”

zh: 事实上，很多“脱欧”选民或许活不到后悔的时候。
en: In fact, many “Leave” voters may not live to regret it.

zh: 但那些压倒性投票支持留欧的年轻人却肯定能看到。
en: But the young Britons who voted overwhelmingly to remain a part of Europe almost certainly will.

zh: 足球、英国退出和我们
en: Football, Brexit, and Us

zh: 坎布里奇—在24支晋级今年欧洲足球锦标赛的球队中，只有一支来自德国。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Of the 24 teams that qualified for this year’s UEFA European Cup football (soccer) tournament, only one came from Germany.

zh: 三支来自英国：英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰。
en: Three came from the United Kingdom: England, Wales, and Northern Ireland.

zh: 这看起来相当奇怪。
en: That seems rather odd.

zh: 毕竟。 东西德1991年才重新统一，巴伐利亚和普鲁士1871年才统一，而爱尔兰、威尔士和苏格兰被英格兰王国吞并/统一分别是在1777年、1542年和1707年。
en: After all, East and West Germans reunited only in 1991, and Bavarians united with Prussians only in 1871, whereas the annexations/unions of Ireland, Wales, and Scotland to the Kingdom of England go back to 1177, 1542, and 1707, respectively.

zh: 那么，为何图林根人、萨克逊人和斯瓦比亚人支持同一支德国队，而英国公民却支持这么多支球队？
en: So why do Thuringians, Saxons, and Swabians root for the same German team, while UK citizens root for so many?

zh: （苏格兰甚至直布罗陀也有自己的球队。
en: (Scotland and even Gibraltar have their own teams as well.)

zh: ）如果他们选出最好的选手代表他们所有人，不是能够拥有一支更强的队伍？
en: Wouldn’t they have a stronger team if they chose the best players to represent them all?

zh: 英国公民想必也明白这一点，但他们更愿意拥有自己的国家队，而不是一支更强的英国队 — — 即使这意味着输给蕞尔小国冰岛。
en: Presumably, British citizens understand this, but they prefer to have their own national teams rather than a stronger UK team – even if this means losing to tiny Iceland.

zh: 毕竟，如果仅仅是为了组成最强球队，你也许还会支持巴塞罗那。
en: After all, if it is only about the strongest team, you might as well root for Barcelona.

zh: 对于一支代表“我们”的球队，它无论如何必须是我们。
en: For a team to represent “us,” it somehow has to be us.

zh: 从这个角度看，英国退出投票也不那么令人震惊了。
en: Seen in this light, the Brexit vote is less surprising.

zh: “留欧”阵营注重于留在欧盟的经济收益和脱离欧盟的成本，其中一些在公投结果宣布后立刻兑现：英镑崩盘，股市财富蒸发数亿美元。
en: The “Remain” campaign focused on the economic benefits of staying in the European Union and the costs of leaving, some of which fell due immediately after the results were announced: the British pound plummeted and stock markets wiped out a couple of trillion dollars of wealth.

zh: 但那52%支持退欧的人更想要一个不允许波兰人和罗马尼亚人生活、工作和竞争经济队伍位置的国家。
en: And yet 52% of those who voted preferred a country where Poles and Romanians would not be permitted to live, work, and compete for a position on the economic team.

zh: 让他们进来也许能打造一支更好的队伍，但它已不再是我们的队伍。
en: Letting them in might produce a better team, but it would no longer be our team.

zh: 从某种角度，这只是感情战胜经济逻辑的又一个例子。
en: From one perspective, this is just another case of emotion defeating economic logic.

zh: 但我们的感情是算法（algorithms ） ， 是演化留给我们，我们用来做出大部分决定（包括政治决定 ） ； 而不与我们的感情罗盘相接的经济成本-收益分析无法推动罗盘上的指针。
en: But our emotions are the algorithms, bequeathed by evolution, by which we make most decisions, including political ones; economic cost-benefit analysis that does not connect to our emotional compass does not move the needle.

zh: 这个问题的关键是“我们”这种感觉。
en: At the core of the issue is the sense of “us.”

zh: 成为欧盟、尼日利亚、伊拉克、土耳其、瑞士或其他任何政治实体的一员意味着什么？
en: What does it mean to be a member of the EU, Nigeria, Iraq, Turkey, Switzerland, or any other political entity?

zh: 我们的感觉是大脑的一个次级例行程序，它基于自我的感觉，而自我的感觉是大脑为数众多的创造物之一：一种身为可以体验事物、记忆它的历史、可以行动并具备感觉和目标的活动的实体的感觉 — — 即著名神经科学家安东尼奥·达马西奥（Antonio Damasio）所谓的亲历式自我（autobiographical self ） 。
en: The sense of us is a subroutine of the brain based on the sense of self, which is one of our brain’s many creations: a sensation of being an ongoing entity that experiences things, remembers its history, can act, and has feelings and goals – what the eminent neuroscientist Antonio Damasio calls an autobiographical self.

zh: 我们的大脑也敏锐地察觉其他自我的存在，以及他们的感觉和意图，并且尤其擅长阅读其他人在想什么，感觉什么，计划什么。
en: Our brain is also acutely aware of the existence of other selves, with their feelings and intentions, and it is particularly good at reading what others are thinking, feeling, and planning.

zh: 我们用同样的心理装置发展出“我们”的感觉：我们所关心和支持的人。
en: We use this same mental apparatus to develop a sense of “us”: the people we care about and root for.

zh: 我们将“我们”看成是一个有历史、有性情、有癖性、有抱负的人。
en: We think of this “us” as if it were a person with an autobiography, a temperament, predispositions, and aspirations.

zh: 我们将企业视为法人，我们谈论国家时将它们当作一个带有鲜明性格的组合人：德国人喜欢秩序，意大利人有激情，英国人表情僵硬。
en: We regard firms as legal persons, and we talk about countries as if they were a composite person with clear characteristics: Germans love order, Italians are passionate, and Brits possess a stiff upper lip.

zh: 而显然 ， “ 我们”的感觉隐含一种“他们”的感觉：我们认为他们的福利不如我们自己的福利那么重要的人。
en: And, obviously, the sense of “us” implies a sense of “them”: those whose welfare we consider less fundamental than our own.

zh: 哈佛大学道德认知实验室主任约书亚·格林（Joshua Greene）指出，我们的道德情感的演化让我们支持人类合作。
en: As Joshua Greene, Director of Harvard University’s Moral Cognition Lab, has argued, our moral sentiments evolved to support human cooperation.

zh: 正如演化给予我们性欲而不是理性争论来确保繁衍，我们也演化出同情、爱情、憎恶和愤怒来反应彼此之间的行为。
en: Just as evolution gave us sexual desire, rather than rational arguments, to ensure procreation, so we have evolved feelings of empathy, affection, disgust, and rage to respond to one another’s behavior.

zh: 我们的道德情感既限制个体滥用公益（common good ） ， 表现为“我”与“我们”之间的冲突；也维持群体的凝聚力，支持“我们”与“他们”之间的竞争。
en: Our moral sentiments both limit individuals’ abuse of the common good, expressed in the conflict between “me” and “us,” and maintain the coherence of the group, to support the competition between “us” and “them.”

zh: 技术和文化发展需要大大扩大的“我们”的感觉。
en: Technological and cultural development has required an ever-expanding sense of “us.”

zh: 在过去10,000年中，随着我们从小型狩猎-采集部落演化为农耕、城市化和更高级的形式，我们必须与之互动与合作的人的网络也有所扩大，从小部落演变为民族国家，最终又形成欧盟这样的实体。
en: Over the past 10,000 years, as we moved from small hunter-gatherer bands to agricultural settlements, urbanization, and beyond, the network of people with whom we must interact and cooperate expanded, from small bands to nations-states and eventually to an entity like the EU.

zh: 当人类依靠温饱型农业过活时，他们的互动半径很小：他们不需要彼此交谈，结果是语言呈现多样性。
en: When humans lived from subsistence agriculture, their radius of interaction was small: they did not have to talk to one another, and as a consequence, languages diverged.

zh: 因此，面积略小于西班牙的喀麦隆存在230种语言。
en: That is why Cameroon, a country slightly smaller than Spain, is home to 230 languages.

zh: 相反，当工业革命增加了更大的市场的价值时，意大利（1861—1871年）和德国（1870—1871年）通过在民族主义情绪和共同语言的基础上合并小国而得以建立，实际上，两国都必须被建立。
en: By contrast, when the Industrial Revolution increased the value of larger markets, Italy (1861-1871) and Germany (1870-1871) were created by unifying smaller states on the basis of nationalist sentiment and a common language, both of which actually had to be created.

zh: 显然，共同的我们的感觉让政治实体的存在变得容易了许多。
en: A shared sense of us obviously makes life much easier for political entities.

zh: 没有这种感觉，国家 — — 应该由它来做出决定、定义和保护权利并规定义务 — — 代表谁行动？
en: Without it, on whose behalf would the state – which is supposed to make decisions, define and protect rights, and impose obligations – be acting?

zh: 如果“我们”只包括（比如）叙利亚的阿拉维派、肯尼亚的吉库尤人或中国的汉族，那么所有其他人都有动力起义。
en: If “us” includes only, say, the Alawites in Syria, the Kikuyu in Kenya, or Han Chinese in China, everyone else has an incentive to rebel.

zh: 显然，有共同语言和宗教的国家比其他国家更容易发展出“我们”的感觉。
en: Clearly, countries that have a shared language and religion may develop a sense of “us” more easily than others.

zh: 但世界上也存在众多在这两方面呈现出多样性的国家，在这些国家，另一种“我们”的感觉演化出来并一直由政治来定义。
en: But the world is full of states that are very diverse in these two dimensions, in which an alternative sense of “us” evolves and is constantly redefined by politics.

zh: 比如，在美国 ， “ 我们”的感觉最初只包括盎格鲁-萨克逊新教徒，而不包括爱尔兰人、意大利人或波兰天主教徒和犹太人 — — 尤其不包括非洲裔美国人。
en: In the United States, for example, the sense of “us” initially included only white Anglo-Saxon Protestants, not Irish, Italian, or Polish Catholics or Jews – and especially not African-Americans.

zh: 基本上是通过政治，一个更加包容的“我们”的感觉发展形成。
en: Largely through politics, a more inclusive sense of “us” developed.

zh: 在缺少共同语言和宗教的情况下，欧盟的“我们”的感觉必须基于共同的价值和文化，它们产生自数百年的互动。
en: In the absence of a common language and religion, the EU’s sense of “us” must be based on shared values and culture, born of centuries of interaction.

zh: 这是一个遗产：文艺复兴、启蒙运动、多次工业革命、梦幻般的科学、艺术和大部分体育。
en: And what a heritage it is: the Renaissance, the Enlightenment, several industrial revolutions, fantastic science, art, and most sports.

zh: 你也许会奇怪为何欧元钞票上印的是朦胧的花纹，而不是人人敬仰的人物 — — 达芬奇、牛顿、伏尔泰、伦勃朗、塞万提斯、肖邦或贝多芬这些欧洲文化遗产的最佳代表。
en: One wonders why euro bills are adorned with indistinct motifs, rather than with figures of universal appeal – da Vinci, Newton, Voltaire, Rembrandt, Cervantes, Chopin, or Beethoven – who best represent Europe’s cultural patrimony.

zh: 欧洲工程要想成功，就必须创造一个欧洲的“我们”的感觉，这种感觉要强大到让人觉得保加利亚理所当然应该被允许在伯明翰生活和工作。
en: The European project will succeed only when it creates a European sense of “us” so powerful that it feels right that, say, Bulgarians should be permitted to live and work in Birmingham.

zh: 当所有人都是欧洲人时，所有人都可以在他们喜欢的任何欧洲地点生活。
en: When all are European, all may live wherever in Europe they please.

zh: 他们甚至还可能组成一支球队参赛。
en: They might even become the team to beat.

zh: 英国退出与特殊关系
en: Brexit and the Special Relationship

zh: 纽约—是否继续成为欧盟的一部分的决定显然应该由英国人民和他们所选出的代表做出。
en: NEW YORK – The decision whether to remain part of the European Union is obviously one for the British people and their elected representatives to make.

zh: 但其结果所影响到的将不只是英国和欧洲的利益。 因此，让其他方面参与进来合情合理。
en: But more than British and European interests will be affected by the outcome, so it is both legitimate and appropriate for other parties to weigh in.

zh: 因此，让我行使作为利益相关外部人士的权利，表达我的明确观点：从我（以及其他许多美国人）的角度讲，英国做出退出欧盟的决定令人讨厌 — — 事实上，是非常令人讨厌。
en: So let me exercise my right as an outsider with a stake in what happens to express a clear opinion: From my perspective (and that of many other Americans), a decision by the United Kingdom to exit the EU would be undesirable – indeed, highly undesirable.

zh: 我知道，有人会指出这一观点的讽刺之处：美国本身就是脱离大英帝国美洲殖民地而 成立的。
en: I am aware of the irony some are sure to note in this, given that the United States’ own independence came about when the American colonies exited Great Britain.

zh: 但今时不同往日，英国退出欧盟将让双方后悔，并引起其紧密盟友的担忧。
en: But that was then, and this is now, and the UK’s exit from Europe would be greeted with equal parts regret and concern by its closest ally.

zh: 原因有很多。
en: There are several reasons for this.

zh: 美国之所以如此重视与英国的关系，原因之一便是英国在欧洲的角色。
en: One reason why the US values its ties to the UK as much as it does is the UK’s role in Europe.

zh: 英国很重要，不仅因为它是一个双边伙伴，也因为（这个原因更加重要）美国可以依靠它来主张或支持布鲁塞尔与美国一致（或至少不严重偏离）的立场。
en: Britain is important not just as a bilateral partner, but because more often than not it can be counted on to argue for and support positions in Brussels consistent with, or at least not far from, those of the US.

zh: 所谓的“特殊关系”在近几年中大大弱化，国会在12月之前一直拒绝支持军事干预叙利亚令这一关系雪上加霜。
en: The so-called “special relationship” has already become considerably less so in recent years, with Parliament’s refusal until December to support military action in Syria taking a particularly heavy toll in this regard.

zh: 英国已经变成 — — 并且被广泛认为是 — — 一个不再那么可靠、不再那么有能力的盟友，而如果英国采取让其在欧洲的角色边缘化的举动，将进一步加剧现实和感觉。
en: Britain has become – and is widely perceived to be – a less dependable and less capable ally, and reality and perception would intensify if the UK were to take a step that would marginalize its role on the continent.

zh: 除了让英国变得更加狭隘、影响力更小，难以想象英国退出还能有什么效果。
en: It is hard to envision Brexit resulting in anything other than a more parochial and less influential UK.

zh: 此外，没有英国的欧盟将让德国拥有比现在还要大的影响力。
en: In addition, an EU without the UK would be one in which Germany would have even more influence that it does now.

zh: 从长期看，如此实力优势绝非好事，它将助长对德国的敌对情绪，并可能让欧盟不再那么愿意在世界舞台上统一行动。
en: Such a preponderance of power cannot be healthy in the long run, as it will fuel resentment of Germany and likely leave the EU less willing and able to act together on the world scene.

zh: 其结果将是欧洲孱弱化，而美国需要的是更加强大的欧洲。
en: The result would be a weaker Europe at a time when the US needs a stronger one.

zh: 更糟糕的是，极有可能鼓吹弱化美国的世界角色的美国人将抓住英国退出作为进一步的证据证明传统盟友不再起到应有的作用，而面临日益增加的赤字和大量国内需求的美国不应该去填补这个空白。
en: Even worse, it is highly probable that Americans advocating for a reduced US role in the world would seize on Brexit as further evidence that traditional allies were not doing their fair share, and that a US facing growing deficits and massive domestic needs should not be expected to make up the difference.

zh: 必须时刻铭记一个简单的现实：始于第二次世界大战后欧洲一体化工程给欧洲大部带来了近四分之三个世纪的前所未有的稳定与繁荣。
en: A simple reality must be kept in mind: The European integration project that began in the wake of World War II has helped to bring unprecedented stability and prosperity to much of the continent for nearly three-quarters of a century.

zh: 英国决定“离婚”将让已经形成气候的离心力锦上添花。
en: A British decision to sue for divorce would add to centrifugal forces already in evidence.

zh: 民族主义和���粹主义因为经济和社会原因兴起，它们将获得更大的动力。
en: Nationalism and populism, already on the rise for both economic and social reasons, would gather even more momentum.

zh: 如此结果难以让人安心，不管它们仍具有高度不确定性。
en: It is difficult to feel confident of the outcome, however uncertain that may be.

zh: 英国人民做出离开欧盟的决定还会让苏格兰独立问题走向日程核心。
en: A decision by the British people to leave the EU would also put the question of Scotland’s independence squarely back on the agenda.

zh: 事实上，许多苏格兰人将号召为了保留欧盟成员资格而支持独立 — — 这一流行的口号可能导致苏格兰人投票脱离英国。
en: Indeed, many in Scotland would argue for independence in order to remain an EU member – a popular refrain that could well result in a vote to secede from the UK.

zh: 从最低程度上说，当俄罗斯再次被视为欧洲的威胁的情况下，美国人不会欢迎和苏格兰领导人就在苏格兰部署核武器和潜艇的问题进行艰难的争议性公共争论。
en: To say the least, Americans would not welcome a difficult, controversial public debate with Scotland’s leaders over the stationing of nuclear weapons and submarines on their territory at a time when Russia is again seen as a threat to Europe.

zh: 分裂绝不会仅限于此。
en: Fragmentation would be unlikely to stop there.

zh: 苏格兰的情况极有可能在分裂后的英国的其他部分造成余波。
en: What happened in Scotland could well have ripple effects across what remained of the disunited United Kingdom.

zh: 特别是，英国脱离欧盟和苏格兰脱离英国将加剧北爱尔兰亲英国的统一党（Unionist）和想要加入爱尔兰的共和党（Republican）之间的对立。
en: In particular, Great Britain’s departure from the EU and Scotland’s departure from the UK would add to tensions in Northern Ireland between pro-UK Unionists and Republicans seeking to join Ireland.

zh: 如今，双方都无法直面过去或在当下进行合作，在这样的情况下升级“最终地位”问题绝不是进步之道。
en: Raising the profile of “final status” issues at a time when the two sides have shown themselves unable to face up to the past, or work together in the present, is not a recipe for progress.

zh: 最后，英国关于其与欧盟的关系的决定不可能在真空中做出。
en: Finally, Great Britain’s decision about its relationship with the EU will not happen in a vacuum.

zh: 事实上，现在绝非做出这一决定的良机。
en: In fact, the timing could hardly be worse.

zh: 欧洲已经面临着财政困难、经济增长萎靡、大规模移民和难民流入以及俄罗斯侵犯再现的“完美风暴 ” 。
en: Europe is already facing a perfect storm of fiscal strains, anemic economic growth, massive inflows of migrants and refugees, and renewed Russian aggression.

zh: 如果这还不够的话，还可以加上分崩离析的中东、严峻的气候变化形势、恐怖主义，还有最新的新疾病 — — 寨卡病毒。
en: As if that weren’t enough, there is the unraveling Middle East, advancing climate change, terrorism, and now a new disease – the Zika virus – on the march.

zh: 今年还将迎来美国新总统选举。
en: There will also be a new US president elected this year.

zh: 美国新总统最不想要的局面是美国最紧密的伙伴因为一场艰难的“离婚”而分心和拖累。
en: The last thing he or she will need is to have America’s closest partner distracted and drained by a difficult divorce.

zh: 而如果英国退出让可能性成为现实，那么就会发生这样的情况。
en: And that is what will happen if Brexit moves from possibility to reality.

zh: 现实主义压倒民粹主义了吗？
en: Is Realism Trumping Populism?

zh: 纽约—金融危机十年后，世界各地的经济环境或多或少地回归了常态，如今，民族主义民粹主义被视为全球复苏的最大威胁。
en: NEW YORK – With economic conditions returning more or less to normal around the world after a decade of financial crises, nationalist populism is now seen as the biggest threat to global recovery.

zh: 齐聚华盛顿参加本月的IMF春季年会的财政部长们显然是这么认为的。
en: That was certainly true of the finance ministers who gathered in Washington, DC, this month for the IMF’s annual spring meeting.

zh: 但这一共识之所以出现，是否正是因为民粹主义浪潮正盛？
en: But is it possible that this consensus has emerged just as the populist wave has crested?

zh: 到底是不是民粹主义政治破坏着经济复苏？ 是否有可能是经济复苏影响着民粹主义政治？
en: Rather than populist politics undermining economic recovery, could economic recovery be undermining populist politics?

zh: 放眼世界，民粹主义经济政策似乎正在退却，尽管明确的取而代之者并未出现。
en: Looking around the world, populist economic policy appears to be in retreat, even though no clear alternative is visible.

zh: 在美国，特朗普总统似乎在克制自己的保护主义本能，与中国的经济关系正在 趋于稳定。
en: In the United States, President Donald Trump seems to be curbing his protectionist instincts, and economic relations with China are stabilizing.

zh: 在欧洲，尽管媒体焦点集中在匈牙利和波兰的仇外政客的成功，但在真正重要的国家，潮流正在远离经济民族主义，如法国、德国、西班牙和意大利等，意大利的两个最近在选举中取得突破性胜利的民粹主义政党宣布支持欧元。
en: In Europe, despite the media focus on the success of xenophobic politicians in Hungary and Poland, the pendulum is swinging away from economic nationalism in the countries that really matter: France, Germany, Spain, and Italy, where the two populist parties that recently achieved electoral breakthroughs are now vying to show their devotion to the euro.

zh: 即使在英国，潮流也在转向。 经济民族主义在2016年的退欧投票中赢得了压倒全球化和多边主义的最大胜利。
en: Even in Britain, where economic nationalism won its most spectacular victory over globalization and multiculturalism in the 2016 Brexit vote, the tide may be turning.

zh: 如今，英国政府逐渐认识到，选民并不真正想要强硬疑欧派所要求的完全脱离欧洲的结果。
en: The British government is gradually realizing that voters do not really want the complete rupture with Europe demanded by hard-core Euroskeptics.

zh: 退欧公投中所提出的两个退欧方案 — — 内向的保护主义“小英国”方案和基于与美国和英联邦的“特殊关系”的后帝国主义“英语文化圈”方案 — — 都不具有经济可行性和政治吸引力。
en: Neither of the two alternatives to EU membership presented in the Brexit referendum – an inward-looking, protectionist “Little England,” or a post-imperial “Anglosphere” based on the “special relationship” with America and the Commonwealth – is turning out to be economically feasible or politically attractive to voters.

zh: 尽管只有3—4%的选民承认改变了退欧的主意，但绝大部分人都希望能保留大部分自由贸易、便利旅行、移民劳工以及强大的环境、消费和卫生监管的好处。
en: While only 3-4% of voters admit to changing their minds about Brexit, large majorities want to keep most of the benefits of free trade, easy travel, immigrant labor, and strong environmental, consumer, and health regulation.

zh: 选民对退欧负面影响的厌恶类似于希腊在2015年公投拒绝欧盟援助后逐渐萌生的现实主义，有助于解释首相梅和她的保守党政府所采取的令人费解的策略。
en: Voters’ aversion to Brexit’s adverse consequences, analogous to the realism that gradually dawned in Greece after its 2015 referendum rejected an EU bailout, helps to explain the otherwise perplexing tactics of Prime Minister Theresa May and her Conservative Party.

zh: 一开始，梅声称人民显然要求她从欧盟“夺回控制权 ” ， 但此后梅逐渐模糊和抹除了她的红线：不再贡献欧盟预算、限制欧洲移民，以及不受欧洲规则和法院裁决约束。
en: After starting out proclaiming a clear instruction from the people to “take back control” from the EU, May has gradually blurred and erased her red lines: an end to EU budget contributions, limiting European immigration, and an exemption from European rules and court judgments.

zh: 她不再要求在2019年3月恢复完全的国家主权，转而开始要求一个过渡期，在此期间，选民们不会感觉到有任何变化。
en: Instead of strident demands for restoration of untrammeled national sovereignty in March 2019, she is now pleading for a transition, in which nothing noticeable to voters will change at all.

zh: 令人惊奇的是，梅的妥协被民族主义强硬派照单全收，而此前他们威胁要剥夺她的领导地位。
en: Surprisingly, May’s compromises have all been accepted by nationalist hard-liners who previously threatened her leadership.

zh: 狂热分子仍然希望最终从欧洲完全脱离，但似乎也释然于等到2020年12月梅的“现状过渡期”结束后在推动。
en: The zealots still hope for a total rupture with Europe eventually, but seem relieved about postponing the day of reckoning until the end of May’s “status quo transition” in December 2020.

zh: 但如果“完全脱离”欧洲现在还过于危险，为何到了2020年就会变得可接受？
en: But if a “clean break” from Europe is too dangerous to attempt now, why will it be more acceptable in 2020?

zh: 不会 — — 很有可能现实会让过渡期延长到2022年大选及以后。
en: It won’t be – and presumably that reality will dictate extending the transition until after the 2022 general election, then beyond.

zh: 我在近一年前写过，结局是英国咄咄逼人的硬退欧将演变为俯首帖耳的假退欧（Fake Brexit ） ， 类似于挪威的准欧盟成员地位。
en: The upshot is that, as I wrote nearly a year ago, Britain’s belligerent Hard Brexit is turning into a docile Fake Brexit: Norwegian-style associate EU membership.

zh: 退欧派和留欧派都会对这一结果感到不满，而英国将变成名副其实的退欧派所谓的“附庸国 ” ： 受欧盟法律约束，但又没有投票权或影响这些法律的能力。
en: Both Leavers and Remainers will be dissatisfied with that outcome, which will turn Britain into what Brexiteers justifiably call a “vassal state”: a country that abides by EU laws but has no voting rights or ability to influence those laws.

zh: 为何英国会接受这一二等公民的地位？
en: Why would Britain accept such second-class status?

zh: 这就要从民主主义民粹主义和经济学的关系说起。
en: This is where we come to the relationship between nationalist populism and economics.

zh: 梅现在所提出的显而易见的劣等欧盟关系的仅剩的论证理由是民粹主义者所提出的“人民的呼声 ” 。
en: The only remaining justification for the obviously inferior form of EU association that May is now proposing is the populist claim that “the people have spoken.”

zh: 直到最近，利用这一口号，所有反对政府政策的人都被贴上了民族主义精英分子的标签，被打为蔑视“真正的人民”的“无国公民 ” 。
en: Until recently, wielding this slogan allowed all opponents of government policy to be branded as internationalist elitists, “citizens of nowhere” who despise the “real people.”

zh: 政治反对派失去了合法性，这让英国退欧眼看难以避免，也让选民根本不去考虑可能让他们改变主意的问题。
en: Delegitimizing political opposition made Brexit appear inevitable, which discouraged voters from even thinking about the issues that might change their minds.

zh: 但英国的政治氛围正在变化。
en: But Britain’s political atmosphere is changing.

zh: 随着2019年3月退欧时限的临近，梅的“过渡期”大大地延长了，所有切实的退欧承诺多成了海市蜃楼，议会和公众的看法都在改变。
en: With the Brexit deadline of March 2019 approaching, May’s “transition” extending into the distant future, and all of the tangible promises of Brexit receding like a desert mirage, both parliamentary and public opinion are shifting.

zh: 工党逐渐认为，尽管许多工人阶级选民支持退欧，但反对退欧才是将梅政府拉下马的唯一机会。
en: The Labour Party is slowly coming to the conclusion that, even though many working-class voters supported Brexit, opposing it offers the only chance of bringing down the May government.

zh: 因此，梅在议会中屡战屡败 ，被迫做出让步，她与欧盟所谈判的任何协定都要由全体议会进行投票批准。
en: As a result, May has repeatedly been defeated in Parliament and forced to concede a full parliamentary vote on whatever agreement she negotiates with the EU.

zh: 这些一会冲突意味着反对退欧已不再被“抹黑”为反民主和精英主义。
en: These parliamentary conflicts mean that opposition to Brexit is no longer discredited as anti-democratic and elitist.

zh: 公众观点正在做出反应，支持议会进行“有意义的投票”决定梅与欧洲的最终协议是否真的比留在欧盟更好的人数显然占据多数。
en: And public opinion is responding, with clear majority support for a “meaningful vote” in Parliament to decide whether May’s final deal with Europe is genuinely better than remaining in the EU.

zh: 如果进行这一投票 — — 很有可能是10月 — — 由所有反对党和几十位亲欧派保守党组成的策略性联盟很有可能击败政府。
en: When this vote occurs, probably in October, a tactical alliance of all opposition parties with a dozen pro-European Tories could well defeat the government.

zh: 如果看到败局已定，梅有可能会试图避免这一局面，自己提出举行公投选择她所提出的退欧方案还是欧盟现状。
en: If such a defeat looks imminent, May will probably move to avert it by herself proposing a referendum to make the final decision between her version of Brexit and the EU status quo.

zh: 但这一受到最近发动的“人民的投票”运动支持的公投会成为滑向民粹主义的又一步，而不是对退欧争论的真正的民主结论吗？
en: But would such a referendum, now backed by a recently launched campaign for a “People’s Vote,” simply mark another descent into populism, instead of a genuinely democratic conclusion to the Brexit debate?

zh: 答案是不会，因为选民将得到在两个定义明确的方案之间做出诚实选择的机会：接受一切政府谈判的退欧协定，或在3月29日前撤销退欧通告并留在欧盟。
en: The answer is no, because voters would be offered an honest choice between two well-defined alternatives: to accept whatever agreement for leaving the EU the government negotiates, or to stay in the EU by withdrawing the Brexit notification before the March 29 deadline.

zh: 相反，2016年公投只给了选民一个现实与幻想之间的虚幻的选择：可以将他们所能想象的一切希望和偏见注入其中的童话般的退欧。
en: By contrast, the 2016 referendum offered voters an illusory choice between reality and fantasy: a fair-tale Brexit, onto which they could project whatever hopes or prejudices they cared to imagine.

zh: 民族主义民粹主义的反面不是全球主义精英主义。
en: The opposite of nationalist populism is not globalist elitism.

zh: 而是诚实的现实主义，英国正在重新认识到这一点。
en: It is honest realism, as Britain is now re-discovering.

zh: 尼采和英国全民公决
en: Nietzsche and the British Referendum

zh: 剑桥—恐怖袭击。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Terrorist attacks.

zh: 宗教和种族少数群体紧张。
en: Tensions over religious and ethnic minorities.

zh: 极端政党支持率日增。
en: Growing support for extremist political parties.

zh: 南北分歧加大。
en: A widening North-South divide.

zh: 强大的德国总理。
en: A powerful German chancellor.

zh: 扩张领土范围的进击的俄罗斯。
en: An aggressive Russia expanding its territorial reach.

zh: 卷入遥远的战争、自问是否应该与欧洲大陆决裂的英国。
en: A United Kingdom embroiled in distant wars, asking itself whether it should disengage from continental Europe.

zh: 诞生于一系列灾难性国际战争的年轻的政治秩序可能分崩离析。
en: A young political order, born of a series of devastating international wars, threatening to implode.

zh: 今天，欧洲面临的问题清单很长，但并非前所未有。
en: The list of problems facing Europe today is long, but this is not unprecedented.

zh: 事实上，从许多角度，现在的情况像极了俾斯麦的德国。
en: Indeed, in many respects, contemporary conditions look strikingly similar to those confronting Otto von Bismarck’s Germany.

zh: 当时，令人担心的是南方天主教少数派可能威胁到新成立的德意志帝国的统一，打算面对在一系列流血战争（最近一次是与法国）和刺杀德国皇帝图谋之后崛起的激进社会主义政党建立稳定。
en: At that time, the fear was that southern Catholic minorities would undermine the unity of the newly founded German empire, intended to bring stability in the face of a rising radical socialist party, after a series of bloody wars (most recently against the French) and assassination attempts on the Kaiser.

zh: 德国被夹在帝国主义俄国和卧薪尝胆的法国之间。
en: Germany was sandwiched between an imperialist Russia and a vengeful France.

zh: 与此同时，英国陷入了亚洲和中东的军事冒险。
en: Meanwhile, Britain was entangled in military adventures in Asia and the Middle East.

zh: 如今，欧洲面临着自身未来的艰难问题，一个例子便是英国即将到来的欧盟成员资格全民公决。 在这样的情况下，也许十九世纪末的德国经验大有裨益。
en: Today, as Europe faces difficult questions about its future, exemplified in the UK’s upcoming referendum on its European Union membership, perhaps Germany’s experience in the late nineteenth century can be brought usefully to bear.

zh: 果真如此的话，对于这一经验 — — 以及我们自身 — — 恐怕没有比弗雷德里希·尼采更好的指导了。 尼采是他所在的时代最有洞察力的思想家。
en: If so, there are few better guides to that experience – and our own – than Friedrich Nietzsche, one of the most perceptive thinkers of his time.

zh: 尼采是俾斯麦在德国统一中所采取的“铁血”权力政治的最可怕的批评家。
en: Nietzsche was a fearsome critic of the “blood and iron” power politics by which Bismarck had brought about German unity.

zh: 他将之称为他在名著《道德谱系学 》 （ On the Genealogy of Morality）中猛烈抨击的“奴隶道德”的一个例子。 奴隶道德是“低级”道德方法，只注重减少痛苦。
en: He called it an example of the “slave morality” that he lambasts in his great work On the Genealogy of Morality – a “lowly” approach to morality, focused simply on relieving suffering.

zh: 尼采指导他在说什么：在普法战争期间，他志愿参军，担任骑兵队长。
en: Nietzsche knew what he was talking about: he had volunteered as a cavalry officer during the Franco-Prussian War.

zh: 尽管一次摔伤让他上不了战场，但他仍然担任了卫生员 — — 并且获得了关于战争伤害的第一手经验。
en: Though a bad fall kept him from combat, he did serve as a medical orderly – and gained first-hand experience of the trauma of war.

zh: 在尼采看来，从这场战争中崛起的军国主义德国已经与其最初的道德使命南辕北辙。
en: The militaristic Germany that emerged from that war, in Nietzsche’s view, had lost touch with its original cultural mission.

zh: 在《超越善恶 》 （ Beyond Good and Evil）中，尼采更进一步，探索了超政治体系 — — 基于超越简单的“好”与“坏”的概念、从高尚和力量的立场发展价值的“主人道德 ” — —应该是怎样的。
en: In Beyond Good and Evil, Nietzsche went further, exploring how a superior political system – based on “master morality,” which transcends simplistic notions of “good” and “bad” to develop values from a position of nobility and strength – would look.

zh: 他构想了一个统一的欧洲，由泛欧洲文化精英领导，他们不注重堂皇，而注重新欧洲文化的发展。
en: He envisioned a united Europe, led by a trans-European cultural elite focused not on grandeur, but on the development of a new European culture.

zh: 尼采指出，只有通过统一，欧洲大陆才能在世界事务上发出强音，在当时，这意味着在与大英帝国和俄罗斯帝国的战略“大博弈”中获得同等地位，赢家将控制阿富汗和北印度。
en: Only through unification, Nietzsche argued, could continental Europe have a strong voice in world affairs, which at that time meant being on an equal footing with the British and Russian empires in their strategic “great game,” the winner of which would control Afghanistan and northern India.

zh: 另一条路 — — 俾斯麦所采取的权力政治 — — 则是“微不足道 ” （ petty ） ， 其前提是欧洲分裂和瓦解。
en: The alternative – the power politics in which Bismarck was engaged – was “petty,” as it was premised upon European fragmentation and disintegration.

zh: 尼采冥思苦想他的新政治学将如何出现，预测来自俄罗斯的日益增加的威胁可能刺激统一。
en: Nietzsche thought hard about how his new politics might come about, speculating that a growing threat from Russia could spur unification.

zh: 他还相信欧洲大陆将“谅解”英国，英国殖民地是欧洲的重要贸易伙伴。
en: He also believed that continental Europe would have to “come to an understanding” with Britain, whose colonies were important trade partners for Europe.

zh: 细节也许已经改变，但许多核心问题 — — 从俄罗斯的威胁到欧洲一体化的战略好处 — — 都仍然不变。
en: The details may have changed, but many of the core issues – from the threat posed by Russia to the strategic benefits of European integration – remain the same.

zh: 至于英国，它已不再是帝国，但仍对欧洲经济有着巨大的重要性；事实上，英国退出欧盟后的贸易物流是英国全民公决争论的一个关键问题。
en: As for Britain, while it no longer has an empire, it remains hugely important to Europe’s economy; indeed, the logistics of trade following a British exit from the EU is a key issue in the debate surrounding the referendum.

zh: 而尽管尼采不可能预测到英国和欧洲大陆的一体化，但他确实警告了英国全民公决有可能助长的分裂。
en: And, though Nietzsche could not have predicted the level of integration between the UK and continental Europe, he did warn against precisely the kind of fragmentation that the British referendum threatens to advance.

zh: 关于“英国退出”全民公决的大部分争论与尼采的概念没有什么关系。
en: Much of the debate about the UK’s “Brexit” referendum has little relation to Nietzsche’s ideas.

zh: 但是，公决双方的政治、经济和社会立场都常常受到恐惧的引导，因此加强哲学深度有益于争论。
en: But, with the political, economic, and social cases from both sides having so often been guided by fear, it seems that that debate would benefit from some more philosophical depth.

zh: 将尼采���概念铭记在心，英国选民就有可能认识到，他们在6月23日所要回答的真正问题是支持微不足道和分歧的权力政治还是伟大高贵的统一政治。
en: With Nietzche’s ideas in mind, British voters might recognize that the real question they must answer on June 23 is whether to endorse petty and divisive power politics or the great and noble politics of unification.

zh: 公投风险
en: The Referendum Risk

zh: 牛津—面临注定的失败，英国首相梅叫停了议会对她上个月与欧盟所达成的英国脱欧协议的投票 ， “ 人民投票 ” — —第二次脱欧公投 — — 的可能性在增加。
en: OXFORD – Now that British Prime Minister Theresa May, facing certain defeat, has postponed Parliament’s vote on the deal she concluded with the European Union last month on the United Kingdom’s departure from the bloc, the case for a “people’s vote” – a second Brexit referendum – is gaining ground.

zh: 但公投真的是决定人民所选择的代表无法或不愿解决的问题的正确机制吗？
en: But is a referendum really the right mechanism for settling political issues that the people’s elected representatives cannot or will not?

zh: 公投能让人民发出声音。
en: Referenda give people a voice.

zh: 在人民充满怒气，不满于政治建制派的时代，这就是它的吸引力所在。
en: That is their appeal in an era when people are angry and dissatisfied with the political establishment.

zh: 但没有规则的话，公投无异于邀请集体发出愤怒的咆哮。
en: But without rules, a referendum is little more than an invitation to a collective roar of anger.

zh: 这必须与国家政策的决定有所区分。
en: This must be distinguished from a national policy decision.

zh: 后者需要谨慎衡量每个人的利益。
en: The latter takes a careful weighing of everyone’s interests.

zh: 这不是 — — 也不可能是 — — 匹夫之责。
en: That is not – and cannot be – the job of every citizen.

zh: 在某些问题上，对某人好的东西，可能对他人不好；而对他人不好的东西，可能对某人更加不好。
en: On some issues, what is good for one person might be very bad for others, and what is bad for others might end up being even worse for the individual.

zh: 大部分人没有时间、兴趣、知识、渠道或渴望对一个有一个问题的这些考量做出深入的理解。
en: Most people do not have the time, interest, knowledge, access, or desire to gain a strong understanding of such considerations on issue after issue.

zh: 但这正是代表整个社会做出决策的必要条件。
en: Yet that is exactly what is needed to make decisions on behalf of an entire community.

zh: 这就是代议制民主存在的理由。
en: This is the raison d’être of representative democracy.

zh: 选民信任政客知情 — — 充分利用公务员、情报和分析 — — 并以长期大局观权衡各种方案。
en: Voters entrust politicians with becoming informed – making full use of public servants, information, and analysis – and weighing alternatives with a long-term, big-picture perspective.

zh: 因此，政客必须将他们的结论带到论坛（议会）上，这个论坛是为了通过互相竞争的政党、选区和代表呈现不同的利益而设计。
en: Politicians must then take their conclusions to a forum (Parliament) that is designed to represent different interests through competing political parties, constituencies, and representatives.

zh: 选民、其他当选官员（通过议会调查的形式）和独立媒体可以问责他们的选择。
en: They are held accountable for their choices by voters, other elected officials (in the form of parliamentary scrutiny), and independent media.

zh: 危险在于政客可以利用公投避免承担艰难决定的责任。
en: The danger is that politicians can use a referendum to avoid responsibility for difficult decisions.

zh: 在掌权之前，墨西哥新当选总统奥不拉多尔就利用“非正式”公投来决定取消墨西哥城新机场（已经建成了30 % ） 和支持他的十项主要社会和基础设施计划等问题。
en: Even before taking power, Mexico’s newly inaugurated president, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, was using “informal” referenda on issues such as the cancellation of Mexico City’s new airport (which is already 30% built) and support for his ten main social and infrastructure programs.

zh: 那么，各国如何确保让直接投票决定公共政策的做法不会影响到代议制民主中的决策质量？
en: So how can countries ensure that putting public policy to a direct vote does not undermine the quality of decision-making in a representative democracy?

zh: 当然，政府可以干脆不进行公投。
en: Of course, governments could simply not hold referenda.

zh: 比利时、马来西亚和印度尼西亚就是如此（这些国家在1985—1999年极权主义统治加剧时期曾经动用过平民表决 ） 。
en: That is the case in Belgium, Malaysia, and Indonesia (where plebiscites were used during the intensification of authoritarian rule in 1985-1999).

zh: 但如果国家仍然希望保留公投这一选项，就应该制定正式的规则，以帮助确保政客不会利用公投来逃避艰难的决定。
en: But if countries still want the option of referenda, they should impose formal rules that help to ensure that politicians cannot use them to dodge difficult decisions.

zh: 首先，国家应该限制什么时候可以召集公投（比如，只能对宪法修正案进行公投 ） ， 制定最低投票率门槛，并要求绝对多数。
en: For starters, countries should limit when they can be called (say, only with regard to constitutional amendments), establish a minimum threshold for turnout, and require a supermajority.

zh: 比如，在澳大利亚，公投只能在特定的条件下举行，并且只有（在总体多数通过的基础上）多数州都经多数通过才算成功。
en: In Australia, for example, referenda can be used only under certain circumstances and can pass only with majority support in a majority of states (in addition to an overall majority).

zh: 英国也应该应用这样的限制，即公投不但要求总体多数，还要求英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰和北爱尔兰分别达到多数。
en: Such limits should be applied in the UK, with referenda requiring not just an overall majority, but also separate majorities within England, Wales, Scotland, and Northern Ireland.

zh: 另一个避免公投陷阱的办法是规定公投不具法律约束力。
en: Another way to avoid the pitfalls of referenda is to make them non-binding.

zh: 芬兰和挪威只允许这种性质的公投，而澳大利亚政客也有召集无约束力的平民表决的选项。
en: Finland and Norway permit referenda only on this basis, while Australian politicians have the option of calling non-binding plebiscites.

zh: 这有利于有效公投的另一个本质特征：确保政客对政策应对的所有权。
en: This serves another essential feature of an effective referendum: ensuring that politicians take ownership of the policy response.

zh: 比如，在瑞士，公投可以用来显示公众的偏好，但政客必须承担制定最有利于国家利益的政策的责任。
en: In Switzerland, for example, a referendum might be used to get a sense of the public’s preference, but politicians must take responsibility for crafting the policy that best serves the national interest.

zh: 2014年2月的公投就是如此，在这次公投中，瑞士选民和各州表达了他们更愿意通过配额限制移民。
en: That was the case in a February 2014 referendum, in which a majority of Swiss voters and cantons expressed their preference for limiting immigration through quotas.

zh: 但引入限额将违反瑞士参加欧盟单一市场的条件。
en: But simply introducing such quotas would have violated the terms of Switzerland’s participation in the EU’s single market.

zh: 因此，在2016年，政府给出了自己的方案，实施了一项法律允许雇主优先考虑瑞士求职者（而不限制欧盟工人向瑞士的自由迁徙 ） 。
en: So, in 2016, the government offered its own solution, enacting a law permitting employers to give priority to Swiss job-seekers (without limiting the free movement of EU workers to Switzerland).

zh: 在举行公投时，政客还必须承担人民决定的环境的责任。
en: When holding referenda, politicians must also take responsibility for the context in which people decide.

zh: 他们必须确保表决的问题得到精心的设计，并且留足了深思熟虑和优质信息的时间。
en: They must ensure that the question it asks is well crafted and that there is time to deliberate and good-quality information.

zh: 瑞士有一项悠久的传统，即地方拥有很长的考虑和咨询时间，因此形成了一种动作缓慢但深思熟虑的决策形式。
en: In Switzerland, a long-standing tradition of lengthy local deliberation and consultation creates a slow-moving but highly deliberative form of decision-making. Spring a referendum on people without such preparation and you get an instant reaction.

zh: 在民主的诞生地古代雅典，公民在辩论首日投票判处全体米蒂利尼（Mytilene）男性死刑，以惩罚他们起义反抗雅典帝国统治。
en: In ancient Athens, the birthplace of democracy, citizens voted on the first day of debate to put to death the entire male population of Mytilene as punishment for their revolt against Athenian imperial control.

zh: 到了第二天，公民们冷静下来，投票同意宽大处理。
en: By the next day, citizens had cooled off, and they voted for leniency.

zh: 在英国 ， “ 脱欧 ” 、 “没有协议”和“留欧”等词语都背上了厚重的含义，每个选项的鼓吹者都在鼓动选民支持他们的观点。
en: In the UK, terms like “Brexit,” “no deal,” and “remain” have become heavily loaded, with campaigners for each priming voters to support their view.

zh: 制约鼓动的办法之一 — — 并有过去的调查的支持 — — 可以是首先引导选民考虑他们对这个话题到底知道多少，包括他们如何理解这些关键词。
en: One way to help counter that priming – supported by past surveys – could be to direct voters, first, to consider what they actually know about the topic, including what they understand by the key terms.

zh: 认为必须在这三个选项之间做出选择的政客应该清楚“折衷效应 ” ， 即人们总是倾向于选择中间选项，而不是对每一个选项都仔细考虑。
en: Politicians who argue for a choice among three options should be aware of the “compromise effect,” whereby people tend to choose the middle option, rather than considering each carefully.

zh: 英国历史上只举行过三次全国公投：一次是1975年欧洲经济共同体的成员资格问题；一次是2011年改变投票制度的问题；还有一次就是2016年的脱欧公投。
en: The UK has held only three country-wide referenda in its history: one on European Economic Community membership in 1975; another on the alternative vote system in 2011; and the Brexit vote in 2016.

zh: 但如今，英国可能即将举行又一次兹事体大的投票。
en: But it now may be set to hold another highly consequential vote.

zh: 随着共同变得越来越频繁，各国需要将规则具体化以确保政客不会滥用。
en: As referenda become more frequent, countries need to specify rules to ensure that politicians do not abuse them.

zh: 这意味着至少在大部分情形的公投不应该具有法律约束力。
en: This means making referenda non-binding, at least in most cases.

zh: 这意味着提供时间、信息和机会让选民做出真正的深思熟虑。
en: It means providing the time, information, and opportunity for genuine deliberation across the electorate.

zh: 公投不应该让政客（或他们的顾问）逃脱责任。
en: And it should never let politicians (or their advisers) off the hook.

zh: 他们被选出来，是为了实施能够推动国家利益的政策。
en: They were elected to enact policies that will advance the national interest.

zh: 他们也必须因此而被问责。
en: They must be held to account for that.

zh: 英国退出的原因和后果
en: The Causes and Consequences of Brexit

zh: 马德里—英国退出欧盟的前景是实实在在的。
en: MADRID – The prospect of a British exit from the European Union is well and truly upon us.

zh: 看起来，即将到来的欧洲理事会会议越来越有可能形成关于英国欧盟成员资格的条件的协议 — — 这个协议将在英国选民举行公决（至早在几年夏天进行）前生效。
en: It seems increasingly likely that the upcoming European Council meeting will result in a deal on the conditions of the United Kingdom’s EU membership – a deal that will be put before British voters in a referendum, possibly as early as this summer.

zh: 但是，不论怎样展开，英国和欧盟都需要仔细思考。
en: But, just as everything rushes forward, Britain and the EU need to take a moment to think carefully.

zh: 毕竟，尽管双方彼此做出了保证，但没人知道公决结果会如何，更不用说如果英国选民选择离开欧盟该怎么办了。
en: After all, despite assurances from both sides, no one knows how the referendum will unfold, much less how to navigate the aftermath if British voters chose to leave.

zh: 公决是最紧迫的未知之事。
en: The referendum is the most immediate unknown.

zh: 过去的经验表明，当选民做出这类决定时，他们很少关注当下的问题。
en: Past experience shows that, when voters make such decisions, they rarely focus on the issue at hand.

zh: 比如，在2005年欧盟宪法草案全民公决中，荷兰人关注的是欧元，而法国人担心被波兰水管工抢了工作。
en: In referenda on the EU’s draft constitution in 2005, for example, the Dutch focused on the euro, while the French worried that Polish plumbers would take their jobs.

zh: 到目前为止的信号表明，即将到来的英国全民公决也将遵循同样的模式，选民们更关注简单化的概念、偏见和情绪，而不关注务实考虑。
en: So far, the signs indicate that the upcoming British referendum will follow the same pattern, with voters focusing more on simplistic ideas, prejudices, and emotions than pragmatic considerations.

zh: 目前，反欧盟阵营更受欢迎，他们的论调也更具煽动性。
en: And the anti-EU camp has been by far the more passionate – and the more inflammatory in its rhetoric – side.

zh: 从欧洲角度讲，这实在令人担忧。
en: From a European perspective, this is deeply worrying.

zh: 众所周知，英国退出将是对欧洲一体化的重大打击，可能导致已经岌岌可危的一体化进程分崩离析。
en: It is well known that a British departure would deal a devastating blow to European integration, possibly causing an already-fragile process to unravel.

zh: 但英国人也应该担心退出欧盟的后果，谁也不知道这到底意味着什么。
en: But the British should also be worried about the consequences of withdrawal, if only because of how little is known about what it would entail.

zh: 问题在于大部分英国人不知道“英国退出”会带来怎样的动荡。
en: The problem is that most Britons have little awareness of the turbulence that “Brexit” would generate.

zh: 除了对苏格兰独立运动、爱尔兰受难日协议（Good Friday Agreement）以及英国与美国的“特殊关系”外，还有其他与未来英国-欧盟关系有关的重要问题。
en: Beyond the impact on Scotland’s independence movement, Ireland’s Good Friday Agreement, and the UK’s “special relationship” with the United States, there are important questions regarding the future of UK-EU relations.

zh: 许多支持英国退出的人搬出一些政策和监管规则 — — 比如欧盟与加拿大和新加坡的自由贸易协定 — — 胡乱拼凑出一幅身在欧洲之外的英国的图景。
en: Many advocates of withdrawal cherry-pick policies and regulations, such as provisions of the EU’s free-trade agreements with Canada and Singapore, to cobble together a vision of what life would like be for the UK outside of Europe.

zh: 他们希望英国人相信，不但伦敦金融城将仍然是欧洲顶级金融中心，英国也能继续进入欧盟单一市场，甚至连劳动力的自由流动也能保留。
en: They want Britons to believe not only that the City of London would remain Europe’s top financial center, but also that the UK would retain access to the EU’s single market, even without free movement of labor.

zh: 这完全是痴人说梦。
en: This is pure fantasy.

zh: 尽管英国将保持其在防务和外交政策方面的强势国际立场，但其在投资和贸易协定的谈判能力 — — 包括与占其贸易量的一半的欧盟本身的协定 — — 将严重受损。
en: Although the UK would retain its strong international standing in terms of defense and foreign policy, its clout in negotiating trade and investment agreements – including with the EU itself, which accounts for half of British trade – would be severely diminished.

zh: 非欧盟国家，如瑞士和挪威都有类似经验。
en: That has been the experience of non-EU countries like Switzerland and Norway.

zh: 事实上，欧盟领导人对于瑞士能够进入单一市场已经十分不满；很难让人相信他们会给予英国同样的待遇，尤其是在自己遭遇“打脸”之后。
en: In fact, EU leaders are already unhappy with Switzerland’s access to the single market; the idea that they would give the UK such access, especially after being slapped in the face, is not convincing.

zh: 有人说，英国退出可以仿照1985年格陵兰轻松退出欧洲共同体的谈判，这也是历史上唯一一次退出事件。
en: Some claim that a Brexit could resemble Greenland’s easily negotiated 1985 withdrawal from the European Economic Community (EEC), the only such withdrawal that has ever taken place.

zh: 但两者的环境大相径庭。
en: But the circumstances could not be more different.

zh: 30年前的欧共体规模有限，无法与今天强大的欧盟相比，正如格陵兰在经济和政治影响力上无法与英国相提并论。
en: The limited EEC of 30 years ago does not compare to the robust EU of today, just as Greenland pales in comparison with the UK in economic size or political significance.

zh: 此外，格陵兰的退出之所以很容易，很大原因是因为它与欧共体成员丹麦的宪法联系，丹麦能够在欧洲机构中继续代表格陵兰的利益。
en: Furthermore, Greenland’s withdrawal was eased considerably by its constitutional ties with EEC member Denmark, which continued to represent its interests in European bodies.

zh: 英国则没有类似的保护人来充当“润滑剂 ” ， 退出欧盟公决后的谈判将是复杂而激烈的，可能耗时多年之久。
en: With no equivalent patron to smooth the way for the UK, negotiations following a vote for withdrawal would be complicated and acrimonious, dragging out over a number of years.

zh: 所有这些不确定性都会给企业和普通百姓造成损失。
en: All of this uncertainty would take its toll, on both businesses and ordinary citizens.

zh: 如果弄不清楚法律安排会是怎样，谁还会去英国进行长期投资？
en: Who would commit to a long-term investment in the UK without knowing what legal arrangements will be in place?

zh: 要避免这一结果，欧洲理事会应该保证英国保留欧盟成员资格将得到媛媛更稳定的前景，同时证明欧洲的基本灵活性。
en: To avoid this outcome, the European Council should affirm the UK’s far more stable prospects as an EU member, while demonstrating Europe’s fundamental flexibility.

zh: 目前，英国已经被允许不加入申根区和欧元区，其司法和内政也保持独立。
en: Already, the UK has been allowed to opt out of the Schengen Area, the euro, and justice and home affairs.

zh: 欧盟已经证明了它愿意寻求向英国首相卡梅伦的要求作出合理妥协。
en: Now the EU has shown its willingness to seek reasonable compromises on British Prime Minister David Cameron’s demands.

zh: 在一些领域，比如提高竞争力和改善监管，共识相对比较容易达成。
en: In some areas, such as boosting competitiveness and streamlining regulation, consensus will be relatively easy to achieve.

zh: 在给予国家议会更大的欧盟立法指导作用方面也有可能达成一致，尽管卡梅伦提出的允许国家议会对欧盟法律亮“红牌”的建议走得太远了。
en: Agreement is also possible on giving national parliaments a greater role in guiding EU legislation.

zh: 至于卡梅伦所要求的取消英国致力于“更加紧密的联盟”的条约���务，达成妥协的关键比较微妙。
en: As for Cameron’s demand to end Britain’s treaty obligation to work toward an “ever-closer union,” the key to compromise may be nuance.

zh: 欧盟也许应该将其关注焦点从更深层次地整合成员国上转移到日益紧密地统一欧洲各民族上。
en: Rather than moving to integrate member states more deeply, perhaps the EU should shift its focus to uniting, increasingly closely, the peoples of Europe.

zh: 最后一个问题也许最为棘手：移民和福利问题。
en: The final issue may be the thorniest: immigration and welfare.

zh: 卡梅伦要求“暂停”四年在英工作欧盟移民的在职和儿童福利 — — 许多人认为这一方针带有歧视性。
en: Cameron has called for a four-year “timeout” on in-work and child benefits for EU migrants working in the UK – an approach that many agree is discriminatory.

zh: 对于这一让人高度焦虑的问题，一个可能能够促进妥协的方法是在这场讨论和关于发酵中的难民危机的争论中间画一条明确的界限。
en: One shift that may ease the way toward a compromise on this highly fraught topic would be to enforce a clear division between this discussion and debates on the ongoing refugee crisis.

zh: 重点必须放在波兰人和拉脱维亚人身上，而不是放在叙利亚人身上。
en: The focus must remain on Poles and Latvians, not Syrians.

zh: 1953年，丘吉尔说过一句名言 ： “ 我们和欧洲站在一起，但我们不属于欧洲；我们互相联系，但是不妥协。
en: In 1953, Winston Churchill famously declared, “We are with Europe, but not of it; we are linked, but not compromised.”

zh: ”如果即将到来的欧洲理事会形成反映这一情绪的妥协，那么英国退出可能得到避免，所有人都能从中获益。
en: If the upcoming European Council can achieve a compromise that reflects this sentiment, Brexit may be avoided, benefiting everyone.

zh: 但是，公决临近，只有好的理想是不够的。
en: But, with the referendum looming, even a good deal may not be enough.

zh: 幻想和操纵依然是英国争论的核心，而英国 — — 以及欧洲 — — 可能遭到当头棒喝。
en: With fantasy and manipulation continuing to dominate the British debate, the UK – and Europe – may be in for a very sobering surprise.

zh: 英国退欧的资产负债表
en: The Brexit Balance Sheet

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 戴维·卡梅伦首相提议英国公民举行公投决定是否退出欧盟或许在几年前还貌似一个有一定安全性的赌博。
en: BRUSSELS – Prime Minister David Cameron’s offer to British citizens to hold a referendum on whether to leave the European Union might have seemed like a reasonably safe gamble just a few years ago.

zh: 当时大多数人可能会投票留在欧盟内部。
en: Most people then probably would have voted to stay.

zh: 但那是在希腊危机对欧元区造成严重破坏之前，此外，数十万难民的到来也导致欧盟（虽然不是英国）在某种程度上失去了对边界的控制。
en: That was before the Greek crisis created havoc in the eurozone, and the arrival of hundreds of thousands of refugees caused the EU (although not the United Kingdom) to lose control of some of its borders.

zh: 卡梅伦实际可能让欧洲其他领导人赞同他的改革要求，若非如此，他表态不会推动他的国家留在欧盟。
en: Cameron might actually get other European leaders to agree to his demands for reform, without which he has said he would not campaign to keep his country in the EU.

zh: 改革要求并不极端：保证非欧元区成员国自由进入单一市场；减少欧盟层面的繁文缛节；免除强制英国加入“日益紧密联盟”的要求。
en: They are not extreme: a guarantee that non-eurozone members gain full access to the single market; less red tape at the EU level; a British exemption from “ever-closer union.”

zh: 他最后的一项要求 — — 减少欧盟移民福利 — — 让欧盟领导人最难接受。
en: His last demand – fewer benefits for EU migrants – will be the hardest for EU leaders to accept.

zh: 尽管力推上述改革，但英国某些欧盟怀疑论者仍然批评卡梅伦太过软弱。
en: Despite this reform push, some British Euroskeptics have criticized Cameron for being too soft.

zh: 英国人越来越难以抗拒彻底放弃这艘沉船并光荣地独自发展的诱惑。
en: The temptation in Britain simply to abandon what appears to be a sinking ship and go it gloriously alone is growing stronger.

zh: 这完全可以理解。
en: This is understandable.

zh: 问题在于“英国退欧”是否像支持者想象的那般光荣。
en: The question is whether “Brexit” would be as glorious as its proponents like to imagine.

zh: 摆脱来自布鲁塞尔的控制，英国退欧鼓吹者承诺英国将籍此再次成为世界自由的灯塔，受到中国的尊敬、借助“特别双边关系”与美国联合，同时还能与欧洲大陆保持友好的商业关系。
en: Unleashed from the rule of Brussels, the sirens of Brexit promise, Britain would once again be a beacon of freedom in the world, respected by China, tied to the United States in the bilateral “special relationship,” and all the while retaining friendly commercial ties with the European continent.

zh: 商业蓬勃发展、伦敦城兴旺繁荣，英国人永远不会成为任何人的奴隶，无论是其他国家还是欧盟。
en: Business would boom, the City of London would prosper, and Britons never would be slaves, not of the EU or anyone else.

zh: 事实上，现实可能远非如此理想。
en: In fact, things might not work out so well.

zh: 正如卡梅伦本人最近出访冰岛后所指出的那样，挪威以非成员国身份与欧盟自由贸易的条件远非那么理想。
en: As Cameron himself stated after a recent visit to Iceland, the Norwegian option of engaging in free trade with the EU as a non-member is far from ideal.

zh: 挪威像瑞士一样仍需遵守欧盟单一市场规则，但却对规则的制定没有发言权。
en: Norway, like Switzerland, still has to abide by EU single-market rules, without having any say in formulating them.

zh: 挪威还需支付大量资金用于欧盟预算，同时必须接受人员（包括难民在内）的跨境自由流动。
en: Norway also pays large amounts of money to the EU budget, and must accept free movement of people (including refugees) across its borders.

zh: 就美国方面而言，奥巴马总统表示英国在欧盟内部比退欧后得到的重视更多。
en: As far as the US is concerned, President Barack Obama has already said that he would take Britain more seriously inside the EU than outside it.

zh: 同样，美国贸易代表迈克尔·弗罗曼最近表示美国没有兴趣与英国单独谈判自由贸易协定。
en: Similarly, US Trade Representative Michael Froman recently observed that the US would not be interested in negotiating a separate free-trade deal with Britain.

zh: 顺便说一下，所有这一切的假设前提是后退欧时代的英国仍然是英国。
en: All this, by the way, assumes that post-Brexit Britain would still be Britain.

zh: 苏格兰人几乎肯定会想脱离英国并以独立成员国身份重新加入欧盟，加泰罗尼亚和其他失意欧洲地区的分离主义份子会因此而倍受鼓舞（这种情况完全不符合我们的要求 ） 。
en: The Scots would almost certainly want to break away from England and rejoin the EU as an independent member, giving further encouragement (as if that were needed) to separatists in Catalonia and other frustrated European regions.

zh: 只剩下英国对威尔士和北爱尔兰挥舞圣乔治大旗，这样的画面相当酸楚。
en: England would be left to wave its flag of St. George over Wales and Northern Ireland, a rather sour prospect.

zh: 但英国退欧也不乏潜在的支持者：某些狂热的欧盟主义者越来越讨厌英国所扮演的阻碍性角色。
en: But there are more potential supporters of Brexit: some keen European Unionists who have found the UK’s often-obstructive membership increasingly annoying.

zh: 太好了，他们可能会说，一旦这次真的离婚，真正的欧洲人终于可以和平地结成联盟。
en: Good riddance, they might say, once the divorce finally comes through; now the true Europeans can finally unite in peace.

zh: 我认为这样的想法也是误读。
en: This, too, strikes me as misguided.

zh: 英国退欧对欧盟的伤害不亚于对英国。
en: A Brexit would most likely be as damaging to the EU as it would be to Britain itself.

zh: 与普通人的认识相反，统治欧盟的不是布鲁塞尔的欧盟委员会。
en: Contrary to popular perception, the EU is not ruled by the European Commission in Brussels.

zh: 各国领袖为争取本国利益而讨价还价，欧洲理事会最重要的决定依然由各国政府做出。
en: National governments still make the most important decisions in the European Council, where leaders wheel and deal to advance their countries’ interests.

zh: 德、英、法作为欧盟三大强国构成一种关键的平衡。
en: Germany, Britain, and France, as the EU’s three major powers, form a crucial balance.

zh: 没有英国，欧盟就会成为法德合资企业，其中德国占绝对主导地位，所有规模较小的成员国都被夹在法德当中。
en: Without Britain, the EU becomes a Franco-German enterprise, with Germany very much the dominant partner, and all the smaller member states squeezed between the two.

zh: 这并不符合任何人的��愿，其中甚至包括并不甘心充当霸主的德国。
en: This is not really what anybody wants, not even the Germans, who are reluctant hegemons.

zh: 此外，英国和德国一直是平衡法国中央集权倾向的天然盟友。
en: Moreover, Britain and Germany are natural allies in balancing the statist tendencies of France.

zh: 其实英国对欧盟的影响主要是积极的。
en: Britain has in fact had a largely positive impact on the EU.

zh: 欧洲得益于英国的民主传统、对其他国家的开放、对官僚障碍的缺乏耐心、甚至是它对抽象乌托邦计划的怀疑态度。
en: Europe has benefited from Britain’s democratic traditions, its openness to the rest of the world, its impatience with bureaucratic obstruction, and even its skepticism toward abstract utopian schemes.

zh: 如果说现在哪一座城市感觉更像欧洲的首都，那么它不是布鲁塞尔、柏林，甚至不是巴黎，而是五十万法国民众和数百万外国人居住的伦敦。
en: If any city feels like a European capital now, it is not Brussels, Berlin, or even Paris, but London, home to almost a half-million French citizens, as well as millions of other foreigners.

zh: 英国退欧会成为欧洲的灾难还有一个原因。
en: There is one more reason, however, why Brexit would be a disaster for Europe.

zh: 人们普遍认为欧洲国家无法独自解决我们这个时代的重大问题，包括气候变化、移民、全球化的经济挑战以及最重要的安全。
en: It is generally agreed that European countries cannot cope alone with the major problems of our time, such as climate change, immigration, the challenges of a globalized economy, and, above all, security.

zh: 1945年来，美式和平掩盖了欧洲管理自身安全方面的无能。
en: Since 1945, Pax Americana has papered over Europe’s incapacity to manage its own security.

zh: 欧洲人喜欢谈论和平与妥协的价值观，而由美国的军事力量为他们的安全负责。
en: Europeans like to talk about the values of peace and compromise, while US military might takes care of their safety.

zh: 这就导致了一定程度的依赖，哪怕仅仅为了减轻美国人的负担、赋予欧洲与其经济地位相称的政治影响力这个问题也必须得到解决。
en: This has created a degree of dependency that should be redressed, if only to relieve the Americans of their burden and give Europe the political influence to match its economic clout.

zh: 为实现这一目标，欧盟必须建立共同的安全政策和军事力量。
en: For this to be achieved, the EU must establish a common security policy and military force.

zh: 这个过程将艰苦而又漫长。
en: This will be a long and difficult process.

zh: 由于显而易见的原因，德国不会出面领导。
en: Germany, for obvious reasons, will not take the lead.

zh: 只有英法两国拥有足够的军事实力为欧洲防务奠定坚实的基础。
en: Only France and Britain have enough military strength to provide a sound basis for European defense.

zh: 英国可以在这个关键问题上成为欧洲的救世主。
en: Britain could, in this vital matter, be the savior of Europe.

zh: 没有英国就没有希望。
en: Without it, there is no hope.

zh: 唉，只靠卡梅伦一个人无法确立这种积极的论调。
en: Alas, Cameron is singularly ill equipped to make such a positive argument.

zh: 他所领导的政党越来越反对除贸易以外的任何欧洲项目。
en: He leads a party that is increasingly opposed to any European project apart from trade.

zh: 他还必须抗衡几代人共有的民间记忆。 上次英国单枪匹马骄傲地拯救了欧洲。
en: And he would have to battle a folk memory that has lasted several generations: the last time Britain helped to save Europe, it stood very much, and very proudly, alone.

zh: 美丽新世界中的脱欧
en: Brexit in a Brave New World

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 在双边贸易的过程中，收益和损失会在较大和较小的经济体之间呈现不对称分布。
en: BRUSSELS – When it comes to bilateral trade, gains and losses are distributed asymmetrically between the larger and the smaller economy.

zh: 在年景好的时候，这对英国来说也算不上是个好消息，因为它正寻求与欧盟和其他国家订立新的贸易协议，更何况如今好年景已经一去不返了。
en: In the best of times, that would be bad news for the United Kingdom as it seeks new trade deals with the European Union and others. And these are not the best of times.

zh: 按照经济理论推算，建立新的贸易壁垒会使双方都利益受损。
en: Economic theory predicts that erecting new trade barriers hurts both sides.

zh: 但经济原则也表明，两个经济体中较大的一个可能损失较少。
en: But economic principles also suggest that the larger of the two economies is likely to lose less.

zh: 以关税为例，较大经济体的较低需求会倾向于压低其进口商品的价格。
en: In the case of a tariff, for example, lower demand from the larger economy will tend to push down the prices of the goods that it imports.

zh: 而较小的经济体不太可能对其进口商品的总体需求产生足够大的影响，从而无力左右其价格。
en: The smaller economy is unlikely to have enough of an impact on overall demand for the goods it imports, and thus on their prices.

zh: 当涉及非关税壁垒时，较大经济的优势会更大，这通常是由于交易国之间的法规和标准的差异造成的。
en: The advantage of the larger economy is even greater when it comes to non-tariff barriers, which often result from differences in regulations and standards among trading countries.

zh: 在大多数情况下，较小国家必须只得接受较大国家的规则。
en: In most cases, the smaller country must simply accept the larger one’s rules.

zh: 有鉴于此，脱欧者声称英国 — — 作为净进口国 — — 将在与欧盟的贸易谈判中处于强势地位的说法就是错误的。
en: Given this, Brexiteers are wrong to claim that the UK, as a net importer, will be in a strong position in trade negotiations with the EU.

zh: 因为真正的决定因素是相对规模，而不是净贸易流量。
en: What counts is relative size, not net trade flows.

zh: 多项研究证实了这一点，结论是英国将承担绝大部分的脱欧成本。
en: Multiple studies confirm this, concluding that the UK will bear the lion’s share of the costs of Brexit.

zh: 研究预测，如果英国和欧盟同意达成基于世界贸易组织（WTO）规则的新贸易关系，英国将损失约1100亿欧元（折合1190亿美元 ） ， 而欧盟只会损失约500亿欧元。
en: If the UK and the EU agree to a new trade relationship based on World Trade Organization (WTO) rules, the studies predict, the UK will lose about €110 billion ($119 billion), whereas the EU will lose only about €50 billion.

zh: 考虑到欧盟的经济规模大概相当于英国的五倍，这意味着英国的损失占GDP的比重将会增加十倍左右。
en: Given that the EU’s economy is about five times larger than that of the UK, this implies that the loss for the UK, as a share of GDP, would be about ten times larger.

zh: 如果没有达成协议，同样的不平衡将出现，只有英国的成本会更高 — — 这是宣称英国将拒绝进行不利谈判的英国首相特里萨·梅所拒绝承认的事实。
en: If no deal is reached, the same imbalance will emerge, only the costs to the UK will be even larger – a reality that British Prime Minister Theresa May, declaring that the UK will walk away from negotiations that don’t go its way, refuses to recognize.

zh: 尽管他们在政治上对此加以粉饰，但一个“坏交易”实际上要比没有交易更有利于英国。
en: Notwithstanding political rhetoric, a “bad deal” is actually better for the UK than no deal at all.

zh: 但与欧盟的谈判只是开始。
en: But the talks with the EU are only the beginning.

zh: 英国还必须与其他合作伙伴展开贸易谈判，包括世界上最大的两个经济体：美国和中国。
en: The UK will also have to negotiate trade deals with other partners, including the world’s two largest economies: the United States and China.

zh: 乍一看，与美国的谈判似乎没有什么可担心的。
en: At first glance, the negotiations with the US may seem like nothing to worry about.

zh: 毕竟特朗普总统已经表示英国将是“第一个”与美国达成贸易协议的国家。
en: After all, President Donald Trump has indicated that the UK would be “first in line” for a US trade deal.

zh: 此外他还对脱欧大加赞扬，甚至鼓励其他欧盟成员国跟随英国退出欧盟。
en: Moreover, he has praised Brexit, even encouraging other EU member states to follow the UK out of the bloc.

zh: 但特朗普也承诺在其所有协议和行动 — — 特别是贸易方面 — — 实现“美国利益优先 ” 。
en: But Trump has also pledged to put “America first” in all deals it makes and actions it takes, particularly regarding trade.

zh: 这引起了人们对特朗普是否愿意在英国仍然可以竞争的少数领域（如航空航天和汽车行业）开放美国市场产生了怀疑。
en: This raises doubts about whether Trump will be willing to open US markets in the few areas where the UK can still compete, like the aerospace and automotive industries.

zh: 但即使他愿意开放市场，这也不太可能是毫无代价的。
en: Even if he does, he is not likely to do it for free.

zh: 至少英国将必须遵守美国的标准和法规。
en: At the very least, the UK will have to adhere to US standards and regulations.

zh: 英国首相知道，要从特朗普处获得一个体面的交易，就必须得按他的游戏规则玩。
en: May knows that, to get a decent deal out of Trump, she has to play his game.

zh: 因此当特朗普签署一项行政命令，在90天内禁止任何来自七个穆斯林人口占多数国家的人入境美国，并无限期关闭叙利亚难民入境的大门，她也只能避免发表任何强烈的声明。
en: So when Trump signed an executive order to bar anyone from seven Muslim-majority countries from entering the US for 90 days, and to close the door to refugees from Syria indefinitely, she avoided any strong statements.

zh: 相比之下，她的欧盟同僚则对欧盟作为一个贸易集团的规模和实力充满信心，毫不掩饰地谴责了这一行动。
en: By contrast, her EU counterparts, confident in the size and strength of the EU as a trading bloc, were uninhibited in condemning the move.

zh: 这就凸显出了一项脱欧者们未曾预料到的挑战。
en: This highlights a challenge that the Brexiteers did not anticipate.

zh: 他们期望在基于规则的多边贸易体系的背景下实现脱欧。
en: They expected Brexit to occur against the backdrop of the rules-based multilateral trading system.

zh: 有了世贸组织这样的全球贸易框架，即便是最糟糕的情况对英国来说也是可以承受的，因此离开欧盟的后果也不会太大。
en: With global trading frameworks like the WTO in place, it seemed that even the worst-case scenario for Britain wasn’t all that bad, and, therefore, that the consequences of leaving the EU would be minor.

zh: 但自那以后，世界已经发生了很大的变化。
en: But the world has changed considerably since then.

zh: 特朗普的崛起正是因为他承诺要摆脱世贸组织（事实上是所有国际组织）的羁绊，并采取基于美国自身利益的单方面决策。
en: Trump’s rise to power was fueled by promises to throw off the fetters of the WTO – indeed, of all international organizations – and to take unilateral decisions based on America’s own interests.

zh: 甚至在特朗普一些同党的眼中与欧盟的贸易谈判都显得太过“多边”了，因为得涉及27个成员国。
en: Even trade negotiations with the EU seem too multilateral to some of Trump’s cohorts, because they involve 27 member countries.

zh: 但如果缺少了美国，基于规则的国际体系就不那么安全 — — 尤其是其他人很快就会跟着特朗普有样学样，放弃多边合作选择双边合作。
en: Without the US on board, the rules-based international system would be far less secure – not least because others might soon follow Trump’s example, choosing bilateral deal making over multilateral cooperation.

zh: 随着世界贸易体系变得不那么开放，每个人都会成为输家，但付出的成本不是平等的。
en: As the world trading system became less open, everyone would lose, but not equally.

zh: 美国，中国和欧盟（如果能存活下来的话）将会比较小经济体（比如英国）活得更滋润。
en: The US, China, and the EU (provided it survives) would do far better than smaller economies, like the UK.

zh: 还有待观察的是美国是否借助其经济实力让特朗普的保护主义手段一路延续下去。
en: It remains to be seen whether the US, with its economic might, can afford Trump’s protectionist approach.

zh: 但似乎显而易见的是英国将在脱欧过程中背负某些沉重的成本。
en: But it seems clear that the UK will incur some heavy costs during the Brexit process.

zh: 如果更多的国家跟随特朗普的脚步，而基于规则的全球系统继续恶化，那么这些成本只会有增无减。
en: If more countries follow Trump’s lead, and the rules-based global system continues to deteriorate, those costs will only grow.

zh: 欧洲依然活在这里
en: Where Europe Still Lives

zh: 利沃夫 — — 英国退欧公投的结果震惊了欧洲全体民众。
en: LVIV – The outcome of the United Kingdom’s Brexit referendum shocked populations across Europe.

zh: 但西乌克兰利沃夫 — — 这个热情洋溢地想要加入欧盟的中心 — — 的反应尤其不和谐。
en: But watching the response in Lviv, in Western Ukraine – a hub of enthusiasm about the European Union – was particularly jarring.

zh: 值此英国不负责任的机会主义者和民粹主义者毫不留情地摧毁本国和欧洲制度之际，乌克兰的改革者却正在试图建设新的制度规则。
en: At a time when irresponsible opportunists and populists in the UK are taking a wrecking ball to their country’s own institutions, and those of Europe, Ukrainian reformers are trying to build something new.

zh: 尽管英国的“退欧”运动竭力兜售莫须有的移民风险来证明自己的观点正确，但乌克兰的活动人士却在努力建设可以承受住寡头和来自俄罗斯外部影响的公民社会框架时面临着真正的威胁。
en: Whereas the UK’s “Leave” campaign peddled trumped-up dangers from immigration to make its case, activists in Ukraine are facing very real threats as they work toward a civil-society framework that can stand up to internal pressure from the oligarchs and external influence from Russia.

zh: 从历史上看，利沃夫或许比任何其他城市更能让我们想起欧洲的自我毁灭。
en: Historically, Lviv, perhaps more than any city, reminds us of Europe’s capacity to self-destruct.

zh: 环绕着利沃夫风景如画的广场，每一块鹅卵石和雕刻着纹饰的建筑物外墙都曾默默见证着伴随帝国兴衰的杀戮。
en: Around its picturesque squares, every cobblestone and ornamental façade has borne silent witness to the bloodletting that accompanied empires’ rise and fall.

zh: 但能够找到欧洲希望的地方同样是利沃夫。
en: Yet Lviv is also where one can find hope for the promise of Europe.

zh: 利沃夫是一座根深蒂固的反俄亲欧城市；但每年夏天，这里都会举行为期5天的由俄罗斯银行赞助的阿尔法爵士乐节。
en: Lviv is a deeply anti-Russian and pro-European city; but, for five days each summer, it hosts the Alpha Jazz Festival, sponsored by a Russian bank.

zh: 在这样一个和乌克兰仍然处于交战状态的时刻，决策者、当地居民、流散在外的乌克兰人甚至有些俄国人都会涌上利沃夫街头欣赏世界级的爵士乐。
en: At a time when Russia and Ukraine are still very much at war, policymakers, local citizens, members of the Ukrainian diaspora, and even some Russians pack the streets of Lviv to celebrate world-class jazz.

zh: 除了生机勃勃的文化生活和地理位置，乌克兰的战略利益对西方极为重要。
en: Beyond its vital cultural life and geographical location, Ukraine is strategically important to the West.

zh: 这里是全球民主和独裁对峙的主战场。
en: It is a key front in the global confrontation between democracy and autocracy.

zh: 对欧洲而言，这里代表着在境外推动法治、透明、自由贸易和良好执政的独特机会。
en: For Europe, it represents a unique opportunity to promote the rule of law, transparency, free trade, and good governance beyond its borders.

zh: 乌克兰是个大国，在众多领域都拥有充足的人力资本、自然资源和增长潜力。
en: Ukraine is a large country, with ample human capital, natural resources, and growth potential in many sectors.

zh: 更重要的是，乌克兰成功实施改革可以加大在俄罗斯取得积极进展的几率。
en: More important, successful reforms in Ukraine make positive developments in Russia more likely.

zh: 尽管如此，乌克兰经济（以美元计价）依然在2006年后缩水了2/3，使之成为欧洲最穷的穷国。
en: Still, Ukraine’s economy has shrunk by two-thirds (in dollar terms) since 2006, making it the poorest country in Europe.

zh: 在2014年推翻亲俄罗斯总统亚努科维奇后，欧洲梦突然之间对许多乌克兰人变得不那么遥远了，他们渴望在不远的将来不需要签证就能旅行和在欧盟国家找到工作。
en: After the 2014 ouster of pro-Russian President Viktor Yanukovych, the European dream suddenly seemed less remote for many Ukrainians, who had hoped for visa-free travel and employment opportunities in the EU sometime in the near future.

zh: 随着英国公投退出欧盟，这种希望现在已经变得非常微弱，曾经长期激励从后苏联时代迷雾中走出来的社会的欧洲榜样也逐渐暗淡下去。
en: With the Brexit vote, that hope is now diminished, as is a European model that has long inspired societies emerging from the post-Soviet fog.

zh: 因为再次亲眼目睹欧洲的自我毁灭，在利沃夫欣赏爵士乐的乌克兰人难以掩饰绝望和难以置信的情绪。
en: There was a palpable sense of despair and disbelief among Ukrainians enjoying jazz in Lviv as they watched Europe self-destruct once again.

zh: 英国退欧不应当地促进了专制势力。
en: Brexit gives the forces of autocracy an undeserved boost.

zh: 欧洲投射软实力的能力遭到削弱，它投射软实力的心情也同样如此。
en: Europe’s ability to project soft power is weakened, as is its appetite to do so.

zh: 独裁者们现在可以放心，因为他们并未错过后阿拉伯之春以及后欧洲时代世界的各种利益。
en: The benefits of a post-Arab Spring and post-European world are not lost on its dictators, who can now rest easier.

zh: 但仍有理由对未来抱有希望。
en: Still, there is reason for hope.

zh: 乌克兰有意义的改革能够取得成功，而且过去两年比之前20年取得了更大的成就。
en: Meaningful reforms in Ukraine can still succeed, and more has been achieved in the last two years than was accomplished in the preceding 20.

zh: 首先，乌克兰经济至少已趋于稳定，而且东部的战斗已经逐渐退去。
en: For starters, the economy has at least stabilized, and the fighting in the east has receded.

zh: 乌克兰现任总理弗拉基米尔·格罗伊斯曼决心落实进一步改革来战胜腐败，包括取消能源补贴并转而实施（从以汇率为目标到以通胀为目标的）更加透明的货币政策。
en: Ukraine’s current prime minister, Volodymyr Groysman, is committed to pushing through additional reforms to combat corruption, including abolishing energy subsidies and shifting to a more transparent monetary policy (from exchange-rate targeting to inflation targeting).

zh: 在乌克兰东部，能源价格低迷和西方制裁损害了俄国经济。 短时间内，这两种因素都将持续下去。
en: To the east, Russia’s economy is suffering from low energy prices and Western sanctions, neither of which will change any time soon.

zh: 即使没有上述外部条件，成本上升和生产率停滞依然困扰着俄罗斯经济。
en: Even without these external conditions, Russia’s economy was plagued by rising costs and a lack of productivity growth.

zh: 但至少某些贴近俄国领导层的内部人士已经暗示俄领导人现在愿意探讨地区及全球问题。
en: But at least some close to the inner circle of Russia’s leadership have hinted at a new willingness to discuss matters of regional or global concern.

zh: 在乌克兰西部，只要欧盟迅速行动解决当前后英国退欧期的不确定性，欧盟仍然可以重新掌握主动。
en: To the west, the EU can still regain its composure, provided it moves quickly to resolve the current post-Brexit uncertainty.

zh: 如果欧盟能成功解决英国退欧问题，就可以抓住乌克兰和东南欧国家的投资机会，并以此来补充其政治资本及再次提高生产率。
en: If it succeeds in this, it can pursue investment opportunities in Ukraine and southeast Europe that stand to replenish its political capital and renew its productivity growth.

zh: 欧盟应当将英国退欧视为推进过去部分因英国反对而陷入停滞的根本性改革的一次机会。
en: The EU should recognize Brexit as an opportunity to move forward with its own fundamental reforms, which have stalled in part because of UK opposition.

zh: 民意调查显示欧盟民众理解有必要在欧盟范围内建立控制金融行业（尤其是跨境金融行业）的框架、管理难民潮并落实应对气候变化及减轻其影响的各项措施。
en: Opinion polls show that EU citizens understand the need for a Europe-wide framework to control the financial sector (particularly cross-border banking), manage refugee flows, and implement measures to fight climate change and mitigate its effects.

zh: 对利沃夫的民众而言，欧洲计划不仅提供了重建社会的榜样，还提供了加盟更大规模事业的机会。
en: For the citizens of Lviv, the European project provides a model not only for rebuilding their own society, but also for joining something bigger.

zh: 那种更大的目标是英国的“留欧”宣传除前首相戈登·布朗的“引领 — — 而非退出”的主题演讲外，未能为其国内选民提供的东西。
en: That larger vision is one the UK’s “Remain” campaign, with the notable exception of former Prime Minister Gordon Brown’s “Lead – Not Leave” speech, did not offer to its own constituency.

zh: 就连英国的亲欧派也在质疑投票留欧是否值得，因为英国政府严重缺乏领导欧盟的能力。
en: Even pro-Europeans in the UK questioned if it was worth voting to remain, given such weak engagement by the UK government in leading the EU.

zh: 英国需要 — — 而且仍然需要 — — 能让民众接受的目标，告诉人们如何能够通过建设欧盟来改善自己的生活。
en: What the UK needed – and still needs – is a vision, put to the people, of how to make itself better by making the EU better.

zh: 在乌克兰改革者勇敢地继续建设新的体制时，他们指望欧盟、尤其是英国能为他们提供蓝图。
en: As Ukrainian reformers bravely continue to build new institutions, they are looking to the EU, and especially to the UK, for blueprints.

zh: 我们希望有一天在审视普通民众对一砖一瓦都具有强烈归属感的利沃夫时，也能够从他们的经历中得到启示。
en: One hopes that we will someday look to Lviv – where every citizen feels a sense of ownership over every stone – for inspiration as well.

zh: 英国退出、特朗普和全球化输家
en: Brexit, Trump, and Globalization’s Have-Nots

zh: 坎布里奇—近几天来，两起政治事件吸引着全球目光 — — 英国投票脱离欧盟议会唐纳德·特朗普的美国总统选战。 这两起事件颇有些共同点。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Two political events that are attracting global attention these days – the vote in the United Kingdom to leave the European Union and Donald Trump’s presidential campaign in the United States – have much in common.

zh: 略多于一半的英国选民选择“英国退出 ” ， 其结果将对英国政治制度和经济前景造成漫长的影响。
en: Just over half of UK voters chose “Brexit,” a result that has cast a long shadow over their country’s political system and economic prospects.

zh: 也许理解这两起事件的共同点有助于美国选民避免在11月份重蹈覆辙。
en: Perhaps understanding the parallels between the two campaigns will help US voters avoid taking a similar path in November.

zh: 一个共同点是两起事件都被彻底低估了，特别是专家和建制派。
en: One parallel is that both campaigns were thoroughly underestimated, especially by experts and establishment figures.

zh: 正如英国退出的可能性在一开始没有引起重视，美国共和党和民主党的政治精英们也极少有人从一开始就认真对待特朗普要争取共和党提名的企图。
en: Just as the possibility of Brexit was initially dismissed, few political elites, Republican and Democratic alike, took seriously Trump’s bid for the Republican nomination.

zh: 另一个类似之处是两起事件都主要以不靠谱甚至荒谬的承诺为基础。
en: Another similarity is that both campaigns have been based largely on implausible, even absurd, promises.

zh: 在英国 ， “ 脱欧”阵营向选民保证英国在脱离欧盟后能够继续进入单一市场，同时又可以限制欧洲工人流入英国。
en: In the UK, “Leave” campaigners assured voters that the UK could maintain access to the single market after withdrawing from the EU, while limiting the entry of European workers to the UK.

zh: 他们还宣称，据估计每周必须向欧盟缴纳的3.6亿英镑可以转而用于饱受缺少现金之苦的国民医疗服务体系。
en: They also declared that the £350 million ($465 million) supposedly sent to the EU each week would be reallocated to the cash-strapped National Health Service.

zh: 公投结果出来后不出几小时 ， “ 脱欧”阵营领导人就开始“反水 ” ， 激起了许多选民的愤怒，特别是那些因为渴望削减移民而支持英国退出的人。
en: Within hours of the referendum result, the “Leave” campaign’s leaders began to backtrack, spurring anger among many voters, particularly those whose support for Brexit had been driven by the desire to cut immigration.

zh: 但特朗普本人的不靠谱承诺 — — 包括在英国和墨西哥之间建设一道墙以及让制造业岗位从海外回到美国 — — 仍令许多选民深信不疑。
en: Yet Trump’s own implausible promises – including his pledges to construct a wall between the US and Mexico and bring back manufacturing jobs from overseas – still seem credible to many voters.

zh: 这些共同之处指向了一个结论：许多感觉被全球化抛下的工人和中产阶级选民的怒气远比建制派领导人所意识到的更深。
en: These parallels point to one conclusion: many working- and middle-class voters, who feel left behind by globalization, are far angrier than establishment leaders realized.

zh: 他们已不再可以忽略；相反，领导人必须找到如何解决他们的担忧。
en: They can no longer be dismissed; instead, leaders must figure out how to address their concerns.

zh: 全球化有赢家和输家。
en: There are winners and losers in globalization.

zh: 但经济学基本主张认为，当个体可以自由地参与交易时，经济蛋糕的规模就会扩大，大到赢家在理论上可以补偿输家，让所有人的境况都得到改善。
en: But a fundamental proposition in economics holds that when individuals are free to engage in trade, the size of the economic pie increases enough that the winners could, in theory, compensate the losers, leaving everyone better off.

zh: 全球化怀疑派正确地指出，在实践中，这一补偿始终只是假说。
en: Globalization skeptics are right that, in practice, the compensation tends to remain hypothetical.

zh: 但就此认为他们应该抵制全球化是站不住脚的，原因很简单：全球化无法抹杀。
en: But the suggestion that we should try to roll back globalization is problematic for a simple reason: globalization can’t be undone.

zh: 任何将精灵捉回瓶子中的尝试不但可能触发贸易战，对经济增长造成 严重后果，也无法让贸易退回到50年前的水平。
en: Any effort to put the genie back in the bottle might not only trigger trade wars, with serious consequences for economic growth, but would also fail to reduce trade to the levels of 50 years ago.

zh: 比如，没有哪个国家领导人能够让钢铁业就业量回到1966年的水平。
en: No national leader could restore, say, steel-industry employment to what it was in 1966.

zh: 幸运的是，有一个更好的选项。
en: Fortunately, there is a better option.

zh: 我们可以将全球化视为给定条件，并采取措施帮助补偿可能被全球化自然淘汰的群体。
en: We can take globalization as a given, and adopt measures to help compensate those who might naturally lose out.

zh: 在美国，有助于实现这一目标的措施包括贸易调整补助（Trade Adjustment Assistance ） ， 这是一个旨在专门帮助因为贸易而失去工作的人的计划。
en: In the US, measures that could help to achieve that include Trade Adjustment Assistance, a program aimed specifically at helping those who have lost their jobs due to trade.

zh: 更重要的计划 — — 帮助那些因为贸易、技术或其他原因而落后的人的计划 — — 包括扩大的劳动收入税收优惠（Earned Income Tax Credit）和医疗保险。
en: More important programs – which could help those left behind by trade, technology, or something else – include an expanded Earned Income Tax Credit and health insurance.

zh: 民主党，包括总统奥巴马及其推定继任提名人希拉里·克林顿，大体上支持这些政策。
en: Democrats, including President Barack Obama and Hillary Clinton, the presumptive Democratic nominee to succeed him, largely support these policies.

zh: 但共和党反对这些政策。
en: Yet Republicans have opposed them.

zh: 有可能特朗普也将拒绝这些计划，即使他宣称自己是工人阶级救世主。
en: It seems likely that Trump would reject such efforts as well, even as he claims to be the savior of the working class.

zh: 特朗普的崛起反映出美国政治极化在过去八年已经深化到了什么程度。
en: Trump’s rise reflects the extent to which political polarization in the US has deepened during the last eight years.

zh: 随着政治温和派被排挤出局，政策僵局恶化，总统的方案总是被国会中的共和党所阻挠，即使这些方案与共和党的理念相符。
en: As political moderates have been pushed out, policy gridlock has worsened, with presidential initiatives routinely blocked by congressional Republicans, even when such proposals were consistent with Republican ideas.

zh: 所有这些都不利于全球化的输家；他们需要领导人 — — 国会和行政机构中的两党领导人 — — 团结一致保护他们的利益。
