en: None of this bodes well for the losers of globalization; they need leaders – of both parties, in Congress and the executive branch – who can come together to protect their interests.

zh: 直到最近，英国选举制度似乎都表现出一种令人羡慕的平衡方针。
en: Until recently, the British electoral system seemed to represent an admirably balanced approach.

zh: 最大的两党基本上都由胜任并一致的领导层领导，代表着相对合理的政策立场 — — 保守党中右翼和工党中左翼。
en: The two largest parties largely operated under competent and consistent leadership and represented relatively well-defined policy stances – center-right for the Conservatives, and center-left for Labour.

zh: 在这一环境下，选民可以根据当前问题做出选择。
en: In this environment, voters could base their choices on the issues at hand.

zh: 此外，在议会制度下，获胜的首相可以致力于兑现他在选战中宣传的政策。
en: And, under the parliamentary system, victorious prime ministers could work to carry out the policies on which they had campaigned.

zh: 但即便是英国的“胜任”领导人有时也会做出命中注定的拙劣决定。
en: Yet even Britain’s “competent” leaders sometimes made fatefully ill-advised decisions.

zh: 从撒切尔夫人引入人头税到布莱尔支持美国领导的支持伊拉克战争，再到卡梅伦决定举行英国退出公投，这些决定破坏了英国的制度。
en: From Margaret Thatcher’s introduction of a poll tax to Tony Blair’s support for the US-led invasion of Iraq, to David Cameron’s decision to hold the Brexit referendum, such decisions have undermined the British system.

zh: 卡梅伦身后留下的是一地狼藉。
en: What is left now, after Cameron, is a mess.

zh: 新的政客群体身上很难看到明确性和一致性。
en: The new crop of politicians shows little clarity or consistency.

zh: 当下一次选举举行时，选民很可能需要在英国所必须做出的重要政策决定上 — — 主要是寻求与欧盟展开相对紧密的协作的谈判还是完全脱离 — — 都没有清晰思路的两党中间做出选择。
en: When the next election is held, voters could well be asked to choose between parties that do not correspond in any clear way to the relevant policy decisions that Britain must make – mainly, whether to seek to negotiate a relatively close association with the EU or to separate completely.

zh: 从这个角度，美国选民可能仍然比他们的英国同道境况好一些。
en: In this sense, American voters might still be better off than their British counterparts.

zh: 尽管特朗普的出现表明美国政治制度也遭到了严重的扭曲，但民主党仍然支持工资保险和全民医疗保险等政策，而共和党依然反对这些政策。
en: Though Trump’s appearance indicates that the US political system has also deteriorated markedly, the Democrats still favor policies like wage insurance and universal health insurance, and the Republicans still oppose them.

zh: 因此，在11月，美国选民仍能根据自己的观点在主要问题之一上做出选择：通过帮助那些落后的人纠正全球化的现实，还是像退出欧盟的英国一样望风披靡。
en: So, in November, American voters are still making a choice about one of the leading issues on their minds: whether to address the reality of globalization by helping those who have been left behind, or to tilt at windmills, like the Brexiting British.

zh: “金砖国家”的谬误
en: The BRICS Fallacy

zh: 马德里 — — 最近巴西信用评级被下调至垃圾级后有大量文章预测金砖五国（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）将就此摇摇欲坠。
en: MADRID – The recent downgrade of Brazil’s credit rating to junk status was followed by a raft of articles heralding the crumbling of the BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa).

zh: 多么准确：幸灾乐祸总是出现在金砖国家传出噩耗之后，金砖国家曾一度被誉为世界未来的经济强国和今后主要的政治力量。
en: How predictable: schadenfreude almost always follows bad news about the BRICS, whose members were once hailed as the world’s up-and-coming economic powerhouses and next major political force.

zh: 这里面有着更深层次的因素。
en: There is something deeper going on here.

zh: 世界对金砖国家起起落落的痴迷反映出想要找到哪个或哪些国家能取代美国成为全球领袖的愿望。
en: The world’s seeming obsession with the BRICS’ perceived rise and fall reflects a desire to identify the country or group of countries that would take over from the United States as global leader.

zh: 但在搜索“明日之星”时，世界忽略了美国仍然是有能力领导世界并确保一定国际秩序的唯一强国。
en: But, in searching for the “next big thing,” the world ignores the fact that the US remains the only power capable of providing global leadership and ensuring some semblance of international order.

zh: 金砖国家的故事非常熟悉。
en: The story of the BRICS is a familiar one.

zh: 2001年其最早以技术分类的形式出现，英国经济学家吉姆·奥尼尔把上述国家（不包括南非）集中起来，并因为它们都是快速发展的新兴经济体而起了这个朗朗上口的名字。
en: It began as a technical grouping in 2001, when the British economist Jim O’Neill lumped them together (without South Africa) and gave them their catchy name for the sole reason that they were all large, rapidly growing emerging economies.

zh: 但金砖国家认识到经济实力可以转化为政治影响，于是在2006年召开了首次非正式会议，并在2009年召开了首次领导人峰会。
en: But, recognizing that economic power could translate into political influence, the BRICS held their first informal meeting in 2006, and their first leaders’ summit in 2009.

zh: 金砖集团取得了成功 — — 至少当时看似如此。
en: The bloc was going places – or so it seemed.

zh: 但在7年7次首脑会议和吸收一个新的成员国后（南非于2010年加入金砖组织 ） ， 金砖国家的重要性仍在被外界热议。
en: But seven years, seven summits, and one new member (South Africa joined in 2010) later, the significance of the BRICS remains hotly debated.

zh: 金砖国家间的差距众所周知。
en: The disparities among the BRICS are well known.

zh: 中国的经济产量几乎是金砖集团其他国家的两倍，约为南非的30倍之多。
en: China’s economic output is nearly twice that of the rest of the BRICS combined, and roughly 30 times that of South Africa.

zh: 它们的治理模式有着很大不同，既有印度的强大民主，也有俄罗斯的非自由模式和中国的一党专政。
en: Their governance models are vastly different, from India’s robust democracy to Russia’s illiberal model to China’s one-party system.

zh: 俄罗斯和中国都是联合国安理会常任理事国，对其他金砖国家入常热情的支持顶多可以用三心二意来形容。
en: Russia and China, both permanent members of the UN Security Council, have offered, at best, lukewarm support for the other BRICS’ aspirations to join them.

zh: 而且金砖成员国间还存在双边分歧，包括印度和中国间激烈的领土争端。
en: And then there are its members’ bilateral disagreements, including a heated territorial dispute between India and China.

zh: 尽管如此，金砖国家仍不止一次携手合作。
en: Nonetheless, the BRICS have acted in concert on more than one occasion.

zh: 去年3月，在俄罗斯吞并克里米亚遭到普遍谴责时，该国的金砖同盟国 — — 就连那些一直支持边界和非干预不可侵犯的国家也不例外 — — 拒绝支持联合国大会确认乌克兰统一和领土完整的决议。
en: Last March, amid near-universal condemnation of Russia’s annexation of Crimea, the country’s BRICS counterparts – even those that had long supported the inviolability of borders and non-intervention – abstained from a UN General Assembly resolution affirming Ukraine’s unity and territorial integrity.

zh: 三个月后，金砖国家发布 “领导人峰会宣言 ” ， 谴责欧盟和美国对俄实施经济制裁。
en: Three months later, the BRICS released their “Leaders’ Summit Declaration” condemning the imposition of economic sanctions on Russia by the European Union and the US.

zh: 最为具体的是，金砖五国联合平等运营的期待已久的新发展银行7月在上海成立。
en: Most concretely, the long-anticipated New Development Bank, run jointly and equally by the five BRICS countries, opened its doors in Shanghai in July.

zh: 金砖集团显然是新生力量。
en: Clearly, the BRICS are a thing.

zh: 只不过不能取代美国领导世界。
en: They are just not the thing.

zh: 金砖集团崛起于世界多数国家，尤其是发达经济体深陷危机的时刻。
en: The BRICS arose at a time when much of the world, especially the advanced economies, was mired in crisis.

zh: “西方衰落”的故事伴随着“其他国家的崛起 ” 。
en: The “fall of the West” narrative ran alongside that of the “rise of the rest.”

zh: 但故事的发展并不符合人们的预期。
en: But the story has not played out quite as anticipated.

zh: 经济上，金砖国家正面临着严峻的挑战。
en: Economically, the BRICS are facing serious challenges.

zh: 除了有明确证据的增长放缓，中国最近经历了相当大的股市动荡和货币贬值。
en: In addition to a well-documented growth slowdown, China has lately experienced considerable stock-market turmoil and currency devaluation.

zh: 巴西和俄罗斯的经济正在萎缩；南非的增长已经放缓；而印度虽然保持了相对强劲的增长，也必须要推行重要的改革。
en: The Brazilian and Russian economies are contracting; South Africa’s growth has slowed; and India, though maintaining relatively strong growth, must undertake important reforms.

zh: 金砖国家也未能兑现领导国际事务的承诺。
en: The BRICS have also failed to fulfill their promise of international leadership.

zh: 最新一个十年开始时，巴西联手土耳其表现出了一定程度的推进伊朗核协议的愿望。
en: At the beginning of the decade, Brazil showed a certain aspiration, along with Turkey, to press ahead with an alternative nuclear deal with Iran.

zh: 但腐败丑闻和大宗商品价格下跌导致该提案崩溃，巴西也就此退出了全球舞台。
en: But that proposal fell apart, and, amid pressure from corruption scandals and falling commodity prices, Brazil left the global stage.

zh: （尽管印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪非常有名 ） ， 但南非和印度仍然未能发挥他们应有的国际影响。
en: South Africa and India also continue to punch below their apparent weight internationally (notwithstanding Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visibility).

zh: 至于传统世界领袖中唯一的俄罗斯，克里姆林宫的乌克兰政策已经严重损害了该国的国际形象 — — 就连俄国在叙利亚可能的外交政变也无法挽回他们的形象。
en: As for Russia, the only traditional world leader of the bunch, the Kremlin’s Ukraine policy has done severe damage to the country’s international profile – damage that not even its possible diplomatic coup in Syria can undo.

zh: 上周习近平主席对华盛顿的访问表明，只有中国表现出了领导世界事务的倾向。 习奥会谈达成了气候行动、网络安全和国际发展等领域的重要公告。
en: Only China has displayed an inclination to lead, as exemplified by President Xi Jinping’s visit to Washington, DC last week, which produced major announcements on climate action, cyber security, and international development.

zh: 亚洲基础设施投资银行和上海合作组织复兴也一直是中国追求的目标。
en: China has also been pursuing initiatives like the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the revitalization of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization.

zh: 但中国日益增长的自信，特别是在南中国海，让人觉得它与其说是领袖还不如说是威胁。
en: But China’s growing assertiveness, particularly in the South China Sea, has fueled the perception that it is more of a threat than a leader.

zh: 总而言之，金砖国家的崛起似乎已经告一段落。
en: All in all, the BRICS no longer seem to be rising.

zh: 与此同时，西方核心国家似乎已经停止继续衰落。
en: At the same time, the core of the West no longer seems to be declining.

zh: 尽管欧洲深陷危机和对自身存在价值充满怀疑、日本经历二十年经济停滞后仍在试图站稳脚跟，但美国的影响力仍然和过去一样。
en: Although Europe remains mired in crisis and existential self-doubt, and Japan is still finding its feet after two decades of economic stagnation, the US is as relevant as ever.

zh: 事实上，从中东冲突到气候变化到全球金融监管 — — 没有哪个重要的全球挑战可以在没有美国参与的情况下得到解决。
en: Indeed, no major global challenge – from conflict in the Middle East to climate change to global financial regulation – can be confronted without American engagement.

zh: 美国的长期统治地位会激怒很多人，而且理由非常充分。
en: America’s enduring dominance will rile many, and with good reason.

zh: 冷战结束后25年已经过去，世界本应以更为公平和平衡的方式解决现有问题，但实际却没有。
en: A quarter-century after the Cold War’s end, the world should have arrived at a more equitable and balanced way of getting things done.

zh: 欧洲太过关注其自身问题；中国引起的怀疑太多；而尽管有迹象表明印度准备在全球发挥更大作用，但却不具备足够的国际权威。
en: But it has not, and no other single power is in a position to take America’s place. Europe is too inward looking; China inspires too much suspicion; and India, despite showing signs that it is preparing for a greater global role, lacks enough international authority on its own.

zh: 结果是在前美国国务卿奥尔布赖特声称自己的国家“不可或缺”20年后，美国的地位仍然未能动摇。
en: As a result, nearly 20 years after former US Secretary of State Madeleine Albright dubbed her country “indispensable,” it remains so.

zh: 当务之急是美国和世界必须认识到这一事实。
en: The imperative now is for the US and the world to recognize this.

zh: 我们应该强调美国领导地位的重要性，而不是关注谁能替代美国 — — 这样有助于刺激美国重新承担起国际责任。
en: Rather than focusing our attention on alternatives to US leadership, we should be emphasizing its importance – an approach that would help to spur the US to rededicate itself to its international responsibilities.

zh: 有迹象表明上述冲动依然存在 — — 最明显的当属伊朗核协议 — — 但解决世界所面临的挑战仍然远远不够。
en: There have been hints that this impulse still exists – notably, the Iranian nuclear deal – but they remain inadequate to the challenges confronting the world.

zh: 国际秩序正处在十字路口。
en: The international order is at a crossroads.

zh: 它需要美国拿出独创性、主动性和耐心来加以引导，才有可能实现和平和繁荣。
en: It needs the US to guide it – with ingenuity, initiative, and stamina – in the direction of peace and prosperity.

zh: 沉湎于猜测哪些国家最终可能取代美国势必让我们都蒙受损失。
en: Obsessing about who might eventually replace America is bound to get us all lost.

zh: 金砖国家繁荣已去
en: The Bloom Is off the BRICS

zh: 斯坦福—几年前，专家和决策者预测金砖国家 — — 巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非 — — 将成为全球增长新引擎。
en: STANFORD – A few years ago, pundits and policymakers were predicting that the BRICS countries – Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa – would be the new engines of global growth.

zh: 将高速增长简单外推让许多人开始构想这些经济体无比光明的未来 — — 以及托它们之福，全世界都会迎来灿烂前途。
en: Naive extrapolation of rapid growth led many people to imagine an ever-brighter future for these economies – and, thanks to them, for the rest of the world as well.

zh: 但如今，繁荣已经凋零。
en: But now the bloom is off the rose.

zh: 巴西和俄罗斯经济正在衰退，而中国和南非也大幅放缓。
en: The economies of Brazil and Russia are contracting, while those of China and South Africa have slowed substantially.

zh: 只有印度增长率在向上攀升，目前略高于中国。
en: Only India’s growth rate has stayed up, now slightly exceeding China’s.

zh: 金砖国家能实现此前的前景吗？
en: Will the BRICS fulfill their former promise?

zh: 还是会遇到难以避免的持续问题？
en: Or are continued problems inevitable?

zh: 低收入国家往往人均固定资本（计算机、工厂、基础设施）和人力资本（教育和培训）极低，因此资本投资回报潜力较高。
en: Given that low-income economies typically have little fixed capital (computers, factories, infrastructure) and human capital (education and training) per worker, they tend to have higher potential returns to capital investment.

zh: 这意味着它们可以以比富裕国家更快的速度增长，直到人均收入实现赶超。
en: That means they can grow more rapidly than wealthier economies, until their per capita income catches up.

zh: 中国、印度和巴西仍存在庞大的从村人口，但它们在减少贫困方面取得了巨大成就，在过去几十年中，数亿人（主要是中国）摆脱了贫困。
en: While China, India, and Brazil still have very large rural populations, they have made great strides in reducing poverty, with several hundred million people (the largest proportion in China), escaping it in the last few decades.

zh: 这些国家的中产阶级也在快速成长。
en: And these countries’ middle classes are growing fast as well.

zh: 新兴经济体的大踏步前进助长了欧洲和北美的经济悲观论。
en: Rapid progress in the emerging economies has contributed to economic pessimism in Europe and North America.

zh: 毕竟，发展中经济体GDP之和已经超过了发达经济体 — — 二十年前我们还无法想象这一情景。
en: After all, the developing economies’ combined GDP now exceeds that of the advanced economies – a situation that would have been unimaginable a generation ago.

zh: 此外，中国、印度和东欧经济开放后，数亿低成本工人加入全球劳动力大军，迄今仍在给发达经济体的工人（技能极高者除外）工资造成压力。
en: Moreover, the hundreds of millions of low-cost workers who joined the global labor force when China, India, and Eastern Europe opened their economies are still putting pressure on the wages of all but the most skilled workers in the advanced economies.

zh: 诺贝尔经济学奖获得者萨缪尔逊（Paul Samuelson）在1948年观察到，国际贸易导致因素价格趋同，不同国家经技能水平调整的工资趋于均衡。
en: As the Nobel laureate economist Paul Samuelson observed in 1948, international trade leads to factor-price equalization, with wages, adjusted for skill levels, equilibrating across countries.

zh: 但是，对金砖国家来说，持续高速进步可能会日益困难。
en: But, for the BRICS, continued rapid progress may become more difficult.

zh: 经验表明，在某一点上 — — 通常是人均收入达到15,000—20,000美元（约为美国水平的三分之一）时 — — 增长开始趋缓。
en: Experience shows that there is a point – usually when per capita income levels reach about $15,000-20,000 (roughly one-third the level in the United States) – when growth tends to slow.

zh: 近几十年来，只有少数经济体 — — 特别是韩国、中国台湾和新加坡 — — 成功地摆脱了所谓的“中等收入陷阱 ” ， 实现了持续繁荣。
en: In recent decades, only a few economies – notably, South Korea, Taiwan, and Singapore – have managed to escape the so-called “middle-income trap” and continue to increase their prosperity.

zh: 除了几乎所有发展中经济体都会面临的问题 — — 比如机构不力和治理不善 — — 每个金砖国家都面临着自身独特的挑战。
en: Beyond the problems that almost all developing economies confront – for example, weak institutions and poor governance – each of the BRICS countries faces a unique set of challenges.

zh: 比如，巴西必须与衰退、低油价和前所未有的国有巨头巴西石油公司腐败丑闻作斗争。
en: For example, Brazil must contend with a recession, low oil prices, and an unprecedented corruption scandal at Petrobras, the state oil company.

zh: 考虑到这些因素，自由贸易（如与北美自由贸易协定国家 — — 加拿大、美国和墨西哥之间的贸易）和更友好的外来投资条件（特别是能源领域）应该成为总统罗塞夫日程的重点。
en: Given this, freer trade, such as with the NAFTA countries (Canada, the US, and Mexico), and more hospitable terms for foreign investment, especially in energy, should top President Dilma Rouseff’s agenda.

zh: 俄罗斯也正在感受低油价的压力，其经常预算和进一步发展能源业的能力都在受到冲击。
en: Russia, too, is feeling the pressure of lower oil prices, both on its current budget and in terms of its ability to pursue further energy-sector development.

zh: 美国和欧洲因为其总统给普京对近邻的侵略性政策而采取了经济制裁，这进一步加剧了俄罗斯面临的挑战。
en: Compounding the challenge are the economic sanctions imposed by the US and Europe in response to President Vladimir Putin’s aggressive policies toward Russia’s immediate neighborhood.

zh: 最后，俄罗斯还存在长期人口问题：人口减少、寿命预期远低于发达国家平均水平以及人才流失。
en: Finally, Russia has a staggering demographic problem, characterized by a shrinking population, life expectancy far below the advanced-country average, and a growing brain drain.

zh: 至少从目前来看，印度的短期经济状况最好。
en: India, at least for the moment, has the best short-run economic conditions.

zh: 此前构成经济主要威胁之一的通货膨胀在印度储备银行行长拉詹（Raghuram Rajan）的指引下有所降低。
en: Inflation, a major threat to the economy until recently, is down under the guidance of the Reserve Bank of India’s governor, Raghuram Rajan.

zh: 今年增长率预计将达7.5 % 。
en: And growth is projected at 7.5% for this year.

zh: 但印度的财政状况仍相当棘手，而印度人口 — — 不久就将超过中国 — — 大部分仍生活在农村和贫困中。
en: But India’s fiscal position remains challenging, and the country’s population, which will soon overtake China’s, remains mostly rural and impoverished.

zh: 尽管面临紧迫挑战，总理莫迪实施承诺的经济改革的速度仍然十分缓慢。
en: Despite the looming challenges, Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been slow to implement the promised economic reforms.

zh: 事实上，尽管他在监管、私有化和面向穷人的转移支付等方面取得了一些小进展，但在更大手笔的土地和劳动力市场改革上仍然没有拿出明确动作。
en: Indeed, although he has made some small improvements in regulation, privatization, and cash transfers to the poor, bolder land and labor-market reforms remain elusive.

zh: 至于中国，它正在尝试艰难的经济再平衡，从出口拉动型增长模式转型为基于消费的增长模式。
en: China, for its part, is attempting a difficult economic rebalancing, from an export-led to a consumption-based growth model.

zh: 用德州扑克术语讲，中国国家主席习近平面临一副缺少中间一张的顺子，他在下注成长起来的中产阶级将需要足够的制造品，足以防止中国经济基础产业严重过剩的产能导致大面积失业。
en: In poker terms, Chinese President Xi Jinping is attempting to pull an inside straight, gambling that a growing middle class will demand enough manufactured goods to prevent the economy’s immense excess capacity in basic industries from leading to widespread unemployment.

zh: 中国家庭消费占GDP之比不足40 % — —发达经济体至少为60 % — —显然还有增长空间。
en: At under 40% of GDP – compared to at least 60% in advanced economies – Chinese household consumption certainly has space to grow.

zh: 但中国经济仍面临大量风险。
en: But China’s economy remains prone to considerable risks.

zh: 如几十年前的日本所发生的，中国正在面临来自越南等国家的低成本竞争；中国股市泡沫巨大；而习近平的反腐运动尽管广受普通群众支持，但也造成了“游戏规则”的巨大不确定性。
en: As occurred in Japan decades ago, China is starting to face lower-cost competition, such as from Vietnam; its stock market is frothy; and Xi’s anti-corruption program, though popular with ordinary citizens, has led to widespread uncertainty about the “rules of the game.”

zh: 最后，南非的问题反映在人们对政府丧失信心、腐败根深蒂固、基础设施需求巨大、劳动力市场和外来投资监管过于严格。
en: Finally, South Africa’s problems reflect a loss of confidence in the government, endemic corruption, massive infrastructure needs, and restrictive labor-market and foreign-investment regulation.

zh: 而从改革的角度讲，总统祖玛的方向也并不正确。
en: And, in terms of reform, President Jacob Zuma is not headed in the right direction.

zh: 金砖国家受到 — — 一直都是如此 — — 与其他经济体相同的因素的影响。
en: The BRICS are – and always have been – subject to the same forces as other economies.

zh: 但是，尽管它们提高了对市场力量的依赖，但它们的政府仍过多地干预重大经济决策，增加了失衡甚至危及的风险。
en: But, although they have increased their dependence on market forces, their governments continue to dictate too many major economic decisions, increasing the risk of imbalances or even crises.

zh: 它们是否有能力发展支持更大经济自由的机构，更多依赖市场竞争、更少依赖政府，这一问题可能将是它们长期成功的主要决定因素。
en: Their ability to develop institutions that support greater economic freedom, with more reliance on market competition and less on government, will likely be the main determinant of their long-term success.

zh: 中国的金砖国家平衡法
en: China’s BRICS Balancing Act

zh: 北京—当世界大部分目光集中在希腊问题上的时候，金砖国家 — — 巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非 — — 一直在致力于推进自身的经济日程，西伯利亚城市乌法（Ufa）举行的第七届年度峰会便是最新动作。
en: BEIJING – As much of the world focuses on Greece’s travails, the BRICS countries – Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa – have been working to advance their own economic agenda, most recently at their seventh annual summit in the Siberian city of Ufa. But, though Russia hosted the meeting, it is China that was viewed as dominating the grouping.

zh: 事实上，金砖国家已成为中国外交的力量放大器，只要中国在推进其国家利益的过程中不过于强硬，就能继续利用这一放大器。
en: Indeed, the BRICS has already proved to be a force multiplier for Chinese diplomacy, and can remain so if China is careful not to push its national interests too hard.

zh: 目前，中国在推进金砖国家迈向真正合作方面起着关键作用。
en: So far, China has played a pivotal role in driving progress toward real cooperation among the BRICS countries.

zh: 最近几周，金砖国家各自承诺向定于明年开始贷款业务的新开发银行投入100亿美元、制定了经济和贸易合作的共同战略，并同意成立规模1,000亿美元的应急基金向面临收支平衡压力的成员国提供临时援助。
en: In recent weeks, its members have each pledged $10 billion to their New Development Bank, which should start lending next year; released a common strategy for economic and trade cooperation; and agreed to a $100 billion contingency fund to provide temporary assistance to members facing balance-of-payments pressures.

zh: 但金砖国家的未来仍充满了未知数，这是拜巨大的经济不利形势所赐。
en: But the BRICS’ future remains uncertain, owing to strong economic headwinds.

zh: 巴西陷入了腐败丑闻和产出停滞。
en: Brazil is wracked by corruption scandals and stagnating output.

zh: 俄罗斯也许已经陷入衰退 — — 在很大程度上是因为其干预乌克兰而遭到了西方的制裁。
en: Russia is probably in recession, owing largely to Western sanctions imposed in response to its intervention in Ukraine.

zh: 印度一直饱受货币贬值和公债高企困扰。
en: India has been suffering from a depreciating currency and soaring public debts.

zh: 中国去年GDP增长率仅为7.4 % ， 为24年来的最低值。
en: China’s GDP grew by only 7.4% last year, the lowest rate in 24 years.

zh: 而由于能源短缺等原因，南非的增长也十分疲软。
en: And South Africa’s growth has been weak, not least due to energy shortages.

zh: 在这样的背景下，许多西方观察者认为金砖国家已经破产。
en: Given these developments, many Western observers have come to believe that the BRICS are broken.

zh: 摩根士丹利的莎尔玛（Ruchir Sharma）强调，上个十年的赢家也许无法在这个十年继续成为赢家。
en: Morgan Stanley’s Ruchir Sharma has emphasized that the winners of the last decade may not continue to win in this one.

zh: 就连“金砖”一词的创造者奥尼尔（Jim O’Neill）也将注意力转向了“薄荷 ” （ MINT）经济体 — — 墨西哥、印度尼西亚、尼日利亚和土耳其 — — 它们都是金砖国家主要的新兴国家竞争对手。
en: Even Jim O’Neill, who coined the term “BRIC,” has turned his attention to the “MINT” economies – Mexico, Indonesia, Nigeria, and Turkey – the BRICS’ key emerging-country competitors.

zh: 但并非所有人都对金砖国家的全球影响力前景感到悲观，不管是个人还是集体观点。
en: But not everyone is bearish about the BRICS’ prospects and global influence, whether taken individually or as a grouping.

zh: 记者拉赫曼（Gideon Rachman）指出 ， “ 非西方经济体的崛起有深刻的历史变革根源，可以应对任何数量的经济和政治冲击。
en: The journalist Gideon Rachman has suggested that “the rise of non-Western economies is a deeply rooted historic shift that can survive any number of economic and political shocks.”

zh: ”中国似乎很渴望拉赫曼是正确的。
en: China seems to be counting on that being true.

zh: 事实上，金砖国家仍然是不容小觑的经济力量，它们贡献了世界GDP的25.7 % 、 人口的42 % 、 贸易总量的17 % 。
en: In fact, the BRICS countries remain an economic force to be reckoned with, accounting for 25.7% of world GDP, 42% of the global population, and 17% of total trade.

zh: 它们吸引着全球外国投资总量的18 % ， 持有外汇储备总量的40%和美国国债海外持有总量的30 % 。
en: They attract more than 18% of the global total of foreign investment, hold 40% of all foreign-exchange reserves, and account for 30% of total foreign holdings of US Treasury bonds.

zh: 此外，金砖国家消费市场价值超过4万亿美元，与欧元区等量齐观。
en: Moreover, the BRICS consumption markets are worth more than $4 trillion, equivalent to those of the eurozone.

zh: 而根据高盛的数据，到2030年，大约85%的全球中产阶级将生活在金砖国家和其他发展中国家。
en: And, according to Goldman Sachs, about 85% of the world’s middle class will be living in the BRICS and other developing countries by 2030.

zh: 此外，许多助推金砖国家高速增长的因素 — — 包括相对较低的劳动力成本、生产率的提高、贸易自由化以及信息和资本的自由流动 — — 仍然有效，现在就宣判金砖国家已是明日黄花还为时过早。
en: Moreover, with many of the factors that have fueled the BRICS’ rapid growth – including relatively low labor costs, rising productivity, trade liberalization, and the free flow of information and capital – still in play, writing off the BRICS would be premature.

zh: 但是，金砖国家还必须倍加努力。
en: Still, the BRICS have work to do.

zh: 推迟结构改革让它们的经济积累了风险和失衡，破坏了长期健康。
en: By delaying structural reforms, they have allowed their economies to accumulate risks and imbalances that have eroded their long-term health.

zh: 特别是，金砖国家面临着巨大的收入不平等，2010—2013年平均基尼系数（零表示绝对平等，一表示绝对不平等）在0.37到0.50之间。
en: In particular, the BRICS suffer from considerable income inequality, with their average Gini coefficient (where zero signifies absolute equality and one is absolute inequality) ranging from 0.37 to 0.50 in 2010-2013.

zh: 如果精诚合作，金砖国家有更大的机会实施提振经济恢复力所需要的改革 — — 它们已经意识到了这一机会。
en: Working together, the BRICS have a better chance of implementing the reforms needed to boost their economies’ resilience – an opportunity that they have already identified.

zh: 印度总理莫迪政府寻求从中国获得大量支持实施国家制造政策和克服开发基础设施的障碍。
en: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s administration has sought massive support from China in implementing its national manufacturing policy and overcoming obstacles to developing infrastructure.

zh: 中国政府走的更远，不仅追求国内改革，还敦促其他金砖国家将合作制度化。
en: The Chinese government is now going further, urging the rest of the BRICS to institutionalize their cooperation, not just pursue domestic reform.

zh: 中国认为，加强金砖国家合作有助于捍卫所有发展中国家的利益。
en: China contends that a stronger BRICS grouping would help to safeguard the interests of all developing countries.

zh: 在这方面，中国带头推进全球经济机构改革，包括促使国际货币基金组织（IMF）做出加权投票制度改革。
en: To that end, the country is also spearheading the effort to reform the global economic architecture, including by pushing for reforms to the International Monetary Fund’s weighted voting system.

zh: 但尽管这些政策可以给新兴和发展中国家带来诸多好处，但它们也造成了中国的金砖国家伙伴国的巨大焦虑，担心中国领导很快就会转化为主宰。
en: But despite such efforts’ potential benefits for emerging and developing economies, they have provoked considerable anxiety among China’s BRICS partners, which fear that its leadership could quickly morph into domination.

zh: 金砖国家除了在政治制度、社会价值和文化传统 — — 这些因素是信任和凝聚的基础 — — 存在巨大差异外，另一个显而易见的特征是中国经济（更不用说军师了）一家独大。
en: Beyond fundamental differences in the BRICS’ countries political systems, social values, and cultural traditions – factors that undermine trust and cohesion – there is the obvious fact that China’s economy (not to mention its military) dwarfs the others’.

zh: 事实上，中国与其他四个金砖国家的双边贸易占了金砖国家内部贸易总量的85 % 。
en: Indeed, bilateral trade between China and the other four BRICS accounts for 85% of total intra-BRICS trade.

zh: 此外，中国的金砖国家伙伴国还面临来自廉价中国制造品的激烈竞争（而许多人认为人民币低估，这进一步增加了担忧 ） 。
en: Furthermore, China’s BRICS partners face keen competition from cheap Chinese-manufactured goods (intensified by what many view as China’s undervalued currency).

zh: 最近几年来你，大部分与贸易相关对华世贸组织投诉来自发展中国家，包括印度和巴西。
en: Most trade-related complaints against China in the World Trade Organization in recent years were lodged by developing countries, including India and Brazil.

zh: 中国与印度的关系尤其令人担忧，两国之间存在着棘手的领土纠纷，在联合国安理会改革上也存在分歧。
en: China’s relationship with India is particularly fraught, owing to their seemingly intractable territorial dispute, as well as disagreements over the reform of the United Nations Security Council.

zh: 如果中国希望金砖国家继续加强合作，就应该寻求扮演组织内部的引导者角色，采取更加审慎而非固执的方针。
en: If China wants the BRICS to continue to deepen their ties, it should seek to act as a guiding hand within the grouping, adopting an approach that is more prudent than pushy.

zh: 这意味着首先要遏制其与印度和俄罗斯的地缘政治竞争。
en: That means, above all, curbing its geopolitical competition with India and Russia.

zh: 与此同时，在处理与发达国家对手的关系时，中国应该采取开放和务实的方针，倡导将发达国家和发展中国家联系在一起的包容的全球政策日程。
en: At the same time, in dealing with its advanced-country counterparts, it should be open and pragmatic, championing an inclusive global policy agenda that connects the developed and developing worlds.

zh: 联合反西方阵线和结成以对立和分裂为特征的集团都不符合中国的利益。
en: A united anti-West bloc would not serve China’s interests any more than a grouping characterized by antagonism and divisions.

zh: 中国 — — 以及其他新兴和发展中经济体 — — 需要的是灵活团结的金砖国家集团，并获得全球公共品领先提供者的强大声誉。
en: What China – and the rest of the emerging and developing economies – needs is a nimble and cohesive BRICS grouping with a strong reputation as a leading provider of global public goods.

zh: 缩小基础设施差距
en: Bridging the Infrastructure Gap

zh: 俄罗斯圣彼得堡 — — 每天，发达和发展中世界都有成百上千万人在交通拥堵中缓慢移动或挤上已经塞得满满的地铁列车上下班。
en: SAINT PETERSBURG, RUSSIA – Every day, millions of people across the developed and developing world inch through gridlock or squeeze into packed subway cars to get to and from work.

zh: 而这只是被撑爆的基础设施系统必须频繁、甚至每天面对的难题。
en: And that is likely to be only one of many frequent – if not daily – confrontations with infrastructure systems that are bursting at the seams.

zh: 发达国家和新兴国家的道路和桥梁同样需要修缮，供水系统老化或能力不足，并因电网负担过重导致大面积停电。
en: In advanced and emerging economies alike, roads and bridges need repair, water systems are aging or inadequate, and power grids are overburdened, leading to blackouts.

zh: 近几十年来太多国家基础设施投资不足，造成日常生活不便甚至妨碍到经济发展。
en: Too many countries have been underinvesting in infrastructure for decades, resulting in everyday inconveniences and, worse, creating roadblocks to economic growth.

zh: 虽然需要大笔资金注入才能解决基础设施不足的问题，但找到资金来源也还仅仅是解决方案中的一环。
en: While a major infusion of funding is needed to address infrastructure gaps, finding the money is only part of the solution.

zh: 各国政府需要改革基础设施规划和监督工作。
en: Governments also need to reform infrastructure planning and oversight.

zh: 公众再也不能接受成本失控的项目。
en: The public can no longer afford to accept projects with costs that spiral out of control.

zh: 决策者非常清楚基础设施项目能在短期创造就业机会，并在长期推动生产效率的提升。
en: Infrastructure projects’ unique ability to create jobs in the short term and boost productivity in the long term is well known to policymakers.

zh: 但尽管过去8年利率一直处于历史低位，空谈却很少转化为实际行动。
en: Yet talk has rarely translated into action, despite the record-low interest rates of the past eight years.

zh: 根据麦肯锡全球研究院的最新估计，到2030年世界各国需要将交通、电力、供水和电信系统投资从每年的2.5万亿增加到3.3万亿，才能为预期的经济增长提供支撑。
en: The world needs to increase investment in transportation, power, water, and telecom systems from $2.5 trillion a year to $3.3 trillion every year through 2030 just to support projected economic growth, according to new estimates from the McKinsey Global Institute.

zh: 但尽管采取行动的必要性显而易见，但20国集团中却有11个国家的基础设施投资实际从2008年全球金融危机后就持续下降。
en: But despite the obvious need for action, infrastructure investment has actually declined in 11 of the G20 economies since the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 传统观点认为财政问题使政府不可能调动足够的公共资金。
en: The conventional wisdom is that fiscal concerns make it impossible to marshal enough public funding.

zh: 事实上，有充分的余地增加公共基础设施投资，尤其当借贷成本一直维持在历史低位的情况下。
en: In fact, there is substantial scope to increase public infrastructure investment, particularly while borrowing costs remain historically low.

zh: 某些情况下，甚至可以不通过加税来获得资金：政府可以通过收取使用费创造收入流，捕捉财产升值或出售现有资产并实现利润回收。
en: In some cases, funding can be found without raising taxes: governments can create revenue streams by instituting user charges, capturing increases in property value, or selling existing assets and recycling the proceeds.

zh: 公共会计准则同样可以允许基础设施资产在完整的生命周期内实现逐渐贬值，而不是要求在建设阶段立即将成本计入财政赤字。
en: Public accounting standards also could allow infrastructure assets to be depreciated over their life cycle, rather than immediately adding their costs to fiscal deficits during construction.

zh: 政府还可以采取多项措施鼓励私人投资，其中最基本的是确保监管确定性并允许收取可以接受的经风险调整的回报价格。
en: Governments can also do much more to encourage private investment, starting by providing regulatory certainty and the ability to charge prices that produce an acceptable risk-adjusted return.

zh: 从广义角度看，他们可以采取措施创造将寻求长期稳定回报的机构投资者和有融资需求的项目联系在一起的市场。
en: Even more broadly, they can take steps to create a market that more efficiently connects institutional investors seeking stable, long-term returns and projects that need financing.

zh: 鉴于这些投资人管理着120万亿美元左右的资产，因此产生制约作用的瓶颈绝不是缺乏资金，而是缺少准备充分且值得投资的项目。
en: Given that these investors have some $120 trillion in assets under management, the bottleneck is not a shortage of capital, but rather a dearth of well-prepared, bankable projects.

zh: 解决方式之一是制定必要的监管和体制基础，协助发达国家的资金从机构投资者顺利流向新兴国家的项目。 新兴国家的海量人口仍然需要享受基本的基础设施服务。
en: One way to clear it would be to develop the regulatory and institutional groundwork needed to enable funding to flow more smoothly from institutional investors in advanced economies to projects in the emerging world, where huge populations still need access to essential infrastructure services.

zh: 除融资外，提高基础设施行业效率所能带来的机遇更大。
en: Beyond financing, making the infrastructure sector more efficient represents an even bigger opportunity.

zh: 以年为单位的延误和高达数十亿美元的成本超支都是公共工程领域令人心酸的共同现象。
en: Delays stretching into years, and cost overruns soaring into the billions of dollars, are a sadly familiar story in public works.

zh: 而且当桥梁变为无用的废物，公众的投资意愿无疑也将受到影响。
en: And when bridges turn into boondoggles, the public grows more reluctant to invest.

zh: 用于基础设施投资的每一块钱都要发挥更大的效用。
en: Every dollar allocated to infrastructure needs to stretch much further.

zh: 这不仅要求建筑业要拿出更好的业绩（该行业生产率增长近几��年都没有任何变化 ） 。
en: Part of that effort involves demanding better performance from the construction industry, where productivity growth has been flat for decades.

zh: 虽然存在从加速桥梁建设到预制模块化施工技术等某些积极的创新现象，但建筑业作为一个整体需要在现代化、技术应用和标准化方面得到有力的推动。
en: There are some positive signs of innovation, from accelerated bridge building to pre-fabrication and modular construction techniques. But the sector as a whole needs a major push in terms of modernization, technology adoption, and standardization.

zh: 推动直接控制的机构和流程转型是政府的任务。
en: Governments must also transform the institutions and processes under their direct control.

zh: 我们与世界各国政府合作的经验表明加强对基础设施建设的管理和监督可以降低基础设施成本达40%左右。
en: Our work with governments around the world has demonstrated that stronger governance and oversight of infrastructure projects can lower infrastructure costs by as much as 40%.

zh: 首先是要采用系统和数据驱动的方法来选择合适的项目。
en: This starts with taking a systematic and data-driven approach to choosing the right projects.

zh: 新加坡和韩国等基础设施搞得最好的国家并不是以孤立的观点来思考项目；他们考量每个基础设施项目能为政策目标提供怎样的支持，并与其他可能产生更好回报的项目进行权衡比较。
en: Top-performing countries such as Singapore and South Korea do not consider projects in isolation; they consider how each supports their policy objectives, and they weigh it against other projects that might yield better returns.

zh: 随着项目逐一进入实施阶段，在交付和执行期加强管理就显得至关重要。
en: As projects move down the pipeline toward realization, it is critical to tighten management of the delivery and execution stages.

zh: 加速环境审核、审批程序和土地收购可以最大限度地控制破土动工前的成本和工期延误。
en: Accelerating environmental reviews, approval processes, and land acquisition can minimize the costs and delays that mount before ground is ever broken.

zh: 采用最佳的施工方法可以释放出巨额价值：目前的状况是，类似项目的标价在不同国家可以相差50%到100%之多。
en: Meeting best practices could unlock huge value: as it stands, the price tags for similar projects can vary by 50-100% from country to country.

zh: “得过且过”绝非满足世界基础设施需求的可行之策。
en: “Kicking the can down the road” is not a viable strategy for dealing with the world’s infrastructure needs.

zh: 我们有义务避免为下一代留下一大堆递延成本以及基本面的不断恶化。
en: It’s up to us to avoid leaving a legacy of deferred costs and deteriorating fundamentals for the next generation.

zh: 资金就在那里。
en: The money is available.

zh: 我们要做的而是将其付诸使用。
en: Let’s put it to use.

zh: 挫败欧元区
en: Scotching the Eurozone

zh: 伦敦—下列哪些事件在今年更容易发生？ 苏格兰在9月的全民公投中决定脱离英国独立，还是至少一个国家决定离开欧元区？
en: LONDON – Which of the following events is more likely to happen this year: Scotland votes to secede from the United Kingdom in its September referendum, or at least one country decides to leave the eurozone?

zh: 传统智慧表明，苏格兰独立存在可能性，但不大，而由国家脱离单一货币的可能性几乎不存在。
en: Conventional wisdom suggests that Scottish independence is possible, albeit not very likely, while any country’s departure from the single currency is fanciful.

zh: 但苏格兰在决定独立后几个月内就要决定其货币安排，一些欧元区国家也将在未来几年中面临相同的货币决策。
en: But the decisions that Scotland would have to make about its monetary arrangements in the months following a vote for independence are at least as likely to be confronted by some eurozone countries over the next couple of years.

zh: 事实上，这两个局面之间有着天然的联系。
en: In fact, there is a natural link between the two situations.

zh: 如果苏格兰决定继续使用英镑 — — 苏格兰政府的官方立场正是如此 — — 那么可以有两种实现方式。
en: An independent Scotland’s continued use of the British pound – the Scottish government’s official position – could be approached in two ways.

zh: 第一种可能是第一部长萨尔蒙德（Alex Salmond）所构想的，即成立一个货币联盟，其中的央行同时对苏格兰和没有了苏格兰的英国负责。
en: The first possibility, which First Minister Alex Salmond appears to have in mind, would entail a monetary union under a central bank accountable both to Scotland and the rump UK.

zh: 但英国政府可以 — — 也必定会 — — 否决如此改变英格兰银行的货币政策、金融稳定和银行监督责任。
en: But the UK government could – and undoubtedly would – veto any such adaptation of the Bank of England’s responsibilities for monetary policy, financial stability, and banking supervision.

zh: 其他任何想得到的货币联盟模式 — — 包括基于如欧洲央行那样的不可问责的中央银行的模式 — — 也将遭到拒绝。
en: Any other conceivable model of monetary union – including one based on a central bank as unaccountable as the European Central Bank – would be subject to the same rejection.

zh: 正如记者沃尔夫（Martin Wolf）最近所指出的 ， “ 要建立自己的货币肯定会让英国其他部分想起对欧元区的恐慌 ” 。
en: As the journalist Martin Wolf noted recently, “the rest of the UK has surely not escaped the horrors of the eurozone only to create similar horrors for itself at home.”

zh: 对于实现充分主权的苏格兰来说，另一种方法是继续使用英镑而放弃对利率或汇率的影响力。
en: The alternative for a fully sovereign Scotland would be to continue using the pound without retaining any influence over interest rates or the exchange rate.

zh: 这是爱尔兰自由国（Irish Free State，后来成为爱尔兰共和国）曾经用过的办法，爱尔兰自由国使用盯住英镑的“爱尔兰镑”长达数十年之久。
en: This was the path taken by the Irish Free State (later the Republic of Ireland), which used the sterling-pegged “Irish pound” (the punt) for several decades.

zh: 即使英国拒绝这一安排，也不能阻止苏格兰这样做 — — 正如欧盟只能谴责但无法阻止黑山单方面使用欧元。
en: Even if the UK disapproved of the arrangement, it could not stop Scotland from adopting it – much as the European Union deplores but cannot stop Montenegro’s unilateral use of the euro.

zh: 尽管这一决定会造成相当大的政治麻烦 — — 即立刻稀释苏格兰刚刚赢得的主权 — — 但其经济影响很难立刻看清。
en: While the decision would have a significant political downside – that is, immediately diluting Scotland’s newly acquired sovereignty – its economic implications are mixed.

zh: 借助老牌货币当局的信誉 — — 特别是发行全球储备货币的当局 — — 在策略上是后独立时代苏格兰的更优选择；但这个新国家将因此面临通胀冲击和来自英格兰银行的扩张性货币政策的英镑危机的风险。
en: Borrowing the credibility of an established monetary authority – especially one that issues a global reserve currency – would be tactically advantageous for a post-independence Scotland; but the new country would be exposed to the risk of an inflation shock and sterling crisis stemming from the Bank of England’s expansionary monetary policy.

zh: 从财政角度看，这样做也面临类似的权衡。
en: From a fiscal perspective, the case is similarly balanced.

zh: 对于像苏格兰这样的新成立的主权国家，市场免不了会要求利率溢价，通过发行英镑债券能够让这一溢价最小化，从而保护投资者免遭贬值风险。
en: The interest-rate premium that the market would inevitably demand from a young sovereign like Scotland could be minimized by issuing debt in sterling, thereby protecting investors from additional devaluation risk.

zh: 但是，由于没有自己的货币发行央行，苏格兰将放弃铸币税（央行操作给国库带来的利润 ） 。
en: But, without its own currency-issuing central bank, Scotland would forego seigniorage (profits from central-bank operations that typically benefit the national treasury).

zh: 也许更重要的是，如果爆发危机，将没有最后贷款人能够稳定银行和金融系统。
en: Perhaps more important, it would have no lender of last resort capable of stabilizing the banking and financial system in a crisis.

zh: 考虑各种因素后，独立的苏格兰的最优策略是从一开始就发行其自身的国家货币，授权苏格兰国民银行（National Bank of Scotland）根据本国经济情况设定利率。
en: All things considered, an independent Scotland would be best served by issuing its own national currency from the outset, empowering the National Bank of Scotland to set interest rates according to domestic economic conditions.

zh: 这一方针还能通过灵活的汇率安排让央行避免货币联盟所面临的的双重风险：低估（带来通胀压力）和高估（需要扭曲性的内部贬值，造成实际工资下降 ） 。
en: By allowing for exchange-rate flexibility, this approach would also enable the central bank to avoid the twin hazards that arise in a currency union: undervaluation, which produces inflationary pressure, and overvaluation, which demands wrenching internal devaluations (driving down real wages).

zh: 要想知道后一种风险有多高，可以看看欧元区。
en: To see just how difficult the latter can be, consider the eurozone.

zh: 货币联盟中的疲软经济体所经历的内部贬值痛苦让越来越多的选民和金融市场要求回归国家货币 — — 这一趋势极有可能在今年5月的欧洲议会选举中达到高潮。
en: The agony of internal devaluation in the currency union’s weaker economies is increasingly driving voters and financial markets alike to call for a return to their national currencies – a trend that may well come to a head in May’s European Parliament election.

zh: 意大利是最可能退出欧元区的国家，尽管法国也可能受到政治冲击，促使其与德国商讨停止货币联盟。
en: Italy is perhaps the prime candidate to lead an exit from the eurozone, though a political shock could also arise in France, spurring it to negotiate with Germany the dissolution of the monetary union.

zh: 但是，不管谁先离开，所有用欧元取代其国家货币的国家都将和独立的苏格兰一样需要决定正确的汇率灵活度。
en: But, regardless of who leaves first, any countries trading in the euro for their defunct national currencies would, like an independent Scotland, have to determine the right degree of exchange-rate flexibility.

zh: 比如，尽管完全浮动的货币能带来纪律和灵活的好处，但极有可能最好的做法还是推迟完全浮动，代之以可调整 （ “ 爬行 ” ） 盯住锚货币。
en: For example, while a fully floating currency would create a beneficial combination of discipline and flexibility, it might best be delayed in favor of an adjustable (“crawling”) peg to some anchor currencies.

zh: 这能为建立信誉争取时间，更重要的是，也有助于将公债限制在可控水平。
en: This would buy time to build credibility and, more important, to help keep public debt under control.

zh: 一个颇具说明性的先例是斯洛伐克，1993年伊始，它通过“天鹅绒革命”脱离捷克独立，并决定使用新的国家货币。
en: An instructive precedent is Slovakia, whose “velvet” divorce from the Czech Republic at the beginning of 1993 led to the creation of a new national currency.

zh: 一开始，斯洛伐克克朗在事先确定的范围中围绕对德国马克和美元的目标平价波动，直到1998年才变为完全浮动汇率。
en: The Slovak koruna was initially kept within pre-defined fluctuation bands around target parities with the Deutsche Mark and the US dollar, before moving to a fully floating exchange rate in 1998.

zh: 此外，斯洛伐克与该地区的大部分国家不同，实现了加入欧元区的法定义务 — — 如果独立的苏格兰如人们预料那样寻求加入欧盟，也需要满足这些义务。
en: Furthermore, Slovakia, unlike most of its regional peers, has fulfilled its legal obligation to join the eurozone – an obligation that an independent Scotland would have to take on when, as expected, it sought EU membership.

zh: 但有主权的苏格兰政府可能会商量取得豁免 — — 这样做将让它加入其他寻求走出欧洲货币联盟犯下的大错的欧洲国家的行列。
en: But a sovereign Scottish government might try to negotiate an exemption to this rule – and, in so doing, join the tide of other European countries seeking a way out of the great blunder that Europe’s monetary union has turned out to be.

zh: 让中国加入应对气候变化的行列
en: Bringing China into the Climate Change Fold

zh: 波兹南—现今的经济危机给本月在波兰举行的气候变化谈判蒙上了一层阴影。 当谈判者希望能够就达成国际气候协议取得具体进展时，世界上两个最大的污染排放国则不够专心—美国在操心防止总统换届期间发生金融体系的崩溃，中国在关注国内投资的下滑和国外对其制造产品的需求减少。
en: POZNAN – The current economic crisis cast a pall over climate change talks held this month in Poland.  While negotiators hoped for concrete progress towards an international climate agreement, the world’s two largest polluters were distracted – the US with preventing a collapse of the financial system in the midst of a presidential transition, China with a slowdown in domestic investment and weakening foreign demand for its manufactured goods.

zh: 在美国的房屋价格和退休储蓄下降而中国的失业人数上升之时，观察家们担心无论美国还是中国都不太愿意削减它们的排放。
en: With American home values and retirement savings falling and Chinese unemployment numbers rising, observers worry that neither America nor China will have much appetite to cut emissions.

zh: 这里的矛盾之处在于这场危机向中美两国展示了一个达成协议的特殊机会。 这个协议将为达成全球性的气候协议奠定基础。
en: The paradox here is that the crisis presents a unique opportunity for the United States and China to strike a deal that would lay the groundwork for a global climate agreement.

zh: 实际上，最近美中之间一年两度的战略经济对话（在气候会议开始的前一周已经举行）的主要目标之一就是开始在“十年能源和环境合作框架”下进行工作，这一框架是本年早些时候建立起来的。
en: Indeed, one of the main goals of the most recent biannual meeting of the US/China Strategic Economic Dialogue (held the week before the climate talks began) was to begin work under the “Ten Year Energy and Environment Cooperation Framework” created earlier this year.

zh: 在双边采取主动之前，有整整十年美国避免参与国际间处理气候变化的尝试，担心如果它采取了行动而中国按兵不动，世界就无法实现减排目标，美国的工业也会陷于不利之境。
en: This bilateral initiative comes on the heels of a decade in which America abstained from international efforts to address climate change, concerned that if it acts but China doesn’t, the world will fail to meet its emission-reduction targets and US industry will be disadvantaged.

zh: 中国则反击说它的历史和人均排放量都远远低于美国水平；就算把国家的总排放水平和美国拉平，旧金山的人均碳预算也比上海高出五倍。
en: China has countered that its historic and per capita emissions remain well below US levels, and that to cap aggregate national emissions at the same level as the US would imply a personal carbon budget in San Francisco five times greater than in Shanghai.

zh: 战略经济对话规避了两国在责任分担上的差异，相反，它关注二者的共同之处。
en: The Strategic Economic Dialogue sidestepped this disagreement on burden sharing and focused instead on what the two countries have in common.

zh: 两国的交通都依赖进口的石油，发电则依靠国内的煤炭。
en: Both depend on imported oil for transport and on domestic coal for power generation.

zh: 两国都拥有强力的国家政府，拥有各自为政的规章制度和能源供应系统。
en: Both have strong state-level governments and balkanized regulatory and energy supply systems.

zh: 但是两国的经济结构，以及推动能源需求的因素—于是包括温室气体的排放—却大相径庭。 正是这种差异为正面处理气候变化提供了最佳时机。
en: But the structure of the two countries’ economies, and what drives their energy needs – and thus greenhouse gas emissions – are very different.  It is this difference that offers the best chance for addressing climate change head-on.

zh: 从经济的角度来看，中美两国互为镜像，在大规模的全球失衡中处在相对立位置。
en: Economically, the US and China are mirror images, opposite sides of a massive global imbalance.

zh: 美国花费太多储蓄太少，面对其他国家的贸易赤字达到2500亿美元。
en: Americans spend too much and save too little, leaving a $250 billion trade deficit financed by other countries.

zh: 其中的大部分信贷来自中国，这里的公司和公民储蓄太多而消费太少，多余的货物和资本流往国外。
en: Much of this credit comes from China, where firms and citizens save too much and consume too little, leaving a surplus of both goods and capital that flows abroad.

zh: 宏观经济的不平衡从两国的碳排放量就可见一斑。
en: This macroeconomic imbalance is reflected in the two countries’ carbon footprints.

zh: 在美国，超过70%的二氧化碳排放来自于和消费者相关的活动，无论是耗油的SUV还是耗电的大型独栋别墅。
en: In the US, more than 70% of CO2 emissions come from consumer-related activities, whether gas-guzzling SUVs or power-hungry McMansions.

zh: 而中国的二氧化碳排放中有超过70%来自工业，光是钢铁生产就消费了国家能源资源的18 % ， 几乎是全中国所有家庭消费量的两倍。
en: In China, more than 70% of emissions come from industry. Steel production alone consumes 18% of the country’s energy resources, nearly twice as much as all Chinese households.

zh: 化工行业比所有私人交通耗费的能源还多，铝业生产在耗电量上和商业部门不相上下。
en: The chemical industry consumes more energy than all private transportation, and aluminum production rivals the commercial sector in terms of electricity demand.

zh: 从为达成气候协议进行谈判的角度来看，这种不均衡是个好消息。
en: In terms of brokering a climate deal, this imbalance is good news.

zh: 它可能促成这样一种减排体系，这一体系既尊重中国家庭的发展需求，又处理美国公司关心的竞争力事宜，同时还能坚持植根于国际谈判中的“共同但有区别的责任”的原则。
en: It suggests a framework for reducing emissions that respects the development needs of China’s households, addresses US firms’ competitiveness concerns, and adheres to the principle of “common but differentiated responsibilities” embedded in international negotiations.

zh: 意识到自身超大的历史排量和人均排量，美国应该同意就整个经济展开减排，这和和现在正在考虑的美国国内气候立法相一致。
en: In recognition of its outsized historic and per capita emissions, the US should agree to economy-wide emissions reductions in line with domestic climate legislation currently being considered.

zh: 中国应该暂时免于承担和消费者相关联的责任，但在认识到这些部门实施有效减排需要相应的国际行动后，也应该承担自身在工业生产上的责任。
en: China should be excused of consumer-related obligations for the time being, but assume commitments on industrial production based on the recognition that effectively reducing emissions in these sectors requires coordinated international action.

zh: 考虑到国家安全，空气和水的质量，以及单纯的经济效益方面的原因，中国领导人已经渴望控制高能耗高污染的工业了。
en: China’s leaders are already eager to rein in energy- and pollution-intensive industry for reasons of national security, air and water quality, and simple economic efficiency.

zh: 仅仅生产钢铁，水泥，化学制品，纸张，铝就耗费了中国能源需求的几乎一半，还制造了将近一半的空气污染。 这种污染每年夺去了超过三十万人的生命，还造成了将近一千亿美元的经济损失。
en: Production of steel, cement, chemicals, paper, and aluminum alone account for nearly half of China’s energy needs and generate nearly half of the air pollution that claims over 300,000 lives and costs the economy close to $100 billion each year.

zh: 但在中国的7.7亿劳动力大军中，这五种行业合计来也只雇用了1400万人而已，少于他们十年前的雇用人数。
en: Yet these five industries combined employ only 14 million people out of a total labor force of 770 million and fewer people than they did a decade ago.

zh: 对于一个面对用工危机的国家来说，投资高能耗产业是一种失策。
en: For a country in an employment crisis, investing in energy-intensive industry is a losing strategy.

zh: 利用气候政策来规范这些行业将有助于重新平衡经济，同时减少中国的排放量。
en: Using climate policy to discipline these industries would help rebalance the economy while taking a bite out of China’s emissions.

zh: 如果中国向其高能耗制造业征收碳价格，美国将不必在更大范围内冒更小的风险针对国际贸易机制采取同样的做法，这种机制是中美双方都依赖的。
en: If China imposes a carbon price for its energy-intensive manufacturing industries, the US won’t need to do so at its border, lowering risks to the international trading system on which both countries rely.

zh: 目前的危机已经化解了部分不均衡，这些不均衡刺激了两国能源和环境方面的提出的挑战。
en: The current crisis is already unwinding some of the imbalances that drive both countries’ energy and environment challenges.

zh: 美国的石油需求已经滑落了8 % ， 因为消费者紧缩开支；中国的电力需求则下滑了10 % ， 因为高能耗产业削减了生产。
en: US oil demand has fallen 8% as consumers tighten their belts, and electricity demand in China is down by 10% as energy-intensive industries cut production.

zh: 机智应对危机能够让这些趋势长久保持。
en: A smart response to the crisis can perpetuate these trends.

zh: 如果美国的复苏计划包括提供资金来增加房屋的御寒性能，升级电网和帮助汽车行业提高燃料效能，未来的美国消费将更加绿色，气候政策付出的代价也会变小。
en: Future US consumption will be greener, and the cost of climate policy reduced, if the US recovery package includes money to weatherize homes, upgrade the electricity grid, and help the auto industry improve fuel efficiency.

zh: 如果中国加强控制高能耗的制造业，从而解放投资资本，将其用于轻型制造业和服务业，就将伴随一种污染降低，雇工增多的增长模式从危机从解脱出来。
en: If China consolidates its energy-intensive manufacturing, thereby freeing up investment capital for lighter manufacturing and services, then it will emerge from the crisis with a growth model that pollutes less and employs more.

zh: 如果美国和中国能够在危机当中就这些事宜达成一致，它们将为明年在哥本哈根举行的气候变化谈判铺平成功之路。
en: If the US and China can find agreement on these issues in the midst of crisis, they will pave the way for success when climate negotiators meet again next year in Copenhagen.

zh: 推倒柏林墙
en: Bringing Down the Wall

zh: 给历史发烧友们出道题。
en: A quiz for history buffs.

zh: 20年前的1989年6月4日，有三件大事书写了那一年的历史。
en: Twenty years ago – on June 4, 1989 – three events shaped a fateful year.

zh: 你对其中哪一件印象最深刻，又是哪一件最显著地改变了世界？
en: Which do you remember most vividly, and which most changed the world?

zh: a) 天安门广场抗议活动的血腥结局。
en: a) The bloody denouement of the protests on Tiananmen Square.

zh: b) 伊朗革命教士阿亚图拉·鲁霍拉·霍梅尼去世。
en: b) The death of Iran’s revolutionary cleric, Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini.

zh: c) 波兰选举。
en: c) The Polish elections.

zh: 相信很少有人会选择c ) 。
en: Few would answer c).

zh: 波兰著名的团结工会在1946年以后东欧举行的首次自由选举中获胜相比于北京的暴力镇压和霍梅尼的动荡逝世显得有些相形见绌。
en: The victory of the famed opposition trade-union movement, Solidarity, in Eastern Europe’s first free election since 1946 was eclipsed by the violent crackdown in Beijing and Khomeini’s tumultuous passing.

zh: 但在欧洲共产党垮台的过程中没有哪件事起了更大的作用，因此团结工会胜选也重新塑造了二战以后的国际秩序。
en: Yet no single event did more to bring down communism in Europe – and thus to re-shape the post-war international order.

zh: 今后几个月会举办各式各样纪念共产主义灭亡，特别是1989年11月柏林墙倒塌的活动。
en: The next few months will bring all sorts of commemorations of communism’s end, particularly of the fall of the Berlin Wall in November 1989.

zh: 很多人把这看作一个光荣的时刻，标志着西方在冷战中获胜，而这次胜利似乎在人们意料之外突然降临。
en: To many, it was a glorious moment, emblematic of the West’s victory in the Cold War, and one that seemed to come out of the blue.

zh: 可是如果你从头至尾观看了东方集团的解体，你就会知道这个过程远比人们所意识到的更加长期和复杂。
en: But if you watched the Eastern Bloc’s disintegration from the ground, you would know that the process was far longer and more complex than most people realize.

zh: 波兰选举根本没有退路，在那一刻我们拥有了不可逆转的变革力量。
en: The Polish election was a point of no return, the moment when forces for change became irreversible.

zh: 整整一夏天的罢工为变革积蓄了力量，当时的波兰共产党领袖沃依切赫·雅鲁泽尔斯基将军认定国家的经济困难无法由共产党独自承当。
en: They gathered momentum after a summer of labor strikes, when Poland’s communist chief, General Wojciech Jaruzelski, concluded that the country’s economic troubles were too grim to face alone.

zh: 他想当然地认为为什么不能让波兰的反对党伸出援手，这样即使不能解决问题，至少也可以帮他们分担一些指责？
en: Why not enlist the help of Poland’s opposition, he reasoned, if not to solve the problems, then at least to share the blame for them?

zh: 因此，一项历史性的协议在6个月的谈判之后达成。
en: And so, after six months of bargaining, a historic deal was struck.

zh: 波兰将举行自由公正的议会选举，而团结工会将参与竞争。
en: Poland would hold free and fair parliamentary elections, and Solidarity would compete.

zh: 执政的共产党人做梦也没有想到过他们会输（这一点团结工会同样没有想到 ） 。
en: It never occurred to the ruling communists (or to Solidarity) that they might lose.

zh: 共产党人做梦也没有想到会彻底丧失执政地位。
en: Never in their wildest dreams did they imagine being driven from power altogether.

zh: 但事实就这样发生了。
en: Yet that is what happened.

zh: 现在回想起来，哪怕存在任何一点点的疑虑都是令人吃惊的。
en: In retrospect, it is astonishing that there should have been any doubt.

zh: 团结工会在竞选中无所不用其极。
en: Solidarity’s campaign was all chutzpah.

zh: 一张标志性的竞选海报抓住了公众的视线：海报上印着经典西部片《正午》中背着枪的治安官加里·库柏的照片。
en: An iconic campaign poster captured the public mood: a picture of a gun-slinging Gary Cooper as the sheriff in the classic western High Noon .

zh: 6月4日是东方道奇城的最后审判日。
en: June 4 was the day of reckoning in Dodge City East.

zh: 在那个春末夏初晴朗的周日上午，选民们毫不犹豫地把波兰共产党赶进了屠宰场。
en: On that bright Sunday morning, as spring turned to summer, voters wasted little time in dispatching Poland’s communists to the abattoir.

zh: 垂死时，波兰共产党干了最后一件怪事，他们最后一次在不知不觉中进行了彻底的自我羞辱。
en: On their dying day, Poland’s communists managed one last perversity, a final and unwitting act of utter self-humiliation.

zh: 在他们设计的选举制度中选民不直接给选中的候选人投票，而是划掉那些未被选中者 — — 也就是每一个共产党员。
en: They devised an electoral system whereby Poles would not vote for candidates of their choice, but would cross out those they did not want – which is to say, each and every communist.

zh: 无论走到哪里，都能看到人们勾掉独裁者。
en: Everywhere you looked, people were excising hated autocrats.

zh: 期盼已久的波兰人民起义终于到来了。 这是对1980年12月雅鲁泽尔斯基宣布戒严令、取缔团结工会并将其领导人投入监狱的报复。
en: Here, at long last, was Poland’s long-awaited popular uprising, revenge for December 1980, when Jaruzelski declared martial law, banned Solidarity, and threw its leaders in jail.

zh: 抹杀的革命！
en: Revolution by deletion!

zh: 最终人们手中的笔比枪更有力量，因为人们能够优雅地挥舞着这件武器进行光荣的报复。
en: The pen, at last mightier than the sword, became a weapon of glorious retribution, wielded with style.

zh: 有些选民在选票上大胆勾掉共产党人的名字，用夸张的勾画动作推翻了原来的政府。
en: Some voters slashed their ballots boldly, decapitating the old regime with flourishing strokes.

zh: 还有人尽情享受这样的时刻，也许在勾掉共产党候选人名字时洋洋自得地吞云吐雾。
en: Others savored the moment, perhaps puffing a cigarette as they reveled in this or that deletion.

zh: “是他把我的亲人投入了监狱。
en: “Oh yes, he jailed my cousin.” Pfft!

zh: ” “ 那个揩油的共产党当官的，在我们贫困潦倒的时候却过着奢侈的生活。
en: “Oh, that sponging apparatchik, living high on our penury.” Pfft!
Pfft!

zh: 反之，共产党的竞选努力几乎让人觉察不到。
en: By contrast, the communists’ campaign was all but invisible.

zh: 在整个华沙，只有寥寥几个政府候选人费力制作了海报。
en: In all of Warsaw, only a couple government candidates bothered to put up posters.

zh: 多数人指望党对媒体的垄断来宣传他们的思想，比如 ： “ 请给优秀共产党员莱斯泽克投票。 ”
en: Most counted on the party’s media monopoly to carry their message, such as it was: “Vote Lezek, a good communist.”

zh: 共产党政权以非凡的风度接受了不可避免的失败，这一点非常值得赞扬。
en: To their credit, the regime accepted its inevitable loss with remarkable grace.

zh: 投票结束后当天下午3点，雅鲁泽尔斯基召集了党内高层会议。
en: At three p.m. on the day after the vote, Jaruzelski summoned top party officials.

zh: “我们遭到了完败 ， ” 他说。
en: “Our defeat is total,” he told them.

zh: “必须找到政治解决的办法。
en: “A political solution will have to be found.”

zh: ”他这么说不是要使用暴力，也不是要窜改计票结果。
en: By that, he meant no violence and no doctoring the ballot count.

zh: 接受现实是共产党人唯一的选择。
en: The communists would have to live with the result.

zh: 20年后的今天，我仍然感到迷惑。
en: Twenty years later, I remain mystified.

zh: 我们这些报导东欧问题的记者知道团结工会必将获胜。
en: Those of us covering Eastern Europe knew that Solidarity would win.

zh: 我们也知道这次和平的胜利将为集团内部其他国家所仿效。
en: We knew, too, that its peaceful victory would be a lesson for the rest of the bloc.

zh: 对于各地反共势力来说，波兰的选举结果尤其令人鼓舞。
en: For anti-communists everywhere, the Polish election was extraordinarily encouraging.

zh: 多亏有了波兰的榜样，仅仅在几天前似乎还不可能的事突然之间变得可能了。
en: Thanks to Poland, what only days before had seemed impossible was, suddenly, possible.

zh: 此外还有其他的迹象。
en: There were other signs.

zh: 五月，匈牙利改革者开始拆掉奥匈边境上的围墙 — — 铁幕终于被挖开了一个洞。
en: In May, Hungarian reformers began tearing down the fence along their border with Austria – a hole in the Iron Curtain.

zh: 在莫斯科，米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫提出建立共同的欧洲议会，不承认干涉主义者勃列日涅夫的教条。
en: In Moscow, Mikhail Gorbachev spoke of a “Common European House” and repudiated the interventionist Brezhnev Doctrine.

zh: 但当柏林墙倒塌的时候，专家和世界领袖们却异口同声。
en: Yet when the Wall tumbled down, experts and world leaders alike were unanimous.

zh: 他们承认“我们从来没有想到 ” 。
en: “We never saw it coming,” they confessed.

zh: 冷战持续的时间如此之长，以致于在自由真正破茧而出前变革似乎超出人们的想象。
en: The Cold War had lasted so long that change seemed unimaginable until freedom burst forth.

zh: 卷起铺盖回家
en: Bringing It All Back Home

zh: 巴黎—2008年爆发金融危机后，每隔一段时间，全球决策者就会拍手相庆，认为避免了20世纪30年代的政策失误。
en: PARIS – Global policymakers regularly congratulate themselves on having avoided the policy errors of the 1930’s during the financial crisis that began in 2008.

zh: 在大萧条经济史专家、美联储主席伯南克的领导下，他们牢记凯恩斯思想，放松货币和财政政策以避免最坏情形发生。
en: Led by US Federal Reserve Board Chairman Ben Bernanke, an economic historian of the Great Depression, they remembered the ideas of John Maynard Keynes and loosened monetary and fiscal policy to avoid the worst.

zh: 我们至今仍在收拾预算烂摊子，特别是在欧洲。 但是，2008年确实没有成为世界末日。
en: We are still coping with the budgetary consequences, especially in Europe, but it is true that the world did not end in 2008.

zh: 货币紧缩并非20世纪30年代唯一的重大政策失误；除此之外还有保护主义复燃 — — 以30年代伊始实行的斯穆特-霍利（Smoot-Hawley）关税法案为典型代表。
en: Monetary tightening was not the only major policy error of the 1930’s; so was a retreat into protectionism, symbolized by the Smoot-Hawley tariff increases at the beginning of that decade.

zh: 经济史家仍然在为斯穆特-霍利法案本身的集中性争辩不休，但随之而来的关税战破坏了贸易和经济增长，让形势雪上加霜。
en: Historians continue to debate the centrality of the Smoot-Hawley law itself, but the subsequent tariff war certainly damaged trade and economic growth, making a bad situation worse.

zh: 如今，政客们还喜欢说，他们避免了保护主义错误，但果真是这样吗？
en: Today’s statesmen like to say that they have avoided the protectionist error as well, but is that true?

zh: 毫无疑问，我认为短期内绝不会发生关税战，但放眼未来，可以看到不少危险的贸易信号。
en: Certainly I do not expect a tariff war to break out in the near term, but there are dangerous indicators of trade trouble ahead.

zh: 全球自由贸易谈判多哈回合已经告废，世界贸易组织现在还在寄希望于日内瓦会议，但心怀惴惴焉。
en: The Doha round of global free-trade talks has been abandoned, and the World Trade Organization is now languishing by the lake in Geneva, uncertain of its future.

zh: 也许多哈回合照目前的形势看不可能获得什么成果，但如果没有后续世界贸易对话跟上 — — 至少也得有个可用的安全阀 — — 则将出现新的风险。
en: Perhaps Doha was unlikely to achieve much in the current circumstances, but the absence of any continuing dialogue on world trade – at worst, a useful safety valve – adds a new level of risk.

zh: 人们口头上还在谈判，但要指望能有多大实际动作已经不太现实。
en: While people are talking, they are less likely to act precipitately.

zh: 在金融方面，越来越多的迹象表明，各国各自为政实施监管和货币政策的时代要卷土重来了。
en: In the financial arena, there are many signs of a revival of nationalistic approaches to regulation and currency policy.

zh: 危机挑战了华盛顿共识 — — 世界正在逐步走向资本自由流动和市场决定的汇率。
en: The crisis challenged the Washington Consensus, which assumed that the world was moving gradually towards free movement of capital and market-determined exchange rates.

zh: 不少国家 — — 包括巴西、韩国和土耳其 — — 已经实施了多种资本管制。
en: Several countries – including Brazil, South Korea, and Turkey – have now imposed capital controls of various kinds.

zh: 就连华盛顿共识的长期实践者IMF也承认 ， “ 在某些情况下，资本管制是合理的资本流管理工具之一 ” 。
en: Even the International Monetary Fund, long the embodiment of the Washington Consensus, has acknowledged that “capital controls are a legitimate part of the toolkit to manage capital flows in certain circumstances.”

zh: 美国国会认定中国是货币操纵国的典型例子，但瑞士也对瑞郎的波动上限有着严格控制。
en: American Congressmen view the Chinese as archetypal currency manipulators, but the Swiss have introduced a firm cap on the franc’s appreciation.

zh: 金融市场的这些反全球化早期迹象也可以在商业银行中找到，这群全球最大的金融机构中已有一些开始迅速收缩。
en: These early signs of deglobalization of financial markets have their parallels in commercial banking, with some of the biggest global institutions retrenching rapidly.

zh: 花旗银行和汇丰银行一直是全球化急先锋；事实上，如今，只要你坐飞机，就一定会看到后者“全世界的本地银行”的广告语。
en: Citibank and HSBC had gone further than most in developing a global footprint; indeed, one can hardly get on a plane nowadays without being reminded that the latter is “the world’s local bank.”

zh: 但这两家银行正在关掉多个国家的业务。
en: But both are closing down in many countries.

zh: 与此类似，许多其他欧洲银行也在大力削减海外业务。
en: Likewise, many other European banks are cutting back their overseas business sharply.

zh: 贸易金融首当其冲 — — 在这方面，欧洲银行一直是亚洲业务的主要参与者。
en: The impact is particularly vivid in trade finance, where European banks have been major participants in Asia.

zh: 如今它们正在快速从亚洲市场撤出，导致亚洲银行疲于奔命，寻找填补它们留下的要命空白的办法。
en: Now they are in rapid retreat from that market, creating a worrying gap that Asian banks are seeking to fill.

zh: 到这里还不算完。
en: There is more to come.

zh: 急于筹集新资本的欧洲银行和保险公司可能将被迫出售海外资产。
en: As they struggle to raise new capital, European banks and insurers are likely to be forced to sell overseas assets.

zh: 如果这仅仅表明欧洲银行转向更专注的可靠长期战略的新动向，那么倒是可以被视为良性发展。
en: If this were simply a sign of a new, tighter focus on viable long-term strategies, it might be regarded it as a benign development.

zh: 但有迹象表明，之所以如此是受监管变化推动，其中不乏监管保护主义。
en: But there are indications that the process is being driven by regulatory change, and in some cases by regulatory protectionism.

zh: 银行要受到注册地“母国”监管者的监督，也要受到一系列业务所在地“东道国”监管者的监督。
en: Banks are overseen by a “home” regulator in their country of incorporation, and by a series of “host” regulators where they operate.

zh: “母国”监管者和最后贷款人越来越担心它们海外业务的潜在风险损失敞口。
en: “Home” regulators and lenders of last resort are increasingly worried about their potential exposure to losses in banks’ overseas operations.

zh: 英格兰银行行长默文·金犀利地指出 ， “ 银行生在全球，死在祖国。
en: As Mervyn King, the Governor of the Bank of England, acutely observed, “banks are global in life, but national in death.”

zh: ”换句话说，一旦出了篓子，还要靠母国当局去收拾残局。
en: In other words, home authorities are left to pick up the tab when things go wrong.

zh: 东道国监管者则对那些通过母公司分支在其辖区内开展业务，但没有本地资本或本地董事会的银行越来越忌惮。
en: Host regulators are increasingly nervous about banks that operate in their jurisdictions through branches of their corporate parent, without local capital or a local board of directors.

zh: 因此它们坚持要求子公司化。
en: So they are insisting on subsidiarization.

zh: 从银行的角度来说，这意味着资本会被困在子公司，而无法在整个网络实现最优配置。
en: From the banks’ perspective, that means that capital is trapped in subsidiaries, and cannot be optimally used across its network.

zh: 因此银行可能宁可选择退出。
en: So banks may prefer to pull out instead.

zh: 欧盟就在上演��个桥段。
en: A particular version of this phenomenon is at work in the European Union.

zh: 作为单一市场，银行可以随处吸收存款而不需要获得地方批准，只要它们获得了其中一个欧洲国家的授权。
en: In the single financial market, banks are allowed to take deposits anywhere, without local approval, if they are authorized to do so in one European country.

zh: 但在冰岛银行纷纷倒闭后，英国和荷兰当局不得不出手拯救本地存款人。
en: Yet when the Icelandic banks failed, the British and Dutch authorities had to bail out local depositors.

zh: 如今，监管者已开始抑制此类跨国业务，这导致了一个难听的新名词 — — “去欧元化 ” 。
en: Now regulators are discouraging such cross-border business, leading to a process with the ugly new name of “de-euroization.”

zh: 我们只能寄希望于这不会成为一种时尚。
en: We can only hope that it does not catch on.

zh: 监管者已经意识到金融反全球化之势加速的风险，开始寻找更好的应对全球银行巨头倒闭的良策。
en: Regulators, recognizing the risks of allowing financial deglobalization to accelerate, have been seeking better means of handling the failure of huge global banks.

zh: 如果银行在出问题时可以轻松解决，损失可以公平地分担，那么监管者可以更爽快地允许它们继续在全球开展高效经营。
en: If banks can be wound up easily when things go wrong, with losses equitably distributed, regulators can more easily allow them to continue to operate globally and efficiently.

zh: 因此，建立跨国解决方案框架的重大努力正在进行中。
en: So a major effort to construct a cross-border resolution framework is under way.

zh: 但这项工作相当繁重，美联储官员塔鲁罗（Daniel Tarullo）承认 ， “ 清晰完整的解决方案还没有成型。 ”
en: But it is uphill work, and Daniel Tarullo, a governor of the Federal Reserve, has acknowledged that “a clean and comprehensive solution is not in sight.”

zh: 所有这些都会成为全球化好处的严重威胁吗？
en: Does all of this amount to a serious threat to the benefits of globalization?

zh: 谨慎的回答是现在还不好说。
en: The cautious answer would be that it is too early to say.

zh: 也许我们所看到的仅仅是卫兵交接仪式，花旗银行和汇丰银行的全球地位由中国工商银行、巴西伊塔乌联合银行（Itau Unibanco ） 、 俄罗斯联邦储蓄银行（Sberbank）取而代之。
en: Perhaps we are just seeing the beginnings of a changing of the guard, and that HSBC and Citibank will be replaced as global players by China’s ICBC, Brazil’s Itau Unibanco, or Russia’s Sberbank.

zh: 但也许我们正在目睹激进凯恩斯主义卷土重来 ： “ 思想、知识、科学 … … 理应天然是国际的。
en: But it may be that we are seeing a revival of a less benign Keynesian doctrine: “ideas, knowledge, science....should of their nature be international.

zh: 但商品应该本地的，存在于合理和便利的地方，而金融，那应该是国家的。 ”
en: But let goods be homespun wherever it is reasonably and conveniently possible and, above all, let finance be national.”

zh: 将英国带到欧洲的核心之中
en: Bringing the UK to Europe’s Core

zh: 布鲁塞尔—目前欧盟的核心国家，除最初的6个创始国外，是组成欧洲货币联盟的15个国家。
en: BRUSSELS – The European Union’s core countries these days, besides the original six founders, are the 15 member states that make up the European Monetary Union.

zh: 这些国家具有趋同的经济体系和共同的货币及财政政策。
en: They have converging economies and coordinated monetary and fiscal policies.

zh: 最大的外围国家是英国。
en: The big outsider is the United Kingdom.

zh: 仍然有许多人希望英国加入欧洲经济货币联盟。
en: British EMU membership remains very desirable.

zh: 如果欧盟想要突破共同的经济和货币政策的界限，在发展安全防卫政策的同时发展共同的外交政策，英国必须参与。
en: If the EU is to progress beyond the limits of a common economic and monetary policy and develop a defense and security policy along with a common foreign policy, the UK must be on board.

zh: 英镑和欧元之间的汇率波动扰乱了欧盟成员国之间的市场力量，有时候甚至在伦敦造成了负面冲击。
en: Exchange-rate fluctuations between sterling and the euro disturb market forces among member states, and at times even have a negative impact in London.

zh: 从长期来看，如果欧元区开始施加更大的影响力，英国就冒着严重的被孤立的风险。
en: In the long run, the UK risks serious isolation if the euro zone starts to exert even greater power.

zh: 但是，鉴于伦敦作为国际金融中心的重要地位以及英国和50多个英联邦国家的特殊关系，其它欧洲国家也应该理解英国要求其拥有自己的货币的观点。
en: But other European countries must also understand British arguments in favor of the UK maintaining its own currency, given London’s importance as an international financial center as well as its privileged relations with more than 50 Commonwealth countries.

zh: 因此，欧元区应该为英国提供一个体面的折衷方案，允许英国成为欧洲经济货币联盟的完全成员，加入其所有的机构 — — 例如欧洲中央银行以及部长级的欧元集团，同时在英国和第三国家关系中可以继续使用英镑。
en: The euro zone should therefore offer the UK an honorable compromise in which Britain would be allowed to become a full member of the EMU and take a seat in all of its institutions like the European Central Bank and the ministerial Eurogroup, while also being able to keep the pound in its relations with third countries.

zh: 但是，欧元应该和英镑一起被作为英国以及英联邦国家的法定货币，这需要英格兰银行和欧洲中央银行间的紧密合作。
en: The euro would, however, have to be accepted as legal tender in the UK, alongside the pound, and in the commonwealth countries, and this would demand close cooperation between the Bank of England and the ECB.

zh: 这样的折衷方案可以增加欧洲经济货币联盟在欧洲以及欧洲以外地区的影响力。
en: Such a compromise would increase the EMU’s weight both inside and outside Europe.

zh: 建立在这样一个核心周围的欧洲符合我所说的“土星模式 ” ， 在这个模式中，在中间是一个巨大的行星，周围被环形环绕着，它们迟早会合而为一。
en: A Europe built around such a core corresponds to what I call a “Saturn model,” with a huge planet in the middle, surrounded by rings, converging sooner or later in the center.

zh: 在模式的外围的是过渡时期的国家，与此同时，围绕在中心周围的环形是仍然拒绝加入欧洲经济货币联盟的欧盟国家，或者是像罗马尼亚和保加利亚这样尚未满足所有条件的国家，或者是最终的西巴尔干半岛国家和土耳其。
en: The outer circles are the transition countries, while the rings around the center would be EU countries that still refuse to join the EMU, or do not yet fulfill all the conditions, like Romania and Bulgaria, or eventually the western Balkan countries and Turkey.

zh: 土星模式将当前关于欧盟扩大和欧洲边界的激烈争论置于一个完全不同的背景，因为核心国家将发现它们不再被要求接受一个被分裂成为不同类别的成员国的欧洲。
en: The Saturn model puts the present fierce debate on enlargement and the borders of Europe into a totally different context, because the core countries would no longer find themselves being asked to accept a Europe divided into different classes of member states.

zh: 处于围绕着核心国家周围的环形上的欧盟国家是暂时的，其目的是推进完全的融合。
en: The positioning of EU countries on the rings around the core would be transitory, with the aim being to facilitate overall convergence.

zh: 鉴于全球化以及诸如中国和印度这样的国家潜在的竞争导致的直接的挑战，欧洲经济需要变得更有创新精神。
en: Given the impact of globalization and the direct challenge to the EU implied by competition from countries like China and India, the European economy needs to become more innovative.

zh: 如果欧盟官方能够协调遍及欧洲的经济和社会改革政策，这些政策会变得更有力，并且，欧盟的扩大以及几乎拥有5亿消费者的内部市场的进一步发展，可以强有力地刺激经济行为。
en: Economic and social reform policies throughout Europe would be strengthened if the EU authorities were able to coordinate them, and EU enlargement, together with the further development of its internal market of almost half a billion consumers, could powerfully stimulate economic activity.

zh: 20世纪80年代西班牙和葡萄牙的加入就是一个生动的例子，它也是对土耳其这样一个人口众多的国家加入欧盟这个问题应该考虑观点。
en: The accession of Spain and Portugal was a vivid example of that in the 1980’s, and it is an argument that should be considered with respect to such a populous country as Turkey.

zh: 现在，欧洲逐渐一体化已经50年了，我们有理由期望进一步的洲际合作和一体化，尤其是因为科学和技术发展的影响。
en: Europe has been unifying gradually for 50 years now, and we can reasonably look forward to further inter-continental cooperation and integration, not least because of scientific and technological developments.

zh: 同时，我们可以期待一个成长中的大西洋共同体，因为后续的贸易自由化谈判使在欧盟和美国之间发展一个自由贸易区更加容易。
en: At the same time, we can expect a growing Atlantic community as successive rounds of trade liberalization make it easier to develop a free-trade area between the EU and the United States.

zh: 欧洲自己的经验告诉我们，关税联盟必须是发展自由贸易区的第一步，然后，关税联盟带来的更紧密的经济合作迟早会迫使其成员建立具有统一的内部市场一切特征的经济共同体。
en: Europe’s own experience has taught us that a customs union must be the first step, and that sooner or later the more intense economic cooperation that a customs union imposes will compel its members to establish an economic community that has all the characteristics of a unified internal market.

zh: 但是，当然，这只有在其成员国之间的汇率波动被消除以后才能顺利运行。
en: But, of course, this can only function smoothly if exchange-rate fluctuations between its members’ currencies have been eliminated.

zh: 虽然大西洋货币联盟（美国和欧盟之间的联盟）是一个长期以来的期望，然而，它仅可以作为一个未来的宏大蓝图来考虑。
en: Although an Atlantic Monetary Union (between the US and the EU) is a long-term prospect, it should be considered as a grand design for the future.

zh: 现在，欧洲的领导人和他们的选民可以在过去的欧洲和未来的欧洲之间进行选择。
en: Europe’s leaders and their voting publics now have a choice between the Europe of the past and of the future.

zh: 过去的欧洲以舒曼计划开始，它为现在的欧盟播下了种子，并在冷战结束的时候结束。
en: The Europe of the past began with the Schuman Plan, which sowed the seeds of today’s EU, and concluded when the Cold War ended.

zh: 这是一个建立在推进战后的德国和法国和解，建立一个和平的欧洲以及苏联扩张的威胁上的一体化时代。
en: It was an era of integration based on the heroic drive to reconcile post-war Germany and France and establish a Pax Europea , as well as the threatened expansion of the Soviet Union.

zh: 但是，在共产主义垮台之后，欧洲的情形多多少少发生了一些逆转：对边界的防卫划分被在整个大陆消除国境所取代。
en: But after the implosion of communism, the situation in Europe was more or less reversed: the defensive demarcation of borders has been replaced by the removal of frontiers across the Continent.

zh: 但是，虽然戴高乐将军曾经提到将欧洲从大西洋扩大到乌拉尔，然而，仅仅用地理概念定义欧洲漏掉了“属于”欧洲的含义的其它标准 — — 包括欧洲的社会模式以及其建立的价值标准。
en: However, while General de Gaulle once spoke of a Europe stretching from the Atlantic to the Urals, defining Europe in purely geographical terms omits other criteria – including the European social model and the scale of values on which it is based – of what it means to “belong” to Europe.

zh: 相反，在21世纪，欧洲的使命应该是成为逐步的洲际融合和统一的杠杆。
en: Instead, the vocation of Europe in the course of the twenty-first century should be to become the lever of step-by-step inter-continental convergence and unification.

zh: 为此目的，欧洲必须进行彻底改造，而扩大欧洲经济货币联盟的范围是一个正确的开端。
en: Europe must be reinvented for this purpose, and broadening the EMU’s reach is the right place to start.

zh: 英国：没有痛苦就没有收获？
en: No Pain, No Gain for Britain?

zh: 伦敦—经济史学家尼尔·弗格森（Niall Ferguson）让我想起已故的牛津历史学家泰勒（A.J.P. Taylor ） 。
en: LONDON – The economic historian Niall Ferguson reminds me of the late Oxford historian A.J.P. Taylor.

zh: 尽管泰勒在其历史写作中坚持试图述说真相，但他随时准备出于好意采取春秋笔法。
en: Though Taylor maintained that he tried to tell the truth in his historical writing, he was quite ready to spin the facts for a good cause.

zh: 弗格森也是了不起的历史学家 — — 但在进入政治领域时有些狂妄。
en: Ferguson, too, is a wonderful historian – but equally ready to spin when he shifts into political gear.

zh: 弗格森笃信美国新保守主义，同时他顽固地排斥凯恩斯和凯恩斯主义。
en: Ferguson’s cause is American neo-conservatism, coupled with a relentless aversion to Keynes and Keynesians.

zh: 最近，英国大选刚刚落下帷幕，他又开始为财政紧缩辩护，在为《金融时报》撰写的文章中，他说 ， “ 工党应该把失败归咎于凯恩斯。 ”
en: His latest defense of fiscal austerity came immediately after the United Kingdom’s recent election, when he wrote in the Financial Times that, “Labour should blame Keynes for their defeat.”

zh: 弗格森的观点就像是残酷不仁的严格执行者，认为受害者还活着就说明他的方法是可行的。
en: Ferguson’s argument amounts to that of a brutal disciplinarian who claims vindication for his methods by pointing out that the victim is still alive.

zh: 他为英国财政大臣乔治·奥斯本（George Osborne）辩护，说英国经济去年增长了2.6 % （ 是“G-7经济体中表现组好的 ” ） ，但对奥斯本给经济复苏过程中造成的伤害只字不提。
en: In pleading on behalf of British Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne, he points out that the UK economy grew by 2.6% last year (the “best performing of the G-7 economies”), but ignores the damage that Osborne inflicted on the economy en route to this recovery.

zh: 如今，对于这一伤害已经达成了相当大的共识。
en: There is now much agreement about this damage.

zh: 由奥斯本设立、评估政府宏观经济表现的独立机构预算责任办公室（Office of Budget Responsibility）刚刚估算，从2010年到2012年，紧缩导致GDP增长下降2 % ， 2010年以来的累计损失相当于GDP的5 % 。
en: The Office of Budget Responsibility, the independent agency set up by Osborne to assess the government’s macroeconomic performance, has just concluded that austerity reduced GDP growth by 2% from 2010 to 2012, bringing the cumulative cost of austerity since 2010 to 5% of GDP.

zh: 牛津大学的西蒙·任-刘易斯（Simon Wren-Lewis）估算该损失可能高达GDP的15 % 。
en: Simon Wren-Lewis of Oxford University estimates that the damage might be as high as 15% of GDP.

zh: 在宏观经济学中心（Centre for Macroeconomics）的最新英国经济学家意见调查中，三分之二的受访者同意紧缩伤害了英国经济。
en: In a recent poll of British economists by the Centre for Macroeconomics, two-thirds agreed that austerity had harmed the UK economy.

zh: 而且英国不是“一个人”在战斗。
en: Moreover, Britain is not alone.

zh: 在2012年10月的《世界经济展望 》 （ World Economic Outlook）中，IMF承认“财政乘数被全世界所低估。
en: In its October 2012 World Economic Outlook, the IMF admitted that, “fiscal multipliers were underestimated across the world.”

zh: ”用大白话说就是：预测者低估了闲置产能的程度，因此也低估了财政扩张可能带来的产出增长。
en: In plain English: the forecasters underestimated the extent of spare capacity and hence the scope for fiscal expansion to raise output.

zh: 这是无心之失吗？
en: Was it an honest mistake?

zh: 或者，这是因为预测者被暗示经济处于充分就业状态、财政扩张的唯一结果只能是通货膨胀的经济模型所迷惑了吗？
en: Or was it because the forecasters were in thrall to economic models that implied that economies were at full employment, in which case the only result of fiscal expansion would be inflation?

zh: 现在，他们已经有了更好的了解，弗格森现在也应该有了更好的了解。
en: They now know better, and Ferguson should now know better as well.

zh: 弗格森的狂妄有一个令人沮丧的方面，那就是他根本没有意识到大萧条对政府表现和商业预期的影响。
en: A depressing aspect of Ferguson’s interpretation is his failure to acknowledge the impact of the Great Recession on government performance and business expectations.

zh: 因此，他将2014年2.6%的增长率与2009年4.3%的衰退相比较。 他称2009年时“工党政府的最后一个整年 ” — —好像工党的政策导致了增长崩溃似的。
en: Thus, he compares 2.6% growth in 2014 with the 4.3% contraction in 2009, which he describes as “the last full year of Labour government” – as though Labour policy produced the collapse in growth.

zh: 类似地 ， “ 自2010年5月以后 ， [ 信心]从未跌回戈登·布朗灾难般的首相生涯的最后两年的低位 ” — —好像是布朗政府的表现导致商业信心崩溃似的。
en: Similarly, “At no point after May 2010 did [confidence] sink back to where it had been throughout the last two years of Gordon Brown’s catastrophic premiership” – as though the Brown government’s performance caused business confidence to collapse.

zh: 把工党选举失利“归咎凯恩斯”的说法尤其怪异。
en: The claim that “Keynes is to blame” for Labour’s election defeat is peculiarly odd.

zh: 毕竟，工党领导层在选战中用力最多之处乃是将工党与一切凯恩斯主义“毒药”划清界限。
en: After all, the one thing Labour’s leadership tried hardest to do in the campaign was to distance the party from any “taint” of Keynesianism.

zh: 也许弗格森的意思是工党与凯恩斯结盟的过去让他们付出了代价 — — 用他的话说，就是“他们在金融危机之前和之中的灾难性治国之道。 ”
en: Perhaps Ferguson meant that it was Labour’s past association with Keynes that had damned them – “their disastrous stewardship before and during the financial crisis,” as he puts it.

zh: 事实上，工党最新几届政府绝非凯恩斯主义者；货币政策的目标一��是2%的通胀，财政政策的目标一直是平衡整个商业周期的预算 — — 在衰退开始前，这是标准的宏观经济方针。
en: In fact, Labour’s most recent governments were determinedly non-Keynesian; monetary policy was geared to hitting a 2% inflation target, and fiscal policy aimed at balancing the budget over the business cycle: standard macro-economic fare before the recession struck.

zh: 对他们的治国之道的最严厉的指责是他们认为金融市场最好自我监管 — — 而这正是凯恩斯反对的。
en: The most damning charge against their stewardship is that they embraced the idea that financial markets are optimally self-regulating – a view that Keynes rejected.

zh: 凯恩斯不是工党失败的原因；从很大程度上说，苏格兰才是。
en: Keynes was not to blame for Labour’s defeat; in large part, Scotland was.

zh: 苏格兰民族党（Scottish National Party）的大获全胜导致工党在该地区只获得一席。
en: The Scottish National Party’s crushing victory left Labour with only one seat in the country.

zh: 毫无疑问，苏格兰民族党之所以大获全胜，原因有很多，但支持紧缩绝不在此列。
en: There are no doubt many reasons for the SNP’s overwhelming triumph, but support for austerity is not one of them.

zh: （保守党和工党做的一样糟糕。 ）
en: (The Conservatives did as badly as Labour.)

zh: 苏格兰第一大臣、苏格兰民族党领袖尼古拉·斯特金（Nicola Sturgeon）抨击威斯敏斯特围绕财政整合计划的“愉快共识 ” 。
en: Nicola Sturgeon, First Minister of Scotland and leader of the SNP, attacked the “cozy consensus” around fiscal consolidation in Westminster.

zh: 她正确地指出，赤字是“经济困难的表征，而不仅是经济困难的原因。
en: The deficit, she rightly said, was “a symptom of economic difficulties, not just the cause of them.”

zh: ”苏格兰民族党的竞选口号承诺“至少在全英国增加1,400亿英镑投资于技能和基础设施。 ”
en: The SNP manifesto promised “at least an additional £140 billion ($220 billion) across the UK to invest in skills and infrastructure.”

zh: 因此，如果苏格兰民族党依靠“凯恩斯主义”财政扩张计划取得如此出色的成绩，那么，认为工党若更有力地为其自身执政记录辩护、更积极地攻讦奥斯本的财政政策就会收到更好的效果岂非有理？
en: This is what leaders of the Labour party like Alistair Darling, Gordon Brown’s Chancellor of the Exchequer, are now saying. But they seem to have had no influence on the two architects of Labour’s election strategy, Ed Miliband and Ed Balls, both now removed from front-line politics.

zh: 保守党的成功做成并且做得相当聪明的是说服英格兰人民他们只是在“收拾工党的烂摊子 ” ， 并且，要不是紧缩，英国将“是另一个希腊 ” — —而这正是弗格森的观点。
en: What the Conservatives did succeed in doing, and doing brilliantly, was to persuade English people that they were only “cleaning up Labour’s mess,” and that, but for austerity, Britain would have “gone the way of Greece” – exactly Ferguson’s view.

zh: 你也许会认为，所有这些都是历史：选民已经发话。
en: One might conclude that all of this is history: the voters have spoken.

zh: 但接受保守党的说辞为定音是一个错误。
