en: The fear was that the United Kingdom would be shut out of the world’s fastest-growing market, and that its partnership with the United States would be at risk as well: The Western alliance would consist of two pillars, and Europe, not a shrunken Britain, would be one of them.

zh: 如今，英国争论背后的推动因素是欧洲的衰落而非其力量。
en: Today, it is the enfeeblement, not power, of Europe, that drives the UK debate.

zh: 英国认为自己表现出色，而欧洲表现糟糕。
en: The British perceive themselves as doing rather well, whereas Europe is doing badly.

zh: 事实上，自2008年大崩盘以来，欧盟一直是失败者。
en: Indeed, ever since the 2008 crash, the EU has been identified with failure.

zh: 除了英国和德国，几乎看不到经济增长。
en: Outside Britain and Germany, there has been almost no economic growth.

zh: 欧洲无法捍卫边界不被恐怖分子突破 （ “ 欧洲不安全 ” ， 唐纳德·特朗普如是说 ） 。
en: It cannot defend its frontiers against terrorists (“Europe is not safe,” proclaims Donald Trump).

zh: 欧洲机构缺乏合法性。
en: Its institutions lack legitimacy.

zh: 欧盟由28个准主权成员构成，它无法行动，只能发布行动意图。
en: Made up of 28 quasi-sovereign members, it cannot act, but only issue intentions to act.

zh: 毫不奇怪收回仍有一些决策权力的国家主权的运动正在酝酿中。
en: No wonder there is a move afoot to reclaim national sovereignty, where some decision-making power still resides.

zh: 欧盟的命运绝望地与其最脆弱的一环联结在一起：包括19个成员国的欧元区，亦即经济停滞的单一货币核心区。
en: The EU’s fate has become hopelessly entangled with that of its most vulnerable feature: the 19-member eurozone, the single-currency heartland of economic stagnation.

zh: 对布鲁塞尔的官员来说，欧元区就是欧盟。
en: To officials in Brussels, the eurozone is the EU.

zh: 只有英国和丹麦被允许选择置身其外。
en: Only Britain and Denmark have been allowed to opt out.

zh: 其他成员国，包括瑞典在内，预计都将在符合标准时加入欧元区。
en: The other members, including Sweden, are expected to join when they meet the criteria.

zh: 欧元区本应成为政治联盟的引擎。
en: The eurozone was to be the engine of political union.

zh: 但这个引擎熄火了。
en: But the engine has stalled.

zh: 诚然，2008年危机肇始于美国银行业大崩盘。
en: To be sure, the 2008 crisis started with the banking collapse in the US.

zh: 但世界其他地区大部分都已经复苏，而欧洲大部没有。
en: But most of the rest of the world has recovered, whereas most of Europe has not.

zh: 为了评估原因，最近牛津大学纳菲尔德学院组织了一次研讨班，讨论的焦点是缺少一个主权实体有能力保护作为一个整体的欧洲经济免受肇始于其他地区的危机的影响。
en: To assess why, a recent symposium on the subject at Nuffield College, Oxford, focused on the lack of a sovereign authority able to protect the European economy as a whole from contagious crises starting elsewhere.

zh: 缺少主权的方面包括一个响应非对称冲击的财政转移支付体系；一种吸收冗余资金的无风险资产（欧元债券 ） ； 一套监督银行和资本市场的单一体系；一个能够作为最后贷款人的中央银行，以及组织泛欧盟稳定/复苏计划的能力。
en: The missing bits of sovereignty include a fiscal transfer system to respond to asymmetric shocks; a risk-free asset (eurobonds) in which to park redundant money; a single system for supervising banks and capital markets; a central bank able to act as lender of last resort; and the ability to organize an EU-wide stabilization/recovery program.

zh: 欧元区削弱了加入其中的国家（nation-states ） ， 而没有建立一个超国家（supranational state）取代其成员国所失去的权力。
en: The eurozone has weakened the nation-states comprising it, without creating a supranational state to replace the powers its members have lost.

zh: 因此，合法性仍停留在已经失去了作为合法性来源的主权特征（比如改变汇率的能力）的政治层面上。
en: Legitimacy thus still resides at a level of political authority that has lost those attributes of sovereignty (such as the ability to alter exchange rates) from which legitimacy derives.

zh: 与此同时，行动承诺仍然层出不穷。
en: Meanwhile, promises of action continue to flow.

zh: 所谓的五主席报告（Five Presidents’ Report）呼吁“完善欧洲的经济和货币联盟 ” ， 作为“政治联盟”的前奏。
en: The so-called Five Presidents’ Report calls for “completing Europe’s economic and monetary union” as a prelude to “political union.”

zh: 但这样的顺序正确吗？
en: But is that the right sequence?

zh: 从历史看，政治联盟先于经济和欧比联盟。
en: Historically, political union precedes economic and monetary union.

zh: 欧洲央行前首席经济学家奥特马尔·伊辛格（Otmar Issing）一贯指出，在没有主权的情况下，向更高层面转移职能 — — 包括货币政策 — — 的过程将造成巨大的合法性赤字。
en: As Otmar Issing, a former ECB chief economist, never tires of pointing out, without a sovereign, the process of transferring competences – including monetary policy – to ever higher levels will create a huge legitimacy deficit.

zh: 欧盟试��逐步实现政治联盟，因为不可能将政治联盟作为起点。
en: The EU has tried to achieve political union incrementally, because it was impossible to start with it.

zh: 事实上 ， “ 欧洲工程”从未掩盖连续不断的危机将推动政治一体化前进的预期。
en: Indeed, barely hidden in the “European project” was the expectation that successive crises would push political integration forward.

zh: 这显然是让·莫奈的希望。
en: This was certainly Jean Monnet’s hope.

zh: 反之 — — 危机将产生相反的效应，导致经济和货币联盟崩溃 — — 从未被认真面对。
en: The alternative – that the crises would have the opposite effect, leading to the breakup of the economic and monetary union – was never seriously confronted.

zh: 在英国，很少有人会欢迎迅速走向政治联盟，英国人认为这意味着填补导致欧元区步履蹒跚的主权缺口。
en: Few people in the UK would welcome a rapid move toward a political union, assuming this means filling in the gaps in sovereignty that have crippled the eurozone.

zh: 事实上，在英国首相卡梅伦与欧洲政府首脑所达成的作为英国留在欧盟的条件的协议中，英国获得了不必遵守“更加紧密的联盟”的承诺的特别豁免。
en: Indeed, in the deal that Prime Minister David Cameron negotiated with European heads of government as a condition of remaining in the EU, Britain is specifically exempted from commitment to “ever closer political union.”

zh: 但是，没有政治联盟，欧元区很难起作用。
en: Yet, without a political union, it is hard to see how the eurozone can be made to work.

zh: 因此，在经历更多失败的权宜之计后，欧元区可能分裂为多个更加兼容的部分。
en: The eurozone is therefore likely to break up into more compatible parts, after further failed efforts to muddle through.

zh: 我们可以想象一个北方单一货币区，它拥有足够的主权（由德国提供，或者更合理地，由德国和法国联合提供）起作用，以及一个不必受北方区货币和财政规则约束的南方区，两者之间通过自由贸易联系。
en: One can imagine a northern single-currency area, with enough sovereignty (provided by Germany or, more plausibly, by Germany and France acting together) to make it work, linked by free trade to a southern area that is not subject to the northern bloc’s monetary and fiscal rules.

zh: 具体而言，南方区成员国彼此之间和与北方联盟之间将拥有固定但可调的汇率。
en: Specifically, members of the southern bloc would have fixed, but adjustable, exchange rates with one another and with the northern union.

zh: 但是，南方区缺少一个拥有可制衡德国的分量和地位的成员国。
en: The southern bloc, however, would lack a member with the weight and prestige to counterbalance Germany.

zh: 这一成员国只能是英国。
en: That member could only be Britain.

zh: 而这正是反对脱离欧盟的主要理由：留在欧盟的英国将能够保证如果欧元区崩溃，崩溃过程不会过于混乱，多少能保留一些欧盟创建者的精神。
en: And this is the main argument against pulling out of the EU: By staying in, Britain would be able to ensure that, if and when the eurozone’s breakup comes, the process is not too messy, and will at any rate preserve something of the spirit of the EU’s founders.

zh: 猛然分手对英国弊端众多，将不可避免地被卷入乱流。
en: Britain has much to fear from an acrimonious divorce, as it will inevitably be swept into its turbulent wake.

zh: 作为连接不同世界的桥梁向来是英国的作用之一对于未来的两个欧洲，英国也可以起到这一作用，但首先决不能自绝于目前存在的欧洲。
en: It has always been part of Britain’s role to act as a bridge between different worlds. It can play this role in the two Europes of the future, but only by not cutting itself off from the one Europe that currently exists.

zh: 英国的寂静选举
en: Britain’s Silent Election

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 世界各国的选举通常都是迷乱且沉闷的，而英国即将在五月七号举行的大选也是如此；许多英国人无疑也深有同感。
en: LONDON – Other people’s elections are usually baffling and boring, which is certainly true of the United Kingdom’s coming vote on May 7; indeed, many Britons share the sentiment.

zh: 令人震惊的莫过于这场在英国史上选前造势期最为漫长的选举竟然不存在任何焦点议题。
en: The longest election campaign in UK history has been strikingly short of focus.

zh: 但即便如此，这场选举依然为其他西方民主国家带来了三点重要的教益。
en: Nonetheless, the campaign contains three important pointers for other Western democracies.

zh: 第一点教益是比尔·克林顿（Bill Clinton）在1992年提出的著名竞选口号 — — “笨蛋，经济才是关键！ ” — —本身就非常愚蠢，或者说至少是不充分的。
en: The first pointer is that Bill Clinton’s famous campaign slogan from 1992 – “It’s the economy, stupid” – is itself stupid, or at least insufficient.

zh: 如果决定英国选举的是经济的话，现任首相戴维·卡梅伦（David Cameron）早就该胜券在握了。
en: If it was the economy that would decide Britain’s election, Prime Minister David Cameron would be leading a much more confident campaign.

zh: 在过去约18个月以来，英国的经济增速位列欧洲第一，甚至不时超越美国。
en: For the past 18 months or so, the UK has had Europe’s fastest-growing economy, and at times has even outpaced the United States.

zh: 目前5.6%的失业率也不及欧元区的一半。
en: The unemployment rate, now 5.6%, has fallen to less than half that of the eurozone.

zh: 但即便这些经济数据如此亮丽，却无法在民调中为卡梅伦的保守党政府争取到什么优势，也无力将其执政联盟搭档 — — 中间派的自由民主党 — — 从民望大跌中拯救出来。
en: But favorable economic indicators have made little difference to the standing of Cameron’s Conservatives in opinion polls, and have done nothing to save their coalition partner, the centrist Liberal Democrats, from a severe slump.

zh: 许多选民似乎并未感觉到自身境遇有所改善，而这种感觉也是有道理的：在历经七年的痛苦煎熬之后，人均收入依然没有抬头迹象。
en: Too many voters, it seems, still do not feel better off, and for good reason: average incomes have barely begun to rise, following seven painful years.

zh: 因此正确的选举口号应该是 ： “ 笨蛋，生活水平才是关键。
en: So the right slogan in this campaign might be, “It’s the living standards, stupid.”

zh: ”或者更准确地说（虽然更拗口 ） ： “笨蛋，对未来生活水平的预期，以及围绕实现这一预期的公平感才是关键 ” 。
en: Or, more accurately (though more cumbersomely): “It’s the perception of future living standards, stupid, and the perception of fairness surrounding those prospects.”

zh: 无论哪种说法，重点都很明确：光靠统计数据来证明复苏，是不够的。
en: Either way, the point is straightforward: statistical recovery is not enough.

zh: 这似乎也是为何中左翼的工党似乎更占优势的原因，虽然在当前民调中他们仅仅领先2~4个百分点。
en: This seems to be why, although it has only a small lead of 2-4 percentage points in the polls, the center-left Labour Party has had the best of the campaign.

zh: 工党领导人埃德·米利班德（Ed Miliband）在去年看来还是个优柔寡断,不招人喜欢的家伙；但或许得益于原本不高的预期，他的形象也随着竞选的不断推进而日渐变得更可信也更具政治家风范了。
en: Labour’s leader, Ed Miliband, was widely derided last year as weak, unconvincing, and unlikeable; but, perhaps benefiting from low expectations, he has looked steadily more credible and statesmanlike as the campaign has gone on.

zh: 第二个教益则是外交事务 — — 虽然在任何国家的大选中都不太起主导作用 — — 可以强化人们对政治领导人的总体不信任感。
en: The second pointer is that foreign affairs, though rarely a major factor in any country’s national elections, can contribute to a general sense of unease about political leadership.

zh: 外界原本认为由于英国独立党的崛起以及卡梅伦承诺如果连任将在2017举行公投，英国会否留在欧盟将成为本次大选的核心议题。
en: It had been widely assumed that the UK’s continued membership in the European Union would be a leading campaign issue, given the rise of the UK Independence Party and Cameron’s pledge that, if re-elected, he would hold a referendum on the question by 2017.

zh: 事实上，卡梅伦的承诺应当是本次大选中最具连锁反应的重大议题：如果他连任，则公投可期；如果米利班德当选，则一切照旧。
en: Indeed, Cameron’s promise is arguably the most consequential issue at stake in the British election: if he remains Prime Minister, there will be a referendum; if Miliband takes over, there will not be.

zh: 英国的战略性未来将由此定夺。
en: Britain’s strategic future rests on this choice.

zh: 但围绕这一选择的讨论却近乎无声无息。
en: Yet there has been near-silence on this choice.

zh: 无论是独立党还是其魅力领袖奈吉尔·法拉奇（Nigel Farage）都在民调中走弱，只能不断作秀吸引眼球。
en: Both UKIP and its charismatic leader, Nigel Farage, have slipped in opinion polls and have struggled to get attention.

zh: 更重要的是，卡梅伦在欧洲和移民方面几乎没有发表过任何言论；而虽然米利班德的亲欧盟立场让他赢得了许多商界领袖的亲睐，他本人却也在刻意弱化这一议题。
en: More important, Cameron has said almost nothing about either Europe or immigration; and, though Miliband’s clearly stated pro-EU stance has endeared his candidacy to many business leaders, he, too, has played down the issue.

zh: 或许这体现了我的个人偏好，但我怀疑英国主要政党在该议题上的躲躲闪闪实际上削弱了人们对它们的支持，因为这让它们作为英国真正代表的想象大打折扣。
en: Perhaps this reflects my own bias, but I suspect that this evasiveness on the part of Britain’s main political parties has weakened support for them, by diminishing their status as valid representatives of the country.

zh: 选民们或许不会将欧洲或者外交事务列为关注重点。
en: Voters may not list Europe or foreign affairs among the main issues that concern them.

zh: 但媒体每天连篇累牍地报道偷渡者死在地中海上，乌克兰战争，希腊的潜在违约，叙利亚、伊拉克、也门，利比亚和加沙地区的乱局以及伊朗核项目都在不断提高选民的意识，认为自己的国家应当由一个拥有长期一致性外交政策的政府来奋力守护。
en: But the daily news about migrants dying in the Mediterranean, the war in Ukraine, Greece’s possible default, the turmoil in Syria, Iraq, Yemen, Libya, and Gaza, Iran’s nuclear program, and more heighten voters’ awareness that their country needs to be defended robustly, by a government with a coherent foreign policy.

zh: 无奈英国的防卫力量已经弱化到了1930年代以来的最低点。
en: And yet Britain’s defense forces are weaker than at any time since the 1930s.

zh: 人们也普遍认为英国在国际事务上的影响力也同步下降。
en: The general perception is that Britain’s voice in international affairs is less influential than at any time since then, too.

zh: 但无论选民们对英国的外交和国防政策有什么样的看法，他们都认为自己的国家无论如何都必须得拟定一个。
en: Whatever voters think Britain’s foreign and defense policy should be, they believe their country should have one.

zh: 这场选举的最后一项教益这些寂静的缩影或许在某种���度上反映了国家领导力的真空.
en: The final pointer of the UK election may partly reflect the vacuum in national leadership that such silence epitomizes.

zh: 无论选举结果如何,其中最引人注目的现象就是地区主义的崛起,其中最明显的就是支持独立的苏格兰国家党的支持率大增。
en: Whatever the result of the election, the most striking phenomenon will be the rise of regionalism, most notably a surge in support for the pro-independence Scottish National Party (SNP).

zh: 没人可以预期苏格兰国家党是否会最终荒诞地加入工党执政联盟，去治理一个它在去年9月的公投中奋力要求脱离的国家。
en: No one can predict whether the SNP might end up in the paradoxical position of joining a coalition with Labour to govern a country that it was campaigning to leave in last September’s independence referendum.

zh: 但该党在选举后可能获得的优势可不能仅仅以分离主义情绪来解释。
en: But the SNP’s likely electoral gain is too large to be explained by secessionist sentiment alone.

zh: 这个党派显然吸引了一些不愿独立但希望为苏格兰争取更多自治权以及在威斯敏斯特议会更大发言权的选民。
en: The party appears to be attracting many people who voted against independence but who want more regional autonomy and a stronger voice for Scotland in the Westminster Parliament.

zh: 在经济复苏中更宽泛的“改善体验”因素缺位，对经济不平等状况的不满，对国际政治领导人的不信任，以及人们对地方主义的更广泛接纳：这些才是英国大选竞选的主要特征。
en: The absence of a broader “feel good” factor from economic recovery, resentment of economic inequality, mistrust of national political leaders, and greater faith in localism: these are the main features of Britain’s election campaign.

zh: 无论他们是否选米利班德做下任首相（与自由民主党和/或苏格兰国家党组成执政联盟 ） ， 他们都将在未来几年间为世界其他地方的选举定下基调。
en: Whether or not they make Miliband the next prime minister (in a coalition with the Liberal Democrats, the SNP, or both), they are likely to characterize elections elsewhere as well in the years ahead.

zh: 博彩公司和英国选举
en: The Bookies and the British Election

zh: 伦敦—我曾经被视为英国和其他国家选举的神准预测家。
en: LONDON – I used to be considered a pretty good forecaster of British and other countries’ elections.

zh: 毕竟，我曾经当过党主席。
en: I was, after all, once a party chairman.

zh: 现在，我可以坦白我的方法了。
en: I can now confess my method.

zh: 我的预测基础不是新颖的政治洞见。
en: It was not based on any novel political insight.

zh: 我不会那些与选举倾向有关的经济因素的魔法算术 — — 尽管你我也确实认为净可支配收入和人们通常的选举倾向有一定相关性。
en: I did not have a magic algorithm relating economic factors to voting intentions – though I do think that there is some correlation between net disposable income and how people normally vote.

zh: 但我自己的仍在用的技术，甚至要比仔细算计每一个选区的政治详情还要可靠。
en: But my own technique, which I still use, has proved more reliable than even poring over the political entrails in every constituency.

zh: 我的做法并不十分复杂：我观察博彩公司的赔率。
en: What I do is not very sophisticated: I watch the bookmakers’ odds.

zh: 这种做法在去年9月的苏格兰独立公投中被证明效果显著。
en: Doing so proved invaluable as recently as the Scottish independence referendum last September.

zh: 计票前两天，博彩公司开始支付下注苏格兰对公投说“不”的赌徒。
en: Two days before the count, bookmakers were paying out to gamblers who had bet that Scotland would vote “No” to independence.

zh: 猜一下苏格兰实际上会做出何种投票选择。
en: Guess which way Scotland actually voted.

zh: 我的方法的基础是一项观察，即你很少听说有穷光蛋博彩公司。
en: My method is based largely on the observation that you rarely hear of a poor bookie.

zh: 因此我运用了美国作家达蒙·朗恩（Damon Runyon）的名言 ： “ 比赛的关键并不总是快，战斗的关键也并不总是强，但我们得这样赌。 ”
en: So I apply the American writer Damon Runyon’s famous adage: “The race is not always to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, but that’s the way to bet.”

zh: 现在的问题是，5月的英国大选实在太势均力敌了。
en: The problem now is that the British general election in May is too close to call.

zh: 因此博彩公司开除了2赔5的无政党可或绝对多数的赔率，而工党和保守党赢得最大数量席位的赔率也都只有10赔11。
en: So the bookmakers have 2:5 odds on no party gaining an outright majority, and 10:11 on either Labour or the Conservatives winning the largest number of seats.

zh: 因此我无法预测结果，伦敦金融城的宇宙主宰者亦然，他们总是对政治不确定性神经过敏。
en: So I cannot predict the outcome, and neither can the masters of the universe in the City of London, who always become jittery in the face of political uncertainty.

zh: 我可以做的是解释为何存在这一不确定性。
en: What I can do is try to explain why that uncertainty exists.

zh: 首先，与许多其他民主国家一样，英国两大政党的支持度正在下降。
en: First, as in many other democracies, support for the United Kingdom’s two main political parties is declining.

zh: 我第一次对政治感兴趣时，也就是在近50年前，工党和保守党吸引了90%左右的公众支持。
en: When I first became interested in politics, nearly 50 years ago, Labour and the Conservatives attracted some 90% of the popular vote.

zh: 而在5月，它们两党相加大概能达到65%到70 % 。
en: In May, their combined share will be about 65% to 70%.

zh: 之所以如此，有几个原因。
en: There are several reasons for this.

zh: 一是传统工人阶级的衰落和更丰裕的中产阶级的成长，这一趋势的基础是居住和拥有住房状况的变化。
en: One is the decline of the traditional working class and the growth of a more affluent middle class, underpinned by changes in occupation and housing.

zh: 工会成员和公共部门就业下降。
en: Trade-union membership and public-sector employment have fallen.

zh: 参加政党的人数随着非左即右的意识形态二分的消退而迅速下降。
en: The number of people joining political parties has dropped sharply as ideological identification with either the left or the right has waned.

zh: 除此之外则是民粹主义和民族主义在英国的兴起，这部分是拜政治和经济疏离所致，而政治和经济疏离的原因则是全球化和经济困境，工党和保守党为了不断下降的支持度而斗个不停。
en: Add to this the rise of populist and nationalist parties in Britain, partly a consequence of the political and economic alienation that have resulted from globalization and economic troubles, and Labour and the Conservatives are fighting over dwindling support.

zh: 最新民调显示34%的选民支持工党，32%支持保守党。
en: The latest polls indicate 34% support for Labour, and 32% for the Conservatives.

zh: 工党的支持率几年前还接近40 % ； 而保守党则一直徘徊在30%左右。
en: Labour’s popularity has been trending down from the high 30s over the last couple of years; the Conservatives have remained stuck at around 30%.

zh: 一些因素让预测结果变得难上加难。
en: Several factors make predicting the outcome even more problematic.

zh: 首先，选举制度的设计极有利于工党。
en: For starters, the electoral system is tipped sharply in Labour’s favor.

zh: 保守党成为议员所需要比工党赢得更多选票，因为城市英国居民拥有过多的代表权，而工党在不少英国选区占据多数优势。
en: It takes more votes to elect a Conservative than a Labour MP, owing to the over-representation of urban Britain and some majority-Labour parts of the country.

zh: 结果，选举专家测算，保守党必须至少赢得比工党高4%的支持才能拿下更多席位。
en: As a result, psephologists calculate that the Conservatives have to win at least 4% more of the popular vote than Labour in order to win more seats.

zh: 其次，反移民、反欧洲的英国独立党（UK Independence Party）从保守党中夺走的选票比从工党夺走的多得多 — — 也许多50 % 。
en: Second, the anti-immigration, anti-European UK Independence Party (UKIP) takes more votes – perhaps as much as 50% – from the Conservatives than it does from the Labour party.

zh: 看起来，英国独立党的支持也许已经见顶，并且已经表露出疲态。
en: It looks as though UKIP’s support may have peaked, and that some of the air is escaping from the party’s tires.

zh: 但没人真的知道英国独立党对保守党的胜算会造成多大影响。
en: But no one really knows how much damage UKIP will do to the Conservatives’ chances.

zh: 第三，在藩篱的另一边，苏格兰民族党（Scottish National Party）似乎正在吸引大量前工党支持者。
en: Third, on the other side of the fence, the Scottish National Party appears to be attracting a large number of former Labour supporters.

zh: 许多苏格兰西部的工人阶级选民曾经在苏格兰议会选举中支持苏格兰民族党，但在英国的大选中，他们将转而支持工党。
en: Many working-class voters in western Scotland used to vote for the SNP in Scottish Parliament elections, but would drift back to Labour in UK general elections.

zh: 但一些人认为这一模式已经被打破，因为有一种感觉认为工党将其传统支持者视为理所当然。
en: But some believe that this pattern has been disrupted, owing to a sense that Labour has taken its traditional supporters for granted.

zh: 工党领袖米利班德（Ed Miliband）在苏格兰的不受欢迎程度与其对手、首相卡梅伦不相上下。
en: Ed Miliband, the Labour leader, seems to be just as unpopular in Scotland as his Conservative counterpart, Prime Minister David Cameron.

zh: 在领导力方面，保守党已经在民调中领先。
en: Leadership is an area where the Conservatives are already ahead in opinion polls.

zh: 他们在经济问题上也有明显的领先优势，而新闻媒体一直在支持该党关于增长与就业复苏以及低通胀正在让整个经济获益的主张。
en: They have a substantial lead on economic issues as well, as the news continues to support the party’s contention that the recovery in growth and employment, along with low inflation, are now benefiting the entire country.

zh: 保守党将与他们上一次在选举中大获全胜的1992年一样苦心钻研经济问题。
en: Conservatives will hammer away on the economy, as they did in 1992, the last time that they won an election outright.

zh: 至于工党，他们将把重点放在选民对不利于政府的问题上的注意力。
en: Labour, for its part, will seek to focus voters’ attention on issues that are thought to be toxic for the government, like the National Health Service.

zh: 选战已经开始，没人会认为主力宣传机器会未来几周偏离既定主题。
en: With the campaign already underway, no one should expect the main protagonists to depart significantly in the weeks ahead from the themes that they have already espoused.

zh: 结果与博彩公司的预测不谋而合会如何？
en: What happens if the outcome matches the bookies’ predictions?

zh: 可能会有几个月的时间可以努力结成不可能的同盟；接着也许是又一场选举（假设议会改变五年一选的法律规定的话 ） 。
en: There will presumably be months of attempts to build coalitions out of improbable alliances; then maybe there will be another election (assuming Parliament can change the law mandating its five-year term).

zh: 我希望不会走到这一步，还希望当硝烟散尽时，卡梅伦将是唯一还站着的人 — — 他配得上胜利。
en: I hope it does not come to that, and that when the battle smoke clears, Cameron will be left – as he deserves to be – the only man standing.

zh: 但在我下注前，我会考虑博彩公司怎么说。
en: But before I place that bet, I will consider what the bookies have to say.

zh: 谎言、该死的谎言和英国选举
en: Lies, Damn Lies, and the British Election

zh: 伦敦 — — 揭示哪些候选人能不加修饰地说出真相并不是民主选举竞赛的目的。
en: LONDON – Democratic elections cannot be described as competitions aimed at revealing which candidates tell the unvarnished truth.

zh: 多数政治家尽量避免直接撒谎；他们像职业拳手那样躲闪可能让自己陷入到说谎境地的问题。
en: Most politicians try to avoid telling outright lies; they bob and weave like prizefighters when faced with questions that might ensnare them in outright mendacity.

zh: 但他们却不约而同地夸大自己的好处以及竞争对手获胜的危险。
en: But they invariably exaggerate what they have to offer, as well as the perils that would result should their opponents win.

zh: 我们可以理解政治家渲染自己的未来目标，而对别人的目标进行淡化处理。
en: It is understandable that politicians should talk up their own vision of the future and talk down what others have to say.

zh: 但做得不太过火才相对可信，并且此人在过去掌权时也应该取得过某些相似的业绩。
en: All of this is most credible if it does not go too far, and if it bears some resemblance to what the same politicians have achieved when they have been in power.

zh: 选民们往往在一英里外就能辩认出政界匹诺曹和说谎者的长鼻子。
en: Voters normally spot political Pinocchios and the lengthening of politicians’ noses a mile off.

zh: 但他们也并不用圣人的标准来要求自己的当选代表。
en: But they also do not expect their elected representatives to be saints.

zh: 他们愿意在一定程度上适用无罪推定（目前为止这是政界领袖能够拥有的最重要的品质 ） 。
en: They are prepared to give some the benefit of the doubt (by far the most important attribute any political leader can possess).

zh: 我猜想在投票当天，戴维·卡梅伦首相在露面时会表现出这种特点。
en: My guess is that on polling day, Prime Minister David Cameron will emerge holding this asset.

zh: 选民们通常也相信直觉 — — 虽然直觉并不总正确 — — 即传统左翼党派往往会多征税多开支，而右翼党派则恰恰相反。
en: Voters also have a gut instinct – usually, though not always, correct – that parties of the traditional left will tax and spend more, and that those of the right will do the opposite.

zh: 选民们对此的反应体现出他们对近期局势的看法，以及他们希望自己和家人拥有什么样的未来。
en: The way voters respond reflects the way they perceive recent history and what they want for themselves and their families in the future.

zh: 我认同选民们往往能够做出正确的判断。
en: I subscribe to the view that they normally get these judgments right.

zh: 但今年，英国选民必须忍受异乎寻常的选举隐瞒。
en: This year, however, the British electorate must navigate more than the ordinary amount of election-time dissimulation.

zh: 在选民5月7日走进投票站时，待选官员要求他们相信危险的三大谎言。
en: As voters head to the polls on May 7, their would-be elected officials are asking them to believe three great falsehoods, each of which is dangerous in its own way.

zh: 英国最成功的两大民粹主义政党 — — 英国独立党（UKIP）和苏格兰民族党（SNP）正在兜售上面提到的前两大谎言，这也是我本人在竞选活动中所目睹过的最大欺骗。
en: The first two falsehoods – deceptions as large as I can remember witnessing during an election campaign – are being peddled by the country’s two most successful populist parties: the United Kingdom Independence Party (UKIP) and the Scottish Nationalist Party (SNP).

zh: 英国独立党的快速崛起基于英国回到从未有过的过去的诺言：以白人为主、敬畏上帝、遵纪守法、在文化上孤芳自赏并一味追求狭隘的国家利益。
en: UKIP’s rapid rise has been built on the promise of a return to a British past that never was: mostly white, God-fearing, law-abiding, culturally insular, and narrowly focused on its own national interests.

zh: 上述目标吸引的主要是怀疑现代化、敌视全球化的民众。
en: It is a vision that appeals mainly to those who are suspicious of modernity and hostile toward globalization.

zh: 英国独立党两大主要政策处方 — — 即结束移民和退出欧盟 — — 其风险在于不符合经济繁荣的要求。
en: The danger is that UKIP’s two primary policy prescriptions – an end to immigration and withdrawal from the European Union – are incompatible with economic prosperity.

zh: 为让英国在欧盟以外继续壮大发展，有必要对全球贸易投资和不断增长的移民进一步开放经济。
en: In order for Britain to continue to thrive outside the EU, it would have to open its economy even further, not only to worldwide trade and investment, but also to increased immigration flows.

zh: 英国独立党面向世界封闭英国的建议只会导致更严重的贫困 — — 尤其是对英国工人而言。
en: Following UKIP’s suggestion to close the country off from the world would result only in greater poverty – above all for British workers.

zh: 苏格兰民族党的竞选也围绕不诚实的核心，不幸的是，这种不诚实恰恰在很大程度上是其成功的源泉。
en: The SNP, too, has built its campaign around a core of dishonesty that, unfortunately, explains a good part of its success.

zh: 除迎合苏格兰仇英的社会暗流外，苏格兰民族党承诺其选民实行远比工党首相候选人埃德·米利班德所能提供的更偏左翼的极端政策。
en: In addition to appealing to an unpleasant undercurrent of Scottish Anglophobia, the SNP promises its electorate the prospect of policies that are far to the left of anything that Labour’s prime ministerial candidate, Ed Miliband, could possibly deliver.

zh: 更糟的是，苏格兰民族党向苏格兰选民承诺的增加福利开支必将主要来自英国纳税人的腰包。
en: To make matters worse, the increase in welfare spending that the SNP is promising Scotland’s voters would have to be paid for primarily by taxpayers in England.

zh: 无论工党还是保守党哪一方赢得最多数量的议会席位，其构成必然会包括众多永远不可能同意其政策重点的英国选民。
en: Regardless of which party – Labour or Conservative – wins the largest number of seats in Parliament, its constituents would of course include many English voters, who would never agree to the SNP’s policy priorities.

zh: 这是一个危险的谎言；在苏格兰仅以10%的优势投票留在英国短短八个月后，它再次对英国的宪法完整性构成威胁。
en: As far as falsehoods go, this is a dangerous one; it once again threatens the constitutional integrity of Britain, just eight months after Scotland voted to stay part of the United Kingdom by a margin of 10%.

zh: 但最后一个谎言流传最为普遍 — — 危险系数可能也最高。
en: But it is the last deception that is the most widespread – and probably the most dangerous of all.

zh: 国家政客的竞选演说体现出一种妄念，即英国能够以50年前相同的力度控制全球。
en: National politicians’ campaign rhetoric embodies the delusional belief that the UK can exercise the same degree of control over global events that might have been possible 50 years ago.

zh: 无论如何，这样的可能性几乎为零。
en: For better or worse, that simply is not true.

zh: 英国不再拥有曾经有过的影响力；事实上，英国人似乎并未受到国家重要性下降的困扰 — — 甚或不太清楚这当中的涵义。
en: The UK no longer wields the international influence it once did; indeed, Britons hardly seem to be bothered by their country’s downgraded importance – or even very much aware of the implications.

zh: 国家主权的概念越来越难以捉摸。
en: National sovereignty is becoming an ever more elusive concept.

zh: 英国的经济前景越来越依赖于海外发生的事件，无论是刚刚跨过英吉利海峡，还是在中国或者加州。
en: Britain’s economic prospects increasingly depend on events beyond its shores, whether just across the English Channel or in China or California.

zh: 危害环境的物质随风而至。
en: Environmental hazards blow in on the wind.

zh: 不断加大的移民压力随时可能压倒任何边境管制的假象。
en: Swelling migration pressures threaten to overwhelm any pretense at border controls.

zh: 安全问题越来越多地同时牵扯到外交和国内政策。
en: Security concerns increasingly implicate foreign and domestic policies simultaneously.

zh: 最近的政治漫画画着英国轰炸机起飞执行任务，一名飞行员对旁边的人说 ， “ 轰炸伦敦南部的几个年轻人似乎有很长的路要走。 ”
en: A recent political cartoon showed British bombers taking off on a mission, with one pilot saying to the others, “It seems a long way to go to bomb a few young men from South London.”

zh: 解决英国人所面临的挑战首先要承认我们无法全面控制造成问题的根源。
en: Addressing the challenges that we Britons face will first require acknowledging our limited control over their root causes.

zh: 国家迫切需要有独立见解的政治家，有勇气对选民坦率而清楚地说明英国独自解决问题的日子已经一去不返。
en: The country is in desperate need of leadership with the courage to be candid with voters, by explaining to them clearly and soberly that the UK can no longer solve its problems alone.

zh: 在越来越危险、联系越来越紧密的世界里，英国不能任由其最重要的集体决策基于妄想或谎言。
en: In an increasingly dangerous, ever-more interconnected world, Britain cannot afford to make its most important collective decisions based on delusions.

zh: 英国政治家披露令人不快的真相将令选民受益 — — 至少他们应该做到停止兜售危险的欺骗。
en: The British electorate would be better served if their politicians had the courage to serve up some uncomfortable truths – or at least not to deal in dangerous deceit.

zh: 悬浮议会的经济后果
en: The Economic Consequences of a Hung Parliament

zh: 发自曼彻斯特 — — 刚刚落幕的英国议会大选本应形成一个(如保守党的竞选宣传口号所言 ) “ 强大而稳定”的政府。
en: MANCHESTER – The United Kingdom’s just-completed election was supposed to provide – as the Conservative Party’s campaign slogan put it – a “strong and stable” government.

zh: 无奈事与愿违，不但冒出了一个悬浮议会（英国政治术语，意指在英国下议院选举中无任何政党赢得总共650个席位中的半数以上 ） , 还可能导致今年晚些时候再来一场大选。
en: It ended up doing the opposite, producing a hung parliament and the likelihood of another general election later in the year.

zh: 与此同时，英国还得赶紧和其他27个欧盟成员国就脱欧问题完成谈判。
en: Meanwhile, the clock is ticking for concluding negotiations with the other 27 EU members on the UK’s withdrawal from the European Union.

zh: 对于任何一个既了解脱欧谈判的苛刻和复杂程度，又明白英国政治家和官员们对此根本准备不足的人来说，这堪称一个令人沮丧的前景。
en: To anyone with an inkling of how demanding and complicated the Brexit talks will be, and how ill-prepared British politicians and officials are for them, this is a depressing prospect.

zh: 虽然如今议会处于悬浮状态，保守党只能试图组建少数政府，英国政治也可能因此转向“软”脱欧方向（至少在未来与欧盟的贸易关系方面 ） ， 但英国政治领袖应付谈判的能力或许只会有减无增。
en: Although a hung parliament, with the Tories attempting to form a minority government, might tilt UK politics in the direction of a “softer” Brexit, at least in terms of the future trade relationship with the EU, it will probably leave Britain’s political leaders even less able to cope with the negotiations.

zh: 英国人只能希望欧盟领导人愿意表现出一点同情心：毕竟，选民所传达的一个明确信息就是他们对现有的脱欧后替代方案缺乏信心。
en: Britons will have to hope that EU leaders are willing to show some compassion: after all, the one clear message from voters was their lack of confidence in the alternatives on offer.

zh: 然而即便是在不存在脱欧的情况下，英国经济也将面临重大挑战 — — 这一点在选举期间的都被忽视了。
en: But the UK economy will be facing significant challenges – all but ignored during the election campaign – even without Brexit.

zh: 这是一个横亘在贸易和技术等领域的赢家和输家之间的鸿沟，也正是这一差距有效解释了去年的脱欧公投为何能获得通过。
en: One is the chasm between the winners and losers from trade and technology, a gap that goes a long way to explaining last year’s pro-Brexit vote.

zh: 与此相关的是英国低得惊人的生产力水平。
en: Related to this is the UK’s shockingly low level of productivity.

zh: 当然，赢家与输家之间的差距 — — 这在选区分布上可见一斑 — — 也并不是英国所特有的；它已经在整个西方煽动起了民粹主义和其他形式的反体制政治浪潮。
en: Of course, the gap between winners and losers – which broadly corresponds to the electoral map – is not unique to Britain; it has incited populism and other forms of anti-establishment politics across the West.

zh: 而英国也不是唯一一个正在经历生产率增长停滞或微增的国家。
en: Nor is the UK the only country to be experiencing flat or slow productivity growth.

zh: 但问题是，英国的生产力水平比G7集团平均水平还要低16％左右，而且还是目前欧洲地区最不平等的经济体。
en: But the UK’s productivity level is some 16% lower than the G7 average. And it is by far the most regionally unequal EU economy.

zh: 如果要提振英国生产力水平的话，该国表现不佳的地区就必须奋力赶上。
en: To improve UK productivity, the country’s underperforming regions must catch up.

zh: 脱欧投票使得对这些较贫穷地区的关注变得倍加必要：应对催生支持脱欧微弱多数票的分裂性政治，并尽量减少因英国与其最大贸易伙伴决裂所必然导致的经济损失 — — 特别是在谈判不力的情况下。
en: The Brexit vote makes it doubly necessary to focus on these poorer regions: to address the divisive politics that underpinned the narrow Leave majority, and to minimize the economic damage that the rupture with the UK’s biggest trading partners, especially if badly negotiated, is sure to cause.

zh: 特雷莎·梅的政府在选举前曾宣布要推行产业化战略，而这也是解决一系列深层次结构性问题的希望。
en: The best hope to tackle the profound structural problems came with the May government’s pre-election announcement of its intention to adopt an industrial strategy.

zh: 虽然工业政策与首相个人的社团主义本质相契合，但自1970年代后期以来，英国的政策界就一直对这一理念不太感冒。
en: Although industrial policy is in line with May’s corporatist instincts, the UK’s policy classes have been allergic to the idea since the late 1970s.

zh: 每当想起当年那些为了挽救濒临破产的英国企业（如汽车制造商和钢铁生产商）或投资注定没有前途的新技术（协和式喷气客机，德洛伦汽车）而错误制定的干预措施，官员们就不寒而栗。
en: Officials shudder at the memory of ill-fated interventions designed to prop up failing companies (such as carmakers and steel producers) or invest in ultimately doomed new technologies (Concorde, DeLorean cars).

zh: 因此就在撒切尔夫人1979年上任首相后不久，专责战略性国家干预行动的英国国家经济发展办公室就被行政降级，并最终于1992年被撒切尔的继任者约翰·梅杰（John Major）撤编。
en: It did not take Margaret Thatcher long after her election in 1979 to downgrade the National Economic Development Office (known as Neddy), the body responsible for strategic state interventions, which was finally dismantled under Thatcher’s successor, John Major, in 1992.

zh: 那些把工业政策视同为补贴和减税的人对此尤其反感。
en: The allergy to industrial policy is particularly acute among those who equate it with subsidies and tax breaks.

zh: 然而，鉴于政府不断出手干预经济，也应当以一种更为战略性的方式思考其行为以及与私营部门的互动。
en: Yet, given that the government constantly intervenes in the economy, it surely makes sense to think about its actions and interactions with the private sector in a far more strategic way.

zh: 事实上，一些政府并不太重视 — — 甚至意外制定 — — 的工业政策都取得了相当的成功。
en: Indeed, some below-the-radar – or even accidental – industrial policies have been rather successful.

zh: 金融业就是一个受益者，由于良好的监管以及对伦敦金融城和金丝雀码头基础设施的巨额投资。
en: Finance is one beneficiary, thanks to benign regulation and huge investment in infrastructure in the City of London and Canary Wharf.

zh: 医药行业也是如此 ， “ 专利箱”这类特殊税收优惠政策再加上英国国家医疗服务体系这个大客户使其欣欣向荣。
en: The pharmaceutical industry has been another, owing to special tax breaks such as the “patent box” and the NHS as a huge customer.

zh: 在英国国家广播公司（BBC）的帮助下，创意界也受益匪浅。
en: The creative sector has benefited as well, thanks to the BBC.

zh: 虽然不断受到各类政治压力，但BBC依然像一个合格的公共合作伙伴一样投身于研究与开发，制定技术标准，提供技能培训，并坚持对中小型影视供应商的开放采购，也使其成为英国最成功的生产者和出口商之一。
en: Although under constant political attack, the BBC acts exactly as a public partner should, undertaking research and development, setting technical standards, providing skills training, and adhering to open procurement from small and medium-size suppliers, which are among the UK’s most successful producers and exporters.

zh: 只要被理解为战略协调，风险分担和提供公共物品的载体，工业政策的经济主张是可以令人信服的。
en: The economic case for industrial policy is compelling, so long as it is understood as a vehicle for strategy coordination, risk pooling, and the provision of public goods.

zh: 通过强有力的竞争和国家援助政策（以确保对汽车行业的支持不仅被视为只针对现有厂商）以及对特定协助的终止条款，就可以在很大程度上避免重蹈旧的错误 — — 支持某些没落行业或豪赌于具体技术。
en: The old mistakes – propping up lame-duck industries or betting on specific technologies – can largely be avoided through strong policies on competition and state aid (to ensure that support for the auto sector, say, is not seen as support only for current incumbents) and sunset clauses for specific assistance.

zh: 而那些反对制定非明确工业政策的主张也有其说服力。
en: The case against not having an explicit industrial policy is also compelling.

zh: 政府干预的偶然性特点有助于解释地域上的经济不均衡现象。
en: The accidental character of government intervention helps explain why the economy is so regionally lopsided.

zh: 比如说，如果要用一个成本效益分析来评估某个待立项基础设施项目的潜在收益，而这种分析又是基于诸如工资水平或房价等市场指标来进行，这样流入伦敦的投资就会越来越多，而英国北部地区则陷入投资明显减少的恶性循环。
en: For example, cost-benefit analyses of proposed infrastructure projects that rely on market metrics such as wage rates or property prices to assess potential benefits will create ever-increasing investment around London, and a vicious circle of apparently decreasingly attractive investment in the UK’s north.

zh: 一个具备战略性地眼光必须能认识到在其他地方播撒新产业集群所带来的生产力优势 — — 例如将英国汽车制造商放在英格兰东北部的偶然性措施，以及BBC将部分运作业务搬到大曼彻斯特地区的塞尔福，进而形成伦敦以外的英国第二大广播媒体部门那样。
en: A strategic view would recognize the productivity benefits of seeding new clusters elsewhere – like the happenstance measures that put UK automakers in the northeast of England and the country’s second-biggest broadcast-media sector outside London in Salford, Greater Manchester, when the BBC moved part of its operations there.

zh: 我们已经拥有了充分的历史证据去说明具体政策的优点（和缺点 ） 。
en: There is ample historical evidence of the merits (and demerits) of specific policies.

zh: 由于英国一直以来都充斥着朝令夕改的政策和大量只关注能不能上新闻头条（却毫无实际效果）的动议，真正的挑战将是建立一个政治和体制框架来实施那些可行的举措，并指导和构建政府与私营部门的互动。
en: As Britain has long been plagued by seesaw policies and a plethora of headline-grabbing (but ineffective) initiatives, the real challenge will be to establish a political and institutional framework to implement viable initiatives, and to shape governmental interaction with the private sector.

zh: 当然，任何选前的政策思想都可能成为政治交易或者只是最近这次选举结果所隐含的巨大的不确定性的牺牲者。
en: Of course, any pre-election policy ideas might fall victim to political deals or simply the massive uncertainty implied by the recent election result.

zh: 但这就实在太可惜了。
en: That would be a shame.

zh: 须知政治不稳定性越大，就越需要一个框架才能最终开始解决英国经济所面临的深刻分歧和挑战。
en: The greater the political instability, the more acute is the need for a framework that will finally start to address the deep divisions and challenges facing the British economy.

zh: 英国的领导病
en: The British Leadership Disease

zh: 伦敦—有道德的（ethical）政治领导在全世界都处于短缺状态，从美国到土耳其到菲律宾都是如此。
en: LONDON – Ethical political leadership is in short supply worldwide, from the United States to Turkey to the Philippines.

zh: 但英国也许是最令人震惊的不诚实领导的例子，英国退欧公投及其后果所导致的动荡规模已经超过了平常时间十年。
en: But perhaps the most striking instance of dishonest leadership has been in the United Kingdom, where the Brexit referendum and its aftermath have caused more instability than Britain experiences in a typical decade.

zh: 公投举行后不出几周，举行公投的首先卡梅伦便提出辞职，而他的保守党继任者梅已经认命了新内阁。
en: In just the first couple of weeks after the referendum, David Cameron, the prime minister who brought about the vote, resigned, and his Conservative successor, Theresa May, appointed a new Cabinet.

zh: 尽管一些脱欧派 — — 包括最著名的前伦敦市长约翰逊（Boris Johnson ） — —已经入职政府，但领衔头欧阵营的人中没有一位最终为脱欧负责。
en: Though some of the Brexiteers – most notably former London Mayor Boris Johnson – are now in the government, none of those who led the campaign to leave the European Union are ultimately responsible for carrying it out.

zh: 梅本人支持“留欧”阵营。
en: May herself supported the “Remain” campaign.

zh: 与此同时，反对党工党陷入了混乱。
en: Meanwhile, the opposition Labour Party has fallen into disarray.

zh: 影子内阁对党领袖科尔宾（Jeremy Corbyn）已失去信心并几乎全体辞职，挑战科尔宾的动作也是风起云涌， 科尔宾的支持者甚至朝他对手的选区办公室窗户投掷砖块。
en: Almost the entire Shadow Cabinet has resigned, having lost confidence in party leader Jeremy Corbyn, and efforts to challenge him have been exceptionally acrimonious, with Corbyn supporters even throwing a brick through the window of one of his rivals' constituency office.

zh: 公投后乱象愈演愈烈。
en: And the post-referendum turmoil runs deeper.

zh: 社会、政治和经济不确定性和不满导致人们情绪低落，公投以来仇恨犯罪数量飙升500 % 。
en: The number of reported hate crimes since the referendum has soared by 500%, amid a lowering mood of social, political, and economic uncertainty and discontent.

zh: FTSE100指数在公投结果公布十分钟内市值蒸发1,000亿多英镑 ，而英镑兑美元汇率更是暴跌至35年来的低点。
en: More than £100 billion ($131 billion) was wiped off the FTSE 100 in the first ten minutes of trading after the result was announced, while the pound has plumbed a 35-year low against the US dollar.

zh: 英国 — — 以及其他许多例子最触目惊心的教训之一是问责商业领袖、确保公司行为合乎道德的有用措施在我们的政治制度并未施行。
en: One of the most striking lessons of the British case – and many others – is that promising efforts to hold business leaders to account and ensure that companies behave ethically have not carried over to our political systems.

zh: 我们的民选领导人 — — 他们往往是一马当先要求私人部门拿出可靠战略、继任规划和问责性的人 — — 在按照他们所鼓吹的那样行动方面可谓表现一团糟。
en: Our elected leaders, often among the first to demand sound strategy, succession planning, and accountability in the private sector, have spectacularly failed to practice what they preach.

zh: 我们希望商业领袖为确定的不确定性（certainty of uncertainty）做好规划并合理管理风险。
en: We expect business leaders to plan for the certainty of uncertainty and to manage risks properly.

zh: 去年，英国、欧盟其他国家以及全世界大大小小的公司举行了数不清的会议和高规格规划研讨会为英国脱欧投票做好准备。
en: In the past year, companies big and small in the UK, elsewhere in the EU, and around the world have held countless meetings and high-level planning sessions to prepare for a Brexit vote.

zh: 当结果出炉时，唯一没有为“脱欧”阵营的胜利做好准备的似乎恰恰是导致这一结果的人。
en: When the results came in, it seemed that the only people who hadn’t planned for the “Leave” campaign’s victory were those who led it.

zh: 事实上，据英国议会外交委员会的最新报告，卡梅伦“认为不需要通知包括外交部在内的重要部门为选民投票支持脱欧的可能性做好计划，这是一个重大过失。 ”
en: Indeed, according to a recent report by Parliament’s foreign affairs select committee, Cameron’s “considered view not to instruct key departments including the Foreign Office to plan for the possibility that the electorate would vote to leave the EU amounted to gross negligence.”

zh: 唯一一位带着明确果断的战略迅速做出反应的英国政治领导人是苏格兰首席部长斯特金（Nicola Sturgeon ） 。
en: The only UK political leader who quickly stepped forward with a clear and decisive strategy was Scotland’s first minister, Nicola Sturgeon.

zh: 她的计划是再次举行苏格兰从英国独立并重新加入欧盟的公投。
en: Her plan is to hold another referendum on Scottish independence and rejoin the EU.

zh: 而以权威保证帮助市场冷静下来的则是非民选的加拿大人、英格兰银行行长卡尼（Mark Carney ） 。
en: And it was an unelected Canadian, Mark Carney, the governor of the Bank of England, whose authoritative reassurance helped to calm the markets.

zh: 2015年，卡尼因为组建了一个为英国脱欧可能性未雨绸缪的委员会而遭受抨击。
en: In 2015, Carney came under fire for forming a committee to carry out forward planning for the possibility of Brexit.

zh: 7月初，他被传唤前往英国下议院财政委员会参与听证，被指控在公投举行前夕倾向“留欧 ” ， 而原因仅仅是他对脱欧胜利的经济结果做出悲观（并正确）的评估。
en: And in early July, he was called to testify before the House of Commons Treasury Committee, accused of leaning toward “Remain” in the run-up to the referendum, simply because he presented a bleak (and accurate) assessment of the economic consequences of a Leave victory.

zh: 7月4日，脱欧阵营最高调、最极端的领袖法拉奇（Nigel Farage）决定辞去英国独立党领导人的职位，他说 ， “ 我想找回我的生活。
en: When Nigel Farage, one of the Leave campaign’s most vociferous and extreme leaders, decided to step down as leader of the UK Independence Party on July 4, he said, “I want my life back.”

zh: ”听起来很耳熟吧，因为时任英国石油首席执行官唐熙华（Tony Hayward）在论及2010年墨西哥湾石油泄漏事件的影响 — — 对他的影响时也这么说过。
en: If that sounds familiar, it is because Tony Hayward, then-CEO of BP, used the same phrase when talking about the impact – on him – of the 2010 oil spill in the Gulf of Mexico.

zh: 唐熙华这么说立刻遭到了口诛笔伐。
en: When Hayward said it, the condemnation was swift.

zh: 他的说辞显然得不到受泄漏事件实际影响的人的共鸣。
en: His words conveyed a complete lack of empathy for the people who were actually affected by the spill.

zh: 类似地，将英国推向灾难的帮凶法拉奇在达到目的后卸任愉快。
en: Likewise, Farage, having helped drive Britain to disaster, blithely walked away when the destination was reached.

zh: 同样令人痛心的是约翰逊被任命为外交大臣，考虑到此人说谎、仇外言论和对世界其他领导人不敬的历史，至少他将公开承担英国灾难的污点。
en: As mortifying as it is to see Johnson appointed Foreign Secretary, given his history of lying, xenophobic statements, and insulting remarks about other world leaders, at least he will bear the stain of Britain’s catastrophe publicly.

zh: 英国更深层次的问题在于没有其他道路可走。
en: The deeper problem in the UK is that there is no alternative.

zh: 工党太分裂，无法掌权。
en: The Labour Party is simply too divided to take power.

zh: 入股偶科尔宾是一名首席执行官，已经失去了整个执行团队和董事会的信任，那么他将被迫辞职或被炒鱿鱼。
en: If Corbyn were a CEO who lost the confidence of his entire executive team and board, he would be forced to resign or be fired.

zh: 如果一名首席执行官无法赢得他的领导团队的尊重，那么他就无法领导公司取得成功，即使大部分员工认为他很了不起。
en: If a CEO can’t command the respect of his leadership team, he can’t lead the company to success, even if most of the employees think he’s great.

zh: 政党也是如此，尽管它们常常需要更长时间采取行动，导致整个实体 — — 在这个例子中是英国 — — 不知所措。
en: The same is true of political parties, though they often take longer to act, causing the enterprise – in this case, the UK – to flounder.

zh: 除了及少数例外，英国脱欧投票揭露了英国领导人最糟糕的一面。
en: With very few exceptions, the Brexit vote has brought out the worst in Britain’s leaders.

zh: 如果一位首席执行官对投资人和消费者说谎如同法拉奇、约翰逊和戈夫（Michael Gove）对英国选民说谎一样形同家常便饭的话，痛苦的后果将很快到来 — — 既有来自监管者的，也有来自市场的。
en: If a CEO lied to investors and consumers as much as Farage, Johnson, and Michael Gove lied to UK voters, the consequences would be swift and painful, both from regulators and the market.

zh: 他们无法简单地辞职走人了事，更不用说在组织中担任另一个职位（高级职位更加不可能 ） 。
en: They could not simply resign and move on, much less receive a future role in the organization (and certainly not a senior post).

zh: 他们将被炒鱿鱼（甚至更加糟糕 ） ， 职业生涯就此终结，收拾好去佛罗里达养老。
en: They would be fined (or worse), professionally ostracized, and sent packing to Florida.

zh: 当我们问责商业领袖比问责民选政治领导人更加有效时，就应该担心未来了 — — 不仅英国是如此。
en: When we can hold our business leaders to account more effectively than we can our elected political leaders, we should worry for the future – and not just in the UK.

zh: 如果作为伯克（Edmund Burke）和贝恩（Tony Benn）的故乡的英国可以发生这种事，其他地方绝对也可以发生。
en: If it can happen here – in the homeland of Edmund Burke and Tony Benn – it truly can happen anywhere.

zh: 英国寻求国家定位
en: Britain in Search of a Country

zh: 伦敦 — — 英国脱欧投票已经粉碎了英国与欧洲和世界经济政治联系的多数基础设施。
en: LONDON – The Brexit vote has smashed much of the infrastructure of Britain’s economic and political relations with Europe and the world.

zh: 那些基本基于谎言和欺骗的英国脱欧派根本不知道下一步该何去何从。
en: Those who campaigned for the United Kingdom to leave the European Union, largely on the basis of lies and delusion, have no idea what to do next.

zh: 他们是毁灭者、而非建设者。
en: They are destroyers, not creators.

zh: 但现在我们英国人已经打碎了店里所有的瓷器，只能将国家利益从碎片中拼凑出来。
en: But now that we Brits have broken all the crockery in the shop, we have to piece together our national interest from the shards.

zh: 在聪明的新任首相特雷莎·梅（梅是留欧支持者）的领导下，我们所有人必须竭尽全力将我们的国家从孤立和衰退的边缘挽救回来。
en: All of us, led by a new and clever prime minister, Theresa May (who campaigned to stay in Europe), must do all we can to save our country from isolation and decline.

zh: 梅已经迅速行动组建了英国脱欧的管理团队。
en: May has moved quickly to put in place a team to manage Britain’s divorce from the EU.

zh: 团队由鲍里斯·约翰逊任外交大臣，他非常清楚外交官的使命是要到国外去为本国说谎这一古老的箴言。
en: It includes Boris Johnson as Foreign Secretary, who will need no reminder of the old adage that diplomats are supposed to go abroad to lie for their country.

zh: 他所面临的挑战不仅是无视真相，而且还有曾经侮辱过很多现在需要打交道的人（包括美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马及其可能的继任者希拉里·克林顿 ） 。
en: His challenge will not only be his cavalier attitude to the truth, but also his record of insulting many of those – including US President Barack Obama and his possible successor, Hillary Clinton – with whom he will need to do business.

zh: 但比团队更重要的是这场博弈的属性。
en: But more important than the team is the nature of the game they have to play.

zh: 梅曾表示过 ， “ 脱欧就是脱欧 ” 。
en: “Brexit means Brexit,” May has said.

zh: 但这对我们的贸易关系和移民政策有何意义？
en: But what does that mean for our trade relations and our immigration policy?

zh: 我们是否力争以与现在相差不多的条件加入欧盟单一市场？
en: Are we committed to seeking access to Europe’s single market on something like our current terms?

zh: 我们能否为银行和金融服务取得“护照 ” ， 让它们既能留在英国又能在欧洲其他国家开展业务？
en: Will we be able to secure “passporting” rights for our banks and financial services, so that they can stay in Britain while operating in the rest of Europe?

zh: 我们怎样才能不像挪威和瑞典一样，在接受单一市场规则的情况下实现这样的目标。
en: How can we secure any of these objectives without, like Norway or Switzerland, accepting the single market’s rules?

zh: 回答这些问题的关键在于我们能谈成什么样的劳动力自由流动结果？
en: A key issue in answering these questions will be what we can negotiate concerning the free movement of labor.

zh: 目前，我们对贸易和移民的态度似乎可以用“欢迎商业、但不欢迎外国人”这句简单而矛盾的口号来概述。
en: At the moment, our attitude to trade and migration seems to be encapsulated in one simple but contradictory slogan: “Open for business, but closed for foreigners.”

zh: 我希望 — — 同时怀疑 — — 在这方面能有一定的灵活性。
en: I hope – and suspect – that some flexibility will be possible in this area.

zh: 英国退欧不仅削弱了英国；在某种程度上，欧盟也同样遭到了削弱。
en: Brexit not only diminishes Britain; to a lesser extent, it also diminishes the EU.

zh: 其他欧洲国家肯定希望让英国的退欧过程尽可能轻松友好。
en: Other European countries should want to make Britain’s exit as easy and friendly as possible.

zh: 但到明年前后，我们之前几个伙伴国有可能意识到他们也希望对欧盟国家间流动的移民潮踩下紧急刹车。
en: Yet, over the next year or so, several of our former colleagues may recognize that they, too, want some form of emergency brake on migration flows from one EU country to another.

zh: 如果真是这样，英国就应当能在不损害欧盟条约和政策完整性的前提下谈成更好的结果。
en: When this happens, it should be possible to offer Britain a better deal, without destroying the integrity of the EU’s treaties and policies.

zh: 这绝不是迎合某些“脱欧”份子那种可耻的种族主义 — — 他们为形形色色的外国人留下了有害的敌意。
en: This would not pander to the sort of racism that was a shameful feature of some of the “Leave” campaigning in Britain – and which has left a harmful residue of hostility to foreigners of every hue.

zh: 公开报道的仇恨犯罪案例已经大幅度上升。
en: Reported instances of hate crime have risen sharply.

zh: 现在 ， “ 脱欧”宣传者当然否认他们与这种状况有任何关系。
en: Now, “Leave” campaigners of course deny that this has anything to do with them.

zh: 有人甚至辩称从未呼吁过限制移民人数，他们的本意只是要夺回对本国边境的“控制权 ” 。
en: Some even argue that they never called for limiting immigration, just for “taking control” of our own borders.

zh: 这是一种虚情假意的逃避。
en: That is a mendacious and hypocritical cop-out.

zh: 没有人会说 ， “ 我们只是想控制自己的边境，目的是让移民的数量和从前一样多。
en: No one was saying, “We want to take control of our own borders so that we can have the same number of migrants.”

zh: ”而那些粗鲁些的英国退欧主义者则明确表示他们要让不加管制就会遍布英国各地的强奸犯、罪犯和拼命生小孩的外国人（尤其是土耳其人）进不了英国。
en: And the cruder Brexiteers were explicit that they would deny entry to the rapists, criminals, and fast-breeding foreigners (Turks in particular) who would otherwise flood the land.

zh: 这种特朗普式的观点非常龌龊。
en: This was nasty, Trump-like stuff.

zh: 充其量，那些“脱欧”运动的高智商领导人在看到这样的沉渣泛起时也选择保持沉默。
en: At best, the “Leave” campaign’s more intelligent leaders looked the other way when the slime was being stirred.

zh: 但他们非常清楚发生了什么。
en: But they knew what was happening.

zh: 一次2005年保守党海报宣传活动曾经质问 ， “ 你和我们想的是否一样？
en: “Are you thinking what we’re thinking?” a 2005 Conservative poster campaign asked.

zh: ”有人认为脱欧是一份虐待生活和工作在这里的男人、女人和儿童的授权书。
en: What some are thinking is that Brexit is a license to abuse men, women, and children who live and work here.

zh: 他们的所作所为严重玷污了我们的荣耀和国家声誉。
en: And what they are doing has left a deep stain on our honor and national reputation.

zh: 挽回声誉在某种程度上是梅最重要的任务，后者已经明确表达了团结国家的真诚愿望。
en: Removing it will in some respects be the most important task for May, who expresses what surely is a sincere desire to unite the nation.

zh: 完成这项任务绝非易事。
en: It won’t be easy.

zh: 在公投运动中，民族主义不仅激发了种族主义者的本能，还激发了民粹主义阴谋论，嘲笑了信奉这些理论的专家和机构。
en: During the referendum campaign, nationalism aroused not only racist instincts, but also populist conspiracy theories that derided experts and the institutions that house them.

zh: 财政部等政府部门、独立的英格兰银行和我们著名大学的完整性部分因为绝大多数议员赞成留欧而遭到围攻、同样遭到围攻的还有议会本身。
en: The integrity of government departments like the Treasury, the independent Bank of England, and our great universities came under attack, as did Parliament itself, partly because the overwhelming majority of MPs favored remaining in the EU.

zh: 但恰恰是这些耗时数十年、甚至更长时间精心打造的机构构成了我们社会的脊梁。
en: Yet it is these institutions, carefully built over decades and longer, which provide the backbone of our society.

zh: 思想曾深刻影响过英国政治体系的埃德蒙·伯克会震惊于脱欧群体对任何民族连贯性的随意无视 — — 并且为他们将这样的决策诉诸公投的迫切意愿而蒙羞。
en: Edmund Burke, whose thought has profoundly shaped the UK’s political system, would have been appalled at the Brexiteers’ casual disregard for any sense of national continuity – and mortified by their willingness to put such a decision to a referendum.

zh: “脱欧”运动的口号是“要重新夺回国家的控制权。
en: The cry from the “Leave” campaign was “We want our country back.”

zh: ”对其他人来说问题仍然存在：这个国家是否依然奉行宽容和多元化、珍视其国内体系和宪法传统、并因为价值观而受到世界各国的尊重？ ”
en: For the rest of us, the question remains: Will it still be a country with a tolerant and plural society, proud of its institutions and its constitutional traditions, and admired for its values throughout the world?

zh: 二合一的欧洲
en: Two Europes in One

zh: 华盛顿—如今，关于英国与欧盟的关系的讨论正在进行中。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Informal discussions on the United Kingdom’s relationship with the European Union are now underway.

zh: 关于英国是否保留欧盟资格的全民公决将在2017年年底前进行。 现在的讨论是变革谈判的第一步，欧盟领导人希望通过谈判说服英国选民选择欧洲。
en: With a referendum on the UK’s continued EU membership set to take place before the end of 2017, the talks are the first step toward negotiating changes which, EU leaders hope, will convince British voters to choose Europe.

zh: 而变革显然是必须的。
en: And changes will certainly be needed.

zh: 事实上，英国首相卡梅伦很清楚，从目前英国与欧盟的关系动态看，英国选民毫无疑问将选择离开欧盟。
en: Indeed, as Prime Minister David Cameron is well aware, given the current dynamic of the UK’s relationship with the EU, British voters would undoubtedly choose to leave the EU.

zh: 但卡梅伦也知道，他必须小心处理谈判事宜。
en: But Cameron also knows that he must handle the negotiations with care.

zh: 如果他的要求超过了欧盟的妥协限度，就会搬起石头砸了自己的脚。
en: If he asks for more than the EU can accommodate, he will look as if he caved in.

zh: 如果他要求过少，英国欧洲怀疑派反对保留成员资格运动就会如虎添翼。
en: If he asks for too little, Britain’s Euroskeptics will have more fuel for their campaign against continued membership.

zh: 类似地，如果欧盟领导人向卡梅伦过多让步 — — 允许英国沾欧盟成员资格的好处而不必和其他成员国承担一样的负担 — — 那么欧洲人民可能会起来反对他们。
en: Likewise, if EU leaders give Cameron too much – allowing the UK to reap the benefits of membership, without shouldering the same responsibilities as its partners – their populations could turn on them.

zh: 但如果他们让步过小，就可能失去英国。
en: But if they give too little, they could lose the UK as a partner.

zh: 除了这些策略性考虑，英国及其欧洲盟友必须还必须解决好与欧元区变动有关的长期问题。
en: Beyond such tactical matters, the UK and its European partners must address long-term issues relating to the changing shape of the eurozone.

zh: 欧元危机产生了一个共识，即，为了有效运转，欧元区必须追求进一步一体化。
en: The euro crisis has given rise to a consensus that, in order to function effectively, the eurozone must pursue further integration.

zh: 具体方案包括指定的欧元区预算、增加成员国之间的财政政策协调、成立欧元区财政部等。
en: Specific proposals include a designated eurozone budget, increased fiscal-policy coordination among members, and a eurozone finance minister.

zh: 对选择不加入欧元区的英国来说，这是一个值得担忧的问题，因为这会将英国排斥在重大决策过程之外 — — 特别是如果转向加权多数投票的转变让大部分领域的问题不再需要一致通过的话。
en: For the UK, which opted out of the euro, this is a cause for concern, as it could leave the country on the sidelines of major decision-making processes – especially if the necessary shift toward weighted majority voting removes the need for unanimity in more areas.

zh: 卡梅伦已经敦促采取“紧急刹车”以减缓对非欧元区国家重要问题的决定过程。
en: Cameron already has pressed for an “emergency brake” mechanism to slow down decisions on issues that are important to the non-euro countries.

zh: 显然，一边是推进欧元区一体化的需要，另一边是一些国家强烈希望保留比可预见的货币联盟更多国家主权，这两方面需要平衡。
en: Clearly, the need for much greater eurozone integration must be balanced against some countries’ strong desire to preserve more national sovereignty than is feasible in the monetary union.

zh: 实现平衡的最佳办法是将欧洲分割成两个集团。
en: The best way to do this would be to divide Europe into two groups.

zh: 个体国家被划入那个集团不是基于一体化的潜在“速度 ” ， 而是该国是否决定永久（或至少长期）采用欧元。
en: Inclusion in one or the other would be based not on the potential “speed” of integration, but on a country’s permanent (or at least long-term) decision on adopting the euro.

zh: 当然，从某种程度上讲，这已经是欧盟的基本结构。
en: Of course, to some extent, this is already the EU’s fundamental structure.

zh: 但建立这一分类划分 — — 按照英国的要求，从明确承认欧盟是一个多货币联盟开始 — — 将使成立更好地保护两个集团的利益的决策框架成为可能。
en: But establishing this categorical division – beginning with, as the UK has requested, an explicit recognition that the EU is a multi-currency union – would allow for the creation of a decision-making framework that better protects both group’s interests.

zh: 非欧元集团 — — 包括英国、丹麦、瑞典、波兰和其他一些东欧国家 — — 将继续选择欧盟议会代表并充分参与欧盟机构，与此同时，欧元集团将在当前合作的基础上追求大大增强财政一体化。
en: The non-euro group – including Britain, Denmark, Sweden, Poland, and some other Eastern European countries – would continue to elect representatives to the European Parliament and participate fully in EU institutions. Meanwhile, the euro group would pursue far greater fiscal integration, in addition to their current cooperation.

zh: 为了确保民主合法性、让各国（而不仅仅是德国）宪法法院满意，必须成立第二欧洲议会作为欧元区的立法机构。
en: To ensure democratic legitimacy and satisfy national constitutional courts (not least Germany’s), a second European parliament would have to be established to serve as the eurozone’s legislative branch.

zh: 这一新的欧元区议会的形式可以是由欧洲议会成员组成的小子集，也可以由欧洲议会和各国议会代表联合组成。
en: This new eurozone parliament could be formed either by a subset of members of the larger European Parliament, or by some combination of representatives from the European Parliament and national parliaments.

zh: 计划中负责管理货币联盟财政政策的财政部长将向欧元区议会负责。
en: The proposed finance minister, responsible for overseeing fiscal policy in the monetary union, would be responsible to the eurozone parliament.

zh: 充分实现这一愿景需要更改现有欧洲条约，或者更可行地，由欧元区成员国达成新条约，如2013年生效的“财政契约 ” 。
en: Full realization of this vision would require either a change to the existing European treaties or, more feasible, agreement by eurozone members on a new treaty, like the “fiscal compact” that entered into force in 2013.

zh: 与此同时，现有欧盟运行条约第136条允许采取一些预备步骤，如安排只负责欧元区国家的欧洲理事会（European Council）选举。
en: In the meantime, Article 136 of the existing Treaty on the Functioning of the EU would allow for some preliminary steps, such as the designation of votes at the European Council that are reserved for eurozone countries only.

zh: 建立“二合一的欧洲”而不是“两个速度的欧洲”将让欧洲能够持续地组织自己。
en: Establishing “two Europes in one,” rather than a “two-speed Europe,” would allow Europe to organize itself in a lasting way.

zh: 更加联邦化的欧元区嵌在更大的防务、外交政策、气候变化措施和移民政策联盟中。
en: The more federal eurozone would be embedded in a larger union that cooperates on defense, foreign policy, climate-change measures, and migration policy.

zh: 欧洲公民在欧盟内部的自由迁徙权利也将保留。
en: Free movement of European citizens within the EU would be upheld.

zh: 这套制度允许不愿分享货币主权或者参与最终必须参与的财政合作的国家做出选择。
en: This system would allow those who do not wish to share monetary sovereignty, or engage in the kind of fiscal cooperation that must eventually come with it, to make that choice.

zh: 与此同时，它也将避免存在多个欧洲所造成的复杂性 — — 多个欧洲选项也许对纯粹从功能着眼的老牌欧洲官僚很有吸引力，但很快就变得无可救药地复杂。
en: At the same time, it would avoid the complications of having multiple Europes – an option that may be attractive to veteran Eurocrats from a purely functional perspective, but soon becomes hopelessly complicated.

zh: 政治制度的明确性和全面性，及其自愿性质，是民主合法性的关键。
en: A political system’s clarity and comprehensibility, together with its voluntary nature, are essential to democratic legitimacy.

zh: 当然，这一过程将会十分漫长，许多细节还有待制定。
en: Of course, this process will be long, and many details remain to be worked out.

zh: 但在英国举行全民公决前就可以实现重要进展 — — 如果欧洲领导人从现在开始真诚地追求这一目标的话。
en: But important progress can be made by the time the UK’s referendum is held – if, that is, EU leaders begin pursuing this goal in earnest now.

zh: 现在正在进行的谈判对于任何一方来说都是不容错失的机会。
en: The talks being held now are an opportunity that neither side can afford to miss.

zh: 故意捣乱的福利制度
en: When Welfare Sabotages Lives

zh: 发自牛津 — — 随着圣诞节的临近，英国正在加速推出只有埃比尼泽·斯克罗吉（Ebenezer Scrooge，狄更斯小说中的一个讨厌圣诞的吝啬鬼）才会喜欢的社会保障计划。
en: OXFORD – As Christmas approaches, the United Kingdom is accelerating the rollout of a social security scheme only Ebenezer Scrooge could love.

zh: “通用福利”计划将取代六种不同的福利待遇 — — 例如儿童税收抵免和住房福利。
en: The “universal credit” program replaces six different welfare benefits – such as the child tax credit and the housing benefit – with one.

zh: 目标是鼓励就业，并创建一个更容易使用的在线系统。
en: The goal is to incentivize employment, and to create an online system that is easier to use.

zh: 这个想法其实不错。
en: That’s the idea, anyway.

zh: 可不幸的是新系统的推出一直都不顺利。
en: Unfortunately, the new system’s rollout has been rocky.

zh: 第一笔福利款需要等待42天才能到账，意味着有些家庭可能要囊中空空地等待六周时间。
en: A minimum 42-day wait for the first payment has meant that some families have been left penniless for as long as six weeks.

zh: 而钱到账后很多受助者都发现自己的福利被削减了。
en: When money has arrived, many recipients have found that their benefits have been reduced.

zh: 在那些通用福利制度广泛实施的地区有越来越多的民众转而向食品银行这类慈善组织求助，因无法支付房租而被赶出住宅的人数也在增加。
en: And in areas where universal credit has been widely implemented, referrals to food banks are increasing, as are evictions.

zh: 但在所有这些夺人眼球的新闻头条之外，英国福利改革还存在一个更深入的，未被报道的问题：与其说是减少贫困，它实际上可能会加剧贫困状况的恶化。
en: But, for all the dramatic headlines, there is a deeper, unreported problem with the UK’s welfare reform: rather than reduce poverty, it could actually exacerbate it.

zh: 哈佛大学经济学教授森迪尔·穆莱纳森（Sendhil Mullainathan）和普林斯顿大学心理学教授埃达尔·沙菲尔（Eldar Shafir）在他们2013年出版的开创性著作《稀缺：为何过度的匮乏影响如此巨大》一书中研究了人们在管理工作，家庭和生活的各类决定条件。
en: In their pioneering 2013 book Scarcity: Why Having Too Little Means So Much, Harvard’s Sendhil Mullainathan and Eldar Shafir of Princeton University examined the conditions under which people make decisions regarding how they manage their jobs, families, and lives.

zh: 而他们的研究会为英国福利体系最新改革的评估提供两点教益。
en: Their study holds two lessons that should be considered in evaluating the latest overhaul of the UK’s welfare system.

zh: 第一个教益是，人们 — — 无论是贫是富 — — 经常都会在缺乏关键资源（如金钱或时间）时做出错误的选择。
en: The first lesson is that people – rich and poor – often make bad choices when they lack a key resource, like money or time.

zh: 例如对于那些资金匮乏的借款人来说利息高得吓人的“发薪日贷款”极具吸引力，即便这些贷款的条款只会令人们在债务中越陷越深 ， 。
en: For example, ruinously expensive “payday loans” can be appealing to cash-strapped borrowers, even if the terms of these loans tend to push people deeper into debt.

zh: 这不是因为人们缺乏教育。
en: This is not because people lack education.

zh: 在几项受控研究中，穆莱纳森和沙菲尔让普林斯顿大学的学生玩一个他们有机会“多借”几秒钟的定时电脑游戏，尽管这样做意味着在总体游戏时间中扣除两倍的时间。
en: In controlled studies, Mullainathan and Shafir asked Princeton University students to play a timed computer game in which they were given the opportunity to “borrow” extra seconds, even though doing so would mean forfeiting double the number of seconds from their overall time.

zh: 许多人都借了这个时间，令穆莱纳森和沙菲尔得出结论：糟糕的决定可能是来自于稀缺和压力。
en: Many took the opportunity, leading Mullainathan and Shafir to conclude that poor decisions can result from conditions of scarcity and stress.

zh: 英国最新的福利改革将推动许多受助者陷入类似的算计，因为许多穷人都被削减了福利。
en: Britain’s latest welfare reforms will push many recipients into a similar calculus, given that many of the poor have had their support reduced.

zh: 这可不是“通用福利”制度的最初目标，但一个试图削减支出的政府总是忍不住去压缩福利。
en: This was not the original goal of the “universal credit” system, but a government seeking to cut spending found slashing welfare to be irresistible.

zh: 其结果就是一个比它所取代的系统少支出30亿英镑（折合40亿美元）的系统。
en: The result is a system that is £3 billion ($4 billion) less generous than the system it replaces.

zh: 据估计约有110万双亲家庭会因此年均少收入2770英镑，而有工作的单亲家庭年均损失1350英镑。
en: It is estimated that some 1.1 million two-parent families will lose an average of £2,770 per year, while working single parents will lose an average of £1,350 per year.

zh: 这些福利的减少很可能会导致一个糟糕的规划和决策周期。
en: These reductions in benefits are likely to perpetuate a cycle of bad planning and decision-making.

zh: 这是一个恶性循环;穷人越是被剥夺了资源，他们的决定就变得越危险。
en: It is a vicious cycle; the more the poor are deprived of resources, the more damaging their decisions can become.

zh: 穆莱纳森和沙菲尔的第二个教益则关于人类的“带宽”限制。
en: A second lesson from Shafir and Mullainathan applies to the limits of human “bandwidth.”

zh: 我们都知道使用手机的驾驶员更容易发生事故，或者在讲座期间使用笔记本电脑的学生内容吸收率较低。
en: We all know that drivers using mobile phones are far more likely to have accidents, or that students using laptops during lectures learn less.

zh: 如果人们的脑力被某些紧迫关注所分散，他们解决问题的表现就会更差。
en: If people’s brainpower is distracted by a pressing concern, they perform worse in problem-solving situations.

zh: 英国的福利制度也是以类似的方式运作；它是一个贪婪的带宽消费者。
en: Britain’s benefit system operates in a similar fashion; it is a voracious consumer of bandwidth.

zh: 例如，2012年福通用福利计划的前身2012年《福利改革法案》规定了当地住房补助和总福利的上限以及住房空置的处罚。
en: For example, the predecessor to the universal credit scheme, the Welfare Reform Act of 2012, created caps to local housing allowances and total benefits, and under-occupancy penalties.

zh: 残疾福利和资格评审也发生了巨大变化。
en: Disability benefits and eligibility tests were also dramatically changed.

zh: 而所有这些“改进”都伴随着其他几十个变化，造成了一场管理制度上的大混乱，既导致带宽紧张，又考验了执行的决心。
en: And all of these “improvements” followed dozens of other changes, creating a maelstrom of bureaucracy that strained bandwidth and tested resolve.

zh: 如今出现的新变化实际上会给受助者造成削弱性的分心，迫使穷人花更多精神精力去使用另一个拥有新规则和程序的系统。
en: Now come the new changes, which, in effect, create debilitating distractions for beneficiaries, forcing the poor to spend even more mental energy navigating yet another system, with new rules and procedures.

zh: 这类似于强迫人们每次开车都使用手机。
en: This is akin to forcing people to use mobile phones every time they drive.

zh: 目前还不清楚那些既要照顾孩子又要上班的人们如何在驾驶一套“让工作者得回报”系统的同时又承担好两个角色。
en: It is unclear how parents and workers navigating a system intended to “make work pay” are supposed to perform either role well.

zh: 英国的新计划被鼓吹为一种降低成本和激励更佳决策的方式，可以使更多的人投入工作，减少福利需求。
en: Britain’s new program was championed as a way to reduce costs and incentivize better decisions, thereby moving more people into work and reducing benefit claims.

zh: 但迄今为止没有什么证据能支持这种乐观设想。
en: But, so far, there is little evidence to support this rosy scenario.

zh: 通过减少穷人获得的福利，政府正在确保稀缺性不断上升以及糟糕决策倍增。
en: By reducing benefits received by the poor, the government is ensuring that scarcity surges and poor decisions multiply.

zh: 在频繁改变福利体系使其更加复杂后，英国领导人也迫使穷人消耗更多的精神带宽。
en: And by changing the system frequently and making it more complicated to access, Britain’s leaders are also forcing the poor to consume more mental bandwidth.

zh: 总而言之，这些因素使得福利受助者变得日益窘迫。
en: Taken together, these factors are leaving welfare recipients worse off.

zh: 决策者应该阅读穆莱纳森和沙菲尔的著作，并考虑如何将他们的研究应用于未来的福利改革。
en: Policymakers should read Mullainathan and Shafir, and consider how their research could be applied to future welfare reforms.

zh: 目标应该是慷慨和稳定的福利，让人们专注于找工作，同时辅导孩子的功课并照顾自己的健康。
en: The goal should be benefits that are generous and stable enough to let people focus on finding work, while also helping their children with homework and looking after their own health.

zh: 这类系统的创建不是不可能的。
en: That type of system is possible to create.

zh: 而另一种办法是给那些最无力承受的人增加负担。
en: The alternative is a system that places additional burdens on those least able to bear them.

zh: 数字脱贫之路
en: The Digital Road From Poverty

zh: 哥本哈根—未来15年，全球社会注意力焦点应该汇聚到何处？
en: COPENHAGEN – Where should the global community focus its attention over the next 15 years?

zh: 健康、营养和教育都是显而易见的选择；比较意外的是，实现宽带普及也应该作为最优先事项。
en: Health, nutrition, and education may seem like obvious choices; more surprisingly, there is a strong case for making broadband access a top priority.

zh: 考虑以下简单的事实：在未来15年将移动互联网普及率提高两倍将让发展中世界增加22万亿美元财富。
en: Consider this simple fact: Tripling mobile Internet access over the next 15 years could make the developing world $22 trillion richer.

zh: 穷人生活和收入潜力的如此改善直接有助于其他挑战；毕竟，更繁荣的民族身体也更健康，吃得也更好，教育程度也更高。
en: Such improvement in the lives and earning potential of poor people could indirectly help with the other challenges; after all, more prosperous people tend to be healthier, better fed, and more highly educated.

zh: 这一讨论很重要，因为全世界193个国家的政府将在9月齐聚联合国，最终确定2030年世界所要实现的发展目标。
en: This discussion matters, because the world’s 193 national governments will meet at the United Nations in September to finalize a list of development targets for the world to meet by 2030.

zh: 我的智库 — — 哥本哈根共识（Copenhagen Consensus）请60组经济学家（其中包括多位诺贝尔经济学奖获得者）研究哪些目标的每一美元收益最大，以帮助此次会议作出最佳选择。
en: My think tank, the Copenhagen Consensus, has asked 60 teams of economists, including several Nobel laureates, to investigate which targets would do the most good for every dollar spent, to help this meeting make the best choices.

zh: 在一份新分析中，图卢兹经济学院（Toulouse School of Economics）的艾曼努尔·奥瑞尔（Emmanuelle Auriol）和亚历克谢·李·冈萨雷斯·范法伦（Alexia Lee González Fanfalone）指出，宽带也许是最好的未来投资。
en: In a new analysis, Emmanuelle Auriol and Alexia Lee González Fanfalone of the Toulouse School of Economics suggest that broadband could be one of the best investments for the future.

zh: 显然，宽带服务的快速推进改变了工业化国家人民的生活；有充分的理由期待发展中国家至少也能获得同样的好处。
en: Clearly, the rapid rollout of broadband services has transformed the lives of people in the industrialized world; there is every reason to expect that developing countries could benefit at least as much.

zh: 比如，获得市场信息可以确保出售剩余庄稼的农民不会被恶劣的贸易商欺骗、渔民可以把收获运往出价最有利的港口。
en: Access to market information, for example, can ensure that farmers selling their surplus crops are not cheated by unscrupulous traders, and that fishermen can land their catch at the port offering the best price.

zh: 一份麦肯锡报告估算，让发展中世界移动宽带达到工业化国家同等水平可以每年增加4,000亿美元全球GDP，多创造一千万个新岗位。
en: A McKinsey report estimates that bringing mobile broadband in the developing world to the levels of the industrial world could add $400 billion annually to global GDP and create more than ten million jobs.

zh: 类似地，世界银行指出，宽带渗透率提高10%可以让中低收入国家GDP增长提高1.4 % 。
en: Similarly, the World Bank has shown that a 10% increase in broadband penetration increased GDP growth by 1.4% in low- to medium-income countries.

zh: 这意味着填补持续存在的发达和发展中地区数字差距可以带来巨大的发展提振作用。
en: This implies that closing the persistent digital divide between the world’s developed and developing regions could give a big boost to development.

zh: 比如，发达地区的移动宽带渗透率为83 % ， 而发展中地区只有21 % 。
en: For example, mobile broadband penetration stands at 83% in the former, but only 21% in the latter.

zh: 尽管欧洲和其他地区的政府一直在投资于更快更好的宽带，但最大的好处将永远来自向从未获得过��带接入的人们提供互联网。 这些人大多生活在发展中和新兴国家。
en: While governments in Europe and elsewhere continue to invest in faster and better broadband, the biggest benefits will always come from providing Internet access to people who do not already have it, most of whom live in developing and emerging countries.

zh: 事实上，发展中国家可以通过直接进入移动宽带实现与发达国家同等的水平，从而避开铺设昂贵的“最后一英里”网络 — — 或接入点 — — 光纤的需要。
en: In fact, developing countries can leap-frog the developed world by going straight to mobile broadband, thereby avoiding the need for expensive fiber-optic cables for the “last mile” – or access point – of the network.

zh: 移动电话正在发展中国家迅速普及，这使得老式固定线路基础设施不再必不可少；数据服务可以使用相同的系统。
en: Mobile phone use is already spreading rapidly in developing countries, making old-style fixed infrastructure unnecessary; data services can use the same system.

zh: 在中国，四分之三的互联网用户已经通过移动电话上网；在埃塞俄比亚和乌干达，这一比例达到了五分之四。
en: In China, three-quarters of Internet users get online via mobile phones already; in Ethiopia and Uganda, four out of five do.

zh: 因此，考虑到移动电话的普及度和移动网络技术的最新进步，普及移动宽带似乎是高性价比的解决之道。
en: Thus, given the pervasiveness of mobile telephony and recent technological advances in mobile networks, rolling out mobile broadband seems a cost-effective solution.

zh: 奥瑞尔和范法伦的研究表明，将发展中地区的移动宽带普及度提高两倍 — — 从21%提高到60 % — —需要花费大约1.3万亿美元巨资，因为要增加三十亿个互联网连接需要大量新增基础设施。
en: The study by Auriol and Fanfalone shows that increasing mobile broadband about three-fold in developing regions – from 21% to 60% – will cost a substantial $1.3 trillion, as a significant amount of extra infrastructure is needed to establish about three billion more Internet connections.

zh: 但这也会增加GDP增长。
en: But it will also increase GDP growth.

zh: 到2020年，这方面的收益将达到每年近5,000亿美元，并将继续逐年递增。
en: By 2020, the benefits would be almost $500 billion annually, and would continue to rise each year.

zh: 在未来十年中，总收益将达到约22万亿美元。
en: Over the coming decades, the total benefit would reach about $22 trillion.

zh: 因此，花在发展中国家移动宽带上的每一美元大约可以带来17美元收益。
en: As a result, every dollar spent on mobile broadband in the developing world would yield an estimated gain of $17.

zh: 这看上去绝对是聪明的投资。
en: That looks like a really smart investment.

zh: 当然，宽带是极其重要的赋能型（enabling）技术，我们很难预测它的全部经济影响，其影响将随地方环境的不同而不同。
en: Of course, broadband is such an important enabling technology that it is difficult to predict its full economic impact, which will vary with local circumstances.

zh: 但是，奥瑞尔-范法伦研究的确表明，增加互联网接入花的钱物有所值。
en: What the Auriol-Fanfalone study does show, though, is that rolling out Internet access is money very well spent.

zh: 就业岗位被直接（在提供网络的组织中）和间接（在供应链组织中）创造出来。
en: Jobs are created directly in the organization providing the network and indirectly in the supply chain.

zh: 一旦建立，宽带将有助于为更广泛的经济创造更多就业岗位。
en: Once in place, broadband helps create more jobs in the wider economy.

zh: 公司的效率和创新力也有所提高。
en: Companies become more efficient and innovative.

zh: 所有这些因素都能增加经济增长速度。
en: All of these factors increase the pace of economic growth.

zh: 除了经济增长和就业创造的直接效应，宽带还能给最不发达国家带来一些重要收益。
en: Apart from the direct effects on economic growth and job creation, broadband can have some other very important benefits for Least Developed Countries.

zh: 九亿人生活在最不发达国家，而伦敦帝国学院的潘特利斯·科特罗姆皮斯（Pantelis Koutroumpis）指出，其中只有6.7%是互联网用户。
en: Nine hundred million people live in LDCs, and, as Pantelis Koutroumpis of Imperial College London points out, only 6.7% are Internet users.

zh: 另一方面，这些人中有近60%使用移动电话。
en: On the other hand, almost 60% of these people use a mobile phone.

zh: 他们可以从智能手机中获益 — — 在手机上装上简单的应用，就可以用于各种健康测试（如心血管疾病、艾滋病和其他病毒以及疟疾 ） ， 结果直接发送到医院并获得即时反馈。
en: They could profit from smartphones with simple adaptations that can be used in a range of health-screening tests (for example, for cardiovascular disease, HIV and other pathogens, or malaria), with the results being sent straight to hospitals for an immediate response.

zh: 移动宽带给最不发达国家带来的潜在好处不仅于此。
en: The potential benefits of mobile broadband for LDCs extend even further.

zh: 互联网接入能提供教育素材、改善教学。
en: Internet access could provide educational material and improve schooling.

zh: 它还能为偏远地区带来实时的、按需提供的交通服务。
en: And it could enable real time, on-demand transport services for remote areas.

zh: 如今，互联网已成为现代世界中极其重要的资源，宽带也成为一项关键技术，带来提振经济增长、让人们摆脱贫困、改善人民健康、营养和教育的效果。
en: With the Internet now such an important resource in the modern world, broadband has become a vital technology, promising to boost economic growth, lift people out of poverty, and improve their health, nutrition, and education.

zh: 当各国政府最终敲定下一阶段的全球发展目标时，绝对应该将宽带接入列入其中。
en: When governments finalize the next set of global development targets, there is now a strong case for broadband access to be among them.

zh: 欧洲的宽带战争
en: Europe’s Broadband Battle

zh: 伦敦—在新欧盟委员会所面临的诸多挑战中，有一项是确定如何在不增税也不让欧洲通信公司破产的情况下为全部5亿欧盟居民带来极速宽带互联网。
en: LONDON – Among the many challenges facing the new European Commission is determining how to provide ultra-fast broadband Internet access to all 500 million European Union residents without raising taxes or bankrupting Europe’s telecommunications companies.

zh: 这一使命让许多人要求谷歌、网飞（Netflix）和Facebook等互联网巨头做出更大贡献，这些公司常常被批评没有起到应有的作用 — — 甚至被猛烈抨击为“免费搭车者 ” ， 想掠夺欧洲资产和市场。
en: This imperative has led many to demand larger contributions from Internet giants like Google, Netflix, and Facebook, which are frequently criticized for failing to pull their weight – and even lambasted as “free-riders,” intent on pillaging European assets and markets.

zh: 这样的批评合理吗？
en: Is this criticism warranted?

zh: 一言以蔽之：不合理。
en: In a word: no.

zh: 现实是大型互联网公司 — — 大部分总部设在美国 — — 已经在投入数十亿美元用于建设和维持对互联网运行至关重要的网络和数据中心。
en: The reality is that major Internet companies – most of which are based in the United States – are already contributing billions of dollars to establish and maintain the networks and data centers that are essential to the Internet’s functioning.

zh: 事实上，这些公司在过去三年直接投资了750多亿欧元的互联网基础设施，在此期间，每年投入都要增加10%左右。
en: In fact, these companies directly invested more than €75 billion ($100 billion) in Internet infrastructure over the last three years, with spending up by about 10% annually over this period.

zh: 此外，它们还合作投资了5亿多欧元用于铺设已于2010年启用的跨太平洋海底光缆和去年投入使用的从东南亚到日本的8,300公里光缆。
en: Moreover, they participated in consortia that invested more than €500 million in laying a trans-Pacific submarine fiber optic cable, which has been operational since 2010, and an 8,300-kilometer (5,200-mile) cable from Southeast Asia to Japan that came on-stream last year.

zh: 但获得全球互联网基础投资最大部分的正是欧洲 — — 过去三年高达250亿欧元，接近总量的三分之一。
en: But it is Europe that has received the lion’s share of global investment in Internet infrastructure – €25 billion, or nearly one-third of the total, in the last three years.

zh: 谷歌最近宣布要在荷兰建设价值6亿欧元的数据中心，并且在芬兰哈米纳（Hamina）和比利时圣吉斯兰（St. Ghislain）已开始投入重金建设数据中心。
en: Google recently announced the construction of a new €600 million data center in the Netherlands, and is already investing heavily in data centers in Hamina, Finland, and St. Ghislain, Belgium.

zh: Facebook也在瑞典吕勒欧（Luleå）建立了自己的数据中心。
en: And Facebook has already established its own data center in Luleå, Sweden.

zh: 这些设施和网络 — — 以及通信公司花数十亿美元建设的宽带网络 — — 构成了互联网的基础。
en: These facilities and networks – along with the broadband networks on which telecommunications companies spend billions – form the foundations of the Internet.

zh: 美国互联网巨头投资者写设施，为欧洲消费者和公司带来了看得见摸得着的好处。
en: By investing in them, America’s Internet giants are providing tangible benefits for European consumers and companies.

zh: 鼓励这类投资应该成为欧盟委员会的主要关注点。
en: Encouraging this investment should be the European Commission’s main concern.

zh: 比如，这些公司的欧洲数据中心有助于所在地区的经济，为当地居民提供工作岗位。
en: For example, these companies’ European data centers contribute to the economies of the regions where they operate, providing jobs to local residents.

zh: 与此同时，它们促进了更顺利的内容交换，让欧洲消费者能够实现大部分互联网连接。
en: At the same time, they facilitate the smooth exchange of content, enabling European consumers to make the most of their Internet connections.

zh: 类似地，互联网公司在内容传递网络和互联网交换点方面的投资让它们能够让自己的信息流更加接近消费者，交给伦敦、巴黎和法兰克福等地的欧洲通信公司。
en: Likewise, Internet companies’ investments in content-delivery networks and Internet exchange points enable them to carry their own traffic close to consumers, handing it off to EU telecoms in places like London, Paris, and Frankfurt.

zh: 如此，它们可以帮助互联网服务提供商削减成本，使之能够投资于自己拥有和经营的“最后一英里”网络接入，从而改善它们提供给消费者的互联网体验。
en: In doing so, they can help Internet service providers to cut costs and enable them to invest in the “last mile” access networks that they own and operate, thereby improving the Internet experience that they offer to consumers.

zh: 从长期看，随着欧洲日益成为数字内容和应用的沃土，这一基础设施将能够让欧洲人得以在全球散播发明创造。
en: In the longer term, as Europe becomes increasingly fertile ground for digital content and applications, this infrastructure will enable Europeans to distribute their creations globally.

zh: 换句话说，谷歌和Facebook等公司今天所建立的结构将有助于为欧洲创新家、企业家和公司打开新市场，而它们的成功将直接有助于欧洲经济。
en: In other words, the structures that companies like Google and Facebook are building today will help to open new markets for European innovators, entrepreneurs, and companies, whose success will directly benefit Europe’s economy.

zh: 欧洲通信公司和来自美国和其他地区的互联网巨头以及公共部门决不能将能量和资源浪费在彼此的斗争上，而应该认识到在给所有欧盟居民创造高速平价宽带互联网中的共同利益。
en: Instead of wasting energy and resources fighting one another, Europe’s telecoms and Internet giants from the US and elsewhere, together with the public sector, should recognize their shared interest in delivering fast, affordable broadband Internet to all EU residents.

zh: 互联网一直是一项合作运动，未来也必须如此，每一位参与者都起着作用。
en: The Internet has always been a collaborative endeavor, and it must remain so, with each actor playing its role.

zh: 在整个过程中，创造性解决方案将成为主宰，而互联网公司的贡献将是不可估量的。
en: Throughout the process, creative solutions will be paramount, and Internet companies’ contributions will be invaluable.

zh: 毕竟，它们是老练的创新者，谷歌与沃达丰（Vodafone）在新西兰以及与西班牙电信（Telefónica）在智利合作通过大气气球为农村地区提供宽带就是明证。
