en: After all, they are seasoned innovators, as exemplified by Google’s collaboration with Vodafone in New Zealand and Telefónica in Chile to deliver broadband to rural areas through atmospheric balloons.

zh: 至于欧盟委员会，它决不能允许既得利益的压力促使其走向对峙。
en: For its part, the European Commission must not allow pressure from vested interests to drive it toward confrontation.

zh: 相反，欧盟领导人应该继续专注于欧洲数百万互联网用户的利益。
en: Instead, EU leaders should remain focused on the interests of Europe’s millions of Internet users.

zh: 唯有采取基于事实的平衡方针和强调合作，他们才能带来消费者的好处、投资、就业和欧洲互联网行业的成长。
en: Only by adopting a balanced, fact-based approach and an emphasis on cooperation can they deliver consumer benefits, investment, jobs, and growth in Europe’s Internet sector.

zh: 被破坏的叙利亚儿童承诺
en: Broken Promises for Syria’s Children

zh: 伦敦—如果你失去了希望的力量 — — 更不用说永不放弃的重要性 — — 你应该用穆罕默德·科沙（Mohammed Kosha）的故事激励自己。
en: LONDON – If you ever lose faith in the power of hope, not to mention the importance of never giving up, remind yourself of the story of Mohammed Kosha.

zh: 这位16岁的叙利亚难民现在生活在黎巴嫩，为了取的好成绩，他克服了大部分人难以想象的困难。
en: A 16-year-old Syrian refugee living in Lebanon, Mohammed has overcome obstacles that most of us cannot even imagine, in order to excel in his education.

zh: 世界领导人应该引起注意。
en: World leaders should take note.

zh: 四年前，穆罕默德和全家为了躲避叙利亚武装力量持续不断的炮击而逃离了位于大马士革市郊达尔亚（Darya）镇的家。
en: Four years ago, Mohammed and his family fled their home in the town of Darya, a suburb of Damascus, to escape relentless bombardment by Syrian armed forces.

zh: 在家乡，由于上学太危险，他已经落下了一年小学功课，当全家到达他们现在居住的黎巴嫩后，他又有一年时间没能上学。
en: Having already lost a year of primary education in his hometown, where it was simply too dangerous to attend school, he then spent another year out of the classroom when the family arrived in Lebanon, where they now reside.

zh: 黎巴嫩政府向难民开放本国公立学校后，穆罕默德的生活发生了变化。
en: Mohammed’s life changed when Lebanon’s government opened the country’s public schools to refugees.

zh: 教室拥挤不堪，授课用的是英语，这意味着他必须得学习一门新语言。
en: Classes were not only crowded; they were also conducted in English, meaning that he would have to learn a new language.

zh: 但穆罕默德抓住了学习的机会，一头扎进了功课中。
en: But Mohammed seized the opportunity to learn, and threw himself into his studies.

zh: 上个月，排除万难的他在黎巴嫩初中升学考试中取得第二名的好成绩。
en: Last month, against all odds, he scored the second-highest marks in Lebanon’s Brevet secondary-school exam.

zh: 他的故事还没有完。
en: And he is not done yet.

zh: 穆罕默德知道，教育是构建更美好未来的关键。
en: Mohammed knows that education is the key to building a better future.

zh: 用他的话说 ， “ 学习给我希望。
en: In his words, “Learning gives us hope.”

zh: ”世界领导人有他一半的智慧就好了。
en: If only world leaders had even a fraction of his wisdom.

zh: 已经有了一些令人鼓舞的信号。
en: There have been some encouraging signals.

zh: 在2月份 伦敦的会议上，国际出资者认识到教育对难民的重要性，承诺到2017年底让所有叙利亚难民儿童上学。
en: At a meeting in London in February, international donors recognized the importance of education for refugees, promising to get all of Syria’s refugee children into school by the end of 2017.

zh: 它们甚至承诺投入14亿美元用于实现这一目标。
en: They even pledged $1.4 billion to achieve that goal.

zh: 这是一个面向非常脆弱的儿童群体的宏大承诺。
en: It was an ambitious promise to a group of highly vulnerable children.

zh: 如今，大约一百万5—17岁叙利亚难民儿童 — — 约占总数的一半 — — 辍学。
en: Today, about one million Syrian refugee children aged 5-17 – roughly half the total – are out of school.

zh: 即使有学可上，绝大部分也进不了中学。
en: And most of those who are in school will drop out before starting their secondary education.

zh: 在仅仅一代小学教育的时间里，叙利亚遭到了也许是史上最严重的教育倒退。
en: In the space of a single primary-school generation, Syria has suffered what may be the greatest education reversal in history.

zh: 叙利亚儿童入学率远远低于撒哈拉以南非洲的地区平均水平。
en: Enrollment rates for the country’s children are now well below the regional average for sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 但如今，仅仅六个月后，所有难民接受教育的承诺眼看就要破产，击碎数百万叙利亚人的希望。
en: But now, just six months later, the promise of education for all refugees is about to be broken, dashing the hopes of millions of Syrians.

zh: 今年，联合国人道主义机构紧急教育援助需要6.62亿美元资金，目��只有39%已经到位。
en: Just 39% of the $662 million in urgent education aid sought by United Nations humanitarian agencies this year has been funded.

zh: 而在今天公布的Theirworld报告中指出，伦敦会议上所承诺的14亿美元只兑现了一小部分。
en: And as documented in a Theirworld report published today, only a fraction of the $1.4 billion pledged in London has been delivered.

zh: 在国际社会逃避责任的同时，叙利亚的邻国继续以极大的努力解决这场危机。
en: As the international community shirks its responsibilities, Syria’s neighbors have continued to make extraordinary efforts to address the crisis.

zh: 黎巴嫩、约旦以及（在较小程度上）土耳其向叙利亚难民开放了公立学校。
en: Lebanon, Jordan, and (to a lesser extent) Turkey have opened up their public schools to Syrian refugees.

zh: 但这些国家的教育体系在危机前便捉襟见肘，根本无法承担它们如今被迫承担的负担。
en: But these countries’ education systems, which were strained even before the crisis, cannot handle the burden that they are being forced to shoulder.

zh: 目前，叙利亚难民占了黎巴嫩公立学校学生总数的三分之一。
en: Syrian refugees now comprise one-third of all Lebanese public-school students.

zh: 这好比是美国小学突然间必须接收所有墨西哥儿童。
en: This is like the American primary-school system suddenly having to absorb all of Mexico’s children.

zh: 教师、教室和教科书严重不足，无法给难民儿童提供像样的教育。
en: There are simply not enough teachers, classrooms, or textbooks to deliver decent educations to the refugee children.

zh: 2月份的会议本应产生能够减轻叙利亚邻国负担的方案。
en: The February conference was supposed to produce solutions that would ease the burden on Syria’s neighbors.

zh: 东道国政府做好了自己的部分，提前计划好如何为难民儿童提供全民教育。
en: Host-country governments did their part, preparing in advance their plans for delivering universal education to refugee children.

zh: 接着，它们还与出资者合作制定覆盖全体辍学儿童和提高教育质量的全面战略。
en: They then worked with donors to develop comprehensive strategies for reaching all out-of-school children and raising the quality of education.

zh: 但是，由于国际社会没有兑现承诺，进展十分缓慢；甚至可能倒退。
en: Yet, with the international community having failed to hold up its end of the bargain, progress has not just stalled; it could be reversed.

zh: 如今，超过80,000在黎巴嫩学校上学的叙利亚难民有可能失去学习机会。
en: More than 80,000 Syrian refugees now in school in Lebanon are at risk of losing their places.

zh: 叙利亚难民所遭受的教育危机的人道后果不容忽视。
en: The human consequences of the education crisis among Syrian refugees are impossible to miss.

zh: 在黎巴嫩贝卡谷（Bekaa Valley）种蔬菜和在土耳其（那里由五十万难民辍学）服装厂工作的童工数量激增。
en: They are apparent in the growing army of child laborers picking vegetables in Lebanon’s Bekaa Valley or working at garment factories in Turkey, where a half-million refugees are out of school.

zh: 难民家庭仍然在冒着生命危险前往欧洲，为的就是让他们的孩子获得受教育的机会。
en: They are also reflected in the continuing flow of refugee families making the perilous journey to Europe, driven by the hope that their children will have educational opportunities there.

zh: 但许多欧洲政府继续投资铁丝网和集中营，而不是学校和教师。
en: Yet many European governments continue to invest in razor wire and detention centers, rather than in schools and teachers.

zh: 我们可以换一种做法 — — 但时间紧迫。
en: There is an alternative – but the clock is ticking.

zh: 下个月，联合国和美国将主办新一轮难民峰会。
en: Next month, the UN and the United States will host another round of refugee summits.

zh: 在此次峰会上，政府可以抛弃车轱辘式的承诺和信誓旦旦的说辞，而应该拿出切实计划兑现它们所承诺的14亿美元。
en: This time, governments can leave their recycled promises and heady rhetoric at home; instead, they should carry with them concrete plans to deliver the $1.4 billion they have already pledged.

zh: 国际社会还必须反思如何进行援助。
en: The international community must also rethink how aid is delivered.

zh: 叙利亚危机不会很快结束。
en: The Syrian crisis will not end any time soon.

zh: 注资人不应该通过不可靠、资金不足的年度人道主义呼吁提供援助，而应该提供可预测的多年期融资，如英国所做的那样。
en: Instead of delivering aid through unreliable, underfunded annual humanitarian appeals, donors need to provide predictable multi-year funding, as the United Kingdom has done.

zh: 更一般地说，欧盟和世界银行应该扩大和强化它们对教育的支持。
en: More generally, the European Union and the World Bank should expand and intensify their support for education.

zh: 当然，更多的教育捐助融资只是一部分。
en: Of course, more donor finance for education is only part of the equation.

zh: 东道国政府不管多么捉襟见肘，总可以也应该多做一些。
en: There is more that host-country governments, however overstretched, can and should be doing.

zh: 首先，它们应该致力于打消叙利亚儿童所面临的语言障碍。
en: For starters, they should be working to remove the language barriers facing Syrian children.

zh: 它们还可以通过临时招聘叙利亚难民教师来缓解教师严重不足的情况。
en: They could also address chronic teacher shortages through expedient recruitment of Syrian refugee teachers.

zh: 最重要的是，东道国政府可以帮助难民更加安全和自立，这主要可以通过提高他们的法律地位和扩大他们的工作权利实现。
en: Above all, host governments could help refugees become more secure and self-reliant, notably by upgrading their legal status and expanding the right to work.

zh: 但是，说到底，难民教育危机的可信应对措施必须包括更公平的负担共担机制。
en: Ultimately, though, a credible response to the refugee education crisis must involve a fairer approach to burden-sharing.

zh: 在下个月的联合国峰会即将到来之际，各国政府应该回顾它们在伦敦会上作出的承诺。
en: Before heading for the UN summit treadmill next month, governments should review the promises they made at the London conference.

zh: 它们还应该回忆一下纳尔逊·曼德拉的名言 ： “ 对儿童的承诺永远不能破坏。 ”
en: And they should recall Nelson Mandela’s dictum: “Promises to children should never be broken.”

zh: 从‘研究’到‘开发’的更好方法
en: A Better Way from ‘R’ to ‘D’

zh: 华盛顿贝尔维尤 — — 在商业领袖汇聚一堂探讨行业创新时，他们往往将重点放在改善基础研究或建设技术中心及孵化器的政府资助行动上。
en: BELLEVUE, WASHINGTON – When business leaders get together to talk about innovating their industries, they typically focus on initiatives like improving government funding for basic research, or building technology hubs and incubators.

zh: 但上述讨论往往缺乏最终产品这一“创新”的关键元素。
en: But a crucial element of “innovation” is often absent from these discussions: the final products.

zh: 这并非疏忽。
en: That’s no oversight.

zh: 恰恰相反，缺乏以产品为核心的讨论恰恰表明几乎所有行业和大大小小的企业所面临的问题要严重的多。
en: On the contrary, the lack of product-focused discussion is symptomatic of a far more serious problem facing businesses of all sizes in nearly every industry.

zh: 简言之，产品开发在创新战略中处于次要地位，因为创意和商业化之间的金融联系被切断了。
en: Simply put, product development takes a back seat in innovation strategy because the financial link between ideation and commercialization is broken.

zh: 要想实现经济繁荣，需要推动好的理念走向市场。
en: For economies to prosper, good ideas need a nudge getting to market.

zh: 毕竟创新产品让生活更健康、更高效也更快乐。
en: Innovative products are, after all, what makes life healthier, more efficient, and more fun.

zh: 但有充分的证据表明开发 — — 也就是研发中的“发 ” — —并未能够跟上“研究 ” — —也就是现代研究惊人的发展速度。
en: But there’s ample evidence to suggest that development – the “D” in R&D – has not kept pace with the blistering speed of “R” – modern-day research.

zh: 就连最强劲的经济体也存在永远无法接触消费者的过剩的想法。
en: Even the most robust economies have a surplus of ideas that never reach consumers.

zh: 比如在美国，仅有5%的活跃专利可以发放许可证或商业化。
en: In the US, for example, just 5% of all active patents are ever licensed or commercialized.

zh: 多数企业付诸应用的发明还不到其拥有专利的四分之一。
en: Most companies use less than a quarter of the inventions they own.

zh: 学术界技术转让的形势也同样严峻。
en: Technology transfers from academia aren’t going so well, either.

zh: 尽管自1969年以来美国大学已经被授予超过75，000项专利 — — 但绝大多数负责管理学校知识产权成果的技术转让部门所得收入甚至无法弥补其自身的运营支出。
en: Although more than 75,000 patents have been issued to American universities since 1969, the vast majority of technology transfer offices – administrative units that manage a school’s intellectual-property output – are failing to generate enough revenue even to cover their operating costs.

zh: 如果想扭转上述趋势并最大限度地提高创新产出，我们需要更多机制来为聪明的理念提供商业化资助。
en: If we want to reverse these trends and maximize innovation output, we need more mechanisms for funding the commercialization of smart ideas.

zh: 目前，风险资本支持的创业企业是从研究转向开发的标准机制。
en: At the moment, venture capital-backed startups are the standard mechanism for moving from “R” to “D.”

zh: 这些企业成立的全部目的就是要推动好的理念进入开发渠道。
en: These companies are formed for the sole purpose of pushing good ideas through the development pipeline.

zh: 而且，考虑到某些创业企业估值很高，人们很容易认为由精明企业和风险投资资金所组成的健康生态系统是确保创新所需要的全部因素。
en: And, given the stellar valuations of some startups, it’s easy to assume that a healthy ecosystem of savvy companies and venture capital funding is all that is needed to ensure innovation.

zh: 但多数企业根本无法将好的理念推向市场，因为它们缺乏获得创新资金的渠道。
en: But most companies are simply unable to take good ideas to market, because they lack access to pools of capital earmarked for innovation.

zh: 中小企业（SMEs）往往很难获得融资来建设研发基础设施。
en: Small- and medium-size enterprises (SMEs) often struggle to secure financing to build R&D infrastructure.

zh: 跨国企业利用留存收益作为研发资金，但因为这种方法可能对企业股票估值造成负面影响，所以就连他们往往都对推动新理念持保守态度。
en: Multinational corporations use retained earnings to finance R&D, but because this approach can adversely affect a company’s stock valuation, even they tend to be conservative in pushing new ideas forward.

zh: 下面我们将这种方案与跨国公司融资基础设施的投资方式进行比较。
en: Compare that scenario with the way that multinationals finance infrastructure investments.

zh: 比方说，假设杜邦想要建设一家新的制造厂。
en: Let’s say, for example, that DuPont wanted to build a new manufacturing facility.

zh: 它可以从银行借款，之后用所得的利润进行偿付。
en: It could borrow money from a bank and repay it from resulting profits.

zh: 但如果杜邦需要资金在现有工厂生产一种新化学品，那么它无法获得贷款，因为银行不知道创新产品的风险评估方法（无论是涉及化工行业还是其他 ） 。
en: But if DuPont needed capital to produce a new chemical in an existing plant, it couldn’t get a loan, because banks don’t know how to assess the risks of innovative products (in the chemical industry or any other).

zh: 除非你是像Alphabet、苹果或特斯拉那样的巨星企业，否则你无法证明一项蓝天研发计划是合理的。
en: Unless you’re a giant like Alphabet, Apple, or Tesla, you can’t justify the risk and expense of a blue-sky R&D program.

zh: 现在就连规模最大的企业也更乐意收购一项已经打包好的新技术，而不是进行内部研发。
en: These days even the biggest companies are more likely to acquire a new, pre-packaged technology than to develop it in-house.

zh: 这也是为什么兼并和收购越来越普遍的一个理由（这还能够解释为什么有些观察家把兼并收购看成一种新的研发 ） 。
en: That’s one reason why mergers and acquisitions are increasingly common (and why some observers see M&As as the new R&D).

zh: 这种状况对投资者而言同样并不理想。
en: This situation isn’t ideal for investors, either.

zh: 比如索尼公司的PlayStation游戏机项目。
en: Consider the case of Sony’s PlayStation gaming console.

zh: PlayStation的研发在二十世纪九十年代吸引了投资者的广泛关注。
en: Development of the PlayStation attracted considerable attention from investors in the 1990s.

zh: 但支持研发计划的唯一方法是购买母公司的股票 — — 而母公司还包括音乐、电影、相机和电视等业务。
en: But the only way to back the project was to buy shares in the parent company—which encompassed music, film, camera, and television businesses as well.

zh: 这样的错配对企业而言像对投资者一样低效。
en: This sort of misalignment is just as inefficient for companies as it is for investors.

zh: 而且对小企业这甚至算不上一项选择；小企业出售股权难度很大。
en: And it’s not even an option for smaller companies; selling equity is hard when you’re an SME.

zh: 显而易见，目前的融资模式扼杀了产品创新和投资，几乎完全冻结了中小企业。
en: Clearly, current funding models stifle product-specific innovation and investment, and all but freeze out SMEs.

zh: 与我谈论这个问题的政府官员更关注保持国内中小企业的健康，而不是跨国企业的保护，他们这么做理由非常充分：无论哪里的中小企业都在就业和岗位创造方面都占据绝大多数份额。
en: The government officials with whom I speak are more concerned with maintaining the health of their countries’ SMEs than protecting multinational corporations, for good reason: SMEs everywhere account for an overwhelming share of employment and job creation.

zh: 但它们却无法得到应有的融资机会。
en: Yet they aren’t getting the financing opportunities they deserve.

zh: 为了扭转这种局面，企业需要将融资工具与产品开发挂钩。
en: To turn things around, businesses need financing vehicles tied to product development.

zh: 一种方法是设立债权基金，并将相关债券与可预测的新产品收入回报相挂钩。
en: One idea is debt-based funds offering bonds with more predictable returns based on revenue from new products.

zh: 这类基金可以设计成在各类项目或行业之间分散风险，这可能提高它们对躲避高风险投资的投资者的吸引力。
en: These funds could be structured to distribute risk among a variety of projects or sectors, which might make them more attractive to investors who avoid high-stakes venture financing.

zh: 这种基金也可以在投资人和创新项目之间达成更紧密的一致。
en: This kind of funding would also enable much closer alignment between investors and innovative projects.

zh: 拥有良好记录、技术能力、经验丰富的管理团队和既有销售渠道的企业是任何国家都不能浪费的创新资源。
en: Companies with proven track records, technical skills, experienced management teams, and established sales channels are sources of innovation that no country can afford to squander.

zh: 现有融资机制的局限性意味着国家正在白白浪费机会。
en: The limitations of the current financing regime mean that countries are letting opportunity pass them by.

zh: 尽管产品商业化现成的机会很少，但全世界的企业、研究机构、大学及政府实验室合起来每年投入超过1万亿美元用于研发。
en: Despite few ready avenues for product commercialization, the world’s companies, research institutes, and university and government laboratories together spend more than a trillion dollars on R&D annually.

zh: 如果没有产品融资的新方式，他们的多数发现都将被束之高阁。
en: Without a new approach to product financing, most of what they discover will remain on the shelf.

zh: 美国领导力长盛不衰
en: America’s Enduring Leadership

zh: 华盛顿—许多观察者把乌克兰危机作为美国全球影响力收缩和衰退的又一例证。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Many observers have cited the crisis in Ukraine as yet another example of American retrenchment and declining global influence.

zh: 一些人还把它视为俄罗斯领衔动员主要新兴经济体 — — 巴西、印度和中国对抗西方的证据。
en: Some have also interpreted it as evidence of a Russian-led effort to mobilize the major emerging economies – Brazil, India, and China – against the West.

zh: 这两种说法都不无道理，但都有些夸张，与此类似的还有美国决定和捍卫安全、繁荣的国际制度的能力正在衰退的观点。
en: While there is a kernel of truth in both narratives, each is a gross exaggeration, as is the notion that America’s capacity to shape a secure and prosperous international system is in decline.

zh: 美国最近几年不是很顺，在经历了两场漫长而艰苦的战争后，它开始从阿富汗缓慢地撤军。
en: The US has had a rough few years. After two long, draining wars, its withdrawal from Afghanistan is inching along slowly.

zh: 在叙利亚，俄罗斯和中国的从中作梗使美国无法找到外交解决途径。
en: In Syria, Russian and Chinese intransigence have frustrated its efforts to find a diplomatic solution.

zh: 中国在东海和南海自信心的日益增长正在威胁美国的地区主宰力，同时也给美国的紧密盟友日本带来了危机风险。
en: And China’s growing assertiveness in the South and East China Seas is threatening US regional dominance, while raising the risk of a crisis with America’s close ally Japan.

zh: 与此同时，美国的许多欧洲盟友陷入了经济困境。
en: Meanwhile, many of America’s European allies are mired in economic malaise.

zh: 此外，尽管美国经济正在从全球金融危机中复苏，但其财政状况和名誉都遭到了重大打击。
en: And, though the US economy is recovering from the global financial crisis, America’s treasury and reputation has been dealt a severe blow.

zh: 尽管如此，美国仍是最有影响力的全球行动者 — — 不仅是因为它所保持的强大联盟。
en: Nonetheless, the US remains the most influential global actor – not least because of the strong alliances that it maintains.

zh: 对中国经济崛起的关注 — — 还有印度和巴西，尽管不如中国那样耀眼 — — 让人忽略了韩国、土耳其、印尼和德国等美国盟友的成功。
en: All of the attention given to China’s economic rise – and, to a lesser extent, that of India and Brazil – has overshadowed the success of US allies like South Korea, Turkey, Indonesia, and Germany.

zh: 事实上，世界上最强盛经济体绝大多数都是美国的盟友。
en: In fact, the vast majority of the world’s strongest economies are allied with the US.

zh: 此外，新兴大国远未结成反西方联盟，而仍然各自为政。
en: Moreover, far from coalescing into a united anti-Western bloc, the emerging powers remain sharply divided.

zh: 现有大国和新兴大国之间存在着纵横交错的利益联系，紧密程度远胜过“西方对抗其他国家”说；事实上，崛起大国与西方国家之间的共同利益往往不亚于它们彼此之间。
en: There are far more overlapping interests between the established and the emerging powers than the “West versus the rest” narrative suggests; indeed, the rising powers often share as many interests with their Western counterparts as they do with each other.

zh: 基于此，即便是非美国盟友的经济超级大国也不想颠覆现有世界秩序，而是希望在其中获得更大份额，比如增加在国际机构中的权威。
en: Given this, even the economic powerhouses that are not US allies do not want to upend the existing world order, but rather to gain more space within it, such as through increased authority in international institutions.

zh: 毕竟，它们之所以崛起，正是因为它们融入了全球经济体系中。
en: After all, they rose precisely by integrating themselves into the global economic system.

zh: 即使是有可能在某些领域削弱美国领导力的中国在许多外交政策问题上也别无选择，只能与美国及其盟友合作。
en: Even China, which arguably seeks to curtail US leadership in some domains, has no choice but to cooperate with the US and its allies on many foreign-policy issues.

zh: 只有在其他国家追随的情况下中国才能挑战美国的领导力，而如今它很难找到追随者。
en: China can challenge American leadership only if others follow it, and so far it has found few takers.

zh: 只有俄罗斯更积极地扮演着动摇性角色 — — 在全球金融危机、叙利亚和如今的乌克兰都是如此。
en: Only Russia has sought to play a more destabilizing role – during the global financial crisis, in Syria, and now in Ukraine.

zh: 平心而论，新兴大国之间确实都有对抗倾向 — — 或至少有自主倾向 — — 这植根于可以被称为“崛起心理”的东西。
en: To be sure, the emerging powers do share a strong inclination toward rivalry – or at least toward autonomy – which is rooted in what might be called the “psychology of rise.”

zh: 但它们知道，过于对抗性的反美立场会影响到它们在稳定的全球经济中的利益，不利于它们的商品和恩呢高原在国际海运和空运路线安全通行。
en: But they know that an excessively aggressive stance toward the US would undermine their interest in a stable global economy and the safe passage of their goods and energy through international sea and air routes.

zh: 中国尤其如此，因为其国内稳定和国际影响力在很大程度上取决于其保持高速经济增长的能力，这就需要日益大量的进口能源和其他天然资源。
en: This is particularly true for China, because its domestic stability and international influence depend largely on its ability to maintain rapid economic growth, which demands ever-larger quantities of imported energy and other natural resources.

zh: 为了保证不受阻碍地获得这些关键资源，中国需要资源来源国、投资市场目标国以及供给国与其本土之间航路的稳定性。
en: To ensure unimpeded access to these critical resources, China needs stability in the countries from which it can extract them, in the markets in which it can invest, and in the routes linking China to its suppliers.

zh: 但中国维持这些条件的能力非常有限 — — 在一些地区（如波斯湾 ） ， 它严重依赖美国的军事实力。
en: But China’s capacity to maintain these conditions is extremely limited – and in some cases (as in the Persian Gulf), it is heavily dependent on US military power.

zh: 简言之，在推动敌对和鼓励克制之间寻找平衡是当代国际关系最重要的动态。
en: In short, striking a balance between the impulse toward rivalry and incentives encouraging restraint is the most important dynamic in contemporary international affairs.

zh: 而如今，全球平衡正在导向克制。
en: And, for now, the global balance is tipping toward restraint.

zh: 当然，美国将一直面临新挑战，乌克兰就是明证。
en: Of course, the US will invariably face new challenges, all of which are on vivid display in Ukraine.

zh: 各国将在维持与美国的安全联系以及构建与中国的新经济联系之间权衡。
en: Countries will be torn between retaining their security ties to the US and building new economic linkages with China.

zh: 让美国利益牵涉其中的复杂的全球体系将考验美国外交。
en: The complex global systems in which America’s interests are enmeshed will test US diplomacy.

zh: 也许最危险的挑战是新兴大国越来越倾向于自主而非结盟。
en: Perhaps the most dangerous challenge is the prospect of emerging powers leaning increasingly toward autonomy, instead of alliance.

zh: 中国和印度或许不满于俄罗斯在乌克兰的行动，但新兴经济体都不会在联合国安理会上投票反对俄罗斯，即使投票说到底没有什么意义。
en: China and India may not have been happy about Russia’s actions in Ukraine, but none of the emerging economies could bring itself to vote against Russia in the United Nations General Assembly, even though the vote was ultimately meaningless.

zh: （中国在安理会中最喜欢弃权。
en: (China took the strongest position in the Security Council by abstaining.)

zh: ）它们不与俄罗斯穿一条裤子；但也不加入西方阵营孤立俄罗斯。
en: They are not sticking with Russia; but they are not joining a Western effort to isolate Russia, either.

zh: 但是，最终，不断演化的世界有利于美国最重要的优势：与范围广泛、相关性极低的国家结成联盟的独特能力。
en: Ultimately, however, the world’s relentless evolution plays to America’s most important strength: its unique ability to build broad and disparate coalitions.

zh: 美国所建立的联盟和关系范围 — — 包括其与一些崛起大国之间的关系 — — 是任何其他全球行动方无法比拟的，并且在可预见的未来继续保持这一优势。
en: The range of alliances and relationships that the US has created, including with several of the rising powers, far surpasses that of any other global actor – and will continue to do so for the foreseeable future.

zh: 这或许是美国实力最长盛不衰的特征。
en: This is perhaps the most enduring feature of American power.

zh: 不可否认，美国已不再享有冷战结束时无人可以撼动的超级大国地位。
en: There is no denying that the US no longer enjoys the unrivaled hyperpower status that it did at the end of the Cold War.

zh: 但是，随着时间的流逝，国际体系仍由美国领导。
en: But, for the time being, the international system remains America’s to lead.

zh: 泡沫的测定
en: Bubble Spotting

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 作为一个在市场投机方面略有论述的评论者，人们总会问我：下一场大规模投机泡沫何时发生？
en: NEW HAVEN – People frequently ask me, as someone who has written on market speculation, where the next big speculative bubble is likely to be.

zh: 是在住宅市场卷土重来，还是转移到股票市场兴风作浪？
en: Will it be in housing again? Will it be in the stock market?

zh: 虽然我对此总会有一些预感，但也无法给出答案，事实上根本没人能准确预测泡沫的来临。
en: I don’t know, though I have some hunches. It is impossible for anyone to predict bubbles accurately.

zh: 在我看来，泡沫是一种社会流行病，由某种人与人之间的互相传染而催生。
en: In my view, bubbles are social epidemics, fostered by a sort of interpersonal contagion.

zh: 当某种观念的“传染率”升高到足以支撑泡沫的程度，泡沫便应运而生了，问题是这种传染率的高低取决于人们的思维模式，而后者是极难进行判断的。
en: A bubble forms when the contagion rate goes up for ideas that support a bubble. But contagion rates depend on patterns of thinking, which are difficult to judge.

zh: 大规模的投机泡沫其实极少发生。
en: Big speculative bubbles are rare events.

zh: （类似某只股票的股价这样的小型价格泡沫则是家常便饭，也不能作为问题的答案。
en: (Little bubbles, in the price of, say, individual stocks, happen all the time, and don’t qualify as an answer to the question.)

zh: ）与此同时，由于大规模泡沫往往持续经年，预测它们就等于要预测未来数年内会发生何事，难度堪比预测两届大选过后的美国总统人选。
en: And, because big bubbles last for many years, predicting them means predicting many years in the future, which is a bit like predicting who will be running the government two elections from now.

zh: 但有些领域似乎比其他领域更容易产生泡沫。
en: But some places appear a little more likely than others to give rise to bubbles.

zh: 股票市场在逻辑上首当其中，因为这是个高杠杆投资行为 — — 而且自诞生以来就不乏泡沫。
en: The stock market is the first logical place to look, as it is a highly leveraged investment – and has a history of bubbles.

zh: 该市场光在上个世纪就出现了3次大规模资产泡沫：1920年代，1960年代和1990年代。
en: There have been three colossal stock-market bubbles in the last century: the 1920’s, the 1960’s, and the 1990’s.

zh: 相比之下美国的住宅市场在过去这100年只有一次泡沫，那是在21世纪的第一个十年。
en: In contrast, there has been only one such bubble in the United States’ housing market in the last hundred years, that of the 2000’s.

zh: 全球股票市场已经从2009年的谷底实现了彻底反弹。
en: We have had a huge rebound from the bottom of the world’s stock markets in 2009.

zh: 标准普尔500指数已较2009年3月9日的点位实质上涨了87 % 。
en: The S&P 500 is up 87% in real terms since March 9 of that year.

zh: 但当屡战屡败的股票市场预测者们尝试判断这场反弹还能持续多久的时候，它其实不像是一场泡沫，而更像是某种萧条恐慌的终结。
en: But, while the history of stock-market prediction is littered with too much failure to try to decide whether the bounceback will continue much longer, it doesn’t look like a bubble, but more like the end of a depression scare.

zh: 股票价格的上涨并未伴随着人们口耳相传的“新时代”财富故事，却更像是一场“死里逃生”的历险记。
en: The rise in equity prices has not come with a contagious “new era” story, but rather a “sigh of relief” story.

zh: 同样，世界某些地方（特别是中国，巴西和加拿大）的住宅价格也在过去一两年出现了可观上涨，而另外许多地方的房价也有上涨的可能。
en: Likewise, home prices have been booming over the past year or two in several places, notably China, Brazil, and Canada, and prices could still be driven up in many other places.

zh: 但那些刚刚遭遇房价泡沫爆破的国家则不太会产生另一场房价泡沫,因为趋向保守的政府政策可能会减少对住房的补贴，而这些国家当前的市场气氛似乎也无法催生泡沫。
en: But another housing bubble is not imminent in countries where one just burst. Conservative government policies will probably reduce subsidies to housing, and the current mood in these markets does not seem conducive to a bubble.

zh: 不过当今的商品价格上涨则更可能持续下去，因为它身上更多地附着有一个“新时代”故事的光环。
en: A continuation of today’s commodity-price boom seems more likely, for it has more of a “new era” story attached to it.

zh: 对全球变暖及其对食品价格影响的担忧，以及北半球寒冷冬天及其对取暖用油价格影响的恐惧都成为了人们之间流传的故事，甚至与当今的头条新闻 — — 中东革命 — — 联系了起来，因为某些说法认为革命是被大众对高食品价格的不满所激发的 — — 而且还会因此引发油价的进一步上涨。
en: Increasing worries about global warming, and its effects on food prices, or about the cold and snowy winter in the northern hemisphere and its effects on heating fuel prices, are contagious stories. They are even connected to the day’s top story, the revolutions in the Middle East, which, according to some accounts, were triggered by popular discontent over high food prices – and which could themselves trigger further increases in oil prices.

zh: 但我在未来十年最看好的潜在泡沫黑马则是农地 — — 但这项判断不仅仅是由美英两国近几个月农地价格上涨而得出的。
en: But my favorite dark-horse bubble candidate for the next decade or so is farmland – and not just because there have been stories in recent months of booming farmland prices in the US and the United Kingdom.

zh: 农地在重要性上显然比不上其他投机资产。
en: Of course, farmland is much less important than other speculative assets.

zh: 比如美国全国的农地在2010年总值约为1.9万亿美元，而股票市场和住宅市场则分别高达16.5万亿和16.6万亿美元。
en: For example, U.S. farmland had a total value of $1.9 trillion in 2010, compared with $16.5 trillion for the US stock market and $16.6 trillion for the US housing market.

zh: 同时大规模的农地泡沫也非常罕见：在20世纪的美国仅仅发生过一次，那是在1970年代人们恐慌人口过度暴增的时期。
en: And large-scale farmland bubbles are quite rare: there was only one in the US in the entire twentieth century, during the great population scare of the 1970’s.

zh: 但农地，至少是某些特定地区的农地，如今正流传着一个极富传染性的“新时代”故事。
en: But, farmland, at least in certain places, seems to have the most contagious “new era” story right now.

zh: 美国农地的价格在过去十年曾经发生过巨大上涨，在到达2008年的顶点时已经实质上涨了74 % 。
en: It was recently booming, up 74% in real terms in the US in the decade ending with its price peak, in 2008.

zh: 而急剧流传的全球变暖故事则向人们描绘了一幅食品短缺以及世界各地土地价值重估的图景，而这将促使投资者进一步加大投资。
en: And the highly contagious global-warming story paints a scenario of food shortages and shifts in land values in different parts of the world, which might boost investor interest further.

zh: 此外，如今的人们很容易会以为住宅和农地市场会经常联动，因为在2000年之后那几年两者都同时上涨。
en: Moreover, people nowadays easily imagine that the housing and farmland markets always move together, because prices in both boomed in recent memory, in the early 2000’s.

zh: 但美国住宅和农地价格在1911年到2010年间的相关性其实只有区区5 % ， 而最新的农地价格数据也并没有像住宅价格那样下跌。
en: But, from 1911 to 2010 in the US, the correlation between annual real growth of prices for homes and farmland was only 5%, and the latest data on farm prices have not shown anything like the decline in home prices.

zh: 截止至2010年，美国农地的实际价格较2008年最高点仅仅下跌了5 % ， 而住宅实际价格较2006年的最高点已经跌去了37 % 。
en: By 2010, real farm prices in the US had fallen only 5% from their 2008 peak, compared to the 37% decline in real home prices since their peak in 2006.

zh: 2000年以来的住宅价格上涨更可能是源于建筑行业的供应瓶颈（无法足够迅速地满足市场的投资需要）并被（在某些地方将被）随之涌出的大量供应所抵消。
en: The housing-price boom of the 2000’s was little more than a construction-supply bottleneck, an inability to satisfy investment demand fast enough, and was (or in some places will be) eliminated with massive increases in supply.

zh: 相比之下农地的供应却没有增加，而激发人们投资热情广泛流传的故事正大行其道，正如1970年代的美国，一场类似的食品价格恐慌催生了上世纪唯一的一场农地价格泡沫。
en: By contrast, there has been no increase in the supply of farmland, and the stories that would support a contagion of enthusiasm for it are in place, just as they were in the 1970’s in the US, when a similar food-price scare generated the century’s only farmland bubble.

zh: 尽管如此，我们还是要将预测泡沫的困难之处牢记于心。
en: Still, we must always bear in mind the difficulty of forecasting bubbles.

zh: 而对于那些勇敢的投资者来说，光找到一场泡沫并投身其中是不够的，还必须决定何时要将这些泡沫中抽身离开，并将资金转投到另一个领域。
en: And, for daring investors, it is not enough to find a bubble to pile into. They must also try to determine when to cash out and put their money elsewhere.

zh: 泡沫的麻烦
en: Bubble Trouble

zh: 房地产繁荣的未来以及未来数年价格大跌可能带来的金融影响已经越来越引起世界各国政府的担心。
en: The future of the housing boom, and the possible financial repercussions of a substantial price decline in coming years, is a matter of mounting concern among governments around the world.

zh: 我在参加今年在怀俄明州遥远的荒野举行的Jackson Hole会议了解了有关这方面的第一手信息。 具有讽刺意味的是，那里几乎没有房子可买。
en: I learned this first-hand while attending this year’s Jackson Hole Symposium in the remote wilderness of Wyoming, where, ironically, there are almost no homes to buy.

zh: 夜晚可以听到郊狼和驼鹿的叫声。
en: The howls of coyotes and bugling of elk rang out at night.

zh: 但是，白天大家谈论的都是房地产问题。
en: But, by day, everyone was talking about real estate.

zh: 该会议已经发展成为各国政府货币政策制定者的重要国际聚会，今年的会议有来自34个国家的中央银行的行长或副行长参加。
en: This conference has grown to be a major international event for government monetary policymakers, with governors or deputy governors of 34 central banks attending this year.

zh: 这些国家中大约有三分之二自2000年以来经历了房地产的高度繁荣，其中绝大多数的繁荣看上去还会继续下去，至少从目前来看是如此。
en: Roughly two-thirds of these countries have had dramatic housing booms since 2000, most of which appear to be continuing, at least for the time being.

zh: 但是大家对于房价的长期走势看法却不尽相同。
en: But there was no consensus on the longer-run outlook for home prices.

zh: 在所有这些国家中，美国看上去最有可能已经达到了一个循环的终点。
en: Of all these countries, the United States appears to be the most likely to have reached the end of the cycle.

zh: 根据标准普尔Case-Shiller美国全国房价指数，美国的房价在1996-2006年之间去除通货膨胀的影响实际上升了86 % ， 但是此后已经下降了6.5 % ， 并且下降的幅度还在加快。
en: According to the Standard & Poor’s/Case-Shiller US National Home Price Index, US home prices increased 86% in real, inflation-corrected, terms from 1996 to 2006, but have since fallen 6.5% – and the rate of decrease has been accelerating.

zh: 看上去一段繁荣的结束已经开始了，尽管你永远不能对此下定论。
en: That looks like the beginning of the end of the boom, though, of course, one can never be sure.

zh: 我提出熊市观点，就是房价从长期来看将持续下跌，尽管许多人提出质疑，但是显然没有人能说服对方。
en: I presented a bearish long-run view, which many challenged, but no one obviously won the argument.

zh: 然而，一个局外观察者也许会对如此多的人认定为期10年的繁荣可能会遭受一次真正的倒转并且随之引发房价的暴跌而感到震惊。
en: Nevertheless, an outside observer might have been struck by the weight given to the possibility that the decade-long boom might well suffer a real reversal, followed by serious declines.

zh: 大家似乎公认存在实质性的不利风险，因为目前的信贷危机似乎与我们已经看到的美国房价的下跌相关。
en: There seems to be a general recognition of substantial downside risk, as the current credit crisis seems to be related to the decline in US home prices that we have already seen.

zh: 房地产的繁荣，以及大家普遍相信房价只会越来越高，导致了借贷标准的降低。
en: The boom, and the widespread conviction that home prices could only go higher, led to a weakening of lending standards.

zh: 抵押借贷者似乎已经认定房屋购买者不会拖欠还款，因为越来越高的价格会使得按期归还贷款变得极有吸引力。
en: Mortgage lenders seem to have believed that home buyers would not default, because rising prices would make keeping up with their payments very attractive.

zh: 此外，繁荣带来了大量的金融创新产品，它们从内在来看也许是好的，但是如果考虑到跌价的风险，它们有时应用得有点过分自信了。
en: Moreover, the boom resulted in a number of financial innovations, which may have been good ideas intrinsically, but which were sometimes applied too aggressively, given the risk of falling prices.

zh: 抵押支持证券被推销给对于他们来说有点冒险的投资者。
en: Mortgage-backed securities were urged onto investors for whom they were too risky.

zh: 而对于购房者来说，一切都会很好，其推理的基础是房价会继续以健康的步伐持续上升。
en: As with homebuyers, all would be well, the reasoning went, on the premise that home prices continue to rise at a healthy pace.

zh: 在Jackson Hole会议上，世界上最大的债券基金太平洋投资管理公司的Paul McCulley说，在过去的一两个月我们已经看到了他所谓的“影子银行系统”的运作。 影子银行系统由伴随这房地产的繁荣涌现出来的所有杠杆投资渠道、媒介和结构组成。
en: At the Jackson Hole conference, Paul McCulley of PIMCO, the world’s largest bond fund, argued that in the past month or two we have been witnessing a run on what he calls the “shadow banking system,” which consists of all the levered investment conduits, vehicles and structures that have sprung up along with the housing boom.

zh: 它处于银行监管者以及储蓄保险的控制之外，通过帮助向购买者提供更多的信用来享受房价的暴涨所带来的利益。
en: The shadow banking system, which is beyond the reach of bank regulators and deposit insurance, fed the boom in home prices by helping provide more credit to buyers.

zh: 当人们担心他们在银行的存款得不到支付而急切地取回他们的钱时就会发生银行的挤提现象，而这正好带来他们所担心的破产。
en: Bank runs occur when people, worried that their deposits will not be honored, hastily withdraw their money, thereby creating the very bankruptcy that they feared.

zh: 这种新型的挤提最早发生在美国并不是一个巧合，因为它是当今世界的房价下跌的最好例子。
en: It is no coincidence that this new kind of bank run originated in the US, which is the clearest example of falling home prices in the world today.

zh: 当房价停止上升，最近的房屋购买者也许会失去继续归还他们的抵押贷款的信心，而投资者会对抵押支持证券失去信心。
en: When home prices stop rising, recent homebuyers may lose the enthusiasm to continue paying their mortgages – and investors lose faith in mortgage-backed securities.

zh: 美联储有时被指责应该对目前的抵押贷款危机负责，因为它所实行的宽松的货币政策被认为刺激了此前的价格上涨。
en: The US Federal Reserve is sometimes blamed for the current mortgage crisis, because excessively loose monetary policy allegedly fueled the price boom that preceded it.

zh: 事实上，从2002年10月至2005年4月这31个月的实际（去除通货膨胀的影响）联邦基金利率是负的。
en: Indeed, the real (inflation-corrected) federal funds rate was negative for 31 months, from October 2002 to April 2005.

zh: 自1950年以来这样的情况仅仅在1974年9月至1977年9月这37个月发生过，这是上个世纪美国发生最严重通货膨胀的阶段。
en: The only precedent for this since 1950 was the 37-month period from September 1974 to September 1977, which launched the worst inflation the US has seen in the last century.

zh: 当时导致消费品价格上涨的情况现在引发了房屋价格的上涨。
en: What then helped produce a boom in consumer prices now contributed to a boom in home prices.

zh: 但是宽松的货币政策并不是所有的问题所在。
en: But loose monetary policy is not the whole story.

zh: 美国房地产繁荣所带来的超低的实际基金利率已经存在很长一段时间了。
en: The unusually low real funds rate came after the US housing boom was already well underway.

zh: 根据标准普尔Case-Shiller美国全国房价指数，房价在2000年已经几乎上涨了10 % ， 同期美联储将联邦基金利率提到了6.5%的最高水平。
en: According to the Standard & Poor’s/Case-Shiller US National Home Price Index, home prices were already rising at almost 10% a year in 2000 – a time when the Fed was raising the federal funds rate, which peaked at 6.5%.

zh: 于是房价的快速上升看起来很可能是利率降低前投机冲动的表现。
en: The rapid increase thus appears to be mostly the result of speculative momentum that occurred before the interest-rate cuts.

zh: 美联储前主席格林斯潘最近说他现在认为投机泡沫是我们经济的重要驱动力，但是与此同时世界各国的货币主管部门无法控制泡沫。
en: Alan Greenspan, the former Fed chairman, recently said that he now believes that speculative bubbles are important driving forces in our economy, but that, at the same time, the world’s monetary authorities cannot control bubbles.

zh: 他在很大程度是对的：考虑到它们其他需要优先考虑的事情和担忧，货币主管部门能采取的最好办法就是倚靠房地产的繁荣，而不是阻碍它的膨胀。
en: He is mostly right: the best thing that monetary authorities could have done, given their other priorities and concerns, is to lean against the real estate bubble, not stop it from inflating.

zh: 目前房价的下跌很明显是与投资者投机热情的消退相联系，而在很大程度上与货币政策并没有联系。
en: The current decline in home prices is associated just as clearly with waning speculative enthusiasm among investors, which is likewise largely unrelated to monetary policy.

zh: 世界各国的货币主管部门将很难制止这种下跌以及解决参与房地产泡沫的人士的所面临的困难，正如它们很难在房价上涨前制止它一样。
en: The world’s monetary authorities will have trouble stopping this decline, and much of the attendant problems, just as they would have had trouble stopping the ascent that preceded it.

zh: 建立一个渐进性的国际体系
en: Building a Progressive International

zh: 发自雅典 — — 西方发达经济体的政治局面目前处于自1930年代以来首次出现的动荡之中。
en: ATHENS – Politics in the advanced economies of the West is in the throes of a political shakeup unseen since the 1930s.

zh: 侵袭大西洋两岸的严重通货紧缩正在唤醒那些在二战后沉睡的政治力量。
en: The Great Deflation now gripping both sides of the Atlantic is reviving political forces that had lain dormant since the end of World War II.

zh: 政治生活再次充斥着激情 — — 但却并非是以许多人所希望的方式。
en: Passion is returning to politics, but not in the manner many of us had hoped it would.

zh: 右派势力陷入了反体制的狂热之中，即便这原本是左派的专利。
en: The right has become animated by an anti-establishment fervor that was, until recently, the preserve of the left.

zh: 在美国，共和党总统候选人唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）大肆攻击其民主党对手希拉里·克林顿（Hillary Clinton）与华尔街关系密切、鼓吹入侵外国领土并准备接受已经拉低了数百万工人生活水平的自由贸易协定 — — 而且似乎有理有据。
en: In the United States, Donald Trump, the Republican presidential nominee, is taking Hillary Clinton, his Democratic opponent, to task – quite credibly – for her close ties to Wall Street, eagerness to invade foreign lands, and readiness to embrace free-trade agreements that have undermined millions of workers’ living standards.

zh: 而在英国，脱欧使得那些撒切尔夫人的右派支持者摇身一变成为了国民医疗服务的热情拥护者。
en: In the United Kingdom, Brexit has cast ardent Thatcherites in the role of enthusiastic defenders of the National Health Service.

zh: 这一转变并非史无前例。
en: This shift is not unprecedented.

zh: 民粹主义右派在通货紧缩时期就接受过准左派的理论。
en: The populist right has traditionally adopted quasi-leftist rhetoric in times of deflation.

zh: 任何一个愿意捏着鼻子重温1920~30年代法西斯和纳粹首领演讲 — — 包括贝尼托·墨索里尼（Benito Mussolini）对社会保障体系的赞颂和约瑟夫·戈培尔（Joseph Goebbels）对金融部门的尖锐批评 — — 的人都会发现，乍一看来这些呼声和渐进性目标似乎并无区别。
en: Anyone who can stomach revisiting the speeches of leading fascists and Nazis of the 1920s and 1930s will find appeals – Benito Mussolini’s paeans to social security or Joseph Goebbels’ stinging criticism of the financial sector – that seem, at first glance, indistinguishable from progressive goals.

zh: 当前我们遇到的是中间派政治崩溃所产生的自然反应，而导致这一切的则是全球资本主义危机 — — 金融危机导致经济大萧条再到如今的大通缩。
en: What we are experiencing today is the natural repercussion of the implosion of centrist politics, owing to a crisis of global capitalism in which a financial crash led to a Great Recession and then to today’s Great Deflation.

zh: 那些右派不过是简单地故伎重演，利用受害者对合乎道义的愤怒及沮丧情绪来推动自身臭不可闻的政治议程。
en: The right is simply repeating its old trick of drawing upon the righteous anger and frustrated aspirations of the victims to advance its own repugnant agenda.

zh: 这一切都始于1944年布雷顿森林体系中建立的国际货币体系 — — 基于“混合”经济，对不平等状况的遏制以及强大的金融监管的战后政治共识 — — 的崩溃。
en: It all began with the death of the international monetary system established at Bretton Woods in 1944, which had forged a post-war political consensus based on a “mixed” economy, limits on inequality, and strong financial regulation.

zh: 这个“黄金时期”在1971年发生的所谓“尼克松冲击”中走向终结，美国也同时失去了维持全球资本主义稳定的从全球各地回收的顺差。
en: That “golden era” ended with the so-called Nixon shock in 1971, when America lost the surpluses that, recycled internationally, kept global capitalism stable.

zh: 值得注意的是，美国在二战后期的霸权增长是与其贸易和预算赤字增长同步的。
en: Remarkably, America’s hegemony grew in this second post-war phase, in parallel with its trade and budget deficits.

zh: 但是为了融资以维持赤字，银行必须从罗斯福新政和布雷顿森林体系的约束中解放出来。
en: But to keep financing these deficits, bankers had to be unleashed from their New Deal and Bretton Woods restraints.

zh: 只有这样，他们才能鼓励和管理支撑美国的财政和经常账户双赤字所需的向内资本流动。
en: Only then would they encourage and manage the inward capital flows needed to finance America’s twin fiscal and current-account deficits.

zh: 当年经济金融化是目标，新自由主义是它的意识形态外衣，保罗·沃尔克（Paul Volcker）时代的美联储加息则是它的 触发器，总统比尔·克林顿（Bill Clinton）在位时最为接近这种浮士德式的魔鬼交易。
en: Financialization of the economy was the goal, neoliberalism was its ideological cloak, the Paul Volcker-era Federal Reserve’s interest-rate hikes were its trigger, and President Bill Clinton was the ultimate closer of the Faustian bargain.

zh: 当年的时机也再合适不过了：苏联帝国的崩溃和中国的对外开放为全球资本主义带来海量的劳动力供给 — — 额外多出近十亿工人 — — 令利润暴增并扼杀了所有西方国家劳动者的���资增长。
en: And the timing couldn’t have been more congenial: the Soviet empire’s collapse and China’s opening generated a surge of labor supply for global capitalism – a billion additional workers – that boosted profits and stifled wage growth throughout the West.

zh: 极端金融化的结果是巨大的不平等和深层次的脆弱性。
en: The result of extreme financialization was enormous inequality and profound vulnerability.

zh: 但至少西方工人阶级获得了廉价贷款和房价升值来抵消工资增长停滞和财政转移支付减少的影响。
en: But at least the West’s working class had access to cheap loans and inflated house prices to offset the impact of stagnant wages and declining fiscal transfers.

zh: 随后爆发的2008年金融危机令美国和欧洲产生了大规模的资金和人员供应过剩。
en: Then came the crash of 2008, which in the US and Europe produced a massive excess supply of both money and people.

zh: 纵使许多人失去了工作，家庭和希望，却有数万亿美元存款在各个全球金融中心之间流转，除此之外还有数万亿美元被绝望的央行抽出来紧急置换金融家造成的烂账。
en: While many lost jobs, homes, and hopes, trillions of dollars in savings have been sloshing around the world’s financial centers ever since, on top of more trillions pumped out by desperate central banks eager to replace the financiers’ toxic money.

zh: 由于公司和机构投资者都不敢投资实体经济，股价迅速飙升，令社会金字塔尖的前0.1％的人喜出望外，而其余的人只能无望地看着那些愤怒的葡萄 “ . . . . . . 不断膨胀和长大，直到采摘的那一刻。
en: With companies and institutional players too frightened to invest in the real economy, share prices have boomed, the top 0.1% can’t believe their luck, and the rest are helplessly watching as the grapes of wrath are “…filling and growing heavy, growing heavy for the vintage.”

zh: 结果在美国和欧洲都有一大批负债累累且失去希望的人 — — 随时可能被特朗普的恐慌言论，法国国民阵线领导人马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）的仇外心理，或英国脱欧支持者憧憬不列颠重新掌权的伟大愿景所诱惑。
en: And so it was that large chunks of humanity in America and Europe became too indebted and too expensive to be anything other than discarded – and ready to be lured by Trump’s fear-mongering, French National Front leader Marine Le Pen’s xenophobia, or the Brexiteers’ shimmering vision of a Britannia ruling the waves again.

zh: 随着他们的数量不断增加，传统的政党不断衰落，由两个新的政治集团 取而代之。
en: As their number grows, traditional political parties are fading into irrelevance, supplanted by the emergence of two new political blocs.

zh: 其中一个集团代表的是自由化、全球化和金融化的旧三驾马车。
en: One bloc represents the old troika of liberalization, globalization, and financialization.

zh: 它可能仍旧掌权，但其实力正迅速下降，正如戴维·卡梅伦（David Cameron ） 、 欧洲的社会民主主义者、欧盟委员会、希拉里·克林顿，甚至希腊被注资援助后的激进左翼联盟政府所展现的那样。
en: It may still be in power, but its stock is falling fast, as David Cameron, Europe’s social democrats, Hillary Clinton, the European Commission, and even Greece’s post-capitulation Syriza government can attest.

zh: 而特朗普、勒庞、英国右翼脱欧论者，波兰和匈牙利两国的反自由化政府和俄罗斯总统普京（Vladimir Putin）正在形成另一个集团。
en: Trump, Le Pen, Britain’s right-wing Brexiteers, Poland’s and Hungary’s illiberal governments, and Russian President Vladimir Putin are forming the second bloc.

zh: 他们构成了一种民族主义国际体系 — — 典型的通货紧缩时期的产物 — — 集结了那些对自由民主制度的抵触情绪以及足以摧毁这一制度的力量。
en: Theirs is a nationalist international – a classic creature of a deflationary period – united by contempt for liberal democracy and the ability to mobilize those who would crush it.

zh: 这两个集团之间的冲突既真实又存在误导性。
en: The clash between these two blocs is both real and misleading.

zh: 克林顿与特朗普之间存在一场真正的战争，就像欧盟迎战英国脱欧支持者；但对战双方与其说是敌人，不如说是同谋，他们之间维持着一个相互强化的无限循环，双方都用其反对的东西来定义自身并以此动员其支持者。
en: Clinton vs. Trump constitutes a genuine battle, for example, as does the European Union vs. the Brexiteers; but the combatants are accomplices, not foes, in perpetuating an endless loop of mutual reinforcement, with each side defined by – and mobilizing its supporters on the basis of – what it opposes.

zh: 逃离这个政治陷阱的唯一方法是渐进式的国际体系，这是建立在团结遍布世界各地希望在全球重建民主政治的大多数人的基础上的。
en: The only way out of this political trap is progressive internationalism, based on solidarity among large majorities around the world who are prepared to rekindle democratic politics on a planetary scale.

zh: 这听起来很乌托邦，但值得强调的是，所有原材料都是现成可用的。
en: If this sounds Utopian, it is worth emphasizing that the raw materials are already available.

zh: 美国伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）的“政治革命 ” ， 杰里米·科尔宾（Jeremy Corbyn）对英国工党的领导，欧洲的DiEM25（欧洲民主运动组织 ） ： 这些都是国际进步运动的预兆，也可以被定义构建民主政治的智力基础。
en: Bernie Sanders’s “political revolution” in the US, Jeremy Corbyn’s leadership of the UK’s Labour Party, DiEM25 (the Democracy in Europe Movement) on the continent: these are the harbingers of an international progressive movement that can define the intellectual terrain upon which democratic politics must build.

zh: 但是我们正处于一个初级阶段，面临着来自全球三驾马车的强力反击：民主党全国委员会对桑德斯的攻击，一个前制药厂说客对科尔宾领导地位的挑战，或是试图因为我反对欧盟的希腊计划而起诉我的行为。
en: But we are at an early stage and face a remarkable backlash from the global troika: witness Sanders’ treatment by the Democratic National Committee, the run against Corbyn by a former pharmaceutical lobbyist, and the attempt to have me indicted for daring to oppose the EU’s plan for Greece.

zh: 大规模的通货紧缩带来一个极大的问题：人类能否设计和实现一个新的、技术先进的“绿色”布雷顿森林体系 — — 一个使我们的地球生态和经济可持续发展的系统 — — 而无需引发原有布雷顿森林体系建立之前的那种大范围人民疾苦和破坏效应？
en: The Great Deflation poses a great question: can humanity design and implement a new, technologically advanced, “green” Bretton Woods – a system that makes our planet ecologically and economically sustainable – without the mass pain and destruction preceding the original Bretton Woods?

zh: 如果我们 — — 渐进式的国际主义者 — — 无法回答这个问题，那又有谁能回答？
en: If we – progressive internationalists – won’t answer that question, who will?

zh: 要知道目前正在西方争权夺利的两个政治集团甚至都不希望这个问题被提出的。
en: Neither of the two political blocs now vying for power in the West even wants it to be posed.

zh: 构建一个安全的纳米技术的未来
en: Building a Safe Nanotechnology Future

zh: 根据某些人的观点我们即将迎来一场纳米技术革命，在那里物体被以比人眼所能看到的小几千倍的尺寸制造，而我们熟悉的材料将会有令人意外的表现。
en: We are living – according to some – on the brink of a nanotechnology revolution, where matter is engineered at a scale thousands of times smaller than the eye can see, and familiar materials behave in unexpected ways.

zh: 这场革命如果成功的话，将会颠覆整个世界。
en: This revolution, if successful, will turn our world upside down.

zh: 纳米技术提高了我们对材料的控制以及提供了提高现有技术和开发新技术的机会。
en: Nanotechnology gives us increasing control over the material world, providing opportunities to enhance existing technologies and develop new ones.

zh: 从建造更强、更轻的材料和制造功能极强但难以置信地小的电脑到开发新的可持续能源和设计个人化的癌症治疗方案，这里看上去有无限的机会。
en: The opportunities seem endless, from building stronger, lighter materials and manufacturing tremendously powerful yet incredibly small computers, to developing new sustainable energy sources and devising personalized cures for cancer.

zh: 现在市场上有超过500种不同制造商宣称生产的纳米技术消费产品，从化妆品到汽车零件以及餐具，应有尽有。
en: More than 500 manufacturer-identified nanotechnology consumer products are now on the market, from cosmetics to car parts to tableware. By 2014 an estimated $2.6 trillion in manufactured goods around the world (or 15% of total global output) will use this technology, building on the research of scientists in some 100 nations around the world.

zh: 如果现在的预测正确，那么纳米技术将有可能对每一个行业以及我们生活中的方方面面都产生影响。
en: If current projections are right, nanotechnology has the potential to have an impact on nearly every industry and virtually every aspect of our lives.

zh: 然而纳米技术也在颠覆着我们对什么东西是有害的认识。
en: Yet nanotechnology is also shaking up our understanding of what makes something harmful.

zh: 在纳米范围（大约比人的头发丝的宽度小5万倍）上，物体的表现并不像寻常那样：弱的物质变强了，惰性的物质变得活跃了，而良性的物质变得有害了。
en: At the nanometer scale (about 50,000 times smaller than the width of a human hair), matter behaves in unusual ways: weak materials become strong, inert materials become active, and benign materials become harmful.

zh: 以同样的方式铁可以被制造成像长柄平底煎锅和剑这样不同的产品，纳米技术产品的有用或有害完全要看它们在纳米范围上是怎样被制作的。
en: In the same way that iron can be made into products as different as skillets and swords, the usefulness or harmfulness of nanotechnology products depends on how they are crafted at the nanometer scale.

zh: 其结果是，我们不能再依赖传统上单单根据原材料来界定危险的方式了。
en: As a result, we can no longer rely on conventional ways of managing risk that are based on the raw materials alone.

zh: 随着使用纳米技术的产品越来越多，我们需要了解它们可能带来的危险的新的科学信息。
en: As the number of products using nanotechnology continues to grow, we need new scientific information on the risks that they might present.

zh: 政府、工业、学术界和其他地方的专家认为如果我们想尽可能安全地开发纳米技术那就要解决一长串的问题。
en: Experts in government, industry, academia, and elsewhere agree that a long list of questions needs to be addressed if we are to develop nanotechnology as safely as possible.

zh: 我们面临的挑战是寻找到能够使生产者和管理者作出合理的、有科学依据的决策以及建立一个能让消费者放心的监管体系的答案。
en: The challenge we face is to find answers that will enable producers and regulators to make sound, science-based decisions, and to develop an oversight system that inspires consumer confidence.

zh: 不幸的是，迄今为止全球对于这一挑战的回应并不那么积极。
en: Unfortunately, the global response to this challenge has not been overwhelming.

zh: 2005年，伍德罗威尔逊国际学者中心新兴纳米技术计划考察了由政府资助的对于纳米技术的环境、健康和安全影响的研究项目。
en: In 2005, the Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars Project on Emerging Nanotechnologies looked closely at government-funded research addressing the environmental, health, and safety impact of nanotechnology.

zh: 在高度相关的研究上的投资非常低：在美国，这方面的投资大约只占联邦在纳米技术的研究和开发上的11亿美元投资的1 % 。
en: Investment in highly relevant research was low: in the United States, it was only an estimated 1% of the $1.1 billion federal investment in nanotechnology research and development.

zh: 更令人担心的是注资进行研究的背后明显缺乏任何策略的现象。
en: More worrying was the apparent absence of any strategy behind the research being funded.

zh: 即便少得可怜的探索可能存在的危险的相关研究也缺乏明确的研究方向，无法令人相信其所开发出的信息能够帮助决策者确保纳米技术被长期安全地开发。
en: Even the small handful of relevant studies exploring possible risks lacked a guiding focus, giving no indication that the information developed would help decision-makers ensure that nanotechnology is developed safely over the long term.

zh: 美国在推动支持使用纳米技术的研究战略上表现得非常成功，并且树立了被全世界广泛仿效的典型。
en: The US has been tremendously successful in promoting research strategies that support the use of nanotechnology, and has served as a model that is being duplicated around the world.

zh: 但是帮助开发纳米技术应用的同等战略无法帮助回答政府和产业 今天 越来越多地问到的有关它可能带来的影响的问题。
en: But the same strategies that work for developing nanotechnology applications will not help answer the growing list of questions about its possible impact that governments and industry are asking today.

zh: 与危险相关的紧迫问题需要全世界都认真行动起来。
en: Pressing risk-related questions require deliberate action on an international scale.

zh: 我们只有通过加强研究努力和注资水平来获得未来安全应用纳米技术的信息才能回答这些问题。
en: They will be answered only by matching research efforts and funding levels to the information needed to steer toward a safe future for nanotechnology applications.

zh: 2006年，科学杂志《自然》刊登了在开发纳米技术研究上五 大挑战 ：
en: In 2006, five research grand challenges for developing safe nanotechnology were published in the scientific journal Nature:

zh: l 寻找到测量空气和水中存在的纳米材料的数量的方式；
en: · finding ways to measure the amount of nanomaterials in the air and water;

zh: l 了解如何评估衡量纳米材料的有害程度；
en: · learning how to assess how harmful nanomaterials are;

zh: l 开发预测 — — 以及防止 — — 纳米材料有害性的方式；
en: · developing ways to predict – and prevent – harm from new nanomaterials;

zh: l 能够熟练评估纳米技术产品从出品到消亡的过程中的潜在影响；
en: · becoming skilled at evaluating the potential impact of nanotechnology products from cradle to grave;

zh: l 制定战略以及注入资金支持旨在应对这些挑战的研究。
en: · and establishing strategies and funding to support the research needed to meet these challenges.

zh: 一些国家和地区已经开始制定研究日程来应对这五大挑战。
en: Some nations and regions are beginning to develop research agendas that respond to these five challenges.

zh: 比如，欧盟最近宣布了一项耗资36亿欧元的纳米技术研究项目，包括与这些挑战相关的环境、健康和安全目标。
en: For example, the European Union has recently announced a €3.6 billion nanotechnology research program, which includes environment, health, and safety goals that align with these challenges.

zh: 同样地，2007年3月，英国政府的科学技术高级咨询机构警告说这个国家在纳米技术上的领先地位正在消失，因为政府没有在了解和有效控制可能产生的健康和环境影响的必需有的研究进行足够的投资。
en: Likewise, in March 2007, the British government’s top advisory body on science and technology warned that the country’s lead in nanotechnology is fading, because the government has not invested enough in research necessary for understanding and effectively managing possible health and environmental effects.

zh: 我们还有很长的路要走。
en: There is still a long way to go.

zh: 如果要让可持续的纳米技术建立在合理的科学基础上，那么全球的研究战略就必须得到创新的政策的支持以及得到足够的资金支持。
en: If sustainable nanotechnology is to be built on sound science, global research strategies must be supported by innovative policies and accompanied by sufficient funds to do the job.

zh: 单单在美国，预计有明确目标的纳米技术危险性研究必须要有的注资水平每年在5千万到1亿美元之间，这是2005年投资额的5到10倍。
en: In the US alone, estimates of the necessary funding levels for goal-oriented nanotechnology risk research are between $50 million and $100 million per year – five to ten times the amount invested in 2005.

zh: 我们不能够一头雾水地冲进纳米技术的未来。
en: We cannot afford to drive blind into the nanotechnology future.

zh: 尽管我们已经有了一个好的开端，许多国家依然在以陈旧和目光短浅的思维模式开发这种二十一世纪的技术。
en: Despite a good start, many countries are developing these twenty-first century technologies within an old and blinkered mindset.

zh: 如果我们无法制定出识别和避免可能的新危险的方式和方法，那这种令人鼓舞的新技术的前景并不乐观。
en: If we do not develop the ways and means to spot and navigate around possible new risks, the outlook for this exciting new technology will be uncertain.

zh: 我们必须清醒地认识到未来的纳米技术应用需要建立在对其可能影响的充分理解之上。
en: We must wake up to the need for future nanotechnology applications to be based on a sound understanding of the possible impact.

zh: 在对纳米技术领导地位的全球竞争中，只有那些对其危险性有很好的认识并且支持必要的研究以把这种危险性降到最低程度的国家才会成为最后的赢家。
en: In the global race for nanotechnology leadership, the winners will be those who understand the risks and support the research necessary to minimize them.

zh: 可持续能源之路
en: Paths to Sustainable Power

zh: 纽约—对能源未来的最安全赌注是下注于低碳能源供给。
en: NEW YORK – The surest bet on the future of energy is the need for low-carbon energy supplies.

zh: 如今，全世界八成左右的一次能源是碳基能源：煤、石油和天然气。
en: Around 80% of the world’s primary energy today is carbon based: coal, oil, and gas.

zh: 我们需要在本世纪中叶转向非碳或低碳能源。
en: We will need to shift to no- or low-carbon energy by mid-century.

zh: 怎样转、何时能转成，这是个大问题。
en: The big questions are how and when.

zh: 低碳一次能源有三种选择：可再生能源，包括风能、太阳能、地热、水电和生物能；核能；以及碳捕捉和碳储存，即用化石燃料生产能源，但限制二氧化碳发生量，并将碳安全地储存于地下。
en: Low-carbon primary energy means three options: renewable energy, including wind, solar, geothermal, hydropower, and biomass; nuclear energy; and carbon capture and sequestration, which means using fossil fuels to create energy, but trapping the CO2 emissions that result and storing the carbon safely underground.

zh: 世界需要转向低碳能源，有三条刻不容缓的原因。
en: There are three compelling reasons for the world to make the shift to low-carbon energy.

zh: 首先，二氧化碳水平的升高正在让海洋变酸。
en: First, higher levels of CO2 are making the world’s oceans acidic.

zh: 照目前的发展速度，我们会毁掉大量海洋生物，严重破坏我们赖以生存的食物链。
en: If we continue with business as usual, we will end up destroying a vast amount of marine life, severely damaging the food chains on which we rely.

zh: 其次，二氧化碳正在让世界气候变得越来越危险，尽管许多石油巨头试图让我们相信并非如此。
en: Second, CO2 is dangerously changing the world’s climate, even if many Big Oil interests would have us believe otherwise.

zh: （烟草公司也花巨资用于政治游说和伪科学，以否认吸烟和肺癌之间的联系。 ）
en: (So, too, did the tobacco companies spend vast sums on political lobbying and bogus science to deny the links between smoking and lung cancer.)

zh: 第三，随着发展中国家的增长推动了需求，而煤、石油和天然气的常规供给越来越少，我们面临着化石燃料价格的暴涨。
en: Third, we face steeply rising prices for fossil fuels, as developing countries’ growth drives up demand and conventional supplies of coal, oil, and gas are depleted.

zh: 诚然，我们可能发现更多的化石燃料，但成本会高很多，环境风险也会高很多，如工业渗漏、废料、泄露等。
en: Sure, we can find more fossil fuels, but at much higher cost and at much greater environmental risk from industrial spills, waste products, leaks, and other damage.

zh: 即使最近大热的页岩气革命，也是幻想多于实际 — — 一如过去的黄金热和股市泡沫。
en: Even the much-heralded shale-gas revolution is a lot of hype – similar to the gold rushes and stock bubbles of the past.

zh: 页岩气矿的耗竭速度远远快于传统矿，且对环境影响很大。
en: Shale-gas wells deplete far more rapidly than conventional fields do. And they are environmentally dirty to boot.

zh: 美国已开发出许多新的低碳能源技术，但其他国家大规模使用这些技术的目标、远见和决心要远强于美国。
en: The United States has developed many new low-carbon energy technologies, but other countries are currently far more intent, far-sighted, and decisive than the US to put these technologies to large-scale use.

zh: 从政治上说，美国仍是石油巨头的国度。
en: Politically, America is still the land of Big Oil.

zh: 美国人整天受到行业资助的媒体的狂轰滥炸，淡化气候变化问题，而化石燃料比美国匮乏得多的国家一开始着手进行迈向低碳未来的必要转型。
en: Americans are bombarded by industry-funded media downplaying climate change, while countries that are much poorer in fossil fuels are already making the necessary transition to a low-carbon future.

zh: 欧洲的两个邻国，德国和法国正在向我们展示通往低碳未来之路 — — 更准确地说，是新道路。
en: Two neighbors in Europe, Germany and France, are showing the way forward – or, more precisely, the alternative ways forward – to a low-carbon future.

zh: 它们根据各自不同的禀赋、行业历史和政治压力选择着不同道路。
en: They are going about it in ways that reflect their different resource endowments, industrial histories, and political pressures.

zh: 德国走的是Energiewende，即转向可持续能源，这是一个用可再生能源，特别是太阳能和风电满足德国全部能源需求的伟大工程（事实上，从未有发达国家有此先例 ） 。
en: Germany is undertaking the Energiewende, or transition to sustainable energy – a remarkable effort (indeed, unprecedented for a large advanced economy) to meet the country’s entire energy demand with renewable energy, especially solar and wind power.

zh: 与此同时，法国将严重依赖低碳核电，并在快速推广电动汽车，比如最尖端的雷诺-日产Leaf。
en: Meanwhile, France relies heavily on low-carbon nuclear power, and is switching rapidly to electric vehicles, such as the pioneering Renault-Nissan Leaf.

zh: 在这两条路中，德国之路更加非常。
en: Of the two approaches, Germany’s is the more unusual bet.

zh: 日本福岛核事故后，德国决定完全关闭核电工业，转向基于提高能源效率（更低单位国民收入能源投入量）和可再生能源。
en: After Japan’s nuclear disaster at Fukushima, Germany decided to shut down its entire nuclear power industry and shift entirely to a strategy based on greater energy efficiency (lower energy input per unit of national income) and renewables.

zh: 如此巨大的能源转型确实没有清晰的路线图可供依据，德国几乎肯定需要依赖泛欧洲电网共享清洁能源，并最终需要从北美和中东进口太阳能。
en: There really is no clear roadmap for such a huge energy transformation, and Germany almost surely will need to rely on a European-wide electricity grid to share clean energy, and eventually on imported solar power from North Africa and the Middle East.

zh: 法国的押注核电是较成熟的选择。
en: France’s bet on nuclear power is a more proven option.

zh: 毕竟，多年前法国就已经实现大部分电力靠核电供应。
en: After all, most of France’s electricity has come from nuclear power for many years.

zh: 此外，尽管反核情绪在欧洲颇为高涨 — — 即使在法国也在水涨船高 — — 核电仍是未来几十年全球能源供应的一部分，这一点只要亚洲（包括中国、印度、韩国和日本）仍是核电大用户即可保证。
en: And, though anti-nuclear sentiment is very strong in Europe – and, increasingly, even in France – nuclear power will remain part of the global energy mix for decades to come, simply because much of Asia (including China, India, South Korea, and Japan) will remain major users of it.

zh: 关键在于，法国和德国以及其他许多欧洲国家 — — 包括拥有丰富风能和水能的斯堪的纳维亚国家 — — 都在考虑世界作为一个整体必须摆脱以化石燃料为基础的能源体系。
en: The key point is that France and Germany, and many other European countries – including the Scandinavian countries, with their considerable wind and hydropower potential – are all recognizing that the world as a whole will have to move away from a fossil-fuel-based energy system.

zh: 这个结论是正确的。
en: That is the right calculation.

zh: 哪条新道路更明智 — — 法国的核电还是德国的太阳能 — — 远未可知。
en: Many will no doubt argue about which alternative – France’s bet on nuclear power or Germany’s solar pathway – is wiser.

zh: 但两种战略可能都不错。
en: But both strategies are probably correct.

zh: 大部分研究表明，行现在开始到本世纪中叶，世界将经历深刻的去碳化，这个时间长度是由环境现实决定的。 去碳化要求所有低碳选择 — — 包括提高能源效率和可再生能源 — — 都要大幅扩大规模。
en: Most studies show that deep de-carbonization of the world economy from now to mid-century, a time horizon mandated by environmental realities, will require that all low-carbon options – including greater efficiency and renewables – be scaled up massively.

zh: 一项当务之急是由我代表联合国秘书长潘基文主管的新的可持续发展解决方案网络（Sustainable Development Solutions Network）能够详尽地规划通往低碳经济的新道路，考虑世界各国的具体条件。
en: One of the highest priorities of the new Sustainable Development Solutions Network, which I direct on behalf of United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, will be to elaborate alternative pathways to a low-carbon economy, taking into account the specific conditions of countries around the world.

zh: 不同国家可以选择不同战略，但所有国家都需要到达同一个终点：基于低碳资源、汽车电动化和智能节能建筑和城市的新的能源体系。
en: Different countries will choose different strategies, but we will all need to get to the same place: a new energy system built on low-carbon sources, electrification of vehicles, and smart, energy-efficient buildings and cities.

zh: 先行者或许会在当下付出更高的代价，但它们和全世界会因此收获长期经济和环境好处。
en: Early movers may pay a slightly higher price today for these strategies, but they and the world will reap long-term economic and environmental benefits.

zh: 通过采用真正可持续的技术，法国、德国和其他国家正在创造一个更能支持世界经济安然度过本世纪的能源体系。
en: By embracing truly sustainable technologies, France, Germany, and others are creating the energy system that will increasingly support the world economy throughout this century.

zh: 仰仗欧元
en: Building on the Euro

zh: 欧元诞生已经6年了，再也不用凭空猜测它的作用和是否能满足诞生时人们的厚望了。
en: The euro is now six years old. It is past time to consider how it is performing, and whether it has lived up to the expectations that accompanied its birth.

zh: 人们对欧元寄予了很高的期望。
en: Those expectations were not modest.

zh: 通过降低交易成本和消除汇率不确定的风险，人们热切地盼望这种单一的欧洲货币能带来完全融合的产品和金融市场，而这又最终意味着更多的贸易收益、更强的竞争力、更多的资金跨国流动、更低的借贷成本和更多的风险共担机会，人们寄希望于上述所有因素结合在一起，能够最终促进投资、提高生产率。
en: By reducing transaction costs and removing exchange-rate uncertainty, the single European currency was expected to lead to fully integrated product and financial markets. This, in turn, would bring greater gains from trade, stronger competition, larger cross-border capital flows, lower borrowing costs, and more opportunities for sharing risk, all of which were expected ultimately to boost investment and productivity.

zh: 但现实却让人们失望了。
en: Reality has disappointed.

zh: 与1999年欧元启动前的5年间相比，意大利、德国、西班牙和荷兰等国的生产率增长都有所下降，而在同一时期，丹麦、瑞典、英国等没有参与欧元计划的成员国生产率却保持不变，甚至还有所增长。
en: Compared to the five years before the euro’s launch in 1999, productivity growth has since slowed in Italy, Germany, Spain, and the Netherlands, while over the same period it accelerated or remained constant in Denmark, Sweden, and the UK, the European Union members that remained out.

zh: 实际上，除法国以外，欧元似乎并没有给其它参与国带来福音。
en: Indeed, with the main exception of France, the euro does not seem to have been a blessing for the countries that adopted it.

zh: 结果为什么会令人失望？
en: Why this disappointment?

zh: 人们预期中新货币的好处是否没能变成现实？
en: Have the expected benefits of the new currency failed to materialize?

zh: 通过研究若干指数，前不久完成的几项经济研究探讨了这个问题。
en: Several recent economic studies addressed this question, looking at a variety of indicators.

zh: 研究结果如下：
en: Here is what emerges:

zh: · 单一货币确实促进了欧元区国际贸易的发展，增长比率约为10 % 。
en: · The single currency has boosted international trade within the euro area, by about 10%.

zh: 虽然这与人们的希望还有距离，但全面评价还为时尚早。
en: Although a larger effect was expected, it remains too early for a complete assessment.

zh: 无论如何，这是个重要的积极因素，因为国际贸易普遍被看作高速和高效的关键因素。
en: In any case, this is an important positive outcome, because international trade is generally regarded as a key determinant of faster growth and higher efficiency.

zh: · 人们预计欧元能提高价格透明度，从而使产品市场竞争更为激烈。
en: · The euro was expected to increase price transparency, thereby strengthening competition in product markets.

zh: 没有证据显示欧元起到了这样的作用。
en: No evidence exists that this happened.

zh: 在20世纪90年代初单一市场计划的起始阶段价格确曾有所靠拢，但后来很快就停止了。
en: Prices did converge during the implementation of the Single Market program, in the early 1990’s, but then price convergence stopped.

zh: · 对欧元区的跨国投资的确有所增长，但要将单一货币和其它衍生事件（比如私有化和企业兼并）的效果区分开来显得更加困难。
en: · Cross-border investment towards the euro area has increased, although here it is more difficult to disentangle the effect of the single currency from other concomitant events (such as privatizations or corporate mergers).

zh: · 目前欧元区的货币和债券市场已经实现了统一，也就是说大公司借款的资金成本有所下降。
en: · Money and bond markets are now fully integrated in the euro area, implying a reduction in the cost of capital for large corporate borrowers.

zh: 而零售银行业仍然条块分割，因此家庭和小生产者的借贷成本没什么变化。
en: Retail banking, however, remains segmented by national borders, so that households and smaller producers have not been much affected.

zh: · 人们希望欧元能成为国际货币，最终提高欧洲抵御经济冲击的能力。
en: · The euro was expected to acquire an international role, eventually improving Europe’s resilience in the face of economic shocks.

zh: 用欧元发行的国际债券价格迅速上升，但欧元外汇市场的流动性并不比它所取代的国家货币强多少，而要想挑战美元的统治地位欧元也还有很长的路要走。
en: There has been a surge in euro-denominated international bonds, but the liquidity of foreign-exchange markets is no higher for the euro compared to the national currencies it replaced, and the euro remains a long way from challenging the supremacy of the dollar.

zh: 当然，欧元从来就不只有单纯的经济意义。
en: Of course, the euro was never just an economic project.

zh: 欧元支持者主要的动机之一就是促进欧洲的政治融合。
en: One of its backers’ main motives was to boost Europe’s political integration.

zh: 实际上，欧元迅速地成为欧洲统一的象征。
en: Indeed, the euro has quickly become a symbol of European unity.

zh: 当被问及“欧盟对你个人意味着什么”时，2004年5月欧盟扩张之前15个原成员国50%的公民都回答“欧元”¾这种回答的普遍性居第二位（仅次于“在欧盟各地旅游、学习和工作的能力 ” ） 。
en: When asked, “What does the EU mean to you personally,” 50% of citizens in the 15 countries that were EU members before enlargement in May 2004 say “the euro” – the second most common response (just behind “the ability to travel, study, and work anywhere in the EU”).

zh: 但这项标志并未使欧盟和欧元区更受人欢迎。
en: Yet, this symbol has not made the EU or the euro area any more popular.

zh: 欧盟扩张前15国对联盟的支持率仍然是20世纪90年代的水平（比20世纪90年代的最高水平有所下降 ） ， 而对欧元的支持率也不比1997年的时候高。
en: Support for EU membership within the pre-enlargement EU-15 remains where it was in the mid-1990’s (and below the peak reached in 1990), while support for the euro is no higher now than it was in 1997.

zh: 可以肯定的是，欧元的引入是一次真正意义的革命，我们现在还无法看到它所有的效果。
en: To be sure, the introduction of the euro was a true revolution, and we cannot yet see all its effects.

zh: 但有一点是十分清楚的：这次革命是在脆弱的国家经济基础之上发生的，它所改革的是欧洲经济的上层建筑¾金融市场和宏观经济制度¾而保留了20世纪七八十年代错误的国家政策所造成供应经济扭曲的原有基础。
en: But what is clear is that the revolution took place on shaky national economic foundations, transforming the upper floors of the European economy – financial markets and macroeconomic policy institutions – while leaving intact the ancien underpinnings of supply-side distortions induced by misguided national policies in the 1970’s and 1980’s.

zh: 造成欧元区经济表现低迷的正是这些扭曲，而不是单一货币的缺陷。
en: These distortions, not any shortcomings of the single currency, account for the euro area’s dismal economic performance.

zh: 欧元的采用国20世纪90年代末就不得不面对糟糕的劳工市场制度，过于庞大的养老金体系、对劳动者收入的高额税收和效率低下的服务部门，这个问题到今天也还没有解决。
en: The countries that adopted the euro had poor labor-market institutions, bloated pension systems, high taxes on labor income, and inefficient service sectors in the late 1990’s, and they still do now.

zh: 欧元更本质的问题是它的采纳并未促使各个国家解决这些潜在问题。
en: The more fundamental problem with the euro is that its adoption has not pushed countries to address these underlying deficiencies.

zh: 人们曾经希望产品和金融市场的彻底融合会暴露哪些低效行业，把资金流从发展迟缓的国家转移到更加高效的使用者。
en: It was expected that full integration of product and financial markets would expose inefficiencies, steering investment flows away from laggards towards the more efficient countries.

zh: 可尽管20世纪90年代包括欧元区内外的整个欧洲改革力度都有所加大，但并没有多少证据表明“区内”国比“区外”国实行了更多意义深远的重大供应改革。
en: Yet, while reform efforts intensified throughout Europe in the late 1990’s both inside and outside of the euro area, there is little evidence that “ins” enacted more far-reaching and significant supply-side reforms than the “outs.”

zh: 担任过美国财政部长的哈佛大学校长萨莫斯曾把单一欧洲货币称为欧洲需要面对的真正供应改革的“干扰因素 ” 。
en: Larry Summers, the former US Treasury Secretary and now president of Harvard University, once called the single European currency a “distraction” from the serious supply-side reforms Europe needed to confront.

zh: 这样的判断未免太过严厉，因为我们不知道没有单一货币的欧盟和统一市场到底还能不能生存。
en: This judgment may be too harsh, because we do not know whether the EU and the single market would have survived without the single currency.

zh: 但有一点可以肯定：那��是欧洲再也不能因为其它事情“分心”了。
en: But one thing is certain: Europe cannot afford other “distractions.”

zh: 检查欧洲摇摇欲坠的供应经济基础是欧元改革不得不面对的关键挑战，而这项挑战需要各国从根源上彻底的解决。
en: Overhauling Europe’s shaky supply-side foundations is the key challenge facing the euro revolution, and it is a challenge that needs to be addressed at its national-level roots.

zh: 在全球复苏的基础上再接再励
en: Building on the Global Recovery

zh: 当今世界各种对立的现象并存。
en: The world is a study in contrasts nowadays. We are haunted by images of terror and warfare.

zh: 恐怖和战争的景象不断烦扰着人们，然而全球各个地区都不同程度地经历了多年来最强劲的经济增长。 尽管油价飙升，通货膨胀却保持在低水平，金融市场也势态良好。
en: Yet every region of the globe has experienced some of the strongest economic growth seen in years, inflation remains subdued despite surging oil prices, and financial markets are doing well.

zh: 几个近来遭遇了金融危机的经济体出现强势的反弹。
en: Several economies that recently faced financial crises are rebounding strongly.

zh: 但与此同时，要防止未来的危机，减少贫困，需要做的事情还很多很多。
en: At the same time, much more needs to be done to help prevent future crises and reduce poverty.

zh: 这些对立的现象对未来有何影响？
en: What do these contrasts mean for the future?

zh: 答案关键取决于各个国家和国际社会如何面对重要的政策挑战：通过宏观经济政策和早就应该实行的改革，解决全球不平衡的问题；负担老龄化人口的花费；加强对经济和金融危机的防卫；解决减少贫困这一迫切问题。
en: The answer depends crucially on how each country and the international community respond to key policy challenges: addressing global imbalances through macroeconomic policies and long-overdue reform; meeting the costs of aging populations; strengthening defenses against economic and financial crises; and delivering on the pressing imperatives of poverty reduction.

zh: 最近，来自184个国家的金融首脑在华盛顿参加国际货币基金组织和世界银行的年会。
en: Recently, financial leaders from 184 countries met in Washington at the Annual Meetings of the IMF and World Bank.

zh: 今年是建立了这两个国际经济合作支柱的布雷顿森林会议的六十周年。
en: This year marks the sixtieth anniversary of the Bretton Woods Conference that established those two organizations as pillars of international economic cooperation.

zh: 作为国际货币基金组织的常务董事，我要讲的是警惕和行动。
en: As IMF Managing Director, my message was one of vigilance and action.

zh: 简单地说，就是国际社会必须利用当前的复苏，扩大努力，确保金融和经济的稳定，并向那些前景堪忧的国家伸出援手。
en: Simply put, the international community must take advantage of the current recovery to broaden efforts to ensure financial and economic stability, and help those countries with limited prospects.

zh: 在经济增长强劲的时期，国家可以建立起防御机制，降低未来出现经济低迷的可能性和严重性。
en: Periods of strong economic growth allow countries to put in place defenses to reduce the likelihood and severity of future downturns.

zh: 但是这样的机会太容易被浪费掉了。
en: But such opportunities are all too easy to squander.

zh: 在这个金融市场全球化的时代，国家很难应付快速的跨国界资金流动，没有时间让我们沾沾自喜。
en: In an era of globalized financial markets, when countries can find it hard to cope with rapid cross-border capital flows, there is no time for complacency.

zh: 上世纪90年代留给我们的教训是，在弱点演变成危机之前就必须采取措施应对。
en: A lesson of the 1990's is that vulnerabilities must be dealt with before they become crises.

zh: 2004年世界性的快速经济增长表明，从上世纪90年代以来所做的建立防御机制的努力是卓有成效的。
en: The world's rapid economic growth in 2004 shows that the efforts to shore up our defenses since the 1990's has paid off.

zh: 但是增长并不平衡：欧洲和日本 - - 虽然最近略有回升 - - 还远远没有发挥他们的潜力，而美国和中国仍然是世界经济的主要推动力。
en: But growth has been unbalanced: Europe and Japan - despite some recent gains - are far from reaching their potential, and the United States and China have continued largely to drive the world economy.

zh: 一个需要优先解决的问题就是要降低全球薪酬的不平衡。
en: One priority is to reduce global payments imbalances.

zh: 美国必须行动起来，减少中期的预算赤字。
en: The US must move to reduce its budget deficit in the medium-term.

zh: 欧洲和日本可以通过加快结构改革的步伐保持增长。
en: Europe and Japan can increase their growth by stepping up the pace of structural reform.

zh: 中国和其他亚洲国家在金融部门改革的支持下提高汇率灵活性的措施将带来国内和全球性的利益。
en: Moves toward increased exchange rate flexibility in China and other Asian countries, supported by financial sector reform, will have domestic and global benefits.

zh: 其他地方的新兴市场国家近来在改革方面取得了可观的进展，但是他们必须保持动力，预防潜在的动荡。
en: Emerging market countries elsewhere have made considerable reform progress of late, but they must sustain the momentum to guard against potential shocks.

zh: 另外还有其他迫在眉睫的挑战。
en: Other challenges loom.

zh: 我们以前称之为"中期"的问题正在变得更加紧迫。
en: Issues that we once regarded as "medium-term" are becoming more urgent.

zh: 老龄化人口正在迫使许多国家解决预算和社会保障体系所面临的压力。
en: Aging populations are forcing many countries to address pressures on their budgets and social security systems.

zh: 这个问题在北美、欧元区和日本特别紧迫。
en: The problem is imminent in North America, the Euro Area, and Japan.

zh: 但是不久之后，许多发展中国家也将面临这个问题，而且在许多地方没有财富的缓冲。
en: But, before long, many developing countries will also have to face up to it, and in many cases without a cushion of affluence.

zh: 然后还有能源问题。
en: Then there is the energy issue.

zh: 高油价使一个昔日的弱点死灰复燃。
en: High oil prices have resurrected an old vulnerability.

zh: 各个国家需要重新制定各自的能源政策 - - 包括提高生产和精炼能力，多样化能源，给节能注入新的动力。
en: Countries need to reformulate their energy policies - including by boosting production and refining capacity, diversifying energy sources, and giving new impetus to conservation.

zh: 在生产和消耗之间取得更佳的平衡，可以避免油价的大幅摇摆。
en: A better balance between production and consumption would avoid large swings in oil prices.

zh: 国际货币基金组织以预防危机为重点，在过去的十年鼓励建立更加透明稳定的金融制度。
en: The IMF focuses on crisis prevention, and in the past decade encouraged greater transparency and stronger financial systems.

zh: 本组织还积极地监督资金市场发展，目前正在实施一项更加系统化的债务可持续性评估。
en: The Fund also actively monitors capital market developments, and is implementing a more systematic assessment of debt sustainability.

zh: 我们总能找到方法加强我们的工作，以便在对每个国家的清楚了解和恰当分析的基础上提供明确的建议。
en: There will always be ways to strengthen our work so that we provide well-articulated advice based on a clear understanding and the best analysis of each country.

zh: 我们需要把我们的立场明确地传达给决策者们，加强激励各国采取适当补救措施的动力。
en: We need to communicate our positions clearly to policymakers and reinforce incentives for countries to take appropriate corrective actions.

zh: 但是归根结底，我们的建议是否有效还是要取决于各国是否愿意按照我们的建议行动。
en: But in the end, the effectiveness of our advice hinges on countries' willingness to act on our recommendations.

zh: 贫困问题也威胁着经济的稳定。
en: Poverty also threatens economic stability.

zh: 面对最近数十年来的所有成就，真实的情况一直是：世界上20%的人口仍然仅靠每天不足1美元的收入生活，同时艾滋病和其他传染病在许多国家肆虐。
en: For all the successes of recent decades, the fact remains that 20% of the world's population still lives on less than $1 a day, while HIV/AIDS and other communicable diseases are ravaging many societies.

zh: 其他的社会指标也描绘了一幅黯淡的画面。
en: Other social indicators offer a bleak picture.

zh: 的确，大多数发展中国家都可能无法实现国际社会到2015年使贫困人口减少一半的目标。
en: Indeed, most developing countries are likely to fall short of the international community's target of halving poverty by 2015.

zh: 2002年，在蒙特雷会议上，国际社会达成一项实现这个目标的框架协议。
en: In 2002, at the Monterrey Conference, the international community agreed on a framework for reaching that goal.

zh: 发展中国家将实施健康的经济政策，并施以良好的管理。
en: Developing countries would implement sound economic policies accompanied by good governance.

zh: 工业化国家将提高援助水平，降低贸易壁垒���国际货币基金组织和世界银行将提供建议、专业知识和资金，其中本组织将集中应对对培养可持续增长和减少贫困至关重要的宏观经济及金融稳定问题。
en: Industrial countries would increase aid levels and lower trade barriers. The IMF and World Bank would offer advice, expertise, and financing, with the Fund concentrating on the macroeconomic and financial stability that is crucial to fostering durable growth and poverty reduction.

zh: 这项"蒙特雷协议"已经取得了一些进展。
en: Some progress has been made on this "Monterrey Consensus."

zh: 但是国际援助远远没有达到承诺的水平。
en: But international support is falling far below promised levels.

zh: 我们需要坚定的政治决心，提供加速进步所需的援助，确保多哈贸易谈判成功 - - 这对发展中国家的长远未来非常重要。
en: Strong political commitments are needed to provide the aid that is needed to accelerate progress, and to secure success for the Doha trade round that is so crucial for developing countries' longer-term prospects.

zh: 全球经济在政治和经济动荡中的复苏表明改革过程的核心实用性 - - 并且说明继续沿着这条道路走下去的重要性。
en: The resilience of the global economy in the face of political and economic shocks demonstrates the central relevance of the reform process - and underlines the importance of continuing along this path.

zh: 各国政府和国际货币基金组织这样的机构在努力保持可持续经济复苏、为全世界人民谋福利的过程中必须把这一点铭记在心。
en: Governments and institutions like the IMF must keep this in mind as they seek to ensure a durable economic recovery that will benefit all of the world's people.

zh: 坚韧不拔的巴基斯坦？
en: Resilient Pakistan?

zh: 伊斯兰堡—自12月中旬以来，巴基斯坦经历了一系列政治和经济动荡，即使从巴基斯坦的标准看，这几次动荡也可谓剧烈。
en: ISLAMABAD – Since mid-December, Pakistan has experienced political and economic volatility that is extraordinary even by Pakistani standards.

zh: 2008年文职政府重新上台之争后形成的脆弱的政治结构摇摇欲坠。
en: The fragile political structure that began to be erected following the resumption of civilian government in 2008 is now shaking.

zh: 一个主要乱源是一名来自多伦多的名叫塔德里（Tahirul Qadri）的穆斯林。
en: A key source of this unrest is Tahirul Qadri, a Toronto-based Muslim cleric who arrived in Lahore in early December.

zh: 12月初，他来到拉合尔，十天后，他在该市独立纪念塔广场的大型公众集会上发表了演讲。 一年前，板球运动员出身的政客的伊姆兰·汗（Imran Khan）在这里掀起了一场他称之为（尽管有些用词不当）政治海啸的风波。
en: Ten days later, he addressed a mammoth public meeting at the city’s Minar-e-Pakistan grounds, where, a year earlier, the cricketer-turned-politician Imran Khan had launched what he not very appropriately termed a political tsunami.

zh: 塔德里给伊斯兰堡政府发出了20天最后通牒，要求政府净化腐败猖獗的政治制度、重组选举委员会，并任命看守当局监督新选举。
en: Qadri issued a 20-day ultimatum to the government in Islamabad to purge the political system of rampant corruption, reconstitute the Election Commission, and appoint a caretaker administration to oversee the upcoming vote.

zh: 他表示，看守当局应该包括技术官僚、退休军官和法官，持续时间应长于宪法规定90天。
