en: The caretakers, he said, should include technocrats, retired military officers, and judges – and could remain in office longer than the constitutionally permitted 90 days.

zh: 除非政府采取这些步骤，否则他将在首都组织百万人大游行。
en: Unless the government took these steps, he would lead a million-man march on the capital.

zh: 政府拒绝服从，然后，5万人走向了充满传奇色彩的伊斯兰堡主干道（Grand Trunk Road ） ， 在36个小时内完成了300公里长征。
en: When the government did not oblige, 50,000 people set out on the fabled Grand Trunk Road to Islamabad, taking 36 hours to complete the 300-kilometer trek.

zh: 塔德里数次向游行者发表演讲，有意散播政治隐喻，自称为当代毛泽东，正在发动一场净化制度的圣战，领导巴基斯坦版阿拉伯之春。
en: Qadri addressed the marchers repeatedly; liberally mixing political metaphors, he called himself a latter-day Mao Zedong on a journey to launch a system-cleansing jihad and initiate a Pakistani version of the Arab Spring.

zh: 1月10日，在塔德里计划长征的同时，两名受极端组织坚格维军（Lashkar-e-Jhangvi，被禁止的逊尼派组织）派遣的人肉炸弹袭击了奎塔市的什叶派哈扎啦（Hazara）社区，造成近100人死亡。
en: On January 10, while Qadri was planning his march, two suicide bombers sent by the extremist Lashkar-e-Jhangvi, a banned Sunni group, attacked the Shia Hazara community in Quetta, killing almost a hundred people.

zh: 哈扎啦对该袭击事件的反应是抬棺游行。
en: The Hazaras reacted to the attack by making the coffins of the dead a symbol of protest.

zh: 他们将死者抬上贯穿该市什叶派社区的阿兰达尔大街（Alamdaar Street ） ， 并拒绝在政府开除无能腐败的地方官员前下葬，当地行政长官在国外和伊斯兰堡呆的时间比在省会更长。
en: They lined up the dead on Alamdaar Street, which runs through the city’s Shia community, and refused to bury them until the government dismissed inept and corrupt local officials, led by a local nawab who spent more time abroad or in Islamabad than in the provincial capital.

zh: 政府屈服了，撤消了行政长官及其班子，由省长暂时主管这一麻烦重重的省。
en: The government succumbed and removed the chief minister and his cabinet, placing the troubled province under the care of the provincial governor.

zh: 五天后，活跃的巴基斯坦最高法院以涉嫌所谓的“电力租赁”案为由下令逮捕总理阿什拉夫和16名其他政府高官。
en: Five days later, Pakistan’s ever-active Supreme Court ordered the arrest of Prime Minister Raja Pervez Ashraf and 16 other senior government officials for alleged involvement in what was called the “rental power” case.

zh: 该案可以追溯到2008—2011年，阿什拉夫当时担任水电部长，监督租赁发电机组的巨额合同，当时，缺点给巴基斯坦经济造成的成本高达GDP的5 % 。
en: The case dates back to 2008-2011, when Ashraf, who was Minister of Water and Power at the time, oversaw large contracts to rent power generators, which were needed to ease an electricity shortage that was costing the economy up to 5% of GDP.

zh: 纸媒和电子媒体的一些报告表明，阿什拉夫所主管的部门所给出的合同有猫腻。
en: Several reports in the print and electronic media suggested that the contracts awarded by Ashraf’s ministry were tainted.

zh: 财政部求助亚洲开发银行，后者确认大量资金从发电机组租赁协议中漏出，许多租赁单位的发电量远低于承诺值。
en: The finance ministry called in the Asian Development Bank, which confirmed that a large amount of money had leaked from the agreements, and that many of the rental units generated much less power than promised.

zh: 最高法院注意到了亚洲开发银行的发现，开始审理针对阿什拉夫和其他高官（包括一些财政部官员）的案件。
en: The Supreme Court took note of the ADB’s findings and started proceedings against Ashraf and other senior officials, including several from the finance ministry.

zh: 阿什拉夫从内阁辞职，后来又出任总理。
en: Ashraf resigned from the cabinet, only to be brought back later as Prime Minister.

zh: 追溯历史可以发现，程度轻得多的危机就会导致军方重返政坛，1958年、1969年、1977年和1999年都发生过此类事件。
en: In earlier times, crises of much lesser intensity would have brought the military rushing onto the political stage, as happened in 1958, 1969, 1977, and 1999.

zh: 事实上，自1947年独立以来，军队掌管巴基斯坦的年份多达33年。
en: Indeed, the army has ruled Pakistan for a total of 33 years since independence in 1947.

zh: 但这一回，军队并未走出军营，原因很简单：觉醒的民众、活跃的公民社会和充满活力的自由媒体不会容忍政治再次落入军方之手。
en: But this time the soldiers have remained in their barracks, for the simple reason that an awakened populace, an active civil society, and a free and vibrant media would not tolerate another venture into politics by the army.

zh: 在经历了五年的民主治理后，巴基斯坦正在建立持久的代议制政治秩序。
en: After almost five years of democratic rule, Pakistan is on its way to establishing a durable and representative political order.

zh: 尽管廉洁高效的政府尚未产生，但公众满怀信心的认为，主要同心协力，巴基斯坦定会找出一条走出混乱局面的道路。
en: While it has not produced clean and efficient government, there seems to be considerable comfort in the popular belief that, by working together, Pakistanis will find a way out of the mess in which the country finds itself.

zh: 1月16日，拉合尔大部分反对党举行连夜会议，拒绝了塔德里的要求，同时通知政府坚守到大选。
en: A late-evening meeting of most opposition parties in Lahore on January 16 rejected Qadri’s demands, while telling the government to stay the course toward the general election.

zh: 一天后，政府找到了挽回颜面的办法，将这位牧师政客 — — 更重要的，还有他的追随者 — — 遣送回国，并承诺给选举委员会时间以确定候选人是否符合选举法的相关规定。
en: A day later, the government found a face-saving formula to send the preacher-politician – and, more important, his followers – home, promising that the Election Commission will be given the time to determine candidates’ eligibility under the relevant constitutional provisions.

zh: 因此，从某种程度上说，塔德里的巴基斯坦之行及其强烈的政治激进主义达到了目的：他增强了人民的对他们正在建设的制度的信念。
en: So, in a way, Qadri’s arrival in Pakistan and his intense political activism have served a purpose: he has reinforced the people’s faith in a system that they are continuing to build.

zh: 自下而上地建立巴勒斯坦国
en: Building Palestine From the Bottom Up

zh: 耶路撒冷 — — 作为巴拉克·奥巴马总统的中东问题特使，前美国参议员乔治·米切尔在对中东地区的访问中获悉，有三大障碍阻碍美国为以巴和平所付出的努力取得成果。
en: JERUSALEM – As President Barack Obama’s special Middle East envoy, former US Senator George Mitchell, learned during his visit to the region, America’s efforts at Israeli-Palestinian peace-making are running up against three major obstacles.

zh: 毫无疑问，奥巴马在与地区领袖即将举行的会议上也将提到这些问题。
en: They will, no doubt, also arise in Obama’s upcoming meetings with the region’s leaders.

zh: 持续不断的巴勒斯坦内战便是第一大障碍 — — 实际上也是今天最突出的核心问题。 控制加沙地带的哈马斯没有把由法塔赫阿布·马赞领导的巴勒斯坦当局放在眼里。
en: The first obstacle – indeed, the issue that stands front and center today – is the ongoing Palestinian civil war, with Hamas controlling the Gaza Strip in defiance of Abu Mazen’s Fatah-led Palestinian Authority.

zh: 巴勒斯坦在基础建国问题上的一无所成导致目前几乎不可能与以色列进行任何有意义的和平谈判 — — 更不要说签订协议了。
en: The Palestinians’ basic failure at nation-building makes any meaningful peace talks with Israel – let alone an agreement – almost impossible at the moment.

zh: 在巴勒斯坦人无法达成最起码的国家共识的情况下，又如何能在他们和以色列中间实现和平呢？
en: With Palestinians unable to agree among themselves on a minimal national consensus, how can peace be established between them and Israel?

zh: 其次，在利库德集团的本杰明·内塔尼亚胡担任总理的情况下，以色列的现政府愿意 — — 或者能够 — — 做出重大让步，从西岸撤出数十万以色列定居者的可能性大大降低。
en: Second, with Likud’s Benjamin Netanyahu as prime minister, Israel now has a government which is far less likely to be willing – or able – to make major concessions and evacuate hundreds of thousands of Israeli settlers from the West Bank.

zh: 第三点，也是最重要的一点，1993年以色列与巴解组织签订的协议到目前为止并未达到既定的目的。
en: Third, and most significantly, the 1993 Israel-PLO agreement has until now failed to achieve its aim.

zh: 恢复奥斯陆和平进程的努力 — — “路线图”和安纳波利斯计划 — — 同样也未能突破空洞的宣言和毫无意义的拍照机会。
en: Attempts to revive the Oslo peace process – the “Road Map” and the Annapolis process – have similarly failed to achieve more than vacuous declarations and hollow photo opportunities.

zh: 15年来失败的原因值得总结，这样米切尔此行才不会又一次胎死腹中。
en: The causes of these 15 years of failure should be considered, so that Mitchell’s mission does not become another stillborn effort.

zh: 奥斯陆和平进程失败我们有理由责怪巴勒斯坦人和以色列人。
en: Both the Palestinians and Israel can easily and rightly be blamed for the failure of the Oslo process.

zh: 但其中涉及到更根本的原因，我们也不应当忽视。
en: But there is a more fundamental cause at stake, and it should not be overlooked.

zh: 奥斯陆进程企图自上而下地实现巴勒斯坦建国：建立巴勒斯坦民族权力机构、向其移交土地、逐步扩大权力、为其配备武器提供资金、举行选举、这样巴勒斯坦国就会慢慢崛起。
en: The Oslo process tried to build a Palestinian state from the top down: create a Palestinian national authority, hand over territory to it, give it increasing power, arm it and finance it, hold elections, and a Palestinian state would emerge.

zh: 不过事与愿违，以这种方式建立起来的却是一个军事化、腐败的巴勒斯坦政府，各派安全力量之间相互掣肘，根本无法提供安全服务。
en: Instead, the consequence was a corrupt, militarized Palestinian Authority, with competing security services proved incapable of providing security.

zh: 这样的机构也无法与以色列举行可信的谈判，同样不能为普普通通的巴勒斯坦人提供必要的服务。
en: Nor could it conduct credible negotiations with Israel or deliver necessary services to ordinary Palestinians.

zh: 两大原因导致了这样的失败：其一是巴勒斯坦公民社会的制度弱点，缺乏建国所必须的基础设施；另外则是不可能同时完成建国和维和两大任务。
en: Two reasons for this failure stand out: the institutional weakness of Palestinian civil society, which lacks the infrastructure necessary for nation-building; and the impossibility of simultaneous nation-building and peace-making.

zh: 全世界还没有任何先例表明这样一种双重目标的努力能够取得成功。
en: There is no precedent anywhere in the world that suggests that such a two-tier process can succeed.

zh: 必须要对计划做出根本性的改变：努力的目标应当转到自下而上地建立巴勒斯坦国，即便是在自上而下努力失败的时候，也有令人鼓舞的迹象表明，自下而上的努力将是我们的出路。
en: A fundamental change of paradigm is needed: the effort should shift to building a Palestinian state from the bottom up, for which there are encouraging signs, even in the midst of the failure of the top-down process.

zh: 过去两年来，英国前首相托尼·布莱尔和美国将军基思·代顿已经成功地在杰宁、伯利恒和希伯伦等西岸三大区域建立了有效运转的体制 — — 从而把上述地区变成了以色列部署军力最少的西岸最和平的区域。
en: In the last two years, former British Prime Minister Tony Blair and US General Keith Dayton have succeeded in effective institution-building in three West Bank districts – Jenin, Bethlehem, and Hebron – turning them into the most peaceful areas in the West Bank, with a minimal Israeli military presence.

zh: 地方当局得到了充足的资金和建议；独立商会成为当地商人中产阶级的主心骨，他们即便在没有签订总体协议的情况下也竭力维护地区的和平；当地警察（在约旦）受训，现在有效地扮演着警察、而不是武装民兵的角色；同时与临近以色列地区的商业关系也得以重新建立。
en: Local authorities were supplied with adequate funding and advice; independent chambers of commerce became the backbone of a local commercial middle class, which is interested in keeping the region peaceful, even absent an overall agreement; local police were trained (in Jordan), and now function effectively as police forces, not armed militias; and business relations with adjacent Israeli regions have been renewed.

zh: 这种针对当地领导层的有效授权行动更多的是持之以恒 — — 而绝非虚张声势。 但这种基础性的项目首次为巴勒斯坦有效建国铺平了道路。
en: This empowerment of an effective local leadership was done with much persistence – and little fanfare. But these nuts-and-bolts projects created – for the first time – the building blocks necessary for effective Palestinian nation-building.

zh: 不可否认的是，这样的和平进程需要时间和耐心。
en: Admittedly, this process will take time and patience.

zh: 但到目前为止，它仍然是经过事实证明的唯一一条成功的道路，而其他所有方法都以失败而告终。
en: But, until now, it has been the only approach proven to succeed, while everything else has failed.

zh: 正如布莱尔不久前所说的那样，这样一种自下而上的和平进程甚至可以同内塔尼亚胡的“经济和平”目标和谐共处，虽然它最终必将超越上述领域。
en: As Blair recently put it, such a bottom-up process may even go hand-in-hand with Netanyahu’s goal of an “economic peace,” though it would eventually have to go beyond it.

zh: 而且一个不争的事实是，这种方式必须彻底停止以色列一切定居活动。
en: That such an approach would have to include a total halt to Israeli settlement activities goes without saying.

zh: 如果措辞时更加谨慎，这一进程甚至可能得到以色列政府的暗中认可，虽然这样的结果也许并不能令他们完全满意。
en: If carefully crafted, it may even be implicitly accepted, albeit without much enthusiasm, by the Israeli government.

zh: 奥斯陆和平进程已经失败，重新启动这一进程的努力 — — 比如以贝鲁特阿拉伯和平协议的方式 — — 只能导致双方现有矛盾的公开化，也无法跨越巴勒斯坦建国的失败努力而取得成功。
en: The Oslo process has failed; an attempt to revive it – say, by way of the Beirut Arab peace initiative – will merely bring into the open all of the existing disagreements between the two sides, and will not overcome the Palestinian failure at nation-building.

zh: 在经历了自上而下建国的种种挫折之后，只有老式的方法 — — 自下而上 — — 才是一种可行的选择。
en: After all the breakdowns in efforts to create a Palestinian state from the top down, only the old-fashioned way – from the bottom up – remains viable.

zh: 构建亚太区域共治下的和平
en: Building Pax Asia-Pacifica

zh: 发自马尼拉 — — 亚洲当前紧张局势的主要来源之一就是斯普拉特利群岛（即中国南沙群岛，西方称之为Spratly Islands）和南中国海问题，因为包括菲律宾，越南以及中国在内的众多国家一直对该区域存在主权争议。
en: MANILA – One of the main sources of tension in Asia nowadays are the Spratly Islands in the South China Sea, where the Philippines, Vietnam, China, and others have conflicting claims.

zh: 据中国媒体报道，该区域日渐浓厚的“不友善”气氛主要是由某些菲律宾评论者“散布谣言和妄加猜测”所挑起的。
en: In Chinese media reports, the heightened “unfriendliness” in the region has allegedly arisen from “bad rumors and speculations” on the part of Filipino commentators.

zh: 但事实却摆在那里：五月，中国飞机入侵菲律宾（在该区域的）领空；三月，中国巡逻船进犯距菲律宾巴拉望岛仅85公里的Recto Bank（即南沙群岛礼乐摊 ） ； 更严重的是，二月时一艘中国导弹护卫舰竟然在巴拉望岛Quirino atoll（即南沙群岛五方礁）附近海域炮击菲律宾渔船。
en: But the reality is starker: the intrusions by Chinese aircraft into Filipino airspace in May; Chinese patrol boats cruising in March in the Recto (Reed) Bank, 85 miles west of the Filipino island of Palawan; and, most serious of all, a Chinese missile frigate firing at Filipino fishing boats in February near Palawan’s Quirino atoll.

zh: 那么这类一再产生（似乎也在不断升级）的摩擦是否会演变成为菲越两国与中国之间的武装冲突？
en: Will armed conflict result from these recurring – and, it seems, escalating – disputes between the Philippines and Vietnam on one side, and China on the other?

zh: 战争显然对各方都没有好处，但摩擦所带来的风险却在不断上升，因为中国与菲越两国的关系已经降到了数十年来的最低点。
en: War, of course, is in no one’s interest. But the risk posed by these disputes is growing, because China’s relations with both the Philippines and Vietnam are at their lowest point in decades.

zh: 在这样的紧张局势下，南中国海的主权争议无疑将很可能成为本月东盟区域论坛以及随后巴厘岛东亚峰会的核心议题。
en: Given these tensions, it is no surprise that the issue of disputed sovereignty in the South China Sea is almost certain to claim center stage at this month’s ASEAN Regional Forum, and at the East Asia summit in Bali that will follow it.

zh: 去年七月，我面对5000名菲利宾民众和几位中国官员发表了庆祝菲中建交36周年暨“菲中友谊日”10周年的讲话。
en: Last June, I gave the keynote speech at the celebrations marking the 36th anniversary of the establishment of Philippines-China diplomatic relations and the 10th anniversary of Philippines-China “Friendship Day” in the presence of 5,000 of my countrymen and a smattering of Chinese officials.

zh: 但就在同一天，中国国内报章的头条却在谴责菲利宾对斯普拉特利群岛的历史主权要求。
en: Yet on that same day, the headlines in Chinese papers were blasting the Philippines for its historic claim to ownership of the Spratly Islands.

zh: 当然，两国政府都认识到维持东亚这一世界上发展最快区域的稳定与协作的重要性。
en: Of course, the governments of both countries recognize the need to maintain the stability and cooperation that have made East Asia the world’s fastest growing region.

zh: 而这一点也适用于越南和美国政府。
en: The same is true of Vietnam’s government and that of the United States.

zh: 但目前仍未有任何制度化手段来调解这一争端，鉴于各方都知道该海域蕴藏有大量矿产能源，对此手段的渴望也日益迫切。
en: But there is no institutionalized means to discuss and resolve the dispute, which is taking on greater significance almost daily, owing to the belief that vast mineral and energy resources lay on the sea bed around the Spratlys.

zh: 如今也是中国、菲律宾、越南，其他各国以及美国着手消除这些紧张态势的时候了。
en: Now is the time for China, the Philippines, Vietnam, other claimants, and the US to take action to begin to diminish these tensions.

zh: 而当务之急则是由亚太地区各国领导人共同订立公约，无论大国小国，在充分尊重各方利益的情况下制定和平解决方案。
en: What is needed, above all, is a covenant among the leaders of the Asia/Pacific region that will make peaceful dispute resolution binding on all stakeholders, big or small.

zh: 也只有这样一个承诺能给于投资者 — — 不管来自哪方 — — 足够的信心来开发该海域的资源。
en: Only such a pledge can provide the type of certainty that investors – any investors – will need if the Spratly resources are to be developed.

zh: 当然，中国领导人也是如此表态的：在今年4月举行的海南博鳌论坛，中国国家主席胡锦涛表示 ： “ 和平与发展依然是这个时代的首要主题。
en: Certainly, China’s leaders talk as if this is their goal.

zh: 世界需要和平，各国应当发展，人民渴望合作（该段引用出处不详，对应主旨演讲原文可能为“推动共同发展，共建和谐亚洲，这是时代赋予亚洲人民的共同使命。
en: In April, at this year’s Boao Forum (the Asian Davos) on Hainan Island, Chinese President Hu Jintao asserted: “Peace and development remain the overriding themes of the times.

zh: ” — —译者注 ） … …中国永远做亚洲各国的好邻居、好朋友、好伙伴。 ”
en: The world needs peace, countries deserve development, and people want cooperation....China will always be a good neighbor, good friend, and good partner of other Asian countries.”

zh: 现在正是将这些声明付诸实施的时候；摩擦的和平解除也不能仅靠一个承诺。
en: It is past time to make those sentiments a reality; more than a pledge to resolve disputes peacefully is needed.

zh: 亚洲各国政府也必须同时开始坚持一个代价更大的理念 — — 开放区域主义 — — 这意味着像印度这样的国家也应当对亚太事务拥有发言权，同时必须尊重那些区域外国家的亚洲利益。
en: Asia’s governments must also begin to adhere to a far more expansive idea of open regionalism, which means that countries like India should have a voice in Asia/Pacific affairs, and they must respect the Asian interests of countries beyond the region.

zh: 比如应当欢迎美国参与 — — 或者长期参与 — — 维和与安全合作事务。
en: The US, for example, should be made welcome to participate – or continue to participate – in peacekeeping and security cooperation.

zh: 但亚洲各国如何能在这一点上达成共识？
en: But how is Asia to reach consensus on this point?

zh: 1994年时任越南国家主席的黎德英担任东南亚国家联盟（东盟）主席时，我就建议东盟各国领导人将斯普拉特利群岛变为非军事区来作为构建信任的第一步。
en: Ever since 1994, when Vietnam’s President Le Duc Anh held the presidency of ASEAN, I have proposed to ASEAN leaders that the Spratlys be demilitarized as a first step toward building trust.

zh: 《联合国海洋公约》以及相关国际承诺必须成为建设性谈话的基础，以此达成有约束力的公约，并随之启动对该海域资源的联合开发。
en: The UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) and associated international commitments must become the basis for productive dialogues leading to binding covenants. Joint exploration and development of the resources within and beneath the archipelago could then begin.

zh: 更宏观地说，亚洲政治家在未来5-10年的紧迫任务就是摒弃多年来维护区域稳定的美国治下的和平（Pax Americana ） ， 转而用构建在包容和承担之上的亚太区域共治下的和平（Pax Asia-Pacifica）接班。
en: More broadly, the urgent task for Asian statesmen over the next 5-10 years will be to replace the region’s Pax Americana, which has guaranteed regional stability for decades, with a more comprehensive Pax Asia-Pacifica that is built on inclusiveness and burden-sharing.

zh: 但这一亚太和平只有在基于多方利益平衡而非实力平衡时才能长久。
en: But such an Asia-Pacific peace will be durable only if it is based on a balance of mutual benefits rather than on the balance of power.

zh: 很显然，这一概念意味着所有亚太地区国家都必须承担相应责任来确保区域的和谐与安全。
en: Clearly, this concept implies burden-sharing by all Asia-Pacific countries to ensure the region’s harmony and security.

zh: 同时也有必要参照二战后的欧洲，在包括美国、中国、日本、印度、韩国，俄罗斯和东盟十国等大国和区域集团的稳固和协作承诺下建立相关亚太共治机构。
en: Pax Asia-Pacifica’s institutions will need to be built, as Europe’s peace was built after World War II, on strong, cooperative undertakings among the most powerful countries and regional blocs – the US, China, Japan, India, South Korea, Russia, and the ASEAN 10.

zh: 众所周知，本区域的持续发展和进步需要我们亚洲人消解敌意并避免武装升级，但不幸的是，这一切却正在眼前发生。
en: The region’s continued economic growth and progress require that we Asians contain our rivalries and avoid the arms buildups that, unfortunately, now seem to be underway.

zh: 给TTIP的小建议
en: Tips for the TTIP

zh: 马德里—三年前，美国和欧盟开启了跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系（TTIP）谈判，承诺“一鼓作气”完成谈判。
en: MADRID – Three years ago, the United States and the European Union launched negotiations on the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership (TTIP), promising to complete them on “one tank of gas.”

zh: 但如今，谈判仍在进行，两方都遇到了重重阻力，达成协定的政治窗口正在迅速关闭。
en: But now the talks are running on fumes, with sniping on both sides and the political window for an agreement closing fast.

zh: TTIP谈判所遇到的障碍并非它所独有。
en: The obstacles that the TTIP negotiations have run up against are not exclusive to that agreement.

zh: 它们反映了一个更为广泛的趋势 — — 这一趋势需要从根本上重新思考贸易和自由贸易协定的流行观点。
en: They reflect a broader trend – one that demands a fundamental rethink of the prevailing approach to trade and free-trade agreements.

zh: 毫无疑问，反对这类协定的力量在近几年中越来越强。
en: It is no secret that the backlash against such agreements has been gaining traction in recent years.

zh: 在美国，两位推定总统提名人 — — 民主党的希拉里·克林顿和共和党的唐纳德·特朗普 — — 都支持反贸易观点，特朗普的重商主义立场更是二战以来美国主流政治争论中首次出现。
en: In the US, both presumptive nominees for the presidency – the Democrats’ Hillary Clinton and the Republicans’ Donald Trump – have espoused anti-trade views, with Trump projecting a mercantilist approach unseen in mainstream US political debate since before World War II.

zh: 此外，美国与环太平洋十一国所谈成的跨太平洋合作伙伴关系获得国会支持的希望也是日益渺茫。
en: Moreover, it looks increasingly unlikely that the Trans-Pacific Partnership, which the US has negotiated with 11 other Pacific Rim countries, will receive congressional support.

zh: 欧洲政客也在追随选民，转向反对TTIP。
en: Politicians in Europe are also following voters in turning against the TTIP.

zh: 特别是法国总统奥朗德，在明年总统大选即将到来之际，他加紧了对TTIP协定的反对。
en: French President François Hollande, in particular, has intensified his opposition to the agreement in the run-up to next year’s presidential election.

zh: 事实上，对TTIP协定的支持大幅滑坡，以至于欧盟委员会主席容克要求领导人在本月的欧洲理事会上重申他们对该协定的承诺。
en: Support for the agreement has weakened so significantly, in fact, that European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker has called for leaders to reaffirm their commitment to the deal at this month’s European Council.

zh: 这一趋势的推手是人们感到全球化过犹不及，正在挤压普通公民，而受益的只是一小撮人。
en: Driving this trend is the sense that globalization has gone too far, and is now squeezing ordinary citizens, while enriching a select few.

zh: 这一感觉不无道理；一些团体确实在经济自由化中以他人为代价攫取了更高的回报。
en: And that sense is not unreasonable; some groups do reap higher rewards from economic liberalization while others suffer.

zh: 但现实是，受国际规则和标准指导的自由贸易，其净宏观影响是积极的。
en: But the reality is that free trade, guided by international rules and standards, has a net positive macroeconomic impact.

zh: 为了避免错失这些收益，我们需要加大力度重新获取公众对TTIP等增长刺激型协议的支持。
en: To avoid losing these benefits, much more must be done to recapture public support for growth-enhancing deals like the TTIP.

zh: 关键是要平稳抵消自由贸易的消极影响，让社会做好准备增进经济开放。
en: The key will be to smooth out free trade’s negative impacts and prepare societies better for increasing economic openness.

zh: 一个显而易见的当务之急是将支持计划 — — 美国的贸易调整援助和欧盟的欧洲全球化调整基金列为重点，注重受贸易协定消极影响的群体。
en: Placing a high priority on support programs – trade adjustment assistance in the US and the European Globalization Adjustment Fund in the EU – with a focus on groups that are negatively affected by agreements is one obvious imperative.

zh: 但这只是权宜之计。
en: But these are just stopgaps.

zh: 自由商品、服务和资本流动对社会构成了根本性挑战 — — 并且因为快速的技术进步（最近是机器人）而以及加剧 — — 结构改革必不可少。
en: Given the fundamental challenges to society posed by the free flow of goods, services, and capital – and compounded by rapid technological progress, most immediately in robotics – structural reforms must also be undertaken.

zh: 一个需要社会予以关注的领域是教育。
en: One area that will require special attention is education.

zh: 在全部行业都受到威胁的情况下，工人面临越来越大的换工作的需要。
en: With entire industries coming under threat, workers increasingly face the need to switch careers.

zh: 在这样的条件下，过去半个世纪的课程表必须重新设计，一个指导事项是要确保工人具备更高水平的能轻松适应范围甚广的多种行业的“元技能 ” 。
en: In this context, curricula that have defined education for the last half-century must be rethought, with a view toward ensuring that workers are equipped with higher-level “meta-skills” that can be adapted easily to a broad array of industries.

zh: 考虑到政治拖累因素，有流言称美国和欧洲领导人将形成一个狭隘的TTIP，只包括已经达成协定的领域。
en: Given the political pushback, there have been rumblings that US and EU leaders will settle on a narrow TTIP, covering only areas where there has already been agreement.

zh: 这一协议将是一个错过的机会，因为TTIP本有可能实现更多东西。
en: Such a deal would be a missed opportunity, because the TTIP has the potential to do much more.

zh: 一个具备更广泛的监管覆盖面的TTIP能够促进贸易的大幅增长。
en: A TTIP with wider regulatory convergence could facilitate a significant increase in trade.

zh: 此外，奠定一个欧盟和美国（GDP分别高达18.5万亿和17.5万亿美元）从根本上作为平等合作伙伴的联合工程能够重振双边关系。
en: Moreover, a TTIP that establishes a joint project in which the EU and the US (with GDPs of $18.5 trillion and $17.5 trillion, respectively) are essentially equal partners could reinvigorate the bilateral relationship.

zh: 对欧洲来说，该协议的好处还要更大，因为它能提高欧盟在全球标准制定方面的话语权，而目前欧盟日益被边缘化。
en: For Europe, the deal would be even more beneficial, as it would amplify the EU’s voice in global standard setting at a time when it is increasingly being talked over.

zh: 有限协定不但不能带来这些好处，实际上还会因为尽显弱势和将规则制定事宜让给其他场合而破坏跨大西洋共同体的分量和影响力。
en: A limited agreement would not only fail to bring these benefits; it could actually undercut the weight and influence of the transatlantic community, by signaling weakness and ceding rulemaking to other forums.

zh: 在当前的政治约束下，让TTIP获得最大影响力绝非易事，需要一些创造性思维 — — 就像去年12月促成巴黎气候协定的那样。
en: Given current political constraints, developing a TTIP with maximum impact will not be easy, and it will require some creative thinking – like that which facilitated the Paris climate agreement last December.

zh: 巴黎协议是一次跃进，表明了如何达成国际协定 — — 它兼具硬规则、不具约束力的承诺以及起支配作用的框架，让195个国家达成了协定。
en: That deal represented a leap forward in how international agreements are made, as it wove together hard rules, non-binding pledges, and overarching frameworks to enable an agreement among 195 countries.

zh: 受这一创新方法的启发，美国和欧盟应该在它们已经达成约束性标准的领域的基础上更进一步，采取广泛原则和框架为后续更艰��的问题谈判创造条件，比如卫生和食品安全。
en: Taking inspiration from this innovative approach, the US and the EU should move on from areas in which they have already agreed on binding standards, and adopt broad principles and frameworks for ongoing negotiations on knottier issues, such as health and food safety.

zh: 这一机制已经体现在TTIP中 — — TTIP有一个关于监管合作的方案章节 — — 但定义模糊，也十分有限。
en: Such a mechanism is already envisioned in the TTIP, in a proposed chapter on regulatory cooperation, but in an indefinite and limited way.

zh: 更加依赖非约束性合作的方针的即期影响较弱，但它可以成为在不必放弃TTIP长期潜力的情况下克服即期政治障碍的关键。
en: While an approach that rests more heavily on non-binding cooperation would have a weaker immediate impact, it could be the key to overcoming immediate political hurdles, without giving up on the TTIP’s longer-term potential.

zh: 此外，它也有助于增强美国在国际规则制定前沿的地位，并让欧洲回到美国的同一边。
en: Furthermore, it could help to reinforce America’s place at the forefront of international rulemaking, while propelling Europe back to America’s side.

zh: 在经历了三年的谈判后，TTIP完全没有实现应有的成果 — — 并且如果没有公共支持，永远无法实现。
en: After three years of negotiating, the TTIP is simply not where it needs to be – and, without public support, it never will be.

zh: 改变公众观点要比取巧的口风困难得多；它需要改变贸易的进行方式和社会适应开放和进步的方式。
en: Shifting popular opinion will take a lot more than slick messaging; it will require changes in how trade is conducted and how society adjusts to openness and progress.

zh: 这需要时间。
en: That will take time.

zh: 美国和欧盟得找到加气站才行。
en: The US and the EU should find a gas station.

zh: 设计更加负责任的数字未来
en: Engineering a More Responsible Digital Future

zh: 苏黎世—世界正在经受技术破坏的锤炼，大数据分析、人工智能、机器人、物联网、区块链、3D打印和虚拟现实等创新改变了社会和经济的运行方式。
en: ZURICH – The world is being battered by technological disruption, as innovations such as big data analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, the Internet of Things, blockchain, 3D printing, and virtual reality change how societies and economies work.

zh: 从个体角度，这些技术的每一项都有可能改变既有产品、服务和相关支持网络。
en: Individually, each of these technologies has the potential to transform established products, services, and associated support networks.

zh: 综合起来，它们将颠覆旧商业模式和机构，预示着新的经济、社会和政治历史时期。
en: Taken together, they will upend old business models and institutions, heralding a new era of economic, social, and political history.

zh: 我们应该如何应对？
en: How will we respond?

zh: 重大经济转型常常会产生影响深远的变化。
en: Major economic transformations typically produce far-reaching change.

zh: 第一次工业革命期间，在十八和十九世纪，新制造工艺最终带来了人类福祉的巨大改善。
en: During the first Industrial Revolution, in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries, new manufacturing processes eventually led to huge improvements in human wellbeing.

zh: 随着生产率的提高，薪水和生活标准也随之上升。
en: As productivity increased, salaries and living standards rose.

zh: 但在这个过程的早期，机械化带来了消极后果，如失业、童工和环境破坏等。
en: But, early in the process, mechanization brought negative consequences, like unemployment, child labor, and environmental degradation.

zh: 数字革命的社会和政治影响可能更加剧烈。
en: The social and political impact of the digital revolution could be even more dramatic.

zh: 有可能爆发战争和革命，人权和公民自由等价值观可能遭到削弱。
en: Wars and revolutions may erupt, and values like human rights and civil liberties could be undermined.

zh: 我的同事和我在发表于《科学美国人 》 （ Scientific American）杂志上的最新文章中指出，计算机越了解我们 ， “ 我们的选择就越不可能自由和不由他人预先决定 ” — —因为信息自决权可望而不可即。
en: As my colleagues and I noted in a recent article in Scientific American, the more computers know about us, “the less likely our choices are to be free and not predetermined by others” – as long as informational self-determination is impossible.

zh: 辛运的是，个体自主权的损失并不是不可避免的。
en: Fortunately, the loss of individual autonomy is not inevitable.

zh: 设计一个更加负责的数字未来的可能性时存在的。
en: It is possible to engineer a more responsible digital future.

zh: 但我们必须立即采取行动。
en: But we must start doing so immediately.

zh: 成功需要公共讨论、数字启蒙和解放，以及对科技的风险的广泛认识。
en: Success requires public discourse, digital enlightenment and emancipation, and broader awareness of technology’s risks.

zh: 换句话说，我们面临的转变不是任何一个国家或组织可以单枪匹马面对的。
en: In other words, the transition we are facing is bigger than any one country or organization can manage alone.

zh: 我们都有切身利益在其中：我们的未来。
en: We all have something at stake: our future.

zh: 显然，放任技术进步独自推动这一变化是危险的。
en: There are obvious dangers in letting technological progress alone drive this change.

zh: 2008年 ， 《 连线 》 （ Wired）杂志编辑克里斯·安德森（Chris Anderson）提出大数据最终将揭示一切真理，不再需要科学或理论。
en: In 2008, Wired editor Chris Anderson suggested that big data would eventually reveal all truth, without requiring science or theory.

zh: 显然，这并未发生。
en: Clearly, that hasn’t happened.

zh: 有了更多可以尽情使用的数据，科学家发现了更多研究模式；需要科学来判断哪些有意义，哪些具有误导性。
en: With more data at their disposal, scientists find more patterns to study; it takes science to judge which are meaningful and which are misleading.

zh: 人工智能将克服偏见等人类弱点的预期也落了空。
en: The expectation that AI would overcome human weaknesses such as bias has also fallen short.

zh: 如今，许多人工智能系统歧视人类，甚至可以操纵。
en: Today, many AI systems discriminate against people, and can even be manipulated.

zh: 其他关于新的“数字社会”的预测也同样不靠谱。
en: Other predictions of the new “digital society” were equally off-base.

zh: 所谓的智能城市 — — 城市生活自动化 — — 没有达到预期。
en: So-called smart cities – in which urban life is automated – have so far failed to live up to expectations.

zh: 这是因为，城市不仅仅是规模庞大的供应链；它们也是试验、创造力、创新、学习和互动的场所。
en: That’s because cities are not simply giant supply chains; they are also spaces for experimentation, creativity, innovation, learning, and interaction.

zh: 最后，尽管在“平台经济”及其对互联网、计算和数据的依赖中产生了一些价值最高的公司，但它们也让许多公民变成了消极被动的消费者。
en: Finally, while the “platform economy,” and its reliance on the Internet, computation, and data, has given rise to some of the most valuable companies in the world, it has also turned many citizens into passive consumers.

zh: 超级联动的讽刺之处是人们不仅不再区分他们所购买的产品，也不再区分他们所消费的信息。
en: The irony of hyper-connectivity is that people are less discerning not only about the products they buy, but also with the information they consume.

zh: 毕竟，是这一“吸引力经济”产生了“假新闻 ” 。
en: It is, after all, this “attention economy” that spawned “fake news.”

zh: 简言之，我们的数字乌托邦不能说来就来。
en: Simply put, our digital utopia will not arrive unaided.

zh: 我们需要更加注重伦理的方针设计技术，这个方针要将宪政、文化和道德标准和价值观与人工和自主系统相融合。
en: We need a more ethical approach to engineering technology, one that integrates constitutional, cultural, and moral norms and values into artificial and autonomous systems.

zh: 科技发展的方方面面都需要“伦理一致 ” 、 “价值观敏感”的设计方针 — — 不管是智能设备还是支持我们的政府和市场的软件。
en: An “ethically aligned,” “value-sensitive” design approach is needed in every aspect of technological development – from smart devices to the software that supports our governments and markets.

zh: 比如，如果民主模式想要继续具有政治可行性，民主政府所使用的信息系统就必须支持人权、尊严、自决、多元主义、分权、透明、公正和正义。
en: For example, if democracy is to remain a viable political model, the information systems that democratic governments use must be designed to support human rights, dignity, self-determination, pluralism, division of responsibility, transparency, fairness, and justice.

zh: 要实现这一民主的数字未来，世界需要改变看待科技的思路。
en: To achieve this democratic digital future, the world needs to change how it thinks about technology.

zh: 我们需要构建开放的参与式信息生态，为全球经济中的每一个人赋权，让他们贡献自己的思想、才华和资源。
en: We need to build open, participatory information ecosystems that empower anyone in the global economy to contribute ideas, talent, and resources.

zh: 在网络化的世界中，我们做的每一件事都会影响他人，我们必须学会超越自我意识，追求合作、共创、共同进化和集体智慧。
en: In a networked world, where everything we do affects others, we must learn to think beyond ourselves, and pursue cooperation, co-creation, co-evolution, and collective intelligence.

zh: 如果我们按照这条路径前进，第四次工业革命可能会比第一次工业革命更加包容；这也是我的同事和我致力于发展的未来。
en: If we progress accordingly, the Fourth Industrial Revolution can be more inclusive than the first; that is the future that my colleagues and I are working toward.

zh: 比如，在荷兰代尔夫特理工大学（Delft University of Technology ） ， 我们正在开发兼顾社会责任的通讯网络和城市治理系统，而FuturICT计划（一个由研究人员组成的国际网络）正在应用多学科方法进行技术开发。
en: For example, at Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands, we are engineering socially responsible communication networks and urban governance systems, while the FuturICT initiative, an international network of researchers, is applying a multidisciplinary approach to technology development.

zh: 这两项研究的目标都是促进更加平等的数字未来。
en: The goal of both research efforts is to facilitate a more equitable digital future.

zh: 我们有能力设计为我们服务而不是奴役我们的科技。
en: We have the ability to engineer technology that serves us, rather than enslaves us.

zh: 但构建这样一个未来需要新的数字时代精神，社会、文化、环境和伦理价值观要成为设计过程的一部分。
en: But building that future demands a new digital zeitgeist, whereby social, cultural, environmental, and ethical values become part of the design process.

zh: 创新和革命常常具有动荡性和破坏性，但在数字时代，它们也可以是负责任的。
en: Innovations and revolutions are often upsetting and tumultuous, but in the digital age, they can also be responsible.

zh: 建立印美合作伙伴关系
en: Building the India-US Partnership

zh: 华盛顿 — —
en: WASHINGTON, DC – President Barack Obama’s first presidential visit to India offers a unique opportunity to cement a global partnership with a rapidly emerging power. Set to become the world’s third or fourth largest economy by 2030, India could become America’s most important strategic partner.

zh: 奥巴马总统对印度的首次访问为美国巩固与这飞速发展的新兴力量的全球合作伙伴关系提供了良机。
en: In coming decades, a strong bilateral partnership will prove vital in managing the rise of China and promoting an Asian balance of power that is favorable to India, the United States, and Asia as a whole.

zh: 将在2030年成为世界第三或第四大经济体的印度可以成为美国最重要的战略伙伴。
en: India’s success as a democracy also strengthens freedom globally and protects broader American interests.

zh: 在未来十年中，坚固的美印关系将在钳制崛起的中国和促进有利于印度、美国及整个亚洲的地区力量均衡中起到关键作用。
en: Obama has understandably focused on competing priorities, including the troubled US economy and ongoing wars abroad. India’s government has been similarly occupied with domestic political struggles and the challenge of sustaining economic growth amid rising pressure for redistribution.

zh: 民主的印度之崛起还有利于促进世界自由、保护更广泛的美国利益。
en: Moreover, Indian officials must still nurture the small, albeit growing, constituency that supports a rapidly transformed relationship with the US.

zh: 奥巴马将注意力放在了解决优先问题上 — — 比如经济困境和海外战争 — — 这也无可厚非。 印度政府情况也差不多，忙于解决国内政治困境和在再分配压力日渐增加的情况下如何维持经济增长的问题。
en: This trip provides a great opportunity for both sides to reinvigorate a critical relationship.

zh: 奥巴马的印度之行对双方来说都是一次重塑关键关系的良机。 一方面，奥巴马政府需要采取一系列举措表明自己对印度崛起及其民主成就和安全斗争的支持态度。
en: For its part, the Obama administration should take a number of steps to reaffirm its support for India’s rise, its democratic achievements, and its struggle for security.

zh: 特别是，美国应该重申自己支持印度在国际组织中扮演更重要的角色、帮助印度融入全球核不扩散机制。
en: Notably, the US should reaffirm its support for a larger Indian role in international organizations and help integrate India into the global non-proliferation regime.

zh: 有基于此，奥巴马政府应该支持印度获得联合国安理会常任理事国席位。
en: In this context, the Obama administration should endorse India’s quest for a permanent seat on the United Nations Security Council.

zh: 奥巴马还应该支持印度加入关键的核不扩散组织，如核供应国集团（Nuclear Suppliers Group）和导弹及其技术控制制度（Missile Technology Control Regime ） 。
en: Obama should also support India’s membership in key non-proliferation organizations like the Nuclear Suppliers Group and the Missile Technology Control Regime.

zh: 另一方面，印度也应该拿出自己的诚意。
en: India, too, must do its part.

zh: 印度可以向美国公司开放更多的投资机会 — — 包括核工业在内，也可以扩大与美国的防务合作，不仅仅只是从美国进口军事装备，而是与美国展开更深层次的外交合作，协助美国解决在阿富汗、巴基斯坦和伊朗遇到的棘手问题。
en: It can begin by creating greater opportunities for US firms – including from the nuclear industry – to invest in India’s economic success. It can expand defense cooperation beyond purchases of American-made military equipment by deepening its diplomatic engagement with the US to help find solutions to the difficult problems stemming from Afghanistan, Pakistan, and Iran.

zh: 简言之，印度政府应该寻找困难时期维持美国在印利益之道。
en: In short, India’s government should look for ways to sustain America’s interest in India during difficult times.

zh: 双方都应该在已达成协议的领域巩固合作关系，包括农业、教育、医疗、能源和科学技术等领域。
en: Both countries should consolidate their cooperation in other areas already agreed upon: agriculture, education, health care, energy, and science and technology.

zh: 双方应该抓住奥巴马访问印度的良机，总结已有成果、扩展到期合作、并开拓新的能使全球受益的合作项目。
en: Obama’s trip offers an opportunity for taking stock, expanding initiatives that have matured, and announcing new projects that will provide global benefits.

zh: 后者包括建立国际粮食安全机构、合作促进印度弱邦的职业培训、加大清洁能源研究力度、投资全球疾病监测系统、以及合作勘探页岩气。
en: The latter include developing an international food security initiative, cooperating to increase vocational training in fragile states, expanding clean-energy research, investing in global disease-detection systems, and collaborating to explore shale-gas extraction.

zh: 此外，美国和印度还应该建立创新合作，这不仅可以为两国带来直接收益，还可以建立通过坚固双边关系改善国际体系的榜样。
en: In addition, the US and India should create innovation partnerships, which would not only yield direct returns to both countries, but would also demonstrate how a strong bilateral relationship can improve the international system.

zh: 在其他多边问题上，美国和印度也应该扩大合作。
en: The US and India should expand cooperation on other multilateral issues as well.

zh: 全球经济危机和对最近的对美国保护主义的担忧使得印度开始反思其对多哈回合的态度。
en: The global economic crisis and new fears of US protectionism have motivated India to rethink its attitude toward the Doha Development Round.

zh: 如果奥巴马能够力排国内抵制新一轮国际贸易谈判之众议，改善美国在发展中国家部门关税减让上的当前处境，美国和印度将有机会使多哈回合绝处逢生，走向成功。
en: If Obama can weather domestic resistance to new international trade negotiations and modify America’s current position on sectoral tariff reduction by developing countries, the US and India will have an opportunity to break the impasse that has stymied the Doha Round’s successful conclusion.

zh: 说到底，坚固的美印合作伙伴关系符合双方战略利益。
en: Ultimately, a strong US-Indian partnership is in both countries’ strategic interest.

zh: 两国在个人、经济和社会关系上早已有了千丝万缕的联系，未来的社会关系还会进一步加深。
en: Their societies are already intertwined – and will be even more so in the future – by various personal, economic, and social links.

zh: 此外，奥巴马不应该将美印双边关系的眼光局限在纯粹的交易层面，而应该寻求加强印度作为美国长期生产伙伴的能力。
en: Moreover, Obama should resist the urge to approach the bilateral relationship purely in transactional terms, but instead should seek to strengthen India’s long-term capacity to be a productive partner with the US.

zh: 简言之，奥巴马所要问的问题不是��印度能为我们做什么？ ”而是“强大、民主和独立的印度符合美国国家利益吗？
en: In short, Obama ought not to ask, “What will India do for us?”, but rather, “Is a strong, democratic and independent India in America’s national interest?”

zh: ”如果答案是肯定的 — — 应该正是如此 — — 那么美国就应该致力于如何帮助印度增长实力。
en: If the answer to this question is yes – as it should be – then the US should focus on how it can help India’s power continue to grow.

zh: 通过重申美国力助印度崛起的承诺，强调美国与印度的伙伴关系，奥巴马能够促使两国在共同利益的基础上携手共进，使两国关系向前迈进一大步。
en: By reaffirming the US commitment to aid India’s rise, and by emphasizing America’s fellowship with India, Obama can help bring the two countries together on the basis of shared interests, and move their relationship forward significantly.

zh: 奥巴马应该马上行动起来。
en: That effort must start now.

zh: 建立我们所需要的市场体系
en: Building the Markets We Need

zh: 维也纳 — — 当前，在全球金融危机的背景下，我们面临的最大的挑战在于，我们无法控制它的复杂性和多样性。
en: VIENNA – The greatest challenge of the current global financial crisis is the seeming impossibility of comprehending and managing its diversity.

zh: 实际上局面几乎已经失控。
en: Indeed, the way problems are proliferating appears almost uncontrollable.

zh: 各个国家对此而采取的应对政策不断作出调整。
en: Plans to meet the crisis, in country after country, have been revamped and restructured time and again.

zh: 过去的一些惯用做法已经过时。
en: The old models about how to understand the economy have had their day.

zh: 对于这场波及全球范围的危机，各国政府都在临着新的挑战，社会和经济的发展究竟何去何从。
en: Across the globe, governments are facing fundamental decisions about the future nature of their economies and societies.

zh: 一切都起源于2007年夏天爆发的次贷危机，先是衍变为金融危机，而后导致经济萧条。 老的问题还没有解决，新的问题接踵而至。
en: The sub-prime crisis in the early summer of 2007 developed first into a financial crisis and ultimately into a recession.

zh: 食品能源的价格先涨后跌，仿佛是在坐过山车。 全球气候变暖的问题日益突现。
en: New economic problems soon rushed in to add to the existing ones: energy and food prices rose and then fell like a yo-yo; the dangers of climate change became ever more clear; and the mal-distribution of global political power demanded action.

zh: 目前，在希腊，拉托维亚，立陶宛等国出现了社会动荡，看来连欧盟的内部都出了问题。
en: The recent social unrest in Greece, Latvia, and Lithuania has shown that political stability is now vulnerable even in the European Union.

zh: 放眼全球，从墨西哥到印度尼西亚，乃至在中国，社会的张力随时可能断裂。
en: Indeed, around the world, from Mexico to Indonesia and even China, the social fabric is being stretched to the point of fraying.

zh: 最倒霉的是那些失去财富的大批无辜者，他们不是这场危机的始作俑者，而却只能默默地承受。 普遍焦虑的情绪不断攀升。
en: This anxiety is reinforced by the general lack of funds among large groups of people who had nothing to do with creating today’s crisis but are bearing the pain of it.

zh: 目前，社会的矛盾还没有最终爆发。 原因在于：伴随着利益团体的游说，政府为了挽救危难中的行业，不断推出对金融机构的拯救方案及经济刺激计划。
en: These social anxieties are not being addressed because financial-sector bailouts, stimulus packages, and help for distressed industries with strong lobbies are testing many governments’ financial limits.

zh: 这同时也在考验着政府的财政极限。 那些整天叫嚷私有制万岁的人士现在又要向政府求救，真是有点可笑，难道问题真的有他们所说的那么严重么？
en: That the advocates of unconditional privatization are now crying out for state support would be cause for cynical laughter if the danger were not as big as it is.

zh: 目前政府面临的最大问题是：是否有方法避免冰岛那样的国家破产？
en: For the brutal question governments must now face is this: is there an alternative to the Icelandic crash course?

zh: 以往，一旦国家的经济出现崩盘，内部的革命和对外的战争不可避免。
en: In the past, when state economic decision-making reached such an impasse, wars and/or revolutions were the inevitable result.

zh: 如今，我们正面临着1930年代以来最具有历史决定性的时刻，我们能够避免历史悲剧重演么？
en: As we face the type of turning-point decisions not seen since the darkest days of the 1930’s, can we avoid such an outcome?

zh: 如果要想避免那样最坏结果，各国的政治家们都要担当起各自的责任，根本性的改变就变得刻不容缓。
en: If we are to avoid the worst, fundamental change is not only necessary, but unavoidable. So politicians everywhere must do their duty and exercise responsible leadership.

zh: 社会政治稳定需要那些具有钢铁般的意志加上大胆的革新实验的政治领袖。
en: A combination of steely calm and bold experimentation is the only way that political and social harmony will be preserved.

zh: 对欧元区国家来说，欧洲中央银行或许是他们最后的避难所。 危难中的欧盟国家得以暂时的喘息。
en: To make the European Central Bank a lender of last resort for all of the euro-zone countries, for example, would give distressed European governments some added breathing space.

zh: 为了解决贸易顺差和逆差之间，借贷与负债之间，贫穷与富裕之间的不平衡。 全球范围内货币政策上的根本性变革在所难免，
en: But it will require global monetary reform of a fundamental order to right the imbalances between surplus and deficit countries, between happy savers and those who lived beyond their means, and between rich and poor.

zh: 解决危机的过程会是痛苦的。
en: Achieving this will not come without suffering.

zh: 对于那些制造有毒资产的金融机构和贪婪无度的投机者来说，反而有可能因此而得益。
en: Some of those who brought the world to this perilous point with their toxic financial instruments and unscrupulous speculation may even turn out to profit from these reforms.

zh: 所以，从道德，甚至可以从法律的角度来说，对他们的清算应该放在经济好转以后。
en: So be it: a moral, and perhaps legal, reckoning must await the return of economic growth.

zh: 当政府进入了他们不可知领域的时候，他们必须时刻提醒自己。
en: As governments move into uncharted territory, they will need to question themselves constantly.

zh: 所有的假设要慎之有慎，反复权衡，新的办法要不断修改，以求完美。
en: All assumptions will need to be assessed and reassessed, starting points found and re-found, and new tools developed and perfected.

zh: 社会大众的福址是首选，对金融机构的利益要推后考虑。
en: The mechanics of the welfare state will need to be strengthened; public policy must stop deferring to the financial sector, regardless of the need for bailout packages.

zh: 当政府进行必要的改革和大胆的实验时，国民的利益要牢记心中。
en: As governments embark on their necessary and bold experiments, they must remember to take their citizens with them.

zh: 一旦振兴经济的计划暗箱操作，政局的动荡将不可避免。
en: For, unless these experiments in economic rejuvenation are transparent, they will lead to domestic political fights.

zh: 务实和投机的政策有着本质的不同，政府必须时刻牢记。
en: There is a wide difference between pragmatic and opportunistic politics, and governments had better keep this distinction in mind in the months and years ahead.

zh: 政策透明性和务实性也适用于外交领域。
en: That domestic transparency and pragmatism will need to be carried over into international economic diplomacy.

zh: 除非我们解决全球贸易不平衡问题，不然灾难会接踵而来。
en: For, unless today’s global imbalances are redressed, the next crash will be upon us before we have recovered from this one.

zh: 当今全球��的市场需要制定规则，同时兼顾到世界各国的不同的宗教和国家利益，这点已经很清楚。
en: Today’s globalized markets need rules that take into account the public good in every country and region of the world. That much is clear.

zh: 目前我们要做的事情是全球货币和经济上的根本性变革，如果解决不好，革命和战争就在所难免。
en: But the decision we are actually faced with is much more fundamental: global monetary and economic reform, or war and revolution.

zh: 在福山推出的“历史的终结者论”的20年之后，我们又站在了历史的转折点上。
en: Twenty years after the world supposedly reached “the end of history,” we are instead at another historical turning point.

zh: 要么创造历史；要么进入一个黑暗时代，或许我们可以避免。
en: Either we will write this history ourselves, or we will suffer through a dark era that could have been avoided.

zh: 鲁哈尼的失去的机会
en: Rouhani’s Lost Chance

zh: 伊斯坦布尔—伊朗总统鲁哈尼的魅力攻势陷入了瓶颈期。
en: ISTANBUL – Iranian President Hassan Rouhani’s charm offensive has stalled.

zh: 去年九月，鲁哈尼的魅力攻势在联合国大会上大放异彩，当时他可以提供实实在在的东西 — — 关于伊朗核计划的协议 — — 让人们认为伊朗的强硬外交政策立场终于要软化了。
en: It worked well in the United Nations General Assembly last September, when he had something solid to offer – a deal on his country’s nuclear program – raising hopes that Iran’s hardline foreign-policy stance would finally soften.

zh: 但联合国秘书长潘基文没有邀请伊朗参加关于叙利亚问题的日内瓦II会议，这表明鲁哈尼需要更多的魅力 — — 甚至需要土耳其总理埃尔多安访问德黑兰 — — 来结束伊朗的孤立。
en: But UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon’s withdrawal of Iran’s invitation to the Geneva II conference on Syria suggests that Rouhani will need more than charm – or even a visit by Turkish Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan to Tehran – to end his country’s isolation.

zh: 鲁哈尼在摆脱其前任内贾德死硬立场的影响方面是成功的。
en: Rouhani has been largely successful in putting his predecessor Mahmoud Ahmadinejad’s tone-deaf leadership firmly in the past.

zh: 伊朗体制支持他对地区邻国开放国家、吸引外国投资、呼吁宗教和文化调和甚至追求与西方达成核协议的尝试。
en: The Iranian establishment has supported his attempts to open the country up to its regional neighbors, court foreign investment, call for moderation in religious and cultural matters, and even pursue the nuclear deal with the West.

zh: 事实上，目前已接近完成的核协议可能是伊朗自1979年伊斯兰教革命以来最重要的外交成就，伊朗国内和国际社会都因此获益良多。
en: In fact, the nuclear agreement – which seems close to completion – is likely to be Iran’s most important diplomatic achievement since the Islamic Revolution in 1979, providing it with considerable relief both domestically and internationally.

zh: 最高领袖哈梅内伊也表示了个人支持这一事实让人们看到了更多的希望。
en: The fact that Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei personally backed the effort makes it all the more promising.

zh: 但是，伊朗政权与美国恢复邦交的可能仍然是中东地区的一大关注点，因为这意味着伊朗实力的增强，而与此同时，美国正在退出该地区。
en: Nonetheless, the regime’s possible rapprochement with the United States remains a source of concern in the Middle East, because it would empower Iran at a time when the US is gradually disengaging from the region.

zh: 现在的问题是鲁哈尼对西方的温和态度是否会伴随着伊朗中东政策的变化，所有人都盯着伊朗的叙利亚政策。
en: The question now is whether Rouhani’s moderation toward the West will be accompanied by a change in Iran’s Middle East policy, with all eyes on its policy toward Syria.

zh: 美国和叙利亚反对派的压力导致伊朗没有获得日内瓦II的入场券。
en: Ban rescinded Iran’s invitation to Geneva II under pressure from the US and the Syrian opposition.

zh: 毕竟，自2011年叙利亚内战爆发以来，伊朗为叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权提供了重要的金融和军事支持，同时还动员其黎巴嫩代理人、强大的真主党武装力量在叙利亚与起义军作战。
en: After all, since the civil war began in 2011, Iran has provided essential financial and military support for Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s regime, while mobilizing its Lebanese proxy, the powerful Hezbollah militia, to fight against the rebels in Syria.

zh: 不管反对派如何担心伊朗的忠诚度，伊朗都毫无疑问是叙利亚平衡的一端；事实上，没有它的加入，就不可能达成任何协议。
en: Whatever concerns the opposition has about Iran’s allegiances, the country is undoubtedly part of the Syrian equation; indeed, its involvement is critical to reaching any accord.

zh: 但鲁哈尼没有就叙利亚问题发表决定性声明，即使在一系列漏出照片证明了叙利亚存在系统性虐待和屠杀并且引起了国际社会的公愤的情况下伊朗仍不表态，这对伊朗的处境非常不利。
en: But Rouhani’s failure to make a decisive statement on Syria – even after a series of leaked photographs of systematic torture and massacre raised the ire of the international community – has not helped the case for keeping Iran in the fold.

zh: 最近，鲁哈尼得到了讨论伊朗立场的机会。
en: Rouhani recently had an opportunity to discuss Iran’s stance.

zh: 但是，在达沃斯世界论坛演讲时，他没有把握这一机会，而是说了些中东地区各国政府应该倾听人民的声音、为年轻提供“工作和希望”之类的陈词滥调。
en: But, addressing the World Economic Forum in Davos, he squandered it, sticking to platitudes about the need for governments in the region to listen to their citizens and provide young people with “jobs and hope.”

zh: 在暴政问题上，鲁哈尼只是轻描淡写地观察道暴君们没有能力联系和理解他们的人民。
en: On the subject of despotic rulers, Rouhani offered only the benign observation that they lack the ability to connect with and understand their people.

zh: 鲁哈尼的最新发言虽然意义积极，但远远没有满足其去年9月的联合国演讲所带来的国际期望。
en: Rouhani’s recent rhetoric, however positive, falls far short of the expectations that his diplomacy has raised since his UN address last September.

zh: 在达沃斯，世界期望它能够就叙利亚问题和其他地区问题做出决定性表态，而不是消除对伊朗的“偏见”这样的民主主义老掉牙话题。
en: In Davos, the world expected a decisive statement on Syria and other regional problems – not hackneyed nationalist rhetoric about eliminating “biases” against Iran.

zh: 鲁哈尼必须知道，他没有处理好叙利亚的人道主义灾难会伤及其外交政策这表明他一定有充分的理由。
en: Rouhani must have known that his failure to address the humanitarian disaster in Syria would damage his diplomatic strategy, which suggests that he must have had a strong reason.

zh: 两种可能性最大：要么伊朗精英内部完全没有政策变化的共识，要么伊朗精英仍下定决心要继续支持巴沙尔。
en: Two possibilities stand out: either there is no consensus within the Iranian elite for a policy change, or the elite remain united in their determination to continue backing Assad.

zh: 两种可能性都毫无魅力可言，这也解释了为何他在伊朗立场问题上语焉不详。
en: Neither alternative is particularly charming, which would explain why he preferred to obscure his country’s position.

zh: 平心而论，埃尔多安本周的德黑兰之旅能够帮助消弭叙利亚的紧张局势 — — 在这个问题上，土耳其和伊朗的立场是完全相反的。
en: To be sure, Erdoğan’s visit to Tehran this week could help to defuse tensions over Syria – a subject on which Turkey and Iran have diametrically opposing views.

zh: 但这不可能缓和伊朗精英之间的分歧，更不能说服强硬派支持巴沙尔，其访问德黑兰的重要性也颇可商榷。
en: But it is unlikely to smooth the divisions among Iran’s elite, much less convince hardliners to stop backing Assad, leaving the visit’s significance uncertain, at best.

zh: 鲁哈尼（和其他许多世界领导人一样）拒绝在叙利亚问题上采取强硬立场，把自身利益凌驾于230万在册叙利亚难民、数百万在国内颠沛流离的叙利亚人、约130,000死难者以及其他饱受长期痛苦的叙利亚人民之上。
en: In refusing to take a strong position on Syria, Rouhani – like so many other world leaders – is placing his own interests above those of the 2.3 million registered Syrian refugees, the millions more who have been internally displaced, the estimated 130,000 people killed, and the rest of Syria’s long-suffering population.

zh: 更糟糕的是，他拒绝承认伊朗在这场悲剧中所扮演的角色。
en: Worse, he has refused to acknowledge Iran’s own role in the tragedy.

zh: 当他在达沃斯说“我们不能漠视我们的同胞在该地区经受痛苦和苦难煎熬”时，他或许已经在暗示巴沙尔政权及其合作伙伴的罪恶。
en: When he said in Davos, “we cannot be indifferent to the pain and suffering of our fellow brethren in the region,” he might as well have been referring to the Assad regime and its partners in crime.

zh: 叙利亚需要的不是言语和魅力；叙利亚需要行动。
en: What Syria needs is not rhetoric or charisma; it needs action.

zh: 伊朗似乎无力采取行动。
en: Iran appears incapable of providing it.

zh: 正因如此，鲁哈尼的魅力攻势将不足以让伊朗的对手相信这个伊斯兰共和国已准备从冷漠中走出。
en: That is why Rouhani’s charm offensive will not be enough to persuade Iran’s adversaries that the Islamic Republic is ready to come in from the cold.

zh: 海湾国家变宽的海湾
en: The Gulf States’ Widening Gulf

zh: 伊斯坦布尔—奥巴马总统在沙特阿拉伯处于关键时刻时来到了这里。
en: ISTANBUL – President Barack Obama is arriving in Saudi Arabia at a critical moment for the country.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯最近决定召回驻卡塔尔大使，凸显出海湾合作委员会（GCC）危机的严重性。 GCC成员都是沙特王国的近邻。
en: Its recent decision to withdraw its ambassador from Qatar has revealed the gravity of the crisis in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), composed of the Kingdom’s most immediate neighbors.

zh: 事实上，随着沙特-阿联酋的重新建交以及最近孤立卡塔尔的举动，海湾政治正在向新的平衡转变。
en: Indeed, Gulf politics is shifting toward a new balance in the wake of the Saudi-UAE rapprochement and the recent attempt to isolate Qatar.

zh: 阿联酋和巴林加入沙特阿拉伯的行列，降低了与卡塔尔的关系级别。
en: The UAE and Bahrain have joined Saudi Arabia in downgrading relations with Qatar.

zh: 此动作不同寻常，因为海湾国家向来把政治分歧作为家事，怎样处理不会昭告天下。
en: This is an unusual move, considering the Gulf states’ tradition of treating political disagreements as a family matter, to be handled behind the scenes.

zh: 阿曼一直与此局面保持距离，而科威特试图在沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔之间调停。
en: Oman is keeping its distance from the situation, while Kuwait has attempted to mediate between Saudi Arabia and Qatar.

zh: 几大因素促使沙特阿拉伯走向卡塔尔的对立面，并且禁止沙特知识分子在卡塔尔报纸上发表文章。
en: Several factors are driving Saudi Arabia’s moves against Qatar, which include a ban prohibiting Saudi intellectuals from contributing to Qatari newspapers.

zh: 这些因素有：卡塔尔支持（埃及和其他地区的）穆斯林兄弟会；伊斯兰教神学家卡达维（Yusuf al-Qardawi）的演讲和卡塔尔出资的半岛电视台在阿拉伯之春后的节目政策；以及证据表明卡塔尔接纳了某些试图在沙特王国组织政变的西方机构的观点并非子虚乌有。
en: There is Qatar’s support for the Muslim Brotherhood (in Egypt and elsewhere); the speeches by the Islamic theologian Yusuf al-Qardawi and the broadcasting policy of Qatar-funded Al Jazeera since the Arab Spring; and the credence given to the view that Qatar is hosting Western institutions with the intent of orchestrating a coup in the Kingdom.

zh: 这一观点反映出沙特阿拉伯对穆斯林兄弟会（沙特称其为恐怖组织）的强硬立场。
en: That view reflects Saudi Arabia’s tough stance against the Muslim Brotherhood, which it has declared a terrorist organization.

zh: 沙特王国认为穆兄会在阿拉伯国家、特别是海湾国家的影响力构成了其内部稳定和生存的严重威胁。
en: The Kingdom perceives the Brotherhood’s influence in Arab countries, particularly the Gulf states, as a serious threat to its internal stability and survival.

zh: 卡塔尔酋长阿勒萨尼（Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani）在2013年6月自愿退位，他的埃米尔之位由其子塔米姆（Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani）继承，但这并未满足沙特对卡塔尔改变外交政策的期望。
en: The voluntary abdication by Qatar’s Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani in June 2013, and his replacement as Emir by his son Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani, failed to satisfy Saudi expectations of change in Qatari foreign policy.

zh: 如今，沙特王国清楚地表明，它的耐心已经到了极限。
en: And now the Kingdom has made it clear that it has reached the limits of its patience.

zh: 但沙特阿拉伯对卡塔尔的态度可能给其自身政策带来一些困难。
en: But Saudi Arabia’s attitude toward Qatar may generate some difficulties for its own policy.

zh: 海湾国家之间有大量跨国商品和服务流动和数十亿美元的跨境投资 — — GCC的进一步分裂将威胁到这些经济活动。
en: There is considerable transnational movement of goods and services, and billions of dollars of cross-border investment, across the Gulf – economic activity that would be endangered by the GCC’s further disintegration.

zh: 穆斯林兄弟会不是一个暴力组织，也没有参与海湾国家的非法行动。
en: The Muslim Brotherhood is not a violent organization, and it has not engaged in illegal activities in the Gulf countries.

zh: 其他GCC国家迫切地希望避免自身政治紧张局势升级，也不可能宣布其为恐怖组织。
en: Other GCC states, eager to avoid escalating political tensions in their own countries, are unlikely to declare it a terrorist organization.

zh: 甚至沙特阿拉伯与约旦的特殊关系也无法让后者做出如此宣布。
en: Even Saudi Arabia’s special relationship with Jordan will not push its government to adopt such a declaration.

zh: 随着时间的推移，针对穆斯林兄弟会的严厉政策将有可能只局限于埃及和沙特阿拉伯。
en: For the time being, harsh policies toward the Muslim Brotherhood are likely to be confined to Egypt and Saudi Arabia.

zh: 沙特王国的问题在于，简单地“纠正”卡塔尔的立场无法改变地区内的政治轨迹 — — 特别是叙利亚和埃及。
en: The problem for the Kingdom is that simply “correcting” the Qatari position cannot change the political trajectory within the region – particularly in Syria and Egypt.

zh: 此外，沙特阿拉伯将其自身偏好的政策强加于CCC，并且可能对卡塔尔采取制裁，这有可能危害到GCC在过去33年中取得的成就。 （自阿拉伯之春爆发以来，GCC便走上了政治衰落之路。
en: Moreover, Saudi Arabia’s imposition of its preferred policies on the GCC, together with the possibility of sanctions on Qatar, risks jeopardizing all that the GCC (which already has fallen into political decline in the wake of the Arab Spring) has achieved over the past 33 years.

zh: 尽管卡塔尔统治者担心沙特王国日益对其感到厌恶，但并未表现出任何屈从于沙特的改变要求的信号。
en: Although Qatar’s rulers are concerned about the Kingdom’s growing antipathy toward them, they have shown no indications of submitting to Saudi demands that they change course.

zh: 此外，考虑到最近伊朗和西方所达成的过渡性核协议对地区地缘政治的重大影响，沙特阿拉伯与其邻国的疏远就更加危险了。
en: Moreover, given the impact on regional geopolitics of the recent interim nuclear deal between Iran and the West, Saudi Arabia’s alienation of its neighbors is all the more hazardous.

zh: 更糟糕的是，显然GCC内部的分歧不再能够藏着掖着，其成员国也无法在不引起外交纠纷的情况下将分歧公开化。
en: Making matters worse, it is clear that disagreements within the GCC can no longer be resolved behind closed doors, and that member states are unable to air them publicly without risking a diplomatic rupture.

zh: 在整个地区，少数族裔的实力越来越强，人民也越来越多地要求改善治理。
en: Across the region, minorities are feeling more empowered and citizens are making ever-stronger demands for better government.

zh: 要求未来摒弃基于恐惧和愤怒的传统政策的呼声越来越响。
en: There is a burgeoning desire for a future that dispenses with traditional policies based on fear and anger.

zh: 在这样的背景下，沙特还死抱过去的政策不妨，选择了自助战略，将问题关在国界之外，尽管它仍自视为地区实力中介。
en: In this context, Saudi policy seems to be stuck in the past, and the Kingdom has chosen to adopt a strategy of self-help in order to isolate itself from problems outside its borders, though it continues to regard itself as the region’s power broker.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯与阿联酋之间突然间恢复邦交原因并��沙特政策具有吸引力，而是两国统治者都感到已无多少政治选择余地。
en: The sudden rapprochement between Saudi Arabia and the UAE resulted not from the attractiveness of Saudi policy, but from their rulers’ shared perception that there is a dearth of political options.

zh: 当然，更明智的办法是解决GCC政府面临的真正问题，包括怨声载道的少数族裔、无法为年轻人创造足够就业机会的经济等。
en: It would, of course, be wiser to address the real problems facing GCC governments, which range from embittered minorities to economies that are unable to create enough jobs for young people.

zh: 但解决这些问题需要包容性、适应性的方针，并且需要国内外双管齐下，而沙特阿拉伯显然还没有做好准备。
en: But resolving these issues would require an inclusive and accommodating approach, both domestically and regionally, and Saudi Arabia, in particular, is not prepared to take that route.

zh: 海湾僵局将进一步恶化已然十分脆弱的中东局势。
en: The Gulf impasse will exacerbate the already-fragile situation in the Middle East.

zh: 地区政治现实、国家间相互影响以及对美好未来的共同追求最终应该战胜为了镇压、纪律和秩序的政策。
en: Regional political realities, transnational interaction, and the common search for a better future should, eventually, prevail over policies geared for repression, discipline, and order.

zh: GCC应该习惯于面对地区安排的相互冲突的前景和地区行动方之间不同程度的合作，并且应该将这些差异视为优势之源。
en: The GCC should be accustomed to conflicting perspectives on regional design and differing degrees of cooperation across regional actors, and it should draw on these differences as a source of strength.

zh: 这场危机或许能够创造一次反思和改变GCC战略的机会，以更现实的地区互赖性、共同安全和共同决策观点为基础。
en: This crisis may create an opportunity to rethink and recalibrate GCC strategies, based on a more realistic view of regional interdependence, common security, and shared decision-making.

zh: 新的GCC治理观念可以带来地区内建设性参与的机制，同时保持与国际行动方的合作。
en: A new mentality in GCC governance could result in the creation of mechanisms of constructive engagement in the region, while maintaining cooperation with international actors.

zh: 显然，这一政策比沙特阿拉伯所追求的的独狼角色更有建设意义，后者只能在海湾地区内部和周边制造僵局。
en: Clearly, this policy would be more constructive than Saudi Arabia’s desire for a lone-wolf role that merely results in a deadlock within and around the Gulf.

zh: 保加利亚对欧洲的背叛
en: Bulgaria’s Betrayal of Europe

zh: 当保加利亚在去年一月加入欧盟时，我相信我的国家最终远离了它压制的过去。
en: When Bulgaria joined the European Union this past January, I believed that my country had finally left its repressive past behind.

zh: 但最近对在该国寻求避难的土库曼斯坦持不同政见者Annadurdy Hadjiev的逮捕和威胁驱逐出境的事件说明有些事情还是没有改观。
en: But the recent arrest and threatened deportation of Annadurdy Hadjiev, a dissident from Turkmenistan who sought refuge here, suggests that some things never change.

zh: 如果保加利亚将此人遣送回土库曼斯坦—在那里他将会面临某种折磨和死亡威胁—我们口口声声说自己是民主、尊重人权的欧洲的一部分的话也成为空谈。
en: If Bulgaria sends this man back to Turkmenistan – where he faces certain torture and the threat of a brutal death – our claim to be part of a democratic, rights-respecting Europe will ring hollow.

zh: 另外，欧盟在全世界的人权卫士形象也会因为它不能让成员国坚持自身的标准而黯然失色。
en: Moreover, the EU’s image as a defender of human rights around the world will be tarnished by its inability to hold member states to its own standards.

zh: 这一案件勾起了人们对克格勃的影响力无处不在的那个时代的回忆。 那时整个东欧和如土库曼斯坦这样的苏联土地上的持不同政见者都生活在恐惧之中。
en: The case evokes memories of the days when the KGB’s influence was pervasive, and dissidents across Eastern Europe and Soviet lands like Turkmenistan lived in fear.

zh: Hadjiev和他的家人在2001年逃到欧洲，以躲避世界上最严酷的政权之一：已故的，自诩为“Turkmenbashi（土库曼之父 ） ” 的Saparmurat Niyazov的专制主义独裁政权。
en: Hadjiev and his family fled to Europe in 2001, escaping one of the world’s most repressive regimes: the absolutist dictatorship of the late Saparmurat Niyazov, who fancied himself “Turkmenbashi,” the father of all Turkmen.

zh: 作为曾担任土库曼斯坦中央银行副行长以及一位后来直言不讳批评Turkmenbashi政府的人士，被流放的资深共和党人Hadjiev在到达保加利亚时得到了“人道入境(humanitarian parole ) ” 的待遇—一个低于难民地位的保护类别。
en: A former deputy chairman of the Central Bank of Turkmenistan and later an outspoken critic of Turkmenbashi’s government, Hadjiev, a senior member of the exiled Watan (Republican) Party, received “humanitarian parole” – a protected category of individuals that falls short of refugee status – when he reached Bulgaria.

zh: 但从那时起，他就在这个本应是“安全岛”的地方一直遭受着激烈而任意的攻击。
en: But he has since been subjected to violent and arbitrary reprisals in this supposed “safe haven.”

zh: 虽然Turkmenbashi在去年十二月死去，他的继任者Gurbanguly Berdymukhammedov继续关押持不同政见者，遏制言论自由，并嘲弄民主，正如他在二月份舞弊的选举中所表现的那样。
en: And, although Turkmenbashi died in December, his successor, Gurbanguly Berdymukhammedov, has continued to imprison dissidents, stifle freedom of expression, and scoff at democracy, as February’s rigged elections demonstrate.

zh: 保加利亚的迫害更加重了Hadjiev及其家人身上遭受的痛苦和不公正。
en: Bulgaria’s persecution adds to the anguish and injustice that has befallen Hadjiev and his family.

zh: 去年夏天，Hadjiev的兄弟和姊妹在参与了一部关于土库曼斯坦的纪录片拍摄之后被捕。 随后又以大鸣大放的持有武器罪名受到审判。
en: Last summer, Hadjiev’s brother and sister were arrested after they collaborated on a documentary about Turkmenistan, and were tried on trumped-up charges of weapons possession.

zh: 经过了一场敷衍的关门庭审之后，他们分别被判入狱七年和六年。
en: After a perfunctory closed trial, they were sentenced to seven and six years in prison, respectively.

zh: Hadjiev的姊妹，新闻记者Olgusapar Muradova几周后在可疑的情况下死于狱中。
en: Hadjiev’s sister, the journalist Olgusapar Muradova, died in prison several weeks later, under suspicious circumstances.

zh: 探视过她遗体的成年子女告诉亲戚他们看到了折磨的痕迹，并且她还遭受了头部的重伤。
en: Her grown children, who viewed her body, told relatives that they saw evidence of torture and that she had sustained a severe head wound.

zh: （国家控制的尸检显示她是自杀。
en: (A state-controlled autopsy implied that she had committed suicide.)

zh: ）Hadjiev的另外两个兄弟，以及他的内兄/内弟，和弟媳/兄嫂自2002年开始就被关押在土库曼斯坦臭名昭著的刑事集中营长期服刑。
en: Hadjiev’s two other brothers, as well as his brother-in-law and sister-in-law, have been in Turkmenistan’s notorious penal gulag since 2002, when they were sentenced to lengthy prison terms.

zh: 2003年，他年迈的岳父也被警方特工殴打，并被迫内部流放。
en: In 2003, his elderly father-in-law was beaten by police agents and forced into internal exile.

zh: 在二月十九日，保加利亚警方逮捕了Hadjiev，企图将其遣送回国面对同样的命运。
en: On February 19, the Bulgarian police arrested Hadjiev with the intention of sending him back to face a similar fate.

zh: 这不是他第一次在保加利亚被捕。
en: This is not the first time he has been arrested in Bulgaria.

zh: 在进入保加利亚之初，Hadjiev和他的妻子也被武断地关押了几天，留下他们13岁的女儿无人照看，也见不到父母。
en: After first arriving, Hadjiev and his wife were arbitrarily detained for several days, leaving their 13-year-old daughter without supervision or access to her parents.

zh: 应土库曼的一个引渡请求，警察在2002年再一次逮捕了Hadjiev。
en: The police arrested Hadjiev again in 2002, in response to a Turkmen extradition request.

zh: 在瓦纳城法院以指控出于政治目的拒绝引渡请求后，保加利亚当局就威胁将他驱逐出境。
en: After the Varna City Court refused to allow the extradition, ruling that the charges were politically motivated, the Bulgarian authorities threatened to deport him.

zh: 在2005年，Hadjiev一家的汽车被一种类似于炸弹的装置烧毁。 他们将此事件解释为让其停止对保加利亚—及可能对土库曼—当局的挑战的警告。
en: In 2005, the Hadjievs’ car was incinerated by a bomb-like device, which they interpreted as a warning to cease their defiant challenges to the Bulgarian – and possibly Turkmen – authorities.

zh: 上个月逮捕Hadjiev的部门连走形式的正当程序都没有执行：他们没有出示逮捕令，并一次次拒绝他见亲友和律师。
en: The authorities that arrested Hadjiev last month made no pretense of due process: they offered no arrest warrant, and have repeatedly refused him access to relatives and legal counsel.

zh: 另外，法庭也没有就为什么允许他再次以早在2003年就已澄清的挪用（公款）罪名受审做出解释。
en: Moreover, the court has given no explanation of why it is allowing him to be tried on the same embezzlement charge that of which he was acquitted in 2003.

zh: 所幸的是，Hadjiev是一名战士。
en: Fortunately, Hadjiev is a fighter.

zh: 从他在保加利亚的艰难困境一开始，他就以与负责迫害他的政府部门对抗的方式来与这个制度抗争。
en: Since the beginning of his travails in Bulgaria, he has battled the system by confronting the government branches responsible for his persecution.

zh: 的确，他已经对负责自己引渡案的起诉人提起诉讼—这一行动可能会影响他获得公平听证的权利。
en: Indeed, he has sued the very prosecutor in whose hands his current extradition now rests – an act that may be jeopardizing his right to a fair hearing.

zh: 我国的政府承诺自发地实践作为欧盟成员国核心要求的法律规范。
en: My government has pledged its willingness live up to the legal norms that are the core of European Union membership.

zh: 通过释放Hadjiev并收回将其引渡回土库曼斯坦的威胁，保加利亚可以明确地显示其对履行自身义务的承诺。
en: By releasing Annadurdy Hadjiev from jail and withdrawing the threat of extradition to Turkmenistan, Bulgaria would unequivocally demonstrate its commitment to fulfilling its obligations.

zh: 通过给予他政治避难，我们可以做出一个响亮的声明：独裁政权在欧洲的疆界内再也得不到支持。
en: By granting him political asylum, we can make a resounding statement that authoritarian regimes can no longer count on support within Europe’s borders.

zh: 欧盟的双重考验
en: Twin Tests for the EU

zh: 慕尼黑—6月份堪称决定欧盟命运之月。
en: MUNICH – June is shaping up to be a fateful month for the European Union.

zh: 6月21日，德国宪法法院将对针对欧洲央行债券购买计划的上诉进行裁决。 债券购买计划是欧洲央行应对欧洲债务危机的核心政策。
en: On June 21, the German Constitutional Court will rule on a challenge to a bond-buying program that is central to the European Central Bank’s response to the continent’s debt crisis.

zh: 两天后，英国选民将决定英国是否应该退出欧盟。
en: Two days later, voters in the United Kingdom will decide whether the UK should exit the EU.

zh: 这两项决定将对欧盟的长期政治与经济稳定带来严重后果。
en: Both decisions will have serious consequences for the EU’s long-term political and economic stability.

zh: 在这两项决定中，德国法院的裁决不太引人关注，但它直指欧洲央行对马斯特里赫特条约的解释的核心。
en: The judgment by the German court is the less spectacular of the two, but it addresses the heart of the ECB’s interpretation of the Maastricht Treaty.

zh: 原告包括德国下议院诸位议员，他们质疑德国联邦银行是否应该被允许参与欧洲央行的直接货币交易（OMT）计划，认为这违反了欧盟条约的第123条和第125条。 他们宣称，这两条禁止政府动用印钞机进行援助行为。
en: The plaintiffs, who include members of the Bundestag, have questioned whether the Bundesbank should be allowed to participate in the ECB’s outright monetary transactions (OMT) program, arguing that it violates Articles 123 and 125 of the EU Treaty, which they claim forbids government bailouts with the printing press.

zh: 特别是，他们反对欧洲央行购买危机受袭国政府债券的无限之承诺（用欧洲央行行长德拉吉的名言讲，就是“不惜一切代价 ” ） 。
en: In particular, they have objected to the ECB’s unlimited commitment (“whatever it takes,” in ECB President Mario Draghi’s famous phrase) to the purchase of crisis-hit countries’ government securities.

zh: 根据OMT计划，购买这些债券的投资者不需要再担心可能的违约。
en: Under the OMT program, investors who buy such securities no longer need to worry about a potential default.

zh: 在破产风险显现之前，可以要求欧洲央行购买投资者投资组合中的危险证券。
en: Before the risk of bankruptcy presents itself, the ECB will be available to buy the endangered securities off investors’ portfolios.

zh: 所需要的只是应用欧洲稳定性机制（European Stability Mechanism，能够为所有欧元区成员国提供快速金融援助的基金 ） 。
en: All that is required is an application to the European Stability Mechanism, a fund capable of providing rapid financial assistance to all members of the eurozone.

zh: 如此，破产风险从债券持有人转移到了经济较为健康的欧元区国家的纳税人身上，他们将永久失去政府债券的利息收入。
en: As a result, the risk of bankruptcy is transferred from the bondholders to taxpayers in economically healthy eurozone countries, who would permanently lose interest income on the government bonds.

zh: 摆在德国宪法法院的问题是这个已经获得欧洲法院认可的安排是否违反了的国际本法 — — 即，OMT是否破坏了德国联邦银行的预算主权。
en: The question before Germany’s Constitutional Court is whether that arrangement, which has already received the blessing of the European Court of Justice, is compatible with the country’s Basic Law – specifically, whether OMT undermines the Bundestag’s budgetary authority.

zh: 这不是欧洲法院可以裁定的问题。
en: This is not a question that the ECJ can decide.

zh: 有两个理由认为德国宪法法院可能对德国联邦银行参与OMT计划施加条件。
en: There are two reasons why the court is likely to impose conditions on the Bundesbank’s participation in the OMT program.

zh: 据说德国联邦银行已向德国宪法法院咨询欧洲央行航的量化宽松计划，而德国宪法法院据说要求有效排除各央行在根据该计划进行的政府债券购买操作中的连带责任。
en: The Bundesbank is said to have consulted the court already regarding the ECB’s program of quantitative easing, and the court is reported to have called for the effective exclusion of joint liability of central banks for government-bond purchases under that program.

zh: 此外，德国宪法法院初步意见认为欧洲央行的权责可能延伸过度了。
en: Furthermore, the court’s preliminary opinion expressed suspicion that the ECB might be overstretching its mandate.

zh: 如果德国宪法法院遵循这一思路，裁决德国联邦银行不得参与OMT计划，该裁决将导致健康经济体和危机受袭经济体利差的扩大，从而反映真正的投资者风险。
en: If the court follows this line of reasoning and rules against the Bundesbank’s participation in the OMT program, the decision would cause the interest-rate spread between healthy and crisis-hit economies to widen, reflecting the true risk to investors.

zh: 这将终结某些人的白日梦，但也意味着增加可问责性，让欧元区回归预算硬约束之路，而预算硬约束是经济体系生存的根基。
en: That would put an end to some pipe dreams, but it would also mean taking a step toward strengthening accountability and put the eurozone back on the path to hard budget constraints, without which no economic system can survive.

zh: 第二项决定，即英国的欧盟成员资格问题，可能引起更大的后果。
en: The second decision, regarding the UK’s membership in the EU, could be even more consequential.

zh: 此次公决是英国和欧洲其他国家漫长而波动的关系史的又一次起伏。
en: The vote is one more convulsion in a long history of tumultuous relations between the UK and the rest of Europe.

zh: 英国于1973年加入欧盟的前身欧洲经济共同体，此前它在1963年和1967年两次申请加入，但都被法国总统戴高乐否决。
en: The UK joined the European Economic Community, the predecessor to the EU, in 1973, on its third attempt, after French President Charles de Gaulle vetoed its applications in 1963 and 1967.

zh: 但英国与欧洲的关系从一开始就很不自然。
en: But the relationship was strained from the outset.

zh: 英国国内存在对加入欧盟条件的强大的抵制力量，导致了1975年的成员资格全民公决。
en: Powerful resistance in Britain to the conditions for joining led to a referendum on membership in 1975.

zh: 大部分英国选民选择了留在欧盟。
en: The majority of UK voters opted for staying in.

zh: 1979年撒切尔夫人上台执政后，通过为英国争取特殊条件的方式向怀疑派让步。
en: After Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher came to power in 1979, she appeased skeptics by negotiating special conditions for Britain.

zh: 但近几年来的欧元危机让欧洲怀疑派重新振兴。
en: But the euro crisis in recent years has revived skepticism about Europe.

zh: 英国只是边缘性地参与了欧盟的危机响应，但英国人日益担心英国及其纳税人总有一天将不得不援助南方的欧洲国家和欧盟银行。
en: The UK may have been only marginally involved in financing the EU’s response to the crisis, but fears are mounting in the UK that the country and its taxpayers will one day have to bail out southern European countries and EU banks.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲难民危机开始触动英国的神经。
en: At the same time, the European refugee crisis has begun to fray British nerves.

zh: 在撒切尔夫人以及她的前任希斯治下���英国叫停了宽松的英联邦移民政策。
en: Under Thatcher, and Prime Minister Edward Heath before her, the UK put a stop to easy immigration from the Commonwealth.

zh: 如今，英国人担心英国有可能面临来自新一波欧盟的移民。
en: Today, the fear is that the country is at risk of a new wave of immigration from the EU.

zh: 担心“英国退出”风险的犹豫不决的选民或能为阻止英国脱离欧盟提供必要的选票。
en: Undecided voters worried about the risks of “Brexit” are likely to provide the margin needed to keep the UK from leaving.

zh: 但全民公决仍暴露出欧盟严重的缺陷以及欧盟领导人无力拿出可信而有说服力的战略解决欧洲所面临的挑战。
en: But the referendum nonetheless has exposed the EU’s serious shortcomings and its leaders’ inability to present a credible and convincing strategy for addressing the challenges facing the continent.

zh: 不管6月的两项决定结果如何，有一点是清楚的：无条件信任欧盟及其机构的日子已经结束了。
en: Whatever the outcome of the two decisions in June, one thing is clear: The era of unconditional trust in the EU and its institutions has come to an end.

zh: 缅甸之痛
en: Burma’s Agony

zh: 当袭击了从伊洛瓦底江三角洲到首都仰光的人口稠密地区的热带风暴持续肆虐并且死亡人数不断增多之时，缅甸的军事独裁统治仍然不停的努力以巩固其权力。
en: As the death toll mounts from the cyclone that struck a densely populated area of Burma stretching from the Irrawaddy Delta to the capital city of Rangoon continues to soar, the country’s military dictatorship is pressing ahead with efforts to consolidate its power.

zh: 军政府领导人在灾难之后为推动恢复重建做的工作非常少。
en: The junta leaders have done little to facilitate recovery efforts in the wake of the disaster.

zh: 他们甚至还公布了通过在星期六的全民公投来批准一部新宪法以继续巩固其权力的意图，他们希望这部宪法能在未来的几十年里继续确认和保护他们的权力。
en: Indeed, they have announced their intentions to move forward with conducting a national referendum scheduled for Saturday to approve a new constitution, which they hope will entrench their power for decades to come.

zh: 缅甸的统治者们已经宣布在受灾严重的地方投票可以推迟到五月二十四日，但是在该国的其他地区全民公投仍然按原计划进行。
en: Burma’s rulers have said that the vote will be delayed in the areas hardest hit by the cyclone until May 24, but the referendum will still go ahead as planned in other parts of the country.

zh: 随着这一活动的进行，军事领导人把他们用来增强其压迫权力的虚假投票放在了缅甸人民的健康福祉之前的位置上了。
en: With this move, the military leaders are putting their sham vote aimed at tightening their repressive grip on power ahead of the well being of the Burmese people.

zh: 这其实没什么好奇怪的。
en: This should be no surprise.

zh: 在近五十年的时间里，缅甸的军事统治者已经系统地损害了他们自己的民众的利益。
en: For nearly five decades, Burma’s military rulers have systematically undermined the interests of their own citizens.

zh: 在最近的例子里，由军政府控制的新闻媒体没有对正在向缅甸逼近的热带风暴给予警告。
en: In this latest case, the junta-controlled news media failed to announce warnings about the approaching cyclone.

zh: 联合国人道主义人员进入缅甸的时间也被推迟了，因为缅甸政府拒绝他们在没有申请签证之前进入该国。
en: The entry of United Nations humanitarian personnel, has been delayed due to the government’s refusal to allow aid workers into the country without first applying for visas.

zh: 而且，军事领导人还通过不放松对人道主义救援物资的进口和联合国灾害评估小组进入该国的限制来拖他们的后腿。
en: Moreover, the military leaders are dragging their feet on easing restrictions on the import of humanitarian supplies and allowing a UN assessment team into the country.

zh: 有些人已经强烈要求将注意力放在对缅甸实施救援而不是批评它的政府上。
en: Some have urged focusing attention on bringing relief efforts to Burma instead of criticizing its government.

zh: 但是事实是这两个问题相互关联，并且灾难的程度因为军政府一心想要保存它的权力而变得更加严重。
en: But the reality is that the two issues are connected and the magnitude of the disaster has been made worse by the junta’s single-minded objective of preserving its power.

zh: 军事领导人已经显示在他们需要时，他们可以迅速地动员军队，这一点已经为去年他们暴力镇压成千上万的和尚和政治激进分子的行动所证实。
en: The military leaders have shown that they can mobilize their forces in short order when they want, as evidenced by their violent crack down on thousands of monks and political activists last year.

zh: 在这次残酷镇压后超过七个月的时间里，政治激进分子不断的被关押和拷打。
en: More than seven months on from this brutal suppression, political activists continue to be imprisoned and tortured.

zh: 人权团体的报告称，在本次投票之前，已经有异议人士因为反对军政府提出的宪法而遭到殴打和威胁。
en: Human rights groups report that opponents of the junta's proposed constitution have been beaten and intimidated in advance of the vote.

zh: 缅甸现行的支持军事领导的宪法缺乏可信性，因为昂山素季 — — 诺贝尔和平奖获得者，在过去18年里有12年是处于软禁或监狱中，和其他民主和少数民族领导人没有被允许参与到该法的起草过程中。
en: The current pro-military constitution lacks credibility because Aung San Suu Kyi, the Nobel Peace Prize laureate who has spent 12 of the past 18 years under house arrest or in prison, and other democratic and ethnic minority leaders have not been allowed to participate in the drafting process.

zh: 而且，因为素季和一个外国人结婚了，新宪法将有效的禁止她竞选总统。
en: Additionally, the new constitution would effectively bar Suu Kyi, from running for president because she was married to a foreigner.

zh: 作为既可以和缅甸的将军们又可以和素季直接对话的唯一的国际参与者，联合国有机会推进真正的国家和解进程。
en: As the only international actor in direct dialogue with both Burma's generals and Suu Kyi, the UN is in a position to press for a genuine process of national reconciliation.

zh: 但是它现在的方法并不起作用。
en: But it’s current approach is not working.

zh: 到目前为止，联合国秘书长潘基文已经通过他的“调停”来关注危机，并任命易卜拉欣·甘巴里作为其对缅甸统治者的代表。
en: To date, UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon has been addressing the crisis through the use of his "good offices," with Ibrahim Gambari serving as his representative to Burma’s rulers.

zh: 在2008年3月份给联合国安理会的简报中，甘巴里报告说他对缅甸最近一次的访问“令人沮丧”并且承认没有取得任何实质性的进展。
en: In his March 2008 briefing to the UN Security Council, Gambari reported that his most recent visit to the country was "frustrating" and acknowledged that no tangible progress was made.

zh: 他没有被允许参加与政府高级官员，少数民族代表以及政治反对派的会谈。
en: He was denied meetings with senior government leaders, representatives of ethnic minorities and political opposition groups.

zh: 这样的结果就是局势重大的退步。
en: The outcome was a major step backward.

zh: 这种没有进展的情况与其说反映了甘巴里的能力，还不如说他还没有取得对缅甸统治者有重大影响的国家的授权，这些国家包括中国，印度和缅甸的东盟邻国。
en: This lack of progress is less a reflection of Gambari's capabilities  than of the fact that he has not been empowered by the countries that  hold the most leverage over Burma’s rulers, including China, India, and  Burma's ASEAN neighbors.

zh: 当影响力足够大的时候 ， “ 调停”的方法是有效的，简单的说，甘巴里还没有取得他需要的影响力。
en: The "good offices" approach is effective when  the weight of the world is behind it and, put simply, Gambari has not  been given the clout he needs.

zh: 由于对军政府有重大影响的国家在缅甸也有重要的商业利益，我们不能期望它们中的任何一个站出来并且带头独立采取行动。
en: Since the countries that carry the  most sway with the junta also have strong commercial interests in Burma,  we should not expect any of them to step up and take the lead on their own.

zh: 作为联合国秘书长，潘基文已经实践了他自称的成为完美外交官的理论，并且在遏制联合国官僚机构膨胀和中东问题上都取得了很大的进展。
en: As Secretary-General, Ban has lived up to his self-styled vision of being the consummate diplomat, and has made some important gains in tackling the UN's bureaucratic bloat as well as dealing with the Middle East.

zh: 但是在其他问题上，潘基文没能实践其前任科菲安南在担任联合国秘书长时期创设的重要的先例，科菲安南把这一职位的任务变成推进人权以及在必要时起到“世界良心”的作用。
en: But on other issues, Ban has failed to live up to the critically important precedent set by his predecessor as Secretary-General, Kofi Annan, who transformed the position to promote human rights and assumed the role of the "world's conscience" when necessary.

zh: 缅甸形式的恶化要求潘基文停止其调停者的角色而开始承担领导者的角色。
en: Burma’s deterioration demands that Ban stop managing and begin to lead.

zh: 他应该开始要求缅甸承担其保护国民的义务并且谴责其利用暴力和压迫策略的行径。
en: He should begin by demanding that  Burma's government fulfill its responsibility  to protect the country’s citizens and condemn the use of violence and repressive tactics.

zh: 假设缅甸的将军们迄今为止一直保持强硬的姿态，这可能说明潘基文有必要到缅甸与其领导人进行面对面的会谈。
