en: Given the Burmese generals' hard line stance to date, it will likely prove to be necessary for Ban to go to Burma to meet face-to-face with its leaders.

zh: 本文给出这样一个观点：潘基文可以根据北朝鲜模式 — — 他从开始担任韩国外交部长起就努力建立的模式，向将军们施压，以使他们同意多党会谈。
en: One idea is to pressure the generals to agree to multiparty talks based on the North Korean model-an, approach that Ban helped to forge from his days as South Korea’s Foreign Minister.

zh: 虽然有国际社会的关注，但是缅甸的将军们依然在成千上万的热带风暴幸存者急切需要住所，清洁的饮用水和医疗护理的时候，加强他们的残暴统治。
en: While the world watches, Burma's generals are consolidating their tyrannical rule as hundreds of thousands of the cyclone’s survivors remain in desperate need of shelter, clean drinking water and medical care.

zh: 现在的情形需要联合国秘书长的直接介入。
en: The situation demands the Secretary-General’s direct involvement.

zh: 否则，军政府将继续不受约束的侵犯缅甸人民的人权。
en: Without it, the junta will continue to have a free hand to act against the human rights of the Burmese people.

zh: 缅甸的毒枭将军
en: Burma’s Drug Lord Generals

zh: 缅甸军政府封锁其决定暂时放弃担任明年东盟(ASEAN)主席国的消息，表明其声望受到了沉重的打击。
en: The news blackout imposed by Burma’s military junta on its decision to forego its turn as chair of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) next year shows that it has received a severe blow to its prestige.

zh: 的确，这一决定并非出于自愿。
en: Indeed, the decision was far from voluntary.

zh: 军政府首脑Than Shwe将军“颜面尽失”并立刻消失在公众视线当中，以至于有的缅甸人认为他已经死了。
en: Junta leader Senior General Than Shwe “lost face” and promptly disappeared from public view so completely that some Burmese thought he had died.

zh: 施压让执政当局放弃东盟轮值主席国之位的主角们却不是通常的西方人权活动分子，而是与缅甸最近的东盟邻国。
en: The protagonists that pressured the regime into relinquishing the ASEAN chair were not the usual Western human rights campaigners, but Burma’s closest ASEAN neighbors.

zh: 对于军政府的将军们来说，这一点使得他们的退却痛苦得犹如伤口上撒盐。 因为此前，东盟一直是缅甸抵御国际社会压力的最坚实的挡箭牌之一。
en: This must have made the retreat doubly painful for the generals, as ASEAN was previously one of the junta’s strongest shields against international pressure.

zh: 对东盟而言，这一事件是过度自信带来的教训。
en: For ASEAN, the episode was a lesson in assertiveness.

zh: 它表明持续不断的压力比其自缅甸加入东盟以来的八年里所追求的徒劳的“建设性接触”要有效。
en: It showed that persistent pressure works better than the “constructive engagement” that it had pursued, to no avail, for the eight years since Burma joined the organization.

zh: 这一转变的领导者是一个被称作“东盟国会议员缅甸民主小组 ” ( AIPMC)的，由该地区当选国会议员组成的，刚成立不久的组织。 我也是其成员之一。
en: This shift has been led by an embryonic grouping of elected regional parliamentarians known as the ASEAN Inter-Parliamentary Caucus on Democracy in Myanmar (AIPMC), of which I am a member.

zh: 该组织成立于去年10月，旨在加速缅甸的民主化进程。 来自泰国、印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡和柬埔寨的国会议员们，以前所未有的姿态跨越了国家和政党的界限，来评估东盟对缅政策，寻求昂山素季的释放并剥夺缅甸的轮值主席国资格。
en: Established last November to spur progress on democratization in Burma, parliamentarians from Thailand, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Cambodia took the unprecedented step of crossing national and party lines to review critically ASEAN policy on Burma, seek the release of Aung San Suu Kyi, and disqualify Burma from chairing.

zh: 除非缅甸当局释放昂山素季和其他政治犯并在民主化方面采取明晰的步骤。 其具体的措施就是举行有包括昂山领导的全国民主联盟和各民族团体代表参加的谈判。
en: Now, we will move for the suspension of Burma’s membership of ASEAN unless Aung San Suu Kyi and other political prisoners are released and clear progress towards democracy is made through negotiations involving the Aung’s National League for Democracy and representatives of the various ethnic groups.

zh: 作为东盟已经建立或成长中的民主国家的当选立法者，AIPMC的成员们认为我们的声音是公正而合法的。
en: As elected legislators in ASEAN’s established and budding democracies, the members of AIPMC feel that our voices have merit and legitimacy.

zh: 我们深知缅甸的政治命运和我们自己国家的密不可分。
en: We know that Burma’s political destiny is inextricably linked to that of our own countries.

zh: 当缅甸在1997年加入东盟时，在整个地区只有21万名缅甸难民和寻求政治避难者。
en: When Burma joined ASEAN in 1997, there were only 210,000 Burmese refugees and asylum seekers throughout the region.

zh: 而现在，有近100万人已从缅甸的政治和经济混乱中逃到了邻国，还有一百万人在缅甸国内处于颠沛流离的状态。
en: Now, nearly one million people have fled Burma’s political and economic chaos for neighboring countries, and another million people remain internally displaced.

zh: 我们的年轻人从大量流入的，以安非他明类兴奋剂(ATS)为主的麻醉品中染上毒瘾的风险正处于历史最高点。 而这些毒品的源头正是缅甸，那里的将军们和毒枭沆瀣一气。
en: Our youth are at an all-time high risk of drug addiction from the massive flow of narcotics, particularly amphetamine-type stimulants (ATS), from Burma, while the generals there maintain congenial ties with notorious drug lords.

zh: 9月中，联合国毒品与犯罪办公室承认缅甸和中国是世界上最大的ATS制造国。
en: In mid-September, the UN Office on Drugs and Crime admitted that Burma and China were the world’s top producers of ATS.

zh: 产自缅甸东部的安非他明类毒品的运输是如此便利，以至于它们在印度东北部及缅甸的西部边境上大量出现。
en: Amphetamine drugs produced in eastern Burma seem to be transported with such ease that significant quantities have been found in northeast India, on Burma’s western border.

zh: 这些毒品，再加上从缅甸运输到印度、中国、泰国和该地区其他国家的的海洛因，对我们的政治和经济安全造成严重威胁。
en: That, together with the heroin that is trafficked from Burma to India, China, Thailand, and other countries in the region, poses a serious threat to our political and economic security.

zh: 具有悲剧性，同时也不可避免的是印度和中国与缅甸接壤的地区成为上述国家毒瘾和HIV感染最集中的地区。 我自己的国家，泰国，每年从缅甸接收多达9亿片的安非他明，我国经常性毒品使用者中，有三分之一的年龄在16岁以下。
en: It is both tragic and inevitable that the areas of India and China bordering Burma now suffer from those countries’ highest concentration of drug addiction and HIV infection., My own country, Thailand, receives up to 900 million amphetamine pills from Burma every year, and about a third of our regular drug users are below the age of 16.

zh: 如果这只是对泰国的影响，那么缅甸那些被限制接受教育、信息和医疗服务的青少年和儿童的情况又会怎样呢？
en: If this is the impact on Thailand, what about the young people and children of Burma, who have been restricted from access to education, information, and health care?

zh: 令人震惊的是，毒枭们享受的自由远大于援助机构，而同时对食品、教育和医疗保健的基本保障却被制肘。 在缅甸的边境地区，多达70%的儿童长期营养不良。
en: It is scandalous that drug lords enjoy more freedom to operate than aid agencies, while basic access to food, education, and health care suffers many restrictions, with up to 70% of Burma’s children are chronically malnourished in some border areas.

zh: 的确，在8月，世界粮食计划署执行主管詹姆斯·莫里斯透露，由于当局的限制，该署只将专供缅甸北部Arakan省的5500吨救济粮中的430吨送到了该地。
en: Indeed, in August, World Food Program Executive Director James Morris revealed that the WFP had delivered only 430 tons of the 5,500 tons of rice earmarked for vulnerable people in Burma’s northern Arakan State because of restrictions imposed by the regime.

zh: 两周以后 ， “ 全球HIV/AIDS、肺结核和疟疾基金会”宣布从其缅甸项目中撤资，并指出政府的限制人为制造了“一种极度困难的环境 ” 。
en: Two weeks later, the Global Fund for HIV/AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria pulled its funding for programs in Burma, citing government restrictions that had created “an impossibly difficult environment.”

zh: 阻止援助被送到急需支援的人们手中已经是罪大恶极。
en: Preventing aid from reaching those in need is bad enough.

zh: 然而，缅甸当局还通过限制咨询、用药和其他支持服务使在该国肆虐的HIV/AIDS的情况极度恶化。
en: But Burma’s regime actually perpetuates conditions that sustain and worsen the HIV/AIDS epidemic by restricting access to counseling, medication, and other support services.

zh: 为了使HIV/AIDS项目有效并可持续，受影响的社团必须能够自由地自我组织并加以应对。
en: In order for HIV/AIDS programs to be effective and sustainable, affected communities must have the freedom to organize and empower themselves.

zh: 只有这样，才能够确保他们得到对于治疗异常重要的足够资源。
en: Only then can they be assured access to the resources essential for treatment options.

zh: 昂山素季“请用你们的自由来促进我们的自由”的打动人心的请求，在我们享受着民主代表制度的AIPMC成员中激起了特别的反响。
en: Aung San Suu Kyi’s eloquent plea, “Please use your liberty to promote ours,” has special resonance for us in AIPMC, who enjoy the benefits of representative democracy.

zh: 这就是为什么我们觉得有义务号召国际社会的最高层—包括联合国安理会—来��决缅甸的问题。 因为我们必须表明对和平、民主和人权的严肃态度。
en: This is why we feel obligated to call on the highest levels of the international community – including the UN Security Council – to address the question of Burma, for we must show that we are serious about peace, democracy, and human rights.

zh: 勇敢的缅甸人民和全世界人民一样，理应得到那些被我们太多的人看成理所当然的权利。
en: The courageous people of Burma, like people everywhere around the world, deserve what far too many of us take for granted.

zh: 缅甸转型
en: Burma’s Turn

zh: 仰光—如今，在政治变迁停滞了半个世纪的缅甸，新的领导层正在试图进行由内而外的快速转型。
en: YANGON – Here in Myanmar (Burma), where political change has been numbingly slow for a half-century, a new leadership is trying to embrace rapid transition from within.

zh: 政府释放了政治犯，举行了选举（后续还会有更多选举 ） ， 开始了经济改革，并开始大规模向外部投资示好。
en: The government has freed political prisoners, held elections (with more on the way), begun economic reform, and is intensively courting foreign investment.

zh: 不难理解，长期以来对缅甸的独裁机制进行着制裁的国际社会依然对缅甸保持谨慎的态度。
en: Understandably, the international community, which has long punished Myanmar’s authoritarian regime with sanctions, remains cautious.

zh: 缅甸的改革来的太迅猛，即便是最著名的缅甸专家也无法确定该国会何去何从。
en: Reforms are being introduced so fast that even renowned experts on the country are uncertain about what to make of them.

zh: 但在我看来，显然，缅甸现在正处于永久变革的良机，国际社会不能坐视这次机会溜走。
en: But it is clear to me that this moment in Myanmar’s history represents a real opportunity for permanent change – an opportunity that the international community must not miss.

zh: 世界应该为缅甸制定前景日程，不仅仅是提供援助，更要取消现在已成为阻挠缅甸转型的制裁。
en: It is time for the world to move the agenda for Myanmar forward, not just by offering assistance, but by removing the sanctions that have now become an impediment to the country’s transformation.

zh: 到目前为止，2010年11月立法选举以来的转型已经称得上令人瞩目。
en: So far, that transformation, initiated following legislative elections in November 2010, has been breathtaking.

zh: 军方（自1962年以来一直大权独揽）保留了25%的席位，因此人们担心此次选举只是一场闹剧。
en: With the military, which had held exclusive power from 1962, retaining some 25% of the seats, there were fears that the election would be a façade.

zh: 但是选举产生的政府在反映缅甸公民基本诉求方面的表现要远好于人们的预期。
en: But the government that emerged has turned out to reflect fundamental concerns of Myanmar’s citizens far better than was anticipated.

zh: 在新总统吴登盛的领导下，缅甸当局回应了政治和经济开放的呼声。
en: Under the leadership of the new president, Thein Sein, the authorities have responded to calls for a political and economic opening.

zh: 与少数民族叛军的和平谈判取得了进展 — — 此类冲突的根源可以追溯到殖民地时期的分割统治策略，在独立后的60余年里，缅甸统治者也延续了这一策略。
en: Progress has been made on peace agreements with ethnic-minority insurgents – conflicts rooted in the divide-and-rule strategy of colonialism, which the country’s post-independence rulers maintained for more than six decades.

zh: 诺贝尔和平奖获得者昂山素季不但被解除了软禁，还开始全力争取在4月的补选中问鼎议会席位。
en: The Nobel laureate Daw Aung San Suu Kyi was not only released from house arrest, but is now campaigning hard for a parliamentary seat in April’s by-elections.

zh: 在经济领域，预算过程引入了前所未有的透明度。
en: On the economic front, unprecedented transparency has been introduced into the budgetary process.

zh: 卫生和教育支出实现了翻番（尽管基数很低 ） 。
en: Expenditures on health care and education have been doubled, albeit from a low base.

zh: 大量关键领域的执照控制也有所放松。
en: Licensing restrictions in a number of key areas have been loosened.

zh: 政府甚至还承诺统一其复杂的汇率体系。
en: The government has even committed itself to moving towards unifying its complicated exchange-rate system.

zh: 希望精神在缅甸随处可见，但老一辈缅甸人目睹着集权统治不断地放松-收紧，对这一次仍然心存疑虑。
en: The spirit of hope in the country is palpable, though some older people, who saw earlier moments of apparent relaxation of authoritarian rule come and go, remain cautious.

zh: 这或许也是国际社会对放松孤立缅甸犹豫不决的原因。
en: Perhaps that is why some in the international community are similarly hesitant about easing Myanmar’s isolation.

zh: 但大部分缅甸人认为，如果变革能够得到很好的管理，那么缅甸将进入不可逆转的转型过程。
en: But most Burmese sense that if changes are managed well, the country will have embarked on an irreversible course.

zh: 2月份，我参加了缅甸知名经济学家吴敏丹（U Myint）在仰光和新建首都内比都举行的讨论会。
en: In February, I participated in seminars in Yangon (Rangoon) and the recently constructed capital, Naypyidaw, organized by one of the country’s leading economists, U Myint.

zh: 这两次讨论会不可不谓盛大，参与听众既多又活跃，两位20世纪60年代离开缅甸、40余年后首次回国著名缅甸经济学家做了既深刻又动人的演说。
en: The events were momentous, owing both to large and actively engaged audiences (more than a thousand in Yangon), and to the thoughtful and moving presentations by two world-famous Burmese economists who had left the country in the 1960’s and were back for their first visit in more than four decades.

zh: 我的哥伦比亚大学同事罗纳德·芬德雷（Ronald Findlay）指出，两位经济学家之一、91岁高龄的伦敦经济学院教授拉敏（Hla Myint）是有史以来最成功的发展战略的提出者，即开放经济、刺激出口导向增长。
en: My Columbia University colleague Ronald Findlay pointed out that one of them, 91-year-old Hla Myint, who had held a professorship at the London School of Economics, was the father of the most successful development strategy ever devised, that of an open economy and export-led growth.

zh: 近几十年来，这一战略在亚洲得到了广泛的应用，最显著的便是中国。
en: That blueprint has been used throughout Asia in recent decades, most notably in China.

zh: 如今，终于轮到他的祖国了。
en: Now, perhaps, it has finally come home.

zh: 2009年12月，我在缅甸做讲座。
en: I delivered a lecture in Myanmar in December 2009.

zh: 当时，身居缅甸需要如履薄冰，因为政府对你如何界定该国的问题 — — 即使是贫困、农业生产率低下、劳动力素质不高这样的问题 — — 颇为敏感。
en: At that time, one had to be careful, given the government’s sensitivities, even about how one framed the country’s problems – its poverty, lack of rural productivity, and unskilled workforce.

zh: 如今，怀疑早已被抛到了九霄云外，取而代之的求贤若渴 — — 缅甸政府急切地想知道如何应付上述三项及其他挑战，也明自己需要技术和其他形式的援助。
en: Now caution has been replaced by a sense of urgency in dealing with these and other challenges, and by awareness of the need for technical and other forms of assistance.

zh: （从人口和收入水平看，缅甸是世界上接受国际援助最少的国家之一。 ）
en: (Relative to its population and income, Myanmar is one of the world’s smallest recipients of international assistance.)

zh: 关于缅甸近期改变之迅猛的原因还存在颇多争议。
en: There is much debate about what explains the rapidity of Myanmar’s current pace of change.

zh: 或许其领导人认识到，这个曾经的世界第一大水稻出口国正在落后于邻邦。
en: Perhaps its leaders recognized that the country, once the world’s largest rice exporter, was falling far behind its neighbors.

zh: 或许他们听到了阿拉伯之春的弦外之音。 或许只是因为他们明白了，在300万缅甸人侨居海外的情况下，想让国家孤立于世界、防止信息从邻国渗入国内是不可能完成的任务。
en: Perhaps they heard the message of the Arab Spring, or simply understood that, with more than three million Burmese living abroad, it was impossible to isolate the country from the rest of the world or prevent ideas from seeping in from its neighbors.

zh: 不管原因为何，变革实实在在地发生着，变革所带来的机会也是不容置疑的。
en: Whatever the reason, change is occurring, and the opportunity that it represents is undeniable.

zh: 但是，大量国际制裁 — — 不管在过去起到了什么作用 — — 现在看起来已是适得其反。
en: But many of the international sanctions, whatever their role in the past, now seem counterproductive.

zh: 比如，金融制裁抑制了透明的现代金融体系的发展，阻止了缅甸融入世界的步伐。
en: Financial sanctions, for instance, discourage the development of a modern and transparent financial system, integrated with the rest of the world.

zh: 由此产生的基于现金的经济不啻于催生腐败的温床。
en: The resulting cash-based economy is an invitation to corruption.

zh: 类似地，限制来自发达工业国的更有社会责任心的公司在缅甸开展业务为投机倒把者开启了方便之门。
en: Likewise, restrictions that prevent socially responsible companies based in advanced industrial countries from doing business in Myanmar have left the field open to less scrupulous firms.

zh: 我们应该欢迎缅甸对来自多边机构和联合国开发计划的指导和建议的渴求；但是，在实际中，我们却在继续束缚这些机构在缅甸转型方面所能施展���拳脚。
en: We should welcome Myanmar’s desire for guidance and advice from multilateral institutions and the United Nations Development Program; instead, we continue to limit the role that these institutions can play in the country’s transition.

zh: 每当我们拒绝给予援助或坚持施加制裁时，我们就应该再三思考，是谁在给我们所寻求的变革制造障碍。
en: Whenever we withhold assistance or impose sanctions, we need to think carefully about who bears the burden in bringing about the changes that we seek.

zh: 开放农业和纺织品贸易 — — 即使只是开放提供给其他贫穷国家的品种 — — 能够为占缅甸人口70%的贫困农民带来直接的好处，还能创造就业机会。
en: Opening up trade in agriculture and textiles – and even providing preferences of the kind that are offered to other poor countries – would likely benefit directly the poor farmers who make up 70% of the population, as well as create new jobs.

zh: 富贵阶层能够绕过金融制裁，无非略有破费而已；而普罗大众要想摆脱国际二等公民的影响就没有那么容易了。
en: The wealthy and powerful can circumvent financial sanctions, though at a cost; ordinary citizens cannot so easily escape the impact of international-pariah status.

zh: 我们看到，阿拉伯之春的花朵在一些国家顽强地绽放着；但另一些国家中，我们还不能确定花朵会变成果实。
en: We have seen the Arab Spring blossom haltingly in a few countries; in others, it is still uncertain whether it will bear fruit.

zh: 缅甸的转型从某种程度上来说称得上悄无声息，没有在Twitter和Facebook上引起热烈关注，但其真实程度并不亚于阿拉伯之春，也和阿拉伯之春一样值得国际社会予以支持。
en: Myanmar’s transition is in some ways quieter, without the fanfare of Twitter and Facebook, but it is no less real – and no less deserving of support.

zh: 布什收拾残局
en: Bush Inherits the Wind

zh: 卡特林娜飓风之后最为令人惊讶的言论当属美国总统乔治·沃克·布什所言 ： “ 我想没有人预想到会决堤 ” 。 这些堤坝保护新奥尔良免受洪涝之灾。
en: The most shocking statement in the aftermath of Hurricane Katrina was President George W. Bush’s remark that “I don’t think anybody anticipated the breach of the levees” that protect New Orleans from flooding.

zh: 新奥尔良市的大部分位于海平面以下，必须由堤坝将大水御于城门之外。
en: New Orleans is a city mostly below sea level, and must be protected by levees to keep water out.

zh: 众多科学家、工程师以及紧急情况准备专家们早就担心堤坝会在强飓风中决堤。
en: Concern that the levees might break in the midst of a powerful hurricane was widespread among scientists, engineers, and emergency-preparedness experts.

zh: 但是，布什显然并不知道这些担忧，在飓风摧毁堤坝、淹没城市之后几天后依然不知道。
en: Yet Bush apparently did not know of these concerns, even days after the hurricane destroyed the levees and flooded the city.

zh: 一个简单的事实有目共睹，这一事实超越这场特定的飓风本身，甚至超越这一特定的总统。
en: There is a simple fact on display here, one that goes well beyond this particular hurricane, and even this particular president.

zh: 美国政治中，科学知识和政治决策严重脱节。
en: There is a deep disconnect in American politics between scientific knowledge and political decisions.

zh: 布什应为此承担大部责任。
en: Bush bears much responsibility for this.

zh: 在有关科学的问题上，布什是最为无知、最能把科学问题转变为政治化的美国总统之一。
en: He has proven to be one of America’s least knowledgeable presidents when it comes to science – and one of the most ready to turn science into a political issue.

zh: 近来数月内，布什损害进化论的生物理论，倡导基督教原教旨主义教条。
en: In recent months, Bush undermined biological theories of evolution in favor of Christian fundamentalist dogmas.

zh: 当气候科学和公共健康科学与其核心支持者的信念和利益冲突之时，他嘲讽前者。
en: He disdains climate science and public health science when it conflicts with the beliefs – and interests – of his core supporters.

zh: 一言以蔽之，布什的科学政策记录惨不忍睹。
en: Simply put, Bush’s record on science policy is miserable.

zh: 气候科学家多年来警告人为温室气体排放造成的全球气候变暖将导致更为剧烈的风暴。
en: Climate scientists have warned for years that global warming caused by manmade emissions of greenhouse gases will generate more extreme storms.

zh: 卡特林娜飓风可能时运不佳，而非人为气候变化迹象。 尽管没有科学的方法将某一场特定的飓风，例如卡特林娜飓风同长期趋势联系在一起，但是，全世界的飓风能量已经显著增加。
en: While there is no scientific way to link a particular hurricane such as Katrina to the long-term trend – in the sense that Katrina might have been bad luck rather than a sign of manmade climate change – the energy of hurricanes throughout the world has been rising markedly.

zh: 布什不仅没有对气候科学的发现作出反应，反而大力主导各种势力证明对气候科学不可信以为真。
en: Bush, alas, led an aggressive effort to discredit climate science rather than to respond to its findings.

zh: 对于导致全球气候变暖、进而使得飓风能量上升的温室气体排放，他呼吁延缓降低。
en: He called for delays in reducing greenhouse gas emissions that cause global warming, which in turn causes the energy of hurricanes to rise.

zh: 根据布什所不予理会的基本科学，飓风从于海水的热度汲取能量，所以飓风发生在炎热的热带地区，并且在夏末，此时海平面温度达到全年最高。
en: According to the underlying science that Bush ignores, hurricanes take their energy from the warmth of seawater. That is why hurricanes occur in hot tropical regions, and at the end of the summer months, when the sea surface temperatures are at their annual maximum.

zh: 人为全球变暖不仅提高空气温度，而且提高海平面温度。
en: Manmade global warming raises not only air temperatures, but sea-surface temperatures as well.

zh: 海平面的高温转化为世界海洋上更为猛烈的风暴。
en: Higher sea-surface temperatures translate into more powerful storms in the world’s oceans.

zh: 根据三项指标衡量飓风：频率、强度和持续时间。
en: Hurricanes are measured according to three dimensions: frequency, intensity, and duration.

zh: 飓风的频率即使有变化也是不多。
en: The frequency of hurricanes has not changed much, if at all.

zh: 飓风的强度和持续时间则变化明显。
en: The big changes are in hurricanes’ intensity and duration.

zh: 强度衡量包括风速在内的飓风的力量，强度增加有记录可查。
en: Intensity measures a hurricane’s force, which includes wind speeds, and there has been some recorded increase.

zh: 最大的改变则是飓风的持续时间，也就是每场飓风持续的天数。
en: The biggest change, however, has been in the duration of hurricanes: how many days each hurricane lasts.

zh: 世界范围内，飓风的持续时间显著增加。
en: Duration has risen markedly around the world.

zh: 一场飓风的强度乘以其持续时间为其总能量。
en: The total energy of a hurricane is found by multiplying the intensity of the hurricane by its duration.

zh: 总能量也大幅上升，而且随着温度上升，能量也随之上升。
en: This, too, has risen sharply, and more is in store as temperatures rise.

zh: 研究气候变化的科学家和工程师们强调政府应当采纳两种主要的应对措施。
en: Scientists and engineers who work on climate change stress that governments need to adopt two main responses.

zh: 第一个称为“减缓 ” ， 也就是降低人为气候变化的数量。
en: The first, called “mitigation,” means reducing the amount of manmade climate change.

zh: 这一点可以通过改变世界能源体系、限制人为气候变化的主要驱策力二氧化碳排入大气层做到。
en: This can be done by changing the world’s energy system to limit emissions of carbon dioxide into the atmosphere – the main driver of manmade climate change.

zh: 其中一项选择是转向非碳能源，例如可再生能源（太阳能和风能）以及核能。
en: One option is a shift to non-carbon energy sources, such as renewable energy (solar and wind power) and nuclear energy.

zh: 另一项选择是将碳基能源（煤炭、石油和天然气）和新技术相结合，防止碳的空中排放。
en: Another option is to combine carbon-based energy (coal, oil, and gas) with new technologies that prevent the emission of airborne carbon.

zh: 应对气候变化的第二个措施称为“适应 ” ， 要求我们为正在发生的气候变化以及未来年间要发生的更大的气候变化做好准备。
en: The second response to climate change, called “adaptation,” requires that we ready ourselves for the climate change now underway and the increased climate change to come in future years.

zh: 这意味着准备对付强度更大、持续时间更长的飓风。
en: This means preparing for hurricanes that are more powerful in both intensity and duration.

zh: 一个勤政的联邦政府早应认识到美国的海湾地区尤为容易受到强飓风的袭击。
en: An attentive national government would surely have realized that the Gulf region of the United States is more vulnerable to high-energy hurricanes.

zh: 实际上，卡特林娜飓风是有史以来在美国登陆的第三大强飓风。
en: Indeed, Hurricane Katrina was the third most intense hurricane ever to make landfall in the US.

zh: 勤政的政府理应采取更多的行动加固堤坝。
en: Such a government would have taken more action to strengthen levees.

zh: 鉴于美国的高度科学专业水准，布什行政当局的疏忽尤为令人惊讶。
en: The Bush administration’s negligence is especially shocking given the remarkable amount of scientific expertise that exists in the US.

zh: 不知如何，科学家被政治运作者所排挤。
en: Somehow, scientists have been pushed aside by political operators.

zh: 但是，美国政府的失职行为世界各地均有，而且肯定在最贫困国家，那里的科学专业水准低下，众多政府并无科学咨询机构可以寻求指导。
en: But the US government’s failings are matched in many parts of the world, and certainly in the poorest countries, where scientific expertise is scarce, and where many governments do not have scientific advisory councils to turn to for guidance.

zh: 卡特林娜飓风对于美国和全世界而言都是警示之钟。
en: Hurricane Katrina is a wakeup call, not only for the US but for the world.

zh: 我们正进入一个良好的科学对于我们的生存而言至关重要的时期。
en: We are entering a period when good science is vital for our survival.

zh: 我们的地球人口拥挤，威胁充斥于我们的气候、海洋、森林、粮食生产以及水供应，全球旅行和高人口密度增加了世界范围疾病传染的危险。 我们必须求助于我们最佳的科学和工程知识来找到安全的通道。
en: On a crowded planet with threats to our climate, oceans, forests, food production, and water supply, and with global travel and high population densities increasing the risk of worldwide disease epidemics, we must turn to the best of our scientific and engineering knowledge to find a safe passage.

zh: 布什高院败诉，美国获胜
en: Bush Loses in the Supreme Court and America Wins

zh: 美国最高法院在这周做出的两项裁定否决了布什总统要求在战争时期得到的压倒一切的权利。
en: Two rulings of the United States Supreme Court this week rejected the sweeping wartime powers claimed by President Bush.

zh: 在亚瑟尔·哈姆迪一案中，高院拒绝了布什政府关于军方可以将美国公民作为"敌方战士"无限期拘押的要求。 这种拘押方式从不给被拘押者在中立的裁定者面前为自己被拘押的罪名进行申辩的权利。
en: In the case of Yaser Hamdi, the court renounced the Administration's claim that military authorities could indefinitely hold a U.S. citizen as an "enemy combatant" without ever providing him with an opportunity to contest the basis for his detention before a neutral decision maker.

zh: 在另一件有14位不同国籍的外国公民提起的诉讼中，高院同样驳回了政府的申辩。 美国政府争辩说由于美国关塔纳摩海军基地名义上是在古巴的主权管辖内，所以美国法院无权受理被拘押者提起的诉讼-这些人无权决定美国军方将他们关押在哪里。
en: And in a case brought by fourteen foreign nationals, the court cast aside the government's argument that because the U.S. Naval Base at Guantanamo Bay is nominally under Cuban sovereignty, American courts lack jurisdiction to entertain legal claims brought by persons who had no say in where the U.S. military chose to detain them.

zh: 虽然两桩案子都没有提到发生在阿布格勒布监狱的虐囚丑行及美国政府重量级律师们炮制的，授权虐待行为的秘密备忘录，但这两点很可能也是影响法官判决的原因。
en: Although nowhere mentioned in either case, the scandalous treatment of Iraqi prisoners at Abu Ghraib and the revelations that high-level government lawyers prepared confidential memoranda authorizing torture, likely played a part in the Justices' reasoning.

zh: 布什政府曾信誓旦旦地说 ： " 相信我们，没错的。
en: The Administration essentially said, "trust us to do what's right."

zh: "显然，法院认为政府的所作所为并没有赢得信任。
en: Clearly, the court thought that such trust had not been earned.

zh: 另一点不言而喻的考虑大概就是吸引了相当国际关注的关塔纳摩湾一案。
en: Another unspoken consideration may have been at work in the Guantanamo Bay case, which has garnered considerable international attention.

zh: 近几年，大多数的美国高院法官都明确表达了美国法律多边主义的观点，这与布什政府的单边主义行为形成鲜明对照。
en: In recent years, a majority of the Justices of the Supreme Court have articulated a multilateralist view of American law that stands in marked contrast to the unilateralism of the Bush Administration.

zh: 例如，在2002年的弗吉尼亚一案中，高院裁定处决智障犯人是被《美国宪法》所禁止的"残酷而非常规的惩罚方式 " 。
en: For example, in a 2002 Virginia case, the high court ruled that the execution of the mentally retarded is forbidden by the American Constitution as "cruel and unusual punishment."

zh: 虽然高院对该案的分析主要基于对国内因素的考虑，但法官们同时也援引了欧盟的一份法律纲要，其中描述了国际社会对这种做法的强烈反对。
en: While most of the Court's analysis focused on domestic considerations, the Justices also invoked a legal brief filed by the European Union that described the overwhelming disapproval of the practice in the world community.

zh: 同样，在去年一项撤销德克萨斯禁止同性性行为的法令的裁决中，高院也引用了1967年《英国议会法案》和欧洲人权法庭在1981年的一项裁决。
en: Likewise, in last year's ruling striking down a Texas prohibition on same-sex sodomy, the Court cited a 1967 Act of the English Parliament and a 1981 ruling of the European Court of Human Rights.

zh: 颇具意味的是在弗吉尼亚和德克萨斯两案中投多数票的法官同样也在关塔纳摩湾案中持多数意见：他们是在"布什对戈尔"一案中投反对票的4位法官和在里根政府时期被任命的两位相对温和的法官-桑德拉·戴·奥康诺和安东尼·肯尼迪。
en: Significantly, the six Justices in the majority in the Virginia and Texas cases also constituted the majority in the Guantanamo Bay case: the four dissenters from Bush v. Gore plus Ronald Reagan's two relatively moderate appointees, Sandra Day O'Connor and Anthony Kennedy.

zh: 这些法官定期参加关于比较宪法的研讨会并认为自己是高等法院法官的国际社团中的一员。
en: These Justices regularly travel to colloquia on comparative constitutional law and see themselves as part of an international community of high court judges.

zh: 他们当然会考虑到如果支持在未经过相关司法程序的情况下对外国公民进行无限期拘押会使自己成为国际司法界被人诟病的对象。
en: It cannot have escaped their notice that to uphold indefinite detention of foreign nationals without judicial process would have made them virtual pariahs on the conference circuit.

zh: 我并不是在暗示高院法官们如此裁定关塔纳摩湾一案是为了博得国际同僚的赞许。
en: I do not mean to suggest that the Justices decided the Guantanamo Bay case as they did so that they would be toasted at their international cocktail parties.

zh: 我坚持认为他们对国际舆论的考虑-如果这种考虑如我所料地影响了他们的判决的话-也是为了国家利益而不是个人得失。
en: I contend that their concern for world opinion-if that concern played the role I am suggesting it did-was for their country, not for themselves.

zh: 在不到四年的时间里，布什总统和其顾问们就在很大程度上将长期以来的两党共识抛在了一边。 这种共识是美国与联合国等多边主义机构沟通和合作的前提。
en: In less than four years, President Bush and his advisers have cast aside much of the longstanding bipartisan consensus under which the United States works through and with multilateral institutions like the United Nations.

zh: 在这种大倒退的警示下，审理关塔纳摩湾一案的大多数法官也许力图向世界表明布什总统并不能为所有的美国人代言。 他甚至不能代表那些一开始让他入主白宫的人的意见。
en: Alarmed by this dramatic volte-face, the majority Justices in the Guantanamo Bay case may be trying to send assurances to the rest of the world that President Bush does not speak for all Americans, not even the ones who put him in office in the first place.

zh: 当然，新保守主义的最高法院批评者会发现这样的解释印证了他们最担心的事情。
en: Of course, neoconservative critics of the high court will see in this explanation the confirmation of their worst fears.

zh: 他们会说，有的法官不明白他们没有资格做美国外交政策的代理人，这一职能是宪法赋予总统和（他们可能会勉强承认）国会的。
en: Here are judges, they will say, who do not understand that they have no legitimate qualifications to act as agents of American foreign policy, a job committed by the Constitution to the President and (they may grudgingly admit) Congress.

zh: 然而高院以前也曾考虑过外交政策的因素。
en: Yet the high court has considered foreign policy implications before.

zh: 在20世纪美国最有名的案例"布朗对教育委员会"的裁决中，高院的法官们很可能就接受了政府关于种族隔离对外交的影响的简要解释。 政府解释说美国南方的种族隔离制度会破坏其与苏联竞争在发展中国家赢得民心民意的努力。
en: In the most celebrated American case of the twentieth century, Brown v. Board of Education, the Justices were probably influenced by a government brief explaining how racial segregation in the southern United States undermined American efforts to compete with the Soviet Union for the hearts and minds of people in developing countries.

zh: 通过对美国的种族隔离政策违反了"平等的法律保护"的宪法条款的裁决，高院的正义一击对美国国内和其在海外的战略利益产生了重要影响。
en: By holding that American apartheid violated the constitutional command of "equal protection of the laws," the court struck a blow for justice at home and American strategic interests abroad.

zh: 确切地说，布朗案��不具有完全的可比性，因为在该案的裁决中最高法院在联邦行政机构的敦促下着重考虑了外交政策因素。
en: To be sure, the Brown precedent is not entirely analogous, for there the Supreme Court gave weight to foreign policy considerations in just the way that the federal executive had urged.

zh: 而在关塔纳摩湾一案中，布什政府申辩说有利于被拘押者的判决会使人力和物力从战场上转移到法庭中，从而削弱美国的战斗力。
en: In the Guantanamo Bay case, by contrast, the Bush Administration argued that a ruling for the detainees would undermine the war effort by diverting manpower and material from the battlefield to the courtroom.

zh: 但以大法官约翰·保罗·史蒂文斯为代表的多数派意见对布什政府的恐怖预告并不在意。
en: But the majority opinion of Justice John Paul Stevens paid little heed to the Administration's parade of horribles.

zh: 作为二战的功勋老兵，史蒂文斯法官很可能认为自己至少和布什政府司法部的官员们一样有资格预测高院裁决对美国军事效力的影响。
en: A decorated World War II veteran, Justice Stevens may well have thought that he was at least as qualified as the civilians in the Bush Justice Department to forecast the impact of the court's ruling on military efficiency.

zh: 抑或这可能仅仅是法官们对布什政府持续的过火行为的反应。
en: Or perhaps the Justices were simply reacting to the Administration's constant overreaching.

zh: 是的，宗教狂热分子杀死大量无辜美国平民企图足以引发政府强烈的反应。
en: Yes, the existence of religious fanatics eager to kill large numbers of innocent American civilians warrants strong measures in response.

zh: 布什政府认为只要一提起"战争"和"恐怖主义"这样的字眼，它就有权要求全国上下对其言听计从。 但最高法院的裁决确认了这样一个根本原则：即便是最严重的危险也不能成为布什政府要求如此特权的理由。
en: But the Supreme Court's rulings affirm the fundamental principle that even grave dangers do not warrant the sort of blanket deference to which the Bush Administration believes it is entitled whenever it utters the words "war" and "terrorism."

zh: 布什言而无信的能源政策
en: Bush’s Bad-Faith Energy Policy

zh: 在今年的达沃斯“世界经济论坛”上比较超现实的场景之一就是石油业的专家们解释说极地冰盖的消融—比我们所有人预想的都要快—如何代表的不仅是个问题，同时也是个机遇：储量巨大的石油现在也许就可以被开采出来了。
en: One of the more surreal sessions at this year’s World Economic Forum in Davos had oil industry experts explaining how the melting of the polar ice cap – which is occurring faster than anyone anticipated ­– represents not only a problem, but also an opportunity: vast amounts of oil may now be accessible.

zh: 同样，这些专家们承认美国没有签署《海洋法公约 》 （ Law of the Sea ） ， 这部决定谁有权开采近海石油和其它海洋矿产权归属的国际公约，从而造成了国际冲突发生的风险。
en: Similarly, these experts concede that the fact that the United States has not signed the Law of the Sea, the international convention determining who has access to offshore oil and other maritime mineral rights, presents a risk of international conflict.

zh: 但他们同时也指出了好的一面：石油产业在对更多石油储藏的无休止探索中，不需要企求美国国会批准就能掠夺阿拉斯加了。
en: But they also point to the upside: the oil industry, in its never-ending search for more reserves, need not beg Congress for the right to despoil Alaska.

zh: 布什总统有一种不可思议的、接收不到重要迅息的能力。
en: President George W. Bush has an uncanny ability not to see the big message.

zh: 事实越来越清楚地表明，他多年以来的能源政策偏误颇多。
en: For years, it has become increasingly clear that much is amiss with his energy policy.

zh: 早期的一项能源法案由石油工业一手炮制，所以就连他的本党同僚也称之为“一个说客都少不了 ” 。
en: Scripted by the oil industry, even members of his own party referred to an earlier energy bill as one that “left no lobbyist behind.”

zh: 布什一方面赞扬自由市场的优点，一方面又过于慷慨大度地给予能源工业巨额的施舍，即便在美国面临财政赤字攀升的情况下也是如此。
en: While praising the virtues of the free market, Bush has been only too willing to give huge handouts to the energy industry, even as the country faces soaring deficits.

zh: 在能源方面存在着市场失灵的情况。 但政府的干预恰好应该与布什政府所倡导的方式背道而驰。
en: There is a market failure when it comes to energy, but government intervention should run in precisely the opposite direction from what the Bush administration has proposed.

zh: 美国人没有为其所造成的污染—特别是由于挥霍能源而造成的温室气体排放—付出完全的代价，意味着能源定价过低的情况在支撑着能源过度消费。
en: The fact that Americans do not pay the full price for the pollution – especially enormous contributions to greenhouse gases – that results from their profligate energy use means that energy is under-priced, in turn sustaining excessive consumption.

zh: 政府需要鼓励节能，并干预价格体系—即通过征收能源税—是行之有效的。
en: The government needs to encourage conservation, and intervening in the price system ­­– namely, through taxes on energy – is an efficient way to do it.

zh: 但是，布什非但没有鼓励节能，反而追求一种“先抽干美国”的政策，使美国在未来更加依赖外国的石油。
en: But, rather than encouraging conservation, Bush has pursued a policy of “drain America first,” leaving America more dependent on external oil in the future.

zh: 更别说高涨的需求驱动油价攀升，使得一些并非美国友邦的中东国家坐享渔人之利。
en: Never mind that high demand drives up oil prices, creating a windfall for many in the Middle East who are not among America’s friends.

zh: 现在，2001年9月的恐怖袭击发生已经4年多了，布什似乎终于从美国（对外国石油）日益增强的依赖的现实中醒悟过来；油价暴涨使他不得不注意到后果的严重。
en: Now, more than four years after the terrorist attacks of September 2001, Bush appears to have finally woken up to the reality of America’s increasing dependence; with soaring oil prices, it was hard for him not to note the consequences.

zh: 但是，其政府再度的犹豫和暧昧几乎肯定会使接下来的情况更糟糕。
en: But, again, his administration’s faltering moves will almost surely make matters worse in the immediate future.

zh: 布什仍然拒绝在节能方面采取行动，他宁可祈求上苍也不在节能技术上投入。
en: Bush still refuses to do anything about conservation, and he has put very little money behind his continuing prayer than technology will save us.

zh: 那么，又应该如何理解布什最近宣布的，在25年内使美国对中东的依赖降低75%的旦旦誓言呢？
en: What, then, to make of Bush’s recent declaration of a commitment to make America 75% free of dependence on Middle East oil within 25 years.

zh: 对投资者而言，其讯息非常明确：不要再在世界上开发成本最低的中东石油储藏开发方面投资。
en: For investors, the message is clear: do not invest more in developing reserves in the Middle East, which is by far the lowest-cost source of oil in the world.

zh: 但是，如果没有了在中东油田开发方面的新投资，美国、中国和世界其它地方野马脱缰般的能源消费增长，意味着需求会超过供应。
en: But, without new investment in developing Middle East reserves, unbridled growth of energy consumption in the US, China, and elsewhere implies that demand will outpace supply.

zh: 如果那还不够，布什对伊朗的制裁威胁会造成风险，中断这个世界主要石油生产国的石油供应。
en: If that were not enough, Bush’s threat of sanctions against Iran poses the risks of interruptions of supplies from one of the world’s largest producers.

zh: 随着世界石油产能接近极限，油价已经比伊拉克战争之前涨了一倍多。 而这样的政策预示着更高的油价，和石油工业的更高利润—该行业是布什中东政策中唯一清楚的赢家。
en: With world oil production close to full capacity and prices already more than double their pre-Iraq War level, this portends still higher prices, and still higher profits for the oil industry – the only clear winner in Bush’s Middle East policy.

zh: 确切地说，我们不应该抱怨布什终于承认了问题的存在。
en: To be sure, one shouldn’t begrudge Bush for having at last recognized that there is a problem.

zh: 然而，如果我们一如既往地进一步审视其政策提议，就会发现其政府的另一手花招。
en: But, as always, a closer look at what he is proposing suggests another sleight of hand by his administration.

zh: 除了拒绝承认全球变暖的严重性，拒绝鼓励节能或划拨更多科研基金，布什那堂而皇之的，降低对中东石油依赖的承诺的实际意义也比表面上看更小。
en: Aside from refusing to recognize the importance of global warming, encourage conservation, or devote enough funds to research to make a real difference, Bush’s grandiose promise of a reduction of dependence on Middle East oil means less than it appears.

zh: 由于美国的石油只有20%来自中东，他所定的目标通过在一定程度上转向另外的国家采购石油就能达到。
en: With only 20% of US oil coming from the Middle East, his goal could be achieved by a modest shift of sourcing elsewhere.

zh: 而我们肯定会想，布什政府必然意识到石油是在全球市场上交易。
en: But surely, one would think, the Bush administration must realize that oil trades on a global market.

zh: 即便是美国完全不需要中东石油，其供应量的减少也会对世界油价产生破坏性影响—进而影响美国经济。
en: Even if America were 100% independent of Middle East oil, a reduction in supply of Middle East oil could have devastating effects on the world price – and on the American economy.

zh: 对布什政府的官方政策不需要有什么好的解释，这已经是见怪不怪了。
en: As is too often the case with the Bush administration, there is no flattering explanation of official policy.

zh: 这究竟是布什在通过煽动美国民众反阿拉伯和反伊朗的情绪玩政治游戏，抑或仅仅又是一次无能和糊涂的表现？
en: Is Bush playing politics by pandering to anti-Arab and anti-Iranian sentiment in America? Or is this just another example of incompetence and muddle?

zh: 结合我们过去5年来的观察，正确的答案很可能比言而无信和尸位素餐更复杂。
en: From what we have seen over the past five years, the correct answer probably contains more than a little bad faith and sheer ineptitude.

zh: 布什的“破产试验”经济
en: Bush’s Crash Test Economics

zh: 十五年前，美国正处于所谓的“期望贬值”时代：生产力增长停滞；能源价格高昂；经济大萧条时期被积压的潜能技术已经枯竭；规模经济导致的收益渐亏使得几乎每一位经济学家做出这样的预测：经济增长速度在未来将远远落后于过去。
en: Fifteen years ago, the United States was in the midst of what you could call its “Age of Diminished Expectations.” Productivity gains had stalled, energy prices were high, the backlog of potential technologies that originated in the Great Depression had been exhausted, and waning benefits from economies of scale led nearly every economist to project that economic growth would be slower in the future than it had been in the past.

zh: 由于生产力增长停滞将近二十年，人们又开始议论美国政府的社会保险支出（社会保障体系、医疗保险、医疗补助制度）过于庞大，应该被缩减。
en: With productivity growth stagnating for almost two decades, it made sense back then to argue that the US government’s social-insurance commitments (Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid) were excessive and so had to be scaled back.

zh: 那是过去的事情了，下面要说的是现在。
en: That was then, this is now.

zh: 在这十五年期间，我们见证了技术革新大爆炸把美国总的生产力增长速度推回到减速前的水平。
en: The intervening years have seen an explosion of technological innovation that has carried America’s general productivity growth back up to its pre-slowdown levels.

zh: 的确，今天美国经济正处在生物科技的边缘，或者说是大规模、大范围的纳米科技的边缘。
en: Indeed, today the US economy is standing on the brink of biotechnological and, perhaps, nanotechnological revolutions of vast scale and scope.

zh: 但缩减社会性支出的呼声依旧持续。
en: Yet the same calls to scale back America’s social commitments are heard.

zh: 社会保障体系的精算师们可能并没有完全认识到如今技术革命带来的冲击力，而是显而易见地继续推进了这一政府能够负担得起的体制的规模。
en: Social Security’s actuaries may not have fully recognized the impact of today’s technological revolutions, but they have markedly boosted the scale of the system that the US government can afford.

zh: 十五年前，大多数人认为：美国的社会保障体制存在严重问题，解决它相当于重建一台机车。
en: Fifteen years ago, the consensus was that America's Social Security System was in huge trouble, that it needed the equivalent of an engine rebuild.

zh: 而现在解决这个问题看起来，就像布鲁金学院经济学家彼得·奥斯杰葛说的那样，更像修理一个漏气的轮胎：最终你必须要修好它，但这并不难而且不那么棘手。
en: Today its problems look, as the Brookings Institution economist Peter Orszag says, much more like the equivalent of a slow tire leak: you have to fix it eventually, but it isn’t very hard to do and repair it isn’t terribly urgent.

zh: 那么布什政府为什么要花时间和精力把社会保障体制的根本转变作为首要的、而且实际上就是唯一的国内政策举措呢？
en: So why is the Bush administration spending time and energy proposing radical changes to the Social Security System as its signature domestic policy initiative – indeed, as virtually its only policy initiative?

zh: 每一个为美国虚弱的财政状况担忧的人都把社会保障相对较小的资金调配失衡放在最后考虑。
en: Everyone who worries about America’s weak fiscal position puts Social Security’s relatively small funding imbalance far down the list of priorities.

zh: 鉴于布什政府的减税政策已经使赤字和里根政府时期的赤字持平，从而威胁到美国经济增长，应该予以首要考虑的是由媒体导向的全面的预算前景。
en: The highest priority problem is the overall budget’s medium-run outlook, as the Bush tax cuts have opened Reagan-size deficits that threaten to cripple US economic growth.

zh: 其次就是制定出医疗保险和医疗补助制度的长期计划。
en: The second highest priority problem is figuring out what to do in the long term with Medicare and Medicaid.

zh: 美国必须确定公共卫生项目的规模以及相关的资金供给。
en: America must decide the size of its public health programs and how to finance them.

zh: 实际上，这更是一个时机问题，而不是个难题：如果人们认为医生护士们现在，而且在一两代人的时间内还创造不出非凡的业绩，那么卫生项目领域内就不会出现严重的财政赤字。
en: In reality, this is more of an opportunity than a problem: if we did not expect that doctors and nurses will be able to do marvelous things in a generation or two that they cannot do now, we would not be projecting serious fiscal deficits arising from the health programs.

zh: 第三个最严重的问题就是要把美国政府的普通资金预算置于稳定雄厚的基础上，那么不属于社会保障体制范围内的政府部门在大约2020年不能再向社会保障信用基金借钱的规定时间到来以后能够做到自给自足。
en: The third most serious problem is to put the US government’s General Fund budget on a sustainable basis, so that the non-Social Security government can finance itself and meet its commitments after the date – around 2020 – when it can no longer borrow from the Social Security Trust Fund.

zh: 财政账目的底线是：社会保障长期的资金困难在计划上要大大小于、远于美国政府正面临的近期的、相对较大的和重要的财政难题。
en: The bottom line is that Social Security’s long-term funding difficulty, while real, is projected to be much smaller and much further in the future than any of the nearer, larger, and more significant fiscal problems currently facing the US government. If Social Security is a slow tire leak, then the post-2020 General Fund is an urgent brake job, Medicare and Medicaid are a melted transmission, and the budget deficit is the equivalent of having just crashed into a tree.

zh: 什么样的司机在自己的汽车撞到树上，变速器被烧毁却需要及时刹车时会说 ： “ 现在最重要的是把漏气的右后轮胎修一下 ” ？
en: What kind of driver, owning a car that has just crashed into a tree, has a burned-out transmission, and needs a brake job, says, “The most important thing is to fix this slow leak in the right rear tire?”

zh: 乔治·W·布什就是这样的司机。
en: George W. Bush is that type of driver.

zh: 至于布什政府为什么把精力用在社会保障体制改革上，有三种说法。
en: There are three theories as to why the Bush administration is focusing on Social Security.

zh: 第一种显然没有说服力：布什和他的人没有意识到联邦政府其它财政问题的重要性和意义。
en: The first is simple incompetence: Bush and his inner circle simply do not understand the magnitude and importance of the federal government’s other fiscal problems.

zh: 第二种说法涉及思想观念：出于某种原因，布什和他的人认为重要的是要破坏富兰克林·罗斯福“新政”体系取得的成就。
en: The second is ideology. For some reason Bush and his people think it is important to undermine the successes of the New Deal institutions established under Franklin Roosevelt.

zh: 第三个原因涉及官僚利益：正像2003年布什政府“医疗药品福利法案”的主要目的在于增加医药公司的利润一样，关于社会保障体制的改革意见是为保证华尔街的利益而提出的。
en: The third reason is bureaucratic capture: just as the principal aim of Bush’s Medicare Drug Benefit bill of 2003 was to boost pharmaceutical company profits, so the Bush administration’s Social Security proposal will most likely be tailored to the interests of Wall Street.

zh: 我看不出任何步伐比这更紧迫的改革 ― ― 比如提高收入税来支付国防开支 ― ― 在布什政府的政策制度中获得如此重视了。
en: I don’t see any other, more pressing, reforms – such as raising income taxes to pay for national security – gaining any traction in the Bush regime.

zh: 如果要我在其中一种可能的原因上下注的话，我肯定会输个精光的 ― ― 毕竟那是白宫掌控下的每一项政策的共同特点。
en: If I had to bet on a cause, I would put my money on sheer incompetence. After all, that seems to be the common denominator of every policy controlled by his White House.

zh: 布什政府将要结束时的加沙地带
en: Bush’s Dying Days in Gaza

zh: 巴黎-在访问中东的过程中，国防部长罗伯特·盖茨曾警告说，美国的敌人不应利用美国出现的权力真空来试图改变现状或是破坏美国新任总统的目标。
en: PARIS – During a visit to the Middle East, Secretary of Defense Robert Gates warned that enemies of the United States should not use the power vacuum there to try to alter the status quo or to undermine the new American president’s objectives.

zh: 但是，这方面的巨大挑战真的来了，并极具讽刺意味的是，它来自于美国在该地区的主要盟友-以色列。
en: But the major challenge in this respect is now coming, ironically enough, from America’s main ally in the region, Israel.

zh: 自然，让以色列强硬派感到遗憾的是，布什政府快走到尽头了，因为他们知道，即使奥巴马总统不大刀阔斧地改变美国对以色列的政策，一旦他上了台，他也不会重复布什政府对以色列无条件地支持的政策。
en: Hardliners in Israel naturally regret the end of the Bush administration, for they know that, even if President Barack Obama does not dramatically change US policy toward Israel once he assumes power, he will not repeat Bush’s unconditional support.

zh: 以色列的强硬派曾把“反恐战争”和伊拉克战争当作他们自己的战争，他们曾支持布什对伊朗近乎宣战的言论和孤立伊朗的立场，并把新保守主义者视为自己的思想同类，尤其是他们和新保守派具有同样的信念，即军事干预是一种合法且有效的实现政治变革的方式。
en: Israeli hardliners saw the “war on terror” and the war in Iraq as their wars, supported Bush’s war-like rhetoric and isolation of Iran, and considered the neo-conservatives their ideological kin. In particular, they shared the neo-cons’ conviction that military intervention is a legitimate and effective way of achieving political change.

zh: 这就是以色列政府在2006年通过“粉碎真主党”行动试图在黎巴嫩实现的目标。
en: This is what the Israeli government tried to achieve in Lebanon by “smashing Hezbollah” in 2006.

zh: 现在它正试图在加沙地带如法炮制。
en: Now it is trying to do the same in Gaza.

zh: 针对哈马斯的火箭弹，以色列人目前正在用过度的武力报以回应，与它们过去在黎巴嫩的行动一模一样。
en: In response to Hamas rockets, Israel is now using disproportionate force, just as it did in Lebanon.

zh: 其结果可能会与过去相同：战争结束时，哈马斯在巴勒斯坦和阿拉伯世界的威望将大增。
en: The result will probably be the same: at the end of the campaign, Hamas will have increased its popularity in Palestine and in the Arab world.

zh: 事实上，在对加沙地带进行了两年的封锁后，目前以色列的紧接着便采取了军事行动，而过去的封锁是为了摧毁哈马斯，但却没有取得成功。
en: Indeed, the current military operation follows Israel’s two-year blockade of Gaza, which was supposed to have damaged Hamas, but failed to do so.

zh: 可能奥巴马会认为建立巴勒斯坦国是符合美国的根本利益的。
en: It is likely that Obama will consider a Palestinian state to be in America’s fundamental interest.

zh: 他会认为这是一个改变美国在阿拉伯和穆斯林世界中形象的先决条件，因为恢复美国的信誉将是下届政府的一个主要目标。
en: He will see it as a precondition for altering perceptions of the US in the Arab and Muslim worlds, since restoring America’s credibility will be a major objective of the incoming administration.

zh: 让以色列强硬派不能确定的是，奥巴马最后是否会从战略性考虑出发，认为有必要改变对以色列的政策，借以实现这一目标。
en: Israeli hardliners cannot be sure that, at the end of the day, Obama will not find it necessary to change policies toward Israel in order to achieve this objective, for he considers it to be a strategic concern.

zh: 他们当然还明白，在寻求达成一个两国解方案的过程中，只要认真地牵涉到巴勒斯坦问题，就肯定意味着会牵涉到哈马斯。
en: They also know, of course, that any serious engagement with the Palestinian question must imply engaging Hamas in the search for a two-state solution.

zh: 简而言之，以色列政府正利用布什政府的最后日子来实现其军事第一的政策。
en: The Israeli government is, in short, using the Bush administration’s dying days to implement its military-first policy.

zh: 与此同时，它试图造成一种局面，即事实上让新总统更难在该地区使其政策获得成功。
en: At the same time, it is trying to create a situation that will, in effect, make it more difficult for the new president to achieve his policies in the region.

zh: 新闻报道显示，仇恨正在阿拉伯世界蔓延，美国和以色列的国旗被并排烧毁。
en: News reports show that revulsion is spreading through the Arab world, where American and Israeli flags are burned side-by-side.

zh: 因此，就在这种对话有绝对必要的关键时刻，这场战争只会让同这些国家打交道变得更困难。
en: This war, therefore, will simply make it more difficult to engage with those countries at the very moment such talks are absolutely necessary.

zh: 国际上对哈马斯不信任的一个原因是，它一直获得伊朗的支持。
en: One reason for international suspicion of Hamas has been the support that it receives from Iran.

zh: 奥巴马誓言要改变美国对伊朗的政策，要打开外交渠道而不仅仅是发出军事威胁。
en: Obama has vowed to change American policy toward Iran, opening diplomatic channels rather than merely issuing military threats.

zh: 这种改变也能更容易地结束对哈马斯的孤立。
en: Such a change would make it easier to end the isolation of Hamas as well.

zh: 美国与伊朗的重新接触显然是一项将对中东产生深远影响的政策。
en: America’s renewed engagement with Iran is clearly a policy that will have a far-reaching impact in the Middle East.

zh: 虽然这一美国政策的战略转变也是最符合以色列利益的，但大多数以色列人并不会这么认为。
en: Although that strategic change in US policy is also in Israel’s best interests, most Israelis will not see it that way.

zh: 美国与伊朗对话将是对以色列强硬派利益的一个沉重打击，他们中的一些人做梦都想让它成为泡影。
en: An American dialogue with Iran will be a serious blow to the interests of Israeli hardliners, and some of them dream of making it impossible.

zh: 因此，制约美国政策可能是以色列入侵加沙的动机之一。
en: Constraining American policy may, therefore, be one of the motivations behind Israel’s incursion into Gaza.

zh: 然而，它是一次对国际和平的严重挑战，并可能在整个地区造成不稳定。
en: Yet it is a grave challenge to international peace and could spread instability throughout the region.

zh: 如果出现这样的情况，奥巴马与伊朗和解的计划将被扼杀在摇篮里。
en: Were that to occur, Obama’s planned rapprochement with Iran would be strangled in the cradle.

zh: 在奥巴马上任前的数日里，当美国继续着权力真空的时候，欧盟可以发挥其在国际行动中的独特作用以结束暴力和不断扩大的人道主义危机。
en: In the days before Obama takes office, while a power vacuum persists in the US, the European Union has a unique role to play in international initiatives to end the violence and the unfolding humanitarian crisis.

zh: 欧盟若要取得成功，就必须追求由法国总统推出的政策，把停止战争作为头等大事并和以色列的对武力的过度使用保持距离。
en: For the EU to succeed, it must pursue the policy launched by the French Presidency, giving priority to stopping the war and distancing itself from Israel’s disproportionate use of force.

zh: 要永久停止敌对行动和解除对加沙地带的封锁，以色列和哈马斯之间停火的谈判可以作为达到此目标的第一步。
en: Negotiating a ceasefire between Israel and Hamas could be the first step toward a permanent end to hostilities and to the blockade of Gaza.

zh: 这实际上可以为奥巴马政府召开国际会议以实现巴勒斯坦两国制解决方案铺平道路，这应在停火之后举行。
en: It could, in effect, pave the way for the new Obama administration to convene an international conference to implement the two-state solution for Palestine, which should follow the ceasefire.

zh: 这些倡议不应在曲折的谈判中陷入困境，而是把重点放在实现巴勒斯坦两国制的解决方案的基本原则上，并按照8年前克林顿政府任期内提出的方针进行。
en: Such initiatives should not become bogged down in tortuous negotiations, but should focus on implementing the basic principles for a two-state solution, along the lines proposed by the Clinton administration before it left office eight years ago.

zh: 哈马斯已经开始进行停火谈判，我们应该让他同法塔赫一道充分参与和平进程。 当然，它必须放弃自己的用武力解决问题的战略，这种战略已经通过它向以色列扔下火箭弹昭示于众了。
en: Hamas has already engaged in ceasefire negotiations and should now be brought fully into the peace process, alongside Fatah, but it will, of course, have to abandon its own strategy of force, as expressed through the rockets it has rained down on Israel.

zh: 这是一个已被证明无效的政策，并且是违反国际法的，因为它的目标是以色列平民。
en: It is a policy that has proved to be ineffective, and that is illegal under international law because it targets Israeli civilians.

zh: 就以色列而言，它需要认识到，如果它想拿出符合自己的民主价值观的行动，就必须放弃其暴力的战略和对巴勒斯坦人的基本人权的不尊重以及“大以色列” 的观点。
en: Israel, for its part, needs to recognize that, if it wants to act in ways that are consistent with its own democratic values, it must abandon its strategy of violence and disrespect for the basic human rights of the Palestinians, as well as the idea of “Great Israel.”

zh: 简而言之，它必须接受一个巴勒斯坦国，这不仅是停留在口头上，而且要落实在行动上。
en: In short, it must accept a Palestinian state, through deeds as well as words.

zh: 一天不这样做，危险的日子就一直要持续到奥巴马就职典礼的日子，而国际社会将需要强有力的冷静的政治家来完成使命。
en: Until this happens, dangerous days lie ahead until Obama’s inauguration, and the international community will need strong, level-headed politicians to see it through.

zh: 布什的赌债
en: Bush’s Gambling Debts

zh: 乔治·W·布什的经济政策一直扎根于一场极其不计后果的赌博。 这场赌博反映了两个主要势力的政治联合：超级富豪和福音基督教会。
en: George W. Bush’s economic policies have been based on an extraordinarily reckless gamble that reflects a political coalition of two major forces: the super-rich and evangelical Christians.

zh: 随着这些政策的失败，全球金融市场反应消极，增加了世界经济的不稳定性。 这种情况不会在可见的未来缓和，因为美国正在进入漫长的政治内讧和僵持的时期。
en: As those policies fail, global financial markets are reacting negatively, adding uncertainty to the world economy, and there is little relief in sight, because America is entering a period of prolonged political infighting and stalemate.

zh: 超级富豪们加入布什联盟是有一个超越一切的目标的：给最富有的家庭带来压倒性利益的减税政策。
en: The super-rich had one over-riding objective in joining the Bush coalition: tax cuts that overwhelmingly benefited the wealthiest households.

zh: 福音基督教会的加入则是建立在所谓的“家庭价值观 ” （ 即反对堕胎和同性恋婚姻）和政府积极支持宗教活动的许诺（包括直接为宗教团体在地方和国际上提供的社会服务买单）上的。
en: Evangelicals were brought in on the basis of so-called “family values,” meaning opposition to abortion and gay marriage, and promises of active government support for religious activities, including direct payments to religious groups for social services that they provide locally and internationally.

zh: 布什集团相信他们最终能够在为富人减税和缩减政府开支之间取得平衡，但是他们从来没有向公众说明。
en: The Bush team believed that they would eventually balance the tax cuts for the rich with reductions in government spending, but they never explained this to the public.

zh: 相反，四年来，他们假装不关心预算赤字。
en: Instead, for four years they pretended that budget deficits were of little concern.

zh: 直到再次当选之后，他们才开始解释那些主要由税收的减少引起的大规模预算赤字，要求大幅度削减社会保障、医疗保健和其他领域的开支。
en: Only after being re-elected did they begin to explain that large budget deficits, caused mainly by lower tax revenues, would require sharp cuts in social security, health care spending, and other areas.

zh: 但是大多数美国人，尽管在布什第一任期内曾支持过减税（因为减税能让他们得到一点点额外的现金 ） ， 现在却不支持随后对基本政府服务的抨击。
en: But the majority of Americans, having supported the tax cuts in Bush’s first term because it gave them a little extra cash, do not support the attack on basic government services that has followed.

zh: 持这种反对立场的还有福音基督教会的选民，因为他们大多生活在工人阶级和中产阶级家庭中，依赖政府的多种社会服务。
en: This opposition extends to Christian evangelicals voters, who tend to live in working-class and middle-class households that depend on many kinds of government social services.

zh: 尽管许多原教旨主义基督徒公开宣扬“自由市场”的信仰，但是作为选民，他们支持由政府提供资金的养老金、医疗保健和其他公共服务。
en: Despite the avowedly “free-market” beliefs of many Christian fundamentalists, as voters they support government-financed pensions, health care, and other public services.

zh: 布什的减税政策从一开始就是不负责任的， 2001年9月11日后则更加如此。
en: Bush’s tax cutting was irresponsible from the start, but became much more so after September 11, 2001.

zh: 随着对阿富汗和伊拉克开战，同时在国内增加国家安全的开支，军事开支大大增加，但布什政府却从未向美国人民解释这些经费从何而来。
en: The Bush administration raised military spending sharply as it went to war in Afghanistan and Iraq, and as it increased spending on national security at home, without ever explaining to the American people how this would be financed.

zh: 军事加安全的预算猛增到了GNP的2 % ， 而税收的减少却更多。
en: The military-plus-security budget soared by more than 2% of GNP, while tax revenues fell by much more.

zh: 与此同时，布什支持提高教育和处方药补助等大众项目的支出，但支付这些服务的方式却是借钱，而不是确保有足够的税收。
en: At the same time, Bush supported expenditure increases for popular items like education and prescription drug benefits, but paid for these services by borrowing the money rather than ensuring sufficient tax revenues.

zh: 这个策略刚为布什赢得再次当选的胜利 — — 这场险胜巩固了共和党对国会的控制 — — 后不久，人们就开始认识到布什在财政上不计后果的作法。
en: No sooner did this strategy pay off with a narrow re-election victory – one that strengthened Republican control of Congress – than the dark realities of Bush’s fiscal recklessness started to be recognized.

zh: 美国每年的预算赤字达到GNP的5 % ， 而且差额中有很大一部分来自亚洲各国的中央银行。 这些央行目前已经持有2万亿美元的美国国债。
en: The annual US budget deficit reached 5% of GNP, with an enormous part of the gap financed each year by Asian central banks, which now hold about $2 trillion in claims against America.

zh: 问题是，布什不计后果的赌博现在已经积累起可观的政治动量。
en: The problem is that Bush’s reckless gamble has now built up considerable political momentum.

zh: 甫一当选，布什就提议削减大众化的政府计划，但却遭到他自己所在党派的反对。
en: As soon as he was re-elected, Bush started to propose cuts in popular government programs, but his own party is rejecting those cuts.

zh: 随着共和党控制的国会企图使面向富人的减税政策永久化，世界开始意识到美国的预算赤字问题已经积重难返。
en: With the Republican-controlled Congress seeking to make the tax cuts for the rich permanent, the world is beginning to realize that America’s budget deficits are now entrenched, with no end in sight.

zh: 由于美国的经济规模太大，美元在全球金融中的地位太高，长期的美国预算赤字意味着大规模的全球性影响。
en: Because America’s economy is so large, and the dollar so central to global finance, chronic US budget deficits mean huge global repercussions.

zh: 美元日趋疲软，因为金融市场知道美国今后需要从国外借贷大笔的资金。
en: The dollar is weakening, as financial markets understand that the US will need to borrow huge sums from abroad for years to come.

zh: 更不利的是，外国中央银行愿意借钱给美国的情况很可能就要结束。
en: More ominously, the willingness of foreign central banks to lend to the US also looks likely to end.

zh: 毕竟，如果今后美元价值会下跌，中国、日本、韩国和其他亚洲国家的央行干吗还要收集大量的美国国库券呢？
en: After all, why should the central banks of China, Japan, South Korea, and other Asian countries accumulate vast holdings of US Treasury bills if the dollar is likely to lose value in the years ahead?

zh: 奇怪但并不出人意料的是，美国正在为自身的问题抨击他人。
en: In a bizarre, but not unexpected way, America is lashing out at others for its problems.

zh: 大规模的减税和不断上涨的军事开支推动了进口的大幅度增加，因此现在巨大的贸易赤字伴随着美国虚弱的财政。
en: Huge tax cuts and rising military spending have fueled an enormous rise in imports, and therefore a yawning trade deficit now accompanies America’s weak fiscal position.

zh: 但是美国的政客却责怪中国和其他国家进行“不公平贸易 ” ， 甚至威胁要制裁他们。
en: But US politicians are blaming China and other countries for “unfair trade,” even threatening them with sanctions.

zh: 这种对国内自身问题的反应选民们倒是买账，但它却是荒谬且愚蠢的，特别是因��美国一直依赖中国来帮助筹措财政赤字的资金。
en: This response to homegrown problems plays well with voters, but it is ridiculous and ignorant, especially since the US has been depending on China to help finance the fiscal deficits.

zh: 本质上，美国是在抨击它自己的付账人，即便它还在向这个付账人借更多的钱！
en: In essence, the US is lashing out at its own banker, even as it asks the banker for yet more loans!

zh: 年初，当布什要求削减开支 — — 包括一项包含将来减少福利的社会保障改革 — — 的时候，世界上的投资者们就料到布什会得逞，至少在很大程度上如此。
en: When Bush asked for spending cuts at the beginning of the year – including a social security reform that includes cuts in future benefits – world financiers expected that Bush would get his way, or most of it.

zh: 他们并不认为从未真正支持过削减开支的美国选民会反对。
en: Little did they appreciate that American voters, having never actually supported spending cuts, would resist.

zh: 随着人们逐渐了解这个现实，经济前景会逐步黯淡。
en: As that reality sinks in, economic prospects darken.

zh: 外国人继续借钱给美国的热情会降温，从而使美元进一步贬值，迫使美国提高利率，并危及美国的股市和消费者开支。
en: Foreigners will become less enthusiastic about continued lending to the US, weakening the dollar further, forcing up US interest rates, and threatening to undermine America’s stock market and consumer spending.

zh: 但是，随着来年的山雨欲来，将布什推上宝座的政治联盟会抑制解决财政混乱的步伐。
en: But as the storm clouds gather in the coming year, the political coalition that put Bush in power will stifle progress in undoing the fiscal mess.

zh: 布什的赌博从一开始就注定失败，今后还将付出巨大的代价 — — 主要是对美国，但对世界上其他国家也会有影响。
en: Bush’s gamble was a loser from the start, generating costly results – mainly for the US, but for the rest of the world, too – for years to come.

zh: 布什的高智商刑讯人员
en: Bush’s Intellectual Torturers

zh: 巴黎 — — 奥巴马政府公布的有关CIA监狱刑讯的绝密备忘录使人们对一个根本性的问题有了新的认识：那些顶着美国政府之名的人怎么会如此轻易地接受拷打囚犯的想法？
en: Paris – The top-secret memoranda released by the Obama administration concerning torture practices in CIA prisons shed new light on a fundamental question: how is it that people acting in the name of the United States government could so easily accept the idea of torturing the detainees in their charge?

zh: 这些不久前公布的文件没有描述具体的刑讯过程，任何想知道的人都已经对此有了相当多的了解。
en: The newly published documents do not disclose the very facts of torture, which were already well known by whomever wanted to know them.

zh: 不过这些文件的确包含大量有关刑讯过程和涉案探员想法的信息。
en: But they do reveal a great deal of information about how the torture sessions unfolded and how the agents involved perceived them.

zh: 最令人震惊的发现是CIA指导手册中规定的、政府的法律专员采纳的琐细规定。
en: What is most striking is the discovery of niggling little rules, outlined in CIA manuals and co-opted by the government’s legal executives.

zh: 一般人以为刑讯是一时冲动所做的错事或无意的过激行为。
en: One would have thought that torture was the result of blunders or unintentional excesses committed on the spur of the moment.

zh: 然而事实正好相反，这些备忘录表明，刑讯是一种细致设计的策略。
en: On the contrary, these memos make clear that torture was a tactic formulated in minute detail.

zh: 在布什政府的“指导方针”中，刑讯可以分为三类，强度各异 ： “ 基础级 ” （ 不许穿衣服、不给吃饭、不让睡觉 ） 、 “调教级 ” （ 殴打）和“强制级 ” （ 浸水、箱内禁闭、向口鼻注水 ） 。
en: In the Bush administration’s “guidelines,” torture can be divided into three categories, of varying levels of intensity: “baseline” (nudity, dietary manipulation, sleep deprivation); “corrective” (hitting); and “coercive” (water-dousing, box confinement, water-boarding).

zh: 打耳光时，审讯员应五指微微张开，打在下巴尖和耳垂正中间的位置。
en: For a facial slap, the interrogator was supposed to hit with fingers slightly spread, at equal length between the tip of the chin and the bottom of the corresponding earlobe.

zh: 将赤裸的囚犯浸在水中，水温为5 C时可浸20分钟，10°C时可浸40分钟，15°C时最长可浸60分钟。 剥夺睡眠的时间不能超过180小时，但是在休息8小时后可以再来。
en: Dousing a naked detainee with water was to last 20 minutes if the water’s temperature measured 5 °C, 40 minutes at 10 °C, and up to 60 minutes at 15 °C. Sleep deprivation could not exceed 180 hours, but could start over again after eight hours rest.

zh: 溺水最多可持续12秒，每天不超过2小时，最多连续30天。
en: Water immersion in a tub could last up to 12 seconds, no more than two hours a day, for up to thirty days in a row.

zh: 向口鼻注水最长可以持续40秒，不过有两名囚犯在一个月的时间里一共有286次受到这种酷刑。
en: Waterboarding could last 40 seconds at most, though two prisoners were subjected to this torment a combined total of 286 times in a single month.

zh: 禁闭在小箱子里的时间不能超过2小时，但是如果犯人可以在箱子里站起来，则每次可持续8小时，每天18小时。
en: Confinement in a small box could not exceed two hours, but if the prisoner could stand in the box, it could continue up to eight hours at a time, 18 hours a day.

zh: 对于箱子里放入昆虫的情况也有相关规定。
en: If an insect was introduced into the box, rules governed that, too.

zh: 刑讯人员的训练过程也有披露。
en: How the torturers were trained is also disclosed.

zh: 大多数方法是根据美国士兵在准备面对“长期极端”情形时所受的训练进行反向设计的（执行人员由此也认为这些拷打是完全可以承受的 ） 。
en: Most methods were reverse-engineered from the training given to US soldiers preparing to face “long and extreme” situations (which somehow enabled executives to conclude that these ordeals are perfectly bearable).

zh: 换句话说，刑讯人员自己也经受过拷打。
en: In other words, the torturers had been tortured themselves.

zh: 之后是为期四周的高强度速成班，足以指导他们胜任他们的新工作。
en: An intense crash course lasting four weeks followed, enough to instruct them in their new jobs.

zh: 布什的律师是刑讯人员不可缺少的搭档。 他们的工作是为了确保法律上的免责。
en: The Bush lawyers were the torturers’ necessary partners, whose work was intended to ensure legal impunity.

zh: 这也是新鲜事物：刑讯似乎不是对公共准则的违反，不好但也情有可原。
en: This was also a novelty: torture does not appear as a breach of a common standard, unfortunate but justifiable.

zh: 相反，刑讯竟然也有法律标准。
en: Instead, it has a legal standard.

zh: 在这里，律师们采取了另外一套技巧。
en: Here, lawyers fell back on another series of techniques.

zh: 为了规避法律，审讯必须在美国境外进行，即使是海外的美军基地也行。
en: In order to circumvent the law, interrogation had to be conducted outside the US, even if that place was an overseas American military base.

zh: 刑讯的法律定义包含故意施加严重的痛苦。
en: The legal definition of torture implies the intentional infliction of severe suffering.

zh: 因此，律师们建议刑讯人员否认有这样的意图。
en: Torturers are thus advised to deny such an intention.

zh: 结果，打耳光的目的不是为了造成囚犯身体上的痛楚，而是让其感到惊讶和屈辱。
en: As a result, the goal of a facial slap is not to inflict physical pain, but to induce surprise and humiliation.

zh: 把囚犯囚禁在箱子里的目的不是为了让其慌乱，而是让他感到不舒服。
en: The purpose of confinement in a box is not to disorient someone, but to give the detainee a feeling of discomfort.

zh: 刑讯人员必须一直强调自己的“善意 ” 、 “真实的想法”和合理的假设。
en: The torturer must always emphasize his “good faith,” “honest beliefs,” and the reasonable premise for them.

zh: 因此，委婉语得到了系统的运用 ： “ 强化手段”用来指刑讯 ， “ 审问专家”用来指刑讯人员。
en: So euphemisms were systematically used: “enhanced techniques” for torture, “interrogation expert” for torturer.

zh: 在肉体上留下痕迹的做法是禁忌。
en: Leaving material imprints is contra-indicated.

zh: 因此，精神上的伤害比身体上的伤害更可取。
en: To that end, mental damage is preferable to physical injury.

zh: 刑讯过程的所有录像记录不出意料都会在事后被销毁。
en: Any video recordings of these sessions, not surprisingly, would be destroyed afterwards.

zh: 多方面的专业小组参与了刑讯。
en: Various professional groups were involved with torture practices.

zh: 因此，这股歪风涉及的范围远远超出刑讯人员的小圈子。
en: Thus, the contagion went well beyond the torturers’ limited circle.

zh: 除了使这种行为合法化的律师外，心理学家、精神病学家、医生（每次刑讯都必须有医生在场 ） 、 学者也经常提供道德、法律或哲学上的辩护。
en: Besides the lawyers legitimating the deeds, psychologists, psychiatrists, doctors (whose presence was mandatory at any session), and scholars also regularly provided moral, legal, or philosophical justifications.

zh: 而且，在被男性拷打的同时，当着女性的面受辱也会加强囚犯的耻辱感。
en: And, while males inflicted torture, degradation in the presence of women enhanced the humiliation.

zh: 对于这种违背法律和基本道德准则的行为，谁应该付法律责任？
en: Who is to be held legally liable for this perversion of the law and basic moral principles?

zh: 执行刑讯的志愿者所负的责任低于为刑讯开脱和创造条件的高级公职人员，而后者的责任又低于要求进行刑讯的政治决策者。
en: The volunteer who carries out the task of torture is less liable than the high-ranking civil servant who justified and nurtured it. And the latter is less liable than the political decision-maker who asked for it.

zh: 友好的外国政府，尤其是欧洲，也负有责任：他们知道刑讯的存在，也利用了刑讯得来的情报，但却没有在任何时候表示最轻微的反对，甚至没有做出任何不赞成的暗示。
en: Friendly foreign governments, especially in Europe, can also be held responsible: although they knew about the torture, and took advantage of the information thus obtained, at no point have they expressed the slightest protest, or even signal their disapproval.

zh: 他们的沉默等同于赞成。
en: Their silence was tantamount to consent.

zh: 那么我们是否应该起诉他们呢？
en: Should we therefore prosecute them?

zh: 对于政客来说，最好的民主惩罚是不再选举他们。
en: The best democratic punishment for politicians is not to re-elect them.

zh: 对于非选举出身的同谋者和促成者，我们可以寄望于他们周围的人予以道德制裁：谁愿意跟随一名提倡刑讯的教授学习？
en: As for unelected collaborators and enablers, we can hope that they will be sanctioned by their peers: who would like to study with a professor who advocated torture?

zh: 谁愿意让授权野蛮行为的法官来主持正义？
en: Who wants justice done by a judge who authorized brutality?

zh: 谁愿意让指导过刑讯的医生来给自己看病？
en: Who wants to be treated by a doctor who oversaw it?

zh: 想知道为什么某些美国人会如此轻易地同意实施酷刑，不需要从长久以来对穆斯林和阿拉伯人的仇恨或恐惧中寻找原因。
en: If we are to understand why some Americans accepted administering torture so easily, we need not look for some ancestral hatred or fear of Muslims and Arabs.

zh: 不，真正的原因远比这些更糟糕。
en: No, the cause is far worse.

zh: 奥巴马政府公布的备忘录告诉我们，任何出于“责任感”或必要的“国防手段”而采纳貌似高尚的原则的人，或者因担心自身或同胞的生命与幸福而冲动的人，都有可能成为折磨别人的人。
en: The memos that the Obama administration has disclosed teach us that anyone who complies with seemingly noble principles dictated by a “sense of duty” or by the necessary “defense of the homeland,” or who is urged by a basic fear for his own life and welfare, or the lives and welfare of his kin, can become a torturer.

zh: 布什的最后机会
en: Bush’s Last Chance

zh: 虽然目的是为了寻求从伊拉克的泥淖中抽身的战略，但“伊拉克研究小组”的严酷报告却成为对布什政府整个外交政策的全然控诉。
en: Though triggered by the need to devise an exit strategy from the Iraqi quagmire, the Iraq Study Group’s grim report is a devastating indictment of the Bush administration’s entire foreign policy.

zh: 这份报告严重质疑了这届受信仰驱使的政府的核心原则，同时也对总统本人提出了挑战。 他在政治信仰的驱使下严重背离了化解冲突的一贯之道，并选择了以蛮力为后盾的讨伐。
en: The report challenges the core principles of a faith-driven administration and of a president whose political gospel led him to a sharp departure from the culture of conflict resolution in favor of a crusade based on raw power.

zh: 一场没完没了的战争有时比战败还糟糕。
en: A war that cannot be ended is sometimes worse than a war that is lost.

zh: 因此，伊拉克报告就不仅是一份挽救伊拉克的计划，它也是让美国从一场打不赢的混乱战争中脱身的路线图。
en: Therefore, the Iraq report is more than a plan to rescue Iraq; it is a road map for extricating America from the mayhem of an unwinnable war.

zh: 不论研究小组是多么努力地回避突然撤军的建议和严格的撤离时间表，但他们的报告实际上不仅是对布什“坚持到底”执迷不悟的批判，也是让美国赶紧抽身的忠告。
en: However much the study group shunned recommendations for a precipitous withdrawal, and avoided strict timetables for disengagement, their report is not only an unequivocal repudiation of Bush’s “stay the course” obsession, but also a counsel to cut and run.

zh: 的确，伊拉克军队和警察绝不可能在短时间内接过战斗和有效维护治安的重任。
en: Indeed, there is no realistic chance that the Iraqi army and police will be able to take over combat responsibilities and effective policing any time soon.

zh: 伊拉克的整个安全机器已经腐朽并被叛乱分子渗透。
en: The entire security apparatus in Iraq is corrupt and infiltrated by insurgents.

zh: 伊拉克人为一个统一的伊拉克国家而战的信念究竟在多大程度上还存在也不得而知。
en: Nor is it at all clear to what degree the Iraqis retain a stake in the idea of a united Iraqi state worth fighting for.

zh: 这份报告实际上呼吁各方在伊拉克政府未能承担自己责任的情况下停止对其的一切支持。
en: The report practically calls for ending all support to the Iraqi government if it fails to assume its responsibilities.

zh: 中东的问题没有一个能够通过武力解决，也没有一个能够通过单边行动解决。
en: None of the Middle East’s problems has a military solution, and none can be solved through unilateral action.

zh: 因此该报告质疑布什坚持放弃与伊朗和叙利亚对话，无意建立更稳定的地区秩序的做法是完全正确的。
en: The report is therefore right to challenge Bush’s insistence on discarding both Iran and Syria as interlocutors for a more stable regional order.

zh: 伊朗在伊拉克内部可以发挥最大的杠杆作用。 而叙利亚也已成为武器和叛乱分子进入伊拉克战场的重要节点。
en: Iran has the most leverage inside Iraq, and Syria has become a vital crossing point for weapons and insurgents into the Iraqi battlefield.

zh: 如果美国不改变其现行政策，加强与该地区的这两个重要干扰者接触，那么伊拉克的稳定就没有希望。
en: There is simply no way that Iraq can be stabilized without America moving from a policy of disengagement to one of engagement with these two major regional spoilers.

zh: 因此这份报告的立场其实是对布什“邪恶轴心”理论的谴责。
en: The report thus stands as a rebuke to Bush’s entire “axis of evil” philosophy.

zh: 它拒绝将伊朗的神秘莫测归咎于一种莫须有的僵化的意识形态。
en: It refuses to ascribe to Iran’s secretive state an ideological rigidity that might not exist.

zh: 的确，伊朗已经不止一次地表明它能够适应高度实用主义的行为方式。 这种表现不仅仅在于其1980年代与伊拉克的战争中与以色列和美国的联系，及其支持美国人与阿富汗的塔利班武装对抗。
en: Indeed, Iran has shown its ability to behave with startling pragmatism more than once, not least in its links to Israel and the United States during its war against Iraq in the 1980’s, and in its assistance to the Americans in the war against the Taliban in Afghanistan.

zh: 但不仅仅是伊拉克才需要地区性的支持集团来实现些许的稳定。
en: But it is not only Iraq that requires regional support groups to reach a modicum of stability.

zh: 中东地区的所有问题—伊拉克、阿以冲突、政治改革的需要和伊斯兰恐怖主义—都是相互关联的。
en: All the problems of the Middle East – Iraq, the Arab-Israeli dispute, the need for political reforms, and Islamic terrorism – are interconnected.

zh: 该地区的外围问题和与阿以冲突有关的内围问题的相互关联性已经由第一届布什政府展现出来。 在第一次海湾战争结束后的1991年10月，该届政府组织了一次旨在实现阿以和平的重要国际会议。
en: The interconnectedness of the problems in the outer circle of the region and those pertaining to the Arab-Israeli conflict in the inner circle was shown by the first Bush administration, which, in October 1991, following the first Gulf War, organized a major international conference aimed at securing an Arab-Israeli peace.

zh: 不能指望以色列政府和其白宫里的亲密盟友会欢迎“伊拉克研究小组”重复这一逻辑的呼吁。 因为它和布什政府所奉行的所有政策都相抵触。
en: Neither the Israeli government nor its intimate ally in the White House can be expected to applaud the Iraq Study Group’s call for a repetition of that logic, for it contradicts everything the Bush administration has championed.

zh: 该报告建议仿效马德里和平会议的形式召开一次国际会议，这不仅适时地指出了阿以冲突和该地区其它问题之间的联系；它同时也在提醒我们注意一个早已不争的事实：双边谈判不能达成协议。
en: The report’s recommendation for an international conference in the style of the Madrid peace conference is not only a timely indication of the linkage between the Israeli-Arab conflict and the region’s other troubles; it is also a long overdue reminder that bilateral negotiations between the parties can not produce an agreement.

zh: 这一认识促成了2002年的全阿拉伯和平计划。 该计划设定了综合解决阿以问题的条件。
en: That realization prompted the all-Arab peace initiative of 2002, which established the conditions for an Israeli-Arab comprehensive settlement.

zh: 可不论“伊拉克研究小组”的报告有多么代表两党的共同观点，也不要奢望布什会采纳其所有的建议，并承认其整个外交政策的破产。
en: Alas, however bipartisan the Iraq Study Group’s report may be, it is too much to expect that Bush will endorse all of its recommendations and admit the bankruptcy of his entire foreign policy.

zh: 实际上，布什已经表达了他对与伊朗和叙利亚展开无条件直接会谈的反对意见。
en: In fact, Bush has already expressed his objection to unconditional direct talks with Iran and Syria.

zh: 他似乎更不会因为将其政府带入一场国际会议而与以色列交恶，就像他的父亲在1991年时与沙米尔总理之间那样。
en: Nor does he seem eager to open a rift with Israel by dragging its government to an international conference, the way his father did with Prime Minister Yitzhak Shamir in 1991.

zh: 布什要改变其对伊朗的政策会特别困难。
en: Bush will find it especially difficult to change his policy with respect to Iran.

zh: 为了确保美国不堪其烦，以致不能对其构成威胁，伊朗一直不断地阻挠布什实施地区性变革的使命。
en: In order to ensure that the US is too harassed to be able to threaten it, Iran has consistently obstructed Bush’s mission of regional transformation.

zh: 该报告敦促布什总统明白干扰者不会将停止干扰作为谈判的前提条件，而只会将其看成谈判的结果。
en: The report urges the president to understand that the spoilers will not cease to be spoilers as a precondition of negotiations, but only as a result of them.

zh: 布什面临着一个艰难的抉择：让美国实现和一种令他厌恶的伊斯兰神权政治的共存。
en: At stake is a painful choice for Bush: to lead America into coexistence with what he considers a repugnant Islamic theocracy.

zh: 但如果布什不想让他的总统生涯钉在历史的耻辱柱上，那么他就没有太多的选择了。
en: But Bush does not have many choices if he is to save his presidency from going down in history as an utter failure.

zh: 他的治国之道从一开始就是自杀式的。
en: His was a suicidal brand of statecraft from the outset.

zh: 如果他不在伊拉克及更广泛的问题上改变路线，他的总统生涯可能会为美国在中东数十年的霸权揭开序幕—从而损害其在该地区最亲密的盟友。
en: If he does not change course in Iraq and beyond, his presidency might draw the curtain on long decades of American hegemony in the Middle East – to the detriment of its closest allies in the region.

zh: 布什的新中东
en: Bush’s New Middle East

zh: 五年前，布什总统宣布伊拉克战争“使命胜利完成”时过于狂妄。 现在，他评价说“增兵”已经“在更为广泛的反恐战争中赢得了一场重要战略胜利”则是胡言乱语。
en: President George W. Bush’s declaration of “mission accomplished” in Iraq five years ago was as hubristic as his current assessment that the “surge” has “delivered a major strategic victory in the broader war on terror” is a fantasy.

zh: 伊拉克战争冒险是美国历史上历时最长、耗资最多的一场战争。 诺贝尔经济学奖得主斯蒂格里茨估计其费用高达三万亿美元。
en: The Iraq adventure is not only the longest and most expensive war in America’s history – the Nobel laureate economist Joseph Stiglitz has advanced a staggering estimate of $3 trillion – but is also the least conclusive.

zh: 这一战争把伊拉克社会碾成了粉末，各个教派分化林立。
en: The war has pulverized Iraqi society, dissolving it into an ethno-sectarian patchwork.

zh: “增兵”早晚要结束，而惨遭暴力和腐败侵袭的伊拉克民众还是无法团结其政治组织。 而且，由于他们的军队还是无法从美国人那里接管过来，因此伊斯兰圣战组织以及不同族裔之间的暴力还是肯定会再次爆发。
en: The “surge” will end sooner or later, and the Iraqis, crippled by violence and corruption, will still be incapable of uniting their polity, and, with their military still unable to take over from the Americans, jihadi and inter-ethnic violence is bound to erupt again.

zh: 摩索尔是当今反叛力量的主要据点，伊拉克军队驻在那里的一位营长阿里说 ： “ 没有美国人，我们根本不可能控制伊拉克。 ”
en: As Iraqi Colonel Omar Ali, the Iraqi battalion commander in Mosul, the main focus of the insurgency today, recently put it, “Without the Americans, it would be impossible for us to control Iraq.”

zh: 丘吉尔曾经把战争定义为“大错的汇集 ” 。
en: Wars, as Winston Churchill defined them, are always “a catalogue of blunders.”

zh: 历史对于伊拉克战争的评判因此肯定会更多地集中于它是否根据美国的民主构想实现了“重建”破败不堪的中东以及巩固美国在该地区霸权地位的战略目标，而非这一战争的流血和金钱的代价。
en: History’s judgment of the Iraq war will therefore certainly dwell more on whether it has accomplished its strategic objectives of “reconstructing” a highly dysfunctional Middle East in America’s democratic image and consolidating America’s hegemonic position in the region than on its price in blood and money.

zh: 从战略上说，这一战争完全失败了。
en: Strategically, the war was an utter failure.

zh: 它是帝国实力过度延伸的明显例证，让美国军队疲惫不堪，破坏了美国在世界上的道德地位及其在中东的声誉，严重威胁了美国经济，并且向美国的盟友和敌人展示了美国实力的局限。
en: A clear case of imperial overstretch, the war strained America’s military, undermined the America’s moral standing worldwide and its reputation in the Middle East, severely threatened its economy, and showed to both friends and foes the limits of American power.

zh: 人们没有预料到的这一战争最为严重的后果是在中东出现了什叶派穆斯林对于西方逊尼派同盟的强大挑战。
en: The most serious unintended consequence of the war is the emergence of a powerful Shia challenge to the West’s Sunni allies in the Middle East.

zh: 美国将伊拉克这一地区强国摧毁，从而把波斯湾的霸权拱手让给了伊朗的什叶派伊斯兰政权。 而波斯湾对于西方利益的重要性无以复加。
en: America’s destruction of Iraq as a regional power handed hegemony in the Persian Gulf – whose centrality to Western interests cannot be overstated – to Iran’s Shia Islamist regime on a silver platter.

zh: 美国在萨达姆侯塞因专制政权的废墟上帮助在伊拉克建立了第一个由什叶派占据统制地位的阿拉伯国家。 这一国家很可能臣服于伊朗的地区野心，这对于美国的逊尼派盟友而言是一个历史性的灾难。
en: On the rubble of Saddam Hussein’s dictatorship, the Americans helped create in Iraq the first Shia-dominated Arab state, which may well become subservient to Iran’s regional ambitions – a calamity of historic dimensions for America’s Sunni allies.

zh: 内贾德总统最近对伊拉克进行国事访问向美国表达了这样一个明白无误的信息，也就是美国即使想在伊拉克稍微实现稳定也要取决于同伊朗结盟的势力。
en: President Mahmoud Ahmedinejad’s recent state visit to Iraq conveyed to the Americans an unequivocal message: the prospects of the United States ever reaching a modicum of stability in Iraq have become dependent on Iran-aligned forces.

zh: 美国在伊拉克以及其他地方的困境决定性地促成了伊朗的核子野心。
en: America’s difficulties in Iraq and beyond contributed decisively to Iran’s nuclear ambitions.

zh: 伊朗现在认为自己不会受到美国对其核子设施的攻击，因为美国在伊拉克的麻烦和美国国内不断增长的反战活动向伊朗表明美国先发制人的战争战略已经失败。
en: The Iranians now see themselves as immune from an American attack on their nuclear installations, for America’s troubles in Iraq and the growing opposition to the war in the US are a signal to them that America’s strategy of pre-emptive wars has failed.

zh: 但是，无论伊朗政权有多么的极端，它还不是自寻灭亡。
en: But, however radical the Iranian regime might be, it is not suicidal.

zh: 因此，拥有核武器的伊朗的威胁或许更多的是其可以有效地施展地区性实力，而非发动对以色列核战争的倾向。
en: Hence, the threat of a nuclear Iran might consist less in its propensity to start a nuclear war with Israel than in its capacity to project its regional power effectively.

zh: 拥有核武器的伊朗甚至可能在危机的时候威胁美国在海湾地区部署常规军力的能力。
en: A nuclear Iran might even threaten America’s capacity to project conventional military force in the Gulf in times of crisis.

zh: 也不能排除这样一种可能，也就是伊朗可能会受到诱惑通过向代理恐怖集团提供核子原料来支持其地区野心。
en: Nor should the possibility be ruled out that Iran might be tempted to back its regional ambitions by supplying nuclear material to proxy terrorist groups.

zh: 美国在伊拉克的惨败如果有一点作用的话，那就是给中东地区现状的挑战者们壮了胆子。
en: If anything, America’s debacle in Iraq has only emboldened the challengers of the status quo in the region.

zh: 这也是不时计划不周的、在阿拉伯世界推行民主圣战的结果。
en: That has also been the result of Bush’s ill-conceived democracy crusade in the Arab world.

zh: 布什难过地发现，在阿拉伯只要实行民主就会招致反西方的伊斯兰份子，无论他们是埃及的穆斯林兄弟会还是伊拉克的什叶派党派或者是巴勒斯坦的哈马斯。
en: Bush discovered to his dismay that any exercise in Arab democracy is bound to usher in anti-Western Islamists, be it the Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt, Shia parties in Iraq, or Hamas in Palestine.

zh: 美国最终不得不放弃了其建立西方模式的阿拉伯民主的幻想，但是它却让伊朗在该地区高举民主的火炬。 这难免有点讽刺意味。
en: The US eventually had to abandon its fantasies about Western-style Arab democracy, but it ironically left the Iranians carrying the torch of democracy in the region.

zh: 毕竟，伊朗很快就意识到举行自由选举是破坏中东的亲美政权的最为稳妥的办法。
en: After all, Iran was quick to recognize that free elections are the safest way to undermine the Middle East’s pro-American regimes.

zh: 伊拉克战争还意味着美国忽略了巴以和平进程。
en: The Iraq war also meant that America ignored the Israeli-Palestinian peace process.

zh: 布什政府把该地区的“温和派”盟友团结起来帮助挽救巴以和平的机会现在受制于伊朗领导的地区轴心。 这一轴心包括哈马斯、真主党以及叙利亚。
