en: The chances that the Bush administration might be able to rally America’s Sunni “moderate” allies in the region to help salvage an Israeli-Palestinian peace are now hostage to an Iranian-led regional axis that includes Hamas, Hezbollah, and Syria.

zh: 它们都拒绝接受中东的美国和平，而且都对美国展开对话的前提条件不屑一顾，表现得极为有韧性。
en: All are united in their rejection of a Pax Americana in the Middle East, and all have so far shown remarkable resilience in ignoring America’s pre-conditions for a dialogue.

zh: 中东人民都受到美国支持的专制政权的统制。 美国无力鼓舞这些人民并不令人惊讶。
en: America’s inability to inspire the peoples of the Middle East, all ruled by US-backed autocracies, is not exactly stunning news.

zh: 令人感到新奇的是美国的实力或许正在失去恐吓他们的能力。
en: What is news is that American power might also be losing its ability to intimidate them.

zh: 布什了无新意的伊拉克新政策
en: Bush’s Old New Plan for Iraq

zh: 去年十一月美国国会选举结果给布什总统的伊拉克政策以沉重打击。
en: Last November’s Congressional elections dealt President George W. Bush a sharp rebuff over his Iraq policy.

zh: 选举后不久，伊拉克研究小组提出了一份超党派的、将美国军队逐步从伊拉克撤出的计划。
en: Shortly after the election, the Iraq Study Group offered a bipartisan formula for the gradual withdrawal of United States troops.

zh: 但是布什予以拒绝，尽管语焉不详，他还坚持宣称要在伊拉克取得胜利。
en: But Bush rejected this, and persists in speaking of victory in Iraq – though it is unclear what that now means.

zh: 可能是由于伊拉克将决定布什在历史上的留名，他不情愿在他的政策看上去是一场灾难的当口让步。
en: Perhaps because Iraq will define his legacy, he has proven reluctant to let go at a point when his policy appears to be a disaster.

zh: 现在，布什将向巴格达和安巴尔省增兵，并且试图平息不断上升的部落间内战和逊尼派起义。
en: Now Bush will increase the number of American troops in Baghdad and Anbar Province and try to stabilize both the rising sectarian civil war and the Sunni insurgency.

zh: 他撤换了对大幅增兵表示怀疑的阿比扎伊德和凯西两位将军，还调离了本应在伊拉克谈判一项政治协议的哈利勒扎德大使。
en: He has removed generals John Abizaid and George Casey, who were skeptical of a troop “surge,” and moved Ambassador Zalmay Khalizad, who was supposed to negotiate a political agreement in Iraq.

zh: 控制新国会的几位民主党国会议员不同意这一措施。
en: A number of the Democratic lawmakers who control the new Congress disagree with this approach.

zh: 某些民主党活动分子寻求立即撤军并且正在给国会施压要求减少对伊拉克战争的拨款，但是这不大可能。
en: Some Democratic activists seek an immediate withdrawal and are pressing for Congress to cut off funding for the war, but that is unlikely.

zh: 国会不大愿意被描绘成为不支持前线战士；尽管他们会予以批评，但是他们还是不会阻碍布什的计划。
en: Congress is reluctant to be portrayed as failing to support troops in the field; while they will criticize, they will not block Bush’s plan.

zh: 布什长期以来一直宣称在伊拉克的士兵人数是一项军事决定，而他只不过是听从了他的将军们的建议，但是，现在这明显不是如此。
en: Bush has long claimed that the number of troops in Iraq was a military decision and that he simply followed the advice of his generals, but now this is clearly not the case.

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，过去有一段时间如果大幅增兵局面可能就会大不相同。
en: Ironically, there may once have been a point at which a large increase in troops might have made a difference.

zh: 2003年4月和5月，民意调查表明大多数伊拉克人欢迎推翻萨达姆。
en: In April and May 2003, polls showed a majority of Iraqis welcoming the overthrow of Saddam Hussein.

zh: 但是布什当局却未能控制骚乱，解散了伊拉克军队并且听任安全局势恶化。
en: But the Bush administration failed to control rioting, disbanded the Iraqi army, and allowed the security situation to deteriorate.

zh: 在这种混乱局面下难以实施重建和发展工作，这些工作本可以改善伊拉克人的生活并吸引支持。
en: In such chaos, it was difficult to do the reconstruction and development work that could have made Iraqi lives better and attracted support.

zh: 让一名海军陆战队或陆军士兵在受到枪击的时候修建一所学校或者诊所，或者让伊拉克的温和派人士冒着生命危险在没有保护不受叛乱份子杀害的情况下支持美国士兵的举动是难以做到的。
en: It is not easy for a marine or soldier to construct a school or clinic when he is being fired upon, or for Iraqi moderates to risk their lives by being supportive when they have no protection against insurgents.

zh: 许多军事专业人士预料到了这一问题。
en: Many military professionals foresaw this problem.

zh: 美国陆军参谋长辛塞奇警告说，尽管有可能用国防部长拉姆斯菲尔德所使用的16万名士兵赢得战争，但是赢得和平却需要两倍的军力。
en: US Army Chief of Staff Eric Shinseki warned that although it would be possible to win the war with the 160,000 troops that Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld used, it would take double that number to win the peace.

zh: 但是由于拉姆斯菲尔德想要证明让美国军事战略脱胎换骨的道理，以及他的新保守派顾问们因意识形态一叶障目、扭曲了对伊拉克现实情况的评估，辛塞奇的建议遭到了拒绝。
en: But because Rumsfeld wanted to prove a point about transforming American military strategy, and his neo-conservative advisors had ideological blinders that distorted their appraisal of Iraqi reality, Shinseki’s advice was rejected.

zh: 国防部副部长沃尔福威茨在国会作证说，辛塞奇对士兵数量的估计“不着边际 ” 。
en: Deputy Secretary of Defense Paul Wolfowitz testified to Congress that Shinseki’s estimate of the number of troops required was “wildly off the mark.”

zh: 实际上，结果证明其实是拉姆斯菲尔德和沃尔福威茨的估计才不着边际。
en: In fact, it turned out that Rumsfeld and Wolfowitz were the ones wildly off the mark.

zh: 现在两个人都以不在任了，而布什则开始转向增兵。
en: Now both are gone, and Bush is turning to troop increases.

zh: 现在为时已晚，而且是杯水车薪。
en: Too little, too late.

zh: 有没有什么理由相信，过去的努力一无所获，现在增兵五个旅将会稳定巴格达的局势？
en: Is there any reason to believe that an additional five brigades will succeed in stabilizing Baghdad now when similar efforts have failed in the past?

zh: 美国新任驻伊拉克军事指挥官欧迪埃诺中将说，新的行动将对逊尼派和什叶派更加一视同仁，而且美国士兵将与伊拉克士兵共同驻扎在已经清理的地区。
en: The new American operational commander in Iraq, Lt. General Raymond Odierno, says that the new efforts will be more evenhanded among Sunni and Shiite neighborhoods, and American troops will stay alongside Iraqi troops in areas that have been cleared.

zh: 他希望，再经过几个月，他就可以将美国士兵撤到巴格达城边，并且把在首都执行警卫的任务交给伊拉克军队。
en: He hopes that with a few months, he can then withdraw American troops to the periphery of Baghdad and leave the policing of the capital to Iraqi forces.

zh: 但是这一局势的前提是伊拉克军队能够胜任工作，而且，依赖什叶派民兵支持的伊拉克总理马利基的政府能够扮演称职而又一视同仁的角色。
en: But this assumes that Iraqi forces are up to the task, and that Prime Minister Nouri al-Maliki’s government, which rests upon Shiite militia support, can play a competent and evenhanded role.

zh: 布什当局的官员们说，新的计划“并非是没有止境的承诺，我们对伊拉克政府提出了确实具体的要求和期望。
en: Bush administration officials argue that the new plan is “not an open-ended commitment: we are putting real, specific requirements and expectations on the Iraqi government.”

zh: ”政治标准包括省份选举以及改革消除复兴党政策，在萨达姆时期在伊拉克政府中工作的人为这一政策付出了巨大的代价。
en: Among the political benchmarks are provincial elections, enactment of an oil law that distributes oil wealth in a way that benefits the Sunnis, and reform of the de-Baathifcation policy, which has been so costly to those who worked in the Iraqi government under Saddam.

zh: 但是，做出政治妥协为时已晚，而马利基政府可能无法制定一个基础广泛的、没有教派偏见的政策。
en: But it may be too late for political compromise, and the Maliki government may not be capable of a broad non-sectarian policy.

zh: 如果布什新的军事计划是权宜之计，以便争取时间沿着伊拉克研究小组训练伊拉克军队以及逐步撤离美国军队的建议方向移动的话，那么，作为解决伊拉克问题的最后机会，它可能还是有点名堂。 但是，只有伴随该研究小组同时提出的外交行动建���才可能奏效。
en: If Bush’s new military plan is a temporary step to buy time to move in the direction of the Iraq Study Group’s proposals of training Iraqi forces and gradually withdrawing American forces, there may be something to be said for it as one last chance, but only if it is accompanied by the diplomatic advice that the study group also suggested.

zh: 在伊拉克建立民主为时已晚。
en: It is too late to create a democracy in Iraq.

zh: 大而言之，推翻萨达姆清除了一个构成威胁的独裁者，而将少数人的暴政代之以多数人的暴政。
en: At best, the overthrow of Saddam removed a threatening dictator, and substituted a tyranny of the majority for the tyranny of a minority.

zh: 但是就在教派间战斗中丧失的伊拉克人而言，代价却是巨大的。
en: But the price has been high in terms of Iraqi lives lost in sectarian fighting.

zh: 现在的目标就是地区稳定。
en: The goal now is regional stability.

zh: 伊拉克的各个邻国各有自己的私利，但是，没有一个国家会从伊拉克的混乱暴力中受益。 这将增强伊朗的影响力，鼓励让土耳其担忧的库尔德分裂主义，并且支持有可能渗入回到约旦、科威特、叙利亚以及沙特的逊尼派恐怖主义运动。
en: Each of Iraq’s neighbors has its own interests, but none will benefit from chaotic violence there, which would increase Iran’s influence, encourage Kurdish separatism to the worry of Turkey, and support Sunni terrorist movements that could spill back into Jordan, Kuwait, Syria, and Saudi Arabia.

zh: 美国无法让伊拉克处于险峻的境地，但是它也无力单独解决问题。
en: The US cannot leave Iraq precipitously, but neither can it solve the problem on its own.

zh: 建立伊拉克邻国组成的联络小组来帮助建立稳定和遏制的规则将是一个重要的步骤。
en: Establishing a contact group of Iraq’s neighbors to help set rules of the road for stabilization and containment will be an important step.

zh: 无法以军事解决手段来处理伊拉克问题。
en: Iraq is not susceptible to a military solution.

zh: 只有用更多的政治和外交手段才能够拯救美国的政策。
en: Only more politics and diplomacy can salvage US policy.

zh: 布什通往中东失败的路线图
en: Bush’s Road Map to Failure in the Middle East

zh: 经历了六年失败的中东政策之后，美国总统布什终于认识到，他所追求的该地区的温和派联盟只有通过巴以和平才能够形成。
en: Six long years of failed Middle East policies have finally brought President George W. Bush to recognize that the alliance of moderates in the region that he covets can only be forged through an Arab-Israeli peace.

zh: 确实，只有有效地解决巴以冲突他才有可能挽救美国在该地区的地位。
en: Indeed, only by effectively addressing the Israeli-Arab dispute can he possibly salvage America’s standing in the region.

zh: 但是，在一个在国内外均遭受失败的跛鸦子总统的政治生命中，美国最近开始的和谈回合太迟了；而且，它也准备不足，令人难以信服。
en: But the round of peacemaking that America has recently embarked upon not only comes too late in the political life of a lame-duck president who has been defeated at home and abroad; it is also ill-conceived and unconvincing.

zh: 国务卿莱斯坚决抵制让叙利亚参与进来并非明智的政策。
en: Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice’s adamant resistance to engage the Syrians is not exactly wise policy.

zh: 一个和平的地区秩序对于美国和以色列而言利益攸关，它们无法坚持拒绝考验叙利亚总统阿萨德当前的和平攻势。
en: The stakes for a peaceful regional order are too high for Israel and the United States to persist in refusing to put Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s current peace offensive to the test.

zh: 过去试图达成以色列和叙利亚之间和平的努力遭受挫折，其争议是有现实的解决办法的。 最近，前任以色列官员和与一个与叙利亚政权有密切联系的叙利亚人通过秘密管道举行了和平谈判正说明了这一点。
en: The bones of contention that wrecked previous attempts to reach an Israeli-Syrian peace have realistic solutions, as was shown by the back-channel peace talks recently held between an Israeli ex-official and a Syrian with close connections to the regime.

zh: 莱斯坚持遵循失败的巴以和解“路线图”同样也没有前途。
en: Nor is Rice’s insistence on sticking to the failed “road map” for an Israeli-Palestinian settlement promising.

zh: 双方都拖延和逃避该路线图，因而它也就胎死腹中。
en: Susceptible to procrastination and evasion by both sides, the road map was stillborn.

zh: 路线图发起几乎四年以后，没有任何一方鼓起必要的政治勇气来落实其主要条款。
en: Almost four years after it was first launched, neither of the parties has managed to muster the political will necessary to implement its primary provisions.

zh: 甚至，为第二阶段保留的“临时边境”的巴勒斯坦国这一古怪的想法对于巴勒斯坦人而言也没有吸引力。
en: Not even the bizarre idea, reserved for the second stage, of a Palestinian state with “temporary borders” is enticing for the Palestinians.

zh: 这一棘手的问题需要的是斩断，而不是去化解。
en: This Gordian knot needs to be cut, not untied.

zh: 在一个各方无力付出其内在的政治代价的没有明确答案和零碎的进程中，达成临时协议的观念现在已经完全过时了。
en: The concept of interim agreements has now become utterly obsolete, if only because the parties are incapable of paying the political price inherent in an open-ended, piecemeal process.

zh: 实际上，现在所需要的是对所有核心问题的一个全面的解决方案。
en: Instead, what is called for is a sweeping solution to all the core issues.

zh: 我们现在正处于我们所知道的和平进程的末尾。
en: We now stand at the end of the peace process as we have known it.

zh: 从现在起，我们的选择要么是极端、单边的撤军，正是它引发了加沙现在的战争，要么是一个必须和路线图联系在一起、并且由一个国际和平会议确认生效的全面的路线图。
en: From now on, our options will be a violent and unilateral disengagement, such as the one that ushered in the current war in Gaza, and a comprehensive peace plan that will have to be annexed to the road map and validated by an international peace conference.

zh: 只有这种“逆向工程 ” ， 也就是从末端开始并且从后向前进行工作，同时被严格的国际机制所合法化并且由其进行监督才有可能把以色列与巴勒斯坦和平的前景从废墟中解救出来。
en: Only such “reverse engineering,” starting at the end and working backward – and legitimized and monitored by strict international mechanisms – might yet save the prospects for an Israeli/Palestinian peace from ruin.

zh: 正如1992年马德里国际和平会议所发起的和平进程所表明的，中东地区的和平前景永远都需要国际社会的一致行动来挖掘和平的机会。
en: As the launch of the peace process at the 1991 Madrid International Peace Conference demonstrated, the prospects for peace in the Middle East always needed a concerted international push to exploit windows of opportunity.

zh: 中东地区的战争，尤其是像以色列最近与真主党的那些没有最终结果的战争，几乎总是会给重大的政治突破创造条件，因为它们使作战的各方认识到了能力的局限性。
en: Wars in the Middle East, especially those , such as Israel’s recent war against Hezbollah, that ended inconclusively, have almost invariably created the conditions for major political breakthroughs, because they taught the warring parties the limits of power.

zh: 中东深陷于呼唤和平转变和忠于末日审判人们之间的斗争，现在再一次呼吁国际社会努力来达成和平。
en: Trapped in a momentous struggle between the forces of peaceful change and those committed to Doomsday, the Middle East is once again calling for a major international effort at peacemaking.

zh: 2002年阿拉伯和平倡议的发起者同样也认识到，单单让以色列和巴勒斯坦达成和解也许并不充分，所以他们呼吁达成一个使整个地区化解冲突的方案。
en: The initiators of the 2002 Arab peace initiative likewise understood that a strictly bilateral approach might be inadequate, and instead called to regionalize the solution to the conflict.

zh: 各方之间缺乏相互信任，以及他们无法向对方作出哪怕最小的让步，更别说在执行他们的承诺的义务时不会刺激到第三方的利益，使得唯有达成一个国际和平的框架协议，才能走出这个危险的僵局的，过去和现在都是如此。
en: Loss of mutual trust between the parties, and their total incapacity to take even the smallest step towards each other, let alone to observe their commitments without prodding by third parties, made (and still makes) an international framework for peace the only way out of the dangerous impasse.

zh: 无法通过双边协议来解决冲突，也缘于巴勒斯坦和以色列有着机能障碍的政治体系。
en: The end of bilateralism stems also from the dysfunctional political systems of both Palestine and Israel.

zh: 今天，巴勒斯坦总统阿巴斯因为受到哈马斯的压制，而无法在政治上有更多的作为。
en: Today, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas is gasping for political air under the smothering control of Hamas.

zh: 最近在去以色列访问时，赖斯从他们的总理、外交部长、战略威胁部部长和国防部长那儿听到的是四个不同的和平方案。
en: On her recent trip to Israel, Rice had to listen to four different peace plans from the prime minister, the foreign minister, the minister for strategic threats, and the defense minister.

zh: 对于以色列人和巴勒斯坦人来说，要在内部达成和平也许要比在他们之间达成和平更艰难。
en: For both Israelis and Palestinians, achieving internal peace might prove as formidable a challenge as establishing peace with each other.

zh: 如果一个由路线图所引导的和平进程，其中的各方对于核心问题都持完全相反的观点的话，那么它注定会是失败的。
en: Any reformed peace process is doomed if it is guided by a road map within which, on the core issues, the parties have diametrically opposed views.

zh: 这并不意味着我们要推倒重来，因为化解阿拉伯与以色列的矛盾的解决方案体现在了已经被摆上桌面的主要和平计划中：即克林顿的和平参数，和在整个阿拉伯实现和平的倡议。
en: But there is no need to reinvent the wheel, because the solution to the Arab-Israeli conflict is embodied in the main peace plans that are already on the table: the Clinton peace parameters, and the all-Arab peace initiative.

zh: 在马德里会议的十五年之后，以色列和巴勒斯坦开始了正式的和平进程，各方都明白如果这个痛苦的进程要达成永久的和平的话，哪些事情是必须要做的。
en: Fifteen years after the Madrid Conference began a formal peace process between Israelis and Palestinians, the parties are wiser as to what is inevitable if this tortuous process is to lead to a permanent settlement.

zh: 1991年，他们开始提出要以“土地换和平 ” 。
en: In 1991, they convened on a platform of “land for peace.”

zh: 但是以色列人从来不相信他们必须归还所有的土地，而阿拉伯人也不认为他们也许将不得不提供“所有的和平 ” 。
en: But the Israelis never believed they would have to give back all the land, while the Arabs did not think they might have to offer “all the peace.”

zh: 今天，所有的人终于都明白了“土地”意味着什么，并且所有的人也终于都明白了“和平”意味着什么。
en: Today, at long last, everyone knows what is meant by “land,” and everyone knows what is meant by “peace.”

zh: 布什的又一次海湾灾难
en: Bush’s Second Gulf Disaster

zh: 布什总统要求美国人在可怕的全国性灾难降临之际切勿“弄权 ” 。
en: President Bush has asked that Americans not “play politics” at this moment of terrible national disaster.

zh: 但政府对飓风卡特里娜的处理却被很多人称作“国家的耻辱 ” ， 在这样的情况下，质问我们的国家领袖恰恰是民主自身提出的要求。
en: But asking hard questions of our nation’s leaders is exactly what democracy demands when the government’s response to Hurricane Katrina is widely viewed as “a national disgrace.”

zh: 卡特里娜来袭的前两天就已经发出了警报，但政府却延误了签发撤离指令的时间。
en: Katrina came with at least two days’ warning, but authorities waited to issue an evacuation order.

zh: 没有为无钱无车的人提供交通工具，住宿设施和对灾民的救护力量也严重不足。 没有人负责运送急需的给养或者维持秩序，用来解救被困群众的船只、直升飞机和其它工具也严重不足。
en: There was no transportation for people without cars or money, facilities to house and care for refugees were insufficient, there were no forces in place to deliver desperately needed supplies or to secure order, and there was nowhere near the number of boats, helicopters, and other craft necessary to rescue the stranded.

zh: 由于国民警卫队40%以上的军力驻扎在伊拉克，将军事人员派到重灾区的进展极为缓慢。
en: Hampered by a National Guard with 40% of its people in Iraq, the pace of getting military personnel to the hardest hit areas was inordinately slow.

zh: 灾难发生后，有整整4天时间根本找不到指挥和控制中心，结果导致无数平民受难乃至死亡。
en: For four days, there was simply no clear center of command and control. As a result, countless people suffered and died.

zh: 这些问题都是布什政府所推行政策的结果，这些政策大大削弱了负责应对灾难的主要政府机构，联邦紧急措施署（FEMA）的救灾能力。
en: Much of this failure is the result of the Bush administration’s policies, which effectively eroded the capacities of the Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA), the government agency primarily responsible for dealing with disasters.

zh: 由于反恐战争和政府职能私有化理念的困扰，政府全面削减了联邦紧急措施署预防长期灾害，或至少在预防无效的情况下减轻灾害后果的能力。
en: Obsessed with the war on terror as well as an ideology of privatizing the functions of government, the administration systematically sapped FEMA’s long-term ability to prevent disaster or at least cushion the blows when prevention is not possible.

zh: 布什政府裁减了联邦紧急措施署的规模，剥夺了该署原来在内阁的席位，将其转划给国土安全部管辖。
en: FEMA was downsized and downgraded from a cabinet position, then placed under the Department of Homeland Security.

zh: 该署灾前规划和准备等方面的职能已经彻底停止，其工作重点转向了与恐怖分子做斗争。
en: Its mission of disaster planning and preparation was dropped entirely, and its focus was altered to fight terrorists.

zh: 紧急措施署的领导人根本不具备灾害管理的任何经验。
en: Its leadership had no experience in disaster management.

zh: 上一任署长是布什在得克萨斯州的得力亲信，而现任署长曾担任过法官署署长，以及国际阿拉伯马协会干事，并在那里由于“管理失误”被要求辞职。
en: The past director was one of Bush’s Texas political cronies, and the current director’s qualifications include a stint as commissioner for judges and stewards with the International Arabian Horse Association, where he was asked to resign for “supervision failures.”

zh: 2001年以来，成百上千亿美元的救灾款项被国家安全和伊拉克战争所挪用。
en: Since 2001, billions of dollars were shifted from disaster relief to homeland security and the war in Iraq.

zh: 重要的减灾计划被砍掉，用作灾后重建的联邦资金也被削减了一半。
en: Key disaster mitigation programs were slashed and federal funding for post-disaster relief was cut in half.

zh: 美国陆军工程兵团在新奥尔良的建坝费用被侵吞，用于路易斯安娜州东南部城市水灾控制项目的专项资金也未能幸免。
en: The Army Corps of Engineers’ budget for levee construction in New Orleans was gutted, including funds specifically aimed at the Southeast Louisiana Urban Flood Control Project.

zh: 保护居民和财产的预防性措施根本没能落到实处，尽管联邦紧急措施署曾经在2001年亲自认定：袭击新奥尔良的飓风将是美国所面临的三大“最现实、最悲惨的灾难”之一。
en: Preventive measures to protect people and property were not carried out despite FEMA’s own conclusion in 2001 that a major hurricane hitting New Orleans was one of the three “likeliest, most catastrophic disasters facing this country.”

zh: 由于认定联邦紧急措施署属于“过度膨胀的福利项目”以及 “政府的职能不是提供服务 ” ， 布什任命的首位联邦紧急措施署署长制定了新的外包计划，开始了全面的私有化进程。
en: Believing FEMA to be an “oversized entitlement program” and that the “business of government is not to provide services,” Bush’s first FEMA director instituted new outsourcing requirements as part of a major privatization effort.

zh: 这一举措导致了人才的大量流失，很多经验丰富的联邦紧急措施署雇员纷纷转入了私有部门。
en: This provoked a brain drain as experienced FEMA personnel moved into the private sector

zh: 私有化也使贫困的州和社区更加不堪一击。
en: Privatization also left poorer states and poorer communities especially vulnerable.

zh: 由于资金枯竭，联邦项目以高价承包给市场上的私有企业，所以只有最富裕、政治上最重要的州和社区才能成功地获得用于交换服务的稀缺的联邦拨款。
en: As money dried up and federal programs were contracted out to private firms at higher rates, only the richest and politically most important states and communities could compete successfully for the scarce federal grants necessary to pay for services.

zh: 举例来讲，佛罗里达（比路易斯安娜多16张选举人票，而且由总统的兄弟管辖）拿到了湿地保护所需要的费用。
en: For example, Florida (with 16 more electoral votes than Louisiana and where the president’s brother governs) received its requested funding to protect its wetlands.

zh: 恰恰相反，更需要这笔款项的路易斯安娜（该州贫困率达到了令人惊讶的24 % ） 却没有拿到2004年用于减灾的资金。
en: By contrast, a more needy Louisiana (with its staggering 24% poverty rate) was denied its request for flood-mitigation funds in 2004.

zh: 由于路易斯安娜州自我保护的能力下降、救灾中心的运营也存在严重的隐患，政府反应能力不足和不必要的灾难破坏几乎不可避免¾而最终付出代价的是那些穷人。
en: With Louisiana’s ability to protect itself weakened and the center of disaster relief badly undermined, an inadequate government response and unnecessary destruction were almost inevitable – with the poor paying the price.

zh: 但除了经常性地有意挪用保护人类免受灾难的政策所必须的那些资源，本届政府还犯下了更为严重的错误。
en: But the failure of this administration runs deeper than its chronic and intentional diversion of resources away from the types of policies that keep people safe from disaster.

zh: 尽管有科学证据表明飓风越来越频繁、破坏力越来越大与气候变化有关，但布什政府却全面拒绝加入国际气候保护机制。
en: Despite scientific evidence demonstrating that the increased intensity and frequency of hurricanes is related to climate change, the Bush administration systematically rejects participation in international climate-protection regimes.

zh: 布什政府不但没有延续上届政府推行的禁止湿地开发的政策，反而将其彻底推翻。
en: Rather than continue a ban on wetlands development instituted by previous administrations, the Bush administration overturned it.

zh: 由于发展造成的侵蚀已经使墨西哥湾与陆地的距离比1965年拉近了20英里，从而使飓风能够积累更多的能量，也使狂风和波涛速度更快、破坏力更强。
en: Because development-provoked erosion has brought the Gulf of Mexico 20 miles closer to land than it was in 1965, hurricanes are able to retain more strength, and their winds and waves pack more speed and destructive power.

zh: 与此相似，湿地的丧失也威胁到了新奥尔良的大坝，因为建坝的基础是认定城市和墨西哥湾之间存在着40到50英里保护性沼泽的水面缓冲。
en: Similarly, loss of wetlands threatened New Orleans’ levees, which were built on the assumption that they would have 40 to 50 miles of protective swamp as buffer between the city and the Gulf of Mexico.

zh: 尽管所有的重要研究都显示保护新奥尔良需要推行大规模海岸恢复计划和加高防洪堤坝，政府却还是允许联��机构停止保护面积达2000万英亩的湿地，允许开发者抽干成千上万英亩湿地中蓄积的水份，并在2004年将用于彭恰尔特恩湖水土保护的资金削减了超过80 % 。
en: Despite every major study showing that a massive coastal restoration program and higher levees were needed to protect New Orleans, the administration permitted federal agencies to stop protecting 20 million acres of wetlands, allowed developers to drain thousands of acres and in 2004 cut funding for holding back the waters of Lake Pontchartrain by more than 80%.

zh: 新奥尔良就像被困在美国矿井中的一只金丝雀。
en: New Orleans is America’s canary in the mineshaft.

zh: 它现在必须向夺去政府力量、允许特权阶层自救而把穷人丢在屋顶的私有化理念发出挑战。
en: Ideologies of privatization that incapacitate effective government, permitting the privileged to save themselves while leaving the poor clinging to roofs, must now be challenged.

zh: 这次灾难令人齿冷地使我们想起政府不能保护人民的时候会发生什么悲剧，美国也必须要有人为此承担责任。
en: This disaster is a chilling reminder of what happens when government fails to protect its citizens, and it is imperative that Americans demand accountability.

zh: 没有完成任务的官员必须要被解职、推行加剧了卡特里娜飓风破坏力政策的当选高官也必须进行撤换。
en: Officials who did not do their jobs must be dismissed, and elected officials whose policies aggravated the devastation wrought by Katrina must be removed from office.

zh: 我们只有这么做，才能对死难人员和幸存者做出交代。
en: We owe this to the dead and to the survivors.

zh: 企业代表了什么？
en: Who Does Business Represent?

zh: 坎布里奇—企业联盟代表谁说话？
en: CAMBRIDGE – On whose behalf do business associations speak?

zh: 好吧，当然是企业。
en: Well, business.

zh: 但“企业”又是谁？
en: But who is “business”?

zh: 这个问题正变得日益紧迫起来，因为，尽管企业极大地改变了我们对自我的看法，但企业联盟还没有跟进。
en: It’s an increasingly urgent question, because while firms have radically changed how they think about themselves, business associations have yet to catch up.

zh: 而由此造成的滞后正在导致资本主义在许多国家失去合法性。
en: And the resulting lag is making capitalism less legitimate in many countries.

zh: 传统企业观 — — 不论是马克思还是米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman ） — —认为，企业是一个由资本家（股东）所有、代表其经营者的组织。
en: The traditional view of the firm – shared by both Karl Marx and Milton Friedman – is that it is an organization owned by capitalists (shareholders), on whose behalf it is run.

zh: 它雇用工人、购买其他投入品，为出钱的人创造最大化回报。
en: It hires workers and buys other inputs to maximize returns for those who put up the money.

zh: 按照弗里德曼的说法，企业的社会责任就是增加利润。
en: According to Friedman, the social responsibility of the firm is to increase profits.

zh: 一切不直接有利于股东的目标都是一种扭曲的税。
en: Any goal that does not directly benefit shareholders is just another distortionary tax.

zh: 但是什么让企业的所有相关利益方，以价值最大化的方式行动？
en: But what makes all of a firm’s stakeholders behave in a way that maximizes value?

zh: 事实上，现代企业很难形成一种员工、管理者、供应商、贷款人、分销商、服务提供商、客户和股东的合作共同体（collaborative community）感，让这些方面精诚合作，通过更好地满足客户的需要和趣味创造价值。
en: In fact, modern corporations struggle to create a sense of a collaborative community of employees, managers, suppliers, lenders, distributors, service providers, customers, and shareholders, all cooperating to create value by better satisfying customer needs and aspirations.

zh: 正因如此，美联航更希望它的员工能够对顾客更加宽容。
en: That’s why United Airlines would prefer that its employees treat passengers with grace.

zh: 正因如此，高盛不愿它的银行家协助和教唆大规模腐败。
en: Or why Goldman Sachs wishes its bankers would not aid and abet massive corruption.

zh: 苹果希望它的供应商人道地对待工人。
en: Apple expects its suppliers to treat their workers humanely.

zh: 联合健康保险公司（UnitedHealthcare）希望他的员工诚实地管理赔付。
en: UnitedHealthcare hopes its employees manage reimbursements honestly.

zh: 优步的股东担心高管的不当行为可能导致客户改换门庭和重要员工流失。
en: Uber’s shareholders worry that misbehavior by senior executives may cause customers to switch service providers and valuable workers to quit.

zh: 为了建立运转良好的合作性组织，人们进化出一种“我者”感，这种感觉就是历史学家兼政治学家本尼迪克特·安德森（Benedict Anderson）著名的“想象的共同体”的一部分。
en: To create functioning collaborative organizations, humans have evolved a sense of “us,” a feeling of belonging to what the historian and political scientist Benedict Anderson famously called an “imagined community.”

zh: 我对这类共同体效忠，我们为这类共同体的成就而骄傲，为它们的波折而痛苦，希望它们能一直取得成功。
en: We owe such communities our loyalty, and we feel pride in their achievements, pain in their stumbles, and hope for their continued success.

zh: 我们合作，不仅是因为这符合冷冰冰的金钱利益，也是因为各种道德感的综合效应 — — 忠诚、骄傲、罪恶、羞愧、愤怒、兴奋 — — 它让我们投入工作，也是我们结成团队的根源。
en: We cooperate not just because it is in our cold pecuniary interest to do so, but because a cocktail of moral sentiments – loyalty, pride, guilt, shame, outrage, glee – make us work and root for our team.

zh: 安德森的关注点在于民族主义的崛起。
en: Anderson’s focus was the rise of nationalism.

zh: 但企业试图通过用崇高而具体化的使命、愿景和价值观，建立一种类似的结盟感。
en: But corporations try to create an analogous sense of allegiance by specifying their mission, vision, and values in lofty terms.

zh: 2000年，当大通曼哈顿银行收购J.P. 摩根时，其管理层认为他们同时也买下了更改组织名称的权利。
en: When Chase Manhattan Bank bought J.P. Morgan in 2000, its managers assumed that they had also acquired the right to rename the organization.

zh: 他们很快就发现，在客户和员工眼中，J. P. 摩根的想象的共同体要比大通的想象的共同体高贵得多。
en: They soon discovered that J.P. Morgan was a more prestigious imagined community than Chase in the eyes of its customers and employees.

zh: 很容易理解，为何作为一个合作共同体的企业的愿景会在商学院和最成功的公司中脱颖而出。
en: It is easy to see why the vision of the firm as a collaborative community is winning out in business schools and the most successful companies.

zh: 一个原因是在大部分上市公司中，股东都是消极投资者，他们向足够地了解企业以决定是买入还出卖出；他们并不像卷入企业决策中。
en: One reason is that in most publicly traded corporations, shareholders are passive investors who just want to know enough about the firm to decide whether to buy or sell; they do not want to get involved in decisions.

zh: 与此同时，通过相关利益方建立结盟感和信任感有利于唱好大戏。
en: At the same time, creating a sense of allegiance and trust by stakeholders facilitates running the show.

zh: 狭隘地注重股东利益会驱使其他相关利益方也都只关注各自的狭隘利益，从而加剧冲突，增加交易成本。
en: A narrow focus on shareholders’ interests would impel all other stakeholders to pursue their narrow interests as well, increasing strife and transaction costs.

zh: CEO可能由股东选出的董事会成员任命，但他原本应该代表和动员作为企业成功的基石的相关利益方网络。
en: The CEO may be appointed by a board of directors whose members are chosen by the shareholders, but he or she is supposed to represent and motivate the network of stakeholders that underpin the corporation’s success.

zh: 哈佛理事会的成员任命了谁来当我的雇主的校长，但他们的人选一定要能够让我们这些相关利益方感到骄傲。
en: The Fellows of the Harvard Corporation appoint my employer’s president, but they try to choose someone who will make us stakeholders proud.

zh: 但企业的社会和政治面貌更加接近于弗里德曼的诠释。
en: And yet the social and political representation of business more closely resembles Friedman’s archetype.

zh: 企业联盟常常完全只顾资本家所有者的狭隘利益。
en: Business associations too frequently speak only on behalf of the narrow interest of the capitalist owners.

zh: 不管什么国家 — — 阿根廷、 智利、 哥伦比亚 、法国、墨西哥、英国都是如此 — — 企业组织让雇主，而不是相关利益方网络，拥有了政治话语权。
en: In country after country – whether in Argentina, Chile, Colombia, France, Mexico, or the United Kingdom – business organizations give political voice to employers, not to the network of stakeholders.

zh: 企业的政治面貌本身，如果考虑周密的话，对社会的价值十分巨大。
en: Political representation of business per se, if well conceived, is invaluable for society.

zh: 毕竟，经济进步需要市场的看不见的手和国家的看得见的手精诚合作。
en: After all, economic progress requires that the invisible hand of the market be coordinated with the visible hand of the state.

zh: 手机行业需要以频段的产权制度为前提。
en: The cellphone industry requires the creation of property rights on the spectrum.

zh: 房地产行业需要说服客户它们所建造的公寓不会被烧毁。
en: The real estate industry needs to convince customers that their apartment building will not burn down.

zh: IT行业得益于儿童从学校就开始学习编程。
en: The IT industry would benefit if kids learned to code in school.

zh: 这些和其他许多例子表明，如果政府能提供多样化的、相对具体的、与时俱进的正确的公共品组合，企业可以变得更加高效。
en: As these and many other examples show, business can become more efficient if governments provide the right combination of a diverse, relatively specific, and evolving set of public goods.

zh: 企业联盟需要与政府互动，以认清哪些公共品可以让经济生态系统更加有利于生产，从而为相关利益方行创造更大的价值。
en: Business associations need to interact with government in order to identify those public goods that would make economic ecosystems more productive, so that they can create more value for stakeholders.

zh: 但这一任务有一个障碍，即人们认为坐在谈判桌上的，无不代表着雇主的狭隘利益，这从他们的政策日程 — — 常常关注如何将税收负担转移给他人 — — 就可以显然地看出来。
en: But that task is burdened by the perception that those at the table are there to represent employers’ narrow interests, as their policy agenda – often focused on shifting the burden of taxation onto others – clearly suggests.

zh: 结果，政府常常要求他们在工会在场的情况下才能谈判 — — 从而让员工也可以发出声音。
en: As a consequence, governments often require that they meet in the presence of labor associations, so that employees also get a voice.

zh: 这一三方谈判的设计大大改变了对话的性质，使其关注劳工和其他可以在企业内部网络解决的分配问题，而如何提供提高生产率、进而令所有相关利益方都受益的公共品的问题，却被搁置在一旁。
en: Setting the table in this tripartite way dramatically changes the nature of the conversation, by focusing it on labor and other distributive issues that could be resolved within the business network, at the expense of addressing how to supply productivity-enhancing public goods that could benefit all stakeholders.

zh: 而之所会这样，原因是企业改变的转变尚未反映在企业联盟的应有概念中。
en: And it happens because the transformation in the conception of what a business is has yet to be reflected in the conception of what a business association should be.

zh: 自然地，这一滞后导致了与其他相关利益方的产生，后者必须与各自的组织应对这一情况。
en: Naturally, this lag leads to confrontation with other stakeholders, who must respond with their respective organizations.

zh: 但如果企业联盟可以转变自身，让它们代表作为企业的实际基础的相关利益方网络，并让它们发出声音，就可以为建立更加合作、更加包容的社会做出巨大贡献。
en: But if business associations could transform themselves so that they represented and gave voice to the network of stakeholders on which businesses are actually built, they could contribute enormously to the creation of a much more collaborative and inclusive society.

zh: 俄罗斯一切照旧？
en: Business as Usual with Russia?

zh: 柏林 — — 尽管今年8月俄罗斯入侵格鲁吉亚造成的紧张局势仍在持续，欧盟还是将就一项新的伙伴与合作协议（PCA）重新开启与俄罗斯的对话。
en: BERLIN – Despite continuing tensions over Russia’s invasion of Georgia this August, the European Union will reopen talks with Russia on a new Partnership and Cooperation Agreement (PCA).

zh: PCA是磋商贸易、司法和人权等领域具体协议的法律框架。
en: A PCA establishes a legal framework for negotiating specific agreements in such areas as trade, justice, and human rights.

zh: 当前的对话旨在替换1997年就已过期、但双方同意在签订新的协定之前继续有效的PCA。
en: The current talks aim to replace the expired 1997 PCA, which remains in force by mutual consent pending a new accord.

zh: 在9月1日的紧急会议上，欧盟领导人拒绝继续PCA对话，除非俄罗斯将作战部队从格鲁吉亚分裂分子控制的阿布哈希亚和南奥塞梯地区撤出。
en: At an emergency meeting on September 1, EU leaders refused to continue the PCA talks until Russia removed its combat units from the Georgian separatist regions of Abkhazia and South Ossetia.

zh: 欧盟27国政府的首脑同样将俄罗斯承认这两个分裂地区的独立看作是“不可接受的 ” 。
en: The heads of the 27 EU governments also characterized the Kremlin’s decision to recognize the independence of the two breakaway regions as “unacceptable.”

zh: 之后，欧盟各国政府降低了条件，声称俄罗斯只要从这两个地区以外的格鲁吉亚领土上撤军就够了，可以继续有关PCA、能源安全和其他问题的对话。
en: Since then, EU governments have moderated their conditions, describing a simple Russian military withdrawal from Georgian territories outside the two regions as sufficient to resume a dialogue on the PCA, energy security, and other issues.

zh: 欧盟做出这个决定的时候，北约也在格鲁吉亚冲突导致双方中断了许多联合项目之后试图重新开始与俄罗斯的约定。 9月18日，北约秘书长谢佛尔在伦敦皇家联合军种研究所演讲。
en: The EU decision comes at a time when NATO has also sought to renew its engagement with Russia after the Georgia conflict led both parties to suspend many joint programs.

zh: 他说，尽管在格鲁吉亚问题上有分歧，但俄罗斯和北约应该“在我们有着相同利益的所有领域”合作。 他特别谈到了在阿富汗的长期合作。
en: In a speech on September 18 at the Royal United Services Institute in London, NATO Secretary General Jaap de Hoop Scheffer argued that, despite differences over Georgia, Russia and the alliance should cooperate “wherever our interests converge.”

zh: 在那里，俄罗斯向北约领导的国际安全救援部队提供后勤支持。 他说这“清楚地表明，在其他领域，共同的利益可以超越分歧 ” 。
en: He specifically cited continued cooperation in Afghanistan, where Russia is providing logistical support for the NATO-led International Security Assistance Force, as “a clear indication that common interests can transcend disagreements in other areas.”

zh: 为了不显得被俄罗斯强行分裂格鲁吉亚的行为所恐吓，北约各国政府纷纷公开重申对格鲁吉亚领土完整和该国加入北约的愿望的支持。
en: In order not to appear intimidated by Russia’s forceful dismemberment of Georgia, NATO governments have publicly reaffirmed their support for Georgia’s territorial integrity and the country’s desire to join NATO eventually.

zh: 然而私下里，许多北约官员都曾告诉媒体，他们比以前更不情愿加深北约与格鲁吉亚的关系，害怕陷进又一场俄罗斯和格鲁吉亚的战争。
en: In private, however, many allied officials have told the media that they are even less inclined than they previously were to deepen NATO’s ties with Georgia, given the risks of becoming entrapped in another Russian-Georgian war.

zh: 当前，大多数西方政府似乎都已决定集中帮助格鲁吉亚的经济从战争中恢复过来，而不是直接惩罚俄罗斯。
en: At present, it seems most Western governments have decided to concentrate on helping Georgia recover economically from the war rather than on punishing Russia directly.

zh: 在上个月的布鲁塞尔国际捐助者会议上，他们承诺提供数十亿美元的重建援助。
en: At last month’s International Donors’ Conference in Brussels, they pledged billions of dollars of reconstruction aid.

zh: 欧盟还在考虑与格鲁吉亚协商建立一个自由贸易区，以及放宽对格鲁吉亚公民的签证限制。
en: The EU is also considering negotiating a free-trade area with Georgia and relaxing visa rules for Georgian citizens.

zh: 北约成立了一个专门的北约－格鲁吉亚委员会，帮助协调北约对格鲁吉亚战后重建的援助。
en: NATO has established a special NATO-Georgian Commission to help coordinate allied support for Georgia’s post-conflict reconstruction.

zh: 尽管如此，俄罗斯和西方的官员仍在美国计划在波兰和捷克共和国部署弹道导弹防御系统的问题上争吵不休。
en: Even so, Russian and Western officials continue to spar over American plans to deploy ballistic missile defense systems in Poland and the Czech Republic.

zh: 11月，梅德韦杰夫总统在对俄罗斯国家杜马的国情咨文演说中警告，俄罗斯会在加里宁格勒的波罗的海港口上部署短程的伊斯坎德尔导弹 ， “ 在必要时抗衡欧洲的反弹道导弹系统 ” 。
en: In his speech in November to the Russian parliament on the state of nation, President Dmitry Medvedev warned that Russia would deploy short-range Iskander missiles in the Baltic Sea port of Kaliningrad “to neutralize if necessary the anti-ballistic missile system in Europe.”

zh: 梅德韦杰夫还说，俄罗斯的电子设备会干扰美国的系统，而且俄罗斯军方还在准备其他的对策。
en: Medvedev added that Russian electronic equipment would jam the American systems and that the Russian military was preparing additional countermeasures.

zh: 北约和欧盟领导人谴责了这些威胁，但这些谴责在美国人民刚刚选出了一位有意改善美俄关系的新总统之后一天做出，显得尤其无稽。
en: NATO and EU leaders denounced the threats, which seemed especially gratuitous coming one day after the American people had elected a new President who has expressed interest in improving relations with Russia.

zh: 俄罗斯政府还试图展示该国不断增长的军事潜力。
en: Russia’s government has also sought to showcase its growing military potential.

zh: 9月和10月，该国的战略部队举行了苏联解体以来规模最大的核武器相关演习。
en: In September and October, the country’s strategic forces engaged in their largest nuclear weapons-related exercises since the Soviet Union’s demise.

zh: 10月12日，俄罗斯海军联合战略火箭部队进行了一场十分协调的演习，演习期间还从不同的地面和潜艇发射平台试射了三个远程弹道导弹，进行了同时发射试验。
en: On October 12, the Russian Navy joined with the Strategic Rocket Forces to conduct a well-integrated exercise involving near-simultaneous testing of three long-range ballistic missiles from separate ground and submarine launch platforms.

zh: 上个月，普京总理又宣布俄罗斯国防开支还将再次增加。
en: Last month, Prime Minister Vladimir Putin also announced yet another increase in Russian defense spending.

zh: 近年来，俄罗斯军队开支以两位数的增幅上升。
en: Russian military expenditures have increased by double-digit figures in recent years.

zh: 今年，俄军方将花掉400亿美元以上。
en: This year, the Russian military will spend over $40 billion.

zh: 2009年，这个数字可能超过500亿美元。
en: The figure for 2009 could exceed $50 billion.

zh: 表面上看起来虽然很惊人，但这样的增长掩饰了几个关键问题。
en: Although superficially impressive, this surge obscures several key issues.

zh: 军事开支的增加大部分仅仅是为了补偿俄罗斯国防部门内极高的通胀压力。
en: Much of the growth merely compensates for the exceptionally high inflationary pressures in Russia’s defense sector.

zh: 另外，近年来的预算增长需要很多年才能形成新的设备。
en: In addition, it will take years for the recent budget increases to translate into new equipment.

zh: 尽管俄罗斯的设计者仍有能力开发一流的武器，但俄罗斯的国防公司还没有从苏联军事工业解体的创伤中恢复过来，仍不能大批量地制造最先进的系统。
en: Although Russian designers can still develop first-class weapons, Russia’s defense companies, which have yet to recover from the traumatic disintegration of the Soviet military-industrial complex, remain unable to manufacture large numbers of the most advanced systems.

zh: 俄罗斯的军方还必须和国外的客户争夺仅有的军用飞机、坦克和其他精密武器。
en: Russia’s military also must compete with foreign customers for those few warplanes, tanks, and other sophisticated weapons that are produced.

zh: 俄罗斯军事复兴的长期可持续性也不确定。
en: The long-term sustainability of Russia’s military revival is also unclear.

zh: 俄政府仍依靠出口石油和天然气赚钱，但这些商品的价格正在急剧下跌。
en: Russia’s government remains dependent on oil and gas exports for revenue, but the prices of these commodities are falling sharply.

zh: 不同于苏联，俄罗斯与世界经济的关系密不可分，因此该国在当前的全球金融危机面前十分脆弱。
en: Unlike the Soviet Union, Russia is tightly integrated into the world economy, rendering the country vulnerable to the current global financial crisis.

zh: 不久前梅德韦杰夫警告说，俄罗斯的“军事工业联合体开始受到信用问题的影响 ” ， 使人愈加担心上世纪90年代困扰国防部门的支付危机再次发生。
en: Medvedev recently warned that Russia’s “military-industrial complex is starting to be affected by credit problems,” stoking fears of a return to the paralyzing payment crises that plagued the defense sector during the 1990’s.

zh: 俄罗斯悬而未决的人口问题同样使武装部队难以成为完全职业化的军队，而不用依赖征募来的士气低落的士兵。
en: Russia’s continuing demographic problems will also make it difficult for the armed forces to become a fully professional military, one that does not depend on poorly motivated conscripts.

zh: 虽然表面上梅德韦杰夫和普京采取了可行的权力共享措施，但俄罗斯发育不良的政治制度缺乏根除腐败和其他低效因素的能力。
en: Although Medvedev and Putin have apparently adopted a viable power-sharing arrangement, Russia’s stunted political institutions lack the capacity to root out corruption and other inefficiencies.

zh: 国家保障部门的全面改革仍未提上政治议程。
en: Comprehensive security-sector reform remains off the political agenda.

zh: 就算在高优先级的国防部门内，可能也有三分之一的政府开支被浪费或贪污 — — 这种情况决不利于俄罗斯实现其极大的权力野心。
en: Even in the high-priority defense sector, perhaps one-third of government spending is wasted or stolen – a condition that is not conducive to realizing Russia’s great power ambitions.

zh: 从商业角度论可持续性
en: The Business Case for Sustainability

zh: 伯克利—越来越多的全球投资者开始寻找在市场回报率之外还能带来环境和社会效益的投资机会。
en: BERKELEY – Investors worldwide are increasingly seeking investment opportunities that promise to bring environmental and social benefits, in addition to market rates of return.

zh: 如果这一趋势持续下去，随着环境和社会目标的推进强化一项投资的价值，将十分有利于已经在全球企业中间风生水起的可持续性承诺。
en: If this trend continues, with the advancement of environmental or social objectives enhancing an investment’s value, it will strengthen the commitment to sustainability that is already gaining momentum among businesses around the world.

zh: 去年，美国专业管理的资产中有六分之一（大约6.6万亿美元）配置给了某种形式的可持续投资，特别是上市公司。
en: Last year, one out of every six dollars of assets under professional management in the United States – a total of $6.6 trillion – was allocated toward some form of sustainable investment, especially public equities.

zh: 大约1,260家公司 — — 它们管理着价值45万亿美元的资产 — — 签署了联合国的“负责任的投资原则 ” 。 该原则认为环境、社会和治理（ESG）等因素 — — 因此公司和市场的长期健康和稳定亦然 — — 是投资者所要考虑的关键问题。
en: Some 1,260 companies, managing $45 trillion worth of assets, are signatories of the United Nations’ “principles for responsible investment,” which recognize environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors – and thus the long-term health and stability of companies and markets – as critical to investors.

zh: 加州公务员退休基金（CalPERS）是全世界最大机构投资者之一，它也是签署者之一，但它更进一步，将要求所有投资经理认识ESG因素并将其纳入投资决策中 — — 这是一项可能改变资本市场的举措。
en: One signatory, CalPERS, one of the world’s largest institutional investors, has gone a step further: it will require all of its investment managers to identify and integrate ESG factors into their decisions – a bold move that could transform capital markets.

zh: 发布可持续性报告的公司从20世纪90年代初的不到30家增加到2014年的7,000多家。
en: The number of companies issuing sustainability reports has grown from fewer than 30 in the early 1990s to more than 7,000 in 2014.

zh: 而在最新的摩根士丹利调查中，71%的受访者表示对可持续投资感兴趣。
en: And, in a recent Morgan Stanley survey, 71% of respondents stated that they are interested in sustainable investing.

zh: 平心而论，阻挠将ESG标准纳入投资决策的一个主要障碍仍然存在：许多投资者 — — 包括摩根士丹利调查的54%的受访者 — — 认为这样做可能降低财务回报率。
en: To be sure, a major barrier to incorporating ESG criteria into investment decisions remains: many investors – including 54% of the respondents in the Morgan Stanley survey – believe that doing so could lower the financial rate of return.

zh: 但越来越多的证据表明并非如此，一些最新报告表明，可持续投资和传统投资表现一样出色，甚至更胜一筹。
en: But there is mounting evidence that this is not the case, with several recent studies indicating that sustainable investments do as well as – or even outperform – traditional investments.

zh: 一项2012年的讨论研究分析了两组行业、规模、财务表现和增长前景相近的公司，结果发现“高可持续性组”的公司股票表现卓著。
en: A seminal 2012 study that analyzed two groups of companies – similar in terms of industry, size, financial performance, and growth prospects – found that those in the “high sustainability group” had superior share-price performance.

zh: 摩根士丹利可持续投资研究所（Institute for Sustainable Investing）的一份最新研究分析了美国10,228家开放式共同基金和2,874个独立管理账户的表现，发现可持续投资通常能够达到可比传统投资相同考察期内的中位回报，并且常常表现更好。
en: And a new study by Morgan Stanley’s Institute for Sustainable Investing, which analyzed the performance of 10,228 open-ended mutual funds and 2,874 separately managed accounts in the US, found that sustainable investments usually met – and often exceeded – the median returns of comparable traditional investments for the periods examined.

zh: 许多ESG因素在评估可持续投资选项中起作用。
en: Many ESG factors come into play when evaluating sustainable investment options.

zh: 比如，代际基金会（Generation Foundation）是代际投资管理公司（我是其顾问委员会成员）的智库，该基金会归纳了与可持续性有关的17项环境因素，16项社会因素和12项治理因素
en: For example, the Generation Foundation – the think tank of Generation Investment Management (on whose advisory board I serve) – identifies 17 environmental factors, 16 social factors, and 12 governance factors relevant to sustainability.

zh: 挑战在于区分对公司表现有和没有实质（material）影响的ESG因素。
en: The challenge is to distinguish between the ESG factors that have a material influence on company performance and those that do not.

zh: 但目前的公司报告数据不足以让投资者做出这一区分。
en: But the data that companies currently report are inadequate to enable investors to make this distinction.

zh: 非营利组织可持续性会计准则委员会（Sustainability Accounting Standards Board，SASB）正在尝试通过开发80个行业的符合美国证券和交易委员会（Security and Exchange Commission）合规规则的实质可持续性会计准则。
en: The non-profit Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) is attempting to change that by developing material sustainability accounting standards for 80 industries, consistent with the US Security and Exchange Commission’s compliance regulations.

zh: 超过2,800家机构 — — 包括市值总和高达11万亿美元的公司和资产管理规模高达234亿美元的投资者 — — 参与了SASB流程。
en: More than 2,800 participants – including companies with market capitalization totaling $11 trillion and investors with $23.4 trillion in assets under management – have been involved in the SASB process.

zh: 一份新研究 — — 目前为止结论最强的研究 — — 使用SASB对45个行业的建议标准和其他指标，发现在实质可持续性因素方面表现出色的公司经营表现更好，风险更低，股东回报也显著高于表现不佳的公司。
en: Using the SASB’s proposed standards for 45 industries, as well as other metrics, a new study – the most definitive so far – has found that companies that perform well on material sustainability factors have better operational performance, are less risky, and earn significantly higher shareholder returns than companies that perform poorly.

zh: 类似地，摩根士丹利最近采取了新框架评估29个行业的公司，该框架包括了带来实质风险或机会的ESG因素。
en: Similarly, a new framework recently proposed by Morgan Stanley for valuations of companies in 29 industries includes ESG factors that pose material risks or opportunities.

zh: 传统的估值方法完全根据公司怎样配置金融资本获取回报来进行，而新框架考虑如何配置自然、人力和社会资本以及治理行为的透明度。
en: Whereas a company is traditionally valued based exclusively on how it deploys financial capital to generate returns, the new framework incorporates how it deploys natural, human, and social capital, as well as the transparency of its governance practices.

zh: 这一新的公司估值方法反映了一个观点：最成功的公司将是那些负责任地配置所有四类资本的公司。
en: This new approach to company valuation reflects the view that the most successful companies will be those that deploy all four kinds of capital responsibly.

zh: 实质ESG因素可以通过多种渠道影响公司的财务表现和股东回报。
en: Material ESG factors can affect a company’s financial performance and shareholder returns through several channels.

zh: 比如，更有效地使用能源和资源��以降低成本；更好地管理人力资源能刺激生产率；更严格的安全、健康和环境规则可以降低严重事故风险；而吸引消费者的新的绿色或公平交易产品可以增加收入。
en: For example, more efficient energy and resource use can lower costs; better management of human talent can boost productivity; stricter safety, health, and environmental rules can reduce the risk of serious accidents; and new green or fair-trade products that appeal to consumers can increase revenues.

zh: 以改进数据中心的能源效率的投资为例。 数据中心的能源消耗量是普通商业建筑的10—20倍，因此会排放出大量温室气体。
en: Consider investments that improve the energy efficiency of data centers, which use 10-20 times more energy than average commercial buildings, and thus are responsible for considerable greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 关于数据中心规格的决定对于管理成本、获得可靠的能源和水供给以及降低名誉风险（特别是在全球监管日益聚焦于气候变化的情况下）至关重要。
en: Decisions about data-center specifications are important for managing costs, obtaining a reliable supply of energy and water, and lowering reputational risks, particularly given the increasing global regulatory focus on climate change.

zh: 谷歌数据中心的建设比普通数据中心节能50 % ， 这给该公司带来了可观的节约。
en: Google’s construction of data centers that use 50% of the energy of an average data center has brought it considerable savings.

zh: 类似的成功故事在各行各业都有。
en: Similar success stories have played out across sectors.

zh: 自2011年以来，美国化学公司杜邦公司投资8.79亿美元用于包括定量环境效益分析在内的产品研发；据其报告，每年降低温室气体排放的产品给该公司带来20亿美元收入，而可再生资源（如风能和太阳能）更是能够带来118亿美元收入。
en: Since 2011, the US chemical company DuPont has invested $879 million in research and development of products with quantifiable environmental benefits; it has recorded $2 billion in annual revenue from products that reduce greenhouse-gas emissions, and an additional $11.8 billion in revenue from renewable resources like wind and solar power.

zh: 类似地，跨国消费品公司宝洁公司报告，2007—2012年“可持续创新产品”销售高达520亿美元。
en: Likewise, the multinational consumer goods company Procter and Gamble reported $52 billion in sales of “sustainable innovation products” from 2007 to 2012.

zh: 这相当于同一时期该公司总销售额的11%左右。
en: That is roughly 11% of the company’s total sales over that period.

zh: 有理由认为，公司可以通过投资于改进实质可持续性增加股东价值。
en: There are good reasons to believe that, by investing in improving material sustainability, companies can increase shareholder value.

zh: 事实上，如果一家公司意欲实现对其投资者的委托责任，它就别无选择，必须超越财务回报，考虑可能对其长期表现形成实质影响的ESG因素。
en: In fact, if a company is to fulfill its fiduciary responsibility to its investors, it has little choice but to go beyond financial returns to incorporate ESG factors that are likely to have a material impact on its performance over time.

zh: 这正是能够驱使世界走向可持续未来的激励。
en: This is precisely the kind of incentive that could propel the world toward a more sustainable future.

zh: 改善全球健康的生意
en: The Business of Improving Global Health

zh: 苏黎世—千年发展目标（MDG）在推动人类健康方面取得了巨大的成功，要继续成功下啊去很难。
en: ZURICH – The dramatic success of the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) in driving advances in human health will be a hard act to follow.

zh: 在仅仅15年里，儿童死亡率下降了一半，疟疾致死率下降了60 % 。
en: In just 15 years, child mortality was nearly halved, and malaria deaths declined by 60%.

zh: 如今，全世界近1,500万人能获得艾滋病治疗，帮助他们继续成为有生产力的社会成员，而在2000年MDG启动时，这一数字只有10,000人。
en: Today nearly 15 million people worldwide receive treatment for AIDS, helping them continue to be productive members of society, compared to only about 10,000 people in 2000, when the MDGs were launched.

zh: 刚刚被联合国采纳、指导未来15年全球发展措施的可持续发展目标（SDG）是否能够复制MDG的成功？
en: Can the new Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), just adopted by the United Nations to guide global development efforts for the next 15 years, replicate the MDGs’ success?

zh: MDG的漂亮历史记录显然让我们感到大有希望。
en: The strong track record of the MDGs certainly provides grounds for hope.

zh: 但新的健康相关目标比此前的目标更广泛、更宏大。
en: But the new health-related goals are broader and more ambitious than before.

zh: 而从诸多角度看，公共卫生状况也比2000年更具挑战性。
en: And the public-health situation is in many ways more challenging than in 2000.

zh: 新的SDG制定了一个崇高的目标（goal ） ： 历史上第一次，世界领导人承诺要减少因癌症、心脏病和糖尿病等慢性疾病所引起的过早死亡。
en: The new SDGs set a lofty goal: for the first time, world leaders have vowed to reduce premature deaths caused by chronic illnesses such as cancer, heart disease, and diabetes.

zh: 在人口快速增长和快速老龄化的当下，这是一个艰难的任务。
en: This is a tall order at a time of rapid population growth and rapid aging.

zh: 慢性病在两种情况中都是致死主因 — — 并且占比日益提高。
en: Chronic diseases are the main – and growing – cause of death in developed and developing countries alike.

zh: 而超过二十亿人仍然无法得到基本药物。
en: And more than two billion people still lack access to essential medicines.

zh: 要实现这些小目标（target ） ， 我们必须找出创造性新办法解决世界最大的健康挑战。
en: To achieve the new targets, we must find creative new ways to address the world’s biggest health challenges.

zh: 最重要的是，我们必须开发新的商业模式，让社会更好地利用知识、创造力和私人企业的推动力改善公共卫生。
en: Above all, we must develop new business models that allow society to better harness the know-how, creativity, and drive of private enterprises to help improve public health.

zh: 公司共同承担着实现这些新目标的责任，但它们也需要来自政府和其他组织的支持才能保证积极影响最大化。
en: Companies share the responsibility for meeting these new goals, but they also need support from governments and other organizations to ensure the greatest positive impact.

zh: 人口挑战十分紧迫。
en: The demographic challenge is daunting.

zh: 在过去12年中，十亿人加入了人类大军。
en: A billion people joined the human race in just the last 12 years.

zh: 据联合国估计，2030年将再新增十亿人，让全球人口达到85亿人。
en: Another billion or so will join by 2030, bringing the world’s population to 8.5 billion, according to UN estimates.

zh: 其中增长最快人群为60以上人群，预计到2030年，这一人群人数将增加5亿，达到14亿人。
en: The fastest-growing segment of the population is people over 60, a group that is expected to grow by 500 million people, to 1.4 billion, in 2030.

zh: 年长者更容易罹患慢性病，而如今慢性病导致了63%的全球死亡总人数。
en: Older people are more likely to develop chronic illnesses, which now account for 63% of all deaths worldwide.

zh: 世界卫生组织预测，未来十年这一比例将达到70 % ， 其中大部分死亡发生在发展中国家。
en: The World Health Organization predicts that the proportion will reach 70% in the next ten years, with most of the deaths occurring in developing countries.

zh: 在中低收入国家，每年大约有2,800万人死于慢性病，占全球慢性病致死总人数的四分之三左右。
en: Some 28 million people die from chronic diseases in low- and middle-income countries each year, accounting for roughly three-quarters of all deaths caused by chronic disease globally.

zh: 发展各国卫生体系已经捉襟见肘。
en: Developing countries’ health systems are already stretched.

zh: 它们常常缺少药物、资源和知识治疗慢性病患，这些病人可能需要几年乃至几十年的治疗。
en: They often lack medicines, resources, and know-how to treat chronically ill patients, who may require years or decades of treatment.

zh: 比如，埃塞俄比亚有9,700万人，但只有四名肿瘤科医生。
en: For example, there are only four oncologists in Ethiopia, a country of some 97 million people.

zh: 此外，许多发展中国家面临加倍的疾病负担，必须同时与疟疾、结核病和艾滋病等传染病抗争。
en: Moreover, many developing countries face a double disease burden and must wage a simultaneous battle against infectious diseases such as malaria, tuberculosis, and HIV/AIDS.

zh: 显然，我们需要更多的资源应对这些挑战。
en: Clearly, more resources will be needed to tackle these challenges.

zh: 但在全球金融危机面前，来自政府和私人赞助者的发展援助徘徊在每年350亿美元左右，而在2000—2010年期间，这一数字每年都能增加11%以上。
en: But in the wake of the global financial crisis, development assistance for health from governments and private donors has plateaued at about $35 billion annually, after growing more than 11% per year from 2000-2010.

zh: 而这些援助资金中只有不到2%被用于遏制慢性病。
en: And less than 2% of that money was directed at combatting chronic diseases.

zh: 慢性病的长期性，以及为发展中世界病患提供更好治疗的复杂性，需要我们找到创新性方案。
en: The long-term nature of chronic diseases, and the complexity of providing better treatment for patients in the developing world, calls for innovative solutions.

zh: 公司有能力，也有全球规模，未来能够在解决公共卫生挑战、实现SDG子目标（objective）方面扮演更重要的角色。
en: Companies possess the capabilities and the global scale to play a stronger future role in addressing public-health challenges and achieving the objectives of the SDGs.

zh: 一些公司正在探索新的“社会企业”方法，该方法让它们满足发展中世界的需要，同时又能覆盖成本甚至略有盈利。
en: Some corporations are beginning to explore new “social business” approaches that will allow them to meet the needs of people and society in the developing world, while at the same time covering their costs, or even making a small profit.

zh: 赚钱的社会事业可以自我维持，并拥有成长潜力，惠及越来越多的人。
en: Moneymaking social ventures are self-sustaining and have the potential to grow, bringing benefits to more and more people.

zh: 它们是慈善事业强大的潜在力量，而如今慈善事业是公共卫生进步的基础。
en: They are a potentially powerful complement to philanthropy, which has underpinned much recent progress in public health.

zh: 比如，我的公司正在推出一个由15中基本药物组成的组合，用于治疗包括糖尿病、呼吸道疾病和乳腺癌在内的疾病。
en: My company, for example, is launching a portfolio of 15 essential medicines to treat diseases including diabetes, respiratory illnesses, and breast cancer.

zh: 该组合的目标是让发展中国家收入不高的人群获得这些药物，而当地卫生系统的每次治疗每月成本只要1美元。
en: The aim is to make these medicines available to people of modest means in developing countries at a cost to local health systems of $1 per treatment per month.

zh: 我们将从肯尼亚、越南和埃塞俄比亚开始。
en: We will start in Kenya, Vietnam, and Ethiopia.

zh: 这是一小步，我们会在前进中学习，目标是几年内将该组合扩展到30个国家。
en: It is a small first step, and we will learn as we go, with a goal of expanding to 30 countries in a few years.

zh: 要克服在中低收入国家成功所面临的诸多障碍，这些新型创业企业可能需要探索与政府、非政府组织和其他公司的创新合作形式。
en: To overcome the many hurdles to success in low- and middle-income countries, these new types of business ventures will likely need to explore innovative forms of collaboration with governments, non-governmental organizations, and other companies.

zh: 这类合作已经证明，跨越传统工作界限、创造性地使用技术以及开发务实解决方案能够带来令人印象深刻的成果。
en: Such collaboration has already shown that working across traditional boundaries, making creative use of technology, and developing pragmatic solutions can yield impressive results.

zh: 让全球人人健康是一个艰巨的挑战。
en: Bringing health care to everyone on the planet is a great challenge.

zh: 它需要想象力、合作和艰苦奋斗。
en: It will take imagination, cooperation, and hard work.

zh: 商业的更大的参与能够增加在2030年实现这一目标的机会。
en: Greater involvement by business could increase the likelihood of getting there by 2030.

zh: 快公司的安全驾驶
en: Safe Driving for Fast Companies

zh: 蒙特利尔—在汽车上，盲点是指后视镜和侧视镜无法看到的路面区域。
en: MONTREAL – In a car, blind spots are the areas of the road that the rearview and side-view mirrors do not show.

zh: 司机必须时刻警惕它们 — — 以及它们所掩盖的潜在死亡风险。
en: A driver must constantly be aware of them – and of the potentially deadly perils they can conceal.

zh: 企业也可能存在盲点 — — 代价也同样高昂，导致公司过度投资于高风险业务尝试，无法利用新兴机会。
en: Businesses can have blind spots, too – and they can be equally costly, causing companies to overinvest in risky ventures or fail to take advantage of emerging opportunities.

zh: 成功的领导者会十分仔细地识别公司的盲点，引入相应机制确保不会因此造成伤害。
en: Successful leaders are careful to identify their company’s blind spots and introduce mechanisms to ensure that no harm will come from them.

zh: 企业盲点的一个共同源头是判断偏误。
en: One common source of businesses’ blind spots is judgment bias.

zh: 当高管对行业看法过于偏隘、低估竞争者能力或没有发现竞争局面正在改变时，就会产生判断偏误。
en: This arises when executives have overly narrow views of their industry, underestimate their competitors’ capabilities, or fail to see how the competitive landscape is changing.

zh: 公司因为此类盲点而蒙受损失的范例是雀巢公司。
en: A good example of a company that suffered from this kind of blind spot is Nestlé.

zh: 几十年来，这家瑞士跨国公司严格捍卫着自己全球领先食品公司的地位。
en: For decades, the Swiss multinational defined itself strictly as one the world’s leading food companies.

zh: 这个标签产生了作茧自缚的效果，将雀巢的产品线限定在一个相对狭窄的范围内。
en: The label created a self-imposed restriction, constraining Nestlé to sell a relatively narrow range of products.

zh: 但是，2010年，公司CEO保罗•布克（Paul Bulcke）将雀巢重新定义为“营养、卫生和健康”公司。
en: In 2010, however, the company’s CEO, Paul Bulcke, redefined Nestlé as a “nutrition, health, and wellness” company.

zh: 这是一个高明的战略决策，让雀巢公司能够提供几十种新产品线和服务。
en: It was a brilliant strategic decision, allowing the firm to offer dozens of new product lines and services.

zh: 许多高管团队过度自信于他们的公司的竞争优势。
en: Many executive teams are overconfident about their company’s competitive strength.

zh: 在董事会面前，他们滔滔不绝地夸大公司状况；80%左右的年报宣称公司是“市场领先者 ” 。
en: In front of their board, they rattle off exaggerated claims about where the company stands; some 80% of annual reports claim that their company is “the leader in the market.”

zh: 不幸的是，如此傲慢可能导致自鸣得意和竞争失败。
en: Unfortunately, this kind of arrogance can lead to complacency and competitive failure.

zh: 比如，许多金融机构没有做好充分准备面对进入市场的新竞争者。
en: Many financial institutions, for example, are inadequately prepared to confront the new players entering their markets.

zh: 悄然进行汽车保险试验的谷歌公司已经持有银行牌照。
en: Google, which is quietly testing the car-insurance waters, holds a banking license.

zh: 与此同时，Square、Paypal和新创业的Affirm等公司都已经开始在在线支付领域攻城略地。
en: Meanwhile, Square, Paypal, and the start-up company Affirm are already processing a large share of online payments.

zh: 在当今快节奏的世界中，竞争者只需要一个技术创新、价格优势或一次出色的病毒广告攻势就能脱颖而出。
en: In today’s fast-paced world, it takes only a single technological improvement, price advantage, or great viral advertising campaign for a competitor to leap ahead.

zh: 新公司几乎可以无中生有。
en: New players can materialize seemingly out of nowhere.

zh: 出租车公司Uber五年前还不存在；如今它的估值已超过400亿美元。
en: The taxi company Uber did not exist five years ago; it is now valued at more than $40 billion.

zh: 阿里巴巴公司的快速扩张威胁了从未预料到会面对中国竞争者的西方零售商。
en: The rapid expansion of Alibaba threatens Western retailers who never expected to face a Chinese competitor.

zh: 无人驾驶汽车和飞机马上也将改变许多行业。
en: Driverless cars and pilotless planes will soon transform many industries.

zh: 另一个常常造成公司盲点的因素是历史偏见，或心理学家所谓的“锚定偏见 ” — —即认为过去正确的东西在未来将依然正确。
en: Another frequent cause of companies’ blind spots is historic bias, or what psychologists call an “anchoring bias” – the assumption that something that was true in the past will continue to be true in the future.

zh: 长期成功记录可能改变高管的分析，扭曲他们的决策，让他们看不见处于萌芽状态的范式转变或市场的快速变化。
en: A long track record of success can warp executives’ analysis, distort their decision-making, and leave them blind to incipient paradigm shifts or rapid changes in a market.

zh: 当美国零售商塔吉特公司（Target）于2013年3月开出第一家加拿大门店时，其管理层认为在美国成功的秘诀也可以在美国的北方邻国奏效。
en: When the American retailer Target opened its first store in Canada in March 2013, its management assumed that the recipe of its success in the United States could be replicated north of the border.

zh: 但是，只过了22个月，塔吉特公司就宣布将关闭所有133家加拿大门店，裁员17,000人。
en: Instead, just 22 months later, the company announced that it would close all of its 133 Canadian stores and lay off 17,000 people.

zh: 事实证明，塔吉特公司的美国经验绝非其在加拿大的合理期望值。
en: Target’s American experience turned out to be a bad predictor of what it could expect in Canada.

zh: 克服历史偏见需要挑战一个行业的禁忌。
en: Overcoming historic biases requires questioning an industry’s taboos.

zh: 比如，如果史上被盗版最严重的电视剧《权力的游戏 》 （ Game of Thrones）的制片商不去和产权侵犯行为作斗争，或许可以抓住机会。
en: For example, if the creators of television series like Game of Thrones, the most pirated show in history, stopped fighting copyright infringement, they could seize an opportunity.

zh: 剧中的直接植入广告将被500万新增 — — 非法 — — 观众看到，增加一倍受众。
en: Advertisements directly embedded in the show would reach five million additional – illegal – viewers, in effect doubling their audience.

zh: 电视行业没有质疑并改写传统模式、方法和经营手段，但它们绝不是孤立。
en: The television industry is not alone in failing to question and revise its traditional models, methods, and operations.

zh: 比如，邮政业可以从航空、铁路、旅行社和饭店等行业中汲取教训，后四者都会在高需求阶段涨价。
en: The postal industry, for example, could learn a lesson from airlines, train companies, travel agencies, and hotels, all of which increase their prices during periods of high demand.

zh: 认为寄信或邮递包裹应该全年一个价的观点应该遭到挑战。
en: The assumption that the price of mailing a letter or shipping a package should remain constant throughout the year is ripe to be challenged.

zh: 针对盲点的保护措施需要仔细思考，但高管和董事会可以设置程序保护公司。
en: Guarding against blind spots takes careful thought, but executives and boards can put processes in place to protect against them.

zh: 首先，公司应该多元化人才储备。
en: For starters, companies should diversify their talent pool.

zh: 管理层应该确保他们能接触到思维不同的人。
en: Managers should ensure that they have access to people who think differently from them.

zh: 反偶像崇拜者和外部专家应该被邀请前往分享观点。
en: Iconoclasts and outside experts should be invited to share their views.

zh: 至少20%的公司董事会席位应该由来自行业外的个人组成。
en: At least 20% of a company’s board should be composed of individuals from outside the industry.

zh: 来自其他辈分和世界其他地区的观点也应该主动出击去寻找和聆听。
en: Views from other generations and other parts of the world should be sought and solicited.

zh: 高管应该花大力气打破禁忌、考察未受挑战的假设、质疑企业最神圣的规则。
en: Executives should make special efforts to break taboos, examine unchallenged assumptions, and question their businesses’ most sacred rules.

zh: 即使是简单的方法，比如把作为公司战略基础的每一条假设都写下来并批驳，也能产生极有价值的洞见。
en: Even simple methods, like writing down and challenging every assumption on which a company has based its strategy, can yield valuable insights.

zh: 每个公司都应该指定人手扮演“持异见者”的角色。
en: Every company should assign someone to play the role of “dissenter.”

zh: 有时还需要“打破瓷器的人 ” ， 让他在董事会会议期间的某个时候把好端端的盘子砸向墙壁，然后看看可以用碎片做些什么。
en: Sometimes called the “China breaker,” this person should be given time during board meetings to throw the good dishware against the wall and see what can be made of the pieces.

zh: 各行业都在变得日益复杂，全球竞争也在变得日益激烈。
en: Industries are becoming increasingly complex and global competition is mounting.

zh: 生存概率最高的公司是那些未雨绸缪、避免被踢出路的公司。
en: The companies that will be best placed to survive will be those that took the proper precautions to avoid being run off the road.

zh: 为了可持续性的商业模式
en: A Business Model for Sustainability

zh: 伦敦—在一篇最新报告中，气候变化政府间委员会（IPCC）警告说，如果不“迅速而大幅地”改变土地、能源、工业、建筑、交通和城市的管理方式，将对我们的地球造成不可逆转的伤害。
en: LONDON – In a recent report, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) warned that without “rapid and far-reaching” changes to how land, energy, industry, buildings, transport, and cities are managed, the damage to our planet could be irreversible.

zh: 个中含义显而易见：我们需要全球层面的协作政策改变当前轨迹。
en: The message was clear: we need a cooperative effort on a global scale to change our current trajectory.

zh: 而世界所面临的许多最棘手的可持续性挑战都与营商有关，因此唯一的审慎进步之道是改变营商方式。
en: And, given that many of the toughest sustainability challenges the world faces are linked to how it does business, the only prudent way forward is to change how business is done.

zh: 这听起来也许令人气馁，但我们已经有了指引专心的框架：联合国可持续发展目标（SDG ） 。
en: This may sound daunting, but we already have a framework to guide the transition: the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

zh: 2915年9月，193个国家共同实施了SDG，旨在到2030年实现“全体人民的更加可持续的未来 ” ， 略加推广，SDG也将带来更好的营商环境。
en: The SDGs, adopted in September 2015 by 193 countries, are designed to achieve a “more sustainable future for all” by 2030, which, by extension, will enable a better business environment.

zh: 商业和可持续发展委员会（Development Commission）估算，到下一个十年末，实现SDG可以让全球经济增加12万亿美元价值和3.8亿个工作岗位。
en: The Business and Sustainable Development Commission has estimated that meeting the SDGs could add some $12 trillion and 380 million jobs to the global economy by the end of the next decade.

zh: 收益是巨大的 — — 不作为的损失也是巨大的 — — 因此私人部门正开始注重利润和可持续性之间的联系。
en: With so much to gain – and to lose from inaction – the private sector is beginning to focus on the connection between profits and sustainability.

zh: 据伦理公司（Ethical Corporation）的最新《责任商业趋势》报告（Responsible Business Trends ） ， 69%的受访企业执行官说他们正在将SDG纳入战略。
en: According to the Ethical Corporation’s latest Responsible Business Trends report, 69% of business executives surveyed said they are integrating SDGs into their strategies.

zh: 与此同时，获得B级企业认证 — — 它衡量企业的社会和环境表现 — — 的公司数量在最近几年中有所增加。
en: At the same time, the number of companies receiving B Corp Certification – which measures a firm’s social and environmental performance – has increased in recent years.

zh: 全球金融也在向可持续性转变。
en: Global finance is also inching toward sustainability.

zh: 比如，环境、社会和治理类资产管理总额据估计已高达22万亿美元；联合国责任投资原则的投入资金高达$82万亿美元；32万亿美元被用于碳定价；甚至“绿色债券”市场也在急速膨胀。
en: For example, environmental, social, and governance assets under management are estimated to be as high as $22 trillion dollars; $82 trillion is committed to the UN Principles for Responsible Investment; $32 trillion is pegged to carbon pricing; and even the market for “green bonds” is growing exponentially.

zh: 这些势头很重要，因为金融市场支持对于实现可持续发展日程至关重要。
en: This momentum matters because financial market support will be essential in achieving the sustainable development agenda.

zh: 但是，要保持进步，企业必须认识到，即使在全球价值链中，也无法外包企业责任。
en: And yet, to sustain this progress, businesses must recognize that even in a global value chain, it is impossible to outsource corporate responsibility.

zh: 相反，跨国公司必须运用它们的市场实力推动社会变革。
en: On the contrary, multinational corporations must use their market power to drive social change.

zh: 以我的公司联合利华为例：每天都会有25亿人次使用我们通过供应链分销的产品，这条供应链包括80,000余家供应商和近两百万农户，他们反过来支持了数百万人的社区。
en: Consider my company, Unilever: 2.5 billion times every day, someone somewhere uses one of our products distributed via a supply chain that includes more than 80,000 suppliers and nearly two million farmers, who in turn support communities of millions of people.

zh: 如此规模让联合利华能够为SDG做出贡献并从中获益，而这正是我们努力所做的。
en: Such scale enables Unilever to contribute to and benefit from the SDGs, which is precisely what we try to do.

zh: 2009年，我们开展了联合利华可持续生活计划（Unilever Sustainable Living Plan ） ， 这是一项支持我们的社会、环境和经济表现的蓝图。
en: In 2009, we introduced the Unilever Sustainable Living Plan, a blueprint to bolster our social, environmental, and economic performance.

zh: 其目标包括提高超十亿人的健康和福利；减少与生产和使用我们的产品有关的环境足迹；以及提高数百万工人的生活水平。
en: Goals include strengthening the health and wellbeing of over a billion people; reducing the environmental footprint associated with the production and use of our products; and enhancing the livelihoods of millions of workers.

zh: 该方针让我们能够更加战略性地辨别我们的企业所面临的挑战和机会。
en: This approach has allowed us to be more strategic in identifying the challenges and opportunities that our business faces.

zh: 通过运用我们的资源和品牌，我们还解决了一些关键性发展挑战，如营养不良、环境卫生和保健；气候变化和荒漠化；人权；技能训练；以及职场平等。
en: By using our resources and brands, we have also addressed key development challenges like poor nutrition, sanitation, and hygiene; climate change and deforestation; human rights; skills training; and workplace equality.

zh: 在取得所有这些成就的同时，我们在十年中获得近300%的回报和19%的股价回报，这表明实现股东和相关利益方价值的注重发展的日程是完全可行的。
en: And we have done all of this with nearly a 300% return over ten years and a 19% return on equity, demonstrating that it is possible to employ a development-focused agenda that delivers for shareholders and stakeholders.

zh: 我并不是在说成功易如反掌；也不是在说我们的生命已经完成。
en: I am not suggesting that success has come easily, or that our job is finished.

zh: 尽管我将在2018年年底从联合利华退休，但我相信，这家我所领导了十多年的公司，将继续在注重加强可持续性的情况下改善商业流程。
en: Although I will be retiring from Unilever at the end of 2018, I am confident that the company I have led for more than a decade will continue to improve business processes with an eye toward strengthening sustainability.

zh: 解决世界社会和环境挑战的关键是运用市场力量，建立联盟改善效率。
en: The key to addressing the world’s social and environmental challenges is using the power of markets and building coalitions to improve effectiveness.

zh: 最后一项SDG，即为了目标而合作（SDG 17 ） ， 认识到这一点，并敦促商业领袖与政府和公民社会携手实现可持续发展目标。
en: The final SDG, Partnerships for the Goals (SDG 17), recognizes this and urges business leaders to cooperate with governments and civil society to deliver on sustainable-development objectives.

zh: SDG 17的一个很好的行动例子是粮食和土地使用联盟（Food and Land Use Coalition ） ， 这是一个由企业执行官、科学家、决策者、投资者和农民组成的全球网络，致力于改变世界分散复杂的粮食体系。
en: A good example of SDG 17 in action is the Food and Land Use Coalition, a global network of business executives, scientists, policymakers, investors, and farmers that is working to transform the world’s fragmented and complex food systems.

zh: 该联盟的一个关键的焦点领域便是生产于消费的脱节。
en: One key area of focus for this coalition is the disconnect between production and consumption.

zh: 我们需要更多这样的联盟；世界经济的未来不再取决于我们是否行动，而取决于我们需要多长时间行动。
en: We need more of this; the future of the global economy is no longer dependent on whether we act, but on how long we take to do so.

zh: 尽管在过去三年中，SDG取得了一些进展，但我们的速度仍然不够。
en: Despite some progress on the SDGs over the past three years, we are not moving fast enough.

zh: 丘吉尔曾说 ， “ 我从不担心行动，我只担心不行动。
en: As Winston Churchill once said: “I never worry about action, only inaction.”

zh: ”这一智慧应该作为我们今天的商业和SDG方针的指南。
en: That wisdom should shape our approach to business and the SDGs today.

zh: 我们想要为孩子们争取的世界，只有在我们选择行动而不是冷漠，选择勇气而不是自得，选择团结而不是涣散的情况下才会到来。
en: The world we want for our children will arrive only when we choose action over indifference, courage over comfort, and solidarity over division.

zh: 被否决的救市计划
en: Busted Bailout

zh: 剑桥-仓促花钱，从容忏悔。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Spend in haste; repent at leisure.

zh: 随着心思集中在对又一场1930年代般的的经济大萧条的恐惧上，美国的政治领袖们几乎在一夜之间通过了一个7000亿美元的救市计划，以重振该国的迅速瓦解的金融部门。
en: With minds concentrated by fears of another 1930’s-style Great Depression, America’s political leaders developed, virtually overnight, a $700 billion bailout plan to resuscitate the country’s rapidly deflating financial sector.

zh: 但是，一样令人震惊的是，美国众议院的普通的议员们把此计划给否决了，至少目前的情况是这样。
en: But, just as stunningly, rank-and-file members of the US House of Representatives have rejected it – at least for now.

zh: 也许他们表示怀疑是对的。
en: Perhaps they were right to be skeptical.

zh: 该计划的核心的自以为是的想法是，政府的聪明才智可以梳理高达万亿美元的“次级”抵押贷款市场，即使华尔街自己的如火箭科学家聪明的人员在解决这个问题上也已经完全失败。
en: The plan’s central conceit is that government ingenuity can disentangle the trillion-dollar “sub-prime” mortgage loan market, even though Wall Street’s own rocket scientists have utterly failed to do so.

zh: 首先，我们已被告知，政府非常聪明，它甚至可能会在整个事件上赚到钱。
en: To boot, we have been told that government is so clever that it might even make money on the whole affair.

zh: 也许是吧，但我们不要忘记，曾几何时，金融业内的很多非常聪明的人也曾这么认为。
en: Perhaps, but let’s not forget that a lot of very smart people in the financial industry thought the same thing until quite recently.

zh: 就在一年前，美国还有五个大型的独立投资银行，它们傲立在强大的金融界之巅。
en: Just a year ago, the United States had five major freestanding investment banks that stood atop its mighty financial sector.

zh: 去年，由于这些机构从他们冒险和激进的商业策略“挣来”的巨额利润，五大投行的雇员拿到的奖金累计超过了360亿美元。
en: Collectively, their employees shared more than $36 billion dollars in bonuses last year, thanks to the huge profits these institutions “earned” on their risky and aggressive business strategies.

zh: 这些战略通常涉及比传统的商业银行的风险和复杂程度大得多的行为。
en: These strategies typically involve far more risk – and sophistication – than the activities of traditional commercial banks.

zh: 8月中旬，我曾冒然预测风险将进一步加大，并有一大美国投资银行可能很快破产或者被迫以令人不安的方式被合并。
en: In mid-August, I had the temerity to predict that risks had come home to roost, and that a large US investment bank might soon fail or be forced into a highly distressed merger.

zh: 当时没想到今天连一家独立的投资银行也没有留在华尔街上。
en: Little did I imagine that today, there would be no freestanding investment bank left on Wall Street.

zh: 事实上，多年来，华尔街以超高薪的工作机会吸引了世界上许多最好的和最聪明的人才，而现在崩溃的投资银行把他们一个个解雇了。
en: Indeed, after years of attracting many of the world’s best and brightest into ultra-high paying jobs, collapsing investment banks are now throwing them out left and right.

zh: 我以前的一个学生，也是个这样的受害者，有一天给我电话问道 ， “ 我现在到底该怎么办，找一份真正的工作？ ”
en: One such victim, a former student, called me the other day and asked, “What am I supposed to do now, get a real job?”

zh: 这又让我们又回到了美国财政部的花费数千亿美元以疏通次级抵押贷款市场的计划。
en: This brings us back to the US Treasury’s plan to spend hundreds of billions of dollars to unclog the sub-prime mortgage market.

zh: 这个计划的想法是，美国政府会充当万不得已的买方来买金融界一直未能定价的垃圾债券。
en: The idea is that the US government would serve as buyer of last resort for the junk debt that the private sector has not been able to price.

zh: 财政部会雇用谁来计算出这一切呢？
en: Who, exactly, would the Treasury employ to figure all this out?

zh: 喔，当然是失业的投资银行家！
en: Why, unemployed investment bankers, of course!

zh: 让我们好好思考以下这些。
en: Let’s ponder this.

zh: 投资银行家们不断地在丢掉其轻松的饭碗，因为他们不能找出任何令人信服的方式定价其不良押贷款债务；否则，他们的公司本来可以利用由主权财富基金、私人股本集团、对冲基金等等拥有的而现在在场外的数万亿美元。
en: Investment bankers have been losing their cushy jobs because they could not figure out any convincing way to price distressed mortgage debt. Otherwise, their firms would have been able to tap the trillions of dollars now sitting on the sidelines, held by sovereign wealth funds, private equity groups, hedge funds, and others.

zh: 现在，他们为纳税人工作了，同样的这些投资银行家们却会突然拿出神奇的一直难倒他们的定价公式。
en: Now, working for the taxpayer, these same investment bankers will suddenly come up with the magic pricing formula that has eluded them until now.

zh: 无怪乎在各种政治背景下的学者都对此表示相当的怀疑。
en: Little wonder that academics across the political spectrum have expressed considerable skepticism.

zh: 诚然，财政部就会接受一些公司的股权，所以也就会有一些上升的潜力。
en: True, the Treasury would take equity stakes in some firms, so there would be some upside potential.

zh: 但主要关注的问题的中心是，财政部显然打算支付两倍以上的当前市场价格（ 20-30美分 ） ， 其理由是，如果财政部成功解开按揭市场的一团乱麻，就会使得任何降价都看上去像是便宜货。
en: But the main concern centers around the Treasury’s apparent intention to pay more than double the current market price (20-30 cents on the dollar) on the premise that its success in untangling the mortgage market would make any discount seem like a bargain.

zh: 这种吹毛求疵是否没有看到调整金融体系的紧迫性呢？
en: Does such nitpicking fail to recognize the urgency of fixing the financial system?

zh: 是否只要有计划总比没有要好？
en: Isn’t any plan better than none?

zh: 我本人不相信这一点。
en: I, for one, am not convinced.

zh: 高效的金融体系是为了促进的实际经济的增长，而不是施加巨大的税务负担。
en: Efficient financial systems are supposed to promote growth in the real economy, not impose a huge tax burden.

zh: 美国的金融部门，在给实际经济车轮上油的的过程中，已吸取了企业总利润的30 ％和总工资的10 ％的，这令人震惊。
en: And the US financial sector, in greasing the wheels of the real economy, has been soaking up an astounding 30% of corporate profits and 10% of wages.

zh: 因此，不同于1930年代，美国目前面临着过于庞大的金融体系。
en: Thus, unlike in the 1930’s, the US faces a hypertrophied financial system.

zh: 那么，是不是有可能，金融业的大萎缩，特别是如果伴随着改善了的监控结构，不仅不会导致大萧条，还实际上可能提高效率和增长？
en: Isn’t it possible, then, that rather than causing a Great Depression, significant shrinkage of the financial sector, particularly if facilitated by an improved regulatory structure, might actually enhance efficiency and growth?

zh: 我并不是说，政府应该袖手旁观。
en: I am not suggesting that the government should sit on its hands.

zh: 在这一动乱时期，政府需要推出一种扩大形式的存款保险制度，这样就不会出现更多的类似北岩银行所遭遇的银行挤兑。
en: It needs to provide an expanded form of deposit insurance during this time of turmoil, so that there are no more Northern Rock-style bank runs.

zh: 这是1930年代给予我们的一个很大的教训。
en: That was a big lesson of the 1930’s.

zh: 政府可能还需要考虑更直接地注资到抵押贷款业界，而让私营业界进行自我恢复。
en: The government may also need to consider injecting funds more directly into the mortgage sector while the private sector reconstitutes itself.

zh: 当然，政府也必须找到更好的方法来帮助业主和他们的贷款方找出有效的破产程序。
en: Certainly, the government must also find better ways to help homeowners and their lenders work out efficient bankruptcy proceedings.

zh: 当还有可行的其它方案能让人们留在自己的家园而银行可以收回更多的钱时，银行收回房子是毫无道理的。
en: It makes no sense for banks to foreclose on homes when there are workout options whereby people could stay in their homes and banks could recover far more money.

zh: 最后，经过进一步的曲折、转折和巨大的开支，美国将摆脱其巨大的财政危机。
en: Eventually, after further twists, turns, and huge expenditures, the US will emerge from its epic financial crisis.

zh: 被否决了的计划没有充分地针对裁减破产的银行，但几乎肯定的是，无论国会如何行动，这绝不会是最后的定论。
en: The proposal that was defeated was not sufficiently targeted at pruning back insolvent banks, but it will almost certainly not be the last word, regardless of how Congress now proceeds.

zh: 男管家，面包师，和资本家？
en: Butlers, Bakers, and Capitalists?

zh: 跨越十九和二十世纪的社会主义改革围绕着集中政府对资本的所有权。
en: The communist revolution that spanned the nineteenth and twentieth centuries was about concentrating government ownership of capital.

zh: 于是，在二十世纪的最后几十年中，目的截然相反的反改革浪潮席卷全球，推崇将资本尽可能地分散以使每个人都能成为所有者。
en: Then, in the closing decades of the twentieth century, a counter-revolution swept the world, pushing for just the opposite: disperse capital as widely as possible by getting everybody involved as owners.

zh: 当前的反改革正被带入一个逻辑极端：若每人都能成为所有者，那么每人都能成为资本家，下至理发师、侍应者甚至拾荒者。
en: Now the counter-revolution is being carried to its logical extreme: if everyone can be an owner, then everyone can be a capitalist, down to the barber, the waiter, and the trash collector. A specter is haunting us again; this time it is the dream of truly democratizing capitalism.

zh: 但是，就如共产主义梦想将每个人都变成充满勇气的社会主义工人一样，将每个人都变成资本家同样也是不可能的。
en: But turning everyone into a capitalist may be as impossible as the communist dream of turning everyone into an inspired socialist worker.

zh: 人们对神秘的金融原理的兴趣一直在减少，尤其是那些喜欢凝神看数表、研究数学公式的人。
en: Interest in the arcane principles of finance has always been an inclination particular to people who love to pore over numerical tables and study mathematical formulas.

zh: 这些人有时候使他们自己变得富有，如果每个人都能做到这样，那看起来还真不错。
en: These people sometimes make themselves rich, and it would seem nice if everyone could do that.

zh: 但是性别不同、天赋、缺点以及心理偏爱的差异，使之成为不可能。
en: But the varying talents, foibles, and psychological predilections of men and women make this impossible.

zh: 民主制资本主义的新精神曾被冠以不同名字，并集合了多种象征符号。
en: The new spirit of democratic capitalism goes by different names and mobilizes a variety of symbols.

zh: 但是，无论我们怎么描绘它，大众成为主人的想法正在各地崛起。
en: But, however we describe it, the idea that the masses should be owners is growing everywhere.

zh: 例如在英国，首相托尼·布莱尔清晰地描绘了 “一个储蓄者与资产拥有者的国家”的前景。
en: In Britain, for example, Tony Blair articulates a vision of “a nation of savers and asset-holders.”

zh: 他的计划被称为“资产政策 ” ， 一个自1991年麦克·史乐山（Michael Sherraden）的《资产和贫穷：一个美国新福利政策》出版后就逐渐风行的术语。
en: His plans have been called “asset-based policies,” a term that has grown in popularity since Michael Sherraden’s 1991 book Assets and the Poor: A New American Welfare Policy .

zh: 在美国，乔治·W·布什把他的梦想称为“产权社会 ” 。
