en: In the United States, President George W. Bush calls his dream the “ownership society.”

zh: 中国2004年全国人民代表大会将个体户、私营企业主重新定义为“社会主义事业建设者 ” ， 并把他们包括进爱国统一战线。
en: In China, the National People’s Congress in 2004 re-defined entrepreneurs and individual proprietors as “builders of the socialist cause,” and included them in the Patriotic United Front.

zh: 全世界各国政府正在花钱控制并监视他们的股票市场，以使它们对个人投资者更为安全，并保证投资者在这些市场中的利益增长。
en: Governments around the world are spending money on regulating and monitoring their stock markets so that they are safer for individual investors, and so that investor interest in these markets will grow.

zh: 他们也尝试努力发展他们的住房集资以扩大房屋所有权。
en: They are also trying to develop their housing finance in order to expand homeownership.

zh: 有些人在谈论让人们以个人退休金、健康储蓄帐户中的健康医疗费以及教育储蓄账户和教育券的形式拥有他们自己的社会保障缴款
en: Some are talking about letting people own their social security contributions, in the form of personal retirement accounts, their health care through health savings accounts, and their education through educational savings accounts and school vouchers.

zh: 这是一个真正的改革尝试，一个前所未有的创意新经济制度的试验，并非重回往昔的资本主义。
en: This is an attempt at a real revolution, not a return to an earlier capitalist past. It is about experimenting with creative new economic institutions that have never been seen before.

zh: 普通概念中的“所有权”本身并非通往成功新经济的路线图，而对如何实现改革的说法数不胜数。
en: The general concept of “ownership” is not by itself a roadmap to a successful new economy, and there are myriad interpretations of how to carry out the revolution.

zh: 改革一直都是试验性的，一直是种冒险。
en: Revolutions are always experiments, and they are always an adventure.

zh: 有一些新政策看来颇具代表性。
en: Some of the new policies seem exemplary.

zh: 托尼·布莱尔的工党政府将在四月开始实行一个计划，为每个新生儿童建立一个250至500英镑的私人“儿童信托基金 ” 。
en: Tony Blair’s Labor government is implementing a plan that, beginning in April, will establish a personal Child Trust Fund of £250 to £500 for every newborn.

zh: 父母到时可以向该免税增长的基金缴款，还可以选择如何分配这笔资金来进行投资。
en: Parents can then make contributions to their child’s trust fund which can grow tax-free, and can choose how to allocate the Fund among investments.

zh: 这件礼物的目的是“鼓励父母和孩子培养储蓄习惯，并与金融机构打交道 ” 。
en: The purpose of the gifts is to “encourage parents and children to develop the saving habit and engage with financial institutions.”

zh: 这是一个规划良好的小型计划，也花不了政府多少钱：即使每年500英镑地投资二十年，也不足以使人脱贫。
en: This is a well-designed, small-scale plan that will cost the government fairly little: £500, even invested for twenty years, will not be enough to lift someone out of poverty.

zh: 该基金的主要目的是培养公民的投资意识。
en: The trust funds’ real promise will consist in educating citizens about investments.

zh: 那是一个良好的开端，尤其是如果其他地方也效仿布莱尔的政策。
en: That’s a good start, particularly if Blair’s policy is copied elsewhere.

zh: 但是其他的提议承担了更大的风险，特别是许多国家正在讨论、并包括英国、智利、瑞典和墨西哥等一些国家已经或者至少部分实���的退休养老金的私有化。
en: But other proposals carry bigger risks, notably the privatization of retirement pensions, which is talked about in many countries, and that some – including Great Britain, Chile, Sweden, and Mexico – have already put in place, at least partly.

zh: 布什的美国社会保障改革计划 — — 至少据目前所知 — — 代表了所有权改革的先锋派。
en: Bush’s plan to reform Social Security in the US – at least what is known of it – represents the ownership revolution’s cutting edge.

zh: 选择该计划的美国年轻人将看到，几十年后当他们退休时，传统的养老金福利将被来源于私人账户的收入所取代，他们能自由将其用于各种投资，包括股票。
en: Young people in the US who opt for it would see most of the traditional pension benefit replaced when they retire decades from now with proceeds from personal accounts that they would be free to allocate among a range of investments, including stocks.

zh: 无论传统福利还留下些什么，都难以使他们维持生计；退休人员只能为了他们的大部分收入而任由市场摆布。
en: Whatever traditional benefit remains would not be enough to live on; retirees would be at the mercy of the markets for the bulk of their income.

zh: 任何这样的试验结果都无从预测，因为其他国家的经验从来都不可能是另一个新体系的完美向导 — — 不同环境其形势也决不会相同。
en: The outcome of any such experiment is impossible to foresee, because other countries’ experience can never be a perfect guide to a new system – the situation is never exactly the same in a different environment.

zh: 假如人们保持理性行为，并且/或者股票市场持续牛市，那么像布什提出的这样一个私有化的社会保障体系也许会很成功。
en: A privatized social security system like the one Bush proposes might turn out very well, assuming that people behave sensibly and/or the stock market keeps going up.

zh: 但是，鉴于人类天性似乎总喜欢推算过去的报酬，还是存在着很大的灾难风险。
en: But there is also a higher risk of disaster, owing to a seemingly inborn human tendency to extrapolate past returns.

zh: 投资者可能会制造一个股票市场泡沫，鼓励更为无知的投资者们将他们的个人退休账户集中投于股票市场 — — 一旦泡沫破裂就把危险留给他们。
en: Investors could create a stock-market bubble, encouraging even more naïve investors to concentrate their personal retirement accounts in the stock market – and leaving them dangerously exposed when it crashes.

zh: 还有另外一个风险，即私人账户将导致私人储蓄利率的进一步下跌。
en: There is also a related risk that private accounts would cause a further drop in the personal saving rate.

zh: 储蓄利率是任何经济体系的生命线，因为不可能指望外国人永远对资本投资投钱。
en: The saving rate is the lifeblood of any economy, because foreigners cannot be expected to finance capital investment forever.

zh: 但是所有关于惊人报酬的讨论将会刺激心理学家所说的“愿望思维偏向 ” ， 引导人们相信他们的私人账户会在将来变得如此值钱以至于他们不需要任何除此之外的储蓄。
en: But all the talk of wondrous returns could spur what psychologists call “wishful thinking bias,” leading people to believe that their personal accounts will be so valuable in the future that outside saving is unnecessary.

zh: 鼓励大范围的资本所有权将有可能带来优惠政策。
en: Encouraging widespread capital ownership could potentially give rise to good policies.

zh: 但是，我们真的需要将这些政策扩展到诸如养老金、健康医疗和教育领域吗？
en: But do we really want to extend such policies to areas like pensions, health care, and education?

zh: 毕竟，拥有资本 — — 无论股票还是房产 — — 都有虽然激动人心，但是我们必须保证，当封锁来临、尘埃落定时，我们还有一个家可以回。
en: After all, owning capital – whether it is stocks or real estate – entails risks, and the need to insure against these risks is why capitalist countries built traditional safety nets in the first place. Revolutions are exciting, but we must make sure that we still have a home to return to when the barricades come down and the dust settles.

zh: 韩国统一和全球和平
en: Korean Unification and Global Peace

zh: 首尔 — — 在2015年联合国庆祝成立70周年时，韩国人却在感叹70年的民族分裂。
en: SEOUL – While the United Nations celebrates its 70th anniversary in 2015, Koreans will lament 70 years of national division.

zh: 考虑到分裂的半岛正在面对 — — 并且今后仍将持续面对的所有机遇和挑战，统一仍将是我们必须继续为之奋斗的重要目标。
en: Considering all of the challenges and opportunities that the divided peninsula faces – and will continue to confront in the coming years – unification remains an important goal that we must continue to pursue.

zh: 1948年在联合国主持下正式成立后，当时羽翼未丰的大韩民国立即被卷入到冷战的强权政治中，并在1991年前阻碍其加入联合国。
en: Founded formally in 1948 under UN auspices, the then-fledgling Republic of Korea immediately became engulfed in Cold War power politics, which hampered its efforts to join the UN – a goal not achieved until 1991.

zh: 但自那以后，韩国充分夺回了失去的时间。
en: Since then, however, the Republic has more than made up for its late arrival.

zh: 它在联合国安全理事会、经济社会理事会和人权理事会都发挥了积极作用 — — 并踊跃投身与维和、发展合作、气候变化、核不扩散及人权相关的众多举措。
en: It is playing an active role in the UN – the Security Council, the Economic and Social Council, and the Human Rights Council – and it is participating in numerous initiatives related to peacekeeping, development cooperation, climate change, non-proliferation, and human rights.

zh: 在此期间，国际社会也发生了巨大变化。
en: During this time, the international community has also dramatically changed.

zh: 全球化和技术革命令相互依存度不断加深，但安全、平等、公正和容忍精神的缺失在全球各地依然随处可见。
en: Globalization and technological transformation have deepened interdependence, and yet insecurity, inequality, injustice, and intolerance remain undiminished worldwide.

zh: 卢旺达大屠杀二十年后，我们继续见证着人类的残忍与恐怖 — — 比方说在叙利亚、南苏丹和中非共和国。
en: Two decades after the Rwandan genocide, we continue to bear witness to human cruelty and horror – in Syria, South Sudan, and the Central African Republic, for example.

zh: 同时，十亿左右全世界最贫困的民众，包括妇女和儿童，都挣扎在死亡线上。
en: Meanwhile, a billion or so of the world’s poorest people, including women and children, are barely surviving.

zh: 东北亚同样麻烦不断。
en: Northeast Asia has its share of trouble.

zh: 崛起的中国、复兴的日本、张扬的俄罗斯以及抱残守缺的朝鲜导致地区新的复杂及不确定性增加。
en: A rising China, a resurgent Japan, an assertive Russia, and an anachronistic North Korea have added new complexities and uncertainties to the region.

zh: 后者试图研发核武器尤其令人担忧。
en: The latter’s pursuit of nuclear arms is particularly worrying.

zh: 就美国而言，它正积极地将“再平衡”转向亚洲。
en: On its part, the United States is now “rebalancing” toward Asia.

zh: 历史、领土及海上安全冲突日趋频繁，加之丑陋民族主义死灰复燃极有可能激发军事对抗，而军事对抗很可能与政治误判相关。
en: Growing conflicts over history, territory, and maritime security, combined with an ugly resurgence of nationalism, risk triggering military confrontation, quite possibly through political miscalculation.

zh: 如果决策者和维和力量置之不理，那么东北亚紧张局势很可能破坏该地区的经济繁荣。
en: Left unattended by policymakers and peacemakers, Northeast Asia’s tensions could undermine the region’s flourishing economy.

zh: 正是在这样充满挑战的环境中，韩国总统朴槿惠于2013年当选。
en: It is in this challenging environment that the Republic of Korea’s president, Park Geun-hye, took office in 2013.

zh: 其外交政策 — — 也就是所谓的“互信政治 ” — —旨在将猜疑和矛盾的氛围转变为信任与合作，并建设“新的朝鲜半岛、新的东北亚和新的世界。 ”
en: Her foreign policy – called “Trustpolitik” – aims to transform this atmosphere of suspicion and conflict into one of confidence and cooperation, and to build “a new Korean Peninsula, a new Northeast Asia, and a new world.”

zh: 朝核问题是实现这一转型的最大障碍。
en: The greatest obstacle to achieving this transformation is the North Korean nuclear question.

zh: 就在几个月前，朝鲜还威胁要进行新一轮核试验。
en: Over the last couple of months, North Korea has threatened to carry out yet another nuclear test.

zh: 因此，当前最紧迫的任务是一定要阻止这种状况发生，之后再对朝鲜核武器及其运载能力的发展进行调查。
en: Today’s most urgent task therefore must be to prevent this from happening, and then to check further advances in the North’s nuclear weapons and delivery capabilities.

zh: 朝鲜半岛的和平表象依然脆弱，韩国政府已经进行了密集的外交努力，团结地区及全世界的朋友和伙伴对朝鲜进行威慑。
en: The semblance of peace on the Korean Peninsula remains fragile, and South Korea’s government has engaged in intensive diplomatic efforts to rally friends and partners in the region and worldwide to deter the North.

zh: 朝鲜进行过三轮核试验后，联合国安理会已经通过一系列决议对其实行大规模制裁。
en: The UN Security Council has adopted a series of resolutions to impose extensive sanctions, following the North’s three previous nuclear tests.

zh: 如果胆敢有任何进一步的挑衅行为，那么机构制裁的一切后果必须由朝鲜自身承担。
en: Any further provocation will bring the full force of the organization’s sanctions to bear.

zh: 在这样的情况下 — — 尽管朝鲜人权及人道主义状况非常严峻 — — 朴依然提出了朝韩统一的目标。
en: Under these circumstances – in addition to the dire human rights and humanitarian situation in North Korea – Park laid out her vision for a unified Korea.

zh: 在德累斯顿最近一次讲话中，她提出了三项具体可行的建议，以解决朝鲜人道主义问题、建设有利于南北朝鲜共同福祉及繁荣的基础设施并促进朝韩民众一体化。
en: In a recent speech in Dresden, she proposed three concrete and action-oriented proposals to the North that would address its humanitarian problems, build infrastructure for the common welfare and prosperity of the two Koreas, and promote integration of the Korean people.

zh: 上述战略人道主义部分的实现可以与政治和安全因素无关。
en: The humanitarian component of this strategy could be implemented regardless of political and security considerations.

zh: 比方说，我们要落实联合国孕产妇保健及婴儿营养1000天计划，以结束长期困扰朝鲜的婴幼儿营养不良。
en: For example, it would involve implementing the UN’s 1,000-day project for maternal health and infant nutrition, aimed at ending the North’s chronically high rate of infant malnutrition.

zh: 我们只能希望朝鲜对此作出积极的回应。
en: We can only hope that North Korea will respond positively to our proposal.

zh: 这将是一项长期计划的首要步骤。
en: It would be an important first step on a much longer journey.

zh: 朝韩两国的统一之路无疑将荆棘密布，需要国际社会的鼎立合作。
en: Korea’s road to unification will undoubtedly be difficult, and will require the international community’s support.

zh: 反过来，我们立志打造的全新统一国家将符合其邻国及国际社会的利益，从而促进全球的和平与繁荣。
en: In return, the new, unified country that we aspire to build will serve the interests of its neighbors and those of the wider international community in promoting global peace and prosperity.

zh: 不久前曾经有过类似的先例，因此我们有理由满怀希望。
en: There is a recent precedent for this vision, and thus reason to be hopeful.

zh: 23年前，导致两德持续分裂的地缘政治背景发生了根本性的变化。
en: Some 23 years ago, the geopolitical context that sustained the division of the two Germanys changed radically.

zh: 同样，总有一天朝韩两个联合国铭牌将换成唯一的一个。
en: Similarly, the day will come when Korea’s two UN nameplates will be replaced with one.

zh: 卡尔德龙的熔炉
en: Calderon’s Cauldron

zh: 在极端不利的情况下，墨西哥终于在上周五诞生了新任总统。
en: Under dramatically inauspicious circumstances, Mexico has finally got itself a new president last Friday.

zh: 费利佩•卡尔德龙 （Felipe Calderón）冒着左翼反对派人士的怒火，击败了民主革命党（PRD）及其领导人安德列斯•曼努埃尔•洛佩斯•奥夫拉多尔（Andrés Manuel López Obrador ） ， 但同时也付出了惨重的代价。
en: Felipe Calderón has taken the oath of office, braving the wrath of his left-wing opposition, out-smarting the Partido de la Revolución Democrática (PRD) and its leader, Andrés Manuel López Obrador, but nonetheless paying a high price.

zh: 全世界电视新闻和报纸的头版头条都惊人地一致 ： “ 墨西哥新总统在混乱和争斗之中宣誓就职。 ”
en: Every TV news show and front-page headline in the world ran the same headline: “New Mexican President inaugurated in chaos and fisticuffs.”

zh: 墨西哥的政府机构艰难地顶住了左翼反对派几乎是暴动般的冲击，左翼人士一心想阻止卡尔德龙就任总统。 同样难以应对的还有革命制度党（PRI ） ， 他们一门心思想看卡尔德龙登上宝座，而后再一败涂地、草草收场。
en: Mexico’s institutions withstood – just barely – the onslaught of a virtually insurrectional left-wing opposition, bent in vain on stopping Calderón’s inauguration, and of a resentful Partido Revolucionario Institucional (PRI), increasingly dedicated to allowing Calderón to take office, and then fail miserably.

zh: 在通往总统宝座的道路上，卡尔德龙出人意料地克服了所有似乎无法逾越的障碍，但管理和改革墨西哥的斗争才刚刚开始。
en: Calderón impressively overcame apparently insurmountable obstacles on the way to the presidency, yet the struggle to govern and transform Mexico has just begun.

zh: 多数墨西哥评论家认为，改善卸任总统文森特·福克斯在就职期间造成的糟糕状况对卡尔德龙来讲难度不大。
en: Most Mexican commentators believe that it should be relatively easy for Calderón to improve on the largely self-inflicted failure of outgoing President Vicente Fox’s term.

zh: 墨西哥需要以两倍于福克斯治下的速度获得经济增长（福克斯在任时增长率只有区区2 % ） 。
en: Mexico needs to grow at roughly twice the rate that it did under Fox (a meager 2% per year).

zh: 如果卡尔德龙能够加强法律和秩序，利用自己强大的政治能力与革命制度党达成经济结构的改革协议，他就能够获得成功。
en: If Calderón can strengthen law and order, and use his considerable political skills to reach agreement with the PRI on structural economic reforms, he will succeed.

zh: 但这种观点太过简单化。
en: But this view is simplistic.

zh: 福克斯的任期，以及前总统埃内斯托·塞迪略（Ernesto Zedillo）的后四年任期，很难说成是彻底的失败。
en: Fox’s term, along with the four last years of former President Ernesto Zedillo’s mandate, were hardly a failure.

zh: 20世纪60年代以来，墨西哥就很少看到连续10年的经济稳定、低通货膨胀、低利率、货币稳定、以及不高但却连续的经济增长。
en: Not since the 1960’s had Mexico undergone ten consecutive years of economic stability, low inflation, low interest rates, a stable currency, and constant, though mediocre growth.

zh: 在这两位总统任内，抵押、汽车贷款和消费信贷破天荒地首次对中下层人群开放：房屋的建造和销售，以及汽车的销售，全部创下了历史新高。
en: For the first time ever, mortgages, automobile loans, and consumer credit became available to the lower middle class: this year more homes were built and sold, and more cars were bought, than ever before.

zh: 同样，尽管福克斯由于对抗议者和破坏性的极端反对力量姑息迁就而饱受批评，但他从未进行过令那些嗜血的前任闻名遐尔的血腥镇压。
en: Likewise, while Fox can be criticized for not clamping down on protesters and a disruptive, extremist opposition, he never resorted to the bloody repression for which most of his predecessors came to be known.

zh: 不仅如此，他打破了墨西哥外交政策的古老窠臼，使移民和人权成为墨西哥新国际议程的核心问题。
en: Moreover, he dragged Mexico out of its archaic foreign policy cocoon, and placed immigration and human rights at the heart of Mexico’s new international agenda.

zh: 同样，卡尔德龙与革命制度党的谈判也进行得举步唯艰，未能成功地建立起联合政府，而卡氏曾反复强调只有联合政府才能打破自1997年来一直困扰着墨西哥的停滞局面。
en: Nor is Calderón finding it easy to negotiate with the PRI, failing to build a coalition government, which he has repeatedly proclaimed as the solution to the gridlock that has cursed Mexico since 1997.

zh: 无论纯粹由国家行动党（PAN）构成的内阁有多少好处，那也并非是卡尔德龙的初衷。
en: Whatever the advantages of a cabinet comprising solely members of his Partido Acción Nacional (PAN), this is not what Calderón sought.

zh: 同样，无法就就职仪式与反对派达成任何协议¾于是就上演了议员们在议会大打出手，而卡尔德龙则被从后门悄悄引入、匆匆完成就职仪式这样尴尬、混乱的一幕。
en: Similarly, no deal with the opposition was possible regarding the inauguration ceremony – thus the chaotic, depressing scenes of congressmen fighting it out in their chamber, while Calderón was ushered in through the back door for a rushed ceremony.

zh: 同样，墨西哥的经济问题也许比很多评论家想象中的更难处理。
en: Mexico’s economic problems might be similarly more intractable than many commentators seem to believe.

zh: 1988－1994年，墨西哥彻底改变了原有的经济模式，在前总统卡洛斯·萨利纳斯（Carlos Salinas）的带领下开始了经济开放的进程。 1994-2000年，在前总统塞迪略的领导下，墨西哥又经历了姗姗来迟但却十分成功的政治开放；最后，多亏福克斯的努力，真正的权力转换终于来临。
en: Mexico experienced a “cold-turkey” economic opening under former President Carlos Salinas in 1988-1994; a belated but successful political opening under former President Zedillo in 1994-2000; and, at long last, a true rotation in power thanks to Fox.

zh: 但20世纪30年代建立起来的革命制度党的组织体系基础却从未发生变化，构成了墨西哥发展和成功最重要也最困难的障碍。
en: But the foundations of the old PRI-corporativist system created in the 1930’s remain untouched, and represent the main and most formidable obstacles to Mexico’s growth and success.

zh: 这一体系的首要支柱就是遍布全国的公私经济垄断。
en: The first pillar of this system is the public and private economic monopolies that dominate the country.

zh: 国有石油公司（Pemex）和电力公司（联邦电力委员会）不存在任何竞争。
en: The state-owned oil (Pemex) and electric power (Federal Electricity Commission) companies face no competition.

zh: 私有资本在电讯（Telmex ） 、 电视（Televisa ） 、 水泥（Cemex ） 、 面包和玉米饼生产（分别是Bimbo和Maseca ） 、 银行（Banamex/Citigroup和Bancomer/Banco de Bilbao）等领域的垄断经营也许在国外面临挑战，而在国内却仍然是惟我独尊。
en: The private virtual monopolies in telecommunications (Telmex), television (Televisa), cement (Cemex), bread and tortilla manufacturing (Bimbo and Maseca, respectively), banking (Banamex/Citigroup and Bancomer/Banco de Bilbao) may face competition abroad, but not at home.

zh: 这些垄断企业前所未有的强大，价格、服务和品质无一不是深受其害。
en: These monopolies are stronger than ever, and prices, supply, service, and quality all suffer.

zh: 从20世纪30年代起就控制着墨西哥劳工运动的工会构成了这一体系的次要支柱。
en: The second pillar is formed by the unions that have controlled the Mexican labor movement since the 1930’s.

zh: 他们享有“完全封闭”的雇佣和解雇特权、毫无争议的领导人选举、缺乏透明度的强制性会费，以及十分强大的政治权力。
en: They enjoy “closed shop” hiring and firing prerogatives, leadership elections by acclamation, mandatory dues without transparency, and immense political power.

zh: 其中教师工会在拉丁美洲的规模首屈一指，而石油工会的财力则在拉丁美洲富甲一方，更有甚者，社会安全员工联盟年复一年地阻挠着有关退��和医疗改革的一切尝试。
en: The teachers’ union is the largest in Latin America, the oil workers’ union is the richest in Latin America, and the social security employees union has thwarted any attempt at pension or health reform for years.

zh: 这一体系的第三根支柱就是政治垄断。
en: The third pillar of the system is political monopoly.

zh: 70年来，一直由革命制度党把持着的墨西哥政治，现在则由三个政党共同把持，其他人不可能进入到政治领域，也不可能染指巨额公共补贴，公共补贴的数额之巨在去年就超过了5亿美元，而现在却不费吹灰之力就落入了执政党手中。
en: For 70 years, the PRI had a complete lock on Mexican politics; now three parties do, and no one else can enter the political arena or gain access to the enormous public subsidies – more than $500 million last year – handed out to these parties without their consent.

zh: 各主要党派自己制定反托拉斯法，自己决定补贴的去向，自己指定候选官员。
en: The main parties write their own anti-trust legislation, vote their own subsidies, and choose their own elected officials.

zh: 在所有层次上缺乏连选连任机制进一步加强了党派机器的力量：各党派自己指定候选人，选民要做的只是在投票中予以批准。
en: The absence of consecutive re-election at any level reinforces the party machines’ power: they pick candidates, whom voters merely ratify at the polls.

zh: 于是墨西哥所面临的挑战就归结为解放劳工运动、打破公私垄断以及降低政治舞台的进入门槛。
en: So Mexico’s challenges boil down to liberating the labor movement, breaking up the private monopolies and opening the public monopolies to competition, and lowering entry barriers that restrict access to the political arena.

zh: 也许它们不是成功的充分条件，但要想获得成功这些条件却无论如何必不可少。
en: These may not be sufficient conditions for success, but they are certainly necessary ones.

zh: 卡尔德龙必须从一开始就懂得控制权力。
en: Calderón must strengthen his presidency from the outset.

zh: 无论看起来多么险象环生，这也许是获得成功的唯一方法。
en: Taking on the powers that be is perhaps the only way to achieve this, however risky it might appear.

zh: 仅以35%的得票率勉强当选、身后没有多数议员的支持、在美国经济增长即将放缓之际当选总统，这些都意味着他的总统任期将会充满艰辛。
en: Elected with only 35% of the vote, lacking a majority in Congress, and taking office on the eve of an economic slowdown in the United States, things would be difficult anyway.

zh: 由于三分之一的选民认为他胜之不武，再加上墨西哥法治目前的微妙处境，卡尔德龙所处的地位就更加不值得羡慕。
en: Given that roughly a third of the electorate does not think he won fairly, and in view of the precariousness of the rule of law in the country, Calderón’s position is even less enviable.

zh: 坚忍不拔、小心翼翼也许是最适合他的行为准则。
en: Caution and patience might not be his best advisors.

zh: 我们的宇宙环境
en: Our Cosmic Context

zh: 纽约 — — 我们生活的星球一向不断变化，但今天与人类行为息息相关的许多气候及生态变化速度尤其可观。
en: NEW YORK – We have always lived on a changing planet, but many of today’s variations in climatic and ecological states are taking place exceptionally fast, and are directly attributable to our behavior.

zh: 考虑到由此产生的后果，唯一合理的对策是确保变化速度逐渐减缓。
en: Slowing the rate of alteration is the only rational course of action, given the potential outcomes.

zh: 但我们还需要仔细斟酌对策，不然就可能冒着重复短视行为的风险。
en: But we also need to examine our responses closely, or risk repeating our shortsighted behavior.

zh: 出人意料的是，在宇宙其他地方搜寻生命的努力或许能让我们从全新的重要视角审视我们的星球。
en: Unexpectedly, the search for life elsewhere in the universe may provide a critical new perspective.

zh: 令人惊叹的工具和值得注意的问题在拥有先进技术的人类文明中随处可见，所有这一切都起源于宇宙行星史。
en: Our technologically advanced civilization – replete with remarkable tools and notable headaches – owes everything to a tapestry of cosmic and planetary history.

zh: 以油、气、煤为例。
en: Consider, for example, oil, gas, and coal.

zh: 这些物质蕴含着纷繁芜杂的碳化学，源起于远离我们时代却有着深刻变异和进化节奏的生物学和地球物理。
en: These substances comprise a complex package of carbon chemistry, produced by biology and geophysics operating within a deep rhythm of variation and evolution originating far from our own epoch.

zh: 我们用来制作巧妙装置延展身心的矿物质和稀土元素也是这种节奏的组成部分，产生于从行星起源到板块构造及小行星影响等一系列独特环境。
en: The minerals and rare-earth elements that we exploit to build ingenious devices – extending our bodies and minds – are also a part of this rhythm, and are accessible only because of a great chain of circumstances, from planetary origins to plate tectonics and asteroid impacts.

zh: 人类物种轨迹与拥有四十亿年历史的生物地球化学系统紧密相连，上述系统反复影响着从细菌、城市规划、大气含氧量到造纸厂在内的星球环境。
en: Our trajectory as a species is hardwired to this four-billion-year-old bio-geo-chemical system that has profoundly worked and reworked the planetary environment, all the way from bacteria to city planners, atmospheric oxygen to paper mills.

zh: 我们每个人除自身基因外还携带着数十万亿微生物。
en: In addition to our own genes, each of us carries the genes of tens of trillions of microbial passengers.

zh: 这些微生物携带着将会永久传承的代谢过程密码 — — 恰恰是这些过程决定了我们这个世界的环境。
en: These tiny organisms harbor codes for metabolic processes that have been preserved across eons – the same processes responsible for shaping the world.

zh: 这不啻为生命在任何地方成功生存的可靠蓝图，即使不同地方的生化细节或许会有所不同。
en: It is a plausible blueprint for successful life anywhere, even if the biochemical details differ.

zh: 我们的日常活动往往会忽视这样的生存背景。
en: Our daily business usually ignores this existential backdrop.

zh: 创造未来、避免战争、饥饿、疾病等人道主义灾难的艰苦斗争往往令我们鲜有余力从哲学的角度思考我们在这微不足道的宇宙尘埃上起什么作用。
en: The struggle to mold our future, to stave off the humanitarian disasters of war, disease, and starvation leaves little room to be philosophical about our place on this crumb of cosmic dust.

zh: 但众多科学家，包括我本人在内，敏锐地感到宇宙可能会用一记响亮的耳光来警告我们。
en: But many scientists, including me, have a sense that the universe might be about to reach in and give us a metaphorical slap in the face.

zh: 过去几十年来，被称为天体生物学的现代科学分支一直在试图确定所有这一切 — — 生命、死亡和进化 — — 是否在宇宙其他地方也发生过。
en: For the last few decades, the modern scientific endeavor known as astrobiology has been seeking to determine whether or not all of this – life, death, and evolution – has happened elsewhere in the cosmos.

zh: 人类很早就已提出过这个问题，但却找不到相应的证据 — — 也就是原始资料。
en: Humans have long asked this question, but the evidence – the raw data – was lacking.

zh: 现在，天文学家已经发现有数不胜数的行星围绕其他恒星转动。
en: Now, astronomers have discovered a remarkable abundance of planets orbiting other stars.

zh: 数据告诉我们有15-20%的类日恒星孕育的世界与地球大小相似，其运行轨道与恒星的距离可能带来温和的地表温度。
en: The numbers tell us that 15-20 percent of Sun-like stars harbor worlds similar in size to the Earth, orbiting stellar parents at distances implying that their surfaces might be temperate.

zh: 人类尚未找到距离我们最近的世界，但从统计学的角度它应该离我们约15光年 — — 这在宇宙学中仅仅是一箭之遥而已。
en: We have not found the nearest such world yet, but statistically it should be within about 15 light years of us – a stone’s throw in cosmic terms.

zh: 我们很可能会在十年内找到类似的星球，并进而搜索上述世界的大气成分或气候有没有外星生物的痕迹。
en: There is an excellent chance that we will find it and its brethren within a decade, and search for signs of an alien biosphere in these worlds’ atmospheric compositions or climates.

zh: 在太阳系中，美国宇航局的好奇号探测车已经在古老火星湖底的矿物泥中发现了或许是有机碳的痕迹。
en: In the Solar System, NASA’s Curiosity rover has discovered what may be organic carbon in the fossil mud of an ancient Martian lakebed.

zh: 人类发现木星被冰层所覆盖的卫星木卫二从相当于地球两倍体积的隐形海洋中向太空喷水。
en: Europa, Jupiter’s icy moon, has been spotted spewing water into space from a hidden ocean that could hold twice the volume of all of Earth’s oceans.

zh: 好运号让我们有机会探索有可能孕育生命的深海海域。
en: Serendipity is providing us with access to an abyssal realm that could conceivably harbor life.

zh: 我们只需要去闻一闻喷出的盐水。
en: We just have to go smell the salty spray.

zh: 即使在这些地方什么都没发现也很有意义，因为这些新的数据具有预测性，能够缩小可能存在生命的行星或卫星范围。
en: Even finding nothing in such places is important, because these new data have predictive power, narrowing the field of planets, or moons, that might harbor life.

zh: 大自然能够提供人类所需要的与地球构成参照的重要实验数据，包括刚走出冰河期的世界、跌入温室气体地狱的世界、年轻的世界、古老的世界、荒芜的世界和可能充满生命的世界。
en: Nature has the critical experimental data that we need to finally place Earth in context, within a zoo of worlds emerging from ice ages, worlds descending into greenhouse hells, young worlds, old worlds, barren worlds, and possibly worlds teeming with life.

zh: 而这意味着人类将有新的数据来引导行星管理工作。
en: And that means that we will have new data to steer decisions about planetary stewardship.

zh: 换句话讲，宇宙扩张可以帮助人类理清身处其中的复杂陆地生态系统和历史。
en: In other words, the cosmic sprawl can help us disentangle the complex terrestrial systems and histories of which we are a part.

zh: 这绝非无聊之举，相反可能帮助我们克服在科技领域的无知。
en: This is not a frivolous exercise. On the contrary, it could be the key to overcoming our scientific ignorance.

zh: 我们或许可以猜测未来几十年全球变暖的总体后果，但仍然难以预测遥远的未来会发生什���以及具体的细节。
en: We might guess the general consequences of global warming in the next couple of decades, but the details remain hard to predict, as does the distant future.

zh: 生物网络、化学平衡不断变化、物种灭绝、新的生态系统逐渐形成的同时旧的系统逐渐瓦解。
en: Biological networks change, chemical balances change, species go extinct, ecosystems unravel, and new ones emerge.

zh: 宇宙环境在相关研究中可能会很有价值。
en: Cosmic context would go a long way in sorting this out.

zh: 很多人无法接受在如此不食人间烟火的课题上浪费时间和资源。
en: For many people, the idea of spending time and resources on such otherworldly pursuits is difficult to swallow.

zh: 但要想保持人类的长期繁盛，就需要避免在重大决策时犯下错误。
en: But if we are to sustain our species into the distant future, we need to make big decisions correctly.

zh: 现在是时候认真对待长远视角，因为我们以前的短视已经带来了问题。
en: It is time to take the long view seriously, because we have tried the short view, and it has not worked.

zh: 加州噩梦
en: California Bad Dreaming

zh: 斯坦福 — — 在中央政府财政问题困扰众多经济体的同时，一场可与之媲美的危机正在席卷世界各地众多的地方政府。
en: STANFORD – While central governments’ fiscal problems plague many economies, a parallel crisis is enveloping many subnational governments around the world.

zh: 从西班牙到中国到美国到意大利，包括地区、州、省、市、镇在内的各级政府所面对的财政挑战异常艰巨。
en: From Spain to China to the United States to Italy, these governments – regions, states, provinces, cities, and towns – face immense fiscal challenges.

zh: 上级政府被迫出手挽救资不抵债的地方政府，甚至可能因此受到牵连而遭遇债券降级。 西班牙、意大利和中国的任务落到了国家政府的头上，而美国则需要州政府担负挽救市镇的职责。
en: Higher levels of government are “on the hook” to bail out local insolvent governments, and may even suffer bond downgrades as a result; in Spain, Italy, and China, that role falls to the national government, and for US cities and towns, to their states.

zh: 各国地方财政灾难的性质和成因有很多相似之处。
en: There are many similarities within and among countries in terms of the nature and causes of these local fiscal calamities.

zh: 地方官员根本不考虑未来可能付出的代价，在经济繁荣期利用不断增长的财政收入资助特殊项目，或提高工资福利。
en: Local officials used growing revenues during the boom to fund pet projects or boost pay and benefits, with little regard to future costs.

zh: 经济陷入低迷后，来自中央财政的补贴收入锐减，票据到期。
en: In the downturn, revenues and subsidies from the central government collapsed and the bills came due.

zh: 极富创意的会计花招掩盖了问题的严重性，现在已经到了清算的时候。
en: Creative accounting gimmicks masked the full extent of the problem. Now comes the reckoning.

zh: 中国地方政府利用地方政府融资平台（LGFV）避开直接借贷禁令，为当地企业提供融资。
en: To finance local businesses, Chinese local governments use local-government financing vehicles (LGFVs) to circumvent bans on direct borrowing.

zh: 西班牙住宅及就业市场萎缩导致财政收入急剧下降。
en: In Spain, housing and employment collapses have hammered revenue.

zh: 即将陷入债务违约的流言充斥着西西里岛，因罗马紧缩开支导致的借贷成本骤增迫使西西里岛总督提出辞职。
en: Rumors of an imminent default swirl around Sicily, whose governor has resigned as borrowing soared after cutbacks from Rome.

zh: 由前美联储主席保罗·沃尔克任联席主席的特别工作组发表全新报告，指出因养老金和医疗保健费用无着，美国不少州的中长期财政前景极其黯淡。
en: A new report from a task force co-chaired by former Federal Reserve Chairman Paul Volcker indicates that unfunded pension and health-care costs make many American states’ medium- and longer-run fiscal prospects bleak.

zh: 加州财政危机也可以警示世界各地的地方政府。
en: California’s fiscal crises may also provide lessons for subnational governments around the world.

zh: 有三个加州城市不久前宣告破产：包括美国有史以来最大的破产城市斯托克顿；第二大破产城市圣贝纳迪诺和猛犸湖。
en: Three California cities have recently declared bankruptcy: Stockton, the largest American city ever to do so; San Bernardino, the second-largest bankrupt city; and Mammoth Lakes.

zh: 传言认为康普顿会下一个宣布破产；多数观察家预计将有更多城市加入到这个队伍。
en: Compton is rumored to be next; most observers expect more to follow.

zh: 加州面临新一轮巨额财政赤字，但杰里·布朗州长今年的年度预算开支却大幅增加。
en: The state faces another large budget deficit, yet Governor Jerry Brown’s budget this year includes a substantial spending increase.

zh: 今年11月布朗的公民投票将把加州个人所得税的最高税率提高到13.3 % ， 这也是美国各地所得税率的最高值。
en: Brown’s ballot initiative this November would raise California’s top personal income-tax rate to 13.3%, the nation’s highest.

zh: 按照布朗的说法此次加税只是一项临时性举措，但这项举措却需要持续七年之久。
en: According to Brown, the tax hike would be temporary, yet it would last seven years.

zh: 此外，他还声称与加州臭名昭著的高薪强势公务员工会谈判达成了5%的减薪。
en: Meanwhile, he claims to be tough on California’s notoriously well-paid and powerful public-employee unions by negotiating a 5% pay cut.

zh: 但协议细节却显示减薪幅度仅为1.6 % ， 而工作时数却下降多达5 % 。
en: But the details reveal a net 1.6% pay cut in exchange for a 5% reduction in work hours.

zh: 各城市纷纷宣告破产，以躲避成倍增长的养老金及医疗费用所带来的压力。
en: Cities are declaring bankruptcy to escape the pressure of exponentially rising pension and health costs.

zh: 与州政府不同，市政府甚至削减了必要的服务，其中包括将警察和消防员人数缩减20 % 。
en: In contrast to the state, cities have even cut back essential services, including 20% reductions in police and fire personnel.

zh: 破产后地方政府可以重新谈判其债券债务，或许还可以重新谈判退休职工养老金和医疗费用（由破产法官最终裁定 ） 。
en: Bankruptcy should allow local governments to renegotiate their bond debt and, perhaps, their retired employees’ pension and health-care costs (that’s up to a bankruptcy judge).

zh: 州政府将从破产地方政府手中接管基本的公共服务。
en: The state would be expected to take over essential public services from bankrupt local governments.

zh: 但州政府自身的财政形势也极为严峻，各市所面临的问题之一就是来自州政府的拨款数大幅降低。
en: But the state itself is in dire financial straits; one of the cities’ problems is the sharp curtailment of state funds to localities.

zh: 即使存在如此众多的困难，布朗还在旧金山至洛杉矶的高铁项目上给加州造成了极大的浪费。
en: Despite these problems, Brown has committed California to a San Francisco-to-Los Angeles high-speed rail boondoggle.

zh: 为了将预算成本从1000亿美元削减至680亿美元，需要利用现有的某些低速轨道，很可能造成洛杉矶到旧金山的旅行时间翻番，达5－6小时。
en: To get the cost projections down to $68 billion from a $100 billion estimate, some existing low-speed rail will be used, likely doubling the time it takes to travel from Los Angeles to San Francisco to 5-6 hours.

zh: 加州将很有可能无法负担整个项目，致使位于人烟稀少的中央山谷的一期工程陷于荒废。
en: California will most likely be unable to pay for the entire project, leaving little use for the first segment in the sparsely populated Central Valley.

zh: 而且就算该项目完成也将不会是什么高速铁路，但却会在今后几十年内大量分流基本政府服务所急需的资金。
en: And, if the project somehow is completed, it will be a not-so-high-speed rail that will drain badly needed resources from other essential government services for many decades.

zh: 从这些令人痛惜的事实中可以汲取重要的教训。
en: These sorry episodes reveal some important lessons.

zh: 一党政府削弱问责制并滋生傲慢。
en: One-party government weakens accountability and breeds hubris.

zh: 民主党几十年来一直控制着加州的立法机关，长期听命于公务员工会、环保人士、辩护律师和教师工会等该党最强大的特殊利益群体。
en: The California legislature has been controlled by the Democratic Party for decades, and it takes its cue from its party’s most powerful special interests: public-employee unions, environmentalists, trial lawyers, and teachers’ unions.

zh: 他们炮制出一项极端进步的社会实验：加州人口仅占全���总人口的12 % ， 却有着超过30%的福利家属。
en: They have concocted an extremely progressive social experiment: with 12% of the US population, California has more than 30% of its welfare dependents.

zh: 从20世纪80年代中到2005年，加州人口仅增长1000万，而医疗补助受益人却猛增了700万之多；所得税纳税人仅增长150,000，而监狱人口却增长了115,000之多。
en: From the mid-1980’s to 2005, California's population grew by 10 million, while Medicaid recipients soared by seven million; tax filers paying income taxes rose by just 150,000; and the prison population swelled by 115,000.

zh: 加州不仅所得税畸高，而且财政收入很不稳定。
en: The state income tax is not only uncompetitively high, but the revenues are volatile.

zh: 在经济和股市持续上升的情况下，由于极端的累进所得税制，财政收入的增速远远高于工资收入的增速（在情况最好的年份，1%工资最高的纳税人所缴纳的所得税占该州的将近一半 ） 。
en: In the economic and stock-market upswing, revenues roll in far more rapidly than incomes rise, owing to the extremely progressive income tax (in good years, the top 1% pays about half the state’s income taxes).

zh: 立法机关花钱的架势就好像高收入会永远继续下去似的。
en: The legislature spends it as if the elevated revenues will continue forever.

zh: 之后不可避免的经济衰退和股市崩盘令该州陷入到危机状态。
en: Then the inevitable recession and stock-market collapse plunges the state into crisis.

zh: 进步社会实验严重出轨，以致于州政府无法可靠地为最需要的群体提供从司法到教育等最基本的服务。
en: The progressive social experiment has gone so severely off-track that the state cannot even dependably provide essential services, from courts to education, for the most needy.

zh: 因此，曾经在美国独领风骚的加州经济现在远远落后也就不值得大惊小怪了。
en: Not surprisingly, California’s economy, which used to outperform the rest of the US, now substantially underperforms.

zh: 加州10.8%的失业率高出全国平均水平近三分之一，且高于除内华达和罗德岛之外的全美每一个州。
en: The unemployment rate, at 10.8%, is almost one-third higher than the national average, and higher than every other state except Nevada and Rhode Island.

zh: 加州在科技、娱乐和农业领域仍具备很强的实力。
en: California still has great strengths in technology, entertainment, and agriculture.

zh: 但民众和政客都必须更谨慎地批准目标服务；针对更大范围的经济活动和人口调降税率、改革税制（几乎半数的人不用缴纳州所得税 ） ； 并推动该州低效项目的现代化，降低开支，改善结果。
en: But citizens and politicians alike must agree to target services far more carefully; reform the tax system with lower rates on a broader base of economic activity and people (almost half pay no state income tax); and modernize inefficient state programs to spend less and produce far better outcomes.

zh: 这也是全世界机构臃肿、债务缠身的中央和地方政府的完美出路，这一点绝不是什么巧合。
en: Not coincidentally, that’s a perfect prescription for bloated, debt-ridden central and subnational governments worldwide.

zh: 加州之死
en: California Dying

zh: 伯克利-虽然奥巴马新政府统领着全球注意力，美国的未来却可能-正如以前曾多次出现的那样-由其最大州决定。
en: Berkeley – While the new Obama administration is commanding global attention, America’s future may be written – as so many times before – in and by its largest state.

zh: 曾几何时，加利福尼亚州还是美国式的乐观主义和功成名就的指路灯，现在，该州却集中体现了美国所面临的困境 – 而且还显示了美国国内有多少窘境还没有暴露出来。
en: Once the lodestar for American optimism and achievement, California now illustrates the difficulties confronting the United States – and how much more can still go wrong domestically.

zh: 加州作为美国50个州中人口最多和最富裕的州，长期以来一直是从世界各地涌来的富有才华和创业精神的人们心中的一盏充满机会的灯塔。
en: The most populous and wealthiest of America’s 50 states, California has long been a beacon of opportunity for talented and enterprising people from all over the world.

zh: 每4个加州居民中就一个是在国外出生。
en: One in every four California residents was born in a foreign country.

zh: 加州的两个最有名的行业，高科技的硅谷和电影基地好莱坞，依赖国外人才的引进。
en: California’s two most famous industries, Silicon Valley and Hollywood, depend on infusions of talent from abroad.

zh: 因受益于发展中国家消费者不断增长的需求，加州强大的农业部门大量地出口食品。
en: Its robust agricultural sector is a massive exporter of food, benefiting from the growing appetites of consumers in developing countries.

zh: 然而，若单独计算加州技术和企业的能量，它就是世界第八大经济体，但该州功能失常的政治制度已经把它推到了财政破产的边缘。
en: Yet California’s technological and entrepreneurial might – standing alone, the state would be the world’s eighth largest economy – coexists with a dysfunctional political system that has brought it to the edge of fiscal bankruptcy.

zh: 5月19日，该州的选民在一次特别选举中，否决了一系列为达到预算平衡所需要的增加税收和削减支出的方案。
en: On May 19, the state’s voters, in a special election, rejected an array of tax increases and spending cuts required to balance its budget.

zh: 现在的加州面临两种选择：要么是尴尬地靠联邦政府救助，要么是在相当长的一段时间内由法官来治理；根据加州法律，法官有权废除劳动协议、取消合同并大规模重组州财政义务。
en: Now, California faces either an embarrassing federal bailout or a prolonged period of rule by judges, who under California law have the power to vacate labor agreements, abrogate contracts, and generally restructure the state’s financial commitments.

zh: 对于奥巴马总统，加州危机则危及了他自己的改革进程表。
en: For President Barack Obama, California’s crisis imperils his own reform agenda.

zh: 因为美国其它州也面临困难的财政状况；救助加州的政治代价，可能会是也必须救助其它几十个州。
en: Because other American states also face tough fiscal conditions, the political price of bailing out California may be bailing out dozens of other states too.

zh: 大规模的对州政府的救助给奥巴马政府增添了巨大的压力，并将暴露出美国的国家治理制度的薄弱环节。
en: A massive state bailout, while adding enormously to pressure on Obama’s government, would expose the weak link in the US system of governance.

zh: 在所谓“单一性”的国家里，如英国。 法国、中国或肯尼 亚，基本上只有单一的一套政府义务：只有一支警察部队，公立学校教师只受雇于一个机构，只有一个总体的养老金制度，等等。
en: So-called “unitary” nations such as Britain, France, China, or Kenya, essentially have a single set of government obligations: one national police force, one employer for all public school teachers, one overall pension system, etc.

zh: 而相比之下，美国的政府形式却是“非对称”的， 它允许很多重叠的政府实体- 仅在加州就有7000个-举债、雇用和解雇员工并进行征税。
en: By contrast, the US has an “asymmetric” form of government, which allows many overlapping government entities – 7,000 in California alone – to incur debts, hire and fire employees, and impose taxes.

zh: 要想弄明白这种不对称性之中蕴含的道理是不容易的。
en: Making sense of these asymmetries is difficult.

zh: 当金融市场集中关注于联邦政府的财政状况时，人们却没有关注政府作为一个整体担负的义务的广度。
en: When financial markets concentrate on the fiscal health of the federal government, they miss the extent of government obligations as a whole.

zh: 治理美国的复杂性，威胁到奥巴马通过赤字开支以刺激经济的决定所带来的利益。
en: The complexity of American governance threatens the benefits of Obama’s decision to stimulate the economy through deficit spending.

zh: 虽然联邦政府在扩大，但如加利福尼亚州这样的州政府却在萎缩。
en: While the national government expands, state governments, such as California’s, contract.

zh: 此外，加州的危机不仅仅是经济上的。
en: Moreover, California’s crisis is more than an economic one.

zh: 加州是美国最多元化的州; 其3700万人口中非白人占了一半以上。
en: California is the most diverse US state; more than half of its 37 million people are non-white.

zh: 对于笃信多元化好处的人来说，加州代表了人类历史上最大的社会实验，它把不同背景的人融合在一起，这样的方式在德国、中国或巴西是难以想象的。
en: For believers in the benefits of diversity, California represents the largest social experiment in human history, bringing people of different backgrounds together in a way unimaginable in, say, Germany, China, or Brazil.

zh: 加州州长施瓦辛格，在他成为电影明星之前也是一个移民（奥地利移民 ） 。
en: California’s governor, Arnold Schwarzenegger, was an immigrant (from Austria) before he was a movie star.

zh: 在他六年的州长生涯中，他曾多次试图绕过两极分化的州政府-甚至年度预算也需要三分之二多数的通过-而直接向选民呼吁。
en: In his six years in office, he has repeatedly tried to bypass a polarized state legislature – even the annual budget requires a two-thirds majority – by appealing directly to voters.

zh: 投票倡议的方法建立于100年前，它赋予普通公民于权利，但近几十年来，这一进程已被为自己谋利的精英们所窃取。
en: Ballot initiatives were created 100 years ago to empower ordinary citizens, but in recent decades the process has been captured by self-serving elites.

zh: 即使当加州的公路破旧不堪以及公共机构衰败的时候-这是开支太少和公共工人太昂贵所造成的-加州继续经营着美国最好的公立大学。
en: Even as California’s roads fall apart and public institutions decline – the result of too little spending and public workers who are too expensive – the state continues to operate the finest set of public universities in the US.

zh: 但是，加州大学成功的秘诀是它能从私人和联邦政府那里拿到更高数额的资金。
en: But the secret of the University of California’s success is its ability to obtain ever-higher amounts of funding from private sources and the federal government.

zh: 脱离加州政体的情况在加州的经济引擎里也是如此。
en: Disengagement from the California polity also is true of the state’s economic engines.

zh: 英特尔公司是世界上最大的芯片制造商和硅谷的主心骨，但它20年多年里却没有在加州建过一家工厂。
en: Intel, the world’s biggest chip maker and a Silicon Valley mainstay, hasn’t built a factory in California for more than 20 years.

zh: 好莱坞越来越多的电影在别处拍摄。
en: Hollywood shoots an increasing number of films elsewhere.

zh: 而农业在很大程度上也依赖来自墨西哥的非法劳工，这些工人暂时住在农田旁边，拿到了钱就寄回国。
en: Agriculture relies heavily on illegal workers from Mexico, who live temporarily near the fields and take their earnings back home.

zh: 如何在一个如此多元化的州里建立一个统一的社区，仍然是一个难以实现的挑战。
en: How to forge a single community out of a state so diverse remains an elusive challenge.

zh: 包括施瓦辛格在内的一些有影响力的人士认为，加州需要一部新宪法以限制投票倡议法，使预算更容易通过。
en: Some influential people, including Schwarzenegger, say the state needs a new constitution that would restrict ballot initiatives and make budgets easier to pass.

zh: 更为激进的思想家们则坚持认为，加州是无法治理的，应把该州一分为二，甚至一分为三。
en: More radical thinkers insist that California is ungovernable and should be broken into two or even three states.

zh: 拆分加州当然需要在华盛顿的联邦政府的批准，而在华盛顿政府中，加州选出的代表-主要来自奥巴马的民主党-在美国历史上她们从未像现在这样大权在握。
en: Creating more Californias would of course require the approval of the federal government in Washington, where elected representatives from California – mainly from Obama’s Democratic Party – have more power today than at perhaps any time in US history.

zh: 众议院多数党领袖南希·佩洛西就是从旧金山来的。
en: Nancy Pelosi, the House majority leader, is from San Francisco.

zh: 加州掌管着众议院中两个最强大的委员会：能源商业与教育劳动委员会。
en: Californians run the two most powerful House committees, Energy and Commerce and Education and Labor.

zh: 两个最有影响力的参议员也来自加利福尼亚州。
en: Two of the most influential senators also come from California.

zh: 为什么在她们的州滑向毁灭边缘的时候，这些在华盛顿的政治家们却置若罔闻呢？ 这在相当程度上说明了美国政治中的失败之处。
en: Why these Washington politicians are idle while their state slides towards ruin says much about what’s broken in American politics.

zh: 施瓦辛格是共和党人，而民主党人私下则希望他失败。
en: Schwarzenegger is a Republican, so Democrats privately wish him to fail.

zh: 还有一个更深层的问题：依赖于特殊利益集团的各方政客们已经习惯于对严重问题进行否认。
en: There’s a deeper problem: politicians across the spectrum, beholden to special interests, are habituated to denying serious problems.

zh: 奥巴马将被迫帮助仔细推敲出一种妥协方案以使加州的财政不至于破产。
en: Obama will be forced to help craft a compromise to keep the state financially afloat.

zh: 然而，作为条件，他可能会坚持要加州人民付更高的税收，而加州已经是美国课税最重的州之一了。
en: Yet as a condition, he may insist that Californians, who are already among the most heavily taxed Americans, pay more.

zh: 如果加州人民不同意，奥巴马可能面临对他政策的日益严重的反抗情绪-他的政策是把扩大政府规模作为应对美国国内困境的主要对策。
en: If Californians refuse, Obama could face a widening revolt – against the idea of expanded government as the chief response to what ails America at home.

zh: 加州与特朗普之战
en: California’s War With Trump

zh: 发自斯坦福 — — 如果您回顾过去媒体报道特朗普的一系列头条，就可以察觉出在政治，经济和文化力量方面的全球性转变对美国及世界产生的影响可能要比单纯的特朗普执政更为深远。
en: STANFORD – If one looks past the headlines of the media’s full-time Donald Trump coverage, one can discern a global shift in political, economic, and cultural forces that might prove far more consequential for America and the world than the actual Trump presidency.

zh: 而这些变革的其中一个主要内容则是中央和地方政府，以及国家和超国家政府之间的关系冲突。
en: Chief among these changes is the fraying of relations between central and subnational, and national and supranational, governments.

zh: 美国人主要通过学校、道路，警察和医院等事务来与州和地方政府进行互动。
en: Americans primarily interact with government at the state and local level, through schools and roads, police and hospitals.

zh: 在全美各州中加利福尼亚州对更大地方自治权的呼声最高，偶尔也会和加泰罗尼亚分离主义者或英国脱欧者一唱一和。
en: And in California, among other states, demands for greater local autonomy are growing louder, occasionally echoing the rhetoric of Catalan secessionists or Brexiteers in the United Kingdom.

zh: 而几乎垄断了加州及下属地方政府政权的民主党正试图否定特朗普的几乎全部政策。
en: With near-monopoly control of California’s state and local governments, the Democrats are trying to negate the effects of virtually all of Trump’s policies.

zh: 例如州立法机关的一项法案将抵消新联邦税法关于州收入和财产税减免额的限制 — — 由于加州税率排名全美前列且房价昂贵，新税法将对其造成沉重打击。
en: For example, a bill in the state legislature would offset the new federal tax law’s limit on state income- and property-tax deductions – a provision that will hit California hard because it has one of the highest tax rates in the country, and its residents own expensive homes.

zh: 而根据拟议的州法律，加州人将被允许将自己的州税作为可抵税慈善捐款“捐赠”给一个州立慈善机构。
en: Under the proposed state law, Californians would be allowed to “donate” their state taxes to a state shell charity as tax-deductible charitable contributions.

zh: 但美国国税局会很快看穿这一诡计。
en: But the Internal Revenue Service will quickly see through this ruse.

zh: 由于慈善捐款只有在捐赠者获得的附带价值不超过其捐赠额时才可在联邦一级抵扣税，而上述州法案安排显然不属于这种情况。
en: Charitable contributions are deductible at the federal level only if the donor receives no more than incidental value for the contribution, which obviously wouldn’t be the case in this situation.

zh: 事实上在一场慈善晚宴中甚至连一顿饭的合理市场价格都无法用来抵税。
en: In fact, not even the fair-market value of a meal at a charity dinner is deductible.

zh: 明年实施的新联邦税法也会废除2010年《平价医疗法案 》 （ Obamacare）的个人强制条款 — — 该条款会对未购买健康保险的人处以罚款。
en: Effective next year, the new federal tax law also repeals the individual mandate of the 2010 Affordable Care Act (Obamacare), which imposes a fine on those who do not purchase health insurance.

zh: 由于此撤销举动可能导致奥巴马医疗的保费激增，许多加州民主党人都要求像加拿大和欧洲那样设立一个由政府资助的单一付费医疗保健体系，即便这一体系可能会使州预算增加三倍。
en: Because the repeal could accelerate a surge in Obamacare insurance premiums, many California Democrats are demanding a single-payer government-funded health-care system, like those in Canada and Europe. Never mind that such a system might triple the state budget.

zh: 此外由于加州认为自己是绿色能源的先锋，一系列州下属机构都对特朗普关于开放海上石油钻探的建议做出了回应，威胁要禁止石油在本州境内运输，甚至连现有管道也不准使用。
en: Moreover, because California considers itself the vanguard of green energy, state agencies have responded to Trump’s proposal to open up offshore oil drilling by threatening to ban the transportation of oil through the state, even in existing pipelines.

zh: 而最具争议的分歧则是移民政策。
en: The source of the most contentious disagreement is immigration policy.

zh: 自1989年宣布自己为“庇护所城市”以来，旧金山已经禁止其警察部门与联邦移民机构进行全面合作。
en: Since declaring itself a “sanctuary city” in 1989, San Francisco has prohibited its police force from cooperating fully with federal immigration agents.

zh: 而去年整个州都已被宣布为“避难所 ” ， 加州检察长萨维尔·贝塞拉（Xavier Becerra）现在还计划对与联邦移民官员合作的雇主予以罚款。
en: But, as of last year, the entire state has been declared a “sanctuary,” and California Attorney General Xavier Becerra now plans to fine employers that cooperate with federal immigration officials.

zh: 随着联邦和州执法机构之间的紧张局势不断上升，许多加州人已经陷入了要么支付州罚款要么违反联邦法律的尴尬境地。
en: With tensions between federal and state law-enforcement agencies rising, many Californians are being put in the untenable position of paying state fines or violating federal laws.

zh: 在所有这些事务上都存在两个互相对立却部分有效的论点。
en: On all of these issues, there are two opposing, partly valid arguments. Consider immigration.

zh: 以移民为例，虽然绝大多数非法移民都在努力操持家庭并改善自己子女的生活，但也有些人犯下严重罪行或参加暴力团伙。
en: While the overwhelming majority of illegal immigrants are working to support their families and improve the lives of their children, some commit serious crimes or belong to violent gangs.

zh: 特朗普侧重于后者引发的边界安全问题，通常援引那些被反复驱逐而又越境潜回的非法移民杀害美国人的例子。
en: Trump focuses on the latter to make the case for increased border security, often invoking examples of Americans killed by illegal immigrants who have returned after being repeatedly deported.

zh: 而特朗普的反对者则认为非法移民本身往往是严重犯罪的受害者或证人，但由于害怕被驱逐出境所以不愿去警局配合调查。
en: Trump’s opponents argue that illegal immigrants themselves are often victims of – or witnesses to – serious crimes, but are reluctant to go to the police because they fear deportation.

zh: 双方都有道理；但不幸的是，他们已经停止了彼此之间的合作。
en: Both sides have a point; but, sadly, they have ceased engaging with each other.

zh: 以至于特朗普政府最近提出一项对两方面都有所兼顾的移民改革计划立刻遭到了反移民活动家和亲移民分子两方的夹攻。
en: Thus, when the Trump White House recently proposed a plan for immigration reform that offered something to both sides, it was instantly denounced by anti-immigration activists and pro-immigration crusaders alike.

zh: 具体而言，该计划将为180万在儿童时期非法入境美国的人提供永久合法身份和获得公民身份的途径，这个数字也是前总统奥巴马童年入境暂缓遣返计划（Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals）所保护的人数的两倍有多。
en: Specifically, the plan would grant permanent legal status and a path to citizenship for 1.8 million people who were brought or sent to the country illegally as children. That is more than twice the number of people who were protected under former President Barack Obama’s Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA) program.

zh: 作为交换条件，特朗普希望在墨西哥边界增设250亿美元的安保措施 — — 包括他承诺的隔离墙 — — 以及限制以家庭为基础的合法移民并鼓励高技能移民的改革，这也是大多数发达国家的常态。
en: In exchange, Trump wants an additional $25 billion for security on the border with Mexico – including his promised wall – and reforms to limit family-based legal immigration and favor higher-skilled workers, which is the norm in most developed countries.

zh: 反移民强硬派拒绝接受特朗普这个类似于大赦的计划。
en: Anti-immigration hardliners have rejected Trump’s plan as a form of amnesty.

zh: 与此同时众议院民主党领袖南希·佩洛西（Nancy Pelosi）则将其描述为“让美国再次变白”的计划。
en: At the same time, the Democratic leader in the House of Representatives, Nancy Pelosi, has described it as a scheme to “make America white again.”

zh: 但是这是一个难题：特朗普政府的计划是近几十年来最为现实的移民改革提案。
en: But here’s the rub: The Trump administration’s plan is the most realistic immigration-reform proposal in decades.

zh: 如果民主党人足够聪明，他们应当遏制住自己的仇视情绪，并认识到特朗普在反移民共和党人一方享有的信誉使其处于达成两党合作的理想位置。
en: If the Democrats were smart, they would curb their detestation, and recognize that Trump’s credibility with anti-immigration Republicans puts him in an ideal position to negotiate a bipartisan package.

zh: 随着加州继续努力否定特朗普政府的政策，人们不禁要问，其做法是否会最终导致一场宪法争议。
en: As California continues its efforts to negate the Trump administration’s policies, one wonders if its approach will lead to a constitutional challenge.

zh: 各州当然有权采取与联邦政策相悖的政策。
en: States certainly have the legal authority to adopt policies that are at odds with federal policy.

zh: 事实上，美国宪法第十修正案明确说明将那些未让渡给联邦政府的权力留给各州。
en: In fact, the Tenth Amendment of the US Constitution explicitly reserves for the states all powers not delegated to the federal government.

zh: 各州也可以起诉联邦政府，正如共和党州长和检察长推翻若干奥巴马时代的法规和行政命令那样。
en: And states may sue the federal government, as Republican governors and attorneys general have done to overturn several Obama-era regulations and executive orders.

zh: 但是美国最高法院一再裁定州不能抵消或违反联邦法律 — — 南部一些州在20世纪中叶抵制学校种族融合时曾要求享有这类权利。
en: But the US Supreme Court has repeatedly ruled that states may not nullify or contravene federal law – a right some southern states claimed in the mid-twentieth century to resist school integration.

zh: 这一宪法原则可追溯至19世纪中叶，当时最高法院推翻了威斯康星州最高法院一项抵制臭名昭著的1850年《逃亡奴隶法案》的裁定。
en: This is a constitutional principle that dates back to the mid-nineteenth century, when the Supreme Court overturned a Wisconsin Supreme Court ruling that nullified the abominable Fugitive Slave Act of 1850.

zh: 在不到九个月后，加州将举行州长，1个参议院席位和53个众议院席位的选举，因此对特朗普的“抵制”言论可能会变得更加激烈 — — 而且各级法院可能会发现自己越来越陷入了分辨什么是合法以及不合法的忙碌之中。
en: In less than nine months, California will hold elections for governor, a US Senate seat, and 53 seats in the House. So, the rhetoric of “resistance” to Trump is likely to become even more heated – and the courts are likely to find themselves ever busier sorting out what is and is not legal.

zh: 反击大银行的恐吓
en: Calling the Big Banks’ Bluff

zh: 柏林—2008年，G20决心不让一家具系统重要性的银行倒闭，从当时看，这一决定是明智的，因为当时全球金融系统面临崩溃风险。
en: BERLIN – The G-20’s decision in November 2008 not to let any systemically relevant bank perish may have seemed wise at the time, given the threat of a global financial meltdown.

zh: 但这一决定以及自此以后央行和政府的坏政策让负债过度的主要银行肆无忌惮地对其拯救者进行敲诈勒索，它们利用这一权力营造了一个自己可以在事实上免受债务负担的金融系统。
en: But that decision, and bad policies by central banks and governments since then, has given over-indebted major banks the power to blackmail their rescuers – a power that they have used to create a financial system in which they are effectively exempt from liability.

zh: 大银行能够营造这样的安排的原因是一个潜在威胁：如果具系统重要性的银行陷入破产，那么金融部门 — — 以及与之相关的经济支付系统 — — 将会崩溃。
en: Big banks’ ability to extort such an arrangement stems from an implicit threat: the financial sector – and with it the economy’s payment system – would collapse if a systemically important bank were ever pushed into insolvency.

zh: 但现在是时候给银行家点颜色看看了：维持支付系统可以也应该与银行破产问题区别对待。
en: But it is time to call the bankers’ bluff: maintaining the payment system can and should be separated from the problem of bank insolvency.

zh: 说到底，G20支持具系统重要性银行的决定必须有所改变。
en: Above all, the G-20’s decision to prop up systemically relevant banks must be revisited.

zh: 政府必须宣布已经做好了依法处置破产银行的准备，以此来应对银行的威胁。
en: And governments must respond to the banks’ threats by declaring their willingness to let insolvent banks be judged accordingly.

zh: 市场经济必须以盈亏的经济学原理为基础。
en: A market economy must rest on the economic principle of profit and loss.

zh: 没有破产也没有人人平等的法治精神的经济不是市场经济。
en: An economy with neither bankruptcies nor a rule of law that applies equally to all is no market economy.

zh: 法律面前人人平等这一原则必须对银行也适用。
en: The law that is valid for all other companies should apply to banks as well.

zh: 此外，政府应该通过改革破产法担保破产银行的对非金融企业的贷款以及私人客户的活期、定期和储蓄存款。
en: Moreover, governments should guarantee insolvent banks’ loans to non-financial companies, as well as private customers’ current, fixed-term, and savings deposits, by reforming insolvency laws.

zh: 显然，政府不应该担保不影响客户存款的银行间债务。
en: Certainly, governments should not guarantee interbank liabilities that do not affect customer deposits.

zh: 破产官员应该接管银行，并确保国家担保所承担的支付都是合理的，而这些支付应该通过央行再融资进行。
en: An insolvency administrator would manage the bank and ensure that all payments for which a state guarantee is given are carried out properly, with refinancing of these payments continuing to take place via the central bank.

zh: 在采取了这些步骤之后，支付系统将会是安全的。
en: After taking these steps, the payments system would be safe.

zh: 在发生破产案时，银行的电脑不会关闭，其雇员不会被马上遣散，支付交易也不会陷入崩溃。
en: In case of insolvency, a bank’s computers would not be turned off, its employees would not instantly be dismissed, and payment transactions would not collapse.

zh: 存款挤兑也不会发生，因为官方担保它们不会因银行破产而受影响。
en: Nor would a run on savings deposits occur, given the official guarantees that they remain unaffected by a bank’s insolvency.

zh: 毕竟，只要政府点头，银行票据就可以成为货币，从而与储蓄存款别无二致，这意味着储户并不能因为持有现金而得到好处。
en: After all, even a simple banknote is money only because the government says so, and thus is no different from savings deposits, which means that no saver has an advantage from holding cash.

zh: 因此也就没有必要挤兑了。
en: So there would be no need for bank runs.

zh: 当然，有意限制银行倒闭对私人活期、储蓄和定期存款的影响意味着A银行的破产可能引发B银行跟着破产。 对于B银行，会出现相同的清盘情景：储蓄存款将是安全的，支付可以来自其客户的活期存款，而贷给非金融公司的贷款也不会受到撤销。
en: Of course, the deliberate restriction of the effects of bankruptcy to accounts other than private current, savings, and fixed-term deposits means that the insolvency of bank A could lead to the insolvency of bank B. For bank B, too, the same liquidation scenario would apply: savings deposits would be safe, payments could be made from its customers’ current deposits, and loans that it granted to non-financial companies would not be revoked.

zh: 显然，多米诺效应并不会止于此处：银行A和银行B的破产可能会把银行C — — 甚至更多的银行 — — 拖入险境。
en: Obviously, the domino effect need not stop there: the insolvency of banks A and B could get a bank C – and additional banks – into trouble.

zh: 事实上，整个过度负债的部分准备金银行子系统都可能遭遇清盘。
en: Indeed, the entire over-indebted fractional reserve-banking subsystem might have to be liquidated.

zh: 但支付系统不会崩溃。
en: But the payment system would survive.

zh: 随着其他国家 — — 在国际金融一体化的基础上 — — 采取类似的有控制的破产银行清盘程序，这还能引发积极的多米诺效应。
en: This might trigger a positive domino effect as well, as other states – on grounds of international financial integration – adopt similar procedures for controlled liquidation of their own insolvent banks.

zh: 僵尸资产将被摧毁。
en: Zombie assets would be destroyed.

zh: 货币和信用的一大部分原本无非是银行间交易所产生的浮云，如今它们被排除在官方担保之外，将恢复其浮云的本来面目。
en: A large part of the money and credit that was created out of nothing from former interbank transactions, now excluded from official guarantees, would return to nothing.

zh: 然后，此前过度负债、现在已被清盘的银行可以被出售。
en: Afterwards, the liquidated, formerly over-indebted banks could be sold.

zh: 我们有权力去除金融系统中迅速增加的债务，创造一个新的、与自由企业原则和法治精神相适应的货币秩序而不产生整个支付系统崩溃的风险。
en: We have it in our power to eliminate the financial system’s rapidly growing debt and to create a new monetary order that corresponds to free-enterprise principles and the rule of law, without risking a breakdown of the entire payment system.

zh: 重塑有效银行监管 — — 不管是欧洲还是世界其他地方 — — 所需要的只是坚决抵制被银行本身绑架的意愿。
en: All that is required to revive effective bank regulation – in Europe and elsewhere – is the will to resist blackmail by the banks themselves.

zh: 外汇储备面面观
en: Call In the Reserves

zh: 中国人民银行和日本银行-以及亚洲的其他中央银行-遇到了麻烦。
en: The People’s Bank of China and the Bank of Japan – as well as other central banks in Asia – are in trouble.

zh: 它们积累了大量的外汇储备，估计超过2万亿美金。
en: They have accumulated vast foreign exchange reserves, estimated at more than $2 trillion.

zh: 问题是其中的美元储备占了绝大部分-而美元正在迅速地贬值。
en: The problem is that almost all of it is in US dollars – a currency that is rapidly losing its value.

zh: 亚洲各央行在应对政策方面似乎都乏善可陈。
en: All policy options for Asia’s central banks appear equally unattractive.

zh: 如果它们无所作为并坚定地持有美元，那么其损失只会进一步加大。
en: If they do nothing and simply hold onto the dollars, their losses will only increase.

zh: 如果它们为了让美元升值尔买入更多，也只能使同一个问题变得更严重。
en: But if they buy more, in an attempt to prop up the dollar, they will only have a bigger version of the same problem.

zh: 反之，如果他们力图使外汇储备多样化，则只会使美元贬值更快，从而造成更大的损失。
en: If, on the contrary, they try to diversify into other currencies, they will drive down the dollar faster and create greater losses.

zh: 将其他的货币作为外汇储备也很可能会遇到同样的问题。
en: They are also likely to encounter the same sort of problem with other possible reserve currencies.

zh: 欧元已被追捧为替代美元或除美元以外的另一种储备货币。
en: The euro has been touted as the replacement for or alternative to the dollar.

zh: 一些欧洲人热诚地鼓励亚洲人将他们的外汇储备多样化。
en: Some enthusiastic Europeans encouraged Asians to diversify their reserve holdings.

zh: 但在几年以后，欧元也很可能重蹈美元覆辙。
en: But the same scenario might well be repeated with the euro in a few years.

zh: 巨大的财政赤字和经济滞胀可能让外汇市场认为欧元没有前途从而引发一股抛售浪潮-因而给持有欧元的央行们带来损失。
en: Large fiscal deficits and slow growth might convince foreign exchange markets that there is little future in the euro, fueling a wave of selling – and hence losses for central bank holders.

zh: 现今人们对世界主要储备货币的担忧在历史上是有资可鉴的。
en: There is a historical parallel to today’s concern about the world’s major reserve currency.

zh: 被20世纪30年代的大萧条破坏的两次大战间的经济为我们今天提供了一系列痛苦但却重要的教训。
en: The interwar economy, shattered by the Great Depression of the early 1930’s, offers a whole series of painful, but important, lessons for the present.

zh: 在上世纪20年代，世界经济围绕着固定汇率机制重建。 在这一机制下，很多国家不以黄金的形式持有储备（这是第一次世界大战以前的惯例 ） ， 而是以外汇的形式，特别以英镑为主。
en: In the 1920’s, the world economy was reconstructed around a fixed exchange rate regime in which many countries held their reserves not in gold (as was the practice before the First World War) but in foreign exchange, especially in British pounds sterling.

zh: 在20年代期间，一些英镑的官方持有人对于英国对外贸易方面差强人意的表现颇为担心。 正如现今的美元一样，这意味着该货币的价值被高估了因此贬值不可避免。
en: During the course of the 1920’s, some of the official holders of pounds grew nervous about Britain’s weak foreign trade performance, which suggested that, like today’s dollar, the currency was over-valued and would inevitably decline.

zh: 外国的央行们询问英格兰银行是否在考虑改变其英镑汇率的立场。
en: Foreign central banks asked whether the Bank of England was contemplating changing its view of the pound’s exchange rate.

zh: 回答当然是该行无意放弃英镑与黄金的联系，坚挺的英镑代表着一种深远和长期的承诺（这与今天的美国财长约翰·斯诺确认“强势美元”的立场如出一辙 ） 。
en: Of course they were told that there was no intention of abandoning Britain’s link to gold, and that the strong pound represented a deep and long commitment (in the same way that US Treasury Secretary John Snow today affirms the idea of a “strong dollar”).

zh: 只有法国不理会英国的声明并大量抛售英镑储备。
en: Only France ignored British statements and substantially sold off its sterling holdings.

zh: 当英镑贬值不可避免地在1931年9月20-21日发生时，许多外国的央行损失惨重并被斥责为对外汇储备处置不当。
en: When the inevitable British devaluation came on September 20-21, 1931, many foreign central banks were badly hit and were blamed for mismanaging their reserves.

zh: 多家央行的职责被解除，相关人员名誉扫地。
en: Many were stripped of their responsibilities, and the persons involved were discredited.

zh: 荷兰央行行长杰拉德·威瑟林引咎辞职。 英镑的崩溃给该机构造成的毁灭性打击使他最终以自杀谢罪。
en: The Dutch central banker Gerard Vissering resigned and eventually killed himself as a result of the destruction wrought on his institution’s balance sheet by the pound’s collapse.

zh: 一些与英国有巨额贸易的国家或一些英联邦国家在1931年后继续以英镑作为其主要外汇储备。
en: Some countries that traded a great deal with Britain, or were in the orbit of British imperial rule, continued to hold reserves in pounds after 1931.

zh: 在第二次世界大战期间，英国充分利用了这一点，因此虽然英镑已不复昔日荣光，但阿根廷、埃及、特别是印度仍成为了主要的英镑债权国。
en: During World War II, Britain took advantage of this, and Argentina, Egypt, and India, in particular, built up huge claims on sterling, although it was an unattractive currency.

zh: 大战结束时，他们想到了使用这笔储备的新方法：花掉它们。
en: At the war’s end, they thought of a new way of using their reserves: spend them.

zh: 其结果使这些储备促生了经济民粹主义。
en: Consequently, these reserves provided the fuel for economic populism.

zh: 拥有大量英镑结余的国家-尼赫鲁的印度、纳塞尔的埃及和庇隆的阿根廷-都掀起了主要的国有化进程和公共事业领域的开支热潮：他们修建铁路、水坝、钢厂。
en: Large holders of sterling balances – Nehru’s India, Nasser’s Egypt, and Peron’s Argentina – all embarked on major nationalizations and a public sector spending spree: they built railways, dams, steel works.

zh: 英镑储备成为庞大而低效的国家计划体制的起点。 这一体制给所有相关国家的经济成长都带来了长期的损害。
en: The sterling balances proved to be the starting point of vast and inefficient state planning regimes that did long-term harm to growth prospects in all the countries that took this course.

zh: 当今拥有庞大外汇储备的国家会重蹈覆辙吗？
en: Could something similar be in store for today’s holders of large reserves?

zh: 来自印度，要以美元储备支持主要基础设施现代化项目的声浪甚高。 而中国和日本也面临相似的问题。
en: The most explicit call for the use of dollar reserves to finance a major program of infrastructure modernization has come from India, which has a similar problem to the one facing China and Japan.

zh: 它在其他国家也会具有同样的诱惑力。
en: It will be similarly tempting elsewhere.

zh: 在被诱惑者们屈从之前就必须把这种诱惑铲除。
en: This temptation needs to be removed before the tempted yield to it.

zh: 储备持有代表着一种过时的理念。 我们应该想出办法削弱其在国际金融体系运作中的中心地位。
en: Reserve holdings represent an outdated concept, and the world should contemplate some way of making them less central to the operation of the international financial system.

zh: 确切地说，外汇储备在一种固定汇率体制下会起到重要的平衡作用。
en: To be sure, reserves are important to smooth out imbalances in a fixed exchange rate regime.

zh: 但自上世纪70年代以来，世界已经向着更灵活汇率的方向迈进了。
en: But the world has moved since the 1970’s in the direction of greater exchange rate flexibility.

zh: 外汇储备显然对只生产少数商品的国家甚为重要-特别是日用品生产国-因为他们要面对世界市场价格不可预测的大幅波动。
en: Reserves are also clearly important for countries that produce only a few goods – especially commodity producers – and thus face big and unpredictable swings in world market prices.

zh: 对咖啡和可可出口的依赖需要有预防性的外汇储备。
en: Dependency on coffee or cocoa exports requires a build-up of precautionary reserves.

zh: 但这并不适用于中国、日本和印度，这些国家的出口产品是多样化的。
en: But this does not apply to China, Japan, or India, whose exports are diversified.

zh: 当今拥有巨额贸易顺差的国家不需要大量的外汇储备。
en: Today’s big surplus countries do not need large reserves.

zh: 在用这笔积累起来财富做出蠢事之前，他们应该尽快减少外汇储备。
en: They should reduce their holdings as quickly as possible, before they do something really stupid with the accumulated treasure.

zh: 颠覆柬埔寨的民主
en: The Trumping of Cambodian Democracy

zh: 华盛顿 — — 去年，柬埔寨执政的柬埔寨人民党（CPP）大幅增加了对政治对手和公民团体的压力。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Over the last year, Cambodia’s ruling party, the Cambodian People’s Party (CPP), has dramatically increased its pressure on its political opponents and civil society.

zh: 柬埔寨民主状况一直令人担忧，选举也不是彻头彻尾自由和公平的。
en: Democracy in Cambodia has always been fraught, and elections are not completely free and fair.

zh: 但这次镇压涉及范围要大得多，并引发人们更深重的关切，因为这在某种程度上是美国漠不关心所导致的后果。
en: But the current crackdown is much greater in scope, and far more concerning, in part because it is being enabled by American apathy.

zh: 东亚地区执政时间最长的非皇族统治者柬埔寨首相洪森利用手中的权力遏制批评者并查封敢于直言的媒体，包括一家独立报纸柬埔寨日报。 柬埔寨人民党还驱逐了一家总部设在美国并关注权利和民主等话题的非营利机构民主研究院，并且拘留了政治挑战者。
en: Prime Minister Hun Sen, East Asia’s longest-serving non-royal ruler, has used his power to silence critics and close outspoken media outlets, including one independent newspaper, the Cambodia Daily.The CPP has also expelled the National Democratic Institute, a US-based nonprofit that focuses on rights and democracy, and detained political challengers.

zh: 主要反对团体柬埔寨国家救助党（CNRP）的联合党首肯·索卡在9月因涉嫌叛国罪名而被捕。
en: Kem Sokha, who co-headed the main opposition group, the Cambodia National Rescue Party (CNRP), was arrested in September on dubious treason charges.

zh: 而另一位主要反对派人士桑兰西仍然在法国流亡。
en: The other main opposition figure, Sam Rainsy, remains in exile in France.

zh: 但近几周，洪森加大了压力，实际上终结了柬埔寨本就摇摇欲坠的民主。
en: But in recent weeks, Hun Sen has increased the pressure, essentially ending Cambodia’s shaky attempts at democracy.

zh: 本月早些时候，一家由柬埔寨人民党主导的法庭解散了柬埔寨国家救助党。
en: Earlier this month, a court dominated by CPP allies dissolved the CNRP.

zh: 结果导致该党很大可能无法参与明年的全国大选，这几乎可以确保洪森将继续连任柬埔寨首相。
en: As a result, the party will most likely be unable to contest national elections next year, all but ensuring that Hun Sen will win another term as prime minister.

zh: 这次裁决还可以协助洪森最终向一名家庭成员进行权力移交。
en: The ruling could also help enable Hun Sen eventually hand power to another family member.

zh: 因为担心自身的生命安全， 约半数的柬埔寨国家救助党党员已经出国。
en: Fearing for their lives, around half of CNRP lawmakers have left Cambodia.

zh: 洪森几乎毫不掩饰地滑向柬埔寨日报最后一天出版时所说的“沦为彻头彻尾的独裁统治者 ” 。
en: Hun Sen has hardly been shy about his slide toward what the Cambodia Daily, on its last day of publishing, termed a “descent into outright dictatorship.”

zh: 事实上，与其他东南亚独裁者一样，洪森现在似乎认为自己得到了全权政治委任，因为美国总统唐纳德·特朗普对人权问题的重视程度并不高。
en: In fact, Hun Sen, like other Southeast Asian autocrats, now seems to believe that he has political carte blanche, given the low priority that US President Donald Trump has placed on human rights.

zh: 过去，西方压力已经能够制约洪森的行动。
en: In the past, Western pressure had managed to keep Hun Sen in check.

zh: 外国援助，包括来自美国的援助，占到柬埔寨国家预算高达40%的份额。
en: Foreign aid, including from the US, accounts for as much as 40% of Cambodia’s national budget.

zh: 而且，虽然巴拉克·奥巴马总统政府的确扩大了与柬埔寨的合作，但也一再向洪森提及侵犯人权问题，包括在2012年奥巴马密集访问金边的时候。
en: And, while President Barack Obama’s administration did expand cooperation with Cambodia, it also repeatedly raised the issue of human-rights abuses with Hun Sen, including during a tense visit by Obama to Phnom Penh in 2012.

zh: 特朗普政府已经减轻了这种压力，而且还淡化了推进人权和民主。
en: The Trump administration has rolled back this pressure, and then some, by downplaying human rights and democracy promotion.

zh: 在9月进行的一次联大发言中，特朗普已经明确表示主权、而不是权利，将成为他的重中之重。
en: In an address to the United Nations General Assembly in September, Trump made clear that his priority would be sovereignty rather than rights.

zh: 与此同时，国务卿雷克斯·蒂勒森甚至据称曾考虑从国务院的使命清单中去除宣传民主。
en: Secretary of State Rex Tillerson, meanwhile, has even reportedly considered removing democracy promotion from the State Department’s mission.

zh: 洪森几乎立即就意识到这样的转变。
en: Hun Sen recognized this shift almost immediately.

zh: 今年2月，他曾把自己对柬埔寨媒体的蔑视与特朗普不信任美国主流媒体相比较。
en: In February, he compared his disdain for Cambodia’s media to Trump’s distrust of the mainstream media in the US.

zh: 尽管包括国家安全委员会高级亚洲主管在内的美国低级官员曾经会晤缅甸对口部门，并就权利问题向其施压，但特朗普却从未对洪森的所作所为进行过任何负面评价。
en: And although lower-ranking US officials, including the Senior Director for Asia on the National Security Council, have met with their Cambodian counterparts to press them on rights issues, Trump has said nothing negative about Hun Sen’s actions.

zh: 在11月初的一次演讲中，洪森实际上因为漠不关心和不干涉主义而 赞扬了特朗普 。
en: In a speech in early November, Hun Sen essentially praised Trump for his indifference and non-interventionism.

zh: 其他东南亚独裁人物，或者具备专制主义倾向的当选领袖，也对特朗普的“美国第一”外交政策持欢迎态度。
en: Other Southeast Asian autocrats, or elected leaders with autocratic tendencies, have also celebrated the arrival of Trump’s “America First” foreign policy.

zh: 泰国总理巴育·占奥差三年前领导政变推翻民选政府，今年却在白宫受到了热情的接待。
en: Thai Prime Minister Prayuth Chan-ocha, who led a coup against an elected government three years ago, was welcomed at the White House this year.

zh: 同样情况的还有马来西亚领导人纳吉布·拉扎克，作为对马来西亚主权财富基金全面欺诈调查的组成部分，美国司法部可能会质疑他所掌握的财富。
en: So was Malaysian leader Najib Razak, whose wealth may be questioned by the US Justice Department as part of a wide-ranging investigation into fraud at a Malaysian sovereign wealth fund.

zh: 与此同时，菲律宾总统罗德里戈·杜特尔特曾经在今年4月与特朗普进行过一次友好的电话谈话。
en: Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte, meanwhile, held a friendly phone call with Trump back in April.

zh: 特朗普赞扬这位菲律宾领导人无法无天的残酷“禁毒战争 ” ， 据人权观察报道，超过12，000人在这场禁毒战争中死亡。
en: Trump praised the Philippine leader for his brutal, lawless “war on drugs,” in which, according to Human Rights Watch, more than 12,000 people have died.

zh: 在特朗普11月访问马尼拉时，杜特尔特为他演唱了一首小夜曲，而且在双方出席的正式场合，特朗普在杜特尔特用“间谍”一词来抨击媒体时开怀大笑。
en: During Trump’s visit to Manila in November, Duterte serenaded him with a song, and then Trump laughed when, in a joint appearance, his counterpart blasted the media, calling them “spies.”

zh: （据记者保护委员会统计，菲律宾是全世界从事记者职业一个最危险的国家。
en: (The Philippines is one of the most dangerous countries in the world to be a journalist, according to the Committee to Protect Journalists.)

zh: ）特朗普后来声称他简单向杜特尔特提到了人权问题，但一名菲律宾政府发言人表示两人并未就人权问题进行任何探讨。
en: Trump later claimed he briefly mentioned human rights to Duterte, but a Philippine government spokesperson said the two had not discussed rights issues.

zh: 正如洪森、杜特尔特和其他人所表明的那样，美国新策略导致专制领袖可以不受惩罚。
en: As Hun Sen, Duterte, and others have shown, the new US approach fosters impunity for autocratic leaders.

zh: 尽管其他捐助国，包括加拿大和法国，有时会对洪森的侵权行为提出反对意见，但作为拥有最多筹码的美国政府在历史上一直是主要的指控方。
en: Although other donor countries, such as Canada and France, have at times spoken out against Hun Sen’s abuses, the US government, as the actor wielding the most leverage, has historically led the charge.

zh: 但特朗普政府“无视邪恶”的策略妨碍了其他国家推动人权和民主。
en: But the Trump administration’s see-no-evil approach hinders other countries’ ability to promote rights and democracy.

zh: 例如加拿大总理贾斯汀·特鲁多本月在与杜特尔特的双边会晤中确实对菲律宾的禁毒战争表达了担忧。
en: For example, Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, in his own bilateral meeting with Duterte this month, did raise concerns about the drug war in the Philippines.

zh: 但没有美国的支持，特鲁多的压力缺少可信的举措。
en: But without US support, Trudeau’s pressure lacked credible measures.

zh: 特朗普的政策正在将美国的长期利益置于危险之中。
en: Trump’s policies are placing America’s long-term interests at risk.

zh: 就像在柬埔寨一样，亚洲的青年男女是民主变革最有力的支持者 。
en: As in Cambodia, many of Asia’s strongest supporters of democratic change are young men and women.

zh: 马来西亚、柬埔寨和其他东南亚国家的反对党吸引了大批年轻人，现在面临重重压力的媒体和民间社会机构也是一样。
en: Opposition parties in Malaysia, Cambodia, and other Southeast Asian countries attract a high share of young people, as do many of the media organizations and civil-society groups now under pressure.

zh: 而且，从国家利益的角度看，最重要的是亚洲其他民主国家与美国的合作关系最为牢固。
en: And, most important from the standpoint of national interest, the US has built its strongest partnerships in Asia with other democracies.

zh: 忽视人权和民主的政策不利于美国也不利于亚洲。
en: Policies that ignore human rights and democracy will not benefit the US or the region.

zh: 不顾上述问题的“美国第一”政策 — — 无论是在柬埔寨还是在其他国家 — — 最后只会让美国的实力不断削弱。
en: An “America First” approach that disregards these issues – in Cambodia or elsewhere – will only leave the US weaker in the end.

zh: 哈马斯崛起
en: Hamas Rising

zh: 加沙城—军事运动组织哈马斯自2007年以来一直统治着加沙，其崛起是在与地区地位大大上升的以色列的最新一轮斗争中实现的。
en: GAZA CITY – Hamas, the militant political movement that has ruled Gaza since 2007, has emerged from the latest round of fighting with Israel with its regional status significantly enhanced.

zh: 与此同时，哈马斯也面临着新问题：是否有能力利用其争取得来的外交机会。
en: At the same time, the movement faces new questions about its ability to take advantage of the diplomatic opportunities that it has gained.

zh: 11月，以色列对加沙采取了军事行动，哈马斯对此以牙还牙，其火箭打到了特拉维夫和耶路撒冷附近，这表明它将坚定不移地捍卫其核心价值。
en: Hamas’s forceful response to Israel’s military operation in Gaza in November, which included landing rockets near Tel Aviv and Jerusalem, demonstrated its commitment to its core value of steadfastness.

zh: 此外，在八日冲突（eight-day clash）中，哈马斯长期流亡的领导人马沙尔（Khaled Meshal）从埃及进入加沙，此前他从来不敢公开在以色列面前露面。
en: Moreover, in the wake of the eight-day clash, Hamas’s long-exiled leader, Khaled Meshal, who had never before dared to show himself openly to Israel, entered Gaza from Egypt.

zh: 他大摇大摆地出现在街头游行中，这加强了加沙内外的印象 — — 哈马斯已经获胜。
en: Parading triumphantly through the streets, he reinforced the idea – at home and abroad – that Hamas had been victorious.

zh: 在加沙地区之外，阿拉伯之春国家（被别是埃及和突尼斯）伊斯兰政治势力的崛起为哈马斯创造了有利的周边环境。
en: Beyond Gaza, the rise of political Islam in the Arab Spring countries, particularly Egypt and Tunisia, has created a more Hamas-friendly neighborhood.

zh: 最关键的是，开罗谈判形成了与以色列的停火，这促成了埃及与哈马斯的直接高层外交契约 — — 与埃及前总统穆巴拉克明确的反哈马斯立场截然相反。
en: Crucially, the negotiations in Cairo that produced a cease-fire with Israel involved direct, high-level diplomatic contact between Egypt and Hamas – a fundamental shift from former Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak’s avowedly anti-Hamas stance.

zh: 卡塔尔埃米尔、土耳其外交部长以及其他地区领导人对加沙的访问进一步巩固了哈马斯的新地位。
en: Visits to Gaza by the Emir of Qatar and Turkey’s foreign minister, as well as by other regional leaders, have further buttressed Hamas’s new stature.

zh: 如今，证明对哈马斯的支持意味着在国内建立信誉，而这又给哈马斯重建带来了机会，阿拉伯和穆斯林国家将为此提供重金。
en: Demonstrating support for Hamas now means building credibility at home, which creates an opportunity to elicit large donations from Arab and Muslim countries to finance Gaza’s reconstruction.

zh: 相反，巴勒斯坦权力机构（PA）主席阿巴斯的策略是与以色列和谈，告别武装斗争，他受到了前所未有的孤立，尽管他在加沙战斗结束数日后成功地将巴勒斯坦在联合国的地位升格为“非成员观察国 ” 。
en: By contrast, Mahmoud Abbas, the president of the Palestinian Authority (PA), who embraces peace negotiations with Israel and disavows armed struggle, is more isolated than ever, despite his success in upgrading Palestine’s status at the United Nations to that of “non-member observer state” days after the fighting in Gaza ended.

zh: 哈马斯一开始对建国计划颇为狐疑，但在停火协议后给予了支持，因为它期望能利用巴勒斯坦地位升格的机会。
en: Hamas initially reacted skeptically to the statehood bid, but supported it after the cease-fire, owing to its expectation that it will be able to exploit Palestine’s upgraded status.

zh: 尽管如此，最近发生的一系列事件加上PA资源告竭，阿巴斯在巴勒斯坦人中间的信誉在下降，被看作是在困兽犹斗。
en: Nonetheless, recent events, together with the PA’s dwindling resources, have diminished Abbas’s credibility among Palestinians, who increasingly view him as desperate.

zh: 以色列在联合国关于耶路撒冷问题的新提案的投票表决之后发表的声明进一步削弱了他的立场。
en: Israel’s announcement after the UN vote of new settlements around Jerusalem weakened his standing further.

zh: 事实上，阿巴斯已是明日黄花。
en: Indeed, Abbas’s time is running out.

zh: 唯一的问题是谁将取代他。
en: The only question is who will replace him.

zh: 与此同时，哈马斯在寻求通过赢得选举最大程度地利用其日益增长的支持度。
en: Meanwhile, Hamas is seeking to capitalize on its growing popularity by winning elections.

zh: 在去年10月的约旦河西岸市政选举中 — — 这是六年来的第一次选举 — — 最大的世俗派法塔赫党在技术上重新赢得了政权，但在哈马斯��抵制号召下，投票比例只有55 % ， 这反映出该党的支持度在下降。
en: In last October’s municipal elections in the West Bank – the first in six years – the largely secular Fatah party technically retained its authority; but voter turnout of only 55%, following Hamas’s call for a boycott, reflected waning support for the party.

zh: 如今，哈马斯被广泛视为巴勒斯坦民族雄心的真正代表，是振臂高呼同意巴勒斯坦人民的不二之选。
en: Hamas is now widely seen as the true representative of Palestinian national ambitions, and is set to unite the Palestinians under its flag.

zh: 但哈马斯能够找到与以色列谈判的基点吗？
en: But can Hamas find a basis for negotiations with Israel?

zh: 平心而论，哈马斯仍未放弃其反抗大旗；但尽管如此，它的巴以冲突立场还是在逐步温和。
en: To be sure, Hamas has not abandoned its resistance mantra; even so, it has moderated its stance on the Palestinian-Israeli conflict over time.

zh: 事实上，哈马斯领导人已表明支持基于1967年界线建立巴勒斯坦国，将东耶路撒冷作为首都。
en: Indeed, Hamas’s leaders have expressed support for the establishment of a Palestinian state based on the 1967 borders, with East Jerusalem as its capital.

zh: 这一逐渐的转变与哈马斯对阿巴斯联合国外交手段的支持一起，表明如今哈马斯认为对以色列取得军事胜利希望渺茫。
en: This gradual shift, combined with Hamas’s endorsement of Abbas’s diplomatic approach in the UN, suggests that Hamas now believes that a military victory over Israel is not possible.

zh: 巴勒斯坦和以色列领导人必须协调不同，达成外交和解。
en: Palestinian and Israeli leaders will have to reconcile their differences and reach a diplomatic settlement.

zh: 哈马斯态度的变化信号正在变得日益明显。
en: Signs of Hamas’s shifting perspective are becoming increasingly apparent.

zh: 尽管马沙尔在加沙讲话中继续保持了强硬立场，但在私下场合，他已表示准备接受在1967年界线的基础上建立巴勒斯坦国。
en: While Meshal maintained a hardline stance in his speech in Gaza (see below), in private discussions he expressed a readiness to accept a Palestinian state based on the 1967 borders.

zh: 马沙尔甚至表示，如果以色列重新考虑其对2002年阿拉伯和平倡议（Arab Peace Initiative of 2002，该倡议号召阿拉伯国家承认以色列存在的权利，以换取以色列退回1967年界线）的态度，哈马斯也将如此。
en: Meshal even stated that, if Israel reconsidered its attitude toward the Arab Peace Initiative of 2002 – which calls upon the Arab world to recognize Israel’s right to exist in exchange for Israel’s return to its 1967 borders – Hamas would do the same.

zh: 但是，尽管马沙尔欢迎与以色列开展谈判的观点，但他仍坚持现在不是时候。
en: But, although Meshal welcomed the idea of future negotiations with Israel, he maintained that the time is not yet right.

zh: 哈马斯认定以色列只认武力和实力，除非以色列接受巴勒斯坦人民的要求永远不会屈服的现实，否则它是不会谈判的。
en: Hamas is convinced that Israel understands only the language of force and power, and it will not negotiate until Israel accepts the permanence of Palestinian demands.

zh: 以色列可能已经开始得到这一信息了。
en: Israel may be starting to get the message.

zh: 事实上，最近的战斗让某些以色列政客，如前总理沙龙的国家安全顾问艾兰德（Giora Eiland ） ， 承认哈马斯是一个不容忽视的政治存在。
en: In fact, the recent fighting drove some Israeli politicians, such as Giora Eiland, former Prime Minister Ariel Sharon’s national security adviser, to acknowledge that Hamas is a political reality that can no longer be ignored.

zh: 艾兰德甚至建议以色列政府承认哈马斯对加沙的统治，撤去对加沙的包围，并与哈马斯直接谈判延长停火事宜。
en: Eiland even advised Israel’s government to recognize Hamas’s rule in Gaza, lift the siege, and negotiate a prolonged cease-fire directly with the movement.

zh: 但这一方案成功与否取决于以色列是否做好了承认哈马斯的准备，目前后者仍被以色列视为恐怖组织，只能通过埃及从中调停。
en: But the success of such an approach depends on Israel’s readiness to engage Hamas, which it continues to regard as a terrorist group, and on the viability of Egyptian mediation.

zh: 在这方面，以色列可能要面对来自其主要盟友的越来越大的压力。
en: Here, Israel may come under growing pressure from its principal ally.
