zh: 事实上，美国接受该地区的伊斯兰政党 — — 从突尼斯复兴运动到埃及穆斯林兄弟会 — — 这一事实表明对伊斯兰组织的怀疑正在消退。
en: Indeed, America’s acceptance of Islamist parties in the region, from Ennahda in Tunisia to the Muslim Brotherhood in Egypt, suggests that skepticism of Islamist groups may be losing ground.

zh: 这还引起了关于美国是否会保持其孤立哈马斯的严格政策的怀疑。
en: It also raises doubts about whether the United States will maintain its strict policy of isolating Hamas.

zh: 埃及总统穆尔西在以色列和哈马斯之间的成功调停表明伊斯兰组织是有弹性的，即便面对的是以色列。
en: Egyptian President Mohamed Morsi’s success in mediating between Israel and Hamas demonstrated that Islamists can be flexible – even when it comes to Israel.

zh: 双方的立场都有缓和的空间，但它们的领导人必须得到正确的平台，以便形成必要的调整。
en: There is room for moderation in both sides’ positions, but their leaders must be given the right platform on which to make the needed adjustments.

zh: 亚洲能摆脱IMF吗？
en: Can Asia Free Itself from the IMF?

zh: 伯克利 — — 清迈倡议（CMI）是2000年在泰国城市清迈建立的亚洲金融互助机制，它的终极目标从来就不是一个问题。
en: BERKELEY – There has never been a question about the ultimate purpose of the Chiang Mai Initiative (CMI), the system of Asian financial supports created in 2000 in that Thai city.

zh: 那个目标当然就是建立一个亚洲货币基金，在该地区取代国际货币基金组织（IMF）的作用 — — 1997~1998年金融危机期间IMF应对不力，令该地区的许多国家至今难以释怀。
en: That purpose, of course, is to create an Asian Monetary Fund, i.e., a regional alternative to the International Monetary Fund, whose tender ministrations during the 1997-98 financial crisis have not been forgotten or forgiven.

zh: 然而，迄今为止，CMI是有马无鞍 — — 在其框架下承诺的信贷和货币互换还从来没有投入过实际应用。
en: So far, however, the CMI has been all horse and no saddle. Its credits and swaps have never been activated.

zh: 雷曼兄弟破产之后的动荡期原本是激活这些机制的好时机。
en: The distress following the failure of Lehman Brothers would have been an obvious occasion.

zh: 然而，该地区受冲击最严重的央行 — — 韩国银行宁可跟美联储搞300亿美元的外汇互换，也不愿向“东盟+3”伙伴们求援，这很能说明一些问题。
en: Yet, revealingly, the Bank of Korea, the central bank hit hardest, negotiated a $30 billion foreign-currency swap with the United States Federal Reserve, not with its ASEAN+3 partners.

zh: 而现在，据说“东盟+3”又取得了一项重大突破，即所谓“清迈倡议多边化 ” — —旨在把双边货币互换和信贷机制升级成地区性储备池的一个进程。
en: Now, we are told, ASEAN+3 has achieved another great breakthrough, the so-called Chiang Mai Initiative Multilateralization (CMIM), aimed at turning its bilateral swaps and credits into a regional reserve pool.

zh: 这一目标是2005年设立的，其实施细节则于上个月在“东盟+3”财长会议上商定。
en: The goal was set in 2005, and last month ASEAN+3 finance ministers negotiated the details.

zh: 会上明确了各成员经济体向1200亿美元储备池出资的比例、借款条件以及投票权的分配等等。
en: They specified contributions to their $120 billion pool, set down borrowing entitlements, and allocated voting shares.

zh: 人们都说就出资比例达成的共识很重要，因为中国和日本将各自出资32 % 。
en: The agreement on contributions is significant, it is said, because China and Japan will both contribute 32%.

zh: 在此前的地区性协议中，比如在亚洲开发银行资本金出资比例上，中国总是被当作第二档的大国来对待，承担较小的出资义务。
en: In previous regional agreements, like capital subscriptions to the Asian Development Bank, China had always been treated as a second-rate power and asked to contribute less.

zh: 实际上，中国之所以对1997年日本提出的建立亚洲货币基金的倡议避而不谈，正是因为它担心自己只轮到一个次要角色。
en: Indeed, China had shunned Japan’s 1997 proposal to create an Asian Monetary Fund precisely because it worried that it would play second fiddle.

zh: 如今中国得到了和日本平起平坐的地位，这意味着它将不会阻碍进一步合作的开展。
en: That China is now acknowledged as a co-equal means that it will not stand in the way of further cooperation.

zh: 人们还说确立简单多数的表决原则也很重要。 清迈倡议的投票权大体同各成员经济体出资比例相当，这意味着没有任何一个国家能够阻挠共同行动。
en: Also significant, we are told, is the agreement to make decisions by simple majority, with countries’ votes to be roughly in proportion to their contributions.

zh: 与之相比，IMF的执行董事会的决策基础是意见统一，因为美国等大国拥有事实上的一票否决权。
en: This means that no single country can block action, in contrast to the IMF executive board, which makes decisions by consensus, giving large countries like the United States de facto veto power.

zh: 然而，有了这些新规则是不是就万事大吉了？
en: But do these new rules really matter?

zh: 清迈倡议规定，当一国需提取的资金超过其可用信贷额度的20 % ， 就必须经过IMF同意，20%只不过是各国出资的一小部分而已。
en: Disbursing more than 20% of the credits available to a country still requires that it first reach an agreement with the IMF, and 20% of a country’s entitlement is actually less than it contributes to the pool.

zh: 这一规定足以抵消整个倡议的初衷 — — 使亚洲不必再仰IMF之鼻息。
en: This would appear to nullify the very purpose of the arrangement, which is to free Asia from the IMF.

zh: 就算“东盟+3”计划逐步提高直至取消20%这个上限，那也是未来说不清哪一天的事情。
en: While there is a plan to raise and then eliminate the 20% threshold, this is left to some future, unspecified date.

zh: 这种自相矛盾的原因很简单。
en: The reason for the contradiction is straightforward.

zh: 各国拿出来的是现金，谁都不希望自己的钱被轻率地用掉，而且最好能得到还款的保证。
en: Countries putting money on the barrelhead want assurances that their resources will not be used frivolously, and they want to know that they will be repaid.

zh: 但是作为同一地区的邻邦，各国都不便过多批评别国的政策，或提出修正方向的要求。
en: But regional neighbors find it hard to criticize one another’s policies and demand course corrections.

zh: 亚洲地区有许多事务在政治上特别敏感。
en: Political sensitivities run especially high in Asia.

zh: 就算是拥有长期合作历史的欧洲各国，其互相之间贷款安排的监测（surveillance）和贷款条件（conditionality）的拟定等职能也是外包给IMF的。
en: Even in Europe, with its long history of cooperation, surveillance and conditionality are outsourced to the IMF.

zh: 比如说，最近向匈牙利和拉脱维亚提供紧急援助的谈判，牵头的就是IMF而不是欧盟。
en: Revealingly, the Fund, not the European Union, has taken the lead in negotiating emergency assistance packages for Hungary and Latvia.

zh: 清迈倡议多边化进程如果要脱离IMF的制约，亚洲各国就必须直面互相之间不留情面的政策批评，必须听取调整政策的呼声，不管调整有多么困难。
en: Delinking the CMIM from the IMF will require Asian countries to undertake hard-hitting reviews of one another’s policies and to demand difficult policy adjustments.

zh: 在这方面 ， “ 东盟+3”已经触及了一些实质。
en: Here ASEAN+3 talks the talk.

zh: 5月份的财长会议共同承诺建立一个地区监测机构。
en: Its May agreement included a commitment to establish a regional surveillance unit.

zh: 尽管如此，这个机构的选址和人员构成仍是悬而未决的问题。
en: But there is no agreement on where to situate it or how to staff it. It could be placed within ASEAN’s Secretariat in Jakarta.

zh: 它可能会设在东盟秘书处所在地雅加达，也可能设在位于马尼拉的亚洲开发银行内部，还可能被安排在“中立”的东北亚国家韩国。
en: It could be placed inside the Asian Development Bank in Manila. It could be given to the “neutral” Northeast Asian country, Korea.

zh: 究竟花落谁家，结果大不一样，所以各国政府正在为此较劲 — — 大家都还记得，IMF设在华盛顿特区这一历史性抉择，是如何自然而然地扩大了美国财政部的影响力。
en: The outcome matters – which is why governments are fighting over it. Recall how the fateful decision to situate the IMF in Washington, DC enhanced the influence of the US Treasury just down the street.

zh: 缓和这些难点有一个办法，那就是把监测职能和资金调拨权都委托给一个超然于国家政治的独立董事会。
en: These dilemmas can be finessed by giving both surveillance responsibilities and the actual power to disburse funds to an independent board insulated from national politics.

zh: 这个董事会的成员，其职位独立于各国政府，任期也设置得相当长，整个董事会就像一个中央银行的货币政策委员会那样运作。
en: Its members, with statutory independence and long terms in office, could function like the monetary policy committee of a central bank.

zh: 它负责发布金融稳定报告，铁面无私地指出各国政策的软肋和金融体系的弱点，还可以要求有关国家做出政策调整，以方便调拨资金。
en: They could issue a Financial Stability Report that bluntly flags weak policies and financial vulnerabilities. And they could demand policy adjustments as a condition for disbursing funds.

zh: 一旦这样一个董事会建立起来，IMF就可以靠边站了。
en: The IMF could then be shown the door.

zh: 这一纲领并不能一下子解决亚洲的所有问题，但它至少可以扫除一个危险，也就是不得不继续扩大外汇储备规模的危险。
en: This scheme wouldn’t solve all of Asia’s problems. But it would at least head off one danger, namely the urge to accumulate even more reserves.

zh: 近期的金融振荡加强了这一冲动。
en: Recent volatility reinforces this temptation.

zh: 如果亚洲国家屈从于这种冲动，全球收支不平衡和有关的种种麻烦都会卷土重来。
en: If Asian countries succumb, global imbalances and all their associated problems will return.

zh: 把地区储备汇到一个池子里，从而给这些钱找到个去处，这是个不错的办法。
en: Pooling regional reserves as a way of making them go further is a better alternative.

zh: 但把这一构想变成现实，需要更有突破性的思维。
en: But making this vision a reality requires further bold thinking.

zh: 商业道德何处寻？
en: Can Business Be Ethical?

zh: 发自墨尔本-哈佛商学院最近出现了些新情况。
en: MELBOURNE – Something new is happening at Harvard Business School.

zh: 当全球金融危机之后的第一批MBA学员临近毕业之时，同学们都在暗自思量自己是否要宣读一份誓言，宣誓内容包括 ： “ 以道德的方式”去从事自己的工作 ； “ 努力在全世界创造可持续的经济、社会和环境财富 ” ； “用正确的信念”管理自己的企业并“防止为满足个人私欲而做出有害于企业和社会的决策和行为 ” 。
en: As graduation nears for the first class to complete their Master of Business Administration since the onset of the global financial crisis, students are circulating an oath that commits them to pursue their work “in an ethical manner”; “to strive to create sustainable economic, social, and environmental prosperity worldwide”; and to manage their enterprises “in good faith, guarding against decisions and behavior that advance my own narrow ambitions but harm the enterprise and the societies it serves.”

zh: 虽然这些MBA新誓言的措辞大都取材于美国亚利桑那州雷鸟国际管理学院2006年就采用的誓言文本，但整个事件依然意义重大，因为采用者是哈佛商学院，世界上最著名的商学院。
en: The wording of the new MBA oath draws on one adopted in 2006 by the Thunderbird School of Global Management, based in Arizona. Nevertheless, the fact that it has been taken up by the world’s most famous business school is significant.

zh: 截至本文发表之时，商学院毕业班里面已经有20%的学员接受了这份誓词。
en: As of this writing, about 20% of the Harvard graduating class have taken the oath.

zh: 虽然有些刻薄的批评家会问 ： “ 还有其他80%呢？ ”但这至少说明有一批人在目睹了最近被大批揭露的经济欺诈和贪婪丑行之后，转而对道德有所诉求。
en: That will, of course, prompt cynics to ask: “What about the other 80%?”  But those who have taken the oath are part of a larger turn toward ethics that has followed the recent flood of revelations of dishonesty and greed in the financial sector.

zh: 人们对商业伦理课程兴趣急升，而顶尖商学院的学生活动也比从前更加关注如何令商业行为服务于长期社会价值的议题。
en: Interest in business ethics courses has surged, and student activities at leading business schools are more focused than ever before on making business serve long-term social values.

zh: 其实相对于医学、法律、工程、牙科或者护理这些职业的所谓道德，商业道德总有些特殊区别。
en: Business ethics has always had problems that are distinct from those of other professions, such as medicine, law, engineering, dentistry, or nursing.

zh: 比如我的一位亲戚眼睛出了毛病，她的医生将其转给了另一个眼科医生，但眼科医生检查之后认为没必要做手术，于是又把她转回去了原来的医生处。
en: A member of my family recently had an eye problem, and was referred by her general practitioner to an eye surgeon. The surgeon examined the eye, said that it didn’t need surgery, and sent her back to the general practitioner.

zh: 医学界的朋友告诉我说，对于一个忠于其职业道德的医生来说，上述事情是再正常不过的了。
en: That is no more than one would expect from a doctor who is true to the ethics of the profession, my medical friends tell me.

zh: 相比之下，你能想象一个汽车经销商忠告你说你根本没必要买辆新车吗？
en: By contrast, it’s hard to imagine going to a car dealer and being advised that you don’t really need a new car.

zh: 对于医生来说，对职业道德起誓的理念可以追溯到古希腊时期的“医药之父”希波克拉底。
en: For physicians, the idea of swearing an oath to act ethically goes back to Hippocrates.

zh: 虽然无论发什么誓，每个行业都会有一些害群之马，但许多卫生保健方面的专业人士确实认定自己是要为顾客利益最大化服务的。
en: Every profession will have its rogues, of course, no matter what oaths are sworn, but many health care professionals have a real commitment to serving the best interests of their clients.

zh: 那么对于公司经理来说，有没有比追求企业成功和赚钱更重要的使命存在？
en: Do business managers have a commitment to anything more than the success of their company and to making money?

zh: 这可很难说，事实上许多企业领导人都否认个人私利与整体利益是互相冲突的。
en: It would be hard to say that they do. Indeed, many business leaders deny that there is any conflict between self-interest and the interests of all.

zh: 他们认为亚当·斯密所谓“看不见的手”已经说明了在自由市场之中，追求个人利益就能促进整体利益。
en: Adam Smith’s “invisible hand,” they believe, ensures that the pursuit of our own interests in the free market will further the interests of all.

zh: 在传统上，经济学家米尔顿·弗里德曼在他1962年的著作《资本主义与自由》中写道 ： “ 对于企业来说有且只有一个社会责任 — — 那就是在遵守游戏规则的情况下尽量利用资源并进行营利活动，而所谓游戏规则，指的就是除欺诈和作伪行为之外的开放、自由竞争。
en: In that tradition, the economist Milton Friedman wrote, in his 1962 book Capitalism and Freedom :  “there is one and only one social responsibility of business – to use its resources and engage in activities designed to increase its profits so long as it stays within the rules of the game, which is to say, engages in open and free competition without deception or fraud.”

zh: ”在弗里德曼这一观点的信徒看来，一个经理人如果摒弃了股东利益最大化而是为其他目标奔忙的话，那就是离经叛道之举。
en: For the true believers in this creed, the suggestion that the manager of a business should strive for anything except maximizing value for shareholders is heresy.

zh: 但即使全球金融危机确实揭露了大范围的欺诈行为，人们却发现危机的深层原因并不是欺诈，而是虽然有发行商不断发行次级抵押债券并吸引金融机构不断购��，但市场却在满足了前者的私欲之后抛弃了后者。
en: But, while the global financial crisis did reveal fraud on a massive scale, the underlying cause of the crisis was not fraud but the failure of the market to knit together the self-interest of those who sold and resold sub-prime mortgages with the interests of the investors in financial institutions that bought them.

zh: 而政府为防止更大的灾祸不致降临，被迫叫全体纳税人掏钱去拯救银行的事实也无疑是给了那些打着“无限制市场”旗号的人一记响亮的耳光。
en: The fact that an even larger catastrophe would have resulted had governments not been willing to draw on taxpayer funds to bail out the banks was an additional blow to those who have told us to trust the unregulated market.

zh: 因此哈佛现在的MBA誓词就是尝试用另一种理念去取代弗里德曼对于企业社会责任的看法：一个承诺要促进社会全体成员长期、可持续福利的管理专业理念。
en: The MBA oath is an attempt to replace the Friedmanite view of the social responsibility of business with something quite different: a management profession that commits itself to promoting the long-term, sustainable welfare of all.

zh: 通过要求经理人“推动自身及其下属管理人员的进步，令经理人职业得以继续壮大并对全社会的福祉有所贡献 ” ， 这份誓词本身就已经传达了一种职业道德理念。
en: The sense of a professional ethic is conveyed by clauses in the oath that require managers to “develop both myself and other managers under my supervision so that the profession continues to grow and contribute to the well-being of society.”

zh: 而另外一条宣言则体现了这种职业的自我约束机制，要求经理人对他人负责。
en: Another clause stresses accountability to one’s peers, a hallmark of professional self-regulation.

zh: 宣言写道：管理的终极目标无疑是“努力在全世界创造可持续的经济、社会和环境财富 ” 。
en: As for the ultimate objectives of the managerial profession, they are, as we have seen, nothing less than “to create sustainable economic, social, and environmental prosperity worldwide.”

zh: 或许人们能从马克思·安德森接受《纽约时报》采访时所说的话中看到一些希望的曙光，作为本次宣誓活动的其中一个学生组织者，他说 ： “ 我们感觉到生活中应该有一些更有意义的事情，并希望能让我们的企业服务于更宏大的社会利益。 ”如有更多商业人士能遵照上述宣言来厘定自身利益的话，那么越来越多以德为纲的职业经理人操守，就将涌现在我们眼前。
en: Can such a code really take hold in the competitive world of business?  Perhaps the best hope for its success can be glimpsed in a comment made to a New York Times reporter by Max Anderson, one of the pledge’s student organizers: “There is the feeling that we want our lives to mean something more and to run organizations for the greater good,” he said.  If enough business people would conceive their interests in those terms, we might see the emergence of an ethically-based profession of business managers.

zh: 取消脱欧现在是否是无可避免的结果？
en: Is Canceling Brexit Now Inevitable?

zh: 伦敦 — — 在政治动荡的年代，局面可以从不可能直接跳转到无可避免，甚至不用经过不太可能。
en: LONDON – In times of political turmoil, events can move from impossible to inevitable without even passing through improbable.

zh: 2016年初，英国脱欧的想法似乎还与曾经六次破产和连环性侵害的唐纳德·特朗普当选下任美国总统一样近乎荒诞。
en: In early 2016, the idea of Britain leaving the European Union seemed almost as absurd as the next American president being the six-time bankrupt and serial sex pest Donald Trump.

zh: 而短短几个月后，英国脱欧和特朗普当选总统就被人们普遍视为早在数十年前就已经有人预测到的反精英反全球化浪潮不可避免的产物。
en: A few months later, Brexit and the Trump presidency were universally acknowledged as the inevitable consequence of an anti-elitist, anti-globalization backlash that was predictable decades ago.

zh: 这种不可避免的宿命感远远胜过真正的反欧洲信念， 阻止英国改变其直到2016年还鲜有选民真正赞同的毫无意义且自我毁灭政策的可能结果。
en: This sense of inevitability, far more than genuine anti-European conviction, is what has discouraged Britain from changing its mind about a pointless and self-destructive policy that few voters cared about until 2016.

zh: 后英国脱欧期民调和焦点小组的调查结果显示 ： “ 我们都知道退欧必须要发生，那么政治家们为何还不着手推动？ ”
en: The message from post-Brexit polling and focus groups has been: “We all know that Brexit has to happen, so why don’t the politicians just get on with it?”

zh: 但随着英国脱欧进程现在正走向高潮，另一个结果正在从不可能逐渐转向无可避免：那就是英国可能很快改变主意并决定留在欧盟。
en: But with the Brexit process now moving toward its climax, another outcome is moving from impossible to inevitable: Britain could soon change its mind and decide to stay in the EU.

zh: 这场逆转命运的好戏可能在下月上演，届时首相特雷莎·梅将失去针对其英国脱欧协议决定性的议会投票。
en: This reversal of fortune could begin next month, when Prime Minister Theresa May is expected to lose the decisive parliamentary vote on her Brexit deal.

zh: 如果投票失利真的发生，梅将被迫面对两个令人不快的选择。
en: If and when this defeat happens, May will face two unpalatable options.

zh: 她可以主持与欧盟的“无协议”决裂 — — 这相当于宣布对欧盟发动经济战 — — 并且冒着再次引发2008年级别经济危机的风险，而且还要同时面对爱尔兰的边境动荡，这样的动荡可能重新导致“麻烦”的发生。
en: She could preside over a “No Deal” rupture with Europe – tantamount to a declaration of economic war against the EU – and risk a 2008-level economic crisis accompanied by a border upheaval in Ireland that could reignite the “Troubles.”

zh: 或者她也可以打破其履行2016年全民公投“人民嘱托”的奢侈承诺，允许一次可能取消脱欧的新的公民投票的发生。
en: Or she could break her extravagant promises to honor the “people’s instruction” from the 2016 referendum and allow a new popular vote that might cancel Brexit.

zh: 为避免这种可怕的选择，梅可能会在原定于1月14日那周举行的投票失利后最后一次尝试推动其议案获得议会通过。
en: To avoid this invidious choice, May could try one last time to push her proposals through Parliament after losing the vote scheduled for the week of January 14.

zh: 但如果这最后的努力失败，那么她只剩下与欧盟无协议决裂和再次举行公投两种选择。
en: But if this last-ditch effort fails, her choices will be reduced to a No Deal rupture with Europe and a new referendum.

zh: 随着选择范围的缩小，英国主要商业游说团体现在公开称之为无协议脱欧的“恐怖”的风险和牺牲将很快引起人们的关注，而两党议会多数肯定会齐心协力阻止这样的结果。
en: With the options thus narrowed, the risks and sacrifices of the “horror,” as Britain’s main business lobbies now publicly describe No Deal, will quickly come into focus, and a bipartisan parliamentary majority will surely converge to block this outcome.

zh: 几位保守党议员已经信誓旦旦地承诺如果梅转向支持无协议脱欧，他们将辞去党内职务 ，而届时的反叛人数肯定会膨胀到足以击垮她的政府。
en: Several Conservative MPs have alreadypromised to resign from the party if May shifts to supporting No Deal, and the rebel numbers could certainly swell enough to bring down her government.

zh: 随着议会不可能通过无协议或梅氏协议脱欧立法变得越来越显而易见，自2016年来一直保护英国脱欧免遭严重挑战的无可避免的氛围正在逐渐消失，而且不久后，无可避免的宿命感就可能转向支持举行新的公投。
en: As the impossibility of legislating either No Deal or May’s deal has become apparent, the aura of inevitability that has protected Brexit from serious challenge since 2016 is vanishing, and soon the sense of inevitability may swing in favor of a new referendum.

zh: 英国媒体已经开始了这种转变。
en: This shift has already started in the British media.

zh: 就连在过去两年一直谴责任何脱欧挑战者为“人民公敌”和民主叛徒的BBC、泰晤士报和其他有影响力的媒体喉舌也已经突然想起，选民有权改变主意其实是民主的基本原则。
en: Having spent the past two years denouncing anyone who challenged Brexit as “enemies of the people” and a traitor to democracy, the BBC, TheTimes, and other influential media organs have suddenly remembered that an essential principle of democracy is that voters have the right to change their minds.

zh: 但就像针对新公投的“原则性”反对意见正在消失一样，一个远为实际的问题已经浮出水面：那就是在最终的“民众投票”中应当提出什么样的问题? 是应当要求选民在留欧或接受梅的脱欧协议中作出选择?
en: But just as the“principled” objections to a new referendum are disappearing, a much more practical problem has emerged: What question should be asked in a final “People’s Vote”?Should voters choose between remaining in the EU or accepting May’s withdrawal agreement?

zh: 还是应当将选项设定为不脱欧或无协议脱欧？
en: Or should the options be No Brexit versus No Deal?

zh: 又或者就像脱欧狂热份子所要求的那样，将选择范围缩小到依据梅的协议脱欧或者无协议脱欧，因为继续保留欧盟成员资格的可能性截止2016年公投结束时就已经完全废除。
en: Or what about the narrower choice between May’s Deal and No Deal, demanded by Brexit zealots who argue that the possibility of continuing EU membership was eliminated by the 2016 referendum?

zh: 显而易见的答案是，向选民提供所有三种选择 — — 无协议脱欧、按照梅的协议脱欧或者不脱欧。
en: The obvious answer would be to present voters with all three options – No Deal, May’s Deal, or No Brexit.

zh: 但新的问题又因此出现，如果这三个选项没有哪个占明确多数，那么将如何开展计票工作？
en: But the problem then arises of how the votes should be counted if none of these options commands a clear majority.

zh: 英美选举采用的简单多数选举制规定，多数选票支持的选项将会胜出。
en: Under the first-past-the-post system used in British and American elections, the option supported by the most votes would win.

zh: 但脱欧支持者完全无法接受这种情况，如果“梅的协议”和“无协议”脱欧分散了他们的选票，他们在此次投票中注定是会失败的。
en: But that would be completely unacceptable to Brexit supporters, who would be guaranteed to lose if their voters were split between May’s Deal and No Deal.

zh: 因此，为确保民主合法性，计票必须或者依据要求选民确定首选和次选的偏好投票制，或者采用双阶段进程。
en: Thus, to gain democratic legitimacy, the votes would have to be counted either through a preferential system, which asks voters for first and second choices, or with a two-stage process.

zh: 例如，选票可以首先要求选民明确他们是否接受政府的脱欧方案，而后回答第二个条件性提问：如果政府协议未能获得多数支持，你会选择无协议退出还是留在欧盟？
en: For example, the ballot could first ask voters to state whether they accepted the government’s Brexit proposal, and then to answer a second conditional question: If the government’s deal does not win majority support, would you prefer No Deal or remaining in the EU?

zh: 或者也可以首先询问选民想要留欧还是继续脱欧，而后再问如果脱欧获胜，他们更倾向于选择“按梅的协议”还是“无协议”脱欧。
en: Alternatively, voters could be asked, first, whether they want to remain in the EU or go ahead with Brexit, and then, in the event that Brexit wins, whether they would prefer May’s Deal or No Deal.

zh: 针对二次公投的最强的反对意见是，至少在理论上，不同的计票体系可能得出截然不同的计票结果，从而破坏整个过程的合法性。
en: The strongest objection to a second referendum is that the different counting systems could give very different results, at least in theory, thereby undermining the legitimacy of the entire process.

zh: 但这种反对意见只有当公众舆论在三种可能结果之间平均分配时才在理论上有效。
en: But this objection turns out to be theoretically valid only if public opinion is divided fairly evenly between the three possible outcomes.

zh: 实际上，似乎民意已经转向很可能给出明确的答案，而无论问题将如何提出。
en: In practice, opinion now seems to be shifting to the point where clear answers are likely, regardless of how the questions are asked.

zh: 在YouGov12月初进行的有关所有三个脱欧选项的首次详细民调中，一次标准的简单多数投票将导致留欧赢得54%的绝对多数，仅有28%的人支持无协议脱欧和18%的人支持按梅的协议脱欧。
en: In the first detailed poll of all three Brexit options, conducted by YouGov in early December, a standard first-past-the-post vote would result in Remain winning a huge 54% absolute majority, against 28% support for No Deal and 18% for May’s Deal.

zh: 在与按梅氏协议脱欧的简单选择中，支持留欧的多数派将会更占优势，达到62%之多。
en: In a simple choice against May’s deal, the majority for Remain would be even bigger, at 62%.

zh: 而如果实行重新分配梅的支持者的第二选项偏好制投票，留欧仍然会以57%对43%的决定性优势胜出。
en: And in a preferential vote count that redistributed the second preferences of May’s supporters, Remain would still win by a decisive margin of 57% to 43%.

zh: 当然，选民们有可能在公投活动中改变主意。
en: Of course, voters could change their minds in a referendum campaign.

zh: 但从目前的情况看，无论采用何种提问或计票方式，新公投都将取得明显多数赞成英国留欧的结果。
en: But as matters stand today, a new referendum would produce a clear majority for Britain remaining an EU member, regardless of how the votes were counted or the questions were asked.

zh: 这表明无可避免的力量正在开始反对英国脱欧。
en: This suggests that the force of inevitability is starting to move against Brexit.

zh: “我们都知道英国脱欧必须取消 ， ” 选民们也许很快会说 ， “ 那么为什么那些政客不能赶快着手？ ”
en: “We all know that Brexit has to be canceled,” voters may soon be saying, “so why don’t the politicians just get on with it?”

zh: 货币政策的回归之路
en: The Way Back for Monetary Policy

zh: 首尔—近几年来，主要发达经济体央行纷纷进入从未涉足过的领域。
en: SEOUL – The central banks of major advanced economies have been navigating uncharted territory in recent years.

zh: 它们对一系列非常规货币政策工具的使用取得了一些效果，也带来了严重的不确定性，世界经济也没有获得充分稳定。
en: While their use of a range of unconventional monetary-policy tools has had benefits, it has also generated significant uncertainty, without fully stabilizing the world economy.

zh: 现在，是时候回归更加熟悉的政策领域了。
en: Now the time has come to head back toward more familiar policy terrain.

zh: 2008年金融崩溃以来，美联储将政策利率减只几乎为零的水平，并采取了所谓的量化宽松，即从公共和私人部门购买长期证券。
en: Following the 2008 financial meltdown, the US Federal Reserve cut the policy rate to almost zero and pursued so-called quantitative easing (QE), by purchasing long-term securities from the public and private sectors.

zh: 欧盟、日本和英国央行很快也推出了类似的非常规政策。
en: The central banks of the European Union, Japan, and the United Kingdom soon launched similar unconventional programs.

zh: 结果是巨量廉价流动性帮助稳定了金融部门，恢复了股票和房地产价格，也提高了内需。
en: The result was a vast amount of cheap liquidity that helped to stabilize the financial sector, restore stock and real-estate prices, and increase domestic demand.

zh: 所有这些都有助于遏制金融危机的后果，让全球经济走向复苏。
en: All of this helped to limit the fallout of the financial crisis and push the global economy toward recovery.

zh: 但这一激进方针尤其局限性。
en: But this aggressive approach has its limits.

zh: 事实上，印度储备银行行长拉古兰·拉詹（Raghuram Rajan）指出，实施多年后，非常规货币政策的收益正在下降，而成本正在上升。
en: Indeed, as Reserve Bank of India Governor Raghuram Rajan has pointed out, after years of effort, the benefits of unconventional monetary policy are diminishing, while the costs are increasing.

zh: 意识到这一点，美联储在去年年底结束了量化宽松，并将政策利率提高25个基点。
en: Recognizing this, the Fed ended QE at the end of last year and raised its policy rate by 25 basis points.

zh: 今年美联储可能继续升息，尽管速度和程度仍不确定。
en: The rate hikes will likely continue this year, though the speed and extent of the increases are uncertain.

zh: 但欧洲央行和日本银行仍决定维持量化宽松计划。
en: Yet the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan (BOJ) have decided to sustain their QE programs.

zh: 此外，它们还采取了负政策利率 — — 即向银行准备金收费 — — 以重振萎靡的需求。
en: Moreover, they have adopted a negative interest-rate policy – which amounts to charging a fee for bank reserves – to revitalize depressed demand.

zh: 毫不奇怪，对通胀和真实产出的影响非常有限。
en: Unsurprisingly, the effects on inflation and real output have been limited.

zh: 货币政策是管理通货膨胀的有效途径，也可以在衰退期间提振就业和产出。
en: Monetary policy is an effective means of managing inflation and can boost employment and output in a recession.

zh: 但是，将利率降到零以下损害了银行资产负债表，降低了它们的贷款能力。
en: Lowering interest rates below zero, however, has hurt banks’ balance sheets, reducing their lending capacity.

zh: 结果，该政策没能提高商业投资。
en: As a result, it has failed to increase business investment.

zh: 即使在低正利率情况下，如果维持很长一段时间，也可能适得其反，助长资产泡沫，导致家庭和公司债务增至不可持续水平。
en: Even low positive interest rates, if maintained for a prolonged period, could backfire, fueling asset bubbles and enabling household and corporate debt to grow to unsustainable levels.

zh: 与此同时，资产购买操作导致主要央行资产负债表规模膨胀至前所未有的水平。
en: Meanwhile, asset purchases have caused the balance sheets of major central banks to swell to unprecedented levels.

zh: 现在，央行需要有序缩减规模，但这非常难以管理。
en: The orderly rewinding that is now needed will be very difficult to manage.

zh: 除了国内影响，非常规货币政策还带来了影响深远的溢出效应。
en: Beyond the domestic sphere, unconventional monetary policies have had far-reaching spillover effects.

zh: 特别是，它们发达经济体和新兴经济体之间的金融联系给后者带去了资本流过山车。
en: In particular, they have sent emerging economies, with their financial links to advanced economies, on a capital-flow roller-coaster ride.

zh: 首先，新兴经济体遭遇来自发达经济体的巨量流动性流入。
en: First, the emerging economies were flooded with liquidity flowing from the advanced economies.

zh: 巨大的资本流入导致了过热和通胀、资产价格泡沫和货币迅速升值。
en: Large capital inflows led to overheating and inflation, asset-price bubbles, and rapid currency appreciation.

zh: 接着，美联储退出量化宽松又导致资本猛然抽离，带来了金融破坏和货币危机风险。
en: Then, the Fed’s tapering of QE led to the sudden withdrawal of that capital, creating a risk of financial disruption and currency crises.

zh: 新兴经济体货币当局难以运用可用工具（包括利率、汇率、审慎监管和资本管制）处理这些冲击。
en: The emerging economies’ monetary authorities have struggled to cope with these shocks using available instruments, including interest rates, exchange rates, prudential regulation, and capital controls.

zh: 但这还不是全部。
en: But that is not all.

zh: 由于发达经济体的非常规货币政策还拉低了它们的货币、刺激了它们的出口，竞争性贬值如今已成为你一个实实在在的威胁。
en: Because advanced economies’ unconventional monetary policies have also depreciated their currencies and stimulated their exports, the risk of competitive devaluations is now a real concern.

zh: 如果（比如）日本银行开始大举干预汇率市场，让日元贬值，那么中国人民银行和大韩银行选择货币贬值的可能性也会增加。
en: If, say, the BOJ moved to intervene outright in the exchange-rate markets to depreciate the yen, the odds that the People’s Bank of China and the Bank of Korea would opt for weaker currencies would increase.

zh: 所有这些都具有高度破坏性，特别是对内外交困的巴西新兴经济体而言。
en: All of this would be highly destabilizing, particularly for emerging economies like Brazil that are facing a brutal combination of internal and external challenges.

zh: 但是，一些经济学家并不把所有这些因素视为退出非常规货币政策的理由，反而建议欧洲央行和日本银行采取更加夸张的政策：所谓的“直升机撒钱 ” 。
en: Instead of viewing all of this as motivation to back away from unconventional monetary policy, however, some economists are recommending that the ECB and the BOJ pursue an even more extraordinary policy: so-called “helicopter drops.”

zh: 直升机撒钱的概念由诺贝尔经济学奖获得者米尔顿·弗里德曼（Milton Friedman）在1969年提出，意指直接向公众分派新印钞票，并且央行承诺永不收回。
en: The idea, introduced by the Nobel laureate economist Milton Friedman in 1969, entails the distribution of freshly printed money directly to the public, with a commitment from the central bank never to withdraw it.

zh: 美联储前主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）指出，货币融资本质上等价于款基减税，由央行承诺购买政府债务。
en: As Former Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke points out, monetary finance is essentially equivalent to a broad-based tax cut, with the central bank committing to purchase government debt.

zh: 支持欧洲和日本采取直升机撒钱的著名经济学家包括伯南克、韦勒姆·布依特（Willem Buiter ） 、 克马尔·德尔维什（Kemal Derviş）和阿代尔·特纳（Adair Turner ） 。
en: Among the influential economists advocating helicopter drops for Europe and Japan are Bernanke, Willem Buiter, Kemal Derviş, and Adair Turner.

zh: 他们指出，即使这不是理想方案，至少可以助经济一臂之力。
en: They argue that even if it is not an ideal solution, it can cure their economies.

zh: 对困于高企的公债和赤字的政府来说，这一方案着实 有诱惑力。
en: For governments restrained by high public debt and deficits, the proposal is certainly tempting.

zh: 但直升机撒钱风险很大。
en: But helicopter drops are highly risky.

zh: 伯南克本人就警告说，这一政策可能破坏央行的长期独立性。
en: As Bernanke himself warns, such a policy could undermine central banks’ long-term independence.

zh: 此外，它使政府能够不受约束地将财政赤字货币化，并有可能出于政治目的滥用印钞权力。
en: Moreover, it would enable governments to monetize fiscal deficits without constraints, and potentially to abuse money-printing power for political considerations.

zh: 它也未必能取得意料中的效果，撒下去的钱可能只是令某些群体受益。
en: And it might not even work as intended, with the money benefiting only certain groups.

zh: 主权和信誉一旦失去，重新获得是十分困难的，因此，央行必须将直升机撒钱作为最后一招。
en: Given the difficulty of regaining lost sovereignty and credibility, central banks must keep helicopter drops as a last resort.

zh: 现实是对宽松的货币政策所营造的飞来横财的依赖可能带来严重的长期影响，特别是如果它们被用来延迟解决基本问题的措施的话。
en: The reality is that recourse to easy windfalls produced through loose monetary policy could have serious long-term repercussions, especially if they are used to delay efforts to address underlying issues.

zh: 日本首相安倍晋三的经济复兴战略 — — 所谓的“安倍经济学”就是一个例子。
en: Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s economic revitalization strategy – so-called Abenomics – is a case in point.

zh: 该战略计划综合运用货币和财政扩张刺激结构改革。
en: The strategy was supposed to use a mix of monetary and fiscal expansion to help facilitate structural reforms.

zh: 但改革面临着推迟，而就业和产出增长非常有限。
en: Yet the reforms have faced delays, and employment and output growth has been limited.

zh: 发达国家央行现在应该做的是实施重塑信誉的货币政策，而政府应该专注于实施有效的财政政策和结构改革。
en: What advanced-country central banks should be doing now is implementing monetary policies aimed at restoring their credibility, while governments focus on implementing effective fiscal policies and structural reforms.

zh: 关键是，发达和新兴经济体必须进行政策协调，以提振信心、提高增长。
en: Crucially, advanced and emerging economies must coordinate their policies, in order to foster confidence and strengthen growth.

zh: 这是回归可全球经济持续健康的唯一办法。
en: This is the only way back onto the path of sustained global economic health.

zh: 上个月，G-20各国财长和央行行长承认了货币政策的局限性，并提出结构改革、基础设施投资和财政政策才是未来增长的关键。
en: Last month, finance ministers and central-bank governors of the G-20 countries acknowledged the limitations of monetary stimulus and embraced structural reforms, infrastructure investment, and fiscal policy as the key to future growth.

zh: 但他们并没有用身体力行来支持他们的言论。
en: But they have yet to back their words with strong action.

zh: 他们的信誉 — — 以及全球经济 — — 命悬一线。
en: Their credibility – not to mention the fate of the global economy – is on the line.

zh: 数字里的癌症
en: Cancer by the Numbers

zh: 发自费城 — — 与一个庞大的听众群体交流医学风险是一件相当艰难的事情，尤其是在官方建议与人们的情绪化描述相抵触的时候。
en: PHILADELPHIA – It is difficult to communicate medical risk to a large audience, especially when official recommendations conflict with emotional narratives.

zh: 而这也是美国预防医学工作组（USPSTF）在2009年所遇到的问题，当时该机构发布了其乳腺癌医学筛查指引，建议将原有的40岁以上无症状妇女每两年做一次筛查改为所有50岁以上的女性每年拍一张乳房X光片，结果却引发了公众的极大愤怒。
en: That is why, when the United States Preventive Services Task Force (USPSTF) in 2009 presented its guidelines for breast cancer screening, which recommended against routine screenings for asymptomatic women in their 40’s and biennial, rather than annual, mammograms for women over 50, the public responded with confused fury.

zh: 其实我们可以在数学和心理学之间的模糊区域中找到解读这一公众回应的关键点。
en: The key to understanding this response is to be found in the nebulous zone between mathematics and psychology.

zh: 人们对于上述发现的不满在很大程度上源自于一种错误的直觉：如果更早且更频密的筛查可以增加发现某种可致命癌症的几率，那么更多的筛查就是应该的。
en: People’s discomfort with the findings stemmed largely from faulty intuition: if earlier and more frequent screening increases the likelihood of detecting a possibly fatal cancer, then more screening is always desirable.

zh: 这么说来倘若更多的筛查可以在40岁年龄段的临床无症状妇女中发现乳腺癌，那何不把它提前到30岁？
en: If more screening can detect breast cancer in asymptomatic women in their 40’s, wouldn’t it also detect cancer in women in their 30’s?

zh: 如果这也可行的话，按照逻辑上的归缪法，干脆从15岁开始每月照一张X光片好了。
en: And, if so, why not, reductio ad absurdum, begin monthly mammograms at age 15?

zh: 很显然，如此频密的筛查只会弊大于利。
en: The answer, of course, is that such intensive screening would cause more harm than good.

zh: 而在此之间寻找一个合适的平衡点也是相当有难度的。
en: But striking the proper balance is challenging.

zh: 其中最不幸的，莫过于我们知道连续多年进行X光照射会产生辐射累积效应，活体组织检查会对人体造成伤害，同时治疗那些缓慢生长且永远不会证明是恶性的肿瘤也将损害患者的健康，但这些因素相对于乳腺癌的危险性该如何权衡则并非易事。
en: Unfortunately, it is not easy to weigh breast cancer’s dangers against the cumulative effects of radiation from dozens of mammograms over the years, the invasiveness of biopsies, and the debilitating impact of treating slow-growing tumors that would never have proven fatal.

zh: 美国预防医学工作组最近还发布了一个对前列腺癌特定抗原检测的更明确警告，认为该检测对病人的伤害大于其益处。
en: The USPSTF recently issued an even sharper warning about the prostate-specific antigen test for prostate cancer, after concluding that the test’s harms outweigh its benefits.

zh: 此外肺癌胸部X光检测与子宫颈癌帕氏抹片检查都受到了类似（但不那么明确）的批评。
en: Chest X-rays for lung cancer and Pap tests for cervical cancer have received similar, albeit less definitive, criticism.

zh: 由于达特茅斯卫生政策研究中心的研究者们宣称乳腺癌筛查的益处往往被过度夸大，而其费用则被刻意低估，因此重新评估癌症筛查的下一步工作也在去年同步展开。
en: The next step in the reevaluation of cancer screening was taken last year, when researchers at the Dartmouth Institute for Health Policy announced that the costs of screening for breast cancer were often minimized, and that the benefits were much exaggerated.

zh: 事实上，即便是一张可以检测出癌症的乳房X光片（全美每年为此支出达4000万美元）也不一定能拯救一条生命。
en: Indeed, even a mammogram (almost 40 million are given annually in the US) that detects a cancer does not necessarily save a life.

zh: 达特茅斯的研究者们发现，在全美每年检测出的13.8万乳腺癌案例中，乳房X光测试对其中12~13.4万遭受病痛折磨的妇女们并无帮助。
en: The Dartmouth researchers found that, of the estimated 138,000 breast cancers detected annually in the US, the test did not help 120,000-134,000 of the afflicted women.

zh: 那些癌瘤要么太小以至于未能威胁，要么在过一段时间后的临床检测中发现后（或者疯狂扩散而使人无计可施）反而更能得到有效治疗。
en: The cancers either were growing so slowly that they did not pose a problem, or they would have been treated successfully if discovered clinically later (or they were so aggressive that little could be done).

zh: 与之相关则是测量标准的问题。
en: A related concern is measurement.

zh: 由于病人的存活期是从诊断结论下达后开始计算的，那么更灵敏的筛查肯定能更早得出结论。
en: Since the patient’s duration of survival is calculated from the time of diagnosis, more sensitive screening starts the clock sooner.

zh: 于是在早期诊断对病人的生存并无实质影响的情况下，存活期似乎却变得更长了。
en: Survival times can thus appear longer, even if the earlier diagnosis had no real effect on survival.

zh: 毫无疑问，适用于不同病例的检测和治疗方案各有不同，但对于频繁的筛查来说，另一个要注意的地方就是假阳性的问题。
en: Naturally, individual cases dictate which tests and treatments are best, but an additional concern about frequent screenings is the problem of false positives.

zh: 当您在寻找一项相对罕见的东西之时（不管是癌症还是恐怖分子 ） ， 最好记住某些阳性结论往往会是错误的。
en: When one is looking for something relatively rare (whether cancer or terrorists), it is wise to remember that a positive result is often false.

zh: 要么那个“检测出来的”病理状态根本不存在，要么就并不是致命的。
en: Either the “detected” pathology is not there, or it is not the sort that will kill you.

zh: 请参见下面这个假想的例子。
en: Consider the following hypothetical example.

zh: 假设某特定癌症筛查方式的准确率为95 % ， 那么说如果有个人患上了这种癌症，那么该测试呈现阳性的概率为95 % 。
en: Assume that the screening test for a certain cancer is 95% accurate, meaning that if someone has the cancer, the test will be positive 95% of the time.

zh: 再推一步，假设有人并未患有这种癌症而呈现阳性的概率为1 % 。
en: Next, assume that if someone does not have the cancer, the test will be positive only 1% of the time.

zh: 最后，我们进一步假设有0.5%的人 — — 也就是1/200 — — 真的会患上这种癌症。
en: Finally, assume further that 0.5% of people – one of every 200 – actually have this type of cancer.

zh: 那如果你的医生告诉你说测试结果呈阳性，是否就意味着你多半会患有此病？
en: If your doctor tells you that you have tested positive, does this mean that you are likely to have the cancer?

zh: 令人吃惊的是，答案是否定的。
en: Surprisingly, the answer is no.

zh: 让我们做一个简单的演算。
en: A little arithmetic shows why.

zh: 假设医院共做了10万次检测。
en: Suppose that 100,000 screenings are conducted.

zh: 其中平均有500人会得癌症。
en: On average, 500 people will have the cancer.

zh: 由于患病者检测出阳性的概率是95 % ， 那么平均会475个阳性结果。
en: Since 95% of them will test positive, there will be, on average, 475 positive tests.

zh: 而对于剩下那9.95万健康人来说，由于出现阳性结果的概率是1 % ， 那么就会有995个假阳性出现，因此这10万人中会有475+995=1470个阳性结果。
en: Of the 99,500 people without cancer, 1% will test positive, yielding 995 false positives out of 1,470 positive tests.

zh: 换句话说，即便你的癌症检测结果呈阳性，你真正患有该病的可能性也只有32 % 。
en: In other words, even if you tested positive for the cancer, the probability that you actually have it is only about 32%.

zh: 这个答案显然是违反直觉的，因此也很容易引发抵触心理。
en: That answer is decidedly counterintuitive and hence easy to reject.

zh: 其实绝大多数人都是以“50-50”或者“百万分之一”来理解可能性这个词的。
en: Most people do not think in terms of probabilities other than “50-50” and “one in a million.”

zh: 但不管可能性几何，事实依然是在筛查某些罕见病症时总会出现高比例的假阳性结果。
en: But, whatever the probabilities, the fact remains that there will generally be a high percentage of false positives when screening for rare conditions.

zh: 此外，那些受到错误诊断的患者通常会接受进一步治疗，也往往会带来有害的后果。
en: Moreover, the patients who receive these faulty diagnoses will usually receive further treatments, which often will have harmful consequences.

zh: 由于人类倾向于通过联想起相关事例的难易程度来评估一种情况出现的可能性，而这种认知偏好又是普遍存在的 — — 也就是所谓的“可用性启发（availability heuristic ） ” ，通常会令事情变得更加模糊不清。
en: The “availability heuristic” – a pervasive cognitive bias caused by people’s tendency to estimate the likelihood of a phenomenon by how easily an example of it comes to mind – routinely clouds the issue.

zh: 相对于一个陌生人因为筛查测试而受苦的统计概率，人们更容易联想起一个挣扎在癌症死亡线上的熟人。
en: People relate much more readily to a friend dying of cancer than they do to statistics about strangers suffering from the consequences of testing.

zh: 但对此最重要的底线在于目前对癌症筛查的重新评估是有证据支撑的。
en: But the bottom line is that the ongoing reevaluation of cancer screening is evidence-based.

zh: 当这涉及到政策制定的时候，决策必须基于事实和论证，而不是道听途说 — — 不管这些描述究竟有多么活灵活现。
en: When it comes to policymaking, decisions must be based on facts and argument, not anecdotes and stories, however compelling those narratives may be.

zh: 发展中世界的癌症治疗
en: Cancer Care for the Developing World

zh: 波士顿—四十多年前，美国总统尼克松宣布“向癌症开战 ” 。 让他感到欢欣鼓舞以至于做出这一决定的是化疗能够治愈急性淋巴细胞白血病和何杰金氏淋巴瘤的该疾病的令人鼓舞的早期结果。
en: BOSTON – More than four decades ago, US President Richard Nixon, inspired by early and encouraging results that showed that chemotherapy could cure diseases such as acute lymphoblastic leukemia and Hodgkin’s lymphoma, declared “war on cancer.”

zh: 自此以后，在使用化疗、手术和放疗治疗和治愈越来越多癌症患者方面取得了稳步进展。
en: Since then, steady progress has been made using chemotherapy, surgery, and radiation to treat and cure an increasing number of cancer patients.

zh: 但中低收入国家仍难以接触到这些救命进步，而当今世界大部分癌症患者都在中低收入国家。
en: But access to these life-saving advances remains elusive in low- and middle-income countries, where the majority of cancer patients reside today.

zh: 在美国，80%以上的乳腺癌患者都能长期生存，80%以上的癌症儿童可以存活。
en: In the United States, more than 80% of patients with breast cancer are long-term survivors, and more than 80% of cancer-stricken children survive.

zh: 我在哈佛大学做了近40年肿瘤专家，医治过数千名患者，如果不是化疗，他们生存机会渺茫。
en: In my nearly 40 years as an oncologist at Harvard University, I have cared for thousands of patients who would have had little chance of survival were it not for chemotherapy.

zh: 许多患者在20世纪70年代开始接受治疗，至今仍活得好好的；他们的孩子们现在已长大成人并有生育能力。
en: Many of the patients who received treatment in the 1970s are alive and well today; their children are now productive adults.

zh: 但直到2011年我开始在卢旺达工作才充分认识到我手中的工具的力量，因为我目睹了没有它们所带来的影响。
en: But it was not until I began working in Rwanda in 2011 that I fully grasped the power of the tools at my disposal, by witnessing the impact of their absence.

zh: 进入基加利公立中心医院儿科癌症病房就像进入了时间旅行。
en: Stepping into the pediatric cancer ward at the central public referral hospital in Kigali was like traveling back in time.

zh: 罹患维尔姆斯瘤（Wilms’ tumor，成年人很少得的肾癌）的卢旺达儿童的最后结局如同80年前的美国，而如今，药物可以让90%的确诊美国儿童病患存活下来。
en: Outcomes among Rwandan children with Wilms’ tumor, a form of kidney cancer that rarely afflicts adults, mirrored those in the US 80 years ago, before the availability of drugs that today enable more than 90% of diagnosed American children to survive.

zh: 根据卢旺达卫生部长比纳格瓦霍（Agnes Binagwaho）的说法，十年前，当她还在医院当儿科医师时，基加利的癌症病房就像是艾滋病单位。
en: According to Rwanda’s health minister, Agnes Binagwaho, the cancer ward in Kigali resembled the HIV/AIDS unit when she was a pediatrician at the hospital, a decade earlier.

zh: 在没有逆抗转录病毒疗法的情况下，给艾滋病开的药方不外乎食物和休息 — — 这意味着染上艾滋病无异于被判死刑。
en: With no antiretroviral therapy, the prescription for HIV/AIDS was food and rest – meaning that infection essentially amounted to a death sentence.

zh: 当时，一些人 — — 还好只是暂时地 — — 站在了历史的错误面。
en: At the time, some were caught, if only briefly, on the wrong side of history.

zh: 2001年，一名资深美国官员宣称治疗非洲的艾滋病是不可能的，因为非洲太“复杂”��成本太高。
en: In 2001, a senior US official claimed that it would be impossible to treat HIV/AIDS in Africa, owing to its “complexity” and high cost.

zh: 但他 — — 以及众多与他持有相同观点的人 — — 被证明是错误的。
en: But he – along with the many others who shared his view – was proved wrong.

zh: 今天，非洲能获得药物的艾滋病毒阳性病人坚持治疗的比率早已超过了美国。
en: Today, rates of treatment adherence in Africa among HIV-positive patients with access to drugs have long exceeded those in the US.

zh: 事实上，卢旺达是世界上第一批实现艾滋病治疗全民普及的国家之一。
en: Indeed, Rwanda was one of the first countries to achieve universal access to AIDS treatment.

zh: 尽管如此，非洲有效癌症治疗的前景仍然遭到了类似的怀疑。
en: Despite this experience, the prospect of effective cancer treatment in Africa has been met with similar skepticism.

zh: 诚然，癌症治疗十分复杂。
en: True, cancer therapy is complex.

zh: 它要求一系列诊断和治疗能力 — — 病理学、手术、放疗、化疗和靶向药物 — — 还需要安全实施这些救命治疗的知识和技能。
en: It requires a broad range of diagnostic and therapeutic capacities – pathology, surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, and targeted medicines – together with the knowledge and skill to safely administer these life-saving treatments.

zh: 但巴特罗卓越癌症中心（Butaro Cancer Center of Excellence）和其他医院证明可以安全有效地治疗癌症患者，哪怕是农村环境下的穷人患者。
en: But the Butaro Cancer Center of Excellence and others like it have proved that it is possible to treat cancer patients safely and effectively, even in poor, rural settings.

zh: 感谢卢旺达卫生部、健康伙伴基金会（Partners In Health）和位于波士顿的丹娜-法伯癌症研究所（Dana-Farber Cancer Institute ） ， 自2012年7月由前总统克林顿和比纳格瓦霍建立以来，巴特罗中心现已治疗了3,000多名癌症患者，其中大部分由该地区之外转入。
en: Thanks to the Rwandan Ministry of Health, Partners In Health, and the Boston-based Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, the Butaro Center has treated more than 3,000 cancer patients, most of whom are referred from outside the region, since its dedication in July 2012 by former President Bill Clinton and Binagwaho.

zh: 来自杰夫·戈登儿童基金会（Jeff Gordon Children’s Foundation ） 、 乳腺癌研究基金会（Breast Cancer Research Foundation ） 、 坚强活着基金会（LIVESTRONG）和私人赞助者的支持也是巴特罗中心成功的关键。
en: Support from the Jeff Gordon Children’s Foundation, the Breast Cancer Research Foundation, LIVESTRONG, and private donors has also been critical to this achievement.

zh: 幸运的是，一些大机构已开始采取行动支持这一努力。
en: Fortunately, some major institutions are already stepping up to bolster this effort.

zh: 世界卫生组织与国际癌症控制联盟（International Union for Cancer Control）一起，正在二次考察世卫组织重要癌症药品模型列表（WHO Model List of Essential Medicines for Cancer ） ， 以更准确地识别哪些癌症对治疗反应最大，哪些癌症给人口带来最大负担。
en: The World Health Organization, together with the International Union for Cancer Control, is re-examining the WHO Model List of Essential Medicines for Cancer to identify more accurately which cancers are most responsive to treatment, and which place the heaviest burdens on populations.

zh: 降低全球癌症致命性的最有效办法是将现有癌症患者疗法移植到发展中国家。
en: The most efficient approach to reducing global cancer mortality rates would be to bring existing therapies to cancer patients in developing countries.

zh: 除此之外还有针对癌症治疗的国际资金 — — 就像通过美国总统艾滋病治疗紧急计划（US President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief）和全球基金（The Global Fund）动员的艾滋病治疗资金那样 — — 发展中国家的癌症致命率可以大幅下降 — — 并且以很快的速度实现。
en: Add to that international funding for cancer treatment, like that which was mobilized for HIV/AIDS through the US President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief and The Global Fund, and cancer mortality rates in developing countries could decline considerably – and quickly.

zh: 十多年前，国际社会决定不能在接受艾滋病患者的大量死亡。
en: More than a decade ago, the international community decided that it would no longer accept certain death for HIV patients.

zh: 今天，我们也必须做出同样的承诺，把救命癌症治疗带给世界各地的患者。
en: We must make the same commitment today to bring life-saving cancer treatment to patients everywhere.

zh: 癌症世界
en: Cancer World

zh: 匹兹堡—在1971年，尼克松总统发动了一场针对癌症的“战争 ” 。
en: PITTSBURGH – In 1971, President Richard M. Nixon launched a “war” against cancer.

zh: 但近四十年后，这场战役的焦点仍然是开发具有高赢利性的治疗癌症的药物和技术方面的努力，而引发癌症的环境因素却几乎被忽略了。
en: But, nearly four decades later, the battle remains focused on highly profitable efforts to develop drugs and technologies to treat the disease while virtually ignoring environmental factors that cause it.

zh: 诚然，死于癌症的人数量下降首先是因为控制吸烟—一项千呼万唤始出来，却仍然乏力的举措。
en: True, cancer deaths have dropped chiefly because of long-delayed – and still poorly supported – efforts to curb smoking.

zh: 在乳腺、肛肠和子宫颈癌的诊断和治疗方面的成功也助了一臂之力。
en: Successes with screening and treatment of breast, colo-rectal, and cervical cancer have also helped.

zh: 但美国和世界其他地方的黑人和少数族裔却没有分享到这些成功，环境因素似乎可以解释这种不平等。
en: But blacks and other minorities in the United States – and elsewhere in the world – do not share in these successes, and environmental factors appear to explain the disparity.

zh: 例如，尽管美国人口中有八分之一是黑人，但他们当中的三分之一从事着保洁或其他的蓝领工作。
en: For example, while one in eight Americans is black, one in three is employed in sanitation or other blue-collar jobs.

zh: 另外，他们体内可预防癌症的维生素D水平只有白人的一半，并且还更有可能居住在受到污染的社区。
en: Moreover, they have half the level of cancer-protective vitamin D as whites, and they are much more likely to live in polluted neighborhoods.

zh: 的确，与吸烟和衰老无关的癌症病患正在增加。
en: Indeed, cases of cancer that are not tied to smoking or aging are increasing.

zh: 癌症是造成中年人和儿童（仅次于事故）死亡的主要原因。 而且我们不能解释为什么对于大多数种类的癌症黑人的死亡率要高于白人。
en: Cancer is the leading cause of death in middle-aged persons and children (after accidents), and we can’t explain why, for most forms of cancer, death rates are higher for blacks than they are for whites.

zh: 我们现在可以断言的是癌症本身是一个错误的敌人。
en: What we can say is that the disease itself is the wrong enemy.

zh: 我们应该打击所知的环境致癌物质—不仅仅是烟草，还有辐射、阳光、苯、溶剂和某些药物及荷尔蒙。
en: Instead, we should be attacking known environmental carcinogens – not just tobacco, but also radiation, sunlight, benzene, solvents, and some drugs and hormones.

zh: 现代的致癌物质，如柴油废气、杀虫剂和其他空气污染物都没有得到系统的研究。
en: Modern cancer-causing agents like diesel exhaust, pesticides, and other air pollutants are not systematically studied.

zh: 即便在我们考虑到这些因素时，也认为它们是进步的必然代价。
en: When they are considered at all, they are deemed to be the inevitable price of progress.

zh: 但大多数的癌症都是后天而非先天的，是我们的基因在整个生命的过程中不断遭受破坏的结果。
en: But most cancers are made, not born, arising from damage to our genes that occurs throughout our lives.

zh: 虽然在出生时，同卵双胞胎的基因极其相似，但他们却罹患不同的癌症。
en: Despite having remarkably similar genes at birth, identical twins do not develop the same cancers.

zh: 到50岁时，他们的染色体带已大不相同。
en: By age 50, their chromosomal bands are profoundly different from one another.

zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心确认当今儿童的血液中含有二十年前并不存在的数十种化学物质，其中包括许多已知会导致癌症和一系列其他疾病的破坏基因的化合物。
en: America’s Centers for Disease Control and Prevention confirm that children’s blood today contains dozens of chemicals that did not exist two decades earlier, including many gene-damaging compounds known to cause cancer and a host of other diseases.

zh: 现在育龄期男女的体内所携带的扰乱荷尔蒙分泌的化合物足以降低他们的生育能力。
en: Men and women of child-bearing age now carry enough hormone-disturbing compounds in their bodies to impair their fertility.

zh: 在十四岁以前接触过高含量的杀虫剂DDT的女性到中年时患乳腺癌的几率要高五倍。
en: Women exposed to higher levels of the pesticide DDT before the age of fourteen have a five times higher chances of developing breast cancer when they reach middle age.

zh: 在整个工业化世界的儿童癌症、睾丸癌和非霍奇金淋巴瘤发病率不断攀升的谜团背后，这些化合物扮演了怎样的角色呢？ 我们应该探究这种关联么？
en: Could such compounds play a role in unexplained and growing rates of childhood cancer, testicular cancer, and non-Hodgkin’s Lymphoma throughout the industrial world?   Should we wait to find out?

zh: 尽管我们目前在防止年轻人因癌症而死亡方面取得了巨大的成功，但这种成功却是一种“浮士德式交易”的结果。
en: While we are phenomenally successful at keeping young people from dying of cancer today, that success comes as a Faustian bargain.

zh: 为控制非霍奇金淋巴瘤而在胸部接受过放射治疗的女性有三分之一的人会在32岁时罹患乳腺癌。
en: One of three young women treated with radiation to the chest to arrest Hodgkin’s disease will develop breast cancer by age 32.

zh: 当然，这些病人如果没有接触过环境中的致癌物质，许多癌症首先就不会发生。
en: Of course, many cancers might not have developed in the first place had these patients not been exposed to other cancer-causing agents in the environment.

zh: 我们对现代生活方便性的依赖使我们非自愿的情况下成为许多不受控制的实验的对象。
en: Our dependence on many modern conveniences makes us the subject of vast uncontrolled experiments to which none of us is asked to consent.

zh: 例如，手机的长期安全性仍然未能得到证实。
en: For example, the long-term safety of mobile phones remains unproven.

zh: 在1990年代早期吹捧其安全性的研究中并没有纳入商务使用者。
en: Widely publicized studies in the early 1990’s touting their safety excluded business users.

zh: 最近来自法国和瑞典的研究报告表明那些使用手机达十年或更长时间的人患脑癌的风险增加了一倍。
en: Recent reports from France and Sweden find that those who have used mobile phones for ten or more years have double the risk of brain cancer.

zh: 同样令人不安的是，瑞士和中国手机微波辐射的法定极限比美国的低五百倍。
en: Also troubling is the fact that the limit for microwave emission from mobile phones is 500 times lower in Switzerland and China than in the US.

zh: 有一句中国成语叫：一叶障目。
en: A way of looking is a way of not looking, runs a Chinese proverb.

zh: 对某些环境性癌症隐患的证据有限不应该与证明无害混为一谈：相关研究比较困难，且在美国只有极少一部分受到政府和商业的资助。
en: The limited nature of evidence on some environmental cancer hazards should not be confused with proof that no harm has occurred: the research is hard to do, and, in the US, very little of it is now funded by the government and private sector.

zh: 另外，烟草工业通过诡计，以巨额的资金支持发动长期的、处心积虑的假信息攻势，也在环境癌症风险方面混淆视听。
en: Moreover, confusion about environmental cancer risks also results from longstanding, carefully cultivated, and well-financed disinformation campaigns inspired by the machinations of the tobacco industry.

zh: 我们不能忽略环境对我们健康的重要性。
en: We cannot afford to ignore the signs of the importance of the environment for our health.

zh: 为了应对癌症的灾难，我们必须致力于首先防止人们罹患癌症以作为对其诊治研究的有力补充。
en: To address the scourge of cancer, we must complement efforts to detect and treat cancer with new ways to keep people from developing the disease in the first place.

zh: 中国能战胜通缩吗？
en: Can China Beat Deflation?

zh: 北京—当经济减速、公司债务高企时，通缩循环将是中国最不堪的噩梦。
en: BEIJING – At a time of slowing economic growth and massive corporate debts, a deflationary spiral would be China’s worst nightmare.

zh: 风险正在堆积。
en: And the risk is mounting.

zh: 自2012年9月以来，生产者物价指数（PPI）已连续39个月负增长。
en: The producer price index (PPI) has been in negative territory for 39 consecutive months, since February 2012.

zh: 中国消费物价指数（CPI）尽管仍在正增长，但幅度稳步下降，从2011年7月的6.5%降至今年5月的1.2 % 。
en: The growth of China’s consumer price index (CPI), though still positive, has also been falling steadily, from 6.5% in July 2011 to 1.2% in May.

zh: 从历史经验看，中国CPI也将很快步入负增长。
en: If past experience is any indication, China’s CPI will turn negative very soon.

zh: 中国上一次经历长期通缩是1998—2002年，物价持续下降的原因是1993年开始的货币和财政紧缩，而缺少倒闭企业退出机制则令情况雪上加霜。
en: In China’s last protracted bout of deflation, from 1998 to 2002, persistent declines in prices were the result of monetary and fiscal tightening that began in 1993, compounded by the lack of exit mechanisms for failed enterprises.

zh: 通胀在1994年达到顶峰（24 % ） ，随后从1995年开始下降。
en: After peaking at 24% in 1994, inflation began to decline in 1995.

zh: 但GDP增长很快开始大幅恶化。
en: But GDP growth soon began deteriorating rapidly.

zh: 为了在困难的全球环境下重振增长、在亚洲金融危机的冲击下支持出口，中国政府从1997年11月开始放松货币和财政政策。
en: In an effort to revive growth in a difficult global environment and buffer exports against the impact of the Asian financial crisis, the Chinese government loosened monetary and fiscal policy beginning in November 1997.

zh: 但放松来得太晚，强度也太小。
en: But it was too little too late.

zh: 1998年CPI通胀开始下降时，生产者物价已经下跌了八个月，并在总共51个月的时间里保持负增长，而CPI在39个月后开始恢复。
en: By 1998, when CPI inflation began to fall, producer prices had already been declining for eight months, and remained negative for a total of 51 months, with CPI growth beginning to recover after 39 months.

zh: 一个显而易见的教训是政府应该早一点开始放松政策，力度也应该更大。
en: An obvious lesson is that the government should have switched to loosening earlier, and more forcefully.

zh: 但这一经验也彰显出通缩环境中货币政策的无力，因为银行不愿放贷，企业也不愿借钱。
en: But this experience also underscores the impotence of monetary policy in a deflationary environment, owing to the unwillingness of banks to lend and of enterprises to borrow.

zh: 亏损企业被允许大量生产廉价商品，从而影响到高质量企业的盈利能力（以及它们的投资激励 ） ， 这一事实延长了通缩时间。
en: The fact that loss-making enterprises were allowed to churn out cheap products, eroding the profitability of high-quality enterprises (and thus their incentive to invest), prolonged the deflation.

zh: 尽管如此，中国最终成功地摆脱了通缩，回归了快速经济增长之路。
en: Nonetheless, China eventually managed to rid itself of deflation and return to rapid economic growth.

zh: 首先，通缩时期的投资下降 — — 以及企业的关停并转 — — 削减了产能，为2002年投资强劲反弹铺平了道路。
en: For starters, a decline in investment during the deflationary period – together with firm closures, mergers, and acquisitions – reduced overcapacity, clearing the way for investment to rebound strongly in 2002.

zh: 与此同时，扩张性财政政策增加了有效需求，而政府在良好的公共财政状况的支持下也能够有效处理不良贷款，从而增加了商业银行的放贷意愿和企业的借款能力。
en: At the same time, expansionary fiscal policy increased effective demand, while the government, backed by its strong public-finance position, was able to tackle nonperforming loans effectively, thereby increasing commercial banks’ willingness to lend and firms’ ability to borrow.

zh: 此外，20世纪90年代末房地产市场改革和按揭贷款市场的发展助长了房地产投资的快速增长，到2000年，房地产年增长率达到了20 % 。
en: Moreover, housing-market reforms and the development of a mortgage-loan market in the late 1990s fueled rapid growth in real-estate investment, which reached an annual rate of over 20% in 2000.

zh: 结果，房地产开发成为经济增长的重要引擎，即使在中国加入世贸组织大幅提振出口之后仍是如此。
en: As a result, real-estate development became the most important contributor to economic growth, even as exports boomed following China’s accession to the World Trade Organization.

zh: 伴随新增长引擎出现而出现的问题是它让中国领导人推迟了重要的结构改革。
en: The problem with the emergence of these new growth engines is that it enabled China’s leaders to delay important structural reforms.

zh: 结果，如今的中国面临着许多与20世纪90年代末同样的问题 — — 首先就是产能过剩。
en: As a result, China now faces many of the same challenges it faced in the late 1990s – beginning with overcapacity.

zh: 在经历了15年的房地产开发快速增长后，这并不令人奇怪。
en: After 15 years of rapid growth in real-estate development, this is not surprising.

zh: 但这并没有降低任何风险。
en: But that does not make it any less risky.

zh: 身水身汗，如果放任产能过剩继续给物价造成下降压力，中国的经济增长将无法稳定在与其潜力一致的水平上；相反，中国经济将陷入债务通缩的恶性循环。
en: In fact, if overcapacity is allowed to continue putting downward pressure on prices, China’s economic growth will not stabilize at a rate consistent with its potential; instead, the economy will be pushed into a vicious spiral of debt deflation.

zh: 眼下，当局可以通过关停并转和其他结构性措施消除过剩产能。
en: At this point, the authorities could eliminate overcapacity through firm closures, mergers and acquisitions, and other structural measures.

zh: 当局还可以通过用扩张性货币和财政政策刺激有效需求来消除过剩产能。
en: They could also seek to eliminate excess capacity by using expansionary monetary and fiscal policies to stimulate effective demand.

zh: 理论上，长期解决办法应该是追求结构性调整以改进资源配置。
en: In theory, the long-term solution would be to pursue structural adjustments that would improve the allocation of resources.

zh: 但这一过程将痛苦而缓慢。
en: But that would be painful and slow.

zh: 在短期和长期方针之间形成平衡将是中国领导层的主要挑战之一。
en: Striking a balance between the short- and long-term approaches will prove to be a major challenge for China’s leadership.

zh: 让局面更加复杂的是以下事实：与1997—2002年间不同，如今中国无法通过刺激房地产投资和出口吸收过剩产能。
en: Complicating this effort is the fact that, unlike in 1997-2002, China cannot absorb overcapacity by stimulating real-estate investment and exports.

zh: 也没人知道被热议的“创新产业”是否能够形成与昔日的房地产投资和出口等量齐观的影响力 — — 因为传统行业的产能过剩情况实在太严重了。
en: And no one knows whether the much-discussed “innovative industries” can have the impact that real-estate investment and exports did – not least because there is so much excess capacity in the traditional industries.

zh: 中国必须竭尽全力避免陷入债务-通缩陷阱。
en: China must do what it takes to avoid falling into the debt-deflation trap.

zh: 幸运的是，中国仍有空间投资于能促进增长的基础设施和创新行业。
en: Fortunately, China still has room to invest in growth-enhancing infrastructure and innovative industries.

zh: 扩大社会安全、改善公共品供给的政策能支持这方面的动作，通过让家庭减少预防性储蓄提振国内消费。
en: Policies to expand social security and improve the provision of public goods could support these efforts, boosting domestic consumption by allowing households to reduce their precautionary savings.

zh: 但是，与此同时，中国领导人必须继续追求结构改革和调整日程，及时这样会对短期增长造成消极影响。
en: At the same time, however, China’s leadership must continue to pursue its agenda of structural reform and adjustment, even if it may have an adverse impact on growth in the short run.

zh: 中国绝不可继续回避改革。
en: China simply cannot afford to continue to kick the reform can down the road.

zh: 据说马克·吐温曾经说过 ： “ 历史不会重演，但总是惊人的相似。
en: As Mark Twain once purportedly said, “History doesn’t repeat itself, but it does rhyme.”

zh: ”中国应该为一段时间的通缩做好准备，这段时期也许比上一次通缩期更长。
en: China should brace itself for a period of deflation, which may be even more protracted than the last one.

zh: 但是，如果有正确的方针 — — 以及一点点运气 — — 中国可以确保这一回的复苏将比过去更加可持续。
en: But, with the right approach – and a bit of good luck – it can make sure that, this time, it recovers more sustainably than in the past.

zh: 人民币的挑战
en: The Renminbi Challenge

zh: 发自首尔 — — 上个月中国公开其第一艘航空母舰，为在南中国海地区挑战美国作好准备。
en: SEOUL – Last month, China unveiled its first aircraft carrier, and is gearing up to challenge the United States in the South China Sea.

zh: 与此同时，通过启动一项货币国际化计划，中国也正试图在国际舞台上挑战美元。
en: By initiating a plan to internationalize its currency, China is similarly seeking to challenge the dollar on the international stage.

zh: 在为人民币打造一个国际角色的过程中，中国的政策制定者的行动相当谨慎。
en: In carving out a global role for the renminbi, Chinese policymakers are proceeding deliberately.

zh: 用中国的一句古话说，就是“摸着石头过河 ” 。
en: In the words of the venerable Chinese proverb, they are “feeling for the stones while crossing the river.”

zh: 当局的第一步是授权中国公司在跨境贸易结算中使用人民币。
en: The authorities’ first step was to authorize Chinese companies to use the renminbi in cross-border trade settlements.

zh: 随着出口到中国的国外公司接受用人民币结算，这些公司在香港的银行账户上就会累积人民币。
en: As foreign firms exporting to China accepted payment in renminbi, the currency piled up in their bank accounts in Hong Kong.

zh: 随后就到了第二步:希望在中国投资的外国公司被允许通过发行以人民币计价的债券来使用这些存款，同时符合条件的境外金融机构被允许在中国的银行间债券市场投资人民币基金。
en: That led to the next step: Foreign firms wishing to invest in China were allowed to tap those deposits by issuing renminbi-denominated bonds, and eligible offshore financial institutions were permitted to invest renminbi funds in China’s interbank bond market.

zh: 然后，去年夏天中国宣布了允许香港银行出借人民币给深圳企业的相关计划，这就相当于在金融意义上向全世界开放了深圳。
en: Then, last summer, China announced plans to allow banks in Hong Kong to lend renminbi to companies in Shenzhen, opening that city financially to the rest of the world.

zh: 人们预期如果金融开放能在深圳奏效，那么也可以在国内其他地区广泛推广。
en: The expectation is that if financial opening works in Shenzhen, it will be implemented more widely.

zh: 最后，作为把人民币变成储备货币这个过程中的其中一步，中国与菲律宾，韩国，日本和澳大利亚签订了货币互换协议。
en: Finally, as a step toward making the renminbi a reserve currency, China signed currency-swap agreements with the Philippines, South Korea, Japan, and Australia.

zh: 同时，马来西亚，尼日利亚和智利也已经储备了一定数额的人民币。
en: Meanwhile, Malaysia, Nigeria, and Chile have already acquired modest amounts of renminbi reserves.

zh: 其他国家的中央银行估计也会效仿。
en: Other central banks are expected to follow.

zh: 那么，中国要把人民币转化为美元的国际对手这一计划是否能成功呢？
en: So, will China’s plan for transforming the renminbi into an international rival to the dollar succeed?

zh: 在我看来，答案在于中国如何应对以下四个挑战。
en: The answer, in my view, turns on how China addresses four challenges.

zh: 首先，中国需要建立流动性更强的金融市场。
en: First, China will have to build more liquid financial markets.

zh: 其债券市场规模依然较小，交易额偏低，这是因为大部分债券都由国内投资者持有直至到期。
en: Its bond markets remain small, and trading volume is low, because the majority of bonds are held to maturity by domestic investors.

zh: 而这对其他国家的中央银行来说是一个相当重要的问题，因为它们在决定持有哪种货币作为储备时都会重点考虑流动性。
en: This is a matter of considerable importance to central banks, which value liquidity when deciding which currencies to hold as reserve.

zh: 毕竟正是美国国库债券的流动性使其成为世界上最主要的储备资产。
en: After all, it is the liquidity of US Treasury bonds that makes them the world’s leading reserve asset.

zh: 第二，这将取决于中国如何将这一转型进程引导向一个更加开放的资本帐户。
en: Second, much will depend on how China navigates the transition to a more open capital account.

zh: 历史经验告诉我们，紧随资本帐户急剧自由化过程之后的往往就是金融危机。
en: History is littered with financial crises occurring in the wake of precipitous capital-account liberalization.

zh: 一旦中国遭受金融危机的冲击，显然也对促进国际上对其货币的使用没什么好处。
en: Falling prey to a crisis would not exactly encourage international use of China’s currency.

zh: 第三，人民币成为国际储备货币的前景将受中国如何处理其经济增长放缓状况的影响。
en: Third, the renminbi’s international and reserve-currency prospects will be shaped by how China handles its growth slowdown.

zh: 关键在于它是否能做到平稳地减速 — — 如果成功平稳减速，那么人民币的国际化将会继续进行，相反如果经济出现硬着陆，这样的话社会动荡将会加剧，所有的希望也将落空。
en: The key will be whether it manages a smooth deceleration, in which case renminbi internationalization will proceed, or suffers a hard landing, in which case social unrest will intensify and all bets are off.

zh: 最后一个挑战可以用一个很少被提出的问题来阐明：中国的政治体系会不会是人民币走向国际化的障碍？
en: The last challenge can be stated as a question that is rarely posed: Is China’s political system an obstacle to renminbi internationalization?

zh: 分别作为19世纪和20世纪主要国际储备货币的英镑和美元都是由民主国家发行的。
en: The pound sterling and the dollar, the principal international and reserve currencies of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries respectively, were issued by democracies.

zh: 英国和美国都拥有竞争性选举以及限制滥用行政权力的政治体制 — — 但这些东西在中国的政治制度中是缺失的。
en: Britain and the US had contested elections and political systems that limited the arbitrary exercise of executive power – institutions that are absent in China’s political system.

zh: 民主政治对国际货币地位很重要的原因之一在于民主选举出来的政府最能够许下开发大规模以及流动性的金融市场所需的信用承诺。
en: One reason why democracy might matter for international currency status is that democratically elected governments are best able to make the credible commitments needed to develop deep and liquid financial markets.

zh: 它们可以承诺不剥夺债权人的权利，因为如果不能够保证这一点的话后者就会投票赶它们下台。
en: They can commit not to expropriate creditors, since the latter will vote them out of office if they do.

zh: 这种对债权的尊重既使国内投资者放心，同样也使国外的官方和私人的投资者放心。
en: And the same respect for creditor rights that reassures domestic investors reassures foreign investors – both official and private – as well.

zh: 那么中国是否可以不需要实现民主全面过渡，就足以限制恣意妄为的行政权力并强化债权？
en: Might it be possible for China to establish limits on arbitrary executive power and strengthen creditor rights sufficiently without undertaking a full-fledged transition to democracy?

zh: 直到目前为止，对中国共产党总书记，也是该国最高领导人的决策约束一直是 — — 委婉地说 — — 有限的。
en: Until now, constraints on decision-making by the general secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, the country’s highest-ranking official, have been – how to put it politely? – limited.

zh: 但情况正在发生变化。
en: But that is beginning to change.

zh: 中共中央总书记的权力正日益受到中国共产党其他机构的限制。
en: The general secretary is increasingly constrained by the CCP’s other institutions.

zh: 比如，全国人民代表大会的审议已经逐渐在从形式化向实质性过渡。
en: The deliberations of the National People’s Congress, for example, are becoming less ceremonial and more substantive.

zh: 对其他的政府决策者而言，他们越来越受制于公众对透明度和信息披露的要求。
en: Other bureaucratic decision makers, for their part, are increasingly constrained by requirements of transparency and disclosure.

zh: 基于互联网的运动正推动中国政策制定者加强劳工和环保标准。
en: Internet-based movements are forcing Chinese policymakers to strengthen labor and environmental standards.

zh: 那强化债权人的权利又有何不可？
en: Why not creditor rights?

zh: 从十九世纪初以来，主要的国际货币都一直都是由是处于民主政治体制下的国家发行，而在这些国家官方是不能任意行动的，债权人的权利也因此得到良好的保障。
en: Since the early nineteenth century, the leading international currencies have been those of countries with democratic political systems, where arbitrary official action is constrained and creditors are well represented.

zh: 这虽然并不意味着中国要人民币成为主要国际储备货币就必须经历一个民主之春。
en: This does not imply that China must have a Democratic Spring before the renminbi becomes a leading international and reserve currency.

zh: 但它的确表明中国必须进一步加强全国人民代表大会的权力并创建一个以规则为基础且更加透明的政府机构，从而实现其货币目标。
en: But it does suggest that it will have to strengthen the powers of the National People’s Congress further and create a more transparent rules-based bureaucracy in order to achieve its monetary goals.

zh: 百毒不侵的中国
en: Poison-Proofing China

zh: 斯坦福 — — 去年一月，一家矿业公司向龙江倾倒镉废料后，中国环保当局勉强避免了近三百万人的饮用水遭受污染。 镉是一种有毒重金属，一般用于电池、油漆、焊接和太阳能电池的制造工艺。
en: STANFORD – Last January, China’s environmental authorities barely averted the contamination of nearly three million people’s drinking water after a mining company dumped cadmium – a toxic heavy metal used in the manufacture of batteries, paint, solder, and solar cells – into the Longjiang River.

zh: 为了防止污染扩散，当地消防部门被迫倒入了大量的水解氯化铝，目的是让氧化铝与镉发生反应沉入江底。 反应形成的有毒化合物最后被从江底挖出来。
en: To stop the contamination from spreading, the local fire department had to add significant quantities of dissolved aluminum chloride, which binds to cadmium and settles on the river bottom. The toxic sediment will eventually be dredged.

zh: 这样的健康及环境威胁在中国并不鲜见。
en: Such threats to health and the environment are not uncommon in China.

zh: 人类不适宜饮用或接触中国高达半数的河流和湖泊水源。
en: The water in as many as half of the country’s rivers and lakes is unfit for human consumption or contact.

zh: 中国还因为食品及药品污染事件而名扬海外（用含铅油漆生产的玩具和有毒牙膏自不必多言 ） 。
en: China has also gained a reputation for food and drug contamination (not to mention lead paint in toys and poisonous toothpaste).

zh: 比方说2008年发生过在奶制品中添加工业化学物质三聚氰胺，以此来伪造奶制品中的蛋白质含量。 这起事件导致6名婴儿死亡，另外300，000人因此而患病。
en: For example, in 2008, the industrial chemical melamine was added to milk products in order to give falsely high readings of milk protein, causing the death of six infants and sickening 300,000 other people.

zh: 同样，去年12月，政府质检员在其某批次牛奶中检出致癌物质黄曲霉毒素后，中国最大的乳制品公司蒙牛宣布已销毁由四川某工厂生产的危险产品。
en: Similarly, Mengniu, China’s largest dairy company, announced last December that it had destroyed hazardous products at a plant in the Sichuan province after government safety inspectors discovered the carcinogen aflatoxin in a batch of its milk.

zh: （该企业否认有消费者购买了受污染的奶制品。 ）
en: (The company denied that any contaminated milk had reached consumers.)

zh: 2007年，有人在宠物食品中故意添加三聚氰胺，以人为提高蛋白质的含量水平，导致北美、欧洲和非洲的数百只猫狗发生肾衰竭。
en: In 2007, melamine was deliberately added to an ingredient in pet food to enhance artificially its protein levels, causing renal failure in hundreds of cats and dogs in North America, Europe, and Africa.

zh: 同年晚些时候，二甘醇被误标为无毒甘油加入感冒药，在巴拿马夺去了100多人的生命，其中还包括很多儿童。
en: Later that year, diethylene glycol was mislabeled as non-toxic glycerin, then mixed into cold medicine, killing at least 100 people in Panama, including many children.

zh: 第二年，血液稀释药肝素前体遭到污染，导致美国数百人产生过敏反应，19人死亡。 德国也发生了至少80起严重的健康事件。
en: The following year, crude precursors of the blood-thinning medication heparin were contaminated, causing hundreds of allergic reactions and 19 deaths in the United States, and at least 80 serious adverse health events in Germany.

zh: 同年遭三聚氰胺污染的鸡蛋导致儿童发生肾结石和肾功能衰竭。
en: Eggs contaminated that year with melamine caused kidney stones and renal failure in children.

zh: 中国政府在健康、安全和总体生活质量方面的管理引发了越来越强烈的国内批评。
en: Internal criticism of the Chinese government’s management of health, safety, and overall quality-of-life issues is growing.

zh: 2011年7月，在东部发生尽人皆知的高铁事故后，中国国家电视台中央电视台的主播邱启明针对这场灾难打了个比喻。
en: In July 2011, following the highly publicized crash of a supposedly state-of-the-art high-speed train in eastern China, Qiu Qiming, a news anchor for the national broadcaster CCTV, turned the disaster into a metaphor.

zh: 她说 ， “ 为了追求我们可能放弃了很多东西，中国，请放慢你的脚步。
en: “While satisfying our need for speed, we might be forsaking many things,” she said. “China, please slow down.

zh: 如果跑得太快，民众的灵魂就会被甩在身后。 ”
en: If you’re too fast, you may leave the souls of your people behind.”

zh: 鉴于中国制造的商品无处不在，中国的安全记录引发了全世界消费者的担忧。
en: Given the pervasiveness of Chinese-made goods, China’s safety record concerns consumers worldwide.

zh: 但中国官员修复对其出口产品信心的零散努力 — — 如在乳品行业制定三聚氰胺含量限制并强化质量控制规定 — — 不太可能打消外国消费者或进口商的疑虑。
en: But Chinese officials’ piecemeal efforts to restore confidence in the country’s exports – for example, establishing limits for trace amounts of melamine in dairy products and tightening quality-control regulations for the dairy industry – are unlikely to reassure foreign consumers or importers.

zh: 事实上，中国决策者似乎把握不了拟定适当奖惩规则的重要性。
en: Indeed, Chinese policymakers seem unable to grasp the importance of crafting appropriate incentives and disincentives.

zh: 政府仍然采用自上而下的政策制度，而不是运用西方模式，鼓励供应链上每一个环节遵守规定的质量和安全标准。
en: Rather than adopting the Western model of motivating every link in the supply chain to adhere to specified quality and safety standards, the government continues to rely on top-down policies.

zh: 但行业分散、缺乏有效监管制度及欠缺企业层面的诱因严重影响了这种方式的有效性。
en: But the decentralized, dispersed nature of many industries, the absence of an effective regulatory infrastructure, and the lack of firm-level inducements undermine the effectiveness of this approach.

zh: 其实，供应链中无所不在的错误刺激造成了食品和药品行业普遍性、系统性的污染问题。 奶企和肝素前体供应企业都主动添加违禁物质，通过造假手段来提高产品质量。
en: In fact, perverse incentives throughout the supply chain facilitate the widespread, systematic contamination of food and drugs. Both milk producers and heparin-precursor suppliers were motivated to add adulterants that would make their products appear to be of a higher quality than they actually were.

zh: 毋庸置疑中国政府面临着一项艰巨的任务。
en: To be sure, Chinese authorities face a daunting task.

zh: 短短几十年前，中国还基本属于贫穷的农业国，主要依赖农业经济，几乎没有中产阶级。
en: Only a few decades ago, China was a poor, largely rural country with an agrarian economy and almost no middle class.

zh: 今天，中国已成为位居世界第二的经济体，拥有蓬勃发展的制造业和迅速壮大的富裕中产阶级。 当今中国15亿人口中有超过半数居住在城市。
en: Today, it boasts the world’s second-largest economy, a thriving manufacturing sector, and a rapidly growing, prosperous middle class, while more than half of China’s 1.5 billion citizens now live in cities.

zh: 直到不久前，环境保护和消费安全在美国和欧洲都还是相对次要的问题。
en: Until relatively recently, environmental protection and consumer safety were secondary issues in the United States and Europe.

zh: 1952年，伦敦连续5天出现充满微粒的致命烟雾，导致12，000人死亡，超过100，000人患病。
en: In 1952, London experienced five days of lethal, particulate-laden smog that killed 12,000 people and sickened more than 100,000.

zh: 1969年，美国污染严重的凯霍加河燃起熊熊大火。
en: And, in 1969, America’s heavily polluted Cuyahoga River caught on fire.

zh: 正如欧洲和美国在实施有效的健康和环境政策领域已经取得了实质性的进展，中国的质量控制机制也同样有改善的余地。
en: Just as Europe and the US have made substantial progress in implementing effective health and environmental policies, China’s quality-control mechanisms can be improved.

zh: 但要想解决这一问题，中国官员应该重视一句谚语 ： “ 只要功夫深，铁杵磨成针。 ”
en: But, in tackling the issue, Chinese officials would do well to heed the proverb: “With time and patience, the mulberry leaf becomes a silk gown.”

zh: 中国可以拯救欧洲吗？
en: Can China Rescue Europe?

zh: 克莱蒙特，加利福尼亚 — — 欧洲的债务危机已不再光是欧洲事件了。
en: CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA – The debt crisis in Europe is no longer a European affair.

zh: 欧洲债务危机加上对美国二次探底衰退的担忧，正在将全球经济拖入另一次金融恐慌和经济衰退循环。
en: Coupled with fears of a double-dip recession in the United States, the European debt crisis is dragging the global economy into another cycle of financial panic and economic recession.

zh: 身处外围的新兴市场经济体大体上（特别是所谓的金砖国家，即巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国）都深感幸运，没有被卷进这个金融大漩涡。
en: Sitting on the sidelines, emerging-market economies in general, and the so-called BRIC countries (Brazil, Russia, India, and China) in particular, may feel fortunate to be spared this financial maelstrom.

zh: 但它们应该再好好想想。
en: But they should think again.

zh: 在全球金融市场和贸易网络高度一体化的背景下，发达经济体（至今在全球GDP仍占近60%的比重）的金融危机和经济收缩将不可避免地有损于新兴市场国家的繁荣。
en: With closely integrated global financial markets and trading networks, financial crises and economic contractions in the developed economies, which still account for nearly 60% of the world’s GDP, will inevitably undermine emerging-market countries’ prosperity.

zh: 于是就有人开始呼吁新兴国家拿出它们的巨量外汇储备来购买希腊、意大利和西班牙等危机国的债务。
en: Some have thus called upon major emerging countries to step up and use their huge foreign-exchange reserves to purchase the debt of crisis-ravaged countries, such as Greece, Italy, and Spain.

zh: 手握3.2万亿美元外汇储备的中国更是被视为将欧洲国家救出债务泥淖的潜在白衣骑士。
en: In particular, China, with its $3.2 trillion in foreign-exchange reserves, is seen as a potential white knight coming to the rescue of debt-ridden European nations.

zh: 在人们的如是期许下，中国显得颇为犹豫，提出了各种各样的要求。
en: Playing upon such hopes, China has been both coy and demanding.

zh: 中国政府没有做出任何实质性的援助承诺，倒是公开要求欧盟给予中国梦寐以求的“市场经济”地位 — — 如果它想让中国慷慨解囊的话。
en: Without committing itself to any substantive assistance, the Chinese government has publicly demanded that the European Union grant China the coveted status of “market economy” if it expects China to loosen its purse strings.

zh: “市场经济”地位绝非小事，因为这意味着更难将中国企业在海外市场的倾销行为视为非法。
en: That status matters, because achieving it will make it more difficult for Chinese firms to be found guilty of dumping goods on overseas markets.

zh: 不幸的是，那些希望中国在平复欧洲金融恐慌中起到直接作用的人太不现实了。
en: Unfortunately, those who expect China to play a direct role in calming the financial panic in Europe are being unrealistic.

zh: 中国领导人在涉水国际金融事务时极度厌恶风险，此外，在领导人交接前夕（大约会在一年后发生 ） ， 也没有哪个高级官员敢拿自己的政治前途冒险，支持激进且充满争议的行动。
en: Chinese leaders have been extremely risk-averse in their forays into international financial affairs, and, on the eve of a leadership transition (expected to take place a year from now), no senior official dares to risk his political prospects by advocating bold and controversial action.

zh: 即使中国愿意帮助欧洲受困经济体，它也只能提供重塑欧洲主权债务信心所需要的巨额融资的一小部分。
en: Even assuming China’s willingness to help Europe’s troubled economies, it would be able to contribute only a modest portion of the huge amount of financing required to restore confidence in European sovereign debt.

zh: 但这并不意味着中国在援助欧洲的问题上什么都做不了。
en: But this does not mean that China can do nothing to help Europe.

zh: 中国官员试图以此换取欧洲的巨大让步 — — 承认其市场经济地位，但在时机和效果上都讨不到好结果，同时，中国政府需要三思 — — 如果在欧洲急需帮助的时候出手，施以有限但意义重大的援手，那么它会获得很大的好处。
en: While the attempt by Chinese officials to extract a huge concession – market-economy status – is ill-timed and in poor taste, China’s government needs to weigh the significant benefits that it could receive by providing limited but meaningful assistance to Europe in its hour of need.

zh: 事实上，作为欧洲经济稳定的相关利益者，对欧洲施以援手是符合中国自身利益的。
en: Indeed, to do so would be in China’s own interest as a key stake-holder in Europe’s economic stability.

zh: 欧盟是中国最大的贸易伙伴，2010年中国对欧盟商品出口额高达3830亿美元。
en: The EU is China’s largest trading partner, accounting for $383 billion in merchandise exports in 2010.

zh: 因此欧洲发生衰退会令依赖出口的中国经济减速。
en: So a recession in Europe would cause a slowdown in China’s export-dependent economy as well.

zh: 债务危机的金融后果也会令中国蒙受巨大损失。
en: The financial fallout from the debt crisis could also result in huge losses for China.

zh: 在中国的外汇储备中，有大约8000亿美元投资于欧元资产。
en: About $800 billion of China’s foreign-exchange reserves are invested in euro-denominated assets.

zh: 如果发生无序违约并因此造成欧元贬值的压力，中国的投资就将不可避免地遭遇价值缩水。
en: A disorderly default, and the resulting downward pressure on the euro, would unavoidably cause Chinese investments to lose value.

zh: 中国可以通过三大举措帮助欧洲，但是，要想成功，欧盟也必须抛弃某些针对中国的长期猜疑。
en: China can take three measures to help Europe, but, if they are to succeed, the EU must set aside some of its long-standing suspicions about China.

zh: 首先，中国可以通过降低其针对欧盟商品的行政贸易壁垒帮助提振欧盟的出口。
en: First, China can help boost the EU’s exports by lowering its administrative trade barriers to products from the EU.

zh: 从短期看，这会影响中国自己的经济增长，但中国对欧盟有着巨大的贸易顺差（2010年为2300亿欧元 ） ， 因此这是早就应该实施的应有之义。
en: In the short term, this might dampen China’s own growth, but, given China’s mammoth trade surplus with the EU ($230 billion in 2010), this is both long overdue and reasonable.

zh: 如果欧盟对中国的出口提升10 % （ 相当于一年净增150亿美元 ） ， 就能创造至少30万个就业岗位，并提振欧洲的增长前景。
en: A 10% increase in the EU’s exports to China (a net increase of $15 billion a year) would help create at least 300,000 jobs and boost Europe’s growth prospects.

zh: 其次，中国可以参与欧洲的银行资本重组。
en: Second, China can participate in bank recapitalization in Europe.

zh: 如今欧洲银行正在竭尽所能强化资产负债表。
en: At the moment, Europe’s banks desperately need to shore up their balance sheets.

zh: 而中国的主权财富基金和非银行金融机构早已开始对久负盛名的西方银行跃跃欲试了。
en: China’s sovereign wealth fund and non-bank financial institutions have been eager to invest in well-established Western banks.

zh: 现在银行估值大幅缩水，采取如是行动正是时候。
en: This is a good time to do so, as these banks’ valuations have plunged.

zh: 最后，欧洲的危机对中国来说也是一次扩大对欧直接投资的良机。
en: Finally, Europe’s crisis presents an attractive opportunity for China to expand its direct investment there.

zh: 2010年，中国对欧盟直接投资额只有13亿美元。
en: In 2010, Chinese direct investment in the EU totaled only $1.3 billion.

zh: 如今，欧洲政府和公司纷纷敞开怀抱欢迎外国投资者，而中国公司则可望更大的市场、技术和多元化的机会，应该可以在欧洲找到大把机会。
en: Today, when governments and companies in Europe are opening their arms to foreign investors, Chinese companies eager for markets, technologies, and diversification should find rich pickings.

zh: 但欧洲人一直对中国资金心存疑虑，这是因为他们担心中国还有不可告人的政治图谋。
en: But Chinese money has been viewed with suspicion in Europe, reflecting fears that China has a hidden political agenda.

zh: 这样的偏见也使得中国资本不愿意在欧洲进行大手笔投资。
en: Such bias has discouraged Chinese capital from making bigger bets on Europe.

zh: 现在，欧洲是时候把宝押在中国身上了。
en: It is now time for Europe to gamble on China.

zh: 这些举措可以提振欧洲中期增长前景。
en: Such measures are likely to boost Europe’s medium-term growth prospects.

zh: 它们很可能无法立刻平复当下金融市场风声鹤唳的状况，但总比在欧洲滑向金融深远时袖手旁观强得多。
en: While they would most likely have no immediate calming effect on today’s panic-stricken financial markets, they are far superior to watching with folded hands as Europe descends into a financial abyss.

zh: 民主能否战胜恐怖？
en: Can Democracy Defeat Terrorism?

zh: 布什政府发动伊拉克战争有三个重要的理论依据，其中只有一条似乎还站得住脚：那就是对中东进行民主化改造，并以此来削弱恐怖分子的根基。
