zh: 欧盟委员会不久前提议，对《稳定和增长协议 》 （ SGP）的实施方式做出重要的调整。
en: The European Commission recently proposed important changes to how the Stability and Growth Pact (SGP) is to be implemented.

zh: 目前委员会和ECOFIN（欧元区财长委员会）正在对此项建议和成员国提出的其它议案进行审阅，并将于2005年上半年做出决定。
en: Now the Commission and ECOFIN (the committee of euro area finance ministers) are reviewing the proposals, as well as others put forward by member states.

zh: 但最终决定出台之前 ， 《 协议》将如何修改仍然很不确定。
en: A decision is expected in the first half of 2005, but how the Pact will be revised remains uncertain.

zh: 改革的必要性显而易见：结构性因素在欧元区近年来的预算赤字总额中占到了75-80 % ， 而且2002年以后《协议》规定的国家预算赤字不超过国内生产总值3%的上限也屡次被突破。
en: The need for reform is self-evident: with structural factors accounting for 75-80% of aggregate budget deficits for the euro area in recent years, the Pact’s 3%-of-GDP ceiling for national budget deficits has been breached repeatedly since 2002.

zh: 虽然芬兰和爱尔兰等面积较小的成员国（其中也包括西班牙）和丹麦、瑞典两个非欧元区国家一直坚持财政平衡或小有盈余（尽管盈余量日渐减少）的预算原则，但英、法、德等欧盟最大的成员都不愿或无力遵守这项规则。
en: Smaller member states, notably Finland and Ireland (as well as Spain) and the two non-euro area countries Denmark and Sweden, have stuck to the principle of fiscal balance or small – though diminishing – surpluses. But the largest European Union members, including the United Kingdom, France, and Germany, have been unable or unwilling to play by the rules.

zh: 实际上，法德两国由于违反《协议 》 ， 2003年11月刚刚勉强逃过一次金融制裁。
en: Indeed, France and Germany barely escaped financial sanctions in November 2003 for their violations of the Pact.

zh: 尽管欧洲法院稍后宣布这项决定无效，但事情却已经陷入了僵局。
en: Although the European Court of Justice later declared that decision invalid, the impasse remains.

zh: 因此，预算行为或《协议》规定两者当中，必须有一个要做出改变。
en: So either fiscal behavior or the Pact’s rules must change.

zh: 最近欧盟委员会提出的议案对以前强硬的立场做出了缓和，提出了可以适当放宽预算规则的几种情况。
en: The European Commission’s recent proposals amount to a relaxation of its earlier hard-line stance, providing a catalogue of ways in which the fiscal rules can be made more flexible.

zh: 但很难指望这些五花八门的新规定真能“加强经济管理”或明确《协议》的执行规则。
en: But it is difficult to see how this hodge-podge will “strengthen economic governance” or clarify the Pact’s implementation.

zh: 这些提议并不互相排斥，但却有不少折中的方法。
en: None of the proposals are mutually exclusive, but there are trade-offs.

zh: 举个例子，如果延长成员国的达标期限，修改标准本身就不那么必要了。
en: If, for example, one extends the time period over which member states are required to conform to the rules, there is less need to modify the rules themselves.

zh: 如果重新界定赤字涵义时把某些开支排除在外，那么3%的最高限额就可能得以遵守。
en: If deficits are redefined to exclude certain expenditures, the 3% ceiling can be observed.

zh: 但把某些公共开销从赤字中排除出去是与合理执行预算政策相违悖的。
en: But removing some public expenditures from the deficit runs counter to sound execution of fiscal policy.

zh: 举例来讲，德国不久前提出把实现欧洲共同目标的开支－比如支持生产率提高的里斯本议程所需的研发经费从赤字中排除出去。
en: For example, Germany recently proposed that expenditures undertaken to meet European commitments – such as Rampamp;D spending to support the Lisbon agenda of enhanced productivity – be exempted.

zh: 但问题在于允许以借贷的方式进行公共投资会导致委员会和各个成员国之间矛盾不断，因为这种做法过多地有赖于本已模糊的界线。
en: The problem is that allowing public investment to be financed by borrowing would lead to continuing disputes between the Commission and individual member states, because it relies excessively on that blurred distinction.

zh: 还有人想纳入更多“特殊情况 ” ， 使国内生产总值长期发展欠佳的所有年份都可以打破赤字上限，而不受-2%增长率的限制。
en: Others seek to broaden the definition of “exceptional circumstances” to permit the deficit ceiling to be breached in any year with prolonged unsatisfactory GDP growth, not just -2%.

zh: 特别是由于高估了增长状况和政府收入而突破《协议》赤字上限的国家希望能与明知故犯者区别对待。
en: In particular, countries that break the Pact’s deficit ceiling because they overestimated their growth – and hence government revenue – want to be treated more leniently than those who deliberately violate the rules.

zh: 这项原则听起来蛮有道理，但以目标而非结果为基础来控制赤字只能纵容政府哄抬增长预测的数值。
en: This may sound principled, but basing deficit monitoring on targets rather than outcomes merely strengthens an already powerful incentive for governments to rig their forecasts.

zh: 如果有国家在已经按照委员会建议缩紧预算、并获得欧元区财长会议批准的情况下还是打破了赤字限制，那么它就有可能受到区别对待。
en: Yet an exception might be warranted where a violation of the deficit ceiling has led to fiscal tightening in line with advice from the Commission and endorsed by Ecofin.

zh: 2002年突破限额后，尽管按照委员会规定采取了措施，德国还是会在2003年再次突破限额。
en: Having violated the ceiling in 2002, Germany looked set to do so again in 2003 despite tightening its budget along Commission lines.

zh: 当德国政府意识到起点比预想低很多，而且收入还是达不到要求的时候，他们拒绝采取进一步的压缩措施。
en: When it turned out that Germany’s starting position had been more unfavorable than initially thought and that revenues were again failing, Germany’s government objected to additional consolidation.

zh: 如果国家已经按照周围同伴的意愿进行了预算调整，那么别的国家就不应该无限制地要求它。
en: Where a country’s fiscal adjustments have been approved by its peers, there should be limits on how much more can be asked of it.

zh: 所有这些可能都是不切实际的，正是因为害怕《协议》规定的金融制裁，各国政府才愿意实行改革措施。
en: All of this may be beside the point, for it is the threat of financial sanctions under the Pact that inspired governments to seek to reform its rules.

zh: 但现在委员会却提议把重点完全转向伙伴国的压力－找到违反规定的国家并对其进行羞辱。
en: But the Commission now proposes to put the emphasis entirely on peer pressure – naming and shaming offenders.

zh: 这可能会激励支持《协议》赤字限额的国家继续做下去，但如果失去了制裁的最终威胁，伙伴国的压力也可能丧失一部分作用。
en: This may encourage national policy-makers who defend the SGP’s deficit ceiling to continue to do so, but peer pressure will lose some of its effectiveness when the ultimate threat of sanctions disappears.

zh: 简言之，委员会和接踵而来的政府建议已经打开了潘多拉之盒。
en: In short, the Commission’s proposals and the follow-up suggestions put forward by some governments have forced open a Pandora’s Box.

zh: 委员会和欧元区国家似乎希望：加速增长会缓解－甚至是解决－改革《协议》摆在他们面前的进退两难的困境。
en: Both the Commission and the euro area countries seem to be hoping that more rapid growth will ease – and ideally resolve – the dilemma that reform of the Pact has put before them.

zh: 特朗普能扭转其总统生涯吗？
en: Can Trump Turn His Presidency Around?

zh: 斯坦福—美国经济增速温和，失业率和通货膨胀率都很低。
en: STANFORD – The United States’ economy is growing at a modest pace, with low unemployment and inflation.

zh: 通常，这些条件有利于美国总统在公众心目中的地位。
en: Normally, these conditions would strengthen a US president’s standing with the public.

zh: 但特朗普的支持率却大大低于40 % ， 而这通常是衰退期间才会出现的现象。
en: And yet Donald Trump’s approval rating is well below 40%, as one would expect to see during a recession.

zh: 当然，特朗普的真正支持率也许会比民调结果高一些，因为同样的调查在去年11月也没有预测他会赢得总统竞选。
en: Of course, Trump’s true popularity may be a little higher than the polls suggest, given that the same surveys failed to predict his victory last November.

zh: 但即使特朗普维持了其“基本盘”的支持，他就职后的“蜜月期”也很快就结束了。
en: But even if Trump has maintained the support of his base, his post-inauguration honeymoon proved to be fleeting.

zh: 如今，他可能要失去那些寄希望于执政之后他会收起棱角、有所成长的共和党的支持了。
en: Now, he is starting to lose the support of Republicans who had hoped that he would smooth his rough edges and grow once in office.

zh: 到目前为止，特朗普还没有实现任何重大立法政策成果。
en: So far, Trump has failed to deliver any major legislative policy achievements.

zh: 尽管如此，他收回了奥巴马总统在能源、教育、金融和劳动法等方面的弊端重重的监管和行政命令，这有助于美国经济增长。
en: Nonetheless, he has helped the economy by rolling back President Barack Obama’s damaging regulatory and administrative diktats in areas such as energy, education, finance, and labor law.

zh: 此外，即使是与特朗普比较极端的言辞划清界限的国会共和党 — — 其中不乏在其发表针对弗吉尼亚州夏洛特维尔（Charlottesville）白人至上主义游行的不当言论之前就与他划清了界限 — — 也仍然支持他的主要政策方案，并且需要依靠他签署奥巴马拒绝签署的保守派立法。
en: Moreover, even congressional Republicans who have distanced themselves from Trump’s more extreme statements – some even before his inadequate response to the violence at a white supremacist rally in Charlottesville, Virginia – still support his main policy proposals, and are relying on him to sign conservative legislation that Obama vetoed.

zh: 不管特朗普是在椭圆办公室、空军一号，还是他的海湖庄园，他都和所有总统一样，身活在一个巨大的肥皂泡中，身边的人总是捡他爱听的话说。
en: Whether Trump is in the Oval Office, on Air Force One, or at his Mar-a-Lago resort, he, like all presidents, resides in a giant bubble, where those around him usually tell him what he wants to hear.

zh: 正因如此，白宫内外的助手和幕僚对总统就至关重要，他们愿意在总统偏离正道时发出提醒。
en: That is why it is so important that presidents have aides and advisers, both in and out of the White House, who are willing to tell them when they are veering off course.

zh: 公开诘难助手让特朗普更加难以 — — 也更加必须 — — 从周边人员那里听到需要的东西。
en: By publicly rebuking his aides, Trump has made it even more difficult, but also more necessary, for those around him to tell him what he needs to hear.

zh: 目前，他的政府的工作重点应该是制定更规律的过程，以确保总统能够获得正确的信息和有效的正确选项。
en: At this point, his administration’s top priority should be to develop more disciplined processes to ensure that the president is being given accurate information and effective policy options.

zh: 在这方面，特朗普决定任命海军陆战队退役将领约翰·凯利（John Kelly）为白宫幕僚长是重要的第一步。
en: To that end, Trump’s decision to appoint John Kelly, a retired Marine Corps general, as White House Chief of Staff was an important first step.

zh: 决定炒掉他的强硬派首席策略师史蒂夫·班农（Steve Bannon ） 、 对阿富汗政策进行慎重的重估（并改变了特朗普对美国阿富汗政策的看法）亦然。
en: So, too, were the decisions to push out his hard-edged chief strategist, Steve Bannon, and to carry out a deliberative Afghanistan policy review, which changed Trump’s mind about US policy there.

zh: 现在，凯利完全掌控了能接触到总统的情报和人事。
en: Kelly now fully controls the flow of information and people reaching the president.

zh: 但特朗普本人能否变得更有规律还有待观察。
en: But it remains to be seen if Trump himself can be more disciplined.

zh: 很少有人有改变第一印象的机会。
en: One rarely gets a second chance to make a first impression.

zh: 但有时候确实也有这样的机会自动出现在美国总统面前。
en: But such opportunities do sometimes present themselves for US presidents.

zh: 克林顿政府一开始就缺乏规律，尝试进行医疗改革失败，民主党也在1994年的中期选举中败北。
en: Bill Clinton’s administration began with a lack of discipline, a failed attempt at health-care reform, and a loss for the Democrats in the 1994 midterm elections.

zh: 但克林顿转换了方针，认命了新助手，转向政治中间派，在1996年赢得连任，并与共和党控制的国会一起实现了平衡预算和鼓励改革。
en: But Clinton turned things around, appointing new aides, moving toward the political center, winning reelection in 1996, and working with a Republican-controlled Congress to balance the budget and reform welfare.

zh: 类似地，里根在1982年中期选举中也遇到了共和党的败北。
en: Similarly, Ronald Reagan endured large Republican losses in the 1982 midterm election.

zh: 当时，由于美联储采取了强硬的抑制通胀政策，美国陷入了深度衰退。 而里根是美联储政策的支持者。
en: At that time, the US was in a deep recession, owing to the Federal Reserve’s tough disinflation policy, which Reagan had supported.

zh: 但在里根的减税和增加军事支出的政策下，经济实现了强劲复苏。
en: But the economy made a strong recovery, helped by Reagan’s tax cuts and increased military spending.

zh: 1984年，里根以压倒性优势赢得连任。
en: In 1984, Reagan won an overwhelming reelection victory.

zh: 相反，卡特政府没有能够克服它的问题，现在人们普遍认为他的总统任期是个彻头彻尾的失败。
en: Jimmy Carter’s administration, by contrast, never overcame its problems, and is now regarded as a dismal failure.

zh: 一旦开始执政，所有美国总统很快就会意识到，他们的国内和经济决策权威受到国会和法院的约束，但在外交和国家安全事务上，他们的运作空间会大得多。
en: Upon taking office, all US presidents soon realize that their domestic and economic policymaking authority is constrained by Congress and the courts, but that they have much more sway over foreign and national-security affairs.

zh: 至于特朗普，他已经证明，他对待安全问题的友邦和敌国要比奥巴马强力得多。
en: Trump, for his part, has made a point of being more forceful than Obama with allies and foes on security matters.

zh: 朝鲜正在令人警惕地大踏步推进核和洲际弹道导弹计划，特朗普的方针也受到了第一次真正的考验。
en: With North Korea making alarming strides in its nuclear and intercontinental ballistic missile programs, Trump’s approach is undergoing its first real test.

zh: 在这里，肯尼迪总统在1962年古巴导弹危机期间的表现可以提供最好的榜样。
en: Here, President John F. Kennedy during the 1962 Cuban Missile Crisis provides the best analogy.

zh: 肯尼迪政府在动摇卡斯特罗的古巴共产主义政权方面昏招频出 — — 最终导致了猪湾惨败。
en: The Kennedy administration stumbled badly when it tried to destabilize Fidel Castro’s communist regime in Cuba – an effort that culminated in the Bay of Pigs fiasco.

zh: 但肯尼迪面对克里姆林宫毫不让步，最终实现了危机的和平解决：苏联从古巴撤出核弹，美国悄悄从土耳其撤出导弹。
en: But by standing firm against the Kremlin, Kennedy brought the crisis to a peaceful end: the Soviet Union removed its nuclear missiles from Cuba, and the US quietly removed its missiles from Turkey.

zh: 朝鲜独裁者金正恩的行事显然与苏联有着不同的政治算盘，而朝鲜半岛的战略局势也比古巴更加棘手。
en: North Korean dictator Kim Jong-un is undoubtedly operating according to a different political calculus than the Soviets, and the strategic situation on the Korean Peninsula is even more daunting than in Cuba.

zh: 朝鲜拥有规模庞大的常规军力，可能让首尔附近的一千万韩国人遭受浩劫。
en: North Korea has a large conventional arsenal that could rain down havoc on ten million South Koreans in nearby Seoul.

zh: 尽管如此，如果特朗普的强硬反应最终获得成功，将会提高他的号召力。
en: Still, if Trump’s firm response ends up being successful, it could widen his appeal.

zh: 特朗普的实际决定要比他的对抗性行为重要得多。
en: Trump’s actual decisions matter far more than his confrontational behavior.

zh: 但他的行为仍然可能影响到他的选择范围。
en: But his behavior can still affect the options that are available to him.

zh: 如果他的公共支持率降得过低，国会中与他合作的成员就越少，而与他作对的成员就越多。
en: If his public approval sinks too low, fewer members of Congress will work with him, and more will work against him.

zh: 此外，他的引人注目的癖好 — — 用无关的推特抨击让好消息黯然失色 — — 导致全盘左倾、与他毫无同理心可言的媒体过于强调他的个性，而忽略他的政府的实质性的成功。
en: Moreover, his remarkable penchant for overshadowing good news with unrelated Twitter attacks allows an overwhelmingly leftist, unsympathetic media to overemphasize his personality, while ignoring his administration’s substantive successes.

zh: 比如，本月早些时候，当许多人的目光完全集中在特朗普的“大嘴巴”上的时候，美国国务卿蒂勒森确保了联合国安理会批准升级对朝制裁，而中国也表示将削减从朝鲜的进口。
en: For example, earlier this month, while many were fixated on Trump’s rhetoric, US Secretary of State Rex Tillerson secured United Nations Security Council approval for increased sanctions on North Korea, and China said that it would curtail its imports from the North.

zh: 此后不久，朝鲜便放弃了此前威胁要对准美国关岛领土附近水域的导弹试射。
en: Soon thereafter, North Korea called off planned test launches of missiles that it had threatened to aim at the waters around the US territory of Guam.

zh: 政治上，美国陷入了深度极化。
en: Politically, America is deeply polarized.

zh: 但在大部分问题上，美国人希望用常识来解决现实问题，政府不要过多影响他们的生活。
en: But on most issues, Americans want commonsense solutions to real problems, with government playing a limited role in their lives.

zh: 特朗普有机会削减税收、改善美国的基础设施、取消或修改平价医疗法（奥巴马医保 ） 。
en: Trump has an opportunity to cut taxes, improve US infrastructure, and replace or amend the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare).

zh: 要想获得成功，它需要表现出尊重合理的反对意见，软化其比较极端的立场，以扩大他的公众支持。
en: To succeed, he needs to demonstrate respect for reasonable opposing viewpoints and tone down his more extreme positions to broaden his popular support.

zh: 但最重要的是，他需要与国会合作，一如此前的里根和克林顿。
en: But, above all, he needs to cooperate with Congress, just as Reagan and Clinton did.

zh: 如果他在这方面取得成功，就有望扭转执政的颓势，在批评者面前证明自己，并留下积极的遗产。
en: If he does that, he could turn his presidency around, confound his critics, and leave a positive legacy.

zh: 他能做到吗？
en: Can he?

zh: 美国伊朗关系还能复苏吗？
en: Can US-Iran Relations Be Revived?

zh: 二次大战期间，盟军的部队占领了伊朗，把它用作从波斯湾向苏联运送给养的中转站。
en: During World War II, Allied soldiers occupied Iran, using the country as a way station to transport supplies from the Persian Gulf to the Soviet Union.

zh: 这是美伊之间的首次接触。
en: This was Iran’s first exposure to Americans.

zh: “可以说他们进入我国时是清白的 ， ” 倍受尊重的伊朗历史学家Kaveh Bayat说 ， “ 他们没有任何殖民企图。 ”
en: “They arrived in our country with a certain innocence,” said the respected Iranian historian Kaveh Bayat, “and without any colonial pretenses.”

zh: 美国的给养火车会定时经过我父辈们祖居的村庄阿拉克，当时那里到处是风景如画的绿洲和果园。
en: The Americans’ supply train would regularly pass through my father’s ancestral village, Arak, then a scenic oasis of green gardens and fruit orchards.

zh: 父亲曾告诉我 ， “ 只要听到火车经过，村里所有的男孩都会快速跑过苹果园，向路过的美国人问候。
en: “Whenever we heard the train coming,” my father once told me, “all the young boys in the village would run as fast as we could through the apple orchard to greet the passing Americans.

zh: 而他们会面带微笑、招手致意，并把身上碰巧带着的小礼物扔给我们－纸牌啦、口香糖啦、救急的糖果啦…在我们眼里，他们简直就是来自另一个世界的英雄。 ”
en: They would smile and wave and throw us whatever gifts they happened to have – playing cards, chewing gum, lifesaver candies….For us they were like heroes from another world.”

zh: 这以后的变化太大了。
en: So much has changed since then.

zh: 1979年的伊朗革命废除了亲美主义、推翻了伊朗国王的不民主统治，并以反美主义和教士的不民主统治取而代之。
en: Iran’s 1979 revolution did away with the pro-American, undemocratic regime of the Shah, bringing in its place the anti-American, undemocratic regime of the clerics.

zh: 25年前，就在这个星期，一些激进的学生袭击了驻德黑兰的美国使馆，把66个美国人扣为人质，关押了444天后，美伊之间的正式关系就几乎不复存在了。
en: Relations between the United States and Iran have been officially non-existent since a group of radical students stormed the US embassy in Teheran – 25 years ago this week – taking sixty six Americans hostage for 444 days.

zh: 60年前，美国士兵眼中的阿拉克不过是个盛产葡萄小村庄，而今天，它在五角大楼官员的眼里却是一座工业城市，与伊朗令人不安的核计划息息相关。
en: Sixty years ago, Arak was a humble village known to US troops for its grapes; today Pentagon officials hone in on it as an industrial city that is integral to Iran’s worrisome nuclear program.

zh: 但没有几个国家之间的关系像美伊关系这么奇特。
en: And yet few countries have a more paradoxical relationship than the US and Iran.

zh: 尽管伊朗当局坚持顽固的反美立场，但伊朗人民却公开地支持美国。
en: While the Iranian regime continues to be belligerently anti-American, the Iranian people are overtly pro-American.

zh: 尽管德黑兰和华盛顿政府是战略对手，但用前国务卿亨利·基辛格的话讲 ， “ 像伊朗这样没理由和美国冲突或利益如此一致的国家，全世界恐怕也找不到几个。 ”
en: While the governments in Teheran and Washington appear to be strategic archrivals, in the words of former Secretary of State Henry Kissinger, “there are few nations in the world with which the United States has less reason to quarrel or more compatible interests than Iran.”

zh: 实际上，从美国领导的阿富汗和伊拉克权力更迭之中，伊朗得到的好处比任何国家都多，因为塔利班和萨达姆·侯赛因都是他们誓不两立的敌人。
en: Indeed, Iran has likely benefited more than any other country from US-led regime changes in Afghanistan and Iraq, as both the Taliban and Saddam Hussein were the country’s sworn enemies.

zh: 但双方都没能抓住机会，扩大和对方的共同之处，于是今天的美伊关系就和几年前一样水火不容。
en: But neither side seized the opportunity to build on this common ground, and today US-Iran relations are as antagonistic as they have been in years.

zh: 在美国眼里，伊朗的核计划、反对以色列和支持极端组织在如今对恐怖主义宣战的背景下变得越来越无法容忍。
en: For the US, Iran’s nuclear ambitions, opposition to Israel, and support for extremist groups have become increasingly intolerable in the context of the war on terror.

zh: 伊朗长期坚持与美国敌对的原因有点复杂。
en: Iran’s long-standing opposition to relations with the US is a bit more complex.

zh: 但可以肯定的是，伊朗很多领导人都出自二十世纪六七十年代，那时反帝国和殖民主义热情都很高涨，对他们的世界观产生了很大影响。
en: To be sure, many of Iran’s ruling elites came of age politically during the anti-imperialist and anti-colonialist agitations of the 1960’s and 1970’s, and still cling to that worldview.

zh: 虽然革命热情随着年龄的增长而有所消减，但他们还是愿意追随已故的阿亚图拉·霍梅尼的世界观，把伊朗和美国之间的关系比作“羊和狼”的关系。
en: Although their revolutionary zeal may have waned over the years, they still tend to share the outlook of the late Ayatollah Khomeini, who likened the relationship between Iran and the US to that “between a sheep and a wolf.”

zh: 不过，意识形态上的刻板并不能完全解释伊朗常常没来由的反美主义。
en: Ideological rigidity alone, however, does not explain Iran’s often-gratuitous anti-Americanism.

zh: 在伊朗的政治军事当权派看来，开放伊美关系所带来的自由会威胁到他们的既得利益。
en: For Iran’s political and military elite, any increased liberalization that would likely result from an opening of ties with the US represents a threat to their interests.

zh: 在他们眼里，伊朗现在是封闭的聚会－是他们自己的聚会－参加的人越少，才越能得到快乐。
en: From their perspective, Iran is now a closed party – their party – and the less who join in, the merrier.

zh: 随着美国在伊拉克陷入困境、石油价格又创下了历史新高，强硬的统治者根本没有妥协的理由。
en: With America bogged down in Iraq and oil prices hitting record highs, regime hardliners see little reason to compromise these days.

zh: 另一方面，以前总统哈什米·拉夫桑贾尼为代表的一些有影响的伊朗人承认：如果要重新融入国际社会、正面处理国内的经济危机，那么伊美关系是必不可少的。
en: On the other hand, some influential Iranians – led by former president Hashemi Rafsanjani – recognize that relations with the US are inevitable, given Iran’s need to re-integrate into the international community and face its economic deficiencies.

zh: 此外，绝大多数伊朗人也完全赞成建立和谐的伊美关系。
en: Moreover, the Iranian people are overwhelmingly in favor of rapprochement.

zh: 就像Afshin Molavi在涵义深刻的旅行杂记《波斯朝圣》中写道的那样，今天伊朗的年轻人不再是30年前的革命理想主义者。
en: As author Afshin Molavi wrote in his incisive travelogue Persian Pilgrimages , Iranian youth today are not revolutionary idealists, like those of three decades ago.

zh: 相反，他们有着自己的具体要求，比如就业机会和政治社会自由。
en: Instead, they have concrete demands, like jobs and political and social freedom.

zh: 他们不顾一切地要融入全球社会，永远洗刷掉身上狼藉的国际恶名。
en: They are desperate to enter the global community and rid themselves of a damaged international reputation.

zh: 今天伊朗的知识分子也经历了类似的成熟过程，彻底抛弃了前人“乌托邦”和“排外主义”的政治理想。
en: Today’s Iranian intellectuals have undergone a similar maturation process, dismissing the “utopianist” and “nativist” political ideals of their predecessors.

zh: 谈到成为1979年革命宣言的Jalal Al-e Ahmad1962年的著作Gharbzadegi （ 《 西方中毒 》 ） 时，德黑兰的一位世俗学者对我说��“现在已经没人再读Al-e Ahmad的书了。
en: Referring to Jalal Al-e Ahmad’s 1962 book Gharbzadegi (“West-toxication”), which became one of the manifestos of the 1979 revolution, one secular intellectual in Teheran remarked to me that, “Nobody reads Al-e Ahmad anymore.

zh: 相反，我们期待着与西方接触的一天。
en: On the contrary, we long for interaction with the West.

zh: 如果这能给我们带来更多的经济机会和社会政治自由，那么我们宁愿“中西方的毒 ” 。
en: If it can bring us more economic opportunities, as well as social and political freedoms, let us be ‘West-toxified.’”

zh: 尽管缓和关系代表了伊朗的民意，美伊两国也有共同的战略利益，但美国和伊朗真正坐下来改变现状，恐怕还得要几年的时间。
en: Still, despite popular demand in Iran, and common strategic interests, it could be years before America and Iran sit down and make amends.

zh: 在长达25年的相互隔绝后，两国关系不可能立刻和解。
en: After 25 years of living without each other, reconciliation will not come immediately.

zh: 但和解真正到来的时刻，我们有理由相信伊朗人会用60年前在阿拉克时同样的友善和热情来欢迎这位失去已久的朋友。
en: When it does, there is good reason to believe that Iranians will greet their long lost friends with the same friendliness and exuberance that they did sixty years ago in Arak.

zh: 我们能否提升国民幸福总值
en: Can We Increase Gross National Happiness?

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 喜马拉雅小国不丹凭借旨在减少游客涌入的高额签证费和促进“国民幸福总值”而非经济增长的政策而在国际上享有盛誉。
en: PRINCETON – The small Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan is known internationally for two things: high visa fees, which reduce the influx of tourists, and its policy of promoting “gross national happiness” instead of economic growth.

zh: 这两项政策具有内在的关联性：游客增加可能推动经济发展，但同时会破坏不丹的环境和文化，从而影响民众的长期幸福。
en: The two are related: more tourists might boost the economy, but they would damage Bhutan’s environment and culture, and so reduce happiness in the long run.

zh: 当我首次听到不丹把追求国民幸福当作目标的时候，曾经怀疑这样一种提法是否只是政治口号，还是具有实际的意义。
en: When I first heard of Bhutan’s goal of maximizing its people’s happiness, I wondered if it really meant anything in practice, or was just another political slogan.

zh: 上个月，我在不丹首都廷布举办的“经济发展和幸福会议”上讲话，才明白这不是口号而是实实在在的行动。 不丹首相吉格梅·廷莱和哥伦比亚大学地球研究所主任兼联合国秘书长潘基文的特别顾问杰弗里·萨克斯是此次会议的共同主办者。
en: Last month, when I was in the capital, Thimphu, to speak at a conference on “Economic Development and Happiness,” organized by Prime Minister Jigme Y. Thinley and co-hosted by Jeffrey Sachs, Director of The Earth Institute at Columbia University and Special Adviser to United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon, I learned that it is much more than a slogan.

zh: 此前我还从未参加过受到国家政府如此重视的会议。
en: Never before have I been at a conference that was taken so seriously by a national government.

zh: 我以为廷莱会以一篇正式的欢迎辞宣布会议开幕，而后回到自己的办公室。
en: I had expected Thinley to open the conference with a formal welcome, and then return to his office.

zh: 相反，他在讲话中对以增强幸福感为国策所涉及的重要问题进行了深刻的反思。
en: Instead, his address was a thoughtful review of the key issues involved in promoting happiness as a national policy.

zh: 随后两天半的会议期间他一直留在现场，并对我们的讨论提出了中肯的建议。
en: He then stayed at the conference for the entire two and a half days, and made pertinent contributions to our discussions.

zh: 其中多数讨论还有几位内阁部长的参与。
en: At most sessions, several cabinet ministers were also present.

zh: 自古以来，幸福就被人们普遍认为是一种美德。
en: Since ancient times, happiness has been universally seen as a good.

zh: 但如何定义并衡量幸福却一直是人们争论不休的话题。
en: Problems arise when we try to agree on a definition of happiness, and to measure it.

zh: 一个重要问题是将幸福视为扣除一世痛苦之后剩余的快乐，还是对生活的总体满意度。
en: One important question is whether we see happiness as the surplus of pleasure over pain experienced over a lifetime, or as the degree to which we are satisfied with our lives.

zh: 前一种方法将普通人的积极感受次数加总求和，减去消极感受次数得到的一个结果。
en: The former approach tries to add up the number of positive moments that people have, and then to subtract the negative ones.

zh: 如果从大体上看积极感受的次数更多，我们就认为此人生活是幸福的，反之，则不幸福。
en: If the result is substantially positive, we regard the person’s life as happy; if negative, as unhappy.

zh: 因此要想按照这样的定义衡量幸福与否，我们必须随机抽取普通人的生存状态，并试图确定他们的心理状态是积极还是消极的。
en: So, to measure happiness defined in that way, one would have to sample moments of people’s existence randomly, and try to find out whether they are experiencing positive or negative mental states.

zh: 另一种方法是询问人们 ： “ 你对目前的生活状况究竟有多满意？
en: A second approach asks people: “How satisfied are you with the way your life has gone so far?”

zh: ”如果回答是满意或非常满意，他们就是幸福的，否则就不幸福。
en: If they say they are satisfied, or very satisfied, they are happy, rather than unhappy.

zh: 但究竟对幸福的哪种理解最贴切地诠释了我们的追求向我们提出了价值观的根本问题。
en: But the question of which of these ways of understanding happiness best captures what we should promote raises fundamental questions of value.

zh: 在采用第一种方法进行的调查中，尼日利亚、墨西哥、巴西和波多黎各成绩不错，这样的结果表明答案可能与民族文化有关，而不取决于健康、教育和生活标准等客观指标。
en: On surveys that use the first approach, countries like Nigeria, Mexico, Brazil, and Puerto Rico do well, which suggests that the answer may have more to do with the national culture than with objective indicators like health, education, and standard of living.

zh: 当采用第二种方法时，丹��和瑞典等富裕国家往往会脱颖而出。
en: When the second approach is taken, it tends to be the richer countries, like Denmark and Switzerland, that come out on top.

zh: 但我们并不清楚不同文化中的民众用不同语言回答的调查问题是否具有同样的含义。
en: But it is not clear whether people’s answers to survey questions in different languages and in different cultures really mean the same thing.

zh: 我们可以认同应该以提升幸福感而非收入或国内生产总值为目标，但如果对幸福没有客观的衡量标准，这样做是否真有意义？
en: We may agree that our goal ought to be promoting happiness, rather than income or gross domestic product, but, if we have no objective measure of happiness, does this make sense?

zh: 约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯曾讲过一句名言 ： “ 我宁愿要模糊的正确也不要精确的错误。
en: John Maynard Keynes famously said: “I would rather be vaguely right than precisely wrong.”

zh: ”凯恩斯指出当世间最初产生思想的时候，这些思想可能模模糊糊，要想界定清楚还需要做很多工作。
en: He pointed out that when ideas first come into the world, they are likely to be woolly, and in need of more work to define them sharply.

zh: 把幸福感作为国家政策目标可能就属于这种情况。
en: That may be the case with the idea of happiness as the goal of national policy.

zh: 我们能否学会该如何衡量幸福？
en: Can we learn how to measure happiness?

zh: 不丹政府12年前成立的不丹研究中心正在处理针对8，000多名不丹民众的访问结果。
en: The Center for Bhutan Studies, set up by the Bhutanese government 12 years ago, is currently processing the results of interviews with more than 8,000 Bhutanese.

zh: 访问内容既包括受访者的生活满意度等主观因素，也包括像生活水平、医疗、教育和文化参与、社会活力、生态健康以及工作和其他活动平衡等客观因素。
en: The interviews recorded both subjective factors, such as how satisfied respondents are with their lives, and objective factors, like standard of living, health, and education, as well as participation in culture, community vitality, ecological health, and the balance between work and other activities.

zh: 目前尚不清楚如此多元化的因素能否很好地相互协调。
en: It remains to be seen whether such diverse factors correlate well with each other.

zh: 需要难度很大的价值判断才能简化上述因素。
en: Trying to reduce them to a single number will require some difficult value judgments.

zh: 不丹设立了国民幸福总值委员会，由首相亲自领导对政府各部拟定的新的政策议案进行审查。
en: Bhutan has a Gross National Happiness Commission, chaired by the prime minister, which screens all new policy proposals put forward by government ministries.

zh: 如果发现某项政策有悖于提升国民幸福总值的目标，就会发回部里重新拟定。
en: If a policy is found to be contrary to the goal of promoting gross national happiness, it is sent back to the ministry for reconsideration.

zh: 没有委员会的首肯，任何政策都无法通过。
en: Without the Commission’s approval, it cannot go ahead.

zh: 近来确实通过了一项禁止售卖烟草的争议法律，而这恰恰表明政府采取强硬措施提升全民幸福感的意愿是多么强烈。
en: One controversial law that did go ahead recently – and that indicates how willing the government is to take tough measures that it believes will maximize overall happiness – is a ban on the sale of tobacco.

zh: 不丹人可以从印度带入少量香烟和烟叶供自己使用，但不允许进行销售 — — 而且在公共场合吸烟时必须随时携带进口税完税凭证。
en: Bhutanese may bring into the country small quantities of cigarettes or tobacco from India for their own consumption, but not for resale – and they must carry the import-tax receipt with them any time they smoke in public.

zh: 去年7月，联合国大会一致通过了一项由不丹提出的决议，承认人类根本目标在于追求幸福，而国内生产总值不能体现这一目标。
en: Last July, the UN General Assembly passed, without dissent, a Bhutanese-initiated resolution recognizing the pursuit of happiness as a fundamental human goal and noting that this goal is not reflected in GDP.

zh: 决议邀请各成员国制定能更好体现幸福目标的对策。
en: The resolution invited member states to develop additional measures that better capture the goal of happiness.

zh: 联大还欢迎不丹在本月开幕的第66届联大会议上就幸福和福祉问题召集小组讨论的建议。
en: The General Assembly also welcomed an offer from Bhutan to convene a panel discussion on the theme of happiness and well-being during its 66th session, which opens this month.

zh: 上述讨论是正在兴起的国际运动的组成部分，目的是把福祉和幸福作为政府政策追求的目标。
en: These discussions are part of a growing international movement to re-orient government policies towards well-being and happiness.

zh: 我们应该衷心期待它取得成功，并希望幸福最终会成为全球而不只是某个国家的目标。
en: We should wish the effort well, and hope that ultimately the goal becomes global, rather than merely national, happiness.

zh: 我们能为海啸投保吗？
en: Can We Insure against Tsunamis?

zh: 大部分围绕如何应对亚洲海啸灾难的讨论都把焦点放在政府赈灾项目和完善预警系统的官方计划上。
en: Most of the discussion surrounding how to respond to Asia’s tsunami disaster has focused on government relief programs and official schemes to implement early warning systems.

zh: 很少有讨论关注个人风险管理制度，特别是保险制度。
en: Little discussion has focused on the promotion of private risk management institutions, notably insurance.

zh: 这真是不幸。
en: This is unfortunate.

zh: 保险公司提供专业且极为详细的风险管理方案，能在考虑各种须加防范的危险的复杂性基础上，针对个人情况提供创造性的解决方案。
en: Insurance companies provide professional, finely detailed risk management that respects the complexity of the dangers to be hedged and responds creatively to individual needs.

zh: 促进个人保险业的发展也许看起来是对海啸灾难的一种间接反应，但它却是一种理性且有力的反应。
en: Promoting private insurance may seem an indirect response to the tsunami disaster, but it is a rational – and powerful – response.

zh: 此次大灾的多数受灾地区都没有保险公司。
en: Insurance companies have not penetrated many of the regions that suffered the greatest losses.

zh: 保险资讯中心（Insurance Information Institute）的一份研究表明，与美国5.23%的比例相比，2003年印度尼西亚财产保险支出仅占全国GDP的0.83 % ， 泰国为1.19 % ， 印度为0.62 % 。
en: According to a study by the Insurance Information Institute, expenditures on non-life insurance in 2003 amounted to only 0.83% of GDP in Indonesia, 1.19% of GDP in Thailand, and 0.62% of GDP in India, compared with 5.23% of GDP in the United States.

zh: 国外援助并不能代替保险。
en: Foreign aid is no substitute for insurance.

zh: 慈善活动鼓舞人心，使我们相信人心博爱，但它却没有规律，不能完全依赖。
en: Charity inspires, reassuring us of our humanity, but it is often capricious. You wouldn’t want to rely on it.

zh: 事实上，在考虑提供多少灾难援助的时候，看来各国主要受到领导人意志影响，因为他们更多考虑的是别人会如何看待他们的善举。
en: Indeed, when deciding how much disaster aid to offer, countries often seem to be influenced mainly by their leaders’ concerns about how others will view them.

zh: 而慈善活动只对那些众人关注的事件有所反应，对于那些非爆炸性的灾难通常忽略不顾。
en: Charity responds to attention-grabbing events, often neglecting less sensational disasters.

zh: 保险，从另一方面来说，却是一种可靠可信的制度。
en: Insurance, on the other hand, is a reliable and venerable institution, its modern form dating back to the seventeenth century.

zh: 现代保险形式起源于十七世纪，但即使是在发达国家，保险和其他的风险管理制度却发展缓慢。
en: But insurance and other risk management institutions have been slow to develop, even in advanced countries.

zh: 在美国，大部分人至今还无洪灾或地震保险。
en: In the US, most people still do not have flood or earthquake insurance.

zh: 在加利福尼亚 — — 全世界地质条件最不稳定的地区之一，只有六分之一的家庭购买了地震保险。
en: In California, one of the world’s most unstable geological regions, only one in six homeowners buys earthquake insurance.

zh: 造成这种情况的一个基本原因就是，保险是一个还未被广泛接受的理念。
en: A fundamental problem is that insurance is not a concept that comes naturally to most people.

zh: 事实上，正如心理学家Daniel Kahneman和Amos Tversky说得那样，人类总是系统性地倾向于降低低概率事件的发生概率，于是乎他们就可若无其事地继续生活，宛若视此事件发生概率为零一样。
en: In fact, as psychologists Daniel Kahneman and Amos Tversky have shown, there is a systematic human tendency to downgrade the perceived probability of low-probability events, so that people go about their lives as if the probability of these events’ occurrence is zero.

zh: 同样道理，人们愿意为了避免某些小损失而接受正呈下降趋势的巨大风险，譬如保费。
en: Similarly, humans tend to accept large downside risks in order to avoid small certain losses, such as insurance premiums.

zh: 保险公司面临着使公众逐步脱离这种倾向的过程，这一过程可谓漫长艰难。
en: Insurance companies have faced a slow and difficult process in weaning the public from these tendencies.

zh: 此外，设计新型风险管理产品并非易事。
en: Moreover, designing new risk-management products is not easy.

zh: 保险公司必须面对风险评估与生俱有的困难性，还必须根据种种限制人们投保的人性癖好创造性地修改方针政策。
en: Insurance companies face inherent difficulties in measuring risks, and they must tailor their policies creatively around the human foibles that limit uptake.

zh: 它还不得不对各种各样可能出现的道德风险 — — 不正当的投机行为动机加以防范，对吸引客户的选择性偏倚问题多加留心。
en: Insurers must also be attentive to a wide array of possible moral hazards – perverse incentives to risky behavior – and to problems of selection bias in attracting clients.

zh: 为了更有效率地处理灾难事故，各国必须达成一个共同意向，为私人保险业的进一步发展和欣欣向荣营造环境。
en: To deal with disasters more effectively, countries must find the will to create an environment in which a much more developed private insurance industry can flourish.

zh: 美国1968年通过的《国家水灾保险项目》规定，凡是在特别水灾危险区筹资建造房产或者改造建筑物的机构都必须购买洪灾保险。
en: In the US, the National Flood Insurance Program of 1968 made it mandatory for those financing construction or improvement of structures within Special Flood Hazard Areas to buy flood insurance.

zh: 如果不实行强制，就必须要采取有效方法推广保险。
en: If not made mandatory, insurance must at least be promoted effectively.

zh: 否则的话，人们就会站在在洪汜平原，坚信他们的政府，或者世界各国政府，有义务来帮助他们摆脱困境，从而坚信根本不该为重大险情投保。
en: Otherwise, people will build on flood plains in the belief that their government, or the governments of the world, will feel obligated to bail them out, thereby insuring, in effect, bad risks that should not be taken.

zh: 此次亚洲损失最为惨重的多为一些海啸高发地区，比如斯里兰卡的低沿海地区。
en: Many of the worst outcomes in Asia occurred in tsunami-prone areas, such as the low-lying coastal areas of Sri Lanka.

zh: 但是，若由私人投保的话，那么就会鉴于私人保险的高额违约金，阻止在高危地点修建房屋，鼓励在边缘地区实施抗海啸的建筑标准。
en: Private insurance would discourage construction in the most dangerous locations, owing to prohibitively high premiums, while encouraging the adoption of tsunami-resistant building standards in marginal areas.

zh: 幸运地是，我们的国际风险管理制度正在日臻完善。
en: Fortunately, our international risk-management institutions are steadily improving.

zh: 各种各样的灾难保单，包括地震和其他各种灾难，以及气象灾害所引起的各种灾难，在近几年内已经开始进入金融���场交易。
en: Various catastrophe bonds, covering earthquakes and other disasters, and weather derivatives have begun trading on financial markets in recent years.

zh: 《京都议定书》针对二氧化碳气体排放问题建立了一个机制，该机制允诺处理解决一个更大的潜在灾难 — — 全球变暖问题的风险。
en: The Kyoto Protocol created a mechanism for trading carbon dioxide emissions, which promises to manage the risks of an even bigger potential disaster: global warming.

zh: 这些保险产品的市场还有待开发，但其成长潜力巨大，它们的进一步发展将提高保险公司处理国际重大灾难的能力。
en: The markets for these products are still small, but they have strong growth potential, and their further development would enhance insurance companies’ ability to cover risks of major international disasters.

zh: 想一想在那些受灾最重地区竟然没有先期海啸预警系统，你很容易责备那里的人们目光短浅。
en: Consider the absence of an early tsunami warning system in the worst affected countries.

zh: 但是九个受灾最重国家无一拥有此系统，他们不可能都如此冒失吧！
en: It is easy to blame people for lack of foresight, but none of the nine hardest hit countries had developed one. They can’t all be bunglers.

zh: 关键问题不在个人之错。
en: The problem is not individual error.

zh: 这种疏忽源于缺少适当的、且能预警各种潜在灾难的国际机制。
en: The failure was caused by the absence of appropriate international institutions that would be alert to the broad spectrum of potential disasters.

zh: 许多有关海啸预警系统的讨论把焦点放于政府规划项目上，但是预警系统不仅仅意味着海洋传感器和卫星，它还包括避开灾难高发地区建造房屋以及刺激私营企业开发有效的安全和撤离程序。
en: Discussion of early warning systems for tsunamis has focused on government programs. But early warning means more than ocean sensors and satellites; it also implies directing construction away from disaster-prone areas and prodding private businesses to develop effective safety and evacuation procedures.

zh: 这些都是保险公司的常规项目。
en: These are normal activities of insurance companies.

zh: 事实上，此次海啸灾难最触目惊心的是，某些高级度假胜地全无准备。
en: Indeed, one of the more striking features of the tsunami disaster was that it caught some of the most glamorous vacation resorts completely unprepared.

zh: 这个教训发人深省：即使是高级产业，其专业程度也只能在现有机制下的基础设施允许范围内。
en: The lesson is clear: even high-class businesses are only as professional as the existing institutional infrastructure permits them to be.

zh: 而他们被攻其不备的最根本的原因是，我们的保险业没有开发海啸风险项目，未能提供最新的防灾指导。
en: The ultimate reason for their lack of preparation is that our insurance industry was not covering their tsunami risks, and hence not offering up-to-date disaster-prevention guidance.

zh: 保险业可以，也应当，领受道德使命、步调一致采取行动以扩大保险范围，应对海啸。
en: The insurance industry can, and should, respond to the tsunami disaster by accepting the moral imperative to take concerted action to expand risk coverage.

zh: 而政府可以做的，是通过制定反应迅速的规章制度，甚至是对新型私人保险产品的试验进行补贴，促进更佳的风险管理。
en: To the extent that governments are involved, they can promote better risk management through responsive regulation and even subsidization of experiments with new private insurance products.

zh: 我们能 在“人类世”时代存活么？
en: Can We Survive the “Anthropocene” Period?

zh: 在过去的三百年里，人类对全球环境的影响越来越大。
en: For the past three centuries, humans’ effects on the global environment have escalated.

zh: 尤其是我们排放的二氧化碳，这导致全球气候的改变，如果要是自然变化的话，可以要几万年时间才可能完成。
en: Most importantly, our emissions of carbon dioxide may cause global climate patterns to depart significantly from their natural course for many millennia to come.

zh: 看来，引入“人类世”的概念来描述现在的人类主宰的时代比较合适，作为一个地质时代，它是“全新世”的下一代。
en: It seems appropriate to assign the term “Anthropocene” to the current, in many ways human-dominated, geological epoch, supplementing the Holocene – the warm period of the past 10–12 millennia.

zh: “全新世”是一个温暖的时期，时间跨度大约为1万-1万2千年之间。 全新世的概念是在18世纪后期开始出现的，科学家在分析了极地冰川的气候后发现，全球二氧化碳和甲烷的含量开始上升。
en: The Anthropocene Period could be said to have started in the latter part of the eighteenth century, when analyses of air trapped in polar ice showed the beginning of growing global concentrations of CO2 and methane.

zh: 与此不谋而合的是，同时代的詹姆斯·瓦特在1784年设计出第一台蒸汽机。
en: This date also happens to coincide with James Watt’s design of the steam engine in 1784.

zh: 早在1873年之前，人类就意识到自身对环境的影响。 意大利地质学家安东尼奥·斯托帕尼将它称为“人类世时代 ” ， 他的定义是“一个全新的地球力量，世界将被这种更伟大的能量主宰。
en: Mankind’s growing influence on the environment was recognized as long ago as 1873, when the Italian geologist Antonio Stoppani referred to the “anthropozoic era,” defined by a “new telluric force, which in power and universality may be compared to the greater forces of earth.”

zh: 1926年，V.I. 韦尔兹基也把人类日益增长的影响力称为“进化发展的自然方向，对周围环境有意识影响的效果越来越明显。
en: In 1926, V. I. Vernadsky similarly acknowledged the increasing impact of mankind on “[t]he direction in which the processes of evolution must proceed, namely towards increasing consciousness and thought, and forms having greater and greater influence on their surroundings.”

zh: ” 韦尔兹基和德日进使用“人类圈 ” — —世界的思想 — — 这个概念来说明，人类大脑对我们未来和环境不断增加的影响力。
en: Vernadsky and Teilhard de Chardin used the term “noösphere” – the world of thought – to mark the growing role of human brain-power in shaping its own future and environment.

zh: 随着人口和人均使用地球资源的不断增加，人类正在不断飞速地发展。
en: Humans’ rapid expansion in terms of population and per capita use of Earth’s resources has continued apace.

zh: 在过去的300年中，人口数量已经增加了10倍，达到60多亿，预计到本世纪，世界人口将达到100亿。
en: During the past three centuries, the human population has increased ten-fold, to more than six billion, and is expected to reach 10 billion in this century.

zh: 地球30-50%的陆地资源已经被人类所占用。
en: As a result, 30–50% of the planet’s land surface is now exploited by humans.

zh: 与此同时，人类饲养家畜的数量达到14亿，它们产生的甲烷也对热带雨林产生破坏作用，从而导致二氧化碳的增加和物种灭绝的加速。
en: At the same time, the methane-producing cattle population has risen to 1.4 billion, contributing to the increasing rate of destruction of tropical rainforests, which releases carbon dioxide and contributes to faster species extinction.

zh: 人类对土地的耕种和开发利用也加速了对土壤的侵蚀，这比自然速率要快15倍。
en: Land conversion for grazing (and construction), together with crop tillage, has also caused soil erosion at 15 times its natural rate.

zh: 如果按照现在的速度，人类对土地的侵蚀将在50年内添满“大峡谷 ” 。
en: Indeed, at its current pace, anthropogenic soil erosion would fill the Grand Canyon in 50 years.

zh: 同样的，水坝的修建和河流的改道目前非常普遍，人类对水资源的消费量已经比100年前增加了9倍。 也就是说，现在人类已经使用了超过半数的可用的水资源 — — 其中大约有三分之二用在了农业上面。
en: Similarly, dam building and river diversion have become commonplace, as humans’ water consumption has risen nine-fold over the past century, to the point that mankind now uses more than half of all accessible fresh water – roughly two-thirds of it for agriculture.

zh: 渔业已经扑杀了超过25%的浅海生物，35%的温带大陆架。
en: Fisheries remove more than 25% of the primary production in upwelling ocean regions and 35% in the temperate continental shelf.

zh: 此外，在20世纪，能源的消耗增加了16倍，导致每年1600万吨的二氧化硫排放到大气之中 — — 比自然排放量的2倍多。
en: Moreover, energy use has grown 16-fold during the twentieth century, causing 160 million tons of atmospheric sulfur-dioxide emissions per year – more than twice the total of natural emissions.

zh: 氮肥料也大量运用在自然生态系统中。 由于化石生物的燃烧而产生的一氧化氮也超过了自然界释放的总量。
en: Likewise, more nitrogen fertilizer is applied in agriculture than is fixed naturally in all terrestrial ecosystems, and nitric-oxide production from the burning of fossil fuels and biomass also surpasses natural emissions.

zh: 与此同时，由于化石燃料的使用和农业活动导致“温室”气体显著增加 — — 二氧化碳增加了30 % ， 甲烷增加了100 % 。
en: At the same time, of course, human consumption of fossil fuels, together with our agricultural activities, have caused substantial increases in concentrations of “greenhouse” gases – CO2 by 30% and methane by more than 100%.

zh: 这些现象在过去40万年中都没有过。 由于目前的现象还只是由25%的人口产生的，随着不断的发展，环境还将恶化。
en: Indeed, these concentrations are higher than at any point in the past 400 millennia, with more growth to follow, because so far these effects have largely been caused by only 25% of the world population.

zh: 由此看来，目前的后果非常严重：酸雨，烟雾和全球气候变暖等。
en: The consequences are numerous and profound: acid precipitation, photochemical “smog” and global warming, among others.

zh: 根据政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）的最近一项估算，本世纪地球的温度已经升高了1.4–5.8 °C，很多有毒物质被释放在环境中，即便一些非有毒的物质，对大自然也是有危害的 — — 例如氯氟碳导致南极臭氧层空洞。
en: Hence, according to the latest estimates by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), Earth will warm by 1.4–5.8 °C during this century.

zh: （目前，我们已经采取行动来治理这个问题。 ）
en: Many toxic substances are released into the environment, even some that are not toxic but nonetheless are highly damaging – for example, the chlorofluorocarbons that caused the Antarctic ozone hole (and which are now regulated).

zh: 事态还在不断恶化之中。 从1970年代的中期，我们就已经开始研究臭氧层遭受破坏的问题。
en: Things could have become much worse: the ozone-destroying properties of halogens have been studied since the mid-1970’s.

zh: 结果发现，具有氯的化学属性，例如溴起到一定的作用。 臭氧空洞是一个全球性的问题，而且情况一年比一年恶化，这也不是南极洲春天事件。
en: If it had turned out that chlorine behaved chemically like bromine, the ozone hole would by then have been a global, year-round phenomenon, not just an event of the Antarctic spring.

zh: 如果一直这么发展下去，灾难性的后果将不可避免。
en: More by luck than by wisdom, this catastrophic situation did not develop.

zh: 除非有灾难性的事件发生 — — 例如流星撞击地球，世界大战或是瘟疫的流行 — — 人类将在接下来的很长一段时间都是影响环境的主要力量。
en: Unless there is a global catastrophe – a meteorite impact, a world war, or a pandemic – mankind will remain a major environmental force for many millennia.

zh: 因此，在这个“人类世”时代，科学家和工程师任务艰巨，他们将帮助我们解决问题，保持环境继续稳定发展。
en: As a result, scientists and engineers face a daunting task during the Anthropocene era: to guide us towards environmentally sustainable management.

zh: 这更需要我们所有人的努力，加强国际间的相互协调和利用大规模的生态工程项目来“优化”气候，不过，至少目前来说，我们对大部分领域还一无所知。
en: This will require appropriate human behavior at all levels, and may well involve internationally accepted, large-scale geo-engineering projects to “optimize” climate. At this stage, however, we are still largely treading on terra incognita .

zh: 非洲的人造水危机
en: Africa’s Manmade Water Crisis

zh: 新加坡—大约十年前，在由时任南非水和环境部长林迪威·亨德里克斯（Lindiwe Hendricks）所召集的南非市长会议上，我们预言，除非水管理实践能够实现巨大进步，否则不出15年南非主要城市就会爆发前所未有的水危机。
en: SINGAPORE – About a decade ago, at a meeting of South African mayors convened by Lindiwe Hendricks, South Africa’s then-minister of water and environmental affairs, we predicted that an unprecedented water crisis would hit one of the country’s main cities within 15 years, unless water-management practices were improved significantly.

zh: 如今，这一预言成真，开普敦有可能关闭自来水网络。
en: That prediction has now come true, with Cape Town facing a shutdown of its piped water network.

zh: 现在的问题是非洲领导人是否会让我们的其他预言 — — 未来25—30年内会有更多非洲城市面临类似危机 — — 成为现实。
en: The question now is whether African leaders will allow our other projection – that, within the next 25-30 years, many more of the continent’s cities will be facing similar crises – to materialize.

zh: 非洲的城市用水和废水管理一直是一个大问题。
en: Africa has long struggled with urban water and wastewater management.

zh: 随着非洲人口的膨胀 — — 从1960年的大约2.85亿增加到今天的近13亿 — — 以及城市化的进展，这一挑战也越来越尖锐。
en: As the continent’s population has swelled, from about 285 million in 1960 to nearly 1.3 billion today, and urbanization has progressed, the challenge has become increasingly acute.

zh: 而这些趋势还会继续加剧：到2050年，非洲总人口预计将突破25亿，其中55%生活在城市环境中。
en: And these trends are set to intensify: by 2050, the continent’s total population is expected to exceed 2.5 billion, with 55% living in urban environments.

zh: 非洲国家面临的挑战并不独特，但从某些角度，它们是前所未有的挑战。
en: The challenge African countries face may not be unique, but it is, in some ways, unprecedented.

zh: 毕竟，在西方国家，城市化所用的时间要长得多，并且是在经济条件稳步改善的背景下完成的。
en: After all, in Western countries, urbanization took place over a much longer period, and against a background of steadily improving economic conditions.

zh: 在建设有效的水和废水管理系统的过程中，城市能获得足够的投资资金和相关专业知识。
en: In building effective systems for water and wastewater management, cities had adequate investment funds and the relevant expertise.

zh: 在非洲，城市的财政和管理能力已经不堪重负。
en: In Africa, cities’ financial and management capacities are already overwhelmed.

zh: 因此，水和废水管理问题常常被放任恶化，决策者只有在发生洪灾旱灾的时候才会关注水相关问题。
en: As a result, water and wastewater management has often fallen by the wayside, with policymakers focusing on water-related issues only when droughts and floods occur.

zh: 第三世界水管理中心（Third World Centre for Water Management）估算，只有大约10—12%的非洲人口能够获得充分的家庭和工业废水收集、处理和排放。
en: The Third World Centre for Water Management estimates that only about 10-12% of Africa’s population has access to adequate domestic and industrial wastewater collection, treatment, and disposal.

zh: 建设满足非洲城市的水需要的基础设施和系统要花费20—30年时间，因此，政府的持续投入至关重要。
en: Given that the construction of the infrastructure and systems required to meet African cities’ water needs is likely to take some 20-30 years, governments’ sustained commitment is essential.

zh: 一个关键性要务是开发对环境更加友好的废水处理系统，以及清洁城市中心内部和周边的已被严重污染的水体。
en: A key imperative is the development of more environmentally friendly systems for wastewater disposal, as is cleaning bodies of water within and around urban centers that are already heavily contaminated.

zh: 这一措施必须基于覆盖各种污染物的全面的水质评估方法 — — 非洲市政供水目前只检测10—40种污染物，这是远远不够的 — — 并且一旦出现新污染物，也要纳入覆盖范围。
en: Such an effort must be based on a comprehensive approach to assessing water quality that covers a wide range of pollutants – far more than the 10-40 that most African utilities now monitor – with the expectation that new pollutants will be added as they emerge.

zh: 新加坡等城市目前定期检测336项水质参数以确保用水安全。
en: Cities like Singapore now regularly monitor 336 water quality parameters to ensure water safety.

zh: 在这方面，非洲需要获得相关知识、充足的资金和运转良好的实验室 — — 所有这些都是现在所短缺的。
en: To that end, Africa will need access to the relevant expertise, adequate funding, and well-run laboratories – all of which are currently in short supply.

zh: 为这些措施提供资金并非易事。
en: Funding such efforts will not be easy.

zh: 一方面，官员腐败长期制约着水基础设施的规划、设计和建设投资，也拖累了对现有基础设施的有效管理。
en: For one thing, official corruption has long undermined investment in the planning, design, and construction of water infrastructure, as well as the effective management of existing infrastructure.

zh: 另一方面，水的社会价值 — — 包括它在许多非洲宗教中所扮演的核心角色 — — 长期限制着政府建立可行的水公共设施融资模式的能力。
en: For another, the social value of water – including its central role in many African religions – has long limited governments’ ability to create a viable funding model for water utilities.

zh: 各国通常热衷于交易石油、天然气、矿产、木材和农产品等资源，但没有国家向外国出售水。
en: Though countries are often eager to trade resources like oil, gas, minerals, timber, and agricultural products, no country in the world sells its water to other countries.

zh: 加拿大在其议会在确认北美自由贸易协定不适用于作为天然状态的水之后，才批准了该协定。
en: Canada approved the North American Free Trade Agreement only after its parliament confirmed that the agreement would not apply to water in its natural state.

zh: 在印度和巴基斯坦等联邦制国家，甚至有个别省（邦）拒绝为邻省（邦）供水。
en: In federal countries like India and Pakistan, even individual provinces refuse to consider giving water to their neighbors.

zh: 各国也不会在国内用水上赚很多钱。
en: Countries don’t make much money from water domestically, either.

zh: 2011年，南非引入了“自由基本水政策 ” （ Free Basic Water Policy ） ， 规定所有家庭，不管其规模和收入为何，每个月免费获得六千升水。
en: In 2001, South Africa introduced a “Free Basic Water Policy,” according to which all households, regardless of size or income, receive six kiloliters (1,585 gallons) of water per month at no cost.

zh: 你也许会说，这是因为水乃生存必需品。
en: One might argue that this is because water is necessary for survival.

zh: 但粮食也是。
en: But so is food.

zh: 尽管水和粮食都由南非宪法提供保证，但只有水是免费供应。
en: And while both water and food are guaranteed in South Africa’s constitution, only water is provided for free.

zh: 南非不是特例。
en: And South Africa is no anomaly.

zh: 在全世界大部分中心城市，水都是免费或有高额补贴，政客也不愿意改变这项政策。
en: In most urban centers worldwide, water is free or highly subsidized, and politicians are reluctant to change that.

zh: 新加坡水价从2000年到2016年期间没有涨过一分钱，香港水价自1996年以来便无变动，尽管其他所有东西的价格都有所上涨。
en: Singapore’s water price did not rise at all from 2000 to 2016, and Hong Kong’s water prices haven’t changed since 1996, even as the price of everything else has risen.

zh: 水当然不应该成为昂贵的奢侈品，但政府不愿意按合理水平收水费制约了它们投资于水公用设施的能力，包括合理的废水收集和处理系统。
en: While water obviously shouldn’t become an expensive luxury good, governments’ reluctance to charge appropriately for it has undermined their ability to invest in water utilities, including proper wastewater collection and treatment.

zh: 这样的做法并没有形成公平，反而让大部分城市的市政水管理变得更加不平等，因为国家无法提供高效、可持续、全面的必须服务。
en: Far from leveling the playing field, this has made urban water management in most cities less equitable, because the state is unable to provide the necessary services in an efficient, sustainable, or comprehensive way.

zh: 如果开普敦供水网络因为出水量过低而关闭 — — 可能在7月9日成为现实 — — 居民就得去200个集水点之一排队领取没人每天25升的配额。
en: When Cape Town’s water network is shut down because reservoirs have become dangerously low – probably on July 9 – residents will have to stand in line at one of 200 water-collection points, in order to collect 25 liters per person per day.

zh: 这对于穷人或困难群体来说尤其艰难。
en: That task will be particularly hard on poor and otherwise vulnerable people.

zh: 南非政客和媒体在争论这场危机的起因，他们常常将目标读准无法反驳的罪犯 — — 气候变化上。
en: As South Africa’s politicians and media debate the causes of this crisis, they often focus on climate change – a culprit that cannot talk back.

zh: 但事实是城市水管理的乱象才是供水网络关闭的主要原因。 一个事实可以很好地说明情况，在南非各大城市，36% 的水因为漏水而损失或无法收取水费，东京和金边的这一比例只有3.7%和8 % 。
en: But the fact is that the dismal state of urban water management – exemplified by the fact that 36% of the water in South African cities is either lost due to leakage or not paid for, compared to 3.7% in Tokyo and 8% in Phnom Penh – remains a leading reason for the shutdown.

zh: 城市水管理不是火箭科学。
en: Managing urban water is not rocket science.

zh: 解决方案几十年前便已为人所熟知，所需要的技术、知识乃至资金也都是现成的。
en: Solutions have been well known for decades, and the needed technology, expertise, and even funds are available.

zh: 缺失的是政治意愿、持续的民众要求以及不懈的媒体监督。
en: What has been missing is political will, sustained public demand, and continuous media scrutiny.

zh: 开普敦的危机应该作为全体非洲国家的警示信号。
en: Cape Town’s crisis should serve as a wake-up call for all of Africa.

zh: 不幸的是，和非洲的水资源一样，这个信号也很有可能被浪费掉。
en: Unfortunately, like Africa’s water resources, it is most likely to be wasted.

zh: 皮凯蒂对皮凯蒂
en: Piketty vs. Piketty

zh: 伯克利—在《二十一世纪资本论 》 （ Capital in the Twenty-First Century）中，法国经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂（Thomas Piketty）强调了北美和欧洲在一战之前的镀金时代和二战后的几十年之间的向明对比。
en: BERKELEY – In Capital in the Twenty-First Century, the French economist Thomas Piketty highlights the striking contrasts in North America and Europe between the Gilded Age that preceded World War I and the decades following World War II.

zh: 在前一个时期中，经济增长缓慢，财富主要靠继承，富人主宰了政坛，经济（以及种族和性别）不平等畸高。
en: In the first period, economic growth was sluggish, wealth was predominantly inherited, the rich dominated politics, and economic (as well as race and gender) inequality was extreme.

zh: 但经历了二战剧变后，一切都改变了。
en: But after the upheaval of WWII, everything changed.

zh: 收入增长加速，财富主要靠挣（不管公不公平 ） ， 政治由中产阶级主宰，经济不平等也相当温和（即使种族和性别平等仍然大大落后 ） 。
en: Income growth accelerated, wealth was predominantly earned (justly or unjustly), politics became dominated by the middle class, and economic inequality was modest (even if race and gender equality remained a long way off).

zh: 西方似乎进入了一个新时代。
en: The West seemed to have entered a new era.

zh: 但是，到了20世纪80年代，这些趋势似乎开始稳步退回一战前的范式。
en: But then, in the 1980s, these trends seemed to start shifting steadily back to the pre-WWI norm.

zh: 皮凯蒂的中心思想是我们不必为这一变化感到惊奇。
en: Piketty’s central thesis is that we shouldn’t be surprised by this.

zh: 我们退回镀金时代的经济和政治模式是可以预期到的，因为北美和欧洲回归了正常资本主义社会。
en: Our reversion to the economic and political patterns of the Gilded Age is to be expected as the economies of North America and Europe return to what is normal for a capitalist society.

zh: 皮凯蒂指出，在资本主义经济中，很大一部分财富被继承是常态。
en: In a capitalist economy, Piketty argues, it is normal for a large proportion of the wealth to be inherited.

zh: 财富分配高度不平等是常态。
en: It is normal for its distribution to be highly unequal.

zh: 财阀精英一旦形成就将利用其政治权力影响经济，使其成员攫取社会收入的大部分，这是常态。
en: It is normal for a plutocratic elite, once it has formed, to use its political power to shape the economy in a way that enables its members to capture a large chunk of a society’s income.

zh: 经济增长开始放缓也是常态；毕竟，高速增长需要创造性破坏；而因为受到破坏的将是财阀的财富，因此他们不可能鼓励创造性破坏。
en: And it is normal for economic growth to be slow; rapid growth, after all, requires creative destruction; and, because what would be destroyed would be the plutocrats’ wealth, they are unlikely to encourage it.

zh: 自该书出版以来，皮凯蒂的观点遭到了猛烈的抨击。
en: Since the publication of his book, Piketty’s argument has come under ferocious attack.

zh: 大部分批评都很平庸；它们给我的印象不像是有鉴赏力的才智之士所为，倒像是崛起的财阀的政治和经济权力的表现。
en: Most of the critiques are at best mediocre; they strike me less as serious acts of engaged intellect than reflections of the political and economic power of a rising plutocracy.

zh: 但是，在这些聒噪中间，有两个角度的批评表明皮凯蒂也许错了，两个角度都涉及到资本主义经济的正常特征以及不平等性问题的可能方向。
en: Out of this cacophony, however, two lines of criticism suggest that Piketty may be wrong, both with respect to the normal characteristics of a capitalist economy and where we may be headed when it comes to inequality.

zh: 第一个抨击阵营的现代领军人物是麻省理工学院研究生马修·荣利（Matthew Rognlie ） ， 尽管他的观点可以追溯到很久以前，比如凯恩斯1919年出版的《和平的经济后果 》 （ The Economic Consequences of the Peace）和1936年出版的《就业、利息和货币通论 》 （ The General Theory of Employment, Interest, and Money ） 。
en: The modern champion of the first line of attack is Matthew Rognlie, a graduate student at MIT, though his argument has a long and impressive pedigree. It can be found in, among other places, John Maynard Keynes’s 1919 The Economic Consequences of the Peace and his 1936 The General Theory of Employment, Interest, and Money.

zh: 资本主义的正常运行会产生一个积累财富的阶级，从而出现尖峰分布，在这一点上，荣利和皮凯蒂意见一致（凯恩斯亦然 ） 。
en: Rognlie agrees with Piketty (as Keynes would) that the normal operation of capitalism produces a class that accumulates wealth, which, as a result, takes on a sharp-peaked distribution.

zh: 但荣利不同意接下来的内容。
en: But he disagrees about what happens next.

zh: 他指出，资本集中度的增加在某种程度上是可以自我纠正的，因为这会导致利润率的更大比例的下降。
en: Rognlie argues that the rising concentration of capital is to some extent self-corrective, as it produces a proportionately larger fall in the rate of profit.

zh: 根据这一观点，不平等的财富分布会产生凯恩斯所谓的“食利者的安乐死，并由此导致资本家用于榨取资本的稀缺价值的累计压迫力的安乐死。
en: Unequal wealth distribution, in this view, produces what Keynes called “the euthanasia of the rentier, and, consequently, the euthanasia of the cumulative oppressive power of the capitalist to exploit the scarcity-value of capital.”

zh: ”结果是经济出现相对平等的收入分布和一个富人话语权相对较小的政治体系。
en: The result is an economy with relatively equal income distribution and a polity in which the wealthy have a relatively small voice.

zh: 我对这套推理的评价是毫不含糊的“可能 ” 。
en: My response to this line of reasoning is an unequivocal “perhaps.”

zh: 第二个抨击阵营则是以皮凯蒂之矛攻皮凯蒂之盾 — — 并不是以他写得著作，而是以他在成为名人和公共知识分子后的行为。
en: The standard bearer for the second line of criticism is none other than Piketty himself – not in anything he has written, but in how he has behaved since becoming a celebrity and a public intellectual.

zh: 皮凯蒂的书鼓励消极反应。
en: Piketty’s book encourages a passive response.

zh: 它描述了有利于主宰性财阀形成的力量，这些财阀如此强大，只有通过世界大战和全球革命��能遏制它们 — — 即便如此，纠正仍只是暂时性的。
en: It portrays the forces favoring the formation of a dominant plutocracy as being so strong that they can be countered only by world wars and global revolutions – and even then, the correction is only temporary.

zh: 但皮凯蒂的行为绝不像是记录不可避免的命运的消极编年史家。
en: But Piketty is not behaving like a passive chronicler of unavoidable destiny.

zh: 他的行为让人相信他认为他在其书中所描述的力量是可以抵挡的。
en: He is acting as if he believes that the forces he describes in his book can be resisted.

zh: 如果我们看看皮凯蒂做了些什么 — — 而不是看他写了些什么 — — 似乎很明显他认为我们能够集体决定我们自身的命运，即便环境非他（或我们）所能选择。
en: If we look at what Piketty does – rather than what he writes – it seems evident that he believes we can collectively make our own destiny, even if the circumstances are not what he, or we, would choose.

zh: 资本主义和怀疑主义
en: Capitalism and Skepticism

zh: 巴尔的摩 - - 每天华尔街都是救市的消息，愈演愈烈。 人们不禁要越发强烈地提出一个问题，那就是，美国经济为何在共和党总统时期如此糟糕？
en: BALTIMORE – As each new day brings word of another Wall Street bailout even more colossal than the last, one question presents itself with ever-increasing force: why does America’s economy perform so badly under Republican presidents?

zh: 事实难以抵赖。 实际上，历史对比无比鲜明，乃至共和党人可能开始怀疑他们是否遭诅咒。
en: The facts are hard to dispute; indeed, the historical record is now so stark that diehard Republicans are probably starting to wonder if there is a curse.

zh: 在对美国经济进行现代统计的时期，民主党在经济表现的几乎所有方面都超过共和党(包括GDP增长、失业率、通货膨胀以及预算赤字 ) 。
en: Over the period for which modern statistics are readily available, Democrats have outperformed Republicans by almost every traditional measure of economic performance (per capita GDP growth, unemployment, inflation, budget deficits).

zh: 民主党甚至在共和党的地盘上打败了他们。
en: Democrats have even managed to beat the Republicans on their own turf.

zh: 由于目前布什政府花销无度(以及克林顿政府的勤俭 ) ， 在进行统计的时间内，在共和党当政时期联邦开支占GDP的平均比例现在超过了民主党当政时期。
en: Thanks to the profligacy of the current Bush administration (and the prudence of the Clinton administration), average Federal spending as a proportion of GDP under Republican presidents now exceeds that under Democrats during the measured period.

zh: 如果采用股票回报来衡量经济表现，那么，在延长历史分析的情况下，共和党的经济表现不足模式也是如此。
en: The pattern of Republican deficiency holds up when the span of historical analysis is extended by using stock returns to measure economic performance.

zh: 平均而言，从1926年标准普尔综合股票指数开始以来，共和党当政时期的股市回报率要比民主党低大约十六个百分点。
en: On average, since the inception of the Standard and Poor’s composite stock index in 1926, the reward for putting your money in the market has been about 16 percentage points lower per presidential term under Republicans than under Democrats.

zh: 即使把大萧条时期和二战排除在外，共和党表现不佳也是顽固不变。
en: Republican underperformance remains a stubborn fact even when the Great Depression and World War II are left out of the analysis (in the fond hope that they will prove to have been unique experiences).

zh: 由于当下的总统马上就要大败而去，因此他可能担心在历史上留下恶名，把他同胡佛总统联系起来。 然而，总统党派与经济表现之间的关系还是需要一些解释研究。
en: With the current presidential term lurching to such a calamitous close that the incumbent is probably worried about being remembered as George Herbert Hoover Walker Bush, the correlation between presidential party and economic outcome demands some kind of explanation.

zh: 在共和党或民主党具体的政策纲领中无法找到答案。 多年来，这些纲领演变巨大，无法笼统而言。
en: The answer can’t be found in the specific policy proposals of Republicans or Democrats, which have evolved so much over the years that they defy meaningful generalization.

zh: 而且，它们在原则上没有什么明显可以辨别的区别可以让人们合理地预计其中一个政党的经济表现要优于另一个。
en: Nor are there clearly identifiable differences in doctrine that should translate into a reasonable expectation of better economic performance under one party than the other.

zh: 最好的解释可能是和态度有关，而非意识形态。
en: Perhaps the best explanation has to do with attitudes, not ideology.

zh: 或许，在对资本主义笃信不疑的人制定、解释、评判以及执行游戏规则的时候资本主义的表现就比怀疑者限制资本主义过度膨胀的时候要差。
en: Maybe capitalism works better when skeptics restrain its excesses than when true believers are writing, interpreting, judging, and executing the rules of the game.

zh: 民主党无疑就是两党中更为怀疑者。
en: The Democrats are surely the more skeptical of America’s two parties.

zh: 在美国经济特征中人们可以找到一些证据，我们相信其他人应该效仿。
en: Some evidence can be found in those features of the American economy that we believe others should emulate.

zh: 现在绝大多数人的共识是，公开、透明以及责任担当的股东控制机制对于上市公司的有效运行十分重要。
en: There is now an overwhelming consensus that open, transparent, and accountable mechanisms of shareholder control are essential for the efficient functioning of public corporations.

zh: 良好的会计规则决定了公司管理要义。
en: Virtue is defined by good accounting rules.

zh: 但是人们应该记住，当许多这些如今已经普遍受到推崇的规则最初提出来的时候遭到激烈的反对。
en: But it is instructive to recall that many of those now-universally-admired rules were fiercely resisted when first proposed.

zh: 苹果公司董事长乔布斯倒签股票期权丑闻代表了创新、追查以及改革的微观生态。 现在制定规则禁止倒签，这一特定的骗术就不会重演了。
en: The options backdating scandal that recently caught Apple’s chairman, Steve Jobs, is a microcosm of innovation, prosecution, and reform; now that a rule has been written to prohibit backdating, this particular scam will not happen again.

zh: 因此，会计规则接近完美。
en: Thus do accounting rules approach perfection.

zh: 我们从这些事例中学到了些什么呢？
en: What do we learn from this example?

zh: 这很难说。
en: It’s hard to say.

zh: 或许是当资本主义受到某些外部标准问责之时要比放任自流要好。
en: Maybe that capitalism works better when it is being held accountable to some external standard than when left to its own devices.

zh: 在二十世纪流逝之际，人们越发认识到，无论好坏，我们时代最为重要的著作是弗里德曼的<<资本主义与自由>>。
en: As the twentieth century recedes in the rear-view mirror, it increasingly seems that, for better or worse, our era’s defining manifesto has been Milton Friedman’s book Capitalism and Freedom .

zh: 但是该书的有力之处最初来自于其坚决独立于当代教条。 当时的统领观点是某种自满的半社会主义。
en: But that book’s potency originally derived from its fierce independence from contemporary orthodoxies.

zh: 这一观点并不认可市场可以实现有用的目标。 弗里德曼的声音在当时就是一股清风。
en: Friedman’s voice was a skeptical breath of fresh air at a time when the reigning viewpoint was a kind of smug pseudo-socialism that did not recognize the astounding power of markets to accomplish desirable aims.

zh: 但是如今，共和党的统领教条是某种自满的半弗里德曼主义。 这一教条相信放任市场运作不会有错。
en: Today, however, the reigning Republican orthodoxy is a kind of smug pseudo-Friedmanism that believes that markets left to themselves can do no wrong.

zh: 现在也许需要另一股清风。
en: Perhaps it is time for another breath of fresh air.

zh: 新时代的巨著还有待完成。 但是我提出一个书名，叫做<<资本主义与怀疑主义>>。
en: The book for the new epoch has yet to be written, but I have a proposed title: Capitalism and Skepticism .

zh: 从观点角度而言，怀疑主义也许不如自由让人喜欢，但是在过去几年中我们应该多运用一点怀疑主义。
en: Skepticism might not be as bracing as freedom, but it’s something we could have used a bit more of in the past few years.

zh: 资本主义的道德私生子
en: Capitalism’s Moral Bastards

zh: 最近，许多公司行政人员被披露将其股票期权的起算日期提早，以确保即使在公司业绩不佳的情况下也能获得超常丰厚的回报。 而这仅仅是新近层出不穷的不良商业行为之冰山一角。
en: Recent revelations that many corporate executives have backdated their stock options, ensuring excessive compensation even when their companies perform poorly, are merely the latest in a stream of examples of bad business behavior.

zh: 在这个养老金和普通职员的福利人间蒸发的时代，CEO们的贪得无厌让早已寒心的公众在愤懑之余不禁要问，大公司究竟怎么了？
en: In an era of evaporated pensions and benefits for the rank and file, piggish pay packets for CEO’s have led a cynical public to wonder where big business has gone wrong.

zh: 答案可能非常简单：太多的老板已经抛弃了基本的人类价值观并将Gordon Gekko在电影《华尔街》中叫嚣的那句著名台词奉为座右铭 ： “ 贪婪有理。 ”
en: The answer may be quite simple: too many bosses have abandoned basic human values and embraced the credo famously uttered by Gordon Gekko in the movie Wall Street : “Greed is good.”

zh: 但越来越多的研究表明贪婪并不总是有理，道德观是商业行为中的必要元素。
en: But a growing body of research concludes that greed is not always good, and that moral values are a necessary element in the conduct of business.

zh: Gordon Gekko们是赚快钱的掠食者。
en: The Gordon Gekkos are predators who take the quick payoff.

zh: 虽然他们在通过竞争提升效率并让对手不敢掉以轻心方面起到了一些作用，但市场的参与者们在大多数情况下都避免与他们打交道，而更喜欢与沃伦▪巴菲特那样的人做生意—冲劲十足，但又以公平竞争和创造长期价值而著称的商人。
en: Although they do serve a useful purpose by keeping other players on their toes and raising efficiency through competition, market participants for the most part avoid them, preferring to do business with the Warren Buffetts – hard-driving businessmen, but known for fair play and creating long-term value.

zh: 想象来到一个购物中心，购物者们在那里选购来自世界各地的商品。
en: Consider the trip to the mall, where shoppers buy goods produced and shipped from around the world.

zh: 这种分散式的交货需要雇员们在获得报酬之前工作两周，公司之间相互提供信用贷款，和银行提供的短期贷款才能实现。
en: This decentralized delivery of goods relies on employees working for two weeks before receiving a paycheck, companies offering each other lines of credit, and banks offering bridge loans.

zh: 虽然人类之间的交流早在文明诞生以前就已存在，但非个人的贸易体系却只有一千年的历史。
en: Even though humans have engaged in exchange since before the birth of civilization, the impersonal system of trading is only around 1,000 years old.

zh: 尽管这个体系如若崩溃我们可以用现行的法律手段进行补救，但非个人的贸易发生的前提必须是大多数人都奉行公平竞争和互利合作的价值观。
en: While legal remedies exist should this system break down, impersonal trading cannot occur unless most people share the values of fair play and reciprocal cooperation.

zh: 即便是在非个人的市场交换中，我们也不可避免地将交易个人化。 比如在杂货店对我们微笑并道谢的收银员，或是仅仅为了让我们感到备受呵护而工作的商店迎宾人员。
en: Even in impersonal market exchange, we cannot help but personalize transactions, say, with the grocery store cashier who smiles and thanks us, or the store greeter whose only purpose is to make us feel cared for.

zh: 和这种个人化相关的大脑区域是从我们的贸易伙伴还是小型氏族团体成员的时候开始进化的。 在那样的情况下，违反道德的行为会被即时发现并加以纠正。
en: This personalization draws upon regions of the brain that evolved when our trading partners were members of small kin-based groups where moral violations were immediately identified and remedied.

zh: Emory大学的灵长类动物学家Sarah Brosnan和Frans de Waal的研究表明猴类也有某种类似于道德观的体系。
en: Research by primatologists Sarah Brosnan and Frans de Waal at Emory University has shown that monkeys also have what look like moral values.

zh: 当两只猴子为食物付出劳动时，他们就期望食物的公平分配。
en: When two monkeys work for food, a fair split is expected.

zh: 如果分配不均，就会引发受委屈的一方怒吼并抛掷食物。
en: If a fair division is not received, it elicits cries of outrage and hurled food by the wronged partner.

zh: 道德观在人类身上也有强烈的生理表现。 当它们受到违背时，我们会有强烈的意识。
en: Moral values have powerful physiological representations in humans, too, and we feel them strongly when they are violated.

zh: 哲学家Josh Greene和他普林斯顿大学的同事们揭示了个人的道德困境（例如，你会不会为救七个人的命而直接杀死一个人）所利用的是我们的情感，而不是更高的认知力—这让许多与其意见相左的哲学家们懊恼不已。
en: The philosopher Josh Greene and his colleagues at Princeton University have shown that personal moral dilemmas (for example, whether you would directly kill one person to save seven others) use our emotions rather than higher cognition – to the chagrin of many philosophers who claimed otherwise.

zh: 这种决定的个人因素让我们心跳加速、手心出汗。
en: The personal aspect of such decisions makes our hearts speed up and our palms sweat.

zh: 在我的实验室里所进行的神经经济学实验中，我们发现当某人通过进行既可能被偿还也可能被偷走的金钱投资将信任托付与另一个陌生人时，我们的大脑会释放一种远古的哺乳类动物荷尔蒙—后叶催产素（oxytocin ） 。
en: In neuroeconomics experiments that my lab has conducted, we have found that when a stranger places trust in another by making a considered monetary investment that can either be returned or stolen, our brains release an ancient mammalian hormone called oxytocin.

zh: 后叶催产素是将哺乳动物与后代联系在一起的物质，在人类身上它使夫妻相互关爱。
en: Oxytocin is what bonds mammals to their offspring, and in humans makes spouses care about and love each other.

zh: 我们发现信任引起后叶催产素分泌的峰值并由此引发回报行为—分享金钱。
en: We have found that trust causes a spike in oxytocin and begets reciprocation – the sharing of money.

zh: 我们“天生”就是要合作的，我们对它的价值认定和我们的大脑对一顿美餐和一场性爱的价值认定相同。
en: We are “wired” to cooperate, and we find it rewarding in the same way that our brains identify eating a good meal or sex as rewarding.

zh: 后叶催产素活跃在我们大脑中较古老的进化区域，作用于我们的意识之外。
en: Oxytocin is active in evolutionarily old areas of our brain, outside of our conscious awareness.

zh: 我们仅仅感到与信任我们的人分享是正确的。
en: We simply have a sense that sharing with someone who has trusted us is the right thing to do.

zh: 我们还发现参加实验的大学生中有2%是纯粹的不合作者。
en: We have also found that about 2% of undergraduates we studied are pure non-cooperators.

zh: 当有机会和信任他（她）的陌生人分享金钱时，不合作者们独占所有的钱，而不与他人分享。
en: When they have an opportunity to share money with a stranger who has trusted him or her, non-cooperators keep all the money rather than share the largess.

zh: 在我们的实验室里对这些人的专用名词是“私生子 ” 。
en: The technical term in my lab for these people is “bastards.”

zh: 我们的证据表明这些私生子的大脑有不同的工作机制。
en: Our evidence suggests that bastards’ brains work differently.

zh: 他们的性格特征类似于那些反社会分子。
en: Their character traits are similar to those of sociopaths.

zh: 他们完全不会像大多数人那样关心他人，他们的大脑不能正常处理后叶催产素似乎是原因之一。
en: They simply do not care about others the way most people do, and the dysfunctional processing of oxytocin in their brains appears to be one reason for this.

zh: 因为私生子大有人在，所以我们仍然需要政府和经济交换在个人层面上的执行。
en: Because bastards are out there, we still need government and personal enforcement of economic exchange.

zh: 不论如何，过度的政府管制可能将道德行为“排挤掉 ” 。
en: Nevertheless, too much government regulation may “crowd out” moral behavior.

zh: 当每一种违规行为都有相应的惩罚措施，那么违反规则就不再是违背道德，而仅仅是做坏事的人冒着事情败露，受到处罚的风险，有效地“利用这一系统”的方式了。
en: When every offense has an associated penalty, transgressions cease to be moral violations, but are simply a way for wrongdoers to effectively “use the system” while facing some risk of getting caught and paying a fine.

zh: 这些外部���惩罚可能取代我们做错事后的那种自责。
en: These external penalties can displace the internal sanctions we feel when we do wrong.

zh: 在安然事件中，通过将许多的任务化整为零，以至在最终丑闻曝光以后也找不到某位个人对某一无知的决策负责。
en: At Enron, this was accomplished by breaking down tasks into small chunks so that no one person was ultimately responsible for a decision and could claim ignorance when caught.

zh: 前安然的首席执行官Jeffrey K. Skilling在受审时为自己的行为辩解说 ： “ 我又不是会计。 ”
en: Former Enron chief executive Jeffrey K. Skilling excused his behavior at his trial by saying, “I’m not an accountant.”

zh: 许多人都认为市场交换使我们丧失人性。
en: Many people have been convinced that market exchange diminishes our humanity.

zh: 想想查理▪卓别林的电影《摩登时代 》 ， 片中的小流浪汉实际上就是资本主义机器上的一枚齿轮。
en: Think of Charlie Chaplin’s film Modern Times , in which the little tramp is literally a cog in the capitalist machine.

zh: 这种观点，作为马克思主义思维方式的残余，是错误的。
en: That view, a residue of Marxist thinking, is wrong.

zh: 相反，协同工作，在市场上相互贸易，正是活生生的道德。
en: On the contrary, working together, and trading with each other in markets, is morality in action.

zh: 资本主义的新装
en: Capitalism’s New Clothes

zh: 墨尔本-全球金融危机提供了一个机会以建立一种基于健康的价值观之上的新的资本主义形式吗？
en: MELBOURNE – Is the global financial crisis an opportunity to forge a new form of capitalism based on sound values?

zh: 法国总统尼古拉·萨科齐和前英国首相托尼·布莱尔似乎是这么认为的。
en: So French President Nicholas Sarkozy and former British Prime Minister Tony Blair appear to think.

zh: 上个月在巴黎召开的主题为“新世界，新资本主义” 会上，萨科齐把基于金融投机之上的资本主义描述为一种“扭曲了资本主义的逻辑 ”的“不道德的制度 ” 。
en: At a symposium in Paris last month entitled “New World, New Capitalism,” Sarkozy described capitalism based on financial speculation as “an immoral system” that has “perverted the logic of capitalism.”

zh: 他认为，资本主义需要寻找新的道德价值观并承认政府能起更强的作用。
en: He argued that capitalism needs to find new moral values and to accept a stronger role for governments.

zh: 布莱尔则呼吁建立一种新的金融秩序，其基础是“价值观而不是短期利润的最大化。 ”
en: Blair called for a new financial order based on “values other than the maximum short-term profit.”

zh: 令人感到惊讶的是，各政党的政治家们-甚至包括那些在意识形态上强烈捍卫市场不受干预的人们-是如此愿意接受这样的观念，即，当银行和保险公司遇到麻烦的时候，国家应给予解救。
en: It is surprising how readily politicians of all parties – even strong ideological defenders of the unregulated market – accepted the idea that the state should bail out banks and insurance companies when they got into trouble.

zh: 除了少数意识形态上致力于捍卫商业自由的人们之外，很少有人愿意承担让大银行崩溃所带来的固有的风险。
en: With the exception of a small number of ideologically committed defenders of free enterprise, few were willing to take the risks inherent in letting major banks collapse.

zh: 如不这样做的话，谁知道会发生什么后果呢？
en: Who knows what the consequences would have been?

zh: 很多人害怕会出现大规模的失业、破产潮、数百万家庭无家可归、社会安全网紧绷到断裂点，甚至暴乱以及如1930年代经济大萧条期间把希特勒送上权利顶峰的政治极端主义的死灰复燃。
en: Many feared mass unemployment, a tidal wave of bankruptcies, millions of families evicted from their homes, the social safety net strained to the breaking point, and perhaps even riots and a resurgence of the political extremism that brought Hitler to power in Germany during the depression of the 1930’s.

zh: 选择为银行由自己的错误所造成的财务后果买单，表明了相信市场智慧的价值观发生了改变。
en: The choice to save the banks from the financial consequences of their own errors indicates a shift in values away from belief in the wisdom of the market.

zh: 显然，市场在一些事情上犯了严重错误-如某些金融证券的价值。
en: Evidently, the market got some things – like the value of certain financial securities – horrendously wrong.

zh: 但经济低迷会让消费者的价值观也产生更深的变化吗？
en: But will the downturn also produce a deeper shift in the values of consumers?

zh: “新世界，新资本主义”专题会在法国举行并非偶然，在法国，正是因为它带来了这种价值观的变化，一些批评者视全球金融危机为必要和所需。
en: It is no accident that the “New World, New Capitalism” symposium was held in France, where some critics have seen the global financial crisis as necessary and desirable precisely because it is producing this change in values.

zh: 费加罗报上的关于如何缩减自己的开支的一个版面则预测“价值观革命” 的来临，并声称，人们将把家庭放在工作之前。
en: In the newspaper Le Figaro, a section on how to scale back one’s expenses predicted a “revolution in values” and claimed that people will put family ahead of work.

zh: （美国人认为实行更短工作时间和更长的夏日休假的法国人，已经把家庭放在工作之前了。 ）
en: (Americans think the French, with their shorter working hours and longer summer vacations, already put family ahead of work.)

zh: 法国人一直以来不是很容易欠债-当他们用卡来消费的时候，他们使用的往往是借记卡，也就是花他们已有的钱，而不是用信用卡。
en: The French have always been less likely to go into debt – when they pay with plastic, they tend to use debit cards, drawing on funds they already have, rather than credit cards.

zh: 现在，他们视当前的危机是对他们价值观的认同，也就是不花你还没有拥有的钱。
en: Now they see the current crisis as a vindication of the value of not spending money that you don’t have.

zh: 在许多情况下，这意味着，削减奢侈消费-这和法国与时装、香水和香槟连在一起的国家形象很难相符。
en: That means, in many cases, less luxury spending – something that is hard to reconcile with the image of France as the country of fashion, perfume, and champagne.

zh: 但过度挥霍已经过时了，有报道说，到处都在削减奢侈品消费。
en: But excess is out of style, and there are reports of cutbacks in luxury goods everywhere.

zh: Richmond里士满，这个瑞士拥有卡地亚和万宝龙品牌的奢侈品公司表示，它正面临着“自20年前成立以来最艰难的市场情况。
en: Richemont, the Swiss luxury goods company that owns the Cartier and Montblanc brands, has said that it is facing “the toughest market conditions since its formation 20 years ago.”

zh: ”但是，这是否标志着价值观的持久的变化，还是仅仅是消费者因投资的损失以及对经济情况的越来越不确定而不得不采取的暂时削减？
en: But does this mark an enduring change in values, or just a temporary reduction, forced upon consumers by investment losses and greater economic uncertainty?

zh: ，美国总统奥巴马在其就职演说中说 ： “ 现在应该是抛弃幼稚的事情的时候了 ” ， 而他没有选择崇高观点， 即“人人都平等自由，都应该有机会追求充分的幸福。
en: In his inauguration speech, American President Barack Obama said, “The time has come to set aside childish things” and instead to choose the noble idea that “all are equal, all are free, and all deserve a chance to pursue their full measure of happiness.”

zh: ”如果全球金融危机能恢复人们对什么才是重要这一问题的恰当认识，这将是一件极好的事。
en: It would be an excellent thing if the global financial crisis restored a proper sense of what is important.

zh: 危机是否可能提醒我们，我们购买奢侈品更多的是因为它们所带来的身份，而不是其内在的价值？
en: Could the crisis remind us that we buy luxury items more because of the status they bring than because of their intrinsic value?

zh: 它是否能有助于我们体会到，对我们的幸福感来说，很多事情比我们把钱花在时装、昂贵的手表和美食上的能力更重要？
en: Could it help us to appreciate that many things are more central to our happiness than our ability to spend money on fashion, expensive watches, and fine dining?

zh: 它甚至是否可以如奥巴马所提出的那样，让我们更清楚地意识到那些生活在真正的贫困中的人们的需求，他们不管有没有金融危机，都比我们将来所面临的情况要更糟糕得多？
en: Could it even, as Obama suggests, make us more aware of the needs of those who are living in real poverty and are far worse off than we will ever be, financial crisis or no financial crisis?

zh: 危险的是，正如之前经常所发生得那样，真正的价值变化的可能性将被那些把它看作又一个赚钱的机会的人霸占。
en: The danger is that the potential for a real change in values will be co-opted, as has happened so often before, by those who see it as just another opportunity to make money.

zh: 设计师Nathalie Rykiel据说正在筹划三月间Sonia Rykiel桑丽卡新时装的发布，她不会再租用面积巨大的场地，而是在她自己的较小的精品空间举行。
en: The designer Nathalie Rykiel is reportedly planning to show the new Sonia Rykiel collection in March not in the usual vast rented area, but in the smaller space of her own boutique.

zh: “这是对亲密关系和价值回归的渴望 ， ” 她对国际先驱论坛报说。
en: “It's a desire for intimacy, to go back to values,” she told the International Herald Tribune .

zh: “我们必须回归小规模，这样就能接触到人们。
en: “We need to return to a smaller scale, one that touches people.

zh: 我们等于在说 , ‘ 来我家吧，看看衣服，感觉一下衣服。
en: We will be saying, ‘Come to my house.
Look at and feel the clothes.’”

zh: 每年有一千万儿童死于可避免的与贫穷有关的原因，温室气体的排放威胁着将数以亿计的人们变为气候难民，活在这样一个世界里，啊是的，我们是应该走进巴黎精品时装店亲手感觉一下服装。
en: Ah yes, in a world in which ten million children die every year from avoidable, poverty-related causes, and greenhouse-gas emissions threaten to create hundreds of millions of climate refugees, we should be visiting Paris boutiques and feeling the clothes.

zh: 如果人们真的为值得捍卫的道德价值而担心，那他们根本就不该去买名牌服装。
en: If people were really concerned about defensible moral values, they wouldn’t be buying designer clothes at all.

zh: 但是，Nathalie Rykiel -或法国、意大利、美国富裕的精英们-有多少可能认同这些价值观呢？
en: But what are the chances of Nathalie Rykiel – or the affluent elites of France, or Italy, or the United States – adopting those values?

zh: 资本家溶化
en: Capitalist Meltdown

zh: 巴黎 - - 人们对世界经济有着不详的预感。
en: PARIS – There is a strange foreboding in the world economy.

zh: 各家报纸对美德法日等所有主要发达国家都向下修正了经济增长预计。
en: Newspapers report downward revisions in growth estimates for all the major developed countries: the United States, Germany, France, Japan.

zh: 看起来没有哪个国家可以幸免。
en: No one, it seems, is being left out.

zh: 确实，这些预计要比仅仅是在去年秋天发布的低大约半个百分点。
