en: Indeed, these estimates are roughly half a percentage point lower than those issued only last autumn.

zh: 与此同时，各家报纸几乎全是用悲惨的语言报导有关银行和金融市场的消息，而对世界经济状况几乎不关心，好像现今的危机仅仅是金融方面的，而且还必将持续如此。
en: At the same time, newspapers report in bleak terms almost exclusively about banks and financial markets, with little attention to the real economy, as if today’s crisis were purely financial and bound to remain so.

zh: 确实，某些专家也相信只要通过对银行重新融资就可以解决这场危机，而且对实际经济的影响将会相对有限。
en: Indeed, some experts, too, believe that the crisis can be resolved simply by refinancing banks, and that the impact on the real economy will be relatively limited.

zh: 这明显是欧洲央行的观点。 该行正在向银行系统注入数千亿欧元来保障流动资金的供应。
en: This is clearly the belief of the European Central Bank, which is pumping hundreds of billions of euros into the banking system to ensure liquidity.

zh: 但是，与美国联邦储备委员会不同的是，它还没有降低利率，而这对企业和百姓而言恰恰是最为重要的。
en: But, unlike the US Federal Reserve, it has not lowered key interest rates, which is what matters most to firms and households.

zh: 当然，其他专家相信实际经济处于危险境地之中，而且经济衰退的危险是切实存在的。
en: Other experts, of course, believe that the real economy is in jeopardy, and that the threat of a recession is genuine.

zh: 但不幸的是，几乎没有任何专家可以抱有信心地评述金融业和宏观经济。
en: But, unfortunately, hardly any experts can speak with confidence about both finance and macroeconomics.

zh: 如此，不是专家的人该如何思考呢？
en: So what is a non-expert to think?

zh: 回顾一下当今世界经济局面是有所帮助的。
en: It is helpful to review where the world economy now stands.

zh: 今年春天将会发生最大规模的次级房屋贷款无力偿还个案。
en: The largest number of defaults on sub-prime mortgages will occur this spring.

zh: 所以这一危机最为险峻的部分还在前面。 130万美国家庭已经无力偿还房屋贷款。
en: So the full impact of the crisis remains ahead of us: 1.3 million American homeowners have already defaulted on their mortgages.

zh: 在2008年，还会有三百万家庭加入这一行列。
en: In 2008, another three million will join them.

zh: 而且，威胁银行的坏帐规模还不清楚，说不定会达到几千亿美元。
en: Moreover, the size of the bad debt threatening banks remains unknown, and could amount to several hundred billion dollars.

zh: 受到威胁的资产总额更为重要，因为房屋按揭贷款已经和其他种类的证券混杂在一起，而这些“套餐”已经销售遍及全世界。
en: The total sum of assets now under threat is even more important, because mortgages have been mixed up with other kinds of securities, and these “packages” have been sold throughout the world.

zh: 例如，德意志银行的一家美国子公司由于无法证明对一所房产的所有权而已被一家美国法院禁止收回该房产。
en: A US subsidiary of Deutsche Bank, for example, has been barred by an American court from foreclosing on a house because it could not demonstrate ownership.

zh: 全球经济充满了这种有毒套餐。
en: The global economy is overrun with such poisoned packages.

zh: 结果，银行互不信任，大多数都停止了相互拆借。 这样就由于大幅降低给企业的信贷而危及到了经济活动。
en: As a result, banks distrust one another and have mostly stopped lending to each other, which jeopardizes economic activity by severely reducing the availability of credit to businesses.

zh: 结果，经济衰退看来是躲不掉的了。
en: As a result, recession seems certain.

zh: 世界经济中流动资金的数量令人惊讶，而各国中央银行的货币扩张并不足以解释这一现象。
en: The quantity of liquidity in the world economy is surprising, and monetary expansion by central banks does not explain it completely.

zh: 所有发达国家中的股东在1945年至1975年和1980年期间没有什么组织并且并不积极。 在过去二十多年，他们以养老基金、投资基金以及对冲基金的形式重新确立自己。
en: For more than two decades, shareholders in all the developed countries, unorganized and passive from 1945 until 1975-1980, have recast themselves in the form of pension funds, investment funds, and hedge funds.

zh: 现在，他们在发达国家所有大公司中以多数股东或者强大的少数股东的角色发挥重要而又积极的作用。
en: Now they are significant and active players (as majorities or strong minorities) in all the big companies of the developed world.

zh: 为了提高其股价，这些股东支持公司裁员并且削减全球范围员工的工资。
en: To boost the value of their shares, these shareholders backed the drive to reduce the global volume of the payroll and the number of workers that companies employ.

zh: 实际上，在过去25年中，在所有有关国家中，直接和间接工资在GDP中占据的百分比从11%下降到8 % 。
en: Indeed, in the last 25 years, the share of direct and indirect wages as a percentage of GDP has fallen by 8% to 11% in all the countries involved.

zh: 结果，1940年至1970年期间几乎不存在的险峻的就业形势和工作不稳定现在影响到超过15%的发达国家人口。
en: As a result, precarious employment and job insecurity, which hardly existed between 1940 and 1970, now affect more than 15% of the developed world’s population.

zh: 过去20年中，美国的平均工资停滞不前，而在此期间，1%的人获取了一半的GDP增长成果。
en: The average real wage has been flat in the US for 20 years, with 1% of the population capturing all of the gains brought about by a 50% growth in GDP during this period.

zh: 这就“解放”了大量流动资金用于金融活动、赌博以及投机。
en: This “liberated” a lot of liquidity for financial activities, gambling, and speculation.

zh: 过去二十年中仅仅在法国，大约两万五千亿欧元注入到了金融市场，也就是说，世界经济整体中总共是30万亿到60万亿之间。
en: In France alone over the past 20 years, roughly 2.5 trillion euros have poured into the financial world, which suggests a total of 30-60 trillion dollars for the world economy as a whole.

zh: 这就伴随着日益增长的不道德现象。
en: This has been accompanied by a growing immorality of the system.

zh: 企业老板的薪金现在达到普通工薪雇员的300倍到500倍，而1980年以前的一个半世纪里则是40倍。
en: Remuneration of company bosses now reaches 300 to 500 times the average salary of rank-and-file employees, up from 40 to one for the century and a half before 1980.

zh: 在全世界，企业面临各种欺诈而带来的法律问题，其数量大幅度增加。
en: Throughout the world, the number of companies facing legal problems for various types of fraud is growing dramatically.

zh: 不幸的是，最坏的还在后面。
en: The worst, sadly, is yet to come.

zh: 由于大多数人的收入停滞不前，而且由于其房贷压力增加收入遭到侵蚀，消费必定下降，造成增长和就业更加缓慢。
en: Because most people’s incomes are stagnant and being eroded as their mortgage payments rise, consumption is bound to fall, yielding lower growth and employment.

zh: 经济衰退只会让就业和工作更为险峻和不稳定，造成社会关系紧张。 而社会关系紧张当然无法帮助减轻金融危机。
en: A recession will only increase job precariousness and unemployment, creating social tensions that will not, of course, help to ease the financial crisis.

zh: 看起来，所有的要素都已经就位，引发长久和剧烈的经济衰退和社会动荡。
en: All the ingredients seem to be in place for a long and powerful perfect storm of economic decline and social unrest.

zh: 我们在发达国家中的人生活在民主制度之中。
en: We in the developed world live in democracies.

zh: 每隔四到五年，体制的合法性需要经过选举来加以确认。
en: Every four or five years, the legitimacy of the system needs to be confirmed by elections.

zh: 但是经济和社会动荡消除了这一制度的合法性，选举还能够维继吗？ 现在这一体制还具有合法性吗？
en: But is the system being so delegitimized by the economic and social turmoil that elections will no longer be viable?

zh: 当然，资本主义从来要比共产主义更为符合个人自由。
en: Of course, capitalism remains more compatible with personal freedom than communism ever was.

zh: 但是现在一清二楚的是，资本主义过于不稳定，没有强大的公共管治就难以维持。
en: But it is now blindingly obvious that capitalism is too unstable to survive without strong public regulation.

zh: 这就是为何社会民主在经过多年的冷遇之后应该作为可行的选择返回政治前沿。
en: That is why, after years of being neglected as a viable option, it is time for the social-democratic project to return to the political fore.

zh: 资本耸耸肩
en: Capital Shrugged

zh: 洛杉矶—资本主义最大的优势在于其韧劲，即其在危机和商业周期的阵痛和挑战中生存下来、刺激创新和经济增长的能力。
en: LOS ANGELES – Capitalism’s greatest strength has been its resiliency – its ability to survive the throes and challenges of crises and business cycles to fuel innovation and economic growth.

zh: 然而，如今，资本主义进入债务危机已逾四年，却仍然不知所向，这不仅让人们开始质疑这一优势。
en: Today, however, more than four years into a credit crisis, a conspicuous enigma calls this legacy into question.

zh: 尽管美国经济最近颇有些复苏的希望（比如2011年第四季度的存货补充 ） ， 但其真实GDP增长仍然持久地低于趋势增长率。
en: Despite recent hopes of recovery in the US, including an inventory catch-up in the fourth quarter of 2011, real US GDP growth has remained persistently below trend.

zh: 此外，尽管经季节调整的1月就业数据显示失业率下降到了8.3 % （ 但实际上1月份的实际就业数量仍在减少 ） ， 但更现实的“失业率”仍高达15%以上，劳动力市场参与率更是处于30年来的最低值。
en: Moreover, although seasonally adjusted January employment data have brought the unemployment rate down to 8.3% (while total jobs were actually lost in January), the more realistic rate of “underemployment” remains over 15% and the labor-force participation rate is at a record 30-year low.

zh: 美国显然不是唯一一个步履维艰的国家，欧元区就面临着远比美国紧迫的主权债务危机。
en: And the US is clearly not alone in its malaise, with the eurozone fighting a far more urgent sovereign-debt crisis.

zh: 那么，这一次为什么会不一样呢？
en: So, why is this time different?

zh: 安·兰德（Ayn Rand）用其1957年的名著《阿特拉斯耸耸肩 》 （ Atlas Shrugged）中的绝望诅咒给出了答案 ： “ 谁是约翰·高特（John Galt ） ？
en: The answer lies in Ayn Rand’s rhetorical invocation of despair in her 1957 epic Atlas Shrugged: “Who is John Galt?”

zh: ”简言之，当国家夺走了资本投资的激励和领导权的时候，资本所有者就会罢工。
en: Simply put, when the state seizes the incentives and drivers of capital investment, owners of capital go on strike.

zh: 兰德描绘了一批类似希腊神话中的阿特拉斯的创新性实业家，在他们背上背负着一个不断膨胀的傲慢的集体主义政府的反乌托邦世界。
en: Rand portrays innovative industrialists as akin to Atlas in Greek mythology, carrying on his back a dystopian world of growing and overbearing collectivist government.

zh: 英雄约翰·高特呼吁实业家耸耸肩，收回他们的生产性活动，让“世界的马达停下 ” ， 不要让这个世界在平均主义的伪装下产生保护政治关系集团经济利益的激励。
en: The hero, John Galt, calls for them all to shrug, to “stop the motor of the world” by withdrawing from their productive pursuits, rather than promoting a world in which, under the guise of egalitarianism, incentives have been usurped in order to protect the politically connected from economic failure.

zh: 如今，兰德的虚构世界似乎变成了现实 — — 以削弱生产率最高部门为代价给予生产率低下部门没完没了的救援和经济刺激、除此之外，还出现了向资本投资增税的呼声。
en: Today, Rand’s fictional world has seemingly become a reality – endless bailouts and economic stimulus for the unproductive at the expense of the most productive, and calls for additional taxation on capital investment.

zh: 当今世界充斥着错综复杂、相互关联的公司和政府资产负债表，需要兰德笔下的英雄创业家们的耸耸肩。
en: The shrug of Rand’s heroic entrepreneurs is to be found today within the tangled ciphers of corporate and government balance sheets.

zh: 自2008年以来，美联储已经增加了超过2万亿美元的基础货币供应，这是前所未有的不可思议的巨额数字，实际上无异于给银行的大礼包，让它们覆盖巨额亏损、刺激借贷和投资。
en: The US Federal Reserve has added more than $2 trillion to the base money supply since 2008 – an incredible and unprecedented number that is basically a gift to banks intended to cover their deep losses and spur lending and investment.

zh: 然而，由于银行仍处于去杠杆化阶段，这些新增货币几乎全部被用作超额储备存在美联储那里。
en: Instead, as banks continue their enormous deleveraging, almost all of their new money remains at the Fed in the form of excess reserves.

zh: 此外，公司也握有大量现金，如果用相对于资产和净值的标准衡量，公司现金持有量处于历史最高点。
en: Corporations, moreover, are holding the largest amounts of cash, relative to assets and net worth, ever recorded.

zh: 然而，尽管权威人士大谈资产负债表如何如何健康，但企业债务水平（相对应于资产和净值来说）也处于历史最高点附近。
en: And yet, despite what pundits claim about strong balance sheets, firms’ debt levels, relative to assets and net worth, also remain near record-high levels.

zh: 现金就是王道。
en: Hoarded cash is king.

zh: 货币流动速度（即货币支出的频率，以GDP与基础货币的比值衡量）仍然徘徊在历史最低水平。
en: The velocity of money (the frequency at which money is spent, or GDP relative to base money) continues to plunge to historic lows.

zh: 因此，货币政策收效甚微一点都没有什么好奇怪的。
en: No wonder monetary policy has had so little impact.

zh: 作为经济增长引擎的资本被空置着 — — 所有人都在耸肩。
en: Capital, the engine of economic growth, sits idle – shrugging everywhere.

zh: 或许兰德比所有经济观察家都更好地指出了激励在激发企业家创新行为和风险承担行为中的核心作用。
en: Rand, perhaps better than any economic observer, underscored the central role of incentives in driving entrepreneurial innovation and risk-taking.

zh: 激励的减少 — — 以及市场通过价格信号传递激励信息的能力的下降 — — 无异于收走增长引擎中的燃料。
en: Whittle away at incentives – and at the market’s ability to communicate them through price signals – and you starve the growth engine of its fuel.

zh: 可是，很显然，采取利率控制和量化宽松的央行忽视了这一事实。
en: Alas, central bankers, with their manipulation of interest rates and use of quantitative easing, patently neglect this fact.

zh: 利率并不只是决定储蓄和投资水平的经济输入变量。
en: Interest rates are more than a mere economic input that determines levels of saving and investment.

zh: 正如奥地利经济学家米赛斯所强调的，利率是人们总时间偏好（即牺牲现在满足将来的渴望）的反映，而不是它的决定因素。
en: Rather, as the Austrian economist Ludwig von Mises emphasized, they are a reflection of people’s aggregate time preference – or desire for present versus future satisfaction – not a determinant of it.

zh: 于是，利率激励并指导企业家如何在不同的时间间配置资本。
en: Interest rates thus incentivize and convey to entrepreneurs how to allocate capital through time.

zh: 比如，低利率和资本成本增加了未来现金流的相对吸引力，从而增加了资本投资，这便是系统对高储蓄、低消费的自动平衡机制。
en: For example, lower interest rates and cost of capital raise the relative attractiveness of cash flows further in the future, and capital investment increases – the system’s natural homeostatic response to higher savings and lower consumption.

zh: 然而，国家对利率的操控并不影响时间偏好，尽管它显示了这样的变化。
en: State manipulation of interest rates, however, does not influence time preference, even though it signals such a change.

zh: 由此产生的不一致性导致了扭曲：如同一切价格管制一样，资本得到了流向与实际供求不一致的投资的激励。
en: The resulting inconsistency creates distortions: as with any price control, capital receives an incentive to flow to investment that is inconsistent with actual supply and demand.

zh: 美联储在有目的地破坏激励系统 — — 具体地说，是在扭曲资金价格所提供的信号 — — 这将会导致投资不当（而当公债被货币化时，还会产生通货膨胀 ） 。
en: The Fed is purposefully and insidiously distorting the incentive system – specifically, signals provided by the price of money – resulting in mal-investment (and, when public debt is monetized, inflation).

zh: 这一过程将维持一段时间，奖励生产率低下的投资，刺激认为美联储已经消除了风险的寡头投机者。
en: This can continue for a time, rewarding unproductive investments and aspiring oligarch-speculators who presume that the Fed has eliminated risk.

zh: 但是，正如兰德所提醒我们的，总有一天，一切都会玩完。 。
en: But, as Rand reminds us, at some point the jig is up.

zh: 如今，在经历了史上最猛的信用扩张之后，引爆点显然已经被触发了。
en: Today, after the largest credit expansion in history, that point has clearly been reached.

zh: 现在，冷漠的资本已经对虚假的市场信号无动于衷了，而随着恒定的时间偏好被重新认识，越来越多的不当投资的清盘正通过系统渗透出来。
en: Impassive capital now ignores deceptive market signals, and the liquidation of untenable mal-investment percolates through the system as immutable time preferences prevail.

zh: 从长期看，国家无法规定企业家怎样借贷和投资；如果对自由市场的操控压力太大，投资资本免不了要耸耸肩。
en: The state, in the long run, simply cannot direct entrepreneurs to lend, borrow, and invest; investment capital will inevitably shrug when faced with oppressive manipulation of free markets.

zh: 当这一幕发生时，我们就会看到宽松货币政策的真正结果：它并没有创造出更多的经济活动，反而破坏了经济协调和调整的自然机制，削弱了系统的韧劲。
en: When that happens, we see the true result of loose monetary policy: not the creation of more economic activity, but the destruction of the natural mechanism of economic coordination and adjustment, robbing the system of its resilience.

zh: 总而言之，货币政策“停止了世界的马达 ” 。
en: In effect, monetary policy has “stopped the motor of the world.”

zh: 在《阿特拉斯耸耸肩》的末尾，集体主义机制分崩离析，高特将目标转为重建旧系统。
en: At the conclusion of Atlas Shrugged, Galt aims to restore the old system anew as the collectivist regime crumbles.

zh: 这一幕会在我们的反乌托邦世界（有希望成为美国总统候选人的共和党无不赞成炒掉美联储主席伯南克）重现吗？
en: Will something like that, too, happen in our own dystopian world (in which all remaining Republican US presidential candidates seem to favor firing Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke)?

zh: 资本要等待多久才能等到激励不再扭曲、增长引擎重新注满燃料、开始轰然作响的那一天？
en: How long must capital wait for the day when, free of distorted incentives, the engine of growth is fueled and humming again?

zh: 首都的价值
en: Capitals of Capital

zh: 纽约 — — 近期，中国政府宣称将在2020年之前将上海打造成全球金融中心， 类似于伦敦和纽约目前的地位。
en: NEW YORK – Recently, China’s government announced that it wants Shanghai to become a global financial capital equal to London and New York by 2020.

zh: 此项愿望能否成功还不可知。
en: An ambitious goal, which may or may not be achieved.

zh: 中国政府如此的雄心也引发了一些担忧，同时也说明了一些新的事实：近些年来，一些政治人物开始介入原来由市场所决定的事情。
en: But China’s aspirations also underscore a worrisome and increasingly pervasive new reality: political officials are making decisions normally left to markets on a scale not seen in decades.

zh: 如同近期的金融危机那样，目前这种现象有在全世界范围蔓延之势。
en: Like the financial crisis itself, this trend is now global.

zh: 在全球的数十个国家中，政治人物已经开始介入，推动地方或是全球金融市场的发展。
en: Political leaders in dozens of countries are making decisions that will drive the performance of local (and global) markets for the foreseeable future.

zh: 中国的出口在2月份已经下滑了25 % 。
en: In China, exports fell by more than 25% in February.

zh: 中国的总理温家宝却不担心，他认为，中国政府有“充足的存货”来推进5,860亿美元的经济刺激方案，就是通过政府在交通，能源基础设施，房地产以及其他大型项目的投入来创造出数百万个工作机会。
en: Not to worry, said Premier Wen Jiabao: the Chinese government has “adequate ammunition” to add to its $586 billion stimulus package, a plan meant to create millions of jobs via enormous government investment in transportation, energy infrastructure, housing, and other large-scale projects.

zh: 在印度，政府通常被看作是阻碍商业发展的势力，而不是经济增长的催化剂。 然而现在，金融市场的推手更可能来自于德里的官僚，而不是来自孟买的创新者。
en: In India, where government is more often considered a drag on commerce than a catalyst of growth, the decisions that move local markets are now more likely to come from bureaucrats in Delhi than from innovators in Mumbai.

zh: 实际上，国大党领导的政府正逢选举年，他们迫切希望改善经济下滑的局面，自从去年12月份以来已经推出了三套经济刺激方案。
en: In fact, the Congress Party-led government, anxious to appear responsive to public demand for help during an election-year economic slowdown, has pushed forward three stimulus packages since December.

zh: 问题的底线在于：我们要研究在数十个国家发达和发展中的国家，各国政府应该在何时，运用何种方式来配置什么样的资产，必须研究政治而非金融的资源。
en: The bottom line: to find out how, when, and where assets will be allocated and wealth generated in dozens of countries across the developed and developing worlds these days, we must now look toward political, not financial, capitals.

zh: 此种趋势将会给全球经济的长期发展带来不利因素。
en: This trend will spell trouble for longer-term global economic growth.

zh: 要在中国共产党精英阶层的内部形成统一意见，这看来并不是一件容易的事情。
en: First, it’s tough enough for leaders within the Chinese Communist Party elite to agree on economic-policy priorities.

zh: 对美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马来说，在推出新的一项冒险而昂贵的政策之前，如何获得喜欢争论的民主党人和固执的共和党人的支持，还要经过漫长磨人的法律流程后才能达成某种妥协，这未尝又不是一种挑战。
en: The challenges facing US President Barack Obama as he tries to win support for risky and expensive policy options from quarrelsome Democrats and obstinate Republicans will create some tortured legislative compromises.

zh: 此类情况同样发生在世界的其他地方，例如俄罗斯，乌克兰，匈牙利，巴基斯坦，土耳其，马来西亚，墨西哥，尼日利亚等国家。 国内不同的政策走向往往导致推出经济政策的不连贯性。
en: In Russia, Ukraine, Hungary, Pakistan, Turkey, Malaysia, Mexico, Nigeria, and other states, battles among domestic political factions will yield often-incoherent responses to pressing economic problems.

zh: 第二，如果在国内的经济问题上都不能达成一致意见，更不用说在全球范围了。
en: Second, if it’s difficult to forge consensus within one country on how best to promote growth, imagine the same argument on a global scale.

zh: 绝大多数的政客都是为自己代言的利益集团牟利，以保护自己个人的政治资本。
en: Most politicians craft policy to serve their local constituents and to protect their personal political capital.

zh: 而如何振兴全球经济往往被远远地放在了第二位。
en: Reinvigorating global growth runs a distant second.

zh: 在华盛顿，许多民主党的议员利用政策辩论的机会将公众的愤怒引向华尔街的大佬,以此为自己谋求政治资本，而共和党人也在寻找机会将公众的愤怒情绪引向民主党人。
en: In Washington, many Democrats will use these policy debates to capitalize on popular fury at Wall Street, while many Republicans look for an opening to capitalize on hoped-for public anger at the Democrats.

zh: 在中国共产党内部，一些领导人希望将经济增长的动力从以出口为导向转为拉动内需的模式。
en: Some within the Chinese Communist Party leadership will support plans to engineer a shift from export-led growth to a model based on domestic consumption.

zh: 而其他一些人却希望通过政府直接投资来为自己个人的项目带来好处。
en: Others will try to direct state funding toward their personal investment projects.

zh: 同样的，在俄罗斯，印度，墨西哥，南非，各国的政府都有自己难念的经。
en: Factions within the Russian, Indian, Mexican, and South African governments have their own competing political priorities.

zh: 看来，如此众多的政治人物应对经济危机的目的是为了解决本土问题或是为本地创造机会，怎么能够指望他们会有一个国际的视野观呢？
en: With so many political officials crafting crisis responses to solve local problems or to create local opportunities, how likely are they to agree on a unified international approach?

zh: 去年11月份，在华盛顿20国紧急峰会上，我们已经目睹参会各国在如何协调应对危机上的不协调之音。
en: Our first glimpse of the trouble in coordinating an international response to the financial crisis came last November, during the emergency G-20 summit in Washington.

zh: 在随后的8国峰会上也是争论不断。 20国峰会上各国不可能达成共识的理由很多，不仅是由于如此众多的参会国家，更因为许多国家对国际经济的基本游戏规则都不认可。
en: To get the G-8 to agree on priorities is a complicated enough; building consensus within the G-20 is exponentially more difficult, not simply because of the larger number of players involved, but because many of them don’t agree on the most basic rules of the global economic game.

zh: 然而，4月举办的20国伦敦峰会出人意料地达成了一些经济政策协议，主要的原因是最具争论的话题 — — 美英主张的全球各国经济刺激方案 — — 被提前撤了下来。
en: While the April G-20 summit in London produced more economic-policy agreement than expected, this was largely because the most divisive issue – the US and British demand for more global stimulus spending – was removed from the table beforehand.

zh: 因此，各国的总统和总理才能微笑地握手言欢。 而捷克总理米雷克•��波拉内克在担任欧盟轮值主席时却表现的不同，他公开批评奥巴马的经济刺激方案，认为会使得其他国家“跌入地狱 ” 。
en: As a result, the smiling presidents and prime ministers could afford to be more diplomatic than Czech Prime Minister Mirek Topolanek, who, in his role as acting president of the European Union, had warned that Obama’s economic plan would lead others down a “road to hell.”

zh: 因为捷克不是成员国，托波拉内克没有参加20国峰会。
en: Topolanek wasn’t at the G-20; his country is not a member.

zh: 英国首相戈登·布朗却大加赞赏奥巴马，认为作为世界最大的工业化国家的美国必须尽可能地刺激国内经济。 然而，英国央行行长默文·金却警告说，如果再推行一次经济刺激方案的话，英国人就会背负太多的债务。
en: And, while British Prime Minister Gordon Brown agrees with Obama that the world’s leading industrialized countries must stimulate their domestic economies as much as they can, Bank of England Governor Mervyn King has warned that Britain may already have taken on too much debt for another round of stimulus.

zh: 然而，在如何应对目前的全球经济萧条问题上，看来世界各国的领袖们还没有达成一个协调统一的意见。
en: However frightening the global recession, a coordinated and coherent response to it by the world’s political leaders remains highly uncertain at best.

zh: 而且，政治过多干预市场对经济的影响将会在数年后才会显现出来。
en: And the increasingly heavy influence of political factors on market performance will likely weigh on global growth for years to come.

zh: 被绑架的欧洲
en: Captured Europe

zh: 华盛顿—能在国家和欧元区层面施加影响的欧洲政策精英陷入了大麻烦。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Europe’s policy elite – the people who call the shots at the national and eurozone level – are in serious trouble.

zh: 由于措置失当，欧洲正在滑向深度危机，创造欧元时信誓旦旦的统一和繁荣没了影儿。
en: They have mismanaged their way into a deep crisis, betraying all of the lofty promises of unity and prosperity issued when the euro was created.

zh: 货币联盟可能最终能够得救，但对千百万人民来说，欧元维持增长、保证稳定的使命肯定是没有完成。
en: The currency union may survive, but, for millions of people, the euro has already failed in its mission of sustaining growth and ensuring stability.

zh: 为什么会这样？
en: How did this happen?

zh: 希腊、葡萄牙、爱尔兰和意大利正在财政紧缩中举步维艰，在可以预见的未来，这些国家都将继续实施预算缩减和税收增加。
en: The Greek, Portuguese, Irish, and Italian economies are reeling under fiscal austerity – with budget cuts and higher taxes as far as the eye can see.

zh: 这一政策组合将使它们及欧洲其他地区的增长减缓。
en: This policy mix will slow their growth, and that of the rest of Europe.

zh: 但这只是问题的一部分。
en: But that is only part of the problem.

zh: 更大的问题是迫使欧洲各国政府做此下策的“债务宿醉 ” 。
en: The bigger issue is the “debt overhang” that has forced European governments to pursue this course.

zh: 美国在过去几年中所发生的事情也颇为相似：许多家庭被债务压得喘不过气来，因此家庭消费出现了下降，至今仍未好转。
en: There are strong parallels to what happened in the United States in the past few years: many families felt crushed by their debts, so household consumption fell and has yet to recover.

zh: 欧洲的调整可能更加痛苦，因为主权债务危机对所有人都形成了抑制效应，消费者、投资者、公共部门，概莫能外。
en: The adjustment will be even more painful in Europe, because a sovereign-debt crisis has a depressing effect on everyone – consumers, investors, and the public sector alike.

zh: 对付债务宿醉有一个简单的办法：重组债务，从而减少偿付。
en: There is a simple way to deal with a debt overhang: reduce payments by restructuring the debt.

zh: 许多企业能够与债权人就融资条件展开谈判，通常是延长债务期限，从而让它们得以借入更多的钱来为更新更好的项目融资。
en: Many firms are able to renegotiate financing terms with their creditors – typically extending the maturity of their liabilities, which enables them to borrow more to finance new, better projects.

zh: 如果谈判不能通过自愿协商达成，那么美国企业将使用破产法第11章，由法院来监督和批准债务重组。
en: If such negotiation cannot be achieved voluntarily, US firms can use Chapter 11 of the bankruptcy code, under which a court supervises and approves the reorganization of liabilities.

zh: 你也许会认为，美国家庭和焦头烂额的欧洲各国政府也可以如法炮制。
en: So you would think the same would be true for US households and embattled European governments.

zh: 但它们的债务重组情况发生得很少也很晚。
en: But the restructuring of debt has been too little and has come too late.

zh: 这是为什么呢？
en: Why?

zh: 不论是美国家庭还是欧洲政府，无法消除债务宿醉的主要障碍来自银行家，他们说，出于两个原因，这样会造成金融市场浩劫。
en: In both cases, the main argument for not removing the debt overhang came from bankers, who claimed that it would create havoc in financial markets for two reasons.

zh: 首先，银行是主要债权人，任何重组都会给它们带来巨大的损失，必然会造成多米诺效应，悲观情绪的蔓延将导致利率升高、毁掉其他借款人的光明前景。
en: First, banks were the primary creditors, and the large losses that they would face in any restructuring was bound to trigger a domino effect, with waves of pessimism driving up interest rates and ruining other borrowers’ prospects.

zh: 其次，银行也会因此遭难，因为它们出售了大量违约保险，即信用违约互换。
en: Second, banks would also suffer because they had sold insurance against default – in the form of credit-default swaps.

zh: 若这些互换被触发，银行将面临不堪设想的损失。
en: When these swaps were activated, the banks would incur potentially further crippling losses.

zh: 国际银行家指出，长期和严厉的希腊债务重组将造成欧元区大范围的深度停滞，其影响甚至可能达到欧元区之外。
en: In the case of Greece, international bankers argued long and hard that debt restructuring would generate contagion far and wide within the eurozone – and perhaps more broadly.

zh: 但最后，希腊别无选择，只能重组其债务，砍掉私人债权面值的75 % （ 饶是如此，可能仍不足以让希腊债务负担变得可持续 ） 。
en: And yet, in the end, Greece had little choice but to restructure its debt, cutting the value of private claims by about 75% relative to their face value (although even this is probably not enough to make the country’s debt burden sustainable).

zh: 这被认为是一起“信用事件 ” ， 将触发信用违约互换：所有为该事件投了保的人都可以获得赔付。
en: This was deemed a “credit event,” so credit-default swaps were exercised: anyone who insured against default had to pay out.

zh: 只是如此吗？
en: Did all hell break loose?

zh: 不。
en: No.

zh: 银行并没有倒闭，也没有出现任何多米诺效应的迹象。
en: Banks have not failed, and there is no sign of tumbling dominoes.

zh: 但这并不是因为银行未雨绸缪留好了更多资本。
en: But that is not because banks prepared themselves by raising more capital.

zh: 相反，与潜在未来损失相比，欧洲银行最近留存的资本仍显太少 — — 切这笔资本是通过会计花招变出来的，而不是真正的用于吸收损失的股本金。
en: On the contrary, compared to their likely future losses, European banks have raised relatively little capital recently – and much of this has been creative accounting, rather than truly loss-absorbing shareholder equity.

zh: 也许希腊债务重组引发金融崩溃的风险永远不会很高，市场并不会对此有多大的反应。
en: Perhaps the risk that a Greek debt restructuring would cause a financial meltdown was always minimal, and quiescent markets were to be expected.

zh: 但是，既然如此，为何这一问题会引发如此关注？
en: But, in that case, why all the fuss?

zh: 答案现在已经很清楚了：利益集团政治和政策精英的世界观。
en: The answer should be clear by now: interest-group politics and policy elites’ worldview.

zh: 就算金融体系的风险很小，对银行和债权人的冲击也会很大。
en: Even if the risk to the financial system was minimal, the impact on banks and bondholders was substantial.

zh: 它们可能因此损失数十亿美元，不少金融部门员工还将丢掉工作。
en: They stood to lose billions, and many financial-sector employees stood to lose their jobs.

zh: 毫不奇怪，不管是公开还是暗地里，大银行都在游说反对债务重组。
en: Not surprisingly, leading bankers lobbied against debt restructuring, both behind closed doors and publicly.

zh: 比如，华盛顿有一个叫国际金融协会（Institute for International Finance）的机构，是代表大银行利益的游说集团。 该协会不断强调：援助我们，否则后果自负。
en: For example, the Institute for International Finance, a preeminent Washington, DC-based lobbying group for large banks, consistently argues: bail us out, or else face the consequences.

zh: 但是，这一说辞的背后是政治权力，这一权力近几年来膨胀迅速，已经到了美国和欧洲主要决策者都得唯银行财富马首是瞻的程度，就算这样做会给经济造成深远冲击。
en: But, just as important as their storyline is their political power, which has risen greatly in recent years – to the point that all major policymakers in the US and Europe cater to banks’ fortunes even when there are no wider implications for the economy.

zh: 即使是现在，大量本应由银行家承担的损失仍然被公共部门承担了 — — 形式多种多样，包括直接支持和欧洲央行高风险的非常规举措。
en: Even now, many of the losses that bankers should have faced are being shouldered by the public sector, including through various forms of direct support and the extraordinary and risky actions of the European Central Bank.

zh: 金融部门得到的补贴之巨令人咋舌，在现行政策下，补贴还将进一步增加 — — 这些补贴的首要作用是支持了最发达国家最高端1%人群的生活方式。
en: The extent of subsidies in this sector is stunning and, under current policies, will only increase over time – thereby primarily supporting the lifestyles of the top 1% of people in very rich countries.

zh: 希腊的违约表明，咬人的狗不吠。
en: The Greek default has turned out to be the proverbial dog that didn’t bark.

zh: 欧洲 — — 还有美国 — — 能从中吸取的教训相当浅显：不要再听银行的鬼话，而应该开始关注它们的行动。
en: The lesson for Europe – and for the US – is clear: it is time to stop listening to what banks say, and start focusing on what they do.

zh: 我们必须重新评估被扭曲的金融部门政治经济学，否则的话，少数人权力的过度膨胀将给其他所有人带来更大的负担。
en: We must re-evaluate the distorted political economy of the financial sector, before the excessive power of the few imposes even larger costs on everyone else.

zh: 绑架欧洲央行
en: Capturing the ECB

zh: 纽约—关于欧洲眼下的政治分歧、特殊利益和短视经济考虑，没有比重组希腊主权债务争论更好的写照了。
en: NEW YORK – Nothing illustrates better the political crosscurrents, special interests, and shortsighted economics now at play in Europe than the debate over the restructuring of Greece’s sovereign debt.

zh: 德国坚持要实行深度重组，至少要债权人“牺牲”50 % ， 而欧洲央行坚持债务重组必须是自愿的。
en: Germany insists on a deep restructuring – at least a 50% “haircut” for bondholders – whereas the European Central Bank insists that any debt restructuring must be voluntary.

zh: 换做从前 — — 比如20世纪80年代的拉美债务危机 — — 急于平息事态的政府和监管者可以把债权人（主要是大型银行）关进小黑屋，威逼利诱一番，然后就达成了协议。
en: In the old days – think of the 1980’s Latin American debt crisis – one could get creditors, mostly large banks, in a small room, and hammer out a deal, aided by some cajoling, or even arm-twisting, by governments and regulators eager for things to go smoothly.

zh: 但是，随着债务证券化时代的到来，债权人数量比以前有了暴增，对冲基金等监管者和政府很难对其施加影响的投资者也被包括了进来。
en: But, with the advent of debt securitization, creditors have become far more numerous, and include hedge funds and other investors over whom regulators and governments have little sway.

zh: 此外，金融市场的“创新”使得证券所有者可以获得保险，这意味着他们也入了局，不再是“事不关己”了。
en: Moreover, “innovation” in financial markets has made it possible for securities owners to be insured, meaning that they have a seat at the table, but no “skin in the game.”

zh: 他们确实有利益在其中：他们想获得保险，这意味着重组必须是“信用事件 ” ， 也就是违约。
en: They do have interests: they want to collect on their insurance, and that means that the restructuring must be a “credit event” – tantamount to a default.

zh: 欧洲央行坚持“自愿”重组 — — 也就是说，避免了信用事件的发生 — — 无异于站到了债权人的对立面。
en: The ECB’s insistence on “voluntary” restructuring – that is, avoidance of a credit event – has placed the two sides at loggerheads.

zh: 其中的讽刺之处在于，监管者坐视这一怪胎体系的产生。
en: The irony is that the regulators have allowed the creation of this dysfunctional system.

zh: 欧洲央行的立场十分奇怪。
en: The ECB’s stance is peculiar.

zh: 你可能寄希望于银行通过买入保险设法消除了投资组合中的债券的违约风险。
en: One would have hoped that the banks might have managed the default risk on the bonds in their portfolios by buying insurance.

zh: 此外，如果它们购买了保险，那么关心系统稳定性的监管者将巴不得保险人在损失事件发生时予以偿付。
en: And, if they bought insurance, a regulator concerned with systemic stability would want to be sure that the insurer pays in the event of a loss.

zh: 但欧洲央行又希望银行承担所持债券50%的损失而不获得任何保险“偿付 ” 。
en: But the ECB wants the banks to suffer a 50% loss on their bond holdings, without insurance “benefits” having to be paid.

zh: 欧洲央行采取这一立场可能有三个原因，但没有一个能很好地为该机构及其监管和监督行为开脱。
en: There are three explanations for the ECB’s position, none of which speaks well for the institution and its regulatory and supervisory conduct.

zh: 第一个原因是，银行事实上并没有买入保险，一些银行的头寸是投机性的。
en: The first explanation is that the banks have not, in fact, bought insurance, and some have taken speculative positions.

zh: 第二个原因是，欧洲央行明白金融体系缺乏透明度，也知道投资者明白他们无法看清非自愿违约的影响，而这可能导致信用市场冻结，重现2008年9月雷曼兄弟倒闭后的乱象。
en: The second is that the ECB knows that the financial system lacks transparency – and knows that investors know that they cannot gauge the impact of an involuntary default, which could cause credit markets to freeze, reprising the aftermath of Lehman Brothers’ collapse in September 2008.

zh: 最后，欧洲央行可能在试图保护出售保险的几家银行。
en: Finally, the ECB may be trying to protect the few banks that have written the insurance.

zh: 这三大理由都不足以成为欧洲央行反对希腊债务深度非自愿重组的借口。
en: None of these explanations is an adequate excuse for the ECB’s opposition to deep involuntary restructuring of Greece’s debt.

zh: 欧洲央行应该坚持增加透明度 — — 事实上，这一点正是2008年的主要教训。
en: The ECB should have insisted on more transparency – indeed, that should have been one of the main lessons of 2008.

zh: 监管者本不应该允许银行如此投机；至少应该要求银行买入保险，然后坚持要求能够确保保险获得偿付的重组。
en: Regulators should not have allowed the banks to speculate as they did; if anything, they should have required them to buy insurance – and then insisted on restructuring in a way that ensured that the insurance paid off.

zh: 但是，没有证据显示深度非自愿重组会比深度自愿重组造成更大的混乱。
en: There is, moreover, little evidence that a deep involuntary restructuring would be any more traumatic than a deep voluntary restructuring.

zh: 欧洲央行或许是想通过坚持自愿违约确保重组程度不至于很深，但是，这样一来，欧洲央行便将银行的利益置于希腊利益之前了，因为对希腊来说，深度重组是走出危机的必经之路。
en: By insisting on its voluntariness, the ECB may be trying to ensure that the restructuring is not deep; but, in that case, it is putting the banks’ interests before that of Greece, for which a deep restructuring is essential if it is to emerge from the crisis.

zh: 事实上，欧洲央行可能把少数出售了信用违约互换的银行的利益置于优先于希腊、欧洲纳税人以及审慎债权人和保险购买者的利益的地位。
en: In fact, the ECB may be putting the interests of the few banks that have written credit-default swaps before those of Greece, Europe’s taxpayers, and creditors who acted prudently and bought insurance.

zh: 欧洲央行立场的最后一个诡异之处与民主治理有关。
en: The final oddity of the ECB’s stance concerns democratic governance.

zh: 决定是否让信用事件发生的是一个国际互换和衍生品协会旗下的秘密委员会，而国际互换和衍生品委员会本身与决定结果有着千丝万缕的联系。
en: Deciding whether a credit event has occurred is left to a secret committee of the International Swaps and Derivatives Association, an industry group that has a vested interest in the outcome.

zh: 如果新闻报道为真，则该委员会的一些成员正在利用职权推行更温和的谈判立场。
en: If news reports are correct, some members of the committee have been using their position to promote more accommodative negotiating positions.

zh: 但欧洲央行将决定什么是可接受的债务重组的权利委托给一个本身也是自利市场参与者的秘密委员会，此举实在有些说不过去。
en: But it seems unconscionable that the ECB would delegate to a secret committee of self-interested market participants the right to determine what is an acceptable debt restructuring.

zh: 一种（尽管只是名义上）将公众利益置于首位的观点是非自愿违约会导致财政问题的传染，意大利、西班牙甚至法国等欧元起大经济体将因此面临借贷成本急剧升高的局面，甚至因此引发危机。
en: The one argument that seems – at least superficially – to put the public interest first is that an involuntary restructuring might lead to financial contagion, with large eurozone economies like Italy, Spain, and even France facing a sharp, and perhaps prohibitive, rise in borrowing costs.

zh: 但这又引出了另一个问题：为什么非自愿重组会引起比深度相仿的自愿重组更严重的传染？
en: But that begs the question: why should an involuntary restructuring lead to worse contagion than a voluntary restructuring of comparable depth?

zh: 如果银行体系有着很好的监管，持有主权债务的银行全部购买了保险，非自愿重组对金融市场的冲击应该没有这么大。
en: If the banking system were well regulated, with banks holding sovereign debt having purchased insurance, an involuntary restructuring should perturb financial markets less.

zh: 当然，你可能会指出，如果希腊逃脱非自愿违约，那么其他国家也会试图依样画葫芦。
en: Of course, it might be argued that if Greece gets away with an involuntary restructuring, others would be tempted to try it as well.

zh: 金融市场将对此产生忧虑，造成其他欧元区风险国利率飙升，不管是大国还是小国。
en: Financial markets, worried about this, would immediately raise interest rates on other at-risk eurozone countries, large and small.

zh: 但风险最高的国家已然被金融市场排除在外了，因此产生恐慌的可能性后果有限。
en: But the riskiest countries already have been shut out of financial markets, so the possibility of a panic reaction is of limited consequence.

zh: 当然，如果希腊在重组后境况确实有所改善，那么其他国家或许真的会群起仿效。
en: Of course, others might be tempted to imitate Greece if Greece were indeed better off restructuring than not doing so.

zh: 这诚然不假，但已是众人皆知的秘密了。
en: That is true, but everyone already knows it.

zh: 欧洲央行的行为倒也不出人意料：放眼别处，不可被民主问责的机构往往会被特殊利益绑架。 2008年以前便是如此。
en: The ECB’s behavior should not be surprising: as we have seen elsewhere, institutions that are not democratically accountable tend to be captured by special interests.

zh: 不幸的是，对欧洲 — — 以及对全球经济 — — 来说，此后这一问题并未得到充分的解决。
en: That was true before 2008; unfortunately for Europe – and for the global economy – the problem has not been adequately addressed since then.

zh: 金融界的可持续革命
en: The Sustainability Revolution in Finance

zh: 发自斯德哥尔摩 — — 金融业界正在发生一场静悄悄的革命。
en: STOCKHOLM – A quiet revolution is taking place in the financial industry.

zh: 根据联合国环境计划署所发布的报告，可持续发展正越来越多地被涵盖到财务决策的考虑因素之中。
en: According to the United Nations Environment Programme, sustainable development is increasingly being integrated into financial decision-making.

zh: 迄今为止欧盟一直在这一转变中显得比较被动，而许多国家的金融监管机构则引领着潮流。
en: The European Union has been rather passive so far in this transformation, but financial regulators in a number of countries are leading the charge.

zh: 法国最近推出了面向机构投资者的全球第一个强制性气候信息披露要求。
en: France recently introduced the world’s first mandatory climate disclosure requirements for institutional investors.

zh: 挪威的主权财富基金正在逐步退出煤炭行业。
en: Norway is divesting its sovereign wealth fund from coal.

zh: 南非则将可持续发展纳入其证券交易所的股票上市要求之中。
en: South Africa has embedded sustainable development into listing requirements on its stock exchange.

zh: 同样，巴西的银行法规现在要求对环境风险进行评估。
en: Likewise, Brazil’s banking regulations now require accounting for environmental risk.

zh: 而瑞典政府正在推动一项雄心勃勃的可持续发展议程，其中列入了一系列旨在增加对投资者的信息披露并确定哪些与气候相关的风险必须由监管机构和金融企业进行解决的提案。
en: And the Swedish government is pushing an ambitious sustainability agenda featuring a series of proposals aimed at improving information for investors and determining which climate-related risks regulators and financial firms must address.

zh: 与此同时，私人部门也不遑多让。
en: Private industry is also moving rapidly.

zh: 全球最大的资产管理公司黑石（Blackrock）现推出非化石燃料指数（fossil-fuel-free index ） ， 而世界上最大的保险公司之一安盛（Axa）也已承诺从煤碳行业撤资。
en: The world’s largest asset manager, Blackrock, is launching a fossil-fuel-free index, and Axa, one of the world's largest insurance companies, has pledged to divest from coal.

zh: 这种撤资运动是滚雪球式的：宗教社区、城市政府、社会名人、工会，大学和机构投资者都表示要撤出化石燃料资产。
en: Meanwhile, the divestment movement is snowballing, with faith-based communities, municipalities, celebrities, trade unions, universities, and institutional investors all pledging to unload their fossil-fuel assets.

zh: 总共已有管理超过$ 2.6万亿美元市值的机构承诺要从化石燃料行业撤资。
en: Altogether, institutions worth more than $2.6 trillion have committed to divest from fossil fuels.

zh: 革命或许是寂静的，但它引发的震荡却日益扩大。
en: The revolution may be quiet, but it is getting louder.

zh: 化石燃料企业正在失去其合法性；因为它们目前的经营模式与关注气候变化的投资组合背道而驰。
en: Fossil-fuel companies are increasingly being delegitimized; their current business model is irreconcilable with a climate-conscious investment portfolio.

zh: 与此同时，投资者开始认识到，关注气候风险是合理投资战略的一个组成部分，可以最大限度地降低风险并有助于提升金融稳健程度。
en: At the same time, investors are starting to understand that paying attention to climate risk is an integral part of a sound investment strategy that seeks to minimize risk and help to promote financial stability.

zh: 安盛首席执行官亨利·德·卡斯特（Henri de Castries）对这样的动机表示赞同，指出脱离煤炭行业有助于从投资组合中剔除风险，并有助于建立一个更加可持续发展的社会。
en: Axa’s CEO Henri de Castries has endorsed such motives, stating that divesting from coal helps remove risk from investment portfolios and contributes to building a more sustainable society.

zh: 英格兰银行行长马克·卡尼（Mark Carney）一直在大力强调气候变化可能带给金融市场的风险。
en: Bank of England Governor Mark Carney has been particularly frank in highlighting the dangers that climate change poses to financial markets.

zh: 在今年9月于伦敦劳合社（Lloyd’s of London）发表的演讲中，他警告如果继续拖延将全球变暖限制在摄氏2ºC以内的转型，则金融稳定性风险将增大。
en: In a speech at Lloyd’s of London this September, he cautioned that a delayed transition to limit global warming to 2º Celsius would increase risks to financial stability.

zh: 一系列机构也对他的警告做出了响应。
en: A range of institutions has echoed his warning.

zh: 与此同时，麦肯锡公司和碳信托基金估计化石燃料公司市值的30-40％可能会因为所谓“碳泡沫 ” — —对化石燃料储量的高估 — — 而受损。
en: Meanwhile, McKinsey and the Carbon Trust have estimated that 30-40% of the value of fossil-fuel companies could be endangered because of a so-called “carbon bubble,” an overvaluation of fossil-fuel reserves.

zh: 据国际能源机构的统计，如���世界要避免气候变化失控的话，2/3的燃料储备必须留在地底不得开采，这意味着相关企业可能无法利用其全部经济潜力。
en: According to the International Energy Agency, two-thirds of these reserves must be kept in the ground if the world is to avoid runaway climate change, which implies that companies may not be able to exploit their full economic potential.

zh: 鉴于欧洲金融部门在化石燃料资产上的投资超过1万亿欧元（约合 1.1万亿美元 ） ， 欧盟所面临的碳泡沫风险尤其巨大。
en: Given that the European financial sector has invested more than €1 trillion ($1.1 trillion) in fossil-fuel assets, the EU is particularly at risk of a carbon bubble.

zh: 事态严重，以至于欧洲央行行长马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）要求欧洲系统性风险委员会对此进行调查。
en: The issue has become serious enough that European Central Bank President Mario Draghi has asked the European Systemic Risk Board to investigate it.

zh: 此外瑞典，德国，荷兰和英国的金融监管机构都在研究气候变化对金融市场的影响。
en: Financial regulators in Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom are all studying the impact of climate change on financial markets.

zh: G20集团还要求位于巴塞尔的金融稳定委员会召开针对碳泡沫的公私听证会。
en: The G-20 has also asked the Basel-based Financial Stability Board to convene a public-private inquiry into the carbon bubble.

zh: 去年九月，欧盟专员乔纳森·希尔（Jonathan Hill）发布了期待已久的资本市场联盟提案。
en: Last September, European Commissioner Jonathan Hill published his long-awaited Capital Markets Union proposal.

zh: 但尽管他建立更为整合且多元化的资本市场的呼吁令人钦佩，却缺乏一个可以将可持续发展融入金融体系的路线图以及应对碳泡沫的战略。
en: But while his call for more integrated and diversified capital markets in the EU is admirable, his proposal lacks both a roadmap for the integration of sustainable development into the financial system and a strategy for addressing the carbon bubble.

zh: 欧洲议会和欧洲理事会不乏机会去改进希尔的建议。
en: The European Parliament and the European Council have the opportunity to improve Hill’s proposal.

zh: 议会已经成立了一个名为碳素集团的非正式跨党派小组，其目的是解决碳泡沫和推进可持续金融。
en: The parliament has already established an informal cross-party grouping, called the Carbon Group, which aims to tackle the carbon bubble and advance sustainable finance.

zh: 在理事会内部，以瑞典和法国为首的几个国家正在为更加大程度地将可持续发展指标整合入金融市场而努力。
en: And within the Council, a range of countries, most notably Sweden and France, are working for greater integration of sustainability metrics into financial markets.

zh: 此外一批机构也开始在它们的决策过程中引入可持续发展因素。
en: A range of institutions are starting to embrace sustainable development considerations in their financial decision-making.

zh: 而政策制定者们 — — 尤其是在欧盟 — — 有责任去推动这些前瞻性思维，并保护全球经济免受气候引发的财务危机。
en: Policymakers – especially in the EU – have a responsibility to advance such forward-looking thinking and to protect the global economy from climate-induced financial distress.

zh: 碳定价和返现计划
en: A Carbon Price-and-Rebate Plan

zh: 巴黎—目前，国际气候谈判没有能够找到可以成功降低全球温室气体排放的机制。
en: PARIS – So far, international climate talks have failed to find a mechanism that will successfully reduce global greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 1997年京都议定书尝试采用可交易配额系统为二氧化碳排放制定价格，但以失败告终，因为美国和一些新兴国家拒绝加入京都议定书。
en: The 1997 Kyoto Protocol attempted to use a system of tradable quotas to establish a price on carbon-dioxide emissions, but foundered after the United States and several emerging countries refused to join.

zh: 2009年哥本哈根气候变化会议引入了承诺-评估程序，各国单方面决定减排多少。
en: The 2009 Copenhagen Climate Change Conference introduced a pledge-and-review process, in which countries unilaterally decided how much they would cut.

zh: 结果，美国和一些新兴经济体首次做出减排承诺。
en: As a result, the US and several emerging economies made commitments to reduce emissions for the first time.

zh: 但这一系统也有极大的缺陷。
en: But this system, too, is badly flawed.

zh: 它没有解决经典 的免费搭车问题，也无法保证发展中国家的减排。
en: What it does not do is resolve the classical free-rider problem or guarantee reductions in developing countries.

zh: 事实上，一些国家为了维持强势谈判地位，被鼓励做得更少一些。
en: Indeed, some countries may have been encouraged to do less than they otherwise would have in order to maintain a strong negotiating position.

zh: 11月30日—12月11日，全世界领导人将在巴黎出席联合国气候变化会议。 这次会议是一次形成有效协议的新机会。
en: As world leaders meet in Paris from November 30 to December 11 for the United Nations Conference on Climate Change, they will have a new opportunity to forge an effective agreement.

zh: 为了鼓励各国政府一致行动，致力于构建一个直观而透明的碳定价系统至关重要。
en: To encourage governments to act in concert, it is essential to work toward a system of carbon pricing that is both straightforward and transparent.

zh: 我们建议采取“定价和返现”机制，制定一个高于某个阈值的排放价格，同时明确所得收入如何使用。
en: We propose a carbon “price-and-rebate” mechanism, which simultaneously sets a price on emissions above a certain threshold and defines how the revenues raised should be used.

zh: 巴黎会议前的研究表明，国际公司可以迅速减少温室气体排放。
en: Studies ahead of the Paris conference suggest that international cooperation could allow for rapid reduction of greenhouse gases.

zh: 它们还强调了迅速采取行动遏制气候变化所能带来的附带好处，包括减少地方污染、增强能源和粮食安全以及更快的创新。
en: They also highlight the knock-on benefits that taking quick action on climate change could have, including reduction of local pollution, greater energy and food security, and faster innovation.

zh: 要加速迈向低碳经济，就必须有适用于所有国家的国际协定；包括一个共同的一致监测、报告和核实系统；并提供全球范围的强经济激励。
en: To accelerate the move toward a low-carbon economy, an international agreement must be applicable to all countries; include a common and consistent system for monitoring, reporting, and verification; and provide strong economic incentives at a global scale.

zh: 我们的定价和返现机制受欧洲的“奖惩”机制启发。 在奖惩机制中，新汽车的买家会被课税或获得补贴，视其所购买汽车的二氧化碳排量而定。
en: Our price-and-rebate mechanism is inspired by the “bonus/malus” scheme in France, in which buyers of new cars are taxed or given a bonus depending on the vehicle’s CO2 emissions.

zh: 在我们的系统中，一国如果超过了世界人均排放量，就必须向其在规定量二氧化碳（及其等价物）以上的排量部分支付每吨若干美元。
en: In our system, a country exceeding the worldwide average for per capita emissions would pay a specified amount on every ton of CO2 (or its equivalent) above a set threshold.

zh: 低于人均排放量的国家将因为污染较少而获得补偿。
en: Countries with lower-than-average emissions would be compensated for polluting less.

zh: 这一系统一开始有利于人均排量最低的国家，这意味着大部分资金将流向最不发达国家。
en: This system would initially benefit countries with the lowest per capita emissions, meaning that most of the funds would flow towards the least-developed countries.

zh: 一旦得到充分执行，定价和返现机制将鼓励所有国家削减人均排放，从而降低支付额和返现额之间的距离。
en: Once it is fully operational, the price-and-rebate mechanism would encourage all countries to reduce their per capita emissions, thereby reducing the gap between payments and rebates.

zh: 理想的谈价格将取决于协定的目标。
en: The ideal carbon price would depend on the objectives of the agreement.

zh: 每吨定价1—2美元可以带来140—280亿美元收入，足够在发展中国家部署监测、评估和核实程序。
en: A price of $1-2 per ton would generate $14-28 billion, enough to fund the deployment of the monitoring, review, and verification process in developing countries.

zh: 在哥本哈根协定中，发达国家承诺在2020年后每年拿出1,000亿美元帮助不发达国家减轻或适应气候变化。
en: The Copenhagen Accord included a commitment by rich countries to spend $100 billion a year after 2020 to help underdeveloped countries mitigate and adapt to climate change.

zh: 7—8美元一吨的定价便能够产生足以兑现这一承诺的收入，资金将流向人均排量较低的国家。
en: A rate of $7-$8 per ton would generate enough revenue to deliver on this promise, with the money flowing to countries with low per capita emissions.

zh: 在这1,000亿美元中，略多于600亿将来自西方国界和日本，只有不到200亿来自碳氢化合物出口国（特别是俄罗斯和沙特阿拉伯）和高增长亚洲经济体（包括中国和韩国 ） 。
en: Of that $100 billion, a little over $60 billion would come from Western countries and Japan, and just under $20 billion would come from hydrocarbon-exporting countries (Russia and Saudi Arabia in particular) and high-growth Asian economies (including China and Korea).

zh: 因此，引入定价和返现系统将按照“共同但有差异的责任和各自能力” 原则重新分配各国的资金。
en: The introduction of a price-and-rebate system would thus redistribute funds among countries in conformity with the principle of “common but differentiated responsibilities and respective capabilities.”

zh: 定价和返现系统将是高效而公平的。
en: A price-and-rebate system would be both efficient and fair.

zh: 全世界所有公民都有同样温室气体排放权利，所有国家都获得同样的边际减排激励。
en: Every citizen in the world would have the same right to emit greenhouse gas, and every country would face the same incentives at the margin to reduce emissions.

zh: 克服建立这样一套系统的主要障碍是说服出资国政府为其碳排放付钱。
en: The main obstacle to be overcome in establishing such a system will be to convince donor countries’ governments to pay for their carbon emissions.

zh: 这一成本与他们的经济规模比起来十分微小，而任何成功的气候变化协定都需要一样的承诺。
en: This cost will be modest relative to the size of their economies, and any successful climate-change agreement will require similar commitments.

zh: 如果发达国家不同意为碳支付一个十分有限的价格，那么巴黎谈判将肯定以失败告终。
en: If rich countries are unable to agree to pay even a modest price for carbon, the talks in Paris will surely be judged a failure.

zh: 通往碳定价之路
en: The Path to Carbon Pricing

zh: 华盛顿—区区六周后，世界领导人将齐聚巴黎协商新的全球气候变化协定。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – In just six weeks, world leaders will meet in Paris to negotiate a new global climate-change agreement.

zh: 目前，150个国家已经递交了关于如何让本国经济走向恢复力更强的低碳轨迹的详细计划。
en: To date, 150 countries have submitted plans detailing how they will move their economies along a more resilient low-carbon trajectory.

zh: 这些计划给出了第一批为了在不让二氧化碳排放量达到如今导致全球变暖的危险水平的情况下构建高竞争力未来而进行的投资。
en: These plans represent the first generation of investments to be made in order to build a competitive future without the dangerous levels of carbon-dioxide emissions that are now driving global warming.

zh: 通往更清洁的未来的转型将需要政府行动起来并未私人部门提供正确的激励。
en: The transition to a cleaner future will require both government action and the right incentives for the private sector.

zh: 居于核心地位的应该是强有力的碳污染定价公共政策。
en: At the center should be a strong public policy that puts a price on carbon pollution.

zh: 给碳基能源、电力和工业活动定更高的价格将刺激人们使用更清洁的燃料、节约能量、促进向更绿色的投资的转变。
en: Placing a higher price on carbon-based fuels, electricity, and industrial activities will create incentives for the use of cleaner fuels, save energy, and promote a shift to greener investments.

zh: 碳税和碳费、排量交易安排和其他定价机制、取消低效补贴，这些措施能够给予企业和家庭它们所需要的确定性和可预测性，让它们为气候智能（climate-smart）发展做出长期投资。
en: Measures such as carbon taxes and fees, emissions-trading programs and other pricing mechanisms, and removal of inefficient subsidies can give businesses and households the certainty and predictability they need to make long-term investments in climate-smart development.

zh: 在国际货币基金组织（IMF ） ， 注意力集中在改革成员国的财政制度，从碳密集型燃料的税收上获得更多收入，同时减少不利于经济表现的劳动和资本方面的税收。
en: At the International Monetary Fund, the focus is on reforming its member countries’ fiscal systems in order to raise more revenue from taxes on carbon-intensive fuels and less revenue from other taxes that are detrimental to economic performance, such as taxes on labor and capital.

zh: 碳定价可以是更智能、更高效的税收制度，并不一定要提高税负。
en: Pricing carbon can be about smarter, more efficient tax systems, rather than higher taxes.

zh: 碳税必须针对源自化石燃料的排放全面收取。
en: Carbon taxes should be applied comprehensively to emissions from fossil fuels.

zh: 其价格必须足够高以实现宏大的环境目标，必须与国家的具体情况相结合，必须稳定以鼓励企业和家庭投资于清洁技术。
en: The price must be high enough to achieve ambitious environmental goals, in alignment with national circumstances, and it must be stable, in order to encourage businesses and households to invest in clean technologies.

zh: 管理碳税并不复杂，可以基于目前在大部分国家都在征收的道路燃料税。
en: Administering carbon taxes is straightforward and can build on existing road fuel taxes, which are well established in most countries.

zh: 碳定价符合许多国家的根本利益，因为它会带来诸多国内环境收益。
en: Carbon pricing will be in many countries’ best interests, owing to the many domestic environmental benefits.

zh: 比如，燃烧更清洁的燃料有助于减少室外空气污染。 据世界卫生组织的数据，目前室外空气污染每年导致约370万人过早死亡。
en: For example, burning cleaner fuels helps to reduce outdoor air pollution, which, according to the World Health Organization, currently causes about 3.7 million premature deaths a year.

zh: 遏制能源价格改革对各国弱势群体的冲击至关重要。
en: It is vitally important to address the impact of energy-price reforms on vulnerable groups in every society.

zh: 因此，这些改革需要辅之以财政制度和社会安全网等方面的调整，以确保穷人不受伤害。
en: So these reforms will need to be accompanied by adjustments to fiscal systems and safety nets, among other things, to ensure that the poor are not harmed.

zh: 世界银行集团正在支持各个国家和企业制定环境友好型公共政策、投资碳市场、探索金融创新以便利低碳转型。
en: The World Bank Group is supporting countries and businesses as they develop climate-friendly public policies, invest in carbon markets, and explore financial innovations to ease into low-carbon transitions.

zh: 世界银行集团利用其经验和业务遍及全球的特点，通过市场合作准��计划（Partnership for Market Readiness）等项目促进学习和知识交流。
en: The Group is leveraging its experience and global reach for learning and knowledge exchange through programs like the Partnership for Market Readiness.

zh: 从这方面的经验出发，我们与经合组织一起制定了帮助指引和启发未来谈定价机制的初步原则。
en: From that experience, we have developed, alongside the OECD, initial principles to help guide and inspire future carbon-pricing schemes.

zh: 通过实施这些原则，各个国家、地区、行政区和企业能够更快地行动起来，解决我们所有人一起面临的气候挑战。
en: By drawing on these principles, countries, regions, states, and businesses can move faster to tackle the climate challenge confronting us all.

zh: 这些原则以公平性、政策和目标的一致性、稳定性和可预测性、透明性、效率和性价比，以及可靠性和环境完整性为基础。
en: The principles are based on fairness; alignment of policies and objectives; stability and predictability; transparency; efficiency and cost-effectiveness; and reliability and environmental integrity.

zh: 为了帮助实现我们的气候目标，我们需要在巴黎气候变化前后促进关于必要政策措施的对话。
en: To help achieve our climate objectives, we need to promote dialogue about the necessary policy measures before and beyond the climate-change conference in Paris.

zh: 因此，我们成立了一个“碳定价委员会 ” ， 委员会将由各国首脑、城市和州省领导人以及来自顶尖公司的代表组成，敦促世界各国和企业为碳制定一个价格。
en: That is why we are announcing a “Carbon Pricing Panel,” which will bring together heads of state, city and state leaders, and representatives of top companies to urge countries and businesses around the world to put a price on carbon.

zh: 这些领导人已开始采取行动为所在国家和地区的碳污染定价和推动更加绿色的投资。
en: These leaders have taken steps to price carbon pollution and catalyze greener investment in their own countries and regions.

zh: 他们包括德国总理默克尔、智利总统巴切莱特、法国总统奥朗德、埃塞俄比亚总理德萨莱尼、菲律宾总统阿基诺三世、墨西哥总统涅托、加利福尼亚州长杰里·布朗（Jerry Brown）和里约热内卢市长爱德华多·佩耶斯（Eduardo Paes ） 。
en: They include German Chancellor Angela Merkel, Chilean President Michelle Bachelet, French President François Hollande, Ethiopian Prime Minister Hailemariam Desalegn, Philippines President Benigno Aquino III, Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto, Governor Jerry Brown of California, and Mayor Eduardo Paes of Rio de Janeiro.

zh: 碳定价政策已开始在大约40个国家（包括世界最大排放国中国）实施，更有23个城市、州省和地区的政府正在制定碳价格。
en: Carbon pricing policies are already being implemented by some 40 national governments, including that of China, the world’s largest emitter, and 23 cities, states, and regions that are putting a price on carbon.

zh: 其他许多政府也在改革能源价格，400多家公司报告正在采用自愿的内部碳定价。
en: Many other governments also are reforming energy prices, and more than 400 companies report using a voluntary, internal carbon price.

zh: 这些政策很有意义。
en: That makes sense.

zh: 顶尖公司必须有效管理气候风险的风险敞口，这样才能获得更高的利润和确保更稳定的收益。
en: Top companies must effectively manage exposure to climate risk in order to generate higher profits and ensure more stable earnings.

zh: 所有这些行动都是值得欢迎的；但我们认为它们只是最初的步骤。
en: All of these actions are welcome; but we view them as being only initial steps.

zh: 与碳定价委员会一起，我们呼吁各国政府抓住时机 — — 为了地球和子孙后代的命运 — — 为碳污染制定一个反映它们所造成的环境伤害的价格。
en: Together with the leaders of the Carbon Pricing Panel, we call on governments to seize the moment – for the sake of the planet and future generations – to put a price on carbon pollution that reflects the environmental damage it causes.

zh: 我们已经做好准备支持政府行动。
en: We stand ready to support governments that act.

zh: 我们等待得越久，我们 — — 以及我们的子辈和孙辈 — — 保护地球的成本和困难就越大。
en: The longer we wait, the costlier and more difficult it will be for us – and our children and grandchildren – to protect the planet.

zh: 病人照护和药物的道德贫困
en: Care-Giving and the Moral Impoverishment of Medicine

zh: 剑桥－对病人照护，经济学家认为是一种“负担 ” ， 临床心理学家认为是一个“因应过程 ” ， 医疗卫生服务研究人员认为是一种医疗成本，而医生认为是一种临床能力。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Care-giving is understood by economists as a “burden,” by clinical psychologists as a “coping process,” by health-services researchers in terms of health-care costs, and by physicians as a matter of clinical competency.

zh: 然而，对许多人来说，病人照护是道德体验的一个基本要素。
en: But, for many people, care-giving is a foundational component of moral experience.

zh: 它是一种承认、移情想象、见证、责任、团结和最具体的帮助行为。
en: It is a practice of acknowledgement, empathic imagination, witnessing, responsibility, solidarity, and the most concrete forms of assistance.

zh: 正是病人照护的这些道德方面，让照护人，有时候甚至是接受照护的人，感受到了更多的“存在 ” — —并因而成为更完整的人。
en: It is this moral aspect that makes care-givers, and at times even care-receivers, feel more “present” – and thus more fully human.

zh: 但是，除了熟练的护理之外，职业治疗和理疗师进行的康复活动，社会工作者的实际帮助以及家庭健康护理和照护，特别是对健康严重受损和处于疾病晚期的病人的健康护理和照护，与当代的医学实践几乎没有什么关系。
en: But, aside from skilled nursing, rehabilitation efforts by occupational and physical therapists, and the practical assistance of social workers and home health aides, care-giving, especially for victims of health catastrophes and end-stage conditions, has relatively little to do with the contemporary practice of medicine.

zh: 为了阐明上述观点，我用我自己照护妻子的个人经历来加以说明 — — 我妻子罹患严重的神经退变性疾病，这种疾病损害了她的记忆力和运动机能，使她独立生活的能力受到了影响。
en: To illustrate this point, I draw on my personal experience as the care-giver for my wife, who suffers from a severe neurodegenerative disorder that has impaired her memory and motor functions, restricting her independence.

zh: 每天早晨，我将妻子叫醒，帮助她上厕所，洗澡，穿衣服，准备我们的早餐并帮她进餐。
en: I wake her up in the morning, assist her in toileting, bathing, and dressing, make us breakfast, and help her feed herself.

zh: 我扶着她走路，将她抱到椅子里，并放进我们的车里。
en: I assist her in walking, placing her in a chair, and getting into our car.

zh: 我几乎一直和她在一起，以免她伤害自己，因为不管是在街上还是在我们家里，她都是既看不见东西也不能安全地行动。
en: I am with her nearly all the time to protect her from injuring herself, because she can neither see nor navigate safely on the street or in our own home.

zh: 看着四十多年的伴侣 — — 一个曾经优雅、知性活泼并且非常独立的人 — — 病情恶化，是令人困扰的。
en: It is disturbing to witness the deterioration of a once elegant, intellectually lively, and highly independent companion of more than four decades.

zh: 但是，由于我们的努力和长期一起的共同生活，最重要的是，由于家人和好友的支持，我们从沮丧、愤怒到悲伤的情绪反应得到了缓解和升华。
en: But our emotional reactions, from frustration and anger to sadness, have been cushioned and sublimated by our work, the long rhythm of our days together, and, above all, by the support of family and close friends.

zh: 家人和朋友对我们的这种关心和责任，和我前面列出的日常行为一样，是对我妻子的照护的一个重要组成部分，也是对我们努力的道德上的支持。
en: That concern and responsibility for us is as much a part of care-giving as all the mundane practices I have listed, and amounts to moral solidarity with our struggle.

zh: 我举出这个个人例子，是因为这是我能用来说明病人照护包含什么以及它对每个人的生活 — — 更通常地说，对人的境况 — — 如此重要的原因的最好途径。
en: I give you this personal sketch because it is the best I can do to illustrate what care-giving entails, and why it is so crucial to everyone’s life – and to the human condition more generally.

zh: 正如我们的情况所表明的那样，病人照护包括，在希望和安慰都被放弃，神正论也结束了的时候，人们要做的事情就是和饱受疾病煎熬的人在一起，在他们身边 — — 通常是安静地陪在他们身边 — — 分担他或她的痛苦。
en: Care-giving, as illustrated by our case, includes what happens when hope and consolation are abandoned, when theodicy ends, and when all there is to do is to be present with the sufferer, sharing his or her suffering by simply – and usually silently – being there.

zh: 但是，在医学院，基础学科和临床实习阶段的课程最关注的都是对疾病的生物学过程和高科技治疗手段的理解。
en: In medical schools, however, the curriculum in both the basic science and clinical apprenticeship years places the greatest emphasis on understanding the biology of disease processes and high-technology treatments.

zh: 在医学院的学生从教室走向病房和临床的过程中，医学院教学对疾病体验的关注也越来越少。
en: The illness experience gets less and less pedagogic attention as the student progresses from classroom to inpatient ward and clinic.

zh: 在更广泛的医疗保健体系内，医学院的学生们会很容易地认为，药物在很大程度上将病人照护的实际工作和情感工作留给了护士、社会工作者、病人以及病人的支持网络。
en: In the broader system of healthcare, students can readily discern that medicine largely leaves the practical and emotional tasks of care-giving to nurses, social workers, and the patient and his or her network of support.

zh: 医疗服务的提供结构和资金投入，使专业人员远离了病人照护的艺术，并在实际上削弱了医生的治疗。
en: The structure of service delivery and the funding of health services work to discourage professionals from the art of care-giving, and can, in fact, undermine the practitioner’s efforts.

zh: 其结果就是医学实践的道德贫困。
en: The result is moral impoverishment of the practice of medicine.

zh: 对医学人类学家来说，任何地方的人都生活在当地（即社交网络、家人、机构以及社区）的人际互动之中。
en: For medical anthropologists, people everywhere live in the flow of interpersonal interactions in local worlds – social networks, families, institutions, and communities.

zh: 也就是说，被认为是人们相互间的语言、行动以及情感流动的体验，不仅是本地的，而且具有内在的道德性，因为我们的生活就是有关赋予价值和表现价值的。
en: That is to say, experience, viewed as the flow of words, movements, and emotions between us, is not only local, but also inherently moral, because living our lives is about animating and enacting values.

zh: 对面临严重健康问题和严重慢性疾病治疗过程的病人和家庭来说，遭受疾病折磨的经历不只是一个个人体验，还是一种会受到形成道德生活过程中的文化和历史变化极大影响的体验，而道德生活在不同时代和社会是不同的。
en: For patients and families faced with health catastrophes and serious chronic medical conditions, the experience of suffering is not just a personal one, but is strongly influenced by cultural and historical changes in the processes that contribute to moral life being distinctive in different eras and societies.

zh: 面对痛苦、畸形、机能丧失以及严重残疾的威胁，个人和家庭通过用伦理、宗教和美学活动来重塑意义、情感和价值，��而在本地的道德世界里重新定义痛苦的体验。
en: Faced with a threat of pain, disfigurement, loss of function, and serious disability, individuals and families reframe the experience of suffering within their local moral world by remaking meanings, emotions, and values via ethical, religious, and aesthetic activities.

zh: 在利用个人和文化资源（包括想象力、责任感、感受力、洞察力以及交流）来完成病人照护方面，医生和外行没有什么不同。
en: Doctors are no different from laypersons in drawing on personal and cultural resources –involving imagination, responsibility, sensibility, insight, and communication – to accomplish their care-giving.

zh: 而且，他们从事的是一个综合了伦理、美学、宗教和实际行动的行为。
en: And what they engage in is an amalgam of ethical, aesthetic, religious, and practical action.

zh: 医生的技巧 — — 这种技巧现在受到了官僚主义、政治和经济力量的极大限制，开始了这些固有的人类资源的专业化过程，并对在医生自身的道德生活上的一般使用产生影响。
en: The physician’s art – now so circumscribed by bureaucratic, political, and economic forces – turns on both the professionalization of these inherently human resources and the impact of their routine use on the doctor’s own moral life.

zh: 显然，为了为病人照护的职业生涯做准备，医学院的学生和年青的医生需要除了科学和技术训练之外的东西。
en: To prepare for a career of care-giving, medical students and young doctors clearly require something besides scientific and technological training.

zh: 事实上，我们甚至可以认为，当前的医学职业教育在使医生成为技术专家的同时，也使他们失去了成为病人照护者的能力。
en: Indeed, current professional education can even be seen as enabling the physician as a technical expert, while disabling him or her as a care-giver.

zh: 要克服这种趋势，我们必须将把人文科学纳入医学训练作为重新点燃和强化想象力和信念这样的人类体验的途径；这些人类体验对病人照护和抵制导致医生技术失败的情感反应和价值官僚化，至关重要。
en: To overcome this trend, we must incorporate the humanities into medical training as a means of rekindling and deepening those human experiences of imagination and commitment that are essential for care-giving, and resisting the bureaucratization of values and emotional responses that causes failure in the physician’s art.

zh: 实质上，医生必须逐渐认识到，病人照护的艺术和疾病的诊断和治疗科学技术一样重要。
en: In essence, the practitioner must come to feel that the art of care-giving is as much at stake as the science and technology of diagnosis and treatment.

zh: 我认为，现在我们要做的就是对当代生物医学文化进行改革。
en: In my view, what is needed is reform of the very culture of contemporary biomedicine.

zh: 我们必须对医学院的学生和医生进行训练：训练他们对是什么限制了他们的病人照护进行批判性的反思；训练他们为病人照护的道德行为打开空间的策略和技巧；训练他们最具体和实际的帮助行为，以使他们永远不会忘记病人照护的实际意义。
en: We must train students and practitioners in critical self-reflection on that which limits their care-giving; in strategies and techniques aimed at opening a space for the moral acts of care-giving; and in the most concrete and practical acts of assistance, so that they never forget what care-giving actually means.

zh: 就业中的创造性破坏
en: Creative Destruction at Work

zh: 牛津—纵观历史，技术进步创造了无穷财富，但也导致了巨大破坏。
en: OXFORD – Throughout history, technological progress has created enormous wealth but also caused great disruption.

zh: 比如，美国钢铁业在20世纪60年代经历了重大转型，当时，大型综合性钢铁厂逐渐被小型钢铁厂挤出，摧毁了宾夕法尼亚州的匹兹堡市和俄亥俄州的杨斯顿（Youngstown）市等老牌经济重镇。
en: The United States’ steel industry, for example, underwent a major transformation in the 1960s, when large, integrated steel mills were gradually put out of business by mini mills, destroying the existing economic base of cities like Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and Youngstown, Ohio.

zh: 但是，小钢铁厂极大地增进了生产率，在其他地区创造出新的就业方式。
en: The mini mills, however, vastly increased productivity, and created new types of work elsewhere.

zh: 美国钢铁业的故事是关于经济学家约瑟夫·熊彼特（Joseph Schumpeter）所谓的“创造性破坏 ” （ “creative destruction ” ） 的重要例子。 长期经济增长并不仅仅是现有工厂产出增加，也意味着就业结构的调整。
en: The story of US steel illustrates an important lesson about what the economist Joseph Schumpeter called “creative destruction”: Long-run economic growth involves more than just increasing output in existing factories; it is also implies structural changes in employment.

zh: 我们可以在最近的信息和通信技术革命中看到类似的现象。 信息和通信技术革命影响了现代工作岗位的方方面面，即使是那些与计算机编程或软件工程没有直接关系的岗位。
en: We can observe a similar phenomenon in the current information and communications technology (ICT) revolution, which has affected most areas of the modern workplace, even those not directly associated with computer programming or software engineering.

zh: 计算机技术创造了繁荣的新企业（甚至企业集群 ） ， 同时也让某些制造业工人成为冗余，让老牌制造业城市衰落。
en: Computer technologies have created prosperous new businesses (even business clusters) while making certain manufacturing workers redundant and sending older manufacturing cities into decline.

zh: 但底特律、里尔和例子等城市之所以衰落，并不是因为制造业产出下降；相反，在过去十年中，这些城市的制造业产出在增加。
en: But the likes of Detroit, Lille, or Leeds have not suffered because of falling manufacturing output; on the contrary, output has been growing in these cities over the past decade.

zh: 它们的衰落的直接原因是没能吸引不同类型的就业岗位。
en: Instead, their decline stems directly from their failure to attract different types of jobs.

zh: 在很大程度上说，这是政策的失败。
en: To a large extent, this is a failure of policy.

zh: 官员不应该试图以振兴旧产业捍卫过去，而应该专注于管理好向新工作形式的转变。
en: Rather than trying to preserve the past by propping up old industries, officials should focus on managing the transition to new forms of work.

zh: 这需要更好地理解新兴技术以及它们如何与被取代的技术之间的区别。
en: This requires a better understanding of emerging technologies, and how they differ from those that they are supplanting.

zh: 工业革命早期的生产技术的一个重要特征是它们取代了相对技能较高的工匠，这反过来增加了对技能较低的工厂工人的需求。
en: An important feature of the Industrial Revolution’s early manufacturing technologies was that they replaced relatively skilled artisans, which in turn increased demand for unskilled factory workers.

zh: 类似地，亨利·福特的汽车制造流水线（1913年上线）就是专门为技能较低工人运行机械而设计的，这使得福特公司生产出大受欢迎的T型车，这也是美国中产阶级能够负担得起的第一款轿车。
en: Similarly, Henry Ford’s assembly line for manufacturing cars – introduced in 1913 – was specifically designed for unskilled workers to operate machinery, thereby allowing the company to produce its popular Model T – the first car that middle-class Americans could afford.

zh: 事实上，过去一百年来，工业发展的历史大多可以归结为教育程度不断提高的劳动力与降低他们的技能要求的新技术之间的竞争。
en: Indeed, much of the story of industrial development over the last century can be seen in terms of competition between an increasingly educated workforce and new technology that would dispense with their skills.

zh: 我们已经可以看到机器人带来的影响 — — 不仅局限于汽车业 — — 机器人能够胜任曾经需要数千中等收入流水线工人来完成的工作。
en: We have already seen the impact – not least in the car industry – of robots that can carry out the routine jobs that were once performed by thousands of middle-income assembly-line workers.

zh: 未来还将出现更大规模的劳动力替代。
en: Even greater workplace disruption lies ahead.

zh: 尽管历史教育我们对于预测技术进步会如何演进需要慎之又慎，但我们已经可以合理地推断计算机可以在不就得将来做什么，因为这些技术已在开发中。
en: Though history counsels caution in predicting how technological progress will play out, we already have a reasonable idea of what computers will be able to do in the near future, because the technologies are already being developed.

zh: 比如，我们知道，许多高技能岗位可以在“大数据”和先进算法的帮助下得到简化。
en: We know, for example, that a wide range of skilled professions can be simplified with the help of “big data” and sophisticated algorithms.

zh: 关于这方面的进展，一个被广泛引用的例子是Symantec Clearwell公司的eDiscovery平台，该平台用语言分析识别文档的主旨概念，据称可以在两天内分析570,000份文档。
en: One frequently cited example of this process is the Symantec Clearwell eDiscovery platform, which uses language analysis to identify general concepts in documents, and boasts of analyzing and sorting more than 570,000 documents in just two days.

zh: Clearwell用计算机来协助进行庭前研究和其他通常由律师帮办处理的任务，甚至协助进行由合同或专利律师处理的任务 — — 它正在改变法律业。
en: Clearwell is transforming the legal profession by using computers to assist in pre-trial research and perform tasks normally undertaken by paralegals – and even by contract or patent lawyers.

zh: 同样地，先进的传感技术意味着许多交通和物流岗位很快就能完全自动化。
en: In the same way, improved sensory technology means that many transportation and logistics jobs will soon be fully automated.

zh: 谷歌的自动驾驶汽车让巴士和的士司机成为多余已不再是遥远的想象。
en: And it is not far-fetched to imagine the likes of Google’s self-driving cars making bus and taxi drivers redundant one day.

zh: 甚至到目前为止仍相当安全的低技能服务岗位也可能无法逃脱自动化的命运。
en: Even hitherto secure, low-skilled service occupations may not escape automation.

zh: 比如，个人和家用服务机器人的需求正在以每年20%的速度增长。
en: Demand for personal and household service robots, for example, is already growing by about 20% annually.

zh: 劳动力市场可能将再次进入技术干扰和工资不平等性加剧的新时代。
en: Labor markets may once again be entering a new era of technological turbulence and widening wage inequality.

zh: 这凸显出一个更大的问题：哪里去创造新类型的工作？
en: And this highlights a larger question: Where will new types of work be created?

zh: 一些迹象指明了未来的方向。
en: There are already signs of what the future holds.

zh: 技术进步正在创造大数据架构师和分析师、云处理专家、软件开发人员和数字营销专家的需求 — — 这些岗位在五年前还几乎不存在。
en: Technological progress is generating demand for big data architects and analysts, cloud services specialists, software developers, and digital marketing professionals – occupations that barely existed just five years ago.

zh: 芬兰提供了一个很好的例子说明城市和国家应该适应这些发展趋势。
en: Finland offers valuable lessons in how cities and countries should adapt to these developments.

zh: 芬兰经济曾经因为其最大公司诺基亚没有顺应智能手机技术趋势而遭遇打击。
en: Its economy initially suffered from the failure of its biggest company, Nokia, to adapt to smartphone technologies.

zh: 但此后，芬兰创业企业中衍生出新的智能手机平台公司。
en: Yet several Finnish start-ups have since built new enterprises on smartphone platforms.

zh: 事实上，到2011年，前诺基亚员工创建了220家类似企业，打造出狂卖1,200万份的智能手机游戏“愤怒的小鸟”的Rovio公司就有大量前诺基亚员工。
en: Indeed, by 2011, former Nokia staff had created 220 such businesses, and Rovio, which has sold more than 12 million copies of its smartphone-based video game, “Angry Birds,” is crowded with former Nokia employees.

zh: 这一转变并非巧合。
en: This transformation is no coincidence.

zh: 芬兰对教育的集中投资创造出韧性十足的劳动力。
en: Finland’s intensive investment in education has created a resilient labor force.

zh: 芬兰通过投资于不受特定企业或行业局限、不受计算机化趋势影响的可转移技能，为如何适应技术升级提供了一份蓝图。
en: By investing in transferable skills that are not limited to specific businesses or industries, or susceptible to computerization, Finland has provided a blueprint for how to adapt to technological upheaval.

zh: 尽管大数据驱动技术在不断扩散，但研究表明，劳动力将继续在社会知识和创新方面存在比较优势。
en: Despite the diffusion of big-data-driven technologies, research suggests that labor will continue to have a comparative advantage in social intelligence and creativity.

zh: 因此，政府发展战略应该集中于强化这些技能，以使劳动力与计算机技术形成互补而不是竞争的关系。
en: Government development strategies should therefore focus on enhancing these skills, so that they complement, rather than compete with, computer technologies.

zh: 乌克兰的欧洲危机
en: Europe’s Crisis in Ukraine

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 我们无法预测乌克兰爆发的深刻危机将以何种方式结束。
en: STOCKHOLM – How Ukraine’s profound crisis will end is impossible to predict.

zh: 欧盟和美国正竭尽全力确保和平过渡到更稳定的民主政体，以及最终能够落实迫切需要的改革。
en: We in the European Union and the United States are doing what we can to secure a peaceful transition to a more stable democracy, and the implementation, at long last, of urgently needed reforms.

zh: 亚努科维奇总统和反对派现在达成的协议应该为此创造出新的可能性。
en: And the agreement now concluded between President Viktor Yanukovych and the opposition should create a new possibility for this.

zh: 如果协议未能兑现，乌克兰很可能会继续陷入混乱和冲突，而这对任何人都没有好处。
en: If the agreement is not honored, Ukraine could well continue its descent into chaos and conflict, which would be in no one’s interest.

zh: 因此乌克兰危机和欧洲危机实际是一码事。
en: That is why Ukraine’s crisis is a European crisis.

zh: 而且，虽然我们无法预知这场危机将如何结束，我们至少应该弄清楚危机爆发的来龙去脉。
en: And, though we cannot know how the crisis will end, we should be very clear about how it started.

zh: 多年来，乌克兰积极寻求和欧盟建立密切关系。
en: For years, Ukraine sought a closer relationship with the EU.

zh: 该国领导人热切希望加入欧盟东部伙伴计划，敦促签订欧盟联合协议并设立深度全面自由贸易区。
en: Its leaders warmly endorsed the promise of enhanced ties under the EU’s Eastern Partnership, and pushed for an EU Association Agreement, together with a Deep and Comprehensive Free Trade Area.

zh: 1991年乌克兰独立后，全部14任当选总理和4任总统无一例外地批准了乌前政府谈判订立的协议。
en: When those talks, which began under the previous Ukrainian government, were concluded, the agreement was endorsed by all four presidents and all 14 prime ministers to hold office since Ukraine achieved independence in 1991.

zh: 乌克兰原定在2013年11月维尔纽斯召开的东部伙伴关系首脑会议上订立联合协议，然而就在欧盟和乌克兰解决遗留问题时，形势却突然急转直下。
en: But, as the EU and Ukraine were addressing remaining issues ahead of the November 2013 Eastern Partnership summit in Vilnius, where Ukraine was to sign its Association Agreement, something suddenly changed.

zh: 8月起，俄罗斯决策者的目标就是要迫使乌克兰放弃它自己选择的线路。
en: From August onward, Russian policymakers embraced the openly declared aim of knocking Ukraine off the course that it had chosen.

zh: 乌国内爆发了针对联合协议的政治运动，同时克里姆林宫实行针对性制裁，并威胁对本已疲软的乌克兰经济采取更严厉的措施。
en: A political campaign against the agreement was launched, and the Kremlin mixed targeted sanctions with threats of harsher measures against the already-weak Ukrainian economy.

zh: 俄领导人公开表态一旦乌克兰和欧盟签署自贸协议俄乌自贸协议将自行废止，并将对乌克兰输俄的所有商品和服务征收高额关税。
en: Russian leaders publicly stated that if Ukraine signed a free-trade agreement with the EU, it would lose its free-trade deal with Russia, and high tariffs would be imposed on all goods and services.

zh: 形势再明显不过，沉重的经济压力将升级为公开的经济战。
en: Severe economic pressure, it was made clear, would become open economic warfare.

zh: 乌克兰总统亚努科维奇选择了让步。
en: Ukrainian President Viktor Yanukovych gave way.

zh: 在向欧盟领导人解释无法签署联合协议的原因时，他明确表示自己如此决策是迫于俄国的压力。
en: In explaining to EU leaders that he was not ready to sign the Association Agreement, he was very clear that Russian pressure was responsible for his decision.

zh: 上述事态现在引发了基辅街头的屠杀死亡事件。
en: This set in motion the chain of events that has now resulted in carnage and death in the streets of Kyiv.

zh: 许多乌克兰人认为欧洲象征着美好生活的希望；但突然间他们发现遭到了不可救药的腐败政治精英的背叛。
en: For many Ukrainians, Europe was the symbol of hope of a better life; suddenly, they felt betrayed by a political elite that they had long perceived as being incorrigibly corrupt.

zh: 因此我们必须清楚，克里姆林宫的压力和亚努科维奇政府的动摇共同构成了当前这场危机的根源。
en: So, to be clear, it was the Kremlin’s pressure, and the Yanukovych administration’s vacillation, that produced the current crisis.

zh: 如果亚努科维奇决定顶住俄国的压力，乌克兰无疑将面临严重的困难。
en: Had Yanukovych decided to stand up to Russian pressure, there is no doubt that Ukraine would have faced difficulties.

zh: 但拥有欧盟联合协议及国际货币基金组织可能提供的雄厚的资金和改革援助，俄罗斯措施的效力持续不了多长时间。
en: But, with an EU Association Agreement and the possibility of solid financial aid and reform assistance from the International Monetary Fund, the Russian measures would not have been sustainable.

zh: 当然，欧盟将要求乌克兰进行艰难的改革，但乌克兰的改革也不会比其他加入欧盟阵营的前共产主义国家更加困难。
en: Of course, the reforms asked of Ukraine would have been difficult, but no more difficult than what had been asked of other ex-communist countries that saw their future in and with Europe.

zh: 隧道尽头将闪烁着希望的曙光，而且随着改革进程的深入，乌克兰将可能作为坚定民主的欧洲国家出现在世人面前。
en: There would have been light at the end of the tunnel, and, as Ukraine embraced the reform process, it would have been seen as a determined and democratic European country.

zh: 相反，亚努科维奇选择了以一己政治生���为核心的短期策略 — — 这越来越被抗议者视为玩弄、欺骗和背叛。
en: Instead, Yanukovych opted for a short-term strategy narrowly focused on his own political survival – a strategy that the protesters increasingly came to view as a game of deceit and betrayal.

zh: 随着现政权开始暴力镇压对手，暴力反对团体正变得越来越可信。
en: As the regime started to use violence to repress its opponents, violent opposition groups gained credibility.

zh: 与俄罗斯和欧盟双方实现自由贸易显然有利于乌克兰经济，而且尽管存在经常被提到的欧盟商品通过乌克兰流入俄罗斯的虚假说法，俄乌自贸协定同样能够利好俄罗斯经济。
en: Free trade with both Russia and the EU would obviously have been good for Ukraine’s economy, thus providing a boost to the Russian economy as well, notwithstanding the oft-used but fundamentally bogus argument that EU goods would flow into Russia via Ukraine.

zh: （有没有人听美国人抱怨过墨西哥和欧盟的自贸协定破坏了美国经济？ ）
en: (Has anyone heard Americans complaining that the free-trade agreement between Mexico and the EU is undermining the US economy?)

zh: 俄国一心想以其所谓欧亚联盟的形式建设新的战略堡垒，并且似乎下定决心迫使乌克兰就范。
en: Russia is intent on building a new strategic bastion in the form of its proposed Eurasia Union, and it seems determined to force Ukraine to join.

zh: 虽然在公开场合抱怨欧盟对乌克兰施压，但现实是俄国残酷要挟乌克兰放弃其既定的欧盟路线。
en: While publicly grumbling about supposed EU pressure on Ukraine, the reality is that Russia brutally extorted the country into abandoning its EU course.

zh: 事实证明这才是这场危机的根源。
en: That is the source of this crisis; the facts speak for themselves.

zh: 即使出现最好情况，乌克兰走回头路也难上加难。
en: Even under the best of circumstances, the road back for Ukraine will be difficult.

zh: 俄罗斯的压力和破坏作用，以及由此所导致的危机已经在乌克兰社会造成了新的裂缝，并进一步给该国脆弱的经济造成损害。
en: Russian pressure and destabilization, and the crisis to which they have led, have created new fissures in Ukraine’s society and have caused further damage to its fragile economy.

zh: 就连俄国也总有一天会身受其害。
en: And that damage could, one day, spill over into Russia.

zh: 像其他国家一样与欧盟建立密切关系的稳定而积极改革的邻国同样应该符合克里姆林宫的利益。
en: The Kremlin should have an interest in a stable and reforming neighbor that, like other countries, is also seeking a close relationship with the EU.

zh: 评级革命
en: The Ratings Revolution

zh: 美国剑桥 — “ 您好，先生，有什么要帮忙的吗？ ”在巴黎饭店，迎宾奉承地问我。
en: CAMBRIDGE – “Bonjour Monsieur, comment pourrais-je vous aider?” asks the obsequious concierge at my Paris hotel.

zh: 我立刻开始奇怪这座城市臭名昭著的傲慢到底发生了什么，特别是对美国游客。
en: I immediately wonder what happened to the city’s infamous haughtiness – especially toward American tourists.

zh: 如果说法国首都不再是欧洲最粗鲁的城市，那么我们或许得感谢TripAdvisor等在线评级工具的增长。
en: If the French capital is no longer Europe’s rudest city, we can perhaps thank the growth of online rating tools, such as TripAdvisor.

zh: 旅行网站大约从20世纪90年代就开始出现，Expedia、Travelocity和其他假日预定网站就兴趣于那时候，旅行者轻点鼠标就能比较航班和饭店价格。
en: Travel Web sites have been around since the 1990s, when Expedia, Travelocity, and other holiday booking sites were launched, allowing travelers to compare flight and hotel prices with the click of a mouse.

zh: 信息不再掌握在旅行社手中或藏身于商务网络，旅游业因此迎来了革命，透明度的增加刺激了价格的下降。
en: With information no longer controlled by travel agents or hidden in business networks, the travel industry was revolutionized, as greater transparency helped slash prices.

zh: 如今，旅游业有受到一场新革命的洗礼 — — 这一回面貌焕然一新的服务质量。
en: Today, the industry is in the throes of a new revolution – this time transforming service quality.

zh: 在线评级平台 — — 有的专注于饭店（TripAdvisor ） ， 有的专注于餐馆（Zagat ） ， 有的专注于公寓（Airbnb ） ， 也有的专注于出租车（Uber ） — —让旅行者能够交换评价和体验，供所有人参考。
en: Online rating platforms – specializing in hotels (TripAdvisor), restaurants (Zagat), apartments (Airbnb), and taxis (Uber) – allow travelers to exchange reviews and experiences for all to see.

zh: 如今，饭店企业不是由业内专家排名、分析和比较的，而是由饭店服务的对象 — — 客户来做这些事。
