en: Hospitality businesses are now ranked, analyzed, and compared not by industry professionals, but by the very people for whom the service is intended – the customer.

zh: 这铸造了买卖双方的新关系。
en: This has forged a new relationship between buyer and seller.

zh: 客户永远用脚投票；他���现在可以向任何感兴趣的人解释自己的选择。
en: Customers have always voted with their feet; they can now explain their decision to anyone who is interested.

zh: 结果，企业受到了极大的监督，并且通常是以极其具体的角度，这创造了巨大的改善服务激励。
en: As a result, businesses are much more accountable, often in very specific ways, which creates powerful incentives to improve service.

zh: 尽管一些读者不在乎关于柏林饭店侍者态度倨傲或休斯顿饭店吹风机不能用之类的琐碎报告，但在线评价的真正力量不在于个别故事，而在于网站有能力产生大规模评级。
en: Although some readers might not care for gossipy reports of brusque bellboys in Berlin or malfunctioning hotel hairdryers in Houston, the true power of online reviews lies not just in the individual stories, but in the Web sites’ capacity to aggregate a large volume of ratings.

zh: 影响是巨大的。
en: The impact cannot be overstated.

zh: 吸引顶尖评级的企业可以获得卓越的增长，新客户因为优异的总体评价慕名而来，并在光临后给出更加（积极）的反馈。
en: Businesses that attract top ratings can enjoy exponential growth, as new customers are attracted by good overall reviews and subsequently provide yet more (positive) feedback.

zh: 在线评级的影响力是巨大的，许多公司目前纷纷聘请数字声誉经理以确保有利的在线名声。
en: So great is the influence of online ratings that many companies now hire digital reputation managers to ensure a favorable online identity.

zh: 这套系统并非总是有益的。
en: The system is not always virtuous.

zh: 我们知道有一些行为不端的操盘手，他们收钱撰写虚假评价帮你提升评级。
en: Nefarious operators are known to pay fake review services to bolster ratings.

zh: 客户也有可能不太地道，参与评级要挟，据TripAdvisor透露，通常的形式是“客人威胁撰写负面评价，除非你满足他的返现、升级或其他要求。 ”
en: Customers, too, can be disingenuous or worse, engage in blackmail, which occurs, as TripAdvisor explains, “when a guest threatens to write a negative review unless a demand for a refund, upgrade, or other request is met.”

zh: 幸运的是，技术正在遏制这一评级滥用现象。
en: Fortunately, technology is countering this misuse of ratings.

zh: 算法已可以通过识别同一评价者的持续积极（或消极）评论数检测虚假评价。
en: Algorithms can already detect fake reviews by identifying consistently positive (or negative) opinions from the same reviewer.

zh: 定位追踪能够确保只有真正使用了服务的客户才能给出评价（如Airbnb ） 。
en: Geolocation tracking can ensure that only customers who have actually used a service can express an opinion (as is the case with Airbnb).

zh: 事实上，恶意批评因为一个相当出乎意料的发展而受到了遏制：客户可以就服务发表观点，服务提供者也可以为客户评级，Uber就是这么做的。
en: Indeed, obstreperous critics are being challenged as a result of another, rather surprising development: while customers may express an opinion about a service, the service provider can also rate its customers, as Uber has demonstrated.

zh: 事实上，热门酒店有朝一日开始挑选客人也不是无法想象的事。
en: Indeed, it is not inconceivable that popular hotels might one day choose their guests.

zh: 消费者和生产者的传统关系也在被其他方式打破。
en: Traditional relationships between consumers and producers are breaking down in other ways, too.

zh: “共享经济”的崛起 — — 即团体内成员共享汽车、泊位、闲置卧室等资源 — — 不但创造了互惠名誉，也模糊了买家与卖家之间的界线。
en: The rise of the “sharing economy,” in which assets – such as a car, a parking space, or a spare bedroom – are shared within communities, not only generates reciprocal goodwill, but also blurs the distinction between buyer and seller.

zh: 但是并不是所有服务都可以在线评级。
en: Not every service, however, has been touched by online ratings.

zh: 评级的影响取决于典型消费者是否真的在决定前读过在线评价。
en: The impact of ratings depends on whether the typical consumer actually reads online reviews before making a decision.

zh: 对预定饭店房间来说，这样做正在日益普及，但在选择繁忙街道上的酒吧方面，这样做的人就要少得多（巴黎侍应生一直态度傲慢就证明了这一点 ） 。
en: While it is increasingly common to do so when, say, booking a hotel room, it is much less so when deciding among, say, bars on a busy street (the enduring rudeness of Parisian waiters attests to that).

zh: 但即使是依赖“外观魅力”吸引客户的服务提供商，或许也将发现好日子不多了。
en: Yet even service establishments that rely on “curb appeal” to attract customers may soon find their days numbered.

zh: “增广现实 ” — —叠加数字信息（如谷歌眼镜和其他服务所开发的 ） — —可以将日常活动转换为数字/实体的混合体验，其中的客户反馈将立刻无缝地与购物者联系起来。
en: The proliferation of “augmented reality” – an overlay of digital information (as developed by Google Glass, among others) – promises to transform everyday activities into a digital/physical hybrid experience in which customer feedback is instantly and seamlessly available to shoppers.

zh: 最后一个抵御评级者的堡垒是客户别无选择的服务，这些服务通常由垄断商或政府机构提供，比如机场。
en: The final holdout against the raters will be services for which customers have no choice, typically monopolies or government agencies, such as airports.

zh: 新加坡樟宜机场是罕有的例外：它随时都在恳请用户予以评级，通过界面活泼的可触摸笑脸图标请旅行者就从通关服务到厕所清洁程度的一切方面的效率发表意见。
en: Singapore’s Changi Airport is a rare exception: it solicits user ratings at every turn, via feedback screens with cheery, touch-enabled smiley-face emoticons that request travelers’ opinions on everything from the efficiency of immigration service to the cleanliness of toilets.

zh: 不消说，许多发达经济体在这方面已经落后，至少在目前是如此。
en: Needless to say, many developed economies lag behind, at least for now.

zh: 但写东西 — — 我的意思就是“写 ” — —必须在墙上，或至少是在屏幕上。
en: But the writing is, literally, on the wall – or at least on the screen.

zh: 事实上，如果你正在在线阅读本文并不同意我的观点，你可以在本文评论栏里解释为什么。
en: Indeed, if you are reading this online and disagree with me, you can explain why in the comments section accompanying this commentary.

zh: 超级城市的生活
en: Life in the Uber City

zh: 伦敦 — — 是的！
en: LONDON – Mais oui!

zh: 每位法国五年级小学生都知道，互联网的发明地是巴黎。
en: As every French fifth-grade student knows, the Internet was invented in Paris.

zh: 当时它名叫迷你电传(Minitel ) , 也就是法语Médium interactif par numérisation d’information téléphonique的缩写，拥有近900万台终端，个人和组织可以实时联网进行信息交换。
en: It was called Minitel, short for Médium interactif par numérisation d’information téléphonique, a network of almost nine million terminals that allowed people and organizations to connect to each other and exchange information in real time.

zh: 迷你电传曾在20世纪八九十年代蓬勃发展，孕育了各种��线应用的雏形，后来正是这些应用引领了全球.com狂潮。
en: Minitel boomed during the 1980s and 1990s, as it nurtured a variety of online apps that anticipated the global dot-com frenzy.

zh: “真正”的互联网主宰全球后迷你电传开始逐渐衰退，直到最终退出历史舞台。
en: It then fell into slow decline and was finally decommissioned after the “real” Internet rose to global dominance.

zh: 迷你电传和互联网都基于数字信息网络创建。
en: Both Minitel and the Internet were predicated on the creation of digital information networks.

zh: 但两者的实施模式却截然相反。
en: Their implementation strategies, however, differed enormously.

zh: 迷你电传采取自上而下的模式；由法国邮政及全国电信运营商负责主要的部署工作。
en: Minitel was a top-down system; a major deployment effort launched by the French postal service and the national telecommunication operator.

zh: Minitel网络运行效果良好，但僵化的体制和专用协议必然限制其增长和创新的潜能。
en: It functioned well, but its potential growth and innovation was necessarily limited by its rigid architecture and proprietary protocols.

zh: 相反，互联网采取自下而上的模式，成功地避开了电信巨头初期的监管。
en: The Internet, by contrast, evolved in a bottom-up way, managing to escape the telecommunication giants’ initial appeals for regulation.

zh: 最终演变成我们今天熟知的混乱但具有革命意义的改变世界的力量（教皇弗朗西斯不久前称之为“来自上帝的礼物 ” 。 ）
en: Ultimately, it became the chaotic but revolutionary world-changer that we know today (“a gift from God,” as Pope Francis recently put it).

zh: 今天，又一场技术革命已经迫在眉睫。
en: Today, another technological revolution is looming.

zh: 无所不在的数字网络正在侵入实体空间，由此而来的是“一切的网络 ” — — “ 智能城市”的网络命脉。
en: Pervasive digital networks are entering physical space, giving rise to the “Internet of Everything” – the networked lifeblood of the “smart city.”

zh: 五花八门的推广模式正在世界各地涌现。
en: And, once again, a broad spectrum of implementation models is emerging in different parts of the world.

zh: 智能城市空间的总体思路一直最受美国现代成功创业者的青睐。
en: In the United States, the general idea of smart urban space has been central to the current generation of successful start-ups.

zh: 最近的例子是智能手机应用程序Uber，任何人都可以用它来打车出行或载客赚钱。
en: One of the latest examples is Uber, a smartphone app that lets anyone call a cab or be a driver.

zh: 这家企业的经营状况两极分化 — — Uber一直是全世界（主要是欧洲）的抗议和罢工对象 — — 但不久前估值时却达到了惊人的180亿美元。
en: The company’s operations are polarizing – Uber has been the subject of protests and strikes around the world (mainly in Europe) – yet it was recently valued at a stratospheric $18 billion.

zh: 除Uber外，恒温控制装置Nest、公寓共享站点AirBnB和苹果刚刚发布的“家用操作系统”等若干创新发明都证明数字信息正在进入真实的生活。
en: Beyond Uber, the learning thermostat Nest, the apartment-sharing website Airbnb, and the just-announced “home operating system” by Apple, to name just a few innovations, attest to the new frontiers of digital information when it inhabits physical space.

zh: 类似的方法很可能解放城市生活从通勤、能源使用到个人健康的方方面面 — — 并得到来自风险投资基金的积极支持。
en: Similar approaches now promise to revolutionize most aspects of urban life – from commuting to energy consumption to personal health – and are receiving eager support from venture capital funds.

zh: 南美、亚洲和欧洲各级政府正迅速认识到建设“智能”城市的潜在好处，并且积极为该领域筹集大笔投资。
en: In South America, Asia, and Europe, all levels of government are quickly identifying the potential benefits of building “smart” cities, and are working to unlock significant investment in that area.

zh: 里约热内卢正在建设“智能操作”中心；新加坡即将启动雄心勃勃的“智能国家”计划；阿姆斯特丹最近投资6000万欧元（合8100万美元）建设新的城市创新中心阿姆斯特丹城市解决方案。
en: Rio de Janeiro is building capacity at its “Smart Operations” center; Singapore is about to embark in an ambitious “Smart Nation” effort; and Amsterdam recently channeled €60 million ($81 million) into a new urban innovation center called Amsterdam Metropolitan Solutions.

zh: 欧盟的2020展望计划已经为2014到2016年拨付了150亿美元的投资 — — 尤其在这样一个财政紧张的时刻，依然为智能城市理念预留了大量的资源。
en: The European Union’s Horizon 2020 program has earmarked €15 billion in 2014-2016 – a significant commitment of resources to the idea of smart cities, especially at a time of severe fiscal constraints.

zh: 但上述资金如何运用才最有效？
en: But how can such funding be used most effectively?

zh: 事实上，大笔公共拨款是不是刺激智能城市的正确途径？
en: Indeed, is allocating huge sums of public money even the right way to stimulate the emergence of smart cities?

zh: 政府当然在支持学术研究和在风险投资不感兴趣的领域促进应用等方面扮演着重要的角色 — — 比方说城市垃圾或自来水服务领域，虽然单调乏味但却至关重要。
en: Government certainly has an important role to play in supporting academic research and promoting applications in fields that might be less appealing to venture capital – unglamorous but crucial domains, such as municipal waste or water services.

zh: 公共部门也可以促进这些项目采用开放的平台和标准，从而推动其在全球城市的应用（巴塞罗那的“城市协议”计划在这方面迈出了重要的一步 ） 。
en: The public sector can also promote the use of open platforms and standards in such projects, which would speed up adoption in cities worldwide (Barcelona’s “city protocol” initiative is a step in this direction).

zh: 但最重要的是，各国政府要向美国学习，投资开发出面向智能城市的自下而上的创新生态系统。
en: But, most important, governments should use their funds to develop a bottom-up innovation ecosystem geared toward smart cities, similar to the one that is growing in the US.

zh: 决策者必须超越传统的孵化器思维，创造并培育出能让创新遍地开花的监管架构。
en: Policymakers must go beyond supporting traditional incubators by producing and nurturing the regulatory frameworks that allow innovations to thrive.

zh: 鉴于不断困扰Uber及Airbnb的法律障碍，这种支持迫切为创新企业所需要。
en: Considering the legal hurdles that continuously plague applications like Uber or Airbnb, this level of support is sorely needed.

zh: 与此同时，政府应避免扮演决定性和自上而下的角色。
en: At the same time, governments should steer away from the temptation to play a more deterministic and top-down role.

zh: 未来智能城市方案是什么样子不应由他们决定 — — 更不能动用公共资本巩固该领域技术跨国企业的地位。
en: It is not their prerogative to decide what the next smart-city solution should be – or, worse, to use their citizens’ money to bolster the position of the technology multinationals that are now marketing themselves in this field.

zh: 这些企业所提供的专有、乏味的现成产品需要不惜一切代价加以避免 — — 以免我们一觉醒来发现自己生活的城市只有Minitel。
en: These companies’ ready-made, proprietary, and typically dull offerings represent a route that should be avoided at all costs – lest we wake up to find ourselves in Minitel City.

zh: 汽车安全之路
en: The Road to Car Safety

zh: 东京—汽车 — — 自由、地位和成功的老牌象征 — — 正站在十字路口。
en: TOKYO – The automobile – long a symbol of freedom, status, and success – is at a crossroads.

zh: 一个多世纪以来，汽车让数十亿人得以旅行得更远、更快、更高效。
en: For more than a century, cars have enabled billions of people to travel farther, faster, and more efficiently than ever before.

zh: 汽车帮助提高了世界经济大国的实力，决定了现代社会和文化轮廓。
en: They have helped power the world’s great economies and shaped our modern social and cultural landscape.

zh: 但所有这些都是有代价的：事故、拥堵、污染、难以摆脱的石油依赖，以及其他。
en: But all of this has come at a price: accidents, congestion, pollution, and an uneasy dependence on oil, among other costs.

zh: 因此，我们的挑战是增加汽车带来的好处，降低（并最终消除）汽车带来的伤害，从而让未来乘车旅行变得清洁、高效、安全且人人可行。
en: Our challenge, therefore, is to boost the benefits and reduce (and eventually eliminate) the harm done by our cars, so that the future of motor travel is clean, efficient, safe, and accessible to all.

zh: 因此若要让汽车产业依然是进步的工具，我们必须与其他产业的同道以及政府在三分方面展开精诚合作：安全、环境和价格。
en: For our industry to remain an instrument of progress, we must therefore work closely with our peers from other industries and government in three major areas: safety, the environment, and affordability.

zh: 道路安全是一个大问题。
en: Road safety is a grave concern.

zh: 每天都有3,000多人因为与汽车有关的事故身亡。
en: More than 3,000 people die in auto-related accidents every day.

zh: 低收入国家拥有全世界的一半汽车，但却占据了致死交通事故的90%以上。
en: Lower-income countries account for only half of all vehicles on the road but suffer more than 90% of the fatalities.

zh: 印度的汽车数量比法国少四倍，道路相关死亡案例却要多20倍 — — 也就是说，平均每辆车造成的事故数高80倍。
en: India has four times fewer cars than France, though it suffers 20 times more road-related deaths – that is, 80 times more accidents per car.

zh: 但安全性正在改善。
en: But safety is improving.

zh: 在欧洲，虽然汽车数量翻番，但道路死亡降低了一半。
en: In Europe, even as the number of vehicles has doubled, the number of road deaths has been halved.

zh: 一个原因是引入了防抱死制动、安全气囊和电力稳定性控制等技术。
en: One reason for this is the introduction of technologies such as anti-lock brakes, airbags, and electronic stability control.

zh: 目前正在开发阶段的技术甚至可以根除与汽车相关的死亡事故。
en: Technologies now in development could even eliminate auto-related fatalities altogether.

zh: 这一方面的一个创新是自动驾驶。
en: One such innovation is autonomous driving.

zh: 雷诺和日产目前正在合作研发互补性技术，可用于预测、侦测和防止碰撞。
en: Renault and Nissan are currently working on complementary technologies that can predict, detect, and prevent collisions.

zh: 通过减少在交通拥堵和不熟悉地段驾驶带来的压力，这一技术能更好地保护司机和行人。
en: By reducing the stresses of driving in heavy traffic and unfamiliar locations, this technology promises greater protection for both drivers and pedestrians.

zh: 这对于行动不便的人来说价值更大，如老年或残疾司机。
en: It is especially valuable to people with restricted mobility, such as elderly or disabled drivers.

zh: 但这类技术突破不能简单地发明和使用，它们需要政府的支持 — — 如规定它们的使用范围的一致的法律和规则。
en: But such breakthrough technologies are not simply invented and then implemented – they need government support in the form of a coherent set of laws and regulations covering their use.

zh: 因此，要想在我们的有生之年实现道路“零致死”的目标，决策者必须在研发的早期阶段就参与进来。
en: Policymakers must therefore be involved at an early development stage if we are to reach the goal of “zero fatality” roads within our lifetimes.

zh: 汽车业还能为环境做出重要贡献。
en: The auto industry can also make a vital contribution to the environment.

zh: 十五年前，雷诺-日产联合公司（Renault-Nissan Alliance）便在全生命周期的基础上评估了旗下汽车的环境影响。
en: Fifteen years ago, the Renault-Nissan Alliance evaluated the environmental impact of its vehicles over their life cycle.

zh: 这项研究考察了我们的原材料使用的影响、汽车尾气对公共健康的影响（特别是在拥堵的城市地区）以及对总体温室气体排放的影响 — — 全世界有23%的温室气体来自汽车业。
en: The study examined the effect of our raw-material usage; the impact of car exhaust on public health, especially in congested urban areas; and the contribution to overall greenhouse-gas emissions – 23% of which come from the auto industry worldwide.

zh: 这份评估带来的结果是雷诺-日产投资了40多亿欧元用于零排放技术。
en: As a result of that evaluation, the Alliance invested more than €4 billion ($5.5 billion) in zero-emission technologies.

zh: 如今，我们是唯一一家大规模生产全系列零排放汽车和轻型商务车的汽车集团。
en: Today, ours is the only auto group that mass-produces a full line of zero-emission cars and light commercial vehicles.

zh: 雷诺和日产加起来在全球售出了10万多部此类汽车 — — 比其他所有主要汽车生产商的总和还要多。
en: Renault and Nissan together have sold more than 100,000 such vehicles worldwide – more than all of the other major carmakers combined.

zh: 更大的任务是让这些汽车融入效率更高、更清洁的电网 — — 比如用水电代替老旧的火电厂。
en: The broader task is to integrate these vehicles into a more efficient and cleaner power grid – for example, by replacing aging coal-fired power plants with hydroelectric power.

zh: 此外，地方和国家政府应该与汽车业合作，让零排放汽车融入国家交通基础设施。
en: Moreover, local and national governments should work with the automobile industry to integrate zero-emission vehicles into national transport infrastructure.

zh: 如果实现了这一点，我们相信汽车有望在可预见的未来实现对环境的零影响。
en: If this is achieved, we believe it will be possible for cars to have zero impact on the environment in the foreseeable future.

zh: 但是，更好的健康性和安全性不能（也不必）要以牺牲发展中国家为代价。 发展中国家的人民也希望享受到发达国家人民享受已久的繁荣果实。
en: Greater health and safety, however, should not (and need not) come at the expense of developing countries, whose citizens want the fruits of prosperity that developed countries’ citizens have long enjoyed.

zh: 1999年，巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国只占全球汽车销量的8 % ； 到2012年，这四个国家总销量已经达到了全球总量的35 % 。
en: In 1999, Brazil, Russia, India, and China accounted for a mere 8% of vehicle sales worldwide; by 2012, their combined sales had reached a staggering 35% of the global total.

zh: 并且这一比例肯定还将进一步上升。
en: And this proportion is sure to rise.

zh: 如此卓越的增长的一个原因是汽车生产商为注重成本的新兴中产阶级开发了更廉价的汽车。
en: One reason for this extraordinary growth is that carmakers have developed more affordable cars for a new, cost-conscious middle class.

zh: 在印度设计和制造的雷诺-日产的CMF-A平台将为在所有发展中国家推广廉价汽车扫清障碍。
en: The Alliance’s CMF-A platform, created and manufactured in India, will pave the way for many more affordable vehicles throughout the developing world.

zh: 这些进步站在日益明显的通往“朴素创新”的趋势的前沿，而发达国家市场也越来越接受这一趋势。
en: These advances are at the forefront of a growing trend toward “frugal innovation” that is increasingly being adopted in developed markets, too.

zh: 汽车在过去一个世纪中对我们的政治、经济、社会和文化生活所造成的影响怎么强调都不过分。
en: It is hard to overestimate the impact that the automobile has had on our political, economic, social, and cultural life over the past century.

zh: 汽车业的全球销售额比第六大经济体的GDP还要高，并为全世界5,000多万人提供了工作岗位。
en: The industry’s global sales are greater than the GDP of all but the five largest economies, and it employs more than 50 million people worldwide.

zh: 汽车业的未来与世界经济的未来息息相关。
en: Its future is bound up with that of the world economy.

zh: 现在的挑战是发明一种新汽车，让它能够在未来几十年中依然是自由和安全的骄傲图腾。
en: The challenge now is to reinvent the car so that it remains a proud totem of freedom and safety in the decades ahead.

zh: 反对气候绝望
en: The Case Against Climate Despair

zh: 斯德哥尔摩—今年夏天肆虐北半球的热浪和极端天气事件让气候变化再次回到公共辩论前沿。
en: STOCKHOLM – Heat waves and extreme-weather events across the Northern Hemisphere this summer have brought climate change back to the forefront of public debate.

zh: 早前的分析强烈表明，本月登陆美国东海岸的佛罗伦萨飓风等自然灾害，因为全球气温的上升而加剧。
en: Early analyses strongly suggest that natural disasters such as Hurricane Florence – which barreled into the US East Coast this month – have been exacerbated by rising global temperatures.

zh: 尽管美国总统特朗普已经撕毁2015年巴黎气候协定，但世界其他国家对于遏制温室气体排放的决心越来越大。
en: Though US President Donald Trump has reneged on the 2015 Paris climate agreement, the rest of the world is becoming increasingly convinced of the need to limit greenhouse-gas (GHG) emissions.

zh: 上个月，一群气候科学家在《美国科学院院刊 》 （ Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences）上发表了一份报告，警告地球可能正在变成不适合人类居住的“火炉 ” 。
en: Last month, a group of climate scientists published a report in the US Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences warning that the planet could be on a path to becoming a “hothouse” that may not be habitable for humans.

zh: 地球已录得上一次冰河期以来的最高气温。
en: The Earth has already registered the highest temperatures since the last Ice Age.

zh: 但报告指出，如果全球平均气温上升到前工业化水平以上2摄氏度以上，我们正在经历的这些都算不上什么。
en: But, as the report notes, what we are experiencing today will be nothing compared to what is in store if average global temperatures surpass 2° Celsius above pre-industrial levels.

zh: 到那时，作者们写道 ， “ [全球]变暖可能会激活引爆因素，进一步提升温度并激活其他引爆因素，就像多米诺骨牌那样，让地球系统温度继续升高。
en: At that point, the authors write, “[global] warming could activate important tipping elements, raising the temperature further to activate other tipping elements in a domino-like cascade that could take the Earth System to even higher temperatures.”

zh: ”关于气候引爆点和末日情景的科学争论仍在继续。
en: The scientific debate about climactic tipping points and nightmare scenarios is ongoing.

zh: 但没人能够笃定地认为 ， 《 火炉地球》报告中所列出的风险不是真的。
en: But no one can say for certain that the risks outlined in the “Hothouse Earth” report are not real.

zh: 但还有另一个风险：类似这样的警告会导致绝望。
en: But there is another risk: that warnings such as these will lead to despair.

zh: 大量报告认为，实现巴黎协定所列出的目标难于上青天。
en: Numerous reports have already concluded that it will be exceedingly difficult to meet the targets outlined in the Paris agreement.

zh: 但就此认为已经毫无希望不但十分危险；事实上也是错误的。
en: But to conclude that the situation is hopeless is not just dangerous; it is also factually incorrect.

zh: 毕竟，当前政治和技术发展情况孕育着真正的希望。
en: After all, political and technological developments that are currently underway offer grounds for genuine hope.

zh: 在这个月的旧金山全球气候行动峰会上，人们探讨了最近几个月到几年中所出现的大量预警报告。
en: At the Global Climate Action Summit in San Francisco, California, this month, there was plenty of talk about the numerous alarming reports that have come out in recent months and years.

zh: 但真正的焦点集中在《指数气候行动路线图上 》 ， 这项重大新研究表明，在使用非化石燃料技术等方面的进展以指数而不是线性的方式推进。
en: But the real focus was on the Exponential Climate Action Roadmap, a major new study showing that progress in the use of non-fossil-fuel technologies is advancing not just linearly, but exponentially.

zh: 你也许没有意识到，但太阳能和风能电力的使用每四年就能翻一番。
en: You may not realize it, but solar- and wind-power usage is doubling every four years.

zh: 如果这一趋势持续下去，到2030年，全球至少一半发电产能可以来自这两种可再生能源。
en: If that continues, at least half of global electricity production could come just from these two forms of renewable energy by 2030.

zh: 并且没有理由认为进展不会进一步加速。
en: And there is no good reason to think that progress couldn’t accelerate further.

zh: 在过去短短几年中，太阳能技术和能源储存就经历了迅速发展。
en: Just in the past few years, there have been rapid advances in solar-energy technologies and energy storage.

zh: 全球经济和气候委员会估算，未来15年全球新基础设施投资规模将达到90 万亿美元。
en: The Global Commission on the Economy and Climate estimates that $90 trillion will be invested in new infrastructure around the world over the course of the next 15 years.

zh: 拜目前正在兴起的新技术所赐 — — 不仅包括能源方面，也包括数字技术 — — 人类将迎来进入更加可持续的碳中性栖息模式的历史性机会。
en: Owing to the new technologies that are now emerging – not just in energy but in the digital domain as well – humanity could have an historic opportunity to leapfrog into far more sustainable, carbon-neutral patterns of habitation.

zh: 此外，除了技术方面的深远进步，私人和公共部门也日益认识到所有决策都要考虑可持续性的重要性。
en: Moreover, in addition to the far-reaching advances in technology, there is also growing private- and public-sector awareness of the importance of factoring sustainability into all decisions.

zh: 新的能源、工业、建筑、城市规划、交通、农业和林业方针，有望到2030年实现温室气体排放减半。
en: New approaches to energy, industry, architecture, city planning, transportation, agriculture, and forestry have the potential to halve GHG emissions by 2030.

zh: 但这只有在决策者广泛联手采取行动的情况下才能实现。
en: But that will happen only if a broad coalition of decision-makers decides to deploy them.

zh: 幸运的是，政府和大公司开始表现出在些问题上的领导力。
en: Fortunately, governments and major corporations have begun to show leadership on these issues.

zh: 结果，占全球排放总量40%的49个国家的温室气体排放已经见顶；甚至有十个国家承诺到2050年实现碳中性。
en: As a result, GHG emissions have already peaked in 49 countries that account for 40% of global emissions; and ten countries have even committed to being carbon-neutral by 2050.

zh: 加利福尼亚州和瑞典表示将在2045年实现零净排放。
en: California and Sweden say that they will produce zero net emissions by 2045.

zh: 指数气候行动路线图表明，我们仍能够决定我们的气候未来。
en: The Exponential Climate Action Roadmap shows that we do still have a say over our climate future.

zh: 不可否认，前方充满了危险。
en: The dangers that await us cannot be denied.

zh: 如果温室气体排放和升温继续按照当前趋势发展，我们的子孙后代很有可能将必须忍受“火炉地球 ” — —假设他们能够生存下来的话。
en: If GHG emissions and rising temperatures continue on their current trajectories, we could well reach the point at which future generations will have to endure “Hothouse Earth,” assuming that they can survive at all.

zh: 但最近的科学成果固然表明了气候变化的危险，但也给出了前进方向。
en: But just as recent scientific work has underscored the dangers of climate change, so, too, has it shown the way forward.

zh: 在新技术的迅速扩散中，在产业、政府和公民社会内部对问题的日益清醒的认识中，存在着希望。
en: There is hope in the rapid diffusion of new technologies, and in the growing awareness of the problem within industry, government, and civil society.

zh: 如果我们能够确保指数技术进步，并拿出必要的政治意愿，就能处理好其后危机。
en: If we can ensure exponential technological progress and marshal the necessary political will, we can tackle the climate crisis.

zh: “稳定地球”仍然在我们的可触及范围内。
en: A “Stable Earth” is still within our reach.

zh: 驳直升机撒钱
en: The Case Against Helicopter Money

zh: 慕尼黑—欧洲央行实施扩张性货币政策已经多年，但仍没能让通胀回到其“低于但接近2 % ” 的目标水平。
en: MUNICH – Despite years of expansionary monetary policy, the European Central Bank has failed to push inflation back up to its target of “below but close to 2%.”

zh: 最新措施 — — 对欧洲央行主要再融资操作实施零利率、月度资产购买量从600亿欧元增加到800亿欧元，以及进一步将存款利率下调到-0.4 % — —也无法改变局面。
en: The latest measures – a zero interest rate on the ECB’s main refinancing operations, an increase in monthly asset purchases from €60 billion ($67 billion) to €80 billion, and an even lower deposit rate of -0.40% – are unlikely to change this.

zh: 因此，一些经济学家正在敦促欧洲央行更进一步，采取所谓的“直升机撒钱 ” — —即通过印钞来为私人消费融资。
en: That is why some economists are urging the ECB to go even further, with so-called “helicopter drops” – that is, financing private consumption by printing money.

zh: 直升机撒钱的思想可以追溯到20世纪60年代的货币主义争论。
en: The idea of helicopter money dates back to the monetarism debates of the 1960s.

zh: 该思想认为，央行永远不会计穷于刺激总需求和抬高通胀，只要它愿意采取极端措施。
en: A central bank, it was argued, never runs out of options for stimulating aggregate demand and stoking inflation, provided it is willing to resort to radical measures.

zh: 但这个曾经的理论概念现在看上去颇有切实可能性。
en: But what was once a theoretical notion now seems to be a concrete possibility.

zh: 在实践中，直升机撒钱的形式将是一次性一家庭为单位支付或全民发放消费券，钱全部由央行出。
en: In practice, helicopter drops would arrive in the form of lump-sum payments to households or consumption vouchers for everybody, funded exclusively by central banks.

zh: 分配钱的政府或商业银行资获得一笔存款信用或得到一笔现金，但央行资产负债表的资产栏不会出现债权。
en: Governments or commercial banks distributing the money would be credited with a deposit or be given cash, but no claim would be created on the left-hand side of the central bank’s balance sheet.

zh: 这种单式记账（single accounting）将降低央行股本，除非它实现（卖出）其资产负债表上的价值准备金（valuation reserves ） 。
en: This type of single accounting would reduce the central bank’s equity capital, unless it realized (sold) valuation reserves on its balance sheet.

zh: 该方针的支持者认为央行受可以按需调整的特殊会计规则的约束。
en: Proponents defend this approach by claiming that central banks are subject to special accounting rules that could be adjusted as needed.

zh: 如今，直升机撒钱的支持者包括一些要人，包括美联储前主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke ） 、 英国金融服务局前局长阿代尔·特纳（Adair Turner）等。
en: The proponents of helicopter drops today include some eminent figures, including former US Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke and Adair Turner, former head of the United Kingdom’s Financial Services Authority.

zh: 而尽管欧洲央行行长德拉吉强调欧洲央行采取直升机撒钱面临技术、法律和会计方面的障碍，但并没有将它排除在外。
en: And while ECB President Mario Draghi has highlighted the technical, legal, and accounting obstacles that stand in the way of helicopter drops by his institution, he has not ruled them out.

zh: 现在的问题是：如此极端的措施真的可行吗？
en: The question now is: Is such an extreme step really justified?

zh: 答案是否定的。
en: The answer is no.

zh: 当通缩日益恶化时，如20世纪20年代末到30年代初，直升机撒钱确实是可行的政策选项，但如今并非如此 — — 不管是欧元区还是全球经济。
en: While helicopter drops are a viable policy option if deflation is spiraling downward, as it was in the late 1920s and early 1930s, that is not the case today – neither in the eurozone nor in the global economy.

zh: 诚然，需求增长萎靡不振，这反映出2008年爆发的全球金融危机的漫长后遗症。
en: True, demand growth is subdued, reflecting the lingering fallout from the global financial crisis that erupted in 2008.

zh: 银行、企业和家庭仍然在清理资产负债表，消化他们在泡沫破裂前的信用繁荣期所累积的债务。
en: Banks, firms, and households are still cleaning up their balance sheets and working off the heaps of debt they amassed during the credit boom that preceded the bust.

zh: 但他们已经取得了重大进展，这意味着对增长的拖累即将结束。
en: But they have already made significant progress, meaning that the drag on growth is set to diminish.

zh: 今天的消费者并没有因为预期商品和服务会变得更便宜（通缩时期的预期）而抑制支出。
en: Consumers today are not holding back on spending because they expect goods and services to become cheaper, as one would expect during a period of deflation.

zh: 相反，他们正在逐渐增加支出，以利用恢复的收入增长和因石油和大宗商品价格大跌而大大增加的购买力。
en: Instead, they are gradually increasing their spending, taking advantage of restored income growth and large gains in purchasing power caused by collapsing oil and commodity prices.

zh: 因此，大部分发达国家再一次以接近产能的水平生产。
en: As a result, most advanced economies are once again producing at close to capacity.

zh: 公司利润数据也不支持我们正陷入通缩的观点。
en: Data on corporate profits also contradict the view that we are mired in deflation.

zh: 物价稳定没有让利润边际承压。
en: Price stability has not put profit margins under pressure.

zh: 相反，在许多发达经济体，部分拜投入品成本下降所赐，利润相当高 — — 甚至达到了创纪录的高位。
en: On the contrary, in many advanced economies, profits are high – even reaching record levels – owing partly to lower input costs.

zh: 在这样的环境下，康央行之慨分钱将造成十分危险的长期系统性后果，因为它会给所有参与者带来不当激励。
en: In this environment, distributing largesse financed by the central bank would have dangerous systemic consequences in the long run, because it would create perverse incentives for everyone involved.

zh: 只要增长不如达不到希望的强度，决策者就会想到动用直升机撒钱，而不是去实施解决经济表现萎靡的根本原因的困难的结构改革。
en: Policymakers would be tempted to resort to helicopter money whenever growth was not as strong as they would like, instead of implementing difficult structural reforms that address the underlying causes of weak economic performance.

zh: 所有这些将在金融市场参与者中间引起一个预期，即央行和政府永远会出手干预平稳地消灭信用泡沫，减轻信用泡沫的后果，即使这意味着积累更多债务。
en: All of this would raise expectations among financial-market actors that central banks and governments would always step in to smooth out credit bubbles and mitigate their consequences, even if that meant accumulating more debt.

zh: 这些参与者的风险感知也因此会被扭曲，而风险溢价的作用将被遏制。
en: These actors’ risk perception would thus be distorted, and the role of risk premiums would be diminished.

zh: 此外还需要面临价值准备金耗尽的影响和负权益（negative equity）的风险 — — 这些情况可能破坏央行信誉，进而破坏货币信誉 — — 看起来，显然至少目前直升机撒钱仍应该稳稳地留在学术争论领域。
en: Add to that the impact of the depletion of valuation reserves and the risk of negative equity –developments that could undermine the credibility of central banks and thus of currencies – and it seems clear that helicopter drops should, at least for now, remain firmly in the realm of academic debate.

zh: 反对国家人工智能战略
en: The Case Against National AI Strategies

zh: 坎布里奇—人工智能开发工作被日益界定为一场全球竞赛，甚至新的大博弈（Great Game ） 。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Efforts to develop artificial intelligence (AI) are increasingly being framed as a global race, or even a new Great Game.

zh: 除了国家之间竞相构建国家实力、建立竞争优势，企业也在互相争夺人工智能人才、利用数据优势、提供独一无二的服务。
en: In addition to the race between countries to build national competencies and establish a competitive advantage, firms are also in a contest to acquire AI talent, leverage data advantages, and offer unique services.

zh: 不管是国家还是企业，成功都取决于人工智能方案是否实现民主化，在各部门之间分配。
en: In both cases, success will depend on whether AI solutions can be democratized and distributed across sectors.

zh: 全球人工智能竞赛不同于其他任何全球竞争，因为创新受国家、公司和学界推动的程度，在国与国之间大相径庭。
en: The global AI race is unlike any other global competition, because the extent to which innovation is being driven by the state, the corporate sector, or academia differs substantially from country to country.

zh: 但平均而言，到目前为止的大部分创新来自学界，政府通过采购而非内部研发做出贡献。
en: On average, though, the majority of innovations so far have emerged from academia, with governments contributing through procurement, rather than internal research and development.

zh: 大宗商品占全球贸易的比重有所下降，而数字服务的比重则有所上升，目前数字化贡献了全球贸易总量的60%强。
en: While the share of commodities in global trade has fallen, the share of digital services has risen, such that digitalization now underwrites more than 60% of all trade.

zh: 到2025年，预计经济总价值的一半将来自数字部门。
en: By 2025, half of all economic value is expected to be created in the digital sector.

zh: 政府寻找如何在未来价值链中占据一席之地，而人工智能就是它们的答案。
en: And as governments have searched for ways to claim a position in the value chain of the future, they have homed in on AI.

zh: 因此，从美国、法国、芬兰和新西兰，到中国和阿联酋，无不制定了国家人工智能战略推动国内人才，为未来自动化对劳动力市场和社会计划的影响做好准备。
en: Accordingly, countries ranging from the US, France, Finland, and New Zealand to China and the United Arab Emirates all now have national AI strategies to boost domestic talent and prepare for the future effects of automation on labor markets and social programs.

zh: 尽管如此，人工智能竞赛的真正的性质尚不明确。
en: Still, the true nature of the AI race remains to be seen.

zh: 它极有可能不局限于单一领域，而决定结果的最重要因素将是政府如何监管和监督人工智能应用，包括国内和国际应用。
en: It most likely will not be restricted to any single area, and the most important factor determining outcomes will be how governments choose to regulate and monitor AI applications, both domestically and in an international context.

zh: 中国、美国和其他参与者不但在数据思维、隐私和国家主权等方面竞争，也在二十一世纪国际秩序的诸多愿景之间竞争。
en: China, the US, and other participants not only have competing ideas about data, privacy, and national sovereignty, but also divergent visions of what the twenty-first-century international order should look like.

zh: 在画下这些战线的同时，最重要的一点是数据流与地理边界一致是偶然而非必然。
en: When drawing these lines, the most important point to remember is that data flows align with geographic boundaries only incidentally, not fundamentally.

zh: 在地理上，民族国家是主权实体；但在数字经济中，它们只是名义上的主权，实际则未必。
en: Geopolitically, nation-states are sovereign entities; but in the digital economy, they are sovereign in name only, not necessarily in practice.

zh: 全球数据流目前顺着政治主权线路流动的事实并不意味着它们必须如此。
en: The fact that global data flows are currently organized along the lines of political sovereignty does not mean that they have to be.

zh: 因此，国家化的人工智能计划是一个对冲赌注。
en: Thus, nationalized AI programs are a hedged bet.

zh: 直到目前，各国政府都认为第一个到达终点的国家将夺走人工智能潜在价值的大部分。
en: Until now, governments have assumed that the country that is first to the finish line will be the one that captures the bulk of AI’s potential value.

zh: 看似正确。
en: This seems accurate.

zh: 但问题并不在于这一看法对不对，而在于国家化的方针是否必要，或是否明智。
en: And yet the issue is not whether the assumption is true, but whether a nationalized approach is necessary, or even wise.

zh: 毕竟，将这一问题严格地界定于国家界限内便忽略了人工智能是如何开发的。
en: After all, to frame the matter in strictly national terms is to ignore how AI is developed.

zh: 数据是否国际共享可能决定着机器学习算法是否会产生因国而异的偏误。
en: Whether data sets are shared internationally could determine whether machine-learning algorithms develop country-specific biases.

zh: 某些芯片是否被列为专利技术可能决定着创新在多大程度上能够在全球层面推行。
en: And whether certain kinds of chips are rendered as proprietary technology could determine the extent to which innovation can proceed at the global level.

zh: 从这些现实出发，有理由担心国家战略的分裂性可能妨碍数字经济的增长。
en: In light of these realities, there is reason to worry that a fragmentation of national strategies could hamper growth in the digital economy.

zh: 此外，在当前环境中，国家人工智能计划在争夺有限的人才储备。
en: Moreover, in the current environment, national AI programs are competing for a limited talent pool.

zh: 尽管人才储备爱会随着时间扩大，但日益人工智能驱动的经济所需要的能力也会变化。
en: And though that pool will expand over time, the competencies needed for increasingly AI-driven economies will change.

zh: 比如，网络安全专家的需求日益增加。
en: For example, there will be a greater demand for cybersecurity expertise.

zh: 到目前为止，在重要研究中心和大学之外工作的人工智能开发者发现了一个可靠的退出策略，以及一个庞大的迫不及待的买家市场。
en: So far, AI developers working out of key research centers and universities have found a reliable exit strategy, and a large market of eager buyers.

zh: 随着公司太抬高研究者的身价，顶尖公司和一般公司之间的全球人才差距越拉越大。
en: With corporations driving up the price for researchers, there is now a widening global talent gap between the top firms and everyone else.

zh: 而由于主要科技公司能够获得新来者和小公司无法接触到的庞大丰富的数据储量，市场也变得越来越集中。
en: And because the major technology companies have access to massive, rich data stores that are unavailable to newcomers and smaller players, the market is already heavily concentrated.

zh: 在这一背景下，孤立主义措施 — — 不仅仅是贸易和移民限制 — — 从长期看将让国家处于经济劣势，这应该是显而易见的。
en: Against this backdrop, it should be obvious that isolationist measures – not least trade and immigration restrictions – will be economically disadvantageous in the long run.

zh: 全球贸易性质的变化表明，威力爱大部分经济价值将不是来自商品和服务，而是来自附着于它们的数据。
en: As the changing composition of global trade suggests, most of the economic value in the future will come not from goods and services, but from the data attached to them.

zh: 因此，能获得全球数据流的公司和国家将是最大赢家。
en: Thus, the companies and countries with access to global data flows will reap the largest gains.

zh: 从根本上说，新的全球竞争是可兼容不同选择和做出优化决策的应用的竞争。
en: At a fundamental level, the new global competition is for applications that can compile alternate choices and make optimal decisions.

zh: 最终，适应这些新技术的负担将落在公民头上。
en: Eventually, the burden of adjusting to such technologies will fall on citizens.

zh: 但在那一刻到来之前，重要人工智能开发者和政府协作确保这项技术得到安全而负责任的部署至关重要。
en: But before that moment arrives, it is crucial that key AI developers and governments coordinate to ensure that this technology is deployed safely and responsibly.

zh: 在航海和导航技术最出色的国家主宰世界的时代，机械钟表是一项鲜有人掌握的技术。
en: Back when the countries with the best sailing and navigation technologies ruled the world, the mechanical clock was a technology available only to the few.

zh: 这次不一样。
en: This time is different.

zh: 即便有超级智能，也应该是全球公共品。
en: If we are to have super intelligence, then it should be a global public good.

zh: 反对补助住房债务的理由
en: The Case Against Subsidizing Housing Debt

zh: 发自新加坡 — — 据纽约联邦储备银行统计，今年第一季度末美国的消费者负债总额再创新高（以美元计 ） ， 越过了2008年第三季度全球金融危机爆发时的前一高点。
en: SINGAPORE – At the end of the first quarter, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, American consumer debt for the first time exceeded its previous peak (in dollars), reached in the third quarter of 2008, just as the global financial crisis erupted.

zh: 虽然汽车贷款和学生贷款一路增长迅猛，但房屋债务仍然占据了12.7万亿美元总额的2/3以上。
en: Although car loans and student debt have been rising especially rapidly, housing debt remains more than two-thirds of the $12.7 trillion total.

zh: 作为收入的一部分，家庭负债对国民经济的威胁已经比十年前有所减弱。
en: As a share of income, household debt is nothing like the threat to the national economy that it was ten years ago.

zh: 但新的统计数字依然提醒了我们美国家庭储蓄不足的现实。
en: But the new statistic is a reminder that American households don’t save enough.

zh: 有些人会把美国人的消费倾向归结为文化因素 — — 正如亚洲人喜欢存钱。
en: Some would attribute Americans’ tendency to spend – while Asians, for example, tend to save – to cultural factors.

zh: 但这其中也存在一个重要的政策因素：美国政府的政策设计好像就是在鼓励美国人尽可能多地承担住房债务。
en: But there is an important policy component as well. US government policy is designed as if to encourage Americans to take on as much housing debt as possible.

zh: 经济学家都不愿向人们解释为何应该少借点钱。
en: Economists hesitate to explain to people that they should borrow less.

zh: 因为该建议听起来就跟学校教务主任的唠叨一样让人生厌，看上去似乎对那些收入无法跟上当今生活水平的人来说缺乏同情心 — — 因为过往的历史趋势给了他们一个生活肯定会变好的迷梦。
en: The advice sounds too schoolmarmish. It seems to lack empathy for those whose incomes are not keeping up with the standard of living that historical trends had led them to expect.

zh: 但在政策上鼓励过度负债并没有任何好处，相信数百万在2008年危机之后失去家园的人已经证明了这一点。
en: But it does no one any favors to encourage over-indebtedness as a matter of policy, as the millions who lost their homes in the aftermath of the 2008 crisis discovered.

zh: 据说拥有自己的家是美国梦的重要组成部分。
en: Owning your own home is said to be an essential part of the American dream.

zh: 做梦没有错，但租房子也没有错。
en: There is nothing wrong with dreaming. But there is nothing wrong with renting, either.

zh: 须知买房子通常是家庭兴旺发达的结果，而不是原因。
en: Buying a house is typically a consequence, not a cause, of a family’s prosperity.

zh: “所有权社会”的倡导者认为，房主会比租客更注意维护房产，还能对临近社区带来正面的外部性影响。
en: Advocates of an “ownership society” argue that homeowners take better care of their property than renters, with positive externalities for the neighborhood.

zh: 但对房屋所有权的群体性鼓吹也会削弱劳动力流动。
en: But public encouragement of homeownership also weakens labor mobility.

zh: 在上一场经济衰退中，许多美国失业者都无法迁移到就业机会更多的其他地区，因为他们无法出售自己的房屋，而这正是求职者被房屋危机绑架的可靠证据。
en: In the last US recession, many who lost their jobs could not move to other parts of the country where jobs were more plentiful, because they couldn’t sell their homes. There is good evidence that the housing crisis boxed in job seekers.

zh: 鼓励自置居所的代价可并不低。
en: Encouraging home ownership isn’t cheap.

zh: 据估计针对美国住房债务的总体实际年度补贴额约占国民年收入的1 ％ ， 其中最大部分是房屋抵押贷款利息的免税额，可是这种做法在耗费大量政府收入的同时又很难在分配上实现其合理性 — — 只有那些收入高到可以将其列入免税项目的人才可以享受这种福利。
en: The overall effective annual subsidy to US housing debt has been estimated at roughly 1% of national income. The largest component of this subsidy is the tax deductibility of home mortgage interest, which costs a lot of revenue and is hard to justify on distributive grounds: the benefit goes only to those with incomes high enough to itemize deductions.

zh: 如果美国总统特朗普能在明年通过任何经济法规的话，那很可能跟减税有关。
en: If US President Donald Trump manages to get any economic legislation passed at all in the coming year, it is likely to be a tax cut.

zh: 国会共和党人表示，他们想要实现既不影响政府收入又提高效率的税收改革，并将其定义为一面降低边际税率，一面取消那些扭曲了政策意图的免税项目，从而保持政府收入和预算赤字稳定。
en: Congressional Republicans say they want revenue-neutral, efficiency-enhancing tax reform, which is properly defined as lowering marginal tax rates but simultaneously eliminating distortionary deductions, thereby keeping revenues and the budget deficit stable.

zh: 照此说与房屋抵押贷款利息对应的减税应该是改革的首要目标，但特朗普政府却明确排除了这一点。
en: In that case, the deductibility of home mortgage interest should be among the first targets for reform. Yet the Trump administration has explicitly ruled out curtailing it.

zh: 尤其让人生疑的是特朗普对某些只会让他这类房地产开发商得益的税项的支持。
en: Particularly suspicious in the case of Trump is his support for giveaways in the tax code that benefit only real-estate developers like him.

zh: 其中一个这样的漏洞让开发商得以利用超过其投资额的损失来抵扣应缴税收入。
en: One such loophole lets developers deduct losses that exceed their investments.

zh: 另一个则利用“相同物类财产交换”来躲避资本增值税。
en: Another is the use of “like-kind exchanges” to avoid capital gains tax.

zh: 但特朗普或共和党人也只是这个问题的一部分而已。
en: But the problem goes well beyond Trump or the Republicans.

zh: 有利于抵押债务的政策本身就极受欢迎，获得了几乎所有主要政党政治家的一贯支持，在他们眼中实现住房所有权的最大化简直就是天经地义的事。
en: The policies that favor mortgage debt are extremely popular. Virtually all politicians of both major political parties have long supported them, taking the goal of maximizing homeownership as self-evident.

zh: 除了用房屋抵押贷款利息抵扣应缴税额之外，借款人还可以借助相当于其所购房屋价值5 % （ 甚至更低 ） — —而不是更符合标准的20 ％ — —的首付来买房。
en: Beyond the deductibility of home mortgage interest, borrowers are permitted to make down payments of as little as 5% (or even less) of the value of the house they buy, rather than the more standard 20%.

zh: 而在韩国和新加坡等许多国家都有相关法规 — — 比如房价贷款比 — — 来限制多少家庭贷款额，甚至设法反周期性地收紧贷款限额或税收措施，而这也有助于稳定房价周期的推荐方式。
en: Many other countries, such as Korea and Singapore, have regulations – loan-to-value ratios, for example – limiting how much households can borrow. They even manage to tighten the loan limits or tax measures counter-cyclically, which is the recommended way to help stabilize the housing cycle.

zh: 但美国不是唯一一个倾向于过度发放住房债务的国家。
en: But the US is not the only country with measures that tilt toward excessive housing debt.

zh: 例如在英国就制定了“帮买房”政策来补贴家庭买房，首付也只需5 ％ 。
en: In the United Kingdom, for example, the Help to Buy initiative has subsidized home purchases with down payments of only 5%.

zh: 美国长期补贴住房债务的另一种方式则是借助大型准政府抵押贷款承销商房利美和房地美。
en: Another way the US has long subsidized housing debt is through the huge quasi-government mortgage underwriters Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

zh: 虽然这两家公司都是私营机构，但却从纳税人处获得了隐性政府担保，也成为了道德风险的典型案例。
en: Both were privately owned but had an implicit government guarantee from taxpayers, a classic case of moral hazard.

zh: 可以肯定的是，它们在2008年都获得了联邦监管。
en: Sure enough, they were put in federal conservatorship in 2008.

zh: 国会很容易在消除隐含担保的时候很重蹈将两者私有化的覆辙。
en: Congress could easily repeat the mistake of privatizing them while failing to eliminate the implicit guarantee.

zh: 对此应该提高两房的资本准备金标准，正如监管机构正确地强迫银行所做的那样。
en: Their capital standards should be raised, just as regulators have appropriately forced banks to do.

zh: 2010年由奥巴马总统签署执行的《多德-弗兰克金融改革法案》包含多项旨在减少下一次大规模金融危机爆发可能性的条款。
en: The Dodd-Frank financial reform bill, signed into law by President Barack Obama in 2010, contained many provisions to reduce the chances of another big financial crisis.

zh: 但如果国会不是在过去七年中处心积虑消磨这一法案的话，那么该法律早就令金融体系进一步向正确的方向发展了。
en: But the law would have moved the financial system further in the right direction if many in Congress had not spent the last seven years chipping away at it.

zh: 举个例子，法案明智地要求银行和其他抵押贷款发起人在自家资产报表上至少留存相当于其创设总额5%的住房贷款产品，而不是将其全部重新包装转售给他人，因为这种“风险共担”可以促使贷款发起人去验证借款者的信誉。
en: The Dodd-Frank law wisely required banks and other mortgage originators to retain on their books at least 5% of the housing loans they made, rather than repackaging every last one for resale to others. The loan originators need to have “skin in the game,” in order to have an incentive to verify borrowers’ creditworthiness.

zh: 但在国会的巨大压力下，这一要求在2014年被废除了。
en: Under heavy pressure from Congress, that requirement was gutted in 2014.

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，在美国，鼓励住房债务甚至未能成功提高本国相对于其他国家的自有住房比率：即便在住宅市场繁荣期，这些补贴对房价的推动力也比自有住房的增长量要大。
en: Ironically, the encouragement of housing debt in the US doesn’t even succeed in raising homeownership rates relative to other countries: even at the peak of the housing boom, the subsidies drove up the price of housing more than the quantity.

zh: 美国自有住房比率甚至还比不上加拿大等许多具有更明智抵押贷款政策（不含税收抵扣）的国家，而2007~09年的危机更将该比率从69％降至63 ％ 。
en: Homeownership was no higher than in many countries with more sensible mortgage policies (no tax deductibility), like Canada. The 2007-09 crisis lowered it from 69% to 63%.

zh: 当然，房屋债务的扭曲本身就是崩溃的关键因素。
en: And of course the housing debt distortion was itself a key contributor to the crash.

zh: 大多数经济学家长期以来都对美国补贴住房所有权的政策表示不满，但他们中的大多数人却依然守口如瓶，到如今许多美国人根本不再想听专家的意见了。
en: Most economists have long frowned on US policies that subsidize homeownership. But most held their tongues.

zh: 人们是什么时候失去信心的？
en: And now many Americans no longer want to hear from experts.

zh: 不正是当经济受到住房和金融危机的打击，而经济学家却无法做出预判的时候吗？
en: When did that loss of faith happen? Wasn’t it when the economy was hit by a housing and financial crisis, which economists were supposed to predict?

zh: 英国的进口替代问题
en: The Case for UK Import Substitution

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 英国脱欧公投所带来的最显著经济效应莫过于英镑的崩溃。
en: LONDON – The most dramatic economic effect of the United Kingdom’s Brexit vote has been the collapse of sterling.

zh: 自6月以来，英镑相对一篮子货币的汇率下跌了16 ％ 。
en: Since June, the pound has fallen by 16% against a basket of currencies.

zh: 对此英格兰银行前行长梅尔文·金（Mervyn King）表示较低的汇率是个“受欢迎的变化 ” 。
en: Mervyn King, the previous governor of the Bank of England, hailed the lower exchange rate as a “welcome change.”

zh: 事实上由于英国当前的经常项目赤字与GDP的比率超过了7 ％ — —也是自1955年开始统计该数据以来的最高值 — — 贬值似乎是好事。
en: Indeed, with Britain’s current-account deficit running at over 7% of GDP – by far the largest since data started being collected in 1955 – depreciation could be regarded as a boon.

zh: 但真相果真如此吗？
en: But is it?

zh: 通常来说，经济学家会将货币贬值视为平衡一个国家外部账户的有效手段，因为这会提高进口成本而拉低出口成本，进而令前者下降而后者上升。
en: Economists would typically argue that the way to balance a country’s external accounts is through a fall in its currency, which would make imports more expensive and exports cheaper, causing the former to fall and the latter to rise.

zh: 较高的进口价格 — — 相当于该国的净损失 — — 将被该国出口竞争力更强的就业和工资所抵消。
en: Higher import prices – a net loss for the country – would be offset by the higher employment and wages generated by the more competitive position of the country’s exports.

zh: 但为了使货币贬值发挥作用，当汇率下降时就立刻得涌现出更多的出口需求（或者用经济学术语说，出口需求的价格弹性必须较高 ） 。
en: But in order for currency depreciation to work its magic, more demand for exports must be forthcoming when the exchange rate falls (or, as economists say, the price elasticity of demand for exports must be high).

zh: 但多项研究表明，英国出口需求的价格弹性较低。
en: But various studies have shown that the price elasticity of demand for UK exports is low.

zh: 例如最近由智库机构欧洲贸易研究组（European Trade Study Group）研究员法兰切斯科·埃罗（Francesco Aiello ） ， 格兹埃拉·布南诺（Graziella Bonanno）和阿列西亚·维阿（Alessia Via）共同发表的一篇论文就显示“长期出口水平似乎与英国的实际汇率无关 ” 。
en: For example, a recent paper by Francesco Aiello, Graziella Bonanno, and Alessia Via of the European Trade Study Group finds that “the long-run level of exports appears to be unrelated to the real exchange rate for the UK.”

zh: 这意味着英国消费者和生产者将不得不全盘承受贬值的冲击：它们的进口商品消费将因价格通胀的急剧上升而遭到遏制，而且无法通过出口来抵消。
en: This means that British consumers and producers will have to bear the entire brunt of devaluation: their import consumption will be rationed through a sharp rise in price inflation, with no offsetting gain for exports.

zh: 这可绝不仅仅是一个理论推算： 2008~09年，当世界其他地区都处于通缩边缘时，英国却在经历通胀型衰退，一方面是高达6.1％的GDP年收缩率，一方面确是5.1％左右的通胀率。
en: This is by no means merely a theoretical proposition. In 2008-09, when the rest of the world was on the verge of deflation, the UK was enduring an inflationary recession, with GDP contracting at a top rate of 6.1% annually, while inflation reached some 5.1%.

zh: 这是因为从2007~08年间，英镑汇率从顶部下跌了超过21 ％ 。
en: This occurred because sterling fell more than 21%, peak to trough, from 2007 to 2008.

zh: 此外，尽管2011年的经常项目赤字缩小到相当于GDP的1.7％左右，但改善只是暂时的。
en: Moreover, although the current-account deficit narrowed to around 1.7% of GDP in 2011, the improvement was only temporary.

zh: 2011年以后，尽管英镑汇率依旧不振，但经常项目赤字却再次开始扩大。
en: After 2011, the current account deficit started to widen once more, even though the pound never clawed back its losses.

zh: 在经济学术语中，英国似乎沦为了一个胡萨克-马格效应（Houthakker-Magee effect）的极端范例 — — 该效应以在1969年发现进口和出口的价格弹性可能大幅度分化，导致出现长期性经常账户不平衡趋势的两位经济学家的名字命名。
en: In economics jargon, the UK seems to be suffering from an extreme variant of the Houthakker-Magee effect – named after two economists who discovered in 1969 that price elasticities for imports and exports could diverge substantially, giving rise to a permanent tendency toward current-account imbalance.

zh: 出现这一状况的原因似乎是英国制造业的大规模收缩 — — 从1978年占总增加值约28％到今天的不足10 ％ 。
en: The reason appears to be the massive contraction of the UK manufacturing sector – from around 28% of gross value added in 1978 to less than 10% today.

zh: 正如经济学家尼古拉斯·卡尔多（Nicholas Kaldor）在很早以前指出的那样，由于制造业比服务业的规模收益更高，制造业出口商往往会比服务出口商表现更佳。
en: As the economist Nicholas Kaldor pointed out long ago, because manufacturing has higher returns to scale than services, manufacturing exporters tend to beat service exporters.

zh: 此外，自1990年代中期以来的结构性改革完成了英国出口商与全球供应链的深度融合，令英国的许多出口产品的生产需要进口各类原料零件；因此英镑贬值和进口价格上涨时也会对出口价格产生连锁效应，使其竞争力降低。
en: In addition, structural reforms since the mid-1990s have ensured that British exporters are deeply integrated within global supply chains. As a result, many of Britain’s exports require imported inputs; so when sterling depreciates and import prices rise, the knock-on effect on export prices renders them less competitive.

zh: 最近的经合组织数据显示，英国出口商品中的进口原料零件比例约为23 ％ ， 而美国和日本则为15％左右。
en: The most recent OECD data show that the import content of UK exports is around 23%, compared to around 15% for US and Japanese exports.

zh: 如今英国只能依靠指向伦敦金融城的资本流入来限制英镑的跌幅。
en: For now, the UK is relying on capital inflows into the City of London to limit sterling’s fall.

zh: 但正如2008年汇率崩溃所显示的那样，外国对英镑的需求是非常不稳定的。
en: But, as the exchange-rate collapse of 2008 showed, this source of foreign demand for sterling is highly unstable.

zh: 当趋势不可避免地逆转且资金流向改变时，英镑汇率和出口将再次���压。
en: When the worm inevitably turns and these flows reverse, both sterling and exports will take another hit.

zh: 对此最坏的情况是英镑价值大幅下跌，随后大幅通胀导致英国出口价格居高不下，加剧货币贬值。
en: The worst-case scenario would involve a sharp fall in the value of sterling, followed by sticky inflation that reinforced the rise in British export prices, fueling further currency depreciation.

zh: 这种恶性循环只有当英国消费者遭受实际收入下降时才会停止 — — 其下降幅度之大，在发达国家范围内都是罕见的。
en: This doom loop would stop only when British consumers suffered a fall in real income of a magnitude not typically seen outside developing countries.

zh: 更可能的出现结果是一种缓慢的腐烂效应，定期贬值逐渐降低了所有赚取英镑生活的人的生活水平。
en: The more likely outcome is a sort of slow rotting effect, with periodic depreciations gradually driving down living standards for all who earn their living in sterling.

zh: 对此我们该如何应对？
en: What is to be done?

zh: 只有政府迅速采取行动来用国产货物替代进口的货物才会奏效。
en: Only rapid government action to substitute goods currently imported with domestically produced goods will do the trick.

zh: 经典的解决方案是进口管制，还可以采取一些对贸易规则和国际友好关系破坏性较轻微的其他措施。
en: The classic solution is import controls. But other measures that are less damaging to trade rules and international amity are available.

zh: 工党现在倡导的国家投资银行可以被授权对具备高进口替代潜力的行业进行投资。
en: The national investment bank which the Labour Party is now advocating could be given a mandate to invest in industries with a high import substitution potential.

zh: 另一种方法是直接从财政部门补贴这些行业，补贴额参照被替代进口商品的性价指标。
en: An alternative would be to subsidize such industries directly from the Exchequer, with subsidies tied to the quality-adjusted price of the import being substituted.

zh: 随着国内商品相对外国商品的竞争力逐步提升，补贴将逐渐消除，让行业自主运行。
en: As the domestically produced goods became competitive with the foreign goods, the subsidies would gradually be removed and the industry allowed stand on its own two feet.

zh: 理想的情况是，英国政府应该把进口相对GDP的比率从目前约30％的高点降至1974年以前的20％左右。
en: Ideally, the British government should aim to bring down imports as a percentage of GDP from the current high of around 30% to pre-1974 levels of around 20%.

zh: 这一想法可能过于乐观，而英国最终可能停留在25％的点位上。
en: This may prove too ambitious, and the UK may have to settle for somewhere around 25% of GDP.

zh: 但如果未能做到这一点，英国就会面临长期性的繁荣流失。
en: But if something is not done, Britain risks permanent impairment of prosperity.

zh: 经济萧条卷土重来，而通胀型经济也将加剧事态。
en: A depressed economy can be reflated, and an inflationary economy can be depressed.

zh: 但由于国家对货币汇率动向失去了控制，英国在很大程度上都将无法避免地丧失那些进入国外关键市场的渠道。
en: But losing access to crucial foreign markets as a result of currency movements outside the country’s control is largely irreversible.

zh: 给非洲现金援助
en: Cash Aid for Africa

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 - - 欧洲已经做出重大承诺来提高对非洲的援助，而非洲面临的挑战则要求更大的参与。
en: STOCKHOLM – Europe has made an ambitious commitment to scale up its aid to Africa, and Africa’s challenges call for that greater engagement.

zh: 但是，对已经依赖援助的国家大幅度提高援助就要求具有更为明晰的提供机制以及一定程度的预算可预见性。
en: But boosting aid to countries that are already aid-dependent requires clearer delivery mechanisms and a degree of budgetary predictability.

zh: 人们要求有新的东西，而向贫困人们直接转移现金可以成为一种选择。 但是这一做法只能是伙伴国家福利制度长久愿景的一部分。
en: Something new is called for, and cash transfers directly to poor people could be an alternative − but only as a part of a longer-term vision of partner countries’ welfare systems.

zh: 欧盟已经承诺其与成员国将援助在2010年增加到GDP的0.56%以及在2015年增加到0.7 % ， 其重点地区是非洲。
en: The European Union has committed itself and its member states to increase aid flows to 0.56% of GDP by 2010 and 0.7% by 2015 − with a big focus on Africa.

zh: 把经和组织发展援助委员会成员国的援助承诺加在一起，向非洲的正式发展援助将会在2004年到2010年期间翻倍。 但是前提条件是它们遵守承诺。
en: The combined aid commitments of OECD Development Assistance Committee member countries would mean a doubling of official development assistance to Africa between 2004 and 2010 – that is, if they are honored.

zh: 毕竟，人们对援助国家是否遵守承诺以及伙伴国家的条件是否允许援助国这样做提出疑问是公平合理的。
en: It is, after all, fair to question whether donor countries will stick to these commitments and, indeed, whether conditions in partner countries will permit them to.

zh: 但是在理论上把非援到2010年增加一倍、并且可能在此之后增加更多提供了战胜贫困的巨大机遇。
en: But a theoretical doubling of African aid by 2010 − with the possibility of even more after that − offers a huge opportunity to combat poverty.

zh: 因此，消除有可能阻碍这些额外资源有效应用的障碍就是当务之急。
en: So tackling any obstacles that could inhibit the effective application of these additional resources is a priority.

zh: 人们通常比较熟悉非洲的需求，但是增加援助解决这些需求还存在挑战。 这反映在宏观经济管理、依赖援助综合症、吸收能力以及交易成本等问题上。
en: While Africa’s needs are relatively well known, there are challenges in scaling up aid to tackle them.

zh: 而且，与这些问题相关的是，随着援助水平上升存在回报下降的风险。 目前萨哈拉沙漠以南非洲国家外援和GDP的比例很高。
en: This reflects such problems as macroeconomic management, aid-dependency syndromes, absorption capacity, transaction costs, and − related to all of it − the risk of decreasing returns as aid levels rise.

zh: 即使在未来提高援助之前，大约半数国家的比例已经高于10 % 。 有鉴于此，人们必需重视这些挑战。
en: Given the current aid-to-GDP ratios in sub-Saharan Africa − with approximately half of countries yielding ratios of above 10% even before future increases in aid are taken into account − these challenges must be taken seriously.

zh: 援助国家以及伙伴国家就前进道路达成一致意见，这样就会在理论上处理这些挑战。
en: Donors and their partners agree on a way forward that could, in theory, tackle these challenges.

zh: 巴黎议程中包含了这一一致意见。 这一巴黎议程确定了所有权的原则、调整以及协调。
en: The agreement is contained in the so-called Paris Agenda, which defines principles of ownership, alignment, and harmonization.

zh: 它要求改善援助的可预见性，并且把预算支持和基于项目基础上的援助列为优先的提供支持方式。
en: It calls for the improved predictability of aid flows, with budget support and program-based aid as the preferred means of delivering support.

zh: 这一议程改进了伙伴关系，减少了交易成本并且提高了效率。
en: It is an agenda for improved partnerships, reduced transaction costs, and increased efficiency.

zh: 巴黎议程在脱离理论和面对现实的时候就出现了问题。
en: It is when the Paris Agenda leaves theory and confronts reality that problems emerge.

zh: 预算支持由于信用度低而受到影响，而低信用度不仅来自援助国家的纳税人，也来自受援国家的人民。
en: Budget support suffers from low credibility, not only among donor taxpayers, but also among citizens in recipient countries.

zh: 尽管可预见的假定财政流向可以预见，但是这一可预见性还是可能虚假。
en: While it assumes predictable financial flows, such predictability can be spurious.

zh: 毕竟，援助国家及其伙伴国家都不会免于腐败、政治危机、武装冲突、违反人权、既得利益或者国际大国政治等等问题。
en: After all, neither donor countries nor their partners are exempt from such problems as corruption, political crises, armed conflicts, human rights abuses, vested interests, or international power politics.

zh: 结果，把过多的鸡蛋放在一个篮子里就让提供援助工作看上去越发具有风险。
en: As a result, placing so many eggs in one basket leaves the business of aid provision looking increasingly risky.

zh: 而且，与各国减少贫困战略相关的预算支持也建立在这一令人怀疑的假定基础之上，也就是伙伴国家的政治经济是为了最为贫困人民服务的。
en: Furthermore, budget support that’s linked to national poverty-reduction strategies also rests on the questionable assumption that the political economy of a partner country works to the benefit of the poorest.

zh: 在援助国家方面，政治也绝不简单。 在反对援助游说变得越发响亮之时，纳税人经常把不断增加的援助预算视为过份。
en: Politics on the donor side is no less complicated, with growing aid budgets often viewed by taxpayers as excessive at a time when the anti-aid lobby is becoming more vocal.

zh: 在提供援助者提供某一国家全国预算的一半或者更多的时候，他们就会发现有时候干预是不可避免的，因为援助者当然有实力进行干预。
en: When donors finance 50% or more of a country's national budget, they may sometimes find intervention unavoidable − donors certainly have the power to intervene.

zh: 这就会意味着对援助施加更多的条件，而不是减少附加条件，即使论调有时候好像相反也一样。
en: That could mean more conditions being placed on aid, not fewer − even if the rhetoric sometimes appears to suggest the opposite.

zh: 直接向最贫困人口发钱来提供援助是否更好呢？
en: Would dispensing aid by making cash transfers directly to the poorest work better?

zh: 在拉丁美洲国家已经进行了试验，也就是把上学和接种疫苗作为儿童津贴的条件。 在人道主义危机发生的时候，有时候就用现金援助取代食品援助。
en: Experimental schemes have been implemented in Latin America in which child allowances are conditional on school attendance and vaccination.

zh: 在赞比亚有具有针对性的社会保险。 在印度、南非和莱索托等国家将会为老年人提供福利。
en: Cash aid has sometimes replaced food aid in humanitarian crisis situations, and there have been targeted social protection schemes in Zambia, as well as incipient welfare schemes for the elderly in India, South Africa, and Lesotho.

zh: 目前为止，成效尚难以令人满意。
en: The results so far are very promising.

zh: 穷人在投资和消费上的花费一半比较有效。
en: Poor people spend money reasonably effectively on investment as well as on consumption.

zh: 在购买了食品和其他基本物品后，地方经济获得了收益，而营养也得到了改善，孩子上学时间也更长。 南非有一项没有附加条件的儿童赠款，其收款人是孩子的母亲。
en: Food and other basic goods are bought – benefiting the local economy – nutrition improves, and kids attend school for longer.

zh: 这一项目甚至提高了儿童的身高。 与对照组同龄儿童相比，这些孩子的身高指数得到了提高。
en: An unconditional child grant scheme in South Africa − with mothers as recipients − even demonstrated the impact in centimeters, because the height-for-age index among children improved in relation to control groups.

zh: 提供能力并非是一个主要障碍。
en: Affordability does not appear to be a big hurdle.

zh: 例如设想一下，给莫桑比克、马拉维和赞比亚所有10岁以下儿童提供每年50美元的赠款，大约可以照顾到一千万儿童。
en: Assume, for example, that an annual universal grant of $50 is given to all children below 10 years of age in Mozambique, Malawi, and Zambia − covering roughly 10 million children.

zh: 这三个低收入国家的艾滋病发病率都是大约15 % 。
en: These are three low-income countries with HIV prevalence rates of roughly 15%.

zh: 再进一步假定相对宽松的20%的行政人头支出，这一项目的总体成本大约是六亿美元，相当于2004年记录给予这些国家援助的五分之一及其GDP总和的3.5%到4 % 。
en: Further assuming a relatively generous 20% administration overhead, the total cost of the scheme would be approximately $600 million – equivalent to a fifth of the reported aid flow to these countries in 2004 and to 3.5-4% of their combined GDP.

zh: 这无疑是成本很高，但是如果非援增加一倍并非遥不可及。
en: It would certainly be costly, but not out of reach if African aid is doubled.

zh: 这些现金转移项目要成功，它们就必须定期、可以预计以及长久。
en: For cash-transfer schemes to work, they must be regular, predictable, and long term.

zh: 但是，尽管援助国家及其纳税人或许愿意为这一承诺做出长期性的承诺，但是他们看来并没有多大胃口做出无休止的承诺。
en: But, while donors and their taxpayers might be willing to make long-term commitments for such a purpose, there is likely to be rather less appetite for making commitments which would seem to be never-ending.

zh: 需���分担责任的模式，从而逐渐增加国内提供资金。
en: A formula for burden sharing would be needed that gradually increases domestic financing.

zh: 但是在任何情况下这些项目都不应该仅仅是完全由援助国家驱动，而绕过地方预算以及机构。
en: But under no circumstances should these schemes be established as purely donor-driven mechanisms that bypass local budgets and institutions.

zh: 伙伴国家必须准备好在自己的机构上投资并且自己给如何安排自身的福利体系制定计划。
en: Partner countries must be ready to invest in their institutions and develop their own vision of how they want to organize their welfare systems.

zh: 非洲伙伴们是否想要这样呢？
en: Would African partners want this?

zh: 或许是这样。
en: Maybe.

zh: 在任何情况下，有关现金转移的辩论不再局限于那些北方发展循环。
en: In any case, the cash-transfer debate is no longer limited to those in northern development circles.

zh: 现在，它已经被提到了某些非洲国家政府和非盟的议事日程上来。
en: It has now reached the agenda of some African governments and the African Union.

zh: 为何非洲应该无现金化
en: Why Africa Should Go Cashless

zh: 亚穆苏克罗—印度最近正在追求一个雄心勃勃的目标：无现金经济。
en: YAMOUSSOUKRO – India has lately been pursuing an ambitious goal: a cashless economy.

zh: 尽管一开始出现了一些错误和混乱，但这个工程将会成为13.1亿印度人民获得更好生活的转机。
en: Despite early missteps and frustrations, it will turn out to be a change for the better for the country’s 1.31 billion people.

zh: 非洲也应该制定类似的目标 — — 并通过建立货币联盟迈出第一步。
en: Africa should set a similar goal – and take the first step by establishing a monetary union.

zh: 当然，实现无现金社会本身不是终点。
en: Of course, achieving a cashless society is not an end in itself.

zh: 相反，这只是帮助推动金融包容、安全和繁荣的手段。
en: Rather, it is a means to help advance financial inclusion, security, and prosperity.

zh: 如今，大约有3.26亿非洲人 — — 相当于非洲成年人口的80 % — —无法使用正式和非正式的金融服务。
en: Today, an estimated 326 million Africans – 80% of the continent’s adult population – use no formal or informal financial services.

zh: 但把钞票藏在床垫下绝不是捍卫家庭储蓄的良方，更无法让家庭积累足够财富摆脱长期贫困。
en: But stashing banknotes under the mattress is no way to safeguard families’ savings, much less enable households to accumulate enough capital to escape chronic poverty.

zh: 类似地，数百万非洲人在非正式经济中讨生活。 在非洲的大部分国家里，非正式经济贡献了大约 41%的 GDP。
en: Similarly, millions of Africans are scratching out a living in the informal economy, which represents about 41% of GDP in most parts of the continent.

zh: 这使得这些非洲人无法得到保护，也无从获得财金融稳定，无法创造财富。
en: This leaves them unprotected, and without pathways to financial stability and wealth creation.

zh: 走向无现金社会能迫使公民、公司和决策者制定让所有非洲人都进入金融系统的机制，大大改善数百万无法获得银行服务或获得足够银行服务的非洲人的生活；也能让许多生计进入到正式经济中 — — 这对于非洲国家来说是一个重要的经济机遇。
en: Moving toward a cashless society would force citizens, companies, and policymakers to devise mechanisms to bring all Africans into the financial sector, drastically improving the lives of the millions who are now under- and unbanked. And it would bring many livelihoods into the formal economy – a major economic opportunity for African countries.

zh: 目标应该是通过与经济活动有关的金融包容实现繁荣。
en: The goal should be to achieve prosperity through financial inclusion linked to economic activity.

zh: 小微企业需要的是新资本以创造就业、做大经济蛋糕；而与经济活动关联的银行账户能确保即使是路边小贩也能从经济蛋糕中分得一块。
en: What small businesses and micro-enterprises need is fresh capital to create employment and expand the economic pie, and bank accounts connected to economic activity ensure that even those selling goods by the roadside can secure a piece of that pie.

zh: 但金融包容不会因为不使用现金而从天上掉下来。
en: But financial inclusion is not a natural by-product of the shift away from cash.

zh: 相反，哈佛大学经济学家肯尼斯·罗格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）指出，成功的去货币化需要可执行的全面计划来增加金融包容和银行的使用。
en: On the contrary, as Harvard economist Kenneth Rogoff argues, successful demonetization requires a comprehensive and implementable plan to increase financial inclusion and use of banks.

zh: 这一计划应该着重于构建正确的经济活动生态系统。
en: Such a plan should focus on building the right ecosystem for economic activity.

zh: 在非洲，这意味着不但要普及金融服务，还要推动金融扫盲。
en: In Africa, that means not just delivering financial services, but also advancing financial literacy.

zh: 新建银行账户如果闲置，就无法带来多少积极效果。
en: Newly established bank accounts have few positive effects if they lie dormant.

zh: 要确保金融包容真正让经济转型得以实现，非洲人必须获得知识和工具来充分利用金融服务。
en: To ensure that financial inclusion actually enables economic transformation, Africans must gain the knowledge and tools to make the most of financial services.

zh: 当然，所有这些都绝非易事 — — 印度在实施激进的去货币化过程所遇到的挑战充分说明了这一点。
en: Of course, none of this will be easy – a point made clear by India’s challenging experience implementing its radical demonetization process.

zh: 成功需要渐进方针。
en: Success will require, among other things, a gradual approach.

zh: 非洲必须让现金稀缺现象让非正式经济难以为继，就像印度那样。
en: Africa must not allow cash scarcity to cripple the informal economy, as it has in India.

zh: 但如果非洲成功实现了这一转型，收益将是巨大的。
en: But if Africa succeeds in this transition, the benefits will be profound.

zh: 去货币化甚至可以为国家省钱。
en: Demonetization would probably even save countries money.

zh: 万事达卡估算，每年全世界要花掉1%的GDP用于铸造、处理和分发钞票。
en: MasterCard estimates that countries worldwide spend as much as 1% of their GDP each year to mint, process, and distribute banknotes.

zh: 这笔钱可以更好地用来满足联合国可持续发展目标，进一步改善非洲穷人的生活。
en: That is money that could be better spent on meeting the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, further improving the lives of Africa’s poor.

zh: 有理由相信，非洲能够成功实现无现金化。
en: There is reason to believe that Africa can succeed in going cashless.

zh: 目前，已有很大一部分非洲人在使用M-Pesa和等EcoCash数字支付系统 — — 它们正是能够在去现金化过程中扮演关键角色的创新平台。
en: Already, a large share of Africans uses digital payment systems like M-Pesa and EcoCash – precisely the types of innovative platforms that can play a pivotal role in the shift away from cash.

zh: 尽管恶性通胀绝非这一转变的理想催化剂，但津巴布韦的经验证明，公民能够也愿意根据变化的环境作出调整。
en: While hyperinflation is far from the ideal catalyst for such a shift, Zimbabwe’s experience proves that citizens can and will adapt to challenging circumstances.

zh: 比如，一些津巴布韦商店可以给移动货币账户提供授信代替找零。
en: For example, some stores in the country will give credit to mobile money accounts in lieu of change.

zh: 但是，非洲要实现广义的无现金化转变，那么向货币联盟迈进将是深化全非洲经济一体化的关键。
en: But, to achieve a broader shift to a cashless Africa, progress toward monetary union will be essential for deepening economic integration across the continent.

zh: 这反过来又将打造一个能够成为大幅扩张非洲内部贸易 — — 让人们摆脱贫困的最快捷方式 — — 基础的全非洲金融服务生态系统。
en: That, in turn, would foster a continent-wide digital financial services ecosystem capable of underwriting a massive expansion of intra-African trade – the quickest route to lifting people out of poverty.

zh: 目前，西非和中非14国共同使用盯住欧元的西非法郎。
en: Already, 14 countries in West and Central Africa share the CFA franc, which is pegged to the euro.

zh: 南非与莱索托、纳米比亚和斯威士兰制定共同货币政策。
en: And South Africa shares a monetary policy with Lesotho, Namibia, and Swaziland.

zh: 前途是显而易见的。
en: We cannot stumble where the road is clear.

zh: 非洲人是去货币化运动的后发者。
en: Africans are latecomers to the demonetization movement.

zh: 但我们可以通过汲取已经实现转型或正在实现转型的国家的经验，将后发转变为优势。
en: But we can use this to our advantage, by learning from countries that have already made the transition or are on the way.

zh: 除了印度，这些国家还包括丹麦、挪威和瑞典。
en: These include not just India, but also Denmark, Norway, and Sweden.

zh: 我们必须将它视为非洲经济急需的结构转型的一个战略优势。
en: We must view this as a strategic advantage in the much-needed structural transformation of the African economy.

zh: 有了以耐心和决心为基础的明智的战略，非洲可以构建一个无现金经济，以高水平的金融包容支持经济繁荣和安全。
en: With a smart strategy, underpinned by patience and commitment, Africa can build a cashless economy, with high levels of financial inclusion supporting economic prosperity and security.

zh: 过不了多久，在加纳路边购买“Kofi broke man ” — —烤芭蕉配花生 — — 可以不需要现金，从而让小贩富在当下，储为未来。
en: Before too long, buying a “Kofi broke man” – a roasted plantain with groundnuts – by the roadside in Ghana could be a cashless transaction, one that helps the vendor prosper in the present – and save for the future.

zh: 西班牙研究
en: A Spanish Disquisition

zh: 哥德堡 — — 就在几天内，加泰罗尼亚地区议会很可能宣布加泰罗尼亚独立，这个地区作为西班牙的领土已经有500年历史。
en: GOTHENBURG – Within a few days, the Catalan regional parliament may declare Catalonia’s independence, after 500 years of history with Spain.

zh: 几小时后，西班牙政府可能会派遣数千警察扣押加泰罗尼亚高级官员，从而终结长达40年繁荣的自治。
en: A few hours afterwards, the Spanish government may respond by sending thousands of police to detain top Catalan officials, putting an end to 40 years of prosperous self-rule.

zh: 反过来，许多加泰罗尼亚人可能走上街头，发起反抗并造成可怕的后果。
en: In turn, many Catalans may take to the streets, launching a revolt with scary consequences.

zh: 乍看之下，西班牙可能陷入混乱的想法令人感到迷惑。
en: At first sight, the idea that Spain could descend into chaos is puzzling.

zh: 该国位列世界表现最好的民主政体之一 — — 某些指标甚至领先于法国、意大利和美国。
en: The country is ranked among the world’s top-performing democracies – ahead of France, Italy, and the US according to some indicators.

zh: 而且西班牙是全球投资者和游客最喜欢的目的地之一。
en: And it is one of the favorite destinations for investors and tourists worldwide.

zh: 漫步于巴塞罗那宏伟而迷人的街道，在那里爆发暴力冲突的可能性比在英属哥伦比亚丛林发现大猩猩还不可思议。
en: Having strolled through the magnificent and charming streets of Barcelona, the possibility of violent clashes there seems as unlikely as a guerrilla in the forests of British Columbia.

zh: 尽管如此，西班牙当局和加泰罗尼亚叛乱部队之间爆发身体对抗的确是可能的结果，除非主要参与方改变其行动方式。
en: Nonetheless, a physical confrontation between the Spanish authorities and Catalan insurrectional forces is a possible outcome, unless the major actors change their course of action.

zh: 但他们都没有这样做的动机。
en: And none of them has incentives to do so.

zh: 就像电影《无因的叛逆》中的詹姆斯·迪恩和布赞一样，西班牙和加泰罗尼亚政府正加速将汽车驶向悬崖，希望对方成为先跳车的那一个。
en: Like James Dean and Buzz in “Rebel Without a Cause,” the Spanish and Catalan governments are speeding their cars toward a cliff, with each expecting the other to be the first to jump out.

zh: 西班牙政府认为加泰罗尼亚议会不敢单方面宣布独立，因为国际社会不会承认加泰罗尼亚独立。
en: The Spanish government assumes that Catalan’s parliament will not dare to declare independence unilaterally, because the move would receive no international recognition.

zh: 而加泰罗尼亚政府则信心满满地认为西班牙政府所采取的压制性对策重新唤起了人们对曾经看到的10月1日公投期间警察殴打手无寸铁的老妇和少年的记忆，西班牙当局此举将为加泰罗尼亚和平叛乱铺平道路，而国际社会有可能普遍对此表示默许。
en: And the Catalan government is confident that a repressive response by the Spanish authorities, reviving the images of police beating unarmed old women and teenagers that the world saw during the referendum on October 1, would pave the way for a peaceful rebellion within Catalonia and widespread international acquiescence.

zh: 此外，西班牙和加泰罗尼亚政府都享有强烈的民意支持。
en: In addition, both governments enjoy strong popular support.

zh: 马德里执政的保守派人民党（PP）即使不讨好加泰罗尼亚选民也可以轻松地在全国选举中获胜，人民党仅有区区11%的选票来自于加泰罗尼亚选民。
en: The ruling conservative People’s Party (PP) in Madrid can comfortably win a national election without courting voters in Catalonia, where it obtained a meager 11% of the vote in 2015.

zh: 同样，分离主义政党可以轻松地在加泰罗尼亚议会赢得多数。
en: Likewise, the separatist parties can easily secure a majority in the Catalan parliament.

zh: 此外，由于政府对公共广播机构的控制和对私人媒体渠道的大量公共补贴，双方都可以召集一支可靠而狂热的知识分子和新闻记者部队，这些人煽风点火的评论正在促使冲突不断升级。
en: Besides, thanks to governmental control of public broadcasters and generous public subsidies to private media outlets, both sides can deploy a reliable army of fiercely motivated journalists and intellectuals whose incendiary comments are contributing to the conflict’s escalation.

zh: 这台西班牙大戏的演员们正面临着被政治学家称之为社会困境的局面：冲突的任何一方均可从自利行为中获益，除非另外一方也同样采取自利的行为。 但如果双方都坚持自利的原则，那么双方都会失败。
en: The actors in the Spanish drama are facing what political scientists call a social dilemma: either side gains from selfish behavior unless the other side behaves selfishly, too, in which case both sides lose.

zh: 采用次佳方案可能对联合主义者和分离主义者双方都更有利。
en: Both unionists and separatists would be better off with a second-best solution.

zh: 举例来讲，分离主义者可以放弃单方面独立宣言，以换取进行有关宪法改革的谈判，从而促成西班牙走向联邦制。
en: For example, the separatists could renounce a unilateral declaration of independence in exchange for talks on constitutional reforms that would move Spain in a federal direction.

zh: 允许对宪法进行象征性修改的宪法修正案，比如正式宣布加泰罗尼亚为“民族”的宣言或实质性举措，比如财政协定，将满足绝大多数加泰罗尼亚人的独立愿望，并保持西班牙领土的完整性。
en: A constitutional amendment that allowed symbolic changes, like an official declaration of Catalonia as a “nation,” or substantive initiatives, like a fiscal pact, would satisfy most Catalans while maintaining Spain’s territorial integrity.

zh: 问题在于，双方都认为表现出妥协的意愿可能损害他们未来的议价能力。
en: The problem is that both sides believe that showing willingness to compromise would weaken their future bargaining situation.

zh: 而政治学研究表明情况可能恰恰相反。
en: Research in political science, however, indicates that the opposite may be true.

zh: 诺贝尔奖得主埃里诺·奥斯特罗姆（Elinor Ostrom）的研究成果表明我们可以用给予而非索取的反向策略来解决社会困局。
en: Following insights by the Nobel laureate Elinor Ostrom, we know that social dilemmas can be solved using the inverse strategy: giving instead of demanding.

zh: 如果一方表现出合作行为，其对手可能感受到回报的压力，从而导致一系列合作而非报复，以及信任而非怀疑。
en: If one party exhibits cooperative behavior, its rival may feel forced to reciprocate, leading to a spiral of cooperation instead of retaliation, and of trust instead of suspicion.

zh: 奉行这种理论现在对加泰罗尼亚有利。
en: This is what is required now in Catalonia.

zh: 西班牙政府和加泰罗尼亚分离主义者都必须承认，如果他们以明智而大度的姿态行事，另一方可能以未来的让步作出回应。
en: Both the Spanish government and the Catalan separatists must acknowledge that, if they act with sensible generosity, the other side may respond with further concessions.

zh: 鉴于马德里和巴塞罗精英当前完全隔绝的心理状态，实现这一目标并不容易。
en: It will not be easy, given the current mental disconnect between the Madrid and Barcelona elites.

zh: 但他们需要思考他们的行为在近40载成功实行民主制度后，正如何危及数百万西班牙人来之不易的福利。
en: Yet they need to consider how their behavior is endangering the hard-earned welfare of millions of Spaniards, after four decades of successful democracy.

zh: 在阳光明媚的西班牙，隧道的尽头应当是光明的未来。
en: In sunny Spain, there should always be light at the end of the tunnel.

zh: 西班牙的危机，欧洲的机会
en: Spain’s Crisis is Europe’s Opportunity

zh: 雅典—要想复兴每况愈下的欧洲工程，加泰罗尼亚地区政府和西班牙国家之间的丑陋冲突也许正是良方。
en: ATHENS – To revive the ailing European project, the ugly conflict between Catalonia’s regional government and the Spanish state may be just what the doctor ordered.

zh: 一场欧盟主要成员国所爆发的宪政危机，为理顺地区、国家和欧洲机构的民主治理，从而实现一个合情合理因而可持续的欧盟创造了一个黄金机会。
en: A constitutional crisis in a major European Union member state creates a golden opportunity to reconfigure the democratic governance of regional, national, and European institutions, thereby delivering a defensible, and thus sustainable, EU.

zh: 对于加泰罗尼亚独立公投期间所发生的警察暴力，欧盟官方的反应可谓玩忽职守。
en: The EU’s official reaction to the police violence witnessed during Catalonia’s independence referendum amounts to dereliction of duty.

zh: 欧盟委员会主席宣称这是西班牙内部问题，欧盟无可奉告，这简直伪善到家了。
en: To declare, as the President of the European Commission did, that this is an internal Spanish problem in which the EU has no say is hypocrisy on stilts.

zh: 当然，伪善早已成为欧盟行为的核心。
en: Of course, hypocrisy has long been at the center of the EU’s behavior.

zh: 其官员可以毫无愧疚之心地干涉成员国的内部事务 — — 比如要求当选政客下台，因为他拒绝减少最贫穷公民的退休金或以跳楼价甩卖公共资产（这种事情，我本人就深有体会 ） 。
en: Its officials had no compunction about meddling in a member state’s internal affairs – say, to demand the removal of elected politicians for refusing to implement cuts in the pensions of their poorest citizens or to sell off public assets at ridiculous prices (something I have personally experienced).

zh: 但当匈牙利和波兰政府赤裸裸地践踏欧盟基本原则时，不干预又突然之间成为神圣不可侵犯的原则了。
en: But when the Hungarian and Polish governments explicitly renounce fundamental EU principles, non-interference suddenly became sacrosanct.

zh: 加泰罗尼亚问题有其深刻的历史根源，也有更广的民族主义根源。
en: The Catalan question has deep historical roots, as does nationalism more broadly.

zh: 但要不是欧洲对2010年以来的欧元区危机处理不当，导致西班牙和其他欧洲外围国家陷入了半永久的停滞，同时也在难民潮开始穿越欧洲外部边境的情况下为仇外主义和道德恐慌创造了条件，加泰罗尼亚问题还会爆发吗？
en: But would it have erupted the way it recently did had Europe not mishandled the eurozone crisis since 2010, imposing quasi-permanent stagnation on Spain and the rest of the European periphery while setting the stage for xenophobia and moral panic when refugees began crossing Europe’s external borders?

zh: 一个例子说明了其中的关联。
en: An example illustrates the connection.

zh: 美丽的加泰罗尼亚首府巴塞罗那是一个富裕的城市，预算有盈余。
en: Barcelona, Catalonia’s exquisite capital, is a rich city running a budget surplus.

zh: 但许多巴塞罗那市民最近却面临被用他们的税金拯救的西班牙银行的驱逐。
en: Yet many of its citizens recently faced eviction by Spanish banks that had been bailed out by their taxes.

zh: 结果是形成了一场民权运动，并在2015年成功地助阿达·卡洛（Ada Colau）当选巴塞罗那市长。
en: The result was the formation of a civic movement that in June 2015 succeeded in electing Ada Colau as Barcelona’s mayor.

zh: 卡洛许诺巴塞罗那人民要为小企业和家庭减税、支持穷人，并为15,000难民建造住房 — — 占西班牙需要从希腊和意大利等前沿国家接收的难民总量的很大一部分。
en: Among Colau’s commitments to the people of Barcelona was a local tax cut for small businesses and households, assistance to the poor, and the construction of housing for 15,000 refugees – a large share of the total number that Spain was meant to absorb from frontline states like Greece and Italy.

zh: 所有这些都可以在市政收支相抵的前提下实现，只不过会让预算盈余减少一些。
en: All of this could be achieved while keeping the city’s books in the black, simply by reducing the municipal budget surplus.

zh: 可惜，卡洛很快就意识到，她难以克服的障碍。
en: Alas, Colau soon realized that she faced insurmountable obstacles.

zh: 西班牙中央政府援引其对欧盟紧缩指引所负的国家义务，实施了事实上禁止所有市降低盈余的立法。
en: Spain’s central government, citing the state’s obligations to the EU’s austerity directives, had enacted legislation effectively banning any municipality from reducing its surplus.

zh: 与此同时，中央政府还禁止卡洛已经为他们建好了良好住宿设施的15,000名难民进入。
en: At the same time, the central government barred entry to the 15,000 refugees for whom Colau had built excellent housing facilities.

zh: 时至今日，巴塞罗那预算仍然保持盈余，服务和地税削减承诺没有能够兑现，为难民而建的社会住房空置。
en: To this day, the budget surplus prevails, the services and local tax cuts promised have not been delivered, and the social housing for refugees remains empty.

zh: 导致这一令人遗憾的情况的过程，显然就是让加泰罗尼亚分离主义复兴的原因。
en: The path from this sorry state of affairs to the reinvigoration of Catalan separatism could not be clearer.

zh: 在所有系统性的危机中，对大部分人实行紧缩，对银行家实行社会主义，对地方民主实行扼杀，这样的组合必然会造成绝望和不满，成为民族主义的温床。
en: In any systemic crisis, the combination of austerity for the many, socialism for bankers, and strangulation of local democracy creates the hopelessness and discontent that are nationalism’s oxygen.
