zh: 在所有这些例子中，资产负债表修复挤出了总需求的复振，货币刺激基本上没有起到刺激经典周期性反弹的作用。
en: In all of these cases, balance-sheet repair preempted a resurgence of aggregate demand, and monetary stimulus was largely ineffective in sparking classic cyclical rebounds.

zh: 这可能是现代央行政策最大的失败。
en: This could be the greatest failure of modern central banking.

zh: 但这一点被一致否认。
en: Yet denial runs deep.

zh: 美联储前主席格林斯潘（Alan Greenspan）2004年初发表的“任务完成”讲话是一个显例。
en: Former Federal Reserve Chair Alan Greenspan’s “mission accomplished” speech in early 2004 is an important case in point.

zh: 格林斯潘使用超宽松货币政策清理2000年互联网泡沫破裂后的乱局，同时坚持美联储不应该因为对20世纪90年代末投机疯狂无动于衷而受到谴责。 他的这一观点受到广泛赞誉。
en: Greenspan took credit for using super-easy monetary policy to clean up the mess after the dot-com bubble burst in 2000, while insisting that the Fed should feel vindicated for not leaning against the speculative madness of the late 1990s.

zh: 这让格林斯潘的继任者陷入滑坡困境。
en: That left Greenspan’s successor on a very slippery slope.

zh: 2008年底的大危机让美联储前主席伯南克（Ben Bernanke）很快手段用尽，不得不祭出新的魔力药丸 — — 量化宽松。 量化宽松是解救受困市场的灵丹，但绝非填补消费者资产负债表、刺激总需求有效复苏的有效工具。
en: Quickly out of ammunition when the Great Crisis hit in late 2008, former Fed Chair Ben Bernanke embraced the new miracle drug of quantitative easing – a powerful antidote for markets in distress but ultimately an ineffective tool to plug the hole in consumer balance sheets and spark meaningful revival in aggregate demand.

zh: 欧洲央行行长德拉吉在2012年所做的著名承诺 — — “不惜一切代价”捍卫欧元 — — 让欧洲央行也走上了同样的道路 — — 先是零利率，然后是量化宽松，现在是负政策利率。
en: European Central Bank President Mario Draghi’s famous 2012 promise to do “whatever it takes” to defend the euro took the ECB down the same path – first zero interest rates, then quantitative easing, now negative policy rates.

zh: 类似地，日本银行行长黑田东彦坚持认为所谓的QQE（量化和质量宽松）已经结束了有害的通货紧缩 — — 即使如今他也采取了负利率并将日本银行2%的通胀目标实现日期延后至2017年年中。
en: Similarly, Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda insists that so-called QQE (quantitative and qualitative easing) has ended a corrosive deflation – even though he has now opted for negative rates and pushed back the BOJ’s 2% inflation target to mid-2017.

zh: 美联储是否能抵御住负利率的诱惑仍有待观察。
en: It remains to be seen whether the Fed will resist the temptation of negative interest rates.

zh: 但最主要央行坚持错误的信念 — — 传统货币政策策略（利率政策在零水平之上进行调整）和非常规工具（如量化宽松和负利率）的效力没有什么区别。
en: But most major central banks are clinging to the false belief that there is no difference between the efficacy of the conventional tactics of monetary policy – driven by adjustments in policy rates above the zero bound – and unconventional tools such as quantitative easing and negative interest rates.

zh: 问题就在于此。
en: Therein lies the problem.

zh: 在常规货币政策时代，传导渠道主要局限于借贷成本以及相应的对实体经济的信用敏感部门（如房屋建设、汽车和商业资本支出）的影响。
en: In the era of conventional monetary policy, transmission channels were largely confined to borrowing costs and their associated impacts on credit-sensitive sectors of real economies, such as homebuilding, motor vehicles, and business capital spending.

zh: 当这些部门因为基准利率的变化而起落时，整个系统的反响（所谓的乘数效应）常常因为资产市场的真实和心理收益（财富效应）而加强。
en: As those sectors rose and fell in response to shifts in benchmark interest rates, repercussions throughout the system (so-called multiplier effects) were often reinforced by real and psychological gains in asset markets (wealth effects).

zh: 今时不同往日。
en: That was then.

zh: 在全新的非常规货币政策时代，传导渠道主要是通过资产市场的财富效应。
en: In the brave new era of unconventional monetary policy, the transmission channel runs mainly through wealth effects from asset markets.

zh: 这一方法引起两个严重的并发症。
en: Two serious complications have arisen from this approach.

zh: 首先，央行忽视了金融动荡的风险。
en: The first is that central banks have ignored the risks of financial instability.

zh: 低通胀给过于友好的货币政策造成了虚假的安全感，导致资产和信用市场出现大量泡沫，从而引起实体经济的大扭曲。
en: Drawing false comfort from low inflation, overly accommodative monetary policies have led to massive bubbles in asset and credit markets, resulting in major distortions in real economies.

zh: 当泡沫破裂并将失衡的经济打入资产负债表衰退时，以通胀为目标的央行已经黔驴技穷 — — 这让它们迅速进入了零利率和量化宽松的流动性注入等未知领域。
en: When the bubbles burst and pushed unbalanced economies into balance-sheet recessions, inflation-targeting central banks were already low on ammunition – taking them quickly into the murky realm of zero policy rates and the liquidity injections of quantitative easing.

zh: 其次，政客因为繁荣的资产市场而获得虚假的安全感，他们不再倾向于选择财政刺激 — — 从而在事实上封住了走出流动性陷阱的唯一的现实道路。
en: Second, politicians, drawing false comfort from frothy asset markets, were less inclined to opt for fiscal stimulus – effectively closing off the only realistic escape route from a liquidity trap.

zh: 在财政刺激缺位的情况下，央行继续向易于产生泡沫的金融市场注入流动性 — — 而没有意识到它们无非是在重复20世纪30年代的“推绳子”政策（绳子只能拉不能推，指适得其反的政策 ） 。
en: Lacking fiscal stimulus, central bankers keep upping the ante by injecting more liquidity into bubble-prone financial markets – failing to recognize that they are doing nothing more than “pushing on a string” as they did in the 1930s.

zh: 转向负利率问题更加严重。
en: The shift to negative interest rates is all the more problematic.

zh: 全世界总需求持续萎靡，惩罚不发放新贷款的银行将带来一系列新风险。
en: Given persistent sluggish aggregate demand worldwide, a new set of risks is introduced by penalizing banks for not making new loans.

zh: 在功能生，这等价于刺激新一波“僵尸贷款 ” — —20世纪90年代贷给毫无偿债能力的日本借款人的不符合经济学原理的贷款。
en: This is the functional equivalent of promoting another surge of “zombie lending” – the uneconomic loans made to insolvent Japanese borrowers in the 1990s.

zh: 央行政策已经迷失了方向，陷入了危机。
en: Central banking, having lost its way, is in crisis.

zh: 世界经济还会远吗？
en: Can the world economy be far behind?

zh: 为何央行数字货币将摧毁虚拟货币
en: Why Central Bank Digital Currencies Will Destroy Cryptocurrencies

zh: 发自纽约 — — 世界各国央行的行长们都已开始讨论中央银行数字货币（Central Bank Digital Currencies）的概念，如今甚至连国际货币基金组织及其总裁克里斯蒂娜·拉加德也在公开谈论这一理念的利弊。
en: NEW YORK – The world’s central bankers have begun to discuss the idea of central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), and now even the International Monetary Fund and its managing director, Christine Lagarde, are talking openly about the pros and cons of the idea.

zh: 此样的对话早该进行了。
en: This conversation is past due.

zh: 现金的使用日渐稀少，甚至在瑞典和中国等国近乎消失了。
en: Cash is being used less and less, and has nearly disappeared in countries such as Sweden and China.

zh: 与此同时，数字支付系统 — — 欧美的PayPal，Venmo等系统；中国的支付宝和微信；肯尼亚的M-Pesa；印度的Paytm — — 都能提供原本归属于传统商业银行的有吸引力的替代服务。
en: At the same time, digital payment systems – PayPal, Venmo, and others in the West; Alipay and WeChat in China; M-Pesa in Kenya; Paytm in India – offer attractive alternatives to services once provided by traditional commercial banks.

zh: 大多数这些金融科技创新仍然与传统银行对接，没有一个依赖于加密货币或区块链。
en: Most of these fintech innovations are still connected to traditional banks, and none of them rely on cryptocurrencies or blockchain.

zh: 同样，如果央行数字货币得以发布，它们也将与这些过度炒作的区块链技术无关。
en: Likewise, if CBDCs are ever issued, they will have nothing to do with these over-hyped blockchain technologies.

zh: 尽管如此，那些过分乐观的加密狂热分子也还是抓住政策制定者对央行数字货币的考量来试图证明即便是央行也得借助区块链或加密技术来加入这场数字货币游戏。
en: Nonetheless, starry-eyed crypto-fanatics have seized on policymakers’ consideration of CBDCs as proof that even central banks need blockchain or crypto to enter the digital-currency game.

zh: 这是无稽之谈。
en: This is nonsense.

zh: 甚至在某种程度上央行数字货币可能取代所有私人数字支付系统，无论它们对接的是传统银行账户还是加密货币。
en: If anything, CBDCs would likely replace all private digital payment systems, regardless of whether they are connected to traditional bank accounts or cryptocurrencies.

zh: 而目前的情况在于只有商业银行才能对接中央银行的资产负债表；同时央行的储备已经作为数字货币而存在，这也是为什么央行在居中调度银行间支付和贷款交易方面如此高效且低成本的原因。
en: As matters currently stand, only commercial banks have access to central banks’ balance sheets; and central banks’ reserves are already held as digital currencies. That is why central banks are so efficient and cost-effective at mediating interbank payments and lending transactions.

zh: 但由于个人，企业和非银行金融机构并不享有相同的访问权限，因此必须依赖持牌商业银行来处理其交易。
en: Because individuals, corporations, and non-bank financial institutions do not enjoy the same access, they must rely on licensed commercial banks to process their transactions.

zh: 因此银行存款属于某种形式的私人资金，用于非银行私人行为主体之间的交易。
en: Bank deposits, then, are a form of private money that is used for transactions among non-bank private agents.

zh: 因此即使是支付宝或Venmo等全数字系统也无法与银行系统分开运作。
en: As a result, not even fully digital systems such as Alipay or Venmo can operate apart from the banking system.

zh: 通过允许任何个人通过中央银行进行交易，央行数字货币将颠覆这种安排，减少对现金，传统银行账户甚至数字支付服务的需求。
en: By allowing any individual to make transactions through the central bank, CBDCs would upend this arrangement, alleviating the need for cash, traditional bank accounts, and even digital payment services.

zh: 而更优秀之处在于央行数字货币不必仰仗于加密货币赖以构建的公开“免许可 ” ， “非信任”分布式记账。
en: Better yet, CBDCs would not have to rely on public “permission-less,” “trustless” distributed ledgers like those underpinning cryptocurrencies.

zh: 毕竟中央银行已经拥有了一个集中化且得到许可的私人非分布式记账，可以安全流畅地促成支付和交易。
en: After all, central banks already have a centralized permissioned private non-distributed ledger that allows for payments and transactions to be facilitated safely and seamlessly.

zh: 任何一个保持理智的中央银行家会用区块链技术替换掉这么一个合理的系统。
en: No central banker in his or her right mind would ever swap out that sound system for one based on blockchain.

zh: 一旦某个央行数字货币被发行出来，它将立即取代加密货币，因为前者不具有备可扩展性，廉价，安全，或实际上是区中心化的。
en: If a CBDC were to be issued, it would immediately displace cryptocurrencies, which are not scalable, cheap, secure, or actually decentralized.

zh: 加密货币的狂热信徒会反驳说加密货币对那些希望保持匿名的人仍然具有吸引力。
en: Enthusiasts will argue that cryptocurrencies would remain attractive to those who wish to remain anonymous.

zh: 但就像今时今日的私人银行存款一样，央行数字货币交易也可以匿名进行，只会在必要时向执法机关或监管机构提供账户持有人信息，就跟私人银行已经发生的情况一样。
en: But, like private bank deposits today, CBDC transactions could also be made anonymous, with access to account-holder information available, when necessary, only to law-enforcement authorities or regulators, as already happens with private banks.

zh: 此外像比特币这样的加密货币实际上并不是匿名的，因为使用加密钱包的个人和组织仍然留下了数字足迹。
en: Besides, cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin are not actually anonymous, given that individuals and organizations using crypto-wallets still leave a digital footprint.

zh: 而那些想要合法地追踪罪犯和恐怖分子的政府当局很快会出手打击那些创建完全隐私加密货币的企图。
en: And authorities that legitimately want to track criminals and terrorists will soon crack down on attempts to create crypto-currencies with complete privacy.

zh: 如果央行数字货币能驱逐掉那些毫无价值的加密货币，它们就应该受到欢迎。
en: Insofar as CBDCs would crowd out worthless cryptocurrencies, they should be welcomed.

zh: 此外，通过将支付从私人银行转移到中央银行，一个基于央行数字货币的系统将成为传递金融包容性的福音。
en: Moreover, by transferring payments from private to central banks, a CBDC-based system would be a boon for financial inclusion.

zh: 数百万无银行账户的人可以通过手机获得一套近乎免费且高效的支付系统。
en: Millions of unbanked people would have access to a near-free, efficient payment system through their cell phones.

zh: 而央行数字货币的主要问题在于它们会破坏当前的条块化储备体系，商业银行通过这种体系来借出比手中持有的流动性存款更多的资金，进而创造出货币。
en: The main problem with CBDCs is that they would disrupt the current fractional-reserve system through which commercial banks create money by lending out more than they hold in liquid deposits.

zh: 银行需要存款才能做出贷款和投资决策。
en: Banks need deposits in order to make loans and investment decisions.

zh: 如果将所有私人银行存款都转成央行数字货币，那么传统银行将需要转型为“可贷资金中介机构 ” ， 通过借入长期资金来为抵押贷款等长期贷款提供资金。
en: If all private bank deposits were to be moved into CBDCs, then traditional banks would need to become “loanable funds intermediaries,” borrowing long-term funds to finance long-term loans such as mortgages.

zh: 换言之，条块化储备银行系统将被主要由央行管理的狭义银行系统所取代。
en: In other words, the fractional-reserve banking system would be replaced by a narrow-banking system administered mostly by the central bank.

zh: 这相当于一场金融革命 — — 而且会产生许多好处。
en: That would amount to a financial revolution – and one that would yield many benefits.

zh: 央行可以更好地控制信贷泡沫，阻止银行挤兑，防止到期日错配以及规范私人银行的高风险授信/贷款决策。
en: Central banks would be in a much better position to control credit bubbles, stop bank runs, prevent maturity mismatches, and regulate risky credit/lending decisions by private banks.

zh: 到目前为止还没有哪个国家决定向这个方向进发，或许是因为这将导致私人银行业的彻底去中介化。
en: So far, no country has decided to go this route, perhaps because it would entail a radical disintermediation of the private banking sector.

zh: 另一种选择是央行将已经转为央行数字货币的存款借回给私人银行。
en: One alternative would be for central banks to lend back to private banks the deposits that moved into CBDCs.

zh: 但如果政府实际上是各大银行唯一的存款人和资金提供者，那么就会明确存在国家干预贷款决策的风险。
en: But if the government was effectively banks’ only depositor and provider of funds, the risk of state interference in their lending decisions would be obvious.

zh: 而拉加德则提倡第三种解决方案：中央银行与私人银行之间的公私合作伙伴关系。
en: Lagarde, for her part, has advocated a third solution: private-public partnerships between central banks and private banks.

zh: “个人可以将一般性存款放在金融企业那里，但交易最终会以企业之间的数字货币来结算 ， ” 她最近在新加坡金融科技节上解释道。
en: “Individuals could hold regular deposits with financial firms, but transactions would ultimately get settled in digital currency between firms,” she explained recently at the Singapore Fintech Festival.

zh: “与当前的状况相类似，但整个操作会在瞬间完成。
en: “Similar to what happens today, but in a split second.”

zh: ”这种安排的优势在于支付“将是即时，安全，廉价且可能是半匿名的。
en: The advantage of this arrangement is that payments “would be immediate, safe, cheap, and potentially semi-anonymous.”

zh: ”此外 ， “ 各家央行依然会是支付行为背后的稳固基础 “ 。
en: Moreover, “central banks would retain a sure footing in payments.”

zh: 这是一个明智的妥协，但一些完美主义者会反驳说它无法解决现行条块化储备银行系统所存在的问题。
en: This is a clever compromise, but some purists will argue that it would not solve the problems of the current fractional-reserve banking system.

zh: 银行挤兑，到期日错配以及由私人银行创造的资金所推动的信贷泡沫等风险依然存在，同时仍然需要存款保险和最后贷款人的支持，而这本身就会产生道德风险。
en: There would still be a risk of bank runs, maturity mismatches, and credit bubbles fueled by private-bank-created money. And there would still be a need for deposit insurance and lender-of-last-resort support, which itself creates a moral hazard.

zh: 这些问题需要通过监管和银行监管来管理，且不一定足以防止未来的银行业危机。
en: Such issues would need to be managed through regulation and bank supervision, and that wouldn’t necessarily be enough to prevent future banking crises.

zh: 在适当的时候，基于央行数字货币的狭义银行和可贷资金中介机构可以确保实现一个更好更稳定的金融体系。
en: In due time, CBDC-based narrow banking and loanable-funds intermediaries could ensure a better and more stable financial system.

zh: 如果对此的替代方案是危机频发的条块化储备系统和加密反乌托邦，那么我们就应该对该想法持开放态度。
en: If the alternatives are a crisis-prone fractional-reserve system and a crypto-dystopia, then we should remain open to the idea.

zh: 中欧的数字自由斗争
en: Central Europe’s Digital Freedom Struggle

zh: 布拉格 — — 四分之一世纪以前，当柏林墙倒塌、铁幕升起，中欧人选择了资本主义和民主，抛弃了专制及共产主义。
en: PRAGUE – A quarter-century ago, when the Berlin Wall fell and the Iron Curtain rose, the people of Central Europe chose capitalism over communism and democracy over dictatorship.

zh: 但时至今日，该地区捷克、匈牙利、波兰和斯洛伐克等四个前共产主义国家的民众在促进和保护互联网自由的问题上令人失望地表现不一。
en: Today, however, citizens of the Czech Republic, Hungary, Poland, and Slovakia – the region's four ex-communist countries – are turning in a disappointingly mixed performance when it comes to promoting and protecting Internet freedom.

zh: 但还有很多地方需要改进。
en: But much needs to be improved.

zh: 捷克共和国在支持言论自由、遏制监视和提高透明度方面表现一直不错，但匈牙利却以巨额罚款和其他制裁措施迫害博主和出版社。
en: The Czech Republic has a strong record of supporting free expression, curbing surveillance, and promoting transparency, but Hungary persecutes bloggers and publishers with heavy fines and other sanctions.

zh: 波兰和斯洛伐克介于其间。
en: Poland and Slovakia fall somewhere in between.

zh: 四国注定要从全新数字世界中获益匪浅。
en: The four countries are poised to benefit greatly from the new digital world.

zh: 各国都具备开放活跃网络社区的先决条件：不错的互联网普及率及民主、多元的政治制度。
en: Each has the prerequisites for open and lively online communities: decent Internet penetration and democratic, plural political systems.

zh: 比方说“一位匈牙利医生在社交媒体驱动下创建了医疗咨询网站，一群波兰学生制造的获奖机器人可以在火星上工作，还有一名斯洛伐克人发明了会飞的汽车。 ”
en: There is “a Hungarian doctor who has created a medical advice website driven by social media, a team of Polish students who have built an award-winning robot that could operate on Mars, and a Slovak inventor of a flying car."

zh: 但尽管有过共产主义经历且斯诺登披露的网络侦听事件引起舆论哗然，中欧政府都没有就遏制自身权力采取有力的措施。
en: And yet, despite their own experiences under communism and the outcry within their borders over Edward Snowden's revelations of Internet snooping, the governments of Central Europe have not taken a strong stand to rein in their own authorities.

zh: 警方每年提交上千份申请以监控互联网应用，并且总能得到当地法院的批准。
en: The police file thousands of requests each year to monitor Internet use, and local courts almost always grant them.

zh: 用户极少得到相关通知，并且申请监控的依据往往不清不楚。
en: Users are rarely notified of such requests, and the basis on which they are made is often unclear.

zh: 保障互联网自由的法律往往遭到忽视或扭曲。
en: Too often, laws ensuring Internet freedom are ignored or bent.

zh: 人们激烈地辩论内容是否应该禁止以及互联网出版物适用哪些版权保护规则。
en: Debates rage over whether content should be blocked and which copyright protections apply to Internet publications.

zh: 官僚对在线信息访问的要求不置可否，而法院则对本该适用在线内容专项通知解决程序的案件表现出过强的立案冲动。
en: Bureaucrats drag their feet on requirements to make information accessible online, and the courts are over-eager to initiate cases that should be settled with notice-and-takedown procedures specifically devised for online content.

zh: 四国都迫切需要改革法律框架，以明确博主和记者言论自由的边界。
en: In all four countries, the legal framework is badly in need of reform to clarify the boundaries of freedom of expression for bloggers and journalists.

zh: 必须推进立法现代化，以适应网络世界的发展和个人沟通及新闻投放的巨大变革。
en: Legislation must to be modernized to reflect developments in the online world and to recognize the enormous shift in personal communication and news delivery.

zh: 斯洛伐克的网络记者无法享受与报社记者同等的法律保护。
en: In Slovakia, online journalists do not enjoy the same legal protection as print journalists.

zh: 针对互联网内容的法���裁决一直向政客而非记者倾斜。
en: Court rulings on Internet content have favored politicians over the press.

zh: 波兰的法官要求迅速删除有攻击性的网络内容；而诽谤需要受到刑事制裁。
en: In Poland, judges demand quick removal of offensive online content; defamation is subject to criminal prosecution.

zh: 整个中欧地区都需要增加透明度。
en: Transparency needs to be increased throughout Central Europe.

zh: 目前的立法过于含混，以致政府机构能以商业机密或隐私问题为由对信息公开申请加以拒绝。
en: Current legislation is vague enough to allow government agencies to refuse freedom-of-information requests on the basis of claims of commercial confidentiality or privacy concerns.

zh: 匈牙利在该地区表现最差。
en: Hungary is the region's single worst performer.

zh: 该法同时削弱了对记者消息来源的保护。
en: The law also weakened the protection of journalists' sources.

zh: 违法处罚包括罚款、停业整顿或彻底取缔。
en: Penalties for violating the rules include fines, suspension, or shutdowns.

zh: 欧盟委员会、欧洲理事会和媒体监督组织都不约而同地批评这项法律，但匈牙利政府仍坚持其媒体镇压路线。
en: The European Commission, the Council of Europe, and press watchdog groups were unanimous in criticizing the legislation, but the Hungarian government persists in its media crackdown.

zh: 新刑法为滥用权力、包括过滤网络内容大开方便之门。
en: A new criminal code leaves room for abuse of authority, including the possibility of filtering online content.

zh: 100,000多名示威者在布达佩斯抗议游行后该提案才暂时取消。
en: After more than 100,000 protesters gathered in Budapest, the proposal was withdrawn – at least for now.

zh: 上述前共产主义国家有独一无二的机会引领互联网自由。
en: These ex-communist countries have a unique opportunity to become global leaders in Internet freedom.

zh: 但与此同时，波兰外长并未优先关注互联网自由。
en: And yet, in the meantime, Poland's foreign ministry has not made Internet freedom a priority.

zh: 比方说，与捷克共和国相比，波兰迄今仍未加入自由网络联盟。
en: Unlike the Czech Republic, for example, Poland still has not joined the Freedom Online Coalition.

zh: 二十年前，中欧人民奋起打倒遮遮掩掩的独裁政府。
en: Two decades ago, the people of Central Europe rose up to bring down secretive, authoritarian governments.

zh: 今天，该地区前共产主义国家已经取得了长足的进步。
en: Today, the region's ex-communist countries have made considerable progress.

zh: 但仍有许多艰苦工作有待完成。
en: But much hard work remains to be done.

zh: 领导互联网自由之战将是很好的开端。
en: A good place to start would be to lead the fight for Internet freedom.

zh: 中欧被误导的毒品战争
en: Central Europe’s Misguided War on Drugs

zh: 华沙 — — 20年前的夏天，从波罗的海塔林到亚得里亚海蒂拉纳的共产主义统治全线瓦解，迎来了自由选举、市场改革和蓬勃发展的公民自由。
en: WARSAW – It was two decades ago this summer that communist rule began to implode from Tallinn in the Baltic to Tirana in the Adriatic, ushering in free elections, market reforms, and expanded civil liberties.

zh: 自那以后，中东欧国家已经取得了令人瞩目的成就。
en: Since then, the countries of Central and Eastern Europe have come a long way.

zh: 其中很多国家已经加入了欧盟。
en: Many are now members of the European Union.

zh: 我的祖国波兰也实现了经济稳定和媒体繁荣。
en: My homeland, Poland, has a steady economy and a thriving media.

zh: 但波兰和中东欧地区其他新兴民主国家一样，在人道对待吸毒人员的问题上仍然停留在过去。
en: Yet Poland, like many of the other new democracies in our region, remains stuck in the past when it comes to the humane treatment of drug users.

zh: 实际上，在整个前苏联集团，使用过时、保守而又严厉的政策对待毒品滥用已经成为一种令人不安的趋势。
en: Indeed, throughout the former Soviet bloc, there is a disturbing trend in using outdated, conservative, and heavy-handed policies to address drug abuse.

zh: 举例来讲，找遍团结运动的发祥地格但斯克也找不到一个美沙酮治疗中心。
en: For example, Gdansk – the birthplace of the Solidarity movement – does not have a single methadone treatment center.

zh: 人们为获取事实证明能够控制毒瘾的药物、减轻吸毒的危害必须经受三个小时的鞍马劳顿。
en: People must travel for three hours to get the medicine that is proven to control cravings and reduce the harms of drug use.

zh: 即便如此他们也还算幸运。
en: And they are the lucky ones.

zh: 波兰只有5%的鸦片吸食人员能够接触到美沙酮，而德国这一比例为40 % 。
en: Only 5% of opiate users in Poland have access to methadone at all, compared to 40% in Germany.

zh: 波兰政府不关心真正有效的治疗方法，而选择重点发展位于农村偏远地区的长期康复中心，这些所谓的康复机构几乎不提供任何被实践证明有效的药物。
en: Instead of focusing on treatment that works, the Polish government chooses to give priority to long-term rehabilitation centers located in the depths of the countryside that have little, if anything, to do with evidence-based medicine.

zh: 波兰还把哪怕是持有最小剂量的毒品定为刑事犯罪，波兰因拥有毒品被判刑的人中60%不过大麻瘾君子就是证明。
en: Poland also chooses to treat possession of even the smallest quantities of drugs as criminal, as evidenced by the fact that 60% of people sentenced for drug possession in Poland are marijuana smokers.

zh: 可借助刑事化和康复中心来解决吸毒问题根本无助于遏止需求，因此毒品吸食率一直居高不下。
en: Addressing drug use through criminalization and rehabilitation centers does nothing to curb demand, however, and usage rates have failed to decline.

zh: 以刑事手段解决毒品问题迫使吸毒人员转入地下，从而进一步加剧了公共健康危机。
en: By driving users underground, criminalization contributes to a deepening public-health crisis.

zh: 中东欧国家几乎都采用这种模式，这些国家的政府不约而同地选择囚禁吸毒者。
en: This pattern persists across Central and Eastern Europe, where governments have also opted to imprison drug users.

zh: 比如在匈牙利，刑法规定瘾君子私人藏毒须处以两年监禁。
en: In Hungary, for example, the penal code calls for two years imprisonment for personal possession by a drug-dependent person.

zh: 而在临近的斯洛伐克，个人藏毒的刑罚与波兰一样，最高可处以三年徒刑。
en: In neighboring Slovakia, the penalty for personal possession is, as in Poland, up to three years.

zh: 这样的处罚方式不仅缺乏人道，而且在经济上也不可持续：应当鼓励这些国家的领导人把稀缺的执法、审判和监狱资源用来惩治性质更严重的犯罪。
en: This approach is not only inhumane, but also economically untenable: leaders in these countries should be encouraged to redirect scarce law enforcement, court, and prison resources towards more pressing causes.

zh: 简言之，政府已经无法承受由于对吸毒人员实施监禁而耗费时间和金钱，而这些资源本来可以被更有效地用在别处。
en: Simply put, governments can no longer afford to drain precious time and money that could be better spent elsewhere by locking up people for drug-related offenses.

zh: 波兰及其邻国要想开辟一条新路，至少需要具备三个条件。 其一，上述国家必须向西方学习更人道的替代性毒品政策。
en: If Poland and its neighbors are to chart a new way forward, at least three things must happen.  First, these countries should look West for alternative, and more humane, drug policies.

zh: 英国毒品政策委员会不久前发布的一份报告呼吁实行“更明智”的毒品政策，重点解决与毒品相关的暴力问题而不是简单逮捕吸毒者。
en: A report released recently by the United Kingdom’s Drug Policy Commission correctly calls for a “smarter” drug policy that focuses on addressing associated violence rather than simply making arrests.

zh: 中东欧国家的官员应当关注英国内政部最近的一次讲话，核心意思是“我们解决这一复杂问题的所有目的就是为了减轻危害。 ”
en: Officials in Central and Eastern Europe should pay heed to recent comments by the UK’s Home Office, which said that “harm reduction underpins every element of our approach to tackling this complex issue.”

zh: 葡萄牙不久前采取了进一步措施，投票确认消遣性质的吸毒，包括吸食海洛因和可卡因不属于刑事犯罪。 这项举措已使因吸毒造成的死亡人数大幅度降低，减少了新增艾滋病感染病例。
en: Portugal recently went a step further in voting to decriminalize recreational drugs, including heroin and cocaine – a move that has led to a significant decline in drug-related deaths and a fall in new HIV infections.

zh: 其二，立法者应当听取选民的意见：波兰最大的日报 《选举日报》 在五天时间内搜集了超过23，000个民众签字，呼吁修改现行的反毒品法律。
en: Second, law-makers should listen to their constituents: a recent public awareness campaign by Gazeta Wyborcza , a leading Polish daily newspaper, collected more than 23,000 signatures in five days for a petition calling for changes to the current drug law.

zh: 上述修改仿效德国的进步政策，将不再惩罚藏匿少量毒品自吸的瘾君子，加重处罚毒贩，并为瘾君子提供更有效的救治。
en: The changes, modeled after Germany’s progressive policies, would stop punishing people for possessing small amounts of drugs for their own use, impose stricter penalties for dealers and provide more effective treatment for drug-dependent people.

zh: 下一步，与拟议中反毒品法有关的波兰议会辩论定于9月开始。
en: In a step forward, a debate in the Polish parliament on the proposed drug law is set to start in September.

zh: 年轻人不该由于个人藏毒而在开始职业生涯前就带上刑事犯罪记录。
en: Young people should not start their working lives with criminal records because of personal possession.

zh: 最后，欧盟层次上的决策者可以发挥作用，鼓励成员国免除对少量藏毒行为的刑事处罚。
en: Finally, at the European level, EU policymakers can help by encouraging member states to decriminalize possession of small amounts of drugs.

zh: 这样做可以腾出低层次吸毒者占用的资源，使国家能够更好地解决严重的毒品供应问题，并为人们提供他们需要也应该得到的有效治疗。
en: By freeing up resources devoted to enforcing policies against low-level users, countries can better tackle serious drug-supply issues and provide people with the effective treatment that they need and deserve.

zh: 中欧的理性教育
en: Central Europe’s Unsentimental Education

zh: 布达佩斯-本月是1956年被镇压的的匈牙利反苏运动领导人伊姆雷·纳吉被重新安葬的20周年纪念。
en: BUDAPEST – This month marks the 20th anniversary of the reburial of Imre Nagy, the leader of Hungary’s failed anti-Soviet revolution of 1956.

zh: 与此同时，匈牙利的反共产主义党派发起了纪念纳吉遇害31周年活动，动员了超过10万名参加者一起来纪念这个标志着僵化制度走向瓦解的开创性事件。
en: The reinternment, organized by Hungary’s anti-communist opposition on the 31st anniversary of his execution, drew more than 100,000 attendees, heralding the beginning of the end of the country’s sclerotic regime.

zh: 虽然对于匈牙利人以及中欧人来说，那些铁幕专制的年代早已远去，但过去20年所经历的一切，仍呼唤我们去反思自己选择的道路。
en: We Hungarians, and Central Europe in general, have come far since those heady times, but the past 20 years have also given us much cause to question the path we took.

zh: 匈牙利在共产主义的瓦解过程中扮演了非常特殊的角色，它通过对东德难民开放边界，加速了瓦解的整个进程。
en: Hungary played a special role in the collapse of Communism, accelerating the process by opening its borders for East German refugees.

zh: 但在1980年代，匈牙利的民主变革要求反对派必须找到某种新的斗争策略：靠革命运动是行不通的，1956年那场苏联入侵证明了这点；内部改革也是行不通的，因为苏联阵营各国势必会像1968年针对捷克斯洛伐克那样插手干预，以挽救整个苏维埃制度。
en: But democratic transformation in Hungary required an opposition strategy throughout the 1980’s: revolution wouldn’t work, as the Soviet invasion in 1956 showed. Nor would internal reforms work, because the Soviets would intervene to save the system, as they did in 1968 in Czechoslovakia.

zh: 对此，反对派采取的新策略则是退出对政治权力的争夺 — — 与其直接与共产党统治硬碰硬，不如选择去建立许许多多自由，且互相关联的小圈子和社会组织，这样只要时机一到，反对派就能够迅速聚集起足够的力量去改变整个体制。
en: Instead, the new strategy was to sideline the issue of political power. Rather than attacking Communist rule directly, we would create small islands of freedom, inter-connected social circles and associations, which, when the moment came, could all be connected in order to change the system.

zh: 而当年在匈牙利就存在着许多关系密切的青年组织，许多1989年参加政治变革的政治团体也正是脱胎于此。
en: In Hungary, several youth organizations existed and were aware of each other, so the political community that took part in the political changes in Hungary in 1989 was organized on this basis.

zh: 同时历史也对匈牙利的成功变革也发挥了作用。
en: History also played a part in the success of the Hungarian transition.

zh: 1956年革命运动是真正意义上的流血革命，也只有在匈牙利，中欧共产主义者才可能要用自己的生命来偿还强加在他人身上的苦难和压迫。
en: The 1956 revolution was a real one, with barricades. In no other Central European country did Communists experience the possibility of paying with their own lives for the suffering and oppression that they inflicted on others.

zh: 这种历史教训对改革显然是有利无害的。
en: This historical experience was good for reform capability.

zh: 而新一代匈牙利人的产生也是必要条件之一。
en: A new generation was also needed.

zh: 当我在1989年6月16日得到机会作为青年一代的代言人发表政见时，这一代人就具有象征意义地诞生了。
en: It appeared symbolically on June 16, 1989, when I had the opportunity to speak on behalf of the young generation.

zh: 我们整一代人都感觉到，匈牙利人有权决定自己未来的时刻终于到了。
en: A whole generation felt that the moment had come when Hungarians could at last determine their own future.

zh: 但是，人们又决定了一个什么样的未来呢？
en: So, what kind of future did they determine?

zh: 这过去的20年可以分为三个阶段。
en: The past 20 years can be divided into three phases.

zh: 首先，匈牙利人分别建立了自己的市场经济，法制以及民主体制。
en: First, a market economy was created, the rule of law established, and democratic institutions built.

zh: 接着我们申请加入北约，并准备申请欧盟成员国资格，所有的体制改革也都围绕着这些目标展开。
en: Next, we applied for admission to NATO and prepared for European Union membership, with all of the institutional reforms that these goals implied.

zh: 第三阶段则和前两个阶段有所不同，我们谋求在经济上追赶欧洲其他国家，但这个阶段进行得不但不太成功，如今甚至有点倒退。
en: The third phase was one of economic catch-up, which, unlike the first two phases, has not really been successful in Hungary, which today may even be falling back.

zh: 但对于整个中欧来说，过去20年堪称是自威斯特伐利亚和约签订以来最好的时期，斯洛伐克和斯洛文尼亚甚至成功地加入了欧元区。
en: But, for Central Europe as a whole, the past 20 years have been the best since the Peace of Westphalia, with Slovakia and Slovenia even joining the euro zone.

zh: 然而，当下的全球金融和经济危机却给欧洲共产主义瓦解的20周年纪念日蒙上了阴影。
en: Nevertheless, the 20th anniversary of the collapse of communism is overshadowed by the global financial and economic crisis.

zh: 很显然这场全球化运动的最大赢家已经不再是欧洲人或美国人，而是亚洲人。
en: And it is now clear that the biggest winners of globalization are no longer the Europeans or the Americans, but the Asians.

zh: 世界市场也正被和平地重新划分，之所以说是“和平 ” ， 则是因为一个国家的领土在全球化之下早已和它的市场分离，再没有任何一方需要为打入另一方的市场而占领别国的领土了。
en: The world market is being re-divided – peacefully, because territories and markets are separated, so that no power occupies another power’s territory.

zh: 但即便如此，欧洲人依然有必要去明确划分谁是伙伴，谁是竞争对手，谁是敌人。
en: But Europe must nonetheless recognize the need to distinguish clearly between partners, competitors, and opponents, and to formulate a more sophisticated and articulated policy towards Russia, in particular.

zh: 特别是要专门针对俄罗斯去制定一个更为成熟严密的政策：比如说当我们对俄罗斯试图重建前苏联“利益圈”和“防御区”的政策感到不满时，中欧人就应该把自己定义为俄罗斯人的对手。
en: For example, we Central Europeans are opponents when we do not accept Russia’s policy of renewing “spheres of interest” and “security zones.”

zh: 此外，过去六个月发生的金融危机也迫使中欧人对那些曾经代表西方道德价值观的国家擦亮了眼睛 — — 这场危机的发生并不是因为碰巧倒霉或某些专业上的失误，而是来源自于道德品质的迷失，这点在美国以及后来的西欧国家尤其严重。
en: Moreover, after all that has happened in the past six months, Central Europeans can no longer look up to old countries representing the moral values of Western civilization. This crisis was not caused by bad luck or some professional misunderstanding, but by character problems, especially in the United States and later Western Europe.

zh: 人们的财富是被盗走了，而不仅仅是“管理不善 ” 。
en: Money was stolen, not merely “mismanaged.”

zh: 投资策略也不仅仅是失误，而是罔顾风险的赌博。
en: Investments were not simply bad, but unacceptably risky.

zh: 是企业领导人的低劣道德酿造了这一危机，所幸他们没有一个来自中欧。
en: The moral state of business leaders caused this crisis, and you cannot find Central Europeans among those leaders.

zh: 而事实上，中欧人发现自己已经处于一种全新的形势之下：西方世界的危机处理方式几乎将我们国家与欧盟市场的联系完全切断。
en: Central Europe has found itself in a completely new situation. Crisis management measures undertaken in the Western world are practically cutting our countries off from the EU market.

zh: 在这种情况下，中欧国家必须紧密合作，不仅为了维护自身利益，更为了维护一个欧洲大同的梦想。
en: In this situation, Central European countries must cooperate to defend their own interests, as well as their dream of a common Europe.

zh: 目前欧洲精英们面临问题,就在于能否坚信过去20年来所付出的努力，能否坚信一体化的欧洲市场和不断扩大的欧洲共同体。
en: The question for the European elite is whether we believe in the work of the past 20 years, whether we believe in an integrated European market and an ever-widening European Community.

zh: 如果我们失去了信心，那么首先是那些最大和最强的国家，其次是中欧所有的国家，都将弃欧洲大同之梦于不顾。
en: If not, then first the biggest and the strongest countries, and then the Central Europeans, will turn away from the European dream.

zh: 许多匈牙利人依然坚信过去20年是没有白费的，并坚信自己走的是一条正确的道路。
en: Those of us who believe that the past 20 years made sense, and that we are on the right track, are still the majority in Hungary.

zh: 世界和欧洲的每个人都需要一个统一的，强大的欧洲。
en: Everyone in Europe and the world needs a unified, robust Europe.

zh: 只要我们的信仰足够强大，我们就能渡过这次危机，也只有这样，我们当年开放边界迎接难民，推倒柏林墙，统一德国以及完成民主改革时所做出的一切努力，才不会付诸东流。
en: If our faith is strong enough, we can survive this crisis without destroying what we have built together by opening our borders, destroying the Wall, unifying Germany, and completing our democratic transitions.

zh: 经济领域的离心力和向心力
en: Centrifugal and Centripetal Forces on Economic Areas

zh: 发自斯坦福 — — 早在几年前笔者就预测说由于政治机构无力应对经济，文化，种族和宗教方面的差异，全球各地都将出现权力下放，分裂和独立等结构性转变。
en: STANFORD – Several years ago, I predicted that there would be a tectonic shift toward devolution, secession, and independence around the world, owing to the failure of political institutions to manage economic, cultural, ethnic, and religious differences.

zh: 超国家经济和政治制度将权力集中于中央政府的做法显然引起了反弹。
en: Supranational economic and political institutions were clearly generating a backlash, as they concentrated more power in central governments.

zh: 许多国家的公民开始觉得本国主权受到了侵蚀。
en: Citizens in many countries started to feel as though their sovereignty had been eroded.

zh: 此外他们也担心由于大衰退后复苏缓慢，生产力增长乏力和劳动力占收入份额下降，导致日渐增加的移民所产生的成本过高。
en: And they worried that the costs of increasing immigration were too high, given the slow recovery from the Great Recession, weak productivity growth, and labor’s declining share of income.

zh: 自那以后，英国决定退出欧盟。
en: Since then, the United Kingdom has decided to withdraw from the European Union.

zh: 现在双方已经在进行“离婚”讨论以确定英国该向欧盟支付的金额以及未来的贸易关系。
en: “Divorce” discussions are now underway to determine how much the British will pay the EU, and what future trade relations will look like.

zh: 这一过程绝非轻而易举，因为欧盟谈判代表担心如果自己开出退出条款太过慷慨，其他成员国可能会纷纷仿效英国退盟。
en: The process has not been easy, because EU negotiators are worried that if the exit terms are too generous, other member states might follow the UK out of the bloc.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普治下的美国已经退出了《跨太平洋伙伴关系》协议，放弃了与欧盟的《跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系》协议。
en: Meanwhile, the United States, under President Donald Trump, has withdrawn from the Trans-Pacific Partnership and abandoned the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership with the EU.

zh: 如今他还逼着墨西哥和加拿大作出让步，否则就威胁要退出《北美自由贸易协定 》 。
en: Now it is threatening to withdraw from the North American Free Trade Agreement unless Mexico and Canada make concessions.

zh: 在西班牙，10月1日，加泰罗尼亚自治区政府举行全民公投，有约43％的加泰罗尼亚人参加了投票且绝大多数选择独立。
en: In Spain, on October 1, the government of the semi-autonomous region of Catalonia held a referendum in which an estimated 43% of Catalans took part, voting overwhelmingly for independence.

zh: 加泰罗尼亚议会宣布独立后，西班牙国家政府援引一项宪法规定正式接管该地区，令危机进一步升级。
en: After the Catalan parliament declared independence, the Spanish national government invoked a constitutional provision to take administrative control of the region, escalating the crisis.

zh: 最近在意大利伦巴第和威尼托这两个最富庶地区举行的公民投票中，超过90%的投票者赞成要对当地的教育支出和税收拥有更多控制权。
en: Not to be outdone, more than 90% of those who participated in recent referenda in Lombardy and Veneto, Italy’s two richest regions, voted for more control over local education spending and taxes.

zh: 这些人显然对意大利的大量公共债务和对较贫困地区的补贴相当在意。
en: Italy’s massive public debt and subsidies to poorer regions were certainly on these voters’ minds.

zh: 但在十九世纪统一了意大利各城邦的朱塞佩·加里波第（Giuseppe Garibaldi）将军肯定会气得从坟墓里跳起来了。
en: But Giuseppe Garibaldi, the general who united Italy’s city-states in the nineteenth century, must be turning over in his grave.

zh: 此外，伊拉克的库尔德斯坦地区政府也在9月底举行了独立公投，现在正试图与派出部队收回该地区油田的巴格达中央政府进行谈判。
en: Elsewhere, Iraq’s Kurdistan Regional Government, having held an independence referendum in late September, is now trying to negotiate with the central government in Baghdad, which has sent troops to reclaim the region’s oil fields.

zh: 而中国国家主席习近平利用本月召开的中共十九大会议将更多的权力从各省转移到了北京的中央政府，从而进一步巩固了自身的权力。
en: And Chinese President Xi Jinping used this month’s 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China to consolidate his position further, by shifting more power from the provinces to the central government in Beijing.

zh: 即使在那些长期保持稳定的国家，中央集权和分权化政治机构之间也存在明显的紧张关系。
en: Even in countries long known for stability, there is a clear tension between centralized and decentralized political authority.

zh: 例如，一个名为“加州退美 ” （ Calexit）的团体正在试图促成一个加利福尼亚脱离美国的投票议案。
en: For example, a group called Calexit is trying to introduce a California ballot proposition to secede from the US.

zh: 根据初期民意调查，1/3的加利福尼亚人会支持这一举措。
en: According to early polls, one-third of Californians would support such an initiative.

zh: 本月初，加利福尼亚州州长杰里·布朗（Jerry Brown）签署了一项法案，宣布加利福尼亚州是一个“庇护州 ” — —这一重大象征性姿态表明该州不会全面配合特朗普政府执行联邦移民法的做法。
en: And early this month, California Governor Jerry Brown signed a bill declaring California a “sanctuary state” – a mostly symbolic gesture indicating that the state will not fully cooperate with the Trump administration’s efforts to enforce federal immigration law.

zh: 在国家层面上，美国国会共和党人徒劳地试图废除和取代2010年《平价医疗法案 》 （ Obamacare ） ， 想利用联邦整笔拨款的方式向各州转移更多的责任。
en: At the national level, congressional Republicans’ ill-fated attempt to repeal and replace the 2010 Affordable Care Act (Obamacare) sought to shift more responsibility to the states through federal block grants.

zh: 然而眼下正在讨论的共和党税收改革却建议消除联邦对各州和地方税收的减免，因为其他州认为这是对加州和纽约这类高税率州的补贴（但考虑到所有的财政互动和转移支付状况，其实是高税率州在补贴它们 ） 。
en: And yet, the Republican tax-reform proposal that is now being discussed would eliminate a federal tax deduction for state and local taxes that other states consider a subsidy for high-tax states like California and New York. (Netting all the fiscal interactions and transfers, the reverse is closer to the truth.)

zh: 在欧洲，欧盟继续在这个问题上虚与委蛇，而非处理主权债务，银行业，增长和失业方面的危机。
en: In Europe, the EU has continued to kick the can down the road, rather than deal with its crises in sovereign debt, banking, growth, and unemployment.

zh: 欧盟领导人希望温和的周期性上涨将会给他们争取点时间。
en: EU leaders are hoping that a modest cyclical upturn will buy them time.

zh: 但是最后还是要面对一个核心问题：德国这个从货币联盟中受益最大且贸易伙伴没有货币可以贬值的国家可不愿意为那些挥霍无度的成员国擦屁股了。
en: But, at the end of the day, they will still have to confront a core problem: Germany, which has benefited the most from a monetary union in which its trading partners have no currency to depreciate, doesn’t want to foot the bill for bailing out profligate member states.

zh: 因此不出所料，最近皮尤研究中心的调查结果显示，70％的欧洲人，加拿大人和美国人赞成实施更直接的民主“好让公民而不是民选官员来对重大问题投票 ” 。
en: It may come as no surprise that a recent Pew Research Center poll found that 70% of Europeans, Canadians, and Americans favor more direct democracy, “in which citizens, rather than elected officials, vote on major issues.”

zh: 不过这会令美国的国父们大惊失色，须知他们可是将直接民主视为暴民统治的前兆，并建立了一个制衡制度来防止这样一幕。
en: This would horrify America’s founders, who regarded direct democracy as a precursor to mob rule, and established a system of checks and balances precisely to prevent such an outcome.

zh: 上述每一个集权和权力下放的例子都有其特殊性，但也值得了解一下它们之间是否存在一些共同点。
en: Each of the aforementioned examples of centralization and devolution is unique. But it is worth asking if there are also commonalities among them.

zh: 当诺贝尔奖经济学奖获得者，理论层面的“欧元之父 ” ， 经济学家家罗伯特·蒙代尔（Robert Mundell）在确定最优货币区域时，他将自然贸易和宏观经济关系置于优先地位。
en: When the Nobel laureate economist Robert Mundell, the intellectual “father of the euro,” set out to determine an optimal currency area, he put a premium on natural trade and macroeconomic ties.

zh: 作为加拿大人，他不喜欢加拿大和美国货币区域“横向”性质。
en: As a Canadian, he was struck by the “horizontal” nature of the Canadian and American currency areas.

zh: 在他看来，涵盖加拿大和美国西部的“垂直”区域可能会有更多的经济意义。
en: To his mind, “vertical” areas comprising the Canadian and American west might make more economic sense.

zh: 蒙德尔的见解可以得到更广泛的应用。
en: Mundell’s insight can be applied much more broadly.

zh: 由于离心和向心力量的竞争，经济地区会不断形成，结合和分化。
en: Economic areas are continually forming, combining, and dissolving as a result of competing centrifugal and centripetal forces.

zh: 而比较优势，规模经济和交易成本的不断变化会影响到适应更为同质的本地化偏好所带来的好处。
en: Constant shifts in comparative advantages, economies of scale, and transaction costs affect the benefits of accommodating more homogeneous localized preferences.

zh: 同样，由于科技和人口的变化，以及两者与不断变化的文化，种族，宗教等因素的相互影响 ， “ 最佳”政治区域也随着时间的推移而发生变化。
en: Likewise, “optimal” political areas change over time, owing to changes in technology and demography, and their interaction with evolving cultural, ethnic, religious, and other factors.

zh: 而这些分分合合的过程可能有益或有害。
en: These processes of coming together and falling apart can be beneficial or harmful.

zh: 欧盟作为贸易区域无疑取得了巨大的成功，但作为劳动力市场和货币联盟就差强人意，作为银行和财政区域则是完完全全的失败。
en: The EU has certainly been a great success as a trade area, but less so as an integrated labor market and currency union; and it has altogether failed as a banking and fiscal area.

zh: 再看看拥有核弹头且互不信任的各邻国对自身和世界构成危险的印度次大陆。
en: Or consider the Indian subcontinent, where distrustful neighbors armed with nuclear warheads pose a danger to themselves and the world.

zh: 鉴于印度与巴基斯坦的穆斯林人口数目几乎相当，那么把这些人归于单一国家的范围内可能会有助于缓解宗教紧张局势。
en: Given that India still has almost as many Muslims as Pakistan, it is possible that religious tensions could have been mitigated within the confines of a single country.

zh: 据笔者估计，巴基斯坦和印度之间的贸易额应该比目前大25倍。
en: By my estimate, Pakistan and India’s current volume of trade should be 25 times higher than it is.

zh: 这将大大有利于两国，尤其是因为它们都能从对方的成功中获取更大的收益。
en: That would greatly benefit both countries, not least because they would each have a greater stake in the other’s success.

zh: 在经济，政治，种族和宗教多样性的背景下做好治理并不容易。
en: Governing well in a context of economic, political, ethnic, and religious diversity is not easy.

zh: 但是如果不这样做可能意味着极低的增长，以及极大的政治风险。
en: But failure to do so can mean substantially less growth – and substantially more political risk.

zh: 阻止夺去女性生命的第二大杀手
en: Stopping Women’s Next Biggest Killer

zh: 日内瓦 — — 对女性而言，将生命带到这个世界意味着用自己的生命冒险，分娩过程中不得不面对真实的死亡威胁。
en: GENEVA – For women, the act of bringing life into this world has historically meant risking their own lives, with the real prospect of death during childbirth.

zh: 虽然降低贫困国家孕产妇死亡率已经取得长足的进步，但女性健康领域所取得的进步正在遭受严重的威胁。
en: But, though great strides are being made in reducing maternal deaths in poor countries, those gains could be undone by a growing threat to women’s health.

zh: 每年因宫颈癌造成的死亡人数首次有望超越分娩而位居第一。
en: For the first time, the number of deaths caused by cervical cancer every year is poised to outstrip the total caused by childbirth.

zh: 上述趋势在一定程度上反映了孕产妇死亡人数的成功降低。
en: The trend partly reflects the success of efforts to reduce maternal deaths.

zh: 20世纪90年代后，死于分娩的女性人数为289,000人，相比之前减少了将近半数。
en: Since 1990, the number of women dying as a result of childbirth has been nearly halved, to 289,000 per year.

zh: 然而同期宫颈癌致死人数却攀升至266,000人，每年骤增近40 ％ 。
en: Over the same period, however, annual deaths from cervical cancer have increased by almost 40%, to 266,000.

zh: 虽然医疗标准提高不断降低孕产妇死亡率，但宫颈癌的死亡人数预计仍将延续升势。
en: Even as better standards of care continue to cut maternal mortality, cervical cancer deaths are expected to rise further.

zh: 截止2035年，预计该病每年将造成发展中国家（其中大部分生活在撒哈拉以南非洲和南亚）的416，000名女性缓慢而痛苦地死去。
en: By 2035, the disease is expected to cause 416,000 women to die slowly and painfully every year – virtually all of them in developing countries (mostly Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia).

zh: 悲剧在于这些死亡几乎完全可以防止。
en: The tragedy is that these deaths are almost entirely preventable.

zh: 人乳头状瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗辅之以筛查和治疗即可预防绝大多数宫颈癌病例。
en: Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccines, coupled with screening and treatment, could prevent the vast majority of cervical cancer cases.

zh: 但死于宫颈癌的女性近90％生活在发展中国家，那里有太多人无法享受到筛查，更不要说治疗服务。
en: But almost 90% of the women who die from cervical cancer are in developing countries, where, for too many of them, screening services are unavailable, and treatment even less so.

zh: 作为宫颈癌死亡人数列世界首位的印度卫生及家庭福利部前任辅助部长，我曾亲眼目睹过宫颈癌所造成的悲剧。
en: As former Additional Secretary at the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare in India, the country with the largest number of cervical cancer deaths in the world, I have seen the impact of the disease with my own eyes.

zh: 尤为严重的是这种病能将希望碾得粉碎。
en: What is particularly devastating is how it also quashes hope.

zh: 比方说感染艾滋病毒的女性特别容易感染宫颈癌。
en: Women with HIV, for example, are particularly prone to the disease.

zh: 随着艾滋病治疗越来越普及，那些劫后余生的女性之后却死于宫颈癌。
en: Yet, with better treatments for HIV becoming available, women are now surviving HIV only to die from cervical cancer.

zh: 2010年，宫颈癌造成的全球损失总额估计约为每年27亿美元。
en: In 2010, the total global cost of cervical cancer was estimated to be around $2.7 billion per year.

zh: 除非采取果断措施，否则截止2030年上述损失总额将增至47亿美元。
en: By 2030, this is expected to increase to $4.7 billion, unless we do something about it now.

zh: 所幸的是宫颈癌疫苗越来越普及。
en: Vaccines, fortunately, are becoming increasingly available.

zh: 安全有效的HPV疫苗2006年后已经上市，对16和18型HPV提供防护，感染以上两种病毒所导致的宫颈癌占全部病例的70 % 。
en: Safe and effective HPV vaccines have been on the market since 2006, protecting against HPV types 16 and 18, which cause 70% of all cervical cancer cases.

zh: 新批准的疫苗效果更为显著。
en: Newly approved vaccines provide even greater protection.

zh: 富裕国家HPV疫苗的价格高达上百美元一剂。
en: In wealthy countries, HPV vaccines are often priced at more than $100 per dose.

zh: 但疫苗联盟Gavi已经与制造企业合作使发展中国家的疫苗售价更加便宜。
en: But Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, has worked with manufacturers to reduce prices in developing countries.

zh: 不久前，我们实现了HPV疫苗单剂4.5美元的创纪录低价，让生活在27个国家的数百万贫困女孩能有接种的机遇。
en: Recently, we secured a record-low price for HPV vaccines of $4.50 a dose, opening the door for millions of the poorest girls to be vaccinated in 27 countries.

zh: 截止2020年，我们预计Gavi将能帮助40多个发展中国家超过3，000万名年轻女性完成抗HPV疫苗的接种任务。
en: By 2020, we estimate that Gavi will have helped over 30 million girls in more than 40 developing countries receive vaccinations against HPV.

zh: 疫苗的经济效益十分显著。
en: The economic benefits of vaccines are substantial.

zh: 需要花很长时间和大笔投资才能提供有效的筛查治疗服务。
en: It takes time and significant investment to set up effective screening and treatment services.

zh: 并且，考虑到即使高收入国家都难以承担癌症的治疗费用，预防显然是更为有效的措施。
en: And, given that even high-income countries struggle to meet the cost of cancer treatments, prevention is clearly a far more efficient option.

zh: 此外，女性多在盛年 — — 对社会和经济贡献最显著的时期遭受宫颈癌的侵袭。
en: Moreover, cervical cancer strikes women during their most economically productive years, when their contribution to society and the economy is greatest.

zh: 这种病不仅摧毁生命；而且破坏经济增长并让家庭一贫如洗。
en: The disease does not just destroy lives; it also impoverishes families and undermines economic growth.

zh: 世卫组织免疫战略咨询小组专家去年提出了进一步提升疫苗成本效益的建议。 他们呼吁仅注射两剂HPV疫苗，而不是之前认定的三剂。
en: A recommendation last year by the World Health Organization’s Strategic Advisory Group of Experts on Immunization promises to boost vaccines’ cost-effectiveness further, by calling for just two doses of the HPV vaccine, rather than the three doses previously thought to be required.

zh: 这不仅能降低疫苗的采购注射成本；还能让医疗工作者和年轻女性接种变得更加容易。
en: This will not only reduce the overall cost of vaccine procurement and delivery; it will also make it easier for health-care workers and the girls themselves.

zh: 世卫组织和伦敦卫生与热带医学院6月发表的一项研究预测，为179个国家的5，800万女童接种疫苗将防止690,000人感染宫颈癌，以及由此造成的420，000致死病例。
en: A study published by WHO and the London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine in June predicts that vaccinating 58 million girls in 179 countries would prevent 690,000 cases of cervical cancer and 420,000 deaths from the disease.

zh: 不幸的是，该研究还发现，在HPV疫苗预防癌症最有可能取得显著效果的33个国家中，有26个还没有引入疫苗接种机制。
en: Unfortunately, the study also found that of the 33 countries where HPV vaccines are most likely to have the greatest effect in preventing cancer, 26 had not yet introduced the vaccine.

zh: 还有许多工作要做。
en: There is much work to be done.

zh: 20世纪90年代后孕产妇死亡率降低近一半无疑值得庆祝，但宫颈癌所造成的威胁必须引起我们的高度重视。
en: We should congratulate ourselves for nearly halving the maternal death rate since 1990. But we must keep the threat of cervical cancer firmly in our sights.

zh: 当务之急是立即采取行动确保每位女孩都能接种HPV疫苗，从而在花样年华不受宫颈癌的困扰，而不管她生活在哪里。
en: It is imperative to act now to ensure that every girl has access to HPV vaccines and a healthy future free from cervical cancer, no matter where she lives.

zh: 非洲的自由贸易未来
en: Africa’s Free-Trade Future

zh: 卢萨卡 — — 当非洲领导人在定于2018年3月21日召开的卢旺达基加利首脑会议上发起成立大规模大陆自由贸易区（CFTA）时，避免推出某种空洞或冗余的条款应当是他们的首要任务。
en: LUSAKA – When African leaders launch the massive Continental Free Trade Area (CFTA) on March 21, 2018, at a summit in Kigali, Rwanda, their top priority should be to avoid rolling out something that is either hollow or redundant.

zh: 大陆自由贸易区是非洲联盟（AU）2063年议程框架下的12个旗舰计划之一，该计划可以使非洲国家内部贸易量增长一倍，并为非洲大陆带来巨大的利益。
en: The CFTA – one of 12 flagship programs under the African Union’s (AU) Agenda 2063 framework – could double intra-African trade and bring enormous benefits to the continent.

zh: 但究竟能取得何种成果还要在很大程度上取决于安排的最终形式。
en: But much will depend on the arrangement’s final shape.

zh: 一个积极的信号是非洲大陆自贸区将涵盖服务贸易，平均而言，服务贸易已经在非洲国家GDP中拥有超过50%的占比。
en: One positive sign is that the CFTA will include trade in services, which already contribute more than 50% of African countries’ GDPs, on average.

zh: 越来越多的研究表明服务将为非洲开拓新的社会和经济发展途径。
en: A growing body of research suggests that services will provide new social- and economic-development pathways for Africa.

zh: 在近期出版的非洲服务贸易潜力研究一书中，世界银行的Nora Dihel和Arti Grover Goswani所搜集的数据显示服务业具备为整个非洲大陆普通民众提供急需的就业和收入的潜力。
en: In their recent book The Unexplored Potential of Trade in Services in Africa, Nora Dihel and Arti Grover Goswani of the World Bank marshal data to show that services have the potential to provide much-needed employment and incomes for ordinary people across the continent.

zh: 通讯、交通、银行、保险、能源、教育及卫生等服务领域是发展的主要动力，而旅游业和建筑业目前具有最高的增长潜力。
en: Service industries such as communications, transportation, banking, insurance, energy, education, and health are key drivers of development, while both tourism and construction currently have high growth potential.

zh: 而且，对于许多青年专业人士而言，提供服务是他们谋生的唯一方式。
en: Moreover, for many young professionals, services are the only way to earn a living.

zh: 而随着创业型大学的出现 — — 其课程作业和毕业论文都更侧重于商业计划而非仅仅是纸面学位 — — 生机勃勃的服务市场将比以往任何时候都具必要性。
en: And with the emergence of entrepreneurial universities – where course work and dissertations produce business propositions rather than just paper degrees – vibrant services markets will become more necessary than ever.

zh: 但Dihel和Goswani也对“监管障碍”提出了警告。
en: But Dihel and Goswani also warn of “regulatory hurdles.”

zh: 非洲决策者需要超越非洲大陆自贸区内已经达成一致的初始框架，才能确定哪些行业可以纳入更广泛的统一服务市场。
en: African policymakers will need to go beyond the initial framework that has already been agreed under the CFTA, to identify sectors that can be brought into the fold of a wider, integrated services market.

zh: 接下来应当制定确立具体行业贸易、投资条款条件以及吸引资金的全面框架。
en: And a comprehensive framework to establish the terms and conditions of trade and investment in specific sectors, and to attract investment, should follow.

zh: 在选择助推行业时，应把重点放在基础设施和各国已通过世贸组织做出市场准入承诺的领域。
en: In selecting sectors to promote, the focus should be on infrastructure and areas where countries have already made market-access commitments through the World Trade Organization.

zh: 这意味着决策者应当把重点放在通信、旅游、银行、交通和能源，其次是教育、卫生和建筑服务。
en: That implies that policymakers should concentrate on communications, tourism, banking, transport, and energy, followed by education, health, and construction services.

zh: 今年早些时候，一个积极的进展是覆盖23个国家和非洲70%航空旅行的非盟非洲单一航空运输市场的建立。
en: One positive development came earlier this year with the establishment of the AU’s Single African Air Transport Market, which covers 23 countries and 70% of air travel in Africa.

zh: 货物贸易方面，非洲大陆自贸区的主要目标是开放市场并大幅降低关税。
en: As for trade in goods, the main goal of the CFTA is to open up markets through a broad reduction in tariffs.

zh: 但在此之前，非洲国家需要就降低进口壁垒达成共同的时间表。
en: But before that can happen, African countries need to agree on a common schedule for lowering their import barriers.

zh: 这可能需要在多利益相关方间进行复杂的谈判协调。
en: That will require potentially complex negotiations among multiple stakeholders.

zh: 为简化事务，或许通过组建国家集团来尽可能限制谈判方的数量显得至关重要。
en: To simplify matters, it will be important to keep the number of negotiating parties to a minimum, perhaps by forming country groupings.

zh: 除此之外，为避免谈判陷入停滞，应确定一份比较短的谈判时间表。
en: Beyond that, a fairly short timeframe for negotiations should be established, so that talks do not bog down.

zh: 除全面降低关税外，决策者还需要以提升区域价值链的方式来指定敏感和除外产品，包括加工农产品、化学品、汽车以及占最终产品价值60%的服务/物流投入。
en: Beyond across-the-board tariff reductions, policymakers will also need to designate sensitive and excluded products in a way that promotes regional value chains, including in agro-processing, chemicals, and automobiles, as well as in the services/logistics inputs that constitute up to 60% of the value of final products.

zh: 决策者还应当对允许除外的进口产品最大值进行限制。
en: Policymakers should also impose a cap on the maximum value of imports that can be excluded.

zh: 总体而言，非洲贸易涵盖的产品线已经较少，也就是说排除交易最多的产品将影响非洲内部贸易，从而使建立非洲大陆自贸区成为多余的举措。
en: On the whole, African trade already comprises relatively few product lines, which means that if the most-traded products are excluded, intra-African trade will suffer, and the entire CFTA will be rendered redundant.

zh: 尽管非洲大陆自贸区贸易只有制定了原产地规则才能启动，但参与各方至少已同意遵守世界海关组织认定的“附加值 ” 、 “物质含量 ” 、 “实质性转化”以及商品是否符合“完全原产标准”等相关规则。
en: Although trade under the CFTA regime will not begin until there are established rules of origin, participants have at least agreed to follow the World Customs Organization’s recognized criteria for determining “value addition,” “material content,” “substantial transformation,” and whether goods are “wholly obtained.”

zh: 尽管如此，为6000多种商品制定具体的产品规则可能需要时间（世贸组织花了27年才完成这项任务 ） 。
en: Still, producing product-specific rules for 6,000-odd goods can take a very long time (it has taken the WTO over 27 years).

zh: 为加快组建非洲大陆自贸区，非洲国家可以同意对附加值征收20-40%的最低关税，而将针对非原产材料的最高限额设定为60-80 % 。
en: To expedite the CFTA, African countries could agree to a general minimum threshold of 20-40% for value addition and a maximum of 60-80% for non-originating material.

zh: 与此同时，他们可以在既定的时间框架约束下，继续推进确定实质性转化和其他具体的产品规则。
en: And in the meantime, work on determining substantial transformation and other product-specific rules could continue, albeit with a set timeframe.

zh: 制定非洲大陆自贸区产品具体原产地规则的重要目标应当是促进非洲内部投入和其他中间产品的生产和贸易。
en: A critical objective in setting the CFTA’s product-specific rules of origin should be to promote the production and trade of inputs and other intermediate products within Africa.

zh: 即便承认某些投入无法避免地来自国外，但非洲大陆自贸区应当充分体现“非洲制造”的原则。
en: The CFTA should enshrine the principle of “Made in Africa,” even as it recognizes that some inputs will necessarily be sourced from abroad.

zh: 我们衷心希望非洲国家元首能踊跃出席本月举行的非盟基加利峰会。
en: One hopes that African heads of state will turn up in large numbers to the AU Kigali summit this month.

zh: 非洲大陆自贸区的启动为非洲树立了重要的里程碑。
en: The launch of the CFTA is a major milestone for Africa.

zh: 它将永久改变非洲大陆的经济地理版图和描述性定义。
en: It will permanently change the continent’s economic geography and defining narrative.

zh: 非洲领导人应借此机会向世界各国发出明确信号，即非洲已经为社会和经济转型做好了准备。
en: African leaders should use the occasion to send a clear message to the rest of the world that Africa is ready for a social and economic transformation.

zh: 贫困线战线
en: The Poverty Line’s Battle Lines

zh: 华盛顿—我曾经是一位大学教授，后来担任印度政府首席经济顾问，长期以来，我愉快地使用着世界银行全球贫困数据，追踪趋势，分析跨国模式。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – For a long time, as a college professor and then as the chief economic adviser to the Indian government, I was a happy user of the World Bank’s data on global poverty, tracking trends and analyzing cross-country patterns.

zh: 我很少停下来想一想这些数字是怎么计算出来的。
en: I seldom paused to think about how those numbers were computed.

zh: 后来，三年前，我成为世界银行首席经济学家。
en: Then, three years ago, I joined the World Bank as its Chief Economist.

zh: 这种感觉就像你原先是一位在最喜欢的饭店预定晚宴的快乐客户，突然之间被要求进入厨房准备晚宴。
en: It was like a customer, happily ordering dinner in a favorite restaurant, suddenly being asked to go into the kitchen and prepare the meal.

zh: 衡量贫困这个责任对世界银行来说是一项挑战。
en: Being in the business of measuring poverty is a challenge for the World Bank.

zh: 如果贫困减少，批评者会指责我们是在炫功。
en: If poverty declines, critics accuse us of trying to showcase our success.

zh: 如果贫苦增加，他们又说我们在“刷存在感 ” 。
en: If it rises, they say we are ensuring that we stay in business.

zh: 如果贫困保持不变，那么我们就会同时受到这两种批评。
en: And if it stays the same, they accuse us of trying to avoid these two charges.

zh: 幸运的是，知道不论结果如何都会被批评倒也让你觉得有些自由。
en: Fortunately, there is something liberating in knowing that you will be criticized for any outcome.

zh: 但是，在我们的团队即将定义今年的全球贫困线（从而确定贫困率）之际，我强烈地感到今年诺贝尔经济学奖获得者安格斯·迪顿的谨慎观点 ： “ 我不知道世界银行花这么大力气搞这项工作是否明智。 ”
en: Still, as our team set about defining the global poverty line this year (and thus the incidence of poverty), I was acutely aware of the note of caution from Angus Deaton, this year’s Nobel laureate in economics: “I am not sure it is wise for the World Bank to commit itself so much to this project.”

zh: 我可以理解他的观点：今年贫困情况的计算特别关键。
en: I could see his point: This year’s poverty calculation was particularly momentous.

zh: 2011年，我们计算了新购买力平价（简称PPP，其实质是估算1美元在不同国家可以买到多少东西 ） ， 并在2014年公开。
en: In 2011, new purchasing power parities (or PPPs, which essentially estimate how much $1 dollar buys in different countries) had been computed, and the data became available in 2014.

zh: 这是评估我们如何调整全球贫困线、估算新贫困数据并将它们发表在今年10月发布的《全球监测报告 》 （ Global Monitoring Report）中的一个原因。
en: This was one reason to take stock of how we would adjust the global poverty line, estimate new poverty numbers, and publish them in our Global Monitoring Report, which was released in October.

zh: 第二个原因是联合国将根除长期贫困列入了其可持续发展目标。
en: A second reason is that the UN has included the eradication of chronic poverty in its new Sustainable Development Goals.

zh: 这意味着我们决定将贫困线画在哪里可能不但会影响世界银行的使命，也会影响联合国及世界全体国家的发展日程。
en: This means that our decision on where to draw the poverty line probably will influence not just the World Bank’s mission but also the development agenda of the UN and all countries around the world.

zh: 显然，在我们计算数字时，肩负着特殊的艰巨任务。
en: Clearly, as we crunched the numbers, we had a special, and daunting, responsibility to fulfill.

zh: 我们的第一个任务是研究此前的全球贫困线是如何决定的。
en: Our first task was to see how the global poverty line had been determined earlier.

zh: 2005年上一次购买力平价计算时，所使用的方法是选取15个最贫困国家的国家贫困线，计算它们的平均值作为全球贫困线。
en: In 2005, when the previous round of purchasing power parities was estimated, the method used was to take the national poverty lines of the 15 poorest countries, compute their average, and treat that as the global line.

zh: 这样算出来的全球贫困线是1.25美元。
en: This led to a global poverty line of $1.25.

zh: 其背后的思想是，任何经PPP调整的每日消费额低于1.25美元的人都是穷人。
en: The idea was that a poor person was anyone whose PPP-adjusted daily consumption fell short of $1.25.

zh: 这一方法的合理性收到了质疑 — — 我也有自己的保留意见。
en: The validity of this method has been questioned – and I have had my own reservations.

zh: 但��某种意义上讲，第一年将这条线划在何处并不那么重要。
en: But where the line is drawn in the initial year is in some sense not that important.

zh: 因为贫困没有独一无二的定义，重要的是将贫困线划在合理的位置，保持这条线的真实（经通胀调整的）水平不变，以便我们追踪世界和个体国家不同时间的表现。
en: Because there is no unique definition of poverty, what matters is to draw a line at some reasonable place and then hold the line constant in real (inflation-adjusted) terms so that we can track the performance of the world and individual countries over time.

zh: 一些批评指出，2005年的贫困线（1.25美元）太低了。
en: Some critics argue that the 2005 poverty line of $1.25 was too low.

zh: 但他们应该警觉地认识到，2011年全世界有14.5%的人口 — — 也就是七分之一 — — 生活在这条线以下。
en: But what should alarm them is that in 2011, some 14.5% of the world’s population – one in every seven people – lived below it.

zh: 我们已经许下了在2030年终结极端长期贫困的承诺，我们的第一个决定是保持衡量贫困的基准线不变。
en: Given that we are already committed to the goal of ending extreme, chronic poverty by 2030, our first decision was to hold the yardstick for measuring poverty constant.

zh: 2005和2011年两次PPP计算期间存在通胀，因此我们显然必须提高名义贫困线以保持真实贫困线不变。
en: Since there had been inflation between the two rounds of the PPP computation, in 2005 and 2011, we would obviously have to raise the nominal poverty line to keep the real line constant.

zh: 但是，对整个世界做这件事绝不容易。
en: However, doing this for the world as a whole is far from easy.

zh: 我们应该用哪些国家的通胀率？
en: Which countries’ inflation should we use?

zh: 我们做了两个实验：其一是用2005年所选取的15个国家来调整贫困线，用它们各自的通胀率取平均值；其二方法相同，但选取101个有必要数据的国家。
en: We ran two experiments: one was to inflate the poverty lines of the 15 countries used in 2005, using their respective inflation rates and then taking an average; the other was to do the same for 101 countries for which we had the necessary data.

zh: 这两种方法将贫困线分别提高到1.88美元和1.90美元。
en: These two methods raised the line to $1.88 and $1.90, respectively.

zh: 但是，还有第三种方法：根据新的PPP指数提高贫困线，以保持全球贫困率不变（因为PPP实际上是跨国平价，不会改变全球贫困的绝对水平 ） 。
en: However, a third approach was possible: to raise the poverty line with the new PPP indices so that the incidence of global poverty remained unchanged (because PPP arguably tells us about parity across countries and should not change the absolute level of global poverty).

zh: 这一方法 — — 看起来像是星球的怪异对齐方式 — — 所产生的贫困线略高于1.90美元。
en: This exercise – and it was beginning to look like a strange alignment of the stars – resulted in a poverty line just above $1.90.

zh: 简言之，如果保留一位小数，那么三种方法都是1.9美元。
en: In short, by keeping to one decimal place, all three methods led to $1.9.

zh: 这就是我们所采用的贫困线。
en: And that is the line we adopted.

zh: 我们并不总能那么幸运，可以用不同方法得到几乎相同的贫困线。
en: We will not always have the good fortune to be able to use different methods and still arrive at virtually the same line.

zh: 此外，贫困可以也应该用除了钱以外的诸多标准衡量：寿命预期、教育程度、健康以及各种其他人类“机能和能力”指标（阿玛蒂亚·森语）都很重要。
en: Furthermore, poverty can and should be measured by many metrics other than money: life expectancy, educational attainment, health, and various other measures of human “functionings and capabilities” (as Amartya Sen calls them) are all important.

zh: 要想在未来解决这些问题并扩展世界银行的贫困研究，我们成立了一个24人的全球贫困委员会，由来自伦敦经济学院和牛津大学纳菲尔德学院的阿特金森爵士（Sir Tony Atkinson）担任委员长。 委员会将在明年春天递交报告。
en: To tackle these problems in the future and broaden the World Bank’s poverty research, we have established the 24-member Commission on Global Poverty – chaired by Sir Tony Atkinson of the London School of Economics and Nuffield College, Oxford – which will submit its report next spring.

zh: 衡量贫困问题吸引了政客和学者的关注 — — 在这两方面我们都不缺人手。
en: Measuring poverty attracts attention from both politicians and academic researchers – and we had an ample amount of both.

zh: 我们关注贫困的政治学，但拒绝政治游说。
en: We were attentive to the politics of poverty, but we resisted political lobbying.

zh: 我们考虑研究者的建议，但使用我们自己的判断。
en: We took account of the suggestions of researchers, but we used our judgment.

zh: 一位研究者坚决要求贫困线应该是1.9149美元。
en: One researcher was adamant that the poverty line should be $1.9149.

zh: 我说后三位小数有点多余了。
en: I decided that those last three digits were a bit excessive.

zh: 从内部改变非洲
en: Change Africa from Within

zh: 罗马 — — 严重的粮食危机正在威胁着苏丹南部。
en: ROME – A severe food crisis currently threatens southern Sudan.

zh: 在已经有成百上千万人依赖粮食援助生活的东非，主食作物成本的飙升令人担忧。
en: In East Africa, where millions of people already are dependent on food aid, a sharp rise in the cost of staple crops looms.

zh: 这只是动荡时期最新出现的忧虑因素，粮食动荡始于两年前，当时全球范围的价格猛涨导致非洲和亚洲的很多国家面临着粮食短缺的袭击。
en: These are just the latest sources of concern in a turbulent period that began two years ago when food shortages hit many countries in Africa and Asia due to a worldwide spike in prices.

zh: 粮食价格上涨意味着已经难以满足人类基本需求的穷人被更深地推入了贫困的境地。
en: Higher food prices meant that poor people, already struggling to meet basic human needs, were pushed deeper into poverty.

zh: 不久全球金融危机又接踵而来，贫困人口再次受到了最沉重的打击。
en: On its heels came the global financial crisis, which also hit the poorest the hardest.

zh: 农业在绝大多数发展中国家是最重要的雇主、就业机会创造者和出口拉动领域。
en: Agriculture is the main employer, job creator, and export in most developing countries.

zh: 从历史角度看，农业曾经推动了许多国家的经济发展，事实证明由农业推动的增长其消除贫困的效果是其他行业增长的两倍。
en: Historically, agriculture has driven economic performance in many countries, generating growth that has been shown to be at least twice as effective in reducing poverty as growth in other sectors.

zh: 因此对农业和农村发展的投资对确保粮食安全和可持续经济发展能够起到至关重要的作用。
en: Investment in agricultural and rural development is therefore vital to food security and sustainable economic development.

zh: 实际上，当前绝大多数发达国家都拥有坚实的农业基础，享受着产能过剩所带来的繁荣和财富。
en: Indeed, the vast majority of today’s developed countries grew from strong agricultural foundations, where surplus production generated wealth and prosperity.

zh: 越南目前的状况就是这样，中国和印度在成为经济发展的引擎之前也走过了同样的道路。
en: This is what is happening today in Vietnam, and it is the path that China and India took on their way to becoming engines of economic growth.

zh: 贫困主要集中在农村地区。
en: Poverty is predominantly rural.

zh: 全球范围内，约有四分之三的极端贫困人口生活在农村，依靠农业和相关活动维持生计。
en: Globally, three-quarters of people living in extreme poverty are in rural areas and depend on agriculture and related activities for their livelihoods.

zh: 撒哈拉南部非洲的大约3亿8千万妇女、儿童和男人每天仅靠不到1.25美元维持生活。
en: About 380 million women, children, and men in sub-Saharan Africa live on less than $1.25 a day.

zh: 很多人营养不良，整天饿着肚子。
en: Many are malnourished or hungry.

zh: 但是在撒哈拉以南非洲8千万小农产出80%农产品的情况下，这些小农在化解金融和粮食危机、释放非洲的自给自足潜能方面发挥着至关重要的作用。
en: But, with some 80 million small farms in sub-Saharan Africa producing 80% of agricultural goods, smallholder farmers have a key role to play in resolving the financial and food crises and unleashing Africa’s potential to feed itself.

zh: 为确保粮食安全、实现脱贫，需要为发展释放农业潜能所必须的非洲农业及相关基础设施 — — 特别是道路、通讯和能源 — — 付出不懈的努力。
en: In order to lift people out of poverty and ensure food security, a sustained effort is needed to develop Africa’s agriculture and the associated infrastructure – notably roads, telecommunication, and energy – needed to unleash agricultural potential.

zh: 加强农业建设是任何非洲国家最好的投资之一。
en: Strengthening agriculture is one of the best investments any African country can make.

zh: 非盟成员国2003年在莫桑比克的马普托就此达成一致，承诺至少拿出10%的国家预算用于追加农业投资。
en: Members of the African Union recognized this in 2003 in Maputo, Mozambique, pledging to increase spending on agriculture to at least 10% of national budgets.

zh: 虽然有8个国家都达到或者超越了这一目标，但非洲大陆作为一个整体却没有完成任务。
en: Although eight countries have met or surpassed that target, the continent as a whole has not.

zh: 而仅仅达到这一目标也还远远不够。
en: But reaching this target is not enough.

zh: 政府必须创造出合适的政策环境，允许在研究和发展领域的恰当投资提高生产率并增加产量。
en: Governments must create the right policy environment to allow for appropriate investments in research and development to enhance productivity and increase production.

zh: 非洲农业投资必须致力于打造一个充满活力的小农部门。
en: Investment in agriculture in Africa must focus on creating a dynamic smallholder sector.

zh: 生机勃勃的农村部门创造出土产商品和服务的当地需求。
en: A vibrant rural sector generates local demand for locally produced goods and services.

zh: 这反过来又会刺激可持续的非农就业增长，这些增长来自服务业、农产品加工和小规模制造。
en: In turn, this can spur sustainable non-farm employment growth in services, agro-processing, and small-scale manufacturing.

zh: 这对于农村就业至关重要，若非如此，贫困的农村青年就会被迫背井离乡，到城里去寻找工作。
en: This is crucial for rural employment, without which poor rural young people will be driven away from their communities in search of work in the cities.

zh: 农业、主要是小农农业，占到了撒哈拉沙漠以南非洲各国国内生产总值的约30 % ， 出口商品总值的40%以上。
en: Agriculture, predominantly on a small scale, accounts for about 30% of sub-Saharan Africa’s GDP and at least 40% of export value.

zh: 在几个非洲小国，农业发挥的作用甚至更大，占到出口收入的80%甚至更多。
en: In a number of small countries in Africa, agriculture plays an even greater role, representing 80% or more of export earnings.

zh: 除非非洲国家出台合适的政策帮助农业发展和繁荣，否则将无法发挥以上数据中埋藏的潜力。
en: The potential in these numbers will remain untapped unless African countries put the right policies in place to help agriculture to develop and flourish.

zh: 但除非私有部门充分进入农业生产、加工和销售领域，否则非洲农业将无法成功转型。
en: But transformation of African agriculture will not happen until the private sector is fully engaged in agricultural production, processing, and marketing.

zh: 政府必须更多地为投资者着想，以便吸引私有部门更多的兴趣。
en: Governments must become more investor-friendly to attract greater private-sector interest.

zh: 从更广义的角度讲，非洲国家需要规范自己的政治和经济秩序。
en: More broadly, African countries need to put their political and economic houses in order.

zh: 他们必须继续深化民主的基础，并确保对经济增长起关键作用的政治稳定。
en: They must continue to deepen the foundations of democracy and ensure the political stability that is so critical to economic growth.

zh: 还有一点至关重要，那就是他们继续完善体制建设，为农村经济发展创造出有利的环境，实现从自耕农到企业家的转型。
en: It is also crucial that they continue to improve their systems to create an enabling environment for dynamic rural growth to transform subsistence farmers into entrepreneurs.

zh: 由于不仅是母亲和照顾者，同时也承担着耕种者的任务，能否确保粮食安全在很大程度上取决于农村妇女。
en: Given their central role not only as mothers and caregivers, but also as farmers, rural women hold the key to food security.

zh: 因此不给妇女提供机会的国家永远不会发挥出所有的潜力。
en: That is why any nation that does not provide opportunities for women will not reach its full potential.

zh: 非洲必须在推动妇女授权及其社会地位，特别是在土地和信贷方面取得重大的进步。
en: Significant progress must be made in Africa to advance both women’s empowerment and their status in society – particularly with regard to land and credit.

zh: 最后，尽管发展援助投资是支持非洲发展的关键所在，但国家终究要为自己的发展负责。
en: Finally, although investment in development assistance is key to supporting Africa’s advancement, nations will ultimately have to take responsibility for their own development.

zh: 没有哪国的国家和人民所经历的发展完全来自于国外的援助。
en: No nation, no people, ever experienced growth that sprang solely from external support.

zh: 因此非洲发展必须发生在非洲、由非洲人推动、为非洲人服务。
en: So Africa’s development must be made in Africa, by Africans, for Africans.

zh: 每棵树、每株小苗，都必须完全植根于自己的土壤，才能生根���芽、茁壮成长。
en: Every tree, every plant, must be fully rooted in its own soil to flourish.

zh: 变革不可能来自外力的作用，而必须是来源于内部自发的要求。
en: Change cannot be imposed from outside, it must be cultivated from within.

zh: 走出中东噩梦
en: Waking from the Middle East Nightmare

zh: 马德里—中东似乎陷入了没完没了的动荡循环。
en: MADRID – The Middle East is caught in a seemingly endless spiral of instability.

zh: 对叙利亚进行军事干预的可能性，以及军事政变以来埃及局势的恶化，都让该地区走在剃刀边缘。
en: The possibility of military intervention in Syria, together with the deteriorating situation in Egypt since the army’s coup, has placed the region on a razor’s edge.

zh: 此外，尽管6月总统选举令伊朗有所改观，但关于其核雄心的国际谈判仍难以取得进展。
en: Moreover, despite the changes in Iran since its presidential election in June, international negotiations over its nuclear ambitions remain a dead letter.

zh: 奇怪的是，美国传统中东盟友（沙特、以色列、土耳其、埃及和海湾国家）在地区关键冲突中采取了反对 — — 有时似乎是矛盾的 — — 立场。
en: Paradoxes abound, as the United States’s traditional Middle East allies (Saudi Arabia, Israel, Turkey, Egypt, and the Gulf states) have taken opposing – and sometimes seemingly contradictory – positions on the region’s key conflicts.

zh: 而在当今所有热点中，邻国或周边国家的利益主张让情况进一步复杂化了。
en: And, in all of today’s hotspots, the assertion of interests by neighboring or nearby countries has complicated matters further.

zh: 沙特担心穆斯林兄弟会在埃及的掌权会引起其国内的严重后果，不愿意看到伊斯兰运动民主地获得合法性。
en: Saudi Arabia, fearing severe domestic consequences from the Muslim Brotherhood’s empowerment in Egypt, does not want to see an Islamist movement legitimized democratically.

zh: 因此它对穆兄会的立场一贯强硬，尽管后者倒是比沙特国内的伊斯兰教政党更为温和。
en: So it has taken a consistently harsh position against the Brotherhood, despite the latter being more moderate than the Saudis’ own brand of Islam.

zh: 以色列通过两个侧面施加影响。
en: Israel, for its part, is exerting pressure in two ways.

zh: 首先，它支持埃及政变和对军事政权的国际承认，从而确保 — — 它希望如此 — — 西奈半岛边境的进一步稳定。
en: First, it is supporting the Egyptian coup and international recognition of the military regime, thereby ensuring – it hopes – greater stability along the Sinai border.

zh: 其次，其与巴勒斯坦的谈判的进展取决于埃及和地区其他国家（如伊朗）事件的走向。
en: Second, it is making progress in its negotiations with the Palestinians dependent on events in Egypt and elsewhere in the region, such as Iran.

zh: 美国国务卿克里对重启和平谈判投入了极大的政治资本，以色列也可以利用这一点。
en: US Secretary of State John Kerry has invested considerable political capital in the revival of peace negotiations, and Israel can use that to its advantage as well.

zh: 与此同时，叙利亚内战点燃了贯穿整个地区的逊尼派-什叶派裂痕，比如沙特与伊朗。
en: The civil war in Syria, meanwhile, has inflamed the Sunni-Shia fault line that traverses the entire region, and that defines, for example, the rivalry between Saudi Arabia and Iran.

zh: 事实上，沙特尽管反对伊斯兰教在埃及获得选举胜利，但却支持伊斯兰教在叙利亚的反抗，这完全是因为伊朗支持叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权。
en: In fact, while Saudi Arabia opposes elected Islamists in Egypt, it supports insurgent Islamists in Syria, owing entirely to Iran’s support for Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s regime.

zh: 埃及政变已经证明是个错误。
en: The Egyptian coup has already proved to have been a mistake.

zh: 军队似乎想要重回前总统穆巴拉克在过去30年所走的统治之路，甚至恢复人心惶惶的安全制度。
en: The military seems to be reverting to the governing methods – and even the feared security institutions – of former President Hosni Mubarak’s 30-year rule.

zh: 穆巴拉克本人也从监狱中被释放。
en: Even Mubarak himself has now been released from prison.

zh: 军队对穆斯林兄弟会的镇压与其说是宗教问题，不如说是权力斗争。
en: The army’s repression of the Muslim Brotherhood is more a question of competition for power than of religion.

zh: 作为埃及唯一能对军队构成挑战的有组织力量，穆兄会是军队面临的最大威胁，穆尔西在被推翻一年前获得总统选举胜利就说明了这一点。
en: As the only organized force in the country that could seriously challenge the military, the Brotherhood is the greatest threat that the Army faces, as demonstrated by Mohamed Morsi’s victory in the election that made him president a year before he was overthrown.

zh: 而位居所有这些问题之上的伊朗核计划问题仍没有得到解决。
en: And, on top of it all, the problem posed by Iran’s nuclear program remains unresolved.

zh: 这或许并不奇怪，因为该地区处处都是暴力和动荡。
en: That may not be surprising, given the violence and turmoil elsewhere in the region.

zh: 但是，自伊朗新总统鲁哈尼8月就职以来，坦白说西方并没有拿出足够的意愿试图打开局面。
en: But, since Iran’s new president, Hassan Rouhani, took office at the beginning of August, the West, to put it bluntly, has not demonstrated sufficient will to explore possible openings.

zh: 这是一个严重的错误，因为与伊朗就其核计划的谈判的进展将为解决该地区其他问题创造有利条件。
en: That is a grave mistake, because progress in the negotiations with Iran over its nuclear program would create a more propitious climate for resolving the region’s other problems.

zh: 此外，如今谈判将由伊朗总统办公厅负责，这给了鲁哈尼更大的施展空间。
en: Moreover, the negotiations will now be under the jurisdiction of Iran’s presidential administration, which gives Rouhani greater room for maneuver.

zh: 新任外交部长扎里夫（Javad Zarif）在所有参与谈判的国家领导人中间拥有极高的知名度和尊敬度，他将在任何谈判中起到重要作用。
en: The new foreign minister, Mohammad Javad Zarif, is well known and respected by the leaders of all of the countries participating in the negotiations, and he will assume important responsibilities in any talks that take place.

zh: 尽管谨慎为上，但鲁哈尼当选的重要意义不容忽视。
en: While caution is certainly in order, the importance of Rouhani’s election must be recognized.

zh: 如果机会窗口打开，西方应该尽可能加以利用。
en: If a window of opportunity has opened, the West should do everything possible to take advantage of it.

zh: 我们也不应该忘记，鲁哈尼的胜利是以出人意料的约75%的优势获得的，虽然他在投票前被普遍看低。
en: Rouhani, it should be remembered, won a surprising victory in an election with roughly 75% voter turnout, despite expectations of widespread apathy.

zh: 鲁哈尼通过明确的经济复兴计划受到了伊朗人民的支持，该计划暗示伊朗将参与国际社会 — — 因此也包括核谈判。
en: Rouhani mobilized Iranians by offering a clear program for economic renewal, which hinges on Iran’s engagement with the international community – and thus on progress in nuclear negotiations.

zh: 自上任以来，鲁哈尼快速地响应了伊朗公众的要求。
en: Since taking office, Rouhani has responded quickly to the Iranian public’s demands.

zh: 从成员的经济改革和国际关系立场看，他能够组成如此内阁着实令观察者大跌眼镜。
en: His cabinet, in terms of its members’ positions on economic reform and international relations, is one that few observers believed he would be capable of assembling.

zh: 因此，两个重要步骤已经完成：其中一步由伊朗人民跨出，他们证明了他们清楚他们所面临的的挑战；另一步由他们的新总统跨出，他组成了可获得的最佳团队来承担非常困难的任务。
en: Thus, two important steps have been taken: one by the people of Iran, who have shown that they understand the challenges they face, and the other by their new president, who has assembled the best team available to undertake an enormously difficult program.

zh: 伊朗的一种观点也适用于国际社会 ： “ 你永远无法唤醒一个装睡的人。
en: There is an expression in Iran that applies to the international community: “You can wake only someone who is sleeping, not someone who is pretending to be asleep.”

zh: ”伊朗的国际谈判员是否能借鲁哈尼的当选有所作为是一种选择，而不是撞大运。
en: Whether Iran’s international interlocutors act on the importance of Rouhani’s election is a matter of choice, not of ignorance.

zh: 在充满了不确定性的中东，更加可预料的伊朗 — — 像地区大国那样作为，而不再是一场野心突破了国际法允许范围的破坏性什叶派运动 — — 符合所有人的利益。
en: In a Middle East so full of uncertainty, a more predictable Iran – one that behaves like a regionally important state, not a destabilizing Shia movement whose ambitions exceed what international law permits – would be in everyone’s interest.

zh: 只有所有各方都拿出参与、承诺和决心，中东才有可能找到走出困境的道路。
en: There can be no path from the Middle East’s agony without the participation, commitment, and determination of all parties.

zh: 鲁哈尼前线
en: The Rowhani Front

zh: 华盛顿—6月17日，在其作为伊朗当选总统后的第一次新闻发布会上，哈桑·鲁哈尼并未开启伊朗伊斯兰共和国与西方关系的新篇章。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – On June 17, at his first press conference as Iran’s President-elect, Hassan Rowhani broke little new ground in the Islamic Republic’s relations with the West.

zh: 在核政策方面，他说“暂停期已经过去 ” ： 伊朗不会在即将进行的谈判中接受暂停铀浓缩计划，但会寻求让其核活动更加透明以建立国际信心。
en: On nuclear policy, he said that the “era of suspension is over”: Iran will not accept the suspension of uranium enrichment in upcoming negotiations but will seek to make its nuclear activities more transparent in order to build international confidence.

zh: 此外，只要美国停止试图干涉伊朗内部事务并停止“恃强凌弱 ” ， 伊朗欢迎与美国进行直接谈判。
en: Moreover, Iran would welcome direct negotiations with the United States if the US stopped attempting to meddle in Iran’s internal affairs and abandoned its “bullying attitude.”

zh: 所有这些说法都无甚新意。
en: None of these statements is new.

zh: 这意味着世界不必指望鲁哈尼当选后伊朗官方行为会有实质性改变吗？
en: Does that mean that the world should not expect meaningful change in Iran’s official behavior following Rowhani’s victory?

zh: 大选前的总体印象是伊朗最高领袖哈梅内伊支持贾里里（Saeed Jalili）或卡利巴夫（Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf ） 。 近几年来，贾里里一直是伊朗核计划问题国际谈判伊方首席代表。
en: The general impression before the election was that Iran’s Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Hosseini Khamenei, supported either Saeed Jalili or Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf. In recent years, Jalili has been the leading Iranian representative in international negotiations over the country’s nuclear program.

zh: 这让他成为鲁哈尼和另一位候选人维拉雅迪（Ali Akbar Velayati，哈梅内伊国际事务顾问）的批评目标。
en: That made him the main target of criticism by Rowhani and another candidate, Ali Akbar Velayati, Khamenei’s adviser on international affairs.

zh: 按照鲁哈尼和维拉雅迪的说法，尽管近几年来伊朗增加了核研究计划中离心机的使用数量，其成本之高在国际制裁下成为一场经济噩梦。
en: According to Rowhani and Velayati, while Iran in recent years has increased the number of centrifuges in use in its nuclear research program, the cost has been an economically devastating array of international sanctions.

zh: 鲁哈尼承诺在推进核计划的同时采取更强硬、更睿智的外交手段防止新制裁的实施并为取消现有制裁铺平道路。
en: Rowhani promised to sustain progress on the nuclear program while adopting stronger and wiser diplomatic measures to prevent the imposition of new sanctions and pave the way for lifting the existing ones.

zh: 贾里里在伊朗国内并非要人。
en: Jalili had not been a high-profile figure within the country.

zh: 伊朗人此前从未看到他在媒体上谈论公共事件，不但讨论核政策，也讨论他关于女性、年轻人和文化问题的极端保守政策。
en: For the first time, average Iranians saw him at public events and in the media, discussing not only nuclear policy, but also his ultra-conservative policy agenda for women, youth, and cultural issues.

zh: 最终，他在这些事务上表现得比卸任总统内贾德更加激进。
