en: He ended up appearing even more radical on these topics than outgoing President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad.

zh: 卡利巴夫是德黑兰市长，他骄傲地承认自己直接参与了2003年对学生游行的暴力镇压。
en: As for Qalibaf, the mayor of Tehran, he proudly confessed that he was directly involved in the violent crackdown on student protesters in 2003.

zh: 事实上，他自称坐在一辆摩托车上，挥舞指挥棒指挥警察部队镇压群众示威。
en: Indeed, he described sitting on the back of a motorcycle with a stick to command police forces to suppress the massive demonstrations.

zh: 鲁哈尼充分利用了这一点反对他。
en: Rowhani used this against him very effectively.

zh: 保守派试图说服他们的候选人团结在一个人物背后，但较弱的候选人并没有退出而为统一候选人让路。
en: Conservatives tried to convince their candidates to unite behind a single figure, but weaker candidates did not drop out in favor of a unity candidate.

zh: 特别是，有大量证据表明伊斯兰革命卫队（Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps ，IRGC）分裂成两大派别，一派支持贾里里，另一派支持卡利巴夫。
en: In particular, there is strong evidence that the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) split into two major factions, with one supporting Jalili and the other backing Qalibaf.

zh: 比如，IRGC圣城旅（Quds Force）指挥官苏雷玛尼（Qassem Suleimani）支持卡利巴夫，认为后者能获得哈梅内伊的全力支持。
en: For example, Qassem Suleimani, the commander of the Quds Force, a branch of the IRGC, endorsed Qalibaf, who he hoped would receive Khamenei’s full support.

zh: 保守派和IRGC内部的暗斗在大选前数日愈演愈烈。
en: The infighting among conservatives and within the IRGC increased in the last few days before the election.

zh: 随着鲁哈尼出人意料地赢得第一轮胜利 — — 以及哈梅内伊拒绝支持两人中的任何一人 — — IRGC两大派别都吃了败仗。
en: And, with Rowhani’s surprising first-round victory – and Khamenei’s refusal to endorse either candidate – both IRGC factions lost.

zh: 哈梅内伊的置身事外、让公众选择获胜或许是明智的。
en: Khamenei was probably wise to step aside and let popular opinion prevail.

zh: 如果贾里里或卡利巴夫当选，IRGC内部的紧张之势可能会恶化，让哈梅内伊难以控制。
en: Had either Jalili or Qalibaf been elected, the tension within the IRGC might have worsened, becoming difficult for Khamenei to control.

zh: 而通过保持中立，哈梅内伊得以让IRGC明白其权力是有限的。
en: And, by remaining on the sidelines, Khamenei may have been seeking to show the IRGC that there are limits to its power.

zh: 鲁哈尼与军方和治安力量关系良好，但他显然被认为是外部人士。
en: Though well connected to the military and security community, Rowhani was clearly considered an outsider.

zh: 事实上，此前他一直不是政治人物，在伊斯兰共和国第一个十年中任军职，其中最后两年的大部分时间在最高国家安全委员会任职。
en: Indeed, he was not a political figure until now, serving in the military during the Islamic Republic’s first decade and spending the last two mostly in the Supreme National Security Council.

zh: 内贾德掌权后，鲁哈尼失去了委员会秘书的职务，但成为哈梅内伊在委员会的个人代表并一直担任这一角色至今。
en: When Ahmadinejad came to power, Rowhani lost his position as the Council’s secretary, but became Khamenei’s personal representative to it – a post that he has held until now.

zh: 不管哈梅内伊是认真策划了鲁哈尼的胜利，还是他只是认为阻止这一幕成本太高，鲁哈尼至少可以在推进哈梅内伊的日程方面不亚于任何其他候选人。
en: Whether Khamenei seriously planned for Rowhani’s victory, or simply calculated that the cost of preventing it would be too high, Rowhani can serve Khamenei’s agenda at least as well as any other candidate.

zh: 鲁哈尼的胜利创造了一种民主过程的印象，也缓解了过去八年、特别是2009年总统选举操纵案后累积起来的公共怒气。
en: Rowhani’s victory created the impression of a democratic process and relieved the popular anger that has accumulated during the last eight years, especially since the rigged presidential election in 2009.

zh: 事实上，他的胜利暴露了伊朗民主力量的裂缝 — — 按是否参与此次大选以及是否表现得与2009年出现的绿色运动（Green Movement）有关分为两个阵营。
en: Indeed, his triumph exposed a rift among Iran’s democratic forces, which were divided over whether to participate in the election, and rendered irrelevant the Green Movement born in 2009.

zh: 鲁哈尼用民主的外衣来粉饰伊朗的外交政策并不令人信服。
en: Rowhani’s efforts to portray Iran’s foreign policy in a democratic light are less convincing.

zh: 比如，他呼吁叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德继续掌权直至2014年如期大选，这是可笑的，因为巴沙尔总是会以苏联式的优势“赢得”叙利亚总统选举，公众支持率在95%以上。
en: For example, his call for Syrian President Bashar al-Assad to remain in power until the scheduled 2014 elections is risible, given that Assad typically “wins” Syria’s presidential elections by Soviet-like margins, with more than 95% of the popular vote.

zh: 对伊朗政权来说，鲁哈尼的胜利为伊朗赢得了在核问题上的时间。
en: More important for the regime, Rowhani’s victory has bought Iran time on the nuclear issue.

zh: 不但新制裁的机会更小了，鲁哈尼当选的合法性可能还可以迫使P5+1（五大联合国安理会常任理事国加上德国）在核问题上向伊朗开出更优厚的条件。
en: Not only is there less chance of new sanctions, but Rowhani’s electoral legitimacy may well force the P5+1 (the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council plus Germany) to offer Iran better terms in any nuclear deal.

zh: 但哈梅内伊将在未来四年中面临与核政策有关的两大主要挑战。
en: But Khamenei will face two main challenges related to nuclear policy in the next four years.

zh: 首先，鲁哈尼的胜利打消了贾里里所支持的抵制政策的合法性。
en: First, Rowhani’s victory has delegitimized the policy of resistance that Jalili championed.

zh: 伊朗政府不再能够宣称核计划是有广大群众支持的国家行为。
en: Iran’s government can no longer claim that the nuclear program is a national cause with broad support.

zh: 与核光荣相比，鲁哈尼的支持者更希望经济好转和融入国际社会。
en: Rowhani’s supporters want a better economy and integration into the international community more than they want nuclear glory.

zh: 其次，即便哈梅内伊将核家底交给鲁哈尼（不一定会如此，因为他仍让内贾德保管核家底 ） ， 新官上任的鲁哈尼也必须与IRGC合作，任何核协议都离不开IRGC的支持（至少是保持缄默 ） 。
en: Second, even if Khamenei hands the nuclear portfolio to Rowhani (which is not certain, given that he retained it under Ahmadinejad), the new president must come to terms with the IRGC, whose support – at least tacit – is necessary for any nuclear deal.

zh: 到目前为止，伊朗核计划和地区政策仍由IRGC和国内强硬派把持。
en: To date, Iran’s nuclear program and regional policies have been run by the IRGC and the country’s hard-liners.

zh: 他们没有硬的大选，但也没有远离权力。
en: They did not win the election, but they have not gone away.

zh: 即将到来的炎热时代
en: The Coming Heat Age

zh: 北京 — — 过去100,000年左右，我们的地球经历了一个冰河时代和几个小冰河时代。
en: BEIJING – In the last 100,000 years or so, our planet has endured an Ice Age and a few mini-ice ages.

zh: 但现在地球到2100年将升温4摄氏度，我们将面临一个“炎热时代 ” 。
en: But now, with the earth on track to be four degrees Celsius warmer by 2100, a “Heat Age” is looming over us all.

zh: 这绝不是制造恐慌。
en: This is not fear-mongering.

zh: 据政府间气候变化专门委员会（IPCC）预测，到2100年预计地表温度平均上升3.7ºC，升幅可能徘徊在2.6-4.8度。
en: According to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), by 2100 we can expect a mean increase in surface temperature of 3.7ºC, with a likely range of 2.6-4.8 degrees.

zh: 全球变暖将导致受灾地区大规模移民，并加剧国家间已经存在的贫富差距。
en: A warmer world will lead to mass migration from stricken areas and exacerbate existing wealth gaps between countries.

zh: 用加州大学圣地亚哥分校大卫·维克多的话来形容，即将到来的炎热时代“肮脏、野蛮而又炎热 ” 。
en: In the words of David Victor, of the University of California, San Diego, the coming Heat Age will be “nasty, brutish, and hot.”

zh: 今年的温室气体排放预计将创纪录地达到360亿吨的高位。 该数字预计将随近几十年的新兴市场繁荣大幅增长，在使世界各地几十亿人摆脱贫困并提高生活水平的同时，也给环境和资源造成越来越大的压力。
en: Greenhouse-gas emissions are expected to reach a record high of 36 billion tons this year.That figure is expected to grow dramatically, as the great emerging-market boom of recent decades, which has lifted billions out of poverty and raised living standards around the world, puts increasing strain on the world’s environment and resources.

zh: 事实上，到2030年，30亿新生中产阶级消费者（多数生活在亚洲）将导致不断增长的排放负担进一步加剧。
en: Indeed, by 2030, three billion new middle-class consumers – most of them in Asia – will add to the ever-growing burden of emissions.

zh: 我们已经感受到气候变化的深远影响。
en: We can already get a sense of the far-reaching consequences of climate change.

zh: 2010年，中国东部地区严重干旱导致小麦作物减产，迫使中国依赖小麦进口。
en: In 2010, a major drought in eastern China damaged the wheat crop, forcing the country to rely on imports.

zh: 俄罗斯小麦产区大火更是雪上加霜，导致全球市场粮食价格翻了一倍。
en: This, combined with major wildfires in Russia’s wheat-producing areas, helped to double average food prices in global markets.

zh: 阿拉伯民众被迫用半数收入来购买食品，而欧美民众的食品消费占比只有5-10 % 。
en: In the Arab world, many people must spend around half of their income on food, compared with just 5-10% in Europe or the United States.

zh: 粮食价格上涨成为点燃阿拉伯春天内乱的助推因素并没有什么稀奇。
en: Not surprisingly, the spike in food prices was a contributing factor in the civil unrest that sparked the Arab Spring.

zh: 全球粮食价格和政治动荡的关系显示：我们生活的世界相互制约，我们未能成功提高粮食产量、也未能建立起消除长远环境威胁的有效的经济激励机制。
en: As the link between global food prices and political instability demonstrates, we live in a globally interconnected world, in which we are failing to produce in the right way or create the right economic incentives to address profound environmental threats.

zh: 正如世行行长金墉（Jim Yong Kim）所说，气候变化现状就是用小方法解决大问题。
en: As World Bank President Jim Yong Kim has put it, climate change is a big problem with small solutions.

zh: 既然如此如何才能找到大方法？
en: So what can be done to find big solutions?

zh: 最近在阿布扎比举行的世界经济论坛全球议程峰会上，我就如何应对气候变化提出了三点建议。
en: At the World Economic Forum’s recent Summit on the Global Agenda in Abu Dhabi, I made three suggestions to tackle climate change.

zh: 首先，需要成立由企业、非政府组织、国家决策者和地方政府组成的新“自愿联盟 ” ， 该联盟应团结起来执行基本规定和原则以实现2020年碳排放封顶，并在2100年将全球变暖控制在2ºC（危险气候变化可能失控的临界点 ） 。
en: First, we need to create a new “coalition of the willing” – including businesses, NGOs, national policymakers, and local governments – that will unite around basic rules and principles to cap emissions by 2020 and limit global warming by 2100 to 2ºC (the tipping point beyond which dangerous climate change would become unstoppable).

zh: 联盟应起草并于2014年秋举行的联合国气候峰会上提出适用于各国的框架机制。
en: This coalition should draft a framework that countries can adopt and present it at the United Nations climate summit in the fall of 2014.

zh: 其次，要确保参与的国家得到恰当的激励 — — 不参与的国家则受到相应的惩罚。
en: Second, we need to ensure that there are appropriate economic incentives for those countries that sign up – and that there are disincentives for those that do not.

zh: 可以采用的措施包括为成员国提供绿色能源全球融资机制。
en: Measures could include a global financing mechanism for green energy, available only to member countries.

zh: 最后，各国不能只把联合国当做谈判的场所，而应当团结执行从可再生能源到可持续农业的具体行动计划。
en: Finally, instead of relying on the UN as a negotiating forum, countries should cluster around specific initiatives, from renewable power to sustainable agriculture.

zh: 我相信这样的集体可以更加灵活，比单一的从上到下机制更便于采取行动。
en: These clusters will, I believe, be more agile and more able to act than one overarching structure.

zh: 其他方案包括为致力削减碳排放的企业提供税收优惠；利用行为科学和公开数据加强对气候变化问题的公众宣传；描绘积极愿景，向各国宣传以限制温室气体排放为目的的多边机制的好处。
en: Other ideas that were put forward include offering tax breaks to companies that commit to cutting emissions; tapping behavioral sciences and open data to improve public communication regarding climate change; and creating a more positive narrative that highlights the benefits for all countries of multilateral efforts to limit greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 因为2015年要通过联合国千年发展目标的替代计划，人们也在认真地探讨怎样把气候变化应对行动与消除贫困、提高人类生活尊严的全球行动相融合。
en: With the successor to the UN’s Millennium Development Goals due to be adopted in 2015, there has also been serious discussion about how to make efforts to combat climate change an integral part of global efforts to eradicate poverty and give people a more dignified life.

zh: 新的可持续发展目标应明确与环境问题挂钩；毕竟不清楚农业、水利和极端天气之间的复杂关系就不能消除饥饿。
en: The new Sustainable Development Goals should be explicitly linked to environmental issues; after all, hunger cannot be eliminated without taking into account the complex interaction between agriculture, water, and extreme weather.

zh: 目前的全球最大温室气体排放国中国显然可以发挥重大的作用。
en: Given that China currently is the world’s largest emitter of greenhouse gases, it clearly has an outsize role to play.

zh: 必须彻底从严重依赖煤炭转向清洁能源利用。
en: A fundamental shift from heavy reliance on coal to clean energy must be accomplished.

zh: 中国必须停止补贴化石燃料、鼓励电动车、消除城市污染所带来的既危害当地居民又有损国际声誉的厚厚的大气污染层。
en: China must stop subsidizing fossil fuels, embrace the electric car, and tackle the thick clouds of urban pollution that are a blight to local residents and a stain on its international reputation.

zh: 中国在环境和清洁能源等领域已经取得了长足的进步。
en: China has already made some great strides in the areas of the environment and clean energy.

zh: 而且中国第十二个五年计划规定了节能、减排和工业发展等明确的国家政策导向。
en: And China’s 12th Five-Year Plan provides a clear national policy direction on energy saving, emissions reduction, and industrial development.

zh: 中国政府当前的任务是在上述计划领域显示出真正的领导力，协助地球远离灾难性的全球变暖状况。
en: The task for China’s government now is to translate these plans into a demonstration of real leadership, thereby helping to steer the earth’s trajectory away from disastrous levels of warming.

zh: 问题的紧迫性不容质疑。
en: The urgency of the problem cannot be doubted.

zh: 事实上，IPCC科学家95%肯定导致气候变化的原因是人类活动。
en: Indeed, IPCC scientists are 95% certain that human activity is the cause of climate change.

zh: 如果有人说你家95%会遭劫你不会坐视不理；你肯定会立即采取预防性举措。
en: If you were told that there was a 95% chance that your house would be robbed, you would not wait; you would take preventive action immediately.

zh: 我们的世界也必须这么做。
en: That is what the world must do.

zh: 改变气候变化
en: Changing Climate Change

zh: 记载中最温暖的十年都出现在1990年以后，而2005年很可能成为最暖的一年。
en: The 10 warmest years on record have all occurred since 1990, and 2005 is likely to be the warmest ever.

zh: 今年，我们初尝了未来将会面对的许多危险的况味：更为极端的飓风、大面积的干旱、森林火灾、传染病的蔓延和洪水。
en: This year, we’ve gotten a taste of the many kinds of dangers that lie ahead: more extreme hurricanes, massive droughts, forest fires, spreading infectious diseases, and floods.

zh: 气候正在变化，而更多的变化即将发生。
en: The climate is changing, and more is yet to come.

zh: 世界各国的政府将在11月底汇集蒙特利尔，制定下一步的应对方案。 其中包括在布什政府放弃有意忽视该问题的态度之后，世界各国可能采取的具体步骤。
en: The world’s governments will meet in Montreal at the end of November to plot the next steps, including specific measures that the world could adopt if the Bush administration abandoned its willful neglect of this critical issue.

zh: 气候变化被等同于“全球变暖 ” ， 但其实质内容要比变暖多得多。
en: Climate change is equated with “global warming,” but much more than warming is involved.

zh: 二氧化碳等温室气体的浓度越来越高，正导致着更为极端的风暴、更高强度的飓风、海平面上升、冰川和冰盖融化、干旱、洪灾和其他气候变化。
en: The rising concentration of carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases is leading to more extreme storms, higher-intensity hurricanes, rising ocean levels, melting glaciers and ice sheets, droughts, floods and other climate changes.

zh: 甚至连土地和海洋的化学成分也发生着变化。 海水的酸性日益增强—进而威胁着珊瑚礁—就是二氧化碳含量增加的结果。
en: Even the chemistry of the land and ocean is changing, with the ocean becoming more acidic – thus threatening coral reefs – as a result of higher carbon dioxide.

zh: 气候变化的详尽模式还不得而知，全球继续朝着这个方向发展的风险正引起广泛的重视。
en: The specific patterns of change are not known precisely, but the risks of continuing on our current global course are widely appreciated.

zh: 然而美国却拒绝签署《京都议定书 》 。 由于该协议只呼吁在2012年之前采取有限的举措，所以它对改变地球长期的状况几乎产生不了什么作用。
en: Yet the United States has refused to sign the Kyoto Protocol, which does little to change the long-term course of events on the planet, since it calls for only small steps up to the year 2012.

zh: 在联合国这项关于气候变化的条约规定下，签约各方—实际上是全世界—每年都要聚首讨论该协定的执行。
en: Under the terms of the UN treaty on climate change, the signatories – virtually the whole world - are to gather each year to discuss the treaty’s implementation.

zh: 在蒙特利尔召开的大会—第十一次这样的会议—应该将目光越过2012年，以使世界走上一条安全和可持续的长期气候轨道。
en: The conference in Montreal - the 11th such meeting - should look beyond 2012, so that the world gets onto a safe and sustainable long-term climate path.

zh: 必需举措的出台是困难的，因为这关系到世界使用能源的核心问题，特别是对化石燃料（煤、石油和煤气）的使用。 这些燃料在燃烧时释放出二氧化碳—温室气体的重要来源—并排放到大气中。
en: The actions that are needed are difficult to introduce, because they go to the heart of the world’s use of energy, particularly its use of fossil fuels (coal, oil, and gas), which, when burned, release carbon dioxide – the key source of rising greenhouse gases – into the atmosphere.

zh: 然而世界经济依赖于化石燃料，发展中国家的经济增长需要使用更多而不是更少的化石燃料。
en: Yet the world economy depends on fossil fuels, and developing countries will need to use more, not less, of them as their economies grow.

zh: 就算是世界上的石油和天然气在不久的将来耗尽，煤却仍然有足够的储量。 固体的煤以相对较低的成本就可以被转化成供应汽车和其他用途的液体燃料。
en: Even if the world runs out of oil and gas in the coming years, coal will prove to be plentiful, and solid coal can be converted at relatively low cost to liquid fuels for automobiles and other uses.

zh: 不幸的是，不会释放二氧化碳的，清洁、可再生的能源，如风能和地热，还不能满足我们的需要。
en: Unfortunately, clean, renewable energy sources that do not emit carbon dioxide, such as wind power and geothermal power, are not yet sufficient.

zh: 太阳能发电的总量能满足需求，但在目前的技术条件下成本过高。
en: Solar power can be produced on the required scale but is too expensive under current technologies.

zh: 核电相对便宜，且潜力巨大，但它也为日益严重的核武器原料扩散造成危险。
en: Nuclear power is relatively cheap, and could be plentiful, but poses huge dangers for increased proliferation of nuclear-weapons materials.

zh: 因此：化石燃料储量充足，但却危害气候；风能等可再生能源对气候无害，但却不足。
en: So: fossil fuels are plentiful, but harmful; renewable sources like wind are good for the climate but not plentiful.

zh: 太阳能发电取之不尽但却成本高昂。
en: Solar power is plentiful but not cheap.

zh: 核电同样充足但却不安全。
en: Nuclear power is plentiful but not safe.

zh: 技术的进步可以让我们从这一桎梏中摆脱出来，但前提是我们必须未雨绸缪。
en: Improved technologies can offer a way out of this bind, but only if we think and act ahead.

zh: 有两种技术看起来最有前途。
en: There are two main kinds of technologies that look most promising.

zh: 第一种是通过使用更高燃料效率的汽车来节省能源。
en: The first is energy conservation through more fuel-efficient vehicles.

zh: 由丰田率先推出的混合动力汽车，能使用汽油和电能，从而将汽油的使用效率提高了近两倍。
en: New hybrid automobiles, pioneered by Toyota, use both gasoline and electric power to boost gasoline efficiency by approximately two-fold.

zh: 向有更高燃油效率的车辆的大规模转变会使局面大为改观。 特别是在中国、印度等汽车数量大的发展中国家。
en: A massive changeover to more fuel-efficient vehicles would make a big difference, especially as the numbers of vehicles on the road soars in China, India, and other developing countries.

zh: 第二大意义深远的技术被称作 ： “ 碳的捕获和储存。
en: The second big technology that could make a major difference is called “carbon capture and storage.”

zh: ”其理念是将发电厂和其他大工厂在燃烧化石燃料时所排放的二氧化碳“捕获 ” ， 从而阻止其被排入大气。
en: The idea is to “capture” the carbon dioxide that is emitted in power plants and other big factories when fossil fuels are burned, thereby preventing it from entering the atmosphere.

zh: 被捕获的碳会被注入空的油田和其他适合的地下贮存处。
en: The captured carbon is then pumped into underground storage sites such as empty oil fields and other suitable locations.

zh: 该技术的所有关键方面—二氧化碳的捕获，排入管道中以便进一步传输，以及最后放入地下—都已有所展示，但它还没有经过更大规模的试验和证实。
en: All of the key aspects of the technology – capturing the carbon dioxide, putting it into pipelines for shipment, and then depositing it underground – have already been demonstrated, but they have not yet been tried, and proven, on a large scale.

zh: 但有足够的证据表明进行大规模的碳捕获和储存不会给世界带来过高的成本。
en: There is strong evidence, however, that it would not cost the world huge amounts to undertake large-scale carbon capture and storage.

zh: 问题是时间。
en: The problem is timing.

zh: 全世界的车辆���换成混合动力和其他更为高效的技术需要数十年，而不是几年。
en: The changeover of the world’s vehicles to hybrid and other efficient technologies will take decades, not years.

zh: 发电厂采用碳捕获和储存技术同样需要很长的时间。
en: So will the changeover of power plants to carbon capture and storage.

zh: 如果我们犹豫不决，那么在我们讨论、争辩和规划的同时，还会面临气候变化所带来的危险。
en: If we procrastinate, the dangers posed by climate change will confront us as we talk, debate, and plan.

zh: 世界需要立刻行动—尽可能快—这样才能阻止重大的威胁。
en: The world needs to start acting soon - very soon - if it is to head off the major threats.

zh: 世界上所有主要的地区都应参与进来。
en: All major regions of the world will need to be involved.

zh: 当今的发展中国家还不是二氧化碳的主要排放国，但随着经济的增长这将不可避免。
en: Today’s developing countries are not yet major emitters of carbon dioxide, but with economic growth they will become so.

zh: 因此，包括发达国家和发展中国家在内的所有国家，都应该担负起各自的责任。 富国应该帮助穷国承担转变的经济成本。
en: Therefore, all countries, both developed and developing, need to do their part, with rich countries helping poor countries cover the financial costs of adjustment.

zh: 就在世界各地的气候谈判者们飞赴蒙特利尔参加会议时，大量的二氧化碳又将被排放到大气中。
en: Plenty of carbon dioxide will be emitted into the atmosphere as the world’s climate negotiators fly to and from the Montreal meeting.

zh: 让我们敦促我们的政府在与会期间取得真正的进展；否则他们所作的一切都只会使气候问题更为严重。
en: Let’s press our governments to make real progress when they meet; otherwise they will merely be adding to the problem.

zh: 导航能源革命
en: Navigating the Energy Revolution

zh: 利雅得/伦敦 — — 几十年来，国际能源格局一直相对稳定，沙特阿拉伯、伊朗和阿尔及利亚等生产国将石油和天然气出售给的美国和欧洲的消费者。
en: RIYADH/LONDON – For decades, the international energy landscape has been relatively stable, with producers like Saudi Arabia, Iran, and Algeria selling oil and gas to consumers in the United States and Europe.

zh: 但随着引人注目的技术、经济和地缘政治变化重塑全球商业关系，能源格局可能会在短短几年内面目全非。
en: In a few years, however, the energy terrain is likely to be unrecognizable, as dramatic technological, economic, and geopolitical changes reshape commercial relationships worldwide.

zh: 我们需要全新的治理结构，以便超越生产者和消费者之间传统的双边关系。
en: What is needed is a new governance structure, one that moves beyond traditional bilateral relationships between producers and consumers.

zh: 在迅速变化的世界确保能源安全需要精心管理环环相扣的多重关系。
en: In a rapidly evolving world, guaranteeing energy security will require the careful management of multiple, interlocking relationships.

zh: 只有可以分享和探讨复杂理念的包容性国际论坛才有可能完成引导新时代能源应用、生产和消费的任务。
en: Only an inclusive international forum, in which complex ideas can be shared and debated, is likely to prove adequate to the task of navigating the new era of energy use, production, and consumption.

zh: 正在发生的变化意义深刻。
en: The ongoing changes are profound.

zh: 许多能源出口国国内消费量急剧增长。
en: In many energy-exporting countries, domestic consumption is rising steeply.

zh: 从历史上看，能源在上述国家一直扮演着廉价资源的角色。
en: Historically, these countries have treated energy as a cheap resource.

zh: 如今，他们正越来越多地采取措施取消补贴、引入市场价和提高效率 — — 这些都是与能源进口国相关的典型政策。
en: Today, they are increasingly taking steps to remove subsidies, introduce market prices, and increase efficiency – policies that are more typically associated with energy-importing countries.

zh: 英国石油公司预计中东地区凭借其丰富的化石燃料储量，到2035年一次性能源消费将增长77 % 。
en: BP predicts that in the Middle East, with its extensive fossil-fuel reserves, primary energy consumption will grow 77% by 2035.

zh: 与此同时，一些传统进口国正利用新能源来源成为生产商，从而改变能源流动的方向。
en: At the same time, some traditional importers are tapping new sources of energy and becoming producers, changing the direction of energy flows.

zh: 美国页岩能源革命或许是这种转变最有名的例子，但并不是唯一一个。
en: The shale-energy revolution in the US is perhaps the best-known example of this shift, but it is not the only one.

zh: 迅速发展的可再生能源业是干扰传统生产和消费关系的另一个���素。
en: The rapidly growing renewable-energy industry is another factor disrupting traditional relationships between producers and consumers.

zh: 2014年上半年，德国耗电总量的13%都来源于风能一项。
en: In the first half of 2014, 13% of electricity in Germany came from wind energy alone.

zh: 20世纪70年代曾完全依赖于能源进口的丹麦现在成了欧盟唯一一个能源净出口国，风力发电满足了该国100%的电力需求。
en: Denmark, a country that in the 1970s was almost entirely dependent on energy imports, is now the European Union’s only net energy exporter, often generating more than 100% of its electricity needs from wind power.

zh: 同时，节能进步也降低了对传统生产国出口的需求。
en: Meanwhile, advances in energy efficiency are also reducing demand for traditional producers’ exports.

zh: 高效建筑往往能轻松利用当地出产的可再生能源发电，并依靠太阳能集热器满足热水需求。
en: Highly efficient buildings often can be easily heated with locally produced renewable electricity and supplied with hot water from solar collectors.

zh: 欧盟新建筑引入的近零能耗建筑标准注定会使大大降低天然气采暖需求。
en: The introduction of the Near Zero Energy Buildings standard for new buildings in the EU is set to reduce drastically dependence on gas for heating.

zh: 风险在于上述快速变化将与地缘政治动荡一道引发全球能源市场衰退。
en: The risk is that these rapid changes will combine with destabilizing geopolitics to trigger a retreat from global energy markets.

zh: 如果各国开始将能源安全定义为能源独立并试图满足自身的所有需求，其结果可能导致昂贵的产能过剩、大规模价格扭曲、技术进步放缓和经济增长变弱。
en: If countries began to define energy security as energy independence and try to supply all their own needs, the result could be expensive overcapacity, massive price distortions, slower technological progress, and weaker economic growth.

zh: 为了对充满竞争、政治色彩浓厚且往往不可预知的能源业保持信任，致力于解决问题和缓解紧张局势的国际论坛可能会非常有效。
en: With the need to maintain trust in the competitive, politically charged, and often unpredictable energy sector both greater than ever and more difficult than ever to meet, an international forum dedicated to addressing concerns and easing tensions could be a powerful tool.

zh: 但论坛所关注的焦点必须恰当。
en: But it must have the right focus.

zh: 比方说，论坛不应着眼于达成具有法律约束力的决定。
en: For example, it should not aim at producing legally binding decisions.

zh: 世贸组织、能源宪章和能源共同体等大量机构已经在能源业制定规则或落实合规管理方面完成了出色的工作。
en: Plenty of bodies, such as the World Trade Organization, the Energy Charter, and the Energy Community, already do an excellent job of developing rules or enforcing compliance in the energy sector.

zh: 此外，这样的机构应该具有包容性，但不需要具有全球抱负；试图将所有国家纳入到系统当中是不切实际的选择。
en: Moreover, though such a body should be inclusive, it need not have global ambitions; it would be impractical to try to bring everybody to the table.

zh: 虽然创始人应该防止它被单一国家或若干国家所引导或主宰，但在开始拓展前规模有限是没有害处的。
en: And while its founders should take care that it not be led or dominated by a single country or bloc of countries, there is no harm if it starts small, with only a few countries, before beginning to expand.

zh: 事实上，致力于创建能源联盟的欧盟委员会完全有能力与非欧盟国家就长期能源政策进行公开对话。
en: Indeed, the European Commission, which is working toward creating an energy union, is well placed to initiate an open dialogue with non-EU countries on long-term energy policies.

zh: 欧盟是全世界最大的能源进口国，如果能与主要出口国就能源战略进行探讨无疑是有好处的。
en: The EU is the largest energy importer in the world, and it would be well served to join the discussion of its energy strategy to a conversation with the world’s main exporters.

zh: 因此在修改能源和外交政策时，欧盟应当抓住机会将公开能源政策对话纳入到规划当中。
en: As the EU revises both its energy and foreign affairs policies, it should not miss the chance to integrate an open energy policy dialogue into its planning.

zh: 这种情况下，委员会的传统弱点 — — 即外交和能源政策通常由各成员国自主决定 — — 可能转化为一项重要的优势。
en: In this context, one of the commission’s traditional weaknesses – that foreign and energy policies are usually decided by individual member states – could serve as an important advantage.

zh: 委员会将被视为讨论的促进者，而不是领导者或主要参与方。
en: The commission will be seen as a facilitator of the discussion, rather than a leader or a dominant player.

zh: 如果建立起熨平分歧的恰当论坛，迅速变化的能源格局可能带来新的繁荣。
en: Given a proper forum for ironing out disagreements, the rapidly changing energy landscape could be a source of new prosperity.

zh: 还有一种可能是造成紧张和误解 — — 上述分歧很可能超出能源政策的范畴对国际关系和安全造成影响。
en: The alternative is a world at risk of tensions and misunderstandings – ones that could easily jump out of the realm of energy policy into international relations and security.

zh: 我们所信仰的魅力
en: Charisma We Can Believe In

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 世界上两大独裁国家都已预定在2012年实现权力交接。
en: CAMBRIDGE – A leadership transition is scheduled in two major autocracies in 2012. Neither is likely to be a surprise.

zh: 在中国，习近平将接替胡锦涛就任国家主席，俄罗斯总理普京则声明自己将从梅德韦杰夫手中重新接过总统宝座。
en: Xi Jinping is set to replace Hu Jintao as President in China, and, in Russia, Vladimir Putin has announced that he will reclaim the presidency from Dmitri Medvedev.

zh: 而全球各民主国家的政治结局则难以逆料。
en: Among the world’s democracies, political outcomes this year are less predictable.

zh: 法国总统萨科齐的连任之路困难重重，美国总统奥巴马也难言轻松。
en: Nicolas Sarkozy faces a difficult presidential re-election campaign in France, as does Barack Obama in the United States.

zh: 在2008年美国总统大选上，媒体告诉我们奥巴马之所以获胜是因为他有“魅力 ” — —某种能激发迷恋和忠诚的特殊力量。
en: In the 2008 US presidential election, the press told us that Obama won because he had “charisma” – the special power to inspire fascination and loyalty.

zh: 如果真是如此，那为什么仅仅四年之后连任就变得如此艰难？
en: If so, how can his re-election be uncertain just four years later?

zh: 一位领导人是否会丧失自身的魅力？
en: Can a leader lose his or her charisma?

zh: 这些魅力是来自于其个人，追随者，还是当时的特定情况？
en: Does charisma originate in the individual, in that person’s followers, or in the situation?

zh: 对此学术研究认为：这三点都可能存在。
en: Academic research points to all three.

zh: 令人吃惊的是，魅力是难以事先测定的。
en: Charisma proves surprisingly hard to identify in advance.

zh: 最近有项调查认为我们对魅力领袖究竟是何人“所知甚少 ” 。
en: A recent survey concluded that “relatively little” is known about who charismatic leaders are.

zh: 一位美国政治顾问迪克·莫里斯（Dick Morris）凭经验总结说 ： “ 魅力是政治特征中最难以捉摸的部分，因为它并不是任何实质性的存在；只有在一位候选人通过勤奋和某些巧妙的议题将其创造出来后，它才会出现于我们的观念之中。
en: Dick Morris, an American political consultant, reports that in his experience, “charisma is the most elusive of political traits, because it doesn’t exist in reality; only in our perception once a candidate has made it by hard work and good issues.”

zh: ”同样，商业媒体也曾用“魅力”这个词来形容许多企业CEO，但当利润下跌时，这个标签也就无影无踪了。
en: Similarly, the business press has described many a CEO as “charismatic” when things are going well, only to withdraw the label when profits fall.

zh: 政治科学家尝试创立一套魅力测量标准来预测投票趋势或者总统候选人排名，但至今都无法取得什么成果。
en: Political scientists have tried to create charisma scales that would predict votes or presidential ratings, but they have not proven fruitful.

zh: 在历届美国总统中约翰·肯尼迪（John F. Kennedy）常常被认为是最有魅力的，但这显然无法得到所有人的同意，因为他当时只是以微弱优势赢得选举，而且在任期内的民望也高低不定。
en: Among US presidents, John F. Kennedy is often described as charismatic, but obviously not for everyone, given that he failed to capture a majority of the popular vote, and his ratings varied during his presidency.

zh: 而肯尼迪遇刺后的继任者林登·约翰逊则哀叹自己缺乏魅力。
en: Kennedy’s successor, Lyndon Johnson, lamented that he lacked charisma.

zh: 这在他与公众的恶劣关系中可见一斑，但在人脉经营方面约翰逊却有极大吸引力 — — 甚至可是说是压倒性的。
en: That was true of his relations with the public, but Johnson could be magnetic – even overwhelming – in personal contacts.

zh: 一项针对总统修辞学方面的详细研究也证明即便是富兰克林·罗斯福或者罗纳德·里根这样的著名演说家都无法仅靠个人魅力来推动政策项目。
en: One careful study of presidential rhetoric found that even such famous orators as Franklin Roosevelt and Ronald Reagan could not count on charisma to enact their programs.

zh: 魅力更容易在事件发生后被定义。
en: Charisma is more easily identified after the fact.

zh: 在这个意义上，它其实是个自我循环的概念。
en: In that sense, the concept is circular.

zh: 正如古代中国所谓的“受命于天 ” ： 帝王因为得到了“天”的旨意而进行统治，而当他们都被推翻的时候，人们就认为“天”已经收回成命了。
en: It is like the old Chinese concept of the “mandate of heaven”: emperors were said to rule because they had it, and when they were overthrown, it was because they had lost it.

zh: 但没有人能预测这些事件将在何时发生。
en: But no one could predict when that would happen.

zh: 同样，成功也经常被用来证明 — — 以马后炮的形式 — — 某个现代领导人具备魅力，但反过来用魅力预测谁会成为成功领导者则非常困难。
en: Similarly, success is often used to prove – after the fact – that a modern political leader has charisma. It is much harder to use charisma to predict who will be a successful leader.

zh: 而追随者们在感觉需要做出变革 — — 在个人，组织或者社会遭遇危机的时候 — — 更容易在领导人身上发现魅力。
en: Followers are more likely to attribute charisma to leaders when they feel a strong need for change, often in the context of a personal, organizational, or social crisis.

zh: 以丘吉尔为例，1939年时英国公众并不觉得此人有何魅力，但就在一年后法国沦陷以及敦克尔克大撤退的恐慌之中，丘吉尔的远见，信心以及沟通技巧则令他充满了魅力。
en: For example, the British public did not regard Winston Churchill as a charismatic leader in 1939, but, a year later, his vision, confidence, and communication skills gave him charisma, given Britons’ anxiety after the fall of France and the Dunkirk evacuation.

zh: 一直到1945年，随着公众的注意力从赢得战争转向建立一个福利国家，丘吉尔也只得离任。
en: And then, in 1945, after the public’s focus had turned from winning the war to constructing a welfare state, Churchill was voted out of office.

zh: 他的魅力并未预测���自身的下台，而追随者们需求的变化却导致了这一点。
en: His charisma did not predict defeat; the change in followers’ needs did.

zh: 在实际情况中，魅力是“个人吸引力”的一个模糊近义词。
en: In practice, charisma is a vague synonym for “personal magnetism.”

zh: 人们吸引他人的能力参差不齐，这些能力一部分取决于内在特性，一部分来自于所学的技能，最后一部分则来源自当时的社会大背景。
en: People vary in their ability to attract others, and their attraction depends partly on inherent traits, partly on learned skills, and partly on social context.

zh: 个人吸引力的某些方面，比如外貌和非语言沟通手段，可以被测试出来。
en: Some dimensions of personal attraction, such as appearance and non-verbal communication, can be tested.

zh: 许多研究都表明那些被认为拥有吸引力的人会比无吸引力者获得更好的待遇。
en: Various studies show that people who are rated as attractive are treated more favorably than unattractive people.

zh: 一项研究发现英俊的男性会比丑陋的对手多获得6~8%的选票。
en: One study finds that a handsome man enjoys an edge over an ugly rival that is worth 6-8% of the vote.

zh: 而对女性来说这一优势则进一步扩大到近10 % 。
en: For women, the advantage is close to ten points.

zh: 非语言信号则是人类沟通的一个主要方面，而简单实验也表明某些人的非语言沟通能力强于他人。
en: Non-verbal signals account for a major part of human communications, and simple experiments have shown that some people communicate non-verbally better than others.

zh: 比如普林斯顿大学的一项研究发现当向被试者展示一场陌生选举的两位候选人照片时，他们有70%的概率选到获胜者。
en: For example, a Princeton University study found that when people were shown images of two candidates in unfamiliar elections, they could predict the winners seven times out of ten.

zh: 哈佛大学的一项类似研究则从历年58场美国州长选举的民主/共和两党竞选对手身上各选取10秒钟无声剪辑，要求被试者观看并判断胜负，并发现这些人的预测因素占了选举变化量的20 % — —比经济表现变量所产生的影响更大。
en: A similar study at Harvard, in which people were shown 10-second silent video clips of 58 elections, found that viewers’ predictions explained 20% of the variation in the two-party vote – a more powerful variable than economic performance.

zh: 但讽刺的是，一旦加入了声音之后，这些预测的作用就被削弱了。
en: Ironically, the predictions became poorer when the sound was turned on.

zh: 在2008年选举中，美国人一方面对布什政府的伊拉克战争感到幻灭，在距正式投票还有两个月的时候又遭遇了金融危机。
en: In the 2008 election, Americans felt disillusioned by the Bush administration’s war in Iraq, and by the financial crisis that erupted two months before the vote.

zh: 而奥巴马又是如此能言善辩并投射出某种对未来的希望。
en: Obama was an attractive young candidate who spoke well and projected a sense of hope for the future.

zh: 很显然，这就是他为何以魅力著称的原因。
en: Clearly, this is one reason why Obama gained a reputation for charisma.

zh: 但他的一部分魅力其实存在于追随者的眼中。
en: But part of his charisma was in the eyes of his followers.

zh: 有时人们会认为魅力是一种“看到了就能感知到的东西 ” ， 但我们其实也是在看一面镜子。
en: People sometimes say of charisma that “we know it when we see it,” but we are also looking in a mirror.

zh: 随着经济恶化失业率上升，奥巴马在管治过程中又不免沾手种种肮脏的妥协交易，那面镜子也逐渐变得污浊不堪了。
en: As the economy worsened, unemployment rose, and Obama had to deal with the messy compromises of governing, the mirror became cloudier.

zh: 魅力可以为我们解读一位候选人的某些方面，但解读更多的其实是我们自身，整个国家的情绪，以及我们所希望的变革。
en: Charisma tells us something about a candidate, but it tells us even more about ourselves, the mood of our country, and the types of change we desire.

zh: 经济困难的时候魅力也随之难以维持。
en: Hard economic times make it difficult to maintain charisma.

zh: 奥巴马面对着失业的持续挑战和共和党不屈不挠的阻挠，萨科齐也不能幸免。
en: Obama faces the continuing challenges of unemployment and a recalcitrant Republican opposition, and Sarkozy must contend with similar problems.

zh: 但当他们再次竞选总统的时候，他们的承诺又会把所有的妥协放在一边。
en: When they are campaigning, however, their rhetoric will be freed from the need to compromise.

zh: 而今年的选举，也将成为他们自身魅力的试金石。
en: This year’s elections will be the true test of their charisma.

zh: 艰难世道中的慈善事业
en: Charity in Hard Times

zh: 普林斯顿-当我在全美国为我的新书《你能挽救的生命：现在行动起来，结束世界贫困》做宣传时，我常常被人问及这个问题，即现在来呼吁富裕的人们拿出更多的钱来消灭他国贫困现状，是不是显得不合时宜？
en: PRINCETON – As I tour the U.S. promoting my new book, The Life You Can Save: Acting Now to End World Poverty , I am often asked if this isn’t the wrong time to call on affluent people to increase their effort to end poverty in other countries. I reply emphatically that it is not.

zh: 我总是强调地回答确实如此。
en: There is no doubt that the world economy is in trouble.

zh: 毫无疑问，世界经济陷入了困境；但如果政府或个人以此为借口而减少援助世上最贫困的人们，他们只能会成倍地加大此问题的全球的严重性。
en: But if governments or individuals use this as an excuse to reduce assistance to the world’s poorest people, they would only multiply the seriousness of the problem for the world as a whole.

zh: 金融危机对穷人的打击比富人更大。
en: The financial crisis has been more damaging for the poor than it has been for the rich.

zh: 尽管无法尽可能减低富裕国家中的失业人们在失业时遭遇的经济上和心理上的打击，但他们仍然享有一个安全网络，这种网络的形式是向他们提供社会保障金，通常还有免费的医疗保健和孩子的免费教育。
en: Without in any way minimizing the economic and psychological blow that people experience when they lose their jobs, the unemployed in affluent countries still have a safety net, in the form of social security payments, and usually free health care and free education for their children.

zh: 他们也能享有卫生设施和安全的饮用水。
en: They also have sanitation and safe drinking water.

zh: 所有这些福利，发展中国家的穷人却是一项也没能享受。 这每年造成了估计有一千八百万人的死亡。
en: The poor in developing countries have none of these benefits, which proves fatal for an estimated 18 million of them each year.

zh: 这比整个二战期间所死亡的人数还多，而防止这种现象的发生却又很容易。
en: That’s a higher annual death toll than during World War II, and it’s easier to prevent.

zh: 根据联合国儿童基金会的统计，死于这些可避免的由贫困造成的原因的人当中，有近一千万是五岁以下的儿童。
en: Of those who die from avoidable, poverty-related causes, nearly ten million, according to UNICEF, are children under five.

zh: 他们死于如麻疹、痢疾和疟疾这样的治疗或预防非常 容易且廉价的疾病。
en: They die from diseases like measles, diarrhea, and malaria that are easy and inexpensive to treat or prevent.

zh: 从我们已习以为常的富裕的水准上掉落，我们可能会感到痛苦，但大多数生活在发达国家的人们，按历史标准来衡量，他们仍然是非常富裕的。
en: We may feel the pain of falling back from a level of affluence to which we have grown accustomed, but most people in developed countries are still, by historical standards, extraordinarily well off.

zh: 在过去一周里，当你明知自来水是免费供应的，你仍买过一瓶瓶装水、啤酒或咖啡吗？
en: Have you, in the past week, bought a bottle of water, a beer, or a coffee when tap water was available at no cost?

zh: 如果你买过，你要知道，对于世上最贫穷的10亿人来说，这是一种他们负担不起的奢侈行为，因为他们的一整天的生活费就是你买一瓶饮料的钱。
en: If you did, that’s a luxury that the world’s poorest billion people can’t afford, because they have to live for an entire day on what you spent on just one of those drinks.

zh: 我们有能力提高援助额的原因之一是，相比于我们花在其它事情上的钱，我们现在捐出的钱是微不足道的。
en: One reason that we can afford to increase the amount of aid we give is that the amount we are giving now is insignificant in comparison to what we spend on other things.

zh: 比如，美国政府的对外援助额约220亿美元，而美国私人捐赠额可能还有100亿美元。
en: The United States government, for example, spends about $22 billion on foreign aid, while Americans privately donate perhaps another $10 billion.

zh: 比起奥巴马总统上个月签署的七千八百七十亿美元的刺激方案来，这笔320亿美元的资金实在是微不足道。
en: Compared to the $787 billion stimulus package signed by President Barack Obama last month, that $32 billion is trivial.

zh: 也就是说，美国人每挣到100美元，其中只有不到0.25美元是用来对外援助。
en: It’s also less than $0.25 for every $100 that Americans earn.

zh: 当然，有些国家在这方面做得更好：比如瑞典、挪威、丹麦、荷兰和卢森堡等国，这些国家都超过联合国提出的把0.70 ％的国民总收入用于对外援助。
en: Of course, some nations do better: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, The Netherlands, and Luxembourg all exceed the United Nations target of allocating the equivalent of 0.7% of gross national income in foreign aid.

zh: 但是，即使是每100美元中拿出0.70美元来用来解决我们这个时代的这个巨大的道德难题，也是不算多的。
en: But even $0.70 for every $100 is still not a lot with which to confront one of the great moral problems of our age.

zh: 如果允许赤贫增加，这将引起新问题，包括新的疾病将从不能提供充分的医疗保健的那些国家蔓延到那些可以提供的国家。
en: If extreme poverty is allowed to increase, it will give rise to new problems, including new diseases that will spread from countries that cannot provide adequate health care to those that can.

zh: 贫困将导致更多的移民寻求移民到富裕国家，无论是通过合法还是不合法的渠道。
en: Poverty will lead to more migrants seeking to move, whether legally or not, to rich nations.

zh: 如果世界上所有的人都能参与全球经济的话，当经济复苏最终来临时，全球经济总量会更大。
en: When there is eventually an economic recovery, the global economy will be smaller than it would be if all the world’s people could take part in it.

zh: 全球金融危机也不是世界各国领导人不信守诺言得理由。
en: Nor is the global financial crisis a justification for the world’s leaders failing to keep their word.

zh: 大约9年前，在纽约举行的“千年发展首脑会议”上，包括所有主要富裕国家的180个国家的领导人承诺，到2015年，他们将共同实现千年发展目标。
en: Nearly nine years ago, at the Millennium Development Summit in New York, the leaders of 180 countries, including all the major affluent nations, promised that by 2015 they would together achieve the Millennium Development Goals.

zh: 这些目标包括减少世界上一半生活在贫困中的人口，并确保世界各地的儿童享受全程初级教育。
en: These goals include halving the proportion of the world’s people living in poverty and ensuring that children everywhere receive a full primary education.

zh: 自2000年那次会议以来，大多数国家所已作出的努力，都没有达到对它们的要求，而现在离2015年只有6年的时间了。
en: Since that meeting in 2000, the commitments made by most nations have fallen short of what is required, and 2015 is now only six years away.

zh: 如果我们削减援助额，我们将会失信，而贫国将再一次了解到富国的那些激动人心的减少世界贫困的华丽的辞藻不会全部付诸实践。
en: If we cut back on aid, we will fail to keep our promise, and poorer countries will learn, once again, that rich countries’ actions fall short of their inspiring rhetoric about reducing world poverty.

zh: 这样一来，对今后的穷富国之间在诸如气候变化问题上的合作来说，这不是一个良好的基础。
en: That is not a good basis for future cooperation between rich and poor countries on issues such as climate change.

zh: 最后，如果说这次全球性金融危机带来了什么好处的话，那就是对我们的基本价值观和优先事项进行重新评估。
en: Finally, if anything good comes out of this global financial crisis, it will be a reassessment of our basic values and priorities.

zh: 我们需要认识到，真正重要的不是购买越来越多的消费品，而是家人、朋友和明白我们正在用我们的生命做一些有意义的事情。
en: We need to recognize that what really matters isn’t buying more and more consumer goods, but family, friends, and knowing that we are doing something worthwhile with our lives.

zh: 而帮助减少世界贫困的可怕后果应是这种重新评估的一部分。
en: Helping to reduce the appalling consequences of world poverty should be part of that reassessment.

zh: 普京的奋斗
en: Putin’s Kampf

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 俄罗斯占领克里米亚是1938年纳粹德国入侵苏台德以来欧洲亲眼见证的和平时期最赤裸裸的侵略。
en: BRUSSELS – Russia’s seizure of Crimea is the most naked example of peacetime aggression that Europe has witnessed since Nazi Germany invaded the Sudetenland in 1938.

zh: 轻视内维尔·张伯伦和爱德华·达拉第姑息希特勒，纵容其对捷克斯洛伐克领土主张的“慕尼黑教训”或许已经成为一种时尚，但如果西方此次默许俄罗斯吞并克里米亚 — — 这已经是俄总统普京从2008年占领格鲁吉亚阿布哈兹和南奥塞梯地区以来第二次从主权国家窃取领土 — — 今天的民主领袖们肯定会后悔自己的不作为选择。
en: It may be fashionable to belittle the “lessons of Munich,” when Neville Chamberlain and Édouard Daladier appeased Hitler, deferring to his claims on Czechoslovakia. But if the West acquiesces to Crimea’s annexation – the second time Russian President Vladimir Putin has stolen territory from a sovereign state, following Russia’s seizure of Georgia’s Abkhazia and South Ossetia regions in 2008 – today’s democratic leaders will surely regret their inaction.

zh: 西方首都对此的反应各式各样。
en: In Western capitals, the response so far has been mixed.

zh: 目前正在酝酿的惩罚包括逐出八国集团 — — 如果不是欧洲和平正面临重大威胁这倒是个不错的笑话。
en: The punishments being considered – expulsion from the G-8, for example – would be laughable were the threat to Europe’s peace not so grave.

zh: 普京将苏联解体视之为现代社会最恐怖的灾难，他一直坚定不移地寻求重塑俄罗斯失落帝国的辉煌。
en: Putin regards the breakup of the Soviet Union as the greatest catastrophe of modern times, and he has sought relentlessly to refashion Russia’s lost empire.

zh: 如果西方还想在国际事务中有一席之地，那就需要像普京那样果断采取行动。
en: If the West intends to be taken seriously, it needs to act as decisively as Putin has.

zh: 普京帝国大业中的很多成就都没有付出任何代价。
en: Putin’s many successes in his imperial project have come virtually without cost.

zh: 他所组建的欧亚经济共同体已经把哈萨克斯坦、乌兹别克斯坦和土库曼斯坦等富油国拉拢到自己的阵营。
en: His Eurasian Economic Community has corralled energy-rich states like Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and Turkmenistan into Russia’s camp.

zh: 格鲁吉亚于2008年解体。
en: Georgia was dismembered in 2008.

zh: 亚美尼亚政府则被迫放弃与欧洲签订联合协议。
en: Armenia’s government was bullied into spurning the European Union’s offer of an Association Agreement.

zh: 现在最重要的地缘战略奖项乌克兰或许会落入普京之手。
en: Now the greatest geostrategic prize of all – Ukraine – may fall into Putin’s hands.

zh: 美国前国家安全顾问兹比格涅夫•布热津斯基写道没有乌克兰的俄罗斯“不再成其为帝国，但俄罗斯一旦收买并收服乌克兰，那就自然而然恢复了帝国的身份。
en: Russia without Ukraine, former US National Security Adviser Zbigniew Brzezinski wrote, “ceases to be an empire, but Russia with Ukraine suborned and then subordinated, Russia automatically becomes an empire.”

zh: ”而且因为多数乌克兰人不愿成为普京帝国的一份子，我们可以肯定从此以后普京领导的帝国将会高度军事化，这很像苏联，不过没有共产党执政。
en: And, because the vast majority of Ukrainians have no desire to join Putin’s empire, we can be certain that the state Putin will lead from this point on will be a highly militarized one, rather like the Soviet Union but without the ruling Communist Party.

zh: 鉴于普京如此崇尚冒险主义，世界必须对此做出相称的反应。
en: Given the scale of Putin’s adventurism, the world’s response must be commensurate.

zh: 取消峰会、贸易协议或诸如八国集团等外交谈判组织的会员资格还远远不够。
en: Canceled summits, trade deals, or membership in diplomatic talking shops like the G-8 are not enough.

zh: 只有实行影响俄国民众（毕竟是他们一而再再而三地投票让普京当选）的实���在在的经济制裁才有望使克里姆林放弃其扩张进程。
en: Only actions that impose tangible economic sanctions that affect Russian citizens – who, after all, have voted Putin into power time and again – offer any hope of steering the Kremlin away from its expansionist course.

zh: 哪些制裁措施可能有效？
en: Which sanctions might work?

zh: 首先，土耳其应当像2008年俄格战争时一样对俄罗斯关闭达达尼尔海峡。
en: First, Turkey should close the Dardanelles to Russian shipping, as it did after the 2008 Russo-Georgian War.

zh: 当时土耳其封锁黑海防止美国干预，但现在我们知道美国根本没打算这样做。
en: Back then, Turkey closed access to the Black Sea to prevent the US from intervening, though the US, it is now clear, had no intention of doing so.

zh: 今天，它不仅应该对俄军舰关闭土耳其海峡，而且还应对所有俄罗斯开往黑海港口的商船实行封锁。
en: Today, it should close the Turkish straits not only to Russian warships, but to all commercial vessels bound for Russia’s Black Sea ports.

zh: 这对俄经济和普京军事主张的打击将是巨大的。
en: The impact on Russia’s economy – and on Putin’s military pretensions – would be considerable.

zh: 根据1982年修订的1936年蒙特勒公约条款，土耳其有权关闭达达尼尔海峡。
en: Turkey is permitted to close the Dardanelles under a 1982 amendment to the 1936 Montreux Convention.

zh: 事实上，土耳其可以动摇普京占领克里米亚的借口 — — 即为那里的俄罗斯族提供保护 — — 并提出要保护自己突厥鞑靼同族，因为过去曾受到俄国的恶劣对待，这些人非常希望继续留在乌克兰的治下。
en: Indeed, Turkey could turn Putin’s justification for seizing Crimea – that he is protecting ethnic Russians there – against him, by arguing that it is protecting its Turkic Tatar kin, who, given Russia’s ill treatment of them in the past, are anxious to remain under Ukrainian rule.

zh: 土耳其外长艾哈迈德·达武特奥卢乘坐的专机本周在空中调头飞往基辅支持乌新任临时政府。
en: Turkish Foreign Minister Ahmet Davutoğlu turned his plane around in mid-air this week to fly to Kyiv to offer support to the new interim government.

zh: 普京应该知道，在普京要求所有克里米亚军队回到塞瓦斯托波尔基地或俄国领地之前，雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安总理无需动员就会对俄船只关闭海峡来支持外长的表态。
en: Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, no pushover himself, as Putin well knows, should follow up on that gesture of support by immediately closing the straits to Russian shipping – until Putin recalls all troops in Crimea to their Sevastopol bases or to Russia proper.

zh: 而北约则应按照北约第5项保障的规定保护土耳其免受俄国威胁。
en: And Turkey should be offered an Article 5 guarantee from NATO should Russia seek to intimidate it.

zh: 其次，美国总统奥巴马应当像为核计划制裁伊朗那样对俄实行金融制裁。
en: Second, US President Barack Obama should impose the type of financial sanctions on Russia that he has imposed on Iran for its nuclear program.

zh: 上述制裁措施削弱了伊朗经济。
en: Those sanctions have crippled Iran’s economy.

zh: 同样，不允许任何与俄国银行或企业有业务往来的银行进入美国金融系统可以在俄国制造出共产主义刚刚倒台时那样的经济混乱。
en: Similarly, denying any bank that does business with a Russian bank or company access to the US financial system would create the kind of economic chaos last seen in Russia immediately after the fall of Communism.

zh: 俄罗斯普通民众应当明白纵容普京（此人声称其主要功绩是结束了苏联刚解体那几年的经济贫困）继续其帝国主义侵略将使他们付出惨重的代价。
en: Ordinary Russians should be made to understand that permitting Putin – whose primary claim to leadership is that he ended the penury of the first post-Soviet years – to continue with his imperialist aggression will cost them dearly.

zh: 第三，奥巴马应当强调中国在欧亚稳定中的利益。
en: Third, Obama should emphasize to the Chinese their stake in Eurasian stability.

zh: 普京或许认为苏联解体是个悲剧，但对中国来讲却是能够想象的最重要的地缘政治礼物。
en: Putin may regard the Soviet Union’s disintegration as a tragedy, but for China it was the greatest geostrategic gift imaginable.

zh: 数百年间盗走中国数百万公顷领土、并以核毁灭威胁人民共和国的帝国突然间不复存在了。
en: At a stroke, the empire that stole millions of hectares of Chinese territory over the centuries, and that threatened the People’s Republic with nuclear annihilation, simply vanished.

zh: 此后，中亚独立国家，甚至乌克兰都已成为中国最重要的贸易伙伴。
en: Since then, Central Asia’s independent states, and even Ukraine, have become important trading partners for China.

zh: 从上海合作组织（包括与中俄共有边界的前苏联国家在内的地区组织）召开的战后峰会上可以看出，俄国征服格鲁吉亚令中国大为不悦。
en: Russia’s conquests in Georgia greatly displeased China, as was seen at the post-war summit of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (a regional grouping that includes ex-Soviet countries that share borders with China and Russia).

zh: 俄罗斯敦促上合组织承认阿布哈兹和南奥塞梯独立。
en: Russia pushed the SCO to recognize the independence of Abkhazia and South Ossetia.

zh: 但上合组织却推三阻四。
en: But the SCO balked.

zh: 没有中国的支持，上合组织哈萨克斯坦、吉尔吉斯斯坦、塔吉克斯坦和乌兹别克斯坦等中亚成员国不会公然对克里姆林表示反对。
en: The group’s Central Asian members – Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan – would not have stood up to the Kremlin without China’s support.

zh: 但今天，中国国家主席习近平或许要在应对普京的冒险主义时少一些神秘。
en: Today, however, Chinese President Xi Jinping may need to be less cryptic in his response to Putin’s adventurism.

zh: 事实上，联合国很快就会考验中国究竟是不是如其所言扮演国际社会负责任的利益相关者。
en: Indeed, the real test of China’s claim that it is a responsible stakeholder in the world community will come soon at the United Nations.

zh: 中国究竟会支持普京对国际法的公然蔑视，还是会支持乌克兰的领土完整？
en: Will it back Putin’s clear flouting of international law, or will it back Ukraine’s territorial integrity?

zh: 还有其他可能的惩戒举措。
en: There are other possible punitive measures.

zh: 比方说拒签并取消所有俄国官员的签证。
en: Visas can be denied and canceled for all Russian officials.

zh: 比方说冻结金融资产，特别是与普京有千丝万缕关系的寡头。
en: Assets can be frozen, particularly those laundered by oligarchs close to Putin.

zh: 只有让精英阶层痛得难以忍受，才有可能迫使普京放弃奋斗。
en: Only when the pain becomes intolerable, particularly for the elite, will Putin’s kampf be defeated.

zh: 坐视不理将付出巨大的代价。
en: The cost of inaction is high.

zh: 从日本到以色列，无数国家都在仰仗美国对严重侵犯和平之举采取有力的打击行动。
en: Countless countries, from Japan to Israel, rely on America’s commitment to act robustly against grave breaches of the peace.

zh: 此外，乌克兰在1994年交出核武器时，美国（英国、法国和俄国）当时都明确表态将保障乌克兰的领土完整。
en: Moreover, when Ukraine surrendered its nuclear weapons in 1994, it did so with the express understanding that the US (and the United Kingdom, France, and Russia) would guarantee its territorial integrity.

zh: 如果克里米亚遭到吞并，谁也没资格反对乌克兰重新实现防御有核化（在技术上乌克兰依然有能力这样做 ） 。
en: Should Crimea be annexed, no one should gainsay Ukraine if it rapidly re-nuclearized its defense (which it retains the technological capacity to do).

zh: 张伯伦从慕尼黑归来时，温斯顿·丘吉尔曾说 ， “ 你要在战争与耻辱间做出选择。
en: When Chamberlain returned from Munich, Winston Churchill said, “You were given the choice between war and dishonor.

zh: 你选择了耻辱但却将面临战争。
en: You chose dishonor and you will have war.”

zh: ”奥巴马和其他西方国家领导人面临着类似的选择。
en: Obama and other Western leaders face a similar choice.

zh: 如果他们选择耻辱，那么可以肯定不受节制的普京将最终带给他们更多战争。
en: And if they choose dishonor, one can be certain that an undeterred Putin will eventually give them more war.

zh: 《查理周刊》的对与错
en: Charlie Hebdo’s Rights and Wrongs

zh: 达沃斯—在法国讽刺杂志、巴黎《查理周刊》遭遇恐怖袭击的背景下 ， “ 我是查理”的宣言响彻全世界。
en: DAVOS – In the wake of the terrorist attack on the French satirical magazine Charlie Hebdo in Paris, declarations of “Je suis Charlie” have echoed worldwide.

zh: 事实上 ， 《 查理周刊》应能自由地刊登它想刊登的东西而不必担心暴力，只要它本身不直接煽动暴力。
en: And, indeed, Charlie Hebdo should be free to publish what it likes, without fear of violence, as long as it does not directly incite violence itself.

zh: 但这意味着其他新闻机构和个人应该转载它吗？
en: But does that mean that other news outlets and individuals should republish it?

zh: 平心而论，言论自由应该永不遭遇镇压，美国最高法院法官霍姆斯（Oliver Wendell Holmes）在一宗与美国宪法对自由言论的保护的案例中，通过反对意见强调了这一点。
en: To be sure, freedom of expression should almost never be repressed, a point that the United States Supreme Court Justice Oliver Wendell Holmes emphasized in a dissenting opinion in a case concerning the US Constitution’s guarantee of free speech.

zh: “ [ 我]们永远警惕抑制被我们讨厌、认为充满了死亡的观点的表达的图谋 ， ” 他写道 ， “ 除非这些表达构成了紧迫的威胁，立即与法律规定的合法和紧要目的相违背，让我们不得不立刻予以抑制以拯救国家。 ”
en: “[W]e should be eternally vigilant against attempts to check the expression of opinions that we loathe and believe to be fraught with death,” he wrote, “unless they so imminently threaten immediate interference with the lawful and pressing purposes of the law that an immediate check is required to save the country.”

zh: 从这个角度看，我应该加入巴黎的百万人大集会，高呼“我是查理。
en: From this perspective, I would have marched with the millions who gathered in Paris, proclaiming “Je suis Charlie.”

zh: ”我也完全理解购买新一期《查理周刊》的渴望 — — 带着勇气和决心，它在袭击发生一周后面市。
en: And I fully understand the desire to purchase the subsequent issue of Charlie Hebdo, published – with bravery and determination – a week after the attack.

zh: 不但是法国，全世界人民都希望证明他们与受害者一条心、将支持言论自由的基本原则。
en: People not just in France, but around the world, want to show their solidarity with the victims and support the fundamental principle of free speech.

zh: 但支持《查理周刊》表达一切它所选择的信息的权利并不一定意味着支持其刊登的先知穆罕默德漫画或愿意参与这些漫画的传播。
en: But supporting Charlie Hebdo’s right to express whatever message it chooses does not necessarily imply support for its portrayals of the Prophet Mohammed or a willingness to participate in their dissemination.

zh: 支持原则并不一定需要支持行动。
en: Support for the principle does not demand endorsement of the practice.

zh: 袭击发生后，转发那些有冒犯之意的卡通形象而不是简单地用言语表达支持成为一场团结运动。
en: In the days after the attack, it became an act of solidarity to retweet the offending cartoons, rather than simply posting expressions of support.

zh: 黎巴嫩博客博主吉诺·莱迪（Gino Raidy）写道 ， “ 求求你们，不断发布这些卡通形象，不要停。
en: The Lebanese blogger Gino Raidy wrote, “Please, publish the cartoons again, and again, and again.

zh: 也许假以时日，以主之名扼杀一幅漫画的野蛮屠夫终究会发现，他们无法阻止我们，每一次尝试都只能让我们更加坚定（原文如此 ） 。 ”
en: Maybe with time, the murderous savages that kill for a drawing in the name of their god, will get it through their thick heads that they can never stop us, and every attempt to only fuels our cause more (sic).”

zh: 莱迪的呼吁充满了激情，这值得敬仰，他的情绪也不难理解。
en: The passion in Raidy’s appeal is admirable, and the sentiment is understandable.

zh: 但认为捍卫言论自由意味着传播具体内容的义务也是大有问题的。
en: But the view that defending free speech imposes a duty to disseminate specific content is deeply problematic.

zh: 发行亵渎或中伤他人虔诚信仰的形象或言论的决定只能是个人决定。
en: The decision to publish images or words that disrespect or defame others’ deeply held beliefs must be a personal one.

zh: 每个人都必须能够自由地做出这一决定，这也是反渎神法违反普世人权的原因。
en: Each individual must be free to make that decision, which is why anti-blasphemy laws violate universal human rights.

zh: 言论自由的基本原则是言论必须用其他言论来应对，决不能使用暴力、禁锢或审查。
en: The fundamental principle underlying freedom of expression is that speech must be answered with more speech, never with violence, imprisonment, or censorship.

zh: 反渎神法不但违反了这一原则，也很容易被滥用，沦为政治权力的工具，让社会变得僵化刻板而变得贫瘠。
en: Anti-blasphemy laws not only violate that principle; they can easily be abused as a tool of political power and impoverish their societies by imposing a code of rigid conformity.

zh: 但人们可以避免发表他人会认为渎神的言论。
en: But people can choose to avoid speech that others will hear as blasphemy.

zh: 尽管我捍卫个人发表种族主义言论的权利，但我自己绝不会发表这样的言论，也不会听发表这一言论的人。
en: Though I will defend the right of individuals to make racist statements, I would not make such statements myself or listen to a speaker making them.

zh: 毕竟，这些观点有损于其他许多重要原则 — — 即那些创造和维持包容、容忍和和平的社会所需要的原则。
en: After all, such views undermine many other important principles – namely, those needed to create and sustain an inclusive, tolerant, and peaceful society.

zh: 在《查理周刊》的例子中，问题在于先知穆罕默德的漫画形象是否可能引起与一个崇尚崇拜和言论自由的社会中的穆斯林、基督徒、犹太人、其他信仰者和无神论者共存相容的争论和行为。
en: In the case of Charlie Hebdo,the question is whether depictions of the Prophet Muhammad are likely to foster the kinds of debate and behavior that are compatible with the coexistence of Muslims, Christians, Jews, other believers, and atheists in a society that upholds the freedom of worship and expression.

zh: 所有人类都有权将某些东西视为神圣 — — 不管是地方、思想还是形象。
en: All human beings are entitled to hold something – a place, an idea, an image – sacred.

zh: 亵渎神社、丑化十字架、或在美国焚烧国旗都属于冒犯和侮辱行为，会引起信仰者的真正痛苦。
en: Desecrating a shrine, defacing a cross, or, in the US, burning a flag, is an aggressive and insulting act, one that causes real pain for believers.

zh: 它可能会引起对话，但是以大不敬的姿态引起的。
en: It may incite a conversation, but it does so from a position of profound disrespect.

zh: 当然 ， 《 查理周刊》运用的幽默恰恰挑战了神明。
en: Charlie Hebdo, of course, used humor precisely to challenge sacred cows.

zh: 它的编辑们勇敢而优雅地捍卫自己的主张，即使生命受到威胁。
en: And its editors bravely and nobly stood by their convictions, even when their lives were threatened.

zh: 我们应该坚持他们的出版权利。
en: We should uphold their right to publish.

zh: 但将他们所出版的形象作为启蒙运动信念的表达则削弱了对文明社会至关重要的价值。
en: But to embrace the images they published as a statement of Enlightenment conviction weakens the values that are essential to a civilized society.

zh: 新一期《查理周刊》在封面上又刊登了一幅先知漫画，在巴基斯坦、阿富汗、科威特、黎巴嫩和叙利亚造成反对大游行。
en: The new issue of Charlie Hebdo, which featured another image of the Prophet on its cover, sparked protest marches in Pakistan, Afghanistan, Kuwait, Lebanon, and Tunisia.

zh: 自称“伊斯兰自由派”的伊亚德·巴格达迪（Iyad El-Baghdadi）在Tweet上评论了这些游行的强度，他恰当地指出 ： “ 无悔意的仇恨到处都在成为主流。
en: Commenting on the intensity of these protests, Iyad El-Baghdadi, a self-described “Islamic libertarian,” aptly tweeted: “Unapologetic hatred is going mainstream everywhere.

zh: 我为世界担心。
en: I worry for our world.”

zh: ”动员广大群众就你“是”或“不是 ” 《 查理周刊》举行示威不啻在所有得益于不断升温的宗派冲突的社会中煽动极端派系。
en: Mobilizing mass demonstrations around whether you “are” or “are not” Charlie Hebdo invites demagoguery from extreme factions in all societies that gain from fueling sectarian conflict.

zh: 加剧巴黎悲剧的最佳办法莫过于用《查理周刊》编辑查波涅尔（Stéphane Charbonnier）和其他11人的死煽动宗教仇恨之火。
en: The easiest way to compound the tragedy in Paris would be to use the deaths of Charlie Hebdo’s editor, Stéphane Charbonnier, and 11 others to fan the flames of religious hatred.

zh: 当然，我们可以捍卫人们表达自我的权利而不认可或支持他们的观点。
en: Surely we can defend people’s right to express themselves without approving or endorsing their views.

zh: 在《查理周刊》的例子中，拒绝传播其漫画也许是出于恐惧，但也有可能是出于尊重。
en: In the case of Charlie Hebdo, the decision not to disseminate its cartoons can be driven not by fear, but by respect.

zh: 团结起来反对极端主义
en: Uniting Against Extremism

zh: 伦敦 — — 一个根本性问题正日益困扰着世界各国政府：如何面对起源于宗教目的的暴力极端主义倾向。
en: LONDON – Governments worldwide are increasingly facing a fundamental question: how to deal with the causes of violent – often religiously motivated – extremism.

zh: 形形色色的建议来自于方方面面，但政府所缺的并不是建议。
en: They are not short of advice – and from a wide range of sources.

zh: 比方说，一名前基地组织成员不久前曾经表示英国当局未能很好地解释不干预叙利亚内战的原因有可能进一步激化穆斯林的激进情绪。
en: A former Al Qaeda member, for example, recently stated that the UK authorities’ failure to explain properly why it had not intervened in Syria’s civil war risked radicalizing more Muslims.

zh: 此外，伦敦市市长鲍里斯·约翰逊建议从激进的父母身边带走他们的孩子。
en: Meanwhile, London Mayor Boris Johnson suggested removing children from radicalized parents.

zh: 虽然人们对类似想法反应各式各样，但至少有一点令人欣慰，那就是这标志着我们迫切需要的公众辩论的开始。
en: Although such ideas have received a somewhat mixed reception, they are a welcome sign of much-needed public debate.

zh: 多数人接受动用安全部队来应对恐怖行为，尤其是在袭击发生之后。
en: Most people accept the need for security services to respond to terror, particularly in the aftermath of an attack.

zh: 但只有同时解决恐怖主义的后果和根源问题，才能带来持久的变化。
en: Achieving lasting change, however, requires addressing not just the consequences of extremism but also its root causes.

zh: 我们究竟应该采取哪些举措？
en: What can be done?

zh: 首先，政府必须开始把教育提升到安全问题的高度。
en: First, governments must start thinking about education as a security issue.

zh: 比方说，与其没完没了地担心网上的危险内容，还不如教给年轻人不去关注类似内容的关键技巧。
en: For example, while endlessly worrying about the existence of dangerous material online, we could do more to educate our youth in the critical thinking skills needed to dismiss such content.

zh: 这是一项全新的挑战，而且完成任务的难度很大。
en: This is a new challenge, and it will not be easy.

zh: 数字革命前，年轻人接触其他国家文化的机会相对有限，比方说去国外度假或者校际交流。
en: Before the digital revolution, young people met those from other countries and cultures in relatively restricted circumstances, such as on a holiday abroad or a school exchange program.

zh: 但今天他们却可以借助智能手机在短短几秒之内与任何国家的任何人实现互动。
en: Today, however, they can interact with any number of people from anywhere in the world in a matter of seconds on their smart phones.

zh: 很多交流平台都缺乏监管，让未成年人接触到各种各样的观点、信仰和文化 — — 但这些内容并不总是积极和安全的。
en: Many of these connections take place on un-moderated platforms that expose children to a wide variety of opinions, beliefs, and cultures – not all positive or safe.

zh: 令人遗憾的是，没有多少好的建议能帮助年轻人控制这些危险因素。
en: Unfortunately, there are few sources of good advice to help young people navigate these dangers.

zh: 多数家长自己都只能勉强跟上技术的发展，更不用说监督孩子的在线对话。
en: Most parents are barely able to keep up with the evolving technology, let alone oversee their children’s online conversations.

zh: 这就是说需要由我们的教育制度进行早期干预来帮助互联网一代在今天的数字世界中安全互动。
en: This means that it is up to our education systems to intervene early to help the connected generation interact safely in today’s digital world.

zh: 如果我们能教孩子认识到与其他文化的共同之处，当然也能帮助他们抵制歪曲真相者的分裂偏见。
en: If we can teach children to recognize what they have in common with those from other cultures, we can also help them to resist the prejudices of those who seek to distort the truth and divide people.

zh: 托尼·布莱尔信仰基金会学校计划在这方面做出了重要贡献。
en: The Tony Blair Faith Foundation’s schools program has made an important start in this respect.

zh: 12-17岁的孩子可以在该计划提供的监管网站上从不同角度以相互尊重并且安全的方式探讨各式各样的难题。
en: It provides a moderated space in which 12-17 year olds worldwide can discuss challenging issues from a variety of perspectives, in a respectful and safe way.

zh: 其次，政府应该为已经存在的反恐怖主义实体及网络组织提供支持。
en: Second, governments should support those groups that are already working on the ground and online to counter extremism.

zh: 方法之一是鼓励表达“相反的观点 ” 。
en: One approach is to encourage “counter-narratives.”

zh: 在尼日利亚等饱受宗教冲突困扰的国家，这意味着帮助宗教领袖建立起牢固的跨群体关系。
en: In countries afflicted by religious conflict, such as Nigeria, this means helping religious leaders to develop strong inter-community relationships.

zh: 我们知道当不同宗教信仰的群众为了更广泛的群体利益而走到一起，他们对对方的了解能够有助于抵御极端分子的诱惑。
en: We know that when people of different religions work together for the good of the wider community, they come to understand one another in a way that helps them resist the call of extremists.

zh: 最坏情况下���往会自发地开展上述长期持续性工作。
en: This type of sustained long-term work comes into its own when the worst happens.

zh: 比方说，为了应对去年在巴基斯坦白沙瓦发生的教堂袭击，当地穆斯林在教堂周围排起人墙，让教堂能够正常提供服务。
en: For example, in response to attacks last year on a church in Peshawar, Pakistan, local Muslims formed human chains around churches, allowing them to hold services.

zh: 面对暴力活动的这类显而易见的反抗行动强化了团体之间的联系，同时能够挫败极端分子的分裂企图。
en: Such visible demonstrations of defiance in the face of violence strengthen ties between communities and can prevent the division that extremists try to generate.

zh: 在伦敦这个全世界最多元化的城市，这种跨团体精神带来了显而易见的好处。
en: The benefits of such inter-community spirit are evident in one of the world’s most diverse cities, London.

zh: 去年六月在伦敦Muswell Hill区索马里布拉瓦福利会（就在英国陆军燧发枪手Lee Rigby被宗教极端分子谋杀之后不久）发生的纵火案所起的作用仅仅是将不同的宗教群体团结在了一起。
en: Last June’s arson attack on the Somali Bravanese Welfare Association’s center in the city’s Muswell Hill district (which followed the murder of British Army fusilier Lee Rigby by religious extremists) served only to unite its different communities.

zh: 当地一家民间机构网络伦敦市民为索马里穆斯林发起了犹太援助计划，包括在亨顿学校和伊顿学校举办课后活动。
en: London Citizens, a network of local civic institutions, organized Jewish assistance programs for Somali Muslims, including after-school events at Hendon School and Eden School.

zh: 此外，芬奇利改革会堂举办了斋月节，芬奇利美国犹太教堂举办了开斋节活动。
en: Meanwhile, Finchley Reform Synagogue hosted a Ramadan festival, and Finchley United Synagogue hosted an Eid event.

zh: 这些活动向极端分子发出了强有力的信号，他们在宗教团体间挑起矛盾的作法取得了相反的效果。
en: These activities sent a powerful signal to extremists that their attempts to turn religious communities against each other had the opposite effect.

zh: 第三，必须即刻清理网上的恐怖内容。
en: Third, it is essential to remove online extremist content promptly.

zh: YouTube采用了复杂的技术程序，以确保能够迅速撤下最不恰当的视频。
en: YouTube uses sophisticated technical procedures to ensure that the most inappropriate videos are swiftly taken down.

zh: 但这只是问题的一个方面：我们还要支持和推动替代性宣传，在网上发掘可信的观点来对抗极端主义者。
en: But this is only half the story: we also need to support and promote alternative, credible voices online to counter the extremist narrative.

zh: 当然，这并不是说上传身着西服的政治家教导年轻人不要加入叙利亚圣战的视频文件。
en: Of course, this does not mean uploading videos of politicians in suits telling young men not to join the jihad in Syria.

zh: 相反，这意味着找到反恐信息能与目标受众产生共鸣的团体并且给予支持。
en: Rather, it means identifying and backing those groups whose anti-extremist messages resonate with the intended audience.

zh: 最后，在目前困难的经济条件下，我们需要找到低成本的方式在全球推广这项事业。
en: Finally, in these tough economic times, we need to consider cost-effective ways to promote this work globally.

zh: 未来可能为有效但资金不足组织提供支持的或许是不久前成立的团体参与及适应性全球基金，这是有史以来第一家公私合营的全球基金，为打击恐怖主义的地方草根力量提供支持。
en: One future source of support for effective but under-resourced groups might be the recently established Global Fund for Community Engagement and Resilience, the first ever public-private global fund to support local, grass-roots efforts to counter extremism.

zh: 随着全球化和技术改革的步伐不断加快，极端分子正在用越来越有创意的方式传播他们的信息。
en: As the pace of globalization and technological change accelerates, extremists are finding ever more creative ways to spread their message.

zh: 各国政府也必须采取相应的措施。
en: Governments must respond in kind.

zh: 纳粹是否像苹果派一样美国？
en: Are Nazis as American as Apple Pie?

zh: 纽黑文 — — 美国是否受到纳粹主义的威胁？
en: NEW HAVEN – Is the United States threatened by Nazism?

zh: 简短的答案是没有，尽管弗吉尼亚夏洛茨维尔刚刚过去的周末发生的事情非常可怕。
en: The short answer is no, notwithstanding the frightening events in Charlottesville, Virginia, this past weekend.

zh: 在由托马斯·杰斐逊创立的弗吉尼亚大学所在地夏洛茨维尔，白人民族分子、分离分子、新纳粹分子、3K党徒和其他具有类似思想的团体团结在纳粹十字标记的周围，举行纳粹风格的火炬游行。
en: In Charlottesville, the home of the University of Virginia, founded by Thomas Jefferson, white nationalists, separatists, neo-Nazis, members of the Ku Klux Klan, and other likeminded groups rallied behind Swastika banners and marched in a Nazi-style torchlight procession.

zh: 游行第二天结束时发生了暴力事件。
en: By the end of the next day, there had also been thuggish violence.

zh: 一名白人至上主义者竟然开车冲进持反对意见的抗议人群中，造成1人死亡，19人受伤。
en: One white supremacist went so far as to drive a car into a crowd of counter-protestors, killing one and injuring 19 others.

zh: 制造夏洛茨维尔暴力事件的团体去年11月曾狂欢庆祝美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的当选。
en: The groups responsible for the violence in Charlottesville reveled in US President Donald Trump’s election last November.

zh: 而特朗普则经常在否定他们时表现出犹豫的态度；在总统大选期间，当前3K党大咖大卫·杜克对其表示公开支持时，特朗普令人愤慨地犹犹豫豫，不愿拒绝杜克及其追随者。
en: And Trump has often hesitated to disavow them; during the election campaign, when former KKK Grand Wizard David Duke publicly backed him, Trump was scandalously slow to reject Duke and his followers.

zh: 特朗普还在竞选期间一再煽动暴力冲突，并表达了对独裁领袖俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京无穷无尽的仰慕。
en: Trump also repeatedly incited violence during the campaign, while evincing a bottomless affection for authoritarian leaders such as Russian President Vladimir Putin.

zh: 夏洛茨维尔事件发生后，特朗普起先发表了一个温和的声明，谴责“来自多方的”仇恨，并借此机会混淆了种族主义者和反对者之间的区别。
en: After the events in Charlottesville, Trump initially offered a bland statement that condemned hate “on many sides,” thereby drawing a moral equivalence between the racists and those who gathered to oppose them.

zh: 两天后，因为压力越来越大，特朗普才发表了一份更加有力的声明，新声明明确谴责3K党、新纳粹分子和其他白人至上主义者，但后来却又改变立场指责“双方”制造了暴力活动。
en: Two days later, under intensifying pressure, Trump issued a more forceful statement, in which he explicitly condemned the KKK, neo-Nazis, and other white supremacists, only to revert the following day to blaming “both sides” for the violence.

zh: 所有这些都令人心生厌恶。
en: All of this is abhorrent.

zh: 但任何清醒的旁观者都可以看出美国还远未到1933年德国噩梦般氛围的时候。
en: But any sober observer can see that the US is still a long way from the nightmarish atmosphere of Germany in 1933.

zh: 美国的民主制度仍在发挥作用，这一点与20世纪30年代危机时没有任何差别。
en: American democratic institutions are holding up, just as they did in the crisis years of the 1930s.

zh: 反对党并没有遭到禁止，而法院也没有丧失独立权威。
en: Opposition parties have not been banned, and the courts have not lost their independent authority.

zh: 不仅如此，特朗普也并非手握准军事部门政党的最高领袖。
en: Moreover, Trump is not the supreme leader of a political party with a paramilitary arm.

zh: 现在没有达豪、奥斯维辛、特雷布林卡这样的设施正在建设当中。
en: There are no facilities such as Dachau, Auschwitz, or Treblinka under construction.

zh: 就连特朗普计划中的墨美边境隔离墙也仍然处在规划阶段，没有得到美国国会的拨款资助。
en: Even Trump’s planned border wall with Mexico remains stuck in the planning stage, with no funding from the US Congress.

zh: 而且国会也没有打算通过一项授予总统独裁权力的法案，就像德意志帝国议会1933年3月授权希特勒时那样。
en: And Congress is not about to pass an Enabling Act conferring dictatorial powers on the president, as the Reichstag did for Hitler in March 1933.

zh: 最后但同样重要的是，美国媒体比前些年更加活跃和顽强。
en: Last but not least, the American press is more tenacious and energized than it has been in years.

zh: 特朗普对专制统治的渴望显而易见。
en: Trump’s yearning for authoritarian rule is clear for all to see.

zh: 但他无法实现这一目标。
en: But he will not achieve it.

zh: 美国将不会实行纳粹独裁制度。
en: There will be no Nazi dictatorship in America.

zh: 但问题不在于美国是否受到上述独裁制度的威胁。
en: But whether America is threatened by such a dictatorship is not the right question.

zh: 美国的民主制度可能正在发挥作用，但历史告诉我们它们无法完全不受恶性种族政治计划的影响。
en: American democratic institutions might be holding up, but history has taught us that they are not immune to the machinations of racially virulent political programs.

zh: 事实上，美国制定了某些法律，这些法律日后很有可能会为德国纳粹运动在美国的发展打下基础。
en: In fact, the US produced some of the laws that would later serve as a foundation for the Nazi movement in Germany.

zh: 美国尽管拥有活力四射的民主机构，但仍拥有20世纪初规模最大的种族主义司法制度。
en: America, with its vibrant democratic institutions, was the leading racist jurisdiction in the world in the early twentieth century.

zh: 一个明显的例子是在信奉种族歧视的南方，白人管辖的立法机构通过了法律强制种族隔离并逆转内战后重建时期的诸多成就。
en: An obvious example is the Jim Crow South, where white legislatures passed laws imposing racial segregation and reversing many of the gains of the post-Civil War Reconstruction period.

zh: 但这并不是唯一的实例。
en: But that is hardly the only example.

zh: 欧洲极右翼同样羡慕美国20世纪初期的移民政策，这些政策设计的初衷是排除“不受欢迎的”种族。
en: Those on the far right in Europe also admired America’s early-twentieth-century immigration policies, which were designed to exclude “undesirable” races.

zh: 在宣言作品我的奋斗中，希特勒将美国列为一个正在创建健康的以种族为基础的秩序的“国度 ” 。
en: In his manifesto Mein Kampf, Hitler singled out America as “the one state” that was progressing toward the creation of a healthy race-based order.

zh: 事实上，在这一时期，美国有30个州出台了旨在维护种族纯洁性的反异族通婚法。
en: Indeed, during this period, 30 US states had anti-miscegenation laws intended to safeguard racial purity.

zh: 20世纪初，美国的民主制度并没有反对这样的政策。
en: America’s democratic institutions did not stand in the way of such policies in the early twentieth century.

zh: 相反，反异族通婚法恰恰是美国民主制度的产物，让许多美国种族主义者有机会充分表达。
en: On the contrary, anti-miscegenation laws were the product of America’s democratic system, which gave full voice to many Americans’ racism.

zh: 而美国法院维护了这样的法律创新，利用灵活的普通法判例来决定“白人”特权地位的归属。
en: And US courts upheld these legal innovations, using flexible common-law precedents to decide who would acquire the privileged status of “white.”

zh: 纳粹分子对此保持了密切的关注。
en: The Nazis paid close attention.

zh: 在炮制自己的种族法律时 — — 也就是1935年的纽伦堡法 — — 他们全神贯注地效仿美国种族法律的榜样。
en: As they concocted their own racial statutes – the Nuremberg Laws of 1935 – they pored over American race law as a model.

zh: 因此今天，与其纠结美国制度能否在特朗普任职期间生存下来，我们必须搞清这套制度怎样才能服务于错误的目标。
en: So today, instead of asking whether American institutions will survive the Trump presidency, we must ask how American institutions can be put in the service of wrongful ends.

zh: 毕竟，尽管美国20世纪初的种族法律已经不复存在，但它仍拥有当时那样过热的民主秩序和普通法的灵活裁量；上述制度也许无法再制定歧视黑人的法律；但举例来讲，美国的刑事司法制度仍然是制度化种族主义的模范代表。
en: After all, while America’s early-twentieth-century race laws are gone, it still has the same overheated democratic order and common-law flexibility that it had back then. These institutions might no longer produce Jim Crow laws; but the American criminal-justice system, for example, remains a poster child for institutionalized racism.

zh: 美国人应当为其国内制度为纳粹种族法律奠定基础而感到耻辱。
en: Americans should be ashamed that their country’s institutions laid the groundwork for Nazi race law.

zh: 但他们不应担心纳粹主义重生的威胁，即使特朗普在谴责白人至上主义者方面表现出明显的矛盾态度。
en: But they should not be worrying about the threat of renascent Nazism, despite Trump’s clear ambivalence in condemning white supremacists.

zh: 相反，美国人应当担心本国制度催生这种邪恶的可能性，尽管我们不愿承认，但这种可能性的存在就像苹果派一样代表着美国。
en: Rather, Americans should worry about the potential of their institutions to facilitate evils that are, as loath as we are to admit it, as American as apple pie.

zh: 拉美两大危机的故事
en: Latin America’s Tale of Two Crises

zh: 墨西哥城—如果你是个无可救药的乐观主义者，那么委内瑞拉和哥伦比亚即将发生的事情将会被你视为吉兆。
en: MEXICO CITY – If one were an irredeemable optimist, upcoming events in Venezuela and Colombia could be viewed as a harbinger of good things to come.

zh: 在委内瑞拉，10月7日的总统大选可能会宣告查韦斯14年统治结束，与之一起结束的是对经济的系统性破坏、媒体管制和无穷无尽的干涉他国内政。
en: In Venezuela, the October 7 presidential election may put an end to Hugo Chávez’s 14 years in power, along with his systematic destruction of the economy, media clampdowns, and endless meddling in other countries’ affairs.

zh: 在哥伦比亚，总统桑托斯政府和FARC游击队将在10月8日于挪威展开和平谈判，可能终结40年的战争和流血。
en: In Colombia, peace talks scheduled for October 8 in Norway between President Juan Manuel Santos’s government and the FARC guerrillas may bring an end to 40 years of war and bloodshed.

zh: 不幸的是，这两个结果都不太可能发生。
en: Unfortunately, neither of these outcomes is likely.

zh: 不论在委内瑞拉还是哥伦比亚，人们渴望之事都是可望而不可及。
en: In both cases, what seems desirable appears highly improbable.

zh: 查韦斯直接参与过四次委内瑞拉大选：1998年他首次当选总统；2004年反对派掀起了罢免投票；2006年他获得连任；以及眼下的第四次。 查韦斯刚从癌症中恢复，委内瑞拉则处于深重的危机中，加拉加斯已经成为全世界最危险的城市。
en: Chávez has participated directly in four Venezuelan elections: in 1998, when he was elected for the first time; in 2004, when the opposition forced a recall vote; in 2006, when he was re-elected; and now, as he recovers from cancer and the country is in the midst of a huge public-safety crisis that has made Caracas one of the most dangerous cities in the world.

zh: 查韦斯在前三次大选中都获胜了，处于某些原因，第四次也会以他获胜告终。
en: Chávez won the first three, and, for several reasons, seems poised to win again.

zh: 首先，查韦斯是个可怕的竞选对手，他对国家权力的控制可谓无孔不入，从选举委员会到国有石油公司PDVSA都在他的控制下。
en: For starters, Chávez is a formidable campaigner, and he has at his disposal every available lever of state power, from the Electoral Council to PDVSA, the national oil company.

zh: 对于反对派候选人拉东斯基（Henrique Capriles Radonski）的能力来说，这根本就不是一场公平的较量，他没有获胜机会。
en: As skillful as Henrique Capriles Radonski, the opposition candidate, may be, the playing field is so uneven that he appears to stand little chance.

zh: 举个例子：委内瑞拉总人口在过去13年里增加了14 % ， 但选举人增加了53 % ； 新增选民可能是僵尸选民、哥伦比亚人，或是尚未出身就注册成为选民的未来若干代查韦斯支持者。
en: One example: Venezuela’s overall population has grown 14% over the past 13 years, but electoral rolls have jumped 53%; the new voters can be ghosts, Colombians, or several generations of chavista supporters already registered to vote, even before they are born.

zh: 大部分民调都显示查韦斯优势明显（大约有15个百分点 ） ， 但尽管如此，反对派仍有一线生机。
en: Most polls give Chávez a significant advantage (of up to 15 percentage points), but nonetheless offer a glimmer of hope to the opposition.

zh: Luis Christiansen的Consultores 21公司、Varianzas公司和Keller公司等多家较中立的调查公司的民调显示，摇摆选民比例惊人地高，他们或者没有表达自己的投票倾向，或者根本不知道该投谁。
en: Many of the more impartial polling firms, such as Luis Christiansen’s Consultores 21, Varianzas, and Keller, all show a surprisingly large proportion of undecided voters – those who do not answer or do not know for whom they will vote.

zh: 在高度极端化和政治化的委内瑞拉，不可能出现高达20%的选民尚未决定投票方向的情况。
en: In highly polarized and politicized Venezuela, it is unlikely that upward of 20% of voters have yet to decide what they will do.

zh: 因此，一些分析者怀疑存在一批 “潜在的反对票 ” ， 当时1990年的尼加拉瓜和2000年的墨西哥都出现过这类选票，最后查莫罗（Violeta Chamorrro）和福克斯分别在两国获胜。
en: Consequently, some analysts suspect a “hidden opposition vote,” such as occurred in Nicaragua in 1990, when Violeta Chamorrro won the presidency, or in Mexico in 2000, when Vicente Fox emerged victorious.

zh: 根据���一逻辑 ， “ 未决定”选票实际上是倾向拉东斯基的，只要这部分选票大过查韦斯的民调优势，查韦斯就可能失败。
en: According to this logic, the “undecided” are actually leaning toward Capriles, and if their number is larger than Chávez’s margin in the polls, the caudillo will lose.

zh: 这并不是不可能，但可能性极低，特别是如果查韦斯在投票结束后可以赢得一部分摇摆选票的话。
en: That is not impossible, but it is unlikely, especially if Chávez can count on several percentage points of tampered votes before and after the polling booths close.

zh: 尽管查韦斯身体有恙，委内瑞拉问题丛生，查韦斯派13年后疲态尽露，但要把查韦斯选下台绝不容易。
en: Despite the president’s illness, the enormous problems facing Venezuela, and fatigue after 13 years of chavismo, it is still Chávez’s election to lose.

zh: 哥伦比亚则可能继续维持现状。
en: The status quo will also likely persist in Colombia.

zh: 没人知道桑托斯是什么时候决定于拉美最老牌、同时也是最残忍之一的游击队组织进行新谈判的；也只有他的亲信部下才知道双方已经进行了多少次会面，在哪里和何时会的面，会面时又发生过什么。
en: No one knows exactly when Santos decided to seek new negotiations with Latin America’s oldest – and one of its most vicious – guerrilla groups; nor do any but his closest aides know how many meetings have already taken place, where and when, or what happened.

zh: 但许多证据表明，谈判进程开始已经有一段时间了，且在就大部分现有问题达成广泛一致前不会公开。
en: But much evidence suggests that most of the process began some time ago, and was meant to be kept secret until broad agreement had been reached on most of the outstanding issues.

zh: 桑托斯可能希望这次谈判可以被视为“缉毒游击队”的相对无条件投降和解除武装。
en: Santos probably wanted to have the talks viewed as a relatively unconditional surrender and disarmament by the “narco-guerrillas.”

zh: 他也许想避免公开谈判所难以避免的炫耀和宣传色彩。
en: He would have wanted to avoid the grandstanding and propaganda generally associated with public negotiations.

zh: 因此谈判之所以被披露，可能并不是因为进展令人满意，而是因为有人想破坏它。
en: So the talks may have been revealed not because they had advanced sufficiently, but because someone wanted to sabotage them.

zh: 那么这个人是谁？
en: Who could that be?

zh: 意料中的嫌疑人是前哥伦比亚总统乌里韦。
en: The predictable suspect is former Colombian president Álvaro Uribe.

zh: 尽管桑托斯是乌里韦的国防部长和理想接班人，但两者的关系已经恶化。
en: Although Santos was both Uribe’s defense minister and preferred successor, relations between the two have soured.

zh: 根本原因可能是乌里韦觉得桑托斯当了总统应该对他投桃报李，而桑托斯觉得他的支持率（很高，但在下跌）是靠自己赢得的，不是乌里韦给的。
en: The bottom line is that Uribe thought Santos would do his bidding as president, and Santos is convinced that his (high but declining) popularity is of his own making, not borrowed from Uribe.

zh: 如此龃龉在政治问题上显露无疑。
en: These strains express themselves on policy issues.

zh: 乌里韦每天要在他有一百多万粉丝的tweet上发40条微博批评桑托斯，说他否定他的“民主安全”立场，使哥伦比亚“Bacrim ” （ 轻微犯罪团伙）愈演愈烈，对两个敌对邻国 — — 委内瑞拉和厄瓜多尔不够强硬，还把他的几位助手送上了反腐法庭。
en: Uribe criticizes Santos – through up to 40 tweets per day to his more than one million followers – for repudiating his “democratic security” stance, for the growth of the “Bacrim” (petty-crime gangs), for appeasing Colombia’s two hostile neighbors, Venezuela and Ecuador, and for prosecuting some of his aides on corruption charges.

zh: 桑托斯什么都没说，以行动作为回击：与查韦斯和厄瓜多尔总统科雷亚保持和平，对乌里韦时期的破坏人权案件提起诉讼，逮捕一批涉及腐败案的官员。
en: Santos says nothing, but replies in kind: making peace with Chávez and Ecuadorean President Rafael Correa, prosecuting human rights violations under Uribe, and arresting several of his allegedly corrupt officials.

zh: 但如今，似乎在一夜之间，桑托斯开始违抗甚至回击乌里韦：与人人鄙视的FARC谈判。 在谈判前，他对FARC进行了毁灭性的军事打击，以使此次和平进程更易达成成果。
en: And now, seemingly out of the blue, he has defied and even offended Uribe by undertaking negotiations with the despised FARC, after having delivered such devastating military blows to them that perhaps, this time around, the peace process will prosper.

zh: 我们可以看到，乌里韦为什么要泄露关于谈判的消息，也可以看到为什么桑托斯会以将谈判公开化、让所有人都看到谈判进程作为回击（谈判将在奥斯陆开始，但会在哈瓦那进行 ） 。
en: One can see why Uribe would threaten to leak news about the negotiations, as well as why Santos would try to preempt the leaks by going public and having them take place in the open (the talks will begin in Oslo, but will be pursued in Havana).

zh: 问题在于，尽管被公布的 — — 如果不是公开的话 — — 和平谈判成功的例子不少，但失败和陷入永久僵局的情况给更多，这是因为在全世界目光下工作的压力是巨大的。
