en: The problem is that, although there are good examples of publicized – if not public – peace talks that have succeeded, there are more instances of failure or indefinite stalemate, owing to the pressure of working under the glare of the international spotlight.

zh: 作为桑托斯人权行动、他对开展毒品法制化问题争论的呼吁以及他结束哥伦比亚“四十年战争”努力的坚定支持者，我担心乌里韦会对和平进程带来致命伤害，导致哥伦比亚的流血现状无限期延长下去。
en: As a fervent supporter of Santos’s human-rights efforts, of his call for a major debate on drug legalization, and of his attempt to end Colombia’s “Forty Years’ War,” I fear that Uribe has fatally wounded the peace process, and will prolong the country’s bloody and fruitless status quo indefinitely.

zh: 这实在令人遗憾。
en: That is a great pity.

zh: 因此，很不幸，在南美的这两个邻国，发生变化的可能性极小 — — 除非像过去一再发生的那样，出人意料之事突然变得无可避免，让所有人都大跌眼镜。
en: So, in this tale of two South American neighbors, unfortunately, little will change – unless, as so often happens, the unexpected suddenly becomes inevitable, in which case all bets are off.

zh: 廉价石油和全球增长
en: Cheap Oil and Global Growth

zh: 伦敦—油价的暴力波动正在动摇全世界经济和金融市场。
en: LONDON – Violent swings in oil prices are destabilizing economies and financial markets worldwide.

zh: 去年油价腰斩，从每桶110美元暴跌至55美元，原因显而易见：沙特阿拉伯决定通过扩大产能增加其占全球石油市场的份额。
en: When the oil price halved last year, from $110 to $55 a barrel, the cause was obvious: Saudi Arabia’s decision to increase its share of the global oil market by expanding production.

zh: 但过去几周油价进一步暴跌 — — 跌到了2008年全球金融危机爆发后的所达到的低位 — — 原因何在，对世界经济会造成怎样的影响？
en: But what accounts for the further plunge in oil prices in the last few weeks – to lows last seen in the immediate aftermath of the 2008 global financial crisis – and how will it affect the world economy?

zh: 标准解释是中国需求疲软，石油价格崩盘被广泛视为衰退的前兆，可能是中国衰退，也可能是整个全球经济衰退。
en: The standard explanation is weak Chinese demand, with the oil-price collapse widely regarded as a portent of recession, either in China or for the entire global economy.

zh: 但这几乎肯定是错误的，即使石油和股市之间的强相关性似乎确认了这一点。 这一相关性已跌至2009年以来的最低点，不仅中国如此，欧洲和大部分新兴经济体亦然。
en: But this is almost certainly wrong, even though it seems to be confirmed by the tight correlation between oil and equity markets, which have fallen to their lowest levels since 2009 not only in China, but also in Europe and most emerging economies.

zh: 石油价格的预测重要性确实令人印象深刻，不过是作为作为反向指标：石油价格下跌从未正确预示过经济衰退。
en: The predictive significance of oil prices is indeed impressive, but only as a contrary indicator: Falling oil prices have never correctly predicted an economic downturn.
On all recent occasions when the price of oil was halved – 1982-1983, 1985-1986, 1992-1993, 1997-1998, and 2001-2002 – faster global growth followed.

zh: 反之，在过去50年中，所有全球刷爱退之前都发生了油价暴涨。
en: Conversely, every global recession in the past 50 years has been preceded by a sharp increase in oil prices.

zh: 最近一次在是2008年大崩盘之前的一年中，油价几乎上涨两倍；接着，油价在六个月的时间内暴跌至40美元，紧随而至的便是2009年4月开始的经济复苏。
en: Most recently, the price of oil almost tripled, from $50 to $140, in the year leading up to the 2008 crash; it then plunged to $40 in the six months immediately before the economic recovery that started in April 2009.

zh: 对生产大宗商品的发展中国家来说，一个重要推论是工业金属价格 — — 这才真正是经济活动的先行指标 — — 极有可能在油价崩盘后上涨。
en: An important corollary for commodity-producing developing countries is that industrial metal prices, which really are leading indicators of economic activity, may well increase after an oil-price collapse.

zh: 比如，1986—1987年，金属价格在油价腰斩后的一年里实现翻番。
en: In 1986-87, for example, metal prices doubled a year after oil prices fell by half.

zh: 油价和全球增长的负相关性背后是一个强大的经济规律。
en: A powerful economic mechanism underlies the inverse correlation between oil prices and global growth.

zh: 由于世界每年要燃烧340亿桶石油，油价下跌10美元就意味着石油生产者向消费者让渡了3,400亿美元。
en: Because the world burns 34 billion barrels of oil every year, a $10 fall in the price of oil shifts $340 billion from oil producers to consumers.

zh: 因此，自去年8月以来油价下跌60美元意味着一年超过2万亿美元被再分配给石油消费者，所形成的收入刺激效应比2009年美国和中国财政刺激之和还要大。
en: Thus, the $60 price decline since last August will redistribute more than $2 trillion annually to oil consumers, providing a bigger income boost than the combined US and Chinese fiscal stimulus in 2009.

zh: 总体而言，石油消费者会相当快地将新增收入花掉，而政府（它获得了全球石油收入的大头）常常通过贷款或减少储备为公共支出融资，因此油价下跌的净效应永远对全球增长起到积极作用。
en: Because oil consumers generally spend extra income fairly quickly, while governments (which collect the bulk of global oil revenues) usually maintain public spending by borrowing or running down reserves, the net effect of lower oil prices has always been positive for global growth.

zh: 据国际货币基金组织（IMF）的数据，今年油价下跌应能刺激2016年GDP提高0.5—1 % ， 其中欧洲提高0.3—0.4 % ， 美国1—1.2 % ， 中国1—2 % 。
en: According to the International Monetary Fund, the fall in oil prices this year should boost 2016 GDP by 0.5-1% globally, including growth of 0.3-0.4% in Europe, 1-1.2% in the US, and 1-2% in China.

zh: 但如果中国等石油消费经济体明年增长有望加速，那么油价暴跌又是什么原因？
en: But if growth is likely to accelerate next year in oil-consuming economies such as China, what explains plunging oil prices?

zh: 原因不在于中国经济和石油需求，而在于中东地缘政治和石油供给。
en: The answer lies not in China’s economy and oil demand, but in Middle East geopolitics and oil supply.

zh: 沙特生产政策显然是去年油价腰斩背后的原因，而7月6日开始的新一轮暴跌就发生在取消伊朗国际制裁的协议达成几天后。
en: While Saudi production policies were clearly behind last year’s halving of the oil price, the latest plunge began on July 6, within days of the deal to lift international sanctions against Iran.

zh: 伊朗核协议推翻了一个普遍存在的天真假设：地缘政治只能单向地推动石油价格。
en: The Iran nuclear deal refuted the widespread but naive assumption that geopolitics can drive oil prices in only one direction.

zh: 交易者突然想起，地缘政治事件也可以增加石油供给，而不只是减少石油供给 — — 而在未来几年中还可能有进一步的地缘政治驱动的供给刺激。
en: Traders suddenly recalled that geopolitical events can increase oil supplies, not just reduce them – and that further geopolitics-driven supply boosts are likely in the years ahead.

zh: 利比亚、俄罗斯、委内瑞拉和尼日利亚等国的条件十分糟糕，很难想象它们的石油产量还会受到什么影响。
en: Conditions in Libya, Russia, Venezuela, and Nigeria are already so bad that further damage to their oil output is hard to imagine.

zh: 相反，许多世界上产油量最大的地区深陷政治混乱，任何稳定迹象都可能迅速刺激供给。
en: On the contrary, with so many of the world’s most productive oil regions gripped by political chaos, any sign of stabilization can quickly boost supplies.

zh: 去年的伊拉克就是如此，而现在的伊朗更是将这一过程推到了新高度。
en: That is what happened in Iraq last year, and Iran is now taking this process to a higher level.

zh: 只要制裁被解除，伊朗承诺可以几乎立刻将石油出口量提高一倍，达到每天两百万桶，到2020年还可以将出口量再翻一番。
en: Once sanctions are lifted, Iran promises to double oil exports almost immediately to two million barrels daily, and then to double exports again by the end of the decade.

zh: 要实现这一点，伊朗需要将其总产出（包括国内消费）提高到每天六百万桶，大致相当于20世纪70年代的巅峰产量。
en: To do this, Iran would have to boost its total output (including domestic consumption) to six million barrels per day, roughly equal to its peak production in the 1970s.

zh: 自20世纪70年代以来，石油开采技术有了长足的进步，而伊朗石油储备更是规模巨大（世界第四，仅次于沙特阿拉伯、俄罗斯和委内瑞拉 ） ， 回复40年前的产出绝对算不上困难的目标。
en: Given the enormous advances in oil-extraction technology since the 1970s and the immense size of Iran’s reserves (the fourth-largest in the world, after Saudi Arabia, Russia, and Venezuela), restoring output to the levels of 40 years ago seems a modest objective.

zh: 要为这一大致等于美国页岩革命所增加的产出的额外产量找到买家，伊朗不但需要和沙特阿拉伯进行激烈竞争，还需要面临伊拉克、哈萨克斯坦、俄罗斯和其他低成本产油国的竞争。
en: To find buyers for all this extra oil, roughly equal to the extra output produced by the US shale revolution, Iran will have to compete fiercely not only with Saudi Arabia, but also with Iraq, Kazakhstan, Russia, and other low-cost producers.

zh: 所有这些国家也决心要将产出恢复至此前的巅峰水平，只要利用美国率先采取的新生产技术，它们将产量提高到20世纪七八十年代以上应该不是难事。
en: All of these countries are also determined to restore their output to previous peak levels and should be able to pump more oil than they did in the 1970s and 1980s by exploiting new production technologies pioneered in the US.

zh: 在这一新的竞争环境中，石油将像任何普通大宗商品一样交易，沙特阿拉伯的垄断将被打破，北美的生产成本将给长期价格带来每桶50美元左右的上限，原因我在1月已经讨论过了。
en: In this newly competitive environment, oil will trade like any normal commodity, with the Saudi monopoly broken and North American production costs setting a long-term price ceiling of around $50 a barrel, for reasons I set out in January.

zh: 因此，如果你想理解油价的下跌，最好忘了中国消费，把目光集中在中东产量上。
en: So, if you want to understand falling oil prices, forget about Chinese consumption and focus on Middle East production.

zh: 如果你希望理解世界经济，最好忘了股市，将目光集中在廉价石油永远刺激全球增长这一事实上。
en: And if you want to understand the world economy, forget about stock markets and focus on the fact that cheap oil always boosts global growth.

zh: 钦奈的警告
en: The Chennai Warning

zh: 特里凡得琅，印度 — — 就在世界领导人在巴黎开会应对气候变化的同时，印度南部泰米尔纳德邦的首府钦奈市（原名马德拉斯市）在104年来最严重的降雨过程中遭受了严重的影响。
en: THIRUVANANTHAPURAM, INDIA – Even as world leaders were meeting in Paris to address climate change, the city of Chennai (formerly Madras), the capital of the southern Indian state of Tamil Nadu, reeled under the onslaught of the heaviest rainfall in 104 years.

zh: 这座拥有500万人的城市几乎完全关闭，道路和近5，000所民宅被洪水淹没。
en: The city, home to five million people, has virtually shut down, with roads flooded and nearly 5,000 homes under water.

zh: 洪水造成450多人死亡。
en: More than 450 people have died.

zh: 航空和铁路服务已经中断，电力和电话线遭到破坏，生命保障设备无法工作造成医院患者死亡。
en: Air and rail services have been suspended, power and phone lines have been disrupted, and hospital patients are succumbing as life-support equipment fails.

zh: 印度陆军和空军派遣救援船只救援受害者。
en: Victims had to be rescued in boats by India’s army and air force.

zh: 拥有大量学校、学院、IT企业、工厂和商业设施的印度第四大城市陷入瘫痪的确很难想象。
en: It is difficult to imagine India’s fourth-largest city – schools, colleges, IT companies, factories, and commercial establishments – being brought to a halt.

zh: 而福特、戴姆勒、宝马和雷诺等全球汽车制造商史无前例地决定停止当地工厂的生产工作。
en: And yet global automakers such as Ford, Daimler, BMW, and Renault took the unprecedented decision to halt production at their local factories.

zh: 因为员工无法上班，久负盛名的钦奈报纸《印度教徒报》178年来首次出现印刷版停刊的情况（尽管它仍顽强地发行了网络版 ） 。
en: The venerable Chennai newspaper The Hindu failed for the first time in 178 years to bring out a print edition, because its employees couldn’t get to work (though it gamely produced an online issue).

zh: 很多人自然而然地将钦奈洪水和巴黎会谈相联，认为这次毁灭性降雨证明了人类活动对世界气候造成了灾难性的影响。
en: Inevitably, many linked the flooding in Chennai to the talks in Paris, seeing the devastating rains as proof of the catastrophic consequences of human action on the world’s weather.

zh: 他们认为更多的灾难不可避免，除非世界领导人在巴黎采取果断行动限制全球气候变化。
en: More such disasters, they suggested, are inescapable unless world leaders in Paris take decisive action to limit global climate change.

zh: “我们正在切身感受到气候变化急剧扩大的影响 ， ” 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪在谈到钦奈洪灾时说，并呼吁工业化国家采取更多措施缓解全球变暖的影响。
en: “We are feeling climate change’s fast-growing impact now,” said India’s Prime Minister Narendra Modi, pointing to Chennai and calling upon industrialized countries to do more to mitigate global warming.

zh: 事实上，科学家预测未来几十年印度气温将显著升高，因此发生干旱、洪涝、农作物歉收和龙卷风等一系列气候灾难的可能性也更大。
en: Indeed, scientists predict that India will become significantly hotter over the next few decades, and therefore more prone to a range of weather-related calamities such as droughts, floods, crop failures, and cyclones.

zh: 他们认为钦奈洪灾仅仅是一次警告。
en: Chennai, they say, is just a warning.

zh: 但另外一个因素更为贴切地解释了问题的所在。
en: But another factor arguably offers a more proximate explanation for what went wrong.

zh: 钦奈周围的印度东海岸每年这个时候遭受严重的季风暴雨袭击是正常现象。
en: It is normal for India’s east coast around Chennai to suffer heavy monsoon rains at this time of year.

zh: 尽管这是1911年以来该地区最为严重的降水，但洪灾也是人为失误的结果：具体而言就是近几十年来改变印度的不负责任且杂乱无章的城市化。
en: And, although this is the most severe precipitation to hit the region since 1911, the flooding was also the result of human error: the irresponsible and unplanned urbanization that has transformed India in recent decades.

zh: 几乎所有受影响地区的洪灾都能与规化不周的建设扯上关系，这些建设丝毫没有考虑到钦奈的自然生态系统和水文状况。
en: In virtually every affected area, the flooding can be linked to ill-planned construction, which has taken place without regard to hydrology or Chennai’s natural ecosystems.

zh: 泰米尔纳德邦环境部制定的规范在很大程度上被人们忽视，因为政界人士以发展为名与建设者有着共同的目标。
en: Norms set by the Environment Department of Tamil Nadu have largely been ignored, because politicians make common cause with builders in the name of development.

zh: 结果是在河漫滩上修建机场和巴士总站；在湿地和沼泽地上修建仓库和工厂；在曾经的湖底开发住宅项目。
en: As a result, airports and bus terminals have been built on floodplains; warehouses and factories on wetlands and marshlands; and housing projects on former lakes.

zh: 排水道和集水区成了开发商抨击的对象。
en: Drainage courses and catchments have been fair game for developers.

zh: 支线公路和高速路如雨后春笋般涌出，丝毫没有考虑到城市的水流状况。
en: Bypass roads and expressways have sprouted up without regard for data on water flow in the city.

zh: 结果造成水体快速退化。
en: The result has been rapid degradation of water bodies.

zh: 因为建设施工几乎不考虑设置充分的废物处理和污水处理系统，以至于城市的河道及运河逐渐变成垃圾场，堵塞到根本无法有效充当将雨水排入海洋的管道。
en: Because construction has occurred with scant regard for the provision of adequate waste disposal and sewage systems, the city’s rivers and canals have become garbage dumps, so choked that they can no longer serve as effective conduits to channel rainwater to the sea.

zh: 同样，关键湿地的破坏和蓄洪基础设施不足意味着没有合适的地点能接受雨水径流的排放。
en: Likewise, the destruction of crucial wetlands and inadequate infrastructure to contain flooding means that rainwater runoff has nowhere to go.

zh: 数十座印度城市同样存在这种现象。
en: The same phenomena can be found in dozens of Indian cities.

zh: 城市化进程不可避免：拥有12亿人的经济体不可能让三分之二的人留在农村还期望增长；农村居民将不可避免地转移到城市寻找工作和更好的生活。
en: Urbanization is inevitable: an economy of 1.2 billion people cannot employ two-thirds of them in agriculture and hope to grow; rural people will inevitably move to cities to seek work and better lives.

zh: 印度的城市人口已经从70年前独立时的10%增长到今天近40%的份额。
en: India’s urban population has risen from 10% at independence, less than seven decades ago, to almost 40% today.

zh: 不久以后大多数印度人将在城市中生活。
en: It will not be long before a majority of Indians live in cities.

zh: 但那些城市的增长方式不能都和钦奈一样。
en: But those cities cannot all grow the same way as Chennai has.

zh: 很多印度城市的人口密度都高于钦奈，科钦或特里凡得琅发生类似的灾难可能会导致更高的伤亡。
en: Many Indian cities have a higher population density than Chennai, and a similar catastrophe in Kochi or Thiruvananthapuram could lead to much higher casualties.

zh: 我们需要重新思考城市的排水系统、改造灾难管理机构，并确保季风雨水可以在最短的时间内从城市里排出。
en: We need to rethink our city drainage systems, rework our disaster-management institutions, and ensure that monsoon rainwater can drain out of our cities in the shortest possible time.

zh: 钦奈悲剧为印度敲响了警钟。
en: The Chennai tragedy is a wake-up call to India.

zh: 如果采取严格措施保护水体和尊重环境，这场灾难本来是 可以避免的。
en: The disaster could have been avoided if strict measures had been taken to preserve water bodies and respect environmental imperatives.

zh: 如果我们认识到事情的轻重缓急，就会从这次令人毛骨悚然的水灾中吸取教训，以环境上可持续的方式实现城市化。
en: If we get our priorities right, we will heed the lessons of this horror and create urban space only in environmentally sustainable ways.

zh: 如果只把钦奈水灾看作一次性的偶发事件，将其归咎于“天灾”而非人祸，那么进一步的灾害将是不可避免的。
en: If we see Chennai as a one-off event, an “act of God” rather than an error of Man, further disasters will be unavoidable.

zh: 在莫迪政府“印度制造”的口号下，国家正筹划建设一百座“智慧城市 ” ， 在市中心吸引高科技增长。
en: In line with the Modi government’s slogan “Make in India,” the country is planning to build a hundred “smart cities” to bring hi-tech growth to urban centers.

zh: 但印度城市必须在低技术领域也实现智能化。
en: But India’s cities must be smart in a low-tech sense, too.

zh: 钦奈的教训是我们不能继续听任更多建筑工程、城市化和制造业侵蚀我们对熟悉的季风气候事件的自然抵抗力。
en: The lesson of Chennai is that we cannot let more construction, urbanization, and manufacturing erode our natural resilience to familiar monsoon weather events.

zh: 绝不能让“印度制造”毁灭印度。
en: “Make in India” must not become the unmaking of India.

zh: 有关切尔诺贝利事故的谎言和误解
en: Chernobyl’s Myths and Misconceptions

zh: 1986年4月26日切尔诺贝利核电站事故二十周年正在引发新的一波有关其对人类健康和环境影响的危言耸听浪潮。
en: The twentieth anniversary of the Chernobyl nuclear accident of April 26, 1986 is prompting a new wave of alarmist claims about its impact on human health and the environment.

zh: 此类纪念性场合已经成为例行公事，也就是几十万人死亡，对癌症发病率上升、先天缺陷以及总体死亡率都有不断最新的报道。
en: As has become a ritual on such commemorative occasions, the death toll is tallied in the hundreds of thousands, and fresh reports are made of elevated rates of cancer, birth defects, and overall mortality.

zh: 对于切尔诺贝利事故的受害者而言，这一情形不仅被严重扭曲、而且有害。
en: This picture is both badly distorted – and harmful to the victims of the Chernobyl accident.

zh: 目前为止所进行的所有具有声望的科学研究都得出结论说，核辐射的影响要比担忧的要轻。
en: All reputable scientific studies conducted so far have concluded that the impact of radiation has been less damaging than was feared.

zh: 几十个扑灭反应堆大火的紧急灭火工人死于急性放射性疾病。
en: A few dozen emergency workers who battled the fire at the reactor succumbed to acute radiation sickness.

zh: 对癌症发病率以及事故发生后的几个月内在核反应堆工作的“清除人员”心血管疾病的上升的研究仍然在进行之中。
en: Studies are still under way into elevated rates of cancer and cardiovascular disease among the “liquidators” who worked at the reactor site in the months following the accident.

zh: 而且，还发现了由于在事故发生后紧接着的几个星期内通过饮用牛奶而吸收的放射性碘导致的大约5000个甲状腺癌症病例，他们当时还都是儿童。
en: And some 5,000 cases of thyroid cancer, attributed to radioactive iodine absorbed through consumption of milk in the weeks immediately following the accident, have been detected among those who were children at the time.

zh: 的确有一些痛苦不堪的事情，特别是那些事故发生后3百30万被迁移的人们。
en: There has been real suffering, particularly among the 330,000 people who were relocated after the accident.

zh: 对此毫无疑问。
en: About that there is no doubt.

zh: 但是，对于5百万居住在受到影响的地区、并被指定为切尔诺贝利事故“受害者”的人来说，核放射对于身体健康并没有可以察觉到的影响。
en: But, for the five million people living in affected regions who are designated as Chernobyl “victims,” radiation has had no discernable impact on physical health.

zh: 这是因为这些人受到低辐射的数量，在大多数情况下和自然背景水平大体相当。
en: This is because these people were exposed to low radiation doses that in most cases were comparable to natural background levels.

zh: 连续二十年的自然腐化和补救措施意味着大多数原先被认为是受到“污染”的地区不再应当贴有这样的标签了。
en: Two decades of natural decay and remediation measures mean that most territories originally deemed “contaminated” no longer merit that label.

zh: 甲状腺癌病例的98.5％都得到了成功的治疗。 除此之外，科学家们尚未记录到放射和身体状况的任何联系。
en: Aside from thyroid cancer, which has been successfully treated in 98.5% of cases, scientists have not been able to document any connection between radiation and any physical condition.

zh: 只有在心理健康方面发现了明显的影响。
en: Where a clear impact has been found is mental health.

zh: 看起来，对放射的恐惧对健康的威胁要比放射本身大很多。
en: Fear of radiation, it seems, poses a far more potent health threat than does radiation itself.

zh: 到处都有压力的症状，而且受到影响的地区的许多居民都坚信他们由于核放射而会生病并早死。
en: Symptoms of stress are rampant, and many residents of affected areas firmly believe themselves to be condemned by radiation to ill health and early death.

zh: 造成这一现象的部分原因是，苏联对此的最初反应是诡秘的。 当时的苏联领导人戈尔巴乔夫在1986年5月14日，也就是事故发生几周后才对此发表电视讲话。
en: In part, this is because the initial Soviet response was secretive: Mikhail Gorbachev, the Soviet leader at the time, addressed the issue on television only weeks later, on May 14, 1986.

zh: 谎言和误解已经根深蒂固，而且超过了随后提供可靠信息的努力。
en: Myths and misconceptions have taken root, and these have outlasted subsequent efforts to provide reliable information.

zh: 政府大幅度提供福利政策给那些被规划为残疾人的生活在受到切尔诺贝利影响地区的数百万人，这些谎言鼓励了宿命主义和悲观行为，并且在受到影响的社区中产生了“依附文化 ” 。
en: Combined with sweeping government benefit policies that classify millions of people living in Chernobyl-affected areas as invalids, such myths encouraged fatalistic and passive behaviors and created a “culture of dependency” among affected communities.

zh: 由八个联合国机构和白俄罗斯、俄罗斯以及乌克兰组成的联合机构联合国切尔诺贝利论坛加强了这些结论。
en: The United Nations Chernobyl Forum, a consortium of eight UN agencies and representatives of Belarus, Russia, and Ukraine, reinforced these findings.

zh: 切尔诺贝利论坛的成立就是为了通过在科学一致意见可以形成的领域作出明确的结论而解决在公众和政府官员之中有关事故影响的疑惑。
en: Chernobyl Forum was created to address the prevailing confusion concerning the impact of the accident, both among the public and government officials, by declaring a clear verdict on issues where a scientific consensus could be found.

zh: 论坛在这一方面获得了成功。 9月份则发表了一份有关辐射影响的全新和令人安慰的报告。
en: The Forum succeeded in this effort, and a fresh and reassuring message on the impact of radiation was made public in September.

zh: 通过以下联接可以找到这份报告的通俗易懂的摘要：http : / /www.iaea.org/publications/booklets/chernobyl/chernobyl.pdf。
en: [An easily digestible summary is available at http://www.iaea.org/Publications/Booklets/Chernobyl/chernobyl.pdf.]

zh: 切尔诺贝利论坛的结论应当带给人们宽慰，因为它们表明侵袭该地区的幽灵并非是不可战胜的辐射，而是可以战胜的贫穷。
en: The Chernobyl Forum findings should have brought relief, for they show that the specter haunting the region is not invincible radiation, but conquerable poverty.

zh: 该地区所需要的是目的在于创造新的谋生手段、而并非加重依赖程度的政策、解决破坏整个前苏联健康的生活方式问题（吸烟和饮酒）的公共医疗运动以及促进自力更生并且返回正常生活的社区发展规划。
en: What the region needs are policies aimed at generating new livelihoods rather than reinforcing dependency; public-health campaigns that address the lifestyle issues (smoking and drinking) that undermine health across the former Soviet Union; and community development initiatives that promote self-reliance and a return to normalcy.

zh: 但是���对切尔诺贝利论坛带来的信息的反应确实令人惊讶地毁誉参半。
en: But the reception given to the Chernobyl Forum’s message has been surprisingly mixed.

zh: 某些官员又重新回到有关由于切尔诺贝利所引起的死亡数目的耸人听闻的语言。
en: Some officials have reverted to alarmist language on the number of fatalities attributed to Chernobyl.

zh: 某些非政府组织以及切尔诺贝利慈善组织对此表示难以相信，他们引用公开承认的普通民众的健康问题作为证据。
en: Some NGO’s and Chernobyl charities have responded with disbelief, citing as evidence the general population’s admittedly poor health.

zh: 核电的反对者说私利破坏了切尔诺贝利论坛的诚信。
en: Opponents of nuclear power have suggested that self-interest has compromised the Chernobyl Forum’s integrity.

zh: 构成切尔诺贝利论坛的科学依据众多，因此，这些反应反映的不仅是谎言和误解挥之不去，而且是既得利益。
en: Set against the impressive body of science underpinning the Chernobyl Forum, such responses reflect the tenacity not only of myths and misconceptions, but also of vested interests.

zh: 有关切尔诺贝利的新的观点威胁到慈善组织的生存。 某些外国的慈善组织为儿童提供医疗“缓解 ” ， 它们的筹款依靠那些的有关先天缺陷儿童活灵活现的电视画面。
en: The new view on Chernobyl threatens the existence of charities – such as those offering health “respites” abroad for children – that depend for their fund-raising on graphic footage of deformed babies.

zh: 这一全新的理解同时还剥夺了该地区官员们例常的寻求国际同情的手段，即使在二十年后重复这些呼吁并不能带来什么财政援助。
en: The new understanding also deprives the region’s officials of a routine way to seek international sympathy, even if the repetition of such appeals after two decades yields little financial aid.

zh: 这些手段通过错误地表述问题而威胁到把稀有的资源投入到错误的救济上。
en: By misstating the problems, these approaches threaten to divert scarce resources into the wrong remedies.

zh: 切尔诺贝利事故的二十周年纪念日对于所有相关者而言都是一个理想的作某些诚实的扪心自问的机会。
en: The twentieth anniversary of the Chernobyl accident is an ideal occasion for all actors to do some honest soul-searching.

zh: 各国政府担忧受到切尔诺贝利影响地区的命运是正确的，但是，前进的方向要求有新鲜的思考以及大胆的决定，特别是把重点从向数以百万计的人发放微不足道的的福利转向有针对性的拨款来帮助促进就业和经济发展。
en: Governments are right to worry about the fate of Chernobyl-affected territories, but the way forward will require fresh thinking and bold decisions, particularly a shift in priorities from paying paltry benefits to millions to targeted spending that helps to promote jobs and economic growth.

zh: 同样地，慈善机构担忧人口的健康是有道理的，但是它们应当集中精力在受到影响的社区内促进健康的生活方式，而不是把儿童们送到国外，好像他们的家园是有毒的那样。
en: Similarly, charities are right to worry about the population’s health, but they should focus on promoting healthy lifestyles in affected communities rather than whisking children abroad as if their homes were poisonous.

zh: 各方担忧受到影响的人口是有道理的，但是，比任何先进的诊断设备更为重要的是以通俗易懂的方式用令人信服的信息对抗切尔诺贝利事故破坏性的恐惧遗产。
en: All parties are right to worry about the affected populations, but, more than any sophisticated diagnostic equipment, what is needed is credible information, presented in a digestible format, to counter Chernobyl’s destructive legacy of fear.

zh: 切尔诺贝利的儿童们都已经长大；符合他们的利益、以及他们自己的孩子们的利益的方式并不是没完没了地唤起辐射的恶梦，而是交给他们重建自身社区所需要的工具和权力。
en: The children of Chernobyl are all grown up; their interests, and those of their own children, are best served not by continually evoking the nightmare of radiation, but by giving them the tools and authority they need to rebuild their own communities.

zh: 再访伊拉克战争
en: Revisiting the Iraq War

zh: 纽约—在经历了七年时间，12卷证据、发现和推论，以及一份执行摘要后 ， 《 伊拉克调查报告 》 — —更普通的名称是《奇尔科特报告 》 （ Chilcot Report，以其主席约翰·奇尔科特的名字命名 ） — —终于向所有人开放了。
en: NEW YORK – Seven years, 12 volumes of evidence, findings, and conclusions, and one executive summary later, the Report of the Iraq Inquiry, more commonly referred to as the Chilcot Report (after its chairman, Sir John Chilcot), is available for one and all to read.

zh: 很少有人会从头到尾通读它；光是执行摘要（大大超过100页）就长到应该对它也总结一份执行摘要了。
en: Few people will get through all of it; the executive summary alone (well over 100 pages) is so long that it calls for its own executive summary.

zh: 但如果该报告不被广泛阅读 — — 以及更重要的，不被广泛研究 — — 将是一件巨大的憾事，因为它包含了一些关于外交如何操作、政策如何制定、决策如何做出的有用洞见。
en: But it would be a shame if the Report were not widely read and, more important, studied, because it contains some useful insights into how diplomacy operates, how policy is made, and how decisions are taken.

zh: 它还让我们了解2003年入侵伊拉克的决定及其后果为何是理解当今中东的核心。
en: It also reminds us of the centrality of the decision to invade Iraq in 2003, and of the aftermath, for understanding today’s Middle East.

zh: 该报告的核心主题之一是伊拉克战争本非非打不可，在开战时显然不是。
en: A central theme of the Report is that the Iraq War did not have to happen, and certainly not when it did.

zh: 开战的决策部分是基于错误的情报。
en: The decision to go to war was partly based on faulty intelligence.

zh: 伊拉克充其量最多只是逐渐积聚的威胁，而绝不是紧迫的威胁。
en: Iraq constituted at most a gathering threat, not an imminent one.

zh: 除了动武以外，其他办法 — — 主要是强化土耳其和约旦对联合国向为向萨达姆·侯赛因施压而采取的制裁执行不力的情况 — — 基本上都没有进行细究。
en: Alternatives to using military force – above all, strengthening Turkey’s and Jordan’s lackluster enforcement of and support for the UN sanctions designed to pressure Saddam Hussein – were barely explored.

zh: 外交手段被急匆匆一带而过。
en: Diplomacy was rushed.

zh: 更糟糕的是，这场战争是在没有对可能的局面进行充分计划和准备的情况下进行的。
en: Making matters worse was that the war was undertaken without sufficient planning and preparation for what would come after.

zh: 报告正确地指出，美国和英国政府的许多人预测如果萨达姆的铁腕统治被推翻，伊拉克将出现乱局。
en: As the Report rightly points out, many in both the US and British governments predicted that chaos could emerge if Saddam’s iron grip were removed.

zh: 遣散伊拉克军队武装、禁止萨达姆的复兴党（Ba’ath Party）的全体成员（而不仅仅是一些领导者）在新政府中担任职位的决定是巨大的错误。
en: The decisions to disband the Iraqi army and to bar all members of Saddam’s Ba’ath Party (rather than just a few of its leaders) from positions in the successor government were huge mistakes.

zh: 伊拉克不仅仅是一个战争选择；它是一项谋划失败、执行不力的政策。
en: Iraq was not just a war of choice; it was an ill-advised and poorly executed policy.

zh: 报告以很大的篇幅着重讨论了英国的算盘以及时任首相布莱尔对美国政策的支持。
en: Much of the Report focuses on British calculations and then-Prime Minister Tony Blair’s support for US policy.

zh: 让英国配合美国的决定对于一个影响力主要来自双边关系的紧密程度的国家来说是一个情有可原的战略选择。
en: The decision to associate the UK with the United States was a defensible strategic choice for a smaller country that derived much of its influence from the closeness of the bilateral relationship.

zh: 布莱尔征服点的失策之处是没有要求以增加对该政策的影响力作为支持美国的条件。
en: Where the Blair government got it wrong was in not pressing for more influence over the policy in exchange for its support.

zh: 小布什政府很可能拒绝这样的要求，但这样英国政府可以选择与这个很多人认为不可能成功的政策保持距离。
en: George W. Bush’s administration might well have rejected such efforts, but the British government could then have exercised the option of distancing itself from a policy that many believed was unlikely to succeed.

zh: 可以从伊拉克战争中汲取很多教训。
en: Many lessons should be taken from the Iraq War.

zh: 其中之一是，当分析师分析情报时，他们的假设从根本上影响了他们所看到的东西，因此，有缺陷的假设可能导致缺陷巨大的政策。
en: One is that, because assumptions fundamentally affect what analysts tend to see when they look at intelligence, flawed assumptions can lead to dangerously flawed policies.

zh: 几乎所���人都假设萨达姆不配合联合国检查者是因为他藏匿了大规模杀伤性武器这一事实。
en: Nearly everyone assumed that Saddam’s non-compliance with United Nations inspectors stemmed from the fact that he was hiding weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 事实上，他隐藏的是他没有这些武器这一事实。
en: In fact, he was hiding the fact he did not have such weapons.

zh: 类似地，在开战之前，许多决策者相信，一旦萨达姆倒台，民主很快就会出现。
en: Likewise, before they started the war, many policymakers believed that democracy would emerge quickly once Saddam was gone.

zh: 确保这些重要的基本假设接受“红队 ” — —即不支持相关政策的人 — — 的检验应该成为标准操作流程。
en: Ensuring that such fundamental and consequential assumptions are tested by “red teams” – those not supporting the associated policy – should be standard operating procedure.

zh: 另外一个现实是，推翻政府尽管困难，却比为型政府营造安全容易得多。 新政府需要这一安全在众目睽睽之下巩固它的权威和赢得合法性。
en: There is also the reality that removing governments, as difficult as that can be, is not nearly as difficult as creating the security that a new government needs to consolidate its authority and earn legitimacy in the eyes of the public.

zh: 在缺乏许多最基本的前提条件的社会创造像民主这样的东西是一个需要耗时几十年而不是几个月的任务。
en: Creating anything like a democracy in a society lacking many of its most basic prerequisites is a task of decades, not months.

zh: 报告对伊拉克战争的遗产几乎只字未提，但考虑这个问题很重要。
en: The Report said little about the legacy of the Iraq War, but it is important to consider.

zh: 首先，伊拉克战争搅乱了地区实力平衡。
en: First and foremost, the war disrupted the regional balance of power.

zh: 伊拉克不再能够牵制和平衡伊朗，反而被伊朗的影响力所笼罩。
en: No longer in a position to distract and balance Iran, Iraq instead came under Iranian influence.

zh: 伊朗不但可以自由地发展有意义的核计划，还通过代理直接干预多个国家。
en: Iran was free not just to develop a meaningful nuclear program, but also to intervene directly and via proxies in several countries.

zh: 宗派斗争毒害了整个地区的逊尼派和什叶派关系。
en: Sectarian fighting poisoned relations between Sunnis and Shia throughout the region.

zh: 被遣散的萨达姆军队官兵离心离德，这助长了逊尼派叛乱，并最终导致所谓的伊斯兰国的崛起。
en: The alienation felt by soldiers and officers of Saddam’s disbanded army fueled Sunni insurgency and, ultimately, led to the rise of the so-called Islamic State.

zh: 伊拉克战争不但对伊拉克和中东造成了深远的影响，对英国和美国也是如此。
en: The war had a profound effect not just on Iraq and the Middle East, but also on the UK and the US.

zh: 英国议会在2013年投票反对参与任何因其公然罔闻不要在内战中使用化学武器的警告而惩罚叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德的军事行动，这显然与伊拉克的军事干预是一场失败的观点有关。
en: The British parliamentary vote in 2013 against participation in any military effort to penalize Syrian President Bashar al-Assad for defying explicit warnings not to use chemical weapons in his country’s civil war was surely related to the view that military intervention in Iraq had been a mistake.

zh: 导致大部分选民支持“英国退出”的对精英阶层的不信任可能也有一些源自伊拉克战争的经验。
en: It is also possible that some of the mistrust of elites that led a majority of voters to support “Brexit” stemmed from the Iraq War experience.

zh: 类似地，伊拉克战争及其后果也影响到美国总统奥巴马政府的思维，当众多美国人出现“干预疲劳”时，奥巴马政府几乎没有兴趣在中东进行新的军事冒险。
en: The Iraq War and its aftermath similarly affected the thinking of US President Barack Obama’s administration, which had little appetite for new military ventures in the Middle East at a time when many Americans were suffering from “intervention fatigue.”

zh: 当然，危险在于教训可能被过度汲取。
en: The danger, of course, is that lessons can be overlearned.

zh: 伊拉克战争的教训绝不是应该避免一切中东和其他地区的武装干预，而是武装干预必须只在它们是最佳可行战略并且结果可能证明值得为之付出代价的情况下才能进行。
en: The lesson of the Iraq War should not be that all armed interventions in the Middle East or elsewhere are to be avoided, but rather that they must only be undertaken when they are the best available strategy and when the results are likely to justify the costs.

zh: 利比亚是违反这一原则的最近的干预例子；叙利亚的干预代价更大，代价来自不作为。
en: Libya was a recent intervention that violated this principle; Syria has been even more costly, but in its case for what was not done.

zh: 伊拉克战争的代价足够沉重，人们却没有从中汲取错误教训。
en: The Iraq War was costly enough without people learning the wrong lessons from it.

zh: 这才是最大的讽刺之处 — — 也让这个悲剧更加惨痛。
en: That would be the ultimate irony – and only add to the tragedy.

zh: 性、谎言和领导力
en: Sex, Lies, and Leadership

zh: 伦敦—新事件常常是自我反省的重要催化剂，至少对公司董事是如此。
en: LONDON – News events can often serve as important catalysts for introspection, not least for members of company boards.

zh: 最近曝光的俄罗斯政府牵涉入侵民主党全国委员会计算机系统的事件 — — 距离朝鲜侵入索尼影业仅仅两年 — — 促使全世界各大公司董事会纷纷要求狠抓公司网络安全。
en: Recent revelations of the Russian government’s involvement in hacking into the Democratic National Committee’s computer system – just two years after North Korea’s hack of Sony Pictures – has spurred a push in boardrooms around the world to tighten their organizations’ cyber security.

zh: 类似地，关于非法或不道德劳工使用情况的报道 — — 比如中国的苹果供应商 — — 促使公司严密关注供给链。
en: Likewise, stories of illegal or unethical labor practices – for example, among Apple suppliers in China – have inspired companies to take a close look at their supply chains.

zh: 关于高管薪酬过高的批评让许多公司董事会薪酬委员会匆忙召开会议讨论应对之策。
en: And criticism of excessive executive remuneration has led to frantic meetings by many boards’ compensation committees.

zh: 但有一类被报道的情况尚未引起董事会足够的关注：儿童性骚扰。
en: But there is one issue in the news that has not yet received sufficient attention in boardrooms: child sexual abuse.

zh: 在英国，上个月曝光了耸人听闻的新闻，足球俱乐部梯队 — — 年轻选手通往职业水平的捷径 — — 存在侵犯儿童的情况。
en: In the United Kingdom, the last month has brought harrowing reports about child abuse in youth soccer teams, where promising young athletes attempt to play their way to the professional level.

zh: 上个月，98家英国业余和职业俱乐部或多或少地被此事涉及。
en: At last count, 98 amateur and professional clubs in the UK were implicated in some way.

zh: 公众被这一消息的曝光所震惊，但涉事俱乐部领导未必 — — 至少不是所有俱乐部都对此大惊小怪。
en: While the public has been shocked by the revelations, the affected clubs’ leaders may not have been – at least not in every case.

zh: 毕竟，许多俱乐部此前早已听闻关于小球员遭受性侵犯的指控，但选择了忽视和掩盖，有时甚至用钱封受害者之口 — — 所有这些都是为了保护自己的名誉。
en: After all, many clubs had previously heard allegations of sexual abuse of young players, but had chosen to ignore them or cover them up, at times even doling out hush money to the victims – all for the sake of protecting their own reputations.

zh: 比如，克鲁亚历山大（Crewe Alexandra）俱乐部董事会积极讨论了针对该俱乐部一名教练 — — 巴里·贝奈尔（Barry Bennell）在20世纪80年代末进行性侵犯的指控，但决定不把他交给警察，甚至也不解雇他。
en: Crewe Alexandra’s board, for example, actively discussed sexual abuse allegations against a coach, Barry Bennell, in the late 1980s, but decided not to report him to the police or even to fire him. Bennell turned out to be a serial pedophile.

zh: 尽管他最终还是在1998年受审并判刑，但在此之前他又多了好几年虐待小男孩的时间，而这都是拜克鲁俱乐部怯懦无骨、见利忘义的董事会所赐。
en: Though he was ultimately tried and sentenced in 1998, he first got to spend several more years abusing young boys, thanks in no small part to Crewe’s spineless and venal board.

zh: 即使在今天，董事会有时也会选择保护名誉，牺牲基本人道尊严。
en: Even today, boards are sometimes choosing to defend their reputations at the expense of basic human decency.

zh: 去年7月，切尔西足球俱乐部用50,000英镑让一位前球员封口，不要说出他据称在20世纪70年代所经历的虐待。
en: Last July, Chelsea Football Club paid a former footballer £50,000 ($62,000) to agree not to speak of the abuse he allegedly endured in the 1970s.

zh: 2001年，英国足总（英国足球监管机构）启动了为期五年的儿童安全措施评估，但只开展了两年便不了了之，据说是因为一些足总工作人员的抵制。
en: The five-year review of child safety measures, launched by the Football Association (the governing body of UK soccer) in 2001, was dropped after just two years, reportedly in response to resistance from some FA staff.

zh: 但英国足球丑闻绝不是孤例。
en: Yet the scandal plaguing UK soccer is hardly unique.

zh: 据刚刚发布的IndyStar和《今日美国》的联合调查，过去20年，美国至少有368名体操运动员曾指控某种形式的性侵犯。
en: According to a just-released joint investigation by the IndyStar and USA Today, at least 368 gymnasts in the United States have alleged some form of sexual abuse over the last 20 years.

zh: 美国体操协会 — — 它是美国最著名的奥林匹克运动组织之一 — — 高级官员不但没有将这些指控转告警方；反而隐瞒投诉。
en: Top officials at USA Gymnastics, one of the country’s most prominent Olympic organizations, not only failed to alert police to those allegations; they hid the complaints.

zh: 报道说，即便是被炒鱿鱼的教练，也常常不会留下污点，这意味着这些“禽兽”教练只需要换一个体操俱乐部就可以重操旧业。
en: Even coaches who were fired, the report asserts, were often not flagged, meaning that predatory coaches could simply start training children at a new gym.

zh: 还有宾夕法尼亚大学丑闻，校理事会对该校前橄榄球助理教练杰瑞·山杜斯基（Jerry Sandusky）系列恋童案长期遭到隐瞒一事置若罔闻。 山杜斯基通过自己的问题少年慈善组织接近受害者。
en: And then there is the Penn State scandal, in which the university’s trustees turned a blind eye to a long-running cover-up of the serial pedophilia of Jerry Sandusky, a former assistant football coach who gained access to his victims through his own charity for troubled youth.

zh: 两名该大学前官员因隐瞒该丑闻而被起诉。
en: Two former university officials have been charged in the alleged cover-up.

zh: 如今，真相已经大白，因此已无必要隐瞒。
en: Now that the truth has come out, there is nowhere to hide.

zh: 英国足总和英国各俱乐部也在纷纷进行调查和评估。
en: The FA and clubs across the UK are scrambling to conduct investigations and reviews.

zh: 美国体操协会派聘请前检察官助其加强儿童保护政策，其理事会也成立一个政策评估小组。
en: USA Gymnastics has hired a former prosecutor to help it strengthen its child-protection policies, and its board of directors has established a policy review panel.

zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学解雇了山杜斯基的上司教练乔·帕特尔诺（Joe Paterno ） ， 因为2002年曾有一位下属向他揭发山杜斯基，但他没有对后者进行指控。
en: Penn State fired the coach under whom Sandusky worked, Joe Paterno, for failing to pursue an allegation against Sandusky that a subordinate brought to his attention in 2002.

zh: 但不应该只有涉事组织才采取行动。
en: But it should not be only the affected organizations that take action.

zh: 即便是“无辜”的公司和组织，也必须评估和升级其弱势群体保护政策，并加强政策执行力度。
en: Even “innocent” companies and organizations must evaluate and upgrade their policies for protecting vulnerable people, along with their means for enforcing those policies.

zh: 它们还必须评估历史记录，检讨过失并确保绝不再犯。
en: They must also review their records, to identify lapses and ensure that past mistakes are not repeated.

zh: 与儿童相关的部门，如教育和体育，显然必须进行这样的评估，但只要具有永久性权力差别的运营特征的组织，都必须进行这样的评估。
en: Such reviews are needed not just in obviously child-related sectors, like education or sports, but wherever power differentials are a permanent feature of operations.

zh: 任何组织，如果它在所在国家或社会中拥有巨大的影响力，都必须采取行动确保工作人员不利用地位欺凌弱势人员或群体。
en: Any organization operating in countries or communities where it has a great deal of influence and leverage must take action to ensure that no staff are using their positions to take advantage of vulnerable people or groups.

zh: 这样的例子包括石油和天然气行业、卫生部门和人道主义部门，包括援助机构和联合国维和部队。
en: Examples include the oil and gas sector, the health sector, and the humanitarian sector, including aid agencies and United Nations peacekeepers.

zh: 责任不仅在于组织自身。
en: The responsibility extends beyond the organizations themselves.

zh: 从国际足联腐败丑闻可以看出，金主和投资者利用他们的影响力带来变化。
en: As we have seen with the FIFA corruption scandal, sponsors and investors can use their influence to bring about change.

zh: 除了道德要求，这样做是因为符合这些行动方的私利。
en: Beyond the moral imperative, doing so is in these actors’ self-interest.

zh: 隐瞒丑闻在短期有助于你，但如今保密比以往任何时候都要困难 — — 而隐瞒秘密以至于罪行和违反道德的行为得逞的人也是帮凶。
en: Hiding from a scandal may help you in the short term, but it is harder than ever to keep a secret nowadays – and those who cover it up enable crimes and ethical violations are complicit in them.

zh: 公司应该以同样的方式问责供给链中的组织。
en: In the same vein, companies should be holding other organizations in their supply chains accountable.

zh: 在不公平或非法劳工行为方面，企业必须拒绝资助、供应无法保证工人不受性侵犯的组织或与其合作。
en: As with unfair or illegal labor practices, businesses must refuse to sponsor, supply, or work with organizations that fail to protect their workers from sexual abuse.

zh: 否则，它们也有罪。
en: Otherwise, they, too, are guilty.

zh: 儿童性侵犯不是新问题。
en: Child sexual abuse is not a new problem.

zh: 最近才浮出水面的问题是公司董事会 — — 以及退休基金和主权财富基金等大投资者 — — 必须具备怎样的权力才能帮助阻止性侵犯。
en: What has become apparent lately is the power that boards of companies – as well as large investors, like pension and sovereign-wealth funds – have to help stop it.

zh: 如今，对“精英”的信心崩塌 — — 不管是对政治领袖还是，是的，对公司董事 — — 在这样的情况下，积极使用这一权力保护年轻人将给重塑分裂社会内部的信任带来额外的好处。
en: At a time of collapsing confidence in “elites” – from political leaders to, yes, board members – actively using this power to protect young people would have the added benefit of fostering trust within divided societies.

zh: 我们没有理由迟迟不采取行动。
en: There is no excuse to delay.

zh: 正确饮食的斗争
en: The Right Food Fight

zh: 德累斯顿 — — 政府对成瘾行为的监管或课税应该做到什么程度？
en: DRESDEN – To what extent should governments regulate or tax addictive behavior?

zh: 这个问题一直是许多国家有关酒精、烟草、赌博及其他商品服务公开辩论的主要内容。
en: This question has long framed public debate about alcohol, tobacco, gambling, and other goods and services in many countries worldwide.

zh: 现在，在可以称之为全球消费文化之母的美国 — — 辩论已经转向了防止儿童肥胖症的传播。
en: And now, in the United States – arguably the mother of global consumer culture – the debate has turned toward the fight against the epidemic of childhood obesity.

zh: 讽刺的是，在这个儿童营养不良困扰着许多发展中国家的世界，儿童肥胖却已成为发达经济体最主要的健康灾难之一。
en: It is ironic that in a world where childhood malnutrition plagues many developing countries, childhood obesity has become one of the leading health scourges in advanced economies.

zh: 举例来讲，世界银行估计超过三分之一的印尼儿童饱受发育不良之苦，面临着对健康与认知发展造成终身影响的威胁。
en: The World Bank estimates that over a third of all children in Indonesia, for example, suffer from stunted growth, confronting them with the risk of lifetime effects on fitness and cognitive development.

zh: 但发展中世界儿童营养不良的困境并没有缓解发达国家的肥胖问题。
en: Yet, the plight of malnourished children in the developing world does not make obesity in the advanced countries any less of a problem.

zh: 事实上，虽然或许难与全球变暖及迫在眉睫的水资源匮乏相提并论，但肥胖 — — 尤其是儿童肥胖 — — 仍然是二十一世纪发达国家所面临的重要公共卫生挑战之一，同时也在迅速影响许多新兴市场经济。
en: Indeed, though perhaps not on a par with global warming and looming water shortages, obesity – and especially childhood obesity – nonetheless is on the short list of major public-health challenges facing advanced countries in the twenty-first century, and it is rapidly affecting many emerging-market economies as well.

zh: 但解决这个问题让我们面临比上世纪成功的公共卫生干预政策更为艰巨的挑战，包括普及接种、饮用水加氟和机动车安全规则问题。
en: Yet solving it poses much more difficult challenges than the kind of successful public-health interventions of the last century, including near-universal vaccination, fluoridation of drinking water, and motor-vehicle safety rules.

zh: 问题是除非政府愿意诉诸比现在更直接了当的举措，否则很难讲对于成功的期待是否现实。
en: The question is whether it is realistic to hope for success unless the government resorts to far more blunt instruments than it currently seems prepared to wield.

zh: 鉴于肥胖对于医疗保健费用、预期寿命和生活质量的巨大影响，这是一个迫切值得关注的问题。
en: Given the huge impact of obesity on health-care costs, life expectancy, and quality of life, it is a topic that merits urgent attention.

zh: 美国的肥胖问题当属世界之最，因此相关的辩论也最激烈。
en: The US leads the world in obesity, and is at the cutting edge of the debate.

zh: 几乎所有人都赞同第一道防线应当是加强消费者教育。
en: Almost everyone agrees that the first line of defense ought to be better consumer education.

zh: 第一夫人米歇尔·奥巴马的“让我们行动起来”的教育活动立志在一代人时间里消除儿童肥胖，但迄今为止这项活动的影响尚不清晰。
en: First Lady Michelle Obama’s “Let’s Move” educational campaign aspires to eliminate childhood obesity in a generation, though its impact so far remains unclear.

zh: 其他努力包括以厨师杰米·奥利弗为首的名人呼吁，以及像芝麻街风格平台Kickin’ Nutrition那样的同龄人学习尝试（全面披露：这个节目的创始人是我的妻子 ） 。
en: Other efforts include appeals by celebrities like the chef Jamie Oliver and attempts to use peer-based learning, such as the Sesame Street-inspired platform Kickin’ Nutrition (full disclosure: the creator is my wife).

zh: 然而，尽管教育在与肥胖的斗争中必不可少，但还远没有搞清它在由财力雄厚且有强烈动机鼓励过度消费的大企业主导的食品环境下能否真正解决问题。
en: Yet, although education is essential to fight obesity, it is far from clear whether it will be enough in a food environment dominated by large corporations with deep pockets and every incentive to cultivate excessive consumption.

zh: 以儿童为对象的商业电视节目充斥着对人体健康价值值得怀疑的加工食品广告。
en: Commercial television programs aimed at children are replete with advertising for processed foods of dubious value to human health.

zh: 而且，尽管有少数名人义务投入时间来反对肥胖，但却有更多名人愿意接受大笔酬劳来兜售高含糖饮料等可以称之为���们这代人烟草的产品。
en: And, for every celebrity who donates time to fighting obesity, there are a dozen who accept large payments to hawk products, such as ultra-sugary drinks, that are arguably the tobacco of our generation.

zh: 非盈利机构很难与碧昂丝的百事可乐广告或泰勒·斯威夫特的健怡可乐广告背后所体现的产值相抗衡。
en: It is hard for non-profits to compete with the production values embodied in Beyoncé’s Pepsi commercial or Taylor Swift’s Diet Coke commercial.

zh: 肥胖的原因非常复杂，而理解人类行为的科学尚处于萌芽时期；但可以毫不夸张地用普遍来形容这个问题。
en: The causes of obesity are complex, and the science of understanding human behavior is embryonic; but it is not hyperbole to call the problem an epidemic.

zh: 据疾病预防控制中心统计，美国6-11岁儿童中约有18%已越过超重阶段出现了肥胖问题。
en: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, roughly 18% of children aged 6-11 in the US are not just overweight, but obese.

zh: 上述流行带来的风险是多方面的，但主要是儿童肥胖导致成人肥胖，进而使患糖尿病和心脏病的风险大幅上升。
en: The risks posed by this epidemic are manifold, but the main one is that childhood obesity begets adult obesity, with significantly increased risks of diabetes and heart disease.

zh: 事实上，专家估计发达经济体超过18%的成年人已经进入肥胖领域。
en: Indeed, experts estimate that more than 18% of all adults in the advanced economies are obese.

zh: 更令人吃惊的是估计约9%的美国人 — — 以及类似比例的全球成年人患有糖尿病。
en: Even more stunning are estimates that roughly 9% of all Americans – and a similar percentage of adults worldwide – have diabetes.

zh: 但政治家反对高糖高热食品却只能风险自负。
en: Yet politicians push back on Big Food at their peril.

zh: 当人气颇高的前纽约市长布隆伯格试图禁止高含糖饮料时，公众舆论 — — 更不用说纽约州上诉法院 — — 都拒绝了他的提议，尽管他的努力获得了医学专家的支持。
en: When the popular former mayor of New York City, Michael Bloomberg, attempted to ban large sugary drinks, public opinion – not to mention the New York State Court of Appeals – rejected the effort, despite support from medical experts.

zh: 许多评论家，甚至就连那些同情布隆伯格目标的评论家，都认为不应如此生硬地立法规范消费者行为。
en: Many commentators, even those sympathetic to Bloomberg’s goal, argued that it was wrong to try to legislate consumer behavior so bluntly.

zh: 但回顾五十年来改善公众健康的其他成功努力 — — 比方说禁止吸烟、安全带立法和车速限制 — — 可以看出立法往往能够很好地补充教育。
en: Yet, when one considers other successful efforts to improve public health over the last five decades – for example, smoking bans, seat-belt laws, and speed limits – one finds that legislation typically supplemented education.

zh: 影响食物选择不那么具有侵略性的方法或许是对包括含糖饮料在内的所有加工食品收取零售税 — — 和对非加工食品给予补偿性补贴。
en: A less intrusive approach to influencing food choices might be to institute a retail tax on all processed foods – not just sugary drinks – and an offsetting subsidy on non-processed foods.

zh: 从长远看，低收入家庭（也是肥胖最严重的受害者）将最大程度地从中受益。
en: In the long run, low-income families (which suffer the most from obesity) would be the greatest beneficiaries.

zh: 而且，在短期内，加大转移支付可以抵消任何收入影响。
en: And, in the short term, any income effects could be offset by increased transfers.

zh: 我与医学研究员戴维·路德维格和莫扎法利安共同拟定了上述方案的大致规定。
en: Together with the medical researchers David Ludwig and Dariush Mozaffarian, I have proposed an outline of such an approach.

zh: 显然，某些加工食品远比其他更为有害。
en: Obviously, some processed foods are far worse than others.

zh: 可以进行更加复杂的分类，当然也应该对其他想法进行审查和讨论。
en: A more complex breakdown is possible, and other ideas should of course be vetted and discussed.

zh: 但我们的想法却有简便易行的现实优势。
en: But our approach has the important practical advantage of simplicity.

zh: 首先，我们必须明白食品行业主导着利用人类对饮食天然喜好的美国消费文化，并（在众多情况下）将其转化为具有成瘾性和破坏性的行为。
en: What must be understood, above all, is that US consumer culture is dominated by a food industry that exploits people’s natural joy in eating, and transforms it (in many cases) into something that is addictive and destructive.

zh: 任何到过美国的人都能很容易地看到这个问题的普遍性。
en: Any visitor to the US can readily see the pervasiveness of the problem.

zh: 解决这个问题的正确着眼点是在教育和商业虚假信息间达到更好的平衡。
en: The right place to start to address it is by creating a better balance between education and commercial disinformation.

zh: 但食物如此容易上瘾、而环境又如此容易朝着不健康的方向发展，因此是时候考虑进行更全面的政府干预。
en: But food is so addictive, and the environment so skewed toward unhealthy outcomes, that it is time to think about broader government intervention.

zh: 这当然应该包括大幅增加对公共教育的支出；但我怀疑长期解决方案注定会涉及更多的直接规范，而且现在开始讨论具体形式恰逢其时。
en: That should certainly include vastly enhanced expenditures on public education; but I suspect that a long-term solution will have to involve more direct regulation, and it is not too soon to start discussing the modalities.

zh: 儿童先驱
en: Children’s Champions

zh: 伦敦—英国社会改革家杰布（Eglantyne Jebb）曾经指出，全世界都听得懂的国际语言只有儿童的哭声。
en: LONDON – The British social reformer, Eglantyne Jebb, once noted that the only international language that the world understands is the cry of a child.

zh: 在杰布创立拯救儿童（Save the Children）计划近一个世纪后，2014年诺贝尔和平奖授予了17岁的女孩教育先驱马拉拉·尤沙夫赛（Malala Yousafzai）和童工反对者凯拉什·塞蒂亚尔西（Kailash Satyarthi ） 。
en: Nearly a century after Jebb founded Save the Children, the 2014 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to Malala Yousafzai, the 17-year-old campaigner for girls’ education, and child-labor opponent Kailash Satyarthi.

zh: 诺贝尔委员会通过这种方式承认了与儿童贩卖、童工、童婚和重男轻女的全球公民权利斗争。
en: The Nobel Committee thus recognized a global civil-rights struggle against child trafficking, child labor, child marriages, and discrimination against girls.

zh: 目前，叙利亚、伊拉克、加沙和南苏丹冲突仍在进行中，许多年轻人的生活饱受蹂躏，诺贝尔委员会突出儿童所遭受的苦难可谓正逢其时。
en: Given recent and ongoing conflicts in Syria, Iraq, Gaza, and South Sudan, which have devastated so many young lives, the Nobel committee had good cause to highlight children’s suffering.

zh: 理应成为庇护所的学校成了军事目标。
en: Schools, which should have been sanctuaries, have become military targets.

zh: 数千叙利亚和伊拉克儿童被强征入伍。
en: Thousands of children in Syria and Iraq have been press-ganged into military service.

zh: 尽管联合国纾困机构做出了努力，但今年夏天的大屠杀仍然添增了一百万儿童难民。
en: Despite the efforts of United Nations relief agencies, the carnage this summer has created an additional one million child refugees.

zh: 儿童的脆弱在六个月前的事件中彰显无遗。 伊斯兰教恐怖组织博科圣地（Boko Haram，意思是“西方教育是一种罪恶 ” ） 诱拐劫持了276名尼日利亚女学生。
en: The vulnerability of children was illustrated only too well six months ago, when the Islamist terrorist group Boko Haram (whose name means “Western education is a sin”) abducted 276 Nigerian schoolgirls.

zh: 即使所有女生最后都随着该组织与尼日利亚政府达成休战协议而安全归来，全球仍有1,500万14岁以下儿童被迫工作，受尽剥削，并且他们的工作环境常常骇人听闻。
en: Even if all of the kidnapped girls are returned safely, as a truce between the group and Nigeria’s government stipulates, there are still 15 million children under the age of 14 worldwide who are forced to work, often in appallingly exploitative environments.

zh: 另有每年一千万学龄女孩成为童婚新娘，大约3,200万女孩享受不到接受小学教育的基本权利。
en: A further ten million school-age girls are married off as child brides each year, while around 32 million girls are denied the right even to an elementary education.

zh: 但全球范围的反击已经开始。
en: But a worldwide counter-offensive is now underway.

zh: 塞蒂亚尔西的反对童工全球大游行（Global March Against Child Labor）减少了成千上万的男女童工，他们往往只有八岁，在印度穷街陋巷的血汗工厂中被奴役。
en: Satyarthi’s Global March Against Child Labor has rescued thousands of boys and girls, as young as eight, working as slave laborers in India’s back streets and sweatshops.

zh: 该组织开启了一场全球性的解救被剥削儿童、让他们重获教育的运动。
en: The organization has inspired a worldwide campaign to lift children out of exploitation and into education.

zh: 与此同时，尤沙夫赛领导了结束重男轻女的斗争，这是对两年前射向她的子弹的藐视性回应。
en: Meanwhile, Yousafzai – following her defiant response to an assassin’s bullet two years ago – has led the fight to end discrimination against girls.

zh: 她的影响力引人注目。
en: Her impact has been remarkable.

zh: 她遇袭后我正好访问巴基斯坦，我看到愤怒的女孩在塔利班的压迫下敢怒不敢言。
en: Visiting Pakistan immediately after that attack, I saw angry girls cowed into submission by their fear of the Taliban.

zh: 几周之后我回访巴基斯坦，为大约2,000名女孩做了教育问题演讲。
en: On a return visit a few weeks ago, I addressed some 2,000 girls about education.

zh: 在尤沙夫赛的激发下，她们不再沉默；相反，她们开始发出声音，要求获得与男孩一样的权利。
en: Inspired by Yousafzai, they were far from quiescent; on the contrary, they were vocal in their demands for the same rights that boys enjoy.

zh: 数以百计的地方儿童解放组织 — — 其中不少位于最偏远顽固的地区 — — 开始为儿童的公民权利斗争。
en: Hundreds of local child-liberation groups, some in the least promising of places, have emerged to fight for children’s civil rights.

zh: 这些组织包括自由卡姆拉里发展论坛（Freed Kamlari Development Forum，反女童奴的尼泊尔组织 ） 、 上曼雅克罗伯儿童权利俱乐部（Upper Manya Krobo Rights of Child Club ） 、 黄色运动（Yellow Movement，埃塞俄比亚年轻人权利运动）等。
en: These include the Freed Kamlari Development Forum (which combats girls’ slavery in Nepal); the Upper Manya Krobo Rights of the Child Club; and the Yellow movement, which campaigns for youth rights in Ethiopia.

zh: 这些年轻活动家也许尚未在Twitter或Facebook上热门起来，甚至在自己的国家中也没有什么名气，但对他们的事业的支持正在快速扩大。
en: These young activists may not yet be trending on Twitter or Facebook, or even be household names in their own countries, but support for their cause is growing fast.

zh: 以无童婚区运动为例，该运动的源于孟加拉国20个地区的女学生联合起来抵抗童婚。
en: Consider the campaign for child-marriage-free zones, which began with schoolgirls in 20 areas of Bangladesh uniting to fight against child marriage.

zh: 如今，该运动在巴基斯坦、印度和非洲展开活动。
en: The movement now operates in Pakistan, India, and Africa.

zh: 在国际儿童计划组织（Plan International）的领导下这些团体迫使政府收紧反童婚法律，在巴基斯坦的信德省等地还强化了执法和整顿。
en: The success of these groups, led by Plan International, has forced governments to toughen laws against child marriage, and – as in Pakistan’s Sindh province – beef up enforcement and policing.

zh: 尤沙夫赛和塞蒂亚尔西毫无疑问代表着成千上万和她们一样与童婚、童工、儿童贩卖作斗争的同志。
en: Yousafzai and Satyarthi would undoubtedly point to thousands of others like them who are protesting against child marriage, labor, and trafficking.

zh: 事实上，在过去连年中，青年勇气奖（Youth Courage Awards）让人们认识了众多致力于改变各自国家儿童前景的运动家，他们是新一代人的榜样。
en: Indeed, for the past two years, the Youth Courage Awards have recognized campaigners – role models for a new generation – who have transformed the prospects for children in their own countries.

zh: 这些人包括：为残疾儿童奔波的视障印度人阿什维尼（Ashwini ） 、 在自家厨房创办女校的阿富汗人阿塔尔（Attal ） 、 在南亚妓院中长大、成立援助被贩卖和被虐待女孩团体的什维塔（Shweta ） 、 协助教育五十万叙利亚和巴勒斯坦难民中的大量儿童的为黎巴嫩教书（Teach For Lebanon）组织创始人萨利恩（Salyne ） 。
en: They include: India’s Ashwini, a visually impaired champion for disabled children; Attal, who created a girls school in his family kitchen in Afghanistan; Shweta who grew up in a South Asian brothel and created a support group for trafficked and abused girls; and Salyne, whose organization, Teach For Lebanon, is helping to educate many of the country’s half-million Syrian and Palestinian refugees.

zh: 青年勇气奖获得者拉齐亚（Razia）在九岁应该上学的年纪被迫从事缝制足球的工作，在获得塞蒂亚尔西的拯救后，她开始从事公民权利工作。
en: One Youth Courage award winner, Razia, who at the age of nine was forced to stitch footballs when she should have been in school, started her civil-rights work after Satyarthi rescued her.

zh: 如今，她领导着印度教育权利运动。
en: She is now leading the campaign in India for the right to education.

zh: 反儿童剥削运动和儿童教育运动正在成为全球趋势。
en: The campaign against child exploitation and for education has become global.

zh: 学校世界（A World of School）组织正在募集史上最大规模请愿以支持有教无类的千年发展目标。
en: The organization A World at School is now circulating the biggest-ever petition in support of the Millennium Development Goal of universal education.

zh: 悲哀的事实是儿童在为自己争取权利方面比成年人做得更多。
en: The sad fact is that children are doing more than adults to fight for their own rights.

zh: 尽管如此，塞蒂亚尔西、尤沙夫赛和其他人所动员起来的儿童解放运动正在日益蓬勃发展，充满勇气的新声音直指绝不能允许在子孙后代继续存在的不公。
en: Nonetheless, the child-liberation movement that Satyarthi, Yousafzai, and others have helped to mobilize is growing by the day, and new, courageous voices are speaking out against injustices that cannot be allowed to persist for another generation.

zh: 儿童引起了全球变暖吗？
en: Do Children Cause Global Warming?

zh: 哥本哈根—不管在哪种文化中，养孩子都被认为是个人回报最高的活动之一。
en: COPENHAGEN – Across all cultures, raising a child is considered one of the most rewarding things a person can do.

zh: 但一些活动家、科学家和记者说，所有人在生育之前都应该三思。
en: Yet a chorus of campaigners, scientists, and journalists suggest that everyone should think twice before procreating.

zh: 美国公共广播台NPR问 ： 《 气候变化时代，我们还应该生孩子吗？
en: The United States’ public radio broadcaster NPR asks, “Should We Be Having Kids in the Age of Climate Change?”

zh: 》 《 国家 》 （ The Nation）想知道 ， 《 当气候变化正在重造地球生命的时候，你如何决定要孩子？
en: The Nation magazine wants to know, “How Do You Decide to Have a Baby When Climate Change Is Remaking Life on Earth?”

zh: 》 《 卫报》建议读者 ， “ 想遏制气候变化？
en: The Guardian counsels readers: “Want to fight climate change?

zh: 少生孩子。
en: Have fewer children.”

zh: ” 《 纽约时报》警告，要孩子是你可以做出的最糟糕的环境活动。
en: And the New York Times warns that having a child is the worst environmental action anyone could take.

zh: 如果拥有两个孩子，假设一位美国妇女开节能型汽车，减少开车，使用回收用品，安装节能灯泡和节能窗户，还是会造成“近40倍于她的这些活动所节约”的伤害。
en: By having two children, a hypothetical American woman who switches to a fuel-efficient car, drives less, recycles, installs efficient light bulbs and energy-saving windows, would do as much damage as “nearly 40 times what she had saved by those actions.”

zh: 去年，美国生育率降至历史低位。
en: Last year, the US fertility rate hit a historic low.

zh: 我们曾经遇到过这种情况。
en: We have been here before.

zh: 20世纪70年代，环境破坏和社会崩溃恐慌促使一些怀有良好初衷的人不要孩子。
en: In the 1970s, fear of environmental degradation and societal collapse drove some well-intentioned people to remain childless.

zh: 罗马俱乐部的科学家和意见领袖做出过著名的（错误的）人类末日，认为世界铝、铜、金、铅、汞、钼、天然气、石油、银、锡、钨和锌将会耗尽。
en: The scientists and opinion leaders comprising the Club of Rome famously (and erroneously) predicted humanity’s end, forecasting that the world would run out of aluminium, copper, gold, lead, mercury, molybdenum, natural gas, oil, silver, tin, tungsten, and zinc.

zh: 他们鼓吹停止经济增长，削减消费，确保要更少孩子。
en: They advocated stopping economic growth, cutting consumption, and making sure people had fewer children.

zh: 一些富裕国家的人遵循了这一建议。
en: Some people in rich countries followed this advice.

zh: 1972年，美国活动家成立了全国无孩组织，宣传不要孩子是“政治上负责 ” 。
en: In 1972, US activists founded the National Organization for Non-Parents, promoting childlessness as “politically responsible.”

zh: 1976年的研究论文指出，担心人口过多已成为“不要孩子的原因之一 ” 。
en: A research paper from 1976 noted that fear of overpopulation had become “one of the reasons for remaining child-free.”

zh: 你可能会好奇，当这个悲观的预言最后证明知识兜售恐慌时，是否有科学家会后悔，或者有多少原本可以成为父母亲的人会后悔。
en: One wonders whether any of the scientists felt remorse, or how many would-be parents felt regret, when the dire predictions turned out to be fear mongering.

zh: 和罗马俱乐部一样，今天的气候科学家反对要孩子的理由是增加地球人口会导致环境负担。
en: Just like the Club of Rome, today’s climate scientists make the case against having children by pointing to the environmental burden caused by adding to the planet’s population. Most analyses use the approach set out in a 2009 paper by Oregon State University’s Paul A. Murtaugh and Michael G. Schlax, which holds each parent responsible for half of every child’s projected lifetime CO2 emissions.

zh: 大部分研究使用俄勒冈州大学的保罗·莫尔塔（Paul A. Murtaugh）和迈克尔·施拉克斯（Michael G. Schlax）的一篇2009年的论文的方法，认为每个父母需要为他们的每个孩子的预期生命周期的二氧化碳排放量负一半责任。
en: But it doesn’t stop there: You are held responsible not just for half of your child’s emissions, but also for a quarter of your grandchildren’s emissions, an eighth of your great-grandchildren’s emissions, and so on. In their central scenario, Murtaugh and Schlax expect that in the US every child will account for more than 20 tons of CO2 every year.

zh: 这个预测有好几个问题。
en: This forecast is problematic on several counts.

zh: 首先，这一排放量与当前的现实相比，已经高了20 % 。
en: First, that emission count is already 20% too high compared to today’s reality.

zh: 此外，预计美国个人排放量将在2050年前再下降0.5 % 。
en: Moreover, the US expects that personal emissions will drop a further 0.5% every year before 2050.

zh: 其次，该方法将所有后代的未来所有排放都归咎于父母，简直荒谬。
en: Second, the approach of blaming parents for all emissions of all progeny into the future is just ludicrous.

zh: 用这一标准衡量的话，狩猎采集的祖先对地球的伤害要远远高于今天乘坐飞机的亿万富翁。
en: By this measure, our hunter-gatherer ancestors were far worse for the planet than any jet-setting billionaire today.

zh: 显然，你襁褓中的女儿在二三十年后是否要孩子的决定是她自己的责任和选择。
en: Clearly, your infant daughter’s decision in two or three decades whether to have children is her own responsibility and choice to make.

zh: 真相是每多一个儿童也许意味着90年的二氧化碳配方（主要来自他在一生中所消费的产生排放的产品和公用设施 ） ， 最多不过今天的水平 — — 大约没人每年15吨。
en: The truth is that one extra child means perhaps 90 years of CO2 emissions (caused largely by a lifetime of consuming products and utilities that account for such emissions), which at worst would remain at around today’s level of about 15 tons per person annually.

zh: 亦即本世纪将增加最多1,300吨。
en: That adds up to 1,350 tons over this century.

zh: 如果你真的担心这些增加的排放，你可以通过欧盟排放交易系统抵消你的孩子一生中的排放量所造成23,400美元伤害。
en: If you are really worried about those extra emissions, you could offset the damage caused by your child’s lifetime emissions for about $23,400 (€19,600) in the European Union’s emissions trading system.

zh: 如果你买到牌照的话，可以迫使能源公司和其他企业今年少减排1,350吨。
en: If you buy the certificates, you will force energy companies and others to emit exactly 1,350 tons less this year.

zh: 考虑到这一背景，美国农业部测算养一个中产阶级美国孩子至17岁的成本为233,610美元。
en: To put this in context, the US Department of Agriculture estimates the cost of raising a middle-class US child to the age of 17 to be $233,610.

zh: 显然，要孩子对父母亲的价值不止 — — 可能远不止 — — 233,610美元。
en: Clearly, the value to parents of having a child is worth more – likely much more – than $233,610.

zh: 通过不要孩子减少二氧化碳排放的价值不会高于23,400美元。
en: Cutting CO2 emissions by not having a child has a value no higher than $23,400.

zh: 如果赤裸裸地谈钱，孩子的“收益”远高于他们的气候“成本 ” 。
en: In crude monetary terms, the “benefits” of children far outweigh their climate “costs.”

zh: 但对未来父母亲的恐吓仍在继续。
en: And yet scaring off potential parents continues.

zh: 《纽约时报》采访了一位年轻妇女，她说 ， “ 我知道人一定要生育后代，但我现在的直觉是要为我的孩子挡住可怕的未来，办法就是不要把他们带到世界上来。 ”
en: The New York Times interviewed one young woman who said, “I know that humans are hard-wired to procreate, but my instinct now is to shield my children from the horrors of the future by not bringing them to the world.”

zh: 这种说法和罗马俱乐部的预测一样具有误导性。
en: This rhetoric is as misguided as the Club of Rome’s predictions.

zh: 联合国气候委员会做了一项关于气候变化伤害成本的科学估算的全球调查，结果表明，气候变暖目前的净成本为零。
en: A global survey of all scientific estimates of the costs of climate change damage, undertaken by the United Nations climate panel, found that global warming right now has about a zero net cost.

zh: （最悲观的观点认为成本可相当于全球GDP的0.3 % ， 最乐观的观点认为有2.3%的净收益。
en: (The most pessimistic study identifies a cost of 0.3% of global GDP, and the most optimistic a net benefit of 2.3%.)

zh: ）如果我们什么也不做，半个世纪后的未来伤害预计将达到GDP的2 % ， 到下世纪初将达到3 — — 4 % 。
en: If we do nothing, future damages are expected to total 2% of GDP in a half-century and 3-4% early next century.

zh: 这意味着气候变化绝对是我们必须面对的挑战，必须增加可再生能源研究和开发的支出。
en: This means that climate change certainly is a challenge we must confront, and there is a compelling case for additional spending on renewable energy research and development.

zh: 但吓唬人们不要孩子让潜在父母们无法获得很可能是一生中最好的礼物，所换来的仅仅是23,400美元就可以买到的好处。
en: But scaring people from having children denies potential parents what is often seen as one of the best things life has to offer, in order to achieve less good than what $23,400 could buy.

zh: 以如此巨大的人道代价获得如此一丁点好处对所有人来说都不是好买卖。
en: Doing little environmental good at such a huge human cost is a bad deal for everyone.

zh: 儿童的黑暗时代
en: Dark Days for Children

zh: 纽约、斯德哥尔摩—2016年可能将因为军事和政治事件而被人铭记，但它也是二战以来儿童遭遇最悲惨的年份之一。
en: NEW YORK, STOCKHOLM – The year 2016 will probably be remembered for military and political events, but it should also go down in history as one of the worst years for children since World War II.

zh: 死亡、受伤和目光呆滞的幼童图像几乎每天都充斥着媒体：一个儿童在家园被炸毁后一边流血一边呆若木鸡；幼小的尸体从废墟中被抬出；地中海沿岸标记佚名儿童死亡的小坟墓，等等。
en: Images of dead, injured, and distraught young children filled the media on an almost daily basis: a small boy sitting stunned and bleeding after his home was bombed; small bodies being lifted out of rubble; and small graves on the Mediterranean shoreline that mark the deaths of unknown children.

zh: 这些图像感染力极强，令人难受。
en: These images are powerful and uncomfortable.

zh: 但它们不足以道出儿童苦难之万一。
en: And yet they cannot capture the magnitude of children’s suffering.

zh: 2.4亿多儿童生活在冲突地区 — — 从叙利亚、也门、伊拉克和尼日利亚北部的杀戮场，到较少见诸媒体但情况骇人听闻的索马里、南苏丹和阿富汗地区。
en: More than 240 million children are living in conflict zones – from the killing fields of Syria, Yemen, Iraq, and northern Nigeria, to less well-documented but horror-stricken areas of Somalia, South Sudan, and Afghanistan.

zh: 而在5,000万被迫逃离祖国或在国内流离失所的儿童中有一大半是被迫离开家园，并面临着生命和福利的新威胁。
en: And of the 50 million children who live outside their own countries or have been internally displaced, more than half have been forcibly uprooted, and are facing new threats to their lives and well-being.

zh: 数百万儿童营养不良，无法上学。 数百万儿童目睹了不可名状的野蛮暴力。
en: Millions of children are undernourished and out of school; millions have witnessed unspeakable brutality; and millions are threatened with exploitation, abuse, and worse.

zh: 数百万儿童惨遭剥削、虐待和更可怕遭遇。 这不是讲故事。
en: This is not rhetoric; it is reality.

zh: 联合国 — — 在瑞典等国家的帮助下，通过包括联合国儿童基金会（UNICEF）在内的协作式人道主义响应系统 — — 正在随时随地竭尽全力减轻苦难。
en: The United Nations – with support from countries such as Sweden, and by working through a coordinated humanitarian-response system that includes UNICEF – is alleviating suffering whenever and wherever it can.

zh: 但层出不穷的危机数量既大，复杂性亦高，正在给这一系统造成前所未有的考验。
en: But the quantity and complexity of cascading crises are testing that system as never before.

zh: 新的挑战，比如恐怖主义等，正在增加儿童的风险，也让接触到他们变得更加困难和危险。
en: New challenges, such as extremism, are increasing the risks to children, and making it more difficult and dangerous to reach them.

zh: 与此同时，武装集团日益将目标对准学校、医院和民居，更加剧了无辜群众的苦难。
en: Meanwhile, armed groups are increasingly targeting schools, hospitals, and homes, and compounding innocent people’s suffering.

zh: 用政治手段解决这些冲突是阻止苦难、结束如此凶残的践踏人权行为的最好方法。
en: Political solutions to these conflicts are the surest way to stop the suffering and bring an end to such savage violations of human rights.

zh: 但是，除了这一理想结果，我们还需要强化当前人道主义系统接触到处境最危险的儿童的能力。
en: But, barring that ideal outcome, we need to strengthen the current humanitarian system’s capacity to reach the children at greatest risk.

zh: 70多年前，世界领导人通过成立新机构随时随地给予需要帮助的人帮助来解决前所未有的人道主义危机。
en: More than 70 years ago, world leaders addressed the unprecedented humanitarian crisis following World War II by creating new institutions to bring immediate assistance to those in need.

zh: 这些新全球实体成为基于合作、对话和结果，而不是冲突、灾难和动乱的未来的基础。
en: These new global entities laid the foundation for a future based on cooperation, dialogue, and results, rather than conflict, disaster, and ruin.

zh: 这是世界历史的一个转折点：如今，我们正站在另一个转折点。
en: That was a turning point in world history; we have now arrived at another one.

zh: 如今，我们需要召唤激励前辈几代人的团结精神和创造力，但不是建立新机构，而是通过找到应对现时代残酷现实的新的应对之道。
en: We need to summon the same spirit of solidarity and creativity today that inspired previous generations, not by founding new institutions, but by finding new ways of responding to the hard realities of our own time.

zh: 首先，我们急需创新来扩大因为身处被围困地区或极端分子控制社区而与世隔绝的儿童的能力。
en: For starters, we urgently need to harness innovation to expand our capacity to reach children who are cut off from assistance in besieged areas or communities controlled by extremists.

zh: 我们应该探索所有选项，如用无人机空投食品和药品供给、开发移动应用监控需要和追踪供给情况，以及保证援助工作者的安全。
en: We should be exploring every option, such as using drones to airdrop food and medical supplies, and developing mobile apps to monitor needs and track supplies on the ground, and to keep aid workers safer.

zh: 尽管没什么可以代替安全畅通的人道主义援助，但我们需要探索一切办法接触危险中的儿童。
en: While there will never be a substitute for safe, unimpeded humanitarian access, we need to explore every avenue to reach children in danger.

zh: 更广泛地看，我们必须更好地协调政府和组织以更有效地提供短期和长期纾困，并用好每一分钱。
en: More broadly, we must do a better job of coordinating among governments and organizations to provide short-term and long-term relief more efficiently, and to make every dollar count.

zh: 随着长期危机的发酵，我们应该努力实现人道和发展措施综合化，因为两者相辅相成。
en: With chronic crises proliferating, we should be maximizing synergies between humanitarian and development initiatives, because the two go hand in hand.

zh: 我们如何应对紧急情况是未来增长和稳定的基础，而我们如何投资于发展可以帮助构建对抗未来紧急情况的恢复力。
en: How we respond in emergencies lays a foundation for future growth and stability, and how we invest in development can help build resilience against future emergencies.

zh: 最后，我们需要改变政府调整它们所提供的关键性援助的方式以满足波动的需要。
en: Lastly, we need to change how governments calibrate the critical aid that they provide to meet fluctuating needs.

zh: 最近几年，随着援助需求的逐步增加，正在经历国内紧缩的各国越来越需要论证对外援助支出。
en: In recent years, as appeals for aid have escalated, countries undergoing domestic austerity have increasingly had to justify their foreign-aid outlays.

zh: 许多出资国指定援助资金用于具体的目标。
en: Many donors have earmarked their aid funds for specific purposes.

zh: 诚然，这些资金一直是人道和发展方面不可或缺的工具；但在当今不可预测的环境下，更灵活、更长期的资金至关重要。
en: To be sure, such funds will always be an indispensable tool in both humanitarian and development efforts; but in today’s unpredictable environment, more flexible, long-term funding is critical.

zh: 这些所谓的“核心”资金让联合国和非政府组织均能够更快地响应紧急情况，进行更有战略性的规划。
en: “Core” funding, as it is known, enables the UN and nongovernmental organizations both to react more quickly in emergencies and to plan more strategically.

zh: 这些资金让我们能够在人们最需要的时候提供救命的帮助，不再干等各国响应具体的人道主义需求。
en: Such funding allows us to provide life-saving help when people need it most, rather than having to wait for countries to respond to specific humanitarian appeals.

zh: 这对于解决媒体不暇报道的“被遗忘的”危机尤其重要。
en: This is especially important for addressing the “forgotten” crises that the media may have missed.

zh: 长期以来，瑞典一直是像这样灵活地支持联合国组织的支持者，因为这样能够改善结果。
en: Sweden has long been a proponent of such flexible support for UN organizations, because it improves results.

zh: 出于这一原因，瑞典政府最近决定将其2016年联合国儿童基金会核心资金贡献额增加一倍。
en: For this reason, Sweden’s government recently decided to double its 2016 contribution to UNICEF’s core funds.

zh: 现在，全世界正在携手朝新的全球发展议程努力，我们希望这一做法能够得到普及，激励其他国家政府更加致力于高质量的人道主义纾困和可持续发展融资。
en: Now that the world is working together on a new global development agenda, we hope this practice will spread and inspire other governments to move more toward high-quality funding for humanitarian relief and sustainable development.

zh: 我们必须保护全世界最脆弱儿童的权利、生命和未来。
en: We must protect the rights, lives, and futures of the world’s most vulnerable children.

zh: 我们在这方面做得越出色，就越有利于我们的共同未来。
en: To the extent that we do that, we will help to determine our common future as well.

zh: 法国的孩子们
en: Children of Frenchmen

zh: 在法国人选举萨科奇作为他们的新总统、现在又让他的政治伙伴在议会取得领导地位的过程中，有一个令人费解的特点通常会被大家忽视，即个人乐观主义和公众悲观主义相互融合。
en: One puzzling and often overlooked feature of the France that elected Nicolas Sarkozy as its new president, and that is now poised to give his political allies a powerful parliamentary mandate, is its mix of private optimism and public pessimism.

zh: 考虑一下这种情况。 法国有着欧盟中最高的人口出生率（每个妇女有差不多两个孩子 ） ， 甚至比人口激增的爱尔兰还要高。
en: Consider this: France has the highest fertility rate in the European Union (just under two children per woman), even ahead of booming Ireland.

zh: 当然，仅靠这个比率并不足以支撑法国目前的人口，但是它远比欧洲邻国高，几乎与美国持平。
en: Of course, that rate alone is not enough to sustain France’s current population, but it’s far stronger than its European neighbors and almost equal to that of the US.

zh: 然而尽管如此，欧洲晴雨表民意测验还是一再显示，在国家未来问题上，法国人是全欧洲最悲观的。
en: Yet, despite this, Eurobarometer polls repeatedly show that the French are the most pessimistic of all Europeans when it comes to their country’s future.

zh: 为什么会出现人们在对他们作为一个国家的共同未来如此悲观的同时却又对在他们的家庭内部建立他们自己的未来如此充满信心的情况呢？
en: How can it be that people who are so negative about their common future as a nation go about confidently building their private futures within their families?

zh: 事实上，因为对政府几十年来未能制止居高不下的失业率感到失望，法国人现在通常被认为不再关心政治而只关注他们自己的生活和休闲。
en: Indeed, strained by decades of governmental failure to curb massive unemployment, the French are nowadays often perceived as having retired from the political sphere to concentrate on their lives and leisure.

zh: 博物馆、园艺以及各种各样的俱乐部在今天的法国如雨后春笋般冒了出来。
en: Museums, gardening, clubs of all sorts are blossoming in today’s France.

zh: 看起来，私人协会已经接过了被政党和工会遗弃的领域。
en: Private associations, it seems, have picked up where political parties and trade unions have left off.

zh: 但是如果说法国人不再关心公共领域，我们又怎么解释在最近的总统选举中创历史记录的高投票率呢？ 在这次的两轮选举中投票率超过了85 % 。
en: But if the French have turned their backs on the public sphere, how are we to make sense of the record-high participation in the recent presidential election, when more than 85% of turned out to vote in both rounds?

zh: 我们怎么解释被选举活动和萨科奇本人所燃起的热情，包括他在议会选举中所受到的巨大首肯呢？
en: How do we explain the passion aroused by the campaign and by Sarkozy himself including the massive affirmation he received in the parliamentary election?

zh: 看起来政治热情并没有在孕育过卢梭和丹东的国土上消失。
en: Political fervor, it seems, has not vanished in the land of Rousseau and Danton.

zh: 所以事实应该是另一种情况。 那就是法国人并没有对政治失去信心，他们只是在等待一个真正的领导人。
en: So the truth must lie elsewhere: the French are not hopeless about politics; they are simply waiting for a genuine leader.

zh: 实际上，我们完全可以肯定法国人绝对不会认为他们的国家会失去力量，不管有没有全球化。
en: As a matter of fact, a case can be made that the French will never come to believe that the state lacks power, globalization or no globalization.

zh: 法国人依然对他们的政府比一体化的欧洲或者没有国界的世界更有所期待。
en: The French still expect greater things from their government than from an integrated Europe or the boundless world.

zh: 然而，法国人是福利国家的忠实拥护者（他们不是唯一有这种想法的人 ） 。
en: Yes, the French are incorrigible lovers of the welfare state (they are not the only ones).

zh: 而萨科奇似乎本能地理解这一点。
en: And Sarkozy seems to understand this instinctively.

zh: 他的日程表似乎直指国内的自由化，从一周工作35小时开始，结束特定行业的特殊养老金体制，增加工作和获得财富的动力。
en: His agenda appears to aim at domestic liberalization – moving beyond the 35-hour week, ending the special pension regimes accorded to particular professions, increasing incentives to work and gain wealth.

zh: 但是它同时也期望在全球化带来的令人眩晕的结果上获得保护，这可能意味着对欧盟共同农业政策强有力的支持，以及对贸易的进一步自由化和强化欧盟经济管理的意愿持反对的态度。
en: But it also seeks protection from the dizzying effects of globalization, which probably will mean strong support for the EU’s Common Agricultural Policy, skepticism toward further trade liberalization and the will to improve European Union’s economic government.

zh: 不过，正因为他们关心他们大量孩子的未来，法国人对于一些聪明的改革方案要比大多数评论家（以及政治家）通常所认为的更经得起考验。
en: Nevertheless, precisely because they care about the future of their numerous children, the French are much more amenable to some wise reforms than most commentators (and politicians) generally assume.

zh: 中等和高等教育是新政府最优先要考虑的问题之一。
en: Secondary and higher education are rightly near the top of the agenda list of the new government.

zh: 但是他们同时也会采取措施把政府的努力集中在鼓励企业主以及提高经济活力上，比如对于住房和新开张企业的公共担保机制，以及对于小企业投资的财政优惠。
en: But so are measures aimed at harnessing the state to efforts to encourage entrepreneurship and boost economic dynamism such as public guaranties for housing and start-ups, and fiscal rebate for investment in small enterprises.

zh: 法国同时也迫切需要认真检视他们目前的文化多元性。
en: France is also in desperate need of a reality check on the nature of its current cultural diversity.

zh: 人们不应该忘记，尽管有他在竞选过程所说的那些话，以及在许多移民中不受欢迎，但是萨科奇本人就是一个移民的儿子，他正是受益于对移民持勇敢地肯定态度的政策。
en: And no one should forget that, despite his campaign rhetoric and his apparent unpopularity with many immigrants, Sarkozy himself is an immigrant’s son who favors bold affirmative action policies.

zh: 此外，把一个北非裔后代的女人挑选为司法部长也使事情一开始就显得很明朗。
en: Besides, the nomination of a woman with a North-African ascent as minister of Justice made that clear from the start.

zh: 大多数法国人认为他们的公共空间，即劳工市场、工作场所、住房以及学校受到了歧视态度的侵蚀。
en: Most French understand that their public spaces – the labor market, the workplace, housing, and educational institutions – are corroded by discrimination.

zh: 法国贫困的近郊和臭名远扬的郊区使“兄弟友爱”的理想听上去更像是伤害外加羞辱。
en: France’s impoverished suburbs, the notorious banlieues , make the ideal of “fraternité” sound like an insult on top of an injury.

zh: 对于萨科奇来说没有比从其内部向那些像他的父亲一样移民来法国的人的后代打开所有的大门更重要的事情了。
en: There is no greater task for Sarkozy than to open, from the inside, all doors to the offspring of others who, like his father, immigrated to France.

zh: 所以我们必须清楚萨科奇的当选不是为了让法国去适应令人难以捉摸的全球化，他更为迫切的使命是必须将法国的公共利益与个人的热情调和起来。
en: Nicolas Sarkozy has not been elected to adapt France to an elusive globalization. His mandate is much more demanding: he must reconcile France’s public interests with its private passions.

zh: 智利和第三堵墙
en: Chile and the Third Wall

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 2010年是智利独立二百周年庆。
en: SANTIAGO – Chile celebrated 200 years of independence in 2010.

zh: 全世界的198个国家中，只有20个已经独立了如此之久。
en: Only 20 of the 198 countries on Earth have reached that age.

zh: 因此，智利人现在应该审视自己的历史，扪心自问一个简单但意义深远的问题： 我们的所作所为究竟是对是错？
en: Therefore, it has been, for Chileans, a time of assessment and of asking ourselves a very simple, yet profound, question: have we done things right or wrong?

zh: 如果与其他拉美国家横向比较，我们的成绩实际是相当不错的，特别是在过去的25年中，我们从南美大陆最贫穷的国家之一一跃成为该区域人均收入最高的国家。
en: If we compare ourselves to the rest of Latin America, the truth is that we have done things very well, especially in the last 25 years, during which we went from being one of the poorest countries on the continent to having the highest per capita income in the region.

zh: 但如果与独特的发达国家集团相比，现实情况是需要我们学习的东西仍有很多。
en: Yet if we compare ourselves to the more exclusive group of developed countries, the truth is that we still have much to learn from them.

zh: 智利二百周年庆一代所面临的伟大目标、庄严使命和全局挑战只有一个： 那就是让智利在这个十年结束前成为拉美第一个可以谦卑而不无骄傲地宣称已经战胜贫困、跻身发达国家行列、并能为后代子孙提供物质和精神进步的切实机会的国家。
en: The great goal, the grand mission, the overarching challenge of our generation, the Bicentennial Generation, is just one: for Chile to be the first country in Latin America to be able to say, before the end of this decade, with pride and humility, that it has overcome poverty and become a developed country with real opportunities for material and spiritual advancement for all its children.

zh: 当然，在我们独立的头二百年中，这样的梦想是非常难以实现的。
en: Of course, this is a dream that has been extraordinarily elusive in our first 200 years of independence.

zh: 那为什么现在可以实现呢？
en: So why should now be different?

zh: 首先，与以往任何时候不同，这一目标完全可以实现，它也因此成为我们责无旁贷的道义职责。
en: First of all, unlike any time in the past, this goal has become fully attainable, and is, as a result, a moral imperative.

zh: 按照购买力调整后，智利目前的人均GDP已达15,000美元。
en: Chile currently has a per capita GDP of $15,000, after adjusting for purchasing power.

zh: 我们已经制定了6%的年均增长目标，这样到2018年，实现目前葡萄牙和捷克共和国等欧洲国家的人均GDP目标是可以期待的。
en: We have set the goal of growing at an average of 6% annually, in order to attain, by 2018, the per capita GDP now enjoyed by European countries such as Portugal and the Czech Republic.

zh: 我们也正努力提高近几年的就业机会创造率，力争在2010－2014年间增加一百万个就业岗位。
en: We are also working on doubling the job-creation rate of recent years, with the aim of adding one million jobs in the period 2010-2014.

zh: 所有指标表明我们努力的方向基本正确。
en: All indicators demonstrate that we are on the right path.

zh: 尽管去年2月的地震和海啸造成了严重的破坏，但智利经济已经以近6%的速度成长，而本届政府上任的头九个月中就已经创造了历史最高的近300,000个新增就业岗位。
en: Despite the devastating effects of the earthquake and tsunami of last February, Chile’s economy is already growing at close to 6%, and we have created nearly 300,000 new jobs in the first nine months of my administration – the highest in our country’s history.

zh: 其次，上述目标能够实现是因为世界格局已经发生变化。
en: Secondly, these goals are attainable because the world has changed.

zh: 几十年来一直不可调和地割裂东西方阵营的铁幕已经被打碎。
en: The Iron Curtain, which for decades irreconcilably divided the East from the West, is gone.

zh: 全球化和新技术也已经使几个世纪来隔离北方富裕繁荣国家和南方欠发达国家的那堵高墙不复存在。
en: And globalization and new technologies have torn down the wall that for centuries separated the rich and prosperous countries of the North from the poor and underdeveloped countries of the South.

zh: 但第三堵墙依然存在，虽然不那么显眼但却同样、甚至更为有害。
en: Yet a third wall remains, less visible than the others but just as harmful, if not more so.

zh: 这堵墙一直挡在我们中间，将颓废怀旧、恐惧未来、相信只有过去更好的人与年轻、富有创造力和创业精神、无畏地拥抱未来、相信未来更加美好的人分隔开来。
en: This wall has been with us always, separating rusting spirits who live in nostalgia, fear the future, and believe that only the past was better, from youthful, creative, and entrepreneurial spirits who fearlessly embrace the future and believe that the best is always yet to come.

zh: 这堵墙阻碍智利和拉美国家参与十九世纪工业革命，也正因为如此，我们到今天仍然是欠发达国家。
en: This wall kept Chile and Latin America from joining the nineteenth-century Industrial Revolution, which is why we remain underdeveloped to this day.

zh: 但如果我们不愿错过今天这场以知识、技术和信息为基础的革命，就需要将面前的这堵高墙拆毁。
