en: But we need this wall to tumble if we do not want to miss today’s revolution, which is delivering societies based on knowledge, technology, and information.

zh: 这次革命对积极参与的国家将会极端慷慨，而对视而不见或错过机会的国家将会极为冷漠甚至残酷。
en: This revolution will be tremendously generous to those countries that embrace it – and utterly indifferent, even cruel, to those that ignore it or let it pass by.

zh: 智利将要怎样获得突破？
en: How will Chile breach this wall?

zh: 首先要加强三大支柱建设，没有这些支柱，发展就无法萌芽，机会也无从谈起： 它们是生机勃勃、稳固、民众参与型的民主政体；自由、竞争力强、对世界各国开放的社会市场经济；以及高效战胜贫困和推动平等机会的强大高效的政府。
en: First, by strengthening the three basic pillars without which development cannot germinate or opportunities flourish: a stable, vital, and participatory political democracy; a social market economy that is free, competitive, and open to the world; and a strong state that is effective in the fight against poverty and in promoting greater equality of opportunities.

zh: 但要想使发展基础更为坚实仅有这三大支柱依然不够。
en: Yet not even this will suffice if we are to build on rock and not on sand.

zh: 21世纪，像智利这样的新兴国家必须在现代社会支柱上投资。
en: In this twenty-first century, emerging countries like Chile must invest in the pillars of modern society.

zh: 这里我指的是发展最宝贵的人力资本，鼓励发展我们掌握的真正永久性资源（即创新和企业家精神 ） ， 投资将在未来带来未知机遇的科学技术，推动将会帮我们占据领先地位的更加健康灵活的市场社会，以积极主动的姿态掌控变革，而不是总被甩在后面，对各种变化只是疲于理解和应对。
en: I mean developing our human capital, which is our greatest resource; encouraging innovation and entrepreneurship, which are the only truly eternal resources we have on hand; investing in science and technology, which will open up unsuspected opportunities in the future; and promoting more dynamic and flexible markets and societies that will put us ahead, and at the helm, of change, rather than always lagging behind and trying to comprehend and adapt to change.

zh: 这些是本届政府重点建设的发展支柱。
en: Those are the pillars that our administration is emphasizing.

zh: 随着智利越来越深地融入世界经济体系，我们也在不断推进结构改革，力求大幅改善成百上千万儿童和青年所接受的教育；在今后四年对四分之三的智利工人开展再培训；让更多的人能够使用宽带网络服务；实现对科技领域的投资翻番；推动公共和私人领域的创新和创业精神；将创办公司的时间减少到一天，成本降低为零。
en: As Chile deepens its integration with the world, we are also moving forward with structural reforms through which we will be able to improve substantially the quality of education received by millions of our children and youths; retrain three-quarters of Chilean workers over the next four years; grant universal access to broadband Internet service; double our investment in science and technology; promote innovation and entrepreneurship in the public and private sectors; and reduce the time needed to start up a company to one day – and the cost to zero.

zh: 以上就是构成本届内阁目标和基础的某些举措。
en: These are some of the many measures that form the goals – and foundation – of my administration.

zh: 这些目标伟大、高尚、雄心勃勃，但同时完全符合今天二百年智利的现实状况，今天的智利正以前所未有的乐观和热情准备迎接21世纪。
en: They are grand, noble, and ambitious goals, but fully attainable for today’s Chile, the Bicentennial Chile, a Chile now viewing the twenty-first century with more optimism and enthusiasm than ever before.

zh: 智利的不确定未来
en: Chile’s Uncertain Future

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 当我在本月初访问智利时，印象最深的莫过于长期自由市场政策为这个国家所带来的切实提升与其左派总统米切尔·巴切莱特（Michelle Bachelet）当前议程之间的反差。
en: CAMBRIDGE – When I was in Chile earlier this month, I was impressed by the contrast between the palpable success of its long-standing free-market policies and the current agenda of its leftist president, Michelle Bachelet.

zh: 而如何消除这种反差将极为重要，不仅关乎该国1700万国民的福祉，还将影响到那些将智利视为合理经济政策成功典范的人们。
en: How this contrast is resolved will be important not only to the country’s more than 17 million people, but also to everyone who regards Chile as a model of what sound economic policies have been able to achieve.

zh: 智利是南美洲经济表现最强的国家。
en: Chile’s economic performance has been the strongest in South America.

zh: 按购买力平价计算人均GDP超过2.2万美元，高于阿根廷，巴西和墨西哥。
en: Its per capita GDP exceeds $22,000 in purchasing-power-parity terms, making its income higher than that of Argentina, Brazil, and Mexico.

zh: 因此智利不出意料地被视为发达国家 — — 也是经合组织在南美的唯一成员国。
en: It’s no surprise that Chile is considered a developed country – the only South American member of the OECD.

zh: 铜是智利的主要产品，占其出口的半壁江山。
en: Copper is Chile’s major product and accounts for half of its exports.

zh: 政府下属的Codelco公司是全球最大的铜生产商，也是智利唯一的公营企业。
en: Although the government owns Codelco, the world’s largest copper producer, it is Chile’s only publicly owned company.

zh: 该公司的营收会随全球铜价波动而变化，因此政府收入也会在某些年份走高或者下跌 — — 比如今年这种下跌市。
en: The company’s revenue varies with the global price of copper, yielding higher government revenues in some years and declines – for example, this year – when the global price is down.

zh: 政府遵循一个明智的财政策略，当预算因高铜价而出现盈余时就将多余的钱存入国家稳定基金。
en: The government follows a wise fiscal strategy that involves budget surpluses in years when copper revenue is high, with the additional funds channeled to a national stabilization fund.

zh: 但即便当前铜价如此低迷，智利的预算赤字也仅为GDP的2 ％ 。
en: But even with the currently depressed copper price, Chile’s budget deficit is only 2% of GDP.

zh: 在谨慎财政策略之下，该国国家负债额只相当于GDP的16 ％ — —主权债务评级也是南美是最高的。
en: As a result of Chile’s cautious fiscal strategy, the country has a national debt that amounts to only 16% of GDP – and a sovereign debt rating that is the highest in South America.

zh: 政府税收和其他收入相当于GDP的不到20 ％ 。
en: Taxes and other government revenues are less than 20% of GDP.

zh: 税收收入的一半都是通过一项增值税来获得，而该税项实质上是一种消费税。
en: Half of tax revenue is collected with a value-added tax, which is essentially a tax on consumption.

zh: 虽然也设立企业所得税，却是以一种和个人所得税打包的方式存在，从而降低了对投资和生产的负面影响。
en: Although there is a tax on corporate income, it is integrated with personal taxes in a way that reduces its adverse effect on investment and production.

zh: 另外一项比较突出的是智利以投资为基础的养老保险制度。
en: Chile is well known for an investment-based pension system.

zh: 员工必须拿出自身工资的10 ％ ， 任选一家私人养老金公司并投入该公司提供的其中一种投资策略中。
en: Employees are required to contribute 10% of their wages to a private pension company of their choice and can then select one of the investment strategies offered by that company.

zh: 政府对投资策略的范围做了强制规定，养老金公司只能改变持有股票的份额以及固定收入的数额。
en: The government mandates the range of investment strategies, which vary in terms of the share of equities and fixed income that companies may offer.

zh: 对于那些工作了一辈子也缴纳了养老金的人来说，由此带来的分红将超过其退休前收入的50 ％ 。
en: For those who have worked and contributed during their entire adult life, this produces benefits that are more than 50% of pre-retirement income.

zh: 与此同时，在历任央行行长（智利宪法保障其独立性）英明指导下的稳健财政政策遏制了通货膨胀，维持长期利率处于相对较低的水平。
en: Meanwhile, sound monetary policy, guided by a series of talented central bankers (whose independence is enshrined in Chile’s constitution), has prevented inflation and kept long-term rates relatively low.

zh: 智利的通胀目标是3 ％ ， 可接受范围为±1 ％ 。
en: Chile’s inflation target is 3% with an acceptable range of plus or minus 1%.

zh: 今年的通胀率预计为3.9 ％ ， 而十年期债券利率仅为4.4 ％ 。
en: Inflation this year is expected to be 3.9%, and the ten-year bond rate is just 4.4%.

zh: 同时通过维护浮动汇率制度，央行将确保智利不会出现其他拉美国家所面对的外债危机。
en: And, by protecting the floating exchange-rate regime, the central bank ensures that Chile does not confront the kind of foreign-debt crisis that has hit other Latin American countries.

zh: 智利也是一个忠实的自由贸易国，与20多个国家签订了自由贸易协定，也是新生的跨太平洋伙伴关系中的一员。
en: Chile is also a devoted free trader. It has free-trade agreements with more than 20 countries and is a member of the nascent Trans-Pacific Partnership.

zh: 得益于其对外国投资开放政策，智利GDP有超过80％来自外国直接投资形成的存量。
en: The economy has also benefited from its openness to foreign investment, with the stock of foreign direct investment in Chile topping 80% of GDP.

zh: 该国识字率也极高，有98％的成年人能够读写。
en: There is also universal literacy, with 98% of the adult population able to read and write.

zh: 平均而言，年轻人从小学到大专院校的平均就学时间为15年。
en: On average, young people spend an average of 15 years in school from primary through tertiary education.

zh: 智利的优异经济表现是在奥古斯托·皮诺切特将军（Augusto Pinochet）的军事独裁期间推出，随后由民选政府在前者离任后的25年间确立并强化的自由市场政策的结果。
en: Chile’s excellent economic performance has been the result of the free-market policies introduced during the military dictatorship of General Augusto Pinochet but confirmed and strengthened by democratically elected governments over the 25 years since he left office.

zh: 但令人吃惊的是，即便这些政策获得了如此高的成就和支持度，选民们却选出了令许多智利人至今担心会动摇这一政策的总统和议会。
en: So, given the success and popularity of these policies, it is surprising that Chile’s voters have elected a president and a parliament that many Chileans now fear could put this approach at risk.

zh: 巴切莱特的施政纲领强调了三大变化。
en: Bachelet’s policy agenda emphasizes three major changes.

zh: 一个关键点是效仿欧洲体制的全民免费大学教育。
en: A key element would be universal free university education, modeled on European systems.

zh: 实现该教育改革需要更高的税率来支撑。
en: Paying for this educational reform would require higher tax rates.

zh: 同时将修改劳动法以加强工会的作用。
en: And labor laws would be revised to strengthen the role of unions.

zh: 巴切莱特的批评者声称这一议程已经开始遏制商业投资，并导致了相对缓慢的经济增长。
en: Critics of Bachelet claim that this agenda is already depressing business investment and is responsible for relatively slow economic growth.

zh: 他们担心国内外投资者将被新的劳动法吓跑。
en: And they worry that foreign and domestic investors will be discouraged by the new labor rules.

zh: 然而幸运的是，智利公众无意重蹈其他几个南美国家，尤其是委内瑞拉，厄瓜多尔，巴西和阿根廷的覆辙。
en: Fortunately, the Chilean public shows no inclination to follow the mistakes of several other South American countries, especially Venezuela, Ecuador, Brazil, and Argentina.

zh: 即使是巴切莱特的批评者也同意智利的基本宏观经济政策将不会改变：一个致力于价格稳定的独立央行，一个汇率浮动的自由贸易体制，一项将让赤字和公共债务控制在低水平的财政政策。
en: Even Bachelet’s critics agree that Chile’s basic macroeconomic policies will not change: an independent central bank committed to price stability, a free-trade regime with a floating currency, and a fiscal policy that will keep deficits and public debt low.

zh: 巴切莱特的任期将于2017年结束。
en: Bachelet’s term in office will end in 2017.

zh: 按照智利宪法规定她无法再次连任。
en: Under Chile’s constitution, she cannot serve another consecutive term.

zh: 因此那一年的选举将有待重点观察。
en: The election that year will therefore be an important one to watch.

zh: 精英学校的民主优势
en: The Democratic Merits of Selective Schools

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 拉美精英们究竟从何而来？
en: SANTIAGO – Where do Latin American elites come from?

zh: 如果从一度在美国和欧洲颇受欢迎的神奇现实主义小说中寻找答案，那么他们来自从殖民时代就拥有全部耕地 — — 和一切财产的14个家族中的一个（没错，精英家族一直就是14个 ） 。
en: If the magical realist fiction once so popular in the United States and Europe is any guide, they belong to one of the 14 families (yes, that is always the number) that since colonial times have owned all arable land – along with everything else.

zh: 但现实的复杂程度总是胜过小说。
en: But reality is more complicated than fiction.

zh: 在多数拉美国家，传统执政家族早就学会与各式各样的精英分享自己的地位：这些精英包括在拉美最好的公立学校和大学接受教育的专业人士和城市毕业生。
en: In most Latin American countries, the traditional ruling families learned long ago to share their place at the table with a different kind of elite: the urban, professional, and educated graduates of the region’s top public schools and universities.

zh: 但智利或许会改变这一切。
en: In Chile, however, that may be about to change.

zh: 智利国家学院是一所竞争激烈的男性中学，它的历史和共和国本身一样古老。
en: Chile’s Instituto Nacional, a fiercely competitive secondary school for boys, is as old as the Republic itself.

zh: 因为不收学费并实行以分数为唯一标准的招生制度，该校的绝大部分学生都来自中产及工薪阶层家庭。
en: With no fees and an entrance system based entirely on merit, students from middle- and working-class families comprise the vast majority of the student body.

zh: 去年高考中，有22名该校学生在全国名列前茅 — — 排名第二的昂贵的私立天主教学校却仅有9名（该教会学校由教会保守的主业会机构负责经营 ） 。
en: In last year’s college entrance examinations, 22 Institute students were nationally ranked – far more than the nine who studied at the second most successful institution, an expensive private Catholic school run by the Church’s conservative Opus Dei organization.

zh: 18名智利总统和近七任中的四任毕业于国家学院及与其地位对等的女校Liceo 1，现任总统巴切莱特也包括其中。
en: The Instituto and its counterpart for young women, Liceo 1, have educated 18 Chilean Presidents and four of the last seven, including the incumbent, Michelle Bachelet.

zh: 智利在这方面远非独一无二。
en: Chile is far from unique in this respect.

zh: 从布宜诺斯艾利斯的国立大学到纽约市史帝文森高中，拉美各国任人唯才的免费公立学校所取得的成绩最为突出。
en: From Colegio Nacional in Buenos Aires to Stuyvesant High School in New York City, institutions that are public, meritocratic, and free have long and distinguished records of achievement across the Americas.

zh: 有人可能认为此类学校或许会令巴切莱特这样的进步领袖感到自豪 — — 原因之一是她本人也曾毕业于类似的学校。
en: One might expect that such schools would make a progressive leader like Bachelet proud – not least because she herself attended one.

zh: 但她最近却提出了一项彻底颠覆这一体制的计划，并在不久前通过了智利国会的审核。 该计划允许国家学院和智利其他二十余家竞争激烈的公立学校通过入学考试选拔30%的生源，其余部分则由抽签决定。
en: Yet she has proposed a plan, recently approved by the Chilean Congress, that will upend the system, allowing the Instituto Nacional and two dozen other highly competitive public schools across Chile to select only 30% of their students through entrance exams, with the rest chosen by lottery.

zh: 受此影响，学生、老师和毕业生质量下降几乎毫无疑问。
en: The affected schools’ students, teachers, and alumni are predictably upset.

zh: 为什么有人想以“平等”为名削弱公立学校的地位？
en: Why would anyone wish to weaken public schools in the name of equality?

zh: 改革的支持者给出了两种说法 — — 但没有一种能令人信服。
en: Backers of the reform make two arguments – neither of which is convincing.

zh: 第一种说法是这些学校的成绩并不像看上去那样突出。
en: The first argument is that these schools’ achievements seem greater than they are.

zh: 批评者称招收实力最强的学生确保公立学校成绩最好，但这并没有改变产生的附加值。
en: By selecting only the strongest students, critics claim, they ensure strong results, without having to add a lot of value.

zh: 这是教科书式的经典“内生性”问题：是学校质量好让学生出类拔萃，还是学生实力强让学校成绩出色？
en: This is a textbook “endogeneity” problem: Do the students excel because of the quality of the school, or does the school gain strong results because of the quality of the students?

zh: 为了回答这个问题，不久前有份论文对比了差点未能考入国家学院的学生和成功考入该学院学生的标准化考试成绩。
en: To answer this question, a recent paper compared standardized-test performance by students who barely missed gaining admission to the Instituto to that of enrolled Instituto students.

zh: 结果是两者间的成绩差距越拉越大，而且这种差距具有统计学意义。
en: It turned out that the performance gap between the two groups grew, and the difference was statistically significant.

zh: 简言之，有理由认为像国家学院这样的精英公立学校能够改变学生的成绩。
en: In short, there is reason to believe that elite public schools like Instituto Nacional do make a difference for their students.

zh: 事实上，主导改革的批评者们都了解这个问题。
en: In fact, the critics  who helped to craft the reform recognize this.

zh: 他们认为成绩优势恰恰说明此类学校的大门应该向所有人敞开，也就是说要取消入学考试。
en: They argue that the performance advantage is precisely why the doors of such schools should be open to all, without entrance exams.

zh: 上述提案貌似弘扬了平等主义；但目前尚不清楚无论这些学校和老师多么出色，是否能提高随机选择的学生成绩。
en: The proposal has a nice egalitarian ring to it; but it is far from clear that these schools and their teachers, however skillful, can have such a significant impact on a randomly selected group of students.

zh: 体育、音乐、科学或视觉艺术等专业学校所面临的挑战尤其艰巨。
en: The challenge is particularly great for schools with a special focus, such as sports, music, science, or the visual arts.

zh: 毕竟，不是只要有腿就能像梅西那样踢足球，也不是任何声音条件都能成为玛丽亚·卡拉斯。
en: After all, not just any pair of legs will allow you to play soccer like Lionel Messi, and not just any set of vocal cords will allow you to sing like Maria Callas.

zh: 纽约布朗克斯理科中学招收移民子女，并将其培养成世界最出色的科学家。
en: The Bronx High School of Science in New York City takes children of immigrants and molds them into some of the world’s leading scientists.

zh: 但就连该校最狂热的支持者（该校的支持者不乏其人）也无法确定如果被禁止自主招生，该校是否还能取得同样的优异成绩。
en: Not even the school’s most enthusiastic boosters – of which there are many – could argue with any certainty that it could produce such impressive results if it could not select its own students.

zh: 类似的试验在拉美已经进行过一次。 20世纪60年代众多公立大学曾试图通过取消入学考试和学费来摘掉所谓的精英主义帽子。
en: Latin America tried this experiment once already, with many public colleges attempting to deflect accusations of elitism by eliminating entrance examinations and tuition fees in the 1960s.

zh: 在大学学位几乎等同于美好生活的拉美地区，入学人数不出所料的迅速膨胀。
en: In a region where a university degree had, until then, represented a ticket to the good life, enrollment predictably swelled.

zh: 但这个试验在很多地方都没有进行下去。
en: But, in many places, the experiment was short-lived.

zh: 像智利大学和圣保罗巴西大学这样的��校没过多久就恢复了竞争激烈的招生程序。
en: Institutions like the University of Chile and Brazil’s University of São Paulo resumed their highly competitive admissions processes.

zh: 那些没有恢复选拔程序的大学，如布宜诺斯艾利斯大学，发现他们打造学术、商业和政治精英的能力被严重侵蚀。
en: Those that did not, such as the University of Buenos Aires, saw their role in shaping their countries’ academic, business, and political elites diminish.

zh: 最后一句话的重点其实是“政治 ” 。
en: In that last sentence, underline the word “political.”

zh: 事实上，维持精英公立学校及其择优录取政策最有力的证据来自政治领域。
en: Indeed, the strongest argument for maintaining elite public schools, with their merit-based admissions policies, is political.

zh: 在传统富人精英早已掌握权力的国家，从中产阶级吸收秉承共和党价值观的传统富裕阶层以外的精英具有宝贵的政治价值。
en: In countries where traditional wealthy elites have long wielded power, an alternative elite drawn from the middle classes and educated under republican values is politically invaluable.

zh: 过去两百年智利民主改革者有不少都毕业于国家学院并不稀奇。
en: It is no coincidence that many of Chile’s democratic reformers of the last two centuries were once students at the Instituto Nacional.

zh: 去年在智利大学招生考试中，名列第二的并不是唯一一所学费不菲的以上层阶级为主的天主教会学校；前十名之内的其余学校也同样如此。
en: In last year’s Chilean college entrance exam, the second-place school was not the only expensive Catholic institution with a largely upper-class student body to perform well; the rest of the top-ten schools also fit this description.

zh: 主业会管理着其中绝大部分 — — 但并不是所有学校都被教会控制。
en: Opus Dei runs most – though not all – of them.

zh: 保守、精英院校占主导地位说明了像国家学院这样的院校为什么如此重要。
en: The dominance of such conservative, elitist institutions is why schools like the Instituto Nacional are so important.

zh: 然而，一旦巴切莱特最近的改革开始产生影响，他们的毕业生就可能不再名列前茅。
en: Yet once the effects of Bachelet’s recent reform kick in, their graduates may no longer be at the top of the ranks.

zh: 精英公立学校倒退最终会使智利民主蒙受损失。
en: As the elite public schools suffer, so will Chilean democracy.

zh: 智利的养老金紧缩
en: Chile’s Pension Crunch

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 养老金固定收益计划正在面临压力。
en: SANTIAGO – Defined-benefit pension plans are under pressure.

zh: 人口构成的变化为所谓随收随付（PAYG）系统带来困难，这套系统的特点是由现有劳动者缴费来资助养老金的发放。
en: Changing demographics spell trouble for so-called pay-as-you-go (PAYG) systems, in which contributions from current workers finance pensions.

zh: 同时创记录的低利率正在对融资体系构成压力，上述系统依靠之前的投资来支付退休福利。
en: And record-low interest rates are putting pressure on funded systems, in which the return from earlier investments pays for retirement benefits.

zh: 金融时报最近称上述养老金紧缩为一场“潜移默化的社会和政治危机。 ”
en: The Financial Times recently called this pensions crunch a “creeping social and political crisis.”

zh: 固定缴款、完全出资系统往往被赞赏为可行的替代选择。
en: Defined-contribution, fully-funded systems are often lauded as the feasible alternative.

zh: 智利被公认为这方面的代表性国度，该国从1981年起就要求民众向由私营管理人管理的个人退休账户内储蓄款项。
en: Chile, which since 1981 has required citizens to save for retirement in individual accounts, managed by private administrators, is supposed to be the poster child in this regard.

zh: 但数十万智利人纷纷走上街头抗议养老金过低的现状。
en: Yet hundreds of thousands of Chileans have taken to the streets to protest against low pensions.

zh: （智利私营体系平均月缴款额度约为三百美元，利于智利法定的最低工资。 ）
en: (The average monthly benefit paid by Chile’s private system is around $300, less than Chile’s minimum wage.)

zh: 智利政府在压力之下承诺要改变曾被秘鲁、哥伦比亚和墨西哥等国模仿的养老金系统，乔治·W·布什也曾将这套系统形容为美国社会保障改革的“出色榜样 ” 。
en: Chile’s government, feeling the heat, has vowed to change the system that countries like Peru, Colombia, and Mexico have imitated, and that George W. Bush once described as a “great example” for Social Security reform in the United States.

zh: 问题究竟出在什么地方？
en: What is going on?

zh: 责任可以部分归咎于劳动力市场。
en: The blame lies partially with the labor market.

zh: 智利与邻国相比经济比较正规 — — 但很多民众 — — 尤其是妇女和年轻人 — — 要么没有工作，要么没有合同。
en: Chile’s is more formal than that of its neighbors, but many people – especially women and the young – either have no job or work without a contract.

zh: 经常更换工作加大了定期缴费的难度。
en: High job rotation makes it difficult to contribute regularly.

zh: 而且事实证明要求自由职业者向个人账户存款的法规执行难度很大。
en: And it has proven difficult to enforce regulations requiring self-employed workers to put money aside in their own accounts.

zh: 此外，法律规定的储蓄率仅为月工资的10 % ， 而男性和女性的退休年龄分别为65岁和60岁 — — 远低于经合组织国家的平均数。
en: Moreover, the legally mandated savings rate is only 10% of the monthly wage, and men and women can retire at 65 and 60, respectively – figures that are much lower than the OECD average.

zh: 结果导致智利人退休存款过低。
en: The result is that Chileans save too little for retirement.

zh: 退休金额度低也就不足为怪了。
en: No wonder pensions are low.

zh: 但这还不是问题的全部。
en: But that is not the end of the story.

zh: 困扰固定收益体系的某些问题同样困扰着以智利为代表的固定支付、私人账户系统。
en: Some of the same problems plaguing defined-benefit systems are also troubling defined-contribution, private-account systems like Chile’s.

zh: 以预期寿命的变化为例。
en: Take changes in life expectancy.

zh: 今天60岁退休的女性其预期寿命可以达到90岁。
en: A woman retiring at age 60 today can expect to reach 90.

zh: 于是缴款期为十五年（智利女性缴款的平均年限）的养老基金却必须资助预期高达三十年的养老金支付。
en: So a fund accumulated over 15 years of contributions (the average for Chilean women) must finance pensions for an expected 30 years.

zh: 只有储蓄回报率达到天文数字这样的组合才能带来满意的养老金数额。
en: That combination could yield decent pensions only if the returns on savings were astronomical.

zh: 储蓄回报率当然没有那么高。
en: They are not.

zh: 相反，从2008到2009年全球金融危机后，世界各国利率就一直急速下行。
en: On the contrary, since the 2008-2009 global financial crisis, interest rates have been collapsing worldwide.

zh: 智利也不例外。
en: Chile is no exception.

zh: 这种情况影响到所有出资养老金系统，无论是固定收益还是固定缴款计划。
en: This affects all funded pension systems, regardless of whether they are defined-benefit or defined-contribution schemes.

zh: 低收益意味着低退休金 — — 或者赤字扩大。
en: Lower returns mean lower pensions – or larger deficits.

zh: 由此造成的冲击及其影响都很大。
en: The shock and its effect are large.

zh: 如果劳动者在退休时用退休基金购买年金，那么长期利率从4%降到2%将使其养老金出现近20%的下降。
en: In the case of a worker who at retirement uses his fund to buy an annuity, a drop in the long interest rate from 4% to 2% cuts his pension by nearly 20%.

zh: 智利基金经理高收费进一步加剧了回报率问题，储蓄者月薪的一定百分比被设定为基金经理的费用。
en: The rate-of-return problem is compounded in Chile by the high fees charged by fund managers, which are set as a percentage of the saver’s monthly wage.

zh: 在政府强制基金经理参与拍卖之前，市场竞争几乎非常微弱（调查结果显示大多数人并不清楚支付了多少费用 ） 。
en: Until the government forced fund managers to participate in auctions, there was little market competition (surveys reveal that most people are not aware of the fees they pay).

zh: 一家政府指定委员会最近得出结论 ，基金经理所得毛利相对于实际投资收益非常高：从1981到2013年，毛利相对于实际投资收益的占比为8.6 % ； 但费用居高不下让同一时期的储蓄者净回报率降至约3%左右。
en: A government-appointed commission recently concluded that managers have generated high gross real returns on investments: from 1981 to 2013, the annual average was 8.6%; but high fees cut net returns to savers to around 3% per year over that period.

zh: 这样的高收费意味着基金经理利润丰厚。
en: Those high fees have also meant hefty profits for fund managers.

zh: 正是少得可怜的养老金支票和基金经理丰厚利润之间的巨大反差激起了抗议活动。
en: And it is precisely the disparity between scrawny pension checks and managers’ fat profits that fuels protest.

zh: 因此，合法性赤字比智利养老金系统的任何技术性问题都更有难度。
en: So, more challenging than any technical problem with Chile’s pension system is its legitimacy deficit.

zh: 将养老金系统视为管理 — — 失业、疾病、利率波动、猝死或长寿 — — 风险的一种方式对解决问题会有所帮助。
en: To address that problem, it helps to think of any pension system as a way of managing risks – of unemployment, illness, volatile interest rates, sudden death, or a very long life span.

zh: 构建养老金体系的不同原则 — — 固定收益与固定缴款、完全出资与现收现付，再加上这两者之间的一切形式 — — 将上述风险以不同方式分配到劳动者、纳税人、退休人员和政府当中。
en: Different principles for organizing a pension system – defined-benefit versus defined-contribution, fully funded versus PAYG, plus all the points in between – allocate those risks differently across workers, taxpayers, retirees, and the government.

zh: 智利的主要经验是基于个人账户的固定缴款出资系统的确存在某些优势：它可以刺激储蓄、积累庞大且不断增长的可投资资金（智利可投资资金总额超过1700亿美元）并同时刺激经济增长。
en: The key lesson from Chile is that a defined-contribution, funded system with individual accounts has some advantages: it can stimulate savings, provide a large and growing stock of investible funds (over $170 billion in Chile), and spur economic growth.

zh: 但民众个人也因此被迫面对太多的风险因素。
en: But it also leaves individual citizens too exposed to too many risks.

zh: 成功的改革必须在保持储蓄积极性的同时改善劳动力市场并制定更加合理的风险分担机制。
en: A successful reform must improve the labor market and devise better risk-sharing mechanisms, while preserving incentives to save.

zh: 这是一项异常艰巨的任务。
en: It is a tall order.

zh: 智利系统已经实现了低收入劳动者和纳税人之间的风险分担，设立了最低非缴费型养老金并在2008年实行了一系列养老金追加举措（作为时任财政部长，我协助设计了这项改革 ） 。
en: Chile’s system already shares risks between low-income workers and taxpayers, via a minimum non-contributory pension and a set of pension top-ups introduced in 2008 (as Minister of Finance, I helped design that reform).

zh: 其后的经验表明上述福利应当扩大并提供给更多退休者。
en: Subsequent experience suggests that those benefits should be enlarged and made available to more retirees.

zh: 但智利政府却受制于剩余资金不足，因为政府将两年前增税带来的可观资金投资于（甚至为高收入学生）提供免费大学教育等考虑不周的政策。
en: But the Chilean government has little money left, having committed the revenues from a sizeable tax increase two years ago to the ill-conceived policy of free university education, even for high-income students.

zh: 为应对最近的抗议活动，政府又额外提出了一项风险分担计划：要求将由雇主支付的提高强制退休储蓄率5%所带来的部分资金划入“团结基金 ” ， 并用于低退休金领取者的转移支付。
en: In response to the recent protests, the government has proposed an additional risk-sharing scheme: some (thus far undecided) part of a five-percentage-point increase in the mandatory retirement savings rate, to be paid by employers, will go to a “solidarity fund” that can finance transfers to people receiving low pensions.

zh: 这一目标方向正确，但魔鬼往往隐藏在细节当中。
en: The goal is correct, but, as usual, the devil is in the details.

zh: 从中长期看，工资很有可能将进行调整，导致雇员、而非雇主将成为增量储蓄的实际承担者。
en: In the medium to long run, it seems likely that wages will adjust, so that the effective burden of the additional savings will be borne by employees, not employers.

zh: 一项研究估计劳动者将强制储蓄的半数视为劳动收入税，因此（尤其是不进入劳动者个人账户的基金）增收数额过大可能造成劳动力参与度下降、或从正规行业转向非正规行业等后果。
en: One study estimates that workers treat half of the compulsory savings as a tax on labor income, so too-large an increase (especially in the funds that do not go to the worker’s individual account) could cause a drop in labor-force participation, a shift from formal to informal employment, or both.

zh: 而这绝不是智利经济所需要的。
en: Chile’s economy does not need that.

zh: 退休金难题不存在简单的答案，无论是在智利还是在其他国家。
en: There are no easy answers to the pensions conundrum, whether in Chile or elsewhere.

zh: 智利立法机构必须依靠难以量化的利弊权衡做出困难的决策。
en: Chilean legislators will have to make difficult choices with hard-to-quantify tradeoffs.

zh: 无论他们如何决定，愤怒的退休人员和即将退休人员都将保持密切的关注。
en: Whatever they decide, irate pensioners and pensioners-to-be will be watching closely.

zh: 智利的总统小步舞
en: Chile’s Presidential Minuet

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯 — — 智利从20世纪80年代起就一直是拉美的成功典范，实现了快速的经济发展、与世界经济的成功融合、建立了可靠的民主制度、高效的国家官僚体系并且拥有低水平的腐败。
en: BUENOS AIRES – Chile has been Latin America’s success story since the 1980’s, boasting rapid economic growth, successful integration into the world economy, solid democratic institutions, an effective state bureaucracy, and low levels of corruption.

zh: 按照多数衡量标准，智利的情况都远胜于其他拉美国家。
en: By most standards, the country is far better off than the rest of the region.

zh: 所以，智利人在奥古斯托·皮诺切特将军17年的残暴军事统治后，从20世纪90年代起允许执政的基督教民主社会联盟 （ Concertación） 连任四届并不值得大惊小怪。
en: Not surprisingly, Chileans have kept the ruling Christian Democrat-Socialist coalition (the Concertación ) in power for four consecutive terms since 1990, when democracy was restored after 17 years of General Augusto Pinochet’s repressive military rule.

zh: 但在12月13日这天，参加智利总统大选投票的选民可能会让基督教民主社会联盟紧张得汗流浃背。
en: On December 13, however, voters in Chile’s presidential election are likely to make the Concertación candidate sweat.

zh: 基督教民主社会联盟的参选人爱德华多·弗雷是基督教民主党成员，也是前总统之子，其父曾在1994到2000年间担任总统一职。
en: The Concertación is running Christian Democrat Eduardo Frei, the son of a former president who was president himself from 1994 until 2000.

zh: 他的竞争对手是前参议员兼企业巨头塞瓦斯蒂安·皮涅拉，皮涅拉代表偏于保守的 民主革新党 （RN）和更为右翼的 独立民主联盟 （UDI）等主要反对力量，他曾在2006年总统选举中获得第二高票。
en: His opponent is Sebastián Piñera, a tycoon, former senator, and presidential runner-up in 2006 who represents the main opposition forces – Piñera’s moderately conservative Renovación Nacional (RN) and the more rightist Union Democrata Independiente (UDI).

zh: 到目前为止一切照旧：此次大选的主要挑战者和以往一样，仍然是民主革新党和独立民主联盟，这两党的主要区别在于对待同为其母党的军政府的态度不同（民主革新党更注重自我批评 ） 。
en: So far, nothing new: the RN and the UDI – which differ mainly in their attitude towards the military government from which they emerged (the RN being the more self-critical) – have been the main challengers in all the previous elections.

zh: 但是变化正在发生，这次大选出现了一名没有传统政党支持的36岁标新立异的候选人。
en: But change is coming, in the form of a 36-year-old maverick with no traditional-party backing.

zh: Marco Enríquez-Ominami在最新民调中获得了20%的选民支持，这与弗雷非常接近（弗雷的支持率约为26 % ） ，离皮涅拉约38%的支持率差距也不算太大。
en: Marco Enríquez-Ominami, with about 20% support in recent polls, is remarkably close to Frei (around 26%), and not terribly far from Piñera (roughly 38%).

zh: 这位年轻候选人出人意料的公众支持仍然植根于执政联盟：他的养父是知名的社会党参议员（而他的生父则是20世纪70年代被皮诺切特政治警察杀害的一名革命左翼领袖 ） 。
en: The young candidate’s unexpected popular support is rooted within the ruling coalition: his adoptive father is a prominent Socialist senator (his biological father, a leader of the revolutionary left in the 1970’s, was killed by Pinochet’s political police).

zh: Marco本人曾被推选为社会党候选代表，但在一次社会党不批准他与弗雷竞争之后他脱离了社会党。
en: Marco himself was elected deputy on the Socialist ticket, but he defected when the party denied him the chance to contest Frei’s nomination in a primary.

zh: Enríquez-Ominami同时具备了圈内人的知识和圈外人的身份，还有两大主要候选人所缺少的新鲜与活力，因此他比多数观察家预测的走得更远。
en: With this unique mix of insider knowledge and outsider status, and a freshness that both main candidates lack, Enríquez-Ominami has gone farther than most observers predicted.

zh: 皮涅拉的领先和Enríquez-Ominami的崛起或许是同一现象的不同表现：那就是来自基督教民主社会联盟内部，以及民众对于基督教民主社会联盟的厌倦。
en: Piñera’s lead and the emergence of Enríquez-Ominami are probably expressions of the same phenomenon: fatigue with – and within – the Concertación .

zh: 尽管20世纪90年代以来胜果累累，而且现任总统（社会党员米歇尔·巴切莱特，智利的首位女性行政长官）的支持率很高，但时间正在给社会联盟带来麻烦。
en: Despite its many successes since 1990, and the high popularity of the current president (Socialist Michelle Bachelet, Chile’s first female chief executive), time is taking a toll.

zh: 近年来，已经从执政党分裂出了几大集团。
en: In recent years, several groups have split from the incumbent parties.

zh: 许多选民也如法炮制，主要支持Enríquez-Ominami。
en: Many voters are following suit, drawn mainly to Enríquez-Ominami.

zh: 弗雷暗淡的支持数字反映了他自身的弱点（众所周知他毫无个人魅力，是连续四任基督教民主社会联盟总统中受欢迎程度最差的一个 ） ， 以及连续二十年的不间断执政给执政联盟所造成的压力。
en: Frei’s lackluster numbers reflect his own weaknesses (he is notoriously uncharismatic and was the least popular of the four Concertación presidents), as well as the inevitable stress that two decades of uninterrupted rule has placed on the ruling coalition.

zh: 从目前的情况看，右翼可能赢得首轮选举，但得票率不到一半。
en: As things stand now, the right is likely to win the first round, but with less than 50%.

zh: 甚至连皮涅拉的轻松获胜都可能在1月17日的决选中遭到逆转，因为弗雷和Enríquez-Ominami实际上致使中左翼力量的得票趋于分散。
en: Even a comfortable Piñera victory could be reversed on the January 17th run-off, as Frei and Enríquez-Ominami are essentially splitting the center-left vote.

zh: Enríquez-Ominami有能力也有意愿在决选中取代弗雷，但他击败皮涅拉可能比较困难。
en: Enríquez-Ominami has the popularity and momentum to displace Frei from the run-off, but he may have a harder time defeating Piñera.

zh: 因此，最有可能出现的局面是政府得以延续或者出现可以预期的改变（人们预期右翼势力将在未来若干年内把持总统一职 ） 。
en: The two most likely scenarios, then, are government continuity or predictable change (the right has been expected to capture the presidency for years).

zh: 但第三种局面 — — 即Enríquez-Ominami获胜后可预测程度较低的改变 — — 也不能完全排除，因为11月13日起才开始刊登媒体竞选广告。
en: But a third scenario – less predictable change following a victory by Enríquez-Ominami – should not be ruled out, as campaign advertisements will appear in the media only starting November 13.

zh: 但从智利主要政策的角度，即便Enríquez-Ominami最终获胜，持续性几乎仍将肯定成为主旋律。
en: In terms of Chile’s major policies, however, continuity is almost certain to prevail, even if Enríquez-Ominami wins.

zh: （在1988年公民投票中）击败皮诺切特（并在1989年大选中击败其总统候选人）的中左翼联盟十分明智，他们坚持并在某些情况下深化了从军政府那里承袭下来的有效的自由市场政策。
en: The center-left coalition that defeated Pinochet (in a 1988 plebiscite and his presidential candidate in the 1989 election) has been wise enough to keep, and in some cases deepen, the sound free-market policies inherited from the military government.

zh: 智利实行规范的财政和货币管理、拥有非常开放的经济和充满活力的私有部门。
en: Chile boasts orthodox fiscal and monetary management, a very open economy, and a dynamic private sector.

zh: 它也是世界第一个实现养老体系完全私有化的国家，这项政策探索的实行者是皮诺切特下属的一位技术专家（此人碰巧是皮涅拉的兄弟乔昔 ） ， 并且从那以后一直延续至今。
en: It was also the first country in the world to adopt a fully private pension system, a policy experiment carried out by one of Pinochet’s technocrats (who happened to be Piñera’s brother, José) and largely kept in place since then.

zh: 上述政策受到选民的欢迎，并且拥有实力派人物（例如出口导向的强大商务部门）和与世界几乎所有主要经济体和区域集团贸易协议的保障。
en: These policies are popular with voters, and they are protected by powerful actors (for example, the strong export-oriented business sector) and by trade agreements with almost all the world’s major economies and regional blocs.

zh: 和20世纪90年代自由化改革后发生民粹主义回潮的许多拉美国家不同，智利的主要挑战者甚至是更加坚定的市场联盟。
en: Unlike many Latin American countries, in which populist backlashes have followed the liberalizing reforms of the 1990’s, the main challenger in Chile is an even more pro-market coalition.

zh: 除经济领域外，当然还有其他许多存在分歧的领域。
en: Beyond the economy, there are, of course, many areas of disagreement.

zh: 基督教民主社会联盟一直审慎地对待独裁政权的政治遗产，逐步的废除皮诺切特赖以保护自身、军队和右翼的自利条款，并且在起诉侵犯人权方面取得了某些进展。
en: The Concertación has dealt prudently with the political legacies of the dictatorship, gradually rescinding the self-serving rules that Pinochet created to protect himself, the military, and the right, and making some progress in prosecuting human rights violators.

zh: 可许多人仍然不满：极端左翼势力 — — 虽然今天不甚强大但却有着重要的政治传统 — — 要求在诉讼领域取得更多更快的进步，同时倔强的右翼反对派坚持要求皮诺切特应当受到民族英雄般的对待。
en: But many are not happy: the far left – not very strong these days but with an important political tradition – wants more and faster progress on prosecutions, while the recalcitrant right insists on treating Pinochet (who died in 2006) as a national hero.

zh: 道德、种族和环境事务同样遵循类似的意识形态准则。
en: Moral, ethnic, and environmental issues follow similar ideological lines.

zh: 但与智利更为两级分明的邻国如阿根廷、玻利维亚和委内瑞拉相比，政策辩论的范围相对狭窄，态度也更加温和。
en: And yet the range of the policy debate is much narrower, and the tone more amiable, than is the case in Chile’s more polarized neighbors, such as Argentina, Bolivia, and Venezuela.

zh: 无论发生哪一种可能的情况：政策延续或者审慎变化，甚至于“外部”候选人在大选中获胜，智利十有八九都会在这个经常发生政治和经济动荡的地区内，继续充当民主稳定、经济活力和国际友谊的灯塔。
en: In either of the most probable scenarios, continuity or prudent change, or even if the “outsider” candidate wins, Chile will in all likelihood remain a beacon of democratic stability, economic dynamism, and international engagement in a region too often characterized by political and economic turbulence.

zh: 智利决定路线方针
en: Chile Stays the Course

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯 — — 随着预定于 3 月 11 日 继任的偏保守派巨头 塞巴斯蒂安·皮涅拉在不久前当选总统，智利注定会经历不同政党间的权力轮换，这一过程被某些政治学家视为向民主政体成功转折的必要步骤。
en: BUENOS AIRES – When Sebastián Piñera – the moderately conservative tycoon who was recently elected president – takes office on March 11, Chile will experience what some political scientists consider a watershed in every successful transition to democracy: the rotation of power among political parties.

zh: 在 奥古斯托·皮诺切特将军的独裁政权 1990 年被民主政权取代后，中左翼执政联盟连续四次在自由公正的总统竞选中获胜。
en: After General Augusto Pinochet’s dictatorship gave way to democracy in 1990, the center-left coalition known as the Concertación won four consecutive free and fair presidential contests.

zh: 长达 20 年的执政生涯结束后，它现在会把权力交给皮涅拉的 争取变革联盟 , 该联盟由中右翼的 民主革新党 和更加保守的 独立民主联盟 联合组成。
en: After 20 years in office, it will now cede power to Piñera´s Coalición por el Cambio , composed of his center-right Renovación Nacional and the more conservative Union Demócrata Independiente .

zh: 执政联盟 的长期执政反映出它作为政党的成功。
en: The long rule of the Concertación reflected its success.

zh: 在从政治稳定到经济发展再到扶贫的所有领域，智利在过去 20 年中的成绩都十分卓著，无疑远好于它的拉美邻国。
en: In almost all areas, from political stability to economic development to poverty alleviation, Chile has done very well over the past two decades, certainly much better than its Latin American neighbors.

zh: 右翼反对派不得不解决在不被与皮诺切特血腥政权关系所沾染的前提下，击败一直坚持实行皮诺切特最成功政策（主要包括自由市场、出口导向型经济模式）的联盟的难题。
en: The rightist opposition had to solve the puzzle of defeating a coalition that had maintained Pinochet’s most successful policies (mainly the free-market, export-oriented economic model) without being tainted (as many Coalición leaders are) by links to his bloody regime.

zh: 皮涅拉得益于他本人对于军政府的批评立场，同样得益于宣传其联盟自由面远多于保守面的竞选活动。
en: Piñera benefited from his own critical stance towards the military government, and from an electoral campaign that emphasized the liberal much more than the conservative aspects of his coalition.

zh: 皮涅拉并没有依靠替皮诺切特辩白来迎合传统的天主教价值观，而是提出了中庸的改革路线，包括赋予同性恋者更多权利和加强对社会问题的关注（智利甚至在长达 25 年的强劲增长之后，不平等现象依然非常严重 ） 。
en: Instead of vindicating Pinochet and appealing to traditional Catholic values, Piñera offered a centrist vision of change that included more rights for homosexuals and an emphasis on social issues (in a country that, even after 25 years of strong growth, remains very unequal).

zh: 执政联盟自身的问题也辅助了皮涅拉的成功。 代表执政联盟参选的基督教民主党候选人爱德华多·弗雷是过去 20 年间智利四任总统中受欢迎程度最低的一个。
en: Piñera’s victory was aided by the sclerosis of the Concertación, which ran as its candidate the Christian Democrat Eduardo Frei, the least popular of its four presidents of the last two decades.

zh: （颇受欢迎的现任社会党总统 米歇尔·巴切莱特不能再合法地谋求连任。
en: (The current and popular Socialist president, Michelle Bachelet, could not legally run for reelection.)

zh: ）更糟糕的是，在社会党否决了年轻代表马克·恩里克斯－大南与弗雷在初选中的竞争资格后，恩里克斯以独立候选人身份启动了相当成功的竞选活动，从第一轮开始就分流了执政联盟的票数。
en: Even worse, after the Socialist Party denied a young deputy, Marco Enríquez-Ominami, the possibility to compete in a primary against Frei, Enríquez launched a quite successful independent candidacy, which split the Concertación vote in the first round.

zh: 如果在内部实行更多民主并对领导人实行优胜劣汰，那么执政联盟可能已经第五次连任成功。
en: With more internal democracy and some renewal in its leadership, the ruling alliance might have secured a fifth term.

zh: 皮涅拉会为智利带来多大变化？
en: How much change does Piñera represent for Chile?

zh: 首先让我们来关注一组数据：当选总统仅以极其微弱的优势（ 51.6 % ） 赢得了第二轮投票，而且在参议院的席位数仍低于执政联盟。
en: First, a look at the numbers: the president-elect won the second-round vote with only a slight popular majority (51.6%), and will have fewer seats than the Concertación in the Senate.

zh: 过去 20 年来一直统治智利政治的大致权力平衡将在皮涅拉的四年任期中得以延续：只有双方协商的修修补补才会成为可能。
en: The rough balance of power that has characterized Chilean politics over the past 20 years will continue during Piñera’s four-year term: only incremental, negotiated change will be possible.

zh: 此外，从实质性的观点来看，两大联盟间并没有那么大的不同（中间派别的皮涅拉和弗雷之间区别更不显著 ） 。
en: Moreover, at a substantive level there is not really that much difference between the two alliances (and even less between the centrist Piñera and Frei).

zh: 是的，商业部门、军队和教堂等传统上受右派把持的选区会发现新政府更对胃口，但几乎不可能出现朝着右翼方向的剧烈转折。
en: Yes, traditional constituencies of the right, such as the business sector, the military, and the Church, will find a somewhat more welcoming government, but a sharp rightward turn is unlikely.

zh: 皮涅拉可能的最具争议性的改革是寻求利润丰厚的大型国有铜业企业智利铜业公司的部分私有化。
en: The most controversial change that Piñera is likely to seek is the partial privatization of CODELCO, the huge and highly profitable state-owned copper company.

zh: 但即使这一政治冒险举动取得成功，他也不过是深化了由皮诺切特开创、并在执政联盟手中得以延续的经济模式。
en: But, even if this politically risky move succeeded, he would just be deepening the economic model started by Pinochet and followed by the Concertación .

zh: 外交政策方面，预计智利会对古巴独裁政权和委内瑞拉总统 乌戈·查韦斯采取更严厉的态度，并同时继续奉行与阿根廷和巴西友好往来及与玻利维亚就原有地区争端继续谈判的政策。
en: In foreign policy, Chile is expected to adopt a harsher stance towards the Cuban dictatorship and Venezuela’s President Hugo Chávez, while retaining the policy of integration with Argentina and Brazil, and of negotiation with Bolivia (over an old territorial dispute).

zh: 真正的变化可能实际发生在两大政治联盟的内部。
en: The real action may actually take place within the two political coalitions.

zh: 执政联盟早已存在的衰竭迹象在选举失败后进一步恶化。
en: Previous signs of exhaustion in the Concertación have worsened after the electoral defeat.

zh: 几名重要的执政党领导人已经辞职。
en: Several key party leaders have resigned.

zh: 规模最小的联盟党派（激进党）迅速与国会右翼势力达成了一致（尽管这项协议在紧随其后的政治丑闻爆出后又被迫取消 ） 。
en: The smallest of the alliance’s parties (the Radicals ) quickly negotiated a deal with the right in Congress (though it was canceled after the ensuing political scandal).

zh: 而 恩里克斯－大南很可能在损害执政联盟利益的基础上继续巩固他的新生势力。
en: And Enríquez-Ominami may continue to build his new force at the expense of the Concertación .

zh: 没有权力将不同派别融合在一起，随时可能触发其他各种紧张局势。
en: Other tensions may erupt without the unifying incentives of power.

zh: 随着军政府时期裂痕的修复和分裂左右翼势力的意识形态海洋变成可以通航的河流，各派别现在有可能进行联盟内部重组。
en: As the cleavages inherited from the military years fade and the ideological ocean that once separated left and right becomes a navigable river, there is potential for coalition reshuffling.

zh: 皮涅拉需要争取更多的国会票数，而阿根廷和巴西等其他多党派总统制民主政体的经验表明在任者很容易以政府职位为交换来吸引联盟合伙人。
en: Piñera needs more votes in Congress, and the experience of other multi-party presidential democracies such as Argentina and Brazil shows that it is not difficult for incumbents to attract coalition partners in exchange for government posts.

zh: 新的执政联盟内部也有可能出现紧张状况。
en: Tensions in the new ruling coalition are also possible.

zh: 皮涅拉已经表态要在任命内阁官员时强调技术能力，将更多机会留给年轻人。
en: Piñera has said that he will emphasize technical competence in his cabinet appointments, with a bias towards the young.

zh: 对于传统的右翼政治人士来讲这可能不是个好消息，为了拥有执政机会他们已经苦苦等待了二十年之久。
en: This may bode ill for traditional politicians of the right who have been waiting two decades for a chance in office.

zh: 但有一种因素可能将所有因素联系在一起：巴切莱特有权而且可能在 2013 － 2014 年再次竞选总统。
en: One factor, however, may hold everything together: Bachelet can and may run again for president in 2013-2014.

zh: 她在民众中的威望，再加上联盟执政可能产生的后果，可能会使执政联盟不久前的惜败转化成为未来的胜利。
en: Her popularity, plus the toll that holding office might take on the Coalición , could turn the Concertación’s recent narrow defeat into a future victory.

zh: 这种希望为联盟党派提供了继续合作的动力。
en: This prospect gives incentives for both alliances to stay together.

zh: 黄金时代曙光微现
en: Silver Linings for a Golden Age

zh: 新加坡—全球稳定与繁荣的前景在改善还是在恶化？
en: SINGAPORE – Are prospects for global stability and prosperity improving or deteriorating?

zh: 很难说，世界上有的部分在启蒙和进步，有的部分在倒退和停滞。
en: With enlightenment and progress in some parts of the world accompanied by atavism and stagnation elsewhere, this is not an easy question.

zh: 但为了回答这个问题，考虑其他三个问题是大有裨益的。
en: But we can gain greater purchase on it by considering three other questions.

zh: 第一个问题是美国能否重新赢得道德领袖地位。
en: The first is whether the United States will regain its standing as a source of moral leadership.

zh: 尽管错误百出，自二战结束以来美国确实在道德方面起到了领导作用。
en: Despite its flaws, America did provide such leadership, beginning at the end of World War II.

zh: 但2001年9月11日的恐怖袭击改变了一切。
en: But the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, changed everything.

zh: 受到袭击的美国人怒不可遏，以至于开始支持曾经认为不可想象的政策。
en: Americans’ anger following the attacks drove them to support policies that they once would have considered inconceivable.

zh: 在“全球反恐战争”的名义下，他们容忍了虐待，接受 — — 甚至支持 — — 对伊拉克的非法入侵；并放任平民成为无人机空袭的附带受害者。
en: In the name of the “global war on terror,” they have tolerated torture; accepted – and even endorsed – the illegal invasion of Iraq; and allowed innocent civilians to become collateral damage of mechanical drone strikes.

zh: 为了重塑美国的道德领导力，总统奥巴马必须兑现他曾经说过的话，真正给受压迫的人民带去曙光 — — 如他在就任总统早期在伊斯坦布尔和开罗说的那样。
en: In order to restore America’s moral leadership, President Barack Obama must make good on his early rhetoric – exemplified in his speeches in Istanbul and Cairo early in his presidency – which demonstrated genuine regard for the oppressed.

zh: 2007年，在第一次竞选总统期间，他写道，美国“不能从世界中抽身，也不能让世界屈膝于己。
en: In 2007, during his first presidential campaign, he wrote that America “can neither retreat from the world nor try to bully it into submission.

zh: 我们必须领导世界，用作为和榜样领导世界。 ”
en: We must lead the world, by deed and by example.”

zh: 但奥巴马无法独自完成这一点 — — 而如今，美国公众和美国国会似乎都没有依照道德指南针所知的方向前进。
en: But Obama cannot do it alone – and, so far, neither the American public nor the US Congress seems committed to reconnecting with its moral compass.

zh: 有些事情本应是不可接受的，比如，国会否决了国家安全官员委员会的释放86位关塔那摩囚犯的决定。
en: It should be unacceptable, for example, for Congress to block the release of 86 Guantánamo Bay detainees cleared by a committee of national-security officials.

zh: 就连前情报承包商斯诺登曝光没人能摆脱美国的监控也没有让美国人站出来要求变换方式。
en: Not even the revelations by former intelligence contractor Edward Snowden that no one is exempt from the possibility of US surveillance have stirred Americans to demand a new approach.

zh: 第二个决定世界未来的问题是中国是否能够重新获得经济动力。 对这个问题的回答似乎也是“否 ” ， 至少在短期是如此，因为大部分专家都同意，中国出口和投资导向的增长模式已经耗尽了潜力。
en: The answer to the second major question shaping the world’s future – whether China will regain its economic momentum – also appears to be “no,” at least in the short term, with most experts agreeing that China’s export- and investment-led growth model has all but exhausted its potential.

zh: 事实上，在其主要需求源 — — 美国和欧洲 — — 萎靡不振、其自身劳动力成本开始上升的情况下，中国无法继续依赖制造业出口。
en: Indeed, China cannot continue to rely on manufacturing exports when its major sources of demand – the US and Europe – are struggling and its labor costs are rising.

zh: 类似地，中国政府不能再将资源浪费在导致工业产能过剩和地方政府债务高企的经济刺激计划上。
en: Likewise, China’s government cannot continue to waste resources on economic-stimulus packages that have led to industrial overcapacity and skyrocketing local-government debt.

zh: 中国也不能让臃肿的国有企业成为迈向更市场化、更高效、更创新的经济的拦路虎。
en: And China cannot move toward a more market-oriented, efficient, and innovative economy with bloated state-owned enterprises blocking the way.

zh: 中国是否能在后危机时代背景下发展并实施可行的新经济增长模式取决于习近平主席和李克强总理能否接过邓小平和朱镕基的枪。
en: Whether China can develop and implement a viable new economic-growth model in post-crisis conditions depends on whether President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Keqiang can revive the legacy of their predecessors, Deng Xiaoping and Zhu Rongji.

zh: 换句话说，中国的未来 — — 以及全球经济的未来 — — 取决于中国领导人有多大决心克服既得利益、追求全面的结构性和政策改革。
en: In other words, China’s future – and that of the global economy – depends on how committed its leaders are to overcoming vested interests and pursuing comprehensive structural and policy reform.

zh: 许多西方人认为（甚至希望）中国在经济转型方面无法获得成功。 习近平和李克强敏锐地认识到了此前增长模式的不可持续性 — — 以及改变这一模式所隐含的挑战。
en: While many in the West contend (and perhaps hope) that China will not succeed in transforming its economy, Xi and Li are acutely aware of the previous growth model’s unsustainability – and the challenges that changing it will entail.

zh: 比如，李克强在3月份说，实施必须的市场改革将是痛苦的，甚至有断腕之痛。
en: For example, in March, Li said that implementing the needed market reforms “will be very painful, and even feel like cutting one’s wrist.”

zh: 习近平和李克强均表示政府准备好了接受更缓慢的短期GDP增长，以换取更坚挺、更可持续的经济。
en: And both Xi and Li have indicated the government’s willingness to tolerate slower GDP growth in the short term for the sake of building a stronger, more sustainable economy.

zh: 最后一个问题是欧洲和日本能否恢复它们的“动物精神 ” 。
en: The final question is whether Europe and Japan will recover their “animal spirits.”

zh: 当前欧洲萎靡不振，而日本所谓的“安倍经济学”的影响也将逐渐消失，很难认为几十年来对全球产出增长推波助澜的欧洲和日本经济能够重获从前的活力。
en: Given Europe’s current malaise and the waning impact of so-called “Abenomics” in Japan, it is difficult to believe that their economies, which fueled global output growth for several decades, will regain their former stature.

zh: 事实上，很多欧洲人和日本人早已放弃了这一幻想。
en: Indeed, Europeans and Japanese have largely given up hope of doing so.

zh: 尽管欧盟领导人设法维持了欧元区，但他们缺少将经济带出泥淖的长期战略。
en: Although European Union leaders have managed to keep the eurozone intact, they lack a long-term strategy to lift their economies out of the doldrums.

zh: 欧洲局面的严重性表现在越来越多的人开始接受西班牙和希腊等某些欧盟国家目前所面临的的高失业 — — 以及超过50%的年轻人失业率。
en: The seriousness of Europe’s situation is reflected in growing acceptance of the high unemployment – and youth-unemployment rates of over 50% – that some EU countries, including Spain and Greece, now face.

zh: 与此同时，日本首相安倍晋三的经济计划的前两支“箭 ” — —大规模货币政策宽松和增加政府支出 — — 似乎给该国长期停滞的经济带来了一点动力。
en: Meanwhile, the first two “arrows” of Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s economic program – radical monetary-policy easing and increased government spending – seem to have given the country’s long-stagnant economy a lift.

zh: 但第三支也是最重要的一支箭 — — 结构性改革 — — 目前为止效果极为有限。
en: But the third and most important arrow – structural reform – has so far had little impact.

zh: 而在经历了二十多年的政治混乱和经济停滞后，日本公众对官员关于经济复兴的承诺已经不太信任。
en: And, after more than two decades of political turmoil and economic decline, the Japanese public has become skeptical of official promises of economic revival.

zh: 幸运的是，美国和中国的经济仍有充满活力、能量和希望的社会的支撑。
en: Fortunately, the US and Chinese economies are underpinned by societies that remain dynamic, vibrant, and hopeful.

zh: 其他亚洲国家的年轻人，特别是印度和东盟十国，也相当乐观 — — 理应如此。
en: Young people in other parts of Asia, especially India and the ten ASEAN countries, are similarly optimistic – as well they should be.

zh: 据估计，在未来数年，亚洲中产阶级人数将迎来爆发性增长，从2010年的5亿增加到2020年的17.5亿。
en: Asia’s middle-class population is expected to experience explosive growth in the coming years, rising from 500 million people in 2010 to 1.75 billion in 2020.

zh: 拥有十亿人口的非洲也在赢得经济动力，为全球中产阶级的扩张贡献着力量。 据估计，全球中产阶级人数将从2010年的18亿增加到2020年的32亿和2030年的49亿（超过总人口的一半 ） 。
en: Africa, with its population of one billion, is also gaining economic momentum, contributing further to the rapid expansion of the global middle class, which is expected to surge from 1.8 billion in 2010 to 3.2 billion in 2020 and to 4.9 billion people – more than half of the world’s population – in 2030.

zh: 尽管叙利亚、索马里、埃及、阿富汗等国家目前面临着诸多重大挑战，全球也面临着食品安全和气候变化等挑战，世界仍有理由对未来充满希望。
en: Despite the massive challenges that countries like Syria, Somalia, Egypt, and Afghanistan currently face, and global challenges like food security and climate change, the world has reason to be hopeful about the future.

zh: 尽管今天的情况悲惨可怕，但我们仍有可能正在步入人类历史的新的黄金时代。
en: Notwithstanding today’s tragic and terrifying headlines, we may be entering a new golden age of human history.

zh: 中国的新皇帝
en: China’s New Emperor

zh: 香港—关于1972年美国总统尼克松访华有一则趣闻，中国领导人一直把它当做长期胜利的证明。
en: HONG KONG – An anecdote about US President Richard Nixon’s visit to China in 1972 has long been regarded as confirmation of the long view of history taken by Chinese leaders.

zh: 据说，毛泽东的忠实副手周恩来在回答关于法国大革命的问题时说，现在下结论为时过早。
en: Zhou Enlai, Mao’s dutiful number two, is said to have responded to a question about the lessons of the French Revolution by saying that it was too soon to tell.

zh: 事实上，据在场外交官说，周恩来讨论的并不是1789年大革命，而是1968年法国学生动乱，因此也许确实是现在下结论为时过早。
en: In fact, according to diplomats who were there, Zhou was discussing not the revolution of 1789, but the 1968 student uprising in Paris, so it probably really was too soon to tell.

zh: 始于这个错误的开始，法国大革命的教训在中国引起了反响。
en: After this false start, lessons from the French Revolution have made a comeback in China.

zh: 2012年中共十八大召开后不久，据说托克维尔写于1856年的著作《旧制度与大革命》成为中共高级干部的“必读书 ” 。
en: Shortly after the 18th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party in 2012, it was reported that Alexis de Tocqueville’s The Old Regime and the Revolution, written in 1856, had become a “must-read” for senior CCP cadres.

zh: 习近平主席的反腐运动负责人、可能也是他的最亲密盟友的王岐山竭力宣传这部著作的好处。
en: The book’s merits were most enthusiastically touted by Wang Qishan, the man at the helm of President Xi Jinping’s anti-corruption campaign and perhaps Xi’s closest ally.

zh: 托克维尔说，十八世纪法国的不断增长的繁荣实际上使得治理国家变得更加困难。
en: Toqueville argued that growing prosperity in eighteenth-century France had actually made it more difficult to govern the country.

zh: 随着人民变得更加富裕，他们也更加关注社会和经济不平等，从而更加仇恨富人和贵人。
en: As people became wealthier, they also became more aware of social and economic inequalities and thus increasingly resentful of the rich and powerful.

zh: 改革制度的尝试只是让这一脆弱性暴露无遗。
en: Attempts to reform the system only highlighted its vulnerabilities.

zh: 革命随之而来，君主和贵族被扫荡一空，人头落地。
en: Revolution followed, sweeping away the monarchy and aristocracy. Their heads literally rolled.

zh: 刚刚结束的中共十九大表明中国领导人深刻领会了托克维尔的洞见。
en: The CCP’s just-completed 19th National Congress showed the extent to which China’s leaders have taken Toqueville’s insights to heart.

zh: 习近平树立了他在党和国家的绝对权威。
en: Xi asserted his undisputed authority over his party and country.

zh: 习近平在第一个任期中，通过推倒许多邓小平的遗产（包括经济开放、党与政府分离，以及低调的外交和安全政策等 ） ， 巩固了他的地位。
en: Xi consolidated his position during his first term, by reversing much of Deng Xiaoping’s legacy, including the opening of China’s economy, the separation of the CCP from government, and a low-key approach to foreign and security policy.

zh: 习近平还扫清了潜在对手，这主要通过用深入的反腐运动拿下此前认为不可撼动的官员实现。
en: Xi has also swept aside potential rivals, relying primarily on his far-reaching anti-corruption campaign to target officials previously thought to be untouchable.

zh: 他刚刚主持了中共中央委员会规模最大的清洗运动。
en: He has just overseen the largest-ever purge of the CCP Central Committee.

zh: 他镇压哪怕最克制的批评或异见迹象，甚至禁止网络笑话，包括将他比作维尼熊的“段子 ” 。
en: He has cracked down on even the most restrained criticism or signs of dissent, and has even banned Internet jokes, including memes comparing him to Winnie the Pooh.

zh: 在别的国家，这样的手段可能会引起严厉批评，指责习近平将中国变成了老派列宁主义独裁。
en: In another country, such measures might trigger harsh reproach, with critics accusing Xi of turning his country into an old-school Leninist dictatorship.

zh: 但在中国，这些手段受到了观察者的赞美，他们认为习近平是实现国家复兴的“中国梦”的领路人。
en: In China, however, they have drawn praise from observers who believe that Xi is leading the way to the fulfillment of the “Chinese dream” to rejuvenate the country.

zh: 但一些人看来，这个梦眼看就要变成一场噩梦。
en: But, for some, the dream is on the verge of becoming a nightmare.

zh: 人口趋势正在以前所未有的速度将过去几十年中推动中国高速增长的劳动力盈余转变为劳动力短缺。
en: Demographic trends are threatening to turn the labor surplus that helped drive China’s rapid growth over the last few decades into a labor shortage at an unprecedented pace.

zh: 水污染和匮乏，以及二氧化碳排放和致命的污染水平，正在威胁人民的健康，制约中国经济表现的可持续性。
en: Water contamination and scarcity, alongside carbon dioxide emissions and lethal levels of air pollution, are imperiling people’s health and jeopardizing the sustainability of China’s economic performance.

zh: 此外，中国的GDP增长尽管值得庆贺，主要受迅速膨胀的债务和蔓延的房地产泡沫的合力的推动。
en: Moreover, Chinese GDP growth, while welcome, is being fueled largely by a combination of fast-rising debt and widespread property bubbles.

zh: 甚至中国研究者也承认，他们的国家的收入不平等性位居世界最高之列。
en: Even Chinese researchers admit that their country has one of the highest levels of income inequality in the world.

zh: 随着穷者愈穷、富者愈富，许多人证遭拷问这是不是“中国特色社会主义”的真正含义。
en: As the poor get poorer and the rich get richer, many are asking if this is what “socialism with Chinese characteristics” really means.

zh: 当然，永远会有乐观派提供积极的信号。
en: Of course, there is always an optimist around to offer a positive spin.

zh: 中国的大部分债务是自己欠自己，因为政治重点和商业考虑一样，都是引导借贷的决定因素。
en: China owes most of its debt to itself, because political priorities guide lending as much as commercial considerations do.

zh: 中国支持解决环境恶化和气候变化的国际措施。
en: China supports international efforts to address environmental degradation and climate change.

zh: 大部分人生活越来越好，尽管程度各不相同。
en: Most people are becoming better off, if unevenly.

zh: 并且习近平的政府至少对于党内的腐败顽疾有所动作。
en: And Xi’s administration is at least doing something to stamp out the endemic corruption in the CCP.

zh: 但愿这些欢呼者提出的东西中至少有一些是真的；如果中国增长崩溃，整个全球经济都将跟着遭殃。
en: We should all hope that at least some of what China’s cheerleaders say is true; if Chinese growth collapses, the entire global economy will suffer.

zh: 但是，即便乐观派有一些道理，习近平所宣称的中国已经找到了一条更好的社会和经济现代化之路也似乎难以令人信服。
en: But, even if the optimists are partly vindicated, Xi’s claim that China has found a better way to run a modern society and economy seems far wide of the mark.

zh: 诚然，从昏庸滑稽的美国总统特朗普，到欧洲民粹民族主义的破坏性崛起，民主国家也在经历各自的“审判 ” 。
en: To be sure, from the stupefying antics of US President Donald Trump to the damaging rise of populist nationalism in Europe, democratic countries are experiencing their share of trials.

zh: 但民主制度有其内在稳定机制，能够在不需要暴力和镇压的情况下纠正自我。
en: But democratic systems have built-in stabilizing mechanisms that enable them to right themselves without resorting to violence or repression.

zh: 而习近平的中国并非如此。
en: That is not the case in Xi’s China.

zh: 多年来，在中国国内，关于国家在经济中的合适角色问题存在激烈的争论。
en: For years, there was a serious debate in China about the state’s proper role in economic affairs.

zh: 一拨人坚持认为，如果中共放松对经济的掌控，就会不可避免地失去对国家的掌控。
en: One camp maintained that if the CCP relaxed its grip on the economy, it would inevitably lose control of the state.

zh: 另一派认为正好相反：如果党不让出更多的经济控制权，就有可能失去政治权力，因为经济矛盾将成倍放大，发展也将不可持续。
en: Others argued just the opposite: unless the Party ceded more economic control, it would lose political power, as the economy’s contradictions multiplied and development became less sustainable.

zh: 习近平显然属于国家控制派。
en: Xi clearly falls into the statist camp.

zh: 但习近平不仅仅在给党赋权；他也在给他自己赋权。
en: But it is not just the Party that Xi is empowering; he is also empowering himself.

zh: 事实上，很难获知谁在接近制高点，谁会因为与最高领袖存在分歧而下台。
en: In fact, it is hard to know who is ascending the CCP’s commanding heights and who will be struck down for disagreeing with the paramount leader.

zh: 这并没有阻止外部人士的猜测，但这场猜谜游戏没有什么玩的意义。
en: This hasn’t deterred outsiders from speculating, but there is not much point in playing that guessing game.

zh: 和其他皇帝一样，习近平将继续任命唯他马首是瞻的朝臣。
en: Xi, like any other emperor, will continue to appoint courtiers who follow him wherever he leads.

zh: 但随大权力一同到来的是大责任 — — 而就这一点而论，习近平的权力几乎是绝对的。
en: But with great power comes great responsibility – and, at this point, Xi’s power is virtually absolute.

zh: 这对一个人来说是沉重的负担。
en: That is a heavy burden for one man.

zh: 习近平也许比特朗普聪明得多（特朗普并不是一个难以清除的障碍 ） ， 但这并不足以保证中国能获得稳定繁荣的未来。
en: Xi may be much smarter than Trump (not a high hurdle to clear), but that is not enough to guarantee a stable and prosperous future for China.

zh: 而一旦出现任何不妙的迹象，所有人都知道把矛头指向谁。
en: And, if things go wrong, everyone will know whom to blame.

zh: 这就是独裁往常总是走向同样的结局的原因。
en: There is a reason why dictatorial dynasties tend to end up the same way.

zh: 你不需要阅读托克维尔就能明白这一点。
en: You don’t have to read Toqueville to know that.

zh: 登堂入室的中国新奇迹创造者
en: Empowering China’s New Miracle Workers

zh: 发自米兰 — — 在中共十九大会议期间，外界的焦点大都放在了习近平政府关键位置的人事任命之上。
en: MILAN – As the Chinese Communist Party’s 19th National Congress has unfolded, much of the focus has been on who will occupy the key positions in President Xi Jinping’s administration for the next five years.

zh: 但是中国的未来发展轨迹其实在很大程度上取决于另外一批受关注较少的领导者：那些执行与中国经济改革和转型相关具体任务的技术官员们。
en: But China’s future trajectory depends crucially on another group of leaders, who have received far less attention: the technocrats who will carry out the specific tasks associated with China’s economic reform and transformation.

zh: 在过去四十年来，中国技术官员们集体推动了一场奇迹般的转型。
en: Over the last four decades, China’s technocrats have collectively engineered a miraculous transformation.

zh: 目前这代极具天赋的决策者团体将在2018年3月左右下台，将指挥棒传给新一代。
en: The current generation, a gifted group of policymakers, will step down in or around March 2018, passing the baton to a new generation.

zh: 新一代人 — — 受过高等教育，经验丰富，而且在很大程度上都是依靠自身的努力取得的成就 — — 正准备以高超的施政技巧和奉献精神来推动中国的经济和社会进步。
en: That generation – highly educated, experienced, and, for the most part, successful on their own merits – is prepared to carry China’s economic and social progress forward with great skill and dedication.

zh: 而问题在于是否能有一个开放的空间来让他们大展拳脚。
en: The question is whether they will have an open field on which to run.

zh: 有一点是肯定的：下一代的技术官员将面临与前辈不同的境况。
en: One thing is certain: the next generation of technocrats will face very different conditions from those confronted by their predecessors.

zh: 中国已经走到了一个充满极大不确定性的时刻。
en: China has reached a moment of significant uncertainty.

zh: 除了在队伍交接过程中存在的固有问题之外，习近平领导下的主导政策框架也出现了巨大的转变。
en: Beyond the questions inherent in the process of generational turnover, there has been a dramatic shift in China’s dominant policy framework under Xi.

zh: 在1978年发起激进式“改革开放”的邓小平治下，政策目标只有一个，就是国内经济的转型和增长，并通过包含了激烈内部讨论的协同决策模式来实现。
en: Under Deng Xiaoping – the leader who initiated China’s radical “reform and opening up” in 1978 – the singular policy goal was domestic economic transformation and growth, to be achieved with a collaborative decision-making model that included vigorous internal debate.

zh: 邓小平将中国明确排除在了更广泛的国际议程之外 — — 这也是中国决策者三十多年沿袭下来的教条。
en: Deng explicitly ruled out a broader international agenda for China – a dictate that China’s policymakers followed for more than three decades.

zh: 自2012年上台以来，习近平在几个关键方面改变了这一政策框架。
en: Since taking power in 2012, Xi has changed this policy framework in several key ways.

zh: 首先，他通过发起了一场史无前例且触及党内最高领导层的反贪运动来打击破坏中国共产党公信力（往大了说就是中国治理模式）的特有腐败现象。
en: For starters, he tackled the endemic corruption that had been undermining the credibility of the CCP (and, by extension, China’s governance model), by launching an unprecedented anti-graft campaign that reached the highest levels of the Party’s leadership.

zh: 许多人都认为习近平的反腐运动只是昙花一现，不过要为2013年第十八届三中全会宣布的积极经济改革铺平道路。
en: Many expected Xi’s anti-corruption campaign to be a temporary initiative, intended to pave the way for implementation of the aggressive economic reforms announced at the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee in 2013.

zh: 但如今反腐已经成为了习近平政府的一个鲜明特征。
en: Instead, the campaign has become essentially a permanent feature of Xi’s administration.

zh: 习近平认为政府的合法性在很大程度上是一个包含持续传递的多项价值观，经济和社会进步，以及严格承诺将公共利益放在治理形式之上的集合。
en: Xi believes that a government’s legitimacy is mainly a function of consistently delivered values, together with economic and social progress, with strict commitment to the public interest taking precedence over the form of governance.

zh: 虽然西方观察家很少能充分认识到这一观点，但过去十年来西方的发展 — — 2008年金融危机，收入和财富不平等状况的扩大以及不断加剧的政治上两极分化都强化了这一理念。
en: While few Western observers have fully recognized this perspective, developments in the West over the last ten years – the 2008 financial crisis, widening income and wealth inequality, and intensifying political polarization – have reinforced this mindset.

zh: 因此，中国领导人和民众比以往任何时候都更加坚信强大的一党执政政府是稳定和增长的重要支柱。
en: As a result, Chinese leaders and citizens are more convinced than ever that government by a strong single party is an essential pillar of stability and growth.

zh: 他们认为，西方对治理形式而非包容性经济和社会发展成果的关注是有误导性的，因为民主和专制制度都可能滋生腐败。
en: The focus in the West on the form of governance, as opposed to inclusive economic and social outcomes, is misguided, they believe, because both democratic and autocratic systems can be corrupted.

zh: 同时习近平的中国经济议程已经超越了对国内增长和发展的狭隘重视，转而涵盖一个力求扩大中国在全球经济（特别是在发展中国家）影响力的协同性工作。
en: Moreover, China’s economic agenda under Xi has expanded beyond its narrow focus on domestic growth and development to include a concerted effort to expand Chinese influence in the global economy, especially in the developing world.

zh: 这个宏大且不断扩展的外部议程在影响政策选择的同时也会催生对资源的需求 — — 成为非洲和中亚地区的主要外部投资者显然需要一大笔钱。
en: This broad and expanding external agenda generates claims on resources – you can’t be the dominant external investor in Africa and Central Asia without spending a lot of money – while influencing policy choices.

zh: 例如，包括银行在内的国有企业可能会比纯私营企业更灵活地处理公共/私人激励因素和投资回报的不同组合。
en: For example, state-owned enterprises, including banks, may respond more flexibly than purely private enterprises to a variable mix of public and private incentives and investment returns.

zh: 最后，近年来中国的政策框架越来越多地反映出长期下达的社会/政治维稳目标与更现代的市场自由化目标之间蕴含的紧张关系。
en: Finally, in recent years, China’s policy frameworks have increasingly reflected the inherent tension between the long-standing imperative of ensuring social and political stability and the more modern objective of market liberalization.

zh: 中国的领导层继续坚定不移地保护党的利益，因为在其眼中这是与全社会的利益是一致的。
en: China’s leadership remains steadfastly committed to protecting the Party’s interests, which it views as coterminous with those of society.

zh: 为此中国共产党继续把重点放在秩序维护上，并将价值观灌输到民众生活的方方面面，不仅积极主导政策辩论，在私营部门的活动和社会事务中也经常能看见党的身影。
en: For that reason, the CCP continues to focus on upholding order and instilling values in all aspects of Chinese life, maintaining an active presence not only in policy debates, but also in private-sector activities and social affairs.

zh: 与此同时，政府力图让市场在经济中发挥更为重要的作用，释放创业精神和创新力量，更有效地满足年轻化，教育程度较高且不断发展壮大的中产阶级的需求和愿望。
en: At the same time, the government is seeking to give markets a more decisive role in the economy, unleash the power of entrepreneurship and innovation, and respond more effectively to the needs and desires of a young, educated, and fast-growing middle class.

zh: 有理由认为这些内部引擎将使中国在全球经济相对疲软，结构转型和中等收入阶段转换遇阻的情况下实现6~7%的年均GDP增长。
en: And for good reason: these are the internal engines that have enabled China to achieve 6-7% annual GDP growth amid a difficult structural shift and middle-income transition, carried out in a relatively weak global economy.

zh: 这两个目标是否相互矛盾还很难说，但担心也不是毫无根据的。
en: It is hard to say for sure whether these two objectives are in direct conflict with each other.

zh: 虽然公共部门在基础研究等领域的决策确实能产生重大影响，但催生创新的动态性竞争毕竟跟集中指导的程序在本质上存在较大差异。
en: But there is reason for concern. The kind of dynamic competition that leads to innovation is, after all, far from a centrally guided process, though public-sector choices in areas like basic research do have a substantial impact.

zh: 此外，在政策制定和学术界，如果要把好想法和坏的区分开来，就必须展开积极的辩论。
en: Moreover, in both policymaking and academia, active debate is indispensable to sorting good ideas from bad ones.

zh: 虽然中国的体制已经证明了在训练有素和经验丰富的参与者（这些人的忠诚度毋庸置疑）之间进行高层次内部政策辩论然后迅速果断采取行动的能力，中国领导人仍然对不受约束的公开辩论和评论存有疑虑。
en: Yet while the Chinese system has proved its capacity for high-level internal policy debate among highly trained and experienced participants whose loyalty is not in question, and then act quickly and decisively, China’s leaders remain suspicious of unfettered public debate and commentary.

zh: 但是许多复杂的政策选择 — — 比如金融部门的改革和开放 — — 其实能够从扩大开放所赋予的去芜存菁过程中获益。
en: But many complex policy choices – for example, about financial-sector reform and opening up – would benefit from the winnowing process that greater openness affords.

zh: 在未来五年间，中国的成功将在很大程度上取决于政府能否打理好这一复杂议程及其营造的紧张态势。
en: Over the next five years, China’s success will depend largely on how well the government’s complex agenda, and the tensions it entails, are managed.

zh: 要达到目标，中国领导人将需要在一个负责制定标准和保护公众利益的强有力，富有纪律性且无所不在的党与推动经济进入未来的创新性，被赋予权利和充满潜力的市场之间实现精巧的平衡。
en: To achieve their objectives, China’s leaders will need to strike a delicate balance between a muscular, disciplined, and ubiquitous Party, setting standards and protecting the public interest, and innovative, empowered, and potent markets, driving the economy into the future.

zh: 富有远见的中国经济刺激政策
en: China’s Visionary Stimulus

zh: 发自上海 — — 在去年3月召开的第12届全国人大会议第一次会议上，时任国务院总理温家宝发表了他第十份也是最后一份《政府工作报告 》 。
en: SHANGHAI – In March of last year, the first session of China’s 12th National People’s Congress began with then-Premier Wen Jiabao delivering his tenth and final “report on the work of the government.”

zh: 当他宣读完报告全文时，与会的三千名代表向他报以热烈掌声；这不仅仅是出于例行礼节，更对温家宝作为中国国家政府领导人所取得成就的赞誉与致敬
en: When he had finished, the 3,000 representatives in attendance gave him a resounding ovation that was surely a response to more than the report; it was a display of praise and respect for his achievements as the head of China’s government.

zh: 然而自那以后，对温家宝领导能力 — — 尤其对其国家经济管理能力 — — 的评价就出现了极大分化。
en: Since then, however, assessments of Wen’s leadership – particularly his stewardship of the economy – have varied widely.

zh: 支持者们坚持认为是他从根本上推动了中国向民主制度和市场经济的转型，而反对者们则指责他未能兑现实现政治和经济改革的承诺。
en: Whereas Wen’s supporters remain adamant that he fundamentally supported a shift toward democracy and a market economy for China, his critics lambast him for failing to fulfill his promises of political and economic reform.

zh: 如今随着温家宝的继任者李克强开始尝试推动深层次体制改革，对前者政策决策的理解就显得尤为重要了。
en: As Wen’s successor, Li Keqiang, attempts to engineer deep systemic reforms, understanding Wen’s policy decisions could not be more relevant.

zh: 温家宝最具争议的经济政策就是其政府为应对2008年金融危机所实施的4万亿人民币（约合5860亿美元）刺激计划。
en: Wen’s most contentious economic policy was the CN¥4 trillion ($586 billion) stimulus package that his government launched in response to the 2008 financial crisis.

zh: 虽然该政策成功维持了中国的经济增长，但也因此受到了广泛指责，认为这是最终导致了货币过度扩张的一次过激反应。
en: Though the policy succeeded in buttressing China’s economic growth, it was widely criticized as an overreaction – one that led to excessive monetary expansion.

zh: 事实上，当时出现的银行贷款高速增长令中国的M2（衡量货币供应的广义数值）大幅飙升，从2008年相当于GDP的150%上升到如今的约200 % （ 超过100万亿人民币 ） 。
en: Indeed, the surge in bank loans caused China’s M2 (a broad measure of the money supply) to soar, from 150% of GDP in 2008 to some 200%, or more than CN¥100 trillion, today.

zh: 对中国经济大规模注入流动性不但催生了大量地产泡沫和过剩产能，也导致负债增加，地方政府和企业负债状况尤为严峻。
en: The massive injection of liquidity into China’s economy has contributed to rising debt, especially among local governments and firms, while fueling massive real-estate bubbles, and resulting in significant excess capacity.

zh: 在过去一年半以来，李克强领导下的中国政府都在着手通过深度调整中国行业结构，压低过剩产能，限制贷款数量，严控影子银行部门以及遏制房地产投资来应对上述挑战。
en: Over the last 18 months, Li’s government has been attempting to address these challenges, by overhauling China’s industrial structure, reducing excess production capacity, restricting lending, containing the shadow banking sector, and curbing real-estate investment.

zh: 虽然这些措施取得了一定成功，但也付出了牺牲经济增长的代价。
en: And he has had some success – at the expense of economic growth.

zh: 即便目前7%的经济增长令人满意，却也远低于2008年前所取得的双位数增长。
en: Though the current rate of 7% is comfortable, it is far lower than the double-digit rates that prevailed prior to 2008.

zh: 考虑到进一步调整经济结构的需要 — — 以及长期的人口构成变化趋势所导致的劳动力供应下降 — — 2008年前的增长率必将无法重现。
en: Given the need for further economic restructuring – and in view of long-term demographic trends, which will reduce the labor supply – pre-2008 growth rates are unlikely to be restored.

zh: 但对于李克强来说，结构转型和产业升级 — — 而非不可持续的信贷驱动型增长模式 — — 才是国家实现高收入阶段的关键，因此降速也是可以接受的。
en: This is fine with Li, who recognizes that structural transformation and industrial upgrading – not an unsustainable credit-led growth model – is the key to achieving high-income status.

zh: 然而对温家宝刺激政策的评估不应仅局限于增长与改革之间的权衡。
en: But there is more to assessing Wen’s stimulus than the growth/reform trade-off.

zh: 因为该政策同时也帮助扩大了中国的对外贸易并借助稳健的国际收支状况，巨额外汇储备和稳定的货币增强了自身外部金融实力，最终为李克强雄心勃勃的改革方案创造了空间。
en: The policy also helped to expand China’s foreign trade and boost its external financial strength (with a robust balance-of-payments position, large international reserves, and a stable currency), thereby creating space for Li to carry out his ambitious reform agenda.

zh: 与此同时，世界金融危机引发了全球资产相对价格的转换。
en: At the same time, the global financial crisis triggered a shift in the relative price of assets worldwide.

zh: 随着发达国家陷入债务危机，导致资产价格下跌和汇率下行，中国的国际购买力反而有所增强。
en: As developed countries were plunged into debt crises, with shrinking asset values and declining exchange rates, China’s international purchasing power grew.

zh: 这些再与温家宝的刺激政策相结合，就大大强化了中国的投资和金融实力。
en: This, together with Wen’s stimulus, bolstered China’s investment and financing capabilities considerably.

zh: 像新西兰或者秘鲁这些无法依赖发达国家实施出口的国家都与中国签订了双边自由贸易协定。
en: Countries like New Zealand and Peru, unable to depend on developed countries for export demand, signed bilateral free-trade agreements with China.

zh: 同时当发达国家削减自身对外投资规模之时，中国开始逐步向全球经济注入急需的资本。
en: Likewise, when developed countries cut back on their foreign investment, China stepped in to inject much-needed capital into the global economy.

zh: 事实上许多国家都已经开始寻求改善对华双边关系以获取中国资本。
en: In fact, many countries began to pursue improved bilateral relations with China, in order to gain access to its capital.

zh: 举个例子，当牙买加在1999年遭遇货币汇率急跌，失业率飙升以及由政府负债问题引发的严重银行风险时，其传统贸易伙伴美国和英国都拒绝出手相助，于是牙买加政府转而向中国求援，后者则提供了1.38亿美元贷款协助重振经济。
en: For example, in 2009, Jamaica was faced with a plummeting currency, surging unemployment, and considerable banking-sector risks stemming from exposure to government debt. When its traditional allies, the United States and the United Kingdom, rejected its pleas for help, it turned to China, which provided $138 million in loans to prop up the economy.

zh: 预计到明年，中国的年对外投资额将达到1000亿美元，与其投资流入额逐渐靠拢。
en: By next year, China’s outward investment is likely to reach over $100 billion annually – bringing it close to parity with inflows.

zh: 相信不用多久，中国就能实现从商品净出口国向资本净出口国的历史性转型。
en: It will not be long before China undergoes an historic shift from net merchandise exporter to net capital exporter.

zh: 但中国的对外金融举措并不会止步于此。
en: And China’s external financing activities do not end there.

zh: 在2009至2010年间中国也对国际货币基金组织进行了巨额投资 — — 中国人民银行在2009年宣布将购买高达320亿美元的特别提款权（国际货币基金组织的一种准货币 ） ， 相当于约500亿美元货币。
en: In 2009-2010, China also invested heavily in the International Monetary Fund, with the People’s Bank of China announcing in 2009 that it would buy up to 32 billion special drawing rights (the IMF’s quasi-currency) – the equivalent of about $50 billion.

zh: 在同一时期，中国签署了多项双边货币互换协议，提供了多笔政策性贷款和特别资助，并对区域性投资基金进行了注资。
en: Over the same period, China signed multiple bilateral currency-swap agreements, offered policy loans and special assistance, and contributed to regional investment funds.

zh: 在未来几年，中国与发展中国家的联系将进一步加深。
en: In the coming years, China’s engagement with the developing world will continue to deepen.

zh: 全国人大已经讨论拿出一部分外汇储备去资助发展中国家的基础设施建设。
en: The National People’s Congress has discussed using a portion of China’s foreign-exchange reserves to finance infrastructure projects in developing countries.

zh: 这样一个中国版的“马歇尔计划”将致力于增强发展中国家采购中国商品的能力，也能推动一个更广泛的发展议程。
en: Such a Chinese “Marshall Plan” could seek to strengthen developing countries’ capacity to absorb Chinese goods, or it could advance a broader development agenda.

zh: 一些中国央行官员甚至提出要建立一个超主权财富基金来执行发展中国家投资。
en: Some central-bank officials have even advocated the establishment of a supra-sovereign wealth fund for developing-country investment.

zh: 中国的持续发展需要其不断扩大对外援助的能力和影响力。
en: China’s continued development demands that it continues to enlarge its capacity and influence in foreign assistance.

zh: 全球金融危机极大加速了这一进程，迫使中国领导人自发地通过经济结构转型去寻求实现该进程。
en: The global economic crisis accelerated the timetable for this process considerably, forcing China’s leaders to pursue it simultaneously with the economy’s structural transformation.

zh: 在这个意义上，温家宝其实是为李克强创造了一个宝贵的开端。
en: In this respect, Wen gave Li an invaluable head start.

zh: 中国将增长得多快？
en: How Fast Will China Grow?

zh: 北京—在市场经济改革以来的35年中，中国的平均增长率高达9.8 % — —这是前所未有的爆炸式增长。
en: BEIJING – In the 35 years since China’s transition to a market economy began, the country has grown at an average rate of 9.8% – an explosive and unprecedented rise.

zh: 但有迹象表明中国奇迹正在走向终点 — — 或者至少经济增长正在放缓。
en: But there are signs that the Chinese miracle is coming to an end – or at least that the country’s economic growth is slowing.

zh: 自2010年一季度以来，中国的增长率一直在下降。
en: China’s growth rate has been falling since the first quarter of 2010.

zh: 2014年三季度，经济增长率降到了相对较低的7.3 % 。
en: In 2014, it was a relatively anemic 7.4%.

zh: 随着2014年临近尾声，中国的经济增长可能将继续面临强劲的逆风，至少与前几十年相比是如此。
en: China’s economic growth is likely to continue to face stiff headwinds this year as well, at least when compared to previous decades.

zh: 2015年，决策者将制定中国的十三五规划，他们将面临一个基本问题：可以预期中国增长得多快？
en: As policymakers draw up the country’s 13th five-year plan, they will grapple with a fundamental question: How fast can China expect to grow?

zh: 在制定一国GDP目标时，首先要明白经济的潜在增长率，即假设内部和外部条件有利、未来增长稳定性与可持续性不会受到威胁的情况下的最快扩张速度。
en: In setting a country’s GDP target, the first thing to understand is the economy’s potential growth rate: the maximum pace of expansion that can be attained, assuming favorable conditions, internally and externally, without endangering the stability and sustainability of future growth.

zh: 亚当·斯密在《国富论》中论证了经济增长取决于劳动生产率的改善，而今天劳动生产率的改善要么来自技术创新，要么来自产业升级（将产能重新配置给更高附加值的新部门 ） 。
en: As Adam Smith discussed in An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations, economic growth depends on improvements in labor productivity, which today result from either technological innovation or industrial upgrading (the reallocation of productive capacity into new sectors with higher added value).

zh: 但位于创新前沿的发达国家处于劣势。
en: But developed countries at the innovation frontier are at a disadvantage.

zh: 要想从新技术中获益，它们就必须创造新技术。
en: To benefit from new technology, they must create it.

zh: 相反，发展中国家拥有“后发优势 ” ， 因为它们可以通过模仿、进口、综合和许可实现技术进步。
en: Developing countries, by contrast, possess a “latecomer advantage,” because they can achieve technological advances through imitation, importation, integration, and licensing.

zh: 结果，它们的成本和风险更低。
en: As a result, their costs and risks are lower.

zh: 过去150年中，发达经济体平均每年增长3 % ， 而一些发展中国家在20年甚至更长的时间里保持7%甚至更高的年增长率。
en: Over the last 150 years, developed economies have grown at an average rate of 3% per year, whereas some developing countries have achieved annual growth rates of 7% or higher for periods of 20 years or longer.

zh: 要计算中国在经历了35年前所未有的经济增长之后还剩下多少后发优势，我们需要考察期技术和产业发展水平与高收入国家的差距。
en: To calculate how much of a latecomer advantage China has after 35 years of unprecedented growth, one needs to look at the gap between its levels of technological and industrial development and those of high-income countries.

zh: 考察这一差距的最佳办法是比较经购买力平价（PPP）调整的人均收入。
en: The best way to see this is by comparing its per capita income, adjusted for purchasing power parity (PPP), with those of developed countries.

zh: 人均收入差距越大，后发优势和增长潜力也就越大。
en: The larger the gap in per capita income, the larger the latecomer advantage and the greater the potential for growth.

zh: 2008年，中国人均收入只有美国的五分之一略多。
en: In 2008, China’s per capita income was just over one-fifth that of the United States.

zh: 这一差距大致相当于1951年美国和日本之间的差距，在此之后的20年里，日本平均年增长率为9.2 % 。 这一差距也大致等于1977年美国和韩国之间的差距，在此之后的20年里，韩国年增长率为7.6 % 。
en: This gap is roughly equal to the gap between the US and Japan in 1951, after which Japan grew at an average annual rate of 9.2% for the next 20 years, or between the US and South Korea in 1977, after which South Korea grew at 7.6% per year for two decades.

zh: 1967年的新加坡和1975年的中国台湾也有类似差距 — — 此后也出现了类似的增长率。
en: Singapore in 1967 and Taiwan in 1975 had similar gaps – followed by similar growth rates.

zh: 由此外推，在2008年后的20年里，中国的潜在增长率应在8%左右。
en: By extension, in the 20 years after 2008, China should have a potential growth rate of roughly 8%.

zh: 但潜在增长率只是故事的一部分。
en: But potential growth is just one part of the story.

zh: 它是否可以实现取决于国内条件和国际环境。
en: Whether it can be achieved depends on domestic conditions and the international environment.

zh: 为了利用后发优势，中国必须深化改革，消除经济中残留的扭曲。
en: In order to exploit its latecomer advantage, China must deepen its reforms and eliminate its economy’s residual distortions.

zh: 与此同时，政府应该更主动地克服市场失灵 — — 如外部性和协调问题 — — 这些失灵是伴随技术创新和产业升级而生的不可避免的现象。
en: Meanwhile, the government should play a proactive role in overcoming the market failures – such as externalities and coordination problems – that are certain to accompany technological innovation and industrial upgrading.

zh: 中国有潜力通过内需 — — 不仅是家庭消费 — — 保持鲁棒增长。
en: China has the potential to maintain robust growth by relying on domestic demand – and not only household consumption.

zh: 中国不缺少投资机会，有充分的产业升级空间和足够的潜力改善城市基础设施、公共住房和环境管理。
en: The country suffers no lack of investment opportunities, with significant scope for industrial upgrading and plenty of potential for improvement in urban infrastructure, public housing, and environmental management.

zh: 此外，中国的投资资源十分丰富。
en: Moreover, China’s investment resources are abundant.

zh: 中央和地方政府债务总和还不到GDP的50 % — —以国际标准衡量属于低水平。
