en: Combined central- and local-government debt amounts to less than 50% of GDP – low by international standards.

zh: 与此同时，中国的私人储蓄相当于GDP的近50 % ， 外汇储备高达4万亿美元。
en: Meanwhile, private savings in China amount to nearly 50% of GDP, and the country’s foreign-exchange reserves have reached $4 trillion.

zh: 即使面临相对不利的外部条件，中国也可以在短期内依靠投资创造就业；而随着就业岗位数量的增加，消费也会水涨船高。
en: Even under comparatively unfavorable external conditions, China can rely on investment to create jobs in the short term; as the number of jobs grows, so will consumption.

zh: 但是，外部情景会更加令人沮丧。
en: The external scenario, however, is gloomier.

zh: 尽管发达国家当局在2008年全球金融危机后进行了强力干预，启动了大规模财政和货币刺激手段，但很多发达国家的结构缺陷仍没有解决。
en: Though developed countries’ authorities intervened strongly in the aftermath of the global financial crisis in 2008, launching significant fiscal- and monetary-stimulus measures, many of their structural shortcomings remain unresolved.

zh: 日本的“安倍经济学”收效甚微，欧洲央行正在步美国和日本的后尘试图用量化宽松提振需求。
en: “Abenomics” in Japan has yet to yield results, and the European Central Bank is following in the footsteps of America and Japan, pursuing quantitative easing in an effort to shore up demand.

zh: 美国的就业正在增加，但劳动力参与率仍然不高，经济也没有达到衰退后反弹通常可以达到的6—7 % 。
en: Employment in the US is growing, but the rate of workforce participation remains subdued and the economy has yet to attain the 6-7% growth rates usually recorded in a post-recession rebound.

zh: 美国、欧洲和日本可能将精力持续的低迷表现，抑制中国的出口增长。
en: The US, Europe, and Japan are likely to experience continued sluggish performance, inhibiting China’s export growth.

zh: 结果，中国的增长可能会低于每年8%的潜在增长率。
en: As a result, Chinese growth is likely to fall below its potential of 8% a year.

zh: 决策者在为下一个五年制定计划时应该增长目标定在7—7.5 % ， 在此范围内根据国际气候变化调整。
en: As policymakers plan for the next five years, they should set China’s growth targets at 7-7.5%, adjusting them within that range as changes in the international climate dictate.

zh: 这一增长目标有助于稳定就业、降低金融风险、实现2020年收入翻番的目标。
en: Such a growth target can help to stabilize employment, lower financial risk, and achieve the country’s goal of doubling income by 2020.

zh: 不可阻挡的中国崛起
en: China’s Irresistible Rise

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 中国最近发布的2017年GDP数据证实了一点：该国令人瞩目的崛起以及与全球经济相关度的急剧上升都并没有放缓。
en: LONDON – China’s recently released GDP data for 2017 confirm it: the country’s dramatic rise, with the concomitant increase in its global economic relevance, is not slowing down.

zh: 无可否认，由于有报道说近年来某些省份故意调高了自身经济表现，媒体对于中国数据的可靠性又开始喋喋不休。
en: To be sure, there has been fresh media chatter about the reliability of Chinese data, owing to reports that some provinces have been overestimating their economic performance in recent years.

zh: 但是据我们所知，其他省份可能正在做相反的事情。
en: But for all we know, other provinces may have been doing the opposite.

zh: 无论如何，那些承认数据作假的省份还不足以对整个国家的形象产生重大影响。
en: And in any case, the provinces that have admitted to inflating their data are not large enough to have a significant impact on the national picture.

zh: 此外针对1990年代末首次发布的中国官方统计的争论往往会漏掉两个关键点。
en: Moreover, two key points are often lost in the debate about China’s official statistics, which the country first starting releasing in the late 1990s.

zh: 首先，这个辩论只有在中国逐步提升其数据虚报程度的时候才有意义。
en: First, the debate is relevant only if China is increasing the degree to which it overestimates its data.

zh: 其次，中国公布的数据应该结合贸易伙伴的数据以及在华运营的主要跨国企业的情况来考虑。
en: Second, China’s published data should be considered in the context of its trading partners’ own figures, as well as those of major international companies that do business in China.

zh: 正如我以前所写的那样，这都已经表明中国已经超越法国和美国，成为了德国最大的贸易伙伴。
en: As I have written before, it is telling that China has overtaken both France and the United States to become Germany’s top trading partner.

zh: 在2017年年化数据方面，媒体关注的焦点主要集中在6.9%的实际（剔除通胀因素后）GDP增长，这意味着了几年来的首次提速，甚至高于是政府6.5％的软指标。
en: As for the annualized 2017 data, most of the media focus has been on China’s reported real (inflation-adjusted) GDP growth, which, at 6.9%, represents the first acceleration in a couple of years and an improvement even on the government’s soft target rate of 6.5%.

zh: 但更重要的数字是以美元计算的中国名义GDP增长。
en: But the more important figure is China’s nominal GDP growth translated into US dollars.

zh: 在人民币升值的部分作用下，2017年中国经济总量达到12.7万亿美元，意味着仅用12个月就大幅增长了13 ％ （ 1.5万亿美元 ） 。
en: Owing partly to a strengthening renminbi, China’s total economic output grew to $12.7 trillion in 2017, representing a massive increase of 13% ($1.5 trillion) in just 12 months.

zh: 显然，那些曾经警告过中国正在跟随日本的脚步迈向长期通缩循环家的人都看走眼了。
en: Clearly, those who have warned that China is following in Japan’s footsteps and heading for a long-term deflationary cycle have been far off the mark.

zh: 在我看来，这样简单的比较永远不会特别有用。
en: To my mind, such simplistic comparisons are never particularly useful.

zh: 中国不仅避免了通缩的风险；而且还是以货币升值的方式实现了这一点。
en: Not only has China averted the risk of deflation; it has done so with an appreciating currency.

zh: 当我以前在高盛和同事们开始追踪金砖四国经济体（巴西，俄罗斯，印度和中国）在21世纪初的崛起时，我们认为中国要到2015年底才会赶上中国日本。
en: When my former Goldman Sachs colleagues and I first started tracking the rise of the BRIC economies (Brazil, Russia, India, and China) in the early 2000s, we figured that it would take until the end of 2015 just for China to catch up to Japan.

zh: 然而2018年才刚刚开始，中国的经济体量已经是日本的2.5倍，是印度的5倍，是巴西的6倍，是俄罗斯的8倍，比整个欧元区还要大。
en: Yet 2018 has barely started, and already China’s economy is two-and-a-half times larger than Japan’s, five times larger than India’s, six times larger than Brazil’s, and eight times larger than Russia’s. It is also larger than the entire eurozone.

zh: 中国在2017年那让人惊叹的1.5万亿美元的扩张规模意味着，从名义GDP层面它实质上创造了一个与韩国同等大小，相当于瑞士的2倍，瑞典的3倍的新经济体。
en: China’s staggering $1.5 trillion expansion in 2017 means that, in nominal terms, it essentially created a new economy the size of South Korea, twice the size of Switzerland, and three times the size of Sweden.

zh: 最新的数据显示中国有可能在2027年前后在名义GDP上与美国看齐。
en: The latest data suggest that China could catch up to the US, in nominal terms, sometime around 2027, if not before.

zh: 在此后的十年内，金砖四国合起来可以与七国集团经济体并驾齐驱。
en: Within a decade after that, the BRIC countries collectively could catch up to the G7 economies.

zh: 当然这样的成就主要是由中国推动的。
en: Of course, such an achievement would be driven largely by China.

zh: 不过其余3个金砖国家的体量加起来也比日本要大。
en: Still, taken together, the remaining BRICs are larger than Japan.

zh: 而目前巴西和俄罗斯已经摆脱近期的经济衰退，金砖四国也可能会在2018年对全球名义GDP增长做出巨大​​贡献。
en: And now that Brazil and Russia have put their recent recessions behind them, the BRICs will likely make a large contribution to nominal global GDP in 2018.

zh: 而全球增长前景的最后一个考虑因素是中国消费者。
en: One final consideration for the global growth outlook is the Chinese consumer.

zh: 许多评论家仍然把中国当作纯粹的工业大国来讨论，但其实中国的消费已经贡献了近40％的GDP总值。
en: Many commentators still discuss China as if it were solely an industrial power. But consumption in China has crept up nearly to 40% of GDP.

zh: 自2010年以来，中国消费者为世界经济添砖加瓦了近2.9万亿美元，这可比英国的整个经济体量还要大。
en: Since 2010, Chinese consumers have added around $2.9 trillion to the world economy. That is bigger than the United Kingdom’s entire economy.

zh: 英国贸易谈判代表应该注意：脱欧后中国市场对英国经济可比以往任何时候都更重要。
en: British trade negotiators should take note: after Brexit, the Chinese market will be more important to the UK economy than ever.

zh: 不过在年度数据之外，中国最近也公布了其12月份数据，其中月度报告零售额同比增长9.4 ％ ， 有点令人失望。
en: Yet, in addition to its annualized data, China also recently reported its December data, which revealed monthly reported-retail-sales growth of a slightly disappointing 9.4% year on year.

zh: 我希望这不是意味着消费放缓，而是因为中国的政策制定者在2017年下半年对财政状况有所收紧。
en: One hopes that this is a reflection not of a consumption slowdown, but rather of Chinese policymakers tightening financial conditions in the second half of 2017.

zh: 毋庸置疑，随着中国对全球经济日益重要，其上行风险和下行风险将继续对世界其他地区产生深远的影响。
en: Needless to say, as China becomes increasingly important to the global economy, its upside and downside risks will continue to have far-reaching implications for the rest of the world.

zh: 同时在实际上消费放缓不仅对中国不利，对世界其他经济也是不利的，因为后者目前依靠的正是中国由工业生产转向国内消费的局面。
en: And, indeed, a consumption slowdown would be bad not just for China, but also for the rest of the world economy, which is now depending on China’s shift from industrial production to domestic consumption.

zh: 中国的调整
en: China Adjusts

zh: 巴林—中国观察家们正在拭目以待，看中国到底是成功软着陆、给过热经济降温并达到可持续性更强的增长率，还是会重蹈邻邦覆辙重重坠落。
en: BAHRAIN – China watchers are waiting to see whether the country has engineered a soft landing, cooling down an overheating economy and achieving a more sustainable rate of growth, or whether Asia’s dragon will crash to earth, as others in the neighborhood have before it.

zh: 但对有些人来说 — — 特别是大选年的美国政客 — — 唯一感兴趣的是中国的贸易平衡。
en: But some, particularly American politicians in this presidential election year, focus on only one thing: China’s trade balance.

zh: 诚然，人民币不久前还处于严重低估的状态，中国的贸易盈余也相当巨大。
en: True, not long ago the renminbi was substantially undervalued, and China’s trade surpluses were very large.

zh: 但这一状态正在改变。
en: That situation is changing.

zh: 调整的力量正在中国经济中见效，因此对中国的外部观点也应该作出调整。
en: Forces of adjustment are at work in the Chinese economy, so foreign perceptions need to adjust as well.

zh: 中国的贸易盈余在2008年达到了3 000亿美元的高峰，此后一直在下降。
en: China’s trade surplus peaked at $300 billion in 2008, and has been declining ever since.

zh: （事实上，官方数据显示，2月份出现了310亿美元的赤字，为1998年以来最大。
en: (Indeed, official data showed a $31 billion deficit in February, the largest since 1998.)

zh: ）到底发生了什么事一目了然。
en: It is clear what has happened.

zh: 自30年前重新加入全球经济以来，贸易伙伴便一直在抢购中国的出口制造品，这是因为中国的低工资使得这些产品极具竞争力。
en: Ever since China rejoined the global economy three decades ago, its trading partners have been snapping up its manufacturing exports, because low Chinese wages made them super-competitive.

zh: 但是，近几年来，相对价格已开始改变。
en: But, in recent years, relative prices have adjusted.

zh: 这一改变可以用实际汇率升值来衡量。 实际汇率升值部分由名义人民币对美元升值决定，部分由中国通货膨胀决定。
en: The change can be measured by real exchange-rate appreciation, which consists partly in nominal renminbi appreciation against the dollar, and partly in Chinese inflation.

zh: 中国政府本应让名义升值（按每人民币可兑换的美元数量衡量）占实际汇率升值的大头，但事实上并非如此，结果，通货膨胀起了主要作用。
en: China’s government should have let more of the real appreciation take the form of nominal appreciation (dollars per renminbi). But, because it did not, it has shown up as inflation instead.

zh: 自然发生的价格调整过程被推迟了。
en: The natural price-adjustment process was delayed.

zh: 首先，当局在1995—2005年和2008—1010年两次出手干预，使得美元汇率稳固在一个不变水平上。
en: First, the authorities intervened in 1995-2005, and again in 2008-2010, to keep the dollar exchange rate virtually fixed.

zh: 其次，在生产率不断提升的中国沿海地区，工人并没有获得完全代表劳动价值的工资（毕竟，中国经济尚未全部完成毛泽东主义向市场的过渡 ） 。
en: Second, workers in China’s increasingly productive coastal factories were not paid their full value (the economy has not completed its transition from Mao to market, after all).

zh: 因此，中国一直以超低价格在向全世界销售商品。
en: As a result, China continued to undersell the world.

zh: 但人民币最终还是开始了对美元的升值之路，2005—2008和2010—2011年间累积升值了25 % 。
en: But then the renminbi was finally allowed to appreciate against the dollar – by about 25% cumulatively during 2005-2008 and 2010-2011.

zh: 此外，劳动短缺也开始出现，中国工人开始迎来工资的快速上升。
en: Moreover labor shortages began to appear, and Chinese workers began to win rapid wage increases.

zh: 北京、深圳和上海均在过去三年中大幅提高了最低工资标准，2010和2011年平均提高了22 % 。
en: Beijing, Shenzhen, and Shanghai raised their minimum wages sharply in the last three years – by 22% on average in 2010 and 2011.

zh: 与此同时，另一大商业成本 — — 地价也开始加速上涨。
en: Meanwhile another cost of business, land prices, rose even more rapidly.

zh: 随着中国沿海省份成本的上升，多种调整也将随之出现。
en: As costs rise in China’s coastal provinces, several types of adjustment are taking place.

zh: 一些制造业正在迁往工资和地价仍相对较低的内地，一些出口业务正在迁往成本较低的越南更国家。
en: Some manufacturing is migrating inland, where wages and land prices are still relatively low, and some export operations are shifting to countries like Vietnam, where they are lower still.

zh: 此外，中国公司正在开始自动化进程，以资本代替劳动，生产更加成熟的产品 — — 沿着日本、韩国和其他亚洲国家的“雁行”模式发展。
en: Moreover, Chinese companies are beginning to automate, substituting capital for labor, and are producing more sophisticated goods, following the path blazed by Japan, Korea, and other Asian countries in the “flying geese” formation.

zh: 最后，美国和其他高工资国家的跨国公司正在将业务从中国收回国内。
en: Finally, multinational companies that had moved some operations to China from the United States or other high-wage countries are now moving back.

zh: 毕竟中国的生产率还不能与美国相媲美。
en: Productivity is still higher in the US, after all.

zh: 这些对大部分中国国际观察者来说都不是新闻。
en: None of this is news to most international observers of China.

zh: 但许多西方政客（平心而论，还包括他们的选民）还没有从十年前的陈腐观念中摆脱 ： （ 1）中国已经加入了世界经济 ； （ 2）那里的工资只有每小时0.5美元 ； （ 3）那里有十亿人口 ； （ 4）中国的工资永远不会达到教科书中的经济学定律所推论的水平，因此其出口将无限制增长下去。
en: But many Western politicians (and, to be fair, their constituents) are unable to let go of the syllogism that seemed so unassailable just a decade ago: (1) The Chinese have joined the world economy; (2) their wages are $0.50 an hour; (3) there are a billion of them; and (4) Chinese wages will never be bid up in line with the usual textbook laws of economics, so their exports will rise without limit.

zh: 但事实是，经济学基本定律还是见效了，即使那是在中国。
en: But it turns out that the basic laws of economics eventually apply after all – even in China.

zh: 与中美经济关系的其他方面相同，中国的调整与30年前的日本如出一辙。
en: Like certain other aspects of the US-China economic relationship, China’s adjustment is reminiscent of Japan with a 30-year lag.

zh: 日本的贸易平衡在2011年由盈余变为赤字，这是1980年来的第一遭。
en: Japan’s trade balance fell into deficit in 2011, for the first time since 1980.

zh: 去年的情形有些特殊，比如油价高企和3月份所发生的海啸。
en: Special factors have played a role in the last year, including high oil prices and the effects of the March 2011 tsunami.

zh: 但日本贸易平衡的下降趋势是显而易见的。
en: But the downward trend in the trade balance is clear.

zh: 即使是今年，1月份的经常项目也是赤字。
en: Even the current account showed a deficit in January.

zh: 相对而言，日本的这一趋势并未引起美国和其他贸易伙伴关注，这着实令人新奇，因为二十年前日本的巨额贸易盈余让西方如临大敌，一如现在的中国。
en: This development has received relatively little attention in the US and other trading partners, which is curious, given that, two decades ago, Japan’s big trade surplus was the subject of intense focus and worry – just like China’s now.

zh: 当时是，一些有影响的观察者警告说，日本人已经找到了超级经济模式，该模式（除了其他具有吸引力的方面外）以战略性贸易为特征，其他国家最好以日本为师。
en: At the time, some influential commentators warned that the Japanese had discovered a superior economic model, featuring strategic trade policy (among other attractions), and that the rest of us had better emulate them.

zh: 不管真是如此，还是日本人在“作弊 ” ， 我们都必须阻止他们。
en: Either that, or the Japanese were “cheating,” in which case we needed to stop them.

zh: 大部分经济学家否定了这些“修正主义”观点，指出日本的经常项目盈余很大程度上是由高国民储蓄率造成的，而高国民储蓄率体现了人口结构，而不是文化差异或政府政策。
en: Most economists rejected these “revisionist” views, and argued that Japan’s current-account surplus was large because its national saving rate was high, which reflected demographics, not cultural differences or government policies.

zh: 与其他发达国家相比，日本人口相对较年轻，但由于20世纪40年代以来的出生率下降以及寿命的增长，日本人口正在快速老龄化。
en: The Japanese population was relatively young, compared to other advanced economies, but was rapidly aging, owing to a declining birth rate since the 1940’s and rising longevity.

zh: 这一观点最后被证明是正确的。
en: That view has been vindicated.

zh: 1980年，9%的日本人为65岁及以上人口；如今，这一比例达到了23%以上，为世界最高之一。
en: In 1980, 9% of Japan’s population was 65 or older; now the ratio is more than 23%, one of the highest in the world.

zh: 结果，30年前努力储蓄的日本公民现在正在动用储蓄，与经济学理论的预测完全相同。
en: As a consequence, Japanese citizens who 30 years ago were saving for their retirement are now dissaving, precisely as economic theory predicted.

zh: 随着国民储蓄率的下降，经常项目盈余也越来越少。
en: As the national saving rate has come down, so has the current-account surplus.

zh: 中国面临着与日本相同的人口结构趋势，并且也在推行解放家庭消费以维持GDP增长的方针。
en: China faces a similar demographic trend, and also a push to unleash household consumption in order to sustain GDP growth.

zh: 与日本一样，中国储蓄率下降的趋势也将体现在经常项目中。
en: As in Japan, the downward trend in China’s saving rate will show up in its current account.

zh: 国际经济学定律最终将起作用。
en: The laws of international economics still apply.

zh: 中国的基础设施银行能行吗？
en: Will China’s Infrastructure Bank Work?

zh: 美国剑桥—中国即将领导一个500亿美元规模的新国际金融机构 — — 亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行 ） ， 而大部分争论集中在美国徒劳地鼓动其他发达经济体不要参加。
en: CAMBRIDGE – With China set to lead a new $50 billion international financial institution, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), most of the debate has centered on the United States’ futile efforts to discourage other advanced economies from joining.

zh: 几乎没人试图去理解为何多边发展贷款常常以失败告终，以及能够做些什么让它更管用。
en: Far too little attention has been devoted to understanding why multilateral development lending has so often failed, and what might be done to make it work better.

zh: 多边发展机构最持久的成功也许是作为“知识”银行、帮助共享地区间经验、最佳实践和技术知识的时候。
en: Multilateral development institutions have probably had their most consistent success when they serve as “knowledge” banks, helping to share experience, best practices, and technical knowledge across regions.

zh: 反之，它们最大的失败来自为宏伟工程融资，这些工程让当前精英集团获益，而没有实现环境、社会和发展重点的合理平衡。
en: By contrast, their greatest failures have come from funding grandiose projects that benefit the current elite, but do not properly balance environmental, social, and development priorities.

zh: 水坝建设是最显著的历史例子之一。
en: Dam construction is a leading historical example.

zh: 总体而言，对于治理不善和腐败横行的国家，其大型基础设施工程的经济收益会是多少有一种高估的倾向，而对于不论预期收入是否实现，偿还贷款的长期社会成本会是多少则有一种低估趋势。
en: In general, there is a tendency to overestimate the economic benefits of big infrastructure projects in countries riddled by poor governance and corruption, and to underestimate the long-run social costs of having to repay loans whether or not promised revenues materialize. Obviously, the AIIB runs this risk.

zh: 尽管如此，发展中亚洲存在巨大的基础设施需求，中国在国际贷款机构中扮演更大角色也正逢其时。
en: That said, there are huge infrastructure needs across developing Asia, and it is high time for China to play a greater role in international lending institutions.

zh: 此外，美国的官方观点 — — 中国应该将钱投资于世界银行和亚洲开发银行等现有机构，因为中国领导的银行可能出现治理问题 — — 有一种伪善的味道。
en: Moreover, the official US argument – that China should invest its money in existing institutions, such as the World Bank and the Asian Development Bank, because a Chinese-led bank would likely have governance problems – smacks of hypocrisy.

zh: 良好的治理？
en: Good governance?

zh: 美国准备放弃其选择世界银行行长人选的历史特权吗？
en: Is the US prepared to relinquish its historical prerogative to choose the World Bank president?

zh: 类似地，美国担心中国可能利用亚投行推进中国的经济和政治利益。
en: Likewise, the US worries that China may use the AIIB to advance China’s economic and political interests.

zh: 但只要你略微了解一下美国队多边贷款的方针就可以知道，在用实力和杠杆赢得战略利益方面，没有国家比美国更加擅长。
en: But anyone who is even vaguely familiar with the US approach to multilateral lending knows that no other country has been as adept at exploiting its power and leverage for strategic gain.

zh: 随着中国在世界秩序中日益重要，它需要获得空间构建其自身的全球经济领导方针。
en: With China’s growing importance in the world order, it needs to be given space to forge its own approach to global economic leadership.

zh: 坦白说，一家相对较小的基础设施银行看起来正合适。
en: Frankly, a relatively small infrastructure bank seems as good a place as any to start.

zh: 此外，中国已经开始向发展中世界提供资金，常常是通过高度不透明的渠道。
en: Besides, China is already pouring money into the developing world, often through highly opaque channels.

zh: 亚投行让中国的发展援助比重正式化，并且让其接受该银行发达国家成员国的监督，因此，亚投行的存在是一件好事。
en: To the extent that the AIIB normalizes a portion of Chinese development assistance, and subjects it to scrutiny from the new bank’s advanced-country members, the new bank’s existence should be all for the better.

zh: 中国以擅长不断实验和改进，因此你甚至可以期待中国将汲取教训并把这些教训应用到其所有发展中国家贷款中。
en: With its penchant for constant experimentation and improvement, one might even hope that China will draw lessons and apply them to all of its developing-country lending.

zh: 谁知道呢，也许现有开发银行还能从中学习。
en: Who knows, maybe the existing development banks will learn something.

zh: 总体而言，世界应该欢��中国的亚投行，但真正的问题是发展中的亚洲需要怎样的援助。
en: While the world should generally welcome China’s initiative, the real question is what kind of aid developing Asia needs.

zh: 在发展中国家工作的人都明白，弱制度和差治理常常是比资金缺乏更大的增长障碍。
en: Anyone who has worked in developing countries understands that weak institutions and poor governance are often far bigger obstacles to growth than a lack of funds.

zh: 此外，一项工程不管在纸面上是如何宏大，其实际操作常常需要小心严谨。
en: And, however great a project looks on paper, practical implementation is often a sobering experience.

zh: 成本总是远远超过最初的估计，规划者常常大大低谷确保工程维持和修整所需要的技能和资金。
en: Costs invariably far exceed initial estimates, and planners often woefully underestimate the skills and funding needed to ensure maintenance and repairs.

zh: 我对世界银行记录的解读是，在用“软”发展基础设施帮助各国，即提供技术援助和作为全球知识银行时，其积极效果最大也最持续。
en: My interpretation of the World Bank’s record is that its role has been most consistently positive when it helps countries with “soft” development infrastructure: technical assistance and serving as a global knowledge bank.

zh: 当它的主要作用是提供金融援助时，结果就会差一些。
en: When its main role has been to provide financial muscle, the results have been less impressive.

zh: 比如，以中国本身为例，世界银行的资金在数量上并不那么重要，但总的来说中国人认为世界银行为他们提供了大有裨益的蓝图和信息。
en: In China itself, for example, World Bank money has not been so important quantitatively, yet the Chinese generally credit the Bank for having helpful blueprints and information.

zh: 事实上，有强大的理由相信，发展援助如果以赠款而非最终需要偿还的贷款形式给予，效果会更好。
en: Indeed, a strong case can be made that development aid would be more effective if it took the form of outright grants, rather than loans that ultimately need to be repaid.

zh: 新闻标题上的援助数字也许不那么引人关注，但长期结果会更好。
en: Headline aid numbers might seem less impressive, but long-run results would be better.

zh: 此外，如今世界流动性充裕，即使政府本身资金不足，也往往可以通过公私合作建设真正的高回报工程。
en: Moreover, the world is awash in liquidity right now, and even where a government’s own money is inadequate, it is often possible to establish public-private partnerships to build genuinely high-return projects.

zh: 胜任的政府是远比现金更加稀缺的商品。
en: Competent government is a far scarcer commodity than cash.

zh: 不幸的是，中国基础设施开发模式是否能够输出到全世界还远未可知。
en: Unfortunately, it is far from clear that the Chinese model of infrastructure development can be exported universally.

zh: 中国强大的中央政府可以镇压因新公路、桥梁和大坝而被迫移民的人民的反对，多年来还全然不顾环境问题和工人权利。
en: China’s strong central government overwhelms opposition from people displaced by new roads, bridges, and dams, and for many years ran roughshod over environmental concerns and workers’ rights.

zh: 与前苏联有着惊人的相似之处。
en: The parallels to the old Soviet Union are striking.

zh: 一些亚洲发展中国家运作方式有所不同。
en: Some developing countries in Asia work differently.

zh: 比如，在民主的印度，重建孟买机场用了八年时间，因为法院迫使政府尊重郊区寮屋居民的权利。
en: In democratic India, for example, it took eight years to rebuild Mumbai’s airport, because courts forced the government to respect the rights of squatters on its outskirts.

zh: 西方领导的基础设施银行留下了大量有问题的贷款和工程，质疑改革现有机构、认为需要新的基础设施银行是合理的。
en: Given the legacy of problematic loans and projects funded by Western-led infrastructure banks, it is reasonable to ask whether another one is needed, as opposed to reforming existing institutions.

zh: 但是，如果亚投行将自身主要视为知识银行而不是融资机构，可以提供真正的附加值。
en: Still, if the AIIB views itself mainly as a knowledge bank, rather than a funding vehicle, it could provide real added value.

zh: 我们需要通过亚投行如何选择和推进工程，而不是仅仅通过它提供了多少融资，来评估亚投行。
en: We should evaluate the AIIB by how it chooses and fosters projects, not just by how much financing it provides.

zh: 亚洲的多边主义
en: Asia’s Multilateralism

zh: 发自纽约 — — 国际货币基金组织和世界银行即将分别召开其年度会议，但有关全球经济治理的大新闻并非来自几天后的华盛顿特区。
en: NEW YORK – The International Monetary Fund and the World Bank are poised to hold their annual meetings, but the big news in global economic governance will not be made in Washington DC in the coming days.

zh: 因为真正的大新闻是上月英国、德国，法国和意大利与其他30多个国家一同成为亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行）的创始国。
en: Indeed, that news was made last month, when the United Kingdom, Germany, France, and Italy joined more than 30 other countries as founding members of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB).

zh: 这个由中国发起，筹资规模达500亿美元的亚投行将有助于满足亚洲极为庞大，但当今没有任何一个机制性协议有能力提供资金支持的基础设施建设需求。
en: The $50 billion AIIB, launched by China, will help meet Asia’s enormous infrastructure needs, which are well beyond the capacity of today’s institutional arrangements to finance.

zh: 人们会认为亚投行的启动，以及如此多的政府支持该行的决定，将成为全球共同庆祝这一盛事的原因。
en: One would have thought that the AIIB’s launch, and the decision of so many governments to support it, would be a cause for universal celebration.

zh: 而对于世界货币基金组织，世界银行以及许多其他机构来说原本也是如此。
en: And for the IMF, the World Bank, and many others, it was.

zh: 但令人莫名其妙的是，那些欧洲发达国家加入该行的决定竟然激怒了美国官员。
en: But, puzzlingly, wealthy European countries’ decision to join provoked the ire of American officials.

zh: 事实上，一位不愿透露姓名的美国官员指责英国“不断纵容”中国。
en: Indeed, one unnamed American source accused the UK of “constant accommodation” of China.

zh: 美国方面还暗中向全球各参与国施压，要求它们退出。
en: Covertly, the United States put pressure on countries around the world to stay away.

zh: 事实上，美国对亚洲行的反对与其在亚洲所声称的经济优先政策并不一致。
en: In fact, America’s opposition to the AIIB is inconsistent with its stated economic priorities in Asia.

zh: 令人遗憾的是，这似乎是美国对其自身全球影响力的不安全感压倒其理念阐述的又一例证 — — 而这次很可能会阻碍了一个让亚洲发展中经济体得以做大做强的重要契机。
en: Sadly, it seems to be another case of America’s insecurity about its global influence trumping its idealistic rhetoric – this time possibly undermining an important opportunity to strengthen Asia’s developing economies.

zh: 中国本身就是一个基础设施投资可以在何种程度上推动发展的极佳范例。
en: China itself is a testament to the extent to which infrastructure investment can contribute to development.

zh: 就在上个月，我赴中国考察了那些原本偏远但如今因为基础设施投资而与外界连通 — — 并因此带来人员，商品和理念的更自由流动 — — 并因此实现繁荣的地区。
en: Last month, I visited formerly remote areas of the country that are now prosperous as a result of the connectivity – and thus the freer flow of people, goods, and ideas – that such investments have delivered.

zh: 亚投行也可以为其他亚洲国家带来类似的好处，同时也更深刻地体现了美方反对的荒谬性。
en: The AIIB would bring similar benefits to other parts of Asia, which deepens the irony of US opposition.

zh: 奥巴马政府一直在鼓吹自由贸易的优越性；但在发展中国家，基础设施的缺乏却是一个比关税更严重的贸易壁垒。
en: President Barack Obama’s administration is championing the virtues of trade; but, in developing countries, lack of infrastructure is a far more serious barrier to trade than tariffs.

zh: 像亚投行这样的一个资金实体还将为全球带来更大的益处：目前全世界都面临着总需求不足的问题。
en: There is a further major global advantage to a fund like the AIIB: right now, the world suffers from insufficient aggregate demand.

zh: 而事实也证明，金融市场无力完成从那些收入高于消费地区回收储蓄，再投向急需投资地区的任务。
en: Financial markets have proven unequal to the task of recycling savings from places where incomes exceed consumption to places where investment is needed.

zh: 当还担任美联储主席的时候，本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）错误地将这一问题定义为“全球储蓄过剩 ” 。
en: When he was Chair of the US Federal Reserve, Ben Bernanke mistakenly described the problem as a “global saving glut.”

zh: 但在一个拥有如此巨大基础设施建设需求的世界上，真正的问题不在于储蓄过剩或是缺乏良好的投资机会，而是我们的金融体系极为擅长操纵市场，投机和内幕交易，却无法完成自身的核心任务：在全球层面上撮合储蓄和投资。
en: But in a world with such huge infrastructure needs, the problem is not a surplus of savings or a deficiency of good investment opportunities. The problem is a financial system that has excelled at enabling market manipulation, speculation, and insider trading, but has failed at its core task: intermediating savings and investment on a global scale.

zh: 这也是为什么亚投行可以为全球总需求产生一点微小但急需的推动。
en: That is why the AIIB could bring a small but badly needed boost to global aggregate demand.

zh: 所以我们应当欢迎中国将资金流实现多边化的倡议。
en: So we should welcome China’s initiative to multilateralize the flow of funds.

zh: 事实上，这一举动复制了美国在二战之后的政策，当年世界银行正是成立用来将主要来自美国的发展资金多边化（而这也帮助催生了一批第一流的国际官员和发展专家 ） 。
en: Indeed, it replicates American policy in the period following World War II, when the World Bank was founded to multilaterize development funds that were overwhelmingly coming from the US (a move that also helped to create a cadre of first-class international civil servants and development professionals).

zh: 世界银行的援助在某些时候充斥着一些流行理念；比如说，被推销给受援助国的华盛顿共识自由市场政策实际上导致了撒哈拉以南非洲的去工业化和收入下降。
en: The World Bank’s assistance was sometimes overburdened by prevailing ideology; for example, the free-market Washington Consensus policies foisted on recipients actually led to deindustrialization and declining income in Sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 但即便如此，如果没有实现多边化，美国的援助在总体上会更加低效。
en: Nonetheless, US assistance was, overall, far more effective than it would have been had it not been multilateralized.

zh: 因为如果这些资源都是通过美国自身援助机构拨付的话，相关政策制定就将随着历任政府更替所导致的发展思维变化（或者不作为）而摇摆不定。
en: Had these resources been channeled through America’s own aid agency, policymaking would have been subject to the vagaries of development thinking (or the absence of reflection) from one administration to another.

zh: 那些将援助多边化的新尝试（包括金砖五国在去年七月启动的新发展银行）也同样会对全球发展产生极大的促进作用。
en: New attempts to multilateralize flows of assistance (including the BRICS countries’ launch of the New Development Bank last July) are similarly likely to contribute significantly to global development.

zh: 数年以前，亚洲发展银行证实了竞争性多元主义的优点。
en: Some years ago, the Asian Development Bank defended the virtues of competitive pluralism.

zh: 而亚投行则提供了一个测试发展援助自身理念的机会。
en: The AIIB offers a chance to test that idea in development finance itself.

zh: 或许美国对亚投行的反对是我经常观察到的一个经济现象的范例：企业都希望各领域有更多竞争，只要不在自己所在领域就好。
en: Perhaps America’s opposition to the AIIB is an example of an economic phenomenon that I have often observed: firms want greater competition everywhere except in their own industry.

zh: 这一立场已经付出了一个沉重的代价：如能有一个更具竞争性的理念市场，那个有缺陷的华盛顿共识可能永远都不会成为一个共识。
en: This position has already exacted a heavy price: had there been a more competitive marketplace of ideas, the flawed Washington Consensus might never have become a consensus at all.

zh: 美国对亚投行的反对并不是没有先例的；事实上，美国在1990年代末就成功压制了日本计划向东亚金融危机国家慷慨提供800亿美元援助的新宫泽动议。
en: America’s opposition to the AIIB is not unprecedented; in fact, it is akin to the successful US opposition to Japan’s generous New Miyazawa Initiative of the late 1990s, which offered $80 billion to help countries in the East Asian crisis.

zh: 随后就跟今天这样，美国并不是想提供另一个援助来源，而只是想一家独大。
en: Then, as now, it was not as if the US were offering an alternative source of funding. It simply wanted hegemony.

zh: 在一个日渐多极化的世界上，它只想维护自己的一国霸权。
en: In an increasingly multipolar world, it wanted to remain the G-1.

zh: 如今资金的匮乏，再加上美国在如何应对危机方面层出不穷的错误理念，导致了该国影响力比原本更深远的衰退。
en: The lack of money, combined with America’s insistence on flawed ideas about how to respond to the crisis, caused the downturn to be far deeper and longer than it should have been.

zh: 即便如此，由于基础设施政策相对于其他政策领域（正如美国在世界银行所主导的那些）更难受制于意识形态和特殊利益的影响，美国对亚投行的反对就显得更加难人寻味。
en: That said, US opposition to the AIIB is harder to fathom, given that infrastructure policy is much less subject to the influence of ideology and special interests than other policymaking areas, such as those dominated by the US at the World Bank.

zh: 此外，对基础设施投资的环境和社会影响所急需的保障问题也将在多边框架下得到有效应对。
en: Moreover, the need for environmental and social safeguards in infrastructure investment is more likely to be addressed effectively within a multilateral framework.

zh: 英国、法国，意大利，德国以及其他决定加入亚投行的国家都应该得到赞赏。
en: The UK, France, Italy, Germany, and the others who have decided to join the AIIB should be congratulated.

zh: 我们也希望其他国家，无论在欧洲还是亚洲，都应该加入，一同协助实现通过改善基础设施来提高其他地区生活水平的宏图壮志，正如中国所展现的那样。
en: One hopes that other countries, both in Europe and Asia, will join as well, helping to fulfill the ambition that infrastructure improvements can raise living standards in other parts of the region, as they have already done in China.

zh: 在清洁空气方面中国能教美国什么
en: What China Can Teach America About Clean Air

zh: 北安普敦 — — 每年，全世界有超过400万人因为呼吸肮脏的空气而过早死亡。
en: NORTHAMPTON – Every year, more than four million people around the world die prematurely from breathing dirty air.

zh: 仅在中国一地，空气污染每年就导致超过一百万人死亡。
en: In China alone, the number of deaths attributable to air pollution exceeds one million annually.

zh: 这一数字可能并不令人惊讶；毕竟，我们经常在媒体上看到笼罩北京、上海和中国其他城市的浓重烟雾的影像。
en: That figure may not come as a surprise; after all, we are routinely treated to images in the media of thick, sooty smog enveloping Beijing, Shanghai, and other Chinese cities.

zh: 但美国的空气也能杀人 — — 而且远没有得到如此的关注。
en: But America’s air kills, too – and it is getting a lot less attention.

zh: 2013年一项麻省理工学院的研究估计空气质量低劣每年导致美国200,000人过早死亡，这超过了死于车祸和糖尿病的人数（其他研究得到的死亡人数相对较低，为接近100,000人 ） 。
en: A 2013 MIT study estimated that poor air quality accounts for 200,000 early deaths in the United States each year, more than the number killed by car crashes and diabetes (other studies have put the number lower, closer to 100,000).

zh: 但虽然今天的中国正在积极应对空气污染问题，但美国却在以经济发展的名义取消空气质量保障 — — 这样一种错误的策略会对人类健康造成破坏性的影响。
en: Yet, while China today is aggressively tackling its air pollution problem, the US is rolling back air-quality protections in the name of economic growth – an ill-conceived strategy that will have a devastating impact on human health.

zh: 自从1993年哈佛“六城”研究发表以来，科学家和公共卫生官员已经认识到死亡和微细颗粒物（或PM2.5，即直径小于2.5微米的空气颗粒物）之间的关系。
en: Ever since the publication of Harvard’s “Six Cities” study in 1993, scientists and public-health officials have been aware of the links between mortality and fine particulate matter, or PM2.5 (airborne particles with a diameter of less than 2.5 microns).

zh: 当人们吸入PM2.5时，细小的固体和液体灰尘、污垢、有机化学物质和金属液滴可以深入肺部，甚至进入到血液当中。
en: When people inhale PM2.5, microscopic solids and liquid droplets of dust, dirt, organic chemicals, and metals can travel deep into the lungs and even enter the bloodstream.

zh: 过去20年的研究证明了PM2.5和一系列不良健康结果之间的联系，包括哮喘、急性支气管炎、肺癌、心脏病和心肺疾病等等。
en: Research over the past 20 years has tied PM2.5 to a range of adverse health outcomes, including asthma, acute bronchitis, lung cancer, heart attacks, and cardiorespiratory diseases.

zh: 我们也已知晓绝大多数PM2.5来自何处：发电厂、重工业和机动车辆。
en: We know, too, where most PM2.5 comes from: power plants, heavy industry, and motor vehicles.

zh: 在化石燃料燃烧期间，全世界最常见的温室气体二氧化碳被排放到空中，同时排放的还有未经完全燃烧并在大气中发生化学反应形成细微颗粒物的固体和气体颗粒物（主要是二氧化硫和氮氧化物 ） 。
en: During fossil-fuel combustion, carbon dioxide, the world’s most prevalent greenhouse gas, is emitted into the air, along with particles of incompletely combusted solids and gases (mainly sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides) that react chemically in the atmosphere to form fine particulate matter.

zh: 了解了致死污染物及其来源，美国环保局根据1990年清洁空气法颁布了降低 PM2.5水平的新标准。
en: Knowing the killer pollutant and its sources, the US Environmental Protection Agency, under the 1990 Clean Air Act, issued new standards to reduce PM2.5 levels.

zh: 美国环保局估计在1990到2015年间，全国颗粒物浓度下降了37 % ， 并且在2010年，由于上述规则实施而避免了约160,000人过早死亡。
en: The EPA estimates that between 1990 and 2015, the national concentration of particulate matter fell by 37%, and that in 2010, some 160,000 premature deaths were averted as a result of the regulations.

zh: 总之，虽然仍有相当数量的死亡案例依然与脏空气有关，但截至今年为止，美国已经在迈向正确的方向。
en: In short, despite a considerable number of deaths still linked to dirty air, the US had, until this year, been heading in the right direction.

zh: 但现在，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普已经承诺要通过废除旨在降低燃煤电厂有毒排放的规则、降低或取缔机动车燃油效率标准和解散环保署等举措来创造“难以置信的繁荣 ” 。
en: Now, however, US President Donald Trump has promised to create “unbelievable prosperity” by discarding regulations intended to reduce toxic emissions from coal-fired power plants, lowering or eliminating fuel-efficiency standards for automobiles, and dismantling the EPA.

zh: 他还承诺要废除对水力压裂的限制、开放更多的公共土地用于煤炭开采，并扩大北极和大西洋海域的石油和天然气生产。
en: He has also vowed to repeal limits on fracking, open up more public lands to coal mining, and expand oil and gas production in the Arctic and Atlantic Oceans.

zh: 让我们暂时假设这样的举措实际能为整个国家、而非仅是化石燃料业带来繁荣。
en: Let’s assume, for a moment, that such measures would actually produce prosperity for the entire country, and not just for the fossil-fuel industry.

zh: 但美国作为一个国家愿意付出什么样的代价？
en: What price, as a country, is the US willing to pay?

zh: 究竟每年多少人过早死亡才是不能承受之重？
en: How many early deaths per year are too many?

zh: 有些替代方案不必在经济增长和人类健康之间进行零和权衡。
en: There are alternatives that don’t require a zero-sum tradeoff between economic growth and human health.

zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，中国是这个能为我们带来灵感的地方。
en: And, ironically, one place to look for inspiration is China.

zh: 把中国作为典范来模仿看似荒谬。
en: Holding up China as a model to emulate might seem absurd.

zh: 毕竟，那里的PM2.5水平远高于美国，而且化石燃料消费量，尤其是煤炭，也要高很多。
en: After all, its PM2.5 levels are considerably higher than in the US, and consumption of fossil fuels, especially coal, is far greater.

zh: 但中国决策者正在采取积极措施扭转局面，力求让国家摆脱对化石燃料的依赖并创造由清洁能源和绿色科技驱动的面向未来的经济 — — 这保障了中国能在全球经济发展中保持领先。
en: But Chinese policymakers are taking vigorous steps to reverse course, free the country from its dependence on fossil fuels and create a future-oriented economy powered by clean energy and green technology – one that places China at the forefront of the global economy.

zh: 今天，中国是世界最大的可再生能源投资国，2015年投资总额为1030亿美元，超过美国440亿美元的两倍还多。
en: Today, China is the world’s largest investor in renewable energy, with outlays in 2015 totaling $103 billion, more than double US spending of $44 billion.

zh: 在全球可再生能源810万个工作岗位中， 350万个属于中国，而仅有不到一百万个属于美国。
en: Of the planet’s 8.1 million jobs in renewable energy, 3.5 million are in China, whereas fewer than one million are in the US.

zh: 因为坚信清洁能源有利于环境和经济，中国到2020年已经承诺投资3，670亿美元用于可再生能源发展 — — 预计如此规模的投资将创造1，300万个就业机会。
en: Persuaded that clean energy is good for the environment and the economy, China has committed $367 billion through 2020 to the development of renewable power sources – a level of investment that is expected to generate 13 million jobs.

zh: 中国还将眼光投向国外，将其在可再生能源和配套技术方面研发的专业知识用于出口。
en: China is also looking beyond its borders, by exporting the expertise it has developed in renewable energy and supporting technologies.

zh: 2016年，中国投资成百上千亿美元用于澳大利亚、德国、巴西、智利、埃及、巴基斯坦、越南、印度尼西亚和其他国家的可再生能源项目开发工作。
en: In 2016, China invested tens of billions in renewable energy projects in Australia, Germany, Brazil, Chile, Egypt, Pakistan, Vietnam, Indonesia, and elsewhere.

zh: 同样，为控制汽车排放污染，中国政府已经把电动车作为重中之重，并制定了到2020年达到上路500万辆的目标。
en: Likewise, to rein in pollutants from motor vehicles, China’s government has made adoption of electric vehicles a high priority, setting a target of five million on the country’s roads by 2020.

zh: 为促进销售，政府对购买者免征销售和消费税（每辆车约为6，000-10，000美元 ） 。
en: To promote sales, buyers are exempted from sales and excise taxes ($6,000-$10,000 per vehicle).

zh: 而且，因为预见到全球传统机动车终将被取代，中国政府为国内制造提供了慷慨的补贴。
en: And, anticipating the eventual replacement of conventional motor vehicles globally, the authorities are providing generous subsidies for domestic manufacturing.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普政府却在试图让时光倒流，把注压在奄奄一息 — — 而且濒临死亡的 — — 化石燃料业的复苏。
en: Meanwhile, the Trump administration is trying to turn back the clock, by betting on the resuscitation of a dying – and deadly – fossil-fuel industry.

zh: 特朗普宣扬向电动车转型会减少工作岗位，主张终止鼓励国内研发生产和购买行为的联邦补贴，比如7,500美元的联邦消费税收抵免政策。
en: Describing a transition to electric vehicles as a job killer, Trump has advocated ending federal subsidies that encourage domestic development, manufacture, and purchase, such as the $7,500 federal tax credit for consumers.

zh: 中国对化石燃料的依赖曾导致其落入深深的环境陷阱，但中国领导人决心要爬出这座陷阱。
en: China’s dependence on fossil fuels has left it in a deep environmental hole, but its leaders are determined to climb out.

zh: 而另一方面，美国则实际正在自掘坟墓。
en: The US, on the other hand, is literally digging its own grave.

zh: 因为每年导致 200,000 美国民众过早死亡，我们绝不能允许经济上的狂妄自大压制对解决办法的探索 — — 无论我们能从哪里得到启示。
en: With as many as 200,000 Americans dying prematurely every year, economic hubris must not be allowed to trump the search for solutions – wherever they may be found.

zh: 美中关系的合作对抗
en: The Cooperative Rivalry of US-China Relations

zh: 坎布里奇—10月份，我访问了北京，很多人问我，美国副总统彭斯最近对中国的激烈批评是否标志着宣布新冷战。
en: CAMBRIDGE – On a visit to Beijing in October, I was often asked whether US Vice President Mike Pence’s recent harsh criticism of China marked the declaration of a new cold war.

zh: 我回答说，美国和中国进入了双边关系的新阶段，但冷战隐喻具有误导性。
en: I replied that the United States and China have entered a new phase in their relationship, but that the cold war metaphor is misleading.

zh: 冷战期间，美国和苏联的数万核武器彼此瞄准，也几乎没有任何贸易和文化联系。
en: During the Cold War, the US and the Soviet Union targeted tens of thousands of nuclear weapons at each other and had virtually no trade or cultural ties.

zh: 相反，中国的核力量更加有限，中美年贸易总额高达五千亿美元，每年有350,000多中国留学生和三百万游客赴美。
en: By contrast, China has a more limited nuclear force, annual Sino-American trade totals a half-trillion dollars, and more than 350,000 Chinese students and three million tourists are in the US each year.

zh: 对于当今双边关系，更适合的描述是“合作对抗 ” （ cooperative rivalry ） 。
en: A better description of today’s bilateral relationship is “cooperative rivalry.”

zh: 自二战以来，美中关系经历了三个阶段，每个阶段大约维持二十年。
en: Since the end of World War II, US-China relations have gone through three phases that lasted roughly two decades each.

zh: 朝鲜战争后的20年是敌对状态，1972年尼克松访华后，双方进入了对抗苏联的有限合作阶段。
en: Hostility marked the 20 years after the Korean War, followed by limited cooperation against the Soviet Union during the phase that followed President Richard Nixon’s famous 1972 visit.

zh: 冷战结束开启了第三阶段 — — 经济接触阶段，美国帮助中国经济融入全球，包括2001年进入世界贸易组织。
en: The Cold War’s end ushered in a third phase of economic engagement, with the US helping China’s global economic integration, including its entry into the World Trade Organization in 2001.

zh: 但在冷战后的第一个十年中，克林顿总统政府也进行了两头下注，同时强化了美日同盟，并改善了美印关系。
en: Yet in the first post-Cold War decade, President Bill Clinton’s administration hedged its bets by simultaneously strengthening the US-Japan alliance and improving relations with India.

zh: 如今，2017年后的美国国家安全战略聚焦于大国实力对抗，中国和俄罗斯被视为美国的主要对手。
en: Now, since 2017, the US National Security Strategy focuses on great power rivalry, with China and Russia designated as America’s main adversaries.

zh: 许多中国分析师将这一第四阶段归咎于美国总统特朗普，但中国国家主席习近平也要承担责任。
en: While many Chinese analysts blame this fourth phase on US President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping is also to blame.

zh: 习近平拒绝了邓小平韬光养晦的审慎政策，取消了主席任期限制，大举宣传民族主义“中国梦 ” ， 这就好比是戴上了一顶印有“让中国再次伟大”字样的红色帽子。
en: By rejecting Deng Xiaoping’s prudent policy of maintaining a low international profile; by ending presidential term limits; and by proclaiming his nationalistic “China Dream,” Xi might as well have been wearing a red hat reading, “Make China Great Again.”

zh: 美国对华的传统智慧自2016年总统选举开始前便已经变质。
en: The conventional wisdom on China within the US had already begun to sour before the 2016 presidential election.

zh: 特朗普的言辞和关税只是令火焰变得更加旺盛的燃料。
en: Trump’s rhetoric and tariffs were merely gasoline poured on a smoldering fire.

zh: 自由国际秩序帮助中国保持了高速经济增长、大幅减少了贫困。
en: The liberal international order helped China sustain rapid economic growth and reduce poverty dramatically.

zh: 但中国也通过补贴国有企业、从事商业间谍活动、要求外资企业向国内“合作方”转让知识产权等手段，搞起了不公平贸易。
en: But China also tilted the trade field to its advantage by subsidizing state-owned enterprises, engaging in commercial espionage, and requiring foreign firms to transfer their intellectual property to domestic “partners.”

zh: 大部分经济学家认为，特朗普聚焦于双边贸易赤字是错误的，但很多人支持他关于中国挑战美国技术领先地位的抱怨。
en: While most economists argue that Trump is mistaken to focus on the bilateral trade deficit, many support his complaints about China’s efforts to challenge America’s technological advantage.

zh: 此外，中国日益增强的军力给双边关系平添一层安全维度。
en: Moreover, China’s growing military strength adds a security dimension to the bilateral relationship.

zh: 尽管中美关系的第四阶段并非冷战（因为双方存在非常高的相互依存关系 ） ， 但也要比典型的贸易纠纷（如美国最近就进入加拿大奶制品市场问题与加拿大产生的冲突）对立得多。
en: While this fourth phase of the relationship is not a cold war, owing to the high degree of interdependence, it is much more than a typical trade dispute like, say, America’s recent clash with Canada over access to that country’s dairy market.

zh: 一些分析师认为，第四阶段标志着冲突的开始 — — 老牌霸权向崛起的挑战者宣战。
en: Some analysts believe this fourth phase marks the beginning of a conflict in which an established hegemon goes to war with a rising challenger.

zh: 修昔底德在解释伯罗奔尼撒战争时有一个著名的论断：斯巴达担心雅典崛起导致了这场战争。
en: In his explanation of the Peloponnesian War, Thucydides famously argued that it was caused by Sparta’s fear of a rising Athens.

zh: 这些分析师认为，中国的崛起也将给美国带来类似的担心，并将此与第一次世界大战类比，当时，崛起的德国把霸主英国逼到了墙角。
en: These analysts believe that China’s rise will create a similar fear in the US, and use the analogy of World War I, when a rising Germany set hegemonic Britain on edge.

zh: 但一战的起源要比这复杂得多，包括俄罗斯实力的崛起（并导致德国的担忧 ） 、 巴尔干地区和其他国家民族主义的崛起，以及哈布斯堡帝国为了挽救自己的衰落而进行的有意冒险。
en: The causes of World War I, however, were far more complex, and included growing Russian power, which created fear in Germany; rising nationalism in the Balkans and other countries; and the risks deliberately taken by the Habsburg Empire to stave off its decline.

zh: 更重要的是，到1900年，德国工业产量已经超越英国，而中国GDP（用美元衡量）目前还只有美国经济的五分之三。
en: Even more important, Germany had already surpassed Britain in industrial production by 1900, while China’s GDP (measured in dollars) currently is only three-fifths the size of the US economy.

zh: 与面对德国的英国相比，美国有更多的时间和本钱管理中国实力的崛起。
en: The US has more time and assets to manage the rise of Chinese power than Britain had with Germany.

zh: 中国受到亚洲天然实力平衡的制约，日本（世界第三大经济体）和印度（人口即将超过中国）都不希望受中国支配。
en: China is constrained by a natural balance of power in Asia in which Japan (the world’s third-largest economy) and India (about to surpass China in population) have no desire to be dominated by it.

zh: 对美国来说，落入修昔底德所描述的担心将是毫无必要的自我实现的预言。
en: Succumbing to the fear that Thucydides described would be an unnecessary self-fulfilling prophecy for the US.

zh: 幸运的是，民调显示美国公众对于歇斯底里地将中国描绘成和冷战时期的苏联一样强大的敌人并不“感冒 ” 。
en: Fortunately, polls show that the American public has not yet succumbed to a hysterical portrayal of China as an enemy as strong as the Soviet Union was during the Cold War.

zh: 中国和美国都不构成斯特勒的德国和斯大林的苏联之间的你死我活关系。
en: Neither China nor the US poses an existential threat to the other the way that Hitler’s Germany or Stalin’s Soviet Union did.

zh: 中国无意入侵美国，也无力将美国逐出西太平洋。 大部分西太平洋国家都欢迎美国的存在。
en: China is not about to invade the US, and it is unable to expel America from the Western Pacific, where most countries welcome its presence.

zh: 所谓的第一岛链的主要部分日本承担了近四分之三的驻地成本，以维持50,000美国驻军。
en: Japan, a major part of the so-called first island chain, pays nearly three-quarters of the host nation costs to keep 50,000 US troops based there.

zh: 我最近的东京之旅让我确认，日本与美国的同盟关系十分紧密。
en: My recent visit to Tokyo confirmed for me that the alliance with the US is strong.

zh: 如果特朗普政府能够保持这一关系，中国将美国逐出西太平洋的希望渺茫，更不用说支配世界了。
en: If the Trump administration maintains it, the prospects are slight that China can drive the US from the Western Pacific, much less dominate the world.

zh: 美国的战略手牌更占优势，无需理会修昔底德担忧。
en: The US holds better strategic cards and need not succumb to Thucydidean fear.

zh: 但还有另一个因素让这一第四阶段成为“合作对抗 ” ， 而非冷战。
en: There is another dimension, however, that makes this fourth phase a “cooperative rivalry” rather than a Cold War.

zh: 中国和美国面临着跨国挑战，如果不彼此携手，就无法克服这一挑战。
en: China and the US face transnational challenges that are impossible to resolve without the other.

zh: 气候变化和海平面的升高背后是物理定律，而非政治规律。
en: Climate change and rising sea levels obey the laws of physics, not politics.

zh: 随着边境变得更加脆弱，从非法毒品到传染病和恐怖主义的一切的跨境传播变得更加容易，全球最大经济体之间必须合作解决这些威胁。
en: As borders become more porous to everything from illicit drugs to infectious diseases to terrorism, the largest economies will have to cooperate to cope with these threats.

zh: 中美关系之间的某些角度包含着正和博弈。
en: Some aspects of the relationship will involve a positive-sum game.

zh: 美国国家安全需要与中国合力，而不是压制中国。
en: US national security will require power with China, not just over China.

zh: 我们可以一边走路一边嚼口香糖吗？
en: The key question is whether the US is capable of thinking in terms of a “cooperative rivalry.”

zh: 在民粹主义民族主义时代，政客创造担忧容易，创造新冷战难。
en: Can we walk and chew gum at the same time? In an age of populist nationalism, it is much easier for politicians to create fear about a new cold war.

zh: 中国和新的权力平衡
en: China and a New Balance of Power

zh: 上海 - - 最后一个与美国抗衡的超级大国苏联在1991年瓦解了。
en: SHANGHAI – The last rival superpower to the United States, the Soviet Union, collapsed in 1991.

zh: 但是，除了其军事实力以外，苏联从来没有足够的实力来制约美国的影响。
en: But, apart from its military strength, the USSR was never really powerful enough to counterbalance US influence.

zh: 在八十年代末，日本看似可以挑战美国在工业上的领先地位，但是到了九十年代日本失去了它的竞争实力。
en: In the late 1980’s, Japan seemed capable of challenging America’s industrial leadership, but by the 1990’s it lost its competitive edge.

zh: 中国自身也许想要在多极化的世界中成为一个大国，但是其整体实力不足令其难以长袖善舞。
en: China might itself wish to be a major force in a multi-polar world, but has been plagued by its lack of overall strength.

zh: 鉴于这些现实因素，中国认为扩大中的欧盟有可能制衡美国实力。
en: Given these realities, China sees the expanding European Union as a likely counterweight to unchecked US power.

zh: 在经济产值上，如今的欧盟与美国并驾齐驱。
en: In terms of economic output, today’s EU is on par with the US.

zh: 但是欧盟尚未建立强大的防卫系统以有效地应付地区性紧急局势或者全球性需要。
en: But it has yet to build a strong defense system that can respond effectively either to regional contingencies or to global needs.

zh: 当这一系统建立之时，应该具有何种实力、以及如何与美国相比呢？
en: What would be the strength of such a system if and when it is developed, and how will it compare with that of the US?

zh: 中国在评估美国实力的时候密切关注美国有关单极世界或者多极世界是非曲直的辩论。
en: In assessing America’s strength, China follows US debates on the merits of a uni-polar or a multi-polar world with keen interest.

zh: 有些美国人赞成由美国统领的单极世界。
en: Some Americans favor a uni-polar system in which the US dominates.

zh: 这样一个美式和平可以让美国以较少的代价予以维持，但是如果美国像在伊拉克问题上采取错误的政策，那么整个世界都会担忧。
en: Such a Pax Americana would cost the country less to sustain, but the world would worry if America adopts a wrong policy, as has been the case in Iraq.

zh: 美国当然有权限制那些进行9/11袭击的恐怖分子。
en: The US certainly has a right to curb terrorists like those who staged the attack on September 11, 2001.

zh: 但是“反恐战争”并不能够开脱美国攻击一个主权国家并且推翻其政府的决定。 美国的推测是错误的，也就是伊拉克藏有大规模杀伤性武器并且与2001年的恐怖攻击事件有牵连。
en: But the “war on terror” did not warrant the decision to attack a sovereign state and topple its government on the flawed presumption that it housed weapons of mass destruction and was linked to the 2001 attacks.

zh: 美国不顾法国、德国、俄国、中国以及其他联合国安理会成员国的强烈反对发动战争。
en: The US went to war despite strong opposition from France, Germany, Russia, China, and other United Nations Security Council members.

zh: 法国和德国从那时以来寻求恢复与美国的关系，但是继续反对这一战争。
en: France and Germany have since sought to restore good relations with the US, but continue to disapprove of the war.

zh: 欧洲一直关注中东问题，而中东也由于这一战争而变得更为不稳定。
en: The Middle East, always a region of concern for Europe, has become even less stable as a result of the war.

zh: 美国的领导地位成为了这一场战争的牺牲品。
en: American leadership has been one of the war’s casualties.

zh: 在中国，欧洲独立防务通常被视为是多极世界中所必需并且有效的。 欧洲独立防务的概念体现为欧洲安全和防务政策、欧盟快速反应力量以及各种不同的政策使命。
en: In China, the concept of an independent European defense – embodied in the European Security and Defense Policy (ESDP), as well as the EU’s Rapid Reaction Force (RRF) and various police missions – is thus generally seen as necessary and effective in a multi-polar world system.

zh: 中国认为，在大多数安全问题上，欧洲独立安全和防务政策目前模仿美国的安全利益，因为欧盟和美国具有共同的人权和民主价值观。
en: China observes that on most security matters, the ESDP will (for now) mimic American security interests, because the EU and US share fundamental values of human rights and democracy.

zh: 而且，许多欧盟成员国同时向北约保证投入其防务实力，而北约从成立以来一直由美国领导。
en: Moreover, many EU members have simultaneously pledged their defense capabilities to NATO, which has been led by the US since its creation.

zh: 但是欧洲独立安全和防务政策得以全面落实后就不一定无条件地追随美国，特别是如果美国的政策继续像在伊拉克问题上那样偏离国际法准则。
en: But the ESDP, once fully developed, will not necessarily follow America’s lead unconditionally, especially if American policy continues to deviate from the norm of international law, as in Iraq.

zh: 欧洲在获得了泛欧防务能力之后就有可能发挥比当前更为独立的作用，管理欧洲内部的安全关系并且履行全球使命。
en: As a result of acquiring a pan-European defense capacity, the Europeans are likely to play a more independent role than at present in managing intra-European security relations and carrying out global missions.

zh: 中国欢迎欧盟扩大安全作用。
en: China welcomes this expanded security role for the EU.

zh: 尽管中国对欧盟实施国际干预存有戒心，但是，出于几个原因，欧洲独立安全和防务政策的实质和模式则有可能赢得中国尊重。
en: Although it remains wary of international intervention by the EU, the substance and pattern of ESDP operations are likely to win China’s respect for several reasons.

zh: 首先，中国领导人注意到，使命的合法性在该政策中居于首位。
en: First, China’s leaders note that the ESDP gives priority to the legitimacy of its missions.

zh: 目前为止，该政策所有的使命都尊重国际法和争议各方的政府安排。
en: So far, all ESDP missions have respected international law and governmental arrangements among disputing parties.

zh: 其大多数军事或者警察使命都建立在联合国安理会决议的基础之上，而且欧洲以外的使命也是受到当地政府当局邀请所为。
en: Most of its military or police missions have been based on UN Security Council resolutions, and ESDP missions outside Europe have been at the invitation of local authorities.

zh: 当然，该政策的安全使命即使遵照联合国安理会决议也未必在联合国系统内运行，这是因为欧盟偏向于其独立的领导作用。
en: Of course, ESDP security missions, even those in accordance with Security Council resolutions, may not operate within the UN system – the EU prefers its own independent leadership.

zh: 该政策并不一定要求安理会授权作为其使命的先决条件。 而且，它也在执行使命上保持独立作用。
en: The ESDP does not necessarily require Security Council authorization as a condition for its missions, and it retains an independent role in executing them.

zh: 但是，与美国相比，该政策在中国眼里更为关注得到联合国授权的国际合法性。
en: However, when compared with the US, the ESDP (in Chinese eyes) cares far more about international legitimacy, backed by the authority of the UN.

zh: 第二，该政策关注良好管治以及机制建设。
en: Second, the ESDP is concerned with good governance and institution building.

zh: 欧盟力求恢复或者建立人权、稳定和繁荣。
en: The EU is keen to restore or establish human rights, stability, and prosperity.

zh: 在欧洲以外，该政策努力改进管治而非政权更替。 而且欧盟还经常援助各国政府改善安全条件。
en: Outside Europe, the ESDP acts to enhance governance rather than promote regime change, and the EU has often assisted governments’ efforts to improve security conditions.

zh: 第三，该政策向国际合作开放。
en: Third, the ESDP is open to international cooperation.

zh: 欧盟既与非欧盟国家，例如加拿大、挪威和土耳其等北约成员国合作，也与申请加入欧盟的国家合作。
en: The EU works with either non-EU states, such as NATO members like Canada, Norway, and Turkey, or applicants for EU membership.

zh: 该政策与联合国和非洲联盟、东盟等其他地区性组织合作。
en: The ESDP cooperates with the UN and other regional organizations, such as the African Union and ASEAN.

zh: 当欧盟主动的时候往往会在这些合作中发挥主要作用。
en: When the EU reaches out, it tends to play a leading role in these collaborations.

zh: 人们有理由预计中国将会继续接受独立欧洲安全机制。
en: There are good reasons to expect that China will continue to accept an independent European security mechanism.

zh: 人们几乎不比担心该政策会干涉台湾问题等中国内部事务。
en: There is little concern, if any, about the ESDP intervening in internal Chinese affairs, such as Taiwan.

zh: 实际上，中国需要一个强大独立的欧洲。 而且从这一点上来看，中国现在直面一个真正多极化的全球体系为时并不太早。
en: Indeed, China wants a strong and independent Europe, and from that vantage point it is not too early for China to envisage a truly multi-polar global system.

zh: 中国与印度的痛处
en: China and India Exposed

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 美国总统奥巴马前脚刚走，中国总理温家宝随后展开印度之行，而此举也再度为媒体炒作中印两国在全球经济中日渐增长的影响力提供了良机。
en: BERKELEY – Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao’s forthcoming trip to India, following hard on the heels of President Barack Obama’s recent visit, will provide another opportunity for the media to gush about the growing global economic clout of China and India.

zh: 而这两大经济体的缺陷也必将再次被掩盖在光环之下。
en: We can be sure that the soft underbellies of both economies will be kept hidden from view.

zh: 在经历了两个世纪的相对停滞后，这两个合共拥有全球2/5人口的国家在过去30年里经历了快速的收入增长。
en: After a couple of centuries of relative stagnation, these two countries, containing nearly two-fifths of the world’s population, have experienced remarkably rapid income growth in the last three decades.

zh: 中国的制造业和印度的服务业（特别是软件制造和业务流程外包等）给国际社会带来了巨大的冲击，而他们对全球企业的收购行为也引发了外界的广泛关注。
en: In manufacturing and services (particularly software, business processing, etc.), respectively, China and India have made huge strides internationally, and their acquisition of global companies has attracted considerable attention.

zh: 不过，近来关于这两大经济体铺天盖地的反复报道似乎已经令一些站不住脚的表象变成了人们的常识，结果两国内部的真实情况反倒被忽视了。
en: But some dubious assertions have, through constant repetition in recent, often breathless, accounts about the two economies, become part of conventional wisdom. Much of what really goes on inside these two large countries is often left out.

zh: 比如说，从产品附加值（即扣除了原料和组分成本之后的产品价值）的角度来看，与普遍印象相反，中国并不是全球制造业的中心。
en: For example, in terms of value added (the value of output after deducting the cost of materials and components), China, contrary to popular impression, is not yet the manufacturing center of the world.

zh: 中国对全球制造业产品附加值的贡献只有15 % ， 而美国却有24 % ， 欧盟也有20 % 。
en: The Chinese produce about 15% of value added in world manufacturing, while the United States contributes about 24% and the European Union about 20%.

zh: 与此类似，尽管印度的信息技术服务业闻名世界，但该行业的就业人数仅占印度总劳动力的0.5 % 。
en: Similarly, while India’s information technology-enabled services have gained an international reputation, the total number of people employed in this sector is less than 0.5% of India’s workforce.

zh: 因此，仅靠这一部门还不能令印度的经济成功转型。
en: As such, it cannot, by itself, transform the Indian economy.

zh: 此外，中国的经济增长普遍被认为是出口拉动的，但殊不知国内投资也是主要动力之一。
en: Chinese growth is widely regarded as furiously export-driven, but domestic investment has in fact been the major component.

zh: 即便是在2002-2007年那段国际贸易大肆扩张的鼎盛时期，出口（从附加值角度看）对GDP增长的贡献仅为1/4多一点，反倒是国内投资的贡献更大。
en: Even at the height of global trade expansion in 2002-2007, exports (in value-added terms) accounted for only a little more than one-quarter of GDP growth, whereas domestic investment contributed a substantially larger share.

zh: 而且，与普遍的看法相反，在过去30年里，中国国内贫困人口数量的急速下降并不是由于融入了全球经济，而是由诸如农业部门（大量的贫困人口都处在这一领域）的发展等国内因素所导致的。
en: Moreover, contrary to popular belief, much of the dramatic poverty reduction in China over the last three decades was due not to integration into the global economy, but to domestic factors like growth in the agricultural sector (where mass poverty was concentrated).

zh: 而这些因素的出现则主要归结于对农村基础设施的投资以及早期对农业生产组织形式和耕地平均分配的改革。
en: This is attributable largely to public investment in rural infrastructure, and, in the initial period, to institutional changes in agrarian production organization and an egalitarian distribution of land-cultivation rights.

zh: 劳动密集型产业的出口扩张无疑让许多中国人摆脱了贫困。
en: Expansion of exports of labor-intensive manufactures has nonetheless lifted many Chinese out of poverty.

zh: 不过以技术密集型和资本密集型出口为主的印度却没有那么幸运了。
en: That is not true of India, where exports are still mainly skill- and capital-intensive.

zh: 毫无疑问，经济改革使印度的企业部门生机勃勃，更具竞争力，但（无论是公共的或私人的）企业部门仅仅是印度经济的一小部分。
en: Economic reform clearly has made the Indian corporate sector more vibrant and competitive, but most of the Indian economy is not in the corporate sector (public or private).

zh: 事实上，92%的劳动力都在非正式部门就业。
en: Indeed, 92% of the labor force is employed in the informal sector.

zh: 印度的贫困状况的确有了明显下降，但还没达到大规模下降的程度。
en: Indian poverty reduction has been significant, but not substantial.

zh: 从贫困的非收入指标来看 — — 比如说，儿童死亡率，营养不良以及辍学等等 — — 印度的表现就非常差（在某些方面甚至比撒哈拉以南非洲还要糟糕 ） 。
en: However, in terms of non-income indicators of poverty – for example, child mortality, malnutrition, and school dropouts – India’s performance has been dismal (in some respects worse even than in sub-Saharan Africa).

zh: 在财经媒体眼中，即便中印两国在私有化，财产权，放松管制以及萦绕不去的官僚僵化等问题上都偏离了正统的经济理论，但这些都未能妨碍它们成为市场化改革和全球化的典范。
en: In the financial media, China and India have become poster children for market reform and globalization, even though in matters of privatization, property rights, deregulation, and lingering bureaucratic rigidities, both countries have in many ways departed from economic orthodoxy.

zh: 根据美国传统基金会权威发布的经济自由度指数，中国和印度都应被归为“较不自由”的一类。
en: According to the US-based Heritage Foundation’s widely cited Index of Economic Freedom, China and India are relegated to the group described as “mostly unfree.”

zh: 2008年，在157个国家中，中国和印度分别排在126和115位。
en: Out of a total of 157 countries in 2008, China ranked 126th and India 115th.

zh: 虽然这两个国家早期的社会主义经济政策抑制了它们的创新能力和企业发展，但我们也不应抹杀了那段时期的积极一面。
en: Although socialist economic policies in both countries inhibited initiative and enterprise, a positive legacy of that period cannot be denied.

zh: 比如说，中国的社会主义经济政策给教育和医疗卫生打下了坚实的基础，实现了农村电气化，构建了由平均地权支撑的社会安全网络，下放给地方发展经济的权力，以及鼓励妇女积极参加工作，因此也为后来的高速增长提供了强大的基础。
en: It is arguable, for example, that Chinese socialism provided a strong launching pad for growth, particularly in terms of a solid base of education and health, rural electrification, a safety net enabled by equitable distribution of land rights, regional economic decentralization, and high female participation in the labor force.

zh: 而政府在科技发展中担任主要角色的累积效应则是这两国的另一个主要社会主义遗产。
en: Moreover, a major part of the socialist legacy in both countries is the cumulative effect of the state’s active role in technological development.

zh: 不过，在印度国，私企是最具活力的经济部门，反过来，在中国，国企较私企更为成功。
en: Unlike in India, where the private corporate sector is the most dynamic sector, in China state-controlled companies are some of the globally more successful.

zh: 即便如联想和华为这样闻名海外的中国私有企业，其产权结构也是错综复杂，而国家控制权与私人控制权之间的界限则模糊不清。
en: Even in famous private Chinese companies like Lenovo and Huawei Technologies, the ownership structure is highly convoluted, and the boundaries of state and private control rights blurred.

zh: 最近，中国私人汽车制造商吉利收购沃尔沃汽车的事街知巷闻，但这笔收购的款项绝��部分由地方市政府筹集的事实却鲜为人知。
en: The recent purchase of Volvo by the private Chinese automaker Geely generated much publicity, but most of the money was put up by municipal governments.

zh: 在中国，许多国企都由有政治势力的家族把持着。
en: Powerful political families run many Chinese state-owned enterprises.

zh: 事实上，有证据证明中国绝大多数百万富翁都是中共高官的亲戚。
en: Indeed, there is some evidence that the overwhelming majority of multi-millionaires in China are relatives of high-ranking Communist Party officials.

zh: 所幸中国的家庭和国企创造了庞大的储蓄，才使中国经济得以承受权贵资本主义造成的资源巨大浪费和扭曲配置。
en: And, thanks to the large pool of savings generated by Chinese households and state-owned companies, the Chinese economy can for the time being bear the waste and misallocation implied by such crony capitalism.

zh: 如果不进行政治改革，这种制度的存续是不可想象的。
en: Without political reform, the long-run viability of such a system is in doubt.

zh: 温总理早在他8月份那次备受海外关注却被中国国内媒体封杀的讲话中充分阐述了这一点。
en: Premier Wen himself indicated as much in a speech in August that was widely noted abroad, but largely blacked out in Chinese media.

zh: 如今，全球媒体也是时候对中国和印度崛起中的特征进行研究，而不仅仅是简单地将其归因于市场改革的成功。
en: The global media should now go further, and begin to examine the many features of the rise of China and India that depart from the simplistic narrative of the triumph of market reform.

zh: 新的世界乱局中的中国和俄罗斯
en: China and Russia in the New World Disorder

zh: 科索沃在没有俄国默认的情况下能否实现独立，而在没有中国积极善意的情况下能否给达尔富尔危机带来人道主义的和政治解决方案？
en: Can Kosovo achieve independence without the tacit consent of Russia, and can there be a humanitarian and political solution to the tragedy in Darfur without the active goodwill of China?

zh: 这两大危机之间没有任何共同点，但是其解决之道却在很大程度上取决于这两大联合国常任理事国是否动用其否决权。
en: The two crises have nothing in common, but their resolution will depend in large part on whether these two permanent members of the United Nations Security Council use their veto power.

zh: 比较中俄两国相应的阻碍主要国际倡议的能力本身没有意义，但是这却是理解美国全球实力相对下降而直接导致的国际体系转变的有用工具。
en: Comparing the respective abilities of Russia and China to block key international initiatives makes no sense in itself, but it does constitute a useful tool for understanding the transformation of the international system that is now taking place as a direct consequence of the relative decline of America’s global power.

zh: 从这一观点来看，中东混乱加剧给中俄两国带来了机遇和风险。 这些机遇和风险有可能迫使两国确定它们想要在世界上扮演的角色和展示的形象。
en: From that standpoint, the deepening of chaos in the Middle East poses both opportunities and risks for Russia and China, which may force them to define the roles they want to play and the images they want to project in the world.

zh: 关键问题是：俄国是否在“错误的道路”上一意孤行，而中国在“正确的道路”上步履姗姗？
en: The key question is this: Is Russia taking giant steps in the “wrong direction” while China is taking “minuscule” steps in the “right direction”?

zh: 从表面上来看，俄国和中国可能给人的印象是，当它们骄傲地宣称“重返”世界舞台之际，它们正在追寻相同的道路。
en: Superficially, Russia and China may give the impression that they are pursuing the same path when they both proclaim with pride that they are “back” on the world stage.

zh: 但是这一宣扬对于这两国意味着不同的事情。
en: But this boast means different things for each country.

zh: 中国是一个高度自信的国家。 对于它而言，所谓“重返”只不过是意味着在缺席两百多年以后重新获得历史上的世界中心地位。
en: For China, a deeply self-confident country, to be “back” simply means regaining the country’s historical centrality in the world after an absence of more than two centuries.

zh: 毕竟，在十八世纪末，中国成为世界第一的制造商品国家，而且，中国自认为是文明的中心，即使不称雄世界，至少是在亚洲无可比拟。
en: After all, at the end of the eighteenth century, China became the world’s first producer of manufactured goods, and it perceives itself as a center of civilization unequalled by any other in Asia, if not the world.

zh: 中国重新树立起来的自信建立在其突出的经济实力基础之上。 其经济实力并非来自自然资源，而是来源于生产效率和创造力。
en: China’s renewed self-confidence is based on its remarkable economic prowess, which is derived not from natural resources, but from productivity and creativity.

zh: 无论有多大的政治、社会以及经济上的紧张局势，人们还是有对中国“感觉良好”的因素。 人们觉得中国取得了进步，2008年的北京奥运会成为一个标志时刻，向全世界表明中国的成就。
en: Whatever the huge political, social, and economic tensions may exist, there is a “feel good” factor in China, a sense of progress, with the 2008 Olympics in Beijing figuring as the symbolic moment that will proclaim to the world the scale of the country’s achievements.

zh: 除了台湾问题以外，中国在国际体系的转变上首先是一个取得满足的现存大国，也是一个耐心的发挥作用的国家，它认为举止得体而又被世人认为是全球第二大强国完全是合理的。
en: Above all, with the exception of the Taiwan issue, China is a satisfied status quo power when it comes to the evolution of the international system – a patient actor that finds it perfectly legitimate to behave and to be seen as the world’s number two power.

zh: 与此相比，俄国对其在世界上的地位依旧感到不牢靠。
en: By contrast, the Russians remain insecure about their status in the world.

zh: 在最近的大国集团首脑会议前夕俄国爆炸性的“修正派”行为表明克里姆林宫“心怀不满”的本性。
en: Russia’s explosive “revisionist” behavior on the eve of the recent G8 summit is an indication of the Kremlin’s “unsatisfied” nature.

zh: 因为他们知道他们不是如此强大，特别是在人口和经济方面，因此俄国人感觉到他们要“有所作为 ” 。
en: Because they know they are less potent, particularly in demographic and economic terms, Russians feel they have to do “more.”

zh: 对于他们而言，说“俄国回来了”意味着令人羞辱的叶利钦年代已经结束，而且他们必须特别是与美国平起平坐。
en: For them, to say “Russia is back” means that the humiliating Yeltsin years are over, and that they now must be treated as equals, particularly by the United States.

zh: 俄国人并非对冷战本身怀旧，而是思恋冷战结束之际他们所失去的国际地位。
en: Russians are nostalgic not for the Cold War as such, but for the international status they lost when it ended.

zh: 现在美国不再是一个没有战略性挑战者的“超级强权 ” ， 因此俄国再一次宣扬其作为“超级大国”地位，而这一宣称并非与事实相符。
en: Now that America is no longer a “hyperpower” with no strategic challengers, Russia has reasserted its status as a “superpower,” a claim that is not necessarily supported by reality.

zh: 俄国人不像中国人，他们并未创造经济财富，只不过是利用了其能源和矿产资源。 而且，与中国人不同，他们并不对自身在世界上的地位感到自信。
en: Unlike the Chinese, the Russians do not create economic wealth, but merely exploit their energy and mineral resources.

zh: 俄国从文化和政治角度而言在欧亚之间徘徊，他们深受黑暗的自恋本能所害。
en: Moreover, unlike the Chinese, they have not always been confident of their position in the world.

zh: 这一本能贯穿于他们对历史的解读和对未来观点。 因此，俄国现在像是一个“修正派”大国也就不足为奇了。
en: Torn between Europe and Asia in cultural and political terms, victimized by a dark, narcissistic instinct that pervades their reading of their past and their visions of the future, it should surprise no one that Russia is now behaving like a “revisionist” power.

zh: 俄国人对于内心认同感到不满足，他们要求可以让他们感觉更为安全和自豪的变化也就是自然而然的事情了。
en: Unsatisfied with their inner identity, it is only natural that Russians should demand changes that make them feel more secure and proud.

zh: 在不到20年前，捷克共和国和波兰是他们的势力范围，所以俄国令人理解地无法接受美国在那里单方面部署其安全防御系统。
en: Less than 20 years ago, the Czech Republic and Poland were part of their sphere of influence, so Russians understandably cannot accept the US unilaterally implanting its security system there.

zh: 当然，西方特别是欧洲人对俄国和中国作出判断可能会表现出选择性的情感。
en: Of course, in their respective judgments on Russia and China, the West – and Europeans in particular – may be demonstrating selective emotions.

zh: 因为我们趋向于将俄国人视为“欧洲人 ” （ 至少是在文化上如此 ） ， 因此“我们”趋向于对中国不像对俄国那样苛刻。
en: “We” tend to be less demanding of China than of Russia, because we tend to see Russia as “European” (at least culturally).

zh: 结果，身体上的暴力以及言语上的挑衅文化在普京统治下的俄国扎根，非常令人担忧，而我们却对中国的不良行为即使不是无动于衷，也是怀有更大的距离感。
en: As a result, the culture of physical violence and verbal provocation that is gaining ground in Putin’s Russia is deeply disturbing, whereas we tend to judge Chinese misdeeds with a greater sense of distance, if not indifference.

zh: 但是，如果中东局势恶化，构成联合国五大常任理事国的集体责任感，那么，如今中俄两国的差别在明天也就不再重要。
en: But the differences between Russia and China today may prove to be less significant tomorrow if the deterioration in the Middle East imposes a sense of collective responsibility on all five permanent members of the UN Security Council.

zh: 中俄两国利用美国在从加沙到喀布尔的范围内不断日益增加的困境是一回事；但是，如果局势恶化到整个地区总体上失去稳定，那就是另外一回事了。
en: It is one thing for Russia and China to exploit America’s growing difficulties from Gaza to Kabul; but it is quite another if the situation deteriorates to the point of general destabilization in the region.

zh: 确实，中东不断加剧的问题可能会迫使中俄两国不以其对西方的全球“微妙价值 ” ， 而是以其为世界秩序作出积极和稳定性贡献的能力来权衡而给这两个国家施加一种限制的感觉。
en: Indeed, the Middle East’s deepening problems may impose a sense of restraint in Russia and China by forcing them to calculate not in terms of their global “nuisance value” vis-à-vis the West, but in terms of their ability to make a positive and stabilizing contribution to the world order.

zh: 中国与阿富汗残局
en: China and the Afghan Endgame

zh: 发自北京 — — 自美国总统奥巴马决定从阿富汗撤军以来，全球开始对中国将在这个饱经战乱之国的未来中（如果会的话）扮演何种角色兴趣大增。
en: BEIJING – Ever since US President Barack Obama decided to begin withdrawing American troops from Afghanistan, global interest in what role (if any) China will play in determining that war-ravaged country’s future has grown dramatically.

zh: 毕竟中国不仅是阿富汗的邻国，还是全世界最重要的新兴势力 — — 事实上正如美国参谋长联席会议主席迈克·马伦在7月访问北京时所说那样，是一个“世界大国 ” 。
en: After all, China is not merely a neighbor of Afghanistan, but the world’s most important rising power – indeed, a “world power,” as Mike Mullen, Chairman of the US Joint Chiefs of Staff proclaimed in Beijing this past June.

zh: 如果中国想表明自己对阿富汗卡尔扎伊政府的支持，那它将不会试图从美国撤军中攫取任何短期利益。
en: If China proves itself willing to help shore up Afghan President Hamid Karzai’s administration, it will not seek to gain any immediate advantage from the withdrawal of US forces.

zh: 纵使中国在开发阿富汗自然资源方面的投资已达数十亿美元之巨，却依然难以观察到一个涵盖范围更广且更为主动的参与性政策。
en: But, despite the billions of dollars China has invested in developing Afghanistan’s natural resources, it is hard to see it undertaking a policy of broader and proactive engagement there.

zh: 而虽然中国在维护区域稳定方面的重要性无可置疑，但其之所以不愿在阿富汗承担更重要角色，就是因为其内部从一开始就对美国的这场战争有不同的看法。
en: One reason why China is wary of assuming a bigger role in Afghanistan, despite the country’s undoubted importance for regional stability, is that America’s war there has been controversial in China from the outset.

zh: 民族主义者认为美国在某种程度上就是想将自己的部队安插在中国其中一个最为敏感的边境地区。
en: Chinese nationalists believe that the war was undertaken by the US partly in order to place its military near one of China’s most sensitive borders.

zh: 同时为了支持阿富汗美军，美国还深入中亚地区，在吉尔吉斯斯坦租用马纳斯空军基地，而该国也与中国接壤。
en: Moreover, to supply its Afghan forces, the US deepened its military footprint in Central Asia by renting the Manas Air Base in Kyrgyzstan, which also shares a border with China.

zh: 在这些民族主义者眼中，这一切都是美国围堵中国阴谋的一部分。
en: In the eyes of Chinese nationalists, these efforts were all the part of an American conspiracy to encircle China.

zh: 因此他们也迫切希望美国早日撤军。
en: Thus, Chinese nationalists can’t wait to see the back of America’s Afghan military presence.

zh: 而对于中国的那些战略现实主义者来说，任何协助美国结束阿富汗军事行动的行为都将成为中美更宏观交易的一部分筹码。
en: For Chinese strategic realists, any support for America’s efforts to help end the Afghan insurgency should be part of a broader China-US bargain.

zh: 只要美国能重新检讨对台军售或者撤回对日本钓鱼岛/尖阁列岛主权诉求的支持，那么中国就不会在阿富汗撤军行动上做手脚。
en: China might agree not to undermine America as it withdraws only if the US agrees to rethink its arms sales to Taiwan, or to pull back from its commitment to support Japan’s claims to the Diaoyu/Senkaku islands, the ownership of which China disputes.

zh: 很显然，这种交易在美国没有什么市场。
en: Obviously, such deals will be unwelcome in the US.

zh: 考虑到上述两大中国外交政策阵营都不相信自己能从与美国合作中得益，所以他们都单纯地希望美国尽快撤军并对撤军后的阿富汗局势漠不关心。
en: Given that neither Chinese foreign-policy camp believes that it will get what it wants out of cooperating with the US, both simply want America’s withdrawal to happen as soon as possible, without concern for what Afghanistan will look like afterwards.

zh: 对这两大阵营来说，只有大国政治博弈才能保障中国的国家安全，而如果外交手段无法左右势力均衡，那么也没什么理由去卷入这么一场事件。
en: For both camps, only great-power politics matters for China’s national security, and if diplomacy cannot influence the balance of power, there is little reason to engage with an issue.

zh: 对中国的中间派来说，阿富汗是种族威胁的代名词。
en: For Chinese liberals, Afghanistan is fraught with ethnic threats.

zh: 美国曾一意孤行地拒绝了中国引渡维吾尔极端分子回国受审的要求，可见该国对中国内部至关重要的事务 — — 分离主义者对国家统一的威胁 — — 缺乏足够重视。
en: By recklessly denying China’s request to extradite Uighur extremists to China for trial, the US showed scant regard for an issue of paramount importance – the threat posed to China’s hard-won unity by separatists.

zh: 在2002至2009年间曾有新疆维吾尔族穆斯林在塔利班训练营被捕并与其他国际恐怖分子一道关押在关塔那摩监狱。
en: Muslim Uighurs from Xinjiang province were captured in Taliban training campus and jailed at Guantánamo Bay with other international terrorists from 2002 through 2009.

zh: 中国认为引渡这些人回国受审将有效化解国际上对维吾尔族独立分子的同情情绪。
en: China thought their extradition necessary to undercutting international sympathy for Uighur independence seekers.

zh: 但美国却担心中国会做出侵犯人权行为并拒绝引渡。
en: But the US worried about the potential for human-rights abuses in China and rejected the Uighurs’ extradition.

zh: 事实上，美国前总统小布什在白宫接待维吾尔族独立运动流亡领导人热比娅·卡德尔的行为激怒了许多中国人。
en: Indeed, former President George W. Bush welcomed Rebiya Kadeer, a leader of the exiled Uighur independence movement, to the White House, embittering many Chinese.

zh: 同时考虑到维吾尔族聚居的新疆自治区靠近中国与阿富汗和巴基斯坦的边境，美国在这方面激怒中国显然是不明智的。
en: And given that the Uighur bastion of Xinjiang is close to China’s borders with Afghanistan and Pakistan, the US was unwise to raise Chinese hackles in this way.

zh: 当然，一个稳定，有秩序而且世俗的阿富汗既符合中国的利益，也符合全世界的利益。
en: Of course, a stable, orderly, and secular Afghanistan serves China’s interests as much as it benefits the rest of the world.

zh: 但仍然只有很少中国人愿意承认是美国领导下的阿富汗战争推翻了塔利班和基地组织在这个国家的统治地位，并因此改善了中国的国内安全形势。
en: Yet few Chinese are willing to confess that the US-led Afghanistan war, which removed the Taliban and Al Qaeda from their dominant roles in the country, improved China’s domestic security.

zh: 而这种抗拒显然是目前中美两国之间存在的“结构性”矛盾心理的结果。
en: That refusal is clearly the result of the “structural” ambivalence that now exists between the US and China.

zh: 中国积极参与阿富汗事务的程度将在很大程度上取决于其能否摒弃当前的这种零和博弈思维，并通过稳定阿富汗局势来协助美国的撤军行动。
en: The extent to which China will engage Afghanistan positively will depend in large part on whether China rids itself of the prevailing zero-sum mindset and facilitates America’s military withdrawal by doing what it can to stabilize the country.

zh: 中国可以通过增强巴基斯坦军队更大规模扫荡本国塔利班极端分子的决心；开放边境地区来协助阿富汗北约部队补给；以及投资阿富汗国内基础设施的方式来提供帮助。
en: China can help by stiffening the resolve of Pakistan’s military to move more aggressively to contain Taliban extremists on its territory; open border regions to help resupply NATO forces in Afghanistan; and invest in the country’s infrastructure.

zh: 事实上由于巴基斯坦和美国之间的紧张关系，中国和巴基斯坦两国关系的重要性最近更加凸显。
en: Indeed, China’s relations with Pakistan have assumed greater importance recently, owing to the tensions that now exist between Pakistan and the US.

zh: 奥巴马当局当前的挑战就是调整最近停止向巴基斯坦提供军事援助的做法来增大其影响力并避免巴国政府��续向恐怖分子靠拢。
en: The Obama administration’s challenge nowadays is to calibrate its recent suspension of some military aid to Pakistan in order to maximize its leverage without pushing the government even closer to the extremists.

zh: 通过与美国在巴基斯坦并肩合作，中国能在巴基斯坦向武装分子发动强大攻势的同时确保自身利益。
en: By working with the US on Pakistan, China can help secure its own interest in a strong Pakistani campaign against the militants on its territory.

zh: 不管在布什时代与美国在关塔那摩维吾尔族囚犯方面发生的争执，中国如今已经占据了一个更有利的地位去告诉自己在伊斯兰堡的“全天候”盟友：阿富汗的稳定不但是美国的事，也是中国的一个重要目标。
en: Regardless of the Bush-era disputes with the US over the Uighur prisoners at Guantánamo, China is in a better position to tell its “all-weather” friends in Islamabad that stabilizing Afghanistan is not only an American objective, but a significant Chinese goal as well.

zh: 中国的协助行动可能对消灭基地组织和其他武装人员方面并非必要，但对实现阿富汗的长治久安却是必不可少。
en: China’s cooperation may not be essential to defeating Al Qaeda and other militants in Afghanistan, but it will be if lasting peace and stability is to be realized.

zh: 中美两国在阿富汗的利益或许永远无法重合，但双方可以并必须学会为各自以及该区域的利益展开合作。
en: Chinese and US interests in Afghanistan are unlikely ever to be perfectly aligned, but the two sides can and must learn to cooperate for their own benefit, and that of the region.

zh: 中国的挑战则在于无论中国人在从台湾到中国东海，南海等一系列广范事务上对美国如何不满，也要以一种与美国相协调的方式来施加其实力和影响力。
en: The challenge for China is to exert its power and influence in a way that harmonizes with the US, despite widespread displeasure among Chinese at America’s position on a variety of issues, from Taiwan to the East and South China seas.

zh: 两种创新经济
en: The Two Innovation Economies

zh: 香港—250年来，技术创新推动了经济发展。
en: HONG KONG – For 250 years, technological innovation has driven economic development.

zh: 但对于创新先锋和创新追随和赶超者来说，创新经济学是大不相同的。
en: But the economics of innovation are very different for those at the frontier versus those who are followers striving to catch up.

zh: 对创新先锋来说，创新经济始于发现，极于投机。
en: At the frontier, the innovation economy begins with discovery and culminates in speculation.

zh: 从科学研究到新技术的商业应用的认识，进步一直是在试错中实现的。
en: From scientific research to identification of commercial applications of new technologies, progress has been achieved through trial and error.

zh: 一再改变市场经济的战略性技术 — — 从铁路到互联网 — — 需要网络建设，而在首次建成之前，网络的价值无法为人所知。
en: The strategic technologies that have repeatedly transformed the market economy – from railroads to the Internet – required the construction of networks whose value in use could not be known when they were first deployed.

zh: 结果，前沿创新取决于资金来源，而与经济价值考虑无甚关联；因此，不能把它同最优资源配置问题等量齐观。
en: Consequently, innovation at the frontier depends on funding sources that are decoupled from concern for economic value; thus, it cannot be reduced to the optimal allocation of resources.

zh: 在解释前沿创新过程方面，新古典经济学的常规生产函数起到了危险的误导作用。
en: The conventional production function of neoclassical economics offers a dangerously misleading lens through which to interpret the processes of frontier innovation.

zh: 金融投机一直是且现在仍是资金的必要来源之一。
en: Financial speculation has been, and remains, one required source of funding.

zh: 金融泡沫产生于高流动性资产市场存在之处。
en: Financial bubbles emerge wherever liquid asset markets exist.

zh: 事实上，投机的目标物远超你的想象：郁金香花球、金矿和银矿、房地产、新国的债务、公司证券，等等。
en: Indeed, the objects of such speculation astound the imagination: tulip bulbs, gold and silver mines, real estate, the debt of new nations, corporate securities.

zh: 偶尔，投机的目标物也会是基础技术 — — 运河、铁路、电气化、无线电、汽车、微电子、计算、互联网 — — 金融投机客为此动员的资本规模远远超过了“理性”投资者所能提供的量级。
en: Occasionally, the object of speculation has been one of those fundamental technologies – canals, railroads, electrification, radio, automobiles, microelectronics, computing, the Internet – for which financial speculators have mobilized capital on a scale far beyond what “rational” investors would provide.

zh: 失败是免不了的，但新经济就是这样不断地在投机废墟中崛起。
en: From the wreckage that has inevitably followed, a succession of new economies has emerged.

zh: 作为投机角色的补充，活跃的国家也在鼓励创新中起着作用。
en: Complementing the role of speculation, activist states have played several roles in encouraging innovation.

zh: 它们在追求政治上合法又超越狭义境计算机的创新中最有效果，比如社会发展、国家安全、疾病防治。
