en: They have been most effective when pursuing politically legitimate missions that transcend narrow economic calculation: social development, national security, conquering disease.

zh: 在美国，政府建设了交通运输网络（州际高速公路系统 ） 、 大量补贴它们的建设（洲际铁路 ） ， 或在设计和早期开发中扮演基础性角色（互联网 ） 。
en: In the United States, the government constructed transformational networks (the interstate highway system), massively subsidized their construction (the transcontinental railroads), or played the foundational role in their design and early development (the Internet).

zh: 全世界的活跃的国家都为基础科学提供资金，并充当着由此产生的新奇产品的早期客户。
en: Activist states around the world have funded basic science and served as early customers for the novel products that result.

zh: 一个著名的例子是，在1950年开始的25年中，美国国防部将这两个角色合而为一，建设了今天数字经济的基础。
en: For a quarter-century starting in 1950, the US Department of Defense – to cite one crucial example – combined both roles to build the underpinnings of today’s digital economy.

zh: 对于作为创新领导者的追随者的国家来说，路径是明确的。
en: For countries following an innovative leader, the path is clear.

zh: 保护和补贴的重商主义政策一直是经济活跃国家的有效工具。
en: Mercantilist policies of protection and subsidy have been effective instruments of an economically active state.

zh: 在美国，第一批盈利纺织厂极大地侵害了英国专利。
en: In the US, the first profitable textile mills blatantly violated British patents.

zh: 凶残的创业私营企业背后是大量国家投资、担保和保护性关税，即亚历山大·汉密尔顿启发、亨利·克莱（Henry Clay）发扬光大的“美国体系 ” （ American System ） 。
en: And ferociously entrepreneurial private enterprise was supported by a broad array of state investments, guarantees, and protective tariffs, in accordance with the “American System” inspired by Alexander Hamilton and realized by Henry Clay.

zh: 1841年，被人忽视的伟大德国经济学家、汉密尔顿的门徒弗雷德里希·李斯特（Friedrich List）在其著作《国家政治经济制度 》 （ National System of Political Economy）为其祖国勾画和创新路线图。
en: The great, neglected German economist Friedrich List, a student of Hamilton’s work, laid out an innovation roadmap for his own country in 1841, in his National System of Political Economy.

zh: 它被反复使用：19世纪最后一个十年的日本、二十世纪下半叶的东亚诸小龙，以及现在的中国。
en: It has been used repeatedly: by Japan beginning in the last decades of the nineteenth century; by the Asian Tigers in the second half of the twentieth century; and now by China.

zh: 李斯特论证了英国是如何依赖国家政策促进英国工业而在18世纪末成为“第一个工业化国家”的。
en: List noted how Britain’s emergence as “the first industrial nation” at the end of the eighteenth century depended on prior state policies to promote British industry.

zh: “如果英国人把所有东西都留给自己 ， ” 他写道 ， “ 那么比利时人现在仍在为英国人做衣服 ， （ 而）英国现在仍是（汉萨同盟）的大羊圈。 ”
en: “Had the English left everything to itself,” he wrote, “the Belgians would be still manufacturing cloth for the English, [and] England would still have been the sheepyard for the [Hanseatic League].”

zh: 刺激经济赶超的连贯计划相对来说较为直观。
en: Coherent programs to promote economic catch-up are relatively straightforward.

zh: 但从追随者转变为创新经济的前沿领导者更具挑战，也更困难。
en: But the transition from follower to leader at the frontier of the innovation economy is more challenging and elusive.

zh: 美国大约在1880—1930年期间完成了这一转型，它将管理专业化与新技术（电气化、汽车和无线电）的投机性尝试以及国家对第二次工业革命的大型产业垄断者（它们将超高利润投入到科学研究中）的容忍结合了起来。
en: The US managed the transition roughly between 1880 and 1930, combining the professionalization of management with a speculative taste for new technologies – electrification, automobiles, and radio – and state tolerance of the Second Industrial Revolution’s great industrial monopolies, which invested their super-profits in scientific research.

zh: 二战后，国家安全的创新成为经济活跃国家合法化的理由，这也扩大了美国的领先地位。
en: The post-World War II invocation of national security as the legitimizing rationale for an economically active state extended America’s leadership.

zh: 东亚经济强国是否能成功完成从追随者到前沿领导者的转型还不得而知。
en: It is not yet clear whether East Asia’s economic powerhouses will succeed in making the transition from follower to frontier.

zh: 首先，赶超阶段的“国家冠军”必须去面对激烈的竞争。
en: To begin, the “national champions” of the catch-up phase must be rendered accessible to competitive assault.

zh: 更一般地说，国家的角色必须从执行明确的计划转型为支持试错实验和容忍创业失败。
en: More generally, the state’s role must shift from executing well-defined programs to supporting trial-and-error experimentation and tolerating entrepreneurial failure.

zh: 而看似经济进步阶段不可避免的、具有削弱性质的“腐败税”必须得到遏制，就像英国在19世纪、美国在20世纪做的那样。
en: And the debilitating “corruption tax” that seems inevitably to accompany economic revolutions must be curbed, as it was in Britain during the nineteenth century and America during the twentieth.

zh: 战略不确定性时刻就出现在这里。
en: Here is the moment of strategic uncertainty.

zh: “美国制造”数字经济在私人部门表现出强劲动力。
en: The “made in America” digital economy exhibits ample momentum in the private sector.

zh: 但未来新经济的领袖 — — 低碳经济 — — 是开放的。
en: But leadership of the next new economy – the low-carbon economy – is open.

zh: 美国正在承受长达一代人时间的判定国家为非法经济行为人的努力带来的后果。
en: America is suffering the consequences of a generation-long effort to render the state illegitimate as an economic actor.

zh: 欧洲陷入了它的“扩张性财政紧缩”的矛盾承诺的泥淖。
en: Europe is mired in its oxymoronic commitment to “expansionary fiscal austerity.”

zh: 中国可以完成必须的经济、文化和政治转型，在见者有份的领导权之争中脱颖而出吗？
en: Can China manage the economic, cultural, and political transitions necessary to assume the leadership role now up for grabs?

zh: 我认为，回顾200年前英国第一次工业革命即将启动时的政治经济学是大有裨益的。
en: I find it intriguing to go back almost 200 years and consider Britain’s political economy when the First Industrial Revolution was gathering steam.

zh: 1820年的英国由腐败的寡头政治统治，紧密的联盟与国教体系把持着权力。
en: England in 1820 was governed by a corrupt oligarchy that exercised power in intimate collaboration with a national religious establishment.

zh: 政治合法性来自于对无政府主义的恐慌 — — 海峡对岸的可怕事实就在眼前，相去未远。
en: Political legitimacy was validated by fear of anarchy, the terrifying reality of which had been observable across the Channel within living memory.

zh: 专制、严厉的压迫就是规则：根据刑事判决的“血腥法典 ” ， 有100多项罪名可判死刑或流刑。
en: Arbitrary, draconian repression was the rule: under the “Bloody Code” of criminal justice, more than 100 felonies were punishable by death or transportation.

zh: 专利制度以昂贵和不可获得而闻名。
en: The patent system was notoriously expensive and inaccessible.

zh: 英国统治者徒劳地试图遏制人类历史上最伟大的经济能量和金融财富大爆发的发生。
en: England’s rulers sought in vain to keep a lid on the greatest explosion of economic energy and financial wealth in human history.

zh: 在很长一段时期内，英国完成了转型。
en: Over a long generation, England was transformed.

zh: 从1832年改革法案到1846年谷物法的废除 — — 以及1853年开始的公务员改革和1867年的人民代表法案 — — 英国开创了独一无二的迈向相对稳定而可持续的民主资本主义之路。
en: From the Great Reform Act of 1832 to the repeal of the Corn Laws in 1846 – and on to the civil-service reforms initiated in 1853 and the Representation of the People Act of 1867 – Britain pursued its unique path toward a relatively stable and sustainable democratic capitalism.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国自身的道路别具一格，一如它抵达当前机会时刻的过程。
en: No doubt China’s own path will be as distinctive as the processes by which it has reached its current moment of opportunity.

zh: 它的道路是否向英国的道路一样具有进步性或许将决定谁会获得全球经济领导权。
en: Whether or not its path proves to be as progressive as England’s may determine who assumes the mantle of global economic leadership.

zh: 中国贪污还是增长？
en: Graft or Growth in China?

zh: 北京—中国国家主席习近平的反腐运动已经将许多政府中的“大老虎”拉下马，这场运动被广泛视为中国构建更加可持续、更加包容、更加市场的经济所需要的深刻结构改革的关键要素。
en: BEIJING – Chinese President Xi Jinping’s anti-corruption campaign, which has already brought down many high-ranking “tigers” in the government, has been widely touted as a key component of the deep structural reforms that China needs if it is to build a more sustainable, inclusive, and market-based economy.

zh: 但这引起的担心，在中国这样一个政府官员对刺激经济增长起着主要作用的国家，根除腐败有可能不利于繁荣。
en: But worries abound that, in a country where government officials play a major role in promoting economic growth, rooting out corruption might undermine prosperity.

zh: 一些人将最近豪华饭店和餐厅（在中国，它们很大程度上是靠政府支出支撑起来的）惨淡经营的状况视为反腐运动不利于强化增长的活动的证据。
en: Some have cited the recent struggles of luxury hotels and restaurants (which, in China, are supported largely by government spending) as evidence that the anti-corruption campaign is discouraging growth-enhancing activity.

zh: 但衰退很有可能是暂时的，新客户在经过一段时间的调整后将陆续出现。
en: But the decline is likely to be temporary, with new customers emerging after a period of adjustment.

zh: 更加可信的担忧是根除腐败的努力是否削弱政府官员刺激增长的激励。
en: A more credible concern is whether efforts to root out corruption weaken the incentive for government officials to promote growth.

zh: 毕竟，高增长水平能带来大量租（rent ） ， 而租通过腐败行为在官员本人、他们朋友和亲信之间进行分配。
en: After all, high levels of growth translate into large rents that can, through corrupt practices, be distributed to the officials themselves, as well as to their friends and protégé.

zh: 逻辑上，消灭这一行为意味着官员将无法从经济增长中获得大量好处 — — 因此也就没有很强的动力刺激增长。
en: Eliminate such practices, the logic goes, and officials will be unable to reap large rewards from economic growth – and thus will be less motivated to encourage it.

zh: 但这一观点很不严密。
en: But this argument is far from airtight.

zh: 腐败最常见的形式之一是“贩卖”政府职位 — — 这一行为和增长没有什么关系，特别是对高级军官而言，比如那些在反腐运动中因收受贿赂升迁部下的解放军将领。
en: Among the most common forms of corruption is the “sale” of government positions – a practice that has little to do with growth, especially when it is conducted by high-ranking officers in the army, such as the Peoples’ Liberation Army generals who have been arrested during the campaign for trading promotions for bribes.

zh: 另一个主要担忧是，如果企业不再能够“走后门 ” — —即贿赂官员允许他们规避过度监管 — — 业绩将受到影响。
en: Another major concern is that, if businesses are no longer able to “grease the wheels” – that is, bribe officials to allow them to circumvent excessive regulations – their performance could suffer.

zh: 而事实上，虽然经历了30年的改革，但中国经济仍饱受红头文件束缚，这极大地影响了生产率。
en: And, indeed, even after 30 years of reform, China’s economy remains bound by red tape, which drags down productivity considerably.

zh: 但这一逻辑也存在漏洞。
en: But there are holes in this logic, too.

zh: 最重要的是，如果这类贿赂规模可以达到大幅或可持续地刺激经济增长的成都，那么必须是各种企业普遍都在这样做 — — 而不只是最富有、关系最硬的企业这样做。
en: Most important, for such bribery to boost economic growth in any significant or sustainable way, it would have to be conducted by a wide range of businesses – not just the wealthiest and best connected.

zh: 如今的情况并非如此；大部分被起诉中国官员都只从一位商人处收受贿赂，让他的企业获得垄断地位。
en: That is not the case today; most Chinese officials who have been charged so far have taken bribes from a single businessman, thereby allowing his business to acquire a monopoly position.

zh: 因此，贿赂或许在一定程度上刺激了中国的增长，但并没有营造出支持长期增长的竞争性商业环境。
en: So, while bribery in China may facilitate growth to some extent, it does not produce the kind of competitive business environment that supports long-term gains.

zh: 事实上，现实是腐败给企业带来了一项沉重的、往往是随机出现的税负，尤其是这样做让官员更加不愿放松束缚所有企业的红头文件 — — 而这才是真正的刺激增长的行为。
en: Indeed, the reality is that corruption imposes a large, often random, tax on businesses, not least by discouraging officials from cutting red tape for all firms – a move that really would boost growth.

zh: 结论很清楚：腐败之弊远大于利 — — 不仅中国如此。
en: The conclusion is clear: the costs of corruption far outweigh the benefits – and not only in China.

zh: 自二战以来，许多国家都试图从低收入国家变成高收入国家，但只有13个国家取得了成功 — — 而它们的官员腐败情况均相对较好。
en: Since World War II, many countries have attempted the transition from low- to high-income status, but only 13 have succeeded – and all had relatively low levels of official corruption.

zh: 因此，你也许会问，中国式如何在腐败猖獗的情况下实现过去20年如此迅速的增长的。
en: Given this, one might ask how China managed to achieve such impressive growth over the last 20 years, despite rampant corruption.

zh: 答案也许在于其“选拔制 ” （ selectocracy ） 。
en: The answer probably lies in its “selectocracy.”

zh: 与民主国家公民根据自己所选择的标准选举政府官员不同，在中国的选拔制中，中共遴选升迁官员的基础是他们是否有能力推进党的主要目标 — — 特别是增长。
en: Unlike in a democracy, where citizens elect their government officials based on whatever criteria they choose, in China’s selectocracy, the Chinese Communist Party chooses officials for promotion based on their ability to advance the party’s main objectives – especially growth.

zh: 当然，政治关系和忠诚也在升迁决定中起着作用，特别是在政府高层。
en: Of course, political connections and loyalty also factor into promotion decisions, especially at higher levels of government.

zh: 但是，美国政治学家皮埃尔·拉迪（Pierre Landry）及其同事观察到，经济增长才是关键，特别是在市级层次。 政府的增长强化措施 — — 如基础设施投资 — — 大部分在市级层次展开。
en: But, as the US-based political scientist Pierre Landry and his colleagues have observed, economic growth is key, particularly among officials at the county and municipal levels, where much of the government’s growth-enhancing activities – such as infrastructure investment – take place.

zh: 升迁为官员提供了刺激增长的强大正激励。
en: Promotions provide officials with a strong positive incentive to boost growth.

zh: 以铁道部前部长刘志军为例，他推动了中国高铁建设的高潮。
en: Consider Liu Zhijun, the former railway minister, who propelled China’s frenzy of high-speed rail construction.

zh: 他对职业成就的渴望 — — 特别是对升迁的渴望 — — 驱动他为中国GDP增长做出了巨大贡献。
en: His yearning for professional achievement – and, especially, his desire to be promoted – motivated his significant contributions to China’s GDP growth.

zh: 但刘志军大量滥用权力 — — 包括2011年被捕时收受超过1亿美元贿赂 — — 给国家造成了巨大经济损失。
en: But Liu also engaged in massive abuses of power – including accepting more than $10 million in bribes by the time he was arrested in 2011 – that resulted in significant economic losses for the state.

zh: 他的死缓判罚应该有助于威慑其他官员效而仿之。
en: His (suspended) death sentence should help to deter other officials from choosing the same path.

zh: 如果腐败官员可以为增长做出如此巨大的贡献，可以想象一下遵纪守法的官员能怎么做。
en: If corrupt officials can make such significant contributions to growth, imagine what law-abiding officials could do.

zh: 他们所需要的不过是积极主动的激励。
en: All they need are strong incentives to be proactive.

zh: 从这个角度讲，中国的“选拔制 ” — —承诺在刺激增长方面效率最高的官员能获得升迁 — — 也许是解释中国辉煌经济增长记录的关键。
en: In this sense, China’s “selectocracy,” which promises promotions to the officials who prove most effective in promoting growth, could be the key to explaining the country’s impressive economic track record.

zh: 中国硅谷的崛起
en: The Rise of Silicon China

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 人工智能的硅谷将在未来（或者可以说是已经）出现在中国。
en: CAMBRIDGE – In the future, if not already, the Silicon Valleys of artificial intelligence (AI) will be in China.

zh: 小米，百度，滴滴出行，美团和今日头条等科技企业都将总部设在北京。
en: The tech firms Xiaomi, Baidu, Didi Chuxing, Meituan, and Toutiao are all headquartered in Beijing.

zh: 阿里巴巴这个中国电子商务巨头位于杭州。
en: Alibaba, China’s e-commerce giant, is based in Hangzhou.

zh: 另一家在人工智能上投入巨资的跨国企业集团腾讯则位于深圳。
en: And Tencent, a multinational conglomerate that is investing heavily in AI, is in Shenzhen.

zh: 腾讯的股票总市值已经高于通用电气，而百度则早就超越了通用汽车。
en: Tencent already has a market capitalization higher than General Electric, and Baidu is larger than General Motors.

zh: 而中国之所以有机会引领人工智能技术的发展，是因为它采用新技术的速度极快。
en: China has a chance to lead in AI because it has managed to adopt new technologies very quickly.

zh: 就像印度的数百万消费者跳过固定电话和翻盖手机直接从无电话跨越到智能手机一样，中国消费者现在也实现了类似的跨越并采用了各类新技术。
en: Just as millions of consumers in India went directly from no phones to smartphones – skipping landlines and flip phones altogether – Chinese consumers are now doing the same, and across a wide range of new technologies.

zh: 比如中国消费者已经跳过信用卡去直接使用电子支付平台。
en: For example, Chinese shoppers have skipped credit cards and gone straight to using e-payment platforms.

zh: 这边Apple Pay还在美国挣扎求增长，那边腾讯已经每天操作6亿多笔无现金交易了。
en: While Apple Pay is struggling to gain momentum in the United States, Tencent is already facilitating more than 600 million cashless transactions every day.

zh: 腾讯以及其他中国企业的大规模集中化平台让他们在人工智能研究和开发方面享有优势，允许他们生成并收集大量数据以完善自身的机器学习算法。
en: Tencent and other Chinese firms’ massive centralized platforms give them an edge in AI research and development, by allowing them to generate and collect huge stores of data with which to train their machine-learning algorithms.

zh: 这些平台也享有近乎垄断的势力，这将有助于它们在未来实现人工智能应用程序的货币化。
en: These platforms also enjoy near-monopolistic power, which will help them monetize AI applications in the future.

zh: 此外这些中国企业也在从中国的隐私文化规范中受益。
en: Moreover, Chinese firms are benefiting from Chinese cultural norms concerning privacy.

zh: 在西方，隐私被视为个人对私有空间所拥有的权利，并且延伸至个人数据方面。
en: In the West, privacy is regarded as a personal right to one’s own space and, by extension, to one’s data.

zh: 这种隐私概念对个人有益，在某种程度上对社会也有好处；但对于人工智能开发人员来说可不是个好消息，因为他们苦于搜集所需的数据来训练自己的算法。
en: This conception of privacy is good for individuals and, arguably, for society; but it is bad for AI developers, who face hurdles accessing the data they need to train their algorithms.

zh: 相反在中国文化中人们会以怀疑的眼光看到隐私，将其视作一种偷偷摸摸的行径。
en: By contrast, in Chinese culture, privacy is viewed suspiciously, as a form of secrecy.

zh: 他们认为一个诚实的人应该是在公众面前没什么可以隐瞒的，所以中国消费者往往乐于交出他们的数据。
en: It is assumed that an honest person should have nothing to hide from the public domain, so Chinese consumers are often happy to give up their data.

zh: 与已经采用了“资讯权”的印度和将“被遗忘权”写入法律的欧盟不同，对于中国的数据隐私问题还未进行过任何严肃讨论。
en: Unlike in India, whose Supreme Court affirmed the right to privacy as a fundamental right, and the European Union, which has codified a “right to be forgotten,” there has not been any serious discussion about data privacy in China.

zh: 这对中国的科技企业来说再好不过了。
en: That suits Chinese technology firms just fine.

zh: 中国的法律框架允许科技公司收集各种用户数据去服务于各类目的，例如构建阿里巴巴的芝麻信用这类社会评分系统。
en: The legal framework in China allows tech firms to collect a wide range of user data for a wide range of purposes, such as constructing social-scoring systems, like Alibaba’s Sesame Credit.

zh: 尽管如此，国内外的有限融资和投资机会可能会削弱中国在人工智能以及相关领域的发展势头。
en: Still, limited financing and investment opportunities – both at home and abroad – could slow China’s momentum in AI and related fields.

zh: 中国储户不太愿意将钱存入中国的银行，因为通胀率比存款的实际回报率要高。
en: Chinese savers have little incentive to put their money in Chinese banks, because the rate of inflation is higher than the real rate of return on deposits.

zh: 此外考虑到中国消费价格波动较大，许多人都不想把储蓄长期放在那里不动。
en: And given China’s high consumer-price volatility, many people are hesitant to lock up their savings for long.

zh: 此外只要中国的经济增长率系统性地高于股票市场表现，就没有理由去投资上海证券交易所综合指数。
en: Moreover, there is little reason to invest in the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index so long as economic growth rates are systematically higher than stock-market performance.

zh: 投资者一直都担心2015年的股灾会重演 — — 当时市场的动荡引发了政府出手干预，股价大幅下跌以及几次交易暂停。
en: And investors are wary of a repeat of 2015, when market turbulence led to government intervention, sharply falling prices, and several trading halts.

zh: 政府当时确实成功稳住了股价，但却是通过为经纪商创造额外激励机制，同时禁止卖空并对卖出股票设置一定的门槛来实现的。
en: The government did manage to stabilize prices, but it did so by creating added incentives for brokers and banning short-sells and the sale of stocks above a certain threshold.

zh: 第三个问题是住房价格的稳步上涨使得所有风险资产的投资风险进一步加大。
en: A third problem is that a steady increase in housing prices has made investment in all risk assets riskier.

zh: 中国人民银行行长周小川如今发言要求警惕“明斯基时刻 ” ， 因为中国在抵押贷款推动下不断增长的家庭债务可能导致资产价格突然崩溃。
en: Zhou Xiaochuan, the governor of the People’s Bank of China, is now warning of a “Minsky moment,” whereby China’s growing mortgage-fueled household debt could lead to a sudden asset-price collapse.

zh: 最后一个问题是中国企业所面临的海外投资限制。
en: A final problem is that Chinese firms face limitations in investing overseas.

zh: 除了中国政府自身的资本管制外，美国政府一直在考虑对面向本国重要战略意义产业的中国投资施加更严格的限制，特别是那些与人工智能和机器学习相关的产业。
en: In addition to the Chinese government’s own capital controls, the US government has been considering tighter restrictions on Chinese investments in strategically important sectors, particularly those relating to AI and machine learning.

zh: 事实上美国的监管机构最近就以国家安全为由否决了阿里巴巴收购速汇金（MoneyGram）的提案。
en: In fact, US regulators recently blocked Alibaba’s attempt to acquire MoneyGram, citing national-security concerns.

zh: 中国领导下的人工智能革命既有机遇，也有挑战。
en: The prospect of a China-led AI revolution poses both opportunities and challenges.

zh: 从西方的角度来看，这为与世界上其中一个最具活力经济体的更广泛合作打开了大门，可以将中国更深入地纳入基于规则的国际秩序之中。
en: From the perspective of the West, it could allow for more collaboration with one of the world’s most dynamic economies. And it could bring China more deeply into the fold of the rules-based international order.

zh: 但与此同时，中国在人工智能方面的领先地位很可能会引发中国企业与国外监管机构之间的更多冲突。
en: Yet, at the same time, China’s lead in AI will likely occasion more clashes between Chinese firms and foreign regulators.

zh: 中国的科技巨头正在向全球扩张，它们对数据收集和隐私的处理方式有可能会让其他国家左右为难。
en: China’s tech giants are expanding internationally, and their approach to data collection and privacy will present a dilemma for other countries.

zh: 而西方面临的挑战将是如何在降低与这个不自由国家做生意的风险的同时不至于丢失来自中国的投资和创新。
en: The challenge will be to contain the risks of doing business with an illiberal state, without losing out on Chinese investments and innovations.

zh: 超级中国
en: China as a Superpower

zh: 柏林 — —
en: YALTA – Given its rapid and successful development, there can be no doubt that the People’s Republic of China will become one of the dominant global powers of the twenty-first century. Indeed, despite the massive problems that the country is confronting, it could even emerge as the global power.

zh: 近年来，中国的发展速度飞快、成效显著，在二十一世纪的国际舞台上，它必将扮演主要角色。
en: But it would be a mistake to assume that the reemergence of so-called “XXL powers” like China and India will simply bring a continuation of Western traditions.

zh: 事实上，尽管面临挑战，中华人民共和国有可能在这幕大戏中担当领衔主演。
en: We will have to deal with a different type of superpower.

zh: 然而 ， “ 超大号”强国再度登场并不意味着中印等新角儿会延续老一代西方列强的做派，超级大国的内涵也在发生变化。
en: Ever since the European powers set sail at the end of the fifteenth century to conquer the world, historiography and international politics have become accustomed to a certain pattern: military, economic, and technological power is translated into the exercise of influence over other countries, conquest, and even global dominance and empire.

zh: 自十五世纪末欧洲各国开辟航路、征服世界以来，史学和国际政治学界已经习惯将军事活动、经济发展、技术演变都解释为国家间相互影响、弱肉强食甚至争夺全球霸权的结果。
en: This was particularly true in the twentieth century, when, in the wake of two world wars, the United States and the Soviet Union replaced the European world powers on the global stage. The Cold War and the period of US global dominance after 1989/1990 followed this pattern as well.

zh: 这种认知模式在二十世纪尤为盛行，特别是在两次世界大战之后，美苏取代欧洲占据强势，冷战以及之后美国全球霸主地位的确立，其间许多事件都因国际影响促成。
en: But China’s rise to global power, I believe, will not, owing to its massive population of 1.2 billion people, which threatens to overstretch the structures of any kind of government system and its decision makers. This is all the more true in times of rapid fundamental change, as is occurring in China now.

zh: 但我相信，中国崛起的模式将会有所不同：其政策重心将会较为内向。
en: The permanent danger of overstretching the country’s internal political structures is unlikely to permit any imperial foreign-policy role.

zh: 原因在于中国人口众多，政府 — — 特别是在目前的变革过程中 — — 面对来自强大的内部压力，这确保了中国无暇施行强权外交，美国的霸主地位进而尚可留存，除非它自愿放弃。
en: Insofar as this is true, the United States won’t be replaced as the dominant power unless and until it abdicates that role. This may sound simple, but it will have far-reaching consequences for the coming century’s international order.

zh: 这一重心的改变说来轻巧，却可能对本世纪的国际格局产生深远影响。
en: The vital interests guiding Chinese policy are internal modernization, the ruling regime’s political stability and survival, and the country’s unity (which includes Taiwan). These interests are unlikely to change for a long time.

zh: 长期来看，中国的核心利益和政策重点在于国内现代化、执政党地位的持续稳定和国家统一（包括台湾问题 ） 。
en: As a result, China will become a largely inward-looking superpower, which – precisely for that reason – will pursue its foreign-policy interests in a completely unsentimental manner.

zh: 所以，中国将成为一个主要关注国内的超级大国，因而奉行实事求是的外交政策。
en: Militarily, China will focus primarily on its regional supremacy, because the country’s unity depends on it.

zh: 军事方面，中国将主要谋求地区内的控制权，以确保国家统一。 另外，为巩固执政党地位，国内经济社会改革也至关重要。
en: Otherwise, though, the transformation of China’s economy and society will be all-important, because the regime’s stability depends on it.

zh: 因此，将经济增长速度维持在年均10%的高水平对中国政府而言意义重大。
en: For the Chinese leadership, this means that a growth rate of about 10% per year will be essential for a long time.

zh: 否则，由农业向“超现代”工业的剧变必将引发社会动荡。
en: Otherwise, the rapid and fundamental transformation of the country from a largely agrarian to an ultra-modern industrialized society could not proceed without destabilizing the system.

zh: 将发展重心置于国内也会带来重大的政治影响。
en: But this focus on internal growth will have massive political consequences, both domestically and in foreign-policy terms.

zh: 就国内来看，鉴于其经济规模和增长需求，中国必将成为首个“绿色”经济体，以避免“增长的极限 ” 、 环境灾难以及政治上的负面影响。
en: Domestically, China will be the first country that, due to its sheer size and required GDP growth, is forced to pursue a “green” economy. Otherwise, China would quickly reach its “limits to growth,” with disastrous ecological and, as a result, political consequences.

zh: 未来，中国将成为最重要的商品市场，不仅参与生产消费过程，还将定义商业模式。
en: Since China will be the most important market of the future, it will be decisive in determining not only what we produce and consume, but how.

zh: 以传统汽车业向电动运输产业的转变为例，尽管欧洲厂家仍存在主导市场的幻想，但在这一转变中起决定作用的将只能是中国。
en: Consider the transition from the traditional automobile to electric transport. Despite European illusions to the contrary, this will be decided in China, not in the West.

zh: 欧美汽车业所能选择的只有：要么适应转变免于出局，要么像其他老牌西方工业一样：到发展中国家中发展。
en: All that will be decided by the West’s globally dominant automobile industry is whether it will adapt and have a chance to survive or go the way of other old Western industries: to the developing world.

zh: 就外交而言，为保证国内产业升级，中国将力图从外国获取原料并打入国际市场。
en: In foreign-policy terms, China will attempt to protect its domestic transformation by securing resources and access to foreign markets.

zh: 然而，中国政府迟早会意识到，对本国外交利益来讲，美国扮演的“全球总管”角色是不可或缺的，因为中国或其他国家难以承担这一重任，则美国的失势必将引发国际秩序的解构。
en: Sooner or later, though, China’s government will come to realize that America’s role as a global regulator is indispensible for China’s vital foreign-policy interests, because China is unable to assume that role, other global players aren’t available, and the only alternative to the US would be a breakdown of order.

zh: 美中并行的国际格局也远非全无争端，实际上中美对话的作用仅限于缓解危机及调和经济政治上对抗局面，如目前的双边贸易不平衡。
en: This US-Chinese tandem will run far from smoothly, and will do little but ameliorate crises and periods of serious economic and political confrontation, like that which is currently looming over the bilateral trade imbalance.

zh: 但从战略角度考虑，双方还将在较长时期内维持相互依赖的关系，而且这种关系将会在一定时机确定为双边机制，从而可能引发其他国际角色（尤其是欧洲国家）的不满。
en: Strategically, however, China and the US will have to rely on one another for a long time. This co-dependency will, at some point, also take shape politically, probably to the chagrin of all other international players, particularly the Europeans.

zh: 只有欧洲在国际舞台上展现出意志和实力，它才能转变其发展模式，而这或许也是中美“二国集团”所乐意看到的。
en: Europe could change the course of this development only if it presented itself as a serious player and stood up for its interests on the global stage. The “G-2” of China and the US would probably be happy about that.

zh: 然而目前，欧盟力量有限且过于分散，各国领导限于本国战略利益不愿作出共同政策，阻碍了欧盟有效地发挥国际影响。
en: But Europe is too weak and too divided to be effective globally, with its leaders unwilling to pursue a common policy based on their countries’ own strategic interests.

zh: 中国脆弱的发展模式
en: China’s Brittle Development Model

zh: 新德里 — — 1947年从英国独立后，印度就成了民主优势的代言人 — — 与1949年成立共产党独裁政权的中国形成鲜明的对照。
en: NEW DELHI – After gaining independence from Britain in 1947, India was something of a poster child for the virtues of democracy – in stark contrast with China, which became a Communist dictatorship in 1949.

zh: 直到20世纪70年代，人们还普遍认为尽管两国同样面临极端贫困、经济落后和疾病的挑战，但印度的模式要好于中国，因为它的民众可以自由选择统治者。
en: Until the 1970s, it was widely argued that, while both countries suffered from extreme poverty, underdevelopment, and disease, India’s model was superior, because its people were free to choose their own rulers.

zh: 但随着中国经济的蓬勃发展，压迫性政治制度更有利发展的相反论调正在赢得市场。
en: With China’s economic boom, however, the counterargument – that a repressive political system is more conducive to development – has gained currency.

zh: 尽管中国近期取得了惊人的成就，但印度模式从长远看可能效果更好。
en: But while China’s recent performance has been spectacular, India’s model may well stand up better in the long run.

zh: 1978年后人们的观点开始发生变化，因为中国经济发展比印度更加迅猛，导致很多人认为印度乱成一团的民主制度正在阻碍它的民众。
en: The conversation changed after 1978, when China surged ahead of India economically, causing many to conclude that India’s chaotic democracy was holding back its people.

zh: 毕竟，如果中国领导人希望新建一条六车道高速公路，他们可以不费吹灰之力用推土机推平村庄。
en: After all, if China’s leaders want to build a new six-lane expressway, they can bulldoze any number of villages.

zh: 而在印度，拓宽一条双车道公路就有可能引发民众抗议，并在法院拖上几年都没有结果。
en: In India, widening a two-lane road could incite popular protests and be tied up in court for years.

zh: 北京清华大学教授贝淡宁出版的一部新著让这种由来已久的争论出现了新的转折。
en: That old debate has now taken a new twist with the publication of a new book by Daniel A. Bell, a professor at Beijing’s Tsinghua University.

zh: 贝淡宁提出中国的威权主义 — — 特别是它的“精英政治 ” — —是一种可行的治理模式，甚至可能比印度和西方的民主制度还要好。
en: Bell argues that Chinese authoritarianism – specifically, its “political meritocracy” – is a viable model of governance, possibly even superior to the democracy of India and the West.

zh: 经济学家兼哲学家阿马蒂亚·森的名言是因为政府不能无视民众的痛苦，所以言论自由的民主国家不会出现饥荒。
en: The economist and philosopher Amartya Sen famously demonstrated that famines do not occur in democracies with a free press, because their governments cannot ignore the suffering.

zh: 贝淡宁指出至少自大跃进结束后，中国同样成功避免了饥荒，并且与印度相比更好地控制了营养不良。
en: Bell points out that China has also avoided famine, at least since the Great Leap Forward, and has done better than India on malnutrition.

zh: 他断言这证明有效地、为民众服务不一定只有民主政府才能做到。
en: This, he asserts, proves that a government does not have to be democratic to serve its people effectively.

zh: 事实上，贝淡宁提出中国以绩效为主的官员选拔评价体制确保了比民主选举更优秀的领导，后者往往导致无知和偏见占据上风。
en: In fact, Bell argues, China’s merit-based system for selecting and evaluating officials guarantees better leadership than democratic elections, which often lead to victory for ignorance and prejudice.

zh: 尽管的确存在缺陷（尤其是自满和腐败 ） ， 中国的制度能够确保有序的执政和发展。
en: Despite some weaknesses (notably complacency and corruption), China’s system ensures orderly governance and development.

zh: 民主制度不一定能做到这一点，因此“真正有意义的政治问题是 ” ， 贝淡宁说 ， “ 民主选举能否带来好的结果。 ”
en: Democracy does not necessarily do that, so the “politically relevant question,” Bell says, “is whether democratic elections lead to good consequences.”

zh: 印度40年前就讨论过这个问题，时任总理英迪拉·甘地宣布国家进入紧急状态。
en: India debated this question 40 years ago, when then-Prime Minister Indira Gandhi declared a state of emergency.

zh: 她暂时取消了公民自由、监禁了反对派领袖并审查新闻媒体，因为她相信民主制度阻碍了印度的发展。
en: She suspended civil liberties, locked up opposition leaders, and censored the press, based on the belief that democracy had impeded India’s development.

zh: 上述问题在1977年得到解决，选举推翻了英迪拉·甘地、恢复了民主。
en: The issue was resolved in 1977, with an election that defenestrated Gandhi and restored democracy.

zh: 但“面包或自由”的困境依然存在：政府能否在实现经济增长和繁荣的同时，尊重公民的权利和自由？
en: But the “bread versus freedom” dilemma remains: Can governments deliver economic growth and prosperity while respecting their citizens’ rights and freedoms?

zh: 近年来印度政界的执政障碍，国内断断续续的议会会议和争吵不休的联盟使这个问题显得比以往任何时候都更加重要。
en: The dysfunction of Indian politics in recent years, with its fractious coalitions and disrupted parliament sessions, has made that question seem more relevant than ever.

zh: 我不相信贝淡宁的答案是正确的。
en: I am not convinced that Bell’s answer is the right one.

zh: 快速工业化和经济发展已经使数百万中国人摆脱了贫困，但由此造成的人类痛苦往往也非常巨大。
en: Rapid industrialization and development have lifted millions of Chinese out of poverty, but often at the cost of great human suffering.

zh: 或许中国的增长速度的确惊人，但在此过程中很多人也付出了惨重的代价。
en: China may have grown at breakneck speed, but it has broken a lot of necks in the process.

zh: 人们可能愿意用印度僵化的官僚体制和中国的高效进行对比，外国投资者在在中国面对红毯，而在印度却要面对繁琐的程序；截然相反的还有印度的党派政治和中国的党内等级。
en: One might like to contrast India’s sclerotic bureaucracy with China’s efficient one, India’s red tape with China’s red carpet for foreign investors, and India’s partisan politics with China’s Party hierarchy.

zh: 但印度的多元化民主无疑有效地管理了国内的多样性，使所有民众感到自己关系到国家利益 — — 并能真正影响到国家的执政方式。
en: But there is no doubt that India’s pluralist democracy has enabled it to manage its diversity superbly, giving all citizens the sense that they have a strong stake in their country – and a real influence over how it is run.

zh: 事实上，印度民主的合法性并非来自精英阶层，而来自占人口绝大多数的贫困和弱势民众。
en: In fact, it is India’s large population of poor and disadvantaged citizens – not the elite – that lends Indian democracy its legitimacy.

zh: 穷人积极投票，因为他们知道参选是让政府了解他们诉求的最有效的方式。
en: The poor turn out to vote, because they know that participating in elections is their most effective means of letting the government know their demands.

zh: 如果政府让他们感到沮丧，他们会在下届选举中投票反对其领导人，而不是发起暴动和叛乱。
en: When they are frustrated with their government, they vote against its leaders in the next election, rather than launching revolts or insurrections.

zh: 每当暴力运动真正兴起，民主进程往往能借助包容将其化解于萌芽状态：昨天的武装分子成为今天的首席部长 — — 以及明天的反对派领袖。
en: When violent movements do arise, the democratic process often defuses them through accommodation: Yesterday’s militants become today’s chief ministers – and tomorrow’s opposition leaders.

zh: 相反，如果中国体制面临重大挑战，其唯一的反应就是镇压。
en: By contrast, if China’s system faces a fundamental challenge, its only response is repression.

zh: 迄今为止这可能收到了效果。 但历史上所有专制国家都有镇压不足以确保秩序和进步的一天。
en: That may have worked so far, but every autocratic state in history has reached a point where repression was no longer enough to ensure order and progress.

zh: 如果中国出现大规模民众骚乱，那么结果就是满盘皆输。
en: If China encounters widespread popular unrest, all bets are off.

zh: 龙可能跌倒，而象则会继续向前。
en: The dragon could stumble, while the elephant trundles on.

zh: 此外，贝淡宁对中国精英政治的感觉可能过于乐观。
en: Moreover, Bell’s perception of China’s meritocracy may be too optimistic.

zh: 鉴于中国实行严格的官僚体制，只允许在职业阶梯上一步步向上爬，因此像美国总统奥巴马那样相对年轻、缺乏经验但却充满活力且鼓舞人心的领导者几乎不可能出现。
en: Given that the Chinese system is rigidly bureaucratic, permitting only gradual ascent up the career ladder, it is impossible for a young and relatively inexperienced but dynamic and inspiring leader – like, say, US President Barack Obama – to emerge.

zh: 中国不会选择年轻时犯过错误的天才领袖，比方说像美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福和亚伯拉罕·林肯。
en: China would not choose gifted leaders who were failures in their youth, like US Presidents Franklin D. Roosevelt or Abraham Lincoln.

zh: 像圣雄甘地和尼赫鲁那样在印度政界呼风唤雨的反叛人士和离经叛道者 — — 在中国体制下根本不可能开始。
en: Rebels and non-conformists who have flourished in Indian politics – leaders like Mahatma Gandhi or Jawaharlal Nehru – would never have gotten started in China’s system.

zh: 除中国外，贝淡宁还列举了新加坡和台湾等专制制度的成功。
en: Beyond China, Bell cites the success of authoritarian systems like Singapore and Taiwan.

zh: 但上述国家的成功可能丝毫不受专制主义影响。
en: But these countries probably would have been at least as successful without authoritarianism.

zh: 他们用于推动增长和发展的方法符合民主原则，就像东亚很多曾经的威权国家在没有阻碍发展的前提下成功实现了民主过渡。
en: The methods they used to promote growth and development are consistent with democratic principles, to the point that many formerly authoritarian states in East Asia managed to carry out successful transitions to democracy, without derailing their development.

zh: 最后，一个简单的事实就可以驳斥贝淡宁的说法：没有任何已经取得民主权利的民众会为回归专制击节叫好。
en: Finally, Bell’s view can be refuted by a simple observation: No population that has gained democratic rights has clamored for a return to dictatorship.

zh: 仅这一点就足以证明民主是种力量而非弱点。
en: That alone should be enough to prove that democracy is a strength, not a weakness.

zh: 中国的体制或许促成了快速经济崛起，但其对自上而下共识的依赖意味着它只在可以预测的环境中才能取得效果。
en: China’s system may have enabled its rapid economic rise, but its dependence on a top-to-bottom consensus means that it functions well only in a predictable environment.

zh: 相反，印度的体系只需要就一点达成共识：即人们并不总要达成一致，只要他们同意保留不同意见。
en: India’s system, by contrast, requires consensus on only one point: that everyone does not always need to agree, so long as they agree on how to disagree.

zh: 在一个不可预知的世界里，这赋予了印度无可否认的宝贵优势。
en: In an unpredictable world, that gives India an undeniable – and invaluable – advantage.

zh: 重估中国的债务负担
en: Rescaling China’s Debt Mountain

zh: 发自蒙特利尔 — — 对于中国经济来说，有两个事实是得到外界普遍同意的。
en: MONTREAL – There is widespread agreement on two facts about the Chinese economy.

zh: 首先，经济放缓已经结束，增长有所抬头。
en: First, the slowdown has ended and growth is picking up.

zh: 其次，在经济上并非万事大吉，但对今后的走向却未有共识。
en: Second, not all is well financially. But there is no agreement on what happens next.

zh: 好消息是中国国内需求持续增长，3月的汽车销售额相比去年增长了近10 ％ ， 第一季度的零售支出相比去年同期也提升了10 ％ 。
en: Car sales were up nearly 10% in March over the same month in 2015. And retail spending grew at an annual clip of 10% in the first quarter.

zh: 但最显著的增长依然是在投资方面。
en: The most dramatic increase, though, is in investment.

zh: 房地产投资在2015年雪崩之后重新抬头。
en: Real estate investment is growing again, following its collapse in 2015.

zh: 工业投资方面也一路狂飙，尤其是国有企业。
en: Industrial investment, especially by state-owned enterprises, has been rallying strongly.

zh: 而这一转变的根源则是庞大的信贷增长，因为当局认定先前的经济放缓超出限度，所以鼓励银行四处放贷。
en: At the root of this turnaround is enormous credit growth, as the authorities, concerned that the earlier slowdown was excessive, encourage China’s banks to lend.

zh: 在2015年第四季度的信贷增长 — — 在中国被称为“社会融资总量 ” — —实现了13％的年化增长率 — — 相当于全年GDP增速的两倍。
en: Credit growth, known in China as “total social financing,” grew at an annual rate of 13% in the fourth quarter of 2015 and again in the first quarter of this year – that is, double the rate of annual GDP growth.

zh: 事实上自金融危机于2008年9月爆发以来，中国实现了比世界任何国家都更快的信贷增长，有历史记录以来的任何一场信贷热潮都难以与之匹敌。
en: Since the financial crisis erupted in September 2008, China has had the fastest credit growth of any country in the world. Indeed, it is hard to point to another credit boom of this magnitude in recorded history.

zh: 坏消息是，正如经济学家莫里茨·斯图拉里克（Moritz Schularick）和艾伦·泰勒（Alan Taylor）提醒我们的那样，信贷扩张一般都没有好下场。
en: The bad news is that credit booms rarely end well, as the economists Moritz Schularick and Alan Taylor have reminded us.

zh: 中国的信贷海啸为钢铁和房地产这些已经产能严重过剩的产业提供了融资。
en: China’s credit tsunami is financing investment in steel and property, sectors already burdened by massive excess capacity.

zh: 换句话说，那些借贷的企业正是那些最没有偿还能力的企业。
en: The companies doing the borrowing, in other words, are precisely those least capable of repaying.

zh: 关于此类事项持往往保守姿态（主要是为了避免得罪各大国政府）的国际货币基金组织估计，中国向非金融企业的贷款中有15％处于危险之中。
en: The International Monetary Fund, which tends to adopt a conservative posture on such matters (not least to avoid antagonizing powerful governments), estimates that 15% of Chinese loans to nonfinancial corporations are at risk.

zh: 由于非金融企业目前负担的债务总额相当于GDP的1.5倍，不良贷款的账面价值可能相当于国民收入的四分之一。
en: With nonfinancial corporations’ debt currently standing at 150% of GDP, the book value of the bad loans could be a quarter of national income.

zh: 不过仍然可能通过抛售空置住房来抵消一部分建设成本，也可以把这些轧钢机械便宜卖给其他国家，或作为废品处理掉。
en: It still may be possible to sell off vacant apartments for a fraction of their construction cost. It may be possible to sell off rolling mill machinery to other countries, or as scrap.

zh: 但是高风险贷款的高度集中 — — 在钢铁，矿业，房地产等 行业 — — 表明损失将是巨大的。
en: But where the loans at risk are concentrated – in steel, mining, and real estate – suggests that losses will be substantial.

zh: 这就是为何原先预想中毫无痛苦的解决方案 — — 债转股 — — 会必然经历痛苦。
en: This is why the supposedly painless solution, debt-for-equity swaps, will not be painless.

zh: 没错，不良贷款可以由资产管理公司收购并打包并打折出售给其他投资者。
en: Yes, bad loans can be purchased by asset-management companies, which can package them up and sell them off to other investors.

zh: 但如果资产管理公司按全额账面价值来购买这些贷款，他们就将为此承担损失，而政府将不得不为此买单。
en: But if the asset managers pay full book value for those loans, they will incur losses, and the government will have to foot the bill.

zh: 如果他们只支付市场价值，损失方就变成了银行，政府也不得不着手修复其资产负债表。
en: If they pay only market value, it will be the banks that incur losses, and the government will have to repair their balance sheets.

zh: 这就产生了三个全都令人纠结的选项：选项一，政府可以发行债券来筹集银行资本重组所需的资金，而这样做实际上就是将公司债务问题转化为公共债务问题。
en: First, the authorities can issue bonds to raise the funding needed to recapitalize the banks. In doing so, they would effectively transform the corporate debt problem into a public debt problem.

zh: 这等于将地方财政负担转移到了未来纳税人肩头，当然也无法提振增加消费者的信心。
en: This would place the financial burden squarely on the shoulders of future taxpayers, which would not enhance consumer confidence.

zh: 这也不会提高人们对公共财政的信心。
en: It also would not enhance confidence in the public finances.

zh: 虽然中国的公共债务总量还算较低；但任何一位爱尔兰公民都可以告诉你，一旦银行业危机袭来，债务就会像气球那样膨胀。
en: Public debt in China is still relatively low; but, as any citizen of Ireland can tell you, it can balloon when banking crises strike.

zh: 选项二，央行可以通过提供信贷来为修复工作融资。
en: Alternatively, the central bank could finance the repair by providing credit.

zh: 但尽管当局在1999年他们上一次面临严重不良贷款问题用过这招，货币印刷机却无法与官员的另一既定目标相兼容：稳定的汇率。
en: But, while the authorities relied on this approach in 1999, the last time they were faced with a serious bad-loan problem, running the money printing press is not compatible with officials’ other stated goal: a stable exchange rate.

zh: 回想去年八月人民币汇率出现意外走势时投资者是多么恐慌。
en: We saw last August how investors can panic when the renminbi exchange rate moves unexpectedly.

zh: 货币贬值可能不仅坠入资本外逃的一个不稳定螺旋；它也可能会破坏���行，因为资金出境必须首先被取出来。
en: Currency depreciation may not only precipitate a destabilizing spiral of capital flight; it could also destabilize the banks, from which money leaving the country must first be withdrawn.

zh: 选项三是想象不良贷款问题会自行解决。
en: The final option is to imagine that the bad-loan problem will solve itself.

zh: 政府会鼓励银行将鼓励“长青”贷款：在其还款日到期后继续延期。
en: The banks would be encouraged to “evergreen” their loans: to roll them over when repayment falls due.

zh: 所谓银行资本雄厚的神话也将得到延续。
en: The fiction that the banks are well capitalized will be maintained.

zh: 需要进行清算或重组借款人反而会在银行融资的输血下活着。
en: Borrowers that need to be liquidated or reorganized will instead stay alive, thanks to the drip-feed of bank finance.

zh: 这一结果对那些熟悉日本银行危机的人来说无比熟悉：僵尸银行贷款给僵尸公司，反而把压力施加到了有活力的企业身上，扼杀了它们的成长。
en: The result will look familiar to aficionados of Japan’s banking crisis: zombie banks lending to zombie firms, which apply artificial pressure on viable firms, stifling their growth.

zh: 通过发行债券来为银行资本重组融资可能是最不坏的选择。
en: Financing bank recapitalization through bond issuance is probably the least bad option.

zh: 但这并不意味着这将不会产生痛苦，也无法确保中国的政策制定者会选择它。
en: This doesn’t mean that it will be painless. Nor is there any assurance that Chinese policymakers will opt for it.

zh: 但如果他们不这样做的话，后果可能是非常可怕的。
en: But if they don’t, the consequences could be dire.

zh: 中国强硬的邻国政策于己不利
en: China’s Bad-Neighbor Policy Is Bad Business

zh: 丹佛 — — 中国正面临着困难时期。
en: DENVER – These are difficult times for China.

zh: 在经历数十年高达两位数的GDP增长之后，今天的经济放缓标志着经济体系出现问题。
en: After decades of double-digit GDP growth, today’s slowdown points to an economic system in trouble.

zh: 曾经被誉为发展典范的中国经济现在却看似僵硬笨重。
en: Once hailed as a model of development, the Chinese economy now appears sclerotic and cumbersome.

zh: 中国公众情绪日益躁动，并且对体制能否兑现延续国家经济“奇迹”的官方承诺感到怀疑。
en: The Chinese public is growing restive and increasingly questioning the system’s ability to deliver on official promises that the country’s economic “miracle” will continue.

zh: 许多中国人担心“中国梦”可能只是梦想而已。
en: Many Chinese fear that the “Chinese Dream” may be just that: a dream.

zh: 中国无法通过拉动适当组合的现有经济杠杆来解决经济问题。
en: China cannot fix its economic problems merely by pulling the right combination of existing policy levers.

zh: 相反，它必须着手进行广泛和深层次的改革创新过程；它必须愿意为长期利益吞下短期增长放缓的苦果。
en: Rather, it must embark on a broader and deeper process of reform and renewal; and it must be willing to swallow the bitter pill of slower short-term growth in the interest of long-term goals.

zh: 与此同时，全面的改革努力不能仅靠经济决策来推动。
en: At the same time, an expansive reform effort cannot be advanced by economic decisions alone.

zh: 中国必须认识到它希望留给世界的印象和世界对其实际印象的差距。
en: China must also come to terms with the gap between how it wants to be perceived and how the world actually perceives it.

zh: 中国应当从经济领域吸取教训，认识到自身在世界舞台上的行动和关系对其信誉所造成的严重影响 — — 同样受到影响的还有它的底线。
en: China should take a lesson from business and recognize that many of its actions and affiliations on the world stage pose serious risks to its reputation – and to its bottom line.

zh: 比方以国际观察家对南中国海局势发展的见解为例。
en: For example, consider an international observer’s view of developments in the South China Sea.

zh: 中国显然正在利用“核心利益 ” （ 为确保核心利益一国将不惜动用武力）这个来势汹汹的词来欺侮它的南部邻国，在一系列争端中保障自己的利益。
en: China is plainly bullying its southern neighbors by using the menacing term “core interests” (in pursuit of which a country would resort to the use of force) to have its way in various disputes.

zh: 但在中国官员口中，中国才是利益受到侵害的地区伙伴。
en: But, to hear it from Chinese officials, China is an aggrieved partner in the region.

zh: 他们辩解中国为避免与越南发生冲突限制了渔船船队的活动，其结果却是越南渔民积极抢占了中国放弃了水域。
en: They argue that they have reined in their fishing fleet to avoid incidents with the Vietnamese, only to see Vietnamese fishermen aggressively claim the relinquished waters.

zh: 中国显然有能力驱逐越南人、菲律宾人、马来西亚人和它选择与之对抗的其他几乎任何人。
en: China obviously has the strength to drive out the Vietnamese, the Filipinos, the Malaysians, the Indonesians, and almost anyone else it chooses to confront.

zh: 东南亚的国土面积和财富根本无法和中国相比。
en: Southeast Asia represents but a fraction of China’s size and wealth.

zh: 但这种做法是否增强了中国的地区实力？
en: But does this behavior make China stronger in the region?

zh: 19世纪追求经济利益的做法是否能为与邻国对抗作出合理的解释？
en: Does a nineteenth-century approach to pursuing economic gain justify ongoing enmity with one’s neighbors?

zh: 毕竟，东南亚各国将一直作为中国的邻国；虽然他们的实力不济但却拥有很好的记忆力。
en: The peoples of Southeast Asia, after all, will be China’s neighbors for the rest of its history; while their knives may be short, their memories surely aren’t.

zh: 很多中国民众认为中国因在南中国海的自信而受到批评是不公正的。
en: Many Chinese genuinely believe that they are unfairly criticized for China’s new assertiveness in the South China Sea.

zh: 但如果自信是以失去信任和遭到谴责为代价那就没有太大意义。
en: But certitude has little to recommend itself when the price paid is distrust and condemnation from everyone else.

zh: 多数人从个人生活经验中了解到一个基本社会事实：幸福和和谐远比相信自己正确的空洞安慰来得更有意义。
en: This is a basic social truth that most people know from their personal lives: Happiness and harmony are far more important than the empty comfort of being convinced you’re right.

zh: 除东南亚地区外，莫过于朝鲜半岛问题更能影响中国的信誉。
en: Beyond Southeast Asia, nowhere in the world is China’s reputation more at stake than on the Korean Peninsula.

zh: 在半岛南部，韩国已经成为一个举世瞩目的充满活力并拥有先进文化的现代化强国，能够直截了当且公开透明的解决国内问题。
en: In the South, the Republic of Korea (ROK) has become a modern, vibrant, and culturally sophisticated country that is admired around the world and addresses its problems forthrightly and transparently.

zh: 而朝鲜却只能被形容为一座战俘营，接受世袭专制领导人的统治，其充其量能被形容为邪教组织的政权正在不屈不挠地研制大规模杀伤性武器。
en: In the North is a state that can best be described as a prison camp, run by a hereditary despotic leader whose regime – most politely described as a cult – is pursuing an unrelenting drive to develop weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 朝鲜的主要出口物资是政治体制制造的黑色幽默、难民和让美国相形见绌的自我标榜的卓异主义。
en: Its main exports are the black humor produced by its political system, refugees, and claims of exceptionalism that put America’s to shame.

zh: 而中国是其唯一真正的盟友，尽管现在也越来越谨慎。
en: And China is its only real – albeit increasingly wary – ally.

zh: 公平地讲，中国在朝鲜半岛上的利益远比西方所描述的更加复杂。
en: To be fair, China’s interests on the Korean Peninsula are more complex than how they are often portrayed in the West.

zh: 对中国而言，朝鲜与其说是中国未来道路上的外交问题还不如说是影响其内部辩论的多层面事务。
en: For China, North Korea is not so much a foreign-policy problem as a multifaceted set of issues that impinge on China’s own internal debates as it charts its future course.

zh: 朝鲜的覆灭及其与韩国潜在的统一对中国安全利益及其对上述利益的看法而言意味着什么？
en: What would the demise of North Korea and its potential unification with the ROK mean for Chinese security interests, and for the perception of those interests?

zh: 失去这个历史“伙伴 ” （ 很多中国人今天会对这种说法感到恼怒 ） 、 并且有可能加强对手实力对中国自身的政治体系和外交政策会产生什么样的影响？
en: What would be the repercussions of losing a historic “partner” (many Chinese today would bristle at such a description), and potentially strengthening a rival, for China’s own political system or foreign policy?

zh: 有一点似乎可以肯定：决定与朝鲜遗留关系未来的将是中国人自己��而不是国际社会。
en: One thing seems certain: the future of the legacy relationship with North Korea will be determined by the Chinese themselves, not by the international community.

zh: 尽管如此，权衡朝鲜半岛的处置方法为中国提供了重新思考其长期利益的理想机会。
en: Still, weighing the disposition of the Korean Peninsula offers China an ideal opportunity to begin reconsidering its long-term interests.

zh: 在这个问题上，中国可以更好地贴近主流国际思维，开始统一世界眼中的中国和中国眼中的中国这两种认知间的差距。
en: It is here, more than anywhere else, that China can align itself within mainstream international thinking and start to close the gap between how it is viewed by the world and how it views itself.

zh: 中国一带一路倡议的经济意义
en: The Economic Case for China’s Belt and Road

zh: 发自纽约 — — 自2013年以来，中国一直致力于推动“一带一路”倡议，旨在为亚洲，欧洲和非洲国家的60多个国家建立起物质基础设施和政策联系。
en: NEW YORK – Since 2013, China has been pursuing its “Belt and Road” initiative, which aims to develop physical infrastructure and policy linkages connecting more than 60 countries across Asia, Europe, and Africa.

zh: 有批评者担心中国此举可能主要是为了扩大地缘政治影响力以便与美国和日本竞争，因此会着力于一些缺乏经济意义的项目。
en: Critics worry that China may be so focused on expanding its geopolitical influence, in order to compete with the likes of the United States and Japan, that it may pursue projects that make little economic sense.

zh: 但如果能满足几个条件的话，这一倡议就会产生相当大的经济意义。
en: But, if a few conditions are met, the economic case for the initiative is strong.

zh: 亚洲开发银行最近的一份报告证实，许多一带一路国家迫切需要大规模的基础设施投资，而这恰恰是中国所承诺的投资类型。
en: As a recent Asian Development Bank report confirms, many Belt and Road countries are in urgent need of large-scale infrastructure investment – precisely the type of investment that China has pledged.

zh: 孟加拉国和吉尔吉斯斯坦这类国家缺乏可靠的电力供应，阻碍了制造业的发展并压抑其出口能力。
en: Some, such as Bangladesh and Kyrgyzstan, lack reliable electricity supplies, which is impeding the development of their manufacturing sectors and stifling their ability to export.

zh: 而印尼等国家则需要足够的港口来实施国内经济一体化或国际贸易。
en: Others, like Indonesia, do not have enough ports for internal economic integration or international trade.

zh: “一带一路”倡议承诺会帮助各国克服这些限制，为港口，道路，学校，医院，发电厂和输电网的建设提供外部资金。
en: The Belt and Road initiative promises to help countries overcome these constraints, by providing external funding for ports, roads, schools, hospitals, and power plants and grids.

zh: 在这个意义上说，这个倡议可以像美国1945年后的马歇尔计划那样发挥作用，而后者为战后欧洲的重建和经济复苏所作出的贡献得到了全世界的广泛赞誉。
en: In this sense, the initiative could function much like America’s post-1945 Marshall Plan, which is universally lauded for its contribution to the reconstruction and economic recovery of war-ravaged Europe.

zh: 当然，只靠外部资金并不足以取得成功。
en: Of course, external funding alone is not sufficient for success.

zh: 受援国还必须实施关键性改革以提高政策透明度和可预测性，从而降低投资风险。
en: Recipient countries must also undertake key reforms that increase policy transparency and predictability, thereby reducing investment risk.

zh: 实际上，补充性改革的实施将成为左右一带一路投资经济回报的关键因素。
en: Indeed, implementation of complementary reforms will be a key determinant of the economic returns on Belt and Road investments.

zh: 对中国来说，一带一路投资在经济上是有吸引力的，尤其是当中国的私营企业率先实施的时候。
en: For China, the Belt and Road investments are economically appealing, particularly when private Chinese firms take the lead in carrying them out.

zh: 当中国在2013年首次提出“一带一路”倡议时，该国的外汇储备已达4万亿美元，而这些储蓄的美元回报率却极低，每年不到1 ％ 。
en: In 2013, when China first proposed the Belt and Road initiative, the country was sitting on $4 trillion in foreign-exchange reserves, which were earning a very low dollar return (less than 1% a year).

zh: 再加上当时人民币兑美元的升值预期，如果换成中国本国货币的话收益甚至是负的。
en: In terms of China’s own currency, the returns were negative, given the expected appreciation of the renminbi against the US dollar at the time.

zh: 在这个意义上，中国的一带一路投资代价并不是特别昂贵，尤其是考虑到其潜在利益的情况下。
en: In this sense, Belt and Road investments are not particularly costly for China, particularly when their far-reaching potential benefits are taken into account.

zh: 而中国之所以拥有超过40％的贸易额相对GDP比率（远高于美国 ） ， 部分原因是其贸易伙伴国的基建发展不足和经济多样化不足。
en: China’s trade-to-GDP ratio exceeds 40% – substantially higher than that of the US – owing partly to underdeveloped infrastructure and inadequate economic diversification among China’s trading partners.

zh: 通过解决这些弱点，中国的一带一路投资可以大大提升本国和参与国贸易量，为企业和劳动者带来相当大的收益。
en: By addressing these weaknesses, China’s Belt and Road investments can lead to a substantial increase in participant countries’ and China’s own trade volumes, benefiting firms and workers substantially.

zh: 这并不意味着这类投资对中国来说是无风险的。
en: This is not to suggest that such investments are risk-free for China.

zh: 经济回报将取决于企业经营决策的质量。
en: The economic returns will depend on the quality of firms’ business decisions.

zh: 特别是当效率并非首要考虑因素的情况下，中国的国有企业可能会参与一些低收益项目，而这也是为何要密切留意中国的国有企业改革进程的原因。
en: In particular, because efficiency is not the primary consideration, Chinese state-owned enterprises (SOEs) might purse low-return projects. That is why China’s SOE-reform process must be watched carefully.

zh: 尽管如此，虽然“一带一路”倡议显然是部分是由战略目标所驱动的，但成本效益分析表明其经济意义也极大 — — 大到有人或许会质疑为什么中国不早点执行。
en: Nonetheless, while the Belt and Road initiative is clearly driven partly by strategic objectives, a cost-benefit analysis shows that the economic case is also very strong – so strong, in fact, that one might ask why China didn’t undertake it sooner.

zh: 即便是美国等国也可能从中获取巨大的经济回报。
en: Even the United States and other countries may reap significant economic returns.

zh: 全球金融危机爆发至今已是十年，全球大部分地区的复苏仍然疲软而短暂，而大规模的基础设施投资可以为全球总需求提供急需的短期刺激。
en: A decade after the global financial crisis erupted, recovery remains weak and tentative in much of the world. Bold, large-scale infrastructure investments can provide much-needed short-run stimulus to global aggregate demand.

zh: 美国可能会看到自身出口的需求激增，包括汽车、牵引机车、飞机，高端建筑设备以及财务、会计，教育和法律服务。
en: The US, for one, is likely to see a surge in demand for its own exports, including cars, locomotives, planes, and high-end construction equipment, and financial, accounting, educational, and legal services.

zh: 从长远来看，新的基础设施将减少物流瓶颈，降低生产原材料的成本，最终带来更高的生产力和更快的全球增长。
en: In the longer term, the new infrastructure will ease logistical bottlenecks, reducing the costs of production inputs. The result will be higher productivity and faster global growth.

zh: 如果各个一带一路项目能遵循较高的环境和社会标准，同时就可以在气候变化和收入不平等等全球挑战方面取得重大进展。
en: If Belt and Road projects are held to high environmental and social standards, significant progress can also be made on global challenges such as climate change and inequality.

zh: 越多的国家选择参与这些项目，实现这些标准的机会就越多，全球社会所得到的回报就越多。
en: The more countries choose to participate in these projects, the better the chance of achieving these standards, and the greater the global social returns will be.

zh: 在这个某些世界上最具影响力的国家都向内转向，大谈树立贸易壁垒和边界围墙的时代，我们的世界更一些需要专注于建立桥梁和道路的举措 — — 无论是在路桥本身还是其寓意上 — — 而一带一路战略这样的倡议正是如此。
en: In an era when some of the world’s most influential countries are turning inward, talking about erecting trade barriers and constructing border walls, the world needs initiatives focused on building bridges and roads, both literal and figurative – initiatives like the Belt and Road strategy.

zh: 习近平的马可·波罗战略
en: Xi Jinping’s Marco Polo Strategy

zh: 坎布里奇—上个月，中国国家主席习近平在北京主持了隆重的“一带一路”论坛。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Last month, Chinese President Xi Jinping presided over a heavily orchestrated “Belt and Road” forum in Beijing.

zh: 这次为期两天的会议吸引了包括俄罗斯总统普京在内的29位国家元首和来自100多个国家的1,200名代表。
en: The two-day event attracted 29 heads of state, including Russia’s Vladimir Putin, and 1,200 delegates from over 100 countries.

zh: 习近平将中国的一带一路计划称为“世纪工程 ” 。
en: Xi called China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) the “project of the century.”

zh: 该计划所包括的65个国家覆盖了全世界三分之二的陆地面积和四十五亿人口。
en: The 65 countries involved comprise two-thirds of the world’s land mass and include some four and a half billion people.

zh: 一带一路计划在2013年首次提出，它的目标是通过一万亿美元的从中国一直延伸到欧洲的基础设施投资整合欧亚，并扩展到东南亚和东非。 它被称为中国的新马歇尔计划和大战略。
en: Originally announced in 2013, Xi’s plan to integrate Eurasia through a trillion dollars of investment in infrastructure stretching from China to Europe, with extensions to Southeast Asia and East Africa, has been termed China’s new Marshall Plan as well as its bid for a grand strategy.

zh: 一些观察家还把此次论坛看成习近平意在填补美国总统特朗普抛弃奥巴马的跨太平洋贸易协定所留下的真空。
en: Some observers also saw the Forum as part of Xi’s effort to fill the vacuum left by Donald Trump’s abandonment of Barack Obama’s Trans-Pacific Partnership trade agreement.

zh: 中国的雄心勃勃的计划将为许多穷国提供急需的高速公路、铁路、管道、港口和发电站。
en: China’s ambitious initiative would provide badly needed highways, rail lines, pipelines, ports, and power plants in poor countries.

zh: 它也将鼓励中国企业增加对欧洲港口和铁路的投资。
en: It would also encourage Chinese firms to increase their investments in European ports and railways.

zh: “一带”包括连接整个中亚的庞大的高速公路和铁路网络，而“一路”是指一系列连接亚洲和欧洲的海上航线。
en: The “belt” would include a massive network of highways and rail links through Central Asia, and the “road” refers to a series of maritime routes and ports between Asia and Europe.

zh: 马克·波罗会为此感到自豪。
en: Marco Polo would be proud.

zh: 而如果中国选择将其盈余金融储备用于建设帮助穷国、加强国际贸易的基础设施，可以说它将能够提供全球公共品。
en: And if China chooses to use its surplus financial reserves to create infrastructure that helps poor countries and enhances international trade, it will be providing what can be seen as a global public good.

zh: 当然，中国的动机并不是纯粹的慈善。
en: Of course, China’s motives are not purely benevolent.

zh: 重新配置中国规模庞大的外汇资产，从低收益的美国国债转向高收益的基础设施不无道理，也为中国商品创造了新的市场。
en: Reallocation of China’s large foreign-exchange assets away from low-yield US Treasury bonds to higher-yield infrastructure investment makes sense, and creates alternative markets for Chinese goods.

zh: 在中国钢铁和水泥企业面临产能过剩的情况下，中国建筑企业可以从这些新的投资中获益。
en: With Chinese steel and cement firms suffering from overcapacity, Chinese construction firms will profit from the new investment.

zh: 而随着中国制造业向交通便利程度较低的省份转移，改善与国际市场连接的基础设施也符合中国的发展需要。
en: And as Chinese manufacturing moves to less accessible provinces, improved infrastructure connections to international markets fits China’s development needs.

zh: 但一带一路是否公共关系的企图大于投资的实际投入？
en: But is the BRI more public relations smoke than investment fire?

zh: 据《金融时报》报道，习近平的这一计划的投资在去年有所下降，这使人怀疑商业界的热情是否与政府一样高涨。
en: According to the Financial Times, investment in Xi’s initiative declined last year, raising doubts about whether commercial enterprises are as committed as the government.

zh: 每周都有五列满载货物的火车从重庆启程开往德国，但只有一列满载火车回程。
en: Five trains full of cargo leave Chongqing for Germany every week, but only one full train returns.

zh: 将商品横跨大陆从中国运往欧洲的成本仍然比海上贸易贵一倍。
en: Shipping goods overland from China to Europe is still twice as expensive as trade by sea.

zh: 《金融时报》指出，一带一路“很不幸地缺少务实的投资计划，而只有宏大的政治愿景。
en: As the FT puts it, the BRI is “unfortunately less of a practical plan for investment than a broad political vision.”

zh: ”此外，一个风险是来自沦为经济“累赘”的项目所造成的债务和未偿付贷款，而安全冲突也将困扰穿越多国边境的项目。
en: Moreover, there is a danger of debt and unpaid loans from projects that turn out to be economic “white elephants,” and security conflicts could bedevil projects that cross so many sovereign borders.

zh: 印度不乐于看到中国在印度洋影响力增加，俄罗斯、土耳其和伊朗也各有各的中亚企图。
en: India is not happy to see a greater Chinese presence in the Indian Ocean, and Russia, Turkey, and Iran have their own agendas in Central Asia.

zh: 习近平的愿景令人印象深刻，但它作为一个大战略会取得成功吗？
en: Xi’s vision is impressive, but will it succeed as a grand strategy?

zh: 中国正在押注于旧的地缘政治计划。
en: China is betting on an old geopolitical proposition.

zh: 一个世纪前，英国地缘政治理论家霍尔福德·麦金德（Halford Mackinder）指出，谁控制了欧亚内陆，谁就控制了世界。
en: A century ago, the British geopolitical theorist Halford Mackinder argued that whoever controlled the world island of Eurasia would control the world.

zh: 相反，美国的战略一直深得十九世纪海军上将阿尔弗雷德·马汉（Alfred Mahan）的地缘政治理论的精髓，强调海权和沿海。
en: American strategy, in contrast, has long favored the geopolitical insights of the nineteenth-century admiral Alfred Mahan, who emphasized sea power and the rimlands.

zh: 二战结束时，乔治·凯南（George F. Kenan）根据马汉的观点制定了他遏制苏联的冷战战略，他指出，如果美国与英国和日本等岛国，以及西欧半岛结盟 — — 它们分列欧亚大陆的两端 — — 就能制造一个有利于美国利益的全球实力平衡。
en: At World War II’s end, George F. Kennan adapted Mahan’s approach to develop his Cold War strategy of containment of the Soviet Union, arguing that if the US allied with the islands of Britain and Japan and the peninsula of Western Europe at the two ends of Eurasia, the US could create a balance of global power that would be favorable to American interests.

zh: 美国国防部和国务院仍然在围绕这个中心点展开工作，而很少顾及中亚。
en: The Pentagon and State Department are still organized along these lines, with scant attention paid to Central Asia.

zh: 互联网时代，形势已经发生了巨大的变化，但地理仍然重要，尽管人们常说距离已死。
en: Much has changed in the age of the Internet, but geography still matters, despite the alleged death of distance.

zh: 在十九世纪，大部分地缘政治对手都围绕着谁能控制被摇摇欲坠的奥斯曼帝国统治的土地这一“东方问题”展开。
en: In the nineteenth century, much of geopolitical rivalry revolved around the “Eastern Question” of who would control the area ruled by the crumbling Ottoman Empire.

zh: 柏林-巴格达铁路等基础设施项目造成列强之间的紧张。
en: Infrastructure projects like the Berlin to Baghdad railway roused tensions among the Great Powers.

zh: 这些地缘政治斗争现在是否会被“欧亚问题”取代？
en: Will those geopolitical struggles now be replaced by the “Eurasian Question”?

zh: 中国实施一带一路计划其实是押注于麦金德和马可·波罗。
en: With the BRI, China is betting on Mackinder and Marco Polo.

zh: 但横跨中亚的陆上通道将重现英国和俄罗斯，以及土耳其和伊朗等昔日帝国卷入其中的十九世纪影响力“大博弈 ” 。
en: But the overland route through Central Asia will revive the nineteenth-century “Great Game” for influence that embroiled Britain and Russia, as well as former empires like Turkey and Iran.

zh: 与此同时，横穿印度洋的海上“一路”将加剧中国和印度之间已经陷入焦灼的对立，围绕中国在巴基斯坦建港修路产生紧张。
en: At the same time, the maritime “road” through the Indian Ocean accentuates China’s already fraught rivalry with India, with tensions building over Chinese ports and roads through Pakistan.

zh: 美国则更多地押注于马汉和凯南。
en: The US is betting more on Mahan and Kennan.

zh: 亚洲有其自身的实力平衡，不论是印度、日本还是越南，都不希望中国主宰。
en: Asia has its own balance of power, and neither India nor Japan nor Vietnam want Chinese domination.

zh: 它们视美国为解决办法的一部分。
en: They see America as part of the solution.

zh: 美国的政策不是遏制中国 — — 两国之间规模巨大的贸易和学生流动就是明证。
en: American policy is not containment of China – witness the massive flows of trade and students between the countries.

zh: 但沉迷于民族复兴的中国却介入了与海上邻国的领土纠纷中，这会将它们推向美国的怀抱。
en: But as China, enthralled by a vision of national greatness, engages in territorial disputes with its maritime neighbors, it tends to drive them into America’s arms.

zh: 事实上，中国的真正问题在于“自我遏制 ” 。
en: Indeed, China’s real problem is “self-containment.”

zh: 即使在互联网和社交媒体时代，民族主义仍然是最强大的力量之一。
en: Even in the age of the Internet and social media, nationalism remains a most powerful force.

zh: 总体而言，美国应该欢迎中国的一带一路。
en: Overall, the United States should welcome China’s BRI.

zh: 前美国贸易代表、世界银行行长罗伯特·佐利克（Robert Zoellick）指出，如果崛起的中国为提供全球公共品做出贡献，美国就应该欢迎中国成为“负责任的相关利益者 ” 。
en: As Robert Zoellick, a former US Trade Representative and World Bank president, has argued, if a rising China contributes to the provision of global public goods, the US should encourage the Chinese to become a “responsible stakeholder.”

zh: 此外，美国公司或许也有机会从一带一路投资中分得一杯羹。
en: Moreover, there can be opportunities for American companies to benefit from BRI investments.

zh: 美国和中国可以在许多跨国问题上合作以取得巨大的收益，比如货币稳定、气候变化、网络规则和反恐等。
en: The US and China have much to gain from cooperation on a variety of transnational issues like monetary stability, climate change, cyber rules of the road, and anti-terrorism.

zh: 一带一路对中国的地缘政治有利也有弊，它不会像一些分析家所认为的那样，成为大战略的局面改变因素。
en: And while the BRI will provide China with geopolitical gains as well as costs, it is unlikely to be as much of a game changer in grand strategy, as some analysts believe.

zh: 更困难的问题是美国是否能完成它应该完成的工作。
en: A more difficult question is whether the US can live up to its part.

zh: 中国资产账户自由化为何停止
en: Why China’s Capital-Account Liberalization Has Stalled

zh: 北京—2012年初，中国人民银行利用其认定的“战略性机会 ” ， 加快了始自2009年的资本账户自由化步伐。
en: BEIJING – In early 2012, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) took advantage of what it viewed as a “strategic opportunity” to accelerate capital-account liberalization, which has been underway since 2009.

zh: 人们预计人民币将在2015年底实现“基本”可兑换，在2020年底实现完全可兑换。
en: The renminbi, it was expected, would be “basically” convertible by the end of 2015, and fully convertible by the end of 2020.

zh: 但情况并没有像人们预料的那样展开。
en: But things haven’t worked out as expected.

zh: 问题始于2014年，当时，自20世纪90年代一直处于盈余状态的中国资本账户转为赤字。
en: Problems began in 2014, when China’s capital account, which had been in surplus since the 1990s, swung into deficit.

zh: 到下一年年底，赤字变得非常巨大，导致中国国际收支余额（BOP）也由正转负，虽然中国经常项目仍保持3,000亿美元以上的盈余。
en: By the end of the next year, the deficit had grown so large that China’s overall balance of payments (BOP), too, turned negative, even as China’s current-account surplus remained above $300 billion.

zh: 去年，中国资本项目赤字达到了约2,000亿美元。
en: Last year, China’s capital-account deficit amounted to some $200 billion.

zh: 为了捍卫人民币，中国人民银行进行了大量干预 — — 这个过程让它付出了沉重的代价。
en: To protect the renminbi, the PBOC intervened heavily – a process that proved costly.

zh: 在不到两年的时间里，中国外汇储备从2014年年中4万亿美元的峰值下降到了略低于3万亿。
en: In less than two years, China’s foreign-exchange reserves fell from their peak of $4 trillion in mid-2014 to just below $3 trillion.

zh: 一开始，许多人对损失无动于衷。
en: At first, many were indifferent to the losses.

zh: 甚至有人指出，根本就没有损失，只不过是资源配置发生了积极的转变，官方储备变成了私人持有的外汇资产。
en: Some even argued that there were no losses at all, but rather a positive shift in resource allocation, with official reserves becoming privately held foreign assets.

zh: 他们指出，毕竟，在中国外汇储备从2014年二季度到2016年年底减少了1万亿美元的同时，私人部门持有的外国资产也增加了9,000亿美元。
en: After all, they pointed out, as China’s foreign-exchange reserves fell by $1 trillion from the second quarter of 2014 to the end of 2016, holdings of foreign assets by the private sector increased by $900 billion.

zh: 但这一观点没有认识到同一时期中国累计经常项目盈余为7,500亿美元。
en: But this argument failed to recognize that, during the same period, China’s cumulative current-account surplus was $750 billion.

zh: 根据定义，一国的经常项目盈余应该等于该国净外国资产。
en: By definition, a country’s current-account surplus should be equal to the increase in the country’s net foreign assets.

zh: 因此，真正发生的情况是8,500亿美元的中国外汇储备灰飞烟灭。
en: So what really happened was that $850 billion of China’s foreign-exchange reserves had gone missing.

zh: 而事实上，这一过程早就开始了。
en: And, in fact, this process had begun much earlier.

zh: 从2011年一季度到2016年三季度，中国累计经常项目盈余为1.28万亿美元，而净外国资产下降了124亿美元。
en: From the first quarter of 2011 to the third quarter of 2016, while China’s cumulative current-account surplus was $1.28 trillion, its net foreign assets fell by $12.4 billion.

zh: 换句话说，中国外国资产蒸发了大约1.3万亿美元。
en: In other words, since 2011, some $1.3 trillion of China’s foreign assets has disappeared.

zh: 察觉到这一危险趋势的中国人民银行立刻在去年给资本账户自由化踩了刹车，收紧了资本管制力度，程度之大为20世纪90年代末亚洲金融危机以来所未见。
en: Recognizing this dangerous trend, the PBOC abruptly hit the brakes on capital-account liberalization last year, tightening capital controls to a degree not seen since the Asian financial crisis of the late 1990s.

zh: 一国经常账户变化与其净外国资产头寸之间的差额部分反映了BOP计算中的“净误差和省略 ” 。
en: The gap between changes in a country’s current account and its net-foreign-asset position partly reflects “net errors and omissions” in the BOP calculations.

zh: 当资本流出一国时，交易理应体现在BOP表格中。
en: When capital flows out of a country, the transactions are supposed to be reflected in the BOP table.

zh: 但在中国这样的国家，资本外逃是非法行为，而投资者试图规避资本管制，因此交易可能根本不会被记录。
en: But in a country like China, where capital flight is illegal and investors attempt to evade capital controls, transactions might not be recorded at all.

zh: 相反，它们会体现在净误差和省略项中，最近几年，中国BOP的该项目已经变为巨大的赤字，在我看来，原因就在于资本外逃加速。
en: Instead, they show up in net errors and omissions, which in China have turned strongly negative in recent years, owing, in my view, to accelerating capital flight.

zh: 一些中国人认为，误差和省略项的负趋势只不过是统计错误的结果。
en: Some in China have argued that the negative trend for net errors and omissions is simply the result of statistical mistakes.

zh: 但在缺口高达1.3万亿美元的情况下，这样的观点根本站不住脚。
en: But when the shortfall amounts to $1.3 trillion, such claims can hardly be taken seriously.

zh: 也无法解释这个事实：在过去六年中，中国的净误差和省略项一直在同向变动，导致了BOP赤字。
en: Nor can they account for the fact that, over the last six years, China’s net errors and omissions have moved in just one direction, always contributing to the BOP deficit.

zh: 尽管中国的净误差和省略项肯定与资本外逃有关，但数字未必需要严丝合缝地对上；净误差和省略项可以大于也可以小于实际数字。
en: Although China’s net errors and omissions must be linked to capital flight, the figures do not have to line up exactly; net errors and omissions can be either larger or smaller than the actual figure.

zh: 中国的情况可能是小于，原因很简单：资本外逃也可以记录为不影响误差和省略项的普通资本外流。
en: In China’s case, the latter seems to be true, for a simple reason: capital flight may also be recorded as regular capital outflows that do not affect errors and omissions.

zh: 比如，在寻求海外并购的过程中，一些中国公司合法地将大量资本输出国外。
en: For example, as they pursue overseas mergers and acquisitions, some Chinese corporations have taken large amounts of capital out of China legally.

zh: 但没人知道这些外流的资本是否会转化为中国居民所持有的净外国头寸。
en: But no one knows whether those outflows will translate into net foreign assets owned by Chinese residents.

zh: 因此，要确定资本外逃的规模，你还必须考虑年底投资头寸，即“金融交易”和“头寸的其他变化”之差的变动。
en: That is why, to gauge the scale of capital flight, one must also consider the difference between year-end investment positions, net of “financial transactions” and “other changes in position.”

zh: 这样的计算让真相大白。
en: Doing so leads to a stark conclusion.

zh: 2012年以来，特别是2014年后，中国经历了大规模资本外逃。
en: Since 2012, and especially since 2014, China has experienced massive capital flight.

zh: 如果政府不在2016年采取行动阻止或者延缓资本账户自由化进程，结果将是真正的灾难。
en: If the government had not taken action to slow, if not halt, the process of capital-account liberalization in 2016, the results could have been truly devastating.

zh: 在过去，中国面临的关键挑战是停止输入“暗物质 ” （ dark matter ） ： 作为世界最大债权人之一，中国必须阻止投资收益赤字。
en: In the past, the key challenge facing China was to stop importing “dark matter”: as one of the world’s largest net creditors, China needed to stop running an investment-income deficit.

zh: 今天的挑战是避免“物质湮灭 ” （ matter annihilation ） ： 中国必须阻止净外国资产消失。
en: Today’s challenge is to avoid “matter annihilation”: China must prevent its net foreign assets from disappearing.

zh: 2013年年初，当资本账户自由化开展得如火如荼时，我写道 ， “ 中国既然弄体系太脆弱，经不起外部冲击，而全球经济仍陷在一片混乱之中，在这样的情况下，中国人民银行下注于其迅速实现资本账户自由化的能力来建立更健康、更稳健的金融体系是不明智的。
en: In early 2013, when capital-account liberalization was in full swing, I wrote that, “with China’s financial system too fragile to withstand external shocks, and the global economy mired in turmoil, the PBOC would be unwise to gamble on the ability of rapid capital-account liberalization to generate a healthier and more robust financial system.”

zh: ”事实上，我继续写道 ， “ 考虑到中国的全面改革日程，进一步开放资本账户可以等一等；而从自由化收益不明但风险巨大的情况看，也应该等一等。
en: In fact, I continued, “Given China’s extensive reform agenda, further opening of the capital account can wait; and, in view of liberalization’s ambiguous benefits and significant risks, it should.”

zh: ”四年后，这一建议仍值得重温。
en: Four years later, this advice is worth reiterating.

zh: 资本逃离的艺术
en: The Art of Capital Flight

zh: 美国剑桥—中国减速将给红得发紫的当代艺术品市场带来什么影响？
en: CAMBRIDGE – What impact will China’s slowdown have on the red-hot contemporary art market?

zh: 这似乎不是一个显而易见的问题，但你不妨想想，对新兴市场投资者来说，艺术品已经成为方便资本逃离和隐藏财富的关键工具。
en: That might not seem like an obvious question, until one considers that, for emerging-market investors, art has become a critical tool for facilitating capital flight and hiding wealth.

zh: 这些投资者已成为过去数年艺术品市场巨大的价格泡沫的主要因素。
en: These investors have become a major factor in the art market’s spectacular price bubble of the last several years.

zh: 因此，随着从俄罗斯到巴西的各新兴市场经济体纷纷陷入衰退，这个泡沫会破裂吗？
en: So, with emerging market economies from Russia to Brazil mired in recession, will the bubble burst?

zh: 仅仅五个月前，全球最大资产管理公司贝莱德（BlackRock）主席兼CEO拉里·芬克（Larry Fink）在新加坡告诉人们，当代艺术品已成为国际财富最重要的两个储藏工具之一，另一个是大都市高级公寓，如纽约、伦敦和温哥华等。
en: Just five months ago, Larry Fink, Chairman and CEO of BlackRock, the world’s largest asset manager, told an audience in Singapore that contemporary art has become one of the two most important stores of wealth internationally, along with apartments in major cities such as New York, London, and Vancouver.

zh: 别再将黄金作为通胀对冲工具了；买画吧。
en: Forget gold as an inflation hedge; buy paintings.

zh: 芬克将艺术品提高到投资级别，这令人震惊，因为此前从未有他这个地位的人敢这样说。
en: What made Fink’s elevation of art to investment-grade status so surprising is that no one of his stature had been brave enough to say it before.

zh: 我当然不是在赞美这一趋势。
en: I am certainly not celebrating the trend.

zh: 我倾向于同意哲学家彼得·辛格（Peter Singer）的说法：将如此巨大数量的金钱花在现代艺术的名作上令人不安。
en: I tend to agree with the philosopher Peter Singer that the obscene sums being spent on premier pieces of modern art are disquieting.

zh: 我们都同意，数字令人咋舌。
en: We can all agree that these sums are staggering.

zh: 5月，毕加索的《阿尔及尔的女人 》 （ Women of Algiers）在佳士得纽约拍卖会上以1.79亿美元卖出，而其在1997年的价格为3,200万美元。
en: In May, Pablo Picasso’s “Women of Algiers” sold for $179 million at a Christie’s auction in New York, up from $32 million in 1997.

zh: 好吧，这是毕加索。
en: Okay, it’s a Picasso.

zh: 但这甚至不是今年的最高价格。
en: Yet it is not even the highest sale price paid this year.

zh: 据报道一名瑞士收藏家通过私下交易以接近3亿美元的价格将高更1892年的作品《你什么时候结婚 》 （ When Will You Marry ? ） 收入囊中。
en: A Swiss collector reportedly paid close to $300 million in a private sale for Paul Gauguin’s 1892 “When Will You Marry?”

zh: 毕加索和高更都已作古。
en: Picasso and Gauguin are deceased.

zh: 他们的画作的供给是已知的，并且有限。
en: The supply of their paintings is known and limited.

zh: 尽管如此，最近的价格疯狂蔓延到了众多尚在人世的艺术家，首屈一指的是美国人杰夫·昆斯（Jeff Koons）和德国人格哈德·里希特（Gerhard Richter ） ， 并且波及许多名声并不那么响亮的艺术家。
en: Nevertheless, the recent price frenzy extends to a significant number of living artists, led by the American Jeff Koons and the German Gerhard Richter, and extending well down the food chain.

zh: 对经济学家来说，艺术品泡沫带来很多令人着迷的问题，但其中又有趣味的一个正是谁会花这么多钱买高端艺术品。
en: For economists, the art bubble raises many fascinating questions, but an especially interesting one is exactly who would pay so much for high-end art.

zh: 答案难以知晓，因为艺术品世界非常不透明。
en: The answer is hard to know, because the art world is extremely opaque.

zh: 事实上，艺术品是最后一个不受监管的大投资机会。
en: Indeed, art is the last great unregulated investment opportunity.

zh: 关于对冲基金经理和私募艺术品股权基金（你购买的实际上是艺术品组合的股份，并没有真正拥有任何艺术品）收藏画作的故事已经司空见惯。
en: Much has been written about the painting collections of hedge fund managers and private equity art funds (where one essentially buys shares in portfolios of art without actually ever taking possession of anything).

zh: 事实上，新兴市场买家，包括中国人，在许多案例中以摇摆买家的面目出现，常常匿名购买。
en: In fact, emerging-market buyers, including Chinese, have become the swing buyers in many instances, often making purchases anonymously.

zh: 但中国不是有严格的资本管制、限制公民每年携外汇出国的规模不得超过50,000美元吗？
en: But doesn’t China have a regime of strict capital controls that limits citizens from taking more than $50,000 per year out of the country?

zh: 是的，但有的是办法让钱进出中国，包括由来已久的“开发票”法。
en: Yes, but there are many ways of moving money in and out of China, including the time-honored method of “under and over invoicing.”

zh: 比如，要把钱弄出中国，中国卖家会与西方进口商合作，大幅低报后者所实际支付的款项的美元价值，差价则存入海外银行账户。
en: For example, to get money out of China, a Chinese seller might report a dollar value far below what she was actually paid by a cooperating Western importer, with the difference being deposited into an overseas bank account.

zh: 估算资本外逃是极端困难的，这既是因为数据不足，也是因为难以区分资本外逃和正常的多样化。
en: It is extremely difficult to estimate capital flight, both because the data are insufficient and because it is tough to distinguish capital flight from normal diversification.

zh: 已故的麻省理工学院经济学家鲁迪格·多恩布什（Rüdiger Dornbusch）常常戏谑说，识别资本外逃就好比是盲人摸象：你很难描述它，但你看到它的时候你能认得出。
en: As the late MIT economist Rüdiger Dornbusch liked to quip, identifying capital flight is akin to the old adage about blind men touching an elephant: It is difficult to describe, but you will recognize it when you see it.

zh: 许多估算认为，近几年来每年逃离中国的资本大约在3,000亿美元，而2015年大幅上升，因为经济持续低迷。
en: Many estimates put capital flight from China at about $300 billion annually in recent years, with a marked increase in 2015 as the economy continues to weaken.

zh: 向来警惕性很高的中国当局正在打击洗钱；但是，由于打击对象资本外逃的动机非常强，打击洗钱就像是一场“打地鼠”游戏。
en: The ever-vigilant Chinese authorities are cracking down on money laundering; but, given the huge incentives on the other side, this is like playing whack-a-mole.

zh: 最近的索斯比和佳士得拍卖会上的匿名中国买家相比在出价前就已经将钱挪到了海外，而画作只不过是能够轻易地保密的投资工具。
en: Presumably, the anonymous Chinese buyers at recent Sotheby’s and Christie’s auctions had spirited their money out of the country before bidding, and the paintings are just an investment vehicle that is particularly easy to hold secretively.

zh: 艺术品甚至未必会现身，而是一直藏在恒温恒湿的瑞士或卢森堡保存室中。
en: The art is not necessarily even displayed anywhere: It may well be spirited off to a temperature- and humidity-controlled storage vault in Switzerland or Luxembourg.

zh: 据报道，今天的一些艺术品买卖只不过是讲画作从某间保存室的某一格移动到另一格，这让人想起了纽约联邦储备银行如何注册各国央行间的黄金交易。
en: Reportedly, some art sales today result in paintings merely being moved from one section of a storage vault to another, recalling how the New York Federal Reserve registers gold sales between national central banks.

zh: 显然，参与资本外逃的艺术投资者，或者希望隐身或洗钱的艺术品投资者，他们的激励和动机与普通投资者大相径庭。
en: Clearly, the incentives and motives of art investors who are engaged in capital flight, or who want to hide or launder their money, are quite different from those of ordinary investors.

zh: 中国人绝非这一游戏的发明者。
en: The Chinese hardly invented this game.

zh: 不久前，拉美是艺术品市场的主要推动力量，因为阿根廷和委内瑞拉等治理不善的经济体有大量资金出逃，而毒枭们也用画作洗白他们的现金。
en: It was not so long ago that Latin America was the big driver in the art market, owing to money escaping governance-challenged economies such as Argentina and Venezuela, as well as drug cartels that used paintings to launder their cash.

zh: 那么，因中国导致的新兴市场减速会如何影响当代艺术品价格呢？
en: So how, then, will the emerging-market slowdown radiating from China affect contemporary art prices?

zh: 在短期，答案是两可的，因为随着一国经济的减速，有更多的钱想要逃离这个国家。
en: In the short run, the answer is ambiguous, because more money is leaking out of the country even as the economy slows.

zh: 在长期，特别是在美联储即将升息的背景下，结果很明确。
en: In the long run, the outcome is pretty clear, especially if one throws in the coming Fed interest-rate hikes.

zh: 随着核心买家的离场和机会成本的上升，艺术品泡沫的最终结局画面也许不会好看。
en: With core buyers pulling back, and the opportunity cost rising, the end of the art bubble will not be a pretty picture.

zh: 中国的西方价值观之战
en: China’s War on Western Values

zh: 克莱蒙特—这些天关于中国的消息大多令人沮丧，因为政府在加紧对批评者的镇压。
en: CLAREMONT – The news from China these days is mostly depressing, owing to the government’s escalating crackdown on its critics.

zh: 但绝大部分观察者 — — 特别是经济分析家 — — 没有注意到的是中国领导层对自由主义或“西方价值观”的战争直接影响着其根除腐败、促进创新和企业家精神以及更深地融入外部世界的努力。
en: But what few observers – particularly economic analysts – seem to understand is that the Chinese leadership’s fight against liberalism and “Western values” is directly undermining its efforts to root out official corruption, promote innovation and entrepreneurship, and deepen engagement with the outside world.

zh: 中共政权的政治倒退对中国的后续经济发展将产生严重后果。
en: The regime’s retrograde politics will have serious consequences for China’s continued economic development.

zh: 首先，政府加紧了互联网审查，热门门户和网站 — — 包括谷歌、Facebook和《纽约时报 》 — —都上不去。
en: For starters, the government has intensified its censorship of the Internet, rendering popular portals and sites – including Google, Facebook, and the New York Times – all but inaccessible.

zh: 此外，著名人权律师遭遇监禁，著名的言论自由支持者浦志强就是其中之一，目前他已被关押超过半年，检方正在罗织罪名。
en: Moreover, prominent human-rights lawyers have been jailed; the well-known free-speech advocate Pu Zhiqiang, for one, has already been held for over six months, while prosecutors attempt to build a case against him.

zh: 与此同时，中国高级官员开始在中共内部执行政治纪律。
en: Meanwhile, senior Chinese officials have taken to enforcing political discipline within the Chinese Communist Party.

zh: 去年6月，中纪委驻中国社科院纪检组组长张英伟说，社科院 — — 中国最著名的官办智库 — — “接受境外势力点对点的渗透 ” ， 以及“每逢敏感时期，进行不法的勾连活动 ” 。
