en: Last June, Zhang Yingwei, Head of the CCP’s discipline inspection office at the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences (CASS), said that the institution – China’s most prestigious government-run think tank – had been “infiltrated by foreign forces” and “was conducting illegal collusion at politically sensitive times.”

zh: 中国社科院副院长、党组副书记赵胜轩对此的反应是保证社科院将“政治纪律作为首要因素 ” 。
en: Zhao Shengxuan, Vice President and Deputy Party Chief of CASS, responded by pledging that the Academy would “treat political discipline as a criterion of the utmost importance in the assessment of academics.”

zh: 不久，中国社科院院长王伟光刊出一篇奇文，称阶级斗争在中国永远不会停止。
en: Soon after, CASS President Wang Weiguang thundered in an essay that class struggle would never be extinguished in China.

zh: 更广泛的中国学界一直是中共政权寻找敌人的首要目标 — — 大学常常开除信奉宪政等“煽动性”思想的教授。
en: Chinese academia more broadly has been the regime’s chief target in its search for enemies, with universities dismissing professors for espousing “seditious” ideas like constitutionalism.

zh: 在一个臭名昭著的例子中，辽宁省的一家官方报纸披露记者乔装成学生进入大学课堂抓住教授批评政府。
en: In a particularly egregious case, an official newspaper in Liaoning province dispatched reporters disguised as students to college classrooms to catch professors criticizing the regime.

zh: 中国教育部部长袁贵仁的最近言论的打击面更大。
en: A recent pronouncement by China’s education minister, Yuan Guiren, threatens to do damage on a far larger scale.

zh: 袁贵仁说，绝不能让 “传播西方价值观”的教材 — — 特别是那些“攻击诽谤党的领导、抹黑社会主义的言论 ” — —进入课堂。
en: Yuan has vowed never to allow textbooks “promoting Western values” – especially those that “attack or defame the leadership of the Party or smear socialism” – into Chinese classrooms.

zh: 考虑到袁贵仁的地位，这一宣言实际上可以视为官方政策。
en: Given Yuan’s position, this pledge could effectively amount to official policy.

zh: 为中国的命运着想，但愿这不是真的。
en: One hopes, for China’s sake, that it does not.

zh: 最近针对言论自由和西方价值观的突击反映出国家主席习近平所面临的核心政治挑战。 习近平必须将因贪婪和不信任而衰败无力的一党体系转变为秩序良好、思想统一的体制，使之具备实施市场改革、维持长期生存的能力。
en: The recent onslaught against free speech and Western values reflects the central political challenge facing President Xi Jinping, who must transform a one-party system enfeebled by greed and mistrust into a well-ordered, ideologically united regime capable of carrying out market-based reforms and sustaining its own long-term survival.

zh: 他似乎认为，镇压自由主义有利于他推进这一目标的反腐运动。
en: A crackdown on liberalism, he seems to believe, will work alongside his anti-corruption campaign to advance this goal.

zh: 这一观点在理论和实践上都站不住脚。
en: This vision is as intellectually flawed as it is impractical.

zh: 不管如何努力，一党体系都不可能在没有言论自由、强大的公民社会和法治精神的情况下根除腐败。
en: However hard one tries, it is virtually impossible to root out corruption in a one-party system without press freedom, a robust civil society, or the rule of law.

zh: 而这些正是中共高级干部所欲除之而后快的“西方价值观 ” 。
en: Yet these are precisely the “Western values” that CCP apparatchiks are attempting to eliminate.

zh: 中国将为这一错误付出沉重代价。
en: China will pay dearly for this mistake.

zh: 想想袁贵仁的教材批评对中国2,800万本科生的影响，他们将不得不使用不合格的课程教材。
en: Consider the impact of Yuan’s textbook campaign on China’s 28 million college undergraduates, who would be left with substandard course materials.

zh: 受到如此教育，这些学生如何能够在全球经济中竞争？
en: How could these students be expected to compete in the global economy, when their education has been compromised in this way?

zh: 当前趋势意味着他们的老师也将面临日益恶化的环境，特别是社会科学和人文科学领域，因为学界与西方的交流将面临更严格的限制。
en: The current trend implies deteriorating conditions for their teachers as well, particularly in the social sciences and humanities, as academics face tighter restrictions on scholarly exchanges with the West.

zh: 出国参加会议、在西方学术刊物发表文章或在国外进行教学和研究的机会将越来越少，他们的职业发展和职业生涯将严重受损。
en: With fewer opportunities to attend conferences abroad, publish papers in Western academic journals, or spend time teaching or conducting research outside of China, their professional development and careers could be severely impaired.

zh: 因此，政府对“西方价值观”的镇压 — — 更不用说无情的互联网战争了 — — 可能促使中国最优秀、最聪明的头脑外流。
en: As a result, the government’s suppression of “Western values” – not to mention its relentless war on the Internet – is likely to spur an exodus of the country’s best and brightest.

zh: 2013年，中国海外留学生数量达到了前所未有的413,900 人 — — 预计2014年的数字还将更高。
en: In 2013, an unprecedented 413,900 Chinese studied abroad – and the figure is expected to be even higher for 2014.

zh: 其中90%的留学生选择在西方国家（以及日本）留学。
en: Of those, 90% chose to study in Western countries (plus Japan).

zh: 平心而论，只有小部分中国大学生在海外大学就读。
en: To be sure, only a small fraction of college-age Chinese students attend universities overseas.

zh: 事实上，2013年出国留学生人数只相当于中国国内大学生人数的6 % 。
en: Indeed, the number of students who went abroad in 2013 was equivalent to only 6% of the students admitted to Chinese universities.

zh: 但中国的执政精英并不把这一群体视为其长期生存的代价，而是引领着出国潮 — — 大多将孩子们送往常青藤大学和牛津剑桥。
en: But China’s ruling elite, far from writing off this group as the price of its long-term survival, is leading the rush to the exits – largely sending its children to the Ivy League and Oxbridge.

zh: 你会奇怪中共领导人到底但不担心他们的子孙后代被西方价值观洗脑；他们显然不愿将孩子们送入国内大学。
en: One wonders whether CCP leaders worry that their offspring will be brainwashed by Western values; they evidently already are reluctant to send their children to local universities.

zh: 此外，如果袁贵仁的话当真，中国大学将日益与朝鲜大学而不是世界级西方大学看齐。
en: And, if Yuan has his way, China’s universities would increasingly look like their North Korean counterparts, rather than world-class Western institutions.

zh: 这将带来影响深远的灾难性后果。
en: That would have far-reaching – and devastating – consequences.

zh: 留在国内的数千万学生将无法获得维持 — — 更不用说增加 — — 中国经济全球竞争力所需要的知识和技能。
en: The tens of millions of students who remain in China would not gain the knowledge and skills needed to maintain, much less improve, the economy’s global competitiveness.

zh: 事实上，创新是中国持续经济发展的关键 — — 习近平一再强调这一点 — — 因此对西方对中国教育的影响开战实在不合理性。
en: Indeed, given that innovation is critical to China’s continued economic development – a point that Xi has repeatedly emphasized – a war against Western influence in Chinese education is downright irrational.

zh: 除非政府的镇压马上结束，否则习近平的国家富强的“中国梦”将演变为加速衰落、日益落后的噩梦。
en: Unless the government’s crackdown ends soon, Xi’s “Chinese dream” of national greatness and prosperity will turn into a nightmare of accelerating decline and increasing backwardness.

zh: 无论如何，向西方价值观开战的中国必将输掉这场战争。
en: One way or the other, the war on Western values is a war that China can only lose.

zh: 习近平的大战略
en: The Grand Strategy of Xi Jinping

zh: 首尔—2014年，中国花了很多时间重现一个七十年前日本所提出的概念，当时的日本帝国主义向整个地区强加自己的意愿 ： “ 亚洲人的亚洲 ” 。
en: SEOUL – China spent much of 2014 seeking to revive a concept that Japan proclaimed seven decades ago, when it was an imperial power seeking to impose its will on the region: “Asia for the Asians.”

zh: 但中国的结局也许会比日本更好。
en: But that effort may not end as badly for China as it did for Japan.

zh: 国际关系总是在实力分布迅速变化的时期变得动荡。
en: International relations tend to become destabilized by rapid changes in the distribution of power.

zh: 老牌列强拒绝接受崛起新贵在决定全球日程中扮演更重要角色的要求，从而助长紧张、干扰既成世界秩序。
en: Established powers’ resistance to their rising counterparts’ demands for a larger role in setting the global agenda fuel tensions and disrupt the existing world order.

zh: 最近在中国和美国之间发生的事情就是如此，这也正是中国“亚洲人的亚洲”政策的动力。
en: That is precisely what has been occurring lately between China and the United States, and is the impetus for China’s “Asia for the Asians” policy.

zh: 去年11月，中国在包括争议海域 — — 主要是中国、日本和中国台湾都主张主权的钓鱼岛 — — 的东海广大海域单方面宣布了防空识别区（ADIZ ） ， 此举动摇了地区秩序。
en: In November 2013, China shook the regional order by unilaterally declaring an air-defense identification zone (ADIZ) over a large swath of the East China Sea that includes disputed territory – notably the Senkaku Islands (known in Chinese as the Diaoyu Islands) that are claimed by China, Japan, and Taiwan.

zh: 这是中国本已咄咄逼人的地区立场的进一步升级，中国国家主席习近平定期派遣海监船和渔政船前往钓鱼岛周边水域，引起韩国和日本的不满。
en: This amounted to an escalation of China’s already assertive stance in the region, with Chinese President Xi Jinping routinely sending maritime-surveillance and fishery law-enforcement ships to the waters surrounding the islands, spurring protests in South Korea and Japan.

zh: 受盟国之怒的促使，美国派遣了两架B-52轰炸机进入中方防空识别区。
en: The US, prompted by its allies’ anger, dispatched two B-52 bombers into the ADIZ.

zh: 紧张局面在2014年初继续升级，引起了人们对中日之间“意外战争 ” （ accidental war）的担忧。 若发生意外战争，日本的主要盟国美国也需要介入（奥巴马在4月访问东京时确认了这一点 ） 。
en: Tensions continued to mount through early 2014, raising concerns about an “accidental war” between China and Japan, which would demand the involvement of Japan’s main ally, the US (as President Barack Obama confirmed on a visit to Tokyo last April).

zh: 与此同时，中国对南海岛礁的领土主张引起菲律宾和越南的反弹，中国和美国之间的冲突看上去不可避免。
en: Add to that simultaneous tensions over China’s claims to South China Sea islands and atolls – claims disputed by the Philippines and Vietnam – and a clash between China and the US was beginning to seem inevitable.

zh: 但是，没过多久，美国就不得不把注意力转向了俄罗斯。 在总统普京的领导下，俄罗斯一直在寻求恢复冷战时期苏丽安娜的地缘政治地位。
en: Before long, however, the US had to turn its attention to Russia, which under President Vladimir Putin’s leadership has been seeking to recapture the Cold War-era Soviet Union’s geopolitical status.

zh: 其地区威权显然受到乌克兰日益亲欧情绪的威胁，因此俄罗斯入侵并吞并了克里米亚，并开始支持东乌克兰的分裂主义叛军，促使美国和欧洲对其实施日益严厉的政治和经济制裁。
en: With its regional authority apparently threatened by rising pro-European sentiment in Ukraine, Russia invaded and annexed Crimea and began supporting separatist rebels in eastern Ukraine, prompting the US and Europe to impose increasingly tough political and economic sanctions.

zh: 在这场冲突中，中国实际成为美国某种意义上的盟友。
en: In this conflict, China has actually become something of a US ally.

zh: 尽管俄中天然气协议经过漫长谈判终告成功，或许反映了两国关系的深化，但中国从俄罗斯那里要到了极低的天然气价。
en: Though the conclusion of long-negotiated gas deals between Russia and China may seem to reflect a deepening of the bilateral relationship, China extracted an exceedingly low price from Russia for the gas that it will receive.

zh: 考虑到这一点，再加上自俄罗斯入侵克里米亚以来中国减少了对俄贷款这一事实，表明从长期看，中国将俄罗斯视为自然资源库而不是平等盟友。
en: This, together with the fact that China has cut lending to Russia since the Crimea invasion, suggests that, in the longer term, the Chinese envision Russia as a natural-resource vassal, not an equal ally.

zh: 中国和美国的政策趋同在2014年的朝鲜问题上表现得更加明显。
en: Chinese and American policies converged even more clearly on North Korea in 2014.

zh: 习近平表示他无意容忍朝鲜变幻莫测的统治者的任何恣睢行为 — — 特别是在核武器问题上。
en: Xi expressed his unwillingness to tolerate any unruly behavior – particularly concerning nuclear weapons – by the country’s unpredictable rulers.

zh: 这促使依赖中国援助的朝鲜向日本、俄罗斯甚至韩国派去外交对话员。
en: This drove the North, which depends on Chinese aid, to send diplomatic interlocutors to Japan, Russia, and even South Korea.

zh: 但是，随着联合国大会作出关于朝鲜人权状况的决议，朝鲜当局又宣布将进行第四次核试验。
en: But, following the United Nations General Assembly’s resolution on North Korea’s human-rights situation, the regime announced that it would hold its fourth nuclear test.

zh: 今年的实力变迁与其说是拜俄罗斯的修正主义野心或中国的军事和经济崛起所赐，不如说是因为美国国际领导力的衰落。
en: These power shifts are the result less of Russia’s expansionist ambitions or China’s military and economic rise than of America’s declining international leadership.

zh: 奥巴马不愿 — — 或者不能，因为美国国内政治党派队里日益严重 — — 在解决埃及、利比亚和叙利亚等国的危机中承担领导责任，这让美国地位的挑战者在2014年信心十足，而美国的盟国则心惊胆寒。
en: With Obama unwilling – or unable, due to rising political partisanship at home – to take the lead in addressing crises like those in Egypt, Libya, and Syria, challengers to American primacy took heart in 2014, and US allies took fright.

zh: 全球实力必须有一个落脚点；如果美国不在国际舞台上柜承担主角，那么就必须有替身站出来。
en: Global power must be allocated somewhere; if the US would not fill its leading role on the international stage, an understudy would have to step in.

zh: 但中国最近不在耀武扬威并且与美国领导的秩序协调利益让人感到它不会在明年继续掀起大规模地区动荡。
en: But China’s recent shift away from muscle-flexing, and its confluence of interests with a US-led order, offers hope that it will not fuel large-scale regional instability this year.

zh: 事实上，7月份中国从争议的西沙群岛到撤回了巨型钻井平台，向钓鱼岛派遣海监船的频率也降低了。
en: Indeed, China withdrew its jumbo oil platform from the waters of the disputed Paracel Islands last July, and it has been sending surveillance ships to the Senkaku Islands less frequently.

zh: 中国官员也更加愿意讨论建立南海行为规范的问题。
en: Chinese officials have also become more willing to discuss the creation of a code of conduct for the South China Sea.

zh: 中国魅力攻势中最重要的元素是其试图改善与日本的关系，首先是在最近的APEC北京峰会上，习近平与日本首相安倍晋三举行了场外会晤。
en: The most important element of China’s charm offensive is its effort to improve relations with Japan, initiated at a meeting between Xi and Japan’s Prime Minister Shinzo Abe on the sidelines of the recent APEC meeting in Beijing.

zh: 在这次APEC峰会的外围会议上，习近平还与奥巴马达成了人们期待已久的气候协议，这也是个不小的动作。
en: The long-awaited climate deal that Xi struck with Obama at another peripheral meeting at the same event is no small step, either.

zh: 中国新的柔性外交体现了更加细致的外交政策。
en: China’s new, more emollient diplomacy underpins a nuanced foreign policy.

zh: 通过向东南亚邻国提供慷慨的经济激励，中国削弱了它们联合对抗中国的意愿。
en: By offering generous economic incentives to its Southeast Asian neighbors, it has weakened their will to confront China in a coalition.

zh: 比如，越南决定“重置”对华关系，并且不与菲律宾合作与中国打海权主张的法律战。
en: Vietnam, for example, decided to “reset” its relations with China, and not to cooperate with the Philippines in waging a legal battle over China’s maritime claims.

zh: 事实上，中国在整个地区正在从硬实力转向软实力，并且正在利用其经济实力挑战西方主导的多边机构。
en: Indeed, China has been shifting from hard power to soft throughout the region, and is using its economic power to challenge Western-dominated multilateral institutions.

zh: 具体而言，中国决定投入大量资金成立新的发展机构：亚洲基础设施投资银行、丝绸之路银行和新开发银行（由五个主要新兴经济体 — — 巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非成立 ） 。
en: Specifically, China has decided to pour huge amounts of money into establishing new development institutions: the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, the Maritime Silk Road Bank, and the New Development Bank (created by the five major emerging economies, Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa).

zh: 此外，中国总理李克强最近还向东盟国家提供200亿美元用于基础设施和发展项目融资。
en: Furthermore, Chinese Premier Li Keqiang recently offered $20 billion to finance infrastructure and development projects in the ASEAN countries.

zh: 美国经济尚未从全球经济危机中完全复苏，美国政治也日益陷入功能失调，这给拥有精明外交和经济实力的中国带来了其所希望填补的全球实力真空 — — 起点就是亚洲。
en: With the US economy yet to recover fully from the global economic crisis, and American politics increasingly dysfunctional, there is a global power vacuum that China, with shrewd diplomacy and economic might, hopes to fill – beginning in Asia.

zh: 这并不意味着亚洲只是亚洲人的亚洲；但这可能意味着美国地区作用的减弱 — — 特别是美国将随着2015年总统选举季的开始而转向国内时。
en: This may not yet mean Asia for only the Asians; but it could mean a reduced regional role for the US – especially as America turns inward during the presidential election season that starts this year.

zh: 中国的五万亿美元良机
en: China’s $5 Trillion Opportunity

zh: 发自上海 — — 在经历了数十年波澜壮阔的发展后，如今的中国正面临着实现经济软着陆的坚巨任务。
en: SHANGHAI – China is facing the difficult task of managing a soft economic landing, after decades of spectacular expansion.

zh: 虽然唱反调者比比皆是，但我们没有必要去担心这些言论，因为在当前动荡的全球经济形势下，中国有着其他国家并不具备的优势：一个清晰的前进路径。
en: Naysayers abound, but never mind them. China has an advantage that other countries in today’s troubled global economy lack: a clear path forward.

zh: 只要中国能实施持续全面的举措以提高生产率，就能应对其发展挑战，降低金融危机的风险，并实现向拥有大量富裕中产阶级的消费驱动型高收入经济体过渡。
en: If China carries out a sustained, comprehensive effort to raise productivity, it can address its growth challenges, reduce the risks of financial crisis, and complete its transition to a consumption-driven, high-income economy with a large and affluent middle class.

zh: 如能实现这一点，到2030年中国的GDP总量估计要比政策制定者们单纯追求投资拉动型增长的方式多产出近5万亿美元。
en: If it does, its annual GDP could be an estimated $5 trillion larger by 2030 than it is likely to be if policymakers continue to pursue investment-led growth.

zh: 事实上，中国可能别无选择。
en: And, in fact, China may have little choice.

zh: 其传统经济驱动引擎 — — 大量剩余劳动力和对基础设施，住房和工业能力的大规模投资 — — 正趋于枯竭。
en: The traditional drivers of its economy – a vast pool of surplus labor and massive investments in infrastructure, housing, and industrial capacity – are becoming exhausted.

zh: 劳动年龄人口数量已经见顶，城市化进程正在放缓，而钢铁和水泥行业正饱受产能过剩之苦。
en: The working-age population has peaked, urbanization is slowing, and the steel and cement industries are suffering from overcapacity.

zh: 由于资本回报率下降，所以中国不可能再靠投资支出来催生足够的增长。
en: Returns on capital have declined, so China cannot rely on investment spending to generate sufficient growth.

zh: 但幸运的是，中国的劳动生产率仅相当于发达经济体10~30％的水平，因此具备相当大的提升空间。
en: Fortunately, however, China has substantial room for gains in labor productivity, which is only 10-30% of the level in advanced economies.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院调研了包括煤炭，钢铁，自动制造业和零售业在内的2000多家中国企业，并认为到2030年有机会将生产效率提升20~100 ％ 。
en: When the McKinsey Global Institute analyzed more than 2,000 Chinese companies in industries ranging from coal and steel to auto manufacturing and retail, it found opportunities to raise productivity by 20-100% by 2030.

zh: 以中国的服务业为例。
en: Consider China’s service sector.

zh: 虽然行业发展迅速且已占到国内生产总值的50％左右，但占主导地位的依然还是低附加值企业。
en: Though the sector has grown rapidly and now accounts for about 50% of GDP, low-value-added businesses still dominate.

zh: 平均而言，中国服务业的生产效率只相当于经合组织国家同行的15％~30 ％ 。
en: On average, service businesses in China are just 15-30% as productive as their counterparts in OECD countries.

zh: 除了理顺和优化现有操作流程（例如通过引入零售企业自助结帐系统）之外，中国还有机会在诸如设计，会计，市场营销和物流领域提供高附加价值的业务服务以辅助其制造部门。
en: In addition to streamlining existing operations (for example, by introducing self-checkout systems in retail businesses), China has opportunities to complement its manufacturing sector with high-value-added business services in areas such as design, accounting, marketing, and logistics.

zh: 而对制造业本身来说，中国可以进一步提升自身企业的自动化水平。
en: In manufacturing itself, China can do more to automate its factories.

zh: 中国已经是全球最大的机器人采购过，但每万名工人只搭配36台机器人，与美国的164台和韩国的478台相去甚远。
en: China is the world’s largest purchaser of robots, but it still has only 36 robots per 10,000 workers, compared with 164 in the United States and 478 in Korea.

zh: 中国企业已经可以将自动和手动装配流水线协同运作，还可以通过合理化运作和提高能源利用率来提升自身的生产力表现，向全球同行看齐。
en: Chinese companies have already shown that they can mix automated and manual assembly lines. They also can raise productivity by rationalizing operations and improving energy efficiency, bringing their performance closer to that of their global peers.

zh: 中国企业是多个行业的主要生产商，但它们尚未采取一些能将价值最大化的步骤。
en: Chinese companies are major producers in a broad range of industries, but they have yet to take over the steps that add the most value.

zh: 以半导体产业为例，中国企业大多只是作为那些芯片设计和销售（也是大多数价值所在）公司的代工厂。
en: When it comes to semiconductors, for example, Chinese companies mostly serve as foundries for companies that design and sell chips (and, in doing so, capture the most value).

zh: 同样，仿制药占了中国药品销售额的90 ％ 。
en: Similarly, generics account for 90% of Chinese pharmaceutical sales.

zh: 中国可以以多种方式来鼓励创新，包括构建研发集群并通过加强知识产权保护以及改革企业市场化流程来鼓励发明创造。
en: China can support innovation in many ways, including by developing research-and-development clusters and helping inventors reap rewards through stronger intellectual property protection and reforms to the process of bringing firms to market.

zh: 在制药行业，一批创新型企业正利用一种中国独有的优势 — — 数量巨大且低成本的技术人才 — — 来推动药物研究，并通过研发品牌药物来进入更高利润的经营模式。
en: In the pharmaceutical industry, for example, a crop of innovative companies is developing a distinctively Chinese approach to drug discovery: massive scale and low-cost technical talent. These firms may be on their way to cracking the more lucrative business of brand-name drugs.

zh: 而中国最大的生产力提升空间则来自于那些产能过剩行业。
en: Some of China’s biggest productivity opportunities are in sectors suffering from overcapacity.

zh: 在过去的十年中，产能过剩导致该国的煤炭和钢铁行业资本投���年回报率从17％下降到了6 ％ 。
en: Over the past decade, overcapacity has reduced annual returns on capital in the country’s coal and steel industries from 17% to 6%.

zh: 中国汽车业年产能达4千万辆，但目前需求量只有2600万辆。
en: The Chinese auto industry is capable of building 40 million cars per year for a market that currently consumes 26 million.

zh: 以钢铁行业为例，通过让那些缺乏竞争力的企业破产并鼓励兼并整合，可以在不影响到满足需求能力的情况下大大提高生产率。
en: Restructuring industries like steel, by letting uncompetitive players fail and encouraging consolidation, could raise productivity dramatically without compromising the ability to meet demand.

zh: 一旦企业迈入高附加值模式，就能创造数以百万计报酬更高的工作机会，并因此提高家庭收入并使更多中国人称为中产阶级。
en: As companies move into higher-value-added activities, millions of better-paying jobs will be created, which should raise household incomes and move more Chinese into the middle class.

zh: 当然，在提高生产力进而实现收入提升前的两三年间，大规模的资源重新分配可能对社会造成相当大的痛苦和迷失。
en: In the first two or three years, however, before the income boost from rising productivity kicks in, the massive reallocation of resources could result in considerable pain and dislocation.

zh: 到2030年实现适度快速稳健的增长之前，数以百万计的低技能工人将需要接受再培训并被分配到新的岗位，GDP的增长也将比预期缓慢。
en: Millions of low-skill workers will need to be retrained and redeployed, and GDP may grow more slowly than expected, before assuming a moderately rapid, steady pace through 2030.

zh: 而另一种方案则是延续现状，以保证就业和社会稳定的名义硬撑起那些业绩不佳的公司 — — 即使这些企业将提高中国各银行的风险。
en: The alternative is a continuation of the status quo, with poorly performing companies propped up in the name of job preservation and social stability – even as they raise risks for Chinese banks.

zh: 中国的资源利用效率将维持低位，企业的全球竞争力也会走下坡路。
en: The country would use its resources unproductively, and its firms would become less globally competitive.

zh: 中国的历史使我们有理由相信它的领导人会做出正确的选择。
en: China’s history provides reason to believe that its leaders will make the right choice.

zh: 在1990年代，境况不佳的国有企业和亚洲金融危机差点拖累了该国的经济。
en: In the 1990s, ailing state industries and the Asian financial crisis risked dragging down the country’s economy.

zh: 但政府没有试图利用财政和货币刺激政策来提供短期经济刺激，而是进行了痛苦的改革，使该国实现了二十年的两位数增长，令人惊叹不已。
en: But, rather than attempting to use fiscal and monetary stimulus to provide a short-term economic boost, the government carried out wrenching reforms and put the country on the path to two decades of awe-inspiring, double-digit growth.

zh: 如今的中国面临着类似的决定。
en: Today, China faces a similar decision.

zh: 它可以选择暂时修修补补并最终令问题进一步恶化，也可以抓住机遇继续推进改革，以提高生产力并实现未来数年的经济繁荣。
en: It can settle for temporary fixes that will ultimately make the problem worse. Or it can seize the opportunity and press ahead with reforms that will boost productivity and create economic prosperity for years to come.

zh: 中国魅力攻势的局限性
en: The Limits of China’s Charm Offensive

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 过去十年来，中国对东亚国家的姿态越来越强硬。
en: STOCKHOLM – Over the last decade, China has taken an increasingly muscular approach to relations with East Asian countries.

zh: 但最近几个月，它令人惊讶地发起了一波魅力攻势。
en: But in recent months, it has surprised its neighbors with a charm offensive.

zh: 究竟发生了什么改变？
en: What changed?

zh: 谈起中国在该地区的所作所为，一两句话说不完。
en: In terms of China’s behavior in the region, quite a lot.

zh: 2013年，中国单方面宣布建立一个覆盖东海有争议的尖阁列岛/钓鱼岛的防空识别区 — — 此举恶化了与日方的紧张关系。
en: In 2013, China unilaterally declared an Air Defense Identification Zone covering the East China Sea’s disputed Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands – a move that exacerbated tensions with Japan.

zh: 一年后，中国开始在南海争议地区建造大型人工岛屿。
en: A year later, China began to construct large artificial islands in disputed areas of the South China Sea.

zh: 2016年，中国对韩国实施制裁，因为韩国允许美国在本国国内部署导弹防御体系。
en: In 2016, China imposed sanctions on South Korea in response to the decision to allow the United States to deploy a missile-defense system there.

zh: 但现在，这样的地缘战略欺凌似乎已经被外交活动所取代。
en: Now, however, such geostrategic bullying seems to be taking a backseat to diplomacy.

zh: 上个月，中国国家主席习近平欢迎日本首相安倍晋三抵达北京访问，安倍访华是七年来日本领导人首次访华，而习近平定于明年访问日本则是中国领导人十多年来的首次访日。
en: Last month, Chinese President Xi Jinping welcomed Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe to Beijing. Abe’s visit to China was the first for a Japanese leader in seven years, and Xi’s scheduled visit to Japan next year will be the first for a Chinese president in more than a decade.

zh: 上周，中国总理李克强前往新加坡，在那里，他签署了一份升级版的中新自由贸易协定。
en: Last week, Chinese Premier Li Keqiang headed to Singapore, where he signed an upgraded version of the China-Singapore free-trade agreement.

zh: 他还希望于明年签署并实施区域全面经济伙伴关系，中国于七年前启动了这项计划，目的是抗衡现在已经解体的跨太平洋伙伴关系（由于多边贸易协定本身具有的复杂性，这一过于雄心勃勃的目标似乎不太可能实现 ） 。
en: He also hopes to sign and implement the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership, which China initiated several years ago to counter the now-defunct Trans-Pacific Partnership, next year (an overly ambitious target unlikely to be achieved, owing to the complexities of multi-party trade deals).

zh: 中国不那么敌对的新姿态并不反映其领导人内心或目标的变化，而是反映变化了的地区地缘政治格局。
en: China’s new, less antagonistic approach does not reflect a change of heart or objectives on the part of its leaders, but rather a change in the regional geopolitical landscape.

zh: 过去六个月来，美国放弃了与中国长达40年的接触政策，反过来采用了遏制战略。
en: Over the last six months, the US has abandoned its four-decade-old policy of engagement with China, adopting a containment strategy instead.

zh: 面对美国不断升级的地缘政治竞争，中国正急于希望在该地区赢得友谊。
en: Facing escalating geopolitical competition with the US, China is scrambling to win friends in the region.

zh: 尽管中国的魅力攻势是个新发展，但其轮廓已经十分明确。
en: Although China’s charm offensive is very recent, its contours are already clear.

zh: 其中最为突出的特点是贸易。
en: The most prominent feature is trade.

zh: 作为众多亚洲国家最大的贸易伙伴，中国将像对新加坡已经实现的那样，为其邻国提供颇具诱惑力的贸易条件。
en: As the largest trading partner of numerous Asian countries, China will offer attractive trade terms to its neighbors, much as it has done with Singapore.

zh: 中国的新策略还包括更为频繁的高层外交接触，除日本外，还重点关注其他主要地区参与者，如韩国、印度尼西亚和越南。
en: China’s new tactics also include more frequent high-level diplomatic engagement, focused on leading regional players, such as South Korea, Indonesia, and Vietnam, in addition to Japan.

zh: 例如，习近平预定将于11月20-21日对菲律宾进行访问。
en: Xi Jinping, for example, is expected to visit the Philippines on November 20-21.

zh: 通过峰会和其他机会召集高级官员，中国将试图与邻国建立更友好的关系。
en: Through summits and other opportunities to convene senior officials, China will attempt to cultivate friendlier relations with its neighbors.

zh: 为支持这些努力，中国的宣传机器可能已经接到指令缓和其民族主义论调，并取消那些可能冒犯其邻国的内容。
en: To support these efforts, China’s propaganda machine has probably been instructed to tone down nationalist rhetoric and cut out content that might offend its neighbors.

zh: 最后，中国可能会暂时限制其对地区领土的要求。
en: Finally, China may temporarily restrain its assertion of territorial claims.

zh: 举例来讲，在可以预见的未来，中国不太可能将其2012年从菲律宾手中夺取的斯卡伯勒浅滩建设成又一个人工岛屿。
en: For example, it is unlikely to turn the Scarborough Shoal, which it seized from the Philippines in 2012, into another artificial island in the foreseeable future.

zh: 同样，它可能会避免派遣军舰靠近尖阁列岛/钓鱼岛，并以此来挑衅日本。
en: Likewise, it will probably avoid sending ships close to the Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands and antagonizing Japan.

zh: 迄今为止，东亚国家对中国的新外交都作出了积极的响应，他们无疑对来自中国好战政策的任何喘息机会都将表示欢迎。
en: East Asian countries have so far responded positively to China’s new diplomacy, and they would undoubtedly welcome any respite from Chinese belligerence.

zh: 但无论甜言蜜语还是贸易协定都无法为中国赢得可靠的盟友，尤其是在与美国的竞争过程中。
en: But neither sweet talk nor trade deals will secure reliable allies for China, especially in a contest against the US.

zh: 东亚鲜有国家希望生活在霸权中国的阴影之下。
en: Few in East Asia want to live in the shadow of a hegemonic China.

zh: 对这种前景的恐惧长期以来一直支撑着美国的东亚安全构架，这种构架基于双边联盟和美国军队的前沿部署。
en: The fear of that prospect has long underpinned America’s East Asian security architecture, which is based on bilateral alliances and forward deployment of the US military.

zh: 而由美国作为亚太地区的战略制衡力量仍然得到东亚国家的广泛支持。
en: And it sustains widespread support in East Asia for the US to act as a strategic counterweight in the region.

zh: 可以肯定，多数东亚国家都不愿立即选择站队。
en: To be sure, most East Asian countries prefer not to choose a side outright.

zh: 但如果美中两国爆发直接战略冲突 — — 这一前景的可能性越来越大 — — 从日本、韩国和越南等盟国那里获得最大支持的将是美国。
en: But if the US and China were to engage in direct strategic conflict – an increasingly likely prospect – it is the US that would gain the most support, especially from allies like Japan, South Korea, and Vietnam.

zh: 马来西亚和新加坡也有可能支持美国。
en: Malaysia and Singapore would probably also back the US.

zh: 如果中国想在邻国当中交到可靠的朋友，就必须在安全问题，尤其是领土争端问题上作出更大的让步。
en: If China wants to make reliable friends in its neighborhood, it will have to make far greater concessions on security issues, especially territorial disputes.

zh: 例如，永久解决有关尖阁列岛/钓鱼岛的领土主张将大大有助于说服日本中国并不构成严重的威胁。
en: For example, a permanent settlement of claims concerning the Senkaku/Diaoyu Islands would go a long way toward convincing Japan that China does not pose a serious threat.

zh: 同样，中国接受针对其南海领土主张的国际仲裁将有助于缓解东南亚邻国的担忧。
en: Similarly, China’s acceptance of international arbitration of its claims in the South China Sea would assuage the fears of its Southeast Asian neighbors.

zh: 目前来看，并无迹象表明，承诺“实现中国伟大复兴”的习近平正在考虑这样的让步。
en: As it stands, there is no indication that Xi, who has pledged to “make China great again,” is so much as considering such concessions.

zh: 但只要中国采取纯粹的战术方法，那么它只能获取纯粹的战术收益。
en: But as long as China takes a purely tactical approach, it will reap purely tactical gains.

zh: 在建立能够抵御与美国战略冲突的友谊时，那些收益还远远不够。
en: When it comes to building friendships that can withstand strategic conflict with the US, those gains will not be nearly enough.

zh: 中国的软实力制约
en: The Limits of Chinese Soft Power

zh: 美国剑桥—中国一直在竭力增强其在不使用武力和强制手段的情况下影响其他国家的能力。
en: CAMBRIDGE – China has been making major efforts to increase its ability to influence other countries without force or coercion.

zh: 2007年，时任国家主席胡锦涛告诫中共，中国需要提升软实力；现任国家主席习近平在去年又重申了这一点。
en: In 2007, then-President Hu Jintao told the Communist Party that the country needed to increase its soft power; President Xi Jinping repeated the same message last year.

zh: 他们知道，对于中国这样的国家，经济和军事实力的增长有可能让邻国陷入恐慌，促使它们结成制衡联盟，因此，明智的战略必须包括让中国看起来不那么可怕的措施。
en: They know that, for a country like China, whose growing economic and military power risks scaring its neighbors into forming counter-balancing coalitions, a smart strategy must include efforts to appear less frightening.

zh: 但中国的软实力野心仍面临着重大障碍。
en: But their soft-power ambitions still face major obstacles.

zh: 诚然，中国的努力已经形成了一些影响。
en: To be sure, China’s efforts have had some impact.

zh: 中国广延各国成为其亚洲基础设施投资银行成员国，并在国事访问中给予各国数十亿美元的援助，这让一些观察家担心，在软实力方面，中国实际上可能已经领先美国等其他国家一头。
en: As China enrolls countries as members of its Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and doles out billions of dollars of aid during state visits abroad, some observers worry that, when it comes to soft power, China could actually be taking the lead over countries like the United States.

zh: 比如，美国“中国通”沈大伟（David Shambaugh）估算中国每年在“对外宣传”中花费大约100亿美元。
en: The American sinologist David Shambaugh, for example, estimates that the country spends roughly $10 billion a year in “external propaganda.”

zh: 相反，美国去年公共外交支出仅为6.66亿美元。
en: By comparison, the US spent only $666 million on public diplomacy last year.

zh: 但中国在魅力攻势上所花费的数十亿美元获得的回报极其有限。
en: Yet the billions of dollars China is spending on its charm offensive have had only a limited return.

zh: 北美、欧洲、印度和日本的民调显示，对中国影响力的观点呈现出显著的负面态度。
en: Polls in North America, Europe, India, and Japan show that opinions about China’s influence are predominantly negative.

zh: 在拉美和非洲，中国的形象更加正面 — — 中国在这些地区没有领土纠纷，人权问题也常常不属于公共日程的重点。
en: The country is viewed more positively in Latin America and Africa, where it has no territorial disputes and human-rights concerns are not always high on the public agenda.

zh: 但即使在这些地区的许多国家，中国的行为 — — 如进口劳动力从事基础设施工程 — — 也不受欢迎。
en: But even in many countries in those regions, Chinese practices like importing labor for infrastructure projects are unpopular.

zh: 看起来，将硬实力和软实力结合形成一个巧妙的战略并非易事。
en: Combining hard and soft power into a smart strategy, it turns out, is not easy.

zh: 一国软实力主要来自三个方面：文化（哪些地方认为其文化具有吸引力 ） 、 政治价值（如果能在国内和国外实现）以及外交政策（如果被视为合理并且具有道德权威性 ） 。
en: A country derives its soft power primarily from three resources: its culture (in places that find it appealing), its political values (when it lives up to them at home and abroad), and its foreign policies (when they are seen as legitimate and having moral authority).

zh: 中国强调其文化和经济强势，但不太关注可能破坏其努力的政治角度。
en: China has emphasized its cultural and economic strengths, but it has paid less attention to the political aspects that can undermine its efforts.

zh: 从最近的国际民调看，两个主要因素制约了中国的软实力。
en: Two major factors limit China’s soft power, as measured by recent international polls.

zh: 首先是民族主义。
en: The first is nationalism.

zh: 中共的合法性基础不但来自高经济增长率，也来自民族主义诉求。
en: The Communist Party has based its legitimacy not only on a high rate of economic growth, but also on appeals to nationalism.

zh: 这样做降低了习近平“中国梦”的国际吸引力，也助长了引起邻国反抗的南海等地区的政策。
en: Doing so has reduced the universal appeal of Xi’s “Chinese Dream,” while encouraging policies in the South China Sea and elsewhere that antagonize its neighbors.

zh: 比如，中国与菲律宾的南海岛礁所有权争议中恃强凌弱，这使得中国在马尼拉建立的孔子学院无法赢得美誉。
en: With, for example, China bullying the Philippines over possession of disputed islands in the South China Sea, the Confucius Institute that China established in Manila to teach Chinese culture can win only so much goodwill.

zh: （中国在100多个国家开设了大约500家孔子学院。
en: (China has opened some 500 such institutes in more than 100 countries.)

zh: ）中国外交政策的后果在去年的越南反华骚乱中可见一斑。 这场骚乱因为中国在中越争议水域钻井开采石油引起。
en: The consequences of the country’s foreign policy can be seen in last year’s anti-Chinese riots in Vietnam following the positioning of a Chinese oil drilling rig in waters claimed by both countries.

zh: 另一个制约因素是中国不愿充分利用不受审查的公民社会。
en: The other limit is China's reluctance to take full advantage of an uncensored civil society.

zh: 《经济学人 》 （ Economist）指出，中共对于软实力主要来自个人、私人部门和公民社会的思想不买账。
en: As noted by The Economist, the Chinese Communist Party has not bought into the idea that soft power springs largely from individuals, the private sector, and civil society.

zh: 相反，中共坚持认为政府是软实力的主要来源，推广其认为具有全球吸引力的古代文化形象 — — 通常是通过宣传工具进行。
en: Instead, it has clung to the view that the government is the main source of soft power, promoting ancient cultural icons that it thinks might have global appeal, often using the tools of propaganda.

zh: 当今媒体业可谓信息泛滥。
en: In today’s media landscape, information is abundant.

zh: 稀缺的关注，关注取决于可信度 — — 而政府宣传很少有可信的。
en: What is scarce is attention, which depends on credibility – and government propaganda is rarely credible.

zh: 中国试图把新华社和中央电视台打造成为CNN和BBC的竞争对手，但不可靠的宣传的国际受众规模非常小。
en: For all of China’s efforts to position the Xinhua news agency and China Central Television as competitors of CNN and the BBC, the international audience for brittle propaganda is vanishingly small.

zh: 相反，美国的软实力很大程度上并非来自政府，而来自公民社会 — — 从大学和基金会到好莱坞和流行文化的一切。
en: The US, by contrast, derives much of its soft power not from the government, but from civil society – everything from universities and foundations to Hollywood and pop culture.

zh: 中国尚不具备规模堪与好莱坞相比的全球文化产业或实力堪与美国相比的大学。
en: China does not yet have global cultural industries on the scale of Hollywood or universities capable of rivaling America’s.

zh: 更重要的是，中国缺少美国那样的对软实力做出巨大贡献的大量非政府组织。
en: Even more important, it lacks the many non-governmental organizations that generate much of America’s soft power.

zh: 除了在海外营造良好声誉、推进国家形象，软实力的非政府来源有时还可以通过其不受审查的批判反应弥补政府不受欢迎的政策 — — 比如美国入侵伊拉克。
en: In addition to generating good will and promoting the country’s image abroad, non-governmental sources of soft power can sometimes compensate for the government’s unpopular policies – like the US invasion of Iraq – through their critical and uncensored reaction.

zh: 相反，中国的政府政策在破坏其软实力的成功。
en: China, by contrast, has watched its government policies undermine its soft-power successes.

zh: 事实上，在国内镇压人权活动家破坏了2008年北京奥运会带来的软实力进步。
en: Indeed, the domestic crackdown on human-rights activists undercut the soft-power gains of the 2008 Beijing Olympics.

zh: 而2009年上海世博会带来的软实力进步又因为诺贝尔和平奖得主刘小波被捕和奥斯陆颁奖现场空荡荡的座位画面而消失殆尽。
en: And the benefits of the 2009 Shanghai Expo were rapidly undermined by the jailing of Nobel Peace Prize laureate Liu Xiaobo and the television screens around the world broadcasting scenes of an empty chair at the Oslo ceremonies.

zh: 营销专家称之为“自己打自己的脸 ” 。
en: Marketing experts call this “stepping on your own message.”

zh: 中国的援助项目常常是成功且建设性的。
en: China’s aid programs are often successful and constructive.

zh: 其经济十分强劲，其传统文化广受敬仰。
en: Its economy is strong, and its traditional culture is widely admired.

zh: 但如果中国要实现其巨大的软实力潜力，就必须反思其国内外政策，克制其对邻国的主张，学会接受批评以充分释放其公民社会的才能。
en: But if the country is to realize its enormous soft-power potential, it will have to rethink its policies at home and abroad, limiting its claims upon its neighbors and learning to accept criticism in order to unleash the full talents of its civil society.

zh: 只要中国继续煽动民族主义、严格实施党控，其软实力永远会受到制约。
en: As long as China fans the flames of nationalism and holds tight the reins of party control, its soft power will always remain limited.

zh: 中国正在输掉新冷战
en: China is Losing the New Cold War

zh: 发自香港 — — 当苏联于1991年崩溃后，中国共产党就一直在尝试分析其原因。
en: HONG KONG – When the Soviet Union imploded in 1991, the Communist Party of China (CPC) became obsessed with understanding why.

zh: 负责这项任务的政府智库把大部分责任都归咎于改革派领导人米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫（Mikhail Gorbachev ） — —但他只是不够铁腕因而无法将苏联整合起来而已。
en: The government think tanks entrusted with this task heaped plenty of blame on Mikhail Gorbachev, the reformist leader who was simply not ruthless enough to hold the Soviet Union together.

zh: 当时中国领导人同时还强调了其他重要因素，而并非所有现任中国领导人都在关注这些因素。
en: But Chinese leaders also highlighted other important factors, not all of which China’s leaders seem to be heeding today.

zh: 当然，中国共产党毫不迟疑地将最重要的教训记在了心里：强有力的经济表现对于政治合法性至关重要。
en: To be sure, the CPC has undoubtedly taken to heart the first key lesson: strong economic performance is essential to political legitimacy.

zh: 过去几十年来，中国共产党一心一意专注于刺激GDP增长，实现了“经济奇迹 ” ， 名义人均收入从1991年的333美元飙升至去年的7329美元。
en: And the CPC’s single-minded focus on spurring GDP growth over the last few decades has delivered an “economic miracle,” with nominal per capita income skyrocketing from $333 in 1991 to $7,329 last year.

zh: 这是也是中共一直都掌握政权的最重要原因。
en: This is the single most important reason why the CPC has retained power.

zh: 然而坐视经济摇摇欲坠并不是苏联领导人犯下的唯一错误。
en: But overseeing a faltering economy was hardly the only mistake Soviet leaders made.

zh: 他们还卷入了耗资巨大且无力取胜的对美军备竞赛之中，最终沦为了帝国过度扩张的牺牲品，不断向那些毫无战略价值且经济管理总是一塌糊涂的政权投入资金和资源。
en: They were also drawn into a costly and unwinnable arms race with the United States, and fell victim to imperial overreach, throwing money and resources at regimes with little strategic value and long track records of chronic economic mismanagement.

zh: 随着中国与美国发生新的“冷战 ” ， 中国共产党似乎面临着重蹈覆辙的风险。
en: As China enters a new “cold war” with the US, the CPC seems to be at risk of repeating the same catastrophic blunders.

zh: 乍一看来，中国似乎并未真正与美国的爆发军备竞赛。
en: At first glance, it may not seem that China is really engaged in an arms race with the US.

zh: 毕竟中国官方今年公布的国防预算 — — 约1750亿美元 — — 仅相当于美国国会批准的7000亿美元军费的1/4。
en: After all, China’s official defense budget for this year – at roughly $175 billion – amounts to just one-quarter of the $700 billion budget approved by the US Congress.

zh: 但据估计中国的实际军费开支要远远高于官方预算：根据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所的数据，去年中国在军队上的支出约为2280亿美元，相当于官方数字（1510亿美元）的1.5倍。
en: But China’s actual military spending is estimated to be much higher than the official budget: according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute, China spent some $228 billion on its military last year, roughly 150% of the official figure of $151 billion.

zh: 不管怎样，问题不在于中国在枪支大炮上花费的具体金额，而在于军费开支的持续增长，这意味着中国准备与美国展开长期的消耗战。
en: In any case, the issue is not the amount of money China spends on guns per se, but rather the consistent rise in military expenditure, which implies that the country is prepared to engage in a long-term war of attrition with the US.

zh: 然而中国经济的架构却不足以产生足够的资源来支撑在这方面获胜所需的支出水平。
en: Yet China’s economy is not equipped to generate sufficient resources to support the level of spending that victory on this front would require.

zh: 如果中国拥有支撑高效率经济的可持续增长模式，它或许能够与美国进行适度的军备竞赛。
en: If China had a sustainable growth model underpinning a highly efficient economy, it might be able to afford a moderate arms race with the US.

zh: 但它缺乏这种模式。
en: But it has neither.

zh: 在宏观层面，由于人口迅速老龄化，高债务水平，债务到期日错配以及美国发动的贸易战升级，中国的增长可能会持续减速。
en: On the macro level, China’s growth is likely to continue to decelerate, owing to rapid population aging, high debt levels, maturity mismatches, and the escalating trade war that the US has initiated.

zh: 所有这些都将耗尽中共的有限资源。
en: All of this will drain the CPC’s limited resources.

zh: 例如，随着退休金年龄段人数占比不断上升，医疗保健和养老金成本也水涨船高。
en: For example, as the old-age dependency ratio rises, so will health-care and pension costs.

zh: 此外，虽然中国经济或许比苏联经济效率更高，但却远没有美国那么高效。
en: Moreover, while the Chinese economy may be far more efficient than the Soviet economy was, it is nowhere near as efficient as that of the US.

zh: 其主要原因是中国国有企业的持久影响力，这些企业消耗了该国银行信贷总额的一半，却只贡献了20％的增值和就业。
en: The main reason for this is the enduring clout of China’s state-owned enterprises (SOEs), which consume half of the country’s total bank credit, but contribute only 20% of value-added and employment.

zh: 中国共产党面临的问题在于国有企业在维持一党统治方面发挥着至关重要的作用，因为这些企业既用来奖励效忠者，又可以代表官方去实施宏观经济目标干预。
en: The problem for the CPC is that SOEs play a vital role in sustaining one-party rule, as they are used both to reward loyalists and to facilitate government intervention on behalf of official macroeconomic targets.

zh: 因此解散这些臃肿低效的企业形同于政治自杀。
en: Dismantling these bloated and inefficient firms would thus amount to political suicide.

zh: 但是一味袒护这些企业也只不过是让那些不可避免的事件迟一点发生而已，因为它们被允许从经济中榨取稀缺资源的时间越长，与美国的军备竞赛就越难以承受 — — 而对中国共产党权威的挑战也会越大。
en: Yet protecting them may merely delay the inevitable, because the longer they are allowed to suck scarce resources out of the economy, the more unaffordable an arms race with the US will become – and the greater the challenge to the CPC’s authority will become.

zh: 中国领导人未能充分尊崇的第二个教训是避免帝国过度延伸的必要性。
en: The second lesson that China’s leaders have failed to appreciate adequately is the need to avoid imperial overreach.

zh: 大约十年前，鉴于大额贸易顺差囤积了大量硬通货币，中国政府开始承担昂贵的海外承诺，并补贴那些烂泥扶不上墙的“盟友 ” 。
en: About a decade ago, with massive trade surpluses bringing in a surfeit of hard currency, the Chinese government began to take on costly overseas commitments and subsidize deadbeat “allies.”

zh: 在此最为突出的莫过于备受瞩目的“一带一路”倡议，这项耗资1万亿美元的计划旨在为发展中国家的基础设施建设提供债务融资。
en: Exhibit A is the much-touted Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), a $1 trillion program focused on the debt-financed construction of infrastructure in developing countries.

zh: 尽管已经出现了一些初期问题迹象 — — 再借鉴苏联的经验，中共本应赶紧收手 — — 中国似乎仍然下定决心要推进这个已被国家领导人确立为新“大战略”支柱的倡议。
en: Despite early signs of trouble – which, together with the Soviet Union’s experience, should give the CPC pause – China seems to be determined to push ahead with the BRI, which the country’s leaders have established as a pillar of their new “grand strategy.”

zh: 帝国过度扩张的一个更令人震惊的例子是中国对各国的慷慨援助 — — 从柬埔寨到委内瑞拉再到俄罗斯 — — 而且几乎没有获得任何回报。
en: An even more egregious example of imperial overreach is China’s generous aid to countries – from Cambodia to Venezuela to Russia – that offer little in return.

zh: 根据美国威廉和玛丽学院发布的援助数据（AidData ） ， 在2000~2014年间，柬埔寨、喀麦隆、科特迪瓦、古巴，埃塞俄比亚和津巴布韦合共获得了244亿美元的中国赠款或高额补贴贷款。
en: According to AidData at the College of William and Mary, from 2000 to 2014, Cambodia, Cameroon, Côte d’Ivoire, Cuba, Ethiopia, and Zimbabwe together received $24.4 billion in Chinese grants or heavily subsidized loans.

zh: 在此同期，安哥拉、老挝、巴基斯坦、俄罗斯、土库曼斯坦和委内瑞拉得到了982亿美元。
en: Over the same period, Angola, Laos, Pakistan, Russia, Turkmenistan, and Venezuela received $98.2 billion.

zh: 现在，中国承诺为“中国-巴基斯坦经济走廊”提供620亿美元的贷款。
en: Now, China has pledged to provide $62 billion in loans for the “China-Pakistan Economic Corridor.”

zh: 该计划将帮助巴基斯坦应付即将到来的国际收支危机；可一旦贸易保护主义威胁其财源的时候，这个计划也将耗尽中国政府的金库。
en: That program will help Pakistan confront its looming balance-of-payments crisis; but it will also drain the Chinese government’s coffers at a time when trade protectionism threatens their replenishment.

zh: 跟苏联一样，中国为一些盟友几乎掏空了自己的钱袋，但只能获得有限的利益，同时还在不可持续的军备竞赛中越陷越深。
en: Like the Soviet Union, China is paying through the nose for a few friends, gaining only limited benefits while becoming increasingly entrenched in an unsustainable arms race.

zh: 中美冷战几乎尚未开始，但中国却已走上了失败的轨道。
en: The Sino-American Cold War has barely started, yet China is already on track to lose.

zh: 中国的复杂性问题
en: China’s Complexity Problem

zh: 纽黑文—在中国向其领导人所谓的中等富裕社会的艰巨转型中，有许多不断活动的部分。
en: NEW HAVEN – There are many moving parts in China’s daunting transition to what its leaders call a moderately well-off society.

zh: 结构性变化在诸多前沿同时发生 — — 经济、金融市场、地缘政治战略、社会政策等。
en: Tectonic shifts are occurring simultaneously on several fronts – the economy, financial markets, geopolitical strategy, and social policy.

zh: 终极考验也许就在于管理这些发展态势之间的过于复杂的互动。
en: The ultimate test may well lie in managing the exceedingly complex interplay among these developments.

zh: 中国领导层能够胜任吗？ 还是会落入“贪心不足蛇吞象”的窠臼？
en: Is China’s leadership up to the task, or has it bitten off too much at once?

zh: 大部分西方评论家一直将这一争论过度简化，将其组织为众所周知的中国硬着陆论。 这一论调至少已经存在了20年。
en: Most Western commentators continue to over-simplify this debate, framing it in terms of the proverbial China hard-landing scenarios that have been off the mark for 20 years.

zh: 今年夏天，当中国股市暴跌、人民币意外贬值时，同样的论调再一次兴盛起来。
en: In the wake of this summer’s stock-market plunge and surprising devaluation of the renminbi, the same thing is happening again.

zh: 但是，我认为担心中国爆发全面衰退是杞人忧天。
en: I suspect, however, that fears of an outright recession in China are vastly overblown.

zh: 关于中国近期前景的争论很重要，但比这个问题大得多的问题是中国经济稳步迈向再平衡 — — 即从制造业和建筑业活动向服务业的结构转变。
en: While the debate about China’s near-term outlook should hardly be trivialized, the far bigger story is its economy’s solid progress on the road to rebalancing – namely, a structural shift away from manufacturing and construction activity toward services.

zh: 2014年，服务业占中国GDP比重达到了48.2 % ， 远超制造业和建筑业之和（42.6 % ） 。
en: In 2014, the services share of Chinese GDP hit 48.2%, well in excess of the combined 42.6% share of manufacturing and construction.

zh: 并且差距在继续扩大 — — 2015年上半年服务业活动同比增长8.4 % ， 远超制造业和建筑业的6.1 % 。
en: And the gap is continuing to widen – services activity grew 8.4% year on year in the first half of 2015, far outstripping the 6.1% growth in manufacturing and construction.

zh: 从许多角度讲，服务业是消费社会的基础设施 — — 在中国的例子中，服务业提供了中国新兴中产阶级需求日益旺盛的基本公用设施、通讯、零售、医疗和金融。
en: Services are in many respects the infrastructure of a consumer society – in China’s case, providing the basic utilities, communications, retail outlets, health care, and finance that its emerging middle class is increasingly demanding.

zh: 服务业也是劳动密集型行业：在中国，服务业单位产出岗位需求比资本密集型制造业和建筑业多30 % 。
en: They are also labor-intensive: in China, services require about 30% more jobs per unit of output than do capital-intensive manufacturing and construction.

zh: 大部分是出于这一原因，中国的就业趋势比面临经济减速的标准情形好得多。
en: Largely for that reason, China’s employment trends have held up much better than might be expected in the face of an economic slowdown.

zh: 2013—14年城镇就业增长量平均为1,300—1,400万略多 — — 远高于政府目标一千万。
en: Urban job growth averaged slightly more than 13 million in 2013-14 – well above the ten million targeted by the government.

zh: 此外，2015年初的数据显示城镇就业在近几年中形势喜人 — — 与经济硬着陆或衰退时常见的劳动力市场吃紧的情况大相径庭。
en: Moreover, the data from early 2015 suggest that urban hiring remains near the impressive pace of recent years – hardly the labor-market stress normally associated with economic hard landings or recessions.

zh: 服务业也是让中国城镇化战略如此有效的要素。
en: Services are also the ingredient that makes China’s urbanization strategy so effective.

zh: 如今，大约55%的中国人口生活在城市中，而1978年只有不到20 % 。
en: Today, approximately 55% of China’s population lives in cities, compared to less than 20% in 1978.

zh: 未来15年，这一比例应能上升至65—70 % 。
en: And the share should rise to 65-70% over the next 15 years.

zh: 新城市和旧城扩张通过基于服务业的就业维持增长，反过来又通过比农村高两倍的城市人均收入提振消费者购买力。
en: New and expanding cities sustain growth through services-based employment, which in turn boosts consumer purchasing power by trebling per capita income relative to that earned in the countryside.

zh: 因此，尽管中国崩溃论不绝于耳，但向基于服务业的经济的快速转变抵消了旧的基于制造业的经济的下行压力。
en: So, despite all the handwringing over a Chinese crash, the rapid shift toward a services-based economy is tempering downside pressures in the old manufacturing-based economy.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）在其最近与中国的第四条款磋商中也得出了这一结论，指出劳动收入占中国GDP的比重正在扩大，2014年消费对GDP增长的贡献已略高于投资。
en: The International Monetary Fund stressed the same conclusion in its recent Article IV consultation with China, noting that labor income is now expanding as a share of GDP, and that consumption contributed slightly more than investment to GDP growth in 2014.

zh: 这看上去也是只是边际进步，但实际上相对于通常十分缓慢的结构变化速度已是相当迅速 — — 中国的结构变化直到2011年才根据十二五规划开始实施。
en: That may seem like marginal progress, but it is actually quite rapid relative to the normally glacial pace of structural change – a process that began in China only in 2011 with the enactment of the 12th Five-Year Plan.

zh: 然而也有一个重要的缺陷。
en: Alas, there is an important catch.

zh: 尽管经济再平衡的进展令人振奋，但中国一下子想要的太多：同时实现金融体系现代化、货币改革和解决股票、债务和房地产市场过剩问题。
en: While progress on economic rebalancing is encouraging, China has put far more on its plate: simultaneous plans to modernize the financial system, reform the currency, and address excesses in equity, debt, and property markets.

zh: 与此同时，当局还在进行大手笔反腐运动，采取了更加强硬的外交政策，并提出了以“中国梦”为名的民族复兴口号。
en: Meanwhile, the authorities are also pursuing an aggressive anti-corruption campaign, a more muscular foreign policy, and a nationalistic revival couched in terms of the “China Dream.”

zh: 这些多重目标之间的互动也许会造成令人望而生却的结果。
en: The interplay among these multiple objectives may prove especially daunting.

zh: 比如，去杠杆化和戳破股市泡沫的组合效应可能在旧制造经济中形成自我强化的向下螺旋，动摇消费者信心，冲销新服务经济的新兴活力。
en: For example, the confluence of deleveraging and the bursting of the equity bubble could create a self-reinforcing downward spiral in the old manufacturing economy that shakes consumer confidence and offsets the emerging dynamism of the new services economy.

zh: 类似地，在南海的军事冒险可能威胁到中国与世界其他国家的关系，而眼下中国还远没有能够依靠内需实现经济增长。
en: Similarly, military adventures in the South China Sea could damage China’s links to the rest of the world long before it is able to count on domestic demand for economic growth.

zh: 讽刺的是，在一个以市场为基础、以消费为导向的体系中，中国当局可能更加难以同时推进多重目标。
en: Ironically, China’s juggling act may prove even more difficult for the authorities to pull off in a market-based, consumer-oriented system.

zh: 中国政府忙于从中国严格控制、国家主导的模式中转型，思维混乱 — — 比如，强调要决定性地向市场转变，但当股价崩盘时又大手笔干预。
en: Caught in the transition from China’s tightly controlled, state-directed model, the government seems to be waffling – for example, by stressing a decisive shift to markets, only to intervene aggressively when equity prices plummet.

zh: 类似地，中国采取更加市场化的外汇机制，但又引导人民币贬值。
en: Likewise, it is embracing more of a market-based foreign-exchange regime while guiding the renminbi lower.

zh: 此外还有一步三回头��国有企业改革承诺，这导致中国在不经意间陷入了裴敏欣提出多时的“受困转型 ” ， 即经济改革战略因为一党专政国家缺少政治意愿而陷入困境。
en: Add to that a stop-start commitment to reform of state-owned enterprises and China could inadvertently find itself mired in something comparable to what Minxin Pei has long called a “trapped transition,” in which the economic-reform strategy is stymied by the lack of political will in a one-party state.

zh: 在国家主席习近平的领导下，中国并不缺少政治意愿。
en: Under President Xi Jinping’s leadership, there is no lack of political will in today’s China.

zh: 挑战在于在改革和再平衡的过程中重点发展这一意愿。
en: The challenge is to prioritize that will in a way that keeps China on the course of reform and rebalancing.

zh: 这些前沿的任何倒退都会导致中国陷入裴敏欣长期担心中国难免会陷入的陷阱中。
en: Any backtracking on these fronts would lead China into the type of trap that Pei has long feared is inevitable.

zh: 经济发展永远是一个艰巨的挑战。
en: Economic development has always been a daunting challenge.

zh: 关于“中等收入陷阱”的警告表明，在历史上，让人均收入在中国所实现的水平上更进一步的失败例子比成功例子更多。
en: As warnings about the “middle-income trap” underscore, history is littered with more failures than successes in pushing beyond the per capita income threshold that China has attained.

zh: 中国完全不必在针尖上跳舞。
en: The last thing China needs is to try to balance too much on the head of a pin.

zh: 中国领导人应该简化和清晰化日程，不要让它变得过于复杂而难以管理。
en: Its leaders need to simplify and clarify an agenda that risks becoming too complex to manage.

zh: 中国面临的全球性危机
en: China Confronts the Global Meltdown

zh: 北京-三十年来，中国一直保持着平均每年9 .8％的增长率。
en: BEIJING – For three decades, China has been growing at an average annual rate of 9.8%.

zh: 此期间的大部分时间，世界市场是对中国是有利的，没有出现任何重大的全球性经济和金融危机或经济减速。
en: For most of this time, world markets were favorable, with no major global economic or financial crisis or slowdown.

zh: 是曾发生过地区性的危机，比如1997- 1998年间的东南亚金融风暴或日本房地产泡沫在1990年的破裂，以及美国的高科技泡沫在2000年的破裂。
en: Yes, there were regional crises such as Southeast Asia’s financial turmoil of 1997-1998 or the collapse of Japan’s housing bubble in 1990 and America’s high-tech bubble in 2000.

zh: 但这些危机没有一个最终对中国的长期繁荣造成严重障碍。
en: But none of these proved a serious obstacle to China’s long boom.

zh: 然而，过去的三个月里，中国的出口、国内投资、工业产值和税收都有相当的放缓。
en: The past three months, however, have seen a significant slowdown in China’s exports, domestic investment, industrial output, and tax revenues.

zh: 重大的经济减速似乎就要来临。
en: A major slowdown seems to be looming.

zh: 中国的快速增长还会持续吗？
en: Will China’s rapid growth persist?

zh: 我相信会。
en: I believe it will.

zh: 中国国内目前的减速主要是自己造成的。
en: Within China, the current slowdown is mostly homemade.

zh: 自2004年以来，中国政府一直试图给过热的经济降温，把增长率从12 ％降到更具持续性的8-9 ％的水平 。
en: Since 2004, China’s government has sought to cool an overheating economy by bringing the growth rate down from 12% to a more sustainable 8-9%.

zh: 国家甚至开始征收出口税，以减少贸易顺差。
en: It even began to tax exports in order to reduce the trade surplus.

zh: 当然，如果中国的决策者当时能预料到现在在世界经济中已经发生了的情况的话，他们可能就不会那么严厉地遏制增长了。
en: Of course, if Chinese policymakers could have predicted what has now happened in the world economy, they might have been less stringent in trying to rein in growth.

zh: 但是，中国在过去30年里能够一直保持增长的原因之一就是它在繁荣时代就已经开始了反周期宏观经济干预，而不是坐等崩溃的来临。
en: But one reason that China has been able to maintain growth over the past 30 years is that it started counter-cycle macroeconomic intervention during the boom times, rather than waiting for a collapse.

zh: 中国政府从未认为它应该把经济完全交给市场。
en: China’s government never believed that it should leave what happens in the economy solely to the market.

zh: 当有没有大的泡沫出现时，就没有必要为大危机而担心。
en: When there is no big bubble, there is no need to worry about a big crisis.

zh: 中国的强劲增长很可能将继续的另一个原因是，其经济基本面是好的。
en: Another reason that China’s strong growth is likely to continue is that its economic fundamentals are sound.

zh: 所有的促进高增长的因素还在：劳动力成本低、教育、高储蓄率、基础设施的改善以及快速的城市化。
en: All the factors that encourage high growth remain in place: low labor costs, education, high savings, improving infrastructure, and rapid urbanization.

zh: 此外，中国的财政状况是世界上最好的国家之一。
en: Moreover, China’s fiscal position is one of the best in the world.

zh: 在过去几十年中，政府赤字极少超过国内生产总值的3 ％ ， 最近几年还有盈余。
en: Government deficits rarely exceeded 3% of GDP in past decades, and there were surpluses in recent years.

zh: 事实上，政府债务和国内生产总值的比例约为20 ％ ， 而美国为80 ％以上， 日本为160 ％ ， 欧洲则是60-90 ％ 。
en: Indeed, the government debt-to-GDP ratio is about 20%, compared with more than 80% in the United States, 160% in Japan, and 60-90% in Europe.

zh: 中国一直实行谨慎的货币政策，而通货膨胀的威胁已随商品和石油价格的下降而减弱。
en: Monetary policy has been prudent, and the threat of inflation has now been lessened by the decline in commodity and oil prices.

zh: 国际收支保持顺差。 尽管现在全球信贷紧缩，但中国还仍然有资本净流入。
en: The international balance of payments remains in surplus, and there is still a net capital inflow despite the global credit crunch.

zh: 官方公布的外汇储备额很快将达到2万亿美元。
en: Official foreign exchange reserves will soon reach US$ 2 trillion.

zh: 因此，如果发生意外，决策者会有足够的回旋余地。
en: Thus, policymakers have ample room to maneuver if anything should go wrong.

zh: 最近五千六百八十亿美元的财政刺激方案，将用于扩建铁路、地铁建设、为穷人建造低预算的住房、灌溉系统、农村社会保障和卫生保健，这些将在未来几年中为增长添加几个百分点。
en: The recent $568 billion fiscal stimulus package, which will be spent on railway expansion, subway construction, low-budget housing programs for the poor, irrigation systems, rural social security, and health care, will add a few percentage points to growth over the next couple years.

zh: 随着货币政策和一些对投资的行政控制以及对本地开支的放宽，经济放缓应该是短暂的。
en: With monetary policy and some of the administrative controls on investment and local spending being relaxed, the slowdown should be brief.

zh: 但是，并不是关于中国经济的情况都是好消息，因为低消费仍然是一个很大的弱点。
en: But it is not all good news in China’s economy, because low consumption remains a big weakness.

zh: 2007年，家庭消费仅占国内生产总值的34 ％ ， 而总消费量不到国内生产总值的50 ％ 。 但是，这个弱点是体制上的，在短期内不会轻易改变。
en: Household consumption only accounted for 34% of GDP and total consumption is less than 50% of GDP in 2007.  That weakness, however, is institutional and cannot be easily corrected in the short run.

zh: 因此，中国国内的经济基本上是安全的，那么中国还能做些什么来帮助世界经济呢？
en: So, with its domestic economy basically secure, is there anything China can do to help the world economy?

zh: 如果中国能够做到在未来两年内每年保持8 ％的实际增长率，那么新兴市场就可增长4 ％ 。
en: If China can manage to maintain real growth at 8% per annum over the next two years, emerging markets may be able to grow at 4%.

zh: 这可以防止世界经济陷入衰退。
en: That may prevent the world economy from falling into recession.

zh: 事实上，中国现在看起来可以发挥 “增长的靠山 ” 的作用。
en: Indeed, China now looks like it can play the role of “growth anchor.”

zh: 但是，不应期望中国能做得太多。
en: But China should not be expected to do too much more.

zh: 例如，世界金融的稳定不是中国可以直接帮忙的。
en: World financial stabilization, for example, is not something China can do much to help directly.

zh: 中国在全球衍生产品市场中几乎没有起什么作用，也没有太多的垃圾证券需要清理或银行需要挽救以解冻信贷流动。
en: China played little part in the global derivatives markets, and does not have much toxic securities to clean up or banks to save in order to unfreeze credit flows.

zh: 也许中国应该利用其1.9万亿美元的官方储备来购买更多的外债，但这一巨额资产的很大一部分已经买了外国主权债券，因此任何的增加只能是渐进式的。
en: Perhaps China should use its $1.9 trillion official reserves to buy more foreign debt, but this huge asset pool is already heavily loaded with foreign sovereign bonds, so any increase can only be incremental.

zh: 要中国在2009年的全球金融和货币体系改革中发挥核��作用，目前也可能是不适合的，因为它尚未完全放开其资本账户和金融体系。
en: China is also probably unsuited at the moment to play a central role in reforming the global financial and monetary system in 2009 because it has not yet fully liberalized its capital accounts and financial system.

zh: 因此，中国的谈判官员们宁愿发挥辅助的作用，让他国，包括发达国家和发展中国家，在大多数风险控制和监控的问题上起主导作用。
en: So Chinese negotiators would rather play a supporting role and let others, both developed and developing countries, take the lead in most issues concerning risk control and regulations.

zh: 但是，中国很可能在一个问题上会加强它的声音，即作为全球储备货币的美元的地位。
en: But China is likely to increase its voice on one issue – the US dollar’s status as global reserve currency.

zh: 中国过去一直因涉嫌操纵汇率而遭到批评，因为它没有按美国的要求让人民币升值。
en: China has been criticized in the past for allegedly manipulating its exchange rate, because it did not revalue its currency as much as the US demanded.

zh: 因此，中国可能会希望看到，例如，修改国际货币基金组织的工作或在国际货币基金组织的工作议程中增设一“章程 ” ， 以制约美国的货币供应量和债务积累。
en: So China might like to see, for example, amendments to the IMF mandate or the addition of a “chapter” to the IMF’s working agenda that discipline America’s money supply and debt accumulation.

zh: 在中国看来，只要求别人来适应美元的贬值是不够的。
en: In China’s view, it is not enough merely to require others to accommodate themselves to dollar devaluation.

zh: 作为一个人均收入2500美元和35 ％的劳动力仍从事农业的发展中国家，其工人每年收入只有约600美元，中国国内的问题仍然是巨大的。
en: As a developing country with US$ 2,500 per capita income and 35% of its labor force still in agriculture, where workers earn only about $600 per year, China’s domestic problems remain enormous.

zh: 因此，发展将继续是最重要的，包括发展中国自己的金融市场。
en: Thus, development will continue to be the top priority, including the development of China’s own financial market.

zh: 好消息是，中国认识到在过去30年里，它从市场化和开放中所获得的益处是多么地巨大。
en: The good news is that China recognizes how much it has benefited from the marketization and openness of the past 30 years.

zh: 尽管存在当前的危机，但中国在全面参与全球市场的道路上已没有回头路可走。
en: There is no turning back on its path toward full involvement in the global market, despite the current crisis.

zh: 实际上，中国真正的挑战在于，当金融危机和经济衰退在其主要的海外市场不断加深时，明年将找到怎样的方法处理日益严重的全球贸易保护主义的问题。
en: Indeed, the real challenge for China in the year ahead will be to find ways to deal with growing global protectionism as the financial crisis and economic recession bite ever deeper in its main foreign markets.

zh: 打造中国的消费者社会
en: The Making of China’s Consumer Society

zh: 香港—中国从制造业驱动和出口拉动型经济向以服务和国内消费为基础之经济的转型正在稳步推进。
en: HONG KONG – China’s transformation from a manufacturing-driven and export-led economy to one underpinned by services and domestic consumption is firmly underway.

zh: 这不仅对于中国是好消息，对全球经济的未来亦然。
en: And that’s good news not just for China, but also for the future of the global economy.

zh: 冯氏集团利丰研究中心和中国社会科学院策划的《中国商业发展报告（2016~2017 ） 》 描述了这一变化。
en: The 2016-17 edition of the Blue Book of China’s Commercial Sector by Fung Business Intelligence and the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences maps the change.

zh: 在经历了十多年的两位数增长后，中国零售市场规模在2015年达到了30万亿元。
en: China’s retail markets reached CN¥30 trillion ($4.6 trillion) in 2015, after more than a decade of double-digit growth.

zh: 在投资速度有所下滑的形势下，家庭消费仍然开始攀升，现已突破GDP的60 % 。
en: Household consumption has begun to climb, even as the pace of investment has fallen, and now exceeds 60% of GDP.

zh: 尽管零售消费增长率放缓至10.7 % ， 但《中国商业发展报告》仍然预测中国国内零售市场将在2020年达到50万亿元规模。
en: Though the consumption growth rate has slowed to 10.7%, the Blue Book projects that China’s domestic market may reach CN¥50 trillion by 2020.

zh: 这一转型的一个主要推动力是互联网技术。
en: A key driver of this transformation has been Internet technology.

zh: 得益于巨大的公共基础设施投资，如港口、机场、公路、铁路和通讯，互联网正在迅速扩大中国消费者的选择范围，同时也降低了物流及递送的成本并提高了速度。
en: Building on heavy investments in public infrastructure, such as ports, airports, roads, rail, and telecommunications, the Internet is now expanding rapidly the range of choices available to Chinese consumers, while lowering costs and accelerating delivery.

zh: 结果，中国在线零售销售额近几年来大幅增长，从2012年占总零售额的 6.3% 增长到2015年的12.9 % 。
en: As a result, China’s online retail sales have surged in recent years, from 6.3% of total retail sales in 2012 to 12.9% by 2015.

zh: 到2020年，中国零售交易中有40%将可能在线上进行。
en: By 2020, 40% of all retail transactions in China may be conducted online.

zh: 移动电话端的在线销售比例从2011的1.5%增加到2015年的55.5 % ， 到2018年有望达到73.8 % 。
en: Online sales via mobile phones have jumped from only 1.5% in 2011 to 55.5% in 2015, and may reach 73.8% by 2018.

zh: 如今，中国已经超过美国，建成了全世界最大的在线零售市场。
en: China has now overtaken the United States to build the world’s largest online retail market.

zh: 其33%左右的增长率也是在线零售市场中最快的。
en: With a growth rate of some 33%, it is also the fastest-growing such market.

zh: 尽管互联网使用大幅增长 — — 上网人数从2008年的2.53亿增加到去年的6.88亿 — — 中国上网人数仍有充足空间继续扩张。
en: And despite growth in Internet use – the number of connected Chinese has risen from 253 million in 2008 to 688 million last year – there is plenty of room for further expansion.

zh: 这一进步体现了中国在互联网商业方面的创新，使得中国能够不必建设和维护昂贵的砖块水泥实体店面而实现广泛的消费扩张。
en: This progress reflects innovations that enable broad-based consumption without the construction and maintenance of expensive brick-and-mortar outlets.

zh: 事实上，移动销售额的增长由低收入消费者驱动，特别是在农村地区，那里81%的互联网使用量通过移动设备来实现。
en: In fact, growth in mobile sales has been driven by lower-income consumers, particularly in rural areas, where more than 81% of Internet use occurs via mobile devices.

zh: 一项关键的创新是阿里巴巴等多方平台公司的创立，这些平台公司提供产品、物流、分销和支付接口，对传统商业模式构成了挑战，并取得了巨大的成功。
en: One key innovation has been multi-sided platforms like Alibaba, which, by providing access to production, logistics, distribution, and payments, challenge traditional business models – and with considerable success.

zh: 2016年二季度，阿里巴巴公告其中国零售市场收入同比增加49 % ， 而另一家在线平台公司腾讯公告收入增加52 % 。
en: In the second quarter of 2016, Alibaba announced that its revenue from China’s retail market had increased by 49% year on year; another online platform, Tencent, reported a 52% increase.

zh: 这些平台公司将贡献了中国80%就业的中小企业与消费者群体联系在一起，侵蚀了一些大型国有企业的竞争优势。
en: By connecting small and medium-size enterprises (which account for 80% of employment in China) with the consumer base, such platforms erode some of the competitive advantage of large state-owned enterprises (SOEs).

zh: 事实上，中国互联网零售革命的回报呈现出高度集中的趋势，但这一次集中的方向不再是国有部门。
en: Indeed, while the returns from China’s Internet retailing revolution have been highly concentrated, for once this concentration has not been in the state sector.

zh: 在移动设备在线零售领域，去年阿里巴巴占据了84.2%的市场份额，第二大在线零售商京东只获得了5.7%的市场。
en: In online retailing via mobile devices, Alibaba held an 84.2% share of the market last year, with the next largest online retailer, JD.com, capturing just 5.7%.

zh: 在企业对消费者（B2C）市场，2015年三季度阿里巴巴天猫市场份额为58 % ， 京东仅占22.9 % 。
en: In the business-to-consumer market, Alibaba’s Tmall claimed a 58% market share in the third quarter of 2015, with JD.com taking just 22.9%.

zh: 在第三方在线支付服务方面，支付宝占领了47.5%的市场，财付通占领了20 % ， 而银行业开发的唯一在线服务系统银联支付只占10.9 % 。
en: In third-party online payment services, Alipay held 47.5% of the market, while Tenpay captured 20%, and UnionPay, the only service developed by the banking community, had 10.9%.

zh: 结果，长期以来专精于单一市场和商品的国有企业现在开始认识到它们需要重整旗鼓参与中国和全球市场竞争。
en: As a result, SOEs, which have long specialized in single markets or products, have now begun to recognize that they need to re-tool to compete both in China and in global markets.

zh: 国企改革进入了中国的日程，这一额外的刺激是很有裨益的。
en: Given that SOE reform has long been on China’s agenda, this extra impetus may prove beneficial.

zh: 但如何构建公平竞技场以实现互联网时代的健康竞争和改善资本配置仍然是一个挑战。
en: But the challenge of determining how to create a level playing field for healthy competition and improve capital allocation in the Internet age remains.

zh: 不仅中国大公司需要反思商业模式，随着中国电子商务平台的日益全球化，它们也可能挑战跨国巨头在国际贸易的主导地位。
en: It is not just China’s large companies that need to rethink their business models. As China’s e-commerce platforms become increasingly global, they may erode the dominance of giant multinationals in international trade.

zh: 2015年，中国跨境电商总规模估计在5.2万亿元，或相当于贸易总量的17.6 % ； 明年可能达到8万亿元，或贸易总量的23 % 。
en: Already in 2015, China’s cross-border e-commerce amounted to an estimated ¥5.2 trillion, or 17.6% of the country’s total trade; it may reach ¥8 trillion, or 23% of total trade, by next year.

zh: 这一增长对中国来说是天大的好消息；事实上，在许多传统行业表现放缓的情况下，在线零售也许是经济的救命稻草。
en: All of this growth is great news for China; indeed, at a time of slowing performance in many traditional sectors, online retailing could be an economic lifesaver.

zh: 但这对长期依靠自上而下决策的政府来说也构成了一种挑战。
en: But it also represents a major challenge for a government that has long relied on top-down decision-making.

zh: 中国电商革命让中国消费者能够决定怎么花钱。
en: China’s e-commerce revolution enables the country’s consumers to decide where to put their money.

zh: 他们不但可以决定哪些商品和服务值得花钱，还可以决定在哪里生活和享受服务。
en: They can choose not only what kinds of goods and services they deem worthwhile, but also where to live and receive an education.

zh: 结果，他们成为住房市场、供应链、金融甚至货币政策转型背后的关键驱动力。
en: As a result, they have become a key driver behind the transformation of the housing market, supply chains, finance, and even monetary policy.

zh: 中国领导人的任务是有效地响应中国公民的需要和渴望，包括通过加快经济改革进程来降低交易成本。
en: The task for China’s leaders is to respond more effectively to their citizens’ needs and desires, including by accelerating progress on economic reform.

zh: 具体而言，他们必须逐步淘汰受制于产能过剩、坏账和日益下降的就业的陈旧供应链，同时对电商革命的赢家合理课税。
en: Specifically, they must phase out obsolete supply chains saddled with overcapacity, bad debts, and falling employment, while taxing the winners in the e-commerce game.

zh: 这些当务之急对传统货币、财政、产业、环境和社会政策的方针构成了挑战，同时也在考验官僚系统和政治制度的治理能力。
en: These imperatives are challenging traditional approaches to monetary, fiscal, industrial, environmental, and social policy, while testing the capacity of the bureaucracy and political system.

zh: 中国向消费者社会的转型将给国内和全球商品和服务供应及分销商带来深远的影响。
en: China’s transformation into a consumer society will have profound implications for domestic and global suppliers and distributors of goods and services.

zh: 首先，它可能影响到中国的一些贸易伙伴，特别是长期依赖中国大宗商品需求的新兴经济体。
en: At first, it might hurt some of China’s trading partners, particularly the emerging economies that have long depended on Chinese demand for their commodity exports.

zh: 中国进口贸易的下跌已经造成大宗商品价格下跌。
en: The decline in Chinese imports has already contributed to a decline in commodity prices.

zh: 此外，外国进口商也许会发现中国制造业的消费品现在更多地关注迎合本地消费者的品味和偏好。
en: Moreover, foreign importers may find that Chinese-manufactured consumer goods now cater more to local tastes and preferences.

zh: 不管出现什么挑战，一个以本地消费者为基础的繁荣的中国将影响及塑造一个繁荣的全球经济。
en: Whatever challenges emerge, the fact is that a prosperous China, underpinned by local consumers, will contribute to – and shape – a prosperous global economy.

zh: 对此，我们要感谢电子商务。
en: We can thank e-commerce for that.

zh: 中国的企业债挑战
en: China’s Corporate-Debt Challenge

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 虽然中国经济在最近几年有所放缓，但相对其他经济体来说仍属强劲，贡献了约1/3的全球经济增长。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The Chinese economy has slowed in recent years, but it is still a strong performer, contributing about one-third of total economic growth worldwide.

zh: 在其经济增长模式由投资出口向国内需求和服务转移后，其经济模式也变得更具可持续性。
en: It is also becoming more sustainable, in line with the shift in its growth model away from investment and exports and toward domestic demand and services.

zh: 在杭州 G20 峰会即将于下月召开之际，中国一直大声呼吁发达和新兴市场经济体应当做出新的结构性改革承诺以刺激增长。
en: In the run-up to next month’s G20 summit in Hangzhou, China has been calling loudly for new commitments to structural reforms to stimulate growth in advanced and emerging-market economies.

zh: 但中国也面临着严峻的国内风险：尤为显著的是国内信贷继续以不可持续的速度扩张，企业债务额也积累到了相当危险的程度。
en: But China faces serious risks at home. Above all, domestic credit continues to expand at an unsustainable pace, with corporate debt accumulating to dangerous levels.

zh: 根据国际货币基金组织最近发表的中国经济年度经济报告，信贷的增长几乎相当于产出量的两倍，并同时在非金融私营部门以及不断延伸且相互连接的不透明金融部门中迅速扩张。
en: According to the International Monetary Fund’s recently published annual report on the Chinese economy, credit is growing about twice as fast as output. It is rising rapidly in both the non-financial private sector and in an expanding, interconnected financial sector that remains opaque.

zh: 此外，虽然信贷增长按照国际标准来说极高 — — 而这一关键指标暗示着潜在的危机 — — 其进一步刺激经济增长的效果却不断减弱。
en: Moreover, while credit growth is high by international standards – a key indicator of a potential crisis – its ability to spur further growth is diminishing.

zh: 警灯长鸣之下，中国政府也已意识到了这个整体性问题。
en: Warning signs are flashing, and the Chinese government has acknowledged the overall problem.

zh: 但为了避免危机爆发，它应立即实施全面改革以铲除企业债务问题的根源。
en: But, to avoid a crisis, it should immediately implement comprehensive reforms to address the root causes of the corporate debt problem.

zh: 这些包括对国有企业和地方政府的松散预算约束、 政府对债务的隐性/公开担保以及金融领域的过度冒险行为 — — 所有这些行为都是不可持续的官方增长目标下长期存在。
en: These include soft budget constraints for state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and local governments, implicit and explicit government guarantees of debt, and excessive risk taking in the financial sector – all of which have been perpetuated by unsustainable official growth targets.

zh: 为解决这一问题，中国政府得像中国国家总理李克强所说的那样“对僵尸企业狠下刀子 ” ， 而此举应同时结合切实的策略来对那些有挽救价值的公司进行重组；识别和分配债权人的损失；承担工人失业和其他社会成本；并进一步开放私营部门市场。
en: To tackle the problem, the Chinese government must, in the words of Premier Li Keqiang, “ruthlessly bring down the knife [on] zombie enterprises.” This culling should be combined with a concrete strategy to restructure salvageable firms; recognize and allocate creditor losses; account for displaced workers and other social costs; and further open private-sector markets.

zh: 更重要的是，政府必须接受短期增长率较低的必然性。
en: More fundamentally, the government must accept the inevitability of lower near-term growth.

zh: 对国有企业的重组尤其重要。
en: It is especially important to restructure SOEs.

zh: 许多国企基本上都是靠财政输血维持，对国家工业总产值的贡献只有1/5，却占据了1/2的企业总负债。
en: Many are essentially on life support, contributing only one-fifth of total industrial output but accounting for about half of all corporate debt.

zh: 认真的重组 — — 包括更严格的预算限制，停止向无挽救希望的企业贷款以及政府债务担保，再加上其他正在进行的供给侧改革 — — 这将为那些更具活力的公司腾出成长空间并促进发展。
en: A serious restructuring effort – including stricter budget constraints and an end to lending to non-viable firms and government guarantees on debt, along with other supply-side reforms already underway – will create space for more dynamic companies to emerge and contribute to growth.

zh: 虽然中国在许多方面都具有自身特色，但它不是第一个遭遇企业债务难题的国家。
en: China is unique in many respects, but it is not the first country to experience corporate-debt difficulties.

zh: 该国领导人也应该从其他国家的经验中吸取以下三大经验教训：
en: Its leaders should heed three broad lessons from other countries’ experience.

zh: 首先，当局应迅速有效地行动起来，以免当前的企业债务问题升级为将来的系统性债务问题。
en: First, the authorities should act quickly and effectively, lest today’s corporate-debt problem become tomorrow’s systemic debt problem.

zh: 其次，应同时处理好债权人和债务人的问题 — — 有些国家只解决了其中一方的问题，为日后其他问题播下种子。
en: Second, they should deal with both creditors and debtors – some countries’ solutions address only one or the other, sowing the seeds for future problems.

zh: 最后，必须对导致问题出现的治理结构进行识别和改革。
en: Finally, the governance structures that permitted the problem to arise must be identified and reformed.

zh: 中国至少需要一个有效的制度来处理破产问题；对风险定价和评估进行严格监管；以及健全的会计， 贷款风险准备金以及财务披露规则。
en: At a minimum, China needs an effective system to deal with insolvency; strict regulation of risk pricing and assessment; and robust accounting, loan-loss provisioning, and financial disclosure rules.

zh: 中国的高层人士很快从国际经验中认识到应对企业债务问题将会限制短期经济增长和增加社会成本 — — 例如失业。
en: Influential voices in China are quick to draw the lesson from international experience that tackling corporate debt can limit short-term growth and impose social costs, such as unemployment.

zh: 也应该对这些问题给予关注，但这样的选择 — — 半吊子改革或根本没有改革 — — 只会导致情况进一步恶化。
en: These are valid concerns, but the alternatives – half measures or no reform at all – would only make a bad situation worse.

zh: 中国应该首先在其增长最快的地区开始进行破产企业重组，因为那里工人能更快找到新的就业机会，改革也不至于损害经济增长。
en: China should begin by restructuring unviable companies in its fastest-growing regions, where workers will find new jobs more quickly and reforms are not likely to hurt growth.

zh: 随后在那些单一企业主导当地经济的增长较慢地区和城市，政策制定者就会在推进转型时拥有更多选择余地。
en: Policymakers can then be more selective when it comes to restructuring in slower-growing regions and cities where a single company dominates the local economy.

zh: 此外，结构性失业及工人重新安置费用可���通过强大的社会安全网来缓解，其中包括有针对性的劳动者重新安置资金，让劳动者们可以重新站稳脚跟自食其力。
en: Moreover, structural unemployment and worker resettlement costs can be mitigated with a strong social safety net that includes funds for targeted labor redeployment so that workers can get back on their feet.

zh: 这种手段将体现政府对那些改革受影响者的承诺。
en: This approach would show the government’s commitment to those at risk of displacement.

zh: 值得赞扬的是，中国在解决债务问题方面已经取得一些成果，并开始去杠杆化。
en: To its credit, China has already made some efforts to solve its debt problem and begin deleveraging.

zh: 当前五年计划的目标是减少煤炭和钢铁行业产能过剩、 划定和重组走没有挽救价值的僵尸国有企业，并投入资金帮助受影响工人。
en: The current Five-Year Plan aims to reduce excess capacity in the coal and steel sectors, identify and restructure nonviable “zombie” SOEs, and fund programs to support affected workers.

zh: 中国是时候推动意义深远的改革。
en: Now is the time for China to push for far-reaching reforms.

zh: 银行的资产负债表中仍有总额相对较低的不良贷款（以及大量风险准备金 ） 。
en: Banks’ balance sheets still have a relatively low volume of non-performing loans (and high provisioning).

zh: 潜在的企业贷款损失成本 — — 国际货币基金组织的最新《全球金融稳定报告》估算约相当于GDP的 7 % — —是可控的。
en: The costs of potential losses on corporate loans – estimated at 7% of GDP in the IMF’s latest Global Financial Stability Report – are manageable.

zh: 此外政府依然拥有较大的缓冲空间︰ 债务相对较低，外汇储备相对较高。
en: Furthermore, the government maintains high buffers: debt is relatively low, and foreign-exchange reserves are relatively high.

zh: 问题在于中国能否在缓冲消耗殆尽之前实现充分的去杠杆化。
en: The question is whether China will manage to deleverage enough before these buffers are exhausted.

zh: 鉴于它过去的经济成就和政府对大手笔改革议程的坚定承诺，中国可以应对这一企业债务挑战，但如果不立刻动手，就来不及了。
en: Given its record of economic success and the government’s strong commitment to an ambitious reform agenda, China can rise to the challenge. But it must start now.

zh: 反腐下一程
en: The Next Battle in China’s War on Corruption

zh: 香港—腐败是一种癌症，没有哪个社会能够免疫。
en: HONG KONG – Corruption is a cancer to which no society is immune.

zh: 它让伊朗因为十年前建造的劣质住房而导致更多的百姓在最近的地震中死亡。
en: It raised the death toll of Iran’s recent earthquake, owing to substandard housing construction ten years ago.

zh: 它冲击到美国海军，有超过60名将领和数百名官兵正在接受有关欺诈和贿赂的调查。
en: It has afflicted the United States Navy, which is now investigating more than 60 admirals and hundreds more officers for fraud and bribery.

zh: 它让许多政府失去了政权，包括去年的巴西总统罗塞夫的政府和蒋介石的国民党政府。
en: It has brought down countless governments, from Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff’s administration last year to Chiang Kai-shek’s Nationalist government of the Republic of China.

zh: 作为历史的好学生，习近平主席深知腐败的破坏力，并能直面这一弊端。
en: Chinese President Xi Jinping, a keen student of history, is well aware of corruption’s destructive potential – and has confronted the phenomenon head-on.

zh: 但是，随着中国经济的不断现代化，还有很多工作要做。
en: But, as China’s economy continues to modernize, much work remains to be done.

zh: 在20世纪80年代的经济改革之前，腐败在中国规模相对较小，因为有限的市场规模及相对强势的道德规范限制了滥用行政权力的机会。
en: Prior to the economic reforms of the 1980s, corruption in China was relatively petty, as the market’s limited size constrained opportunities for administrative abuse.

zh: 但是，随着市场化的深入，相应的监管公权力也不断扩大，加上立法不完善及制度保障不健全，腐败和行政权力滥用越来越肆无忌惮。
en: But, as the market deepened, inadequate legislation and weak institutional safeguards facilitated increasingly brazen corruption and administrative abuses.

zh: 与此同时，随着收入和教育水平的提高和公众道德意识的回升，公民不再轻易地容忍权力滥用，越来越要求政府透明、依法地行使公权与提供基本公共品，包括基础设施、环境保护以及收入和机会的公平分配。
en: Meanwhile, as income and education levels rose, citizens became less tolerant of such abuses, increasingly demanding transparent and lawful delivery of basic public goods, from infrastructure to environmental protection, as well as a fair distribution of income and opportunities.

zh: 认识到腐败对党和国家合法性和权威的破坏力，习近平展开了规模、范围和深度前所未见的反腐运动。
en: Recognizing the potential of corruption to undermine the legitimacy of the Communist Party of China and the authority of the Chinese state, Xi has embarked on an anti-graft campaign that is unprecedented in scale, scope, and depth.

zh: 在过去五年中，这场反腐运动令不下440名省级官员、8,900名市级官员、63,000名县级官员和278,000名村级官员遭到停职、处分和其他惩罚。
en: Over the last five years, that campaign has resulted in the dismissal, sanction, or other punishment of no less than 440 provincial officials, 8,900 at the municipal level, 63,000 at the county level, and 278,000 at the village level.

zh: 大约58,000名个人被刑事调查。
en: Some 58,000 individuals have been referred for further criminal investigation.

zh: 在中共8,900万党员中，1.7%受到了影响，其中既包括“老虎 ” （ 党的高级领导人 ） ， 也包括“苍蝇 ” （ 一般官员 ） 。
en: All in all, 1.7% of the CPC’s 89 million members – including both “tigers” (Party leaders) and “flies” (petty officials) – have been affected.

zh: 反腐行动还远未结束。
en: But the initiative is far from over.

zh: 上个月的中共十九大提出要成立国家监察委员会来巩固反腐成果，及建立现代化反腐机构，其反腐范围将超越党员，覆盖各级别行使公权力的所有官员。
en: At the CPC’s 19th National Congress last month, the Party endorsed the creation of a National Supervision Commission to consolidate and modernize the anti-graft agency, so that it will expand beyond Party members to cover all officials exercising public power at all levels.

zh: 但从历史及国际经验来看，构建强健而持续的反腐机制绝非易事，因为腐败官员往往会竭尽全力去影响、甚至操纵这些机构。
en: But building robust and lasting anti-graft institutions will not be easy, owing to the enduring ability of corrupt officials to capture such institutions.

zh: 例如，2007—2008年全球金融危机就暴露了发达经济体中的腐败，既得利益集团为了确保他们的利益，乘机巩固了他们在立法和监管方面的影响力。
en: Consider the kind of corruption in advanced economies exposed by the 2007-2008 global financial crisis, in which vested interests secure the enactment of laws and regulations that entrench their own advantages.

zh: 美国最高法院在2010年颁布的臭名昭著的联合公民裁决（Citizens United）就积极地鼓励了这样的结果，允许公司和工会可匿名动用无限量的资金用于竞选，来确保候选人当选或败选。
