en: In the US, the Supreme Court’s infamous Citizens United decision of 2010 actively encourages such outcomes, by allowing corporations and unions to spend unlimited sums anonymously to help secure the election or defeat of individual candidates.

zh: 这项裁决导致2016年选举周期的预算外支出达到了近14亿美元，而2006年的选举周期的预算外支出只有不到1亿美元，使得美国的民主制度在公平、道德、及合法性方面出现倒退。
en: As a result of the decision, outside spending in the 2016 election cycle reached nearly $1.4 billion in 2016, compared less than $100 million in the 2006 cycle.

zh: 因此，腐败不只是政府失灵；它和市场、法律、道德和意识形态体系的失灵也息息相关。
en: So corruption is not just a failure of the state; it is also closely linked to the failure of market, legal, and ideological systems.

zh: 金融市场和网络经济往往会造成经济和社会权力的集中，如果这些集中的权力被用于俘虏和控制政治权力，那么在正常情况下有效的制衡系统也会失灵。
en: If the concentrated economic and social power that financial markets and network economies tend to create can be used to capture and control political power, an effective system of checks and balances becomes virtually impossible.

zh: 伦敦经济学院人类学家大卫·格雷伯尔（David Graeber）从政治活动参与者如何与官僚体系互动的角度来分析这个问题。
en: The London School of Economics anthropologist David Graeber frames the problem in terms of how political actors approach bureaucracy.

zh: 格雷伯尔指出，右翼政治集团往往喜欢谴责过度的官僚制度和行为。
en: As Graeber points out, those on the political right condemn excessive bureaucracy.

zh: 但他们的解决方案 — — 减少政府角色，让市场力量来接管官僚 — — 实际上却有可能加剧积重难返的官僚主义扩张。
en: Yet their solution – to reduce the role of the state and allow market forces to take over – is actually what fuels cumbersome bureaucratic expansion.

zh: 格雷伯尔用他所谓的“自由主义的铁律”总结了这一观点 ： “ 任何市场化改革，任何旨在减少红头文件、促进市场力量的政府计划，都会导致监管规则总量、红头文件总量和政府雇用的官僚总人数增加的最终效应。
en: Graeber sums up this argument in what he calls an “iron law of liberalism”: “any market reform, any government initiative intended to reduce red tape and promote market forces, will have the ultimate effect of increasing the total number of regulations, the total amount of paperwork, and the total number of bureaucrats the government employs.”

zh: ” 换句话说，市场能够有效运转的前提是有一个能干、诚实、公平的政府为市场公平运作提出合适的指引，并有效地防止滥用权力及腐败，包括阻止市场人士行贿及官僚受贿。
en: In other words, markets can work efficiently only with the guidance of a competent, honest, and fair state, with effective protections against abuses and graft from both the market actors who offer bribes and the officials who accept them.

zh: 这对中国有什么启发？
en: What does this mean for China?

zh: 首先，政府需要制定现代机制来解决因产权或市场交易规则不明晰而产生的民事纠纷。
en: For starters, the country needs to develop modern mechanisms for resolving civil disputes arising from unclear property rights or rules for market transactions.

zh: 在这方面，中国可以从西方普通法体系（循例断案）中汲取有益经验，也可以从行政诉讼法庭解决官民纠纷的做法汲取有益经验。
en: Here, China can take inspiration from the Western common law system, in which cases are decided on the basis of existing precedents, or from the use of administrative courts to resolve disputes between individuals and the bureaucracy.

zh: 香港廉政公署也提供了有益的榜样。
en: Hong Kong’ Independent Commission Against Corruption also provides a useful model.

zh: 与此同时，中国需要减少官员从事腐败活动的吸引力，包括提高各级别公务员的薪酬。
en: At the same time, China must reduce the incentive for graft, by raising the pay of public servants at all levels.

zh: 目前，官员的薪酬常常参考国民收入总水平制定，但这导致有些行业与地区官员的薪酬过低，难以产生抵抗力来拒绝在一些重要的高利润部门（如能源、金融和房地产）以权谋私的诱惑。
en: As it stands, officials’ salaries are usually set with reference to the overall level of national income. But the resulting pay is not high enough to mitigate the temptation officials face to use their enormous power to profit in key sectors, such as energy, finance, and real estate.

zh: 在发达经济体，官员薪酬要高得多，他们也面临离职后在其监管行业内就业的各种限制。
en: Similarly, in advanced economies, officials not only receive much higher pay; they are also often subject to limitations on what they can do, and when, after they leave office.

zh: 而在中国，一些官员往往为了离职后得到回馈来帮助利益集团获利。
en: In China, by contrast, officials can exchange favors while in office for higher-paying jobs or benefits after retirement.

zh: 确保政府问责并同时防止既得利益俘虏权力机构并不容易，因为在这个过程中，不仅需要对公权力的制衡及相应的公务员激励机制，还需要建立恰当的道德观来抵消易受诱惑的官僚体系内的负能量，从而培育对腐败的持久抵抗力。
en: Maintaining accountability and preventing vested interests from capturing institutions – a process that involves entrenching morality within vulnerable bureaucracies – will be no easy feat.

zh: 这也许是中国在实现习近平提出的“中国梦”过程中最为艰巨的挑战。
en: It may well be the toughest challenge Xi faces in realizing what he calls the “China Dream.”

zh: 但就目前而言，中国的反腐大致已经进入正确的轨道。
en: But, for now, China’s anti-corruption agenda seems to be on the right track.

zh: 中国的信用过量
en: China’s Credit Overdose

zh: 上海—两位数的经济增长已经一去不返了。
en: SHANGHAI – The days of double-digit economic growth in China are over.

zh: 事实上，中国年经济增长率自2012年以来一直徘徊在7.5%左右，今年预计将下降到7 % ， 并且有可能继续降低。
en: Indeed, the annual growth rate, which has been lingering at about 7.5% since 2012, is predicted to fall to 7% this year – and is likely to go lower.

zh: 这是中国的“新常态 ” ， 用中国领导人的话说，其特征是“中高速 ” （ 而不是高速）增长。
en: This is China’s “new normal,” characterized, according to China’s leaders, by “medium-to-high-speed” (instead of high-speed) growth.

zh: 但也许“中高速”也有些乐观了。
en: But perhaps even this is optimistic.

zh: 在过去两年中，信用增长几乎是GDP的两倍，社会融资总额增长得还要快。
en: In the last two years, credit grew almost twice as fast as GDP, and total social financing grew even faster.

zh: 但GDP增长较2002—2011年间的年平均水平10.2%大幅放缓，表明中国也许更接近于中低速增长路径。
en: Yet GDP growth slowed considerably – from an annual average of 10.2% in 2002-2011 – suggesting that China may be moving closer to a medium-to-low-speed growth path.

zh: 信用和GDP增长分化的一个可能解释是潜在增长已经下降到7 % 。
en: One possible explanation for the divergence between credit and GDP growth is that potential growth has already dropped to 7%.

zh: 但潜在增长如此剧烈的降幅通常意味着猛烈的“刹车 ” ， 以外部冲击或重大内部调整的形式发生。
en: But such a sharp decline in potential growth typically implies a powerful brake, in the form of an external shock or major internal adjustments.

zh: 在正常情况下，经济的潜在增长率会随着结构变化进展而自然缓慢地调整。
en: Under normal circumstances, an economy’s potential growth rate adjusts naturally and gradually, as structural change progresses.

zh: 事实上，没有确切证据表明中国潜在增长率下降。
en: In fact, there is no definitive evidence that China’s potential growth rate has plunged.

zh: 中国比其他新兴经济体更好地抵御了2008年全球经济危机。
en: China weathered the 2008 global economic crisis better than other emerging economies.

zh: 此外，固然老龄化和劳动力减少等结构性因素可能破坏潜在增长，但它们不会突然爆发。
en: And, though structural factors, including an aging population and shrinking labor force, can certainly undermine potential growth, their effects are not sudden.

zh: 那么，怎样解释中国经济产出在信用高速扩张背景下的剧降？
en: So what explains the sharp decline in China’s economic output, in an environment of rapid credit expansion?

zh: 答案很简单：信用是如何使用的。
en: The answer is simple: the way the credit is being used.

zh: 危机前，中国信用扩张与GDP增长是匹配的。
en: Before the crisis, credit expansion in China kept pace with GDP growth.

zh: 但是，自2008年底以来，每年发行的信用量相当于GDP的35 % ， 导致信用-GDP之比从危机前的150%飙升到现在的250 % 。
en: Since the end of 2008, however, credit amounting to 35% of GDP has been issued annually, causing the credit-to-GDP ratio to soar from less than 150% before the crisis to 250% today.

zh: 这意味着信用的效率大幅下降。
en: That means that credit has become much less efficient.

zh: 问题源自中国政府2008年所实施的四万亿人民币刺激计划，这助长了大约14万亿人民币的信用创造 — — 也支撑了固定资产投资特别是基础设施和房地产开发的快速增长。
en: The problem stems from the CN¥4 trillion ($660 billion) stimulus plan that the government launched in 2008, which fueled the creation of about CN¥14 trillion worth of credit – and supported a rapid increase in fixed-asset investment, especially in infrastructure and real-estate development.

zh: 2009年末，当投资密集型经济开始出现过热信号时，政府采取了严格的宏观经济调控，迫使投资者暂停正在进行的项目。
en: When, in late 2009, the investment-intensive economy began to show signs of overheating, the government imposed strict macroeconomic controls, forcing investors to halt ongoing projects.

zh: 增长应声而落。
en: Growth fell immediately.

zh: 与此同时，债务在继续增加 — — 因为利息在不断积累。
en: Meanwhile, debt continued to rise – not least because of the continued accumulation of interest.

zh: 事实上，根据政治经济学家史宗瀚（Victor Shih）的估算，因利息而形成的增量债务在2010年达到了新增名义GDP的80 % 。
en: Indeed, according to the political economist Victor Shih, the interest that accrued to all debts in China in 2010 amounted to 80% of incremental nominal GDP.

zh: 2012年，两者已经等量齐观，而在2013年，利息升高到新增名义GDP的140 % 。 史宗瀚预测2014年这一比例将达到200 % 。
en: In 2012, the two figures were nearly equivalent, with interest rising to 140% of incremental nominal GDP in 2013 and, Shih expects, to 200% for 2014.

zh: 特别是，地方政府需要应对巨大的不良债务，这破坏了它们的资本支出能力，也冻结了对生产性投资的私人需求。
en: Local governments, in particular, have struggled with a colossal volume of bad debt, which has undermined their capacity for capital expenditure and frozen out private demand for productive investment.

zh: 严格的房地产市场调控给开发商本身造成了严重负担，钢铁等相关行业也大受影响。
en: Stringent controls on the real-estate market placed a heavy burden on the developers themselves, as well as related industries like steel.

zh: 但中国政府没有及时认识到 — — 更谈不上解决 — — 不良债务问题，而是放任这一问题不断扩大。
en: Yet China’s government failed to acknowledge – much less address – the bad debts in a timely manner, instead allowing them to grow even larger.

zh: 由于让借款人避免违约 — — 至少暂时避免 — — 的唯一办法是提供不断增加的流动性，因此，即使银行面临流动性约束，也仍然愿意扩大新贷款。
en: Given that the only way to enable borrowers to avoid default – at least temporarily – has been to provide an ever-increasing amount of liquidity, even banks facing liquidity constraints have remained willing to extend new loans.

zh: 尽管中国国民储蓄率很高，意味着不需要向外部借取流动性发行大量货币，但其所面临的风险不可低估。
en: Though China’s high national savings rate means that it does not have to borrow liquidity from abroad or print large amounts of money, the risks it faces should not be underestimated.

zh: 如此大比例的新流动性被用于维持债务的支出，留给刺激增长的新投资的部分寥寥无几。
en: With such a large share of the new liquidity being used to cover debt service, there is little left to finance new, growth-stimulating investment.

zh: 此外，随着债务的不断增加，银行的放贷意愿会降低，促使债务人转向不受监管、利率畸高的影子银行部门以满足流动性需求。
en: Moreover, as debts grow ever larger, banks’ willingness to lend will decline, driving debtors to the unregulated shadow-banking sector, where interest rates are extremely high, for their liquidity needs.

zh: 融资成本的上升将进一步阻碍固定资产投资（进而阻碍经济增长 ） 。
en: The rising cost of financing will further undermine fixed-asset investment (and thus economic growth).

zh: 中国的“新常态”其实一点都不正常。
en: China’s “new normal” is actually not normal at all.

zh: 东亚经济20世纪60—90年代的增长曲线和结构变化表明中国可能继续维持十年的中高速增长，但中国必须首先解决其债务问题。
en: While the growth curve and structural changes in the East Asian economy from the 1960s to the 1990s suggest that China could experience medium-to-high growth rates for another decade, the country must address its debt problem first.

zh: 第一步是立刻降息，从而降低债务人的负担、提振GDP增长。
en: The first step is to cut interest rates immediately, thereby reducing the burden on debtors and bolstering GDP growth.

zh: 政府还必须实施更加积极的财政政策，而不是只注重货币政策。
en: The government must also pursue a more active fiscal policy, rather than focusing on monetary policy.

zh: 此外，由于地方政府和国有企业占了中国不良债务的大头，因此通过中央政府债券提供资金予以减记也许是必不可少的 — — 并且要快。
en: Furthermore, given that local governments and state-owned enterprises are responsible for the majority of China’s bad debts, write-offs, funded by central-government bonds, will probably be necessary – and soon.

zh: 财政部刚刚推出的“债务置换”机制 — — 允许高负债地方政府将1万亿人民币的今年到期的债务置换为利率更低的债券 — — 方向是正确的，但远远不够。
en: Though the “debt swap” scheme that the finance ministry just introduced – which allows highly leveraged local governments to swap CN¥1 trillion of debt maturing this year for bonds with lower interest rates – is a step in the right direction, it is far from adequate.

zh: 中央政府面临非常有利的财政环境 — — 债务-GDP之比只有20%左右 — — 实施更大规模的债务置换计划正当其时。
en: With the central government enjoying such favorable fiscal conditions – its debt-to-GDP ratio stands at only about 20% – now is the ideal time to initiate a much larger debt-swap program.

zh: 当然，遏制未来债务积累对中国的长期繁荣也很关键。
en: Of course, curbing future debt accumulation is also vital to China’s long-term prosperity.

zh: 因此，中国必须通过培育债券和股票市场来降低地方政府对通过银行满足融资需求的依赖。
en: That is why China must reduce local governments’ dependence on banks to meet their financing needs, by nurturing bond and equity markets.

zh: 如今，债务所导致的中国经济的扭曲可谓名副其实 — — 扭曲。
en: The debt-induced distortions in China’s economy today are precisely that – distortions.

zh: 它们不是经济的根本特征，也不是中国新常态的必然特征。
en: They are not a fundamental feature of the economy, and they need not characterize China’s new normal.

zh: 当局可以用正确的战略消除这些扭曲，让经济在未来十年中达到中高速的增长潜力。
en: With the right strategy, the authorities can eliminate these distortions and allow the economy to reach its medium-to-high-speed growth potential over the next decade.

zh: 错误的中国警报
en: False Alarm on China

zh: 纽黑文—2016年伊始，中国经济崩溃论给全球金融市场造成了剧烈动荡。
en: NEW HAVEN – The prospect of an economic meltdown in China has been sending tremors through global financial markets at the start of 2016.

zh: 但这样的恐慌过于夸张。
en: Yet such fears are overblown.

zh: 中国股票和货币市场动荡决不能掉以轻心，但中国在实体经济的结构调整方面仍然取得了令人鼓舞的进步。
en: While turmoil in Chinese equity and currency markets should not be taken lightly, the country continues to make encouraging headway on structural adjustments in its real economy.

zh: 如今，中国已经进入向新增长模式转型的临界点，经济再平衡的进步与金融改革的退步之间的错配最终必须得到解决。
en: This mismatch between progress in economic rebalancing and setbacks in financial reforms must ultimately be resolved as China now enters a critical phase in its transition to a new growth model.

zh: 但这并不意味着危机近在眼前。
en: But it does not spell imminent crisis.

zh: 与中国长期中央计划的经验相符，如今它仍然擅长产业再造。
en: Consistent with China’s long experience in central planning, it continues to excel at industrial reengineering.

zh: 2015年的趋势印证了这一点：服务业扩张8.3 % ， 超过了曾经的领头羊制造业和建筑业，后两者总量去年只增长了6 % 。
en: Trends in 2015 were a case in point: The 8.3% expansion in the services sector outstripped that of the once-dominant manufacturing and construction sectors, which together grew by just 6% last year.

zh: 2015年，所谓的第三产业占中国GDP之比为50.5 % ， 大大高于2011年实施十二五规划时的目标47 % ， 更是比第二产业活动（制造业和建筑业）的40.5%高出了整整十个百分点。
en: The so-called tertiary sector rose to 50.5% of Chinese GDP in 2015, well in excess of the 47% share targeted in 2011, when the 12th Five-Year Plan, was adopted, and fully ten percentage points larger than the 40.5% share of secondary-sector activities (manufacturing and construction).

zh: 中国经济结构的这一重大变化对于其消费拉动的再平衡战略具有关键重要性。
en: This significant shift in China’s economic structure is vitally important to the country’s consumer-led rebalancing strategy.

zh: 服务业发展奠定了城市发展机会，而城市发展机会有是个人收入的重要基础。
en: Services development underpins urban employment opportunities, a key building block of personal income generation.

zh: 对于每单位产出，中国服务业所需要的就业岗位数量比制造业和建筑业加起来还要多30 % ， 因此，第三产业的相对强势对于遏制失业、防止社会动荡（长期以来这一直是中国最大的担忧）具有重要作用。
en: With Chinese services requiring about 30% more jobs per unit of output than manufacturing and construction, combined, the tertiary sector’s relative strength has played an important role in limiting unemployment and preventing social instability – long China’s greatest fear.

zh: 相反，即使面临GDP增长减速，2015年城市就业岗位仍然增加了1,100万个，高于一千万的政府目标，也比2014年的1,070万略有增加。
en: On the contrary, even in the face of decelerating GDP growth, urban job creation hit 11 million in 2015, above the government’s target of ten million and a slight increase from 10.7 million in 2014.

zh: 坏消息是中国在实体经济重组方面取得重大进步的同时，其金融日程遭遇重大挫折 — — 股市泡沫破裂，货币政策变化处置不当金融资本发生外逃。
en: The bad news is that China’s impressive headway on restructuring its real economy has been accompanied by significant setbacks for its financial agenda – namely, the bursting of an equity bubble, a poorly handled shift in currency policy, and an exodus of financial capital.

zh: 这些绝非癣疥之疾 — — 特别是考虑到中国最终必须让其金融基础设施与其基于市场的消费社会相符。
en: These are hardly inconsequential developments – especially for a country that must eventually align its financial infrastructure with a market-based consumer society.

zh: 说到底，如果中国不让其金融改革与实体经济的再平衡更加同步，就无法取得成功。
en: In the end, China will never succeed if it does not bring its financial reforms into closer sync with its rebalancing strategy for the real economy.

zh: 资本市场改革 — — 特别是发展更加稳健的股票和债券市场，扩大长期以银行系统为核心的信用中介体系 — — 对于这一目标至关重要。
en: Capital-market reforms – especially the development of more robust equity and bond markets to augment a long dominant bank-centric system of credit intermediation – are critical to this objective.

zh: 但股市泡沫破裂后，股票融资之路在可预见的未来都行不通。
en: Yet in the aftermath of the stock-market bubble, the equity-funding alternative is all but dead for the foreseeable future.

zh: 仅仅从这一点出发，就可以看出中国最近的金融业退步是多么令人沮丧。
en: For that reason alone, China’s recent financial-sector setbacks are especially disappointing.

zh: 但退步和危机不是一回事。
en: But setbacks and crises are not the same thing.

zh: 好消息是中国巨大的外汇储备意味着它拥有重要的缓冲可以应对经典的货币和流动性危机。
en: The good news is that China’s massive reservoir of foreign-exchange reserves provides it with an important buffer against a classic currency and liquidity crisis.

zh: 诚然，中国的储备在过去19个月中大幅下降，减少了7,000亿美元。
en: To be sure, China’s reserves have fallen enormously – by $700 billion – in the last 19 months.

zh: 最近，中国新增大量美元计价负债，国际清算银行的数据认为在1万亿美元左右（短期和长期债务之和 ） ， 绝不能忽视外部脆弱性。
en: Given China’s recent build-up of dollar-denominated liabilities, which the Bank for International Settlements currently places at around $1 trillion (for short- and long-term debt, combined), external vulnerability can hardly be ignored.

zh: 但是，2015年12月中国仍拥有3.3万亿美元储备，是其短期外债的四倍多 — — 远超一国在无法从国际市场上借贷的情况下偿清所有短期外部负债所需资金量的经验法则。
en: But, at $3.3 trillion in December 2015, China’s reserves are still enough to cover more than four times its short-term external debt – well in excess of the widely accepted rule of thumb that a country should still be able to fund all of its short-term foreign liabilities in the event that it is unable to borrow in international markets.

zh: 当然，如果外汇储备继续以每年5,000亿美元（2015年的数字）的速度消耗，这一缓冲将在六年后耗尽。
en: Of course, this cushion would effectively vanish in six years if foreign reserves were to continue falling at the same $500 billion annual rate recorded in 2015.

zh: 这正是20世纪90年代末亚洲金融危机期间最大的担忧，当时，人们广泛预期中国将步其他所谓的东亚奇迹经济体后尘。 这些经济体因为本币遭遇传染性袭击（contagious attack）而耗尽湖北。
en: This was precisely the greatest fear during the Asian financial crisis of the late 1990s, when China was widely expected to follow other so-called East Asian miracle economies that had run out of reserves in the midst of a contagious attack on their currencies.

zh: 但既然当时并没有发生这一情况，现在也肯定不会发生：如今，中国外汇储备是其1997—98年持有量1,400亿美元的23倍。
en: But if it didn’t happen then, it certainly won’t happen now: China’s foreign-exchange reserves today are 23 times higher than the $140 billion held in 1997-98.

zh: 此外，中国仍保持巨大的经常项目盈余，这与20世纪90年代末其他亚洲经济体纷纷出现大规模外部赤字截然不同。
en: Moreover, China continues to run a large current-account surplus, in contrast to the outsize external deficits that proved so problematic for other Asian economies in the late 1990s.

zh: 但是恐慌仍然存在：如果资本外逃加剧，中国最终将无力阻止。
en: Still, fear persists that if capital flight were to intensify, China would ultimately be powerless to stop it.

zh: 大错特错。
en: Nothing could be further from the truth.

zh: 中国的制度对于危机及其后果有着深刻的记忆。
en: China’s institutional memory runs deep when it comes to crises and their consequences.

zh: 20世纪90年代末尤其如此，当时的中国领导人在第一线目睹了储备���尽和相关货币的崩溃是如何席卷看似坚不可摧的经济体的。
en: That is especially the case concerning the experience of the late 1990s, when Chinese leaders saw firsthand how a run on reserves and a related currency collapse can wreak havoc on seemingly invincible economies.

zh: 事实上，正是这一认识，以及毫不动摇地坚持保持稳定，让中国抓紧时间囤积了现代历史上规模最大的外汇储备。
en: In fact, it was that realization, coupled with a steadfast fixation on stability, that prompted China to focus urgently on amassing the largest reservoir of foreign-exchange reserves in modern history.

zh: 近几年来，当局采取了多项开放资本账户的重要措施，它们并不想重新关闭资本账户，但如果资本外逃成为更加严重的威胁，它们几乎肯定会重新思考立场。
en: While the authorities have no desire to close the capital account after having taken several important steps to open it in recent years, they would most certainly rethink this position if capital flight were to become a more serious threat.

zh: 诚然，最近所实施的诸多金融改革让中国步履蹒跚。
en: Yes, China has stumbled in the recent implementation of many of its financial reforms.

zh: 股市大崩盘尤其令人触目，对2015年8月的汇率政策变化不做官方解释亦然。
en: The equity-market fiasco is especially glaring in this regard, as was the failure to clarify official intentions regarding the August 2015 shift in exchange-rate policy.

zh: 这些失误决不能掉以轻心 — — 特别是考虑到中国所做出的引人注目的市场改革承诺。
en: These missteps should not be taken lightly – especially in light of China’s high-profile commitment to market-based reforms.

zh: 但这些与很多人相信近在眼前的危机还有很大距离。
en: But they are a far cry from the crisis that many believe is now at hand.

zh: 中国的货币政策惊奇
en: China’s Monetary-Policy Surprise

zh: 纽黑文—与其他大多数领域一样，经济政策也是言大于行。
en: NEW HAVEN – In economic policy, as in most other areas, actions speak louder than words.

zh: 中国人民银行降低基准政策利率的措施彰显出中国政府对稳定政策的战术性关注。 中国政府将GDP增长下限定在7%左右。
en: By cutting its benchmark policy interest rates on November 21, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) has underscored the tactical focus of the government’s stabilization policy, which aims to put a floor of around 7% on GDP growth.

zh: 实现这一目标是个不小的成就。
en: Achieving this goal will be no small feat.

zh: 中国经济面临结构性问题，这些问题来自经济转型（向新的服务和消费拉动经济）以及周期性压力（严峻的全球环境对旧的出口和投资拉动型模式形成了压力 ） 。
en: China’s economy is caught in the crossfire of structural and cyclical headwinds. Structural pressures have arisen from the shift to a new model of services- and consumer-led growth, and cyclical pressures stem from a tough global environment that has put downward pressure on the old model of export and investment-led growth.

zh: 特别是，周期性挑战要比预想的更加严重。
en: The cyclical challenges, in particular, are proving to be more vexing than anticipated.

zh: 尽管出口占GDP之比已经从危机前峰值35%大幅下降，但仍高达24 % ， 这意味着中国需受全球增长周期的影响 — — 特别是需求尤其疲软的发达国家市场。
en: Though exports have declined considerably from their pre-crisis peak of 35% of GDP, they continue to account for about 24%, leaving China exposed to the global growth cycle – especially to markets in the developed world, where demand is exceptionally weak.

zh: 事实上，42%的中国出口流向了欧洲、美国和日本 — — 这三个经济体都在经历长期停滞。
en: Indeed, 42% of Chinese exports go to Europe, the United States, and Japan – three economies that are flirting with secular stagnation.

zh: 其中最大出口市场欧洲最为困难。
en: And Europe, China’s largest export market, has struggled the most.

zh: 当经济达到中等收入水平时，发展战略就会开始失效，而中国正在迅速达到这一水平，因此中国不能允许高企的周期性风险阻碍其结构型转型。
en: Given that development strategies typically begin to fail when economies reach middle-income status – a threshold that China is rapidly approaching – China cannot afford to allow mounting cyclical risks to undermine its structural transformation.

zh: 现代历史表明，最容易使发展中国家踏入可怕的“中等收入陷阱”的办法莫过于纠结于模式太久。
en: Modern history shows that the easiest way for a developing country to become ensnared in the dreaded “middle-income trap” is to cling to its old model for too long.

zh: 事实上，只有结构转型能让发展中国家步入高收入发达水平。
en: The fact is that only structural transformation can lift a middle-income developing country to high-income developed status.

zh: 幸运的是，中国领导人认识到了这一点并决心实现这一点。
en: Fortunately, China’s leaders recognize this, and are committed to achieving it.

zh: 国家主席习近平一直承担着推进改革和再平衡的领导责任。
en: President Xi Jinping has been spearheading the effort to press ahead with reform and rebalancing.

zh: 一年前，在中共十八大三中全会上，习近平和他的团队制定了35年来中国最有雄心的经济改革日程。
en: A year ago, at the Third Plenary Session of the 18th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), Xi and his team created the country’s most ambitious economic-reform agenda in 35 years.

zh: 这一日程和2011年的十二五规划彰显出当局对提振服务业和内需的决心。
en: This, together with the 12th Five-Year Plan that was enacted in 2011, highlights the authorities’ commitment to bolstering the services sector and domestic consumption.

zh: 与此同时，中国一直在将实施改革的责任从过时的计划部门（发改委）过渡给效率更高的党内市场机制（全面深化改革领导小组 ） 。
en: At the same time, China has been shifting responsibility for implementing reform from its antiquated planning apparatus (the National Development and Reform Commission) to a more effective market-based mechanism embedded in the CCP’s structure (the Leading Small Group for Comprehensively Deepening Reforms).

zh: 此外还有前所未有的反腐运动，中国的再平衡和结构变迁之路也没有回头路可走。
en: Add to that Xi’s unprecedented anti-corruption campaign, and there is no turning back on China’s road to rebalancing and structural change.

zh: 但周期性干扰的风险（如出人意料的全球经济增长下降）仍然存在。
en: But the risk of cyclical disruptions, such as an unexpected decline in global economic growth, remains.

zh: 这构成了中国的一个重要战术性挑战。
en: This raises an important tactical challenge for China.

zh: 它如何保持改革进程，同时又免受短期增长严重减速的影响？
en: How can it stay the reform course without being derailed by a significant growth slowdown in the short term?

zh: 中国已不是第一次面临这样的挑战。
en: This is not the first time that China has confronted this challenge – nor will it be the last.

zh: 事实上，2008—2009年大衰退曾将中国推向衰退边缘。
en: The Great Recession of 2008-2009 also pushed China to the brink of outright recession.

zh: 全球贸易崩溃，中国出口需求年增长率从2008年年中的26%下降到2009年年初的-27 % ， 面对这一情况，政府果断行动，向经济注入4万亿元人民币。
en: With global trade collapsing and Chinese export demand having plummeted from 26% annual growth in mid-2008 to a 27% contraction by early 2009, the government moved aggressively to inject CN¥4 trillion ($586 billion) into the economy.

zh: 尽管这一措施使经济在2009年底实现复苏，但也创造了新的问题，包括债务过多、房地产市场积压和大量地方政府金融风险。
en: Though this enabled growth to recover by the end of 2009, it also contributed to new problems, including excessive debt, a property-market overhang, and mounting local-government financial risk.

zh: 中国最不需要的就是财政刺激。
en: The last thing China needs is more fiscal stimulus.

zh: 今天的周期性干扰远远不如2008—2009年，此外，与在财政上十分鲁莽的发达经济体相比，中国认识到债务过多是可持续增长和发展的威胁。
en: Today’s cyclical disruption pales in comparison to that of 2008-2009, and, unlike the fiscally reckless developed economies, China recognizes excessive government debt as a legitimate threat to sustainable growth and development.

zh: 此外，主要发达经济体已将政策利率下降至零水平，用尽了常规货币政策，而中国有足够的货币刺激储备解决周期性干扰。
en: Moreover, unlike major developed economies, most of which have used up all of their conventional monetary-policy ammunition by reducing their policy interest rates to zero, China has plenty of monetary stimulus on reserve to address cyclical disruptions.

zh: 在这样的情况下，有理由认为中国会更倾向于货币政策而不是财政政策。
en: In these circumstances, it makes sense for China to lean more on monetary policy than on fiscal expansion.

zh: 尽管如此，中国人民银行的战术性决定也存在潜在漏洞，因为这鼓励了信用规模扩张，而中国正在竭力摆脱债务密集型增长。
en: Nonetheless, the PBOC’s tactical decision is not without potential pitfalls – not least because interest-rate cuts encourage the extension of more credit at a time when China is trying to wean itself from debt-intensive growth.

zh: 一个关键的挑战将是避免信用风险升级��浙江破坏改革和再平衡过程。
en: A key challenge will be to avoid escalating credit risk, which could undermine the process of reform and rebalancing.

zh: 首先，中国领导人知道，结构转型和商业周期的互动将是复杂的。
en: From the start, China’s leaders knew that the interaction between structural transformation and the business cycle would be complex.

zh: 前总理温家宝在近八年前就指出，中国经济增长越来越“不稳定、不平衡、不协调、不可持续 ” 。
en: As former Premier Wen Jiabao noted nearly eight years ago, China’s economy had become increasingly “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable.”

zh: 中国在解决问题上拖延的越久，就越难以找到办法。
en: The longer China delayed addressing its problems, the more intractable the solution became.

zh: 习近平和他的同志们决心坚持中国经济再平衡的事业，与此同时也要保持对短期周期性风险的清醒认识。
en: Xi and his colleagues are resolute in attempting to solve this problem by staying the course to rebalance the Chinese economy, while remaining acutely aware of cyclical risks.

zh: 毕竟，中国之所以容易受到这些风险的影响，根源在于旧增长模式维持得太久。
en: After all, China’s vulnerability to such risks is rooted in its old growth model, which was allowed to remain in place for far too long.

zh: 最近的货币宽松表明中国当局正在划定阻止增长过度减弱的底线，他们将周期性干扰视为对中国长期结构改革日程的真正威胁。
en: With the recent monetary easing, the Chinese authorities seem to be drawing a line in the sand to prevent an excessive drop in growth. This suggests that they now view a cyclical disruption as a real threat to the country’s longer-term structural-reform agenda.

zh: 由于这一担忧是持久的，可以预期还会有更多的货币宽松。
en: To the extent that those fears persist, additional monetary easing can be expected.

zh: 亚洲的水资源战争？
en: A Water War in Asia?

zh: 柏林 — — 亚洲水资源紧张局势正在升级 — — 而且不仅因为海洋权益主张相互矛盾。
en: BERLIN – Tensions over water are rising in Asia – and not only because of conflicting maritime claims.

zh: 虽然南中国海海域领土争端吸引了绝大部分注意力 — — 毕竟，它们威胁到海上航道安全和航行自由，从而影响到域外大国的利益 — — 但对跨国共享淡水资源争夺的战略影响同样是不可忽视的。
en: While territorial disputes, such as in the South China Sea, attract the most attention – after all, they threaten the safety of sea lanes and freedom of navigation, which affects outside powers as well – the strategic ramifications of competition over transnationally shared freshwater resources are just as ominous.

zh: 亚洲的人均淡水资源保有量低于其他任何大陆，并且根据麻省理工学院的一项研究，亚洲面临的水资源危机将持续加剧，预计到2050年可能面临严重的水资源短缺。
en: Asia has less fresh water per capita than any other continent, and it is already facing a water crisis that, according to an MIT study, will continue to intensify, with severe water shortages expected by 2050.

zh: 在这样一个地缘政治纷争随处可见的年代，对淡水资源的过度争夺可能演变为对亚洲长期和平与稳定的严重威胁。
en: At a time of widespread geopolitical discord, competition over freshwater resources could emerge as a serious threat to long-term peace and stability in Asia.

zh: 水资源争夺战目前已经开始，而中国是主要的进攻方。
en: Already, the battle is underway, with China as the main aggressor.

zh: 事实上，中国在南海进行领土掠夺的同时还悄无声息地侵占了跨国流域资源。
en: Indeed, China’s territorial grab in the South China Sea has been accompanied by a quieter grab of resources in transnational river basins.

zh: 重新设计跨境河流的流动是中国加强对亚洲控制和影响战略的重要部分。
en: Reengineering cross-border riparian flows is integral to China’s strategy to assert greater control and influence over Asia.

zh: 中国毫无疑问有能力执行这项战略。
en: China is certainly in a strong position to carry out this strategy.

zh: 该国享有无与伦比的沿岸主导优势，拥有110条跨国河流和湖泊流入到十八个下游国家。
en: The country enjoys unmatched riparian dominance, with 110 transnational rivers and lakes flowing into 18 downstream countries.

zh: 中国同时拥有全世界数量最多的水坝，而且毫不犹豫地利用这些设施来遏制跨国河流流入其他国家。
en: China also has the world’s most dams, which it has never hesitated to use to curb cross-border flows.

zh: 事实上，中国在流出本国领土的绝大多数跨国河流上都修建了水坝。
en: In fact, China’s dam builders are targeting most of the international rivers that flow out of Chinese territory.

zh: 中国绝大部分国际共享水资源均位于青藏高原，青藏高原于二十世纪五十年代成为中国的领土。
en: Most of China’s internationally shared water resources are located on the Tibetan Plateau, which it annexed in the early 1950s.

zh: 不出所料，青藏高原成为中国水坝建设的新枢纽。
en: Unsurprisingly, the plateau is the new hub of Chinese dam building.

zh: 事实上，中国第十三个五年计划呼吁在青藏高原启动新一轮水坝建设项目。
en: Indeed, China’s 13th five-year plan, released this year, calls for a new wave of dam projects on the Plateau.

zh: 此外，中国最近切断了作为孟加拉国和印度北部生命线的布拉马普特拉河的支流，用于修建一座水坝作为西藏一个主要的水电项目。
en: Moreover, China recently cut off the flow of a tributary of the Brahmaputra River, the lifeline of Bangladesh and northern India, to build a dam as part of a major hydroelectric project in Tibet.

zh: 而且该国正在布拉马普特拉河上修建另一座水坝，目的是从无到有创造一系列人工湖。
en: And the country is working to dam another Brahmaputra tributary, in order to create a series of artificial lakes.

zh: 中国还在同样流入东南亚的湄公河上修建了六座大坝，对下游已经造成的影响日渐显著。
en: China has also built six mega-dams on the Mekong River, which flows into Southeast Asia, where the downstream impact is already visible.

zh: 但中国不仅没有遏制其水坝建设，反而在湄公河上抓紧修建另外几座大坝。
en: Yet, instead of curbing its dam-building, China is hard at work building several more Mekong dams.

zh: 同样，中亚大部分干旱地区供水也面临着进一步的压力，因为中国占用的伊犁河水越来越多。
en: Likewise, water supplies in largely arid Central Asia are coming under further pressure as China appropriates a growing volume of water from the Illy River.

zh: 哈萨克斯坦的巴尔喀什湖现在面临的大规模收缩的风险，对于乌兹别克斯坦边境线上的咸海也是一样 — — 在不到四十年的时间里咸海已经近乎枯竭了。
en: Kazakhstan’s Lake Balkhash is now at risk of shrinking substantially, much like the Aral Sea – located on the border with Uzbekistan – which has virtually dried up in less than 40 years.

zh: 中国还将水调出额尔齐斯河，这条河向哈萨克斯坦首都阿斯塔纳提供饮用水，并且河水最终流入俄罗斯的鄂毕河。
en: China is also diverting water from the Irtysh, which supplies drinking water to Kazakhstan’s capital Astana and feeds Russia’s Ob River.

zh: 对中亚地区而言，跨境水资源流量不断减少还不是问题的全部。
en: For Central Asia, the diminished transboundary flows are just one part of the problem.

zh: 中国在新疆地区不断发展的能源、制造和农业活动正在造成更深远的影响，因为就像汉族核心地区的河流一样，这些活动排放的有毒化学品和化肥污染了区域跨国河流的河水质量。
en: China’s energy, manufacturing, and agricultural activities in sprawling Xinjiang are having an even greater impact, as they contaminate the waters of the region’s transnational rivers with hazardous chemicals and fertilizers, just as China has done to the rivers in its Han heartland.

zh: 当然，中国并非唯一一个因水资源引发冲突的国家。
en: Of course, China is not the only country stoking conflict over water.

zh: 就像为了凸显克什米尔的领土争端既因为水资源也因为领土一样，巴基斯坦在短短十年中第二次根据1960年印度河水域条约的规定，启动了针对印度的国际仲裁法庭诉讼。
en: As if to underscore that the festering territorial dispute in Kashmir is as much about water as it is about land, Pakistan has, for the second time this decade, initiated international arbitral tribunal proceedings against India under the terms of the 1960 Indus Waters Treaty.

zh: 个中的悖论是地处下游的巴基斯坦利用该条约 — — 全世界最慷慨的水资源共享协议 — — 为自身保留了印度六河体系超过80%的水资源 — — 以便支持印巴冲突。
en: The paradox here is that downstream Pakistan has used that treaty – the world’s most generous water-sharing deal, reserving for Pakistan more than 80% of the waters of the six-river Indus system – to sustain its conflict with India.

zh: 此外，地处内陆以水��出口为支柱产业的老挝为了向以中国为首的国家出口水电刚刚通知邻国其决定修筑发电量为912兆瓦的北宾大坝，这也是第三个具有争议的项目。
en: Meanwhile, landlocked Laos – aiming to export hydropower, especially to China, the mainstay of its economy – has just notified its neighbors of its decision to move ahead with a third controversial project, the 912-megawatt Pak Beng dam.

zh: 之前老挝不顾区域其他国家有关改变水流自然模式的忧虑，执意推进沙耶武里和栋沙宏大坝项目。
en: It previously brushed aside regional concerns about the alteration of natural-flow patterns to push ahead with the Xayaburi and Don Sahong dam projects.

zh: 没有理由期待这次会产生不同的结果。
en: There is no reason to expect a different outcome this time.

zh: 亚洲不断增长的水资源竞争后果将远远超越地区的范畴。
en: The consequences of growing water competition in Asia will reverberate beyond the region.

zh: 已经有一些亚洲国家因为担心能否种出足够的粮食，在撒哈拉以南非洲地区租用了大片农地，并在一些地区引发了抗议活动。
en: Already, some Asian states, concerned about their capacity to grow enough food, have leased large tracts of farmland in Sub-Saharan Africa, triggering a backlash in some areas.

zh: 2009年，当韩国大宇物流公司谈判达成租赁协议租用马达加斯加高达半数的耕地种植谷物和棕榈油供应韩国市场时，由此引发的抗议活动和军事干预推翻了一任民主选举的总统。
en: In 2009, when South Korea’s Daewoo Logistics Corporation negotiated a deal to lease as much as half of Madagascar’s arable land to produce cereals and palm oil for the South Korean market, the ensuing protests and military intervention toppled a democratically elected president.

zh: 亚洲占用水资源的竞争正在给农业和渔业施加压力，破坏生态系统，并且造成整个地区的不和谐与不信任。
en: The race to appropriate water resources in Asia is straining agriculture and fisheries, damaging ecosystems, and fostering dangerous distrust and discord across the region.

zh: 这种情况必须结束。
en: It must be brought to an end.

zh: 亚洲国家需要澄清该地区越来越黑暗的水文政治。
en: Asian countries need to clarify the region’s increasingly murky hydropolitics.

zh: 解决问题的关键在于建立有效的争端解决机制和更加透明的水资源共享安排协议。
en: The key will be effective dispute-resolution mechanisms and agreement on more transparent water-sharing arrangements.

zh: 亚洲可以建设一套和谐并基于规则的水资源管理系统。
en: Asia can build a harmonious, rules-based water management system.

zh: 但这套系统需要中国的加入。
en: But it needs China to get on board.

zh: 至少从目前的情况看，似乎不太可能实现这一目标。
en: At least for now, that does not seem likely.

zh: 中国造成的全球环境威胁
en: A Global Environmental Threat Made in China

zh: 新德里—亚洲的未来不可避免地与世界屋脊喜、这个缺水之洲的主要河流系统发源地马拉雅山脉联系在一起。
en: NEW DELHI – Asia’s future is inextricably tied to the Himalayas, the world’s tallest mountain range and the source of the water-stressed continent’s major river systems.

zh: 但不顾后果的国家工程正在威胁该地区脆弱的生态系统，造成日益严重的安全威胁，并影响到亚洲之外。
en: Yet reckless national projects are straining the region’s fragile ecosystems, resulting in a mounting security threat that extends beyond Asia.

zh: 喜马拉雅山脉海拔从不到500米急剧升高到8,000米以上，成为从高山冲击草原和亚热带阔叶林到针叶林和高山草甸的生态系统之家。
en: With elevations rising dramatically from less than 500 meters (1,640 feet) to over 8,000 meters, the Himalayas are home to ecosystems ranging from high-altitude alluvial grasslands and subtropical broadleaf forests to conifer forests and alpine meadows.

zh: 喜马拉雅山脉从缅甸一直绵亘到兴都库什山中亚分水邻，对亚洲水循环和天气和气候模式起着核心作用，包括引发每年的夏季季风。
en: Stretching from Myanmar to the Hindu-Kush watershed of Central Asia, the Himalayas play a central role in driving Asia’s hydrological cycle and weather and climate patterns, including triggering the annual summer monsoons.

zh: 其18,000座高海拔冰川存储着巨量淡水，在冬天时充当着仅次于南极洲的世界第二大吸热器，从而帮助缓和全球气候。
en: Its 18,000 high-altitude glaciers store massive amounts of freshwater and serve in winter as the world’s second-largest heat sink after Antarctica, thus helping to moderate the global climate.

zh: 但在夏天，喜马拉雅山脉又成为热源，将季风流从海洋吸引到亚洲内陆。
en: In summer, however, the Himalayas turn into a heat source that draws the monsoonal currents from the oceans into the Asian hinterland.

zh: 如今，喜马拉雅山脉面临着冰川加速融化、气候动荡和生物多样性损失。
en: The Himalayas are now subject to accelerated glacial thaw, climatic instability, and biodiversity loss.

zh: 发源于大喜马拉雅地块的五条河流 — — 长江、印度和、湄公河、怒江和恒河 — — 都名列世界十大濒危河流。
en: Five rivers originating on the Great Himalayan Massif – the Yangtze, the Indus, the Mekong, the Salween, and the Ganges – rank among the world’s ten most endangered rivers.

zh: 从大规模大坝建设到无节制地勘探自然资源，人类活动显然腰围喜马拉雅生态系统的灾难性变化负责。
en: From large-scale dam construction to the unbridled exploitation of natural resources, human activity is clearly to blame for these potentially devastating changes to the Himalayan ecosystems.

zh: 从某种程度上讲，域内所有国家都是共谋，但中国所造成的伤害最大。
en: While all the countries in the region are culpable to some extent, none is doing as much harm as China.

zh: 中国不像（比如）民主的印度那样，有各种草根积极主义约束，用大规模但常常不透明的工程建设让大自然屈从于它的意志，彰显自己的大国地位。
en: Unconstrained by the kinds of grassroots activism seen in, say, democratic India, China has used massive, but often opaque, construction projects to bend nature to its will and trumpet its rise as a great power.

zh: 这其中包括睥睨全球的跨河流和跨流域引水基础设施，其16,000公里的运河体系能够运送一百亿立方米以上的水源。
en: This includes a globally unmatched inter-river and inter-basin water-transfer infrastructure with the capacity to move over ten billion cubic meters (13 billion cubic yards) through 16,000 kilometers (9,940 miles) of canals.

zh: 中国运用大坝改造自然河流流向 — — 目前中国有五分之一的河流，干流流量不如引向水库的水量 — — 已经导致沿河生态系统破坏和350座大型湖泊消失。
en: China’s reengineering of natural river flows through damming – one-fifth of the country’s rivers now have less water flowing through them each year than is diverted to reservoirs – has already degraded riparian ecosystems and caused 350 large lakes to disappear.

zh: 随着这些引水工程日益向国际而非内部河流集中 — — 特别是覆盖了喜马拉雅冰川区四分之三的青藏高原河流 — — 环境威胁也远远超出了中国国界。
en: With these water-diverting projects increasingly focused on international, rather than internal, rivers – in particular those in the Tibetan Plateau, which covers nearly three-quarters of the Himalayan glacier area – the environmental threat extends far beyond China’s borders.

zh: 而大坝只是开始。
en: And dams are just the beginning.

zh: 青藏高原也是中国地质改造实验的主体，目标是将雨水引入干旱的华北和西北。
en: The Tibetan Plateau is also the subject of Chinese geo-engineering experiments, which aim to induce rain in its arid north and northwest.

zh: （西藏降雨集中在喜马拉雅地区。
en: (Rain in Tibet is concentrated in its Himalayan region.)

zh: ）这些活动可能夺走其他地区的水分，影响到亚洲的季风。
en: Such activities threaten to suck moisture from other regions, potentially affecting Asia’s monsoons.

zh: 更糟糕的是，这些实验是中国军方天气改造项目的延伸。
en: Ominously, such experiments are an extension of the Chinese military’s weather-modification program.

zh: 此外，中国似乎要让西藏（西部宝藏）变得名副其实，要采尽这个生态脆弱但资源丰富的高原的矿产资源，丝毫不顾后果。
en: Moreover, as if to substantiate the Chinese name for Tibet, Xizang (“Western Treasure Land”), China is draining mineral resources from this ecologically fragile but resource-rich plateau, without regard for the consequences.

zh: 目前，铜尾矿已在污染喜马拉雅藏民圣地，即白玛岗，世界海拔最高的大河雅鲁藏布江在这里沿着喜马拉雅山脉绕了一个大弯，流入印度。
en: Already, copper mine tailings are polluting waters in a Himalayan region sacred to Tibetans, which they call Pemako (“Hidden Lotus Land”), where the world’s highest-altitude major river, the Brahmaputra (Yarlung Tsangpo to Tibetans), curves around the Himalayas before entering India.

zh: 去年秋天，曾经清澈见底的雅鲁藏布江干流香江江水在流入印度时突然变成黑灰色，原因很可能是中国在上游从事的开挖、开采和破坏活动。
en: Last fall, the once-pristine Siang – the Brahmaputra’s main artery – suddenly turned blackish gray as it entered India, potentially because of China’s upstream tunneling, mining, or damming activity.

zh: 当然，中国政府宣称 11月中旬西藏东南部地震“可能导致河水浑浊 ” 。
en: To be sure, the Chinese government claimed that an earthquake that struck southeastern Tibet in mid-November “might have led to the turbidity” in the river waters.

zh: 但在地震之前，河水便早已不再适合人类使用。
en: But the water had become unfit for human consumption long before the quake.

zh: 无论如何，中国没有让步。
en: In any case, China is not letting up.

zh: 比如，它急不可耐地启动了在喜马拉雅山脉东麓争议地区（它通过1959年武装冲突从印度手中夺取）的大规模采掘金银等贵重矿产的作业。
en: It has, for example, eagerly launched large-scale operations to mine precious minerals like gold and silver in a disputed area of the eastern Himalayas that it seized from India in a 1959 armed clash.

zh: 与此同时，中国的瓶装水行业（世界最大）从已经饱受巨大压力的喜马拉雅山冰川吸取 “优质饮用水 ” ， 特别是喜马拉雅山东麓的冰川，那里的雪和冰盖融化加速清晰可辨。
en: Meanwhile, China’s bottled-water industry – the world’s largest – is siphoning “premium drinking water” from the Himalayas’ already-stressed glaciers, particularly those in the eastern Himalayas, where accelerated melting of snow and ice fields is already conspicuous. Unsurprisingly, this is causing biodiversity loss and impairment of ecosystem services.

zh: 科学家还报告喜马拉雅山脉存在大规模森林采伐，基因多样性迅速丧失和高地物种灭绝。
en: Across the Himalayas, scientists report large-scale deforestation, high rates of loss of genetic variability, and species extinction in the highlands.

zh: 青藏高原的变暖速度是全球平均水平的近三倍。
en: The Tibetan Plateau, for its part, is warming at almost three times the average global rate.

zh: 这意味着环境影响远远不止于亚洲。
en: This holds environmental implications that extend far beyond Asia.

zh: 高耸的喜马拉雅高地，特别是西藏，影响着北半球大气循环系统，帮助将赤道的暖气送往极地，在此过程中保持各种气候带。
en: The towering Himalayan Highlands, particularly Tibet, influence the Northern Hemisphere’s atmospheric-circulation system, which helps to transport warm air from the equator toward the poles, sustaining a variety of climate zones along the way.

zh: 换句话说，喜马拉雅生态系统的破坏可能影响到欧洲和北美气候模式。
en: In other words, Himalayan ecosystem impairment will likely affect European and North American climatic patterns.

zh: 阻止喜马拉雅山区环境剧烈破坏已是当务之急，而要实现这一目标，唯有通过喜马拉雅地区 — — 从下湄公河地区和中国到南亚各国 — — 所有成员的通力合作。
en: Halting rampant environmental degradation in the Himalayas is now urgent, and it is possible only through cooperation among all members of the Himalayan basin community, from the lower Mekong River region and China to the countries of southern Asia.

zh: 但要实现这样的合作，国际社会必须施压中国遏制其肆无忌惮的破坏环境的行为。 到目前为止，这是最大的风险来源。
en: To bring about such cooperation, however, the entire international community will have to apply pressure to rein in China’s reckless environmental impairment, which is by far the greatest source of risk.

zh: 中国如何避免债务通缩陷阱？
en: China in the Debt-Deflation Trap

zh: 香港—中国经济近期的下滑及波动触发了全球股市抛售潮，在此形势下，美联储刚刚宣布了暂缓升息。
en: HONG KONG – In the wake of a global stock-market sell-off triggered by economic turmoil in China, the US Federal Reserve has just decided to postpone raising interest rates.

zh: 事实上，中国正面临巨大挑战：应对全球范围的过度负债风险及避免因被迫减债而导致的通缩陷阱。
en: Indeed, China is facing the huge challenge of dealing with the risk of a global debt-deflation trap.

zh: 1933年，欧文·费雪（Irving Fisher）第一个指出过度负债和随后被迫减债而导致的通缩危险，并说明了它们在触发美国大萧条中所起的“作用 ” 。
en: In 1933, Irving Fisher was the first to identify the dangers of over-indebtedness and deflation, demonstrating their contribution to the Great Depression in the United States.

zh: 四十年后，查尔斯·金德尔伯格（Charles Kindleberger）将这一理论用到了全球金融体系中，强调了在全球范围由于缺乏协调一致的货币、财政和监管政策以及缺乏国际最后贷款人时全球经济可能出现的问题。
en: Forty years later, Charles Kindleberger applied the theory in a global context, emphasizing the problems that arise in a world lacking coordinated and consistent monetary, fiscal, and regulatory policies, as well as an international lender of last resort.

zh: 2011年，辜朝明（Richard Koo）用日本案例强调了资产负债表衰退的长期风险，在这类衰退中，过度负债的债务人为了重建更健康的资产负债表而不得不在相当长的一段时间采取去杠杆的措施。
en: In 2011, Richard Koo used Japan’s experience to highlight the risks of a prolonged balance-sheet recession, when over-stretched debtors deleverage in order to rebuild their balance sheets.

zh: 债务通缩周期始于不断加剧的过度繁荣、过度借贷和不断加码的投机性交易，也就是失衡，之后是泡沫破灭，而过剩产能和债务的顺周期特点导致流动性紧缩、物价通缩、失业及经济停滞、甚至是深度萧条。
en: The debt-deflation cycle begins with an imbalance or displacement, which fuels excessive exuberance, over-borrowing, and speculative trading, and ends in bust, with procyclical liquidation of excess capacity and debt causing price deflation, unemployment, and economic stagnation. The result can be a deep depression.

zh: 2000年，失衡反映在美国的巨额经常项目赤字：世界第一大经济体在国际资本市场上大量借入资金而非借出资金。
en: In 2000, the imbalance was America’s large current-account deficit: the world’s largest economy was borrowing heavily on international capital markets, rather than lending, as one might expect.

zh: 时任美联储主席伯南克（Ben Bernanke）将问题归结于有巨大贸易盈余的国家购买了太多的美国国债，从而抵消了美联储从紧的货币政策。
en: According to then-Fed Chairman Ben Bernanke, the problem was that countries running large surpluses were buying so many US Treasuries that they were negating the Fed’s monetary-policy efforts.

zh: 但是，博里奥（Claudio Borio ） 、 Hyun Shin和其他人则指出：美国和欧洲的银行过度发展表外和离岸借贷活动加剧了债务的顺周期扩张。
en: But, as Claudio Borio, Hyun Shin, and others have pointed out, excessive off-balance-sheet and offshore lending by US and European banks also added procyclical pressure.

zh: 结果，冒险和杠杆日增，而监管不力让这些行为变得更加便利，终于引发了2008年的全球金融危机。
en: As a result, risk-taking and leverage grew, facilitated by inadequate regulation, culminating in the global financial crisis of 2008.

zh: 为了阻止资产泡沫爆裂并为更加可持续的政策解决方案赢得时间，发达国家的央行采取了大规模货币宽松政策并将利率削减至零。
en: To prevent asset bubbles from collapsing and buy time for more sustainable policy fixes, advanced-country central banks implemented massive monetary easing and cut interest rates to zero.

zh: 不幸的是，大部分国家的决策者都浪费了央行为他们争取到的时间；此外，发达经济体的量化宽松政策给新兴市场经济体带来了影响深远的信贷扩张溢出效应。
en: Unfortunately, policymakers in most countries wasted the time they were given; moreover, so-called quantitative easing had far-reaching spillover effects.

zh: 中国的债务失衡则始于2008年11月时中国政府开始实施的4万亿元刺激经济计划。 当时中国决策层希望这个计划可以抵消主要出口市场需求萎靡的影响。
en: Within China, a second displacement occurred: the government implemented a ¥4 trillion ($680 billion) stimulus package in November 2008 to offset weak demand in its major export markets.

zh: 这个想法并没错，但计划执行后的两个结果却给今天的中国改革过程平添不少复杂的困扰。
en: While the Chinese authorities had the right idea, two of the policy’s outcomes have complicated the reform prcoess today.

zh: 首先，当时以投资为主的发展战略没有能够及时减少已经过剩的产能、也没有及时推动产业结构向生产率更高的方向转型，反而进一步增加了低端制造业及全球大宗商品剩余产能。
en: First, instead of reducing excess capacity and encouraging a structural shift to higher-productivity activities, the authorities’ investment-led strategy increased manufacturing capacity further, along with excess capacity in global commodity production.

zh: 其次，当时的刺激经济计划主要通过激增的债务来给项目融资。
en: Second, the stimulus was funded by a debt binge, especially among state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and local governments.

zh: 不仅新增大量国有企业和地方政府债务，民营企业债务也通过影子银行大增，因为中国企业很难进入股权形式的资本市场，导致中国的债务上升到占 GDP之比达 282 % 。
en: The private sector, too, built up debt, with its limited access to equity capital driving firms to the shadow banking sector. The result is a debt overhang of 282% of GDP.

zh: 简而言之，如今中国面临着与世界许多其他国家一样的债务通缩挑战。
en: In short, China now faces the same debt-deflation challenge that much of the rest of the world must address.

zh: 当然，关键在于如何应对这一挑战。
en: The question, of course, is how.

zh: 一些人认为答案与发达国家采取的措施类似：继续货币宽松及加码财政刺激，包括以较低利率、更长的期限、及更多的债务来置换现有的坏账，从而为调整经济结构赢得时间。
en: Some argue that the answer is more of the same: continued monetary easing and additional fiscal stimulus. Accumulating more debt (at lower interest rates) can indeed buy time for economic restructuring.

zh: 可是，如果政策执行者不能善用这段宝贵的时间来实施有效的结���改革，情况将会变得更糟。
en: But it will merely make matters worse if politicians do not use the time to implement effective reforms.

zh: 跳出债务陷阱必然会带来政治痛苦。
en: There is no politically painless way out of the debt trap.

zh: 事实上，这一过程的第一步是直面损失，包括会计意义上的损失和实质性的社会及经济损失。
en: Indeed, the first step in that process is to face up to losses, both in accounting and in real terms.

zh: 在短期，刺激技术进步和创新的措施虽然有利于创造新利润及复苏，但对就业的总影响也不一定是正面，因为创新也有可能对传统行业带来创造性的破坏。
en: In the short run, even efforts to spur technological progress and innovation, which might generate recovery through new profits, are likely to have a negative overall impact on employment, owing to the creative destruction of obsolete industries.

zh: 认识到这些复杂的挑战，一些人认为强推结构改革之道在于让利率体现信用风险。
en: Recognizing this, some argue that the way to force reform is to allow interest rates to reflect credit risks.

zh: 对中国来说，其去年年底的净国际投资头寸，也就是净对外资产，为盈余1.8万亿美元或GDP的17 % ， 这意味中国经济整体对外没有资不抵债的问题。 通过国内项目层次的债务/股权互换，也就是实施内部债务及股权结构重组来避免债务通缩是有可能的。
en: For China, whose net international investment position at the end of last year was a surplus of $1.8 trillion , or 17% of GDP, it will be possible to implement internal debt restructuring through debt/equity swaps at the project level.

zh: 当然财务重组后，应该对国有及民营行业都进行更深入的治理和结构改革。
en: Far-reaching governance and structural reforms in the state and private sectors should follow.

zh: 根据中国社会科学院的研究，2013年底中国中央和地方政府净资产为93万亿元，占GDP的164 % 。
en: According to the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences, the central and local governments’ net assets amounted to ¥93 trillion, or 164% of GDP, at the end of 2013.

zh: 国有企业和地方政府占了银行系统发行的信用总量的一大半。 因此，国有资产及债务结构的重组可以让民营投资者及职业管理团队通过改善总回报来增强资金的效率及项目的成功率。
en: Because SOEs and local governments accounted for more than half of the credit issued through the banking system, proper debt restructuring of state-owned assets would strengthen the projects they were funding, by allowing private or professional management teams to improve overall returns.

zh: 这些改革是非常关键的，因为归根结底摆脱债务通缩陷阱要求中国提升全要素生产率 — — 在这一方面，民营部门更适合充当推动者的角色。
en: Such reforms are crucial, because, ultimately, escaping the debt-deflation trap will require China to rejuvenate total factor productivity – an effort that the private sector is better equipped to lead.

zh: 北欧斯堪的纳维亚半岛国家的经验表明，国有资产未必阻碍生产率的提升，只要这些公共资产得到专业、透明的管理，比如将它们注入退休基金的投资组合中。
en: As the Scandinavian experience has shown, state ownership need not be an obstacle to productivity growth, provided that public assets are professionally and transparently managed, for example, by placing them in the portfolios of pension funds.

zh: 发达国家陷入债务通缩陷阱是因为它们不愿接受实体经济部门结构重组的政治痛苦，而是依赖金融工程和宽松的货币和财政政策来避免短痛。
en: The advanced countries have fallen into the debt-deflation trap because they were unwilling to accept the political pain of real-sector restructuring, relying instead on financial engineering and loose monetary and fiscal policies.

zh: 在这方面，中国的由党来领导重大改革的政治体制可能有其显而易见的优势：中国领导人能够做出政治上十分痛苦的决定而不必担心短期的选举。
en: Here, China’s one-party system provides a clear advantage: the country’s leaders can take politically painful decisions without worrying about the next election.

zh: 希望中国决策层可以果断去做那些应该做的治理及结构性改革。
en: One hopes that they do.

zh: 中国大逃亡
en: The Great Escape from China

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 自今年年初以来，人民币大幅贬值的预期已经成为了高悬于全球市场头上的达摩克利斯之剑。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Since 2016 began, the prospect of a major devaluation of China’s renminbi has been hanging over global markets like the Sword of Damocles.

zh: 从来没有任何一个政策不确定性的来源能对各方面的稳定造成如此重大的影响。
en: No other source of policy uncertainty has been as destabilizing.

zh: 少数观察家怀疑中国将在未来十年中的某个时间点被迫随人民币汇率自由浮动，问题则是在这一过渡期间会因为政治和经济规则发生冲突而产生多少乱象。
en: Few observers doubt that China will have to let the renminbi exchange rate float freely sometime over the next decade. The question is how much drama will take place in the interim, as political and economic imperatives collide.

zh: 一个在 2015 年还拥有6000 亿美元贸易顺差的国家竟然会担心货币走软，这似乎有点奇怪。
en: It might seem odd that a country running a $600 billion trade surplus in 2015 should be worried about currency weakness.

zh: 但众多因素结合在一起，包括经济增长放缓和逐步放宽对国外投资的限制，已经引发了巨大的资本外流。
en: But a combination of factors, including slowing economic growth and a gradual relaxation of restrictions on investing abroad, has unleashed a torrent of capital outflows.

zh: 按规定每个中国公民每年可以携带 5万美元出国。
en: Private citizens are now allowed to take up to $50,000 per year out of the country.

zh: 如果20个中国人中有一个采取此做法，中国的外汇储备就会灰飞烟灭。
en: If just one of every 20 Chinese citizens exercised this option, China’s foreign-exchange reserves would be wiped out.

zh: 同时现金充裕的中国企业公司也开始动用各种手段往外汇钱。
en: At the same time, China’s cash-rich companies have been employing all sorts of devices to get money out.

zh: 一个完全合法的做法是对外出借人民币并要求以外币偿还。
en: A perfectly legal approach is to lend in renminbi and be repaid in foreign currency.

zh: 不是所以法律方法是开具虚假或夸大贸易发票 — — 基本上是某种形式的洗钱。
en: A not-so-legal approach is to issue false or inflated trade invoices – essentially a form of money laundering.

zh: 比如一家中国出口可能会报一个比其实际价格更低的销售价格给美国的进口商，并要求对方偷偷把美元差额存入一个美国银行帐户 (而这些钱反过来可能会用于购买毕加索的名画 ) 。
en: For example, a Chinese exporter might report a lower sale price to an American importer than it actually receives, with the difference secretly deposited in dollars into a US bank account (which might in turn be used to purchase a Picasso).

zh: 如今中国企业收购了大量美国和欧洲的公司，洗钱过程甚至可以在企业内部完成。
en: Now that Chinese firms have bought up so many US and European companies, money laundering can even be done in-house.

zh: 而且这种做法根本算不上是中国人的发明。
en: The Chinese hardly invented this idea.

zh: 在二战后，几遭毁灭的欧洲执行了严苛的外汇管制，但平均下来流出的非法资本经常会占到贸易总额的10%或更多。
en: After World War II, when a ruined Europe was smothered in foreign-exchange controls, illegal capital flows out of the continent often averaged 10% of the value of trade or more.

zh: 作为世界上最大的贸易国之一，当逃离的动机变得足够强大时，中国几乎不可能保持对资本流出的严格限制。
en: As one of the world’s largest trading countries, it is virtually impossible for China to keep a tight lid on capital outflows when the incentives to leave become large enough.

zh: 事实上，尽有着庞大的贸易顺差，中国央行依然被迫大举出手干预以支撑汇率 — — 如此大手笔以至于外币储备实际上在2015 年减少了5000亿美元。
en: Indeed, despite the giant trade surplus, the People’s Bank of China has been forced to intervene heavily to prop up the exchange rate – so much so that foreign-currency reserves actually fell by $500 billion in 2015.

zh: 在这种漏洞百出的资本管制之下，3兆美元的中国货币战争资源不能无限期地守住城池。
en: With such leaky capital controls, China’s war chest of $3 trillion won’t be enough to hold down the fort indefinitely.

zh: 事实上，越多的人担心汇率下跌就越多人想把自己的钱立即弄出这个国家。
en: In fact, the more people worry that the exchange rate is going down, the more they want to get their money out of the country immediately.

zh: 这种恐惧反过来也成为了一直推动中国股市下挫的重要因素。
en: That fear, in turn, has been an important factor driving down the Chinese stock market.

zh: 还有很多市场判断认为中国将执行大规模的一次性贬值 — — 比如10 % — —来缓解人民币汇率的下行压力。
en: There is a lot of market speculation that the Chinese will undertake a sizable one-time devaluation, say 10%, to weaken the renminbi enough to ease downward pressure on the exchange rate.

zh: 但是，除了给唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）这类认为中国是不公平交易者的人提供佐证之外，对一个并不能得到金融市场完全信任的政府来说这将是非常危险的策略选项。
en: But, aside from providing fodder for the likes of Donald Trump, who believes that China is an unfair trader, this would be a very dangerous choice of strategy for a government that financial markets do not really trust.

zh: 主要风险是人民币大幅贬值将被理解为中国经济减速比人们所想得更严重，在这种情况下资金只会继续逃离。
en: The main risk is that a big devaluation would be interpreted as indicating that China’s economic slowdown is far more severe than people think, in which case money would continue to flee.

zh: 除非中国何时能学会如何发布真实可靠的经济数据，否则没有什么简单的方法能改善该国与市场的沟通。
en: There is no easy way to improve communication with markets until China learns how to produce credible economic data.

zh: 当中国 2015 的GDP 增长据报为6.9 % ， 低于7%的官方目标时引发了外界的极大关注。
en: It was a huge news story when China’s 2015 GDP growth was reported at 6.9%, just short of the official target of 7%.

zh: 这种差异本应是无关痛痒的。 但市场对其给予了极大重视，因为投资者相信如果连政府不能编造足够的数字以达到其目标，那么情况肯定是非常糟糕的。
en: This difference ought to be irrelevant, but markets have treated it with the utmost importance, because investors believe that things must be really bad if the government can’t rig the numbers enough to hit its target.

zh: 当局首先要启动的一个良好开端是成立一个经济学家委员会，核定出一整套更加现实和可信的过往国民生产总值数字，为未来发布更可信的国民生产总值数据铺路。
en: A good place for the authorities to start would be to establish a commission of economists to produce a more realistic and believable set of historical GNP figures, paving the way for more believable GNP figures going forward.

zh: 另外政府为缓解紧迫汇率压力的一个替代方案是让人民币和一揽子共13种货币挂钩，而不仅仅针对美元。
en: Instead, the government’s immediate idea for relieving exchange-rate pressure is to peg the renminbi to a basket of 13 currencies, instead of just to the US dollar.

zh: 这是一个理论上的好主意；然而在实践中挂钩一揽子货币会容易出现长期的透明度问题。
en: This is a good idea in theory; in practice, however, basket pegs tend to have chronic transparency problems.

zh: 此外，挂钩一揽子货币跟简单盯住美元所产生的大多数问题都是同样的。
en: Moreover, a basket peg shares most of the problems of a simple dollar peg.

zh: 实际上，欧元和日元在过去几年间已经相对美元的有所贬值。
en: True, the euro and yen have fallen against the dollar over the past couple of years.

zh: 如果美元在2016年贬值，挂钩一揽子货币就意味着人民币兑美元汇率还要上涨，而这可能不是什么好事。
en: If the dollar retreats in 2016, however, the basket peg implies a stronger renminbi-dollar rate, which might be unhelpful.

zh: 中国政府还表示计划更严厉打击非法资本流动；但把蛇赶回洞里又谈何容易呢？
en: The government has also indicated that it intends to clamp down more heavily on illegal capital flows; but it will not be easy to put that genie back in the bottle.

zh: 如果中国能在年景好的时候更大幅度地提升汇率灵活性的话，当前的情况可能会更加游刃有余，而我们有些人已经为此呼吁了超过十年。
en: Life would be a lot easier today if China had moved to a much greater degree of exchange-rate flexibility back when the going was good, as some of us had advised for more than a decade.

zh: 也许当局将能够在 2016 年控制住局面；但更有可能的是人民币将继续其震荡之路 — — 也让全球市场随之上下翻飞。
en: Maybe the authorities will be able to hold on in 2016; but it is more likely that the renminbi will continue its rocky ride – taking global markets along with it.

zh: 为什么国际上对中国发展逻辑没有共识？
en: Why There Is No “Beijing Consensus”

zh: 香港—四十年似乎已足以确定中国发展模式的基本逻辑。
en: HONG KONG – Four decades would seem to be plenty of time to identify the underlying logic of China’s development model.

zh: 但在1978年邓小平启动的改革开放已经取得巨大成就的今天，及西方新自由主义“华盛顿共识”不再时髦之时，国际上有关中国发展模式还没有形成“北京共识 ” 。
en: Yet, 40 years after Deng Xiaoping initiated the country’s “reform and opening up,” a “Beijing Consensus” – that is, a Chinese rival to the Western neoliberal Washington Consensus – has yet to be articulated.

zh: 40年来，中国致力于将其封闭的计划经济转变为开放的市场经济。
en: Over the years, China has worked to transform its closed, planned economy into a more open, market-based system.

zh: 工业取代农业成为增长的主要动力，而服务业也开始崛起；在技术方面，中国也从“山寨”转变为创新者。
en: Industry and, increasingly, services have replaced agriculture as the main drivers of growth, and the country has gone from technological copycat to global innovator.

zh: 中国还同时在应对多项严峻挑战，如过度负债、产能过剩、严重污染和官员腐败等等。
en: Meanwhile, China has tackled several difficult challenges, from excessive debt and overcapacity to severe pollution and official corruption.

zh: 这是一个非常复杂的过程。
en: This has been a highly complex process.

zh: 中国社科院经济学家蔡昉认为，只有从中国独特的历史、人口和地理角度出发，兼顾技术和全球发展趋势，才能理解这个过程。
en: According to China Academy of Social Sciences economist Cai Fang, it can be understood only in the context of the country’s unique history, demography, and geography, not to mention broader technological and global trends.

zh: 毕竟，所有这些因素都对中国的治理和制度有重要影响。
en: All of these factors have, after all, helped to shape China’s governance and institutions.

zh: 但老牌中国观察家比尔·奥佛霍尔特（Bill Overholt，他是第一批预言中国崛起的外国专家之一）在其新著《中国源于成功的危机 》 （ China’s Crisis of Success）中指出，中国的改革推动力是“恐惧和简单性 ” 。
en: Yet the veteran China watcher Bill Overholt – one of the first to predict China’s rise – argues in his latest book, China’s Crisis of Success, that the country’s reforms were driven by “fear and simplicity.”

zh: 他认为，同样的因素也驱动了东亚在1945年后的发展。
en: The same factors, he asserts, drove East Asia’s post-1945 development.

zh: 其他观察者，包括世界银行、经合组织以及哈佛大学费正清中国研究中心等，则意见不尽相同。
en: Other observers – including the World Bank, the OECD, and think tanks like Harvard’s Fairbank Center for China studies – can’t seem to agree on who is right.

zh: 外国观察家尚不习惯评估一个历史遗产、价值观、意识形态、制度和治理传统与西方如此大相径庭的经济体。
en: They are not accustomed to assessing an economy whose primary influences – including historical legacies, values and ideologies, and institutional and governance traditions – differ so profoundly from those of the West.

zh: 以治理问题为例。
en: Consider governance.

zh: 西方流行的经济思想认为，国家应该尽量不要干预市场。
en: Western economic dogma holds that the state should intervene in markets as little as possible.

zh: 但对中国领导精英来说，从概念上到实践中，国家是否能够及应该与市场分开都是个问题。
en: Yet, for China’s leaders, it is not clear whether the state can even be separated, conceptually or operationally, from the market.

zh: 几千年来，国家控制一直是中国默认的治理战略，强大的中央政府负责维稳、防止派系与地方势力制造混乱。
en: For thousands of years, state control was China’s default governance strategy, with a strong central government overseeing stability and preventing regional and factional rivalries from causing chaos.

zh: 因此，当中国尝试增加政府问责程度时，并没有完全倚赖市场制度，更没有采纳民主选举，而是通过改进监管来遏制权力滥用、以及允许更多的产品、资本、人力和信息流动。
en: So when China wanted to increase its leaders’ accountability, for example, it focused not on creating a market-based, much less democratic, system, but rather on introducing regulations to curb abuses of power and facilitate the flow of products, capital, people, and information.

zh: 在这一家长式治理传统的约束下，对中国增长至关重要的改革试验和适应性改良措施往往都是在地方层面展开的，因为地方政府拥有可观的，尽管并不是确定的，改革自主权。
en: Within the constraints of this paternalistic approach, the experimentation and adaptation that have been so crucial to China’s growth had to be carried out by local governments, which have enjoyed considerable, albeit uncertain, authority to do so.

zh: 其中的逻辑很简单，通过利用地方政府以及市场对管理本地发展的优势来实现各地间的竞争及地方增长，但又不破坏整体社会凝聚力和国家统一。
en: The idea was that, by using local-government (and market) expertise, China could generate growth without disturbing social cohesion or compromising national integrity.

zh: 但中国的治理远非完美无缺。
en: Yet Chinese governance has not exactly been beyond reproach.

zh: 在市场竞争的质量方面还存在大量问题，包括国有企业主导某些行业、监管的有效性、以及与国际标准、实践、及法律的差距等。
en: When it comes to the quality of market competition, questions about the state sector’s dominance, as well as the effectiveness of regulations and adherence to international laws, standards, and practices, have persisted.

zh: 而尽管中国政府十分擅长提供“硬”基础设施，如高速公路、铁路和机场等，但在发展软基础设施方面，如与教育、医疗、能源、环境和金融有关的基础设施，还有很长的路要走。
en: And while China’s government has proved adept at providing “hard” infrastructure, such as highways, railroads, and airports, it has far to go in developing soft infrastructure, such as that related to education, health care, energy, the environment, and finance.

zh: 因此中国一直面临着如何平衡国家与市场角色的问题，这关系到确保政府可以问责、市场有效竞争、国家为达到全球五分之一人口的国民提供充足的公共品。
en: So China continues to grapple with the question of how to balance the state and the market, in order to ensure accountability, market competition, and adequate provision of public goods for one-fifth of the world’s population.

zh: 而迅猛的技术进步、全球化及其各种副作用、以及地缘政治因素也让挑战变得更加艰巨。
en: Compounding the challenge are rapid technological change, globalization (and the backlash against it), and geopolitical considerations.

zh: 但西方也没有能够有效证明其自由市场方针的有效性。
en: But it is not as if the West has proved definitively that its free-market approach works.

zh: 进入二十世纪后，政府的角色，如以公共部门占GDP之比以及监管民间活动法规的深度和复杂度来衡量，几乎在每个经济体都在不断扩张。
en: The state’s role – measured according to the public sector’s share of GDP, for example, and the depth and complexity of laws governing private activities – has been expanding in almost every economy since the beginning of the twentieth century.

zh: 特别是美国，它提供了一个很有用的基准。
en: The United States, in particular, provides a useful benchmark.

zh: 和中国一样，它是一个大陆型巨大经济体，也是全球诸多领域的领先标杆，包括科技、国防和研发等。
en: Like China, it is a continental economy. But it also represents the global gold standard in many fields, including technology, defense, and research and development.

zh: 与中国中央集权的历史遗产相反，美国的历史经验给其公民和领导人带来的影响主要是自由主义使命，包括自由市场和地方自治。
en: Contrary to China’s statist legacy, America’s historical experience has instilled in citizens and leaders a devotion to liberty, including free markets, and local autonomy.

zh: 美国联邦政府的规模和权力直到20世纪30年代才开始缓慢扩大，当时，为了应对大萧条，美国实施了罗斯福新政，包括大量的联邦计划、公共工程项目以及金融改革和监管。
en: The US federal government’s size and power grew only very slowly until the 1930s, when the New Deal – which included federal programs, public works projects, and financial reforms and regulations – was implemented in response to the Great Depression.

zh: 二战结束后，联邦政府再度扩张，这体现了美国的全球新霸主地位及其中产阶级的崛起，其在很大程度上也要归因于罗斯福新政对工会和居屋所有权的支持。
en: The US federal government expanded again during and after WWII, reflecting the country’s new global hegemony and the prosperity of its middle class (created in no small part by the New Deal’s support for unionization and home ownership).

zh: 联邦政府在国防、外交政策、医疗和社会保障等领域的角色也越来越重要。
en: The government assumed a larger role in areas ranging from defense and foreign policy to health care and social security.

zh: 尽管联邦政府在某些领域加强了监管，美国仍然主要依赖市场来发展经济，导致了不平等加剧、公共基础设施恶化、财政赤字和债务水平不可持续。
en: But even as the federal government increased regulation in some areas, the US remained highly reliant on the market, resulting in rising inequality, the deterioration of public infrastructure, and an unsustainable fiscal deficit and debt.

zh: 2008年金融危机所引发的全球衰退加剧了国际上对“华盛顿共识”的质疑。
en: The global recession triggered by the 2008 financial crisis intensified growing doubts about the Washington Consensus.

zh: 可以说，美国的一些最根本性的挑战，如遏制不平等、稳定财政和金融、确保环境可持续等，和中国面临的挑战是一模一样的，而两国在发展模式上都没有明确的、被证明的“共识”可以充当指引。
en: So some of America’s most fundamental challenges – such as reducing inequality, supporting stable fiscal and financial conditions, and ensuring environmental sustainability – are the same as China’s, and neither country has a clear and proven “consensus” to guide it.

zh: 在这样的背景下，中美合作提供全球公共品，特别是在维护世界和平方面，应该是可能的。
en: Against this background, cooperation to deliver global public goods – including peace – should be possible.

zh: 关键在于双方需要共同努力致力于一些双方认可的共同目标，同时在某些意识形态原则上同意保留双方还存在的分歧。
en: The key is for the two sides to work toward common goals, while agreeing to disagree on certain ideological tenets.

zh: 在这方面，美国需要认识到全球合作不是零和博弈，中国的崛起不需要视为威胁。
en: Here, the US needs to recognize that global cooperation is not a zero-sum game, and that China’s rise need not be viewed as a threat.

zh: 相反，中国与印度等其它新兴经济体的成长是能够为全球再平衡做出贡献的，并可以真正加强全球经济和地缘政治的稳定性。
en: On the contrary, China – along with other emerging economies, such as India – can contribute to a global rebalancing that actually strengthens economic and geopolitical stability.

zh: 超越发展援助
en: Development Beyond Aid

zh: 北京—今年的国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行春季年会静悄悄地过去了，但有理由认为全球经济仍然面临一些忧虑。
en: BEIJING – Despite the apparent tranquility of this year’s spring meetings of the International Monetary Fund and World Bank, there are reasons to be concerned about the global economy.

zh: 即将到来的英国“硬”脱欧和美国总统特朗普的反全球化日程正在制造经济不确定性，并将持续一段时间。
en: The United Kingdom’s impending “hard” Brexit from the European Union and US President Donald Trump’s anti-globalization agenda are creating economic uncertainty, and will continue to do so for some time.

zh: 与特朗普相反，中国国家主席习近平坚决捍卫全球化，并为制造全球公共品、加强互通性和创造发展中国家工作岗位投入新的资本。
en: In contrast to Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping has come to the defense of globalization, and made new capital available for creating global pubic goods, enhancing connectivity, and creating jobs in developing countries.

zh: 60多个国家对习近平的“一带一路”计划表示欢迎，其中28国首脑将在5月14日来到北京参加一带一路峰会。
en: More than 60 countries have welcomed Xi’s “One Belt, One Road” initiative, and 28 heads of state will attend an OBOR summit in Beijing on May 14.

zh: 那么，中国为什么要追求这个被许多国家，特别是发展中国家所接受的宏大愿景？
en: So, what is China’s rationale for pursuing this grandiose vision – one that so many countries, especially in the developing world, have embraced?

zh: 在我们的新书《超越发展援助》中，我们指出，官方发展援助（ODA）并不总是需要享有特殊对待，并且提出了要“超越援助 ” ， 走向更广泛的包括贸易和投资在内的方针 — — 比如中国所采取的方针。
en: In our new book, Going Beyond Aid: Development Cooperation for Structural Transformation, we argue that official development aid (ODA) need not always be concessional, and make the case for going “beyond aid,” toward a broader approach – like that taken by China – that includes trade and investment.

zh: 目前，经合组织对ODA的定义甚至不包过一些便利受助国结构改革的更加有效的工具，如权益投资和大额无优惠基础设施贷款等。
en: Right now, the OECD’s definition of ODA does not even include some of the more effective instruments for facilitating structural transformation in recipient countries, such as equity investment and large non-concessional loans for infrastructure.

zh: 通过将援助与贸易和投资结合起来，援助国和受助国都可以从中获益。
en: By combining aid with trade and investment, donor and recipient countries alike can benefit.

zh: 比如，南南发展合作采取所有这三类活动充分利用受助国的经济优势。
en: For example, the South-South development cooperation uses all three activities to capitalize on recipient countries’ economic strengths.

zh: 这使得南南发展合作避免了标准ODA模式中合作国家所遇到的瓶颈，即援助与贸易和私人投资相隔离，从而阻碍国家利用自身比较优势。
en: This allows the SSDC to avoid the bottlenecks in partner countries that one sees under the standard ODA model, which separates aid from trade and private investment – and thus impedes countries from exploiting their comparative advantages.

zh: 在我们的书中，我们通过新结构经济学的视角看待这一问题。
en: In our book, we look at this topic through the lens of New Structural Economics.

zh: 新结构经济学将经济发展视为技术、产业以及软硬基础设施的持续的结构变化过程 — — 所有这些因素都能提高劳动生产率，进而提高人均收入。
en: NSE treats modern economic development as a process of continuous structural change in technologies, industries, and hard and soft infrastructure – all of which increases labor productivity, and thus per capita income.

zh: 新结构经济学认为，低收入国家推动动态增长和发展的最有效、最可持续的方法是发展它具有潜在比较优势的部门：即生产成本较低，但交易成本因为软硬基础设施不足而较高的部门。
en: According to NSE, the most effective and sustainable approach for a low-income country to jumpstart dynamic growth and development is to develop those sectors in which it has latent comparative advantages: where production costs are low, but transaction costs are high due to inadequate hard and soft infrastructure.

zh: 政府可以通过建设特别经济区或产业园、改善基础设施、加强这些区域的整体营商环境吸引力等方式来帮助降低交易成本。
en: Governments can help to reduce transaction costs by creating special economic zones or industrial parks, improving infrastructure, and making the overall business environment more attractive in those enclaves.

zh: 采用这一方法，发展中国家可以实现动态增长，形成就业创造和贫困减少的良性循环，即使其总体基础设施和营商环境仍然有所欠缺。
en: With this approach, a developing country can grow dynamically, and create a virtuous circle of job creation and poverty reduction, even if its overall infrastructure and business environment are still lacking.

zh: 此外，中国、巴西和印度等大型新兴市场经济体可以利用它们在基础设施和轻制造业方面的比较优势帮助其他国家。
en: Moreover, large emerging-market economies such as China, Brazil, and India can use their comparative advantages in infrastructure and light manufacturing to help others.

zh: 对中国来说，就是要牢记《论语》中的话“己欲立而立人，己欲达而达人。 ”
en: For China, this is in keeping with a Confucian dictum: “One who wishes himself to be successful must also help others to be successful; one who wishes to develop himself must also help others to develop.”

zh: 中国在基础设施建设方面拥有显而易见的比较优势，这来自其低廉的劳动力成本（中国工地工头的成本是经合组织国家的八分之一）以及使其能够实现其他国家无从实现的规模经济的巨大的国内市场。
en: China has a clear comparative advantage in infrastructure construction, owing to its lower labor costs (the cost of a project site foreman in China is one-eighth that of OECD countries) and vast domestic market, which have enabled it to achieve economies of scale that other countries simply cannot.

zh: 因此，中国高铁总建设成本只有工业化国家的三分之二。
en: Consequently, the overall construction cost for high-speed rail in China is two-thirds of what it is in industrial countries.

zh: 但中国在97个子部门中的46个的比较优势 — — 特别是制造业 — — 也能让其他发展中国家获益。
en: But China’s comparative advantages in 46 of 97 subsectors – particularly in manufacturing – benefit other developing countries, too.

zh: 随着中国劳动力成本的上升，劳动密集型产业正在流向工资更低的发展中国家，创造了数百万个工作机会。
en: As labor costs in China rise, labor-intensive industries are relocating to lower-wage developing countries, providing millions of job opportunities.

zh: 比如，华坚鞋业、C&H服饰和JD集团（一家成衣制造商）目前分别在埃塞俄比亚、卢旺达和坦桑尼亚的特别经济区设厂经营。
en: For example, the Huajian Shoemaking Company, C&H Garments, and China JD Group (an apparel maker), are now operating in special economic zones in, respectively, Ethiopia, Rwanda, and Tanzania.

zh: 除了输出其比较优势，中国也在部署“耐心资本 ” （ patient capital ） ， 这种投资期限往往达到十年或更长。
en: In addition to exporting its comparative advantages, China also deploys “patient capital,” which has a maturity of ten years or more.

zh: 在一篇最近发表的文章中，我们将耐心资本界定为“关系”投资，即投资者对一国的发展有着长期利益。
en: In a recently published paper, we conceptualize patient capital as an investment in a “relationship,” whereby an investor has a long-term stake in a country’s development.

zh: 耐心资本所有者类似于权益投资者，但他们愿意在一段相当长的时间里让钱“沉”在实体部门。
en: Patient-capital owners are like equity investors, but they are willing to “sink” money in the real sector for an extended period of time.

zh: 耐心资本所有者也更加愿意，同时也更有能力承担风险。
en: Patient-capital owners are also more willing, and better able, to take risks.

zh: 在下图中，我们看到一国净外国资产头寸与其长期导向强相关。
en: In the chart below, we show that a country’s net-foreign-asset position correlates strongly with its long-term orientation.

zh: 另一方面，短期导向、储蓄低的国家，经外国资产头寸往往出现恶化，同时外债高企。
en: On the other hand, net-foreign-asset positions of countries with a short-term orientation and a low savings rate tend to deteriorate, while their foreign debts mounts.

zh: 耐心资本在基础设施融资中非常重要，因为它往往伴随技术和管理知识，有助于改善全球连通性、加速发展。
en: Patient capital plays an important role in infrastructure financing, because it is often accompanied by technological and administrative know-how, which helps to improve global connectivity and accelerate development.

zh: 目前，中国巨大的耐心资本储备被用于其国内项目的融资。
en: So far, China’s large reserve of patient capital has been used to finance its own domestic projects.

zh: 但随着更多中国企业和银行“走向全球 ” ， 输出的耐心资本也会越来越多。
en: But it will increasingly be exported as more Chinese enterprises and banks “go global.”

zh: 事实上，中国有望很快成为世界最大的净债权国，其净外国资产的一部分将以耐心资本的形式出现，适合在全球改善基础设施、发展制造业、创造就业岗位。
en: In fact, China could soon become the world’s largest net creditor, and a portion of its net foreign assets will take the form of patient capital that is suitable for improving infrastructure, developing manufacturing sectors, and creating jobs around the world.

zh: 2015年以来，发展金融开始较少来自传统援助，较多来自新兴经济体的发展融资机构、开发银行和主权财富基金。
en: Since 2015, development finance has started to come less from traditional aid, and more from development-finance institutions, development banks, and sovereign wealth funds in emerging economies.

zh: 比如，中国在2016—2018年间为非洲提供了600亿美元发展融资 — — 其中大部分是耐心资本。
en: China, for example, has committed $60 billion in development financing to Africa for the 2016-2018 period – much of it patient capital.

zh: 随着与全球北方和南方合作伙伴开展合作，中国和其他新兴经济体也在从双边主义转向多边主义。
en: China and other emerging economies are also shifting from bilateralism to multilateralism, by working with partners from the global North and South.

zh: 新的南方主导的机构，如亚洲基础设施投资银行和新开发银行，在与老牌多边开发银行合作的过程中学习如何成为更好的合作者，也为全球发展措施添加动力。
en: As new South-led institutions such as the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank and the New Development Bank work with established multilateral development banks, they are learning to be better partners, and adding momentum to global development efforts.

zh: 此外，中国也在试图从发展伙伴身上学习，以改善自身的治理、劳动和环境标准。
en: China, moreover, is trying to learn from its partners so that it can improve its own governance, labor, and environmental standards.

zh: 这一双向过程催生了新思想、新理论和新概念 — — 我们的书就是其中之一。
en: And this two-way process is giving rise to new ideas, theories, and concepts – our book being one of them.

zh: 中国欣然接受其全球角色应该受到各国的欢迎。
en: China’s embrace of a global role should be welcomed.

zh: 我们对南北合作确保全人类的和平与未来感到谨慎乐观。
en: We are cautiously optimistic that the North and South can work together to ensure peace and prosperity for all.

zh: 中国，晋身数字化巨头
en: China, the Digital Giant

zh: 上海 — — 中国已经稳固奠定了自身作为消费者导向型数字技术全球领导者的地位。
en: SHANGHAI – China has firmly established itself as a global leader in consumer-oriented digital technologies.

zh: 它是全球最大的电子商务市场，占据了全球零售电商40％以上的交易额，在自动驾驶汽车，3D打印，机器人，无人机和人工智能等领域，其风险投资规模位列全球三甲。
en: It is the world’s largest e-commerce market, accounting for more than 40% of global transactions, and ranks among the top three countries for venture capital investment in autonomous vehicles, 3D printing, robotics, drones, and artificial intelligence (AI).

zh: 全世界1/3的独角兽企业（估值超过10亿美元的创业公司）都来自中国，同时，中国科技企业的运算效率依然保持着世界纪录。
en: One in three of the world’s unicorns (start-ups valued at more than $1 billion) is Chinese, and the country’s cloud providers hold the world record for computing efficiency.

zh: 虽然中国的总体服务贸易仍呈现逆差，但近年来，在数字服务贸易方面，中国已实现每年150亿美元的顺差。
en: While China runs a trade deficit in services overall, it has lately been running a trade surplus in digital services of up to $15 billion per year.

zh: 推动中国数字经济取得如此瞩目进步的是阿里巴巴、百度和腾讯等互联网巨头，这些巨头正在大规模地将其服务商业化，为全球带来新的商业模式。
en: Powering China’s impressive progress in the digital economy are Internet giants like Alibaba, Baidu, and Tencent, which are commercializing their services on a massive scale, and bringing new business models to the world.

zh: 这三家公司在各自领域分别拥有5~9亿月活跃用户。
en: Together, these three companies have 500-900 million active monthly users in their respective sectors.

zh: 而它们的崛起则得益于宽松 — — 或者更准确地说，是略显滞后 — — 的监管。
en: Their rise has been facilitated by light – or, perhaps more accurate, late – regulation.

zh: 比如，监管机构在支付宝推出网上转账服务整整11年后才开始对转账额度进行了限制。
en: For example, regulators put a cap on the value of online money transfers a full 11 years after Alipay introduced the service.

zh: 如今，这些互联网巨头正利用其强势地位不断投资中国的数字生态系统，以及那些层出不穷的，持续拓展着数字生态系统定义的创业群体。
en: Now, these Internet firms are using their positions to invest in China’s digital ecosystem – and in the emerging cadre of tenacious entrepreneurs that increasingly define it.

zh: 阿里巴巴，百度和腾讯总共投资了30%的本土领先创业公司，例如滴滴出行（500亿美元 ） ， 美团-点评（300亿美元）和京东（560亿美元 ） 。
en: Alibaba, Baidu, and Tencent together fund 30% of China’s top start-ups, such as Didi Chuxing ($50 billion), Meituan-Dianping ($30 billion), and JD.com ($56 billion).

zh: 凭借全球规模最大的本土市场以及充足的风险投资，中国不少企业已经摆脱了“抄袭效仿者”的帽子，转型成为强大的创新企业。
en: With the world’s largest domestic market and plentiful venture capital, China’s old “copy-cat” entrepreneurs have transformed themselves into innovation powerhouses.

zh: 他们在这个全球竞争最激烈的市场上摸爬滚打，学会发展出复杂的商业模式（如淘宝的免费增值模式 ） ， 并建立了坚固的壁垒以保护自身业务（比如美团-点评就创建了一个终端到终端的餐饮手机app，就连送餐服务也一并涵盖在内了 ） 。
en: They fought like gladiators in the world’s most competitive market, learned to develop sophisticated business models (such as Taobao’s freemium model), and built impregnable moats to protect their businesses (for example, Meituan-Dianping created an end-to-end food app, including delivery).

zh: 因此，中国创业企业的估值往往会比西方同行高出许多倍。 此外，中国在一些特定领域居于全球领先地位。
en: As a result, the valuation of Chinese innovators is many times higher than that of their Western counterparts.

zh: 从直播（例如Musical.ly这款唇音同步和视频分享手机app）到共享单车（摩拜和ofo在中国已经拥有每天超过5000万人次的骑乘量，并正在向国外扩张 ） ， 中国正引领全球趋势。
en: Moreover, China leads the world in some sectors, from livestreaming (one example is Musical.ly, a lip-syncing and video-sharing app) to bicycle sharing (Mobike and Ofo exceed 50 million rides per day in China, and are now expanding abroad).

zh: 更值得一提的是，中国处于移动支付的前沿。 可以进行点对点交易的中国手机用户多达6亿人，而且交易过程几乎完全免费。
en: Most important, China is at the frontier of mobile payments, with more than 600 million Chinese mobile users able to conduct peer-to-peer transactions with nearly no fees.

zh: 中国的移动支付基础设施 — — 其处理的交易量远比美国的第三方移动支付要多得多 — — 即将成为更多创新活动的平台。
en: China’s mobile-payment infrastructure – which already handles far more transactions than the third-party mobile-payment market in the United States – will become a platform for many more innovations.
