zh: 随着中国企业的技术能力日益提高，中国的市场优势正在转变为数据优势，这对于人工智能的发展至关重要。
en: As Chinese firms become increasingly technically capable, the country’s market advantage is turning into a data advantage – critical to support the development of AI.

zh: 中国企业旷视科技（Face ++）最近完成了4.6亿美元的C轮融资，这是截至目前人工智能领域规模最大的一笔融资。
en: The Chinese firm Face++ recently raised $460 million, the largest amount ever for an AI company.

zh: 科大讯飞（一家市值140亿美元的语音识别技术企业）以及海康威视（市值500亿美元的视频监控企业）也都是在各自领域中全球最有价值的企业。
en: DJI (a $14 billion consumer drone company), iFlyTek (a $14 billion voice recognition company), and Hikvision (a $50 billion video-surveillance company) are the world’s most valuable firms in their respective domains.

zh: 在中国市场，另外一个重要的发展趋势则是“线上线下融合（OMO ） ” — — 这也是除人工智能之外，创新工场另一个重点投资的方向。
en: Another important developing trend in China is “online merging with offline” (OMO) – a trend that, along with AI, Sinovation Ventures is betting on.

zh: 物理世界正在变得数字化，企业可以掌握消费者所处的位置 、 ， 移动路径和身份识别，并将这些数据上传，用于塑造在线体验。
en: The physical world becomes digitized, with companies detecting a person’s location, movements, and identity, and then transmitting the data so that it can help shape online experiences.

zh: 举个例子，OMO商店将配备可以无缝识别客户身份及潜在消费行为的传感器，就如同目前电子商务网站可以做到的一样。
en: For example, OMO stores will be equipped with sensors that can identify customers and discern their likely behavior as seamlessly as e-commerce websites do now.

zh: 同样，OMO语言学习可以将远程授课的国外教师、协助维持课堂气氛的本地助教，纠正发音的自主软件以及批改作业和考试的自主硬件结合在一起。
en: Similarly, OMO language learning will combine native teachers lecturing remotely, local assistants keeping the atmosphere fun, autonomous software correcting pronunciation, and autonomous hardware grading homework and tests.

zh: 通过重建其线下基础设施，中国可以确保其在OMO领域的领先地位。
en: With China in a position to rebuild its offline infrastructure, it can secure a leading position in OMO.

zh: 但是，即便中国在消费行业数字化方面处于领先地位，数字技术的商业化应用总体仍然有所滞后。
en: Yet, even as China leads the way in digitizing consumer industries, business adoption of digital technologies has lagged.

zh: 不过这一状况正在快速改观。
en: This may be about to change.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院的一项新研究发现，三大数字化推动力 — — 去中介化（摒弃中间人 ） ， 分散化（将庞大的资产分解为多个组成部分）和非物质化（从物理形式转变为虚拟形式 ） — —到2030年，或可转变（与创造）10~45%的行业总收入。
en: New McKinsey Global Institute research finds that three digital forces – disintermediation (cutting out the middle man), disaggregation (separating processes into component parts), and dematerialization (shifting from physical to electronic form) – could account for (or create) 10-45% of the industry revenue pool by 2030.

zh: 那些成功抓住这一商机的企业，很可能将快速发展壮大，其规模将足以大到影响全球数字版图，并激励更多在海外的数字创业者。
en: Those actors that successfully capitalize on this shift are likely to be large enough to influence the global digital landscape, inspiring digital entrepreneurs far beyond China’s borders.

zh: 价值将从目前那些反应迟缓的企业，转向那些敏捷的、建立在全新商业模式之上的数字挑战者身上；同时价值将从价值链的一部分转移到另一部分。
en: Value will shift from slow-moving incumbents to nimble digital attackers, armed with new business models, and from one part of the value chain to another.

zh: 大规模的创造性颠覆将铲除中国行业效率较低的状况，从而帮助中国经济的全球竞争力跻身新梯队。
en: Large-scale creative destruction will root out inefficiencies and vault China to a new echelon of global competitiveness.

zh: 中国政府对中国作为世界数字化强国的未来有着宏伟的规划。
en: China’s government has grand plans for the country’s future as a digital world power.

zh: 在国务院领导的“大众创新、万众创业”号召之下，中国已经新建了8000多个项目孵化器和加速器。
en: The State Council-led Mass Entrepreneurship and Innovation Program has resulted in more than 8,000 incubators and accelerators.

zh: 政府的“创业投资引导基金”为风险投资和私募股权投资者提供了总额达274亿美元的资金 — — 这是一项拥有特殊赎回奖励措施的被动性投资。
en: The government’s Guiding Fund program has provided a total of $27.4 billion to venture capital and private equity investors – a passive investment, but with special redemption incentives.

zh: 目前中国政府鼓励各方资源，计划投入1800亿美元在未来7年内建成本国的5G移动网络，同时支持量子技术的发展。
en: The authorities are now mobilizing resources to invest $180 billion in building China’s 5G mobile network over the next seven years, and are supporting the development of quantum technology.

zh: 国务院同时还出台了发展人工智能技术的指导方针，目标是到2030年使中国成为全球人工智能创新中心。
en: The State Council has also issued guidelines for developing AI technologies, with the goal of making China a global AI innovation center by 2030.

zh: 目前正在建设中的雄安地区可能成为第一个专为自主驾驶车辆设计的“智慧城市 ” 。
en: Xiongan, now under construction, may be the first “smart city” designed for autonomous vehicles.

zh: 而广东省政府则制定了到2020年实现自动化覆盖率达到80%的宏伟目标。
en: In Guangdong Province, the government has set an ambitious target of 80% automation by 2020.

zh: 这样的愿望必然会在劳动力市场激起波澜，首先将影响日常的白领工作（如客户服务和电话营销 ） ， 其次是是常规的蓝领工作（如流水线作业 ） ， 最后甚至会影响到一些非常规工作（比如驾驶甚至放射影像诊断 ） 。
en: Such aspirations will inevitably disrupt the labor market, beginning with routine white-collar jobs (such as customer service and telemarketing), followed by routine blue-collar jobs (such as assembly line work), and finally affecting some non-routine jobs (such as driving or even radiology).

zh: 最近一项麦肯锡全球研究院研究发现，在一个高速实现自动化的情境下，约有0.82~1.02亿的中国劳动者需要重新找一份工作。
en: Recent MGI research found that in a rapid-automation scenario, some 82-102 million Chinese workers would need to switch jobs.

zh: 对失业者的再培训，以及防范数字巨头攫取扼杀创新的垄断地位，都将是中国政府面临的重大挑战。
en: Retraining the displaced will be a major challenge for China’s government, as will preventing the major digital players from securing innovation-stifling monopolies.

zh: 但政府鉴定拥抱新兴数字时代、实施扶持性政策以及避免过度监管的意愿，已经使中国在数字化浪潮中占据了明显优势。
en: But the government’s readiness to embrace the emerging digital age, pursuing supportive policies and avoiding excessive regulation, has already placed the country at a significant advantage.

zh: 中国的危险数字日程
en: China’s Dangerous Digital Agenda

zh: 华盛顿/布鲁塞尔—中国电子商务巨头阿里巴巴公司去年底在纽约证券交易所挂牌上市，一夜之间成为世界第17大公开交易公司，市值2,300亿美元 — — 比亚马逊、eBay和Facebook都要大。
en: WASHINGTON, DC/BRUSSELS – When the Chinese e-commerce juggernaut Alibaba listed on the New York Stock Exchange late last year, it became the world's 17th largest publicly traded company overnight, with a market capitalization of $230 billion – larger than Amazon, eBay, or Facebook.

zh: 但是，欧洲似乎遗漏了这个消息。
en: Europe, however, seems to have missed the news.

zh: 事实上，欧盟并没有对中国的数字崛起做出反应，而是心安理得地享受着美国平台的全球成功 — — 如亚马逊、Facebook 和谷歌 — — 甚至威胁要对它们使用惩罚措施。
en: Indeed, instead of responding to China's digital rise, the European Union has remained fixated on the global success of American platforms like Amazon, Facebook, and Google, even threatening punitive actions against them.

zh: 该决议要求“不得将搜索引擎与其他商业服务绑定 ” 。
en: The resolution called for “unbundling search engines from other commercial services."

zh: 但大量证据表明，对欧洲来说，真正的竞争挑战将来自东方特别是中国。 中国正在采取保护主义和扩张主义方针确保其未来数字主宰力。
en: But there is mounting evidence that the real competitive challenge for Europe will come from the East, especially China, which is taking a protectionist and expansionist approach to securing its future digital dominance.

zh: 如果欧盟和美国不联合起来在这方面限制中国，就有可能让竞技场朝基于直接与西方最大两个经济体所共有的基本价值相冲突的原则的朝监管制度洞开。
en: If the European Union and the United States do not collaborate to limit China on this front, they risk leaving the playing field wide open to a regulatory regime based on principles that directly controvert the fundamental values the West's two largest economies share.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国在互联网经济中大获成功。
en: There is no doubting China's success in the Internet economy.

zh: 包括阿里巴巴在内，中国已拥有27家所谓的怪兽公司（在经过IPO、销售或公开宣布的融资轮后市值超过10亿美元 ） ， 而欧洲只有21家。
en: With Alibaba, China has 27 so-called unicorns (companies that are valued at $1 billion following an IPO, sale, or publicly declared round of funding), whereas Europe has only 21.

zh: 中国还拥有四家全球访问量前十名的网站。
en: China also boasts four of the world's top ten most visited websites.

zh: 中国最大搜索引擎百度预测，不出六年，其收入的一半将来自中国以外地区。
en: Baidu, the country's leading search engine, anticipates that half of its revenues will come from outside of China within just six years.

zh: 平心而论，在数字领域中国仍远远落后于美国，美国拥有79家怪兽公司。
en: To be sure, China still lags far behind the US, with its 79 unicorns, in the digital sphere.

zh: 但它给该行业的开放性和竞争带来了更大的挑战，因为中国领导人依靠重商主义和保护主义来追求高科技目标。
en: But it poses a greater threat to the sector's openness and competitiveness, as its leaders rely on mercantilism and protectionism to further their high-tech goals.

zh: 比如，中国国务院意欲确保到2030年中国在半导体生产方面领先全球，该计划将向中国所有的企业提供至少200亿欧元政府补贴，并采取歧视性采购挤出外国竞争者。
en: For example, the Chinese State Council's plan to ensure that the country leads the world in semiconductor production by 2030 will involve the provision of at least €20 billion ($22.6 billion) in government subsidies to Chinese-owned firms, as well as discriminatory procurement to shut out their foreign competitors.

zh: 类似地，中国政府承诺在五年内每年投入6,400亿欧元给包括信息和通讯技术在内的七大“战略性新兴产业 ” 。
en: Similarly, the Chinese government has committed €640 billion annually for five years to just seven “strategic emerging industries," including information and communications technology.

zh: 此外，中国利用技术标准作为市场壁垒，同时用反垄断法打击美国和欧洲公司。
en: Moreover, China employs technology standards as a market barrier, while using its anti-monopoly laws to harass US and European companies.

zh: 此外中国还窃取欧洲和美国的知识产权，包括通过政府支持的黑客行为入侵欧洲公司计算机。 中国对公开竞争的威胁更是众人皆知。
en: Add to that the theft of valuable European and American intellectual property, including through the government-backed hacking of European companies' computers, and the threat that China poses to open competition could not be clearer.

zh: 但问题并不局限于中国。
en: But the problem is not confined to China's borders.

zh: “北京共识 ” — —中国的中央集权政策方针，通常与欧洲和美国所广泛支持的亲市场的“华盛顿共识”针锋相对 — — 正在促使越来越多的国家采取给予本国优秀科技公司特殊地位和补贴的政策。
en: The “Beijing consensus" – China's statist policy approach, often contrasted with the “Washington consensus" of market-friendly policies broadly favored by Europe and the US – is inspiring a growing number of countries to shower domestic tech champions with privileges and subsidies.

zh: 也许问题更大的是中国的影响正在刺激许多国家对互联网分割的支持 — — 将全球互联网分割为更小的封闭国家网络，其中包括巴西、俄罗斯和土耳其等重要国家，甚至在欧洲也有同情者。
en: Perhaps more problematic, Chinese influence is fueling support for Internet balkanization – the splintering of the global Internet into smaller, closed national networks – in a number of countries, including key players like Brazil, Russia, and Turkey, and even has sympathizers in Europe.

zh: 这一数据地方化看上去人畜无害，特别是在美国国家安全局大肆监控等丑闻曝光后作为合理应对措施出现的情况下。
en: Such data localization may sound harmless, especially when it is presented as a legitimate response to revelations of far-reaching surveillance by the likes of the US National Security Agency.

zh: 此外，这也是决策者正在尝试的事情 — — 承诺“安全”的国家云。
en: And, in promising a “secure" national cloud, this is precisely what policymakers are attempting to do.

zh: 但这些都不能作为破坏当代最伟大创新和最有效经济增长引擎的借口，特别是考虑到黑客行为可能并且确实在世界各地都有发生。
en: But those are weak grounds for undermining one of today's greatest innovations and most effective economic-growth engines, especially given that hacking can, and does, occur from anywhere.

zh: 事实上，最恶劣的网络犯罪正是来自这些在分割运动中一马当先的国家，包括中国和俄罗斯。
en: Indeed, the gravest cyber crimes originate from precisely those countries, including China and Russia, that are leading the balkanization movement.

zh: 大西洋两岸斤斤计较于相对较小的问题，这最有利于加速中国的数字崛起。
en: The surest way to accelerate China's digital rise is a transatlantic falling out over relatively small issues.

zh: 不管是数据、版权、物联网还是隐私，欧盟和美国都必须采取共同方法 — — 基于民主、法治和言论自由等共同价值。
en: Whether it is data or copyright, the Internet of Things, or privacy, the EU and the US must agree on a common path – based on shared values like democracy, the rule of law, and freedom of speech.

zh: 否则，中国很快就会在这一世界增长最快的经济部门赢得贸易优势。
en: Otherwise, China will soon be dictating the terms of trade of the world's fastest-growing economic sector.

zh: 如果开放多元社会不站出来捍卫开放互联网和基于市场的贸易，还有谁会站出来？
en: If open and pluralistic societies do not stand up for an open Internet and market-based trade, who will?

zh: 中国的数字经济革命红利
en: China’s New Digital Dividend

zh: 香港—在过去四十年中，中国从低工资供应商起步，演变为全球价值链中的最重要的三个超级链接环之一 — — 另外两个环是美国和德国。
en: HONG KONG – Over the past four decades, China has gone from being a low-wage supplier to one of the three most important links in the global value chain, alongside the United States and Germany.

zh: 尽管越来越多的人担心中国的企业债务（目前接近GDP的170 % ） 及其摆脱中等收入陷阱的能力，但迅速的数字经济革命将让中国经济继续在价值链中向上攀升。
en: Despite growing concerns about China’s corporate debt – which is now close to 170% of GDP – and its ability to escape the middle-income trap, rapid digitization will allow the Chinese economy to continue moving up the value chain.

zh: 在近40年前采取了战略性的“开放”政策之后，中国为世界提供了充足的廉价土地和劳动力，这让它实现了在消费品制造业领域的规模经济。
en: Following its strategic “opening up” almost 40 years ago, China provided an abundant source of cheap land and labor, which enabled it to achieve economies of scale in consumer manufacturing.

zh: 随着中国跻身中等收入国家行列，其本身也成了全球主要消费市场之一。
en: Then, as China moved toward middle-income status, it became a major consumer market in itself.

zh: 2012年上任的中国新一届领导层认识到中国的“人口红利”已经告罄：中国经济正在接近“刘易斯拐点 ” ， 即劳动力供给盈余消失而工资却不断上涨的阶段。
en: In 2012, China’s current leaders recognized that the country’s “demographic dividend” had run its course: the Chinese economy was reaching its “Lewis turning point,” the stage at which its surplus labor supply would be exhausted, and wages would start to rise.

zh: 而与此同时 ， “ 开放红利”也接近尾声，并且面临全球贸易保护主义壁垒的威胁。
en: And, at the same time, the “opening-up dividend” was also reaching maturity, and encountering protectionist barriers around the world.

zh: 中国仍然可以通过“一带一路”等计划打开新市场，但需要为此付出沉重的代价。
en: China can still tap new markets through efforts such as the “Belt and Road Initiative,” but at a considerable cost.

zh: 最终，持续高速增长需要不断地向全球价值链高端攀升，这需要通过深化经济改革和聚焦技术创新。
en: Ultimately, sustaining rapid growth requires continuing to move up the global value chain, by implementing further economic reforms and focusing on new technologies.

zh: 中国政府的十三五规划（2016—2020年）反映了其通过市场来配置资源和降低营商成本的决心。
en: The Chinese government’s 13th Five-Year Plan (2016-2020) reflected its commitment to market allocation of resources and lowering the costs of doing business.

zh: 当局2015年推出的“中国制造 2025”和“互联网+”计划表明其准备将中国制造业主体带入互联网时代。
en: And in 2015, the authorities’ “Made in China 2025” and “Internet Plus” initiatives signaled a determination to take the country’s manufacturing base into the Internet age.

zh: 这两个计划将共同致力于把人工智能、机器人和社交媒体与制造过程相融合，实现中国经济和社会的数字化革命。
en: Together, the two plans aim to integrate artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, and social media into manufacturing processes, and to digitize China’s economy and society.

zh: 确实，2015年以来，中国在电子商务方面独领风骚，网购已占零售总额的18 % ， 而美国只有8 % 。
en: Since 2015, China has taken the lead in e-commerce worldwide, with online purchases accounting for 18% of total retail sales, compared to just 8% in the US.

zh: 中国三大领先技术平台 — — 百度、阿里巴巴和腾讯已经能够与亚马逊、苹果、脸谱、谷歌和奈飞等美国的全球技术巨头一争高下。
en: China’s three leading tech platforms – Baidu, Alibaba, and Tencent – have grown to the point that they are beginning to compete with US-based global tech giants such as Amazon, Apple, Facebook, Google, and Netflix.

zh: 此外，根据iResearch的研究，中国移动支付已经达到5.5万亿美元规模，是美国的50倍。
en: Moreover, according to iResearch, mobile payments in China already amount to $5.5 trillion, roughly 50 times that of the US.

zh: 在中国的大部分城市，各种手机电子钱包应用正在取代现金，成为首要支付手段。
en: In most Chinese cities, electronic-wallet apps on mobile phones are replacing cash as the primary method of payment.

zh: 中国向数字时代的跃进受益于硬件技术、数字技术以及新商业模式的合力推动。
en: China’s leap into the digital age was facilitated by a combination of physical and digital technologies and new business models.

zh: 据Bruegel的最新研究，中国的研发支出占GDP的百分比已经高于欧盟；其科技出版物规模已与美国相当，而其自然科学和工学博士数量更有过之。
en: According to a recent study by Bruegel, China already spends more on research and development, as a percentage of GDP, than the European Union; and it now produces as many scientific publications as the US and more PhDs in natural sciences and engineering.

zh: 通过让信息交流更加便利及提升复杂任务中的协作效率，中国社交媒体应用平台“微信”在2017年一季度的用户已达9.38亿，带来了此前无法想象的生产率进步。
en: And, by streamlining the exchange of information and facilitating coordination of complex tasks, the Chinese social-media app WeChat – with 938 million users as of the first quarter of 2017 – has contributed to previously unimaginable productivity gains.

zh: 据波士顿咨询集团的研究，中国电商平台的商业模式演化与西方电商平台有所不同，中国的电商平台面对的是中国消费者快速增长的支出能力以及对使用创新产品的热情。
en: According to the Boston Consulting Group, Chinese e-commerce platforms’ business models have evolved differently from those in the West, as they have responded to Chinese consumers’ rapidly increasing spending power and enthusiasm for innovation.

zh: 借政府鼓励互联网商业模式创新试错的东风，中国企业正在颠覆传统模式。
en: Having been encouraged by the government to experiment with Internet-based business models, Chinese firms are upending traditional practices.

zh: 其颠覆速度快到连一些政府都感到有压力采取区块链和人工智能等新技术。
en: And this is happening so quickly that even the government now feels pressure to catch up, by adopting new technologies such as blockchain and AI.

zh: 在过去，由于交易成本过高，即使中国制造的产品，其在中国的价格仍可能高于美国。 而电子支付对降低中国营商和交易成本非常关键，大大提高了零售业的效率。
en: E-payments are a key factor in lowering business and transaction costs in China, because they improve efficiency in the retail sector, where prices can still be higher than in the US even when the products are made in China.

zh: 但一些P2P平台的欺诈和倒闭风波也表明，中国需要采取更严格的监管以保持系统的稳定性。
en: But the emergence of fraud and the failures of some peer-to-peer (P2P) platforms point to the need for tighter regulations to maintain systemic stability.

zh: 随着更多活动的数字化，中国融入全球价值链的进程也将日益发生在数字空间中。
en: As more activities become digitized, China’s integration into the global value chain will increasingly occur in digital spaces.

zh: 中国生产商可以在本土需要的地点及时间使用3D打印、机器人、大数据、及人工智能应用，同时仍然能够连接全球市场，从海外吸取新思想和新技术。
en: Chinese producers can use 3D printing, robotization, and Big Data and AI applications at the local level, while still tapping into global markets and sourcing ideas and skills from abroad.

zh: 如今，有无限种可能将生产和消费分成不同的阶段与模块。
en: There are now endless possibilities for dividing production and consumption into separate stages.

zh: 但这也意味着新的数字经济的大量成功案例也将伴随着同样多的失败场景。
en: But this also implies that the new digital economy’s many successes will be accompanied by many failures.

zh: 事实上，在未来几年中，中国决策者需要面对各种“数字困境 ” 。
en: Indeed, Chinese policymakers will have to confront various “digital dilemmas” in the coming years.

zh: 中国的许多公用事业机构 — — 如航空、铁路、港口和通讯等 — — 都是单一产品实体，由国有企业负责经营管理。
en: Many public utilities in China – such as airlines, railways, ports, and telecommunications – are single-product entities administered by state-owned enterprises (SOEs).

zh: 但民营的新技术巨头却是多产品、全方位的渠道平台，可以通吃所有供应链环节 — — 包括生产、分销、支付，目前还在进军财富管理。
en: Yet the new tech giants are multi-product, omni-channel platforms that cut across all sectors, including production, distribution, payments, and, increasingly, wealth management.

zh: 中国决策层就像是在下围棋，需要将国家的关键棋子 — — 即国有企业商业模式的改变 — — 在正确的时间落在正确的地方，而且棋子与棋子之间还要互相协调。
en: As in a game of Go, China’s leaders need to move the country’s pieces – that is to say, effect change in the SOEs’ business models – in the right place, at the right time, and in a coordinated fashion.

zh: 对国企改革进展缓慢的泛泛抱怨也许忽视了一个战略性挑战：在国企和新技术上市企业巨头之间，形成在数字空间的良性竞争。
en: Superficial complaints about the slow pace of SOE reforms ignore the strategic challenge of creating productive competition between SOEs and publicly listed tech giants in the digital space.

zh: 国企管理者大可以说，严格的监管让国企处于市场竞争劣势，而科技巨头却在免费搭乘国营通讯、交通和金融通道，夺走了国企的午餐。
en: SOE managers can credibly argue that heavy regulations place them at a competitive disadvantage, and that the tech giants are eating their lunch by free-riding on state-administered telecommunication, transportation, and financial channels.

zh: 与此同时，科技巨头也可以辩解说，如果它们可以更快地进入效率低下的生产和分销领域，尤其是移动支付，中国的整体生产率增长还能更快。
en: The tech giants, meanwhile, argue that if they could just move faster into inefficient production and distribution areas, not least mobile payments, productivity growth would accelerate.

zh: 另一个困境是：数字化对消费者固然是好事，但对就业和社会稳定的冲击可能是负面的。
en: Another dilemma is that digitization is good for consumers, but possibly bad for employment and social stability.

zh: 在“数字中国 ” ， 必然会有赢家和输家。
en: In a “Digital China,” there will necessarily be winners and losers.

zh: 但失业工人越快适应新的现实，整个系统就会越健康。
en: But the sooner displaced workers can adapt to new realities, the healthier the system will be.

zh: 中国转向基于知识的新经济才能在全球价值链中占据核心地位，并最终产生“改革红利 ” 。
en: China’s transformation into a knowledge-based economy occupying a central position in the global value chain will ultimately yield a “reform dividend.”

zh: 这一转型固然令人激动，但也隐藏着风险。
en: But as exciting as that transformation will be, it will also be dangerous.

zh: 此前，从未有哪个如此庞大的经济体以如此快的速度经历如此深远的变革。
en: Never before has an economy so large undergone such far-reaching change so quickly.

zh: 中国数字经济的机遇与挑战
en: The Challenges Confronting China’s Digital Economy

zh: 香港—中国数字经济的崛起势如破竹：中国占全球电子商务的比重已经高达42 % ； 全世界最成功的科技初创企业有三分之一在中国；中国每年的移动支付总额更是美国的11倍；但未来发展面临巨大挑战。
en: HONG KONG – China’s digital economy is a force to be reckoned with. The country now accounts for 42% of global e-commerce, boasts one-third of the world’s most successful tech startups, and conducts 11 times more mobile payments than the United States per year.

zh: 中国数字经济的迅猛发展要归功于其丰富多样的创新创业生态系统、监管者和政府对技术发展的友好态度、以及巨大的消费市场。
en: To be sure, China is on track for continued progress, thanks to its rich ecosystem of innovators, a tech-friendly attitude among regulators and government, and its massive consumer market.

zh: 中国有7.31亿互联网用户，比欧盟和美国的总和还要多。
en: China’s 731 million Internet users outnumber those in the European Union and the US combined.

zh: 这些因素为中国金融技术（FinTech）市场的高增长预期奠定了基础。
en: These factors underpin projections of rapid growth in China’s FinTech market.

zh: 高盛公司预测，2016—2020年间，与消费有关的第三方支付量将从1.9万亿美元增长到4.6万亿美元；非传统贷款人贷款将从1,560亿美元增加到7,640亿美元；新的在线导向的资产管理规模将从8.3万亿美元增加到11.9万亿美元。
en: From 2016 to 2020, Goldman Sachs expects consumption-related third-party payment value to grow from $1.9 trillion to $4.6 trillion, with lending by non-traditional players soaring from $156 billion to $764 billion and new online-oriented asset management increasing from $8.3 trillion to $11.9 trillion.

zh: 中国也正在加快人工智能（AI）方面的投资。
en: Moreover, China is accelerating investment in artificial intelligence.

zh: 根据麦肯锡公司（McKinsey）的报告《人工智能：对中国的影响 》 （ Artificial Intelligence: Implications for China）测算，取决于采用AI的速度，AI技术将为中国GDP增长带来0.8—1.4个百分点的增量。
en: In its report Artificial Intelligence: Implications for China, McKinsey estimates that AI technology in China could add 0.8 to 1.4 percentage points to China’s annual GDP growth, depending on the speed of adoption.

zh: 本月早些时候，谷歌AI中国在北京成立，由在中国出生的谷歌云计算首席科学家李飞飞主持。
en: Early this month, Google AI China was launched in Beijing by the company’s Chinese-born chief scientist for cloud computing, Fei-Fei Li.

zh: 但中国仍有很长的路要走。
en: Yet China still has a long way to go.

zh: 麦肯锡公司的最新研究《数字中国：赋予经济全球竞争力 》 （ Digital China: Powering the Economy to Global Competitiveness）指出，美国数字化程度仍比中国高4.9倍，而且，在中国内部，不同行业的数字化水平和参差不齐。
en: As another recent McKinsey study, Digital China: Powering the Economy to Global Competitiveness, points out, the US remains 4.9 times more digitized than China. And, within China, there are large variations in various sectors’ level of digitization.

zh: 在追赶及缩短差距的过程中，中国将面临严峻挑战。
en: China will confront serious risks as it closes these gaps.

zh: 麦肯锡公司指出，到2030年，数字化有望改变四个关键行业（消费和零售、汽车和交通、医疗、及物流）并创造相当于全行业10 % - 45%的收入。
en: As McKinsey notes, digitization promises to shift and create value equivalent to anywhere from 10% to 45% of total industry revenues in four key sectors (consumer and retail, automotive and mobility, health care, and freight and logistics) by 2030.

zh: 这将对现有的价值链体系造成巨大冲击，提升就业、消费和社会政治环境的不确定性。
en: This implies significant disruptions to value chains and uncertainty about jobs, consumption, and the socio-political context.

zh: 为了确保数字经济的持续健康发展，应对突破性技术进步所带来的产业与社会风险，中国需要实施明智的监管机制。
en: If China is to ensure the continued development of its digital economy, while containing the risks associated with disruption, its leaders will need to implement smart regulations.

zh: 而这就需要审慎考察推动及制约技术进步的各种因素。
en: And that will require careful consideration of the factors that have contributed to – and impeded – its progress so far.

zh: 十年前，几乎没人预测到中国会发生如此引人注目的数字经济突破。
en: As recently as a decade ago, few expected China’s remarkable digital breakthrough.

zh: 事实上，中国的两位互联网先锋， 阿里巴巴的马云和腾讯的马化腾，创业之初都经历过失败。
en: In fact, both of the country’s key Internet pioneers, Jack Ma of Alibaba and Pony Ma of Tencent, experienced early failures.

zh: 受益于中国对外开放及鼓励试验与创新的政策，这两家公司才能获得外国资本和技术，并在海外进行首次公开募股（IPO ） — —腾讯在香港上市，阿里巴巴在纽约上市。
en: But thanks to the Chinese leadership’s willingness to experiment, allowing access to foreign capital and technology, these pioneers were able to pursue initial public offerings elsewhere – Tencent in Hong Kong and Alibaba in New York.

zh: 他们利用新数字技术以及中国高质量的电讯及物流公共基础设施来撬动和构建以互联网为基础的数字服务业，成为中国数字经济崛起的先锋。
en: As they took advantage of emerging digital technology – not to mention China’s high-quality public infrastructure – to leverage and build services, these pioneers spearheaded rapid progress in China’s digital economy.

zh: 阿里巴巴的电子商务平台降低了交易成本、开拓了新市场、挤出了制约生产率提升的传统中介。
en: Alibaba’s e-commerce platform expanded market access and reduced transaction costs, crowding out traditional middleman who undermined productivity.

zh: 腾讯的微信降低了个体之间通讯、交流、协作和社会活动的成本，刺激了跨行业创新。
en: Tencent’s WeChat reduced the costs of communication, interaction, coordination, and socialization among individuals, stimulating innovation across industries.

zh: 两家公司的创新成功推翻了制造、分销、媒体和金融之间的壁垒，帮助中国经济在规模、范围、与速度维度同步提升。
en: Both broke down barriers among manufacturing, distribution, media, and finance, thereby achieving scale, expanding scope, and increasing speed.

zh: 中国迅速崛起的新经济 带来了巨大的生产率、收入和财富提升，是民营企业活力与市场创造力的写照。
en: These achievements – which produced major productivity, income, and wealth gains – are a testament to private-sector ingenuity.

zh: 但各级政府也为市场创新提供了便利，明智地选择了在市场发展的初期对新生事物采取网开一面的灵活政策，监管措施不但允许民企及市场不断扩张，还让这些市场成功融入全球经济。
en: But they were facilitated by the state, which pursued a policy of flexible non-enforcement of functional rules and regulations that enabled not only the expansion of private markets in China, but also the integration of those markets into the global economy.

zh: 但基于市场的创新具有内在不可预测性，而与创新有关的预期常常会过度高估或低估现实可能。
en: Yet market-based innovations are intrinsically unpredictable, and expectations regarding innovations often overshoot.

zh: 对于中国的数字经济，监管和执法的滞后和漏洞加剧了营商环境的失衡，导致金融和债务风险、污染和收入不平均等社会问题。
en: In the case of China’s digital economy, imperfect and lagging regulations and enforcement exacerbated the effects of imbalances in the business environment, which enabled the emergence of severe vulnerabilities, from financial and debt risk to pollution and inequality.

zh: 在中国现行体制下，需要政府来解决这些社会问题。
en: Under China’s current system, it is up to the government to deal with these problems.

zh: 在过去五年中，政府也确实在尝试解决这些问题，但通常会使用传统、非系统性、及现成的行政管理工具。
en: And, over the last five years, it has attempted to do just that, often using old, imperfect, but already-available administrative tools.

zh: 在过去一年，中国有关当局逐步收紧了对加密数字货币（比特币 ） 、 互联网融资平台、影子银行、跨境资本流动、地方债务及证券市场的监管。
en: Over the last year alone, China’s authorities have steadily tightened regulations governing the crypto-currency Bitcoin, B2C financing platforms, shadow banking, cross-border capital flows, and debt and securities markets.

zh: 但这些应急措施在短期有其必要，却无法根除导致风险与不确定性的一些更基本的制度因素，即如何处理创新过程中的失败、损失、及监管漏洞等灰犀牛问题。
en: But such changes do not address the underlying weaknesses that allow risk to proliferate.

zh: 因此，中国需要构建更有效的制度与机制来应对企业破产、吸收损失、及管理风险和不确定性。
en: For that, China must build more effective institutions to deal with business failures, absorb losses, and manage risks and uncertainty.

zh: 特别是，中国需要健全的破产流程、有活力的多层次资本市场、有效的社会安全体系、可靠的公共住房体系、以及一个旨在降低收入与财富不平等的累进税制。
en: In particular, China needs improved bankruptcy procedures, multilevel capital markets, an effective social-security system, reliable public housing, and a progressive tax regime that aims to reduce inequality.

zh: 与此同时，为了遏制一些市场不平衡，中国需要引入更强的竞争法、反腐败机制以及环境监管。
en: At the same time, to counter market abuses, China should introduce more robust competition laws, anti-corruption mechanisms, and stronger environmental regulations.

zh: 数字经济天然有利于市场、有利于提高生产率、有利于全球化。
en: The digital economy is naturally pro-market, pro-productivity, and pro-globalization.

zh: 但如果没有有效的监管，数字经济可能导致严重的经济失衡，甚至影响到社会稳定。
en: Yet, without effective management, it can generate significant economic imbalances that foster political and social instability.

zh: 在新经济对传统经济具有大规模冲击力的时代，在突破性技术进步、人口老化和气候变化等因素相互作用的环境下，这一点尤其重要。
en: This is all the more true at a time of large-scale disruptions, owing to rapid technological progress, demographic shifts, and climate change.

zh: 为了实现数字经济的潜力，并避免其可能的弊端，中国需要构建公正包容的社会制度来保护产权及确保有效的市场。
en: The only way to harness the digital economy’s potential while avoiding downside risks is to build fair and inclusive social institutions that protect property rights and ensure efficient markets.

zh: 换句话说，一切都取决于清楚、合理、有效地界定政府与市场的角色。
en: In other words, it all comes down to delineating clearly, appropriately, and effectively the roles of the state and the market.

zh: 中国敢于贬值
en: China’s Daring Depreciation

zh: 北京—8月11日，中国人民银行将人民币中间汇率下调1.9 % ， 引起了全球冲击。
en: BEIJING – On August 11, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) lowered the central parity rate of the renminbi by 1.9%, sending shockwaves around the globe.

zh: 许多外国评论家指责贬值是赤裸裸地为了提振中国的出口 — — 他们警告说，此举将引发新一轮货币战争。
en: Many foreign commentators condemned the devaluation as a blatant attempt to boost Chinese exports – a move that would, they warned, spark a new round of currency wars.

zh: 但有很好的理由相信这绝非中国贬值的初衷。
en: But there are good reasons to believe that this was not China’s motivation at all.

zh: 事实上，中国十分清楚，货币战争无异于拿起石头砸自己的脚。
en: In fact, China knows full well that currency wars are self-defeating.

zh: 1997年亚洲金融危机期间，中国经济状况比现在糟糕得多，但中国政府仍然抵制住了贬值的诱惑 — — 而中国也成功地在危机中毫发无伤。
en: During the 1997 Asian financial crisis, China’s economic situation was much worse than it is today, but the government still resisted the temptation to devalue the renminbi – and the country managed to emerge from the crisis virtually unscathed.

zh: 如今，贬值对中国的贸易盈余也许根本起不了什么作用。
en: Today, a devaluation would probably do little for China’s trade surplus.

zh: 毕竟，中国已经占据全球出口量的12%强，因此进一步扩大这一比例可能恶化贸易条件。
en: After all, the country already accounts for more than 12% of global exports, so expanding its share further would probably worsen its terms of trade.

zh: 在中国的贸易中，加工贸易占主导地位 — — 即进口原材料和部件，出口制成品 — — 这意味着贬值的效果更加模棱两可。
en: The dominance of processing trade in China – the import of raw materials and components and the export of finished goods – makes the effectiveness of devaluation even more dubious.

zh: 此外，目前中国持有巨额海外资产和负债。 其非金融公司海外借款高达1万亿美元。
en: Moreover, China now holds a massive volume of overseas assets and liabilities; its non-financial corporations have borrowed as much as $1 trillion abroad.

zh: 贬值将增加企业债务负担的人民币值，因此不良贷款和破产的风险也将增加。
en: As devaluation causes businesses’ debt burdens to grow in renminbi terms, the risk of non-performing loans and bankruptcies rises.

zh: 除了明白竞争性贬值的短期风险，中国政府还认真地致力于其长期目标 — — 将增长模式从基于投资和出口转变为由国内消费驱动。
en: Beyond an awareness of the short-term risks of competitive devaluation lies the Chinese government’s serious commitment to its longer-term goal of shifting the country’s growth model from one based on investment and exports to one driven by domestic consumption.

zh: 事实上，中国计划减少其贸易盈余 — — 当然，其规模仍然十分庞大 — — 并通过增加内需抵消由此带来的消极影响。
en: Indeed, China plans to shrink its trade surplus – which, to be sure, remains large – and offset the negative impact of that process by increasing domestic demand.

zh: 考虑到这些因素，也许最近的贬值另有其目的。
en: Given these factors, it seems likely that the recent devaluation was driven by a different goal.

zh: 事实上，在贬值的同一天，中国宣布了另一个事项 — — 因为恐慌而没有引起什么关注 — — 这个事项也许更能暗示贬值的目标。
en: And, in fact, an announcement made on the same day as the devaluation – one that has been largely overshadowed by the panic – offers an important indication of what that goal was.

zh: 中国政府宣布，从现在开始，人民币汇率中间价将更紧密地与前一日的收盘现货汇率相一致。
en: From now on, China’s government declared, the renminbi’s central parity rate will align more closely with the previous day’s closing spot rates.

zh: 这表明贬值主要是为了让市场在人民币汇率的决定中起到更大的作用，其目标是进一步深化货币改革。
en: This suggests that the devaluation was aimed primarily at giving the markets a greater role in determining the renminbi exchange rate, with the goal of enabling deeper currency reform.

zh: 目前，中国的汇率可以在由人民银行每日公布的汇率中间价上下2%之内波动。
en: As it stands, Chinese exchange rates are allowed to fluctuate by a maximum of 2% on either side of the central parity, which the PBOC fixes daily.

zh: 当市场汇率达到波动区间的边界时，人民银行将通过买入或出售其外汇储备干预市场。
en: When the moving market rate reaches the edges of the fluctuation band, the PBOC can intervene in the market by buying or selling its foreign-exchange reserves.

zh: 现在，做市商被通知，它们向人民银行报告的卖出价应基于前一日市场汇率收盘价，与外汇市场供求条件以及主要货币汇率的波动相一致。
en: Market makers now have been instructed that the offer prices they report to the PBOC should be based on the market’s closing parity rate from the previous day, along with the demand and supply conditions in the foreign-exchange market and the movements of major currencies’ exchange rates.

zh: 除了人民银行，其他人都不知道做市商如何满足这一要求。
en: No one outside the PBOC knows how the market makers will meet these demands.

zh: 如果人民银行现在只是进一步拉平不受其干预约束的卖出价，那么它就是在进一步靠近完全基于市场的汇率机制。
en: If the PBOC is now simply moving closer to averaging the offer prices that are not subject to its interference, it is moving closer to an entirely market-based exchange-rate regime.

zh: 但这一动作蕴含着严重的风险。
en: But this shift carries serious risks.

zh: 如果人民币每天贬值（比如）2 % ， 那么不消多久，其币值就会跌去20 % — —足以引发恐慌，造成汇率混乱，不管经济基本面如何。
en: If the renminbi were to depreciate by, say, 2% every day, it would take very little time for the currency to lose 20% of its value – enough to cause a panic and, regardless of the country’s economic fundamentals, send the exchange rate into a tailspin.

zh: 因此，人民银行保留了影响做市商报告卖出价和直接干预市场的权利。
en: That is why the PBOC has retained the right to influence the reporting of offer prices by market makers and intervene directly in the market.

zh: 而这正是人民银行在8月12—13日所做的，当时，比预期更大幅度的贬值压力和飙升的贬值预期导致了一个风险，即计划中的一次性汇率调整可能引发崩盘。
en: And this is precisely what the PBOC did on August 12-13, when stronger-than-expected depreciation pressure and surging devaluation expectations raised the risk that the planned one-off exchange-rate adjustment could trigger a rout.

zh: 因此人民银行通知市场，贬值不会超过3 % — —这是一个可信的陈述，因为人民银行拥有充足的官方外汇储备稳定汇率。
en: So the PBOC informed the market that the depreciation would not exceed 3% – a credible statement, given abundant official reserves with which to stabilize the exchange rate.

zh: 人民币随之反弹，市场重归平静。
en: The renminbi rebounded, and calm was restored.

zh: 这一事件表明，人民币存在着巨大的贬值压力，而随着GDP增长的走弱，人民银行开始放松货币政策（特别是在美联储逐渐收紧其货币政策时 ） ， 这进一步加剧了这一压力。
en: This episode showed that the renminbi is under significant depreciation pressure, which is likely to intensify as the PBOC, amid weak GDP growth, loosens monetary policy (particularly as the US Federal Reserve is gradually tightening its monetary policy).

zh: 除此之外，中国还要实施资本账户自由化和人民币国际化，因此可以预期会出现一些汇率波动。
en: Add to that efforts to liberalize the capital account and internationalize the renminbi, and some exchange-rate volatility can be expected.

zh: 对中国的货币决策者来说，改革汇率制度，同时防止贬值失控是一个严峻的挑战。
en: For China’s monetary policymakers, reforming the exchange-rate system, while preventing depreciation from getting out of hand, poses a serious challenge.

zh: 对世界其他国家来说，鼓励中国放松对汇率的管制（即使人民币大幅贬值）也是同样严峻的要务。
en: For the rest of the world, encouraging China to loosen its grip over the exchange rate, even as the renminbi depreciates significantly, is an equally serious imperative.

zh: 两方面都不容有失。
en: Neither side can afford to fail.

zh: 激发引导中国的企业家精神
en: Channeling China’s Animal Spirits

zh: 香港—为了减轻企业和地方政府的债务负担，中国人民银行在六个月内第三次降低了利率。
en: HONG KONG – The People’s Bank of China has cut interest rates for the third time in six months, in order to lighten the debt burdens of companies and local governments.

zh: 但人行的货币宽松 — — 以及配套的财政政策和行政机构改革 — — 对于增加新贷款需求没有起到理想的效果。
en: But the PBOC’s monetary easing – accompanied by complementary fiscal and administrative adjustments – has done little to increase demand for new loans.

zh: 相反，货币政策的调整导致了中国股市大涨。
en: Instead, it has triggered a sharp rise in China’s stock markets.

zh: 现在的问题是，这是否能够变成一件大好事。
en: The question now is whether that could turn out to be a very good thing.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国经济正在快速换挡。
en: There is little doubt that China’s economy is shifting gears very quickly.

zh: 官方数据表明，旧制造业和以建筑业为基础的经济实际增长已经放缓，这反映在出口利润下滑、违约率上升和不良贷款增加，特别表现在业绩表现较差的城市和地区。
en: Official statistics show a slowdown in real growth in the old manufacturing and construction-based economy, reflected in declining corporate profits, rising defaults, and an increase in non-performing loans in poorer-performing cities and regions.

zh: 与此同时，政府在治理腐败、产能过剩、地方过度负债和污染等问题的措施也给投资、消费以及增长造成了压力。
en: Meanwhile, the government’s policies to tackle corruption, overcapacity, excess local-government debt, and pollution have put downward pressure on investment, consumption, and the government’s capacity to deliver its promised growth rate.

zh: 在中央政府所施加的预算约束趋紧的情况下，地方官员和国有企业削减了投资支出，并且变得过于谨慎。
en: With harder budget constraints imposed by the central government, local officials and state-owned enterprises (SOEs) have curbed their spending on investment, and are now being overly cautious.

zh: 从短期看，这些结构调整可能导致局部地区及行业的资产负债表衰退，即使中央政府正在尽力创造更宽松合适的宏观经济环境。
en: In the short run, this restructuring could lead to localized balance-sheet recessions, despite the authorities’ efforts to create a more accommodating macroeconomic environment.

zh: 另一方面，一些私营企业及部门却蒸蒸日上，最新的行政体制改革导致2014年3月以来的企业注册量增加了54 % 。
en: The private sector, by contrast, is picking up steam, with recent administrative reforms having contributed to a 54% rise in business registrations since March 2014.

zh: 创新产业和服务业的崛起帮助中国超越其作为世界工厂的角色。 在阿里巴巴和腾讯等互联网平台企业的推动下，中国已经开始发展自身的物联网行业。
en: Increased innovation and the rise of the services sector have helped China move beyond its role as the world’s factory to develop its own version of the Internet of Things, driven by platform companies like Alibaba and Tencent.

zh: 去年，中国股市新增开户数量1,430万户。
en: Some 14.3 million new stock-market trading accounts were opened in China last year.

zh: 中国人银行的降息和降准政策导致上海、深圳和创业板指数自2013年1月以来分别上扬95 % 、 198%和383 % 。
en: And the PBOC’s interest-rate cuts, together with reductions in banks’ mandatory reserve ratios, have fueled a rise in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and ChiNext indices of 95%, 198%, and 383%, respectively, since January 2013.

zh: 中国股市市值占GDP之比从2012年的44%增加到本月初的94 % 。
en: Chinese stock-market capitalization grew from 44% of GDP at the end 2012 to 94% of GDP earlier this month.

zh: 这些政策影响既有利也有弊。
en: This has important potential implications – both positive and negative.

zh: 从有利的角度看，中国股市在低息环境中的复苏代表着重要的资产配置变化，即资金从房地产和储蓄中流出。
en: On the positive side, the revival of China’s stock market in a low-interest-rate environment represents an important shift in asset allocation away from real estate and deposits.

zh: 大约50%的中国储蓄 — — 高达GDP的50 % — —存在于房地产中，20%为存款，11%在股市中，12%在债券上。
en: Roughly 50% of Chinese savings – amounting to as much as half of GDP – lie in real estate alone, with 20% in deposits, 11% in stocks, and 12% in bonds.

zh: 比较而言，在美国，房地产、保险与退休养老金各占总储蓄的20%左右，存款占7.4 % ， 股票市占21 % ， 债券占33 % 。
en: To compare, in the United States, real estate, insurance, and pensions each account for about 20% of total savings, with 7.4% in deposits, 21% in stocks, and 33% in bonds.

zh: 中国股市市值的上涨还有助于降低实体经济对银行融资的过度依赖及其风险暴露。
en: Rising stock-market capitalization also helps to reduce the real economy’s exposure to bank financing.

zh: 美国的“金融深化”程度远远超过中国，2013年底美国股市和债券分别占GDP的133%和205 % 。
en: The US is much more “financialized” than China, with stocks and bonds amounting to 133% and 205% of GDP, respectively, at the end of 2013.

zh: 中国的这两个比例分别为35%和43 % 。
en: Those ratios were only 35% and 43%, respectively, in China.

zh: 与此同时，中国银行资产占GDP之比为215 % ， 是美国的95%的两倍多。
en: Meanwhile, China’s bank assets amounted to 215% of GDP – more than double America’s 95%.

zh: 最后，中国股市的大涨让净财富在18个月中增加了37万亿元人民币，相当于中国GDP的57 % 。
en: Finally, China’s surging stock prices increased net wealth by CN¥37 trillion ($6 trillion), equivalent to 57% of China’s GDP, in just 18 months.

zh: 如果股价可以维持，对于消费、流动性和去杠杆的影响将是深远的。
en: If stock prices can be sustained, the implications for consumption, liquidity, and leverage will be profound.

zh: 明智的家庭和企业可能兑现股市利润、降低债务。
en: Smart households and entrepreneurs could take profits and reduce their debts.

zh: 同时，民企和国企都可能利用牛市热情增发股本为新投资项目融资。
en: Similarly, both private enterprises and SOEs could use market buoyancy to raise equity to fund new investments.

zh: 但股价的飙升也带来了大量风险。 金融行业可能会滥用新出现的流动性，为创造资产泡沫的投机性行为融资，并支持产能过剩的旧行业。
en: But the rapid run-up in equity prices also carries considerable risks – namely, the possibility that the financial sector will misuse the newfound liquidity to finance more speculative investment in asset bubbles, while supporting old industries with excess capacity.

zh: 2008—2009年的教训需要铭记，当时，上证指数2007年曾达到6092点，加上政府4万亿人民币的刺激计划维持了传统行业的过剩产能。
en: That is what happened in 2008-2009, when a run-up of the Shanghai index (which reached 6,092 in October 2007), together with the government’s CN¥4 trillion stimulus package, sustained overcapacity in traditional industries.

zh: 大部分信贷涌向了房地产和地方基础设施项目，加剧了中国经济结构的不平衡。
en: Most of the credit went to real estate and local infrastructure projects, effectively reinforcing the most problematic trends in China’s economy.

zh: 我们希望这次会有所不同。
en: This time, one hopes, will be different.

zh: 虽然中国散户投资者已经开始将资金投向创新型企业，但发掘成功企业和行业绝非易事。
en: But even if Chinese retail investors begin to channel their money toward innovative ventures, identifying the companies and industries most likely to succeed will be difficult.

zh: 在美国，2000年高科技泡沫的破裂导致市值缩水4万亿美元，但当时美国股市的破灭并没有导致系统性经济危机。
en: In the US, the collapse of the tech bubble in 2000 entailed a $4 trillion loss in market capitalization. But the US managed to avoid a systemic crisis.

zh: 如果中国的企业家精神可以通过市场机制起作用，在预期“梦幻”价格中找到真实价值，那么中国也可成功走向新经济，尽管在此过程中难免会有个别企业的失败和股市的调整。
en: If China’s animal spirits are allowed to operate through market mechanisms, distinguishing real value from aspirational prices, China, too, can stay the course toward the new economy, despite the failures and consolidation that will inevitably occur.

zh: 随着中国的企业家精神得到发挥，将日益考验当局不干预股价，而是允许市场力量来驱动商业周期的决心。
en: As China’s animal spirits are channeled, they will increasingly test the authorities’ resolve to resist price intervention, instead allowing market forces to propel the business cycle.

zh: 这绝非易事。
en: This will not be easy, given that the PBOC has plenty of additional room for monetary easing.

zh: 中国人民银行有足够的空间实行宽松的货币政策。 事实上，截至去年底，中国仍有22.7万亿人民币的法定准备金，相当于GDP的36 % 。
en: Indeed, at the end of last year, China still had CN¥22.7 trillion of statutory reserves, amounting to 36% of GDP, that had long been used to “sterilize” its large foreign-exchange holdings.

zh: 长期以来，法定准备金是“冲销”巨额外汇储备的手段。 这一“被锁定的流动性”可以以新增银行贷款或新股本的方式重新输回到市场中。
en: Such “locked liquidity” can be returned to the market in the form of new bank credit or new equity.

zh: 因此，中国行政改革的真正考验是当局能否通过改进破产制度和阻止欺诈及市场操纵的监管，让市场力量能够真正主导资源配置。
en: That is why the real test of China’s administrative reforms is whether, through improved bankruptcy mechanisms and regulations that block fraud and market manipulation, they allow – and even facilitate – the effective functioning of market forces.

zh: 只有当企业家精神，而不是当局的行政指导，真正发挥作用时，中国才能够发展出具有未来竞争力的高附加值、高科技经济。
en: With animal spirits – not the authorities – guiding it, China can build the high-value-added, high-tech economy it needs to compete in the future.

zh: 中国例外论寿终正寝？
en: R.I.P. Chinese Exceptionalism?

zh: 新德里—从阿根廷到土耳其，从南非到印度尼西亚，新兴市场再次被金融动荡席卷。
en: NEW DELHI – From Argentina to Turkey and from South Africa to Indonesia, emerging markets are once again being roiled by financial turbulence.

zh: 但我们不要忘了其中最大，也许也是最有问题的一个：中国。
en: But let us not lose sight of the biggest and potentially most problematic of them all: China.

zh: 在过去几十年中，中国的增长似乎违反了一些经济学基本定律。
en: Over the past few decades, China’s growth has appeared to violate certain fundamental laws of economics.

zh: 比如，斯坦因定律（Stein’s Law）认为，既然事情不能永远继续下去，它总会停止。
en: For example, Stein’s Law holds that if something cannot go on forever, it will stop.

zh: 但中国债务一直在上升。
en: Yet China’s debt keeps on rising.

zh: 事实上，据国际货币基金组织（IMF）数据，中国公司、政府和家庭债务在过去十年就增加了23万亿美元左右，其债务-GDP之比升高了大约100个百分点，来到250%以上。
en: Indeed, according to the International Monetary Fund, Chinese corporate, government, and household debt has increased by about $23 trillion in the last decade alone, and its debt-to-GDP ratio has risen by around 100 percentage points, to more than 250%.

zh: 这已经超过经常导致金融危机的水平几个数量级了。
en: That is orders of magnitude above the level at which financial crises normally occur.

zh: 诚然，中国的议席而债务被用来扩大工业基础和制造业。
en: To be sure, some of China’s debt has been used to expand its industrial base and infrastructure.

zh: 但大部分用来维持亏钱公营企业和重复建设的公用设施和住房投资。
en: But much of it has also gone toward sustaining money-losing public enterprises and endless investments in superfluous public facilities and housing.

zh: 中国的内部失衡指向了另一个它成功打破了的经济学定律。
en: China’s domestic imbalances point to another economic law that it has managed to break.

zh: 对正常国家，累积巨量剩余产能会导致投资和GDP增长大幅下降。
en: For any normal country, the build-up of extensive surplus capacity would lead to sharp declines in investment and GDP growth.

zh: 这反过来将产生金融抑制，如果警示信号得不到重视的话，危机也将接踵而至。
en: And that, in turn, would produce financial distress, followed by a crisis if the warning signs were ignored.

zh: 但中国的经验截然不同。
en: But China has had a different experience.

zh: 其GDP增长有所放缓，但投资保持强劲，银行体系也没有承压。
en: Its GDP growth has slowed, but investment remains robust, and there is no strain on its banking system.

zh: 对于中国经济突出的坚韧性，一个常规的解释是它拥有巨大的国内储蓄池和外汇储备（超过3万亿美元 ） ， 可以用来消除金融恐慌。
en: A common explanation for China’s apparent invulnerability is that it has large pools of domestic savings and enormous foreign-exchange reserves (over $3 trillion), which can be spent down to head off financial panics.

zh: 并且政府资产负债表仍足够救助没有自生能力的金融企业，因此能够解决重要行业的任何压力信号。
en: And because the government’s balance sheet is still strong enough to bail out unviable financial firms, it can address any emerging sources of stress in that crucial sector.

zh: 对中国的恢复力的另一个常见解释是政治。
en: Another common explanation for China’s resilience is political.

zh: 高度集中的决策使其能够迅速地集中力量办大事，比如官方遏制外汇外流。
en: Highly centralized decision-making allows for swift, concerted action, such as official clampdowns on foreign-exchange outflows.

zh: 在这个独一无二的受控制 — — 并可控制 — — 社会，源自经济破坏的常见经济压力都可以游刃有余地得到管理。
en: And in such a uniquely controlled – and controllable – society, the normal social stresses that arise from economic disruptions are eminently manageable.

zh: 这些观点固然有理，但值得商榷。
en: Plausible as these arguments are, it is time to revisit them.

zh: 中国经济例外论正受到已有压力 — — 即国内债务累积 — — 和新情况 — — 包括美国贸易壁垒、针对中国一带一路计划的地缘政治反弹以及（特别是美国的）货币条件紧缩所组成的完美风暴的威胁。
en: China’s economic exceptionalism is now being threatened by a perfect storm of existing stresses – namely, the domestic debt build-up – and new complications, including US trade barriers, the geopolitical pushback against China’s Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), and tightening monetary conditions, particularly in the United States.

zh: 2008年金融危机后，中国改变了经济模式，从出口转向内源增长。
en: After the 2008 financial crisis, China shifted its economic model away from exports and toward internal sources of growth.

zh: 但这一再平衡要求更多的债务和投资，从而制造了更大的崩溃风险。
en: But such a rebalancing requires ever more debt and investment, thus creating greater risks of collapse.

zh: 因此，政府不得不如履薄冰，在经济需要的时候小心翼翼地予以刺激。
en: As a result, the government has had to tread carefully, providing only moderate dollops of stimulus to the economy as needed.

zh: 其平衡政策没有行动指南。
en: There is no how-to manual for managing this balancing act.

zh: 现在看似温和的政策干预，有可能很快就会显得过度。
en: Policy interventions that seem moderate in the moment could turn out to have been excessive.

zh: 斯坦因定律总会在某个时候证明自己。
en: At some point, Stein’s Law will assert itself.

zh: 中国增长所面临的新威胁中，首屈一指的是美国贸易政策。
en: First among the emerging threats to Chinese growth is US trade policy.

zh: 目前，特朗普政府的关税只影响到截至500亿美元的中国出口。
en: So far, only about $50 billion worth of Chinese exports have been affected by the Trump administration’s tariffs.

zh: 但在7鱼粉，特朗普宣布了新一轮关税，目标新增价值2,000亿美元的中国商品，或对美出口总额的15 % 。
en: But in July, Trump announced a new round of tariffs targeting an additional $200 billion worth of Chinese goods, representing about 15% of total exports to the US.

zh: 中国面对特朗普的持续威胁的反应相当“配合 ” ， 表现出其脆弱性正在增加。
en: Reflecting its growing vulnerability, China’s reactions to Trump’s continued threats have been notably accommodative.

zh: 外部需求的第二个威胁来自中国重商主义政策的穷途末路。
en: A second threat to external demand comes from the exhaustion of China’s mercantilist policies.

zh: 20世纪90年代到21世纪初，中国发展出一个规模巨大的出口行业，部分原因在于允许人民币贬值。
en: In the 1990s and 2000s, China developed an exceptionally large export industry in part by allowing its currency to become undervalued.

zh: 但最近，它开始通过其他手段保持该方针，即用BRI为其他国家购买中国商品和服务融资。
en: More recently, however, it has perpetuated this approach through other means, namely the BRI, with which it finances other countries’ purchases of Chinese goods and services.

zh: 可称之为中国重商主义2.0。
en: Call this Chinese Mercantilism 2.0.

zh: 问题在于，重商主义2.0现在受到了政治和经济的双重打击。
en: The problem is that Mercantilism 2.0 is now under attack, both politically and economically.

zh: 政治上，中国贷款的接收方 — — 从斯里兰卡到马来西亚和缅甸 — — 都表示反对BRI和它的新帝国主义味道。
en: Politically, recipients of Chinese loans – from Sri Lanka to Malaysia to Myanmar – have been expressing objections to the BRI and its odor of neo-imperialism.

zh: 经济上，沉重的BRI融资条件导致至少八个国家债务积累到了危险水平（据全球发展中心数据 ） 。
en: Economically, the onerous terms of BRI financing have resulted in alarming debt build-ups in at least eight countries, according to the Center for Global Development.

zh: 比如，马来西亚已经不得不取消价值220亿美元的中国支持项目。
en: Malaysia, for example, has already had to cancel $22 billion worth of Chinese-backed projects.

zh: 斯里兰卡不得不回归IMF寻求帮助，因为过多的中国进口品对其对外账户造成了影响。
en: Sri Lanka has had to turn to the IMF for help, owing to the impact of excessive Chinese imports on its external accounts.

zh: 巴基斯坦也可能很快就将被迫做同样的事情。
en: And Pakistan may soon be forced to do the same.

zh: 随着更多国家开始担心BRI，它们也将减少从中国的贷款和进口。
en: As more countries become wary of the BRI, they will borrow and import less from China.

zh: 与此同时，美国利率的稳步升高形成了第三道冲击。
en: Meanwhile, the steady rise in US interest rates is creating a third shock.

zh: 随着美国利率超过中国利率，资本将流出中国，今年在其他新兴市场就是如此。
en: As US rates exceed Chinese rates, capital will flow out of China, as it has from other emerging markets this year.

zh: 因此，中国领导人将面临经典的新兴市场困境。
en: China’s leaders will thus be faced with the classic emerging-market dilemma.

zh: 如果它放任人民币贬值，有可能在短期内加剧资本外逃并导致美国将其列为货币操纵国。
en: If they allow the renminbi to weaken, they could aggravate capital flight in the short term and invite accusations of currency manipulation from the US.

zh: 但如果它想要支撑人民币，就必须像2015年那样，在消耗掉一万亿美元储备。
en: But if they want to prop up the currency, they may have to spend down another trillion dollars in reserves, as happened in 2015.

zh: 或者，中国政府可以重新引入严厉的资本管制。
en: Alternatively, the government could reimpose draconian capital controls.

zh: 但这将扼杀外部需求，破坏更广泛的经济管理，也让中国对全球经济领导地位的主张（包括人民币国际化）信誉扫地。
en: But that would stifle external demand, undermine economic management more broadly, and discredit the country’s claim to global economic leadership (including internationalization of the renminbi).

zh: 在这场经济挑战的完美风暴中，对于中国国家主席习近平是否像所有人认为的那样，一切尽在掌握的问题，也越来越受到质疑。
en: Amid this perfect storm of economic challenges, there are also growing questions about whether Chinese President Xi Jinping has as strong a grip on events as he would like everyone to think.

zh: 习近平要想做好的话，不但要牢记斯坦因定律，也不能忘记多恩布什定律（Rüdiger Dornbusch’s Law ） ， 该定律认为 ， “ 危机的到来过程比你想象的长得多，而当它发生时，有比你认为的快得多。 ”
en: Xi would do well to remember not just Stein’s Law, but also Rüdiger Dornbusch’s Law, which holds that, “The crisis takes a much longer time coming than you think, and then it happens much faster than you would have thought.”

zh: 迟早，中国例外论要让位给经济学定律。
en: Sooner or later, Chinese exceptionalism will give way to the laws of economics.

zh: 世界应该做好准备。
en: The world should prepare itself.

zh: 后果可能是严重的 — — 要比近期所经历过的都要严重。
en: The consequences could be severe – and unlike anything experienced in recent history.

zh: 中国的经济身份危机
en: China’s Economic Identity Crisis

zh: 北京—中国和西方不同。 美国前总统老布什曾经戏谑“愿景这玩意儿 ” （ the vision thing ） ， 而中国对待经济战略非常严肃。
en: BEIJING – Unlike the West, where former US President George H.W. Bush once mockingly referred to “the vision thing,” China takes economic strategy very seriously.

zh: 这在最近的北京中国发展论坛上表现得淋漓尽致。 中国发展论坛始于2000年，是每年在“两会”后不久举行一次的重要会议。
en: That much was clear at the recent China Development Forum (CDF) in Beijing, an important gathering held each year since 2000, immediately after the conclusion of the annual National People’s Congress.

zh: 中国发展论坛最初由前总理朱镕基 — — 中国最有战略眼光的现代改革家之一 — — 决心举办，并很快成为中国高级决策者和国际学者、官员和商界领袖的高规格交流平台。
en: Originally conceived by former Premier Zhu Rongji – one of modern China’s most strategy-minded reformers – the CDF quickly became a high-level platform for engagement between senior Chinese policymakers and an international lineup of academics, foreign officials, and business leaders.

zh: 本质上，这是知识压力测试 — — 迫使中国领导人在严格而理性的外部专家面前为其新制定的战略和政策辩护。
en: It is, in essence, an intellectual stress test – forcing Chinese leaders to defend newly formulated strategies and policies before a tough and seasoned audience of outside experts.

zh: 对于这样的场合，要提炼出简单的信息向来不易，尤其是中国经济发展论坛，它曾经只是小规模非公开会议，但现已发展成为类似于达沃斯论坛的大会，要举行三天，进行50场左右的讨论。
en: It’s not always easy to distill a singular message from an event like this, especially as the CDF, once a small intimate gathering, has morphed into a Davos-like extravaganza of some 50 sessions spread out over three days.

zh: 但是，我出席了17次会议中的16次（错过了第一届 ） ， 我的感觉是2016年中国发展论坛对于中国所面临的艰巨经济挑战来说具有特别丰富的战略含义。
en: But, having attended 16 of the 17 meetings (I missed the first one), my sense is that CDF 2016 was especially rich in its strategic implications for China’s daunting economic challenges.

zh: 据我所见，房间中的大象是中国经济模式的核心身份 — — 由生产者拉动还是由消费者拉动。
en: And, as I saw it, the elephant in the room was the core identity of China’s economic model – a producer-led versus a consumer-led model.

zh: 中国的30年发展奇迹 — — 从1980—2010年保持10%的年真实GDP增长 — — 是通过作为终极生产者的强大实力实现的。
en: China’s 30-year development miracle – 10% real annual GDP growth from 1980 to 2010 – was all about the country’s prowess as the ultimate producer.

zh: 在制造业和建筑业的拉动下，中国获得了独特的强大动力。
en: Led by manufacturing and construction, China enjoyed a uniquely powerful impetus.

zh: 1980年，出口和投资加起来占中国GDP的41 % ； 到2010年，这一比例为75 % 。
en: In 1980, exports and investment collectively accounted for 41% of Chinese GDP; by 2010, the combined share was 75%.

zh: 出口比例增加最多 — — 翻了近六倍，从1980年的6%增长到2007年危机前35%的峰值水平 — — 新产能和基础设施、低成本劳动力和加入世界贸易组织让中国成为加速的全球化和急剧增长的贸易流的最大受益者。
en: The export portion increased the most – by nearly six-fold, from 6% in 1980 to a pre-crisis peak of 35% in 2007 – as new capacity and infrastructure, low-cost labor, and accession to the World Trade Organization made China the world’s greatest beneficiary of accelerating globalization and surging trade flows.

zh: 但生产者模式不是中国到2020年实现小康的公式。 这一认识滥觞于现已妇孺皆知的前总理温家宝的“四不”批评。
en: Yet the producer model was not the definitive formula for achieving China’s aspirations of becoming a moderately prosperous society by 2020.

zh: 2007年，温家宝正确地指出生产者模式“不平衡、不稳定、不协调、不可持续。 ”
en: This realization was foreshadowed by the now-famous “Four Uns” critique of former Premier Wen Jiabao, who back in 2007 correctly diagnosed the producer model as “unbalanced, unstable, uncoordinated, and unsustainable.”

zh: 当然，这些批评的对象是储蓄盈余、过度投资、无尽的资源需求、环境破坏和日益加剧的收入不平等。
en: Those, of course, were code words for surplus saving, excessive investment, open-ended resource demand, environmental degradation, and mounting income inequalities.

zh: 需要新的模式来摆脱这些全套，并避免大部分高增长发展中国家在到达中国正在迅速靠近的收入门槛时陷入的可怕的“中等收入陷阱 ” 。
en: A new model was needed not only to escape such pitfalls, but also to avoid the dreaded “middle-income trap” that ensnares most fast-growing developing economies when they reach income thresholds that China was rapidly approaching.

zh: 温家宝的批评激起了激烈的内部争论，最后形成了一个重要战略决定 — — 通过向基于消费者的模式的转型实现中国经济再平衡，并写入了2011—2015年的十二五规划。
en: Wen’s critique triggered an intense internal debate that resulted in a key strategic decision to rebalance the Chinese economy by shifting to a consumer-based model, as framed by the 12th Five-Year Plan of 2011-2015.

zh: 这一新方针强调三个主要成分：转向服务业以增加就业创造；加速城市化以提高真实工资；以及更加坚挺的社会安全网向中国家庭提供安全保证从而让他们将从出于恐惧而进行的预防性储蓄中获得的收入用于自由裁量支出。
en: This new approach stressed three major components: a shift to services to boost job creation; accelerated urbanization to raise real wages; and a more robust social safety net to provide Chinese families with the security needed to channel their newfound income from fear-driven precautionary saving into discretionary consumption.

zh: 现已完成的十二五规划成果卓著 — — 特别是考虑到对任何经济体来说都十分艰巨的结构变化挑战。
en: The results of the now-completed 12th Five-Year Plan were impressive – especially in light of the formidable challenge that structural change implies for any economy.

zh: 但中国的战略重点在哪里影响最大 — — 这提供了一个指导中国经济从A点走向B点的整体框架。
en: But that’s where China’s strategic focus is most effective – providing an over-arching framework to guide the economy from point A to point B.

zh: 但这一过程还远未完成。
en: But this journey is far from complete.

zh: 中国的服务业和城市化目标超额完成，但最终结果在很多方面并未达到构建更加坚挺（即资金充裕）的社会安全网的目标。
en: While China’s targets for services and urbanization were exceeded, the end results fell short on many aspects of building a more robust (that is, fully funded) social safety net.

zh: 结果，个人消费只是从2010年仅占GDP的35%增加到2015年的37%左右。
en: As a result, personal consumption inched up from just 35% of GDP in 2010 to only about 37% in 2015.

zh: 尽管向消费拉动的再平衡尚未完成，中国目前仍开始了其核心经济战略的另一个转变 — — 其背后推动因素是范围广泛的“供给侧改革方案 ” ， 包括产能收缩、去杠杆、创新和生产率。
en: Notwithstanding the unfinished business of consumer-led rebalancing, China now appears to be embracing yet another shift in its core economic strategy – driven by a broad array of “supply-side initiatives” that range from capacity reduction and deleveraging to innovation and productivity.

zh: 这一着重点由李克强总理在最新《政府工作报告》中提出，该报告还提出了刚刚开始实施的十三五规划（2016—2020年）的新战略刚要。
en: That emphasis was formalized in Premier Li Keqiang’s recent “Work Report,” which outlined the new strategy of the just-enacted 13th Five-Year Plan (covering the 2016-20 period).

zh: 在确定2016年的“八大任务”中，李克强将供给侧改革排在第二 — — 仅次于应对增长放缓的经济稳定政策。
en: In identifying the top “eight tasks” for 2016, Li put supply-side reforms at number two – second only to the government’s focus on economic stability in countering China’s growth slowdown.

zh: 相反，对提振内需的强调 — — 长期以来一直是中国消费拉动再平衡战略的重点 — — 在所谓的工作议程中排位下降到第三。
en: By contrast, emphasis on boosting domestic demand – long the focus of China’s consumer-led rebalancing strategy – was downgraded to third place on the so-called work agenda.

zh: 在中国，内部争论总是被小心掩饰，不存在偶尔发生的事故。
en: In China, where internal debates are carefully scripted, nothing happens by accident.

zh: 在今年中国发展论坛的主旨演讲上，中共中央政治局常委、副总理张高丽强调了这一点，重点指出了引导供给侧方案对准中国“主要威胁”的必要。
en: In the keynote speech at this year’s CDF, Vice Premier and Politburo Standing Committee Member Zhang Gaoli drove this point home, emphasizing the need to direct supply-side initiatives at China’s “main threat.”

zh: 相反，对于消费者推动的再平衡，张高丽只是一带而过。
en: By contrast, there were only passing mentions of consumer-led rebalancing.

zh: 也许我有些钻牛角尖了。
en: Maybe I am guilty of splitting hairs.

zh: 毕竟，所有经济体都需要同时注重增长等式的供给和需求侧。
en: After all, every economy needs to focus on both the supply and the demand sides of its growth equation.

zh: 但强调点的转变 — — 包括十三五规划以及今年中国发展论坛的争论和吹风 — — 似乎是一个重要的信号。
en: But this shift in emphasis – in the 13th Five-Year Plan as well as in the debate and messaging at this year’s China Development Forum – appears to be an important signal.

zh: 我担心这意味着过早地从消费者拉动模式回到中国的舒适区 — — 长期以来更加顺从于中央计划的产业工程的生产者模式。
en: I worry that it could indicate a premature shift away from the consumer-led model back to China’s comfort zone of a producer model that has long been more amenable to the industrial engineering of central planning.

zh: 战略是中国最大的优势，也是其结构转型承诺的信誉来源。
en: Strategy is China’s greatest strength, lending credibility to its commitment to structural transformation.

zh: 但要让中国消费者拥有活力还有很多事要做。
en: Yet much remains to bring the Chinese consumer to life.

zh: 诚然，这是一个艰巨的挑战。
en: Yes, it is a tough challenge.

zh: 但不再强调这一战略承诺可能让中国核心经济身份所要求的关键转变出现问题。
en: But de-emphasizing that strategic commitment could call into question a crucial shift now required of China’s core economic identity.

zh: 中国的坎坷新常态
en: China’s Bumpy New Normal

zh: 发自上海 — — 中国正在实施的从出口驱动型向基于国内服务和家庭消费的增长模式转型要比一些人预想中更多波折，而股市暴跌和汇率波动则体现了对该国经济稳定状况的忧虑。
en: SHANGHAI – China’s shift from export-driven growth to a model based on domestic services and household consumption has been much bumpier than some anticipated, with stock-market gyrations and exchange-rate volatility inciting fears about the country’s economic stability.

zh: 不过按历史标准衡量，中国的经济仍然表现良好 — — 接近7%的GDP年增长率在某些人看来已经非常好了 — — 而中国在过去三十年间取得的巨大成功则催生了很高的期望。
en: Yet by historical standards, China’s economy is still performing well – at near 7% annual GDP growth, some might say very well – but success on the scale that China has seen over the past three decades breeds high expectations.

zh: 一个基本的教训是 ： “ 中国特色的市场”就跟美国特色的市场一样充满波动和难以控制。
en: There is a basic lesson: “Markets with Chinese characteristics” are as volatile and hard to control as markets with American characteristics.

zh: 市场一贯都有自身的生命力；也不太愿意按指令行事。
en: Markets invariably take on a life of their own; they cannot be easily ordered around.

zh: 在某种程度上，控制市场就得通过某种透明的方式来设置游戏规则。
en: To the extent that markets can be controlled, it is through setting the rules of the game in a transparent way.

zh: 所有的市场都需要规章制度。
en: All markets need rules and regulations.

zh: 好的规则可以帮助稳定市场。
en: Good rules can help stabilize markets.

zh: 而设计有缺陷的规则，无论出发点是多么用心良苦，都可以产生反效果。
en: Badly designed rules, no matter how well intentioned, can have the opposite effect.

zh: 比如有了1987年美国股市崩盘的前车之鉴，全世界都知道了设立熔断机制的重要性；但如果设计不当，这种改革反而会增加波动性。
en: For example, since the 1987 stock-market crash in the United States, the importance of having circuit breakers has been recognized; but if improperly designed, such reforms can increase volatility.

zh: 如果两个级别的熔断 — — 短期和长期交易暂停 — — 被设置得太过接近，一旦触发第一级，市场参与者会意识到第二级很快会来到，于是争相逃离市场。
en: If there are two levels of circuit breaker – a short-term and a long-term suspension of trading – and they are set too close to each other, once the first is triggered, market participants, realizing the second is likely to kick in as well, could stampede out of the market.

zh: 此外，市场状况与实体经济之间只会有松散的联系，而最近的大衰退就说明了这一点。
en: Moreover, what happens in markets may be only loosely coupled with the real economy. The recent Great Recession illustrates this.

zh: 尽管美国股市已强劲复苏，实体经济却依然低迷。
en: While the US stock market has had a robust recovery, the real economy has remained in the doldrums.

zh: 尽管如此，股市和汇率的波动可以产生真正的影响。
en: Still, stock-market and exchange-rate volatility can have real effects.

zh: 不确定性可能会导致较低水平的消费和投资（这就是为何政府应把目标放在巩固稳定的规则之上 ） 。
en: Uncertainty may lead to lower consumption and investment (which is why governments should aim for rules that buttress stability).

zh: 而更重要的则是管理实体经济的规则。
en: What matters more, though, are the rules governing the real economy.

zh: 在今日的中国，正如35年前的美国一样，存在着究竟是供应侧还是需求侧措施才最可能恢复增长的讨论。
en: In China today, as in the US 35 years ago, there is a debate about whether supply-side or demand-side measures are most likely to restore growth.

zh: 而美国的经验和许多其他案例则可以提供一些答案。
en: The US experience and many other cases provide some answers.

zh: 首先，在存在充分就业的情况下最好实施供应侧措施。
en: For starters, supply-side measures can best be undertaken when there is full employment.

zh: 在缺乏足够需求的情况下，提高供应侧效率只会导致更严重的资源利用不足。
en: In the absence of sufficient demand, improving supply-side efficiency simply leads to more underutilization of resources.

zh: 把劳动力从低生产率活动向零生产率的失业迁移并不会增加产量。
en: Moving labor from low-productivity uses to zero-productivity unemployment does not increase output.

zh: 而如今全球总需求的缺乏也需要政府采取刺激消费的措施。
en: Today, deficient global aggregate demand requires governments to undertake measures that boost spending.

zh: 这些支出可以用在很多很好的地方。
en: Such spending can be put to many good uses.

zh: 当今中国的关键需求包括减少不平等现象，遏制环境恶化，打造宜居城市，以及投资于公共卫生，教育，基础设施和技术。
en: China’s critical needs today include reducing inequality, stemming environmental degradation, creating livable cities, and investments in public health, education, infrastructure, and technology.

zh: 当局还需要加强在食品，建筑，医药和其他许多方面的安全监管能力。
en: The authorities also need to strengthen regulatory capacity to ensure the safety of food, buildings, medicines and much else.

zh: 这些投资所产生的社会回报也将远远超过其资金成本。
en: Social returns from such investments far exceed the costs of capital.

zh: 中国过去的错误在于过于依赖债务融资。
en: China’s mistake in the past has been to rely too heavily on debt financing.

zh: 但中国也有足够的空间去以提高整体效率和/或资产的方式增加其税基。
en: But China also has ample room to increase its tax base in ways that would increase overall efficiency and/or equity.

zh: 环境税可能会在带来大量政府收入的情况下催生更好的空气和水质量；拥堵税将改善城市的生活质量；财产和资本利得税能刺激更多向生产性活动增加投资，促进经济增长。
en: Environmental taxes could lead to better air and water quality, even as they raise substantial revenues; congestion taxes would improve quality of life in cities; property and capital-gains taxes would encourage higher investment in productive activities, promoting growth.

zh: 简而言之，只要设计合理，平衡预算措施 — — 在提升支出的同时增加税收 — — 就相当于一个庞大刺激计划。
en: In short, if designed correctly, balanced-budget measures – increasing taxes in tandem with expenditures –could provide a large stimulus to the economy.

zh: 中国也不应落入强调过去供应侧措施的陷阱。
en: Nor should China fall into the trap of emphasizing backward-looking supply-side measures.

zh: 在美国，那些坐落于内华达州沙漠中的劣质房屋是被浪费的资源。
en: In the US, resources were wasted when shoddy homes were built in the middle of the Nevada desert.

zh: 但首要任务不是清拆那些房屋（以巩固住房市场 ） ； 而是确保资源能在未来得到有效分配。
en: But the first priority is not to knock down those homes (in an effort to consolidate the housing market); it is to ensure that resources are allocated efficiently in the future.

zh: 事实上，在任何初级经济学课程的第一周所教授的基本原则都是要向前看 — — 不要打翻的牛奶哭泣。
en: Indeed, the basic principle taught in the first weeks of any elementary economics course is to let bygones be bygones – don’t cry over spilt milk.

zh: 低成本的钢材（以低于长期平均生产成本却等于或高于边际成本的价格供应）对其他行业来说显然是福音。
en: Low-cost steel (provided at prices below the long-term average cost of production but at or above the marginal cost) may be a distinct advantage for other industries.

zh: 比如说，消除美国的光纤产能过剩状况可能是错误的（美国企业在1990年代从中大举获益 ） 。
en: It would have been a mistake, for example, to destroy America’s excess capacity in fiber optics, from which US firms gained enormously in the 1990s.

zh: 与未来潜在未来使用相关的“选项”价值应该与维护的最低成本相权衡。
en: The “option” value associated with potential future uses should always be contrasted with the minimal cost of maintenance.

zh: 而中国在产能过剩问题方面面临的挑战是，那些失去工作的人将需要某种形式的援助；企业会要求大笔救助款以减少自身损失。
en: The challenge facing China as it confronts the problem of excess capacity is that those who would otherwise lose their jobs will require some form of support; firms will argue for a robust bailout to minimize their losses.

zh: 但如果政府能把有效的需求侧措施和积极劳动力市场政策相结合，那么至少就业问题能得到有效解决，还可以设计出最优的 — — 或者至少是合理的 — — 经济结构调整政策。
en: But if the government accompanied effective demand-side measures with active labor-market policies, at least the employment problem could be effectively addressed, and optimal – or at least reasonable – policies for economic restructuring could be designed.

zh: 此外还有一个宏观通缩的问题。
en: There is also a macro-deflationary problem.

zh: 产能过剩增加了价格下行的压力，对负债企业产生了负外部性，令企业感到（计入通胀后）真实杠杆有所增加。
en: Excess capacity fuels downward pressure on prices, with negative externalities on indebted firms, which experience an increase in their real (inflation-adjusted) leverage.

zh: 但比一个比巩固供应侧更好的做法是积极的需求方扩张，这将遏制通缩压力。
en: But a far better approach than supply-side consolidation is aggressive demand-side expansion, which would counter deflationary pressures.

zh: 经济原则和政治因素是众所周知的。
en: The economic principles and political factors are thus well known.

zh: 但针对中国经济的讨论往往被天真的供应侧改革提议所主导 — — 伴随着对2008年全球金融危机后采取的需求侧措施的批评。
en: But too often the debate about China’s economy has been dominated by naive proposals for supply-side reform – accompanied by criticism of the demand-side measures adopted after the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 这些措施远远称不上完善；在意外的紧急状态下必须在执行的同时得到规管。
en: Those measures were far from perfect; they had to be formulated on the fly, in the context of an unexpected emergency.

zh: 但这要远胜于呆在原地毫无应对。
en: But they were far better than nothing.

zh: 这是因为以次优的方式使用资源总是比不使用要好；如果没有2008年后的刺激，中国将遭遇大规模失业。
en: That is because using resources in suboptimal ways is always better than not using them at all; in the absence of the post-2008 stimulus, China would have suffered substantial unemployment.

zh: 如果当局能实施设计更完善的需求方改革，他们将有更大空间去实施全面的供应侧改革。
en: If the authorities embrace better-designed demand-side reforms, they will have greater scope for more comprehensive supply-side reforms.

zh: 此外，一些必要的供应侧改革的幅度将显着减少，正是由于需求侧的措施将减少供应过剩。
en: Moreover, the magnitude of some of the necessary supply-side reforms will be markedly diminished, precisely because the demand-side measures will reduce excess supply.

zh: 这可不仅仅是发生在世界另一端的西方凯恩斯主义者和供给侧经济学家之间的一个学术争论。
en: This is not just an academic debate between Western Keynesian and supply-side economists, now being played out on the other side of the world.

zh: 因为中国实施的政策手段将极大影响全球的经济表现和前景。
en: The policy approach China adopts will strongly influence economic performance and prospects worldwide.

zh: 解构中国的经济恢复力
en: Deciphering China’s Economic Resilience

zh: 纽黑文—中国经济再一次否定了消极论者的聒噪。
en: NEW HAVEN – Once again, the Chinese economy has defied the hand wringing of the nattering nabobs of negativism.

zh: 在经历了连续六年的减速后，真实GDP增长在2017年呈现出上扬之势。
en: After decelerating for six consecutive years, real GDP growth appears to be inching up in 2017.

zh: 据最新报道，中国GDP第二季度年化增长率为6.9 % ， 高于2016年的6.7 % ， 也远高于国际预测者的共识。 几个月前，他们认为中国增长今年将接近6.5 % ， 2018年将进一步放缓至6 % 。
en: The 6.9% annualized increase just reported for the second quarter exceeds the 6.7% rise in 2016 and is well above the consensus of international forecasters who, just a few months ago, expected growth to be closer to 6.5% this year, and to slow further, to 6%, in 2018.

zh: 我一直指出，过度关注标题GDP导致人们忽略了中国增长讨论中的更深层次的问题。
en: I have long argued that the fixation on headline GDP overlooks deeper issues shaping the China growth debate.

zh: 这是因为，中国经济正处在一个波澜壮阔的结构转变过程中 — — 制造业领衔的生产国模式将让位给日益强大的服务业推动的消费国模式。
en: That is because the Chinese economy is in the midst of an extraordinary structural transformation – with a manufacturing-led producer model giving way to an increasingly powerful services-led consumer model.

zh: 这意味着GDP的组成将从投资和出口的超快速增长，转变为增长相对缓慢的内部私人消费，因此，总体GDP增长将是不可避免的，也是应有之义。
en: To the extent that this implies a shift in the mix of GDP away from exceptionally rapid gains in investment and exports, toward relatively slower-growing internal private consumption, a slowdown in overall GDP growth is both inevitable and desirable.

zh: 对于中国疲软的观点，应该放到这一环境中去考察。
en: Perceptions of China’s vulnerability need to be considered in this context.

zh: 这一争论由来已久。
en: This debate has a long history.

zh: 我第一次看到它可以追溯到20世纪90年代末亚洲金融危机期间。
en: I first caught a whiff of it back in the late 1990s, during the Asian financial crisis.

zh: 危机从泰国和印尼，蔓延到韩国和台湾，人们普遍认为中国将是下一个。
en: From Thailand and Indonesia to South Korea and Taiwan, China was widely thought to be next.

zh: 1998年10月 ， 《 经济学人 》 （ The Economist）刊登了生动的封面配图，中国废墟被一个强大的漩涡吞没。 这说明了一切。
en: An October 1998 cover story in The Economist, vividly illustrated by a Chinese junk getting sucked into a powerful whirlpool, said it all.

zh: 然而这一预言大错特错。
en: Yet nothing could have been further from the truth.

zh: 中国硬是成为东南亚覆巢之下的完卵。
en: When the dust settled on the virulent pan-regional contagion, the Chinese economy had barely skipped a beat.

zh: 真实GDP增长在1998—1999年期间暂时性地下降到7.7 % ， 但在随后的十年中又再次升高到10.3 % 。
en: Real GDP growth slowed temporarily, to 7.7% in 1998-1999, before reaccelerating to 10.3% in the subsequent decade.

zh: 中国在金融大危机期间所表现出来的恢复力同样很能说明问题。
en: China’s resilience during the Great Financial Crisis was equally telling.

zh: 在这场20世纪30年代以来最糟糕的全球衰退中，2008—2009年中国经济仍然能够以平均每年9.4%的速度扩张。
en: In the midst of the worst global contraction since the 1930s, the Chinese economy still expanded at a 9.4% average annual rate in 2008-2009.

zh: 尽管这比危机前三年间不可持续的12.7%的增长率低了不少，但和1980年以来的30年趋势10%相比只是略微下降。
en: While down from the blistering, unsustainable 12.7% pace recorded during the three years prior to the crisis, this represented only a modest shortfall from the 30-year post-1980 trend of 10%.

zh: 事实上，若非中国在最近的衰退中表现出卓越的恢复力，世界GDP在2009年就不会只收缩0.1 % ， 而将下降1.3 % — —第二次世界大战结束以来最严重的全球经济活动萎缩。
en: Indeed, were it not for China’s resilience in the depths of the recent crisis, world GDP would not have contracted by 0.1% in 2009, but would have plunged by 1.3% – the sharpest decline in global activity of the post-World War II era.

zh: 针对中国经济的最大悲观论关注两大问题，即去杠杆和与之相关的房地产市场紧缩 — — 本质上，就是日本式停滞。
en: The latest bout of pessimism over the Chinese economy has focused on the twin headwinds of deleveraging and a related tightening of the property market – in essence, a Japanese-like stagnation.

zh: 但在这里，西方的视角再次对错了焦。
en: Once more, the Western lens is out of focus.

zh: 和日本一样，中国是一个高储蓄经济体，其高企的债务基本都是内债。
en: Like Japan, China is a high-saving economy that owes its mounting debt largely to itself.

zh: 并且，中国还有一个日本所不具有的缓冲可以用来避免可持续性问题。
en: Yet, if anything, China has more of a cushion than Japan to avoid sustainability problems.

zh: 据国际货币基金组织（IMF）数据，2017年中国国民储蓄可能高达GDP的45 % ， 远高于28%的日本储蓄率。
en: According to the International Monetary Fund, China’s national savings is likely to hit 45% of GDP in 2017, well above Japan’s 28% saving rate.

zh: 日本的总政府债务高达GDP的239 % ， 仍然能够避免主权债务危机。 类似地，中国拥有更大的储蓄缓冲和更小的主权债务负担（GDP的49 % ） ，其避免内部崩溃的形势远远优于日本。
en: Just as Japan, with its gross government debt at 239% of GDP, has been able to sidestep a sovereign debt crisis, China, with its far larger saving cushion and much smaller sovereign debt burden (49% of GDP), is in much better shape to avoid such an implosion.

zh: 平心而论，中国确实存在企业债务迅速积累的问题 — — 据估算，非金融债务-GDP之比在2016年年底高达GDP的157 % （ 2008年年底为102 % ） 。
en: To be sure, there can be no mistaking China’s mounting corporate debt problem – with nonfinancial debt-to-GDP ratios hitting an estimated 157% of GDP in late 2016 (versus 102% in late 2008).

zh: 这意味着必须将实施国有企业改革列为未来几年的重中之重。 国有企业是中国企业债务增量的大头。
en: This makes the imperatives of state-owned enterprise reform, where the bulk of rising indebtedness has been concentrated, all the more essential in the years ahead.

zh: 此外，对于中国的房地产市场，始终存在令人担忧的理由。
en: Moreover, there is always good reason to worry about the Chinese property market.

zh: 毕竟，崛起的中产阶级需要平价住房。
en: After all, a rising middle class needs affordable housing.

zh: 随着中国城镇人口比例从1980年的20%增长到2016年的56 % — —到2030年极有可能达到70 % — —这绝不是一件小事。
en: With the urban share of China’s population rising from less than 20% in 1980 to more than 56% in 2016 – and most likely headed to 70% by 2030 – this is no trivial consideration.

zh: 但这意味着中国房地产市场 — — 和充分城市化的主要经济体不同 — — 拥有来自需求端的充分支持，在未来10—15年中，城镇人口有望保持1—2%的年化增长率。
en: But this means that Chinese property markets – unlike those of other fully urbanized major economies – enjoy ample support from the demand side, with the urban population likely to remain on a 1-2% annualized growth trajectory over the next 10-15 years.

zh: 2005年以来，中国住房价格上涨了近50 % — —是全球正常水平的近五倍（据国际清算银行和IMF全球住房观察数据 ） — —平价性显然是一个合理的关注点。
en: With Chinese home prices up nearly 50% since 2005 – nearly five times the global norm (according to the Bank for International Settlements and IMF global housing watch) – affordability is obviously a legitimate concern.

zh: 中国面临的挑战是审慎地管理住房供给的增长，从而既满足城镇化需求的需要，又不产生过度投机和危险的资产泡沫。
en: The challenge for China is to manage prudently the growth in housing supply needed to satisfy the demand requirements of urbanization, without fostering excessive speculation and dangerous asset bubbles.

zh: 与此同时，2017年上半年中国经济还获得了周期性恢复力的强大支撑。
en: Meanwhile the Chinese economy is also drawing support from strong sources of cyclical resilience in early 2017.

zh: 6月份，中国出口同比增长11.3 % ， 与此前几年饱受危机后全球恢复萎靡的不利影响的局面形成了鲜明的对比。
en: The 11.3% year-on-year gain in exports recorded in June stands in sharp contrast with earlier years, which were adversely affected by a weaker post-crisis global recovery.

zh: 类似地，2017年上半年，经通胀调整的零售额实现了10%的年化增长 — — 比6.9%的总体GDP增长速度快了大约4.5 % — —这反映了家庭收入的迅速增长和电子商务推动力的日益强大（并且可能被低估 ） 。
en: Similarly, 10% annualized gains in inflation-adjusted retail sales through mid-2017 – about 45% faster than the 6.9% pace of overall GDP growth – reflect impressive growth in household incomes and the increasingly powerful (and possibly under-reported) impetus of e-commerce.

zh: 长期以来，悲观论者总是把中国经济与本国经济作比较 — — 重复着耶鲁大学历史学家史景迁（Jonathan Spence）的著名观点在多年前就发出警告的典型错误。
en: Pessimists have long viewed the Chinese economy as they view their own economies – repeating a classic mistake that Yale historian Jonathan Spence’s seminal assessment warned of many years ago.

zh: 人们普遍认为，重创日本和美国的资产泡沫也会给中国带来同样的威胁。
en: The asset bubbles that broke Japan and the United States are widely presumed to pose the same threat in China.

zh: 类似地，中国最近的债务密集性经济增长狂欢也被认为是在重蹈其他国家的覆辙。
en: Likewise, China’s recent binge of debt-intensive economic growth is expected to have the same consequences as such episodes elsewhere.

zh: 预测家总是难以抗拒把受大危机重创过的发达经济体的经验生搬硬套到中国头上的诱惑。
en: Forecasters find it difficult to resist superimposing the outcomes in major crisis-battered developed economies on China.

zh: 在过去，这种方法一直是错误的；今天，它将再次证明是错误的。
en: That has been the wrong approach in the past; it is wrong again today.

zh: 中国的恶性增长循环
en: China’s Vicious Growth Circle

zh: 伦敦—大部分经济学家都有为中国经济担心的原因 — — 消费不足和巨大的外部盈余啦，工业产能过剩啦，环境破坏啦，资本管制或金融抑制之类的政府干预啦，等等。
en: LONDON – Most economists have a reason to be worried about China’s economy – whether it be low consumption and large external surpluses, industrial overcapacity, environmental degradation, or government interventions like capital controls or financial repression.

zh: 很多人没有意识到的是，这些大多只是同一个根本问题的症候：中国增长模式存在缺陷。
en: What many fail to recognize is that these are merely the symptoms of a single underlying problem: China’s skewed growth model.

zh: 从某正程度上说，这一模式是政策导致的结构，是根深蒂固地偏好建筑和制造业作为经济发展主要引擎的结果。
en: That model is, to some extent, a policy-induced construct, the result of a deep-rooted bias toward construction and manufacturing as the leading drivers of economic development.

zh: 这一偏好可以追溯到20世纪50年代的大跃进，在这场运动中，为了满足太过于乐观的钢铁产量目标，进而实现毛泽东的快速工业化梦想，炼出了大量废金属。
en: This predilection harkens back to the Great Leap Forward of the 1950s, when scrap metal was melted to meet wildly optimistic steel-production targets, thereby advancing Mao’s dream of rapid industrialization.

zh: 如今，中国对工业产量的热衷可以从大规模制造业和基础设施工程中一览无余，这些工程的背后是直接和间接的政府补贴。
en: Today, China’s proclivity for industrial production is manifested in large-scale manufacturing and infrastructure projects, encouraged by direct and indirect government subsidies.

zh: 这一方针能刺激投资、为地方政府带来税收收入，因此比发展服务业的政策对GDP有更加迅速的积极影响。
en: By boosting investment and generating tax revenue for local governments, this approach has a more immediate positive impact on GDP than efforts to develop the service sector.

zh: 但该模式也带来了巨大的代价。
en: But the model also carries considerable costs.

zh: 事实上，如今中国陷入了一个恶行经济循环，这一循环由看似无关，但事实上彼此关系紧密甚至是共生关系的扭曲性政策维持。
en: Indeed, China is now locked in a vicious economic circle, sustained by seemingly unrelated distortionary policies that are, in fact, deeply interconnected, even symbiotic.

zh: 这一模式的一个最显著的特征是中国GDP增长（在过去几十年中平均每年接近10 % ） 与其就业增长（每年只增加1—2 % ） 之间的不匹配。
