en: One of the most glaring features of this pattern is the disparity between China’s GDP growth, which has averaged nearly 10% annually over the last few decades, and its employment growth, which has amounted to just 1-2% annually.

zh: 显然，工业化和出口扩张无法吸收中国巨大的劳动力。
en: Clearly, industrialization and export expansion alone cannot absorb China’s massive labor force.

zh: 问题在于，工业部门快速的劳动生产率增长（过去二十年每年大于10 % ） 正在减少雇用更多工人的需要。
en: The problem is that rapid labor-productivity growth in the industrial sector – more than 10% per year over the last two decades – is reducing the need to hire more workers.

zh: 相反，服务业劳动生产率增长要缓慢得多（过去二十年每年大约5 % ） ，这意味着其在创造就业增长方面远比工业部门有效。
en: The service sector, by contrast, experienced much slower labor-productivity growth (about 5% annually over the same period), meaning that it could be far more effective in generating employment growth.

zh: 在美国，2012年80%左右的劳动力在服务业中就业。
en: In the United States, about 80% of the total labor force was deployed in the services sector in 2012.

zh: 中国有缺陷的增长模式的另一个后果是家庭收入占GDP比重从1990年的70%下降到2009年的60 % ， 而（比如）美国的这一比例稳定在GDP的80%左右。
en: Another consequence of China’s skewed growth model has been a decline in household income as a share of GDP, from 70% in 1990 to 60% in 2009, whereas in the US, for example, the ratio has remained stable, at around 80% of GDP.

zh: 换句话说，中国家庭并没有获得经济增长的好处。
en: In other words, Chinese households are missing out on the benefits of economic growth.

zh: 这一现象也可以主要归咎为扭曲性政策。
en: This phenomenon, too, can be blamed largely on distortionary policies.

zh: 为了限制劳动力成本的上升，工资被抑制，在过去20年中每年只增加5 % ， 尽管生产率增长年率高达8.5 % 。
en: In order to cap the rise in labor costs, wages were suppressed, growing by only 5% annually over the last 20 years, even as productivity grew at an annual rate of 8.5%.

zh: 与此同时，金融抑制降低了资本成本。
en: Meanwhile, financial repression lowered the cost of capital.

zh: 在过去十年中，存款平均真实（经通胀调整）回报接近于零。
en: In the last decade, the average real (inflation-adjusted) return on deposits has been near zero.

zh: 中国家庭储蓄中有大约80%是银行存款，这一隐性存款税带来了巨大的经济影响，强化了中国家庭的储蓄倾向，从而削弱了消费增长、恶化了全球失衡。
en: With about 80% of Chinese household savings deposited in banks, this implicit tax on savings has had a major economic impact, reinforcing Chinese households’ tendency to save and thus undermining consumption growth and exacerbating global imbalances.

zh: 中国的扭曲性政策就这样长期维持着一个功能不健全的增长模式。
en: In this way, China’s distortionary policies have helped to perpetuate a dysfunctional growth model.

zh: 工资抑制、金融抑制和汇率低估补贴了出口和生产，而承担代价的是被迫存款的家庭，这削弱了内需。
en: Wage suppression, financial repression, and an undervalued exchange rate subsidize exports and production, at the expense of households, which are thus compelled to save, weakening domestic demand.

zh: 为了实现增长目标，政府不得不依靠出口和投资 — — 从而积累起巨额储备，而储备必须予以冲销。
en: In order to achieve growth targets, the government thus must depend on exports and investment – an approach that leads to the accumulation of massive reserves, which subsequently need to be sterilized.

zh: 低利率有助于遏制国家层面的冲销成本、降低了企业成本 — — 而承受代价的又是家庭。
en: Low interest rates help to contain the cost of sterilization at the national level and reduce costs at the firm level – again at the expense of households.

zh: 打破这一循环并不容易，但要解决中国经济所面临的大部分紧迫问题，没有别的路可走。
en: Breaking the cycle will not be easy, but there is no other way to address many of the most pressing problems confronting China’s economy.

zh: 事实上，当前的增长模式还对环境造成了重大影响，污染威胁着人民的健康，特别��在城市地区。
en: Indeed, the current growth model is also taking a heavy toll on the environment, with pollution threatening the population’s health, especially in urban areas.

zh: 此外，偏好制造和出口也导致了严重的资本错配。
en: Moreover, the bias toward manufacturing and export industries leads to a severe misallocation of capital.

zh: 低效率行业积累了大量过剩产能，动摇着整个经济，而生产率更高的高效率行业又难以获得需要的资源。
en: Less efficient industrial sectors have accumulated significant excess capacity, destabilizing the entire economy, while more productive, efficient sectors lack access to the resources they need.

zh: 因此，重组经济也许是当今中国领导人所面临的最紧迫也是最艰难的挑战。
en: Restructuring the economy is perhaps the most urgent – and most difficult – challenge facing China’s leaders today.

zh: 当前的诸多扭曲盘根错节，必须同时解决。
en: Given that the current distortions are interlinked, they may need to be addressed simultaneously.

zh: 中国的渐进方针也许不再管用了。
en: China’s gradualist approach may no longer work.

zh: 中国的慢增长机会
en: China’s Slow-Growth Opportunity

zh: 北京—在经历了令人失望的四年后，中国经济学家已经意识到，GDP增长的放缓 — — 从2010年危机后峰值12.8%下降到今天的7%左右 — — 主要是结构性的，而不是周期性的。
en: BEIJING – After four disappointing years, Chinese economists have realized that slowing GDP growth – from a post-crisis peak of 12.8% in 2010 to about 7% today – is mainly structural, rather than cyclical.

zh: 换句话说，中国潜在增长率已经下降到显著更低的平台。
en: In other words, China’s potential growth rate has settled onto a significantly lower plateau.

zh: 尽管中国应能避免硬着陆，但可以预期未来十年年增长率保持在6—7 % 。
en: While the country should be able to avoid a hard landing, it can expect annual growth to remain at 6-7% over the next decade.

zh: 但这未必是坏消息。
en: But this may not necessarily be bad news.

zh: 你也许会问，为何人均收入最近才越过7,000美元的中国，其GDP即将比1956—1970年的日本慢许多。 1956—1970年，日本人均收入也在7,000美元左右，但其年增长率平均为9.7 % 。
en: One might question why GDP in China, where per capita income recently surpassed $7,000, is set to grow so much more slowly than Japan’s did from 1956 to 1970, when the Japanese economy, with per capita income starting from about $7,000, averaged 9.7% annual growth.

zh: 答案就在于潜在增长率。
en: The answer lies in potential growth.

zh: 据日本银行的数据，1960至1973年间，日本劳动生产率平均每年增长10%以上，而中国生产率增长在近几年中稳步下降从2001—2008年的11.8%下降到2008—2012年的8.8 % ， 2011—2012年又下降到7.4 % 。
en: Whereas, according to Japan’s central bank, Japanese labor productivity grew by more than 10% annually, on average, from 1960 to 1973, Chinese productivity has been declining steadily in recent years, from 11.8% in 2001-2008 to 8.8% in 2008-2012, and to 7.4% in 2011-2012.

zh: 日本劳动供给（以劳动时长衡量）也在1960至1973年期间有所增长，每年增长幅度超过3 % 。
en: Japan’s labor supply (measured in labor hours) was also growing during that period, by more than 3% annually.

zh: 相反，自2012年以来，中国工作年龄人口开始下降，每年下降规模超过三百万 — — 这一趋势将以4—6年的时滞导致劳动供给增长下降甚至由正转负。
en: By contrast, China’s working-age population has been shrinking, by more than three million annually, since 2012 – a trend that will, with a 4-6-year lag, cause labor-supply growth to decline, and even turn negative.

zh: 扭转这些趋势很困难，因此很难想象中国如何能够在未来十年继续维持接近10%的增长率，尽管其人均收入仍然较低。
en: Given the difficulty of reversing these trends, it is difficult to imagine how China could maintain a growth rate anywhere close to 10% for another decade, despite its low per capita income.

zh: 但还有其他原因。
en: But there is more.

zh: 日本经济学家馆龙一郎（Ryuichiro Tachi）指出，日本还从高储蓄率和小于1的低资本系数（资本与产出的比率）中获益。
en: As the Japanese economist Ryuichiro Tachi has pointed out, Japan also benefited from a high savings rate and a low capital coefficient (the ratio of capital to output) of less than 1.

zh: 尽管精确比较十分困难，但毫无疑问中国资本系数要远高于日本，这意味着更大的资本密集度（每一美元收入所需要的资本总量）和劳动生产率增长缺口。
en: Though a precise comparison is difficult, there is no doubt that China’s capital coefficient is much higher, implying a larger gap between the growth rate of capital intensity (the total amount of capital needed per dollar of revenue) and that of labor productivity.

zh: 有时，高储蓄率可以抵消高资本系数对增长的负面影响。
en: At times, a high investment rate can offset a high capital coefficient’s negative impact on growth.

zh: 但中国的储蓄率已经过高，几乎占了GDP的一半。
en: But China’s investment rate is already too high, accounting for almost half of GDP.

zh: 由于中国资本密集度增长远高于劳动生产率，投资的低效率显而易见。
en: With capital intensity increasing significantly faster than labor productivity in China, the inefficiency of investment is clear.

zh: 在这样的情况下，提高投资只能恶化问题。
en: In this context, increased investment would only exacerbate the problem.

zh: 更糟糕的是，中国的公司债务已是世界最高，不管以绝对值衡量还是以相对GDP衡量都是如此。
en: Making matters worse, China’s corporate debt is already the highest in the world, both in absolute terms and relative to GDP.

zh: 在这样的情况下，增加投资不但会进一步抑制资本效率，还会增加公司高杠杆率带来的风险。
en: In this context, increasing investment would not only reduce capital efficiency further; it would also heighten the risk implied by companies’ high leverage ratios.

zh: 所有主要主表都表明中国增长潜力将显著下降，中国领导人必须接受增长放缓的现实并据此调整重点。
en: With all major indicators suggesting a significant decline in China’s growth potential, China’s leaders must accept the reality of lower growth and adjust their priorities accordingly.

zh: 接受大规模货币和财政刺激的诱惑 — — 如全球经济危机爆发时那样 — — 不但不能刺激可持续增长；实际上还会破坏中长期增长和稳定。
en: Succumbing to the temptation of massive monetary and fiscal stimulus, such as that pursued in the wake of the global economic crisis, would not only fail to boost growth in a sustainable way; it would actually undermine growth and stability in the medium to long term.

zh: 更好的方针是将重点放在让经济增长更加可持续。
en: A better approach would focus on making economic growth more sustainable.

zh: 在这一问题上，日本可以提供一些有用的教益。
en: On this issue, Japan has some useful lessons to offer.

zh: 20世纪70年代，日本意识到放缓已不可避免，提出了“改造”日本列岛的宏大计划。
en: In the 1970s, recognizing the inevitability of a slowdown, Japan shelved its ambitious plan to “remodel” the Japanese archipelago.

zh: 决策者关闭了重化工业的能源密集型工厂，刺激创新，并采取措施解决空气和水污染。
en: Policymakers shut down energy-intensive factories in the heavy chemical industry, promoted innovation, and took steps to address air and water pollution.

zh: 结果，日本经济增长质量大幅改善，虽然其增长率在1973年石油冲击后的十年中下降了近一半。
en: As a result, the quality of Japan’s economic growth improved considerably, even as its rate fell by nearly half in the decade after the oil shock in 1973.

zh: 好消息是中国领导人似乎倾向于采取类似地方方针，包括直到增长要崩溃才考虑货币和财政扩张。
en: The good news is that China’s leaders seem intent on adopting a similar approach, including avoidance of monetary and fiscal expansion, unless growth seems set to collapse.

zh: 事实上，在最近结束的全国人大会议上，李克强总理确认今年当局的GDP增长目标为7 % ， 并重申了深化改革、实施结构调整的重要性。
en: Indeed, at the recently concluded National People’s Congress, Prime Minister Li Keqiang affirmed the authorities’ 7% target for GDP growth this year, while reiterating the importance of deepening reform and carrying out structural adjustments.

zh: 对中国来说，接受更低的增长为支持稳定的可持续发展提供了关键机会。
en: For China, accepting lower growth provides a crucial opportunity to support stable and sustainable development.

zh: 如果中国领导人坚持改革和再平衡，全球经济都能从中获益。
en: If China’s leaders stay the course of reform and rebalancing, the entire global economy will be better off.

zh: 中国应该做什么？
en: What Should China Do?

zh: 斯坦福—中国政府大手笔遏制最近的股市波动 — — 最新的举措是禁止卖空和大股东减持 — — 严重损害了它的信誉。
en: STANFORD – The Chinese government’s heavy-handed efforts to contain recent stock-market volatility – the latest move prohibits short selling and sales by major shareholders – have seriously damaged its credibility.

zh: 但中国的政策失败并不令人惊奇。
en: But China’s policy failures should come as no surprise.

zh: 中国决策者绝非金融市场、货币和贸易管理不当的“先锋 ” 。
en: Policymakers there are far from the first to mismanage financial markets, currencies, and trade.

zh: 比如，20世纪90年代初，许多欧洲政府因为试图捍卫估值不正确的货币而蒙受了巨大损失。
en: Many European governments, for example, suffered humiliating losses defending currencies that were misaligned in the early 1990s.

zh: 不过，中国经济仍然是巨大的不确定性来源。
en: Still, China’s economy remains a source of significant uncertainty.

zh: 事实上，尽管中国股市以及实体经济表现之间的关系并不密切，但大减速已经开始。
en: Indeed, although the performance of China’s stock market and that of its real economy has not been closely correlated, a major slowdown is underway.

zh: 这是一个严重问题，令全世界财政部长、央行行长、交易界和进出口行业担心不已。
en: That is a serious concern, occupying finance ministries, central banks, trading desks, and importers and exporters worldwide.

zh: 中国政府相信它可以在从出口和投资推动的动辄两位数的经济增长向以国内消费特别是服务业消费为基础的稳定均衡增长的过程中实现软着陆。
en: China’s government believed that it could engineer a soft landing in the transition from torrid double-digit economic growth, fueled by exports and investments, to steady and balanced growth underpinned by domestic consumption, especially of services.

zh: 而事实上，中国政府也实施了一些明智的政策和改革。
en: And, in fact, it enacted some sensible policies and reforms.

zh: 但高增长掩盖了许多问题。
en: But rapid growth obscured many problems.

zh: 比如，官员们寻求通过实现短期经济目标确保升迁，这导致了资源配置不当；基础行业（如钢铁业和水泥业）累积了巨大的过剩产能；而银行和地方政府的资产负债表上也累积了大量不良贷款。
en: For example, officials, seeking to secure promotions by achieving short-term economic targets, misallocated resources; basic industries like steel and cement built up vast excess capacity; and bad loans accumulated on the balance sheets of banks and local governments.

zh: 最能体现这一问题莫过于城镇化规划，城镇化让大型新城市纷纷投入建设 — — 包括现代基础设施和大量住房 — — 却无人入住。
en: Nowhere are the problems with this approach more apparent than in the attempt to plan urbanization, which entailed the construction of large new cities – complete with modern infrastructure and plentiful housing – that have yet to be occupied.

zh: 从某种程度上讲，这些“鬼城”与沙俄的波将金村（Potemkin village）类似，只是为了个路过的沙皇皇后营造印象深刻的幻觉；但中国的鬼城是实实在在的，也许不仅仅是为了取悦领导人。
en: In a sense, these “ghost cities” resemble the Russian empire’s Potemkin villages, built to create an impressive illusion for the passing Czarina; but China’s ghost cities are real and were presumably meant to do more than flatter the country’s leaders.

zh: 如今，经济增长已经慢了下来 — — 官方年增长率数据为7 % ， 但大部分观察者认为接近5 % （ 甚至更低 ） — —中国的治理问题也变得不容忽视。
en: Now that economic growth is flagging – official statistics put the annual rate at 7%, but most observers believe the real number is closer to 5% (or even lower) – China’s governance problems are becoming impossible to ignore.

zh: 尽管中国的增长率仍超过当今绝大部分经济体，但放缓的规模令人担忧，其所造成的短期动态类似于美国或德国GDP从2%的增长变为3%的收缩。
en: Although China’s growth rate still exceeds that of all but a few economies today, the scale of the slowdown has been wrenching, with short-run dynamics similar to a swing in the United States or Germany from 2% GDP growth to a 3% contraction.

zh: 陷入严重经济问题的中国可能发生严重的社会和政治动荡。
en: A China beset by serious economic problems is likely to experience considerable social and political instability.

zh: 随着减速开始拖累就业创造，每年迁往中国城市的数百万人将更加难以找到优渥的生活，在这样的情况下，中国共产党的政治垄断合法性将受到质疑。
en: As the slowdown threatens to impede job creation, undermining the prospects of the millions of people moving to China’s cities each year in search of a more prosperous life, the Chinese Communist Party will struggle to maintain the legitimacy of its political monopoly.

zh: （从更广的角度看，中国问题，再加上俄罗斯的崩溃和委内瑞拉的60%的通货膨胀率，将让很多人不再相信国家资本主义优于市场经济。 ）
en: (More broadly, the weight of China’s problems, together with Russia’s collapse and Venezuela’s 60% inflation, has strained the belief of some that state capitalism trumps market economies.)

zh: 中国对于全球经济具有系统重要性，因此中国出现动荡所产生的危险远远不止于其国界线内。
en: Given China’s systemic importance to the global economy, instability there could pose major risks far beyond its borders.

zh: 中国是美国国债最大的外国持有者，美国、欧洲、拉丁美洲和澳大利亚的主要贸易伙伴，也是内亚贸易的关键推动者，这部分是因为其巨大的加工贸易规模。
en: China is the largest foreign holder of US Treasury securities, a major trade partner for the US, Europe, Latin America, and Australia, and a key facilitator of intra-Asian trade, owing partly to the scale of its processing trade.

zh: 中国对于世界可谓牵一发而动全身，而中国当局已经快要左支右绌了。
en: The world has a lot at stake in China, and China’s authorities have a lot on their plate.

zh: 中国政府必须解决减速的短期影响，同时继续实施旨在让经济平稳过渡到新增长模式和扩大市场作���的改革。 外国企业正在试图争夺中国快速增长的中产阶级。
en: The government must cope with the short-term effects of the slowdown while continuing to implement reforms aimed at smoothing the economy’s shift to a new growth model and expanding the role of markets.

zh: 据麦肯锡全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）估算，中国中产阶级已超过2亿人。
en: Foreign firms are seeking access to China’s rapidly growing middle class, which the McKinsey Global Institute estimates already exceeds 200 million.

zh: 但这需要稳定的商业环境，包括增加政府批准的透明度和放松资本管制。
en: But that implies a stable business environment, including more transparency in government approvals, and looser capital controls.

zh: 为了实现这些目标。 中国政府最近发动了温和的货币贬值 — — 到目前为止贬值了大约3 % 。
en: With these goals in mind, China’s government recently engineered a modest currency devaluation – about 3% so far.

zh: 这一幅度也许无法让中国与欧洲或美国的贸易平衡发生重大变化。
en: That is probably too small to alter China’s trade balance with Europe or the US significantly.

zh: 但它释放出一个向更加市场导向的汇率变化的信号。
en: But it signals a shift toward a more market-oriented exchange rate.

zh: 投资者、管理者和政府官员所想到的风险是货币市场 — — 或者受市场力量冲击的政府管理的货币 — — 常常动能过大，导致基础价值发生过度调整。
en: The risk on the minds of investors, managers, and government officials is that currency markets – or government-managed currencies buffeted by market forces – often develop too much momentum and overshoot fundamental values.

zh: 在中国政府使用货币政策稳定市场的同时，微观层面的改革必须继续进行。
en: As China’s government uses monetary policy to try to calm markets, micro-level reforms must continue.

zh: 中国必须在各行业部署新技术，同时改善工人的教育、培训和卫生情况。
en: China must deploy new technologies across industries, while improving workers’ education, training, and health.

zh: 此外，中国需要加强提振国内消费的力度，目前中国国内消费占GDP的比重仍远低于其他国家。
en: Moreover, China needs to accelerate its efforts to increase domestic consumption, which, as a share of GDP, is far below that of other countries.

zh: 这意味着降低前所未有的高储蓄率 — — 很大一部分储蓄流向了国有企业。
en: That means reducing the unprecedentedly high savings rate, a large share of which accrues to state-owned enterprises.

zh: 如果要让民营企业和家庭取代政府引导的投资成为经济的主要增长引擎，国家就必须降低在大企业中的股份，允许更多的利润直接分配给股东，并从剩余利润中拿出更多给公民。
en: If private firms and households are to replace government-led investment as the economy’s main drivers of growth, the state must reduce its stake in major enterprises and allow more profits to be paid directly to shareholders, while providing more of the profits from its remaining shares to citizens.

zh: 降低过度国家控制的转变还应该包括用针对低收入工人的定向支持和增加人力资本投资取代给予重点行业的补贴和补助。
en: The shift away from excessive state control should also include replacing price subsidies and grants to favored industries with targeted support for low-income workers and greater investment in human capital.

zh: 此外，中国必须减少行政自由裁量权，引入明智的、可预测的监管解决自然垄断和外部性问题。
en: In addition, China must reduce administrative discretion, introducing sensible, predictable regulation to address natural monopolies and externalities.

zh: 回到宏观层面，中国需要在各级政府间重新分配责任和资源，以利用它们在提供服务和筹集收入方面的比较优势。
en: Back at the macro level, China needs to reallocate responsibilities and resources among the various levels of government, in order to capitalize on their comparative advantage in providing services and raising revenue.

zh: 经济必须逐渐降低债务负担（目前已经超过GDP的250 % ） 。
en: And the country must gradually reduce its total debt load, which now exceeds 250% of GDP.

zh: 幸运的是，在面临前方艰巨的调整挑战时，中国3.6万亿美元的外汇储备可以作为不可避免的损失的缓冲垫。
en: Fortunately, in facing the difficult adjustment challenges that lie ahead, China’s $3.6 trillion in foreign-currency reserves can serve as a buffer against unavoidable losses.

zh: 但中国也必须避免重回加强国家对经济的控制的老路 — — 当局在股价出现修正走势时所表现出来的激烈反应凸显出这一可能性。
en: But China must also avoid reverting to greater state control of the economy – a possibility glimpsed in the authorities’ ham-fisted response to the correction in equity prices.

zh: 这条老路需要彻底抛弃，决不能让它对中国的长期稳定与繁荣造成更大伤害。
en: That approach needs to be abandoned once and for all, before it does any more damage to China’s quest for long-term stability and prosperity.

zh: 中国能避免通缩吗？
en: Can China Avoid Deflation?

zh: 北京—在2015年达沃斯世界经济论坛上，中国总理李克强在讲话中成人中国经济面临强大阻力。
en: BERLIN – In his speech at the 2015 World Economic Forum meeting in Davos, Chinese Premier Li Keqiang acknowledged that China’s economy is facing strong headwinds.

zh: 2014年GDP增长为7.4 % ， 是1990年以来的最低值。
en: Annual GDP growth in 2014 was 7.4%, the lowest rate since 1990.

zh: 但是，为了稳定经济增长，他承诺中国将继续“追求积极的财政政策和审慎的货币政策。 ”
en: But, to stabilize economic growth, he pledged that China will “continue to pursue a proactive fiscal policy and a prudent monetary policy.”

zh: 中国当前的经济减速时政策导致的。
en: China’s current economic slowdown was policy-induced.

zh: 在过去两年中，中国政府收紧了财政和货币政策，以期抵消为应对2008年全球金融危机而实施的大规模刺激政策的副作用。
en: During the last two years, the government has tightened fiscal and monetary policy, in the hope of offsetting the adverse effects of the large stimulus package implemented in response to the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 李克强的达沃斯讲话意在向世人表明中国经济不会放任增长率进一步下滑。
en: Li’s Davos speech was intended to signal that the Chinese government will not allow the growth rate to slip further.

zh: 中国的刺激计划是迄今全世界规模最大、实施最力的。
en: China’s stimulus package was by far the world’s largest and most effectively implemented.

zh: 它稳定了中国的增长、缓和了全球经济收缩。
en: It stabilized growth in China and moderated the global economic contraction.

zh: 但它也给中国经济带来了一些严重问题。
en: But it left in its wake some serious problems for the Chinese economy.

zh: 最重要的是，中国经济的杠杆率大大增加了。
en: Most important, the country’s economy has become highly leveraged.

zh: 房价一飞冲天，房地产开发商大肆借贷，地方政府也背上了沉重的负债。
en: Housing prices shot up, real-estate developers borrowed recklessly, and local governments became heavily indebted.

zh: 结果，广义货币（M2）迅速增加，现已超过中国GDP的两倍多，也是世界最高水平之一。
en: As a result, broad money (M2) increased rapidly, and now stands at more than two times China’s GDP – one of the highest levels in the world.

zh: 这笔钱也给2013年初接班的李克强和国家主席习近平敲响了警钟。
en: This flood of money rang alarm bells for Li and President Xi Jinping when they took office in early 2013.

zh: 此后，中国政府遏制了货币供应增长，开始实施地方政府贷款上限。
en: The government has since reined in money-supply growth and started to impose limits on local governments’ borrowing.

zh: 货币扩张有所减速。
en: Monetary expansion has decelerated.

zh: 预算法也进行了修订，允许地方政府发行政府债券，而它们从央行的贷款被严密监控。
en: The budget law has been revised to allow local governments to issue government bonds, and their borrowing from commercial banks is being closely monitored.

zh: 这些政策提高了资本成本，特别是，在货币紧缩的情况下，地方政府和房地产开发商成熟了很大压力。
en: These policies have raised capital costs, with monetary tightening, in particular, taking a large toll on local governments and real estate developers.

zh: 由于增长放缓迫使它们不得不借新债还旧债，利率也随之水涨船高，挤出了实体经济中的企业，进一步拖累了增长。
en: Because slower growth forces them to borrow new money to pay their maturing debts, interest rates are bid up, and businesses in the real economy are crowded out, creating a further drag on growth.

zh: 与此同时，生产者物价指数节节下降，而消费者物价指数保持平稳。
en: Meanwhile, producer prices have been falling, while consumer prices are flat.

zh: 因此，与世界其他部分一样，中国也面临着通缩风险。
en: So, like much of the rest of the world, China is facing the risk of deflation.

zh: 事实上，要不是中国从2008年开始实施了两年的刺激计划，提振了投资需求从而延缓了世界大宗商品价格的下跌之势，全球通缩压力的影响将出现得更早。
en: Indeed, global deflationary pressure would have emerged much sooner had China not launched its two-year stimulus plan in 2008, which boosted investment demand and thus delayed the fall in world commodity prices.

zh: 如今，大宗商品价格下跌已经来临，国内通缩也成为实实在在的威胁，特别是考虑到国内财政扩张减速的情况。
en: Now that the fall has arrived, domestic deflation has become a real threat, particularly given slower domestic fiscal expansion.

zh: 因此，中国政府应该回忆一下1997年亚洲金融危机。
en: That is why China’s government would do well to recall the Asian financial crisis of 1997.

zh: 邓小平南巡后，改革进程得到了必要的提振，20实际90年代上半叶，投资快速增加。
en: In response to Deng Xiaoping’s famous tour to the south, which provided a needed boost to the reform process, investment increased rapidly in the first half of the 1990s.

zh: 结果，1994年中国年通货膨胀率飙升至创纪录的24 % 。
en: As a result, China’s annual inflation rate soared to an all-time high of 24% in 1994.

zh: 政府在此后所采取的遏制通胀政策也许成功地实现了软着陆，但金融危机严重冲击了中国，导致了六年的通缩。
en: The government’s subsequent measures to curb inflation might have engineered a soft landing; but the financial crisis hit China severely, leading to six years of deflation.

zh: 亚洲金融危机 — — 从这个意义上说，是任何金融危机 — — 的主要教训是，通缩是复苏的终极威胁。
en: The main lesson of the Asian financial crisis – or, for that matter, of any financial crisis – is that deflation is the ultimate threat to recovery.

zh: 由于1997年危机局限于东亚地区，中国得以在加入世贸组织后摆脱了通缩。
en: Because the 1997 crisis was confined to East Asia, China was able to escape deflation after it joined the World Trade Organization.

zh: 但今时不同往日。
en: But today is different.

zh: 如今全世界都被通缩所困扰。
en: The entire world is in the grip of deflationary forces.

zh: 如果中国也沦陷，这一回其贸易伙伴将无法成为救星。
en: If China enters the vortex, its trade partners will not be able to pull it out this time.

zh: 因此，中国政府的关键问题是中国能否自救。
en: So the key question for China’s government is whether the country can do so on its own.

zh: 李克强在达沃斯所承诺的积极财政政策有所助益，但货币政策也需要改变。
en: The proactive fiscal policy that Li pledged at Davos will help, but monetary policy also needs to change.

zh: 中国当局面临的难题是货币扩张的唯一效果是助长了资产价格攀升，而不是实体经济信用流入的增加。
en: The conundrum facing China’s authorities is that monetary expansion would merely fuel a run-up in asset prices, rather than resulting in higher credit flows to the real economy.

zh: 最大的妨碍曾经是地方政府和僵尸开发商。
en: The blockages used to be local governments and zombie real-estate developers.

zh: 但今年可能会有所不同。
en: But that is likely to change this year.

zh: 地方政府贷款将得到严密监控，它们的新增债务融资将主要来自政府债券。
en: Borrowing by local governments will be strictly monitored, and their new debt financing will come mainly from government bonds.

zh: 而尽管大部分观察者认为中国一线城市（北上广深）在2015年将继续疲于消化近几年中所建立的巨大住房库存，但一些二线和三线城市已经触底并开始回暖。
en: And, though most observers believe that China’s first-tier cities (Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, and Shenzhen) will still struggle in 2015 to digest the huge housing stock they built up in recent years, some second- and third-tier cities have already reached the bottom, and have started to recover.

zh: 中国是世界上最大的贸易国，这使很多人要求中国领导人承担更多的全球经济总体健康责任。
en: China is the largest trading country in the world, prompting calls for Chinese leaders to assume greater responsibility for the overall health of the global economy.

zh: 中国的危机后刺激计划表明中国当局愿意承担这一责任。
en: China’s post-crisis stimulus package demonstrated the authorities’ willingness to do so.

zh: 类似地，中国政府的反通缩措施将不但有助于中国，也将有助于世界其他地区。
en: Likewise, the government’s anti-deflation effort will help not only China, but the rest of the world as well.

zh: 管窥中国新常态
en: A Window on China’s New Normal

zh: 美国剑桥—每年的这个时候，中国政府都会组织一次盛会。 这一盛会由中国国务院发展研究中心主办，汇集中国高级官员、中国和西方企业CEO以及一小部分国际官员和学者。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Every year at this time, China’s government organizes a major conference – sponsored by the Development Research Center, the official think tank of the State Council – that brings together senior Chinese officials, CEOs from major Chinese and Western firms, and a small group of international officials and academics.

zh: 发展中国论坛在一年一度的全国人大会议后不久举行。
en: The China Development Forum (CDF) occurs just after the annual National People’s Congress.

zh: 在这一论坛上，演讲者 — — 包括财政部长和央行首脑 — — 会总结中国领导层的最新思维。
en: At the forum, speakers, including the finance minister and the head of the central bank, summarize the Chinese leadership’s current thinking.

zh: 接着，官员们听取来自西方商界和学界与会者的评论和建议，李克强总理也会参与提问环节。
en: Officials then listen to comments and suggestions from Western business and academic participants, including a question and answer session with Premier Li Keqiang.

zh: 十多年来，我一直出席发展中国论坛会议，但我发现今年的会议与以往大不相同。
en: Although I have been attending the CDF’s meetings for more than a decade, I found this year’s conference substantially different from any in the past.

zh: 关键区别在于中国官方承认了年实际GDP增长永久性地从过去三十年来近10%的平均水平有所下降。
en: The key difference was the official Chinese recognition that annual real GDP growth has declined permanently from the past three decades’ average rate of nearly 10%.

zh: 2014年官方估算实际GDP增长为7.4 % ， 今年可能还会进一步降低到7 % 。
en: The official estimate is that real GDP grew 7.4% in 2014, and that the rate will probably slow further, to 7%, this year.

zh: 发展研究中心所展示的详细估算表明增长率将继续下降，到这个十年的末尾达到6%左右。
en: The Development Research Center presented detailed estimates showing that the growth rate will continue to decline, reaching about 6% by the end of the decade.

zh: 几乎每一位中国官员都把这一减速成为中国的“新常态 ” 。
en: Virtually every Chinese official referred to this slowdown as their country’s “new normal.”

zh: 他们似乎都已经适应了增长放缓 — — 尽管一开始有些惊讶，因为官员此前指出中国需要高速增长维持就业、避免政治动荡。
en: They all seemed reconciled to slower growth, which was initially surprising, because officials previously argued that China needed rapid growth to maintain employment and avoid political unrest.

zh: 如今他们似乎理解了增长率下降不会导致失业，因为放缓反映出中国从出口导向型重工业生产日益向贸易服务生产的转型，制造同样的价值量，后者需要的就业更多。
en: They now appear to understand that the declining growth rate will not lead to unemployment, because the slowdown reflects China’s structural shift from export-oriented heavy industrial production to increased production of consumer services, which require more employment to create the same amount of value.

zh: 但中国仍需要更强的增长，因为它仍是相对低收入国家，并且存在大量贫困。
en: Stronger growth nevertheless remains necessary, because China is still a relatively low-income country with substantial poverty.

zh: 尽管中国总实际GDP已是世界第二，仅次于美国（若以购买力衡量，或许比美国还要大 ） ， 但其人均收入仍只有7,000美元左右，只有美国的15 % 。
en: Although China’s total real GDP is second only to that of the United States (and might be larger when measured in terms of purchasing power), its per capita income is only about $7,000, or roughly 15% of the US level.

zh: 消费仍然很低 — — 包括政府支出只占GDP的50%左右，只算家庭消费则只占35 % 。
en: And consumption remains low – only about 50% of GDP when government spending is included, and just 35% when limited to household consumer spending.

zh: 因此中国还需要大量努力才能达到其领导人实现“繁荣的现代社会”的目标。
en: So China has a long way to go to reach its leaders’ goal of achieving a “modern prosperous society.”

zh: 中国人看到 ， “ 新常态”需要他们将增长战略从因素驱动增长转向创新驱动增长。
en: The Chinese see that the “new normal” requires a shift in their growth strategy from factor-driven growth to innovation-driven growth.

zh: 但尚不清楚的是如何实现创新的增加。
en: But it is not clear how that increase in innovation will be achieved.

zh: 官员强调对要依赖市场，但中国没有像美国那样的促进创新的风险资本和“天使融资 ” 。
en: While officials stress reliance on the market, China does not have the venture capital and “angel financing” that facilitates innovation in the US.

zh: 当局也许希望它们的银行存款保险计划能让存款从三家最大银行流向全国众多小银行，解决地方创业企业的融资难问题。
en: The authorities may hope that their plan to insure bank deposits will shift deposits from the three largest banks to many smaller banks around the country, facilitating local startups’ access to financing.

zh: 其他许多经济问题也摆在面前。
en: Many other economic problems loom.

zh: 官员在发展中国论坛承认，最大的风险在金融部门，特别是地方政府的巨额负债。
en: Officials acknowledged at the CDF that the biggest risks lie in the financial sector, particularly owing to local governments�� very large liabilities.

zh: 在过去，政府通过向银行注资解决这些负债给银行系统造成的问题。
en: In the past, the government dealt with the problems that these liabilities caused for the banking system by injecting funds into the banks.

zh: 环境问题是另一个严重拖累中国当前生活水平的问题。
en: Environmental problems are another powerful drag on China’s current standard of living.

zh: 但在总需求大幅减少时，环境同时也是增加GDP的潜在方法。
en: But they also represent a potential way to increase GDP should overall demand decline significantly.

zh: 中国认识到，严重的空气和水污染制造了巨大的不安和公共卫生伤害。
en: China acknowledges that high levels of air and water pollution create discomfort and harm the public’s health.

zh: 如果需求端疲软加剧预期中的供给端放缓问题，政府的环境破坏治理支出可以吸收大量资金。
en: Government spending on remedying environmental damage could absorb substantial funds if demand-side weakness exacerbates the expected supply-side slowdown.

zh: 此外，国有企业 — — 它们在重工业和一些服务业中仍扮演着主要角色 — — 的拙劣表现也是增长的一大障碍。
en: Moreover, the very weak performance of state-owned enterprises, which continue to play a large role in heavy industry and in some service sectors, represents a powerful brake on growth.

zh: 尽管官方政策要降低这些企业的重要性，以便“市场在资源配置中起决定性作用 ” ， 但缩减这些企业十分困难，因为它们在中共内部拥有强大的政治背景。
en: Although official policy aims to reduce these firms’ role so that “the market can play the decisive role in resource allocation,” shrinking these firms has proved to be difficult, owing to their strong political backing within the Chinese Communist Party.

zh: 与此同时，中国仍对外国直接投资保持限制，企业种类和合资入股规模都有限制。
en: At the same time, China maintains restrictions on direct investment by foreigners, limiting both the kinds of firms and the share of joint ventures that they can own.

zh: 官方政策要降低外国公司投资的壁垒，特别是高科技和服务行业。
en: The official policy is to reduce the barriers to foreign corporate investment, especially in high tech and the service sector.

zh: 当然，许多主题仍没有摆上台面，也没有在今年的发展中国论坛上讨论。
en: There were, of course, a number of subjects that remained just below the surface and were not discussed at this year’s CDF.

zh: 中国国家主席习近平的反腐运动没有减弱迹象，尽管私下里的一些对话认为反腐运动已经造成了决策延迟，对生产率和增长造成了副作用。
en: There was no indication of a slowdown in President Xi Jinping’s anti-corruption campaign, though some private conversations suggested that the campaign has resulted in decision-making delays that are hurting productivity and growth.

zh: 中国对西方技术的网络盗窃也没有讨论。
en: There was also no discussion of Chinese cyber theft of Western technology.

zh: 2014年，当这一问题被提出时，李克强否认中国有此行为，但指出中国企业被来自国内的黑客侵入。
en: When that subject was raised in 2014, Li denied that the Chinese do such a thing, but noted that Chinese firms are hacked by domestic sources.

zh: 此外，发展中国论坛的主题是合作，因此也不会讨论中国在东海和南海争议领土上的可能的军事行动。
en: And, with the CDF’s emphasis on cooperation, there was no discussion of possible military action by the Chinese to stake their disputed territorial claims in the East and South China Seas.

zh: 发展中国论坛这样的会议提供了一个有用的窗口，让我们得以一窥这个全球经济重要性还将日益增加的国家。
en: Meetings like the CDF provide a useful window into a country whose importance for the global economy will continue to grow.

zh: 当下的向新常态减速让这样的窗口变得更加重要了。
en: The current slowdown to a new normal makes such windows even more important.

zh: 中国增长的秘密
en: China’s Growth Secret

zh: 上海—许多人对中国经济的增长前景感到十分悲观，因为大规模债务、过度投资、产能过剩以及2008年全球金融危机以来的所谓“鬼城”逐渐出现。
en: SHANGHAI – Many people are profoundly pessimistic about the Chinese economy’s growth prospects, owing to the emergence of massive debt, excessive investment, overcapacity, and so-called “ghost cities” since the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 但这些问题都不是新问题。
en: But these problems are not new.

zh: 自1978年以来，它们就以各种方式影响着中国经济，东亚的其他高增长经济体 — — 台湾、韩国甚至日本 — — 在快速增长时期也无不遇到过这些问题。
en: They have, in various forms, affected China’s economy since 1978, and were evident in East Asia’s other high-performing economies – Taiwan, South Korea, and even Japan – during their periods of rapid growth.

zh: 尽管如此，自邓小平启动他的“改革开放”政策以来，中国平均年增长率高达9.7 % 。
en: Nonetheless, in the 35 years since Deng Xiaoping initiated his program of “reform and opening up,” China has recorded 9.7% average annual growth.

zh: 而韩国和台湾都只花了40年时间完成了从低收入到高收入的转型。
en: And it took only 40 years for South Korea and Taiwan to complete their transitions from low- to high-income status.

zh: 这些经济提是如何成功地以如此快速增长如此长时间，并克服期间所面临的严重问题的？
en: How did these economies manage to grow so fast for so long and overcome the serious problems that they faced along the way?

zh: 答案很简单：恢复力（resilience ） 。
en: The answer is simple: resilience.

zh: 经济发展是一个坎坷的过程，充满了挑战和风险、成功和失败、外部冲击和内部动荡。
en: Economic development is a convoluted process, full of challenges and risks, successes and failures, external shocks and internal volatility.

zh: 副作用 — — 如债务-GDP比率上升和产能过剩 — — 也是难以避免的。
en: And adverse effects – such as a rising debt-to-GDP ratio and excess capacity – are inevitable.

zh: 如果一国不能在新挑战出现时予以充分应对，经济增长和发展就会停滞下来。
en: If a country fails to respond adequately to new challenges as they arise, economic growth and development stall.

zh: 比如，许多拉美和南亚国家就陷入了所谓的“中等收入陷阱 ” ， 因为它们没能及时调整经济增长模式。
en: Many countries in Latin America and South Asia, for example, have become mired in the so-called “middle-income trap,” because they failed to adjust their growth models in a timely manner.

zh: 相反，东亚经济体不断地调整增长战略、持续地进行制度改革。
en: East Asia’s economies, by contrast, consistently adjusted their growth strategies and engaged in continuous institutional reform.

zh: 其目的不在于解决直接面临的问题，而在于引导新的效率更高的活动以助债务转化为资产并最大限度地利用经济的产能。
en: The aim was not to tackle the problems they faced directly, but to induce new, more efficient activities that would help to turn debt into assets and maximize use of the economy’s capacity.

zh: 从这个角度讲，东亚经济体发生的是奥地利经济学家熊彼特（Joseph Schumpeter）所描述的“创造性破坏 ” ， 经济结构从内部不断革命。
en: In this sense, East Asia’s economies have embraced the process of “creative destruction” described by the Austrian economist Joseph Schumpeter, whereby the economic structure is continually revolutionized from within.

zh: 此外，它们还通过实施有利于 — — 甚至鼓励 — — 用更有活力的新增长源取代效率低下的就增长源的增量改革加快这一过程。
en: Moreover, by implementing incremental reforms that facilitate – and even encourage – the replacement of old, inefficient sources of growth with new, more dynamic ones, they have expedited this process.

zh: 比如，中国在20世纪80年代所实施的提高生产率的农业改革从某种程度上说是受到非农业部门增长的刺激，是旨在鼓励乡镇企业的政策的结果。
en: For example, China’s productivity-enhancing agricultural reforms in the 1980s were spurred partly by growth in the non-agricultural sector, a result of policies aimed at stimulating township and village enterprises.

zh: 类似地，20世纪90年代，中国通过实施刺激更有活力的部门的制度改革解决了坏账累积和烂尾楼工程问题（分别由国有企业长期亏损和房地产投资过度导致 ） ， 从而抵消了国有企业资本回报率的下降。
en: Similarly, in the 1990s, China addressed the buildup of bad debt and unfinished construction projects – the result of state-owned enterprises’ chronic loss-making and excessive property investment, respectively – by implementing institutional reforms that stimulated growth in more dynamic sectors, thereby offsetting the SOEs’ declining return on capital.

zh: 因此，自邓小平实施改革以来，恢复力已成为政府和市场互动的特征。
en: Resilience has thus characterized the interaction between the government and markets since the introduction of Deng’s reforms.

zh: 事实上，按照已故经济学家古斯塔夫·拉尼斯（Gustav Ranis）的说法，政策和市场制度的互动动态（interactive dynamic）是东亚经济体成功的关键。
en: Indeed, according to the late economist Gustav Ranis, the interactive dynamic of policy and market institutions was the key to the success of the East Asian economies.

zh: 比如，由地方机构要求增加自治权所推动的中国的财政分散化帮助刺激了地区竞争、维持了日益市场化的经济环境。
en: For example, fiscal decentralization in China, spurred by local institutions’ demands for increased autonomy, has helped to fuel regional competition and sustain an increasingly market-oriented economic environment.

zh: 这一互动动态也反映在产业政策的形成中。
en: This interactive dynamic is also reflected in the formation of industrial policies.

zh: 在中国，尽管生机勃勃的小制造商集群不断繁荣，但决策者采取促进产业发展和升级的措施的情况相对较少。
en: In China, though clusters of vibrant smaller manufacturers are flourishing, policymakers have done relatively little to promote industrial development and upgrading.

zh: 于是市场机构指导了这一过程，确保它们在不断扩大的产业部门中扮演关键角色。
en: This leaves it up to market institutions to guide the process, ensuring that they play a key role in the expanding industrial sectors.

zh: 东亚的另一个恢复力来源是地方政府。
en: Another source of resilience in East Asia are local governments.

zh: 首先，它们负责公共资本支出，推动了中国实体基础设施的改善，并给私人投资者带来合理回报。
en: For starters, they are responsible for public capital expenditure, driving the improvement in China’s physical infrastructure and yielding reasonable returns for private investors.

zh: 这推进了帮助地方企业特别是创新型中小企业成长和繁荣的目标。
en: This advances the objective of helping local businesses, particularly innovative small and medium-size firms, to grow and thrive.

zh: 在这方面，地方政府还帮助企业得以进入全球供给链。
en: To this end, local governments are also helping entrepreneurs gain access to global production chains.

zh: 浙江省和广东省做得尤其成功 — — 毫不奇怪，这两个省也拥有中国最强健的地区经济。
en: The Zhejiang and Guangdong provinces have been particularly successful in this effort – and, unsurprisingly, rank among China’s most robust regional economies.

zh: 最后，地方政府表现出愿意支持制度创新。
en: Finally, local governments have demonstrated a willingness to support institutional innovation.

zh: 这能带来解决地方层面结构挑战所需要的灵活性，从而防止它们阻碍增长。
en: This allows for the flexibility needed to address structural challenges at the local level, thereby preventing them from blocking growth.

zh: 在经历了三年的增长放缓和债务增加后，中国再一次站在了十字路口。
en: After three years of slowing growth and rising debt, China once again finds itself at a crossroads.

zh: 幸运的是，它似乎正在选择灵活和调整之路，追求一个宏大的改革计划，我们希望这能让中国更加接近 — — 并最终迈过 — — 高收入门槛。
en: Fortunately, it seems to be choosing the path of flexibility and adjustment, as it pursues an ambitious reform plan that, it is hoped, will enable it to edge closer to – and eventually cross – the high-income threshold.

zh: 中国的试错经济
en: China’s Trial-and-Error Economy

zh: 香港—在本月的全国人大上，中国总理李克强的2015年工作规划强调中国进入了经济增长率为7%的“新常态 ” 。
en: HONG KONG – Chinese Prime Minister Li Keqiang’s work plan for 2015, revealed at this month’s National People’s Congress, highlighted the country’s shift to a “new normal” of 7% economic growth.

zh: 这一增长放缓的转变在短期是一个严峻的挑战，但也为中国确保长期经济发展创造了重要的机会。
en: The shift to slower growth poses serious challenges, but it also creates an important opportunity for China to ensure its long-term economic development.

zh: 中国领导人不仅认识到这一机会，而且也正在采取行动引导中国经济转向更加可持续的增长模式。
en: China’s leaders recognize this opportunity, and are taking action to support the shift to more sustainable growth models.

zh: 财政部将中央政府预算赤字占GDP之比从2014年的1.8%提高到2015年的2.7 % ， 并允许高负债的地方政府将1万亿人民币的今年到期债务置换为利率更低的长期债券。
en: The finance ministry has raised the central-government budget deficit from 1.8% of GDP in 2014 to as much as 2.7% in 2015, and will allow highly leveraged local governments to swap CN¥1 trillion ($161.1 billion) of debt maturing this year for bonds with lower interest rates.

zh: 中国人民银行也提供了一些货币政策支持，逐渐降低利率和准备金率。
en: Likewise, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) has provided monetary support, gradually lowering interest rates and reserve requirements.

zh: 由于工资仍在上升，2015年的通胀目标定在3 % — —高于2014年2%的实际水平，尽管生产者价格指数负增长已有36个月。
en: Because wages are still rising, the inflation target for 2015 has been set at 3% – higher than the actual 2014 inflation of 2%, even though producer-price inflation has been negative for 36 months.

zh: 尽管日元、欧元和新兴经济体货币兑美元出现了大幅贬值，人民银行认为今年人民币对美元的汇率环境将保持稳定，并会稳步实现资本帐项下的人民币可兑换，这将促进全球金融稳定。
en: The PBOC also has projected a stable exchange-rate environment for this year – despite the steep depreciation of the Japanese yen, the euro, and emerging-economy currencies against the dollar – thereby promoting global stability.

zh: 这些政策反映出中国领导人有很大的决心完成结构改革及市场开放，尽管外部环境恶化和国内结构调整面临严重阻碍。
en: These policies reflect a remarkable determination to continue on the path of structural reform, despite strong headwinds from the deteriorating external environment and domestic structural adjustments.

zh: 简言之，中国政府似乎具有明确、乐观的长期愿景及信心。
en: In short, China’s government seems to have a clear long-term vision.

zh: 但并非所有人都对中国的前景感到乐观。
en: But not everyone is optimistic about China’s trajectory.

zh: 老牌中国观察家沈大伟（David Shambough）最近警告说，以中共为领导的中国政治制度所面临的挑战可能将严重制约政府实施2013年所提出的宏大经济改革的能力。
en: Veteran China watcher David Shambaugh recently went so far as to warn that the challenges facing the political system, led by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), may be severely compromising the government’s ability to implement the package of ambitious economic reforms that it unveiled in 2013.

zh: 但认为中国经济和政治发展岌岌可危的观点往往忽视了中国改革的“适应性学习过程”这一重要特征 — — 这一过程烙印于每一项经济、外交、军事和社会政策上。
en: And yet the claim that China’s economic and political development is in jeopardy seems to ignore the country’s adaptive learning process, which shapes every economic, diplomatic, military, and social policy.

zh: 这一过程的特征包括实验、评估、调整、再实验这样的互动循环，它起源于中共在20世纪30年代的内战经验，邓小平在20世纪80年代的改革中所使用的就是这一适应性学习过程，并由后来的中国领导人不断提炼完善。
en: This process – characterized by experimentation, assessment, and adjustment – emerged from the CCP’s military experience of the 1930s, was applied by Deng Xiaoping to his reform program in the 1980s, and has been refined by subsequent Chinese leaders.

zh: 历史上从未有哪个经济体经历过如此大规模、如此快速的增长，因此，用邓小平的话说，管理中国发展的唯一办法是“摸着石头过河 ” 。
en: Because no economy had ever experienced such rapid growth on such a large scale, the only way to manage China’s development was, as Deng put it, to “cross the river by feeling the stones.”

zh: 中国的“适应性学习过程”决策方法既需要面对惨痛的失败 — — 如个别市场被完全关闭，也可能有令人瞩目的成功 — — 如产生了可供其它地区借鉴的改革经验及市场模式，包括当年的包产到户、出口导向的制造业发展、成功的基础设施建设等等。
en: China’s adaptive policymaking approach has produced both spectacular failures, with entire markets being shut down, and remarkable successes, yielding models that could be applied across the country.

zh: 并不是所有的实验都是成功的，许多实验虽然有利于GDP增长，但也同时导致了产能过剩、污染、腐败和“鬼城”等问题。
en: Some experiments have had less clear results, making, say, a positive contribution to GDP growth, but also contributing to problems like excess industrial capacity, pollution, corruption, and the creation of ghost towns.

zh: 既然是实验，产生这些意料外后果是可以理解的。
en: In a context of experimentation, such unintended consequences are understandable.

zh: 这些问题的出现是改革过程的一部分，并不能单凭实验后出现的问题就得出结论中国将迈向灾难；只有在这些问题成为持久性问题时中国才有可能面临困境。
en: The mere fact that they have emerged in no way suggests that China is headed for disaster; that would be the case only if these problems were allowed to persist.

zh: 避免这些困境需要中国制定适应“新常态”的措施时超越仅仅维持经济增长的狭隘政策范围。
en: Preventing such an outcome requires that efforts to adjust to China’s “new normal” go beyond policies intended to sustain economic growth.

zh: 改革必须将目标放在更全面的培养包容性、推进环境可持续性、激发创新和促进竞争力上，而 这正是中国领导人正在采取的步骤。
en: Reforms must aim to bolster inclusivity, advance environmental sustainability, promote innovation, and boost competitiveness. And this is precisely the four-pronged approach that China’s leaders seem to be taking.

zh: 事实上，从降低煤炭使用以解决空气污染，到将信息技术与现代制造业整合的计划，中国政府一再表明它明白改革的必要性。
en: Indeed, from slashing coal consumption to address air pollution to plans for integrating information technologies with modern manufacturing, the government has shown time and again that it recognizes its reform imperatives.

zh: 此外，中国政府不懈地根除官员贪污，也表明它愿意采取必要措施确保中国改革的成功。
en: And, by remaining dogged in its efforts to root out official graft, it has demonstrated its will to do what is needed to ensure that China succeeds.

zh: 这并不是说前途一帆风顺。
en: This is not to say that it is all smooth sailing ahead.

zh: 中国的官僚体系必须做出重大调整才能处理技术革命和全球化的风险， 并利用其中的好处，其中最大的挑战是朝基于��识的、有环境意识的、包容而稳定的新经济的转型。
en: The Chinese bureaucracy must adapt radically to cope with the risks – and take advantage of the benefits – of technology and globalization, with the biggest challenge being the shift to a knowledge-based, environmentally conscious, inclusive, and stable industrial base.

zh: 中国政府必须采取措施让市场力量在引导经济活动中扮演更重要的角色，包括降低民营企业的审批门槛和它们面临的监管负担。
en: And China’s government must take steps to enable market forces to play a greater role in directing economic activity, including by reducing licensing and regulatory requirements in the private sector.

zh: 市场力量也将从家庭购买力的增长中获益。
en: Market forces will also benefit from the growth in households’ spending power.

zh: 事实上，持续实际工资增长正在迫使单纯依靠廉价劳动力的低效率行业退出市场，同时也增强了可以满足购买力日益增长、口味不断变化的中国消费者的厂商的竞争力。
en: Indeed, continued real-wage growth is forcing inefficient industries that relied solely on cheap labor out of the market, while bolstering the competitiveness of producers that appeal to the evolving tastes of China’s increasingly potent consumers.

zh: 为了支持这一结构调整过程，中国如今正在建立像存款保险这样的稳定市场制度。
en: To support this process, China is now implementing deposit insurance, for example.

zh: 与此同时，中国也正在改革其低效率的证券首次发行（IPO）体制，从审批制改成注册制。
en: At the same time, China is reforming its inefficient approval-based system of initial public offerings to one based on registrations.

zh: 更活跃及高效的IPO市场将让公司不只是靠银行中介来满足融资需要，而可以利用股权市场来帮助企业解决积累的债务及降低杠杆率，这对企业未来的创新及风险管理至关重要。
en: A more active and efficient IPO market will allow companies to meet their financing needs without bank intermediation – a step that is vital to helping firms eliminate their debt overhangs.

zh: 事实上，降低银行在各种融资渠道中的比重对于平衡中国经济来说是不可或缺的。
en: In fact, reducing the role of banks is essential to balancing China’s economy.

zh: 尽管股市最近大幅上扬，但市值仍只有GDP的40%左右，而银行资产总量高达GDP的266 % 。
en: Despite the recent rebound, China’s stock-market capitalization amounts to only 40% of GDP, while banking assets total 266% of GDP.

zh: 与此同时，只有10%的社会融资总额来自股市。
en: Meanwhile, only 10% of total social funding comes from the equity market.

zh: 但是，在政府的2015年改革日程中还缺失了一个重要元素：改善用于处理资不抵债借款人的破产程序。
en: But there is one important component missing from the government’s reform agenda for 2015: improved bankruptcy procedures for failed borrowers.

zh: 除非破产人和失败的项目可以迅速而平稳地退出系统，否则市场将饱受坏账和烂尾工程的纠缠，耗费宝贵的信贷资源，拖累收入、增长及就业表现。
en: Unless failed borrowers and projects exit the system quickly and smoothly, the market will be saddled with bad debt and incomplete projects, undermining its performance.

zh: 中国改革的历史一再证明其越来越市场化的经济体的耐久力和适应力。
en: China has repeatedly proved its durability and adaptability.

zh: 如今，它必须再次证明这一点，靠的就是通过改革与开放来确保其“新常态”发展具有可持续、包容、创新及稳定的特征。
en: Now, it must do so yet again, by ensuring that its “new normal” is as stable, sustainable, and inclusive as possible.

zh: 这需要强化中国的制度基础、建立明确透明的规则，从而鼓励大胆实验和创新，确保烂尾工程的平稳退出，并有稳健常规化的机制收拾不成功实验的残局。
en: This entails strengthening China’s institutional foundations and establishing clear, transparent rules, in order to encourage experimentation and innovation, ensure the smooth exit of failed projects, and manage the fallout of errors.

zh: 失败是成功之母 — — 但只有在你汲取失败教训时是如此。
en: Failure may be the mother of success – but only if one makes the effort to learn from it.

zh: 幸运的是，中国领导人似乎正准备这样做。
en: Fortunately, China’s leaders seem intent on doing just that.

zh: 莫要一“习”障目
en: Missing the Forest for the Xi

zh: 伦敦—最近几周，西方媒体评论员的注意力都集中在中共取消国家主席任期限制的决定上。 这一决定让习近平能够无限期掌权。
en: LONDON – In recent weeks, Western media commentators have focused extensively on the Communist Party of China’s (CPC) decision to abolish presidential term limits, which will allow Xi Jinping to remain in power indefinitely.

zh: 毫不奇怪，西方评论员对这条新闻的一般反应是失望，并对中国政治模式产生疑问。
en: Unsurprisingly, they have generally responded to the news with disappointment and skepticism about the Chinese political model.

zh: 但令人惊奇的有人宣称中国违背了变得更加西方的含蓄承诺。
en: What is surprising, though, is the claim that China is reneging on some implicit promise to become more like the West.

zh: 许多观察员认为中国将无可避免地拥抱西方式自由民主。
en: Many observers assumed that China would inevitably embrace Western-style liberal democracy.

zh: 但尽管我也对中共的最新决定略感吃惊，但我向来不认为简单化地解读现代中国具有合理性。
en: But even though I, too, was slightly taken aback by the CPC’s latest decision, I never considered that simplistic interpretation of modern-day China to be particularly sensible.

zh: 澄清：我并不是说非选举产生的强人领导要优于西方式民主。
en: Now, let me be clear: I am not going to argue that unelected strongman leadership is superior to Western-style democracy.

zh: 如果我认为习近平准备在未来20年中铁腕治国，我也会和其他许多评论员一样感到质疑。
en: If I believed that Xi was preparing to rule China with an iron fist for the next 20-plus years, I would share the doubts of many other commentators.

zh: 但容我提出一种更具开放性思维的解读。
en: But allow me to suggest a more open-minded interpretation.

zh: 首先，密歇根大学的洪源远（Yuen Yuen Ang）在其出色的著作《中国如何摆脱贫困陷阱 》 （ How China Escaped the Poverty Trap）中提醒我们，没有遵循常规西方发展观的中国，让数亿人摆脱了贫困。
en: For starters, as Yuen Yuen Ang of the University of Michigan reminds us in her excellent book How China Escaped the Poverty Trap, China has lifted hundreds of millions of people out of poverty without adhering to the conventional Western approach to development.

zh: 事实上，我最近遇到的一位年轻的北京创业家估计，现在至少有20%的中国人 — — 超过2.5亿人 — — 每年的收入超过40,000美元。
en: In fact, a young Beijing-based entrepreneur I met recently estimates that at least 20% of Chinese – over 250 million people – are now making $40,000 per year.

zh: 除了美国，没有一个国家有如此多的人创造如此多的财富。
en: Besides the United States, no other country in the world has that many people generating that much individual wealth.

zh: 不管西方人情不情愿承认，这是一个了不起的成就。
en: Whether Westerners like to admit it or not, that is a remarkable achievement.

zh: 但更加了不起的事实是这发生在一个非民主制度中，并且中国人民表现出相当的满意。
en: But even more remarkable is the fact that it has happened under a non-democratic system, and that Chinese citizens appear to be rather content.

zh: 尽管小规模示威时有发生，甚至一些最顶层20%的人也加入到示威之中，但这些示威活动十分分散，转瞬即逝。
en: Although small-scale protests are not uncommon, even among those in the top 20%, they tend to be scattered and fleeting.

zh: 现在，想想这一点。
en: Now, think about this.

zh: 如果中国能够在未来15年保持5.5—7%的年经济增长，那么每年赚40,000美元的中国人数量还会翻番。
en: If China can sustain 5.5-7% annual economic growth for the next 15 years, the number of Chinese earning $40,000 per year could more than double.

zh: 果真如此的话，他们也许对习近平仍然是国家领导人并不会特别关注。
en: In that case, they probably will not be particularly concerned that Xi is still their country’s anointed leader.

zh: 这让我看到了第二点。
en: This brings me to a second point.

zh: 有些悲观派老是说中国GDP增长面临很大压力，和他们的错误论点相反，我认为中国最大的隐患其实是户口制度。
en: Contrary to the pessimists who have long been wrong about looming threats to China’s GDP growth, I suspect that China’s ultimate undoing could actually be its hukou (household registration) system.

zh: 这一安排允许农民工前往城市打工，但他们没有城市出生居民的同等权利。
en: This is the arrangement that allows migrants from rural areas to work in cities across China, but does not afford them the same rights as urban-born dwellers.

zh: 我的猜测是这些中国人当中只有很少一部分能跻身收入最高的20%群体。
en: My guess is that very few of these Chinese are among the top 20% of earners.

zh: 尽管中共在小城市试点放松户口制度以刺激增长，但大城市仍没有这样的政策。
en: Although the CPC has experimented with scrapping the hukou system in smaller cities where it wants to promote growth, it has refrained from doing so in the big cities.

zh: 基于我与中国决策者的私下对话，我了解到他们也把目前的安排视为重大问题。
en: Based on private discussions I have had with Chinese policymakers, I know that they see the current arrangement as a major problem.

zh: 但他们不想面对这个问题。
en: But they do not want to confront it.

zh: 他们的理由是，放弃户口制度会给北京和上海的超级都市带来不可持续的负担。
en: Their reasoning is that abandoning the system altogether would impose an unsustainable burden on megacities such as Beijing and Shanghai.

zh: 尽管如此，我的预感是最终会有一些事情发生改变。
en: Still, my hunch is that something will have to change eventually.

zh: 双轨制 — — 近一半人口享受西方水平的财富，而另一半人口不拥有医疗和社会保障权利 — — 无法再维持15年。
en: A two-tier system in which almost half the population enjoys Western levels of wealth while the rest have no right to health care or social security cannot survive another 15 years.

zh: 而既然连我都觉得这显而易见，中国领导层肯定也对此一目了然。
en: And if this is obvious to me, then it must be obvious to the Chinese leadership, too.

zh: 无法断言户口制度的修订会在何时发生。
en: There is no telling when an overhaul of the hukou system will come.

zh: 但当它真的发生时 — — 我认为肯定会 — — 有可能伴随着政治治理的巨变。
en: But when it does, as I think it must, it will probably be accompanied by a dramatic shift in political governance.

zh: 因此，我可以理解为何中共高层对于未来几年领导层变化异常谨慎。
en: Given this, I can see why the CPC’s upper echelons would want to be particularly careful about leadership changes in the years ahead.

zh: 并且我们不要忘了，2013年3月习近平掌权时，一些党的最高领导层抵制他所带来的变化。
en: And lest we forget, when Xi came to power in March 2013, some at the top of the party tried to resist the changes he was bringing.

zh: 十年也许是很长一段时间，但可能没有长到足以事关中国和中共未来的根本性问题得到圆满解决。
en: Ten years may be a long time, but it probably isn’t long enough for fundamental questions about the future of the country and the party to be laid to rest.

zh: 因此，我的第三点也是最终观点是，不是中共精英想让习近平永远当国家主席，他们只是想避免在2023年被迫更换领导层。
en: So, my third and final point for consideration is that the CPC elites do not want a permanent Xi presidency so much as they want to avoid a forced change of leadership in 2023.

zh: 因此，我对西方观察员的建议是同时也要关注中国经济的演化。
en: My recommendation for Western commentators, then, is to focus on how the Chinese economy evolves in the meantime.

zh: 评论考察中国私人消费占GDP比重之比，或可能的户口制度变化，要比纠结于习近平的个性和野心更有裨益。
en: Commentary examining growth in Chinese private consumption as a share of GDP, or potential changes to the hukou system, will be far more edifying than that devoted to the personality and ambition of Xi Jinping.

zh: 中国在行动
en: China on the Move

zh: 北京 — — 辩论阶段已经过去。
en: BEIJING – The debate is over.

zh: 经过六年的反复权衡，中国现在坚定地贯彻全新发展战略。
en: After six years of weighing the options, China is now firmly committed to implementing a new growth strategy.

zh: 至少这是我通过刚结束的中国年度发展论坛，也是中国与外界最重要的对话渠道了解到的结论。
en: At least, that’s the verdict I gleaned from the just-completed annual China Development Forum, long China’s most important dialogue with the outside world.

zh: 上述战略的基本主旨不出所料，中国改变投资结构，从出口主导的经济增长模式向着更平衡的消费和服务经济转型。
en: There were no surprises in the basic thrust of the strategy – a structural shift in China’s investment- and export-led growth model toward a more balanced consumer-based and services-led economy.

zh: 这样的转型既是主动为之但亦属绝对必要。
en: The transformation reflects both necessity and design.

zh: 说它必要是因为持续疲弱的全球增长不太可能像以往那样为中国出口提供强劲的外部需求。
en: It is necessary because persistently weak global growth is unlikely to provide the solid external demand for Chinese exports that it once did.

zh: 同时也因为中国新领导层似乎决意解决威胁环境、造成收入不平等并拉大地区差距的各种国内不平衡。
en: But it is also essential, because China’s new leadership seems determined to come to grips with a vast array of internal imbalances that threaten the environment, promote destabilizing income inequality, and exacerbate regional disparities.

zh: 战略转型也是中国决策者为避开“中等收入陷阱”的深思熟虑之举 — — “中等收入陷阱”是指多数经济体在人均收入接近17，000美元大关（国际不变价格）时的中期增长放缓。
en: The strategic shift is also a deliberate effort by Chinese policymakers to avoid the dreaded “middle-income trap” – a mid-stage slowdown that has ensnared most emerging economies when per capita income nears the $17,000 threshold (in constant international prices).

zh: 长时间保持原有增长模式的发展中经济体可能会落入陷阱，而中国或许会在3－5年内进入上述阶段。
en: Developing economies that maintain their old growth models for too long fall into it, and China probably will hit the threshold in 3-5 years.

zh: 今年中国发展论坛有三项观点增强了我的信心，让我坚信中国避开中等收入陷阱的大规模结构转型正在展开。
en: Three insights from this year’s China Development Forum deepened my confidence that a major structural transformation is now at hand that will enable China to avoid the middle-income trap.

zh: 首先，已经出台以消费再平衡为重要支柱的明确的城市化战略。
en: First, a well-articulated urbanization strategy has emerged as a key pillar of consumer-led rebalancing.

zh: 这一点在中国新一代领导层 — — 常务副总理张高丽和总理李克强的论坛开闭幕讲话中都有所强调，此外论坛期间的工作会议还提供了相当多的详细资料。
en: This was emphasized by China’s new senior leaders – Executive Vice Premier Zhang Gaoli and Premier Li Keqiang – in the Forum’s opening and closing remarks, and considerable detail was provided in many of the working sessions.

zh: 城市化是消费的基石，可以强力撬动中国家庭的购买力指标。
en: Urbanization is a building block for consumption, because it provides powerful leverage to Chinese households’ purchasing power.

zh: 城镇职工的人均收入高出农村人口三倍以上。
en: Urban workers’ per capita income is more than three times higher than that of their counterparts in the countryside.

zh: 2012年中国城镇人口占比52.6 % ， 较1980年的18%增长近3倍，且预计到2030年将占比近70 % 。
en: The urban share of the Chinese population reached 52.6% in 2012 – up nearly three-fold from 18% in 1980, and is expected to rise toward 70% by 2030.

zh: 如果持续城镇化能在重点发展尚处在萌芽状态的劳动密集型服务业的同时不断创造就业机会，那么家庭收入增长的前景是令人鼓舞的。
en: If ongoing urbanization can be coupled with job creation – a distinct possibility in light of China’s emphasis on developing its embryonic labor-intensive services sector – the outlook for household-income growth is quite encouraging.

zh: 城市化步伐应当打消西方关于所谓鬼城和长期过度投资的疑虑。
en: The pace of urbanization should dispel Western doubts stemming from concerns over so-called ghost cities and chronic over-investment.

zh: 据麦肯锡公司研究报告的统计结果，每年新涌入的城镇居民高达1，500－2，000万，这意味着到2030年中国大城市（人口至少在百万以上）需要从2010年的125座增加到2030年的220座以上。
en: According to research by McKinsey & Company, with the annual influx of new urban residents totaling 15-20 million, China will need more than 220 large cities (at least one million people) by 2030, up from 125 in 2010.

zh: 此外，因为城市化需要海量资金且中国的单位人工股本（推动生产率增长的关键要素）还仅有美国和日本的13 % ， 因此中国有充分理由在今后若干年内保持投资的高速增长。
en: Moreover, because urbanization is a capital-intensive endeavor and China’s capital stock per worker – a key driver of productivity growth – is still only 13% of the levels in the United States and Japan, China has good reason to remain a high-investment economy for years to come.

zh: 当前的新课题主要是城市化的外部效应，特别是土地征用和环境退化等棘手问题。
en: What is new today is the focus on urbanization’s negative externalities – especially the thorny issues of land confiscation and environmental degradation.

zh: 今年的发展论坛提出了解决这两项问题的“生态城市”框架，主要关注集约型土地应用、地方交通混合模式、轻型建筑材料及非碳能源等推动新型城市化模型的激励机制。
en: A well-developed “eco-city” framework was presented at this year’s Forum to counter both concerns, and features incentives promoting a new urbanization model that stresses compact land usage, mixed modes of local transportation, lighter building materials, and non-carbon energy sources.

zh: 2013年中国发展论坛的第二项观点是新政府重点强化社会安全网作为现代消费社会的支柱。
en: The second insight from the 2013 China Development Forum is the new government’s focus on strengthening the social safety net as a pillar of a modern consumer society.

zh: 特别是户口（中国陈旧的户籍制度）导致公共服务和福利均不能异地享受。
en: In particular, owing to the hukou (China’s antiquated household registration system), access to public services and benefits is not portable.

zh: 由此导致约1亿6千万名底层农民工无法享受由政府提供的医疗、教育和社会保障。
en: As a result, migrant workers – an underclass numbering roughly 160 million – remain shut out of government-supported health care, education, and social security.

zh: 社会安全网络漏洞导致高额且不断增加的预防性储蓄 — — 进而妨碍劳动收入增加对可支配购买力形成推动。
en: Holes in the social safety net have led to high and rising levels of precautionary saving – driving a wedge between increases in labor income and any impetus to discretionary purchasing power.

zh: 重要的是，中国高层领导人在论坛上释放出积极审议户口改革的强烈信号。
en: Significantly, there were strong hints from senior Chinese leaders at the Forum that hukou reform is now under active consideration.

zh: 尽管上述表态广受欢迎，但仍需要扩大福利范围来加以配合。
en: While that would be welcome, such efforts need to be accompanied by an expansion of benefits.

zh: 中国的养老金系统仅仅管理着约4，300亿美元的资产（国家及地方政府社会保障和私营部门养老金 ） 。
en: China’s retirement system has only about $430 billion of assets under management (national and local government social security and private-sector pensions).

zh: 我就此问题追问过新任财政部长楼继伟，建��中国拿出部分外汇储备余额来资助这项事业 — — 中国曾用同样的办法为中投公司提供了2，000亿美元的启动资金，而楼继伟过去五年半中一直是上述主权财富基金的管理者。
en: I pressed newly appointed Finance Minister Lou Jiwei on this point, suggesting that China deploy some of its excess foreign-exchange reserves to fund such an effort – the same tactic used to provide a $200 billion start-up injection for the China Investment Corporation, the sovereign wealth fund that he ran for the previous five and a half years.

zh: 遗憾的是，他对这项提议并不赞成。
en: Unfortunately, he did not favor this suggestion.

zh: 我从论坛上得到的最终 — — 也或许是最重要的观点涉及到中国的新任领导人。
en: The final – and possibly most important – insight that I took away from the Forum concerned the quality of China’s new leaders.

zh: 从主席习近平和总理李克强开始，中国的全新领导集体十分擅长分析、风险评估、情景预设和为解决棘手问题制定创新方案。
en: From President Xi Jinping and Premier Li Keqiang on down, China’s new leadership team is quite sophisticated in terms of analytics, risk assessment, scenario modeling, and devising innovative solutions to tough problems.

zh: 此外，在原有中央计划机构当前翻版国家发展和改革委员会（NDRC）的机构框架下，中国已经聚拢了大量资源制定深思熟虑的全方位经济对策。
en: Moreover, under the organizational umbrella of the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) – the latter-day version of the old central planning apparatus – China has marshaled considerable resources into the formulation of a comprehensive and well-thought-out economic strategy.

zh: 但归根结底，单凭强势政策和分析能力来应对严峻的经济挑战还远远不够。
en: But, in the end, it takes more than strong policy and analytical skills to deal with tough economic challenges.

zh: 近年来我们看到这样不幸的例子在西方一再上演，而中国的新任领导人也不一定能避免类似的错误。
en: We have seen unfortunate examples of that repeatedly in the West in recent years, and there are no guarantees that China’s newly installed leaders will avoid comparable pitfalls.

zh: 目标和战略对实现中国新任领导人所谓的“中国梦”至关重要。
en: Vision and strategy are vital for realizing the “China Dream,” as the country’s new leaders are now calling it.

zh: 但勇气和坚定的决心在对抗来自根深蒂固的地方及省级权力集团的最强力障碍时也同样必不可少。
en: But it will take courage and sheer determination to tackle what is perhaps the biggest obstacle of all – resistance from deeply entrenched local and provincial power blocs.

zh: 在这个关键领域，掷地有声的话语必须伴随着大胆的行动。
en: On this critical front, strong words must be accompanied by bold action.

zh: 中国贫困的终结？
en: The End of Poverty in China?

zh: 北京 — — 中国最受瞩目的统计数据之一很可能是过去35年来中国民众的脱贫人数。
en: BEIJING – One of the most cited statistics about China may well be the number of Chinese who have been lifted out of poverty over the last 35 years.

zh: 有 超过8亿人口摆脱了贫困，这一数字十分巨大 — — 而且的确是非凡的壮举。
en: At over 800 million, it is a huge number – and an extraordinary feat.

zh: 事实上，没有哪个国家在如此短的时间内将如此水准的减贫变成了事实。
en: Indeed, no other country has achieved such a level of poverty reduction in such a short period.

zh: 但那些被落在后面的成百上千万中国人该怎么办？
en: But what about the millions of Chinese who have remained behind?

zh: 中国政府决意完成这项任务，目标是到2020年将农村贫困基本降为零。
en: China’s government is committed to finishing the task, with the aim of reducing rural poverty essentially to zero by 2020.

zh: 中国官方首先在2015年联合国做出了这项承诺，并在其后的官方场合下一再重申。
en: The authorities first made the pledge at the United Nations in 2015, and have reiterated it in subsequent official settings.

zh: 但履行这一承诺 — — 需要改善约4,500万民众的福祉，这一数字大约相当于苏丹人口总量 — — 需要付出巨大的成本。
en: But fulfilling that promise – which would now entail improving the wellbeing of about 45 million people, roughly equivalent to Sudan’s entire population – will carry significant costs.

zh: 像许多重要事业一样，减贫也无法逃脱边际收益递减的法则：某件事做得越多，收效就越低。
en: Poverty reduction, like so many important endeavors, is subject to the law of diminishing returns: the more you do something, the less productive your efforts become.

zh: 就像给手表上弦：你拧得越紧，发条的阻力就越大，螺母移动同样的距离就需要花费更大的力气。
en: Think of winding a watch: the more you wind, the more resistance builds up in the mainspring, and the more energy it takes to move the stem the same distance.

zh: 在减贫问题上，最先受益的人很可能由于背景或地理位置的原因最有脱贫的能力。
en: When it comes to poverty reduction, the people who benefit first are most likely those who were best equipped to do so, owing to, say, their background or geography.

zh: 到只有少数 — — 或者几百万 — — 民众尚未脱贫的时候，帮助他们的难度肯定会大得多。
en: By the time there are only a few – or even a few million – left, one can expect reaching them to be much harder.

zh: 中国的实际经验完美地诠释了这样的现象。
en: China’s experience illustrates this phenomenon perfectly.

zh: 在1978年开始的中国官方“改革开放”的最初七年，估计每年约有1亿1千万人实现脱贫。
en: During the first seven years of China’s official “reform and opening up,” which began in 1978, it is estimated that around 110 million people annually rose out of poverty.

zh: 接下来的十五年 — — 从1985到2000年 — — 进展的速度大幅放缓，每年越过贫困线的仅有约2600万人。
en: For the next 15 years – from 1985 to 2000 – the pace of progress slowed considerably, with around 26 million people moving above the poverty line each year.

zh: 从2000到2015年，这一数字停留在每年2200万多一点，政府现在的目标是每年帮助1000万人脱贫。
en: From 2000 to 2015, the figure stood at just over 22 million per year. The government’s target now is to lift ten million people out of poverty annually.

zh: 随着脱贫步伐的放缓，脱贫成本也随之上升 — — 新发布的联合国报告指明了这一趋势，世界银行数据也为此提供了佐证。
en: As the pace of poverty-reduction has slowed, its costs have risen – a trend illustrated in a new UN report, together with World Bank data.

zh: 2000年，中国中央政府要投入约48美元每年（名义数据）帮助一个人脱贫。
en: In 2000, lifting a person out of poverty in China cost the central government approximately $48 per year (in nominal terms).

zh: 而到2010年，这一数字增长了超过三倍，达到每年150美元。
en: By 2010, this figure had increased more than three-fold, to $150 per year.

zh: 现在政府正努力帮助最偏远地区的民众 — — 这些人没有公路、电力或清洁用水 — — 每人每年的脱贫成本超过200美元。
en: Now that the government is working to reach the most remote people – those without access to roads, electricity, or clean water – the cost exceeds $200 per year.

zh: 这并不是说中国将无法实现其2020年目标。
en: This is not to say that China will not be able to meet its 2020 target.

zh: 恰恰相反，政府在计划和实施方面都一如既往地强劲。
en: On the contrary, the government’s plans and implementation appear as strong as ever.

zh: 事实上，就在去年，政府超额完成了这一目标，帮助1，240万民众摆脱了农村贫困。
en: In fact, last year, the government exceeded its target, with 12.4 million people escaping rural poverty.

zh: 而且今年的预算增加了30 % ， 这也意味着中国政府已经为计划在2017年脱贫的1亿民众每人拨付了1，000美元以上。
en: And the budget for this year is 30% larger, meaning that at least $1,000 has been allocated for each of the ten million people China’s government plans to lift out of poverty in 2017.

zh: 但就在政府试图 — — 通过让所有民众超过每年2，230元人民币（合324美元）的国家贫困线而将农村贫困“降到零”的过程中，仍然不应忽视更大范围的与贫困有关的挑战。
en: But, as the government attempts to “get to zero” on rural poverty – by moving all people above the national rural poverty line of CN¥2,230 ($324) per year – it should not lose sight of broader poverty-related challenges.

zh: 中国继续经历快速城市化进程 — — 这一现象为过去的减贫工作提供了巨大的帮助，但同时也使越来越多的城市居民陷入赤贫。
en: China continues to experience rapid urbanization – a phenomenon that contributed substantially to past poverty reduction, but that also places a growing number of urban dwellers at risk of destitution.

zh: 官方数据显示，中国5%最贫困城市家庭的平均收入约为1，128美元（约合7，521元人民币 ） 。
en: According to official figures, the average income of the poorest 5% of households in Chinese cities amounts to about $1,128 (CN¥7,521).

zh: 这大致相当于中国农村贫困线的3.5倍。
en: That is about 3.5 times China’s rural poverty line.

zh: 但总体而言，城市平均收入至少是农村的四倍还多，表明在这样的财务状况下生活甚至比生活在农村贫困线以下更为艰苦。
en: But, overall, the average income in cities is at least four times higher than that in the countryside, suggesting that living on such a budget may be even tougher than living at the rural poverty line.

zh: 而这还没有计算未被纳入统计数据的众多农民工，他们的收入很可能还比不上最贫困的5 % 。
en: And that does not even account for the many migrant workers who live under the radar in cities and are likely to earn even less than the poorest 5%.

zh: 要想战胜这些贫困形式可能更加困难，尤其因为中国这方面更缺乏经验。
en: These forms of poverty may be even harder to address, not least because China has less experience doing so.

zh: 有鉴于此，正如中国农村减贫工作的成功可以作为其他国家的榜样一样，其他国家管理城市贫困的成功可以 — — 而且也应当 — — 有助于指导中国的工作。
en: Given this, just as China’s successful efforts to reduce rural poverty can serve as a model for others, other countries’ successes in managing urban poverty can – and should – help to guide China’s efforts.

zh: 专注于结束贫困斗争的国家绝不仅仅是中国一个；事实上，第一个可持续发展目标呼吁到2030年结束一切形式的贫困。
en: China is far from alone in focusing on the fight to end poverty; indeed, the very first Sustainable Development Goal calls for an end to poverty in all of its manifestations by 2030.

zh: 随着这一过程变得越来越昂贵并富于挑战性，借鉴其他国家的经验可以使所有中国人过上体面、有尊严的生活。
en: With the process becoming increasingly challenging and costly, looking across borders could prove vital to enabling all Chinese to live decent, dignified lives.

zh: 让中国的泡沫破灭
en: Letting China’s Bubble Burst

zh: 发自纽约 — — 中国经济增长模式所产生的问题在近期广受关注，而中国股市最近的直线下跌使它们成为了更为尖锐的焦点问题。
en: NEW YORK – The problems with China’s economic-growth pattern have become well known in recent years, with the Chinese stock-market’s recent free-fall bringing them into sharper focus.

zh: 但对中国经济失衡和脆弱性的讨论往往忽视结构性变革中一些更为积极的元素，尤其是政府过往那些迅速纠偏行动，以及在必要时可以动用的大量国家资产。
en: But discussions of the Chinese economy’s imbalances and vulnerabilities tend to neglect some of the more positive elements of its structural evolution, particularly the government’s track record of prompt corrective intervention, and the substantial state balance sheet that can be deployed, if necessary.

zh: 然而，从这个角度看，今年上半年爆发的股票市场泡沫应被视为一个例外。
en: In this regard, however, the stock-market bubble that developed in the first half of the year should be viewed as an exception.

zh: 不仅因为中国监管机构允许散户投资者 — — 其中很大一部分都是第一次炒股 — — （用借来的钱）从事融资融券交易促使泡沫增长；而且6月下旬开始的响应市场回调的政策也存在极大问题。
en: Not only did Chinese regulators enable the bubble’s growth by allowing retail investors – many of them newcomers to the market – to engage in margin trading (using borrowed money); the policy response to the market correction that began in late June has also been highly problematic.

zh: 鉴于过去对这些泡沫的经验，这些政策的错误是令人费解的。
en: Given past experiences with such bubbles, these policy mistakes are puzzling.

zh: 2007年秋我在北京，当时上证指数飙升至近6000点（最近这波的高点是5000多点 ） ， 部分原因是相对缺乏经验的散户投资者的大量参与。
en: I was in Beijing in the fall of 2007, when the Shanghai Composite Index skyrocketed to almost 6,000 (the recent peak was just over 5,000), owing partly to the participation of relatively inexperienced retail investors.

zh: 当时，我认为最大的政策关注点应该是规模超过GDP10%且不断增长的经常账户盈余，这将使得中国与贸易伙伴产生摩擦。
en: At the time, I thought that the greatest policy concern would be the burgeoning current-account surplus of over 10% of GDP, which would create friction with China’s trading partners.

zh: 但该国领导人更关心的是股市回调后的迅速产生社会后果。
en: But the country’s leaders were far more concerned about the social consequences of the stock-market correction that soon followed.

zh: 虽然社会动荡并没有出现，但即使经济持续快速增长，股票价格依然长期停滞不前。
en: Although social unrest did not emerge, a prolonged period of moribund equity prices did, even as the economy continued to grow rapidly.

zh: 2008年，在资产价格暴涨和家庭部门过度杠杆的双重作用下，全球金融危机爆发。
en: In 2008, it was a combination of exploding asset prices and excessive household-sector leverage that fueled the global financial crisis.

zh: 当这类债务驱动型泡沫破灭，通过家庭部门的资产负债表直接影响到实体经济，伴随着消费减少，就业和私人投资的下降。
en: When such a debt-fueled bubble bursts, its effects are transmitted directly to the real economy via household-sector balance sheets, with the reduction in consumption contributing to a decline in employment and private investment.

zh: 而相对于金融部门的资产负债表引发的连锁危机，打破这个动态循环更为困难。
en: It is much harder to find circuit breakers for this dynamic than for, say, that caused by balance-sheet distress in the financial sector.

zh: 然而，中国当局似乎没有从这两个事件中吸取教训。
en: Yet the Chinese authorities seem not to have learned the lessons of either episode.

zh: 他们不仅没有减轻风险，如2007年的危机所警示的，控制新的散户投资者进入市场；而且他们实际上加剧了风险，通过允许甚至鼓励这些投资者通过保证金交易来累积杠杆。
en: Not only did they fail to mitigate the risks, underscored in the 2007 collapse, that new retail investors introduce into the market; they actually exacerbated them, by allowing, and even encouraging, those investors to accumulate leverage through margin buying.

zh: 更糟糕的是，当股市于六月上旬开始回调，中国监管机构放宽了限购的限制，同时鼓励国有企业和资产管理者购买更多股票。
en: Making matters worse, when the current stock-market correction began in early June, Chinese regulators relaxed margin-buying restrictions, while encouraging state-owned enterprises and asset managers to purchase more stocks.

zh: 似乎在当局看来支撑市场比受控制的价格修正更感兴趣。
en: The authorities, it seems, were more interested in propping up the market than allowing for a controlled price correction.

zh: 可以肯定的是，中国股市的泡沫不是直到最近才出现的。
en: To be sure, China’s stock-market bubble did not emerge until recently.

zh: 去年十月，当上证指数处于2500区间时，许多分析师认为股票价格被低估。
en: Last October, when the Shanghai Composite Index was in the 2,500 range, many analysts considered equity prices undervalued.

zh: 鉴于经济增长相对强劲，股价的上涨似乎是合理的，直到大约3月份市场主要受交易清淡的中小型股票驱动，突击超越5000点，将得经济处于危险的位置（同时，事实上，许多人仍然声称上涨不是不可持续的，因为在4月中旬股市交易的远期价格市盈率约为15，跟过往十年的平均值一致。
en: Given relatively strong economic growth, rising prices seemed justified until about March, when the market, driven by mostly thinly traded small- and mid-cap stocks, shot to over 5,000, placing the economy at risk. (And, in fact, many still claimed that the rally was not unsustainable, as the stock market was trading at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of about 15, consistent with its ten-year average, in mid-April.)

zh: 但这是一个泡沫，一个高度杠杆化的泡沫。
en: But it was a bubble – and a highly leveraged one at that.

zh: 周期性泡沫也许是不可避免的，但所有泡沫都会带来后果，高杠杆泡沫往往造成更大的破坏，因为其对实体经济的极大影响和持续漫长的去杠杆化过程。
en: While periodic bubbles may be unavoidable, and no bubble is without consequences, a highly leveraged bubble tends to cause far more damage, owing to its impact on the real economy and the duration of the deleveraging process.

zh: 这体现在当今发达经济体的持续缓慢复苏中。
en: This is reflected in the persistently sluggish recovery in the advanced economies today.

zh: 即便是美国这个自危机爆发以来比大多地区都发展得好的地方，自2008年开始记录的GDP增长很少超过10 % ； 而在同一时期，中国的经济增长达到66 % 。
en: Even the United States, which has fared better than most since the crisis, has recorded GDP growth of little more than 10% since the start of 2008; over the same period, China’s economy grew by about 66%.

zh: 当���，由于中国家庭部门持有股票的份额相对房产来说比较小，目前股市的暴跌不太可能导致经济脱轨。
en: Of course, with China’s household sector holding a relatively small share of equities compared to real estate, the current stock-market slump is unlikely to derail the economy.

zh: 然而，正如2007年那样，不能排除因失去储蓄而引发社会动荡的预期，尤其是这个时代有着像社交媒体这样的工具可以供百姓容易地共享信息、怨气、并动员起来进行抗议。
en: Nonetheless, as in 2007, the prospect that lost savings will trigger social unrest cannot be dismissed, especially at a time when tools like social media enable citizens easily to share information, air grievances, and mobilize protest.

zh: 正如以往的危机所示，中国经济的低迷已经显现，必须采取措施来缓和市场风险。
en: As previous crises have shown, and as the current downturn in China has highlighted, steps must be taken to mitigate market risks.

zh: 具体而言，中国需要谨慎的法规来限制资产购买的杠杆。
en: Specifically, China needs prudential regulation that limits the use of leverage for asset purchases.

zh: 在这里，该国已经拥有了一个优势：相对高水平的资产净值和抵押贷款/房产价值的低比率是中国家庭部门购买房地产的典型特征。
en: Here, the country already has an advantage: relatively high levels of equity and low mortgage-to-value ratios typically characterize real-estate purchases by China’s household sector.

zh: 此外，一旦市场回调开始，当局应该允许市场自主运行，而不是用附加的杠杆来支撑价格，因为这是只是一种拖延回调的方法。
en: Moreover, once a market correction begins, the authorities should allow it to run its course, rather than prop up prices with additional leverage – an approach that only prolongs the correction.

zh: 如果中国监管机构允许市场正确运行，具有长期价值取向的成熟机构投资者将最终介入，提高市场的稳定性。
en: If Chinese regulators allow the market to correct, sophisticated institutional investors with a long-term value orientation will ultimately step in, enhancing the market’s stability.

zh: 在此期间，使用公共资产购买足够的权益，以防止市场矫枉过正可能是合理的。
en: In the interim, the use of public balance sheets to purchase enough equity to prevent the market from over-correcting may be justified.

zh: 随着中国市场的扩大 — — 上海和深圳股市的市值是11万亿美元 — — 它们越来越超出政策制定者管理价格和估值的能力。
en: As China’s markets expand – the capitalization of the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets is on the order of $11 trillion – they are increasingly outstripping policymakers’ capacity to manage prices and valuations.

zh: 唯一切实可行的办法是，中国政府要把重点放在监管和机构发展上，同时承诺让市场在资源配置中发挥决定性作用。
en: The only practical way forward is for the Chinese authorities to focus on regulatory and institutional development, while following through on their commitment to allow markets to play the decisive role in allocating resources.

zh: 中欧投资潜力无穷
en: The Untapped Potential of Sino-European Investment

zh: 北京—国际货币基金组织（IMF）说，全球经济“在太长的时间里增长太慢 ” 。
en: BEIJING – Global economic growth, says the International Monetary Fund, has been “too slow for too long.”

zh: 一个主要原因是全球贸易增长猛烈下降，世贸组织预计今年增长率只有1.7 % ， 远远低于2008年危机前十年的平均值6.7 % 。
en: A major reason has been sharply decelerating growth in global trade, which the World Trade Organization expects to grow by 1.7% this year – far below the 6.7% average in the decade preceding the 2008 crisis.

zh: 光靠贸易已无法支持全球合作，因此必须辅之以更多投资联系。
en: With trade alone no longer capable of underpinning global cooperation, it is time to add more investment linkages to the mix.

zh: 目前，真正的全球水平投资框架尚不存在。
en: As it stands, there is no real global-level investment framework.

zh: 但G20最近批准了世界上首个多边贸易纲领性文件，即《G20全球投资决策指导原则 》 。
en: But the G20 recently approved the world’s first programmatic document on multilateral investment, entitled the G20 Guiding Principles for Global Investment Policymaking.

zh: 该文件所提供的一般框架对正在进行双边投资条约谈判的中国和欧盟来说尤其重要。
en: The general framework it provides could be particularly valuable for China and the European Union, as they attempt to negotiate a bilateral investment treaty (BIT).

zh: 目前，双边投资条约谈判已经进行了数论，焦点集中在增加投资保护和市场进入。
en: So far, there have been several rounds of BIT talks, focusing on increased investment protection and market access.

zh: 更多轮次正在进行中，一些问题 — — 包括监管透明度保证以及成立有效的纠纷解决机制 — — 仍未得到充分解决。
en: Many more rounds are on the way, as some significant issues – including guarantees of regulatory transparency and the creation of an effective dispute-settlement mechanism – have yet to be fully agreed.

zh: 中欧双边投资条约将以涉及中国和28个欧盟成员国的现有双边投资条约为基础 — — 这些条约可谓众说纷纭，市场准入条件和限制不尽相同。
en: The Sino-European BIT is to be based on 26 existing BITs involving China and 28 individual EU members – treaties that are far from consistent, in terms of requirements for and restrictions on market access.

zh: 缺乏统一性是中国谈判单一条约的主要动机之一：中国想要确保中资企业在所有欧盟成员国获得平等市场准入权，避免因需要遵守不同制度而产生的成本和复杂性。
en: This lack of uniformity is a major motivation for China to negotiate a single treaty: it wants to ensure that its enterprises have equal market access in all EU member countries and avoid the costs and complications associated with adhering to different regimes.

zh: 获得欧洲企业的先进技术和管理技能也是一大主要诱惑。
