en: As an adviser to the Chinese government said on my recent trip, “movements in the stock-price index are totally unrelated to the real state of the economy.”

zh: 中国决策者似乎没有意识到这样的干预隐含着巨大的长期风险。
en: What Chinese policymakers don’t seem to recognize is that such interventions carry serious long-term costs.

zh: 很少有人愿意在一个政府可以随意修改规则的市场从事投资活动。
en: Few want to invest in a market where the government can change the rules at any moment.

zh: 中国近来的货币市场干预也发出了混杂的信号。
en: China’s recent intervention in the currency market also sent mixed signals.

zh: 多年来，政府在追求人民币国际化期间支持人民币升值 — — 这项工作在国际货币基金组织（IMF）最近决定将人民币纳入构成其储备资产的货币篮子 — — 即所谓特别提款权时达到了高潮。
en: For years, the authorities tended to support the renminbi, as they pursued renminbi internationalization – an effort that culminated in the International Monetary Fund’s recent decision to add the renminbi to the basket of currencies that compose its reserve asset, so-called Special Drawing Rights.

zh: 股市崩盘后不久，政府允许人民币贬值。
en: Not long after the stock-market crash, however, the authorities allowed the currency to depreciate.

zh: 中国应该沿这条路走下去，坚持采用这种为自由市场经济体所普遍采用的旨在确保价格和就业最佳组合的货币政策方法。
en: China should continue along this path, pursuing the kind of monetary-policy approach – aimed at securing the right combination of prices and employment – that prevails in free-market economies.

zh: 持续的货币贬值将为经济放缓提供迫切需要的提振，就像安倍经济学利用日元贬值协助日本摆脱了一场旷日持久的经济衰退。
en: Continued currency depreciation would provide a much-needed boost to the slowing economy, just as depreciation of the yen through Abenomics has helped to lift Japan out of a protracted recession.

zh: 随着2015年临近尾声，中国领导人发现自己正处在十字路口。
en: As 2015 closes, China’s leaders find themselves at a crossroads.

zh: 他们必须决定是要继续控制经济，还是兑现其承诺，建立真正以市场为导向的体制。
en: They must decide whether to continue trying to control the economy or to follow through on their promise to build a genuinely market-oriented system.

zh: 为了中国及其邻国的利益，我们希望他们坚持奉行自由市场计划。
en: For China’s sake, and that of its neighbors, one hopes they stick to the free-market plan.

zh: 中国的现代化野心
en: China’s Modernization Ambitions

zh: 发自北京 — — 在去年十月中国共产党第十九次全国代表大会开幕会上的工作报告中，中国国家主席习近平誓言中国将在2035年“基本实现现代化 ” ， 并在2049年 — — 也就是中华人民共和国成立100周年之际 — — 成为高收入国家。
en: BEIJING – Last October, as he opened the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, President Xi Jinping vowed that the country would have a “fully modern” economy by 2035, and would reach high-income status by 2049 – the 100th anniversary of the founding of the People’s Republic.

zh: 而人们都希望他能比在1964年承诺要在二十世纪末实现“四个现代化”的新中国第一任总理周恩来取得更大的成就。
en: One hopes that he is more successful than China’s first premier, Zhou Enlai, who in 1964 promised “four modernizations” by the end of the twentieth century.

zh: 周恩来的方案把重点放在四个关键部门的改革：农业，工业，国防和科技。
en: Zhou’s plan focused on reforming four key sectors: agriculture, industry, defense, and science and technology.

zh: 他并未设定具体的收入目标，但可以肯定地说，他或许预期中国能有更好的表现：根据世界银行的标准，世纪之交的中国依然属于中低收入国家。
en: He did not set a specific income goal, but it is safe to say that he probably expected China to do better than it did: by World Bank standards, China at the turn of the century was a lower-middle-income country.

zh: 这一次实现收入目标可能并不困难。
en: This time around, reaching China’s income goals might actually be the easy part.

zh: 中国的实际人均GDP目前约相当于美国的25 ％ 。
en: China’s real per capita GDP currently amounts to about 25% that of the United States.

zh: 而如果要加入以经合组织为代表的高收入俱乐部的话，就必须将这一数字提高到至少45 ％ （ 取决于实际收入的衡量方式 ） — —到目前为止已经有36~40个经济体达到了这一水平。
en: To join the high-income club, embodied by the OECD, China will have to raise that figure to at least 45% (depending on how real income is measured) – a level achieved, so far, by 36-40 economies.

zh: 如果中国经济能从今年开始每年增长率至少高于美国1.7%的话，那么就有望在2049年加入这些国家的行列。
en: China could join these countries’ ranks by 2049 if its economy grows by at least 1.7 percentage points more than the US economy every year, starting now.

zh: 换句话说假设美国经济保持2％的长期增长，中国就得每年增长3.7 ％ （ 这也比目前的6.5％低得多 ） 。
en: Assuming that the US economy maintains its long-term growth rate of 2%, China would have to grow by 3.7% annually. That’s a lot lower than China’s current 6.5% rate.

zh: 即使到2049年时中国GDP增长率稳步降至2 ％ ， 其平均增长率也至少相当于4 ％ 。
en: Even if China’s GDP growth decelerated steadily to 2% by 2049, the average rate would amount to at least 4%.

zh: 但现代化可不仅仅与收入有关，更是一个全面的进程，最终令中国社会具备当今发达民主国家所能提供的各类好处 — — 发展机会，个人福祉和公共服务，而完成这个进程绝非易事。
en: But modernization is about more than income. It is a comprehensive process that would ultimately transform China into a society with the kinds of benefits – opportunities, personal comforts, and public services – found in today’s advanced democracies.

zh: 首先，中国必须对环境加以清理整治 — — 这在普通中国人看来不是奢侈品，而是一种必要。
en: For starters, China will have to clean up its environment – something that ordinary Chinese now view not as a luxury, but as an imperative.

zh: 政府已经采取了一些积极措施：比如北京周边地区的空气质量在今年冬天大幅改善，这要归功于关闭污染企业并用天然气代替煤炭供暖。
en: The government has taken some positive steps: the air quality around Beijing, for example, has improved considerably this winter, thanks to efforts to shut down polluting factories and replace coal with natural gas for household heating.

zh: 但是这种改善的成本很高，包括导致天然气价格上涨。
en: But this change has come at a high cost, including rising natural gas prices.

zh: 仅仅是对中国所有城市的空气质量加以改善，更别提清理国内所有受污染的河流，湖泊和土壤，都将带来巨大的成本。
en: The cost of improving air quality in all Chinese cities, let alone cleaning up all the polluted rivers, lakes, and soil in the country, will be massive.

zh: 中国在实现现代化方面所面临的第二个挑战则是缩小城乡差距。
en: A second challenge China faces in pursuing modernization is to narrow the rural-urban divide.

zh: 尽管收入差距已经有所缩小，但农村居民依然难以获得优质的教育，基础设施和公共服务。
en: Notwithstanding the narrowing income gap, rural residents still face inferior access to education, infrastructure, and public services.

zh: 持续的城市化将有所帮助，但即使是最乐观的预测也表明到2035年仍会有超过3亿中国人居住在农村地区。
en: Continued urbanization will help, but even the most optimistic forecast estimates that more than 300 million people will still living in the countryside in 2035.

zh: 无论那些城市如何光鲜亮丽，只要农村地区仍然落后，这个国家就算不上是现代化。
en: No country can be considered modern, regardless of how shiny and dynamic its cities are, if its rural areas are left behind.

zh: 此外还有人口方面的现代化挑战，因为世界银行的数据显示中国的适龄劳动人口数量到2040年可能会相对当前水平减少超过10 ％ 。
en: Compounding the modernization challenges China faces, its working-age population is beginning to decline, and could fall by more than 10% by 2040, according to the World Bank.

zh: 虽然自动化可以保护中国免遭严重劳动力短缺的掣肘，但人口老龄化会增加社会保障体系的经济负担。
en: While automation may protect China from severe labor shortages, population aging will increase the economic burden of social security.

zh: 尽管在20年前就已经引入了个人账户体系，但中国的养老金制度基本上还是在现收现付的基础上运作。
en: Despite the introduction of individual accounts 20 years ago, China’s pension system effectively still functions on a pay-as-you-go basis.

zh: 当1962~1976年间出生的中国“婴儿潮”一代开始退休时，该系统的赤字将上升。
en: When China’s “baby boom” generation – born between 1962 and 1976 – begin to retire, the system’s deficits will mount.

zh: 事实上一些迅速老龄化和增长缓慢的省份目前只能依靠中央政府的补贴来维持。
en: In fact, some rapidly aging and slow-growing provinces already depend on central government subsidies.

zh: 中国迫切需要一个更加统一和全面的体系来平衡全国的社会保障覆盖。
en: China desperately needs a more unified and comprehensive system to balance social security coverage across the country.

zh: 当然，中国不断上涨的国民收入将有助于应对该国所面临的挑战。
en: Of course, China’s rising national income will help the country confront the challenges it faces.

zh: 但财富虽然必要，却不是万能的。
en: But wealth, while necessary, is not sufficient.

zh: 首先，法治必须得到相当程度的加强，而不仅仅是遏制官员腐败。
en: For one thing, the rule of law must be strengthened considerably, and not just to rein in official corruption.

zh: 同时还要需要实现文化上的转变，让公民学习如何在一个由可靠的规则和法律架构 — — 而不是地理或家庭血缘关系 — — 来主导的社会中生存和发展。
en: There needs to be a cultural shift, with citizens learning how to function in a society governed by reliable rules and legal structures, not geographical or familial ties.

zh: 好消息在于习近平已经认识到了法治的重要性。
en: The good news is that Xi recognizes the importance of the rule of law.

zh: 在他提交给全国代表大会的报告中有20多处提到了法治，并强调要“全面推进依法治理的总体目标”以“建设社会主义法治国家 ” ， 但还是需要做出更多的工作去转变中国的传统生活方式，而不仅仅是发表一些指向性的言论。
en: In the report he delivered to the National Congress, he mentioned the phrase more than 20 times, emphasizing “the overall goal of comprehensively advancing law-based governance” in order to “build a country of socialist rule of law.” Nonetheless, transforming traditional ways of living in China will require more than hortatory rhetoric.

zh: 中国的政治制度内含的一个关键障碍在于：虽然人们普遍认为民主对于充满活力的公民社会是不可或缺的，但是当局已经下定决心不以任何方式，形态或形式去引入选举民主。
en: One key obstacle lies in the Chinese political system. It is widely believed that democracy is indispensable for a dynamic civil society.

zh: 而各个发达民主国家最近的政治走势，尤其是包括美国总统特朗普在内的右翼民粹主义运动和领导人的崛起，更是加强了他们的这一决心。
en: Yet the Chinese authorities are determined not to introduce electoral democracy in any way, shape, or form. Recent political developments in advanced democracies – in particular, the rise of right-wing populist movements and leaders, including US President Donald Trump – have reinforced their resolve.

zh: 在提高了人民生活水平的情况下 ， “ 中国模式”满足了政治合法性的一些要求。
en: To the extent that it raises living standards, the “China Model” fulfills some requirements of political legitimacy.

zh: 可一旦这些生活水平达到一定水平，中国人民几乎必定会产生更多的人身自由和政治问责诉求。
en: But, once those living standards reach a certain level, the Chinese people will almost certainly demand more personal freedom and political accountability.

zh: 那么中国领导人面临的最根本的挑战就在于在继续摒除选举民主的情况下找到一个能满足这些要求的治理模式。
en: The most fundamental challenge facing China’s leaders, then, is to find a governance model that fulfills these demands while continuing to exclude electoral democracy.

zh: 中国与民主的未来
en: China and the Future of Democracy

zh: 伦敦—中国会马上成为世界领先的经济和地缘政治力量吗？
en: LONDON – Will China soon be the world’s leading economic and geopolitical power?

zh: 它是否如一些人所称的那样，已经实现了这一地位？
en: Has it achieved this status already, as some suppose?

zh: 如果这两个问题的其中任何一个的答案是肯定的，对民主的未来的全球影响为何？
en: And if the answer to either question is yes, what are the global implications for the future of democracy?

zh: 中国崛起的证据是明确的。
en: The indicators of China’s rise are clear.

zh: 按总GDP衡量，中国将在二十年内取代美国，尽管准确的时间点预测取决于你对两个经济体的增长率以及人民币换算成美元的汇率的假设。
en: China is poised to overtake the United States in terms of aggregate GDP within two decades, although forecasting precisely when depends on what one assumes about the growth rates of the two economies and the exchange rate used to convert renminbi into dollars.

zh: 中国已经是世界领先的贸易经济，它推动人民币国际化之举让越来越大比例的贸易用其自己的货币结算，有望对美元作为领先全球货币的地位发起挑战。
en: China is already the world’s leading trading economy, and its push to internationalize the renminbi has resulted in a growing share of that trade being settled in its own currency, potentially challenging the dollar’s position as the leading global currency.

zh: 此外，中国正在向非洲和南亚输出外国投资，从这些负债累累的商业伙伴手中换取军事基地和其他地缘战略资产。
en: Moreover, China is pumping foreign investment into economies across Africa and South Asia, obtaining military bases and other geostrategic assets in return from its heavily indebted commercial partners.

zh: 其一带一路计划进一步推动了中国的对外投资，深化了其与欧亚大陆各国的经济联系。
en: Its Belt and Road Initiative is further fueling China’s outward investment and deepening its economic links with countries across the Eurasian landmass.

zh: 还有中国的软实力：它的学校计划、文化交流、博物馆展览和联合国教科文组织项目。
en: And then there is China’s soft power: its school programs, cultural exchanges, museum exhibitions, and UNESCO projects.

zh: 这一不断提升的地缘战略影响力、崛起的软实力，以及（最重要的）不断的经济成功表明，其他国家将把中国视为效仿的榜样。
en: This growing geostrategic influence, rising soft power and, above all, continued economic success suggest that other countries will see China as a model to emulate.

zh: 它们将向往中国的政治模式 — — 避开西方民主的混乱，支持集中化的行政控制。
en: They will be attracted to its political model, which eschews the chaos of Western democracy in favor of centralized administrative control.

zh: 特朗普政府混乱的治国方针、英国保守党混乱的退欧管理，以及意大利组织政府不力 — — 略举三个民主失序的例子 — — 让中国模式的吸引力更加巨大了。
en: The attractions are even more alluring against the backdrop of the Trump administration’s incoherent approach to governing, the British Tories’ shambolic efforts to manage Brexit, and Italy’s inability to form a government, to cite just three examples of democratic disarray.

zh: 相反，中国展现出的实力、繁荣与稳定越强大，其极权模式的号召力也越强。
en: By contrast, the more power, prosperity, and stability China projects, the greater the appeal of its authoritarian model.

zh: 新兴和发展中国家的观察者们时常发现，在民主制度中，形成决定代价高昂，结果也难以持续。
en: Observers in emerging and developing countries are apt to note that decisions are costly to reach and difficult to sustain in democratic systems.

zh: 过程和结果都不可靠。
en: Both the process and results are unreliable.

zh: 中国方法 — — 目前已经为两代人带来了成果 — — 看上去更有效果，从最需要持续增长的穷国的角度看尤其如此。
en: China’s approach, which has delivered the goods for two generations now, has more going for it, especially from the perspective of poor countries where sustained growth is the priority.

zh: 据说这不可避免地将令更多国家效仿中国的治理。
en: This makes it inevitable, it is said, that more countries will emulate Chinese governance.

zh: 这一观察也对民主的未来蒙上了一层深刻的疑云。
en: And this observation casts grave doubt on the future of democracy.

zh: 但这一信心满满的预测忽略了一个关键点。
en: But this confident forecast misses a key point.

zh: 民主也许混乱，但它包含了一个内在纠错机制。
en: Democracy may be messy, but it contains a built-in course-correction mechanism.

zh: 当政策方向错误时，承担错误责任的现任可能 — — 也常常 — — 会通过选举被赶下台，被（至少在理论上）胜任的对手取而代之。
en: When policy goes awry, the incumbents responsible for the mistake can be, and often are, voted out of office, to be replaced, in principle at least, by more competent rivals.

zh: 极权机制不存在这样的自动调整机制。
en: An authoritarian regime has no such automatic adjustment mechanism.

zh: 独裁领导人不会轻易放弃权力，可能会（自作聪明地）选择加倍实施失败的政策。
en: Autocratic leaders will not give up power easily, and may choose, in their wisdom, to double down on failed policies.

zh: 没有迫使他们改变政策的有序的方法。
en: There is no orderly way of compelling them to do otherwise.

zh: 群众起义 — — 如波兰的团结运动（Solidarity ） ， 或权贵反抗 — — 如苏联发生多次的情况，有可能强迫政策改变。
en: A popular uprising, like the Solidarity movement in Poland, or a revolt of the nomenklatura, such as in the Soviet Union, can force the issue.

zh: 但常常需要等到旷日持久的政治和政策僵局已经到了不得不打破的程度 — — 并且常常造成高昂的代价，如群众暴力和生命损失。
en: But this typically happens only when an extended political and policy stalemate must be broken – and it often comes at a high cost in terms of public violence and loss of life.

zh: 此外，认为中国领导人会继续永远避免严重的政策错误，以及他们作为危机管理者的能力永远不会经受考验也完全是出于幻想。
en: Moreover, the idea that China’s leaders will continue to avoid serious policy errors indefinitely, and that their capacity as crisis managers will never be tested is, quite simply, fanciful.

zh: 多种冲击 — — 某家负债累累的公司倒闭、中国金融机构隐藏的问题暴露、全球能源价格暴涨，或严重的地缘政治事件 — — 只要发生任何一个，都有可能让增长难以为继。
en: Any one of a number of shocks – the failure of a heavily-indebted corporation, revelations of hidden problems in Chinese financial institutions, a spike in global energy prices, or a serious geopolitical event – could bring growth tumbling down.

zh: 中国金融市场的开放突显出中国经济暴露于资本流波动的风险中，也加大了资本外逃的规模。
en: The opening of China’s financial markets heightens the economy’s exposure to volatile capital flows and increases the scope for capital flight.

zh: 而与朝鲜咫尺相邻的中国的地缘政治周边环境也不太有利。
en: And China, close as it is to North Korea, is not in a good geopolitical neighborhood.

zh: 简言之，灾难就在眼前，而如果中国领导人无法管理好灾难所造成的余波，公众就有可能不再支持他们。
en: In short, stuff happens, and if Chinese leaders do not manage the fallout well when it does, the public could turn against them.

zh: 体制如何应对这一情况将是一个悲惨的故事。
en: How the regime responds in that case will tell the tale.

zh: 这个故事 — — 你可以说“天安门广场”吗？ — — 没有哪家政府希望在国内重复。
en: And it could be a tale – can you say “Tiananmen Square”? – that no government wants to reprise at home.

zh: 显然，中国正在崛起成为世界强国，并且速度很快，以至于美国眼看已经成为不可靠的伙伴，只关注自己的利益而不惜在必要时牺牲其他国家。
en: China, clearly, is emerging as a world power, even more quickly than it otherwise would, to the extent that the US is coming to be seen as an unreliable partner concerned only with advancing its own interests – at the expense, if necessary, of other countries.

zh: 但认为中国将继续在相当长的一段时间内以5%上下的速度增长违反了预测的第一法则：不可将现状外推到未来。
en: But the belief that China will continue growing at mid-single-digit rates for an extended period violates the first rule of forecasting: don’t extrapolate the present into the future.

zh: 在某个时点，中国将遭遇颠簸，谁也不能保证其领导人将承认失败并据此调整政策。
en: At some point, China will hit bumps in the road, and there is no guarantee that its leaders will admit their failures and adjust policy accordingly.

zh: 到了那时，强力政治控制的中国模式对于其他国家将不再那么有吸引力，特别是如果体制重拳镇压公民社会的话。
en: At that point, the Chinese model of strong political control will appear less alluring to other countries, especially if the regime clamps down hard on civil society.

zh: 到了那一步，民主可能好歹还有个未来。
en: Democracy, then, may have a future after all.

zh: 中国出任G-20主席国的贡献
en: The Promise of China’s G-20 Presidency

zh: 香港—再过一个月，中国就将成为G-20主席国。
en: HONG KONG – In just over a month, China will assume the G-20 presidency.

zh: 今后一年 — — 特别是9月在杭州举行的G-20峰会期间 — — 中国准备为建设更加“创新、活力、联动、包容”的世界经济奠定基础。
en: Over the next year – and especially at the organization’s September summit, to be held in Hangzhou – China plans to help lay the groundwork for a world economy that is more “innovative, invigorated, interconnected, and inclusive.”

zh: 问题在于如何实现。
en: The question is how.

zh: 我们可以首先看看现任G-20主席国土耳其在今年峰会的议题，它强调包容、实施和以增长为目标的投资。
en: One place to look is the current G-20 presidency, held by Turkey, which has emphasized inclusiveness, implementation, and investment for growth.

zh: 尽管在G-20内部确保形成共识向来十分困难，但土耳其在主席国任上仍取得了三项关键成功。
en: Though securing consensus within the G-20 is notoriously difficult, the Turkish presidency has had three key successes.

zh: 去年，土耳其牵头制定了G-20国家提振增长政策的新问责框架。
en: In the last year, Turkey has spearheaded a new accountability framework for efforts to boost growth in the G-20 countries.

zh: 它成立了世界中小企业论坛（World Small and Medium Enterprise Forum ） ， 旨在加强中小企业对全球经济的贡献。
en: It has launched a World Small and Medium Enterprise Forum aimed at enhancing the contributions of SMEs to the global economy.

zh: 而在最近的G-20安塔利亚峰会上（举行于11月13日巴黎恐怖袭击前两天 ） ， G-20达成共识，将打击伊斯兰国作为“主要重点 ” 。
en: And at the recent G-20 summit in Antalya, held just two days after the November 13 terrorist attacks in Paris, a consensus emerged that the fight against the Islamic State is a “major priority.”

zh: 简言之，今年G-20峰会获得了一些动力，而中国可以从中获益。
en: In short, the G-20 has gained some momentum, and China can benefit.

zh: 如果最新的联合国气候变化会议产生一个有约束力的全球遏制温室气体排放协定，这一动力将进一步增强。
en: If the current United Nations Climate Change Conference produces a binding global agreement to curb greenhouse-gas emissions, that momentum will become even stronger.

zh: 目前G-20占据世界人口的三分之二和GDP的85 % ， 任何全球协议的实施都无法脱离G-20。
en: Given that the G-20 countries represent two-thirds of the world’s population and 85% of its GDP, they would be integral to the implementation of any deal.

zh: 通过为这些国家提供一个框架定期会晤讨论气候变化等全球问题，G-20，作为一个自我选择的成员组成的俱乐部，可以赢得合法性。
en: By providing a framework for these countries to meet regularly to discuss global challenges like climate change, the G-20 – which is, at best, a club of self-selected members – gains legitimacy.

zh: 所有这些都有利于帮助中国应对全球增长、贸易和投资放缓。
en: All of this bodes well for China’s capacity to help counter the global slowdown in growth, trade, and investment.

zh: 时间已经不多了：持续减速是当前世界经济面临的最大风险之一，因为这可能加剧已经十分脆弱的国家的绝望和动荡，同时迫使较为强健的经济体转向自顾而不去解决愈演愈烈的危机。
en: And not a moment too soon: The ongoing slowdown is among the greatest risks the world currently faces, because it could exacerbate desperation and instability in already-fragile countries, while compelling more robust economies to turn inward, rather than address proliferating crises.

zh: 幸运的是，中国最近一直在表明其成为更负责任的全球相关利益方的承诺。
en: Fortunately, China has lately been showing its commitment to becoming a more responsible global stakeholder.

zh: 最引人瞩目的也许要数最近在北京成立的亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行 ） 。 亚投行将作为中国对外投资的主要载体之一。
en: Perhaps most notable, it recently led the establishment of the Beijing-based Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), which will serve largely as a vehicle for Chinese foreign investment.

zh: 具体而言，亚投行（以及其它机构）将为中国宏大的“一带一路”政策提供资金。 一带一路旨在以大规模基础设施投资加强整个亚洲通过中东进入欧洲的贸易联系。
en: Specifically, the AIIB will (among other things) provide funding for China’s ambitious “one belt, one road” policy, which aims to enhance trade linkages throughout Asia, across the Middle East, and into Europe, through massive infrastructure investment.

zh: 尽管有美国和日本的反对，仍有50多个国家签署成为亚投行创始成员国，这一事实表明，成员国对基础设施的紧迫需求压倒了地缘政治竞争。
en: The fact that more than 50 countries signed on as founding members, despite opposition from the United States and Japan, indicates that members’ interest in securing resources to meet urgent infrastructure trumps geopolitical competition.

zh: 同样的务实主义也体现在中国对于自己被排除在最近达成的跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP）贸易协定的反应上。 TPP由美国牵头，包括了12个环太平洋国家。
en: The same brand of pragmatism was apparent in China’s response to its exclusion from the recently agreed Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP) trade agreement, spearheaded by the US and including 12 Pacific Rim countries.

zh: 中国对TPP并没有激烈的反应，而是表态愿意按需追求不同形式的贸易协定。
en: Instead of grandstanding, China has shown its willingness to pursue different types of trade arrangements, as needed.

zh: 如果中国能抓住担任G-20主席国的机会，斡旋完成停滞已久的世贸组织多哈发展回合，其作为全球利益相关方的地位将得到加强。
en: If China can grasp the opportunity of the G-20 presidency to broker a deal to conclude the World Trade Organization’s long-stalled Doha Development Round, its credentials as a global stakeholder would be enhanced.

zh: 诚然，中国最终可能还是会加入TPP，一些中国人相信这如同加入世贸组织一样能够支持国内改革。
en: To be sure, China might ultimately join the TPP, a move that some Chinese believe would, like accession to the WTO, support domestic reform.

zh: 但即使中国不加入TPP，仍可以继续为加强贸易做出贡献。
en: But even if China stays out, it seems likely to continue doing its part to enhance trade.

zh: 还有更令人振奋的消息。
en: There is more promising news.

zh: 人民币即将加入美元、英镑、欧元和日元的行列，成为决定国际货币基金组织（IMF）储备资产价值（SDR特别提款权）的货币篮子成员。
en: The Chinese renminbi is poised to join the US dollar, the British pound, the euro, and the Japanese yen in the basket of currencies that determines the value of the International Monetary Fund’s reserve asset, Special Drawing Rights.

zh: 人民币距离成为储备货币又近了一步，这意味着中国帮助世界 — — 特别是新兴市场经济体 — — 处理即将到来的市场波动的能力得到了极大的增强。
en: With the renminbi moving one step closer to becoming a reserve currency, China’s capacity to help the world – and especially emerging-market economies – cope with impending market volatility will be greatly enhanced.

zh: 构建一个强健、统一和快速增长的全球经济是十分困难的，即使是在最有���的环境下。
en: Building a robust, unified, and fast-growing global economy will be extremely difficult even under the most favorable circumstances.

zh: 如果世界多国 — — 最引人瞩目的是中东 — — 陷于混乱和暴力难以自拔，这将是一个不可能完成的任务。
en: It will be impossible if large swaths of the world – most notably, the Middle East – remain mired in chaos and violence.

zh: 因此，中国可以像土耳其一样，利用担任G-20主席国的机会促进结束叙利亚冲突。 通过追求振兴贸易、投资和就业的战略来支持整个中东为达到长期和平及经济发展目标形成共识。
en: Given this, China could, like Turkey, use its G-20 presidency to promote consensus on the need to end the Syrian conflict and to support long-term peace and economic development throughout the Middle East by pursuing strategies that revive trade, investment, and employment.

zh: 在多极世界中，强调共同利益是促进合作和进步的关键。
en: In a multipolar world, emphasis on common interests is the key to fostering cooperation and progress.

zh: 尽管叙利亚危机毫无疑问极其复杂，并且牵涉到的行动方 — — 如伊朗、俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯和土耳其 — — 各有各的目标，但无人可以否认社会和政治稳定带来的经济利益。
en: Though the Syrian crisis is undoubtedly highly complex, and the actors involved – such as Iran, Russia, Saudi Arabia, and Turkey – have distinct objectives, no one can deny the economic benefits of social and political stability.

zh: 类似地，尽管一些发达经济体可能会追求紧缩，但现实是更强的增长有利于所有人。 能源和大宗商品价格上涨能让新兴经济体走出当前的低增长和债务陷阱。
en: Likewise, while the advanced economies may be tempted to pursue austerity, the reality is that stronger growth would benefit everyone, with rising energy and commodity prices lifting the emerging economies out of their current low-growth and debt trap.

zh: 明年，G-20拥有一个重要机会证明其能够有效处理从世界经济长期停滞的风险到跨国恐怖主义祸害的全球危机。
en: Next year, the G-20 has an important opportunity to show that it can deal effectively with global crises, from the risk of secular stagnation to the scourge of transnational terrorism.

zh: 通过正确地结合现实主义和权力共享，中国的G-20主席国任期能够催化全球治理的重要进步 — — 甚至可能为建立一个适合二十一世纪的新全球经济架构打下一个坚实的基础。
en: With the right mix of realism and power sharing, China’s G-20 presidency could catalyze important progress – and perhaps even place a firm foundation beneath a new global economic architecture fit for the twenty-first century.

zh: 中国的G-20时刻
en: China’s G-20 Moment

zh: 北京—2009年，全世界松了口气。
en: BEIJING – The world caught a break in 2009.

zh: 由世界最大发达经济体和主要新兴经济体组成的G-20 — — 但目前仍未在世界舞台上留下浓墨重彩 — — 在匹兹堡召开会议，制定应对全球金融危机的措施。
en: The G-20, an assembly of the world’s largest developed and major emerging economies – which had thus far failed to make a serious mark on the world stage – was meeting in Pittsburgh to formulate a response to the global financial crisis.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马已经知道G-7无法独力管理全球经济，因此，在这次他领衔的峰会上，他让G-20成为协调全球经济政策的主要机构。
en: US President Barack Obama, having gotten the message that the G-7 could no longer oversee the global economy on its own, led a summit that made the G-20 the primary body for coordinating global economic policy.

zh: 这是美国领导力的顶点。
en: It was a highpoint for American leadership.

zh: 明年，另一个世界超级经济强国将成为G-20的主席国并举办G-20年度峰会。
en: Next year, the world’s other economic superpower will assume the presidency of the G-20 and host its annual summit.

zh: 尽管人们预计中国的领导不具备2009年这样的戏剧性，但中国国家主席习近平毫无疑问会留下自己的印记。
en: Though China’s leadership will, it is hoped, lack the drama of 2009, President Xi Jinping will undoubtedly make an impression of his own.

zh: 如果在去年举办亚太经济合作（Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation ）峰会时他抓住机会推进了亚太贸易协定，那么他显然不会放弃确保G-20日程服务中国利益的机会。
en: If he did not miss the opportunity to advance the goal of an Asia-Pacific trade agreement while hosting last year’s Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, he certainly will not pass up the chance to ensure that the G-20 agenda serves China’s interests.

zh: 当然，在土耳其主持G-20的时期就要开始的时候，习近平还没有确定具体的优先事项。
en: Of course, with Turkey’s term at the G-20’s helm having barely begun, Xi probably has not yet settled on specific priorities.

zh: 但一些潜在关注领域已经浮现。
en: But some potential areas of concern are already apparent.

zh: 目前的G-20日程要素与中国国内的经济问题十分契合，特别是基础设施问题。
en: Elements of the current G-20 agenda align well with China’s domestic economic concerns, especially with regard to infrastructure.

zh: 去年，G-20成员国同意实施旨在促进基础设施项目和（关键性地）中小企业投资、增加资金支持的全球基础设施计划。
en: Last year, G-20 members agreed to pursue a global infrastructure initiative aimed at facilitating investment and boosting financing for infrastructure projects and, crucially, for small and medium-size enterprises.

zh: 中小企业将在中国的新增长战略中扮演关键角色，并且它们贡献了中国新增就业岗位的85 % ， 因此这一计划十分契合中国。
en: Given that SMEs will play a key role in China’s new growth strategy, and already account for some 85% of new jobs in the country, this initiative suits China well.

zh: 土耳其已经确定要让中小企业成为促进包容性增长的载体，因此今年的峰会可能在这方面取得进展。
en: With Turkey having zeroed in on SMEs as a key vehicle for fostering more inclusive growth, this year’s summit could already produce progress on this front.

zh: 但其他与基础设施相关的机会也在闪光。
en: But other infrastructure-related opportunities beckon.

zh: 中国一直在寻求让亚洲的连通性达到与北美和西欧旗鼓相当的水平 — — 亚洲开发银行（Asian Development Bank）在2009年时估算，到2020年，这一工程将耗资8万亿美元。
en: China has long sought to place Asia on par with North America and Western Europe in terms of connectivity – a project that the Asian Development Bank estimated in 2009 would cost $8 trillion by 2020.

zh: 作为目前实现亚洲开发银行支出目标的唯一一个亚洲新兴经济体，中国可以利用担任G-20主席国的机会说服邻国增加该地区的投资。
en: China, the only major Asian emerging economy that is currently meeting the ADB’s spending target, could use its G-20 presidency to persuade its neighbors to increase investment in this area.

zh: G-20还有可能让中国得以推进关键地缘政治目标：改革国际货币基金组织（IMF）的投票权。
en: The G-20 may also enable China to advance a key geopolitical objective: the reform of voting rights at the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 奥巴马也许是构想G-20领导地位的领导人；但美国显然极不情愿允许新兴力量影响力进入多边机构。 新兴大国不断增长的经济分量让它们提出了新的要求。
en: Obama may be the leader who envisaged a premier role for the G-20; but the United States has displayed a distinct aversion to allowing emerging powers to exert the influence over multilateral institutions that their increased economic weight warrants and demands.

zh: 事实上，美国国会一直没有批准2010年达成一致的IMF改革方案，如若改革实施，则中国等国家将拥有更大的决策影响力。 美国的这一做法保护了西欧 — — 西欧国家是现状的最大受益者。
en: Indeed, the US Congress has consistently failed to ratify a package of IMF reforms, agreed in 2010, that would give countries like China greater say in decision-making – a failure that protects Western Europe, whose members benefit most from the status quo.

zh: 如果中国利用其G-20领导地位大力推进变革，则不但可以增加其自身获得IMF更大话语权的机会；也可以给其他新兴国家带来好处 — — 它们也对美国（和欧洲）领导人对待这一问题的态度十分不满。
en: If China uses its G-20 leadership to push vigorously for change, it would not only improve its own chances of gaining more authority in the IMF; it would also gain favor with other emerging economies, which have been similarly frustrated by US (and European) leaders’ treatment of the issue.

zh: 中国还有可能收获另一个长期由美国和欧洲主宰的领域的领导地位：全球金融体系。
en: There is also scope for China to assume a leadership role in another domain long dominated by the US and Europe: the global financial system.

zh: 中国常常批评美元的支配地位导致全球金融陷入不必要的波动，它可以利用担任G-20主席国的机会要求增加通常被认为是唯一的国际货币 — — IMF特别提款权（Special Drawing Rights，SDR）的作用。
en: China, where the US dollar’s predominant role is often criticized for having subjected global finance to unnecessary volatility, could use its G-20 presidency to demand a larger role for what is often considered the world’s only international currency: the IMF’s Special Drawing Rights.

zh: 在此过程中，将人民币加入确定SDR价值的货币组合符���中国的利益。
en: In this effort, it would be in China’s interest to add the renminbi to the basket of currencies that determine the SDR’s value.

zh: 是的，2011年IMF拒绝了这一方案，因为人民币尚不符合可自由兑换货币的标准。
en: To be sure, the IMF rejected this proposition in 2011, because the renminbi did not yet meet the criteria of a freely convertible currency.

zh: 但IMF也暗示可以灵活调整，它让步说，因为SDR从根本上说是一种储备资产，因此其基础货币只需要在“充分流动和深化的市场”中可以获得就行。
en: But the IMF also hinted at a willingness to be flexible, conceding that, because the SDR is fundamentally a reserve asset, the currencies that underpin it need only to be available in “sufficiently liquid and deep markets.”

zh: 此外，在过去几年中，中国当局逐渐放松了对资本账户的管制，这让人民币成为全球第五大结算货币。
en: And, over the last few years, China’s authorities have gradually loosened their grip on the capital account, allowing the renminbi to become the fifth most popular currency for settling global payments.

zh: 目前，至少有60家央行将人民币纳入了外汇储备组合，因此明年对中国来说是一个推进其改革全球货币体系的长期目标的理想机会。
en: With at least 60 central banks now including renminbi among their foreign reserves, next year could present an ideal opportunity for China to advance its long-term goal of reshaping the world monetary system.

zh: 与此同时，中国可以追求改变国际金融监管动态。
en: At the same time, China might pursue a shift in the dynamic of international financial regulation.

zh: G-7经济体 — — 毫不奇怪，它们在过去20年中决定着国际标准 — — 在指名道姓指责新兴经济体没有遵守国际范式方面从来不会犹豫。
en: The G-7 economies – which, no surprise, have dictated international standards for the last 20 years – have rarely hesitated to name and shame emerging economies for their failure to comply with global norms.

zh: 尽管中国的国内监管机制仍饱受各种约束，但中国领导人可以利用G-20峰会改变口风，强调美国和欧洲没有完成它们的监管日程。
en: Though China’s domestic regulatory regime remains subject to severe constraints, China’s leaders could use the G-20 summit to change the narrative, highlighting the failure of the US and Europe to complete their regulatory agendas.

zh: 如果中国成功迫使它们这样做，将带来巨大的好处 — — 不仅限于其国际声望。
en: If China managed to compel them to do so, it would benefit considerably – and not just in terms of its international reputation.

zh: 作为出口导向型经济和拥有世界最大规模外汇储备的国家 — — 更不用提其保守的国内金融体系了 — — 中国已暴露在国际经济和金融的动荡之下。
en: With an export-oriented economy and the world’s largest pile of foreign reserves, not to mention a conservative domestic financial system, China is exposed to international economic and financial volatility.

zh: 明年，中国也许无法实现所有目标。
en: China may not be able to achieve all of its goals next year.

zh: 但如果它能打出好牌，就可以极大地增加其国际影响力，同时增强全球经济和金融稳定。
en: But, if it plays its cards right, it could do much to increase its international influence, while enhancing global economic and financial stability.

zh: 这应该成为未来几个月中国领导人的重点考虑问题。
en: That should give China’s leaders much to consider in the coming months.

zh: 中国领导发展的机会
en: China’s Chance to Lead on Development

zh: 北京—9月，中国将首次主办G20世界领导人会议。
en: BEIJING – In September, China will host the G20 meeting of world leaders for the first time.

zh: 这是扮演领导角色的最佳良机。
en: It could not have chosen a more opportune moment to assume a leadership role.

zh: 中国国家主席习近平应该抓住这次机会，将中国雄心勃勃的发展日程推向全球。
en: Chinese President Xi Jinping should seize the occasion to push China’s ambitious development agenda globally.

zh: 具体而言，习近平应该证明正确的发展能让所有人受益。 他还应该发起关于明年制定多边投资协定的讨论。
en: Specifically, Xi should make the case that development done right benefits everyone, and he should launch discussions on a multilateral investment agreement to be developed in the next year.

zh: 这是此次峰会的一个可以实现的目标：G20在协调多边合作方面具有相对成功的记录，如应对2008年全球金融危机的措施。
en: This is an achievable goal for the summit: the G20 has a record of relative success in coordinating multilateral efforts, such as in its response to the 2008 global financial crisis.

zh: 此外，成功的发展的秘诀早已众所周知，包括不断的技术进步（持续增长和就业的关键 ） ； 专注于人力和实物资本最大化；以及能降低交易成本和增进效率的基础设施。
en: Moreover, the ingredients of successful development are very well known. They include constant technological improvement, which is critical for sustained growth and employment; a focus on maximizing human and physical capital; and infrastructure investments geared toward reducing transaction costs and increasing efficiency.

zh: 我们还知道目前在发展方面存在哪些缺口。
en: We also know the current gaps that exist in development.

zh: 发展中国家受制于人力和金融资本水平低下，以及外汇储备不足或难以获得外汇（这限制了它们进口提高其全球价值链地位所需要的原材料和设备的能力 ） 。
en: Developing countries today are constrained by low levels of human and financial capital, and by low reserves of or access to foreign exchange, which limits their ability to import the raw materials and equipment needed to ascend global value chains.

zh: 填补人力和金融资本缺口、扩大获得外汇的渠道的最佳办法是通过外国直接投资（FDI ） 。
en: The best way to close the gaps in human and financial capital, and to increase access to foreign exchange, is through foreign direct investment.

zh: FDI应该不难吸引，因为发展中国家资本相对劳动力较为稀缺，潜在回报应该更高。
en: FDI should not be difficult to attract, because the potential returns should be higher in developing countries, where capital is scarce relative to labor.

zh: 但诺贝尔奖得主罗伯特·卢卡斯（Robert Lucas）指出，资本的流向出了问题，从低收入向高收入国家流动。
en: But as Nobel laureate Robert Lucas noted, capital has been flowing in the wrong direction, from low- to high-income countries.

zh: 这一趋势正在耗尽发展中国家的可用资本，限制它们的发展，也扩大了全球收入差距。
en: This trend is depleting developing countries’ available capital, limiting development, and widening the global income gap.

zh: 劳拉·阿尔法罗（Laura Alfaro ） 、 赛博内姆·卡伦里-奥兹坎（Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan）和瓦蒂姆·沃洛索维奇（Vadym Volosovych）在《经济学和统计学 》 （ Review of Economics and Statistics）2008年的一篇研究中指出，穷国之所以资本流出，部分是因为它们缺少接收和便利投资的机构。
en: As Laura Alfaro, Sebnem Kalemli-Ozcan, and Vadym Volosovych pointed out in a 2008 study for the Review of Economics and Statistics, poorer countries are deprived of capital flows partly because they lack the institutions that are needed to receive and facilitate investments.

zh: 从某种程度上讲，这些国家陷入了陷阱，因为它们首先需要资本发展必要的机构。
en: In a sense, these countries are trapped, because they need capital to develop these necessary institutions in the first place.

zh: 多边贸易协定能让投资于发展中国家更加容易，从而解决这一问题。
en: A multilateral investment agreement could fix this problem by making it easier to invest in developing countries.

zh: 它还能建立投资保护和激励、纠纷解决程序、公司社会责任基准和国有企业和主权基金投资的监管框架，从而强化发展中国家的经济基础。
en: It could also strengthen the economic foundation for growth in developing countries by establishing investment protections and incentives, dispute-resolution procedures, corporate social responsibility benchmarks, and regulatory frameworks for investments made by state-owned enterprises and sovereign funds.

zh: 世界贸易组织是进行这一协定的谈判的当然场所，但过去的努力以失败告终，部分是因为谈判被视为严重偏袒发达国家。
en: The World Trade Organization (WTO) is the natural place to negotiate this agreement, but past efforts have failed partly because negotiations were seen as heavily favoring developed countries over developing ones.

zh: 过去十年中，全球投资环境发生了巨大的变化，谈判也应该重新启动。
en: With the global investment environment having changed dramatically in the past decade, negotiations should be restarted.

zh: 下图表明，目前发展中国家占全球对外直接投资（ODI）的比重越来越大。
en: As the figure below shows, developing countries now account for a growing share of global outward direct investment (ODI).

zh: 这意味着一些新兴市场经济体本身正在成为资本的来源，因此能够在未来投资框架中大显身手。
en: This means that some emerging market economies themselves are becoming a source of capital and thus have a role to play in any future investment framework.

zh: 中国是最显著的例子。
en: China is the prime example.

zh: 下图显示，中国从FDI中获益良多，所以如今其自身ODI也在增长。
en: As the following graph shows, China has benefited so much from FDI that it is now increasing its own ODI.

zh: 据联合国贸易和发展会议，2013年中国成为其他国家FDI的第三大来源，并预计将在2016年首次成为资本净输出国。
en: According to the UN Conference on Trade and Development, in 2013 China became the third largest source of other countries’ FDI and is expected to become a net capital exporter for the first time in 2016.

zh: 考虑到中国鞭策国内公司赴海外投资的“走出去政策”以及建设洲际贸易基础设施的“一带一路”框架的合力，这一趋势还将持续下去。
en: This trend can only continue, considering the combined impact of China’s “Go Out Policy” of prodding domestic companies to make investments abroad, and it’s “One Belt, One Road” framework to build continent-wide trade infrastructure.

zh: 假以时日，中国很有可能将成为世界上最大的FDI来源国。
en: In time, China will likely be the world’s largest source of FDI.

zh: 在最近几十年中，中国从FDI接受国一跃成为净输出国，非常适合领导G20的全球发展讨论。
en: Having gone from being a recipient of FDI to a net contributor in recent decades, China is perfectly positioned to lead G20 discussions on global development.

zh: 中国的做法，应该是为可行发展框架制定一个切实目标，这个目标要带有实现具体里程碑的明确时间表。
en: It should do so by setting a concrete goal for a workable development framework with a clear timeline for reaching specific milestones.

zh: 一个早期里程碑应该是为发展中国家建立一个非约束性的投资便利框架。
en: An early milestone should be to establish a non-binding investment facilitation framework for developing countries.

zh: 此外，整体上，该协定应该强调包容和以诚相待，从而促进发展中和发达国家的经济增长。
en: And, more generally, the agreement should emphasize inclusiveness and honest dealing to foster economic growth for developing and developed countries alike.

zh: 中国能从特朗普贸易战中得到什么
en: What China Can Gain from Trump’s Trade War

zh: 北京 — — 全世界最大两个经济体 — — 中国和美国 — — 正在进行一场全面的贸易战，而美国总统唐纳德·特朗普原本期望的闪电战现在已经变得更像一场面对面的肉搏。
en: BEIJING – The world’s two largest economies – China and the United States – are engaged in a full-blown trade war, and what US President Donald Trump hoped would be a blitzkrieg has turned out more like trench combat.

zh: 许多人都担心这仅仅是长期冲突的开始，这样的冲突可能用到远超贸易范畴的武器，并带来远超贸易范畴的伤亡。
en: Many fear that this is only the beginning of a long conflict that could include weapons – and casualties – far outside the realm of trade.

zh: 自2001年中国加入世贸组织以来，美国一直对中国巨额经常账户盈余和人民币低估问题提出异议。
en: Since China joined the World Trade Organization in 2001, the US has taken issue with China’s large current-account surplus and the undervalued renminbi.

zh: 但过去十年来，这种盈余几乎已经消失，而人民币则基本一直呈现升值态势。
en: But over the last ten years, that surplus has pretty much disappeared, and the renminbi has largely been appreciating.

zh: 现在美国又将注意力转移到中国对知识产权的保护不力以及利用市场准入来换取外国技术的政策上。
en: Now, the US has shifted its attention to China’s inadequate protection of intellectual-property rights and its policy of appropriating foreign technology in exchange for market access.

zh: 但在中国看来，刺激美国的不仅是其具体的贸易政策，而且还包括其成为全球主要大国的愿望和整体发展模式。 实现这样的愿望并不是不可能的。
en: Yet, in China’s view, what the US is really reacting to is not only the specifics of its trade policy, but also its overall development model and its aspirations to become a major global power – aspirations that are not out of reach.

zh: 事实上，中国人相信，特朗普的贸易战有效证明了中国已经对美国霸权构成了真正和现实的威胁。
en: In fact, the Chinese believe, Trump’s trade war effectively proves that China has become a real and present threat to American hegemony.

zh: 事实是否如此其实无关紧要；重要的是这是中国人的看法。
en: Whether this is true or not is irrelevant; what matters is Chinese perception.

zh: 过去，仅有少数保守分子警告美国试图“遏制”中国，但现在几乎每个中国人都相信这种说法，包括越来越多的年轻人。
en: Whereas in the past, only a few conservatives warned of US attempts to “contain” China, virtually everyone in China now buys into this narrative, including a growing number of young people.

zh: 因为在繁荣和自信中长大，接受西方生活方式和教育，外界普遍认为中国出生于20世纪80和90年代的千禧一代本该主导一个更加开放和自由的时期。
en: Having grown up amid prosperity and confidence, exposed to Western lifestyles and educations, China’s millennial generation – born in the 1980s and 1990s – were supposed to usher in an era of even greater openness and freedom.

zh: 但这些年轻人 — — 此前的报道称他们比自己的父辈和祖辈对西方国家和日本更有好感 — — 但现在特朗普的所作所为却在动摇他们对西方思想的信心。
en: Yet these young people – who have previously reported much warmer feelings toward Western countries and Japan than their parents and grandparents – are having their faith in Western ideas tested by Trump’s actions.

zh: 而真正的危险在于不断高涨的民族主义情绪可能壮大在中国被称为新左派的一股党内势力，他们谴责资本主义及其西方支持者，并呼吁重新回归40年前的毛泽东社会主义秩序。
en: The real danger is that rising nationalism could embolden a contingent of the Party, known in China as the New Left, that denounces capitalism and its Western proponents, and calls for a return to the Maoist socialist order of 40 years ago.

zh: 从积极的方面看，这可能带来实施结构性改革所需的政治凝聚力，从而实现经济从贸易和制造向国内消费的转型。
en: On the positive side, it is likely to produce the political cohesion needed to implement structural reforms that shift the economy away from trade and manufacturing and toward domestic consumption.

zh: 由于不同利益集团和派系团结起来对付共同的敌人，习近平主席能够获得更多的政治资本，从而促成从出口主导经济增长到贸易中性模式的顺利转型。
en: As different interest groups and factions unite against a common foe, President Xi Jinping will gain even more political capital, facilitating the shift from export-led economic growth to a trade-neutral model.

zh: 期间也不排除减税和财富面向家庭重新分配的可能。
en: Tax cuts and the redistribution of wealth toward households are also possibilities.

zh: 这绝不是说中国不会继续推行进一步开放的计划。
en: This is not to say that China is not continuing to pursue its plans to open up further.

zh: 为了兑现其增加总体进口和支持国内消费的承诺，即使在中国提高对美国进口关税的同时，却在降低对其他国家的关税。
en: Even as China raises tariffs on US imports, it is lowering tariffs for other countries, in order to fulfill its promise to increase overall imports and bolster domestic consumption.

zh: 而中国即将开始的金融服务业开放将成为其入市以来迈向开放的最重要步骤。
en: And its impending liberalization of its financial-services sector will amount to its biggest step toward openness since its accession to the WTO.

zh: 开放外国参与的领域包括银行、证券、保险、支付和评级服务。
en: Areas that will become open to foreign participation include banking, securities, insurance, payments, and ratings services.

zh: 对外国投资者持股或投资服务的限制正在逐步取消。
en: Restrictions on foreign investors’ equity holdings or investments in services are being sequentially eliminated.

zh: 为更好地体现习近平“早比晚好、快比慢好”的精神，央行4月宣布的11项措施中至少有七项已经落实完成了。
en: Reflecting Xi’s belief that “sooner is better than later, and faster is better than slower,” at least seven of the 11 measures the central bank announced in April have already been completed.

zh: 但尽管中国继续其经济开放，却越来越将注意力转向国内，越来越注重将公民转化为消费者和推动企业采用并推进新技术。
en: Even as China continues its economic opening, however, it is looking increasingly inward, at its citizens to serve as consumers and at its businesses to adopt and advance new technologies.

zh: 许多企业已经加倍努力提高其自身的增值和创新水平。
en: Many companies have already redoubled their efforts to increase their value-added and innovation capacity.

zh: 无论特朗普的贸易战是想遏制中国还是仅仅因贸易行为而惩罚中国，但意想不到的结果是中国现在正在为迎接一个充满政治和经济挑战的新时代而自我武装。
en: Whether Trump’s trade war is about containing China or just about punishing it for its trade practices, the unintended consequence is that China is now fortifying itself for a new era of political and economic challenges.

zh: 是的，举例来讲，中国或许更难依赖“一带一路计划 ” ， 或者出口其过剩产能。
en: Yes, the country will find it more difficult to pursue the “Belt and Road Initiative,” for example, or to export its excess capacity.

zh: 但从长远看，降低对外国贸易和进口技术的依赖将使中国更强大，更具适应性，而且可能不再那么愿意默许美国设计的规则。
en: But in the longer term, reducing its reliance on foreign trade and imported technologies will leave China stronger, more resilient, and possibly less willing to acquiesce to US-designed rules.

zh: 有时，贸易战的“失败者”结局好过“胜利者 ” 。
en: Sometimes the “loser” of a trade war ends up better off than the “winner.”

zh: 20世纪80年代，当罗纳德·里根总统对日本可能出口到美国的汽车数量进行限制时，日本损失惨重。
en: In the 1980s, when President Ronald Reagan imposed restrictions on the number of cars Japan could export to the US, Japan suffered.

zh: 但随着时间的推移，日本的汽车工业却得到了发展，开始出口更昂贵的汽车。
en: But, over time, it developed its auto industry so that it could export more expensive cars.

zh: 特朗普认为利用贸易攻击中国有助于“让美国再次伟大 ” 。
en: Trump thinks that attacking China through trade will help to “Make America Great Again.”

zh: 但让中国更强却是更有可能的结果。
en: But it is more likely to make China stronger.

zh: 中国和大宗商品价格的未来
en: China and the Future of Commodity Prices

zh: 马尼拉—毫无疑问，中国增长的持续放缓对全球经济造成了深远影响。
en: MANILA – There is no doubt that China’s ongoing growth slowdown has had far-reaching effects on the global economy.

zh: 但其对2014年以来大宗商品价格暴跌的作用要比传统智慧所认为的有限得多。 大宗商品的暴跌给大宗商品出口国带来了灾难，包括曾经充满活力的新兴经济体。
en: But its role in the sharp fall in commodity prices that has occurred since 2014 – an outcome that has been devastating for commodity-exporting countries, including once-dynamic emerging economies – is more limited than the conventional wisdom suggests.

zh: 事实上，中国减速只是大宗商品价格故事的一部分。
en: In fact, China’s slowdown is only a part of the commodity-price story.

zh: 诚然，中国GDP增长和大宗撒谎那个品及挨个之间存在明确的相关性。
en: To be sure, there is a clear correlation between Chinese GDP growth and commodity prices.

zh: 21世纪初，当中国增长加速时，大宗商品价格暴涨；自2011年中国开始减速以来，能源价格跌去70 % ， 金属价格跌去50 % ， 农产品价格跌去35 % 。
en: In the early 2000s, when Chinese growth accelerated, commodity prices rose sharply; since China’s slowdown began in 2011, energy prices have fallen by 70%, metals prices by 50%, and agricultural commodity prices by 35%.

zh: 但认为中国减速是大宗商品阿济格暴跌的主要推动力的观点是不完全的。
en: But the view that China’s slowdown is the main driver of the collapse in commodity prices is incomplete, at best.

zh: 亚洲开发银行的新研究认为，尽管中国在大宗商品市场上起着非常重要的作用 — — 比如，中国消费了全球大约一半的金属、煤炭和猪肉 — — 但并没有像人们广泛认为的那样起着主导作用。
en: As new research by the Asian Development Bank shows, while China plays a significant role in commodity markets – accounting for about half of global consumption of metals, coal, and pork, for example – it is not nearly as dominant as is widely believed.

zh: 中国只占世界糖、小麦、家禽和牛肉消费的不到五分之一，原油消费的12 % ， 天然气的5 % 。
en: China accounts for less than one-fifth of world consumption of sugar, wheat, poultry, and beef; 12% of world consumption of crude oil; and 5% of natural gas.

zh: 而事实上，一些下跌幅度最大的大宗商品价格 — — 最显著的是石油（下跌73 % ） 和天然气（下跌55 % ） — — 中国都只是相对次要的因素。
en: And, in fact, some of the commodities that have experienced the largest price declines – most notably, oil (down 73%) and natural gas (down 55%) – are those in which China is a relatively minor player.

zh: 此外，中国的实际大宗商品消费要比数据所显示的更小。
en: Moreover, China’s actual commodity consumption is even lower than the figures suggest.

zh: 传统衡量指标不考虑跨国生产链，只计算一国产出和大宗商品净进口的和来衡量消费水平。
en: Conventional measures, instead of taking into account cross-border production chains, simply take the sum of a country’s production and net commodity imports to determine its level of consumption.

zh: 但是，对中国来说，其所“消费”的大宗商品中有相当大的部分实际上被用于生产出口至世界其他地区的商品。
en: But, for China, a sizeable proportion of the commodities it “consumes” is actually used in the production of goods that will be exported to the rest of the world.

zh: 事实上，近三分之一的中国金属需求被用于满足出口需求。
en: Indeed, almost one-third of Chinese metals demand is used to satisfy export demand.

zh: 扣除包含在中国出口制造品中的大宗商品将大大降低中国在这些市场上的显著作用。
en: Subtracting the commodities embedded in China’s exported manufactured goods would substantially reduce China’s apparent role in these markets.

zh: 研究大宗商品价格波动本身便可强化这一观点。
en: A look at the commodity-price fluctuations themselves reinforces this view.

zh: 以铜为例：从2001年到2006年，其价格大幅震荡，一些年份下跌30 % ， 另一些年份上涨150 % — —而中国工业产量和铜需求增长均保持相对稳定，分别为15%和20 % 。
en: Consider copper: From 2001 to 2006, prices gyrated wildly, with price declines of 30% in some years and increases of 150% in others – all while growth in Chinese industrial production and demand for copper remained relatively steady, at 15% and 20%, respectively.

zh: 显然，其他因素 — — 供给侧因素、全球需求、投机性需求、存货调整等 — — 也在推动大宗商品市场走势方面起着重要作用。
en: Clearly, other factors – ranging from supply-side factors and global demand to speculative demand and inventory adjustment – are also playing a major role in driving outcomes in commodity markets.

zh: 那么，中国持续减速对大宗商品价格意味着什么？
en: So what does China’s continuing slowdown imply for commodity prices?

zh: 中国增长平庸化始于2011年，但其大宗商品消费增长仍高于世界其他地区。
en: Even though China’s growth has moderated since 2011, the country’s commodity-consumption growth still outpaces that of the rest of the world.

zh: 因此，其占全球大宗商品消费比重一直在上升。
en: As a result, its share in global commodity consumption has been rising.

zh: 这并不令人惊奇，因为中国GDP增长虽然教两位数时期大幅下降，但仍保持在6%以上。
en: This should not be surprising, given that Chinese GDP growth, though down significantly from its double-digit heyday, remains above 6%.

zh: 从投资拉动增长模式向消费驱动增长模式的转变会减弱金属和能源需求增长，但也会带来食品和服务增长的增加，因此农产品需求也会增加。
en: While the shift from an investment-led to a consumption-driven growth model will weaken growth in demand for metals and energy, it will also bring an increase in demand for food products and services, and hence for agricultural commodities.

zh: 结论是清晰的：中国经济状况的变化绝非大宗商品出口国的灾难。
en: The conclusion is clear: China’s changing economic situation does not spell disaster for commodity exporters.

zh: 相反，即使如许多人担心的那样，中国经济继续放缓，其对大宗商品价格的影响也将是有限的。
en: On the contrary, even if, as many fear, China’s economic growth slows further, its impact on commodity prices will be limited.

zh: 进一步提振大宗商品价格前景的是其他新兴巨人 — — 如印度和印度尼西亚 — — 未来几年很有可能加速。
en: Bolstering prospects for commodity prices further is the promise that demand in other emerging giants, such as India and Indonesia, will accelerate in the coming years.

zh: 其他发展中亚洲经济体之和目前比中国规模大4%左右，而2000年（中国大宗商品价格需求开始加速时）大约为中国的两倍。
en: The rest of developing Asia’s economy is currently about 4% larger than China’s, and twice as large as China was in 2000, when growth in the country’s commodity demand began to accelerate.

zh: 如果其他亚洲新兴经济体在未来十五年保持强劲增长，也能产生不亚于中国在其繁荣年份所带来的大宗商品需求。
en: If solid growth in Asia’s other emerging economies continues over the next decade and a half, it will generate commodity demand at least as large as China’s in the boom years.

zh: 中国增长平庸化对大宗商品价格的拖累作用是实实在在的。
en: The drag on commodity prices from China’s growth moderation is real.

zh: 但大宗商品价格全面剧烈下跌不应该完全归咎于中国。
en: But the sharp and generalized drop seen in commodity prices should not be laid entirely at China’s feet.

zh: 也许更重要的是，中国仍然在进口大量大宗商品，而其他亚洲发展中经济体也将产生新一轮大宗商品需求激增，大宗商品价格反弹的前景看上去更加光明了。
en: Perhaps more important, with the country still importing large volumes of commodities and the rest of developing Asia set to generate a new surge in commodity demand, the prospects for a commodity-price rebound look brighter.

zh: 为中国创造空间
en: Making Space for China

zh: 伦敦—当英国在本月早些时候宣布同意成为中国主导的亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行）创始成员时，大部分新闻的焦点并不是这个消息本身，而是这一决定在英国和美国之间造成的摩擦。
en: LONDON – When the United Kingdom announced earlier this month that it had agreed to become a founding member of the China-led Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), most of the headlines focused not on the news itself, but on the friction the decision had caused between the UK and the United States.

zh: 白宫发布了一份声明，敦促英国政府“发声推动采取高标准的 ” 。
en: The White House issued a statement urging the British government to “use its voice to push for adoption of high standards."

zh: 据称一位美国高官指责英国“一直通融中国，这绝非与崛起力量打交道的最佳方式 ” 。
en: And one senior US administration official was quoted accusing the UK of “constant accommodation of China, which is not the best way to engage a rising power."

zh: 事实上，宣扬错误方针的是美国。
en: In fact, it is the US that is advocating the wrong approach.

zh: 在英国，这场外交口水让英国媒体抓住机会传播那些认为政府应该对中国采取更强硬立场的人的批评。
en: In the UK, the diplomatic spat served as an occasion for the British press to air criticism from those who believe that the government should adopt a stronger stance on China.

zh: 比如，他们说政府应该以更有力的声音支持去年的香港民主示威，不应该在2013年卡梅伦首相访华期间与达赖喇嘛保持距离（英国政府似乎这么做了 ） 。
en: For example, they say that the government should have spoken out more forcefully in support of last year's pro-democracy protests in Hong Kong, and that it should not have distanced itself from the Dalai Lama (as it seems to have done) during Prime Minister David Cameron's visit to China in 2013.

zh: 英国确实需要为了自己而站出来，但没有理由要对中国内政说三道四 — — 特别是香港的问题。 1997年同意中国收回香港主权后，英国就已经失去了香港问题上的立场。
en: The UK does need to stand up for itself, but there is no reason for it to become confrontational about internal Chinese matters – especially in the case of Hong Kong, where it lost its standing when it agreed to return the city to Chinese control in 1997.

zh: 对美国来说，也最好不再拒绝世界正在改变的事实。
en: The US, too, would be wise to stop resisting the fact that the world is changing.

zh: 美国国会仍没有批准给予中国和其他新兴大经济体在世界银行和国际货币基金组织中更大话语权的2010年协议。
en: The US Congress has yet to ratify a 2010 agreement providing China and other large emerging economies greater voting power in the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 与此同时，这一协议已经过时了，中国经济自该协议达成以来已经扩大了近一倍。
en: In the meantime, the agreement has become obsolete; China's economy has nearly doubled in size since the deal was struck.

zh: 美国 — — 以及法国、德国和意大利 — — 不愿在现有国际金融机构给予新兴力量合理的话语权只能起到适得其反的效果。
en: America's reluctance – and that of France, Germany, and Italy – to give the emerging powers an appropriate voice in the established international financial institutions is counterproductive.

zh: 这促成了新的类似金融机构的诞生，如亚投行和2014年由金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度和南非）建立的新开发银行。
en: It drives the creation of new parallel institutions such as the AIIB and the New Development Bank, founded in 2014 by the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa).

zh: 在未来几天中，我将作为英国政府抗耐药性评估（Review on Antimicrobial Resistance）主席以及博鳌亚洲论坛（类似于达沃斯世界经济论坛的年度会议）与会者的身份访问中国。
en: In the coming days, I will be visiting China in my role as Chair of the British government's Review on Antimicrobial Resistance, and also as a participant in the Boao Forum for Asia, an event similar to the annual gathering of the World Economic Forum in Davos.

zh: 我希望鼓励中国决策者将与耐药性的斗争作为2016年中国作为G-20主席国期间的当务之急。
en: I hope to encourage Chinese policymakers to make the fight against antimicrobial resistance a priority when China chairs the G-20 in 2016.

zh: 而尽管我不是英国大使，但我仍然乐于表明我的态度：英国政府加入亚投行是明智之举，而美国政府表示反对不是明智之举。
en: And though I am not the British ambassador, I will be happy to state my belief that the UK government was wise to join the AIIB, and that the US administration, in voicing its opposition, was not.

zh: 中国10万亿美元的经济比法国、德国和意大利的总和还要大。
en: China's $10 trillion economy is bigger than those of France, Germany, and Italy combined.

zh: 即使其年度产出增长减速至7 % ， 今年仍能让全球GDP增加7,000亿美元。
en: Even if its annual output growth slows to 7%, the country will add some $700 billion to global GDP this year.

zh: 日本要想取得同样的影响力，必须达到14%的增长率才行。
en: Japan would have to grow at something like 14% to have that type of impact on the world.

zh: 对任何想参与全球贸易的人来说，认识到中国想要什么至关重要。
en: For anyone who wants to engage in global trade, it is thus vital to identify what China wants.

zh: 对英国来说，这显然包括金融（以及体育、音乐、时尚，也许还有医疗 ） 。
en: In the case of the UK, this obviously includes finance (as well as sports, music, fashion, and perhaps health care).

zh: 与中国合作实现自身利益显然是英国的聪明做法。
en: The UK is simply being smart when it promotes its own interests by cooperating with China.

zh: 2008年为数不多的积极结果之一是G-20全球影响力的加强；理论上，G-20是远比G-7代表性更强的国际领导力论坛。
en: One of the few positive consequences of the 2008 financial crisis was the elevation of the G-20's global role; in principle, it is a far more representative forum for international leadership than the G-7 ever was.

zh: 但是，G-20的出现有一个弊端：庞大的参与者数量使其难以形成一致意见并办成事。
en: There is, however, a downside to the G-20's emergence: the large number of participants can make it difficult to reach agreements and get things done.

zh: 新的G-7需要在G-20内部构建，从而为中国提供一定程度的影响力以反映其经济实力，并要求它承担相称比例的全球责任。
en: A new G-7 needs to be created within the G-20, thereby providing China with a degree of influence that reflects its economic weight and requires it to assume a commensurate proportion of global responsibility.

zh: 如果以表达出共同货币承诺的欧元区国家同意放弃个体国家席位，以货币联盟占据一个代表席位，则中国就将获得空间。
en: Space at the table for China could be obtained if the eurozone countries, signaling their commitment to the common currency, agreed to surrender their individual seats in exchange for one representing the entire monetary union.

zh: 美国最终也必须接受中国的重要全球作用。
en: The US, too, would finally have to accept China's heightened global role.

zh: 今年晚些时候，IMF将重新制定其账户单位 — — 由目前包括美国、欧元、英镑和日元的一揽子货币所组成的所谓的特别提款权的权重。
en: Later this year, the IMF will recalibrate the weights in its unit of account, the so-called Special Drawing Rights, which comprises a basket of currencies that currently includes the US dollar, the euro, the British pound, and the Japanese yen.

zh: 几乎不论根据什么经济和金融标准，特别提款权现在都应该包括中国的人民币。
en: According to almost every economic and financial criterion, the SDR basket should now include China's renminbi.

zh: 美国的明智做法是不要反对这一变化。
en: The US would be wise to not oppose such a move.

zh: 否则，就有可能加速现有国际金融机构的衰落。
en: Otherwise, it would risk accelerating the decline of the established international financial institutions.

zh: 类似地，美国国会应该批准已经形成一致的IMF和世界银行治理结构的变化。
en: Similarly, the US Congress should ratify the agreed changes to the governance of the IMF and the World Bank.

zh: 中国和其他新兴力量通过成立亚投行和新开发银行，表明它们不会坐等它们的声音被听见。
en: By founding the AIIB and the New Development Bank, China and other emerging powers have signaled that they will not wait for their voices to be better heard.

zh: 而英国 — — 以及法国、德国和意大利 — — 的决定表明它们也这样想。
en: And decisions like that of the UK – and France, Germany, and Italy – show that they are not alone.

zh: 中国的新世界秩序
en: China’s New World Order

zh: 发自首尔 — — 中国，这个世界上最大的出口者，制造者以及国际储备资产持有者，已经随时准备在今年取代美国成为世界上最大的经济体（以购买力平价计算 ） 。
en: SEOUL – China – already the world’s largest exporter, manufacturer, and international-reserve-asset holder – is poised to overtake the United States as the world’s largest economy (measured according to purchasing power parity) this year.

zh: 如今该国正利用其不断膨胀的政治影响力来重塑全球经济治理。
en: Now, it is using its growing clout to reshape global economic governance.

zh: 事实上，中国遵循邓小平“韬光养晦”指示的日子早已一去不返了。
en: Indeed, the country’s days of following Deng Xiaoping’s injunction to “hide brightness and cherish obscurity” are long gone.

zh: 在数十年如一日积极参与国际经济机构 — — 包括G20，国际货币基金组织，世界银行，世界贸易组织 — — 的运作之后，中国开始变得像一个试图创建新世界秩序的修正主义势力。
en: After decades of actively participating in international economic institutions – including the G-20, the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, and the World Trade Organization – China has begun to resemble a revisionist power seeking to create a new world order.

zh: 就在上月，中国就和其他二十个亚洲国家签订了一份谅解备忘录，以建立一个新的多边开发银行 — — 亚洲基础设施投资银行。
en: Last month, China and 20 other Asian countries signed a memorandum of understanding to establish a new multilateral development bank, the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.

zh: 作为对世界银行以及亚洲开发银行的首个关键性体制冲击，该银行正是由中国动议的。
en: Viewed as the first serious institutional challenge to the World Bank and the Asian Development Bank (ADB), the AIIB was proposed by China.

zh: 在某种意义上，考虑到对现有国际机构及治理架构的自身内在缺陷 — — 尤其是中国在这些体系中不成比例的跑龙套角色 — — 的广泛讨论，这一转变其实毫不令人感到意外。
en: In a sense, this shift should not be surprising, given the widespread debate over the inherent weaknesses of existing international institutions and governance structures – in particular, China’s disproportionately small role in them.

zh: 相比于美国在国际货币基金组织中16.8%的投票份额，以及亚洲开发银行12.8%的份额（日本的该两项比例为6.2%和12.8 % ） ，中国则只有区区3.8%及5.5 % 。 。
en: China accounts for a 3.8% voting share of the IMF and a 5.5% share of the ADB, compared to 16.8% and 12.8%, respectively, for the United States and 6.2% and 12.8% for Japan.

zh: 此外，此外各发达经济体早已把自身的领导权牢牢地根植在这些机构之中。
en: Moreover, the advanced economies have staked their claim to leadership in these institutions.

zh: 自二战后建立至今，国际货币基金组织和世界银行就分别由欧洲人和美国人把持着。
en: Europeans have led the IMF and Americans have controlled the World Bank since their establishment after World War II.

zh: 同样，亚洲开发银行是1966年成立以来就一直由日本人担任总裁。
en: Likewise, the ADB has had Japanese presidents since its founding in 1966.

zh: 与此同时，像中国这样的新兴经济体如果想要在这些机构中提升自身出资额度（以及地位）的话也是困难重重。
en: Meanwhile, emerging economies like China face significant barriers to boosting their capital contributions to – and their status in – these institutions.

zh: 而对这些机构的改革虽然已经进行过广泛讨论，却迟迟未能推动。
en: And reforms, though widely discussed, have faced long delays.

zh: 以国际货币基金组织的配额和治理改革为例，G20各国领袖早已在2010年表决同意，如今却依然是一纸空文。
en: For example, IMF quota and governance reform, on which G-20 leaders agreed in 2010, has yet to be implemented.

zh: 饱经挫败之后，中国最终决定要推动亚洲基础设施投资银行的建立，并自任最大的股东，持有最多达50%的股份。
en: Frustrated, China finally decided to push for the establishment of the AIIB, in which it will be the largest shareholder, with a stake of up to 50%.

zh: 该银行的首任总裁也将由中国人担任，并将总部设在北京。
en: China will also provide the AIIB’s first president, and the bank’s headquarters will be in Beijing.

zh: 中国可以借助自身对亚洲基础设施投资银行的巨大影响力来壮大其国际形象，尤其是通过进一步加强与发展中国家的关系。
en: China can leverage its considerable influence over the AIIB to bolster its international image, particularly by strengthening its relationships with developing countries.

zh: 因为许多发展中国家都存在巨大的基础设施投资缺口，急需补足来支撑其长期经济发展。
en: Many developing Asian countries, for example, have significant unmet need for infrastructure investment to buttress their long-term economic growth.

zh: 亚洲基础设施投资银行不仅可以向发展中国家输送更多的资源；而且可以以一种更加契合受资助国需要的方式行事，相比其他建立已久的国际组织来说官僚主义条条框框更少，也更为灵活。
en: The AIIB can not only channel more resources toward developing countries; it can do so in a way that is better suited to their needs, with fewer bureaucratic barriers and more flexibility than its more established counterparts. The AIIB would complement China’s rapidly increasing bilateral development financing, with the added benefit of a multilateral structure that ensures better governance and higher operating standards.

zh: 而亚洲基础设施投资银行或许无法做到的则是帮助提升亚洲的经济治理水平 — — 尤其是因为日本，澳大利亚，印尼和韩国这几个GDP总量加起来几乎与中国相等的国家尚未成为银行成员。
en: What the AIIB may not be able to do is contribute to improved economic governance in Asia – not least because Japan, Australia, Indonesia, and South Korea, whose total GDP is roughly equal to China’s, are not yet members.

zh: 如果没有这些国家去制衡中国的影响力，或者缺少一个常驻董事会的话，该银行同样也会沦为中国向成员国及受益国强加其意志的工具。
en: Without these economies to counterweigh China’s influence or a resident board of directors, the AIIB could allow China to impose its will on members and beneficiaries alike.

zh: 例如，正如前印度外交部长沙希·塔鲁尔（Shashi Tharoor）所指出的那样，中国或许会利用亚洲基础设施投资银行来协助投资建立一条新的丝绸之路，构建一条连接东亚和欧洲的跨大陆及海运交通线。
en: For example, as former Indian Minister of State for External Affairs Shashi Tharoor has suggested, China may use the AIIB to help finance a new Silk Road, an overland and maritime route connecting East Asia with Europe.

zh: 虽然该项目可以为所处区域带来极大的好处，通过推动一体化整合及巩固联系来刺激经济发展，但主要还是为中国的利益服务，协助扩张该国的国际影响力，并减少该国国内东西部地区之间的经济差距。
en: While the project could have significant regional benefits, stimulating economic development by promoting integration and connectivity, it would serve primarily China’s interests, expanding the country’s international influence and reducing the gap between its eastern and western regions.

zh: 与此同时，这也可能使中国及其邻国之间的地缘政治紧张局势和领土争端进一步恶化。
en: At the same time, it could exacerbate geopolitical tensions and territorial disputes between China and its neighbors.

zh: 更宏观的来看，一些发展专家已经对亚洲基础设施投资银行是否能遵照治理及透明度的国际标准，执行银行金融风险防范措施，拒绝与无能腐败政府合作，以及遵循有效程序进行运作而感到担心。
en: More generally, some development experts have raised concerns about whether the AIIB can operate according to international standards of governance and transparency, enforce safeguards, refuse to work with incompetent or corrupt governments, and follow effective procedures.

zh: 他们同时也担心，由于令国际开发融资变得碎片化，亚洲基础设施投资银行可能会极大削弱自身的影响力。
en: They also worry that, by fragmenting international development finance, the AIIB could weaken its impact considerably.

zh: 无可否认，中国也在着手应对这些担忧，反复强调新银行的目的是对其他机构进行补充，而非与之竞争。
en: To be sure, China has made an effort to address such concerns, emphasizing repeatedly that the AIIB aims to complement, not compete with, other institutions.

zh: 在该银行建立之后，中国国家主席习近平宣称该行“应当遵循多边规则和程序”并学习“现有多边开发机构的优秀运作和有益经验 ” 。 。
en: Following the AIIB’s launch, Chinese President Xi Jinping declared that it “needs to follow multilateral rules and procedures” and should learn from “existing multilateral development institutions in their good practices and useful experience.”

zh: 但如果要落实这些声明的话，中国必须积极承诺采取公平和有效的治理。
en: But China must support such statements with an active commitment to fair and efficient governance.

zh: 尤其是应该考虑降低自身的投票份额，构建一个轮值主席机制，并将各亚洲发达经济��纳入到成员国的范围之内。
en: Specifically, it should consider lowering its own voting share, instituting a rotating presidency, and broadening membership to include advanced Asian economies.

zh: 亚洲基础设施投资银行是一个令人鼓舞的动议。
en: The AIIB is a welcome initiative.

zh: 但考虑到中国，其邻国，以及美国在安全，环境和人权事务方面存在的深刻不信任和大量冲突，讨论该动议的成功还为时过早。
en: But, given deep mistrust and a multitude of conflicts involving China, its regional neighbors, and the United States over security, environmental, and human-rights issues, its success is far from guaranteed.

zh: 而中国必须作出必要的让步来令该银行发挥其最大潜力。
en: It is up to China to make the necessary compromises to enable the AIIB to reach its potential.

zh: 中国影响全球治理的手法还是小荷才露尖尖角。
en: China’s approach to influencing global governance is only beginning to emerge.

zh: 唯一希望的，就是它能采取正确的步伐。
en: One hopes that it starts off on the right foot.

zh: 中国，创新之龙
en: China, the Innovation Dragon

zh: 华盛顿—自1978年以来，中国成就斐然。 邓小平开启了市场经济改革。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – China has achieved much since 1978, when Deng Xiaoping initiated the transition to a market economy.

zh: 以总体经济进步衡量，过去四十年来中国转型的速度可谓前所未有。
en: In terms of headline economic progress, the pace of China’s transformation over the past 40 years is unprecedented.

zh: 中国GDP平均每年增长近10 % ， 并改变了全球贸易模式，成为世界第二大经济体。
en: The country’s GDP grew by nearly 10% per year on average, while reshaping global trade patterns and becoming the second-largest economy in the world.

zh: 这一成功让八亿人摆脱了贫困，五岁以下儿童夭折率在2006—2015年间下降了一半。
en: This success lifted 800 million people out of poverty, and the mortality rate of children under five years old was halved between 2006 and 2015.

zh: 现在的问题是，大有希望成为世界创新领导者的中国，是否能在2018年随后的一段时间实现这一机会。
en: The question now is whether China, well positioned to become the world’s innovation leader, will realize that opportunity in 2018 or soon after.

zh: 中国转型的基础，是前所未有的制造业繁荣。
en: China’s transformation has been underpinned by an unprecedented manufacturing boom.

zh: 2016年，中国向全世界输出了2万亿多美元的产品，占全球总出口量的13 % 。
en: In 2016, China shipped more than $2 trillion worth of goods around the world, 13% of total global exports.

zh: 中国通过大规模基础设施投资实现经济现代化，包括桥梁、机场、公路、能源和电信等。
en: It has also pursued economic modernization through massive infrastructure investment, including bridges, airports, roads, energy, and telecoms.

zh: 在不到十年的时间里，中国就建成了全世界最大的高速铁路系统，2017年7月里程突破22,000公里。
en: In less than a decade, China built the world’s largest bullet train system, surpassing 22,000 kilometers (13,670 miles) in July 2017.

zh: 年消费量预计在2021年将接近2万亿美元，相当于给全球经济新增一个德国规模的消费市场。
en: Annual consumption is expected to rise by nearly $2 trillion by 2021, equivalent to adding another consumer market the size of Germany to the global economy.

zh: 本月早些时候，苹果公司CEO库克（Tim Cook）说“中国已不再是多年前哪个低劳动力成本的国家，劳动力成本低廉也不再是来华的原因。
en: Earlier this month, Apple CEO Tim Cook declared that, “China stopped being a low-labor-cost country many years ago, and that is not the reason to come to China.”

zh: ”如今，这个国家的制造业优势在于对先进生产的知识和强大的供应链网络。
en: The country’s manufacturing strengths now lie in its advanced production know-how and strong supply-chain networks.

zh: 不难理解，中国领导层希望提高生产率、进一步上价值链上游攀升。
en: Understandably, China’s leadership wants to increase productivity and continue to move further up the value chain.

zh: 基于十三五规划（2016年5月 ） ， 当局为中国制定的目标是到2020年成为“创新国家 ” ， 到2030年成为“国际创新领导者 ” ， 到2050年成为“世界科技创新强国 ” 。
en: Building on its 13th Five Year Plan (in May 2016), the authorities established objectives for China to become an “innovative nation” by 2020, an “international innovation leader” by 2030, and a “world powerhouse of scientific and technological innovation” by 2050.

zh: 当局还承诺到2020年要提高研发支出至GDP的2.5 % ， 每10,000人申请专利量要接近翻番。
en: It also committed to increasing its expenditure on research and development to 2.5% of GDP and almost doubling the number of patents filed per 10,000 people by 2020.

zh: 为让创新成为可能，市级政府正在打造技术枢纽以期吸引人才。
en: To enable this innovation, municipal governments are building technology hubs, hoping to attract talent.

zh: 广州鼓励研究人员、企业家和企业在那里建立大本营。
en: The city of Guangzhou is encouraging researchers, entrepreneurs, and corporations to base themselves there.

zh: 通用电气最近承诺在8亿美元规模的生物科技园建立其首个亚洲生物制药项目。
en: General Electric recently committed to build its first Asian biopharmaceutical project in an $800 million bio-campus.

zh: 位于广州以南的深圳以“硬件硅谷”文明，而深港大区被评为全球第二大密集城市群（以专利衡量 ） 。
en: The southern city of Shenzhen is already known as the “Silicon Valley of Hardware,” and the greater Shenzhen-Hong Kong area is ranked second in terms of global inventive clusters (measured by patents).

zh: 在中国，做生意的速度和技巧与世界其他国家都不一样。
en: Business in China often operates at a speed and nimbleness unlike anywhere else in the world.

zh: 中国全方位接受了数字模式，而不只是对旧模式进行数字化改造。
en: China is fully embracing digital models, not just digitizing old models.

zh: 中国没有历史包袱，这使它能够在数字支付、共享经济（共享单车正在横扫全世界）和电子商务方面可以“弯道超车”西方。
en: Its lack of legacy systems has already enabled it to leapfrog the West in areas such as digital payments, the sharing economy (dockless bicycles are sweeping the world), and e-commerce.

zh: 中国研发总支出（占GDP百分比）从2000年的0.9%提高到2016年的2.1 % 。
en: Total spending on R&D in China (as a percentage of GDP) more than doubled from 0.9% in 2000 to 2.1% in 2016.

zh: 到目前为止，这一增量大部分集中在应用研究和商业开发，只有5%投入了基础科学。
en: To date, the increase has mostly been focused on applied research and commercial development, with only 5% dedicated to basic science.

zh: 尽管如此，中国仍在2017年全球创新指数（基于81项指标对127个国家和经济体进行的调查）中位列第22名，高于西班牙、意大利和澳大利亚。
en: Nevertheless, China ranked 22nd in the 2017 Global Innovation Index (a survey of 127 countries and economies based on 81 indicators) ahead of Spain, Italy, and Australia.

zh: 中国占高影响力学术出版（引用率排在斯高帕斯（Scopus）数据库中前0.1%的文章）的比例也从1997年的不到1%增加到2016年的约20 % 。
en: China’s share of high-impact academic publications (the top 0.1% of papers in Scopus, which rates by citations) has grown, from less than 1% in 1997 to about 20% in 2016.

zh: 巨大的大学毕业生数量（2012年达到620万，是2001年的六倍 ） ， 加上大量回国的具备国际背景的高水平侨民（中国有800,000大学生在海外留学 ） ， 有望带来足够多数量的人才实现中国想要的结果。
en: The sheer volume of university graduates (6.2 million in 2012, six times the 2001 total) combined with an internationally trained, highly skilled diaspora whose members return home in large numbers – there are 800,000 Chinese students in tertiary education abroad – is likely to produce enough talent to achieve the desired effect.

zh: 美国工人的生产率仍然比中国工人高得多。
en: American workers are still considerably more productive than their Chinese counterparts.

zh: 平均而言，每名中国工人所生产的GDP，只有美国工人的19%左右。
en: On average, each Chinese worker generates only about 19% of the amount of GDP that an American worker does.

zh: 但这一领先地位正在被追上。
en: But this lead is being eroded.

zh: 美国的其他优势是它拥有全球100所顶尖高校中的30所，拥有一个勇于冒险的企业家文化，并且美国公司要时刻面对严酷的市场竞争。
en: Other factors in America’s favor include 30 of the top 100 universities in the world, a risk-taking, entrepreneurial culture, and its companies’ heavy exposure to market forces.

zh: 传统上，这促使美国企业采用进攻性竞争策略，通常需要要创新。
en: Traditionally, this has driven US firms to compete aggressively, often relying on innovation.

zh: 但美国工业已经不如昔日那样有活力。
en: But American industry is not as dynamic as it once was.

zh: 1997—2012年间，三分之二的美国行业经历了市场集中度升高，创纪录的74%的员工在历史悠久（16年或以上）的老牌企业工作。
en: Between 1997 and 2012, two-thirds of America’s industries experienced an increase in market concentration, and a record 74% of employees are working at these aging (16 years or older) incumbents.

zh: 美国总统特朗普的政府似乎完全误解了需要什么。
en: US President Donald Trump’s administration seems to have completely misunderstood what is needed.

zh: 特朗普想要更加保护主义的未来，这将降低美国公司的全球竞争和真正创新的压力。
en: Trump favors a more protectionist future, which would take the pressure off US companies to be globally competitive or truly innovative.

zh: 美国大学正在被税制和严厉的支出削减所制约 — — 其中一些措施可视为反科学战争。
en: American universities are being undermined by changes in the tax code and impending spending cuts – part of what appears to be a broader war on science.

zh: 而移民 — — 人才和思想的重要来源 — — 也有可能受到限制。
en: And immigration – an essential source of talent and ideas – looks likely to be restricted.

zh: 从其自身以及美国的政策看，中国正走在成为世界创新领导者的路上。
en: Given its own policies, and those of the US, China is on track to become the world’s innovation leader.

zh: 到2018年年底，我们将更加清楚地看到中国的成功故事的新篇章将以多么迅速和轻松的方式写就。
en: By the end of 2018, it will be more apparent just how quickly and easily this latest chapter in the Chinese success story will be written.

zh: 中国的新全球领导力
en: China’s New Global Leadership

zh: 纽约—今年最大的经济新闻几乎没有引起什么主意：根据国际货币基金组织（IMF）的排名，中国取代美国成为世界最大经济体。
en: NEW YORK – The biggest economic news of the year came almost without notice: China has overtaken the United States as the world’s largest economy, according to the scorekeepers at the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 而尽管中国的地缘政治地位也在随着经济实力而迅速提升，但美国仍在挥霍其全球领导力 — — 拜其政治和经济精英肆无忌惮的贪婪和其作茧自缚的中东持久战所赐。
en: And, while China’s geopolitical status is rising rapidly, alongside its economic might, the US continues to squander its global leadership, owing to the unchecked greed of its political and economic elites and the self-made trap of perpetual war in the Middle East.

zh: 根据IMF的数据，中国GDP将在2014年达到17.6万亿美元，超过美国17.4万亿美元的产出。
en: According to the IMF, China’s GDP will be $17.6 trillion in 2014, outstripping US output of $17.4 trillion.

zh: 当然，由于中国人口比美国多四倍多，其12,900美元的人均GDP仍不足美国的54,700美元，这表明美国的生活水平比中国高得多。
en: Of course, because China’s population is more than four times larger, its per capita GDP, at $12,900, is still less than a quarter of the $54,700 recorded in the US, which highlights America’s much higher living standards.

zh: 中国的崛起是个大事件，但也意味着回报。
en: China’s rise is momentous, but it also signifies a return.

zh: 毕竟，自从中国在2,000多年前成为统一国家以来，一直是世界上人口最多的国家，因此其成为世界最大经济体理所应当。
en: After all, China has been the world’s most populous country since it became a unified state more than 2,000 years ago, so it makes sense that it would also be the world’s largest economy.

zh: 事实上，证据表明，直到1889年前后被美国超过前，中国比世界其他任何经济体规模都要大（以购买力平价衡量 ） 。
en: And, indeed, the evidence suggests that China was larger (in terms of purchasing power parity) than any other economy in the world until around 1889, when the US eclipsed it.

zh: 如今，125年过去了，在中国经历了几十年的高速经济发展后，名次再次发生逆转。
en: Now, 125 years later, the rankings have reversed again, following decades of rapid economic development in China.

zh: 经济实力的提高带来了地缘政治力量的增加。
en: With rising economic power has come growing geopolitical clout.

zh: 中国领导人受到了全世界的热捧。
en: Chinese leaders are feted around the world.

zh: 许多欧洲国家将中国视为增强国内增长的关键。
en: Many European countries are looking to China as the key to stronger domestic growth.

zh: 非洲领导人将中国视为新的不可或缺的增长伙伴，特别是在基础设施和商业开发方面。
en: African leaders view China as their countries’ new indispensable growth partner, particularly in infrastructure and business development.

zh: 类似地，拉丁美洲的经济战略家和商业领袖现在也认为中国至少与美国一样值得重视。
en: Similarly, economic strategists and business leaders in Latin America now look to China at least as much as they look to the US.

zh: 在经历了一段时间的剑拔弩张后，中国和日本似乎在采取措施改善关系。
en: China and Japan seem to be taking steps toward better relations, after a period of high tensions.

zh: 甚至俄罗斯最近也“倾身”倒向中国，在包括能源和交通在内的许多领域构建更紧密的中俄联系。
en: Even Russia has recently “tilted” toward China, establishing stronger connections on many fronts, including energy and transport.

zh: 就像二战后的美国，中国拿出真金白银 — — 而且是大量真金白银 — — 用于构建与全世界的强大经济和基础设施联系。
en: Like the US after World War II, China is putting real money on the table – a lot of it – to build strong economic and infrastructure links with countries around the world.

zh: 这有利于其他国家提振本国增长，同时也有利于巩固中国的全球经济和地缘政治领导力。
en: This will enable other countries to boost their own growth, while cementing China’s global economic and geopolitical leadership.

zh: 中国四面出击，计划数量之多令人咋舌。
en: The number of Chinese initiatives is staggering.

zh: 仅仅是在去年，中国就启动了四项大工程，这些工程可以极大地扩大其在全球贸易和金融中的作用。
en: In just the past year, China has launched four major projects that promise to give it a greatly expanded role in global trade and finance.

zh: 中国联合俄罗斯、巴西和南非成立了新开发银行（New Development Bank ） ， 并将总部设在了上海。
en: China joined Russia, Brazil, India, and South Africa in establishing the New Development Bank, to be based in Shanghai.

zh: 新的位于北京的亚洲基础设施投资银行（Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank）将帮助亚洲地区的基础设施（公路、电力、铁路等）提供融资。
en: A new Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, to be based in Beijing, will help to fund infrastructure projects (roads, power, and rail, among others) throughout the region.

zh: 新丝绸之路寻求通过扩大的铁路、高速公路、电力、光纤和其他网络连接中国与东亚、南��、中亚和欧洲的经济体。
en: The New Silk Road land belt seeks to connect China with the economies of East Asia, South Asia, Central Asia, and Europe through an expanded grid of rail, highways, power, fiber, and other networks.

zh: 新的21世纪海上丝绸之路则旨在提振东亚和印度洋的海上贸易。
en: And the new 21st Century Maritime Silk Road is aimed at boosting ocean-based trade in East Asia and the Indian Ocean.

zh: 总之，这些各种各样的计划有望在未来十年撬动数千亿美元的额投资，加速相关国家的增长，深化它们与中国的生产、贸易和金融联系。
en: All told, these various initiatives are likely to leverage hundreds of billions of dollars in investment over the coming decade, speeding growth in the counterpart countries while deepening their production, trade, and financial linkages with China.

zh: 这些计划未必都能成功或平稳推进。
en: There is no guarantee that all of this will succeed or proceed smoothly.

zh: 中国面临巨大的内部挑战，如高企并仍在不断加剧的不平等性、严重的空气和水污染、向低碳经济转型的必要性以及令美国和欧洲也深受困扰金融市场动荡风险。
en: China faces huge internal challenges, including high and rising income inequality, massive air and water pollution, the need to move to a low-carbon economy, and the same risks of financial-market instabilities that bedevil the US and Europe.

zh: 而如果中国在其邻国面前表现得过于咄咄逼人 — — 比如要求争议水域的离岸石油和领土权利 — — 将会引起严重的外交反弹。
en: And if China becomes too aggressive toward its neighbors – for example, by demanding rights to offshore oil or territory in disputed waters – it will generate a serious diplomatic backlash.

zh: 中国在未来几年的行程（任何世界其他国家也是如此）绝非坦途。
en: No one should assume smooth sailing for China (or for any other part of the world, for that matter) in the years ahead.

zh: 但是，在中国经济和地缘政治崛起的同时，美国似乎在竭尽全力浪费其所拥有的经济、科技和地缘政治优势，这着实令人惊讶。
en: Still, it is striking that just as China is rising economically and geopolitically, the US seems to be doing everything possible to waste its own economic, technological, and geopolitical advantages.

zh: 美国政治制度饱受其富豪精英的贪欲的掣肘，他们的狭隘目标是削减公司和个人税率、让个人拥有的巨额财富最大化、制约全球经济发展中的建设性美国领导力。
en: The US political system has been captured by the greed of its wealthy elites, whose narrow goals are to cut corporate and personal tax rates, maximize their vast personal fortunes, and curtail constructive US leadership in global economic development.

zh: 他们对美国的对外援助嗤之以鼻，洞开大门让中国获得发展融资的全球领导力。
en: They so scorn US foreign assistance that they have thrown open the doors to China’s new global leadership in development financing.

zh: 更糟糕的是，在中国大秀地缘政治肌肉的同时，美国唯一系统性追求的外交政策竟然是毫无结果的中东持久战。
