en: Even worse, as China flexes its geopolitical muscles, the only foreign policy that the US systematically pursues is unceasing and fruitless war in the Middle East.

zh: 美国没完没了地在叙利亚和伊拉克浪费其资源和能源，一如曾经在越南所做的那样。
en: The US endlessly drains its resources and energy in Syria and Iraq in the same way that it once did in Vietnam.

zh: 与此同时，中国避免卷入海外军事乱局，而是强调双赢经济计划。
en: China, meanwhile, has avoided becoming enmeshed in overseas military debacles, emphasizing win-win economic initiatives instead.

zh: 如果中国领导人强调基础设施、清洁能源、公共卫生和其他国际当务之急的投资，那么中国的经济崛起就有利于全球福祉。
en: China’s economic rise can contribute to global wellbeing if its leaders emphasize investment in infrastructure, clean energy, public health, and other international priorities.

zh: 但是，如果美国能够与中国合作，继续致力于建设性领导，世界将会变得更好。
en: Still, the world would be better off if the US also continued to lead constructively, alongside China.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马和中国国家主席习近平最近宣布达成关于气候变化和清洁能源的双边协议，这是最好的结果。
en: The recent announcement by Presidents Barack Obama and Xi Jinping of bilateral agreements on climate change and clean energy show the best of what’s possible.

zh: 美国在中东的持久战则是最坏的结果。
en: America’s perpetual war-making in the Middle East shows the worst.

zh: 中国大胆的能源愿景
en: China’s Bold Energy Vision

zh: 北京 — — 实现2015年巴黎气候协定所制定目标的最大胆的计划来源于中国的手笔。
en: BEIJING – The boldest plan to achieve the targets set by the 2015 Paris climate agreement comes from China.

zh: 巴黎协议要求世界各国政府承诺将全球变暖控制在比前工业化水平低两摄氏度的范围内（3.6华氏度 ） 。
en: The Paris accord commits the world’s governments to keeping global warming to well below 2º Celsius (3.6º Fahrenheit) relative to the pre-industrial level.

zh: 上述目标主要通过到2050年将世界主要能耗来源从碳基化石燃料（煤炭、石油和天然气）转移到可再生的零碳能源（风能、太阳能、水电、地热、海洋能及生物质能）以及核能来实现。
en: This can be accomplished mainly by shifting the world’s primary energy sources from carbon-based fossil fuels (coal, oil, and natural gas) to zero-carbon, renewable (wind, solar, hydro, geothermal, ocean, biomass), and nuclear energy by the year 2050.

zh: 中国的全球能源互联计划（GEI）为实现这一能源转型目标描绘了激动人心的愿景。
en: China’s Global Energy Interconnection (GEI) offers a breathtaking vision of how to achieve this energy transformation.

zh: 鲜有政府对这一转型的规模具备充分的认识。
en: Few governments appreciate the scale of this transformation.

zh: 气候学家经常提到“碳预算 ” — —也就是人类未来可以排放的二氧化碳总量，而上述总量以将全球变暖控制在比前工业化水平高两摄氏度以下为前提。
en: Climate scientists speak of the “carbon budget” – the total amount of carbon dioxide that humanity can emit in the coming years while still keeping global warming to under 2º.

zh: 目前的估计显示世界碳预算的中点约为6000亿吨。
en: Current estimates put the mid-point estimate of the world’s carbon budget at around 600 billion tons.

zh: 人类目前每年排放大约400亿吨二氧化碳，这意味着世界必须在本世纪中叶甚至更早淘汰化石燃料，并彻底转向零排放的主要能源来源。
en: Humanity currently emits around 40 billion tons of CO2 per year, implying that the world has only until mid-century or even sooner to phase out fossil fuels and move entirely to zero-emission sources of primary energy.

zh: 下面的任务需要我们来完成。
en: Here’s what needs to be done.

zh: 目前主要靠燃烧煤炭和天然气来发电；这些热电企业需要被逐步淘汰，并以利用太阳能、风能、水电、核能以及其他非碳能源发电的电力企业来实现替代。
en: Today’s electricity is largely generated by burning coal and natural gas; these thermal power plants need to be phased out and replaced by electricity generated by solar, wind, hydro, nuclear, and other non-carbon sources.

zh: 今天的建筑采暖主要采用锅炉、散热器以及以石油和天然气为燃料的采暖炉；这些都需要由通过电力采暖的建筑来取代。
en: Today’s buildings are heated mostly by boilers, radiators, and furnaces fueled by heating oil and natural gas; these need to be replaced by buildings heated by electricity.

zh: 今天的车辆运行依靠石油产品；这些都需要由电动汽车来取代。
en: Today’s vehicles run on petroleum products; these need to be replaced by electric vehicles.

zh: 今天的船舶、重卡和飞机同样全部依赖石油产品；未来，他们需要使用以再生二氧化碳和可再生能源制造的合成燃料，或以可再生能源制造的氢气为燃料来源。
en: Today’s ships, heavy trucks, and airplanes run on petroleum products as well; in the future, they will need to run on synthetic fuels produced with recycled CO2 and renewable energy, or with hydrogen produced by renewable energy.

zh: 而今天为工业生产，如钢铁制造提供动力的化石燃料，也将必须由电力来取代。
en: And the fossil fuels that power today’s industrial processes, such as steel production, will have to be replaced by electricity.

zh: 因此，简单的答案就是必须大规模使用零碳能源，尤其是风能和太阳能等形式的可再生能源发电。
en: The short answer, therefore, is the massive use of zero-carbon energy, especially renewable energy such as wind and solar power, in the form of electricity.

zh: 世界有足够的零碳能源用来推动整个全球经济的发展 — — 事实上，零碳能源可以推动的全球经济规模可以远大于今天。
en: The world has enough zero-carbon energy sources to power the entire global economy – indeed to power a global economy much larger than today’s.

zh: 关键的一步是要向有需求的人口中心提供零碳能源。
en: A key step is to bring zero-carbon energy to the population centers that need it.

zh: 中国的宏伟愿景就在这里呈现。
en: This is where China’s grand vision comes in.

zh: 近年来，中国国内一直面临能源转型挑战。
en: In recent years, China has faced the energy-transformation challenge domestically.

zh: 中国最好的可再生能源供应（尤其是风能和太阳能）均位于国家西部，而大部分人口和能源需求均集中在东部的太平洋沿岸。
en: China’s best supplies of renewable energy (especially wind and solar power) are in Western China, while most of China’s population and energy demand are concentrated on the Pacific (eastern) seaboard.

zh: 中国一直试图通过建设大规模超高压输电网（UHV）来解决这一问题，超高压输电网可以尽可能降低在传送过程中的电能损耗。
en: China has been solving this problem by building a massive distribution grid based on ultra-high-voltage (UHV) transmission, which minimizes heat loss along the way.

zh: 长距离超高压输电经济高效，而中国在开发这项技术方面已经取得了重大进展。
en: Long-distance UHV transmission is efficient and economical, and China has made major strides in developing this technology.

zh: 现在中国提出用超高压全球电网联通整个世界。
en: Now China proposes to help connect the entire world with a UHV global grid.

zh: 像在中国一样，可再生能源集中度最高的地方（如日照和风力最强的地方）往往远离人们的居住地。
en: In most of the world, as in China, the highest concentrations of renewable energy (such as the sunniest and windiest places) are far from where people live.

zh: 必须将太阳能从沙漠输送到人口中心区。
en: Solar power must be carried from deserts to population centers.

zh: 偏远地区风力发电的潜在能力也往往最高，其中包括海上风电。
en: The potential for wind power is often highest in remote places as well, including offshore.

zh: 巨大的水电潜力可以在流经无人山区的偏远的河流流域被发现。
en: Tremendous hydroelectric potential can be found on distant rivers flowing through unpopulated mountain regions.

zh: 中国提出全球连通电网背后的逻辑是可再生能源具有间歇性的特点。
en: The logic behind China’s proposal of a globally connected grid is that renewable energy is intermittent.

zh: 太阳只在白天发光，而即使在白天，浮云也会打断太阳能抵达光伏板。
en: The sun shines only during the day, and even then, cloud cover disrupts the solar energy reaching photovoltaic panels.

zh: 同样，风力的强度也在不断波动。
en: Likewise, wind fluctuates in strength.

zh: 如果能将这些间歇性的能源连接在一起，就可以实现平滑能源波动的目标。
en: By linking these intermittent sources together, the energy fluctuations can be smoothed.

zh: 当云层影响某个地区的太阳能时，人们可以用来自其他地区的太阳能或风能来发电。
en: When clouds diminish solar energy in one region, solar or wind power can be used from elsewhere.

zh: 从宏观问题着眼，中国已经创建了一个令人惊叹的组织 — — 全球能源互联发展与合作组织（GEIDCO ） — —目的是将国家政府、电网运营商、学术机构、发展银行和联合国机构召集到一起，启动建设全球可再生电网的工作。
en: Thinking big, China has created an impressive organization – the Global Energy Interconnection Development and Cooperation Organization (GEIDCO) – to bring together national governments, grid operators, academic institutions, development banks, and United Nations agencies to launch the global renewable energy grid.

zh: 在3月举行的全球会议上，全球能源互联发展与合作组织邀请了远在阿根廷和埃及等国的代表，共同合作实现全球清洁能源互联。
en: At its global meeting in March, GEIDCO gathered delegates from countries as far-flung as Argentina and Egypt to work together to realize the vision of globally interconnected clean energy.

zh: 中国正在采取几项进一步举措，全球能源互联发展与合作组织正在加紧研究几项关键技术挑战，如大规模能源存储、超导输电以及利用人工智能来管理电力系统的大规模互联。
en: China is taking several further steps. GEIDCO is mobilizing research and development on several key technology challenges, such as large-scale energy storage, superconductivity in power transmission, and artificial intelligence to manage large interconnected power systems.

zh: 全球能源互联发展与合作组织还在提出全新国际技术标准，目的是让各国电网能在无缝全球系统中实现互联。
en: GEIDCO is also proposing new international technical standards so that countries’ power grids can fit together in a seamless global system.

zh: 而中国正大规模投资于低成本可再生能源发电的研发，如先进的光伏发电和高性能电动汽车等终端应用。
en: And China is investing heavily in R&D on low-cost renewable energy generation, such as advanced photovoltaics, and end-uses, such as high-performance electric vehicles.

zh: 美国和欧盟同样应参与解决能源问题，两者均应与中国和其他国家合作，以加速实现向零碳能源转型。
en: The United States and the European Union should be engaging in the same kind of energy problem-solving, and both should be cooperating with China and others to accelerate the transformation to zero-carbon energy.

zh: 令人遗憾的是，在唐纳德·特朗普总统领导下，美国政府及其监管机构已经完全掌握在化石燃料游说团体的手中，而欧盟仍在与煤炭生产国就何时以及以何种方式淘汰煤炭争论不休。
en: Regrettably, under President Donald Trump, the US government and its regulatory agencies are entirely in the hands of the fossil-fuel lobby, while the EU bickers with its coal-producing member states about how and when to phase out coal.

zh: 因此中国提出的以可再生能源、超高压输电和智能电网为基础的全球能源互联代表了世界各国政府实现巴黎气候协定目标最大胆、最激动人心的全球行动。
en: China’s proposed global energy interconnection – based on renewables, UHV transmission, and an AI-enabled smart grid – thus represents the boldest and most inspiring global initiative by any government to achieve the goals of the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 该战略非常适合应对我们这代人所面临的前所未有的能源转型规模。
en: It is a strategy fit for the unprecedented scale of the energy transformation facing our generation.

zh: 中国向前进
en: China Going Forward

zh: 北京 — — 中国的人均收入达到3，800美元，已经超过了中等收入国家的收入标准。
en: BEIJING – China’s per capita income, at $3,800, has now surpassed the threshold for a middle-income country.

zh: 可就在战略和经济学家忙于推测中国的发展道路，预测中国何时能赶超美国的时候，中国的国内情绪在2010年却显得既严肃又克制。
en: But, even as economists and strategists busily extrapolate China’s future growth path to predict when it will catch up to the United States, the mood inside China became somber and subdued in 2010.

zh: 事实上，温家宝总理认为中国的发展“不稳定、不平衡、不协调、并且最终不可持续。 ”
en: Indeed, Premier Wen Jiabao sees China’s growth as “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and ultimately unsustainable.”

zh: 当然，任何国家的经济增长都绝非一帆风顺。
en: Economic growth, of course, has never been linear in any country.

zh: 纵观历史，中等收入国家进入这一发展阶段后数十年停滞不前，和/或最终退回到低收入国家的例子不胜枚举。
en: Throughout history, there are countless examples of middle-income countries becoming stuck in that category for decades and/or eventually falling back to low-income status.

zh: 诺贝尔奖得主迈克尔·斯宾塞指出在第二次世界大战后，只有少数几个国家最终达到了完全工业化的发展水平。
en: The Nobel laureate economist Michael Spence has pointed out that after WWII, only a handful of countries were able to grow to a fully-industrialized level of development.

zh: 令中国在过去30年取得巨大成功的发展模式是以社会主义计划经济为初始条件的一种东亚发展模式的变体。
en: China’s progress over the past three decades is a successful variation on the East Asian growth model that stems from the initial conditions bequeathed by a planned socialist economy.

zh: 但这种发展模式现在已经耗光了大部分潜力。
en: That growth model has now almost exhausted its potential.

zh: 因此中国已经到了紧要关头： 如果不进行痛苦的结构调整，中国的经济增长势头就有可能嘎然而止。
en: So China has reached a crucial juncture: without painful structural adjustment, its economic-growth momentum can suddenly be lost.

zh: 中国为实现高速增长付出了昂贵的代价。
en: China’s rapid growth has been achieved at extremely high cost.

zh: 这种代价可能只有后代子孙才能够真正计算的清楚。
en: Only future generations will know the true price.

zh: 中国的投资增速现在保持百分之五十以上 — — 这明确体现出中国资本使用效率的低下。
en: The country’s investment rate now stands at more than 50% – a clear reflection of China’s low capital efficiency.

zh: 中国的投资热中有两方面特别令人忧虑。
en: There are two worrying aspects of this high rate.

zh: 首先，地方政府影响很大一部分投资决策。
en: First, local governments influence a large proportion of investment decisions.

zh: 其次，房地产开发投资占总投资额的将近四分之一。
en: Second, investment in real-estate development accounts for nearly one-quarter of the total.

zh: 有些地方政府简直是用先挖坑再填上的方法来制造GDP。
en: Some local governments are literally digging holes and then filling them in order to create GDP.

zh: 中国已经有太多的豪华公寓、宏伟的政府办公楼和高耸的摩天大厦。
en: As a result, there are simply too many luxurious condominiums, magnificent government office buildings, and soaring skyscrapers.

zh: 中国省级市修建的酒店可以让西方位于首都的五星级酒店相形见绌。
en: Hotels in China’s provincial cities can make five-star hotels in Western capitals looked shabby.

zh: 中国已经成为全世界污染最严重的国家之一。
en: China has become one of the most polluted countries in the world.

zh: 粉尘和烟雾笼罩着一座座大城市。
en: Dust and smog choke its cities.

zh: 国内所有的主要河流均已遭到污染。
en: All of the country’s major rivers are contaminated.

zh: 尽管取得了一些进步，森林砍伐和荒漠化依然非常严重。
en: Deforestation and desertification are rampant.

zh: 干旱、水灾和山体滑坡已经非常普遍。
en: Drought, floods, and landslides have become commonplace.

zh: 毫无节制的开采正在迅速耗光中国的资源储备。
en: Relentless extraction is quickly depleting China’s resource deposits.

zh: 在中国贸易和出口占GDP比重已经超过60%和30%的情况下，已经无法继续依靠外部需求来实现经济发展的目的。
en: With China’s trade-to-GDP ratio and exports-to-GDP ratio already exceeding 60% and 30%, respectively, the economy cannot continue to depend on external demand to sustain growth.

zh: 不幸的是，由于出口部门为数千万工人提供了就业岗位，导致这种依赖已经转变为一种结构性问题，而这意味着，降低中国的贸易依存度和贸易顺差已经不单单是调整宏观经济政策所能解决的问题。
en: Unfortunately, with a large export sector that employs scores of millions of workers, this dependence has become structural, which implies that to reduce China’s trade dependency and trade surplus is much more than a matter of adjusting macroeconomic policy.

zh: 经历了数十年的快速扩张后，中国已经奠定了世界经济工厂的地位。
en: After decades of rapid expansion, China has become the workshop of the global economy.

zh: 问题在于它不过就是工厂而已： 中国经济的致命弱点是缺乏创新和创造力。
en: The problem is that it is no more than a workshop: lack of innovation and creation form the economy’s Achilles’ heel.

zh: 比如单从数量上看，中国现在是全世界最大的汽车制造国，今年一年的汽车产量就达到1700万台之多。
en: For example, in volume terms, China now is the largest car producer in the world, churning out 17 million this year.

zh: 但由中国制造企业自主研发的车型却屈指可数。
en: But the share of models developed by Chinese carmakers is negligible.

zh: 在这样一个以快速技术进步、创新和创造力为核心的年代，全球经济风景线瞬息万变。
en: In an era of rapid technological progress, creativity, and innovation, the global economic landscape can change rapidly.

zh: 没有强大的创新和创造能力，即使是巨人也有致命的软肋。
en: Without a strong capacity for innovation and creativity, even a giant has feet of clay.

zh: 当巨人倒下时，很多人都不能幸免。
en: And when a giant falls, many are hurt.

zh: 事实上，尽管中国的生活水准在过去30年内已经有了很大提高，但贫富差距也已经急剧扩大。
en: Indeed, while China’s living standards have risen dramatically over the past 30 years, the gap between rich and poor has widened sharply.

zh: 收入分配向富人倾斜的时间已经过长，政府也未能为公众提供足够的公共产品。
en: Income distribution has skewed in favor of the rich for too long, and the government has failed to provide decent public goods.

zh: 富人奢华的生活方式和穷人生活水平缓慢改善之间的强烈反差激起了社会的紧张情绪，对这种现象的强烈反弹随时可能发生。
en: With the contrast between the opulent lifestyle of the rich and the slow improvement of living conditions for the poor fomenting social tension, a serious backlash is in the making.

zh: 如果中国未能及时解决这些结构性问题，经济发展很可能无法持续。
en: If China fails to tackle its structural problems in a timely fashion, growth is unlikely to be sustainable.

zh: 任何结构性的调整都十分痛苦。
en: Any structural adjustment is painful.

zh: 但延误越久，调整的痛苦就越剧烈。
en: But the longer the delay, the more painful it will be.

zh: 中国今天强大的财政实力赋予了它成功调整的机会。
en: China’s strong fiscal position today gives it a window of opportunity.

zh: 但这样的机会稍纵即逝，因为特定改革政策的特定受益者已经形成既得利益阶层，他们会不惜一切代价保护已经得到的利益。
en: But that window will close fast, because beneficiaries of specific reform policies have morphed into vested interests, which are fighting hard to protect what they have.

zh: 中国公众最为痛恨的是官商勾结，倍受尊敬的中国经济学家吴敬琏将其称之为“权贵资本主义。
en: What the Chinese public resents most is the collusion between government officials and businesspeople, described by the respected Chinese economist Wu Jianglian as “capitalism of the powerful and rich.”

zh: ” 打破这一邪恶联盟是中国领导人在2011年和今后所面临的最大考验。
en: Breaking this unholy alliance will be the big test for China’s leadership in 2011and beyond.

zh: 在中国目前的制度条件下，精英管理是廉政善政的先决条件。
en: Under China’s current institutional arrangements, meritocracy is a prerequisite for good governance.

zh: 但阿谀奉承和玩世不恭的政治文化已经对精英管理造成了严重的侵蚀。
en: But meritocracy has been eroded by a political culture of sycophancy and cynicism.

zh: 因此，经济发展的辩证法已经再次凸显了政治改革的重要性。
en: So once again, the dialectics of economic development has brought political reform back to the fore.

zh: 在国外，中国的崛起已经激起了钦佩、嫉妒、怀疑，甚至在某些角落已经引发了公开的敌意。
en: Abroad, China’s rise has caused admiration, envy, suspicion, and even outright hostility in some corners.

zh: 无论中国领导人如��频繁地否认霸权野心，仍然无法消除某些人对中国真实意图的怀疑。
en: No matter how often Chinese leaders repudiate any hegemonic ambition, wariness about China’s true intentions will remain.

zh: 这种情况也可以理解： 历史上新的大国崛起一定会冲击既有国际秩序。
en: That is understandable: the rise of new powers has always disrupted the established international order.

zh: 如果这个新兴大国拥有13亿人口和陌生的政治制度和意识形态，那么它的崛起自然会引发更多的忧虑。
en: When this new power is a nation of 1.3 billion people living under an alien political system and ideology, its rise is bound to cause even more uneasiness.

zh: 幸运的是，由于全球化趋势的存在，中国的崛起像其他新兴经济体的崛起一样，符合所有人的利益。
en: Fortunately, because of globalization, China’s rise is in everyone’s interest, as is the rise of other emerging economies.

zh: 在今后若干年内，在气候变化、全球失衡和国际货币体系改革等领域，作为重要全球利益攸关方，中国应该而且会发挥更积极的作用。
en: In the coming years, in areas such as climate change, global imbalances, and reform of the international monetary system, China should and will play a more active role as a major global stakeholder.

zh: 但有一点应该不言自明：互惠互利是必须遵守的原则。
en: Needless to say, reciprocity will be necessary.

zh: 如何正确评判中国的国家治理？
en: The Right Way to Judge Chinese Governance

zh: 香港—一年一度的中国“两会 ” （ 人大和政协会议）后，似乎所有西方观察者都在讨论取消国家主席两届任期限制的话题。
en: HONG KONG – Following China’s “two sessions” – the annual meetings of the national legislature and the top political advisory body – all Western observers, it seems, are discussing the removal of the two-term limit for the president.

zh: 国际媒体强调了这是中国领导人在巩固权力，甚至是在培养个人崇拜。
en: Xi Jinping, the international media insists, is consolidating power, and may even be laying the groundwork for a Mao Zedong-style personality cult.

zh: 但这样的解读过于简单，没有看到中国国家治理的实质性含义。
en: But this reading is fundamentally flawed.

zh: 西方主流观点担心习近平权威日益加强其实是体现了美国和欧洲对它们的民主体制日益遭到挑战而感到焦虑。
en: The predominant Western view that Xi’s growing authority represents a dangerous trend partly reflects anxiety over growing challenges to democracy in the United States and across Europe.

zh: 在世界从单极向多极体系转变的时代，我们不能仅仅从传统的西方视角来看待及评判中国的政治发展及其国家治理。
en: But it makes little sense to view Chinese political developments through a Western lens, especially at a time when the world is shifting from a unipolar to a multipolar system.

zh: 中国最近在国家治理方面的变化应该被视为中国大历史及更广泛的现代化进程的一部分。 在这个过程中不同的国家治理体系正相互竞争，以应对复杂的、在全球范围内相互关联的的各种挑战，包括颠覆性新技术的涌现、地缘政治对抗、气候变化和人口结构演变等。
en: Recent changes in China should instead be regarded as part of a broader process, in which competing systems of governance are emerging to cope with complex, globally connected challenges, such as disruptive technologies, geopolitical rivalries, climate change, and demographic shifts.

zh: 简言之，各国正在寻找维护与改善其国家治理的立足点，特别是如何应对持续不断的结构调整及伴随的社会问题。
en: In short, countries are trying to find their governance footing.

zh: 在日新月异的世界里，国家治理体系必须确保在充满不确定性的国际环境下不仅能够迅速决策来解决不断积累的长期结构性经济社会问题，同时还可以确保政府问责。
en: In a fast-changing world, governance systems must support rapid decision-making under conditions of radical uncertainty, while maintaining accountability.

zh: 这才是我们正确评估中国政治发展与国家治理的标准，而不应该仅以从传统西式国家治理体系导出的期望为标准。
en: That – not the Western expectation of what a governance system should look like – is the standard by which we should be assessing political developments in China.

zh: 事实上，西式国家治理体系早已不再是其鼓吹者一直以来所宣称的国家治理“金本位 ” 。
en: In fact, Western-style governance no longer looks like the gold standard its advocates long proclaimed it to be.

zh: 西方民主国家正面临严重的来自内部的民粹主义的威胁与挑战，并催生了贸易保护主义等危险的政策偏向。 这些内部威胁之所以产生，主要是因为西方民主国家在国际环境剧烈变化过程中没能解决好国内收入不平等、政治极化、国家债务高企、公共基础设施破败等长期积累的经济与社会问题。
en: Western democracies are facing serious internal threats – most notably, populist forces espousing dangerous policies like trade protectionism – that have risen largely in response to these systems’ failure to manage problems such as income inequality, political polarization, rising debt, and failing infrastructure.

zh: 这些政府在公共服务方面的失灵部分反映了主导西方民主体制的政治家短期短视行为。 过短的选举周期（六个月到四年）常常迫使政治家专注于周期性问题，而忽略了妨碍长期生产率进步、收入增长、及社会公平的结构性瓶颈。
en: That failure partly reflects the short-termism that tends to dominate in Western democracies, where short electoral cycles (from about six months to four years) often compel politicians to focus on cyclical issues, rather than on structural impediments to long-term productivity gains and income growth.

zh: （类似地，许多西方企业也总是将经营基于季度结果，而忽视长期风险和机会。 ）
en: (Similarly, Western companies tend to base their operations on quarterly results, and thus may neglect long-term risks and opportunities.)

zh: 相反，中国领导人在制定和执行政策的时候，往往以几十年为时间跨度来考虑面临的经济与社会问题及应对策略。
en: By contrast, when China’s leaders formulate and execute policies, they tend to think in terms of decades.

zh: 这对于制定有效措施来应对结构性变化至关重要，特别是在处理经过40年高速增长和发展后产生的，包括腐败、不平等、与环境污染等，一系列经济与社会顽症的时候。
en: This is vital to enable an effective response to the structural problems – such as corruption, environmental pollution, and inequality – that more than two generations of rapid growth and development have brought.

zh: 在现有的国家治理体系下，中国的各个部门及地方已经在各自的职权范围内开始解决这些长期积累的经济与社会问题，以创造更平等，更有创新力、及更有适应力的社会。
en: The current bureaucracy, working within its silos, is already addressing these problems, in order to create a more equitable society that is also innovative and adaptable.

zh: 也只有这样面对改革的硬骨头，中国才能在人口老龄化给经济增长造成更大压力之前突破所谓的 “中等收入陷阱 ” 。
en: Only then can China escape the infamous “middle-income trap” before population aging begins to take a higher toll on economic growth.

zh: 更进一步看，中国领导人已经制定了一个国家经济和治理现代化的30年目标。 很少看到世界上其它国家可以制定如此长远的政策目标，更不用说落实了。
en: More broadly, China’s leaders have set a 30-year target for modernizing the country’s economy and governance – a long-term goal that reflects the kind of vision that few countries have managed to articulate, let alone implement.

zh: 取消国家主席任期限制为习近平主席和王岐山副主席实现这一长期愿景铺平了道路，从而提高了中国未来发展取得成功的机率。
en: By removing the presidential term limit, China’s leadership is improving its chances of success, by opening the way for Xi and his vice president, Wang Qishan, to go further in realizing this vision.

zh: 习近平和王岐山都是久经考验的政治家，拥有丰富的处理危机和驾驭复杂的制度变革和社会挑战的经验，不管是在地方层面还是在全球层面。
en: Xi and Wang are seasoned politicians with extensive experience dealing with crises and managing complex institutional and social challenges, from the local to the global level.

zh: 两人都熟谙历史，具备面对顽固既得利益所需要的魅力和决心。
en: Both have a strong grasp of history, as well as the charisma and will needed to confront recalcitrant vested interests.

zh: 因此，延长他们的领导任期对中国顺利度过其历史转折时期至关重要。
en: Their continued leadership is thus invaluable.

zh: 但这并不意味着新的国家治理体系没有问责机制。
en: But this does not mean that accountability will be lost.

zh: 相反，全国人大批准对国家治理结构进行重大修改，成立了新的国家监察委员会负责监督所有官员的腐败问题，不论属于哪个党派与部门、不论在党内地位有多高，都要接受监察委的监督。
en: On the contrary, the National People’s Congress has approved a major overhaul of China’s governance structure, creating a new National Supervision Commission to check corruption by all Chinese officials, regardless of their affiliations or status in the Communist Party of China.

zh: 国务院也进行了重组，各部门、委员会和机构进行了整合和梳理，以便更加有序及有效地深化改革。
en: The State Council has also been restructured, with ministries, commissions, and agencies consolidated and streamlined to manage reforms in a more coordinated and efficient way.

zh: 比如，农业和农村事务合并为一个部，所有环境保护事务也整合为一个部。
en: For example, agriculture and rural affairs have been combined under one ministry, as have all environmental issues.

zh: 为了降低金融业风险（包括杠杆率过高和影子银行问题 ） ， 银行和保险监管被整合为新的中国银行保险监督管理委员会。
en: Likewise, in order to reduce financial-sector risks (including excessive leverage and shadow banking), regulation of banking and insurance have been consolidated under the new China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission.

zh: 这些彻底的机构改革使中国的国家治理结构在功能上更加接近美国和欧洲。
en: These sweeping institutional reforms would make China’s governance structure look functionally similar to American and European counterparts.

zh: 与习近平和王岐山类似，这些机构的新任官员也是有奉献精神、有能力、有经验的改革者。
en: Like Xi and Wang, officials at these institutions are dedicated, competent, and experienced reformers.

zh: 曾在哈佛求学、在长期发展规划方面拥有30多年经验、对市场力量如何支持高效的资源配置有着深刻理解的刘鹤出任国务院副总理，辅佐总理李克强。
en: Assisting Premier Li Keqiang will be the Harvard-educated vice premier Liu He, who has spent more than 30 years in long-term development planning, and has a deep understanding of how market forces can support efficient resource allocation.

zh: 金融改革则交给了中国人民银行行长、有美国留学经历的易纲和中国银行保险监督管理委员会主席、曾赴牛津大学进修、拥有在省、央行和证监会高层领导履历的郭树清。
en: Financial reforms are in the hands of People’s Bank of China Governor Yi Gang, a US-educated economist, and the chairman of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, Guo Shuqing, an Oxford-trained economist with experience in provincial leadership, central banking, and securities regulation.

zh: 两千年前，中国哲学家韩非子认为治国需要三个要素：法治规范、官僚技术和政治意势。
en: Two thousand years ago, the Chinese philosopher Han Fei argued that effective governance required three things: the rule of law, bureaucratic tools, and political will.

zh: 修订法律法规和国家治理部门的改革很重要，但如果政治领袖没有持久的改革决心，一切都是空谈。
en: Changing laws or honing the tools of governance is important, but they mean little without sustained and determined efforts by political leaders.

zh: 中国的国家治理体系之所以能够存续，一个重要的原因是中国的几代领导人能够果断持续地直面并纠正各种市场及政府失灵。
en: China’s system has survived because its leaders have been willing to confront market failures and administrative deficiencies in a direct and consistent manner.

zh: 进一步提高政府问责的新措施对于加强国家治理体系的合法性至关重要，将提升中国国家治理体系在国际上的竞争力。
en: New efforts to boost accountability – vital to reinforce legitimacy – will strengthen the system further.

zh: 与美国和欧洲一样，中国太大，不容失败。
en: China, like the US and Europe, is too big to fail.

zh: 因此，中国有责任发展出一套能够真正实现经济和社会结构有效变化，同时又确保政府有效问责，的国家治理体系。
en: It thus has a responsibility to develop a system of governance that can deliver structural changes to its economy and society, while ensuring effective accountability.

zh: 评判中国国家治理体系的标准是其能否适应及应对在中国大历史的背景下出现的各种长期结构调整的挑战，为国家和全球福利做出贡献，而不是其是否符合短期流行的一些西方标准。
en: The test is whether that system adapts to long-term challenges and contributes to national and global wellbeing, not whether it adheres to Western standards.

zh: 中国的干预教训
en: China’s Intervention Lessons

zh: 北京—今年夏天以来，中国股市成为一个热门话题。 急速上涨变成大崩盘，引发了全球股市大甩卖。
en: BEIJING – China’s stock market has been a hot topic since the summer, when a rapid rise gave way to a major plunge, triggering a global equities sell-off.

zh: 现在的问题是如何防止进一步波动。
en: The question now is what can be done to prevent further volatility.

zh: 要回答这个问题，需要理解中国如何走到今天这一步。
en: To answer that question requires understanding how China got to this point.

zh: 多年来，在当局的鼓励（或至少是默许）下，中国证券公司卯足了劲用各种新奇金融工具和做法推高指数，其唯一的目的是在股价上涨中收获资本利得（中国很少派发股息 ） 。
en: For years, with the authorities’ encouragement (or at least acquiescence), China’s securities companies spared no effort in pumping up China’s stock exchanges with fashionable financial instruments and practices, the sole aim being to realize capital gains from rising prices (dividends are rarely distributed).

zh: 结果，在多年的熊市后，上证指数在不到七个月的时间里飙升100%度，从2014年11月的2,505点涨到今年6月的5,178点 — — 这一水平是中国经济基本面无法支撑的。
en: As a result, after years of poor performance, the Shanghai Composite Index soared by more than 100% in less than seven months, from 2,505 points in November 2014 to over 5,178 last June – a level that was not merited by China’s economic fundamentals.

zh: 助力这波涨势的最重要的工具是保证金交易。 保证金交易让投资者大量借钱购买股票。
en: The most important instrument driving this surge was margin trading, which enabled investors to borrow heavily to purchase shares.

zh: 据美国银行策略师崔伟的估计，7.5万亿元人民币的股票头寸来自保证金 ， “ 相当于A股市值的13%和流通市值的34 % 。 ”
en: According to Bank of America strategist David Cui, some CN¥7.5 trillion ($1.2 trillion) in market positions are being carried on margin, “equivalent to some 13% of A-share’s market cap and 34% of its free float.”

zh: 问题的一部分在于保证金交易并不只限于机构投资者。
en: Part of the problem was that margin trading was not limited to institutional investors.

zh: 比如，监管薄弱的“配资”公司可以让几乎所有人都获得保证金贷款，这带来了2.3万亿元人民的在线私募配资和1万亿人民币的线下私募配资，后者的杠杆率高达5:1。
en: Lightly regulated “fund matching” companies, for example, would distribute margin loans to virtually anyone, resulting in about CN‎¥2.3 trillion in online private fund matching and CN¥1 trillion in offline private fund matching, with a leverage ratio of up to 5:1 for the latter.

zh: 6月中旬，股价不断飙升终于让紧张的中国证监会下令限制线下私募配资。
en: In mid-June, the prolonged surge in stock prices finally drove an unnerved China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC) to impose restrictions on offline private fund matching.

zh: 这一决定立刻引起大甩卖，上证指数一天下跌2 % 。
en: The decision immediately triggered a sell-off, with the Shanghai Composite Index falling 2% in just one day.

zh: 一开始，这看上去只是自然修正。
en: Initially, this looked like a natural correction.

zh: 但保证金交易的普遍性导致下跌迅速演变为崩盘。
en: But the prevalence of margin trading caused the decline to turn quickly into a rout.

zh: 首先，暴跌的股价导致投资者账户中的股票下降到维持保证金水平以下，于是经纪商开始催缴保证金，迫使投资者甩卖更多资产以获得所需要的现金。
en: First, as plummeting stock prices caused the equity in investors’ accounts to fall below the maintenance margin, brokers began issuing margin calls, forcing investors to offload more assets to come up with the needed cash.

zh: 如果他们无法及时追加保证金，他们的股票就会被经纪商卖出，进一步打压股价。
en: When they failed to pay margin calls on time, their shares were sold by brokers, pushing stock prices down further.

zh: 当局急忙试图止血。
en: The authorities scrambled to stanch the bleeding.

zh: 6月27日，中国人民银行下调存款准备金率和基准利率。
en: On June 27, the People’s Bank of China lowered the reserve requirement ratio and the benchmark interest rate.

zh: 但上证综指继续下跌，7月1日已跌至4.200点。
en: But the Shanghai Composite Index kept falling, reaching 4,200 on July 1.

zh: 此时，中国证监会出台了一系列紧急措施：停止首次公开发行（IPO ） 、 允许上市公司停牌、限制卖空。
en: At that point, the CSRC launched a succession of desperate measures: it suspended initial public offerings, allowed companies to stop trading, and limited short selling.

zh: 它甚至组织了一支由21家大券商组成的“国家队 ” ， 在政府控制的证金公司的领导下买入股票支持上证综指。
en: It even organized a “national team” of 21 large securities companies, led by a government-controlled financial corporation, to purchase shares to buttress the Shanghai Composite Index.

zh: 为此，中国监管当局几乎在一夜之间打破了许多早已完善的规则。
en: In doing so, China’s regulatory authority changed many well-established rules of the game virtually overnight.

zh: 此外，尽管大规模官方干预或许阻止了崩盘，但也过早透支了监管者的信誉。
en: And, while massive official intervention may have halted the rout, it could have permanently damaged regulators’ credibility.

zh: 而这完全是没有必要的；银行并未过度暴露在风险中，也不存在任何系统性风险。
en: And it was not even merited; the banks were not overly exposed, so there were no systemic risks.

zh: 但导致股市溃败的这一政策失灵的后果并不仅限于此，而是导致了全球金融危机以来政府助推的信用飙升。
en: But the policy failures fueling this stock-market fiasco go back further, to the massive government-fueled surge in credit since the global financial crisis.

zh: 若非如此，经纪商拿不出足够的流动性为保证金交易提供全部贷款。
en: Without that, brokerages would not have had all of that liquidity to lend for margin trading.

zh: 危机爆发后，政府没有认识到潜在增长的下降并据此调整，而是继续间接坚持不现实的10%的年GDP增长目标。
en: After the crisis struck, instead of recognizing the decline in potential growth and adjusting accordingly, the government remained implicitly wedded to an unrealistic target of 10% annual GDP growth.

zh: 但是，尽管4万亿元刺激计划暂时提振了增长，投资回报却出现了恶化，因为潜在增长已经低于实际增长。
en: But, while the CN¥4 trillion stimulus package propped up growth temporarily, return on investment was deteriorating, because potential growth was already lower than actual growth.

zh: 因此，信用需求相对疲软；在许多情况下，商业银行必须说服企业接受贷款，很大一部分信用最终被用于在资本市场中竞逐资产。
en: As a result, credit demand was relatively weak; in many cases, commercial banks had to persuade enterprises to accept loans, with a large proportion of the credit ultimately devoted to chasing assets in the capital market.

zh: 一开始，过剩流动性助长了房地产泡沫。
en: At first, the excess liquidity fueled real-estate bubbles.

zh: 政府打压住宅和商用项目贷款后，高风险影子银行活动激增。
en: After the government clamped down on lending for residential and commercial projects, risky shadow banking activity surged.

zh: 政府打压影子银行后，流动性来到了股市；股市崩盘后，流动性又融入了债市。
en: After the government clamped down on that too, the liquidity was channeled toward stock exchanges; once those crashed, it sloshed into the bond market.

zh: 但债券市场不够大，吸收不了那么多流动性，因此其中一些流动性又回到了股市，股价出现了局部反弹，上证综指达到了3,500点。
en: But the bond market is not large enough to absorb it all, so some has now returned to the stock exchanges, leading to a partial recovery in share prices, with the Shanghai index reaching 3,500.

zh: 经济增长势头的减弱增加了放松货币政策的诱惑。
en: Declining economic growth strengthens the temptation to loosen monetary policy.

zh: 但在当今通缩环境中，光靠典型的货币扩张是无法帮助实体经济的，因为钱要么闲置，要么助长资产泡沫和资本外流。
en: But in today’s deflationary environment, typical monetary expansion alone can do little to help the real economy, because the money either remains idle or fuels asset bubbles and capital outflows.

zh: 如果中国政府要阻止债务-通缩循环演变为硬着陆，它应该将重点转到定向财政政策宽松。
en: If China’s government is to prevent a debt-deflation spiral from causing a hard landing, it should shift its focus to targeted expansionary fiscal policy.

zh: 中国政府预算赤字只占GDP的2.3 % ， 必然能够负担政府支出的增加和减税。
en: With a budget deficit of 2.3% of GDP, China can certainly afford to increase government expenditure and reduce taxes.

zh: 关键是，政策应该由财政部发行的政府债券融资，而不应该由商业银行通过地方政府融资平台融资。
en: Critically, the package should be financed by government bonds issued by the Ministry of Finance, not by commercial banks via local-government financing vehicles.

zh: 任何放松货币政策的措施都应该直接着眼于配合财政政策。
en: Any loosening of monetary policy should be aimed directly at accommodating fiscal policy.

zh: 这样，金融资源将被引导到实体经济中而不是吹起资产泡沫。
en: That way, financial resources would be channeled into the real economy, rather than inflating asset bubbles.

zh: 要支持这一政策，中国政府应该放松汇率管制，同时保持适当的资本管制。
en: To support this effort, China’s government should loosen its grip on the exchange rate, while maintaining appropriate capital controls.

zh: 人民币国际化不应该作为政策重点。
en: Renminbi internationalization should not be a policy priority.

zh: 近几年来中国的经验为中国领导人带来了极有价值的教训。
en: China’s experience in recent years holds valuable lessons for the country’s leaders.

zh: 如果实行反映这些教训的更加平衡的干预防针，中国领导人能够让中国经济走上更加稳定的道路。
en: With a more balanced approach to intervention that reflects those lessons, they could put China’s economy on a much more stable path.

zh: 但是，中国正在经历结构性经济转型，宏观经济政策的稳定潜力有限。
en: That said, as China undergoes structural economic transition, the stabilization potential of macroeconomic policy is limited.

zh: 如果不进行更多的基本面改革，即使是完美无瑕的宏观经政策组合也无法奏效。
en: Without more fundamental reforms, even an impeccable macroeconomic policy mix would not work.

zh: 改革需要时间，这意味着中国需要勇敢面对更多的麻烦和漫长的低速增长期。
en: Reforms take time, which means that China may need to brace itself for more troubles and a protracted period of slow growth.

zh: 中国的绿色能源革命
en: China’s Green-Energy Revolution

zh: 悉尼 — — 如同工业革命以来所有崛起经济体一样，中国的发电系统大多依赖燃烧化石燃料。
en: SYDNEY – China generates most of its electricity by burning fossil fuels, just as every rising economic power has done since the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 但只看到这一点就可能忽视一种值得关注的趋势。
en: But to focus on this single fact risks overlooking a notable trend.

zh: 中国的发电系统正在朝绿色化方向发展 — — 并且速度远非地球上规模相当的其他系统能够比拟。
en: The Chinese system of power generation is turning green – far more quickly than any other system of comparable size on the planet.

zh: 上述趋势体现在三个方面。
en: This trend is visible in three areas.

zh: 其中首先是发电领域。
en: The first is electricity generation.

zh: 中国电力企业联合会发布的数据显示，中国的化石燃料发电量2014年有史以来首次同比下降了0.7 % 。
en: According to data released by the China Electricity Council, the amount of power that China generated from fossil fuels in 2014 decreased by 0.7% year on year, the first drop in recent memory.

zh: 此外，非化石燃料发电量则同比增长19 % 。
en: Meanwhile, power generation from non-fossil-fuel sources increased by 19%.

zh: 值得注意的是，上述变化绝大部分并非来自核能。
en: Remarkably, nuclear energy played only a small role in this change.

zh: 水能、风能和太阳能等严格意义上的绿色能源发电增长了20 % ， 其中以太阳能发电的增幅最大，实现了175% 的惊人涨幅。
en: Electricity generated by strictly green sources – water, wind, and solar – increased by 20%, with the most dramatic growth occurring in solar power generation, which rose a staggering 175%.

zh: 太阳能发电在新能源产出方面同样超过核电，去年太阳能发电量增长17.43太瓦时，而核能发电量仅增长14.7太瓦时。
en: Solar power also surpassed nuclear in terms of new energy produced, providing an extra 17.43 terawatt-hours last year, compared to 14.70 terawatt-hours from nuclear sources.

zh: 而且中国风力发电的贡献量连续第三年超过核能。
en: And, for the third consecutive year, China generated more electricity from wind than from nuclear energy.

zh: 有鉴于此，中国非碳发电将依赖核电的说法似乎并不准确。
en: Given this, the argument that China will be dependent on nuclear power plants for non-carbon sources of electricity appears to have little merit.

zh: 绿色趋势越来越明显的还有中国的总发电量领域。
en: The second area in which the green trend has become apparent is China’s total electricity-generating capacity.

zh: 中国的电力系统目前居世界之首，其发电能力为1.36太瓦，超过美国1太瓦的总发电能力。
en: The country’s power system is now the world’s largest, capable of producing 1.36 terawatts, compared to the United States’ one terawatt.

zh: 直接比较不同种类的能源发电难度很大，因为一天内的不同时间风能、太阳能、核能和化石燃料的使用并不一致。
en: Direct comparisons of different power sources are difficult, because the use of wind, solar, nuclear, and fossil-fuel plants varies according to the time of day.

zh: 但审视年度数据就可以了解发电系统的变化趋势。
en: But a look at annual data can offer insights into how the entire system is changing.

zh: 去年中国连续第二年非化石燃料新增发电量超过化石燃料。
en: Last year was the second in a row in which China added more generating capacity from non-fossil-fuel sources than from fossil-fuel sources.

zh: 中国化石燃料新增发电能力45千兆瓦，总计拥有916千兆瓦的化石燃料发电能力。
en: China increased its ability to generate electricity from fossil fuels by 45 gigawatts, to reach a total of 916 gigawatts.

zh: 与此同时，��国非化石燃料新增发电能力56千兆瓦，总计实现444千兆瓦的非化石燃料发电能力。
en: At the same time, it increased its capacity to produce electricity from non-fossil-fuel sources by 56 gigawatts, achieving a total of 444 gigawatts.

zh: 风能、水能和太阳能电厂新增51千兆瓦的发电能力。
en: Wind, water, and solar plants added 51 gigawatts of generating capacity.

zh: 这样一来，风能、水能和太阳能发电量从2007年占中国总发电量的 21%增长至31 % ， 此外核能发电还额外占据总发电量的2 % 。
en: As a result, wind, water, and solar power accounts for 31% of China’s total electricity-generation capacity, up from 21% in 2007, while nuclear power accounts for another 2%.

zh: 目前的成绩超出了中国十二五规划的既定目标，该计划预计中国非化石燃料发电能力到2015年将占到国内电力系统的30 % 。
en: These results exceed the goal established by China’s 12th Five-Year Plan, which projected that power generating capacity based on non-fossil-fuel sources would account for approximately 30% of the country’s electricity system by 2015.

zh: 最后，中国的投资模式可以明确反映出绿色能源趋势。
en: Finally, the trend toward green energy can be seen in China’s investment patterns.

zh: 证据非常简单：相比化石能源发电中国正将更多资金投入到绿色发电领域。
en: The evidence is plain: The country is putting more money toward green sources of electric power than toward those reliant on fossil fuels.

zh: 事实上，中国在绿色能源投入领域已经领先世界。
en: Indeed, China is spending more on green energy than any other country.

zh: 化石燃料发电设备投资持续下降，从2008年的1，670亿人民币（约合240亿美元）下降至2014年的950亿人民币（约合153亿美元 ） 。 而同期的非化石燃料发电设备投资则持续上升，从2008年的1，180亿人民币上升至2014年的至少2，520亿人民币。
en: Investment in facilities producing energy from fossil fuels has consistently declined, from CN¥167 billion (roughly $24 billion) in 2008 to CN¥95 billion in 2014 ($15.3 billion), while investment in non-fossil-fuel sources has increased, from CN¥118 billion in 2008 to at least CN¥252 billion in 2014.

zh: 进入可再生能源发电领域的投资比重稳步上升，2011年已从短短四年前占投资总额的32%上升至占投资总额的50 % 。
en: The share of energy investment going into renewable electric generation has increased steadily, reaching 50% in 2011, up from 32% just four years before.

zh: 2013年，不低于总投资额的59%流入到可再生能源投资。
en: In 2013, renewables’ share of investment reached no less than 59%.

zh: 中国的能源改革成功与否事关重大，尤其是该国打造世界最大可再生能源发电系统的努力 — — 中国的雄心超出所有人的想象，西方做出的努力根本无法与之相比。
en: Much depends on the success of China’s energy reforms, and in particular on its efforts to build the world’s largest renewable power system – an ambition far larger than anything imagined, much less attempted, in the West.

zh: 因此为了把握变化的总体方向，对中国发电系统的变化情况进行跟踪就显得愈加重要。
en: This makes it all the more important to report accurately on the system as it evolves, in order to comprehend the overall direction of change.

zh: 中国的电力系统依然在很大程度上依赖于煤炭，在真正完成从黑色到绿色的转变之前还要烧掉很多煤。
en: China’s power system remains heavily based on coal, and much more will be burned before the system can accurately be described as more green than black.

zh: 但变化的方向十分明确。
en: But the direction of change is clear.

zh: 我们必须承认这种变化 — — 并在全球能源和能源政策谈判中予以考虑。
en: This needs to be acknowledged – and factored into discussions of global energy and energy policy.

zh: 中国的双轨挑战
en: China’s Dual-Track Challenge

zh: 香港—中国经济减速的迹象从未如此明显。
en: HONG KONG – With China's economic slowdown more apparent than ever, its prospects of avoiding a hard landing are weakening.

zh: 决策者是否能够成功避免硬着陆，取决于他们是否能够应对来自日益分化的双轨经济的挑战。
en: Whether policymakers succeed will depend on whether they can navigate the challenges stemming from an increasingly divided dual-track economy.

zh: 1月份的最新同比数据彰显出危险程度。
en: The latest year-on-year data, from January, highlight the danger.

zh: 消费物价指数下跌0.8 % ； 生产物价指数下跌4.3 % ； 出口减少3.3 % ； 进口减少19.9 % ； 广义货币（M2）增速放缓1.4 % 。
en: The consumer price index dropped to 0.8%; the producer price index fell by 4.3%; exports contracted by 3.3%; imports were down by 19.9%; and growth of broad money (M2) slowed by 1.4%.

zh: 此外，人民币正在经受贬值的压力，部分是因为美国经济复苏加速了资本外流。
en: Moreover, the renminbi has come under downward pressure, owing partly to economic recovery in the United States, which has fueled capital outflows.

zh: 考虑到工业利润增长下降（从2013年的12.2%下降到去年的3.3 % ） 和地方政府卖地收入下降（2014年下降37 % ） ，不禁令人担忧，目前的通缩周期可能引发企业和地方政府的债务危机。
en: Given huge declines in industrial profit growth (from 12.2% in 2013 to 3.3% last year) and in local-government revenues from land sales (which fell by 37% in 2014), there is considerable anxiety that today's deflationary cycle could trigger corporate and local-government debt crises.

zh: 中国希望通过实现从国家主导的经济向市场导向的经济转变，以确保长期可持续的经济发展。
en: China hopes to secure its long-term economic development by shifting from a state-directed to a market-led economy.

zh: 但该过程导致其双轨经济在效益方面的裂变，国有企业表现明显劣于民营企业，尽管前者比后者更容易获得信贷。
en: But the process has created significant discrepancies in economic performance, with state-owned enterprises (SOEs) performing significantly worse than their private-sector counterparts, despite having better access to credit.

zh: 而中国繁荣的一、二线城市和落后的三、四线城市之间的房地产行情差别也越来越大。 一二线城市的地产行情不仅好过三四线城市，前者由于平均家庭收入更高而对房价的承受力更强。
en: And there is a widening disparity between real-estate prices in China's thriving first- and second-tier cities and its lagging third- and fourth-tier cities (though higher household incomes in the former make housing there more affordable).

zh: 政府目前的任务是一方面如何针对表现较好的民营企业和一二线城市出台可以巩固及持续其增长的措施，另一方面如何针对表现较差的国有企业和三四线城市出台可以消除过剩产能和提高生产率的措施。
en: The authorities' task now is to determine how to support continued growth on the better performing track (the private sector and the first- and second-tier cities), while eliminating overcapacity and boosting productivity on the weaker track (SOEs and third- and fourth-tier cities).

zh: 要想成功，就必须纠正此前政策的缺陷 — — 向落后者提供更多资金和优惠政策，否则将助长产能过剩和不可持续的地方债务。
en: To succeed, they must address the fallout of the previous approach, which, by providing more money and preferential policies to the lagging track, ended up fueling overcapacity and unsustainable local debts.

zh: 换言之，中国必须面对由于过去地方计划及决策失误而已经发生的成本（经济学称其为沉淀成本，因为我们不能改变历史 ） ， 不能继续指望靠官僚系统的干预来粉饰有缺陷及不可持续的项目。
en: In other words, China must confront the sunk costs of bad local-planning decisions.

zh: 政府应该采取市场化的方法，让这些失败的项目的财务损失通过破产程序来处理，从而让所有相关的生产要素解放出来，并转向更具创造性的活动。
en: Instead of continuing to hope that bureaucratic intervention can repair flawed projects, officials should take a market-based approach, allowing losses to be allocated through the bankruptcy process, thereby enabling all stakeholders to move on to more productive activities.

zh: 中国经济的双轨结构也带来了宏观金融管理方面的独特挑战。
en: The Chinese economy's dual-track structure also presents unique challenges for macro-financial management.

zh: 高速增长部门吸收了越来越多的资源，因此需要利率市场化来确保资源可以有效配置。
en: As the fast-growing sectors absorb an increasing amount of resources, a shift toward more market-oriented interest rates is needed to ensure efficient allocation.

zh: 与此同时，低速增长部门有可能陷入“资产负债表衰退 ” ， 比如，高负债的国有企业和地方政府将主要精力用在偿还债务上，而无法继续投资于必要的基础设施，甚至在利率下降时也是如此。
en: Meanwhile, the slow-growing sectors risk falling into a “balance-sheet recession," with highly indebted SOEs and local governments becoming so focused on paying down their debts that they stop investing in needed infrastructure, even when interest rates fall.

zh: 结果，传统的货币政策和审慎的宏观政策都难以满足目前双轨经济对信贷的大量竞争性需求。 一轨需要更多贷款来支持其创新及生产率增长，而另一轨则需要更多贷款用于兼并、重组、破产、维稳及为改革赢得时间。
en: As a result, conventional monetary and macro-prudential policies are caught between competing demands for credit, with one track needing to support productive growth and the other attempting to buy time for restructuring.

zh: 中国央行试图通过根据部门或金融机构的类型，采取不同的准备金要求以应对这一困境。
en: The People's Bank of China (PBOC) has attempted to confront this dilemma by differentiating reserve requirements according to sector or type of financial institution.

zh: 但结果并不乐观。
en: The results have not been encouraging.

zh: 比如，去年11月，当央行降低基准利率以减轻民营部门借贷成本时，却引起了投机性的股市暴涨。
en: For example, when the PBOC cut its benchmark interest rate last November, in order to help reduce private-sector borrowing costs, it triggered a speculative stock-market boom.

zh: 继1月份令人失望的宏观经济数据，央行再次采取行动，将准备金率降低50个基点，并进一步降低了专注于中小企业贷款的银行和中国农业发展银行的准备金率（分别降低了50个基点和400个基点 ） 。
en: Following January's disappointing macroeconomic data, the PBOC acted again, by lowering the reserve ratio for banks by 50 basis points, with additional cuts for banks focused on small and medium-size enterprises (50 basis points) and for the Agricultural Development Bank of China (400 basis points).

zh: 尽管采取了这些措施，但两条轨道的经济主体似乎还面临信贷不足的状况。
en: Despite these efforts, neither track seems satisfied that their credit demands are being met.

zh: 应对这些结构性挑战的措施之所以不容易推进，不仅因为有制度壁垒，也因为根深蒂固的官员腐败。
en: Efforts to address these structural challenges are being frustrated not just by institutional barriers, but also by entrenched official corruption.

zh: 反腐措施赢得了广泛的民众支持，但也在短期影响了官僚体系的效率 — — 在关键的改革之年解决这一问题尤其紧迫，特别是考虑到目前经济增长显著放缓的情况。
en: The problem is that anti-corruption measures, despite enjoying broad public support, undermine bureaucratic effectiveness in the short term – a significant issue in a critical reform year, especially given slowing growth.

zh: 结构改革旨在打击腐败、削减过剩产能、处理不可持续的地方债务，以此产生长期的改革红利与可���续的回报。
en: Institutional reforms aimed at combating corruption, reducing overcapacity, and dealing with unsustainable local debts will generate long-term dividends and sustainable payoffs.

zh: 但结构改革在短期从宏观层面其实不可避免的会有紧缩效果，这就很自然地需要短期对冲刺激手段 — — 如减税和增加财政赤字 — — 来保证增长波动不会太大。
en: But short-term stimulus measures, such as tax cuts and higher fiscal deficits, will be needed to minimize growth disruptions.

zh: 这意味着需要改变目前政府预算赤字下降的趋势。 中国预算赤字从2013年占GDP的2%下降到去年的1.8 % 。
en: This would mean reversing the recent decline in the government budget deficit, which narrowed to 1.8% last year, from 2% of GDP in 2013.

zh: 从双轨经济向市场经济的转型绝非易事。
en: The transition from a dual-track economy to a market-based economy will not be easy.

zh: 中国经济的增长方式显然亟需修复。
en: The Chinese economy is clearly in urgent need of repair.

zh: 但我们看到的并非都是坏消息：中国经济的大部分仍在发展，其总体增长率仍高于世界其它经济体。
en: But the news is not all bad: a substantial portion of the economy continues to expand, underpinning much higher overall growth rates than in most other economies.

zh: 此外，尽管存在对资本外流的担忧，中国拥有坚实的净外汇资产头寸，高达1.7万亿美元（占GDP的17.6 % ） ，足以维持中国渡过艰难的转型期。
en: Moreover, despite some concerns about capital outflows, China's consolidated net foreign-asset position, which stands at $1.7 trillion (17.6% of GDP), remains sufficient to sustain China through this tough transition.

zh: 中国领导人认识到为了确保可持续增长，重要的制度改革势在必行，虽然对短期增长放缓的担忧不可避免的会要求出台一些解决当前问题的措施。
en: China's leaders recognize the long-term imperative of serious institutional reform, even as concerns about slowing growth heighten the temptation to embrace short-term fixes.

zh: 当局正在采取强硬手段治理污染、提高能源利用效率、实施养老金改革、扩大医疗保障和廉租房覆盖面。
en: The authorities are taking strong action to curb pollution, improve energy efficiency, implement pension reform, and expand access to health care and low-cost housing.

zh: 更重要的是，中国领导层决心铲除腐败的毒瘤。
en: More immediately, China's leadership is committed to excising the cancer of corruption.

zh: 与实施人命关天的重要手术一样，成功的一个重点在于确保必要的生命支持系统（如供氧、供血、止痛）运转良好。
en: The key, as with any critical surgery, is to ensure that the necessary life-support systems are in place.

zh: 对中国来说，这意味着，在强力推进结构性改革的时候，需要保持充足的金融流动性及财政支持。
en: In China's case, that means maintaining adequate liquidity.

zh: 最终，可持续发展需要中国经济的双轨合一。
en: In the end, sustainable development will require that China's two economic tracks merge.

zh: 在这个正确的方向下，在改革的过程中维持相对稳定快速的增长，并避免硬着陆，不仅对中国有利，还能确保全球经济所亟需的增长与稳定。
en: With the right approach, relatively stable and rapid growth can be maintained throughout the reform process. Avoiding a hard landing would be good not only for China; it would ensure much-needed growth and stability for the global economy.

zh: 为何中国能够按计划增长
en: Why China Can Grow According to Plan

zh: 北京—最近，中国完成了十三五规划的制定，为2016—2020年勾勒出经济战略和目标地图。
en: BEIJING – China’s recently finalized 13th five-year plan maps out its economic strategy and ambition for the 2016-2020 period.

zh: 其中一个目标是实现GDP和平均农村和城市家庭收入在2010年水平的基础上翻一番。
en: Among its objectives are a doubling of GDP and average rural and urban household incomes relative to their 2010 levels.

zh: 这些目标需要中国经济平均年增长率在未来五年至少达到6.5 % 。
en: These targets would require China’s economy to grow at an average annual rate of at least 6.5% during the next five years.

zh: 这一速度比1979年以来平均每年9.7%的增长率低不少，但从国际标准看，毫无疑问仍属于高增长。
en: While this pace would be significantly slower than the 9.7% growth the country has averaged since 1979, it is undeniably fast by international standards.

zh: 此外，考虑到自2010年初以来中国每个季度增长都有所放缓，一些人开始质疑这一目标是否可以实现。
en: And, given that China’s growth has decelerated every quarter since the beginning of 2010, some have questioned whether it is achievable.

zh: 我相信答案是肯定的。
en: I believe that it is.

zh: 经济增长来自由技术进步和产业升级带来的劳动生产率的增加。
en: Economic growth results from increases in labor productivity caused by technological advance and industrial upgrading.

zh: 高收入国家已经处于生产率的前沿，必须通过技术和组织突破才能实现增长；因此，它们的典型增长率在3%左右。
en: High-income countries, already on the cutting edge of productivity, must earn their increases through technological and organizational breakthroughs; as a result, their typical growth rate is about 3%.

zh: 但是，发展中国家可以通过从发达国家借技术 — — 即像中国那样利用后发优势 — — 加快生产率增长，从而加快GDP增长。
en: Developing countries, however, could potentially accelerate productivity growth, and thus GDP growth, by borrowing technology from advanced countries – that is, tapping the latecomers’ advantage, as China has done.

zh: 在经历了36年的赶超之后，中国的问题是还能从这一过程获益多久。
en: The question for China, after 36 years of catching up, is how much longer it can continue to benefit from this process.

zh: 一些学者认为极限已经达到。
en: Some scholars believe it has reached its limits.

zh: 他们使用经济史学家安格斯·麦迪逊（Angus Maddison）的历史数据，说明了其他东亚经济体如何在人均GDP达到11,000美元左右时（按以1990年美元价格为基准的购买力平价计算，若按2005年美元价格，则为17,000美元）经历经济增长减速。
en: Using historical data compiled by the economic historian Angus Maddison, they show how other East Asian countries experienced a deceleration of economic growth after their per capita GDP reached about $11,000 in purchasing-power-parity terms relative to constant 1990 US dollar prices, or $17,000 in constant 2005 US dollar prices.

zh: 比如，在日本到达这一水平后的五年里，其经济平均年增长率为3.6 % 。
en: For example, in the five years after Japan reached that level, its economy grew at an average annual rate of 3.6%.

zh: 在韩国，增长率下降到4.8 % 。
en: In South Korea, growth fell to 4.8%.

zh: 香港下降到5.8 % 。
en: In Hong Kong, it slowed to 5.8%.

zh: 中国预计将于今年达到相同的阈值，因此很多人相信其未来五年平均年增长率将大大低于7 % 。
en: Given that China is projected to cross the same threshold sometime this year, many believe its average annual growth over the next five years will fall well below 7%.

zh: 我不这么看。
en: I disagree.

zh: 这一分析没有考虑到一个事实，即发达国家不是袖手旁观者；它们在增长并做出技术突破。
en: What this analysis fails to take into account is the fact that advanced countries are not sitting by idly; they are growing and making technological breakthroughs.

zh: 而这给发展中国家创造了持续学习的机会。
en: And that creates opportunities for developing countries to continue to learn.

zh: 预测中国减速者着眼于人均GDP，这是正确的，人均GDP体现了一国平均劳动生产率，因此也体现了其技术和工业进步水平。
en: Those who predict a slowdown in China are correct to look at its per capita GDP, which is a reflection of a country’s average labor productivity and thus the level of its technical and industrial advancement.

zh: 但中国增长潜力的最佳指标不是其人均GDP相对于任意确定的阈值的水平；而是中国和美国（世界上最发达的经济体）人均GDP之差。
en: But the best indicator of China’s growth potential is not its per capita GDP relative to some arbitrary threshold; it is the difference in per capita GDP between China and the United States, the world’s most advanced economy.

zh: 以这一衡量指标，中国还有充足的扩张空间。
en: And on this measure, China has plenty of room for expansion.

zh: 1972年，当日本迈过11,000美元阈值时，其人均GDP相当于美国水平的72 % 。
en: When Japan crossed the $11,000 threshold in 1972, its per capita GDP was 72% of the US level.

zh: 当台湾在1992年迈过这一阈值时，其人均GDP为美国的48 % 。
en: When Taiwan crossed it in 1992, its per capita GDP was 48% of America’s.

zh: 今天，中国的可比数字只有30%左右。
en: The comparable figure for China today is only about 30%.

zh: 2008年 — — 麦迪逊2010年去世前提供数字的最新年份 — — 中国人均GDP为美国的21 % 。
en: In 2008 – the last year for which Maddison provided figures before he died in 2010 – China’s per capita GDP was 21% of the US level.

zh: 我们可以考察其他东亚经济体在类似水平上的表现，以此估计中国的增长潜力。
en: By examining how other East Asian economies performed when they were at a similar point compared to the US, we can estimate China’s potential for growth.

zh: 日本人均GDP在1951年达到美国的21 % ， 随后20年，其经济以平均每年9.2%的速度增长。
en: Japan’s per capita GDP was 21% of America’s in 1951, and in the following 20 years it grew at an average rate of 9.2%.

zh: 新加坡在1967年达到这一水平，随后20年的平均增长率为8.6 % 。
en: In the two decades after Singapore hit that level in 1967, it grew at an average of 8.6%.

zh: 台湾、香港和韩国也都类似；在人均GDP达到美国的21%之后的20年，它们的增长率在8%左右。
en: And the story is similar in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and South Korea; in the 20 years after their per capita GDP were 21% of the US level, they grew at around 8%.

zh: 没有理由认为中国在2018年前不具备这一水平的潜力。
en: There is no reason not to believe that China has the potential to do the same until 2018.

zh: 中国经济目前的放缓是外部和周期性因素的结果，而不是自然极限。
en: The Chinese economy’s current slowdown is the result of external and cyclical factors, not some natural limit.

zh: 中国一直在承受2008年金融危机和出口需求暴跌的影响。
en: China has been suffering from the aftereffects of the 2008 financial crisis and plummeting export demand.

zh: 从1979年到2013年，年出口增长率平均为16.8 % 。
en: From 1979 to 2013, annual export growth averaged 16.8%.

zh: 2014年，出口增长率下降到6.1 % ； 2015年进一步下降，为-1.8 % 。
en: In 2014, it dropped to 6.1%; in 2015, it dropped further, to -1.8 %.

zh: 外部拖累可能会维持下去，因为发达国家的政治局面妨碍它们实施重振经济增长所需要的结构改革 — — 比如降低工资、削减社会福利、金融去杠杆和整固预算赤字。
en: This external drag is likely to continue, as politics in developed countries impedes efforts to implement the structural reforms – such as reducing wages, lowering social benefits, financial deleveraging, and consolidating budget deficits – needed to revive economic growth.

zh: 事实上，与始于1991年的日本类似，发达世界中的许多国家有可能迎来失去的几十年。
en: Indeed, like Japan beginning in 1991, much of the developed world risks lost decades.

zh: 要想实现增长目标，中国需要依靠内需，包括投资和消费。
en: To achieve its growth targets, China will have to rely on domestic demand, including investment and consumption.

zh: 幸运的是，这两方面均前景可期。
en: Thankfully, it has strong prospects in both areas.

zh: 发达国家常常难以发现生产性投资机会，与此不同的是，中国可以追求基础设施改善、城市化措施、环境管理和高科技行业。
en: Unlike developed countries, which often struggle to find productive investment opportunities, China can pursue improvements in infrastructure, urbanization efforts, environmental management, and high-tech industries.

zh: 此外，与许多发展中国家竞争对手不同，中国拥有充足的财政空间、家庭储蓄和外汇储备来进行这些投资。
en: And, unlike many of its developing-country rivals, China has ample fiscal space, household savings, and foreign-exchange reserves for such investments.

zh: 投资将产生就业、家庭收入和消费。
en: The investments will generate jobs, household income, and consumption.

zh: 因此，即使外部条件不改善，实现6.5%或以上的年增长也绝对在中国的能力范围内。
en: As a result, even if external conditions do not improve, achieving 6.5% and above annual growth is well within China’s reach.

zh: 如此，中国将继续成为世界主要经济引擎，至少在2020年前贡献30%的全球增长。
en: In that case, the country will continue to be the world’s primary economic engine, contributing about 30% of global growth until at least 2020.

zh: 中国新常态，不新亦不常
en: China’s Not-So-New Not-So-Normal

zh: 香港—我刚刚在中国度过了一周时间，参加了类似于达沃斯世界经济论坛的一年一度的博鳌亚洲论坛。
en: HONG KONG – I just spent a week in China, where I participated in the Boao Asia Forum, a conference similar to the annual gathering of the World Economic Forum in Davos.

zh: 我所在的讨论组的主题是中国国家主席习近平所提出的中国经济的“新常态 ” ： 在三十年的两位数经济扩张期后，中国将迎来一个增长相对较缓的时期。
en: The topic of my panel was what President Xi Jinping has called the Chinese economy’s “new normal”: an era of relatively slower growth, following three decades of double-digit economic expansion.

zh: 但让我印象最深的是中国经济的非凡之处。
en: But what strikes me most about China’s economy is how remarkable it is.

zh: 事实上，它的表现仍然让我震惊。
en: Indeed, its performance continues to astound me.

zh: 尽管它毫无疑问面临着诸多挑战，但关键问题是这些挑战会怎样影响经济。
en: Though it undoubtedly faces plenty of challenges, the key question is how likely they are to bring down the economy.

zh: 在金砖四国（巴西、俄罗斯、 印度、中国）中，习近平的国家是在这个十年以来唯一一个达到我的预期的。
en: Of the four BRIC countries – Brazil, Russia, India, and China – Xi’s is the only one that has met my expectations for growth so far this decade.

zh: 从2011年到2014年，中国经济平均每年增长8 % 。
en: From 2011 to 2014, the Chinese economy grew at an average annual rate of 8% per year.

zh: 如果在这个十年的剩余时间以每年7%左右，即中国当局和许多观察者所预计的速度增长，则整个十年的平均扩张速度为7.5 % ， 与我的预测相当。
en: If it continues to grow by around 7% for the rest of the decade, as the authorities and many observers expect, it will achieve an average pace of expansion of 7.5%, in line with my projections.

zh: “新常态”一词是中国领导人机智的说法。 他们必须向14亿中国人解释为何经济不会再以每年10%的速度增长。
en: The phrase “new normal” is a clever bit of messaging by China’s leaders, who must explain to the country’s 1.4 billion citizens why the economy will no longer be growing by 10% a year.

zh: 但对一个已是位居其后的日本两倍规模，并且可能在未来五年内超越欧盟的经济体来说，这样的速度一点都不“常 ” 。
en: But there is nothing normal about an economy that is already twice as large as the next largest, Japan, and will possibly outstrip the European Union within the next five years.

zh: 我来中国主要是以英国政府抗耐药性评估（Review on Antimicrobial Resistance）主席的身份；但我也寻找机会与人讨论中国经济所面临的挑战。
en: I was in China primarily in my role as Chair of the British government’s Review on Antimicrobial Resistance; but I also sought opportunities to speak to people about the challenges facing the economy.

zh: 许多国际观察者担心中国房地产的过度供给和相关信用繁荣，这让我怀疑是否对这些风险过于乐观了。
en: Many international observers have been worried about the country’s oversupply of housing and the related credit boom, making me wonder whether I have been overly sanguine about these risks.

zh: 但通过对话我相信，这两个问题都是可管理的。
en: But my conversations persuaded me that both problems are likely to be manageable.

zh: 诚然，房地产市场的景气已经过去了。
en: To be sure, the housing market is in the doldrums.

zh: 但是，许多人对我说，这部分是政府有意压制的结果（另一个令人放心的事实是总体而言消费者并未过度负债 ） 。
en: But, as many pointed out to me, this is partly the result of deliberate government measures to deflate it (also comforting is the fact that consumers are in general not overleveraged).

zh: 一些建筑商将面临信用问题，一些地方当局亦然。
en: Some builders will experience problems with credit, and so might some local authorities.

zh: 但中央那政府支出占中国总GDP比重很小，如果有必要在这些领域进行干预，决策者拥有很大的动作空间。
en: But spending by the central government is such a small percentage of the country’s total GDP that policymakers have a lot of room for maneuver if intervention becomes necessary in these areas.

zh: 外国观察者频繁预测中国当局也许有意高估了经济的强度。
en: Foreign observers frequently speculate that the Chinese authorities may be deliberately overstating the economy’s strength.

zh: 但同样可能的是一些部门的规模被低估了。
en: But it is equally possible that the size of some sectors is being understated.

zh: 在北京的几天中，很明显中国正处于互联网应用的热潮中，包括将其作为消费平台。
en: After spending a few days in Beijing, it was abundantly clear that China is undergoing a boom in Internet use, including as a consumer platform.

zh: 在线商务抵消了经济其他领域的弱势，其完全影响力在官方数据中实际是被低估的。
en: Online commerce is offsetting some of the other weaker areas of the economy, and its full impact might actually be underreported in official statistics.

zh: 我确实担心政府给予中国数百万农民工在他们工作和生活的城市的正式居留权的动作不够迅速。
en: I do worry that the government is not moving fast enough to grant the country’s millions of migrant workers official residency in the cities where they work and live.

zh: 农民工仍然无法获得公共服务可能会阻止消费占GDP比重的大幅上升。
en: Migrants’ continued lack of access to public services might prevent a large rise in consumption as a share of GDP.

zh: 但是，在中国之旅中有人告诉我，中央政府不愿加快动作节奏是因为担心给地方当局增加太大的财政压力。
en: But, as I was told during my visit, the central government’s reluctance to move more quickly reflects its wariness of imposing immense fiscal pressures on local authorities.

zh: 另一个令人严重关注的领域是医疗。
en: Another area of serious concern is health care.

zh: 总有一天中央政府必须解决这一部门的缺陷。
en: At some stage, the central government will have to address the sector’s deficiencies.

zh: 在讨论抗耐药性问题是我了解到一个例子，政府对抗耐药性的反应是试图限制病人可用抗生素的剂量。
en: I learned about one example when discussing antimicrobial resistance, to which the government has responded by attempting to limit the quantity of antibiotics a patient may take.

zh: 麻烦在于许多医院和医生的收入很大一部分来自卖药，这给了他们很大的激励想办法规避规则。
en: The trouble is that many hospitals and doctors rely on drug sales for a large portion of their revenues, which creates a powerful incentive to find ways to circumvent the rules.

zh: 污染也仍然是一个严峻的挑战。
en: Pollution remains a grave challenge as well.

zh: 但同样应该注意的是2014年中国二氧化碳排放量大幅下降，这也许是第一个实在的证据证明中国正在这方面取得进步。
en: But it must also be noted that China’s carbon dioxide emissions declined notably in 2014, offering what is perhaps the first tangible evidence that the country is making some progress on this front.

zh: 能源效率和开再生能源的使用也都在增加。
en: Energy efficiency and renewable energy use are both on the rise as well.

zh: 最重要的是，尽管面临这些挑战，中国经济的巨大的重要性已获得广泛承认。
en: Most important, despite the challenges it faces, the Chinese economy’s singular importance is now widely recognized.

zh: 目前，中国的国际成就 — — 特别是它有能力确保英国、法国、德国和意大利不顾美国的反对支持其亚洲基础设施投资银行 — — 表明中国很有信心成功解决它的问题。
en: The country’s recent international achievements – particular its ability to secure the backing of the United Kingdom, France, Germany, and Italy for its Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank in the face of opposition from the United States – imply a high degree of confidence that China will address its problems successfully.

zh: 中国在现有国际金融机构中的作用也可能在今年发生改变。
en: China’s role within existing international financial institutions could change this year as well.

zh: 12月，国际货币基金组织（IMF）将考虑将人民币与美元、欧元、英镑和日元一起纳入其账户单位即所谓的特别提款权的货币篮子中。
en: In December, the International Monetary Fund will consider adding renminbi to the basket of currencies that comprise the Fund’s unit of account, known as Special Drawing Rights, alongside the US dollar, the euro, the British pound, and the Japanese yen.

zh: 而世界仍在等待美国实施IMF的2010年改革。 这项改革将加强中国和其他新兴大经济体在IMF治理结构中的地位。
en: And the world is still waiting for the US to implement a 2010 reform of the IMF that would strengthen the position of China and other large emerging economies in the institution’s governance structure.

zh: 考虑到中国经济的重要性，不解决这一问题绝不正常。
en: Given the significance of the Chinese economy, continuing to leave this unaddressed is anything but normal.

zh: 中国的下一个日程
en: China’s Next Agenda

zh: 坎布里奇—我刚刚从北京返回。 我在北京呆了一周，与中国官员会谈，还参加了中国发展论坛。
en: CAMBRIDGE – I recently returned from Beijing, where I had spent a week talking with Chinese officials and attending the China Development Forum (CDF), the major annual gathering of Chinese and senior foreign officials and top business executives.

zh: 中国发展论坛是一年一度的中国和国外高级官员和顶级企业高管会议。 中国政府刚刚发布了十三五规划，官员们急切地想解释它对中国未来的意义。
en: The Chinese government had just released its 13th Five-Year Plan, and officials were eager to explain what it means for China’s future.

zh: 尽管这一最新的规划包含一份看似无穷无尽的具体的项目和目标清单，但今年的主要新主题是“供给侧结构调整 ” ， 这个词包括了范围甚广的一系列旨在提振经济增长和生活水平的政策。
en: Although the latest plan contains a seemingly endless list of specific projects and goals, the major new theme this year is “supply-side restructuring,” a term that includes a wide range of policies aimed at boosting economic growth and living standards.

zh: “供给侧”一词意在将这些政策与传统的需求侧措施（已经将目标对准增强经济活动的宽松的货币和略微扩大的财政赤字）相区别。
en: The term “supply side” is intended to distinguish these new policies from the traditional demand-side measures of easy money and a slightly larger fiscal deficit that are already aimed at strengthening economic activity.

zh: 在供给侧政策清单上名列前茅的是消灭一些国有企业和钢铁和煤炭行业的过剩产能。
en: High on the list of supply-side policies is eliminating some of the excess capacity of state-owned firms in the steel and coal industries.

zh: 这意味着要分流四百万工人，相当于中国劳动力数量的0.5%左右。
en: This means shedding some four million workers, a number equal to about 0.5% of China’s workforce.

zh: 规划成立了一个特别基金，为失业者提供帮助。
en: The plan authorizes a special fund to provide assistance to those who remain unemployed.

zh: 专家认为还需要更大规模的裁员；但当局起步十分谨慎，以观察政策效果和监控公众反应。
en: Experts believe that much more downsizing is needed; but the authorities are starting small to see how it works and to monitor the public’s response.

zh: 中国还将让数百万人从生产率低下的农村地区流向数十个新城市，并提出了兴建50座新机场和数千英里新公路和铁路的宏伟计划。
en: China will also be shifting millions of people from low-productivity agricultural areas to dozens of new cities, accompanied by ambitious plans to build 50 new airports and thousands of miles of new roads and railroads.

zh: 当局还提出了一带一路计划，该计划将通过中国的金融援助和资源开发连接中国和亚洲、中亚乃至欧洲各部分的港口、铁路和高速公路。
en: The authorities also tout the One Belt, One Road project, which will use Chinese financial assistance and resources to develop ports, railroads, and highways linking China with other parts of Asia, central Asia, and potentially even Europe.

zh: 外交政策的目标是扩大中国在该地区内外的影响力。
en: The foreign-policy goal is to expand Chinese influence in the region and beyond.

zh: 一带一路计划还将提供出口一些中国过剩工业产能的机会。
en: It will also provide an opportunity to export some of China’s excess industrial capacity.

zh: 此外，官员意欲通过研发刺激创新，包括降低高科技企业的税率。
en: Moreover, officials intend to stimulate innovation through research and development, including by lowering tax rates for high-technology firms.

zh: 税收改革还将把中国的增值税扩大到服务业。
en: Tax reform will also extend China’s value-added tax to the service sector.

zh: 而金融改革将取消银行存贷款利率限制。
en: And financial reforms will eliminate the limits on interest rates that banks can pay on deposits and charge on loans.

zh: 与此同时，关于中国的新外汇机制存在重大认识混乱。
en: At the same time, there is substantial confusion about China’s new foreign-exchange regime.

zh: 近几年来，人民币相对美元贬值导致与中国产品竞争的美国企业怨声载道。
en: In recent years, the renminbi’s decline relative to the dollar has prompted complaints from American firms that compete with Chinese products.

zh: 但自2010年以来，人民币相对其他发达国家货币也升值了25 % 。
en: But the renminbi has also strengthened by 25% relative to other advanced-country currencies since 2010.

zh: 当局承诺让市场决定汇率，并且没有理由认为人民币会继续下跌。
en: The authorities promise to allow the market to determine the exchange rate, and that there is no reason for a sustained decline.

zh: 但官员仍然报告人民币相对美元的波动，因为他们担心强调相对于一揽子货币的汇率管理意味着兑美元进一步下跌，这一预期将增加资本外流。
en: But officials continue to report the renminbi’s movements relative to the dollar because they fear that emphasizing exchange-rate management relative to a currency basket will suggest further decline relative to the dollar, an expectation that would increase capital outflows.

zh: 改善环境的政策也是未来五年政府日程的重点。
en: Policies to improve the environment are also high on the government’s agenda for the next five years.

zh: 公众渴望获得更清洁的空气、河流和土地。
en: The public is eager for cleaner air, rivers, and land.

zh: 为了实现这一目标，政府将采取新监管措施，并创造“绿色债券”为环境修复和低碳能源资源提供融资。
en: To achieve this, the government will adopt new regulations and create “green bonds” to finance remediation and low-carbon energy sources.

zh: 中国汽车企业被鼓励制造混合动力汽车，政府也警告外国汽车公司，如果不遵守规定，将采取措施降低它们的市场份额。
en: Chinese auto firms are being encouraged to produce hybrid cars, and the government is warning foreign auto companies that it will take steps to reduce their market share if they don’t conform.

zh: 改善生活质量还需要增提高中国消费者所购买的产品的质量。
en: Improving the quality of life also requires boosting the quality of products that Chinese consumers can buy.

zh: 在中国发展论坛上，一位政府部长指出，去年一百万中国出境游客刷信用卡购买了价值大约十亿美元的国内买不到的商品（并且讽刺地指出了其中一些欧洲和美国品牌实际上为中国制造 ） 。
en: One government minister at the CDF noted that the one million Chinese tourists who went abroad last year used their credit cards to buy about $1 billion worth of goods that they cannot obtain at home (while noting the irony that some of those European and American branded goods are actually manufactured in China).

zh: 中国仍是一个低收入国家，人均GDP只有14,000美元，相当于美国的四分之一。
en: China is still a low-income country, with per capita GDP of just $14,000, about one fourth of that in the United States.

zh: 尽管北京和上海相对繁荣，但中国仍存在大量贫困。
en: Although Beijing and Shanghai are relatively prosperous, there is still much poverty.

zh: 具有启发性的是，为了实现十三五规划到2020年消灭贫困的目标，将需要让贫困人口减少5,500万人，为此，贫困线被划定在一年354美元，每天还不到1美元。
en: It is revealing that to achieve the Five-Year Plan’s goal of eliminating poverty by 2020, which requires reducing the number of poor people by 55 million, the poverty line is defined as just $354 a year, or less than one dollar a day.

zh: 中国公司债务水平高企可能成为金融动荡的来源，尽管一些官员强调他们并不担心。
en: Chinese corporations’ high level of debt could be a source of financial instability, although several officials stressed that they were not worried.

zh: 政府数据表明，银行债务与GDP之比已经两倍于美国水平。
en: Government data show that the ratio of bank loans to GDP is about twice that of the United States.

zh: 更令人担心的是，不良贷款比例之高可能已经非常危险。
en: More worrying, the share of nonperforming loans may be dangerously high.

zh: 但即使这一比例比官方数字更高，中国的坏账问题与西方也大不相同。
en: But even if that share is higher than official statistics indicate, China’s bad-debt problem is very different from that of the West.

zh: 中国最大的公司债务人是国有企业，而它们的债权人是国有银行。
en: China’s largest corporate debtors are state-owned firms, and their creditors are state-owned banks.

zh: 因此解决坏账意味着将损失从国有银行转移给政府。
en: So resolving the bad debts would involve transferring the losses from the state-owned banks to the government.

zh: 而由于政府债务相对较低 — — 约为GDP的17 % — —因此政府吸收这些损失并不困难。
en: And, because the government debt is relatively low – about 17% of GDP – it would not be difficult for the government to absorb these losses.

zh: 如有必要，政府还能处理地方政府在中央当局的鼓励下在2008和2009年增加的过多债务。
en: If necessary, it could also deal with the excess debts that local governments, encouraged by the central authorities, incurred in 2008 and 2009.

zh: 中国发展论坛没有讨论习近平主席正在采取的重拳打击高层腐败行动。 许多人说这妨碍了经济决策，降低了GDP增长。
en: What was not discussed at the CDF is the major crackdown on high-level corruption that President Xi Jinping is pursuing and that many say is impeding economic decision-making and slowing GDP growth.

zh: 论坛也没有讨论广泛存在的意识形态左倾，这可能威胁到财产权利，导致资本因为个人寻求财富安全而外流。
en: Nor was there any discussion of the widespread concern about an ideological shift to the left that could threaten property rights, leading to capital flight as individuals seek to protect their wealth.

zh: 但尽管中国依然是一个复杂的谜题，当局仍显然在追求市场改革，试图在未来五年维持6.5%或以上的真实年增长率，实现中共在2010年提出的2020年真实人均收入翻一番的目标。
en: But while China remains a complicated puzzle, the authorities are clearly pursuing pro-market reforms designed to produce real annual growth of 6.5% or more during the next five years, leading to the doubling of real per capita income by 2020 that the Chinese Communist Party called for in 2010.

zh: 如果这一目标没有实现，不能说是中国政府没有采取措施。
en: If that target is missed, it will not be for a lack of effort on the part of the Chinese government.

zh: 中国的高收入未来
en: China’s High-Income Future

zh: 伦敦 — “ 如果这是‘尽善尽美’会怎样？
en: LONDON – “What if this is ‘as good as it gets’?”

zh: ”在同名电影中，杰克·尼克尔森（Jack Nicholson）一边在心理医生的候诊室来回踱步一边问。
en: Jack Nicholson asks, as he walks through his psychiatrist’s waiting room in the eponymous film.

zh: 在最近的G-20财长上海会议上，与会者也问了相同的问题 — — 不仅仅是为萎靡的全球增长中期预期而问。
en: At the recent meeting of G-20 finance ministers in Shanghai, participants were asking much the same question – and not just with regard to medium-term expectations of weak global growth.

zh: 现在，许多人疑惑中国的当前增长率是否能够长时间“尽善尽美 ” 。
en: Many are now wondering whether China’s current growth rate will be as good as it gets for a long time to come.

zh: 研究这些担忧的合理性需要理解什么导致了中国经济减速。
en: Determining the validity of such fears requires understanding what is driving China’s economic slowdown.

zh: 一些人给出了直观的解释：中国和其他主要新兴经济体一样，落入了致命的“中等收入陷阱 ” ， 无法突破跻身发达经济。
en: Some offer a straightforward explanation: China, along with other major emerging economies, has become ensnared in the dreaded “middle-income trap,” unable to break through to advanced-economy status.

zh: 但这需要假设一些外生力量或倾向导致国家“定”在某个收入水平上 — — 这一观点被一项又一项学术研究所批驳。
en: But this assumes that some exogenous force or tendency causes countries to become “stuck” at a particular income level – a view that one academic study after another has debunked.

zh: 诚然，各国确实常常难以实现高收入。
en: To be sure, countries do often struggle to achieve high-income status.

zh: 据世界银行的数据，1960年归为中等收入的101个国家，只有13个在2008年跻身高收入行列。
en: According to the World Bank, only 13 of 101 countries classified as middle income in 1960 had reached high-income status in 2008.

zh: 此外，一些中等收入国家在经历了强劲增长后在某个人均收入水平上被“困”了几十年。
en: Moreover, some middle-income countries, after promising growth, spent decades “trapped” at a certain per capita income level.

zh: 比如，1870—1940年间，阿根廷人均收入增长堪比美国；此后两国差距逐渐拉开。
en: Argentina, for example, kept pace with the United States in per capita income growth from 1870 to 1940; since then, the gap has been widening steadily.

zh: 同理，甚至有的国家已经进入高收入行列，但有倒退到中等收入水平。
en: In this manner, even countries that make it to high-income status sometimes regress to middle-income levels.

zh: 但各国被定在某个收入水平的现象不具有历史必然性。
en: But there is no historical necessity that dictates that countries get stuck at particular levels of income.

zh: 相反，研究表明，高速增长的低收入国家也有可能成为高速增长的中等收入国家，并最终成为高收入国家。
en: On the contrary, studies suggest that fast-growing low-income economies are also likely to become fast-growing middle-income economies, and ultimately to graduate to high-income status.

zh: 如果经济被定住，那是因为它调整失败，而调整是增长变化的基础。
en: If an economy gets stuck, it is because it has failed to adjust, as the basis for growth changes.

zh: 事实上，缺乏正常地自我转型的能力的现象在低收入水平上也可以观察到。
en: And, in fact, the lack of capacity for self-transformation normally would have been visible at low-income levels, too.

zh: 那么，那些调整是必要的？
en: What, exactly, does the needed adjustment entail?

zh: 各国具体情况各不相同，但由经济学家菲利普·阿齐安（Philippe Aghion）和彼得·霍伊特（Peter Howitt）提出的注重创新的新熊彼特主义增长理论提供了了一些重要洞见。
en: While the specifics vary across countries, the innovation-focused Neo-Schumpeterian growth theory, proposed by the economists Philippe Aghion and Peter Howitt, offers some important insights.

zh: 阿齐安和霍伊特将创新定义为一切将新产品或工艺引入企业在其中经营的市场的变化。
en: Aghion and Howitt view innovation as any change that leads to the introduction of new products or processes in the market where a firm operates.

zh: 远离世界技术前沿的国家因为模仿已有技术并根据本地条件改造而获益，但假以时日，这些国家必须改善自身创新能力。
en: Countries far from the world technology frontier are better off imitating existing technologies and adapting them to local conditions, but over time such countries must improve their capacity for innovation.

zh: 研究还表明，创新和社会流动之间存在积极联系，甚至创新和收入不平等之间也是如此。
en: Studies have also shown a positive link between innovation and social mobility, and even between innovation and income inequality.

zh: 注重创新的角度的核心是以下概念：经济增长需要技术转移和新企业能够形成、成长和退出（从而将生产要素重新配置给更加成功的企业）的环境。
en: Central to the innovation-focused perspective is the notion that economic growth requires technology transfers and an environment in which new firms can form, grow, and exit (thereby reallocating factors of production to more successful firms).

zh: 管理质量显然起着重要作用，但制度和人力资本也很重要；腐败、信用约束和难以获得高质量教育都会导致经济转型更加困难。
en: Quality of management obviously plays a key role, but institutions and human capital also matter; corruption, credit constraints, and lack of access to high-quality education all make economic transformation more difficult.

zh: 但促进创新不是万灵丹。
en: But fostering innovation is not a silver bullet.

zh: 向创新者提供回报有助于更多创新，但也让商人攫取了转型过程的太大比例。
en: While providing returns to innovators can help to spur more innovation, it can also allow businesspeople to capture too large a share of the transformation process.

zh: 比如，比尔·盖茨也许对经济转型是有利的，但墨西哥电信业富豪卡洛斯·斯利姆（Carlos Slim）就不是这样。
en: For example, whereas Bill Gates has probably been good for economic transformation, the Mexican telecoms billionaire Carlos Slim has not.

zh: 鼓励前一种创新者可能导致后一种轻易崛起。
en: Encouraging one kind of innovator could easily give rise to the other.

zh: 这对中国来说意味着什么？
en: What does all this mean for China?

zh: 中国正在试图为更大的真正创新创造条件，它必须解决诸多短期挑战。
en: As the country attempts to create the conditions for greater genuine innovation, it must also address myriad short-term challenges.

zh: 它陷入了通缩螺旋，下跌的物价和对经济前景担忧的增加彼此强化。
en: It is caught in a deflationary spiral, with falling prices and increased anxiety over the economy’s prospects reinforcing each other.

zh: 而公司部门特别是制造业过度贷款导致巨大的过剩产能和越来越多的坏账，制约了增长。
en: And excessive lending to the corporate sector, particularly in manufacturing, has led to massive excess capacity and a growing mountain of bad debt, suppressing growth.

zh: 让挑战更加复杂的是，中国经济比以往任何时候都更加具有全球重要性和互联性，这意味着它所采取的任何行动都可能产生深远影响。
en: Compounding the challenge, China’s economy is more globally relevant and interconnected than ever before, which means that any action it takes can have far-reaching effects.

zh: 已经尝试并经受考验的政策在新环境下不再管用，政府需要因地制宜。
en: With tried and tested policies unlikely to work in this new context, the government is having to improvise.

zh: 此外，焦虑的市场显然认识到，这一方针可能导致政策错误。
en: And, as anxious markets clearly recognize, that approach carries the potential for policy mistakes.

zh: 尽管如此，有很好的理由认为中国能够成功，因为中国经济史表明它具有令人印象深刻的转型能力。
en: Nonetheless, there is good reason to believe that China can succeed, given that the country’s economic history indicates an impressive capacity for transformation.

zh: 当然，自1978年邓小平启动改革开放政策以来，中国经济已经取得了长足的进步。
en: Of course, China’s economy has come a long way since Deng Xiaoping initiated the policy of reform and opening up in 1978.

zh: 但是，即使在最近几年，中国产出中的技能内容也得到了大幅改善，资源也成功地从农业转移到服务业而不是大型国有企业仍在许多行业占主导地位的制造业。
en: But even in more recent years, the skill content in China’s output has improved radically, and resources have been successfully transferred from agriculture to the services sector, rather than to the manufacturing sector, where large state-owned firms still dominate many industries.

zh: 如果最近批驳中等收入陷阱的研究是正确的，那么中国 — — 历史上最不可思议的增长故事之一 — — 很有希望带着同样的力道成功进入高收入行列。
en: If the recent research debunking the middle-income trap is correct, China – one of history’s most miraculous growth stories – has a very good chance of succeeding in the transition to high-income status with similar vigor.

zh: 近几年来中国所出现的基础结构变化更加强了这一乐观。
en: The underlying structural changes that have occurred in China in recent years reinforce this optimism.

zh: 中国需要继续改革和克服既得利益，特别是在国有部门，但它成功的机会仍然很高。
en: China will need to continue reforms and overcome vested interests, particularly in the state-owned sector, but its chances of success remain high.

zh: 一国一制
en: One Country, One System

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 7月1日是在“一国两制”模式下，英国向中国交还香港20周年纪念日。
