en: STOCKHOLM – July 1 marks the 20th anniversary of the United Kingdom’s handover of Hong Kong to China, under a model called “one country, two systems.”

zh: 但一个无法回避的问题笼罩着官方纪念活动：香港回归是否真的值得庆祝？
en: But an unavoidable question will hang over the official commemorations: Is there really anything to celebrate?

zh: 如果你询问一国两制模式的设计师邓小平香港回归20周年纪念日应当是什么样子，他可能会说香港居民会为了繁荣和自由而举杯庆贺。
en: If you had asked Deng Xiaoping, the architect of the “one country, two systems” model, what the handover’s 20th anniversary would look like, he might have said that Hong Kong’s residents would be toasting to their prosperity and liberty.

zh: 中国领导人将表现出他们的信誉和执政能力，并最终让那些曾经质疑中国共产党及其对香港承诺诚意的唱反调者闭上嘴巴。
en: China’s leaders, for their part, would be showcasing their credibility and governing capacity, finally quieting the chorus of naysayers who had doubted the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) and the sincerity of its promises to Hong Kong.

zh: 但现实却是截然不同的。
en: But the reality is very different.

zh: 今天，1997年在香港曾经不可思议的场景 — — 大规模反华游行、反共激进分子被选进立法会、公开呼吁独立 — — 已经变得屡见不鲜。
en: Today, scenes that would have been unthinkable in Hong Kong in 1997 – mass anti-China demonstrations, the election of anti-CCP radicals to the city’s legislature, open calls for independence – have become routine.

zh: 可以肯定，1997年来，香港一直承受着包括中国崛起、全球化、高度不平等以及房价飞涨等巨大经济力量的冲击，在损害这座城市竞争力的同时加重了社会的不满情绪。
en: To be sure, powerful economic forces – including China’s rise, globalization, high inequality, and soaring property prices – have buffeted Hong Kong since 1997, undermining the city’s competitiveness and contributing to social discontent.

zh: 但尽管不利的社会经济因素加剧了民众的失望，但已经成为香港生活现实的大规模抗议活动从本质上说是以香港民众权利为核心的政治抗议。
en: But, while adverse socioeconomic factors have exacerbated popular frustration, the mass protests that have become a fact of life in the city are quintessentially political protests centered on the rights of Hong Kong’s people.

zh: 在这样的背景下，恐怕没有多少人会说“一国两制”取得了成功。
en: Against this background, few would call “one country, two systems” a success.

zh: 事实上，这种模式可能从一开始就注定逃脱不了失败的命运，因为有几个致命缺陷存在于这种模式的结构当中。
en: In fact, the model was probably doomed from the start, owing to several fatal flaws that are embedded in its structure.

zh: 首先，中国尊重香港民众民主权利的承诺故意含糊不清。
en: For starters, the language committing China to respect the democratic rights of the people of Hong Kong was deliberately vague.

zh: 即使是为1997年移交奠定基础的英中两国政府于1984年签署的联合声明也仅仅提供了某种不严谨的承诺，即特首将由中国方面“以当地进行的选举或协商结果为基础”进行任命。
en: Even the joint declaration signed by the British and Chinese governments in 1984, which set the stage for the 1997 handover, offered the somewhat imprecise promise that the chief executive would be appointed by China “on the basis of the results of elections or consultations to be held locally.”

zh: 不仅如此，有权执行联合声明条款、更不要说香港称之为基本法的迷你宪法的唯一一方是北京中央政府。
en: Moreover, the only party with the power to enforce the terms of the joint declaration, not to mention Hong Kong’s mini-constitution known as the Basic Law, is the central government in Beijing.

zh: 结果是中国领导人可以在不受惩罚的情况下不履行承诺精神甚至哪怕是其中的明确规定。
en: As a result, China’s leaders could fail to honor the spirit or even the explicit terms of their commitments with impunity.

zh: 香港民众，尤其是年轻人，目前的激进态势反应了改变现状的愿望，他们希望中方为不履行“自治”承诺和用镇压来回应不同意见付出代价。
en: The current radicalization of Hong Kong citizens, particularly its young people, reflects a desire to change that, and make China pay a price for reneging on its promise of “self-rule” and responding to dissent with repression.

zh: “一国两制”注定难以成功还因为另外一个特点，那就是中国利用裙带资本家来统治香港的有意决策。
en: There is one more feature of the “one-country, two systems” scheme that has doomed it: China’s deliberate decision to rule Hong Kong through crony capitalists.

zh: 虽然颇具讽刺意味，但中国所谓共产党显然更相信香港的巨头而不是群众（也许因为收买巨头的成本要低得多 ） 。
en: As ironic as it may sound, China’s so-called communists apparently trust Hong Kong’s tycoons more than its masses (perhaps because buying off tycoons costs a lot less).

zh: 但因为忠诚于北京的支持者而不是他们所管理的这座城市的民众，香港的裙带资本家作为政治家根本不合格。
en: But, because their loyalty lies with their backers in Beijing, not the people of the city they administer, Hong Kong’s crony capitalists are bad politicians.

zh: 在共产党治下，他们取得了英国治下无法实现的特权和权力。
en: Under the CCP, they have gained power and privileges that were unattainable under British rule.

zh: 但这也导致他们对选民的要求反应日益迟钝，并且越来越疏远他们的支持者。
en: But that has made them unresponsive to their constituency as it becomes increasingly alienated from their patrons.

zh: 结果导致中国代理人在争取民众合法性方面已经彻底失败了。
en: As a result, China’s proxies have failed spectacularly at securing popular legitimacy.

zh: 以中国执政者亲自挑选管理这座城市的香港特首们为例。
en: Consider the fate of Hong Kong’s chief executives, hand-picked by China’s rulers to run the city.

zh: 首任特首董建华于2003年面对50万人的抗议；2005年，在第二任任期过半的时候，对他不断增长的民众不满迫使他辞职。
en: The first, Tung Chee-hwa, faced a half-million protesters in 2003; in 2005, halfway through his second term, his ever-growing unpopularity drove him to resign.

zh: 董的继任者曾荫权勉强完成了两任任期，却在卸任后因腐败罪名（和他的2号人物一同）被判入狱。
en: Tung’s successor, Donald Tsang, completed his two terms, but just barely, and he was jailed for corruption (along with his number two) after leaving office.

zh: 其后上台的梁振英简直是场灾难，以至于中国执政者在第一个任期完成后就被迫解雇他。
en: Leung Chun-ying, who came next, was such a disaster that China’s rulers had to cashier him after just one term.

zh: 当然 ， “ 一国两制”模式并不是彻头彻尾的灾难。
en: Of course, the “one country, two systems” approach has not been an unmitigated disaster.

zh: 鉴于香港和大陆间巨大的文化经济和制度差异，情况甚至可能比现在更糟。
en: Given the vast cultural, economic, and institutional gaps between Hong Kong and the mainland, things could have been much worse.

zh: 但这并不意味着一国两制是可以持续的模式。
en: But that does not make it a sustainable model.

zh: 事实上，这种模式可能已经走到了尽头。
en: In fact, it may well already be dead.

zh: 在他们的心目中，中国领导人一直试图引导香港走上“一国一制”的道路。
en: In the back of their minds, China’s leaders have always sought to move toward a “one country, one system” model for Hong Kong.

zh: 邓认为这样的过渡可能需要50年，但他的继任者只花了20年，而且他们甚至对此都没有完全意识到。
en: Deng thought that such a transition would take 50 years, but it took his successors only 20, and they didn’t even fully realize it was happening.

zh: 无论中国政府从现在到2047年采取什么样的政策，他们的目标将是让未来 — — 尤其是政治权利的缺失 — — 和现在越来越相像。
en: Whatever policies Chinese authorities pursue in Hong Kong between now and 2047, the goal will be to make the present – particularly the absence of political rights – look more and more like the future.

zh: 中国真能取代美国的经济霸权吗？
en: Will China Really Supplant US Economic Hegemony?

zh: 坎布里奇—中国和美国正在进行最新一轮贸易纠葛，大部分经济学家理所当然地认为，从长期看中国将实现全球经济支配，不管现在的情况怎样。
en: CAMBRIDGE – As China and the United States engage in their latest trade tussle, most economists take it as given that China will achieve global economic supremacy in the long run, no matter what happens now.

zh: 毕竟，中国人口是美国的四倍，在经历了几个世纪的技术停滞后痛下决心要实现赶超，因此，中国决定性地接过经济霸权的大王旗是不可避免的吗？
en: After all, with four times as many people as the US, and a determined program to catch up after centuries of technological stagnation, isn’t it inevitable that China will decisively take over the mantle of economic hegemon?

zh: 我没有那么确定，许多经济学家，包括很多将中国庞大的劳动力视为决定性优势的经济学家，同时也担心机器人和人工智能最终将接管大部分岗位，而大部分人类将把时间用在休闲活动上。
en: I am not so sure. Many economists, including many of the same experts who see China’s huge labor force as a decisive advantage, also worry that robots and artificial intelligence will eventually take away most jobs, leaving most humans to while away their time engaged in leisure activities.

zh: 到底会怎样？
en: Which is it?

zh: 一百年后谁会接管？ 中国工人还是机器人？
en: Over the next 100 years, who takes over, Chinese workers or the robots?

zh: 如果机器人和人工智能成为下个世纪生产的主要推动力，也许有太多人口需要照顾 — — 特别是同时还需要通过限制互联网和信息渠道来实现控制 — — 对中国更多地是一个阻碍因素。
en: If robots and AI are the dominant drivers of production in the coming century, perhaps having too large a population to care for – especially one that needs to be controlled through limits on Internet and information access – will turn out to be more of a hindrance for China.

zh: 中国人口的迅速老龄化则加剧了这一挑战。
en: The rapid aging of China’s population exacerbates the challenge.

zh: 随着机器人和人工智能重要性的日渐增加遏制了中国的制造优势，在技术方面实现领先就变得更加重要。
en: As the rising importance of robotics and AI blunts China’s manufacturing edge, the ability to lead in technology will become more important.

zh: 在这方面，当前的趋势是权力和控制日益向中央政府而非私人部门集中，这有可能在全球经济进入更高发展阶段时对中国起到妨碍作用。
en: Here, the current trend toward higher concentration of power and control in the central government, as opposed to the private sector, could hamstring China as the global economy reaches higher stages of development.

zh: 中国也许永远无法取代美国成为世界经济霸权，这一可能性是技术和不平等问题的另一面。
en: The possibility that China might never supplant the US as the world’s economic hegemon is the flip side of the technology and inequality problem.

zh: 西方人人担心工作的未来，但从很多方面看，这对于中国而非美国发展模式来说问题更大。
en: Everyone in the West is worrying about the future of work, but in many ways it is a bigger problem for the Chinese development model than for the American one.

zh: 美国需要竭尽全力解决如何在内部进行收入再分配的问题，特别是在新概念和新技术所有权高度集中的情况下。
en: The US needs to struggle with the problem of how to redistribute income internally, especially given highly concentrated ownership of new ideas and technology.

zh: 但对中国来说，还有一个如何在机器时代保持其出口超级大国地位的问题。
en: But for China, there is the additional problem of how to extend its franchise as export superpower into the machine age.

zh: 诚然，美国总统特朗普的夸夸其谈和虚张声势几乎不可能让制造业岗位大量回流美国。
en: True, it is highly unlikely that President Donald Trump’s huffing and puffing and bluffing will bring about a large-scale return of manufacturing jobs to the US.

zh: 但美国有潜力扩大其制造业基础规模 — — 用产出而不是就业岗位衡量。
en: But the US has the potential to expand the size of its manufacturing base anyway, in terms of output if not jobs.

zh: 毕竟，今天的高科技车间只需要很少的工人就能生产出更多的东西。
en: After all, today’s high-tech factory floors produce far more with far fewer workers.

zh: 机器人和人工智能不但出现在制造业和无人驾驶汽车中。
en: And the robots and AI are coming not just in manufacturing and driverless cars.

zh: 机器医生、机器财务顾问、机器律师都只是机器颠覆服务业岗位的冰山一角。
en: Robo-doctors, robo-financial advisors, and robo-lawyers are just the tip of the iceberg in machine disruption of service-sector jobs.

zh: 平心而论，中国的崛起绝不是海市蜃楼，其巨大的成功也并非只是基于人口规模。
en: To be sure, China’s rise is hardly a mirage, and its heady success is not built on population size alone.

zh: 印度人口与中国相近（均为13亿左右 ） ， 但至少现在还远远落后于中国。
en: India has a similar population (both around 1.3 billion people), but for now, at least, it trails far behind.

zh: 中国领导层让数亿人摆脱贫困、进入中产阶级，巨大的功劳不容抹杀。
en: Chinese leadership must be credited with doing a miraculous job of lifting hundreds of millions of people out of poverty and into the middle class.

zh: 但中国的高速增长主要受技术赶超和投资的推动。
en: But China’s rapid growth has been driven mostly by technology catch-up and investment.

zh: 而尽管相较苏联中国表现出远远更强的本土创新能力 — — 中国公司已经在下一代5G移动网络上成为领导者 — — 其网络战能力也完全与美国旗鼓相当，但接近前沿与定义前沿完全是两回事。
en: And while China, unlike the Soviet Union, has shown vastly more competence in homegrown innovation – Chinese companies are already leading the way in the next generation of 5G mobile networks – and its cyber-warfare capacity is fully on par with the US, keeping close to the cutting edge is not the same thing as defining it.

zh: 中国的收益仍主要来自采纳西方的技术，在一些情形中，还需要挪用知识产权。
en: China’s gains still come largely from adoption of Western technology, and in some cases, appropriation of intellectual property.

zh: 特朗普绝非第一位抱怨中国滥用知识产权的美国总统，他的抱怨也是正确的（尽管发动贸易战绝非解决方案 ） 。
en: Trump is hardly the first American president to complain on this score, and he is right to do so (though starting a trade war cannot be the solution).

zh: 在二十一世纪的经济中，其他因素 — — 包括法治和获得能源、适耕土地和清洁水的便利性 — — 也有可能变得越来越重要。
en: In the economy of the twenty-first century, other factors, including rule of law, as well as access to energy, arable land, and clean water may also become increasingly important.

zh: 中国正在走自己的路，仍有待证明集中化的制度能够比任何人所想象的更快更深地推动发展，远不止于成为一个增长的中等收入国家。
en: China is following its own path and may yet prove that centralized systems can push development further and faster than anyone had imagined, far beyond simply being a growing middle-income country.

zh: 但中国的全球主导地位绝不像许多专家所认为的那样已是板上钉钉。
en: But China’s global dominance is hardly the predetermined certainty that so many experts seem to assume.

zh: 诚然，美国也面临着巨大的挑战。
en: Yes, the US faces vast challenges as well.

zh: 比如，它必须设法在保持有活力的技术增长的同时阻止财富和权力的过度集中。
en: For example, it must devise a way to retain dynamic technological growth while preventing excessive concentration of wealth and power.

zh: 但成为霸权并不要求一定得是全球最大经济体 — — 否则的话英国也永远无法统治世界大部长达一个多世纪之久。
en: To be a hegemon, however, does not require being the world’s largest country – otherwise, England would never have ruled much of the world as it did for more than a century.

zh: 美国失数字未来之鹿，中国固可逐之，但它无法仅仅因为人口更多而成为全球主宰者。
en: China might lead the digital future if the US drops the ball, but it won’t become the dominant global power simply because it has a larger population.

zh: 相反，即将到来的机器时代可能将是霸权之争的局面改变因素。
en: On the contrary, the coming machine age could be a game changer in the battle for hegemony.

zh: 中国错觉
en: The China Delusion

zh: 纽约—中国对其汇率盯住机制的管理仍在影响全球金融市场。
en: NEW YORK – China’s management of its exchange-rate peg continues to rattle global financial markets.

zh: 关于人民币贬值的持续不确定性正在助长恐慌 — — 通缩压力将席卷新兴市场，并严重打击利率已经达到或接近零水平（因此无法继续下降对抗输入性通缩）的发达经济体
en: Ongoing uncertainty about renminbi devaluation is fueling fears that deflationary forces will sweep through emerging markets and deliver a body blow to developed economies, where interest rates are at or near zero (and thus cannot be lowered to defend against imported deflation). Fiscal gridlock in both Europe and the United States is heightening the angst.

zh: 但最近的汇率焦虑其实是另一个事实的症候：中国增长战略从出口拉动型转向内需推动型的过程远远不像人们希望的那样平稳。
en: But the current bout of exchange-rate anxiety is really just a symptom of the fact that China’s transition from an export-led growth strategy to one propelled by domestic consumption is proceeding far less smoothly than hoped.

zh: 对一些人来说，中国特色资本主义的美好前景仍然没有褪色。
en: For some people, visions of the wonders of capitalism with Chinese characteristics remain undiminished.

zh: 他们笃定地认为，在经历了三十多年国家引导的增长后，现在中国领导人知道如何扭转低迷的经济。
en: They are certain that, after more than three decades of state-directed growth, China’s leaders know what to do to turn their slumping economy around.

zh: 这些乐观派的幻想受到了供给派的挑战。 供给派认为应该对中国低迷的国有部门采取休克疗法，并立即将中国尚不发达的资本市场融入如今动荡不已的全球金融体系。
en: The optimists’ unreality is rivaled by that of supply-siders, who would apply shock therapy to China’s slumping state sector and immediately integrate the country’s underdeveloped capital markets into today’s turbulent global financial system.

zh: 这是一个极其危险的药方。
en: That is a profoundly dangerous prescription.

zh: 转变中国的市场力量不可能产生自一个停滞的经济中，如果经济停滞，这些措施将加剧通缩压力，导致灾难。
en: The power of the market to transform China will not be unleashed in a stagnant economy, where such measures would aggravate deflationary forces and produce a calamity.

zh: 人民所承受的持续贬值压力反映出人们越来越担心中国决策者对他们所面临的困境一筹莫展。
en: The persistent downward pressure on the renminbi reflects a growing fear that Chinese policymakers have no coherent solution to the dilemmas they face.

zh: 比如，让人民币浮动是一个危险的选项。
en: Floating the renminbi, for example, is a dangerous option.

zh: 毕竟，中国经济仍在经历总体经济转型，估算能够锚定投机的长期均衡利率几乎是不可能的，特别是在人们一直在怀疑数据质量、披露和决策过程不透明的情况下。
en: After all, with the Chinese economy undergoing wholesale economic transformation, estimating a long-term equilibrium exchange rate that will anchor speculation is virtually impossible, particularly given persistent doubts about data quality, disclosure, and opaque policymaking processes.

zh: 但如果当前盯住一揽子货币的汇率机制无法锚定人民币、防止急剧贬值的话，给世界所造成的通缩性后果将非常严重。
en: But if the current exchange-rate peg to a basket of currencies fails to anchor the renminbi and prevent sharp depreciation, the deflationary consequences for the world economy will be profound.

zh: 此外，这些影响将反馈在中国的出口部门，从而制约货币贬值的刺激性效应。
en: Moreover, they will feed back on the Chinese export sector, thus dampening the stimulative impact of a weakened currency.

zh: 稳定汇率的关键在于制定可信的发展政策。
en: The key to stabilizing the exchange rate lies in creating a credible development policy.

zh: 惟其如此，对人民币的压力，以及对中国外汇储备的压力才会有所减少，因为国内外投资者将能够看清楚未来情况。
en: Only then will the pressure on the renminbi, and on China’s foreign-exchange reserves, subside, because investors both within and outside the country will see a clear way forward.

zh: 树立政策信誉需要减少国家控制和担保所带来的混乱的微观经济激励。
en: Establishing policy credibility will require diminishing the muddled microeconomic incentives of state control and guarantees.

zh: 此外，还需要通过财政政策支持将成为新增长模式基石的新兴经济部门，从而重振总需求。
en: It will also require reinvigorating aggregate demand by targeting fiscal policy to support the emerging economic sectors that will underpin the new growth model.

zh: 但是，和中国的往常情况一样，这套战略充满着矛盾。
en: But, as usual with China, such a strategy is riddled with contradictions.

zh: 比如，缩小国有企业的规模是必要条件，但在需求已经十分疲软的情况下，这样做必然将进一步抑制总需求。
en: For example, reducing the size of the state-enterprise sector is necessary, yet would be certain to depress aggregate demand at a time when demand is already soft.

zh: 类似地，削减（通过政府指定银行贷款的）对僵尸企业的财政支持能够释放财政能力，让资源能够会被引导进入有利于服务业和城市就业的新部门；但这也将加剧 — — 至少在一开始是如此 — — 眼下的需求短缺。
en: Likewise, cutting fiscal support (via government-directed bank lending) to zombie firms would free up fiscal capacity and enable resources to be redirected to new sectors that facilitate services and urban employment; but this would exacerbate – at least at first – today’s demand shortfall.

zh: 大刀阔斧地削减国有部门、期待通过紧缩实现转型绝不是可行的道路。
en: Slashing the state sector abruptly and expecting to achieve transformation through austerity is not the way forward.

zh: 经济历史学家，特别是迈克尔·伯恩斯坦（Michael A. Bernstein）在其对美国大萧条的 研究中，令人信服地指出，转型中的经济需要强大的总需求让资源流入新部门。
en: Economic historians, notably Michael A. Bernstein in his study of the Great Depression in the United States, have convincingly shown that an economy in transition requires strong aggregate demand to pull resources into new sectors.

zh: 如果经济体的新旧部门都萎靡不振，资本形成将会熄火，升级人力资本的投资将会收缩，结构调整也将会停顿。
en: If both the old and new sectors of an economy are in a slump, capital formation will sputter, investment in upgrading human capital will decline, and structural adjustment will stall.

zh: 强大的总需求永远是成功转型的关键。
en: Robust aggregate demand is always essential to successful transformation.

zh: 对中国的经济转型来说，另一个同样巨大的障碍 — — 人们甚至不敢指名道姓地说出它的名字 — — 是对中国混合市场经济的普遍崇拜。
en: An equally large obstacle to China’s economic transition – the problem that almost dare not speak its name – is the widespread worship of China’s hybrid market economy.

zh: 简言之，眼下模糊的市场激励有利于国有企业，因此不利于转型。
en: Simply put, today’s muddled market incentives impede transformation by favoring state-owned enterprises.

zh: 2012年初，中国领导层开始推动更强大的私人所有权，股市的民营企业细分指数表现要好于国有企业细分指数，在上海和香港都是如此。
en: In early 2012, when the Chinese leadership moved toward stronger private ownership, stocks in the private-sector sub-index outperformed the state-owned sector sub-index on both the Shanghai and Hong Kong stock exchanges.

zh: 但自2014年春以来，这一趋势出现了逆转，国有企业细分指数表现好于民营企业细分指数。
en: But since the spring of 2014, this trend has reversed, and the state-owned sector sub-index has outperformed the private-sector sub-index.

zh: 随着中国经济的减速和违约风险的增加，国家担保的价值也水涨船高，让资本进一步远离民营部门增长。
en: As the Chinese economy slows and default risk grows, the value of state guarantees rises, directing capital away from private-sector growth.

zh: 这一混合制度显然导致信用分配不利于推动发展，同时也产生并维持着反对改革的既得利益。
en: This hybrid system clearly impedes credit allocation from catalyzing development, while creating and sustaining vested interests opposed to reform.

zh: 这一既定模式为害尤甚，因为深刻的转型显然需要依靠来自可靠的主权债券市场的融资，而如果关于政府或有负债 — — 一切隐性担保 — — 的不确定性得不到解决，主权债券市场就无法合理地起作用。
en: This holding pattern is particularly harmful because profound transformation will surely depend on financing from a sound sovereign bond market, which cannot function properly until uncertainty related to the government’s contingent liabilities – all those implicit guarantees – has been resolved.

zh: 中国拥有通过可信改革稳定汇率的能力，特别是重新引导资源提振内需、让资源流向更新的高价值部门的政策。
en: China has it within its power to stabilize its exchange rate via credible reforms, particularly policies that redirect resources to invigorate domestic demand and pull resources toward the newer high-value sectors.

zh: 中国所需要的改革无法在经济低迷中完成，也无法通过大规模汇率贬值完成。 大规模汇率贬值将让中国退回出口拉动型增长时代，而西方需求的停滞意味着这根本不可行，只能徒劳地让世界陷入通缩。
en: The reforms China needs cannot be accomplished in a slump, or by a large exchange-rate depreciation that deflates the world in a vain effort to turn back the clock to an era of export-led growth that stagnant demand in the West has rendered nonviable.

zh: 推动进口为何会提升中国的贸易顺差？
en: Why Import Promotion Could Increase China’s Trade Surplus

zh: 发自纽约 — — 各国经常会动用公共资金去推动本国商品和服务的出口。
en: NEW YORK – Countries often devote public funds to promoting exports of their own goods and services.

zh: 但是投入资源去促进进口 — — 正如刚刚在上海召开的首届中国国际进口博览会所做的那样 — — 却是相当罕见。
en: But devoting resources to promote imports – as China is doing with its inaugural International Import Expo, which just opened in Shanghai – is truly rare.

zh: 作为中国整体进口推动战略的一部分，计划每年举办一届的进口博览会吸引了全球数千家企业前来争取中国企业（包括接受政府指令要确保世博会圆满成功的众多国有企业）的大订单。
en: The annual Import Expo, which will be part of China’s overall import promotion strategy, has attracted thousands of companies worldwide with the promise of large orders from Chinese firms, including the state-owned enterprises that the government has tasked with making the expo a success.

zh: 在人们的认识中，如果世博会能增加进口，那么或许也能帮助降低中国的贸易顺差。
en: If the expo succeeds in raising imports, one might expect it to reduce China’s trade surplus.

zh: 但事实并非如此。
en: But that need not be the case.

zh: 中国是一个劳动力丰富的国家，不仅在人口绝对数量方面是这样，而且在资本和其他资源方面也是如此。
en: China is a labor-abundant country, not only in terms of the absolute number of people, but also in relation to capital and other resources.

zh: 虽然相对均衡态势一直有所变化，但中国的平均劳动力成本仍然相当于世界平均水平的85％左右。
en: Though the relative balance has been evolving, China’s average labor cost still stands at about 85% of the world average.

zh: 一旦中国降低进口壁垒，资本密集型产品将占到进口增量的很大一部分，进而取代国内生产的资本密集型产品。
en: If China lowers import barriers, capital-intensive goods will comprise a substantial share of the added imports, which will displace domestically produced capital-intensive goods.

zh: 为此之前用于生产这类产品的银行贷款、劳动力，土地和其他资源都需要进行重新部署，而且最可能流向那些中国具有真正比较优势的部门，包括出口制造业。
en: The bank loans, labor, land, and other resources that were previously deployed to produce those goods will need to be redeployed, most likely to sectors where China has a true comparative advantage, including export manufacturing.

zh: 因此中国的整体出口可能会随着进口增加而增加。
en: As a result, China’s overall exports would probably increase alongside its imports.

zh: 换句话说，旨在促进进口的政策也最终也可能促进了出口。
en: In other words, policies aimed at promoting imports will likely end up promoting exports as well.

zh: 而我与鞠建东和施康合作进行的研究表明这一影响要比上述推理所展现的更大：当一个劳动力相对丰富的国家减少进口壁垒时，出口实际上比进口增加更多。
en: Research I conducted with Jiandong Ju and Kang Shi suggests something even stronger than this: when a relatively labor-abundant country reduces import barriers, exports actually grow more than imports.

zh: 额外进口的资本密集型商品有效地扩大了该国的资本池，降低了本地的资本回报，也为企业和家庭创造了向国外输出更多资金的激励因素，而实现更大的贸易顺差则是实现这一目标的手段。
en: The additional imports of capital-intensive goods effectively expand the pool of capital in the country, reducing the domestic returns on capital. This creates an incentive for firms and households to send more capital abroad, and running a bigger trade surplus is the way to accomplish this.

zh: 这听起来可能有点违反直觉。
en: This may sound counter-intuitive.

zh: 事实上，在美国这类资本充裕的国家，更多的进口（主要为劳动密集型产品）会提高资本回报率，从而推动国际资本流入该国。
en: And, indeed, in a more capital-abundant country like the United States, more imports (of mostly labor-intensive products) would raise the returns on capital, creating an incentive for international capital to flow to the country.

zh: 在这种情况下更多的进口则与更大规模的贸易逆差相关联。
en: In this case, more imports are associated with a bigger trade deficit.

zh: 如果人们只习惯于思考相对富裕国家的经验，那么或许就不会意识到同样的进口增长却可能在发展中国家和发达国家身上产生相反的贸易平衡动态。
en: If one is accustomed to thinking about the experience of relatively rich countries, one might not realize that the same rise in imports could lead to opposite movements in trade balances between developing and developed countries.

zh: 中国过去的经历就是一个很好的例子。
en: China’s past experience is a good illustration.

zh: 2001年加入世界贸易组织后中国被要求大幅放宽其进口管制，于是该国将平均进口关税税率从1990年代后期的15％降至2006年的约5％并减少了许多非关税进口壁垒，例如对哪些公司可以合法从事国际贸易的限制。
en: Accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001 required China to liberalize its import regime substantially. The country cut its average import tariff rate from 15% in the late 1990s to about 5% by 2006, and reduced many non-tariff import barriers, such as restrictions on which firms could legally engage in international trade.

zh: 结果中国的进口量飙升，以美元计每年增长超过15 ％ — —甚至高于2001~2007年的GDP增长率，而在此期间其贸易顺差也大幅增加。
en: As a result, China’s imports soared, growing by more than 15% annually in USD terms – faster than GDP from 2001 to 2007. But its trade surplus also expanded dramatically during this period.

zh: 虽然外界往往将较高的贸易顺差归咎于实际汇率的低估，但我们的研究表明中国的进口自由化也可能是一个重要因素。
en: While the higher trade surplus is often blamed on an undervalued real exchange rate, our research suggests that China’s import liberalization program could be a significant factor, too.

zh: 同样，尽管2007年之后中国贸易顺差的减少通常被认为是全球金融危机的后果，但我们的研究表明中国多阶段进口自由化进程的结束可能也起到了作用。
en: Likewise, though the decrease in China’s trade surplus after 2007 is usually regarded as resulting from the global financial crisis, our research suggests that the end of China’s multiple-phase import-liberalization program may also have played a role.

zh: 值得注意的是，即使整体顺差增加，中国仍可以减少对任意特定合作伙伴的双边贸易顺差。
en: It is important to note that China can still reduce the bilateral trade surplus against any particular partner, even if its overall surplus rises.

zh: 而即使进口博览会实际上扩大而非减少了该国的整体贸易顺差，它也可能带来其他好处。
en: And even if the Import Expo expands, rather than reduces, the country’s overall trade surplus, it may well have other benefits.

zh: 首先，降低进口成本将提高中国家庭的购买力以及获取改善生活质量产品的能力。
en: For starters, lowering the cost of imports will increase Chinese households’ purchasing power and their access to products that can improve their quality of life.

zh: 同时中国企业也将受益于外国制造零部件和设备的低成本，这将提高其全球竞争力 — — 这也是另一条减少进口壁垒可以最终促进出口的渠道。
en: Chinese firms, too, will benefit from lower costs for foreign-made parts and equipment, which will boost their global competitiveness – another channel through which lower import barriers can end up boosting exports.

zh: 最后，国际进口博览会将成为中国其他开放市场措施（包括降低外国金融公司的准入门槛）的补充。
en: Finally, the International Import Expo will complement China’s other measures to liberalize its market, including lower entry barriers for foreign financial firms.

zh: 中国拥有一个其他国家都渴望进入的庞大增长型市场，无论其进口促进措施对该国整体贸易顺差的影响如何，全世界都有充分的理由去欢迎国际进口博览会等相关倡议。
en: China has a massive and growing market to which other countries want access. Whatever the impact of its import-promotion measures on the country’s overall trade surplus, the world has good reason to welcome initiatives like the International Import Expo.

zh: 走向全球的中国公司
en: China, Inc. Goes Global

zh: 纽约 — — 中国经济正在迈出又一大步：其制造部门的一部分正在朝增值链的高端转移，并在走出国门。 中国挑战如今已成为全球挑战。
en: NEW YORK – China’s economy is now taking its next great leap forward: parts of its manufacturing sector are now moving up the value-added chain and out of the country.  The China challenge is now a global one.

zh: 个中原因不难看穿。
en: The reasons are not difficult to fathom.

zh: 中国沿海省份（该国大部分制造和服务产品的生产和外国直接投资坐落于此）的生产成本（工资、租金、土地、资本等）已出现快速上升。
en: Production costs (wages, office rents, land, capital, etc.) in China’s coastal provinces – where most of the country’s manufacturing and service production, as well as foreign direct investment, are located – have been rising fast.

zh: 去年一年，12个沿海省份（包括北京）的最低工资平均上升了21 % 。
en: Since last year alone, minimum wages in nine of twelve coastal provinces (including Beijing) rose by an average of more than 21%.

zh: 与此同时，人民币也在升值，这使得国内出口导向产品和服务的生产变得更贵了。
en: At the same time, the renminbi is appreciating, making domestic production of export-oriented goods and services even more expensive.

zh: 这绝非小事，特别是对于劳动密集型活动（从玩具制造到数据输入服务）来说尤其如此，不管是外国跨国公司（占中国出口的二分之一强）分公司还是国内公司，都在失去国际市场上的竞争力。
en: This matters, especially for labor-intensive activities (ranging from toy manufacturing to data-entry services), whether by affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises (which account for more than half of China’s exports) or by local firms, which are losing competitiveness in international markets.

zh: 为了维持其出口导向生产基础，产出必须向增值链上端转移，转向更精致成熟的产品。
en: To maintain its export-oriented production base, output must move up the value-added chain, toward more sophisticated products.

zh: 跨国公司可以在其一体化的全球生产网络中做到这一点 — — 其生产网络使其能够组织起公司内部的国际劳动分工。
en: Multinational enterprises can do that within their integrated global production networks, which allow them to organize an international intra-firm division of labor.

zh: 其生产链的任何部分都可以部署在最有利于公司国际竞争力的地区。
en: Any part of these production chains can be located wherever it suits the firms’ international competitiveness best.

zh: 此外，这类公司拥有在全球寻找正确投资地的经验。
en: And such firms have the experience to scout the globe for the right investment locations.

zh: 中国国内公司也必须面对这一压力。
en: Domestic Chinese firms, too, need to respond to these pressures.

zh: 这方面，中国迅速深化的技能和技术帮了大忙。
en: They are helped in this effort by the rapid deepening of China’s skills and technology base.

zh: 这部分地反映了外国子公司的培训成果，但主要原因还是中国政府在不懈地推进教育和培训，鼓励从外国公司向国内公司的技术转移，特别是培育自身的研发实力。
en: This partly reflects training in foreign affiliates, but the main reason has been the Chinese government’s sustained effort to foster education and training, encourage technology transfers from foreign to domestic firms, and, in particular, to build up research and development capabilities.

zh: 简言之，生产更成熟商品和服务的发达和新兴市场国家生产者需要做好面临与日俱增的来自中国的竞争的准备。
en: In short, producers of more sophisticated goods and services in developed and emerging-market countries need to be prepared for growing competition from China.

zh: 与此同时，中国的劳动密集型生产将迅速地向劳动成本更低的国家转移，包括孟加拉国、印度、印尼、相邻的越南（在越南，中国公司已经设立了大约1000家子公司）以及众多非洲国家。
en: At the same time, China’s labor-intensive production will increasingly move to countries with lower labor costs – including Bangladesh, India, Indonesia, and neighboring Vietnam (where Chinese firms have already established about 1,000 affiliates), as well as various African countries.

zh: 这一过程已经开始了，并从本世纪初就开始得到政府“走出去”政策的支持（通过鼓励中国企业进行对外直接投资 ） 。
en: This process has already begun, and has been supported since the beginning of the last decade by the government’s “Going Global” policy, through which it encourages outward FDI from China.

zh: 数据说明了一切：2008年，外国直接投资流出额在2007年230亿美元的基础上翻了一番多，达到了520亿美元，2009年又更上一层楼（同一年，由于西方金融和经济危机，世界外国直接投资流暴跌50 % ） ，并于2010年达到680亿美元。 这使得中国成为世界第五大对外投资国（不计香港 ） 。
en: The data bear this out: FDI outflows more than doubled in 2008, to $52 billion, from $23 billion in 2007, and rose even further in 2009 (when world FDI flows collapsed by about 50%, owing to the Western financial and economic crisis), before reaching $68 billion in 2010.  Not counting Hong Kong, this made China the world’s fifth largest outward investor that year.

zh: 这一发展态势为其他发展中国家创造了通过参与国际劳动分工攫取贸易收益的新机会。
en: This development creates new opportunities for other developing countries to reap the trade benefits of inserting themselves into the international division of labor.

zh: 这些国家的投资促进机构 — — 事实上是所有国家，包括发达国家在内 — — 应该更多地将目标投向中国公司，吸引它们前来投资。
en: These countries’ investment-promotion agencies – indeed, those of all countries, including developed ones – should increasingly target firms in China to lure them to their shores.

zh: 在这样做的时候不应该把目标局限于国有企业，中国还有越来越多的活跃中小私人企业，范围涉及经济的所有部门。
en: In so doing, they should aim not only for big state-owned companies, but also for the rising number of vibrant, private small and medium-size enterprises in China that can be found in all sectors of the economy.

zh: 但有一点必须注意：中国有着广袤的远不及沿海省份发达的内陆地区。
en: But an important caveat is in order: China has a vast interior that is far less developed than the coastal provinces.

zh: 中国政府正在“西部大开发战略”的框架下推出特别措施开发这些地区，包括建设现代基础设施、推进高质量教育、支持科学技术（均为生产区位的关键决定因素）以及鼓励投资。
en: The government is making special efforts to develop these areas in the framework of its “Great Western Development Strategy,” including by building modern infrastructure, promoting high-quality education, supporting science and technology (all key determinants of the location of production), and encouraging investment there.

zh: 结果，需要迁移生产线、又不想通过“走出去”实现多元化的沿海省份公司可以选择迁往中国内陆。
en: As a result, firms based in the coastal provinces that have to move their production (and see no need to diversify away from China) can choose to relocate to China’s interior, rather than going abroad.

zh: 其中的模式是显而易见的：当今的发达国家以前也发生过迁离劳动密集型制造业的情况，总部设在欧洲、日本和美国的公司将生产线迁往发展中国家。
en: The pattern is clear: this sort of transition away from labor-intensive manufacturing happened before in today’s developed countries, when firms headquartered in Europe, Japan, and the United States moved production to developing countries.

zh: 在亚洲，香港、韩国、新加坡和台湾便曾是受益者。
en: In Asia, Hong Kong, South Korea, Singapore, and Taiwan were (and have been) among the beneficiaries.

zh: 当劳动密集型产品和服务的成本在这些国家变得太高时，生产便转移到了别处。
en: When costs for labor-intensive goods and services became too high in these countries, production was shifted elsewhere.

zh: 这种制造的迁移一直伴随着信息密集部分变得可贸易的服务的离岸化。
en: This relocation of manufacturing has since been accompanied by the off-shoring of services whose information-intensive components have become tradable.

zh: 如今的开放国际贸易和投资体系使得公司能够把生产放在最有利于其国际竞争力的地方，中国本身也从中获益良多，现在，中国也开始转移劳动密集型产业了。
en: China itself has benefited from today’s open international trade and investment regime, which allows firms to locate production where it is most beneficial for their international competitiveness – and is now beginning to shed labor-intensive industries itself.

zh: 政府��要调整政策以适应生产的全球迁移。
en: Governments need policies to adapt to this global shift in production.

zh: 它们应该通过建立培训项目、刺激创新、在提供社会安全网的同时维持或创造鼓励“创造性破坏”的竞争性环境等办法帮助本国公司适应生产者的离去。
en: They should help their countries’ firms to adapt to the departure of some producers by establishing training programs, stimulating innovation, and maintaining or creating a competitive environment that encourages “creative destruction” while providing for a social safety net.

zh: 类似地，吸引从其他地方流出的生产线的政府需要出台能让它们获得全球生产迁移最大好处的政策，从而进一步发展本国经济。
en: Likewise, governments that attract the production that was shed elsewhere need to have policies in place that enable them to benefit as much as possible from this global shift, thereby furthering their own economic development.

zh: 中国的不完全契约
en: China’s Incomplete Contracts

zh: 香港—今年诺贝尔经济学奖被授予哈佛大学的奥利佛·哈特（Oliver Hart）和麻省理工学院的本特·霍尔姆斯特罗姆（Bengt Holmström ） ， 以表彰他们在产权和契约经济学方面的开创性工作。
en: HONG KONG – This year’s Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences went to Harvard’s Oliver Hart and MIT’s Bengt Holmström for their pioneering work on the economics of property rights and contracts.

zh: 如今，中国正在尝试艰难的转型 — — 从不完全契约系统转向更成熟完善的产权体制与市场，哈特和霍尔斯特罗姆的理论贡献在真实世界中的重要性从未如此清晰。
en: At a time when China is attempting the difficult transition from a system of incomplete contracts to a strong property-rights regime, the real-world importance of these contributions could not be clearer.

zh: 不论什么契约，都无法具体规定一切可能性。
en: No contract can specify every eventuality.

zh: 因此，契约必须转而规定“剩余控制权及剩余收益权”的配置 — — 谁可以在怎样的环境下做决定及谁可以获得相应的收益。
en: So contracts must, instead, spell out the allocation of “control” rights – who can make decisions in which circumstances.

zh: 对于一个尝试逐渐增加市场力量的中央计划经济而言，这样的具体但不完全的契约是无比宝贵的 — — 至少在一开始是这样。
en: For a centrally planned economy attempting to allocate more authority to the market, such contracts are invaluable – at least at first.

zh: 中国改革者并没有忽视不完全契约的重要性。
en: This has not been lost on Chinese reformers.

zh: 20世纪80年代中期到90年代初，他们引入了“农村家庭联产承包责任制”和国企的“企业承包责任制 ” 。
en: From the mid-1980s to the early 1990s, they introduced both the “rural household responsibility system” and the “enterprise contract responsibility system” for state-owned enterprises (SOEs).

zh: 这些制度本质上是将更多的决策权利和一定的利润以不完全契约的方式委托给了农民和工人，因此给了他们更大的激励在集体所有制的土地上和国有制企业中更加高效地工作。
en: Those systems essentially delegated more decision-making rights, as well as certain profits, to farmers and workers, so that they had a stronger incentive to work more efficiently within state-owned communes and firms.

zh: 1994年，中国以类似的方法进行了财政改革，解决中央和地方政府的税收分配问题，与土地和地方经济发展有关的控制权利被委托给地方官员，特别是在市和县的层面。
en: A similar approach was adopted in China’s 1994 fiscal reform to handle tax-sharing between the central and local governments, with control rights relating to land and local economic development delegated to local officials, particularly at the municipal and county levels.

zh: 这有助于推进地方发展，尽管也为地方官员制造了攫取利益的空间 — — 后来演变成一些赤裸裸的腐败。
en: This helped to advance development, though it also created space for local officials to take advantage of fringe benefits – a practice that later morphed into outright corruption.

zh: 接着，不完全契约方法又被用到了影子银行领域。
en: More recently, the incomplete contract approach has also been used in the area of shadow banking.

zh: 监管者允许基于不完全契约的金融中介的创新，如信托公司和互联网金融平台，同时对正规银行部门施加了严格的控制。
en: Regulators allowed innovations in incomplete contract-based financial intermediations, such as trust companies and Internet-based platforms, while maintaining tight control over the formal banking sector.

zh: 中国领导人通过界定部分决策权和收益权，让利益相关方有激励与同一层面的企业及地方对手进行高效竞争，同时又不必完全放弃中央权威及国家对资产终极拥有与控制。
en: By defining partial rights to both decision-making and benefits, China’s leaders gave stakeholders incentives to compete efficiently with their peers, without giving up full authority.

zh: 正是这些不完全契约构成了中国过去三十多年市场竞争不断加强的基础。 而在制度和意识形态逐渐变化后，许多不完全契约就顺利过渡到了有明确私有产权的民营企业及上市公司。
en: In that sense, these incomplete contracts laid the foundation for market-oriented competition in China, before it was possible – owing to institutional and ideological barriers – to achieve clearly defined private property rights.

zh: 尽管不完全契约的改革策略在向市场经济转型期间是不可或缺的，它并不是长期解决方案。
en: But while the incomplete-contract approach was necessary during the transition to a market economy, it is not a long-term solution.

zh: 以有效的法律和司法框架为基础，更清晰地定义和更安全地保护产权及履行合约仍然十分必要。
en: More clearly defined and securely protected property rights, underpinned by an effective legal and judicial framework, are still needed.

zh: 事实上，不完全契约的漏洞正在阻挠中国改革的进程。
en: In fact, the loopholes in the incomplete contracts are undermining progress.

zh: 比如，农村家庭联产承包责任制的一个长期遗留问题是农地产权不清晰。 目前，法律上农地仍归本地农民集体所有，尽管土地使用权利以30年的合约期承包给了个体家庭。
en: One of the lingering issues of the rural household responsibility system, for example, was unclear property rights relating to farm land, which is still legally owned collectively by local farmers, even though land-use rights were contracted to the individual households for 30 years.

zh: 如果不进行土地的私有化，农民就无法以市场价格出售土地用于城市开发，这给滥权和腐败创造了空间，也为社会动荡埋下了祸根，特别是因为在中国高速增长时期，城市和农村土地价值差距迅速拉大。
en: Without privatization, the farmers could not sell their land at market value for urban development, creating space for abuse and corruption, as well as social instability, particularly because urban and rural land values widened substantially during China’s high-growth period.

zh: 类似地，企业承包制也没有让国有企业走上持续盈利之路。
en: Likewise, the enterprise contract system failed to move the SOEs to sustained profitability.

zh: 和没有借贷的农民不同，国企从国有银行大量借贷。
en: Unlike farmers, who did not borrow at all, SOEs borrowed heavily from state-owned banks.

zh: 当国企产生利润时，其收益由管理者和员工分享。
en: When they generated profits, the proceeds were shared with managers and employees.

zh: 但当国企产生亏损时 — — 比如20世纪90年代 — — 银行就不得不背上巨量不良贷款。
en: But when they generated losses – for example, in the 1990s – the banks were left with huge amounts of non-performing loans.

zh: 当年朱镕基总理通过将国企坏账转移给四大国有资产管理公司的办法解决了当时的国企坏账问题，并将大部分亏损的中小国企民营化。
en: China’s government under Premier Zhu Rongji attempted to resolve the debt problem by putting the SOEs’ bad loans into four state-owned asset-management companies, and most of the small and medium-size loss-making SOEs were privatized.

zh: 剩下的大型国有银行和企业由于其垄断地位而能够盈利，从而能够在香港、上海和深圳证券交易所上市，并在此后的多年中为中国大规模公共基础设施建设做出了关键贡献。
en: The remaining large state-owned banks and enterprises then became profitable, thanks largely to their monopolistic positions, which allowed them to be listed on the Hong Kong, Shanghai, and Shenzhen stock exchanges. In the ensuing years, they made critical contributions to China’s massive public infrastructure.

zh: 但国企也是许多严重问题的根源。
en: But the SOEs have also been the source of serious problems.

zh: 它们在财务和人力资本方面的效率远远比不上民营企业，并且也是一些腐败案件和能源及资源价格扭曲的源头。
en: They use both financial and human capital far less efficiently than their private-sector counterparts, and they have become key sources of both corruption and distortions in energy and natural-resource prices.

zh: 此外，由国企主导的股市也逐渐开始阻碍中国资本市场的进一步健康发展；它们不但霸占非常稀缺的股本资源，也让兼并与收购市场的正常操作变得十分复杂。
en: Moreover, their stock-market dominance has hindered the healthy development of China’s capital market; they not only crowd out scarce resources for equity capital, but also complicate the normal operation of the market for mergers and acquisitions.

zh: 如今，上市国企的公司所有权和控制权已经变得非常复杂而难以适应市场化的变更重组。
en: Nowadays, it is very difficult to undertake market-oriented changes in corporate ownership and control for the listed SOEs.

zh: 但企业控制权市场对于改善企业治理和竞争力至关重要，特别是在未来经济增长的基础行业，如服务、知识和创新驱动行业。
en: Yet such changes are critical to improve governance and competitiveness, especially in the service, knowledge, and innovation-driven sectors that will underpin future economic growth.

zh: 习近平主席领导的中国政府从2012年以来采取了一些列措施治理国有部门，包括发动了大规模反腐运动，目标是提高政府及国企效率及限制因权力下放缺少制衡而导致的滥权。
en: To be sure, President Xi Jinping has taken some steps to rein in the state sector. Since 2012, his government has engaged in a massive anti-corruption drive, aimed at controlling the inefficiencies and abuses that have arisen from a lack of appropriate checks on delegated authority.

zh: 但彻底解决腐败、污染、产能过剩和债务还需要靠大手笔供给侧结构性改革，特别是与完善产权及契约制度相关的改革。
en: But it has not been enough to root out corruption fully, and problems with pollution, overcapacity, and debt remain, which can be addressed only through a major supply-side structural-reform program.

zh: 简言之，中国的不完全契约体制亟待完善。
en: In short, China’s incomplete contracts need to be completed.

zh: 关键是通过司法改革来制定有序的、制度化的流程来解决产权和契约纠纷。
en: The key is judicial reform and the development of an orderly and institutionalized process for resolving property-rights and contractual disputes.

zh: 比如，更强大的破产法能让银行和监管部门执行信用纪律，将薄弱或破产的借款人踢出金融系统以提高其效率与竞争力及降低系统风险。
en: Stronger bankruptcy laws, for example, would enable Chinese banks and state authorities to enforce credit discipline, pushing weak or failed borrowers out of the system.

zh: 中国朝向高收入国家的进步之路需要制定基于更完全契约及更完整产权的市场制度。
en: China’s continued progress toward high-income status requires it to develop a strong and comprehensive property-rights system based on more complete contracts.

zh: 或许中国决策部门可以从哈特和霍尔姆斯特罗姆的研究得到启发及指引。
en: Its leaders should look to the work of Hart and Holmström for guidance.

zh: 不完整的中国增长战略
en: China’s Incomplete Growth Strategy

zh: 北京—中国增长放缓已经六年 — — 远远长于预期。
en: BEIJING – China’s economic growth has been slowing for six years – far longer than expected.

zh: 渴望遏制颓势的中国政府官员和经济学家急切地试图进行明确的解释，从而找到有效政策应对。
en: Eager to stem the slide, Chinese government officials and economists have desperately sought a clear explanation pointing toward an effective policy response.

zh: 去年11月，他们正式将矛头指向了长期供给端缺陷，并承诺用深刻的结构改革解决这些缺陷。
en: And, last November, they officially placed the blame on long-term supply-side shortcomings, which they pledged to address with far-reaching structural reforms.

zh: 但是，尽管中国官员承诺实施痛苦 — — 也是急需 — — 的结构改革值得赞赏，但聚焦于供给端在很大程度上忽略了当下。
en: But, although Chinese officials should be applauded for their commitment to implementing painful – and badly needed – structural reforms, the supply-side focus largely ignores the present.

zh: 中国面临两个不同的挑战：潜在增长率下滑的长期问题和实际增长低于潜在水平的当务之急。
en: China faces two separate challenges: the long-term issue of a declining potential growth rate and the immediate problem of below-potential actual growth.

zh: 制约潜在增长的长期因素是规模回报递减、收入差距扩大和通过模仿进行技术赶超的空间缩小。
en: Among the long-term factors undermining potential growth are diminishing returns to scale, a widening income gap, and a narrowing scope for technological catch-up through imitation.

zh: 此外，即使人口红利消失，其承载力（环境可以维持的人口规模）正在耗竭 — — 显然高污染进一步加剧了这一状况。
en: Moreover, even as the country’s demographic dividend dissolves, its carrying capacity (the size of the population the environment can sustain) is being exhausted – a situation that high levels of pollution are certainly not helping.

zh: 最后也是最重要的，中国正饱受市场改革进展不足之苦。
en: Finally, and most important, the country is suffering from inadequate progress on market-orientated reform.

zh: 在这些因素中，有一些是不可逆转的，但另外一些可以有效解决。
en: While some of these factors are irreversible, others can be addressed effectively.

zh: 而事实上，中国政府的供给端改革战略将大大有助于解决这些因素，最终稳定甚至提高中国的增长潜力。
en: And, indeed, the government’s supply-side reform strategy will go a long way toward doing just that, ultimately stabilizing and even raising China’s growth potential.

zh: 但是，与流行的信念相反，该战略无法提振中国当下的实际增长率。
en: But, contrary to popular belief, they will not boost China’s actual growth rate today.

zh: 为何有如此多的经济学家相信长期改革战略是中国唯一需要的东西？
en: Why are so many economists convinced that a long-term reform strategy is all China needs?

zh: 一个原因在于一个被广泛接受的概念，即当下的产能过剩反映的是供给端问题，而不是需求不足。
en: One reason is the widely held notion that today’s overcapacity reflects supply-side problems, not insufficient demand.

zh: 据此观点，中国应该实施减税等政策鼓励公司生产存在真实需求的产品。
en: According to this view, China should implement policies like tax cuts to encourage companies to produce products for which there is genuine demand.

zh: 如此，政府不会再维持没了银行贷款和地方政府支持就无法生存的“僵尸企业 ” 。
en: That way, the government would not inadvertently sustain “zombie enterprises” that cannot survive without bank loans and support from local governments.

zh: 但中国产能过剩只能局部归因于坏的投资决策，而有很大一部分源自有效需求不足。
en: But only some of China’s overcapacity can be attributed to bad investment decisions. A large share has emerged because of a lack of effective demand.

zh: 而这又至少部分源自政府给房地产投资降温的措施，这些措施导致房地产业年增长暴跌，从2010年的38%降低到2015年底的1 % 。
en: And that is, at least partly, a result of the government’s effort to moderate real-estate investment, which has caused the sector’s annual growth to tank, plunging from 38% in 2010 to 1% at the end of 2015.

zh: 去年，房地产投资仍占中国GDP的14%以上，房地产业增长暴跌给整体经济带来巨大的下行压力，将中国推向了债务-通缩螺旋。
en: With real-estate investment still accounting for more than 14% of GDP last year, plummeting growth in the sector has put considerable downward pressure on the economy as a whole, helping to push China into a debt-deflation spiral.

zh: 随着产能过剩拉低生产物价指数（PPI，现已连续51个月下跌 ） ， 真实债务在增加。
en: As overcapacity drives down the producer price index – which has now been falling for 51 consecutive months – real debt rises.

zh: 这破坏了公司盈利能力，刺激公司去杠杆和减少投资，从而导致PPI进一步下跌。
en: This is undermining corporate profitability, spurring companies to deleverage and reduce investment, and fueling further declines in PPI.

zh: 房地产投资对中国经济增长有着持久的重要性，这反映在今年一季度的趋势中。
en: The enduring importance of real-estate investment to China’s economic growth is reflected in trends from the first quarter of this year.

zh: 年GDP增长为6.7 % ， 为七年来最低季度数字，但仍高于市场预期。
en: Annual GDP growth of 6.7%, despite being the slowest rate for any quarter in seven years, exceeded market expectations.

zh: 而其背后部分原因就在于房地产投资增长出人意料地增加到6 % 。
en: And it was driven partly by an unforeseen increase in real-estate investment growth, to 6%.

zh: 这并不是说中国需要更多的房地产投资。
en: This is not to say that what China needs is more real-estate investment.

zh: 据国家统计局的数字，到2015年底，中国为出售商业和住宅楼面面积高达7.18亿平方米；若考虑在建项目，房地产库存将超过五十亿平方米。
en: According to the National Bureau of Statistics, China had 718 million square meters of unsold commercial and residential floor space at the end of 2015; when space under construction is factored in, inventory expands to more than five billion square meters.

zh: 每年平均住房销售面积只有12亿平方米，降低房地产供给过剩的最佳方法已经呼之欲出：限制未来建设。
en: With an average of only 1.2 billion square meters of housing being sold each year, the best way to reduce this supply glut is clear: limit future construction.

zh: 当前投资激增的最重要的原因之一是充足的流动性刺激了投机性需求 — — 而这是很难维持的。
en: One of the most important reasons for the recent investment surge was abundant liquidity driving speculative demand – and that is hardly sustainable.

zh: 但并非所有投资都是一样的。
en: But not all investment is created equal.

zh: 特别是基础设施投资或是解决中国经济萎靡的关键。
en: Infrastructure investment, in particular, may well be the key to tackling China’s economic woes.

zh: 毕竟，基础设施投资在2016年一季度增长率为19.6 % ， 已证明是经济增长的关键动力 — — 并且，与房地产投资不同，基础设施投资不会恶化中国的资源配置或为重大失衡创造条件。
en: After all, such investment, which grew at 19.6% in the first quarter of 2016, has already proved to be a critical driver of economic growth – and, unlike real-estate investment, it has not worsened China’s resource allocation or set the stage for major imbalances.

zh: 当经济有所松弛时，摆脱债务-通缩陷阱的唯一办法是强劲的增长。
en: When there is slack in the economy, the only way to escape the debt-deflation trap is to grow strongly.

zh: 由于中国存在为数巨大的地方政府和公司债务，但同时也存在为数巨大的国内储蓄和坚挺的财政状况，情况就变得非常重要。
en: Given that China is saddled with large local-government and corporate debts, but also enjoys large domestic savings and a strong fiscal position, this message could not be more pertinent.

zh: 在理想状况中，国内消费将成为增长的主要引擎；在当前环境下，基础设施投资是更可靠的选择。
en: In an ideal world, domestic consumption would serve as the main engine of growth; under current circumstances, infrastructure investment is the most reliable option.

zh: 在短期，产能过剩和通缩是主要问题，基础设施投资通过经济的需求端提振增长。
en: In the short term, when overcapacity and deflation are the main obstacles, infrastructure investment boosts growth through the economy’s demand side.

zh: 在长期，它通过供给端刺激生产率从而提高增长潜力。
en: In the long run, it operates through the supply side to boost productivity and thus raise growth potential.

zh: 中国可以用财政赤字为这些投资融资，因为对政府债券的需求十分强劲。
en: China can fund such investment with fiscal deficits, given strong demand for government bonds.

zh: 而中国主要银行仍为国有，资本管制也仍然存在，因此立刻发生金融危机的风险很小。
en: And, with China’s major banks still state-owned, and capital controls still in place, the risk of an imminent financial crisis is very low.

zh: 当然，中国政府必须坚守实施结构改革的承诺。
en: Of course, China’s government must uphold its commitment to implement structural reforms.

zh: 但基础设施投资也非常需要，不仅是为了防止经济进一步下滑，也是为了让中国能够保持实现跨越发达国家门槛所需要的长期增长。
en: But infrastructure investment is also badly needed, not just to prevent the economy from sliding further, but also to enable China to generate the sustained long-term growth that it requires to achieve developed-country status.

zh: 识破中国的虚张声势
en: Calling the Chinese Bully’s Bluff

zh: 新德里—中国实力积累越来越大，它也越来越喜欢用诈唬、恫吓和胁迫来实现自己的外交政策目标。
en: NEW DELHI – The more power China has accumulated, the more it has attempted to achieve its foreign-policy objectives with bluff, bluster, and bullying.

zh: 但是，随着中印喜马拉雅山区军事对峙的发展，这一方针的局限性也变得越来越明显。
en: But, as its Himalayan border standoff with India’s military continues, the limits of this approach are becoming increasingly apparent.

zh: 当前的僵持始于6月中旬，当时，印度的紧密盟友不丹发现解放军正在扩建一条通过洞朗的公路。 洞朗是喜马拉雅山区的一片高原，属于不丹领土，但中国对其有领土主张。
en: The current standoff began in mid-June, when Bhutan, a close ally of India, discovered the People’s Liberation Army trying to extend a road through Doklam, a high-altitude plateau in the Himalayas that belongs to Bhutan, but is claimed by China.

zh: 印度为微型国家不丹提供安全保障，立刻派遣军队和设备阻止中方建设，认为这条公路 — — 它可以俯视西藏、不丹和印度锡金邦的交界点 — — 威胁到其自身安全。
en: India, which guarantees tiny Bhutan’s security, quickly sent troops and equipment to halt the construction, asserting that the road – which would overlook the point where Tibet, Bhutan, and the Indian state of Sikkim meet – threatened its own security.

zh: 此后，中国领导人几乎每天都要警告印度退回去，否则将面临军事报复。
en: Since then, China’s leaders have been warning India almost daily to back down or face military reprisals.

zh: 中国国防部威胁要给印度一个“惨痛的教训 ” ， 信誓旦旦地表示任何冲突都将会导致比1962年中印战争“更大的损失 ” 。 当时，中国在一次喜马拉雅山区边境纠纷中入侵了印度，在几周时间里造成了严重破坏。
en: China’s defense ministry has threatened to teach India a “bitter lesson,” vowing that any conflict would inflict “greater losses” than the Sino-Indian War of 1962, when China invaded India during a Himalayan border dispute and inflicted major damage within a few weeks.

zh: 类似地，中国外交部也极尽嘲讽之能事，试图通过恐吓迫使印度就范。
en: Likewise, China’s foreign ministry has unleashed a torrent of vitriol intended to intimidate India into submission.

zh: 尽管如此，在印度政府在莫迪总理的领导下，一直保持冷静，拒绝回应中国的任何威胁，更不用说撤军了。
en: Despite all of this, India’s government, led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has kept its cool, refusing to respond to any Chinese threat, much less withdraw its forces.

zh: 随着中国备战行为的深入，其真面目也变得越来越清晰。
en: As China’s warmongering has continued, its true colors have become increasingly vivid.

zh: 现在，很显然中国正在尝试用心理战推进其战略目标 — — 即孙子所谓的“不战而屈人之兵 ” 。
en: It is now clear that China is attempting to use psychological warfare (“psywar”) to advance its strategic objectives – to “win without fighting,” as the ancient Chinese military theorist Sun Tzu recommended.

zh: 中国对印度发起的心理战主要是通过散布错误信息和操纵媒体，其目标是将印度 — — 一个公共外交能力孱弱的喧闹的民主国家 — — 描述为侵略者，而中国则是被侵略的一方。
en: China has waged its psywar against India largely through disinformation campaigns and media manipulation, aimed at presenting India – a raucous democracy with poor public diplomacy – as the aggressor and China as the aggrieved party.

zh: 中国国家媒体几周来一直在猛烈地抨击印度。
en: Chinese state media have been engaged in eager India-bashing for weeks.

zh: 中国还动用了“法律武器 ” ， 有选择性地援引殖民地时代的协定，而忽视其自身违反时间上更近的双边协定的行为 — — 不丹和印度都指出过。
en: China has also employed “lawfare,” selectively invoking a colonial-era accord, while ignoring its own violations – cited by Bhutan and India – of more recent bilateral agreements.

zh: 在僵持一开始的几天中，中国的心理闪击战让它赢得了话语权。
en: For the first few days of the standoff, China’s psywar blitz helped it dominate the narrative.

zh: 但是，随着中国的主张和策略受到日益严格的审视，其方针的回报也越来越差。
en: But, as China’s claims and tactics have come under growing scrutiny, its approach has faced diminishing returns.

zh: 事实上，从国内角度讲，中国将自己描述为受害者 — — 宣称印军非法进入中国领土并滞留 — — 有很大的弊端，这会导致抨击没能驱逐入侵者的民族主义声浪。
en: In fact, from a domestic perspective, China’s attempts to portray itself as the victim – claiming that Indian troops had illegally entered Chinese territory, where they remain – has been distinctly damaging, provoking a nationalist backlash over the failure to evict the intruders.

zh: 因此，习近平作为统帅的形象，以及中国成为地区主导力量的假定，都将承受压力，而重要的中共十九大即将在几个月后召开。
en: As a result, President Xi Jinping’s image as a commanding leader, along with the presumption of China’s regional dominance, is coming under strain, just months before the critical 19th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP).

zh: 很难看出习近平如何扭转局面。
en: And it is difficult to see how Xi could turn the situation around.

zh: 尽管中国总体军力占优，但在喜马拉雅山区作战其很难决定性地击败印度，因为印度已经加强了边境防线。
en: Despite China’s overall military superiority, it is scarcely in a position to defeat India decisively in a Himalayan war, given India’s fortified defenses along the border.

zh: 即使是三国交界地区的局部对峙，中国也没有能力主导，因为印军控居高临下，军队密度也更大。
en: Even localized hostilities at the tri-border area would be beyond China’s capacity to dominate, because the Indian army controls higher terrain and has greater troop density.

zh: 如果这些军事冲突让中国碰了个鼻青脸肿，就像1967年在同一地区所发生的那样，那么习近平在即将召开的十九大上将遇到很大的麻烦。
en: If such military clashes left China with so much as a bloodied nose, as happened in the same area in 1967, it could spell serious trouble for Xi at the upcoming National Congress.

zh: 但即便没有实际冲突，中国也必然是输家。
en: But, even without actual conflict, China stands to lose.

zh: 其对抗方针可能促使亚洲最重要的地缘政治“摇摆国”印度坚定导向中国的主要全球对手 — — 美国的阵营。
en: Its confrontational approach could drive India, Asia’s most important geopolitical “swing state,” firmly into the camp of the United States, China’s main global rival.

zh: 对抗方针也有损于其自身在作为世界增长最快的主要经济体、又位居中国能源进口生命线的必经之路的印度的商业利益。
en: It could also undermine its own commercial interests in the world’s fastest-growing major economy, which sits astride China’s energy-import lifeline.

zh: 目前，印度外交部长苏什马·斯瓦拉伊（Sushma Swaraj）默默地 警告，如果中国 — — 目前其对印度贸易有每年600亿美元的盈余 — — 继续干扰边境和平，将对其采取经济制裁。
en: Already, Indian Foreign Minister Sushma Swaraj has tacitly warned of economic sanctions if China, which is running an annual trade surplus of nearly $60 billion with India, continues to disturb border peace.

zh: 更广泛地说，在中国已经宣布印度的无条件撤军是结束僵持的“先决条件”的同时，在过去的十年中面临着中国的反复入侵的印度坚持边境和平是发展双边关系的“先决条件 ” 。
en: More broadly, as China has declared unconditional Indian troop withdrawal to be a “prerequisite” for ending the standoff, India, facing recurrent Chinese incursions over the last decade, has insisted that border peace is a “prerequisite” for developing bilateral ties.

zh: 在这样的背景下，习近平的最明智的举动是确保印度帮助其找到能够挽回颜面的妥协办法，结束这场危机。
en: Against this background, the smartest move for Xi would be to attempt to secure India’s help in finding a face-saving compromise to end the crisis.

zh: 僵持持续得越久，习近平费尽心机打造的强力领导人的形象就越有可能遭到破坏，中国的亚洲霸主形象也是如此，这将损害中共政权在国内的支持度，严重削弱中国对邻国的影响力。
en: The longer the standoff lasts, the more likely it is to sully Xi’s carefully cultivated image as a powerful leader, and that of China as Asia’s hegemon, which would undermine popular support for the regime at home and severely weaken China’s influence over its neighbors.

zh: 目前，僵持已经给了其他需要面对中国恫吓的亚洲国家重要的教训。
en: Already, the standoff is offering important lessons to other Asian countries seeking to cope with China’s bullying.

zh: 比如，中国最近威胁要对越南在争议的南沙群岛哨所采取军事行动，强迫越南政府停止在南海中国专属经济区边缘钻探天然气。
en: For example, China recently threatened to launch military action against Vietnam’s outposts in the disputed Spratly Islands, forcing the Vietnamese government to stop drilling for gas at the edge of China’s exclusive economic zone in the South China Sea.

zh: 中国尚未表现出转变方针的迹象。
en: China does not yet appear ready to change its approach.

zh: 一些专家甚至预测中国很快会采取“小规模军事行动”驱逐目前位于其助长领土内的印军。
en: Some experts even predict that it will soon move forward with a “small-scale military operation” to expel the Indian troops currently in its claimed territory.

zh: 但这种攻击行为对中国毫无益处，更不会改变三国交界处的领土现状。
en: But such an attack is unlikely to do China any good, much less change the territorial status quo in the tri-border area.

zh: 这也显然无法让中国恢复其铺路作业。
en: It certainly won’t make it possible for China to resume work on the road it wanted to build.

zh: 当印度不吃中国的虚张声势时，梦就要醒了。
en: That dream most likely died when India called the Chinese bully’s bluff.

zh: 中印关系中的达赖因素
en: The Dalai Lama Factor in Sino-Indian Relations

zh: 新德里—印度与中国的关系在近几年里打得火热。
en: NEW DELHI – Relations between India and China haven’t been particularly warm in recent months.

zh: 但最近两国关系遭遇一股寒流，中国领导人震怒于达赖喇嘛访问印度东北部的阿鲁纳恰尔邦。 中国认为该邦属于中国领土。
en: But they have lately taken on an icy chill, with Chinese leaders furious over the Dalai Lama’s visit to the northeastern Indian state of Arunachal Pradesh, which China claims as its own.

zh: 4月8日，在中国政府的强烈反对声中间，达赖喇嘛在边陲小镇达旺历史悠久的庙宇中向来自世界各地的信众发表了演说。 达旺是三百多年前六世达赖的诞生地。
en: On April 8, over loud protests from China’s government, the Dalai Lama addressed devotees from far and wide at the historic monastery in the border town of Tawang, where the sixth Dalai Lama was born more than three centuries ago.

zh: 印度和中国对于达赖喇嘛和阿鲁纳恰尔邦的看法截然不同。
en: India and China view both the Dalai Lama and Arunachal Pradesh very differently.

zh: 从印度的角度看，达赖喇嘛是藏传佛教的精神领袖，因此有权利在达旺的藏传佛教名寺向信众布道。
en: From India’s perspective, the Dalai Lama is the spiritual leader of the Tibetan Buddhist community, and so has the right to minister to his followers at the great Tibetan Buddhist monastery in Tawang.

zh: 并且因为阿鲁纳恰尔是印度联盟的一个邦，因此印度完全可以独自做出这个决定。
en: And, because Arunachal Pradesh is a state of the Indian union, what happens there is India’s decision alone.

zh: 但中国认为阿鲁纳恰尔邦实际上并不是印度的。
en: In China’s view, however, Arunachal Pradesh is not really India’s.

zh: 诚然，在官方上它属于印度，但这只是因为麦克马洪线的存在，而这条由英帝国主义在1911年划定的边境线中国并不承认（尽管中国根据这条线确定了它与缅甸的边境 ） 。
en: Yes, it officially belongs to India, but only because of the McMahon line, a boundary drawn by British imperialists in 1911, which China no longer accepts (though China did settle its boundary with Myanmar along the same line).

zh: 中国政府将阿鲁纳恰尔称为藏南。
en: The Chinese government refers to Arunachal Pradesh as South Tibet.

zh: 中国表示，无论如何达赖喇嘛都不是精神领袖，只是政治领袖。
en: In any case, says China, the Dalai Lama is not a spiritual leader, but a political one.

zh: 而由于他支持西藏自治（中国官员怒称其为“分裂分子 ” ） ，因此他访问敏感边境地区被视为故意挑衅。
en: And, given his support for Tibetan self-rule (Chinese officials angrily call him a “splittist”), his visit to a sensitive border area is being viewed as a deliberate provocation.

zh: 按照中国发言人的说法，允许达赖喇嘛访问阿鲁纳恰尔邦将伤害双边关系，印度要“对后果负责 ” 。
en: According to China’s spokesman, allowing the Dalai Lama to visit Arunachal Pradesh could harm bilateral relations, with India “facing the consequences.”

zh: 中国还召见印度驻华大使顾凯杰（Vijay Gokhale）正式表示抗议。
en: China has also summoned Indian Ambassador Vijay Gokhale to register a formal protest.

zh: 至于印度，它采取了调解方针。
en: India, for its part, has taken a conciliatory approach.

zh: 外交部长先是试图安抚中国，说“对于达赖喇嘛的宗教和精神活动，不应加上其他色彩。
en: The Ministry of External Affairs first attempted to assuage China, stating that “no additional color should be ascribed to the Dalai Lama’s religious and spiritual activities.”

zh: ”在中国的反对升级后，总理莫迪的政府重申其尊重“一个中国”政策，敦促中国政府不要制造“人为争议 ” 。
en: And, in the face of China’s increasingly intemperate fulminations, Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government reiterated its respect for the “One China” policy, urging China’s government not to generate “artificial controversies.”

zh: 但中国并未就此干休。
en: But China has not been mollified.

zh: 相反，达赖抵达阿鲁纳恰尔邦时，中国官方媒体宣称中国可能“被迫采取严厉手段 ” 。
en: Instead, when the Dalai Lama arrived in Arunachal Pradesh, Chinese official media declared that China might be “forced to take tough measures.”

zh: 中共喉舌《人民日报》旗下的英文版报纸《环球时报》立场尤其强硬。
en: The Global Times, an English-language tabloid published by the Chinese Communist Party mouthpiece the People’s Daily, took a particularly belligerent tone.

zh: 它指出，中国GDP“数倍于印度 ” ， 中国军力“可以直达印度洋 ” — —更不用说中国临近克什米尔争议地带的地理位置 — — 然后发出了“中国和印度玩地缘政治”谁会赢的问题。
en: Citing China’s GDP, which is “several times higher than that of India,” and its military capabilities, which “can reach the Indian Ocean” – not to mention its proximity to troubled Kashmir – it asked, “if China engages in a geopolitical game with India,” who will win?

zh: 同一篇《环球时报》社论还强调，达赖此次访问阿鲁纳恰尔邦与他此前的六次访问 — — 最近一次是在2009年 — — 有所不同，因为这次他系印度内政部长里吉朱（Kiren Rijiju）邀请并陪同访问。
en: The same Global Times editorial stressed that this visit by the Dalai Lama to Arunachal Pradesh was different from his previous six – the last of which was in 2009 – because he was “received and accompanied” by India’s junior home minister, Kiren Rijiju.

zh: 印度认为，身为阿鲁纳恰尔政客的里吉朱出席重大精神场合没有什么反常之处。
en: India sees nothing unusual in Rijiju, an Arunachali politician, being present for a major spiritual occasion.

zh: 在民主国家，此类与广受欢迎的宗教人物共同现身的公共事件稀松平常，政客京城通过出席这些场合来获得他们所吸引的注意力。
en: In democracies, such public events involving popular religious figures are common, and politicians often enjoy the attention they attract by attending them.

zh: 但中国更愿意将里吉朱的出席视为此事实质已成政治事件的证据，指出印度利用此次访问“作为向中国施压的外交工具。
en: But China prefers to use Rijiju’s attendance as evidence that the event is, in fact, political, suggesting that India is using the visit as “a diplomatic tool to put pressure on China.”

zh: ”其本质 ， 《 环球时报》强调，是达赖喇嘛“是中国外交活动中的一个高度政治化的象征 ” ， 一个国家如何对待达赖喇嘛将影响到它与中国的“全面关系 ” 。
en: The fundamental point, the Global Times stressed, is that the Dalai Lama “is a highly politicized symbol in China’s diplomacy,” so much so that a country’s attitude toward him affects almost “the entire relationship” with China.

zh: 但是，显然中国必须承认，近几年来它并没有让印度政府感到有理由需要安抚它的敏感性。
en: Yet surely China must recognize that it has not, in recent years, given India’s government much reason to accommodate its sensitivities.

zh: 事实上，对莫迪的一系列示好举动，中国的反应令印度难堪。
en: In fact, it has responded to Modi’s efforts at outreach with a series of insults.

zh: 比如，2014年莫迪不但欢迎中国国家主席习近平在他生日这天访问他的家乡艾哈迈达巴德（Ahmedabad ） ； 还在习近平的这次访问期间解除了此前印度政府对中国在港口和通讯等敏感经济部门投资的限制。
en: For example, in 2014, Modi not only welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to his hometown, Ahmedabad, on his own birthday; on that same trip, he also lifted the previous government’s restrictions on Chinese investments in sensitive sectors of the Indian economy, such as ports and telecoms.

zh: 中国军人悍然穿越查谟和克什米尔的拉达克地区中印争议地带，在印度宣称拥有主权的领土上安营扎寨。
en: Chinese soldiers promptly crossed the disputed frontier with India in the Ladakh region of Jammu and Kashmir, going so far as to pitch tents on land that India considers its sovereign territory.

zh: 这场小型危机后，又发生了一系列政策倒退，这表明中国在诸多问题上丝毫不顾印度的敏感性。
en: That mini-crisis was followed by a series of policy setbacks that reflected China’s scant regard for India’s sensitivities on various issues.

zh: 中国反对印度要求成为核供给集团（Nuclear Suppliers Group）的动议（美国强烈支持 ） 。
en: China opposed India’s bid (strongly supported by the United States) for membership in the Nuclear Suppliers Group.

zh: 中国否决印度要求将穆罕默德军（巴基斯坦恐怖组织）首脑马苏德·阿扎尔（Masood Azhar）列入联合国安理会黑名单的要求，尽管其他14个成员都表示支持。
en: It blocked India’s request to name Masood Azhar, the head of Jaish-e-Mohammed (a Pakistani terrorist group), to a United Nations Security Council blacklist, despite support for the move from the council’s 14 other members.

zh: 中国还建立了一个穿越巴基斯坦控制的克什米尔地区的“中巴经济走廊 ” 。
en: China has also built a “China-Pakistan economic corridor” through Pakistan-controlled parts of Kashmir.

zh: 中国本身亦承认克什米尔属于争议地区，但其政府完全无视印度对侵犯其主权的抗议。
en: China itself recognizes that the territory is disputed, yet its government completely ignored India’s objections to the violation of its sovereignty.

zh: 在这样的背景下，中国如何期望印度尊重它的敏感性？
en: Against this background, China’s expectation that India will respect its sensitivities is a bit rich.

zh: 但中国的傲慢姿态并不新鲜。
en: Yet China’s arrogant approach is not new.

zh: 事实上，它对于达赖喇嘛访问阿鲁纳恰尔邦的反应与它在南海的行为是一贯的，在南海，中国坚持领海应该根据其“九段线”划定。
en: In fact, its reaction to the Dalai Lama’s visit to Arunachal Pradesh is of a piece with its behavior in the South China Sea, where China insists that sovereignty should be determined according to its “nine-dash line.”

zh: 中国在提出这样的要求时总是期望其他国家予以满足，就像杜特尔特治下的菲律宾一样。
en: China expects other countries to fall into line when it makes such a demand, as the Philippines has done under President Rodrigo Duterte.

zh: 而中国的行为也表明，对于不满足它的要求的国家，如日本和越南，它会让事情升级。
en: And China has proved willing to turn up the heat on those that don’t, such as Japan and Vietnam.

zh: 但印度要比中国的其他地区内邻国更加庞大，立场也更坚定。
en: But India is somewhat bigger than China’s other regional neighbors, and is made of sterner stuff.

zh: 中国领导人不应该继续抓住达赖访问阿鲁纳恰尔邦的事件做文章，让冲突升级，而是应该冷静下来，让昨天的新闻大事化小。
en: Rather than escalate the conflict over the Dalai Lama’s visit further, China’s leaders should allow passions to subside and relegate the episode to yesterday’s news.

zh: 如果中国不这么做，反而继续威胁，很有可能会发现印度手里也是有牌可打的。
en: If they don’t, and instead move to follow through on their threats, they may well discover that India, too, has cards to play.

zh: 可再生能源革命
en: The Renewable Energy Revolution

zh: 悉尼 — — 在美国和欧洲，人们认为可再生能源主要可以带来环境方面的好处。
en: SYDNEY – In the United States and Europe, the benefits of renewable energy are predominantly seen as environmental.

zh: 风能和太阳能可以抵消燃烧化石燃料的需求，从而有助于缓解气候变化。
en: Energy from the wind and sun can offset the need to burn fossil fuels, helping to mitigate climate change.

zh: 但在中国和印度，人们看待可再生能源的方式截然不同。
en: In China and India, however, renewable energy is viewed in a remarkably different fashion.

zh: 中印两国以较快的速度摆脱化石燃料并不是因为担心气候变化，而是因为可再生能源可以带来经济上的好处。
en: The relatively rapid transition away from fossil fuels in both countries is driven not so much by concerns about climate change as by the economic benefits renewable energy sources are perceived as conveying.

zh: 事实上，可再生能源的经济效益既可以吸引德日等发达经济体（上述两国都在迅速摆脱化石燃料 ） ， 更可以为新兴工业巨人带来好处。
en: Indeed, while the economic benefits of renewables can be attractive to advanced economies such as Germany or Japan (both of which are rapidly moving away from fossil fuels), the advantages for emerging industrial giants are overwhelming.

zh: 对印度和中国而言，基于化石燃料的经济发展轨迹可能会带来灾难，因为其庞大人口的巨额需求可能激化地缘政治紧张。
en: For India and China, an economic trajectory based on fossil fuels could spell catastrophe, as efforts to secure enough for their immense populations ratchet up geopolitical tensions.

zh: 除强化能源安全外，低碳经济还能促进国内生产，并通过减少城市雾霾等方式改善当地的环境质量。
en: Aside from increased energy security, a low-carbon economy would promote domestic manufacturing and improve local environmental quality by, for example, reducing urban smog.

zh: 当然，在西方世界过去200年的工业化进程中化石燃料发挥了巨大作用。
en: To be sure, fossil fuels conferred enormous benefits on the Western world as it industrialized over the past 200 years.

zh: 向以碳为基础的经济转型让西方经济摆脱了古老的马尔萨斯约束。
en: The transition to a carbon-based economy liberated economies from age-old Malthusian constraints.

zh: 对一小撮代表少部分全球人口的特定国家而言，燃烧化石燃料开启了爆炸式的增长时代，显著改善了生产力、收入、财富和生活水平。
en: For a group of select countries representing a small slice of the global population, burning fossil fuels enabled an era of explosive growth, ushering in dramatic improvements in productivity, income, wealth, and standards of living.

zh: 过去20年来，中国和印度带头宣传化石燃料对世界其他国家的好处。
en: For much of the past 20 years, China and India led the charge in claiming the benefits of fossil fuels for the rest of the world.

zh: 但近来他们开始缓和自己的态度。
en: Recently, however, they have begun to moderate their approach.

zh: 随着化石燃料使用接近了地缘政治和环境上限，他们被迫对替代品 — — 其中最明显的是可再生能源进行认真的投资。
en: As their use of fossil fuels brushes up against geopolitical and environmental limits, they have been forced to invest seriously in alternatives – most notably, renewables.

zh: 这样做的同时他们正在引领一波全球性的过渡，在短短几十年内可能彻底淘汰化石燃料。
en: In doing so, they have put themselves in the vanguard of a planetary transition that in a few short decades could eliminate the use of fossil fuels altogether.

zh: 昂贵、不连续或不够集中等反对可再生能源的经济论据很容易驳斥。
en: The economic arguments advanced against renewable sources of energy – that they can be expensive, intermittent, or not sufficiently concentrated – are easily rebutted.

zh: 虽然可再生能源的反对者众多，但驱动他们的更多是保持化石燃料和核能现状的利益因素，而不是担心风力涡轮机和太阳能发电厂会破坏景色。
en: And while renewables’ opponents are legion, they are motivated more by interest in preserving the status quo of fossil fuels and nuclear energy than by worries that wind turbines or solar farms will blot the landscape.

zh: 无论如何，阻止可再生能源扩张者不太可能战胜简单的经济学。
en: In any case, those wishing to halt the expansion of renewables are unlikely to triumph over simple economics.

zh: 可再生能源革命并非由碳排放税或清洁能源补贴推动；而是不久就会使水力、风力和太阳能发电成本低于燃煤发电的制造成本降低的结果。
en: The renewable energy revolution is not being driven by a tax on carbon emissions or subsidies for clean energy; it is the result of reductions in the cost of manufacturing that will soon make it more cost-effective to generate power from water, wind, and the sun than from burning coal.

zh: 国家可以通过大规模投资制造风力涡轮机、太阳能电池和其他可再生能源所需的生产能力来确保能源安全。
en: Countries can build their way to energy security by investing in the industrial capacity needed to produce wind turbines, solar cells, and other sources of renewable energy at scale.

zh: 随着中印两国加入可再生工业革命，所谓“循环和积累因果关系”的全球连锁反应正在形成。
en: As China and India throw their economic weight into the renewables industrial revolution, they are triggering a global chain reaction known as “circular and cumulative causation.”

zh: 与采矿、钻探或萃取不同的是，制造企业遵循学习曲线，其制造过程越来越廉价和高效。
en: Unlike, mining, drilling, or extraction, manufacturers benefit from learning curves that make production increasingly efficient – and cheaper.

zh: 可再生能源投资降低其生产成本并扩大市场，使得进一步投资更具诱惑性。
en: Investments in renewable energy drive down the cost of their production, expanding the market for their adoption and making further investment more attractive.

zh: 从2009到2014年，上述机制使得太阳能光伏发电成本降低了80 % ， 陆上风力发电成本降低60 % ， 上述结论来自拉扎德动力、能源与基础设施集团的统计结果。
en: From 2009 to 2014, these mechanisms drove down the cost of solar photovoltaic energy by 80% and reduced the cost of land-based wind power by 60%, according to Lazard’s Power, Energy & Infrastructure Group.

zh: 可再生能源快速发展可能会产生与工业革命同样深远的影响。
en: The impact of the rapid uptake in renewable energy could have consequences as profound as those unleashed by the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 十八世纪，欧美经济在不完全了��个中含义的情况下开始了向化石燃料能源体系的过渡。
en: In the eighteenth century, the economies of Europe and the United States initiated the transition to an energy system based on fossil fuels without fully understanding what was happening.

zh: 但这一次，我们完全了解事情的改变，并做好准备面对可能造成的影响。
en: This time, we can see the way things are changing and prepare for the implications.

zh: 目前来看，前景似乎是乐观的。
en: For the moment, the outlook appears promising.

zh: 二氧化碳减排或许不是可再生能源革命的主要动力；但很可能如果没有这次革命，控制气候变化的努力将永远不会成功。
en: Efforts to reduce carbon dioxide emissions may not be the prime driver of the renewable energy revolution; but it is very possible that without the revolution, efforts to minimize the impact of climate change would never succeed.

zh: 如果我们能够避免最严重的全球变暖危险，我们可能要感谢印度和中国。
en: If we are able to avoid the worst dangers of a warming planet, we may have India and China to thank for it.

zh: 印度洋-太平洋地区的新秩序
en: A New Order for the Indo-Pacific

zh: 发自悉尼 — — 目前印度洋-太平洋地区的安全动态正在迅速变化。
en: SYDNEY – Security dynamics are changing rapidly in the Indo-Pacific.

zh: 该地区不仅是全球增长最快经济体的所在地，也是军事开支和海军实力增长最快，对自然资源竞争最激烈以及最危险的战略热点，甚至可以将其称之为全球安全的关键。
en: The region is home not only to the world’s fastest-growing economies, but also to the fastest-increasing military expenditures and naval capabilities, the fiercest competition over natural resources, and the most dangerous strategic hot spots. One might even say that it holds the key to global security.

zh: 人们越来越频繁地使用“印度洋-太平洋”这一术语 — — 指的是所有濒临印度洋和太平洋的国家 — — 而不是“亚洲-太平洋 ” ， 这凸显出了当前紧张局势的海洋特质。
en: The increasing use of the term “Indo-Pacific” – which refers to all countries bordering the Indian and Pacific oceans – rather than “Asia-Pacific,” underscores the maritime dimension of today’s tensions.

zh: 亚洲的海洋日益成为资源和影响力竞争的舞台。
en: Asia’s oceans have increasingly become an arena of competition for resources and influence.

zh: 现在看来似乎未来的区域性危机也将在海上触发和/或解决。
en: It now seems likely that future regional crises will be triggered and/or settled at sea.

zh: 这种转变的主要驱动力是中国。 过去五年来，中国一直在通过在南中国海建造人工岛礁来将其边界向国际水域推进。
en: The main driver of this shift has been China, which over the last five years has been working to push its borders far out into international waters, by building artificial islands in the South China Sea.

zh: 通过将这些前哨军事化 — — 以作为对世界其他地区的既成事实 — — 现在它已将其重点转移到印度洋。
en: Having militarized these outposts – presented as a fait accompli to the rest of the world – it has now shifted its focus to the Indian Ocean.

zh: 中国已经在吉布提建立了第一个海外军事基地，吉布提最近从一家迪拜企业处征用了其主要港口并可能交付给中国。
en: Already, China has established its first overseas military base in Djibouti, which recently expropriated its main port from a Dubai-based company, possibly to give it to China.

zh: 此外，中国正计划在巴基斯坦由中国控制的瓜德尔港口旁边兴建一个新的海军基地。
en: Moreover, China is planning to open a new naval base next to Pakistan’s China-controlled Gwadar port.

zh: 它还在目前陷入危机的马尔代夫租用了几个岛屿并计划在那里建立一个海洋观测站收集附近海域数据，以便在印度洋部署攻击型核潜艇和弹道导弹核潜艇。
en: And it has leased several islands in the crisis-ridden Maldives, where it is set to build a marine observatory that will provide subsurface data supporting the deployment of nuclear-powered attack submarines (SSNs) and nuclear-powered ballistic missile subs (SSBNs) in the Indian Ocean.

zh: 简而言之，中国在短短五年内改变了该地区的战略格局。
en: In short, China has transformed the region’s strategic landscape in just five years.

zh: 如果其他大国不介入来抵抗对当前领土和海上现状的进一步挑战，中国很可能会在未来五年进一步巩固其战略优势。
en: If other powers do not step in to counter further challenges to the territorial and maritime status quo, the next five years could entrench China’s strategic advantages.

zh: 其结果可能是由中国领导的非自由霸权地区秩序夺取了优势，并以牺牲该地区大多数国家支持的基于规则的自由秩序为代价。
en: The result could be the ascendancy of a China-led illiberal hegemonic regional order, at the expense of the liberal rules-based order that most countries in the region support.

zh: 考虑到该地区的经济权重，这将对全球市场和国际安全带来极大风险。
en: Given the region’s economic weight, this would create significant risks for global markets and international security.

zh: 为了缓解这一威胁，印度洋-太平洋各国必须应对三大挑战：首先是政治和经济之间越来越大的差距。
en: To mitigate the threat, the countries of the Indo-Pacific must confront three key challenges, beginning with the widening gap between politics and economics.

zh: 尽管印度洋-太平洋地区缺乏政治一体化以及共同安全框架，但自由贸易正在不断延伸，其中最近的要数包含11国的《全面且先进的跨太平洋伙伴关系协定 》 （ Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership ） ， 而中国也已经成为本地区大多数经济体的主要贸易伙伴。
en: Despite a lack of political integration and the absence of a common security framework in the Indo-Pacific, free-trade agreements are proliferating, the latest being the 11-country Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP). China has emerged as the leading trade partner of most regional economies.

zh: 但单靠蓬勃的贸易并不能减少政治风险，而后者需要一个共享和可执行的规则和规范框架。
en: But booming trade alone cannot reduce political risks. That requires a framework of shared and enforceable rules and norms.

zh: 特别是，所有国家都应根据国际法去表述和阐明其领土或海洋主张，并以和平手段 — — 而不是武力或胁迫 — — 去解决所有争端。
en: In particular, all countries should agree to state or clarify their territorial or maritime claims on the basis of international law, and to settle any dispute by peaceful means – never through force or coercion.

zh: 建立一个加强法治的区域框架需要在克服第二个挑战方面取得进展：该地区的“历史问题 ” 。
en: Establishing a regional framework that reinforces the rule of law will require progress on overcoming the second challenge: the region’s “history problem.”

zh: 关于领土，自然资源，战争纪念碑，防空区和教科书的争端都以某种方式与竞争对手的历史叙述联系在一起。
en: Disputes over territory, natural resources, war memorials, air defense zones, and textbooks are all linked, in one way or another, with rival historical narratives.

zh: 其结果就危及该地区未来的，互相竞争和强化的民族主义。
en: The result is competing and mutually reinforcing nationalisms that imperil the region’s future.

zh: 历史仍然持续给韩国和日本之间的关系蒙上阴影 — — 而双方都是美国在东亚最亲密的盟友。
en: The past continues to cast a shadow over the relationship between South Korea and Japan – America’s closest allies in East Asia.

zh: 就中国而言，它用历史来作为推翻当前领土和海洋现状的借口，并将1945年以前日本对自身的殖民掠夺行为用在了别人身上。
en: China, for its part, uses history to justify its efforts to upend the territorial and maritime status quo and emulate the pre-1945 colonial depredations of its rival Japan.

zh: 中国与周边11个邻国的所有边界争端都是基于历史主张而不是国际法。
en: All of China’s border disputes with 11 of its neighbors are based on historical claims, not international law.

zh: 这又引出印度洋-太平洋地区面临的第三大挑战：不断变化的海洋动态。
en: This brings us to the third key challenge facing the Indo-Pacific: changing maritime dynamics.

zh: 在海上贸易流量激增的情况下，地区大国正在资源获取能力，影响力和相对优势方面展开争夺。
en: Amid surging maritime trade flows, regional powers are fighting for access, influence, and relative advantage.

zh: 在此最大的威胁在于中国试图单方面改变地区现状的做法。
en: Here, the biggest threat lies in China’s unilateral attempts to alter the regional status quo.

zh: 与俄罗斯吞并克里米亚相比，中国在南中国海的所作所为具有更深远和更长远的战略意义，因为它传达了这样一个信息 — — 公然违抗法则的单边主义可不一定会带来国际后果。
en: What China achieved in the South China Sea has significantly more far-reaching and longer-term strategic implications than, say, Russia’s annexation of Crimea, as it sends the message that defiant unilateralism does not necessarily carry international costs.

zh: 此外还有各项新挑战 — — 从气候变化，过度捕捞，海洋生态系统退化到海上非国家行为体（如海盗，恐怖分子和犯罪集团）的出现 — — 以及区域安全环境变得日益充满和不确定。
en: Add to that new challenges – from climate change, overfishing, and degradation of marine ecosystems to the emergence of maritime non-state actors, such as pirates, terrorists, and criminal syndicates – and the regional security environment is becoming increasingly fraught and uncertain.

zh: 所有这些都会提升战争风险，无论是意外还是故意的。
en: All of this raises the risks of war, whether accidental or intentional.

zh: 正如最近发布的美国《国家安全战略报告》所指出的那样 ， “ 在印度洋-太平洋地区存在着自由和压迫性这两个世界秩序愿景之间的地缘政治竞争。
en: As the most recent US National Security Strategy report put it, “A geopolitical competition between free and repressive visions of world order is taking place in the Indo-Pacific region.”

zh: ”尽管该地区的主要参与者都同意开明且基于规则的秩序要比中国的霸权更受欢迎，但迄今为止它们在促进合作方面都做得不够。
