en: And yet while the major players in the region all agree that an open, rules-based order is vastly preferable to Chinese hegemony, they have so far done far too little to promote collaboration.

zh: 但可供浪费的时间已经不多了，各印度洋-太平洋大国必须采取更强有力的行动来强化地区稳定，重申其对共同规范（更不用说国际法）的承诺并建立健全的体制。
en: There is no more time to waste. Indo-Pacific powers must take stronger action to strengthen regional stability, reiterating their commitment to shared norms, not to mention international law, and creating robust institutions.

zh: 首先，澳大利亚，印度，日本和美国必须在将其四方安全对话制度化方面取得进展，以便能更好地协调各方政策并寻求与越南，印尼和韩国等其他重要区域参与者以及其他小国展开更广泛合作。
en: For starters, Australia, India, Japan, and the US must make progress in institutionalizing their Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, so that they can better coordinate their policies and pursue broader collaboration with other important players like Vietnam, Indonesia, and South Korea, as well as with smaller countries.

zh: 无论是在经济还是战略上，全球重心都在向印度洋-太平洋地区转移。
en: Economically and strategically, the global center of gravity is shifting to the Indo-Pacific.

zh: 如果该地区的参与者现在不采取行动来强化开明且基于规则的秩序，那么安全局势将一路恶化下去 — — 并引发可能会在全球范围内造成混乱的后果。
en: If the region’s players don’t act now to fortify an open, rules-based order, the security situation will continue to deteriorate – with consequences that are likely to reverberate worldwide.

zh: 中国的工业化战略对我们的教益
en: Learning from China’s Industrial Strategy

zh: 发自日内瓦 — — 在世界各地都焦急地等待美国总统特朗普对中国的进一步动向之时，中国领导人则仍然专注于本国正在进行的下一阶段经济转型。
en: GENEVA – While the world watches anxiously for signs of US President Donald Trump’s next move vis-à-vis China, Chinese leaders remain focused on the next stage of their country’s ongoing economic transformation.

zh: 而他们的做法应该得到所有人的关注 — — 特别是美国决策者。
en: What they do should interest everyone – especially US policymakers.

zh: 与其他成功的东亚经济体一样，中国的工业化进程结合了利润主导的投资，积极的产业政策和出口纪律。
en: China’s industrialization process, like that of other successful East Asian economies, has combined profit-led investment, active industrial policy, and export discipline.

zh: 但是这一手段也存在局限性，以致许多试图在同一发展阶梯上攀登的发展中国家最终在中端陷入停滞，甚至倒退下滑，而哈佛大学的经济学家丹尼·罗德里克（Dani Rodrik）将其称之为“过早的去工业化”现象。
en: But that approach has its limits, exemplified in the numerous developing countries that have attempted to climb the same development ladder, only to become stuck on the middle rungs or even to fall back, owing to what Harvard University economist Dani Rodrik has called “premature deindustrialization.”

zh: 中国希望能在“中国制造2025”战略的帮助下避免这一命运，这是指导中国国家工业现代化的路线图，由总理李克强于2015年正式发布。
en: China hopes to avoid this fate, with the help of “China Manufacturing 2025” (CM2025), a roadmap released by Premier Li Keqiang in 2015 to guide the country’s industrial modernization.

zh: 其战略重点是发展先进制造业，同时考虑生产性服务业，服务型制造和绿色科技将如何对这一进程进行补充。
en: The strategy focuses on developing advanced manufacturing sectors, but also considers how producer services, services-oriented manufacturing, and green technologies can complement that process.

zh: 作为中国制造2025战略的一部分，政府将提供政策和财政支持以推动包括新一代信息技术；高端数控机床和机器人；航天航空设备；新能源汽车；以及生物医药和高性能医疗器械等十大关键领域的技术突破。
en: As part of CM2025, policy and financial support will be provided to spur technological breakthroughs in ten key areas, including next-generation information technology; high-end computer-controlled machine tools and robotics; space and aviation equipment; alternative-energy vehicles; and bio-medicine and high-performance medical devices.

zh: 人们有时会将中国制造2025战略描绘为对旧式由上自下的重商主义运作和进口替代政策的回归，但这一看法其实忽略了中国在工业和金融政策方面的积极尝试。
en: CM2025 has sometimes been portrayed as a return to old-school top-down mercantilist practices and import-substitution policies. But that reading overlooks China’s active experimentation with industrial and financial policies.

zh: 事实上，这项尝试可以为其他国家和地区的政策评估和创新提供宝贵的经验教训。
en: In fact, that experimentation may hold valuable lessons for policy evaluation and innovation elsewhere.

zh: 正如许多发展中国家现都制定了自身的产业升级和多样化战略，一些发达经济体，包括美国，正在试图振兴其制造业基地。
en: Not only are many developing countries now devising their own strategies for industrial upgrading and diversification; some developed economies, including the United States, are currently seeking to revive their manufacturing bases.

zh: 让我们首先从产业政策入手。
en: Start with industrial policy.

zh: 根据该规划，到2025年，中国应该拥有一批具有国际竞争力且位处全球价值链上游的跨国企业。
en: According to China’s strategy, by 2025, the country should have a set of internationally competitive multinational firms that have made progress in upgrading their positions in global value chains.

zh: 此外，彼时中国的重要行业都应该在能源/原料利用效率与污染排放方面实现与国际效率标准接轨。
en: Moreover, by that date, key Chinese industries should adopt international efficiency standards related to energy and material consumption and pollution.

zh: 接着到2035年，中国经济将完全实现工业化。
en: By 2035, China expects its economy to be fully industrialized.

zh: 这些宏大目标都被分解成一系列具体针对关键领域市场份额的国内（及国际）指标。
en: These broad objectives are underpinned by an array of specific domestic (and international) targets for market share in key areas.

zh: 例如2030年，集成电路的生产将能够满足75%的国内需求，相比之下2015年则为41 ％ 。
en: For example, production of integrated circuits should rise to 75% of domestic demand in 2030, compared to 41% in 2015.

zh: 其中一个人们较少关注的中国制造2025战略组成部分是财政政策指导，也是其更为创新的部分。
en: One of CM2025’s less-noticed components, financial-policy guidance, is also one of its more innovative.

zh: 为了降低制造业企业的资金成本，该战略要求创建新的融资渠道，同时指示中国的开发性金融机构加大对特定领域的扶持力度。
en: In order to reduce the cost of capital for manufacturing firms, the strategy calls for the creation of new financing channels, while instructing China’s development-finance institutions to increase their support for particular ends.

zh: 具体来说，中国进出口银行应加强对制造业企业海外投资行为的服务，而国家开发银行应增加对制造业企业的贷款，同时“引导”来自其他机构的融资，比如风投和私募基金。
en: Specifically, the Export-Import Bank of China should strengthen services for manufacturing firms to invest overseas, while the China Development Bank (CDB) should increase loans to manufacturing firms, with a view to “guiding” financing from other institutions, such as venture-capital and private-equity funds.

zh: 中国希望通过建立一套负责分配公共投资资金的专用融资工具 — — 名为政府指导基金 — — 来推动实现产业升级和改革目标。
en: This approach, China hopes, can drive progress toward its objectives for upgrading and reform, by creating a set of purpose-built financing vehicles – so-called government guidance funds (GGFs) – that are responsible for allocating public investment funds.

zh: 正如麦肯锡公司的一份报告所说，这种“更加市场化的投资方式”是一种“旨在提高成功可能性的大胆尝试 ” 。
en: As a report by McKinsey & Company puts it, this “more market-based investment approach” is a “bold experiment designed to improve the likelihood of success.”

zh: 具体举个例子，具有国家背景的清华紫光集团最近获得了1500亿元人民币（约合218亿美元）的新融资以支持本国半导体行业的升级换代。
en: Exemplifying this approach, China’s state-backed Tsinghua Unigroup recently secured CN¥150 billion ($21.8 billion) in new financing to support upgrading in the country’s semiconductor industry.

zh: 在这笔融资中有1000亿元来自中国国家开发银行，500亿元来自国家集成电路产业投资基金 — — 于2014年创建的国家级政府指导基金。
en: Of that financing, CN¥100 billion came from the CDB and CN¥50 billion came from the National Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund. a national-level GGF created in 2014.

zh: 政府指导基金的作用将越来越大。
en: The role of GGFs will only grow.

zh: 仅在2015年就有297个政府指导基金建立，可动用资本总额超过1.5万亿人民币，相当于2014年规模的五倍。
en: In 2015, 297 GGFs were created with slightly more than CN¥1.5 trillion of available capital – a fivefold increase from 2014.

zh: 市级政府指导基金数量最多；但省级政府指导基金在融资额方面处于优势地位。
en: Municipal-level GGFs were the most numerous; but provincial-level GGFs led the way in terms of funding.

zh: 在去年还建立了两个国家级的政府指导基金：300亿美元规模的国家风险投资基金和500亿美元的国家国有企业产业结构调整基金。
en: Last year, two more national-level GGFs were created: a $30 billion state venture capital investment fund and a $50 billion state structural adjustment fund.

zh: 这两家基金的主要股东都是一家国有资产监督管理委员会下属的控股公司。
en: In both cases, the main shareholder is a holding company owned by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission.

zh: 1月份，中国丝绸之路基金 — — 联合其他中国投资者以及新加坡和日本的投资者 — — 创建了资金规模为8亿美元的厚安创新基金，投资于物联网，自主车辆，云计算，大数据和人工智能等领域的初创科技企业。
en: In January, China’s Silk Road Fund – along with other Chinese investors, as well as investors from Singapore and Japan – founded the $800 million Hou’an Innovation Fund, to invest in technology start-ups in areas like the Internet of Things, autonomous vehicles, cloud computing, Big Data, and artificial intelligence.

zh: 关于中国制造2025战略以及各种新投资工具的使用还有待观察。
en: Much remains to be seen about CM2025 and the use of these various new investment vehicles.

zh: 但中国似乎已经准备好在某个战略部门的一系列新兴技术和先进技术上大手笔投资，同时在研发和商业化完成后保留一定股权。
en: But China appears poised to boost investment significantly in a range of new and advanced technologies in strategic sectors, while retaining equity stakes as they are developed and commercialized.

zh: 一旦成功，这将为新的增长来源奠定体制基础。
en: If it succeeds, it will have laid the institutional foundations for new sources of growth.

zh: 同时随着创新的成效在整个经济中不断扩散，中国也将越来越接近其目标：成为一个高收入国家。
en: And, as the benefits of innovation are diffused throughout the economy, China will move closer to its goal: becoming a high-income country.

zh: 中国在工业和金融政策方面的尝试可以最终为新兴经济体提供宝贵的经验来避免陷入中等收入陷阱。
en: China’s experiments with industrial and financial policies may end up providing emerging economies with valuable insight into how to avoid the middle-income trap.

zh: 但对于关注制造业基地衰败问题的美国而言，这一教益已经显现。
en: But, for a US concerned with its eroding manufacturing base, the lesson is already apparent.

zh: 正如布莱德·德龙（Brad DeLong）和史蒂芬·科恩（Stephen S. Cohen）所指出的那样，美国现在应该采取行动，恢复其讲求实效的工业政策传统，让金融重新为实体经济服务，并投资于可以振兴中产阶级的新经济活动之上。
en: As Brad DeLong and Stephen S. Cohen have outlined, the US should act now to revive its pragmatic industrial-policy tradition, put finance back to work for the real economy, and invest in new activities that can reinvigorate a struggling middle class.

zh: 谁在害怕中国影响力？
en: Who’s Afraid of China’s Influence?

zh: 香港—冷战结束以来，西方投入了巨量资源引导中国的政治自由化，包括促进法治、公民社会、透明度和政府问责的各种计划。
en: HONG KONG – Since the Cold War ended, the West has invested huge amounts of resources in efforts to induce political liberalization in China, including through programs to promote the rule of law, civil society, transparency, and government accountability.

zh: 结果令人失望。
en: The results have been disappointing.

zh: 中国并没有变得更加民主，最近反而向强硬极权主义倒退。
en: Far from becoming more democratic, China has lately been backsliding toward hard-line authoritarianism.

zh: 如今，它正在投入资源将这一极权主义引入西方民主国家。
en: And now it is investing resources in efforts to do some inducing of its own in the world’s democracies.

zh: 中国在西方兜售影响力已成为媒体报道和智库研究的主题，并且引起了高层政客的关注，如美国副总统彭斯和澳大利亚总理特恩布尔。
en: China’s influence-peddling in the West has been the subject of media reports and think tank studies, and has elicited the concern of high-profile politicians, from US Vice President Mike Pence to former Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull.

zh: 他们认为，中国的“影响力操作”包括培养与西方政客的关系、在全世界设立孔子学院推广中国语言和文化、扩大中国官方宣传网络的全球推送，以及捐赠学术机构和交换计划等。
en: China’s “influence operations,” they argue, include cultivating ties with Western politicians, establishing Confucius Institutes around the world to promote Chinese language and culture, expanding the global reach of China’s official propaganda networks, and donations to and exchange programs with academic institutions.

zh: 西方自由民主国家应该如何面对一个按照自己的战略计划行动、利用它们的开放性推动它的意识形态和地缘政治目标的中国？
en: How should Western liberal democracies confront a China that is taking a page from their own playbook, as it exploits their openness to advance its ideological and geopolitical objectives?

zh: 首先，西方领导人和机构应该区分国家赞助的活动和私人公民和实体之间的合法互利的文化、民间和教育交流。
en: For starters, Western leaders and institutions should distinguish between state-sponsored activities and legitimate, mutually beneficial cultural, civic, and educational exchanges among private citizens and entities.

zh: 平心而论，中国共产党擅长“统一战线 ” — —注重在中国内外中立其政策和统治的反对者 — — 这通常需要依赖私人公民实现其目标。
en: To be sure, the Communist Party of China’s sophisticated “United Front” operation – which focuses on neutralizing opposition to its policies and authority, inside and outside China – often relies on private citizens to achieve its objectives.

zh: 而私人行动方也存在对中国保持友好以取悦中共的非正式激励。
en: Private actors also have informal incentives to curry favor with China’s rulers by behaving in CPC-friendly ways.

zh: 结果，即使是表面上独立或私人的行为，也会给西方组织带来政治和名誉风险，有可能被指控成为中国“影响力的代理人 ” 。
en: As a result, even ostensibly independent or private activities can carry political and reputational risks for Western organizations, which may be accused of acting as “agents of influence” for China.

zh: 但这并不意味着西方实体应该完全拒绝与中国实体和个人合作的机会。
en: But that does not mean that Western entities should reject outright any opportunity for cooperation with Chinese entities and individuals.

zh: 这样做不但会导致西方组织和个人错失无价的机会；还会增强中共控制信息流、操纵民意、改写流行叙事的能力。
en: Such an approach would not only cause Western organizations and individuals to miss out on valuable opportunities; it also would strengthen the CPC’s capacity to control the flow of information, manipulate public opinion, and shape popular narratives.

zh: 因此，西方固然必须保持警觉，但也必须避免反应过度。
en: So while the West must exercise vigilance, it should avoid overreaction.

zh: 中国国有企业对（比如）西方学术和文化机构捐助必须非常谨慎地对待，甚至严词拒绝，因为这可能影响到受赠方的名誉或限制它的自由。
en: A donation from a Chinese state-owned enterprise to, say, a Western academic or cultural institution must be handled with extraordinary care, if not rejected outright, because it could compromise the recipient’s reputation or constrain its freedom.

zh: 但来自中国富豪商人的馈赠应该受到欢迎，只要它一切透明并且不包含有害于受赠方的条件。
en: But a gift from a wealthy Chinese businessperson should be welcomed, as long as it is transparent and includes no conditions that would infringe on the recipient’s mission.

zh: 事实上，透明度是保护西方民主程序免受中国影响力操作破坏的最强大的机制。
en: In fact, transparency is one of the most powerful mechanisms for protecting Western democratic processes from Chinese influence operations.

zh: 比如，要求公开披露面向政客、政党以及公民和学术机构的捐赠来源和条件，以及媒体资产的所有权股份，就能让中国政府难以通过表面的私人行动方行使影响力。
en: For example, public-disclosure requirements regarding the sources and conditions of donations to politicians, political parties, and civic and academic institutions, as well as ownership stakes in media assets, would make it much harder for the Chinese government to exert its influence through ostensibly private actors.

zh: 对付中国的共同行为准则也有助于确保在一切交易和合作中坚守民主价值观。
en: A shared code of conduct for dealing with China would also help to ensure that democratic values are upheld in any deal or collaboration.

zh: 坚守民主价值观也意味着西方政府必须谨慎地避免另一种反应过度：针对本国社会中的华裔。
en: Upholding these values also means that Western governments must take care to avoid another kind of overreaction: targeting their societies’ own citizens of Chinese origin.

zh: 中国向来有通过侨民获得经济和政治好处的传统，一些西方人很容易怀疑一切华裔，导致他们饱受歧视，甚至遭到监控。
en: Given China’s long record of exploiting its diaspora for economic and political gain, some in the West will be tempted to look upon all ethnic Chinese with suspicion, exposing them to discrimination and potentially even subjecting them to surveillance.

zh: 放任华裔遭到憎恶、恫吓或因为行使公民和政治权利而受到惩罚 — — 比如，进行政治捐赠或就事关他们的事务（包括与中国相关的事务）发声 — — 非常不公。
en: But allowing ethnic Chinese to be harassed, intimidated, or punished for exercising their civil and political rights – say, by making political donations or speaking out on issues that matter to them, including those related to China – would be a grave injustice.

zh: 这在战略上也将适得其反：西方宣称要捍卫的民主价值观的强大的软实力，正是抵御中国影响力操作的最有效的防卫。
en: It would also be self-defeating strategically: the soft but intense power of the democratic values that the West claims to defend constitutes the most effective defense against Chinese influence operations.

zh: 西方机构得益于无与伦比的韧性，这种韧性来源于其自由价值观基础。
en: Western institutions benefit from unparalleled resilience, thanks to the liberal-democratic values that underpin them.

zh: 它们很难被极权政权所推翻，不管它实现多少文化交流，建立多少语言学校。
en: They cannot be easily subverted by an authoritarian regime, no matter how many cultural exchanges or language institutes it builds.

zh: 事实上，中国扩张其海外影响力的措施最可关注的特征不在于它的成功，而在于它们所暴露的轻松（ease ） 。
en: In fact, what is most notable about China’s efforts to spread its influence abroad is not their success, but the ease with which they are exposed.

zh: 将它们描述成世界民主国家的真正威胁不但出卖了西方自身的不安全，也给了中国与实际情况不符的信誉。
en: Portraying them as a genuine threat to the world’s democracies not only betrays the West’s own insecurity, but also gives China more credit than it deserves.

zh: 中国创新会超过西方吗？
en: Will China Out-Innovate the West?

zh: 纽约—十九世纪初至二十世纪初，西方国家将经济增长归因为“科学家和航海家”的发现。
en: NEW YORK – From the early nineteenth century to the early twentieth century, Western countries attributed their economic growth to the discoveries of “scientists and navigators.”

zh: 一个国家只需要“热衷于”开发“显而易见”的商业应用，并为满足新产品的需求创建便利条件，就可以实现经济增长。
en: A country needed only the “zeal” to develop “obvious” commercial applications, and build the facilities to meet demand for new products.

zh: 直到最近，中国都相信这个说法。
en: Until recently, the Chinese believed the same thing.

zh: 但如今，中国商人和企业家日益表现出他们不仅具备适应新机会的企业家动力，还表现出为自己创新而非简单复制已有创新的渴望和能力。
en: But now, Chinese businesspeople and entrepreneurs are increasingly showing not only the entrepreneurial drive to adapt to new opportunities, but also the desire and capacity to innovate for themselves, rather than simply copying what’s already out there.

zh: 事实上，越来越多的中国公司正在意识到，它们必须创新才能赶超 — — 并保持 — — 全球经济的领先地位。
en: Indeed, more and more Chinese companies are realizing that they must innovate in order to get – and stay – ahead in the global economy.

zh: 一些公司 — — 主要包括阿里巴巴、百度和腾讯 — — 通过提供便利创新活动的数字时代基础设施而取得突破。
en: Several companies – notably Alibaba, Baidu, and Tencent – made breakthroughs, by offering digital-age infrastructure that facilitates innovative activity.

zh: 工业企业最近也转向了机器人和人工智能。
en: And industrial firms have recently moved into robots and artificial intelligence.

zh: 至于中国政府，则显然对中国企业发展内生创新的能力持支持态度。
en: For its part, China’s government is evidently supportive of Chinese businesses developing a capacity to produce indigenous innovations.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国政府意识到这些创新在西方创新保持弱势、全要素生产率保持长期减速时更有价值。
en: It no doubt recognizes that such innovations are all the more valuable when innovation remains weak in the West, where growth in total factor productivity (TFP) has continued its long slowdown.

zh: 近几年来，中国政府采取了旨在刺激企业家精神和创新的政策。
en: In recent years, China’s government has introduced initiatives aimed at increasing both entrepreneurship and innovation.

zh: 它大大缩短了创办新公司的流程。
en: It has shortened dramatically the process for forming a new company.

zh: 它建设了大量学校，让中国儿童更多地学习他们将要面对的世界。
en: It has built a vast number of schools, where Chinese children learn more about the world they will face.

zh: 最近它还对外国专家来华参与新商业项目大开方便之门。
en: And it recently facilitated the entry of foreign experts to work on new projects in the business sector.

zh: 当局也认识到允许更加激烈的竞争对经济的重要性。
en: The authorities have also recognized the importance of allowing more competition in the economy.

zh: 个人应该获得自由创办新公司的权利，已有公司应该可以自由进入新行业。
en: Individuals should be freed up to start new companies, and existing companies should be freed up to enter new industries.

zh: 竞争解决了很多问题 — — 而西方在这一点上日益迷失。
en: Competition solves a lot of problems – a point that is increasingly lost on the West.

zh: 在1月份的达沃斯世界经济论坛年会上，中国官员讨论了中国政府两年前所采取的增加竞争的基础改革。
en: At the World Economic Forum’s annual meeting in Davos, Switzerland, in January, Chinese officials discussed basic reforms that the government introduced two years ago to increase competition.

zh: 根据新政策，产能过剩表明应该允许供给收缩，驱使冗余企业推出市场。
en: Under the new policy, excess capacity now signals that supply should be allowed to contract and prompt redundant firms to exit the market.

zh: 当然，需求过剩表明应该允许供给提高，引来新企业进入。
en: Of course, excess demand signals that supply should be allowed to increase, leading to the entry of new firms.

zh: 关键洞见是，当现有企业受到保护，怀揣新概念的新来者无法进入市场时，结果将是 — — 用哈耶克（Friedrich Hayek）的话说 — — 创新和对变化的世界的“适应”的损失。
en: The key insight is that when existing enterprises are protected from new market entrants bearing new ideas, the result will be less innovation and less “adaptation” to a changing world, to use Friedrich Hayek’sterm.

zh: 还可以得出另一个观点。
en: Another argument can be made.

zh: 在所有现代经济体中，几乎所有行业都需要面临基本未知的未来。
en: In any modern economy, virtually every industry operates in the face of a largely unknowable future.

zh: 一个行业中有越多的公司思考一个问题，就越有可能找到解决办法。
en: The more companies an industry has thinking about a problem, the more likely a solution is to be found.

zh: 一家被排除在某个行业之外的公司可能知道一些行业内所有公司都不知道的东西。
en: A company that has been kept out of an industry might know something that all the companies in the industry do not.

zh: 或者某种独特的经验可以通过只能传授给有相同经验的其他人的“个人知识”让某个个体取得成功。
en: Or some unique experience may have furnished an individual with “personal knowledge” that is impossible to transmit to others who have not had the same experience.

zh: 无论如何，当允许局外人之玉攻行业之石时，社会就会获益 — — 更低的价格、更多的就业岗位、更好的产品和服务等。
en: Whatever the case, society benefits – through lower prices, more jobs, better products and services, and so forth – when outsiders with something to add are free to do so.

zh: 所有这些都是20世纪二三十年代的伟大理论家所耳熟能详的，包括哈耶克、奈特（Frank Knight）和凯恩斯。
en: All of this was known to the great theorists of the 1920s and 1930s: Hayek, Frank Knight, and John Maynard Keynes.

zh: 如今，中国人也有了这样的认识，认识到公司带着自己的思维和知识进行自由竞争将令国家受益。
en: And now it is known to the Chinese, who understand that a country benefits when companies – each with its own thinking and knowledge – are free to compete.

zh: 西方则似乎已经忘记了这一点。
en: The West seems to have forgotten this.

zh: 自20世纪30年代以来，大部分西方政府将保护已有企业不受竞争冲击视为自己的责任，即使参与竞争的新企业能提供新的调整或创新。
en: Since the 1930s, most Western governments have seen it as their duty to protect established enterprises from competition, even when it comes from new firms offering new adaptations or innovations.

zh: 这些保护措施 — — 形式多种多样 — — 几乎必然地让许多企业家不再用更新更好的概念开拓进取。
en: These protections, which come in myriad forms, have almost certainly discouraged many entrepreneurs from coming forward with new and better ideas.

zh: 历史中充满了竞争的价值的证据。
en: History is rife with evidence of the value of competition.

zh: 在战后英国，步入20世纪70年代后，各行业被英国工业联合会（Confederation of British Industry）内部的排他俱乐部所控制，新进入者被阻止。
en: In post-war Britain, into the 1970s, industries were controlled by exclusive clubs within the Confederation of British Industry, which barred new entrants.

zh: 1979年撒切尔出任首相时，全要素生产率已经停滞不前。
en: By the time Margaret Thatcher became prime minister in 1979, TFP had stagnated.

zh: 但撒切尔叫停了工业联合会的反竞争措施，英国全要素生产率从20世纪80年代中期开始恢复增长。
en: But Thatcher put a stop to the Confederation’s anti-competitive practices, and Britain’s TFP was growing again by the mid-1980s.

zh: 如今，中国的情景似曾相识。
en: We are now seeing something similar in China.

zh: 到2016年，中国全要素生产率已经多年放缓。
en: By 2016, China’s TFP growth rate had been slowing for a number of years.

zh: 但自2016年的改革以来，又开始加速。
en: But since the reforms that year, it has been increasing.

zh: 西方必须解决其全要素生产率大减速的问题，这个问题从20世纪60年代末便已出现。
en: The West must address its great TFP slowdown, which has lasted since the late 1960s.

zh: 不再保护老牌企业不受怀揣新调整和创新的新进入者冲击是一个很好的起点。
en: Ending protection of incumbents from new entrants possessing ideas for new adaptions and innovations is a good place to start.

zh: 中国好经济
en: A Good Economy for China

zh: 纽约—几十年老牛拉破车式的经济增长，再加上2008年金融危机，促使世界大部分地区经济思想发生了剧烈转变。
en: NEW YORK – Decades of plodding growth together with the 2008 financial crisis have prompted a seismic shift in economic thinking in much of the world.

zh: 有人说要将资源从投资转向消费，从重工业转向“服务 ” ， 从私人部门转向公共部门。
en: There is talk of moving resources from investment to consumption, from heavy industry to “services,” and from private sector to public sector.

zh: 但令我震惊的是这些观点只专注于改善经济内部的产出组合，丝毫不关注劳动力。
en: But what strikes me is that these arguments focus only on improving the mix of outputs within an economy, with no attention paid to labor.

zh: 中国的这一现象特别明显。 从某些指标看，中国目前已是世界第一大经济体。
en: This is obvious in the case of China, now the world’s biggest economy by some measures.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国必须抵制继续在笨重的轧钢厂和空置的公寓楼上进行投资。
en: No doubt, China must reject further investment in hulking steel mills and empty apartment buildings.

zh: 但是，与此同时，中国必须关注工人，提升他们的工作体验 — — 从亚当·斯密到艾尔弗雷德·马歇尔的大批经济学家无不把这作为经济思想的核心。
en: At the same time, however, it must focus on workers and elevating the experience of their work, which economists from Adam Smith to Karl Marx and Alfred Marshall placed at the center of their concerns.

zh: 并非所有人都同意这一点。
en: Not everyone agrees.

zh: 在工作体验这个问题上，许多人 — — 特别是欧洲大陆人 — — 认为最优配置（带来运转良好的机构）如能加上教育投资便已足够。
en: When it comes to the experience of work, many – especially in continental Europe – believe that optimal allocation (entailing well-functioning institutions), if accompanied by investment in education, is all that is needed.

zh: 毕竟，意大利人、德国人和法国人工作时间相对较短，但工作努力且出色，因此拥有很高的单位时间生产率和工资 — — 比美国和英国都要高。
en: After all, the Italians, Germans, and French work hard and well over a relatively small number of hours, resulting in high hourly productivity and wages – higher than in the United States and the United Kingdom.

zh: 但欧洲大陆人似乎工作得并不十分快乐。
en: Yet continental Europeans do not seem particularly happy with their work.

zh: 间接的证据是他们爱好创纪录的休假 — — 以及相对较低的劳动力参与度。
en: Circumstantial evidence is their preference for record-setting vacations – and relatively low labor-force participation.

zh: 而职业满意度数据提供了直接证据：在西方大国中，欧洲大陆工人报告的职业满意度最低。
en: And data on job satisfaction provide direct evidence: among large Western countries, workers in continental Europe report the lowest levels.

zh: 这并不令人奇怪。
en: That is not surprising.

zh: 欧洲公司总体而言已不再是工人的思维接受新刺激和新挑战的场所。
en: Europe’s companies are generally no longer places where new stimuli and new challenges engage workers’ minds.

zh: 但如果中国避免追求效率的欧洲模式，又应该追求什么模式？
en: But if China should avoid the efficiency-seeking European model, which model should it embrace?

zh: 我在我的书《大繁荣 》 （ Mass Flourishing）中指出，正确的模式是好经济（good economy ） 。
en: I argue in my book Mass Flourishing that the right model is the good economy, which is an economy that offers the good life.

zh: 好经济是提供好生活（good life）的经济。 最优资源配置（效率是其中一部分）是好经济的必要但非充分条件。
en: Optimal resource allocation (of which efficiency is a part) is a necessary but not sufficient feature of a good economy.

zh: 事实上，一根筋地专注于提高国内消费可能导致中国领导人不再关注好经济所需要的其他政策。
en: Indeed, the single-minded focus on raising domestic consumption is likely to distract China’s leaders from other policies needed for a good economy.

zh: 在这里，我不同于其他许多经济学家，包括我的好朋友约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz ） 、 让-保罗·费托西（Jean-Paul Fitoussi）和弗拉基米尔·柯文特（Vladimir Kvint ） — —他们喜欢使用生活质量标准。
en: Here I differ with many economists – including my dear friends Joseph Stiglitz, Jean-Paul Fitoussi, and Vladimir Kvint – whose preferred standard is the quality of life.

zh: 但他们所谓的生活质量主要是指充足的消费和充足的闲暇，以及公共品 — — 比如清洁的空气、安全的食物和安全的街道 — — 和市政公园和体育场的文娱设施。
en: By this they mean mainly ample consumption and ample leisure, together with public goods – for example, clean air, safe food, and safe streets – and civic amenities such as municipal parks and sports stadiums.

zh: 这是自古有之的理想的详细版本。
en: This is a fleshed-out version of an ideal traceable to antiquity.

zh: 我不反对这些服务或由国家来提供这些服务；但它们并不添加在哲学家的“好生活”概念中。
en: I don’t oppose these services or their provision by the state; but they do not add up to philosophers’ concept of the “good life.”

zh: （亚里士多德打趣说，我们需要这些服务来恢复，从而能够在第二天工作。 ）
en: (Aristotle joked that we need these services to recover for the next day’s work.)

zh: 另一位好朋友阿玛蒂亚·森（Amartya Sen）指出，经济学家对消费的关注忽视了人们“做事”的需要。
en: Another dear friend, Amartya Sen, points out that economists’ focus on consumption leaves out people’s need to “do things.”

zh: 但他走得还不够远。
en: But he does not go far enough.

zh: 人们不想呆在他们没有自主权的工作项目中。
en: People want out of programs of work in which they have no autonomy.

zh: 为了得到好生活，人们需要在工作中获得一定程度的领导。
en: For a good life, people need a degree of agency in their work.

zh: 他们希望能够领衔和做令人愉快的工作。
en: They want to be able to take the initiative and do work that is engaging.

zh: 人们珍惜表达自己的空间 — — 即说出他们的想法和展示他们的才华。
en: People value room to express themselves– to voice their thoughts or show their talents.

zh: 换句话说，人们珍视凭自身努力取得的成就。
en: In other words, people value attainment through their own efforts.

zh: 我用“事成 ” （ prospering，来自拉丁语prospere，意思是“如希望或期望的 ” ） 来描述一个人工作中的成功体验：手艺人看到自己的技能获得其他人的高评价而得到满足，商人看到自己的“船靠岸”而得到的满足，或学者从荣誉教职中所获得的价值感。
en: I have used the word “prospering” (from the Old Latin prospere, meaning “as hoped, or expected”) to refer to the experience of succeeding in one’s work: a craftsman’s gratification at seeing his skills valued by others, a merchant’s satisfaction at seeing his “ships come in,” or a scholar’s sense of validation from an honorary professorship.

zh: 人们还珍视可能来自其职业生涯的个人成长。
en: People also value the personal growth that may come from their career.

zh: 我用“繁荣 ” （ flourishing）来描述进入未知领域的旅途所带来的满足感 — — 即挑战和克服障碍的诉求带来的激动感。
en: I use the word “flourishing”to refer to the satisfaction from a journey into the unknown – the excitement of the challenges and the appeal of overcoming obstacles.

zh: 事实上，成就、事成和繁荣都是指体验性奖赏，无关金钱。
en: Indeed, attaining, prospering, and flourishing all refer to experiential rewards, not to money.

zh: 那种经济能带来这种好生活？
en: What sort of economy would offer this good life?

zh: 历史表明是企业家民族（敏锐于不受关注的机会，并采取行动尝试新事物）和创新型民族（想象新事物，发展新概念以形成商业产品和方法，并把它们兜售给潜在客户 ） 。
en: History suggests that it would be one of entrepreneurial people (alert to unnoticed opportunities, and exercising their initiative to try out new things) and innovative people (imagining new things, developing new concepts into commercial products and methods, and marketing them to potential).

zh: 这样的好经济的参与者包括从草根到社会最顶层的所有人。
en: The participants in such a good economy would range from the grassroots of society to the most advantaged.

zh: 我希望中国能发展出这样的经济。
en: This is the kind of economy I hope China will develop.

zh: 当然，在艰难时世，一国也许无法立即实现好经济；其人民首先希望获得清洁的空气和安全的食物。
en: Of course, in a time of hardship, a country may not immediately be able to afford a good economy; its people will first want clean air and safe food.

zh: 风险在于充分满足所有各种各样的公共服务需求需要一个异常庞大的公共部门，以致于极大地挤出私人部门创新活动。
en: The risk is that fully satisfying all the myriad demands for public services would require a public sector so big that it might well crowd out innovative activities in the private sector.

zh: 中国必须认识到，在许多目前由公共部门供给的服务方面，私人部门完全可以赶上 — — 或超过 — — 公共部门。
en: China must keep in mind that the private sector can match – or surpass – the public sector in supplying many services now provided by the public sector.

zh: 地铁曾经是私人企业家所创造的产物。
en: Underground railways were once the creation of private entrepreneurs.

zh: 如今，最具革命性的城市交通措施是优步，而在近期未来，最具革命性的变化可能是���动驾驶汽车 — — 它们都是私人部门的产物。
en: Today, the most radical step in urban transportation is Uber, and the most radical change in the near future is probably the self-driving car – both creations of the private sector.

zh: 当然，一些犬儒主义者认为，中国不具备作为创新者的成熟性和气质。
en: Of course, some cynics say that the Chinese possess neither the sophistication nor the temperament to be innovators.

zh: 但对中国和G7国家自主创新的估计表明，中国在20世纪90年代已经名列第四；而在此后十年，英国和加拿大逐渐掉队，中国已经跃居第二 — — 并且距离美国已经不远。
en: Yet estimates of indigenous innovation in China and the G7 countries show that China already ranked fourth in the 1990s; and in the next decade, when the UK and Canada fell back, China moved up to second place – not very far behind the US.

zh: 事实是，美国的创新数量已经大不如前 — — 而欧洲的创新更是凤毛麟角。
en: The fact is that there is much less innovation coming out of America than there once was – and hardly any coming out of Europe.

zh: 因此，中国完全可能成为全球经济主要创新源之一，赶上或超过美国。
en: So China could become a major source of innovation for the global economy, equaling or exceeding America.

zh: 在我看来，这是中国无比宝贵的机会 — — 也是值得世界其他国家欢迎的发展趋势。
en: To my mind, this is an invaluable opportunity for China – and a development to be welcomed in the rest of the world.

zh: 中国特色创新
en: Innovation with Chinese Characteristics

zh: 上海—今年，中国增长放缓主宰了全球经济新闻头条 — — 不无道理。
en: SHANGHAI – China’s slowing growth has dominated global economic news this year – and for good reason.

zh: 除了是世界第二大经济体之外，中国还是第一大制造国和原材料消费国；因此，任何中国开始疲软的信号对全球经济体来说都是坏消息。
en: Beyond being the world’s second-largest economy, China is the largest manufacturer and consumer of raw materials; so any sign of weakening there is bad news for the global economy.

zh: 但是，关于增长的担忧当然值得关注，但应该把它们放在中国的长期经济轨道上去审视，特别是中国崛起成为全球创新枢纽这一趋势。
en: But, while concerns about growth certainly merit attention, they should be viewed in the context of China’s longer-term economic trajectory, especially its emergence as a global hub of innovation.

zh: 作为创新国度的中国没有得到相衬的承认。
en: China is not given enough credit for how far it has come as an innovator.

zh: 但是，在未来十年，中国不仅可能成为全球各大公司研究和新产品发布地点，还可能成为影响世界各地竞争的低成本灵活创新的源头。
en: And yet, over the next decade, China could become not only the place where global companies conduct research and launch new products, but also the source of a low-cost and nimble approach to innovation that affects competition everywhere.

zh: 这一结论是根据麦肯锡全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）的一项深度研究计划做出的。 该计划旨在研究中国在创新方面的地位，其方法是测量创新的真正影响 — — 即商业化概念在真实的世界市场中表现如何。
en: This conclusion is based on an in-depth research project by the McKinsey Global Institute, which aimed to gauge where China stands in terms of innovation, by measuring innovation’s true impact – that is, how commercialized ideas actually fare in markets worldwide.

zh: 我们利用一个涵盖占全球GDP三成左右的20,000家上市公司的数据库，研究符合四大创新“原型 ” — —专注客户、效率驱动、基于工程和基于科学 — — 的产业的全球收入。
en: Using a database of 20,000 public companies representing about 30% of global GDP, we looked at global revenue in industries that fit four innovative “archetypes”: customer-focused, efficiency-driven, engineering-based, and science-based.

zh: 中国的某产业被归为擅长创新，如果中国企业占据该行业全球收入的12 % （ 等于中国GDP占全球GDP的比重）以上的话。
en: A Chinese industry was classed as strong in innovation if Chinese players were capturing more than 12% of global revenue, the equivalent of China’s share of global GDP, in that sector.

zh: 数据表明，中国在符合其中两个原型的产业中构建了强大的优势：专注客户和效率驱动。
en: The data show that China has built considerable strengths in industries fitting two of these archetypes: customer-focused and efficiency-driven.

zh: 第一类包括电器和互联网服务与软件等行业，前者中国占行业全球收入的36 % ， 后者占15 % 。
en: The first category includes industries like appliances, in which China has captured 36% of global revenues, and Internet services and software, where China accounts for 15% of global revenues.

zh: 第二类包括太阳能面板行业和纺织业，前者中国占行业全球总收入的51 % ， 后者占20 % 。
en: The second includes the solar-panel industry, where Chinese players have 51% of global revenue, and the textile industry, in which Chinese companies claim 20% of global revenue.

zh: 中国公司在专注客户的产业繁荣壮大是因为它们学会了根据中国新兴消费阶级的需要打造产品。
en: Chinese companies have prospered in customer-focused industries because they have learned to tailor their goods to the needs of their country’s emerging consumer class.

zh: 中国公司过去专注于设计“足够好”的产品 — — 未必赶得上西方产品的质量，但能节约很多成本 — — 而如今，它们制造价更廉并且物更美的产品。
en: Whereas Chinese companies used to focus on designing products that were “good enough” – not quite matching the standard of Western products, but offering huge cost savings – they are now out to create products that are cheaper and better, in order to satisfy wealthier consumers.

zh: 中国市场的巨大规模 — — 由超过1亿的主流消费家庭组成 — — 也有所助益，如此大的市场让公司能够迅速且大规模地将新概念商业化。
en: The sheer size of China’s market – comprising more than 100 million mainstream consumer households – also helps, as it enables companies to commercialize new ideas rapidly and on a large scale.

zh: 在基于效率的产业，中国力量来自其“世界工厂”的角色。
en: In efficiency-based industries, China’s prowess is rooted in its role as the “world’s factory.”

zh: 中国庞大的制造业生态系统 — — 1.5亿工厂工人、五倍于日本的供应商基础以及现代基础设施 — — 让削减成本、提高质量、缩短上市时间的工艺创新容易实现。
en: The country’s massive manufacturing ecosystem – 150 million factory workers, five times the supplier base of Japan, and modern infrastructure – enables process innovations that cut costs, raise quality, and shorten time to market.

zh: 中国制造商还在朝价值链的更高端攀升，打造更多的“知识密集型”产品（如通讯设备 ） 、 开发灵活的自动化方法将劳动力和机器相结合，在保持灵敏度的同时降低成本。
en: Chinese manufacturers are also moving up the value chain, building more “knowledge-intensive” products (for example, communications equipment) and developing flexible approaches to automation that blend labor and machinery to maintain responsiveness, while reducing cost.

zh: 对于其他创新原型，中国也取得了一些成果。
en: As for the other innovation archetypes, China has some work to do.

zh: 毫无疑问，在基于工程的产业，中国公司已经取得一些成功。
en: To be sure, in engineering-based industries, Chinese companies have had some success.

zh: 事实上，打造足够强大的知识和经验基础实现这一领域的繁荣需要时间，而一些中国产业学习过程非常迅速，这部分是因为政府采取措施方便全球合作伙伴间的技术转移。
en: Indeed, while it takes time to build up a base of knowledge and experience strong enough to thrive in this area, some Chinese industries have learned fast, partly owing to the government’s efforts to facilitate technology transfer with global partners.

zh: 这方面的例子包括高铁（站全球收入的41 % ） 、风涡轮（20 % ） 和通讯设备（18 % ） 。
en: Examples include high-speed trains (41% of global revenue), wind turbines (20%), and communications equipment (18%).

zh: 但大量产业过得并不好。
en: But plenty of industries have not fared so well.

zh: 比如，中国汽车业只占全球收入的8 % ， 这主要是拜学习机会有限所赐。
en: China’s auto industry, for example, commands just 8% of global revenue, which largely reflects limited learning opportunities.

zh: 中国在基于科学的创新方面最需要赶超，这方面的产业包括特殊品化工、半导体设计和专利药等。
en: China has the most catching up to do in science-based innovation, which includes industries like specialty chemicals, semiconductor design, and branded pharmaceuticals.

zh: 事实上，尽管中国在科技能力方面投资巨大 — — 其每年的研发支出高达2,000亿美元以上，仅次于美国 — — 在这方面尚无任何中国产业能获得全球收入的12%以上。
en: In fact, despite significant investment in technical capabilities – the country spends more than $200 billion annually on research and development (second only to the US) – no Chinese industry in this area has captured more than 12% of global revenues.

zh: 中国基于科学的产业的一个关键问题是新发现的打磨和商业化需要极长时间。
en: One key problem for China’s science-based industries is the long time horizon for new discoveries to be perfected and commercialized.

zh: 因此各大公司正在开发独特的中国创新法。
en: So companies are developing uniquely Chinese approaches to such innovation.

zh: 比如，为了加快需要15年之久的新药上市过程，中国制药公司正在实施工业风格（industrial-style）方法。
en: For example, to speed up the 15-year process of taking a new drug from the lab to market, Chinese pharmaceutical companies are implementing industrial-style approaches.

zh: 在未来十年，中国有机会超越仅仅作为全球科技的吸收者和改造者的角色，成为真正的创新领导者。
en: Over the next ten years, China has a chance to move beyond merely absorbing and adapting global technologies to become a true innovation leader.

zh: 如果中国获得成功，关于其长期放缓拖累全球增长的担忧将不攻自破。
en: If it succeeds, fears of a prolonged slowdown that hampers global growth will prove unwarranted.

zh: 我们估计，到2025年，中国服务业的创新 — — 该行业生产率远远落后于发达国家 — — 将带来每年5,000亿到14,000亿美元的经济价值。
en: We estimate that innovation in China’s service industries, where productivity lags far behind that of developed economies, could create anywhere from $500 billion to $1.4 trillion in economic value per year by 2025.

zh: 在制造业，中国可以利用其巨大的资源在数字化制造时代独领风骚，该行业的创新每年可以增加4,500—7,800亿美元经济价值。
en: In manufacturing, where China can use its vast resources to lead the world in an era of digitized manufacturing, innovation can add $450-$780 billion in value each year.

zh: 这将是通过提高生产率应对人口老龄化等挑战道路上的巨大进步。
en: This would go a long way toward raising productivity enough to offset challenges like population aging.

zh: 最重要的是，中国崛起成为真正的创新者能够让它成为全球研发枢纽。
en: Most important, China’s emergence as a true innovator could turn it into a global R&D hub.

zh: 毕竟，与美国等今天的创新领导者不同，中国可以提供低成本和紧邻巨大（可以说是取之不竭的）市场（包括它自己在内）的便利，便于迅速部署新产品。
en: After all, unlike today’s leading innovators like the US, China offers low costs and proximity to large – and largely untapped – markets, including its own, which enables the rapid deployment of new products.

zh: 即使工资有所增加，中国研究者 — — 更不用说其他类型的劳动者了 — — 所获得的报酬也只是发达国家同行的10—20 % 。
en: Even with rising wages, Chinese researchers – not to mention other kinds of labor – receive only 10-20% of what their advanced-country counterparts earn.

zh: 中国拥有巨大的市场、低廉的成本、灵活性和雄心，它可以为全世界创新公司提供前所未有地更快、成本更低地将概念转化为商业产品的机会。
en: With a combination of a massive market, low costs, flexibility, and ambition, China offers innovative companies from all over the world the chance to transform their ideas into commercial products more quickly and at lower cost than ever.

zh: 随着越来越多的创新公司认识到这一点并将业务迁往中国，所有市场都可能被破坏。
en: As more of them recognize this, and move their operations to China, all sorts of markets could be disrupted.

zh: 而最终，中国创新模式可能成为全球标准。
en: And, eventually, the Chinese model of innovation could become the global standard.

zh: 中国的制度改革挑战
en: China’s Institutional Challenge

zh: 香港—上个月，一位将经济理论应用于历史分析并提供了制度和社会变迁宝贵洞见的教授、诺贝尔经济学奖获得者道格拉斯·诺斯（Douglass North）在密歇根州的家中去世。
en: HONG KONG – Last month, the Nobel laureate economist Douglass North, who applied economic theory to history to gain insight into institutional and social change, died at his home in Michigan.

zh: 但他的思想是不朽的，特别是在中国。
en: But his ideas will live on, particularly in China.

zh: 诺斯从未专研中国的制度发展，但他的理论框架却能够让中国领导人在引领中国下一阶段制度变迁时获得宝贵的启发。
en: Though North never focused explicitly on China’s institutional development, his theoretical framework could prove invaluable to the country’s leaders as they navigate the next phase of institutional change.

zh: 在1993年的诺贝尔奖演讲中，诺斯提出了决策者可以从他的研究中汲取的三个教训。
en: In his Nobel lecture in 1993, North identified three lessons that policymakers should draw from his research.

zh: 首先，决定经济表现的是“正式规则、潜规则和执法特征”的结合。
en: First, what determines economic performance is the mix of “formal rules, informal norms, and enforcement characteristics.”

zh: 其次，政治对经济表现具有强烈影响，因为政治“决定并执行经济规则 ” 。
en: Second, polities have a major impact on economic performance, because they “define and enforce the economic rules.”

zh: 最后，适应效率（adaptive efficiency，即规则如何变化 ） ， 而不是配置效率（allocative efficiency，当下的规则是否最有效 ） ， 是长期增长的关键。
en: And, finally, adaptive efficiency (how the rules are changed), not allocative efficiency (the most effective rules right now), is the key to long-term growth.

zh: 这些教训与启发来自诺斯对西欧制度和经济发展的研究及评估。 他将欧洲的工业革命归因于两个关键因素：一个是为数众多的不同信仰体系的存在，另一个是新兴主权力量之间和内部的激烈竞争。
en: These lessons are reflected in North’s assessment of Western Europe’s institutional and economic development, in which he attributed the Industrial Revolution to two key factors: varying belief systems and intense competition between and within the emerging sovereign powers.

zh: 具体而言，英国人和荷兰人创造了多样化的政治/经济单位，这些经济单位演化为促成专业化和劳动分工的经济制度。
en: Specifically, the English and the Dutch created diverse political/economic units that evolved institutions nurturing specialization and division of labor.

zh: 这些经济制度通过更低的交易成本、明晰且可执法的产权以及其他公共领域的规则和规范带来了超凡的经济和政治表现。
en: These institutions delivered superior economic and political outcomes through lower transaction costs, clear and enforceable property rights, and other shared rules and norms.

zh: 诺斯观察到，制度变化是非常困难的，因为这不但要克服既得利益，还必须克服陈旧的信仰体系和思维模式。
en: North observed that institutional change is extremely difficult, as it requires overcoming not only vested interests, but also outdated belief systems and mental models.

zh: 他指出，制度的突破关键在于贸易规则应超越本地社区内的贸易，从而让匿名的不带个人色彩的交易可以跨空间和时间进行。
en: The breakthrough, he noted, comes when institutions go beyond trade within local communities to permit anonymous and impersonal exchange across time and space.

zh: 有生命力的制度需要学习和适应，克服其制度体系自身的历史偏见和局限。
en: Sustainable institutions are those that learn and adapt, overcoming their own biases and limitations.

zh: 诺斯的工作有助于解释中国过去三十年来所发生的剧烈的制度变迁和经济成就，并对中国在未来十年将遇到的改革挑战有重要的启发。
en: North’s work goes a long way toward explaining the dramatic institutional and economic changes that have occurred in China over the last three decades, as well as illuminating the challenges that it will face over the next decade.

zh: 事实上，他的贡献有助于缓和最近在讨论中国前途的场合所弥漫的悲观情绪。
en: In fact, it should temper the pessimism that pervades most current discussion of China’s prospects.

zh: 首先，目前的中国经济存在大量的激烈竞争。
en: For starters, intense competition is alive and well in China.

zh: 中国的大城市（特别是最近提出的在上海、广东、天津和厦门设立的自贸区）相互竞争激烈。 而新一波科技创新公司（如华为、腾讯和阿里巴巴）正在竞相开启新的商品、服务、人才、资本和知识市场。
en: Its major cities (including Shanghai, Guangdong, Tianjin, and Xiamen) are still competing vigorously with one another, and a new breed of technologically innovative companies (such as Huawei, Tencent, and Alibaba) are battling to open up new markets in goods, services, talent, capital, and knowledge.

zh: 执政的中国共产党致力于构建一个更高效的、越来越多由服务业推动，并更受市场和法治约束的经济。
en: The ruling Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has dedicated itself to creating a more efficient, services-driven economy, subject to the market and the rule of law.

zh: 中国最近不断承诺放松国内和国外投资者准入要求，加大市场开放度，并不断在强化土地、劳动力、资本和知识的产权；这些制度层面的变化与数字和机器人技术的进步互相作用，正不断降低中国经济的交易成本。
en: For example, it has committed to ease market access by loosening entry requirements for both domestic and foreign investors. It has also strengthened property rights relating to land, labor, capital, and knowledge; this, together with advances in digital and robot technology, has brought down Chinese transaction costs.

zh: 此外，过去十年中国建设了许多必须的硬件基础设施（也许有些领域有过量之嫌 ） ， 现在中国政府开始强调建软件基础设施，包括为促进市场发展的法律、会计、金融、及互联网等服务行业。
en: Moreover, having built the needed physical infrastructure in the last decade (perhaps to excess), China is now emphasizing the software infrastructure needed to sustain the growth of its burgeoning services sector.

zh: 2015年，中国的服务业占GDP之比已经超过制造业和第一产业之和。
en: In 2014, services’ share of GDP already exceeded 50%, more than the manufacturing and primary sectors combined.

zh: 中国的国有企业改革还是任重道远，但政府已开始有意地允许一些民营新技术企业巨头与国有金融机构竞争。
en: While the government has not pursued adequate reform of state-owned enterprises, it has deliberately allowed new, largely private-owned technology giants to compete against state-owned banks and financial institutions.

zh: 而几年前没人预料到中国共产党铲除腐败，包括军队、金融业和党内最高层的腐败，的力度会如此之大。
en: And no one predicted the intensity of the CCP’s campaign to root out corruption, including in the military, the financial sector, and the highest levels of the party itself.

zh: 中国政府在促成人民币���纳入国际货币基金组织（IMF）储备资金账户货币篮子（即特别提款权SDR）时向后者做出了一系列承诺，这些承诺有助于强化中国的市场化制度转型。
en: China’s market-oriented shift will be reinforced by the commitments that its leaders made to the International Monetary Fund when the renminbi was added to the basket of currencies that determine the value of the Fund’s unit of account, Special Drawing Rights.

zh: 另外，由美国主导的涵盖了中国大部分邻国，但还没有包括中国的，跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP）的建立也将对中国走向更市场化的制度产生类似的约束效应。
en: The need to cope with trade pressures after the Trans-Pacific Partnership encompasses most of China’s neighbors will have a similar disciplining effect.

zh: 中国共产党并不以西方自由民主治理模式为基准来考评自己的制度建设，而更多的是受到中国古代法家传统的影响。 法家传统强调强大的中央威权，并通过坚持任人唯贤的问责标准维持其合法性。
en: The CCP is judging itself not against the Western benchmark of liberal democratic governance, but against the ancient Chinese legalist tradition of strong, central authority that maintains legitimacy by upholding meritocratic standards of accountability.

zh: 也许更重要的是，中国当局目前更依赖有丰富实践经验的一批体制内智囊及中央与地方干部来设计其国家发展路线图，而不是靠传统的党内意识形态理论家。
en: Perhaps more important, it has relied on seasoned intellectuals and policymakers – not Party ideologues – to design its development roadmap.

zh: 这一方针在今年夏天以来得到了强化，尽管当时遇到了严重的股票市场动荡，但中国决策层之后仍坚守其让市场在“资源配置中起决定性作用”的承诺，不断推出更市场化的改革。
en: This approach was fortified last summer, when despite serious market turmoil, the CCP upheld its commitment to allow the market to play a “decisive role in resource allocation.”

zh: 这清楚地表明，为提高收入及实现小康社会目标，中国决策层有意识改变及升级其经济、社会、政治发展理念和思维方式 。
en: There could be no clearer indication that China is willing to upgrade its belief systems and mental models in order to achieve high-income status.

zh: 尽管如此，中国仍需要克服许多制度改革困难，特别是在制度的适应效率方面。
en: Nonetheless, China still has rivers to cross, particularly when it comes to adaptive efficiency.

zh: 其中的一个关键是需要清楚地认识到：正式规则容易迅速改变，但文化与潜规则往往难以在短期改变。
en: Here, it is important to note that whereas formal rules can be altered quickly, informal cultural norms are difficult to change in the short run.

zh: 新的正式规则可能与现存的非正式规范相冲突，导致官僚体系的激励机制被扭曲，对官员及国有企业的负责人的行为和表现造成消极影响。
en: New formal rules can conflict with established norms, causing bureaucratic incentives to become distorted, with adverse effects on institutional behavior and performance.

zh: 中国决策层必须面对的一个艰巨市场挑战是：由于中国在制度方面的一些短板，中国经济能提供的产品及服务与消费者需要的产品与服务之间的不匹配。
en: China’s leaders must cope with an asymmetry between what they can deliver and what consumers demand.

zh: 根据诺斯的观点，国家制度能力不足是一个短期配置效率问题或一个历史积累的沉淀成本，可以用提高制度的适应效率来补偿，也就是找到更好的改革机制，让效率更高的制度不断代替效率低下的制度。
en: According to North, institutional under-capacity is a short-term allocative problem, or sunk cost, for which the state can compensate with greater adaptive efficiency, or better mechanisms for bringing about the exit of less efficient institutions.

zh: 诺斯的理论遗产对于未来几年中国决策者应对制度改革挑战至关重要，因为它给出了关于如何应对快速制度变化的实用指引。
en: North’s theoretical legacy could prove vital for China’s policymakers in the coming years, because it gives them specific guidance about how to cross the river of rapid institutional change.

zh: 如果希望对中国制度变革之父邓小平在三十多年前所提出的“摸着石头过河”的策略有所提升与改进，以便更快达到河对岸，中国需要重视诺斯给出的有关制度变迁的启示 。
en: The alternative is to continue relying on what Deng Xiaoping, the father of China’s institutional breakthrough more than three decades ago, called “feeling the stones.” That, as North would put it, may not be the most efficient way to get to the other side.

zh: “南方”的特朗普主义
en: Trumpism Down Under

zh: 悉尼—三十年前，我的一位担任负责非洲和亚洲的事务的英国政府阁臣同事，在办公室里挂着一幅倒置的世界地图。
en: SYDNEY – Thirty years ago, a colleague of mine in the British government who had ministerial responsibilities in Africa and Asia hung the world map in his office upside down.

zh: 他将当时所谓的第三世界放在最上面，说这样做能增进他对这些国家的问题和前景的理解。
en: Placing what was then called the Third World at the top, he claimed, improved his understanding of those countries’ problems and perspectives.

zh: 但对英国来说，真正的“南方 ” — —那个你绕过半个地球才能到达的国家 — — 是澳大利亚。
en: But, for the British, the real “down under” – the country you would reach if you turned the world on its head – is Australia.

zh: 学生们常常会学到，如果你往地下打一个垂直的隧洞，最后就能从澳大利亚钻出来。
en: Schoolchildren used to be taught that, if you dug a straight tunnel through the planet, Australia is where you would end up.

zh: 他们的季节和我们的相反，日子也是 — — 最好的例子就是，一大早我们能听到来自布里斯班或阿德莱德的板球评论。
en: Their seasons were the opposite of ours, as were the days – a point that was driven home when, in the early morning hours, we listened to cricket commentaries from Brisbane or Adelaide.

zh: 当英国人沉睡时，澳大利亚人在阳光下游戏。
en: While Britain slept, the Aussies played in the sunshine.

zh: 澳大利亚是一个美丽繁荣的国度，有着宏伟的景观和漂亮的城市，最著名的是悉尼和墨尔本。
en: Australia is a beautiful and prosperous country, with a grand landscape and fine cities, most notably Sydney and Melbourne.

zh: 他是一个喧闹的民主国家，十分尊重法治，社会自由而开放，为来自全世界的移民和难民提供避风港。
en: It is a rumbustious democracy with a profound appreciation of the rule of law, a free and open society that has provided a haven for immigrants and refugees from all over the world.

zh: 当然，它对待土著居民的方式毫无疑问很有问题，但它有勇气和成熟的风度承认这些令人不快的事实。
en: While its past treatment of its indigenous population has undoubtedly been problematic, it has had the courage and maturity to acknowledge unpleasant truths.

zh: 但这个令人敬仰的国家现在面临着生存威胁。
en: Yet this admirable country now faces an existential challenge.

zh: 澳大利亚和美国的关系日益紧张，而其政治动态也变得越来越复杂和危险。
en: As Australia’s relationship with the United States comes under increasing strain, its political dynamics are becoming increasingly complex and perilous.

zh: 几十年来，澳大利亚一直与美国保持密切的关系，包括在安全方面。
en: For decades, Australia has had a close partnership with the US, not least in security terms.

zh: 但特朗普总统上台一年来，不但挑战了与许多美国传统盟友之间的关系；还积极地破坏了由美国本身带头主导和鼎力维持的全球和地区合作体系。
en: But, in his year since taking office, President Donald Trump has not only challenged ties with many of America’s traditional allies; he has also worked actively to undermine the systems of global and regional cooperation that the US itself spearheaded and underwrote.

zh: 他撤销前几任总统好不容易在构建关系和达成互惠协议方面所取得的进步，比如伊朗核协议、跨太平洋合作伙伴关系和巴黎气候协定等。
en: He has reversed his predecessors’ hard-won progress in building relationships and striking mutually beneficial deals, including the Iran nuclear agreement, the Trans-Pacific Partnership trade deal, and the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 与特朗普宣称的他的政策将“让美国再次伟大”相反，他让美国在世界上的作用极大地退缩了。
en: Contrary to Trump’s claims that his policies will “Make America Great Again,” he is deeply compromising his country’s role in the world.

zh: 长期盟友很遗憾地看到，它们所长期敬仰的美国，被一个不诚实、不可靠的外交“纵火犯”所领导。
en: Long-standing allies regret that the US, a country they have long admired, is now being steered by a mendacious, untrustworthy diplomatic arsonist.

zh: 这对于澳大利亚来说是坏消息，它当然希望与和自己具有共同民主价值观和利益的地区力量构建更加强大的关系，包括印度、日本和美国等。
en: This is bad news for Australia, which would clearly like to build a stronger partnership with regional powers that share its democratic values and interests, including India, Japan, and the US.

zh: 这一联盟不是为了遏制中国，而是为了确保中国不会滥用权力和煽动地区紧张和动荡。
en: Such an alliance would not seek to contain China, but to ensure that it does not abuse its power and stoke regional tensions and instability.

zh: 在没有可靠的地区制衡力量的情况下，中国恰恰表现出这一急切意图。
en: Without a reliable regional counterweight, that is exactly what China seems eager to do.

zh: 和特朗普一样，中国国家主席习近平也一反前任的政策，包括邓小平所推行的某些市场经济改革。
en: Like Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping has reversed many of his predecessors’ policies, including some of the market-oriented reforms pushed through by Deng Xiaoping.

zh: 习近平培养了一种毛泽东式的个人崇拜，宣称现在是让中国再次伟大的良机。
en: Having cultivated a Mao-style cult of personality, Xi proclaims that the time has come to Make China Great Again.

zh: 因此，外交政策的克制被抛在了一边，而习近平也让中共重新掌控了经济。
en: So foreign-policy restraint has gone out the window, and Xi has enabled the Communist Party of China to reassert its control over the economy.

zh: 自由企业再一次被公共部门所压制。
en: Free enterprise is now once again subordinated to the public sector.

zh: “共产主义统一战线”势不可挡。
en: The “Communist united front” has been let off its leash.

zh: 自1917年十月革命以来，所有共产主义政权都用“统一战线”来扩大党在国内和国外的权力，形式或隐晦或张扬，但卑劣则一。
en: Every Communist regime since the Russian Revolution of 1917 has sought to use the “united front” to extend the power of the party, both at home and abroad, in ways that may be subtle or overt, but are invariably underhanded.

zh: 今天的中国统一战线也不例外，而澳大利亚就是被它针对的目标之一。
en: Today’s Chinese united front is no exception, and Australia is one of the countries that is being targeted.

zh: 澳大利亚和中国有着紧密的经济联系，后者向前者购买大量矿产和农作物。
en: Australia has strong economic ties with China, which buys much of what it mines and grows.

zh: 中国则向澳大利亚输出资金和人，包括商界和学界。
en: For its own part, China has exported money and people to Australia, from the business world to academia.

zh: 大部分在澳华人 — — 其中一些将新家园视为逃离压迫和腐败的避难所 — — 成为有着骄傲中国遗产的铁杆澳大利亚人。
en: Most Chinese in Australia, some of whom regard their new home as a haven from repression and corruption, have become enthusiastic Australians with a proud Chinese heritage.

zh: 但一些在澳华人成为中国的列宁主义（而非真正的共产主义）独裁的排头兵，受中国外交官和一些商人的操纵。
en: But a few Chinese in Australia have allowed themselves to become foot soldiers of China’s Leninist (not really communist) dictatorship, manipulated by Chinese diplomats and a few businessmen.

zh: 外交政策的制定和反对政府的选票动员中都可以见到他们的活动的影响。
en: The effects of their activities can be seen in the conduct of foreign policy and in attempts to mobilize votes against the government.

zh: 如今，澳大利亚总理特恩布尔政府已经对这些活动有所反应，立法禁止外国（包括某些慈善机构）捐助政党和活动组织，并要求为外国利益效命的前政客、游说者和高管若想继续参与澳大利亚政治，都必须进行注册。
en: Now Australian Prime Minister Malcolm Turnbull’s administration has responded to this activity, introducing legislation that bans foreign donations to political parties and activist groups, including some charities, and requires former politicians, lobbyists, and executives working for foreign interests to register if they are to be involved in Australian politics.

zh: 这一动作显然是为了阻止外国 — — 具体而言，就是中国 — — 干预澳大利亚的民主生活。
en: The move is explicitly intended to prevent foreign – and, specifically, Chinese – interference in Australia’s democratic life.

zh: 特恩布尔镇压外国势力干预国内政治的措施是巩固澳大利亚在全球南方的地位的果断之举。
en: Turnbull’s crackdown on foreign interference in domestic politics amounts to a bold attempt to strengthen Australia’s position in the global South.

zh: 特恩布尔明确表示，这个国家准备和中国交朋友，但不容胁迫和操纵。
en: The country, Turnbull is making clear, is prepared to be a friend to China, but it will not be bullied or manipulated.

zh: 民主国家统一阵线显然有助于实现这些目标。
en: A united front of democracies would certainly help get that point across.

zh: 但是，特朗普的滑稽动作非但无法支持澳大利亚，实际上还会掣肘特恩布尔的努力。
en: But, beyond failing to support Australia, Trump’s antics are actually undermining Turnbull’s effort.

zh: 和其他许多传统盟国一样，澳大利亚显然也向往着有一天特朗普 — — 及其原始的、适得其反的民族主义 — — 不再会伤害他自己的国家和其他国家。
en: Australia, like so many other traditional allies, surely yearns for the day when Trump, with his crude and self-defeating nationalism, can no longer harm his own country and others.

zh: 中国的援外模式
en: A Chinese Model for Foreign Aid

zh: 新加坡 — — 上个月，比尔和梅林达盖茨基金会发表了一份跟踪联合国可持续发展目标（SDGs）进展状况的报告。
en: SINGAPORE – Last month, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation released a status report tracking progress on the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

zh: 这些数据在凸显人们为消除极端贫困和减少过早死亡所付出努力的同时，也旨在转移人们的注意力。
en: The data, which were meant to highlight efforts to eradicate extreme poverty and reduce premature deaths, was also intended to cajole.

zh: 报告的结论是各国可以，而且应当为应对我们这个星球所共同面临的全球发展挑战而付出更多的努力。
en: Countries can, and must, do more to address the global development challenges that the planet collectively faces, the report concluded.

zh: 在盖茨的报告中，并没有单独提到哪个国家有“恢复世界发展承诺”的潜力。
en: No country was singled out in the Gates report for its potential to restore the “world’s commitment to development.”

zh: 相反，各国领导人都有责任确保到2030年实现可持续发展目标。
en: Rather, “leaders everywhere” bear responsibility for ensuring that the SDGs are met by 2030.

zh: 但我们相信有一个国家可以在实现可持续发展目标时发挥更大的作用：这个国家就是中国。
en: But we believe there is one country that can do more than others to build the world envisaged by the SDGs: China.

zh: 可持续发展目标计划实施两年来，国际发展已来到十字路口。
en: Two years into the SDG program, international development is at a crossroads.

zh: 长期领导援外工作的美国正在撤退；欧洲的情况也差不多（尽管程度没那么严重 ） 。
en: The United States, long the torchbearer of foreign aid, is retreating; so is Europe (albeit to a lesser extent).

zh: 但中国开始展现出全球抱负，有机会为援外概念注入新活力并提供人道主义援助。
en: But China, with its newly articulated global ambitions, has an opportunity to reinvigorate the conception and delivery of humanitarian assistance.

zh: 2015年联合国大会通过的可持续发展目标描绘了未来15年在贫困、教育、公共卫生、不平等、可持续发展和气候行动等一系列领域的全球发展愿景。
en: Adopted by the UN General Assembly in 2015, the SDGs outline a vision for global development that targets poverty, education, public health, inequality, sustainability, and climate action over the next 15 years.

zh: 它明确了广义的发展目标，曾几何时人们眼中的国内问题现在则成为整个世界需要集体应对的挑战。
en: It presents a broad vision for development, whereby issues once viewed as country-specific are treated as challenges for the entire world to tackle collectively.

zh: 相比之下，2015年结束的千年发展目标涉及面相对较窄，其所针对的事务主要影响那些贫困国家。
en: By contrast, the Millennium Development Goals, which ended in 2015, were more narrowly focused, and primarily targeted at issues affecting poor countries.

zh: 但盖茨的研究表明某些可持续发展目标已处于危险当中。
en: But the Gates’ study suggests that some of the SDG targets are already in jeopardy.

zh: 例如目前来看，不太可能在规定时间内实现包括消灭新生儿及儿童可预防死亡的可持续健康目标（SDG 3 ） 。
en: For example, the health goal (SDG 3), which includes a target for eliminating preventable deaths among newborns and children, is unlikely to be achieved in the allotted timeframe.

zh: 以目前的速度，在本世纪中以前无法实现南亚和非洲地区死亡率的下降。
en: At the current pace, mortality reduction in South Asia and Africa will not be realized until mid-century.

zh: 显而易见，更多投资于那些已经被证明有效的地方干预措施在全球范围内都十分必要。
en: Clearly, more investment is needed globally in the types of interventions that have proven effective locally.

zh: 埃塞俄比亚的卫生推广人员计划和马拉维的健康监督助理计划已经被事实证明能有效减少儿童死亡。
en: Ethiopia’s Health Extension Worker program and Malawi’s Health Surveillance Assistant program have been proven to reduce child mortality.

zh: 需要特别拨付援助资金协助这样的项目向其他地区推广。
en: Aid dollars should be earmarked to help programs like these expand to other regions.

zh: 事实是正在发生相反的情况。
en: Instead, the opposite is happening.

zh: 因世界各国民粹主义回潮而愈演愈烈的孤立主义正在对国外援助造成严重的影响。
en: The growing isolationism associated with the populist backlash around the world is having severe consequences for foreign assistance.

zh: 据经合组织统计，2016年针对世界最不发达国家的双边援助出现了近4%的下降。
en: According to the OECD, bilateral aid to the world’s least-developed countries fell by nearly 4% in 2016.

zh: 鉴于官方发展援助（ODA）占这些国家所获援助总额的超过2/3，目前情况对这些国家而言不啻于惊人的援助下降。
en: This is an alarming drop for these countries, given that official development assistance (ODA) accounts for more than two thirds of the aid they receive.

zh: 现在依然是全球孕产妇及儿童健康营养计划最大捐助国的美国正在引领这样的资金撤退运动。
en: The US, which remains the world’s largest donor for nutrition programs and for maternal and child health initiatives, is leading the funding retreat.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统2017年的预算提案包括美国机构将提供给国际开发署供水及卫生项目的资金支持缩减令人震惊的45 % ， 全球卫生资金缩减26 % ， 同时将计划生育资金彻底取消。
en: President Donald Trump’s 2017 budget proposal includes a staggering 45% cut to funding by the US Agency for International Development for water and sanitation projects, a 26% cut to global health funding, and the elimination of funds for family planning.

zh: 尽管还不清楚国会是否会支持特朗普的预算提案（该提案将导致国际社会失去数十亿美元的援助 ） ， 哪怕是美国援助开支的小规模缩减也将损害世界众多最贫困国家。
en: While it is not clear whether Congress will support Trump’s budget request, which would amount to billions of dollars in lost aid, even a minor reduction in US aid spending would hurt many of the world’s poorest.

zh: 美国并不是唯一一个缩减援外资金的国家。
en: The US is not alone in its foreign aid retrenchment.

zh: 欧盟2018年预算草案提出将发展开支缩减9，000万欧元（合1.06亿美元 ） ， 而奥地利、德国和意大利等国都已经将发展援助预算款项转而用于应对移民危机，而后者则被其国内民众视为迫在眉睫的国家安全威胁。
en: The European Union’s 2018 draft budget proposes a €90 million ($106 million) cut to development spending, while Austria, Germany, and Italy have all diverted development assistance budgets towards migration crises viewed as imminent national security threats.

zh: 这些都是令人不安的转变，因为私人慈善根本无法弥补政府援助的撤出。
en: These are troubling trends, because private philanthropy cannot replace aid withdrawn by governments.

zh: 世界需要国际发展新的领军人物，而中国应当接过这一任务。
en: The world needs a new champion for international development, and China should assume the role.

zh: 由于传统捐助国官方发展援助力度不断削弱，中国有机会领导人类发展、贫困缓解和公共卫生支出。
en: With weakening ODA commitments from traditional donors, China has a chance to lead in human development, poverty alleviation, and public health spending.

zh: 现实是中国的援助模式与西方不同。
en: It is true that China’s aid model differs from the West’s.

zh: 欧美从历史上看一直侧重于在鼓励民间社会发展和参与的同时资助医疗保健和教育计划。
en: Europe and the US have historically focused on funding health care and education initiatives, while encouraging civil-society growth and participation.

zh: 而另一方面，中国则以双边援助的形式作为基础，并往往将援助资金用于兴建基础设施项目。
en: China, on the other hand, grants aid on a bilateral basis, and has typically targeted its funding toward infrastructure projects.

zh: 但中国领导人最近也有兴趣为加强民间社团和改善民生提供援助。
en: But Chinese leaders have also recently shown interest in aid to strengthen civil society and improve livelihoods.

zh: 尽管中国的官方发展援助仍然只是经合组织国家开支的一小部分，但中国已经表现出有兴趣在发展援助、尤其是卫生领域担负起领导角色。
en: Although Chinese ODA is still a fraction of what OECD countries spend, China has signaled its interest in becoming a development leader, especially in the health sector.

zh: 在2015年纽约举行的联合国可持续发展高峰会议上，中国承诺出资20亿美元协助实施可持续发展议程，而作为中国发展援助旗舰的一带一路计划在拟议战略中纳入了卫生领域的合作。
en: At the 2015 UN Sustainable Development Summit in New York, China pledged $2 billion to help implement the SDG agenda, and China’s flagship “Belt and Road Initiative” includes health cooperation as part of its proposed strategy.

zh: 2014年，中国也出资4，700万美元协助遏制西非埃博拉疫情的爆发。
en: In 2014, China also committed $47 million to help contain the Ebola outbreak in West Africa.

zh: 虽然这显著低于美国承诺的18亿美元，但中国履行承诺的速度却是最快的。
en: While that was significantly lower than the US pledge of $1.8 billion, China was among the fastest to deliver on its commitment.

zh: 随着中国地缘政治和经济影响力的不断扩大，中国也必须在促进国际和平和发展方面发挥更大的作用。
en: China’s geopolitical and economic influence is growing, and so, too, must its role in promoting international peace and development.

zh: 鉴于中国与西方国家有着不同的政治和意识形态，出现对中国发展意图的怀疑情绪几乎是不可避免的。
en: Skepticism about China’s development intentions will no doubt emerge, given China’s political and ideological differences with the West.

zh: 但这样的怀疑也可能产生积极效果，尤其如果它能促使西方强国重新评估他们撤出援外工作的决策。
en: But the skepticism could yield positive results, especially if it prompts Western powers to reevaluate their foreign aid retreat.

zh: 即便西方国家继续坚持收缩援助，中国也有能力成为经济发展的领导者。
en: Even if it does not, China has the tools to become a leader in international development.

zh: 而且中国也有这方面的经验，因为在1990和2005年间中国曾成功帮助约4.27亿国内民众摆脱极端贫困。
en: And, having lifted some 470 million of its own citizens out of extreme poverty between 1990 and 2005, it also has the experience.

zh: 但更重要的是，中国现在面临着政治机遇。
en: But, more than anything, China now has the political opportunity.

zh: 随着美国和欧洲更多关注国内事务，确保可持续发展目标取得成功将越来越取决于能否鼓励 — — 并且习惯于接受 — — 中国的领导。
en: As the US and Europe turn inward, ensuring the SDGs’ success will increasingly depend on encouraging – and becoming accustomed to – Chinese leadership.

zh: 中国的国际增长日程
en: China’s International Growth Agenda

zh: 米兰—在过去35年的大部分时间里，中国决策者的焦点一直集中在国内经济上，改革也是为了让市场提供效率和准确的价格信号。
en: MILAN – For most of the past 35 years, China’s policymakers have set their focus on the domestic economy, with reforms designed to allow the market to provide efficiency and accurate price signals.

zh: 尽管他们必须日益认识到中国对全球经济影响越来越大，但他们并没有确保中国邻国从中国经济转型中获益的战略。
en: Though they had to be increasingly aware of their country’s growing impact on the global economy, they had no strategy to ensure that China’s neighbors gained from its economic transformation.

zh: 但如今中国有了这一战略，或者正在快速制定这一战略。
en: But now China does have such a strategy, or at least is rapidly developing one.

zh: 此外，这一战略远远超出了亚洲，也包括了东欧和非洲东海岸。
en: Moreover, it extends well beyond Asia, embracing Eastern Europe and the east coast of Africa.

zh: 中国战略的一大关键要素是最新成立的亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行 ） ， 在某种程度上，去年由巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非共同建立的金砖国家新开发银行也可以算上。
en: A key element of China’s strategy is the recently established Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), and to some extent the BRICS’ New Development Bank, established last year by Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.

zh: 这两家银行显然是西方主导的世界银行和国际货币基金组织（IMF）的替代者 — — 或竞争对手。
en: Both banks are obvious alternatives – and so rivals – to the Western-dominated World Bank and International Monetary Fund.

zh: 对这一新战略来说，同样重要的是两条当代丝绸之路：经过中亚抵达黑海的陆路和穿越南海、途经马六甲海峡、渡过印度洋抵达东非，然后经过红海进入东地中海的“海上丝绸之路 ” 。
en: Also vital to the new strategy are two prospective modern-day Silk Roads: an overland route through Central Asia to the Black Sea and a “Maritime Silk Road” by which shipping will pass from the South China Sea, through the Strait of Malacca, across the Indian Ocean to East Africa, and from there through the Red Sea into the eastern Mediterranean.

zh: 经济学家有时把全球经济描述成一个大集市。
en: Economists sometimes portray the global economy as a huge bazaar.

zh: 但并非如此。
en: But it is not.

zh: 全球经济是一张网，其联系通过扩大商品、服务、人力、资本以及 — — 极其重要的 — — 信息流构建。
en: It is a network, in which the links are built by expanding the flows of goods, services, people, capital, and – importantly – information.

zh: 中国的目标是制造这些联系，并且它拥有足够的资产让它作为全球增长和发展的催化剂。
en: China’s goal is to create these links, and it has plenty of assets that will allow it to act as a catalyst of global growth and development.

zh: 最显而易见的资产是中国规模巨大、蒸蒸日上的国内市场，其他经济体可以通过贸易和投资进入这一市场。
en: The most obvious asset is China’s large and growing domestic market, to which other economies can gain access via trade and investment.

zh: 中国将为处于经济发展更早期阶段的国家提供出口市场（和就业 ） ， 在此过程中跻身发达国家行列。
en: China will thus be joining the ranks of the advanced countries in providing an export market (and jobs) for countries at earlier stages of economic development.

zh: 此外，由于中国所构建的投资能力远远超过其国内经济目前的吸收能力，因此必须寻找海外机会 — — 不论是公共还是私人机会。
en: In addition, because China has built up a capacity to invest that is far larger than its domestic economy can now absorb, it will inevitably seek opportunities abroad, both public and private.

zh: 特别是中国公司将日益渴望建立国际品牌。
en: Chinese companies, in particular, will increasingly want to establish their brands internationally.

zh: 在亚投行和新开发银行的参与下，中国已经有了跨国发展战略。
en: With the involvement of the AIIB and the New Development Bank, China has developed what amounts to a multinational development strategy.

zh: 尽管存在质疑者，但对亚投行的普遍支持表明收益大于风险，并且中国的措施有助于构建一个向所有人开放的网络。
en: While there are skeptics, broad support for the AIIB suggests that the benefits outweigh the risks, and that China’s initiatives may help build a network that is open to everyone.

zh: 毕竟，随之而来的贸易和投资不可能都流经中国。
en: After all, the trade and investment that will follow could not possibly all flow through China.

zh: 与此同时，中国与30多家外国央行签订了互换协议（其中第一家央行是2008年9月的韩国央行 ） ， 利用其外汇储备帮助邻国和其他国家抵御国际资本流的波动。
en: Meanwhile, by virtue of more than 30 swap arrangements with other central banks (the first was with South Korea in December 2008), China is using its foreign-exchange reserves to help its neighbors and others defend themselves against volatile international capital flows.

zh: 这与当局促进人民币国际化的方向一致。 人民币正在迅速扩大其在贸易结算中的作用。
en: This is in tandem with the authorities’ efforts to promote the internationalization of the renminbi, which is rapidly expanding its role in trade settlement.

zh: 用贸易伙伴国的货币结算交易而不通过（比如）美元作为中介可以大大提高效率。
en: There are significant efficiency gains to be had by settling transactions in trading partners’ currencies, without the intermediation of, say, the US dollar.

zh: 当然，货币国际化有许多条件，包括庞大的高流动性国内金融市场和建立信任和信心。
en: Of course, there is much more to the internationalization of a currency, not least large and liquid domestic financial markets and the establishment of trust and confidence.

zh: 这需要时间，但中国已经向IMF申请将人民币纳入决定其账户单位 — — 特别提款权（SDR）价值的货币篮子中。 2015年底或能见分晓。
en: This takes time, but China is already applying to the IMF to have the renminbi included in the basket of currencies that determines the value of the Fund’s unit of account, Special Drawing Rights, with a decision likely in late 2015.

zh: 加入美元、英镑、欧元和日元的行列成为SDR俱乐部的一员具有象征性重要意义。
en: Joining the US dollar, the British pound, the euro, and the Japanese yen in the SDR club would be symbolically significant.

zh: 更重要的是，就像2001年中国加入世贸组织需要其做出重大改革一样，满足加入SDR的条件意味着中国必须加快走向资本账户完全自由化 — — 从而实现人民币的完全可兑换。
en: More important, as with China’s accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001, which required substantial reforms, fulfilling the conditions for joining the SDR promises to speed progress toward full capital-account liberalization – and thus toward a fully convertible renminbi.

zh: 中国决策者的眼光十分长远。
en: China’s policymakers have long time horizons.

zh: 毫无疑问，他们的战略在未来几年中将面临阻碍。
en: Their strategy will doubtless face obstacles in the coming years.

zh: 问题在于是否值得从现在开始追求这一战略。
en: The question is whether the strategy is worth pursuing now.

zh: 答案几乎斩钉截铁：是的。
en: The answer almost certainly is yes.

zh: 比如，陆上“丝绸之路”将减少中国对海路的依赖 — — 海路容易遭到阻碍和干扰，特别是在马六甲海峡。
en: The overland “silk road,” for example, will reduce China’s reliance on sea-lanes, which can be blocked or disrupted, especially at the Strait of Malacca.

zh: 从更大范围来说，中国的投资将环节丝绸之路上的经济体因为发达经济体增长放缓和投资不足导致的困难。
en: More generally, Chinese investment will ease the constraints on the silk road economies caused partly by slow growth and investment shortfalls in advanced economies.

zh: 最终，该地区有活力的增长经济体也将给中国的经济和地位带来好处。
en: Ultimately, vibrant growing economies in the region will benefit China’s economy and its stature.

zh: 许多人认为公共部门投资是很好（也许是最好）的使用全球经济生产性资源、提高效率和增长潜力的办法。
en: Many believe that public-sector investment is a good way (perhaps the best way) to use the global economy’s productive resources and increase its efficiency and growth potential.

zh: 但这需要跨国努力。
en: But this requires a multinational effort.

zh: 中国领导人当然希望中国的全球地位获得国际承认。
en: China’s leaders surely want international recognition of their country’s global stature.

zh: 但他们也希望中国跻身高收入国家的过程可以通过有利于邻邦和世界的方式实现 — — 并获得邻邦和世界的承认。
en: But they also want China’s rise to high-income status to occur in a way that is – and that is perceived to be – beneficial to its neighbors and the world.

zh: 中国增长和发展战略的新的外部重点似乎是为了让这一愿景变得现实。
en: The new external focus of China’s growth and development strategy seems to be intended to make that vision a reality.

zh: 旁观者眼中的中国
en: China in the Eye of the Beholder

zh: 发自克劳尔蒙特—当前与中国有关的其中一个显而易见却未能引起足够注意的怪异现象，就是对其领导者的看法是如何随着观察者不同而产生分歧的。
en: CLAREMONT – One of the most glaring, if unremarked, oddities concerning China nowadays is how perceptions of its leaders diverge depending on the observer.

zh: 中国公众眼中的政​​府官员腐败无能，一心只想利用职位捞钱。
en: In the eyes of the Chinese public, government officials are venal, incompetent, and interested solely in getting lucrative appointments.

zh: 而西方企业高管人员却总是认为中国官员聪明、果断、知识渊博、富有远见 — — 大致相同的形容词也曾被他们用来形容倒台之前的​​薄熙来，那个颜面扫地的前重庆党委书记。
en: But Western executives invariably describe Chinese officials as smart, decisive, knowledgeable, and far-sighted – roughly the same adjectives that they once used to describe Bo Xilai, the disgraced Communist Party boss of Chongqing, before he was purged.

zh: 调和这些不同的观点是不可能的。
en: It is impossible to reconcile these views.

zh: 这既不是因为中国公众尖酸刻薄，也并非西方高管冥顽不化。
en: Either the Chinese public is impossible to please, or Western executives are hopelessly wrong.

zh: 但由于日常体验把中国公民置于一个相比西方高管绝对有利的位置去评估中国官员及其行为，因此人们必然得出结论说前者基本上是完全正确的。
en: But, given that daily experience places Chinese citizens in an infinitely better position than Western executives to evaluate Chinese officials and their conduct, one would have to conclude that they are almost certainly right.

zh: 这意味着那些花了相当长的时间了解中国并以经验老到的“中国通”自居的西方人需要思考一下：自己为什么会得出如此错误的结论。
en: And that means that Westerners who have spent considerable time in China and consider themselves seasoned “China hands” need to ask why they have gotten it so wrong.

zh: 一个显而易见的解释是，中国的官员非常善于利用友好的姿态以及慷慨的承诺去迷惑西方商人。
en: One obvious explanation is that Chinese officials are extremely good at seducing Western businessmen with friendly gestures and generous promises.

zh: 一名官员可以一面对普通中国百姓作威作福，转身却展现出不可抗拒的魅力去吸引西方投资者。
en: The same officials who lord it over ordinary Chinese people often summon irresistible charm to woo Western investors.

zh: 西方高管的另一个论据是许多中国官员都拥有工程学背景，相比之下西方官员大多数都是律师出身。
en: Another selling point for Western executives is that many Chinese officials have engineering backgrounds, in contrast to their Western counterparts, most of whom are lawyers.

zh: 在商人看来，工程师是实际问题的解决者，而律师们则痴迷于研究程序的复杂性并热衷于寻找合同漏洞。
en: To businessmen, engineers are practical problem solvers, whereas lawyers are obsessed with procedural complexities and intent on exploiting contractual loopholes.

zh: 此外大多数中国官员已经学会了西方商业术语，可以针对企业需要解决的问题发表睿智的意见。
en: Moreover, most Chinese officials have learned the jargon of Western business, and can speak intelligently about the problems that companies need to solve.

zh: 西方高管产生这些看法的另一个更微妙原因，是他们在评估中国官员时心里存在着一个潜意识的参照框架。
en: A more subtle reason for Western executives’ perceptions is their subconscious frame of reference when assessing Chinese officials.

zh: 跨国公司的高级管理人员往往有先入为主的观念，他们仅仅把中国看作其中一个发展中国家，因此评估中国官员时也与其他发展中国家的官员相比较。
en: Senior executives of multinational companies tend to have pre-conceived notions of China as just another developing country, and thus evaluate Chinese officials by comparing them with those in other developing countries.

zh: 这种无意中的比较通常是对中国官员有利的。 作为一个群体，中国官员受教育程度更高、更国际化、更专注于商业（因为执政的共产党利用经济增长和国外投资来作为官员升迁的标准 ） 。
en: This unwitting comparison usually comes out in favor of Chinese officials, who are, as a group, better educated, more cosmopolitan, and more focused on business (because the ruling Communist Party uses economic growth and foreign investment as criteria for promoting officials).

zh: 同时作为一个国家组织，中国远比其他典型发展中国家更加强大也更具有目的性。
en: And, as an organization, the Chinese state is far stronger and more purposive than states are in more typical developing countries.

zh: 虽然西方商人把中国与其他发展中国家相比较是很自然的事情，但是中国公民有着更高的标准，因为他们没有把中国仅仅当做一个发展中国家。
en: But, while it may be natural for Western businessmen to compare China with other developing countries, Chinese citizens have much higher standards, because they do not regard theirs as just another developing country.

zh: 他们认为中国是一个特别的，重新崛起的大国，必然会加入世界上最先进国家的行列，并且报纸上总是引用富裕社会而非发展中国家的治理实践作为样板。
en: They view China as special, a re-emerging great power bound to join the ranks of the world’s most advanced countries, and the governance practices that their newspapers cite as models are invariably those of rich societies, not developing ones.

zh: 事实上，侮辱中国人的一个最有效方法就是告诉他们，他们应该感到幸运，因为他们比印度人或巴西人拥有一个更好的政府。
en: Indeed, one sure way to insult the Chinese is to tell them they should feel lucky, because they have a better government than the Indians or Brazilians.

zh: 西方商人对中国产生误解的第三个原因是，他们对中国政府的赞美其实是对本国政府感到失望的反映。
en: A third reason why Western businessmen get China wrong is that their admiration of the Chinese government is a reflection of their frustrations with their own governments.

zh: 他们逐渐对杂乱的民主进程、令人窒息的条例、高税收和媒体监督感到不耐烦。
en: They have grown impatient with the messiness of the democratic process, stifling regulations, high taxes, and media scrutiny.

zh: 与此相反，在中国这样的一党制国家中，他们发现与官员做生意更容易，因为官员们可以迅速做出决定并且在同一时间执行。
en: By contrast, in China’s one-party state, they find it is easier to do business with officials who can make quick decisions and implement them almost instantly.

zh: 当然，有时这些高管们也会怀念西方通行的法治。
en: Of course, sometimes these executives do miss the rule of law that prevails in the West.

zh: 但与中国民营企业家相比这些西方大型企业的代理人就是一个特权集体，甚少成为官员腐败行为的受害者。
en: But, compared with Chinese private entrepreneurs, representatives of large Western firms are a privileged group, and are not victimized as frequently by official corruption.

zh: 因此他们很少能直接评价一党统治最糟糕的一面：一个贪婪的，逍遥法外的精英集团。
en: As a result, they have little direct appreciation of the worst aspect of one-party rule: a rapacious, legally unrestrained elite.

zh: 最令人遗憾的是，西方高管对中国政府的误解很可能持续下去，至少在那些没有直接经历中国国家组织黑暗面的人还会坚持这些观点。
en: The most regrettable aspect of Western executives’ misconceptions of the Chinese government is that they are likely to persist, at least among those who have no direct experience with the dark side of the Chinese state.

zh: 这些人往往都成功、睿智，同时在政治判断上都极其自信。
en: They are successful, intelligent, and have a high degree of confidence in their political judgment.

zh: 此外西方企业是等级独裁制也与中国的一党专政相类似，因此高级管理人员的错误判断很少能直接遭到下属的质疑。
en: Moreover, Western corporations are hierarchical and autocratic, similar to the Chinese one-party state, so senior executives’ errors of judgment are rarely challenged directly by their underlings.

zh: 这是一个真正的遗憾。
en: That is a real pity.

zh: 很少西方高管能明白他们这些误解的政治后果。
en: Few Western executives understand the political consequences of their misperceptions.

zh: 他们对中国官员素质和效率的称赞往往被共产党当成对其政策和合法性的国际认可四处炫耀 — — 即使普通中国人知道实情根本不是这个样子的。
en: Their praise of Chinese officials’ quality and effectiveness is often held up by the Communist Party as an international endorsement of its policies and legitimacy – even if ordinary Chinese know otherwise.

zh: 全球经济的新规则制定者
en: The Global Economy’s New Rule-Maker

zh: 发自米兰 — — 在最近发表的一篇香港《南华早报》专栏文章中，汇丰银行大中华区首席执行官黄碧娟表示，中国新崛起的4亿年轻消费者将很快占据该国国内消费额的一半以上。
en: MILAN – In a recent commentary for the South China Morning Post, Helen Wong, HSBC’s chief executive for Greater China, shows that China’s rising generation of 400 million young consumers will soon account for more than half of the country’s domestic consumption.

zh: 她指出这一代人主要是通过创新且整合的移动平台在网上进行交易，这表明其已经“从 前网络时代一步跳跃到了移动互联网，完全越过了个人电脑这个环节 ” 。
en: This generation, Wong notes, is largely transacting online, through innovative, integrated mobile platforms, indicating that it has already “leapt from the pre­web era straight to the mobile Internet, skipping the personal computer altogether.”

zh: 当然，中国中产阶级的崛起早就不是什么新闻了。
en: Of course, China’s rising middle class is not news.

zh: 但数字网络化的年轻消费者究竟会在多大程度上推动中国服务业的快速增长，这点还未得到足够的重视。
en: But the extent to which digitally oriented younger consumers are driving rapid growth in China’s service industries has not yet received ample attention.

zh: 毕竟服务业将有助于推动中国从中等向高收入经济体的结构性转型。
en: Services, after all, will help drive China’s structural transition from a middle- to a high-income economy.
