zh: 不久之前，许多权威人士还在怀疑中国能否从以劳动密集型制造业、出口，基础设施投资和重工业为主的经济转向由内需支撑的服务经济转型。
en: Not too long ago, many pundits doubted that China could make the shift from an economy dominated by labor-intensive manufacturing, exports, infrastructure investment, and heavy industry to a service economy underpinned by domestic demand.

zh: 但即便中国的经济转型还远未完成，其进展也足以令人刮目相看。
en: But even if China’s economic transition is far from complete, its progress has been impressive.

zh: 近年来，中国一直在将其劳动密集型的出口部门转移到劳动力成本较低的其他欠发达国家。
en: In recent years, China has been offloading its labor-intensive export sectors to less-developed countries with lower labor costs.

zh: 在其他行业，它已经转向了更为数字化、资本密集型的生产形式，极大缓解了劳动力成本的劣势。
en: And in other sectors, it has shifted to more digital, capital-intensive forms of production, rendering labor-cost disadvantages insignificant.

zh: 这些趋势意味着供给侧的增长已不再依赖于外部市场。
en: These trends imply that supply-side growth has become less dependent on external markets.

zh: 在这些变化之下，中国的经济实力正在迅速上升。
en: As a result of these changes, China’s economic power is rapidly rising.

zh: 它的国内市场正在快速增长，并可能很快成为世界上第一大市场。
en: Its domestic market is growing fast, and could soon be the largest in the world.

zh: 同时由于中国政府控制了进入该市场的渠道，它可以在亚洲和其他地区施加更多的影响。
en: And because the Chinese government can control access to that market, it can increasingly exert its influence in Asia and beyond.

zh: 与此同时，中国对出口拉动型增长的依赖程度不断下降，使其在面对控制全球市场渠道者的反复无常行为时可以不那么脆弱。
en: At the same time, China’s declining dependence on export-led growth is reducing its vulnerability to the whims of those who control access to global markets.

zh: 但中国并不需要真正限制进入本国市场的渠道以维持增长，它只需要威胁这样做就可以增强其讨价还价的能力。
en: But China does not actually need to limit access to its own markets to sustain its growth, because it can increase its bargaining power by merely threatening to do so.

zh: 这表明中国在全球经济中的地位开始近似于二战后的美国，当时后者与欧洲一样是主要的经济力量。
en: This suggests that China’s position in the global economy is starting to resemble that of the United States during the post-war period, when it, along with Europe, was the dominant economic power.

zh: 在二战后的几十年里，欧洲和美国在全球总产出中所占的比例超过了一半 (最高时将近70 % ) ，但除了石油和矿产等自然资源外它们并不严重依赖其他地方的市场。
en: For decades after World War II, Europe and the US represented well over half (and near 70% at one point) of global output, and they were not heavily dependent on markets elsewhere, other than for natural resources such as oil and minerals.

zh: 当今的中国也在迅速形成类似的格局。
en: Now, China is rapidly approaching a similar configuration.

zh: 它有一个非常庞大的国内市场（且手握准入权 ） ， 不断增加的收入以及极高的总需求；其增长模式越来越多地以国内消费和投资为基础而非依赖于出口。
en: It has a very large domestic market – to which it can control access – rising incomes, and high aggregate demand; and its growth model is increasingly based on domestic consumption and investment, and less on exports.

zh: 但中国将如何发挥其日益增长的经济实力？
en: But how will China wield its increasing economic power?

zh: 在战后时期，发达经济体利用自己的优势地位来为全球经济活动制定规则。
en: In the post-war period, the advanced economies used their position to set the rules for global economic activity.

zh: 虽然它们这样做也是为了让自己受益；但它们也试图尽可能地去包容发展中国家。
en: They did so in such a way as to benefit themselves, of course; but they also tried to be as inclusive as possible for developing countries.

zh: 当然，这些强国不一定非得采取这种做法，它们也可以随心所欲地着眼于自身的更狭隘利益。
en: The post-war powers certainly did not have to take that approach. It was within their power to focus far more narrowly on their own interests.

zh: 但此举可能不是明智的。
en: But that might not have been wise.

zh: 值得记住的是，在第二十世纪经历了两次世界大战之后，和平才是第一要务，其优先级与繁荣等同，甚至要高于繁荣。
en: It is worth remembering that in the twentieth century, following two world wars, peace was the top priority, along with – or even before – prosperity.

zh: 中国展现了朝同一个方向前进的所有迹象。
en: China shows every sign of moving in the same direction.

zh: 它很可能不会追求狭隘的利己主义，主要是因为这样做会削弱其全球地位和影响力。
en: It most likely will not pursue a narrowly self-interested approach, mainly because to do so would diminish its global stature and clout.

zh: 中国已经表明它希望通过扮演一个支持性的伙伴 角色(至少在经济领域) 在发展中国家中 (当然也在亚洲) 发挥影响力。
en: China has shown that it wants to be influential in the developing world – and certainly in Asia – by playing the role of a supportive partner, at least in the economic realm.

zh: 中国能否实现这一目标将取决于它在两个关键政策领域中的所作所为。
en: Whether China can achieve that goal will depend on what it does in two key policy areas.

zh: 第一个是投资，中国在这方面步伐甚快，引入了多项双边和多边动议。
en: The first is investment, where China has moved aggressively by introducing a variety of multilateral and bilateral initiatives.

zh: 例如除了大量投资于非洲国家以外它还在2015年创建了亚洲基础设施投资银行，并于2013年宣布了 “一带一路倡议 ” ， 目的是通过在公路、港口和铁路运输方面的大规模投资来整合欧亚大陆。
en: For example, in addition to investing heavily in African countries, it created the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank in 2015, and, in 2013, announced the “Belt and Road Initiative,” meant to integrate Eurasia through massive investments in highways, ports, and rail transport.

zh: 其次，在贸易和投资方面，中国管理进入其庞大内部市场渠道的手法将对该国所有外部经济伙伴（而不仅仅是发展中国家）产生深远的影响。
en: Second, how China manages access to its vast internal market, in terms of trade and investment, will have far-reaching consequences for all of China’s external economic partners, not just developing countries.

zh: 国内市场是当今中国的力量源泉，这意味着它近期内在这一领域做出的决策将在很大程度上决定其未来几十年的全球地位。
en: China’s domestic market is now the source of its power, which means that the choices it makes in this area in the near term will largely determine its global standing for decades to come.

zh: 无须讳言，中国目前在国内市场准入问题上的立场比其在海外的经济野心更为模糊。
en: To be sure, China’s current position on domestic-market access is less clear than its economic ambitions abroad.

zh: 但中国很有可能走向一个开放的，基本上基于规则的多边框架。
en: But China will most likely move toward an open, largely rules-based multilateral framework.

zh: 根据战后的经验教训，这种方法将发挥最大的外部作用，从而增强中国的国际影响力。
en: The lesson from the post-war period is that this approach will do the most good externally, and will thus enhance China’s international influence.

zh: 在中国的这一发展阶段，这样的做法基本上是百利而无一害。
en: At this stage of China’s development, such an approach will have few if any costs, while most likely conferring many benefits.

zh: 而有待观察的是中美关系的走向。
en: What remains to be seen is how China’s relationship with the US fares.

zh: 美国正遭受非包容性增长模式以及相关政治和社会动荡的困扰，如今其国际经济政策正在背离战后原则。
en: The US is suffering from non-inclusive growth patterns and related political and social upheavals. And it now seems to be departing from its historical post-war approach to international economic policy.

zh: 即使美国在总统特朗普治下走向孤立，它仍然个无法被忽视的大块头。
en: But even if the US is isolating itself under President Donald Trump, it is still too big simply to ignore.

zh: 如果特朗普政府颁布了针对中国的激进政策，中国也别无选择，只能接招应对。
en: If the Trump administration enacts aggressive policies directed at China, the Chinese will have no choice but to respond.

zh: 与此同时，中国可以继续奉行以规则为基础的多边主义做法，并期望得到其他发达国家和发展中国家的广泛支持。
en: Still, in the meantime, China can continue to pursue a rules-based multilateral approach, and it can expect broad support from other advanced and developing countries.

zh: 但关键是不要因为美国的民族主义而分心。
en: The key is not to be distracted by America’s descent into nationalism.

zh: 毕竟谁也不知道这种状况将持续多久。
en: After all, it is anyone’s guess how long that will last.

zh: 中国没问题
en: China is Okay

zh: 纽黑文—对中国经济可能出现硬着陆的担忧一日深过一日。
en: NEW HAVEN – Concern is growing that China’s economy could be headed for a hard landing.

zh: 在过去一年中，中国股市下跌了20 % ， 下探2009年以来的低点。
en: The Chinese stock market has fallen 20% over the past year, to levels last seen in 2009.

zh: 最新数据的持续疲软 — — 不管是采购经理人情绪指标还是工业产出、零售额和出口 — — 更是让不安显露无疑。
en: Continued softness in recent data – from purchasing managers’ sentiment and industrial output to retail sales and exports – has heightened the anxiety.

zh: 许多人担心，长期以来一直是全球经济最有力引擎的中国正在失去燃料。
en: Long the global economy’s most powerful engine, China, many now fear, is running out of fuel.

zh: 这样的担心有些过了。
en: These worries are overblown.

zh: 是的，中国经济有所放缓。
en: Yes, China’s economy has slowed.

zh: 但这种放缓已经被消化了，并且极有可能是在可预见的未来的最低点。
en: But the slowdown has been contained, and will likely remain so for the foreseeable future.

zh: 软着陆的基本面依然十分坚挺。
en: The case for a soft landing remains solid.

zh: 中国硬着陆的特征因2008—2009年大衰退期间而众人皆知。
en: The characteristics of a Chinese hard landing are well known from the Great Recession of 2008-2009.

zh: 当是时，中国年GDP增长率出现了大幅下滑，从2007年二季度14.8%的峰值下落至2009年一季度的6.6 % 。
en: China’s annual GDP growth decelerated sharply from its 14.8% peak in the second quarter of 2007 to 6.6% in the first quarter of 2009.

zh: 2009年令全球贸易量创出历史跌幅记录（10.5 % ） 的可怕外部需求冲击导致中国的出口导向型经济迅速地从繁荣走向了破灭。
en: Hit by a monstrous external demand shock that sent world trade tumbling by a record 10.5% in 2009, China’s export-led growth quickly went from boom to bust.

zh: 随后，中国失衡经济中的其他部门也受到了打击，特别是劳动力市场，光是广东省就减少了2000万个工作岗位。
en: The rest of an unbalanced Chinese economy followed – especially the labor market, which shed more than 20 million jobs in Guangdong Province alone.

zh: 这一回，经济下滑要温和得多。
en: This time, the descent has been far milder.

zh: 中国的年GDP增长率从2010年一季度的峰值11.9%下降至2012年二季度的7.6 % ， 降幅只有大衰退期间8.2个百分点的一半。
en: From a peak of 11.9% in the first quarter of 2010, China’s annual GDP growth slowed to 7.6% in the second quarter of 2012 – only about half the outsize 8.2-percentage-point deceleration experienced during the Great Recession.

zh: 在排除了欧元区发生无序解体的情形后（可能性极低 ） ， IMF对2012年全球贸易的基线预测是全年增长4 % ， 这一预测颇为合理。
en: Barring a disorderly breakup of the eurozone, which seems unlikely, the International Monetary Fund’s baseline forecast of 4% annual growth in world trade for 2012 seems reasonable.

zh: 该数字要低于1994—2011年间的趋势增长率6.4 % ， 但仍比2008—2009年的崩盘水平高出不少。
en: That would be subpar relative to the 6.4% growth trend from 1994 to 2011, but nowhere near the collapse recorded during 2008-2009.

zh: 而中国经济对出口导向部门危险的抵御力远高于两三年前，因此硬着陆不会发生。
en: With the Chinese economy far less threatened by export-led weakening than it was three and a half years ago, a hard landing is unlikely.

zh: 实事求是地说，中国经济还面临其他难题，特别是对过热房地产市场的政策降温。
en: To be sure, the economy faces other headwinds, especially from the policy-induced cooling of an overheated housing market.

zh: 但所谓的社会保障房的建设 — — 受益者为低收入家庭，最近天津、重庆、长沙等大城市以及贵州和广东等省份都宣布了保障房投资计划 — — 足以抵消跌势。
en: But construction of so-called social housing for lower-income families, reinforced by recent investment announcements in key metropolitan areas such as Tianjin, Chongqing, and Changsha, as well as in Guizhou and Guangdong Provinces, should more than offset the decline.

zh: 此外，与三四年前的各项计划都需要依赖银行融资因而导致了令人担忧的地方政府债务过重的忧虑不同，中央政府将在本轮项目融资中扮演更重要角色。
en: Moreover, unlike the bank-funded initiatives of 3-4 years ago, which led to a worrisome overhang of local-government debt, the central government seems likely to play a much greater role in financing the current round of projects.

zh: 关于空城、空桥和空机场的报道使得西方分析师担心失衡中国经济将卷土重来，重蹈2009年上半年覆辙。
en: Reports of ghost cities, bridges to nowhere, and empty new airports are fueling concern among Western analysts that an unbalanced Chinese economy cannot rebound as it did in the second half of 2009.

zh: 中国固定资产投资占GDP的比重正在接近前无古人的50 % ， 因此西方分析师担心新的投资导向的财政刺激只能让中国加速迈向崩溃的宿命。
en: With fixed investment nearing the unprecedented threshold of 50% of GDP, they fear that another investment-led fiscal stimulus will only hasten the inevitable China-collapse scenario.

zh: 但悲观派忽视了中国现代化最重要的推动力之一：世界历史上前所未见的城市化进程。
en: But the pessimists’ hype overlooks one of the most important drivers of China’s modernization: the greatest urbanization story the world has ever seen.

zh: 2011年，城镇人口占总人口比例第一次跨过了50 % ， 达到了51.3 % ， 而1980年时还不到20 % 。
en: In 2011, the urban share of the Chinese population surpassed 50% for the first time, reaching 51.3%, compared to less than 20% in 1980.

zh: 此外，根据OECD的预测，中国早已形成快速增长之势的城镇人口将在2030年时再增加3亿 — — 增量相当于当前美国总人口。
en: Moreover, according to OECD projections, China’s already burgeoning urban population should expand by more than 300 million by 2030 – an increment almost equal to the current population of the United States.

zh: 每年将有1500—2000万人从农村走入城市，当下的所谓鬼城将很快变成明天的繁荣大都市。
en: With rural-to-urban migration averaging 15 to 20 million people per year, today’s so-called ghost cities quickly become tomorrow’s thriving metropolitan areas.

zh: 上海浦东便是一个经典例子，说明了20世纪90年代末的“空”城建设项目是如何变成拥挤的城市中心地带的。 如今，浦东人口已经达到了550万。
en: Shanghai Pudong is the classic example of how an “empty” urban construction project in the late 1990’s quickly became a fully occupied urban center, with a population today of roughly 5.5 million.

zh: 麦肯锡的一项研究估计，到2025年，中国将至少有220个人口超百万的城市，而2010年只有125个；更有23个大城市人口将突破500万。
en: A McKinsey study estimates that by 2025 China will have more than 220 cities with populations in excess of one million, versus 125 in 2010, and that 23 mega-cities will have a population of at least five million.

zh: 建设新城市对中国来说刻不容缓。
en: China cannot afford to wait to build its new cities.

zh: 投资和建设必须跟上未来城市居民大增的趋势。
en: Instead, investment and construction must be aligned with the future influx of urban dwellers.

zh: “鬼城”论完全站不住脚。
en: The “ghost city” critique misses this point entirely.

zh: 所有这些都只是中国宏伟蓝图的一部分。
en: All of this is part of China’s grand plan.

zh: 30年来颇为有效的生产者模式不可能将中国带入繁荣的乐土。
en: The producer model, which worked brilliantly for 30 years, cannot take China to the promised land of prosperity.

zh: 中国领导人早就知道了这一点，这一点通过温家宝总理2007年著名的“四不”批评就可一窥端倪 — — 温家宝警告说，要警惕“不稳定、不平衡、不协调、说到底不可持续”的经济。
en: The Chinese leadership has long known this, as Premier Wen Jiabao signaled with his famous 2007 “Four ‘Uns’” critique – warning of an “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and ultimately unsustainable” economy.

zh: 两大外部冲击 — — 首先是美国，现在是欧洲 — — 已将四不警告转变为行动。
en: Two external shocks – first from the US, and now from Europe – have transformed the Four Uns into an action plan.

zh: 从前，中国过度依赖来自被危机重创的发达国家的外部需求，如今，中国已开始实施刺激消费的十二五规划，其中包括一个能够提供数十年发展动力的再平衡战略。
en: Overly dependent on external demand from crisis-battered developed economies, China has adopted the pro-consumption 12th Five-Year Plan, which lays out a powerful rebalancing strategy that should drive development for decades.

zh: 大规模城市化所需要的投资和建设是这一战略的关键支柱。
en: The investment and construction requirements of large-scale urbanization are a key pillar of this strategy.

zh: 目前，城镇人均收入是农村水平的三倍。
en: Urban per capita income is more than triple the average in rural areas.

zh: 只要城市化能够伴随就业创造 — — 该战略有中国大力推进服务导向型发展的政策支持 — — 劳动收入和消费者购买力水平就能得到改善。
en: As long as urbanization is coupled with job creation – a strategy underscored by China’s concomitant push into services-led development – labor income and consumer purchasing power will benefit.

zh: 与中国怀疑论者认为的相反，城市化绝非伪增长，而是“下一个中国”的关键组成部分，因为这能丰富中国的周期性和结构性选择。
en: Contrary to the China doubters, urbanization is not phony growth. It is an essential ingredient of the “next China,” for it provides China with both cyclical and structural options.

zh: 当面临需求短缺时 — — 不管原因是外部需求冲击还是内部调整，比如房地产价格的修正 — — 中国可以相应地加大城市化导向的投资力度。
en: When faced with a shortfall of demand – whether owing to an external shock or to an internal adjustment, such as the housing-market correction – China can tweak its urbanization-led investment requirements accordingly.

zh: 中国拥有巨大的剩余储蓄量，预算赤字不到GDP的2 % ， 因此有充足的资金来做这些事情。
en: With a large reservoir of surplus savings and a budget deficit of less than 2% of GDP, it has the wherewithal to fund such efforts.

zh: 货币宽松的空间也很充足：与西方央行不同，中国人民银行的弹药库相当充盈。
en: There is also ample scope for monetary easing; unlike central banks in the West, the People’s Bank of China has plenty of ammunition in reserve.

zh: 对出口导向型经济来说，减速并不令人震惊。
en: A growth slowdown is hardly shocking for an export-led economy.

zh: 但中国比世界其他国家的境况要好得多。
en: But China is in much better shape than the rest of the world.

zh: 有力的再平衡战略提供了避免硬着陆所需要的结构性和周期性支持。
en: A powerful rebalancing strategy offers the structural and cyclical support that will allow it to avoid a hard landing.

zh: 中国的无就业增长之谜
en: China’s Jobless Growth Miracle

zh: 发自北京 — — 中国国家总理李克强最近指出创造就业是实现本国“稳定增长最终目标”的关键因素。
en: BEIJING – Chinese Prime Minister Li Keqiang recently cited job creation as vital to his country’s “ultimate goal of stability in growth.”

zh: 而他的这一论断也是极为正确的。
en: His observation could not be more accurate.

zh: 事实上，中国经济崛起的其中一个最令人困惑的特征就是，即便在实现两位数增长率的时期，1978年~2004年间的年均就业增长率也仅为1.8 % 。
en: In fact, one of the most baffling features of China’s economic rise is that, even amid double-digit GDP growth, employment grew at a measly 1.8% average annual rate from 1978 to 2004.

zh: 这似乎表明，普通中国家庭在很大程度上未能分享中国经济增长的成果。
en: Households, it seems, have largely missed out on the benefits of economic development in China.

zh: 导致GDP增长与就业增长之间差距的表面因素是对低效率国有企业的整改，导致公共部门就业数量大幅下跌，1995年至2004年间，就业人口从1.126亿下降至6700万。
en: The superficial explanation of the discrepancy between GDP growth and job gains attributes the gap to the restructuring of inefficient state-owned enterprises (SOEs), which caused public-sector employment to plummet, from 112.6 million to 67 million, from 1995 to 2004.

zh: 但是，还有一个更深层次的原因：中国的工业化倾向。
en: But there is a more fundamental cause: China’s bias toward industrialization.

zh: 中国政府一直认为工业化是现代化的关键。
en: China’s government has long viewed industrialization as the key to modernization.

zh: 在毛泽东的大跃进时期甚至大量收集废旧金属进行冶炼以满足过分乐观的钢铁产量目标，从而推动工业快速发展。
en: During Chairman Mao’s Great Leap Forward, scrap metals were melted to meet wildly optimistic steel-production targets and thus to propel rapid industrial development.

zh: 如今政府则推动工业和基础设施项目，通过鼓励投资和增加税收，让经济满足雄心勃勃 — — 但不再轻率 — — 的增长目标。
en: Today, the government promotes industrial and infrastructure projects that, by encouraging investment and generating tax revenues, enable the economy to meet ambitious – though no longer harebrained – growth targets.

zh: 问题是，制造业在创造就业机会方面贡献甚小，主要是因为该行业生产率增长较快 — — 过去二十年间年均10％以上 — — 因而限制更多的劳动力需求。
en: The problem is that the manufacturing sector does little to create jobs, largely because relatively high productivity growth in the sector – averaging more than 10% annually over the last two decades – constrains demand for more workers.

zh: 相比之下，中国服务业的年生产率增长只有大约5 ％ ， 也是创造就业机会的更有效引擎。
en: By contrast, China’s services sector has registered only about 5% annual productivity growth, and thus is a much more effective engine of job creation.

zh: 事实上，服务业在大多数发达经济体中的就业中占了最大的份额。
en: In fact, services are responsible for the lion’s share of employment in most advanced economies.

zh: 但在2012年，当美国80％的劳动力受雇于服务业时，中国只有36％的劳动力在这个部门工作。
en: But, whereas 80% of the American labor force was employed in service industries in 2012, only 36% of China’s workers worked in the sector.

zh: 要强化服务业的就业，中国政府必须放松监管，减少例如电信业所存在的行业壁垒，鼓励劳动力流动。
en: To bolster employment in services, China’s government must loosen its regulatory grip, ease barriers to entry in branches like telecommunications, and encourage labor mobility.

zh: 中国把重点放在工业生产带来了另一个问题：这是一个高度资本密集型部门，而原因主要是政府政策造成的扭曲。
en: China’s focus on industrial production is problematic in another respect: it is extremely capital-intensive, owing largely to the distortions wrought by government policies.

zh: 除了维持利率低于市场水平之外，政府还为汽车、机械以及钢铁等几个行业提供优先廉价信贷渠道，优惠税收待遇和公共投资支持。
en: Beyond keeping interest rates below market levels, the government offered the automobile, machinery, and steel industries, among others, preferential access to cheap credit, favorable tax treatment, and public investment support.

zh: 这些政策促使企业采用资本密集型技术，进一步淡化了劳动力的自然比较优势。
en: Such policies spurred firms to adopt capital-intensive technologies, obscuring labor’s natural comparative advantages.

zh: 与此同时，政府借助限制融资渠道的干预手段来限制民营企业的发展。
en: At the same time, the government’s interventions have limited the growth of private-sector firms by impeding their access to finance.

zh: 虽然国有企业只雇佣了占劳动力总量13％的人口，只贡献了约30％的GDP，但它们吸收了投资总额的一半。
en: Though SOEs employ only 13% of the total workforce, and contribute about 30% of GDP, they absorb half of all investment.

zh: 总之，银行和政府把手中资金的35％投资给国有企业，但只有10％投资于私人公司。
en: Together, banks and the government provide about 35% of investment in SOEs, but only 10% of investment in private companies.

zh: 但是，民营企业的劳动密集程度明显高于国有企业 — — 而国有企业占用的资本是民营企业的几乎四倍之多 — — 因此近十年来一直担负着中国大部分的就业机会。
en: But private firms are significantly more labor-intensive than SOEs – which use almost four times as much capital – and thus have been responsible for most of China’s job creation in recent decades.

zh: 随着每年10.4％的平均就业增长，正规私营部门在1995年至2004年间一定程度上弥补了国有企业裁员。
en: With average employment growth of 10.4% per year, the formal private sector partly compensated for the SOE layoffs from 1995 to 2004.

zh: 非正规私营部门增长更快，年增长率达24 ％ ， 但这是建立在基数较低的基础上的。
en: The informal sector grew even faster, at an annual rate of 24%, albeit from a low base.

zh: 鉴于私营部门的蓬勃发展和迅速扩大带来了极大的好处，中国政府应采取措施，以确保这些公司 — — 尤其是常常被挡在信贷市场门外的中小规模企业 — — 能够获得扩张所需的资本。
en: Given the obvious benefits of a flourishing and rapidly expanding private sector, China’s government should take steps to ensure that such firms – especially the small and medium-size enterprises that so often are crowded out of credit markets – can access the capital they need to expand.

zh: 这将必然带来就业机会的激增。
en: This would inevitably lead to a surge in job creation.

zh: 但令人感到难受的事实是，中国家庭从这个国家的经济增长奇迹中获益太少。
en: The uncomfortable truth is that Chinese households have benefited far too little from the country’s economic-growth miracle.

zh: 实际上，在过去十年中家庭收入占国民收入的比例大幅下降，与发达经济体形成鲜明对比，在那些国家家庭收入的占比一直很高。
en: Indeed, households’ share of national income has declined considerably in the last decade, in sharp contrast to the advanced economies, where households’ share is consistently high.

zh: 通过允许私营企业蓬勃发展，并鼓励向以服务为导向的经济结构转变，中国政府可能会加强就业增长，继而增加国内消费。
en: By allowing the private sector to flourish, and encouraging the shift toward a services-oriented economy, China’s government could bolster employment growth and, in turn, domestic consumption.

zh: 李克强似乎认识到，经济结构再平衡不仅可以提高中国公民的福祉，更是在漫长的全球不确定性时期促进经济和社会稳定的保障。
en: As Li seems to recognize, structural rebalancing is needed not only to improve Chinese citizens’ wellbeing, but also to bolster economic and social stability at a time of profound global uncertainty.

zh: 中国能拯救全球秩序吗？
en: Can China Save the Global Order?

zh: 安纳波利斯—在1月份的达沃斯世界经济论坛年会上，中国国家主席习近平用中国自身的最新经验为全球化辩护，并提出了一个包容性、可持续发展的愿景。
en: ANNAPOLIS – At the World Economic Forum’s Annual Meeting in Davos in January, Chinese President Xi Jinping, drawing on China’s own recent experience, spoke in defense of globalization, and offered a vision of inclusive, sustainable development.

zh: 在美国总统特朗普政府与国际主义渐行渐远之际，中国站出来支撑了全球领导力。
en: With US President Donald Trump’s administration turning its back on internationalism, China has stepped forward to assume the mantle of global leadership.

zh: 中国真的能够提供维持全球化引擎运转所需要的新的解决方案吗？
en: But can China really provide the alternative solutions needed to keep the engines of globalization running?

zh: 自2008年金融危机以来，战后自由秩序陷入了严重的麻烦。 金融危机削弱了西方经济体，也冲击了全球治理机构和监管当局。
en: The post-war liberal order has been in serious trouble since the 2008 financial crisis, which weakened Western economies and undermined global-governance bodies and regulatory institutions.

zh: 据国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁拉加德，危机爆发后，新兴经济体贡献了全球总增长的80%多，目前它们的GDP占全球的60 % 。
en: According to International Monetary Fund Managing Director Christine Lagarde, emerging economies accounted for over 80% of global growth in the aftermath of the crisis, and now contribute 60% of global GDP.

zh: 与此同时，新兴力量，特别是中国和俄罗斯，进一步受到关键自由派机构和价值观的束缚。
en: Meanwhile, emerging powers, particularly China and Russia, have further undermined key liberal institutions and values.

zh: 2014年俄罗斯吞并克里米亚和干预叙利亚挑战了“保护责任 ” （ R2P）等人道主义干预原则，而中国崛起正面临着战后全球秩序中的西方霸权 — — 不论是硬实力还是软实力。
en: Russia’s 2014 annexation of Crimea and intervention in Syria have challenged principles of humanitarian interventionism such as the “responsibility to protect” (R2P); and a rising China is confronting the West’s supremacy – in hard- and soft-power terms – in the post-war global order.

zh: 美国对这些发展态势的应对之道是试图建立自有秩序2.0，方法就是战略性转向亚洲，捍卫现状。
en: The US has responded to these developments by trying to create a liberal order 2.0, and by pursuing a strategic pivot to salvage the status quo in Asia.

zh: 许多观察者聚焦于美国在遏制中国的地区主宰地位方面的角色。
en: Many observers have focused on America’s goal of preventing Chinese regional dominance.

zh: 但美国还想捍卫和强化让战后亚洲得以成功的原则 — — 及美国前助理国务卿库尔特·坎贝尔（Kurt Pambell）所谓的的亚洲的“操作系统 ” 。
en: But the US also wants to defend and strengthen the principles that made post-war Asia’s success possible – what former US Assistant Secretary of State Kurt Campbell calls Asia’s “operating system.”

zh: 因此，奥巴马政府着手推进缅甸民主；执行保护航海自由的规则；并完成了美国与其他11个环太平洋国家之间的跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP ） 。
en: Thus, the Obama administration pursued democracy promotion in Myanmar; enforced rules protecting freedom of navigation at sea; and concluded the Trans-Pacific Partnership agreement between the US and 11 other Pacific Rim countries.

zh: 与此同时，2015年12月，美国国会批准了IMF 2010年配额和治理改革；2016年10月，IMF理事会将人民币纳入构成IMF账户单位 — — 特别提款权（SDR）的货币篮子。
en: Meanwhile, in December 2015, the US Congress ratified the IMF’s 2010 Quota and Governance Reforms; and in October 2016, the IMF Executive Board added the Chinese renminbi to the basket of currencies comprising the Fund’s unit of account, Special Drawing Rights.

zh: 如果希拉里·克林顿（Hillary Clinton）赢得2016年美国总统大选，现在我们将看到美国继续领导世界振兴和保持亚洲及其他地区存在已久的现状。
en: If Hillary Clinton had won the 2016 US presidential election, we would now be seeing a continued US-led effort to reinvigorate and preserve the longstanding status quo in Asia and beyond.

zh: 但随着特朗普的上台，许多人担心现有国际安排很快将寿终正寝。
en: But with Trump in office, many fear that existing international arrangements could soon be upended.

zh: 美国在保持自由世界秩序中的利益来自它的角色，即政治学家所谓的体系中的“负责任的受托人”和“特权者 ” 。
en: America’s interest in maintaining the liberal world order stems from its role as what political scientists call a “responsible fiduciary” and “privilege taker” in that system.

zh: 但特朗普将美国霸权视为一个负担，似乎没有察觉到它给美国带来的特权，比如控制世界主要储备货币所带来的诸多好处。
en: But Trump sees US hegemony as a burden, and seems oblivious to the privileges that it affords, not least the many benefits associated with controlling the world’s main reserve currency.

zh: 但与此同时，特朗普又不愿意牺牲美国在全球超然独立的地位，这意味着他表现出偏好贸易战，甚至军事冲突。
en: But, at the same time, Trump does not want to cede America’s global preeminence, which means that he could show a penchant for trade wars, or even military conflicts.

zh: 在如此世界中的中国的角色时，值得注意中国自21世纪第一个十年的末期以来发生了一个根本性变化，它不再关注国际地位，转而更加专注于国家复兴，或“中国梦 ” 。
en: In considering China’s role in such a world, it is worth noting a fundamental shift in Chinese thinking since the late 2000s, away from concern with international status and toward a narrower focus on national rejuvenation, or the “Chinese Dream.”

zh: 比如，哈佛大学的阿拉斯泰尔·伊恩·约翰斯顿（Alastair Iain Johnston）的一份中国媒体分析认为 ， “ 习近平的主要思想不是关注反对国外‘敌对势力 ’ ， 而是‘中华民族的伟大复兴 ’ 。 ”
en: For example, an analysis of Chinese media by Harvard University’s Alastair Iain Johnston concludes that, “Instead of a focus on anti-foreign ‘hostile forces,’ Xi’s primary ideological message is the ‘great revival of the Chinese nation.’”

zh: 外交政策现实派根据一国的自我感知或物质能力定义超级大国地位。
en: Foreign-policy realists define great-power status in terms of a country’s self-perception or material capacities.

zh: 但是，对中国来说，地位要放到它与既成权威即西方的关系中感受。
en: For China, however, status is conceived in the context of its relationship with the established authority, namely the West.

zh: 从20世纪90年代开始，中国认为美国和西方代表着全球主流。
en: Starting in the 1990s, China began to see the US and the West as representing the global mainstream.

zh: 中国领导人也许并不想加入西方，但他们显然寻求西方的承认。
en: While Chinese leaders might not aspire to join the West, they have certainly sought its recognition.

zh: 他们不想让中国被看成敌对修正主义力量，被归为现有秩序的“外部集团 ” 。
en: They do not want China to be perceived as a hostile revisionist power, and cast into the “outgroup” of the existing order.

zh: 因此，中国开始向西方靠拢，寻求进一步融入全球经济。
en: This is why China began to gravitate toward the West and seek further integration into the global economy.

zh: 中国政府的改革思维认定中国要“与国际接轨 ” 。
en: The government’s reformist ideology dictated that China “connect with the international track.”

zh: 但是，2008年金融危机后，中国突然发现这一“国际轨道”陷入了麻烦。
en: But, after the 2008 financial crisis, the Chinese suddenly discovered that the “international track” was in trouble.

zh: 既是出于必要，也是出于选择，中国开始变得以自我为中心的“后责任 ” （ post-responsible）力量。
en: By necessity, but also by choice, China has since become a self-centered, “post-responsible” power.

zh: 它不再像过去那样受到现状的束缚，而是更倾向于改变现状。
en: It is now less constrained by the status quo, and more intent on changing it.

zh: 幸运的是，中国的行为不像是传统意义上的修正主义力量，而是继续深度致力于经济全球化。
en: Fortunately, China is not acting like a traditional revisionist power, and it remains deeply committed to economic globalization.

zh: 中国领导人将中国视为这一过程的新引擎。
en: Chinese leaders see their country as the new engine of that process.

zh: 2013年以来，习近平一直在推动中国的大规模“一带一路”计划，该计划旨在通过全球互通和基础设施投资刺激增长。
en: Since 2013, Xi has been rolling out China’s massive “one belt, one road” program, designed to stimulate growth through global connectivity and infrastructure investment.

zh: 中国不想看到分裂的亚洲或沿地缘政治裂缝分裂的碎片化的地区区块，因此它通过共同利益来培养国际睦仪。
en: China does not want a divided Asia or fragmented regional blocs built along geopolitical fissures, so it is cultivating international comity through shared interests.

zh: 但试图高举经济全球化的火炬引领世界前进的过程中，中国将面临一系列独特的问题。
en: But China will face a unique set of problems as it tries to carry the torch of economic globalization forward.

zh: 首先，它仍然是一个发展中国家，其国内形势兼具政治风险和经济不确定性。
en: For starters, it is still a developing country, and its domestic landscape is fraught with political perils and economic uncertainties.

zh: 习近平政府正在勉力保持国内稳定，中国需要摆脱劳动密集型的大量投资拉动的经济增长，转向基于国内消费和服务的增长模式。
en: Xi’s government is struggling to maintain domestic stability as it moves China away from labor-intensive, investment-heavy economic growth toward a model based on domestic consumption and services.

zh: 国内日程的主要地位意味着中国领导全球变革的努力将缺少明确的愿景和一致的战略。
en: The primacy of this domestic agenda means that China’s attempt to lead global change will lack a clear vision and coherent strategy.

zh: 第二个问题来自中国未竟的国际地位转型。
en: A second problem stems from China’s incomplete transition on the world stage.

zh: 在二战中一战而胜后，美国立刻就毫无争议地主宰了地球。
en: After prevailing in World War II, the US immediately and undeniably dominated the globe.

zh: 而寻求领导下一阶段经济全球化的中国缺少类似的地缘政治实力和合法性。
en: China, in seeking to lead the next stage of economic globalization, enjoys no such geopolitical power and legitimacy.

zh: 西方和发展中国家观察者之一中国所提出的方案到底是不是真正的公共品；比如，许多人怀疑中国“一带一路”计划是一个自私的单边阴谋。
en: Observers in the West and the developing world question whether the solutions China is offering are genuine public goods; many suspect that China’s “one belt, one road” initiative, for example, is a self-serving, unilaterally imposed scheme.

zh: 这一不确定性构成了一个中心点：也许自由世界秩序会陷入麻烦，但中国领导的另辟蹊径局势仍不明朗。
en: That uncertainty underscores a central point: while the liberal world order could be in trouble, a Chinese-led alternative is not yet discernible.

zh: 公平和自由贸易
en: Fairness and Free Trade

zh: 坎布里奇—今年年底，世界贸易体系将面临重要转折点，这个转折点因为近15年前中国加入世贸组织而延迟到现在。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The global trade system faces an important turning point at the end of this year, one that was postponed when China joined the World Trade Organization almost 15 years ago.

zh: 美国和欧盟必须决定是否在贸易政策中开始将中国作为“市场经济”对待。
en: The United States and the European Union must decide whether they will begin to treat China as a “market economy” in their trade policies.

zh: 不幸的是，虽然这场战争随着今年的深入而逐渐升级，但选择的条件决定了不会对全球贸易机制更深层次的缺陷做出任何修补。
en: Unfortunately, even as the battle escalates over the course of this year, the terms of the choice ensure that nothing will be done to address the global trade regime’s deeper flaws.

zh: 2001年12月签署的中国加入世贸组织协定允许贸易伙伴在最长15年的时间里将中国视为“非市场经济 ” （ NME ） 。
en: China’s WTO accession agreement, signed in December 2001, permitted the country’s trade partners to deal with China as a “non-market economy” (NME) for a period of up to 15 years.

zh: 非市场经济地位让进口国更容易以反倾销税的形式对中国出口商品施加特别关税。
en: NME status made it a lot easier for importing countries to impose special tariffs on Chinese exports, in the form of antidumping duties.

zh: 特别是，它们可以用比较昂贵的国家的生产成本作为中国真正成本的标准，这样就提高了发现倾销的可能性和倾销利润估计。
en: In particular, they could use production costs in more expensive countries as a proxy for true Chinese costs, increasing both the likelihood of a dumping finding and the estimated margin of dumping.

zh: 如今，尽管阿根廷、巴西、智利和韩国等许多国家已经给予中国市场经济地位，但世界最大的两个经济体 — — 美国和欧盟 — — 并未这样做。
en: Today, though many countries, such as Argentina, Brazil, Chile, and South Korea, have already rewarded China with market-economy status, the world’s two biggest economies, the US and the EU, have not.

zh: 但是，不论它们是否这样做，反倾销手段都不适合作为解决不公平贸易问题的手段 — — 不是因为这些问题没有真凭实据，而是因为它们远远超过了倾销范畴。
en: But, regardless of whether they do, antidumping measures are ill-suited to the task of addressing concerns about unfair trade – not because such concerns are ungrounded, but because they go well beyond dumping.

zh: 反倾销给最恶劣的保护主义打开了方便之门，同时对需要合法政策空间的国家没有任何益处。
en: Antidumping facilitates protectionism of the worst kind, while doing nothing for countries that need legitimate policy space.

zh: 经济学家从未对世贸组织的反倾销规则感兴趣。
en: Economists have never been fond of the WTO’s antidumping rules.

zh: 从严格的经济学角度，定价低于成本对进口经济体来说不是问题，只要参与这一策略的企业没有垄断市场的可能。
en: From a strictly economic standpoint, pricing below costs is not a problem for the importing economy as long as the firms that engage in the strategy have little prospect of monopolizing the market.

zh: 因此，国内竞争政策常常要求拿出反竞争行为证据或成功掠夺的可能性证据。
en: That is why domestic competition policies typically require evidence of anti-competitive practices or the likelihood of successful predation.

zh: 但是，根据世贸组织规则，出口国定价低于成本足以成为施加进口关税的理由，即使这只不过是标准的竞争行为 — — 如在经济衰退期间。
en: Under WTO rules, however, pricing below costs on the part of exporters is sufficient for imposing import duties, even when it is standard competitive practice – such as during economic downturns.

zh: 这和其他程序方面的考虑让反倾销成为企业在光景困难时寻求免受外来对手竞争的保护的比较喜欢的图景。
en: This and other procedural considerations make antidumping the preferred route for firms to obtain protection from their foreign rivals when times are tough.

zh: 世贸组织确实有一个具体的“保护”机制，允许各国在进口导致本国企业“严重受伤”时临时施加关税。
en: The WTO does have a specific “safeguard” mechanism that enables countries to raise tariffs temporarily when imports cause “serious injury” to domestic firms.

zh: 但该机制的程序性障碍较大，使用它的国家必须补偿受到不利影响的出口国。
en: But the procedural hurdles are higher for safeguards, and countries that use them have to compensate adversely affected exporters.

zh: 数字证明了一切。
en: The numbers speak for themselves.

zh: 1995年世贸组织成立以来，共实施过3,000多项反倾销税（印度、美国和欧盟最常使用这一手段 ） 。
en: Since the WTO was established in 1995, more than 3,000 antidumping duties have been put in place (with India, the US, and the EU being the heaviest users).

zh: 相应地，保护措施只是用了155次（发展中国家最常用 ） 。
en: The corresponding number for safeguard measures is a mere 155 (with developing countries being the heaviest users).

zh: 显然，反倾销贸易救济的主力之选。
en: Clearly, antidumping is the trade remedy of choice.

zh: 但除了经济效率，全球贸易机制还必须解决公平问题。
en: But the global trade regime has to address issues of fairness, in addition to economic efficiency.

zh: 当国内企业必须与受到财大气粗的政府的金融支持的（比如）中国企业竞争时，大部分人都会认为此时的竞争环境是不可接受的。
en: When domestic firms must compete with, say, Chinese firms that are financially supported by a government with deep pockets, the playing field becomes tilted in ways that most people would consider unacceptable.

zh: 某种类型的竞争优势破坏了国际贸易的合法性，即使（如本例中）它们对进口国产生了总体经济收益。
en: Certain types of competitive advantage undermine the legitimacy of international trade, even when (as with this example) they may imply aggregate economic benefits for the importing country.

zh: 因此，反倾销机制属于政治逻辑。
en: So the antidumping regime has a political logic.

zh: 贸易决策者对这一逻辑耳熟能详，这也是反倾销机制之所以以现在的形式出现、促成相对容易的保护的原因。
en: Trade policymakers are deeply familiar with this logic, which is why the antidumping regime exists in its current form, enabling relatively easy protection.

zh: 贸易官员从来不明说的是，公平问题超越了倾销的范畴。
en: What trade officials have never taken on board is that the fairness argument extends beyond the dumping arena.

zh: 如果国内企业与受到政府补贴或支持的外国单位竞争是不公平的，那么国内工人与缺少集体讨价还价权利或职场体罚保护的外国工人竞争难道就公平吗？
en: If it is unfair for domestic firms to compete with foreign entities that are subsidized or propped up by their governments, is it not similarly unfair for domestic workers to compete with foreign workers who lack fundamental rights such as collective bargaining or protections against workplace abuse?

zh: 掠夺环境、使用童工或就业环境危险的企业难道不也是不公平竞争��来源吗？
en: Aren’t firms that despoil the environment, use child labor, or provide hazardous employment conditions also a source of unfair competition?

zh: 这些关于不公平贸易的问题是反全球化抵制的核心。
en: Such concerns about unfair trade lie at the heart of the anti-globalization backlash.

zh: 但合法贸易救济让它们只能存在于定价低于成本的狭隘范畴之内。
en: Yet legal trade remedies permit little room for them beyond the narrow commercial realm of below-cost pricing.

zh: 工会、人权非政府组织、消费者组织或环保组织无法获得企业所获得的直接保护。
en: Labor unions, human rights NGOs, consumer groups, or environmental organizations do not have direct access to protection in the way that firms do.

zh: 贸易专家长期以来一直担忧向劳动和环境标准或人权等问题开放世贸组织机制，害怕贸易主义的滑坡谬误。
en: Trade experts have long been wary of opening up the WTO regime to questions about labor and environmental standards or human rights, fearing the slippery slope of protectionism.

zh: 但日益明确的是，将这些问题排除在外造成了更大的伤害。
en: But it is becoming increasingly clear that excluding these issues does greater damage.

zh: 与经济、社会和政治模式截然不同的国家做贸易确实会引起合法性问题。
en: Trade with countries that have very different economic, social, and political models raises genuine concerns about legitimacy.

zh: 拒绝承认这些问题只能破坏贸易关系；也有害于整个全球贸易机制的合法性。
en: Refusal to acknowledge such concerns not only undermines these trade relationships; it also jeopardizes the legitimacy of the entire global trade regime.

zh: 所有这些都不意味着民主国家不应该与非民主国家做贸易。
en: None of this implies that democracies should not trade with non-democracies.

zh: 要点在于商业逻辑不是决定它们的经济关系的唯一考虑因素。
en: The point is that commercial logic is not the only consideration that should govern their economic relationships.

zh: 我们可以摆脱 — — 因而必须面对 — — 得自贸易的收益有时需要以国内社会安排的牺牲为代价的困境。
en: We cannot escape – and therefore must confront – the dilemma that gains from trade sometimes come at the expense of strains on domestic social arrangements.

zh: 公共讨论和协商是民主国家掂量矛盾价值和做出权衡的唯一办法。
en: Public discussion and deliberation are the only way that democracies can sort out the contending values and tradeoffs at stake.

zh: 与中国和其他国家的贸易纠纷是晾出 — — 而不是镇压 — — 这些问题、进而向世界贸易机制民主化卖出重要一步的机会。
en: Trade disputes with China and other countries are an opportunity for airing – rather than repressing – these issues, and thus taking an important step toward democratizing the world’s trade regime.

zh: 习近平的改革序幕
en: Xi’s Reform Gambit

zh: 香港—35年前，当邓小平开启中国的市场经济改革时，他和中国共产党承担了自1949年人民共和国成立以来最大的政治风险。
en: HONG KONG – When Deng Xiaoping initiated China’s market-oriented reforms 35 years ago, he – and the Chinese Communist Party – was taking the biggest political risk since the founding of the People’s Republic in 1949.

zh: 当习近平主席在去年的中共十八大三中全会上启动他的改革日程时，他也承担了同样巨大的风险。
en: When President Xi Jinping unveiled his own reform agenda at last year’s Third Plenum of the 18th CCP Congress, he was taking an equally large risk.

zh: 他的改革战略会带来成果吗？
en: Will his strategy pay off?

zh: 1979年，邓小平处于十分困难的境地。
en: In 1979, Deng was in a difficult situation.

zh: 他知道从中央计划的平均社会主义向市场经济的资本主义的转变可能会动摇中共的统治，而短期内财富的不平等积累也可能引发巨大的社会和政治动荡。
en: He knew that the shift from centrally planned egalitarian socialism toward market-oriented capitalism could destabilize the CCP’s rule, and the unequal accumulation of wealth in the short term could cause significant social and political division.

zh: 但是，在经历了文革十年动乱后，当时的中国已经站在了经济和社会崩溃的边缘，他必须采取行动，因为除此之外别无选择。
en: But, with China on the verge of economic and social collapse, following the decade-long chaos of the Cultural Revolution, he had to take action – and there were few, if any, alternatives available.

zh: 邓小平的改革最终收到了巨大成效：三十多年两位数字的经济增长。
en: The reforms turned out to be extremely rewarding: more than three decades of double-digit economic growth followed their implementation.

zh: 此外，邓小平的改革也让中共巩固了政权， 但给不同的人和地区带来了贫富不均，而这一问题比邓小平所预想的还要难以解决。
en: Moreover, they allowed the CCP to retain its hold on power. But they benefited some people and regions much more quickly than others – a problem that was tougher to address than Deng had anticipated.

zh: 习近平的改革和邓小平当初的改革类似，是别无选择的选择。
en: Xi’s reforms, like Deng’s, reflect the absence of alternatives.

zh: 不但中国的劳动密集、出口及投资拉动型增长模式已经失去动力；低效的官僚主义、无处不在的腐败、严重的贫富差距、 不断恶化的污染等问题正在损害着中国的长期发展前景。
en: Not only has China’s labor-intensive, investment-led growth model run out of steam; bureaucratic inefficiencies and pervasive corruption – not to mention severe and worsening pollution – are also damaging China’s long-term prospects.

zh: 只有解决这些问题并转向基于创新、包容、及环境可持续的增长模式，中国才能继续繁荣， 并最终步入高收入行列。
en: Only by addressing these weaknesses and shifting to an innovation-based, environmentally sustainable growth model can the country continue to prosper – and ultimately achieve high-income status.

zh: 两人改革的不同之处在于，习近平必须处理邓小平改革初期没有预料到的新问题 。
en: The difference between the two reform efforts is that Xi must also address the shortcomings of Deng’s work.

zh: 邓小平认为，仍在经济中扮演核心角色的政府，能够使用市场所产生的新资源来纠正他的改革所引发的短期不平等。
en: Deng mistakenly believed that the state, which retained its central role in the economy, would be able to use new market-generated resources to correct the short-run inequalities created by his reforms.

zh: 但现实是官僚体系及其特权网在改革过程中不仅成了最大的既得利益，而大量的官员腐败还形成了非源于市场的第二种不平等。
en: But the bureaucracy and its privileged networks benefited most, and a second, non-market source of inequality – endemic official corruption – became entrenched.

zh: 因此，习近平的反腐运动成为改革的关键前奏。
en: That is why Xi’s anti-corruption campaign was a critical precursor to reform.

zh: 除了完成中国向更开放、更市场化的经济转型，习近平还必须建立适用于所有人的法治精神，同时解决尖锐的机会、收入、 财富和福利不平等的矛盾。
en: In other words, beyond completing China’s transformation into an open, market-based economy, Xi must establish a strong rule of law that applies to all, while addressing acute inequality of income, opportunity, wealth, and wellbeing.

zh: 习近平所追求的改革必须能让人、资金、自然资源、信息和企业更加自由地在部门、地区和国家间流动。
en: For this reason, Xi must pursue reforms that allow people, money, resources, information, and companies to move more freely across sectors, regions, and national borders.

zh: 由此带来的财富和机会的趋同将产生巨大的经济与社会效益，并将改变中国、亚洲和世界的经济地理。 这种改头换面的变革必然会伴随巨大的创造性破坏。
en: The resulting convergence of wealth and opportunities would generate massive economic and social gains.

zh: 此外，只有在中国的当权者能够容忍各种短期及局部价格波动时，包括住房、股票、劳动力、自然资源和货币等要素价格的波动， 市场的力量才能通过市场规律的自然实现过程来降低长期的扭曲及不平等。
en: But, by effectively transforming the economic geography of China, Asia, and the world, liberalization would also lead to significant creative destruction.

zh: 在市场规律下，短期的价格扭曲正是套利的机会，而短期套利的行动也是导致长期价格趋同及收入平等的动力。
en: Furthermore, market forces could reduce inequality in the longer term only if China’s authorities tolerated the short-term inequalities created by fluctuations in prices for housing, stocks, labor, natural resources, and currency.

zh: 问题在于中国的官员更偏好短期稳定，且相信政府比市场更有能力调控短期经济波动，他们往往将调控短期经济波动的权利保留给政府及市场监管者。 而这往往导致政府宏观调控权力的扩大及市场自然调节过程的弱化，结果往往是阻碍了创新和增长。
en: The problem is that the Chinese bureaucracy prefers stability, and it has strong incentives to strengthen its own position relative to the market, thereby exacerbating power inequalities and dampening innovation and growth.

zh: 另一方面，中国的大量未完成的改革任务仍然需要依靠政府官员领头来实施，特别是需要他们的努力来提出可以凝聚社会共识的改革政策 。
en: Yet the bureaucracy remains integral to the implementation of any policy that promotes social cohesion.

zh: 要想遏制由一些自负且腐败的官员导致的滥用权利的系统性风险，习近平必须在制度方面重新平衡官员的激励机制。
en: To mitigate the serious systemic risks stemming from the power of China’s overweening, corrupt mandarins, Xi must rebalance their incentives.

zh: 他已开始着手根除贪污、限制行政审批权、削减国有部门的权力、明确土地的产权、提升福利、税收和金融监管的透明度及公平性等改革。
en: He is already working to eliminate graft, restrict the scope of administrative approvals, reduce the state-owned sector’s advantages, clarify property rights in land, and simplify welfare, tax, and financial regulations.

zh: 这些结构性的制度改革不仅可以降低系统性风险，如果新的制度成功建立并可以保持，还能形成正真的“改革红利 ” 。
en: Beyond reducing systemic risks, these efforts – if they are sustained – could generate “reform dividends” over time.

zh: 但制度性的激励问题并不局限于官员。
en: But the incentive problem is not confined to the bureaucracy.

zh: 系统性制度改革需要承认和弥补两类原罪：一类是官员的以权谋利；另一类是资本家及既得利益团体通过违反、破坏、或改变公平规则来谋利 。
en: Systemic reform requires recognizing and atoning for two original sins: not only that of bureaucrats who made money by abusing their power, but also that of capitalists who made money by breaking the rules.

zh: 最能说明这一挑战的莫过于国有企业和民营企业之间的竞争。
en: This challenge is best illustrated in the competition between state-owned enterprises and private firms.

zh: 民营企业无法获得补贴和低成本融资，它们的失败让其他人不敢从事创新和富有挑战的领域。
en: The failure of private firms that lack access to subsidies or affordable financing deters others from innovating and challenging the status quo.

zh: 与此同时，有些国有企业可能因为腐败和能力欠缺而投资过剩产能并产生净损失，可还是可以获得政府补贴而不必面临破产。
en: Meanwhile, SOEs – which can invest in excess capacity, record net losses (often through corruption and incompetence), and count on government subsidies – never face a reckoning.

zh: 好的激励机制应该确保宏观经济政策，如低利率和宽松的信贷，适用所有合格公司，而不是以所有权性质、企业大小、地区等歧视性条款来分配。 而是否合格应由企业的竞争力决定，并通过平等竞争获得融资机会。
en: The implication is that macroeconomic policies like low interest rates and easy access to credit should be used to ensure equal access to credit for all qualified companies, based on their competitiveness, not their ownership.

zh: 不幸的是，实施这些措施有时需要包含微观层面的政府各个部门的干预，往往导致政府权力的进一步扩大。
en: Unfortunately, implementing such measures would entail micro-level bureaucratic intervention, leading to further expansion of state powers.

zh: 正因如此，不仅需要严惩腐败官员，让他们明白滥用权力是不可容忍的并放弃对市场行为的不合理的干预，也需要给予努力工作的官员恰当的激励，如更高的薪水及明确的业绩指标和奖励。
en: That is why the bureaucracy must be given incentives – higher salaries, clear performance indicators, and awareness that abuses of power will not be tolerated – to abandon the micro-management of market activities.

zh: 最近，尽管金融市场持续波动，但中国经济金融的决策部门仍放宽了宏观经济政策，这为明年落实大量制度性改革奠定了基础。 制度性改革是为了降低系统性风险，是确保中国未来可持续发展所必须做的。
en: China’s recent relaxation of macroeconomic policy, despite ongoing market volatility, is an important step toward breaking unnecessary barriers to implementing the reforms needed to mitigate systemic risks.

zh: 但大部分的制度性改革在短期往往会导致宏观紧缩及波动，需要较为宽松的宏观环境来缓解短期实体经济面临的困难。 习近平的反腐运动已经扳倒了中共内部的一些大“老虎 ” ， 大大降低了中国可持续增长的系统性风险，现在是专注于制度性结构改革的时候了。
en: Now that Xi’s anti-corruption campaign has taken down some of the CCP’s biggest “tigers,” it is time to focus on structural reform.

zh: 如能具备正确的方针和持续的政治愿景，习近平的改革可以给中国带来比邓小平的改革有过之而无不及的回报。
en: With the right approach and sustained political will, Xi’s risk-taking can bring China the kind of returns that Deng’s did – and more.

zh: 中国城市的新常态
en: The New Normal in China’s Cities

zh: 香港—几十年来，城市化的快速发展使中国出现了一批知识和制造业集中的大都会，它们大多坐落在能很好地与全球经济相连的区域。
en: HONG KONG – For decades, rapid urbanization in China created clusters of knowledge, manufacturing, and distribution in areas that benefited from well-established connections to the global economy.

zh: 但这一增长模式已经达到了极限。
en: But that growth model has reached its end.

zh: 2013年中国城市居民人口比例达到了53 % ， 而1981年仅为20 % ， 这表明中国正在进入一个城市化、工业化、信息化、现代化市场经济的“新常态 ” 。
en: With the share of people living in cities rising to 53% in 2013, from 20% in 1981, China is shifting to a “new normal.”

zh: 国家主席习近平指出，新常态的目标是确保年经济增长在7%左右，以高附加值制造、信息技术和现代化农业生产的新机遇为增长驱动力。
en: According to President Xi Jinping, the aim is to ensure annual economic growth of around 7%, driven by new opportunities in value-added manufacturing, information technologies, and modernized agricultural production.

zh: 但是，在向这一目标迈进的过程中，中国将面临困难的资产负债表的结构调整，这一调整无法仅仅依靠传统财政和货币政策来轻松解决。
en: In moving toward this goal, however, China will face difficult balance-sheet adjustments that cannot easily be managed by conventional fiscal and monetary policies.

zh: 德意志银行（Deutsche Bank）新的研究报告指出，去年中国300个城市土地出让金收入下降了37 % — —相当大的降幅，而土地出售占地方政府收入的比例占35 % 。
en: A new Deutsche Bank study reports that, last year, China’s 300 cities faced a 37% drop in their land-sale revenues – a major setback, given that land sales accounted for 35% of total local-government revenues.

zh: 更重要的是，2009—2013年间，土地出让金收入以平均每年24%的超高速度增长。
en: Such revenues had risen at an average annual rate of 24% from 2009 to 2013.

zh: 此外，去年12月年度消费者和生产者通胀率分别下降到1.5%和-3.3 % ， 部分原因是全球油价暴跌。
en: Moreover, annual consumer and producer inflation dropped to 1.5% and -3.3%, respectively, last December, owing partly to the sharp decline in world oil prices.

zh: 如今，中国面临着通缩和不利的外部经济环境，其以城市为中心的经济也在偿债能力、流动性和结构调整等复杂的挑战中互动与挣扎。
en: China now faces deflation and an inhospitable external economic environment, and its urban centers are struggling with the complex interaction of solvency, liquidity, and structural issues.

zh: 但一些城市比另一些更能抵御挑战。
en: But some cities are better equipped than others to weather these challenges.

zh: 中国的一二线城市十分富有，这是得益于高房价和人才、资本、公司以及投资项目的持续流入。
en: China’s first- and second-tier cities are very wealthy, benefiting from high property values and the continuous inflow of talent, capital, companies, and investment projects.

zh: 尽管房地产市场有所减速，但最近北京土地拍卖仍创出了每平方米38,000元人民币的历史记录。
en: Despite a property-market slowdown, Beijing’s recent land auction concluded with record-breaking prices of about CN¥38,000 ($6,200) per square meter.

zh: 另一方面，由于资产价格下跌、劳动力外流以及需要确定新的增长模式，三、四线城市面临着更加艰巨的资产负债表调整的挑战。
en: Third- and fourth-tier Chinese cities, however, face more challenging balance-sheet adjustments, owing to falling asset prices, outflows of labor, and the need to define new growth models.

zh: 在经历了2008年以债务驱动的基础设施投资热潮之后，这些城市需要改革，包括改变与中央政府的收入分成方式、增加地方预算的透明度和完善问责制、并完善市政债券的用途和地方基础设施项目的公私合作模式。
en: In the aftermath of the post-2008 debt-fueled infrastructure-investment boom, these cities need to reform how revenue is shared with the central government, increase the transparency and accountability of local budgets, and overhaul the use of municipal-bond and public-private partnership models for local infrastructure projects.

zh: 在实施这些变革前，这些城市必须先解决积压的失败工程和亏损的国有企业问题。
en: But, before such changes can be implemented, these cities must address the overhang of poorly performing projects and loss-making state-owned enterprises (SOEs).

zh: 事实上，中国城市和地方企业所需要的流动性比传统发达国家的通缩、信用紧缩和价格下跌情形下的需求更多，因为地方政府和国有企业的基础设施和房地产投资仍在消耗大量资金。
en: In fact, Chinese cities and local enterprises will need even more liquidity than would be required in a classic case of deflation, credit tightening, and falling prices, because infrastructure and property investments by local governments and SOEs are still consuming funds.

zh: 此外，由于国家对基准利率及许多投资项目的控制，市场还无法以足够快的速度仅仅通过利率调整来实现有效的资源配置。
en: And, given state intervention, interest rates do not adjust quickly enough to allocate resources efficiently.

zh: 中国人民银行已经试图通过降低利率及放松流动性等政策来帮助实体经济，但它也担心这样做会导致通胀、股市投机、助长房地产行业的过度投资和其它的产能过剩。
en: Of course, the People’s Bank of China could lower the interest rate and relax its liquidity policy. But it remains concerned that doing so would spark inflation and fuel wasteful investment – and greater excess capacity – in the real-estate sector.

zh: 可是，保持相对较紧的流动性也有一些难以接受的后果。
en: Maintaining relatively tight liquidity, however, also has serious consequences.

zh: 首先，当外部流动性相对宽松，而中国流动性相对较紧，这会给影子银行带来利率上升的压力，并助长人民币套息交易的增长，及促使汇率升值，特别是相对那些没有与美元挂钩的、正在贬值的货币升值 。
en: For starters, as long as external conditions remain relatively liquid, tighter conditions in China put upward pressure on interest rates in the shadow-banking sector. Together with the growth of the renminbi carry trade, this has pushed up the exchange rate at a time when non-US dollar-linked currencies are largely depreciating.

zh: 此外，利率波动和不确定性鼓励了套利行为，导致部分央行提供的流动性流向了一些有损于社会利益的寻租和股票投机，而没有实现帮助实业的初衷。
en: Moreover, interest-rate volatility and uncertainty encourages arbitrage and investment in socially costly rent-seeking and speculation, with central-bank liquidity flowing to financial markets, instead of fulfilling its intended purpose of helping the real sector.

zh: 尽管经济增长有所放缓，但自去年7月以来，中国A股市场仍上涨了近50 % ， 银行业利润仍然畸高。
en: Despite slowing growth, China’s A-share market has risen by nearly 50% since last July, and the banking sector’s margins remain exceptionally large.

zh: 与此同时，非金融私营部门信心仍萎靡不振，因为需求低迷而生产成本还在上升。
en: Meanwhile, confidence in the non-financial private sector remains depressed, as diminished demand leads to increased production costs.

zh: 中国的增长模式所依赖的一个重要的治理制度就��： 地区、城市、公司和个人在日益市场化但仍受中央监管的经济环境中的竞争。
en: China’s growth model hinges on a governance system in which regions, cities, companies, and individuals compete within an increasingly market-oriented, but still centrally regulated, economy.

zh: 像中国这样的一个非常多元化大国，任何一刀切的政策都很难确保市场的有效运行， 毕竟，不同的地方经济有不同的需要。
en: But, in a country as large and diverse as China, a one-size-fits-all approach will not ensure that the market functions effectively. After all, different local economies have different needs.

zh: 以佛山市经济为例。 佛山经济以私营企业为驱动力，人均GDP比北京和上海更高。
en: Consider the city of Foshan’s economy, which, driven by private-sector activity, boasts a higher per capita GDP than Beijing or Shanghai.

zh: 可是，2011年，佛山的银行信用占GDP之比只有85 % — —远低于上海的184%和北京的221 % — —因此佛山在客观条件上应该比其它高负债地区更有条件使用土地作为抵押贷款来扩大投资。
en: Given that Foshan’s ratio of bank credit to GDP in 2011 was only 85% – much lower than Shanghai’s 184% and Beijing’s 221% – the city could use land as collateral to borrow money to expand investment.

zh: 全国性地收紧信用政策，尽管对高负债地区来说或许有必要，但却可能会阻碍像佛山这类高生产力城市的经济增长。
en: A tight national credit policy, though potentially useful in some highly indebted areas, would impede such growth-enhancing activities in Foshan.

zh: 更普遍、更重要的一个问题 是，大部分强化市场配置所需要的结构性工具 — — 包括长期规划、区域规划、环境标准、产权和破产程序 — — 都是在地方层面实施的。
en: More generally, most of the structural tools needed to strengthen market allocation – including planning, zoning, environmental standards, property rights, and bankruptcy procedures – are implemented at the local level.

zh: 此外，地方经济可能在增长模式改变的阶段需要经历一个“创造性的破坏过程 ” ， 这就带来了新的动荡因素，可能导致暂时性的经济减速，拖累总体经济的增长，并对短期流动性提出更多的要求。
en: And, adding yet another layer of variability, local economies may experience “creative destruction” as their growth models change, potentially causing temporary slowdowns that drag down overall growth.

zh: 在这样的背景下，维持中国经济转型、防止硬着陆的最好办法是实施宽松的货币和信用政策，让生产率最高的城市、公司和行业创造新的增加值，并同时推出通常有紧缩效应的结构性改革。
en: Against this background, the best way to sustain China’s economic transition and prevent a hard landing is to implement looser monetary and credit policies that enable the most productive cities, companies, and industries to generate new added value.

zh: 如今，通胀和资产泡沫的风险被油价下跌和过剩产能所遏制，正是实施这一相对宽松的货币及财政政策的良机。
en: With the risks of inflation and asset bubbles being mitigated by lower oil prices and excess capacity, now is a good time to initiate this policy shift.

zh: 当然，中国可能会面临一些短期调整的冲击，因此这一政策转变的积极效果需要一些时间才能显现。
en: Of course, China will probably face some short-term headwinds, so the positive effects of this shift will take some time to emerge.

zh: 中央政府通过财政改革和反腐运动已经巩固了对整体宏观经济的掌控，但在地方层面组织实施下一阶段的结构改革，则需要巧妙的协调各种改革及宏观政策的匹配。
en: As the central government consolidates its power through fiscal reform and an anti-corruption campaign, orchestrating the next phase of structural reforms at the local level will require deft coordination.

zh: 在经历了几十年的高增长和成功政策实验后，周期性超调 — — 体现在过剩产能、鬼城和地方债务积压等现象上 — — 已见怪不怪。
en: After decades of high-speed growth and policy experimentation, cyclical overshoots – reflected in excess capacity, ghost towns, and local-debt overhangs – are no surprise.

zh: 如今，是纠正这些问题的时候了。
en: Now it is time to address them.

zh: 只有直面这些结构性问题，中国才能完成向更发达、更平等、更可持续的“新常态”的转型。
en: Only by confronting these structural issues can China complete its shift to its new, more developed, and more equitable “normal.”

zh: 中国如何改善政策透明度？
en: China’s Transparency Problem

zh: 香港—中国经济在今年冬天遭遇出人意料的严重伤寒 — — 严重到全球所有市场都因此打了寒战。
en: HONG KONG – The Chinese economy has caught a surprisingly severe cold this winter – a cold so bad that almost all global markets are sneezing.

zh: 在2016年的前两周，上证综指下跌18 % 。
en: During the first two weeks of 2016, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 18%.

zh: 1月15日，该指数收于2,901点 — — 接近去年夏天股市大幅波动的低点。
en: On January 15, the index closed at 2,901 – very close to the trough of last summer’s stock-market crash.

zh: 海外分析师几乎一致预测将爆发另一场市场崩溃甚至硬着陆。
en: Foreign analysts almost uniformly predict another market crash or even a hard landing.

zh: 而国际石油价格也下跌到每桶28美元，全球经济传染病的幽灵开始浮现。
en: With oil prices dipping below $28 per barrel, the specter of a global economic pandemic has appeared.

zh: 中国的新年金融市场冲击可归因于几个因素，主要与政策清晰度及其执行过程的透明度不够有关。
en: China’s New Year financial-market shock has been attributed to several causes, primarily related to policy transparency and clarity.

zh: 其一是中国叫停了股市“熔断机制 ” ， 该机制不仅没能遏制波动，反而刺激了新一轮抛售潮。
en: One was the reversal of China’s attempt to install a stock-market “circuit breaker,” which, far from tempering volatility, spurred a new wave of selloffs.

zh: 另一个问题 — — 也许是更严重的挑战 — — 是市场搞不懂人民币汇率的变动方向，人民币兑美元汇率经历了连续十天的逐渐贬值，这个短期的趋势刺激了资本外流，直到央行出手干预。
en: The other – arguably more serious – problem was market confusion about the direction of the renminbi exchange rate, following a gradual but constant ten-day depreciation against the US dollar that fueled capital outflows, until the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) intervened.

zh: 据央行的说法，新年前后的贬值主要源于人民币汇率机制的一个技术性改变，即人民币汇率从之前的维持与美元的汇率稳定转向以维持与一揽子货币的汇率稳定（官方没有正式公开一揽子货币成分 ） 。
en: According to the PBOC, the confusion arose from a technical change in the process of setting the renminbi exchange rate, with the common reference rate against the US dollar replaced by a rate established on the basis of an undisclosed basket of key international currencies.

zh: 这一改革本意是为了增强人民币的稳定性，特别是在美元相对其它货币大幅升值的时候；但这个变化对市场冲击不小，市场更喜欢人民币兑美元汇率的稳定，而不愿面对参照一揽子货币的有管理的浮动汇率的不确定性。
en: This reform may be intended to boost the renminbi’s stability; but it is not good for markets, which prefer stability against the dollar to the uncertainty of a managed float.

zh: 这不是市场第一次被初衷良好的改革打得措手不及。
en: This is not the first time markets have felt blindsided by well-meaning reforms.

zh: 去年8月，中国人民银行宣布人民币银行间市场汇率将由更加市场化的机制决定，即每日参考基准汇率将基于前一日的收盘汇率。
en: Last August, the PBOC announced a more market-oriented mechanism for setting the renminbi exchange rate in the interbank market, with the daily fixing rate to be based on the previous day’s closing price.

zh: 可是，在执行这个新政策时，由于央行同时将人民币兑美元一次性贬值1.9 % ， 市场错误地认为，中国将调整政策引导人民币贬值。
en: But, because the move coincided with a one-time devaluation of 1.9% against the US dollar, markets wrongly assumed that the central bank would pursue a policy-induced depreciation.

zh: 不清晰的政策沟通由于全球经济形势低迷而对市场形成了愈加复杂的冲击。
en: Unclear policy communication was compounded by global developments.

zh: 去年12月，美联储决定提高联邦基金利率，再加上油价崩溃造成的不确定性，让投资者纷纷降低了对中国的风险敞口，并转向美元安全资产。
en: The US Federal Reserve’s decision in December to raise the federal funds rate, together with the uncertainty generated by collapsing oil prices, has also spurred investors to reduce their China exposure and switch to dollars.

zh: 中国央行认识到汇率超调可能远远大于股市，特别是在新兴经济体，于是开始稳定汇率，大举干预离岸人民币市场，并收紧对短期跨境资本流动的管制。
en: Recognizing that exchange rates can overshoot much more than the stock market, especially in emerging economies, the PBOC moved to stabilize the exchange rate, intervening heavily in the offshore renminbi markets and tightening controls on short-term cross-border capital flows.

zh: 另一方面，去年12月，中国政府重申将致力于实施棘手的市场化改革，包括针对环境污染、产能过剩、债务积压、高税收、官僚主义和国有企业垄断特权等问题的改革措施。
en: In December, China’s government reiterated its commitment to implementing tough market-oriented reforms, including measures to address environmental pollution, overcapacity, excessive debt, high taxes, bureaucratic red tape, and monopoly privileges for state-owned enterprises (SOEs).

zh: 问题在于短期投资者不会坐等长期改革的成效 — — 它们更偏爱用短期对冲手段规避对冲不明确的短期汇率和其它宏观政策。
en: The problem is that short-term investors are unlikely to wait around for long-term reforms to pay off – preferring short-term hedges against unclear exchange-rate policy.

zh: 所有现代经济体的政策制定及执行者都对金融市场的剧烈短期价格波动和实体经济更具渐进性的长期结构调整之间的矛盾感到焦头烂额。
en: All modern economies struggle with the inconsistency between sharp and volatile short-term price movements in financial markets and more gradual long-term structural adjustments in the real economy.

zh: 在过去，中国决策者可以集中精力于实体经济的长期发展而不必担心金融市场的短期波动，但今时不同往日，如今他们必须管理好利率和汇率自由化以及更大更快的国内和国际资本流动带来的短期波动。
en: Unlike in the past, when Chinese policymakers were able to concentrate on the real economy without worrying about excessive financial-market instability, they now must manage short-term volatility caused by liberalized interest and exchange rates, together with larger and faster capital flows both within and across borders.

zh: 对中国来说，协调旨在稳定短期市场及宏观经济的凯恩斯主义财政和货币政策和旨在调整产业结构的长期改革绝非易事 — — 特别是在需要防止增长下降太多以至于干扰市场预期的限制条件下。
en: For China, coordinating short-term Keynesian fiscal and monetary policies aimed at stabilizing markets with long-term changes to the industrial structure – all without allowing growth to fall low enough to disrupt expectations – will be no easy feat.

zh: 但有一点是明确的：与市场参与者和实体经济参与者的有效沟通是决策层建立可信度及稳定市场预期的关键。
en: But one thing is clear: effective communication with market participants and real-economy players is crucial to market credibility and stability.

zh: 在相对封闭简单的经济体中，达到政策��果比解释复杂政策更重要。
en: In relatively closed economies, explaining complex policies is less important than delivering results.

zh: 但随着外部参与和互动的日益增加，保持稳定意味着通过透明可信的决策和行动锚定市场信心。
en: But with increasing foreign participation and interaction, maintaining stability means anchoring market confidence with transparent, credible policymaking and action.

zh: 中国需要精通市场的中央和地方政府官员和国有企业管理者来实施短期宏观稳定措施及长期结构改革。
en: Only with market-savvy central- and local-government officials and SOE managers can China implement short-term stabilization measures or long-term structural reforms.

zh: 正如中国证监会主席肖刚及其它资深官员及市场人士最近感叹，中国这样的人才太少；具备这种才能的人更愿意在其它地方赚取更高收入，他们也担心当局市场化 改革是否会收到限制，甚至害怕卷入腐败。
en: The problem, as China Securities Regulatory Commission Chairman Xiao Gang recently lamented, is that such talent is not widely available in the country; those who possess it tend to seek higher pay elsewhere, worry about the limits of the authorities’ market-friendly approach, or even feel vulnerable to corruption accusations.

zh: 吸引市场人才加入中国庞大的官僚体系的一个关键点是政府高层需要鼓励下属果断独立的政策执行并容忍善意的决策失误，让有才干的官员在面对不确性而作出实时决定时不会有太大压力。
en: The key to attracting market-oriented talent to China’s large bureaucracy is to make it clear that risk-taking – and even failure – will be tolerated.

zh: 这样，政策制定与执行才能跟上市场的节奏，及有效响应新的发展趋势，从而维持较高的市场信心水平。
en: Only if skilled officials feel comfortable making real-time decisions under uncertain conditions can the state keep pace with markets, responding effectively to new developments and thus maintaining high levels of confidence.

zh: 为了支持官员果断决策，包括作出削减产能和重组倒闭企业等不受欢迎的决定，中国还需要保持决策程序的透明以确保公平对待所有相关利益方。
en: To support officials during this process, which will include unpopular decision such as cutting capacity and restructuring failed enterprises, China also needs transparent processes that ensure fairness to all stakeholders.

zh: 中国在处理当前面临的各种挑战时具有许多有利条件。
en: China is in a strong position to handle the challenges that it faces.

zh: 增长尽管不如过去三十年那么快，但仍相对强势。 中国外汇资产头寸以及中央政府和家庭部门资产负债表都很健康。
en: Growth, while slower than in the last three decades, remains relatively strong, as does China’s foreign-asset position and its central-government and household-sector balance sheets.

zh: 稳定的市场需要稳定的政策转型。
en: Stable markets need stable policy transitions.

zh: 通过不断建立与维护政策的可信度及培养熟练应对市场变化的监管能力，中国能够一步一步走向更加市场化及创新驱动的经济发展模式 — — 而这一转型也将支持更强劲的全球增长。
en: By installing officials with strong policy credibility and the ability to handle market volatility deftly, China can complete its transition to a more market-oriented, innovation-driven economy – one that also supports stronger global growth.

zh: 中国清洗的苏联教训
en: Soviet Lessons for Chinese Purges

zh: 克莱蒙特，加利福尼亚—8月1日，中国人民解放军迎来建军88走周年。
en: CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA – On August 1, China’s People’s Liberation Army celebrated its 88th anniversary.

zh: 但解放军230万将士没有什么好庆祝的。
en: But the country’s 2.3 million soldiers have little to cheer about.

zh: 建军节前夜，解放军前高级军官郭伯雄突然被开除党籍，移交军事司法机关处理，他将面临腐败指控，包括收受下级军官巨额贿赂换取提拔。
en: On the eve of the anniversary, the PLA’s former top general, Guo Boxiong, was unceremoniously booted out of the Communist Party and handed over to military prosecutors to face corruption charges, including allegations that he took large bribes from fellow PLA officers in exchange for promotions.

zh: 郭伯雄绝不会是最后一位面临此类指控的解放军军官。
en: And Guo will not be the last PLA officer to face such charges.

zh: 身为中央军委副主席的郭伯雄在2002—2012年期间负责主管解放军的日常事务。
en: Guo, a vice chairman of the Central Military Commission, was in charge of the military’s day-to-day affairs from 2002 to 2012.

zh: 此前，去年6月，2007—2012年在任的军委副主席徐才厚也被逮捕。
en: His arrest follows that of General Xu Caihou, who served on the commission from 2007 to 2012, in June of last year.

zh: 自2012年底军委主席习近平发起反腐运动以来，郭伯雄和徐才厚并非仅有的落马高级军官。
en: Guo and Xu are not the only senior officers to have fallen since their commander-in-chief, President Xi Jinping, launched his war on corruption at the end of 2012.

zh: 从官方数据看，已有39位将军（包括少将军衔的郭伯雄之子）被逮捕。
en: Based on official data, 39 generals (including Guo’s son, a major general) have already been arrested.

zh: 如果能证明大量将官依靠行贿郭伯雄和徐才厚获得升迁，那么可以推断这场子文化大革命以来范围最广的解放军高级军官清洗还将继续。
en: And if there is merit to the allegations that a large number of generals bribed Guo and Xu for their promotions, it is reasonable to assume that the most wide-ranging purge of senior PLA officers since the Cultural Revolution will continue.

zh: 这正是习近平在第16集团军发表的最新讲话所传递的信息。 20世纪90年代初，徐才厚在该集团军担任政委。
en: That is precisely the message Xi sent to the military in a recent speech to the 16th army group, for which Xu served as political commissar in the early 1990s.

zh: 习近平要求“从思想上、政治上、组织上、作风上”彻底清除徐才厚案件的影响，强调绝不容忍违背党的领导。
en: After vowing to eradicate Xu’s influence, “ideologically, politically, and also in terms of organization and work style,” Xi stressed that disobedience to the Party leadership would not be tolerated.

zh: 习近平说，军队必须“坚决听从党中央、中央军委指挥 ” 。
en: The army must, Xi declared, “resolutely conform to orders from the party Central Committee and the Central Military Commission.”

zh: 只要你在过去两年中仔细观察习近平的作风，就能看出他的目标是通过强化其个人权威、重新开展国内镇压和追求独断外交政策巩固中共在中国的执政地位。
en: Anyone who has been watching Xi over the last two and a half years could discern his goal of consolidating Communist Party rule in China by strengthening his personal authority, reinvigorating domestic repression, and pursuing an assertive foreign policy.

zh: 为了实现这一目标，习近平需要解放军的赤胆忠心 — — 而这就需要清洗不可靠或腐败的军官。
en: To achieve this goal, Xi needs to secure the PLA’s unimpeachable loyalty – and that requires the purge of unreliable or corrupt officers.

zh: 从个人层面，解放军的忠心对于弥补习近平在制度权力基础上的不足至关重要。
en: On a personal level, the PLA’s loyalty is vital to make up for Xi’s lack of an institutional power base.

zh: 相反，1989年天安门事件后，前国家主席江泽民成为中共总书记时，他能够依靠有能力又忠心的上海官员支撑官僚体系；接着，在20世纪90年代，他通过招安其他派系扩大自己的支持。
en: By contrast, when former President Jiang Zemin became General Secretary of the Communist Party following the Tiananmen crackdown in 1989, he was able to rely on capable and loyal officials in Shanghai to run the bureaucracy; he then expanded his support base by co-opting other factions in the 1990s.

zh: 而他的继任者胡锦涛则来自同志遍布党国各层级的共青团。
en: And Jiang’s successor, Hu Jintao, hailed from the Communist Youth League, which has alumni at all levels of the party-state.

zh: 习近平将通过逐步任命支持者担任要职构建强大的权力基础，在此期间，他需要解放军捍卫他的政治权威。
en: While Xi will work to build a strong power base by gradually appointing his supporters to key positions, he needs the PLA to defend his political authority in the interim.

zh: 对习近平来说，确保解放军忠心的最有效办法就是用自己的支持者出任最高军官（大部分由前任主席提拔 ） 。
en: The most efficient way for Xi to secure the PLA’s loyalty is to replace its top generals – most of whom were promoted by previous presidents – with his own supporters.

zh: 看起来习近平没有忘记1964年前苏联领导人赫鲁晓夫倒台的教训。
en: It seems that the lesson from the fall of Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev in 1964 was not lost on Xi.

zh: 赫鲁晓夫在由克格勃支持并得到军队认可的宫廷政变中被赶下台。
en: Khrushchev was ousted in a palace coup sponsored by the KGB and blessed by the military.

zh: 如果苏联红军完全忠于赫鲁晓夫，政变阴谋是无法成功的。
en: Had the Red Army been completely loyal to Khrushchev, the conspirators would not have succeeded.

zh: 但习近平的计划不只限于个人权威 — — 而苏联的教训亦然。
en: But Xi’s plans extend beyond his personal authority – and so do the lessons of the Soviet Union.

zh: 习近平掌权后不久，便向广东地方官员感叹道，苏联解体时精英早已失去了战斗精神。
en: Shortly after Xi’s assumption of power, he lamented to local officials in Guangdong that when the Soviet Union collapsed, the elite had lost the will to fight.

zh: 在中共政治垄断地位日益受到挑战的时候，习近平不会重蹈覆辙。
en: At a time when the Chinese Communist Party’s political monopoly is increasingly being challenged, Xi will not make that mistake.

zh: 为了避免苏联的命运，习近平和他的同事重新开始了对意识形态和公民自由的控制。
en: To avoid the Soviet Union’s fate, Xi and his colleagues have re-imposed ideological control and curtailed civil liberties.

zh: 中共目前只动用了警察和互联网审查（现在希望在所有互联网公司安排秘密警察 ） ， 但其长期生存在没有忠诚的解放军的情况下是不可想象的，特别是如果类似于1989年天安门事件的示威再次爆发的话。
en: While the Party has so far employed only the police and Internet censors (and now wants to embed secret policemen within all Internet companies), its longer-term survival is inconceivable without a loyal PLA, especially if protests like that in Tiananmen Square in 1989 erupt again.

zh: 习近平巩固中共权威的最后一个支柱是用强硬外交取代邓小平的谨慎外交。
en: The final pillar of Xi’s strategy for solidifying the Communist Party’s authority is to replace Deng Xiaoping’s cautious foreign policy with a muscular one.

zh: 如果中国不得不动用武力支持其在（比如）南海或台湾海峡的激进策略，那么解放军决不能由腐化不忠的将军领导。
en: Should China have to back its aggressive tactics in, say, the South China Sea or the Taiwan Strait with force, its military must not be led by venal and perfidious generals.

zh: 如果习近平根除军中腐败的措施能够实现这三个目标，那么必须承认他绝对是一个政治天才。
en: If Xi’s efforts to root out corruption in the PLA can accomplish these three objectives, one must grudgingly admit that it will be a stroke of political genius.

zh: 但是，要确保中国占据最强势的可能位置，习近平必须从苏联身上汲取另一个教训：清洗极有可能过度。
en: But, to ensure that China is in the strongest possible position, Xi must learn one more lesson from the Soviets: Purges can easily lead to excesses.

zh: 斯大林在纳粹入侵前夕自断手脚清洗了大量红军军官。
en: Stalin annihilated the Red Army’s officer corps on the eve of Nazi Germany’s invasion.

zh: 习近平决不能犯同样的错误。
en: Xi cannot afford to make the same mistake.

zh: 真正的新加坡模式
en: The Real Singapore Model

zh: 克莱蒙特，加利福尼亚—新加坡国父李光耀的逝世让我们思考他的遗产 — — 也许更重要的是，还有关于他的遗产能否被正确理解的问题。
en: CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA – The death of Lee Kuan Yew, Singapore’s founding father, offers an occasion to reflect on his legacy – and, perhaps more importantly, on whether that legacy has been correctly understood.

zh: 在31年的总理生涯中，李光耀打造了独特的政府制度，复杂而巧妙地将极权和民主、国家资本主义和自由市场相平衡。
en: During his 31 years as prime minister, Lee crafted a unique system of government, intricately balancing authoritarianism with democracy and state capitalism with the free market.

zh: 李光耀的治国之道被称为“新加坡模式 ” ， 常常被误解为一党独裁加自由市场经济。
en: Known as “the Singapore model,” Lee’s brand of governance is often mischaracterized as a one-party dictatorship superimposed on a free-market economy.

zh: 他成功地让新加坡变为一个繁荣的城市国家，这常常被极权统治者用来论证严格控制社会的正当性 — — 首屈一指的便是中国。
en: His success in transforming Singapore into a prosperous city-state is frequently invoked by authoritarian rulers as justification for their tight control of society – and nowhere more so than in China.

zh: 事实上，中国国家主席习近平所实施的转型日程受到新加坡模式的巨大影响 — — 不懈的反腐斗争、大范围打击异见人士，以及市场经济改革。
en: Indeed, Chinese President Xi Jinping is pursuing a transformative agenda heavily influenced by the Singapore model – a relentless war on corruption, a broad crackdown on dissent, and pro-market economic reforms.

zh: 中国共产党把新加坡视为未来愿景之一：在一个繁荣的资本主义社会中永远垄断权力。
en: The Chinese Communist Party (CCP) sees in Singapore a vision of its future: the perpetuation of its monopoly on political power in a prosperous capitalist society.

zh: 但中国统治者所理解的新加坡模式从来没有存在过。
en: But the Singapore model, as China’s rulers understand it, never existed.

zh: 模仿李光耀的政府模式 — — 而不是它的讽刺漫画形象 — — 需要允许远超中共可容忍程度的民主制度。
en: To emulate Lee’s model of government – rather than its cartoon caricature – would require allowing a far more democratic system than the CCP would ever tolerate.

zh: 李光耀政治天才的真正秘密不是他驾轻就熟地使用镇压手段，如起诉媒体或政治反对派；这些策略很平常，在半极权体制中也好不显眼。
en: The true secret of Lee’s political genius was not his skillful use of repressive practices, such as launching lawsuits against the media or his political opponents; such tactics are common and unremarkable in semi-authoritarian regimes.

zh: 李光耀真正的革命性做法是用民主制度和法治遏制新加坡执政精英的掠夺倾向。
en: What Lee did that was truly revolutionary was to use democratic institutions and the rule of law to curb the predatory appetite of his country’s ruling elite.

zh: 与中国不同，新加坡允许反对党在选举中自由竞争（尽管未必公平 ） 。
en: Unlike China, Singapore allows opposition parties to contest in competitive and free (though not necessarily fair) elections.

zh: 在2011年的上一次议会选举中，六大反对党赢得占总数40%的选票。
en: In the last parliamentary election in 2011, six opposition parties won a total of 40% of the vote.

zh: 如果李光耀所创立的人民行动党（People’s Action Party，PAP）因为治国不善而失去合法性，新加坡选民可以将它赶下台。
en: Should the People’s Action Party (PAP), the party Lee founded, lose its legitimacy due to poor governance, Singapore’s voters could throw it out of office.

zh: 通过举行定期竞争性选举，李光耀有效地建立了一套政治自我执行和问责的机制 — — 他给予新加坡选民决定PAP是否应该掌握权力的权力。
en: By holding regular competitive elections, Lee effectively established a mechanism of political self-enforcement and accountability – he gave Singaporean voters the power to decide whether the PAP should stay in power.

zh: 这一执行机制维持了新加坡执政精英内部的纪律，也让精英的承诺有了可信度。
en: This enforcement mechanism has maintained discipline within Singapore’s ruling elite and makes its promises credible.

zh: 遗憾的是，世界其他地区的大部分人都没有给予李光耀的这项成就以相称的赞誉：他建立了一套极权和民主相混合的制度，既极大地提高了新加坡公民的福祉，又没有让他们遭遇新加坡的诸多邻国所采取的残酷统治和镇压。
en: Regrettably, most of the rest of the world has never given Lee proper credit for crafting a hybrid system of authoritarianism and democracy that vastly improved the wellbeing of his country’s citizens, without subjecting them to the brutality and oppression to which many of Singapore’s neighbors have resorted.

zh: 中国最好模仿这一模式，引入相当大程度的民主并强化法治。
en: China would be wise to embrace this model, by introducing a considerable degree of democracy and strengthening adherence to the rule of law.

zh: 如果中国统治者能实施新加坡式的政治制度和实践，14亿中国公民将获益良多。
en: China’s 1.4 billion citizens would benefit immensely if their rulers were to adopt Singapore-style political institutions and practices.

zh: 这将意味着至少要合法化有组织政治反对，引入定期举行的竞争性选举，并建立独立的司法制度。
en: This would mean, at a minimum, legalizing organized political opposition, introducing competitive elections at regular intervals, and creating an independent judiciary.

zh: 模仿李光耀将让中国实现巨大的进步并成为更人道、更开放的社会，获得更加光明的未来。
en: Emulating Lee would allow China to achieve immense progress and become a more humane and open society with a brighter future.

zh: 不幸的是，这几乎不可能发生，至少在短期内是如此。
en: Sadly, there is almost no chance of this happening, at least any time soon.

zh: 中国领导人在提及新加坡模式时，心里想的只是其权力的永续性。
en: When China’s leaders cite the Singapore model, what they have in mind is limited to the perpetuation of their power.

zh: 他们希望获得政治主宰的好处，而不面对竞争性制度环境的制衡。
en: They want the benefits of political dominance, without the checks imposed by a competitive institutional context.

zh: 李光耀也许质疑民主的好处，但他内心并不敌视民主；他知道民主的用处。
en: Lee may have been skeptical about the benefits of democracy, but he was not viscerally hostile to it; he understood its usefulness.

zh: 相反，中国领导人将民主视为生存性意识形态威胁，必须不惜任何代价将其屏蔽。
en: By contrast, China’s leaders view democracy as an existential ideological threat that must be neutralized at any cost.

zh: 对他们来说，允许哪怕是一丁点作为约束精英纪律的方式的民主，也是自杀性的大错。
en: For them, allowing even a modicum of democracy as a means to impose some discipline on the elite is considered suicidal.

zh: 不幸的是，李光耀已经永远离开了我们。
en: Unfortunately, Lee is no longer with us.

zh: 你也许会想象他想中国领导人解释什么才是新加坡模式真正的创新之处。
en: One would like to imagine him explaining to China’s leaders what has been truly innovative about the Singapore model.

zh: 显然，这已无从发生。
en: Obviously, that is not an option.

zh: 但中共 — — 如果单纯只是尊重这位亚洲最伟大政治家之一 — — 应该停止打着新加坡模式的旗号让它为完全不同的日程服务。
en: But it would behoove the CCP – if for no other reason than simple respect for one of Asia’s great statesmen – to stop appropriating the Singapore brand in the service of a completely different agenda.

zh: 被误导的中国汇率机制
en: China’s Misguided Exchange-Rate Machinations

zh: 发自北京 — — 2015年8月11日，中国人民银行宣布人民币兑美元汇率中间价报价将参照前一交易日收盘价设定，上下幅度为2 ％ 。
en: BEIJING – On August 11, 2015, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) established that the central parity of the renminbi’s exchange rate against the US dollar would be set with reference to the previous trading day’s closing price, within a 2% band.

zh: 这是向更灵活更市场化的汇率迈出的一大步。
en: It was a bold step toward a more flexible, market-driven exchange rate.

zh: 但这项改革的发布却导致了市场的恐慌，导致人民币汇率在短短四个交易日内下滑了3 % ， 因此很快就被抛弃了。
en: But the announcement of the reform caused the market to panic, triggering a 3% decline in the renminbi in just four trading days. So it was quickly abandoned.

zh: 收回这一政策的做法虽然可以理解，却也带来了遗憾。
en: That policy reversal, while understandable, is regrettable.

zh: 在2015年剩下的那段时间里中国人民银行一直在努力防止人民币贬值，而在消耗了巨量外汇储备之后，又在2016年2月决定引入一套新的汇率中间价报价制定规则。
en: For the rest of 2015, the PBOC struggled to prevent the renminbi from weakening. Having spent a huge amount of foreign-exchange reserves, it decided in February 2016 to introduce a new rule for setting the central parity rate.

zh: 根据这套替代规则，汇率中间价报价不仅要考虑前一个交易日的收盘价，还要考虑一个保证包含24种货币篮子的中国外汇交易系统指数在过去24小时内不发生变化的“理论汇率 ” 。
en: According to the replacement rule, the central parity rate would take into account not just the previous trading day’s closing price, but also the “theoretical exchange rate” that would keep the index of the China Foreign Exchange Trade System, a 24-currency basket, unchanged over the previous 24 hours.

zh: 换言之，每当美元指数发生变化，中国人民银行就必须出手干预外汇市场，确保市场形成的人民币兑美元汇率与使中国外汇交易系统保持稳定的理论汇率保持一致。
en: In other words, whenever there was a change in the US dollar index, the PBOC would have to intervene in the foreign-exchange market to align the market-determined renminbi-dollar exchange rate with the theoretical exchange rate that kept the CFETS index stable.

zh: 根据中国人民银行的说法，由于美元指数走势不确定，需要将一篮子货币引入价格制定过程以实现人民币兑美元汇率的双向波动。
en: According to the PBOC, with an uncertain dollar index, the introduction of a basket of currencies into the price-setting process was needed to enable two-way fluctuations of the renminbi-dollar exchange rate.

zh: 市场可以去验证中国人民银行是否遵循了汇率制定规则，但无法去确定汇率；这项任务会交由中国人民银行来完成。
en: The market was allowed to verify whether the PBOC had followed the rate-setting rule, but it didn’t determine the exchange rate; that task was carried out by the PBOC.

zh: 不管怎么样，新规则在美元指数上涨时似乎没什么问题。
en: In any case, when the dollar index is rising, the new rule seemed to work just fine.

zh: 由于人民币汇率持续面临下行压力，如果人行允许人民币在美元指数上涨的背景下贬值，中国外汇交易系统指数将基本上保持不变。
en: Given persistent downward pressure on the exchange rate, if the PBOC allowed the renminbi to fall against the rising dollar index, the CFETS index would stay more or less constant.

zh: 这意味着中国人民银行可以在无需过于频繁采取干预措施的情况下遵循汇率制定规则。
en: This meant that the PBOC could follow the rate-setting rule without resorting to intervention too often.

zh: 而反之亦然，如果美元指数下跌，中国人民银行就必须为人民币设定更高的汇率中间价。
en: But, all else being equal, if the dollar index was falling, the PBOC would have to set a higher central parity rate for the renminbi.

zh: 这意味着中国人民银行可能要被迫抛出本已大量消耗的美元储备，人为推高人民币收盘价并将波动保持在2％以内的水平。
en: This implies that the PBOC could be forced to sell its US dollar reserves, already substantially depleted, to push up artificially the closing price of the renminbi and keep the spot rate within the 2% band.

zh: 2017年7月，中国人民银行决定对利率设定规则进行额外修订以过滤“大幅市场波动”和“羊群效应 ” 。
en: In July 2017, the PBOC decided to make an additional change to the rate-setting rule to correct for “big market swings” and “irrational herd behavior.”

zh: 通过在中间价报价模型中引入所谓的“逆周期因子 ” ， 中国人民银行试图抵消贬值预期相对于中国经济基本面的改善对汇率所造成的不成比例影响。
