en: Soon after, however, monetary tightening put economic growth back on a downward trajectory, spurring the government to loosen policy and introduce mini-stimulus packages in late 2011 and early 2012.

zh: 这带来了短暂而温和的反弹，随后不久经济增长再次下滑（但速度不快 ） 。
en: This produced a short-lived and moderate rebound, with economic growth again beginning to slide, albeit less steeply, soon after.

zh: 最终，到了2016年，中国经济增长再次开始稳定下来，年增长率连续三季度达到6.7 % 。
en: Finally, in 2016, Chinese economic growth began to stabilize again, with the annual rate reaching 6.7% for three quarters in a row.

zh: 最新数据表明，2017年三季度中国经济增长了6.8 % ， 这让许多经济学家对来年充满了乐观。
en: The latest figures show that China’s economy grew by 6.8% in the third quarter of 2017, leading many economists to offer rather optimistic forecasts for the coming year.

zh: 尽管中国金融体系表现出令人担忧的脆弱性，但许多中国经济学家相信中国终于进入了年增长保持在6.5%左右的稳定期 — — 这一增长率与其增长潜力相符。
en: Though China’s financial system is fraught with worrying vulnerabilities, many Chinese economists believe that the country has at last entered a period of stable annual growth of about 6.5% – a level that is in line with potential.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）的最新《世界经济展望 》 （ World Economic Outlook）也同意这一观点，认为2017年中国经济将增长6.8 % ， 2018年将增长6.5 % 。
en: The International Monetary Fund has echoed this view in its latest World Economic Outlook, predicting 6.8% growth in 2017 and a 6.5% rate in 2018.

zh: 我则没有那么乐观。
en: I am less sanguine.

zh: 几十年来，增长的主要推动力是固定资产投资，它几乎占了总需求的半壁江山。
en: For decades, fixed-asset investment was the main driver of growth, accounting for almost half of total demand.

zh: 目前，固定资产投资占GDP的比例超过50 % ， 而算作剩余资本形成的投资占GDP的45%左右。
en: Its share of China’s GDP today exceeds 50%, while investment calculated as residual capital formation accounts for some 45% of GDP.

zh: 但是，自2013年年末以来，投资增长一直在稳步下降，这一趋势在2017年下半年有所加速。
en: Yet, since late 2013, investment growth has been declining steadily, a trend that accelerated in the second half of 2017.

zh: 2017年前三季度固定资产投资平均年同比增长率只有2.19 % 。
en: In the first three quarters of 2017, fixed-asset investment grew at an average rate of just 2.19% year on year.

zh: 第三季度投资出现了负增长，增长率为-1.1 % 。
en: In the third quarter, investment growth was actually negative, at -1.1%.

zh: 如此低迷的形势为几十年所未见。
en: China has not seen such lows in decades.

zh: 从结构调整的角度看，中国对固定资产投资依赖程度下降应该是一项值得庆贺的成就。
en: From the perspective of structural adjustment, China’s declining dependence on fixed-asset investment should be hailed as an achievement.

zh: 但《金融时报》的马丁·沃尔夫（Martin Wolf）在2016年时强调，在投资增长萎靡的情况下，中国很难保持总需求。
en: But, as the Financial Times’ Martin Wolf emphasized in 2016, it will be very difficult for China to sustain aggregate demand amid weakening investment growth.

zh: 家庭消费无法填补空白。
en: Household consumption is unlikely to pick up the slack.

zh: 2017年前三季度私人消费真实（经通胀调整的）增长率为5.9 % — —较2016年下降了0.5个百分点。
en: In the first three quarters of 2017, private consumption grew by 5.9% in real (inflation-adjusted) terms – down 0.5 percentage points from 2016.

zh: 2018年家庭消费突然猛增的可能性很小。
en: It is difficult to envisage a sudden surge in household consumption in 2018.

zh: 净出口增长似乎也无法抵消投资的下降，因为美国总统特朗普的对华策略将继续偏向保护主义。
en: Growth in net exports, too, seems unlikely to offset declining investment, not least because US President Donald Trump continues to lean toward protectionism in his dealings with China.

zh: 尽管中国有可能继续用财政政策来提振需求，但操作空间将受到地方政府债务负担和取缔所谓的地方政府融资平台等动作的制约。
en: And while China probably will continue to use fiscal policy to shore up demand, the extent to which it can do so will be constrained by factors like local governments’ debt burden and a consequent clampdown on so-called local-government financing vehicles.

zh: 政府可能不会允许预算赤字超过GDP的3 % 。
en: The government probably will not allow the budget deficit to surpass 3% of GDP.

zh: 中国固定资产投资包括三个主要类别：制造业、基础设施和房地产。
en: China’s fixed-asset investment comprises three main categories: manufacturing, infrastructure, and real estate.

zh: 制造业投资占比最大，为30 % 。
en: Manufacturing investment accounts for the largest share – 30%.

zh: 但该项投资从2012年开始稳步下降，拖累了总投资增长。
en: But it has been declining steadily since 2012, weakening overall investment growth.

zh: 而其再度起势的可能很小，除非中国能够实现技术和制度突破。
en: And it is unlikely to pick up again, unless China achieves some technological or institutional breakthrough.

zh: 与此同时，房地产投资在过去二十年中呈现出周期模式，2016年年初强劲复苏，2017年再度下降。
en: Real-estate investment, meanwhile, has followed a cyclical pattern over the last two decades, recovering strongly in early 2016 before falling again in 2017.

zh: 政府决心要遏制住房价格 — — 房价高企时常激起人们对地方泡沫的担忧 — — 因此没有理由认为房地产投资能够迅速反弹。
en: Given the government’s determination to contain housing prices – which have, at various times, stoked concern about local bubbles – there is little reason to expect that real-estate investment will rebound anytime soon.

zh: 于是只剩下了基础设施投资，其占总投资之比自2012年以来不断上升。
en: This leaves only infrastructure investment, whose share of total investment has been increasing since 2012.

zh: 但基础设施投资已经非常高，继续提高有可能恶化资源配置 — — 这与政府公开的目标背道而驰。
en: But infrastructure investment has already reached such a high level that continued growth could worsen resource allocation – the opposite of the government’s stated objectives.

zh: 此外，基础设施投资还面临财政约束和更严格的金融监管，因此进一步扩大难上加难。
en: Add to that fiscal constraints and stricter financial regulation, and a further expansion of infrastructure investment would be difficult, to say the least.

zh: 所有这些可以推出一个简单的结论：除非我看错了官方投资数据，否则2018年中国经济增长不容乐观。
en: All of this leads to a simple conclusion: unless I’ve read the official investment statistics wrong, optimism about China’s economic growth in 2018 is not warranted.

zh: 但这并不意味着中国的前景黯淡无光。
en: But this does not mean that China’s prospects are altogether dismal.

zh: 如果经济增长有可能大大低于6.5%的目标，政府将采用宏观经济稳定工具，哪怕这会给未来造成严重负担，同时，政府也将致力于防止金融脆弱性演变为系统性金融风险。
en: If economic growth seems to be falling far below the 6.5% target, the government will employ macroeconomic stabilization tools, despite the high heavy future costs, while working to prevent financial vulnerabilities from turning into systemic financial risks.

zh: 更令人憧憬的是，中国政府不断哺育创新、实施结构性改革，这有望带来巨大的长期回报。
en: More promising, the Chinese government’s ongoing efforts to cultivate innovation and implement structural reforms are likely to produce major returns in the long term.

zh: 所有这些表明，中国经济的过山车正在迈向新的升势，增长最终将在一个较好的水平上稳定下来。
en: All of this suggests that China’s economic roller coaster is headed for another climb, and that growth will eventually stabilize at a decent rate.

zh: 但就像大部分游乐项目一样，过山车上的乘客需要先等一会儿。
en: But, as with most popular attractions, its passengers may have to wait a while.

zh: 探寻高质量增长之路
en: China’s Search for Quality Growth

zh: 香港—随着国家主席习近平开始他的第二个五年任期，向“高质量增长”转型成为中国最重要政策目标。
en: HONG KONG – As Chinese President Xi Jinping begins his second five-year term, shifting toward “quality growth” is at the top of the country’s policy agenda.

zh: 政府上下，一个悄然但坚定的政策变化正在深根发芽 — — 打造一个新的增长模式，来纠正由几十年来中国两位数增长带来的一系列扭曲，包括腐败、污染、不平等加剧和其它结构失衡问题。
en: Across China’s government, a quiet but resolute commitment to fostering a new growth model that corrects the distortions created by decades of double-digit growth – including corruption, pollution, rising inequality, and other structural imbalances – is taking root.

zh: 在过去40年，中国采取了基于土地的高速发展，主要通过地方政府吸引基础设施投资、人力资源和税收收入来推动增长。
en: Over most of the last 40 years, China focused on rapid land-based development, driven by local initiatives aimed at attracting infrastructure investment, human resources, and tax revenues.

zh: 经济特区、产业园和自贸区的建立为这种基于土地的发展模式提供了便利，同时，来自农村的大量廉价劳动力也起到了推动作用。
en: The creation of special economic zones, industrial parks, and free-trade zones facilitated such development, as they benefited from a large pool of cheap labor migrating from rural areas.

zh: 在这个过程中，中国将GDP增长作为衡量成功的主要指标。
en: Throughout this process, China used GDP growth as its main measure of success.

zh: 这为地方官员建立了定义明确的目标和彼此竞争的激励。
en: This enabled the establishment of well-defined goals and incentives for local officials as they competed with one another.

zh: 但这也带来了一些严重的问题，如环境污染、不平等、债务过高、产能过剩以及腐败。
en: But it also caused serious problems – such as environmental damage, inequality, excessive debts, overcapacity, and corruption – to flourish.

zh: 如今，中国领导人在地方和国家层面开始用更全面的指标体系来考察增长的质量，它们不仅覆盖增长的速度，也覆盖生活质量。
en: Today, China’s authorities are looking at a broader range of measures at the local and national levels that cover not just growth, but also quality of life.

zh: 这一转变背后的政策愿景写在去年10月党的十九大报告中，习近平特别强调了发展“新时代中国特色社会主义”的14个关键政策领域。
en: The vision behind this shift was articulated at the Communist Party of China’s 19th National Congress last October, when Xi stressed 14 policy areas that would be critical to develop “socialism with Chinese characteristics.”

zh: 在这些当务之急的关键领域中 ， “ 坚持新发展理念”以便“保障和改善民生”赫然在列。
en: Among those imperatives was “adopting a new vision for development,” which “ensures and improves living standards.”

zh: 而新发展理念的基础是“以人为本”及“人与自然和谐共生 ” 。
en: This vision should be underpinned by a commitment to a “people-centered approach” and “harmony between human and nature.”

zh: 习近平还强调加强国家治理，特别是要“坚持党对一切工作的领导 ” 、 “坚持全面依法治国 ” 、 及“全面从严治党 ” 。
en: Xi also emphasized strong governance, specifically “ensuring Party leadership over all work,” “ensuring every dimension of governance is law-based,” and “exercising full and rigorous governance over the Party.”

zh: 中国转变发展模式的动机不言自明。
en: The motivation behind the shift in China’s development focus is no mystery.

zh: 如今，中国已经是世界第二大经济体，贡献了全球增长的近一半。
en: China is now the world’s second-largest economy and accounts for nearly half of global growth.

zh: 在基础设施、贸易、投资和工业化方面，中国已经基本上赶上了发达国家。
en: It has now largely caught up with the advanced countries in terms of infrastructure, trade, investment, and industrialization.

zh: 继续加强在世界舞台上的地位，要求中国在可持续发展和良好治理等方面满足甚至超过全球标准。
en: Continuing to strengthen its position on the world stage is now a matter of meeting and even exceeding global standards in areas ranging from sustainability to good governance.

zh: 当然，解决中国所面临的挑战需要大量的试错 — — 就像过去的高速增长一样 — — 还要接受一些经济代价。
en: Of course, addressing the challenges China faces will require plenty of trial and error – much like that which enabled its past development – not to mention acceptance of some economic casualties.

zh: 比如，东北工业基地的衰落和在东南地区珠三角、长三角崛起的现代化的、具有国际竞争力的制造业集群便是同一枚硬币的两面。
en: For example, the decline of the industrial areas in northeast China and the rise of modern, globally competitive manufacturing clusters in the Pearl and Yangtze River Deltas in southeast China are two sides of the same coin.

zh: 在中国出现的市场竞争创造了赢家和输家，东南部的赢家从东北部的输家那里赢得了企业家、人才和其它资源。
en: Market competition in China created both winners and losers, with the winners in the southeast taking entrepreneurs, talent, and other resources from the losers in the northeast.

zh: 驾驭中国地区经济的转型，并同时确保社会稳定，需要在以输家为代表的、主要依靠国有企业和公共投资的旧增长战略，和由赢家发展出来的、主要依赖市场及人力资源的新发展模式之间实现谨慎的平衡。
en: Managing the transformation of China’s regional economies while preserving social stability will demand a careful balance between the old growth strategy exemplified by the losers, which relied heavily on state-owned enterprises and public investment, and the new, more human-capital-oriented approach being developed by the winners.

zh: 在此过程中，需要考虑到地方因素，如人口趋势、自然资源，包括国内日益增长的中等收入游客对美好自然景区的旅游需求等。
en: In the process, China will need to take into account local factors, such as population trends, natural resources, and regions’ appeal to middle-income domestic tourists.

zh: 这一再平衡需要中央政府的帮助来缓解衰落地区破产项目所导致的债务负担，一如20世纪90年代中央政府曾经果断处理大批国企在亚洲金融危机期间发生的损失。
en: This rebalancing will require the central government to help relieve the debt burdens resulting from bankrupt projects in the losing regions, much like it did in the 1990s, when it wrote off the losses that SOEs incurred during the Asian financial crisis.

zh: 这并不意味着中国应该拯救落后的地方产业。
en: This does not mean that China should rescue outdated local industries.

zh: 相反，这意味着防止旧增长模式导致的沉淀成本将整个地区拖入低增长和低质量发展陷阱，并帮助本地居民建立创新型初创企业，也就是投资于可以创造新收入机会的项目。
en: Rather, it means preventing the sunk costs of China’s past growth model from leaving entire regions trapped in low-quality growth and development, by enabling local people to develop innovative start-ups, while investing in projects that create new income opportunities.

zh: 除了供给侧结构调整，中国还必须确保新增长战略解决以人为本的城镇发展的“最后一公里”需求侧问题，包括解决交通拥堵、基础设施瓶颈、住房短缺、垃圾处理、及教育和医疗服务不足等问题。
en: Beyond supply-side structural adjustments, China must ensure that its new growth strategy addresses “last mile” demand-side problems of urban and human development, including traffic jams, infrastructure bottlenecks, housing shortages, underdeveloped waste-management services, and inadequate education and health care.

zh: 这些微观层面问题对于国民福利至关重要，也已经成为中国复杂的宏观经济和社会发展中最薄弱的环节。
en: As it stands, resolving these micro-level issues – critical to human wellbeing – is among the weakest areas of China’s complex macroeconomic and social reform plans.

zh: 中国已经具备解决这些问题所需要的物资、金融和社会资源。 事实上，这些问题对于公共和私人部门来说都是潜在的巨大投资机会。
en: China has all the physical, financial, and social resources it needs to redress these problems, which in fact amount to major investment opportunities for both the public and private sectors.

zh: 但成功不仅需要因地制宜的信息反馈及可行方案，还必须让地方政府、企业、民众主动“拥有”这些具有本土特色的解决方案，包括方案的制定和实施。
en: But, to succeed, any strategy must not only account for local feedback about what is achievable under local conditions; it must also allow for local ownership of solutions, including design and implementation.

zh: 中国决策层已经显示了从宏观及长远角度来看中国未来发展的意愿和能力，并接受在转变发展模式、再平衡、及改善生活质量的过程中降低一些GDP增长率。
en: In any case, China’s leaders have demonstrated a willingness and ability to look at the big picture, accepting lower rates of GDP growth as they rebalance the country’s development model and pursue improvements in quality of life.

zh: 实现习近平在去年10月所宣布的“以人民为中心”的发展理念绝非易事，但中国已经在这个正确的道路上启程。
en: It will not be easy to realize the vision of “people-centered development” that Xi announced last October. But China is on the right track.

zh: 中国减煤
en: Chinese Coal Cuts

zh: 香港—在限制全球变暖的斗争中，没有哪个国家像中国那样重要。 中国严重依赖煤炭，其二氧化碳排放量占全球的30 % 。
en: HONG KONG – In the fight to limit global warming, no country matters more than China – a massive coal-dependent country, which is responsible for 30% of global carbon-dioxide emissions.

zh: 幸运的是，中国正在改善环境记录。
en: Fortunately, it is moving to improve its environmental record.

zh: 但它做得足够了吗？
en: But is it doing enough?

zh: 如果中国智能追求一个目标，那就是减少对煤炭能源的依赖。
en: If China could pursue only one goal, it should be cutting its reliance on coal energy.

zh: 中国人口占全球的六分之一，但却消费了全球近二分之一的煤炭。
en: The country is home to one-sixth of the world’s people, yet it accounts for almost one-half of global coal consumption.

zh: 如果中国不降低这一比例并减少温室气体排放，那么遏制全球变暖就无从实现。
en: If China does not reduce that share and cut its greenhouse-gas emissions, keeping global warming in check will prove impossible.

zh: 好消息是去年中国煤炭使用量略有下降 — — 预计这一趋势将会持续。
en: The good news is that coal use in China seems to have fallen slightly last year – a trend that is expected to continue.

zh: 能源经济学和金融分析研究所（Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis）估算，中国煤电比例将从2014年的72.5%下降到2020年的60 % 。
en: The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis estimates that the share of coal-generated electricity in China will decline from 72.5% in 2014 to 60% in 2020.

zh: 去年的煤炭使用量下降也许只是技术上的波动，但预计中国煤炭消费量很快就会见顶 — — 有可能就在明年。
en: While last year’s drop in coal use may have been a technical blip, Chinese coal consumption is expected to peak very soon – probably next year.

zh: 这意味着二氧化碳排放量 — — 导致全球变暖的温室气体排放的最大成分 — — 也将开始下降，使中国兑现其在去年11月与美国达成的标志性气候协议中所做的排放量在2030年左右达到最高峰的承诺。
en: That means that CO2 emissions – the largest component of the greenhouse-gas emissions that cause global warming – will begin falling, too, enabling China to fulfill its pledge, made last November as part of a landmark climate agreement with the United States, that emissions would peak around 2030.

zh: 事实上，如果中国领导人采取果断行动，排放高峰还会来的更快一些，在21世纪20年代初就能达到。
en: In fact, if China’s leaders act boldly, the peak could be reached even sooner, in the early 2020s.

zh: 随着中国煤炭用量的下降，其可再生能源部门正在快速成长。
en: As China’s coal use begins to fall, its renewables sector is growing rapidly.

zh: 去年中国将900亿美元巨资投于可再生能源 — — 远远高于第二大投资国美国的520亿美元。
en: Last year, China spent a massive $90 billion on renewable energy – far more than the $52 billion invested by the second-largest spender, the US.

zh: 如今，中国拥有全球规模最大的风电基地，其太阳能发电能力也仅次于德国。
en: China now has the world’s largest installed base of wind power, and its solar power capacity is second only to Germany’s.

zh: 自世纪之交崛起以来，中国的风能和太阳能公司已跻身全球规模最大、效率最高的行列。
en: From humble beginnings at the turn of the century, Chinese wind and solar companies have grown into some of the world’s largest and most efficient.

zh: 中国政府推进可再生能源部分是因为来自中国中产阶级的压力日益增加。 他们对污染感到日益不满。
en: The government’s efforts to promote renewables are driven partly by growing pressure from middle-class Chinese, who are increasingly frustrated with pollution levels.

zh: 事实上，如今环境是中国的一个热点话题，纪录片《穹顶之下》即时明证。 该片以批判的角度讲述了空气污染和中国煤炭和石化公司在其中所起的“作用 ” 。
en: Indeed, the environment is a hot topic in China today, exemplified by the response to the documentary film “Under the Dome,” which takes a critical look at air pollution and the role of the country’s coal and petrochemical companies.

zh: 该片在2月底发布，时间恰逢每年一度的人大会议，自发布以来观看人数已超过3亿。
en: More than 300 million Chinese saw the film after its late-February release, which was timed to coincide with the annual meeting of China’s National People’s Congress in early March.

zh: 这部103分钟长的影片由著名记者柴静制作，突出强调了严重的雾霾对中国生产率最高城市所在成的健康威胁。
en: The 103-minute production, by the prominent journalist Chai Jing, highlights the health risks posed by the thick smog shrouding China’s most productive cities.

zh: 影片以柴静一出生就被诊断出良性肿瘤的女儿开头。
en: The film begins with the story of Chai’s own newborn daughter being diagnosed with a benign tumor.

zh: 尽管柴静从未将女儿的肿瘤与空气污染直接联系起来，但《穹顶之下》仍传达的引人注目的信息。
en: Though Chai never directly links her daughter’s tumor to air pollution, “Under the Dome” delivers a compelling message.

zh: 《穹顶之下》引起了极大的热议。
en: The public reaction was overwhelming.

zh: 该片甚至得到了即将上任的环保部长陈吉宁的支持，他将该片与蕾切尔·卡尔森（Rachel Carson）的名著《寂静的春天 》 （ Silent Spring）相提并论。
en: The film even drew support from the incoming environment minister, Chen Jining, who compared it to Rachel Carson’s influential book Silent Spring.

zh: 尽管反响如此热烈 — — 或许正因如此 — — 《穹顶之下》以及相关评论已被中国媒体禁播。
en: Despite – or perhaps because of – this response, “Under the Dome” and related commentary have been removed from China’s media.

zh: 但是，尽管政府也许不愿吸引注意力集中至环境问题，但显然也在采取措施解决环境问题。
en: But, though the government may not want not to draw attention to its pollution problem, it certainly is trying to address it.

zh: 中国政府投资让全球可再生能源价格有所下降。
en: Its investments have already helped to lower global prices of renewables.

zh: 哈佛大学和清华大学的研究者指出，理论上，到2030年风能就可以以煤电的价格生产出中国的所有电力。
en: Researchers at Harvard University and Tsinghua University say that wind power could, in theory, produce all of China’s electricity for the price of coal by 2030.

zh: 尽管如此，中国应该加大行动力度。
en: Still, China should be acting even more aggressively.

zh: 当局的重点不但应该包括生产可再生能源，还应该包括改进现有体系的能源效率。
en: The authorities should focus not only on producing renewable energy, but also on improving the energy efficiency of existing systems.

zh: 目前，中国经济的能源密集程度大约是美国的三倍（而美国本身的能源效率并不十分出色 ） 。
en: As it stands, China’s economy is about three times as energy-intensive as America’s (a country that is not particularly energy-efficient itself).

zh: 随着可再生能源相对于化石燃料的成本竞争力的增加以及能源消费效率的提高，中国将能够更好地降低排放而不破坏经济增长。
en: As renewable energy becomes increasingly cost-competitive with fossil fuels and energy consumption becomes more efficient, China will become better able to reduce emissions without undermining economic growth.

zh: 根据清华大学/麻省理工学院中国能源和气候项目（China Energy & Climate Project）的一项最新研究，碳税（特别是煤炭碳税）与继续支持可再生能源双管齐下可以让中国在21世纪20年代早期或中期达到碳排放高峰。
en: According to a recent study by the Tsinghua/MIT China Energy & Climate Project, a combination of carbon taxes – especially on coal – and continued support for renewable power would enable China to reach its carbon-emissions peak in the early to mid-2020s.

zh: 这一结果大大有利于全球减排。
en: Such an outcome would bolster global emission-reduction efforts considerably.

zh: 事实上国际能源署的新数据表明，2014年全球二氧化碳排放量没有增加，这表明减轻气候变化的努力可能正在产生比以往所认为的更大的效果。
en: In fact, new data from the International Energy Agency show that, in 2014, global CO2 emissions did not rise, suggesting that efforts to mitigate climate change may already be having a more significant effect than previously thought.

zh: 这一点尤其令人瞩目，因为最近的排放停止增长与过去40年中所发生过的三次不同，它是在经济扩张仍能达到相当出色的3%的年率的情况下实现的。
en: This is particularly notable because the recent pause in emissions growth, unlike the other three that have occurred in the last 40 years, occurred amid economic expansion at a respectable annual rate of 3%.

zh: 随着温室气体排放与经济增长的脱钩，世界成功遏制气候变化的机会大大增加了。
en: As greenhouse-gas emissions become decoupled from economic growth, the world’s chances of successfully mitigating climate change become much higher.

zh: 国际能源署首席经济学家（以及未来主任）法蒂赫·毕罗尔（Fatih Birol）指出，这一发展趋势“给了准备在12月的巴黎达成全球气候协定的谈判者急需的动力。 ”
en: As IEA Chief Economist (and future Executive Director) Fatih Birol put it, this development “provides much-needed momentum to negotiators preparing to forge a global climate deal in Paris in December.”

zh: 中国仍有很长的路要走。
en: China still has a long way to go.

zh: 但其最近在减少排放方面所取得的进步表明，在政府政策、公司计划和公共压力的正确组合下，哪怕是污染程度最大最严重的国家也可以让经济变得干净，并助力遏制全球变暖。
en: But its recent progress in reducing emissions shows that, with the right combination of government policies, corporate initiatives, and public pressure, even the largest and most polluted countries can clean up their economies and help fight global warming.

zh: 遏制中国减速
en: Containing China’s Slowdown

zh: 首尔—专家们喜欢争论中国经济的增长前景，如今是悲观派占据上风。
en: SEOUL – Pundits love debating the Chinese economy’s growth prospects, and nowadays the pessimists are gaining the upper hand.

zh: 但许多人的预测是基于其他经济体的经验，而在过去三十年中，中国一直在打破经济增长的常规。
en: But many are basing their predictions on other economies’ experiences, whereas China has been breaking the mold on economic growth for the last three decades.

zh: 那么，中国经济前景真如主流观点所认为的那么糟糕吗？
en: So, are China’s economic prospects as bad as prevailing wisdom seems to indicate?

zh: 果真如此的话，怎样改善其经济前景？
en: And, if they are, how can they be improved?

zh: 中国的状况毫无疑问是严重的。
en: China’s situation is certainly serious.

zh: 去年经济增长率为7.4 % ， 是1990年以来的最低值；今年也不可能达到7%的官方目标。 此外，据国际货币基金组织（IMF）的数据，2016年经济增长率只有6.3 % 。
en: The economy grew by 7.4% last year, the lowest rate since 1990; it is unlikely to meet the official target of 7% this year, and, according to the International Monetary Fund, will probably grow by a mere 6.3% in 2016.

zh: 显然，国内活动疲软和外部需求下降的影响正在显现。
en: Clearly, weak domestic activity and diminished external demand are taking their toll.

zh: 中国还在失去长期增长动力，生育率和投资回报率的下降抑制了劳动力扩张和资本积累。
en: China is also losing long-term growth momentum, as falling fertility rates and returns on investment weaken labor-force expansion and capital accumulation.

zh: 并且中国利用技术驱动的生产率进步也越来越困难。
en: And it is becoming increasingly difficult for China to take advantage of technology-driven productivity gains.

zh: 所有这些挑战让美国财政部前部长劳伦斯·萨默斯（Lawrence Summers）及其哈佛大学同时兰特·普利切特（Lant Pritchett）认为，根据“回归均值”理论所隐含的历史增长模式，中国增长在未来二十年可能下降至2—4 % 。
en: All of these challenges have led former US Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers and his Harvard colleague Lant Pritchett to argue that China’s growth could slow to 2-4% over the next two decades, as the country succumbs to the historically prevalent growth pattern implied by “regression to the mean.”

zh: 但是，到目前为止，中国的增长模式一直是“不走寻常路 ” ， 因此它一夜之间回归常规轨道似乎也不太可能。
en: But, given that China’s growth pattern has, so far, been exceptional, the notion that it will suddenly start following a common trajectory seems unlikely.

zh: 类似地，世界银行前首席经济学家林毅夫的观点也有缺陷。
en: Similarly flawed is the view of Justin Lin, former Chief Economist of the World Bank.

zh: 林毅夫认为，中国可以继续以每年8%的速度增长二十年，因为它拥有持久的“后发优势 ” ， 这一优势与其他因素一起，通过技术赶超美国带来生产率的快速提高。
en: Lin argues that China can achieve 8% annual growth for another two decades, owing to its enduring “latecomer advantage,” which, among other things, entails rapid productivity gains brought about by technological catch-up with the United States.

zh: 但这一观点没有考虑“条件趋同”的标准增长理论：只有拥有可比结构特征（比如劳动力技能和制度质量）的经济，它们的人均收入水平才会趋同。
en: But this fails to account for the standard growth theory of “conditional convergence”: only economies with comparable structural characteristics, such as labor skills and institutional quality, converge to similar per capita income levels.

zh: 出于这些原因，我提出一个较为中庸的观点。 我预测，到2030年，中国平均潜在GDP增长率将下降至5—6 % 。
en: For these reasons, I take a more moderate view, predicting that China’s average potential GDP growth will fall to 5-6% by 2030.

zh: 这一预期基于一个条件趋同框架，而该框架又基于过去三十年中国独特的增长经验以及其他经济体的增长经验所产生的数据。
en: This expectation is based on a conditional convergence framework that relies on data generated by China’s unique growth experience, as well as those of other economies, over the last three decades.

zh: 和林毅夫不同，我认为难以避免的中国经济减速很快就会到来。
en: Unlike Lin, I believe that China’s inevitable economic slowdown is coming soon.

zh: 但是，和萨默斯不同，我不认为前景必然苍凉。
en: But, unlike Summers, I do not believe that it has to be dire.

zh: 这一情景的关键是中国领导人让中国经济转向更平衡、可持续的增长路径，以现实的预期为基础。
en: The key to this scenario is that China’s leaders move the economy onto a more balanced and sustainable growth path, based on realistic expectations.

zh: 他们决不能错误地处理不可避免的挑战，比如那些来自国内制度缺陷、政治不确定性和外部冲击的挑战。
en: They cannot afford to mishandle unavoidable challenges, such as those stemming from domestic institutional weaknesses, political uncertainty, and external shocks.

zh: 任何有效战略的第一步都必须承认，对于如此庞大和不可预测的经济体，政府不能依赖直接干预或宏观经济政策。
en: The first step in any effective strategy must be to recognize that, in such a large and unpredictable economy, the government cannot rely on direct intervention or macroeconomic policies.

zh: 相反，政府必须实施改革以刺激生产率、抵消增长的下行压力。
en: Instead, it must implement reforms that boost productivity and offset downward pressure on growth.

zh: 要素市场 — — 劳动力、土地和金融 — — 改革十分关键。
en: Reforms in factor markets – labor, land, and finance – are essential.

zh: 中国领导人必须改善劳动力市场灵活性和劳动力流动性；提高土地使用、兼并和补偿效率；并构建一个更加市场化的金融体系。
en: China’s leaders must improve labor-market flexibility and labor mobility; make land use, acquisition, and compensation more efficient; and build a more market-based financial system.

zh: 目前，中国的金融体系受到严格监管并由银行（其中许多为国有银行）主导。
en: As it stands, China’s financial system is highly regulated and dominated by banks, many of which are state-owned.

zh: 要改变这一点，政府需要推进基于市场的信用配置。
en: To change this, the government needs to promote market-based credit allocation.

zh: 中国需要灵活高效的金融部门，以有效监督和监管的资本市场为基础，以此避免资产泡沫、支持生产性和创新性企业。
en: China needs a flexible and efficient financial sector, underpinned by an effectively supervised and regulated capital market, to avoid asset bubbles and support productive and innovative firms.

zh: 类似地，促进持续技术创新和产业升级的政策可以提高生产率。
en: Similarly, policies to promote continuous technological innovation and industrial upgrading can increase productivity.

zh: 而增加国内研究能力 — — 比如通过强化知识产权保护 — — 能够培育创新。
en: And measures that increase domestic research capacity – for example, by strengthening protection of intellectual property rights – can nurture innovation.

zh: 改革中国巨大的国有企业部门也能够刺激生产率。
en: Reform of China’s massive state-owned-enterprise (SOE) sector would also boost productivity.

zh: 最近宣布的国企改革是令人振奋的一步。
en: The recently announced SOE reforms are a promising step.

zh: 除了促进包括民营资本在内的混合所有制、强化公司治理和便利商业经营，国企改革还承诺向非国有投资者开放能源、资源和通讯业。
en: Beyond promoting mixed ownership involving private capital, strengthening corporate governance, and facilitating commercial operations, the reforms promise to open up the energy, resources, and telecom industries to non-state investors.

zh: 新一轮国企改革应该坚决贯彻下去。
en: This new round of SOE reform should be pursued diligently.

zh: 随着中国从投资和出口拉动型增长转向基于国内消费和服务德尔更加可持续的增长模式，这些提高生产率的措施是至关重要的。
en: Such efforts to increase productivity are all the more important as China moves to shift from investment- and export-led growth to a more sustainable model based on domestic consumption and services.

zh: 重新配置资源，使其从出口导向型行业流向服务业可能导致生产率不可逆转地下降。
en: Reallocating resources from export-oriented industries to service activities could cause an irreversible drop in productivity.

zh: 类似地，鼓励企业提高工资的政策将增加家庭收入和国内消费，但涨工资也可能侵蚀出口竞争力，阻碍外国直接投资的涌入。
en: Likewise, while policies that encourage firms to increase wages will raise household income and domestic consumption, wage increases can erode export competitiveness and choke off inflows of foreign direct investment.

zh: 光靠再平衡政策无法大幅提高平均产出增长率，因此，对于中国的长期前景，强化生产率至关重要。
en: With rebalancing policies alone unlikely to increase average output growth substantially, enhancing productivity is crucial to China’s long-term prosperity.

zh: 中国之谜的最后一块拼图是现实主义。
en: The final piece of the puzzle for China is realism.

zh: 目前，中国政府急切地要保持每年7%的漂亮增长数字，同时又要推进再平衡和改革。
en: As it stands, the Chinese government is keen to maintain decent growth of about 7% annually while pushing for rebalancing and reform.

zh: 风险在于，在改革措施起效前，当局仍可能需要依赖短期刺激以实现增长目标，从而加剧资源配置不当和结构性弱点。
en: The risk is that, until reform measures take effect, the authorities may rely on short-term stimulus to meet growth targets, aggravating resource misallocation and structural vulnerabilities.

zh: 考虑到去年中国总债务水平已达GDP的282 % — —已经超过了美国 — — 影子银行部门继续鲁莽地向地方政府和民营企业借贷可能给经济带来金融危机的危险。
en: Considering that China’s total debt reached 282% of GDP last year – surpassing America’s debt level – further reckless lending to local governments and private enterprises from the shadow banking sector would hold the economy hostage to the growing risk of a financial crisis.

zh: 要避免这一结果，中国应该在未来几年将增长目标降至6%左右。
en: To avoid such an outcome, China should lower its growth target to about 6% in the coming years.

zh: 这样一来，它就可以追求让经济走上更平衡和可持续的长期增长之路所需要的深度改革。
en: That way, it could pursue the deep reforms that are needed to move the economy onto a more balanced and sustainable long-term growth path.

zh: 停滞的中国改革
en: China’s Reform Stalemate

zh: 北京—中国的改革走入了死胡同，根本利益的冲突和微妙的阻力机制阻碍了进步。
en: BEIJING – China’s reform program has reached an impasse, with fundamental conflicts of interest and subtle resistance mechanisms blocking progress.

zh: 在这些障碍被排除前，陷入减速的中国经济 — — 2014年增长率为7.4 % ， 是近四分之一世纪以来的最低值 — — 几乎没有希望依靠改革给自己带来需要的推力。
en: Until these barriers are removed, there is little hope that China’s slowing economy – which grew by 7.4% in 2014, its lowest rate in nearly a quarter-century – can rely on reform to give it the push it needs.

zh: 中国领导人很熟悉实施彻底改革可能面临的困难。
en: Chinese leaders are well acquainted with how difficult it can be to implement drastic reforms.

zh: 1978年，邓小平果断启动“改革开放”时，他也面临着激烈的反对 — — 大多来自思想顽固的理论家和革命到底派。
en: When Deng Xiaoping launched his radical program of “reform and opening up” in 1978, he faced fierce opposition – mostly from fervent ideologues and revolutionary diehards.

zh: 正如邓小平的地位和铁腕让他能够战胜反对者、让中国经济走上现代化进程，现任国家主席习近平的果断领导也能克服既得利益，实施必要的改革。
en: Just as Deng’s status and forcefulness enabled him to face down his opponents and keep China’s economic modernization on course, President Xi Jinping’s determined leadership can overcome vested interests and implement the needed reforms.

zh: 当然，协调中国的根本性利益不合绝非易事 — — 因为利益集团不会公开透明地讨论改革，更不会反对。
en: Of course, reconciling the fundamental misalignment of interests in China will not be easy – not least because interest groups will not discuss, much less oppose, reforms in an open and transparent manner.

zh: 相反，他们指出改革风险太高，或者清除改革的具体规定。
en: Instead, they argue that the reforms are too risky or purge their substantive provisions.

zh: 迄今为止，在减少政府干预方面只做出了很小的妥协，所影响到的权力要么无关紧要，要么实际上根本不存在。
en: Only small concessions have been made to scaling back government intervention, affecting powers that are either irrelevant or never actually existed.

zh: 政府机构之间存在两类利益冲突。
en: There are two types of conflicts of interest among the government bodies.

zh: 首先，中国强大的官僚体系不愿因自由化和向市场经济转型的原因让出自己的权力。
en: First, China’s powerful bureaucracy is disinclined to cede its powers in the name of liberalization and a shift toward a more market-oriented economy.

zh: 比如，国资委是一个负责国有企业的部级政府机构。
en: For example, the Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council (SASAC) is the ministry-level government institution responsible for state-owned enterprises.

zh: 目前其任务包括清理国有企业的垄断权力，因为这阻碍了市场竞争。
en: Its task now includes eliminating the SOEs’ monopoly power, which is hampering market competition.

zh: 但削减国有企业的权力也意味着降低国资委的作用，也很有可能导致其最终被取消。
en: But reducing the SOEs’ power would also mean a diminished role for SASAC – and, most likely, its eventual obsolescence.

zh: 因此，治理垄断的努力十分缓慢，而下一阶段的改革 — — 向“混合所有制”转型 — — 依然任重道远。
en: As a result, efforts to fight monopoly are lagging, and the next stage of reform – the transition to a “blended ownership system” – remains distant.

zh: 类似地，外管局是中国人民银行下属管理商业银行和家庭外汇交易的机构，其权力来自对资本流进流出的管制。
en: Similarly, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), the subsidiary of the People’s Bank of China that controls the foreign-exchange transactions of commercial banks and households, derives its power from controlling capital inflows and outflows.

zh: 外管局明白向资本账户自由化迈进意味着它最终将被解散，因此以各种借口（最近的西方金融危机让这些借口看起来颇有道理）继续保持对外汇交易的严格管制。
en: Recognizing that progress toward capital-account liberalization would imply its eventual demise, SAFE has made numerous excuses (to which the recent financial crises in the West have lent credence) for retaining tight control over foreign-exchange transactions.

zh: 因此，尽管政府言之凿凿要实现资本账户自由化，但人民银行仍没有作出显而易见的进展。
en: So, despite the government’s stated commitment to liberalize the capital account, the PBOC has yet to make observable progress.

zh: 中国的第二大利益冲突是中央和地方政府。 两者理应调整收入分享模式。
en: The second major conflict of interest in China is between the central and local governments, which are supposed to be adjusting their revenue-sharing model.

zh: 问题在于它们各自的税收收入分成和强制性支出比例之间的不匹配。
en: The problem lies in a mismatch between their respective shares of tax revenues and mandatory expenditures.

zh: 地方政府被迫在获得低收入比例的情况下承担高公共支出比例，因此债台高筑。
en: With local governments forced to cover a large proportion of public spending with a disproportionately low share of revenues, local-government debt has swelled.

zh: 但中央政府仍不愿对收入分成模式作出重大调整，原因不但在于其担心国库，也在于地方官员权威的增加。
en: But the central government remains reluctant to make significant changes to the revenue-sharing model, wary not only of the effects on its coffers, but also of conferring more authority on local officials.

zh: 此外，中央政府怀疑地方政府是否有能力管好预算、高效地使用增加的税收收入。
en: Moreover, they doubt local governments’ ability to manage their budgets properly and to use the additional tax revenues efficiently.

zh: 这些例子表明，根本矛盾存在于改革过程的目标与支撑这些目标的激励之间。
en: The fundamental contradiction, as these examples show, is between the goals of the reform process and the incentives that underpin them.

zh: 最能表明这一问题的莫过于中共十八大三中全会所提出的“混合所有制 ” 。
en: Nowhere is this clearer than in the “mixed ownership system” envisaged by the Third Plenary of the 18th Central Committee of the Communist Party of China.

zh: 按设想，鼓励民营部门在能源、电力和金融等战略性领域入股国有企业能够增加竞争、提高效率、减少政府的投资压力。
en: Encouraging the private sector to take stakes in SOEs in strategic areas like energy, power, and finance is supposed to increase competition, boost efficiency, and reduce pressure on the government to invest.

zh: 但民营投资者为何要把钱投向国有企业？
en: But why should private investors put their money in SOEs?

zh: 作为管理层由组织部指派国有企业的少数股东，民营行动方根本不能影响决策。
en: As minority shareholders in firms whose managers are appointed by the Central Personnel Ministry, private actors cannot influence decision-making.

zh: 除非中央政府愿意放弃其对国有企业管理层的控制，否则所有权改革无法引起民营部门的多大兴趣。
en: Until the central government is willing to yield its control over SOE management, ownership reforms are likely to spark only tepid interest from the private sector.

zh: 如果能够充分实施，当前的改革措施将对中国政治经济产生深远影响，因为它们改变了权力平衡，让它从官员手中转移到市场手中。
en: If implemented fully, the current round of reforms would have a far-reaching impact on China’s political economy, because they shift the balance of power from officials to markets.

zh: 这可以让中国继续朝高收入国家行列迈进，并在此过程中改善数百万人民的福利。
en: This would enable China to continue its ascent toward high-income status, improving the wellbeing of millions of its citizens along the way.

zh: 但既得利益不会善罢甘休。
en: But vested interests will not back down.

zh: 尽管他们不会公然反对改革，但他们将继续消极应对并传播对经济动荡和社会对立的恐慌，以阻止威胁他们地位和特权的的变化。
en: Though they will not oppose reforms outright, they will continue to procrastinate and spread fear about economic instability and social tension to prevent changes that threaten to diminish their status and prerogatives.

zh: 除非中国最高领导层克服这些阻力，否则改革无法取得进展。
en: Unless and until China’s top leaders overcome such resistance, progress on reform will remain sluggish.

zh: 中国的可再生能源革命
en: China’s Renewable-Energy Revolution

zh: 北京 — — 2017年初，中国宣布截止2020年将投资3，600亿美元用于发展可再生能源，并废除建设85座燃煤电厂的计划。
en: BEIJING – At the start of 2017, China announced that it would invest $360 billion in renewable energy by 2020 and scrap plans to build 85 coal-fired power plants.

zh: 3月，中国政府报告该国已经超额完成了能源效率、碳排放强度、清洁能源占比等领域的官方目标。
en: In March, Chinese authorities reported that the country was already exceeding official targets for energy efficiency, carbon intensity, and the share of clean energy sources.

zh: 就在上个月，中国的能源监管机构国家能源局推出了降低国家对煤炭依赖的新举措。
en: And just last month, China’s energy regulator, the National Energy Administration, rolled out new measures to reduce the country’s dependence on coal.

zh: 这些还仅仅是中国正处在全球能源转型核心的最新指标，技术变革和可再生能源成本下降是背后的驱动因素。
en: These are just the latest indicators that China is at the center of a global energy transformation, which is being driven by technological change and the falling cost of renewables.

zh: 但中国并不仅仅是投资于可再生能源及淘汰煤炭。
en: But China is not just investing in renewables and phasing out coal.

zh: 该国还在全球能源需求中所占的比例不断扩大，这意味着中国经济向服务和消费主导型增长的持续转型将重塑全球能源行业。
en: It also accounts for a growing share of global energy demand, meaning that its economy’s continuing shift toward service- and consumption-led growth will reshape the resource sector worldwide.

zh: 与此同时，其他各种因素都在减少全球能源消耗，包括住宅、工业和商业建筑提升能效和运输业能源需求降低，运输业能源需求降低是因为自动驾驶技术的发展和汽车共享。
en: At the same time, various other factors are reducing global resource consumption, including increased energy efficiency in residential, industrial, and commercial buildings, and lower demand for energy in transportation, owing to the proliferation of autonomous vehicles and ride sharing.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所（MGI）一份名为超越超级周期：技术如何重塑资源的新报告认为，上述趋势正在减缓初级能源需求的增长。
en: According to Beyond the Supercycle: How Technology Is Reshaping Resources, a new report from the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI), these trends are slowing the growth of primary energy demand.

zh: 如果迅速采用新技术的趋势能够继续下去，那么初级能源需求可能在2025年见顶回落。
en: If rapid adoption of new technologies continues, that demand could peak in 2025.

zh: 而且随着能源应用密集程度的降低和效率的提高，全球经济的能源使用效率可能会在今后20年出现40~70%的增长。
en: And with less intensive energy use and increased efficiency, energy productivity in the global economy could increase by 40-70% over the next two decades.

zh: 尽管全球能源需求增长正在放缓，但中国在整体需求中的份额却不断提高。
en: While global growth in energy demand is slowing, China’s share of that demand is increasing.

zh: 截止2035年，中国在世界初级能源需求中所占的份额可能从今天的23%提高到28 % ， 而同期美国的能源需求份额则可能从今天的16%下降到2035年的12%左右。
en: By 2035, China may account for 28% of the world’s primary energy demand, up from 23% today, whereas the United States could account for just 12% by 2035, down from 16% today.

zh: 中国已经在控制能源需求强度方面取得了重大进展：在1980到2010年间，中国经济增长了18倍，但其能源消费却只增长了五倍左右。
en: China has already made significant progress in reducing its resource intensity: between 1980 and 2010, its economy grew 18-fold, but its energy consumption grew only fivefold.

zh: 世界银行的数据显示，这反映出单位GDP实现了70%的能源强度下降。
en: According to World Bank data, that reflects a 70% decline in energy intensity per unit of GDP.

zh: 在第13个五年计划中，中国政府的目标是在2016到2020年间将能源强度降低15 % 。
en: In its 13th Five-Year Plan, the Chinese government aims to reduce energy intensity by a total of 15% between 2016 and 2020.

zh: 中国已经在很好地实现这一目标。
en: It is already well on its way toward achieving that goal.

zh: 在今年年初举行的全国人民代表大会上，中国总理李克强报告仅去年一年中国就实现了5%的能源强度下降。
en: At China's National People’s Congress earlier this year, Chinese Premier Li Keqiang reported that China’s energy intensity fell by 5% last year alone.

zh: 可再生能源仅仅是中国能源强度下降的一个理由。
en: Renewables are one reason for China’s declining resource intensity.

zh: 因为希望在该领域取得世界领先地位，中国已经每年投资超过一千亿美元用于发展国内的可再生能源市场。
en: Hoping to become a world leader in the field, China is already investing more than $100 billion in domestic renewables every year.

zh: 这一数字是美国国内可再生能源投资的两倍，并且超过美国和欧盟对可再生资源年度投资的总和。
en: That is twice the level of US investment in domestic renewable energy and more than the combined annual investment of the US and the European Union.

zh: 不仅如此，中国正在投资320亿美元用于开发海外可再生资源，这一数字超过世界其他任何国家，而顶级中国企业在全球可再生能源价值链中的领先地位则越来越稳固。
en: In addition, China is investing $32 billion – more than any other country – in renewables overseas, with top-tier Chinese companies increasingly taking the lead in global renewable-energy value chains.

zh: 中国国家电网公司计划开发利用全球风力发电机和太阳能电池板的能源网。
en: China’s State Grid Corporation has plans to develop an energy grid that draws on wind turbines and solar panels from around the world.

zh: 中国太阳能电池板制造企业估计比美国同行成本低20 % ， 因为他们实现了规模经济以及更先进的供应链开发。
en: Chinese solar-panel manufacturers are estimated to have a 20% cost advantage over their US peers, owing to economies of scale and more advanced supply-chain development.

zh: 而中国风力发电机制造企业则逐渐弥补了原来存在的技术差距，现在已经占据超过90%的中国国内市场，而2002年国内企业仅占25%左右。
en: And Chinese wind-turbine manufacturers, having gradually closed technology gaps, now account for more than 90% of the Chinese domestic market, up from just 25% in 2002.

zh: 上述趋势表明中国将成为能源需求和尖端技术的主要发源地，意味着中国将拥有独一无二的机会提供全球领导。
en: These trends suggest that China will be a major source of both energy demand and cutting-edge technology, implying that it will have a unique opportunity to provide global leadership.

zh: 中国降低能源强度的经验可以成为发展中国家效仿的对象。
en: Its experience in reducing energy intensity can serve as a roadmap for developing countries.

zh: 而中国对国内国外可再生能源的投资可能引领进一步技术突破，进而导致全球各地消费者的成本下降。
en: And its investments in renewables at home and abroad can lead to additional technological breakthroughs that drive down costs for consumers everywhere.

zh: 但中国在从化石能源向可再生能源转型的过程中在快速变化的全球能源领域仍将面对挑战。
en: But China will also face challenges as it moves from fossil fuels to renewables within a changing global resource sector.

zh: 中国经济仍然高度依赖煤炭，这意味着中国在向天然气和可再生能源等其他能源转型的过程中可能成本会非常高昂。
en: Its economy is still highly dependent on coal, implying sizeable costs as it shifts capacity to other resources such as natural gas and renewables.

zh: 此外，中国太阳能电池板和风电厂的建设已经超过了电网升级的速度，并造成大面积浪费的情况。
en: Moreover, the construction of solar panels and wind farms in China has outpaced upgrades to its electrical grid, creating a great deal of waste.

zh: 而中国制造企业像其他大多数制造企业一样，正面临越来越大的压力来降低成本和提高效率以弥补世界能源增长的不足。
en: And Chinese producers, like most others, are feeling increasing pressure to reduce costs and improve efficiency to make up for slower demand growth worldwide.

zh: 尽管存在这些技术障碍，但技术创新会帮助中国制造企业实现生产率的提高并将更低的成本贡献给消费者。
en: Despite these hurdles, technological innovation should help Chinese producers realize productivity gains and deliver savings to consumers.

zh: 按照麦肯锡研究所的统计，截止2035年，主要商品的供需变化可能导致全世界9，000到1.6万亿美元的成本下降。
en: According to MGI, by 2035, changes in the supply and demand for major commodities could result in total cost savings of $900 billion to $1.6 trillion worldwide.

zh: 上述成本下降规模不仅取决于新技术的应用速度，还取决于决策者及企业能否适应新的环境。
en: The scale of these savings will depend not only on how quickly new technology is adopted, but also on how policymakers and companies adapt to their new environment.

zh: 归根结底，所有这一切都要看中国。
en: But, above all, it will depend on China.

zh: 中国汇率陷阱
en: China’s Exchange-Rate Trap

zh: 纽约—几个月来，中国汇率政策一直在冲击全球金融市场。
en: NEW YORK – For months now, China’s exchange-rate policy has been roiling global financial markets.

zh: 更准确地说，是中国汇率政策的模糊性一直在冲击全球金融市场。
en: More precisely, confusion about that policy has been roiling the markets.

zh: 中国官员在沟通他们的意图方面做得太差，导致人们认为他们不知道他们在干什么。
en: Chinese officials have done a poor job communicating their intentions, encouraging the belief that they don’t know what they’re doing.

zh: 但批评中国政策容易，提出建设性意见很难。
en: But criticizing Chinese policy is easier than offering constructive advice.

zh: 事实是，中国政府已经没有什么好选择。
en: The fact is that China’s government no longer has any good options.

zh: 毫无疑问，如果采取更具弹性的汇率，将打消投机者的单边押注，成为经济冲击吸收器，中国也将因此获益。
en: No question, the country would be better off with a more flexible exchange rate that eliminated one-way bets for speculators and acted as an economic shock absorber.

zh: 但“退出战略”方面的文献 — — 即关于如何以更具弹性的汇率取代货币盯住 — — 清楚地表明，中国已经错失平稳过渡的时机。
en: But the literature on “exit strategies” – on how to replace a currency peg with a more flexible exchange rate – makes clear that the moment when China could have navigated this transition smoothly has now passed.

zh: 一国要想平稳取消盯住汇率，唯有在人们对其经济充满信心时着手，让人们相信根据弹性的汇率既可以贬值，也可以升值。
en: Countries can exit a pegged rate smoothly only when there is confidence in the economy, encouraging the belief that the more flexible exchange rate can appreciate as well as weaken.

zh: 中国曾经拥有这样的机会，但今时已不同往日。
en: This may have been true of China once; it is no longer true today.

zh: 如今，中国决策者就好比是一位爱尔兰游客，他想去都柏林，而他得到的回答是“先生，如果我是你，我不会从这里出发。 ”
en: This puts Chinese policymakers in the position of the Irish tourist who asks for directions to Dublin and is told, “Well, sir, if I were you, I wouldn’t start from here.”

zh: 那么，中国最不坏的选择是什么？
en: What, then, is China’s least bad option?

zh: 当局可以继续当前战略 — — 让人民币盯住一揽子外币，同时推进经济重组和再平衡日程。
en: The authorities could continue with their current strategy of pegging the renminbi to a basket of foreign currencies, and push ahead with their agenda of restructuring and rebalancing the economy.

zh: 但考虑到最近的失误，让持怀疑态度的观察者相信他们将坚决执行这一战略需要时间。
en: But convincing skeptical observers that they are committed to this strategy will take time, given recent missteps.

zh: 与此同时，投资者也会在相反的方向上下注。
en: Meanwhile, investors will bet against them.

zh: 已经如此了。
en: They already are.

zh: 资本外流保持在每月1,000亿美元。
en: Capital outflows have been running at $100 billion a month.

zh: 不难算出，拥有3万亿美元外汇储备的中国当局还可以支撑数年。
en: Simple arithmetic suggests that with $3 trillion of reserves, the authorities can hold out for at least a couple of years.

zh: 但资本外逃总是在最后阶段急剧扩大。
en: But capital flight tends to rise dramatically as the end draws near.

zh: 因此，两年的窗口期只是个幻觉。
en: A two-year window is an illusion.

zh: 另一个选择是让人民币更加自由地波动。
en: Alternatively, the renminbi could be allowed to fluctuate more freely.

zh: 中国人民银行可以允许人民币兑参考货币篮汇率每月贬值（比如）1 % ， 以提振中国出口商的竞争力并打消人民币被高估的担忧。
en: The People’s Bank of China can permit it to depreciate against the reference basket by, say, 1% a month, in order to enhance the competitiveness of Chinese exports and address concerns that the currency is overvalued.

zh: 但是，在全球需求疲软的情况下，这一温和贬值不会对刺激出口和支持经济增长起到多大作用。
en: But, given weak global demand, this kind of modest depreciation won’t do much to boost exports and support economic growth.

zh: 此外，如果人民币每个月都要失去1%的价值，资本外逃也会进一步加速。
en: Moreover, with the renminbi losing 1% of its value each month, capital flight would accelerate further.

zh: 第三个选择是一次性贬值（比如）25 % 。
en: A third option is a one-time devaluation of, say, 25%.

zh: 这将大大增强出口竞争力。
en: This would enhance export competitiveness at a stroke.

zh: 这一观点认为，让货币贬值到大幅低估的程度后，投资者就会预期反弹。
en: Depreciate the currency to the point where it is significantly undervalued, the argument goes, and investors will expect it to recover.

zh: 资本将流入，而不是流出。
en: Capital will then flow in, not out.

zh: 当然，这需要假设所有人都认为一次贬值不会引发另一次贬值。
en: This assumes, of course, that everyone buys into the idea that one devaluation doesn’t augur another.

zh: 它假设投资者不会因为当局不再信守此前绝不大幅贬值的承诺而受到影响。
en: It assumes that investors would be unperturbed by the authorities’ abandonment of their prior vow to shun a mega-devaluation.

zh: 它忽视一个事实，即已经深陷重重困境的中国企业背负着多大1万亿美元的外币债务，贬值将让它们维持债务的难度大大增加。
en: It ignores the fact that Chinese enterprises, already in dire straits, have as much as $1 trillion of foreign-currency debt that would become significantly more difficult to service.

zh: 它还假设大幅贬值对于中国的竞争对手国家的破坏性经济影响是最低的。
en: And it minimizes the devastating economic impact of a mega-devaluation on countries with which China competes.

zh: 在排除过程中，唯一留下的选项是收紧资本管制。
en: By process of elimination, the only option that remains is tightening capital controls.

zh: 严格的管制可以防止居民和外国人在在岸市场上卖出人民币买入外汇，然后将所得汇往国外。
en: Strict controls can prevent residents and foreigners from selling renminbi for foreign currency on onshore markets and transferring the proceeds abroad.

zh: 在这一金融长城的保护下，当局可以允许汇率波动更加自由、逐渐贬值，而不引发资本外逃。
en: Protected by this financial Great Wall, the authorities could let the exchange rate fluctuate more freely and allow it to depreciate gradually without provoking capital flight.

zh: 当局将赢得所需要的时间实施构建信心的改革。
en: They would gain the time needed to implement confidence-building reforms.

zh: 他们可以削减对亏损企业的流动性供给，迫使企业砍掉过剩产能。
en: They could curtail the provision of liquidity to loss-making enterprises, forcing firms to eliminate excess capacity.

zh: 他们可以重组有问题的债务。
en: They could restructure problematic debts.

zh: 他们可以对因为这些改革而受到附带资产负债表冲击的银行进行资本重组。
en: They could recapitalize banks that suffered inadvertent balance-sheets damage as a result of these reforms.

zh: 他们可以修复受到损害的信誉。
en: They could repair their damaged credibility.

zh: 日本银行行长黑田东彦等少数观察者认为中国可以考虑收紧管制。
en: A few observers, like Bank of Japan head Haruhiko Kuroda, have suggested that China might consider tightening controls.

zh: 但大部分经济学家不愿意将这一选项纳入考虑范围。
en: But most economists are reluctant to contemplate this option.

zh: 资本管制会破坏人民币国际化的努力，让IMF下不了台 — — 它最近才将人民币纳入决定其账户单位特别提款权（SDR）的货币篮子中。
en: Capital controls would undermine China’s efforts to internationalize the renminbi and would embarrass the International Monetary Fund, which recently added the currency to the basket of four major currencies underpinning its unit of account, the SDR.

zh: 但是，最有力的反对意见是，重启管制将去除改革的压力。
en: The most powerful objection, though, is that reimposing controls would remove the pressure to reform.

zh: 摆脱国际资本市场压力后，中国当局将顺从国有企业和地方官员，他们更想继续保持宽松的流动性供给，想让银行为他们的债务展期。
en: Freed of pressure from international capital markets, the Chinese authorities would defer to state-owned enterprises and local officials who prefer continued easy provision of liquidity and would rather see the banks simply roll over their loans.

zh: 这一倒退风险是实实在在的。
en: This risk of backsliding is real.

zh: 如果成为现实，资本管制所赢得的时间将白白浪费。
en: If it materializes, the time bought by capital controls will be squandered.

zh: 在某一点上，问题将从汇率危机演变为增长崩溃。
en: The problem would then metastasize, at some point, from an exchange-rate crisis to a growth collapse.

zh: 中国 — — 以及世界 — — 面临的最好的局面是中国当局明白危机是可怕的浪费。
en: China’s best hope – and the world’s – is that the Chinese authorities understand that a crisis is a terrible thing to waste.

zh: 人民币何以贬值？
en: Why is the Renminbi Depreciating?

zh: 发自北京 — — 中国的人民币汇率有开始下跌了。
en: BEIJING – China’s currency has started falling again.

zh: 人民币上一次大幅贬值始于2015年下半年，因资本外流激增而触发，尽管中国人民银行多次出手干预，市场仍然经历了一年多的狂乱状态。
en: The last major depreciation of the Chinese renminbi began in the second half of 2015, triggered by a surge in capital outflows. Despite repeated interventions by the People’s Bank of China (PBOC), markets remained frenzied for more than a year.

zh: 在2017年初稳定下来之前美元兑人民币汇率已降到大概7的水平。
en: The currency’s value fell to nearly CN¥7 per US dollar, before stabilizing in early 2017.

zh: 而最近这次的下跌幅度则更大。
en: The latest decline has been even sharper.

zh: 在升值了一年多之后，人民币汇率在2018年第二季度开始走弱 — — 6月份汇率出现大幅加速下跌，其中人民币兑美元汇率跌幅最大。
en: After more than a year of appreciation, the exchange rate began to weaken in the second quarter of 2018 – a drop that accelerated significantly in June, when the currency suffered its largest-ever monthly decline against the US dollar.

zh: 到目前为止，人民币兑美元已经贬值超过8 ％ 。
en: So far, the renminbi had depreciated by over 8% against the dollar.

zh: 正如2015~2016年一样，投资者都在忧虑中国的经济前景。
en: Like in 2015-2016, investors are concerned about China’s economic prospects.

zh: 由于基础设施投资下降以及出口表现不佳，该国的GDP增长正在放缓 — — 如今投资者害怕这一趋势可能会被美国发起的针锋性贸易战所强化。
en: The country’s GDP growth is slowing, owing to declining infrastructure investment and poor export performance – trends that investors now fear could be reinforced by the tit-for-tat trade war that the United States has initiated.

zh: 有些人甚至担心说如果美国（错误地）认为人民币贬值是为了确保自身贸易优势，那么人民币贬值可能会加剧这场贸易战。
en: Some have even expressed concern that the falling renminbi could exacerbate that trade war, if it is (wrongly) perceived by the US to be a purposeful devaluation aimed at securing a trade advantage.

zh: 由于中国结构性改革停滞不前，风险也在进一步积累。
en: With China’s structural reforms lagging, the risks are heightened further.

zh: 尽管中国人民银行将自身政策立场调整为略微放松，但相对从紧的货币政策，金融监管的强化以及旨在支持更广泛去杠杆化和遏制房价增长的规定也引发了对房地产和其他资产泡沫即将破裂的担忧。
en: A relatively tight monetary policy, strengthened financial supervision, and regulation aimed at supporting a broader deleveraging drive and containing housing prices also stoke concern that real-estate and other asset bubbles will soon burst, though the PBOC adjusted its policy stance toward loosening a bit.

zh: 加上其他新兴经济体不断上升的风险，也无怪乎投资者会越来越精神不定了
en: Add to that rising risks in other emerging economies, and it is unsurprising that investors are becoming increasingly unnerved.

zh: 但与上一轮人民币贬值形成鲜明对比的是，投资者并未表现恐慌。
en: Yet, in contrast to the last round of renminbi depreciation, investors aren’t panicking.

zh: 外汇市场的日均交易量仅相当于2015年和2016年平均交易量的一半左右。
en: The average volume of daily transactions in the foreign-exchange market amounts to only about half of the average in 2015 and 2016.

zh: 由于交易量相对较小，即使是对美元的需求稍多了一点也会对汇率产生重大影响。
en: With a relatively small volume of transactions, even relatively tepid excess demand for US dollars can have a significant impact on the exchange rate.

zh: 此外，根据国家外汇管理局的数据，2018年第二季度中国的经常账户和非储备金融账户盈余分别为58亿美元和182亿美元。
en: Moreover, according to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange, China’s current-account and non-reserve financial-account surpluses stood at $5.8 billion and $18.2 billion, respectively, in the second quarter of 2018

zh: 既然第二季度和7月份出现“双顺差 ” ， 又没有明显的大规模资本外流，人民币的大幅贬值就变得更加难以解释。
en: With “twin surpluses” in the second quarter and July, and with no detectable large-scale capital outflows, the renminbi’s sharp depreciation becomes more difficult to explain.

zh: 一种解释是目前公布的国际收支平衡数据只是初步的，还有待修订。
en: One explanation is that the published balance-of-payments data, now only preliminary, will be revised.

zh: 另一种可能性是中国人民银行正在依据其在2016年初制定的“汇率中间价制定规则”来管理人民币汇率。
en: Another possibility is that the PBOC is managing the renminbi’s exchange rate according to the “central-parity rate-setting rule” that it formulated in early 2016.

zh: 该规则会参照前一个交易日的收盘价以及可以保持中国外汇交易系统指数（包含一揽子24个货币）在过去24小时内不变的“理论汇率 ” 。
en: That rule takes into account the previous trading day’s closing price, as well as the “theoretical exchange rate” that would keep the index of the China Foreign Exchange Trade System, a 24-currency basket, unchanged over the previous 24 hours.

zh: 如果是这种情况，人民币汇率与外汇市场的美元供需状况无直接关系。
en: If this is the case, the renminbi exchange rate is not related directly to US dollar supply and demand in the foreign-exchange market.

zh: 但这种说法存在一个问题：中国人民银行在大约一年前就已经停止了对外汇市场的日常干预。
en: But there is a problem with this account: the PBOC stopped its daily interventions in the foreign-exchange market about a year ago.

zh: 如果重启这些干预措施，那么它可能会试图通过出售外汇储备来阻止人民币贬值。
en: If it restarted those interventions, presumably it would be attempting to stem the renminbi’s fall by selling foreign-exchange reserves.

zh: 然而在7月中上旬人民币汇率迅速下跌时，中国的外汇储备实际上是有所增加的。
en: Yet in the second quarter of July, when the renminbi was declining rapidly, China’s foreign-exchange reserves actually increased.

zh: 这种增加可能仅仅反映了中国以美元计价的储备资产价值的增加。
en: That increase may simply reflect the increase in the value of China’s dollar-denominated reserve assets.

zh: 但也有可能中国人民银行已经动用了外汇储备，而没有相应更新公开的国际收支数据而已。
en: But it is also possible that the PBOC has used China’s foreign-exchange reserves, without updating the published balance of payments accordingly.

zh: 鉴于2015~2016年的经验，后一种情况会引起严重关切。
en: The latter scenario would raise serious concerns, given the experience of 2015-2016.

zh: 当时，中国人民银行的强烈干预措施在不到两年时间内令中国的外汇储备中缩水了约1万亿美元。
en: At that time, the PBOC’s frenetic interventions drained some $1 trillion from China’s foreign-exchange reserves in less than two years.

zh: 如果没有这种代价高昂的干预，人民币贬值的幅度可能更大。
en: Without that costly intervention, the renminbi may have depreciated more than it did.

zh: 但事实是当所有人都认为汇率很快就会跌至1美元兑7人民币的水平时，汇率稳定了下来，随后开始攀升。
en: But the fact is that, just when everyone believed that the exchange rate would soon break the CN ¥7 per US dollar threshold, it stabilized, and then began to climb.

zh: 当然，有些人认为这种稳定是中国人民银行出手的结果。
en: Of course, some argue that this stabilization was an upshot of the PBOC’s efforts.

zh: 但随后美元指数的下跌则表明情况并非如此。
en: But the subsequent decline in the dollar index suggests otherwise.

zh: 无论如何，考虑到中国的经济基本面，很难想象人民币会下跌到触发金融危机的程度。
en: In any case, given China’s economic fundamentals, it is difficult to imagine that the renminbi would have fallen so far that it would have triggered a financial crisis.

zh: 这段经历给了我们一个明确的教训：不要惊慌。
en: This experience holds a clear lesson: don’t panic.

zh: 对于市场参与者而言，这意味着要避免大规模的资本外逃。
en: For market participants, that means refraining from large-scale capital flight.

zh: 对中国货币当局而言，这意味着即使美元兑人民币汇率跌至7以下也必须坚持不干预政策。
en: For the Chinese monetary authorities, it means sticking to a policy of non-intervention, even if the dollar exchange rate drops below CN ¥7.

zh: 只要有了这种忍耐，拖延已久的汇率制度改革就可能最终大功告成。
en: With this forbearance, the long-overdue reform of the exchange-rate regime may finally be completed.

zh: 人民币如何应对特朗普冲击？
en: Trumping the Renminbi

zh: 香港—在刚刚结束的瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛年会上，中国国家主席习近平有力地为全球化辩护，重申了中国的“开放”政策，承诺不会挑起贸易战，也不会企图从货币贬值中获利。
en: HONG KONG – At the recently concluded World Economic Forum Annual Meeting in Davos, Switzerland, Chinese President Xi Jinping mounted a robust defense of globalization, reaffirming his country’s “open door” policy and pledging never to seek to start a trade war or to benefit from devaluation of its currency.

zh: 之后不久，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在其就职演说中做出了实质上的相反的承诺：他使用了七次“保护”一词，确认了他的“美国第一”的思想就是保护主义的意思。
en: Soon after, US President Donald Trump, in his inaugural address, effectively made the opposite pledge: using the word “protect” seven times, he confirmed that his “America first” doctrine means protectionism.

zh: 特朗普将美国说成是处于衰落中、必须复兴的经济体。
en: Trump speaks of the United States as an economy in decline that must be revitalized.

zh: 但现实是美国经济在过去两年中表现十分抢眼。
en: But the reality is that the US economy has been performing rather well in the last two years.

zh: 其经济复苏速度超过了其他发达经济体； 创造的就业令人印象深刻；美元也保持强势。
en: Its recovery has outpaced that of other advanced economies; job creation has been impressive; and the dollar has been strong.

zh: 在过去几个月中，特朗普承诺的增加政府支出、降低企业税收、削减监管约束等新政吸引了全球避险投资流向美国寻求高质量资产，导致美元猛烈升值。
en: The dollar’s value has risen particularly high in the last few months, as Trump’s promises to increase government spending, lower business taxes, and cut regulation have inspired a flight to quality by investors.

zh: 相反，人民币经历了大幅贬值 — — 从2014年年底的6.2元兑1美元下跌到去年年底的6.95元兑1美元 — — 主要原因，除美元升值外，是中国的投资和出口减缓。
en: By contrast, the Chinese renminbi has weakened significantly – from CN¥6.2 per dollar at the end of 2014 to CN¥6.95 at the end of last year – owing largely to declining investment and exports.

zh: 特朗普指责中国为了提振出口竞争力故意贬值人民币。
en: Trump has accused China of intentionally devaluing the renminbi, in order to boost its export competitiveness.

zh: 但真相正好相反：面临强烈的人民币贬值压力，中国一直在试图让人民币兑美元汇率保持相对稳定，并因此而消耗了1万多亿美元的官方外汇储备。
en: But the truth is quite the opposite: in the face of strong downward pressure on the renminbi, China has sought to keep the renminbi-dollar exchange rate relatively stable, – an effort that has contributed to a decline of more than $1 trillion in official foreign-currency reserves.

zh: 与特朗普一样，中国绝不希望人民币贬值 。
en: China does not want the renminbi to depreciate any more than Trump does.

zh: 但影响汇率变化的原因多样而复杂，所有国家都无法完全控制它的汇率。
en: But no country has full control over its exchange rate.

zh: 从技术发展的影响到地缘政治对峙的冲击，再到主要贸易伙伴国内宏观形势的变化，都会影响人民币的贬值，以及由于贬值而导致的汇率政策的变化。
en: From technological developments to geopolitical rivalries to policy shifts among major trading partners, the causes of the renminbi’s decline – and, thus, the factors influencing China’s exchange-rate policy – are varied and complex.

zh: 影响汇率的其中一个因素是迅速变化的全球供应链。
en: One factor affecting exchange rates is a rapidly changing global supply chain.

zh: 不断演化的消费模式、监管制度和数字技术刺激了更多的本地生产基地。
en: Evolving consumption patterns, regulatory regimes, and digital technologies have lately encouraged more domestic production.

zh: 在美国，机器人和3D打印等技术提振了本地制造业的效益，支持了经济复苏，而并没有增加来自亚洲的进口。
en: In the US, manufacturing has received a boost from technologies like robotics and 3D printing. That has supported economic recovery, without increasing its imports from Asia.

zh: 与此同时，中国已经从贸易推动的增长模式转变为依靠更高的国内消费的模式，因此强势人民币可能更有利于中国经济。
en: Meanwhile, China is already shifting from an export-driven growth model to one based on higher domestic consumption, so a stronger renminbi might serve its economy better.

zh: 2016年，中国的经常项目盈余下降到只有GDP的2.1 % ， 国际货币基金组织（IMF）预测，随着出口的继续下降，中国的经常项目盈余还将进一步减少。
en: China’s current-account surplus fell to just 2.1% of GDP in 2016, and the International Monetary Fund projects it to narrow further, as exports continue to fall.

zh: 但经常项目不是影响汇率唯一重要的因素。
en: But the current account is not the only relevant factor.

zh: 考虑到资本流动对汇率的重要影响，国际清算银行经济学家克劳迪奥·伯利奥（Claudio Borio ）认为也需要关注记录一个国家对外资产与负债的金融账户。
en: Given the role of capital flows in exchange rates, BIS economist Claudio Borio argues for looking at the financial account as well.

zh: 在这方面，人民币贬值并不利于中国的金融账户的健康，因为贬值会导致由金融账户调整而触发的资本外逃。
en: Here, too, a depreciating renminbi doesn’t serve China.

zh: 据IMF研究，到2021年，美国净投资头寸可能会进一步恶化 — — 预计净负债从占GDP的41%上升到63 % — —而中国净投资头寸盈余将基本保持不变。
en: According to the IMF, by 2021, the US net investment position will probably deteriorate – with net liabilities rising from of 41% of GDP to 63% – while China’s net investment position remains flat.

zh: 这意味着其他盈余国家，即德国和日本，可能必须用其经常账户和金融账户盈余为美国的净投资头寸增量赤字提供融资。
en: This means that other surplus countries like Germany and Japan are likely to be financing the growing US deficit position, from both their current and financial accounts.

zh: （美国高于其它发达国家的利率将强化这一预期过程。 ）
en: (The expanding interest-rate differentials between the US and its advanced-country counterparts reinforce this expectation.)

zh: 对中国，当前最大的挑战在于其资本账户的健康发展。
en: But perhaps the biggest challenge for China today lies in its capital account.

zh: 自2015年人民币开始跌势以来，降低外债、增加海外资产的动机明显加强了。
en: Since the renminbi began its downward slide in 2015, the incentive to reduce foreign debts and increase overseas assets has intensified.

zh: 中国的对外债务（包括公共和私人）从国际标准看已经非常低，但却从2014年年底的占GDP的9.4 % （ 9,752亿美元）下降到去年年底的6.4 % （ 7,010亿美元 ） 。
en: China’s total foreign debts (public and private), already very low by international standards, have fallen from 9.4% of GDP ($975.2 billion) at the end of 2014 to 6.4% of GDP ($701.0 billion) by the end of last year.

zh: 这一趋势有望继续，因为中国公民仍然在进行资产组合多样化，特别是增加海外资产，以匹配其日益国际化的生活方式。
en: And this trend seems set to continue, as Chinese citizens continue to diversify their asset portfolios to suit their increasingly international lifestyles.

zh: 人民币贬值将进一步刺激这一金融账户调整趋势。
en: A weaker renminbi will only bolster this trend.

zh: 当然，反复威胁要对中国征收进口关税的特朗普也能影响中国的汇率政策。
en: Of course, Trump, who has repeatedly threatened to impose tariffs on China, could also influence China’s exchange-rate policy.

zh: 但从某种角度讲，特朗普的莽撞及无常使他变得无关紧要。
en: But, in a sense, Trump’s irreverence makes him practically irrelevant.

zh: 毕竟，从过去的行为判断，不管中国选择什么政策路径 — — 完全自由浮动并且充分可兑换也好，保持当前的“有管理的浮动”也好，盯住美元汇率也好 — — 他都可能指责中国操纵货币。
en: After all, judging by his past behavior, it seems likely that he will accuse China of currency manipulation, regardless of the policy path it chooses: a completely free float with full convertibility, the current managed float, or a pegged exchange rate.

zh: 那么，中国应该如何应对？
en: So what is China’s best option?

zh: 自由浮动的汇率可以立即排除。
en: A free-floating exchange rate can be ruled out right away.

zh: 在当前由美元驱动的国际货币制度中，采取这样的方针将造成过度的汇率波动及投机。
en: In the current dollar-driven international monetary regime, such an approach would produce too much volatility.

zh: 但即使是当前的“有管理的浮动”机制也越来越难以管理。
en: But even the current regime is becoming difficult to manage.

zh: 考虑到最近为保持汇率稳定表象所付出的代价，看起来3万亿美元的外汇储备也不足以支撑人民币“有管理的浮动 ” 。
en: Considering the cost of recent efforts to maintain some semblance of exchange-rate stability, it seems that not even the equivalent of $3 trillion in foreign-exchange reserves is enough to manage a currency float.

zh: 从长期看，中国可以、也应该拓宽及加深其国际投资的资产、负债及头寸，以支持人民币汇率与跨境资本流动的长期稳定。
en: To be sure, China can – and should – broaden and deepen its international investment position, in order to support currency stability.

zh: 但在2015年年底，中国总对外资产相对国际水平太低，仅相当于GDP的57.2 % ， 而日本和许多欧洲国家为180%左右，美国为130%左右。
en: At the end of 2015, China’s gross foreign assets were relatively low, at 57.2% of GDP, compared to about 180% for Japan and many European countries and around 130% for the US.

zh: 与此同时，中国净对外资产只有GDP的14.7 % ， 日本为67.5 % ， 德国为48.3 % （ 美国为-41 % ） 。
en: Meanwhile, China’s net foreign assets amounted to only 14.7% of GDP, compared to 67.5% for Japan and 48.3% for Germany (negative 41% of GDP for the US).

zh: 中国的实体和金融部门的改革可以逐步提高中国对外资产、对外负债及对外投资头寸盈余 。
en: Reforms in the real and financial sectors would enable this level to rise.

zh: 但是，在目前，对中国来说最好的选择也许是人民币盯住美元并在上下5%的幅度内调整，在这一幅度内，人民银行可以进行轻微干预，目的是引导市场回归人民币与美元的长期挂钩平价。
en: For now, however, the best option may be for China to peg the renminbi to the dollar, with an adjustment band of 5%, within which the central bank would intervene only lightly, to guide the market back to parity over the long term.

zh: 毕竟，投资者关注的几乎完全是人民币兑美元汇率。
en: Investors are, after all, focused almost exclusively on the renminbi-dollar exchange rate.

zh: 不管采取什么路径，在特朗普新政环境下，中国都不得不为推动全球化和追求货币稳定付出相当沉重的代价。
en: Whatever path it chooses, China will pay a heavy price for advocating globalization and pursuing currency stability.

zh: 在目前从特朗普宣布新政策到影响市场交易及价格只需要发一个推特（tweet）的时代，政治将压倒理性的经济讨论。
en: In a world in which announcing new policies – and thus moving markets –is as easy as sending a tweet, politics will trump rational economic discussion.

zh: 中国的特别提款权误区
en: China’s SDR Distraction

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 10月初，人民币被纳入到由多种货币组成的国际货币基金组织特别提款权（SDR）序列中。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – At the start of October, China’s currency, the renminbi, was added to the basket of currencies that make up the International Monetary Fund’s Special Drawing Rights, or SDR.

zh: 而在此之前SDR仅被定义为美元、欧元、英镑和日元的加权平均值，现在人民币加入并终于可以称自为五大全球性货币之一了。
en: Previously, the SDR had been defined as a weighted average of the dollar, euro, British pound, and Japanese yen. Now that the renminbi has been added, it can claim to be one of just five truly global currencies.

zh: 不管外界对此有何观感，但中国人确实非常在意这一点。
en: Should we care? The Chinese certainly do.

zh: 在我上个月末访问北京期间，加入那个清高的SDR俱乐部是所有的人都想谈论的话题（好吧，说实话，他们也很想聊聊唐纳德​​·特朗普（Donald Trump ） 。
en: In Beijing, where I was late last month, joining the rarefied SDR club was all people wanted to talk about. (Okay, truth be told, they also wanted to talk about Donald Trump.)

zh: 人民币加入SDR篮子是个事关民族自豪感的问题。
en: Seeing the renminbi added to the SDR basket was a matter of national pride.

zh: 它象征着中国成为全球大国。
en: It symbolized China’s emergence as a global power.

zh: 它证明了政府鼓励在跨境交易中使用人民币的努力，使中国和世界其他国家免于过度依赖美元。
en: And it vindicated the government’s efforts to encourage use of the renminbi in cross-border transactions, freeing China and the rest of the world from over-dependence on the dollar.

zh: 但事实是，将人民币加入SDR篮子没有什么实际意义。
en: But the fact of the matter is that adding the renminbi to the SDR basket has little practical significance.

zh: SDR不是货币，它只是基金组织通报其财务账目所使用的单位。
en: The SDR is not a currency; it is just the unit in which the IMF reports its financial accounts.

zh: 因为银行和公司没有发现这个选项特别有吸引力，所以只有少数国际债券会用特别提款权来发行。
en: Only a small handful of international bonds are denominated in SDRs, because banks and firms do not find this option particularly attractive.

zh: SDR债券的主要发行者是国际货币基金组织的姊妹组织 — — 世界银行（基金本身没有授权发行债券 ） 。
en: The main issuer of SDR bonds is the IMF’s sister organization, the World Bank (the Fund itself is not authorized to issue bonds).

zh: 将人民币加入特别提款权篮子的唯一实际意义是，人民币与特别提款权的其他四种货币一样，当各国向国际货币基金组织借款时，它们可以借人民币。
en: The only practical implication of adding the renminbi to the SDR basket is that it now becomes a currency that countries can draw, along with the SDR’s other four constituent currencies, when they borrow from the IMF.

zh: 到时候我们可以看看究竟有多少国家愿意这样做。
en: Only time will tell how many wish to do so.

zh: 这个议程包括中国人民银行和各外国央行之间的货币互换协议谈判，而目前已签署超过24项。 它还包括指定中国金融机构为每个主要金融中心的人民币交易提供清算和结算服务（例如9月份中国银行就被选为纽约的官方清算银行 ） 。
en: The Chinese argue that the renminbi’s addition to the SDR basket should be seen in a broader context.

zh: 外国实体也被授权在中国发行人民币计价债券。 截止8月底，波兰成为第一个在中国发行人民币计价债券的欧洲政府。
en: It is one of a series of steps to encourage use of the renminbi in international transactions.

zh: 中国人认为，应该在更广泛的背景下看待人民币加入特别提款权篮子。
en: This agenda includes negotiating currency swap agreements, now more than two dozen, between the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) and foreign central banks.

zh: 它是鼓励在国际交易中使用人民币的一系列步骤之一。
en: And foreign entities are being authorized to issue renminbi-denominated bonds in China itself. Toward the end of August, Poland became the first European government to do so.

zh: 但再次现实的说，这些步骤更多的是象征而非实质。
en: But the reality, again, is that these steps are more about symbolism than substance.

zh: 中国人民银行的人民币互换几乎没有被使用过。
en: The PBOC’s renminbi swaps are almost entirely unused.

zh: 指定的清算银行依旧门可罗雀。
en: Designated clearing banks have not exactly been flooded with business.

zh: 离岸人民币银行存款额正在下降。
en: Offshore renminbi bank deposits are falling.

zh: 中国以人民币结算商品贸易的比例自2015年中以来一直在下降。
en: The proportion of China’s merchandise trade settled in renminbi has been declining since mid-2015.

zh: 也没有迹象表明波兰政府如此大胆地冒险会引发其他政府的快速跟进。
en: And there is no sign that where the Polish government has so boldly ventured, other governments will soon follow.

zh: 借用一句莎士比亚的名言，错不在命运，而在于中国的金融市场本身。
en: The fault, to paraphrase Shakespeare, lies not in the stars but in China’s own financial markets.

zh: 自2015年中以来，该国的股票市场就像过山车一样。
en: Since mid-2015, the country’s stock market has been on a rollercoaster.

zh: 从国际货币基金组织到国际清算银行，每一个忠于职守的国际组织都一直对中国企业债券市场的问题发出警告。
en: Every international organization worth its salt, from the IMF to the Bank for International Settlements, has been warning of problems in China’s corporate bond market.

zh: 正如这些国际组织预测的一样，一旦公司贷款出现大批违约，那么就将对银行造成可怕的影响。
en: And if defaults on loans to corporations are widespread, as these organizations predict, the implications for the banks could be dire.

zh: 问题在于中国政府的错误策略。
en: The problem is mistaken tactics by the Chinese government.

zh: 政府和中国人民银行相信，放松资本管制，允许金融资本更自由地流入和流出国家将迫使金融市场参与者们提高自身水平。
en: The government and the PBOC believe that relaxing capital controls and allowing financial capital to flow more freely in and out of the country will force financial market participants to up their game.

zh: 公司必须升级其会计标准，并加固其风险管理手段以应付更快的金融交易步伐。
en: Companies will have to upgrade their accounting standards, and banks their risk-management practices, to cope with the faster pace of financial transactions.

zh: 结果将是更具流动性和稳定的金融市场，并反过来令人民币作为一个结算货币单位、支付方式、为居民和外国人的保值手段而变得更具吸引力。
en: The result will be more liquid and stable financial markets, in turn making the renminbi more attractive as a unit of account, means of payment, and store of value for residents and foreigners alike.

zh: 但不幸的是假设并不成真。
en: Unfortunately, assuming a result doesn’t make it so.

zh: 如果中国的银行和企业调整的步伐过慢，放开国际资本流动就只会导致更多的波动，更少的离岸存款，更少依赖人民币去结算商品交易 — — 正如最近的情况一样。
en: If Chinese banks and firms are slow to adjust, liberalizing international capital flows will lead only to more volatility, fewer offshore deposits, and less reliance on the renminbi for settling merchandise transactions – exactly as has been the case recently.

zh: 中国的政策制定者现在必须分清主次。
en: Chinese policymakers must now put the horse before the cart.

zh: 他们选择的最重要促进人民币国际化步骤应当是加强国内金融市场，使监管现代化，并简化合同执行。
en: The most important steps they can take to foster renminbi internationalization are to strengthen domestic financial markets, modernize regulation, and streamline contract enforcement.

zh: 如果中国想将人民币转变成一流的全球货币，它应该更少关注纽约的人民币交易和货币在特别提款权篮子里的权重，而是聚焦于构建一个具备深厚基础，流动性和稳定性的国内金融市场。
en: If China wants to transform the renminbi into a first-class global currency, it should pay less attention to renminbi trading in New York and the currency’s weight in the SDR basket, and more to the development of deep, liquid, and stable financial markets at home.

zh: 为什么人民币不会统治
en: Why the Renminbi Won’t Rule

zh: 东京—在反乌托邦科幻片《银翼杀手2049 》 （ Blade Runner 2049）中，32年后的洛杉矶看上去就像是今天的中国大都市：灰蒙蒙污染严重，到处都是霓虹灯广告闪烁的高楼大厦。
en: TOKYO – In the dystopian fantasy Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles 32 years from now looks a lot like China’s megacities today: grey, polluted, and dominated by tall towers emblazoned with flashing neon advertisements.

zh: 观众从来不甚了解外部世界，甚至不知道广告中的商品用哪种货币交易。 美元仍然拥有主宰地位吗？
en: The viewer never learns much about the outside world, much less in what currency the advertised goods are traded.

zh: 中国人民币取而代之了吗？ 还是有其他货币崛起为全球主导？
en: Is the US dollar still dominant, has the Chinese renminbi taken over, or has some other currency surged to global preeminence?

zh: 美国总统特朗普似乎一定要让美国（至少部分地）从其全球领导角色上退出。
en: US President Donald Trump seems intent on ensuring that America retreats, at least partly, from its global leadership role.

zh: 但是，就像英镑在两次世界大战之间那样，一种货币可以在发行国失去了经济、金融和地缘政治霸权之后继续保有全球主导地位很久。
en: But, as was the case with the British pound in the interwar period, a currency can remain globally dominant even after its issuing country loses its economic, financial, and geopolitical hegemony.

zh: 今天也是如此，在相当长的一段时间内，世界都应该认为美元可以继续保有关键储备货币地位，被用于结算国际贸易。
en: Today, too, the world should expect the US dollar to remain the key reserve currency, used to invoice and settle international trade, for a long time to come.

zh: 但从国际金融外交的角度，美元的地位可能不那么牢靠了。
en: But, in terms of international financial diplomacy, the dollar’s position may not be as secure.

zh: 问题在于，经济学家巴里·艾肯格林（Barry Eichengreen）预测的 “美元外交”的结束是否必然意味着人民币外交的崛起。
en: The question is whether the end of “dollar diplomacy,” which the economist Barry Eichengreen predicts, will necessarily mean the rise of renminbi diplomacy.

zh: 自20世纪90年代以来，中国决策者一直希望发展人民币在国际金融中的作用，从而增强中国的地缘政治地位。
en: Chinese policymakers have been hoping to develop the renminbi’s role in international finance, in order to strengthen China’s geopolitical standing, since the 1990s.

zh: 在近几年中，中国领导层领导了一场共同行动以实现这一野心，特别是通过中国货币的国际化。
en: And, in recent years, the Chinese leadership has led a concerted effort to fulfill that ambition, especially by internationalizing China’s currency.

zh: 但人民币计价金融从未成为美元金融的竞争对手 — — 更不用说敌人了。
en: Yet renminbi-denominated finance is nowhere near ready to compete with – let alone rival – dollar finance.

zh: 事实上，人民币在国际金融中的角色仍然远远不及其他储备货币（美元、欧元、日元和英镑 ） ， 人民币在本世纪中叶领导国际货币体系是和《银翼杀手2049》一样的反乌托邦景象。
en: In fact, the renminbi still trails other reserve currencies (the US dollar, the euro, the Japanese yen, and the British pound) in international finance by so much that a renminbi-led international monetary system by mid-century seems about as likely as a Blade Runner 2049-style dystopia.

zh: 人民币在国际金融中始终处于弱势的一个原因是，尽管自2010年以来取得了可观的进展，但它仍然只是半熟（half-baked）的国际货币。
en: One reason for the renminbi’s continued weakness in international finance is that, despite considerable progress since 2010, it remains a half-baked international currency.

zh: 除了指定的离岸市场，人民币不具有流动性，也不能自由兑换。
en: The renminbi is illiquid and unconvertible outside designated offshore markets.

zh: 因此，其在国际投资者投资组合中的比重可以微乎其微。
en: As a result, its weight in international investors’ portfolios is miniscule.

zh: 甚至中国本身也只在其四分之一的国际贸易中使用人民币，其国际金融业仍然是美元计价。
en: Even China itself uses the renminbi in only about a quarter of its international trade, and its international finance remains dollar-denominated.

zh: 中国蓝筹企业 — — 阿里巴巴、百度和腾讯 — — 在纽约或香港上市，用美元或港币计价。
en: China’s blue-chip firms – Alibaba, Baidu, and Tencent – are listed in New York or Hong Kong, where they are priced either in US or Hong Kong dollars.

zh: 中国迅速膨胀的贷款和海外投资大部分也是美元计价。
en: And most of China’s fast-expanding loans and overseas investments are in dollars.

zh: 但不必期待人民币在不久的将来主导国际金融体系的最令人信服的原因在于中国领导人从未表现出要让人民币成为美元的真正替代品的持久的决心。
en: But the most compelling reason why one should not expect a renminbi-dominated international finance system to arise anytime soon is that China’s leaders have never shown any sustained commitment to developing the renminbi as a true alternative to the dollar.

zh: 相反，他们对国际货币体系改革采取合作方针，指出国际货币体系不应该只依赖任何一种货币。
en: Instead, they have pursued a cooperative approach to reform of the international monetary system, which they argue should not be dependent on any one currency.

zh: 对中国人来说，国际货币体系的未来应该是在结算、支付和资产配置等方面有多种国家的货币提供选择，从而降低体系对国家政治的风险暴露。
en: For the Chinese, the future of the international monetary system should be one in which multiple national currencies provide choice – in terms of invoicing, payments, and asset allocation – thereby reducing the system’s exposure to national politics.

zh: 此外，有更多的央行创造流动性，国际金融中心提供流动性池，则这样一套体系发生现金动荡的风险更低。
en: Moreover, with more central banks creating liquidity, and international financial centers offering pools of it, such a system would entail a lower risk of cash crunches.

zh: 目前，中国已开始试点在关键金融中心发展离岸人民币市场，以此作为克服人民币流动性局限的方法。
en: Already, China has been experimenting with the development of offshore renminbi markets in key financial centers, as a way to overcome its currency’s limited liquidity.

zh: 但要构建这样一个多货币体系，世界需要采取深刻的国际机构改革。
en: In order to build such a multi-currency system, however, the world would need to undertake far-reaching reforms of the international institutions.

zh: 这正是中国人民银行行长周小川在2009年的一次讲话中提出的看法。 这次讲话批驳了只有美国通过美元才能保证国际货币体系的运行的观点。
en: This was precisely the point that Zhou Xiaochuan, the governor of the People’s Bank of China, made in a 2009 speech challenging the view that only the US, through the dollar, could guarantee the functioning of the international monetary system.

zh: 周小川说，美元的货币主导地位的基础是二战后创立的布雷顿森林机构。
en: As Zhou pointed out, the US dollar’s monetary dominance is underpinned by the Bretton Woods institutions, created after World War II.

zh: 因此，改革国际货币体系就是要改革多边金融机构的治理 — — 这也是中国在去年担任G20主席国时所强调的观点。
en: Reforming the international monetary system, therefore, means reforming the governance of the multilateral financial institutions – an argument that China emphasized during its G20 presidency last year.

zh: 随着美国退出世界舞台以及多极全球秩序的出现，国际货币体系也可能发生转变 — — 但也许不是转变为以人民币为首的体系。
en: As the US retreats from the world stage and a multipolar global order emerges, the international monetary system may well be transformed – but probably not into a renminbi-led system.

zh: 不管是因为中国国际金融的内在弱点，还是出于对真正的国际货币必须是市场驱动，因此是政府控制的人民币所无法充当的认识，就连中国也不认为人民外交的时代会很快到来。
en: Whether because of the intrinsic weakness of China’s international finance or an understanding that a truly international currency must be more market-driven than the government-controlled renminbi could be, not even China expects the age of renminbi diplomacy to arrive anytime soon.

zh: 中国失败和成功的风险
en: The Risks of China’s Failure – and Success

zh: 新德里—全世界金融领导人正准备齐聚华盛顿参加国际货币基金组织（IMF）春季年会，他们的希望 — — 以及恐惧 — — 都集中在中国身上。
en: NEW DELHI – As the world’s financial leaders gather in Washington, DC, for the annual spring meeting of the International Monetary Fund, their hopes – and fears – center on China.

zh: 毕竟，中国是可能有能力让全球经济复苏全力启动的国家；但其自身经济增长的基础正在日益表现出吃紧的信号。
