en: After all, China is the one country that might be able to jump-start the sputtering global economy’s recovery; and yet its own economic growth is based on a foundation that is increasingly showing signs of strain.

zh: 困境在于不管中国的失败还是成功都会给世界经济带来风险。
en: The dilemma is that both Chinese failure and success carry risks for the world economy.

zh: 失败情景将是二战后历史上前所未有的。
en: A failure scenario would be unique in post-World War II history.

zh: 中国经济规模巨大，其后果将蔓延全世界。
en: Because China’s economy is so large, the consequences would reverberate worldwide.

zh: 2008年，美元升值使得新兴市场得以迅速复兴，与此不同的是，如果中国经济遭到严重衰退，人民币可能贬值，把通缩输出到全世界。
en: But, unlike in 2008, when the US dollar appreciated, allowing emerging markets to revive quickly, the renminbi would likely depreciate should China’s economy experience a serious downturn, spreading deflation far and wide.

zh: 其他货币也可能贬值，其中不乏有意为之的情况。
en: Other currencies might depreciate as well, some as a result of deliberate policy.

zh: 因此，中国失败的情景可能类似于20世纪30年代，其特征为竞争性贬值，实体经济活动剧减。
en: Consequently, a China failure scenario could resemble the events of the 1930s, characterized by competitive devaluation and plummeting real economic activity.

zh: 但如果成功实现当前向基于消费的经济模式的转型会如何？
en: But what if China succeeds in its current transition to a consumption-based economic model?

zh: 2007年，当中国经常项目盈余达到GDP的10%时，其储蓄突破了GDP的50 % ， 投资超过GDP的40 % 。
en: When the Chinese current-account surplus reached 10% of GDP in 2007, saving exceeded 50% of GDP and investment surpassed 40% of GDP.

zh: 这些数字看起来过高，无法带来动态效率或增进福利。
en: These numbers seemed far too high to be dynamically efficient or welfare enhancing.

zh: 结果，一个共识迅速迅速产生：储蓄和投资应该降低，并实现更好的平衡。
en: As a result, a consensus rapidly emerged: Saving and investment should be reduced and brought into better balance.

zh: 投资应该通过向“任性”的上市公司施加更严格的财务纪律来遏制，而社会安全网应该得到加强，从而家庭不必大量储蓄来抵御失孩和变老的成本。
en: Investment should be reined in by imposing greater financial discipline on wayward public enterprises, while the social safety net should be strengthened, so that households would not have to save so much to meet the costs of having children and growing old.

zh: 很快，十年过去了，我们看到了什么？
en: Fast forward a decade, and what do we see?

zh: 政府已经建成安全网，经常项目赤字也已经减少，一如人们的希望。
en: The government has built safety nets, and the current-account surplus has receded, exactly as hoped.

zh: 去年，经常项目盈余还不到GDP的3 % ， 只有2007年水平的几分之一。
en: Last year, the surplus amounted to less than 3% of GDP, a fraction of its 2007 level.

zh: 但这绝不意味着这套理论是有效的。
en: But this hardly validates the theory.

zh: 经常项目盈余的降幅中大约有一半发生的原因是投资占GDP之比实际上升了。
en: About half of the reduction in the current-account surplus has occurred because investment has actually increased as a share of GDP.

zh: 与此同时，国民储蓄有所下降，占GDP之比与2007年相比下降3.5个百分点（据IMF估计，2013年底官方数据 ） 。
en: Meanwhile, there has been some decline in national saving, by perhaps 3.5 percentage points of GDP compared to 2007 (according to IMF estimates, as official data end in 2013).

zh: 但这一降幅与2000—2007年间15个百分点的升幅相比相当温和。
en: But this reduction is quite modest compared to the 15-percentage-point increase that occurred during 2000-2007.

zh: 更引人注目的是，这一储蓄的温和下降似乎全部来自公司部门；家庭储蓄相对GDP相较2007年大体保持稳定。
en: Even more striking, all of this modest reduction in saving seems to have come from the corporate sector; household saving is roughly the same, relative to GDP, as it was in 2007.

zh: 换句话说，繁荣期的增量没有降下来。
en: In other words, what went up during the boom has failed to come down.

zh: 这是一个真正的谜题，解决这个谜题不仅对中国的未来很重要，对世界的未来也很重要。
en: This is a real puzzle, and resolving it is important not only for China’s future, but for that of the world.

zh: 有两种大致的可能性。
en: There are two broad possibilities.

zh: 可能理论基本上是正确的，但需要更多时间表现结果。
en: It could be that the theory is basically correct, but needs more time to show results.

zh: 果真如此的话，只要中国执政者继续强化社会安全网，储蓄的下降就能匹配设想中的投资下降，保持较低水平的经常项目盈余。
en: In that case, as long as China’s rulers continue to strengthen social safety nets, the decline in saving could match the envisaged decline in investment, keeping the current-account surplus low.

zh: 但如果理论是错误的货不完全的话会怎样？
en: But what happens if the theory is wrong, or incomplete?

zh: 比如，社会安全网对储蓄的福利效应被高估了。
en: For example, the beneficial effects of safety nets on saving may have been overestimated.

zh: 或者，这些效应可能被人口老龄化的负面效应所抵消。
en: Or those effects may be offset by the negative effects of population aging.

zh: 未来15年，中国60岁及以上人口将增加三分之二。
en: Over the next 15 years, the Chinese population aged 60 and above will increase by two-thirds.

zh: 这些老龄化工人现在正竭尽全力储蓄，为即将到来的退休构筑财务缓冲。
en: These aging workers might now be saving as much as they possibly can, to build up a financial cushion for impending retirement.

zh: 如果这一情景以某种形式实现，家庭储蓄率可能只能缓慢持续下降。
en: If some version of this scenario is realized, the household saving rate may continue to decline only gradually.

zh: 与此同时，政府将关闭无利可图的工厂，这可能刺激公司储蓄。
en: In the meantime, the government would be closing unprofitable plants, which might boost corporate saving.

zh: 因此，即使投资骤降���总储蓄也可能保持高位，导致经常项目盈余再次飙升。
en: As a result, overall saving could remain high, even as investment falls sharply, causing the current-account surplus to surge again.

zh: 这对于世界经济来说可不是好消息。
en: This would not be a pleasant prospect for the world economy.

zh: 随着中国的放缓，全球增长也会放缓，而剩下的需求再分配将有利于中国，加剧其他国家已然十分严重的短缺。
en: As China slowed, so would global growth, and the remaining demand would be redistributed toward China, aggravating other countries’ already-severe shortfalls.

zh: 这与此前中国巨大的经常项目盈余至少部分能被中国高速增长所抵消的全球失衡情况截然不同。
en: This would be very different from the previous episode of global imbalances when large Chinese current-account surpluses were at least offset to some extent by rapid Chinese growth.

zh: 简言之，尽管中国经济硬着陆可能刺激全球通缩，但避免这一结果可能意味着全球失衡回归。
en: In short, whereas a hard economic landing for China could spur global deflation, avoiding that outcome could mean the return of global imbalances.

zh: 在全球领导人怀着抑郁的心情前往华盛顿赴IMF年会时，他们需要思考这些严峻的可能性。
en: These are the stark possibilities that leaders need to ponder as they gather gloomily at the IMF in Washington.

zh: 中俄联姻
en: The Sino-Russian Marriage

zh: 伦敦—中国人是最有历史意识的民族。
en: LONDON – The Chinese are the most historically minded of peoples.

zh: 在其权力征程中，毛泽东采取了生活在公元前500年左右的孙子的兵法。 而产生于差不多时期的儒家思想至今仍占据中国社会思想核心地位，尽管毛泽东对其进行了无情的镇压。
en: In his conquest of power, Mao Zedong used military tactics derived from Sun Tzu, who lived around 500 BC; Confucianism, dating from around the same time, remains at the heart of China’s social thinking, despite Mao’s ruthless attempts to suppress it.

zh: 因此，当中国国家主席习近平2013年发起他的“新丝绸之路”时，你不必为其历史参照感到震惊。
en: So when President Xi Jinping launched his “New Silk Road” initiative in 2013, no one should have been surprised by the historical reference.

zh: “两千多年前 ， ” 中国发改委解释说 ， “ 勤劳勇敢的欧亚大陆人民探索和开发了多条连接亚洲、欧洲和非洲的贸易和文化交流通道，被后人统称为丝绸之路。
en: “More than two millennia ago,” explains China’s National Development and Reform Commission, “the diligent and courageous people of Eurasia explored and opened up several routes of trade and cultural exchanges that linked the major civilisations of Asia, Europe, and Africa, collectively called the Silk Road by later generations.”

zh: ”在中国，古老的历史常常被新新思维所用。
en: In China, old history is often called to aid new doctrine.

zh: 今天的新新思维便是“多极 ” ， 即世界由（也应该由）多个不同的引力极组成。
en: The new doctrine is “multipolarity” – the idea that the world is (or should be) made up of several distinctive poles of attraction.

zh: 与此相对的思维是“单极 ” （ 即美国或西欧主导的）世界。
en: The contrast is with a “unipolar” (that is, an American- or Western-dominated) world.

zh: 多极是一个政治思想，但范畴不只限于实力关系。
en: Multipolarity is a political idea, but it is about more than power relations.

zh: 它否认存在一个所有国家都感到合适的单一文明理想。
en: It rejects the notion that there is a single civilizational ideal to which all countries should conform.

zh: 不同的世界地区有不同的历史，给它们的民族带来不同的关于如何生活、如何管理自己、如何生存的思想。
en: Different world regions have different histories, which have given their peoples different ideas about how to live, govern themselves, and earn a living.

zh: 这些历史都值得尊重：不存在“正确”的未来之路。
en: These histories are all worthy of respect: there is no “right” road to the future.

zh: 据说欧亚（Eurasia）思想的时代即将再次到来。
en: Eurasia is an idea whose time, it is said, has come around again.

zh: 最新的历史研究让古老的丝绸之路不再被遗忘。
en: Recent historical research has rescued the old Silk Road from historical oblivion.

zh: 已故的美国社会学家珍妮特·阿布-路高德（Janet Abu-Lughod）认为在西北欧和中国之间存在八个互相重叠的“贸易回路 ” ， 这八个贸易回路受蒙古和平（Pax Mongolica）的保护，繁荣于十三和十四世纪。
en: The late American sociologist Janet Abu-Lughod identified eight overlapping “circuits of trade” between northwest Europe and China that, under the aegis of a Pax Mongolica, flourished between the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries.

zh: 根据路高德的说法，西方帝国主义只是凌驾于这些古老贸易回路之上，并没有抹除它们。
en: According to Abu-Lughod, Western imperialism superimposed itself on these older circuits, without obliterating them.

zh: 伊斯兰教继续着它的跨地理和跨政治的传播。
en: Islam continued to spread across geographic and political boundaries.

zh: 中国和印度的移民从未停止。
en: Chinese and Indian migrations did not stop.

zh: 如今，一个独特的经济和政治发展趋势给欧亚创造了一次从历史休眠中醒来的机会。
en: Now a unique conjuncture of economic and political developments has created an opportunity for Eurasia to emerge from its historical slumbers.

zh: 近几年来，西方的自信因为2008—2009年金融危机和中东政治灾难而大受打击。
en: In recent years, Western self-assurance was humbled by the financial crisis of 2008-2009 and political catastrophes in the Middle East.

zh: 与此同时，欧亚的两大潜在构建者 — — 中国和俄罗斯的利益表面上出现了趋同之势。
en: At the same time, the interests of the two potential builders of Eurasia, China and Russia, seem – at least superficially – to have converged.

zh: 中国恢复蒙古和平的动机显而易见。
en: China’s motive for reviving Pax Mongolica is clear.

zh: 它的增长模式主要建立在向发达国家出口廉价制造品的基础上，如今已颓势尽显。
en: Its growth model, based largely on exporting cheap manufactured goods to developed countries, is running out of steam.

zh: 长期停滞威胁着西方，加之贸易主义情绪日趋高涨。
en: Secular stagnation threatens the West, accompanied by rising protectionism sentiment.

zh: 而尽管中国领导人知道必须实现经济再平衡，从投资和贸易转向消费，但这样做有可能给执政的中共带来严重的国内政治问题。
en: And, although Chinese leaders know that they must rebalance the economy from investment and exports to consumption, doing so risks causing serious domestic political problems for the ruling Communist party.

zh: 将投资和出口方向引向欧亚提供了一个替代方案。
en: Reorienting investments and exports toward Eurasia offers an alternative.

zh: 随着中国劳动力成本的提高，生产从沿海地区转向西部省份。
en: As China’s labor costs rise, production is being re-located from the coastal regions to the western provinces.

zh: 这一生产格局的天然出口便是新丝绸之路。
en: The natural outlet for this production is along the New Silk Road.

zh: 丝绸之路的开发（实际上是数条“带 ” ， 包括一条南方海路）将需要巨大的交通和城市基础设施投资。
en: The development of the road (actually several “belts,” including a southern maritime route) will require huge investments in transport and urban infrastructure.

zh: 如同十九世纪，交通成本的降低将打开新的贸易市场。
en: As in the nineteenth century, reduction in transport costs will open up new markets for trade.

zh: 俄罗斯也有开发欧亚的经济动机。
en: Russia, too, has an economic motive for developing Eurasia.

zh: 它没能实现经济现代化和多样化。
en: It has failed to modernize and diversify its economy.

zh: 结果，它仍然主要是石化产品出口国和制造品进口国。
en: As a result, it remains predominantly an exporter of petroleum products and an importer of manufactured goods.

zh: 中国提供了一个稳定且不断扩大的能源出口市场。
en: China offers a secure and expanding market for its energy exports.

zh: 实现欧亚经济潜力所需要的巨大的交通和建设投资有助于俄罗斯复苏其因共产主义崩溃而失去的工业和工程实力。
en: The big transport and construction projects needed to realize Eurasia’s economic potential may help Russia recover the industrial and engineering might it lost with communism’s fall.

zh: 今年，俄罗斯、亚美尼亚、白俄罗斯、哈萨克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦共同加入了欧亚经济联盟（Eurasian Economic Union，EEU ） 。 EEU是一个关税联盟，也带有防御性质。
en: This year Russia, Armenia, Belarus, Kazakhstan, and Kyrgyzstan have joined together in a Eurasian Economic Union (EEU), a customs union with a defense component.

zh: 在支持者眼中，EEU是以自愿的经济和政治联盟为形式重建昔日苏联边界的一步。 EEU以欧盟为样板，是对西方在冷战中的“胜利”的刺激。
en: The EEU is seen by its advocates as a step toward re-establishing the old Soviet frontiers in the form of a voluntary economic and political union, modeled on the EU – a project to take the sting out of the West’s “victory” in the Cold War.

zh: 俄罗斯官方观点着眼于“EEU和丝绸之路经济带互相渗透、互相融合 ” ， 形成一个“大欧亚 ” ， 为“俄罗斯和中国提供稳定发展的安全的共同周边环境。
en: Official Russian opinion looks forward to “the interpenetration and integration of the EEU and the Silk Road Economic Belt” into a “Greater Eurasia,” which will afford a “steady developing safe common neighborhood of Russia and China.”

zh: ”5月8日，普京和习近平在莫斯科签署了旨在成立协调政治机构、投资基金、开发银行、货币机制和金融体系的协议 — — 所有这些都可以服务于连接中国、欧洲、中东和非洲的广袤的自由贸易区。
en: On May 8, Putin and Xi signed an agreement in Moscow that envisages the establishment of coordinating political institutions, investment funds, development banks, currency regimes, and financial systems – all to serve a vast free-trade area linking China with Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

zh: 这个梦想有多少现实性？
en: How realistic is this dream?

zh: 俄罗斯和中国都感到被美国及其盟友“包围 ” 。
en: Russia and China both feel “encircled” by the United States and its allies.

zh: 中国的反霸权目标浅显而模糊地表达为确保“文明宽容 ” ， 尊重“各国发展模式的选择 ” 。
en: China’s anti-hegemonic aim, expressed in almost inscrutable prose, is to secure “tolerance among civilizations” and respect for the “modes of development chosen by different countries.”

zh: 与此同时，自乌克兰危机以来，普京加强了其比中国直白得多的反美立场。 他认为乌克兰危机时西方干预俄罗斯内政的明证。
en: Putin, meanwhile, has ratcheted up his much more explicit anti-American rhetoric since the Ukraine crisis, which he sees as a prime example of Western interference in Russia’s domestic affairs.

zh: 提振俄罗斯与中国的贸易流、增强政治和安全合作将增强两国对外部干预的抵抗力，并释放世界实力新中心崛起的信号。
en: Boosting trade flows between Russia and China, and strengthening political and security coordination, will reduce their vulnerability to outside interference and signal the emergence of a new center of world power.

zh: 西方用政治手段让两大实力和中亚影响力的老对手联合起来试图将西方逐出中亚地区未来发展事务，这堪称巨大的“成功 ” 。
en: It may be considered a singular success for Western statesmanship to have brought two old rivals for power and influence in Central Asia to the point of jointly seeking to exclude the West from the region’s future development.

zh: 特别是美国，它断然拒绝国际货币基金组织改革（改革将加强中国对IMF决策的影响力 ） ， 阻挠俄罗斯对北约成员资格的建议，因此错失了将中俄两国纳入单一世界体系的机会。
en: The US, especially, missed opportunities to integrate both countries into a single world system, by rebuffing reforms of the International Monetary Fund that would have strengthened China’s decision-making influence, and by blocking Russia’s overtures for NATO membership.

zh: 这导致两国携手寻找另一种未来可能。
en: This led both countries to seek an alternative future in each other’s company.

zh: 中俄因势利导的联姻是否能产生一个持久的联盟 — — 或者如乔治·索罗斯（George Soros）预言的那样形成世界和平的威胁 — — 仍有待观察。
en: Whether their marriage of convenience will lead to an enduring union – or, as George Soros predicts, a threat to world peace – remains to be seen.

zh: 哈萨克斯坦存在显而易见的势力范围问题，中国也在双边协议中竭尽所能逼迫俄罗斯。
en: There is an obvious sphere-of-influence issue in Kazakhstan, and the Chinese have been squeezing the Russians for all they can get in bilateral deals.

zh: 但是，从目前看，在新丝绸之路上的争吵给中俄两强造成的痛苦似乎不如没完没了的西方聒噪。
en: For the time being, though, squabbles over the New Silk Road seem less painful to the two powers than enduring lectures from the West.

zh: 中国的3.2万亿美元大麻烦
en: China’s $3.2 Trillion Headache

zh: 北京 — — 标准普尔降低美国政府债务评级之举重创了全球金融市场，对此最紧张的应该是中国：其3.2万亿美元的官方外汇储备的绝大部分（超过60 % ） 是美元资产，其中包括1.1万亿美元的美国国债。
en: BEIJING – While the downgrade of United States government debt by Standard & Poor’s shocked global financial markets, China has more reason to worry than most: the bulk of its $3.2 trillion in official foreign reserves – more than 60% – is denominated in dollars, including $1.1 trillion in US Treasury bonds.

zh: 只要美国政府不违约，降级带给中国的损失总归是有限的。
en: So long as the US government does not default, whatever losses China may experience from the downgrade will be small.

zh: 美元固然会下跌，从而有损于中国人民银行的资产负债表。
en: To be sure, the dollar’s value will fall, imposing a balance-sheet loss on the Peoples’ Bank of China (PBC, the central bank).

zh: 但贬值的美元会降低中国消费者和企业买美国商品的成本。
en: But a falling dollar would make it cheaper for Chinese consumers and companies to buy American goods.

zh: 如果美国物价保持稳定（现状正是如此 ） ， 购买美国商品成本降低的好处将正好抵消人民银行资产负债表的损失。
en: If prices are stable in the US, as is the case now, the gains from buying American goods should exactly offset the PBC’s balance-sheet losses.

zh: 此外，降级将迫使美国财政部提高新债利率，这也能使中国获利。
en: The downgrade could, moreover, force the US Treasury to raise the interest rate on new bonds, in which case China would stand to gain.

zh: 但标普给美国国债降级是个糟糕的决策，选择的时机不对。
en: But S&P’s downgrade was a poor decision, taken at the wrong time.

zh: 如果美国国债真的已不如过去那样信誉卓著，那么在8月2日奥巴马总统和国会就提高政府债务上限问题达成一致的时候，美国国债应该更加值得怀疑。
en: If America’s debts had truly become less trustworthy, they would have been even more dubious before the agreement reached on August 2 by Congress and President Barack Obama to raise the government’s debt ceiling.

zh: 债务上限协议给了全世界一个希望：美国经济将沿着可预测的道路走向复苏。
en: That agreement allowed the world to hope that the US economy would embark on a more predictable path to recovery.

zh: 降级打破了这个希望。
en: The downgrade has undermined that hope.

zh: 一些人甚至预测将出现二次探底。
en: Some people even predict a double-dip recession.

zh: 如果二次探底真的发生，美国真的发生违约的可能性将远高于现在。
en: If that happens, the chance of an actual US default would be much higher than it is today.

zh: 这些新担忧为中国敲响了警钟。
en: These new worries are raising alarm bells in China.

zh: 外汇储备多元化、告别美元独大的状态是中国应该选择的策略。
en: Diversification away from dollar assets is the advice of the day.

zh: 但这并不容易，从短期看尤是如此。
en: But this is no easy task, particularly in the short term.

zh: 如果人民银行开始以更大手笔买入非美元资产，则必须将一些现有美元资产转换为其他货币，而这将不可避免地引起该货币升值，从而推高人民银行的成本。
en: If the PBC started to buy non-dollar assets in large quantities, it would invariably need to convert some current dollar assets into another currency, which would inevitably drive up that currency’s value, thus increasing the PBC’s costs.

zh: 中国决策层正在讨论的另一种策略是允许人民币对美元升值。
en: Another idea being discussed in Chinese policy circles is to allow the renminbi to appreciate against the dollar.

zh: 中国官方外汇储备有一大部分是因为人民银行试图控制人民币汇率而积累起来的 — — 在人民币升值过程中，人民银行一直在强调渐进性和可控性。
en: Much of China’s official foreign reserves have accumulated because the PBC seeks to control the renminbi’s exchange rate, keeping its upward movement within a reasonable range and at a measured pace.

zh: 如果人民银行允许人民币以更快速度升值，那么它将不需要购买如此大量的外汇。
en: If it allowed the renminbi to appreciate faster, the PBC would not need to buy large quantities of foreign currencies.

zh: 但人民币升值能否见效取决于是中国净资本流入和经常项目盈余是否减少。
en: But whether renminbi appreciation will work depends on reducing China’s net capital inflows and current-account surplus.

zh: 国际经验表明，在短期，货币升值会吸引更多的资本流入，而大多数实证研究表明，渐进升值对一国经常项目水平只有有限影响。
en: International experience suggests that, in the short run, more capital flows into a country when its currency appreciates, and most empirical studies have shown that gradual appreciation has only a limited effect on countries’ current-account positions.

zh: 如果升值没有减少经常项目盈余和资本流入，那么人民币汇率将承受更大的升值压力。
en: If appreciation does not reduce the current-account surplus and capital inflows, then the renminbi’s exchange rate is bound to face further upward pressure.

zh: 这就是为什么一些人建议中国采取一次性大幅升值的策略 — — 一次升足，打消人民币进一步走强的预期，阻止投机性“热钱”的涌入。
en: That is why some people are advocating that China undertake a one-shot, big-bang appreciation – large enough to defuse expectations of further strengthening and deter inflows of speculative “hot” money.

zh: 如此规模的升值还将抑制出口、鼓励进口，从而减少中国长期存在的贸易盈余。
en: Such a revaluation would also discourage exports and encourage imports, thereby reducing China’s chronic trade surplus.

zh: 但这样的动作对中国经济来说不啻自杀。
en: But such a move would be almost suicidal for China’s economy.

zh: 从2001年到2008年，出口增长要占中国总体经济增长的40%强。
en: Between 2001 and 2008, export growth accounted for more than 40% of China’s overall economic growth.

zh: 也就是说，如果出口增长被完全消除，那么中国的GDP年增长率将下降4个百分点。
en: That is, China’s annual GDP growth rate would drop by four percentage points if its exports did not grow at all.

zh: 此外，中国经济研究中心的研究表明，人民币对美元升值20%将导致就业人口下降3 % ， 相当于2000万人。
en: In addition, a study by the China Center for Economic Research has found that a 20% appreciation against the dollar would entail a 3% drop in employment – more than 20 million jobs.

zh: 解决中国3.2万亿美元难题没有速效药。
en: There is no short-term cure for China’s $3.2 trillion problem.

zh: 中国政府必须依靠长期手段来解决这个问题，包括人民币国际化。
en: The government must rely on longer-term measures to mitigate the problem, including internationalization of the renminbi.

zh: 用人民币来结算中国的国际贸易账户能助中国免受美国以邻为壑政策（即允许美元对其贸易对手大幅贬值）的冲击。
en: Using the renminbi to settle China’s international trade accounts would help China escape America’s beggar-thy-neighbor policy of allowing the dollar’s value to fall dramatically against trade rivals.

zh: 但如果中国不能减少其经常项目盈余和资本流入问题，那么3.2万亿美元的问题将转变为20万亿人民币的问题。
en: But China’s $3.2 trillion problem will become a 20-trillion-renminbi problem if China cannot reduce its current-account surplus and fence off capital inflows.

zh: 国内结构调整在所难免。
en: There is no escape from the need for domestic structural adjustment.

zh: 为了进行结构调整，中国必须增加国内消费在GDP中的呃比重。
en: To achieve this, China must increase domestic consumption’s share of GDP.

zh: 这一点已经写入了中国政府的十二五规划。
en: This has already been written into the government’s 12th Five-Year Plan.

zh: 不幸的是，由于通胀高企，结构调整已经中止，控制信贷扩张成了中国政府的第一要务。
en: Unfortunately, given high inflation, structural adjustment has been postponed, with efforts to control credit expansion becoming the government’s first priority.

zh: 投资收缩强化本身就能增加中国的净储蓄，即经常项目盈余，同时约束国内消费。
en: This enforced investment slowdown is itself increasing China’s net savings, i.e., the current-account surplus, while constraining the expansion of domestic consumption.

zh: 只要中国的生活水平在赶超美国，那么人民币的实际升值就是无可避免之事。
en: Real appreciation of the renminbi is inevitable so long as Chinese living standards are catching up with US levels.

zh: 事实上，中国政府无法既保持低通胀，又维持人民币币值稳定。
en: Indeed, the Chinese government cannot hold down inflation while maintaining a stable value for the renminbi.

zh: 人民银行应该把目标定在人民币的实际升值速度上，而不是币值稳定前提下的通货膨胀率上。
en: The PBC should target the renminbi’s rate of real appreciation, rather than the inflation rate under a stable renminbi.

zh: 在此基础上，中国政府还需要更加关注结构调整，这才是医治中国3.2万亿美元麻烦的唯一有效的药方。
en: And then the government needs to focus more attention on structural adjustment – the only effective cure for China’s $3.2 trillion headache.

zh: 中国的开放半途而废
en: China’s Aborted Openness

zh: 中国官方新华社最近报道了政府调查山东临沂村发生的一系列强制结扎和堕胎事件。
en: China’s state-run Xinhua news agency recently reported on a government investigation into a string of forced sterilizations and abortions in the village of Linyi, Shandong province.

zh: 据说调查开始于为受害者仗义直言的盲人活动份子陈光诚遭绑架后的几天，其速度以及报道的坦率给人的印象是政府的应对措施更为积极有效、官方媒体更为大胆。
en: The speed of the investigation – said to have begun days after the kidnapping of Chen Guangcheng, a blind activist who had been a public advocate for the victims – and the candor of the report created the impression of greater government responsiveness and bolder official media.

zh: 事实果真如此吗？
en: Is this impression right?

zh: 通常，中国的宣传干部会将临沂的事态埋藏于中共的机密文件中。
en: The story in Linyi is the kind of news that propaganda officials usually bury in the Communist Party’s secret files.

zh: 报道说，临沂的地方政府为了避免超生，迫使妇女堕胎并将许多超生的夫妇强制结扎。
en: According to reports, local authorities in Linyi, seeking to avoid exceeding birth quotas under China’s “one-child” policy, forced several women to undergo abortions and forcibly sterilized many couples with more than one child.

zh: 据说，躲避这一运动的村民的家人被囚禁。
en: Villagers who hid to avoid the campaign reportedly saw their family members jailed.

zh: 临沂还有人痛诉辱没人格、酷刑以及敲诈等事件。
en: Some in Linyi alleged degrading treatment, torture, and extortion.

zh: 为何调查及报道这一丑闻？
en: Why investigate and report this scandal?

zh: 我相信，新华社的报道至多可以理解为控制损害。
en: The Xinhua reports, I believe, are best read as damage control.

zh: 中国正在争取联合国资金用以改善生育健康，因强制堕胎的报道而遭到挫折。
en: China is trying to secure funding from the United Nations to improve reproductive health – an effort that has been set back by reports of forced abortion.

zh: 直到有关陈光诚遭到骚扰乃至在北京警方协助下被绑架的新闻被国际媒体曝光，中央政府方才调查临沂的滥用职权事件。
en: Central authorities did not investigate the Linyi abuses until news of the harassment of Chen Guangcheng – and his abduction with the help of Beijing police – spread into international media.

zh: 陈光诚将滥用职权事件报告给了领导，并要求非政府组织公民维权网进行调查。
en: Chen had reported the abuses to officials and asked a non-governmental organization, the Citizens’ Rights Defense Group, to investigate.

zh: 该组织于五月份前往临沂。
en: The group went to Linyi in May.

zh: 一个月后，中国维权网报道了该组织的调查结果并且要求国家计划生育委员会干预此事。
en: A month later, the network of Chinese Human Rights Defenders reported the group’s findings and demanded the intervention of the central government’s Family Planning Commission (FPC).

zh: 我作为中国维权网的志愿者同陈光诚保持联系并密切跟踪事态的发展。
en: As a volunteer for the network, I was in touch with Chen and followed events closely.

zh: 七月份，由于无法得到政府回应，陈光诚开始从知名律师那里寻求法律援助，代表受害者准备诉讼，从而引起了地方干部的恐慌。
en: In July, having failed to elicit any government response, Chen began seeking legal aid from prominent lawyers to prepare lawsuits on behalf of the victims, causing alarm among local officials.

zh: 在警方的追捕下，陈光诚隐藏了起来。
en: Pursued by police, Chen went into hiding.

zh: 在8月30日我收到他的最后一封电子邮件中，他说他的“个人安全受到了威胁。 ”
en: My “personal safety was threatened,” he wrote on August 30 in the last email I received from him.

zh: 在国际社会强烈抗议陈光诚被绑架事件的情况下，计生委决定予以调查。
en: Following strenuous international protests over Chen’s kidnapping, the FPC decided to investigate.

zh: 新华社宣布，对暴力事件负有责任的地方干部或被起诉。
en: Xinhua announced that local officials responsible for the violence might be prosecuted.

zh: 中央政府似乎感觉到有必要立即平息对其充满争议的人口控制措施的批评。
en: Central authorities seemed to sense an immediate need to quell criticism of its controversial population-control efforts.

zh: 新华社还不失时机地宣称暴力事件局限于几个村庄。
en: And Xinhua wasted no time in claiming that the abuses were limited to a few towns.

zh: 但是，中央政府并没有做什么事情来制止对临沂村民的恐吓。
en: However, central government authorities have done little to halt intimidation of Linyi’s villagers.

zh: 陈光诚从拘留中获得释放，但是仍然被软禁，并且在9月2日莫名其妙地被带到警察局。
en: Chen was released from detention but remains under house arrest and was dragged back to the police station on September 2 for unknown reasons.

zh: 警方拒绝交还陈光诚的个人电脑和手机。
en: Police refuse to return Chen’s personal computer and cell phone.

zh: 该村的电话也被神秘地切断。
en: The village, too, is mysteriously without phone service.

zh: 同时，当局通过逮捕、威胁和贿赂，强迫村民撤回滥用职权的指控以及撤诉，并警告说，同陈光诚和律师们合作会有严重后果。
en: Meanwhile, through arrests, threats, and bribery, authorities are forcing villagers to withdraw accounts of abuse and back out of their lawsuits, warning of the dire consequences of cooperating with Chen and the lawyers.

zh: 国家计生委说是没有执法权而拒绝干预。
en: The FPC declines to intervene, citing lack of law-enforcement powers.

zh: 10月10日，村民的律师们被告知说原订于当天举行的法院听政会取消了。
en: On October 10, the villagers’ lawyers were told that the court hearing scheduled that day was canceled.

zh: 在律师们返回北京的路上，据说遭到了歹徒的袭击。
en: On their way back to Beijing, thugs reportedly assaulted the lawyers.

zh: 由此可见，如果相信政府对临沂事态的措施反映了政府对损害人权事件予以新的反应看起来未免天真。
en: Viewed in this context, the belief that the government’s approach to Linyi reflects a new responsiveness to human-rights abuses seems naïve.

zh: 如果政府果真更为积极，那么为什么我们没有见到对其他争议，例如盗取农田、投资者权利受损或者高层腐败等的类似的反应呢？
en: If the government were truly becoming more responsive, why have we not seen similar responses to other disputes over the theft of farmland, compromised investors’ rights, or high-level corruption?

zh: 所有这些事件中，政府用压制手段予以回应，包括雇用便衣民兵绑架或殴打敢于公开问题的人士。
en: In all these cases, authorities have responded with repression, including the hiring of plain-clothes militias to kidnap or beat up people who attempt to publicize problems.

zh: 中国对于农村艾滋病泛滥以及萨斯传染病几度姗姗来迟的公开报道清楚地表明中央政府只不过把公开透明视作权宜之计。
en: China’s belated bouts of openness about the rural spread of AIDS and the SARS epidemic clearly indicate that the central government regards transparency solely as a matter of expediency.

zh: 有人认为中国政府开始对地方当局失去控制。
en: Others argue that China’s government is simply losing its grip over local authorities.

zh: 这一前景并不妙。
en: This prospect is hardly encouraging.

zh: 如果无论中央政府如何关注，或者媒体如何直言，地方上滥用权力和压制事件我行我素，那么将会怎样？
en: If abuses and repression in the provinces continue no matter how attentive the central government, or how assertive the press might have become, what then?

zh: 但是，中央当局更为可能采取大多数中国人熟悉的“内紧外松”的政策。
en: More likely, however, the central authorities are following a policy that most Chinese know well: neijin waisong, or “controlled inside, relaxed outside.”

zh: 这个政策用在这里，就意味着对内巩固权力，对外平息指责。
en: Applied here, the policy means consolidating power at home while disarming critics abroad.

zh: 我相信，各省政府失去控制是幕后安排好的。
en: I believe that the government’s loss of control in the provinces has been stage-managed.

zh: 混乱可以为打压提供借口。
en: Chaos provides a cover for crackdowns.

zh: 身份不明的强人殴打和骚扰质疑中共统治的活动人士再方便不过，而当国际媒体开始提问时，各级官员可以把责任推到失去控制的“犯罪团伙”上。
en: It is too convenient when unidentified strongmen beat and harass activists who question Party rule, and it is too easy for officials to blame an out-of-control “criminal society” when international media start asking questions.

zh: 在临沂以外的地方也发生了目标可疑的“罪犯“攻击事件。
en: Suspiciously targeted “criminal” assaults have, indeed, occurred in places other than Linyi.

zh: 十月上旬，歹徒在广东省的太石村用棍棒殴打民权活动人士吕帮列。
en: Thugs thrashed civil rights activist Lu Banglie in the Guangdong town of Taishi in early October.

zh: 七月，河北省定州村的六名村民因抗议政府剥夺他们的土地，与一群歹徒发生流血冲突后死亡。
en: Six villagers in the Hebei village of Dingzhou, protesting government seizure of their land, died after bloody clashes with a gang of toughs in July.

zh: 此类事件举不胜举。
en: The list goes on.

zh: 国家媒体最近开始发布年终“群体事件”统计。
en: State media recently started releasing year-end “mass incident” statistics.

zh: 政府说，去年有74,000起此类事件。
en: Last year, the government said, there were 74,000 such incidents.

zh: 观察家们对于中国领导人承认这样惊人的抗议数字感到惊讶。
en: Observers marvel that China’s leaders admit to such a staggering number of protests.

zh: 但是，在这里，政府又在自圆其说。
en: But here, again, the government is hiding in plain sight.

zh: 国营媒体机关不得不承认这些抗议在测试中共维护权力的意志。
en: State-run media organs have been forced to admit that these protests test the Party’s will to maintain power.

zh: 但是它们并未说出中共如何实施这一意志，而是相信承认本身就可以让我们满意。
en: They neglect to tell the real story of how the Party exercises that will, trusting that the admission itself will satisfy us.

zh: 我们不应轻���随波逐流。
en: We should not be so quick to play along.

zh: 中国的阿富汗博弈
en: China’s Afghan Game Plan

zh: 马德里—在其新著《论中国 》 （ On China）中，亨利·基辛格用中国和西方的传统博弈游戏 — — 围棋和象棋 — — 来说明双方在国际权力政治方面的不同态度。
en: MADRID – In his latest book, On China, Henry Kissinger uses the traditional intellectual games favored by China and the West – weiqi and chess – as a way to reveal their differing attitudes toward international power politics.

zh: 象棋的目标是完全胜利，争夺的是克劳塞维茨所谓的“重心 ” ， 旨在最终完全消灭敌人，而围棋追求的是通过避免直接冲突的包围战略获得相对优势。
en: Chess is about total victory, a Clausewitzian battle for the “center of gravity” and the eventual elimination of the enemy, whereas weiqi is a quest for relative advantage through a strategy of encirclement that avoids direct conflict.

zh: 这一文化反差可以作为观察中国如何管理当前与西方之争的指南。
en: This cultural contrast is a useful guide to the way that China manages its current competition with the West.

zh: 中国的阿富汗政策便是竞争中的一项，且颇为符合围棋之道。
en: China’s Afghan policy is a case in point, but it also is a formidable challenge to the weiqi way.

zh: 在美国准备从阿富汗撤军的同时，中国必须处理好不确定性很大的战后状况。
en: As the United States prepares to withdraw its troops from the country, China must deal with an uncertain post-war scenario.

zh: 阿富汗对中国具有关键性的战略利益，但中国领导人从未想过要通过战争维护这一利益。
en: Afghanistan is of vital strategic interest to China, yet it never crossed its leaders’ minds to defend those interests through war.

zh: 阿富汗是中国西陲的关键安全区域、中国确保其在巴基斯坦（中印之争中中方的传统盟友）利益的重要走廊，也是中国获得该地区关键性自然资源的通道。
en: A vital security zone to China’s west, Afghanistan is also an important corridor through which it can secure its interests in Pakistan (a traditional ally in China’s competition with India), and ensure its access to vital natural resources in the region.

zh: 此外，在与阿富汗接壤的新疆自治区，穆斯林占据着人数优势，局势很不稳定，很容易受到塔利班和中国分裂分子的渗透。
en: Moreover, China’s already restless Muslim-majority province of Xinjiang, which borders on Afghanistan, might be dangerously affected by a Taliban takeover there, or by the country’s dismemberment.

zh: 阿富汗战争是美国打得最久的战争，花费（到目前为止）超过了5550亿美元，更有上千万阿富汗人民和近3100名美国士兵丧命。
en: The US fought its longest-ever war in Afghanistan, at a cost (so far) of more than $555 billion, not to mention tens of thousands of Afghan civilian casualties and close to 3,100 US troops killed.

zh: 但中国在阿富汗的战略大体上集中于商业开发，以满足其对能源和矿产的需求为目标。
en: But China’s strategy in the country was mostly focused on business development, and on satiating its vast appetite for energy and minerals.

zh: 据美国国防部估计，阿富汗待开发矿产存量大约价值1万亿美元。
en: The US Defense Department has valued Afghanistan’s untapped mineral deposits at $1 trillion.

zh: 而如今欲在阿富汗攫取其中大部分资源的正是中国。
en: But it is China that is now poised to exploit much of these resources.

zh: 事实上，中国的艾娜克（Aynak）铜矿开发项目阿富汗历史上最大的单一外国直接投资项目。
en: Indeed, China’s development of the Aynak Copper Mine was the largest single foreign direct investment in Afghanistan’s history.

zh: 中国还参与了5亿美元的电厂项目和塔吉克斯坦-巴基斯坦铁路项目。
en: China was also engaged in constructing a $500 million electric plant and railway link between Tajikistan and Pakistan.

zh: 去年12月，中石油与阿富汗当局签署了一项协议，成为首家开采阿富汗原油和天然气储备的外国公司。
en: Last December, China’s state-owned National Petroleum Corporation signed a deal with the Afghan authorities that would make it the first foreign company to exploit Afghanistan’s oil and natural-gas reserves.

zh: 一旦中国在阿富汗巨大的经济和安全利益没有了美国军力的约束，中国肯定会在阿富汗扮演更重要的角色，一种阿富汗人希望达到“战略水平”的角色。
en: Once China’s enormous economic and security interests in Afghanistan are left without America’s military shield, the Chinese are bound to play an even larger role there, one that Afghans hope will reach “strategic levels.”

zh: 中国将用中国的方式完成这一步 — — 即通过展示软实力，也可能通过“非传统安全区”来达到这一目的 — — 这也是中国政府在阿富汗总统卡尔扎伊6月初正式访问北京时的说法。
en: China would prefer to accomplish this the Chinese way – that is, essentially through a display of soft power – or, as the Chinese government put it on the occasion of Afghan President Hamid Karzai’s official visit to Beijing in early June, through “non-traditional security areas.”

zh: 以中国在世界其他地区的行为来判断，军事合作可能会非常温和和小心翼翼。
en: Judging by China’s behavior in other parts of the world, any military cooperation is likely to be extremely modest and cautious.

zh: 中国已经明确表态不会在维持阿富汗国防军的41亿美元多国资金中出力。
en: China has already made it clear it will not contribute to the $4.1 billion multilateral fund to sustain Afghan national security forces.

zh: 两国最新签署的双边合作协议将通过社会和经济发展“捍卫阿富汗国家稳定 ” 。
en: Rather, the two countries’ recently signed bilateral cooperation agreement is about “safeguarding Afghanistan’s national stability” through social and economic development.

zh: 中国特别热心于打击毒品运输，因为与新疆接壤的阿富汗巴达赫尚省已成为阿富汗鸦片的主要运输路线。
en: China is especially keen on combating drug trafficking, as Badakhshan, the Afghan province bordering on Xinjiang, has become the main transit route for Afghan opium.

zh: 防止塔利班宗教极端主义向新疆的渗透也依然是最重要的任务之一。
en: But preventing the spillover into Xinjiang of Taliban-inspired religious extremism remains a high priority as well.

zh: 在最近的上合组织（成员包括中国、俄罗斯和主要中亚国家）北京峰会中，中国竭尽全力营造地区利益相关者的利益均衡局面。 此外，上合组织还寻求在防止该地区遭受“区域外动荡冲击 ” （ 胡锦涛主席语）方面达成共识。
en: China went to great lengths to present the recent summit in Beijing of the Shanghai Cooperation Organization, which includes China, Russia, and major Central Asian countries, as an attempt to create a fair balance of interests among regional stakeholders.  Moreover, the SCO sought a consensus on how, in Chinese President Hu Jintao’s words, to guard the region “against shocks from turbulence outside the region.”

zh: 但是，不管中国如何集中精力于在阿富汗战事软实力，都可能发现难以在这个极端复杂且充满着历史冲突的地区充当警察角色。
en: Yet, however focused it is on soft-power projection in Afghanistan, China will likely find it difficult not to be drawn into the role of policeman in an extremely complex and historically conflict-ridden region.

zh: 此外，中国的地区动作会与该地区的其他大国（比如俄罗斯和印度）发生冲突。
en: China’s regional outreach, moreover, clashes with that of other regional powers, such as Russia and India.

zh: 其自身盟友巴基斯坦也并不急于清除威胁邻国（中国也是其中之一）安全的恐怖主义集团。
en: Nor is its own ally, Pakistan, particularly eager to confront terrorist groups that threaten the security of its neighbors, China among them.

zh: 巴基斯坦或许会发现，协调其中国盟友的安全与其与印度的事实上的代理战争是十分困难的。
en: Pakistan might find it extremely difficult to reconcile the security of its Chinese ally with its de facto proxy war with India.

zh: 因此，中国或许被迫增强其在巴基斯坦以及阿富汗边境部落区域的军力部署，以对付恐怖主义集团，比如巴基斯坦的东突厥斯坦伊斯兰运动组织（中国认为它是新疆暴乱的罪魁 ） 。
en: China might then be forced to bolster its military presence in Pakistan and in tribal areas along the Afghan border in order to counter terrorist groups such as the Pakistan-based East Turkestan Islamic Movement, which the Chinese believe is responsible for attacks in Xinjiang.

zh: 中国喜欢的方式是合作与对话。
en: The preferred Chinese way would be that of cooptation and dialogue.

zh: 事实上，中国外交官最近忙于和巴基斯坦和阿富汗开战旨在与塔利班和解的三边对话。
en: Indeed, Chinese diplomacy has been busy lately in trilateral talks with Pakistan and Afghanistan aimed at achieving reconciliation with the Taliban.

zh: 中国也无意搅合其盟友巴基斯坦和其对手印度之间的冲突。
en: Nor is China interested in stirring up the conflict between its Pakistani allies and its Indian rivals.

zh: 相反，多年来中国一直指出影响阿富汗稳定的主要问题是印度-巴基斯坦代理战争，因此克什米尔和平才是阿富汗和平的关键。
en: On the contrary, China has argued for years that the main problem affecting Afghanistan’s stability is the India-Pakistan proxy fighting, and that peace in Kashmir is therefore the key to peace in Afghanistan.

zh: 如何在美国撤军后捍卫其在阿富汗的利益才是中国外交所面临的真正重大挑战。
en: The task of defending its interests in Afghanistan after US withdrawal is a truly formidable challenge for Chinese diplomacy.

zh: 但是，没有迹象表明中国会像美国那样部署大规模军事干预（而在近几年中，世界逐渐习惯了美国的做法 ） 。
en: It is inconceivable, though, that the Chinese would enter into the kind of massive US-style military intervention to which the world has grown accustomed in recent years.

zh: 对中国来说，阿富汗的考验很有可能兼具了象棋和围棋的特点。
en: For China, the Afghan contest will most likely turn out to be a very measured combination of chess and weiqi.

zh: 中国的非洲恶行
en: China’s African Mischief

zh: 发自东京 — — 随着利比亚国家过渡委员会试图在这个新近解放的国家建立政府，卡扎菲执政时的种种黑幕也逐渐被公诸于世。
en: TOKYO – As Libya’s National Transitional Council attempts to establish a functioning government for a newly liberated country, the truth about what went on under Col. Muammar el-Qaddafi’s regime is starting to come to light.

zh: 在的黎波里各处都发现了一些金库和储藏室，但这些地方已经被原来的主人匆忙地搬空了，而那些被虐待，被谋杀以及失踪者的遭遇也逐渐曝光。
en: Various treasures have been unearthed from Tripoli mansions that were hastily vacated by their owners, and what happened to the tortured, the murdered, and the missing is beginning to be revealed.

zh: 与此同时，卡扎菲的某些最肮脏的外交秘密也被揭发出来。
en: So, too, are some of Qaddafi’s dirtiest diplomatic secrets being exposed.

zh: 加拿大《环球邮报》在9月2日披露了陷入混战的卡扎非政权与一些和中国政府有直接联系的军火公司的谈判细节，其合同总值高达2亿美元。
en: On September 2, the Canadian newspaper The Globe and Mail reported on recent negotiations between the embattled Qaddafi regime and Chinese armaments companies with direct ties to China’s government for contracts worth $200 million.

zh: 这些合同粗暴践踏了1970年联合国安理会通过的利比亚武器禁运决议，而中国也是签署国之一。
en: Such contracts were in flagrant violation of the arms embargo instituted under UN Security Council Resolution 1970, which China approved.

zh: 中国领导人否认这些秘密武器交易的有效性，并坚持说政府并未批准这类行为。
en: China’s rulers have denied that the secret arms deals were valid, and insist that the government did not authorize them.

zh: 但一份出差报告明确显示卡扎菲手下的安全官员曾分别与中国3个武器制造商会面，其中包括中国北方工业集团（Norinco ） ， 中国精密机械进出口总公司（CPMIC）和中国新兴进出口总公司。
en: But a travel report explicitly states that Qaddafi’s security officials met with three Chinese arms manufacturers: China North Industries Corp. (Norinco), the China National Precision Machinery Import & Export Corp.

zh: 会面日程不但包括了这些公司的现有武器库存，还包括了中方在有需要的情况下额外提供武器的承诺。
en: (CPMIC), and China XinXing Import & Export Corp. The agenda included not only these companies’ available weapons stockpiles, but also the Chinese firms’ promise to provide additional weapons if required.

zh: 卡扎非在绝望时向中国求救的行为多少有点出人意料。
en: Qaddafi’s turn to China in his hour of desperation is somewhat surprising.

zh: 毕竟他本人对中国在非洲日渐频繁的活动 — — 其下属坚称是“帝国主义行为 ” — —的反应就是在2006年接待了时任台湾总统陈水扁的正式访问。
en: After all, he reacted to China’s growing activities in Africa – which his officials maintained was “reminiscent of imperialism” – by receiving an official visit in 2006 from Taiwan’s then-President Chen Shui-bian.

zh: 随着起义势力所造成的压力越来越大，卡扎菲把维持权力的最后希望放在了中国身上，而对后者染指非洲的忧虑也只能靠边站了。
en: As the pressure from the rebels grew, Qaddafi’s last hope for maintaining power became China, and so fear of its influence in Africa was brushed aside.

zh: 数十年以来，卡扎菲的所作所为就仿佛是他是其吹鼓手们所说的“非洲之王 ” ， 凭借手中的大量石油收入，他不断向邻国给予援助。
en: For decades, Qaddafi had behaved as if he were, as his propagandists proclaimed him, “King among African Kings,” using his country’s abundant oil revenues to provide aid to his neighbors.

zh: 他宣称已经为“将非洲从西方手中解放出来”资助了970亿美元。
en: He announced investments of $97 billion to “free Africa from the West.”

zh: 布基纳法索总统孔帕奥埃曾在1980年代发动军事政变上台前接受过利比亚的军事训练（谣传该国也是卡扎菲的逃亡目的地 ） 。
en: President Compaoré of Burkina Faso (initially rumored to be a likely destination for Qaddafi’s exile) received military training from Libya in the 1980’s before rising to power in a coup d’état.

zh: 乍得总统伊德里斯·代比同样也是在卡扎非支持下于1990年上台。
en: President Idriss Déby of Chad also brought about political change in 1990 with Qaddafi’s backing.

zh: 目前正为卡扎非第三子沙阿迪提供庇护的尼日尔总统马哈马杜·伊素福正是依靠卡扎菲的金钱才能在今年3月赢得选举。
en: Niger’s President Mahamadou Issoufou, who is now harboring Qaddafi’s third son, Saadi, was able to win his country’s presidential election last March thanks to financial support from Qaddafi.

zh: 但近年中国逐渐成为卡扎菲非洲野心的一大障碍，何况还照搬了他的做法：用金钱和武器收买那些独裁者们。
en: But, in recent years, China became an obstacle to Qaddafi’s African ambitions, and China did so by copying his methods: buying the support of dictators with weaponry and finance.

zh: 自2000年以来中国向非洲那些局势不稳和实施独裁的国家大献殷勤：一方面利用援助，另一方面承诺可以阻止联合国对这些国家实施制裁。
en: Since 2000, China has actively courted Africa’s unstable and dictatorial countries with offers of aid and a refusal to back United Nations sanctions against them.

zh: 事实上，中国正肆无忌惮地染指那些欧美出于制裁而不愿涉及的非洲国家交易。
en: Indeed, China has blithely entered into business with African countries that Europe and America refuse to engage with, owing to sanctions.

zh: 看上去国际制裁似乎已经成为中国为满足本国企业需求而大量开发非洲矿产资源的方便之门。
en: International sanctions, it now seems, were the door through which China rushed to gain access to Africa’s mineral wealth for its voracious industries.

zh: 比如说中国非但没有致力于维护苏丹和平，相反作为一个联合国安理会常任理事国，中国借助石油设施和武器而对苏丹的深度介入实际上延长了达尔富尔冲突。
en: For example, instead of making an effort to foster peace in Sudan, as a permanent, veto-wielding member of the UN Security Council should, China’s deep involvement with Sudan, through the provision of oil infrastructure and weapons, actually prolonged the Darfur conflict.

zh: 一封由多位美国国会议员联名签署的致中国官员的信，以及由大赦国际所撰写的报告都表明中国违反了联合国禁止向苏丹提供武器的决议。
en: A letter to Chinese officials, signed by many members of the US Congress, and a report by Amnesty International state that China exported weapons to Sudan in violation of UN resolutions.

zh: 由于中国支持喀土穆政府，奥斯卡奖得主斯皮尔伯格不但辞去了2008年北京奥运会的顾问一职，使中国蒙羞，还将这场运动会称之为“种族灭绝奥林匹克 ” 。
en: The Oscar-winning film director Steven Spielberg embarrassed China by resigning from an advisory post for the 2008 Beijing Olympics because of its support for the government in Khartoum, calling the Chinese games the “genocide Olympics.”

zh: 在今年夏天卡扎菲与反对派混战的时候，南部苏丹的十个州也宣布独立，成为非洲大陆的第54个国家。
en: As Qaddafi fought his opponents this summer, ten states in southern Sudan broke away, claiming independence as the 54th country on the African continent.

zh: 苏丹每日49万桶的石油产量中有80%来自南部。
en: Roughly 80% of Sudan’s oil production of 490,000 barrels per day is concentrated in South Sudan.

zh: 2010年中国从苏丹进口了25万桶石油，约占其总产量的一半，相当于中国石油总需求量的5 % 。
en: In 2010, China imported almost half of this output, roughly 250,000 barrels per day, which accounts for about 5% of China’s oil imports.

zh: 鉴于其过去对残暴的喀土穆政府的支持，中国目前正想尽办法与南苏丹修复关系，以确保能继续开发这个新生国家的石油储备。
en: Given its support for the brutal national government in Khartoum, China is now desperately trying to repair relations with South Sudan, so that it can continue to exploit the new country’s oil reserves.

zh: 跟苏丹类似的还有安哥拉这个曾经陷入数十年武装冲突的非洲第二大石油生产国。
en: Like Sudan, Angola, Africa’s second largest oil producer, has experienced continued conflict for decades.

zh: 该国在2002年遭到联合国制裁。
en: It was subject to UN sanctions until 2002.

zh: 但在安哥拉混乱期间，中国用大笔基础设施建设资金换取了大量石油。
en: Yet, during the years of Angola’s pariah status, China provided large-scale infrastructure finance in return for oil.

zh: 如今中国也是安哥拉石油的第二大出口目的地（在制裁撤消之后的石油开采热潮中美国得以介入并晋身第一大进口国 ） 。
en: Today, China is the second biggest destination for Angolan oil (the US, which jumped on the bandwagon after sanctions were lifted, is the largest).

zh: 事实上安哥拉向中国提供的石油供应超过沙特阿拉伯，而与此同时，超过10万名中国工人也在参与安哥拉基础设施建设。
en: Indeed, Angola produces more oil for China than Saudi Arabia does, and, at times, as many as 100,000 Chinese workers have been working on Angolan infrastructure projects.

zh: 中国选择了一条高风险的道路 — — 将人权和联合国制裁置诸脑后 — — 以此来确保本国工业迅速增长所需的能源以及其他资源供应。
en: China has chosen a high-risk path – ignoring human rights and violating UN sanctions – to secure the energy and other resources needed to sustain its economy’s rapid growth.

zh: 这不是一个跟安理会常任理事国地位相称的选择，也无法体现中国作为国际社会中负责任成员的角色。
en: It is a choice that neither befits one of the permanent members of the Security Council, nor demonstrates China’s readiness to be a responsible stakeholder in the international community.

zh: 中国武装和维护非洲独裁者的意愿，甚至像在利比亚那样罔顾联合国制裁的行为将使其宣称的“和平崛起”大打折扣。
en: China’s willingness to arm and defend African dictators, even in the teeth of UN sanctions, as in Libya, undermines its claim to a “peaceful rise.”

zh: 鉴于中国在利比亚的两面派行为，全世界如今都应当思考它是否只是个在国际规则符合其利益时才服从这些规则的国家。
en: Given China’s Libyan duplicity, the world should now determine whether it is a country that obeys international rules only when doing so suits its interests.

zh: 中国的艾滋病危机
en: China’s AIDS Crisis

zh: 外国医生一般很少会到中国的农村，传染性爱滋病在那里流行肆虐，夺去了很多无辜的生命。
en: It is rare for a foreign doctor to get to China’s rural areas, where its AIDS epidemic was born and takes a horrible toll.

zh: 但不久前，我和两位护士随无国界医生组织的医疗队来到了湖北泥嘴的贫困山村，走访了那里一户刘姓家庭，看望了他们只有7个月大的小孩。
en: But recently, two nurses and I ventured into a poor farming area, Nizui in Hubei Province, as part of a Medecins Sans Frontières(MSF) team to visit the Liu family and evaluate their 7-month-old baby.

zh: 那孩子身材只有两个月大，可眼神却像八旬老翁一样充满了极度的苦痛。
en: The child was the size of a two month old, but his eyes held the gaze of an 80-year-old man long acquainted with extreme suffering.

zh: 他正在艾滋病的边缘垂死挣扎。
en: The baby was dying of AIDS.

zh: 他的父母、阿姨和叔叔的HIV检测也都呈阳性。
en: His parents, aunts, and uncles were also HIV-positive.

zh: 刘姓家庭不过是20世纪90年代在被污染的献血过程中感染艾滋病的成千上万穷苦农民家庭中的一员，那个时候，管理不善的赢利性血库组织重复使用针头，在血浆采集后把感染者身上的血液输到了健康的献血者身上。
en: The Liu family is one of thousands of poor farming families in China’s interior who contracted HIV through contaminated blood donations during the 1990’s, when under-regulated for-profit blood banking companies reused needles and transferred blood from infected donors to clean donors after extracting the plasma.

zh: 中国卫生部最近公布了总数达840，000例的HIV/艾滋病汇总结果，但多数专家相信，实际的数字比这还要大的多。
en: The Chinese Health Ministry recently put the total number of HIV/AIDS cases at 840,000, although most experts believe that the true number is much higher.

zh: 有人甚至认为到2010年，中国人的感染总数可能会达到1000万。
en: Some believe that by 2010, the number of infected Chinese may reach 10 million.

zh: 在连续多年采取消极、低调的策略之后，卫生部官员终于加大了反艾滋病的力度。
en: After years of taking a passive, low-profile approach to the epidemic, health officials have stepped up their anti-HIV campaign.

zh: 由于80%的HIV/艾滋病患者处在乡下，对这些地区的卫生保健工作就成了当务之急。
en: Since 80% of HIV/AIDS patients reside in the countryside, greater access to health care in these areas has become a priority.

zh: 今年7月，受到高度关注的曼谷第15届国际艾滋病大会召开期间，温家宝总理宣布中国将全力制止艾滋病的蔓延。
en: This past July, during the highly publicized 15th International AIDS Conference in Bangkok, Premier Wen Jiabao declared all-out war against the burgeoning epidemic.

zh: 今年早些时候，政府承诺要开展血液制品检测、提供自愿免费的HIV病毒测试，以及为贫困人口免费发放治疗艾滋病的药品。
en: Earlier this year, the government promised blood-products screening, free voluntary HIV testing, and free medicine for the poor.

zh: 此次新的反HIV/艾滋病攻势得到了国际社会的广泛赞誉，它们确实比以前显得更加开放和积极。
en: This new anti-HIV/AIDS campaign, which the international community has lauded, is more open and proactive than before.

zh: 可这次行动也还是在封闭的社会环境中进行，而在这样的环境下，政府对媒体的控制限制了有效应对公众健康传染病所必需的信息流通。
en: But it must still operate in the context of a closed society, where government control over the media limits the flow of information necessary to deal with any public health epidemic.

zh: 不仅如此，我们还不清楚中国预备怎样把医疗护理送到农村的艾滋病前沿，因为人民公社解体后，老的卫生防疫站体系早就随着农业集体化的崩溃不复存在了。
en: Moreover, it is unclear how care will be delivered to the rural front lines, where the old system of clinics based in Peoples’ Communes collapsed with the de-collectivization of agriculture.

zh: 为了确保治疗效果，HIV/艾滋病流行地区的卫生防疫站必须给艾滋病人提供和其它人一样的医疗条件。
en: To be effective, clinics in areas where HIV/AIDS is prevalent must provide patients with the same standard of care that is offered for other health conditions.

zh: 可不幸的是，这在多数情况下的确很难实现，其中的部分原因是中国开始时并不希望海外组织进入自己的内陆地区提供协助。
en: Unfortunately, the door to such access remains largely closed, partly because China was initially reluctant to allow overseas groups into their hinterlands to assist.

zh: 不过，当地和国外的非政府机构现在也开始在弥合国家政策和一线医疗条件的差距中发挥作用。
en: Nonetheless, local and foreign NGO’s are now starting to play a role in filling the gap between government policies and front-line healthcare delivery.

zh: 2003年5月，无国界医生组织得到许可，在湖北省襄樊地区设立一家HIV/艾滋病诊所。
en: In May 2003, MSF was authorized to set up an HIV/AIDS clinic in Xiangfan, Hubei Province.

zh: 不久前到那里时，我碰到了杜先生，一位HIV检测呈阳性的瘦瘦的中国农民。 他的妻子去年刚死于艾滋病，他拼命想保住感染的7岁儿子，不让他也遭受同样的厄运。
en: On my recent visit, I met Mr. Du, a thin-framed, HIV-positive farmer who lost his wife to AIDS last year and was desperate to prevent his infected 7-year-old son from meeting the same fate.

zh: 为了寻求帮助，他带着孩子、坐着火车、汽车和卡车走遍了全中国。
en: He had been taking the boy all over China by train, bus, and truck in search of help.

zh: 仅仅在上月一个月，他们就走访了五大城市，可并没有收到任何效果。
en: Last month alone, they visited five large cities without success.

zh: 杜先生和像他一样的人在中国得到帮助的可能性是微乎其微的，目前，多数诊所和医院都还没有做好准备，收治艾滋病毒感染的病人。
en: The chance that Mr. Du, and those like him, will find help in China is slim; at present, most clinics and hospitals are not adequately prepared to treat HIV-infected patients.

zh: 就算能治的地方，条件也非常有限。
en: Treatment is extremely limited where it is available.

zh: 举例来讲，襄樊传染病医院是该地区唯一一家能接收HIV/艾滋病患者的医疗机构。
en: For example, Xiangfan’s Infectious Diseases Hospital is the prefecture’s only health facility where HIV/AIDS patients can be admitted.

zh: 单从纸面上看，这家医院似乎人员充足，设备先进，可我一到那里，就发现大厅和病房几乎空无一人。
en: On paper, the hospital appears well staffed and adequately equipped, but on my rounds there, I found the halls and wards deserted and barren.

zh: 那里总共也没有几种诊断和治疗的设备。
en: Few therapeutic and diagnostic options were available.

zh: 即使像断层扫描这样最基本的检查，也需要转到该地区的其它医院来进行。
en: Even a basic test like a CAT scan would require transport to another regional hospital.

zh: 可医院设备不全还不是控制中国艾滋病危机的最大障碍。
en: But under-equipped hospitals may not be the greatest obstacle to controlling China's AIDS crisis.

zh: 同样有害的还有政府对政策失误的敏感和艾滋病通过性行为传播的恶名。
en: Equally harmful are the government’s sensitivity to its own policy failures and the stigma attached to a disease that is often sexually transmitted.

zh: 实际上，信息匮乏和与艾滋病相关的恶名已经到了令人发指的程度，以致于艾滋病人受到普通人乃至医务人员的排斥都成了家常便饭。
en: Indeed, information is so limited and the stigma so strong that ordinary people – and sometimes medical personnel – often ostracize AIDS patients.

zh: 接受治疗的病人用药一般不合规范，甚至可能有害。
en: Patients who do receive care are often treated with substandard, even harmful, medicine.

zh: 据国际制药工业协会联合会统计，中国病人有40-50%的机会在药店里买到假药，而处方药造假的比例比这还要高。
en: According to the International Federation of Pharmaceutical Manufacturers Associations, patients in China can have a 40-50% chance of being sold fake over-the-counter remedies and an even higher chance of being sold fake prescription drugs.

zh: 有些假药中甚至含有一些有毒的物质。
en: Some of these counterfeit products contain toxic ingredients.

zh: 像无国界医生组织这样的国外非政府组织坚持使用的药品必须达到国际卫生组织的标准，但中国政府坚持这样的限制措施根本无法实现。
en: Foreign NGOs such as MSF insist on using medications that are up to World Health Organization standards, but the Chinese government insists that such restrictive measures are excessive.

zh: 尽管无国界医生组织启用了自己的药品库，但中国病人还是经常在街上买到成分和药效不明的产品。
en: Although MSF uses its own drug supply, Chinese patients still often buy medicine with unknown ingredients and efficacy on the street.

zh: 最低限度要对治疗HIV病毒的抗逆转录酶药物采取安全措施，因为这种药对剂量变化和与其它药的相互作用极其敏感。
en: Safety regulations must, at a minimum, be applied to the prescription of the anti-retroviral medications that fight HIV, because such drugs are extremely sensitive to dosage changes and interactions with other medicines.

zh: 不恰当的用药会导致艾滋病毒产生耐药性，对病人的临床治疗也没有任何好处。
en: Improper use of these medicines fosters HIV resistance and provides little therapeutic value for patients.

zh: 结束中国的艾滋病危机没有任何捷径。
en: There is no quick-fix solution to ending China’s AIDS crisis.

zh: 那里的官员不仅要关注在农村地区建立起切实可行的医疗卫生体系，同时还要加大中国媒体的开放程度，只有这样，拯救生命的公众信息才能��到有效的传播。
en: Officials there must focus not only on developing a pragmatic, realistic healthcare infrastructure in rural areas, but also on bringing about greater openness in China’s media in order to spread life-saving public information.

zh: 和所有传染病一样，中国的HIV/艾滋病流行是一场公众健康的危机，这场危机只有通过准确信息的广泛传播才能得以遏制。
en: Like all epidemics, HIV/AIDS in China is a public health crisis that can only be solved with the mass dissemination of accurate information.

zh: 把承诺和政策转变为患者权利、认识和有效的医疗护理肯定需要时间，在中国这样庞大且缺乏透明度的国家恐怕尤其如此。
en: Transforming promises and policies into patient rights, awareness, and effective health care will undoubtedly take time, especially for a country as massive and lacking in transparency as China.

zh: 对成百上千万艾滋病患者来讲，他们很可能已经等不了那么长的时间。
en: For the hundreds of thousands of HIV sufferers, this is likely to be more time than they have left.

zh: 亚洲：屈服还是合作？
en: Kowtow or Cooperation in Asia?

zh: 东京—美国总统获得连任后的第一次出访来到了亚洲，这可以让你肯定，亚洲一定有大事在发生。
en: TOKYO – When an American president’s first overseas trip following his re-election is to Asia, one can be sure that something big is afoot in the region.

zh: 事实上，奥巴马决定首先访问长期孤立的贫困国家缅甸证实了该国正在发生的深远变化，也证实了美国明白中国正在设法让亚洲屈服于其经济和外交政策利益。
en: Indeed, Barack Obama’s decision to go first to impoverished and long-isolated Myanmar (Burma) attests to the potency of the changes underway in that country – and to US awareness of China’s efforts to shape an Asia that kowtows to its economic and foreign-policy interests.

zh: 金边东盟和东亚领导人峰会 — — 奥巴马亚洲之行的另一重要一站 — — 证实了这一点。
en: Events at the ASEAN and East Asian leadership summits in Phnom Penh, the other key stop on Obama’s tour, confirmed this.

zh: 在东盟峰会上，前红色高棉指挥官、三十年来对柬埔寨实施着铁腕统治的首相洪森在闭幕词上说，所有领导人都同意不将南海岛屿主权争端“国际化 ” 。
en: At the ASEAN summit’s conclusion, Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Sen, a former Khmer Rouge commander who has ruled his country with an iron fist for three decades, closed the meeting by proclaiming that all of the leaders had agreed not to “internationalize” sovereignty disputes over islands in the South China Sea.

zh: 中国总理温家宝对这一显然让中国得偿所愿的决定微笑着点头。 在峰会中，温家宝签署了数千万美元的援助柬埔寨新协议。
en: Chinese Prime Minister Wen Jiabao, present at the summit to sign new multi-million-dollar aid agreements with Cambodia, smiled and nodded in agreement at this apparent acceptance of Chinese wishes.

zh: 没有这么快，菲律宾总统阿基诺三世说。
en: Not so fast, said Filipino President Benigno S. Aquino III.

zh: 并未达成这样的协议。
en: No such agreement had been made.

zh: 洪森对东盟领导人讨论结果的描述是错误的。
en: Hun Sen had mischaracterized the discussions among ASEAN’s leaders.

zh: 也在金边现身的日本首相野田佳彦同意阿基诺的说法。
en: Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda, who was also present in Phnom Penh, agreed with Aquino.

zh: 峰会结束时，越南、马来西亚、印尼、文莱和新加坡都加入了阿基诺的行列，要求洪森改口。
en: At the summit’s end, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, Brunei and Singapore joined with Aquino in demanding that Hun Sen’s statement be amended.

zh: 这六个国家均在敦促中国与东盟展开多边谈判，解决南海领土争端。
en: All six of these states have been pushing China to negotiate with ASEAN a multilateral process to resolve the South China Sea territorial disputes.

zh: 而比它们大得多的中国则偏好双边谈判。
en: China, dwarfing all of them, prefers bilateral talks.

zh: 洪森的行为表明，过度依赖中国援助和外交支持的国家会据此调整政策。
en: As Hun Sen’s behavior demonstrates, countries that are overly dependent on Chinese aid and diplomatic backing will harmonize their policies accordingly.

zh: 二十年来，缅甸的行为与柬埔寨别无二致，直到中国玩得太过火 — — 特别是在最近废除的密松大坝项目上 — — 其追求主导的野心昭然若揭。
en: For two decades, Myanmar behaved likewise, until Chinese overreach, particularly the now-abandoned Myitsone dam project, revealed in full the subservient relationship that China envisioned.

zh: 事实上，中国的傲慢 — — 要求密松大坝发电量100%输往中国 — — 也许是促使缅甸发生民主政治转型、重新开放走向世界的关键因素。
en: Indeed, China’s arrogance – 100% of the power from the proposed dam was to be exported to China – was probably the key factor in precipitating Myanmar’s democratic political transition and new openness to the world.

zh: 但亚洲也不能曲解奥巴马的访问。
en: But Asians must not misconstrue Obama’s visit.

zh: 尽管美国肯定会将亚洲作为战略“重点 ” ， 但光靠其一国是无法建立有效的地区安全结构的。
en: Although the US is certainly undertaking a strategic “pivot” to Asia, America alone cannot construct a viable security structure for the region.

zh: 从印度到日本，每个亚洲国家都必须加入其中。
en: From India to Japan, every Asian country must play its part.

zh: 没有替代方案，因为中国的崛起伴随着整个地区的大规模社会和经济变化 — — 在某些情况下甚至是混乱。
en: There is no alternative to this approach, because China’s rise has been accompanied by massive social and economic changes – in some instances dislocation – across the entire region.

zh: 当然，亚洲经济体在近几十年中大大地一体化了，特别是通过全球供应链的产生。
en: Asia’s economies have, of course, become much more integrated in recent decades, particularly through production for global supply chains.

zh: 但外交并没有跟上经济一体化进度。
en: But economic integration has not been matched diplomatically.

zh: 即使两个战略利益几乎相同的亚洲民主大国 — — 日本和韩国 — — 也陷入了由来已久的领土争端 — — 反映了由来更久的冲突 — — 无法进行紧密合作。
en: Even two of the region’s great democracies, Japan and South Korea, which have nearly identical strategic interests, have allowed an old territorial dispute – itself reflecting older unresolved animosities – to block closer cooperation.

zh: 中国漫长 — — 显然仍未完结 — — 的领导权交接过程 — — 被薄熙来事件打断 — — 表明其领导人继续引导中国崛起为超级大国的能力并不板上钉钉。
en: China’s prolonged – and apparently contentious – leadership transition, punctuated by the purge of Bo Xilai, suggests that its leaders’ ability to continue to manage the country’s emergence as a great power is not entirely certain.

zh: 这使得能被广泛接受的亚洲地区和平结构的缺位变得尤其危险。
en: That makes the absence of a widely accepted regional structure of peace all the more dangerous.

zh: 国际秩序的产生要么通过共识，要么通过武力。
en: International orders emerge either by consensus or through force.

zh: 奥巴马、即将上任的中国主席习近平、印度总理辛格、12月大选后上台的日本和韩国领导人、以及所有东盟成员国必须确保在亚洲形成共识的同时不让中国最大的战略隐忧 — — 岛链 — — 恶化。
en: The great task for Obama, incoming Chinese President, Xi Jinping, Indian Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, the new Japanese and South Korean leaders who will come to power following elections in December, and all ASEAN members is to ensure that consensus prevails in Asia without stoking China’s greatest strategic fear – encirclement.

zh: 所有亚洲人都应该认识到，不管共产主义中国什么时候认为它面临威胁，它都会付诸武力解决 — — 1950年的朝鲜、1962年的印度、1969年的苏联、1979年的越南都是如此。
en: As everyone in Asia should recognize, whenever communist China has deemed that it faced such a threat, it has resorted to war – in Korea in 1950, India in 1962, the Soviet Union in 1969, and Vietnam in 1979.

zh: 但害怕挑衅中国���应该阻止亚洲领导人寻求地区安全共识，比如处理南海争端的解决方案。
en: But fear of provoking China should not stop Asia’s leaders from seeking a regional security consensus, such as the proposed code of conduct for disputes in the South China Sea.

zh: 只有最软弱的亚洲国家才会甘愿屈服于中国的霸权 — — 或者与此相对的冷战式美国领导的遏制战略。
en: Only the weakest of Asian states will submit willingly to Chinese hegemony – or, for that matter, to a Cold War-style US-led containment strategy.

zh: 事实上，亚洲国家必须选择中国未来还是美国未来的观点是错误的。
en: Indeed, the idea that Asian countries must choose between a Chinese or American future is false.

zh: 但亚洲对霸权的担忧以及中国对军事包围的担忧可以调和吗？
en: But can Asia’s fear of hegemony and China’s fear of military encirclement be reconciled?

zh: 唯有认识到共同追求才能避免地区军事化。
en: Only a shared sense of common purpose can prevent regional militarization.

zh: 正确方向的最初步骤已经可以看到。
en: Some early steps in the right direction are visible.

zh: 美国与其他一些国家加入了泛太平洋合作伙伴关系协定，这是一个联系美洲和亚洲的自由贸易契约。
en: The United States has joined several other countries in embracing a Trans-Pacific Partnership, a free-trade pact linking the Americas with Asia.

zh: 日本执政党和最大反对党均支持该协定，奥巴马邀请中国加入的举动表明美国在可行的时候也在试图打造地区共识。
en: Japan’s ruling party and leading opposition party are coming around to support the idea, and Obama’s invitation to China to join suggests that the US is trying to forge regional consensus where it can.

zh: 不过，在当下，中国又其他想法。
en: For now, however, China has other ideas.

zh: 它敦促东盟建立一个包括中国但不包括美国和日本的贸易区。
en: It has pressed ASEAN to establish a trade zone that would include China but exclude the US and Japan.

zh: 无论如何，贸易协定不管好处多大，都无法消弭亚洲主权争端，而在主权争端问题 — — 地区紧张局势的罪魁祸首 — — 上，共同目标不但可行，而且是维持和平的必要条件。
en: In any case, trade agreements, however beneficial, can do little to defuse Asia’s sovereignty disputes, and it is here – the greatest current source of regional tensions – that a shared common enterprise is not only possible, but also necessary if peace is to be preserved.

zh: 毕竟，亚洲地区没有哪个国家 — — 不管是日本、韩国、中国台湾、菲律宾这样的民主政体，还是中国和越南这样的一党执政国家，抑或文莱这样的微型君主国家 — — 可以在默许这类问题的情况下生存下去。
en: After all, no government in the region – whether a democracy like Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and the Philippines, a one-party state like China and Vietnam, or a tiny monarchy like Brunei – can acquiesce on such issues and hope to survive.

zh: 如此外交现实主义并不一定导致零和结果，欧洲一体化进程就是明证。
en: Such diplomatic realism need not lead to zero-sum outcomes, as the example of European integration demonstrates.

zh: 正如欧洲煤炭和钢铁共同体成为了今天的欧盟，所有亚洲都能从共同开发丰富的海洋资源（不抛弃任何主权主张）中获益，尽管这一再成为地区争端的导火索。
en: Just as the European Coal and Steel Community preceded today’s European Union, all of Asia would benefit from embracing shared development (without any renunciation of sovereignty claims) of the rich maritime resources that, in several cases, are fueling the sovereignty disputes.

zh: 中国的抗脆弱之路
en: China’s Antifragile Ambitions

zh: 香港 — — 中国实现包容性可持续繁荣的征程再次面临十字路口。
en: HONG KONG – China has once again reached a crossroads on its journey toward inclusive, sustainable prosperity.

zh: 去年十一月中国共产党代表大会上选出的新一届领导班子，一方面必须面对中国历史和千变万化的地缘政治的限制， 另一方面必须描绘中国未来十年蓝图，并担当实现中国社会、政治和经济体制现代化的重任。
en: At the Chinese Communist Party’s congress in November, the new leadership was tasked with plotting the country’s path for the next ten years, which entails modernizing China’s social, political, and economic systems within the constraints of its history and changing geopolitical context.

zh: 无论以何种标准衡量，用雄心勃勃来形容中国的改革目标都毫不过分 — — 尤其是考虑到冷漠而脆弱的外部环境。
en: By any standards, the reform agenda is ambitious – especially given a fragile and unaccommodating external environment.

zh: 今后十年，中国领导人必须设计并贯彻改革来打击腐败；通过放开户口管制支持城市化；推动技术创新；平衡经济增长点；提高环境和劳工标准；建立包括医疗、教育和社会保障在内的全国社会保障体系。
en: Within the next decade, China’s leaders must design and implement reforms to combat corruption; support migration to cities (such as liberalizing the house-registration system); promote technological innovation; rebalance sources of economic growth; raise environmental and labor standards; and build the country’s social-welfare system, including health care, education, and social security.

zh: 为确保实现可持续发展，设计制度时必须考虑到纳西姆•塔勒布提出的所谓罕见的“黑天鹅”事件。 全球经济危机爆发证明“黑天鹅”事件的确会发生，并造成灾难性后果。
en: To ensure a system’s sustainability, its design must account for what Nassim N. Taleb called rare “black swan” events – which, as the global economic crisis demonstrated, do occur, with devastating consequences.

zh: 但仅有增强系统“弹性”或“活力”的措施是远远不够的。
en: But measures to make systems more “resilient” or “robust” would be incomplete.

zh: 系统不仅应该能够承受波动，还应该在压力和混乱中不断成熟。
en: They should not only be able to withstand volatility; they should be primed to profit from stress and chaos.

zh: 塔勒布发明的“抗脆弱性”一词，是形容在本质上不确定、波动和无序的环境中可以不断自我完善的系统。
en: Recently, Taleb coined the term “antifragile” to describe a system that benefits from inherent uncertainty, volatility, and disorder.

zh: 他指出，尽管僵硬的系统看似更稳定，但却无法经受住意外的冲击，因而从长远来看其实很脆弱。
en: He pointed out that, while rigid systems may seem more stable, they are not equipped to cope with unexpected shocks, making them fragile in the long run.

zh: 相反，经常性的局部及临时波动会迫使系统变得更加灵活高效，从而获得在压力下实现繁荣昌盛的能力。
en: By contrast, frequent exposure to localized, temporary volatility forces systems to become more dynamic and flexible, enhancing their capacity to thrive under pressure.

zh: 有鉴于此，与其为追求效率最大化而将结构推向极限，还不如在系统中事先留出弹性空间（以多种方式体现出同样的功能 ） 。
en: Given this, rather than allowing demands for maximum efficiency to push structures to their limits, redundancies (equivalent capabilities implemented in multiple ways) should be built into systems.

zh: 上述低成本的措施不仅能够逐渐培育出长期的抗脆弱能力，同时能够获得足以��补黑天鹅事件的正面收益。
en: These low-cost measures nurture long-term antifragility, while capturing future upside gains that could compensate for black swan events.

zh: 抗脆弱性对中国这样的大国至关重要，因为中央政府行政权力相对集中，但日常活动主体却分散在家庭、民间团体、市场和各级地方政府。
en: Antifragility is crucial in large economies like China, where administration is largely centralized, but activities are dispersed among families, civil society, markets, and the various levels of government.

zh: 中国最大的挑战在于平衡以家庭为主体的分治传统和集权的中央政府这两者的关系，进而孕育出根植于中国文化中的那种抗脆弱能力。
en: China’s greatest challenge lies in balancing its decentralized, family-based traditions with its centralized governance, thereby developing in its institutions the kind of antifragility that is already present in its culture.

zh: 在不断的改朝换代、内部衰退和外族入侵的漫漫历史上，中国一直在努力平衡中央集权与地方分治 — — 也就是控制与动荡之间的关系。
en: China has been struggling to balance centralization and fragmentation – that is, control and uncertainty – throughout its long history of rising and falling dynasties, domestic decay, and foreign invasion.

zh: 尽管任人唯才的公开选拔“学者型官员”的制度（学而优则仕）帮助中国封闭的帝国王朝治理结构延续了两千多年，但随着帝国人口随领土扩张从1.5亿猛增到4.5亿，这种选拔制度终究无法抵消清王朝体制暴露出来的日益明显的脆弱特征。
en: While the open, meritocratic selection of “scholar-officials” helped to sustain China’s closed dynastic governance structure for more than 2,000 years, it could not offset the system’s growing fragility under the Qing Dynasty, as territorial gains increased the empire’s population from 150 million to 450 million.

zh: 由于腐败猖獗、社会动荡以及无力抵御现代西方列强，清王朝以及全世界历史最悠久的官僚制度最终于1912年彻底崩溃。
en: Rampant corruption, rising social unrest, and the inability to resist modern Western powers ultimately caused the dynasty, and the world’s longest-lasting bureaucracy, to crumble in 1912.

zh: 随后成立的中华民国国民政府同样未能缓和中央集权和地方分治之间的矛盾 — — 这就是宏观历史学家黄仁宇（Ray Huang）所谓的中国无法实现“数目字管理 ” 。
en: The nationalist government that followed, which established the Republic of China, also failed to address the tension between centralization and fragmentation – what the macro-historian Ray Huang called China’s “mathematical unmanageability.”

zh: 事实上，中国从未发展出精英政府治理下以家庭为主体的农业经济所需的产权基础设施和货币财政政策。
en: Indeed, it never developed the property-rights infrastructure or the monetary and fiscal policies needed in a family-dominated agrarian economy with an elite-run government.

zh: 通过有效执行产权并落实国家政策，中国共产党成为连接整合政党精英和广大群众的制度体系。
en: By effectively enforcing property rights and implementing national policy, the Chinese Communist Party became the institutional mechanism that bridged the divide between the elites (the Party) and the masses.

zh: 但是1958年至1961年，大跃进，也就是毛泽东为实现中国经济工业化和集体化的政治运动，导致了过度的中央计划及体制性脆弱。
en: But, in 1958-1961, excessive central planning to support the Great Leap Forward (Mao Zedong’s intensive campaign to industrialize and collectivize China’s economy) generated systemic fragility.

zh: 1978年形势才开始好转，邓小平推行以市场为导向的改革和开放政策，为中国带来了经济增长和就业的全新机遇，即通过所谓“四个现代化”来加强农业、工业、国防和科学技术等关键领域。
en: The situation began to improve in 1978, when Deng Xiaoping began to implement market-oriented reforms and open up the economy, giving China access to new opportunities for economic growth and employment. Through the so-called Four Modernizations, the crucial sectors of agriculture, industry, national defense, and science and technology were strengthened.

zh: 20世纪90年代，其他东亚经济体为追求效率而开放其资本账户的时候，中国还没有放松对金融体系的管制。
en: At the same time, China was slow to open up its financial system – even as other East Asian economies pursued efficiency by liberalizing their capital accounts in the 1990’s.

zh: 结果1997年亚洲金融危机来袭时，中国幸免于难，而其邻国受到强烈冲击、显示出其脆弱性。
en: As a result, when the Asian financial crisis struck in 1997, China was insulated from the volatility that ravaged its fragile neighbors.

zh: 中国将这次危机当契机，及时推动加入世贸组织、金融系统和国有企业 改革、大型银行上市、及公务员住房私有化等制度改革。
en: In fact, the crisis became an opportunity, prompting China to join the World Trade Organization, implement reforms of its financial system and state-owned enterprises (SOEs), list major banks publicly, and privatize civil-service housing.

zh: 但中国许多抗脆弱性改革并不够彻底，没有达到标本兼治。
en: But many of China’s antifragile measures have been piecemeal and incomplete.

zh: 比方说，由于既得利益集团反对进一步推进民营化和市场化，国企改革仍停留在理论探讨层面。
en: The need to overhaul SOEs, for example, remains on the agenda, owing to the power of vested interests that oppose further privatization and market-based reforms.

zh: 中国领导人现在必须确定采取抗脆弱性改革的具体领域，同时谨慎推进必要的改革。
en: China’s leaders now must identify the specific areas in which to build antifragility, and approach the required reforms prudently.

zh: 在确保全面改革的同时，他们还必须避免动作过大过快而引发的既得利益者抵抗，或者无意间引发危险的连锁反应。
en: While they must ensure that reforms are comprehensive, they also must avoid attempting too much too fast, which could trigger resistance from deeply entrenched players or unintentionally trigger dangerous chain reactions.

zh: 幸运的是，中国相对强劲的财政和外汇状况可以缓解对经济的短期冲击。
en: Fortunately, China’s relatively strong fiscal and foreign-exchange positions can cushion the economy against short-term shocks.

zh: 而且，尽管腐败导致一定的脆弱性，中国的官僚机构仍有不错的政策执行落实能力。
en: And, notwithstanding corruption-induced fragility, the bureaucracy’s capacity to implement policy is sound.

zh: 关键是如何界定党、政府、市场和民间团体的作用和职责。
en: A major challenge will be delineating the roles and responsibilities of the Party, the state, the market, and civil society.

zh: 鉴于政府历史上显示出的干预市场及社会的能力，危机发生时，中国的上下阶层往往默认应依赖政府措施而非市场力量来应对，而不是容忍市场自身无序的自查自纠。
en: Given the government’s proven capacity to intervene, the default option during a crisis has been to rely on administrative measures rather than on market forces.

zh: 要利用市场的抗脆弱能力，从中央到地方的各级行政机构以及国有企业都需要对市场抱有更多的信心。
en: To allow disorderly self-correction by markets would require confidence at all levels of governance, from the central government to village administrations, and among SOEs.

zh: 此外，中国必须在司法、民间团体和媒体范围内建设更充分的制度及功能，以实现法治，以强化长期抗脆弱能力。
en: Moreover, China’s leaders must build sufficient institutional power within the judiciary, civil society, and the media to implement the rule of law and enhance long-term antifragility.

zh: 这需要防止行政权力滥用，为国企和其他企业创造公平的竞争环境，并实现监管者与被监管者的彻底分离。
en: This entails preventing administrative abuses, establishing a level playing field for SOEs and other companies, and divorcing regulators from regulated entities.

zh: 随着跨部门结构改革的进行，中国领导人有机会构筑国家长期繁荣的基石。
en: As they undertake structural reforms across multiple sectors, China’s leaders have the opportunity to bolster their country’s long-term prosperity.

zh: 但成功需要在维持系统稳定和允许中国这个庞大经济体不断适应及成长之间保持平衡 — — 这正是中国几百年以来面临的巨大挑战。
en: But success will require striking a balance between maintaining systemic stability and allowing the country’s massive economy to adapt and grow – a challenge with which China has struggled for centuries.

zh: 中国的反分裂国家法自食其果
en: China's Anti-Secession Law Boomerangs

zh: 中国形同虚设的全国人大通过任何法律都只不过是走走过场。
en: The passage of any law by China’s rubber-stamp National People’s Congress is always a mere formality.

zh: 但事实证明，引起争议的反分裂法却非例行公事。
en: But the controversial legislation to outlaw Taiwanese secession has proved anything but routine.

zh: 这项法律提高了岛内台独阵营的赌注，增加了海峡两岸发生军事冲突的风险。
en: It raised the stakes for the island’s pro-independence camp and increased the risk of a cross-Strait military conflict.

zh: 矛盾的是，反分裂法模棱两可的语言和极力软化的措辞 — — 或许是为了平息外国舆论 — — 不但没有降低，反而增加了中美两国违背意愿地卷入一场不可避免的军事冲突的可能性。
en: The anti-secession law’s vague language and attempt at softened wording – perhaps geared toward mollifying foreign critics – paradoxically increases rather than decreases the likelihood that China and the United States could be unwittingly and unwillingly drawn into an avoidable military conflict.

zh: 由于没有明确说明台湾假定或潜在的“红线 ” ， 这项法律既有可能导致严重的错误估计或误解。
en: By failing to clearly delineate presumed or potential “red lines” for Taiwan, the law leaves open the possibility of substantial miscalculation or misinterpretation.

zh: 尽管几周来美国大力施压，企图软化 — — 甚至阻止 — — 这项法案，中国的领导人们却无动于衷，仅仅是重申了他们的立场，即绝不承诺放弃“非和平 ” （ 即军事化）手段 — — 反正人们早就知道。
en: Despite several weeks of intense US pressure to soften - or even retract - the proposed law, China’s leaders did little more than attempt to reinforce their position that “non-peaceful” (i.e., military) measures would serve strictly as a last resort - which had already been assumed anyway.

zh: 布什政府的反应异常生硬，呼吁“北京重新考虑是否通过这项法律 ” — —在中国看来，这是对内政相当直接的干涉。
en: The Bush administration’s reaction was uncharacteristically blunt, with its call for “Beijing to reconsider the passage of the law'” – a rather directly worded intrusion into what China considers to be an internal matter.

zh: 陈水扁和他领导的执政党民进党（简称DPP）在2004年12月台湾立法选举中出人意料的失败，加上台独阵营未能获得立法院的大多数席位，被看作是与大陆关系的积极进展。
en: Taiwan’s December 2004 legislative elections had delivered an unexpected defeat for Chen and his ruling Democratic Progressive Party, or DPP, and the pro-independence camp’s failure to secure a legislative majority was seen as a positive development for relations with the mainland.

zh: 的确，2005年初两岸联系有所好转，包括春节包机计划的成功实行。
en: Indeed, the start of 2005 saw some movement on improved ties, with the introduction of a hugely successful lunar new year charter-flights program.

zh: 这样本可深入讨论建立永久性的直飞航线，以推动双边贸易。
en: This gave rise to serious discussion about instituting permanent direct air links to aid bilateral trade flow.

zh: 现在，在反分裂法的余波下，未来的包机计划前景不妙。
en: Now, in the aftermath of the anti-secession law, the future of the charter-flights scheme looks bleak.

zh: 台湾的民意调查反映出民众对中国立法的不安。 这种消极的情绪将增加陈总统身上的压力，况且他最近因为向泛蓝反对派亲民党示好而招致了更加激进的支持者的不满。
en: Opinion polls in Taiwan reflect public dismay over the Chinese legislation, and this negative sentiment will raise the pressure on President Chen, who recently antagonized some of his more ardent pro-independence supporters by reaching out to the pro-unification opposition People First Party.

zh: 台湾《中国时报》进行的一场调查发现，接受调查的人中有56%对反分裂法不满，47%称台湾应该进行反击，对此问题举行全民投票，或者制定自己的反立法。
en: A survey by Taiwan’s China Times found that 56% of those polled resented the anti-secession law, with 47% saying that Taiwan should retaliate by either holding a public referendum on the issue or introducing counter-legislation of its own.

zh: 现在，很多人担心所谓的深绿派 — — 台独泛绿阵营中的激进派 — — 将抓住这件事作为打击陈总统的大棒。
en: There are now serious concerns that the so-called dark greens – the harder-line faction in Taiwan’s pro-independence pan-green political camp – will seize this issue as a stick with which to beat President Chen.

zh: 正如民进党立委萧美琴最近所言，反分裂法“会让我们很难成为温和派 ” 。
en: As DPP legislator Hsiao Bi-khim recently said, the anti-secession law “will make it very hard for us to be moderates”.

zh: 反分裂法还有一点更加让人沮丧，即它是完全不必要的挑衅。
en: One of the more frustrating elements of the anti-secession law is the fact that it is an entirely unnecessary provocation.

zh: 西藏和新疆没有批准军队镇压分裂主义活动的法律，但中国政府从来没有停止野蛮地迫害那里要求独立的个人和群体。
en: The absence of laws mandating force to block separatist activity has never stopped Chinese authorities from brutally persecuting individuals and groups who have called for an independent Tibet or Xinjiang.

zh: 因此，我们没理由相信在应付台北的“分裂主义”政府时有必要以更加明确的方式表明立场。
en: There is thus little reason to believe that a more explicitly assertive stance is necessary for dealing with the “splittist” government in Taipei.

zh: 在此以前，导弹试验、解放军军事演习和威胁性的措辞一直是有效的威慑手段。
en: Missile tests, PLA military exercises and threatening rhetoric have been sufficient deterrents until now.

zh: 大陆官方用政策明朗化和建立入侵台湾的法律前提来为此辩护。
en: Mainland officials justify the law in terms of clarifying their policy and establishing a legal premise for invading the island.

zh: 然而实际上，法律基础的构筑可能会削弱中国政府在回应台湾人的分裂举动时的战术灵活性。
en: In practice, however, the construction of legal foundations could weaken the Chinese government’s operational flexibility when responding to a Taiwanese move toward independence.

zh: 这项法律出乎预料的后果说明这种在对待台湾活动分子的态度上拒绝含糊其辞的做法可能后院起火，一旦台湾企图改变现状，大陆领导人将没有回旋的余地。
en: The law of unintended consequences dictates that this effort to deny ambiguity to Taiwanese activists could backfire, and instead leave mainland leaders without room to maneuver if Taiwan does attempt to revise the status quo.

zh: 这意味着胡锦涛政府很可能自缚双手，无法寻求某种妥协方案，来解决目前这个已经充满麻烦和复杂性，而且随着时间的流逝，根本没有迹象会变得容易解决的状况。
en: This means that the Hu Jintao administration could well have its hands tied, and find itself unable to pursue some kind of compromise solution to a situation that is already fraught with nuance and complexity, and which shows no sign of getting easier to manage with the passage of time.

zh: 尽管彻底的军事冲突仍不太可能，中国含糊其辞的“红线”和不明确的威胁肯定会增加双方错误估计和误解的可能性。
en: While outright military conflict is still considered unlikely, the combination of China’s vague “red lines” and non-specific threats will certainly raise the likelihood of miscalculation and misinterpretation on both sides.

zh: 在更大范围上，对那些对近年来表面上老练巧妙的中国外交留下了深刻印象的人来说，反分裂法的建立本身将使他们大感失望。
en: More broadly, the fact that the anti-secession law was introduced at all comes as a major disappointment to those who had been impressed by the apparent sophistication and skillfulness of recent Chinese diplomacy.

zh: 反分裂法的制定发生在中国笨手笨脚地罢免香港特首董建华的同一周，说明大陆的公关才能是有限的，也说明台湾仍将是中美关系上一个敏感而不和谐的棘手问题。
en: Coming in the same week as China’s poorly handled removal of Tung Chee-hwa as Hong Kong’s Chief Executive, the anti-secession law episode illustrates that the mainland’s PR savvy has its limits and that Taiwan will remain an emotional and divisive thorn in the side of Sino-US relations.

zh: 新失踪者
en: The New Disappeared

zh: 纽约—从20世纪七八十年代统治阿根廷和智利的军政府，到苏联的斯大林铁腕政权，独裁向来擅长让批评者“消失 ” 。
en: NEW YORK – From the military juntas that ruled Argentina and Chile in the 1970s and 1980s to Joseph Stalin’s iron-fisted regime in the Soviet Union, dictatorships have a long history of making their detractors “disappear.”

zh: 今天，这种犯罪行为似乎卷土重来。
en: Today, this sinister practice seems to be making a comeback.

zh: 在智利或阿根廷的军事政权下，你可能会从直升机上扔下海，尸骨无存。
en: Under the military regimes in Chile or Argentina, a person might be tossed into the sea from a helicopter, never to be found.

zh: 你可能先被杀，然后又被烧得面目全非或被石灰毁容，加快你的分解速度，埋在没有标记的野坟。
en: They might be killed and then burned beyond recognition or coated in lime, to accelerate decomposition, and buried in an unmarked grave.

zh: 在斯大林的苏联，你可能随时会被抓起来，带到卢比扬卡（克格勃总部）或其他地狱设施，共产党员尤其容易被抓，数百万苏联公民在监狱或古拉格中永远地消失了。
en: In Stalin’s Soviet Union, someone could be picked up and taken to the Lubyanka (the KGB headquarters) or some other nightmarish facility at any moment. During the purges of the 1930s and later, members of the Communist Party were particularly vulnerable, and millions of Soviet citizens disappeared forever in prisons or the gulag.

zh: 如今，现代极权主义者正在复活这些行径，突然间秘密抓捕人民，包括知名人士和高级官员，把他们关押起来或更加糟糕。
