en: Today, modern authoritarians are reviving such behavior, suddenly and covertly snatching people, including well-known figures and high-ranking officials, to be detained or worse.

zh: 在许多例子中 ， “ 失踪者”最后还是现身了，但对待过去的工作或羁押他们的政府的态度来了个一百八十度大转弯。
en: In many cases, the “vanished” do eventually resurface, but with an apparently transformed perspective on their past work or the government that detained them.

zh: 在这方面，中国和沙特阿拉伯堪称杰出 — — 尽管它们绝不是“孤家寡人 ” — —组织了一系列日益厚颜无耻的绑架或让批评者失踪。
en: Here, China and Saudi Arabia stand out – though they are by no means alone – for orchestrating a series of increasingly brazen abductions or vanishings of their detractors.

zh: 上个月，国际刑警组织主席孟宏伟在从该组织总部巴黎前往北京途中消失。 中国是幕后之手，孟宏伟同时也是中国公安部副部长。
en: China was behind last month’s disappearance of Interpol President Meng Hongwei on a trip from France, where Interpol is based, to Beijing, where he also served as vice minister of public security.

zh: 孟宏伟被抓尤其令人震惊，因为很多中国人为他在2016年被任命为国际刑警组织最高职位而欢呼雀跃 — — 他是第一位担任主要国际组织最高职务的中国公民 — — 认为这是中国终于步入国际秩序顶层的信号。
en: Meng’s abduction was particularly shocking, because many Chinese trumpeted his 2016 appointment to Interpol’s highest post – which made him the first Chinese citizen to lead a major global institution – as a sign that the country had finally arrived at the top tier of the international order.

zh: 但中国国家主席习近平甘愿放弃这一公共关系胜利。
en: Yet Chinese President Xi Jinping was willing simply to throw away that public relations victory.

zh: 最终，中国宣布孟宏伟被捕，正在接受贪污受贿调查。
en: Eventually, it was announced that Meng had been detained and was being investigated for bribery.

zh: 这一决定被称为中国反腐运动的一部分 — — 批评者说这是为了掩盖习近平清除对他不忠的政治人物的运动 — — 根本无视、甚至蔑视全世界的看法。
en: The decision, justified as part of China’s ongoing anti-corruption campaign – an endeavor that critics say is a cover for eliminating political figures disloyal to Xi – revealed an utter lack of regard, or even contempt, for world opinion.

zh: 事实上，习近平可以说是连环绑架者。
en: In fact, Xi is something of a serial kidnapper.

zh: 自2012年上台以来，各种各样的人 — — 从香港小书商（包括一些非中国公民）到中国子夜领袖 — — 被秘密绑架并抓回中国。
en: Since he came to power in 2012, all sorts of people – from small-scale book publishers in Hong Kong (including some holders of non-Chinese citizenship) to Chinese business leaders – have been covertly kidnapped and returned to China.

zh: 在经过相当长一段时间的静默或隔离后，他们现身宣布放弃此前的事业。
en: After a long period of silence and seclusion, they emerged to renounce their past work.

zh: 中国最红电影明星范冰冰就是如此，她从去年7月开始消失，同时，她以往非常活跃的新浪微博账户突然不再更新。
en: That is what happened to Fan Bingbing, China’s biggest movie star, who disappeared last July, when her previously very active account on the Sina Weibo social media platform (China’s answer to Twitter) suddenly went silent.

zh: 没人知道发生了什么。 但人们都知道政府正在做些什么，与她签订代言协议的企业纷纷中止合作。
en: No one knew what happened, but it was assumed that the government had something to do with it, and businesses with which she had spokesperson deals cut ties with her.

zh: 最后，范冰冰在本月早些时候重新现身，发表了一封卑微的道歉信，反省了自己的逃税行为，并将面临巨额罚款。
en: Finally, Fan resurfaced earlier this month, issuing a groveling apology for having evaded taxes, for which she will now face massive fines.

zh: 值得注意的是，她的声明充满了对中国共产党的赞美，说自己身为演员所取得的成功都要感谢党。
en: Tellingly, her statement included plenty of praise for the Communist Party of China, which she credited for her success as an actress.

zh: 这再令人熟悉不过，让人们想起了斯大林大清洗时代的苏共党报《真理报》编辑布哈林（Nikolai Bukharin）以及其他人的可怜的自白书。
en: It was all depressingly familiar, recalling as it did the pathetic confessions of Nikolai Bukharin, the editor of the Communist Party newspaper Pravda, and others during Stalin’s purges.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯也执行过一系列出于政治动机的高规格绑架。
en: Saudi Arabia has also executed a series of high-profile, politically motivated kidnappings.

zh: 去年，沙特阿拉伯王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（Mohammed bin Salman）下令拘捕正在对利雅得进行正式访问的黎巴嫩总理哈里里。
en: Last year, Saudi Arabia’s Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman ordered the detention of Lebanese Prime Minister Saad Hariri, who was on an official visit to Riyadh.

zh: 哈里里被隔离，即使他的保镖也无法接近他，并被迫辞职。
en: Hariri was isolated even from his bodyguards and forced to resign.

zh: 几周后，显然是抓捕者的要求得到了满足，他被允许返回黎巴嫩继续行驶当选领导人的角色。
en: Weeks later, and evidently enlightened to his captors’ satisfaction, he was permitted to return to Lebanon and resume his role as its elected leader.

zh: 接着，在上周，流亡沙特记者贾马尔·哈绍吉（Jamal Khashoggi）在来到沙特阿拉伯驻伊斯坦布尔领事馆办理离婚文件，以便在第二天与一位土耳其妇女结婚时失踪。
en: Then, last week, Jamal Khashoggi, an exiled Saudi journalist, vanished after entering Saudi Arabia’s consulate in Istanbul to obtain a document confirming his divorce, so that he could marry a Turkish woman the next day.

zh: 他的未婚妻一直等在领事馆门口；他再也没有出现。
en: His fiancée waited at the consulate’s entrance; he never reemerged.

zh: 哈绍吉的消失进一步表明，当今的极权主义者为了令批评者噤声，丝毫不把国家边界放在眼里。
en: Khashoggi’s disappearance is further evidence of how little regard today’s authoritarians have for national borders when it comes to silencing their detractors.

zh: 哈绍吉身上到底发生了什么仍然不得而知，但总统埃尔多安领导下的土耳其政府坚称他在领事馆内被杀。
en: Precisely what happened to Khashoggi is still unknown, but Turkey’s government, led by President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, has insisted that he was killed while in the consulate.

zh: 据土耳其当局的说法，在哈绍吉的预约日，两队共15人从利雅得飞到伊斯坦布尔，并在几小时内离开。
en: According to the Turkish authorities, two teams, totaling 15 people, flew from Riyadh to Istanbul on the day of Khashoggi’s appointment and left within hours.

zh: 俄罗斯人对这一幕也很熟悉：斯大林也有特别刺杀小队，其中之一在墨西哥杀害了他的劲敌莱昂·托洛茨基（Leon Trotsky ） 。
en: This, too, is grimly familiar to Russians: Stalin also had special assassination teams, one of which carried out the murder in Mexico of his archenemy, Leon Trotsky.

zh: 毫不奇怪，沙特人否认有任何过错。
en: Unsurprisingly, the Saudis have denied any wrongdoing.

zh: 他们说，哈绍吉离开了领事馆。
en: Khashoggi, they claim, left the consulate.

zh: 俄罗斯对于政府实施的消失的体验不仅限于过去。
en: Russia’s own experience with government-orchestrated disappearances is not limited to the past.

zh: 总统普京政权也以在外国对批评者定点清除而闻名，如今年3月在英国用神经毒素攻击前俄罗斯间谍谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔（Sergei Skripal）和他的女儿尤利娅（Yulia ） 。
en: President Vladimir Putin’s regime has also been known to target detractors for elimination on foreign soil, as allegedly happened with the nerve-agent attack on the former Russian spy Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia in the United Kingdom in March.

zh: 问题在于独裁者为了让反对者噤声而不顾国界和主权是否得不偿失。
en: The question is whether autocrats’ contempt for borders or sovereignty in silencing opponents is worth the cost.

zh: 再度爱不分西方国家，普京遭人唾弃，习近平也信誉扫地，而穆罕默德王储作为改革家的名声也大大受损，或许已经无法修复。
en: In the majority of the Western world, Putin is regarded as an outcast, Xi is flirting with a similar loss of credibility, and Prince Mohammed’s reputation as a reformer has been severely damaged, perhaps beyond repair.

zh: 他们可能很快就将面临拿破仑的警察主管约瑟夫·富歇（Joseph Fouché）在昂吉安公爵被诱捕和妆模作样的审判后的觉醒 ： “ 这比犯罪还要糟糕；这是一个错误。 ”
en: All of them may soon face a realization like that of Joseph Fouché, Napoleon’s police chief, after the abduction and sham trial of the Duke of Enghien: “It was worse than a crime; it was a mistake.”

zh: 中国的婴儿脚步
en: China’s Baby Step

zh: 中国在货币升值方面迈出了细小的第一步，无论最终会产生什么样的经济影响，都让人对其卓越的谋略感到佩服。
en: Whatever the ultimate economic effects of China’s first modest step towards floating its currency, one has to admire its strategic brilliance.

zh: 中国这个小小的动作（允许人民币对美元升值2 % ） 聪明就聪明在没有人知道接下来在什么时候会发生什么。
en: The genius of China’s mini-move (allowing the Yuan to rise 2% against the dollar) is that no one can tell when or what is going to happen next.

zh: 美国和欧洲那些恨不得对中国货物征收惩罚性巨额关税的贸易保护主义者们被打了个措手不及。
en: Protectionists in the United States and Europe, itching to slap huge punitive tariffs on Chinese goods, have been caught flat-footed.

zh: 他们想继续泡在媒体舆论中，但如果这些贸易保护主义者在对中国的责难中走得太远太快，人们就会觉得他们妨碍了微妙的幕后谈判。
en: They want to keep bathing in press coverage, but if they push their China-bashing too far and too fast, the protectionists will be seen as hindering delicate behind-the-scenes negotiations.

zh: 但是没有人知道中国的婴儿脚步是不是更有力措施的前奏，而中国的领导人前一天还在这样暗示，第二天又予以否认。
en: But no one knows whether China’s baby step is the start of something much bigger, as China’s authorities hint one day and deny the next.

zh: 面对严峻的国际压力，中国领导人稍微让了一小步，重新调整了人民币的汇率，于是巧妙地堵住了越来越多的人要求他们管制贸易顺差增长的呼声。
en: By relenting just a little to intense global pressure to revalue its exchange rate, the Chinese leadership has masterfully stifled the growing chorus of demands to rein in its growing trade surplus.

zh: 然而关键的问题仍然是中国是否正在以自身为代价抵抗市场的力量。
en: The key question, however, remains whether China is defying market forces at its own risk.

zh: 至少从表面上看，汇率的微调似乎还没有削弱中国按照自己的意愿操纵外汇市场的能力。
en: On the surface, at least, the mini-revaluation hardly seems to have compromised China’s ability to bend exchange markets to its will.

zh: 外国专家曾警告说，人民币略微升值还不如不升。
en: Foreign experts had warned that a small Yuan appreciation might be worse than none.

zh: 小幅度的升值不但不能缓解全球贸易的不平衡，而且会导致外国资金大量涌入，摧毁中国的货币防卫机制，引起混乱。
en: While hardly denting global trade imbalances, a small move would bring in a flood of foreign capital, overwhelming China’s currency defenses and leading to chaos.

zh: 迄今为止，这种情况还没有发生，中国的我行我素似乎再次证明专家们的错误。
en: So far, that has not happened and, China once again seems to have gone its own way and proved the experts wrong.

zh: 但暂且不要鼓掌。
en: But hold the applause.

zh: 或许投机性资金涌入的情况最终会发生，只不过较慢而已。
en: Perhaps the speculative-inflow scenario will play out, but in slow motion.

zh: 毕竟，中国不是投资者心跳一下就能拿到钱的国家。
en: After all, China is not a country where investors can just take their money in a heartbeat.

zh: 中国可以保住阵地，因为它实行的是世界上最严格的外汇与资金管制制度之一。
en: It can hold the fort because it maintains one of the world’s strictest regimes of exchange and capital controls.

zh: 许多拉美国家及前苏联国家实行类似的管制制度，然而违反的人比遵守的还多。 与这些国家不同的是，在中国，违反资金管制基本上算一项死罪。
en: Unlike many Latin American and former Soviet-bloc countries, where similar controls are honored mainly in the breach, violating capital controls in China is virtually a capital offense.

zh: 不过，倒退五十年，许多其他国家，包括法国和意大利，也曾实施过严格的管制制度，结果全都一样：最终，私有部门改变和腐蚀了管制的有效性。
en: But, over the past fifty years, when many other countries, including France and Italy, implemented draconian controls, the result was always the same: eventually, the private sector adapted and eroded the controls’ effectiveness.

zh: 不管是通过虚报进出口情况，还是利用腐败的政府官员（在这方面中国货源充足 ） ， 只要有足够的动力，私有资金最终会找到绕过管制的方法。
en: Whether by misreporting imports and exports or exploiting corrupt government officials (which China has in ample supply), private capital eventually starts finding its way around the controls if the incentives are strong enough.

zh: 因此，即使中国政府能够勉强保持资金管制制度不被大幅度削弱，随着全国金融体系日趋复杂化和非集权化，政府终将无法阻挡千疮百孔的管制制度消亡。
en: Thus, even if the Chinese authorities can somehow keep their capital controls from hemorrhaging as the country’s financial system becomes more sophisticated and decentralized, they will not be able to stop the controls from dying a death of a thousand cuts.

zh: 毕竟，中国只有通过亦步亦趋地追随美国的利率政策才能保持汇率固定不变，而这对于如此庞大且多样化的地区来说毫无意义。
en: After that, China will be able to keep its exchange rate pegged only by slavishly following US interest-rate policy, which makes no sense for such a large and diverse region.

zh: 更长远地看来，中国面临的最大问题在于某一天资金会向外流出。
en: Indeed, over the longer term, the biggest concern for China is that some day money will be trying to get out.

zh: 哪怕是中国海量的外汇储备也不足以阻止货币痛苦地贬值。
en: Even China’s vast reserves will not be enough to stave off a painful devaluation.

zh: 如果趁着货币受到升值压力的时候放弃固定汇率制，事情就要容易得多。
en: It is a lot easier to exit from a fixed exchange rate regime when the pressures on the currency are upwards.

zh: 虽然投机风潮转为不利于中国的情况似乎难以想象，汇率压力却可能在刹那间转向。
en: While it may seem hard to imagine that the speculative tide might ever turn against China, exchange-rate pressures can turn in an instant.

zh: 今天被人当作掌上明珠的货币，明天可能让人避之犹恐不及。
en: Today’s darling currency can be tomorrow’s dog.

zh: 考虑到中国巨大且不断扩大的收入差距，以及农村大规模的隐性失业现象，很容易想象政局不稳的那一天，投资者们会争先恐后地逃走。
en: Considering China’s huge and growing income inequalities, and its massive disguised rural unemployment, it is easy to imagine a period of political instability that sends investors heading for the exits.

zh: 再加上中国不牢固的金融体系，以及与别人 — — 如台湾 — — 发生争端之后可能出现的贸易制裁，很明显，人民币不一定总是只赚不亏的赌注。
en: Mix in China’s shaky financial system and the prospect of trade sanctions after an altercation over, say, Taiwan, and it is clear that the Yuan might not always be a one-way bet.

zh: 最后，但决非最不重要的是，为了维护共产党的合法性，中国政府需要不顾一切地追求超常的国家经济增长。
en: Last but not least, the Chinese authorities desperately need to maintain the country’s breakneck economic growth in order to preserve the Communist Party’s legitimacy.

zh: 然而随着经济生活越来越丰富，越来越复杂，中国将无可避免地遭遇内部信用分配的市场规则。
en: But, as the economy becomes richer and more complex, there will be no escaping the market imperative in internal credit allocation.

zh: 其他所有的新兴市场，即便是在亚洲，最终也都不得不跨过这道坎。
en: Every other emerging market, even in Asia, has eventually had to cross this bridge.

zh: 毫无疑问，追求金融自由化和维持增长是中等收入国家容易受金融危机影响的核心原因。
en: Indeed, the need to pursue financial liberalization to maintain growth is a central reason why middle-income countries are so prone to financial crises.

zh: 这就是为什么中国政府应该趁现在提高灵活性，而不要等到后来悔之晚矣。
en: That’s why Chinese authorities should move to greater flexibility now, and not wait until it is too late.

zh: 那么，近期内我们会看到中国更加强有力的货币调整吗？
en: So should we expect to see much bigger currency moves in China anytime soon?

zh: 我们会不会终有一天看到中国的汇率大幅度地上下浮动，就像平时看到的澳大利亚元和南非兰特那样？
en: Should we ever expect to see wild gyrations in China’s exchange rate of the sort one routinely sees in, say, the Australian dollar or the South African rand?

zh: 两种情况都不太可能。
en: Neither scenario is very likely.

zh: 只有狂热的自由市场鼓吹者才会要求极端自由的货币浮动，而他们似乎忘了，中国的金融体系基础不牢，经受不住一夜之间的自由化。
en: Only fire-breathing free-market advocates, seemingly oblivious to the fact that China’s shaky financial system cannot survive liberalization overnight, are calling for an extreme version of floating.

zh: 不过，在今后一年到一年半的时间里可能还会有更多的调整。
en: But there may well be a lot more to come over the next 12-18 months.

zh: 在人民币对美元汇率至少上升10%甚至更多之前，第一轮的调整不会结束。
en: The first round of Yuan revaluation won’t be over until the currency is up against the dollar by at least 10%, and probably more.

zh: 中国的首次货币调整是英明的，不过前提是这不是最后一次。
en: China’s first currency move was brilliant only if it is not the last.

zh: 中国的不良债务人
en: China’s Bad Debtor

zh: 发自北京 — — 在金融危机爆发之前，外界对中国经济不平衡 — — 表现为其财政与贸易的双盈余 — — 的批判主要集中在资源的错误配置上，这种错配表现为穷国以高利率向富国借款之余又以低利率向富国贷款。
en: BEIJING – Before the global financial crisis hit, critics of China’s economic imbalances – its twin fiscal and trade surpluses – mainly concentrated on the misallocation of resources that occurs when poor countries borrow from rich countries at high interest rates and lend the money to them at low interest rates.

zh: 而金融危机带给我们最大的讽刺就是目前的状况非但没有得到改善，反而更加恶化了。
en: The great irony of the financial crisis is that the situation has become worse, not better.

zh: 事实上，当前中国的外汇储备正承受着三重冲击击：美元购买力下降，美国政府债券价格下滑以及在未来一段长时期内的通胀可能性。
en: China’s foreign-exchange reserves, indeed, are facing a triple whammy: a decline in the US dollar’s purchasing power, a fall in the prices of US government securities, and possible inflation in the longer run.

zh: 中国持有2.3万亿的庞大外汇储备不是为了应付外部的冲击，而只是以美国国债的形式表现出来的储蓄。
en: The bulk of China’s $2.3 trillion in foreign reserves are held not for the purpose of protection against negative external shocks, but as savings in the form of US Treasury notes.

zh: 因此中国必须要让自身储蓄得以保值。
en: China thus needs to preserve the value of its savings.

zh: 但从长期来看，美元肯定会贬值 — — 这一进程早在2002年4月就已经启动，其间短暂中断之后又在2009年3月再度开启。
en: But there is no question whatsoever that the US dollar will go south in the long run – a depreciation that started in April 2002 and, after a short interval, resumed in March 2009.

zh: 如果美国经济无法改善其国际贸易收支的话，美元就肯定会贬值。
en: Unless the US economy improves its trade balance, the dollar will fall.

zh: 但如果美元不贬值，美国国际贸易收支状况又无法得到改善。
en: But the US cannot improve its trade balance unless the dollar falls.

zh: 可见用美元来衡量的中国外汇储备势必将不可避免地承受资本损失。
en: Measured by the dollar index, therefore, capital losses on China’s foreign exchange reserves are inevitable.

zh: 此外，考虑到美国庞大的预算赤字，美国政府在未来几年将大量发行政府债券。
en: Due to the huge US budget deficit, the supply of American government bonds will increase astronomically in the years ahead.

zh: 但是国外投资者（包括外国政府）对这种债券是否卖账则是未知之数。
en: But there is no guarantee that demand for these Treasury notes among foreign investors – including foreign governments – will be sufficient.

zh: 因此，在全球经济回复常态以及资本避难需求减少的情况下，美国政府债券的价格就会下滑，而该债案的收益率就会上升。
en: So it is very likely that when the global economy has returned to a sort of normality and safe-haven demand has declined, the prices of US government securities will fall and their yields will rise.

zh: 这样导致的结果是，以美元计价的中国外汇储备 — — 美国债券最大的海外持有者 — — 将要承受利率损失。
en: As a result, China’s dollar-denominated foreign-exchange reserves, which account for the largest share of all the foreign holdings of US government securities, will suffer interest-rate losses.

zh: 而且，美联储把年度通胀率定为4 % 。
en: Moreover, the US Federal Reserve is targeting a 4% annual inflation rate.

zh: 单单这一点就意味着，在正常情况下，中国的外汇储备每年都要自动贬值4 % 。
en: This alone means that under normal circumstances the purchasing power of China’s foreign-exchange reserves will automatically depreciate by 4% each year.

zh: 而自两年前美国次贷危机爆发后，美国出台了极度扩张性的货币政策。 在此政策下，无论是否存在通胀，中国的外汇储备都已经受到侵害。
en: Due to the extremely expansive US monetary policy that has been in place since the sub-prime crisis began two years ago, the real value of China’s foreign-exchange reserves has already been eroded, with or without inflation.

zh: 现在，中国就像一家公司的股东，而这家公司却暗中增加了自身股票的供应：因此虽然现在这家公司还维持着自身的股价，但总有一天会跌的。
en: China is like the shareholders of a company that has increased the supply of its shares in a stealthy way: the share price may not have fallen yet, but it will.

zh: 除非美联储成功地执行了一套从当前扩张性货币政策中退出的战略（这是相当令人怀疑的 ） ， 否则中国无法靠自身来讨回自己的损失 ， 。
en: Unless the Fed successfully implements an exit strategy from monetary expansion, which is doubtful, China will not be able to recover its losses.

zh: 另一个可能性较低但更具破坏性的局面则是所有被美联储主席本·伯南克投到美国经济中的货币最终将引发一波严重的通胀。
en: A less likely but more damaging scenario is that all the money dropped on the economy by US Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke will eventually stoke a bout of serious inflation.

zh: 如果这一噩梦成真的话，那中国以美国政府债券形式所拥有的储蓄（目前大约为价值9亿美元的美国国库券）将全部化为乌有。
en: If this nightmare comes true, China’s packed savings in the form of US government securities (which now amounts to some $900 million in Treasury bills alone) will simply go down the drain.

zh: 虽然留给中国政府调配其外汇储备的空间十分有限，但它也不应放弃捍卫其历尽艰辛挣回来的，又托付给了有信誉而且负责任的美国政府的财富的价值。
en: Despite China’s limited room for maneuver with regard to its stocks of foreign-exchange reserves, it should never give up its efforts to safeguard the value of its hard-earned wealth, which has been entrusted to the good will and supposedly responsible hands of the US government.

zh: 作为更具实力和更富经验的一方，美国有能力帮助中国减轻其对其国际储蓄安全的忧虑。
en: As the stronger and more experienced party, the US can help to allay China’s fears about the safety of its national savings.

zh: 比方说，美国政府可以发行更多诸如长期通货膨胀保值债券的金融工具，从而使中国能够把其手中持有的部分美国政府债券转换成与之类似，但更为安全的资产。
en: For example, the US government should offer more financial instruments like Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS), thereby allowing China to convert some of its holdings of US government securities into similar but safer assets.

zh: 另外，中国应该被允许把部分外汇储备换成以国际货币基金组织特别提款权来计价的资产。
en: Furthermore, China should be allowed to convert part of its foreign-exchange reserves into assets denominated in the International Monetary Fund’s special drawing rights (SDRs).

zh: 当然，中国也不应排除模仿国际货币基金组��特别提款权的构成来调整自身外汇储备结构的做法。
en: Of course, China should not rule out the possibility of adjusting the composition of its foreign-exchange reserves to mimic the composition of the SDR.

zh: 最后，如果美国政府不能保证其政府债券的价值，它就应该以某种形式来弥补中国为此承受的损失。
en: Finally, if the US government cannot safeguard the value its securities, it should compensate China in one way or another.

zh: 只有如此，中国和世界才能确定美国那种不负责任的态度 — — 表现为“美元是我们的货币，所产生的问题却是你们的 ” — —已经一去不复返了。
en: Only then can China and the world be certain that America’s irresponsible attitude – “the dollar is our currency, but your problem” – has become a thing of the past.

zh: 中国的赌博式恶性增长
en: China’s Bad Growth Bet

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 最近我先后两次踏足中国，恰逢政府启动“十二五计划”以重新调整其长期增长模式的时间点。
en: LONDON – I recently took two trips to China just as the government launched its 12th Five-Year Plan to rebalance the country’s long-term growth model.

zh: 而这两次访问使我更加深信：中国的短期和中期经济状况之间存在着可能影响稳定的潜在冲突性因素。
en: My visits deepened my view that there is a potentially destabilizing contradiction between China’s short- and medium-term economic performance.

zh: 中国经济目前已经过热，但再过一段时间，当前的过度投资将引发其国内乃至全球的通货紧缩。
en: China’s economy is overheating now, but, over time, its current overinvestment will prove deflationary both domestically and globally.

zh: 一旦不断增加的固定资产投资无以为继 — — 这很可能在2013年发生 — — 中国经济的发展就可能严重放缓。
en: Once increasing fixed investment becomes impossible – most likely after 2013 – China is poised for a sharp slowdown.

zh: 可见中国的政策制定者应当关注的不是如何确保在当前实现软着陆，而是经济发展可能在五年计划后半段严重受阻的问题。
en: Instead of focusing on securing a soft landing today, Chinese policymakers should be worrying about the brick wall that economic growth may hit in the second half of the quinquennium.

zh: 虽然新计划也像上一个五年计划那样宣称要增大消费占GDP的比例 — — 但对政府来说，政治阻力最小的做法依然是维持现状。
en: Despite the rhetoric of the new Five-Year Plan – which, like the previous one, aims to increase the share of consumption in GDP – the path of least resistance is the status quo.

zh: 公开发布的新计划细节也显示：经济的增长依然要仰仗投资（包括兴建公共住房）来支撑，而不是以实施更迅速的货币升值，面向家庭的大规模财政转移支付，税收和/或国有企业的私有化，解除户口制度限制以及放宽财政管制的方式来实现。
en: The new plan’s details reveal continued reliance on investment, including public housing, to support growth, rather than faster currency appreciation, substantial fiscal transfers to households, taxation and/or privatization of state-owned enterprises (SOEs), liberalization of the household registration (hukou) system, or an easing of financial repression.

zh: 过去几十年以来，中国都是靠以出口为导向的工业化和弱势货币来实现增长，并因此催生了极高的企业和家庭储蓄率，以及对净进口和固定资产投资（基础设施，房地产以及来料加工和出口部门的生产能力）的依赖。
en: China has grown for the last few decades on the back of export-led industrialization and a weak currency, which have resulted in high corporate and household savings rates and reliance on net exports and fixed investment (infrastructure, real estate, and industrial capacity for import-competing and export sectors).

zh: 当净出口金额从2008~2009年度的占GDP11%下降到5%的时候，中国领导人的应对措施就是将固定资产投资占GDP的比例从42%拉高到了47 % 。
en: When net exports collapsed in 2008-2009 from 11% of GDP to 5%, China’s leader reacted by further increasing the fixed-investment share of GDP from 42% to 47%.

zh: 凭借着爆发性的固定资产投资，中国得以摆脱了2009年日本，德国和亚洲新兴国家所遭遇的严重经济衰退。
en: Thus, China did not suffer a severe recession – as occurred in Japan, Germany, and elsewhere in emerging Asia in 2009 – only because fixed investment exploded.

zh: 但固定资产投资占国内GDP的比例也因此进一步上升到2010~2010年度的近50 % 。
en: And the fixed-investment share of GDP has increased further in 2010-2011, to almost 50%.

zh: 这就暴露出一个问题：任何国家都不可能拥有足够的发展速度，足以在将50%的GDP重新投资的情况下最终避免遭遇巨大的产能过剩和令人忧心的不良贷款问题。
en: The problem, of course, is that no country can be productive enough to reinvest 50% of GDP in new capital stock without eventually facing immense overcapacity and a staggering non-performing loan problem.

zh: 中国内部到处充斥着在实物资本，基础设施和不动产方面的过量投资。
en: China is rife with overinvestment in physical capital, infrastructure, and property.

zh: 在一个访问者眼中，证据就是那些光鲜靓丽却旅客寥寥的机场和高速列车（这将减少45个计划兴建中的机场的客流量 ） ， 通往偏僻之地的高速公路，数千座高大的中心城镇和地方政府建筑，空无一人的新城区，以及被迫关闭以避免引发全球价格下跌的崭新铝冶炼厂。
en: To a visitor, this is evident in sleek but empty airports and bullet trains (which will reduce the need for the 45 planned airports), highways to nowhere, thousands of colossal new central and provincial government buildings, ghost towns, and brand-new aluminum smelters kept closed to prevent global prices from plunging.

zh: 商业和高级住宅方面的投资早已过剩，汽车的产能即便在最近的销售热潮中也已经过量了，钢铁，水泥和其他制造部门的产能过剩问题也在不断恶化。
en: Commercial and high-end residential investment has been excessive, automobile capacity has outstripped even the recent surge in sales, and overcapacity in steel, cement, and other manufacturing sectors is increasing further.

zh: 在短期内，这场投资繁荣将刺激通货膨胀，这是源自于其高度资源密集型的增长特点。
en: In the short run, the investment boom will fuel inflation, owing to the highly resource-intensive character of growth.

zh: 但过剩的产能将无法避免地带来严重的通货紧缩压力，而制造业和房地产部门则首当其冲。
en: But overcapacity will lead inevitably to serious deflationary pressures, starting with the manufacturing and real-estate sectors.

zh: 中国大概会在2013年后遭遇一场硬着陆。
en: Eventually, most likely after 2013, China will suffer a hard landing.

zh: 事实上所有与过度投资有关的历史场景 — — 包括在1990年代的东亚地区所发生的一切 — — 都会以一场金融危机和/或长期的低增长来谢幕。
en: All historical episodes of excessive investment – including East Asia in the 1990’s – have ended with a financial crisis and/or a long period of slow growth.

zh: 如果要避免这一命运的话，中国需要降低储蓄率，减少固定资产投资，削减净出口占GDP的比例，并刺激消费所占的比重。
en: To avoid this fate, China needs to save less, reduce fixed investment, cut net exports as a share of GDP, and boost the share of consumption.

zh: 但问题是中国人之所以乐于储蓄而不愿消费，是有其结构性原因的。
en: The trouble is that the reasons the Chinese save so much and consume so little are structural.

zh: 而要扭转这一过度投资的诱因，可能需要整整20年的改革。
en: It will take two decades of reforms to change the incentive to overinvest.

zh: 对于高储蓄率的传统解释（缺乏社会安全网，有限的公共服务，人口老化，消费信贷的不发达）只是这一迷局的其中一部分。
en: Traditional explanations for the high savings rate (lack of a social safety net, limited public services, aging of the population, underdevelopment of consumer finance, etc.) are only part of the puzzle.

zh: 中国大陆地区的消费者并不比香港，新加坡和台湾等地的同胞更倾向于储蓄 — — 他们都同样会将大概30%的可支配收入存起来。
en: Chinese consumers do not have a greater propensity to save than Chinese in Hong Kong, Singapore, and Taiwan; they all save about 30% of disposable income.

zh: 但最大的区别在于家庭部门占中国GDP的比例小于50 % ， 因此也只给消费留下了一个很小的空间。
en: The big difference is that the share of China’s GDP going to the household sector is below 50%, leaving little for consumption.

zh: 中国实施的一系列政策都是将大量收入从政治上处于弱势的家庭转移到了强势的大企业手里。
en: Several Chinese policies have led to a massive transfer of income from politically weak households to politically powerful companies.

zh: 弱势的人民币使进口商品变得昂贵，降低了家庭购买力，却保护了那些出口型国企并增加了出口商的利润。
en: A weak currency reduces household purchasing power by making imports expensive, thereby protecting import-competing SOEs and boosting exporters’ profits.

zh: 面向家庭的低存款利率和面向企业和开发商的低贷款利率意味着千家万户的巨额储蓄实际上的是在赔钱，而国企的贷款成本却是负数。
en: Low interest rates on deposits and low lending rates for firms and developers mean that the household sector’s massive savings receive negative rates of return, while the real cost of borrowing for SOEs is also negative.

zh: 这就产生了一个强大的过度投资诱因并意味着从家庭向国企的大规模转移支付 — — 倘若这些企业以市场利率贷款的话肯定是要亏损的。
en: This creates a powerful incentive to overinvest and implies enormous redistribution from households to SOEs, most of which would be losing money if they had to borrow at market-equilibrium interest rates.

zh: 此外，对工人的压榨也导致工资上升的幅度远远低于生产力的增长速度。
en: Moreover, labor repression has caused wages to grow much more slowly than productivity.

zh: 如果要放宽对家庭收入的限制的话，中国必须让人民币更快地升值，放开利率管制，并大幅增加工资。
en: To ease the constraints on household income, China needs more rapid exchange-rate appreciation, liberalization of interest rates, and a much sharper increase in wage growth.

zh: 更重要的是，中国要么必须将其国企私有化，让这些企业的利润能转化为家庭收入，要么像这些企业征收更高的税收并将这些财政收入转移给家庭。
en: More importantly, China needs either to privatize its SOEs, so that their profits become income for households, or to tax their profits at a far higher rate and transfer the fiscal gains to households.

zh: 事实上，除家庭储蓄之外，企业部门（大部分为国企）的储蓄 — — 或者说保留利润 — — 已经占到了GDP的25 % 。
en: Instead, on top of household savings, the savings – or retained earnings – of the corporate sector, mostly SOEs, tie up another 25% of GDP.

zh: 但增加家庭占总收入比例的举措将产生极大的破坏效应，因为这会导致一大批国企，出口企业和地方政府破产，而这些又是在政治上很有权势的部门。
en: But boosting the share of income that goes to the household sector could be hugely disruptive, as it could bankrupt a large number of SOEs, export-oriented firms, and provincial governments, all of which are politically powerful.

zh: 最终导致的结果就是中国只能在这个五年计划中继续增加投资。
en: As a result, China will invest even more under the current Five-Year Plan.

zh: 继续沿着这条投资导向的道路走下去将使已经暴露出来的制造业，房地产和基础设施产能饱和现象进一步恶化，并将在固定资产投资增长无法继续扩大的情况下加剧未来的经济放缓。
en: Continuing down the investment-led growth path will exacerbate the visible glut of capacity in manufacturing, real estate, and infrastructure, and thus will intensify the coming economic slowdown once further fixed-investment growth becomes impossible.

zh: 但直到领导层在2012-2013年换届之前，中国的政策制定者们都将继续在罔顾巨额未来成本的情况下维持一个高增长率。
en: Until the change of political leadership in 2012-2013, China’s policymakers may be able to maintain high growth rates, but at a very high foreseeable cost.

zh: 中国的银行改革
en: China’s Banking Revolution

zh: 2007年世贸条约生效之前中国必须面对的最大挑战之一是为国内银行系统的民营化和与外国银行竞争做好准备。
en: One of the greatest challenges China must confront before the WTO treaty enters into force in 2007 is to prepare the country’s banking system for privatization and competition with foreign banks.

zh: 政府已经建立了一个新的机构，中央汇金投资公司，在大型国有银行被售之前进行管理和资产重组。
en: The government has established a new agency, Central Hujin Investment Company, to manage and re-capitalize big state-owned banks before they are sold.

zh: 汇金已经将600亿美元外汇储备注入中国银行、中国建设银行、以及工商银行。
en: Hujin has already injected $60 billion of China’s foreign-exchange reserves into the Bank of China, the China Construction Bank, and the Industrial and Commercial Bank.

zh: 农业银行也将需要新的资金，尽管政府还没有开始为其民营化做准备。
en: The Agricultural Bank will also require new capital, although the government is not yet preparing it for privatization.

zh: 政府的救援政策似乎正在起作用。
en: The government’s rescue policies appear to be working.

zh: 上两个月内，美国银行宣布斥资25亿美元购买中国建设银行9%的股份，新加坡控股公司淡马锡则宣布计划斥资14亿美元买进中国建设银行5.1%的股份。
en: During the past two months, Bank of America has announced a $2.5 billion investment in return for a 9% stake in the China Construction Bank, and The Singapore-based holding company Temasek paid $1.4bn for a 5.1% stake in China Construction Bank.

zh: 苏格兰皇家银行正率领一个投资集团打算向中国银行追加31亿美元的投资，同时高盛和德国安联也准备签约投资类似数额的资金收购工商银行9.9%的股份。
en: The Royal Bank of Scotland is leading an investment group that will invest $3.1 billion more in the Bank of China, while Goldman Sachs and Germany’s Allianz are close to an agreement to acquire a 9.9% stake in the Industrial and Commercial Bank for a similar sum.

zh: 政府希望通过这些外资为2006年银行在香港和其他地方的证券交易所上市做好准备，然而外国银行投资的目的却是要打入巨大的中国市场。
en: The government hopes that these foreign investments will set the stage for the banks to go public on stock exchanges in Hong Kong and elsewhere during 2006, whereas foreign banks are investing with an eye to penetrating the enormous Chinese market.

zh: 三大国有银行拥有广泛的支行网络，雇佣了数十万员工。
en: The big three state-owned banks have vast branch networks and employ hundreds of thousands of people.

zh: 没有本地合作伙伴，外国银行永远也别想实现如此全面的覆盖率。
en: Foreign banks could never hope to achieve such comprehensive coverage without a local partner.

zh: 外国银行开始会主要集中在信用卡等领域，不过也可以建立其他的合资企业。
en: They will focus initially on sectors such as credit cards but could develop other joint ventures.

zh: 汇丰银行也宣布向平安保险注入巨额投资，可能以次促进未来银行保险的实践。
en: HSBC also announced a major investment in Ping An Insurance, which could set the stage for experiments with Bancassurance in the future.

zh: 交通银行在吸纳汇丰的投资后不久即在香港股票市场上市，因此和那些还在等待民营化的银行相比，它能给市场提供更多资讯。
en: The Bank of Communications listed on the Hong Kong stock market shortly after the HSBC investment, so it has been able to provide the market with more information than have the banks that are still awaiting privatization.

zh: 高盛持乐观态度，认为这家银行今年能实现17%的贷款增长、20个基本点的盈余增长、以及大幅度的收费收入增长。
en: Goldman Sachs is bullish, believing that the bank can record 17% loan growth this year, a 20-basis-point improvement in margins, and significant growth in fee income.

zh: 然而，最大的忧患在于不断增加的不良贷款。
en: The major concern, however, is evidence of a growing volume of non-performing loans.

zh: 交通银行的业绩说明，中国2003和2004年的贷款高峰可能在今年和明年引发另一波坏账。
en: The Bank of Communications’ performance suggests that China’s lending boom of 2003 and 2004 could lead to another wave of defaults this year and next.

zh: 2004年，随着银行向巨幅增长的房地产开发和制造业放款，投资占GDP的比例上升到45 % — —这是有记录的金融史上最高的水平之一。
en: In 2004, the investment share of GDP rose to 45%—one of the highest levels in recorded financial history—as banks financed a huge expansion of property development and manufacturing capacity.

zh: 现在，最大的几家银行都声称不良房地产贷款数额大大增加，同时新的工业生产能力过剩，说明某些企业可能没有足够的利润偿还债务的利息。
en: Now, the largest banks are claiming significant increases in non-performing property loans, while the glut of new industrial capacity implies that some firms may not have adequate profits to service their debts.

zh: 尽管去年中国银行出于对信用质量的担心减缓放款，但许多新的地方银行却迅速提高了各自的放款量，随着经济增长的减速和企业偿债能力的减弱，它们可能蒙受巨大损失。
en: Alhough the Bank of China curtailed its lending growth to only 6% last year because of concerns about credit quality, many new local banks have expanded their lending aggressively, and could now suffer huge losses as the economy slows and firms’ solvency weakens.

zh: 在这样的情况下，民营化将对中国经济产生深远的影响。
en: In these circumstances, privatization will have profound consequences for China’s economy.

zh: 因为银行系统仍归国有，要响应政策压力，上次的资本投资狂潮引起了2003和2004年投机性放贷的爆发 — — 直到2004年4月政府实施了信用管理来防止不良贷款的飙升。
en: The recent capital-spending boom produced a burst of speculative lending in 2003 and 2004 because the banking system was still state-owned and responsive to political pressure—until the government itself imposed credit controls in April 2004 to prevent a sharp upsurge in non-performing loans.

zh: 在今后的商业循环中，中国的银行将自1949年以来首次归民间资本所有。
en: In the next business cycle, China’s banks will be privately owned for the first time since 1949.

zh: 它们将根据商业标准而不是与大型国有企业的关系来放贷。
en: They will make loans on the basis of commercial criteria rather than relations with big state-owned companies.

zh: 地方政府为发展项目的资金对它们施加的压力将会减弱。
en: They will be less vulnerable to political pressure from local governments to finance development projects.

zh: 它们很可能将更加重视消费贷款，特别是按揭和信用卡。
en: They are likely to place much greater emphasis on consumer lending, especially mortgages and credit cards.

zh: 由于中国的按揭贷款仅相当于GDP的10 % ， 远低于英美国家的60-70 % ， 因此增长的潜力非常巨大。
en: With China’s mortgage lending equal to only 10% of GDP, compared to 60-70% in the Anglo-Saxon countries, there is huge opportunity for growth.

zh: 中国银行系统的转变，加上最近调整人民币汇率的决策，要求在货币政策的实施上做出重大改变。
en: The transformation in China’s banking system, coupled with the recent decision to revalue China’s currency, will require major changes in the conduct of monetary policy.

zh: 直到不久以前，中国的货币政策还由固定汇率支配，利率在2004年10月前连续九年不变，因为政府企图通过行政指导和信用管理控制放款。
en: Until recently, an exchange-rate peg dominated China’s monetary policy, with interest rates unchanged for nine years until October 2004, as the government attempted to manage lending through administrative guidance and credit controls.

zh: 将来，中国必须更多地依靠利率来管理货币政策，利用资本价格而不是政治考虑来影响企业的投资决策。
en: In the future, China will have to rely more heavily on interest rates to manage monetary policy, using the price of capital, not political considerations, to influence how firms make investment decisions.

zh: 中国银行系统的转变因为涉及到根本性质的变化而异常复杂和艰难。
en: The transformation in China’s banking system is complex and difficult because it involves a change in its fundamental nature.

zh: 但是，除非经济上出现重大颠簸，否则，随着资金分配效率的提高，这些变化将产生正面的影响。
en: However, barring any major economic bumps, the changes will have a positive impact, as capital allocation becomes more efficient.

zh: 与2002至2004年放款增长期间相比，提高对家庭贷款的重视也会使资本支出和消费支出之间的经济平衡更加优化。
en: Increased emphasis on household lending should also create a better balance in the economy between capital spending and consumer spending than was possible during the expansion of 2002-2004.

zh: 中国的最佳希望
en: China’s Best Hope

zh: 人们并不是主要由于2008年发生的高尚或者英勇的行为而怀念这一年。
en: 2008 will not be remembered chiefly for noble or heroic acts.

zh: 但是，在过去几个月有关金融诈骗、印度和加沙流血以及全球经济灾难的新闻报导中，有一个事件则由于其勇敢和高尚而引人注目。
en: Yet, amidst the news reports over the past few months of financial fraud, bloodshed in India and Gaza, and global economic disasters, one item stood out for its bravery and nobility.

zh: 12月10日是世界人权宣言发表60周年纪念日，三百多名中国各界人士，包括法学教授、商人、农民甚至某些政府官员在零八宪章这一非凡的文件上签名。
en: On December 10, the 60th anniversary of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, more than 300 Chinese citizens, ranging from law professors to businessmen, farmers, and even some government officials, put their names to a remarkable document, entitled Charter 08.

zh: 后来又有几千人签名，他们问到，中国在二十一世纪究竟走向何处。 中国是否继续在独裁统治下实现“现代化 ” ， 还是接受普世人权价值标准，加入文明国家主流并且建设民主体制？
en: The signatories, later joined by thousands more, asked where China was heading in the twenty-first century: “Will it continue with ‘modernization’ under authoritarian rule, or will it embrace universal human values, join the mainstream of civilized nations, and build a democratic system?”

zh: 零八宪章中根本就没有什么煽动性言论。 它并不呼吁暴力叛乱，也没有复仇或者报复的饥渴嚣张。
en: There is nothing incendiary about Charter 08, no call for violent rebellion, no thirst for revenge or retribution.

zh: 它只是要求所有自由民主国家公民中认为是理所当然的东西，也就是质疑政府政策的权利、保护人权、独立司法以及多党选举。
en: It merely asks for what citizens of all liberal democracies take for granted: the right to question government policies, protection of human rights, an independent judiciary, and multi-party elections.

zh: 零八宪章建立在捷克斯洛伐克的七七宪章模式基础之上。
en: The model for Charter 08 was Czechoslovakia’s Charter 77.

zh: 1977年，哈维尔等几名著名的签署人因此遭到监禁。
en: In 1977, several prominent signatories, such as Václav Havel, were arrested as a result.

zh: 同样，刘晓波是最为勇敢、头脑最为清晰的知识分子之一。 他由于签署零八宪章而被捕，现在还没有被释放。
en: Likewise, one of the bravest, most lucid Chinese intellectuals, Liu Xiaobo, was arrested in December for signing Charter 08, and has yet to be released.

zh: 其他签署人也遭到了盘查和骚扰。
en: Other signers have been interrogated and harassed.

zh: 零八宪章还没有受到应有的注意，可能是因为其他人还有更为迫切的关心事项。
en: Charter 08 has not received the attention it deserves, perhaps because most people have other, more pressing concerns.

zh: 但是还有一种倾向，也就是把这些对民主的呼吁驳斥为无关紧要、甚至误入歧途。
en: But there is also a tendency, not only in China, to dismiss such calls for democracy as irrelevant, even misguided.

zh: 这一倾向并不限于中国。 美国最近的政策也给促进民主坏名声。
en: Recent American policies have given the promotion of democracy a bad name.

zh: 在中国和其他现存的亚洲独裁国家中，人们、甚至那些自诩为“自由派”人士已经惯于争辩说民主可能对欧美国家是好事，但是它并不适用于亚洲传统。
en: In China, and other remaining areas of Asian authoritarianism, it has become customary, even among some self-professed “liberals,” to argue that democracy may be fine for Europeans and Americans, but is unsuited to Asian conditions.

zh: 中国国家太大，它的文化不同，而且其人口过于贫困、没有接受教育而无法支撑民主体制。
en: China is too big, its culture too different, and its population still too poor and uneducated to support a democratic system.

zh: 这一论调的另一个说法就是，中国具有自身民主形式，它建立在孔夫子政府仁义以及中国文化偏向于为了集体利益而牺牲个人权利的基础之上。
en: An alternative to this line of argument is to claim that China has its own kind of democracy, based on a Confucian idea of government benevolence and the Chinese people’s cultural propensity to sacrifice individual rights to collective goods.

zh: 许多西方经商人士完全赞同中共这一观点。 对于那些持这一观点的人而言，零八宪章的签署人完全脱离了自身的文化。
en: To those who take this view – and on this point many Western businessmen are in complete agreement with the Chinese Communist Party – the signatories of Charter 08 are simply out of touch with their own culture.

zh: 就其直接影响而言，零八宪章几乎无法在中国政治的池塘中产生什么波痕，这是不假。
en: In terms of its immediate impact, it is true that Charter 08 will hardly make a ripple in the pond of Chinese politics.

zh: 政府甚至不会讨论宪章的观点，更不要说采取行动加以落实了。
en: The government will not even discuss the Charter’s ideas, let alone do anything to implement them.

zh: 但是这并不是称之为无关紧要的理由。
en: But this is no reason to call it irrelevant.

zh: 在1977年，很少有人会预计哈维尔将会有一天成为捷克总统。
en: In 1977, few people would have predicted that Havel would one day preside over a Czech democracy.

zh: 他和其他异议人士也是沧海一粟。
en: He and his fellow dissidents were a tiny minority, too.

zh: 自由民主的中国可能无法马上实现，但是在零八宪章发表后无人能够否认许多中国人迫切想要实现自由民主。
en: A liberal-democratic China may not come soon, but after Charter 08 no one can deny that many Chinese desperately want it.

zh: 现在表达这一愿望尤其重要，因为世界目前正经受令人担忧的经济危机。
en: The expression of this desire is especially important now that the world is gripped by a terrifying economic crisis.

zh: 大规模的经济困境从来都不会没有政治后果。
en: Widespread economic distress is never without political consequences.

zh: 欧洲的排外正在抬头。
en: Xenophobic populism is on the rise in Europe.

zh: 奥巴马总统限制美国国内怀恨在心的保护主义将会遇到困难。
en: President Barack Obama will have a difficult time curbing resentful protectionism in the United States.

zh: 但是，没有任何一个地方的经济下滑带来的政治和社会后果要比中国更为具有潜在的破坏稳定后果。
en: Japanese might revert to angry nationalism. Nowhere, however, are the political and social consequences of an economic slump more potentially destabilizing than in China.

zh: 这是因为只有中国经济持续快速增长才能够给中共权力垄断提供合法性。 没有了经济增长，工人和农民就会失业，城市中产阶级就会失去不断繁荣的机会。
en: This is because the Chinese Communist Party’s monopoly on power can be justified only by continued rapid economic growth, without which workers and farmers will lose their jobs, and the urban middle classes their chance of increasing prosperity.

zh: 一党专制国家合法性的唯一来源就是经济繁荣。
en: The economic boom is the only source of legitimacy that the one-party state has left.

zh: 甚至包括党员在内，很少有人还相信马列主义，更不要说是毛泽东思想了。
en: Few people, even Party members, still believe in Marxism-Leninism, let alone Maoism.

zh: 1989年，大众对官员腐化以及政治压迫不满在全中国都充分地展现了出来。
en: And the general discontent with official corruption and political oppression was amply demonstrated in all regions of China in 1989.

zh: 中共政府在天安门惨案后依旧保持政权并非仅仅是通过暴力。
en: The Communist government managed to stay in power after Tiananmen not just through brute force.

zh: 中共用更多财富的保证从特别是受过教育的中产阶级那里收买了政治合法性的外表。
en: A semblance of political legitimacy, especially among the educated middle class, was purchased with the promise of greater wealth.

zh: 只要人们感到他们在逐渐致富，对言论自由、保护人权以及选举权力的要求就可以推后。
en: As long as people felt that they were getting richer, demands for more freedom of speech, better protection of human rights, and the right to vote could be postponed.

zh: 但是如果这一安排崩溃以及日益增长的物质繁荣不再唾手可得，那么形势就会大不一样了。 不会有什么让人高兴的事情发生。
en: But if this arrangement collapses, and increasing material prosperity can no longer be taken for granted, many things could happen – few of them pleasant.

zh: 农村地区和工业化城市中会爆发大规模骚乱。
en: Rural areas and industrial cities might explode in massive riots.

zh: 政府或许会用强力镇压这些骚乱，但是中产阶级丧失信心可能会更加严重。
en: While the government might be able to crush such disturbances with force, a loss of confidence among the middle class would be more serious.

zh: 惊恐不已的统治者鼓动会鼓动激进的民族主义，这或许会是一个后果。
en: Militant nationalism, partly encouraged by nervous rulers, might be one consequence.

zh: 军队通过控制政府而平息骚乱也许是另一个后果。
en: Attempts by the military to stem unrest by taking control of government might be another.

zh: 如果除了一党专制、军人统治或者全国大乱之外没有别的���法可供选择，那么中国的未来就确实非常严峻。
en: If there were no alternative ideas to one-party authoritarianism, military rule, or nationwide chaos, the future of China would be very bleak indeed.

zh: 但是还是有一个选择。
en: But there is an alternative.

zh: 零八宪章有力而又雄辩地提出了这一选择。
en: It has been set out eloquently and persuasively in Charter 08.

zh: 如果中国有朝一日跟随韩国、日本以及台湾的榜样，通过建立自由民主而加入“文明国家的主流 ” ， 那么，2008年12月10日就会成为孕育这一变革的关键日期而名垂青史。
en: If China manages one day to follow the example of South Korea, Japan, and Taiwan, and join the “mainstream of civilized nations” by establishing a liberal democracy, then December 10, 2008, will go down in history as one of the key dates of its conception.

zh: 中国的黑石妙计
en: China’s Blackstone Coup

zh: 当中国海洋石油总公司（中海油）在两年前企图收购美国的优尼科公司时，在美国的政界激起了轩然大波。
en: When China National Offshore Oil Company tried to buy America’s UNOCAL two years ago, it set off a political firestorm in the United States.

zh: 当迪拜港口世界公司（Dubai Ports World）收购了英国的铁行轮船集团(P&O Steam Navigation Company)后，由于后者在美国国内运营一些港口，所以此项并购案也在美国引发了更多的争议。
en: When Dubai Ports World bought Britain’s P&O Steam Navigation Company, the fact that P&O operated ports inside the US led to more controversy in America.

zh: 人们会认为像美国这样一个经常项目下的赤字每年高达约8000亿美金的国家，会意识到这样一个巨大的外部缺口不可避免地要靠出售资产来填补。 这就意味着资金雄厚的外国人能够获取美国公司的所有权和控制权。
en: One would think that a country like the US, with a current account deficit of roughly $800 billion a year, would realize that such a yawning external gap is inevitably financed only by selling off assets, which means that foreigners with money acquire ownership and control of US-based businesses.

zh: 但美国—至少是国会和媒体—却不明白这一点。
en: But the US – or at least Congress and the media – doesn’t get it.

zh: 美国人显然是希望世界能够如其所愿地让他们实施不负责任的、催生赤字的财政政策，保持非常低的人均储蓄率和适当的投资率。 这一切最好都由外国资本买单，而金主没有对其资产的控制权但却乐于承担风险。
en: Americans evidently hope for a world in which they can have feckless deficit-generating fiscal policies, a very low private savings rate, and a moderate rate of investment, all financed by foreign capital whose owners are happy to bear the risks yet have no control over their assets.

zh: 人们或许以为外国投资者在这些条件面前会不寒而栗并对以美元计算的资产敬而远之。
en: One might think that foreign investors would quake in terror at these terms and shy away from dollar-denominated assets.

zh: 但事实却并非如此。
en: But this has not been the case.

zh: 高企的石油价格为中东各国政府创造了巨大的出口收入。 而这些政府仍然希望将它们的盈收固化为美国资产。
en: High oil prices have created huge export revenues for Middle Eastern governments, which still want to park their earnings in American assets.

zh: 俄罗斯也是如此。 该国的（石油）寡头和财政部长Alexi Kudrin创建的巨无霸国家投资基金也想将它们来自石油的收入投资到美国。
en: The same is true of Russia, whose oligarchs, as well as the huge state investment fund that finance minister Alexi Kudrin has created, also want to invest their oil revenues in the US.

zh: 对于亚洲各国政府而言，以中国为代表，将美国作为进口国仍然是下下策。
en: As for Asia’s governments, with China in the lead, the US remains the importer of last resort.

zh: 它们发展战略的关键是将农村人口转化为城市的劳力，生产以美国为目标市场的出口商品。
en: The key to their development strategy is to put migrants from the countryside to work making exports destined for the US market.

zh: 它们对以推动内需为基础的发展战略能否成功表示怀疑。
en: They doubt that an alternative development strategy based on boosting domestic demand would succeed.

zh: 因此，它们货币的真实价值必须相对美元保持在较低水平。 这就意味着他们投资美国的外汇储备必须持续增长。
en: Thus, the real values of their currencies must be kept low relative to the dollar, which means that their reserves now invested in the US must continue to grow.

zh: 当然，总有一天这种情况会终结。
en: Someday, of course, this will come to an end.

zh: 可能亚洲货币的真实价值会由于通胀的爆发而大幅提升。
en: Perhaps Asian real currency values will rise sharply as a result of a burst of inflation in Asia.

zh: 可能美元会崩溃，美国也会爆发通货膨胀。 因为美联储认为两害相权，暂时放弃美元与价格水平的联系机制比由于美元崩溃和利率提升所造成的失业率高居不下的结果要好。
en: Perhaps the dollar will collapse and there will be a burst of inflation in the US as the Federal Reserve Board decides that temporarily abandoning its price-level peg is a lesser evil than the unemployment fallout that will result from a dollar collapse and interest rate spike.

zh: 一个国家的政府通过将日益增长的外汇资产投入美金证券的方式来购买政治风险保险的做法有一定的避险作用。
en: A government that buys political risk insurance by placing an ever-growing stock of reserve assets in dollar securities guards against some dangers.

zh: 但这种做法会面临其它的风险，特别是当这种投资局限于小部分的资产形式，即美国政客们特别愿意让外国人持有的美国国库券和高级别公司债券。
en: But it is exposed to other risks, especially if it confines its investments to that slice of the asset pool, US Treasury and high-grade corporate bonds, that American politicians are comfortable having foreigners own.

zh: 名义债券对于通胀的避险功能较弱，并且长期来看，未得到有效控制的可变现资产很容易受到金融秃鹫们的攻击。
en: Nominal bonds are not well hedged against inflation, and, over the long run, assets that are claims to cash without effective control are highly vulnerable to financial vultures.

zh: 审慎的外国政府和私人投资者会寻求途径使投资多元化。
en: Prudent foreign government and private investors would find some way to diversify.

zh: 但应该如何做呢？
en: But how?

zh: 收购他国的资产意味着放弃相对美元保持货币实际价值低水平的目标。
en: Buying other countries’ bonds would mean abandoning the goal of keeping real currency values low against the dollar.

zh: 整体收购企业会在美国国会引发激烈的言论。
en: Buying up whole enterprises triggers angry speeches in the US Congress.

zh: 现在所需要的就是一个中间组织，既能够给予外国人一定程度的控制权，使其投资能够多元化地分布在更广泛的美国本地资产中，又能使得这些资产在政客们的眼里仍然是100%的美国资产。
en: What are needed are intermediary organizations that will grant a measure of control to foreigners, allow diversification across a wider range of US-located assets, and yet still appear 100% American to US politicians.

zh: 于是黑石集团应声而出。
en: Enter the Blackstone Group.

zh: 中国在黑石的30亿美元投资，尽管相对于中国1.3万亿美元的外汇资产储备不值一提—这一数额在今年底会直冲1.5万亿，并可能在2009年的某个时候达到2万亿—但这也只是小试锋芒。
en: China’s $3 billion investment in Blackstone, while insignificant relative to China’s $1.3 trillion of reserve assets – a sum headed for $1.5 trillion by the end of this year and likely to hit $2 trillion sometime in 2009 – is but a toe dipped in the water, a test run.

zh: 在这一进程之初，中国会获得大量美国企业的小部分间接所有权。 而这样的操作很可能不会遭遇通常的反对。
en: At the start of the process, China will have small and indirect ownership stakes in a great many US enterprises, and the odds are that the usual objections will be absent.

zh: 中国会获得一种分散风险的方式，降低使其外汇储备收益保持低水平的价格压力，同时避免陷入政治麻烦。
en: China will gain a measure of risk diversification, reduce the price pressure that has kept earnings on its foreign exchange reserves low, and avoid running into political trouble.

zh: 而黑石会得到额外的现金和丰厚的佣金。
en: Blackstone will gain extra cash to deploy and extra fees.

zh: 有些观察家认为美国政界对外国人“收购美国”的强烈反弹将会终结现今的全球不平衡状态。
en: Some observers think that the US political backlash against foreigners “buying up America” is what will bring the current configuration of global imbalances to an end.

zh: 像中国投资黑石这样的交易会延缓这种反弹，但并不会持久：30亿美金只相当于中国在三个工作日里所积累的外汇储备。
en: Deals like China’s investment in Blackstone postpone that backlash, but not for long: $3 billion is equivalent to what China accumulates in reserve in less than three working days.

zh: 在中国对黑石投资以后的问题是：这一进程能走多远？
en: The question following China’s Blackstone investment is this: how far can this process go?

zh: 美国的投资者们最终会发现他们到底放弃了多大的控制权？
en: And how much control will US investors ultimately find that they have given up?

zh: 中国在缅甸面临的考验
en: China’s Burma Test

zh: 缅甸的和平抗议活动正在接近其倾覆点，而军政府正在衡量全面军事镇压可能的代价。
en: Burma’s peaceful protests are nearing their tipping point, with the military junta weighing the potential costs of a full military crackdown.

zh: 但是如果中国继续给他们提供支持以及保护他们免受联合国安理会的制裁，缅甸的将军们几不太可能选择流血镇压。
en: But Burma’s generals will have little incentive to opt for an alternative to bloodshed and repression if China continues to provide them with support and protection against sanctions at the UN Security Council.

zh: 中国比任何其他国家对缅甸执政的将军们都有更大的影响力。
en: China has more influence over Burma’s ruling generals than any other country.

zh: 事实上，如果没有来自中国的支持，缅甸政权是否还能维持下去很值得疑问。
en: Indeed, without Chinese support, it is debatable whether the Burmese regime could sustain itself.

zh: 所以，尽管缅甸目前的危机并不是中国造成的，但是任何和平的解决方案只有得到中国的支持才有可能实现。
en: So, while the current crisis in Burma is not of China’s making, any peaceful settlement may be possible only if China acts to support it.

zh: 中国因而就面临着一次它自己并不愿意看到的对于它声称要在国际社会充当一个负责任的利益相关的参与者的考验。
en: China is thus facing an unwanted test of its claim to be a responsible stakeholder in the international community.

zh: 到目前为止，在缅甸东部已经有3000座村庄被毁坏、150万人无家可归，这场人道主义灾难已经延续了很长一段时间了。
en: With 3,000 villages destroyed and 1.5 million people already displaced in eastern Burma, a humanitarian disaster has been unfolding for some time now.

zh: 但是中国一直以来对此都闭口不谈，而是坚持它不干涉别国内政的政策。
en: Throughout these troubles, China has held its tongue, sticking to its policy of non-interference in the internal affairs of any nation.

zh: 但是那个政策也许已经站不住脚了，因为寻找到避免血腥镇压发生的有效替代解决方案符合中国的利益，一场血腥的镇压只会让整个世界鲜活地回忆起1988年发生在仰光以及接下来的一年发生于天安门广场的大屠杀。
en: But that policy may no longer be tenable, because it is in China’s interest to find an effective alternative to a brutal crackdown, which would only remind the world vividly of the massacres in Rangoon in 1988 and in Tiananmen Square the following year.

zh: 鉴于一些国际知名人士已经因为中国支持世界上某些最最残酷地镇压百姓以及不称职的政权而掀起抵制北京奥运会的运动，缅甸发生军事镇压是中国当局最不愿意看到的事情。
en: With some international celebrities already keen to start a campaign to boycott the Beijing Olympics because of China’s support for some of the world’s most repressive and incompetent regimes, a military crackdown in Burma is the last thing the Chinese authorities can afford.

zh: 此外，中国的执政者正把精力集中在即将召开的党的十七大上，而这有可能被缅甸发生的血腥冲突所破坏。
en: Moreover, China’s rulers are focused on the looming 17th Congress of the Communist Party, which could likewise be spoiled by a bloody confrontation in Burma.

zh: 然而中国也许可以通过让选择血腥镇压将让缅甸政权付出高得令人望而生畏的代价来预先制止这样一种结果。
en: Yet China may be able to pre-empt such an outcome by making the option of a brutal crackdown prohibitively high to the Burmese regime.

zh: 它应该私下里威胁切断所有的援助和贸易联系，以及停止在联合国内保护其政权免受任何额外的国际制裁。
en: It should privately threaten to cut off all aid and trade links, and to end its protection of the regime within the United Nations from any additional international sanctions.

zh: 作为对和平政权更迭的诱导，中国也可以保证一旦军政府的成员被迫突然离开缅甸，将保护他们的人身安全和财富不受损失。
en: As an inducement to peaceful change, China can also guarantee the personal safety and wealth of the military junta should its members have to leave Burma suddenly.

zh: 但是中国应该清楚地表明这种保护需要缅甸的将军们共同寻找到一条和平的解决方案。
en: But China should make it clear that such protection requires the Burmese generals to cooperate in finding a peaceful solution.

zh: 中国还应该公开地在联合国和东盟内寻找到一条国际社会可以帮助和平地解决这场危机的途径。
en: China should also publicly work within the UN and with ASEAN to find a way in which the international community can help to resolve the crisis peacefully.

zh: 但是最终，危机只能在缅甸内部解决。
en: Ultimately, a solution can be found only within Burma itself.

zh: 军政府如果不想让事情更糟的话，也许可以把昂山素季释放出来与她进行合作，后者依然拥有足够的地位和号召力获得公众的支持让政权和平过渡到平民执政，再经过一定的过程，过渡到民主政府。
en: The junta can do worse than releasing and working with Aung San Suu Kyi, who still has sufficient status and appeal to rally public support for a peaceful transfer of power to civilian rule and, in due course, to a democratic government.

zh: 允许军政府的成员可以带着他们非法积聚的财物退休在道义也许令人难以接受，但是任何替代方案都将会使缅甸的百姓付出高得惊人的代价。
en: It may be morally repulsive to allow the junta’s members to retire with their ill-gotten gains, but any alternative will exact a dramatically higher price from Burma’s people.

zh: 中国的国际利益要求它不能永久地支持缅甸军政府。
en: China’s national interest does not require it to prop up the Burmese junta forever.

zh: 当然，中国也因为能够开采缅甸的能源和其他自然资源中获得了巨大的利益。
en: Of course, China benefits greatly from access to Burma’s energy and other natural resources.

zh: 但是，通过在引导权力成功和和平的更迭中扮演积极的角色，中国可以比它现行的政策更有效地让缅甸成为一个友好的邻国，因为它现在的政策只会引发缅甸人民的仇恨。
en: But, by playing a positive role in bringing about a successful and peaceful transfer of power, China can secure a friendly neighbor in Burma more effectively than with its current policy, which merely incurs the hatred of the Burmese people.

zh: 作为一项地缘政治战略，在缅甸担当积极的主导作用可以使中国让它的邻国确信它的“和平崛起”政策是真实的并且有益的。
en: As a matter of geo-political strategy, taking a positive lead in Burma can help China reassure its neighbors that its policy of a “peaceful rise” is real and beneficial.

zh: 不管东盟各国政府在公开场合怎样欢迎这种崛起，但是除非它们看到中国在确保地区稳定上担当积极的正面角色，否则它们内心所存在的疑虑是不会消除的。
en: Whatever ASEAN governments say in public welcoming that rise, their lingering doubts and suspicions will not be erased unless they see China actively playing a positive role in assuring regional stability.

zh: 当前缅甸发生的危机正给中国提供了这样的一个绝佳机会。
en: The current crisis in Burma offers China a rare opportunity to do so.

zh: 国际社会对于中国的和平崛起也有既得利益。
en: The international community, too, has a vested interest in seeing that China rises peacefully.

zh: 它应该鼓励和支持中国主导缅甸问题的解决，只要中国致力于寻找一条和平的解决方案。
en: It should encourage and support China in taking the lead over Burma, so long as China commits itself to finding a peaceful solution.

zh: 国际社会的目标应该被限定在让缅甸人民能够制定他们自己的解决方案这一和平结果上。
en: The international community’s objective should be restricted to a peaceful outcome that allows Burma’s people to work out their own solution.

zh: 缅甸任何政权的更迭将不会是国际社会干预的结果，而只能是军政府和它的国内反对者之间政治谈判的结果。
en: Any change of regime in Burma will not be the result of international intervention, but of political negotiations between the junta and its domestic opponents.

zh: 因此中国应该认识到运用它的影响力并不代表它是在干涉别国的内政。
en: China should thus recognize that using its influence would not imply accepting as a matter of principle intervention in other countries’ domestic affairs.

zh: 中国的科学革命
en: China’s Scientific Revolution

zh: 北京 — — 中国经济近年来发生了根本性的变化，正在为科技的卓越进步打下坚实的基础。
en: BEIJING – The Chinese economy has undergone radical transformation in recent years and is now laying the groundwork for impressive advances in science and technology.

zh: 尤其是，中国参与了与疾病的斗争，而且，人们有理由相信该国将在未来的生命科学研究中发挥核心作用。
en: In particular, China is setting itself up to be a major player in the fight against disease, and there are many reasons to believe that the country will play a central role in the life-sciences research of the future.

zh: 首先，麦肯锡季刊发布的一份报告显示，中国每年耗资2000亿美元进行研发，而且该投资水平仅次于美国。
en: For starters, according to a report in McKinsey Quarterly, China spends more than $200 billion on research annually, a level of investment that is second only to the United States.

zh: 中国国家主席习近平将科技创新列为国家计划的首要任务。 中国政府的第13个5年计划将重点放在大脑研究、基因科学、大数据和医疗机器人等新兴领域的复杂项目。
en: Chinese President Xi Jinping has positioned science-based innovation near the top of the national agenda, with the government’s 13th Five-Year Plan prioritizing complex projects in emerging fields like brain research, gene science, big data, and medical robotics.

zh: 中国医疗科研投资如此之巨部分原因是该国有着尚未满足的巨大的医疗需求。
en: China is devoting so much to medical research in part because the country has significant unmet medical needs.

zh: 到2050年，中国65岁以上人口预计将增加约1.9亿。
en: By 2050, the Chinese population over age 65 is expected to increase by about 190 million.

zh: 此外，慢性疾病现在占中国疾病负担的80%以上。
en: Meanwhile, chronic illnesses now account for more than 80% of China’s disease burden.

zh: 因此，中国自然已成为全球第二大医药市场，换句话说，据麦肯锡季刊报告显示，中国的创新经费到2020年将达到1万亿美元的规模。
en: So it is no surprise that China is already the world’s second largest pharmaceutical market, or that its innovation expenditure, according to the McKinsey Quarterly report, is expected to reach $1 trillion by 2020.

zh: 预期中国爆发科研革命的另一个原因是中国现在毕业的科学、技术、工程和数学领域的大学生比其他任何国家都多 — — 每年毕业生数量约为250万，大约比美国多5倍左右。
en: Another reason to expect a Chinese research revolution is that China now graduates more university students in the fields of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics than any other country – about 2.5 million students per year, or about five times more than the US.

zh: 仅在科学和工程领域，中国每年就培养出近30,000名博士生。
en: In science and engineering alone, China generates nearly 30,000 PhDs annually.

zh: 与此同时，政府的激励措施正在吸引一直在海外工作的中国科学家回国创业，其中很多人都曾在西方顶级机构工作。
en: At the same time, government incentives are luring Chinese scientists who have been working abroad – many with top-tier Western institutions – back home.

zh: 从2008年开始实施到2014年年中，这项“千人计划”已经吸引了4000多名海外学者归国。
en: From its inception in 2008 through mid-2014, this “Thousand Talents” program has attracted more than 4,000 returnees.

zh: 这些趋势都清楚地表明中国确有机会成为全球药品研发的主要力量，而且中国定期出现突破性创新的时点可能将很快到来。
en: These trends clearly indicate that China has a real opportunity to become a major force in global pharmaceuticals research, and that there will soon come a time when breakthrough innovation occurs in China on a regular basis.

zh: 全球药品企业已经有所察觉。
en: Global pharmaceutical companies have taken notice.

zh: 我自己的公司10年来一直坚持在中国进行研发活动。
en: My own company has been working in research and development in China for ten years.

zh: 早在2006年，我们就在中国设立了首家综合性研发机构，其规模在国际企业中也可谓首屈一指。
en: Back in 2006, we opened the first integrated R&D facility in the country, and the largest among international firms.

zh: 而且我们不久前在上海的张江高科园区开设了一家新的研发中心。
en: And we recently opened a new R&D center in Shanghai’s Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park.

zh: 在上海，很多从哈佛医学院和麻省理工学院等知名研究中心归国的顶级科学家将着重研究中国民众易患的疾病。
en: In Shanghai, premier scientists – many having returned to China from major research centers like Harvard Medical School and MIT – will focus on diseases that are endemic to the Chinese population.

zh: 其中包括肺、肝及胃癌，以及其他肝脏疾病，如慢性乙型肝炎、肝纤维化和肝硬化等。
en: These include lung, liver, and gastric cancers, as well as other liver diseases, such as chronic hepatitis B, liver fibrosis, and cirrhosis.

zh: 超大比例的中国民众感染上述疾病。
en: These diseases disproportionately affect people in China.

zh: 比方说，中国乙肝发病率比美国高近30倍；胃癌及肝癌发病率比美国或欧洲高11到18倍之多。
en: For example, the incidence of hepatitis B in China is nearly 30 times higher than in the US; stomach and liver cancer rates are 11-18 times higher than in the US or Europe.

zh: 多亏近年来所取得的进展，科学家们现在可以确定调节基因活动的表观遗传修饰酶。
en: Thanks to advances in recent years, scientists can now identify epigenetic modification enzymes that regulate gene activities.

zh: 上述研究领域在寻找有效的肿瘤疗法方面尤其有前途。
en: This area of research is especially promising in the search for effective new oncological therapies.

zh: 通过深入研究这些疾病在中国患者身上的表现，制药行业正在完善针对性的治疗方法，以便在世界其他地区加以推广应用。
en: And by better understanding how these diseases manifest in Chinese patients, the industry is honing targeted therapies that can then be introduced in other settings worldwide.

zh: 中国很可能会成为利用表观遗传学深入了解疾病深层原因的全球标准制定者。
en: China could very well set the global standard for using epigenetics to gain a better understanding of the underlying causes of diseases.

zh: 中国诺华制药的科学家已经在推进处于不同阶段的15个药品研发项目，而这样的研发速度只会不断提高。
en: In China, Novartis scientists alone are already running 15 drug discovery projects at different stages, and this pace of development will only accelerate.

zh: 我为中国得出里程碑式科研成果的可能性而倍感鼓舞。
en: I am inspired by China’s potential for making landmark scientific discoveries.

zh: 随着中国全球研发地位的不断提升，它所做出的贡献将在中国国内和世界各地促进人类与其病的斗争。
en: As the country becomes increasingly important to global R&D, its contributions will be a boon for the fight against disease, both in China and worldwide.

zh: 中国的互联革命
en: China’s Connectivity Revolution

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 作为一个有着悠久碎片化历史的国家，中国正被一种新的联系工具以前所未有的方式连结在了一起。
en: NEW HAVEN – Long the most fragmented nation on earth, China is being brought together like never before by a new connectivity.

zh: 该国的网络社区正急速扩大，不但深刻影响了整个经济，还对社会行为模式和政治体制造成了冲击。
en: Its Internet community is expanding at hyper speed, with profound implications for the Chinese economy, to say nothing of the country’s social norms and political system.

zh: 这是一个无法被赶回神灯的幽灵：一旦联通起来，就没有回头路可走了。
en: This genie cannot be stuffed back in the bottle. Once connected, there is no turning back.

zh: 这条转型之路是非常激动人心的。
en: The pace of transformation is breathtaking.

zh: 根据世界互联网统计中心（Internet World Stats）的数字，中国的网民数量自2006年以来已经翻了三倍有多，并于2011年中期达到4.85亿人。
en: According to Internet World Stats, the number of Internet users in China has more than tripled since 2006, soaring to 485 million in mid-2011 – more than three times that in 2006.

zh: 此外中国面向互联性的狂飙还远未停止：在2011年中期，13亿中国人中只有36%能够上网 — — 这个数字相比韩国，日本和美国等地高达80%的渗透率来说还是偏低。
en: Moreover, China’s rush to connectivity is far from over. As of mid-2011, only 36% of its 1.3 billion people were connected – far short of the nearly 80% penetration rates seen in South Korea, Japan, and the United States.

zh: 事实上，随着互联成本大幅下降 — — 中国的手机用户数量预计将在2013年超过个人电脑用户 — — 还有城市化以及人均收入大幅上升，中国的互联网渗透率将在2015年越过50%的门槛就毫不意外了，而因此增加的人数相当于美国当前所有网民数量的3/4。
en: Indeed, with the cost of connectivity falling sharply – China’s mobile users are expected to surpass PC users by 2013 – and, with urbanization and per capita incomes also rising sharply, it is not unreasonable to expect China’s Internet penetration rate to cross the 50% threshold by 2015. That would be the functional equivalent of adding about three-fourths of all existing Internet users in the US.

zh: 中国那些不常使用互联网的人数也是如此。
en: Nor are the Chinese casual and infrequent Internet users.

zh: 正如网络理论家克莱·舍奇（Clay Shirky）所说，社会具有开启基于网络行为“认知过剩”现象的强烈嗜好，而中国互联网信息中心的调查数据也与该理论不谋而合：中国网民平均每天上网近2.6个小时，比15~49岁中国人平均每天看电视的时间还多出整整一个小时。
en: Consistent with what the social-network theorist Clay Shirky has dubbed a society’s penchant for unlocking the “cognitive surplus” embedded in net-based activities, survey data from the China Internet Network Information Center suggest that Chinese netizens log an average of 2.6 hours per day online – a full hour longer than the average 15-49-year-old Chinese citizen spends watching television.

zh: 中国使用最为频密的微博（或者是社会网络）估计在2011年年末达到2.7亿的用户量，而且还拥有极大的上升空间。
en: China’s microblogs, or social networks, where usage tends be most intense, were estimated to have approximately 270 million users as of late 2011. And there is plenty of upside.

zh: 在全球范围内大约有70%的互联网用户也在使用某种形式的微博，也是当前网络增长最快的部分。
en: Worldwide, about 70% of all Internet users currently engage in some form of microblogging, which is the fastest-growing segment of the Internet.

zh: 而在中国，这个比例只有55 % 。
en: In China, this share is just 55%.

zh: 当对中国进行分析的时候，我们往往容易被数字所迷惑，尤其是其庞大的基数。
en: When it comes to analyzing China, it is always easy to get carried away with numbers – especially those driven by the country’s sheer size.

zh: 但真正有价值的信息则着眼于互联性，而不仅仅是其规模。
en: But the real message here concerns the implications of connectivity, not just its scale.

zh: 其中一个关键的含义就是互联网在中国消费社会的崛起中可能扮演某种重要角色的潜力 — — 而消费社会恰恰是长期不平衡的中国经济所急需的重要架构。
en: A key implication is the Internet’s potential to play a significant role in the emergence of China’s consumer society – a critical structural imperative for a long-unbalanced Chinese economy.

zh: 随着互联性而生的则是一种关于消费习惯，品味和品牌的国家意识 — — 这也是任何消费文化所必备的特质。
en: With connectivity comes a national awareness of spending habits, tastes, and brands – essential characteristics of any consumer culture.

zh: 消费占中国GDP的比例还不够35 % ， 在世界几大国之间是最低的。
en: The consumption share of China’s economy, at less than 35% of GDP, is the lowest of any major country.

zh: 而不断增加的中国互联网使用量将极大有利于最近推行的第十二个五年计划中的消费促进方略。
en: Surging Chinese Internet usage could well facilitate the pro-consumption initiatives of the recently enacted 12th Five-Year Plan.

zh: 互联网同样也能实现更自由也更开放的沟通，阶层流动，透明和迅速的信息传播，还有毫无疑问的一点：个人主义。
en: The Internet could also enable freer and more open communications, upward mobility, transparent and rapid dissemination of information, and, yes, individuality.

zh: 中国的领导层也逐渐认识到不断加剧的贫富不均现象可能阻碍他们所谓“和谐社会”的发展。
en: China’s leadership has been increasingly vocal in raising concerns about growing inequalities that might otherwise hinder the development of what they call a more “harmonious society.”

zh: 而网上互联则可成为一个帮助中国团结起来并实现这一目标的有力工具。
en: Online connectivity could be a powerful means to help China come together and achieve this goal.

zh: 最后，互联网也有成为政治变革工具的潜力。
en: Finally, there is the Internet’s potential as an instrument of political change.

zh: 这是所有反思过去年“阿拉伯之春”的国家都认真考虑的问题，而网络所赋予的动员性也确实对许多国家（尤其是突尼斯和埃及）的变革有所助力。
en: That is hardly an inconsequential consideration for any country in the aftermath of last year’s Arab Spring, which was facilitated in many countries (especially Tunisia and Egypt) by network-enabled mobilization.

zh: 虽然中国这个一党制国家的改革常常被视为现代中国一个最重要的目标 — — 从1970年代末魏京生所说的“第五次现代化”到最近国家总理温家宝的讲话都有涉及 — — 但所取得的进展却极为有限。
en: While reform of China’s single-party state has always been viewed as an important objective in modern China – from the so-called Fifth Modernization of Wei Jinsheng in the late 1970’s to recent speeches by Premier Wen Jiabao – meaningful progress has been limited.

zh: 那么随着中国拥抱互联网，变革也会因此而生吗？
en: Is this likely to change as China embraces the Internet?

zh: 政治稳定的实现需要领导力，可靠性和责任心，中国也毫不例外。
en: China is no exception in requiring leadership, accountability, and responsiveness as conditions of political stability.

zh: 该国迅速扩大的互联网社区使得民众对重大区域性事件的关注度迅速提升。
en: Its rapidly expanding Internet community has repeatedly raised national awareness of tough local issues.

zh: 而这一点在2008年四川地震，2009年新疆暴乱和2011年温州高铁等事件中则显得尤其突出。
en: This was especially evident in the aftermath of the Sichuan earthquake of 2008, ethnic violence in Xinjiang in 2009, and the high-speed rail crash in Wenzhou in 2011.

zh: 正如阿拉伯之春所显示的那样，互联网能将本地事件迅速转化为全国性的爆点 — — 将新的互联性转化成引发政治不稳定和混乱的潜在源头。
en: As the Arab Spring demonstrated, the Internet can quickly transform local incidents into national flashpoints – turning the new connectivity into a potential source of political instability and turmoil.

zh: 但这些个案仅仅发生在那些由不受民众拥戴的独裁政权统治的国家。
en: But that has been the case only in countries ruled by highly unpopular autocratic regimes.

zh: 相比之下，中国领导层所获得的公众支持看上去更高。
en: By contrast, China’s leadership is viewed with a much greater degree of public sympathy.

zh: 他们对最近在四川，新疆和温州等事件所作出的迅速直接反映说明了这一点。
en: Their quick and direct response to the recent incidents in Sichuan, Xinjiang, and Wenzhou are important cases in point.

zh: 面对网上喷涌而出的关注之声，党的高级领导人 — — 尤其是总理温家宝 — — 迅速做出了国家层面的感人回应，并起到了极大作用。
en: Senior Party leaders – especially Premier Wen – were quick to lead an empathetic national response that was largely effective in countering the outpouring of concern expressed on the Internet.

zh: 但上述一切也无法掩盖中国互联网爆炸过程中的阴暗面 — — 也就是对个人自由表达权利的广泛审查和限制。
en: None of this is to deny the dark side of the Chinese Internet explosion – namely, widespread censorship and constraints on individual freedom of expression.

zh: 中国的“天网”团队（据说人数超过3万人）是全世界最大的网络警察力量。
en: China’s “SkyNet” team (rumored to be greater than 30,000) is the largest cyber police force in the world.

zh: 此外，虽然中国不是唯一进行网络审查的国家，该国许多大型门户网站的自我审查也强化了官方的监管和盯梢。
en: Moreover, while China is not alone in censoring the Internet, self-policing by many of the nation’s largest portals amplifies official oversight and surveillance.

zh: 最近对微博作者的监管 — — 尤其是禁止那些使用化名且无法追查的人登录 — — 也令人更加关注的中国的互联网自由。
en: Recent restrictions on microbloggers – especially denial of access to those who use untraceable aliases – have heightened concerns over Chinese Internet freedom.

zh: 当然，这类管制在双方面都起到了作用 — — 既限制了个人表达的自由，也遏制了某些在网上的恶意造谣抹黑行为。
en: Such restrictions, of course, cut both ways – potentially limiting personal expression, but also constraining disguised and reckless vigilante attacks.

zh: 但不管是否存在网络过滤行为，一个长期碎片化的中国如今拥有了一个切实存在并迅速扩张的网络。
en: Filtered or not, a long-fragmented China now has a viable and rapidly expanding network.

zh: 而这个网络的力量 — — 尤其在经济，社会和政治变革都被关注的情况下 — — 将难以预测。
en: The power of that network – especially insofar as economic, social, and political change is concerned – is hard to predict.

zh: 但互联性为现代中国的凝聚力增加了一个新的维度，而这也只会加速其超常规发展的速度。
en: But connectivity adds a new dimension of cohesion to modern China. That can only accelerate the speed of its extraordinary development journey.

zh: 中国的建设狂热
en: China’s Construction Fetish

zh: 纽黑文－在我们揣摩中国5860亿美元经济刺激计划的含义时，思考中国为什么每次在需要促进经济增长的时候，都选择基础设施建设、房屋以及大项目，是很有趣的。
en: NEW HAVEN – As we digest the implications of China’s $586 billion stimulus plan, it is intriguing to ponder why China chooses infrastructure, buildings, and big projects every time growth needs a boost.

zh: 中国应该或者能够仅仅通过增加实体建筑来取得长期增长吗？
en: Should, or can, China achieve long-term growth only by adding physical structures?

zh: 如果当要暂停或改变经济增长的路径的时候，中国现存的政治－经济制度能够适应这样的变化吗？
en: If and when the time comes to pause or change course, will China’s existing political-economic institutions accommodate such a transformation?

zh: 在最近到巴西的一次旅行中，我的出租车司机抱怨圣保罗崎岖不平的街道和公路。
en: During a recent trip to Brazil, my taxi driver complained about Sao Paulo’s bumpy streets and highways.

zh: 我回应道 ， “ 我以为高油价和高铁矿石价格已经使巴西繁荣起来了 … . . 巴西为什么不在其基础设施建设上花更多的钱呢？
en: I responded, “I thought the high oil and iron ore prices had made Brazil boom….Why hasn’t Brazil spent more on its infrastructure?”

zh: 出租车司机回答说 ， “ 巴西经济运行良好。
en: He replied, “The Brazilian economy has been doing well.

zh: 但是，只要政府有额外的钱，卢拉总统总是喜欢减税并补贴人民，而不是将这些钱用在修建道路上。 为什么？
en: But, whenever the government has extra money, President Lula likes to give tax rebates and subsidies to people, instead of using it on the roads.
Why?”

zh: “哦 ， ” 我说 ， “ 巴西是一个民主国家。
en: “Well,” I said, “Brazil is a democracy.

zh: 想象你是卢拉并且有180亿美元可以支配。
en: Imagine you were Lula and had $18 billion at your disposal.

zh: 你是将这些钱花在修建公路上，还是宁愿给每个巴西人发100美元？ ”
en: Would you rather spend it on highways, or give each Brazilian $100?”

zh: “当然将它给人民，以赢得更多的选票。 ”
en: “Yes, give it to the people, just to win more votes.”

zh: “在中国，政府不是选举产生的，所以赢得更多的选票不是政府考虑的一部分，而且，将钱返还给人民从来就不是一个选择。
en: In China, the government is not elected, so winning more votes is not part of the calculation, and returning money to the people is never the choice.

zh: 中国政府不仅仅是花掉钱，而且似乎总是喜欢像摩天大楼，华丽的政府建筑物，公路以及大工业项目这样有形的东西。 ”
en: The government doesn’t just spend it, but seems always to favor tangible things like skyscrapers, fancy government buildings, highways, and big industrial projects.

zh: 这不仅部分地解释了像印度和巴西这样的民主国家在基础设施上落后于中国的原因，也解释了中国将其新经济刺激计划集中于运输系统上的原因（仅仅铁路项目就会得到5860亿美元经济刺激计划一半以上的投资 ） 。
en: This partly explains not only why democracies such as India and Brazil lag behind China in infrastructure, but also why China is focusing its new stimulus package on transport systems (railroad projects alone will receive more than half of the $586 billion stimulus).

zh: 在一个不民主的国家，官员是对其上级负责，而不是对选民负责。
en: In a non-democracy, officials are held accountable to their superiors, not to voters.

zh: 对官员的上级来说，有形的项目是最容易识别的东西。
en: And for one’s superiors, tangible projects are the easiest to recognize.

zh: 事实上，虽然中国的新经济刺激计划极其强调基础设施建设，但是却对诸如医疗和教育这样的社会保障项目不予理睬，即使这些社会保障项目可以降低家庭的储蓄压力并增加私人消费。
en: Indeed, while China’s new stimulus plan overwhelmingly emphasizes infrastructure, it gives short shrift to social programs, such as health care and education, even though they can reduce household saving pressure and increase private consumption.

zh: 这种支出结构对中国来说一点也不新鲜。
en: This type of spending structure is nothing new to China.

zh: 在2007年，中国在医疗、社会保险和失业福利项目上的政府开支总计约880亿美元，即财政预算的15 % ， GDP的2.4 % （ 既远远低于发达民主国家，也远远低于发展中民主国家的一般百分比 ） 。
en: In 2007, government expenditure on health care, social security, and unemployment welfare programs totaled about $88 billion, or 15% of the fiscal budget and 2.4% of GDP (far below the typical percentage in both developed and developing democracies).

zh: 巴西政府仅仅在医疗上的开支就占其GDP的4.7 % 。
en: Brazil’s government spends 4.7% of GDP on health care alone.

zh: 中国政府在教育上的开支大约是GDP的3 % ， 而巴西的是GDP的 5.4 % 。
en: China’s government expenditure on education is approximately 3% of GDP, compared to 5.4% in Brazil.

zh: 由于缺乏对政府预算的公众监督，中国的政治体系特别偏向于赞成大型实体项目，并且，通过税收和全民所有制，中国政府几乎维持着对绝大多数国民收入和财富的完全控制，从而将这种偏向的影响最大化。
en: Due to the lack of public oversight on government budgeting, China’s political system is especially biased to favor big physical projects, and, through taxation and state ownership, the government maintains almost full control over much national income and wealth, maximizing the impact of this bias.

zh: 北京令人惊叹的奥林匹克场馆不是一个意外，而是这种体系的结果。
en: The wonderful Olympics sites in Beijing were no accident, but rather a result of the system.

zh: 在中国，征税权力几乎不受全国人民代表大会和媒体的制约。
en: Taxation power is hardly checked by the National People’s Congress or the media.

zh: 结果，从1995年到2007年，调整通胀后的政府财政收入增加了5.7倍。
en: As a result, from 1995 to 2007, inflation-adjusted government fiscal revenue increased 5.7 times.

zh: 与此形成对比的是，在同期，城市人均可支配收入的累积增长是1.6倍，农村人均可支配收入的累积增长是1.2倍。
en: In contrast, over the same period, the cumulative increase was 1.6 times for urban residents’ per capita disposable income and 1.2 times for rural peasants’ per capita income.

zh: 所以，中国“具有中国特色的社会主义”经济制度，是越来越多的国民收入归国家所有的经济制度。
en: So, China’s “socialism with Chinese characteristics” is an economy where an increasing share of national income goes to the state.

zh: 尽管进行过私有化，但是，现在中国仍然有大约119000家国有企业，这些企业的账面价值大约有4万亿美元。
en: Despite privatization, there are roughly 119,000 state-owned enterprises today, with a book value of about $4 trillion.

zh: 中国国有土地的价值超过了7万亿美元。
en: State-owned land is valued at more than $7 trillion.

zh: 加起来，这些国有资产合计几乎达到了中国国家生产财富的四分之三。
en: Combined, these state-owned assets total almost three-quarters of China’s national productive wealth.

zh: 因为国家占有了这么多东西，所以在过去30年里，中国资产价值的收益都进入了政府的口袋。
en: With the state owning so much, most of the gains in asset values experienced over the past 30 years have gone into the government’s coffers.

zh: 当大多数家庭不拥有生产资产的时候，它们不能分享资产升值和财产受益。
en: When most households own no productive assets, they cannot share any of the asset appreciation or property income.

zh: 对大多数中国公民来说，工资是唯一的收入来源。
en: For most citizens, wages are the only source of income.

zh: 但是，在中国工资的增长速度远远低于GDP的增长速度。
en: But wages have grown at a far slower pace than GDP.

zh: 难怪中国的国内消费不能以与GDP相适应的方式增长。
en: No wonder domestic consumption cannot grow in a manner commensurate with GDP.

zh: 将中国从一个出口驱动型的经济体转变成为一个依靠国内消费的经济体需要进行两个根本性的改革。
en: Transforming China from an export-driven economy to one that relies on domestic consumption requires two fundamental reforms.

zh: 首先，剩下的国家资产的所有权应该公平地分配给13亿中国人。
en: First, ownership rights to the remaining state assets should be distributed equally to China’s 1.3 billion citizens.

zh: 这可以通过将这些资产置于国家财富基金之下，并免费将基金的份额分配给中国公民的方式来实现。
en: This can be done by putting these assets into national wealth funds and distributing the funds’ shares to citizens at no cost.

zh: 其次，政府的预算过程必须通过国家立法机构的公开听证和经过媒体的公众参与进行公开。
en: Second, the government budgeting process must be opened up through both public hearings in the national legislature and public participation via the media.

zh: 因为这样而增加的责任，可以使政府开支离开实体构造建设，向与人民需要相关的项目转移。
en: Such increased accountability will shift government spending toward programs related to people’s needs and away from physical structures.

zh: 没有这样的结构改革和通过减税以及退税将财政盈余返还给家庭的行动，中国政府建立在投资上的经济刺激努力最多可以在短期内对经济起到促进作用。
en: Without such structural reforms or returning fiscal surpluses to families through tax cuts and rebates, government investment-based stimulus efforts can provide, at best, a short-term economic boost.

zh: 它们不能改变中国的出口和投资导向型的政治－经济体��。
en: They cannot transform China’s export- and investment-oriented political-economic system.

zh: 事实上，即使在新的经济刺激一揽子计划之后，中国仍然依靠投资和出口带动增长。
en: Indeed, even after the new stimulus package, China will still depend on investment and export for growth.

zh: 30年来。 通过全民所有制和税收将资源集中到政府手中，对中国的发展起到了很大的作用。
en: For 30 years, concentrating resources in the government’s hands through state ownership and taxes has served China well.

zh: 它为中国“集中资源办大事”的国家建设政策提供了基础。
en: It provided a basis for China’s nation-building policy of “Concentrate Resources and Do Big Things.”

zh: 但是，现在中国已经有了体面的基础设施，令人印象深刻的大楼以及过剩的工业基础。
en: Today, however, China has decent infrastructure, impressive buildings, and an excessive industrial base.

zh: 中国缺乏的是促进内生性增长的足够的私人消费。
en: What is missing is sufficient private consumption to power endogenous growth.

zh: 为了改变这一点，中国需要提高其人民对未来的金融安全感，并使私人收入的增长和GDP的增长相适应。
en: To correct this, China needs to boost its people’s sense of future financial security and affect a rise in private income commensurate with GDP growth.

zh: 建设一个国家需要的不仅仅是钢铁和混凝土。
en: Building a nation demands more than steel and concrete.

zh: 中国的消费者共产主义
en: China’s Consumer Communism

zh: 自八十年代中期以来，中国发生了巨变。
en: China has changed dramatically since the mid-1980’s.

zh: 变化不仅仅是增加了让长久未来的访客不知所措的高速公路、广告牌以及摩天大楼。
en: It’s not just the increase in the number of freeways, billboards, and skyscrapers that disorient long-time visitors.

zh: 甚至去一下书店就足以让在几十年前了解中国的人震惊。 那时，非马列主义理论的著作会超过马列主义者是不可想象的。
en: Even a visit to a bookstore can shock anyone who first came to know China decades ago, when it seemed inconceivable that works by non-Marxist theorists would ever outnumber those by Marxists.

zh: 一家话剧演出公司甚至被允许上演乔治·奥维尔著名的反专制主义讽喻剧<<动物庄园>>。 社会主义阵营的读者以往只是通过地下版本知道这部作品。
en: A theatre company has even been allowed to stage “Animal Farm,” George Orwell’s famous anti-authoritarian allegory, once known to socialist-bloc readers only via underground editions.

zh: 当然，变化还要深刻。
en: The changes run deeper, of course.

zh: 在八十年代，城市马路上没有乞丐，而主要的社会分歧则只是将一小部分在政治上有后台、享受特权生活方式的人与平民百姓分离开来。
en: In the 1980’s, there were no beggars on city streets, and the main social cleavage divided the small number of politically well-connected people, who enjoyed a privileged lifestyle, from everyone else.

zh: 如今，乞丐与蓬勃兴起的中产阶级并存。
en: Now, there are both beggars and a burgeoning middle class.

zh: 以前在上海，星期六晚上无事可做。
en: It used to be difficult to find anything to do on a Saturday night in Shanghai.

zh: 现在，美国时代周刊把上海称为地球上“最为热闹非凡”的地方。
en: Now, Time magazine calls the city the “most happening” place on earth.
