zh: 当我在二十年前准备中国之行的时候，乔治·奥维尔的黑色名著<<1984年>>看起来就是一个观察这个“人民共和国”的有用的镜片。
en: While preparing for my first trip to China twenty years ago, George Orwell’s dark masterpiece, Nineteen Eighty-Four, seemed a useful lens through which to view this “people’s republic.”

zh: 当时中国的专制还没有严重到使其成为极度独裁的“大哥”国家的化身，但与之也有相似之处，如对各种“资产阶级”享受和娱乐活动的轻视和定期的坚持声称二加二等于五之类的宣传运动。
en: Control in China was not nearly rigid enough to make it the embodiment of an all-embracing, authoritarian Big Brother state, but there were parallels, from the disparagement of many forms of “bourgeois” enjoyment and entertainment to periodic propaganda campaigns insisting that two plus two equaled five.

zh: 然而，尽管发生了巨大的变化，当今天的国外评论员想要在评论中国的作品中引用文学典故时，奥维尔的作品仍然是首选。
en: Still, despite all the changes, when foreign commentators nowadays want to spice up a China piece with a literary allusion, Orwell remains the seasoning of choice.

zh: “大哥”陷入了实行互联网审查制度的报道里。
en: Big Brother is invoked in stories about Internet censorship.

zh: 当中国政府发布了人权《白皮书》后，其中的言辞在官方新闻语言中被大量引用。
en: When the authorities issue a White Paper on human rights, references are made to Newspeak.

zh: 但是，这仍旧是观察当今中国最好的镜子吗？ 奥尔德斯·贺胥黎是否提供了一个更为贴切的视角呢？
en: But is this really the best lens through which to see China now?

zh: 这个问题值得考虑。 他是奥维尔的老师，写过另外一部伟大的预言性政治小说 ― ― 《美丽新世界 》 。
en: It is worth considering whether Aldous Huxley, who taught Orwell at school and who wrote another great and portentous piece of political fiction, Brave New World, provides a more relevant perspective.

zh: 贺胥黎的名著比奥维尔的作品对唯物主义、精神控制、大众娱乐和社会分裂有更多的描述，提供了一个观察21世纪中国正在发生的变化的新视角。
en: Huxley’s masterpiece, which had more to say about materialism, mood-control, mass-distraction, and social fragmentation than Orwell’s, offers a new kind of insight into what is really happening in twenty-first-century China.

zh: 《美丽新世界》提供了一种诱导精神愉悦的药物“躯体”和名为“多感觉宣传媒介”的感官娱乐活动（与现在电子游戏和iPods所提供的引人入胜的娱乐活动相似 ） ， 增加了一个新的视角和观察维度，从中可以理解中国共产党作为一个经常变化的执政党所拥有的持久生命力。
en: With its bliss-inducing drug “soma” and sensuous entertainments known as “feelies,” which provided the sort of engrossing distraction now offered by video games and iPods, Brave New World’s perspective adds a new dimension to understanding the durability of the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) as a protean ruling party.

zh: 当然，官方新闻语言在很多地方仍然大行其道，在官方的声明和行动中也肯定有奥维尔的作品中所描述的那些事情的痕迹。
en: Of course, Newspeak is alive and well in many places, and there are certainly Orwellian echoes in the authorities’ pronouncements and actions.

zh: 但是奥维尔的批评无助于解释说明中国共产党令人惊奇的执政能力，尤其是在大多数社会主义国家变质之后，并且面临着普遍抗议的情况下，据估计2004年仅中国就爆发了74,000起分裂事件。
en: But Orwell’s critique doesn’t help in explaining the CCP’s surprising ability to retain power long after the demise of most of the socialist bloc, even in the face of widespread protests, including an estimated 74,000 separate incidents across China in 2004 alone.

zh: 在1949年也就是中华人民共和国成立的那一年阅读过《1984》年之后， 贺胥黎给他从前的学生写了一封信，对这本小说提出了表扬。
en: After reading Nineteen Eighty-Four in 1949, the year of the founding of the People’s Republic of China, Huxley sent his former pupil a letter praising the novel.

zh: 他对小说强调的通过掩耳盗铃式的技巧和娱乐方面严格的道德倾向进行统治做出了重点说明。
en: He noted the emphasis that it put on rule via “boot-on-the-face” techniques and puritanical distaste for pleasure.

zh: 但是贺胥黎思考是的下面这个问题，未来的统治精英通过如《美丽新世界》描述的性诱惑、娱乐和其它形式的娱乐活动努力使得被统治者与他们保持一致，这难道不是更有可能出现的吗？
en: But wasn’t it more likely, Huxley mused, that future ruling elites would strive to keep the governed in line by distracting them with sexual allurement, entertainment, and other forms of pleasure, à la Brave New World?

zh: 中国今天的消费文化在许多方面与贺胥黎描述的缓和剂完全一样。
en: In many ways, today’s Chinese consumer culture is precisely the kind of palliative that Huxley described.

zh: 《美丽新世界》中另一个控制策略是将民众之间的分隔界线最大化。
en: Another of Brave New World’s strategies for control was to maximize divisions among the populace.

zh: 在《1984》和《美丽新世界》中统治者与被统治者主要的区别是由完全不同的品味和生活方式决定的不同的社会等级。
en: Whereas the main distinction in Nineteen Eighty-Four is between rulers and ruled, in Brave New World, people are divided into different social orders defined by disparate tastes and lifestyles.

zh: 中国今天的情况与此类似，贫富、城乡、沿海和内地文化之间的差距如此之大，以至于与以前相比，不同阶层的人们感觉越来越难以拥有共同信念和目标。
en: The same could be said of China today, where the gaps between rich and poor, urban and rural populations, and coastal and inland culture are so great that it is much harder than before for people from varied walks of life to feel that they share common plights and goals.

zh: 当然，没有任何一本小说可以提供观察任何一个社会的完美的镜子。
en: Of course, no single novel provides a perfect lens through which to view any society.

zh: 有的时候，如平息中国南方抗议官员剥夺田地的农民暴乱时，中国共产党仍旧使用“掩耳盗铃”式的镇压方式。
en: Sometimes, such as when violence was recently used to quell South Chinese peasants protesting official land grabs, the CCP still shows its willingness to use “boot-on-the-face” suppression.

zh: 但是，最近更多的时候发生的更多的事件支持贺胥黎的政治等级观点而不是奥维尔的。
en: Still, there have been more moments lately that favor Huxley’s vision of political order over that of Orwell.

zh: 在我的第一次后1989年中国之旅中，一个酒吧间男服务员向我介绍了一个明确反映新的官方精神的习语 ： “ 没有运动，什么都可以 ” （ 只要没有政治运动，干什么都可以 ） 。
en: During my first post-1989 trip to China, a bartender introduced me to a phrase that perfectly characterized the new official mood: “Meiyou yundong, shenme dou keyi” (As long as there are no political movements, anything goes).

zh: 奥维尔描述的“大哥”不会觉得这种评论有趣。
en: Orwell’s Big Brother would not have been amused by this remark.

zh: 但《美丽新世界》中描述的统治精英则会对此付之一笑。
en: But a member of Brave New World’s ruling elite would have taken it in stride.

zh: 跛脚的中国金融部门
en: China’s Crippled Financial Sector

zh: 发自北京 — — 即便是在年景最好的时候，中国的中小企业也难以从银行获得贷款。
en: BEIJING – Even in the best of times, it is difficult for China’s small and medium-size enterprises to get bank loans.

zh: 如今随着政府为遏制经济过热和通胀压力而实施信贷紧缩，中小企业的日子也就更加难过了。 金融，这个中国改革最为滞后的部门，如今正压迫着整个国家经济的动力核心。
en: But with the current regimen of credit austerity, imposed to contain economic overheating and inflationary pressure, making conditions for SMEs worse, the financial sector – the least reformed sector in China – now is suffocating the beating heart of the country’s economic dynamism.

zh: 平时中小企业可以借助民间金融市场进行周转；但最近在以灵活私营经济著称的中国浙江省温州市所爆发的事件，却暴露了民间金融市场缺乏稳定且可靠性低的缺陷。
en: In normal times, the informal financial market helps SMEs to get by; but the recent woes of Wenzhou, a city in southern Zhejiang province renowned for its freewheeling private economy, have shown that the informal financial market can be very volatile and undependable.

zh: 当地几大借款人携巨额借款潜逃，普通企业的欠债违约现象也引发高度关注。
en: Several major lenders absconded with large amounts of deposits, and defaults by ordinary companies have become a serious concern.

zh: 形势如此恶劣，以致国家总理温家宝都得亲赴当地处理。
en: Things have gotten so bad as to warrant a visit by Premier Wen Jiabao.

zh: 中国的官方外汇储备几乎以每个工作日10亿美元的速度不断增加，其中绝大部分都用来购买回报率极低的美国国债或其他国际资产。
en: China’s official foreign reserves are increasing at a rate of about $1 billion per business day, almost all of which is used to buy US Treasury bonds and other international assets that carry a minimal rate of return.

zh: 与此同时，中国各大银行有40%的储蓄无法转化成贷款。
en: At the same time, about 40% of China’s bank savings are not lent out.

zh: 有人大概会认为这是资产回报低的缘故。
en: One might thus think that returns to capital are low in China.

zh: 但这个看法也是错误的，因为有研究显示中国的资产回报率自1990年代以来一直都高于10 % 。
en: But one would be wrong: studies have consistently shown that the rate of return to capital has been more than 10% since the late 1990s.

zh: 那么中国的中小企业为何要依赖民间金融市场来获取日常营运资金？
en: Why then, can’t China’s SMEs rely on the formal financial sector to finance their daily operations?

zh: 这是因为虽然其他国家的中小企业在争取银行贷款方面也相对较难，但其困难程度无法与中国相比；一系列调查都显示只有约10%的中国中小企业融资来自银行，是全球水平的1/2。
en: To be sure, it is not easy for SMEs in other countries to get formal financing. But not many countries are experiencing the same level of difficulties; surveys consistently show that only about 10% of Chinese SMEs’ finance comes from banks, while the global average doubles.

zh: 此外也没有一个国家拥有中国这样巨大的贸易顺差。
en: Moreover, none of these countries has a capital surplus of China’s magnitude.

zh: 而中小企业融资的主要障碍则是中国的地方政府，它们和中小企业争夺贷款并不出意外地将后者挤压出正式金融部门。
en: The main impediment in China is local governments, which compete with SMEs for bank loans and inevitably crowd them out from the formal banking sector.

zh: 地方政府以来银行信贷来支撑基础设施建设和房地产发展。
en: Local governments rely on bank credit to invest in infrastructure and real-estate development.

zh: 中国人民银行今年年初发布的报告显示全国近1/3的未偿还贷款（14万亿人民币，折合2.2万亿美元）由地方政府欠下。
en: A report released early this year by the People’s Bank of China showed that close to one-third of the country’s total outstanding loans, or 14 trillion renminbi ($2.2 trillion), were owed by local governments.

zh: 在过去几年，有30~40%的贷款被投入政府基础设施建设项目。
en: In the last few years, 30-40% of bank credits went to government infrastructure projects.

zh: 另外一个障碍则是大银行的统治地位。
en: Another impediment is the dominance of large banks.

zh: 中国四大银行的贷款额占全国总量的60 % 。
en: The four largest banks in China account for 60% of the country’s total bank lending.

zh: 虽然美国的银行部门也同样高度集中，但除此之外依然存在约1.8万家金融机构，包括商业银行、储蓄贷款协会，共同储蓄银行以及信贷联盟，相比之下中国只有大概400家商业银行，3000家农村信用合作社以及相关城镇金融机构。
en: While the US banking sector is similarly concentrated, it has far more financial institutions – roughly 18,000 commercial banks, savings and locals associations, mutual savings banks, and credit unions, compared to only around 400 commercial banks and 3,000 rural credit unions and township banks in China.

zh: 这意味着中国各银行的平均规模要比美国更大，如果考虑到两国GDP规模的巨大差异的话，这一点就更加显著。
en: This means that banks in China on average are larger than in the US, especially in view of the difference in the size of the two countries’ GDP.

zh: 为了节省成本，大型银行都倾向于大企业贷款。
en: Large banks tend to lend to large companies in order to save costs.

zh: 在先进经济体中，这种偏袒现象可以通过大银行提供的各种灵活金融工具来抵消。
en: This bias is mitigated in advanced economies by various flexible financing tools offered by large banks.

zh: 比如说信用历史良好的小企业可以通过一张由大机构发行的信用卡来借到很大一笔资金。
en: For example, a small business with a decent credit history can borrow large amounts with a major credit card.

zh: 但这种做法在中国尚不存在。
en: This is absent in China.

zh: 最后，正是这个跛脚的金融系统成为了横亘在中国巨大贸易顺差与中小企业正式金融部门通道之间的障碍。
en: In the end, it is the crippled financial system that is driving the wedge between China’s large surplus of capital and formal financing for the country’s SMEs.

zh: 事实上在中国南部的某些地区，民间金融部门正不断增大以适应正规金融部门的规模。
en: Indeed, in some parts of southern China, the informal financial sector is growing to match the size of the formal financial sector.

zh: 而从储蓄者的角度看，参与民间金融部门也是个理性的选择。
en: From depositors’ point of view, participating in the informal sector is a rational choice.

zh: 正式银行储蓄利率不但赶不上通胀率 — — 甚至比民间集资者承诺的利率还要低许多倍。
en: Bank interest rates on savings are lower than the inflation rate – and many multiples lower than the rates promised by the informal sector.

zh: 民间部门的默认利率都相当高，而且正如温州所发生的那样，集资者也会携款潜逃。
en: Default rates in the informal sector are high, and lenders may disappear with depositors’ money, as happened in Wenzhou.

zh: 但尽管存在这些风险，投资民间金融市场依然要比存银行更加划算。
en: But, despite these risks, investing in the informal market can still be a better choice than keeping one’s money in the bank.

zh: 过去20年的历史显示中国的货币和银行监管部门都喜欢对民间金融部门采取鸵鸟政策，自欺欺人地假装在监管这个领域，直到严重问题爆发为止。
en: The record of the last 20 years shows that the Chinese monetary and banking authorities have a habit of taking an ostrich approach to the informal financial sector, pretending that they are regulating the sector until serious problems emerge.

zh: 这不是长久之计，而改变则意味着必须认识到正式金融部门的缺点并采取补救措施。
en: This approach cannot last forever, and changing it means acknowledging the backwardness of the formal financial sector and taking remedial action.

zh: 而正如许多经济体多年来所提出的那样，相关部门应当迅速改变利率机制，使储蓄利率能反映投资的成本。
en: An immediate step that the authorities should take, as many economists have argued for years, is to allow the saving rate to reflect the cost of investment.

zh: 这样一般储户才能再次将钱存入银行，因为正式金融部门将提供给他们一个分享中国巨大增长的机会。
en: That way, ordinary depositors would put their savings back into banks, because the formal financial sector would offer them a way to tap into the benefits offered by China’s phenomenal growth.

zh: 而银行一方面能拥有更多的可支配储蓄，另一方面具备更灵活的利率政策，因此也能更容易地评估风险价格并因此贷款给广大中小企业。
en: With more deposits at their disposure and a more flexible interest rate policy, banks would be able to price risks more easily and thus lend more to SMEs.

zh: 中国的网络战士
en: China’s Cyber-Warriors

zh: 新德里 — — 对于每个国家都有责任保护大气层、水圈、岩石圈和生物圈等“全球公域”这一点，全世界已经达成了共识；而对于在我们的日常生活、经济福祉与安全中具有至关重要地位的网络空间，我们也必须实施同样的规范。
en: NEW DELHI – The world now accepts that protecting our atmosphere, hydrosphere, lithosphere, and biosphere – the “global commons” – is the responsibility of all countries. The same norm must apply to cyberspace, which is critical to our everyday life, economic well-being, and security.

zh: 在这个全球范围内、网络攻击日渐高发的时代，美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿采取了正确的做法，她宣布对一国计算机网络所实施的攻击 “将是对全体的攻击 ” 。
en: At a time when cyber attacks are increasing worldwide, US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton was right to declare that an attack on one nation’s computer networks “can be an attack on all.”

zh: 事实上，这些攻击便是在提醒人们：网络空间这一全球公域中新的成员，已经处在了威胁之下。
en: Indeed, the attacks are a reminder that, as a new part of the global commons, cyberspace already has come under threat.

zh: 网络空间必须与外层空间、国际水域以及国际空域一道，被视作为全人类所共有并造福于所有人的财产；而如果我们打算保卫这份共有财产与集体利益的话，那么网络犯罪就应当如海盗行为与劫机行为一样，绝不能被允许逍遥法外。
en: Cyberspace must be treated, along with outer space, international waters, and international airspace, as property held in common for the good of all. And, like ocean piracy and airplane hijacking, cyber-crime cannot be allowed to go unpunished if we are to safeguard our common assets and collective interests.

zh: 克林顿将中国列入一批已加强网络审查的国家名单之中，并就此警告说 ： “ 一道新的信息大幕已在全球许多地区降下 ” 。
en: Naming China among a handful of countries that have stepped up Internet censorship, Clinton warned that “a new information curtain is descending across much of the world.”

zh: 她的此番声明与关于冷战期间铁幕的暗示，相当于含蓄承认了自上世纪九十年代以来，引导美国对华政策的核心假设（即认为帮助中国经济崛起，将会为该国带来更大的政治开放性 ） ， 已经出现了问题。
en: Her statement, with its allusion to the Cold War-era Iron Curtain, amounted to an implicit admission that the central assumption guiding US policy on China since the 1990’s – that assisting China’s economic rise would usher in greater political openness there – has gone awry.

zh: 利用市场力量与互联网，以使封闭的政治体系得以开放的战略，明显没有奏效。
en: The strategy of using market forces and the Internet to open up a closed political system simply is not working.

zh: 事实上，中国所积累的经济力量越大，该国就越是变得擅长于将审查制度向网络空间进行推广。
en: Indeed, the more economic power China has accumulated, the more adept it has become in extending censorship to cyberspace.

zh: 中国至少已经证明了一国可以融合控制、强制与施以恩惠等多种手段，以阻碍互联网在政治层面上具有自由化效应的元素。
en: If anything, China has proven that a country can blend control, coercion, and patronage to stymie the Internet’s politically liberalizing elements.

zh: 通过谨慎却又强硬的控制措施，北京方面执行了一种外紧内松的政策（即外表松懈，内部警惕 ） 。
en: Through discreet but tough controls, Beijing pursues a policy of wai song, nei jin – relaxed on the outside, vigilant internally.

zh: 谷歌如今正在痛诉受到了一场“来自中国的、针对本公司基础设施的、高度复杂且极具针对性的攻击 ” 。
en: Google is now crying foul over “ a highly sophisticated and targeted attack on our corporate infrastructure originating from China.”

zh: 不过，尽管该公司有着“不要作恶”的格言，但它自身却在协助中国实施网络审查方面发挥过作用，谷歌为该国量身定制了一款搜索引擎，其搜索结果清除了所有被中国政府认为不妥的关联词与网站。
en: But, despite its corporate motto – “Don’t be evil” – Google itself was instrumental in aiding online censorship in China, having custom-built a search engine that purges all references and Web sites that the Chinese government considers inappropriate.

zh: 正如当年英法两国对希特勒实施绥靖战略、最终却自作自受一样，谷歌如今也成为了中国日益增强的网络能力之受害者。
en: Now Google itself has become a victim of China’s growing cyber prowess, in the same way that appeasement of Hitler boomeranged onto France and Britain.

zh: 中国部署了数万名“网警 ” ， 以封锁网站、在网吧中进行巡查、监控移动电话的使用、并追踪互联网上的活跃人士。
en: China deploys tens of thousands of “ cyber police” to block Web sites, patrol cyber-cafes, monitor the use of cellular telephones, and track down Internet activists.

zh: 但全球新的公域所受之威胁，并非来自于中国在其国内的做法，而是来自于另一个方面：即中国在构建国内网络监控这一过程中所学到的技术，已被证明对其从事跨境网络入侵的努力具有无从估量的价值这一点。
en: But the threat to the new global commons comes not from what China does domestically. Rather, it comes from the way in which the know-how that China has gained in fashioning domestic cyber oversight is proving invaluable to it in its efforts to engage in cyber intrusion across its frontiers.

zh: 加拿大研究者已经发现了中国的一个巨型监控系统 — — “幽灵网络 ” ， 该系统可以通过内含恶意代码的电子邮件侵入外国组织的计算机中，这些邮件可以自动进行扫描、并将文件传回位于中国的一个数字存储设施。
en: Canadian researchers have discovered a vast Chinese surveillance system called “GhostNet,” which can compromise computers in organizations abroad through booby-trapped e-mail messages that automatically scan and transfer documents to a digital storage facility in China.

zh: 这便是去年位于印度达兰萨拉地区的西藏流亡政府的计算机受到攻击时所上演的一幕。
en: This is what happened when computers of the Tibetan government-in-exile in Dharamsala, India, were attacked last year.

zh: 印度国家安全顾问于近日抱怨道，其办公室的电脑又一次成为了黑客的目标，他指出 ： “ 人们看起来很确信，攻击者是中国方面。
en: India’s national security adviser recently complained that his office was targeted yet again by hackers. “People seem to be fairly sure it was the Chinese,” he said.

zh: ”德国、英国以及美国的官员同样也承认：据信来自于中国的黑客，已侵入其政府与军方的网络之中。
en: Officials in Germany, Britain, and the US have acknowledged that hackers believed to be from China also have broken into their government and military networks.

zh: 这种受到国家支持的跨国网络威胁包括两个层次。
en: The state-sponsored transnational cyber threat is at two levels.

zh: 其中第一层带有国家性质，黑客主要关注于两种目标：一种目标是窃取机密、获得对他国的不均衡优势。
en: The first is national, with the hackers largely interested in two objectives. One is to steal secrets and gain an asymmetrical advantage over another country.

zh: 和平时期的网络入侵，使侵入者可以知晓网络中的内容、并了解不同计算机网络的相对重要性，这样它便知道在冲突发生时、应当使哪些网络陷入瘫痪了。
en: Cyber intrusion in peacetime allows the prowler to read the content and understand the relative importance of different computer networks so that it knows what to disable in a conflict situation.

zh: 另一种目标则事关商业方面，即窃取知识产权。
en: The other objective is commercial: to pilfer intellectual property.

zh: 第二层威胁则针对特定的个体。
en: The second level of cyber threat is against chosen individuals.

zh: 试图侵入电子邮件账户是其中最为常见的入侵方式；目标个体也会面对通过邮件实施的木马攻击，这些攻击旨在侵入用户电脑，并允许渗透者对文件进行远程破坏或传送。
en: The most common type of intrusion is an attempt to hack into e-mail accounts. The targets also can face Trojan-horse attacks by e-mail intended to breach their computers and allow the infiltrators to corrupt or transfer files remotely.

zh: 当然，如果网络攻击被施以伪装的话，人们就难以辨识出发动攻击的国家了。
en: To be sure, if a cyber attack is camouflaged, it is not easy to identify the country from which it originated.

zh: 通过运用所谓“冒充他人进行的间谍活动”或其他一些方式，网络攻击就可以取道第三国的电脑。
en: Through the use of so-called “false-flag espionage” and other methods, attacks can be routed through the computers of a third country.

zh: 正如某些中国制药企业向非洲出口标明“印度生产”的假药一样（这是中国政府承认的事实 ） ， 人们也知道某些中国黑客经由俄罗斯、伊朗、古巴以及其他国家的计算机实施其网络入侵行动。
en: Just as some Chinese pharmaceutical firms exported to Africa spurious medicines with “Made in India” labels – a fact admitted by the Chinese government – some Chinese hackers are known to have routed their cyber intrusion through computers in Russia, Iran, Cuba, and other countries.

zh: 不过，正如制药行业的同党一样，这类黑客也会留下泄露身份的记号。
en: But, like their comrades in the pharmaceutical industry, such hackers tend to leave telltale signs.

zh: 于是，在许多情况下，黑客直接从中国发动袭击。
en: Then there are many cases in which the attacks have originated directly from China.

zh: 这些黑客（尤其是参与网络间谍活动、窃密活动或恐吓行动的黑客 ） ， 看起来不大可能是一些与中国政府没有关系的独立个人；更有可能的情况是：这些黑客与人民解放军之间有着关联。
en: It seems unlikely that these hackers, especially those engaged in cyber espionage, pilferage, and intimidation, are private individuals with no links to the Chinese government. It is more likely that they are tied to the People’s Liberation Army.

zh: 在战争中，这种非正规的黑客分队将成为解放军与敌交战前的先头部队。
en: In war, this irregular contingent of hackers would become the vanguard behind which the PLA takes on the enemy.

zh: 当世界已在面对着包括跨国恐怖主义在内的、其他非常规威胁之际，系统性网络攻击又构成了非对称战争的一条新战线。
en: Systematic cyber attacks constitute a new frontier of asymmetrical warfare at a time when the world already confronts other unconventional threats, including transnational terrorism.

zh: 由于国家安全与繁荣如今依赖于网络空间的安全保障，因此对网络犯罪加以有效回击一事，必须成为国际社会的优先关注；如若不然，则网络空间将蜕变为新的全球共同战场。
en: With national security and prosperity now dependent on the safekeeping of cyberspace, cybercrime must be effectively countered as an international priority. If not, cyberspace will become the new global-commons battlefield.

zh: 中国趋于老化的人口
en: China’s Decrepit Population

zh: 中国政府最终似乎认识到了这个国家日趋老化的人口所带的紧迫挑战。
en: China’s government finally appears to be acknowledging the urgent challenges presented by the country’s aging population.

zh: 12月12日，中国政府第一次发表了关于该问题的白皮书，希望尽力克服越来越高的社会保险和医疗费用、日趋严峻的劳动力市场以及其他潜在的障碍以便继续推动其经济的快速增长。
en: On December 12, it released a cabinet-level White Paper on the problem – the first of its kind ­– in an effort to grapple with the prospect of rising social-security and healthcare costs, a tightening labor market, and other potential obstacles to continue rapid economic growth.

zh: 回过头来看，中国政府在1979年开始实行的严厉的“独生子女”政策，与旨在吸引劳动密集型的外国制造业投资的“开放”政策在同时实行很具有讽刺意味。
en: Looking back, it is ironic that the Chinese government’s draconian “one-child” policy, imposed in 1979, was implemented at the same time as the “open door” policy, aimed at capturing labor-intensive foreign manufacturing investment.

zh: 两项政策应该说都取得了成功，但是多年以后计划生育政策所带来的是越来越老化的人口，这也许会削弱中国作为一个低费用的劳动密集型制造中心的吸引力。
en: While both policies must be regarded as successes, over the years the family planning program has contributed to an aging population that may diminish China’s attractiveness as a low-cost, labor-intensive manufacturing hub.

zh: 在“独生子女”政策推行的近三十年时间里，每年出生的新生儿从二十世纪八十年代早期的2250万降到了近几年的大约1600-1700万。
en: During the nearly three decades since the “one-child” policy was introduced, live births have dropped from 22.5 million per year in the early 1980’s to around 16-17 million by the middle of this decade.

zh: 此外，因为预期寿命的增高带来了老年人口的增加，这种低出生率使得65岁以上的老年人的比率从总人口的4.9%增加到了7.7 % 。
en: Moreover, with the number of elderly growing as a result of rising life expectancy, this low birth rate has pushed the share of those aged 65 and above from 4.9% of the total population to 7.7%.

zh: 根据联合国人口部（UNPD）的“中期变化”推测，如果不改革“独生子女”政策，中国15岁以下的人口比率将从2000年的24.8%降到2050年的15.7 % ， 而65岁以上人口的比率将从6.8%飞升到23.6 % 。
en: According to the United Nations Population Division’s (UNPD) “medium-variant” projections, without reform of the “one-child” policy, the share of China’s population aged 15 and below would decline from 24.8% in 2000 to 15.7% in 2050, while the share of those aged 65 and above would soar from 6.8% to 23.6%.

zh: 由于可以补充进劳动力的孩子的数量越来越少，那些15岁到64岁之间符合劳动年龄的人口的比率将从68.4%降到60.7 % 。
en: With fewer children to replenish the workforce, the working-age cohort of those 15-64 years old would shrink from 68.4% to 60.7%.

zh: 因此中国老年人口的比率会比其他的一些新兴的大的经济体，比如巴西、印度、印度尼西亚和墨西哥要高得多。
en: The elderly would thus account for a far greater share of China’s population than in other large emerging economies, such as Brazil, India, Indonesia, and Mexico.

zh: 中国的人口趋势对其经济会带来很多负面的影响。
en: China’s demographic trends hold several adverse implications for its economy.

zh: 因为人口的急剧老化以及劳动力的减少，税收收入将会萎缩，而养老金和医疗费用的增长会严重破坏财政状况。
en: With a rapidly aging population and a shrinking workforce, tax revenue will contract, while expenditure on pensions and health care will expand, undermining the fiscal position.

zh: 由私营部门的经济学家和世界银行的官员所作出的种种预测表明政府累积得越来越高的“净隐性养老金债务”可能会膨胀到GDP的75-110 % 。
en: Various estimates by private-sector economists and World Bank officials suggest that the government’s accumulated “net implicit pension debt” could balloon to 75-110% of GDP.

zh: 此外，符合劳动年龄的人口的下降会压缩劳动力的供给，刺激工资水平的上升，并且侵蚀这个国家的经济竞争力。
en: Furthermore, the decline in the working-age cohort would squeeze labor supply, fueling wage growth and eroding the country’s economic competitiveness.

zh: 在制造业最密集的长江三角洲和珠江三角洲，已经出现了劳动力的短缺。
en: Already, in the Yangtze and Pearl River Deltas, where manufacturing activity is the densest, labor shortages have appeared.

zh: 比如，在2004年，广东省不得不强制最低工资提高了20%以便吸引其他地区的工人。
en: In 2004, for example, Guangdong Province had to raise the mandatory minimum wage by as much as 20% to attract workers from other regions.

zh: 为了雇用和留住有技术的工人，许多外资企业通常会支付比最低工资高的薪金。
en: To hire and retain skilled workers, many foreign-invested enterprises routinely pay above the minimum wage.

zh: 但是一些外国制造商为了控制越来越高的劳动力费用，已经开始把生产从中国转到工资更便宜的地方，比如越南，那里工厂工人的平均月工资是50-60美元，只有中国的一半。
en: But some foreign manufacturers, seeking to cap rising labor costs, are shifting production from China to cheaper destinations such as Vietnam, where average monthly wages for factory workers is $50-60 – half that of China.

zh: 越南的外国直接投资（FDI）2005年上升了40 % ， 主要的投资者来自日本、韩国和台湾。
en: Foreign direct investment (FDI) in Vietnam grew by 40% in 2005, led by investors from Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan.

zh: 中国境内的外国直接投资2006年的头七个月在2005年下降了0.5%的基础上又下降了1.2 % ， 而来自日本、韩国和台湾的总体投资在2006年的上半年大幅下降了31 % ， 2005年则下降了6.5 % 。
en: China’s inward FDI fell 1.2% in the first seven months of 2006, after a 0.5% decline in 2005, while combined investment from Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan plummeted 31% in the first half of 2006, compared to the 6.5% decline in 2005.

zh: 这些数字只是一个日趋明显的趋势的早期警告。
en: These figures are only the early warnings of an emerging trend.

zh: 从长远看，随着劳动力的短缺变得越来越严峻，中国需要放弃一些低级的、劳动密集型的制造活动，这会使它的出口减速并且放慢经济增长的速度。
en: In the long run, as labor shortages become acute, China will need to relinquish some low-end, labor-intensive manufacturing activities, which will translate into decelerating export performance and lower economic growth.

zh: 除放弃“独生子女”政策，中国参照香港、新加坡、韩国和台湾的做法通过攀升制造业和服务业的价值链来防止这一结果。
en: Aside from abandoning the “one-child” policy, China could avoid this outcome by climbing the value chain in manufacturing and services, as Hong Kong, Singapore, South Korea, and Taiwan have done.

zh: 然而，中国要想获得成功，还必须加大其在研发上的投资力度，以及对教育体制进行彻底的改革。
en: However, for China to succeed, higher investment in research and development, together with a fundamental overhaul of the educational system, is essential.

zh: 根据经合组织的估计，中国目前的研发费用只占其GDP的1.3 % ， 而日本是3.2 % ， 韩国、台湾和美国的平均水平是2.5%到2.6 % 。
en: According to OECD estimates, China’s current expenditure on R&D amounts to only 1.3% of GDP, compared to 3.2% in Japan and an average of 2.5-2.6% in South Korea, Taiwan, and the United States.

zh: 尽管政府最近宣布它将把研发费用在2010年提高到GDP的2 % ， 但是这依然低于经合组织2.2%的平均水平。
en: Although the government recently announced that it intends to increase R&D spending to 2% of GDP by 2010, this remains below the OECD average of 2.2%.

zh: 至于中国落后的教育体制，尽管每年的大学毕业生很多，但是因为他们总体上无法达到标准的素质，这一数字没有多大意义。
en: As for China’s backward educational system, the large number of university graduates is offset by their overall sub-standard quality.

zh: 根据一项最近由麦肯尼什公司所作的调查，在中国的大专院校每年出来的超过300万的大学毕业生中，因为缺少实际锻炼和差劲的英语水平，只有不到10%的人能够在国际公司担任工作。
en: According to a recent survey by McKinsey & Company, of the more than three million graduates churned out by China’s universities and colleges every year, less than 10% are suitable for employment with international companies, owing to their deficiencies in practical training and poor English.

zh: 考虑到这些制度性的弱点，中国是否能通过转向一个以创新和生产效率为推动的经济从而克服其劳动力的短缺依然值得怀疑。
en: In view of these systemic weaknesses, China’s ability to overcome its labor deficit by shifting to an innovation- and productivity-driven economy remains dubious.

zh: 中国的隐形战争
en: China’s Stealth Wars

zh: 新德里 — — 中国正在不费一枪一弹颠覆南海东海、中印边界甚至跨国流域的现有版图。
en: NEW DELHI – China is subverting the status quo in the South and East China Seas, on its border with India, and even concerning international riparian flows – all without firing a single shot.

zh: 就像20世纪50年代悄悄跨过喜马拉雅侵占领土一样，中国正在对亚洲邻国发动对整个区域构成威胁的隐形战争。
en: Just as it grabbed land across the Himalayas in the 1950’s by launching furtive encroachments, China is waging stealth wars against its Asian neighbors that threaten to destabilize the entire region.

zh: 中国积累的经济实力越强，在改变地区现状时就愈加野心勃勃。
en: The more economic power China has amassed, the greater its ambition to alter the territorial status quo has become.

zh: 纵观中国近代摆脱贫困实现相对繁荣并跻身全球经济强国的过程，其基本的政治手段和战略理念并没有多大改变。
en: Throughout China’s recent rise from poverty to relative prosperity and global economic power, the fundamentals of its statecraft and strategic doctrine have remained largely unchanged.

zh: 从毛泽东时代起中国就坚定贯彻周朝军事战略家孙武利用敌方弱点以攻为守实现“不战而屈人之兵”的理念。
en: Since the era of Mao Zedong, China has adhered to the Zhou Dynasty military strategist Sun Tzu’s counsel: “subdue the enemy without any battle” by exploiting its weaknesses and camouflaging offense as defense.

zh: “兵不厌诈”是孙武的名言。
en: “All warfare,” Sun famously said, “is based on deception.”

zh: 在邓小平稳固共产党统治后的20余年里，中国一直在与亚洲国家关系领域奉行“睦邻友好”的政策，从而将全部精力用于国内经济发展。
en: For more than two decades after Deng Xiaoping consolidated power over the Chinese Communist Party, China pursued a “good neighbor” policy in its relations with other Asian countries, enabling it to concentrate on economic development.

zh: 随着中国经济和战略影响力不断扩大，相邻国家也从中国GDP快速增长中得到好处，刺激了本国经济的发展。
en: As China accumulated economic and strategic clout, its neighbors benefited from its rapid GDP growth, which spurred their own economies.

zh: 但在过去10年中的某个时点，中国领导人显然决定属于中国的时刻已经到来；自此之后，中国的“和平崛起”被更自信的姿态所取代。
en: But, at some point in the last decade, China’s leaders evidently decided that their country’s moment had finally arrived; its “peaceful rise” has since given way to a more assertive approach.

zh: 这种转变的最早迹象之一是中国在2006年重又提起对印度领土阿鲁纳恰尔邦的主权要求。
en: One of the first signs of this shift was China’s revival in 2006 of its long-dormant claim to Indian territory in Arunachal Pradesh.

zh: 为扩大其“核心利益 ” ， 中国很快就开始与几个邻国挑起领土争端。
en: In a bid to broaden its “core interests,” China soon began to provoke territorial disputes with several of its neighbors.

zh: 去年，中国依据联合国海洋法公约正式要求南海超过80%海域的主权。
en: Last year, China formally staked a claim under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea to more than 80% of the South China Sea.

zh: 从利用其强势贸易地位到倚仗其对稀土等重要资源的全球垄断，中国在亚洲采取了更加霸气外露的姿态。
en: From employing its strong trade position to exploiting its near-monopoly on the global production of vital resources like rare-earth minerals, China has staked out a more domineering role in Asia.

zh: 事实上，中国越是公开接受市场资本主义就越是倒向民族主义，因为其领导人为巩固政治合法地位需要用某种理论来取代马克思主义教条。
en: In fact, the more openly China has embraced market capitalism, the more nationalist it has become, encouraged by its leaders’ need for an alternative to Marxist dogma as a source of political legitimacy.

zh: 因此中国的国家重建很难与领土主权问题分开。
en: Thus, territorial assertiveness has become intertwined with national renewal.

zh: 中国由资源驱动的隐形战争正在成为亚洲地缘政治动荡的主要原因。
en: China’s resource-driven stealth wars are becoming a leading cause of geopolitical instability in Asia.

zh: 中国采用的手段多种多样，包括准军事海事机构配备的新型隐形战机。
en: The instruments that China uses are diverse, including a new class of stealth warriors reared by paramilitary maritime agencies.

zh: 这种战机已经积累了一定的成功战例。
en: And it has already had some victories.

zh: 去年，中国部署舰艇并设置进入壁垒禁止菲律宾渔民进入其传统的捕鱼保留地，从而有效控制了斯卡伯勒浅滩。 对南海上述海域提出过主权要求的还包括菲律宾和台湾。
en: Last year, China effectively took control of the Scarborough Shoal, an area of the South China Sea that is also claimed by the Philippines and Taiwan, by deploying ships and erecting entry barriers that prohibit Filipino fishermen from accessing their traditional fishing preserve.

zh: 中国和菲律宾至今仍在对峙。
en: China and the Philippines have been locked in a standoff ever since.

zh: 目前菲律宾正面临迫不得已的战略选择：要么接受中国指定的现实，要么甘冒全面开战的危险。
en: Now the Philippines is faced with a strategic Hobson’s choice: accept the new Chinese-dictated reality or risk an open war.

zh: 中国同时在东海发动了一场隐形战争，对1895年开始由日本控制（其间1945到1972年曾由美国管辖）的资源丰富的尖阁列岛（中国称钓鱼岛）宣誓领土主权。
en: China has also launched a stealth war in the East China Sea to assert territorial claims over the resource-rich Senkaku Islands (called the Diaoyu Islands in China), which Japan has controlled since 1895 (aside from a period of administration by the United States from 1945 to1972).

zh: 中国迫使国际社会承认存在主权争议的开局策略已经成功，这预示着对现状的进一步破坏不可避免。
en: China’s opening gambit – to compel the international community to recognize the existence of a dispute – has been successful, and portends further disturbance of the status quo.

zh: 同样，中国也对印度提出了新的挑战。 中国从多侧面加大战略压力，包括重新要求旧有的领土主权。
en: Likewise, China has been posing new challenges to India, ratcheting up strategic pressure on multiple flanks, including by reviving old territorial claims.

zh: 鉴于中印两国拥有全世界最长也最富争议的陆地边界，印度受到来自中国的直接军事压力尤为明显。
en: Given that the countries share the world’s longest disputed land border, India is particularly vulnerable to direct military pressure from China.

zh: 阿鲁纳恰尔邦是中国要求的最大一片领土，中国称其为西藏的一部分，面积几乎相当于三个台湾。
en: The largest territory that China seeks, Arunachal Pradesh, which it claims is part of Tibet, is almost three times the size of Taiwan.

zh: 近年来，中国一再试图突破从资源丰富的阿鲁纳恰尔邦绵延到查谟和克什米尔拉达克地区的喜马拉雅边境 — — 中国的行动往往成功，因为边境线荒凉辽阔，非常难于巡逻。
en: In recent years, China has repeatedly attempted to breach the Himalayan frontier stretching from resource-rich Arunachal Pradesh to the Ladakh region of Jammu and Kashmir – often successfully, given that the border is vast, inhospitable, and difficult to patrol.

zh: 中国的目的是刺激印度，也可能意在向南推进实际控制线。
en: China’s aim is to needle India – and possibly to push the Line of Actual Control southward.

zh: 事实上在4月15日，中国军队的一个排趁夜色悄悄越过拉达克地区的边境实际控制线，在深入印度占领区19公里（12英里）的地方安营扎寨。
en: Indeed, on April 15, a platoon of Chinese troops stealthily crossed the LAC at night in the Ladakh region, establishing a camp 19 kilometers (12 miles) inside Indian-held territory.

zh: 中国的强制外交政策由此开始，仅在印度摧毁其构筑的防御工事后才被迫撤军。
en: China then embarked on coercive diplomacy, withdrawing its troops only after India destroyed a defensive line of fortifications.

zh: 中国还提交了一份意在冻结迟构建筑的单方面协议草案，一方面遏阻印度构建边境防御工事，一方面可以让中国在没有任何预警的情况下发动袭击。
en: It also handed a lopsided draft agreement that seeks to freeze the belated, bumbling Indian build-up of border defenses while preserving China’s capability to strike without warning.

zh: 印度也制定了自己的协议草案防止边境暴力冲突。
en: India has countered with its own draft accord designed specifically to prevent border flare-ups.

zh: 但领土并不是中国隐形战争的唯一目的；在流域关系方面中国也在试图破坏现状。
en: But territory is not the only objective of China’s stealth wars; China is also seeking to disturb the status quo when it comes to riparian relations.

zh: 事实上，中国为扩大其对邻国的影响力几乎悄悄启动了再造跨界河流的大坝项目。
en: Indeed, it has almost furtively initiated dam projects to reengineer cross-border river flows and increase its leverage over its neighbors.

zh: 亚洲国家应当和美国一道化解亚洲的安全赤字并建立区域规范。
en: Asian countries – together with the US – should be working to address Asia’s security deficit and establish regional norms.

zh: 但中国以支配和操纵遏制合作的政治手段破坏了这些国家的努力。
en: But China’s approach to statecraft, in which dominance and manipulation trump cooperation, is impeding such efforts.

zh: 这致使另一地区强国美国进退两难：要么眼睁睁看着中国逐步破坏现状，削弱其盟国及战略伙伴的力量，要么冒着损害对华（中国是关乎美国最核心利益的亚洲国家）关系的危险采取对策。
en: This presents the US, the region’s other leading actor, with a dilemma: watch as China gradually disrupts the status quo and weakens America’s allies and strategic partners, or respond and risk upsetting its relationship with China, the Asian country most integral to its interests.

zh: 无论哪种选择所产生的影响都将十分深远。
en: Either choice would have far-reaching consequences.

zh: 在此背景下，确保亚洲和平稳定的唯一方法是采取诱使中国接受现状的第三种选择。
en: Against this background, the only way to ensure peace and stability in Asia is to pursue a third option: inducing China to accept the status quo.

zh: 这要求我们必须放弃欺骗和边缘政策，并采取基于互利合作的全新政治手段。
en: That will require a new brand of statecraft based on mutually beneficial cooperation – not brinkmanship and deception.

zh: 中国的核心？
en: A Chinese Pivot?

zh: 新德里 — — 在新任主席习近平领导下，中国是否正在谋求与美国“亚洲核心”政策相对应的外交核心政策？
en: NEW DELHI – Is China, under its new president, Xi Jinping, undertaking its own diplomatic pivot, parallel to the United States’ “pivot to Asia”?

zh: 习上任后将俄罗斯选为首次正式出访的目的地，之后又即刻赶赴南非出席金砖四国峰会，这些重大的国际举措均表明中国有可能将与世界最大新兴国家的关系提升至与中美关系同等的地位。
en: Xi’s first significant international initiatives – making Russia his first official visit abroad, followed immediately by his attendance at the BRICS summit in South Africa – suggest that China may be seeking to place its relations with the world’s most powerful emerging countries on a par with its US diplomacy.

zh: 其实，习最近发表的中印关系声明证实了上述猜测，他称中印关系是中国“最重要的双边关系”之一。
en: Indeed, this possibility is supported by Xi’s recent statement about relations with India, which he termed “one of the most important bilateral relationships” for China.

zh: 习上任伊始对中印关系的关注有别于其他中国领导人。
en: Xi’s early focus on Sino-Indian relations is unusual for a Chinese leader.

zh: 他提出与贾瓦哈拉尔·尼赫鲁的“和平共处五项原则”近似的中印关系五点建议 ， “ 和平共处五项原则”首载于1954年的两国《和平共处五项原则条约 》 。
en: He enunciated a five-point platform, rather like Jawaharlal Nehru’s “five principles of peaceful coexistence,” implemented in the two countries’ Panchsheel Treaty of 1954.

zh: 习建议在最终解决领土问题之前，中印两国应合作维护和平安定，防止边界争端影响到两国的整体关系。
en: According to Xi’s platform, pending a final settlement of territorial issues, the two countries should cooperate to maintain peace and tranquility and prevent border disputes from affecting the overall relationship.

zh: 中印两国应保持密切的战略沟通，以确保双边关系“走上正轨 ” 。
en: China and India should maintain close strategic communications in order to keep bilateral relations on the “right track.”

zh: 此外，两国应充分利用彼此的比较优势，在基础设施、投资和其他领域扩大互利合作；两国应巩固文化纽带推进并扩大友谊；增强多边论坛合作，在应对全球挑战中捍卫发展中国家的合法权益。
en: Moreover, the two countries should harness each other’s comparative strengths and expand mutually beneficial cooperation in infrastructure, investment, and other areas; strengthen cultural ties to advance an expanding friendship; and enhance their cooperation in multilateral forums to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of developing countries in tackling global challenges.

zh: 最后，两国应充分重视对方的核心关切。
en: Finally, they should accommodate each other’s core concerns.

zh: 虽然去年十一月任中共总书记、今年三月任国家主席以来习近平主要忙于处理国内事务，但中印关系却可以直接影响到中国的国内局势。
en: While Xi has been preoccupied with his country’s domestic challenges since becoming Chinese Communist Party (CCP) General-Secretary last November, and now as president since March, relations with India can have a direct impact on internal conditions.

zh: 比方说，中国的警察及安全部队因希望制止其南部省份云南的贩毒行为而对缅甸局势有着浓厚的兴趣，而印度也同样关注缅甸的局势。
en: For example, China’s desire to prevent drug trafficking in its southern province of Yunnan means that its police and security forces are taking a keen interest in what happens in Myanmar, a country that is also of special interest to India.

zh: 当然还有中国最大的国内安全隐患西藏，一直存在着领土纠纷导致中印间的紧张局势。
en: Then, of course, there is Tibet, perhaps China’s greatest domestic security concern, and also a perennial source of tension with India, owing to territorial disputes.

zh: 达赖喇嘛最近对存在争议的阿鲁纳恰尔邦达旺寺的访问引起中国愤怒充分显示了这个问题的严重性。
en: China’s recent anger over a visit by the Dalai Lama to the Tawang monastery in Arunachal Pradesh, Indian territory claimed by China, suggests just how potent this issue remains.

zh: 中国现代国际关系研究院首席南亚战略分析师胡仕胜认为此类访问并不意味着“印中关系处于不稳定状态 ” ， 但潜在的麻烦的确也不容小觑。
en: Hu Shisheng, a leading South Asia strategic analyst at the China Institutes for Contemporary International Relations, has suggested that such visits do not mean that “India-China relations are [in a state of] disturbance,” though the potential for trouble remains high.

zh: 但在习近平领导下，中国似乎更愿意强调积极因素。
en: Under Xi, however, China seems to be accentuating the positive.

zh: 中共官方报纸《人民时报》最近指出两大最重要的“中印利益领域 ” 。
en: The CCP’s official newspaper, the People’s Daily, recently identified the “two areas of interest with India” that matter most.

zh: 在“有效控制”边界问题的基础上更多地关注“贸易及多边问题 ” ， 因为在上述领域取得成功能够翻开两国关系史上更受人欢迎的“新”篇章。
en: With the border issue “effectively controlled,” there should be greater focus on “trade and multilateral issues,” where success could bring about a “new” and welcome “chapter” in bilateral ties.

zh: 中印两国间的“不信任”是否在逐步减少？
en: So is “mistrust” between the two powers diminishing?

zh: 《人民日报》似乎认为现阶段双边关系处于正常状态。
en: The People’s Daily seems to consider bilateral relations as normal at this point.

zh: 印度似乎同样充满了希望。
en: India appears to be equally hopeful.

zh: 事实上，一名印度高官不久前在谈及南海紧张局势时说 ： “ 我们不能想当然地认为无法避免印中海上争夺。 ”
en: Indeed, a senior Indian official,speaking about tensions in the South China Sea, was recently quoted as saying: “You can’t assume that India-China maritime rivalry is inevitable.”

zh: “印度－太平洋同属一个地缘政治区域 ” ， 这名官员说 ， “ 但我们看看印度洋的情况。
en: The “Indo-Pacific is one geopolitical area,” the official reportedly said, “but look at the situation in the Indian Ocean.

zh: 南海、日本海或西太平洋等中国近海的局势是完全不同的。
en: The situation near China, whether in the East China Sea, near Japan, or in the West Pacific, is completely different.

zh: 印、中、美都需要运输能源的海上通道。 ”
en: India, China, and the US – everyone needs sea links; everybody’s energy goes through it.”

zh: 但印度国防部一份机要报告强调“越开越多的中国潜艇进入印度洋水域，并由此对印度的安全利益构成威胁。
en: A classified report from India’s defense ministry, however, emphasizes the “increasing number of Chinese submarines venturing into the Indian Ocean region, thus posing [risks] to India’s security interests.”

zh: ”报告显示“去年有据可查的与北京领海外巡逻的中国攻击潜艇的遭遇多达22次 ” ， 并警告称中国海军的“潜在焦点”似乎是“对高度敏感的海上交通线进行控制。 ”
en: The report indicated that at least “22 contacts were recorded with vessels suspected to be Chinese attack submarines patrolling outside Beijing’s territorial waters last year,” and warned that the “implicit focus” of China’s navy appears to be “to control highly sensitive sea lines of communication.”

zh: 习在向印度示好的同时也在与中国的另一大型邻国俄罗斯发展关系。
en: Xi’s efforts to cement ties with China’s other huge neighbor, Russia, should be seen as complementing his outreach to India.

zh: 习充分利用了俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京对美国和西方的明显轻视。
en: Here, Xi has been aided by Russian President Vladimir Putin’s evident disdain for the US and the West.

zh: 在这方面中国也有着同样的疑虑；事实上，习近平宣布俄中两国在地缘政治领域“拥有众多的共同利益。 ”
en: China shares Russia’s suspicions in this regard; indeed, Xi proclaimed that, in terms of geopolitics, Russia and China “speak a common language.”

zh: 当然，有一些密切中俄关系的理由完全合理。
en: There are, of course, perfectly legitimate reasons for close Sino-Russian relations.

zh: 双方均为上海合作组织的合作伙伴。
en: They are partners in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization.

zh: 中国是世界最大的能源消费国，而俄罗斯是最大的能源生产国。
en: China is the world’s largest energy consumer, while Russia is the biggest energy provider.

zh: 双边贸易蓬勃发展，每年贸易额高达880亿美元之巨。
en: And bilateral trade is booming, worth $88 billion per year.

zh: 习近平自身的区域核心政策应当是“振兴中华民族”宏伟目标的一部分，这本质上要求中国恢复其曾经有过的亚洲领导地位。
en: Xi’s own regional pivot should be viewed as part of his grand vision of a “revitalization of the Chinese nation,” which essentially calls for China to resume the paramount leadership in Asia that it has exercised for much of its history.

zh: 他的目标十分宏大，但他和中国人民似乎决意要将它变成现实。
en: His ambitions are vast, yet he, and the Chinese people, appear determined to achieve them.

zh: 这与印度朦胧的战略目标不可同日而语。
en: That is far more than can be said of India’s rather wooly strategic meanderings.

zh: 演化中的中国合约网络
en: China’s Evolving Web

zh: 发自香港 — — 经济学家阿克塞尔·莱琼霍夫德（Axel Leijonhufvud）在近期的一篇文章中将市场体系定义为一个合约网络。
en: HONG KONG – In a recent article, the economist Axel Leijonhufvud defines the market system as a web of contracts.

zh: 由于合约之间彼此关联，一份合同的违约可能影响一系列承诺的兑现，如雪崩一般不断扩大，进而“破坏市场体系正常运转所需要的整个正式与非正式合约的网络系统 ” 。
en: Because contracts are linked with each other, one default can trigger an avalanche of broken promises, “[making] it possible to destroy virtually the entire web of formal and informal contracts which the market system requires for its functioning.”

zh: 国家的作用正是保护、强制执行并规范这些合约以及相关的财产权利，并适时干预以防系统性失灵。
en: The state’s role is to protect, enforce, and regulate these contracts and related property rights, as well as to intervene to prevent systemic failure.

zh: 主流经济学家往往将合约网络系统视作理所当然的，以至于几乎对其视而不见。 合约网络界定了市场体系内的正式与非正式规则，同时塑造并约束了个人及社会行为。
en: This web of contracts – often taken for granted in mainstream economics, to the extent that it becomes almost invisible – embodies the formal and informal rules embedded in the market system that shape and constrain individual and social behavior.

zh: 因此，可以说合约网络是构造人类所有制度的基础材料。
en: They form the fabric of all human institutions.

zh: 发达经济体有着非常复杂的合约网络，例如金融衍生产品。
en: Advanced economic systems have very complex webs of contracts, such as financial derivatives.

zh: 莱琼霍夫德指出，应对当前的欧洲危机需要关注三重问题的相互叠加 ： “ 杠杆率 ” 、 “期限错配”与“网络拓扑 ” ， 也就是“其联通性与关键节点的存在导致其“太大而不能倒 ” 。
en: For Europe, Leijonhufvud argues, this implies a three-pronged approach that focuses on “levels of leverage,” “maturity mismatches,” and “the topology of the web,” – that is, “its connectivity and the presence of critical nodes that are ‘too big to fail.’”

zh: 这是因为“合约网络已经出现了严重失调 ” 。
en: This is because “[t]he web of contracts has developed serious inconsistencies.”

zh: 坚持履行所有合约，将会“引发绝大部分合约网络的崩溃”以及“严重的经济灾难以及无法估量的社会与政治后果。 ”
en: To insist that all contracts be fulfilled would “cause a collapse of very large portions of the web,” with “serious economic and incalculable social and political consequences.”

zh: 相比之下，像中国这样的新兴市场，合约网络尚没有那么成熟。 然而，随着时间推移，尤其是通过参与国际贸易，新兴市场国家也会发展出越来越复杂的合约网络及系统性的关联结构。
en: By contrast, emerging markets like China have less sophisticated systems and evolve more complex contractual/institutional links over time, particularly through globalized transactions.

zh: 当中国处于计划经济时代，大部分合约发生在个人与国家层面；过去三十年间，随着市场化进程，越来越复杂成熟的市场合约出现或再次浮现。
en: Under China’s planned economy, most contracts were between individuals and the state, whereas more sophisticated market contracts have emerged or re-emerged only over the last 30 years.

zh: 事实上， 中国建设“社会主义市场经济”的一个重要的调整与进展就是在公有制企业中广泛使用市场合约。
en: Indeed, the widespread use of market contracts with publicly-owned companies was a recent and important adaptation in the move toward a “socialist market economy.”

zh: 然而，合约网络也可理解为不断调整适应的复杂市场体系，其中包括国家与家庭层面的各种制度关系。
en: The web of contracts, however, can also be understood as complex adaptive market systems, which encompass the state and family relations as well.

zh: 要理解中国的社会主义市场经济体制，需要系统研究这些不同形式的合约关系与制度架构。
en: To understand China’s socialist market economy, it is essential to examine systematically these different forms of contracts and their institutional structures.

zh: 家庭及亲属合约规范了婚姻、收养、共同居住、 及继承等行为，构成了人类社会的基本单位。
en: Family and kinship contracts, which govern marriage, adoption, cohabitation, inheritance, etc., form the basic unit of human society.

zh: 这些最古老的契约依然是当今中国社会关系的基础。
en: These contracts are the most ancient and remain the foundation of social relationships in China today.

zh: 企业合约将追求利润的法人置于交易的中心，并将所有的利益相关方联系在一起。
en: Corporate contracts place the profit-oriented legal person at the center of the transaction and bind all of its stakeholders.

zh: 过去三十年里，中国的企业合约实现了指数式增长。 由于国有企业在中国经济占据了主导地位，这给中国的企业合约带来了一些中国特色。
en: Chinese corporate contracts have grown exponentially over the last 30 years, but they have special characteristics that reflect the primary role of Chinese state-owned enterprises.

zh: 市场合约是生产者与消费者之间或各种厂商之间的合约，并通过本地或全球市场的供应链体系将个人、家庭、企业、政府与公众团体联系在一起。
en: Market contracts between producers and consumers – and/or among producers in supply chains – link individuals, families, firms, governments, and public organizations through local or global markets.

zh: 在过去几十年里，中国开始执行现代合同法，加入了世界贸易组织，并承诺遵守国际贸易与投资规则。
en: Over the last few decades, China has begun to practice modern contract law and joined the World Trade Organization, committing itself to international rules governing trade and investment.

zh: 民间合约 通过非政府或非盈利的机构将人们联系在一起，参与社区、宗教、社会与政治活动。
en: Non-governmental and non-profit civil contracts bind people together for communal, religious, social, and political activities.

zh: 在中国，这些民间合约关系相对较新，仍处于发展演进的过程中。
en: These contracts are still relatively new and evolving in China.

zh: 社会合约 通过宪法与行政法规，界定了国家及其相关部门相对于个人与私营部门的权力与义务，包括政府的征税权；国家通过刑法、行政法以及民法对个人与私营部门施加的约束，及国家为公民提供公共物品和服务的义务。
en: Social contracts created by constitutional and administrative laws define the powers and responsibilities of the state and its constituent bodies vis-à-vis individuals and the private sector. They include the authority to impose taxes and restraints on individuals and private entities through criminal, administrative, and civil law, as well as the state’s obligation to provide public goods and services.

zh: ���国通过一系列重大的制度创新，加强了其传统的中央集权体制创造经济增长及中等收入繁荣的能力。 但是中国仍然保留了源于两千年前的五级行政管理政府架构，从上至下依次是中央、省、市、镇和村。
en: China has strengthened its unitary state with important institutional innovations that have delivered growth and middle-income prosperity, but it still retains the basic five-level administrative structure – central government on top, with provincial, city, town, and village bodies below – that first emerged two millennia ago.

zh: 理解经济行为与表现的关键在于破解合约网络的结构，包括这种网络结构如何面对内外部力量的冲击，及其动态的非线性调整与适应过程。
en: Deciphering the structure of the web of contracts holds the key to understanding how an economy behaves, including its dynamic non-linear adaptation to internal and external forces.

zh: 按照物理学家菲杰弗·卡帕（Fritjof Capra）的观点，我们应该将生物体、社会制度体系与生态系统看作一个相互关联、相互依赖、不断调整适应的复杂系统。
en: Following the physicist Fritjof Capra, one should regard living organisms, social systems, and ecosystems as an interconnected and interdependent, complex adaptive system.

zh: 这意味着我们不应将经济与社会视为僵化的层级或机械式运作的市场，而应将其视作一个网络体系或生命网络，而存在于其中的合约，不管是正式还是非正式，履行了还是违反了，都是人类活动的根本。
en: This means that we should view the economy and society not as rigid hierarchies or mechanical markets, but as networks or webs of life, in which contracts, formal and informal, fulfilled or violated, are the essence of human activity.

zh: 探讨合约网络与生物学家研究细胞结构和DNA相似，都能让我们透过现象看本质。
en: Examining webs of contracts should be similar to a biologist’s examination of cell structure and DNA.

zh: 正是得益于复杂合约网络的不断演进及扩展，中国成功构建了具有全球规模的正常运作的制造业、基础设施、金融与政府服务这四大现代供应链。
en: China has created four functioning global-scale modern supply chains in manufacturing, infrastructure, finance, and government services, thanks to its evolving, expanding, and complex web of contracts.

zh: 短时间内，中国如何能够从传统的家族式合约与陈旧的体制架构中脱胎换骨而建立一个现代产业基础？
en: But how was China able to build a modern industrial base within a relatively short period of time from its traditional, patrimonial family contracts and archaic constitutional structures?

zh: 运用邓小平所描述的“摸着石头过河”的思路，通过试验、适应与演进，中国正在成功摸索一个更高层次的供应链 — — 政治决策供应链 。
en: Through experimentation, adaptation, and evolution – a process that has been described as “crossing the river by feeling the stones” – China has been able to evolve a higher-order, or fifth, supply chain in political decision-making.

zh: 在中国，这第五个供应链的构建被称为“顶层设计 ” ， 其作用是协调及安排其他不同的供应链及整个合约网络的运行，以便达到个人、家庭、企业、社会与国家目标之间的微妙平衡。
en: This “top-level governance architecture,” as it is known in China, has been essential for coordinating and orchestrating the different supply chains and the overall web of contracts to achieve the delicate balance among individual, family, corporate, social, and national objectives.

zh: 顶层设计类似于计算机操作系统，需要合理安排所有软硬组件，达到系统兼容及完整。 许多现代经济体都已经拥有这种顶层治理结构。
en: This top-level governance architecture is analogous to a computer’s operating system, which orchestrates the other software and hardware components to form a holistic unity.

zh: 在中国，由于政府在经济中发挥着相当大的核心作用，其顶层治理结构对中国经济体系的成效至关重要。
en: Such a structure exists in many economies, but, in the Chinese context, where the state plays a central role in the economy, it is critical to the system’s effectiveness.

zh: 中国的顶层治理结构未来的发展，将取决于中国的历史、文化、制度以及不断演进的合约网络如何相互作用而影响中国的基本社会结构。
en: How it is shaped will depend on how China’s history, culture, institutional context, and evolving web of contracts affect the country’s social fabric.

zh: 中国的产能过剩之痛
en: China’s Excess-Capacity Nightmare

zh: 发自上海 — — 让时光回到 1958 年，那个发动“大跃进”的年月，国家主席毛泽东对中国的钢铁工业寄予了厚望。
en: SHANGHAI – Back in 1958, the year of China’s ill-fated “Great Leap Forward,” Chairman Mao had big plans for the steel industry.

zh: 在 1957 年钢产量仅有 500 万吨的情况下，他希望全国钢产量能在 1962 年时赶上甚至超过美国，达到 8000 万到 1 亿吨，并在 1970 年代中期达到 7 亿吨，让中国成为无可争议的世界钢材生产之王。
en: While production had been just over five million tons in 1957, he expected the country to catch up with or even surpass the United States by 1962, producing 80-100 million tons per year, and to reach 700 million tons per year by the mid-1970’s, making China the undisputed world leader.

zh: 而用来实现这一宏愿的，则是一些连专门钢铁生产技术都不具备的民众建立起来的“土法炼钢炉 ” 。
en: All this was to be accomplished using small “backyard steel furnaces” operated by ordinary people with no particular technical expertise.

zh: 时至今日，虽然时间有所推迟，但毛泽东赶超世界水平的梦想终于得到了实现，中国的钢铁年产量已经达到 6.6 亿吨，而其他工业部门也同样如此。
en: Today, Mao’s dream of catching up with the rest of the world has been realized, albeit a bit behind schedule, not only in steel making, where annual capacity has reached 660 million tons, but in many other sectors as well.

zh: 到了 2008 年，中国在钢铁，水泥（两者都占全球总产量近半 ） ， 铝（占全球 40 % ） 和玻璃（占 31 % ） 产量方面都位居世界第一。
en: In 2008, China ranked first in steel (about half of world production), cement (also about half), aluminum (about 40%), and glass (31%), to take just a few examples.

zh: 中国的汽车产量在 2009 年超过了美国，而在造船方面仅仅落后于韩国，拿下了全球造船总吨位的 36 % 。
en: The country topped the US in auto production in 2009, and remains second only to South Korea in shipbuilding, with 36% of global capacity.

zh: 对于北京的决策者来说，中国工业的规模带来却是一座警钟而不是庆功的号角。
en: For Beijing’s central planners, however, the size of China’s industrial base has become a cause for alarm rather than celebration.

zh: 在中国国务院 9 月 26 日下达的一份文件中，国家发展和改革委员会（简称发改委）警告在多个行业都出现了严重的产能过剩。
en: In a document approved by the State Council on September 26, the National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC) warned of serious excess capacity in a wide variety of sectors.

zh: （中国国务院，由总理，副总理及各部委负责人组成，是中国政府的最高行政机关）
en: (The State Council, which includes the premier, vice premiers, and heads of ministries and commissions, is China’s highest executive authority.)

zh: 根据发改委公布的数据显示，在 2008 年钢铁行业的产能利用率只有 76 % ， 水泥 75 % ， 铝 73 % ， 平板玻璃 88 % ， 甲醇 40 % ， 多晶硅（一种生产太阳能电池板的关键原料）的利用率更只有 20 % ， 而目前的项目规划则暗示明年中国的风能发电企业将有超过 50% 的产能闲置不用。
en: Based on the NDRC’s figures, 2008 capacity utilization rates were just 76% for steel, 75% for cement, 73% for aluminum, 88% for flat glass, 40% for methanol, and 20% for poly-crystalline silicon (a key raw material for solar cells). The current project pipeline also implies less than 50% utilization for wind-power equipment manufacturers in 2010.

zh: 其实国务院自 2005 年以来就把解决产能过剩列为优先处理的问题，在各个行业都出台了一些限制来阻止新项目上马，并关停那些效率低下的生产企业。
en: Excess capacity has been a priority for the State Council since 2005, when it issued industry-by-industry restrictions on new projects and targets for shutting down inefficient production.

zh: 但从那时起，情况在许多方面不但没有得到好转，反而进一步恶化。
en: Since that time, however, the situation has in many cases only gotten worse.

zh: 而问题的症结则在许多北京明令禁止的“盲目”和“多余”投资项目背后都有地方政府撑腰。 这些地方政府主要把眼光放在如何拉动当地 GDP 的增长之上，根本不管这些项目在经济上是否具有可行性。
en: The problem is that much of the so-called “blind” and “redundant” investment that Beijing would like to eliminate has the strong support of local governments, whose primary concern is with generating GDP growth in their jurisdictions, regardless of whether the means of achieving it make any economic sense.

zh: 以水泥生产为例，根据中国水泥行业协会的数据， 38% 的水泥产量都是来自于立窑，而这种技术在世界各地都已经淘汰将近一个世纪了，甚至在 1957 年的中国也只有 3% 的水泥产量来自立窑，因为当时国内的水泥生产设备都是从东欧进口的。
en: Consider cement production, where, according to the China Cement Association, 38% of capacity consists of “shaft” kilns. These have been obsolete in most of the rest of the world for over a century, and accounted for less than 3% of production even in 1957, when most of China’s cement plants were imports from Eastern Europe.

zh: 然而时至今日，立窑技术却得到了地方政府的青睐，因为他们可以花很少的成本尽快上马项目来创造经济增长和就业。
en: Nowadays, however, shaft kilns are a favorite of local governments because they can be built cheaply and quickly and generate growth and employment.

zh: 至于有没有规模经济效益，能不能减少对环境的影响这些问题，根本就不在优先考虑之列。
en: Achieving economies of scale and lessening environmental impacts simply are not priorities.

zh: 而钢铁工业也存在着同样的状况，中央关停小型炼钢炉的尝试同样也一次又一次碰壁。
en: A similar situation exists in the steel industry, where the central government has made repeated unsuccessful attempts to close small furnaces.

zh: 例如国家发改委在 2006 年就拿出了一份要求在 2007 年年末必须关停的钢铁企业名单。
en: In 2006, for example, the NDRC produced a list of plants that were required to cease operations by the end of the following year.

zh: 结果到了 2007 年 12 月大限将至之时，在中国钢铁行业信息方面居于领先地位的网站“我的钢铁网”派出一名记者，走访了名单上的各个企业，希望能拿到企业如何遵照中央指令拆除设备的第一手资料。
en: As the deadline approached in December 2007, a correspondent from Mysteel , a leading local source of information on the sector, visited a number of these mills to see first-hand how they were progressing with the government-mandated dismantling of their equipment.

zh: 但展现在记者面前的却是一个反映这类项目在现实中被如何执行的绝佳例子。
en: What he found was a great example of how any such program is likely to work in practice.

zh: 一间企业依然在 24 小时开工生产；其他企业则暂时停工，只等限期过后再次恢复生产；只有极少的一部分企业真正拆除了设备。
en: One site was still operating 24 hours a day; in others production had been temporarily halted until the deadline passed. In only a very few cases had any machinery actually been removed.

zh: 地方官员和管理者都有很多的理由不去服从发改委的指令。 有些人希望进一步扩充产能，好让自己的企业不再位列“低效率”的名单之内 — — 但这种把戏是明令禁止的。
en: Local officials and managers had a variety of reasons for not complying with the NDRC’s order.   Some expected to expand their plants so that they would no longer be counted as inefficient – a stratagem explicitly prohibited by the regulations.

zh: 当这些���备属于私人所有时，有人会（可能不合理地）觉得关停企业违反了保护财产权的相关法律。
en: Where facilities were privately owned, it was felt, perhaps not unreasonably, that removing assets would violate China’s property-rights law.

zh: 一所原本属于国营的企业继续维持运作的原因则是 2001 年签订租赁协议时规定十年之内不能让任何员工下岗。
en: One formerly state-run enterprise was being operated under a 2001 lease specifying that no workers could be laid off for the next ten years.

zh: 有些地方部门干脆直接吊销了有问题企业的生产许可证，这样一来，正如一位监管者所言，这些企业就“不存在”了。
en: And there were also jurisdictions that had canceled the licenses of the operators in question, so that, as one regulator put it, they simply “didn’t exist.”

zh: 中国的产能过剩问题折射出了“社会主义市场经济”所产生的严重弊端。
en: China ’s excess-capacity problem reveals a serious defect in its “socialist market economy.”

zh: 在许多行业，无论是市场本身还是中央政府的力量都不足以推动对低效率生产者的“创造性淘汰 ” 。
en: In many industries, neither market forces nor central planning are strong enough to bring about the “creative destruction” of inefficient producers.

zh: 结果赶超发达国家的梦想就以一种令人大吃一惊的方式，按照毛泽东构想的那样实现了 — — 以低水平官员操纵小规模技术的形式。
en: As a result, the dream of catching up with the developed countries has to a surprising extent been realized much as Mao imagined – by lower-level cadres using small-scale technology.

zh: 如果目标仅仅是实现产量的世界第一的话，那么主席的宏愿也算圆满完成了。
en: If simply leading the world in output is the goal, the Chairman’s vision has been resoundingly vindicated.

zh: 但如果产品质量，环保水平和经济效益都同样重要的话，那么中国工业目前的状况，就堪称一场噩梦。
en: But if product quality, environmental protection, and economic efficiency are important as well, this state of affairs is little short of nightmarish.

zh: 中国扩大的核心利益
en: China’s Expanding Core

zh: 东京—目前，中国与菲律宾的黄岩岛之争和与日本的钓鱼岛之争愈演愈烈，这两个岛均位于南海中国200英里领海线之外。
en: TOKYO – China is now engaged in bitter disputes with the Philippines over Scarborough Shoal and Japan over the Senkaku Islands, both located far beyond China’s 200-mile-wide territorial waters in the South China Sea.

zh: 事实上，如今，中国的领土主张非常强硬，以至于许多亚洲国家弄不清如何才能满足中国捍卫其“核心利益”的愿望。
en: Indeed, so expansive are China’s claims nowadays that many Asians are wondering what will satisfy China’s desire to secure its “core interests.”

zh: 中国的领土欲望就没有一个限度吗？ 还是说，中国认为自己已经重新成为天朝上国，全世界面对它都得卑躬屈膝？
en: Are there no limits, or does today’s China conceive of itself as a restored Middle Kingdom, to whom the entire world must kowtow?

zh: 到目前为止，正式被中国列入“核心利益”的包括台湾、西藏和新疆。 “核心利益”一词意味着国家主权和领土完整，中国在这方面绝不会让步。
en: So far, China has formally referred to Taiwan, Tibet, and Xinjiang province as “core interests,” a phrase that connotes an assertion of national sovereignty and territorial integrity that will brook no compromise.

zh: 如今，中国正意欲把核心利益一词用于与日本的钓鱼岛之争，甚至不顾危险地将它用于对整个南海的主张：事实上，一些军官已经在这么用了。
en: Now China is attempting to apply the same term to the Senkaku Islands in its dispute with Japan, and is perilously close to making the same claim for the entire South China Sea; indeed, some Chinese military officers already have.

zh: 钓鱼岛位于东海冲绳以西，目前无人定居，1895年被划入日本明治政府。
en: The Senkaku Islands, located to the west of Okinawa in the East China Sea and currently uninhabited, were incorporated into Japan by the Meiji government in 1895.

zh: 该岛一度曾有常住民从事鲣鱼干的制作。
en: At one time, there were regular residents working at a bonito-drying facility.

zh: 1969年，联合国亚洲和远东经济委员会完成了一份关于东海海床的调查报告，报告说，东海海底蕴藏着大量资源，其中钓鱼岛附近海域蕴藏着巨量石油和天然气储量。
en: In 1969, the United Nations Economic Commission for Asia and the Far East (ECAFE) completed a seabed survey of the East China Sea, and reported the possible presence of vast underground mineral resources, including abundant oil and natural gas reserves near the Senkakus.

zh: 两年后，1971年，中国和台湾宣称对钓鱼岛拥有主权，但日本政府立场从未改变：日本对该岛的主权不容置疑。
en: Two years passed before Taiwan and China claimed sovereignty over the islands, in 1971, but the Japanese government’s stance has always been that Japan’s sovereignty is not in question.

zh: 4月，敢说敢做的爱国人士、东京都知事石原慎太郎宣布，他所领导的东京政府计划买下目前由日本公民私人拥有的钓鱼岛群岛的四个岛屿。
en: In April, Tokyo Governor Shintaro Ishihara, a famous and articulate patriot, announced that the metropolitan government that he leads plans to acquire four of the Senkaku Islands, which are currently privately owned by Japanese citizens.

zh: 日本人民对此项活动的捐款额已经超过了7亿日元。
en: Donations for the purchase from the people of Japan now exceed ¥700 million ($8.4 million).

zh: 中国以其一贯的敏感应对石原慎太郎的主张：拒绝接受石原慎太郎之子、日本主要反对党自民党总干事的访问计划。
en: China reacted to Ishihara’s proposal with its usual sensitivity: it refused to receive the scheduled visit of Ishihara’s son, who is Secretary-General of Japan’s Liberal Democratic Party, the country’s main opposition party.

zh: 此外，在本月早些时候在北京举行的中日韩三国峰会中，日本首相野田佳彦和中国总理温家宝进行了会晤。 温家宝说，新疆维吾尔自治区的独立运动和钓鱼岛事件的性质是一样的。
en: Moreover, at a meeting in Beijing earlier this month between Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda and Chinese Premier Wen Jiabao during a trilateral summit with South Korea, Wen mentioned the independence movement in the Xinjiang Uyghur Autonomous Region and the Senkaku Islands in the same breath.

zh: “尊重中国的核心利益和重大关切是十分重要的。 ”温家宝强调说。
en: “It is important to respect China's core interests and issues of major concern,” he emphasized.

zh: 在此之前，中国政府从未将“核心利益”用于钓鱼岛。
en: Until that moment, the Chinese government had never applied the term “core interest” to the Senkaku Islands.

zh: 随着温家宝的这番话脱口而出，三国峰会也变了质。
en: Following Wen’s statement, the trilateral summit deteriorated.

zh: 韩国总统李明博继续与中国国家主席胡锦涛进行了双边会谈，但野田佳彦和胡锦涛的会晤以及计划中的日本经联团主席米仓弘昌与中国外交部长杨洁篪的会谈被取消了。
en: While South Korean President Lee Myung-bak held bilateral talks with Chinese President Hu Jintao, talks between Noda and Hu, and a scheduled meeting between Keidanren Chairman Hiromasa Yonekura and Chinese Foreign Minister Yang Jiechi, were also canceled.

zh: 三国峰会联合宣言也推迟了一天发布，宣言中没有任何关于朝鲜问题的内容，而这本是日本和韩国最关心的问题。
en: The joint declaration issued at the summit was delayed a day, and omitted all references to North Korea – a prime concern of both Japan and South Korea.

zh: 中国之所以对日本领导人唐突以待，恐怕不仅仅是在钓鱼岛问题上的示威，也是在对5月第四届世界维吾尔大会在东京召开表示不满。
en: China’s brusque treatment of Japan’s leaders probably was intended as a rebuke not only over the Senkaku Islands issue, but also for hosting the Fourth General Meeting of the World Uyghur Congress in Tokyo in May.

zh: 此前，世界维吾尔大会曾在德国和美国举行，而此次在日本召开的第四届大会旨在强调保护人权，捍卫维吾尔族的传统、文化和语言，日本政府对此既不反对，也不赞成。
en: Previously, such meetings had been held in Germany and the United States, and this one, which stressed the importance of protecting human rights and preserving the traditions, culture, and language of the Uyghur people, received no official sanction or endorsement from the Japanese government.

zh: 如果粗暴外交是中国扩张性领土主张的唯一表现，那么亚洲领导人大可以高枕无忧。
en: If gruff diplomacy was the only manifestation of China’s expansive territorial claims, Asian leaders could sleep more peacefully.

zh: 但事实表明，中国海军在南海的活动越来越活跃，特别是在钓鱼岛和黄岩岛海域，在越南宣称拥有主权的南沙群岛也是如此。
en: But the fact is that China’s navy is becoming increasingly active in the South China Sea, at the Senkaku Islands and Scarborough Shoal in particular, but also around the Spratly Islands claimed by Vietnam.

zh: 中国的军费节节攀升，军队的神秘性与日俱增，其海军所表现出来的魄力已经对其他南海邻国敲响了警钟。
en: Given China’s mushrooming military budget and secretiveness, that assertiveness has set off alarm bells among the other countries bordering the South China Sea.

zh: 此外，中国对菲律宾的欺凌不仅包括派遣军舰前往黄岩岛，还对菲律宾产品突然施加了严格的进口限制。
en: Moreover, China’s bullying of the Philippines included not only the dispatch of warships to Scarborough Shoals, but also the sudden imposition of import restrictions on Filipino produce.

zh: 而自从非自民党入主日本政坛以来，中国的对日行为也变得更加偏执了。
en: And China’s reactions toward Japan are far more paranoid since a non-LDP government took power.

zh: 薄熙来事件中的中共内斗以及盲人活动家陈光诚在中美经济对话期间逃脱监禁让中国领导人的民族主义取向更加坚定了。
en: The struggles for power within China’s ruling Communist Party over the purge of Bo Xilai, and the blind activist Chen Guangcheng’s escape from detention during economic talks with the US, have made Chinese leaders’ nationalist assertions even more strident than usual.

zh: 没有哪个官员愿意在事关中国认定的“核心利益”问题上示软。
en: No official wants to appear soft where China’s supposed “core interests” are concerned.

zh: 到目前为止，中国还没有使出反日和反其他国家大游行这一以往惯用的表达不满的招数。
en: So far, China has not unleashed the sort of mass demonstrations against Japan and others that it has used in the past to convey its displeasure.

zh: 但这可能反映了中国领导人在薄熙来事件发酵过程中的不安情绪：他们无法保证反日游行不会演变为反政府示威。
en: But that probably reflects the jittery state of China’s leaders in the wake of the Bo purge: they cannot guarantee that an anti-Japan demonstration would not turn into an anti-government protest.

zh: 中国真正的核心利益并不在领土扩张和称霸四邻，���在于提升人权和改善中国人民的福利，这也是世界对中国的核心利益。
en: China’s real core interests are not in territorial expansion and hegemony over its neighbors, but in upholding the human rights and improving the welfare of its own citizens, which is the world’s core interest in China.

zh: 但在中国认识到南海领土主张必须放在多边讨论框架内以使菲律宾和越南等小国不至于感到威胁之前，中国不但扩大的“核心利益”将一直是东亚不稳定之源。
en: But until China accepts that its territorial claims in the South China Sea must be discussed multilaterally, so that smaller countries like the Philippines and Vietnam do not feel threatened, China’s ever expanding “core interests” will be the root of instability in East Asia.

zh: 中国的美国朋友 — — 不可共患难
en: China’s Fair-Weather American Friends

zh: 慕尼黑 — — 由于中国已经将其估值过低的货币人民币与美国挂钩，因此美国金融危机后美元每次贬值都意味着人民币对其他世界货币贬值。
en: MUNICH – Because China has pegged its undervalued currency, the renminbi, to the dollar, every weakening of the dollar in the wake of America’s financial crisis has also meant a weakening of the renminbi vis-à-vis other world currencies.

zh: 但是中国真的是全球货币战争爆发的罪魁祸首吗？
en: But is China really to blame for the eruption of a global currency war?

zh: 韩国、巴西、台湾、日本、瑞士以及其他许多国家的央行正在购买美元来防止它们本国货币的升值，以此来保护他们的出口。
en: The central banks of South Korea, Brazil, Taiwan, Japan, Switzerland, and many other countries are now buying dollars in order to protect their own currencies against revaluation and thus to defend their exports.

zh: 对于欧元汇率超过1.4美元，欧洲也是紧张不已，这远远超出了1.17美元的购买力平价率。
en: Europe also became nervous after the euro exchange rate rose to more than $1.40, far beyond the purchasing power parity (PPP) rate of $1.17.

zh: 如今，美国正在采取严厉措施对付中国，也准备着一场贸易战。
en: The United States is now taking drastic steps against China, and is making provisions for a trade war.

zh: （美国）国会已授权总统，如果中国仍旧不愿大幅提高人民币对美元的价值，那么就对中国商品强加进口税。
en: Congress has authorized the President to impose import duties on Chinese products if China remains unwilling to increase the value of its currency substantially against the dollar.

zh: 但是人民币的估值过低 — — 目前低了45 % — —已经存在许多年了。
en: But the undervaluation of the renminbi, which is currently 45%, has persisted for many years.

zh: 为什么美国突然 采取富有侵略性的措施呢？
en: So why is the US suddenly acting so aggressively?

zh: 为什么美国早前不采取措施呢？
en: Why didn’t America take action much earlier?

zh: 原因在于资本的流动。
en: The reason lies in capital movements.

zh: 以前中国用中美商贸中赚得的美元来填补美国的财政赤字，因此美国接受人民币的低估值。
en: The US accepted the lower valuation of the renminbi as long as China returned the dollars that it earned from bilateral merchandise trade by financing America’s budget deficit.

zh: 而今，中国人喜欢把资本投入到非洲和其他地方的原材料上，这让美国决策者愤怒不已。
en: Now that the Chinese prefer to invest that money in raw materials in Africa and elsewhere, they have aroused the full ire of American policymakers.

zh: 中国的投资转变非常剧烈。
en: China’s shift has been dramatic.

zh: 在2008～2009年间，中国以每月170亿美元的速度购买美国政府债券。
en: In 2008 and 2009, the Chinese purchased US government bonds at a rate of $17 billion a month.

zh: 但是在2009年9月，中国改变了投资方向。
en: But China reversed course in November 2009.

zh: 在2010年的头7个月，中国不仅不再买入美国政府债券，而且甚至开始出售手中的债券。
en: During the first seven months of 2010, China not only refrained from buying any more US government paper, but even began to sell its holdings.

zh: 中国每个月净出售70亿美元的美国政府债券。
en: Each month, China sold a net sum of about $7 billion in US government bonds.

zh: 美国现在神经紧绷也是完全可以理解的。
en: That nerves are now on end in America is perfectly understandable.

zh: 伦敦市插入了中国留下的投资缝隙，提高了对美政府债券的购买量。 在2008～2009年期间，伦敦的购买量是每月10亿美元左右，在今年头7个月增至平均每月280亿美元。
en: The City of London has jumped into the breach, increasing its purchases, which in 2008 and 2009 amounted to only about $1 billion monthly, to an average of $28 billion in the first seven months of this year.

zh: 由于英国本身是一个资本输入国，因此我们可以猜测，伦敦并不是自己持有这些债券，而是通过简单地重新包装这些债券，然后为这些债券取个印有伦敦盖章的新名字，然后转售到世界其他地方。
en: Since the United Kingdom itself is a large capital importer, we can assume that the City is not holding the paper itself but merely restructuring it and then selling it to the world under a new name and with the London stamp on it.

zh: 尽管不再为美国政府提供资金，但是中国仍旧是世界上最大的资本净输出国，自2006年以来， 中国一直保持这个地位。 在2007～2008年，中国平均每年输出4 000亿美元的资本。
en: Despite its withdrawal from financing the US government, China remains the world’s largest net capital exporter, a position that it has held since 2006.In2007 and 2008, China exported on average about $400 billion of capital annually.

zh: 当时，美国每年需要8 000亿美元的资本输入来抵消几乎完全中断的私人储蓄，中国的大部分资本输出流到了美国。
en: The US, which at the time needed annual capital imports of $800 billion in order to offset the near total cessation of private savings, received the lion’s share of this capital.

zh: 中国人的��愿消费使得美国人能在许多年间依靠借来的资金来建造新房，维持一个美国经济无力维系的消费水平。
en: The unwillingness of the Chinese to consume enabled Americans to build new houses for many years on borrowed money and to maintain a level of consumption that the US economy was unable to finance on its own.

zh: 当然，中国人一般不为美国的私有房地产提供资金。
en: To be sure, the Chinese always restrained themselves from private real-estate financing in the US.

zh: 他们一般只购买政府债券以及由半国有机构房利美和房地美发行的证券化的房地产工具。
en: They bought only government paper and securitized real-estate instruments that were issued by the semi-public bodies Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

zh: 直接的房地产私人资本融资主要来自其他国家，比如德国。
en: Direct real-estate finance via private channels came mainly from other countries – Germany, for example.

zh: 尽管如此，中国人通过为美国政府提供了原本要从美国纳税人中收取的资金，帮助美国达到更高的生活水准。
en: Nevertheless, China helped the US to achieve a higher standard of living by making money available to government authorities that would otherwise have had to come from American taxpayers.

zh: 就这段历史来看，如今指责中国的汇率政策是有点卑鄙的。 中国的汇率政策使美国人能在这么长的时期内享受超出自己收入的生活水平。
en: Given this history, it is a bit shabby to reproach China now for its exchange-rate policy – a policy that enabled the US to live beyond its means for so long.

zh: 美国经常称人民币的低估值损害了美国利益，其实正是人民币的低估值让美国人能做全民有房的美国梦。
en: Rather than coming at the expense of the US, as is constantly claimed, it was the renminbi’s low valuation that allowed Americans to dream their American dream of universal homeownership.

zh: 廉价中国产品的进口使美国能腾出资本和人力，来大规模增加房产数量，由此急剧提高了美国人的生活水准。
en: Imports of inexpensive Chinese products freed up capital and labor in the US for a dramatic expansion of the housing stock – which led to a sharp rise in the American standard of living.

zh: 如今，中国人不愿意继续在美国投资，这是可以理解的。
en: It is understandable that the Chinese are now reluctant to invest more money in the US.

zh: 他们曾尝试购买优尼科，进入美国能源市场，但是美国的政治人士阻止了这一并购举措。
en: They tried to enter the US energy market with the purchase of Unocal, but were blocked by politicians.

zh: 国会同样还以国家安全为借口，阻止了中国其他的直接投资。
en: Other direct investments were also stopped by Congress on the pretext of national security.

zh: 人们只要回想光纤公司“Emcore”和金矿公司“Firstgold”的竞标案就明白了。
en: One need only recall the bidding for Emcore or Firstgold.

zh: 美国想要中国人的资金，但是却只愿意提供信誉无保障的结构化证券，以及如今有通胀和贬值危险的政府债券。
en: The US wanted the Chinese money, but it was not prepared to offer anything more than structured securities of questionable creditworthiness, as well as government paper that is now clearly exposed to the risk of inflation and devaluation.

zh: 如果美国停止频频对中国做卑鄙的道德指责，那么世界和平将会受益。
en: It would be a service to world peace if the US stopped making cheap moral accusations against China.

zh: 事实比赤裸裸的政治利益更加微妙。
en: The truth is much more subtle than naked political interest.

zh: 中国的金融拜物
en: China’s Financial Fetish

zh: 随着北京近邻的天津今日打响滨海开发开放的战地口号，中国另一个“金融中心”建设的帷幕似乎就要拉开。
en: With the drum beating for the development of the costal areas of Tianjin near Beijing, the curtain seems to be rising on yet another “financial center” in China.

zh: 几年前当上海举起中华牌的时候，全世界的银行家和投资客都在猜测，其用意是否真的就是要让上海取代香港成为中国的金融中心。
en: When Shanghai sought a similar role several years ago, bankers and investors around the world wondered whether the aim was really for Shanghai to replace Hong Kong as China’s financial heart.

zh: 在目前这一试点中，天津与上海形成南北竞争的局面，越发引起人们的猜测。
en: In the current pilot project, Tianjin in China’s north and Shanghai in the south are competing against each other, prompting even more second-guessing.

zh: 以前，没有人知道如何建造“金融中心 ” 。
en: Once upon a time, no one had any idea about how to create a “financial center.”

zh: 金融中心只不过是一个重要的金融活动集散地。
en: A financial center was simply a great metropolis where enormous financial dealings took place.

zh: 像纽约和伦敦那样的城市只有证明了自己的作用之后才被称作金融中心。
en: Cities such as London and New York became known as financial centers only after they had proved themselves in the role.

zh: 中国的决策者似乎并不知道，没有幸运地成为金融中心的大都市还有很多很多。
en: Policymakers in China seem to be unaware that many major cities have not had the luck to become financial centers.

zh: 经济学家或者其他理论家并没有一个理论告诉我们，成为金融中心的城市一定比没有成为金融中心的城市更有价值、更可爱。
en: There is no economic or other theory that explains why a city called a “financial center” should be more valuable or lovely than others.

zh: 那么，为什么中国要把建设金融中心列为重要的全国性目标呢？
en: Why, then, should China make developing global financial centers a vital national goal?

zh: 中国果真需要自己的世界级的金融中心吗？
en: Does China really need its own financial centers of world standing?

zh: 是否世界需要中国有世界级的金融中心？
en: Does the world need China to have them?

zh: 或者是一个金融中心可以决定一个大都市的命运，就必须有这样的一个目标呢？
en: Or is such a goal necessary because a financial center can determine the fate of a great metropolis?

zh: 金融的发展史、城市的演变以及现代经济学都不能提供明确的答案。
en: Nothing in the history of finance, the evolution of cities, or modern economics provides a clear answer.

zh: 但金融中心这个词变成今天如此的份量和含义，是中国人自己的产物。 我们试图把金融中心的功能拆开来，并且把每一个细节都量化。
en: It is the Chinese who have endowed the term “financial center” with such weight and meaning by trying to dissect the functions of such cities and quantify every detail.

zh: 结果，政客们就选择一个城市并且命令它建造金融中心的功能，好像是这样一个东西可以当作建筑来建设。 这是一个错得没谱的概念。
en: As a result, politicians are prepared to pick a city and order it to create the functions of a financial center, as if such a thing can be constructed like a building – a concept that could not be more off the mark.

zh: 在金融的现代发展模式下，金融有没有中心已经不是什么有意义的问题。
en: Indeed, according to modern development models of finance, whether or not a physical center of finance exists is no longer a meaningful issue.

zh: 由于历史因素和机遇，传统上金融活动与欧美资本主义的崛起紧密相连，其形成集中在那些城市里。
en: Owing to historical factors and opportunities, financial transactions were concentrated in cities that were traditionally closely linked to the rise of European and American capitalism.

zh: 但是现在，金融活动聚集在哪个地方并不重要，重要的是在世界经济运行中，金融越来越重要，越来越全球化了。
en: But what counts nowadays is not where financial transactions physically take place, but rather the growing importance and globalization of finance in the operation of the world economy.

zh: 某些城市成为金融中心并不是因为它们比其他城市更为优越，也不是一些地方做了一些别的地方忘记做的事情。
en: Cities do not become financial centers because they are more “excellent” than other cities, or because they have done something that other cities failed to do.

zh: 而是一旦金融活动聚集在一个地方，就不大容易搬迁到其他地方。
en: Instead, once financial transactions begin to concentrate in a place, it becomes hard to move them to other places.

zh: 自由的市场经济和法律传统对于金融中心的生存不可或缺，当然帮助它们崛起，但是最初的崛起总是历史演变，而不是政府的战略打造出来的。
en: A free-market economy and its legal traditions -- both indispensable to the survival of financial centers – certainly helps them to rise, but that initial rise has always been attributable to historical evolution, not government strategy.

zh: 从这个意义上说，中国刻意通过政府法令建造全球金融中心是苛刻教条的。
en: In this sense, China’s effort to deliberately create, through government fiat, global financial centers is both exacting and dogmatic.

zh: 毫无疑问，为了中国的经济持续有效地发展下去，需要金融部门的健康发展。
en: There is no doubt that China needs its financial sector to develop soundly in order to ensure sustained economic growth.

zh: 在这个问题上，我们有了共识，那就是，实现这一目标要求政府保障金融自由化。
en: And there is now a common understanding in China that meeting this objective requires that the government safeguard financial liberalization.

zh: 但是这一进程缓慢，因为，中国的政客们把推进金融发展的重心放在打造金融中心这个地方政府的目标上去了。
en: But progress has been slow, because China’s politicians have put nurturing financial centers – which should be the objective of local governments – at the heart of the country’s financial development.

zh: 实际上，将金融自由化与城市被列为“金融中心”的特权等同起来恰好放慢了金融自由化的目标，也就是减少政府控制，加快金融市场的发展。
en: Indeed, equating financial liberalization with privileges for cities designated as “financial centers” undermines the very goals of liberalization – namely, to reduce government control and to accelerate the development of financial markets.

zh: 中国由于金融领域的行政和政治色彩浓厚，中国的金融体系一直落后。
en: China’s financial system is failing in that respect, owing to frequent administrative and political intervention.

zh: 结果限制了上海发挥其金融功能，而且也限制了香港这一亚洲公认的金融中心帮助中国的金融现代化。
en: As a result, Shanghai has been restricted from making the best of its financial functions, and Hong Kong, Asia’s acknowledged financial center, from assisting China’s financial modernization.

zh: 中国需要的是一个能够利用自由化和全球化的力量在未来几十年中推动经济增长的金融部门。
en: What China needs most is a financial sector capable of harnessing the forces of liberalization and globalization to drive economic growth in the decades ahead.

zh: 现在应当放弃建设金融中心的包袱，集中精力推进中国金融现代化的步伐。
en: The time has come to cast off the burden of building financial centers, and focus instead on advancing the modernization of Chinese finance.

zh: 中国的五年计划与全球利率
en: China’s Five-Year Plan and Global Interest Rates

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 中国的新五年计划将对全球经济产生极其重要的影响。
en: CAMBRIDGE – China’s new five-year plan will have important implications for the global economy.

zh: 该计划的主要特点就是将原本着眼于GDP增长最大化的官方政策转变为对消费以及劳动者平均生活水平的提高。
en: Its key feature is to shift official policy from maximizing GDP growth toward raising consumption and average workers’ standard of living.

zh: 虽然这一变化是由中国国内的一些因素所引发的，但它仍将对全球现金流和利率造成显著影响。
en: Although this change is driven by Chinese domestic considerations, it could have a significant impact on global capital flows and interest rates.

zh: 中国在过去几十年内的高GDP增长无疑使数亿中国人的收入得到了提高，而其中受益最大的则是那些居住在城市或是城郊区域的人们。
en: China’s high rate of GDP growth over the past decade has, of course, raised the real incomes of hundreds of millions of Chinese, particularly those living in or near urban areas.

zh: 而那些城市劳动者向农村老家的汇款同时也有助于提高后者的生活水平。
en: And the funds that urban workers send to relatives who remain in the agricultural sector have helped to raise their standard of living as well.
