zh: 但实际工资和消费的增长速度却远远低于中国GDP总额的增长速度。
en: But real wages and consumption have grown more slowly than China’s total GDP.

zh: 事实上GDP的增长主要来自于大型国有企业，而这些企业也借此巩固了自身的行业垄断地位。
en: Much of the income from GDP growth went to large state-owned enterprises, which strengthened their monopoly power.

zh: 此外还有大量的中国产品被输往国外，出口总额大幅超出进口总额，仅仅在去年就创造了3500亿美元的经常账户盈余。
en: And a substantial share of China’s output goes abroad, with exports exceeding imports by enough to create a current-account surplus of more than $350 billion over the past year.

zh: 中国如今计划提高实际工资的相对增长率并以此刺激更多的消费支出，同时还强调进一步扩大服务业而非制造业的规模。
en: China now plans to raise the relative growth rate of real wages and to encourage increased consumer spending. There will also be more emphasis on expanding service industries and less on manufacturing.

zh: 国有企业将被迫将更多的利润拿出来分享。
en: State-owned enterprises will be forced to distribute more of their profits.

zh: 而人民币的升值将导致中国制造商将重心从国际市场转回到国内市场。
en: The rising value of the renminbi will induce Chinese manufacturers to shift their emphasis from export markets to production for markets at home.

zh: 政府也将在低收入者住房和扩大医疗保障方面投入更多资金。
en: And the government will spend more on low-income housing and to expand health-care services.

zh: 上述这几点都意味着中国的国家储蓄将减少而家庭和政府的支出将增加。
en: All of this will mean a reduction in national saving and an increase in spending by households and the Chinese government.

zh: 中国目前拥有全世界最高的储蓄率，大约相等于GDP的50 % ， 这个数字无论是在国内还是全球范围内都非常重要，也正是它导致了中国的经常账户盈余。
en: China now has the world’s highest saving rate, probably close to 50% of its GDP, which is important both at home and globally, because it drives the country’s current-account surplus.

zh: 一个将资金更多地用于储蓄而非投资于设备和基建的国家（像中国这样）将会向国外输出一个额外的产物，那就是经常账户盈余；而与此对应的则是一个投资高于储蓄的国家（比如美国）会通过从全世界进口多于出口的方式来消化上述盈余。
en: A country that saves more than it invests in equipment and structures (as China does) has the extra output to send abroad as a current-account surplus, while a country that invests more than it saves (as the United States does) must fill the gap by importing more from the rest of the world than it exports.

zh: 一个拥有经常账户盈余的国家可以有钱去贷款或者投资世界其他国家；而一个经常账户赤字的国家则必须向全球其他国家借钱以弥补其外部逆差。
en: And a country with a current-account surplus has the funds to lend and invest in the rest of the world, while a country with a current-account deficit must finance its external gap by borrowing from the rest of the world.

zh: 更精确地说，一个国家的经常账户平衡状况就等于其国家储蓄与投资之间的差额。
en: More precisely, a country’s current-account balance is exactly equal to the difference between its national saving and its investment.

zh: 未来中国储蓄的减少就意味着中国经常账户盈余的减少 — — 以及其向美国以及世界其他国家借款能力减弱。
en: The future reduction in China’s saving will therefore mean a reduction in China’s current-account surplus – and thus in its ability to lend to the US and other countries.

zh: 如果对增加消费的新一轮强调能使中国储蓄相对GDP的比率下降5 % ， 那么中国依然会是全球储蓄率最高的国家，但这5%的下降将完全消灭中国的经常账户盈余。
en: If the new emphasis on increased consumption shrank China’s saving rate by 5% of its GDP, it would still have the world’s highest saving rate. But a five-percentage-point fall would completely eliminate China’s current-account surplus.

zh: 这一情景本不该出现，但却完全有可能在本轮5年计划的末期变成现实。
en: That may not happen, but it certainly could happen by the end of the five-year plan.

zh: 如果这一情况真的发生的话，对全球资本市场的影响将十分巨大。
en: If it does, the impact on the global capital market would be enormous.

zh: 没有了经常账户盈余，中国就不再是美国政府债券以及外国债券的净买家。
en: With no current-account surplus, China would no longer be a net purchaser of US government bonds and other foreign securities.

zh: 此外，如果中国政府以及中资企业想继续开拓海外石油资源或者进行商业投资的话，就必须出售自己投资组合中的美元债券或其他国家的主权债券。
en: Moreover, if the Chinese government and Chinese firms want to continue investing in overseas oil resources and in foreign businesses, China will have to sell dollar bonds or other sovereign debt from its portfolio.

zh: 这一新举措的后果则是更高的美国以及世界各国债券利率。
en: The net result would be higher interest rates on US and other bonds around the world.

zh: 与此同时，利率是否上升还取决于美国的储蓄和投资在同一时期内有何进展。
en: Whether interest rates do rise will also depend on how US saving and investment evolves over the same period. America’s household saving rate has risen since 2007 by about 3% of GDP.

zh: 美国的家庭储蓄相对GDP的比率自2007年以来已经上升了3 % ， 公司储蓄也有所增加，但大量增加的政府赤字却掩盖了上述成果。
en: Corporate saving is also up. But the surge in the government deficit has absorbed all of that extra saving and more.

zh: 事实上，2010年美国经常账户赤字比前几年都低的唯一原因就是在住宅和其他建设项目方面的投资大幅下滑。
en: Indeed, the only reason that America’s current-account deficit was lower in 2010 than in previous years is that investment in housing and other construction declined sharply.

zh: 如果美国人对住宅的需求重新上扬而企业又想增加投资的话，那么中国的低储蓄率和美国继续存在的高财政赤字之间将发生冲突，并导致全球利率大幅上升。
en: If Americans’ demand for housing picks up and businesses want to increase their investment, a clash between China’s lower saving rate and a continued high fiscal deficit in the US could drive up global interest rates significantly.

zh: 中国的抗议浪潮
en: China’s Flood Of Protests

zh: 中国的抗议问题已经是老生常谈了。
en: Protests in China are nothing new.

zh: 据有些估计，目前中国官员每年处理的“主要事件”就多达50，000起。
en: By some accounts, Chinese officials currently negotiate upwards of 50,000 “major incidents” annually.

zh: 四处蔓延的腐败激起了深刻的不满： 工人们抗议安然式诈骗毁掉了自己一生的积蓄，城市居民反对非法侵占土地，而农村人则不得不日日与大大小小的不公平现象抗争。
en: Widespread corruption has bred deep discontent: workers protest the Enron-like bilking of their life savings, townspeople fight against illegal land seizures, and villagers battle injustices – small and large – on a daily basis.

zh: 典型的抗议活动常带有浓厚的地方色彩，而且一般可以通过补偿、拘留和承诺以后改进等方法加以化解。
en: Typically, these protests are local in nature and generally resolved with a combination of payoffs, arrests, and promises of future improvement.

zh: 中国政府也会偶尔采取行动，惩治恶行昭彰的地方官吏。
en: Occasionally, China’s government takes action against local officials whose crimes are considered egregious.

zh: 只要抗议活动是地方性的，就可以作为孤立事件进行处理，而不会构成大范围的挑战或点燃体制骤变的火花。
en: As long as protests remain local, however, they can be managed as isolated cases that won’t pose a broader challenge or spark a movement toward systemic change.

zh: 但政府像扑灭山林火险那样压制民众抗议的日子已经一去不复返了。
en: Yet the government’s days of putting out protests like brush fires may be ending.

zh: 过去一年半以来，中国环境领域的非政府组织（NGOs）组织了跨省抗议活动，赢得了中国社会各阶层的参与及媒体的支持，矛头直指国家政府的腐败无能。
en: Over the past year and a half, China’s environmental non-governmental organizations (NGO’s) have organized protests that reach across provincial boundaries, engage Chinese from all social strata, garner support from China’s media, and directly address the issue of failed governance on a national scale.

zh: 这次大规模抗议活动的导火索是在中国西部建设成百上千个水库的提议。
en: The catalyst for these broad-based protests is the proposed construction of hundreds of dams throughout western China.

zh: 中国的水库建设从来就不听取群众意见。
en: Dam construction in China has never been open to public debate.

zh: 与此同时，中国的环保行动人士还重点关注保护生物多样性、资源再生和环境教育等方面的政治安全问题。
en: China’s environmental activists, meanwhile, have focused on the “politically safe” issues of protecting biodiversity, recycling, and environmental education.

zh: 可现在这些人变得更加自信，他们对云南境内怒江和金沙江和四川闽江流域的几个水库提出了反对意见。
en: Now, however, these activists have become more assertive, launching campaigns against a number of proposed dams along the Nu and Jinsha Rivers in Yunnan and the Min River in Sichuan.

zh: 他们还就有损生物多样性、破坏景区的自然景观和文化价值、以及居民重新安置时的不平等现象等传统问题提出了异议。
en: They still raise traditional issues of biodiversity loss, destruction of sites of natural beauty and cultural importance, and social justice issues surrounding resettlement.

zh: 他们现在又把矛头指向腐败和管理不善，正是这两个原因让水库建设变得毫无节制，也不进行环境影响方面的评估，而与此同时，地方官员把安置款项据为己有，对当地村民的要求完全置之不理。
en: But now they also challenge the shoddy governance and corruption that allow dam construction to proceed unchecked, without environmental impact assessments, as local officials siphon off resettlement funds and ignore the claims of local villagers.

zh: 由于能够给政治人物带来巨大的利益，中国兴修水利的热情一直非常高涨。
en: The political stakes are high, and China’s hydropower interests are strong.

zh: 目前正在为阻止淹没云南著名的虎跳峡文化风景区修建水库而四面奔走的环保人士，面对的其实是前总理李鹏之子，水利核心人物李小鹏。
en: Environmental activists who are currently battling to halt damming and flooding in the culturally and scenically renowned region of the Tiger Leaping Gorge in Yunnan are battling hydropower kingpin Li Xiaopeng, son of former Premier Li Peng.

zh: 反对兴修水库的抗议活动常常带有很大变数。
en: Dam protests can often be volatile.

zh: 10月，成千上万名不满安置补偿的村民把一名当地官员扣留了数小时之久，最后直到万名武装警察出动才把他解救出来。
en: In October, tens of thousands of villagers protesting inadequate resettlement compensation held a local official captive for several hours before ten thousand People’s Armed Police officers rescued him.

zh: 这些抗议颇具威力，不仅因为他们针对的问题非常敏感，还因为他们获得了更为广泛的支持。
en: These protests are striking not only for the sensitive nature of the issues they address, but for the broad-based support they have elicited.

zh: 尽管是带头的是设在北京的非政府组织，但水库抗议还牵涉到来自各地的中国人，采用了所有的联络手段，还得到了中央政府官员的大力支持。
en: While spearheaded by Beijing-based NGO’s, the dam protests involve Chinese from all parts of the country, employ all means of communication, and engage the support of central government officials.

zh: 北京的非政府组织与四川当地的非政府组织通力合作，发动了一场因特网宣传攻势来散布请愿书和动员村民参与。
en: Beijing-based NGO’s are allying with local Sichuan NGO’s to launch Internet campaigns, distribute petitions, and mobilize villagers.

zh: 其中一次，环保行动份子把村民从拟议中的库址领到另外一个城镇，让他们亲眼目睹了其它人在重新安置过程中的悲惨遭遇。
en: In one case, environmental activists took villagers from a proposed dam site to another town to see firsthand how poorly others had fared in the dam resettlement process.

zh: 拟建库址当地的大学生也通过网络聊天组的形式参与了进来。
en: University students in the regions of the proposed dams have also become engaged through Internet chat groups.

zh: 环保人士的活动得到了中国国家环保总局、国家气象局和林业局不少官员的支持。
en: Environmental activists have found allies among officials within China’s State Environmental Protection Administration, Meteorological Administration, and Forestry Bureau.

zh: 水库项目也成了中国媒体大规模政治辩论中一个非常重要的焦点话题。
en: The dam projects have also become a focal point for a broader political debate within the Chinese media.

zh: 《南方周末 》 、 《中国青年报》甚至是传统上非常保守的《中国日报》都直截了当地呼吁扩大政治开放和政治参与，并要求加强法治建设。
en: Newspapers such as Southern Weekend , China Youth Daily , and even the traditionally conservative China Daily call directly for greater political openness, increased political participation, and for strengthening the rule of law.

zh: 类似的环保抗议在其它国家也有演变成大规模政治改革要求的先例。
en: Similar environmental protests have evolved into demands for broader political change in other countries.

zh: 在前苏联及其附属国中，环保主义也对制度变革起到过引人注目的推动作用。
en: In the former Soviet Union and its satellite states, environmental activism contributed dramatically to regime change.

zh: 在泰国、印尼和菲律宾等国，环保领域的抗议也曾对政治改革有所帮助。
en: In countries like Thailand, Indonesia, and the Philippines, environmental protest has helped spur political reform.

zh: 同样的事也有可能发生在中国。
en: The same may happen in China.

zh: 中国起领导作用的很多环保主义者都曾是1989年天安门事件中的学生和知识份子领袖，他们都深信：环境行动主义可以为更为广泛的政治改革开辟道路。
en: Many of China’s leading environmentalists are former students and intellectual leaders from the Tiananmen protests of 1989 who believe that environmental activism offers an avenue for advancing broader political reform.

zh: 其他人的出发点与政治无关，但他们相信:如果不进行政治改革，环境保护就永远不可能成功。
en: Others began apolitically, but have come to believe that there can be no environmental protection without political change.

zh: 这种对体制改革的一致要求使中国政府面临着严峻的考验。
en: This shared commitment to systemic reform is putting China’s government to the test.

zh: 即便中国领导人也承认：自己的政策选择非常有限： 要么像从前那样压制，要么就开始改革。
en: China’s leaders recognize that their policy options are limited: business as usual, repression, or reform.

zh: 迄今为止，政府在用传统手段应对新的挑战方面，已经显示出一定的灵活性。
en: Thus far, the government has demonstrated some flexibility while trying to manage this new challenge with traditional means.

zh: 温家宝总理已经暂停了几项筑坝工程，等待环境和社会影响方面的评估结果。
en: Premier Wen Jiabao has stayed the construction of a number of dams until environmental and social impact assessments could be undertaken.

zh: 有些工程被批准上马，而有些则被撤销。
en: Some have been approved while others have not.

zh: 因为还有成百上千座水坝可能引发争议，要求采取进一步措施的压力只会越来越大。
en: With hundreds of dams still likely to become targets for protest, pressure will only intensify for a more significant response.

zh: 政府有可能对这样的抗议进行镇压，尽管这样做只会损害中国的国际威望，并引发规模更大、更猛烈的抗议行动。
en: The government could launch a broad crackdown on such protests, although this would risk damaging China’s prestige internationally and provoking larger, more violent protests.

zh: 还有第三种选择，那就是把环境保护作为开展真正政治改革、推动中国向前发展的理由。
en: The third option is to use environmental protection to justify moving China ahead with real political reform sooner rather than later.

zh: 尽管目前看来这种可能性还不大，但随着反对筑坝工程的力量越来越大，中国的领导人可能会发现：如果他们不能迅速采取行动，就面临着被这股浪潮吞没的危险。
en: While this is currently an unlikely outcome, as the anti-dam protests gather strength, China’s leaders may realize that if they do not move quickly, they risk being swept away.

zh: 中国的环境欠债
en: China’s Green Debt

zh: 过去十年来，全世界都在想知道中国的领导人何时能够认识到中国所面临的巨大的环境危机。
en: For a decade, the world has wondered when China’s leaders will recognize the staggering environmental crisis confronting their country.

zh: 今年，我们有了答案。 新的五年计划把环境保护列为优先问题。
en: This year, we got an answer: a new Five-Year Plan that makes environmental protection a priority.

zh: 随后开展了一鼓风的绿色宣传，政府现在谈论用“绿色GDP”来衡量发展。
en: A storm of green propaganda has followed, and the government now talks about using “Green GDP” to measure development.

zh: 但是，所有的这些高谈阔论能够带来实际的进展吗？
en: But will all this talk amount to real progress?

zh: 尽管中央政府承认由于快速经济发展所造成的某些环境破坏，但是，政府还是文过饰非。
en: While the central government admits to some of the environmental degradation caused by rapid economic growth, the picture it paints is incomplete.

zh: 看一看“绿色GDP”就可以知道了。
en: Consider “Green GDP.”

zh: 今年春天，国家环保总局发布了中国的第一个正式的由于环境损失造成的向下调整后的GDP估计。
en: This spring, the State Environmental Protection Administration produced the country’s first official estimate of GDP adjusted downward for environmental losses.

zh: 根据这些估算，清理在2004年所产生的污染就会需要840亿美元，相当于当年GDP的3 % 。
en: According to these calculations, it would cost $84 billion to clean up the pollution produced in 2004, or 3% of GDP for that year.

zh: 但是，更为现实的估计认为，环境损失占中国每年GDP增长的8%到13 % 。 这就意味着，由于污染，中国几乎失去了自七十年代末期以来所得到的一切成就。
en: But more realistic estimates put environmental damage at 8-13% of China’s GDP growth each year, which means that China has lost almost everything it has gained since the late 1970’s due to pollution.

zh: 中国的环境问题根源复杂，最终可以归结于我们对于马克思主义的理解。
en: China’s environmental problems, complex as the causes may be, can ultimately be attributed to our understanding of Marxism.

zh: 在中国最近历史的大部分时期，我们一直把马克思主义看作是阶级斗争哲学。
en: For most of our recent history, we saw in Marxism only a philosophy of class struggle.

zh: 我们相信经济发展可以解决所有问题。
en: We believed that economic development would solve all our problems.

zh: 在改革时期，这一对马克思主义的误解转变成对于物质利益无限制的、不计道德的追求。
en: In the reform period, this misreading of Marx morphed into an unrestrained pursuit of material gain devoid of morality.

zh: 传统中国文化强调人与自然的和谐，已经被抛在一边。
en: Traditional Chinese culture, with its emphasis on harmony between human beings and nature, was thrown aside.

zh: 结果，耗费大量能源以及低效率的污染企业，例如煤炭和矿物开采、纺织厂、造纸厂、钢铁企业、化工厂以及建材企业统治了中国的经济。
en: As a result, China’s economy is dominated by resource-hungry and inefficient polluters, such as coal and mineral mines, textile and paper mills, iron and steel makers, petrochemical factories, and building material producers.

zh: 我们的城市规模在爆炸，耗尽了水资源并且造成可怕的交通堵塞。
en: Our cities are exploding in size, depleting water resources and creating horrific traffic congestion.

zh: 中国人口的四分之一饮用低于标准的水；三分之一的城市居民呼吸严重污染的空气。
en: One-quarter of China’s people drink substandard water; one-third of urbanites breathe badly polluted air.

zh: 而且，中国最近发生了一系列的环境事件。
en: Moreover, the country recently witnessed a spate of environmental accidents.

zh: 实际上，中国平均每两天就会发生一起严重的水污染事件。
en: Indeed, on average, China suffers a major water pollution accident every other day.

zh: 尽管中国签署了京都议定书以及大约50个其他国际环保协议，我们却基本上没有履行。
en: Although China has signed the Kyoto Protocol and some 50 other international environmental accords, we do little to honor them.

zh: 如果我们对提升我们的产业结构不予以重视，我们就会无法实现我们的减少排放的承诺。
en: If we are not serious about upgrading our industrial structure, we will fail when it comes time to fulfill our commitments to cut emissions.

zh: 尽管新的五年计划制定了精确的目标，许多省份却还没有实现上一个五年计划的主要环保目标。
en: And while the new Five-Year Plan sets fine goals, many provinces have failed even to meet the major environment protection targets of the last Five-Year Plan.

zh: 的确，中国在过去三十年中实现了西方国家需要100年才能够实现的经济发展。
en: True, China has made the kind of economic advances in three decades that required 100 years in Western countries.

zh: 但是，中国在这30年中也承受了一个世纪的环境破坏。
en: But China also has suffered a century’s worth of environmental damage in 30 years.

zh: 不幸的是，与西方国家不同的是，我们无法等到我们的年人均GDP达到一万美元再解决我们的环境问题。
en: Unfortunately, unlike Western countries, we cannot afford to wait until our per capita annual GDP reaches $10,000 before tackling our environmental problems.

zh: 我们的专家估计，当中国的年人均GDP达到3000美元之时，环境危机将会加剧到一个危险的地步。
en: Our experts predict that the environmental crisis will intensify to a critical stage by the time China’s per capita annual GDP reaches just $3,000.

zh: 更加糟糕的是，尽管我们抛弃了中国传统文化的精华，我们却没有吸收现代文明中好的一面。
en: Making matters worse, while we discarded the finer elements of our traditional culture, we failed to absorb the better aspects of modern civilization.

zh: 建立在权利和义务基础之上的“社会契约”概念是构成有效的环境保护的最为重要的先决条件的基本价值观点却被忽略。
en: The concept of a “social contract” based on rights and obligations – the essential values that constitute the most important precondition for effective environmental protection – goes largely ignored.

zh: 结果，在计算生产成本的时候，环保项目经常不能被列入。
en: As a result, environmental protection projects often fail to be included in calculating production costs.

zh: 很少有人会费神为中国的贫困和没有权势的人考虑环境成本以及他们的权利。
en: Scarcely anyone bothers to consider the environmental costs to – or rights of – the country’s poor and powerless.

zh: 现在，环境因素急待在中国的宏观经济规划中切实予以重视。
en: It is imperative that environmental factors figure in China’s macroeconomic planning in a real way.

zh: 这就要求在重要产业项目和耗能大户企业的规划中制定出一个更为理性的战略。
en: This requires that a more rational strategy be mapped out in the planning of major industrial projects and energy-hungry enterprises.

zh: 在项目开工前，应当认真研究，确定现有的能源、土地、矿产以及生物资源。
en: Careful studies need to be done to determine available energy, land, mineral, and biological resources before projects proceed.

zh: 必须改革土地规划，打破工业垄断，发展目标应当根据人口、资源数量以及吸收污染的能力来予以制定。
en: Land planning must be overhauled, with industrial monopolies broken up and development goals set according to population, resource volume, and the capacity to absorb pollution.

zh: 最后，中国需要一个新的能源战略。
en: Finally, China needs a new energy strategy.

zh: 工业化国家发展并大量利用了核能、风力、沼气以及其他可再生资源。
en: Industrialized nations have developed and made great use of nuclear, solar, wind, and bio-gas, and other renewable energy resources.

zh: 中国在这方面的技术甚至落后于印度和巴基斯坦这样的发展中国家，而且，其对煤炭的依赖是对全球气候最大的威胁之一。
en: China’s technological capacities in this sector lag behind even other developing nations such as India and Pakistan, and its reliance on coal is one of the greatest threats to the global climate.

zh: 目前，根本就没有替代。
en: For now, there is simply no alternative.

zh: 但是，从长远来看，清洁能源是在不造成无可挽回的环境破坏的情况下带来经济增长的唯一的途径。
en: But in the long run, clean energy will be the only way to bring economic growth without doing irreparable environmental damage.

zh: 政府无法自己解决这些问题。
en: Government cannot solve these problems on its own.

zh: 中国人民在环保问题上最为利益悠关，因此就必须成为推动力量。
en: China’s people have the biggest stake in environmental protection, and so must become the driving force.

zh: 地方社区、非政府组织以及企业界都必须做份内的事情。
en: Local communities, non-governmental organizations, and businesses all must do their part.

zh: 它们不能仅仅把自己局限在“监管”的范围之内并向上级呼吁。
en: They cannot limit themselves simply to “supervision” and appeals to the authorities.

zh: 它们必须进入其他的领域，包括公开听证、福利诉讼、提高媒体报道以及其他自愿性的活动。
en: They must expand into other avenues of appeal: public hearings, welfare lawsuits, enhanced media coverage, and other voluntary activities.

zh: 但是，最后的权力还是在政府那里。
en: But ultimate power does rest with the government.

zh: 中国的领导人需要采取几项切实的行动，而不仅仅是停留在口头。
en: China’s leaders need to make several concrete moves in order to move beyond rhetoric.

zh: 他们必须赋予环保干部以实权来实施现有的法律并堵塞巨大的法律漏洞。
en: They must give real power to environmental officials to implement existing laws and close gaping legal loopholes.

zh: 只有引入奖励保护环境者、惩罚污染者的法律机制以及帮助联合散落在不同地方的环境监督组织才能够做到。
en: This can only be done by introducing legal mechanisms to reward those who protect the environment, while making polluters pay, and by helping to unify the environmental watchdogs scattered across different sectors.

zh: 最为重要的是，需要建立一个监督干部经济以及环境政绩的体系。
en: Above all, a system needs to be established to monitor officials’ performance in environmental as well as in economic terms.

zh: 中国正在处在一个危险的危机点上。
en: China is dangerously near a crisis point.

zh: 国家巨大无比的环境欠帐无论那种形式总归要还的。
en: The country’s enormous environmental debt will have to be paid, one way or another.

zh: 中国必须高瞻远瞩，趁还可以控制的时候现在就开始偿还债务，而不是让债台高筑，最终威胁到让大家都破产。
en: China must exercise the foresight needed to begin paying this debt now, when it is manageable, rather than allowing it to accumulate and, ultimately, threaten to bankrupt us all.

zh: 中国增长风险增加
en: China’s Growing Growth Risks

zh: 北京—如果一切顺利，中国将于2021年超越美国成为世界第一大经济体（以当前美元价值衡量，如果用实际值衡量，超越美国将更快 ） 。
en: BEIJING – If everything goes right for China, it will surpass the United States as the world’s largest economy, in current dollar terms (and more quickly in real terms), by 2021.

zh: 中国的人均收入将达到低端高收入国家的现有水平。
en: Its per capita income will reach that of today’s lower tier of high-income countries.

zh: 但是，尽管中国经济前进势头迅猛，但在未来十年仍面临着一些不利的风险。
en: But, despite its forward momentum, the Chinese economy faces looming risks in the coming decade.

zh: 最紧迫的风险是欧洲的持续停滞甚至衰退。
en: The immediate risk is continuing stagnation, or recession, in Europe.

zh: 在过去十年中，出口增长为中国的整体经济增长贡献了大约三分之一，而在中国的出口中，又有三分之一去向了欧盟。
en: In the last decade, export growth has accounted for roughly one-third of China’s overall economic growth, and about one-third of Chinese exports went to the European Union.

zh: 如果欧洲的状况持续不振，中国的增长也将被拉后退。
en: If the situation in Europe continues to deteriorate, China’s growth will be dragged down.

zh: 过紧的宏观经济政策，特别是房地产调控政策，将增加减速风险，目前，在政府严厉措施的作用下，全国房价都呈现出下降态势。
en: Over-tightening of domestic macroeconomic policies, especially those aimed at the real-estate market, could heighten the risk of a slowdown, with house prices currently falling across China, owing to stringent government measures.

zh: 事实上，中国的情况与1997年亚洲金融危机时颇为相似。
en: Indeed, the situation is much like that of the 1997 Asian financial crisis.

zh: 在危机爆发之前的几年中，中国一直在与通胀作斗争，准备着实现软着陆。
en: In the several years before that crisis hit, China had been combating inflation, and appeared to be headed for a soft landing.

zh: 但危机与紧缩政策一起导致中国在数年内出现了通缩和增长大减速。
en: But the combination of crisis and austerity condemned China to several years of deflation and considerably slower growth.

zh: 如今，放眼中期，中国政府必须面对其过度干预经济所造成的问题。
en: Today, as China looks to the medium term, the government must face the problems created by its pervasive role in the economy.

zh: 最新世界银行报告指出，国有企业改革不力是中国经济最主要的障碍。
en: A new World Bank report singles out lack of reform of state-owned enterprises as the most important impediment to the country’s economic growth.

zh: 但这本身只是一个症状，更深层次的问题在于政府主导着经济活动。
en: But that is only a symptom of a deeper problem: the government’s dominant role in economic affairs.

zh: 中国政府直接控制着GDP的25—30 % ， 此外还掌握着大部分金融资源。
en: In addition to controlling 25-30% of GDP directly, the government also takes a lion’s share of financial resources.

zh: 近年来，三分之一以上的银行贷款流向了基础设施，而基础设施大部分是由政府实体建设的。
en: In recent years, more than one-third of total bank lending has gone to infrastructure, most of which has been built by government entities.

zh: 事实上，政府已认识到了基础设施投资过的问题，目前已中止了几项已经开工的高铁项目。
en: Indeed, recognizing its over-investment in infrastructure, the government recently abandoned several high-speed rail projects that were already under construction.

zh: 但政府投资过度的问题仍然存在，数不尽的工业园和高新开发区就是明证。
en: But government over-investment is also evident in numerous industrial parks and high-tech zones.

zh: 中国的投资狂热不禁让人想起了20世纪80年代的日本，当时是，高铁延伸到了日本的每个角落，偏远地区也没有落下。
en: China’s investment frenzy reminds many people of Japan in the 1980’s, when high-speed rail links were extended to Japan’s remotest corners.

zh: 如今，多条线路都必须仰仗政府补贴过活。
en: Most rely on government subsidies to this day.

zh: 尽管补贴在一定程度上能够改善普通人的生活质量，但这是以压抑国内消费为代价实现的。
en: And, while the subsidies may improve the quality of life for ordinary people in some respects, they also detract from it by suppressing domestic consumption.

zh: 基础设施投资难免要受边际回报递减规律的束缚，但消费增长是没有极限的。
en: Infrastructure investment will inevitably run up against the law of diminishing marginal returns, but consumption growth does not have a limit.

zh: 因此，压抑消费会拖累未来增长，家庭消费占GDP的比重从20世纪90年代中期的67%下降到了最近几年的不到50 % ， 其中大部分可以用政府政策所导致的扭曲来解释。
en: Suppressing consumption thus suffocates future growth, and the share of household consumption in GDP has declined from 67% in the mid-1990’s to below 50% in recent years, with most of the decline reflecting the distortions created by government policies.

zh: 中国政府是生产导向的。
en: China’s government is production-oriented by nature.

zh: 这样做的好处是有利于维持GDP的高增长率。
en: The upside is that this has helped to maintain high GDP growth rates.

zh: 但坏处同样明显，其中之一是收入不平等性的持续恶化。
en: But the downside is equally pronounced. One negative consequence is the persistent deepening of income inequality.

zh: 人均收入基尼系数已经超过了50（100代表最大程度的不平等 ） ， 这意味着中国已经步入世界上最不平等的四分之一国家行列。
en: The Gini coefficient of per capita income has surpassed 50 (with 100 representing maximal inequality), putting China in the upper quartile of inequality worldwide.

zh: 或许问题并不在于不平等性本身，而在于其后果，比如人力资本的分化。
en: The problem may not be inequality per se, but its consequences, one of which is the bifurcation of human capital.

zh: 在中国，教育的回报是上升的，但获得教育的难易程度正在社会和人口结构中呈现两极分化。
en: The return on education is increasing in China, but access to education is becoming increasingly divided socially and geographically.

zh: 城市的教育状况在改善，但农村的孩子面临着教育质量下降的问题，因为优秀教师都跑到城市里去了。
en: While education is improving in urban areas, children in the countryside are facing a decline in educational quality, because better teachers find their way to the cities.

zh: 此外，由于城市和农村收入差距的存在，教育对农村家庭来说显得更加昂贵。
en: Moreover, given the income disparities between cities and rural areas, their education is more expensive than it is for urban families.

zh: 结果，大部分农村孩子开始工作时没有大学文凭。
en: As a result, a majority of rural kids will enter the workforce without a university diploma.

zh: 在中国的1.4亿农民工中，80%只接受过9年甚至更少的正式教育，远低于高收入国家标准。
en: Among China’s 140 million migrant workers, 80% have only nine years or less of formal education – far short of what high-income countries require.

zh: 中国官员似乎有意减弱收入不平等的状况，但政府的一系列政策 — — （包括但不限于）补贴生产商、优待资本密集型产业、维持效率极低的金融部门等 — — 在加剧这一问题。
en: Despite officials’ seeming desire to reduce income inequality, China’s government is aggravating it, by – among other things – subsidizing producers, favoring capital-intensive industries, and maintaining a highly inefficient financial sector.

zh: 但令人振奋的经济信号还是存在的。
en: But there are also promising signs of an economic uptick.

zh: 中国政府刚刚宣布了户籍政策新规。
en: The government has just announced new rules for household registration, known as hukou.

zh: 除大城市外，你只要在一地居住满三年，就可以自由选择是否将户籍迁入。
en: Except in large cities, people can now freely choose their hukou after three years of residency.

zh: 这一政策大大有助于农民工，因为它保障了孩子平等接受教育的机会。
en: This will greatly help migrants by ensuring equal access to education for their children.

zh: 但是，要彻底转变政府的扭曲性行为就必须采取更加迅猛的政治变革。
en: To change completely the government’s distorting behavior, however, requires more drastic political changes.

zh: 户籍改革是一个良好的开端，它增加了农民工在所在社区的政治权利。
en: The hukou reform is a good start, as it will strengthen migrants’ political rights in local communities.

zh: 中国有着数量庞大的农民工群体，他们参与政治将迫使地方政府更加关心普通人民的需求。
en: Given their large numbers, their political participation may force local governments to become more responsive to ordinary people’s needs.

zh: 而我们希望，低级政府对群众要求的相应最终会传递到最高层。
en: And government responsiveness at lower levels, one may hope, might eventually trickle up to the top.

zh: 商品价格下跌的全球影响
en: The Global Implications of Falling Commodity Prices

zh: 纽约—长达十年的商品价格繁荣已经进入了尾声，对全球GDP增长产生了巨大影响。
en: NEW YORK – The decade-long commodity-price boom has come to an end, with serious implications for global GDP growth.

zh: 而尽管经济运行模式不会简单复制自己，但始自2000年代初的世界商品超级周期上升阶段的结束给发展中国家继续快速赶超发达国家收入水平的前景蒙上了一层阴影。
en: And, although economic patterns do not reproduce themselves exactly, the end of the upward phase of the commodity super-cycle that the world has experienced since the early 2000’s dims developing countries’ prospects for continued rapid catch-up to advanced-country income levels.

zh: 在截至7月的一年中 ， 《 经济学人》商品价格指数下跌了16.5 % （ 按美元计价，若按欧元计价，则跌幅为22.4 % ） ，其中金属价格自2011年初见顶以来已经下跌了两年多。
en: Over the year ending in July, The Economist’s commodity-price index fell by 16.5% in dollar terms (22.4% in euros) with metal prices falling for more than two years since peaking in early 2011.

zh: 粮食价格表现出了更强的抗跌力，但在过去的一年中，粮食价格跌幅比其他商品更深。
en: While food prices initially showed greater resilience, they have fallen more sharply than those of other commodities over the past year.

zh: 只有石油价格仍维持高位（尽管波动巨大 ） ， 毫无疑问这是由中东复杂的政治事件导致的。
en: Only oil prices remain high (though volatile), no doubt influenced by the complex political events in the Middle East.

zh: 从历史上看，这并不奇怪，我们的商品超级周期研究显示了这一点。
en: In historical terms, this is not surprising, as our research into commodity super-cycles shows.

zh: 自19世纪末以来，商品价格经历了三次长期周期和第四长周期的上升阶段，其主要推动力是全球需求。
en: Since the late nineteenth century, commodity prices have undergone three long-term cycles and the upward phase of a fourth, driven primarily by changes in global demand.

zh: 前两次周期相对较长（接近四十年 ） ， 但第三个周期较短（28年 ） 。
en: The first two cycles were relatively long (almost four decades), but the third was shorter (28 years).

zh: 所有四个超级周期的上升阶段都受需求激增的提振，但每次的源泉不同。
en: The upward phases of all four super-cycles were led by major increases in demand, each from a different source.

zh: 在当前周期中，中国的快速经济增长提供了动力，其占全球金属消费比例的上升就是明证。
en: During the current cycle, China’s rapid economic growth provided this impetus, exemplified by the country’s rising share of global metals consumption.

zh: 尽管这几个周期达到了相似的峰值，但下降阶段的幅度根据全球经济增长形势的不同而不同。
en: While these cycles reached similar peaks, the downswings’ intensity has varied according to global economic growth.

zh: 一战后以及1980年代和1990年代的下降势头很猛；相反，朝鲜战争后的降幅相对较弱，当时正逢世界经济的繁荣期。
en: The downswings following World War I and in the 1980’s and 1990’s were strong; in contrast, the dip after the Korean War, when the world economy was booming, was relatively weak.

zh: 二战后，不同商品板块的超级周��变得更加同步（包括石油，此前该商品显示出不同的波动模式 ） 。
en: After World War II, the super-cycles of different commodity groups became more closely synchronized (including oil, which had previously shown a different pattern).

zh: 正如中国经济繁荣推动了本次周期的商品价格增长，当前的价格下跌在很大程度上也是因为中国GDP增长减速，从2003—2007年以及2010年的两位数降至今年的7.5%左右。
en: Just as China’s economic boom drove commodity-price growth in the current cycle, so the recent weakening of prices has largely been a result of its decelerating GDP growth, from double-digit annual rates in 2003-2007, and again in 2010, to roughly 7.5% this year.

zh: 尽管对中国未来增长的预测各不相同，但所有人都认为其短期经济表现将会走弱，长期增长率甚至可能进一步下降。
en: While projections of China’s future growth vary, all predict weaker economic performance in the short term – and even lower growth rates in the long term.

zh: 根本性的短期问题是重复2008年雷曼兄弟公司倒闭后所采取的大规模经济刺激的政策空间有限。
en: The fundamental short-term issue is the limited policy space to repeat the massive economic stimulus adopted after the collapse of Lehman Brothers in 2008.

zh: 中国对抗危机所采取的投资拉动战略导致了债务积压以及需求结构的进一步扭曲 — — 目前投资比重极高（接近GDP的一半）而私人消费比重太低（约35 % ） — — 这进一步制约了决策者的选择。
en: China’s investment-led strategy to counter the crisis left a legacy of debt, and the continued deterioration of the demand structure – now characterized by an extremely high share of investment (close to half of GDP) and a low share of private consumption (about 35%) – further constrains policymakers’ options.

zh: 当前的共识是，这些反常需求模式在长期必须改变，中国要向消费拉动增长模式转变。
en: There is a consensus that these abnormal demand patterns must change in the long term, as China moves to a consumption-led growth model.

zh: 但是，为了完成这一转变，中国领导人必须实施深刻而全面的结构性改革，逆转继续鼓励投资和出口、直接间接对消费课税的政策方向。
en: But, to accomplish this transition, China’s leaders must implement deep and comprehensive structural reforms that reverse a policy approach that continues to encourage investment and exports while explicitly and implicitly taxing consumption.

zh: 中国未来经济转型所面临的不确定性在一定程度上给其增长前景蒙上了一层阴影。
en: The uncertainty surrounding China’s impending economic transformation muddies the growth outlook somewhat.

zh: 一些预测家预计中国将迎来软着陆，但对增长率的预测众说纷纭。
en: Some forecasters predict a soft landing, but differ on the growth rate.

zh: 官方数字表明2018—2022年年GDP增长为6.5 % ， 北京大学的佩蒂斯（Michael Pettis）认为3—4%的增长率才与消费的持续快速增长以及提高消费占GDP的目标相符。
en: Official estimates put annual GDP growth at 6.5% in 2018-2022, while Peking University’s Michael Pettis, for example, regards 3-4% growth as consistent with continuous rapid consumption growth and the targeted increase in consumption’s share of GDP.

zh: 硬着陆并伴生潜在债务危机的可能性也是存在的，但当局有足够的政策空间应对。
en: While hard-landing scenarios, associated with a potential debt crisis, are also possible, the authorities have enough policy space to manage them.

zh: 无论如何，下行风险相当高，而上行空间几乎不存在。
en: In any case, downside risks are high, and room on the upside is essentially non-existent.

zh: 因此，后危机时代的全球经济主要引擎将会减速，这将对过去十年最积极的经济趋势 — — 发达国家和发展中国家人均收入水平的趋同 — — 造成严重影响。
en: The main engine of the post-crisis global economy is therefore slowing, which has serious implications for one of the last decade’s most positive economic trends: the convergence of developed and developing countries’ per capita income levels.

zh: 正如中国经济繁荣让依赖商品的经济体（主要是发展中国家）获益良多，期减速也将反映于这些经济体增长率的下降上。
en: Just as China’s economic boom benefited commodity-dependent economies, primarily in the developing world, its slowdown is reflected in these economies’ declining growth rates.

zh: （事实上，一些南美国家已经遭遇了严重冲击，就连澳大利亚这样的发达国家也没能幸免。 ）
en: (In fact, while several South American countries have been among the hardest hit, even developed countries like Australia have not been immune.)

zh: 如果全球需求疲软导致当前商品超级周期的下降阶段与1918年后和20世纪末时一样猛烈，那么世界应该做好准备迎接增长停滞和世界收入趋同趋势的急剧减速甚至结束。
en: If weak global demand causes the current commodity super-cycle’s downswing to be as sharp as those of the post-1918 period and the late twentieth century, the world should be prepared for sluggish economic growth and a significant slowdown – or even the end – of income convergence worldwide.

zh: 中国快乐的面具
en: China’s Happy Mask

zh: 北京 - - 中国的“面子”可能是其致命的东西。
en: BEIJING – China’s “face” may be its Achilles’ Heel.

zh: 中国龙正在超越了亚洲的老虎以及西方的驴子。 正当它沉湎于经济超级大国地位之时却错误地忽视其严重的结构性弱点。
en: As it basks in its new status as an economic superpower – the dragon that is outpacing Asia’s tigers as well as the donkeys of the West – China is mistakenly downplaying its own serious structural weaknesses.

zh: 中共领导人认为难以提及中国的问题，更不必说强调这些问题。
en: The communist leadership finds it hard to mention, let alone emphasize, the country’s problems.

zh: 各级官员一心想要的就是得到尊重和不丢面子，导致他们几乎只关注中国的成就。
en: Officials’ preoccupation with commanding respect and not losing face leads them to focus almost exclusively on China’s achievements.

zh: 这是一个有可能逆火的战略，因为这错误地理解了国际政治的浩荡局势。
en: This is a strategy that risks backfiring, because it misunderstands the dynamics of international politics.

zh: 强调中国的大幅崛起意味着世界其他地方对于需要持续快速经济发展、从而满足其13亿人口的期望的理解不足。
en: Emphasizing China’s meteoric rise means less understanding in the rest of the world of the need to sustain rapid economic development in order to satisfy the expectations of its 1.3 billion inhabitants.

zh: 中国政府知道它面临严重的政治问题，但是在国内外却拒绝承认这一点。
en: The government knows that it has a political tiger by the tail, but refuses to acknowledge it, either inside China or outside.

zh: 贸易摩擦继续上升。
en: Trade tensions continue to mount.

zh: 美国在五月份与中国的“战略经济对话”后收效甚微，对此严重关切。 美国国会正威胁采取严厉的保护主义措施。
en: The United States is deeply concerned, following the minimal results of its “strategic economic dialogue” with China in May, and Congress is threatening tough protectionist measures.

zh: 欧盟也并不落后；很大程度上取决于中国在未来的18个月内双方谈判达成范围广泛的合作夥伴协议时如何解释说明。 这一协议将会决定未来十年中双边关系的质量。
en: The European Union may not be far behind; much will depend on how China presents its case over the coming 18 months as the two sides negotiate a wide-ranging Partnership Cooperation Agreement, which will determine the quality of bilateral relations for the next decade.

zh: 德国总理默克尔刚刚抵达北京，而法国总统萨尔科奇不久也可能造访。
en: German Chancellor Angela Merkel has just visited Beijing, with French President Nicolas Sarkozy likely to follow soon.

zh: 两位领导人当然都知道中国去年大幅上升的出口使得其超越美国而成为欧盟最大的外国供应国。
en: Both are surely aware that China’s surging exports last year helped it surpass the US as Europe’s largest foreign supplier.

zh: 当然，他们不会见到中国数以百万计人口生活水平极端地下，特别是农村的贫苦人民。
en: What they won’t see, of course, are the desperately low living standards of China’s teeming millions, especially the rural poor.

zh: 但是中国在于西方打交道的时候却毫无表明贫苦的心态。
en: Yet China is in no mood to plead poverty when dealing with the West.

zh: 它的目的就是从2008年奥运会以及2010年春夏之交的上海世博会中获得尽可能多的声望。
en: Its aim is to gain as much prestige as possible from the Olympic games in 2008 and the six-month World Expo in Shanghai during the spring and summer of 2010.

zh: 这两大活动项目是否能够改变世界的观点获得对其的好感并且加以保持还有待观察。
en: It remains to be seen whether the two events will be capable of swinging world opinion in China’s favor and keeping it there.

zh: 确实，中国政府怀疑国际媒体有可能在几千名记者云集中国之时，不可避免地将其报导范围超出体育而扩大到政治和人权问题。 这就可能引起摩擦。
en: Indeed, the government’s suspicion of the international media is liable to spark friction when thousands of journalists arrive and inevitably widen their coverage beyond athletics to politics and human rights.

zh: 目前，人们对于中国未来还是保持一贯的乐观高调。
en: For the time being, sentiment about China’s future remains relentlessly upbeat.

zh: 麦肯锡咨询公司甚至预计，到2025年，中高阶层人口将达到5亿2千万。 中共官员欢迎这种预计，因为这是对于其市场经济和严厉的国家控制的奇怪的组合的肯定。
en: McKinsey consultants have even forecast that the upper middle-class will number 520 million by 2025 – the sort of projection that the communist mandarins welcome as a tribute to their strange hybrid of a market economy and rigid state control.

zh: 但是，这几乎正是他们应当警觉的预计。
en: Yet it is almost certainly the sort of forecast of which they should beware.

zh: 远离北京或者上海等城市省份的当今中国的生活实际与其大不相同。
en: The reality of life in today’s China looks very different from the vantage point of a province far from the heady atmosphere of Beijing or Shanghai.

zh: 例如，位于中部的甘肃省与中国其他大多数地方一样正在应付结构性和社会问题，这些问题有的很棘手，有的难以克服。
en: For example, like much of the country, Gansu Province, at China’s geographical center, is grappling with structural and social problems that range from the daunting to the apparently insuperable.

zh: 人均年产值是大约900美元，构成其人口大多数的2千6百万农民的收入少于250美元。
en: Average annual output per capita is about $900, and incomes among the peasants who make up most of its rural population of 26 million are less than $250.

zh: 甘肃省的挑战包括将其重工业进行现代化改造，抵御沙化以及戈壁沙漠的侵袭。
en: Gansu’s challenges range from modernizing its heavy industries to resisting desertification and the encroachment of the Gobi desert.

zh: 尽管该省一直取得缓慢而稳步的进展，但是其未来还是受困于日益恶化的水源短缺；尽管黄河横跨该省，但是其地下水正在快速下降。
en: While it has been making slow but steady progress, its future is clouded by worsening water shortages; though it straddles the Yellow River, the water table is dwindling fast.

zh: 回到北京，那里的主要精力集中在缓和西方政府的同时维持11%的GDP增长。
en: Back in Beijing, the chief preoccupation is to safeguard 11% GDP growth while assuaging Western governments.

zh: 到今年年底，中国的出口将会超过2006的24 % ， 达到1.2兆美元，而其贸易顺差将增长43 % 。
en: By the end of this year, China’s exports will be 24% higher than in 2006, at $1.2 trillion, and its trade surplus will have grown by 43%.

zh: 但是贸易可能并不是中国的国际关系中德主要忧虑点。
en: But trade will probably not be the main worry for China’s international relations.

zh: 麻烦更有可能来自于西方对气候变化的日益增长的担忧。
en: Trouble seems more likely to come from growing concern in the West over climate change.

zh: 欧洲各国和美国的政治领导人可能完全知道中国在全球经济中的重要地位，但是，很多人感觉到，中国的工厂肮脏，对于环境造成伤害。
en: Political leaders in EU capitals and the US may be well aware of China’s global economic importance, but the widespread public perception is that its factories are dirty and environmentally harmful.

zh: 对于产品安全以及盗版问题的抗议可能会轻易地激起新的贸易限制的呼吁。
en: Rows over product safety and intellectual piracy could all too easily fuel calls for tough new trade limits.

zh: 答案并不是让中国加大其公关努力。
en: The answer is not for China to step up its public-relations effort.

zh: 相反，中国应该揭露其弱点和隐患来获得西方的谅解。
en: Instead, it should be revealing its weaknesses and vulnerabilities to gain Western understanding.

zh: 这的确将会是一场文化革命。
en: That really would be a cultural revolution.

zh: 中国的内部分歧
en: China’s House Divided

zh: 发自丹佛 — — 最近几年谈论美国衰落的声音越来越多，相应的是中国将取而代之的论调。
en: DENVER – There has been much talk about America’s decline in recent years, with the corollary that China will take its place.

zh: 虽然美国无疑面临着亟待解决的问题，但对于中国来说，如果不能解决好自家的事情，就无法实现进一步崛起，更别提在国际上取代美国了。
en: But, while the United States does indeed face problems that urgently need to be addressed, if China is to rise further, to say nothing of supplanting the US internationally, it must first put its own house in order.

zh: 那些认为美国正在走向衰落的人很难从经济角度解释自己的说法。
en: Those who argue that America is in decline have a difficult case to make in economic terms.

zh: 美国最近的确遇上了困难（对许多国家来说这算不上什么困难 ） ， 但仍然是工业和革新的火车头，而且很有可能在未来崛起成为一个能源大国。
en: For all its recent woes (which many countries would gladly exchange for their own), the US remains a dynamo of industry and innovation, and may be emerging as an energy powerhouse as well.

zh: 真正威胁美国在全球领导地位的，其实是这个国家在国内政治上出现的各种史无前例的分歧和争议。 美国人民一直以来都是勇于实践的人民。
en: What threatens America’s global leadership is, rather, some of the most divided and disruptive domestic politics in its history.

zh: 但是在今天，过多的理论和思想，以及所谓的“新思维”正在使这个国家陷入了疲惫虚弱的状态当中。 这种情况遏制了那些本应由与政治对手之间建设性互动而产生的具有实践意义的理念。
en: A country whose people have traditionally prided themselves on practicality is experiencing a debilitating bout of excessive theorizing, ideology, and so-called “new ideas,” thereby forestalling the practical ideas that come from constructive interaction with one’s political opponents.

zh: 美国国内政治中那种的妥协和共赢的遗产也对美国与别国的互动提出了新的挑战。
en: The demise of compromise and collegiality in domestic politics has raised new challenges in America’s interaction with others as well.

zh: 美国关于外交政策的辩论现在已经被谁“更强硬”的表态所主导，而“更强硬”却并不一定意味着“更聪明 ” 。
en: Foreign-policy debate in the US has become a proxy for who is “tougher,” which does not necessarily mean wiser.

zh: 于是乎，过去美国外交辩论方式中与不同观点交锋同时又能保留自己意见的做法，如今很大程度上已经变成了大声叫喊，互相指责，同时又自以为是，彼此揭短。
en: Thus, the American art of diplomatic engagement, the ability to talk with different sides while holding one’s own views to oneself, has been largely replaced by a penchant for loud talk, finger-pointing, self-righteousness, and recrimination.

zh: 很多国家曾经欢迎并寻求美国的参与，现在却敬而远之，尤其是当这种参与是为了迎合美国国内选民胃口而做出强硬姿态的时候。
en: Countries used to welcome and look for American engagement. Now some are more likely to fear it, especially if it comes in the form of playing to domestic American constituencies’ appetite for supposed toughness.

zh: 但是，当美国将国际社会的领导权交给中国之前，我们应该看到中国不但存在着国内政治分歧，而且也不能使其国内政治与其不断增长的国际责任协调一致。
en: But, before the US hands over international leadership to the Chinese, it would be instructive to look at China’s own internal political divisions and inability to synchronize its domestic politics with its growing global responsibilities.

zh: 这一点非常有启示意义，在中国的问题面前，那些困扰美国体制的问题都相形见绌。
en: China’s problems make those afflicting the US polity seem trivial in comparison.

zh: 近年中国越来越多地卷入到与东南亚邻国之间关于南中国海的，带有某种19世纪色彩的争端之中。
en: In recent years, China has been increasingly embroiled in a nineteenth-century-style dispute with several of its Southeast Asian neighbors over conflicting claims to the South China Sea.

zh: 在遗憾美国无心介入这一国际事务之前，仔细观察中国的行为是有启发意义的，你会发现它正在一步一步地将本来非常重要的区域关系搞得越来越复杂，而这指的又是哪些方面呢？
en: Before one laments Americans’ unwillingness to crack a history book on an international subject, it is enlightening to watch China in action, systematically complicating its vitally important relationships in the region over…what?

zh: 中国所谓的“九段线”基本上将整个南中国海变成了南中国的内湖，但这实际上这是民国时期遗留下来的说法。 那蒋介石委员长是在哪儿找到这套说辞的？
en: China’s so-called “nine dashes” claim, which essentially seeks to turn the entire South China Sea into a southern Chinese lake, represents a legacy of Chiang Kai-Shek’s Republic of China.

zh: 中国声称对于这片水域的所有权已经有了上千年历史。
en: And where did the Generalissimo find the inspiration for this claim?

zh: 但更可靠的说辞应该来源于不远的一段历史：日本帝国在1945年以前对台湾的占领将南中国海也纳入其中。
en: China argues that the waters have been Chinese for a thousand years, but the likelier inspiration is more recent, reflecting Imperial Japan’s occupation of Taiwan until 1945.

zh: 结果中国这个让全世界都羡慕其文化和发展成就的国家，就不得不为了一个没多长历史的继承权而与几乎所有南部邻国陷入口水战当中 — — 有时候还夹杂着海军舰艇的对峙，而解决问题还是要靠有礼有节的国际谈判。
en: Thus, China, whose culture and achievements are the envy of the world, is today in a war of words – and a few naval vessels as well – with almost all of its southern neighbors over a recently inherited claim on an issue that calls for a respectful process of international negotiation.

zh: 在这种情况之下，对于政策选择显然应该有多重考虑。
en: Various considerations typically underlie policy choices in such situations.

zh: 但是中国之所以在南中国海问题上进退失当，关键因素是国内民众公开谴责“政府示弱”并要求领导人表现强硬。
en: But, in the case of China’s ham-handedness in the South China Sea, domestic constituencies decrying “weakness” and demanding toughness from political leaders are a key factor.

zh: 中国现有的5亿网民如今民族主义情绪高涨，都在严厉批评官方在维护中国利益问题面前“太软弱 ” 。
en: Among China’s 500 million Internet users, for example, one senses a palpable rise in nationalist sentiment, reflected in bitter criticism of official “weakness” in defending Chinese interests.

zh: 中国政府对于这种批评极度敏感。
en: China’s government is extremely sensitive to such attacks.

zh: 如果有哪个中国博客写手批评政府镇压法轮功或表示支持西藏反对派，互联网警察就会立刻赶赴“罪行”现场。
en: If a Chinese blogger criticizes the government over its crackdown on Falun Gong, or supports Tibet’s opposition, the Internet police rush to the scene of the supposed crime.

zh: 但是如果网上发出带有侵略性的呼声，要求抢占更多原材料资源，政府就会表示欢迎并更加努力去取悦他们。
en: But if the blogosphere emits jingoistic calls for more raw materials, the government salutes and works harder to obtain them.

zh: 类似的这种国内政治压力使中国政府在别的事情上也会做出类似反应。
en: Domestic pressures have tied China in knots on other issues as well.

zh: 如果考虑到许多别的国家彼此之间也有海洋领域的冲突，许多国际观察家也许会原谅中国在南中国海的所做作为。
en: Many international observers might forgive China its behavior in the South China Sea, given that many countries, large and small, have maritime disputes with neighbors.

zh: 但是中国国内政治，无论是网民或者是相互打架的各种官方机构，现在都已经在世界范围内成为各国 — — 不论弹丸小国还是强权大国 — — 的笑柄。
en: But China’s own constituencies, whether netizens or competing official institutions, have contributed to an international record that is earning China derision from small neighbors and great powers alike.

zh: 中国对一直渴求核武器的朝鲜的支持就是一个例子。
en: China’s continued support for a nuclear aspirant like North Korea is a case in point.

zh: 世界上没有哪个负责任的大国会认为朝鲜的做法能够产生什么好处。
en: No responsible country in the world today sees any merit to North Korea’s behavior.

zh: 但是中国过于关注其国内政治，以致每次朝鲜胡作非为时都只会表示暧昧的遗憾之情，并不切实际地表达对朝鲜改革的希望。
en: Yet China’s preoccupation with its internal politics is such that it cannot see the price that it pays for reacting to every North Korean outrage with only vague opprobrium, combined with expressions of hope-over-experience that North Korea will reform.

zh: 中国对2010年朝鲜炮击韩国延坪岛事件视若无睹，让许多同为邻居的韩国人对两国关系大感绝望。
en: For example, the equanimity of its response to North Korea’s military attacks against South Korea in 2010 left South Koreans, who are also China’s neighbors, in despair about bilateral relations.

zh: 中国的外交政策之所以散乱无序，其原因在于中国领导层无力影响和塑造其国内政治动向：许多中国人仍旧将负隅顽抗的小国朝鲜当做自己的朋友和盟友。
en: The origin of China’s desultory policy lies in its leadership’s failure to shape or sharpen the drift of domestic politics: many Chinese still see plucky little North Korea as a friend and ally.

zh: 因此中国无法释放出认真处理朝鲜问题的信号，当然也就不会赢得一个对朝鲜的行为感到越来越厌恶的国际社会的广泛尊重。
en: So China does nothing to signal a more serious way forward, much less earn respect in the broader international community, which is now thoroughly disgusted by North Korea’s behavior.

zh: 在中国这张不可靠的外交政策清单上不止朝鲜一个国家。
en: The list of untenable policies goes on.

zh: 受到国内政治制约的中国现在有了最新的问题国家叙利亚，而且似乎又没处理好。
en: Syria is the latest international problem that China, again constrained by domestic politics, cannot seem to get right.

zh: 没有人指望中国会在叙利亚或者别的问题上紧跟美国或者欧盟。
en: No one expects China to line up in perfect formation with the US or the European Union on this and other issues.

zh: 可是中国却一直站在对立的一侧，甚至这种做法已经与自身国家利益相违背的时候依然故我。 这实在让人怀疑中国是否在内部有足够的底气去成为一个国际领导者。
en: But its consistent preference for lining up on the other side of the divide – even when doing so runs counter to its own national interests – calls into question whether it has the internal fortitude to be a leader.

zh: 当然，上述这一切无法减轻美国政治极端化的所产生的后果。
en: None of this is meant to minimize the consequences of political polarization in the US.

zh: 但当美国的外交问题是国内政治压力有时会导致过度强硬之时，中国的问题则是类似的压力使其在外交上优柔寡断。
en: But, whereas America’s problem in the world today is that domestic pressures sometimes lead to an excess of fortitude, China’s problem is that similarly constraining pressures produce foreign-policy weakness.

zh: 负责任的相关利益方中国
en: China the Responsible Stakeholder

zh: 东京—来到亚洲，你可以发现，越来越多的人担心中国正在该地区营造势力范围。
en: TOKYO – Come to Asia and you will hear a growing chorus of concern that China is building a sphere of influence in the region.

zh: 为了促进中国的对外投资，亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行）应运而生，其中中国政府将占有30%的股权。
en: To promote Chinese foreign investment, there is the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), in which the government is poised to take a 30% share.

zh: 还有中国的“一带一路”计划，该计划啊旨在构建一条覆盖中亚的丝绸之路经济带和一条连接中国和东南亚、印度洋、中东最终达到欧洲的海上丝绸之路。
en: And there is China’s “One Belt, One Road” initiative to construct a Silk Road Economic Belt extending through Central Asia, and a Maritime Silk Road linking China with Southeast Asia, the Indian Ocean, the Middle East, and ultimately Europe.

zh: 在金融方面，中国正在推广人民币的国际用途。
en: On the financial side, China is promoting wider international use of its currency, the renminbi.

zh: 此外，它还在不断通过军事主张利益，在存在纠纷的南沙群岛构筑工事，建设可供战斗机起降的跑道。
en: And it is increasingly asserting its interests militarily, fortifying the disputed Spratly Islands and constructing runways capable of accommodating fighter jets.

zh: 看待这些措施时，很重要的一点是注意其中的细节。
en: When contemplating these initiatives, it is important to take a nuanced view.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国在南海的岛基前哨阵地不但给越南、菲律宾和其他邻国的安全造成了威胁，也影响到它们的矿产和渔业权利。
en: There is no question that China’s new island-based outposts in the South China Sea pose a threat not just to the security of Vietnam, the Philippines and other neighboring countries, but also to their mineral and fishing rights.

zh: 国际社会有共同利益阻止这样的行为。
en: The international community has a shared interest in discouraging such activities.

zh: 但中国的经济措施对于国内和中国的贸易伙伴来说都有利可图，是完全不同的另一个故事。
en: But China’s economic initiatives, which promise benefits both at home and for the country’s partners, are a different matter.

zh: 对中国来说，亚投行和丝绸之路工程可以替代生产率低下的国内投资。
en: For China, the AIIB and Silk Road projects offer alternatives to unproductive domestic investment.

zh: 为中国、东南亚和崛起的中亚之间的日益兴盛的贸易打基础对于中国的建筑业来说是一条比在国内建设更多鬼城好得多的出路。
en: Laying the foundations for increased trade among China, South Asia, and emerging Central Asia represents a better outlet for the Chinese construction sector than building more ghost towns at home.

zh: 至于这些地区的其他国家来说，它们也能从增加的贸易中获益。
en: Countries in these other regions, for their part, also will benefit from the additional trade.

zh: 中国领导的基础设施银行有助于满足它们不断增加的基础设施需要，能让这些国家更加深入地与中国乃至全世界结合起来。
en: A Chinese-led infrastructure bank that helps meet their extensive infrastructure needs could integrate these countries more deeply not just with China but also with the rest of the world.

zh: 令人担忧之处在于，中国作为亚投行最大的股东和出资者，它将主导该银行，扭曲该银行的决策。
en: The worry is that China, as the AIIB’s largest shareholder and contributor, will dominate the bank and distort its decision-making.

zh: 怀疑派说，这将导致亚投行融资的铁路和公路项目全部指向中国，而受资国的增长将更加依赖 — — 不仅是金融上 — — 它们的强大的出资国。
en: The result, skeptics say, is that AIIB-financed rail and road projects will lead only to China, while recipients grow more dependent – and not just financially – on their powerful funder.

zh: 但事实上，50多个国家，包括持民主价值观的发达经济体在内，都加入了亚投行，这意味着有可能监督亚投行的行为。
en: But the fact that more than 50 countries, including advanced economies with democratic values, have joined the AIIB means that it will be possible to monitor its actions.

zh: 中国承诺亚投行将是开放透明的。
en: China promises that the new bank will be open and transparent.

zh: 对于这一点，理应“疑罪从无 ” ， 除非出现相反的证据。
en: It should be given the benefit of the doubt, at least until there is evidence to the contrary.

zh: 类似地，人民币国际化应该受到鼓励而不是阻止。
en: Similarly, renminbi internationalization should be encouraged rather than resisted.

zh: 诚然，扩大人民币作为跨境贸易和投资载体的国际使用将增加其他国家在危机时期对人民币计价信用的依赖。
en: To be sure, wider international use of the renminbi as a vehicle for cross-border trade and investment will heighten other countries’ dependence on renminbi-denominated credit in times of crisis.

zh: 意识到这一点，中国人民银行与其他央行进行了货币互换谈判，并指定中国五大国有商业银行之一作为官方清算银行为各大外国金融中心提供人民币交易结算服务。
en: Acknowledging this, the People’s Bank of China has negotiated currency swap lines with other central banks and has designated one of the country’s five large state-owned commercial banks as official clearing bank to settle transactions in renminbi in a variety of foreign financial centers.

zh: 与此同时，中国要求国际货币基金组织（IMF）将人民币纳入其账户单位 — — 特别提款权（SDR）的成分货币篮子中。
en: Meanwhile, China has asked the International Monetary Fund to include the renminbi in the basket of currencies comprising Special Drawing Rights, the Fund’s unit of account.

zh: 对于这一结果，其他国家应该欢迎，因为这将增加中国在这一监督全球货币体系运营的多边机构中的分量。
en: That is an outcome that the rest of us should welcome, because it would give China a greater stake in a multilateral institution that oversees the operation of the global monetary system.

zh: 人民币国际化让世界拥有除美元外的另一个全球流动性源泉，因此值得鼓励。
en: Renminbi internationalization is also desirable insofar as it gives the world another source of global liquidity besides the dollar.

zh: 当美国金融出问题时 — — 比如2008年 — — 其他国家能够获得备用紧急信用。
en: When things go wrong financially in the United States, as they did in 2008, other countries will be able to tap a backup supply of emergency credit.

zh: 事实上，中国已经为多个国家制定了清算银行并进行了货币互换谈判，不仅包括亚洲国家，也包括欧洲和西半球国家。
en: Indeed, China has designated clearing banks for, and negotiated swap lines with, countries in not just Asia but in Europe and the Western Hemisphere as well.

zh: 中国并非在亚洲构建一个货币区，而是寻求让人民成为真正的全球货币，有一天能够对抗美元。
en: Rather than attempting to build a monetary bloc in Asia, China appears to be seeking to elevate the renminbi to the status of a true global currency that might one day rival the dollar.

zh: 存在不止一个紧急贷款人和多条国际流动性渠道能带来诸多好处，因此这对世界其他国家来说是件不折不扣的好事。
en: Given the advantages of having more than one emergency lender and multiple sources of international liquidity, this can only be a good thing for the rest of the world.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国感到了它的重要性，也更加着力地彰显它的地位。
en: No question, China is feeling its oats and asserting itself more forcefully.

zh: 当中国的行为威胁到其邻国时 — — 比如其南海领土主张 — — 应该强烈地予以制裁和抵制。
en: Where China’s actions threaten its neighbors, as with its territorial claims in the South China Sea, they should be strongly sanctioned and resisted.

zh: 但当它的政策可能在经济上惠及其他国家时 — — 比如通过亚投行和丝绸之路工程提供基础设施融资 — — 也该获得鼓励。
en: But where its policies promise economic benefits for other countries, as in the case of infrastructure finance through the AIIB and the Silk Road initiative, they should be encouraged.

zh: 人民币国际化措施也是如此，它能让中国更加深入地融入全球经济，让它在国际体系的稳定中起更大的作用。
en: This is equally true of initiatives like renminbi internationalization, which will integrate China more deeply into the global economy, giving it a bigger stake in the stability of the international system.

zh: 国际社会不必因为害怕而反对，而应该鼓励中国的建设性参与。
en: Rather than recoiling in fear, the international community should encourage China’s constructive engagement.

zh: 迈向这一目标的第一步应该是仔细审视中国最近的举措。
en: The first step toward that goal should be to take a more nuanced view of China’s recent initiatives.

zh: 中国铁拳的丝绸手套
en: A Silk Glove for China’s Iron Fist

zh: 新德里—多年来，中国一直在寻求用“珍珠链”包围南亚。 所谓“珍珠链”是指连接中国东部沿海到中东的港口网络，这条链能增强其战略实力和海上航线。
en: NEW DELHI – For years, China has sought to encircle South Asia with a “string of pearls": a network of ports connecting its eastern coast to the Middle East that would boost its strategic clout and maritime access.

zh: 毫不奇怪，印度和其他国家将此视为严重威胁。
en: Not surprisingly, India and others have regarded this process with serious concern.

zh: 但是，如今，中国试图掩饰这一战略，声称其意欲建设二十一世纪海上丝绸之路以促进贸易和文化交流。
en: Now, however, China is attempting to disguise its strategy, claiming that it wants to create a twenty-first-century maritime Silk Road to improve trade and cultural exchange.

zh: 但友好的说辞难以平息亚洲和其他地区的担忧：中国的战略目标是主宰这一地区。
en: But friendly rhetoric can scarcely allay concern in Asia and beyond that China's strategic goal is to dominate the region.

zh: 这一担忧理由充分。
en: That concern is well founded.

zh: 简言之，丝绸之路计划就是为了中国成为亚洲和印度洋地区新秩序的枢纽。
en: Simply put, the Silk Road initiative is designed to make China the hub of a new order in Asia and the Indian Ocean region.

zh: 事实上，中国在努力使自己成为贸易大动脉的主宰者，同时煽动与不少邻国的领土和领海纠纷，以此改变亚洲的地缘政治版图。
en: Indeed, by working to establish its dominance along major trade arteries, while instigating territorial and maritime disputes with several neighbors, China is attempting to redraw Asia's geopolitical map.

zh: 海上丝绸之路有其战略图谋，这是基于一个事实：解放军主导着这一主题的讨论。
en: The strategic dimension of the maritime Silk Road is underscored by the fact that the People's Liberation Army has led the debate on the subject.

zh: 中国国防大学少将纪明葵指出，这一计划有助于中国构建“新形象 ” 、 “赢得影响力 ” ， 特别是在美国的亚洲“支点 ” “ 失去动力”时。
en: The PLA National Defense University's Major General Ji Mingkui argues that the initiative can help China to craft a “new image" and “win influence," especially as the US “pivot" to Asia “loses momentum."

zh: 但解放军专家仍忙不迭否认丝绸之路计划与“珍珠链”有关。
en: Yet PLA experts remain eager to disavow the Silk Road initiative's link with the “string of pearls."

zh: 相反，他们将其与十五世纪的郑和下西洋相提并论。 郑和的宝船队伍一直航行至非洲。
en: Instead, they compare it to the fifteenth-century expeditions of Zheng He, a Chinese eunuch admiral who led a fleet of treasure ships to Africa.

zh: 根据中央军委委员孙思敬的说法，郑和在古丝绸之路的航行中没有侵占“一寸土地 ” ， 也没有寻求“海洋霸权 ” （ 但历史证明他使用军事力量 — — 比如处决地方统治者 — — 控制海路要塞 ） 。
en: According to Central Military Commission member Sun Sijing, Zheng used the ancient Silk Road without seizing “one inch of land" or seeking “maritime hegemony" (though history attests to his use of military force – for example, executing local rulers – to control maritime chokepoints).

zh: 在现实中，海上丝绸之路和“珍珠链”基本没有区别。
en: In reality, little distinguishes the maritime Silk Road from the “string of pearls."

zh: 尽管表面上中国采取了和平战术推进该计划，但其主要目标并非多赢合作；而是战略主宰。
en: Though China is employing ostensibly peaceful tactics to advance the initiative, its primary goal is not mutually beneficial cooperation; it is strategic supremacy.

zh: 事实上，丝绸之路是中国国家主席习近平的“中国之路”野心的一部分。 中国梦就是要重塑中国过去的光荣和地位。
en: Indeed, the Silk Road is integral to President Xi Jinping's “China dream" ambitions, which entail restoring China's past glory and status.

zh: 中国，特别是习近平治下的中国，常常使用援助、投资或其他经济杠杆迫使邻国加深对中国的经济依赖 — — 并扩大与中国的安全合作。
en: China, especially under Xi, has often used aid, investment, and other economic leverage to compel its neighbors to deepen their economic dependence on – and expand their security cooperation with – the People's Republic.

zh: 习近平投入400亿美元建立丝绸之路基金并出资成立新的亚洲基础设施投资银行以发展海上丝绸之路，反映的就是这一方针。
en: Xi's use of a $40 billion Silk Road Fund and the new China-sponsored Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank to develop the maritime Silk Road reflects this approach.

zh: 中国已经在地区内的沿海国家建设了港口、铁路、高速公路和管道，这不仅是为了便利矿产资源进口和中国制造品出口，也是为���推进其战略军事目标。
en: Already, China is constructing ports, railroads, highways, and pipelines in the region's littoral states, not only to facilitate mineral-resource imports and exports of Chinese manufactured goods, but also to advance its strategic military goals.

zh: 比如，中国与巴基斯坦完成了数十亿美元的交易，在瓜达尔开发港口，原因就在于这里霍尔木兹海峡口的战略区位，这足以抵消该港口商业潜力有限的弊端。
en: For example, China concluded a multi-billion dollar deal with Pakistan to develop the port at Gwadar, owing to its strategic location at the mouth of the Strait of Hormuz, which more than offsets the port's limited commercial potential.

zh: 去年秋天，中国攻击型潜艇两次停驻斯里兰卡科伦坡港新开的价值5亿美元的集装箱码头 — — 该码头由中国国有公司建设并拥有多数股权。
en: Twice last autumn, Chinese attack submarines docked at Sri Lanka's newly opened, $500 million container terminal at Colombo Harbor – built and majority-owned by Chinese state companies.

zh: 如今，中国在科伦坡进行一项14亿美元的工程，填海造出一片相当于摩纳哥大小的土地建造综合体 — — 这个“港口城市”将成为中国海上“之路”的主要停靠站。
en: China has now embarked on a $1.4-billion project to build a sprawling complex roughly the size of Monaco on reclaimed land in Colombo – a “port city" that will become a major stop on China's nautical “road."

zh: 解放军军事科学院荣誉研究员周波承认，中国的巨型工程“将从根本上改变印度洋的政治和经济格局 ” ， 同时将中国描述为“强大而温和”的力量。
en: Zhou Bo, an honorary fellow with the PLA Academy of Military Science, admits that China's mega-projects “will fundamentally change the political and economic landscape of the Indian Ocean," while presenting China as a “strong yet benign" power.

zh: 这一点很重要，因为新亚洲秩序与其说将由东亚发展趋势决定，不如说将由印度洋所发生的事件决定。 在东亚，日本必然会阻挠中国的崛起，而在印度洋，中国正在挑战目前的印度主导地位。
en: This is important, because the new Asian order will be determined less by developments in East Asia, where Japan is determined to block China's rise, than by events in the Indian Ocean, where China is chipping away at India's longstanding dominance.

zh: 印度当然怀疑中国的行为。
en: India is certainly suspicious of China's behavior.

zh: 但中国小心翼翼，以使其能够继续推进其目标而不打草惊蛇。
en: But China is treading carefully enough that it can continue to advance its goals, without spooking its intended quarry.

zh: 美国学者约翰·贾沃尔（John Garver）用中国寓言很好地描述了这一局面 ： “ 青蛙在温吞水中感觉舒适又安全。
en: The American academic John Garver depicted it best using a Chinese fable: “A frog in a pot of lukewarm water feels quite comfortable and safe.

zh: 他没有注意到水温正在缓慢上升，直到被杀死并彻底煮熟。 ”
en: He does not notice as the water temperature slowly rises until, at last, the frog dies and is thoroughly cooked."

zh: 照此看，中国邀请印度参与其海上丝绸之路也就不足为奇了。
en: Seen in this light, it is not surprising that China has invited India to join the maritime Silk Road initiative.

zh: 中国的目标不仅是安抚狐疑的邻国，还包括减缓印度与美国和日本的战略关系。
en: The aim is not only to help calm a suspicious neighbor, but also to slow the development of India's strategic ties with the US and Japan.

zh: 中国的丝绸之路计划综合了经济、外交、能源和安全目标，其手段是打造庞大的连接设施网络促进贸易、协助战略渗透、使其日益强大和活跃的潜艇部队起到更大作用。
en: China's plans for the Silk Road combine economic, diplomatic, energy, and security objectives in an effort to create an expansive network of linked facilities to boost trade, aid strategic penetration, and permit an increasingly potent and active submarine force to play an expanded role.

zh: 在此过程中，中国意在改变亚洲秩序，使之不再基于与美国的实力平衡，而是基于其自身的霸权。
en: In the process, China aims to fashion an Asian order based not on a balance of power with the US, but on its own hegemony.

zh: 民主国家只有齐心协力才能阻挡这一战略。
en: Only a concert of democracies can block this strategy.

zh: 中国的丝绸之路复兴
en: China’s Silk Road Revival

zh: 新德里 — “ 丝绸之路”给人们以浪漫印象 — — 一半是历史，一半是传说 — — 商人带着驼队和帐篷走在中亚无路可循的沙漠和丘陵中。
en: NEW DELHI – The phrase “Silk Road” evokes a romantic image – half history, half myth – of tented camel caravans winding their way across the trackless deserts and mountains of Central Asia.

zh: 但丝绸之路并不只是虚构的过去的一部分；它也是中国最新外交政策的重要特征。
en: But the Silk Road is not just part of a fabled past; it is an important feature of China’s current foreign policy.

zh: 历史上的丝绸之路由一条陆路和一条海路组成，这两条路促进了商品和思想传向欧洲和东南亚，有中国茶叶，有纸、火药和指南针这样的发明，也有佛经和印度音乐这样的文化产品。
en: The historical Silk Road comprised an overland and a maritime route, both of which facilitated the transfer to Europe of South and East Asian goods and ideas, from Chinese tea to inventions like paper, gunpowder, and the compass, as well as cultural products like Buddhist scripture and Indian music.

zh: 类似地，丝绸之路 — — 主要是指途径阿拉伯世界抵达欧洲的陆路通道 — — 让中国接触到印度的天文学、植物和草药，也接触到了佛教和伊斯兰教信仰。
en: Likewise, the Silk Road – primarily the overland route, which also passed through the Arab world to Europe – gave China access to Indian astronomy, plants, and herbal medicines, while introducing it to the Buddhist and Islamic faiths.

zh: 十五世纪初，七下印度洋的郑和让中国产品成为印度西南部喀拉拉邦妇女们最喜爱的炊具。
en: Thanks to Chinese Admiral Zheng He, who steered his naval fleet across the Indian Ocean seven times in the early fifteenth century, the Chinese wok became the favorite cooking vessel of women in the southwestern Indian state of Kerala.

zh: 中国渔网至今仍在科钦（Kochi）水域中使用。
en: Chinese fishing nets still dot the waters off Kochi.

zh: 1411年，在斯里兰卡海岸附近的加勒（Galle）竖起一块石碑，石碑上用汉字、波斯文和泰米尔文镌刻着祈祷印度诸神保佑他建立基于贸易和商业的和平世界的铭文。
en: In 1411, Zheng erected a stone tablet – translated into Chinese, Persian, and Tamil – near the Sri Lankan coastal town of Galle, with an inscription appealing to the Hindu gods to bless his efforts to build a peaceful world based on trade and commerce.

zh: 六百年后，中国国家主席习近平也在追求类似的目标 — — 只不过他寻求欧洲和亚洲的政治领袖配合他的目标。
en: Six hundred years later, Chinese President Xi Jinping is espousing a similar goal – only he is appealing to political leaders throughout Europe and Asia to advance his cause.

zh: 去年9月，在哈萨克斯坦巴扎尔巴耶夫大学（Nazarbayev University）的演讲中，习近平提出了所谓的“丝绸之路经济带 ” ， 这是一项旨在增进欧亚地区国际合作和联合开发的新外交政策。
en: In September of last year, in a speech at Kazakhstan’s Nazarbayev University, Xi announced the so-called “Silk Road Economic Belt,” a new foreign-policy initiative aimed at boosting international cooperation and joint development throughout Eurasia.

zh: 习近平提出了五个具体目标：加强经济合作，改善陆路连接，促进贸易和投资，促进货币兑换，加强人际交流。
en: To guide the effort, Xi identified five specific goals: strengthening economic collaboration, improving road connectivity, promoting trade and investment, facilitating currency conversion, and bolstering people-to-people exchanges.

zh: 一个月后，另一只鞋也落了地。
en: The following month, the other shoe dropped.

zh: 习近平在印尼议会演讲时号召重新建立昔日的海洋网络，形成二十一世纪的“海洋丝绸之路”促进国际联系、科学和环境研究以及渔业活动。
en: Xi, addressing Indonesia’s Parliament, called for the re-establishment of the old sea networks to create a twenty-first century “maritime Silk Road” to foster international connectivity, scientific and environmental research, and fishery activities.

zh: 随后，中国国务院总理李克强在亚太经济合作峰会上重申了这一目标，然后又在去年的东亚峰会上再次重申。
en: Chinese Premier Li Keqiang subsequently reiterated that goal at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit, and again at the East Asia Summit last year.

zh: 自此以后，建立现代陆路和海路丝绸之路就成为中国的官方政策，受到中共和全国人大的支持。
en: Since then, the establishment of a modern overland and maritime Silk Road has become official Chinese policy, endorsed by the Communist Party and the National People’s Congress.

zh: 习近平强调，丝绸之路经济计划的目标重振当代全球化世界的古老联系和友谊。
en: Xi has emphasized that the goal of the Silk Road economic initiative is to revive ancient ties of friendship in the contemporary globalized world.

zh: 但毫无疑问，他也有其国内动机，即日益拉大的东西部经济差距。
en: But he undoubtedly has a domestic motive as well, rooted in the growing prosperity gap between eastern and western China.

zh: 经济活动集中在东部城市和特别经济区造成了能源供给和环境约束和瓶颈，妨碍了中国追求不如高收入行列所必须的可持续、包容性增长的能力。
en: The concentration of economic activity in the cities and special economic zones of the east has generated energy-supply and environmental constraints and bottlenecks that are hampering China’s ability to achieve the sustainable, inclusive growth that it needs to attain high-income status.

zh: 中国政府希望丝绸之路计划可以使西部和西南地区成为中国下一阶段的发展引擎。
en: The government hopes that the Silk Road initiative will make China’s west and southwest regions the engines of the next phase of the country’s development.

zh: 尽管如此，该计划的国际部分仍然更加重要，也更加复杂。
en: Nonetheless, the initiative’s international dimension remains the most relevant – and complex.

zh: 中国外交官指出，近几年来所建立或强化的众多制度和平台有助于将实现该计划影响最大化，如上海合作组织、孟加拉国-中国-印度-缅甸走廊、中国-巴基斯坦经济走廊、中国建设的渝新欧铁路（从重庆到德国，可进一步延伸到北欧海港 ） 、 中国和中亚以及缅甸之间方兴未艾的新能源走廊等。
en: Chinese diplomats have pointed to a constellation of mechanisms and platforms built or strengthened in recent years that could help maximize its impact. These include the Shanghai Cooperation Organization; the Bangladesh-China-India-Myanmar Corridor; the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor; the Chinese-built Yuxinou Railway from Chongqing to Germany (and onward to north European ports); and the new and incipient energy corridors between China and Central Asia, as well as Myanmar.

zh: 此外，中国与其他金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度和南非）成立了新开发银行，还建立了亚洲基础设施投资银行 — — 毫无疑问，这些机构将从中国巨大的投资盈余中获益。
en: Moreover, China has established the New Development Bank with its fellow BRICS members (Brazil, Russia, India, and South Africa) and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank – institutions that will undoubtedly benefit from China’s enormous investible surplus.

zh: 中国在这两大机构中都起着主导作用，因此可以轻松地利用它们为丝绸之路相关项目融资。
en: Given China’s prominent role in both, they could easily be used to provide financing for Silk Road-related programs.

zh: 但是，尽管中国或许并不难于为丝绸之路野心融资，但可能面临政治阻力 — — 特别是在海上丝绸之路上。
en: But, though China may not struggle to finance its Silk Road ambitions, it is likely to face political resistance – especially with regard to the maritime route.

zh: 中国在东南沿海的进攻姿态正在引起邻国的焦虑 — — 包括日本、越南、菲律宾和新加坡 — — 因此丝绸之路计划将带来巨大的地缘政治恐慌。
en: At a time when China’s assertive stance in the South and East China Seas is provoking anxiety among its neighbors – including Japan, Vietnam, the Philippines, and Singapore – the Silk Road initiative has aroused significant geopolitical apprehension.

zh: 事实上，这些恐慌有其深刻的历史根源。
en: In fact, these fears have a strong historical basis.

zh: 郑和在下西洋的过程中在今天的印尼、马来西亚、私利兰克和印度使用暴力扶持友好统治者、控制印度洋沿岸战略要塞。
en: Zheng’s expeditions involved the use of military force in present-day Indonesia, Malaysia, Sri Lanka, and India to install friendly rulers and control strategic chokepoints across the Indian Ocean.

zh: 他干预斯里兰卡和印尼的王朝政治，诱捕并处死地方统治者。
en: He intervened in the dynastic politics of Sri Lanka and Indonesia, abducting and executing local rulers.

zh: 他甚至抢夺象征斯里兰卡政治主权的佛陀牙齿舍利。
en: He even seized the relic of the tooth of Buddha, a symbol of Sri Lankan political sovereignty.

zh: 因此，在郑和下西洋沿途国家看来，他的旅程并不只是为了促进贸易和建立商业联系，也是为了直接军事干预它们的事务，所谓引入在中华帝国统治下的和谐世界秩序只是借口。
en: The countries along Zheng’s route therefore recall his adventures not just as initiatives to promote trade and establish commercial links, but also as direct military intervention in their affairs, under the pretext of ushering in a harmonious world order under China’s emperor.

zh: 唤醒对这一痛苦过去的回忆并不完全符合中国的利益。
en: Reminding them of this painful past may not be entirely in China’s interest.

zh: 这并不是说现代丝绸之路将只有利于中国。
en: This is not to say that the modern Silk Road would benefit only China.

zh: 相反，其陆路和海路铜带可能吸引大量投资进入沿途国家 — — 特别是来自中国的投资，中国正在寻找新途径部署其为数巨大的储备。
en: On the contrary, its overland and maritime routes could attract considerable investment to participating countries – especially from China, as it seeks new avenues for deploying its vast reserves.

zh: 但现代丝绸之路的建设也标志着古代中国“天下”观的复兴。 在“天下”观念中，中国皇帝是天指定的全部已知世界的统治者。
en: But the modern Silk Road’s establishment will also mark a step toward reinvigorating the ancient Chinese concept of tianxia, in which the Chinese emperor was considered the divinely appointed ruler of the entire known world.

zh: 许多亚洲人仍记得日本在二战前和二战期间试图通过征服建立“大东亚共荣圈 ” ， 即日本统治下的自给自足的国家圈。
en: Many Asians still remember Japanese efforts before and during World War II to create a “Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere” – a self-sufficient bloc of countries, under Japan’s leadership – through conquest.

zh: 也许中国也有类似的想法 — — 只不过没有那么公然罢了？
en: Might China be on a similar – albeit less openly aggressive – path?

zh: 具有中国特色的发展金融学？
en: Development Finance with Chinese Characteristics?

zh: 发自日内瓦 — — 在亚洲基础设施投资银行（AIIB）再次添加了一批姗姗来迟的创始成员国后，如今焦点开始转向以中国为导向的亚投行规则和规定的设置。
en: GENEVA – After a late flurry of additions to the founding membership of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank, attention now turns to setting the China-led AIIB’s rules and regulations.

zh: 但最重要的问题依然存在，就是亚投行对现有的多边金融机构，比如世界银行，究竟是潜在的竞争对手还是喜闻乐见的补充。
en: But important questions remain – most important, whether the AIIB is a potential rival or a welcome complement to existing multilateral financial institutions like the World Bank.

zh: 自从去年10月中国和20个主要亚洲国家签署了亚投行最初的谅解备忘录后，其他36个国家，包括澳大利亚、巴西、埃及、芬兰、法国、德国、印尼、伊朗、以色列、意大利、挪威、俄罗斯、沙特阿拉伯、南非、韩国、瑞典、瑞士，土耳其和英国 — — 均以创始成员国的身份加入其中。
en: Since China and 20 mostly Asian countries signed the AIIB’s initial memorandum of understanding last October, 36 other countries – including Australia, Brazil, Egypt, Finland, France, Germany, Indonesia, Iran, Israel, Italy, Norway, Russia, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Turkey, and the United Kingdom – have joined as founding members.

zh: 根据中国财政部公布的资料消息，亚投行的创始成员计划在7月前完成谈判协议条款，并于今年底开始实施。
en: According to China’s finance ministry, the AIIB’s founding members are to complete negotiations on the Articles of Agreement before July, with operations to begin by the end of the year.

zh: 中国将成为谈判会议的常务主席，与轮值主席的其他成员国联席主持会谈。
en: China will serve as the standing chairman of the negotiators’ meetings, which will be co-chaired by the member country hosting the talks.

zh: 4月底，第四届首席谈判代表会议在北京结束，第五届会议将于5月底在新加坡举行。
en: The fourth chief negotiators’ meeting was completed in Beijing in late April, and the fifth will take place in Singapore in late May.

zh: 中国经济学家金立群被推选带领亚投行多边临时秘书处，负责监督亚洲投资银行的建立。
en: The Chinese economist Jin Liqun has been selected to lead the AIIB’s Multilateral Interim Secretariat, charged with overseeing the bank’s establishment.

zh: 虽然创始成员之间将以GDP为基本标准配置股份，但财政部于10月时表示，中国不一定需要依据其GDP占比而获得50%的股份。
en: While GDP will be the basic criterion for share allocation among the founding members, the finance ministry suggested in October that China does not necessarily need the 50% stake that its GDP would imply.

zh: 此外，尽管亚投行总部设在北京，但外交部表示，区域办事处和高级管理人员的任命可以通过进一步磋商和谈判决定。
en: Moreover, although the AIIB will be based in Beijing, the ministry has said that regional offices and senior management appointments will be subject to further consultation and negotiation.

zh: 就像金砖国家(巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非)去年夏天宣布建立500亿美元规模的新开发银行一样，亚投行也面临着相当严厉的审视，例如一些西方领导人质疑其治理、透明度和动机。
en: Like the $50 billion New Development Bank announced by the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) last summer, the AIIB has faced considerable scrutiny, with some Western leaders questioning its governance, transparency, and motives.

zh: 事实上，许多西方人会认为它的建立会在一定程度上取代现有的多边贷款机构。
en: Indeed, many in the West have portrayed their establishment as part of an effort to displace existing multilateral lenders.

zh: 但是相比取代当前机构，新开发银行似乎对改进这些机构更感兴趣 — — 这也是两者的共同目标。
en: But the new development banks seem less interested in supplanting current institutions than in improving upon them – an objective shared by those institutions themselves.

zh: 正如中国财政部副部长史耀斌最近指出，通过识别改革治理的需求，现有多边贷款机构表明，事实上没有“最佳实践 ” ， 只有“更好的实践 ” 。
en: As Deputy Finance Minister Shi Yaobin pointed out recently, by recognizing the need to reform their governance, existing multilateral lenders have shown that there are, in fact, no “best practices” – only “better practices.”

zh: 同时也没理由不让其他机构来推动改革
en: There is no reason improvements cannot originate elsewhere.

zh: 事实上，鉴于其实验方法的发展，一些高级官员已经暗示。 中国不仅适合，而且愿意多为这个过程做出贡献。
en: In fact, given its experimental approach to development, China is well-suited – and, as some top officials have hinted, more than willing – to contribute to this process.

zh: 如果中国能够帮助找到一种方法，来对高贷款审核标准和无可避免的快速分散贷款项目进行平衡，全球经济治理就将极大受益。
en: If China can help find a way to balance the need for high standards and safeguards in project lending with the imperative of rapid loan dispersion, global economic governance would benefit significantly.

zh: 为了开创一种更务实的方法来发展金融，中国的制度模式可能是习近平主席于去年11月宣布的400亿美元丝路基金。
en: In pioneering a more pragmatic approach to development finance, China’s institutional model could be the $40 billion Silk Road Fund that President Xi Jinping announced last November.

zh: 丝路基金和亚投行将作为中国 “一带一路”战略主要的金融工具，以创建两个现代丝绸之路 — — （陆上）经济带“丝绸之路”和“21世纪海上丝绸之路 ” — —横跨亚洲至欧洲。
en: The SRF and the AIIB will serve as the key financial instruments of China’s “One Belt, One Road” strategy, centered on the creation of two modern-day Silk Roads – the (overland) “Silk Road Economic Belt” and the “Twenty-First Century Maritime Silk Road” – stretching across Asia toward Europe.

zh: 主要通过为基础设施如公路、铁路、机场、港口和发电厂提供融资，致力于促进亚太地区经济合作和一体化。
en: The initiative will aim to promote economic cooperation and integration in the Asia-Pacific region, mainly by providing financing for infrastructure like roads, railways, airports, seaports, and power plants.

zh: 然而，丝路基金从西方媒体得到的关注非常少。
en: Yet the SRF has received scant attention from Western media.

zh: 这是不幸的，因为它将可能在发展金融变革中发挥重要的作用，而我们却对它知之甚少。
en: This is unfortunate, because what little is known about it suggests that it could play an important role in transforming development finance.

zh: 据中国媒体报道，丝路基金将由四大国家机构控制。
en: According to Chinese media, the SRF will be capitalized by four state agencies.

zh: 国家外汇管理局将持有65%的股份，中国投资公司（CIC，中国主权财富基金）和中国进出口银行将分别有15%的股份；中国国家开发银行（国开行）将持有剩余5%的股份。
en: The State Administration of Foreign Exchange will hold a 65% stake; the China Investment Corporation (CIC, the country’s sovereign-wealth fund) and the China Export-Import Bank (China Exim) will each have a 15% stake; and the China Development Bank (CDB) will hold the remaining 5%.

zh: 该基金于2014年12月正式注册，并于次月举行了第一次董事会会议。
en: The Fund was officially registered in December 2014, and held its first Board of Directors meeting the following month.

zh: 从某种意义上说，丝路基金可以被认为是中国最新的主权财富基金项目公司，一些媒体甚至称其为“第二个中投 ” 。
en: In a sense, the SRF can be considered China’s latest sovereign-wealth-fund initiative, and some media have even referred to it as the “second CIC.”

zh: 但是，中投是受财政部管理控制的，而丝路基金的运营似乎反映了中国人民银行的影响。
en: But, whereas the CIC is under the managerial control of the finance ministry, the SRF’s operations appear to reflect the influence of the People’s Bank of China.

zh: 在最近的一次采访中，中国央行行长周小川建议丝路基金在其“常规”的融资功能之外，更应致力于“合作项目 ” ， 尤其是直接股权投资。
en: In a recent interview, the PBOC’s governor, Zhou Xiaochuan, suggested that the SRF would concentrate more on “cooperation projects,” particularly direct equity investment, before hinting at the Fund’s “just right” financing features.

zh: 例如，周小川表示丝路基金将采取至少15年时间的投资项目，而不是大多数私募股权公司采取的7-10年，因为发展中国家的基础设施投资回报率相对较慢。
en: For example, Zhou indicated that the SRF will adopt at least a 15-year time horizon for investments, rather than the 7-10-year horizon adopted by many private equity firms, to account for the slower return on infrastructure investment in developing countries.

zh: 此外，丝路基金应该作为其他国家金融机构所选项目进行股权和债务融资的催化剂。
en: Moreover, the SRF could act as a catalyst for other state financial institutions to contribute to a selected project’s equity and debt financing.

zh: 国际货币基金组织和其他私人、公共投资者 — — 将首先合资投资项目。
en: The Fund and other private and public investors – would first make joint equity investments in the project.

zh: 中国进出口银行和国开行可能随后为债务融资支付贷款，中投公司提供进一步的股权融资。
en: China Exim and the CDB could subsequently disburse loans for debt financing, with the CIC providing further equity financing.

zh: 亚投行启动并运行时，它也可以通过债务融资与最初的股权投资支持这一过程。
en: When the AIIB is up and running, it, too, could support this process, by arranging debt financing alongside SRF’s initial equity investment.

zh: 当然，这些新融资计划还有很多东西要消化研究。
en: Of course, there is still much to digest in these new financing initiatives.

zh: 但是你可以看到新兴南-南发展金融格局的轮廓 — — 也是有潜力去更广泛实现多边贷款的转型。
