en: Of course, China’s leaders vigorously resisted that evangelism, especially after the collapse of communism in Europe in 1989, often berating the West for “intruding in the internal affairs of China” and clinging even more defiantly to their Leninist, one-party form of governance.

zh: 而中国那种充满活力，更现代也更全球化的经济与其缺乏透明度的一党执政体制之间的不平衡状态也日益加深，在许多西方专家看来，这种矛盾对立将不可避免地使中国走向危机。
en: As the imbalance between China’s ever more dynamic, modern, and globalized economy and its opaque, single-party system of political rule deepened, many Western specialists predicted that the contradiction would inevitably trip China up.

zh: 谁知最后陷入经济下滑的，却是美国和西方。
en: Instead, it was America and the West that went into an economic tailspin.

zh: 当乔治·布什灾难性的8年任期过去之后，巴拉克·奥巴马正式入主白宫，有一段时间美国仿佛有能力遏制住下滑的颓势。
en: When, after the eight catastrophic years of George W. Bush’s presidency, Barack Obama entered the White House, it seemed for a moment as if America might be able to arrest its downward slide.

zh: 然而令人生厌的事情却接着发生了：奥巴马陷入了美国民主最黑暗的旋涡之中：那些倾向于共和党的州所具有的地方主义以及狭隘无知，严重的保守主义，共和党对国会议事进程的故意阻挠，甚至还有民主党内的不同政见。
en: But then an unwelcome thing happened. Obama ran right into a perfect storm of the worst aspects of American democracy: red-state provincialism and ignorance, fearful conservatism, Republican Party obstructionism and even some Democratic Party dissidence.

zh: 在党争之下，美国国会已经陷于瘫痪。
en: The US Congress became paralyzed by partisan politics.

zh: 由于显然缺乏一个精神中枢系统，它已经变成了一个机能紊乱的肌体，连普通的国家利益都无法实现，在维护国际利益方面更是乏善可陈。
en: Seemingly lacking a central nervous system, it has become a dysfunctional creature with little capacity to recognize any common national, much less international, interest.

zh: 在这样的情况下，一位出色的领导者即便拥有一群精明强干的幕僚和充满希望的政策，也无法实施他的雄图大略。
en: Under such circumstances, even a brilliant leader, with an able staff and promising policies, will be unable to pursue his agenda.

zh: 而正当西方政府在修复破产经济方面日益陷入困境时，中国却已然规划出一整套崭新而周全的政策措施，用大胆的决策应对一个接一个严峻的问题，稳步前进。
en: As governments across the West have become increasingly bogged down trying to fix a broken economy, China has been formulating a whole series of new, well-considered policies and forging ahead with bold decision-making to tackle one daunting problem after another.

zh: 在成功举办了2008年奥运会之后，中国领导人展开了历史上最令人瞩目的基础建设计划，非常成功地执行了一揽子经济刺激措施，并迈向绿色科技，可再生能源与节能领域的前列 — — 而这些领域则注定是全球经济的新一代增长点。
en: Triumphant from the 2008 Olympic Games, its leaders have undertaken the most impressive infrastructure program in history, implemented a highly successful economic stimulus package, and now are moving into the forefront of green technology, renewable energy, and energy efficiency – the activities out of which the new global economy is certain to grow.

zh: 简而言之，当西方陷入瘫痪之时，中国却在能源、资金、计划和领导层的共同作用下活跃起来，并进一��向前发展。
en: In short, China is veritably humming with energy, money, plans, leadership, and forward motion, while the West seems paralyzed.

zh: 当我信步穿过天安门广场的时候，那个矛盾一直在冲击着我的思绪：民主资本主义这个曾经被西方世界如此热切信任和拥护的体系现在似乎辜负了我们。
en: As I strolled through Tiananmen Square, the paradox that struck me was that the very system of democratic capitalism that the West has so ardently believed in and advocated now seems to be failing us.

zh: 而与此同时，长期遭到我们指摘的独裁统治和计划经济却似乎令中国大受裨益。
en: At the same time, the kind of authoritarianism and state-managed economics that we have long impugned now seems to be serving China well.

zh: 而令人在理性和政治上都极其不安的是，我们必须意识到，如果西方社会不能够尽快速纠正其政府体系中的错误，那么就只有中国这类没有进行“政治改革”的国家才有能力做出一个国家所需的选择，从而在当今高速发展，高科技并日益全球化的世界当中更好的生存下来。
en: It is intellectually and politically unsettling to realize that, if the West cannot quickly straighten out its systems of government, only politically un-reformed states like China will be able to make the decisions that a nation needs to survive in today’s high-speed, high-tech, increasingly globalized world.

zh: 收缩中的中国贸易顺差
en: China’s Shrinking Trade Surplus

zh: 发自北京 — — 整个2010年，中国都淹没在美国（及其他各国）国会关于“操纵”人民币以抢占出口优势并维持贸易顺差的指责之中。
en: BEIJING – Throughout 2010, China was criticized by the United States Congress (and many others) for “manipulating” its currency in order to maintain an advantage for exports, and thus preserve its trade surplus.

zh: 各方都声称中国的所作所为就是当今全球巨额贸易不平衡的根源。
en: China’s behavior, it was alleged, was the source of today’s huge global imbalance.

zh: 中国对此则不以为然，并一再拒绝了美国对人民币大幅升值的要求。
en: China, however, refused to accept the blame and declined repeated US demands to undertake a large revaluation.

zh: 人民币兑美元的汇率在2010年下半年只上升了约3 % 。
en: The exchange rate of the renminbi against the US dollar rose only about 3% between June 2010 and the year’s end.

zh: 照某些美国经济学家和政客的分析方法，低升值率再加上中国2010年出口31%的增长（对比2009年 ） ， 中国的贸易顺差显然是进一步扩大了。
en: According to an analysis used by some American economists and politicians, the low rate of currency appreciation, combined with Chinese export growth of 31% in 2010 over 2009, should have increased China’s trade surplus by a wide margin.

zh: 但实际上，中国2010年的贸易顺差总额较2009年下降了6.4 % ， 更何况之前的2008年已经在经济危机及后续衰退的影响下跌去了30 % 。
en: In fact, China’s trade surplus decreased by 6.4% in 2010 compared to 2009. And that decline follows a 30% drop in China’s trade surplus in 2008, owing to the global financial crisis and subsequent recession.

zh: 总体来说，中国的贸易顺差按绝对美元计算已经下跌了36 % ， 占GDP的比例也在过去两年中下跌了超过一半（53 % ） 。
en: Overall, China’s trade surplus has decreased by 36% in absolute US dollar terms, and has dropped by more than half (53%) in proportion to GDP over the past two years.

zh: 因此中国经常帐户盈余占GDP的比例已经下降到4.6 % ， 显著低于2007年的高峰11.3%了。
en: So the ratio of China’s current-account surplus to GDP is down to 4.6%, significantly below the recent peak of 11.3%, reached in 2007.

zh: 上述数据明确表明关于贸易不平衡的“汇率中心”理论是不符合实际的。
en: These data demonstrate conclusively that the “exchange-rate centered” theory of the trade imbalance does not match reality.

zh: 即便没有进行显著的汇率调整，中国经济在过去两年间在对外贸易关系方面也已经变得更加均衡。
en: China’s economy over the past two years has become much more balanced in its external trade relationships, despite there being no significant exchange-rate adjustments.

zh: 而其中的原因当然是国内需求的强劲增长。
en: The reason, of course, is the strong increase in Chinese domestic demand.

zh: 按实际价值计，生活消费品总销售额在2010年增长了14.8 % ， 而国内固定投资额则上升了19.5 % 。
en: Total sales of consumer goods increased by 14.8% in 2010 and domestic fixed investment grew by 19.5%, both in real terms.

zh: 另一方面以美元价值计算的进口需求增长了38.7 % ， 超过进口增长达31 % 。
en: As a result, in US dollar terms, import demand grew by 38.7%, outpacing export growth of 31%.

zh: 简而言之，如果一个国家能改善其国内经济平衡状况，那么无论汇率变化究竟有多细微，它在对外贸易方面也会变得更加平衡。
en: Simply put, if a country can improve its domestic balance, it will become more balanced externally, regardless of how little the exchange rate changes.

zh: 第二个问题是，中国是否能在继续维持人民币“逐渐升值”政策的同时进一步减少其贸易顺差？
en: The second question is this: can China reduce its trade surplus still further while continuing to maintain its policy of “gradual appreciation” of the renminbi?

zh: 事实上这样的结果很可能在随后几年中发生，在新的五年计划 （ “ 十二五 ” ） 期间。
en: Such an outcome is, in fact, quite likely in the next years, during the period of the new Five Year Plan.

zh: 首先，数项重大财政/税收改革现正在进行或是筹划中，比如增加国有企业的利润提取，或是提高石油和采矿等行业的资源税，以达到减少企业储蓄的目的。
en: To begin with, several significant fiscal/taxation reforms are now underway or in the pipeline, such as an increase in the collection of state-owned companies’ dividends and a hike in the resource tax on industries such as oil and coal mining, in order to reduce corporate savings.

zh: 未来几年内也将降低个人所得税征税额，以增加家庭可支配收入。
en: There will also be cuts in personal-income tax in the next few years in order to increase households’ disposable income.

zh: 在2011-2015的新五年计划中还针对社会安全网的改革设定了一系列政策目标。
en: In the new Five-Year Plan for 2011-2015, some binding targets are set for the social safety-net reforms.

zh: 社会安全系统将最终实现包括农村人口和城市农民工在内的普遍覆盖。
en: The social-security system will finally provide universal coverage, including the rural population and migrant workers in China’s cities.

zh: 更多公共资金将投入到农村教育和农村医疗卫生方面。
en: More public funds will be available for rural education and rural health care.

zh: 更多的公共服务将提供给新城市化进程中的农村居民。
en: More public services will be provided to newly urbanized rural migrants.

zh: 而所有这些变化将同时在短期和长期内增加家庭消费。
en: All of these changes will increase household consumption in both the short and long term.

zh: 当所有这些改革都是实现了之后，中国的国家储蓄率将从当前的51%下降到45 % 。
en: When all of these reforms are realized, China’s national saving rate may be reduced to 45%, from 51% currently.

zh: 这将在减少经常账户顺差 — — 这个数字则反映了国家的净储蓄 — — 方面产生巨大作用。
en: That will have a very significant effect in terms of reducing the current-account surplus, which reflects net national savings.

zh: 此外，中国的中央和地方政府将继续追加对城市化和工业化的基础设施投资。
en: Moreover, the Chinese government, at both the central and local levels, will remain keen to continue infrastructure investments aimed at further urbanization and industrialization.

zh: 一个宏大的国家高速铁路计划已经启动。
en: An ambitious plan for a national high-speed train system has been set forth.

zh: 所有主要城市区域，包括一些二线城市正在建设包括地铁和轻轨在内的公共运输系统。
en: And all major urban areas, including some second-tier cities, are building their public transportation systems to include more subways and light-rail networks.

zh: 此外中国国内对其他城市基础设施也拥有巨大需求，因为中国的城市人口将在可见的未来大幅增加。
en: Other urban facilities will also be in strong demand, because China’s urban population will continue to increase massively for the foreseeable future.

zh: 考虑到城市化比率依然相对较低（48 % ） ，相对较高的基础设施投资额将持续一段长的时期。
en: Given that the urbanization ratio is still quite low, at 48%, a relatively high investment in infrastructure may be sustained for a long time.

zh: 这些投资将消耗中国大部分国内储蓄并维持对进口的高需求。
en: Those investments will drain most of the country’s domestic savings and sustain high demand for imports.

zh: 因此似乎中国的经常账户顺差将在不久之后下降到占GDP的4%以下 — — 甚至可能继续下降，只要不转化为逆差的话。
en: So it seems likely that China’s current-account surplus will dip below 4% of GDP before long – and probably go even lower, if not turn into an outright deficit.

zh: 换言之，中国能轻易地达到美国官员在去年11月首尔G20部长级会议上提出的在2015年减少全球不均衡的“标志性指导方针 ” 。
en: In other words, China could easily reach the target set by the “indicative guidelines” for reducing global imbalances by 2015, as proposed by US officials recently at the G-20 ministerial meeting in Seoul last November.

zh: 关键问题是，代表了巨大不平衡另一端的美国应当做些什么？
en: The key question is: what is going on with the US, which, after all, represents the other side of the great imbalance?

zh: 得益于出口增长，美国的经常账户逆差在最近几个季度收窄了。
en: The US current-account deficit has been narrowing in recent quarters, thanks to export growth.

zh: 这是个好消息。
en: That is good news.

zh: 而且这一状况是在没有进行大幅汇率下调的情况下实现的，原因是欧元和其他几个主要货币的走弱。
en: Moreover, it happened without much downward exchange-rate adjustment so far, owing to the weakness of the euro and some other key currencies.

zh: 美联储推行的货币宽松政策增加了外界对美元贬值的预期并有助于出口。
en: The monetary easing undertaken by the US Federal Reserve raised expectations for a devaluation of the US dollar that might help US exports.

zh: 但美国的国内储蓄依旧极低，同时还背负着巨额的公共债务。
en: But domestic savings remain low in the face of persistently high levels of public debt.

zh: 总的来说，当今这种国际不平衡的根本原因都可以在双方的国内经济结构问题中找到，而汇率在重新平衡的过程只是扮演了次要的地位而已。
en: Again, the fundamental cause of today’s global imbalance can be found in domestic structural problems on both sides. Exchange rates will play only a secondary role in rebalancing.

zh: 沉默的中国农村革命
en: China's Silent Rural Revolution

zh: 在最近结束的中国全国人民代表大会（全国人大）年会上，对人权和私有财产的保护被写入宪法。
en: When China's National People's Congress (NPC) concluded its annual meeting recently, it voted to enshrine protection of human rights and private property in the constitution.

zh: 但在中国的发展战略中出现的一些重要变化却远远没有引起外界的足够关注。
en: But other major changes in China's development strategies that appear to be taking place have attracted far less notice.

zh: 上任一年的中国现任领导层批评了过去十年来"片面追求GDP增长"的做法，并公布了以"平衡、以人为本和有利于环境"为特点的实现现代化的新思路。
en: China's current leadership, one year after coming to power, has criticized "the single-minded pursuit of GDP growth" over the past decade and unveiled a new approach to modernization characterized as "balanced, human-centered, and environmentally friendly."

zh: 发展重点优先次序的改变-容易被外界忽视-却并不难理解。
en: The change in priorities - and outsiders' tendency to overlook it - is not difficult to understand.

zh: 当世界惊异于中国的经济奇迹时，却对其在过去25年来为实现8-9%的经济年增长率所付出的代价漠不关心。
en: The world is fascinated by China's economic miracle, but it is much less interested in the costs associated with the country's 8-9% annual growth rate in the past 25 years.

zh: 例如，中国每单位工业产出的能源消耗比全球平均水平高出近三倍。
en: For instance, the energy consumption of every unit of Chinese industrial output is close to three times the global average.

zh: 在一些地方，环境已经遭到了近乎不可逆的破坏。
en: In may places, the environment has been devastated almost beyond recovery.

zh: 无独有偶，一本新近的中文畅销书《中国农民调查》披露了中国为现代化所付出的高昂人力成本。
en: Similarly, a recent Chinese bestseller, A Survey of Chinese Peasants , reveals the tremendous human costs of China's modernization drive.

zh: 该书以其对9亿农民困苦境况的细致描述和对政府农村政策的大胆批评，引起了精英阶层和普通大众的注意。
en: The book caught the attention of both the elites and the mass public with its heart-breaking stories of the suffering endured by 900 million farmers and its bold criticism of the government's rural policies.

zh: 在北京、上海和其它中心城市鳞次栉比的摩天大厦以外，生活在农村的大多数中国人从过去20年的物质进步中所获得的利益极为有限。
en: Beyond the glamorous skyscrapers of Beijing, Shanghai, and other urban centers, the majority of Chinese who live in the countryside have gained little from the material progress of the past two decades.

zh: 相反，农民从上世纪七十年代末和八十年代初的农村改革中所获得的初始利益已不复存在；由于生产成本的提高和农产品价格的降低，农民的实际收入在近几年呈下降之势。
en: On the contrary, the initial benefits that peasants gained from the rural reforms of the late 1970's and early 1980's have disappeared; real income among farmers has dropped in recent years as their production costs rise and agricultural prices decline.

zh: 在中国的大多数地方，从事农业生产已不能维持合理的生活水平。
en: In most parts of China, farming can no longer sustain a respectable standard of living.

zh: 最令人担忧的是针对农村人口的税务负担不断加重。
en: Most worrying is the ever-growing tax burden placed on the rural population.

zh: 在1994-97年间农民的平均收入增加了90 % ， 而同期的税赋却激增了8倍。
en: While average agricultural income grew by 90% in the 1994-97 period, the rural tax burden jumped by 800%.

zh: 各级政府向农民征收的税费多达300余项。
en: More than 300 taxes and fees have been imposed on peasants by all levels of government.

zh: 例如，一些乡镇对注册结婚都会征收14项费用。
en: For example, some townships demand 14 kinds of fees to register a marriage.

zh: 如今，一个农民的年收入只有城市居民的六分之一，但他的纳税额却是城市居民的三倍。
en: Today, a farmer's annual income is only one-sixth that of an urban dweller's, but he has to pay three times more in taxes.

zh: 除此之外，还有地方政府施加的财政负担。
en: This comes in addition to many other financial burdens exacted at the local level.

zh: 事实上，25年的改革并没有改变中国"一个国家，两种体制 " - 这一把中国的中心城市和广大农村隔离开来，并以牺牲后者的利益实现前者发展的模式。
en: Indeed, 25 years of reforms have changed nothing of China's "one country with two systems" - a model that segregates China's urban centers from its agricultural areas, with development of the former realized at the expense of the latter.

zh: 如果我们用"吉尼系数"来衡量这一城乡收入差距，以"0"表示收入分配的绝对平等，用"1"表示绝对不平等，则中国在2002年的吉尼系数为0.454。
en: If we use what is called the "Gini coefficient" to measure this income gap, with "0" indicating perfect equality of income distribution and "1" meaning perfect inequality, the number for China is 0.454 in 2002.

zh: 这是国际公认的"绝对悬殊"水平。
en: This is an internationally recognized level of "absolute disparity."

zh: 印度素以其贫富差距"著称 " ， 而该国的吉尼系数在过去50年来一直在0.30-0.32间波动。
en: India, long known for gross disparities between rich and poor, has a Gini coefficient that has hovered around 0.30 to 0.32 over the past five decades.

zh: 所以当今的中国是一个比印度更为贫富悬殊的社会。
en: So today's China is a much less equitable society than India.

zh: 中国社会科学院的最近的一项研究所得出的结论是中国的城乡收入差距几乎是"全球之冠 " ， 或许只比津巴布韦略好一些。
en: A recent study by the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences concluded that China's urban-rural income gap is the worst on earth, maybe only slightly better than Zimbabwe.

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，中国被一致认为是成功的典范，而津巴布韦则一向被认为是一个积重难返的国家。
en: The irony here is that China is widely hailed as a success story, while Zimbabwe is generally viewed as a failed state.

zh: 这种基于经济剥削、社会不公和政治排斥的财富分配不均，导致了中国农民沉默但却持久的抵抗。
en: Such an unfair distribution of wealth based on economic exploitation, social injustice and political exclusion has caused silent but persistent resistance by Chinese peasants.

zh: 他们抗议，他们请愿，他们在走投无路之际加入地方的骚乱。
en: They protest, they petition, and they participate in local riots when all other means are exhausted.

zh: 但情况毫无改观。
en: Yet little changes.

zh: 结果是"农民问题"现在已威胁到社会稳定并可能带来爆发性的后果，正如当年毛泽东以农民对国民党蒋介石政府的农村政策的不满来组织革命那样。
en: As a result, the "peasant question" is now threatening social stability and is potentially explosive in a way reminiscent of when Mao organized his revolution around peasant disaffection with the rural policies of the Nationalist government of Chiang Kai-shek.

zh: 作为回应，温家宝总理在全国人大会议期间公布了一系列措施，从在未来五年逐渐减免农业税到旨在增加农民收入的举措。
en: In response, Premier Wen Jiabao announced a series of measures during the NPC, ranging from phasing out agricultural taxes over the next five years to measures aimed at increasing farmers' income.

zh: 但经验表明，只要官员们对农村贫困的关注还是"雷声大，雨点小 " ， 这样的承诺是不足以解决问题的。
en: But while official attention to rural poverty is music to the ears of the poor, experience shows that such promises are usually inadequate.

zh: 温家宝的前任朱镕基也说过他"最大的头痛"就是如何减少农村的税务负担和增加农民收入。
en: Wen's predecessor, Zhu Ronji, also said that his "biggest headache" was how to reduce the rural tax burden and increase peasant income.

zh: 而情况却进一步恶化了。
en: Yet the situation only worsened.

zh: 中国政府必须承认严重的收入不平等和农村贫困已不仅仅是一个经济问题，而是影响到社会安定和政治稳定的问题。
en: China's government must acknowledge that deep income inequality and rural poverty is no longer exclusively an economic problem, but threatens social peace and political stability.

zh: 全面改革是唯一的出路。
en: Comprehensive reform is the only way out.

zh: 除非中国致力于更大程度的政治公开，允许贫困和弱势群体表达他们的意愿，代表他们自己并监控政策的实施，否则它将会继续受到这种虚假和危险的繁荣所带来的危害。
en: Unless China commits to greater political openness, allowing the poor and disadvantaged to voice their concerns, represent themselves, and monitor policy implementation, it will continue to be jeopardized by a false and perilous prosperity.

zh: 中国大陆对台湾的软实力攻势
en: China’s Soft-Power Offensive in Taiwan

zh: 发自东京 — — 中国大陆在最近台湾总统大选期间的所作所为显示出该国的领导人已经在过往的失败经历中得到了一些教训。
en: TOKYO – China’s behavior during the recent presidential election in Taiwan demonstrates that its leaders have learned some lessons, if only the hard way.

zh: 他们认识到大陆可以通过贸易或者提升令台湾民众富裕感来对选民施加影响，而不是像以往历届大选（特别是台独派候选人有望胜选的时候）那样采取威胁性策略 — — 甚至声称要威胁导弹。
en: They have learned that China can have a greater impact on Taiwanese voters through trade and making people feel richer than by threats – even threats to fire missiles – which had been China’s electoral tactics in previous Taiwanese elections, particularly when a pro-independence candidate looked popular enough to win.

zh: 事实上，出于对李登辉这位极受欢迎的台独派总统候选人的恐惧，中国人民解放军曾于1996年台湾大选期间向基隆港附近海域发射了导弹。
en: Indeed, fearing the popularity of Lee Teng-hui, who ran in the 1996 presidential election on a pro-independence platform, China’s People’s Liberation Army actually fired missiles close to the nearby coast of Keelung.

zh: 但这一炫耀武力的举动却产生了反效果，李登辉最终赢得了大选。
en: But this saber rattling backfired. Lee won.

zh: 而1月14日的那场大选则是两岸政权各自实施权力交接的第一幕。
en: The presidential election on January 14 was the first of the transfers of power in China and Taiwan that will take place this year.

zh: 随后，中国国家主席胡锦涛和总理温家宝将被中国共产党早已选定的接班人所取带。
en: Later this year, China’s President Hu Jintao and Prime Minister Wen Jiabao will be succeeded by men chosen by the Communist Party long ago.

zh: 防止对台出现紧张态势看上去似乎是中国领导人早已计算好的决定，特别是他们开始自己的 — — 或者尚未完全尘埃落定的 — — 权力交接之时。
en: Avoiding new tension with Taiwan appears to have been a calculated decision by China’s leaders as they begin their own – perhaps not yet fully settled – changing of the guard.

zh: 近20年来，台湾的总统选举吸引了全球的注意：这一方面是源自于其生机勃勃的民主文化，另一方面则是出于一个悬而未决的问题 — — 选举的胜者是否将谋求台湾的正式独立。
en: For almost two decades, Taiwan’s presidential elections have attracted global attention not only for the robustness of Taiwan’s democratic culture, but also for the perennial question of whether the winner would seek formal independence for Taiwan.

zh: 在本次大选中，在野台湾民主进步党所推举出来的候选人蔡英文在选举最后阶段对执政的国民党总统马英九造成了极大威胁，但大陆方面却并未对此作出过激举动。
en: This time, Tsai Ing-wen, the woman nominated by the opposition Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), mounted a late charge on the Kuomintang incumbent, Ma Ying-jeou. But China did not bluster as Tsai surged in the polls.

zh: 相反，中国不惜一切代价去支持马英九这位在第一任期间大力增强两岸经济纽带的总统。
en: Instead, China did all that it could do boost Ma, who has presided over a massive increase in economic ties with the mainland.

zh: 例如目前有大概100万台湾人居住在中国大陆，而中国则向其中约40万人提供廉价机票以便他们回乡投票。
en: For example, China provided cheap airplane tickets to roughly 400,000 of the one million Taiwanese living on the mainland to enable them to return home to vote.

zh: 鉴于马英九本次以80万票的优势胜选，这一策略或许并非是决定性的，但却很可能在决定选举结果方面扮演了一个重要的角色。
en: Given that Ma won by 800,000 votes, this tactic may not have been decisive, but it most likely played a considerable part in determining the outcome.

zh: 而奇怪的是，从国民党分裂出来的亲民党候选人宋楚瑜的优异表现帮助了马英九，因为前者提供了一个马英九之外的第二选项（因此那些不喜欢马英九的选民也不一定非要投给蔡英文 ） 。
en: Paradoxically, the strong performance of James Soong Chu-yu of the People First Party, which split from the Kuomintang, helped Ma by giving voters a second alternative to him.

zh: 与此同时，美国为免激怒大陆民族主义者而对所有候选人采取的沉默态度也无疑在缓和与中国大陆的紧张态势中发挥了作用 — — 这也是另一个可能对马英九有帮助的因素。
en: And America’s quiet instructions to all candidates to avoid nationalist provocation undoubtedly also played a role in dampening tension with China – another factor that probably benefited Ma.

zh: 所谓中国大陆对台新的“软性”策略的一部分，温家宝强调要“出让利益”给台湾。
en: As part of China’s new “soft” approach to Taiwan, Wen emphasizes “conceding interests” to Taiwan.

zh: 而在长期以来一直是民进党大本营的台湾南部地区，这一策略似乎获得了成功。
en: In Taiwan’s south, long a DPP stronghold, that approach appears to have paid off.

zh: 大陆与台湾之间的经济合作框架协议（简称ECFA）使得南部地区的农民和渔民能将自己的收获销往广阔的大陆市场，而国民党在这些地区所获得的支持也比以往历次大选更多。
en: The Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA) between China and Taiwan has enabled farmers and fishermen in southern Taiwan to prosper by selling agricultural and fisheries products to the enormous Chinese market, and the Kuomintang received higher support in the region than in past elections.

zh: 当然，大陆的最终目标并不是推动两岸经济互动，而是统一。
en: Of course, promoting economic interaction with Taiwan is not China’s ultimate goal; unification is.

zh: 大陆当局似乎相信马英九的当选似乎是想这一目标又迈进了一步。
en: China’s government appears to believe that Ma’s victory is a step in this direction.

zh: 但经济整合是一回事，政治整合又是另一回事。
en: But economic integration is one thing, and political integration quite another.

zh: 在经历过了民主制度以及言论自由的好处之后，台湾民众不会接受一个比当前开放程度更低的社会。
en: After experiencing the benefits of democracy and freedom of expression, Taiwanese are unlikely to want to settle for anything less than the open society that they have today.

zh: 事实上，随着两岸接触的日益增加，大陆普通民众将开始羡慕台湾人所建立起来的现代民主制度 — — 并将开放社会的理念在大陆散播开来。
en: Indeed, with increased contact between Taiwan and the mainland, ordinary Chinese could begin to envy the modern democracy that the Taiwanese people have built – and spread the idea of an open society to the Chinese mainland.

zh: 而马英九在其第二任期间所扮演的角色则应当是一个像大陆传播民主的传道者。
en: Ma’s role in his second term should be to serve as just such an evangelist for democracy in China.

zh: 而大陆方面对这一“危险”也有充分认识，并采取了五项应对政策。
en: Well aware of this “danger,” China is implementing five policies.

zh: 首先是进一步扩大ECFA的范围，使得更多台湾企业能从中受益。
en: The first is to expand the ECFA, so that more Taiwanese companies feel its benefits.

zh: 与之类似的第二项则是继续瞄准台湾南部地区农民和渔民的商业利益，并以此动摇民进党的基础。
en: Second, and similarly, China will try to shake up the DPP’s base by further targeting the commercial interests of Taiwanese farmers and fishermen in the south.

zh: 第三则是强调共同的中国文化来缓解台湾人对统一的恐惧。
en: Third, China will emphasize common Chinese culture in order to reduce Taiwanese fear of unification.

zh: 第四项目标是争取那些在本次总统选举期间选举出来的新立法委员的支持。
en: A fourth goal is to win over young legislators elected during this presidential election.

zh: 最后，大陆将试图阻止国际社会使用“台湾”字样，并以拗口的“中华台北”取而代之。
en: Finally, China will seek to prevent the use of the name Taiwan and force the international use of the awkward name “Chinese Taipei.”

zh: 但影响两岸关系的最大事务其实是中国经济本身。
en: But the greatest issue affecting cross-strait relations is the Chinese economy itself.

zh: 在经历了数十年的两位数增长之后，中国经济放缓的迹象将影响其全面对台政策。
en: Signs of decline in China’s economy, which has racked up double-digit growth for decades, would affect all of its Taiwan policies.

zh: 当上海股市在去年下跌20%之时，台湾股市几乎在同一时间下跌了同一幅度 — — 也证明了两岸经济的同步一致性。
en: When Shanghai stocks fell by about 20% last year, Taiwanese stocks fell by a similar amount almost simultaneously – proof of how synchronized the Chinese and Taiwanese economies have become.

zh: 而一旦这一同步利益纽带出现破裂，大陆也无法继续按自己的想法行事。
en: China will not be able to get its way if the profitability of this synchronization breaks down.

zh: 因此，台湾是否会变得更像大陆，还是反其道而行之？
en: So, will Taiwan become more like the mainland, or vice versa?

zh: 问这样一个问题实际上等于重启当年香港澳门回归大陆时的讨论，但在今天已经不多见了。
en: To ask that question is to reprise a debate that was heard when Hong Kong and Macau reverted to China, but that is seldom encountered nowadays.

zh: 是否能在统一方面实现重大进展将取决于中国软实力政策的效力，而这一���策要取得成功的话，也不能仅仅被局限于经济方面的吸引力。
en: Whether serious moves toward unification change that fact will depend on the effectiveness of China’s soft-power approach, which cannot be limited only to the attractiveness of its economy if it is actually to succeed.

zh: 中国的稳定话题
en: China’s Stability Gambit

zh: 北京—我从20世纪90年代末开始关注中国，我从中学到的第一条原则就是，在中国，稳定压倒一切，不管是经济、社会还是政治。
en: BEIJING – The first principle that I learned when I started focusing on China in the late 1990’s is that nothing is more important to the Chinese than stability – whether economic, social, or political.

zh: 中国饱经上千年动乱，因此今天的中国领导人将竭尽全力保证稳定。
en: Given centuries of turmoil in China, today’s leaders will do everything in their power to preserve stability.

zh: 每当我认为中国会出现潜在的政策变化时，我都会用稳定性来检查可能的选择，屡试不爽。
en: Whenever I have doubts about a potential Chinese policy shift, I examine the options through the stability lens. It has worked like a charm.

zh: 在3月17—20日举行的一年一度的中国发展论坛（CDF）上，稳定占据着每一位与会者的头脑。
en: Stability was on everyone’s mind at the annual China Development Forum (CDF) held March 17-20 in Beijing.

zh: 这次论坛由温家宝总理主持，多位国务院所属部长出席，是中国最重要的国际会议。
en: Hosted by Premier Wen Jiabao, with many ministers of the State Council in attendance, the CDF is China’s most important international conference.

zh: 但是，就在今年CDF召开前两天，颇具争议的重庆市委书记薄熙来被免去了职务。
en: Yet, literally two days before this year’s CDF began, the controversial Bo Xilai was removed as Party Secretary of Chongqing.

zh: 薄熙来本是进入中共中央政治局常委的有力竞争者，他的突然去职令人震惊。
en: As a strong candidate to join the Standing Committee of the Politburo, China’s inner circle of leadership, Bo’s sudden demise was stunning.

zh: 我们在钓鱼台国宾馆开会的时候，明显地感觉到暗流在涌动。
en: There was a palpable buzz in the air as we convened in the Diaoyutai State Guesthouse.

zh: 会议的正式部分按部就班地进行，着重强调了即将采取的针对增长模式的结构性改革 — — 从过去32年的完全依靠出口和投资的增长向更依赖消费的模式的巨大转变。
en: The formal sessions played out predictably, placing great emphasis on the coming structural transformation of China’s growth model – a colossal shift from the all-powerful export- and investment-led growth of the past 32 years to a more consumer-led dynamic.

zh: 中国高层领导已经形成了广泛的一致，将促进再平衡。
en: There is now broad consensus among China’s senior leadership in favor of such a rebalancing.

zh: 正如一位与会者所言 ， “ 争论已经从做什么转变为何时开始做。 ”
en: As one participant put it, “The debate has shifted from what to do to how and when to do it.”

zh: 许多其他主题都是围绕这一大前提展开的。
en: Many of the other themes flowed from this general conclusion.

zh: 向服务拉动型增长转变以及基于创新的发展战略尤其令人瞩目。
en: A shift to services-led growth and an innovations-based development strategy were highlighted.

zh: 与此同时，最近强势复现的国有企业也是吸引了相当多的关注 — — 着眼点在国民收入分配从以劳动为基础向以资本为基础的转变，这也是中国偏向消费的再平衡目标的主要障碍。
en: At the same time, there was considerable concern about the recent resurgence of state-owned enterprises, which has tilted the distribution of national income from labor to capital – a major impediment to China’s pro-consumption rebalancing.

zh: 世界银行和中国发展研究中心（CDF主办单位）刚刚发布了一份如何修正这一关键问题的诸多方面的详细报告。
en: The World Bank and the China Development Research Center (the CDF’s host) had just released a comprehensive report that addressed many aspects of this critical issue.

zh: 但CDF的正式进程与钓鱼台国宾馆内的真正关注点一点关系都没有。
en: But the CDF’s formal proceedings never even hinted at the elephant in the chambers of Diaoyutai.

zh: 关于薄熙来及其在今年 — — 领导层过渡的关键之年 — — 免职对中国国内政治的影响的内容只字未提。
en: There was no mention of Bo Xilai and what his dismissal meant for China’s domestic politics in this critical year of leadership transition.

zh: 打听关于随后发生的宫廷阴谋的流言并非难事，而我认为，薄熙来的免职意义深远。
en: While it is easy to get caught up in the swirling tales of palace intrigue that have followed, I suspect that Bo’s removal holds a far deeper meaning.

zh: 中国的官员面临着政治和经济不稳定相互交织的风险。
en: Chinese officials faced the risk of a dangerous interplay of political and economic instability.

zh: 过去三年中，中国经历了两次外部需求的打击 — — 先是美国次贷危机，然后是现在的欧洲主权债务危机 — — 此时爆发内部政治动荡将产生严重得多的危险。
en: Hit by a second external demand shock in three years – first, America’s subprime crisis, and now Europe’s sovereign-debt crisis – any outbreak of internal political instability would pose a far greater threat than might otherwise be the case.

zh: 薄熙来就是这一风险的写照。
en: Bo personified that risk.

zh: 他鼓吹所谓的“重庆模式 ” — —一种近年来在中国颇为得势的国家资本主义，即将权力集中在地方领导人和国企手中的政府引导的城市化和经济发展。
en: He embodied the so-called “Chongqing model” of state capitalism that has been ascendant in China in recent years – government-directed urbanization and economic development that concentrates power in the hands of regional leaders and state-owned enterprises.

zh: 去年夏天，我在重庆呆了一段时间。 这是一个有着3400万人口的超级都市。
en: I spent some time in Chongqing – a vast metropolitan area of more than 34 million people – last summer.

zh: 重庆市计划之宏伟令我颇为震惊。
en: I left astonished at the scope of the city’s plans.

zh: 重庆计划由市长黄奇帆谱写，他也是上海浦东开发项目的主要缔造者。 重庆计划的目标是将重庆两江地区打造为中国首个内陆城市开发区。
en: Orchestrated by Chongqing Mayor Huang Qifan, the principal architect of the spectacular Pudong development project in Shanghai, the goal is to transform the Liangjiang area of Chongqing into China’s first inland urban development zone.

zh: 这将使两江区与已有的两个沿海示范区 — — 浦东和天津滨海区并驾齐驱。
en: That would put Liangjiang on a par with coastal China’s two earlier showcase projects – Pudong and the Binhai area of Tianjin.

zh: 但该计划正属于在今年的CDF上受到口诛笔伐的国家主导发展模式，亦与中国高层领导人普遍认同的市场导向替代模式相悖。
en: Yet this is the same state-dominated development model that came under heavy criticism at this year’s CDF – and that stands in sharp contrast to the more market-driven alternative that has gained broad consensus among senior Chinese leaders.

zh: 换句话说，薄熙来不仅被认为是政治稳定的威胁，同时也被视为经济动荡模式的主要代表。
en: In other words, Bo was perceived not only as a threat to political stability, but also as the leading representative of a model of economic instability.

zh: 如此突然地免去薄熙来的职务实际上是中央政府对稳定承诺的坚定不移的强调。
en: By dismissing Bo so abruptly, the central government has, in effect, underscored its unwavering commitment to stability.

zh: 这与中国谜团的另一个有趣部分相契合。
en: This fits with yet another curious piece of the Chinese puzzle.

zh: 五年前，温家宝发出过著名的警告：中国经济正面临着“不稳定、不平衡、不协调、不可持续”的危险。
en: Five years ago, Wen famously warned of a Chinese economy that was in danger of becoming “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable.”

zh: 我一再强调，温家宝的“四不”警告对促进消费的“下一个中国”战略的形成是至关重要的。
en: I have repeatedly stressed the critical role that Wen’s “Four Uns” have played in shaping the pro-consumption strategy of the “Next China.”

zh: 温家宝的批评为中国扫清了再平衡之路上的障碍。
en: Wen’s critique paved the way for China to face its rebalancing imperatives head on.

zh: 但在今年CDF的正式讲话中，中国高层领导人 — — 包括未来总理李克强 — — 并未明言任何“不稳定”的中国经济风险。
en: But, in their formal remarks to the CDF this year, China’s senior leadership – including Premier-designate Li Keqiang – dropped all explicit references to the risks of an “unstable” Chinese economy.

zh: 简言之，四不已经变为了三不。
en: In short, the Four Uns have now become three.

zh: 在中国，这种用语变化绝非偶然。
en: In China, such changes in language are no accident.

zh: 最有可能的解释是，高层已经无法容忍任何在稳定问题上的让步了。
en: The most likely interpretation is that those at the top no longer want to concede anything when it comes to stability.

zh: 通过用促进消费的再平衡解决经济不稳定问题以及用免职薄熙来解决政治不稳定问题，稳定已经从一个风险因素转变为铁板一块了。
en: By addressing economic instability through pro-consumption rebalancing, and political instability by removing Bo, stability has gone from a risk factor to an ironclad commitment.

zh: 中国领导层的中心意思已经再无可疑了。
en: There can be no mistaking the Chinese leadership’s core message nowadays.

zh: 他们是首批承认增长和发展战略正处在关键的十字路口的领导人。
en: They are the first to concede that their growth and development strategy is at a critical juncture.

zh: 他们担心，邓小平的“改革开放”政策有失去动力的危险。
en: They worry that the “reforms and opening up” of Deng Xiaoping are in danger of losing momentum.

zh: 通过消除经济和政治风险相互作用给稳定带来的危险，中国政府已经为下一波超凡发展阶段铺平了道路。
en: By addressing the interplay between economic and political risks to stability, the government is clearing the way for the next phase of China’s extraordinary development.

zh: 在我看来，质疑他们能否达到这一目标是不明智的。
en: I would not advise betting against their commitment to achieving that goal.

zh: 中国：减速的纠结
en: China’s Struggle to Slow

zh: 北京—在一年一度的人大会议开幕时，温家宝总理宣布，中国政府2012年的年经济增长目标为7.5 % 。
en: BEIJING – At the opening of the annual session of China’s parliament, the National People’s Congress (NPC), Premier Wen Jiabao announced that the government’s target for annual economic growth in 2012 was 7.5%.

zh: 在全球经济依然在挣扎着复苏的时候，温家宝宣布中国增长率的大幅下降自然而然地引起了全世界的广泛关注。
en: With the global economy still struggling to recover, Wen’s announcement of such a significant dip in China’s growth rate naturally sparked widespread concern around the world.

zh: 但需要指出的一个要点是，温家宝所表达的更多的是一种政策姿态，而不是在预测经济表现。
en: But it is important to note that Wen was expressing a policy rather than forecasting performance.

zh: 他解释说，降低增长率目标是为了“引导各方面把工作着力点放到加快转变经济发展方式、切实提高经济发展质量和效益上来。 ”
en: The purpose of targeting a lower growth rate, he explained, is “to guide people in all sectors to focus their work on accelerating the transformation of the pattern of economic development and making economic development more sustainable and efficient.”

zh: 固定资产投资是中国增长的最重要引擎。
en: Fixed-asset investment is the most important engine of China’s growth.

zh: 中国是一个发展中国家，年人均收入不足5000美元，仍有重组的空间可用于资本存量的增加。
en: As a developing country with annual per capita income of less than $5,000, there is still significant room for China to increase its capital stock.

zh: 但投资增长率显得太高了。
en: But the growth rate of investment is too high.

zh: 问题不在于中国是否需要更多的投资，而在于中国的吸收能力是否能像过去十年那样适应快速的投资增长。
en: The issue is not whether China needs more investment, but whether China’s absorption capacity can continue to accommodate the rapid investment growth of the past decade.

zh: 出于这样的考虑，投资率 — — 在中国，投资占GDP的比重超过50 % ， 而且还在不断上升 — — 可以作为固定投资对经济的压力的指标。
en: In this sense, the investment rate, which in China approaches 50% of GDP and is rising, can be regarded as a measure of the stress that fixed investment places on the economy.

zh: 说中国经济的投资增长耐受力已经到达了极限并不是很夸张的说法。
en: It is not entirely an exaggeration to say that the economy’s capacity for investment growth has reached its limit.

zh: 最近的高铁项目问题就是这一问题的写照。
en: The recent high-speed rail debacle is a case in point.

zh: 2003年，中国上马了第一个高铁项目。
en: In 2003, China built its first high-speed-rail project.

zh: 作为2008—2009年全球金融危机时出台的4万亿人民币刺激项目的关键部分，高铁建设投资可谓一日千里。
en: As a key component of the RMB4 trillion ($630 billion) stimulus package introduced during the 2008-2009 global financial crisis, investment in high-speed-rail construction increased by leaps and bounds.

zh: 到2010年底，中国运营高铁网络超过8000公里，另有17000公里在建。
en: By the end of 2010, China’s operational high-speed-rail network surpassed 8,000 kilometers, with an additional 17,000 kilometers under construction.

zh: 与此形成对照的是，西方国家花了半个世纪的时间才建造了6500公里高铁线路。
en: By contrast, all Western countries combined took a half-century to build a total of 6,500 kilometers.

zh: 如此匆忙上马，灾难在所难免。
en: Built in such haste, catastrophe was almost inevitable.

zh: 超过一国吸收能力的投资增长会快速恶化投资的效益，进而危害长期增长前景。
en: Investment growth that surpasses an economy’s absorption capacity will lead to a rapid deterioration in the efficiency of investment, which in turn will harm long-term growth prospects.

zh: 现今在中国出现的迹象一点都不令人奇怪。
en: Evidence of this in China today is all too prevalent.

zh: 为了扭转这一趋势，适当放缓投资增长不仅必要，而且是利润驱动的经济所不可避免的过程。
en: To reverse this trend, some respite in investment growth is not only necessary, but also inevitable in a profit-driven economy.

zh: 中国的投资率必须下降到一个可持续水平，与此同时，另一个重要性有过之而无不及的挑战是调整投资结构。
en: While China’s investment rate should be brought down to a sustainable level, an equally, if not more, important challenge is to adjust the structure of investment.

zh: 多年来，房地产开发在中国的投资中独占鳌头，大约可占到GDP的10%和总投资的25 % 。
en: For many years, the single most important category of investment in China has been real-estate development, which accounts for roughly 10% of GDP and a quarter of total investment.

zh: 但更多的资源应该被配置到建设人力资本、提供公共品和促进创造力和创新的项目中。
en: But resources need to be allocated to projects that build up human capital, provide public goods, and foster creativity and innovation.

zh: 但是，调整投资结构将不可避免地引起投资增长放缓，至少在过渡期内是如此，因而会拉低总体GDP的增长率。
en: Adjusting the investment structure, however, will inevitably cause investment growth to decelerate, at least in the transitional period, thus leading to a slowdown in overall GDP growth.

zh: 过去30年来，国际贸易在中国的经济发展中扮演着关键角色。
en: International trade has played a pivotal role in China’s economic development over the past 30 years.

zh: 但是，全球市场已经无法吸收中国庞大的出口了，何况欧洲和美国的经济低迷立刻会对出口需求形成冲击。
en: However, the global market is no longer able to absorb China’s massive exports, not to mention the immediate impact of economic malaise in Europe and the United States on export demand.

zh: 此外，劳动成本的增加和人民币升值也将不利于中国出口部门，造成今年GDP增速放缓。
en: Moreover, rising labor costs and a stronger renminbi will also undermine China’s export sector, causing GDP growth to slow this year.

zh: 毫无疑问，中国需要较慢但更好的增长。
en: Few would argue against China’s need for slower but better growth.

zh: 问题在于，如果中国希望将GDP增长率由2011年的9.2%放缓为2012年的7.5 % ， 同时又不想通过进一步提高投资率来恶化增长方式，那么年投资增长就必须不高于7.5 % 。
en: The problem is that if China wishes to lower the GDP growth rate to 7.5% in 2012, from 9.2% in 2011, without worsening the growth pattern by raising the high investment rate even further, the annual growth rate of investment must be equal to or less than 7.5%.

zh: 无需复杂的计算就可以得出，除非政府已做好了忍受投资率进一步攀升的准备，否则达到GDP增长7.5%的目标意味着投资增长率的大幅下降。
en: A back-of-the-envelope calculation suffices to show that, unless the government is prepared to tolerate a further increase in the investment rate, achieving a GDP growth target of 7.5% implies a significant fall in the growth rate of investment.

zh: 为了补偿由此产生的对GDP增长的不利冲击，在出口增长仍受全球需求萎靡约束的情况下，消费必须出现迅速增加，而这一点很难实现。
en: To compensate for the negative impact on GDP growth, and with export growth constrained by weak global demand, consumption must rise even more sharply, which is hard to imagine.

zh: 换句话说，降低GDP增长率至7.5%而又不让中国增长模式更加非理性是一个不可能完成的任务。
en: In other words, lowering the GDP growth rate to 7.5% without making China’s growth pattern even more irrational is an impossible mission.

zh: 因此，更可能的2012年增长剧本是经济增长率低于2011年，但仍显著高于7.5 % 。
en: So a more likely growth scenario for 2012 is that China’s growth will be lower than in 2011, but still significantly higher than 7.5%.

zh: 相应地，投资驱动的增长模式将被进一步强化，尽管速度有所放缓。
en: Correspondingly, its investment-driven growth pattern will be strengthened further, though at a slowing pace.

zh: 否则就难以避免政策引发的硬着陆。
en: Otherwise, a policy-induced hard landing would be difficult to avoid.

zh: 事实上，如何实现增长率放缓而不导致硬着陆是中国政府所面临的最严峻的挑战。
en: Indeed, how to achieve a more moderate growth rate without causing a hard landing is one of the most severe challenges confronting the Chinese government.

zh: 硬着陆绝不是可选项。
en: A hard landing is simply not an option.

zh: 中国的财政状况依然坚挺，因此中国领导人不太可能不惜风险一根筋地“加速经济发展模式转型 ” 。
en: With the country’s fiscal position still positive, it is difficult to image that the Chinese leadership would be so headstrong about “accelerating the transformation of the pattern of economic development” as to risk such an outcome.

zh: 就算中央政府确实如此，迷信GDP又债务缠身的地方政府仍有可能勉力追求尽可能高的增长率，同时在口头上鼎力支持温家宝的减速呼声。
en: Even if it is, GDP-obsessed and debt-ridden local governments are likely to strive to achieve the highest possible growth rates for themselves, while paying lip service to Wen’s call for a slowdown.

zh: 这就是为何大部分中国经济学家在官方目标大幅下调的情况下仍预测2012年的增长率将远高于8 % 。
en: That is why, despite the official target, most Chinese economists still bet on a growth rate well above 8% for 2012.

zh: 重塑中国的“制高点”
en: Reforming China’s Commanding Heights

zh: 发自米兰 — — 中国国家主席习近平的大规模反腐运动已经推进了一系列关键目标：极大恢复了外界对中共承诺按能力提拔干部制度的信心；逆转了长达数十年之久的公共部门主导模式；削弱了既得利益阶层阻挠改革的力量；并提高了习近平本人在私人部门经营者心中的声誉（在官僚机构中则相反 ） 。
en: MILAN – Chinese President Xi Jinping’s massive anti-corruption campaign has advanced a number of key objectives: It has gone a long way toward restoring confidence in the Communist Party’s commitment to a merit-based system; countered a decades-old pattern of public-sector domination; reduced the power of vested interests to block reform; and bolstered Xi’s popularity among private-sector actors, if far less so with the bureaucracy.

zh: 总而言之，习近平铲除腐败的行动同时为中共和改革派增添了力量。
en: In short, Xi’s effort to root out corruption has empowered both the Party and the reformers.

zh: 而问题则在于他们的改革野心究竟有多大。
en: The question is how far they will take their reform ambitions.

zh: 习近平显然不会到此为止，在上个月的中共第十八届四中全会中，他提出了一系列法律改革，为公共和私营部门构建一个更为公平的竞争平台。
en: Xi is certainly not finished yet, having outlined a set of legal reforms at last month’s Fourth Plenum of the Communist Party aimed at creating a more level playing field for the public and private sectors.

zh: 如果这些改革能得到正确实施，就将为合同的制定和执行创造一个更加有效的体系，放宽新市场参与者的进入渠道，并强化中国一系列竞争法的应用。
en: If implemented properly, the reforms will create a more efficient system for the creation and enforcement of contracts, ease the path for market entrants, and strengthen the application of China’s competition laws.

zh: 更加忠于法治的举措同时也会创造出一个减少私人部门欺诈行为（包括财务报表申报）的法律和经济基础环境。
en: Greater fidelity to the rule of law will also lead to the creation of a legal and financial infrastructure that reduces fraud in the private sector, including in financial reporting.

zh: 这些再与不断增加的资本获取渠道相结合，将有助于加速服务行业的发展，并以此创造更多的城镇就业岗位。
en: That, together with increased access to capital, will help to accelerate the development of the services sector, which is needed to create urban employment.

zh: 而对中国大规模的公共资产 — — 其中包括3.5~4万亿美元的外汇储备，持有的大量土地，以及对主导经济的国有企业的主要控制权 — — 的更合理管理将进一步补足上述措施。
en: Better management of China’s considerable public assets – which include $3.5-4 trillion of foreign-exchange reserves, substantial land holdings, and majority ownership of the state-owned enterprises that dominate the economy – would complement these efforts.

zh: 事实上，这将有助于刺激竞争，鼓励创新，强化金融系统并扩大融资渠道。
en: Indeed, it could help to boost competition, encourage innovation, strengthen the financial system, and expand access to capital.

zh: 但问题是，中国究竟将如何实现这一点。
en: The question is how China could achieve this.

zh: 在目前的情况下，中国经济在某种程度上依然遵循着从前列宁主义的“制高点”模式 — — 由党来控制着所有的政治权力以及主要企业和经济部门，即便在由蓬勃发展的私人部门推动增长和就业的情况下也是如此。
en: As it stands, China’s economy follows, to some extent, the old Leninist “commanding heights” model, with the Party holding all political power and controlling major enterprises and sectors, even as the burgeoning private sector drives growth and employment.

zh: 在这个背景下，中国所追求的“精英领导阶层专业主义”就非常重要；但这并不能取代在公共或私人部门中的真实竞争 — — 至少不能在把创新和结构改革作为目标时这样做。
en: In this context, the kind of “meritocratic professionalism” that China is pursuing is important; but it is no substitute for genuine competition in the public or private sector – at least not if innovation and structural change are the goals.

zh: 当然，习近平可以直接宣称中国版的国家资本主义在过去是行得通的，而且会一直这样下去。
en: Of course, Xi could simply declare that China’s version of state capitalism has worked well in the past, and will continue to do so.

zh: 但在见识过发达国家的微观经济动力（这正是中国的目标）之后，这种说法就站不住脚了 — — 因此习近平也不太可能发表类似观点。
en: But experience with the microeconomic dynamics of advanced economies (where China is headed) makes this a weak stance – and, thus, one that Xi is unlikely to take.

zh: 而替代方案可能是着手实施一个持续私有化项目，以缩减该国庞大的资产负债表中的资产项目。
en: The alternative would be to embark on a sustained program of privatization to shrink the asset side of the state’s huge balance sheet.

zh: 但中国的资产负债表运行良好，令政府可以通过极高投资比率去推动快速增长。
en: But China’s balance sheet has served it well, enabling the extraordinarily high rates of investment that have fueled rapid growth.

zh: 与此同时，所许多发达经济体却因为自身资产负债表中只有极为有限且未能精确统计的资产，加上孤独庞大的债务和非债务偿付责任而深受其害。
en: Meanwhile, many advanced economies have suffered considerably from their balance-sheet composition, with limited, poorly measured assets and outsize debt and non-debt liabilities.

zh: 事实上考虑到资本和劳动两者（以及不同工种之间）日渐失衡的收入分配，更大的公共资产储备显然是有利的，因为它能以非直接的方式平衡资本和财富的分配。
en: In fact, given an increasingly unequal distribution of income between capital and labor (as well as across the income spectrum for labor) a larger store of public assets certainly has merit, as it equalizes the distribution of capital and wealth, albeit indirectly.

zh: 这些公共资产，不仅可以用来缓冲冲击即逆转反向趋势；还有助于为社会保险范围的扩大提供资金。
en: Not only can public assets be used to cushion shocks and counter adverse trends; they can also help fund an expansion of social insurance.

zh: 而中国所面对的问题并非国有资产的规模，而是这些资产都过度集中于少部分企业和行���之中 — — 这种情况会为经济表现带来风险。
en: The problem in China is not the volume of state-owned assets, but their concentration in a few companies and industries – a situation that poses risks to economic performance.

zh: 有鉴于此，合理的解决方案并不是处理掉国家持有的资产，而是逐步将它们分散到各个部门。
en: Given this, the logical solution is not to dispose of the state’s asset holdings, but to diversify them over time.

zh: 这种做法将有一系列的好处。
en: Such an approach would have a number of benefits.

zh: 首先，这将产生一个拥有庞大市场职能的国家资产负债表，提振就业，刺激创新，并推进整个经济体的结构转型。
en: First and foremost, it would reconcile a large state balance sheet with an expanding role for markets, bolstering employment, stimulating innovation, and advancing the economy’s structural transformation.

zh: 毕竟对基础设施，人力资本和经济体的知识技术基础的公共投资依然是至关重要的。
en: To this end, public investment in infrastructure, human capital, and the economy’s knowledge and technology base would remain crucial.

zh: 此外，中国国家资产的多样化将极大深化其金融市场。
en: Furthermore, the diversification of China’s asset holdings would deepen its financial markets considerably.

zh: 在未来数年中，随着国有部门的市场资本的已交易或可交易份额从目前10~15%的较低水平逐步上升，更多机构投资者，例如养老基金和保险公司，都将参与到中国的股市交易之中 — — 而目前这还主要是散户在操作。
en: Over the next several years, as the traded or tradable share of the state-owned sector’s market capitalization increased from today’s low base of 10-15%, more institutional investors, such as pension funds and insurance companies, would become involved in Chinese equity trading, which is currently dominated by retail investors.

zh: 这将为日渐富裕的民众提供更多储蓄选项并增强对长期投资和发展的支持力度。
en: This would augment savings options for an increasingly affluent population and strengthen support for long-term investment and development.

zh: 债券市场也会从这些举措中受益。
en: Debt markets would also benefit from such an initiative.

zh: 随着时间不断推移，私人和国有部门之间界限的逐渐模糊将削弱后者获取 — — 及滥用 — — 银行融资渠道的优势，令到企业债券的市场不断扩张。
en: Blurring the line between the private and the state-owned sectors would, over time, reduce the latter’s privileged access to – and overuse of – bank financing, leading to the expansion of corporate bond markets.

zh: 随着社会保障系统和主权基金这样的公有实体持有更加多样化的资产组合，也就会大大减少偏袒国家持有较多份额的已有企业的市场干涉行为。
en: With public entities like the social security system and sovereign-wealth funds holding more diversified asset portfolios, incentives would be substantially reduced for market intervention favoring incumbents in which the state owned a large share.

zh: 这与竞争法的更强大的执行力度一道，向着营造一个公平市场竞争平台迈出一大步。
en: This, along with enhanced enforcement of competition law, would go a long way toward leveling the playing field in markets.

zh: 明确界定的受托责任和治理将有助于确保公有资产能最大限度地追求规避风险的长期回报，使得国家和公民同时收益而市场则成为效率与创新程度的裁决者。
en: Clearly specified fiduciary responsibilities and governance would help to ensure that publicly held assets were managed to maximize long-term risk-adjusted returns, with the state and citizens as beneficiaries and the market as the arbiter of efficiency and innovation.

zh: 管理最完善的国有企业将脱颖而出 — — 或维持 — — 成为成功和长期的市场参与者，适应不断扩大的市场竞争并实现创新与规模经济的结合。
en: The best-managed state-owned enterprises could emerge – or remain – as successful and prominent players, adapting to expanded market competition and combining innovation with economies of scale.

zh: 事实上，公共部门资产管理可以“外包 ” ， 邀请私人资产管理者来竞争这一角色。
en: Indeed, public-sector asset management could be “outsourced,” with private asset managers competing for the job.

zh: 这将加速资产管理部门的发展并为储蓄者和投资者带来长远的好处。
en: This would accelerate the development of the asset-management sector, with far-reaching benefits for savers and investors.

zh: 中国没必要放弃持有大量资产所带来安全网来让市场扮演一个决定性的微观经济角色。
en: China does not have to give up the safety net provided by large asset holdings to allow markets to play a decisive microeconomic role.

zh: 它可以摒弃“制高点”模式并发展自身的“国家资本主义”来发挥两个世界经济模式的优点。
en: It can abandon the commanding heights model and develop its version of “state capitalism” to support the best of both worlds.

zh: 而唯一所需的则是政府持续且坚定追求公众利益的承诺 — — 当然，还有一个完美执行改革战略。
en: All that is needed is a persistently strong government commitment to the public interest – and, of course, a skillfully executed reform strategy.

zh: 中国经济日程
en: A Growth Agenda for China

zh: 米兰/北京—在美国即将向内转之际，中国经济表现对全球变得至关重要。
en: MILAN/BEIJING – At a time when the United States is poised to turn inward, China’s economic performance is more important globally than ever.

zh: 未来几年，中国能否实现可持续增长将取决于诸多重要因素。
en: Whether China can achieve sustainable growth patterns in the coming years will depend upon a number of key factors.

zh: 影响中国前景的主要外部因素之一是其与唐纳德·特朗普的美国的关系。
en: One of the leading external factors shaping China’s prospects will be its relationship with the US under President Donald Trump.

zh: 理想的情况是两国政府合作协商双赢贸易和投资协定，对双方均面临的挑战保持敏锐。
en: Ideally, the two governments would work together to negotiate mutually beneficial trade and investment agreements, with sensitivity to the challenges faced by both sides.

zh: 但相反的结果 — — 双输贸易和投资纠纷升级 — — 的可能性同样不小。
en: But the opposite outcome – the escalation of mutually damaging trade and investment disputes – is also a distinct possibility.

zh: 欧洲政治不确定性也在增加。
en: Political uncertainty is also on the rise in Europe.

zh: 其对中国的影响不如特朗普的行动直接，但也是对整个全球经济的重要中期风险源。
en: While its impact on China would not be as direct as Trump’s actions, it is a source of significant medium-term risks for the entire global economy.

zh: 在亚洲内部，影响中国经济前景的一个关键因素是中国领导的地区贸易和投资协定的进展情况。
en: Within Asia, a key factor shaping China’s economic prospects is progress on Chinese-led regional trade and investment agreements.

zh: 特别是，通过“一带一路”计划和亚洲基础设施投资银行进行的地区发展投资可以为亚洲（及其他地区）带来更多的贸易和增长，尽管其影响需要时间才能显现。
en: In particular, investments in regional development via the “one belt, one road” initiative and the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank may produce expanded trade and growth in Asia (and beyond), though the effects will not be immediate.

zh: 第四个重要外部因素是汇率。
en: The fourth major external factor relates to exchange rates.

zh: 目前，人民币面临着巨大的贬值压力，主要原因是资本外流。
en: As it stands, the renminbi is facing significant depreciation pressure, caused largely by a surge in capital outflows.

zh: 与此同时，在特朗普采取财政扩张的预期下，美元正在升值。
en: Meanwhile, the US dollar is strengthening in anticipation of Trump’s fiscal expansion.

zh: 中国的表现部分将取决于这些动态如何发展。
en: China’s performance will depend partly on how these dynamics play out.

zh: 但是，除了外部不确定性和不利因素，中国还面临一系列内部挑战，它们也许是中国经济所面临的更大的风险。
en: But, beyond the external uncertainties and headwinds, China faces a slew of internal challenges, which may well present even greater risks to its economy.

zh: 这些挑战 — — 包括实体经济和民营经济疲软、产能过剩、杠杆过高、房价高企等 — — 主要原因在于金融部门问题的积累以及中国领导人没能及时解决这些问题。
en: Those challenges – including weaknesses in the real economy and the private sector, overcapacity, excessive leverage, and high housing prices – are rooted largely in the financial sector’s mounting problems and the failure of China’s leaders to address them.

zh: 以促进实体部门投资的措施为例。
en: Consider efforts to promote investment in the real sector.

zh: 中国人民银行一直在向市场提供流动性，希望缓解生产性民营企业和行业的财务负担。
en: The People’s Bank of China has been providing spurts of liquidity to the market, in the hope of relieving financial constraints on productive private businesses and industries.

zh: 但货币政策传导机制不畅，流动性没有流向实体经济。
en: But the monetary-policy transmission mechanism is broken, and liquidity is not making it to the real economy.

zh: 相反，中国的银行仍然将信用主要配置给国有企业和地方政府融资平台。
en: Instead, China’s banks continue to allocate credit largely to state-owned enterprises (SOEs) and local-government financing vehicles (LGFVs).

zh: 流向国有部门的信用最后没有用于提振���产率的投资，而是进入了房地产市场（这推高了房价泡沫）和产能过剩行业（进一步增加了产能过剩，也让许多公司逃避急需的重组 ） 。
en: Credit to the state sector ends up flowing not into productivity-enhancing investments, but into the housing market (fueling price bubbles) and industries with excess capacity (fueling even more overcapacity and enabling companies to avoid much-needed restructuring).

zh: 地方政府融资平台用低成本贷款建设基础设施，但这些投资的社会回报通常很低；而在进行了数十年高速基础设施建设后，边际回报也在下降。
en: While LGFVs use the low-cost loans to build infrastructure, the social returns of those investments are often low; and, after decades of rapid infrastructure construction, the marginal returns are declining.

zh: 与此同时，地方政府的负债仍在节节攀升。
en: Meanwhile, local governments’ leverage continues to rise.

zh: 国有企业也可能利用不受监管的影子银行系统，将它们获得的廉价资金再次贷款给民营企业，因为后者无法从正式银行系统中借到钱。
en: SOEs may also use the unregulated shadow banking system to re-lend at higher interest rates the cheap money they receive to private businesses, which cannot borrow reliably from the formal banking system.

zh: 正式银行系统一年期贷款利率为5%左右，但温州影子银行市场（姑举一例）11月平均一年期利率高达16%左右。
en: Whereas the interest rate of a one-year loan in the formal banking system is around 5%, the average one-year interest rate in the Wenzhou shadow banking market (to cite one example) was around 16% in November.

zh: 这一形势正在伤害整个经济。
en: This state of affairs is jeopardizing the entire economy.

zh: 银行救活了破产的公司，而民营企业 — — 特别是中小企业 — — 仍然饱受挤压。
en: Banks are bailing out bankrupt companies, while private firms – especially small and medium-size enterprises – continue to get squeezed.

zh: 考虑到民营部门生产率一般远高于国有企业或地方政府融资平台，创造远远更高的投资回报，因此经营不善的国有企业缺乏预算硬约束的问题显然必须得到解决。
en: Given that the private sector is generally significantly more productive than SOEs or LGFVs, generating much higher returns on investment, the absence of hard budget constraints on troubled SOEs clearly must be addressed.

zh: 当然，中国领导人曾经明白这一点，也制定了旨在改革国有企业、释放民营部门潜力的改革日程。
en: Of course, China’s leaders have known this for a while, and have created a reform agenda that seeks to reform the SOEs, while unleashing the private sector’s potential.

zh: 但这项工作进展缓慢。
en: But it is still a work in progress.

zh: 说服银行贷款给民营企业而不是国有企业和地方政府融资平台仍需要中国经济做出重大结构性调整。
en: Convincing banks to lend to private enterprises, rather than to SOEs and LGFVs, will require substantial structural shifts in China’s economy.

zh: 对金融机构来说，不管负债多重、竞争力多低，国有企业和地方政府融资平台的风险远低于民营企业。
en: For financial institutions, SOEs and LGFVs represent much lower risk than private businesses, regardless of how leveraged or uncompetitive they are.

zh: 毕竟，国有企业和地方政府融资平台有中央或地方政府的隐性担保，违约的可能性很低。
en: After all, because SOEs and LGFVs are implicitly guaranteed by central or local governments, they are highly unlikely to default.

zh: 银行知道（或认为 ） ， 如果国有企业或地方政府融资平台破产，政府会介入采取有利政策并给予补贴、减税和提供低成本融资工具。
en: Banks know (or believe) that if an SOE or LGFV faces bankruptcy, the government will step in with favorable policies and subsidies, tax cuts, and low-cost financing instruments.

zh: 在一些例子中，银行别无选择，只能贷款给倒闭国企；省政府可能要求它们提供大量低息贷款给奄奄一息、生产率低下的企业，特别是对地方财政收入和就业影响巨大的企业。
en: In some cases, banks have no choice but to lend to failing SOEs; their provincial government may demand that they provide large low-cost loans to a struggling and unproductive firm, particularly if it contributes significantly to local fiscal revenue and employment.

zh: 由于民营企业无法享受到这样的官方保护，因而必须在相当不公平的竞技场上竞争，它们就必须在生产率和竞争力上远远超过国有企业。
en: Given that private firms enjoy no such official protections and thus play on a field that is nowhere near level, they must be substantially more productive and competitive than the SOEs.

zh: 即便如此，如果与它们竞争的国企日子太难过，它们还有可能面临更加恶劣的政策环境变化。
en: And even then, if the SOEs with which they are competing struggle too much, they are vulnerable to policy shifts that increase their disadvantage further.

zh: 简言之，中国金融部门偏袒国有企业正在成为中国经济的最大的风险源之一。
en: Simply put, the Chinese financial sector’s bias in favor of SOEs is contributing to some of the biggest risks faced by China’s economy.

zh: 投资者对这一风险的认识或是资本外流的原因之一，这意味着金融系统激励扭曲同时也在给人民币汇率造成贬值压力。
en: Investors’ recognition of these risks may be one driver of capital outflows, meaning that distortionary incentives in the financial system are also contributing to the downward pressure on the exchange rate.

zh: 近几年来，中国在实施提振国内私人消费的改革方面取得了巨大进展。
en: China has made great strides in recent years in implementing reforms that boost domestic private consumption.

zh: 尽管中国面临各种挑战，其民营部门仍然充满活力和创新力。
en: And, despite the barriers it faces, the country’s private sector has become highly dynamic and innovative.

zh: 早先的改革现在正在结果，这有助于保持经济增长。
en: Earlier reforms are now bearing fruit, and this has helped to sustain economic growth.

zh: 但实现更快、更富有韧性的增长需要中国取消有利于国有企业的市场和金融体系的偏袒、保护和隐性担保。
en: But achieving faster, more resilient growth will require China to eliminate the biases, protections, and implicit guarantees favoring SOEs in the marketplace and in the financial system.

zh: 惟其如此，货币政策才能实现目标：支持生产性投资、创新、民营企业壮大和实体经济增长。
en: Only then can monetary policy achieve its goal: supporting productive investment, innovation, the scaling of private-sector businesses, and real economic growth.

zh: 十字路口的国企
en: China’s State-Owned Enterprises at a Crossroads

zh: 香港—最近，有关国企改革问题，出现了一些批评意见，特别是针对强化党委在国企管理中的角色的提法。
en: HONG KONG – China has lately been facing harsh criticism for the direction of its reforms of state-owned enterprises, particularly its strengthening of the role of Communist Party committees in SOE management.

zh: 尽管这看似是中国市场经济改革的一步后退，加强对国企的监督实在很有必要，至少目前是如此。
en: But while this might seem like a step backward for China’s market-oriented reforms, there are good reasons to boost oversight, at least for now.

zh: 中国正在经历一个根本性的转型，其目标是以创新为驱动、以知识为基础、靠服务拉动的新的经济发展模式。 中国领导人此刻必须仔细思索如何改革国有企业，使其能够继续为新经济做贡献。
en: With China undergoing a fundamental transformation into an innovation-driven, knowledge-based, and services-led economy, its leaders must think carefully about how to reform the SOEs so that they can contribute to the new economy.

zh: 在过去，国企的角色是明确的。
en: In the past, the role of the SOEs was clear.

zh: 在过去三十年中，它们是中国基础设施建设繁荣的先锋，为中国崛起成为全球制造业强国构筑了基础。
en: Over the last three decades, they underpinned China’s emergence as a global manufacturing powerhouse, by spearheading China’s infrastructure-construction boom.

zh: 在此过程中，它们成为中国经济的一个主导力量，特别是在自然垄断行业（如通讯和电力）和关键战略性行业（如钢铁、煤炭和银行 ） 。
en: In the process, they became dominant, especially in sectors prone to natural monopolies (such as telecommunications and power) and key strategic sectors (such as steel, coal, and banking).

zh: 但以国有企业为主导力量的传统单边市场目前正受到阿里巴巴和腾讯等新技术企业的冲击。 后者通过具有规模经济的统一大平台，横跨多边的产品、物流和分销等市场。
en: But the traditional single-sided markets where SOEs lead are now being disrupted by new technology firms like Alibaba and Tencent, which straddle multi-sided markets of production, logistics, and distribution by using unified platforms that benefit from economies of scale.

zh: 这些企业通过同时为消费者和小企业打造平台 — — 从根本上说，它们也是在提供一个公共基础设施 — — 直接对国企的传统业务模式构成挑战。
en: By creating platforms for consumers and small-scale producers – what is essentially public infrastructure – these firms have directly challenged the SOE business model.

zh: 新数字平台对公共需求的反应迅速而有效。
en: New digital platforms respond quickly and efficiently to public needs.

zh: 这些企业比传统制造业更能体现合作性和共享性，帮助了消费者和小型初创企业来参与决定产品和服务的内容，包括影响从设计到分销的各个供应链环节。
en: These businesses are more collaborative or sharing than the traditional business of manufacturing, allowing consumers and smaller start-ups to shape products and services, from design to distribution.

zh: 对于创新和购买力而言，中国高达13亿的人口是一个巨大的竞争优势。 因此这些数字化平台能够通过提供更胜一筹的规模、速度和便利性（包括与全球市场的对接）来颠覆老牌单边市场生产商（包括一些国企 ） 。
en: Given China’s population of 1.3 billion – a major competitive advantage in terms of innovation and purchasing power – these platforms can disrupt the incumbent one-sided market producers by offering superior scale, speed, and convenience, including access to global markets.

zh: 与此同时，国有企业过时的业务模式 — — 更不用说强大的惰性 — — 使其难以辨别在变化的经济中提供公共品的新机会并据此做出反应。
en: Meanwhile, the SOEs’ obsolete business model – not to mention strong inertia – makes it difficult to identify and respond to new opportunities in providing public goods in a changing economy.

zh: 比如，国有通讯公司和银行就没有能够很好地应对新技术的挑战。
en: China’s state-owned telecommunication companies and banks, for example, have failed to respond to new technological challenges.

zh: 而华为和美的等传统民营企业就比国有企业表现好得多，它们通过尽快学习来适应不断变化的需求和要素成本，已经开始使用机器人技术和来自西方的产品设计来提高竞争力。
en: Even traditional private companies like Huawei and Midea have done much better, adjusting to shifting consumer demand and changing factor costs by retooling as quickly as possible, acquiring, for example, robot technology and product designs from the West.

zh: 如今，不可阻挡的技术进步逻辑要求中国增长模式做出改变。 在这样的情况下，对市场的反应能力尤其关键。
en: Such responsiveness is particularly critical today, when the inexorable logic of technological progress is demanding a transformation of China’s growth model.

zh: 例如，在国内消费硬件和耐用商品的需求有所下降的形势下，中国必须开始发展其自身的高科技产品，同时打造强大的服务业。
en: With demand for consumer hardware and durables falling, China must begin to develop its own higher-tech products, while building a strong services sector.

zh: 而随着世界商品出口的下降 — — 这既有周期性因素，也受到发达经济体经济增长放缓的影响 — — 中国必须激活其国内庞大的消费市场。
en: And with world exports of goods declining – both cyclically and as a result of the growth slowdown in the advanced economies – China must activate its domestic consumer base.

zh: 但是未能重新定位国有企业的新角色及没有找到国企在新形势下的业务模式正在拖累国企。
en: But the inability to update the roles and business models of SOEs is holding China back in this regard.

zh: 国企可能在银行信用、自然资源和土地方面享有特权，但它们也受到僵化的治理结构和反腐带来的大规模人事流动的困扰。
en: SOEs may enjoy privileged access to bank credit, natural resources, and land, but they also suffer from rigid governance and high staff turnover, spurred by President Xi Jinping’s anti-corruption campaign.

zh: 国企的关键人事岗位的变动，需要得到党组织的首肯。
en: When it comes to key personnel, the Communist Party establishment calls the shots.

zh: 因此，对需要不断适应市场变化的国企来说，其决策必须获得管理企业、执行产业政策和维护政治纪律的企业内部和外部官员的一致同意。
en: So, for SOEs to make changes, there must be consensus among internal and external officials in charge of business, industrial policy, and politics.

zh: 20世纪90年代末，国企上市获得了双赢的效果，既确保了解决历史遗留的亏损的新资源，又推进了治理水平和生产率的提高。
en: In the late 1990s, public listings of SOEs had the twin benefits of securing new resources for tackling legacy losses and propelling governance and productivity gains.

zh: 但是，如今，民营技术平台中很多在海外上市，它们获得了新经济的大部分估值收益及现代治理的帮助。
en: Today, however, privately owned technology platforms, many of which are listed abroad, have captured much of the valuation gains of the new economy.

zh: 而对于国企，决策者却难以找到好办法来为债务累累且有过剩产能和陈旧的设备的过时国企提供破产重组的融资。
en: As a result, policymakers are struggling to find a way to finance the creative destruction of outdated SOEs burdened by debt, excess capacity, and obsolete equipment.

zh: 这些对国企的挑战与不确定性迫使当局重新思考其最初的比较激进的改革计划。
en: It is this uncertainty that seems to have spurred the authorities to rethink their original, more aggressive reform plan.

zh: 他们认识到，当经济和金融体系由各种联动和互相依存的要素网络组成时，改变其中一个组成部分 — — 特别是像国有部门这样的重要组成部分 — — 可能会引起深远的后果。
en: They recognize that, when economic and financial systems comprise intricate networks of a variety of interlocking and interdependent elements, changes to one component – especially one as dominant as China’s state sector – can have far-reaching consequences.

zh: 最近的国企改革战略调整让中国领导人获得了一些时间去认识国企在新经济中的合适地位。
en: With the recent adjustments to the reform strategy, China’s leaders have bought themselves some time to figure out where the SOEs can fit into the new economy.

zh: 国企改革的答案也许就在应对新经济环境下新的公共基础设施挑战 — — 发达经济体已在面临这一挑战 — — 包括与信息安全及公平竞争相关的问题。
en: The answer probably lies in new public infrastructure challenges – the kind that the advanced economies are already facing – including issues related to information security and competition.

zh: 如果国有企业能够改变其业务模式及角色定位，转为以低成本提供平台和监管服务，抓住规模经济优势，那么它们也许可以有助于管理大型公共平台对信息的使用。
en: If SOEs shift their business models to provide platform and regulatory services at low cost, taking advantage of economies of scale, they can help, for example, to manage the use of information by the large private platforms.

zh: 或者它们可以有助于监督脸谱（Facebook）和谷歌等外国科技巨头进入中国市场，确保这些外国公司可以带来良性竞争及优质服务但不会完全垄断中国市场 。
en: Or they might help to guide the entry of foreign tech giants like Facebook and Google into the Chinese market, to ensure that those companies do not become too dominant.

zh: 至于国有银行，也许可以利用它们的规模经济等优势为数以百万计的渴望影响和丰富新经济的中小企业提供多层次金融服务。
en: State-owned banks, for their part, might be able to provide multi-tiered financing for the millions of small and medium-size enterprises that are eager to shape and enrich the new economy.

zh: 最后，国有企业也许可以涉足公私合作，与地方政府及地方民营企业一起建设交通和运输体系、城市排水系统以及加强在食品安全、污染控制和公共安全等公共领域机构的建设和管理。
en: Finally, SOEs can enter into public-private partnerships with local businesses to handle the construction and management of transport and traffic systems, urban drainage, and bodies responsible for food safety, pollution control, and public security.

zh: 幸运的是中国国家和地方政府都拥有许多有价值的实物资产，净资产总量高达GDP的140%以上。
en: The good news is that the Chinese government, at both the national and local levels, has plenty of assets with real value, amounting to more than 140% of GDP.

zh: 这些净资产有助于缓和国企转变业务模式和角色定位时所面临的冲击，比如可以填补社会保障系统的赤字及解决历史遗留不良债务（包括过去的腐败、不良贷款和公共设施和服务供给不足所造成的不良债务 ） 。
en: Those assets can help to smooth the transition to this new SOE business model, such as by plugging the holes in the social security system and addressing legacy liabilities, including those arising from past corruption, non-performing loans, and inadequate provision of public goods and services.

zh: 中国的国有企业正处在一个重要的十字路口。
en: China’s SOEs are at a crossroads.

zh: 改革兹事体大，中国领导人花一些时间评估及选择是合适的。
en: Given the high stakes of reform, the country’s leaders are right to take some time to assess their options.

zh: 不管他们选择那条路，都将充满挑战。
en: Whichever route they take is sure to be challenging.

zh: 但这些挑战与坚持旧国企业务模式及角色定位不变将造成的负面后果相比根本不值一提。
en: But those challenges pale in comparison to the problems that would arise from sticking to the old SOE model.

zh: 亚洲的筑坝水霸权
en: Asia’s Dammed Water Hegemon

zh: 新德里—好像为了强调亚洲最大挑战乃是如何应对日渐专横的中国的崛起似的，中国政府披露了在流向他国的大河上建设新大坝的计划。
en: NEW DELHI – As if to highlight that Asia’s biggest challenge is managing the rise of an increasingly assertive China, the Chinese government has unveiled plans to build large new dams on major rivers flowing to other countries.

zh: 中国国务院无视下游国家的忧虑，决定单方面行动，这表明亚洲面临的主要问题不再是做好适应中国崛起的准备，而是需要说服中国领导人将与邻国合作制度化。
en: The decision by China’s State Council to ride roughshod over downstream countries’ concerns and proceed unilaterally shows that the main issue facing Asia is not readiness to accommodate China’s rise, but the need to persuade China’s leaders to institutionalize cooperation with neighboring countries.

zh: 中国是亚洲地缘政治中心，与20个国家海陆相邻；因此，没有中国的参与，就不可能建立基于规则的地区秩序。
en: China is at the geographical hub of Asia, sharing land or sea frontiers with 20 countries; so, in the absence of Chinese participation, it will be impossible to establish a rules-based regional order.

zh: 那么，如何让中国入局呢？
en: How, then, can China be brought on board?

zh: 这一挑战在亚洲跨国河流问题上特别突出。 中国拥有众多国际大河的上游（主要在青藏高原和新疆 ） ， 因此握有地区水霸权，而中国也在着手通过大坝、水库、堰堤、灌溉网和其他构造改造跨国河流，这是其他大洲所没有的现象。
en: This challenge is most striking on trans-boundary rivers in Asia, where China has established a hydro-supremacy unparalleled on any continent by annexing the starting places of major international rivers – the Tibetan plateau and Xinjiang – and working to reengineer cross-border flows through dams, reservoirs, barrages, irrigation networks, and other structures.

zh: 中国 — — 它比任何其他水霸权国家都拥有更多的跨国河流水路 — — 的建坝关注点已经从内河（已经建满了大坝）转向国际河流，其建坝数量比其他国家的总和还要多。
en: China – the source of trans-boundary river flows to more countries than any other hydro-hegemon – has shifted the focus of its dam-building program from dam-saturated internal rivers to international rivers after having already built more large dams than the rest of the world combined.

zh: 中国的大部分大坝兼负多重功能，包括发电和满足制造、矿业、灌溉和市政供水需求。
en: Most of China’s dams serve multiple functions, including generating electric power and meeting manufacturing, mining, irrigation, and municipal-supply water needs.

zh: 不断增加大坝规模的中国不但建造了世界上最多的超级大坝，也是世界最大的水电发电国，建成发电能力高达230G瓦。
en: By ramping up the size of its dams, China now not only boasts the world’s largest number of mega-dams, but is also the biggest global producer of hydropower, with an installed generating capacity of 230 gigawatts.

zh: 中国国务院意在将中国已经很大的水电发电能力再增加120G瓦，并挑选了54做新坝 — — 不含目前已经开工的大坝 — — 纳入新版2015年能源规划的“重点建设工程 ” 。
en: The State Council, seeking to boost the country’s already-large hydropower capacity by 120 gigawatts, has identified 54 new dams — in addition to the ones currently under construction — as “key construction projects” in the revised energy-sector plan up to 2015.

zh: 这些新大坝大多位于生物多样性丰富的西南地区，那里的自然生态系统和土著文化正在日益受到威胁。
en: Most of the new dams are planned for the biodiversity-rich southwest, where natural ecosystems and indigenous cultures are increasingly threatened.

zh: 2006年的三峡大坝（世界最大大坝）建成后的一系列严重环境后果让中国放慢了建坝计划，如今，中国急切地开始建设新一代大坝。
en: After slowing its dam-building program in response to the serious environmental consequences of completion in 2006 of the Three Gorges Dam – the world’s largest – China is now rushing to build a new generation of giant dams.

zh: 西方基本上已不再建设新坝 — — 日本和印度等其他民主国家的普通民众也越来越反对建设大坝 — — 中国将继续充当世界巨型水坝工程的核心建设者。
en: At a time when dam building has largely petered out in the West – and run into growing grassroots opposition in other democracies like Japan and India – China will remain the nucleus of the world’s mega-dam projects.

zh: 这些项目凸显中国水利决策的零和心态。
en: Such projects underscore the zero-sum mentality that seemingly characterizes China’s water-policy calculations.

zh: 中国在少数民族聚居的边陲建设一系列巨坝，意在赶在河流出境前截留更多的水源。
en: By embarking on a series of mega-dams in its ethnic-minority-populated borderlands, China is seeking to appropriate river waters before they cross its frontiers.

zh: 以人均淡水量衡量，亚洲是全世界最干旱的大洲，它需要一个基于规则的体系来管理水压力，维持快速经济增长以及确保环境可持续性。
en: Asia, the world’s driest continent in terms of per capita freshwater availability, needs a rules-based system to manage water stress, maintain rapid economic growth, and ensure environmental sustainability.

zh: 但中国是当中一块绊脚石，拒绝与邻国签署水共享条约，对地区监管框架支持寥寥，因为它希望保持其对跨境河流的战略控制。
en: Yet China remains the stumbling block, refusing to enter into a water-sharing treaty with any neighbor – much less support a regional regulatory framework – because it wants to maintain its strategic grip on trans-boundary river flows.

zh: 在新批准的多个大坝项目中，有五个位于怒江，三个位于雅鲁藏布江，两个位于澜沧江。
en: Among the slew of newly approved dam projects are five on the Salween, three on the Brahmaputra, and two on the Mekong.

zh: 中国已在澜沧江 — — 东南亚的生命河 — — 建设了六个巨坝，最新建成的254米高的糯扎渡大坝，其所形成的水库设计容量近220立方米。
en: China has already built six mega-dams on the Mekong – the lifeblood for continental Southeast Asia – with its latest addition being the 254-meter-high Nuozhadu Dam, whose gargantuan reservoir is designed to hold nearly 22 billion cubic meters of water.

zh: 目前的建坝计划将威胁到联合国世界遗产怒江大峡谷以及雅鲁藏布江和澜沧江流域环境脆弱的原生态区域。
en: The current dam-building plans threaten the Salween River’s Grand Canyon – a UNESCO World Heritage site – and the pristine, environmentally sensitive areas through which the Brahmaputra and the Mekong flow.

zh: 这三条跨国河流发源于青藏高原，它们丰富的水量吸引着中国规划者。
en: These three international rivers originate on the Tibetan plateau, whose bounteous water resources have become a magnet for Chinese planners.

zh: 从西藏经云南流入缅甸和泰国的怒江将不再是亚洲最大的无坝大河 — — 其上第一个大坝将是4200兆瓦容量的西藏松塔水电站。
en: The Salween, which runs from Tibet through Yunnan Province into Burma and Thailand, will cease to be Asia’s last largely free-flowing river, with work on the first project – the giant, 4,200-megawatt Songta Dam in Tibet – to begin shortly.

zh: 中国国务院推翻了总理温家宝2004年宣布的中止在怒江建坝的决定，当时，在毗邻世界遗产 — — 怒江、澜沧江、金沙江三江并流地区的国家级自然保护区开工建设一系列巨坝的计划引起国际舆论大哗。
en: The State Council’s decision reverses the suspension of dam building on the Salween announced by Premier Wen Jiabao in 2004, after an international uproar over the start of multiple megaprojects in the National Nature Reserves, adjacent to the world heritage area – a stunning canyon region through which the Salween, the Mekong, and the Jinsha flow in parallel.

zh: 这一出尔反尔也见于其他项目，包括长江：在大工程之后，中国暂时叫停了争议计划，以平息汹涌的民意，稍后再重启相同的计划。
en: This reversal is consistent with the pattern established elsewhere, including on the Yangtze: China temporarily suspends a controversial plan after major protests in order to buy time while public passions cool, before resurrecting the same plan.

zh: 与此同时，中国宣布在印度东南部和孟加拉国主要河流 — — 雅鲁藏布江建设三座新大坝的决定促使印度政府建议中国“确保下游国家利益不受上游工程侵害 ” 。
en: Meanwhile, China’s announcement of three new dam projects on the Brahmaputra, the main river running through northeastern India and Bangladesh, has prompted the Indian government to advise China to “ensure that the interests of downstream states are not harmed” by the upstream works.

zh: 水已成为中印关系的新分歧因素。
en: Water has emerged as a new divide in Sino-Indian relations.

zh: 中国在西南部建坝的新计划还带来了巨大的安全担忧。
en: China’s new focus on building dams in the southwest of the country also carries larger safety concerns.

zh: 事实上，中国科学家将2008年青藏高原东沿发生的夺去87000人生命的大地震归咎于位于地震断层附近的新建成的紫坪铺大坝。
en: Indeed, Chinese scientists blamed the massive 2008 earthquake that struck the Tibetan plateau’s eastern rim, killing 87,000 people, on the newly constructed Zipingpu Dam, located next to a seismic fault.

zh: 大坝的水库截留了巨大的水量，据说这些水的巨大重量触发了严重的结构应力，即科学家所谓的水库引发的地震。
en: The weight of the water impounded in the dam’s massive reservoir was said to have triggered severe tectonic stresses, or what scientists call reservoir-triggered seismicity.

zh: 中国急切地建设新坝的计划注定要引起亚洲关系动荡，引发水的更大竞争，妨碍已然进展缓慢的地区合作和一体化的制度化进程。
en: China’s rush to build more dams promises to roil relations across Asia, fostering greater competition for water and impeding the already slow progress toward institutionalizing regional cooperation and integration.

zh: 如果中国一意孤行，基于规则的亚洲秩序前景渺茫。
en: If China continues on its current, heedless course, prospects for a rules-based order in Asia could perish forever.

zh: 中国对俄国的威胁
en: China’s Threat to Russia

zh: 上周，在俄国总统普京和中国主席胡锦涛的观摩下，中俄两国举行了联合军事演习。
en: Last week, Russia and China held joint military maneuvers in the presence of both Russian President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Hu Jintao.

zh: 但是两国之间不大可能结成战略联盟关系，因为尽管克里姆林宫的许多人在与美国和西方交恶之际，对于中国对俄国构成最大的战略威胁这一点视而不见。
en: But a new strategic alliance between the two countries is not likely, as it is China that poses the greatest strategic threat to Russia, although many in the Kremlin seem blind to this as they rattle sabers at America and the West.

zh: 确实，中国官方认为俄国远东的几个地区只是从该国“分离”出去。
en: Indeed, China officially considers several regions in Russia’s Far East to be only “alienated” from it.

zh: 中国对俄国的领土主张在中国的小学地理教科书中经常提及，这包括在中国境内的几个俄国远东地区。
en: China’s territorial claims on Russia are often noted in Chinese grade school geography textbooks, which include a number of Russian Far Eastern regions within China’s borders.

zh: 这与中国的“重大空间”战略概念相吻合，这一空间包括陆地、海上、空中以及太空的国家战略活动的所有方面。
en: This is consistent with the Chinese strategic concept of “vital space,” which includes all spheres of a state’s strategic activities, on land, at sea, under water, in the air, and in space.

zh: 国家的经济、科技、社会以及军事能力，也就是它的“总体实力”决定了“重大空间”的各个方面。
en: The dimensions of “vital space” are determined by a country’s economic, scientific, technical, social, and military capabilities – in essence, its “total power.”

zh: 中国的理论学家们认为，大国的“重大空间”延伸到国家的边界以外，而弱小国家的“重大空间”则限于战略边境以内，而且并不总是与其国家领土相符合。
en: According to Chinese theorists, the “vital space” of great powers extends far beyond a state’s borders, whereas the “vital space” of weak countries is limited to strategic boundaries that do not always correspond to the borders of their national territory.

zh: 如今，中国对其24个邻国中的11个有领土要求，包括印度、日本、越南、菲律宾以及俄国。
en: Today, China has territorial claims against 11 of its 24 neighbors, including India, Japan, Vietnam, and the Philippines, in addition to Russia.

zh: 在中国与所有这些国家的关系中，潜在动用武力过去是一个重要的因素，现在也是如此。
en: In China’s relations with all of them, the potential use of military force was and remains an important factor.

zh: 2006年9月，中国人民解放军举行了一次前所未有的为期十天的大规模军事演习，包括中国七大军区中实力最为雄厚的沈阳和北京军区。
en: In September 2006, China’s People’s Liberation Army (PLA) conducted an unprecedentedly large 10-day exercise, involving the Shenyang and Beijing military districts, the two most powerful of China’s seven military districts.

zh: 沈阳军区毗邻俄国军队的远东军区，而北京军区则与俄国西伯利亚军区接壤。
en: Shenyang abuts the Russian Armed Forces’ Far Eastern District, and the Beijing district shares a border with Russia’s Siberian Military District.

zh: 在演习中，沈阳军区的部队深入北京军区1000公里，两大军区在那里进行了联合军事演习。
en: During the exercises, Shenyang units advanced 1,000 kilometers into the Beijing district, where they engaged in joint war games.

zh: 对于军事观察家而言，北京和沈阳两大军区的演习看起来是针对俄国的进攻行动，因为，如此规模的演习只是在多年训练士兵、进行具体的战略和作战安排的最后阶段才实施。
en: To military observers, the Beijing/Shenyang exercises seemed to be practice for a possible offensive operation against Russia, because exercises on such a scale are undertaken only at the final stage of a multi-year program to train troops to enact specific strategic and operational plans.

zh: 演习的地点及其进攻性质毫无疑问说明俄国被认为是“假想敌 ” 。
en: The geography of the exercises, and the offensive nature of the tasks undertaken, leaves little doubt that Russia was cast in the role of “potential adversary.”

zh: 这种喧耀武力是中国古代的一种政治手段。
en: Such a show of force is an ancient, traditional Chinese political technique.

zh: 自相矛盾的是，这些演习是在双边政治和经济关系表面上处于最高点的时候进行的。
en: Paradoxically, these exercises were undertaken during a period when bilateral political and economic ties appeared on the surface to be at their highest point.

zh: 俄国在中国的地缘政治考量中占有重要的地位，是其现代化所需要的现代武器和能源的供应国。
en: Russia has an important place in Chinese geopolitical calculations, as a supplier of both modern weaponry and energy resources needed to continue its modernization.

zh: 因此，中国人竭尽全力来加强在俄国的经济和政治地位，并且把俄国拉入其势力范围之中。
en: Therefore, the Chinese are doing everything possible to strengthen their economic and political position in Russia, and to draw Russia into their sphere of influence.

zh: 中国最主要地通过一贯强化普京的反美和反西方规划正在取得成功。
en: And China is succeeding, most importantly by consistently reinforcing Putin’s anti-American and anti-Western agenda.

zh: 当北京军区和沈阳军区的军事演习向俄国领导人表明，中国对俄国的意图未必总是善意之时，俄国的政治和军事领导层看起来并未意识到这一点；相反，他们继续向中国出售先进武器。
en: While Beijing/Shenyang exercise should have indicated to Russian leaders that China’s intentions toward Russia may not always be benign, Russia’s political and military leadership seem not to sense any threat; on the contrary, they continue to sell the Chinese advanced weapons.

zh: 俄国目前的外交倾向完全是违背其自身的长期国家安全利益。
en: Russia’s current diplomatic tilt, indeed, is clearly against its own long-term national security interests.

zh: 中国永远不会对俄国的经济和政治现代化感兴趣，因为它宁愿俄国继续成为矿产和能源来源以及同美国日益成形的挑战的巨大“战略后方 ” 。
en: China will never be interested in Russia’s economic and political modernization, for it prefers Russia to remain a source of mineral and energy resources and a vast “strategic rear” in its looming challenge with the United States.
