zh: 同样，刚刚结束年度会议的上海合作组织在中国的眼中是帮助加强中国影响力和以俄国为代价、控制中亚自然资源的地区政策的工具。
en: Likewise, the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO), which just concluded its annual meeting, is in China’s eyes a tool of regional policy that helps strengthen China’s influence and control over Central Asia’s natural resources at the expense of Russia.

zh: 没有一个国家威胁中国的陆地边界。
en: No nation threatens China’s land borders.

zh: 中国可以自己解决其国内问题，例如分裂主义。
en: China can solve its domestic problems, such as separatism, by itself.

zh: 中国在军事上自给自足，只是为了在影响其利益的冲突发生时可以腾出手来才需要在上海合作组织的框架下的军事合作。
en: China is militarily self-sufficient and needs military cooperation under the SCO framework only in order to free its hands if any conflict should arise that affects its interests.

zh: 实际上，鉴于两国在该地区经济和政治利益的明显不同，正是在中亚地区中俄之间才有可能爆发冲突。
en: In fact, conflict between Russia and China is possible precisely in Central Asia, given the clear differences in the two countries’ economic and political interests in that region.

zh: 除了控制该地区的能源供应外，由于中国严重缺水，水已经成为冲突的潜在因素。
en: Aside from control of the region’s energy supplies, water has become a potential source of conflict, given China’s serious shortages.

zh: 但是，尽管中国完全理解这些急迫的问题并且准备用外交和军事手段予以处理，克里姆林宫依旧短视地专著于美国威胁的幻影。
en: Yet, while the Chinese clearly understand these contingencies and are preparing themselves to deal with them diplomatically and militarily, the Kremlin remains myopically obsessed with the phantom threat of America.

zh: 如此，正当克里姆林宫梦想重新建立对自己所称的“近邻 ” ( 乌克兰、白俄罗斯、波罗的海国家以及其他后苏联国家)控制之时，中国正在日益把俄国视为其自身的“近邻 ” 。
en: Thus, as the Kremlin dreams of re-establishing its domination over what Russians refer to as the “near abroad” (Ukraine, Belarus, the Baltic countries, and the other post-Soviet states), China is increasingly looking at Russia as its own “near abroad.”

zh: 克里姆林宫是否会最终清醒，意识到这一点呢？
en: Will the Kremlin finally wake up to this?

zh: 36年前，当美中两国意识到是苏联、而非各自两国构成更大威胁的时候，尼克松和毛泽东把世界政治搞得天翻地覆。
en: Thirty-six years ago, Richard Nixon and Mao Zedong turned world politics upside down, as both America and China realized that it was the Soviet Union, and not each other, that posed the greater threat.

zh: 普京需要其自己的“尼克松时刻 ” 。
en: Vladimir Putin needs his own “Nixon moment.”

zh: 当对俄国最大的长期威胁来自东方的时候，与西方分离是一项愚蠢的战略。
en: Alienating the West is a foolish strategy when the greatest long term threat to Russia comes from the East.

zh: 全球增长 — — 依然中国制造
en: Global Growth – Still Made in China

zh: 纽黑文—夸大中国减速的焦虑不绝于耳，但中国经济仍然是世界GDP增长的最大贡献者。
en: NEW HAVEN – Despite all the hand-wringing over the vaunted China slowdown, the Chinese economy remains the single largest contributor to world GDP growth.

zh: 对于以失速速度蹒跚前行的全球经济而言 — — 如果再来一次大冲击，恐怕就无法避免再次陷入衰退了 — — 这一贡献无比重要。
en: For a global economy limping along at stall speed – and most likely unable to withstand a significant shock without toppling into renewed recession – that contribution is all the more important.

zh: 一组数据说明了这一点。
en: A few numbers bear this out.

zh: 如果2016年中国GDP增长达到6.7 % — —与政府官方目标一致，略高于国际货币基金组织（IMF）的最新预测6.6 % — —则中国将为世界GDP增长贡献1.2个百分点。
en: If Chinese GDP growth reaches 6.7% in 2016 – in line with the government’s official target and only slightly above the International Monetary Fund’s latest prediction (6.6%) – China would account for 1.2 percentage points of world GDP growth.

zh: 目前，IMF 预测今年全球增长仅为3.1 % ， 这意味着其中中国的贡献接近39 % 。
en: With the IMF currently expecting only 3.1% global growth this year, China would contribute nearly 39% of the total.

zh: 如此比重令其他主要经济体汗颜。
en: That share dwarfs the contribution of other major economies.

zh: 比如，尽管人们广泛赞扬美国稳步复苏，但其2016年增长率预计只有2.2 % — —只能为世界总GDP增长贡献0.3个百分点，或者中国贡献幅度的四分之一。
en: For example, while the United States is widely praised for a solid recovery, its GDP is expected to grow by just 2.2% in 2016 – enough to contribute just 0.3 percentage points to overall world GDP growth, or only about one-fourth of the contribution made by China.

zh: 僵化的欧洲经济预计只能给世界增长带来0.2个百分点，日本恐怕连0.1个百分点都达不到。
en: A sclerotic European economy is expected to add a mere 0.2 percentage points to world growth, and Japan not even 0.1 percentage point.

zh: 事实上，中国对全球增长的贡献要比所有所谓的发达经济体的贡献之和（0.8个百分点）高出50 % 。
en: China’s contribution to global growth is, in fact, 50% larger than the combined 0.8-percentage-point contribution likely to be made by all of the so-called advanced economies.

zh: 此外，没有发展中经济体对全球增长的贡献可以与中国相比。
en: Moreover, no developing economy comes close to China’s contribution to global growth.

zh: 印度GDP预计今年将增长7.4 % ， 比中国快0.8个百分点。
en: India’s GDP is expected to grow by 7.4% this year, or 0.8 percentage points faster than China.

zh: 但中国经济占世界产出的整整18 % （ 以购买力平价衡量 ） ， 是印度的7.6%的两倍多。
en: But the Chinese economy accounts for fully 18% of world output (measured on a purchasing-power-parity basis) – more than double India’s 7.6% share.

zh: 这意味着今年印度对全球GDP增长的贡献可能只有0.6个百分点 — — 只有中国预计贡献幅度1.2个百分点的一半。
en: That means India’s contribution to global GDP growth is likely to be just 0.6 percentage points this year – only half the 1.2-percentage-point boost expected from China.

zh: 光广泛地看，预计中国将占所谓的金砖国家（大型发展中经济体集团）总增长的整整73 % 。
en: More broadly, China is expected to account for fully 73% of total growth of the so-called BRICS grouping of large developing economies.

zh: 印度（7.4 % ） 和南非（0.1 % ） 的贡献将被俄罗斯 （ - 1.2 % ） 和巴西 （ - 3.3 % ） 所抵消。
en: The gains in India (7.4%) and South Africa (0.1%) are offset by ongoing recessions in Russia (-1.2%) and Brazil (-3.3%).

zh: 剔除中国的话，2016年金砖国家GDP预计将只有3.2 % 。
en: Excluding China, BRICS GDP growth is expected to be an anemic 3.2% in 2016.

zh: 因此，不管你如何剖析，中国仍然是世界主要经济引擎。
en: So, no matter how you slice it, China remains the world’s major growth engine.

zh: 诚然，中国经济较1980—2011年间平均每年10%的增长已经大幅放缓。
en: Yes, the Chinese economy has slowed significantly from the 10% average annual growth recorded during the 1980-2011 period.

zh: 但即使在从“旧常态”转为中国领导层所谓的“新常态”后，全球经济增长仍然严重依赖中国。
en: But even after transitioning from the “old normal” to what the Chinese leadership has dubbed the “new normal,” global economic growth remains heavily dependent on China.

zh: 长期以中国为核心的全球增长动态有三个重要影响。
en: There are three key implications of a persistent China-centric global growth dynamic.

zh: 首先也是最显而易见的是，中国增长的持续减速对于疲软的全球经济的影响要比后者以接近3.6%的趋势增长率增长时的情况大得多。
en: First, and most obvious, continued deceleration of Chinese growth would have a much greater impact on an otherwise weak global economy than would be the case if the world were growing at something closer to its longer-term trend of 3.6%.

zh: 剔除中国的话，2016年世界GDP增长将在1.9%左右 — — 远远低于常常伴随全球衰退的阈值2.5 % 。
en: Excluding China, world GDP growth would be about 1.9% in 2016 – well below the 2.5% threshold commonly associated with global recessions.

zh: 第二个影响与第一个有关，即人们广泛担心的中国经济“硬着陆”将带来灾难性的全球影响。
en: The second implication, related to the first, is that the widely feared economic “hard landing” for China would have a devastating global impact.

zh: 中国GDP增长每下降一个百分点，都将直接拉低近0.2个百分点的世界GDP；若包括对外贸易的溢出效应，总全球增长影响将在0.3个百分点左右。
en: Every one-percentage-point decline in Chinese GDP growth knocks close to 0.2 percentage points directly off world GDP; including the spillover effects of foreign trade, the total global growth impact would be around 0.3 percentage points.

zh: 将中国硬着陆定义为当前6.7%的增长率下降一半，则其直接和间接总影响将是全球总增长下降一个百分点左右。
en: Defining a Chinese hard landing as a halving of the current 6.7% growth rate, the combined direct and indirect effects of such an outcome would consequently knock about one percentage point off overall global growth.

zh: 在这个情形中，世界将无法不免又一次大衰退。
en: In such a scenario, there is no way the world could avoid another full-blown recession.

zh: 最后（更有可能只是我的观点 ） ， 中国经济成功再平衡也会带来全球影响。
en: Finally (and more likely in my view), there are the global impacts of a successful rebalancing of the Chinese economy.

zh: 如果中国GDP的组成要素继续发生改变，从制造业拉动的出口和投资转变为服务和家庭消费，那么世界将大受裨益。
en: The world stands to benefit greatly if the components of China’s GDP continue to shift from manufacturing-led exports and investment to services and household consumption.

zh: 在这样的环境下，中国内需有可能成为中国主要贸易伙伴出口拉动型增长的重要源泉 — — 当然，一个前提是其他国家能自由开放地进入快速扩张的中国市场。
en: Under those circumstances, Chinese domestic demand has the potential to become an increasingly important source of export-led growth for China’s major trading partners – provided, of course, that other countries are granted free and open access to rapidly expanding Chinese markets.

zh: 中国成功再平衡的情形有望以新的重要总需求源提振全球需求 — — 这对于停滞的世界来说是一针强心剂。
en: A successful Chinese rebalancing scenario has the potential to jump-start global demand with a new and important source of aggregate demand – a powerful antidote to an otherwise sluggish world.

zh: 也许我们不应该忽视这一可能，因为全球贸易争论正在受到政治压力。
en: That possibility should not be ignored, as political pressures bear down on the global trade debate.

zh: 总而言之，尽管所有的焦点都集中在美国、欧洲和日本身上，但中国仍然是当今疲软的全球经济的王牌。
en: All in all, despite all the focus on the US, Europe, or Japan, China continues to hold the trump card in today’s weakened global economy.

zh: 中国硬着陆将是灾难性的，但成功的再平衡将是不折不扣的提振。
en: While a Chinese hard landing would be disastrous, a successful rebalancing would be an unqualified boon.

zh: 因此，可以断言，中国才是全球经济前景的决定性因素。
en: That could well make the prognosis for China the decisive factor for the global economic outlook.

zh: 最新月度指标表明，中国经济已经稳定在2016年上半年所报告的6.7%的增长附近，但下半年仍然阻力重重。
en: While the latest monthly indicators show China’s economy stabilizing at around the 6.7% growth rate recorded in the first half of 2016, there can be no mistaking the headwinds looming in the second half of the year.

zh: 特别是，私人部门固定资产投资进一步下滑的可能性可能加剧去杠杆、外部需求持续低迷以及房地产周期由盛转衰所带来的压力。
en: In particular, the possibility of a further downshift in private-sector fixed-asset investment could exacerbate ongoing pressures associated with deleveraging, persistently weak external demand, and a faltering property cycle.

zh: 但是，和政策空间严重受限的主要发达经济体不同，中国当局有足够的空间调整以支撑经济活动。
en: But, unlike the major economies of the advanced world, where policy space is severely constrained, Chinese authorities have ample scope for accommodative moves that could shore up economic activity.

zh: 与一直在短期周期性压力和长期结构改革之间权衡的主要发达经济体不同，中国完全有能力同时解决这两大挑战。
en: And, unlike the major economies of the developed world, which constantly struggle with a tradeoff between short-term cyclical pressures and longer-term structural reforms, China is perfectly capable of addressing both sets of challenges simultaneously.

zh: 只要中国领导层能够保持这一多维度政策和改革重点，疲软且依旧脆弱的全球经济就可能受益。
en: To the extent that the Chinese leadership is able to maintain such a multi-dimensional policy and reform focus, a weak and still vulnerable global economy can only benefit.

zh: 世界比任何时候都需要成功的中国。
en: The world needs a successful China more than ever.

zh: 市场操纵全球化
en: Market Manipulation Goes Global

zh: 纽黑文—市场操纵已经成为全世界政策圈的标准操作流程。
en: NEW HAVEN – Market manipulation has become standard operating procedure in policy circles around the world.

zh: 如今，所有人的目光都集中在中国如何处理股市大泡沫的破灭。
en: All eyes are now on China’s attempts to cope with the collapse of a major equity bubble.

zh: 但中国当局的措施并不独特。
en: But the efforts of Chinese authorities are hardly unique.

zh: 西方主要经济体无不做着同样的事情 — — 只不过用不同的外衣掩饰操纵之实而已。
en: The leading economies of the West are doing pretty much the same thing – just dressing up their manipulation in different clothes.

zh: 以量化宽松为例。 先是本世纪初的日本，然后是2008年的美国，再然后是2013年日本再次动用量化宽松，现在则轮到了欧洲。
en: Take quantitative easing, first used in Japan in the early 2000s, then in the United States after 2008, then in Japan again beginning in 2013, and now in Europe.

zh: 在所有这些例子中，量化宽松本质上都是操纵资产价格的大动作。
en: In all of these cases, QE essentially has been an aggressive effort to manipulate asset prices.

zh: 它主要通过央行直接购买长期主权债券、从而降低长期利率、反过来再让股票更有吸引力起作用。
en: It works primarily through direct central-bank purchases of long-dated sovereign securities, thereby reducing long-term interest rates, which, in turn, makes equities more attractive.

zh: 以量化宽松的方式进行市场操纵是否完成了目标 — — 为饱受危机冲击、依赖资产的经济提供刺激 — — 仍有待争议：毕竟，目前发达世界的复苏相当萎靡。
en: Whether the QE strain of market manipulation has accomplished its objective – to provide stimulus to crisis-torn, asset-dependent economies – is debatable: Current recoveries in the developed world, after all, have been unusually anemic.

zh: 但这并没有阻止当局继续尝试。
en: But that has not stopped the authorities from trying.

zh: 央行的辩解缺乏事实依据。 它们说，如果不采取量化宽松，情况还要糟糕得多。
en: In their defense, central banks make the unsubstantiated claim that things would have been much worse had they not pursued QE.

zh: 但是，如今被操纵的资产市场出现了许多泡沫，带来了新的金融动荡风险，因此对于这一点也有待争议。
en: But, with now-frothy manipulated asset markets posing new risks of financial instability, the jury is out on that point as well.

zh: 中国的市场操纵措施并不比发达国家更激进。
en: China’s efforts at market manipulation are no less blatant.

zh: 面对沪深300指数从6月12日的高点暴跌31%的情况（此前12个月上涨145 % ） ，中国监管者采取了大手笔措施遏制损失。
en: In response to a 31% plunge in the CSI 300 (a composite index of shares on the Shanghai and Shenzhen exchanges) from its June 12 peak, following a 145% surge in the preceding 12 months, Chinese regulators have moved aggressively to contain the damage.

zh: 官方行动可谓火力全开，包括证金公司的4,800亿美元政府支持的救市资金、190亿美元国内主要券商资金池以及中国人民银行承诺无限期动用其资产负债表支持股价。
en: Official actions run the gamut, including a $480 billion government-supported equity-market backstop under the auspices of the China Securities Finance Corporation, a $19 billion pool from major domestic brokerages, and an open-ended promise by the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) to use its balance sheet to shore up equity prices.

zh: 此外，大约50%的上市公司停牌（2,800家上市公司中的1,400多家 ） 。
en: Moreover, trading was suspended for about 50% of listed securities (more than 1,400 of 2,800 stocks).

zh: 与西方通过量化宽松进行市场操纵 — — 通过央行流动性注入间接操纵市场 — — 不同，中国的版本的目标更加直接 — — 处于危机中的市场，现在是股市。
en: Unlike the West’s QE-enabled market manipulation, which works circuitously through central-bank liquidity injections, the Chinese version is targeted more directly at the market in distress – in this case, equities.

zh: 显然，量化宽松是一种被动方法 — — 旨在促使危机市场和经济在崩溃后复苏。
en: Significantly, QE is very much a reactive approach – aimed at sparking revival in distressed markets and economies after they have collapsed.

zh: 中国的方法更加主动，好比是接飞刀 — — 驯服处于自由落体状态的市场。
en: The more proactive Chinese approach is the policy equivalent of attempting to catch a falling knife – arresting a market in free-fall.

zh: 中国和西方的市场操纵之间还有几个重大差异。
en: There are several other noteworthy distinctions between China’s market manipulation and that seen in the West.

zh: 首先，中国当局似乎较少关注实体经济的系统性风险。
en: First, Chinese authorities appear less focused on systemic risks to the real economy.

zh: 这是明智的，因为在中国，私人消费只占GDP的36 % ， 相当于美国等依赖财富的经济体的一半，因此，中国的财富效应要小得多。
en: That makes sense, given that wealth effects are significantly smaller in China, where private consumption accounts for just 36% of GDP – only about half the share in more wealth-dependent economies like the US.

zh: 此外，中国股市市值暴涨时间很短。
en: Moreover, much of the sharp appreciation in Chinese equity values was very short-lived.

zh: 沪深300指数过去12个月的大涨中有90%的涨幅集中在2014年11月所谓的沪港通开始、引来大规模跨境资本流之后的七个月。
en: Nearly 90% of the 12-month surge in the CSI 300 was concentrated in the seven months following the start of cross-border investment flows via the so-called Shanghai-Hong Kong Connect in November 2014.

zh: 结果，投机者没有时间让资本利得沉淀下来、形成持续的改善生活（lifestyle）效应。
en: As a result, speculators had little time to let the capital gains sink in and have a lasting impact on lifestyle expectations.

zh: 其次，在西方，危机后改革通常是策略性的，目标是修复已有市场的漏洞，而不是促进新市场。
en: Second, in the West, post-crisis reforms typically have been tactical, aimed at repairing flaws in established markets, rather than promoting new markets.

zh: 相反，在中国，后泡沫时代改革更具战略眼光，因为股灾对政府的资本市场改革具有重要影响，而资本市场改革被视为结构再平衡的关键。
en: In China, by contrast, post-bubble reforms have a more strategic focus, given that the equity-market distress has important implications for the government’s capital-market reforms, which are viewed as crucial to its strategy of structural rebalancing.

zh: 长期以来，中国存在着以银行为核心的信用中介体系，发展安全稳定的股市和债市是中国促进更加多元化的商业资金平台的重中之重。
en: Long saddled with a bank-centric system of credit intermediation, the development of secure and stable equity and bond markets is a high priority in China’s effort to promote a more diversified business-funding platform.

zh: 股票泡沫的崩溃让这一方针受到了严重的质疑。
en: The collapse of the equity bubble calls that effort into serious question.

zh: 最后，中国人民银行强调监管措施，其基准政策利率仍稳稳地保持在可怕的零区间上方，因此它实际上比其他央行都更能够保持货币政策控制力，不会沦为泡沫市场严重倚赖的无限期流动性提供者。
en: Finally, by emphasizing a regulatory fix, and thereby keeping its benchmark policy rate well above the dreaded zero bound, the PBOC is actually better positioned than other central banks to maintain control over monetary policy and not become ensnared in the open-ended provision of liquidity that is so addictive for frothy markets.

zh: 此外，与西方不同，中国专门以股市为目标的措施使得流动性溢出至其他资产市场从而造成金融传染的风险降到最低。
en: And, unlike in the West, China’s targeted equity-specific actions minimize the risk of financial contagion caused by liquidity spillovers into other asset markets.

zh: 中国国内股市基本上仍处于封闭状态，因此很难知道此次修正走势的动物精神何时耗尽。
en: With a large portion of China’s domestic equity market still closed, it is hard to know when the correction’s animal spirits have been exhausted.

zh: 政府集中了大量弹药遏制一个巨大的泡沫的破裂，但高杠杆投机性需求的堆积令人不安。
en: While the government has assembled considerable firepower to limit the unwinding of a spectacular bubble, the overhang of highly leveraged speculative demand is disconcerting.

zh: 事实上，在截至6月的12个月中，保证金融资买入股票规模占国内股市流通市值之比翻了近三倍。
en: Indeed, in the 12 months ending in June, margin financing of stock purchases nearly tripled as a share of tradable domestic-equity-market capitalization.

zh: 中国股市从7月8日的低点大幅反弹14 % ， 但7月27日再度暴跌8.5 % ， 这表明市场稳定也许只是昙花一现。
en: While Chinese equities initially bounced 14% off their July 8 low, the 8.5% plunge on July 27 suggests that that may have been a temporary respite.

zh: 全面恢复交易后，被迫去杠杆的可能性仍可能造成进一步下跌。
en: The likelihood of forced deleveraging of margin calls underscores the potential for a further slide once full trading resumes.

zh: 从更广的角度，与日本、美国和欧洲一样，毫无疑问促使中国进行市场操纵的是巨大资产泡沫带来的风险。
en: More broadly, just as in Japan, the US, and Europe, there can be no mistaking what prompted China’s manipulation: the perils of outsize asset bubbles.

zh: 监管者和决策者 — — 更不用说政治领导人了 — — 一再守着遏制市场过度的开关睡大觉。
en: Time and again, regulators and policymakers – to say nothing of political leaders – have been asleep at the switch in condoning market excesses.

zh: 在劳动收入被持续抑制的全球化世界中，把资产市场当作万灵丹的诱惑实在太大，国家难以抵御。
en: In a globalized world where labor income is under constant pressure, the siren song of asset markets as a growth elixir is far too tempting for the body politic to resist.

zh: 投机泡沫便是这一诱惑的症候。
en: Speculative bubbles are the visible manifestation of that temptation.

zh: 随着泡沫的破裂 — — 泡沫总是会破裂 — — 虚假繁荣暴露无遗，防御性市场操纵策略刻不容缓，看起来也符合逻辑。
en: As the bubbles burst – and they always do – false prosperity is exposed and the defensive tactics of market manipulation become both urgent and seemingly logical.

zh: 这就是市场操纵最大的讽刺所在：我们越是依赖市场，就越是不信任市场。
en: Therein lies the great irony of manipulation: The more we depend on markets, the less we trust them.

zh: 不消说，这与决定市场效率的“看不见的手”大不相同。
en: Needless to say, that is a far cry from the “invisible hand” on which the efficacy of markets rests.

zh: 与亚当·斯密一样，我们声称无人性的市场确保了稀缺资本的效率最高的配置；但我们真正想要的是完全按我们的意图行事的市场。
en: We claim, as Adam Smith did, that impersonal markets ensure the most efficient allocation of scarce capital; but what we really want are markets that operate only on our terms.

zh: 不正常的中国股市
en: China’s Abnormal Stock Market

zh: 伦敦—中国股市再次暴跌8.5 % — —历史上第二大单日跌幅，也是全球金融危机以来第一大单日跌幅。
en: LONDON – China’s stock market has plunged yet again, this time by 8.5% – the market’s second-largest fall in a single day, and the largest since the global financial crisis.

zh: 股市“过山车”远未结束。
en: The roller-coaster ride is far from over.

zh: 事实上，中国股市更像是赌场而不是游乐场。
en: In fact, China’s stock market is more like a casino than an amusement-park attraction.

zh: 散户贡献了85%的交易量，而在其他主要市场，机构投资者 — — 它们拥有相对更充分的信息 — — 才是最大的交易者。
en: Retail investors account for 85% of trades, in contrast to other major markets, where institutional investors – with their relative abundance of information – are the biggest traders.

zh: 毫不奇怪，结果便是市场波动剧烈，流言和情绪在驱动股价方面起着极大的作用。
en: The result, no surprise, is an extremely volatile market, in which rumor and emotion play an outsize role in driving outcomes.

zh: 而这一波动性正是赌场比喻成立的另一个原因：中国股市可以暴涨暴跌10%以上而不引发更广泛的经济灾难 — — 至少到目前为止是如此。
en: And that volatility is the other reason why the casino metaphor applies: China’s stock market can rise or fall by double digits without triggering a wider economic crash – at least so far.

zh: 比如，2001—2005年，中国股市市值缩水一半，这并没有影响到中国GDP（事实上，中国经济增长率接近10 % ） ，而此后的市场复苏（直到2008年金融危机后才大幅下跌）也是如此。
en: For example, China’s GDP growth was unaffected (in fact, the economy was growing at nearly 10%) when the stock market lost half of its value between 2001 and 2005 – or, for that matter, when the market then recovered (only to fall dramatically again after the 2008 financial crisis).

zh: 此后，中国股市一直落后于全球 — — 直到去年以来又成为世界表现最好的股市，上涨超过150 % 。
en: Since then, China’s stock market has been a global laggard – that is, until the past year, when it became the best performing in the world, rising by more than 150%.

zh: 但过山车模式还在继续：周一8.5%的暴跌之前，中国股市刚刚经历了2008年以来最大的两日涨幅。
en: And yet the roller-coaster pattern continues: the 8.5% plunge came when the market re-opened on a Monday that followed the largest two-day rise since 2008.

zh: 而在上涨之前，从6月中旬到7月上旬，中国股市跌去了近三分之一的市值。
en: That rise had been preceded by a loss of nearly one-third of the market’s value from mid-June to early July.

zh: 如此波动凸显出中国确保平稳实现金融自由化的挑战。
en: This volatility highlights the challenges of ensuring a smooth process of financial liberalization in China.

zh: 在大规模政府干预禁止某些卖出股票行为并大面积停牌后，股价出现了反弹。
en: After extensive government intervention prohibited some selling of shares and froze trading for the bulk of the market, prices rebounded.

zh: 但干预无法阻止新一轮崩盘。
en: Yet intervention is unlikely to prevent another crash.

zh: 原因在于中国股市流动性不足，也没有融入全球市场。
en: The reason is that the Chinese stock market is not wholly liquid or globally integrated.

zh: 此外，中国股市的主力资金来自中国储户 — — 即散户。
en: Moreover, it is dominated by captive money from Chinese savers – the retail investors.

zh: 事实上，在2009年之前，中国证交所上市股票只有一小半可以交易。
en: Indeed, it was not until 2009 that most shares on China’s stock exchanges were tradable.

zh: 在2005年启动改革之前，三分之二股票是国有企业或法人（通常是国家控制的实体）持有的非流通股。
en: Until the reforms that began in 2005, two-thirds of shares were non-tradable and held by state-owned enterprises (SOEs) or legal persons, which are typically state-controlled entities.

zh: 事实上，尽管如今只有不到30%的股票不可交易，民营企业仍然只占中国上市公司的一小部分。
en: Indeed, private firms still comprise a minority of China’s listed companies, though today fewer than 30% of shares cannot be traded.

zh: 诚然，在过去几年中，这带来了巨大的流动性。
en: To be sure, that has led to a huge infusion of liquidity over just the past few years.

zh: 但中国也对投资组合投资流实施资本账户限制，这意味着其股市仍相对封闭。
en: But China also imposes capital-account restrictions on portfolio-investment flows, which means that its stock markets remain relatively closed.

zh: 直到最近连接沪港两地市场的沪港通启动前，国际投资者是无法直接在大陆交易所购买A股的。
en: Until the recent launch of the Shanghai-Hong Kong Connect corridor, which links the two markets, international investors could not directly buy A-shares on the mainland exchanges.

zh: 目前直接购买仍有限额，即数量有限的所谓合格境外投资者（QFII）资格。
en: Direct purchases remain subject to a quota, in the form of a limited number of so-called Qualified Foreign Institutional Investor licenses.

zh: 同理，除了可以从人脉和其他手段获益的巨富群体外，数亿跻身中产阶级的普通中国储户无法进入全球市场。
en: By the same token, aside from the very wealthy, who benefit from personal connections and other devices, the hundreds of millions of ordinary Chinese savers who have achieved middle-class status do not have easy access to global markets.

zh: 此外，存款回报极低（此前一直为负 ） ， 国家主导的金融体系也不提供多样化的产品。
en: Moreover, returns on deposits are low (and had been negative), and the state-dominated financial system offers few diversified products.

zh: 结果，住房和国内股市就成为他们能够进行的主要投资手段。
en: As a result, housing and domestic equities are the main investments available to them.

zh: 但随后对房地产泡沫的担忧促使政府收紧了信用，住房市场随之停滞，而股市成为中产阶级储户的资金流向。
en: But then the housing market stalled, as fears of a property bubble spurred a government clampdown on credit, leaving the stock market the place for middle-class savers to put their money.

zh: 随后的上涨时1998—2001年走势的镜像，当时住房市场实现了自由化，而股市则处于熊市。
en: The ensuing boom was a mirror image of the pattern between 1998 and 2001, when the housing market was liberalized and the stock market fell.

zh: 现在的大问题是最近的波动是否会溢出到其他资产市场和实体经济中。
en: The big question now is whether the recent volatility will spill over into other asset markets and the real economy.

zh: 6月以来上证指数两位数的下跌之所以没有引起经济危机，主要是因为只有不到10%的中国家庭参与了股市，而股票只占家庭资产的不到15 % 。
en: The double-digit drop in the Shanghai Composite Index since June has not triggered an economic crisis largely because fewer than 10% of Chinese households participate in the stock market, and equities comprise less than 15% of household assets.

zh: 但即使只有一小部分中国家庭发生了直面损失，其数量也将达到几千万人。
en: But even a small fraction of Chinese households experiencing paper losses still amounts to tens of millions of people.

zh: 而这足以引起政府的关注并采取行动，包括放松抵押品要求、允许用不动产充抵保证金。
en: That has caused enough concern for the government to act, including by relaxing collateral requirements to permit real-estate assets to be used to cover margin calls.

zh: 事实上，人们认为当局对保证金借贷的严打 — — 以及全球市场下跌导致的信心损失 — — 才是引发市场崩溃的罪魁。
en: It was, in fact, the authorities’ clampdown on margin borrowing, together with a loss in confidence as global markets declined, that is thought to have triggered the market meltdown.

zh: 这也是小交易者主导的市场的一大特征：助长大规模枯荣循环的“羊群”行为更加普遍，因为个体认为其他个体拥有更好的信息。
en: And that, too, is a feature of a market dominated by small traders: the “herding” behavior that fuels major booms and busts becomes more prevalent, because individuals assume that others have better information.

zh: 结果我们都看到了 — — 小规模甩卖可以轻易演变为崩溃。
en: The result, as we are now witnessing, is that a moderate sell-off can easily turn into a stampede.

zh: 而政府干预堵住出口并不恰当。
en: And government intervention to block the exits is inadequate.

zh: 相反，在开放中国股市、使其制度基础变得容易预测之前，波动都将是中国股市唯一的指导规则。
en: On the contrary, until China’s stock market opens up and its institutional foundation becomes predictable, volatility will be its only guiding rule.

zh: 中国共产资本主义的矛盾
en: The Contradictions of China’s Communist Capitalism

zh: 伯克利—最近，上海和深圳股市暴跌对中国共产党构成了独特的考验。
en: BERKELEY – The recent dizzying plunge in the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges has posed a unique test for China’s Communist rulers.

zh: 只要市场保持升势，世界最大最强的共产党掌控有力的资本主义式发展这一矛盾就只会引起学者和老派马克思主义者的困惑。
en: So long as the markets were rising, the paradox of vigorous capitalist development overseen by the world’s largest and strongest Communist party confounded only academics and old-school Marxists.

zh: 只要中共精英及其亲属、外国金融机构和一些中国小投资者（得益于保证金贷款）从股市中赚钱，就不会有人会去费心理解他们所哺育的怪物。
en: As the Chinese Communist Party elite and their relatives, foreign financial institutions, and some Chinese small investors (enabled by margin lending) made money on stocks, no one bothered to comprehend the mutant creature they were milking.

zh: 但如今，人们开始认识到中国股价不会永远上涨，而中共也开始了病急乱投医式的控制回调的措施。
en: But now, as the realization sinks in that Chinese stock prices will not keep rising indefinitely, the CCP is taking desperate, if clumsy, measures to control the correction.

zh: 所有新股首发被叫停，许多交易被取消；央行也被要求帮助中国证券金融公司诱导投资者买入股票、稳定市场。
en: All new initial public offerings have been halted, and much trading has been curtailed; the central bank has been asked to help the China Securities Finance Corporation induce investors to buy shares and thus stabilize the market.

zh: 事实上，就连中国主权财富基金也采取了行动。
en: Indeed, even the country’s sovereign wealth fund has gotten into the act.

zh: 但是，与其他资本主义经济不同，钱并非当局所能动用的唯一工具。
en: But, unlike in other capitalist economies, money is not the only tool at the authorities’ disposal.

zh: 在中国，如果经纪人建议你卖出股票，他们必须小心翼翼地避免成为造谣者，这样会受到官方惩罚。
en: If your brokers in China advise you to sell shares, they must be careful not to appear to be rumormongers, subject to official punishment.

zh: 有消息说大宗卖出行为可能招致当局的调查。
en: And there are reports that sales of large holdings may trigger investigations by the authorities.

zh: 在中国，扰乱公共秩序和金融稳定是可能是严重罪名，而关于境外势力暗中破坏经济的阴谋论更是层出不穷。
en: Causing public disorder or financial instability can be a serious offense in China, where conspiracy theories about foreigners’ efforts to undermine the economy abound.

zh: 中国官员想要的是不会引起大损失以至于动摇中共信誉和控制力的资本主义股票市场。
en: What Chinese officials desire is a capitalist stock market without the possibility of large losses that can shake confidence in the CCP’s credibility and control.

zh: 但这样的市场还没有被发明出来。
en: But that is a market that no one has yet invented.

zh: 共产主义政权试图托起如同赌场的资本主义市场，这一奇观只是几乎遍布中国经济和政治每一个角落的大量矛盾中的一个。
en: The spectacle of a communist regime trying to jack up a casino-like capitalist market is just one of the many contradictions that have been accumulating in almost every corner of China’s economy and politics.

zh: 而如今，这些矛盾的分量也许已经成为中共政党层级难以承受之重。
en: And now, their weight is perhaps becoming too heavy for the Party hierarchy to bear.

zh: 事实上，中共的组成本身就是一个矛盾。
en: Indeed, the composition of the CCP is itself a contradiction.

zh: 这个代表工人和农民的革命党现在被商人、大学生和专业人士所主导。
en: The revolutionary party of peasants and workers is now dominated by businessmen, college students, and professionals.

zh: 在胡润中国财富榜上，三分之一的上榜者是党员。
en: One-third of the people listed in the Hurun Report, the Shanghai-based monitor of China’s wealthiest people, are Party members.

zh: 中国人大代表中最富有的70人的平均财富超过10亿美元。
en: The average wealth of the richest 70 members of the National People’s Congress, China’s parliament, far exceeds $1 billion.

zh: （印度乃至美国议会 — — 目前均由右翼政党控制 — — 最富有的70名议员的财富值要低得多。 ）
en: (The richest 70 members of India’s parliament or even the US Congress, both now controlled by right-wing political parties, are substantially less wealthy.)

zh: 当然，国家主席习近平最近的反腐运动让很多中共富豪不寒而栗。
en: Of course, President Xi Jinping’s recent drive against corruption high and low has made many Communist Party plutocrats jittery.

zh: 但很多人质疑对所谓的“老虎”所提起的腐败指控是否只是障眼法，其实质是对习近平在党内和军中的反对势力的老式清洗。
en: But questions abound as to whether the corruption charges being brought against the so-called “tigers” are a fig leaf for an old-fashioned purge of Xi’s rivals in the Party and the military.

zh: 普通中国人大多支持反腐运动；经常发起示威和指责不诚实官员的也正是他们。
en: Ordinary Chinese generally support the anti-corruption drive; it is they who usually initiate protests and point fingers at dishonest officials.

zh: 但是，如果这样的示威引起过多关注，那么更有可能发生的情况是示威被驱散，示威领导人被镇压，而不是腐败得到阻止。
en: But, if such protests attract too much attention, it is more likely that they will be quashed and their leaders repressed than that the corruption will be stopped.

zh: 比如，2008年四川地震时，数千儿童因为校舍质量低劣而死亡。
en: In 2008, for example, following the Sichuan earthquake, thousands of children died when their shoddily built schools collapsed.

zh: 有一段时间，官方新闻也充斥着关于学校建设腐败问题的报道。
en: For a while, tales of corruption in the schools’ construction dominated even the official news.

zh: 但是，最终被逮捕、被国家批评的却是示威的死亡儿童的家长和教师。
en: In the end, however, it was the protesting parents and teachers of the dead children who were detained and harassed by the state.

zh: 中共拒绝承认，只要它垄断着政治权力，腐败就无法根除；没有有组织的反对和功能健全的公民社会机构，官员就会继续利用公职作为敛财工具。
en: What the CCP refuses to recognize is that corruption cannot be rooted out as long as the Party maintains its monopoly on political power; with no organized opposition or functioning civil-society institutions, officials will continue to use their positions of public authority as a vehicle to generate personal wealth.

zh: 中共十八大三中全会强调市场竞争原则；但是，一位资深中国银行家在多年前的评论说 ： “ 如果你与裁判比赛，你很难去和他竞争。 ”
en: The Third Plenum of the 18th Party Congress gave primacy to the principle of market competition; but, as a senior Chinese banker commented in a related context some years back: “It’s quite hard to compete when you’re playing against the referee.”

zh: 这一观察可以扩大到法治和宪政领域。
en: That observation extends to the rule of law and constitutionalism.

zh: 在习近平治下，中共一再强调法治是“社会主义核心价值 ” ， 承诺提高宪法的权威。
en: Under Xi, the CCP has repeatedly insisted that the rule of law is a “core socialist value” and has pledged to promote the authority of the constitution.

zh: 但在中共眼里，法治就是由党定法，由党释法，由党执法。
en: Yet the rule of law in the Party’s eyes is a law that it dictates, interprets, and enforces.

zh: 中国公民援引宪法（特别是保护言论、出版、集会和结社自由的第35条）和一般地提及宪政主义都要受到审查，在法庭中引用宪法的律师也常常会被关起来。
en: Chinese citizens’ references to the constitution (especially article 35, which guarantees freedom of speech, press, assembly, and association) and constitutionalism in general are routinely censored, and lawyers who cite the constitution in court are frequently detained.

zh: 在1937 年的论文中，毛泽东对矛盾的性质做出了著名的总结 ： “ 事物矛盾的法则，即对立统一的法则，是自然和社会的根本法则。
en: Mao famously speculated on the nature of contradictions in a 1937 essay: “The law of contradiction in things, that is, the law of the unity of opposites, is the fundamental law of nature and of society.”

zh: ”尽管如此，我们还是会困惑，就连毛泽东是否也无法抓住、更不用说管理共产资本主义的矛盾。
en: One wonders, though, if even he could have grasped, much less managed, the contradictions of communist capitalism.

zh: 错误的中国警报
en: A False Alarm About China

zh: 马尼拉—一些专家说，中国的经济奇迹 — — 让3亿人摆脱贫困并改变了世界地缘政治重心 — — 正在走向混乱的终局。
en: MANILA – To hear some pundits tell it, China’s economic miracle – one that lifted 300 million people out of poverty and shifted the world’s geopolitical center of gravity – is coming to a tumultuous end.

zh: 根据这一观点，剧烈动荡的股市和人民币“意外”贬值便是经济崩溃即将到来的信号，高风险投资和高水平政府债务给几十年来的“涡轮增压式”产出增长踩了刹车。
en: The volatile stock market and the renminbi’s “surprise” depreciation are signs of imminent economic collapse, according to this view, as risky investments and high levels of government debt put the brakes on decades of turbo-charged output growth.

zh: 幸运的是，没有理由表明应该相信这些末日预言，也没有理由相信最近屡屡成为新闻焦点的市场轮动比短期波动更严重。
en: Fortunately, there is little reason to believe such dire predictions, or that the market gyrations that have been driving recent headlines represent anything more than short-term volatility.

zh: 毕竟，股市波动只是实体经济表现的拙劣预测指标。
en: After all, equity-price movements are a poor predictor of the real economy’s performance.

zh: 事实上，2010—2013年，中国GDP增长强劲，股价也是下跌的。
en: Indeed, when Chinese GDP was growing strongly during 2010-2013, stock prices were falling.

zh: 更近一点，2015年上半年股价狂飙突进，但经济减速已经开始。
en: More recently, when stock prices began soaring during the first half of 2015, the economy’s slowdown had already begun.

zh: 美国经济学家保罗·萨缪尔森（Paul Samuelson）有一句名言 ， “ 股市九次预警最近的五次衰退。 ”
en: As the American economist Paul Samuelson famously quipped, “The stock market has called nine of the last five recessions.”

zh: 中国经济减速主要是其基本面变化的结果：人口结构不再有利，从强调出口和公共投资转向着重服务业和国内消费，以及发达经济体需求下降。
en: China’s growth has slowed largely as a result of changes in its fundamentals: less favorable demographics, a shift in emphasis from exports and public investment to the service sector and domestic consumption, and lower demand from advanced economies.

zh: 但中国过去的成功也助长了这场减速：工资提高了，这制约了依靠低成本劳动力和技术赶超的高速增长的潜力。
en: But China’s past success also contributed to this slowdown, in the form of higher wages, which narrow the scope for rapid growth based on low-cost labor and technological catch-up.

zh: 2015年上半年出现了更多疲软信号，包括出口和投资的萎靡数据。
en: Additional signs of weakness, including soft data on exports and investment, emerged in the first half of 2015.

zh: 但其他重要指标 — — 如零售额和住房 — — 表现出上升势头。
en: But other important indicators – like retail sales and housing – show upticks.

zh: 此外，也许最重要的是，中国劳动力市场仍十分健康，2015年上半年创造了720万城镇新工作岗位 — — 其中许多是服务业岗位。
en: And, perhaps most important, the country’s labor market remains healthy, creating some 7.2 million new urban jobs – many of them in services – in the first half of 2015.

zh: 与此同时，工资增长仍然强劲，没有受到干扰。
en: Meanwhile, wage growth remains strong and uninterrupted.

zh: 今年中国的增长率也许会低于7 % ， 但我不相信会比政府“7%左右”的目标低很多。
en: China’s growth rate may be lower than 7% this year, but I do not believe that it will end up very far from the government’s target of “about 7%.”

zh: 最近几个月中的股价波动与其说与中国经济基本面有关，不如说与中国股市的特殊性有关。
en: The volatility in equity prices in recent months has more to do with the peculiarities of China’s stock markets than with the country’s underlying economic fundamentals.

zh: 在更发达的经济体（如美国和欧洲 ） ， 众多机构投资者 — — 他们往往专注于长期基本面 — — 有助于稳定股市。
en: In more developed economies, such as the United States and Europe, many institutional investors – who tend to be focused on long-term fundamentals – help stabilize stock markets.

zh: 相反，中国股市由散户主导，他们更有可能追求短期收益，参与动量交易，从而放大的波动，在股市和经济增长之间制造出更大的失联。
en: By contrast, the Chinese markets are dominated by retail investors, who are more likely to pursue short-term gains and engage in momentum trading, thereby exacerbating volatility and creating a greater disconnect between equity prices and real economic growth.

zh: 此外，中国上市公司并不代表中国企业。
en: Moreover, the firms listed on China’s stock exchanges are not representative of the country’s companies.

zh: 比如，大型国有企业占了中国股市市值的三分之二，但它们只贡献了中国GDP的三分之一弱，对就业的贡献就更小了。
en: Majority state-owned firms account for two-thirds of the market value of the country’s exchanges, for example, though they are responsible for no more than one-third of Chinese GDP and an even smaller share of employment.

zh: 中国股市的兴衰应该置于一个背景下去理解：中国家庭的储蓄选择十分有限。
en: The rise and fall of the Chinese stock market should also be understood in the context of Chinese households’ limited options for storing savings.

zh: 价格上升发生在存款利率被官方限定了上限时。
en: The run-up in prices took place at a time when deposit interest rates were officially capped.

zh: 当其他储蓄手段少之又少，并且只能提供低回报时，股市看起来很有吸引力，特别是当中国各大报纸纷纷发表牛市评论时 — — 事实正是如此。
en: When the alternatives are few and provide only low returns, the equity market looks more attractive, especially if – as was the case – the country’s major newspapers are running bullish editorials about stock prices.

zh: 最近的发展趋势增加了价格下跌的压力，包括关于取消存款利率上限的讨论（一年期及以上定期存款利率上限在8月25日被取消 ） 。
en: More recent developments may have contributed to the downward pressure on prices, including discussion about abolishing interest-rate ceilings on deposits (the cap on term deposits of one year or more was removed on August 25).

zh: 富裕家庭将储蓄转移出国更加容易了，而美国预计即将升息，这也许是另一个下跌压力。
en: The greater ease with which wealthy households can move savings out of the country, along with an anticipated increase in interest rates in the United States, was likely another contributing factor.

zh: 此外，哈佛大学的杰弗里·弗兰克尔（Jeffrey Frankel）指出，监管者在今年数次提高保证金要求，使得借钱买股票更加困难。
en: Furthermore, as Harvard’s Jeffrey Frankel has pointed out, regulators increased margin requirements several times this year, making it harder to buy stocks with borrowed money.

zh: 此外，和所有股市一样，与基本面无关的情绪变化也助长了波动。
en: And, as with all stock markets, shifts in sentiment that are not connected to fundamentals can also drive volatility.

zh: 中国经济是否能够继续高速增长更多地取决于其改革能力，而非股市表现如何。
en: Whether China’s economy can continue to grow rapidly will depend far more on its ability to reform than on how its stock markets perform.

zh: 如果中国想实现长期繁荣，那么提升总体生产率是关键。
en: If China is to thrive in the long term, raising its aggregate productivity is key.

zh: 这意味着中国需要整顿国有企业和金融部门，使资源能够流向生产率最高的投资项目。
en: This means that it will need to overhaul its state-owned firms and the financial sector so that resources can flow to the most productive investment projects.

zh: 降低企业税负 — — 包括工资税 — — 也十分有用。
en: Lowering the tax burden on firms – including the payroll tax – would also be useful.

zh: 增加劳动力市场灵活性的改革也很重要。
en: Reforms that increase the flexibility of the labor market are also in order.

zh: 过去，中国制造业劳动力市场相对比较灵活，但近几年来，企业按照市场需要配置工人变得更加困难。
en: While China used to have a relatively flexible labor market in the manufacturing sector, firms’ reallocation of workers based on market needs has become more difficult in recent years.

zh: 增加灵活性也许不能刺激短期增长，但可以改善对未来消极冲击（不管来自国内还是国外）的恢复力。
en: Greater flexibility might not stimulate short-term growth, but it would improve resilience to future negative shocks, whether they originate at home or abroad.

zh: 只要中国继续追求亲市场改革，从中期看，它就将继续成为全球GDP增长最大的贡献者，股市波动无法改变这一点。
en: As long as China continues to pursue pro-market reforms, it will remain the largest single-country contributor to global GDP growth over the medium term – unperturbed by stock-market volatility.

zh: 如果改革停滞下来，那么股价下跌仅仅是中国悲剧的开始。
en: If reforms stall, falling stock prices are likely to be the least of China’s worries.

zh: 中国的股市烟雾弹
en: China’s Stock-Market Red Herring

zh: 发自罗马 — — 上证券综合指数自去年六月以来已经出现超过40％的跌幅，而全球投资者对这场下跌的关注也日渐增加 — — 这并不是因为他们有意趁暴跌抄底（中国的股票绝大多数还是由中国投资者持有 ） 。
en: ROME – With the Shanghai Stock Exchange Composite Index down more than 40% since last June, investors worldwide are watching the decline with growing concern – but not because they are invested in the plummeting market (China’s stocks are overwhelmingly held by Chinese).

zh: 相反，他们担心的是股价暴跌意味着中国的经济已经进入下行通道。
en: Rather, the fear is that plunging equity prices mean that China’s economy is going down the tubes.

zh: 而那些试图分辨中国经济未来的人则应该从其他地方去寻找可靠的线索。
en: But those seeking compelling clues about China’s economic future should look elsewhere.

zh: 当然，中国的增长速度已经显著放缓是事实，并有充足的理由相信，这种减速并非是暂时的。
en: Of course, it is true that China’s growth rate has slowed substantially, and there are plenty of reasons to believe that the deceleration is not temporary.

zh: 但所有这些原因基本上都跟股市没什么关系。
en: But none of those reasons has much to do with the stock market.

zh: 这种脱节状况其实已经相当明显，因为当前的股市价格竟然比2014年更高，而那年正是中国超过美国成为世界第一大经济体（按购买力平价计算）并催生了乐观预期的一年。
en: This disconnect is apparent in the fact that market prices are higher today than they were in 2014, the year when China surpassed the United States to become the world’s largest economy (in terms of purchasing power parity), a development that spurred bullish expectations.

zh: 但当时似乎并没有什么观察家认识到中国的经济已经放缓。
en: What observers at the time did not seem to recognize was that China’s economy was already slowing.

zh: 据官方统计，1980~2010年间的增速平均为10 ％ ， 而在2012~2014年间则下降到7-8 ％ 。
en: According to official statistics, the growth rate averaged 10% in 1980-2010, but fell to 7-8% in 2012-2014.

zh: 首先，经济放缓实际上间接有助于股票价格上涨，因为这刺激了中国的人民银行在2014年11月开始降息。
en: At first, the slowdown actually contributed indirectly to a rise in stock prices, by spurring the People’s Bank of China to begin cutting interest rates in November 2014.

zh: 但在2015年春的市场繁荣则更像一场信贷推动的泡沫。
en: But by the spring of 2015, the market’s boom was looking a lot like a credit-fueled bubble.

zh: 当中国证监会提高了保证金比例后，上证综指于6月12日见顶 ， 。
en: The Shanghai index peaked on June 12, when the China Securities Regulatory Commission tightened margin requirements.

zh: 事实是，中国经济增速放缓本该不是什么意外。
en: The truth is that China’s economic slowdown should not have surprised anyone.

zh: 因为该国三十年来年均10％的GDP增​​速已经堪称前无古人了。
en: The country’s three-decade run of 10% annual GDP growth was already unprecedented.

zh: 问题是为何没有一个国家，甚至包括中国，可以将其经济奇迹不断延续下去？
en: The question is why no country, not even China, managed to prolong its economic miracle?

zh: 有些人会提供一些众所周知的解释：国家落入中等收入陷阱，或增长率回归均值。
en: Some offer broad explanations: countries fall into the middle-income trap or experience a regression to the mean in growth rates.

zh: 但在中国的情况下，一些特定的因素可能会发挥作用。
en: But, in China’s case, a number of specific factors may be at play.

zh: 第一个因素是资本回报的不断减少，这削弱了投资于交通基础设施和住宅建设等措施所带来的增长促进作用。
en: The first factor is diminishing returns to capital, which weakened the growth-enhancing effects of, say, investment in transport infrastructure and residential construction.

zh: 另一个原因是，城市土地价格被抬高，而环境的“承载能力”却已经耗尽。
en: Another is that urban land prices have been bid up, while the environment’s “carrying capacity” has been exhausted.

zh: 再就是人口结构方面的问题。
en: Then there are demographic challenges.

zh: 劳动年龄人口数量已经达到顶峰，同时退休年龄人口的比重迅速上升 — — 这主要源自于该国延续35年之久，直到最近才宣告取消的独生子女政策。
en: The working-age population has peaked, and the share of retirement-age population is rising fast – not least because of the country’s 35-year-long one-child policy, which was only recently rescinded.

zh: 此外，曾经看似取之不尽用之不竭的农村剩余劳动力已经基本消失，从而导致工资上升，削弱了该国在劳动密集型产业的竞争优势。
en: Moreover, China’s once seemingly inexhaustible surplus of rural labor willing to migrate to urban areas has largely disappeared, causing wages to rise and the country’s competitive advantage in labor-intensive manufacturing to weaken.

zh: 经济已经从制造业向服务转型，而后者的生产率增长空间较小。
en: The economy has shifted from manufacturing toward services, where there is less scope for productivity growth.

zh: 此外，中国在技术，生产工艺和管理方法上追赶发达经济体的空间不断缩小，进一步削弱了生产力增长 — — 导致中国只能寻求一些自身的创新。
en: Moreover, room for catch-up gains with the developed economies in terms of technology, production processes, and management practices is shrinking, undermining productivity growth further – and leaving it up to China to do some innovating of its own.

zh: 在此背景下，增长率趋向5-7％的转移是自然的。
en: Against this background, a shift to a trend annual growth rate of 5-7% is natural.

zh: 但是，这种转变可以以两种方式发生：一是软着陆，在中国继续维持较慢但​​可持续的增长趋势，或是硬着陆，爆发一场金融危机以及一系列更严重的经济衰退。
en: But that shift can happen in two ways: a soft landing, in which China continues to grow at the slower-but-sustainable trend rate, or a hard landing, involving a financial crisis and more severe economic recession.

zh: 跟日本在1980年代和韩国在1997~1998年的情况类似，中国在其高速增长阶段主要依赖投资和债务融资，提高了经济增长放缓后产能过剩导致金融危机的风险。
en: Like Japan after the 1980s or South Korea in 1997-1998, China has depended significantly on investment and debt financing during its high-growth phase, raising the risk that excess capacity could lead to financial crisis as the economy slows.

zh: 而事实上，产能过剩已经成为了许多行业的严重问题。
en: And, indeed, excess capacity is already a serious problem in many sectors.

zh: 不过，目前还不清楚中国将以何种方式着陆 — — 这不仅是因为官方统计数据可能极大夸大了当前的GDP增长。
en: Still, it is unclear what kind of landing China faces – not least because official statistics may be overstating current GDP growth considerably.

zh: 由于官方增长数据通常与政府定下的目标过于接近所以显得不太可信，怀疑开始转向可以统计的有形经济指标，指出能源消耗，铁路货运量以及如煤炭，钢铁和水泥等工业产品的产量都已大幅放缓。
en: With official growth data usually aligning a little too closely with government targets to be credible, skeptics are turning to other, more tangible measures of economic conditions, pointing out that energy consumption, freight railway traffic, and output of industrial products like coal, steel, and cement has slowed sharply.

zh: 正如许多人推断的那样，这些统计数字可能表明中国经济增长速度显著低于7 ％ ， 远低于政府数据。
en: These statistics could, as many infer, indicate that China’s economy is growing at a rate much lower than the 7% the government claims.

zh: 但是，正如尼古拉斯·拉迪（Nicholas Lardy）令人信服地指出，这些数据可能也反映了经济从重工业向服务业的转换 — — 这正是中国向更可持续发展趋势的自然转换所急需的。
en: But, as Nicholas Lardy persuasively argues, they could also reflect the economy’s shift from heavy manufacturing toward services – a shift that is highly desirable in helping China’s natural transition to the more sustainable trend.

zh: 如果是这样的话，那中国就正在稳步实现软着陆。
en: It is still possible, then, that China is on track for a soft landing.

zh: 但是，成功的前提是减少对投资支出和出口需求的依赖，更倾向国内居民消费以支​​持经济增长。
en: But success presupposes less reliance on investment spending and export demand, and more on domestic household consumption, to support growth.

zh: 此外，中国必须增加土地和劳动力市场的灵活性。
en: Moreover, China must increase the flexibility of land and labor markets.

zh: 例如，不确定的农村土地使用权以及持续阻碍劳动力流动的城市户口制度。
en: For example, insecure land rights in the countryside and the hukou (household registration) system in the cities continue to impede labor mobility.

zh: 更宏观地说，市场在塑造经济中所扮演的作用必须继续增强。
en: More generally, markets’ role in shaping the economy must continue to grow.

zh: 国有企业必须受到限制，卫生保健，社会保障和税收制度必须进行改革和强化。
en: State-owned enterprises must be reined in. The health-care, social-security, and tax systems must be reformed and strengthened.

zh: 而更完善的环境监管则是至关重要的。
en: And better environmental regulation is crucial.

zh: 中国领导人和经济学家已经知道了这一切。
en: Chinese leaders and economists already know all of this.

zh: 他们在2013年制订了涵盖这些领域的改革目标清单。
en: They adopted a list of reform objectives covering these areas in 2013.

zh: 并在过去的两年中在一些方面取得了进展。
en: And in the last two years, they have made progress in implementing some of them.

zh: 但这仍有很长的路要走，也没人能保证一定成功。
en: But there is still a long way to go, and success is by no means guaranteed.

zh: 正如亚洲开发银行首席经济学家魏尚进指出的那样，决定中国经济命运的是这类改革的进展 — — 而非股市的表现。
en: As Shang-Jin Wei, the chief economist of the Asian Development Bank points out, progress on these reforms – not what happens in the stock market – is what will determine the fate of China’s economy.

zh: 中国的意志胜利
en: China’s Triumph of the Will

zh: 莫斯科-当北京奥运会在几天后举行开幕式时，观众们会看到一场经过精心设计的、浸透着民族主义庸俗演出。
en: MOSCOW – When the opening ceremony of the Beijing Olympic Games begins in a few days, viewers will be presented with a minutely choreographed spectacle swathed in nationalist kitsch.

zh: 当然，会让人回想起希特勒迈着正步走的冲锋队的画面绝对不是中国领导人想让人们留下对奥运会的印象；不管怎样，官方的中华民族主义宣扬的是这个国家将依靠田园诗般的“和谐发展”来实现“和平崛起 ” 。
en: Of course, images that recall Hitler’s goose-stepping storm troopers are the last thing that China’s leaders have in mind for their Olympics; after all, official Chinese nationalism proclaims the country’s “peaceful rise” within an idyll of “harmonious development.”

zh: 但是，不管是在美学上还是在政治上，这种描述都不着边际。
en: But, both aesthetically and politically, the parallel is hardly far-fetched.

zh: 事实上，选择希特勒的心腹、1936年柏林奥运会的建筑师和设计师的儿子小阿尔伯特·斯佩尔来设计北京奥运会的总体规划，中国政府本身就暗示了美学的极端政治化正是二十世纪极权主义的一大特征。
en: Indeed, by choosing Albert Speer Jr., the son of Hitler’s favorite architect and the designer of the 1936 Berlin Olympics, to design the master plan for the Beijing Games, China’s government has itself alluded to the radical politicization of aesthetics that was a hallmark of twentieth-century totalitarianism.

zh: 像那些政权一样，不管是法西斯政权或是共产主义政权，中国的领导人一直在寻求将公共场所和体育比赛项目转化成他们能胜任并且授权统治这个国家的可见证明。
en: Like those regimes, whether fascist or communist, China’s leaders have sought to transform public space and sporting events into visible proof of their fitness and mandate to rule.

zh: 小斯佩尔的使命是为进入北京的奥林匹克建筑群的大道制定总体规划。
en: Speer Jr.’s commission was to lay out a master plan for the access to the Olympic complex in Beijing.

zh: 他的设计主要集中在建设一条连接紫禁城与将举行开幕式的国家体育场之间的气势宏伟的大道。
en: His design centered on the construction of an imposing avenue to connect the Forbidden City and the National Stadium in which the opening ceremony will take place.

zh: 而他的父亲为“日尔曼尼亚 ” 、 也就是希特勒为计划在二战后建设的柏林所选择的名称所进行的规划也主要依赖这一宏伟的中轴线。
en: His father’s plan for “Germania,” the name Hitler selected for the Berlin that he planned to construct after World War II, also relied on such a mighty central axis.

zh: 中国的统治者把奥运会看作是他们向世界展示他们在过去三十年所建设起来的这个拥有巨大活力的国家的舞台。
en: China’s rulers see the Olympics as a stage for demonstrating to the world the exceptional vitality of the country they have built over the past three decades.

zh: 而这种展示还带有一种更加重要的国内政治目标：使这个政权的持续统治在普通中国人眼里进一步合法化。
en: And that demonstration serves an even more important domestic political objective: further legitimizing the regime’s continuing rule in the eyes of ordinary Chinese.

zh: 鉴于这一因素，一种高调并且巨型的建筑语言几乎就是不可避免的了。
en: Given this imperative, an architectural language of bombast and gigantism was almost inevitable.

zh: 因此北京奥运会可能与1936年那届欺骗了德国元首兼帝国首相并且迷住了德国普通民众的傲慢的奥运会相类似就并不令人感到奇怪了。
en: So it is no surprise that the Beijing Games may resemble the hubristic Games that beguiled the Führer and enthralled the German masses in 1936.

zh: 像北京奥运会一样，柏林奥运会也被设想成一场亮相的盛会。
en: Like the Beijing Games, the Berlin Olympics were conceived as a coming-out party.

zh: 戈培尔的纳粹宣传机器开足了马力。
en: Josef Goebbels’ Nazi propaganda machine was fully deployed.

zh: 里芬斯塔尔著名的纪录片发扬光大的运动形象似乎在纳粹和古希腊人之间建立起了联系，被用来证明纳粹关于德意志人和德意志文明是古代“雅利安人”文化真正后裔的谎言。
en: Athletic imagery – used to brilliant effect in Leni Riefenstahl’s acclaimed documentary – appeared to create a link between the Nazis and the ancient Greeks, and to confirm the Nazi myth that Germans and German civilization were the true heirs to the “Aryan” culture of classical antiquity.

zh: 在为北京奥运会设计总体规划时，小斯佩尔这位享有盛名的建筑师和城市规划师而像他的父亲一样试图创造一个未来国际大都市。
en: While designing the master plan for the Beijing Games, Speer Jr., an acclaimed architect and town planner, also sought, like his father, to create a futuristic global metropolis.

zh: 当然，他用来向中国人兜售他的规划的语言与他的父亲将他的计划提交给希特勒时所用的语言肯定非常不同。
en: Of course, the language that he used to sell his scheme to the Chinese was very different from the words his father used to present his plans to Hitler.

zh: 小斯佩尔没有过分强调他的设计的壮观性，而是坚称其对环境的友好。
en: Instead of emphasizing his design’s pomposity, the younger Speer insisted on its environmental friendliness.

zh: 拥有2000多年历史的北京应该被转化成一座超现代的城市，而他父亲在1936年对柏林的设计用他的话来说“就是妄自尊大 ” 。
en: The 2,000-year-old city of Beijing should be transported into hyper-modernity, whereas his father’s 1936 Berlin design was, in his words, “simply megalomania.”

zh: 当然，父亲的罪过不应该落到儿子的头上。
en: Of course, the sins of the father should never be visited on the son.

zh: 但是当儿子继承了他的父亲建筑原理的核心思想，并且把它用来服务一个寻求用某些曾驱使希特勒的理由来利用奥运会的政权时，你能说他没有有意地表现那些罪过吗？
en: But, in this case, when the son borrows essential elements of his father’s architectural principles and serves a regime that seeks to use the Games for some of the same reasons that animated Hitler, is he not willingly reflecting those sins?

zh: 极权主义政权，比如纳粹、八十年代的苏联和现在的中国，都渴望把举办奥运会作为向世界标榜它们的优越性的途径。
en: Totalitarian regimes – the Nazis, the Soviets in 1980, and now the Chinese – desire to host the Olympics as a way to signal to the world their superiority.

zh: 中国相信它已经找到了它自己发展和现代化的模式，而它的统治者像纳粹和勃列日涅夫一样，也把奥运会当成将他们的模式“兜售”给全球观众的途径。
en: China believes that it has found its own model to develop and modernize, and its rulers regard the Games in the same way as the Nazis and Leonid Brezhnev did, as a means of “selling” their model to a global audience.

zh: 显然，中国人在选择一位其姓名承载了如此黑暗的历史含意的建筑师时出现了政治上的音盲。
en: Obviously, the Chinese were politically tone-deaf in choosing an architect whose name carried such dark historical connotations.

zh: 斯佩尔这个名字本身对于选择他的那些官员来说也许根本不算什么。
en: The name of Speer itself probably did not matter to the officials who chose him.

zh: 他们寻求的是让奥运会成为展示他们自己形象的舞台，而小斯佩尔，鉴于他的父亲精湛的建筑技艺，能够为他们实现这一目标。
en: They sought to stage an Olympics that made manifest their image of themselves, and Speer Jr., looking back to his father’s mastery of the architecture of power, delivered the goods.

zh: 小斯佩尔以及他的客户的奥运梦想化为现实标志着欢迎插曲的终结。
en: The realization of Speer Jr.’s Olympic vision, and that of his patrons, marks the end of a welcome interlude.

zh: 自从冷战结束后，政治已经远离了奥运会。
en: For years following the end of the Cold War, politics had been removed from the Games.

zh: 一块金牌反映了某个运动员的体育才能和对体育的执着，而不应被认为是造就了他们的政治制度的功劳。
en: A gold medal signified the sporting abilities and dedication of individual athletes, not the supposed merits of the political system that produced them.

zh: 但是现在我们又回到了政治催眠的美学标准中，这反映在主办国宣称中国应该赢得比任何国家都多的金牌。
en: But now we have returned to an aesthetic of political mesmerization, reflected in the host government’s declared aim that China should win more gold medals than any country before.

zh: 奥运火炬传递本身就是由纳粹创造出来的，并且首先是从柏林奥运会开始进行的。 当火炬在小斯佩尔建造的强力大道上行进时，世界将再一次目睹极权主义意志的胜利。
en: As the Olympic torch relay – itself a creation of the Nazis, first employed in the Berlin Games – makes its way down Speer Jr.’s avenue of power, the world will once again be made to witness a triumph of the totalitarian will.

zh: 中国的周边烦心事
en: China’s Trouble with the Neighbors

zh: 北京 — — 中国的“好邻居”政策正在受到前所未有的压力；事实上，中国周边形势正处在冷战结束以来的最低潮。
en: BEIJING – China’s “good neighbor” policy is under unprecedented pressure; indeed, it is at its nadir since the Cold War’s end.

zh: 最近，中国与邻国一再发生摩擦。
en: One after another, frictions with neighboring countries have arisen recently.

zh: 从与越南和菲律宾的南中国海领海之争，到与缅甸和泰国的紧张局势，曾经良好甚至可谓友善的邻邦关系急转直下。
en: From the territorial disputes with Vietnam and the Philippines in the South China Sea to tensions with Burma (Myanmar) and Thailand, relationships that were sound, if not always friendly, have now soured.

zh: 缅甸决定搁置中国支持的密松大坝项目，令中国大为震惊。
en: Myanmar’s decision to shelve the Chinese-backed Myitsone Dam project shocked China.

zh: 此外，10月，13名中国船员在湄公河遇害，此事件不啻当头一击，中国向来稳固的南部边境 — — 已有近20年时间没有发生任何麻烦 — — 现在似乎成了对中国敌意最深的邻邦。
en: Likewise, the killing of 13 Chinese boat crewmen on the Mekong River in October serves as a stark reminder that China’s presumably peaceful southern land border, which has been untroubled for nearly 20 years, today resembles the most hostile sort of neighborhood.

zh: 中国民众和政府对湄公河杀戮事件尤为震惊，这似乎再一次证明，尽管中国的全球地位已经今非昔比，但其政府在保护公民免遭海外屠戮方面依然无能。
en: China’s people and government are especially dismayed by the Mekong killings, which seemed to demonstrate, once again, the government’s inability to protect its citizens from being murdered abroad, despite the country’s newfound global status.

zh: 结果产生了两大引人注目的问题：为什么邻国不把中国的利益放在眼里？
en: As a result, two compelling questions have arisen: Why do China’s neighbors choose to neglect its interests?

zh: 为什么在中国崛起的背景下，当局在保障中国人民海外人身安全和商业利益方面却越来越无能？
en: And why, despite China’s rise, do its authorities seem increasingly unable to secure Chinese lives and commercial interests abroad?

zh: 中国民众对这些问题的焦虑左右着中国的政策氛围。
en: Chinese anxiety about these questions forms the atmosphere shaping Chinese policy.

zh: 随着卡扎菲在利比亚的倒台，中国公司损失了大约200亿美元的投资，而利比亚新政府已经暗示，这笔损失无法弥补。
en: With Muammar el-Qaddafi’s fall from power in Libya, Chinese companies lost investments worth roughly $20 billion, which Libya’s new government has implied are unlikely to be recovered.

zh: 许多中国人对政府决定从利比亚撤侨的决定感到十分不满，他们更愿意留在利比亚，为保护中国商业资产做更大努力。
en: Many Chinese were disquieted by their government’s decision to evacuate China’s citizens from Libya, and would have preferred a bolder effort to protect the countries’ commercial assets there.

zh: 与此类似，随后中国政府的态度突然来了一个大逆转，承认了国家过渡委员会为利比亚政府，国内一片哗然。
en: Similarly, the Chinese government’s later, and quite sudden, about-face in recognizing the rebel Transitional National Council as Libya’s government aroused considerable sneering at home.

zh: 毕竟，在北约干预之初，中国曾下了很大的政治血本反对北约的空袭，然而到了最后，却又支持在北约帮助下夺得政权的反对派。
en: After all, China spent valuable political capital to oppose NATO’s airstrikes at the beginning of the intervention, only to end up backing the forces that NATO helped bring to power.

zh: 中国外交的功利主义和唯利是图尽显无疑。
en: This was China’s utilitarian, commercially-driven diplomacy at its most transparently hollow.

zh: 由于中国实力部署能力有限，对大部分中国人来说，利比亚是个遥远的国度。
en: For most Chinese, Libya is a far-away and out-of-reach country, owing to China’s limited capacity to project power.

zh: 因此强调恢复中国的商业利益即使得不到完全的理解，也可以被勉强接受。
en: So the emphasis on restoring Chinese commercial interests is accepted reluctantly if not completely understood.

zh: 但缅甸和其他湄公河流域国家被认为是中国的“好邻居 ” ， 且完全在中国实力覆盖范围之内，因此公众对中国利益在这些地区受到威胁十分愤怒。
en: But Myanmar and the other Mekong River countries are supposed to be the country’s “good neighbors,” and are completely within reach of Chinese power, so public anger over threats to the country’s interests in these places is intense.

zh: 这些利益包括一条连接缅甸和昆明的新输油管道。
en: Those interests include a new oil pipeline linking Myanmar to Kunming, the provincial capital of Yunnan province.

zh: 此外，中国还在从事不少“连接”工程 — — 即高速公路和铁路网络 — — 以提振中国和东盟国家的经济和社会联系。
en: China is also working on “connectivity” projects – namely, a rail and highway network – aimed at boosting economic and social ties between China and the ASEAN countries.

zh: 现在，密松事件和湄公河事件给这些项目蒙上了一层阴影，激发了人们对产生连锁反应的担忧 — — 中国20年来促进地区一体化的努力可能因此付诸东流。
en: The Myitsone and Mekong incidents have now cast a shadow over these projects, fueling fear of a chain reaction that could wreck China’s two-decade-long effort to achieve deeper regional integration.

zh: 显然，缅甸新政府不愿意激化已然不安定的边境地区的情绪 — — 叛军集团正在利用密松大坝项目召集新的支持者。
en: Obviously, Myanmar’s new government does not want to aggravate sentiment in its already-unstable border areas, where rebel groups were using the dam project to rally new supporters.

zh: 新政府试图与缅甸动荡地区的政治势力分享权力从而削弱地方军阀，这显然也是叫停大坝建设的原因之一。
en: The new government’s effort to share power with political forces in Myanmar’s volatile regions, and thus weaken local warlords, clearly contributed to the decision to halt construction.

zh: 而对大坝的中国投资者而言，他们太过依赖两国双边联系的深度，低估了该项目的政治风险。
en: The dam’s Chinese investors, for their part, relied too heavily on the depth of the two countries’ bilateral ties, and so heavily discounted the project’s political risks.

zh: 他们的行为也反映了政府重商主义的隐性担保，以及中国国有企业 — — 大部分中国海外投资都由国企经手 — — 的目中无人。
en: Their behavior also reflects the implied guarantee of official government mercantilism, as well as the complacency of China’s state-owned enterprises, which account for most Chinese overseas investment.

zh: 他们认为政府会为他们兜底 — — 万一失败必会出手救援 — — 因此态度颇为傲慢。
en: Operating on the assumption that the government will back them – or bail them out if they fail – they can afford to be cavalier.

zh: 湄公河事件则体现出另一大严峻现实。
en: The Mekong incident tells another grim story.

zh: 湄公河流经五个国家，向来以贩毒、赌博、走私等跨国犯罪的温床著称。
en: The river, which links five countries, has been long famous as a setting for trans-national crimes such as drug trafficking, gambling, and smuggling.

zh: 中国经济的繁荣使得其与湄公河流域的地下经济有了越来越多的互动。
en: China’s booming economy has brought growing interaction between China and the Mekong’s underground economies.

zh: 13名中国船员遇害便与这一趋势有关。
en: The killing of the 13 Chinese boat crewmen was linked to this trend.

zh: 但中国避免类似悲剧再现的最好方式不是展示实力，而是促进更大的多边合作，打击湄公河流域的跨国犯罪。
en: But China can best avoid similar tragedies not by flexing its muscles, but by building greater multilateral cooperation to combat transnational crime along the Mekong.

zh: 密松大坝和湄公河事件凸显了中国与其南方邻国关系的急转直下。
en: The Myitsone and Mekong episodes highlight China’s suddenly edgy relations with its southern neighbors.

zh: 中国的好邻居政策正把中国外交导向一个未知领域。
en: Its good-neighbor policy, it turns out, has steered China’s regional diplomacy into uncharted waters.

zh: 事实上，除非中国开始提供必须的公共品 — — 不仅包括商业，还包括基于法治精神、尊重人权和地区经济增长的成熟完善的地区治理 — — 否则其邻国是不会真心实意地位中国利益着想的。
en: Indeed, China’s neighbors will not be reliably good to Chinese interests unless and until China begins to provide essential public goods – not just commerce, but also full-fledged regional governance based on the rule of law, respect for human rights, and regional economic growth.

zh: 否则的话，像密松事件和湄公河事件这样的决裂还会再次发生，加深中国的孤立感和恐惧感。
en: Otherwise, ruptures such as those at Myitsone and along the Mekong will recur, deepening China’s sense of isolation and panic.

zh: 中国经济结构转型之痛
en: China’s Painful Structural Transformation

zh: 上海一年多来，全球经济新闻头条纷纷指向中国经济放缓。
en: SHANGHAI – For more than a year, headlines worldwide have been pointing to a Chinese economic slowdown.

zh: 但近观国内区域经济的增长动态，看到的东西会有所不同 — — 与其说中国经济处于减速期，不如说处于换挡期。
en: But a closer look at regional dynamics within China tells a different story – one that is less about deceleration than changing gears.

zh: 根据中国国家统计局公布的资料，资源丰富的山西省遭遇了经济下滑，但是位于西南部的重庆市和贵州省的经济却增长迅速，生机勃勃。
en: According to China’s National Bureau of Statistics, the resource-rich province of Shanxi has suffered an economic slowdown, but the southwestern provinces of Chongqing and Guizhou have experienced vibrant growth.

zh: 同时，河北省和其他东北三省正在经历经济衰退带来的不良后果，而同样曾是重工业主导的天津市、山东省和江苏省的经济却保持蓬勃发展势头。
en: Hebei and three other northeastern provinces are feeling the effects of recession, but the heavy-industry economies of Tianjin, Shandong, and Jiangsu are booming.

zh: 2008年全球金融危机后，经济增长放缓已成为许多国家的“新常态 ” ， 中国也开始加快经济的再平衡，由原来的制造业和出口转向主要用于国内消费的产品的生产与服务的提供。
en: After the 2008 financial crisis, when slower growth became the “new normal” for many countries, China began to accelerate its economic rebalancing by shifting the drivers of growth from manufacturing and exports toward goods and services for domestic consumption.

zh: 这一转变给中国未来的经济增长动力带来了深远影响。
en: This transition has had far-reaching implications for the future dynamics of China’s economy.

zh: 以前的出口战略中，政府优先考虑的是将国内制造业与全球生产链进行整合。
en: With its previous export strategy, the government’s main priority was to integrate domestic manufacturing operations into global production chains.

zh: 如今的目标则变为满足多样的国内消费需求，并且正是与这些需求紧密相关的产业正在迅猛发展。
en: Now, however, its aim is an economy that meets domestic consumers’ diverse demands, and it is the industries closely connected to those demands that are quickly expanding.

zh: 现今繁荣的这些经济活动长期以来是被归入服务业，而非制造业的，但是服务业并不意味着脱离实际，与世隔绝。
en: Previously, the economic activities that are now flourishing weren’t categorized as manufacturing industries at all, but as “services.” But services do not exist in a vacuum.

zh: 所有的商业活动都需要制造、运输、信息和通信技术、物流、地产、金融、保险等行业配套。
en: All businesses need manufactured products, transportation, information and communications technology (ICT), logistics, real estate, finance, insurance, and more.

zh: 因此，对于新服务的新需求会对基础设施投资和设备投资产生良性循环的效果。
en: Thus, new demand for new services has virtuous-cycle effects in terms of capital investment in infrastructure and equipment.

zh: 不同于传统智慧，服务业的日益增长是为了满足国内消费需求，并不意味着制造业和资本投资的末日，更不意味着经济增长走到尽头。
en: Contrary to the conventional wisdom, the growth of services in China to meet domestic demand does not mean the end of manufacturing and capital investment, much less of economic growth.

zh: 即便不能完全弥补，服务业也在努力更多地弥补由出口导向型制造业产出降低导致的增长失速。
en: Service sectors stand to make up for much, if not all, of the growth lost to lower output in export-oriented manufacturing branches.

zh: 中国在运输、信息和通信技术、金融、保险、地产、教育、健康等行业的劳动生产率长期以来并不高，反倒证明这些行业有着重要的快速增长空间。
en: China’s transportation, ICT, finance, insurance, real estate, education, and health-care sectors have long had inappropriately low labor productivity, which means they have significant room to grow faster.

zh: 经济学家Jong-Wha Lee 和Warwick J. McKibbin在一篇论文中指出，亚洲的服务业生产率增长将“最终使所有行业受益，并有助于亚洲经济体持续、平衡的增长。
en: According to a paper by the economists Jong-Wha Lee and Warwick J. McKibbin, service-sector productivity growth in Asia “benefits all sectors eventually, and contributes to the sustained and balanced growth of Asian economies.”

zh: ” 以韩国的经济发展情况为鉴，他们发现运输、地产和信息和通信技术行业的人均附加值要高于制造业的平均值，同时指出在美国、日本和中国也如此。
en: Examining economic development trends in South Korea, the authors find that the average value added per worker in transportation, real estate, and ICT is now higher than the average in manufacturing, and they point to similar dynamics in the United States, Japan, and China.

zh: 这一发现表明中国服务经济的迅猛发展能够逆转2008年以来由外部冲击造成的不景气。
en: This finding suggests that rapid development in China’s service economy could reverse the externally triggered dampening of growth since 2008.

zh: 然而从日本和韩国从出口转向国内需求导向的增长经验来看，结构转型是一个缓慢而痛苦的过程。
en: But, as the Japanese and South Korean transitions from export to domestic demand-driven growth demonstrate, structural transformation is a slow and painful process.

zh: 中国正处于结构转型中，必须警惕避免经济增长对既存增长源泉的削弱，以免掉入结构性陷阱造成结构转型成本过高，抵消转型的好处。
en: China is in the midst of that process, and it must be careful not to undermine existing sources of growth lest it fall into a structural trap where the cost of transition itself derails new gains.

zh: 而中国多省出现的转型成本高昂拖累了总体的经济增长趋势，这并不是一个好征兆。
en: It is not a good sign that the high costs in many Chinese provinces have been weighing down overall growth.

zh: 尽管中国消费者的规模潜力相当巨大，但是上述情况还是指出了发展前路上面临的基本挑战。
en: This points to fundamental challenges ahead, notwithstanding the significant economic potential of Chinese consumers.

zh: 对于新手而言，基于国内需求多元化的经济增长相较于出口导向型发展更为复杂，因为这些新行业的发展更多倚重于复杂的金融服务、自由公平的市场准入资格、受教育程度更高的劳动者以及对研究开发领域更多的投资。
en: For starters, economic development based on diversified domestic demand is more complicated than export-driven development, because these new sectors rely more heavily on sophisticated financial services, free and equitable market access, better educated workers, and higher investment in research and development.

zh: 因此，转向新增长模型的新业态对中国现存经济治理体系提出远超出其所能承载的要求。
en: As a result, the new businesses emerging from the shift to a new growth model are demanding far more from China’s current economic-governance system than it can bear.

zh: 为解决这些问题，中国的结构性改革还有很长的路要走，即使不会皆大欢喜，这依然要求中国领导人要做出艰难的政治决定。
en: Further structural reforms would go a long way toward fixing this problem, but they will also require China’s leaders to make tough political decisions that won’t please everyone.

zh: 另一项根本挑战是中国的低城市化率，尽管经历了25年的出口拉动型增长，城市化进程依旧步履蹒跚。
en: Another fundamental challenge is China’s slow rate of urbanization, which is still lagging, even after 25 years of export-led growth.

zh: 信息和通信技术、金融、保险、运输、地产，繁荣的服务型经济中每一项主要要素都离不开其他要素的繁荣，而正是城市将这些要素聚拢，即所谓的网络关联外部性现象。
en: Each of a thriving service economy’s major components – ICT, finance, insurance, transportation, and real estate – needs the others to prosper, and cities are what bring them all together – a phenomenon of network externalities.

zh: 不幸的是，中国长期的城乡二元结构体制与不合理的城市规划，已经导致大城市社区碎片化、分散化并缺乏多样化的城市网群，不然大城市社区本应能促进生产率更大的提高。
en: Unfortunately, China’s enduring system of dividing urban and rural regions, together with poor urban planning, has led to fragmented and scattered metropolitan communities without diversified networks that would otherwise have helped boost productivity.

zh: 城市将成为中国经济长期成功发展的核心要素。
en: China’s cities will be a key ingredient of its long-term economic success.

zh: 城市化应当从现在开始提速，并且未来10到15年间城市规模应当配合服务拉动型经济增长而进行扩张。
en: Urbanization should start accelerating today, and over the next 10-15 years, with the expansion of metropolitan areas geared toward the needs of services-led economic growth.

zh: 如果中国能够跨越这个挑战，将更有利于为迈向高收入国家扫清现存障碍。
en: If China can rise to that challenge, it will be well positioned to clear the remaining hurdles in its path toward high-income status.

zh: 中国的下一轮刺激政策
en: China’s Next Stimulus

zh: 发自北京 — — 从去年十一月以来，经济学家和媒体都都在为供应侧结构改革大唱赞歌，视之为破除中国经济困境的开创性解决方案。
en: BEIJING – Since last November, economists and the media alike have been hailing supply-side structural reform as a groundbreaking solution to China’s economic woes.

zh: 说到底，在中国人眼里以凯恩斯主义刺激形式存在的需求侧政策只能解决短期和数量问题。
en: After all, the logic in China goes, demand-side policies, in the form of Keynesian stimulus measures, are useful only for resolving short-term and aggregate problems.

zh: 既然当前的问题是长期和结构性的，那么国家就该聚焦在供应侧的结构改革，即使GDP增速放缓也在所不惜。
en: Because China’s problems are long term and structural, the country should be focused on supply-side structural reform, even if it means accepting slower GDP growth.

zh: 不过这个做法就是对的吗？
en: Is this the right approach?

zh: GDP增长是通过经济的供给侧和需求侧之间的相互作用来推动的。
en: GDP growth is generated via the interaction between the supply side and the demand side of the economy.

zh: 比如说在人力资本上的投资能驱动创新，而创新产生的产品反过来又创造了需求 — — 以及经济增长。
en: For example, investment in human capital enables innovation, the products of which create demand and, in turn, economic growth.

zh: 需求侧政策和结构性调整不是相互排斥的。
en: Demand-side policy and structural adjustment are not mutually exclusive.

zh: 从总体来看，供应增长决定了增长潜力，而需求的增长则决定了这一潜力如何付诸现实。
en: In aggregate terms, growth of supply determines growth potential, and growth of demand determines the use of that potential.

zh: 要转变经济结构和增长模式的话，首先就得改变需求的结构。
en: To change the economic structure and growth pattern, first the structure of demand must be changed.

zh: 对中国来说，应该主要由创新和创造来驱动供应侧，而非以增加投入为主。
en: For China, the supply side should be driven more by innovation and creation, rather than by increasing inputs.

zh: 在需求侧，主力应该是国内消费，而非投资（尤其是房地产）和出口。
en: On the demand side, it should be driven more by domestic consumption, rather than investment (especially in real estate) and exports.

zh: 但这种转换遇到了难题，因为结构性因素导致中国的长期潜在增长率下降；目前看来今年的经济甚至还要低于这个已经调低的增长率水平。
en: But this shift is proving difficult, as structural factors cause China’s long-term potential growth rate to fall; the economy now seems set to fall below even that lower rate this year.

zh: 所有这些都表明中国需要持续实施结构调整。
en: All of this suggests that continued structural adjustment is needed in China.

zh: 但现实是中国一直都在实施这类调整，搞了很长时间，结果却不尽人意，说明可能需要执行需求侧政策作为补充。
en: But the reality is that China has been engaged in such adjustment for a long time, with unsatisfactory results, indicating that complementary demand-side policies may be needed.

zh: 此外，尽管经济增长会因调整而不可避免地放缓，中国对最低增长速度的接受程度是有下限的。
en: Moreover, while slower growth is unavoidable because of adjustment, there is a limit to how low a growth rate China can accept.

zh: 由于在2015年已经出现了25年来最低的增长率，离这道底线的距离可能并不遥远了。
en: With China’s growth having already reached a 25-year low in 2015, that threshold may not be far off.

zh: 实际上许多人认为中国的增长率将在2016年下半年企稳。
en: To be sure, many believe that China’s growth rate will stabilize in the second half of 2016.

zh: 如果确实如此的话，中国的领导人可能会聚焦在结构调整上而不考虑额外的刺激。
en: If it does, China’s leaders could probably concentrate on structural adjustment, without considering additional stimulus.

zh: 但也有充分的理由相信中国经济的增速将在今年继续下滑。
en: But there is good reason to believe that China’s growth rate will continue to decline this year.

zh: 事实上中国仍然笼罩在通货紧缩的阴云之下，价格和产量双双处于下降通道。
en: The fact is that China remains gripped by deflation, with prices and output in a downward spiral.

zh: 尽管消费者价格指数（CPI）稍显正面，但生产者价格指数（PPI）却已连续下跌了47个月。
en: Despite a slightly positive consumer price index (CPI), the producer price index (PPI) has been falling for 47 months in a row.

zh: 同时GDP平减物价指数自2015年开始一直为负。
en: Moreover, the GDP deflator has been negative since the beginning of 2015.

zh: 目前中国出现了两种类型的通货紧缩螺旋效应。
en: Two types of deflation spirals are currently at work in China.

zh: 一是产能过剩-通货紧缩螺旋：产能过剩压低了生产者价格指数，导致企业的盈利能力下降。
en: There is the overcapacity-deflation spiral, in which overcapacity pushes down PPI, leading to falling corporate profitability.

zh: 二是债务-通货紧缩螺旋：生产者价格指数下降导致实际债务上升，再次削弱了企业的盈利能力。
en: Then there is the debt-deflation spiral, in which falling PPI causes real debt to rise, again weakening corporate profitability.

zh: 在这两种情况下公司只得去杠杆化并减少投资，从而导致更多的产能过剩和生产者价格指数的进一步下滑。
en: In both cases, firms are driven to deleverage and reduce investment, a response that leads to more overcapacity and further declines in PPI.

zh: 此外，鉴于中国的企业负债水平已经极高，实际债务的增加可能会对金融稳定形势造成灾难性的后果。
en: Furthermore, given that China’s corporate debt is already very high, the increase in real debt may have devastating consequences for financial stability.

zh: 令中国面临的挑战进一步复杂化的是经济的主要需求侧驱动力（房地产投资）比处于上升阶段的替代来源（国内消费）下降得更为迅速。
en: Compounding the challenge confronting China is the fact that the economy’s major demand-side driver, real-estate investment, is declining more rapidly than the alternative source of demand, domestic consumption, is rising.

zh: 2015年全国住宅未售出面积为7亿平方米（折合75亿平方英尺 ） ， 而在正常年份的年均销售面积为13亿平方英尺。
en: In 2015, the unsold residential floor space for China as a whole was 700 million square meters (7.5 billion square feet), while the average annual sale of floor space in normal times was 1.3 billion square meters.

zh: 面对两位数的库存增长，房地产开发商只得大幅削减投资。
en: Faced with double-digit growth in inventory, real-estate developers slashed investment.

zh: 截至2015年底，房地产投资增速下跌到几乎为零。
en: By the end of 2015, real-estate investment growth dropped almost to zero.

zh: 尽管投资额在今年一、二月有所增加，但这一速度几乎肯定会进一步显著下跌。
en: This year, though investment increased somewhat in January and February, that rate is almost certain to fall significantly further.

zh: 由于房地产投资占中国GDP的比重超过10 ％ ， 这一趋势对整体经济增长的影响将极为巨大。
en: Because real-estate investment accounts for more than 10% of China’s GDP, the impact of this trend on overall economic growth will be considerable.

zh: 在此背景下，摆在中国面前的并不是究竟该选择凯恩斯主义刺激还供应侧改革，而是如何平衡这两者。
en: In this context, China is not facing a choice between Keynesian stimulus or supply-side reform, but rather a challenge in balancing the two.

zh: 如果要避免一场令结构性调整非常难以实施的经济硬着陆 — — 就得推动成长 — — 就需要另一项通过基础设施投资刺激来提高总需求的方案。
en: In order to avoid a hard landing that would make structural adjustment extremely difficult to implement – not, it should be noted, to prop up growth – another stimulus package that increases aggregate demand through infrastructure investment is needed.

zh: 鉴于中国的财政状况仍然较为强健，这样的政策是完全可行的。
en: Given that China’s fiscal position remains relatively strong, such a policy is entirely feasible.

zh: 新经济刺激计划的设计和实施应当比2008年实施的4万亿（折合5860亿美元）政策更为严谨。
en: The new stimulus package should be designed and implemented with much more care than the CN¥4 trillion ($586 billion) package that China introduced in 2008.

zh: 在正确的投资下，中国才能改善其经济结构，同时有助于消除产能过剩。
en: With the right investments, China can improve its economic structure, while helping to eliminate overcapacity.

zh: 其成功的关键是主要利用政府债券而非银行信贷来为项目融资。
en: The key will be to finance projects mainly with government bonds, instead of bank credit.

zh: 这样一来，中国就可以避免再次出现过去几年间的那种资产泡沫 — — 信贷快速增长，却未能支持实体经济。
en: That way, China can avoid the kinds of asset bubbles that swelled in the last several years, when rapid credit growth failed to support the real economy.

zh: 为配合这种方式，中国的人民银行应及时调整货币政策以降低政府债券收益率。
en: To accommodate this approach, the People’s Bank of China should adjust monetary policy to lower government-bond yields.

zh: 具体来说，应该将货币政策的中期目标从扩大货币供应量转为降低基准利率。
en: Specifically, it should shift the intermediate target of monetary policy from expanding the money supply to lowering the benchmark interest rate.

zh: 当然，为了维护货币政策的独立性，中国必须去除对人民币汇率的束缚。
en: Needless to say, in order to uphold monetary-policy independence, China has to remove the shackles from the renminbi exchange rate.

zh: 结构调整仍是中国的未来依然至关重要，也应当准备好承担这一过程的痛苦。
en: Structural adjustment remains absolutely critical to China’s future, and the country should be prepared to bear the pain of that process.

zh: 但在目前情况下，单凭一侧的政策手段不会生效。
en: But, under current circumstances, a one-dimensional policy approach will not work.

zh: 扩张性的财政政策和宽松的货币政策也会对中国迈向更稳定且可持续的增长道路发挥重要作用。
en: Expansionary fiscal policy and accommodative monetary policy also have an important role to play in placing China on a more stable and sustainable growth path.

zh: 超越结构改革
en: Beyond Structural Reform in China

zh: 香港—2016年上半年中国的经济增长平均为6.7 % ， 这让全球市场舒了一口气。
en: HONG KONG – Global markets have breathed a sigh of relief.

zh: 在英国投票退出欧盟的冲击后，中国的GDP数据表明其经济似乎已经摆脱衰退。
en: Following the shock of the United Kingdom’s vote to exit the European Union, GDP data indicate that China’s economy seems to have escaped a slump, with annual growth averaging 6.7% in the first half of 2016.

zh: 但这并不意味着中国经济已经安全着陆，确保可持续长期增长所需要的结构再平衡能否成功还远未确定。
en: But that does not mean that China is in the clear. On the contrary, the success of the structural rebalancing that China needs to ensure sustainable long-term growth is far from certain.

zh: 国家主席习近平领导的中国政府对于结构改革可谓尽心尽力，知道不能再依靠刺激短期需求来挺增长。
en: To be sure, President Xi Jinping’s government is committed to structural reform. China’s leaders know that they can no longer rely on stimulating short-term demand.

zh: 今年头半年，固定资产投资增长已经下降了2.4个百分点至9 % ， 民营部门的固定资产投资增长率更是只有2.8 % 。
en: Already this year, annual growth in fixed-capital investment has fallen by 2.4 percentage points, to 9%, with the private-sector investment up by just 2.8%.

zh: 中央政府的计划是实施供给侧改革以提振生产率、改善市场和政府的运行效率。
en: The plan now is to implement supply-side structural reforms aimed at boosting productivity and improving the functioning of both the market and the state.

zh: 但是，考虑到中国的规模和多样性 — — 更不用说其深深融入全球经济的状况 — — 在各个地区、部门和社会群体中沟通和实施新政策并不容易。
en: But, given China’s size and diversity, not to mention its deep integration into the global economy, communicating and implementing new policies across regions, sectors, and social groups will be very difficult.

zh: 中国要想成功，其决策层可能需要跳出中国传统的自上而下的施政习惯。
en: If China is to succeed, its leaders will need to think beyond their traditional top-down approach.

zh: 30年前，邓小平用“放权让利”的口号成功地激励了地方官员、国有企业和后来的民营企业家接受市场化改革。
en: Some 30 years ago, Deng Xiaoping used the slogan “delegating power and sharing dividends” to motivate local officials, state-owned enterprises (SOEs), and soon-to-be private entrepreneurs to embrace market-oriented reforms.

zh: 如今，中国可能还需要类似的激励来应对当前的挑战：即解决由不完美官僚体系监管的不完美但却快速扩张的市场所造成的新问题。
en: A similar approach could work today, as China’s leaders attempt to address the problems generated by the rapid expansion of imperfect markets managed by an imperfect bureaucracy.

zh: 中国现在面临的市场发展中的新问题包括地方政府和国有企业杠杆过高、制造业产能过剩、房地产库存过剩、生产成本上升、腐败、不平等性、环境破坏以及科技创新不足。
en: Among the main problems China faces are over-leveraged local governments and SOEs, manufacturing overcapacity, excessive real-estate inventory, rising production costs, corruption, inequality, environmental degradation, and inadequate technological innovation.

zh: 供给侧结构改革就是为了解决这些新问题，以便形成更加可持续、包容、开放和高效的经济。
