en: Supply-side structural reform is intended to address these problems, producing a more sustainable, inclusive, open, and efficient economy.

zh: 但光靠宏观层面的政策可能不足以解决供给侧结构问题，因为这些问题常常与微观层面的商业与监管模式有关，例如，市场与监管效率都太低而无法保持足够的增长率。
en: But macro-level solutions alone might not be adequate to address supply-side structural problems, which often relate to the micro-level failure of business models, say, to produce adequate growth or productivity.

zh: 事实上，在成熟的市场经济中，这些问题主要靠微观层面的企业自身解决，也许一些地方政府与行业监管部门需要参与。
en: And, in fact, in a mature market economy, those problems are addressed largely by businesses themselves, perhaps with the involvement of municipal governments.

zh: 但是，在中国，国家层面的政策对商业模式及市场监管影响巨大，最显而易见的例子就是国有企业。
en: In China, however, national policy shapes business models, most obviously in the case of the SOEs.

zh: 这造成了许多利益冲突，导致政府难以同时平衡增长、就业、效率和社会稳定等多重使命。
en: That creates conflicts of interest, with the government struggling to balance the imperatives of growth, employment, efficiency, and social stability.

zh: 在中国的部分地区，供给侧结构问题正在微观层面被不断解决。
en: In some parts of China, supply-side structural problems are being addressed on the micro level.

zh: 例如，在广东省佛山市和深圳市，民营部门和地方政府正在相对有效地处理这些问题。
en: In the cities of Foshan and Shenzhen in Guangdong province, the private sector and local governments are dealing relatively effectively with such issues.

zh: 结果，他们的业绩比其他地区要好得多，这很能说明问题。
en: And, tellingly, they have performed significantly better than the rest of the country.

zh: 今年上半年，广东省GDP增长7.4 % ， 而全国为6.7 % 。
en: In the first half of this year, Guangdong’s GDP grew by 7.4%, compared to the 6.7% national rate.

zh: 广东民营固定资产投资增长19.6 % ， 而全国为2.8 % 。
en: Private fixed-capital investment in the province grew by 19.6%, compared to the 2.8% economy-wide figure.

zh: 广东的经验对于中国决策层应该采取什么策略来解决全国各地的供给侧结构问题提供了重要启示。
en: This provides important insight into the approach that China’s leaders must take to addressing supply-side structural problems throughout the country.

zh: 正如提高官僚效率对于更有效地引导市场力量至关重要，微观层面的市场激励对于维持健康的经济增长也是必不可少的。
en: Just as increased bureaucratic efficiency is important to harness market forces more effectively, micro-level market incentives are needed to sustain healthy growth.

zh: 对于一个长期依赖中央政府管控经济的国家，政府与市场的关系极其复杂。
en: For a country that has long relied on state control over the economy, this complicates matters significantly.

zh: 不但市场在不同地区和部门的运行状况大相径庭，政府与市场的互动也会经历重大变化。
en: Not only are there considerable differences in how markets work in different regions and sectors; the interaction between the state and these markets will undergo major changes.

zh: 这可能导致影响深远的政策模糊，导致官员、学者、企业家和公众的紧张和误解。
en: That can create far-reaching ambiguity, leading to tensions and confusion among officials, scholars, businesspeople, and the public.

zh: 对中国顶级房地产开发商万科公司的敌意收购很能说明这一问题。
en: This issue was evident in the hostile takeover of China’s top real-estate developer, Vanke.

zh: 收购过程导致了现任管理层、一个民营投资集团和一家国有企业股东之间的纠纷。 另一个例子是国有企业东北特钢公司票据违约事件，该事件导致辽宁省政府、国家开发银行和许多其他投资者之间的纠纷。
en: The process has involved disputes among the incumbent executives, a private investment fund, and an SOE shareholder, as well as a default on corporate bonds issued by the state-owned Dongbei Special Steel that has spurred disputes among the Liaoning provincial government, the China Development Bank, and many other investors.

zh: 市场不知道如何应对包括多个与政府相关的利益相关方的产权纠纷。
en: Markets do not know how to react to property-rights disputes that involve this many layers of government.

zh: 要最小化不确定性，制度改革必不可少。
en: To minimize uncertainty, institutional reforms are needed.

zh: 具体而言，中央和地方当局必须明确土地、资本和自然资源等方面的产权，并确立行业标准和最佳实践。
en: Specifically, the central and local authorities must clearly delineate property rights with regard to land, capital, and natural resources, and establish industrial standards and best practices.

zh: 这种产权明确化过程对于遏制产权纠纷激增至关重要，而产权纠纷的激增又会阻挠能提高生产率的市场导向的产权调整。
en: Such clarity is critical to curtail a surge in disputes over rights, which block productivity-enhancing market-oriented adjustments.

zh: 当然，产权纠纷还是会不断发生，并且会以中国司法体系难以处理的规模与速度发生。
en: Of course, disputes would still occur, and on a scale that China’s legal system is not equipped to handle.

zh: 要想迅速处理这些纠纷 — — 从而遏制可能因为产权冲突升级而导致的社会和经济动荡 — — 中国需要建立可靠、低成本和独立的纠纷解决机制，并将具体的经济利益纠纷的解决与实现更广泛的政治和社会目标相对隔离。
en: To resolve them quickly – and thus to deter the social and economic instability that could arise from escalating conflicts – China needs reliable, affordable, and independent mechanisms that separate specific economic interests from broader political and social objectives.

zh: 与此同时，中国需要培育微观层面的竞争，这可以通过发展面向中小企业的资产交易平台和相关金融服务来实现。
en: At the same time, China will need to cultivate micro-level competition, by developing exchange platforms and related financial services for small and medium-size enterprises.

zh: 一旦摆脱破坏激励的金融抑制，这些企业不但能够为增长和发展做出贡献，还有助于推进必要的市场结构调整。
en: Free of incentive-crushing financial repression, such firms would be able not only to contribute to growth and development, but also to help propel the needed market adjustments.

zh: 有理由相信中国的供给侧再平衡正在朝正确的方向前进。
en: There is reason to believe that China’s supply-side rebalancing is moving in the right direction.

zh: 但除非中国决策层同时处理好市场和官僚效率低下所带来的挑战，强劲可持续的增长目标并不容易实现。
en: But unless China’s leaders also tackle the challenges posed by market and bureaucratic inefficiencies, the objective of strong and sustainable growth will remain out of reach.

zh: 绿化中国的金融体系
en: Greening China’s Financial System

zh: 北京—中国成立亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行）加剧了关于是否需要由新兴国家领导的新一代开发银行来确保金融决定充分考虑环境可持续增长原则的争论。
en: BEIJING – China’s establishment of the Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) has intensified debate about whether a new generation of development banks, led by emerging countries, is needed to ensure that financing decisions account adequately for principles of environmentally sustainable growth.

zh: 但是，远为重要的是这些原则是否巩固了发展中国家的总体资本市场的基础。 发展中国家资本市场在国际金融体系中的核心作用正在日益显现。
en: Far more important, however, is whether such principles underpin developing countries’ broader capital markets, which have become increasingly central to the international financial system.

zh: 从目前看，答案似乎是肯定的。
en: The answer, as of now, seems to be yes.

zh: 事实上，中国和其他主要新兴经济体致力于设计服务于包容性、可持续发展的长期目标的金融体系。
en: Indeed, China and other major emerging economies appear committed to designing financial systems that serve the long-term imperatives of inclusive and sustainable development.

zh: 但它们无法单枪匹马建立真正的包容性、可持续的全球经济。
en: But they cannot create a genuinely inclusive and sustainable global economy alone.

zh: 对于这方面的努力，政策导向投资载体 — — 近几年来，这类机构数量和重要性不断增加 — — 至关重要。
en: Policy-directed investment vehicles, which have grown in number and significance in recent years, are critical to this effort.

zh: 亚投行和即将成立的由金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）经营的新开发银行的国际化特征最为明显，但它们只是冰山一角。
en: While the AIIB and the forthcoming New Development Bank, operated by the BRICS countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa), are the most visible internationally, they are only the tip of the iceberg.

zh: 世界上规模最大的两家开发银行 — — 巴西开发银行和中国国家开发银行 — — 加起来管理着大约1.5万亿美元的资产。
en: The world’s two largest development banks – the Brazilian Development Bank and the China Development Bank – together manage about $1.5 trillion in assets.

zh: 主权财富基金也对全球资产市场具有重要影响。 主权财富基金资产规模已从2007年的略高于3万亿美元膨胀到今天的7万亿美元。
en: Sovereign wealth funds – the assets of which have swelled from just over $3 trillion in 2007 to more than $7 trillion today – also have a significant influence on global asset markets.

zh: 类似地，货币当局也一直在扮演日益积极的角色，主要央行资产负债表规模从2005年的5.5万亿美元左右扩大到今年早些时候的13.9万亿美元。
en: Likewise, monetary authorities have been playing an increasingly active role, with the major central banks’ balance sheets having expanded from about $5.5 trillion in 2005 to $13.9 trillion earlier this year.

zh: 但这些数字固然巨大，与商业银行、机构投资者和其他私人金融机构和个人所持有的305万亿美元金融资产相比只是九牛一毛。
en: But such figures, though large, pale in comparison with the $305 trillion worth of financial assets held by commercial banks, institutional investors, and other private financial institutions and individuals.

zh: 这些资金如何配置将决定未来经济的格局和我们所生活的环境的状况。
en: How these funds are deployed will determine the shape of tomorrow’s economies and the state of the environment on which they depend.

zh: 联合国环境署的最新报告用两个关键数据点简洁地总结了我们的状况：去年全球可再生能源投资增长17 % ， 140个注册国家中有116个自然资本存量出现了恶化。
en: Recent reports commissioned by the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) neatly summarize where we are with two key data points: While global investment in renewables increased by 17% last year, 116 of 140 countries registered a deterioration in their stock of natural capital.

zh: 换句话说，金融市场正在响应与环境有关的风险和机会，但速度远远不足以停止人类活动可能导致的灾难性破坏，更不用说扭转这一局面了。
en: In other words, financial markets are responding to environment-related risks and opportunities, but far too slowly to halt, let alone reverse, the potentially catastrophic damage being wrought by human activity.

zh: 这必须有所改变。
en: This must change.

zh: 需要更迅速、更果断地将融资从自然资源密集型和污染性投资引向绿色机会。
en: Finance needs to be directed more rapidly and decisively away from natural-resource-intensive and polluting investments and toward green opportunities.

zh: 绿色经济和产业政策至关重要，但仍有欠缺；政策和金融经济的市场失灵也必须纠正。
en: While greener economic and industrial policies are vital, they are inadequate; policy and market failures in the financial economy must be addressed as well.

zh: 经合组织国家是现代史上最严重的金融崩溃的始作俑者，但对于推进可持续性作为金融体系设计的基本原则，它们并没有什么兴趣（英格兰银行对于与环境有关的金融业风险的审慎态度是一个显著例外 ） 。
en: The OECD countries, despite being the source of modern history’s most devastating financial meltdown, have shown less appetite to advance sustainability as a design principle of their financial systems (the Bank of England’s ongoing prudential review of climate-related risks to the financial sector is a notable exception).

zh: 这与一些发展中国家的���针形成了鲜明对比，后者不但面临更紧迫的环境和社会挑战，还采取了关于金融体系作用的“发展”观。
en: This contrasts with the approach of some developing economies, which not only face more immediate environmental and social challenges, but also take a “developmental” view of the financial system’s role.

zh: 以中国为例。 中国人民银行成立的工作组刚刚发布了14项宏大的方案以“绿化”中国金融体系。
en: Consider China, where a task force created by the Peoples’ Bank of China has just unveiled 14 ambitious proposals to green the country’s financial system.

zh: 所谓的“绿色金融工作组 ” — —由中国人民银行研究局和联合国环境署可持续金融体系设计选择调查（Inquiry into Design Options for a Sustainable Financial System）联合组建 — — 最初由40名部长、监管官员、学者和金融活动家组成，并由国际专家支持。
en: The so-called “green finance task force” – co-convened by the PBOC’s Research Bureau and the UNEP Inquiry into Design Options for a Sustainable Financial System – initially comprised 40 ministers, regulators, academics, and financial actors, supported by international experts.

zh: 如今该工作组已包括100多家机构，共同致力于为每一项方案制定详细的执行计划。
en: It was recently expanded to include more than 100 institutions, which are working together to create detailed execution plans for each proposal.

zh: 方案涵盖了四大领域。
en: The proposals cover four broad areas.

zh: •         支持绿色投资的国内和国际专业化投资载体。
en: • Specialized investment vehicles to support green investment, domestically and internationally.

zh: •         财政和金融支持，包括绿色贷款利息补贴、发展绿色债券市场的激励、设计更加良好的机制以支持绿色企业在股市中披露它们的环境业绩。
en: • Fiscal and financial support, including interest subsidies for green loans, incentives for developing the green bond market, and better mechanisms for green firms to communicate their environmental performance in equity markets.

zh: •         新金融基础设施，包括碳排市场、绿色评级体系和绿色投资者网络。
en: • New financial infrastructure, including carbon markets, a green ratings system, and a green investor network.

zh: •         法律基础设施，包括更加明确的贷款人责任条款、强制性环境责任保险、环境信息的披露等。
en: • Legal infrastructure, including clearer lender liability provisions, compulsory environmental liability insurance, and the disclosure of environmental information.

zh: 中国的绿色金融正处于初级阶段，全球范围亦然。
en: Green finance is at an early stage in China, just as it is in the rest of the world.

zh: 幸运的是，根据联合国环境署对绿色金融和资本市场政策选择的为期两年的调查，绿色金融运动正在巴西、肯尼亚和印度尼西亚等新兴国家以及英国等发达经济体赢得动力。
en: Fortunately, according to UNEP’s two-year inquiry into policy options for greening financial and capital markets, the movement is gaining traction in emerging countries such as Brazil, Kenya, and Indonesia, as well as developed economies like the United Kingdom.

zh: 中国的新举动标志着其金融市场发展的新阶段，绿色金融目标将是核心措施而不再只是一个附加项。
en: China’s recent move marks the beginning of a new phase of its financial-market development, in which green-finance goals are central, rather than an add-on, to relevant initiatives.

zh: 据中国人民银行副行长潘功胜透露，绿色金融将是“中国金融业改革和发展十三五规划”的“关键要素”
en: According to Pan Gongsheng, the PBOC’s deputy governor, green finance will be a “key element” of “the 13th Five-Year Plan for the reform and development of China’s financial sector.”

zh: 发展中国家当前向绿色金融转变的趋势具有重要的国际影响。
en: The current shift toward green finance in developing countries can have a significant international impact.

zh: 特别是中国，随着其全球金融重要性的日益增加，它的措施可以推动世界走向临界点。
en: China’s efforts, in particular, could take the world to a tipping point, through their effects on the country’s growing global financial footprint.

zh: 而事实上，国际行动 — — 从知识共享到制定合理的标准和监督 — — 对于推进绿色金融至关重要。
en: And, indeed, international action – from knowledge sharing to the development of suitable standards and oversight – is vital to advance green finance.

zh: 幸运的是，这方面也正在取得进展。
en: Fortunately, progress is being made here, too.

zh: 联合国环境署的工作有助于推动一个包括央行和其他规则制定者和市场行动者在内的充满活力的非正式网络。
en: UNEP’s work has helped to invigorate a vibrant informal network involving central banks and other rule-makers and market actors.

zh: 主要评级机构标准普尔正在其主权信用分析中加入环境风险因素。
en: The major rating agency Standard & Poor’s is integrating climate risks into its sovereign-credit analysis.

zh: G-20最近也要求金融稳定委员会（Financial Stability Board）考虑潜在的“碳泡沫 ” — —其根源在于，因为没有考虑未来开采和使用极限，市场高估了化石燃料公司的石油、煤炭和天然气储量 — — 给全球金融体系造成的风险。
en: And the G-20 recently asked the Financial Stability Board to consider the risks that a possible “carbon bubble” – caused by markets’ overvaluation of fossil-fuel companies’ oil, coal, and gas reserves, owing to a failure to account for future limits on extraction and use – pose to the global financial system.

zh: 进步国家的领导和国际合作 — — 再加上国际机构的深度参与 — — 是构建更包容的绿色全球金融体系的必要条哦见。
en: Progressive national leadership and international coalitions – together with more deeply engaged multilateral institutions – are needed to build a more inclusive green global financial system.

zh: 唯有这样一个体系能够有效推进可持续发展。
en: Only such a system can effectively advance sustainable development.

zh: 中国的政策转变
en: China’s U-Turn

zh: 北京－最近在北京结束的全国人民代表大会，充满了希望和危险的碰撞。
en: BEIJING – Hope and danger collided at the recently concluded National People’s Congress in Beijing.

zh: 中国每年都会召开为期两周的全国人民代表会，虽然将这一大会描述成橡皮图章是不公平、不准确的，但是基本上，全国人民代表大会的代表们都会对中央政府和中国共产党确定的政策，表示支持。
en: The two-week conclave meets annually, and while it is unfair and inaccurate to characterize the Congress as a rubber-stamp exercise, delegates tend, in the main, to jump on the bandwagon of policies constructed by the central government, and by the Communist Party.

zh: 人们对此次会议抱有的希望是，中国领导层最终会采取一些措施 — — 最好是大胆的措施 — — 来阻止中国主要经济指标的进一步下滑。
en: The hope was that the Chinese leadership would finally do something – preferably something bold – to forestall further decline in the country’s major economic indicators.

zh: 中国经济增长已经放缓，出口急剧回落，失业率大幅上升，而且其主流的观点认为 ， “ 先责怪美国”的策略是很有道理的。
en: Growth has slowed, exports have plummeted, and unemployment has jumped, and the prevailing view has been that a “blame America first” strategy makes the most sense.

zh: 分析人士一直在等待中国官员先提出挽救中国经济的详细计划，并借此来挽救资本主义。
en: Analysts kept waiting for Chinese officials to salvage capitalism by spelling out a plan to save its economy first.

zh: 此次会议中存在的危险是，中国领导人正是这样做的。
en: The danger is that this is exactly what China’s leaders did.

zh: 中国政府官员在许多问题上存在分歧，但是，他们强烈而且观点鲜明的一致认为，中国必须要有一个强有力的刺激经济一揽子计划来防止更多的人失去工作，否则，中国的社会稳定就会处于危险之中。
en: China’s government is divided on a number of matters, but there is a strong, sharp-edged consensus that social stability is at risk unless a robust stimulus package emerges to stave off further job loss.

zh: （尽管中国缺乏失业和社会动荡之间存在明确的因果关系的历史证据 ） 。
en: (Never mind that Chinese history lacks evidence of a clear, causal connection between unemployment and national unrest.)

zh: 中国总理温家宝证实，为了推广和实施以前宣布的四万亿人民币的经济刺激计划，中国政府作出了重大的努力，而且，如果中国的经济形势进一步恶化，中国政府会投入更多的资金来经济刺激。
en: Premier Wen Jiabao confirmed that a major effort was being made to extend and implement the previously announced four-trillion-yuan plan, and that more funds were available if conditions worsened.

zh: 有关中国刺激经济一揽子计划的范围的数据 — — 例如，每个省的投资数量，新项目的数量与那些追加资金就可以重新启动或振兴的项目的数量的对比（以及这些项目和那些会关停的项目的数量的对比 ） — —很难确定。
en: Data on the scope of the stimulus package – for example, investment per province or the number of new projects versus those that more cash would restart or reinvigorate (and these projects versus those that would be shut down) – are difficult to determine.

zh: 中国官方数据的透明度和连续性，远远滞后于中国政府对改革政府、简化官僚机构以及收缩中国共产党政党机构所作的夸大的承诺。
en: The transparency and consistency of official figures lags well behind the authorities’ hyped promises about government reform, streamlining of the bureaucracy, and the retreat of the Party apparatus.

zh: 而且，现在不是我们对中国经济刺激计划 不 知情的东西让人感觉棘手，而是我们已经知道了的东西令人觉得如此。
en: Still, it is not what we don’t know about the stimulus plan that is troublesome.

zh: 中国政府和任何其他政府一样，容易受到政治操纵和政策僵局的影响，它似乎认为立即见效的经济增长至关重要，而且8%的年经济增长率对中国来说非常关键。
en: China’s government, as prone to political maneuvering and policy gridlock as any, appears to agree that immediate economic growth is crucial and that an 8% annual rate is essential.

zh: 许多中国官员（以及支持他们的分析人士和顾问）认为，8%这一神奇的数字代表了为中国的工人和管理人员提供工作机会、吸收每年从中国校园进入社会的超过6百万寻找工作的应届毕业生所需的最低比率。
en: Many officials (and the analysts and advisers who support them) assumed that this magic number represents the minimum rate needed to provide jobs to workers and managers and absorb the more than six million new graduates who spill out of China’s campuses each year in search of employment.

zh: 中国8%的经济增长目标肯定会实现，因为在中国，政府确定的目标总是实现了，并且经常是超额完成。
en: That 8% target will be met, because in China directed objectives are always attained, and often exceeded.

zh: 毕竟，中国官员的政治前途是建立在认同中央政府的要求上的。
en: After all, political careers depend on acceding to the demands of the central government.

zh: 虽然中国对需要国家强力推行以达到官方确定的目标的经济政策的依赖程度，已经减弱了。
en: And yet China’s reliance on economic policies that require the heavy hand of the state to achieve officially decreed targets had been fading.

zh: 但是，中国政府对政府确定经济增长率这样的目标的重新关注，是全球经济危机加强了那些支持社会主义制度的中国官员和知识分子的地位的又一证据。
en: The government’s renewed focus on such a target is thus another indication that the global economic crisis has strengthened those Chinese officials and intellectuals who advocate a socialist system.

zh: 毕竟，在市场经济处于困境的时候，在中国支持市场经济的人要为它说话更加困难。
en: After all, it is much more difficult to make an argument for market economies when they are under siege.

zh: 中国新推出的刺激经济一揽子计划的真正危险不是意识形态方面的，而是环境方面的。
en: The real danger of the new stimulus package is not ideological but environmental.

zh: 中国8%的经济增长率向各省官员和工业管理人员传递的信号是，中国政府新兴的绿色GDP承诺 — — 为此，地方政府不仅要显示经济有增长，还要显示是清洁节能的增长 — — 已经被抛弃了。
en: What the figure of 8% signals to provincial officials and industrial managers is that the emerging promise of green GDP – wherein a local government had to show not only growth, but also clean and energy-efficient growth – has been abandoned.

zh: 然而，在中国共产党党的干部中，很少有人真正想为这样复杂的计划劳神费力，但是，为了保住职位和寻求升迁，他们对此要么予以遵守，要么给予口头支持。
en: Few Party officials really wanted to be troubled by the complexities of such calculations anyway, but either abided by them or paid them lip service, for the sake of maintaining patronage and seeking promotion.

zh: 现在，在中国共产党管理经济的能力似乎在经受考验的时候，它的一揽子经济刺激计划意味着，在人们的工作机会或经济增长目标受到威胁的时候，中国可以为绕开环境保护开绿灯。
en: Now, with the Party’s ability to manage the economy seemingly at stake, its stimulus package implies a green light to bypass environmental regulations if jobs or growth targets are in jeopardy.

zh: 中国政府的节能承诺在这里是更大的输家。
en: A big loser here is energy efficiency.

zh: 正当中国的能源消费价格结构改革开始启动的时候，它用于节能降耗的新确定的经费的比例，却已经几乎减少了一般。
en: The proportion of new outlays devoted to energy conservation and reduction have been cut almost in half, just when reforms in the price structure of energy use were beginning to kick in.  Some measures aimed at redistributing the energy load – such as solar and wind power – have been retained.

zh: 中国有些为了重新分配能源负荷的措施 — — 例如太阳能和风能 — — 得到了保留，但是，扩大这些能源措施的资金主要要依靠地方官员，而这些官员是不会愿意为此而强迫当地的工厂中断生产和解雇更多的工人的。
en: But the funding for expanding these efforts will rest largely on provincial officials, who will be reluctant to compel local cadres to disrupt production and lay off even more workers.

zh: 在中国，政治大部分是地方性的，但是环境保护则很少如此。
en: Much of politics in China is local, but little of environmental protection is.

zh: 在中国新推出的刺激经济一揽子计划中，还有更坏的讯息。
en: There is worse news elsewhere in the new plan.

zh: 根据中国新的刺激经济一揽子计划，几乎每一个应该得到直接和快速的政府支持的工业部门，都是能源密集型和污染型的（例如，水泥和钢铁 ） ， 或者是由国有企业严格控制的，因此，它们失去了平衡经济增长和环境保护的动力（像中国石油工业的情形那样 ） 。
en: Nearly every industrial sector that, according to the stimulus package, deserves direct and immediate government support is energy-intensive and polluting (cement and steel, for example) or heavily managed by the state sector, and therefore missing incentives to balance growth with environmental protection (as is the case with the oil industry).

zh: 对中国社会中的新生利益群体和官僚来说，控制这些部门以及和中国共产党中的某些派别重合的政治游说力量，已经强大到了他们无力抵挡的地步。
en: Political lobbies that oversee these sectors and overlap with certain factions in the Party are simply too powerful for nascent interests in society and the bureaucracy to parry.

zh: 中国的这一退步也说明，在中国的政府高官中，保护环境的共识是多么得少。 对中国来说，当前经济危机的危险不是政府没有采取措施，而是它采取的措施破坏了人们最近对其可以通过保护环境来帮助其自身的希望。
en: The recent signal being sent from China’s leadership is that economic revival rests on decreased regard for the environment.  This retreat also illustrates how little consensus there is among high-level government officials for making China green.  The danger of the current crisis is not that China’s government is not doing something, but that what it is doing undermines recent hope that China could help to save itself by saving the environment.

zh: 中国的受害综合症
en: China’s Victimization Syndrome

zh: 在中国那个巨大的国家，现在正进行着一场关于中国精神的辩论。 两种强大的力量和对待外部世界两种截然不同的态度互相对抗。
en: A contest for China’s soul is now underway in that giant country, pitting two powerful forces and two very different stances toward the outside world against each other.

zh: 结果必然会对中国能否成功地与外部世界建立真正具有建设性的持久关系产生巨大冲击。
en: The outcome will have a major impact on whether China succeeds in becoming a nation capable of having truly constructive and durable relations with the outside world.

zh: 一方面，中国的经济革命帮助中国找到了自己在世界上的位置：可靠的贸易强国，更有责任感的全球权力代理，甚至是令人放心的军事力量。
en: On one hand, China’s economic revolution has helped position it in the world as a confident powerhouse of trade, a more responsible global powerbroker, and even as a reassuring military presence.

zh: 但另一方面，中国依然为过去所困，其思维方式充满了受害意识，诱使其将内部问题归咎于外部责任。
en: On the other hand, China remains trapped by a past and a mindset steeped in a sense of victimization, which tempts it to export blame for internal problems.

zh: 最主要的问题是，中国能否逃出这种古老的心理综合症的束缚（在整个20世纪，这种综合症使中国沉浸于感伤之中，认为自己弱小、不安全、受人羞辱，这种多愁善感削弱了中国的力量 ） ， 重新看待整个世界，甚至自己的宿敌，并以此来引导自己的发展？
en: The main question is whether China can escape the pull of this old psychological syndrome – which kept it preoccupied throughout the twentieth century with debilitating sentiments of weakness, insecurity, and humiliation – and allow itself to be guided by a new outlook on the world, and even on old enemies.

zh: 反日游行便是这一古老综合症的症状之一。 引发这些游行的怨恨产生于多年以前，那时中国确实遭到了伤害，饱受了屈辱。
en: The anti-Japanese demonstrations are a symptom of the old syndrome, fueled by grievances born at a time when China was, indeed, aggrieved and humiliated.

zh: 随着中国经济实力的增长，生活水平的提高，在世界上享有越来越受尊敬的地位，人们希望中国民众和他们的领袖能找到某种途径，放开过去死亡的记忆。
en: With China’s growing economic clout, rising standard of living, and increasingly respected place in the world, one would hope that the Chinese and their leaders would find a way to let go of the dead.

zh: 但即使在“中国奇迹”的光辉让世界眼花缭乱之时，中国人好像依然不愿意放下他们受害者的阴暗情绪。
en: Yet, even as the luster of the “China miracle” dazzles the world, the Chinese seem loath leave behind their dark feelings of victimization.

zh: 中国已经取得了种种成绩：国家统一，国际贸易蓬勃发展、全球影响日益增强。 但中国领导人却未能基于这一现实，确立一种新的国家范式，而是抱住中国的旧有形象不放，依然把中国当成受害者、当成是被日本这样掠夺成性的帝国主义、殖民主义国家瓜分的“东亚病夫 ” 。
en: Instead of assuming a new national paradigm based on the reality of their accomplishments (national unity, robust international trade, and growing global influence), China’s leaders cling to the old paradigm of their country as victim, the “sick man of Asia” being “cut up like a melon” by predatory imperial and colonial powers like Japan.

zh: 那些被压迫、被剥削的惨痛回忆在很多中国人的头脑之中挥之不去，就像强烈的灯光关掉以后留下的影像久久不散一样。
en: That bitter memory of oppression and exploitation lingers in the minds of too many Chinese like the afterimage of a bright light long after it has been turned off.

zh: 日本对中国的占领是一段尤其让中国人觉得痛恨和屈辱的岁月，因为日本不是西方霸权，而是亚洲国家。
en: The Japanese occupation of China was a particularly galling and humiliating period because Japan was an Asian, not a Western, power.

zh: 此外，日本和中国一样，深受儒家文化影响。 19世纪、20世纪中国很多改革者都怪罪儒家文化，认为是这种文化严重阻碍了他们自己国家的发展和现代化进程。
en: Moreover, like China, Japan was a society steeped in Confucian culture, which many Chinese reformers in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries blamed as a critical impediment to their own country’s development and modernization.

zh: 当然，日本确实占领过中国，犯下过难以想象的暴行，而且此后也没有进行赔款，没有以令人信服的方式道过歉。
en: Of course, Japan did occupy China, committed unimaginable savagery, and has since paid no reparations or apologized in a convincing way.

zh: 但不管怎样，60年后，中国再旧事重提，又有什么好处呢？
en: Nevertheless, what benefit does China gain by continuing to raise these issues 60 years later?

zh: 日本是世界上第二大经济强国，也是中国最重要的贸易伙伴之一，冒着疏远它的风险，这值得吗？
en: What is worth the risk of alienating the world’s second largest economy and one of China’s most important trade partners?

zh: 第一点，也是最重要的一点，助长和煽动民众表达对日本的愤怒是中国共产党领导人随时可用的有力工具。 利用这种情绪，共产党领导人可以重新集结国内支持，以合法化自己的权力。
en: First and foremost, aiding and inciting the expression of popular anger against Japan gives China’s Communist Party leaders a powerful and readily available vehicle for rallying domestic support, thereby legitimizing their own power.

zh: 同时，这些游行反映了中国对世界的感受：这个世界是个不公平的地方，弱者总是被凌辱，被剥削，被羞辱。
en: At the same time, the demonstrations represent China’s experience of the world as an unequal place where the weak are inevitably bullied, exploited, and humiliated.

zh: 这种思维方式意味着，尽管城市里连绵不断的空中轮廓线，广告牌和华丽的五星级酒店诉说着中国的变化与发展，但要真正理解并珍惜其实际的成就和地位，中国还有很长一段路要走。
en: This mindset suggests that, despite the panoramic city skylines, the billboards, and the flashy five-star hotels say otherwise, China has a long way to go before it truly comes to understand and appreciate its actual accomplishments and status.

zh: 事实上，中国在受到攻击或侮辱时爆发出来的有组织的愤怒并不让人觉得新鲜。
en: Indeed, surges of organized anger when China is attacked or insulted are hardly new.

zh: 从1998年，美国误炸中国驻贝尔格莱德大使馆，到美国侦察机与中国飞机在太平洋上空相撞事件，中国领导人的反应如果算不上煽动，至少也是允许了大规模的反外游行。
en: The reaction of China’s leaders to the America’s accidental attack on China’s embassy in Belgrade in 1998, and to the collision of an American spy plane with a Chinese plane over the Pacific, was to permit, if not foment, large anti-foreign demonstrations.

zh: 外交部长李肇星对日本的指责也是这一综合症的体现，他说日本不为自己犯下的罪行道歉，已经“伤害了中国人民的感情 ” ， 好像他是心理部部长，而不是外交部部长一样。
en: In keeping with this syndrome, Foreign Minister Li Zhaoxing has accused Japan of having “hurt the feelings of the Chinese people” by not apologizing for their crimes, as if he were Minister of Psychology, rather than foreign affairs.

zh: 当然，中国的心灵受到过创伤，希望从以前给他们带来过痛苦的人那儿获得补偿，这一点值得同情。
en: Of course, China’s wounded psyche and the desire for restitution from its former tormentors deserve sympathy.

zh: 从这个意义上来说，中国和其他很多国家一样，可以说多少具有两种截然不同的性格。
en: In this sense, China, like many countries, could be said to have something of a bi-polar personality.

zh: 在民众中，受到外国不平等待遇和羞辱的感觉普遍存在，毛泽东革命的感情力量大半来源于此。 这种革命的狂热从来就没有完全消逝过。
en: Much of the emotional force of Mao’s revolution derived from the widespread sense of unequal treatment and humiliation by foreign powers, and this revolutionary fervor has never been properly interred.

zh: 就如毛泽东的画像从来没有从天安门上取下来过一样，毛泽东革命的所有元素也一直存留于中国的制度、思维方式以及与世界的互动模式中。
en: Just as Mao’s portrait has never been taken down from The Gate of Heavenly Peace, so whole elements of his revolution continue to survive in China’s institutions, ways of thinking, and modes of interacting with the world.

zh: 这些元素就象隐性基因一样，有时会忽然重新表达出来。
en: Like recessive genes, they sometimes suddenly re-express themselves.

zh: 对中国人来说，受害者的角色是再熟悉不过了，甚至可以说，或许这种角色或多或少都会让人感到安慰，因为它为解释（和搪塞）中国问题提供了一种途径。
en: The role of victim is all too familiar to the Chinese, perhaps even somewhat comforting, for it provides a way to explain (and explain away) China’s problems.

zh: 但同时，这一角色也是危险的，因为其来源于中国旧有的弱点而非新的实力。
en: But it is also dangerous, because it derives from China’s old weaknesses rather than its new strengths.

zh: 日本军国主义、帝国主义的时代早已经过去了，世界正在争先恐后地拜访登门中国。
en: The era of Japanese militaristic and imperialist power has long gone, and the world is beating a path to China’s door.

zh: 中国最不必做的事就是继续陷在过去之中。
en: The last thing the country needs is to remain trapped in the past.

zh: 两个人的中国晚宴
en: A Chinese Dinner for Two

zh: 伦敦—自70年前中国共产党领袖毛泽东与他的国民党对手蒋介石会面以来，台湾海峡便成为一道不可逾越的海峡。
en: LONDON – A great deal of water has flowed through the Taiwan Strait in the 70 years since the leader of China’s Communists, Mao Zedong, met the leader of his nationalist opponents, Chiang Kai-shek.

zh: 因此，他们的后继者，中华人民共和国主席习近平及其台湾同道马英九最近在新加坡的碰面称为历史性可谓实至名归。
en: So the recent meeting in Singapore between their heirs, President Xi Jinping of the People’s Republic and his Taiwanese counterpart, Ma Ying-jeou, could legitimately be described as historic.

zh: 会面前的外交谈判复杂又细致，甚至涵盖了应该由谁来为晚宴买单的内容（最后决定各付各的 ） 。
en: The diplomatic negotiation that preceded the meeting was exquisitely complex, even covering who should pay for dinner (they split the bill).

zh: 但是，在闭门会面简单交换了看法后，双方并没有发表联合声明，中国国家媒体对会面内容报道也是遮遮掩掩。
en: But, after a brief exchange of views behind closed doors, no joint statement was issued and only a heavily sanitized account of the meeting was made available to China’s state media.

zh: 那么，这次会面为什么要进行，又预示着什么？
en: So why did the meeting happen, and what does it portend?

zh: 自毛泽东的共产党赢得内战、蒋介石的国民党力量退入台湾以来（1945年上一次两党会晤便是为了避免内战 ） ， 双方的关系一直在“焖烧”从未真正走火。
en: Ever since Mao’s Communists won the civil war (which the last meeting between the parties, in 1945, had been called to try to avert) and Chiang Kai-shek’s Kuomintang forces withdrew to Taiwan, relations between the two sides have smoldered without ever really catching fire.

zh: 美国和国民党之间的关系并不好，但美国仍向台湾提供军事保护承诺，这威慑了中国，后者没有尝试用武力统一两岸。
en: While there was no love lost between the United States and the Kuomintang leadership, the US gave Taiwan assurances of military protection, which deterred China from trying to unify the island with the mainland by force.

zh: 毛泽东在朝鲜半岛的冒险 — — 支持朝鲜对抗韩国及其西方盟友 — — 帮助巩固了华盛顿-台北轴心，这一轴心在巧妙的外交运作下，在20世纪70年代初尼克松与中国恢复邦交后得以保存。
en: Mao’s adventures on the Korean peninsula, supporting the North against the South and its Western allies, helped to cement the Washington-Taipei axis, which, thanks to some nifty diplomatic footwork, survived President Richard Nixon’s rapprochement with China in the early 1970s.

zh: 美国承认北京的中共为中国合法政府，同时帮助台湾游走在主权实体和实际存在的国家之间。
en: America recognized the communists in Beijing as China’s legitimate government, while helping to sustain Taiwan in a limbo between sovereignty and the practical exercise of statehood.

zh: 台湾自为其政，在20世纪80年代变成了一个欢闹的民主政体，但从未在国际上获得完全主权国家地位的承认。
en: The island ran its own affairs, becoming a rambunctious democracy in the 1980s, but never insisted on international recognition as a full-fledged sovereign state.

zh: 对中国统治者来说，台湾是一个“反叛的省 ” ， 任何国际社会的成员只要试图对待台湾高于这一规格，就会成为中国攻讦的目标。
en: For China’s rulers, Taiwan was a “renegade province,” and it steadily picked off members of the international community who tried to treat it as anything more than this.

zh: 但与此同时，中国也承认现实 — — 特别是经济现实。
en: But there has also been a recognition of reality – especially economic reality – along the way.

zh: 人们都记得1989年天安门杀人事件。
en: People remember 1989 for the Tiananmen Square killings.

zh: 但在当年5月和6月，包括我在内的部长官员飞往北京见证一个在我们所有人看来都具有积极意义的真正的历史时刻。
en: But that May and June, ministers like me flew to Beijing for what seemed to us all to be a positive and truly historic occasion.

zh: 中国首次接受台湾出席亚洲开发银行理事会年会，提出的要求是以“中国台北”名义出席。
en: China allowed Taiwan to attend the Asian Development Bank’s annual board meeting for the first time, provided it was called “Taipei, China.”

zh: 几年后我担任欧盟委员期间，在分别与中华人民共和国和台湾进行世界贸易组织成员资格谈判后，我们希望在台北开设一个欧盟办事处，监督台湾遵守世贸组织规则的情况。
en: Some years later, when I was a European Union commissioner, after we had negotiated World Trade Organization membership with both the People’s Republic and Taiwan, we wanted to set up an EU office in Taipei to monitor the island’s compliance with the WTO’s rules.

zh: 在此之前，我向中国政府告知我们正在做什么 — — 我们开设的是一个商业监管机构，不是大使馆。
en: Before doing so, I made a point of telling the Chinese government what we were doing – opening a commercial regulator, not an embassy.

zh: 当然，中国和台湾都不会拒绝钱，如今它们的经济关系也十分密切，许多台湾人在中国生活和工作（特别是在上海地区 ） ， 台湾在中国也有着为数巨大的制造业投资。
en: Money of course talks for both China and Taiwan, and their economies are now closely linked, with large numbers of Taiwanese living and working in China (especially in the Shanghai area) and huge Taiwanese investments in Chinese manufacturing.

zh: 台湾的富士康公司是世界第一大电子产品制造商（包括黑莓、苹果和Kindle ） ， 它在中国有12家工厂，其中深圳工厂雇用工人多达数十万人。
en: Taiwan’s Foxconn, the world’s largest electronics manufacturer (including Blackberries, iPhones, and Kindles), has 12 factories in China, including one in Shenzhen that employs hundreds of thousands of workers.

zh: 但是，尽管台湾政治自然而然地被台湾与大陆的关系所主导，但中国和台湾之间深刻的经济关系没有与之匹配的外交关系。
en: But, though Taiwanese politics is naturally dominated by the island’s relationship with the mainland, the reality of deep commercial ties between China and Taiwan has had no diplomatic equivalent.

zh: 国民党希望在不牺牲台湾独立性的情况下改善关系。
en: The Kuomintang (also called the Chinese Nationalist Party) wants to improve relations without surrendering Taiwan’s independence.

zh: 其反对派民进党希望采取更加自主的姿态，尽管这一姿态是否会达到触及中国底线的程度还未可知。
en: Its opponent, the Democratic Progressive Party, wants to strike a more autonomous posture, though whether it would ever really go for anything more substantial than tweaking China’s nose is doubtful.

zh: 三年前的一份调查表明，2,500万台湾人民中有80%支持正式宣布独立，只要这不会导致中国入侵。
en: A survey three years ago suggested that 80% of Taiwan’s 25 million people would support a formal declaration of independence, provided that it did not prompt a Chinese invasion.

zh: 这是相当大的警告。
en: That is a rather large caveat.

zh: 中国常常警告台湾不要做这样鲁莽的事情，美国也会在台湾领导人对大陆过于傲慢时提醒台湾。
en: China regularly warns Taiwan against any such reckless action, and the US puts the squeeze on the island’s leaders whenever they seem to be getting too uppity with the mainland.

zh: 习近平和马英九的会面似乎有两个原因。
en: There appear to be two reasons why Xi and Ma met.

zh: 首先，他们显然担心在去年的地方选举中一败涂地的国民党将在1月的大选中也败下阵来。
en: First, they are clearly worried that the Kuomintang, which lost last year’s local elections in a landslide, will lose the general election in January as well.

zh: 双方都希望，表明中国和台湾能够不太麻烦地携手共进能够为国民党增加选票。
en: Both hope that showing that China and Taiwan can get along without too much trouble will bring electoral benefits for the Nationalists.

zh: 此外，中国经济正在减速，而因为中国在东海和南海的耀武扬威，地区紧张态势也在升级，因此，习近平似乎急切地想释放热爱和平的宏愿。
en: In addition, at a time when the Chinese economy is slowing and regional tensions are rising because of China’s muscle flexing in the South and East China Seas, Xi seems eager to radiate peace-loving ambitions.

zh: 在许多邻国（不仅仅是美国）深感不安的情况下，习近平访问越南和总理李克强访问韩国都是与习马会类似的外交手段。
en: Having unsettled many of his neighbors, not just the Americans, his upcoming visit to Vietnam, and his prime minister Li Keqiang’s visit to South Korea, are of a piece with his dinner-hour diplomacy with Ma.

zh: 中国真正的长期意图并不显而易见，也许这是其战略的一部分：模棱两可在外交中扮演着重要角色。
en: China’s real, long-term intentions are not entirely obvious, and maybe that’s part of its strategy: ambiguous signals play an important role in diplomacy.

zh: 但有两点是清楚的。
en: But two things are clear.

zh: 首先，习近平的做法表明了他在中国政坛的主导地位。
en: First, Xi’s initiative shows the extent to which he dominates Chinese politics.

zh: 弱势领导人不可能采取这样宏大的步骤，这是与过去的中共正统的真正决裂。
en: A weaker leader could not have taken such an ambitious step, which represents a real break with past Communist orthodoxy.

zh: 其次，大陆和台湾的和平统一仍然是不可能的，除非 — — 如中国继续承诺的 — — 在“一国两制”的基础上。
en: Second, peaceful reunification of the mainland and Taiwan remains unlikely, unless it takes place – as China continues to promise – on the basis of “one country, two systems.”

zh: 但台湾人并不那么笃定 — — 他们看着现在的香港正在发生什么。 1997年回归中国前，香港也得到了同样的承诺。
en: But the Taiwanese cannot be very reassured by what they see happening today in Hong Kong, which was promised the same thing before its return to China in 1997.

zh: 台湾是民主制度，中国不是。
en: Taiwan’s system is democratic; China’s is not.

zh: 香港的例子表明，中国必须迫使台湾放弃民主和法治 — — 或两者都放弃 — — 然后再欢迎它的“反叛的省”回到怀抱。
en: What the example of Hong Kong suggests is that China would have to force Taiwan to give up democracy and the rule of law – or embrace both itself – before it could welcome its “renegade province” back into the fold.

zh: 从玻璃房子里看中国
en: China as Seen from a Glass House

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 在近期出台的中国宪法修订案中，取消国家领导任期仅限两届、每届五年的做法令外界深感震惊。
en: NEW HAVEN – The removal from the Chinese constitution of the provision limiting presidents to two five-year terms came as a shock to many.

zh: 对中国而言，领导继承的制度化是邓小平最重要的遗产之一，标志着对毛泽东的胡乱领袖崇拜所引发的痛苦不稳定状态得到了终结；而对西方来说，届别限制则是通向契约精神的意识形态桥梁。
en: For China, the institutionalization of leadership succession was one of Deng Xiaoping’s most important legacies, signaling an end to the wrenching instability of the chaotic leadership cult of Mao Zedong. For the West, the term limit was an ideological bridge that led to a path of engagement.

zh: 那么在中美关系不稳定的情况下，这一废除措施会否成为一个转折点呢？
en: Could its abolition be the tipping point for an already precarious Sino-American relationship?

zh: 让我们先从中国以及这一举措对其未来的意义开始讨论。
en: Start with China and what the move means for its future.

zh: 要弄清楚在不同的领导继承框架下会发生些什么变化，重要的是看透当局那些含糊的说辞 — — 从“小康社会”转变为“新时代 ” — —并对其基本发展战略实施压力测试。
en: To figure out what will change under a different framework for leadership succession, it is important to cut through the authorities’ opaque rhetoric – the “moderately well-off society” transitioning into the “new era” – and stress-test their basic development strategy.

zh: 尽管万事皆有可能，并且总会有犯错误的风险，但我敢打赌，中国仍然会坚持当前的道路。
en: While anything is possible, and there is always a risk of mistakes, my bet is that China stays its current course.

zh: 无论领导者是否可以长期连任，将中国从一个贫穷的大型发展中国家转变为近乎一个繁荣的现代化高收入经济体的趋势不会改变。
en: Succession or not, there can be no turning back from a transition that has brought a large, poor developing country to the brink of prosperity as a modern, high-income economy.

zh: 起初中国的领导层从分析的角度提出了自己的看法 — — 比如前总理温家宝在2007年出人意料地批评中国经济越来越“不稳定，不平衡，不协调和不可持续 ” 。
en: Initially, China’s leadership – responding to former Premier Wen Jiabao’s surprising 2007 critique of a Chinese economy that had become increasingly “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and unsustainable” – made its case from an analytical perspective.

zh: 而去年10月习近平主席在第十九次党代会上的讲话中则转而从意识形态的角度来提出同样的观点，用所谓马克思的主要矛盾原理重新阐述了“不平衡不充分”的发展所产生的陷阱。
en: Last October, in a speech to the 19th Party Congress, President Xi Jinping made the same point from an ideological perspective, reframing the so-called Marxian principal contradiction around the pitfalls of “unbalanced and inadequate” development.

zh: 值得注意的是，这两个观点 — — 分析和意识形态的 — — 都是在将中国带往同一个目的地：一个有着蓬勃发展中产阶级的繁荣经济和社会。
en: Significantly, these two perspectives – analytical and ideological – take China to the same destination: a prosperous economy and society with a thriving middle class.

zh: 要实现这一目标，中国必须实现从制造业到服务业，从出口依赖到国内消费，从国有到私营，从农村到城市的转型再平衡。
en: To get there, China must go through a transformative rebalancing, from manufacturing to services, from export dependence to domestic consumption, from state-owned to private, and from rural to urban.

zh: 到目前为止，所有这些都是很明确的。
en: By now, all of this is well understood.

zh: 目前在中国内部的争论并不是关于战略设计，而是关于如何实施。
en: The current debate in China is less about strategy design and more about implementation.

zh: 实际上，这是习近平2012年下半年就职时的首要任务，并成为了一场空前反腐运动背后的基本指导思想，旨在消灭那些根深蒂固而又阻碍转型的权力集团。
en: This, in fact, was Xi’s highest priority on assuming office in late 2012, and it formed the rationale behind an unprecedented anti-corruption campaign aimed at dislodging deeply entrenched power blocs that have stymied the transition.

zh: 而如今五年过去了，中国领导层已准备好迎接实施问题挑战的下一阶段。
en: But now, five years later, the Chinese leadership is poised to tackle the next phase of the implementation challenge.

zh: 这项任务有一种明显的紧迫感。
en: There is a palpable sense of urgency to this task.

zh: 在一个自信领导人的公共形象背后，习近平也承认存在失败的可能性。
en: Behind the public façade of a confident leader, Xi has owned up to the possibility of failure.

zh: 从分析的角度来看，如果中国经济管理不善就会出现日本式的停滞。
en: From an analytical perspective, this has been expressed in terms of a Japanese-like stagnation if China mismanages its economy.

zh: 从意识形态的角度看，如果“主要矛盾”无法得到解决，社会混乱和革命的恶果就将浮现。
en: From an ideological perspective, an endgame of chaos and revolution looms if the “principal contradiction” is not resolved.

zh: 在这些日益严重的忧虑之下，实施性风险现在正在以不同的方式呈现。
en: Given these mounting concerns, implementation risks are now being presented in a different light.

zh: 今年1月的达沃斯世界经济论坛上，中国新任中央财经领导小组办公室主任刘鹤暗示即将到来的改革将以惊人的速度推进。
en: At the World Economic Forum in Davos in January, Liu He, China’s new vice premier for economic policy, hinted that upcoming reforms would be carried out with surprising speed.

zh: 在《人民日报》最近发表的一篇署名评论文章中，他也指出“加强党的全面领导是核心问题。 ”
en: In a recent signed commentary published in People’s Daily, he also noted that, “Strengthening the party’s overall leadership is the core issue.”

zh: 这些观点绝非凭空而来。
en: These views do not come out of thin air.

zh: 作为一位策略专家的刘鹤似乎在强调领导力与改革步伐之间的联系。
en: Liu, a master tactician, seems to be underscoring the link between leadership power and the pace of reforms.

zh: 对更强大领导力的需求 — — 体现在解除国家领导任期限制上 — — 已经成为当局实施工作的关键要素。
en: The perceived need for greater leadership power – reflected in the elimination of the presidential term limit – has become a key element of the authorities’ implementation efforts.

zh: 与习近平的预见性才能相结合，这或许是中国避开邓小平在1992年警告的“死胡同”的唯一途径。
en: Consistent with Xi’s early instincts, this may well be the only way for China to avoid the “blind alley” of which Deng warned in 1992.

zh: 当然从自由民主的角度来看，中国的宪法修订是令人失望的治理倒退。
en: Yes, viewed from the perspective of liberal democracies, China’s constitutional revision is a disappointing governance setback.

zh: 然而从中国的角度来看，它可能是正面应对其艰巨实施要求的唯一选择。
en: From China’s perspective, however, it may well be the only option to address its daunting implementation imperatives head-on.

zh: 而其他国家（特别是美国）的近期经验则肯定会反对西方那种将连任条件和领导质量混为一谈的倾向。
en: And the recent experience of other countries, particularly the United States, certainly cautions against the Western tendency to conflate succession and leadership quality.

zh: 实际上，美国的领导缺陷正将美中两国推向一场贸易战。
en: America’s leadership deficit is, in fact, pushing the US and China to the brink of a trade war.

zh: 美国中产阶级的困境需要有人来承担责任，而中国及其所声称的不公平交易行为则被列为罪魁祸首。
en: The plight of the US middle class has been framed as a blame game, with China and its alleged unfair trading practices singled out as the culprit.

zh: 然而证据却表明并非如此：由于美国国内储蓄缺口极大，只能依赖国外的剩余储蓄来填补差距，其结果就是多边贸易逆差，而中国以及其他101个国家都在提供美国实现收支平衡所需的外国资本。
en: Yet the evidence points elsewhere: to a dramatic shortfall of domestic saving that leaves America dependent on surplus saving from abroad to fill the gap. The result is a multilateral trade deficit, with China and 101 other countries, required to provide the foreign capital needed for the balance of payments.

zh: 换句话说，中国实际上是美国“解决”储蓄短缺型增长问题的重要组成部分。
en: In other words, China is actually an important part of America’s “solution” to its saving-short growth problem.

zh: 然而美国领导人认为把中国打成替罪羊没什么问题。
en: Yet US leaders find it expedient to make China a scapegoat.

zh: 更何况情况正在恶化，2017年年底实施的大规模减税措施将在未来十年中令美国新增1.5万亿美元联邦预算赤字，进一步压低其国内储蓄额 — — 这一结果将导致更庞大的贸易赤字。
en: And the situation is going from bad to worse. The large tax cut enacted at the end of 2017 will expand the US federal budget deficit by $1.5 trillion over the next decade, pushing domestic saving even lower – an outcome that will lead to even wider trade deficits.

zh: 如果这还不够糟糕的话，奉行保护主义的特朗普政府已将反华关税提升为国际政策议程中的核心角色。
en: As if that’s not bad enough, a protectionist Trump administration has elevated anti-China tariffs to a central role in its international policy agenda.

zh: 然而贸易逆差扩大之下的贸易保护主义只会对充斥泡沫的金融市场以及储蓄不足的美国经济带来麻烦。
en: Yet protectionism in the face of widening trade deficits spells nothing but trouble for frothy financial markets and a saving-short US economy.

zh: 而这可能导致自1989年以来中美关系最严重的破裂。
en: And it risks the most serious rupture in the Sino-American relationship since 1989.

zh: 没有人知道习近平将继续任职多久。
en: No one knows how long Xi will remain in office.

zh: 如果中国继续坚持原有的道路，继任问题其实是无足轻重的 — — 至少目前如此。
en: If China stays the course, the succession question is inconsequential – at least for the time being.

zh: 当然如果中国出了问题，对此的评价肯定会非常不同。
en: If China slips, the verdict will be very different.

zh: 虽然美国拥有一个与中国极为不同政治反馈路径，但问责制也相当重要。
en: While the US has a very different political feedback loop, accountability also matters.

zh: 最终两国领导人的素质才是最重要的。
en: In the end, the quality of leadership is what matters most for both countries.

zh: 可悲的是，住在玻璃房子里的人总会觉得向别人扔石头最容易，却不知道这一做法首先会伤到自己。
en: Sadly, those living in glass houses always find it easiest to throw stones.

zh: 中国和东盟：换个剧本重来？
en: A New Playbook for China and ASEAN

zh: 吉隆坡—海牙常设仲裁法院（PCA）就中国南海领土主张所作出的裁决，是国际法的一个分水岭，也是中国近年来在东南亚的强势战略主张的一次挫折。
en: KUALA LUMPUR – The ruling by the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague against China’s territorial claims in the South China Sea is a watershed moment for international law and an unmistakable warning to China about its strategic assertiveness in Southeast Asia.

zh: 中国宣称不承认仲裁院的裁决，但并不等于中国可以泰然自若。
en: China says that it does not recognize the PCA ruling; but that doesn’t mean it is undisturbed by it.

zh: 现在的问题是，中国要如何回应。
en: The question now is how China will respond.

zh: 中国会减缓在东南亚的强势战略吗？
en: Will it change its often-aggressive behavior in the region, or will it continue to view the South China Sea mainly in terms of US-China competition?

zh: 或者继续把南中国海问题当作中美竞争的其中一个题目：即假使中国判定美国没有政治意愿卷入冲突与风险，就大可通过武力执行其在南中国海的声索。
en: If China assumes that a war-weary and risk-averse US will avoid conflict, it could simply assert its South China Sea claims by force.

zh: 但中国如果在南中国海延续强势策略，可能只会适得其反。
en: But belligerence could backfire in several ways.

zh: 首先，东盟成员国被迫在中国和美国之间做出抉择。 东盟国都希望避开在中美之间做出零和的抉择。
en: First, it would force the members of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) to choose between China and the US, a decision that all of them would prefer to avoid.

zh: 东盟成员国 — — 特别是菲律宾、新加坡、泰国和印度尼西亚 — — 大多与美国有着深切的军事关系，但也非常重视与中国的经济关系。
en: Whereas ASEAN member states – particularly the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia – generally have deep military ties with the US, they also value their economic ties with China.

zh: 事实上，东盟国希望被当做独立的政治单位，而不是中美竞争的棋子。 中国为东盟国保留越大的模糊策略空间，越符合中国在东南亚的长远利益。
en: The reality is that ASEAN states could choose to become independent players, rather than pawns in the US-China competition, implying that it is in China’s interest to maintain ambiguity in US-ASEAN relations.

zh: 其次，中国军事化南中国海的焦岩和人工岛，在不经意间也助长了东盟各国国内的极端民族主义势力。
en: Second, by militarizing outcroppings and artificial islands in the South China Sea, China is unwittingly strengthening ultra-nationalist groups in the ASEAN states.

zh: 为了避免被右翼夺取话语权，也为了安抚躁动的军队和将领，东盟国本来相对温和领导人就被迫对中国采取更加强硬的立场。
en: This development forces moderate leaders in these countries to adopt a tougher stance toward China than they otherwise would, in order to preempt attacks from the ultra-right and assuage their generals.

zh: 例如，印尼总统佐科威最近乘军舰访巡视纳土纳群岛宣示主权，对中国渔民和海军舰只入侵海域做出反应。
en: A case in point is Indonesian President Joko Widodo’s recent visit to the Natuna Islands on a warship, a show of force in response to incursions there by Chinese fishermen and navy vessels.

zh: 中国应该要清楚，东盟与中国经济关系所带来的物质和利益输送，不足以保证平稳的外交关系。
en: China must know that the material advantages from closer ASEAN-China economic relations will not be enough to guarantee smooth diplomatic relations.

zh: 大部分东盟成员国是中等收入国家，也有持多元观点、受过高深教育的精英群，不是纯粹靠经济利益输送就能说服。
en: Most ASEAN member states are middle-income countries with educated elites who hold diverse views.

zh: 即便是极端贫困且政治不自由的缅甸在美国的积极示好下，也减低了对中国的依赖。
en: And even extremely poor and politically illiberal Myanmar has reduced its dependence on China in response to active wooing by the US.

zh: 中国也应该反思坚持与个别东盟国进行国与国谈判而非与东盟整体谈判的立场。 这样会让东盟国认为中国有心“逐个击破”东盟国。
en: China should rethink its insistence that negotiations over its territorial claims could be conducted only with individual ASEAN states, and not with ASEAN as a bloc – a stance that creates the impression that China is committed to bringing about the group’s breakup.

zh: 中国不应该有意无意推动东盟机制的解体，因为这只会驱使一些目前保持中立的东盟国家进一步靠向美国。
en: But China should not encourage ASEAN’s demise, because that would drive several now-neutral ASEAN states further toward the US.

zh: 此外，由于东盟的“共识”机制要求发表立场前达成一致的看法，因此中国没有理由担心东盟立场与中国的看法相去太远。
en: Moreover, because ASEAN must represent ten countries with one voice, and must reach a consensus before it speaks, China has little reason to fear that a common ASEAN negotiating position would be totally unacceptable – particularly given recent history.

zh: 晚近的一些事例可以作为参考：2012年东盟峰会首次没有发表联合声明，因为中国的盟友柬埔寨不同意关于南中国海的议案；2016年6月在昆明举行的东盟外长会议上，东盟因为柬埔寨与寮国的反对，不得不撤回批评中国在南中国海的行为的联合声明。
en: For example, a 2012 meeting of ASEAN foreign ministers failed to produce a joint statement, because Cambodia, a Chinese ally, would not agree to mentioning the South China Sea. And in a meeting of the same group in Kunming, China, in June 2016, ASEAN had to withdraw a joint statement critical of China’s actions in the South China Sea when China, again, pressured Cambodia, as well as Laos, to object.

zh: 换句话说，在与东盟打交道时，中国有谈判两次的权利 — — 首先在东盟共同立场形成过程中通过其在东盟的最紧密盟友进行，然后再与所有东盟国谈判。
en: What this shows is that, in dealing with ASEAN, China gets to negotiate twice – first, through its closest allies within ASEAN in the formulation of common ASEAN positions, and then directly with an ASEAN team that could include one of its allies.

zh: 某些东盟国显然重视对华关系甚于对其他东盟国家的关系；因此，除非中国已经不准备就南中国海问题进行谈判，否则不应该排除与东盟作为一个整体进行谈判。
en: Certain ASEAN countries clearly value their relationships with China more than their relationships with other ASEAN countries; so, unless China has already ruled out any negotiation on the South China Sea, it should not rule out meeting ASEAN as a bloc.

zh: 中国的南中国海声索的吊诡之处是，中共陷入了其于1949年打败的国民党不经意间布下的陷阱。
en: The irony in China’s South China Sea claim is that the Communist Party has fallen into a trap set unintentionally by the Kuomintang, which it defeated in 1949.

zh: 1947年，国民党政府试图在国共内战期间操弄民族主义换取支持，划定最初的“十一段线 ” ， 随后毛泽东为了表示与越南的友好关系，减为“九段线 ” 。
en: It was the crumbling Kuomintang that in 1947 drew and promulgated the original “11-dash line” map – subsequently reduced to nine dashes by Mao Zedong, in a fraternal gesture to Vietnam – in a futile effort to rally the population to its side via imperial ambition.

zh: 中国内战的胜利者没有必要重走失败者的老路。
en: There is no need for the winner of China’s civil war to follow the path of the loser.

zh: 如果中国真的要延续在南中国海的声索以安抚国内民族主义势力，也应该通过外交手段，而不是军事手段。
en: And if China has to press this claim in order to appease ultra-nationalist elements, it should do so by deploying diplomats, rather than its military.

zh: 当然，海牙仲裁最后是否可以形成双赢的结果，也取决于东盟和美国的行动。
en: Of course, a win-win outcome from The Hague decision will also depend on ASEAN and US actions.

zh: 东盟和美国对于中国一再强调的不称霸的说法抱持怀疑的态度；但却也不能罔顾中国的合理安全顾虑。
en: ASEAN and the US are highly skeptical of China’s repeated public promises of a non-hegemonic mode of international relations; but they should not be blind to China’s legitimate security concerns, which it will never neglect.

zh: 东盟和中国必须克制，并以良善意图开启谈判，正视和解决双方的顾虑，换个剧本重来。
en: Both ASEAN and China must now exercise self-restraint and start negotiating in good faith to resolve the territorial disputes in the South China Sea in a way that addresses these concerns.

zh: 中国的货币政策选择
en: China’s Monetary-Policy Choice

zh: 上海—近几年来，中国经济的运行轨迹不可不谓引人注目：从打破纪录的增长发动机沦为了重大全球风险，至少在某些人眼里是如此。
en: SHANGHAI – China’s economy has followed a remarkable course in recent years: from record-breaking powerhouse to major global risk, at least in the eyes of some.

zh: 事实上，今年GDP增长几乎肯定无法达到当局7%的目标，目前，全世界都在密切关注危机和急剧减速的信号。
en: Indeed, with GDP growth this year almost certain not to reach the authorities’ 7% target, the world is now watching closely for signs of crisis and a much sharper slowdown.

zh: 中国是如何走到这一步的？ 它能够让经济增长重回正轨吗？
en: How did China get here, and can it put its economic growth back on track?

zh: 中国增长不可持续已经有一段时间了。
en: China’s growth has been unsustainable for a while.

zh: 2008年，为了应对全球金融危机，中国实施了有欠审慎的固定资产投资刺激计划，保持了两年9%的GDP增长。
en: A stimulus package of less-than-prudent fixed-asset investment, adopted in response to the 2008 global financial crisis, sustained 9% GDP growth for two years.

zh: 但是，2011年后，刺激转变为宏观经济紧缩，导致投资增长从30%以上的名义增长率下降到最近的10%左右。
en: But, after 2011, stimulus turned to macroeconomic tightening, causing investment growth to plummet from a nominal rate of over 30% to about 10% recently.

zh: 这阻止了产能和资源的充分利用，也解释了为何GDP增长不可能超过7 % 。
en: This prevents full utilization of production capacity and resources, and explains why GDP growth above 7% is simply not possible.

zh: 产能过剩和增长下降是互相强化的。
en: Excess capacity and falling growth are mutually reinforcing.

zh: 不仅产能过剩对增长具有消极影响，也许更重要的是，急剧下降的增长也会导致某些行业的大规模冗余（特别是资源业、重工业和化工业 ） 。
en: Not only does excess capacity have a negative impact on growth; perhaps more important, sharply declining growth also contributes to massive redundancy in some industries (especially resources and the heavy and chemical industries).

zh: 问题在于为何增长持续低迷。
en: The question is why growth continues to slow.

zh: 流行的思维关注人口变化等长期结构性因素。
en: One popular line of thinking focuses on long-term structural factors, such as demographic transition.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，很少有研究表明结构性因素足以解释过去几年来中国潜在增长率下降的幅度。
en: But, so far, few studies have indicated that structural factors are adequate to explain the extent of the decline in China’s potential growth rate over the last couple of years.

zh: 更有说服力的答案在于中国的货币政策立场。
en: A more convincing answer lies in China’s monetary-policy stance.

zh: 自2013年上任以来，李克强总理的政府没有选择放松前任政府的严厉宏观政策，而是希望由此产生的对现有行业的压力能有助于刺激当局所追求的向家庭消费和服务业的转型。
en: Since assuming office in 2013, Premier Li Keqiang’s government has chosen not to loosen the previous government’s rigorous macro policies, instead hoping that the resulting pressure on existing industries might help to stimulate the authorities’ sought-after structural shift toward household consumption and services.

zh: 经济学家对这一看似合理的方针十分欢迎， 该方针将减缓导致2008—2010年间债务大规模累积的信用扩张。
en: Economists welcomed this ostensibly reasonable approach, which would slow the expansion of credit that had enabled a massive debt build-up in 2008-2010.

zh: 中国的较低增长轨迹被称为“新常态 ” 。
en: China’s lower growth trajectory was dubbed the “new normal.”

zh: 但是，这一方针要想起效，就必须保持GDP增长稳定，而不是让它急剧放缓。
en: But, for this approach to work, GDP growth would have had to remain steady, rather than decline sharply.

zh: 而事实并非如此。
en: And that is not what has happened.

zh: 事实上，尽管中国继续进行着结构调整，但经济正在面临日益严重的需求萎缩和持续通缩。
en: Indeed, although structural adjustment continues in China, the economy is facing an increasingly serious contraction in demand and continued deflation.

zh: 消费物价指数（CPI）保持在2%以下，生产物价指数（PPI）已经44个月为负。
en: The consumer price index (CPI) has remained below 2%, and the producer price index (PPI) has been negative, for 44 months.

zh: 中国有着巨量的流动性 — — M2（货币供应量的常用指标）达到了中国GDP的两倍 — — 而借贷成本仍在升高，这毫无意义。
en: In a country with a huge amount of liquidity – M2 (a common measure of the money supply) amounts to double China’s GDP – and still-rising borrowing costs, this makes little sense.

zh: 问题在于政府将经PPI调整的基准利率保持在11%以上。
en: The problem is that the government has maintained a PPI-adjusted benchmark interest rate that exceeds 11%.

zh: 影子银行部门的利率达到了令人咋舌的20 % ， 一些民间借贷比20%还要高。
en: Interest rates reach a ludicrous 20% in the shadow banking sector, and run even higher for some private lending.

zh: 结果是过高的融资成本，这让许多制造业的企业无法维持边际利润率。
en: The result is excessively high financing costs, which have made it impossible for firms in many manufacturing industries to maintain marginal profitability.

zh: 此外，地方政府融资平台的关闭，加上中央政府施加的信贷上限，导致地方基础设施投资资本支出下降到历史最低水平。
en: Moreover, the closure of local-government financing platforms, together with the credit ceiling imposed by the central government, has caused local capital spending on investment in infrastructure to drop to a historic low.

zh: 而收紧的金融约束也大大削弱了房地产部门的增长。
en: And tightening financial constraints have weakened growth in the real-estate sector considerably.

zh: 地方政府和公司难于支付利息，被迫进入了一个恶性循环，从影子银行部门借钱偿还债务，从而进一步推高了无风险利率。
en: With local governments and companies struggling to make interest payments, they are forced into a vicious cycle, borrowing from the shadow banking sector to meet their obligations, thereby raising the risk-free interest rate further.

zh: 如果过高利率破坏了中国扭转经济放缓势头所需要的内需，那么一个自然而然的疑问是为何政府不采取措施降低利率。
en: If excessively high real interest rates are undermining the domestic demand that China needs to reverse the economic slowdown, one naturally wonders why the government does not take steps to lower them.

zh: 显而易见的答案是，实现经济从投资和出口拉动型增长的转型才是政府压倒一切的重点。
en: The apparent answer is the government’s overriding commitment to shifting the economy away from investment- and export-led growth.

zh: 但中国能否实现它所追求的消费驱动的再平衡十分可疑。
en: But it is doubtful that China can achieve the consumption-driven rebalancing that it seeks.

zh: 毕竟，没有一个表现抢眼的东亚经济体曾经实现过这样的再平衡，而中国也有类似的增长模式。
en: After all, no high-performing East Asian economy has achieved such a rebalancing in the past, and China has a similar growth model.

zh: 基于此，中国当前的紧缩应该驱使决策者追求货币宽松，将真实利率下降到显著更低的水平甚至零水平。
en: Given this, China’s current deflation should motivate its policymakers to pursue monetary easing, reducing real interest rates to a much lower level, even zero.

zh: 这一动作 — — 中国有足够的空间这样做 — — 不但能够降低现有债务负担；也许更重要的是，它还能让债务在经济加速时得以展期。
en: Such a move – for which China has plenty of room – would not only enable the reduction of existing debt burdens; perhaps more important, it would also allow for the rollover of debt as the economy accelerates.

zh: 事实上，由于中国 — — 与（比如）欧洲不同 — — 大部分银行贷款现在锁定在基础设施和其他实体资产中，因此刺激需求比去杠杆化更好。
en: Indeed, because most bank loans in China – unlike, say, in Europe – are now locked up in infrastructure and other physical assets, boosting demand is preferable to deleveraging.

zh: 关键在于将利率降低足够的程度，以减少高杠杆的金融风险并使地方政府债务能够重组。
en: The key is to lower interest rates enough to mitigate the financial risks of high leverage and enable the restructuring of local-government debts.

zh: 降低借贷成本还能刺激中国的资本市场，它是为创新性中小企业提供股权融资的关键。
en: Lower borrowing costs would also boost China’s capital market, which is critical to provide equity financing to innovative small and medium-size businesses.

zh: 当然，中国需要继续进行债务减记和互换，并且必须保持渐进的结构改革。
en: Of course, China needs to continue debt write-offs and swaps, and it must remain on the path of gradual structural reform.

zh: 但决策者必须认识到过高真实利率正在造成什么风险。
en: But policymakers must recognize the damage being done by excessively high real interest rates.

zh: 货币宽松是阻止增长进一步放缓的关键，因此也是确保国内经济稳定、保持全球复苏动能的关键。
en: Monetary loosening is vital to prevent growth from slowing further, and thus to ensure economic stability at home and maintain the momentum of recovery worldwide.

zh: 中国的不满之夏
en: China’s Summer of Discontent

zh: 发自加利福尼亚州克莱蒙特 — — 政治有种总喜欢不时吓人一跳的恶习 — — 特别是在中国这类几乎毫无透明度且充满政治权力斗争的国家。
en: CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA – Politics has a nasty habit of surprising us – especially in a country like China, where there is little transparency and a lot of intrigue.

zh: 五个月前中国国家主席习近平废除国家主席任期限制以及表明终身执政意图的举动让国人大吃一惊。
en: Five months ago, President Xi Jinping jolted his countrymen by abolishing the presidential term limit and signaling his intention to serve for life.

zh: 但谁知道真正惊吓的事情还在后面。
en: But the real surprise was to come later.

zh: 在习近平取消主席任期制时，大家都认为他在中共党内的统治地位几乎是无可置疑的，因此他的权威也不可能受到挑战。
en: At the time of Xi’s announcement, the conventional wisdom was that his dominance inside the Chinese party-state was virtually absolute, and thus that his authority could not possibly come under attack.

zh: 但如今习近平正面临自2012年11月上台以来最糟糕的一个夏天，因为源源不断的坏消息让许多中国人 — — 尤其是精英阶层 — — 感到失望、焦虑，愤怒和无助，并对他们那位权势日益壮大的领导人深感不满。
en: Xi is now facing the worst summer since he came to power in November 2012, characterized by a steady stream of bad news that has left many Chinese – and especially Chinese elites – feeling disappointed, anxious, angry, helpless, and dissatisfied with their increasingly powerful leader.

zh: 最新的一条坏消息在上月底爆发，政府调查人员发现一家制药公司生产的百白破疫苗质量不合格，甚至在其狂犬病疫苗上伪造数据。
en: The latest piece of bad news, which broke late last month, was the discovery by government investigators that a pharmaceutical company had been producing substandard vaccines for diphtheria, tetanus, and whooping cough, and had faked data for its rabies vaccine.

zh: 全国有数十万中国儿童接种了有问题的疫苗。
en: Hundreds of thousands of Chinese children nationwide have been given the faulty vaccines.

zh: 当然中国早就经历过许多类似丑闻 — — 从三聚氰胺婴儿配方奶粉到受污染的血液稀释药物肝素 — — 而贪婪的商人和腐败官员都得为此负责。
en: Of course, China has experienced many similar scandals before – from tainted baby formula to the contamination of the blood-thinning drug heparin – with greedy businessmen and corrupt officials held to account.

zh: 习近平已经在遏制腐败和加强控制方面投入了相当多的政治资本。
en: But Xi has staked considerable political capital on rooting out corruption and strengthening control.

zh: 但一家拥有深厚政治关系的私营企业处于疫苗丑闻核心的事实令人痛苦地证明，习近平这场自上而下的反腐运动并未像宣称的那样有效。
en: The fact that a private company with deep political connections is at the center of the vaccine scandal is painful evidence that Xi’s top-down anti-corruption drive has not been as effective as claimed.

zh: 习近平巩固权力的一个令人意想不到的后果是他要对丑闻负责，至少在中国公众眼中是如此。
en: An unintended consequence of Xi’s consolidation of power is that he is accountable for the scandal, at least in the eyes of the Chinese public.

zh: 但是对习近平的不满和反弹在疫苗事件之前就开始了。
en: But the backlash against Xi began even before the vaccine revelations.

zh: 人们越来越关注个人崇拜的逐渐形成。
en: Concerns were rising over the gradual creation of a personality cult.

zh: 最近几个月习近平的支持者一直在不遗余力地运作此事。
en: In recent months, Xi’s loyalists have spared no effort in this regard.

zh: 习近平在文化大革命期间插队了七年的荒凉村庄被称为“大学问”的根源，一跃成为炙手可热的旅游胜地。
en: The desolate village where Xi spent seven years as a farmer during the Cultural Revolution has been branded as a source of “great knowledge” and become a red-hot tourist destination.

zh: 对于一些人来说这不禁让人联想起毛泽东当年近乎封神的地位，但他在“大跃进”和“文化大革命”期间令数千万人丧命，还几乎摧毁了中国经济。
en: For some, this is all too reminiscent of the quasi-divine status attributed to Mao Zedong which, during the “Great Leap Forward” and “Cultural Revolution” resulted in millions of deaths and nearly destroyed the Chinese economy.

zh: 事实上，今天中国的经济新闻一片惨淡，而首当其冲的则今年已经下跌了14％的股市。
en: And, in fact, today’s economic news in China is grim, beginning with a 14% decline in stock prices this year.

zh: 三年前的夏天，面对股价急剧下跌习近平下令国企买入股票以支撑市场。
en: Three summers ago, in the face of sharply falling stock prices, Xi ordered state-owned companies to buy shares to prop up the market.

zh: 可一旦这种强制购买行为告终，市场又会再度下滑，而这次则是在外汇储备枯竭的背景下。
en: But as soon as the forced purchases stopped, another market decline followed, this time against a background of depleted foreign-exchange reserves.

zh: 习近平此次并没有重复那种经济无知行为，但中国股市接下来的走向依然悬而未决。
en: Xi has not repeated that bit of economic illiteracy this time around, but what will come next for China’s stock market remains an open question.

zh: 但这还不是更糟糕的经济新闻。
en: And there is more bad economic news.

zh: 人民币已下探至13个月的低点，虽然2018年的GDP增长表面上有望实现6.5％的目标，但经济显示出疲软的迹象。
en: The renminbi has reached a 13-month low, and while GDP growth is ostensibly on track to meet the 6.5% target for 2018, the economy is showing signs of weakness.

zh: 投资，房地产销售和私人消费都在放缓，促使政府停止其去杠杆措施并拨出更多资金来维持增长。
en: Investment, real-estate sales, and private consumption are all slowing, prompting the government to halt its deleveraging effort and allocate more funds to propping up growth.

zh: 然而最糟糕的经济发展形势是正在与美国展开的贸易战。
en: The worst economic development, however, is the unfolding trade war with the United States.

zh: 尽管尚未感受到其经济影响，但美国总统特朗普发起的贸易冲突可能是习近平迄今面临的最严峻挑战，其背后原因则远远超出了经济范畴之外。
en: Though its economic impact has yet to be felt, the clash over trade that US President Donald Trump has initiated is likely to be the toughest challenge Xi has faced so far, for reasons that extend far beyond the economy.

zh: 首先，习近平推动了旨在令中国复兴成为世界大国的“中国梦 ” 。
en: For starters, there is Xi’s promotion of the “China Dream,” which entails the country’s revival as a world power.

zh: 但贸易战却明摆着展现出中国对美国市场和技术的严重依赖。
en: But, as the trade war makes starkly apparent, China remains deeply dependent on US markets and technology.

zh: 习近平的中国不是一个重新焕发活力的，致力于重塑全球经济的霸权国家，而更像是一个外强中干的巨人
en: Far from a rejuvenated hegemon poised to reshape the global economy, Xi’s China has been exposed as a giant with feet of clay.

zh: 而地缘战略的各项影响也很难被夸大。
en: The geostrategic implications are difficult to exaggerate.

zh: 自邓小平带领中国走出毛泽东黑暗时代的这40年以来，中国实现了前所未有的经济增长和发展。
en: In the 40 years since Deng Xiaoping began to lead China out of the Maoist dark ages, the country has achieved unprecedented economic growth and development.

zh: 但如果中国不是一直秉承与美国保持合作关系的政策，这种进步是不可能实现的 — — 或者至少要慢得多。
en: But that progress would have been impossible – or, at least, much slower – were it not for China’s policy of maintaining a cooperative relationship with the US.

zh: 而习近平在位期间已经改变了这一政策，正如他在南中国海日益激进的行动所表现的那样。
en: Xi has upended that policy during his tenure, not least with his increasingly aggressive actions in the South China Sea.

zh: 这些事态发展指向了一个直截了当的结论：中国正在走向一个错误的方向。
en: These developments point to a straightforward conclusion: China is headed in the wrong direction.

zh: 中国的精英们显然也注意到了这一点，这体现在他们显而易见 — — 且不断升温 — — 的挫败感上。
en: This is not lost on China’s elites, whose frustration is palpable – and rising.

zh: 但尽管传闻有退休老领导反对习近平，但他不太可能被推翻，因为他仍然牢牢掌控着中国这个党化国家的安全机构和军队。
en: Yet, despite rumors of pushback against his power by retired elderly leaders, Xi is unlikely to be overthrown. He remains solidly in control of the Chinese party-state’s security apparatus and the military.

zh: 此外也缺乏有足够勇气或影响力去真正挑战他权威的竞争对手 — — 比如像在1978年推翻毛泽东亲自指定的中共领导人华国锋的邓小平和其他老一辈革命家。
en: Moreover, he has no rivals with the courage or influence genuinely to challenge his authority, as Deng and other veteran revolutionaries did in 1978, when they pushed out Hua Guofeng, Mao’s hand-picked successor as leader of the Communist Party of China.

zh: 尽管如此，习近平的前进道路依然危机四伏。
en: Nonetheless, the road ahead for Xi remains treacherous.

zh: 如果他维持现在的路线，那么中国也会如此，每次失误都会加深对他领导层的负面看法。
en: If he stays his current course, so will China, with each stumble reinforcing negative perceptions of his leadership.

zh: 然而改变路线也可能损害习近平的声誉，因为这相当于承认自己的判断有缺陷 — — 这对任何领导者来说都是一个问题，但对习近平这样的强人尤甚。
en: Yet changing course could also hurt Xi’s reputation, as it would amount to an admission of flawed judgment – a problem for any leader, but especially for a strongman like Xi.

zh: 此外习近平必须采取的一些新政策也会有悖于他的直觉和价值观。
en: And some of the new policies Xi would have to adopt conflict with his instincts and values.

zh: 这些风险都真实存在。
en: The risks are real.

zh: 但习近平可能没有多少选择，只能直接面对它们。
en: But Xi probably doesn’t have much choice but to face them.

zh: 正如中国这个不满之夏所明确暗示的那样，他需要一个新的行动计划。
en: As China’s summer of discontent clearly suggests, he needs a new game plan.

zh: 中国的贸易战武器
en: China’s Weapons of Trade War

zh: 北京—中国对美出口要比美国对华出口更多。
en: BEIJING – China exports more to the United States than the US exports to China.

zh: 这让美国总统特朗普抓狂 — — 事实上，抓狂到了可能不惜发动贸易战的程度。
en: That makes US President Donald Trump furious – so furious, in fact, that he may be willing to start a trade war over it.

zh: 特朗普对中国发出了严厉的保护主义威胁。
en: Trump has leveled tough protectionist threats against China.

zh: 他若想巩固其总统地位，就不可能放弃这些威胁。
en: As he attempts to consolidate his presidency, he is unlikely to back away from them.

zh: 而随着中共十九大即将于11月在北京召开，中国领导人也不可能屈服于美国的压力。
en: And with the Communist Party of China’s 19th National Congress set to take place in Beijing in November, Chinese leaders are unlikely to yield to US pressure.

zh: 毫无疑问，贸易战将是两败俱伤。
en: A trade war would undoubtedly hurt both sides.

zh: 但有理由相信美国会输得更惨。
en: But there is reason to believe that the US has more to lose.

zh: 不出意外的话，中国似乎知道可以动用哪些武器。
en: If nothing else, the Chinese seem to know precisely which weapons they have available to them.

zh: 中国可以停止采购美国飞机，对美国大豆制品实施禁运，甩卖美国国债和其他金融资产等。
en: China could stop purchasing US aircraft, impose an embargo on US soybean products, and dump US Treasury securities and other financial assets.

zh: 中国企业可以削减对美国的企业服务的需求，政府也可以说服企业不要买美国货。
en: Chinese enterprises could reduce their demand for US business services, and the government could persuade companies not to buy American.

zh: 如今 ， 《 财富》500强公司大部分年销售额都来自中国 — — 并且它们已经开始日益不满。
en: The bulk of numerous Fortune 500 companies’ annual sales come from China nowadays – and they already feel increasingly unwelcome.

zh: 除了是美国的第二重要的贸易伙伴之外，中国还是美国的主要就业岗位提供者。
en: Beyond being America’s second most important trading partner, China is America’s main jobs supplier.

zh: 因此，贸易战将让美国损失数百万个就业岗位。
en: A trade war could thus cost the US millions of jobs.

zh: 比如，如果中国舍弃波音，采购空中客车，美国将失去179,000个就业岗位。
en: If China switched from Boeing to Airbus, for example, the US would lose some 179,000 jobs.

zh: 减少美国企业服务需求也将让美国失去85,000个就业岗位。
en: Reduction in US business services would cost another 85,000 jobs.

zh: 大豆生产区 — — 如密苏里州和密西西比州 — — 将因为中国不再进口美国大豆产品而失去大约10%的本地就业岗位。
en: Soybean-producing regions – for example, in Missouri and Mississippi – could lose some 10% of local jobs if China halted imports.

zh: 此外，尽管美国对华出口要小于中国对美出口，但中国控制着全球供应链和生产网络的关键元件。
en: Moreover, though the US exports less to China than vice versa, it is China that controls key components in global supply chains and production networks.

zh: 以iPhone为例。
en: Consider the iPhone.

zh: 中国只提供了4%的增加值，但它以低成本向苹果公司提供核心元件。
en: While China provides just 4% of value added, it supplies the core components to Apple at low prices.

zh: 苹果公司不可能在美国从零开始生产iPhone，因此不得不去寻找替代供应商，从而大大增加其生产成本。
en: Apple cannot build an iPhone from scratch in the US, so it would have to search for alternative suppliers, raising its production costs considerably.

zh: 这将给中国智能手机企业制造从主要竞争对手手中抢夺市场份额的机会。
en: This would give Chinese smartphone businesses an opportunity to seize market share from major players.

zh: 如今，80%的全球贸易在国际供应链中进行。
en: Today, 80% of global trade comprises international supply chains.

zh: 贸易成本的下降使企业得以将生产线分散到各个地区，在这个链条中，商品的加工和价值的增加在多个国家实现。
en: Declining trade costs have allowed firms to splinter their production lines geographically, with goods processed and value added in multiple countries along the chain.

zh: 如果中国向这条供应链的齿轮中惨一些沙子，就能影响到整个生产网络，对美国造成严重打击（事实上，所有参与这些网络的国家都会受到冲击 ） 。
en: If China threw a handful of sand in the gears of these chains, it could disrupt entire production networks, doing serious damage to the US (and, indeed, all the countries participating in such networks).

zh: 如果贸易战升级，双方都将建立系统性进口壁垒，这将助推美国的通胀压力，有可能促使美联储更快更大幅地提高利率。
en: An escalating trade war, with each side erecting symmetric import barriers, would fuel inflationary pressure in the US, potentially driving the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates higher and faster than it would otherwise.

zh: 再加上令人堪忧的增长前景，美国股市将承受压力，而就业和家庭收入的下降可能导致美国和中国都蒙受巨大的GDP损失。
en: That, together with diminished growth prospects, would depress equity markets, and declining employment and household income could lead to a sizeable loss of GDP in both the US and China.

zh: 但是，更有可能的情景是两国在个别部门发生纠纷，特别是钢铁等传统制造业。
en: A more likely scenario, however, is that both countries would initiate disputes in specific sectors, particularly traditional manufacturing industries like iron and steel production.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普将继续谴责中国操纵汇率，无视人民币最近受到的贬值压力（这表明人民币此前其实是高估的 ） ， 更不用说许多政府都出手干预汇率的简单事实了。
en: Meanwhile, Trump will continue to accuse China of manipulating its exchange rate, ignoring the recent downward pressure on the renminbi (which indicates that the currency was actually overvalued), not to mention the simple fact that many governments intervene to manage their exchange rates.

zh: 日本和瑞士在近几年中都曾大举干预本国货币，美国本身也很有可能加入这一行列，如果强势美元给美国出口造成难以承受的竞争力冲击的话。
en: Both Japan and Switzerland have engaged in outright currency intervention in recent years, and the US itself may well join their ranks, when the strong dollar’s impact on US export competitiveness becomes untenable.

zh: 无论如何，中国可能无从实现世贸组织规则所规定的“市场经济地位 ” ， 直到特朗普下台。
en: In any case, China can probably forget about achieving “market economy status” under World Trade Organization rules until after Trump is out of the White House.

zh: 中美贸易冲突还将影响到双边投资流。
en: The trade confrontation between the US and China will also affect bilateral investment flows.

zh: 美国可以以国家安全为借口阻止中国的投资。
en: The US may cite national security concerns to block Chinese investments.

zh: 它也可以让政府停止采购华为等中国公司的产品，迫使中国企业和富人收回目前支撑美国资产价格的投资。
en: It may also stop government purchases from Chinese companies like Huawei, and force Chinese firms and wealthy individuals to reduce investments that have hitherto bolstered US asset prices.

zh: 高质量的中美双边投资条约可以为美国公司创造公平的竞争环境，让它们更容易打入庞大的中国市场。
en: A high-quality US-China bilateral investment treaty would create a level playing field for American companies, giving them better access to China’s large market.

zh: 但这些条约的谈判难免会受到挫折，而关于知识产权和网络安全的纠纷将再度兴起。
en: But those talks will invariably be pushed back, while disputes over intellectual property rights and cyber security will be reinvigorated.

zh: 目前，中国领导人似乎认为他们没有理由屈从于美国的压力。
en: For now, China’s leaders seem convinced that they have little reason to bend to US pressure.

zh: 一方面，特朗普似乎更关注其他重点事项，如撤销平价医疗法、改革税收制度、基础设施投资等。
en: For one thing, Trump seems more concerned with other priorities, such as repealing the US Affordable Care Act, reforming the tax system, and investing in infrastructure.

zh: 中国领导人认为，即使真的爆发贸易战，也不会维持太久，因为双方都将付出沉重的收入和就业代价。
en: Even if a trade war does happen, China’s leaders assume, it probably would not be sustained for long, given the income and job losses that both sides would suffer.

zh: 无论如何，美国和中国都无意向热衷于试探对方底线的领导人示弱。
en: In any case, they have no intention of sending any signal of weakness to a leader so intent on testing other’s limits.

zh: 在过去五年中，中国建立了更少依赖出口、更多依赖国内消费的增长模式。
en: For the past five years, China has sought to establish a growth model that is less reliant on exports and more reliant on domestic consumption.

zh: 但中国通常需要危机或外部冲击来推动改革。
en: But China often needs a crisis or an external shock to drive reform.

zh: 也许特朗普就是这一冲击。
en: Perhaps Trump is that shock.

zh: 尽管其政策从短期来讲不利于中国，但有可能为中国提供取消出口补贴、纠正国内经济的长期扭曲的刺激因素。
en: While his policies will be bad for China in the short term, they may also provide the impetus China needs to stop subsidizing exports and perpetuating distortions in the domestic economy.

zh: 果真如此的话，中国反倒可以在特朗普时代获得比以往更多的收益。
en: If this happens, China may actually emerge from the era of Trump better off than before.

zh: 中国的二孩消费引擎
en: China’s Two-Child Consumption Engine

zh: 伦敦 — — 去年10月中国终止实施独生子女政策标志着37年偏离历史轨道的结束，上述偏离导致该国的人口老龄化进程提前了数十年。
en: LONDON – The announcement in October that China is terminating its one-child policy marks the end of a 37-year historical aberration that has accelerated the country’s demographic aging by decades.

zh: 政府严格控制人口的社会和经济影响导致城市家庭平均生育率从20世纪70年代的户均三个下降到1982年的一个多一点，并造成了引人注目的经济后果。
en: The social and economic consequences of the authorities’ drastic population controls, which reduced the average fertility rate in urban households from about three in 1970 to just over one by 1982, have been dramatic.

zh: 现在的问题是国家新的二胎政策能否、以及能在多大程度上缓解这样的后果。
en: The question now is whether, and to what extent, the country’s new two-child policy will mitigate those consequences.

zh: 事实上，二孩政策的影响可能同样深远 — — 而且总体而言其积极影响可能远超独生子女政策。
en: In fact, the impact of the two-child policy is likely to be just as far-reaching – and, overall, much more positive – than that of the one-child rule.

zh: 长远来看影响尤其如此，但即使在较短期限内其影响也是显而易见的。
en: This is especially true in the long term, but the effects will become apparent even in the relatively shorter term.

zh: 关键原因之一是单个家庭子女数量的增加将迫使民众降低总体储蓄率，从而实现长期的宏观经济目标。
en: One key reason for this is that an increase in the number of children per household will force a reduction in the aggregate savings rate, fulfilling a long-standing macroeconomic goal.

zh: 中国目前储蓄率高到常被指造成全球失衡及拉低全球利率的后果。
en: China’s current saving rate is so high that it is often blamed for fueling global imbalances and driving down interest rates worldwide.

zh: 此外，高储蓄率还阻碍了中国完成从出口导向型增长模式向以国内消费服务为主模式的过渡。
en: Moreover, it is a major obstacle in China’s ongoing transition from an export-led growth model to one based on domestic consumption and services.

zh: 二孩政策在推动上述转型方面或许必不可少 — — 上述进程的开始可能比多数观察家的预测更为迅速。
en: The two-child policy may prove indispensable in propelling this transition – a process that will begin sooner than most observers anticipate.

zh: 迄今为止，经济学家主要研究中国人口结构即将发生的变化。
en: So far, economists have focused largely on the impending shifts in China’s demographic structure.

zh: 在独生子女政策驱动下，20岁以下中国人口比例从1970年的51%下降到2010年的27 % ， 与此同时60岁及以上人口比例从7%上升到14 % 。
en: Driven by the one-child policy, the share of China’s population under the age of 20 fell from 51% in 1970 to 27% by 2010, while the share of people aged 60 and up rose from 7% to 14%.

zh: 结果导致年龄中位数从20岁左右上升到35岁。
en: As a result, the median age increased from about 20 to 35.

zh: 随着退休人员占工作人口比例不断提高，今天的年轻一代所面临的压力越来越大。
en: As retirees increasingly outnumber working-age people, the pressure on today’s younger generation will intensify.

zh: 事实上，未来80后独生子女一代每人平均需要赡养两位老人。
en: Indeed, in the coming years, each member of the post-1980s one-child generation will need to support two older people, on average.

zh: 当然，当二孩一代步入中年，他们人均只需供养一位老人，从而缓解如此之高的老年赡养比所带来的经济压力。
en: Of course, when the two-child generation becomes middle-aged, its members will each have to support only one elderly person, on average, alleviating the economic pressure associated with such a high old-age dependency ratio.

zh: 但这要等到数十年之后。
en: But that will take a few decades.

zh: 在此期间，80后独生子女一代将不光要赡养老人，还要抚养更多子女。
en: In the meantime, the post-1980s one-child generation will be supporting not only the elderly, but also a higher number of young people.

zh: 虽然这对独生子女一代而言无疑困难重重，但因80后一代将别无选择只能加大消费，一个意想不到的副作用将是消费量激增。
en: Although this will undoubtedly be tough for the one-child generation, an unintended side effect will be a surge in consumption, as its members will have little choice but to spend a lot more.

zh: 比较独生子女政策下双胞胎家庭和独生子女家庭的消费可以表明消费变化的规模（当然双胞胎父母无法在较长期间内平摊消费意味着这并非是一种完美的模型 ） 。
en: A comparison of families that had twins under the one-child policy and those that had just one child offers an indication of the scale of the change in consumption (though, of course, the inability of twins’ parents to spread out consumption spending over time means that it is not a perfect representation).

zh: 具体到储蓄方面，两个孩子的城镇居民家庭2009年平均存款占其收入的12.8 % ， 而独生子女家庭存款收入比则为21.3 % 。
en: In terms of saving, urban households with two children saved 12.8% of their incomes, on average, in 2009, compared to 21.3% in families with an only child.

zh: 上述差别在所有收入群体中都非常显著。
en: The difference is large across all income groups.

zh: 因子女提振的家庭消费无疑对某些行业的贡献会比其他行业更大。
en: The child-fueled boost in household consumption will undoubtedly affect some sectors more than others.

zh: 首先，儿童激增将提振儿童书籍、玩具和自行车企业的股价。
en: At first, the surge in the number of children will boost the performance of stocks in children’s books, toys, and bicycles.
