zh: 随着那代人年龄的增加，对住房、寿险和药品的需求也将大幅增加。
en: As that generation ages, demand for housing, life insurance, and pharmaceuticals will increase substantially.

zh: 最大的差异将来源于教育支出。
en: One of the biggest differences will be expenditure on education.

zh: 2009年城镇住户调查显示，中国独生子女家庭教育费用占其总收入的比例平均为10.6 % ， 而双胞胎家庭为17.3 % 。
en: According to the 2009 urban household survey, a one-child household in China spends an average of 10.6% of its total income on education, whereas a household with twins spends 17.3%.

zh: 随着二孩家庭数量的增加，仅这一项变化就能导致中国总储蓄率降低7-10个百分点，从今天的30%下降到今后10年的22%左右。
en: As the number of households with two children increases, this change alone could cause the aggregate saving rate in China to drop by as much as 7-10 percentage points, from 30% today to about 22% over the next ten years.

zh: 但还有一个警告。
en: There is, however, a caveat.

zh: 子女数量增多意味着单个子女教育投资减少，导致人力资本成就下降。
en: More children also mean less education investment per child, which could lead to lower human-capital attainment.

zh: 事实上，双胞胎在15岁以后得到的平均支持远小于独子，导致教育结果大不相同。
en: Indeed, the average twin receives far less support after age 15 than the average only child, creating large differences in education outcomes.

zh: 双胞胎上职高的几率比独子高出40 % 。
en: Twins are 40% more likely to go to a vocational high school than only children.

zh: 尽管如此，中国仍迫切需要过渡到二孩政策 — — 而且不完全因为这样做能够实现平衡该国人口结构的长期目标。
en: Nonetheless, China’s shift to a two-child policy is badly needed – and not just because it will achieve the intended long-term goal of balancing the country’s demographic structure.

zh: 虽然无疑会遇到困难，包括过渡期所遭遇到的困难，事实将证明这项政策可能会使中国经济走上更稳定的长期发展轨道。
en: While there are certainly pitfalls, including a difficult transition period, the policy could prove to be a boon to China’s efforts to put its economy on a more stable long-term growth path.

zh: 中国贸易政策真的不公平吗？
en: Are China’s Trade Practices Really Unfair?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—美国总统特朗普和中国国家主席习近平在刚刚结束的布宜诺斯艾利斯G20会议上达成暂时休战，双方都获得了一些时间思考问题之所在。
en: BRUSSELS – The temporary truce reached by US President Donald Trump and his Chinese counterpart Xi Jinping at the just-concluded G20 meeting in Buenos Aires should give both sides some time to reflect on the issues in question.

zh: 这些问题中最根本性的一个是美国对中国的仇视 — — 许多发达经济体都有这样的仇视 — — 是否有合理的依据。
en: And the most fundamental of those issues is whether American grievances against China – shared by many of the advanced economies – are justified.

zh: 诚然，美国的单方面措施从全球贸易规则角度是站不住脚的。
en: To be sure, unilateral US measures are indefensible under global trading rules.

zh: 但如果发发经济体 — — 它们已经形成了一个“中国输家”的非正式联络小组，成员包括来自欧盟、日本和美国的代表 — — 所谓的中国一直在进行不公平贸易行为的说法是正确的话，这肯定会引来一些反击。
en: But some pushback conceivably could be warranted if the advanced economies – which have already created an informal contact group of “China losers,” including representatives of the European Union, Japan, and the United States – are right that China has been engaging in unfair trading practices.

zh: 对美国来说，最大的担忧似乎是所谓的强制技术转让 — — 即要求外国公司与本国“合作方”共享知识产权，这样才能进入中国市场。
en: For the US, the biggest concern seems to be so-called forced technology transfer – that is, the requirement that foreign companies share their intellectual property with a domestic “partner” in order to gain access to the Chinese market.

zh: 但这种说法是不恰当的，因为不想共享技术的公司随时可以选择不投资于中国。
en: But this is a misnomer, at best, because companies that do not want to share their technology can always choose not to invest in China.

zh: 欧洲的抱怨 — — 或者更具体地说，是1,600多家欧洲公司的抱怨 — — 在中国欧盟商会所发布的新报告中做了总结。
en: Europe’s complaints – or, more specifically, the complaints of over 1,600 European companies – are summarized in a new report issued by the European Union Chamber of Commerce in China.

zh: 但有趣的是，这些抱怨中几乎没有一项是针对中国贸易行为 — — 至少从狭义上说是如此。
en: But, interestingly, few of those complaints are about China’s trading practices per se, at least in the narrow sense.

zh: 比如，没人提及关税。
en: Tariffs, for example, are not cited.

zh: 2001年加入世界贸易组织后，中国被迫降低了一半的关税保护。
en: With its accession to the World Trade Organization in 2001, China was forced to reduce its tariff protections by one-half.

zh: 随后的多年中，中国平均关税税率继续下降，目前已不足4 % ， 尽管中国一直保留着异常高的关税极值（即对范围非常有限的产品征收高额关税 ） 。
en: In the ensuing years, the average tariff rate applied by China has continued to fall, and now stands at less than 4%, though China does maintain an unusually high number of tariff peaks (that is, high tariffs for very limited categories of product).

zh: 当然，关税绝非制造贸易障碍的唯一办法。
en: Of course, tariffs are far from the only way to create obstacles to trade.

zh: 事实上，关税从很多角度看属于昨天的问题 — — 至少曾经如此，直到特朗普把它们拿出来作为贸易战的武器之一。
en: Indeed, in many ways, tariffs are yesterday’s problem – at least they were, until Trump dusted them off as a weapon for his trade war.

zh: 但对于非关税壁垒，中国的记录似乎也不向抱怨者所说的那样有问题。
en: But when it comes to non-tariff barriers, China’s record also does not seem as problematic as is claimed.

zh: 平心而论，很难衡量非关税壁垒对贸易的总体重要性，因为它们的形式不一而足。
en: To be sure, it is difficult to measure the overall importance of non-tariff barriers to trade, because they can take so many forms.

zh: 但根据独立的《全球贸易预警 》 （ Global Trade Alert）的观察，自2008年以来，中国平均每年只采取了25项措施（称之为“国家干预 ” ） 可能限制与美国的贸易。
en: But, according to the independent Global Trade Alert observatory, since 2008, China has introduced only 25 measures (referred to as “state interventions”) per year, on average, that might restrict trade with the US.

zh: 与此同时，中国还会采取差不多数量的新措施放松与美国的贸易。
en: Meanwhile, China enacted about the same number of new measures that liberalize trade with the US.

zh: 因此，总体而言，中国并未针对美国而变得更加保护主义；相反，其开放过程是持续的，尽管速度缓慢。
en: Overall, then, China has not become more protectionist against the US; on the contrary, the opening process is continuing, albeit very slowly.

zh: 相反，美国每年都会实施80到100项针对中国的限制措施，而放松措施数量要少得多。
en: By contrast, the US has enacted between 80 and 100 restrictive measures against China every year, and far fewer liberalizing measures.

zh: 其他指标也确认中国在逐渐迈向自由化。
en: Other indicators confirm China’s gradual move toward liberalization.

zh: 即使是外国投资也是如此 — — 美国和欧洲公司都抱怨外国投资问题。
en: This is the case even for foreign investment – an issue about which both US and European companies complain.

zh: 尽管中国对外国直接投资的开放程度仍比不上大部分发达经济体，但经合组织综合指标表明，中国在这一方面一直在改善，尽管速度缓慢。
en: Although China remains far less open to foreign direct investment than most advanced economies, the OECD’s composite indicator shows that there has been continuous, albeit sluggish, improvement.

zh: 简而言之，即使中国非关税壁垒（包括正式的和非正式的）仍然严重，但较之过去已经有所降低。
en: In short, even if China’s non-tariff barriers (both formal and informal) remain high, they are lower than in the past.

zh: 那么，为何美国、欧洲和日本现在要发起反击？
en: So, why are the US, Europe, and Japan pushing back now?

zh: 答案在于中国生产商竞争力的提高。
en: The answer lies in the increased competitiveness of Chinese producers.

zh: 在西方公司在知识和技术方面拥有近乎垄断的地位时，它们的竞争优势能够补偿中国的贸易和投资壁垒所带来的扭曲。
en: When Western companies had a near-monopoly on know-how and technology, their competitive edge more than compensated for distortions created by Chinese barriers to trade and investment.

zh: 但随着中国企业日益崛起成为难对付的竞争对手，西方公司承受非关税壁垒成本的能力有所下降。
en: But, as Chinese enterprises have become increasingly serious competitors in their own right, Western countries’ capacity to bear the extra costs of non-tariff barriers has diminished.

zh: 因此，关于中国不公平贸易措施的抱怨，实际上是关于缓慢的经济开放速度与快速的现代化节奏之间的错配的抱怨。
en: Complaints about unfair Chinese trade practices, therefore, are actually complaints about the mismatch between the slow pace of economic opening and the very fast pace of modernization.

zh: 中国和经合组织国家之间的竞争力差距的填补速度远远快于监管环境的趋同速度。
en: The competitiveness gap between China and the OECD countries is closing much faster than the regulatory environment is converging.

zh: 事实上，总人口超过1亿人的中国多省人均GDP — — 因而代表着生产率 — — 已经类似于发发国家（以购买力平价计算，约在30,000美元 ） 。
en: In fact, per capita GDP – and thus productivity – in a number of Chinese provinces with a combined population of over 100 million is similar to that of advanced countries (around $30,000 per capita at purchasing power parity).

zh: 当然，全国平均水平要低得多（大约为这个数字的一半 ） ， 因为总体生产率要低得多，而中国当局必须在广袤的全国理顺政策。
en: Of course, the national average is much lower (about one-half), as overall productivity is much lower, and the Chinese authorities have to calibrate policies for their entire vast country.

zh: 但对外部世界来说，高生产率地区才是问题的重点。
en: But, for the outside world, the high-productivity regions are what matters.

zh: 要想避免紧张的进一步升级，西方和中国必须认识到彼此的角度。
en: If we are to avoid further escalation of tensions, the West and China must acknowledge each other’s perspectives.

zh: 但说到底，外国压力不会对中国巨大且强大的经济造成多少影响。
en: Ultimately, however, foreign pressure will have little effect on China’s massive and powerful economy.

zh: 对中国来说，真正的问题在国内：长期存在的扭曲和投资壁垒是否真的有利于落后省份的发展？
en: The real question for China lies at home: Do enduring distortions and barriers to investment really serve the development of the country’s lagging provinces?

zh: 在过去，保护沿海地区的新兴产业免受外国竞争也许很有意义。
en: In the past, it might have made sense to protect the nascent industries in the coastal regions from foreign competition.

zh: 但时至今日，中国的保护主义机制对于帮助贫穷内陆的信心产业几乎没有作用，因为它们的最大竞争对手不再是外国公司，而是来自充满活力的沿海地区的企业。
en: Today, however, China’s protectionist regime does little to help nascent industries in the poor interior, because their biggest competitors are no longer foreign companies, but rather firms from the dynamic coastal areas.

zh: 这意味着中国必须反思其发展战略。
en: This implies that China must rethink its very development strategy.

zh: 而对于这个问题，决策者最必须避免的就是贸易战。
en: And to do that, the last thing policymakers need is an ongoing trade war.

zh: 多极世界中的美国领导
en: American Leadership in a Multipolar World

zh: 伦敦—放弃闪光灯向来不易。
en: LONDON – Giving up the spotlight is never easy.

zh: 美国和许多上了年纪的名人一样，正在与新面孔争夺舞台，特别是中国。
en: The United States, like many aging celebrities, is struggling to share the stage with new faces, especially China.

zh: 即将到来的两大由美国及其西方盟友主导的机构 — — 国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行会议是一次改变这一局面的理想机会。
en: The upcoming meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank – two institutions dominated by the US and its Western allies – provide an ideal opportunity to change that.

zh: 美国必须面对世界已经改变的事实。
en: The US must come to terms with the reality that the world has changed.

zh: 美国越是否认这一点，对其利益以及全球影响力的伤害就越大。 目前美国的全球影响力依然强大，尽管受到了前所未有的制约。
en: The longer the US remains in a state of denial, the more damage it will do to its interests and its global influence, which remains substantial, if more constrained than before.

zh: 世界不再遵从静态的冷战秩序，即两大阵营公开而克制地针锋相对。
en: The world no longer adheres to the static Cold War order, with two blocs locked in open but guarded confrontation.

zh: 世界也不再遵从苏联解体后的十年中成为主导的“美式和平 ” （ Pax Americana ） ， 即美国成为唯一的超级大国。
en: Nor does it work according to the Pax Americana that dominated in the decade after the Soviet Union’s collapse, when the US briefly emerged as the sole superpower.

zh: 当今世界的基础是多极秩序，这一秩序来自发展中经济体 — — 其中最令人瞩目的是中国 — — 崛起为贸易和金融的重要行动方。
en: Today’s world is underpinned by a multipolar order, which emerged from the rise of developing economies – most notably China – as major actors in trade and finance.

zh: 美国 — — 以及其他G-7国家 — — 不但必须与中国竞争和合作，也必须通过G-20等扩大论坛与印度、巴西和其他国家竞争和合作。
en: The US – not to mention the other G-7 countries – now must compete and cooperate not only with China, but also with India, Brazil, and others through expanded forums like the G-20.

zh: 在这方面，美国必须表现出领导力和适应力。
en: To this end, the US must show leadership and adaptability.

zh: 美国不可拒绝支持中国扩大其在全球治理中的作用的努力。
en: It cannot refuse to support China’s efforts to expand its role in global governance.

zh: 美国也不应该因为盟友不对其言听计从而猛烈抨击，比如在英国宣布准备加入中国领导的新亚洲基础设施投资银行的时候。
en: Nor should it issue harsh rebukes to its allies when they do not follow suit, as it did when the United Kingdom announced its intention to join the new China-led Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank.

zh: 美国似乎沉迷于布雷顿森林体系无法自拔。 布雷顿森林体系是一套基于规则的秩序，其基础是以美元为核心的IMF和世界银行，出现于二战后。
en: The US seems to be stuck in the Bretton Woods system, the rules-based order – underpinned by the IMF and the World Bank, with the US dollar at its heart – that emerged after World War II.

zh: 布雷顿斯林体系将美国的地缘政治霸主地位制度化，而旧帝国力量英国只能靠边站 — — 姿态还算体面，虽然从其糟糕的战后经济状况看也带着一丝绝望。
en: The Bretton Woods system institutionalized America’s geopolitical supremacy, leaving the old imperial power, the UK, to step aside – a step that it took graciously, if a little desperately, given its grave postwar economic situation.

zh: 但是，随着时间的推移，布雷顿森林体系及其自由多边主义和市场经济政策相结合的特征已成为盎格鲁-美利坚主宰的全球经济的象征，如今受到了世界许多国家的批评，特别是在全球金融危机爆发后。
en: Over the years, however, the Bretton Woods system, with its mix of liberal multilateralism and market-oriented economic policies, has come to symbolize the Anglo-American dominance of the global economy that much of the world now criticizes, especially since the global financial crisis.

zh: 尤其是华盛顿共识 — — 影响IMF、世界银行、美国和英国政策的自由市场原则 — — 制造了大量不满，特别是在20世纪90年代亚洲金融危机后。
en: In particular, the Washington Consensus – the set of free-market principles that influences the policies of the IMF, the World Bank, the US, and the UK – has generated considerable resentment, especially after the Asian financial crisis of the 1990s.

zh: 在这一背景下，中国利用其不断增长的全球影响力引导新经济秩序 — — 一个美元不再拥有霸主地位的秩序 — — 不足为奇。
en: Against this backdrop, it is hardly surprising that China has been using its growing global influence to help engineer a new economic order – one in which the US dollar does not reign supreme.

zh: 中国人民银行行长周小川一再呼吁国际货币体系允许多重货币进行支付和投资。
en: Zhou Xiaochuan, the governor of the People’s Bank of China, China’s central bank, has repeatedly called for a shift toward an international monetary system that allows for the use of multiple currencies for payments and investment.

zh: 这一方针将降低流动性危机风险和影响，同时让国际货币体系不再与“单一国家的经济状况和主权利益”挂钩。
en: Such an approach would reduce the risk and impact of liquidity crises, while decoupling the international monetary system from the “economic conditions and sovereign interests of any single country.”

zh: 当然，中国认为它的人民币最终应该在新货币体系中起关键作用，以反映中国不但是全球经济增长引擎、也是世界最大债权国的地位。
en: Of course, China believes that its own currency, the renminbi, should eventually play a central role in this new monetary system, so that it reflects China’s role not only as a leading engine of global economic growth, but also as the world’s largest creditor.

zh: 事实上，中国与其他具系统重要性经济体（美国、英国、日本和欧元区）一道，驱动着远超其国界线的趋势（不论好坏）��
en: Indeed, together with the other systemically important economies (the US, the UK, Japan, and the eurozone) China drives trends that, for better or worse, extend far beyond its borders.

zh: 2009年以来，中国领导力一直在追求鼓励在地区贸易中使用人民币、降低其在国际支付中对美元的依赖的政策。
en: Since 2009, China’s leadership has been pursuing a set of policies that encourage the use of the renminbi in regional trade and reduce its dependence on the dollar in international payments.

zh: 但扩大人民币在国际货币体系中的角色只是通往多极世界秩序制度化的第一步。
en: But expanding the renminbi’s role in the international monetary system is just the first step toward institutionalizing a multipolar world order.

zh: 中国还牵头成立了新的多边机构，在亚投行之前还有其与其他主要新兴经济体（巴西、俄罗斯、印度和南非）共同建立的新开发银行。
en: China has also spearheaded the establishment of new multilateral institutions, with AIIB following on the heels of the New Development Bank, created with other major emerging economies (Brazil, Russia, India, and South Africa).

zh: 中国领导人通过实施这些步骤激发了人们对现有国际货币体系及其机构框架在当今复杂的多极世界经济中的不足之处的关注。
en: By taking these steps, China’s leaders have called attention to the inadequacy of the existing international monetary system, and its institutional framework, in today’s complex, multipolar world economy.

zh: 特别是中国的日程凸显出对美国是否有能力提供必要的流动性以支持国际贸易和金融的质疑。
en: In particular, China’s agenda highlights questions about America’s capacity to provide the needed liquidity to support international trade and finance.

zh: 平心而论，美国质疑中国希望构建的新秩序是否能与美国所领导的秩序一样公开并以规则为基础 — — 从而让中国获得实现其壮观经济崛起所需要的市场 — — 这是正确的。
en: To be sure, the US is right to wonder whether the new order that China hopes to build will be as open and rules-based as the American-led order – the one that gave China the market access it needed to achieve its spectacular economic rise.

zh: 但这一质疑的答案只能通过将中国纳入全球治理改革等问题来寻找，否认必要的改变无助于事。
en: But the answer to that question can be found only by engaging China on the issue of reform of global governance – not by denying that change is needed at all.

zh: 美国顽固地追求遏制中国 — — 其最近在亚投行的成立过程中从中作梗、其坚持不懈地指责中国货币操纵、其拒绝批准增加中国影响力的IMF都是明证 — — 这有可能使其丧失影响未来世界的能力。
en: As the US stubbornly pursues a policy of containment toward China – exemplified in its fight against the AIIB’s establishment, its relentless accusations of currency manipulation, and its refusal to ratify IMF reforms that would increase China’s influence – it risks losing its ability to shape what comes next.

zh: 其结果可能是一个四分五裂的世界 — — 这一结果不但会破坏全球繁荣，也会破坏面对共同挑战的合作。
en: The result could be a world of fragmented blocs – an outcome that would undermine not only global prosperity, but also cooperation on shared challenges.

zh: IMF和世界银行春季会议是一次表现新对华方针的重要机会。
en: The Spring Meetings of the IMF and the World Bank offer an important opportunity to signal a new approach toward China.

zh: 而最令人信服的喜好莫过于美国支持人民币加入IMF用于为其国际储备资产特别提款权计价的货币篮子。
en: And there could be no more credible signal than US support for the renminbi’s addition to the basket of currencies that the IMF uses to value its international reserve asset, the Special Drawing Right.

zh: 美国将再一次站在聚光灯下。
en: America will be in the spotlight once again.

zh: 但它会如何表现？
en: But how will it perform?

zh: 城市群竞争正帮助中国攻克发展困境
en: How Cities Are Saving China

zh: 香港—全球有效需求不足，世界正为寻找解决这个问题的合适方法而头痛。
en: HONG KONG – The world has a demand problem, and it is dealing with it all wrong.

zh: 中国需要尽力且充分地利用其在政策试点、长期规划和务实决策等方面的优势与能力，创造自己的有效需求，而不能听任其它国家的错误政策冲击而受到伤害。
en: Rather than allowing itself to be harmed by other countries’ problematic policies, China must work to create its own demand by making full use of its capacity for policy experimentation, long-term planning, and pragmatic decision-making.

zh: 2008年全球经济危机以来，发达经济体严重依赖宽松货币政策，希望通过大量的流动性和极低的利率来创造足够的需求及消灭过剩产能。
en: In the decade since the 2008 global economic crisis, advanced economies have leaned heavily on easy monetary policy, hoping that large amounts of liquidity and ultra-low interest rates would generate enough demand to eliminate excess capacity.

zh: 但这破坏了生产率增长，鼓励了投机，助长了资产泡沫，并加剧了收入和财富不平等。
en: But this has undermined productivity, encouraged speculative activity, fueled asset bubbles, and exacerbated income and wealth inequality.

zh: 发达国家的老百姓日益不满于这一状况，其政客 — — 特别是美国总统特朗普 — — 试图通过限制移民和贸易保护措施取悦选民。
en: As developed-country citizens have become increasingly frustrated with this state of affairs, politicians – in particular, US President Donald Trump – have attempted to appease them with immigration restrictions and protectionist trade measures.

zh: 这有可能暂时满足这些国家中的某些群体，但也将遏制全球需求，加剧结构性失衡（包括贸易失衡 ） ， 最终导致全球衰退，而让情况变得更糟。
en: But while this might temporarily satisfy some segments of these countries’ populations, it will ultimately make matters worse, by curbing global demand, exacerbating structural imbalances (including trade imbalances), and eventually leading to recession for all.

zh: 这些全球形势对中国影响甚大。 中国已成为特朗普政府关税的主要攻击目标，威胁要中国为全球产能过剩负责。
en: All of this has significant implications for China, which has become the primary target of the Trump administration’s tariffs, amid accusations that it is responsible for global excess production capacity.

zh: 在这样的情况下，中国急需降低对外需和过高固定资产投资水平的依赖，培养可持续的国内消费。
en: In this context, it is more urgent than ever that China curbs its reliance on foreign demand and high levels of investment, by fostering sustainable domestic consumption.

zh: 成功取决于中国继续运用其独特的“BREEP”探索策略（Browse, Research, Experiment, Evaluate, and Push ） ， 即决策者通过广泛考察（Browse ） 、 深入研究（Research ） 、 精心试点（Experiment ） 、 客观评估（Evaluate）和大力推进（Push）来发现及执行真正行之有效的政策，并不断地提炼和运用被实践检验有用的政策工具和执行策略。
en: Success will hinge on China’s continued use of what we call the “BREEP methodology,” whereby policymakers browse, research, experiment, evaluate, and push forward what works, continually refining and adapting their tools and tactics.

zh: 2000年以来，中国旨在提高收入、降低不平等、及保护环境的长期发展计划主要依靠的是企业创新和城市群发展这两个发动机和谐一致地推动。
en: Since 2000, China’s long-term plan for boosting incomes, reducing inequality, and protecting the environment has depended on the harmonious progression of innovation and urbanization.

zh: 中国特别希望通过打造绿色和高效的城市群来提高市民的受教育程度、生产力、收入水平等，以创造可持续的消费。
en: Specifically, China hopes to create green and efficient urban clusters populated by increasingly educated workers who can consume in a sustainable manner.

zh: 现有经济理论对于如何实现收入和生产率增长的良性循环（这是建设有活力而繁荣昌盛的城市群的关键）几乎没有指导作用。
en: Current economic theory gives little guidance on how to achieve the virtuous circle of rising income and rising productivity that is vital to dynamic and prosperous cities.

zh: 但运用自己土生土长的BREEP探索方法，中国学会了拒绝西方流行的一刀切经济发展理论，认识到促进城市间的竞争、试错、及多样化是探索及实现发展战略突破的很有价值的方法。
en: But, using its BREEP methodology, China has learned that rejecting one-size-fits-all approaches and promoting competition among cities is a valuable means of achieving breakthroughs in development strategies.

zh: 2010年，国务院划定三大城市群作为未来智能城市的试验场：长三角、珠三角和京津冀城市群。
en: In 2010, China’s State Council identified three major urban clusters as launch-pads for smart urbanization: the Yangtze River Delta (YRD), the Pearl River Delta (PRD), and the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei cluster (BTH).

zh: 2014年，珠三角扩大为粤港澳大湾区，覆盖广东南部珠三角九市及香港和澳门。
en: By 2014, the PRD had morphed into the Greater Bay Area (GBA), covering nine cities around the PRD in Southern Guangdong, plus Hong Kong and Macau.

zh: 最新的汇丰银行报告指出，中国三大城市群的GDP都超过了西班牙，到2025年，三大城市群将贡献中国GDP总量的45 % 。
en: As a recent HSBC report notes, each of China’s top three urban clusters has a GDP greater than that of Spain; together, they will account for 45% of China’s total GDP by 2025.

zh: 其中，大湾区人口最少，为7千万人，长三角有1.2亿人，京津冀有1.12亿人。
en: Of these, the GBA is the smallest by population, with 70 million inhabitants, compared with 120 million in the YRD and 112 million in the BTH.

zh: 但大湾区贡献了1.5万亿美元GDP（占中国GDP总量的12 % ） ，以及中国37%的出口。
en: Yet the GBA contributes $1.5 trillion to China’s GDP – a total of 12% – and accounts for 37% of the country’s total exports.

zh: 大湾区的GDP增长也显著高于中国其他地区。
en: And the cluster’s GDP growth is significantly higher than the rest of China.

zh: 大湾区集中了众多很有活力的民营企业，如腾讯、美的、华为等，也是中国最有创新力的城市群，创造了中国50%以上的国际专利申请。
en: The GBA is home to a high concentration of dynamic private businesses, such as Tencent, Midea, and Huawei. It is also China’s most innovative urban cluster, generating more than 50% of the country’s international patent applications.

zh: 据汇丰银行报告，大湾区也是国企最少和过剩产能负担最轻的地区。
en: And, according to HSBC, the GBA is the least burdened by inefficient state-owned enterprises and excess capacity.

zh: 原因很简单，与其他地区相比，大湾区的市场导向要强烈得多，香港和澳门的对外开放程度比其他中国城市高很多。
en: The reason is simple: the GBA is far more market-oriented than its counterparts, with Hong Kong and Macau much more open to the outside world than any other Chinese cities.

zh: 香港和澳门不但能带来更自由的货物、服务、资本、技术、人才和资源在全球的流动，还符合监管、商业行为、软基础设施、甚至生活方式等各个方面的国际标准。
en: Both cities not only permit the freer flow of goods, services, capital, technology, talent, and resources, but also meet global standards in terms of regulations, business practices, soft infrastructure, and even lifestyles.

zh: 当然，中国不会满足于几个成功的城市群；相反，她正致力于在全国推广经验。
en: Of course, China’s leaders are not content simply to rest on the laurels of their successful urban clusters; on the contrary, they are working to apply their lessons across the country.

zh: 比如，从2013年开始，国家发改委深入大湾区最有活力的城市之一佛山开展调研，并总结经验，准备以更好、更创新的战略进一步发展大湾区。
en: For example, beginning in 2013, China’s National Development and Reform Commission studied in-depth lessons from Foshan, one of the GBA’s most dynamic cities, in order to plan the further development of the cluster with better and more innovative strategies.

zh: 发改委广泛考察了世界银行、麦肯锡（McKinsey）和其他机构的智能城市发展研究，以获得关于城市群及产业链如何支持经济增长和技术创新的洞见，并直接与地方官员、投资者和外国专家开展深入交流与合作。
en: The NDRC browsed studies on smart urbanization by the World Bank, McKinsey, and others, in order to gain insight into how clustering could support economic growth and innovation. To augment their research, NDRC planners worked directly with local officials, investors, and foreign experts.

zh: 广泛考察及深入调研之后是精心试点，成立了上海自由贸易区和前海-蛇口自由贸易试验区等特区以便先行先试。
en: Then the experimentation phase began, with the establishment of the Shanghai Free-Trade Zone and the Qianhai-Shekou Pilot Free-Trade Zone.

zh: 在对这些试点的客观评估之后，又宣布建立更多的自由贸易区，包括雄安新区。 雄安新区是一个雄心勃勃的多样化试点计划，意欲利用尖端技术，将京津周边相对落后的河北地区变成充满活力的中国北方绿色样板城市。
en: Evaluations of those experiences led to last year’s announcement of more FTZs, as well as the Xiong’an New Area, an ambitious plan to transform – using cutting-edge technology – dusty plains in Hebei near Beijing and Tianjin into a dynamic green model city.

zh: 事实上，中国目前正在强化全国各个城市之间的相互联系，以打造19个“超级城市群 ” 。
en: In fact, China is currently creating 19 “supercity clusters,” by strengthening the links among cities.

zh: 汇丰银行预测，到2030年这些超级城市群将贡献中国GDP的80%左右。
en: By 2030, HSBC projects, those clusters will account for about 80% of the country’s GDP.

zh: 在受到贸易战威胁的严峻国际形势下，中国应该致力于进一步提高已经取得成功的城市群的升级发展，特别是粤港澳大湾区。
en: China should also work to foster even faster growth in urban clusters that are already successful.

zh: 在大湾区内，香港拥有多所世界前100名大学，在基础研究方面比较优势明显。
en: Within the GBA, Hong Kong, home to several of the world’s top 100 universities, has a clear comparative advantage in basic research.

zh: 与此同时，深圳、东莞、佛山和其他大湾区城市也有很强的创新动力、市场导向的研发和制造能力。
en: Meanwhile, Shenzhen, Dongguan, Foshan, and other GBA cities have a strong capacity for innovative market-oriented research and development as well as manufacturing.

zh: 因此，改善大湾区内部的连通融合能够改善并支持区内复杂高效供应链上每一个环节的创新与效率，从而创造适合中国14亿消费者，并适应全球市场的好产品。
en: Improving connectivity within the GBA will thus support innovation in each segment of the supply chain, which can lead to products that can be sold to China’s 1.4 billion consumers and adapted to global markets.

zh: 贸易战威胁或许对中国不是什么好消息，但其本身并不会拖垮中国经济。
en: The threat of a trade war may not be good news for China, but it will not bring down the economy.

zh: 中国所面临的真正挑战是如何利用大湾区等充满活力的超级城市群之间的竞争与合作来探索未来中国的可持续发展：也就是在创造经济增长的同时，以金融和环境可持续的方式来解决不平等和产能过剩等结构性挑战。
en: The real challenge China faces is to take advantage of dynamic urban clusters like the GBA not only to generate growth, but also to address structural challenges like inequality and excess capacity in financially and environmentally sustainable ways.

zh: 为何中国城市将驱动全球增长
en: Why China’s Cities Will Drive Global Growth

zh: 上海—15年来，中国一直是全球增长的关键引擎。
en: SHANGHAI – For 15 years, China has been a key engine of global growth.

zh: 但随着中国的投资拉动繁荣动力告罄，后续经济增长 — — 不管是中国还是全世界 — — 将取决于中国消费者。
en: But now that China’s investment-led boom has run its course, continued economic growth – in China and globally – will depend on urban Chinese consumers.

zh: 到2030年，生活在城市中的居民将贡献91%的全球消费增长，而中国正在同时强调城镇化和消费拉动的增长模式。
en: By 2030, people living in cities will drive 91% of global growth in consumption, and China is emphasizing both urbanization and a consumer-led growth model.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所（MGI）的最新研究对于中国战略能取得成功十分乐观。
en: The McKinsey Global Institute’s latest research is optimistic that China’s strategy will succeed.

zh: MGI（我们其中之一是其合伙人）预测城市消费者数量和收入将继续增长，从现在到2030年，700座中国城市将产生7万亿美元或30%的全球城市消费增长。
en: MGI (where one of us is a partner) foresees continued growth in the number and income of urban consumers, and predicts that 700 Chinese cities will generate $7 trillion, or 30%, of global urban consumption growth between now and 2030.

zh: 如今，中国城镇工作年龄消费者数量为5.21亿；不出15年，这一数字将膨胀到6.28亿。
en: Today, China’s urban working-age consumers number 521 million; in just 15 years, their ranks will have swollen to 628 million.

zh: 北京、广州、上海和深圳将各自增加一百万以上年收入超70,000美元的家庭 — — 相当于目前达到这一收入水平的香港家庭总数。
en: Beijing, Guangzhou, Shanghai, and Shenzhen will each add more than one million households with annual income above $70,000 – the number of Hong Kong households in that income bracket today.

zh: 2030年人均支出预计将从4,800美元猛增至10,700美元，届时，该群体将贡献全世界城市消费总额的12 % 。
en: Per capita spending is set to jump from $4,800 to $10,700 by 2030, at which point this group will spend 12 cents of every $1 of urban consumption worldwide.

zh: 如今，中国城镇收入正接近商品和服务支出迅速加速的阈值。
en: Urban incomes in China are now reaching a threshold where spending on both goods and services accelerates rapidly.

zh: 用于个人产品和“下馆子”的年家庭支出将增长一倍以上， 分别达到770美元和720美元。
en: Annual household spending on personal products and on dining out will more than double, to $770 and $720, respectively.

zh: 中国消费者也将更多地参与旅游活动，中国出境游研究所预测，到2020年，将有1亿多中国人出国旅游。
en: Chinese consumers are also traveling more, with the China Outbound Tourism Research Institute predicting that more than 100 million Chinese will travel abroad by 2020.

zh: 中国的新消费大军有花钱的途径，更重要的是，他们也有意愿把提高的收入花掉。
en: China’s new consumer army will have the means and, more important, the willingness to spend its higher earnings.

zh: 麦肯锡2016年全球情绪调查表明，在26个国家的22,000多民给消费者中，中国工作年龄人口的收入增量消费倾向 — — 而非储蓄或用于偿还债务 — — 为全球最高。
en: According to McKinsey’s 2016 Global Sentiment Survey of more than 22,000 consumers in 26 countries, China’s working-age population has the world’s highest propensity to spend additional income, rather than save it or use it to pay off debt.

zh: 正如西方的婴儿潮一代，中国城镇消费者 — — 他们生长于改革年代，与父辈有着不同的储蓄和消费观 — — 与过去有着代际差异。
en: Just like Western baby boomers, Chinese urban consumers – who have grown up in post-reform China and have different views from their parents about saving versus spending – will make a generational break from the past.

zh: 这一思维的变化将推动中国向消费拉动型经济转变。
en: That shift in mindset will fuel China’s transition to a consumer-led economy.

zh: 中国的工作年龄消费者是数字时代的孩子，他们通过直接与公司互动助其重新发明产品和服务来推动创新。
en: China’s working-age consumers, as children of the digital age, are driving innovation by interacting directly with companies to help reinvent products and services.

zh: 在麦肯锡的调查中，55%的这一群体表示愿意通过微信向朋友或家人推荐产品、服务或公司。
en: In a McKinsey survey, 55% of them said that they would be willing to recommend a product, service, or company to their friends or family on the social network WeChat.

zh: 中国智能手机厂商小米直接利用消费者在线调查来研究他们希望看到怎样的创新。
en: Xiaomi, the Chinese smartphone company, conducts direct online polling of consumers to find out what innovations they would like to see.

zh: 该公司在微博上拥有数千万“粉丝 ” 。
en: The company has more than ten million “fans” on Weibo, the microblogging platform.

zh: 现在，西方公司也开始跟进。
en: And now Western companies are following suit.

zh: 大众汽车公司与潜在客户进行在线直接互动，而不只是单纯地依靠经销商。
en: Volkswagen’s China operation engages with potential customers directly online, rather than relying solely on traditional dealerships.

zh: 冯氏集团（我们其中之一为其常务董事）与IBM和Pico合作，在上海成立了“零售实验室 ” ， 为企业提供可控设置实时观察消费者如何响应新技术和产品。
en: The Fung Group (where one of us is a managing director), in partnership with IBM and Pico, has set up a “retail laboratory” in Shanghai to provide a controlled setting for businesses to observe – in real time – how consumers react to new technologies and products.

zh: 除了推动进一步创新，中国消费者 — — 即使收入相对较低 — — 对于投资下一代也毫不含糊，预计在2015到2030年间，12.5%的总消费增长将用于教育。
en: In addition to driving further innovation, Chinese consumers – even those with relatively low incomes – are also investing heavily in the next generation, with 12.5% of overall consumption growth expected to go to education between 2015 and 2030.

zh: 这在MGI所调查的所有国家中名列第二，仅次于瑞典（12.6 % ） 。
en: That’s the second-highest rate of any country MGI examined, behind only Sweden (12.6%).

zh: 通过从现在开始投资于下一代的技能和能力，中国消费者正在为未来持续增长和创新构建强大的基础。
en: By investing in the skills and capacity of the next generation now, Chinese consumers are building a strong foundation for continued growth and innovation in the future.

zh: 这一持续增长需要中国经济模式进一步从生产转向消费。
en: That continued growth will require China to shift its economic model further from production to consumption.

zh: 这样的转型向来不易，前途挑战重重。
en: No pivot of this kind is easy, and many challenges lie ahead.

zh: 但中国日益兴旺、教育程度日益提高、信心日益高涨的消费者有实力 — — 也具备足够大的数量 — — 改变全世界花钱的方式，也许比西方婴儿潮一代年轻时还要强大。
en: But China’s increasingly prosperous, educated, and confident consumers have the clout – and the numbers – to transform the way the world spends, possibly even more than Western baby boomers did in their prime.

zh: 他们的网购第一的购物习惯、对旅游和新体验的开放态度以及不断提升的购买力表明，他们所购买的产品和服务将影响全世界的消费市场，助推全球经济增长。
en: Their mobile-first shopping habits, openness to travel and new experiences, and rising purchasing power suggest that the products and services they buy will influence consumer markets worldwide, fueling global economic growth.

zh: 世界经济需要他们 — — 任何面向消费者的公司可以忽视他们。
en: The world economy needs them – and no consumer-facing company can afford to ignore them.

zh: 亚洲博弈非零和
en: Asian Games Are Not Zero-Sum

zh: 美国剑桥—两个贵妇彼此为敌。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Two society hostesses are rivals.

zh: 她们都激烈地捍卫自己的社会地位 — — 甚至以不再邀请作为对出席另一位女主人的派对的客人的威胁。
en: Both guard their social standing jealously – and may even punish a guest who attends the other’s party by withholding future invitations.

zh: 中国和美国看待亚太关系就是如此：零和博弈。
en: China and the United States seem to regard Asia-Pacific relations similarly: as a zero-sum game.

zh: 各国要在中国的亚洲基础设施投资银行（亚投行）还是美国的跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP）上签字？
en: Are countries signing up for China’s Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB), or for America’s Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP)?

zh: 中国说服国际货币基金组织（IMF）将人民币纳入其账户单位 — — 特别提款权（SDR）的尝试会获得欢迎，还是被耻辱性地拒绝？
en: Will China be welcomed, or humiliatingly rebuffed, in its effort to persuade the International Monetary Fund to include the renminbi in its unit of account, Special Drawing Rights (SDR)?

zh: 美国还是世界最大经济体地位吗？ 2014年中国到底有没有超过它？
en: Is the US still the world’s largest economy, or did China surpass it in 2014?

zh: 关注这些问题很有诱惑力，但这些都是思考全球经济的错误思路。
en: However tempting it may be to focus on such questions, they are the wrong way to think about the global economy.

zh: 没有理由认为某些国家不应该同时加入中国的亚投行和美国的TPP，也没有理由认为成员资格的重合现象不应该随时间的推移而扩大 — — 或者说，事实上，没有理由认为女主人应该永不参加彼此的派对。
en: There is no reason why some countries should not join both China’s AIIB and America’s TPP, or why overlapping memberships should not expand over time – or, indeed, why the hostesses should not eventually attend each other’s parties.

zh: 不幸的是，当前的全球经济治理问题并不是这样推进的。
en: Unfortunately, that is not how current issues of global economic governance are being framed.

zh: 3月份，英国、德国、韩国、澳大利亚和其他国家出人意料地决定加入亚投行，这让很多媒体将此报道为（部分拜美国决策者的失策所赐）美国盟友集体投敌。
en: When the United Kingdom, Germany, South Korea, Australia, and others unexpectedly decided in March to join the AIIB, it was widely reported (partly because of missteps by US policymakers) as a mass defection of US allies to a rival’s party.

zh: 但加入亚投行一点都没错。
en: But there is nothing wrong with joining the AIIB.

zh: 亚洲需要比世界银行和亚洲开发银行所能提供的更多的基础设施投资帮助；中国可以起到有用的领导作用；而高治理水平国家的参与有助于防止大规模基础设施工程容易产生的裙带、腐败和环境破坏问题。
en: Asia needs more help with infrastructure investment than the World Bank and the Asian Development Bank can provide; China can play a useful leadership role; and the participation of countries with high governance standards can help prevent the cronyism, corruption, and environmental damage to which large-scale infrastructure projects are prone.

zh: 类似地，TPP谈判有时被认为是美国孤立中国的尝试。
en: Likewise, the TPP negotiations are sometimes characterized as a US attempt to isolate China.

zh: 但是，考虑到亚太地区巨大的贸易量以及各个方向上的为数众多的贸易协议，没有一个国家（包括中国）可以被孤立。
en: But, given the Asia-Pacific region’s high trade volumes, and its dense set of trading arrangements running in every direction, no one, including China, is about to be isolated.

zh: 此外，所有国家都可以参与的世界贸易组织谈判已经停滞了多年，因此TPP和其他地区协议（如亚太经合组织和各种内亚自由贸易区）至少聊胜于无。
en: And, with World Trade Organization negotiations, in which all countries could participate, stalled for years, the TPP and other regional initiatives (like Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation and various intra-Asia free-trade areas) are better than nothing.

zh: 汇率是另一个零和思维盛行的领域。
en: Exchange rates are another area where zero-sum thinking prevails.

zh: 4月9日，美国财政部发布了国会授权的双年报，报告中列出了参与“货币操纵”的国家名单。
en: On April 9, the US Treasury released the biannual report mandated by Congress to identify countries engaging in “currency manipulation.”

zh: 这一次，中国和其他任何国家都未被认定“有罪 ” 。
en: Neither China nor anyone else was found guilty this time.

zh: 但财政部官员认为他们必须保持压力，唯恐国会坚持要惩罚被认定实施货币操纵的国家，导致TPP和其他贸易协议破产。
en: But Treasury officials believe that they must keep up the pressure, lest Congress follow through on threats to punish supposed currency manipulators, derailing the TPP and other trade agreements.

zh: 然后是SDR问题。
en: Then there is the SDR.

zh: 每五年，IMF都会修订SDR成分，目前SDR由美元、欧元、日元和英镑组成。
en: Every five years, the IMF reconsiders its composition, which currently is defined in terms of the dollar, euro, yen, and pound.

zh: 眼下人民币不可能被纳入SDR货币篮子，因为它无法“自由使用 ” 。
en: China’s renminbi is unlikely to be included in the basket now, because it is not “freely usable.”

zh: 此外，尽管这可能被认为是对中国的一次打击，但并非如此。
en: And, though this will likely be reported as a defeat for China, it should not be.

zh: 这个问题根本无关紧要。
en: The issue is of little importance.

zh: 看起来，所有这些都可以一笑了之，把它们当做无害媒体的夸张报道。
en: It might seem that all of this could be shrugged off as a harmless media spectator sport.

zh: 但是，由于错误地把注意力放在国家排名上已成为明智决策的一大障碍，这完全可能造成真正的伤害。
en: But, to the extent that a misplaced focus on country rankings becomes a barrier to sensible policy, it can do real damage.

zh: IMF配额改革就是这样一个排名确实有一定重要性，但并非一定零和的问题。
en: Such is the case with the stalled IMF quota reform, an issue where the rankings in fact are of some importance, but not in a zero-sum way.

zh: 不管用何种经济重要性衡量标准，中国和其他主要新兴经济体都早已应该获得更大的IMF配额比例，即更大的融资贡献和更大的投票比重。
en: By any measure of economic importance, China and other major emerging economies have long since merited much larger IMF quota shares, implying greater financial contributions and greater voting weights.

zh: 但它们的比例的增加并不一定需要以美国为代价。
en: But their increase in shares need not come at the expense of the US.

zh: 代表权大大过高的是欧洲国家。
en: It is the European countries that are greatly over-represented.

zh: 尽管欧洲不愿让步，但美国总统成功地在2010年11月G-20首尔峰会上促成了IMF配额比例的再分配。
en: Despite European reluctance to cede ground, US President Barack Obama succeeded in brokering such a reallocation of IMF quota shares at the G-20 summit in Seoul in November 2010.

zh: 五年后，美国国会仍拒不批准IMF配额改革 — — 不是因为这意味着权力损失或美国纳税人损失，而是因为许多议员不愿意让奥巴马得偿所愿。
en: Five years later, the US Congress is still holding up IMF quota reform – not because it would imply any loss of power or cost to US taxpayers, but because many members do not want to give Obama anything he asks for.

zh: 三十年前，西方最大的愿望就是中国变成资本主义经济。
en: Thirty years ago, the West wanted nothing more than for China to become a capitalist economy.

zh: 中国已经变成了资本主义经济，并且取得了极大的成功。
en: It has done so, with spectacular success.

zh: 如今，游戏规则要求中国在国际机构治理上获得更大的比例。
en: The rules of the game now require that China be given a bigger share in the governance of international institutions.

zh: 营造谈判空间有利于在最重要的“博弈 ” — —世界和平与繁荣中的其他人。
en: Making room at the table will help the rest of us in the “game” that matters most: world peace and prosperity.

zh: 如果国会不通过IMF配额改革，美国将难以指责中国另起炉灶建立亚投行等机构。
en: If the Congress does not pass the IMF quota reform, the US can hardly blame the Chinese for undertaking initiatives such as the AIIB on their own.

zh: 我们常常耳闻硬实力（军事）和软实力（一国思想、文化、经济制度等方面的吸引力 ） 。
en: We often hear about hard power (military) and soft power (the attractiveness of a country’s ideas, culture, economic system, and so forth).

zh: 但还有另一种实力。
en: But there is another kind of power.

zh: 自布雷顿森林以来，美国一直拥有全球领导实力。
en: Ever since Bretton Woods, the US has had the power of global leadership.

zh: 在两次大战期间（1919—1939年 ） ， 美国人还没有做好承担责任的准备；但二战让他们领略了孤立主义的代价，1944年，他们终于迎难而上。
en: During the interwar period (1919-1939), Americans were unprepared to assume that mantle; but World War II taught them the cost of isolationism, and they rose to the challenge in 1944.

zh: 七十年后，即使美国在伊拉克和其他地区犯下了严重的外交政策错误，即使中国GDP据称已经赶上美国（至少从购买力平价角度是如此 ） ， 世界仍准备接受美国的领导，包括在贸易和IMF改革等关键问题上。
en: Seventy years later, even after America’s massive foreign-policy mistakes in Iraq and elsewhere, and even after Chinese GDP has supposedly caught up with America’s (at least in terms of purchasing power parity), the world remains ready to be led by the US, including on the crucial subjects of trade and IMF reform.

zh: 如果热衷计分派得势，美国将无法行使世界所需要的领导力。
en: If those who insist on scorekeeping have their way, the US will be unable to exercise the leadership that the world needs.

zh: 而世界将把目光转下他处。
en: And the world will look elsewhere.

zh: 世界的重组
en: The Restructuring of the World

zh: 米兰 — — 全球经济正在经历具有深刻影响的转型。
en: MILAN – The global economy is undergoing a far-reaching transformation.

zh: 各国人员、生产率、财富、权力和志向的改变催生了变化，而美国总统唐纳德·特朗普重塑供应链结构、改变跨境投资激励机制以及限制人员和技术跨境流动的各项举措则加速了这样的转型。
en: Change is being driven by shifts in countries’ populations, productivity, wealth, power, and ambitions, and accelerated by US President Donald Trump’s moves to reshape supply-chain structures, alter cross-border investment incentives, and limit the movement of people and technology across borders.

zh: 上述改变所造成的紧张局势明确体现在贸易争端的不断升级中。
en: The tensions that these changes are producing are most apparent in escalating disputes over trade.

zh: 尽管新兴经济体出现了某些混乱，但迄今为止市场对这种针锋相对收取关税的反应仍然相对柔和。
en: Notwithstanding some dislocations in emerging economies, markets’ reaction to the tit-for-tat tariffs so far has been only muted.

zh: 投资者可能认为这仅仅是重新谈判过程的组成部分，而上述重新谈判过程将最终制定全球商业接触的新规则 — — 而这种规则可能更有利于强者 。
en: Investors probably assume that it is all just part of a renegotiation process that will ultimately produce new rules of engagement for global business – rules that are even more favorable to the powerful.

zh: 但上述假设可能低估了问题的复杂性，其中首当其冲的就是投资和就业在何处创造的政治敏感事务。
en: But such assumptions may underestimate the complexity of the issues at play, beginning with the politically salient matter of where investment and employment are created.

zh: 就其本身而言，如果将关税和贸易壁垒视为短暂的谈判策略，将不会显著改变全球投资模式或全球供应链及就业结构。
en: On their own, tariff and trade barriers, if viewed as transitory negotiating tactics, will not significantly change global investment patterns or the structure of global supply chains and employment.

zh: 特朗普等保护主义者认为，关税和其他贸易壁垒的力量在于能够遏制作弊和搭便车。
en: Protectionists like Trump argue that the power of tariffs and other trade barriers lies in their ability to curb cheating and free-riding.

zh: 这意味着这些措施有助于消除与全球化相关的紧张局势、不平衡和两极分化。
en: The implication is that such measures can help to eliminate the tensions, imbalances, and polarization associated with globalization.

zh: 当然“作弊”是旁观者的看法。
en: “Cheating,” of course, is in the eye of the beholder.

zh: 针对特定行业的国家补贴，包括国有企业的优惠待遇，均有可能被视为作弊的举动。
en: State subsidies for specific sectors, including preferential treatment of state-owned enterprises, may be regarded as cheating.

zh: 同样可能被视为作弊的还有要求以技术转让换取市场准入、偏向于国内实体的公共采购、接受不安全的工作环境及剥削性的劳动行为，还有汇率操纵。
en: So may requiring technology transfer in exchange for market access, public procurement favoring domestic entities, acceptance of unsafe work environments and exploitative labor practices, and exchange-rate manipulation.

zh: 搭便车的界定方法是相对于一个国家的能力，它是否对提供全球公共产品，如国防和安全、科学和技术知识、减缓气候变化和吸收难民所做的贡献太少。
en: The test of free-riding is whether a country contributes too little, relative to its capacity, to the provision of global public goods, such as defense and security, scientific and technical knowledge, mitigation of climate change, and absorption of refugees.

zh: 以上问题成就了搭便车者。
en: The culprits depend on the topic in question.

zh: 但无论作弊或搭便车带来何等危害，处理这些行为都不太可能令导致经济、社会和政治两极化的条件彻底解除。
en: But whatever the downsides to cheating or free-riding, tackling these behaviors is unlikely to eliminate the conditions that have contributed to economic, social, and political polarization.

zh: 毕竟，劳动套利一直都是全球供应链组织至少三十年来的核心驱动力 — — 当然，随着中国崛起带来的重大分配和就业效应，劳动套利的核心动力一直在加速。
en: After all, labor arbitrage has been the core driver of the organization of global supply chains for at least three decades – accelerating, of course, with China’s rise – with significant distributional and employment effects.

zh: 假使中国和其他新兴经济体遵守世贸组织规定，就认定它们融入全球经济所带来的分配效应会就此消失似乎不太可能。
en: It seems unlikely that, had China and other emerging economies adhered to the letter of World Trade Organization rules, the distributional effects of their integration into the global economy would have disappeared.

zh: 那么关税的真正目的是什么？
en: What, then, is the real purpose of the tariffs?

zh: 特朗普感兴趣的或许只是公平竞争，在实现公平竞争的情况下他将接受全球市场结果。
en: Trump could be interested only in leveling the playing field, at which point he will accept global market outcomes.

zh: 但更合理的是，这仅仅是其战略的组成部分 — — 越来越多国家的领导人开始呼应上述战略 — — 那就是通过主张国家优先和主权来赢得选票。
en: But it is more plausible that this is all part of his strategy – echoed by leaders in a growing number of countries worldwide – to win support by asserting national priorities and sovereignty.

zh: 上述努力正在推动世界日益巴尔干化。
en: Such efforts are pushing the world toward a more balkanized system.

zh: 此外，技术进步，特别是数字技术在国家安全和经济表现方面所带来的挑战和担忧也在驱使世界各国进一步走向分散化。
en: Moreover, the challenges and fears raised by advances in technology, especially digital technology, with regard to both national security and economic performance are also propelling the world toward greater fragmentation.

zh: 15年前，很少有人能够预测像谷歌或领书这样的大型平台将成为图像识别、人工智能和自动驾驶汽车（包括军用汽车）研发领域的关键参与者。
en: Fifteen years ago, few would have predicted that mega-platforms like Google or Facebook would become key players in areas like image recognition, artificial intelligence, and the development of autonomous vehicles (including military vehicles).

zh: 但事实是这样的情况的确发生了。
en: Yet that is exactly what has happened.

zh: 事实上，谷歌现在已成为一家国防承包商（尽管它可能不会续签合同 ） 。
en: In fact, Google is now a defense contractor (though it may not renew its contract).

zh: 鉴于上述研发的安全影响，以及诸如数据隐私和安全、社会分裂及外国干预选举等一系列问题，各国不愿放弃监管互联网。
en: Given the security implications of these developments, as well as a host of issues like data privacy and security, social fragmentation, and foreign interventions in elections, countries are unwilling to leave the Internet unregulated.

zh: 但他们同样不愿将监管委托给一个超国家机构。
en: But they are also unwilling to delegate regulation to a supra-national body.

zh: 结果导致许多国家将权力掌控在自己手中，从而使各国在互联网监管方面的分歧日益加大。
en: As a result, many are taking matters into their own hands, leading to a growing divergence among countries regarding Internet regulation.

zh: 为体现上述计划的国家安全倾向，美国外国投资委员会的权力和监管范围 — — 该机构负责审查外国对美国企业或业务所有权的国家安全影响 — — 最近得到了扩大。
en: Reflecting the national-security tilt of these initiatives, the scope and authority of the Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States – responsible for reviewing the national-security implications of foreign ownership of US companies or operations – has recently been expanded.

zh: 尽管做出了这些努力，但现实依然是创新无法轻易被国家边境所阻挡。
en: Despite these efforts, however, the fact remains that innovation cannot easily be blocked by national borders.

zh: 相反，未来全球化最重要的领域可能就是思想的传播。
en: On the contrary, the diffusion of ideas may well become the most consequential dimension of globalization in the future.

zh: 虽然这可能加剧国家安全计划的复杂性，但也创造出巨大的商业新机遇，尽管面临着强劲的贸易逆风。
en: While this may complicate national-security planning, it represents powerful new opportunities for business, even as trade faces headwinds.

zh: 现在已经出现了大量创新的数字化商业模式，尤其是在新兴经济体，其中不少可以成为包容性发展的强劲引擎。
en: Already, there has been an explosion of innovative, digitally-based business models, many of which could become powerful engines of inclusive growth, especially in emerging economies.

zh: 拥有巨大经济潜力的新兴模式的一个例子是具有开放式构架和低门槛的数字化生态系统。
en: Digitally-enabled ecosystems, with open architecture and low barriers to entry, are one example of an emerging model with considerable economic potential.

zh: 还有一种关键力量将决定未来数十年全球经济将如何发展：那就是中美之间的战略竞争。
en: There is one more crucial dynamic that will shape how the global economy will develop in the coming decades: the strategic rivalry between China and the US.

zh: 目前为止，还无法准确预测双方竞争所采取的形式。
en: At this point, it is impossible to say precisely what form this rivalry will take.

zh: 但显而易见的是，全球经济的每个组成部分都将受到合作及竞争组合的影响。
en: What is clear is that every part of the global economy will be affected by the mix of cooperation and competition that emerges.

zh: 面对强大的竞争对手，人们可能期待美国会推行一种战略 — — 重点是建立、扩大并巩固与天然盟友的联盟 — — 也就是说那些具有类似治理结构并对国际合作和开放市场所带来的好处持相同见解的国家。
en: In the face of a powerful rival, one might expect the US to pursue a strategy focused on building, expanding, and consolidating alliances with natural allies – that is, countries with similar governance structures and shared views about the benefits of international cooperation and open markets.

zh: 相反，特朗普却疏远了长期盟友并攻击多边框架和机构，并同时在迅速演变为双方敌对的局面下对抗中国。
en: Instead, Trump has alienated longtime allies and attacked multilateral structures and institutions, all while antagonizing China in what is quickly becoming a two-player game.

zh: 这一策略十分怪异。
en: This is a bizarre strategy.

zh: 无论特朗普认为通过对抗天然盟友能够得到什么样的好处，但与由此造成的损失相比都将相形见绌。
en: Whatever advantage Trump thinks he will gain by positioning the US in opposition to its natural allies will be dwarfed by the losses.

zh: 美国及其传统盟友间的分裂如果成为全球新秩序的永久特点，必将导致世界市场民主国家陷入更深的分裂之中。
en: A split between the US and its traditional allies, if it becomes a permanent feature of the new global order, would lead to deeper fragmentation among the world’s market-oriented democracies.

zh: 随着中国稳步成为世界最大的经济体，这无疑将会朝着有利于中国的方向改变长期的权力平衡。
en: That will surely shift the long-term balance of power in China’s favor, as it moves steadily toward becoming the world’s largest economy.

zh: 在危险的世界中优化决策
en: Optimizing Decision-Making in a Dangerous World

zh: 剑桥城和纽约 — — 美中两国在双边关系中抵达了一个危险时刻。
en: CAMBRIDGE AND NEW YORK – The United States and China have reached a precarious moment in their relationship.

zh: 21世纪最大的地缘政治挑战将是确保一个和平的结果。
en: Ensuring a peaceful outcome will be the greatest geopolitical challenge of the twenty-first century.

zh: 我们的领导人是否能够完成这项任务？
en: Are our leaders up to it?

zh: 今天的局面是，风险似乎正在升级当中。
en: As things stand today, the risks seem only to be escalating.

zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府已经就与朝鲜的金融关系强制实施了对中国机构的经济制裁，因为它不相信中国已经为约束朝鲜政权做得足够多。
en: US President Donald Trump’s administration has imposed economic sanctions on Chinese entities with financial ties to North Korea, because it does not believe that China has done enough to constrain the North Korean regime.

zh: 而且，特朗普直言不讳的表示，如果中国不管束朝鲜，这项工作就由他来做。
en: And, as Trump has said bluntly, if the Chinese don’t deal with North Korea, he will.

zh: 随着朝鲜离研制出能够打到美国大陆的核导弹越来越近，特朗普威胁将用“世界从未见过的战火和愤怒”来摧毁这个国家。
en: As North Korea inches closer to developing a nuclear-tipped missile that can hit the continental US, Trump has threatened the country with “fire and fury like the world has never seen.”

zh: 中国方面否认其外交部所谓的“中国对朝负责论 ” 。
en: China, for its part, rejects what its foreign ministry has called the “China responsibility theory” regarding North Korea.

zh: 中国一份官方报纸发表社论称尽管中国在朝鲜首先发起攻击的情况下会保持中立，但美国以政权更迭为目标的打击行动将会导致中国介入。
en: A recent editorial in a Chinese state-run newspaper asserted that while China would stay neutral if North Korea attacked first, US strikes aimed at regime change would cause China to intervene.

zh: 中国还愤怒地回应了美国海军舰艇上月通过南海争议水域，中国外交部称此举为严重损害中国主权和安全的“挑衅行为 ” 。
en: The Chinese also responded furiously to the passage of a US naval warship through disputed waters in the South China Sea last month, a move that the foreign ministry called a “provocation” that “severely undermines China’s sovereignty and security.”

zh: 虽然这些问题才刚刚出现，但背后的政治动态实际却由来已久。
en: While these issues are modern, the underlying political dynamic is not new.

zh: 在描述古希腊一次类似的权力斗争时，历史学家修昔底德写道 ， “ 恰恰是雅典的崛起及其带给斯巴达的恐惧，导致了不可避免的战争爆发。 ”
en: Describing a similar power struggle in classical Greece, the historian Thucydides wrote that, “It was the rise of Athens, and the fear that this instilled in Sparta, that made war inevitable.”

zh: 在岁月的长河中，所谓的修昔底德陷阱曾一再出现，加剧了崛起和执政大国之间的关系紧张，导致本来可控的事件推动行动及反制循环，并最终以毁灭性战争的形式结束。
en: Across the ages, the so-called Thucydides Trap has appeared repeatedly, fueling tensions between rising and reigning powers that caused otherwise manageable events to fuel cycles of action and reaction that ended in devastating wars.

zh: 在过去500年间，在崛起大国威胁要取代执政大国的16个案例中，其中12个以战争结束。
en: Over the last 500 years, in 16 cases where a rising power threatened to displace a ruling power, 12 led to war.

zh: 美中两国应当提高警惕：照常行事很可能重复历史的错误。
en: The US and China should take note: business as usual is likely to produce history as usual.

zh: 不过除了可怕的警示，历史也为我们提供了避免冲突的有益线索。
en: But, beyond dire warnings, history offers instructive clues for avoiding conflict.

zh: 以1940年美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福面对的看似不可逾越的困境为例，当时英国在反对纳粹德国的战争中正严重承压。
en: Consider the seemingly insurmountable dilemma faced by US President Franklin Roosevelt in 1940, when the United Kingdom was under serious strain in its fight against Nazi Germany.

zh: 英国的物资和钱正在快速耗尽，但罗斯福知道美国国会永远不会将所需的贷款提供给英国。
en: The UK’s supplies and money were running low, but Roosevelt knew that the US Congress would never simply loan Britain the money it needed.

zh: 罗斯福的问题看似无法解决，历史学家多丽丝·卡恩斯·古德温在其著作非常时期中写道。
en: Roosevelt’s problem “seemed insoluble,” writes historian Doris Kearns Goodwin in her book No Ordinary Time.

zh: 但罗斯福的所作所为在今天的政治气候下却似乎令人难以想象：他登上一艘海军舰艇休假十天，并对这样的困境进行了深入的思考。
en: But Roosevelt did something that would seem inconceivable in today’s political climate: he took a ten-day break on a navy ship, and gave the predicament the thought it deserved.

zh: 之后，美国总统在如此紧要关头逃避外界的想法最初招致了批评。
en: Then, too, the idea of the US president escaping from the world at a critical juncture initially drew criticism.

zh: “很长一段时间我都不知他在想什么 ， ” 罗斯福的助手霍普金斯后来说。
en: “I didn’t know for quite a while what he was thinking about, if anything,” Roosevelt aide Harry Hopkins later said.

zh: “而后 — — 我开始明白他在给自己充电，他看似在休息和无所事事的时候经常这么做。
en: “But then – I began to get the idea that he was refueling, the way he so often does when he seems to be resting and carefree.

zh: 因此我没有问他任何问题。
en: So I didn’t ask him any questions.

zh: 然后，一天傍晚，他突然想出了办法 — — 并且拿出了整个计划。 ”
en: Then, one evening, he suddenly came out with it – the whole program.”

zh: 霍普金斯指的是开创性的500亿美元租借法案，该法案成为二战期间美国向国外提供军事援助的主要工具。
en: Hopkins was referring to the groundbreaking $50 billion Lend-Lease Act, which became the primary means by which the US provided military aid to foreign countries during World War II.

zh: 通过这项计划，总统有权无偿向任何国家转移国会已向政府拨款的国防物资，只要接受国被认为对美国的安全至关重要。
en: Through that program, the president could transfer defense materials for which Congress had appropriated funds to the government of any country whose defense was considered vital to US security, without requiring compensation.

zh: 今天，领导人面对一系列艰巨挑战进行类似开创性决策的压力非常大。
en: Today, leaders are under extraordinary pressure to apply similarly inspired decision-making skills to an array of daunting challenges.

zh: 除中美紧张关系不断加剧外，他们还必须面对俄罗斯日益增长的自信，中东持续的动荡以及逐渐逼近的灾难性气候变化。
en: Beyond deepening tensions between China and the US, they must confront Russia’s growing assertiveness, the Middle East’s continued instability, and the looming specter of catastrophic climate change.

zh: 究竟有多少人有勇气学习罗斯福的做法？
en: How many have the courage to learn from Roosevelt’s approach?

zh: 很难想象特朗普会跟随罗斯福的脚步。
en: It is hard to imagine Trump following in FDR’s footsteps.

zh: 但坚持具有潜在灾难性的决策始于一种疲惫不堪的偏激心态并不是站在党派立场上的观察。
en: But to insist that the most certain path to potentially catastrophic decisions begins with an exhausted, intemperate mind is not a partisan observation.

zh: 斯多葛派理解这种状况。
en: The Stoics understood this.

zh: 在19年的罗马皇帝生涯中，马尔库斯·奥列里乌斯面临几乎不间断的战争、可怕的瘟疫以及一次政变企图。
en: In his 19 years as Rome’s emperor, Marcus Aurelius faced nearly constant war, a horrific plague, and a coup attempt.

zh: 但奥列里乌斯并未抨击那些被认为反对他的人，而是冷静地问自己 ， “ 发生的一切是否能阻止你按照正义、慷慨、自控、理智、审慎、诚实、谦卑、直率，以及允许个人发挥天性的所有其他品质的方式做出决策？ ”
en: But instead of lashing out at those he presumed were against him, Aurelius calmly asked himself, “Does what’s happened keep you from acting with justice, generosity, self-control, sanity, prudence, honesty, humility, straightforwardness, and all other qualities that allow a person’s nature to fulfill itself?”

zh: 中国智慧提供了另外一个有益的视角。
en: Chinese wisdom offers another helpful perspective.

zh: 无为是道家理念的核心，可以从字面上译为“不采取任何行动 ” ， 但实际含义却远不止于此。
en: Central to Taoism is the concept of wu wei, which can be literally translated as “non-action,” but is really much more than that.

zh: 在道家理论中，当我们能与自己和睦相处，就能在直觉指引下毫不费力地自发采取行动。
en: In Taoism, when we are in a state of harmony and connection with ourselves, we operate in a kind of effortless, intuitive, and spontaneous way.

zh: 回顾自己的总统经历，比尔·克林顿认识到精疲力尽所带来的威胁。
en: Looking back on his own presidency, Bill Clinton recognized the dangers of burnout.

zh: 他曾说过 ， “ 我一生中所犯的每个重要错误，都是因为太累才犯下的。
en: “Every important mistake I’ve made in my life, I’ve made because I was too tired,” he once said.

zh: ” 大卫·盖根在其著作权力目击者中详细列举了克林顿首任总统期间毫无节制的休息习惯所付出的代价。
en: David Gergen, in his book Eyewitness to Power, detailed the costs of Clinton’s undisciplined rest habits in the first period of his presidency.

zh: “克林顿仍然喜欢庆祝胜利，还喜欢熬夜与老朋友纵情谈笑 ， ” 他写道。
en: “Clinton was still celebrating the victory and loved staying up half the night to laugh and talk with old friends,” he wrote.

zh: 这对总统产生了显著的影响，他“显得筋疲力尽、臃肿和极度兴奋 ， ” 同时又“情绪低落、无法集中精力和不耐烦。 ”
en: This had a visible impact on the president, who according to Gergen, “seemed worn out, puffy, and hyper,” as well as “out of sorts, easily distracted, and impatient.”

zh: 创造加油、充电和思考所需的时间和空间是人类操作系统发挥最佳水平的关键因素。
en: Creating the time and the space needed to recharge, refuel, and reflect is essential for the human operating system to function optimally.

zh: 这不是一种系统错误；而是一种强大的特点 — — 今天的领导人应当最大限度地对其加以利用。
en: That is not a systemic bug; it’s a powerful feature – one that leaders today should be using to its fullest extent.

zh: 日本的最后机会？
en: Last Chance for Japan?

zh: 纽黑文—日本是目前令大部分主要发达国家心弦紧绷的长期停滞斗争的老根据地。
en: NEW HAVEN – Japan is the petri dish for the struggle against the secular stagnation that is now gripping most major developed economies.

zh: 而尽管围绕“安倍经济学”的标榜不绝于耳，但日本经济依然毫无活力。
en: And, notwithstanding all of the fanfare surrounding “Abenomics,” Japan’s economy remains moribund.

zh: 在安倍最新首相任期的前六个季度里，年化真实GDP增长平均只有1.4 % — —只比1992年以来长期低迷的总平均水平1%略高。
en: In the six quarters of Shinzo Abe’s latest stint as prime minister, annualized real GDP growth has averaged just 1.4% – up only slightly from the anemic post-1992 average of 1%.

zh: 安倍结合了潜力巨大的货币和财政刺激，并辅之以范围广泛的结构性改革，理应结束日本“失去的几十年 ” 。
en: Abenomics, with its potentially powerful combination of monetary and fiscal stimulus, coupled with a wide array of structural reforms, was supposed to end Japan’s “lost decades.”

zh: 安倍战略的所有三支“箭”都指向一个目标 — — 让日本经济从15年的通缩泥淖中解脱出来。
en: All three “arrows” of the strategy were to be aimed at freeing the economy from a 15-year deflationary quagmire.

zh: 不幸的是，并非三支箭都能飞起来。
en: Unfortunately, not all of the arrows have been soaring in flight.

zh: 日本银行的第一支箭射得还不错 — — 采取了它所谓的量化和定性宽松（QQE ） 。
en: The Bank of Japan seems well on its way to delivering on the first one – embracing what it calls quantitative and qualitative easing (QQE).

zh: 相对于GDP而言，日本银行的货币政策头炮可以说打得比美联储还要响。
en: Relative to GDP, the BOJ’s monetary-policy gambit could actually far outstrip the efforts of America’s Federal Reserve.

zh: 但其他两支箭射得摇摇摆摆。
en: But the flight of the other two arrows is shaky, at best.

zh: 最近，安倍严重质疑此前已获立法通过的提高消费税措施的第二阶段，提高消费税一直被视为日本债务重组战略的关键。
en: In recent days, Abe has raised serious questions about proceeding with the second phase of a previously legislated consumer-tax hike that has long been viewed as the linchpin of Japan’s debt-consolidation strategy.

zh: 安倍之所以退缩，是因为经济仍然十分疲软，有可能导致通缩卷土重来。
en: Abe has flinched because the economy remains weak, posing renewed risks of a deflationary relapse.

zh: 与此同时，第三支箭 — — 结构性改革，特别是税收、教育和移民改革 — — 距离目标也还相去甚远。
en: Meanwhile, the third arrow of structural reforms – especially tax, education, and immigration reforms – is nowhere near its target.

zh: 有人也许会下结论说，安倍经济学本质上是美国和欧洲所实施的失败的政策组合在日本的尝试：中央银行大规模非常规地注入流动性（欧洲央行现在显然要步美联储后尘了 ） ， 但基本财政和结构性改革几乎没有。
en: Abenomics, one might conclude, is basically a Japanese version of the failed policy combination deployed in the United States and Europe: massive unconventional liquidity injections by central banks (with the European Central Bank apparently now poised to follow the Fed), but little in the way of fundamental fiscal and structural reforms.

zh: 短期货币解决方案的政治便利性再一次取得了胜利。
en: The political expedience of the short-term monetary fix has triumphed once again.

zh: 如此赌博对日本来说问题尤其严重。
en: Such a gamble is especially problematic for Japan.

zh: 日本工作年龄人口正在老化和下降，因此重振增长空间有限。
en: With an aging – and now declining – working-age population, it has limited scope for reviving growth.

zh: 日本要么通过提高生产率取代更多的现有劳动力，要么寻找新的国内外需求源。
en: Japan must either squeeze more out of its existing workforce by boosting productivity, or uncover new sources of demand at home or abroad.

zh: 在国内，这意味着增加工人数量，要么通过提高女性劳动力参与率（目前为63 % ， 在发达国家中垫底 ） ， 要么通过放松移民限制。
en: At home, that could mean adding workers, either by boosting female participation in the work force, which, at 63%, is among the lowest in the developed world, or relaxing immigration restrictions.

zh: 不幸的是，这两个方面都没有什么进步。
en: Unfortunately, there has been little progress on either front.

zh: 此外，即使发射第三支箭 — — 结构性改革的政治意愿突然增强（这一前提能不能实现还大有问题 ） ， 任何生产率方面的回报也极有可能需要很长时间才会显现。
en: Moreover, even if the political will to launch third-arrow structural reforms were suddenly to strengthen – a dubious proposition – any productivity payback would most likely take a long time to materialize.

zh: 于是只剩下了外部需求，而这也许代表了安倍经济学中最严重的战略缺陷：它没有考虑某些全球经济中有可能发生的最大变化。
en: That leaves external demand, which underscores what is perhaps Abenomics’ most serious strategic flaw: It does not take into consideration some of the biggest changes that are likely to occur in the global economy.

zh: 这是一个巨大遗憾，因为日本有很大的优势利用最强大的全球趋势之一 — — 即将到来的中国和美国经济再平衡。
en: That is a great pity, because Japan is well positioned to take advantage of one of the most powerful global trends – the coming rebalancing of the Chinese and US economies.

zh: 中国似乎比美国更加致力于重组 — — 至少在可预见的未来是如此。
en: China appears to be more committed to restructuring than the US – at least for the foreseeable future.

zh: 十八大三中全会改革给出了严密的支持转型的框架。
en: Its Third Plenum reforms provide a cohesive framework for a pro-consumption transformation.

zh: 尽管美国目前仍倾向于复兴已经衰竭的增长模式，但有理由相信它最终也会实现再平衡。
en: Though America currently remains intent on resurrecting a tired growth model, there is good reason to hope that it, too, will eventually rebalance.

zh: 日本绝对不能浪费这些机会。
en: Japan cannot afford to squander these opportunities.

zh: 作为中国增长从外需转向内需的主要推动力，谁能比日本出口商获得更大的好处？
en: As the main driver of Chinese growth shifts from external to domestic demand, who could benefit more than Japanese exporters?

zh: 中国已经成为日本最大的出口市场，中国对消费品和服务的需求即将井喷，这意味着日本占据着争夺新增市场份额的理想身位。
en: China is already Japan’s largest export market, leaving it ideally situated to capture additional market share in the coming surge of Chinese demand for consumer products and services.

zh: 类似地，日本可以从其环境修复的技术实力中获益。 环境修复是未来几年中国的一项当务之急。
en: Likewise, Japan stands to benefit from its technological prowess in environmental remediation – an urgent priority for China in the years ahead.

zh: 日本在一些中国所面临的最严峻问题上拥有众多解决方案专家。
en: Japan already has great expertise in many of the solutions to some of China’s toughest problems.

zh: 日本也可以从姗姗来迟的美国经济再平衡中获益。
en: Japan is also likely to gain from a long-overdue rebalancing of the US economy.

zh: 美国的变化 — — 从过度消费大部分外包给低工资发展中国家的商品转向投资拉动型因素日益重要的经济所需要的资本设备 — — 将有利于日本最大的优势。
en: A shift in the US – from excessive consumption of goods largely sourced in low-wage developing countries to the capital equipment that an increasingly investment-led economy will require – would play to Japan’s greatest strengths.

zh: 作为基础设施投资所需要的复杂机械和挖掘机的全球领先者，日本应该能够抓住这些机会。
en: As a global leader in sophisticated machinery and the earth-moving equipment needed for infrastructure investment, Japan should be able to to seize these opportunities.

zh: 在寻找外需时，日本不应该忽视其早期成就。
en: In looking to external demand, Japan should not lose sight of its earlier achievements.

zh: 在20世纪七八十年代，日本是全世界艳羡的对象 — — 其无比强大的需求机器在快速增长的全球经济所带来的需求中如鱼得水。
en: In the 1970s and 1980s, Japan was the envy of the world, owing to an all-powerful export machine that tapped the demand of a rapidly growing global economy.

zh: “日本公司”依然是关于怎样吸引外需支持的美好制度记忆（institutional memory ） 。
en: “Japan, Inc.” still has a good institutional memory of what it takes to draw support from external demand.

zh: 是时候重温这一记忆了。
en: It is time to recapture that memory.

zh: 否则身为世界第三大经济体的日本就有可能被世界前两大经济体 — — 中国和美国的转型进一步边缘化。
en: Failure to do so would leave Japan, the world’s third largest economy, at risk of being further marginalized by transformations in the world’s two largest, the US and China.

zh: 一个显而易见的重要警示信号是中日关系。 拜历史恩怨所赐，两国关系可能阻止日本实现中国经济再平衡所带来的经济好处。
en: There is one obvious and important caveat: Poor Sino-Japanese relations, owing to unresolved historical grievances, could prevent Japan from realizing the economic benefits implied by China’s economic rebalancing.

zh: 经济和政治关系的相互作用是大国兴衰的关键要素。
en: The interplay between economics and politics lies at the heart of the rise and fall of great powers.

zh: 在快速变化、以中国和美国的潜在经济结构变化为突出特征的世界中，日本决不能无视这一事实。
en: In a rapidly changing world, underscored by likely shifts in the economic structure of China and the US, Japan cannot afford to lose sight of that fact.

zh: 美国和中国可以从它们的经济转型中获得巨大好处，而留给日本的时间正在流失。
en: Just as the US and China have much to gain by transforming their economies, Japan is running out of time.

zh: 站在失去的二十年的基础上推算，这也许是日本最后的机会。
en: In the grip of two lost decades and counting, this could be Japan’s last chance.

zh: 谎言，该死的谎言和越南贸易数字
en: Lies, Damn Lies, and Vietnam’s Trade Statistics

zh: 新加坡—4月17日，彭博社报道中国超过美国，成为越南最大的出口市场。
en: SINGAPORE – On April 17, Bloomberg reported that China had overtaken the United States as Vietnam’s largest export market.

zh: 据彭博社援引的国际货币基金组织（IMF）数据，2017年越南对华出口总额达到了506亿美元，而对美出口总额为465亿美元。
en: According to figures cited by the news organization and tallied by the International Monetary Fund, Vietnam’s exports to China totaled $50.6 billion in 2017, compared to $46.5 billion in exports to the US.

zh: 如果这些数字是准确的，那么它们代表了越南、中国和美国三角贸易关系的重大转变。
en: If these numbers are accurate, they would represent a significant shift in the triangular relationship between Vietnam, China, and the US.

zh: 彭博社言简意赅地指出，数据彰显出世界第二大经济体正在“提高其地区影响力 ” ， 而它挤占的是美国的影响力。
en: As Bloomberg succinctly put it, the data underscore how the world’s second-largest economy is “growing its influence in the region” at the expense of the US.

zh: 但贸易数字并不是全部；更仔细的解读表明这些数字也有可能是错误的。
en: But the trade numbers do not tell the whole story; a closer reading suggests they might even be wrong.

zh: 越南海关总署（GDVC，它负责监督越南贸易数据）的初步统计数字与IMF的评估相悖。
en: Preliminary statistics from the General Department of Vietnam Customs (GDVC), which oversees Vietnam’s trade data, contradict the IMF assessment.

zh: 据GDVC数据，去年对美国出口总额为416亿美元，对华出口为355亿美元。
en: According to the GDVC, exports to the US last year totaled $41.6 billion, while exports to China stood at $35.5 billion.

zh: 换句话说，从越南的统计口径看，美国仍是其第一大出口市场，领先中国17 % ， 且这一差距在2018年前三个月保持稳定。
en: In other words, by Vietnam’s count, the US remained its largest export market by a margin of 17%, a gap that held steady during the first three months of 2018.

zh: 此外，GDVC数据还表明，越南贸易保持着其历史趋势；越南对中国存在巨大贸易逆差，而对美国存在贸易顺差。
en: Moreover, the GDVC figures show that historic trends in Vietnam’s trade ties have remained intact; Vietnam continues to run a large trade deficit with China and a surplus with the US.

zh: 那么，官方数据和IMF数字为什么会出现差异？
en: So, what can account for the discrepancies between the official data and the IMF’s figures?

zh: 一个可能的解释是差异来自方法：IMF和GDVC用不同的算式得到了各自的估算结果。
en: One possible explanation is methodological: the Fund and the GDVC simply used different formulas to arrive at their estimates.

zh: 但在对华贸易帐上存在151亿美元的差别，这看上去不可思议。
en: But a gap of $15.1 billion on the China side of the ledger makes this highly unlikely.

zh: 另一个可能是IMF的数据完全来自中国当局。
en: Another possibility is that the IMF sourced its data exclusively from Chinese authorities.

zh: 但对这一点没有什么证据可以证明。
en: But evidence for that scenario is thin.

zh: 第三种解释 — — 坦白说，它也很难排除合理的怀疑 — — 也许最为可信：双方都操纵了年度和月度贸易数字，以支撑本方的叙事。
en: A third theory – which, admittedly, is impossible to prove beyond a reasonable doubt – may be the most credible: both sides manipulated annual and monthly trade data to bolster their own narratives.

zh: 对越南来说，显示出口下降的数据可以支持政府扩大贸易、深入中国市场的政策。
en: For Vietnam, data indicating lower exports would support the government’s efforts to extend trade deeper into Chinese markets.

zh: 在庞大而持续的双边贸易赤字的压力下，越南官员一直要求中方加大从越南的进口。
en: Plagued by a large and persistent bilateral trade deficit, Vietnamese officials have long requested that their Chinese counterparts allow more imports from Vietnam.

zh: GDVC所发布的数字有利于 — — 或者说至少不会不利于 — — 这一目标。
en: The numbers released by GDVC would advance – or at least not undermine – that goal.

zh: 另一方面，对中国来说，夸大从越南进口的数字有助于抵御这一要求，提醒越南当局对华贸易对越南经济的重要性。
en: For China, on the other hand, inflating the figures for imports from Vietnam could help neutralize such a request, reminding the Vietnamese authorities of how important trade with China is to their country’s economy.

zh: 较大的贸易数字或能说服越南保持双边友好，甚至有望促使越南在南海纠纷等棘手的地区安全问题上采取更加配合的立场。
en: Higher trade figures may persuade Vietnam to maintain friendly bilateral ties, and perhaps even to adopt more accommodating positions on thorny regional security issues, such as the South China Sea dispute.

zh: 当然，特朗普政府的保护主义贸易政策可能让所有这些猜测变得毫无意义。
en: Of course, the Trump administration’s protectionist trade policies could render all of this speculation meaningless.

zh: 越南对华双边贸易不断扩大，有望在今年突破1,000亿美元，而其对美贸易关系因为美国向内转政策而受到影响。
en: While Vietnam’s bilateral trade with China is expanding and could exceed $100 billion sometime this year, its trading relationship with the US is being hurt by America’s inward turn.

zh: 越南海鲜和钢铁行业主要出口商已经受到美国新关税政策的冲击，而其他行业（如纺织业）有可能是下一个受害者。
en: Major Vietnamese exporters of seafood and steel have already been hit with new US tariffs,and additional sectors, such as textiles, could be next.

zh: 美国已经撤出跨太平洋合作伙伴关系，美越双边贸易肯定会进一步受到影响。
en: With the US having withdrawn from the Trans-Pacific Partnership, growth in bilateral trade is bound to suffer further.

zh: 如果这些趋势继续下去，IMF的分析 — — 不管从现在看有多大的问题 — — 最终将成为现实。
en: If these trends continue, the IMF’s analysis – as questionable as it may be now – will eventually become reality.

zh: 如果早已成为越南最大进口国的中国真的超过美国成为越南最重要的出口市场，那么越南几乎不可能保持其在两强之间左右逢源的当前战略。
en: And, if China, which has long been Vietnam’s largest source of imports, does replace the US as Vietnam’s most important export market, Vietnam will find it nearly impossible to continue its current strategy of hedging between two great powers.

zh: 到那时，无论什么创造性会计方法都无法掩盖越南经济约束的新现实了。
en: At that point, no amount of creative accounting will be able to mask the new realities of Vietnam’s economic constraints.

zh: 中国如何看待特朗普
en: How China Views Trump

zh: 伦敦—唐纳德·特朗普在美国总统竞选中大获全胜，这震惊了全世界。
en: LONDON – Donald Trump’s stunning victory in the US presidential election has shaken the world.

zh: 墨西哥总统涅托引人注目地保持沉默，而法国总统奥朗德则说这开启了一个“不确定性时代 ” ， 克里姆林宫要得意忘形了。 这说明特朗普不像过去的美国总统那样在国际上受欢迎。
en: From Mexican President Enrique Peña Nieto’s conspicuous silence to French President Francois Hollande’s statement that it opens up a “period of uncertainty” to the Kremlin’s barely concealed giddiness, Trump has not been received internationally like past US presidents.

zh: 但有一个国家基本不为所动：中国。
en: But one country has remained largely unmoved: China.

zh: 特朗普对中国的立场是众所周知的：他什么事都要指责中国，不管是对他的对手的攻击（美国政府认为这是俄罗斯杰作 ） ， 还是气候变化（他说这是中国为了破坏美国的竞争力而布下的骗局 ） 。
en: Trump’s stance on China is well known: he has blamed the country for everything from hacks on his opponent (thought by the US government to be the work of Russia) to climate change (which he has called a hoax cooked up by China to undermine US competitiveness).

zh: 他还承诺对中国商品征收45%的关税。
en: And he has promised to impose a 45% tariff on Chinese goods.

zh: 但中国流淌着儒家的中庸血液。
en: Yet prudence flows through China’s Confucian veins.

zh: 中国领导人没有急着判断美国的未来政策，更没有采取过早的行动，而是对特朗普胜选保持中立态度。
en: Rather than jumping to conclusions about future US policies, much less taking premature action, China’s leaders have remained neutral in their response to Trump’s victory.

zh: 他们似乎坚信，尽管双边关系会有所变化，但不会发生根本性转变。
en: They seem confident that, though the bilateral relationship will change somewhat, it will not be fundamentally transformed.

zh: 特朗普当选既不会特别好，也不会特别坏。
en: It will still be neither very good nor very bad.

zh: 一个有利的变化是当选以后的特朗普就停止了攻击中国。
en: It helps that Trump has all but ceased China-bashing since the election.

zh: 相反，他在Twitter上发布了一则视频，由他的外孙女用普通话朗诵中国古诗 — — 此举立刻打动了中国。
en: Instead, he posted on Twitter a video of his granddaughter reciting a poem in Mandarin – an instant hit in China.

zh: 不管是不是在向中国传递明确信息，这一举动强调了特朗普的竞选纲领与他的实际立场和计划也许并不相同。
en: Whether intended explicitly as a message to China or not, the move highlighted the possibility of a gulf between Trump’s campaign rhetoric and his actual positions and plans.

zh: 一些西方人可能认为仅仅凭着竞选纲领就足以激怒中国领导人。
en: Some in the West might think that the rhetoric alone would be enough to incense China’s leaders.

zh: 但事实上，国家领导人会见达赖喇嘛的情形对中国人的冒犯远甚于此 — — 而奥巴马总统在6月份就这么做了。
en: But the truth is that the Chinese are far more offended by national leaders meeting with the Dalai Lama, as President Barack Obama did in June.

zh: 此外，此前的美国选举清楚地表明，竞选纲领与现实之间基本上毫无关系。
en: And, as past US elections have made clear, rhetoric may well bear little relation to reality.

zh: 特朗普的竞选纲领包括了一些一损俱损的承诺 — — 比如他征收关税的承诺，这进一步表明他未必会认真对待竞选纲领。
en: That is all the more true when the rhetoric in question includes promises that would harm everyone involved, as Trump’s proposed tariffs would.

zh: 长期以来，能够获得来自中国的廉价产品使得即便是美国市场上的非中国商品也承受降价压力。
en: The availability of inexpensive products from China has long placed downward pressure on prices even of non-Chinese goods in the US market.

zh: 对最有可能消费廉价进口商品的低收入家庭来说，这简直是及时雨，因为他们的购买力大大提高了。
en: For low-income households, which are the most likely to consume inexpensive imported goods, this has been a godsend, as it has effectively raised their purchasing power.

zh: 如果中国进口品被阻挠，物价将会上涨，从而遏制消费，阻碍经济增长，加剧不平等性。
en: If Chinese imports were blocked, prices would rise, undermining consumption, impeding economic growth, and exacerbating inequality.

zh: 并且美国甚至仍然无法避免制造业就业的流失；就业岗位将流向越南或孟加拉国等劳动力成本比今天的中国还要低的国家。
en: And the US would not even be protected from manufacturing employment losses; the jobs would just go to Vietnam or Bangladesh, where labor costs are even lower than in China nowadays.

zh: 投资流亦然。 作为全球化的第二引擎，它在关于中美经济关系的讨论被理所当然地忽视了。
en: The same goes for investment flows – the second engine of globalization – which are often conveniently forgotten in discussions of the US-China economic relationship.

zh: 中国是美国国债的最大买家之一，并且一直在为美国消费和投资提供融资。
en: China is one of the biggest purchasers of US Treasuries, and continues to finance US consumption and investment.

zh: 中国甚至可以帮助特朗普所承诺的大型基础设施项目融资，从而减小美国预算的压力。
en: China may even help to finance the large infrastructure projects that Trump has promised, thereby reducing pressure on the US budget.

zh: 因此，特朗普不可能大幅改变美国经济政策，至少如果他知道怎样对自己最有利的话是如此。
en: So Trump is unlikely to change much in terms of US economic policy, at least if he knows what’s good for him.

zh: 他可能在外交政策方面做出一些改变；但这些变化更有可能是为了取悦而不是刺激中国。
en: Where he might make some changes is in foreign policy; but those changes may be more likely to please China than to aggravate it.

zh: 多年来，奥巴马政府一直在亚洲搞战略再平衡。
en: The Obama administration has for years been engaged in a strategic rebalancing toward Asia.

zh: 在中国快速积累经济和军事优势的同时，奥巴马似乎在竭尽全力遏制中国崛起，其手段包括让美国介入南海领土纠纷。
en: At a time when China was rapidly accumulating both economic and military strength, Obama seemed committed to containing its rise as best he could, including by involving the US in territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

zh: 相反，特朗普在外交政策上提出了“美国第一”的方针，不太关注南海纠纷。
en: By contrast, Trump, with his “America first” approach to foreign policy, has paid little attention to the South China Sea dispute.

zh: 这对中国来说当然是件好事。 中国欢迎美国减少涉足亚洲 — — 特别是南海和台湾。
en: That works just fine for China, which would welcome less US involvement in Asia – in particular, in the South China Sea, as well as in Taiwan.

zh: 但这里也存在纲领和现实的差异，我们不应该期待会出现巨大的变化。
en: But here, too, there is a gap between rhetoric and reality, and no radical change should be expected.

zh: 当选后不久，特朗普就像日本和韩国领导人重申了美国对两国安全的承诺，尽管在竞选时他承诺要提高美国的“保护费 ” 。
en: Soon after the election, Trump assured the leaders of Japan and South Korea of America’s commitment to their countries’ security, despite a campaign vow to demand more payment for US protection.

zh: 除此之外还有朝鲜的威胁，因此美国从亚洲战略性撤退（这可能引起动荡）的可能性很小。
en: Add to that the threat posed by North Korea, and a destabilizing US strategic retreat from Asia remains highly unlikely.

zh: 如果特朗普兑现其改善对俄关系的承诺，则中国摆脱美国压力的可能性又小了一分。
en: If Trump follows through on his pledge to mend fences with Russia, the odds that China will escape US pressure would lengthen further.

zh: 不再需要应对俄罗斯的美国将由更多时间用于亚洲事务。
en: Without Russia to deal with, the US would have even more time to dedicate to Asian affairs.

zh: 此外，俄美关系回暖也可能导致中俄关系出现微妙变化，自俄罗斯因为吞并克里米亚与西方闹僵以来，中俄关系大大地深化了。
en: Moreover, a warming of the Russia-US relationship could lead to subtle changes in the Russia-China relationship, which has deepened since Russia’s annexation of Crimea wrecked its relations with the West.

zh: 特朗普的胜选绝非不重要。
en: Trump’s victory is far from inconsequential.

zh: 他不是普通的美国总统，并且，借用《大西洋 》 （ The Atlantic）的塞伦娜·齐拓（Salena Zito）的话，必须认真对待特朗普，但不要从字面上理解他。
en: He is no ordinary US president, and he must be taken seriously, though not literally, to borrow a phrase from The Atlantic’s Salena Zito.

zh: 但是，中国领导人似乎认识到，他几乎别无选择，只能在身为总统的有限空间内施展腾挪。
en: But, as China’s leaders seem to recognize, he will have little choice but to color mostly inside the lines as president.

zh: 即使他想偏离外交政策共识，美国的制度也会限制他这样做的能力。
en: Even if he wants to deviate more from the foreign-policy consensus, the US system limits his ability to do so.

zh: 因此，中国领导人不担心特朗普的个人偏好，也不去试图预测不可预测的东西，而是保持专注于真正重要的东西：合作性双边关系的需要。
en: So, rather than worrying about Trump’s personal predilections or trying to predict the unpredictable, China’s leaders are remaining focused on what is really important: the need for a cooperative bilateral relationship.

zh: 其他世界强国也应该这样做。
en: Other world powers should do the same.

zh: 中国的贸易武器化
en: China’s Weaponization of Trade

zh: 新德里—中国否认在商业中混入政治，但长期以来它一直用贸易来惩罚“不听话”的国家。
en: NEW DELHI – China denies mixing business with politics, yet it has long used trade to punish countries that refuse to toe its line.

zh: 最近，中国因为韩国决定部署萨德反导系统而对韩国进行了严厉的经济制裁，这是中国当局将贸易用作政治武器的最新例子。
en: China’s recent heavy-handed economic sanctioning of South Korea, in response to that country’s decision to deploy the Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) anti-missile system, was just the latest example of the Chinese authorities’ use of trade as a political weapon.

zh: 中国政府先是鼓励其他国家在经济上依赖中国，随后利用这种依赖迫使它们支持它的外交政策目标。
en: China’s government has encouraged and then exploited states’ economic reliance on it to compel their support for its foreign-policy objectives.

zh: 它的经济惩罚包括限制某个针对国家的进口或非正式地抵制该国商品、中止战略出口（如稀土材料 ） 、 鼓励中国人游行示威反对具体的外资企业等。
en: Its economic punishments range from restricting imports or informally boycotting goods from a targeted country to halting strategic exports (such as rare-earth minerals) and encouraging domestic protests against specific foreign businesses.

zh: 其他巩固包括暂停旅游团出行、封锁渔场等。
en: Other tools include suspending tourist travel and blocking fishing access.

zh: 所有这些手段使用时都会十分小心，以避免可能损害中国自身商业利益的破坏。
en: All are used carefully to avoid disruption that could harm China’s own business interests.

zh: 蒙古是这一新经济强迫的经典例子。 去年11月，蒙古接待了达赖喇嘛。
en: Mongolia became a classic case of such geo-economic coercion, after it hosted the Dalai Lama last November.

zh: 中国占了蒙古出口的90 % ， 中国当局决定给蒙古一个教训。
en: With China accounting for 90% of Mongolian exports, the Chinese authorities set out to teach Mongolia a lesson.

zh: 在对其大宗商品出口征收惩罚性费用后，中国外交部长王毅说“希望蒙方认真吸取教训 ” ， “恪守承诺 ” ， 不再邀请这位西藏精神领袖入境。
en: After imposing punitive fees on its commodity exports, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi voiced “hope that Mongolia has taken this lesson to heart” and that it would “scrupulously abide by its promise” not to invite the Tibetan spiritual leader again.

zh: 一个更加著名的例子是中国对挪威的贸易报复。 2010年，身陷囹圄的中国异见者刘晓波获得诺贝尔和平奖。
