en: A more famous case was China’s trade reprisals against Norway, after the 2010 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded to the jailed Chinese dissident Liu Xiaobo.

zh: 此后，挪威对华三文鱼出口量急剧下降。
en: As a result, Norwegian salmon exports to China collapsed.

zh: 2010年，中国利用其对重要稀土材料的全球垄断地位，通过暗中出口禁运给日本和西方予以沉重的商业打击。
en: In 2010, China exploited its monopoly on the global production of vital rare-earth minerals to inflict commercial pain on Japan and the West through an unannounced export embargo.

zh: 2012年，中国与日本就钓鱼岛（由日方在1895年首先控制）的领土纠纷再起，中国再次利用贸易作为战略武器，让日本付出了几十亿美元的代价。
en: In 2012, after China’s sovereignty dispute with Japan over the Senkaku Islands (which the Japanese first controlled in 1895) flared anew, China once again used trade as a strategic weapon, costing Japan billions of dollars.

zh: 类似地，2012年4月，南海争议岛礁黄岩岛附近发生摩擦，中国不但调拨海监船恫吓菲律宾，还建议中国公民不要赴菲旅游，并突然叫停香蕉进口（这导致许多菲律宾蕉农破产 ） 。
en: Likewise, in April 2012, following an incident near the disputed Scarborough Shoal in the South China Sea, China bullied the Philippines not only by dispatching surveillance vessels, but also by issuing an advisory against travel there and imposing sudden curbs on banana imports (which bankrupted many Philippine growers).

zh: 在国际社会的注意力集中到其贸易行为的同时，中国悄悄地占领了黄岩岛。
en: With international attention focused on its trade actions, China then quietly seized the shoal.

zh: 中国最近因为韩国部署萨德系统而发动的贸易报复应该放在这一背景下考察。
en: China’s recent trade reprisals against South Korea for deploying the THAAD system should be viewed against this background.

zh: 中国的报复没有针对美国。 美国部署萨德系统是为了防御新兴的朝鲜导弹威胁，并且有能力还击。
en: China’s reprisals were not launched against the US, which deployed the system to defend against North Korea’s emerging missile threat and has the heft to hit back hard.

zh: 而这也不是第一次：2000年，韩国提高大蒜关税保护本国农民免受进口大蒜涌入的影响，中国的反应是禁止从韩国进口手机和聚乙烯。
en: Nor was this the first time: in 2000, when South Korea increased tariffs on garlic to protect its farmers from a flood of imports, China responded by banning imports of South Korean cellphones and polyethylene.

zh: 针对不相关产品的全面报复不仅仅是为了促进国内产业，也是为了确保韩国的损失远远高于中国。
en: The sweeping retaliation against unrelated products was intended not only to promote domestic industries, but also to ensure that South Korea lost far more than China did.

zh: 如果自己的损失会更大的话，中国就不会抡起贸易的大棒，最近在西藏、不丹和印度锡金邦交界处的中印军事对峙便是如此。
en: China will not use the trade cudgel when it has more to lose, as illustrated by the current Sino-Indian troop standoff at the border where Tibet, Bhutan, and the Indian state of Sikkim meet.

zh: 中国领导人将中国对印度的不对称贸易关系 — — 出口比进口高五倍多 — — 视为破坏其对手的制造业基础，同时还能斩获可观的利润的战略武器。
en: Chinese leaders value the lopsided trade relationship with India – exports are more than five times higher than imports – as a strategic weapon to undercut its rival’s manufacturing base while reaping handsome profits.

zh: 因此，中国并没有中止边境贸易 — — 这会导致印度的经济报复 — — 而是切断了印度朝圣者前往西藏的传统途径。
en: So, instead of halting border trade, which could invite Indian economic reprisals, China has cut off Indian pilgrims’ historical access to sacred sites in Tibet.

zh: 只要有贸易杠杆可用，中国向来不惮于使用。
en: Where it has trade leverage, China is not shy about exercising it.

zh: 一份2010 年的研究发现，凡是领导人接见了达赖喇嘛的国家，对华出口都将迅速下降8.1—16.9 % ， 结果是，如今几乎所有国家 — — 印度和美国是显著的例外 — — 都切断了与这位西藏领导人的官方接触。
en: A 2010 study found that countries whose leaders met the Dalai Lama suffered a rapid decline of 8.1-16.9% in exports to China, with the result that now almost all countries, with the conspicuous exception of India and the US, shun official contact with the Tibetan leader.

zh: 严峻的现实是，中国正在成为一个凌驾于国际规则之上的贸易暴君。
en: The harsh reality is that China is turning into a trade tyrant that rides roughshod over international rules.

zh: 其违反国际规则的行为包括保持非关税壁垒排挤国际竞争、补贴出口、扭曲国内市场以利于中国公司、盗版知识产权、用反垄断法律强迫让步、通过收购让外国企业将技术转让给中国等。
en: Its violations include maintaining nontariff barriers to keep out foreign competition; subsidizing exports; tilting the domestic market in favor of Chinese companies; pirating intellectual property; using antitrust laws to extort concessions; and underwriting acquisitions of foreign firms to bring home their technologies.

zh: 中国甚至将双边契约也是为实现其目标的工具。
en: China regards even bilateral pacts as no more than tools to enable it to achieve its objectives.

zh: 在中国看来，双边契约等到满足了它的目标便失去了约束力，比如，中国官员最近表示，为1997年香港回归中国铺平道路的1984年中英联合声明可以丢弃。
en: From China’s perspective, no treaty has binding force once it has served its immediate purpose, as officials recently demonstrated by trashing the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration that paved the way for Hong Kong’s handover in 1997.

zh: 讽刺的是，中国是在美国的帮助下练就了发达的贸易肌肉，是美国取消了对华制裁，让中国融入国际机构，从而在中国的经济崛起过程中起到了关键作用。
en: Ironically, China has developed its trade muscle with help from the US, which played a key role in China’s economic rise by shunning sanctions and integrating it into global institutions.

zh: 美国总统特朗普的当选本应该宣告中国免费搭乘贸易的顺风车的日子的结束。
en: President Donald Trump’s election was supposed to end China’s free ride on trade.

zh: 但是，特朗普并没有对这个他一直称之为贸易骗子的国家采取行动，反而再次帮了中国的大忙，包括美国退出跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP ） 、 缩减其在亚太地区的影响力等。
en: Yet, far from taking any action against a country that he has long assailed as a trade cheater, Trump is helping make China great again, including by withdrawing the US from the Trans-Pacific Partnership and shrinking US influence in the Asia-Pacific region.

zh: 日本首相安倍晋三正在正在寻求复活TPP（但美国不会参与 ） ， 这有助于建立一个市场有好的、基于规则的经济共同体，从而遏制中国不受约束的重商主义行为。
en: The TPP, which Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe is seeking to revive, but without US participation, can help rein in China’s unremitting mercantilist behavior by creating a market-friendly, rule-based economic community.

zh: 但如果TPP要想真正有效地抵挡一个强大的、高度中央集权的政权所挥舞的贸易利剑，必须将印度和韩国也包括进来。
en: But if the TPP is to be truly effective in offsetting the trade sword wielded by a powerful, highly centralized authoritarian regime, it needs to be expanded to include India and South Korea.

zh: 到目前为止，没人对中国的贸易武器化提出挑战。
en: China’s weaponization of trade has gone unchallenged so far.

zh: 唯有联合的国际战略 — — 其中复活的TPP是必不可少的一部分 — — 有希望迫使中国领导人按规则行事。
en: Only a concerted international strategy, with a revived TPP an essential component, stands a chance of compelling China’s leaders to play by the rules.

zh: 中国经济政策的下一步
en: The Next Step for Chinese Economic Policy

zh: 坎布里奇—我十分仰慕中国及其调整经济政策以维持高速增长的能力。
en: CAMBRIDGE – I am a great admirer of China and its ability to adjust its economic policies to maintain rapid growth.

zh: 但如今，中国已经登上全球经济之巅，必须采取必要的改革，充分遵守它在2001年加入世贸组织时接受的国际规则。
en: But now that it has risen to the top of the global economy, it must adopt the necessary reforms to become fully compliant with the international rules that it accepted upon joining the World Trade Organization in 2001.

zh: 1982年我第一次访问中国时，它还是一个非常贫穷的国家，采取完全的共产主义体制。
en: When I first went to China in 1982, it was a very poor country governed by a thoroughly communist regime.

zh: 农业完全是集体化的。
en: Agriculture was completely collectivized.

zh: 农民没有权利在自己的土地上想种什么就种什么，因此，农业产出非常低。
en: Because peasants had lost the right to farm their own land, agricultural output was extremely low.

zh: 除了农业，个人拥有生产资料也是非法的。
en: Beyond agriculture, individual ownership of the means of production was outlawed.

zh: 中国家庭可以拥有一台自用的缝纫机，但不能拥有两台缝纫机，也不能雇用邻居帮忙制作衣服。
en: A Chinese family could own a sewing machine for its own use, but it could not own two sewing machines or hire a neighbor to help produce garments.

zh: 在邓小平的领导下，这一状况开始改变。
en: Under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping, this began to change.

zh: 小片土地返还给从前的所有者，并允许他们获得政府强制限额以上部分的产出。
en: Plots of land were returned to their previous owners, who were allowed to keep any output exceeding the government’s mandatory quota.

zh: 结果是农业产出激增，农民加种各种作物，如鲜花和蔬菜，直接向公众出售。
en: As a result, agricultural output soared, and farmers produced a range of additional crops, like flowers and vegetables, to sell directly to the public.

zh: 生产资料所有权和雇用工人的限制也逐步放宽，如今，民营部门贡献了中国经济活动的大部分。
en: Restrictions on ownership of productive assets and on hiring workers were gradually relaxed, such that the private sector now accounts for the majority of economic activity in China.

zh: 结果是经济增长大爆发和生活水平的急速提高。
en: The result was an explosion of economic growth and a rapid increase in living standards.

zh: 1982年以来，中国真实（经通货膨胀调整的）GDP平均年增长率超过7 % 。
en: Since 1982, China’s real (inflation-adjusted) GDP has grown at an average annual rate of more than 7%.

zh: 人均真实GDP增长了17倍，自邓小平开启改革以来有大约8亿人摆脱了贫困。
en: Per capita real GDP is now 18 times higher, with some 800 million people having been lifted out of poverty since the start of Deng’s reforms.

zh: 尽管中国总人均产出仍然只有美国的四分之一，但中国大城市的生活水平已经达到了相当高的程度。
en: Although overall per capita output in China is still only a quarter of the US level, the standard of living in China’s major cities is impressively high.

zh: 看看那些闪闪发光的摩天大楼和生活优渥的年轻人川流不息的各种商店，你就能感受到短短几十年中所发生的变化。
en: To see the gleaming skyscrapers and array of shops serving affluent young people is to appreciate the change that has occurred in just a few decades.

zh: 邓小平曾经说过 ， “ 致富光荣 ” 。
en: Deng once declared, “To get rich is glorious.”

zh: 中国人民对此回应热烈。
en: China’s people have responded.

zh: 私人部门繁荣昌盛，非常活跃的股市实现了股份所有权的扩散。
en: Private entities flourish, and a very active stock market allows widespread share ownership.

zh: 中国白手起家的 亿万富翁数量明显多于美国。
en: China apparently has more self-made billionaires than the United States.

zh: 私人激励加上有效的教育是中国高速增长的关键。
en: The combination of private incentives and effective education is a key reason for China’s rapid growth.

zh: 中国有通过各种考试选拔最聪明的学生的古老传统。
en: China has an ancient tradition of promoting the brightest students based on extensive examinations.

zh: 为皇帝效命的官员经由以儒家思想为基础的书面考试的遴选而出。
en: The officials who worked for the emperors were selected based on written exams of Confucian thought.

zh: 如今，中国人民普遍识字，而国家高考用来决定谁能进入顶尖大学学习。
en: Now literacy is universal and national examinations are used to decide who goes to the top universities.

zh: 今天，超过一百万中国学生在美国留学，不少政府最高经济官员也毕业于美国的大学。
en: More than a million Chinese students have studied in the US, and several of the top government economic officials have done graduate work there.

zh: 从多种角度看，中国经济现在就像是一家庞大的美国跨国公司。
en: In many ways, the Chinese economy now works like a large American multinational corporation.

zh: 大战略由最高管理层制定，包括增长目标、从重工业转向消费的结构性转型、一带一路计划（作为出口和对外援助的指引）等。
en: Broad strategy is set by management at the top: growth targets, the structural shift from heavy industry to consumption, the Belt and Road Initiative (which will guide exports and foreign aid), and so on.

zh: 管理者在区域级城市中历练，根据他们在实现国家领导人所制定的目标方面的成功获得晋升。
en: Individual managers are tried out in regional cities and promoted based on their success in achieving the goals set by national leaders.

zh: 习近平主席和现任政府所制定的目标是提高经济的成熟度，让中国人民实现中产阶级生活水平。
en: The goals set by President Xi Jinping and the current government are to increase the sophistication of the economy and achieve a middle-class standard of living for the population.

zh: 为了取得成功，中国正大力投资于研究和技术教育。
en: To succeed, China is investing large sums in research and technical education.

zh: 但在渴望赶超西方的同时，中国也在从西方公司窃取技术。
en: But in their eagerness to catch up to the West, China has also stolen technology from Western companies.

zh: 奥巴马执政期间，美国指责中国参与针对美国企业的网络间谍活动，窃取知识产权。
en: Under President Barack Obama, the US accused China of engaging in cyber espionage against American firms and stealing their intellectual property.

zh: 随后习近平和奥巴马在2013年签署了放弃网络窃取行为的公报。
en: Presidents Xi and Obama subsequently signed a communiqué in 2013 renouncing such cyber theft.

zh: 但中国仍在从美国企业那里照搬技术。
en: But China continues to take technology from US companies.

zh: 它要求想在中国做生意的外国公司与中国企业组建合资公司，让中国合作方获得美国企业的技术。
en: It does so by requiring foreign companies that want to do business in China to form joint ventures with Chinese firms, allowing the Chinese partners to obtain US firms’ technology.

zh: 尽管世贸组织禁止成员国以这种强制性技术转让作为市场准入条件，但中国回应说并没有强制，因为公司大可不在中国做生意。
en: And while the WTO prohibits member countries from conditioning market access on such mandatory technology transfers, the Chinese have responded that nothing is mandatory, because companies do not have to do business in China.

zh: 这显然是不诚实的，而美国宣布对中国出口课以沉重关税也是为了鼓励中国遵守世贸组织关于技术转让的规则。
en: That is clearly disingenuous, and the announcement of large US tariffs on Chinese exports is intended to encourage China to comply with the WTO rule on technology transfer.

zh: 中国可能已经领会了个中含义。
en: The Chinese may be getting the message.

zh: 在今年的博鳌论坛的最新演讲中，习近平说中国将不再要求汽车行业组建合资企业 — — 这间接承认了这一要求违反世贸组织规则。
en: In an important recent speech at this year’s Boao Forum, Xi said that China will no longer require such joint ventures in the auto industry – an implicit admission that the requirement is a violation of the WTO rule.

zh: 中国应该扩大这一新政策，完全取消组建合资企业的要求。
en: It is time for China to extend this new policy and eliminate the joint-venture requirement completely.

zh: 尽管美国没有提出这样的要求，但公开宣布未来不会要求外国公司参与合资或以其他方式转让技术为条件进入中国市场对中美两国都有裨益。
en: Although the US does not have such a requirement, it would be helpful for both countries to state openly that in the future no foreign company will be required to enter a joint venture or to transfer technology in other ways as a condition of doing business.

zh: 中国可以通过自己的努力保持高速增长和技术发展。
en: China can continue its rapid growth and technological development through its own efforts.

zh: 而其当前政策只能带来严重的贸易冲突。
en: Its current policy will only lead to a serious trade conflict.

zh: 中国货币操纵不是问题
en: The Non-Problem of Chinese Currency Manipulation

zh: 美国剑桥—美国两大政党很少形成一致，但有一件事让它们团结起来 — — 那就是对“货币操纵 ” ， 尤其是中国的货币操纵的愤怒。
en: CAMBRIDGE – America's two political parties rarely agree, but one thing that unites them is their anger about “currency manipulation," especially by China.

zh: 也许是受最近美元升值及其影响净出口的首批信号的刺激，国会中的民主党和共和党正在再次考虑采取立法对付它们眼中的不公平货币贬值。
en: Perhaps spurred by the recent appreciation of the dollar and the first signs that it is eroding net exports, congressional Democrats and Republicans are once again considering legislation to counter what they view as unfair currency undervaluation.

zh: 计划措施包括针对贬值国的惩罚性关税，即使这可能违反国际贸易规则。
en: The proposed measures include countervailing duties against imports from offending countries, even though this would conflict with international trade rules.

zh: 这是错误的方针。
en: This is the wrong approach.

zh: 即使你认为可以识别货币操纵，中国也不符合标准。
en: Even if one accepts that it is possible to identify currency manipulation, China no longer qualifies.

zh: 但还有一个更加基本的问题：从经济学角度讲，货币操纵或不公平贬值的概念很难界定。
en: But there is a more fundamental point: From an economic viewpoint, currency manipulation or unfair undervaluation are exceedingly hard to pin down conceptually.

zh: 2014年人民币兑美元的略微贬值并非货币操纵的证据；其他许多货币 — — 最值得关注的包括日元和欧元 — — 去年贬值幅度大得多。
en: The renminbi's slight depreciation against the dollar in 2014 is not evidence of it; many other currencies, most notably the yen and the euro, depreciated by far more last year.

zh: 平心而论，中国人民银行在过去十年中经常这样做。
en: To be sure, the People's Bank of China (PBOC) did a lot of this over the last ten years.

zh: 资本流入带来了巨大的国际收支盈余，当局买进美元，以此阻止人民币升值压力。
en: Capital inflows contributed to a large balance-of-payments surplus, and the authorities bought US dollars, thereby resisting upward pressure on the renminbi.

zh: 结果是床下历史记录的外汇储备，2014年7月已达到了3.99万亿美元。
en: The result was as an all-time record level of foreign exchange reserves, reaching $3.99 trillion by July 2014.

zh: 但最近情况有所变化。
en: But the situation has recently changed.

zh: 结果，今年下半年总体国际收支呈现出赤字，中国人民银行的干预实际上是为了阻止人民币贬值。
en: As a result, the overall balance of payments turned negative in the second half of the year, and the PBOC actually intervened to dampen the renminbi's depreciation.

zh: 2015年外汇储备降至3.84万亿美元。
en: Foreign-exchange reserves fell to $3.84 trillion by January 2015.

zh: 没有理由认为这一当前趋势会很快逆转。
en: There is no reason to think that this recent trend will reverse in the near future.

zh: 人民币相对美元的贬值压力反映出美国经济复苏相对强势和中国经济的减速，这也是美联储结束长期货币放松和人民银行开始新一轮货币刺激的原因。
en: The downward pressure on the renminbi relative to the dollar reflects the US economy's relatively strong recovery, which has prompted the Federal Reserve to end a long period of monetary easing, and China's economic slowdown, which has prompted the PBOC to start a new period of monetary stimulus.

zh: 相似的经济基本面也在其他国家起着作用。
en: Similar economic fundamentals are also at work in other countries.

zh: 国会也许还会在跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系（Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership）的后续谈判中对准欧元区。
en: Congress may also want to target the eurozone in coming negotiations on the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership.

zh: 但日本银行和欧洲央行干预外汇市场已有多年。
en: But it has been years since the Bank of Japan or the European Central Bank intervened in the foreign-exchange market.

zh: 事实上，在两年前一次不为人所注意的G-7部长会议中，它们同意了美国财政部关于不要单方面进行外汇干预的提议。
en: Indeed, at an unheralded G-7 ministers' meeting two years ago, they agreed to a US Treasury proposal to refrain from unilateral foreign-exchange intervention.

zh: 但是，美国政府十分清楚，不可能仅仅因为会造成货币贬值而要求经济萎靡的国家不降低利率。
en: But, as the US government knows well, countries with faltering economies cannot be asked to refrain from lowering interest rates just because the likely effects include currency depreciation.

zh: 当时，巴西财政部长曼特加（Guido Mantega）创造了“货币战争”一词，指责美国是主要侵略者。
en: At the time, Brazilian Finance Minister Guido Mantega coined the phrase “currency wars" and accused the US of being the main aggressor.

zh: 事实上，自1985年广场协定后的合作干预以来，美国从未大幅干预货币市场出售美元。
en: In fact, the US has not intervened in a major way in the currency market to sell dollars since the coordinated interventions associated with the Plaza Accord in 1985.

zh: 一个标准是异常大的贸易和经常项目赤字。
en: One criterion is an inappropriately large trade or current-account surplus.

zh: 另一个标准是异常低（经通胀调整）的外汇价值。
en: Another is an inappropriately low real (inflation-adjusted) foreign-exchange value.

zh: 但许多国家都存在巨大的贸易赤字或弱势货币。
en: But many countries have large trade surpluses or weak currencies.

zh: 通常很难说这些情况是否属于异常。
en: Usually it is difficult to say whether they are appropriate.

zh: 十年前，人民币确实似乎满足低估的所有标准。
en: Ten years ago, the renminbi did seem to meet all of the criteria for undervaluation.

zh: 但今非昔比 。
en: But this is no longer the case.

zh: 2006至2013年间，人民币实际价值一直在上升。
en: The renminbi's real value rose from 2006 to 2013.

zh: 最近的购买力统计表明人民币币值已处于人均实际收入10,000美元左右国家的正常范围。
en: The most recent purchasing power statistics show the currency to be in a range that is normal for a country with per capita real income of around $10,000.

zh: 相反，美国国会所关注的标准 — — 双边贸易余额 — — 与经济学家（以及IMF规则）的标准无关。
en: By contrast, the criterion on which the US Congress focuses – the bilateral trade balance – is irrelevant to economists (and to the IMF rules).

zh: 诚然，中国对美国的双边贸易盈余无比巨大。
en: It is true that China's bilateral trade surplus with the US is as big as ever.

zh: 但中国同时也存在对沙特阿拉伯、澳大利亚和其他石油和矿产出口国的双边赤字，对韩国也是如此（中国从韩国进口元件然后组装成制造品出口 ） 。
en: But China also runs bilateral deficits with Saudi Arabia, Australia, and other exporters of oil and minerals, and with South Korea, from which it imports components that go into its manufactured exports.

zh: 这里的重点是双边贸易余额根本说明不了什么问题。
en: The point is that bilateral trade balances have little meaning.

zh: 根据法律，国会要求美国财政部每年两次向其报告哪些国家在货币操纵方面行为不端，双边贸易余额被指定为标准之一。
en: Congress requires by law that the US Treasury report to it twice a year which countries are guilty of currency manipulation, with the bilateral trade balance specified as one of the criteria.

zh: 但对于想要的结果，国会应该保持谨慎。
en: But Congress should be careful what it wishes for.

zh: 如果中国同意美国的要求让人民币自由浮动，结果人民币出现有利于其出口商国际竞争力的贬值，这将十分讽刺。
en: It would be ironic if China agreed to US demands to float the renminbi and the result was a depreciation that boosted its exporters' international competitiveness.

zh: 中国经济最后一次软着陆？
en: China’s Last Soft Landing?

zh: 发自纽黑文市 — — 中国又一次藐视了它的反对者们。
en: NEW HAVEN – Once again, China has defied the naysayers.

zh: 其经济增长在2012年最后一个季度提速至7.9 % — —比第三季度7.4%的GDP增长速度高出半个百分点。
en: Economic growth picked up in the final quarter of 2012 to 7.9% – half a percentage point faster than the 7.4% increase in GDP in the third quarter.

zh: 在经历了连续十个季度的减速后，这次提速意义非凡，它标志着中国经济在略短于4年的时间内第二次实现了软着陆。
en: This was a meaningful increase after ten consecutive quarters of deceleration, and it marks the Chinese economy’s second soft landing in slightly less than four years.

zh: 尽管有很多关于中国将来会转向内需导向的说法，中国现在依然严重依赖出口和外部需求 — — 这是其经济增长的主要动力。
en: Despite all the talk about the coming shift to internal demand, China remains heavily dependent on exports and external demand as major drivers of economic growth.

zh: 中国最近两次经济减速都紧随其最大的两个国外市场 — — 欧洲和美国 — — 的经济衰退之后，这可并不是巧合。
en: It is not a coincidence that its last two slowdowns followed closely on the heels of growth slumps in its two largest foreign markets, Europe and the United States.

zh: 就像2009年初的软着陆发生在美国引发的可怕危机后那样，最近一次的软着陆则紧跟在欧洲主权债务危机之后。
en: Just as the soft landing in early 2009 occurred in the aftermath of a horrific American-made crisis, this latest one followed the European sovereign-debt crisis.

zh: 中国有几个力量来源，使其能够在过去四年里承受艰难的外部冲击。
en: China has several sources of strength that have enabled it to withstand the tough external shocks of the last four years.

zh: 大量储蓄（GDP的53 % ） 所构成的缓冲区以及外汇储备（3.3万亿美元）是其最重要的力量来源。
en: Large buffers of saving (53% of GDP) and foreign-exchange reserves ($3.3 trillion) are at the top of the list.

zh: 此外，不像西方国家已经用光了大部分的传统逆周期政策，如果形势需要，中国还保持着财政及货币政策调整的巨大空间。
en: Moreover, unlike the West, which has used up most of its traditional countercyclical policy ammunition, China has maintained ample scope for fiscal and monetary-policy adjustments as circumstances dictate.

zh: 同样地，强大的城市化动力继续为中国的高投资经济提供坚固的支持，同时让相对贫穷的农民工能够通过在城市找到收入更高的工作来增加自身的收入。
en: Likewise, a powerful urbanization dynamic continues to deliver solid support for China’s high-investment economy, while enabling relatively poor rural workers to raise their incomes by finding higher-paying jobs in the cities.

zh: 然而，这也许是中国最后一次能够在其发展不受影响的情况下避免外部冲击。
en: Nonetheless, this may be the last time that China can escape an external shock with its growth intact.

zh: 其总理温家宝早在六年多之前就提出了这种可能性，他在2007年3月指出：看似辉煌的中国经济已经变得“不稳定、不平衡、不协调、并最终不可持续”了。
en: Premier Wen Jiabao addressed this possibility nearly six years ago, arguing in March 2007 that the seemingly spectacular Chinese economy had become “unstable, unbalanced, uncoordinated, and ultimately unsustainable.”

zh: 自那时起，中国的许多固有优势被不断的外部冲击削弱了。
en: Since then, many of China’s inherent strengths have been sapped by all-too-frequent external shocks.

zh: 银行业仍在清理2008年全球危机后遗留下来的不良债务。
en: The banking sector is still digging out from the bad loans extended in the aftermath of the global meltdown in 2008.

zh: 对那些第一次移居到城市的人来说，要找到负担得起的房子已经成为一个日益严重的问题。
en: Finding affordable housing has become an increasingly serious problem for those relocating to cities for the first time.

zh: 腐败丑闻和政治动乱风险导致人心骚动 — — 至少在去年共产党领导层权力交接之前的几个月是这样的。
en: And corruption scandals and the related risks of political turmoil were unsettling, to say the least, in the months prior to last year’s Communist Party leadership transition.

zh: 换句话说，温家宝的“四不”所指的经济弱点已经显著加剧了。
en: In other words, the vulnerability implied by Wen’s “Four Uns” has increased significantly.

zh: 中国经济确实变得更不稳定，它的实际GDP增长于2009年大幅放缓，2012年也是如此。
en: China’s economy has certainly become more unstable, with major slowdowns in real GDP growth in 2009 and again in 2012.

zh: 其发展不平衡也变得更严重 — — 投资占GDP的比重接近50 % ， 而私人消费占GDP的比重还不到35 % 。
en: Its imbalances have gotten worse as well, with the investment share of GDP approaching 50% and private consumption falling below 35% of GDP.

zh: 同样地，中国也变得更加不协调，或者说碎片化，这是因为其收入差距一直在扩大。
en: Similarly, China has become more uncoordinated, or fragmented, as its income disparities have continued to widen.

zh: 而发展的可持续性正被环境退化和污染所破坏，这对中国的大气和水供应构成了越来越大的威胁。
en: And sustainability is being jeopardized by environmental degradation and pollution, which pose a growing threat to the country’s atmosphere and water supply.

zh: 简而言之，中国的增长模式被史无前例地扩张。
en: In short, China’s growth model has been stretched as never before.

zh: 而且，就像一块布料，它被拉伸的时间越长，要回到原来有弹性的状态的所需的时间就越长 — — 而且越有可能下一次出了什么差错，它再也恢复不到有弹性的状态。
en: And, like a piece of fabric, the longer it remains stretched, the longer it will take to return to its former resilient state – and the greater the possibility that it will not spring back the next time something goes wrong.

zh: 这给新一届中国领导人传递的信息是很明显的：历史上从来没有像现在一样迫切需要进行经济发展的再平衡和改革。
en: The message to China’s new leadership is unmistakable: There has never been a more urgent time to get on with the heavy lifting of rebalancing and reform.

zh: 现在是时候要实施这些措施了，以加速向更为消费者导向的经济过渡的进程。
en: Now is the time to implement the measures that will accelerate the transition to a more consumer-led economy.

zh: 进程是很漫��的，但它已经不是一个秘密了。
en: The agenda is long, but it is hardly a secret.

zh: 它包括发展服务业、资助社会保障、放宽过时的户口政策、改革国有企业并通过提高被人为刻意降低的储蓄利率来结束对家庭的金融压迫。
en: It includes developing the services sector, funding the social safety net, liberalizing an antiquated residential-permit system (hukou), reforming state-owned enterprises, and ending financial repression on households by lifting artificially low interest rates on savings.

zh: 如果不能迅速地在实施这个计划，在这个饱受危机冲击的世界，中国将会很容易受到下一次不可避免的冲击。
en: Failure to act quickly on this program would leave China far too vulnerable to the inevitable next shock in a crisis-battered world.

zh: 没有进行重新平衡的调整，这几个潜在临界点中的任何一个都会严重危害该经济体完成另一次软着陆的能力：银行体系信贷质量的恶化；随着工资上涨削弱出口竞争力；重要的环境、治理和社会问题（也就是，污染、腐败和贫富差距的问题 ） ； 当然，还有外交政策失误，正如与日本之间不断升级的问题所显示出来的一样。
en: In the absence of rebalancing, any one of several potential tipping points could seriously compromise the economy’s ability to pull off another soft landing: deteriorating credit quality in the banking system; weakening export competitiveness as wages rise; key environmental, governance, and social problems (namely, pollution, corruption, and inequality); and, of course, foreign-policy missteps, as suggested by escalating problems with Japan.

zh: 中国经济在过去四年里已经安然度过了两个重要的全球危机。
en: The Chinese economy has come through two major global crises in the past four years.

zh: 表面上，中国的经济韧性令人印象深刻 — — 正如中国领导人一直对全世界强调的一样，它是第一个复苏的国家。
en: On the surface, its resilience has been impressive – the first to recover, as Chinese leaders always want to remind the rest of the world.

zh: 然而，表面之下，这个不平衡、不稳定、不协调、无法持续发展的经济体可能会失去复原能力。
en: But, beneath the surface, an unbalanced, unstable, uncoordinated, and unsustainable economy risks losing its capacity for resilience.

zh: 如果不进行再平衡和改革，中国自动软着陆的好日子也许就再也不会有了。
en: Without rebalancing and reforms, the days of the automatic Chinese soft landing may be over.

zh: 对中国的经济我已经乐观了15年。
en: I have been an optimist about China for 15 years.

zh: 现在我仍然持乐观的态度。
en: I still am.

zh: 但时间不等人。
en: But the clock is ticking.

zh: 温家宝六年前的评论是对过去中国缺陷强有力的诊断，并指出了未来中国的希望和梦想所在。
en: Wen Jiabao’s critique six years ago was a powerful diagnosis of the Old China’s flaws that pointed to the Next China’s hopes and dreams.

zh: 它仍然是中国新一代领导人不能忽视的蓝图。
en: It remains a blueprint that China’s new leadership cannot ignore.

zh: 时间已经对中国来说已经很紧迫了，它必须马上采取行动。
en: Time is no longer on China’s side. It must act now.

zh: 中国经济和美联储政策
en: The Chinese Economy and Fed Policy

zh: 美国剑桥—9月24日耶伦在马萨诸塞州大学发表的讲话清楚地表明，她和美联储联邦公开市场委员会（FOMC）大部分成员倾向于在2015年底提高短期利率。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Janet Yellen’s speech on September 24 at the University of Massachusetts clearly indicated that she and the majority of the members of the Federal Reserve’s Federal Open Market Committee intend to raise the short-term interest rate by the end of 2015.

zh: 尤其重要的是，她明确包括了她自己的观点，这与她在FOMC9月会议后代表全体成员的讲话不同。
en: It was particularly important that she explicitly included her own view, unlike when she spoke on behalf of the entire FOMC after its September meeting.

zh: 尽管如此，由于美联储最近频繁修正其政策立场，市场对今年会否升息仍抱怀疑态度。
en: Nonetheless, given the Fed’s recent history of revising its policy position, markets remain skeptical about the likelihood of a rate increase this year.

zh: 几个月来，美联储一直在说，它将在劳动力市场趋于充分就业、FOMC成员能够确定年通货膨胀达到2%时升高联邦基金利率。
en: The Fed had been saying for several months that it would raise the federal funds rate when the labor market approached full employment and when FOMC members could anticipate that annual inflation would reach 2%.

zh: 但是，尽管这两个条件在9月初都已实现，FOMC仍决定保持利率不变，给出的解释是其担忧全球经济环境，特别是中国的情况。
en: But, although both conditions were met earlier in September, the FOMC decided to leave the rate unchanged, explaining that it was concerned about global economic conditions and about events in China in particular.

zh: 我对此不敢苟同。
en: I was unconvinced.

zh: 几个月来，我认为美联储应该开始收紧货币政策，以降低投资者和贷款人的行为导致金融不稳定的风险。 投资者和贷款人的高风险行为是对2008年金融危机以来长时间超低利率的反应。
en: I have believed for some months that the Fed should start tightening monetary policy to reduce the risks of financial instability caused by the behavior of investors and lenders in response to the prolonged period of exceptionally low interest rates since the 2008 financial crisis.

zh: 中国的情况不是进一步延迟升息的理由。
en: Events in China are no reason for further delay.

zh: 首先，我们看看国内经济情况，从就业状况开始。
en: Consider, first, domestic economic conditions, starting with the employment picture.

zh: 9月16日FOMC会议举行时，失业率已下降至5.1 % ， 这是美联储此前定义为充分就业的水平。
en: By the time the FOMC met on September 16, the unemployment rate had fallen to 5.1%, the level that the Fed had earlier identified as full employment.

zh: 尽管仍有人无法找到全职工作，但按照美联储的说法，让失业率下降到5.1%以下最终会导致有害的通胀升高。
en: Although there are still people who cannot find full-time jobs, driving the unemployment rate below 5.1% would, according to the Fed, eventually lead to unwanted increases in inflation.

zh: 当前通胀状况比较令人难以厘清。
en: The current inflation picture is more confusing.

zh: 过去12个月的年标题通胀率（headline rate）只有0.2 % ， 远低于美联储2%的目标。
en: The annual headline rate over the past 12 months was only 0.2%, far short of the Fed’s 2% target.

zh: 这反映出此前一年中能源价格的大幅下跌，消费物价指数中的能源价格下降了13 % 。
en: This reflected the dramatic fall in energy prices during the previous year, with the energy component of the consumer price index down 13%.

zh: 所谓的核心通胀率（剔除能源成本）为1.8 % 。
en: The rate of so-called core inflation (which excludes energy purchases) was 1.8%.

zh: 即使这个数字也低估了能源对测得通胀率的影响，因为汽油价格的下降降低了运输成本，从而降低了各种价格。
en: Even that understates the impact of energy on measured inflation, because lower gasoline prices reduce shipping costs, lowering a wide range of prices.

zh: 要点一目了然：当能源价格停止下降时，总体物价指数将升至2%附近。
en: The point is simple: When energy prices stop falling, the overall price index will rise close to 2%.

zh: FOMC成员的中位通胀预测值为2017年1.8 % ， 2018年2 % 。
en: And the FOMC members’ own median forecast puts inflation at 1.8% in 2017 and 2% in 2018.

zh: 因此，如果美联储出于某种原因想保持利率不变，它需要美国经济状况之外的解释。
en: So if the Fed, for whatever reason, wanted to leave the interest rate unchanged, it needed an explanation that went beyond economic conditions in the United States.

zh: 美联储转向了最近几周频频登上新闻的中国。
en: It turned to China, which had been much in the news in recent weeks.

zh: 中国正在降低其全球进口，有可能削弱对美国出口的需求。
en: China was reducing its global imports, potentially reducing demand for exports from the US.

zh: 中国股市大幅下跌，从最近的高点跌去40 % 。
en: The Chinese stock market had fallen sharply, declining some 40% from its recent high.

zh: 中国还突然降低了人民币汇率，有可能导致美国进口品价格下降 — — 从而拉低通胀。
en: And China had abruptly devalued the renminbi, potentially contributing to lower import prices – and therefore lower inflation – for the US.

zh: 但对于中国的麻烦给美国经济造成什么影响这一问题，并没有乍看上去那么复杂。
en: But when it comes to the impact of China’s troubles on the US economy, there is less than meets the eye.

zh: 中国的进口需求放缓是因为其经济结构从倚重工业转向倚重服务业和家庭消费。
en: China’s import demand is slowing in line with its economic structure’s shift away from industry and toward services and household consumption.

zh: 这意味着中国不再需要那么多从澳大利亚和南美进口的铁矿石和其他原材料以及那么多从德国和日本进口的专业制造设备。
en: This means that China needs less of the iron ore and other raw materials that it imports from Australia and South America and less of the specialized manufacturing equipment that it imports from Germany and Japan.

zh: 美国只占中国进口额的8 % ， 而其对华出口只占其GDP的不到1 % 。
en: The US accounts for only 8% of China’s imports, and its exports to China represent less than 1% of its GDP.

zh: 因此中国削减出口对美国GDP的影响最多只有零点几个百分点，并且这一影响也需要好几年才会充分显现。
en: So China’s cut in imports could not shave more than a few tenths of a percentage point from US GDP, and even that would be spread over several years.

zh: 至于股市 — — 一小部分中国家庭把中国股市看成是赌场 — — 只有6%的中国人拥有股票。
en: As for the stock market – widely viewed as a kind of casino for a small fraction of Chinese households – only about 6% of China’s population own shares.

zh: 上证指数从一年前的2,200点飙升至今年仲夏的5,100点，然后又暴跌至现在的3,000点上下。
en: The Shanghai stock market index soared from 2,200 a year ago to a peak of 5,100 in mid-summer and then dropped sharply, to about 3,000 now.

zh: 因此，尽管最近股市暴跌是热门新闻，但中国股市仍比一年前上涨了30%以上。
en: So, despite the sharp drop that made headlines recently, Chinese shares are up more than 30% from a year ago.

zh: 更重要的是，中国的财富和消费与房地产价值而非股票价值密切相关。
en: More important, wealth and consumption in China are closely related to real-estate values, not equity values.

zh: 最后，最近人民币兑美元贬值幅度只有2.5 % ， 从6.2元兑1美元贬至6.35元兑1美元 — — 远远比不上日元、欧元和英镑两位数的贬值幅度。
en: Finally, the renminbi’s recent decline against the dollar was only 2.5%, from CN¥6.2 to CN¥6.35 – far below the double-digit declines of the Japanese yen, the euro, and the British pound.

zh: 因此，从总贸易加权角度看，人民币价值相对其竞争对手货币来说要高得多。
en: So, on an overall trade-weighted basis, the renminbi is substantially higher relative to the currencies with which it competes.

zh: 更重要的是，人民币和其他货币在过去一年中的贬值对美国进口价格影响甚微，因为中国和其他出口国的商品以美元定价，不会因为汇率变化而调整价格。
en: Even more relevant, the decline of the renminbi and other currencies in the past year has had very little impact on US import prices, because Chinese and other exporters price their goods in dollars and do not adjust them when the exchange rate changes.

zh: 美国官方数据显示，在截至今年8月的12个月中，总体进口物价下降了11 % ， 但这几乎完全是因为能源成本下降所致。
en: While official US data show overall import prices down 11% in the 12 months through August, this is almost entirely due to lower energy costs.

zh: 剔除能源产品后，进口物价只下降了3 % 。
en: When energy products are excluded, import prices are down only 3%.

zh: 因此，美联储说能源价格暴跌引起了通胀低迷是正确的；但它不必担心主要贸易伙伴货币贬值的影响。
en: So the Fed is right to say that inflation is low because of the sharp drop in energy prices; but it need not worry about the effect of major trading partners’ lower currency values.

zh: 重申一次，当能源价格停止下跌时，通胀率会上升至接近核心通胀率的1.8 % 。
en: And, again, when the price of energy stops declining, the inflation rate will rise close to the core rate of 1.8%.

zh: 因此，除非美国经济发生出人意料的变化，我们可以预期美联储将如耶伦所提出的那样在今年晚些时候开始升息，并在2016年及以后持续升息。
en: So, unless there are surprising changes in the US economy, we can expect the Fed to start raising interest rates later this year, as Janet Yellen has proposed, and to continue raising them in 2016 and beyond.

zh: 我只希望美联储在未来18个月中将利息升高足够多，以避免长时间过度宽松货币政策可能导致的金融不稳定和长期通胀。
en: I only hope that it raises them enough over the next 18 months to avoid the financial instability and longer-term inflation that could result from the long era of excessively easy monetary policy.

zh: 中国的金融防洪闸
en: China’s Financial Floodgates

zh: 发自纽约 — — 在经历了数十年波澜壮阔的增长后，中国经济的增速开始下降，而这也令其政府日渐处于资本账户自由化的诱惑之下。
en: NEW YORK – As China’s economy starts to slow, following decades of spectacular growth, the government will increasingly be exposed to the siren song of capital-account liberalization.

zh: 考虑到中国政府实现人民币国际化的意愿，这一选项或许咋一看上去极为诱人。
en: This option might initially appear attractive, particularly given the Chinese government’s desire to internationalize the renminbi.

zh: 但这却是容易让人误入歧途的表象。
en: But appearances can deceive.

zh: 一份新发表的报告认为中国政府可能会对资本账户自由化持怀疑态度。
en: A new report argues that the Chinese authorities should be skeptical about capital-account liberalization.

zh: 通过借鉴其他新兴国家的最新经验，该报告认为中国在将自身经济暴露在全球资本洪流之前，应当采取一个周密部署且谨慎小心的步骤。
en: Drawing lessons from the recent experiences of other emerging countries, the report concludes that China should adopt a carefully sequenced and cautious approach when exposing its economy to the caprices of global capital flows.

zh: 而新兴经济体近来最常出现的情况 — — 从拉美开始再延续到东亚和中东欧地区 — — 就是资本流动会大幅强化经济周期，同时也是引发金融不稳定状况的最大单一因素。
en: The common thread to be found in the recent history of emerging economies – beginning in Latin America and running through East Asia and Central and Eastern Europe – is that capital flows are strongly pro-cyclical, and are the biggest single cause of financial instability.

zh: 而与自由化相关联的国内金融不稳定状况也会对国家经济表现产生重大影响，正如对非银行金融中介机构缺乏监管所导致的那样 — — 随着中国影子银行部门对信贷增长的不断助推，这个问题也变得日益凸显。
en: Domestic financial instability, associated with liberalization, also has a large impact on economic performance, as does the lack of control over non-bank financial intermediaries – an issue that China is now starting to face as the shadow banking sector’s contribution to credit growth becomes more pronounced.

zh: 大多数学术研究也认为金融和资本账户自由化应当更加谨慎的推进，并同时伴随更为严格的国内金融监管措施。
en: Most academic research also supports the view that financial and capital-account liberalization should be undertaken warily, and that it should be accompanied by stronger domestic financial regulation.

zh: 在资本流动方面，这意味着保留资本账户监管措施作为宏观经济政策的一个必要工具。
en: In the case of capital flows, this means retaining capital-account regulations as an essential tool of macroeconomic policy.

zh: 事实上在1990年代，中国 — — 以及印度 — — 已经让所有发展中国家了解到了逐步实施自由化的重要性。
en: Indeed, during the 1990s, China – and also India – taught the rest of the developing world the importance of gradual liberalization.

zh: 但在1997年在东亚地区爆发并在随后一年蔓延到俄罗斯，并导致大多数发展中国家的金融和经济危机后，许多国家才真正领会到了这一点。
en: It was a lesson that many countries fully learned only in the wake of the economic and financial crises that began in East Asia in 1997, spread to Russia in 1998, and affected most of the emerging world.

zh: 当年中国之所以能置身事外，就是通过保持严格的资本账户监管。
en: By maintaining strong capital-account regulation, China avoided the contagion.

zh: 即便是国际货币基金组织，也在2012年年末采用了一项谨慎策略。
en: Even the International Monetary Fund, in late 2012, adopted a cautious approach.

zh: 该组织认为，资本账户自由化有利有弊，因此“自由化需要进行周密策划，制定时间表，并循序渐进以保证其利大于弊 ” 。
en: The IMF now recognizes that capital-account liberalization comes with risks as well as benefits, and that “liberalization needs to be well planned, timed, and sequenced in order to ensure that its benefits outweigh the costs.”

zh: 此外该组织也认为，资本账户监管属于国家为避免出现经济和金融不稳定状况而应当自由实施的更广泛宏观计划手段的一部分。
en: Moreover, the Fund now regards capital-account regulations as part of the broader menu of macro-prudential measures that countries should be free to use to prevent economic and financial instability.

zh: 考虑到资本账户的不稳定性是新兴经济体最主要的顺周期性金融冲击，监管应该是对抗这一冲击的主要宏观计划工具。
en: To the extent that capital-account volatility is the major pro-cyclical financial shock in emerging economies, regulation should be the major macro-prudential instrument used to counter it.

zh: 同时这些监管也应当是其他反周期宏观经济政策的补充而非取代物。
en: These regulations should complement, not substitute for, other countercyclical macroeconomic policies.

zh: 该组织同时建议给于这类政策比那些其他政策更高的优先度，而我们则建议将这些政策和资本账户监管并列实施。
en: The IMF recommends giving higher priority to those other policies, whereas we have previously recommended using them and capital-account regulations simultaneously.

zh: 需要留意快速自由化风险的可不仅仅是新兴市场国家。
en: It is not just emerging markets that have had to pay heed to the dangers of rapid liberalization.

zh: 对于一种国际需求持续增高的货币来说。 日本的经验也为谨慎实施资本账户自由化的重要性提供了宝贵一课。
en: Japan’s experiences also offer valuable lessons about the importance of prudence in capital-account liberalization for a currency in increasingly high demand internationally.

zh: 在相当长的一段时期。 日本只允许受到严格监管的金融中介机构去管理资金流，也因此有效遏制了其货币的国际应用。
en: For an extended period, Japan allowed only strongly regulated financial intermediaries to manage capital flows, effectively discouraging the international use of its currency.

zh: 而当一场资本海啸似乎要淹没整个经济体之时。 政策制定者们也毫不犹豫地尝试遏制这些现金流入。
en: And when a tsunami of capital looked set to flood the economy, policymakers did not shy away from trying to contain the inflows.

zh: 在某种意义上，西欧地区也曾出现过同样的情况。
en: In a sense, Western Europe was once in the same boat.

zh: 其资本账户自由化同样也是一个长期进程，始于1958年的经常账户可兑换性，最终完成于1990年的经常账户可兑换性。
en: Its capital-account liberalization was also a long-term process, beginning with current-account convertibility in 1958 and ending with capital-account convertibility in 1990.

zh: 而就在大功告成两年后，其支付系统就遭遇了一场危机并导致某些国家的货币大幅贬值。
en: And it faced a crisis of its payments system two years later that led to significant depreciation for some countries’ currencies.

zh: 上述例子并不是建议人民币的国际化不应在可见的将来实施。
en: None of this is intended to suggest that the internationalization of the renminbi should not take place in the foreseeable future.

zh: 考虑到中国在全球经济中的重要性，人民币交易和投资份额的不断扩大似乎是不可避免的。
en: Given the importance of China in the global economy, the denomination of an increasing share of trade and investment in renminbi seems inevitable.

zh: 但中国当局应当按部就班地管理这一进程，选好执行这一进程的各种特定渠道。
en: But China’s authorities should manage that process gradually, choosing the specific channels through which it should take place.

zh: 事实上，中国或许是有史以来在渐进及实用主义经济转型方面的最成功范例。
en: Indeed, China is perhaps the most successful example in history of gradual and pragmatic economic transformation.

zh: 因此它也不应当让自身被一种已经导致无数新兴经济体摇摇欲坠的政策所蛊惑，最终偏离已经经过历练和考验的进程。
en: It should not allow itself to be tempted from its tried and tested course by calls for a policy that has led too many emerging economies onto the rocks.

zh: 中国经济的长城
en: The Chinese Economy’s Great Wall

zh: 华盛顿—最近，人民币贬值给中国股市动荡推波助澜，让政府在上周两次中止交易，这彰显出中国所面临的一个重大挑战：如何平衡国内和国际经济责任。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The recent decline in China’s currency, the renminbi, which has fueled turmoil in Chinese stock markets and drove the government to suspend trading twice last week, highlights a major challenge facing the country: how to balance its domestic and international economic obligations.

zh: 当局采取何种方针将对全球经济的利益造成重大影响。
en: The approach the authorities take will have a major impact on the wellbeing of the global economy.

zh: 2008年全球金融危机，以及随后发达国家复苏令人失望让中国的转型政策面临了新的紧迫性。 中国欲将其增长模式从基于投资和外需转为基于国内消费。
en: The 2008 global financial crisis, coupled with the disappointing recovery in the advanced economies that followed, injected a new urgency into China’s efforts to shift its growth model from one based on investment and external demand to one underpinned by domestic consumption.

zh: 做好这一结构转型并且不让经济增长严重下降对任何国家来说都是难事。
en: Navigating such a structural transition without causing a sharp decline in economic growth would be difficult for any country.

zh: 而对于中国这样的复杂大国，挑战尤其巨大，特别是在当今全球增长萎靡的环境下。
en: The challenge is even greater for a country as large and complex as China, especially given today’s environment of sluggish global growth.

zh: 多年来，中国政府试图扩大权益所有权，从而让更多的中国公民在成功的市场经济转型中分得一杯羹。
en: For years, China’s government sought to broaden equity ownership, thereby providing more Chinese citizens with a stake in a successful transition to a market economy.

zh: 但是，与美国在2008年危机前扩大房屋所有权的措施一样，中国的政策过犹不及，造成了一个金融上不可持续的局面，并极有可能出现剧烈的价格下跌和混乱。
en: But, like the United States’ effort to expand home ownership in the years preceding the 2008 crisis, Chinese policies went too far, creating a financially unsustainable situation that implied the possibility of major price declines and dislocations.

zh: 因此，调整挑战变得十分艰巨。
en: As a result, the adjustment challenge has grown dramatically.

zh: 中国公司不再能够向国外出售迅速扩大的产量并进一步支持产能扩张，中国经济失去了一些重要的增长。 就业和工资引擎。
en: With Chinese companies no longer able to sell a rapidly increasing volume of products abroad and support further expansion of productive capacity, the economy has lost some important growth, employment, and wage engines.

zh: 由此带来的经济减速制约了政府保持资产价格膨胀、避免信用枯竭的能力。
en: The resulting economic slowdown has undermined the government’s capacity to maintain inflated asset prices and avoid pockets of credit distress.

zh: 为了减轻所有这些给中国公民福利带来的不利影响，中国官员指引人民币贬值。
en: In an effort to limit the detrimental impact of all this on citizens’ wellbeing, Chinese officials have been guiding the currency lower.

zh: 去年8月的突然贬值后，人民币在岸汇率一跌再跌，所有这些都是为了增加中国商品的海外吸引力，同时加快国内的进口替代。
en: A surprise devaluation last August has been followed by a number of lower daily fixes in the onshore exchange rate, all intended to make Chinese goods more attractive abroad, while accelerating import substitution at home.

zh: 人民币在离岸市场的贬值幅度比在岸市场还要大。
en: The renminbi has depreciated even more in the offshore market.

zh: 人民币贬值与近几年来囊括新兴市场和发达经济体的更广大的趋势相符。
en: China’s currency devaluations are consistent with a broader trend among both emerging and advanced economies in recent years.

zh: 全球金融危机后，美国很快开始严重依赖扩张性货币政策，其特征是近零利率和大规模资产购买，美元于是贬值，从而刺激出口。
en: Soon after the global financial crisis, the US relied heavily on expansionary monetary policy, characterized by near-zero interest rates and large-scale asset purchases, which weakened the dollar, thereby boosting exports.

zh: 最近，欧洲央行也采取了类似的方针，指引欧元贬值以刺激国内经济活动。
en: More recently, the European Central Bank has adopted a similar approach, guiding the euro downward in an effort to boost domestic activity.

zh: 但在追求国内目标的同时，中国也在不经意间放大了全球金融动荡风险。
en: But in pursuing its domestic objectives, China risks inadvertently amplifying global financial instability.

zh: 具体而言，市场担心人民币贬值可能“偷走”其他国家的增长，包括那些外债比中国高得多、金融缓冲远不及中国（中国有着巨量国际储备）充分的国家。
en: Specifically, markets worry that renminbi devaluation could “steal” growth from other countries, including those that have far more foreign debt and far less robust financial cushions than China, which maintains ample international reserves.

zh: 这一担忧给中国带来了更加艰巨的平衡挑战：在中国寻求在全球经济治理中获得与其经济实力相称的作用的过程中，它必须平衡好各方利益。
en: This concern speaks to the even more challenging balancing act that China must perform as it seeks to play the role in global economic governance that its economic weight warrants.

zh: 毕竟，现在中国是世界第二大经济体（以一些非市场标准衡量已经是世界第一大经济体 ） 。
en: After all, China is now the world’s second-largest economy (and, by some non-market measures, the largest).

zh: 诚然，中国最近表现出逐渐实现其金融体系国际化的兴趣。
en: And, indeed, China has lately been showing greater interest in gradually internationalizing its financial system.

zh: 最近，中国令人瞩目地成功说服国际货币基金组织（IMF）将人民币加入决定其特别提款权（SDR）价值的货币篮子。 SDR是IMF用来与其188个成员国做交易的价值单位。
en: Notably, it recently succeeded in persuading the International Monetary Fund to add the renminbi to the basket of currencies that determines the value of the Special Drawing Right, the unit the IMF uses in dealing with its 188 member countries.

zh: 这一举措 — — 授予人民币与主要全球性货币（美元、欧元、英镑和日元）同等地位 — — 将让更多公共和私人部门在国际货币体系中接受人民币。
en: That step – which places the renminbi on par with the major global currencies (the US dollar, the euro, the British pound, and the Japanese yen) – will enhance public- and private-sector acceptance of China’s currency in the international monetary system.

zh: 与此同时，这也形成了一个预期 — — 乃至义务 — — 即中国不会去加剧全球金融动荡。
en: At the same time, it created the expectation – though not the obligation – that China will refrain from aggravating global financial instability.

zh: 总有一天，中国的国内和国际责任将再次相对更加一致。
en: There will come a time when China’s domestic and international responsibilities will again be relatively well aligned.

zh: 但这一天不是现在；考虑到中国未竟的结构转型困难重重，这一天在近期也不可能到来。
en: But that time is not now; and, given the country’s tricky ongoing structural transition, it probably will not come anytime soon.

zh: 与此同时，中国可能继续被迫首先顾及其国内责任，但方式将更加细致，以避免引发全球经济的大动荡。
en: In the meantime, it seems likely that China will continue to feel compelled to place its domestic obligations first, but in a nuanced way aimed at avoiding large disruptive tipping points for the global economy.

zh: 但是，这是否足以避免无需结果绝非板上钉钉。
en: Whether that will be enough to avoid disorderly outcomes, however, is not totally assured.

zh: 肯尼亚和津巴布韦的中国因素
en: The China Factor in Kenya and Zimbabwe

zh: 北京 — — 如果询问一个对非洲有基本知识的人哪个国家更有可能取得成功 — — 津巴布韦还是肯尼亚 — — 他或她会毫不犹豫的回答“肯尼亚 ” 。
en: BEIJING – Ask anyone with a basic knowledge of Africa which country is more poised for success – Zimbabwe or Kenya – and he or she will undoubtedly answer “Kenya.”

zh: 上周发生的事件似乎证实了这样的判决。
en: Events of the last week would seem to confirm that verdict.

zh: 周一，在肯尼亚最高法院支持总统乌胡鲁·肯雅塔在该国有争议的总统选举中连任之后，法治似乎多年以来首次战胜了政治暴力。
en: On Monday, after Kenya’s Supreme Court upheld the reelection of President Uhuru Kenyatta in the country’s contested presidential election, the rule of law seemed to trump political violence for the first time in years.

zh: 而另一方面，津巴布韦则在37年来首次失去了总统罗伯特·穆加贝。
en: Zimbabwe, on the other hand, is without President Robert Mugabe for the first time in 37 years.

zh: 而且，尽管该国现在可能欣喜若狂，但其政治未来却距离“确定”还相去甚远。
en: And, although the country may be ecstatic now, its political future is far from certain.

zh: 但是作为一名生活在非洲大陆最重要的发展伙伴之一中国的肯尼亚人，我看到有一个衡量标准导致天平向津巴布韦倾斜：那就是这个国家与我第二故乡的关系。
en: But as a Kenyan living in China, one of the African continent’s most important development partners, I see one metric that tips the scale in Zimbabwe’s favor: its relationship with my adopted home.

zh: 事实上，津巴布韦与中国的经济和政治关系可能被事实证明对这个非洲永久的失败国家具有决定性的意义。
en: In fact, Zimbabwe’s economic and political ties to China could prove decisive for Africa’s perpetual underdog.

zh: 从纸面上看，肯尼亚显然具有优势。
en: On paper, Kenya clearly has the edge.

zh: 尽管津巴布韦拥有更多的自然资源和矿产财富，但土地面积却小得多，极端贫困的情况也更为普遍。
en: Although Zimbabwe has more natural resources and mineral wealth, it has far less land and extreme poverty is much more widespread.

zh: 全国1，600万人口中有超过70%每天依靠不到1.9美元生活，而肯尼亚的4，800万人口中仅有46%处在相同的境遇。
en: More than 70% of the country’s 16 million people live on less than $1.90 a day, compared to 46% of Kenya’s 48 million people.

zh: 此外， 高达90%的津巴布韦人没有工作或就业不足，而只有39%的肯尼亚人处在同等境遇。
en: Moreover, as many as 90% of Zimbabweans are unemployed or underemployed, compared to 39% of Kenyans.

zh: 就连肯尼亚与中国的经济关系乍看上去似乎也更令人钦佩。
en: Even Kenya’s economic links to China might seem more impressive at first glance.

zh: 肯尼亚和中国一直在大型基础设施项目上开展长期合作。
en: Kenya and China have long cooperated on large infrastructure projects.

zh: 今年早些时候贯通的一条由中国出资修建的内罗毕和蒙巴萨之间的铁路就是最近的例子。
en: A Chinese-funded railway between Nairobi and Mombasa, which opened earlier this year, is the latest example.

zh: 2000年以来，中国已经向肯尼亚提供了68亿美元的基础设施项目贷款，而津巴布韦则只有17亿美元。
en: Since 2000, China has offered Kenya $6.8 billion in loans for infrastructure projects, compared to $1.7 billion for Zimbabwe.

zh: 而且，因为贷款条件中往往包括雇用中国雇员等要求，截至2015年底肯尼亚拥有超过7，400名中国员工，而津巴布韦则仅有950多人。
en: And, because loan conditions often include a requirement to hire Chinese employees, Kenya had more than 7,400 at the end of 2015, while Zimbabwe had just over 950.

zh: 但在对中国慷慨投资的争夺中，肯尼亚对津巴布韦的优势也截止于此。
en: But in the competition for Chinese largesse, Kenya’s advantage over Zimbabwe ends there.

zh: 2003年来津巴布韦所累计的中国外商直接投资已达近70亿美元，而肯尼亚则只有39亿美元。
en: Cumulative Chinese foreign direct investment since 2003 has reached nearly $7 billion in Zimbabwe, compared to $3.9 billion for Kenya.

zh: 按照年同比计算，也有更多的中国资本流往津巴布韦。
en: Year on year, more Chinese money is flowing to Zimbabwe as well.

zh: 此外，津巴布韦与中国的贸易平衡远优于肯尼亚。
en: Moreover, Zimbabwe’s trade balance with China is far superior to Kenya’s.

zh: 2015年，肯尼亚对中国的出口总额为9，900万美元，但从中国的进口却惊人的达到出口额的60倍。
en: In 2015, Kenya’s exports to China totaled $99 million, while it imported from China a staggering 60 times that amount.

zh: 即便考虑到与中国建造基础设施相关的材料进口，这也是非常大的双边赤字。
en: Even taking into account imports of materials tied to Chinese-built infrastructure, this is an exceptionally wide bilateral deficit.

zh: 另一方面，津巴布韦尽管增长缓慢，2015年却向中国出口了7.6亿美元的商品，而进口额为5.46亿。
en: Zimbabwe, on the other hand, despite its slow growth rate, exported $766 million worth of goods to China in 2015, and imported $546 million.

zh: 最令人惊讶的是，津巴布韦的出口不仅像人们想象的那样限于矿产和金属，而且还包括烟草和棉花这些劳动密集程度相对较高的产品，这也意味着在国内创造了更多的工作岗位。
en: Most surprisingly, Zimbabwe’s exports were not restricted to minerals and metals, as one might assume, but also included tobacco and cotton, products that are relatively more labor-intensive, meaning more job creation at home.

zh: 而且，尽管津巴布韦的注册中国企业比肯尼亚少近50家，但肯尼亚经济规模约为津巴布韦的4.5倍，这显然意味着在津巴布韦运营的中国企业对该国经济的贡献更大。
en: And, while Zimbabwe has around 50 fewer registered Chinese companies than Kenya, Kenya’s economy is around 4.5 times the size of Zimbabwe’s, clearly implying that those firms that are operating there contribute more to the country’s economy.

zh: 津巴布韦究竟如何实现了（至少从数字角度看）比肯尼亚与中国更好的关系？
en: How has Zimbabwe achieved what looks like, at least from a numerical perspective, a more productive relationship with China than Kenya has?

zh: 除穆加贝及其亲密同事，包括该国新任总统埃默森·姆南加古瓦外，很少有人确切了解这其中的奥秘。
en: Few beyond Mugabe and his close colleagues, including the country’s new president, Emmerson Mnangagwa, know for sure.

zh: 但做出靠谱推测的一个方法是对比两国与中国的双边关系史。
en: But one way to make an educated guess is to compare both countries’ history of bilateral engagement with China.

zh: 肯尼亚和津巴布韦两国在整个后殖民史上都曾有过两次中国领导人访问的经历。
en: Both Kenya and Zimbabwe have had two visits from Chinese heads of state during their post-colonial histories.

zh: 中国主席江泽民于1996年分别访问了这两个国家，而胡锦涛主席则在2006年访问肯尼亚。
en: Chinese President Jiang Zemin visited each country in 1996, while President Hu Jintao visited Kenya in 2006.

zh: 中国的现任主席习近平则在2015年访问了津巴布韦。
en: China’s current president, Xi Jinping, visited Zimbabwe in 2015.

zh: 反过来的国家访问更加不平衡。
en: State visits in the other direction have been more uneven.

zh: 穆加贝首访中国是在1980年，也就是独立六个月后；他在任期间又曾13次到访中国，而且其他津巴布韦官员的高层访问甚至更为频繁，在穆加贝执政期间大约每两年发生一次。
en: Mugabe’s first visit to China was in 1980, just six months after independence; he made 13 more during his tenure, and high-level visits by other Zimbabwean officials were even more frequent, occurring roughly once every two years during Mugabe’s reign.

zh: 相比之下，肯尼亚总统同期仅六次到访中国，其中最近的一次是在2017年5月。
en: Kenyan presidents, by contrast, traveled to China just six times during the same period, most recently in May 2017.

zh: 津巴布韦领导人充分利用访问机会寻求贸易和军事合作，而且很可能直接接触私营中资企业。
en: Zimbabwe’s leaders made the most of their visits to press for trade and military cooperation, and likely engaged directly with private Chinese companies.

zh: 这营造出一种互惠互利的文化。
en: This has nurtured a culture of reciprocity.

zh: 例如短短几个月前，一家中国企业曾向我的公司咨询如何进入津巴布韦医疗市场的建议。
en: Just a few months ago, for example, a Chinese company approached my firm asking for advice about how to enter Zimbabwe’s health-care market.

zh: 我还没有就进入肯尼亚市场接到过类似的问题。
en: I have not yet fielded similar questions about gaining access to markets in Kenya.

zh: 中国在非洲经济中所发挥的作用也曾受到批评；但正如我之前所说的那样，中国投资一直维系着非洲大陆许多人的生命。
en: China’s role in African economies has been criticized; but, as I have argued before, Chinese investment has also been a lifeline to many on the continent.

zh: 从创造就业机会到直接投资基础设施，在许多西方投资者选择远离非洲的时候中国却选择成为非洲的合作伙伴。
en: From creating employment opportunities to providing direct investment in infrastructure, China has been a partner to Africa when many Western investors preferred to stay away.

zh: 肯尼亚和津巴布韦如何驾驭未来的对华关系依然有待观察。
en: How Kenya and Zimbabwe navigate their future relationships with China remains to be seen.

zh: 两国都支持习近平提出的标志性的一带一路战略，这在理论上应当增加它们对中国的战略价值。
en: Both countries have supported Xi’s signature Belt and Road Initiative, which, in theory, should increase their strategic value to China.

zh: 肯尼亚回归政治稳定也应当维持甚至加深该国与中国的经济关系。
en: Kenya’s return to political stability should also sustain, if not deepen, the country’s economic engagement with China.

zh: 津巴布韦与中国的历史关系同样重要。
en: Zimbabwe’s historic ties to China will be no less important.

zh: 在穆加贝辞职后，中国外长不遗余力的赞扬“中国和津巴布韦之间的友谊 ” ， 而姆南加古瓦肯定会延续这样的关系。
en: Following Mugabe’s resignation, China’s foreign ministry went out of its way to praise the “friendship between China and Zimbabwe,” and Mnangagwa can be expected to continue that relationship.

zh: 这位新总统曾在中国接受过军事培训，并在2001年以议会议长的身份进行过正式访问。
en: The new president received military training in China, and paid an official visit as speaker of the parliament in 2001.

zh: 甚至有人猜测中国曾在津巴布韦政变之前收到过警告，甚至事先曾征询过中国的意见。
en: There is even speculation that China was warned of the looming coup in Zimbabwe, if not consulted beforehand.

zh: 随着肯尼亚和津巴布韦探索各自的政治未来，两国的很多情况毫无疑问将会发生改变 — — 我们当然希望是向好的方向改变。
en: As Kenya and Zimbabwe navigate their political futures, much in both countries will no doubt change – one hopes for the better.

zh: 它们与中国的关系将成为评估各自发展道路的关键标准。
en: Their ties with China will be a key metric in assessing their trajectory.

zh: 中国的政治干预
en: China’s Political Interventions

zh: 东京—在上周前后，全球股市波动陡增，纽约、东京、伦敦和其他地区的交易员纷纷面临巨大的价格震荡。
en: TOKYO – In the last week or so, stock markets around the world have been hit by an upsurge in volatility, with large price swings confronting traders in New York, Tokyo, London, and beyond.

zh: 而全球金融痉挛的原因大多指向了同一个罪魁：中国。
en: And the entire global financial spasm has been largely blamed on a single culprit: China.

zh: 在自由经济中，市场机制可以制造稳定或不稳定。
en: In a free economy, market mechanisms can produce stability or instability.

zh: 有形商品价格的上涨通常导致需求下降，促使市场形成新均衡。
en: An increase in the price of a tangible good would typically cause demand to fall, leading the market toward a new equilibrium.

zh: 相反，股市等资产的价格上涨制造出进一步上证的预期，导致需求增加，有可能达到过高水平。
en: By contrast, an increase in the price of an asset like a stock raises expectations of a further increase, causing demand to rise, potentially to excessively high levels.

zh: 在像中国这样的计划经济中，决策者用各种工具影响资产价格，理论上，这一不稳定可以避免；事实上，马克思主义观点认为，阻止危机的政府干预正是管制经济优于自由市场经济的要害。
en: In a planned economy like China’s, where policymakers use various tools to influence asset prices, such instability could, in theory, be avoided; indeed, the Marxist view is that government intervention to stop crises is precisely why controlled economies are superior to their free-market counterparts.

zh: 但在实践中似乎并非如此。
en: But, in practice, that does not seem to be the case.

zh: 中国货币当局所谓的维持价格操作（日本在20世纪90年代曾经尝试过）想必正是过去一年中国股市暴涨的原因，其涨幅远远超过了经济基本面所隐含的水平。
en: So-called price-keeping operations by China’s monetary authorities (an approach tried in Japan in the early 1990s) are presumably the reason why the domestic stock market rose sharply over the last year, far beyond the levels warranted by the country’s economic fundamentals.

zh: 最近的股市暴跌表明投资者认定股价已不可持续。
en: The recent stock-market plunge suggests that investors have concluded that equity prices have become unsustainable.

zh: 但中国政府仍决定干预，用出于政治动机的大手笔政策应对市场修正，包括完全停牌许多公司的股票。
en: Yet the Chinese government has remained committed to intervention, responding to the correction with heavy-handed, politically motivated measures, including the complete suspension of trade of many companies’ stocks.

zh: 这一措施似乎阻止了上证指数的进一步下跌。
en: The move seemed to have halted the further deterioration of the Shanghai stock market.

zh: 但效果只是暂时的；8月24日，市场下跌8.5 % ， 创出2007年以来的最大跌幅。
en: But the effect was only temporary; on August 24, the market fell by 8.5%, the largest drop since 2007.

zh: 中国的干预主义方针的长期系统性影响也许比股市的当前下跌更加严重。
en: The long-term systemic impact of China’s interventionist approach may be even more serious than the stock market’s current decline.

zh: 没人愿意在政府可以随时更改游戏规则的市场上投资，特别是他们获得了在关键时刻被禁止交易的第一手经验。
en: Few want to invest in a market where the government can change the rules of the game at any time, especially if they have had first-hand experience of being blocked from trading at a crucial moment.

zh: 更糟糕的是，中国投资者不像其他市场上的投资者那样可以获得那么多信息。
en: To make matters worse, Chinese investors do not have the same access to information that investors in other markets do.

zh: 像上海这样的高度组织的金融市场有可能与极权体制相容吗？
en: Can a highly organized financial market like the one that is emerging in Shanghai ever be compatible with an authoritarian regime?

zh: 中国当局的另一项最新干预 — — 逐渐升值，然后出人意料地让人民币贬值 — — 也造成了类似的问题。
en: Another recent intervention by the Chinese authorities – gradual appreciation, followed by the unexpected devaluation of the renminbi – raises similar questions.

zh: 平心而论，这一做法的第一阶段也许主要是因为渴望加强市场在决定汇率方面的作用，这有助于增加长期稳定、增加人民币成为全球储备货币的机会。
en: To be sure, the first part of the move was probably motivated largely by the desire to strengthen markets’ role in setting the exchange rate, which promises to boost long-term stability and improve the renminbi’s chances of becoming a global reserve currency.

zh: 但是，最近的贬值表明，这一在强化人民币多年后所发生的变化可能给世界货币市场带来波动剧增。
en: But, as the recent devaluation showed, the shift, coming after years of efforts to strengthen the renminbi, could fuel a sharp increase in volatility in world currency markets.

zh: 当然，最近的人民币贬值比2008年金融危机后美国和英国所发动的实际贬值要小得多，也远远比不上2012年以来日本银行所发动的贬值。
en: Of course, the renminbi’s recent depreciation was much smaller than the de facto currency devaluations engineered by the United States and the United Kingdom after the financial crisis of 2008. It was also nowhere near as significant as the devaluation that the Bank of Japan has pursued since 2012.

zh: 但人民币受严格管制这一事实以及多年来的稳步升值的历史意味着其突然贬值要比美国、英国和日本的动作产生更大的市场影响。 后三者的贬值人们是提前得到暗示的。
en: But the fact that the renminbi has been so highly managed, together with its history of steady appreciation, meant that the sudden devaluation had a more significant effect on the market than the US, British, and Japanese moves, all of which were communicated better in advance.

zh: 尽管如此，关于人民币贬值将引发“货币战争”的警告是站不住脚的。
en: Still, warnings that renminbi devaluation will spark a “currency war” are unwarranted.

zh: 当今世界，弹性汇率制度是主流，如果每个国家的货币政策都专注于实现理想的国内通胀和就业条件，结果将是相当稳定 — — 甚至所谓的帕累托最优 — — 的宏观经济环境。
en: Under the flexible exchange-rate system that now prevails around the world, if each country focuses its monetary policy on achieving ideal inflation and employment conditions at home, the result will be reasonably stable – or even so-called Pareto-optimal – macroeconomic conditions.

zh: 当然，美国也许会通过暂停升息或调整退出量化宽松的节奏来应对人民币贬值，而日本可能加码其自身的量化宽松以应对消极溢出效应。
en: To be sure, the US may respond to China’s devaluation by postponing interest-rate hikes or moderating the pace of its withdrawal from quantitative easing, and Japan may intensify its own QE to cope with negative spillovers.

zh: 但竞争性累计贬值不会发生。
en: But competitive cumulative devaluations will not arise.

zh: 尽管如此，最近的事件应该迫使中国领导人重新思考控制中国经济的程度。
en: Nonetheless, recent events should compel China’s leaders to reconsider the extent to which they control the country’s economy.

zh: 如果他们继续秘密决策、用政治操纵价格系统，那么他们构建一个以主要国际储备货币为基础的、稳定而恢复力强的市场经济的机会将受到严重制约。
en: If they maintain their secretive decision-making and continue to manipulate the price system for political ends, their chances of building a stable, resilient, and market-oriented economy, underpinned by a major international reserve currency, will be seriously compromised.

zh: 朝鲜越界了吗？
en: North Korea’s Step Too Far?

zh: 北京—朝鲜放出战争狂言近一个月后，中国好像是受够了，不再对朝鲜的边缘行为保持沉默，突然表示了对这一盟国鲁莽威胁的失望。
en: BEIJING – After nearly a month of belligerent bluster from North Korea, China appears to have had enough, ending its silence about North Korea’s brinkmanship and suddenly roaring its disapproval of its ally’s reckless threats.

zh: 中国反常的强硬态度并不一定意味着它想抛弃金正恩政权，但至少表明了中国对朝政策的急剧变化不再向以往那样是不可想象的。
en: China’s exceptional tough talk does not necessarily mean that it intends to abandon Kim Jong-un’s regime; but, at the very least, it does suggest that a radical shift in China’s policy toward North Korea might no longer be unthinkable.

zh: 中国外交部长王毅与联合国秘书长潘基文4月6日通电话时表达了中国拒绝动摇东北亚地区稳定的口头和实际行动。
en: When Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi exchanged phone calls with United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon on April 6, he expressed China’s rejection of rhetoric and action aimed at destabilizing the Northeast Asian region.

zh: 此外，王毅还澄清，中国不会允许有人“在中国家门口制造麻烦 ” 。
en: Moreover, Wang made clear that China would not allow “troublemaking on China’s doorstep.”

zh: 第二天，习近平主席在亚洲政治和商业领袖年度会议 — — 博鳌亚洲论坛上说 ， “ 不能为一己之私把一个地区乃至世界搞乱。
en: The next day, Chinese President Xi Jinping, speaking to an assembly of primarily Asian political and business leaders at the annual government-sponsored Boao Forum for Asia, declared that no country “should be allowed to throw a region and even the whole world into chaos for selfish gain.”

zh: ”习近平没有提到具体的国家名字，但其实暗指朝鲜再清楚不过了。
en: Xi did not mention any country by name, but his implicit condemnation of North Korea was clear to all.

zh: 在这些正式诘难之前，已有很多人猜测中国是否会冒险彻底改变与其仍在大量援助的社会主义“小兄弟”朝鲜的关系。
en: Before these official rebukes, there had been much speculation about whether China would risk a fundamental change in its relations with North Korea, the socialist “little brother” that it continues to subsidize heavily.

zh: 在习近平和王毅罕见地公开发怒之后，这类猜测变得更加强烈了。
en: Following the rare display of open indignation by Xi and Wang, such speculation has now become stronger than ever.

zh: 有人问，金氏隐士王国有什么价值，能让中国做不出果断决策；还有人不知道中国领导人会在多大程度上由于担心国内问题而继续抑制其教训朝鲜的意图。
en: Some ask what “value” Kim’s hermit kingdom provides that prevents China from acting decisively; others wonder to what extent Chinese leaders’ domestic concerns continue to inhibit their willingness to switch course on North Korea.

zh: 事实上，中国领导人对朝鲜的最新挑衅行为感到十分恼怒。
en: In fact, China’s leaders have agonized over North Korea’s recent provocations.

zh: 他们一直在忙于说服金氏政权收敛气焰，接受“大谈判 ” ： 正式承认和正常化其与所有邻国以及美国的关系，以此作为其去核化的交换条件。
en: They have been struggling to persuade the Kim regime to temper its volatility and accept a “grand bargain”: official recognition and normalization of relations with all of its neighbors, and with the United States, in exchange for denuclearization.

zh: 事实上，最近几年，这已经导致两国数度交恶。
en: Indeed, this has led to considerable squabbling between the two countries in recent years.

zh: 中国知道，朝鲜的难以驾驭植根于它与世界的深度隔绝、其人民的长期受骗，以及金氏害怕失去对朝鲜的独家统治权。
en: China understands that North Korea’s intractability is rooted in its deep isolation from the world, mass deception of its people, and Kim’s fear of losing control of a country that only his family has ruled.

zh: 因此，朝鲜统治者相信，挑衅是他们获得注意和资源的唯一方法。
en: So the country’s rulers have come to believe that they can gain attention and resources only through provocation.

zh: 对中国来说，只有它跟随中国的领导，实行改革开放才能保证其生存。
en: For China, the Kim regime’s survival can be assured only if it follows China’s lead in reforming and opening up.

zh: 但是，面对韩国朝气蓬勃的民主和繁荣的经济，中国模式与朝鲜并不相契：跟随中国意味着承认韩国在朝鲜半岛的领导地位，这对金氏政权的合法性来说是沉重打击。
en: But, faced with South Korea’s shining democracy and booming economy, the Chinese model is irrelevant to the North: following it would mean acknowledging the South’s supremacy on the Korean Peninsula, and thus an instant loss of legitimacy.

zh: 过去20年来，朝鲜领导人略做了一些“改革”的微小实验，但无不迅速不了了之。
en: During the past two decades, North Korea’s leaders have experimented lightly with minimal “reform,” only to retreat from it quickly.

zh: 中国耐心忍受着朝鲜间歇性的边缘政策和抑制改革，很大程度上是因为它相信金氏王朝所带来的风险是可控的，只要中国不切断金氏政权的石油、食品和其他必需品生命线。
en: China patiently bore this pattern of intermittent brinkmanship and timid reform, largely owing to its belief that the risks posed by the Kim dynasty could be controlled as long as China did not cut off the regime’s lifeline of oil, food, and other necessities.

zh: 更重要的是，中国领导人认为用朝鲜来抵挡美国的压力符合其自身国家安全利益。
en: More important, China’s leaders believed that by shielding the North from US pressure, it was acting in the interest of its own national security.

zh: 但在这里，中国的算盘大错特错了，因为它低估了金氏政权在认为生存受到威胁时所迸发的不可遏制的绝望。
en: But here China’s analysis has been completely wrong, for it underestimates the Kim regime’s unmanageable desperation whenever it believes that its survival in doubt.

zh: 此外，朝鲜不希望被某个大国玩弄于股掌之间，包括中国。
en: Moreover, North Korea does not want to be beholden to any power, including China.

zh: 因此它利用着中国的良好意图和国家安全需要，甚至把中国的赞助当成理所当然。
en: So it exploits China’s goodwill and national-security concerns, and even regards Chinese patronage as its due.

zh: 让局面更加复杂的是朝鲜的核野心。
en: A further complication concerns North Korea’s nuclear aspirations.

zh: 朝鲜似乎坚信，有了核武器就有了完全的外交独立，而害怕核要挟的中国永远不会抛弃它。
en: The North appears to be convinced that, with nuclear weapons, it can maintain complete diplomatic independence, and that China, fearing nuclear blackmail, will never abandon it.

zh: 但是，如今轮到朝鲜犯了错。
en: Now, however, it is North Korea’s turn to make a mistake.

zh: 金正恩孩子气的怒火真正惹恼了中国。
en: Kim Jong-un’s childish tantrums have genuinely enraged China.

zh: 是的，中国领导人有时抱怨援助朝鲜负担太重；但是此前从未有中国领导人如此公开地表示对朝鲜表现的不满。
en: Yes, the country’s leaders have sometimes complained about the heavy burden of subsidizing North Korea; but, until now, they had never shown such open disgust with the North’s performance.

zh: 中国警告它不会允许朝鲜“在中国家门口制造麻烦 ” ， 这等同于在足球比赛中“亮黄牌 ” 。
en: China’s warning that it will not allow North Korean “troublemaking on China’s doorstep” can be considered the equivalent of a “yellow card” in soccer.

zh: 中国还没有决定抛弃朝鲜。
en: China has not decided to abandon North Korea.

zh: 但对金正恩来说，警告是严厉的：如果他不改变行为，中国要把他罚出场了。
en: But the warning is a stern one for Kim Jong-un: China may send him to the sidelines if he does not change his behavior.

zh: 美国国务卿克里即将访问北京。
en: US Secretary of State John Kerry is set to visit Beijing in the coming days.

zh: 现在，是中美领导人协商当前危机的真正可行的解决之道并有成果地探索朝鲜半岛无核化进程的时候了。
en: It is now time for American and Chinese leaders to negotiate a real and viable exit from the current crisis, while productively exploring ways to restart the denuclearization process on the Korean peninsula.

zh: 如果金正恩夸大的核威胁导致中美联手推出朝鲜解决方案，那么整个世界都将因此变得更加安全。
en: If Kim’s bombast and nuclear threats lead to China-US bonding over a joint North Korea settlement, the entire world will be the safer for it.

zh: 中国的阴暗面
en: Chinese Shadows

zh: 发自纽约 — — 这段时间以来中国发生了一些有趣的事件。
en: NEW YORK – These are interesting times in China.

zh: 一名共产党高官 — — 薄熙来 — — 被撤职，罪名包括对（国家主席胡锦涛在内的）其它党内大佬进行窃听 — — 而其妻子则因为牵涉到一名英国商人的怀疑谋杀案而受到调查。
en: A senior Communist Party official, Bo Xilai, is brought down – accused of offenses that include wire-tapping other party bosses, including President Hu Jintao – while his wife is investigated for her alleged role in the possible murder of a British businessman.

zh: 与此同时，一名盲人人权分子从非法软禁他的家中逃了出来，跑到了美国驻北京大使馆寻求避难，随后在声明自己家人遭到所在地当局威胁后才离开了使馆。
en: Meanwhile, a blind human-rights activist escapes from illegal house arrest, finds refuge in the United States’ embassy in Beijing, and leaves the compound only after claims that Chinese authorities in his hometown had threatened his family.

zh: 虽然媒体对两件事的报道铺天盖地，但我们真正知道的东西却异常稀少。
en: Despite exhaustive press coverage of these events, it is remarkable how little we actually know.

zh: 那名英国商人的尸体据说未经解剖验尸就被送去了火化。
en: The British businessman’s body was allegedly cremated before any autopsy was conducted.

zh: 那些关于薄熙来妻子的离奇故事全都未经证实。
en: None of the lurid tales about Bo’s wife have been proven.

zh: 至少在目前来说，她丈夫究竟因何在政治上倒台，还是一件说不清楚的事情。
en: And the reasons for her husband’s political disgrace remain murky, to say the least.

zh: 中共下任领导人通常都由全国人民代表大会开会选定，而在会议召开之前情况往往会变得诡异无比。
en: Things always tend to get interesting in China before a National People’s Congress, where the Party’s next leaders are anointed.

zh: 大多数民主国家的领导人更替都是一个相对透明的过程；只待全国大选后尘埃落定。
en: Leadership change in most democracies is a relatively transparent process; it follows national elections.

zh: 当然，即便是公开的民主制度也会有暗中的人选交易，或是所谓“吸烟室”里的讨价还价。
en: To be sure, even open democracies have their share of opaque jockeying and deal-making in what used to be called smoke-filled rooms.

zh: 特别是在日本这样的东亚国家，这类情况尤为常见。
en: This is particularly true in East Asian countries, such as Japan.

zh: 但在中国，一切都是暗中进行的。
en: But, in China, everything takes place out of sight.

zh: 由于无法用选举来罢免领导人，于是必须用其他方式来解决政治争端。
en: Because leaders cannot be ousted through elections, other means must be found to resolve political conflicts.

zh: 有时这就意味着刻意导演一场公开的闹剧。
en: Sometimes, that entails deliberate public spectacles.

zh: 重庆前市委书记薄熙来的陨落显然属于这个范畴。
en: The disgrace of Bo, Chongqing’s former Party leader, certainly falls into this category.

zh: 他是一个长相英俊，富有魅力的民粹派，从小就在中国政治精英阶层中浸淫成长。 他也是一个铁腕领导，在打击有组织犯罪（黑社会 ） — —以及任何敢跟他对着干的人 — — 方面经常使用一些逾越法律的手段。
en: A handsome, charismatic populist born into the Party elite, Bo was known as a tough official, whose methods in fighting organized crime – and others who got in his way – were often unrestrained by law.

zh: 薄熙来手下的前公安局长，也就是传说中为他干这些脏活的人，在与他关系彻底破裂后于今年1月潜逃到了美国驻成都领事馆，让中共丢尽了脸。
en: Bo’s ex-police chief, who is said to have done the dirty work, embarrassed the Party by fleeing to the US consulate in Chengdu in February, after he fell out with his boss.

zh: 虽然薄熙来看上去无比怀念过去那套毛泽东理论，但他自己显然富得流油。
en: Despite Bo’s nostalgia for Maoist rhetoric, he is conspicuously wealthy.

zh: 其子在牛津和哈佛上学期间的奢侈生活方式也都被媒体不厌其烦地逐条披露了出来。
en: His son’s expensive lifestyle as a student at Oxford and Harvard has been described in lavish detail in the press.

zh: 换句话说，薄熙来身上拥有一个黑帮老大的所有特质：腐败，对对手毫不留情，蔑视法律，但一张嘴满口都是道德说教。
en: In other words, Bo bore all the hallmarks of a gangster boss: corrupt, ruthless towards his enemies, contemptuous of the law, and yet moralistic in his self-presentation.

zh: 这一点对大多数中共领导人来说都是如此。
en: But the same could be said of most Party bosses in China.

zh: 他们都拥有无法用自身工资收入来解释的财富。
en: They all have more money than can be explained by their official pay.

zh: 许多人的子女都在英美那些学费昂贵的大学就读。
en: Most have children studying at expensive British or American universities.

zh: 所有人的行为似乎都凌驾于法律之上，仿佛法律只是制订来管制普通公民的。
en: All behave as though they are above the laws that constrain normal citizens.

zh: 但薄熙来的不寻常之处在于他那种公开表露的权力欲。
en: What was unusual about Bo was his open ambition.

zh: 中共大佬们，跟日本政客 — — 或者，事实上还有黑手党教父 — — 那样，本应尽力隐藏自己的权力欲。
en: Chinese party bosses, like Japanese politicians – or, indeed, Mafia dons – are supposed to be discreet in their appetite for power.

zh: 而在这一点上薄熙来则表现得像一个美国政治家。
en: Bo behaved more like an American politician.

zh: 他喜欢公开叫板。
en: He liked to throw his weight around in public.

zh: 而这也足以激怒其他党内大佬了。
en: That was enough to annoy other party bosses.

zh: 由于党内的派系争端无法暗中调和，因此薄熙来的某些同僚觉得是时候让他走人了。
en: Since factional rivalry inside the Party cannot be handled discreetly, some of Bo’s colleagues felt that he had to go.

zh: 无论是中国还是日本，党派大佬消灭恼人对手的方式就是通过公众丑闻让他们倒台，先把消息透露给手下俯首帖耳的媒体，然后再煽风点火。
en: The way that party bosses, in China no less than in Japan, get rid of irksome rivals is to bring them down through public scandals, leaked to an obedient press, which then fans the flames.

zh: 而在中国的公众丑闻中恶妻的登场堪称一个常见的情境。
en: The appearance of a wicked wife in Chinese public scandals is a common phenomenon.

zh: 当年毛泽东在文化大革命中整倒身边级别最高的党内大佬刘少奇时，后者的妻子就被戴上乒乓球做成的项链游街，以示其生活奢靡堕落。
en: When Mao Zedong purged his most senior Party boss, Liu Shaoqi, during the Cultural Revolution, Liu’s wife was paraded through the streets wearing ping-pong balls around her neck as a symbol of wicked decadence and extravagance.

zh: 在毛泽东死后，其妻江青旋即被捕并被描绘成中国的麦克白夫人（莎士比亚悲剧人物，怂恿其夫弑君篡位 ） 。
en: After Mao himself died, his wife Jiang Qing was arrested and presented as a Chinese Lady Macbeth.

zh: 而对薄熙来妻子谷开来的谋杀指控很可能就是这出政治戏剧的其中一幕。
en: It is possible that the murder accusations against Bo’s wife, Gu Kailai, are part of such political theater.

zh: 事实上，薄熙来的倒台不仅牵涉到他的妻子，还包括其整个家庭。
en: In fact, Bo’s fall from grace involves not only his wife, but his entire family.

zh: 这也是一项中国传统。
en: This, too, is a Chinese tradition.

zh: 家族必须为其中一位成员的罪行负责。
en: The family must take responsibility for the crimes of one of its members.

zh: 一个人倒台了，所有人都无法幸免。
en: When that individual falls, so must they.

zh: 另一方面，当一个人扶摇直上，其他人也随之鸡犬升天，正如薄熙来大权在握的时候其妻子以及许多亲戚都生意兴隆那样。
en: On the other hand, when he is riding high, they benefit, as was the case with many of Bo’s relatives and his wife, whose businesses thrived while he was in power.

zh: 外界对薄熙来倒台以及盲人人权分子陈光诚在遭受18个月软禁后大胆脱逃所产生的后果有诸多猜测。
en: There has been a great deal of speculation about the consequences of Bo’s fall, and of the daring escape of the human-rights activist, Chen Guangcheng, after 18 months of house arrest.

zh: 后者飞赴美国大使馆的举动是否会��中国领导人的态度转趋强硬？
en: Will his flight to the US embassy harden the attitudes of China’s leaders?

zh: 这一事件是否会迫使美国在中国人权问题上板起面孔？
en: Will it force the US to get tougher on human rights in China?

zh: 如果答案是肯定的话，接着又会发生些什么？
en: If so, what will follow from that?

zh: 由于薄熙来一方面把自己打扮成为对当代中国资本主义的民粹派批判者，另一方面又刚愎自用地鼓吹毛泽东式道德，因此他在党内的天然敌人似乎就是那些更倾向“自由化”的大佬们，后者偏爱自由市场资本主义，或许甚至会欢迎某些政治改革。
en: Since Bo presented himself as a populist critic of modern Chinese capitalism and an authoritarian promoter of Maoist ethics, his natural enemies inside the Party leadership would seem to be the more “liberal” bosses, who favor free-market capitalism and perhaps even some political reforms.

zh: 现任国家总理温家宝似乎就是该派系的领军人物，也曾多次发表有关民主改革紧迫性的演说并公开批评薄熙来。
en: The current premier, Wen Jiabao, would seem to be this faction’s leader. He has made speeches about the need for democratic reform, and has been openly critical of Bo.

zh: 而陈光诚也请求温家宝下令调查自己和家人所遭受的迫害。
en: Chen asked him to investigate abuses against him and his family.

zh: 因此，薄熙来的倒台是否会催生一个更开放，对异见声音更少敌意的社会？
en: So, could the fall of Bo lead to a more open society, less hostile to dissident voices?

zh: 是否那些偏爱经济自由主义的共产党人也更倾向于接受一个更加开放的社会？
en: It is possible that Chinese Communists who favor more economic liberalism would also be more receptive to a more open society.

zh: 但事情的反面也可能出现：随着财富分配不均现象逐渐恶化，越来越多人起来抗议经济分配不均，该政权对异见分子的镇压也会更严厉。
en: But the opposite could also be true: the wider the disparities in wealth, and the more people protest against economic inequality, the more the regime will crack down on dissidents.

zh: 这样的镇压并不是为了维护共产主义，更别提什么毛泽东主义了。
en: Such repression is not meant to protect communism, let alone what little is left of Maoism.

zh: 相反，这是为了维护中国共产党的资本主义招牌。
en: On the contrary, it is meant to protect the Chinese Communist Party’s brand of capitalism.

zh: 这可能是薄熙来为何会被罢免的原因，也是陈光诚及其家人为何要遭受如此多的苦难，以致最后只能绝望地将逃往一个外国使馆作为自身最后选择的原因。
en: That may be why Bo had to be toppled, and certainly why dissidents like Chen, as well as his family, have to suffer so much that refuge in a foreign embassy is their final, desperate option.

zh: 中国掠夺印度领土
en: China’s India Land Grab

zh: 新德里—与日本、越南和菲律宾在东海和南海岛屿整个不休并没有让越来越专断的中国停下脚步，它又新开辟了一条前沿，出兵越界侵入争议中的喜马拉雅边境禁区。
en: NEW DELHI – Stoking tensions with Japan, Vietnam, and the Philippines over islands in the South and East China Seas has not prevented an increasingly assertive China from opening yet another front by staging a military incursion across the disputed, forbidding Himalayan frontier.

zh: 4月15日夜，解放军的一个排暗中进入中印巴三方交界附近，深入在印控区19公里扎营，并向印度政府主张具有战略关键意义的750平方公里高海拔高原地区。
en: On the night of April 15, a People’s Liberation Army (PLA) platoon stealthily intruded near the China-India-Pakistan tri-junction, established a camp 19 kilometers (12 miles) inside Indian-controlled territory, and presented India’s government with the potential loss of a strategically vital 750-square-kilometer high-altitude plateau.

zh: 因国内政治危机焦头烂额的印度大吃一惊，匆忙寻求积极响应中国的领土掠夺 — — 这是中国开始对邻国采取更强硬政策以来最大、最具战略性的不动产掠夺。
en: A stunned India, already reeling under a crippling domestic political crisis, has groped for an effective response to China’s land-grab – the largest and most strategic real estate China has seized since it began pursuing a more muscular policy toward its neighbors.

zh: 中国将继续侵占，建设雪线高原的永久军营，还是准备在获得印度羞辱性的军事妥协后撤离仍不明朗，而且从某种程度上说，这个问题并没有什么意义。
en: Whether China intends to stay put by building permanent structures for its troops on the plateau’s icy heights, or plans to withdraw after having extracted humiliating military concessions from India, remains an open – and in some ways a moot – question.

zh: 事实是，中国的“和平崛起”已经让位于日渐对四邻的日渐专横，它扩大了自己的“核心利益 ” — —即不容妥协的利益 — — 和领土主张，同时表现出准备不惜冒险实现这一目标。
en: The fact is that, with its “peaceful rise” giving way to an increasingly sharp-elbowed approach to its neighbors, China has broadened its “core interests” – which brook no compromise – and territorial claims, while showing a growing readiness to take risks to achieve its goals.

zh: 比如，不但升级了其对日本对尖阁列岛（钓鱼岛）几十年控制权的挑战，还从去年控制黄岩岛开始于菲律宾针锋相对。
en: For example, China has not only escalated its challenge to Japan’s decades-old control of the Senkaku (Diaoyu) Islands, but is also facing off against the Philippines since taking effective control of Scarborough Shoal last year.

zh: 让喜马拉雅山入侵事件成为中国专横亚洲新立场的有力标志的是其闯入不对在“实际控制线”之外的地区扎营，这条实际控制线是中国在1962年由其发动的边境战争后单方面划定的。
en: What makes the Himalayan incursion a powerful symbol of China’s aggressive new stance in Asia is that its intruding troops have set up camp in an area that extends beyond the “line of actual control” (LAC) that China itself unilaterally drew when it defeated India in the 1962 Chinese-initiated border war.

zh: 中国的海军和部分空军专注于支持其在南海和东海的报复性领土和领海主张，其陆军则活跃于中印边境的山区，试图一点一点改变实际控制线。
en: While China’s navy and a part of its air force focus on supporting revanchist territorial and maritime claims in the South and East China Seas, its army has been active in the mountainous borderlands with India, trying to alter the LAC bit by bit.

zh: 解放军所采用惯用伎俩是让汉族牧民来到实际控制线沿线的山谷，提供保护让他们跨越实际控制线，从而将印度牧民驱逐出他们的传统牧场。
