en: One of the novel methods that the PLA has employed is to bring ethnic Han pastoralists to the valleys along the LAC and give them cover to range across it, in the process driving Indian herdsmen from their traditional pasturelands.

zh: 但最近的危机的引发方式是中国直接在毗邻连接中银的喀喇昆仑山口的战略边境地区直接使用军队。
en: But the latest crisis was sparked by China’s use of direct military means in a strategic border area close to the Karakoram Pass linking China to India.

zh: 实际控制线并不是双方公认的 — — 中国违反了2001年于印度交换地图的承诺 — — 因此中国宣布解放军只是在“中国领土”上扎营。
en: Because the LAC has not been mutually clarified – China reneged on a 2001 promise to exchange maps with India – China claims that PLA troops are merely camping on “Chinese land.”

zh: 但是，中国在重演其暗中渗透争议领土然后以调停者面目出现的故技，提出要以“耐心”和“谈判”帮助解决最新的“问题 ” 。
en: Yet, in a replay of its old strategy of furtively encroaching on disputed land and then presenting itself as the conciliator, China now counsels “patience” and “negotiations” to help resolve the latest “issue.”

zh: 中国显然实在试图利用印度的政治乱局改变领土现实。
en: China is clearly seeking to exploit India’s political disarray to alter the reality on the ground.

zh: 群龙无首、陷入瘫痪的印度政府获知解放军侵入的消息大惊失色，唯恐受到要求采取强硬措施的公众压力。
en: A paralyzed and rudderless Indian government initially blacked out reporting on the incursion, lest it come under public pressure to mount a robust response.

zh: 印度媒体引用军方消息源报道了解放军的入侵，中国随后发布了不痛不痒的否认，直到此时，印度政府才第一次发布公开声明。
en: Its first public statement came only after China issued a bland denial of the intrusion in response to Indian media reports quoting army sources.

zh: 让印度更加被动的是，拙劣的外交部长库什德（Salman Khurshid）一开始对二十五年多来最深入的中国人入侵事件满不在乎。
en: To add to India’s woes, Salman Khurshid, the country’s bungling foreign minister, initially made light of the deepest Chinese incursion in more than a quarter-century.

zh: 这位多嘴部长称入侵只是双边关系“漂亮脸蛋”上的“小粉刺 ” ， 只消“略施药膏”就能轻易除去。
en: The garrulous minister called the intrusion just “one little spot” of acne on the otherwise “beautiful face” of the bilateral relationship – a mere blemish that could be treated with “an ointment.”

zh: 如此不当评论不啻给予印度政府召见中国大使要求恢复现状的要求致命一击。
en: Those inept comments fatally undercut the government’s summoning of the Chinese ambassador to demand a return to the status quo ante.

zh: 总理辛格的政府因深陷腐败而摇摇欲坠，没有任何正式理由解释印度如何陷入了关键军事地区的困局，最近一段时间，中国再三试图侵占该地区的印度国土。
en: With Prime Minister Manmohan Singh’s corruption-tainted government tottering on the brink of collapse, there has been no official explanation of how India was caught napping in a militarily critical area where, in the recent past, China had made repeated attempts to encroach on Indian land.

zh: 事实上，政府不知因何在2010年用边境巡警代替了正规军���逻目前被解放军侵入的高原山区。
en: In fact, the government inexplicably replaced regular army troops with border police in 2010 to patrol the mountain-ringed plateau into which the PLA has now intruded.

zh: 这片被称为达普桑（Depsang）的高原地区横跨穿越喀喇昆仑山口、连接新疆莎车和印度拉达克（Ladakh）地区的古老的丝绸之路
en: Known as Depsang, the plateau lies astride an ancient silk route connecting Yarkand in Xinjiang to India’s Ladakh region through the Karakoram Pass.

zh: 印度在喀喇昆仑山口南端拥有一个军事补给站和飞机跑道，有能力切断连接中国和其“全天候盟友”巴基斯坦的高速公路。
en: India, with a military staging post and airstrip just south of the Karakoram Pass, has the capacity to cut off the highway linking China with its “all-weather ally,” Pakistan.

zh: 解放军的入侵威胁了印度的军事基地，其目的大概是遏制印度切断中国驻巴基斯坦吉尔吉特-巴尔蒂斯坦地区（Gilgit-Baltistan，中国在此扩大了驻军和战略工程规模）军队和工人的补给的能力。
en: The PLA intrusion, by threatening that Indian base, may have been intended to foreclose India’s ability to choke off supplies to Chinese troops and workers in Pakistan’s Gilgit-Baltistan region, where China has expanded its military footprint and strategic projects.

zh: 为了保卫这些工程，据报道几千中国军队已部署在这一什叶派占多数的对与外部世界隔绝的叛乱区。
en: To guard those projects, several thousand Chinese troops reportedly have been deployed in the rebellious, predominantly Shia region, which is closed to the outside world.

zh: 对印度来说，中国的入侵还威胁了它对达普桑以西的海拔6300米锡亚琴冰川（Siachen Glacier）的接近。
en: For India, the Chinese incursion also threatens its access to the 6,300-meter-high Siachen Glacier, to the west of Depsang.

zh: 巴基斯坦对这一战略性地楔入巴基斯坦和中国控制克什米尔地区的印控冰川有着主权主张，自20世纪80年代以来，这里是全世界最高、最冷（也最血腥）的战场，直到2003年停火协议生效。
en: Pakistan claims the Indian-controlled glacier, which, strategically wedged between the Pakistani- and Chinese-held parts of Kashmir, served as the world’s highest and coldest battleground (and one of the bloodiest) from the mid-1980’s until a cease-fire took effect in 2003.

zh: 印度迫使中国从达普桑撤军的非军事选择包括外交手段（中止所有正式访问或重新考虑承认西藏为中国一部分）和经济手段（非正式抵制中国货，正如中国通过非官方抵制日货那样给日本造成损失 ） 。
en: India’s nonmilitary options to force a Chinese withdrawal from Depsang range from diplomatic (suspension of all official visits or reconsideration of its recognition of Tibet as part of China) to economic (an informal boycott of Chinese goods, just as China has hurt Japan through a nonofficial boycott of Japanese-made products).

zh: 可能的军事应对手段包括派遣印军在中国领导人视为高度战略重要性的其他地区中国领土建立军营。
en: A possible military response could involve the Indian army establishing a camp of its own on Chinese territory elsewhere that China’s leaders regard as highly strategic.

zh: 但是，在可信地执行任何选择之前，印度需要一个稳定的政府。
en: But, before it can exercise any option credibly, India needs a stable government.

zh: 在此之前，中国将继续无所不用其极地利用形势声张自己的主张。
en: Until then, China will continue to press its claims by whatever means – fair or foul – it deems advantageous.

zh: 中国价值观？
en: Chinese Values?

zh: 发自柏林 — — 如今我们已经没有什么理由去怀疑中华人民共和国会在21世纪主导整个世界。
en: BERLIN – There can be little reasonable doubt today that the People’s Republic of China will dominate the world of the twenty-first century.

zh: 该国高速的经济增长，战略潜力，庞大的国内市场以及对基础设施，教育和科研的巨额投资，还有大规模军备建设都证明了这一判断。
en: The country’s rapid economic growth, strategic potential, huge internal market, and enormous investment in infrastructure, education, and research and development, as well as its massive military buildup, will see to that.

zh: 这意味着，在政治和经济意义上，我们正在进入一个东亚和东南亚的世纪。
en: This means that, in political and economic terms, we are entering an East and Southeast Asian century.

zh: 必须认识到的是，如果没有中国的成功崛起，这个世界肯定是一番更糟糕的景象。
en: Lest we forget, the outcome for the world would have been far worse if China’s ascent had failed.

zh: 但如今这个世界又将是何种状况？
en: But what will this world look like?

zh: 可以预期这股势力将塑造自己的地缘政治格局，但在这些行为背后又会是一种什么样的价值观在支撑着一切？
en: We can foresee the power that will shape its geopolitics, but what values will underlie the exercise of that power?

zh: 自1970年代以来一直为中国崛起打下基础的“四个现代化 ” （ 工业、农业，军事和科学技术）政策并不能为此提供答案，因为“第五个现代化 ” — —民主的崛起以及法治 — — 依然处于缺失状态。
en: The official policy of “Four Modernizations” (industrial, agricultural, military, and scientific-technological) that has underpinned China’s rise since the late 1970’s has failed to provide an answer to that question, because the “fifth modernization” – the emergence of democracy and the rule of law – is still missing.

zh: 事实上，政治现代化进程遭到了中国共产党的极力反对，因为他们根本没兴趣放弃自身对权力的独家垄断。
en: Indeed, political modernization faces massive opposition from the Chinese Communist Party, which has no interest in surrendering its monopoly of power.

zh: 此外，向一个疏导（而非压制）政治冲突的多党制体系的转型也充满风险，即便该风险必将随着一党制统治（以及相伴而生的地方性腐败）的继续延续而不断增大。
en: Moreover, the transition to a pluralist system that channels, rather than suppresses, political conflict would indeed be risky, though the risk will grow the longer one-party rule (and the endemic corruption that accompanies it) persists.

zh: 在意识形态上，中国领导层对人权，民主和法治这类事物的抵制是基于一个观点，那就是这些一般被认为是普世价值的东西其实只是实现西方利益的掩护伞而已，因此对这些事物的否定也应该被视为一种自尊之举。
en: Ideologically, Chinese leadership’s rejection of human rights, democracy, and the rule of law is based on the contention that these supposedly universal values are a mere stalking horse for Western interests, and that repudiating them should thus be viewed as a matter of self-respect.

zh: 既然中国已经永远不会再屈从于西方军事力量之下，因此也不能再度臣服于西方的规范。
en: China will never again submit to the West militarily, so it should not submit to the West normatively either.

zh: 现在让我们回到这个起源于新加坡和马来西亚的“亚洲价值观”概念。
en: And here we return to the concept of “Asian values,” originally developed in Singapore and Malaysia.

zh: 但时至今日，也是该概念提出整整30年后，其意义却依然模糊不清。
en: But until this day, three decades later, its meaning remains unclear.

zh: 从本质上，这一概念就是为了证明某种集体主义专制统治是源于当地传统和文化的正当产物，而自治则被定义为是一种外来物 — — 换句话说，这就是一种与西方及其价值观完全不相同的事物。
en: Essentially, the concept has served to justify collectivist-authoritarian rule by aligning it with local tradition and culture, with autonomy defined in terms of otherness – that is, differentiation from the West and its values.

zh: 因此 ， “ 亚洲价值”并不是普世规范，而是一种服务于身份认同政治的自我保护策略。
en: Thus, “Asian values” are not universal norms, but rather a self-preservation strategy harnessed to identity politics.

zh: 考虑到西方对亚洲的殖民历史，这种保持独特身份定义的意愿既具有其合法性，在情感上也是可以理解的，对许多亚洲国家 — — 旗手当然是中国 — — 来说，现在是时候清算一下旧账了。
en: Given the history of Western colonialism in Asia, the desire to maintain a distinct identity is both legitimate and understandable, as is the belief in many Asian countries – first and foremost China – that the time has come to settle old scores.

zh: 但维护自身实力，那些营造特殊“亚洲”身份定义的需要以及清算历史旧账的意愿都不能解决由中国崛起成为本世纪支配力量所带来的规范问题。
en: But the effort to preserve one’s power, the need for a distinct “Asian” identity, and the desire to settle historical scores will not solve the normative question raised by China’s emergence as the century’s dominant power.

zh: 而这个问题将如何得到解答是极端重要的，因为它将决定一个全球势力的特性，并以此决定它将如何与那些比它弱小的国家相处。
en: How that question is answered is crucially important, because it will determine the character of a global power, and thus how it deals with other, weaker countries.

zh: 当战略重要性和潜力令一个国家可以将自己的势力延伸到全球的时候，它就变成了一个全球势力。
en: A state becomes a world power when its strategic significance and potential give it global reach.

zh: 而一般来说，这样的国家随后将尝试通过强加其支配地位（霸权主义）的方式来维护自身利益，而如果此举是基于强迫而非合作的话，就将成为滋生危险冲突的温床。
en: And, as a rule, such states then try to safeguard their interests by imposing their predominance (hegemony), which is a recipe for dangerous conflict if based on coercion rather than cooperation.

zh: 世界对一个全球霸权架构的顺从 — — 也就是由全球势力维护一个世界秩序的状况 — — 在冷战后幸存了下来。
en: The world’s acclimation to a global hegemonic structure – in which world powers guarantee an international order – survived the Cold War.

zh: 苏联并非在意识形态上反对西方，因为共产主义和社会主义其实都是西方的发明，但它在政治层面上反对西方。
en: The Soviet Union wasn’t ideologically anti-Western, because Communism and Socialism were Western inventions, but it was anti-Western in political terms.

zh: 而其崩溃并不仅仅是出于经济原因，而是因为它的国内外行为都是基于被迫的服从而非人们的真心赞成。
en: And it failed not only for economic reasons, but also because its internal and external behavior was based on compulsion, not consent.

zh: 相比之下，美国（以及西方）的经济和政治模式，及其对个人权利和公开社会的倡导，成为了冷战中最有力的武器。
en: By contrast, the United States’ economic and political model, and that of the West, with its individual rights and open society, proved to be its sharpest weapon in the Cold War.

zh: 美国的获胜并不仅仅来自其军事优势，而是出自其软实力，出自其支配地位并不是来自于威胁强迫（虽然某些时候也有类似情况出现）而在很大程度上基于人们的赞同。
en: The US prevailed not because of its military superiority, but because of its soft power, and because its hegemony was based not on coercion (though there was some of that, too), but largely on consent.

zh: 那么中国会选择哪条道路？
en: Which path will China choose?

zh: 中国一方面没有抛弃其令人敬仰的古老文明，另一方面也因为采取了当代的西方现代化模式才实现了重新崛起 — — 这是邓小平的伟大功绩，正是他在30多年前让中国走上了这条道路。
en: While China will not change its ancient and admirable civilization, it owes its re-emergence to its embrace of the contemporary Western model of modernization – the huge achievement of Deng Xiaoping, who put the country on its current path more than three decades ago.

zh: 但有关政治现代化的决定性问题依然未能得到解答。
en: But the decisive question of political modernization remains unanswered.

zh: 很显然，国家利益以及其他某些纯粹的权力行为，是美国和其他西方国家推行人权、法治，民主和多党制过程中的一部分考虑。
en: Clearly, national interests, and sometimes pure power, play a part in how the US and other Western countries apply values like human rights, the rule of law, democracy, and pluralism.

zh: 但这些价值观可不仅仅是西方利益的遮羞布；事实上，它们并没有达到那么夸张的程度。
en: But these values are not mere ideological window dressing for Western interests; in fact, they are not that to any significant extent.

zh: 它们就是一种普世的东西；而且这一点在这个广泛全球化的时代显得更加明显。
en: They are indeed universal, and all the more so in an era of comprehensive globalization.

zh: 我们无法预计亚洲 — — 尤其是中国 — — 将对这一整套价值观做出什么样的贡献，如果“第五个现代化”为中国带来政治转型的话必将贡献良多。
en: The contribution of Asia – and of China, in particular – to the development of this universal set of values is not yet foreseeable, but it will surely come if the “fifth modernization” leads to China’s political transformation.

zh: 中国晋身成为一个全球势力的进程将在很大程度上通过它如何面对这个问题来决定。
en: China’s course as a world power will be determined to a significant extent by the way it confronts this question.

zh: 挑选欧洲先生
en: Choosing Mr. Europe

zh: 布鲁塞尔 - - 美国引人入胜的总统大选或许吸引了所有的头条新闻，但是欧洲也在进行一场领导权的斗争。
en: BRUSSELS – America’s riveting presidential election campaign may be garnering all the headlines, but a leadership struggle is also underway in Europe.

zh: 目前，所有的目光都集中在成为第一个经过任命的欧洲理事会主席的没有公开宣布的侯选人身上。
en: Right now, all eyes are on the undeclared frontrunners to become the first appointed president of the European Council.

zh: 即使完全参与这一过程的人士也不确切知道欧盟领导人是如何挑选的。
en: Nobody – not even people closely involved in the process – really knows how the European Union’s leaders are chosen.

zh: 这里没有什么正式的规则，更不要说选举；不知如何，人名浮现于媒体之中，成为欧盟神秘的内部交易体制中的一部分。
en: There are no formal rules, much less elections; somehow, names just surface in the media to become part of the EU’s mysterious internal bargaining system.

zh: 实际上，总共有五个最高职位供人抢夺，因此欧洲各国政府间正在进行一场复杂而秘密的讨论，以便在不破坏政治家族或者大小国家之间微妙平衡的情况下决定谁担任什么职务。
en: In fact, there are five jobs up for grabs, so a complex but secretive discussion is being conducted between Europe’s chancelleries over who might do what without disturbing the delicate balances between political families or between large and small states.

zh: 这一过程的核心是一个更为敏感的问题，也就是负责欧盟主要机构的人士是否应该是强势领导人。
en: At the heart of this process is the even touchier issue of whether the people who will take charge of the EU’s main institutions should be strong leaders.

zh: 在原则上，每个人都想要大人物；而实际上，许多国家领导人却拒绝接受布鲁塞尔有一个更为独立和张扬的团队。
en: In principle, everyone wants heavy-hitters; in practice, many national leaders resist the idea of a more independent and assertive team in Brussels.

zh: 最高职务“欧洲先生”现在有两个明显的侯选人，这就清楚地体现了这一矛盾。
en: The dilemma is neatly summed-up by the two clear candidates for the top job as “Mr. Europe.”

zh: 在一方面，小国卢森堡老牌首相容克尔是一个稳妥的侯选人。 他对欧盟的政治机器了如指掌，而且主持欧元区的部长会议。
en: On the one hand, there’s the safe pair of hands personified by Jean-Claude Juncker, the veteran prime minister of tiny Luxembourg, who knows the ins and outs of the EU’s political machinery and chairs the euro zone’s ministerial set-up.

zh: 他不会引发巨变，但也不会造成新闻。
en: He won’t make waves, but he won’t make headlines either.

zh: 下一个就是布莱尔。
en: Then there’s Tony Blair.

zh: 他闻名世界但是引发争议，能够团结各种舆论并且可以赋予欧洲建设以欧盟所盼望的人望。
en: World famous but controversial, Blair is capable of rallying public opinion and giving the European project the high profile that the EU craves.

zh: 但是他也有可能把欧盟为期30个月的礼仪性职务转变成为更为政治性的角色，超过欧盟27个国家领导人所希望的程度。
en: But he’s also liable to turn a 30-month ceremonial post as the EU’s figurehead into one with much more political clout than its 27 national leaders might like.

zh: 另外四个职务有可能由于某种平衡而作为一揽子交易而决定。
en: The other four posts will probably be decided as part of a package deal, owing to the need to achieve some sort of balance.

zh: 首先是欧盟委员会的现任主席、葡萄牙前总理巴罗索是否应该连任五年。
en: First, there’s the question of whether the European Commission’s current president, former Portuguese Prime Minister Jose Manuel Barroso, should get another five-year term.

zh: 他原先要新官上任三把火，结果却四平八稳。 而且还有一个问题，那就是再度任命他是否会把这一职务变成标准的10年任期，而无论其继任者的能力如何。
en: His early promise to be the EU executive body’s new broom has turned into a steady-as-she-goes captaincy, and there’s the added question of whether his re-appointment might turn the job into a standard 10-year post for his successors, regardless of their abilities.

zh: 第三位职务的侯选人看起来更为明显。 索拉纳创立了这一外交政策的超级职务，具有更多的资源和权力。
en: The choice for No. 3 job – the foreign policy supremo who will have extra resources and powers to build on the position created by Javier Solana – looks more straightforward.

zh: 言辞温和的索拉纳是西班牙人，曾经担任北约秘书长。 他看起来会担任这一职务几个月时间，然后交给瑞典外相和前首相比尔特，他在九十年代处理巴尔干问题上赢得了国际地位。
en: Solana, the soft- spoken Spaniard who was previously NATO’s secretary-general, looks like the odds-on favorite to take the new job for a few months before handing it over to Carl Bildt, the Swedish foreign minister and ex-premier who gained international stature in the Balkans in the 1990’s.

zh: 但是没有什么事情是确定无疑的。
en: But nothing is certain.

zh: 如果丹麦首相拉斯穆森正如许多人所建议的那样成为容克尔和布莱尔之间的妥协人选，那么，两个中间偏右的斯堪的那维亚人就会成为麻烦。
en: If Denmark’s prime minister, Anders Fogh Rasmussen were to succeed as a compromise candidate between Juncker and Blair, as is widely suggested, the presence of two center-right Scandinavians would present a problem.

zh: 剩下的两个职位，也就是欧洲议会主席以及容克尔目前担任的“欧洲先生”职务也将会促进总体平衡并且反映2009年年中欧洲议会选举的结果。
en: The remaining two posts, president of the European Parliament and the “Mr. Euro” job currently held by Juncker, will also have to contribute to overall balance and reflect the outcome of the European Parliament elections in mid-2009.

zh: 议会也是这一完全不民主和无法预料的过程的另一个未知因素。
en: The parliament is a further wild card in this wholly undemocratic and unpredictable process.

zh: 改革条约有可能成为饱受争议的欧盟宪法的替代物并且创立欧盟主席的职位。 根据这一条约，欧洲议会的785个议员们也将会发表意见。
en: Under the Reform Treaty – the look-alike successor to the controversial European constitution that creates the post of EU president – the parliament’s 785 members will also have their say.

zh: 在过去的年份里，这一各国政府才有能力否决欧盟最高职位的侯选人，但是现在议会也可以拒绝他们。
en: In years past, only governments could torpedo candidates for Europe’s top jobs, but now the parliament also will be able to reject them.

zh: 现在根本就不清楚谁会有更大的权力来决定结果。
en: It’s not at all clear which will have the greater power to decide the outcome.

zh: 这一不确定局面开始让人们注意到欧盟是否可以继续以这种奇怪而又暗箱操作方式来挑选领导人。
en: This uncertainty is beginning to focus attention on the fundamental question of whether the EU can continue to choose its leaders in such a strange and furtive manner.

zh: 在欧盟规模更小低调的时候，政府间的交易看起来是可行的，这并不是因为各国政治人物可以低调处理“欧洲”的重要性。
en: When the Union was smaller and more modest, inter-governmental horse-trading seemed acceptable, not least because national politicians could downplay the importance of “Europe.”

zh: 如今，欧盟急于在世界舞台扮演更为重要的角色，因此，转向更为开放的制度也就看起来不可避免了。 欧盟在华盛顿、北京以及其他地方的对华们已经表明，声称代表欧洲说话的欧洲国家领导人缺乏可信度，而欧盟领导人明显没有令人信服的政治授权也是如此。
en: Today, with the EU eager to play a forceful role on the world stage, a move towards a more open system appears to be inevitable. The EU’s interlocutors in Washington, Beijing, and elsewhere already make it plain that national leaders claiming to speak for Europe lack credibility, as do EU leaders who so evidently have no convincing political mandate.

zh: 现在有两个明确的主张。
en: Two clearly defined schools of thought are emerging.

zh: 有人认为这些是敏感和复���的问题，超出了大多数选民的理解，而且更多的民主将会要么造成民粹主义，要么是让人尴尬的大范围弃权。
en: There are those who argue that these are sensitive and complicated issues beyond most voters’ understanding, and that more democracy would result in either populism or embarrassingly widespread abstentions.

zh: 还有人相信欧盟无法再继续像北京或者平壤那样运作。 这将会是任何通过老方法挑选出来的新团队所要面临的问题。
en: Others believe the EU cannot continue being run along the same lines as in Beijing or even Pyongyang. It’s an issue that will confront any new team chosen by the old methods.

zh: IMF总裁人选之争
en: Choosing the IMF’s Next Leader

zh: 发自纽约 — — 国际货币基金组织（IMF）新总裁的甄选进程比预期中快，而笔者十几年来不断抨击的恰恰是该组织以其首脑选举制度为代表的管制方式：根据各大利益攸关方（G8）之间的君子协定 — — 总裁必须是欧洲人，而二把手以及世界银行总裁则由美国人担任。
en: For more than a decade, I have criticized the Fund’s governance, symbolized by the way its leader is chosen. By gentlemen’s agreement among the majority shareholders – the G-8 – the managing director is to be a European, with Americans in the number two post and at the head of the World Bank.

zh: 欧洲人通常会私下商定继任人选，美国人也一样，双方都不太理会发展中国家的意见，只是草草咨询一下了事。
en: The Europeans typically picked their nominee behind the scenes, as did the Americans, after only cursory consultation with developing countries.

zh: 而这种做法所产生的结果对IMF本身，世界银行以及全世界都是没有好处的。
en: The outcome, however, was often not good for the IMF, the World Bank, or the world.

zh: 其中一个最臭名昭著的任命就是指派保罗·沃尔福威茨这个伊拉克战争的主要策划者担任世界银行总裁。
en: Most notorious was the appointment of Paul Wolfowitz, one of the main architects of the Iraq War, to lead the World Bank.

zh: 他在任时所作出的决策跟导致美国卷入那场灾难性冒险的决定一样糟糕。
en: His judgments there were no better than those that got the United States involved in that disastrous adventure.

zh: 此人将反腐败设为世界银行首要议程，最终却因为自身的徇私行为而被迫中途离职。
en: Having placed fighting corruption at the top of the Bank’s agenda, he left in the middle of his term, accused of favoritism.

zh: 最终在对美国引发的大萧条的反思中，一个新秩序似乎正逐渐浮现，20国集团（G20）同意（或者设想）下一任IMF领导人将通过公开透明的方式选出。
en: Finally, as a new order seemed to emerge in the aftermath of the US-made Great Recession, the G-20 agreed (or so it was thought) that the next IMF head would be chosen in an open and transparent manner.

zh: 有人推测说这一程序将催生一位来自新兴市场国家的总裁。
en: The presumption was that the outcome of such a process almost surely would be a managing director from an emerging-market country.

zh: 毕竟IMF的主要任务就是应对危机，而大部分危机都发生在发展中国家 — — 自从在30多年前启动取消金融管制和经济自由化的乱政后已经有超过100个国家遇险，并因此涌现出许多风云人物。
en: After all, the IMF’s main responsibility is to fight crises, most of which have been in developing countries – more than a hundred since the disastrous policies of financial deregulation and liberalization began some 30 years ago. There were many heroes of these battles in the emerging markets.

zh: 应对危机需要异常谨慎。
en: Crises need to be carefully managed.

zh: 回想起来正是IMF和美联储对1997年东亚金融危机的错误处置直接导致该地区的经济下滑演变成衰退，再又由衰退恶化成萧条，而当今世界已经无力再次承受这样的过失。
en: In 1997, the mismanagement of the East Asia crisis by the IMF and the US Treasury transformed downturns into recessions, and recessions into depressions. The world cannot afford to repeat that performance.

zh: 如今危机也正不断逼近欧洲：欧洲央行似乎要将自身以及其他欧洲国家央行的资产负债表盈亏 — — 上面满是爱尔兰，希腊和葡萄牙的债务 — — 凌驾于这些国家民众的福祉之上。
en: Today, the imminent crisis is in Europe, where the European Central Bank seems to be putting its own balance sheet and those of European banks – loaded with debt from Ireland, Greece, and Portugal – above the well-being of these countries’ citizens.

zh: 这些债务几乎肯定要被重组，但在放任这些银行盲目使用高杠杆并积累大量有毒金融衍生品之后，欧中央行现在对任何形式的债务重组和减记都开始持反对态度。
en: This debt almost surely needs to be restructured, but, having allowed the banks to leverage themselves beyond any level of prudence and load up on toxic derivatives, the ECB is now warning against any sort of restructuring or write-down.

zh: 但欧洲央行现在才将债务重组认定为“不可考虑”已经有点太迟了。
en: But it is a bit late for the ECB to describe debt restructuring as “unthinkable.”

zh: 欧洲央行本该在纵容这一情况产生之前深思熟虑。
en: The ECB should have done some thinking before it let this state of affairs arise.

zh: 而事实上不仅要考虑，更应该采取一些管制措施以防欧洲各国银行变得过于不堪一击。
en: Indeed, more than thinking, it should have done some regulating to prevent Europe’s banks from becoming so vulnerable.

zh: 如今欧洲央行需要考虑如何拯救所有人，而不仅仅是那几个购买了债券的银行。
en: Now the ECB needs to think about how to help everyone, not just the bankers who bought the bonds.

zh: 这个新思维必须以民众福祉为先，随后才是银行的股东和债券持有人。
en: The new thinking should put people first, and banks’ shareholders and bondholders second.

zh: 即使后面两者失去了一切，只要合理地进行重组，我们依然可以拯救这些银行并保护纳税人和劳动者的利益。
en: Even if the shareholders and bondholders lose everything, with the right restructuring, we can still save the banks and protect taxpayers and workers.

zh: IMF下任总裁将何时着手处理这个问题 — — 而这一财政拯救行动是否是通过财政紧缩（由普通市民来承担成本，而银行家只是略伤了点皮毛 ） — —则极端重要，却也是难以预测的。
en: Where the IMF’s next managing director will come down on this issue – and on whether fiscal salvation is to be achieved through austerity, with costs borne by ordinary citizens, even as bankers get only a mild slap on the wrist – is critically important, but hard to predict.

zh: 尽管IMF的策略在东亚，拉美和其他地区都不奏效，但依然有人拥护这个组织，甚至包括一些新兴市场国家。
en: Despite the failure of the IMF’s strategy in East Asia, Latin America, and elsewhere, it still has adherents, even within the emerging markets.

zh: 总裁之位争夺战的走向跟许多人想象的不同。
en: The leadership contest has turned out differently from what many had expected.

zh: 某些最够资格的候选人（无论是来自发达国家还是发展中国家）都未能从本国政府处得到整个政治程序所需的支持。
en: Some of the most qualified candidates (in both developed and developing countries) have not received the support of their own governments that the political process seems to require.

zh: 其他来自新兴市场国家的候选人则对是否参选犹豫不决 — — 这是一份相当残酷的工作，整天东奔西走，不但要求智慧和经验，还得有一幅好身板。
en: Other qualified people from emerging markets have been reluctant to put their hats into the ring – it is a brutal job, with a travel schedule that requires physical stamina to match wisdom and experience.

zh: 而包括笔者在内的许多人都希望看到来自新兴市场和发展中国家的人选来领导IMF，首要原则是通过一个公开透明的程序选择一个具备相关能力，承担和认识水平的领导人，一个能在IMF业已启动的改革道路上坚持走下去的人。
en: Much as I would like to see someone from the emerging markets and the developing world head the IMF, the first priority is to choose a leader with the requisite skills, commitments, and understandings in an open and transparent process, someone who will continue along the reform path on which the Fund has embarked.

zh: 权力政治可能意味着在最高管理层将同时有中美两国的高层人物跻身其中，而二把手位置将依然由美国人来担任的推测也必须被抛弃。
en: Realpolitik might mean that there will be senior people from both China and the US in the top management team, but the presumption that the number two position should be filled by an American also has to go.

zh: 但不管最后人选是谁，IMF，世界银行和国际社会都必须重申他们对公开透明程序的承诺 — — 并思考如何改善这一程序。
en: Whatever the outcome, the IMF, the World Bank, and the international community need to reaffirm their commitment to an open and transparent process – and ask how that process can be improved.

zh: 与其由各国政府提名候选人（它们往往不愿提名来自反对派的绝佳人选 ） ， 不如由一个国际提名委员会来进行提名。
en: For example, rather than nominations from governments, which often are reluctant to support excellent candidates from opposition parties, an international nominating committee could put forward names.

zh: 同样，对投票过程的修改（由各国公开投票而不是通过选区，或者要求当选人必须赢得大多数发展中和新兴市场国家的支赞成票）将促使更多的新兴市场国家官员竞逐总裁之位。
en: Similarly, changes in voting procedures (public voting by countries, rather than through constituencies, or a requirement that candidates win the support of a majority of developing and emerging countries) could persuade more emerging-market officials to put their names forward.

zh: 我们现在所看见的 — — 公开竞选，而不是闭门商议 — — 似乎是向正确的方向迈出了一步。
en: What we are seeing now – open campaigning, as opposed to selection behind closed doors – seems to be a move in the right direction.

zh: 但我们也希望当选者不要像在选举政治中经常发生的情况那样被竞选承诺束缚了手脚。
en: But one hopes that campaign promises won’t tie the new leader’s hands, as so often happens in electoral politics.

zh: 过分简单化的意识形态将世界拖入了现在这场混乱当中，而同样过分简单化的拯救方案（即便是以“辣手仁心的紧缩”形式）也只会令问题更加复杂化。
en: Simplistic ideologies got the world into the mess in which it now finds itself, and simplistic prescriptions (even of the “tough-love austerity” form) will only compound the problems.

zh: 其中一个呼声最高的下届IMF总裁候选人是一位法国女性，克里斯蒂娜·拉加德，作为法国财政部长她成功带领国家渡过了衰退，而她本人也是位金融部门改革的大力鼓吹者，在同僚中也久负盛名。
en: One of the leading candidates to be the IMF’s next managing director has turned out to be a Frenchwoman, Christine Lagarde, who, as France’s finance minister, helped lead her country through the Great Recession. She has been an outspoken advocate of financial-sector reforms, and has won the respect of all of those with whom she has worked.

zh: 虽然政治总是不青睐那些优秀的候选人，但世界应该庆幸至少还有拉加德这么一位，而国籍也不应该成为她当选的障碍。
en: The world should be thankful that there is at least one. Where she was born should not be an impediment to her prospects.

zh: 选择学习
en: Choosing to Learn

zh: 斯德哥尔摩—北欧国家的经济表现不错，其中很重要的原因之一就是它们在逐步改革自己的“社会模式 ” ， 响应人民的需求来应对新的现实情况。
en: STOCKHOLM – The Nordic countries’ economies are performing well, and a part of the reason is that they are gradually reforming their “social model,” adapting it to new realities in ways that respond to people’s demands.

zh: 但这种变革并不是独一无二“北欧式”的。
en: But there is nothing uniquely “Nordic” about this change.

zh: 相反，它是其他国家可以效仿的。
en: On the contrary, it is one that others can emulate.

zh: 显然，这样的政策需要在研发方面大量投资。
en: Obviously, such a policy requires significant investment in research and development.

zh: 例如，瑞典在这方面的投资超过了其他任何一个欧洲国家—远超过了欧盟占GDP 3%的目标。
en: Sweden, for example, invests more than any other European country in this area – well above the EU target of 3% of GDP.

zh: 许多国家投资少于瑞典，鉴于中国、印度和美国在研发方面的更高投入，即便是瑞典占GDP 4%的投入可能也是不足的。
en: Many countries invest less, and even Sweden’s 4% of GDP might not be enough, given higher spending on R&D in China, India, and the United States.

zh: 另外，如果知识不能被转化为成功的业务，那么对研发大量投资的作用也可能是有限的。
en: Moreover, large investments in R&D may be of limited use if knowledge can’t be transformed into successful businesses.

zh: 需要采取的政策将会涵盖从幼稚园培训到公司与高校的合作，以及一种健康的商业大环境的营造。 在这样的环境下，成功会得到奖赏，而失败也不会被视作人为的灾难。
en: That requires adopting policies that cover everything from kindergarten training to collaboration between universities and companies, as well as an overall business climate in which success is rewarded and failure is not treated as a human catastrophe.

zh: 美国的成功在很大程度上就是基于这样的一种思维。
en: America’s success is to a great extent based on this kind of thinking.

zh: 不幸的是，大多数的欧洲教育体系都建立在过时的惯例和理论之上。
en: Unfortunately, most European educational systems are based on outdated practices and theories.

zh: 虽然教育的可能性和结构已经被逐渐多元化，但大多数欧洲教育体系的重大缺陷仍然存在：学生的选择太少，而老师们如果想保住饭碗就必须严格遵循高度模块化的教学法。
en: Although educational possibilities and structures have gradually been diversified, the major shortcoming of most European educational systems remains: students have too few choices, and teachers, if they want to remain in their profession, must adhere to a severely compartmentalized pedagogy.

zh: 就像公司垄断一样，顾客（学生）通常被看作是同质化的群体，因而所有的学生都可以用同样的教学方式来教育。
en: As with corporate monopolies, the consumers (students) are often seen as a homogeneous mass, where all students can be educated according to the same pedagogical approach.

zh: 但学校必须通过将学习变成一种具有启发性的历险活动从而能够适应不同学生个体的需求和能力。
en: But schools must be able to meet the needs and abilities of individual children in a way that makes learning a stimulating adventure.

zh: 其他国家可能会发现瑞典的体系值得研究。
en: Other countries might find Sweden’s system worth studying.

zh: 它的学校通过各地的社区获得资助，并在议会和政府制定的课程框架内开展教学活动。
en: Its schools are financed by local communities and work within the framework of a national curriculum designed by the parliament and government.

zh: 但是，尽管所有学校都必须遵守这些规定，而每一个学校都是以一种竞争的方式运作。
en: But, while everyone must follow these rules, individual schools are run in a competitive manner.

zh: 任何人—父母、老师甚至公司—都可以申请办学校的许可。
en: Anyone – parents, teachers, or even companies – can apply for a license to operate a school.

zh: 从原则上讲，如果提出申请的学校有达到国家目标的实力和稳定的财政基础，那么国家教育委员会都会批准其申请。
en: The National School Board is, in principle, instructed to approve an application if the proposed school is likely to fulfill the national goals and has a solid financial base.

zh: 另外，私立学校不止被看作是对公立学校的补充，而是另一种完备的选择，所以它们也不需要别出心裁。
en: Moreover, private schools are not seen as mere supplements to public schools, but as fully-fledged alternatives, so they need not offer something different.

zh: 私立学校所在的社区必须在资金支持和给予每个学生的教育凭证上给它和公立学校同等的待遇。
en: A community where a private school offers its services must support it with the same amount of money, or vouchers, per student that it provides to public schools.

zh: 每个学生获得的资金是相同的，得到教育凭证的学校不得再收取额外的费用。
en: The amount of financing per student is the same, and schools that receive vouchers cannot charge additional fees.

zh: 当这一体系在1990年代实施之后，许多非公立学校应运而生。
en: After this system was adopted in the 1990’s, many non-public schools were established.

zh: 其先行者往往是持有某种独特教学观的父母或教师的合作体。
en: The pioneers were often parents’ or teachers’ cooperatives, usually with a special pedagogical philosophy.

zh: 经营连锁办学的公司随后也扮演了重要角色。
en: Companies operating chains of schools later came to play an important role as well.

zh: 其结果是不同种类的学校在瑞典快速增长。
en: As a result, the variety of schools has increased throughout Sweden.

zh: 凭证制度意味着所有的学生，不论家庭收入，都能自主择校。
en: The voucher system means that all students, irrespective of family income, can attend the school of their choice.

zh: 即便是在农村地区，学生也有众多的学校可以选择。
en: Even in rural areas, there is now a wide choice of schools, and it seems that competition has improved the overall quality of Swedish schools, as non-public schools’ very existence has created a demand for reform of public schools.

zh: 由于非公立学校的存在造成了对公立学校进行改革的需求，所以竞争似乎使瑞典学校的整体素质得到了提升。
en: If there is any difference, it seems that non-public schools often are better than public schools in dealing with children with learning problems.

zh: 当然，在振兴教育方面除了瑞典的做法还有其他的选择。
en: There are, of course many alternatives to what Sweden has done to revitalize education.

zh: 但瑞典的改革有三个特点似乎特别重要：它是建立在公共和市场体系结合的基础之上；它在形式上具有普遍性，没有规定非公立学校必须与众不同才能获得办学许可；它覆盖了所有的学生。
en: But three features of Sweden’s reform seem particularly important: it was based on a combination of public and market systems; it was general in form, without demanding that non-public schools be special in order to be licensed; and it covered all students.

zh: 瑞典的凭证教育制度很可能是世界上的同类制度中最为雄心勃勃的。
en: Sweden’s voucher educational system is probably the most ambitions of its kind in the world.

zh: 在一个公共服务领域内的竞争还没有被完全接受的国家，其教育制度所依赖的竞争原则能够如此深入人心，也更凸显其卓尔不凡。
en: This is all the more remarkable insofar as the principle of competition on which it relies has taken root in a country where competition within the area of public services has not generally been accepted.

zh: 重新统一英国
en: Reuniting the United Kingdom

zh: 伦敦—最终，民主得到了救赎。
en: LONDON – In the end, democracy came to the rescue.

zh: 苏格兰人民以令人舒心的10%优势继续成为英国的一部分 — — 这是三位工党政治家阿拉斯代尔·达令（Alastair Darling ） 、 戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）和吉姆·墨菲（Jim Murphy）活动的功劳。
en: The people of Scotland voted by a comfortable margin of about 10% to remain part of the United Kingdom – not least because of the campaigning of three Labour politicians, Alastair Darling, Gordon Brown, and Jim Murphy.

zh: 有好几次，结局已经无比接近，甚至于我们英国人有可能促成我们的祖国的分解。 几个世纪以来，英国由四个民族社会（national community）组成：英格兰、威尔士、北爱尔兰和苏格兰。
en: At times, it seemed that the result would be much closer, or even that we British might engineer the dismemberment of our country, which for centuries has brought together four national communities: England, Wales, Northern Ireland, and Scotland.

zh: 苏格兰人成为英国的一部分已逾三百年，他们是铸就英国身份的新教、帝国、冒险和向外看文化的中流砥柱。
en: The Scots have been part of the British state for more than 300 years, at the heart of the Protestant, imperial, adventuring, outward-looking culture that forged Britain’s identity.

zh: 尽管如此，这一身份一直是断裂的；我希望这不会无法修复。
en: Still, that identity has been fractured; I hope not beyond repair.

zh: 无论如何，破镜即使重圆，也不再是原来的镜子。
en: In any case, things will never be quite the same again.

zh: 如今，英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰人民 — — 毕竟它们没有被拒绝 — — 必须竭尽所能从有时相当令人不快的分裂言论中挽回一些行得通的东西。
en: Now, the people of England, Wales, and Northern Ireland – not rejected, after all – must behave as well as possible to salvage something workable from the sometimes bitter and divisive arguments.

zh: 我们必须表现出宽宏大量 — — 这即使在最好的时代也相当难能可贵。
en: We have to display magnanimity – a difficult enough virtue to practice at the best of times.

zh: 在试图奋起应对这一挑战前，我们可以从这次几乎走到悬崖边的经历中学到什么？
en: Before trying to rise to this challenge, what can we learn from this walk along the cliff edge?

zh: 尽管苏格兰投票日群情雀跃，但用公投作为解决重大政治问题的办法实属悲哀。
en: Despite the huge turnout on polling day in Scotland, referendums are a lamentable way of trying to settle big political issues.

zh: 建立和发展了英国议会民主的人十分清楚这一点。
en: Those who established and developed parliamentary democracy in Britain knew this very well.

zh: 公投是民粹主义者和潜在独裁者的最爱。
en: Referendums are the favorite device of populists and would-be dictators.

zh: 在某一天投一票将复杂问题归结为公民投票问题，而这往往不是许多人实际所回答的问题。
en: One vote on one day subsumes complex matters with one ballot question, which in any event is frequently not the question that many people actually answer.

zh: 议会民主应该和公投绝缘。
en: Parliamentary democracies should have nothing to do with them.

zh: 最终，300年的共同经验和共同繁荣没有葬送在2014年9月的某个星期四。
en: In the event, we did not dispose of 300 years of shared experience and common prosperity on one Thursday in September 2014.

zh: 但有三个理由可以说明我们距离这一结果相当接近，其中没有一个原因能很好地反应英国政治程序或者（在我看来）证明我们的未来将会也必须不同。
en: But there are three reasons why we seemed at times to come so close to that outcome, none of which reflect well on the British political process or, in my view, justify the claim that our future will, and must, be different.

zh: 首先，尽管苏格兰民族主义拥有可歌可泣的传统和壮志，但该运动及其酝酿表现出令人厌恶的沙文主义色彩，并且时不时对多元主义表现出粗野的敌意 — — 比如，不少记者的恫吓就是明证。
en: First, while Scottish nationalism has many honorable roots and aspirations, the campaign and its incubation showed a nasty tinge of chauvinism and an occasionally brutish hostility toward pluralism, reflected, for example, in the intimidation of some journalists.

zh: 总体而言，在亲独立运动中，英国扮演了哲学家和社会学家所谓的“他者 ” ， 一种外部威胁势力。
en: Overall, the English took on the role of what philosophers and social scientists call the “other,” an alien threatening force, in the pro-independence campaign.

zh: 英格兰人是天天与苏格兰人相伴的恶棍。
en: The English were every day’s villains.

zh: 现在我们必须把这些全部忘掉。
en: Now we have to try to forget all of that.

zh: 其次，与欧洲其他国家一样，英国正在经历愤怒的民粹主义反启蒙政治势力的崛起，其背后的推动力是阴谋论。
en: Second, Britain, like other countries in Europe, is suffering from the rise of angry, populist, anti-enlightenment political forces, fueled by conspiracy theories.

zh: 在英格兰，英国独立党（UK Independence Party）在选举中的成功就是这样的例子。
en: In England, the electoral success of the UK Independence Party is one such example.

zh: 蛊惑民心的政客堆砌半真不假的信息，以此产生偏见，而一切试图让讨论与现实联系起来的努力都通过侮辱性的撒谎和自私指责打压下去。
en: Demagogues stack prejudices atop half-truths, and any attempt to connect discussion with reality is shot through with contemptuous accusations of dishonesty and self-interest.

zh: 在面对这样的对话者时，负责任的政治领导人必须更加积极、果断和强势。
en: Responsible political leaders will have to be more aggressive, bold, and vigorous in confronting such interlocutors.

zh: 最后，就政策而言，我们英国人自欺欺人地相信我们的政府体系可以通过零敲碎打的修补生存下去。 而事实上，这一体系的代表性越来越低，越来越低效，越来越过度集中。
en: Finally, as far as policy is concerned, we Britons have deluded ourselves to think that our system of government – increasingly shown to be unrepresentative, inefficient, and over-centralized – could survive with a little tinkering here and there.

zh: 这一信念适用于两大主要党派。
en: This belief has suited the two main political parties.

zh: 工党寻求避免宪政争论，因为任何联邦制度方向的变化都要求该党在英国议会获得多数代表权。
en: Labour has sought to avoid a constitutional debate, because any move in the direction of federal institutions requires addressing the party’s over-representation in the UK parliament.

zh: 在给予苏格兰议会更大权力的同时继续让控制着下议院41个苏格兰选区的工党拥有英格兰事务的优势发言权是不公平的。
en: It is unfair to give ever more power to a Scottish parliament while continuing to give Labour, which controls 41 Scottish constituencies in the House of Commons, disproportionate say over what happens in England.

zh: 至于保守党，其关于英国各部分联盟的信念杜绝了任何关于如何让联盟现代化的讨论。
en: As for the Conservatives, the party has allowed its belief in the union of the country’s constituent parts to foreclose any discussion of how that union can be modernized.

zh: 如果我们想防止英国分崩离析，就必须改变我们管理我们自己的方式。
en: If we are to prevent the UK from rattling to pieces, we have to change the way we govern ourselves.

zh: 首相卡梅伦目前对该过程的节奏把握令人捏一把冷汗。
en: The pace that Prime Minister David Cameron has now proposed for this process is breathtaking.

zh: 不到60年前，保守党在苏格兰拥有多数席位。
en: Conservatives held a majority of the seats in Scotland less than 60 years ago.

zh: 如今 ， ， 苏格兰保守党议员只占英国议会的59分之一，这充分说明了保守党是如何让自己被驱逐出英国的某些部分之外的。
en: Today, there is one Scottish Conservative MP out of 59 in the UK Parliament, a mark of how the Tories have allowed themselves to be frozen out of some parts of the country.

zh: 从某些角度看，这是所有人都必须面对的英国政治文化的最大挑战。
en: In some respects, this is the biggest challenge of all to the UK’s political culture.

zh: 保守党正在脱离英国某些他们曾经很强的部分 — — 不仅有苏格兰，还包括北英格兰的一些城市 — — 并且与英国日益重要的少数族裔群体也在日益失去联系。
en: Conservatives are losing touch with parts of the country where once they were strong – not just Scotland, but also cities and the north of England – and there is a growing disconnect between the party and Britain’s increasingly important minority ethnic groups.

zh: 工党也受到一些同样的问题的困扰。
en: Some of the same problems affect Labour.

zh: 两大党都必须解决这些问题，这样，我们才能够开始改革英国这一漫长而艰巨的任务 — — 这个国家已经失去了部分亲和力和让其团结了如此之久的凝聚力。
en: Both big parties will have to address these issues as we start on the long and difficult task of reforming a UK that has lost some of the glue of affinity and solidarity that has held it together for so long.

zh: 对苏格兰边界以南的一些英国公民来说，要他们带着从公投事件中恢复所必须的良好意愿行动将十分困难。
en: For some British citizens south of the Scottish border, it will be difficult to act with the goodwill now required to recover from the referendum episode.

zh: 我不知道敦促举行公投、现已辞职的苏格兰民为族党（Scottish Nationalist Party）领导人阿莱克斯·萨尔蒙德（Alex Salmond）在其政党支持率上升中居功几何；但我怀疑，唉，他给英格兰带来了太多的民族主义情绪。
en: I do not know how much Alex Salmond, the now-resigned Scottish Nationalist Party leader who pressed for the referendum, is responsible for the surge in his own party’s support; but I suspect that he may, alas, have galvanized all too much nationalist sentiment in England.

zh: 我听一位评论家声称，公投运动是“美丽的 ” 。
en: I heard one commentator claiming that the referendum campaign was “beautiful.”

zh: 也许最终我们真的可以“相信人民 ” ， 这是一个令人振奋的想法。
en: Perhaps in the end, we really could “trust the people,” and that is an invigorating thought.

zh: 让其他在本国反对民主的人注意吧。
en: Let others, who oppose democracy in their own countries, take note.

zh: 但这场运动确实有好几次接近于非理性者获得胜利，令人捏一把冷汗。
en: But the campaign did come perilously close at times to being a triumph for un-reason.

zh: 现在的挑战是指出如何将半真不假和大谎言驱逐出我们的政治，并为我们的分裂之地重塑理性和节制。
en: The challenge now is to figure out how to banish half-truths and big lies from our politics and restore reason and moderation to our divided land.

zh: 我了解的普京
en: What I Learned From Vladimir Putin

zh: 伦敦 — — 俄罗斯总统普京是否像多数政治领袖一样愿意为自身利益而扭曲真相？
en: LONDON – Is Russian President Vladimir Putin, like most political leaders, predisposed to spinning the truth for his own benefit?

zh: 或者他还远不止于此，在懒散成性的国内媒体教唆下，依赖不计后果的谎言来治理俄罗斯、与邻国和世界各国打交道。
en: Or does he go far beyond that, governing Russia and dealing with his neighbors and the rest of the world with reckless mendacity, abetted by a supine national media?

zh: 有时要想回答这样的问题，我们不仅需要借鉴自己的耳闻目睹，个人经验也非常必要。
en: Sometimes, in answering questions like this, we can draw not only on what we have heard and seen, but also on personal experience.

zh: 1999年10月我作为欧盟对外事务专员出席欧盟-俄罗斯首脑会议时第一次见到普京。
en: I first met Putin in October 1999 in Helsinki, when I was attending a European Union-Russia summit as the EU’s external affairs commissioner.

zh: 叶利钦总统最后一刻以“身体不适”为由取消了参会计划；而是派新任代总理普京替他出席，普京的所作所为证实了这句话的正确性：你可以把人调离克格勃，但克格勃的印记会伴随这个人一生。
en: President Boris Yeltsin canceled his attendance at the last moment; he was “indisposed.” In his place, Yeltsin sent the new acting prime minister, Vladimir Putin, whose behavior confirmed the wisdom of the observation that you can take the man out of the KGB, but you can’t take the KGB out of the man.

zh: 清早起来筹备会议时，欧盟代表团听说车臣首府格罗兹尼发生爆炸并致数人死亡。
en: Preparing for the meeting in the early morning, the EU team heard that there had been an explosion in Grozny, Chechnya’s capital, killing several people.

zh: 普京抵达时，我们向他了解情况。
en: When Putin arrived, we asked him about it.

zh: 他说他并不清楚，但承诺会在午饭时通报情况。
en: He claimed to know nothing, but promised to find out by lunch what had happened.

zh: 午餐讨论期间他汇报说爆炸是由经营武器市场的车臣恐怖分子造成的。
en: At our lunchtime discussion, he reported that the explosion had been caused by Chechen terrorists who were running their own arms bazaar.

zh: 而此时我们已经知道是俄军进攻导致了这些人死亡；之后又传出俄罗斯发射的一波弹道导弹（很可能是飞毛腿导弹）已经导致超过百人死亡。
en: By this time, we knew that the deaths had been caused by a Russian military assault; it subsequently came to light that a wave of Russian ballistic missiles (probably Scuds) had killed more than a hundred people.

zh: 普京直视着我们的眼睛说了谎，他几乎肯定知道我们明白他说的不是真话。
en: Putin had looked us in the eye and lied, almost certainly aware that we knew he was lying.

zh: 当天的公报并未提及车臣，而是大谈特谈以往那套“共同价值观 ” 、 民主、人权、法治信念和战略合作等空话。
en: The communiqué that day made no mention of Chechnya, but enunciated the usual “blah blah” about shared values, belief in democracy, human rights, and the rule of law, and the need for strategic cooperation.

zh: 我可以举出 — — 我该怎么形容才好 — — 不计其数的实例，证明普京及其同事大肆利用真相。
en: I can recall countless instances of – how can I best put it? – Putin and his colleagues economizing with the truth on a spectacular scale.

zh: 在车臣问题上，他们一直报告说没有接到欧盟的任何投诉，或称一直严格遵守联合国救援活动相关守则；其实他们在两个问题上一直是两面三刀。
en: On Chechnya, they regularly reported either that they had received no complaints from the EU about humanitarian relief, or that they were complying with the United Nations code on relief efforts; they were duplicitous on both counts.

zh: 此外他们在贸易、伙伴关系协定、欧盟东扩和进入加里宁格勒等问题上一直在耍花招。
en: Similar dissembling characterized negotiations on trade, partnership agreements, the enlargement of the EU to Eastern Europe, and access to Kaliningrad.

zh: 在这样的背景下，我觉得很难相信普京口中乌克兰发生了什么 — — 波兰和波罗的海国家的许多资深观察家也秉承同样的看法。
en: Against this background, I find it difficult to believe any of Putin’s account of what has been happening in Ukraine – a view shared by many seasoned observers in Poland and the Baltic states.

zh: 普京不甘心担任一个人口缩减、势力范围仅限于亚洲的国家的总统。
en: Putin does not want to preside over a country with a declining population and a footprint that is largely Asian.

zh: 他像现代沙皇般希望重新打造曾在历史上一度辉煌的俄罗斯斯拉夫国，吞并乌克兰，并重建（尽管以另一种形式）克里姆林宫的失落帝国。
en: He wishes, like a modern czar, to re-create the historic Slav state of Russia, incorporating Ukraine, and to rebuild, albeit in a different form, the Kremlin’s lost empire.

zh: 帝国的核心领土是由俄罗斯、白俄罗斯和哈萨克斯坦组成的欧亚联盟。
en: The Eurasian Union – Russia, Belarus and Kazakhstan – is to be its heartland.

zh: 为此普京一直反对乌克兰历史性地像西方靠拢，而欧盟过去在这个问题上同样热情不高。
en: To this end, Putin has always resisted Ukraine’s historic turn to the West, about which the EU itself has been standoffish in the past.

zh: 欧盟曾准备承认乌克兰的“欧洲使命 ” ， 但它真正为此所做的工作却少之又少。
en: The EU was prepared to recognize Ukraine’s “European vocation,” but it did as little as it could to encourage this outcome.

zh: 乌克兰腐败总统维克托·亚努科维奇今年初因退出欧盟联合协议而被民众驱逐时，俄罗斯开始对乌克兰稳定起破坏作用。
en: When Ukrainians earlier this year ousted their corrupt president, Viktor Yanukovych, after he backed out of an association agreement with the EU, Russia set out to destabilize the country.

zh: 克里米亚曾是俄国一部分的吞并理由根本站不住脚，因为如果同样的理由在其他地方适用，相当于认可欧洲大部分地区可以凭武力重新绘制边境版图。
en: Crimea was annexed on the spurious grounds that it had once been part of Russia – a justification that, if applied elsewhere, could underwrite the violent redrawing of boundaries in much of Europe.

zh: 而后是俄罗斯煽动并参与武装分裂份子接管东乌克兰行动，该行动直接导致上个月马航17航班被击落和机上全部298人罹难。
en: Then came Russia’s fomenting of, and participation in, armed separatists’ effort to take over parts of eastern Ukraine, which led directly to the downing last month of Malaysian Airlines Flight 17 and the death of all 298 people on board.

zh: 尽管很可能是一次意外，但恰恰是俄国的背信弃义和致命干涉导致了此次意外的发生。
en: Though likely an accident, it was an accident that happened only because of Russia’s duplicitous and lethal meddling.

zh: 因此虽然我对普京政权的所作所为感到难过，但我并不吃惊。
en: So, though I am saddened by the Putin regime’s behavior, I am not surprised by it.

zh: 我的确希望欧盟能出人意料地承认乌克兰局势需要欧洲站出来捍卫国际尊严和法治原则。
en: I do hope to be surprised by the EU’s recognition that what has happened in Ukraine requires Europe to stand up for international decency and the rule of law.

zh: 我们不该再兴高采烈地谈论共同价值观。
en: There should be no more happy talk about shared values.

zh: 现在的当务之急是必须坚持原则。
en: This is a time for steely principle.

zh: 匈牙利Jobbik运动和法国国民阵线等欧洲极右翼政党肯定不以为然。
en: That will not be welcomed by Europe’s far right, from Hungary’s Jobbik to France’s National Front.

zh: 普京是他们眼中的宠儿。
en: They love Putin.

zh: 但事实证明即便对英国独立党领袖法拉奇等昔日的崇拜者而言乌克兰也已似乎走得太过。
en: But Ukraine has proved a step too far for some of his erstwhile admirers, like Nigel Farage, the leader of the United Kingdom Independence Party.

zh: 如果法拉奇有过接触普京的第一手经验，他准确认清形势可能会快得多。
en: If Farage had had some first-hand experience dealing with Putin, he might have reached an accurate assessment much sooner.

zh: 从贝多芬到北京
en: From Beethoven to Beijing

zh: 伦敦—17年前的7月1日，我登上了英国皇家游艇离开香港。 前一天午夜，中国根据被称为中英联合声明（Joint Declaration）的国际协定（在联合国制定）收回香港主权。
en: LONDON – On July 1, 17 years ago, I was sailing on Britain’s Royal Yacht away from Hong Kong where, at midnight the previous day, China assumed sovereignty under the terms of an international agreement with the United Kingdom (tabled at the United Nations) known as the Joint Declaration.

zh: 该协定保证香港将在邓小平的“一国两制”方针下保持50年不变。
en: That agreement guaranteed Hong Kong’s way of life for 50 years under Deng Xiaoping’s slogan “One country, two systems.”

zh: 法治精神以及多元主义自由精神 — — 程序正义以及言论、集会和信仰自由 — — 将继续充当香港繁荣与稳定的基础。
en: The rule of law and the freedoms associated with pluralism – due process and the freedom of speech, assembly, and worship – were to remain the bedrock of Hong Kong’s prosperity and stability.

zh: 光阴荏苒，很快就过去了17年。
en: Fast forward to this year.

zh: 作为末代港督，这个日子对我个人来说意义重大，对香港人民来说更是如此。 7月1日，我出席了在牛津附近的一间乡间别墅举行的盛大的贝多芬《费德里奥 》 （ Fidelio）演出。
en: On a date that meant so much to me personally as the colony’s last governor, and much more to the citizens of Hong Kong, I attended a magnificent production of Beethoven’s “Fidelio” on the grounds of a country house near Oxford.

zh: 《费德里奥》是贝多芬唯一的歌剧，初写于1805年（即拿破仑在奥斯特里茨（Austerlitz）获胜的那一年 ） ， 重写于1814年（拿破仑退位的那一年 ） ， 是对能在各个社会都引起共鸣的基本人类价值 — — 自由和反暴政 — — 的伟大的文化表达。
en: Beethoven’s only opera, written in 1805 (the year of Napoleon’s victory at Austerlitz) and rewritten in 1814 (when Napoleon abdicated), is one of the supreme cultural expressions of fundamental human values – freedom and opposition to tyranny – that resonate in every society.

zh: 《费德里奥》的高潮出现在政治犯从地牢中暂时释放出来时。
en: “Fidelio’s” most dramatic moment comes when political prisoners are briefly released from their dungeons.

zh: “哦，天堂！
en: “Oh Heaven!

zh: 救赎！
en: Salvation!

zh: 幸福 ， ” 他们说道 ， “ 哦，自由！
en: Happiness,” they sing. “Oh Freedom!

zh: 我们会达到你们吗？
en: Will you be given us?”

zh: ”在他们歌颂自由的同时，落日余晖让犯人和牛津郡的观众们感到炫目。
en: As they sang of liberty, the setting sun’s rays dazzled the prisoners and the Oxfordshire audience.

zh: 大自然也在彰显这一信念的重要性。
en: Nature underlined the importance of the message.

zh: 自贝多芬完成他的歌剧以来的两个世纪中，历史主要围绕追求自由这一主题展开：反殖民地斗争、基本人权运动、抵抗现代集权主义和独裁政权。
en: Much of the history of the two centuries since Beethoven composed his opera has centered on that quest for freedom: the fight against colonial powers, the campaigns for basic human rights, the resistance to modern totalitarian and authoritarian regimes.

zh: 总体而言，自由获得了胜利。
en: On the whole, liberty has triumphed.

zh: 但斗争并未结束；而是在各个大洲以多种形式继续开展着。
en: But the struggle is not yet over; it continues on every continent and takes many forms.

zh: 从中非到科特迪瓦到巴基斯坦，酷刑肆虐；在埃及，合法骚扰公行（不仅仅是针对记者 ） ； 在俄罗斯和乌干达，同性恋饱受迫害；在发达国家，人口贩卖也禁而不绝；在尼日利亚北部，年轻的女基督徒惨遭绑架。
en: Consider the victims of torture from Central America to Côte d’Ivoire to Pakistan; the legal harassment – not least of journalists – in Egypt; the persecution of gays in Russia and Uganda; human trafficking, prevalent even in developed countries; and the abduction of young Christian women in northern Nigeria.

zh: 在许多国家，政治异见者（就像《费德里奥》中的囚犯）遭到关押 — — 甚至更糟 — — 本应确保法治精神的清晰公开程序荡然无存。
en: In many countries, political dissidents (like the captives in “Fidelio”) are locked up – or worse – in defiance of the clear and open procedures that should ensure the rule of law.

zh: 在大部分民主国家，应该在外交政策中考虑多少人权因素是一个有争议的问题。 民主国家常常认为，凭借其自身的记录，它有权对别国说三道四。
en: The extent to which concern for human rights should be a consideration in setting foreign policy is a contentious issue in most democracies, which often believe that their own record entitles them to lecture others.

zh: 有时候是如此，有时候则不是。
en: Sometimes it does; often it does not.

zh: 比如，美国自身在关塔那摩湾和其他地方的记录就削弱了美国政客在这一主题上的信誉。
en: For example, the United States’ own record, at Guantánamo Bay and elsewhere, has undermined American politicians’ credibility on this subject.

zh: 另一个问题是一致性。
en: There is also the question of consistency.

zh: 你不能对不同的国家两面三刀 — — 但在贸易协定等事务上，这一情形稀松平常。
en: One cannot credibly thump the table about human rights in one country, but keep one’s opinions to oneself in another – an all-too-common occurrence when, say, a trade deal might suffer.

zh: 缺少一致性是欧盟在尝试建立基于价值的外交政策上的一宗罪。
en: A lack of consistency has been one of the European Union’s sins in attempting to establish a value-based foreign policy.

zh: 比如，欧盟试图建立地中海地区经济和政治合作伙伴关系，其中的金融援助和贸易自由化将通过契约联系起来，以促进人权和发展民主机构。
en: The EU sought to build a partnership of economic and political cooperation in the Mediterranean region, for example, in which financial assistance and trade liberalization would be contractually linked to progress in advancing human rights and developing democratic institutions.

zh: 这一明智的目标因为总是忽视有的国家的实际发生情况而遭到妨碍。
en: This sensible objective was sabotaged by the tendency to overlook what was actually happening in some countries.

zh: 许多人怀疑一些欧盟成员国一方面在与有虐待囚犯记录的国家谈判双边协定时要求加入强健的人权条款，一方面又秘密帮助恐怖主义嫌犯引渡回这些国家。
en: Many suspect that some EU member states, while insisting on robust human-rights clauses in bilateral agreements with countries known to torture prisoners, secretly aided in the rendition of suspected terrorists to these same countries.

zh: 我毫不怀疑推广自由和人权有利于民主国家的国家利益。
en: I have no doubt that it is in the national interest of democracies to promote freedom and human rights.

zh: 尽管这些价值不可能通过武力强加或如同速溶咖啡那样制造出来，如果各国能够更体面地对待自己的公民，世界将变得更和平、更稳定、更繁荣。
en: Though these values cannot be imposed by force or manufactured like instant coffee, the world is likely to be more peaceful, stable, and prosperous the more that countries treat their own citizens decently.

zh: 这并非否认真实需求的空洞政策的药方。
en: This is not a prescription for a soggy policy that denies the demands of the real world.

zh: 但依靠现实政治作为外交政策的指南针的历史记录相当不堪。
en: But reliance on realpolitik as the guiding light of foreign policy has a pretty shabby track record.

zh: 现实政治给我们带来了柬埔寨轰炸和布尔波特大屠杀。
en: Realpolitik brought us the bombing of Cambodia and the mass killings under Pol Pot.

zh: 此外 ， “ 现实主义”假设常常非常不靠谱。
en: Moreover, “realist” assumptions often turn out to be remarkably implausible.

zh: 贸易协定常常得不到保障，或必须靠政治屈服维持。
en: Trade deals often are not secured or sustained by political kowtows.

zh: 各国以最优价格购买需要的东西，出售可以出售的东西，不管别国有没有写部长级公告。
en: Countries buy what they need and sell what they can at the best price they can get, regardless of whether another country has or has not written a ministerial communiqué.

zh: 但是，所有相关政策 — — 从援助到政治和安全合作 — — 都应该有利于强化其所坚持的制度和价值。
en: Rather, all relevant policies – from aid to political and security cooperation – should be related to strengthening the institutions and values to which one adheres.

zh: 所有这些把我带回了今年7月1日。
en: All of this brings me back to July 1 of this year.

zh: 当我欣赏《费德里奥》时，数万香港人（据组织者称有数十万）正在为了自由而游行。
en: While I was listening to “Fidelio,”tens of thousands of Hong Kongers (organizers say hundreds of thousands) were demonstrating for liberty.

zh: 他们想要公正开放的体系选举政府，希望捍卫让香港变得如此特殊和成功、成为真正的（古典含义的）自由社会的自由和法治精神。
en: They want a fair and open system for electing their government, and to defend the freedom and rule of law that make Hong Kong so special and successful, a genuinely liberal – in the classical sense – society.

zh: 最终，香港人民会得到他们所想要的，即使有中国的反对；最后的胜利永远属于自由。
en: Eventually, Hong Kong’s people will get what they want, despite China’s objections; freedom invariably wins in the end.

zh: 但中国统治者如能认识到这一诉求并非对其国家福祉的威胁，将是一个大进步。
en: But China’s rulers would take a giant step forward by recognizing that such aspirations are not a threat to the country’s wellbeing.

zh: 但是，目前，作为一个大国和日渐崛起的强国，中国处理经济事务的手法比其应对政治挑战更加成熟和可靠。
en: For now, however, China, a great country and a growing power, is handling its economic affairs with more sophistication and a surer touch than it is addressing its political challenges.

zh: 组织中东和平
en: Organizing Middle East Peace

zh: 伦敦—在布莱希特（Bertolt Brecht）著名的反战剧《勇气妈妈和她的孩子们 》 （ Mother Courage and Her Children）中有一句台词 ： “ 你知道和平的问题是什么吗？
en: LONDON – In Bertolt Brecht’s great anti-war play, “Mother Courage and Her Children,” one of the characters says, “You know what the trouble with peace is?

zh: 没有组织。 ”
en: No organization.”

zh: 这出剧写于欧洲三十年战争期间。 这场十七世纪上半叶的战争摧毁了欧洲，直到1648年签订威斯特伐利亚和约（Peace of Westphalia）才宣告结束。
en: The play is set during Europe’s Thirty Years’ War, which devastated Europe in the first half of the seventeenth century, ending only with the Peace of Westphalia in 1648.

zh: 战争一开始是新教徒和天主教徒之间的宗教战争，但很快就演变为一场敌对国家和王朝之间的旷日持久的战争，主要对峙双方一方是神圣罗马帝国和哈布斯堡王朝，另一方是黎塞留主教治下的法国。
en: The war began as a religious struggle between Protestants and Catholics, but rapidly morphed into a long-running fight between rival countries and dynasties, principally between the Habsburgs and the Holy Roman Empire on one side and Cardinal Richelieu’s France on the other.

zh: 毫不奇怪，一些人将今天肆虐于美索不达米亚和西亚的逊尼派-什叶派冲突比作三十年战争。 战争造成大规模死伤、瘟疫、经济崩溃和社会动荡（如政治迫害 ） 。
en: Not surprisingly, some have compared today’s Sunni-Shia conflict, which is consuming swaths of Mesopotamia and Western Asia, to that war, which caused death on a massive scale, plagues, economic destruction, and social turmoil marked, for example, by a wave of witch hunting.

zh: 事实上，在三十年战争开始前半个世纪，曾经有过一份和平协定，即组织和平的努力。
en: There had in fact been a peace settlement a half-century before the fighting broke out – an effort to organize peace.

zh: 1555年，查理五世提出了奥格斯堡和约（Peace of Augsburg ） ， 和约基于以下一致：主权国家有权选择接受那种基督信仰。
en: Emperor Charles V engineered the Peace of Augsburg in 1555, which was based on an agreement that sovereign states could choose for themselves which version of Christianity to adopt.

zh: 条约一撕毁，杀戮便随之而来。
en: When that treaty fell apart, the killing started.

zh: 如今肆虐于伊拉克、叙利亚和其他地区的流血动荡之前又有什么“组织和平 ” ？
en: What was the “organized peace” that preceded the current bloody turmoil in Iraq, Syria, and elsewhere?

zh: 答案取决于你将时间回溯多久。
en: The answer depends on how far back one goes.

zh: 随着奥斯曼帝国的崩溃，西方列强发动了一场重画地区版图的自我扩张运动，建立政权、扶持依存关系、圈定势力范围、保障日益重要的石油供给。
en: As the Ottoman Empire crumbled, the Western powers launched a self-aggrandizing project to redraw the region’s map, installing regimes, creating dependencies, establishing spheres of influence, and securing access to increasingly important supplies of oil.

zh: 结果产生了一个针对从马格里布到黎凡特的诸国的持久的国家行为判断准则：是否给以色列对巴勒斯坦的态度以及后者 可行建国主张制造外交（或其他）麻烦。
en: Then came a persistent tendency to judge the behavior of states across the Maghreb and the Levant by whether or not they would make diplomatic (or other) trouble over Israel’s attitude toward Palestine and the latter’s claim to viable statehood.

zh: 赤裸裸的干预不时发生，如暗中推翻伊朗民主选举产生的总理摩萨德（Mohammad Mossadegh）以及更为晚近的军事干涉伊拉克并造成二十五万伊拉克人死亡等。
en: There have also been explicit interventions, from the covert removal of Iran’s democratically elected prime minister, Mohammad Mossadegh, to the more recent military intervention in Iraq, which led to a quarter-million Iraqi deaths.

zh: 但西方国家一直不愿面对联合国发展计划署的一份2002年报告所描述的该地区的基本现实。
en: But Western countries have been reluctant to face up to the region’s underlying realities, set out in a 2002 report by the United Nations Development Program.

zh: 起草这份报告的阿拉伯学者和决策者将人们的注意力吸引到极权政府、经济疲软、高失业以及过度的忏悔政治（confessional politics）之间的关系上。
en: The Arab scholars and policymakers who drafted the report drew attention to the connections between authoritarian government, economic weakness, high unemployment, and excessively confessional politics.

zh: 该地区的政治越是独裁，就有更多的年轻人 — — 没有工作，也没有言论自由 — — 转向与伟大信仰背道而驰的极端主义和暴力伊斯兰教。
en: The more dictatorial politics in the region became, the more young men – denied both jobs and freedom of expression – turned to extremist and violent Islamism, the perversion of a great faith.

zh: ”这个问题，我们有个显而易见但不够充分的答案。 就像爱尔兰农民对旅行者问路的回答 ： “ 我不会从这儿开始走。
en: So here we are today, with the obvious but inadequate answer to the question, “Well, what would you do about it?” being the Irish farmer’s reply to a traveler’s request for directions: “I wouldn’t start from here.”

zh: 唉，这根本就不是答案，尽管或许算得上对前美国副总统切尼等鼓吹重演刚刚过去一幕之人的有用托辞。
en: Alas, that is no answer at all, though it may be a useful riposte to those – like former US Vice President Dick Cheney – who advocate a replay of the recent past.

zh: 美国和英国保守主义者否认事实，显然认为最近所发生的事情证明了他们的观点 — — 他们对伊拉克开战的选择再坚决一点的话，早就大获成功了。
en: Denying reality, American and British neoconservatives apparently believe that recent events justify their view that their war of choice in Iraq would have been a great success had there only been more of it.

zh: 但保守势力也绝不是完全在误导。
en: But the neocons are not entirely misguided.

zh: 美国前国务卿赖斯正确地指出 ， “ 以民主为代价最求稳定”的时间太长，导致“两头落空。 ”
en: The United States, former US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice rightly argued, for too long had pursued “stability at the expense of democracy”; as a result, it had “achieved neither.”

zh: ��是强有力的观点，支持不能放弃2002年报告作者和其他人所坚持的多元价值论的长期承诺。
en: That is a powerful argument for not abandoning a long-term commitment to the sort of pluralist values embraced by – among others – the authors of the 2002 report.

zh: 西方在运用这些原则方面前后不一，常常会使用武力推行（从而造成灾难性后果 ） ， 并且不能有效利用支持这些原则的资金和机制设计。
en: The West has been inconsistent in its application of these principles, has occasionally tried to impose them by force (with disastrous consequences), and has failed to use effectively the money and mechanisms devised to support them.

zh: 欧盟在地中海周边的一系列贸易与合作协定所带来的惨痛后果就是明证。
en: Consider, for example, the miserable results of the European Union’s trade and cooperation agreements around the Mediterranean.

zh: 西方必须动用一切外交资源促进什叶派和逊尼派武装斗争的主要支持者 — — 伊朗和沙特阿拉伯之间的谅解。
en: The West must use all of its diplomatic resources to broker an understanding between Iran and Saudi Arabia, the main sponsors of, respectively, Shia and Sunni armed struggle.

zh: 看到自己所在的地区分崩离析不符合两国的利益。
en: It is not remotely in either country’s interest to see their own region go up in flames.

zh: 两国应该开始修复关系，5月这一情景看上去已具备现实可能（最近又有所退步 ） 。
en: These two countries need to start repairing their relations, a prospect (recently set back) which seemed a real possibility back in May.

zh: 在伊拉克应该在美国和土耳其的帮助下向联邦国家的方向转变，承认库尔德人、逊尼派和什叶派的渴望。
en: With American and Turkish help, Iraq should be steered in the direction of a federal state, which recognizes the aspirations of Kurds, Sunni, and Shia.

zh: 在叙利亚，总统巴沙尔·阿萨德仍在执政，但已无多少权力。
en: In Syria, President Bashar al-Assad remains in office but hardly in power.

zh: 他的军队也许正在节节获胜，但战斗还在继续。
en: His army is probably winning, but the fighting continues.

zh: 目前，最佳前景似乎是罗马历史学家塔西佗所描述的 — — “他们制造了一片沙漠，他们管它叫和平。 ”
en: At the moment, the best outlook appears to be that described by the Roman historian Tacitus – “they make a desert, they call it peace.”

zh: 外部人士能够考虑有效军事干预的时刻早已过去。
en: The time is long since past when outsiders could have considered an effective military intervention.

zh: 但在联合国安理会的支持下，全球人道主义措施应该更加扩大和集中，以使近1,100万叙利亚难民能获得更多的纾困。
en: But with UN Security Council support, the world’s humanitarian efforts should be more extensive and focused, so that greater relief can be brought to the almost 11 million Syrian refugees who need it.

zh: 最后，我们不能忽视悬而未决的以巴冲突的破坏力，它仍在助长政治极端主义、滋生严重威胁西方人权承诺的问题。
en: Finally, we should not ignore the continuing toxicity of the unresolved Israel-Palestine conflict, which continues to feed political extremism and raises serious questions about the West’s commitment to human rights.

zh: 中东地区之外的国家还面临着另一个任务：劝说年轻人不要参与伊斯兰内战。
en: Countries outside of the region face an additional task: the need to discourage young men from going to fight in Islam’s civil war.

zh: 我的祖国就有这个问题，我们似乎没有很好地在某些社区灌输对曾经将这些年轻人的父母亲吸引到英国来的价值的理解和接受。
en: That is a problem for my own country, where it seems that we have not done a good job instilling in some communities an understanding and acceptance of the values that often brought these young men’s parents to the United Kingdom in the first place.

zh: 真正而持续的和平的日程是长期而复杂的。
en: The agenda for real and lasting peace is long and complex.

zh: 我们需要组织计划，并需要多年去实施。
en: Plans need to be organized, and they will take years to implement.

zh: 除非从现在开始，否则战火将会在政治和宗教的助长下蔓延 — — 受害者也决不会仅限于尼尼微（Nineveh ） 。
en: Unless we start now, the fires will spread – fanned by politics and religion – and it will not only be Nineveh that is consumed by them.

zh: 廉价肉类的高成本
en: The High Cost of Cheap Meat

zh: 柏林—工厂化畜牧业生产是农业工业化的关键推动力。
en: BERLIN – Factory-style livestock production is a critical driver of agricultural industrialization.

zh: 其不断的扩张导致了气候变化、森林采伐、生物多样性损失和人权侵犯 — — 而这都是为了满足西方对廉价肉食的不健康胃口。
en: Its remorseless expansion is contributing to climate change, deforestation, biodiversity loss, and human-rights violations – all to satisfy Western societies’ unhealthy appetite for cheap meat.

zh: 欧洲和美国是二十世纪最大的肉类消费国，平均每人每年要吃60—69公斤肉 — — 远远高于满足人类硬要需要的水平。
en: Europe and the United States were the largest meat consumers in the twentieth century, with the average person eating 60-90 kilograms (132-198 pounds) annually – far more than is required to meet humans’ nutritional needs.

zh: 如今尽管西方消费率已不再走高，甚至在某些地区出现了下降，但仍远高于其他大部分地���。
en: Though Western consumption rates are now stagnating and even declining in some regions, they remain far higher than in most other regions in the world.

zh: 与此同时，在新兴经济体 — — 特别是所谓的金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非 ） — —新兴中产阶级正在改变饮食结构，模仿发达国家中产阶级。
en: Meanwhile, in emerging economies – especially the so-called BRICS (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa) – members of the burgeoning middle class are changing their diets to resemble those of their rich-country counterparts.

zh: 在未来几十年中，随着收入继续上升，肉类和奶制品需求也将水涨船高。
en: In the coming decades, as incomes continue to rise, so will demand for meat and dairy products.

zh: 为了满足这一需求，世界农业企业将把肉类产量从今天的3亿吨提高到2050年的4.8亿吨，整个价值链（饲料供给、生产、加工和零售）的几乎每一阶段都会造成严重的社会挑战和生态压力。
en: To meet this demand, the world’s agribusiness firms will attempt to boost their annual meat output from 300 million tons today to 480 million tons by 2050, generating serious social challenges and ecological pressures at virtually every stage of the value chain (feed supply, production, processing, and retail).

zh: 工厂化畜牧业生产的一个主要问题是造成巨量温室气体排放 — — 因为反刍动物的消化过程会产生甲烷。
en: One major problem with factory-style livestock production is that it leads to considerable greenhouse-gas emissions – and not just because the digestive processes of ruminant animals produce methane.

zh: 来自动物的废气，以及生产饲料所使用的化肥和杀虫剂会造成大量氮氧化物。
en: The waste from the animals, together with the fertilizers and pesticides used to produce feed, generate large quantities of nitrogen oxides.

zh: 事实上，从饲料生产开始，工厂化模式意味着土地用途的巨大改变和森林采伐。
en: Indeed, the factory model implies significant land-use change and deforestation, beginning with the production of feed.

zh: 目前，大约三分之一的现有农地用于饲料生产，其中用于畜牧生产（包括牧草）的比重为70%左右。
en: As it stands, about one-third of existing agricultural land is used for feed production, with the total share used for livestock production, including grazing, amounting to about 70%.

zh: 随着肉类消费的增加，光是大豆产量就将接近翻番，这意味着土地、化肥、杀虫剂和水等投入品用量的相应增加。
en: With expanded meat consumption, soybean production alone would nearly double, implying a proportional increase in the use of inputs like land, fertilizer, pesticides, and water.

zh: 越来越多的作物用于喂养牲口将导致粮食和土地价格出现上涨压力，使世界贫困人口更加难以满足基本营养需要。
en: Increased crop diversion to feed livestock will put upward pressure on food and land prices, making it increasingly difficult for the world’s poor to meet their basic nutritional needs.

zh: 更糟糕的是，畜牧业从混养或地方饲养向大规模经营转变，这将危害到农村牲口，特别是在发展中国家。
en: Making matters worse, the shift from mixed-use or indigenous systems of raising livestock to large-scale operations jeopardizes rural livelihoods, particularly in developing countries.

zh: 牧民、小生产商和独立农民根本无法与低廉的零售价格竞争 — — 这样的价格无法覆盖该行业真正的环境和健康成本。
en: Pastoralists, small producers, and independent farmers simply cannot compete with low retail prices that fail to account for the industry’s true environmental and health costs.

zh: 而工业化畜牧业系统工资低、健康和安全标准低，因而也不是理想的就业替代方案。
en: And the industrial livestock system, with its low wages and poor health and safety standards, does not provide a good alternative for employment.

zh: 最后，工业化畜牧业生产还有公共健康影响。
en: Finally, there is the public-health impact of industrial livestock production.

zh: 首先，过高的肉类和奶类消费导致了肥胖、心血管病等于营养有关的健康问题。
en: For starters, excessively high levels of meat and dairy consumption are contributing to nutrition-related health problems like obesity and cardiovascular disease.

zh: 此外，将动物大量集中在受限制的空间有利于传染病的传播，包括禽流感等可以传播给人的疾病。
en: Moreover, keeping large concentrations of animals in confined spaces facilitates the proliferation of infectious diseases that can spread to humans, such as avian flu.

zh: 而遏制这一风险的措施，如使用低剂量抗生素以预防疾病（和刺激生长）会引发抗药性，造成公共健康危机。
en: And measures used to mitigate that risk, such as the administration of low doses of antibiotics to prevent disease (and promote growth), are creating a public-health crisis by strengthening resistance to antimicrobial drugs.

zh: 除了动物本身所遭遇的可怕环境，由于畜牧业不愿采取合理的动物福利标准，你可能会质疑为何让这个行业变得如此巨大。
en: Add to this the horrific conditions suffered by the animals themselves, owing to the industry’s resistance to applying reasonable animal-welfare standards, and one might wonder how the industry could have been allowed to grow so large.

zh: 答案在于寡头政治权力，它使工业化畜牧业生产商能够将真正的社会和环境成本外部化，而随后必须由工人和纳税人来承担代价。
en: The answer lies in its oligopolistic power, which enables industrial livestock producers to externalize their true social and environmental costs, which must then be covered by workers and taxpayers.

zh: 现实是，我们有其他满足世界肉类和奶类需要的办法。
en: The reality is that there are other ways to meet the world’s need for meat and dairy.

zh: 在欧盟，只要改变共同农业政策（Common Agricultural Policy）的两个关键要素，就可以显著减少生产体系的扭曲。
en: In the European Union, only two key elements of the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) would have to be changed to reduce drastically the distortions in the production system.

zh: 实施这些改变将释放一个明确的信号 — — 欧洲决策者认真对待消费者的愿望。
en: Implementing these changes would send a clear signal that European policymakers take consumers’ wishes seriously.

zh: 第一个变化是禁止进口转基因饲料，并要求农民自己生产至少一半农场动物所需饲料。
en: The first change would be to prohibit imports of genetically modified feed, and require that farmers produce at least half of their animal feed on their own farms.

zh: 为饲料采购制定明确规则将让国际营养失衡问题不复存在，并削弱孟山都等跨国农业生物技术公司的实力。
en: A clear set of rules on feed procurement would eliminate international imbalances in nutrients, and diminish the power of multinational agricultural biotechnology corporations like Monsanto.

zh: 此外，泥浆和粪肥也不会被长途运输，可以用于增肥农民自身的生产饲料用地。
en: Moreover, slurry and manure would no longer be transported long distances, and could be used to fertilize farmers’ own land to produce feed.

zh: 其次，应禁止对饲料和灌溉系统添加不必要的抗生素。
en: Second, the unnecessary administration of antibiotics in feed and watering systems should be prohibited.

zh: 这将迫使农民根据兽医诊断逐一治疗动物疾病。
en: This would force farmers to treat animals individually for illnesses, based on veterinary diagnosis.

zh: 在美国，食品和药品监督局（Food and Drug Administration）可以禁止非治疗用途的抗生素。
en: In the United States, the Food and Drug Administration could ban the non-therapeutic use of antibiotics.

zh: 而美国农业部农场补贴计划可以为放养畜牧增加支持，以鼓励更为可持续的肉类生产方法。
en: And the US Department of Agriculture’s farm bill programs could provide increased support for free-range livestock operations, in order to encourage more sustainable approaches to meat production.

zh: 当然，这些措施只是重要的第一步。
en: Of course, these actions would be only important first steps.

zh: 随着新兴经济体中产阶级的成长，一个关键是认识到现有西方肉类生产和消费模式绝不是可靠的未来蓝图。
en: As emerging-economy middle classes grow, it is vital to recognize that existing Western models of meat production and consumption do not provide a sound blueprint for the future.

zh: 应该建立一个符合我们的生态和社会现状以及伦理规范的系统。
en: It is time to create a system that adheres to our ecological, social, and ethical boundaries.

zh: 让全球经济重获动力
en: Re-Empowering the Global Economy

zh: 华盛顿—2013年，全球经济依然停留在希望和不确定性之间。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The global economy in 2013 remained suspended between the poles of hope and uncertainty.

zh: 复苏赢得了动力（特别是在一些发达经济体 ） ， 但世界经济仍然没有达到马力全开的状态 — — 未来几年可能将依然处于动力不足的状态。
en: While recovery gained momentum, particularly in some advanced economies, the world economy is not yet flying on all engines – and is likely to remain underpowered next year as well.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）的最新报告预测2014年全球GDP将增长3.6 % ， 这个数字相当漂亮，但仍低于约4%的潜在增长水平。
en: The International Monetary Fund’s latest forecast puts global GDP growth at 3.6% in 2014, which is decent, but still below potential growth of around 4%.

zh: 换句话说，世界可以制造大量新增就业岗位而不会引起通胀压力。
en: In other words, the world could still generate considerably more jobs without fueling inflationary pressure.

zh: 这意味着IMF各成员国 — — 不管是发达经济体、新兴市场还是发展中经济体 — — 有更多的工作要做。
en: This means that the IMF’s members – whether advanced, emerging-market, or developing economies – have more work to do.

zh: 要让所有国家所有民族都获得强劲而持续的复苏，需要决策者在财政、结构和金融诸方面全面出击。
en: A strong and lasting recovery that lifts all countries and all peoples requires policymakers to press ahead on all fronts – fiscal, structural, and financial.

zh: 与此同时，国际社会必须通过G-20、IMF和其他行动方重新加强合作。
en: At the same time, the international community must reinvigorate its efforts to strengthen cooperation through the G-20, the IMF, and other actors.

zh: 事实上，只有通过精诚合作，我们才能克服全球危机的持续影响。
en: Indeed, only through such collaboration can we overcome the lingering impact of the global crisis.

zh: 在过去五年中，我们毫无疑问已经避免了最坏情形（大萧条II ） ， 这是全球决策这努力的功劳，特别是各央行果断地保持全球低利率并支持金融系统以及一些国家所采取的财政刺激。
en: We have certainly avoided the worst-case scenario (Great Depression II) over the past five years, thanks to the efforts of global policymakers – particularly the determination of central banks to keep global interest rates low and to support the financial system, coupled with fiscal stimulus in some countries.

zh: 但现在我们需要更进一步，包括利用非常规货币政策所创造的空间实施能够重振增长、创造就业岗位的结构性改革。
en: But the time has come to push further, including by using the room created by unconventional monetary policies to implement structural reforms that can jump-start growth and create jobs.

zh: 发达经济体表现如何是决定全球前景的关键；而尽管它们最近表现较为强劲，停滞和通缩风险依然挥之不去。
en: What happens in advanced economies is central to global prospects; and, despite their stronger performance recently, the risks of stagnation and deflation continue to loom large.

zh: 央行应该等到稳健复苏已成定局时再回归常规货币政策。
en: Central banks should return to more conventional monetary policies only when robust growth is firmly rooted.

zh: 长期以来，美国一直是全球经济的主要引擎，而其私人需求已重振雄风。
en: The United States has long been the main engine driving the global economy, and private demand there has regained vigor.

zh: 但关键的挑战仍有待解决。
en: But key challenges lie ahead.

zh: 比如，一个至关重要的问题是决策者需要在最近的预算协议基础上更进一步，结束困扰美国未来财政局面的政治角力。
en: For example, it is vitally important that policymakers follow through on the recent budget agreement and end the political wrangling over the country’s fiscal future.

zh: 增加政策方向的确定性能刺激增长，使之提振整个全球经济。
en: Greater certainty about the direction of policy could restore growth to a level that would lift the entire global economy.

zh: 在日本，复苏受积极的货币和财政政策组合 — — 即所谓的“安倍经济学”推动。
en: In Japan, recovery has been spurred by the mix of aggressive monetary and fiscal policies known as “Abenomics.”

zh: 这是一个重要的发展趋势。
en: This is an important development.

zh: 现在的挑战是就中期财政调整和实施结构性改革达成一致。 结构性改革包括放松产品和服务市场监管、增加女性占劳动力市场比重等，它们是夯实经济增长基础、最终摆脱通缩幽灵的必要条件。
en: The challenge now is to agree on medium-term fiscal adjustments and implement the structural reforms – including deregulation of product and service markets and measures to boost the share of women in the workplace – that are needed to give growth a firm foundation and finally banish the specter of deflation.

zh: 欧洲也处在关键时刻。
en: Europe is also at a key juncture.

zh: 欧元区终于开始显现复苏信号，但增长既不平均，也不平衡。
en: The eurozone is finally showing signs of recovery, but growth is uneven and unbalanced.

zh: 许多国家表现抢眼，但总体而言需求依然萎靡，外围国失业率（特别是年轻人失业率）仍居高不下。
en: While many countries are doing well, demand in general remains weak, and unemployment in the periphery remains obstinately high, particularly for young people.

zh: 欧洲所面临的一个不确定方面是其银行的健康状况。
en: One area of uncertainty for Europe is the health of its banks.

zh: 即将到来的压力测试和资产质量评估有助于重塑信心、推进金融一体化，但必须以认真落实为前提。
en: The forthcoming stress tests and asset-quality review can help restore confidence and advance financial integration, but only if they are conducted well.

zh: 欧洲还需要提振需求、强化其金融和财政结构，并实施结构性改革以确保持续增长和就业创造。
en: Europe also needs to boost demand, strengthen its financial and fiscal architecture, and put in place structural reforms to ensure sustained growth and job creation.

zh: 在过去五年中，新兴市场一直是经济复苏的先锋：加上发展中国家，它们贡献了全球GDP增长的四分之三。
en: Over the past half-decade, the emerging markets have been in the vanguard of economic recovery: together with developing countries, they have accounted for three-quarters of global GDP growth.

zh: 但在2013年，由于美国货币政策正常化时机未明，加上增长路径遭受质疑，这些经济体势头有所减弱。
en: But these economies’ momentum slowed in 2013, as uncertainty about the timing of monetary-policy normalization in the US coincided with doubts about the sustainability of their growth path.

zh: 最坏的担忧已经打消，但新兴经济体仍面临新的政策挑战。
en: While the worst fears have faded, the emerging economies face new policy challenges.

zh: 为了应对需求放缓，决策者必须注意金融过剩，特别是表现为资产泡沫和债务增长的金融过剩。
en: In responding to slower demand, policymakers must be wary of financial excess, especially in the form of asset bubbles or rising debt.

zh: 它们还应该专注于增强金融监管，以更有效地管理好信用周期和资本流；并重塑财政机动空间。
en: They should also focus on strengthening financial regulation, in order to manage credit cycles and capital flows more effectively, and on reestablishing fiscal room for maneuver.

zh: 在过去五年中，低收入国家也是全球经济的一大亮点。
en: Low-income countries have been a bright spot for the global economy over the last five years as well.

zh: 它们在危机面前表现出了恢复力 — — 特别是非洲，其2013年产出增加了约5 % — —并且增长强劲。
en: They proved resilient in the face of crisis, and many – especially in Africa, where annual output rose by about 5% in 2013 – are enjoying strong growth.

zh: 如今，它们应该在这些成就的基础上更进一步，首先要增强增加收入的能力。
en: Now is the time to build on these gains, primarily by strengthening these countries’ capacity to raise revenues.

zh: 随着来自新兴市场的需求的减弱，低收入国家应该构筑抵御严重衰退的防线，虽然它们正在继续强调在关键社会计划和基础设施工程上的支出。
en: With demand from emerging markets weakening, low-income countries should bolster their defenses against a serious downturn, even as they continue to focus their spending on key social programs and infrastructure projects.

zh: 中东转型国家面临着更多的挑战，包括社会动荡和政治不确定性。
en: Middle Eastern countries in transition face additional challenges in the form of social instability and political uncertainty.

zh: 这些问题应该通过夯实基础、塑造有充满活力的透明的经济、承诺更加包容的增长以及确保国际社会的进一步支持来解决。
en: These problems should be addressed by laying the groundwork for dynamic, transparent economies, promoting more inclusive growth, and ensuring continued support from the international community.

zh: 各国各地区所面临的的挑战各不相同，但在未来几年需要解决许多共同问题。
en: While challenges vary by country and region, many common problems must be addressed in the years ahead.

zh: 太多国家面临沉重的公私债务遗留、财政和经常项目失衡，以及无法创造足够多就业岗位的增长模式。
en: Too many countries face a legacy of high public and private debt, fiscal and current-account imbalances, and growth models that are unable to generate enough jobs.

zh: 国际社会也需要完成必要的监管改革以创造更安全的金融体系，从而更好地支持实体经济的需要。
en: The international community also needs to complete the regulatory reforms required to create a safer financial system that better supports the needs of the real economy.

zh: 没有抽象的挑战。
en: These are not abstract challenges.

zh: 如今，数十亿人有着越来越多的愿望 — — 找到工作、摆脱贫困、有朝一日跻身全球中产阶级，等等。 唯有克服这些挑战，我们才能确保未来繁荣。
en: Only by addressing them can we ensure future prosperity at a time when billions of people have rising aspirations – to find jobs, to rise out of poverty, and to one day join the global middle class.

zh: 2014年，我们需要采取让这一梦想变为现实的措施。
en: In 2014, we need to take the steps that would help make this dream a reality.

zh: IMF将致力于与188个成员国通力合作，制定和实施能给增长引擎注入动力 — — 也让所有人都拥有全新的未来的政策。
en: The IMF is committed to working with its 188 member countries to define and implement the policy measures that can power the engines of growth – and lift all people to renewed prosperity.

zh: 对跨大西洋金融监管说“是”
en: Getting to Yes on Transatlantic Financial Regulation

zh: 华盛顿—随着2014年的到来，欧盟和美国的监管关系冲突信号尽显。
