en: WASHINGTON, DC – As 2014 gets underway, signs of a fraying regulatory relationship between the European Union and the United States seem to be everywhere.

zh: 美联储对外国银行的严厉新规引起了欧盟委员会的反弹，扬言要报复。
en: The US Federal Reserve’s tough new regulations on foreign banks have spurred the European Commission to threaten retaliation.

zh: 美国和欧洲的衍生品规则的协调工作进展落后。 衍生品是金融危机的主要原因之一。
en: Progress toward reconciling US and EU rules on derivatives – one of the main causes of the financial crisis – has fallen apart.

zh: 欧盟和英国“隔离”银行存款的计划从形式到实质都不同，与美国新采取的沃克尔规则（Volcker rule）也不相同。
en: And plans by the EU and the United Kingdom to “ring-fence” bank deposits are poised to depart in form and substance from one another and from the newly unveiled Volcker rule in the US.

zh: 但大部分观察者从日益加剧的分歧中得出的教训 — — 即，即使在金融监管领域，权力政治也压倒了共同好处 — — 是不完全的。
en: But the lesson that most observers draw from these increasingly high-profile disputes – that, even in financial regulation, power politics trumps the common good – is incomplete.

zh: 毕竟，监管分歧并不仅仅是国家利益差异的产物；外交实践和协作效率的高低也起着作用。
en: After all, regulatory disparities are not just a product of divergent national interests; how effectively diplomacy is practiced and coordinated can play a role as well.

zh: 比如，一项最新研究强调G-20领导人没能在2008年危机后给出一致的、可实现的金融监管日程实施路线图。
en: For example, a recent study highlighted the failure of G-20 leaders to define a consistent and achievable roadmap for implementing the financial-reform agenda announced after the 2008 crisis.

zh: 在过去的十年中，各国首脑一直在不但要求监管者处理资本要求这样的大问题，也要求他们处理场外市场衍生品和信用评级改革等其他问题。
en: For roughly the past decade, heads of state have been calling on regulators to tackle big issues, such as capital standards, along with other matters like over-the-counter derivatives and credit-ratings reforms.

zh: 但是，在此期间，官员或多或少地拥有自由裁量权，这导致问题得根据不同的经济和政治周期予以解决。
en: But, during this period, officials have acted more or less at their discretion, leaving problems to be addressed according to different economic and political cycles.

zh: 美国和欧盟的决策文化之间的巨大差别加剧了这一问题。
en: Radical disparities between the rule-making cultures of the US and the EU are exacerbating the problem.

zh: 在美国，独立机构根据国会授权领导规则制定过程，与此不同的是，在布鲁塞尔和斯特拉斯堡 — — 欧盟委员会、欧洲理事会和欧洲议会 — — 是立法者制定监管日程和起草规则。
en: Unlike the US, where independent agencies lead the rule-making process according to Congressional dictates, legislative actors in Brussels and Strasbourg – the European Commission, the European Council, and the European Parliament – set regulatory agendas and write the rules.

zh: 此外，尽管欧洲央行等欧盟机构承担的监管责任比重越来越大，但决策程序的分歧仍然影响了跨大西洋协作的节奏和性质。
en: And, though EU agencies like the European Central Bank are assuming an increasing share of regulatory responsibility, divergences in decision-making procedures continue to affect the rate and nature of transatlantic coordination.

zh: 更糟糕的是，市场和货币改革偶尔会合而为一，规则制定部分取决于不同机构和部门的决定。
en: Making matters worse, market and monetary reforms have occasionally merged, with rule-making becoming partly dependent on the decisions of disparate agencies and institutions.

zh: 比如，符合加强后的巴塞尔III资本标准便不仅仅事关规则；还需要重组银行 — — 这一过程在欧洲花费的时间比��美国更长，部分是因为欧元区必须为银行和现金不足的政府谈判融资机制。
en: Meeting enhanced Basel III capital standards, for example, is about more than just rules; it requires the recapitalization of banks – a process that is taking longer in Europe than in the US, partly because the eurozone has had to negotiate funding mechanisms for banks and cash-strapped governments.

zh: 如今，这些拖延因素已经让美国开始怀疑欧盟的改革承诺。
en: Now these delays are raising doubts in the US about the EU’s commitment to reform.

zh: 所有这些问题都反映了一个简单事实，即决策者缺少动态市场改革环境下的合适的监管外交工具。
en: All of these problems reflect the simple fact that policymakers lack suitable tools for conducting regulatory diplomacy in a world of dynamic market reform.

zh: 监管外交的传统方式 — — 互相承认和合规替代 — — 需要一种环境，即各国通过让外国人更容易进入本国市场（只要其母国监管与本国相同）互相鞭策提高标准。
en: The conventional means for doing so – mutual recognition and substituted compliance – were developed in an environment in which countries would spur each other to raise standards by offering foreigners easier access to domestic markets once regulations in their home countries mirrored their own.

zh: 这两种机制都没有遇见到所有国家同时寻求横跨多部门升级金融系统的局面。
en: Neither mechanism foresees a situation whereby all countries simultaneously seek to upgrade their financial systems across a variety of sectors.

zh: 与此同时，欧盟-美国谈判的传统论坛 — — 金融市场监管对话（Financial Markets Regulatory Dialogue，该论坛不定期汇集各方监管者，就监管分歧问题逐一讨价还价）节奏太缓慢，也太容易规避。
en: Meanwhile, the traditional forum for EU-US talks, the Financial Markets Regulatory Dialogue – which brings regulators together at irregular intervals to haggle over lists of divergent regulations one by one – is all too often slow and circumvented.

zh: 好消息是欧洲和美国决策者可以做出清除结构性障碍的选择。
en: The good news is that European and American policymakers have options for clearing the structural roadblocks.

zh: 第一步应该是开发新的“工具包”帮助各国不但满足现有标准、还齐心协力在快速变化的市场中改善标准。
en: They should begin by developing a new “toolkit” to help countries not just meet existing standards, but also work together to improve standards in an environment of rapidly changing markets.

zh: 不管作为跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系谈判的一部分还是作为非正式政策实施，互相承认和替代合规计划都应该更加鲁棒，并且应该为协调实时规则制定和行政程序提供程序性机制。
en: Whether implemented as part of the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership talks or on an informal basis, mutual-recognition and substituted-compliance programs should become more robust, and they should provide procedural mechanisms for coordinating rule-making and administrative processes in real time.

zh: 此外，协调机制应该尽可能地设计成基于目标的程序，以国际承诺和最佳实践来衡量。
en: Moreover, coordinating mechanisms should be – to the extent possible – objectives-based processes measured against international commitments and best practices.

zh: 最后，考虑到金融监督和货币关系之间的交互，金融市场监管对话应该随G-20财政官员和央行行长会议重启。
en: Finally, given the interface between financial supervision and monetary relations, the Financial Markets Regulatory Dialogue should be revived alongside G-20 meetings of treasury officials and central bankers.

zh: 欧盟和美国监管者不应该依赖多地区的金融稳定委员会消除分歧、设定监管节奏，而应该被鼓励拿出联合解决方案和以更广泛的国际考虑为目标的改革。
en: Instead of relying on the multi-regional Financial Stability Board to hash out differences and set the regulatory pace, EU and US regulators should be encouraged to present joint solutions and reforms for wider international consideration.

zh: 当然，改革跨大西洋监管框架只能为金融外交做到这一步，国家利益永远是重要的。
en: Of course, reforming the transatlantic regulatory architecture can do only so much for financial diplomacy, and national interests will always be important.

zh: 但是，世界资本流规模已臻万亿，可靠的全球金融系统事关重大，因此即使是微小的改善也能带来极大的不同。
en: But, in a world of trillion-dollar capital flows and ever-higher stakes in a sound global financial system, even modest improvements can make a big difference.

zh: 更好的规则制定机制是一个良好的开端。
en: Better rule-making mechanisms are a good place to start.

zh: 奥巴马的反教条行动
en: The Obama Anti-Doctrine

zh: 丹佛 — — 美国总统奥巴马做出了正确的决定，放弃参加在印尼巴厘岛举办的亚太经合组织（APEC）会议，集中精力处理美国国会的政治问题。
en: DENVER – US President Barack Obama was right to forego the Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in Bali, Indonesia, and focus instead on dealing with the political pathologies of the US Congress.

zh: 不过决策虽然正确，但却在事实上再次让人们注意到东亚地区越来越普遍的限制 ： “ 支点”到底是怎么回事？
en: But his decision, while correct, had the effect of reviving an increasingly common refrain in the East Asian region: What happened to the “pivot”?

zh: 虽然被外界视为资源和注意力从中东战争和其他紧迫挑战向亚太地区无限机遇的期待已久的转移，但美国备受赞誉的新战略支点立即引发了意想不到的后果（这是政策不连贯且表述不清晰的必然结果 ） 。
en: Conceived as a long-overdue shift in resources and attention from wars and other urgent challenges in the Middle East toward the vast expanse of opportunities in the Asia-Pacific region, America’s much-vaunted strategic pivot immediately ran into a gauntlet of unintended consequences (the handmaidens of inconsistent and poorly articulated policy).

zh: 首先，有人认为美军撤出伊拉克和阿富汗实际是美国中东利益衰落的标志。
en: For starters, there was the perception that the withdrawal of US troops from Iraq and Afghanistan amounted to a downgrading of US interests in the Middle East.

zh: 因为恰好发生在灾难性阿拉伯之春革命的前夕，奥巴马政府一直尽全力消除新支点出人意料的后果。
en: Coming as it did on the eve of the cataclysmic Arab Spring, the Obama administration has struggled with this unintended consequence of the pivot ever since.

zh: 政府“幕后领导”一词的设计者只是使问题进一步复杂化。
en: Whoever in the administration devised the phrase “leading from behind” only compounded the problem.

zh: 其次，很多欧洲人认为亚洲支点的潜台词是削减美国对大西洋联盟的投入。
en: Second, many Europeans understood the pivot to Asia as implying a reduction in America’s commitment to the Atlantic alliance.

zh: 虽然有些欧洲国家较好地维护了欧美协商及承诺机制，但欧洲领导人对战后安全结构的动摇已经表现出越来越明确的关注。
en: Though several European countries have done relatively well in terms of maintaining consultations and commitments with the US, Europe’s leaders have watched with growing concern as the postwar security structure has faltered.

zh: 可以肯定，欧洲人同样起了推波助澜的作用：迫不及待地退出阿富汗北约行动就是证明。
en: To be sure, Europeans have contributed to this dynamic: witness their own haste in exiting the NATO mission in Afghanistan.

zh: 但欧洲金融危机和美国长期政治裂痕所造就的欧洲－大西洋结构越来越强的不稳定感令人们很难保持乐观情绪。
en: But the increased sense of drift in Euro-Atlantic structures, fueled principally by Europe’s financial crisis and America’s prolonged political rift, leaves little room for optimism.

zh: 最后，明确支点目标（美国确认亚洲现在是世界经济中心）的努力从一开始就已经落空。
en: Finally, efforts to explain the pivot’s goal – US affirmation that Asia is now at the center of the world economy – have fallen flat from the start.

zh: 中国人坚信对抗及遏制其地缘政治崛起是美国唯一的目标。
en: The Chinese believed that the entire purpose was to confront and contain their country’s geopolitical rise.

zh: 联想到口口声声对中国问题表示担忧的美国政策声明，谁又能责怪中国有这样的担忧？
en: And who could blame them, given the drumbeat of US policy pronouncements expressing concern about China?

zh: 事实上，在最初宣布支点政策的几个星期内（也就是2012年美国大选进行期间 ） ， 美国官员对中国的抨击一直愈演愈烈。
en: Indeed, in the weeks that followed the initial announcement of the pivot (which came just as the 2012 US election campaign was getting under way), China-bashing by American officials got worse.

zh: 美菲安全协议完全正常的续订变成了宣泄对中国主权要求不满的场所，前国务卿希拉里·克林顿用“西菲律宾海”来称谓中菲的争议领土。
en: A perfectly normal extension of the US-Philippine security agreement turned into an occasion to bemoan China’s claims on what former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton called the “West Philippine Sea.”

zh: 在这样的大前提下，中国将美国派遣海军陆战队到澳洲训练的例行决策视为打压中国系列行动的一个步骤。
en: In this environment, the Chinese perceived a routine decision to send US marines to train in Australia as another link in the chain meant to hold China down.

zh: 就连向缅甸开放的举措也在媒体通气过程中被作为对抗中国在这个资源富国影响力的举措。
en: Even the opening to Myanmar was briefed to the press as a move designed to counter Chinese influence in that resource-rich country.

zh: 这些事件发生后不久，美国国防部宣布将着手进行美军向西太平洋的调动，这进一步引发了中国的关注。
en: Soon after these episodes, the US Department of Defense announced that it would begin relocating American forces to the western Pacific, focusing China’s attention further.

zh: 同样，迄今为止将中国排除在外的拟议中的区域综合自贸协定跨太平洋伙伴关系（TPP）也让中国人更加担心美国的意图。
en: Likewise, the Trans-Pacific Partnership (TPP), a proposed mega-regional free-trade deal from which China has so far been excluded – has fueled concern in China regarding US intentions.

zh: 但中国的做法也远非无可指责：其对亚洲邻国强加东南中国海主权要求时的高压姿态就是证明。
en: But China has been far from blameless: witness its heavy-handed approach to its Asian neighbors in pressing its territorial claims in the East and South China Seas.

zh: 尽管中国对朝鲜越来越不耐烦的态度被视为最终政策转变的先兆而颇受欢迎，但中国新思维并没有阻止美国强化与韩国和日本的军事合作。
en: And, while growing signs of impatience with North Korea have been welcomed as a harbinger of an eventual policy shift, fresh thinking in China has not been sufficient to forestall US efforts to step up military cooperation with South Korea and Japan.

zh: 但或许中国并不需要采取行动再次改变美国的政策。
en: But perhaps China does not need to do anything to change US policy again.

zh: 奥巴马连任后似乎渐渐偏离了所谓的亚洲支点，而更加趋向于“恢复原状 ” 。
en: Since Obama’s re-election, there appears to have been a pivot away from the pivot, toward something that can be described only as retro.

zh: 国务卿约翰·克里重启阿－以和平进程的努力是一项值得称道的举措。
en: Secretary of State John Kerry’s effort to jump-start the Arab-Israel peace process was a laudable initiative.

zh: 但如果说“阿拉伯之春”对我们有所教益，那就是中东真正的裂痕与其说是因为以色列，还不如说因为阿拉伯世界不断加深的世俗－伊斯兰鸿沟和什叶逊尼派别间越来越激烈的宗派争斗。
en: But, if the Arab Spring has taught us anything, it is that the Middle East’s real fault lines have little to do with Israel and much to do with the Arab world’s deepening secularist-Islamist divide and growing sectarian struggle between Shia and Sunni.

zh: 以色列只是总体格局中的一小部分内容。
en: Israel is but a small part of this overall pattern.

zh: 最近由于突发事件的驱动，又发生了美国为结束叙利亚内战，在化学武器袭击造成至少1，400人死亡后逐渐转向与俄罗斯合作。
en: More recently, there was America’s event-driven shift toward cooperation with Russia on ending Syria’s civil war, following a chemical-weapons attack that left at least 1,400 people dead.

zh: 所有这些都提出了一个根本问题：那就是美国是否真的需要从总体上设计外交政策？
en: All of this raises a fundamental question: Does the US even need an overarching design for its foreign policy?

zh: 如果唯一的结果是降低其外交政策的可靠性和可预见性 — — 甚至更糟，招致别人的误解 — — 那么答案当然是不需要。
en: If the outcome is to make its foreign policy less reliable and predictable – or, worse, susceptible to misunderstanding – then it certainly does not.

zh: 新世界格局已经让位给混乱无序的世界，可靠性和可预见性已经让位给快速变化的重点和变幻无常的承诺。
en: The new world order has given way to an order-less world, in which reliability and predictability have given way to rapid shifts in focus and fickle commitments.

zh: 更可悲的是造成这种局面的并不是身处危机的国家，而是美国。
en: And, sadly, this state of affairs seems to be emanating not from countries in crisis, but rather from the US itself.

zh: 现在，���巴马似乎面对国内问题时有了短暂的喘息机会，这也许是他确定美国外交政策重点并明确美国执行计划的绝佳时刻。
en: Now that Obama appears to have a brief respite from his domestic problems, this might be an opportune moment for him to set out America’s foreign-policy priorities and explain how the US plans to pursue them.

zh: 亚洲支点究竟是否可行？
en: Is the pivot to Asia sustainable?

zh: 美国在中东的目标是什么？
en: What are America’s objectives in the Middle East?

zh: 美国是否想要扮演恃强凌弱的非政府组织，喋喋不休地指责朋友和批评者他们为什么不更像美国？
en: Is the US to be a kind of hectoring NGO, lecturing friends and detractors alike for not being more like Americans?

zh: 美国在俄国那里究竟想得到什么？
en: And just what is the US trying to accomplish with Russia?

zh: 为了解决共同关注的问题，美国能否和这个难以相处的非民主国家合作？
en: Can it identify ways to cooperate with this difficult, undemocratic state, in order to address issues of mutual concern?

zh: 现在是奥巴马纵观全局的时刻。
en: It is time for a tour d’horizon from Obama.

zh: 他的政府仍有三年任期，全世界都在等待、观望、坦率地讲，充满了疑惑。
en: His administration still has three years to go, and the world is waiting, watching, and, frankly, wondering.

zh: 直面慢性病
en: Facing Up to Chronic Disease

zh: 蒙特利尔—许多人担心有一天会中风或突发致命心脏病。
en: MONTREAL – Many of us are terrified by the prospect of having a debilitating stroke or a fatal heart attack.

zh: 但是，很少有人对慢性病有类似的恐慌 ， “ 慢性病”一词含义暧昧又宽泛，主要用于组织卫生服务。
en: Few of us, however, respond as emotionally to the threat of chronic disease, a vague and elastic term that is mainly useful for organizing health services.

zh: 但慢性病正在成为一个主要社会问题，需要集体应对。
en: And yet chronic disease has become a major social problem that requires a collective response.

zh: 历史上，慢性病是指症状维持很长时期的状况。
en: Historically, chronic disease referred to conditions lasting over a long period.

zh: 但是，随着围绕具体疾病的医学组织的增加 ， “ 慢性病”一词所指范围已没有边界，可以包括心血管病、癌症、糖尿病等，但不包括结核病和疟疾等传染病和精神疾病。
en: But, with the increasing organization of medicine around specific diseases, the term has come to refer to an open-ended set of conditions including cardiovascular disease, cancer, and diabetes, but not infectious diseases, such as tuberculosis and malaria, or mental illness.

zh: 在十九世纪，慢性病之所以被视为问题，部分是因为患者占据了宝贵的医院病床，而医院日益专注于治疗可治愈的急性疾病。
en: In the nineteenth century, chronic disease was considered problematic in part because sufferers took up scarce beds in hospitals that were increasingly focused on treating acute, curable diseases.

zh: 但随着癌症、心血管疾病和糖尿病致死人数的增加，慢性病很快就成了更大的公共卫生问题。
en: But chronic disease soon became a wider public-health issue as the death toll from cancer, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes seemed to rise.

zh: 事实上，这些疾病报告死亡数量的最初增加最有可能是识别和确诊方面的进步。
en: In fact, the initial increase in the number of reported deaths from these diseases most likely reflected better identification and diagnosis.

zh: 填写死亡报告不是精确科学，医生总是专注于他们所熟悉的死因。
en: Filling in death certificates is not an exact science, and doctors focus on causes with which they are familiar.

zh: 但是，随着时间的推移，发达国家慢性病发病率几乎确定地增长着。
en: Over time, though, the incidence of chronic disease almost certainly did rise in developed countries.

zh: 随着传染病日益得到控制，更多的人能够活到老年，而老年人更容易得长期疾病。
en: As infectious diseases have been brought increasingly under control, more people live into old age, when they become susceptible to long-term illnesses.

zh: 因此，如今，慢性病构成了医疗体系患病总数的最大头。
en: As a result, chronic diseases now comprise a large proportion of health-care systems' total caseloads.

zh: 我们对于解决慢性病问题的共同兴趣不仅在传染病统计数字。
en: Our collective interest in addressing the problem of chronic diseases does not rest only on epidemiological statistics.

zh: 它还反映了长期存在的对文明的影响的深刻担忧：城市过度拥挤、久坐的生活方式、吸烟饮酒等不健康的习惯、过度饮食，还有压力。
en: It also reflects deep, long-standing concerns about the effects of civilization: urban overcrowding, sedentary lifestyles, unhealthy habits like tobacco and alcohol consumption, overeating, and stress.

zh: 此外，我们开始相信，大部分疾病 — — 包括从前的不治之症 — — 可以预防、治疗和减轻症状，或用科学药物加以控制，即使无法从中获益的病患也有权利获得医疗。
en: Moreover, we have come to believe that most diseases, including previously hopeless conditions, can be prevented, cured, ameliorated, or controlled by scientific medicine, and that even those patients unlikely to benefit have a right to medical care.

zh: 随着慢性病成为日益普遍的社会问题，人们开始用两种方法对付它。
en: As chronic disease has become an increasingly prevalent social problem, it has been dealt with in two ways.

zh: 最普通的应对办法是对症下药（disease-specific ） 。
en: The most common response is disease-specific.

zh: 美国癌症协会（American Cancer Society ） 、 美国心脏协会（American Heart Association）以及国家卫生研究局（National Institutes of Health）等基于疾病的研究机构就是显著的例子。
en: The American Cancer Society and the American Heart Association, as well as the disease-based research institutes of the National Institutes of Health, are notable examples.

zh: 另一种方法是将这些疾病视为同一个全面的问题。
en: An alternative approach is to treat these illnesses as a single, comprehensive problem.

zh: 最早的例子出现在美国，关注脆弱人群 — — 老人、残疾人和穷人 — — 的福利措施和健康保险有力地推进了针对这一人群广泛存在的慢性病的治疗。
en: The earliest example occurred in the United States, where a focus on welfare measures and health insurance for vulnerable populations – the elderly, the disabled, and the very poor – led to a strong push to confront the chronic diseases widespread among them.

zh: 欧洲国家的国民医疗体系面向全部人口，花了更长的时间转向全面战略。
en: European countries, preoccupied with national health-care systems that addressed the needs of the entire population, took longer to move toward comprehensive strategies.

zh: 两种方法都产生了新的流行病监控形式。
en: Both approaches have given rise to new forms of epidemiological surveillance.

zh: 比如，20世纪50年代以来，该领域扩展到了风险因素，这一概念来自关于烟草的健康影响和对有多重潜在原因的心血管病的研究。
en: Since the 1950s, for example, the field has been extended to risk factors, a concept that grew out of debates about the health effects of tobacco and studies of cardiovascular diseases with multiple potential causes.

zh: 一些风险因素 — — 比如轻微高血压和高胆固醇 — — 本身已成为慢性病，需要药物（有时是手术）治疗并造成发病率的上升。
en: Some risk factors – moderate hypertension and high cholesterol, for example – have themselves become chronic diseases, requiring medical (and sometimes surgical) treatment and further contributing to the rise in illness rates.

zh: 一种源自美国的有管理的医疗（managed-care）运动的新医疗形式最近凸显出采取全面方法治疗这些状况的重要性。
en: A new vision of health care, which has grown out of the US managed-care movement, has recently heightened the relevance of embracing a comprehensive approach to treating these conditions.

zh: 最初的目标是削减成本，而如今的目标则是为新时期提供更合适的医疗，其选角条件是对许多疾病的长期医疗需要不同于针对急性病治疗的医疗组织形式。
en: Originally intended to cut costs, the goal now is to provide more appropriate care for a new era, the premise being that long-term care for many diseases requires forms of medical organization that are different from those geared toward acute care.

zh: 急性发作和昂贵的住院治疗可以通过为患者提供自我护理专家团队支持避免。
en: Acute episodes and expensive hospitalization can be avoided by providing expert team support for patient self-care.

zh: 这类项目中最成功、最彻底的是美国医生爱德华·瓦格纳（Edward Wagner）所提出的慢性医疗模式（Chronic Care Model ） 。
en: The most successful and radical of these initiatives is the Chronic Care Model developed by Edward Wagner, an American doctor.

zh: 不太彻底的模式是家庭医疗模式（Medical Home Model ） ， 该模式也源于美国，寻求组建医疗团队为患有多重疾病的患者提供更好的就医便利和���疗持续性。
en: Less sweeping is the Medical Home Model, also developed in the US, which seeks to create teams of caregivers to provide better access and continuity of care to patients suffering from multiple diseases.

zh: 大众医疗体系无法快速轻松地改变。
en: Massive health-care systems cannot shift course easily or quickly.

zh: 但这类措施通过专注于提供合理平价的慢性病医疗的需要，朝着正确的方向迈出了一小步。
en: But efforts like these, by focusing on the need to provide appropriate and less expensive care for chronic diseases, constitute a small step in the right direction.

zh: 货币危机预言纪
en: Chronicle of a Currency Crisis Foretold

zh: 坎布里奇 — —
en: CAMBRIDGE – The crisis in Greece and the debt problems in Spain and Portugal have exposed the euro’s inherent flaws.  No amount of financial guarantees – much less rhetorical reassurance – from the European Union can paper them over. After 11 years of smooth sailing since the euro’s creation, the arrangement’s fundamental problems have become glaringly obvious.

zh: 希腊危机和西班牙、葡萄牙的债务问题将欧元的内在漏洞暴露无遗。
en: The attempt to establish a single currency for 16 separate and quite different countries was bound to fail.

zh: 财政担保已无法粉饰太平 — — —更不用说欧盟的口头承诺了。
en: The shift to a single currency meant that the individual member countries lost the ability to control monetary policy and interest rates in order to respond to national economic conditions.

zh: 在平稳运行了11年之后，欧元制度的基本问题已显露无疑。
en: It also meant that each country’s exchange rate could no longer respond to the cumulative effects of differences in productivity and global demand trends.

zh: 为16个相互独立且迥异的国家设立一种单一货币的努力正濒于失败。
en: In addition, the single currency weakens the market signals that would otherwise warn a country that its fiscal deficits were becoming excessive.

zh: 转向单一货币意味着各成员国不再能够针对自身经济状况控制货币政策和利率，也意味着各国不再能够根据生产率差异和全球需求趋势的累积效应调整汇率。
en: And when a country with excessive fiscal deficits needs to raise taxes and cut government spending, as Greece clearly does now, the resulting contraction of GDP and employment cannot be reduced by a devaluation that increases exports and reduces imports.

zh: 此外，单一货币制度还弱化了市场信号，使得财政赤字过度膨胀的国家得不到警告。
en: Why, then, is the United States able to operate with a single currency, despite major differences among its 50 states?

zh: 而当一国的财政赤字过大从而需要增税和削减政府开支时 — — 正如眼下希腊的情况，由此造成的GDP和就业萎缩无法通过货币贬值、增加出口和减少进口来缓和。
en: There are three key economic conditions – none of which exists in Europe – that allow the diverse US states to operate with a single currency: labor mobility, wage flexibility, and a central fiscal authority.

zh: 那么，为何美国50个州各不相同，却仍然可以实行单一货币？
en: When the textile and shoe industries in America’s northeastern states died, workers moved to the West, where new industries were growing. The unemployed workers of Greece, Portugal, and Spain do not move to faster-growing regions of Europe because of differences in language, history, religion, union membership, etc.

zh: 有三个关键的经济因素 — — 这些在欧洲都不存在 — — 允许多元化的美国实行单一货币：劳动力的流动性、工资的弹性，以及中央财政体系
en: Moreover, wage flexibility meant that substantially slower wage growth in the states that lost industries helped to attract and retain other industries. And the US fiscal system collects roughly two-thirds of all taxes at the national level, which implies an automatic and substantial net fiscal transfer to states with temporarily falling incomes.

zh: 当美国东北部的纺织和制鞋工业衰落时，工人便迁移到新产业蓬勃发展西部。
en: The European Central Bank must set monetary policy for the eurozone as a whole, even if that policy is highly inappropriate for some member countries.

zh: 但希腊、葡萄牙和西班牙的失业工人却由于语言、历史、宗教、工会等情况的差异而未能迁移到欧洲增长较快的地区。
en: When demand in Germany and France was quite weak early in the last decade, the ECB reduced interest rates sharply.

zh: 此外，美国的工资弹性意味着即使某些州的产业萧条了，持续的较低工资增长率也有助于吸引和留住其他产业。
en: That helped Germany and France, but it also inflated real-estate bubbles in Spain and Ireland.

zh: 同时，在美国的财政系统中，国税要占总税收的三分之二，这意味着收入暂时下降的州可以自动且持续地获得净财政转移支持。
en: The recent collapse of those bubbles caused sharp downturns in economic activity and substantial increases in unemployment in both countries.

zh: 欧洲央行必须在整个欧元区的层面上制定货币政策，尽管那样可能对某些成员国非常不利。 在2000年代早期，由于德国和法国需求不振，欧洲央行大幅削减利率。
en: The introduction of the euro, with its implication of a low common rate of inflation, caused sharp declines in interest rates in Greece and several other countries that had previously had high rates.

zh: 这提振了德法两国，但也助长了西班牙和爱尔兰的地产泡沫。 最近这些泡沫破裂，造成两国经济活动大幅萎缩和失业率持续上涨。
en: Those countries succumbed to the resulting temptation to increase government borrowing, driving the ratio of government debt to GDP to more than 100% in Greece and Italy.

zh: 欧元的推行 — — 以及其中所暗含的较低的欧元区整体通胀率 — — 将希腊和其他高利率国家的利率大幅拉低。 这些国家经不住低利率的诱惑，提高了政府借贷，希腊和意大利的债务占GDP比重均超过了100 % 。
en: Until recently, the bond markets treated all euro sovereign debts as virtually equal, not raising interest rates on high-debt countries until the possibility of default became clear.

zh: 债券市场一直将所有欧元区主权债务一视同仁，直到最近出现了明显的违约可能，才开始对高负债国家要求高利率。 希腊 — — 或许还有其他一些国家 — — 需要进行大规模的财政调整，又无法通过货币贬值进行缓冲，因此可能对其政府债务违约具体的方式可能是在IMF支持下进行债务重组。
en: The need for massive fiscal adjustment without any offsetting currency devaluation will now drive Greece and perhaps others to default on their government debt, probably through some kind of IMF-supported debt restructuring.

zh: 当初，欧元的宣传口号是“一个市场，一种货币 ” ， 俨然为成员国之间进行自由贸易所必须。
en: The euro was promoted as necessary for free trade among the member countries under the slogan “One Market, One Money.”

zh: 但在现实中，单一货币或固定汇率并非贸易繁荣的必要条件。
en: In reality, of course, a single currency or fixed exchange rate is not needed for trade to flourish.

zh: 美元实行弹性汇率，几十年来波动很大，但美国每年的贸易量可达2万亿美元。
en: The US has annual trade turnover of more than $2 trillion, despite a flexible exchange rate that has seen sharp ups and downs in recent decades.

zh: 北美自由贸易区增进了加拿大、墨西哥和美国之间的贸易，而三国均采用浮动汇率。
en: The North American Free Trade area increased trade among Canada, Mexico, and the US, all of which have separately floating exchange rates.

zh: 日本、韩国和其他亚洲贸易国家的汇率也颇具弹性。
en: Japan, South Korea, and other major Asian trading countries have very flexible exchange rates.

zh: 而且，显而易见的是，欧盟自由贸易区的27个成员国中，只有16个使用欧元。
en: And, obviously, only 16 nations within the 27-member EU’s free-trade area use the euro.

zh: 尽管问题重重，欧元从当前的危机中生存下来的机会仍然很大。
en: Despite its problems, the euro is very likely to survive the current crisis.

zh: 但一年后很可能会有一些国家退出欧元区。
en: But not all of the eurozone’s current members may be there a year from now.

zh: 回顾过去可以发现，很显然，某些国家在财政赤字很重、债务占GDP比重很高时便被草率地纳入了欧元区。
en: In retrospect, it is clear that some of the countries were allowed to join prematurely, when they still had massive budget deficits and high debt-to-GDP ratios.

zh: 而某些国家的产业构成和较低的生产率增长速度意味着固定汇率会使其贸易赤字不断恶化。
en: Moreover, some countries’ industrial composition and low rates of productivity growth mean that a fixed exchange rate would doom them to increasingly large trade deficits.

zh: 其他国家可能采用某些机制 — — 如增强监管和控制 — — 以限制未来财政赤字。
en: For the rest, some mechanism of enhanced surveillance and control may be adopted to limit future fiscal deficits.

zh: 但是，即使欧元区有所缩小并且预算程序有所改进，欧元所面临的基本问题 — — 强迫情况各异的多个国家在单一货币政策和单一汇率安排下运行 — — 仍然无法消除。
en: But, even with a smaller group of member countries and some changes in budget procedures, the fundamental problems of forcing disparate countries to live with a single monetary policy and a single exchange rate will remain.

zh: 愚蠢排名？
en: Rank Stupidity?

zh: 布卢明顿 — “ 引用来源。
en: BLOOMINGTON – “Cite your sources.”

zh: ”这一戒条回响在每一个马虎的本科生和想走捷径的博士后耳边。
en: The admonition rings in the ear of every slapdash undergraduate and corner-cutting postdoc.

zh: 但我们是否过于强调引用了？
en: But have we taken the emphasis on citation too far?

zh: 从小我们就被教导要感谢用思想和洞见影响我们的思维的人。
en: From an early age, we are taught to acknowledge those whose ideas and insights have shaped our thinking.

zh: 在我们的学术生涯中，我们学习为我们所使用的词汇、数据或图像提供正确的属性。
en: During our academic careers, we learn to provide correct attribution for the existing words, data, or images that we are using.

zh: 而“感谢应该感谢的人”则是整个学术发表体系所围绕的核心原则。
en: And “credit where credit is due” is the axial principle around which the entire scholarly publication system revolves.

zh: 在学术界，引用他人工作并不仅仅是出于礼貌；而是一种规范要求。
en: In academia, citing the work of others is not a mere courtesy; it is a normative requirement.

zh: 事实上，几乎无法想象著名杂志会发表不列明参考文献的文章。
en: Indeed, it is almost impossible to imagine an article being published in a reputable journal without an accompanying list of references.

zh: 剽窃是极少数可以辉煌的学术生涯戛然而止的行为之一。
en: Plagiarism is one of the few acts that can bring a glittering academic career to a halt.

zh: 引用穿插在研究之中，有助于引导读者。
en: Citations contextualize research and help to orient the reader.

zh: 引用让读者可以在对其所选取的参考文献质量的印象的基础上评估作者工作的价值。
en: They allow the reader to evaluate the author’s work on the basis of the perceived quality of the selected references.

zh: 引用也让读者能够追溯先前不了解但可能非常有用的工作。
en: And they enable the reader to track down previously unknown but potentially useful work.

zh: 尤金·加菲尔德（Eugene Garfield）明白这一点。
en: Eugene Garfield understood this.

zh: 1955年，加菲尔德创建了科学文献索引（Science Citation Index，SCI ） ， 该数据库包括了名望最高的科学期刊中的所有被引用文献，构成了一张连接文献的庞大的网络。
en: In 1955, Garfield created the Science Citation Index (SCI), a database containing all of the cited references across the most highly respected scientific journals, thereby capturing the sprawling web of connections among texts.

zh: 正如他所言 ， “ 通过在编辑文献索引过程中使用作者参考文献，我们开始真正利用索引器的威力，作者每列举一条参考文献，事实上都是在为自己的观点编辑索引。
en: As he put it, “By using the authors’ references in compiling the citation index, we are in reality utilizing an army of indexers, for every time an author makes a reference, he is in effect indexing that work from his point of view.”

zh: ”SCI将让研究者能够沿着科学文献中的引用链接上下追溯知识链条。
en: The SCI would enable researchers to follow chains of knowledge backward and forward along the citation links embedded in scientific literature.

zh: SCI从未失去在科学界的潜力，学者们很快就接受了它 — — 但原因并非人们所预想的。
en: The SCI’s potential was not lost on the scientific community, whose members quickly adopted it – but not for the reasons one might expect.

zh: 丰富的前人分析主题、联系和相同引用文献的结论显然都是吸引力的一部分。
en: The enrichment of the subject matter with previous analyses, connections, and conclusions regarding the same cited texts was certainly part of the attraction.

zh: 但是，更有吸引力的是有可能以此追踪自己或他人在长期和多领域的学术影响力，并找到被引用最多的科学家、论文、期刊和机构。
en: More appealing, however, was the possibility of tracking the scholarly influence of oneself and others over time and across fields, and identifying the most highly cited scientists, papers, journals, and institutions.

zh: 几乎在一夜之间，谦逊的目录式参考文献（bibliographic reference）获得了象征意义，科学也有了记分牌。
en: Almost overnight, the humble bibliographic reference acquired symbolic significance, and science gained a scorecard.

zh: 但科学针对需要记分牌吗？
en: But did science really need one?

zh: SCI催生了众多基于引用的指标，其中有两个特别值得注意。
en: The SCI gave rise to multiple citation-based measures, with two, in particular, warranting mention.

zh: 第一个也源于加菲尔德的构思，名为影响因子（impact factor，IF ） ， 该指标以所刊文章在前两年中平均被引用的次数为基础推定学术期刊的质量。
en: The first – another brainchild of Garfield’s – is impact factor (IF), which offers a putative indication of an academic journal’s quality based on the average number of times its articles were cited during the previous two years.

zh: 高影响因子可以立竿见影地提高期刊的地位。
en: A high impact factor instantly boosts a journal’s prestige.

zh: 另一个值得关注的指标是h指数。 该指标由物理学家乔治·赫西（Jorge Hirsch）提出，旨在衡量学者的生产率和影响。
en: Another notable measure is the h-index – conceived by the physicist Jorge Hirsch – which aims to measure scholars’ productivity and impact.

zh: H指数的计量方法非常直观：某研究者发表了20篇文章，每篇文章至少被引用了20次，则他的h指数就是20。
en: H-index accounting is straightforward: if a researcher publishes 20 papers that have each been cited at least 20 times, she has an h-index of 20.

zh: 如果他发表了34篇文章，每篇文章被引用至少34次，则它的h指数就是34。
en: If she publishes 34 papers, each cited at least 34 times, she earns an h-index of 34.

zh: 尽管这些指标有着广为诟病的局限性，但凭借着简明性 — — 更不用说科学进步固有的竞争了 — — 它们仍具有相广泛的吸引力。
en: Despite the well-documented limitations of these measures, their simplicity – not to mention the competition inherent to scientific progress – makes them widely appealing.

zh: 因此，它们被应该是更明白的人认为很有意义。
en: As a result, they have been deemed meaningful by people who should know better.

zh: 事实上，引用数据已成为学术界的重要统计数字，研究者通常会在简历中写上他的IF数据和h指数 — — 以及来自汤森路透（Thomson Reuters）的科学网（Web of Science，加菲尔德的数据库 ） 、 艾斯维尔（Elsevier）的斯高帕斯（Scopus）和谷歌学术（Google Scholar）等来源的原始引用分数。
en: Indeed, citation data have become the vital statistics of academia, with researchers routinely including IF data and h-indexes – along with raw citation scores generated from sources like Thomson Reuters’ Web of Science (Garfield’s database), Elsevier’s Scopus, and Google Scholar – on their curricula vitae.

zh: 类似地，一些年度大学排名 — — 包括CWTS莱顿排名（CWTS Leiden Ranking ） 、 上海交通大学世界大学学术排名（Shanghai Academic Ranking of World Universities ） 、 QS世界大学排名（QS World University Rankings）和世界大学排名（QS World University Rankings）等 — — 的算法都基于发表和引用数据。
en: Likewise, several annual university rankings – including the CWTS Leiden Ranking, the Shanghai Academic Ranking of World Universities, QS World University Rankings, and the World University Rankings – rely on publication and citation data in their calculations.

zh: 大学校长必须致力于增加本校的引用记录，尽管他们知道这些数据的准确性和有效性以及它们所衍生的排名大有可疑。
en: University presidents must work to boost their institutions’ citation records, even though they know that the validity and reliability of these data, and the rankings that they inform, are questionable.

zh: 问题不仅在于学术界。
en: The problem is not limited to academia.

zh: 管理人员用这些指标评估他们聘用和给予资金支持的人的生产率，追踪他们所承担的研发项目的下游影响，丝毫不关注这些指标的局限性。
en: Administrators are using such measures to assess the productivity of those they hire and fund, and track the downstream impact of the research and development projects they underwrite, with little regard for the limitations of such indices.

zh: 在英国、澳大利亚、德国和意大利等国家，研究评估工作正在无情地创造一种资格和问责文化，引用数据的重要性日益增加。
en: In countries like the United Kingdom, Australia, Germany, and Italy, research-assessment exercises are inexorably creating a culture of quantification and accountability, in which citation data play an increasingly important role.

zh: 越多这些“客观”指标被用于研究评估和人事评估，就有越多科学家感到必须参与这个引用游戏。
en: The more these “objective” indicators are used in research assessment and personnel evaluation, the more scientists feel obliged to play the citation game.

zh: 逐渐地，这意味着与制度周旋，专注于能带来短期效益的工作，追求“热点”研究主题，将更多的时间用于钻营（社交媒体的兴盛起到了推波助澜的效果 ） ， 将工作切割包装以最大程度地吸引关注。
en: Increasingly, that means gaming the system, by focusing on work that promises short-term yields, pursuing “hot” research topics, spending more time on self-promotion (facilitated by the proliferation of social media), and slicing and dicing their work to attract maximum attention.

zh: 最近出现的所谓“替代指标 ” （ 如下载、推荐、Facebook“喜欢”和Tweet等）更是加剧了研究者收集影响力证据的压力。
en: The recent emergence of so-called “alternative metrics” (such as downloads, recommendations, Facebook likes, and Tweets) has intensified the pressure on researchers to stockpile multidimensional evidence of their influence.

zh: 平心而论，将社会分析用于研究和学术界可以带来重要洞见，让我们更容易评估学者“真正”的贡献。
en: To be sure, the application of social analytics to the world of research and scholarship may yet provide important insights that make it easier to assess a scholar’s “true” contributions.

zh: 挑战在于管理透明度和琐碎化之间的权衡。
en: The challenge will be to manage the trade-off between transparency and triviality.

zh: 据说爱因斯坦曾说 ， “ 可数的未必重要，重要的未必可数。 ”
en: As Einstein purportedly said: “Not everything that can be counted counts, and not everything that counts can be counted.”

zh: 全球问题的本地解决方案
en: Local Solutions for Global Problems

zh: 蒙特利尔 — — 6月8日，来自全球最大发达经济体的领导人将齐聚一年一度的七国首脑会议，探讨世界所面临的最为紧迫的挑战。
en: MONTRÉAL – On June 8, leaders from the largest advanced economies will gather for the annual G7 summit to discuss the most pressing challenges the world faces.

zh: 议程上的绝大多数议题 — — 从气候变化到不平等 — — 在占世界人口54%的城市居民看来共鸣都尤其强烈。
en: Most of the items on the agenda – from climate change to inequality – resonate particularly strongly for people living in urban areas, who comprise 54% of the world’s population.

zh: 尽管如此，七国首脑会议期间，市政府将不会以任何正式身份派代表出席。
en: And yet, municipal governments will not be represented in any official capacity during the G7 meetings.

zh: 这是个错误；城市必须成为对话的组成部分，才能解决世界最严重的问题。
en: This is a mistake; if the world’s biggest problems are to be solved, cities must become part of the conversation.

zh: 历史上看，城市在全球讨论中一直扮演着边缘化的角色。
en: Historically, cities have played a marginal role in global debates.

zh: 例如，在美国，早期的城市充斥着腐败和宗派主义；地方政治混乱不堪。
en: In the United States, for example, early cities were rife with corruption and factionalism; local politics was messy enough.

zh: 但今天的城市中心却在经济上更强势，政治上也更大胆。
en: But today’s urban centers are economically stronger and politically bolder.

zh: 2017年末，21世纪城市为维护其自身利益采取行动的决心十分清晰，50多位美国市长表态将履行2015年巴黎气候协定所作出的承诺 — — 这直接挑战了唐纳德·特朗普总统退出该协定的决策。
en: Twenty-first-century cities’ determination to act in their own interests became clear in late 2017, when more than 50 US mayors pledged to meet the commitments of the 2015 Paris climate agreement – directly challenging President Donald Trump’s withdrawal from the deal.

zh: 本周，来自蒙特利尔和全球其他10,000座城市的领袖将向七国集团会议做出类似的表态。
en: This week, leaders from Montreal and 10,000 other cities around the world will deliver a similar message to the G7.

zh: 他们将发表一份声明，其中包括关于峰会主要议题的多种多样的市政意见，并敦促各国政府与地方政府进行更为紧密的合作。
en: They will present a declaration that includes a diverse collection of municipal views on the summit’s key themes, and urge national governments to collaborate more closely with their local counterparts.

zh: 这样的要求及其提出方式在七国集团首脑会议上尚属首次。
en: These demands, and the manner in which they are being made, will be a first for a G7 meeting.

zh: 他们的目的是今后让这种方式成为常态。
en: The goal is to make this the norm.

zh: 即使无法参与讨论，世界许多特大城市（在人力资本、竞争激烈的市场和广泛吸引力的驱动下）正在竭尽全力建设更加进步、包容和可持续的未来。
en: Still, even without a seat at the table, many of the world’s megacities – powered by strong human capital, competitive markets, and widespread appeal – are already working to build a more progressive, inclusive, and sustainable future.

zh: 从布宜诺斯艾利斯到东京，城市领导人正在向全球民众表达他们的关切 — — 他们的表述往往不顾国家议程。
en: From Buenos Aires to Tokyo, city leaders are making their concerns known globally – often irrespective of national agendas.

zh: 中小城市同样在提升其国际形象。
en: Small and mid-sized cities are also raising their international profiles.

zh: 通过投资“智能”且“更富弹性”的城市规划，从法国波尔多到巴西库里提巴在内的市政府正在强化其品牌形象并吸引来自全球的人才、投资和企业。
en: By investing in “smart” and “resilient” urban planning, governments from Bordeaux in France to Curitiba in Brazil are strengthening their brand identities and luring talent, investment, and businesses from around the world.

zh: 美籍加拿大作家兼城市活动家简·雅格布曾提出过一个著名的论断，即城市是国家繁荣背后真正的驱动力量。
en: The American-Canadian author and urban activist Jane Jacobs famously observed that cities are the true engines of national prosperity.

zh: 城市通过创新、贸易和交流推动经济增长。
en: Cities power growth through innovation, trade, and exchange.

zh: 而与联邦援助相比，城市服务往往更容易引起民众的关注；例如，想想在发生交通事故或自然灾害时由谁来采取对策。
en: And city services are often more visible to citizens than federal aid; consider, for example, who responds during a traffic accident or a natural disaster.

zh: 可以肯定，今天的城市面临着许多挑战。
en: To be sure, today’s cities face many challenges.

zh: 随着城市地区的发展，领导者们被迫改变原有的规划。
en: As urban areas have grown, leaders have been forced to change how they plan.

zh: 由于预算不断收紧，城市政府正从过度官僚系统转向鼓励更高层次的企业家精神。
en: Amid tightening budgets, city governments are moving away from overly bureaucratic systems toward those that encourage greater levels of entrepreneurship.

zh: 但正如芝加哥市长拉姆·伊曼纽尔上个月所指出的那样，这一趋势对许多城市都产生了积极的作用，使它们成为流动性 、工作、住房、能源、教育和医疗未来的试验场所。
en: But, as Chicago Mayor Rahm Emanuel noted last month, this has been positive for many cities, allowing them to become testing grounds for the future of mobility, work, housing, energy, education, and health.

zh: “从现在起20年后 ， ” 伊曼纽尔在纽约告诉其它与会市长，我们将看到“民族国家衰落的拐点，而像新加坡这样的城市国家则转而推动文化和经济活动。 ”
en: “Twenty years from now,” Emanuel told fellow mayors in New York City, we will see “an inflection point where the nation-state is in decline, and the city-state à la Singapore is driving the cultural and economic activity.”

zh: 当然，并非所有城市都拥有像芝加哥或新加坡那样的资源、影响力和需求。
en: Of course, not all cities have the same resources, influence, or needs as Chicago or Singapore.

zh: 但今天任何一位城市领袖都能够理解站在变革的前沿有多重要。
en: But any city leader nowadays can appreciate the importance of standing on the frontlines of change.

zh: 在这种团结的鼓舞下，并借助像大都会、C40城市及百强城市等国际网络建立的相互联系，各地市政领袖正在形成伙伴关系，共同制定统一的城市规划。
en: Inspired by this solidarity, and connected through international networks like Metropolis, C40 Cities, and 100 Resilient Cities, municipal leaders everywhere are forging partnerships to create united urban agendas.

zh: 在几乎每个转折点上，而且几乎涉及所有重大问题，国家政府都未能拿出有效决策，而城市领袖却继续鼓舞着公众的信心。
en: At nearly every turn, on just about every major issue, national governments are failing to deliver solutions, while city leaders continue to inspire public confidence.

zh: 巴黎政治学院政治研究中心2017年一份调查显示，64%的法国成年人认为他们的地方市长比行政部门更努力地解决日常问题。
en: According to a 2017 survey by the Centre for Political Research at Sciences Po, 64% of French adults believe their local mayor is working harder than the executive branch to solve everyday problems.

zh: 许多其他城市居民无疑也有同样的感受。
en: No doubt many other urbanites feel the same way.

zh: 现在是城市领袖升级为全球参与者的好时机。
en: This is an opportune time for city leaders to become global players.

zh: 当召开七国集团首脑会议这样的会晤活动来讨论全世界最艰巨的挑战时，那些离挑战距离最近的人应当参与其中，他们最有可能提出克服挑战的最宝贵的见解。
en: When gatherings like the G7 summit are convened to discuss the world’s most difficult challenges, the people closest to those challenges, who are likely to have the most valuable insights concerning how to overcome them, should be in the room.

zh: 掌握食品可持续性核心的城市
en: Cities Hold the Key to Food Sustainability

zh: 发自奥斯汀 — — 住在城市里会让你变成为一个食人族，至少让-雅克·卢梭（Jean-Jacques Rousseau）是这样比喻的，因为在他眼中城市就是人类堕落的泥潭。
en: AUSTIN – Living in a city turns you into a cannibal. That, at least, is the metaphor preferred by Jean-Jacques Rousseau, who considered cities a pit of human corruption.

zh: 卢梭对城市化的恶劣影响深信不疑，以至于他“宁愿看到人们在草地上拔草吃，也不愿目睹他们在城市中相互吞噬。
en: Rousseau was so convinced of the malign effects of urbanization that he “would rather see men grazing on meadow grass than devouring each other in cities.”

zh: ”城市化使人对乡村的痛苦感到厌烦，而随着市民聚拢在一处，他们同情他人的能力也相应萎缩。
en: Urbanization inures people to the suffering of the countryside, and as townspeople crowd together, their capacity for compassion toward others atrophies.

zh: 城市居民成为了那种愿意牺牲他人以满足自身食欲的人：食人族。
en: Urbanites become the kind of people who are ready to sacrifice one another to satisfy their appetites: cannibals.

zh: 卢梭对城市刺激民众以牺牲他人为代价追求自身利益的担忧无论在其所在的十八世纪还是今时今日都具有意义。
en: Rousseau’s fear that cities inspire inhabitants to pursue their own interests at the expense of others remains as relevant today as it was in the eighteenth century.

zh: 而最真实体现这一点的莫过于城市食品体系了。
en: And nowhere is this truer than in the food system.

zh: 只要存在城镇，就会有供养它们的策略。
en: For as long as there have been towns, there have been strategies to feed them.

zh: 在英国，工业革命期间的份地农园运动建立了一个体系，让那些贫苦劳动者能够获得用于种植水果和蔬菜的土地。
en: In the United Kingdom, the allotment movement during the Industrial Revolution established a system that gave the working poor access to land for the cultivation of fruits and vegetables.

zh: 如今这些城市农园仍然是英国都市人的一种流行维生方式；约有35万人被分配了土地，另有80万人正在排队等待分配。
en: Today, these urban gardens remain a popular means of sustenance for British urbanites; an estimated 350,000 people have allotments and another 800,000 want them.

zh: 世界各地的城市都认识到了城市农业的重要性，特别是城市农业生态学，它利用生物多样性而非施加化学肥料来提升土壤肥力，提高作物产量和管理水资源。
en: Cities worldwide are recognizing the importance of urban agriculture, and particularly urban agroecology, which uses biological diversity – rather than chemical inputs – to build soil quality, increase crop yields, and manage water use.

zh: 从罗马到圣保罗的各大都市区都大力支持农业生态学以应对健康危机，气候变化和贫困。
en: Metropolitan areas from Rome to São Paolo have supported agroecology to tackle health crises, climate change, and poverty.

zh: 但如果你从未听说过这种农业，那么仔细阅读卢梭的著作就会明白：它威胁到了那些城市精英所积累的财富。
en: But if you have never heard of this type of farming, a careful reading of Rousseau might explain why: it threatens the wealth that urban elites accumulate.

zh: 卢梭预言了民主将会在何处以及如何遭到颠覆 ： “ 如果城市是有害的，那么首都更是如此 ， ” 他曾写道。
en: Rousseau anticipated where and how democracy becomes subverted: “If cities are harmful, capitals are even more so,” he once wrote.

zh: “首都是一个深渊，吞噬了几乎整个国家的道德，法律，勇气和自由。
en: “A capital is an abyss where nearly the entire nation goes to lose its morals, its laws, its courage, and its liberty.”

zh: ”在粮食方面，今天的首都只不过是花钱来阻止地方政府保护公民的地方。
en: In the context of food, capitals today are where money is spent to stop local governments from protecting citizens.

zh: 以食品行业在最近美国中期选举前夕的游说活动为例。
en: Consider the food industry’s lobbying campaign during the run-up to the recent midterm elections in the United States.

zh: 在华盛顿州，可口可乐公司，百事公司和Keurig Dr Pepper公司花费超过2000万美元制定一项投票议案以防止州内各城市提高杂货 — — 包括已知会增加2型糖尿病风险的含糖饮料 — — 的税率。
en: In Washington State, The Coca-Cola Company, PepsiCo, and Keurig Dr Pepper spent over $20 million to craft a ballot measure to prevent cities from raising taxes on groceries – including sugar-sweetened beverages, which are known to increase the risk of type 2 diabetes.

zh: 该议案最终获得了通过，虽然西雅图现行的碳酸饮料税得到了豁免，但其他城市将无法效仿收税。
en: The initiative passed, and although Seattle’s current soda tax was exempted, other cities will not be able to follow suit.

zh: 为了减少杂货支出并增加行业利润，华盛顿州的居民被说服去互相牺牲。
en: In order to keep grocery bills low and industry profits high, Washington State residents were persuaded to sacrifice one another.

zh: 他们也不是独一份。
en: They are not alone.

zh: 在过去十年中已经有12个美国州立法阻止市政当局去应对加工食品所导致的公共卫生危机，至少有26个州颁布法律保护食品企业免受与饮食相关疾病相关的诉讼。
en: Over the last decade, 12 American states have passed legislation to stop municipalities from addressing the public-health crisis of processed foods, and at least 26 states have enacted laws to shield food companies from lawsuits linked to diet-related diseases.

zh: 虽然一些政策制定者确实认识到食品行业正在模仿大型烟草公司的策略，但卢梭预测了一个更普遍的趋势：城市财富其实与公共自由不相容。
en: Although some policymakers do recognize that the food industry is emulating Big Tobacco’s tactics, Rousseau predicted a more general trend: urban wealth is incompatible with public liberty.

zh: 在1760年代，当科西嘉人向卢梭求教制宪建议时，他建议应该保留农民。
en: In the 1760s, when Corsicans asked Rousseau for advice on writing a constitution, he counseled that they should remain peasants.

zh: “一个务农者不应贪图城市的闲暇并羡慕居住其中的游手好闲者 ， ” 他告诫道。
en: “An agricultural people should never covet the leisure of the cities and envy the life of the do-nothings that inhabit them,” he admonished.

zh: “商业产生财富，但农业能保障自由。
en: “Commerce produces wealth, but agriculture ensures freedom.

zh: 你或许觉得最好可以拥有财富和自由，但它们其实并不相容。 “
en: You may say it would be better to have both wealth and liberty, but they are incompatible.”

zh: 可以肯定的是，卢梭这种不折不挠的反城市主义早已过时。
en: To be sure, Rousseau’s unyielding anti-urbanism is well past its expiration date.

zh: 而现代食品工业如此积极地推销其产品的一个原因正是因为城市已成为渐进式变革的引擎。
en: One reason the modern food industry is so aggressive in pushing its products is precisely because cities have become engines of progressive change.

zh: 跟总统不一样，市长们都知道想要确保一个健康的食品体系就需要根除原本那个不健康​​的体系。
en: More than presidents, mayors recognize that ensuring a healthy food system requires uprooting an unhealthy one.

zh: 事实上越来越多的市政府正在采纳类似《米兰城市粮食政策协议》这样的措施，该协议鼓励采取新手段来应对饥饿，生态风险和可持续性。
en: In fact, a growing number of municipal governments are embracing efforts like the Milan Urban Food Policy Pact, which encourages new approaches to tackling hunger, ecological risk, and sustainability.

zh: 但卢梭在另一个意义上仍然是正确的：政策不可能在缺乏政治的情况下发生，而养活未来城市的最大挑战依然在于那些财富过度集中所催生的问题。
en: But Rousseau is still right in another sense: policies cannot happen without politics, and the greatest challenge to feeding tomorrow’s cities lies in the problems that concentrated wealth creates.

zh: 城市和农村的饥饿是贫困的产物，而贫困是现代粮食体系产生的结果。
en: Urban and rural hunger are products of poverty, and poverty is a consequence of modern food systems.

zh: 在美国，十大薪酬最低的工作中有七个属于食品行业 — — 即便该行业内的企业纷纷取得了创纪录的利润。
en: In the US, seven of the ten lowest-paying jobs are in the food industry, even as the companies that comprise it post record profits.

zh: 我们为未来的城市提供食物的方式不再是通过耕种土地，而是消灭卢梭所谓的社会“同类相食 ” 。
en: It is not through the literal tilling of the land that we will feed future cities. Rather, it will be in undoing Rousseau’s social “cannibalism.”

zh: 这意味着与最受当今食品体系伤害的人群构建团结，并在借助越来越多的营养失调和营养不良者的共同愤怒去集体组织起来实现真正的变革。
en: That means cultivating solidarity with those most hurt by today’s food system and using shared outrage at the growing number of malnourished and poorly nourished to organize collectively for genuine change.

zh: 包容性增长依靠城市
en: Inclusive Growth Depends on Cities

zh: 巴黎、华盛顿—我们生活在动荡时代，群众对现状的不满与日俱增。
en: PARIS, WASHINGTON, DC – We live in turbulent times, and popular discontent with the status quo is mounting.

zh: 群众不满的原因各个国家各不相同，但有一个共同线索是越来越多的人感到经济被操纵以满足一小撮人的利益。
en: The reasons for popular frustration vary from country to country, but the common thread everywhere is a growing sense that the economy is rigged in favor of the few.

zh: 事实上，经济增长的收益越来越多地流向最高薪群体。
en: Indeed, the gains from economic growth are increasingly going to the very highest earners.

zh: 在经合组织国家中，收入分布最顶层10%人群要比最底层10%多赚十倍 — — 近30年前只有七倍。
en: In OECD countries, people in the top 10% of the income distribution earn around ten times more than people in the bottom 10% – up from seven times more nearly 30 years ago.

zh: 2012年，在有可比数据的18个经合组织国家中，最顶层10%拥有50%的家庭总财富，而最底层40%只拥有3 % 。
en: In 2012, among the 18 OECD countries with comparable data, the top 10% accounted for 50% of total household wealth, while the bottom 40% accounted for only 3%.

zh: 当不平等性达到新高度时，我们所有人都要付出代价。
en: We all pay a price when inequality reaches new heights.

zh: 在一些经合组织国家，1990—2010年间不平等性加剧造成6—10个百分点的总GDP损失。
en: In a range of OECD countries, rising inequality knocked 6-10 percentage points off overall GDP between 1990 and 2010.

zh: 当最贫困人群无法充分实现潜能时，经济增长就会受到影响。
en: When the poorest people are unable to fulfill their potential, economic growth suffers.

zh: 决策者和政治领导人都在寻找让经济增长更加包容之道，任何方案都必须以城市为核心要素。
en: As policymakers and political leaders look for ways to make economic growth more inclusive, cities will play a central role in any solution.

zh: 经合组织国家调查表明，一半人口生活在500,000人以上的城市中，而自2001年以来，城市贡献了60%的总就业和GDP增长。
en: A survey of OECD countries shows that half the total population lives in cities of more than 500,000 inhabitants, and that cities have accounted for 60% of total growth of employment and GDP since 2001.

zh: 但是，这一增长不是包容性的：所有经合组织国家的城市收入不平等程度都高于国家平均水平，只有加拿大是例外。
en: However, this growth has not been inclusive: income inequality in cities is higher than the national average in all OECD countries surveyed, except Canada.

zh: 在美国，100个最大城市中的95个在大衰退后的五年中就业和经济产出有所增加，但只有20个中位工资有所增加。
en: In the United States, 95 of the 100 largest metropolitan areas added jobs and increased their economic output in the five years following the Great Recession, but only 20 experienced median-wage growth.

zh: 近几年来，经济进步并未让普通工人境况变好，而由于富裕个体攫取了增长的收益，贫困变得更加集中。
en: Economic gains in recent years have not made the typical worker better off, and as wealthy individuals have reaped the benefits of growth, poverty has become more concentrated.

zh: 据布鲁金斯学会的研究，2000年后美国极端贫困社区数量翻了一番。
en: According to research by the Brookings Institution, the number of extremely poor neighborhoods in the US has more than doubled since 2000.

zh: 这带来了巨大的成本。
en: This has far-reaching costs.

zh: 证据表明，在贫困社区中长大会大幅恶化个人生活前景，即使收入保持不变。
en: Growing up in a poor neighborhood has been shown to reduce a person’s life prospects dramatically, even when earnings remain constant.

zh: 而在伦敦和巴尔的摩等大都会地区，相隔数英里的贫穷和富裕社区的预期寿命差距可能高达20多年。
en: And in metropolitan areas such as London and Baltimore, the difference in life expectancy between poor and wealthy neighborhoods just a few miles apart can be more than 20 years.

zh: 城市既是经济机会的集中地，也是经济差异的高发区，我们必须解决城市中的不平等性问题。
en: As the site of both economic opportunity and disparity, cities are where we must look to tackle inequality.

zh: 3月份，经合组织、福特基金会、布鲁金斯学会和其他机构与纽约市长白思豪和其他20个全球城市市长合作发起了城市包容性增长计划（Inclusive Growth in Cities Initiative ） 。
en: In March, the OECD, the Ford Foundation, Brookings, and other institutions launched the Inclusive Growth in Cities Initiative, in partnership with New York City Mayor Bill de Blasio and 20 other mayors from around the world.

zh: 该计划集中了“顶尖市长”制定了一份包容性增长日程，承认市长在创造机会、增加个体和企业生产力方面所起到的关键作用。
en: By bringing together “Champion Mayors” to define a shared inclusive-growth agenda, the Initiative acknowledges the crucial role mayors play in creating economic opportunity and boosting the productive capacity of individuals and firms.

zh: 在最近的布鲁金斯学会活动上，经合组织秘书长古里亚讨论了城市能够着力降低不平等性的四个方面。
en: At a recent Brookings event, OECD Secretary-General Angel Gurría discussed four key areas where cities can work to reduce inequality.

zh: 这些概念将在11月21日的巴黎会议上进一步探讨，会议将由巴黎市长希达戈（Anne Hidalgo）主持。
en: These ideas will be developed further at a meeting in Paris on November 21, hosted by Paris Mayor Anne Hidalgo.

zh: 首先，城市应该加大职业学校投资，让各个年龄段和背景的人都能学到有销路的技能，从而实现包容性教育系统。
en: First, cities should make education systems more inclusive by investing in vocational schools where people of all ages and backgrounds can learn marketable skills.

zh: 比如，亚特兰大市长里德（Kasim Reed）发起了一项由本地创业孵化器、亚特兰大市劳动力发展机构和一所编程学校组成的合作项目，为年轻人提供指导网络，帮助他们发展财务知识和批判性思考能力，同时也教他们写代码。
en: For example, in Atlanta, Mayor Kasim Reed has launched a partnership between a local startup incubator, the city’s workforce development agency, and a coding school to provide young people with mentorship networks, through which they can develop financial literacy and critical thinking skills, while also learning how to write code.

zh: 其次，城市应该确保人人都能就业和创业机会，包括妇女、年轻人、移民和弱势群体。
en: Second, cities should ensure that employment and entrepreneurship opportunities are available to all people, including women, young adults, immigrants, and disadvantaged populations.

zh: 斯托克霍姆在2015年秋至2016年春期间接收了8,000名寻求庇护者，市长万加尔德（Karin Wanngård）正在开发一种新型成人学校。
en: In Stockholm, which took in 8,000 asylum-seekers between fall 2015 and spring 2016, Mayor Karin Wanngård is developing a new type of school for adults.

zh: 作为全面的融合战略的一部分，新学校将教授参与斯托克霍姆就业市场所必须的语言、文化和技术技能。
en: As part of a comprehensive integration strategy, the new schools will teach the language, cultural, and technical proficiencies necessary to participate in Stockholm’s job market.

zh: 首尔市长朴元淳正在通过定向金融支持、更公平的交易和转包规则以及非正式工作转正等手段为中小企业打造公平的竞争环境。
en: In Seoul, Mayor Park Won-soon is leveling the playing field for small and medium-size enterprises with targeted financial support, fairer transaction and subcontracting rules, and informal-work regularization.

zh: 第三，城市必须确保所有人都能在安全健康的社区获得高质量的平价住房。
en: Third, cities must ensure high-quality, affordable housing for all in safe, healthy neighborhoods.

zh: 巴黎市长希达戈实施了“优先认购权”计划，市政府可以收购指定社区中挂牌出售的房产，提供给有可能无家可归的贫困居民。
en: In Paris, Hidalgo’s “right of first refusal” plan allows the municipal government to acquire residences that come on the market in selected neighborhoods so that it can provide them to poorer residents at risk of being displaced.

zh: 最后，城市应该确保公共基础设施和服务 — — 包括公共交通、水、能源、垃圾处理和宽带 — — 人人都能轻松获得。
en: Finally, cities should ensure that public infrastructure and services – including public transportation, water, energy, waste management, and broadband – are easily accessible for all.

zh: 在纽约，白思豪的IDNYC计划为所有居民提供免费的市民卡 — — 包括无家可归者、无证移民和刑满释放人员 — — 从而让边缘化群体也可以使用纽约市的资源。
en: In New York, de Blasio’s IDNYC initiative is providing free government-issued identification cards for all residents – including the homeless, undocumented immigrants, and former convicts – so that marginalized groups can make use of the city’s resources.

zh: 城市包容性增长计划和联合国第三届人居会议等活动有助于逐一解决城市的不平等性加剧问题。
en: Efforts such as the Inclusive Growth in Cities Initiative and the United Nation’s Habitat III conference are helping to turn the tide against rising inequality one city at a time.

zh: 我们越多利用地方解决方案应对共同全球问题，所能取得进步也越大。
en: The more we can capitalize on local solutions for common global problems, the more progress all of us will make.

zh: 拆分花旗集团
en: Break Up Citigroup

zh: 华盛顿—美国总统选战已经上路了。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – America’s presidential campaign is already well underway.

zh: 选举要等到2016年11月举行，目前只有极少数候选人急吼吼地加入其中，但刺激和发展观点（idea）的竞争 — — 不管是公开竞争还是闭门竞争 — — 已经如火如荼。
en: The election is not until November 2016, and very few candidates have formally thrown their hats into the ring, but the competition to promote and develop ideas – both behind closed doors and publicly – is in fully swing.

zh: 本月早些时候，花旗集团利用这一关键的政治时期，抓住一个机会赢得了一次战术胜利 — — 但这一胜利导致了一个战略大错。
en: Earlier this month, Citigroup took advantage of this formative political moment by seizing an opportunity to score a tactical victory – but one that amounts to a strategic blunder.

zh: 用显然是花旗集团自身游说者操刀的立法语言说，该公司成功要求撤销2010年多德-弗兰克（Dodd-Frank）金融改革的部分内容。
en: Using legislative language apparently drafted by Citi’s own lobbyists, the firm successfully pressed for the repeal of some of the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial reforms.

zh: 该提案附于一项最后时刻的支出法案中获得通过 — — 这一战术确保了它基本不会再众议院讨论，绝对不会在参议院讨论。
en: The provision was then passed after it was attached to a last-minute spending bill – a tactic that ensured very little debate in the House of Representatives and none at all in the Senate.

zh: 花旗集团此举既证明了他们在华盛顿仍拥有政治实力，也表明他们想继续承担过多金融风险（这一特别立法变化允许这样做 ） 。
en: At a stroke, Citi executives demonstrated both their continued political clout in Washington and their continued desire to take on excessive amounts of financial risk (which is what this particular legal change permits).

zh: 游说获得承担更多风险的许可正是花旗集团在20世纪90年代和21世纪初在克林顿和小布什任总统期间用过的伎俩 — — 并在2007—09年给实体经济造成了灾难性后果。
en: Lobbying to be allowed to load up on risk is exactly what Citi did during the 1990s and 2000s under Presidents Bill Clinton and George W. Bush – with catastrophic consequences for the broader economy in 2007-09.

zh: 因此，拆分花旗集团正被严肃考虑作为潜在竞选话题。
en: As a result, breaking up Citigroup is under serious consideration as a potential campaign theme.

zh: 比如，伊丽莎白·沃伦（Elizabeth Warren）在一次强有力的演讲中毫不妥协地回应了巨人花旗集团最新的秀肌肉行为 ： “ 让我们通过某些 — — 随便什么 — — 有助于拆分这些巨型银行的东西。 ”这次演讲在网上点击次数超过了五十万。
en: For example, in a powerful speech – watched online more than a half-million times – Senator Elizabeth Warren responded uncompromisingly to the megabanks’ latest display of muscle: “Let’s pass something – anything – that would help break up these giant banks.”

zh: 巨型银行 — — 花旗、JP摩根大通、美国银行、富国、高盛和摩根士丹利 — — 抨击沃伦是左翼民粹主义的化身。
en: Defenders of the megabanks – Citi, JP Morgan Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Goldman Sachs, and Morgan Stanley – dismiss Warren as an avatar of left-wing populism.

zh: 但这是个严重的误导；事实上，沃伦吸引了来自中间派和右翼的巨大支持。
en: But this is a serious misconception; in fact, Warren is attracting a great deal of support from the center and the right.

zh: 路易斯安那州参议员大卫·维特（David Vitter）是国会中支持限制大银行规模和权力的最重要的共和党议员，但还有其他一些人观点与他近似。
en: Senator David Vitter of Louisiana is the most prominent Republican member of Congress in favor of limiting the size and power of the biggest banks, but there are others who lean in a similar direction.

zh: 类似地，政治独立人士、联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）副主席托马斯·霍尼格（Thomas Hoenig）一直在警告巨型银行带来的风险。
en: Similarly, the vice chair of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation, Thomas Hoenig, a political independent, consistently warns about the dangers associated with megabanks.

zh: 前FDIC主席、堪萨斯州共和党西拉·拜亚（Sheila Bair）强烈支持增加措施限制大银行。
en: And former FDIC Chair Sheila Bair, a Republican from Kansas, argues strongly for additional measures to rein in the biggest banks.

zh: 对于任何寻求美国两大政党提名的人来说，这是一个跨越党派鸿沟的话题。
en: From the perspective of anyone seeking the nomination of either of America’s political parties, here is an issue that cuts across partisan lines.

zh: “拆分花旗集团”是一个具体且强力的观点，能让金融体系走向正确方向。
en: “Break up Citigroup” is a concrete and powerful idea that would move the financial system in the right direction.

zh: 它不是万灵丹，但能够拆分花旗集团的联盟也能够采取其他措施让金融体系更加安全）包括更有效的消费者保护、更大的市场透明度和更高的主要银行资本要求。
en: It is not a panacea, but the coalition that can break up Citi can also put in place other measures to make the financial system safer – including more effective consumer protection, greater transparency in markets, and higher capital requirements for major banks.

zh: 在左翼看来，重点是巨型银行对权力的滥用以及对中产阶级的大压榨。
en: From the left, the emphasis has been on the megabanks’ abuse of power and the great rip-off of the middle class.

zh: 在右翼看来，压力在于权贵资本主义风险 — — 因为这些银行获得了巨大的隐性政府补贴。
en: From the right, the stress is on the hazards of crony capitalism, owing to the massive implicit government subsidies that these banks receive.

zh: 但左翼和右翼都同意当前的“花旗集团修正案”所隐含的根本性的不对称：银行家不论输赢都能致富，因为美国纳税人会为他们失败的高风险赌注买单。
en: But both left and right agree on the fundamental asymmetry that the recent “Citigroup Amendment” implies: Bankers get rich whether they win or lose, because the US taxpayer foots the bill when their risky bets fail.

zh: 潜在共和党总统候选人犹豫着没有将这一话题公开化 — — 也许是觉得妨碍他们从华尔街筹集资金。
en: Potential Republican presidential candidates have hesitated to take up this issue in public – perhaps feeling that it will inhibit their ability to raise money from Wall Street.

zh: 但是，在民主党中间，这一机会的诱惑要大得多；事实上，避免与华尔街起冲突也许会给候选人造成问题（希拉里·克林顿大概很认同这一点 ） 。
en: Among the Democrats, however, the opportunity seems to be much more compelling; indeed, avoiding a confrontation with Wall Street might actually create problems for a candidate (as Hillary Clinton may well find out).

zh: 进步变化研究所（Progressive Change Institute）正在运作“大观点工程 ” （ The Big Ideas Project ） ， 人们投票选择他们所认为的最重要的政策议案。
en: The Progressive Change Institute is currently running “The Big Ideas Project,” whereby people can vote on what they regard as the most important policy proposals.

zh: 在“经济和就业”类的前十大观点中有三个与增加大银行约束有关 — — 而对于“拆分花旗集团 ” （ Break Up Citigroup）的支持更是急剧增加（充分披露：该主题由我建议该网站列出 ） 。
en: Three of the top ten ideas under “Economy & Jobs” are about imposing greater constraints on the big banks – and there is a sharp upward trend in support for Break Up Citigroup (full disclosure: I suggested this item for the website).

zh: 这一观点将在民主党初选（将于2016年初进行）中起到很大作用。
en: This idea would play well in the Democratic primary elections (which start in early 2016).

zh: 此外，由于这构成了负责政策的基础，因此也将吸引中间派。
en: And, because it forms the basis for responsible policies, it would attract support from centrists.

zh: 而右翼选民喜欢提供可信的结束徇私（favoritism ） — —乃至赤裸裸的腐败（已成为定义政府高层与华尔街关系的用词 ） — —办法的议案。
en: And voters on the right like proposals that offer a credible way to end the favoritism – if not outright corruption – that has come to define the relationship between the top levels of government and Wall Street.

zh: “拆分花旗集团，结束危险的政府补贴，让市场回归。
en: “Break up Citigroup, end dangerous government subsidies, and bring back the market.”

zh: ”2016年美国总统候选人如能这样说 — — 并且令人信服地这样说 — — 将有很大的当选机会。
en: The US presidential candidate who says this in 2016 – and says it most convincingly – has a good chance of winning it all.

zh: 坐视华尔街登上总统宝座？
en: Wall Street for President?

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 距离下一次美国总统大选尚余两年，也没几个候选人宣布正式参选。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – America’s presidential election is still nearly two years away, and few candidates have formally thrown their hats into the ring.

zh: 但民主共和两党都在努力挖掘究竟哪些议题最能在各自的党内初选中赢得选民青睐 — — 同时也在思考何种议题在2016年11月大选时更有利于全局。
en: But both Democrats and Republicans are hard at work figuring out what will appeal to voters in their parties’ respective primary elections – and thinking about what will play well to the electorate as a whole in November 2016.

zh: 在现阶段两党之间的差异堪称泾渭分明。
en: The contrast between the parties at this stage is striking.

zh: 潜在共和党候选人正就一切议题进行内部讨论，从经济到社会事务无所不包；很难说究竟哪种理念和观点会最终夺魁。
en: Potential Republican presidential candidates are arguing among themselves about almost everything, from economics to social issues; it is hard to say which ideas and arguments will end up on top.

zh: 相比之下，民主党这边的议题也是包罗万象，只有一个最重要的例外：金融改革以及超大型银行的势力。
en: The Democrats, by contrast, are in agreement on most issues, with one major exception: financial reform and the power of very large banks.

zh: 相对于近几周民主党及其同盟提出的针对收入不均问题的三份主要政策建议，民主党内在上述金融议题上的内部分歧显得格外碍眼。
en: The Democrats’ internal disagreement on this issue is apparent when one compares three major proposals to address income inequality that the party and its allies have presented in recent weeks.

zh: 在收入不均上，总统奥巴马（在其政府预算及国情咨文中）提出的策略，民主党智库美国进步中心发布的一份重要报告，以及由知名众议员克里斯·范·霍伦推动的相关理念 — — 议员建议在高收入群体中进行更多转移支付以抵消对中等收入群体更大规模减税所造成的影响 — — 之间都只存在一些小差异。
en: There are only small differences between President Barack Obama’s proposals (in his budget and State of the Union address), those made in a high-profile report from the Center for American Progress, and ideas advanced by Chris Van Hollen, an influential member of Congress. (For example, Van Hollen recommends more redistribution from higher-income people to offset a larger tax cut for middle-income groups.)

zh: 在这种事先打好招呼一片大团结的背景下，民主党大佬们对华尔街的意见分歧 — — 无论是对2010年多德-弗兰克金融改革法案的相关细节还是更广泛议题 — — 就显得格外惹眼了。
en: Against this backdrop of programmatic unity, the difference of opinion among leading Democrats concerning Wall Street – both the specifics of the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial reforms and more broadly – stands out in bold relief.

zh: 在多德-弗兰克法案上，民主党人 — — 包括奥巴马 — — 显然在究竟应在何种程度上坚持自身提出的改革方面存在着分歧。
en: On Dodd-Frank, Democrats – including Obama – are apparently of two minds on the extent to which they should stick up for their own reforms.

zh: 在去年12月，白宫同意了共和党人提出的一项提案，将法案中一条关于限制各美国银行巨头过度投机行为的条款废除（而该提案的文本正是由花旗银行执笔的）
en: In December, the White House agreed to a Republican proposal to repeal a provision of Dodd-Frank that would have limited the risk-taking of the country’s largest banks (in fact, the proposal’s language was drafted by Citigroup).

zh: 但最近这段时间，奥巴马威胁要对任何在金融改革上开倒车的行为行使否决权。
en: More recently, however, Obama has threatened to veto any further attempts to roll back financial reform.

zh: 如今他提出对各大银行的负债征收一小笔税项，希望这能“鼓励银行作出与自身行为对整体经济影响力更为相称的决策，而这将反过来有助于帮助减低引发广泛经济成本的重大违约事件的发生率。 ”
en: And now he is proposing to impose a small tax on the largest banks’ liabilities, which he hopes will encourage “them to make decisions more consistent with the economy-wide effects of their actions, which would in turn help reduce the probability of major defaults that can have widespread economic costs.”

zh: 相比之下，美国进步中心的报告只在很少的篇幅中提到了金融部门改革 — — 在报告作者眼中这类事务似乎不算什么大事。
en: In contrast, the Center for American Progress report devoted very little space to financial-sector reform – in the authors’ view, such issues hardly seem to be a high priority.

zh: 范霍伦却对此相当关心 — — 并提出征收一项金融交易税以减少投机行为。
en: Van Hollen does have some concerns – and proposes a financial transaction tax to reduce speculative activities.

zh: 但有位在全国影响力不断攀升的民主党政治新星，参议员伊丽莎白·沃伦却拿出了一系列提案，极大挑战了上述观点。
en: But a serious challenge to all of these views has now emerged, in proposals by Senator Elizabeth Warren, a rising Democratic star who has become increasingly prominent at the national level.

zh: 在沃伦看来，当局应当直接挑战美国银行巨头们过度膨胀的影响力以及危险的架构。
en: In her view, the authorities need to confront head-on the outsize influence and dangerous structure of America’s largest banks.

zh: 那些反对沃伦的人喜欢将她的提案归结为某种非主流观点；但事实上，她赢得了来自各派派别的支持。
en: Warren’s opponents like to suggest that her ideas are somehow outside the mainstream; in fact, she draws support from across the political spectrum.

zh: 例如在上月试图阻击花旗银行修订多德-弗兰克法案的斗争中，沃伦的同盟来自于众议院民主党首脑，美国独立社区银行家联合会，共和党参议员戴维·维特（David Vitter）及托马斯·贺尼格（Thomas Hoenig ） — —共和党指派担任联邦储蓄保险公司的副主席人选。
en: In last month’s fight against Citigroup’s successful effort to roll back Dodd-Frank, for example, Warren’s allies included the House Democratic leadership, the Independent Community Bankers of America, Republican Senator David Vitter, and Thomas Hoenig (a Republican-appointed vice chair of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation).

zh: 沃伦所传达的信息很简单：撤销政府对那些大而不能倒银行的隐性补贴。
en: Warren’s message is simple: remove the implicit government subsidies that support the too-big-to-fail banks.

zh: 这一举措将最终尽可能减少（如果不能根除的话）裙带资本主义并强化金融部门的市场竞争。
en: That single move would go a long way toward reducing, if not eliminating, crony capitalism and strengthening market competition in the financial sector.

zh: 这是一个受到政治各派欢迎的信息。
en: This is a message that plays well across the political spectrum.

zh: 而沃伦支持率的不断增加也有助于美联储及其他负责任监管者着力防范这些大银行去冒超过警戒线的风险。
en: And growing support for Warren’s ideas helps the Federal Reserve and other responsible regulators in their efforts to prevent big banks from taking on dangerous levels of risk.

zh: 华尔街银行巨头对华盛顿拥有巨大的影响力，这在很大程度上是因为他们手握大笔政治献金。
en: The big Wall Street banks have enormous influence in Washington, DC, in large part because of their campaign contributions.

zh: 他们还支持 — — 直接或非直接地 — — 那些大型宣传机构，圈养一批假装持独立/温和立场的评论员，操纵金融媒体，或者利用智库机构来捏造一些早已定制好的“研究结论 ” 。
en: They also support – directly and indirectly – a vast influence industry, comprising people who pose as independent or moderate commentators, edit the financial press, or produce bespoke “research” at think tanks.

zh: 这些巨头们决心一定要将多德-弗兰克法案尽可能废除，而众议院共和党人似乎也非常愿意助一臂之力。
en: These megabanks are making a determined attempt to repeal as much of Dodd-Frank as possible, and the House Republicans seem keen to help them.

zh: 这可不是一件容易被抹去的重大事件。
en: This is not an issue that will fade away.

zh: 民主党人必须制定好自身针对华尔街的政策。
en: The Democrats need to figure out their policy on Wall Street.

zh: 过去他们只会去追逐竞选经费，用自身的政治资源和影响力作交换。
en: In the past, they have simply gone for the campaign contributions, doling out access and influence in exchange.

zh: 而这种做法在维护多德-弗兰克法案剩余条款的斗争中已经变得不可取了。
en: It is now obvious that this is not consistent with defending what remains of Dodd-Frank.

zh: 沃伦提供了一个具有说服力，温和的替代性金融部门政策方案，而且会在党内初选中占优势并在总统大选中赢得广泛支持。
en: Warren offers a plausible, moderate alternative approach to financial-sector policy that would play well in the primaries and attract a great deal of support in the general election.

zh: 那么民主党人是否又能抓住这一机会呢？
en: Will the Democrats seize the opportunity?

zh: 公民与赤贫
en: Citizens versus Extreme Poverty

zh: 20年前，国际扶轮社领导的草根运动决定行动。 该社为志愿性组织，在200多个国家拥有大约120万会员。
en: Twenty years ago, a grass-roots movement led by Rotary International, a voluntary organization with around 1.2 million members in more than 200 countries, decided to attack.

zh: 到二十世纪八十年代中叶，全球每年发生30多万起小儿麻痹症，但是这种疾病在最富裕国家已消除，这些国家已将接种疫苗列入常规程序。
en: As of the mid-1980’s, there were more than 300,000 cases of polio per year worldwide, despite the disease’s virtual elimination in the richest countries, where vaccination was routine.

zh: 扶轮社接受挑战，向公共健康系统比较薄弱或根本不存在的地区的贫困人口提供疫苗。
en: Rotary took on the challenge of getting vaccines to the poor, in regions with weak or non-existent public health systems.

zh: 扶轮社人不仅希望减少小儿麻痹症病例数量，而且希望完全消除这种疾病。
en: Rotarians dreamed not only of reducing the number of polio cases, but of eradicating the disease entirely.

zh: 这一目标的实现如今指日可待了。
en: This goal is now within reach.

zh: 扶轮社人并非等待政客们奋起与小儿麻痹症作斗争，而是领导斗争。
en: Rather than wait for politicians to take up the fight against polio, Rotarians led the way.

zh: 几年以后，世界卫生组织以及当时其他一些国际机构和捐助国加入了这一事业，创建了目前支持扶轮社愿景的政府机构与私人组织联盟。
en: A few years later, the World Health Organization, and then other international agencies and donor countries, joined the cause, creating a coalition of official and private organizations that now support Rotary’s vision.

zh: 到2006年，小儿麻痹症病例总数急剧下降，每年不到3,000例。
en: By 2006, the number of polio cases had been cut dramatically, to well under 3,000 cases per year.

zh: 完全消除小儿麻痹症为期不远，但依然难以捉摸，因为近年来小儿麻痹症的爆发困扰了一个又一个国家。
en: Complete eradication is in reach, but is still proving elusive, as small outbreaks have plagued one country or another in recent years.

zh: 有些情况下，如尼日利亚北部，社会对疫苗的抵制阻碍了人口接种的覆盖率。
en: In some cases, such as Northern Nigeria, social resistance to the vaccine has blocked adequate coverage of the population.

zh: 小儿麻痹症小范围传播现象在印度、巴基斯坦和阿富汗继续存在。
en: Pockets of polio transmission also persist in India, Pakistan, and Afghanistan.

zh: 在其他一些国家，来自小儿麻痹症尚未完全消除地区的旅行者将这种疾病重新引入。
en: In a few other countries, the disease has been sporadically reintroduced by travelers from regions where polio has not yet been eliminated.

zh: 罕见的情况下，疫苗本身不起作用，导致感染。
en: And, in rare cases, the vaccine itself has failed and led to infection.

zh: 然而，尽管根除最后的病例有困难，诊治小儿麻痹症却由来已久了。
en: Still, despite the difficulties of rooting out the very last cases, the progress made against polio has been historic.

zh: 更为重要的是，扶轮社率先对小儿麻痹症进行诊治为与赤贫、饥饿和疾病作斗争提供了更为普遍的经验教训。
en: More importantly, Rotary’s leadership on polio offers a more general lesson in the fight against extreme poverty, hunger, and disease.

zh: 即便政客不领导斗争，忠于职守的个人和志愿性组织依然可能改变世界。
en: Even when politicians don’t lead, it is still possible for committed individuals and voluntary organizations to change the world.

zh: 关键在于，将大胆的想法与切实可行、功效卓著的技术联系起来，然后将想法和技术通过大规模公民行动推向前进。
en: The key is to link a bold idea with a practical and powerful technology, and then to push the idea and technology forward through mass citizen action.

zh: 同样这些教训适用于《千年发展目标 》 ， 这是与贫穷、疾病和饥饿作斗争的目标，世界各组织于2000年通过。
en: These same lessons can be applied to the Millennium Development Goals (MDG’s), the targets for fighting poverty, disease, and hunger that the world’s governments adopted in 2000.

zh: 《千年发展目标》设想大胆，成效显著。
en: The MDG’s are bold but achievable.

zh: 例如，它们呼吁，到2015年，减少1990年世界人口长期营养不良的比例，削减儿童死亡率三分之二。
en: For example, they call for reducing by 2015 the proportion of the world’s population that was chronically under-nourished in 1990, and for cutting the child mortality rate by three quarters.

zh: 《千年发展目标》还述及产妇分娩死亡、缺乏安全饮用水和疟疾、肺结核和艾滋病等致命疾病问题。
en: The MDG’s also address the scourges of maternal death in childbirth, lack of access to safe drinking water, and killer diseases such as malaria, tuberculosis, and AIDS.

zh: 就像小儿麻痹症一样，与饥饿、疾病和缺乏安全饮用水和卫生设施的斗争可以通过切实可行、成效卓著的技术取得进展。
en: Just as with polio, the fight against hunger, disease, and lack of access to safe water and sanitation can be carried forward with practical and powerful technologies.

zh: 确实，这些技术非常有效，能够使目前陷入贫困的家庭永远解脱出来。
en: Indeed, these technologies are so powerful that they can enable families currently trapped in poverty to escape it once and for all.

zh: 想想非洲的饥荒吧。
en: Consider hunger in Africa.

zh: 大多数非洲农民在小块土地上耕种，打出的粮食不足以果腹，更别说赚取收入了。
en: Most of Africa’s farmers, working tiny plots, do not produce enough food to feed their families, much less to earn an income.

zh: 问题的根源在于，非洲农民太贫穷，无法获得基本的现代化农用物质—包括高产种子、肥料以及小规模水利管理系统—以便他们能够使粮食和经济作物产量翻一番或两番。
en: The root of the problem is that Africa’s farmers are too poor to obtain the basic modern inputs—including high-yield seed varieties, fertilizers, and small-scale water management systems—that could enable them to double or triple their output of food and cash crops.

zh: 因此，解决的办法并不比小儿麻痹症疫苗更为复杂。
en: The solution is therefore not much more complicated than a polio vaccine.

zh: 如果国际扶轮社这类组织能够帮助非洲农民获得50公斤一袋的适用肥料和10公斤一罐的改良种子，农业产量的增长足以缓解极端饥饿，并帮助农户开始获得一些收入。
en: If organizations like Rotary International can help African farmers to get a 50 kilogram bag of appropriate fertilizer and a 10 kilogram tin of improved seeds, the rise in farm output could be enough to relieve extreme hunger and help farm households begin to earn some income.

zh: 这种切实可行的办法可以解决许多赤贫的关键问题。
en: Such practical approaches can solve many of the key problems of extreme poverty.

zh: 同样，想想疟疾造成的死亡和疾病吧，疟疾可以通过使用蚊帐和抗疟疾药物大幅度减少。
en: Consider, similarly, the death and illness caused by malaria, which can be reduced very sharply through the use of mosquito nets for beds and anti-malaria medicines.

zh: 抗疟疾蚊帐仅花费5美元，可以使用五年，可供两个孩子睡眠用。
en: An anti-malaria bed net costs just $5, lasts five years, and can accommodate two children.

zh: 因此，每年仅花0.5美元，每个孩子就能得到一顶蚊帐的保护。
en: Thus, for just $0.50 per year, each child can be protected by a bed net.

zh: 如果孩子在有蚊帐的情况下还感染了疟疾，花1美元治疗就可以将疟疾治愈。
en: And a $1 medical treatment can cure malaria if the child gets infected despite the bed net.

zh: 然而，蚊帐和抗疟疾药物���无法送达需要它们的人们手中，因为需要它们的人都太贫穷了。
en: Yet bed nets and anti-malaria medicines do not reach the people who need them, because the people who need them are too poor.

zh: 幸运的是，美国红十字会和其他组织效仿扶轮社，利用私人捐助和志愿者来填补政治领袖们留下的空白。
en: Fortunately, the American Red Cross and other organizations have been following the Rotary model, using private donations and private volunteers to fill the gap left by our political leaders.

zh: 非洲各地的红十字会与其他组织合作，采用扶轮社分发小儿麻痹症疫苗的方式，免费向赤贫家庭分发蚊帐。
en: Red Cross chapters across Africa, in partnership with other organizations, are now distributing bed nets free of charge to impoverished families, in the same way that Rotary has been distributing polio vaccines.

zh: 该是志愿性组织付出巨大努力通过私人行动实现《千年发展目标》的时候了。
en: The time has arrived for a massive effort by voluntary organizations to take up the MDG’s through private action.

zh: 我们不必等待政客们的行动。
en: We need not wait for the politicians.

zh: 在短期内，世界公民可在与疾病、饥饿和贫穷的斗争中取得长足进展。
en: In a short period of time, the world’s citizens can make deep inroads in the fight against disease, hunger, and poverty.

zh: 然后政客们就会仿效了。
en: Then the politicians will follow.

zh: 关键在于实用、大胆，以及最重要的是，家境富裕的人们自愿花时间和金钱，为全世界最贫穷的人们提供切实可行的帮助的承诺—以高产种子肥料、药物、蚊帐、水井和建造校舍和诊所的材料的形式。
en: The key is practicality, boldness, and, most importantly, a commitment by those who are better off to volunteer their time and money to bring practical help–in the form of high-yield seeds, fertilizers, medicines, bed nets, drinking wells, and materials to build school rooms and clinics—to the world’s poorest people.

zh: 隐性城市财富
en: The Hidden Wealth of Cities

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 世界正越来越城市化，因为越来越多的人选择在城镇和城市中生活。
en: STOCKHOLM – The world is becoming increasingly urbanized, as more people are choosing to live in towns and cities than ever before.

zh: 麻烦的是，多数城市地区均未做好准备管理人口流入。
en: The trouble is, most urban areas are unprepared to manage the influx.

zh: 世界各地的城市面临着迫在眉睫的投资危机，导致这些城市不适宜居住。
en: Cities around the world face a looming investment crisis that makes them less livable than they should be.

zh: 重要社会和经济基础设施的维护，更不用说规划发展，正因为缺乏现金而遭遇延误。
en: The maintenance of vital social and economic infrastructure, not to mention development planning, is being delayed because of a lack of cash.

zh: 随着持续扩大的支出承诺拖累地方政府财政，许多城市的公共资源受到严重的制约。
en: With local governments’ finances burdened by continuously expanding spending commitments, public resources in many cities are highly constrained.

zh: 事情并不一定非得是这样。
en: It doesn’t have to be this way.

zh: 就连苦苦挣扎的城市也拥有一系列商业资产能够借以扭转这样的趋势。
en: Even struggling cities own a range of commercial assets that can be used to reverse these trends.

zh: 例如充分释放利用不足的房地产的公共价值，或者实现交通运输和公用事业资产货币化，不仅可以而且应当成为核心的城市战略。
en: Unlocking the public value of poorly utilized real estate, for example, or monetizing transportation and utility assets, could and should become core urban strategies.

zh: 这并不需要进行私有化，而是要求资产可以产生合理的回报，从而释放出比目前多数城市所拥有的更多的资源。
en: This does not require privatization, but rather that assets could yield a reasonable return, freeing more resources than most cities currently have on hand.

zh: 事实上，通过更智能化的资产管理，城市可以在不增加税收也不削减开支的情况下实现投资翻番。
en: In fact, through smarter asset management, cities could more than double their investments without having to raise taxes or cut spending.

zh: 过去50年，政府拥有大量商业资产引发了观点截然不同的辩论，尤其是在欧洲，但最近美国也出现了类似的情况。
en: For the last 50 years, government ownership of vast commercial holdings has triggered a polarized debate, especially in Europe, but recently also in the United States.

zh: 但将私有和公有对立是一种二分法错误。
en: But private versus public ownership is a false dichotomy.

zh: 最重要的是支持当地经济发展的上述资产的专业管理质量。
en: What matters most is the quality of professional management of such assets supporting local economies.

zh: 编制准确的资产负债表 — — 尽管这种知识十分重要，但却在多数城市欠缺得令人震惊 — — 是朝着采取以管理为中心策略迈出的关键步骤。
