en: But free-flowing rivers are also essential to the health of communities, local economies, and ecosystems.

zh: 据一些测算，如果世界完成所有目前已经开工或规划的项目而不采取减轻破坏作用的措施，这些基础设施将破坏300,000公里的自由流动河流 — — 足以环绕地球七圈。
en: By some estimates, if the world completes all of the dam projects currently underway or planned without mitigation measures, the resulting infrastructure would disrupt 300,000 kilometers (186,411 miles) of free-flowing rivers – a length equivalent to seven trips around the planet.

zh: 我们可以采取更好的办法。
en: There is a better way.

zh: 通过系统规模方法 — — 从整个流域，而不是基于项目着眼看待建坝 — — 就可以更好地预测和平衡各个项目的环境、社会和经济影响，与此同时又能确保社会的能源需要得到满足。
en: By taking a system-scale approach – looking at dams in the context of an entire river basin, rather than on a project-by-project basis – we can better anticipate and balance the environmental, social, and economic effects of any single project, while at the same time ensuring that a community’s energy needs are met.

zh: 大自然保护协会（Nature Conservancy）指出，这种规划方法 — — 我们称之为“水电设计 ” — —有助于各国充分实现流域内的全部价值。
en: The Nature Conservancy has pioneered such a planning approach – what we call “Hydropower by Design” – to help countries realize the full value within their river basins.

zh: 即使是一座大坝，也能改变流域的物理特性。
en: Even one dam changes the physical attributes of a river basin.

zh: 再经由整座分水岭的乘数效应，其影响将大大扩大。
en: Multiplied through an entire watershed, the impact is magnified.

zh: 孤立规划的水电项目常常导致不必要的额外环境破坏；也常常无法实现最大化的战略潜力，甚至可能制约未来经济机会。
en: Hydropower projects planned in isolation not only often cause more environmental damage than necessary; they often fail to achieve their maximum strategic potential and may even constrain future economic opportunities.

zh: 因此，即使大坝能够满足发电目标，也有可能无法实现其他水管理目标 — — 如控制洪水、航船和储水等 — — 的最大化长期价值。
en: As a result, even dams that meet their power-generation goals may fail to maximize the long-term value of other water-management services such as flood control, navigation, and water storage.

zh: 我们的研究表明，这些管理目标每年能给全球经济额外带来大约7,700亿美元。
en: Our research shows that these services add an estimated $770 billion annually to the global economy.

zh: 因此，因为大坝的设计问题而导致它们无法充分实现潜能代价高昂。
en: Failure to design dams to their fullest potential, therefore, carries a significant cost.

zh: 在过去，一些开发者不愿意采取这种战略性规划，认为这会导致延期，实施成本也非常高昂。
en: In the past, some developers have been resistant to this sort of strategic planning, believing that it would cause delays and be expensive to implement.

zh: 但是，大自然保护协会的最新报告《电之河：商业案例 》 （ The Power of Rivers: A Business Case）指出，事先考虑环境、社会和经济风险能够让拖延和预算超支最小化，同时降低诉讼可能。
en: But, as the Conservancy’s latest report – The Power of Rivers: A Business Case – demonstrates, accounting for environmental, social, and economic risks up front can minimize delays and budget overruns while reducing the possibility of lawsuits.

zh: 更重要的是，对开发者和投资者而言，采取全局或系统性的方法能够撬动大坝建设的规模经济。
en: More important, for developers and investors, employing a holistic or system-wide approach leverages economies of scale in dam construction.

zh: 这种规划的财务和发展收益意味着它能够自负盈亏。
en: The financial and development benefits of such planning enable the process to pay for itself.

zh: 我们的测算表明，使用“设计水电”方法的项目能够实现能源目标，带来更高的平均回报率，降低对环境资源的消极影响。
en: Our projections show that projects sited using a Hydropower by Design approach can meet their energy objectives, achieve a higher average rate of return, and reduce adverse effects on environmental resources.

zh: 从现在到2040年，预计将有2 万亿美元的水电投资，明智的规划的收益不可不谓巨大。
en: With nearly $2 trillion of investment in hydropower anticipated between now and 2040, the benefits of smarter planning represent significant value.

zh: 系统规模的水电规划不要求建造商采取全新的流程。
en: System-scale hydropower planning does not require builders to embrace an entirely new process.

zh: 相反，政府和开发者可以将原则和工具嵌入已有规划和监管流程。
en: Instead, governments and developers can integrate principles and tools into existing planning and regulatory processes.

zh: 类似的原则已经应用于风能、太阳能和其他地理足迹巨大的能源资源。
en: Similar principles are being applied to wind, solar, and other energy sources with large geographic footprints.

zh: 完成向低碳未来的转型也许是现时代最艰巨的挑战，如果不扩大可再生能源生产，我们无法取得成功。
en: Completing the transition to a low-carbon future is perhaps the preeminent challenge of our time, and we won’t succeed without expanding renewable-energy production.

zh: 在水电的例子中，如果我们使用更加全局的方法进行仔细的规划，可以既满足清洁能源的全球目标，又保护大约100,000公里原本可能遭到破坏的河流。
en: In the case of hydropower, if we plan carefully using a more holistic approach, we can meet global goals for clean energy while protecting some 100,000 kilometers of river that would otherwise be disrupted.

zh: 但如果我们不停下来审视全局，就有可能陷入“按下葫芦浮起瓢”的困局。
en: But if we don’t step back and see the whole picture, we will simply be trading one problem for another.

zh: 清洁能源新政治
en: New Politics for Clean Energy

zh: 纽约 — — 外交官们去年12月签署巴黎气候协议已经完成了任务。
en: NEW YORK – The diplomats have done their job, concluding the Paris climate agreement in December.

zh: 而政治领袖上周齐聚联合国签署了这项新协议。
en: And political leaders gathered last week at the United Nations to sign the new accord.

zh: 但实施肯定是一项艰巨的任务。
en: But implementation is surely the tough part.

zh: 因为这个问题高度复杂、长期而全球化，政府在处置时需要拿出新的态度。
en: Governments need a new approach to an issue that is highly complex, long term, and global in scale.

zh: 气候挑战的核心是能源问题。
en: At its core, the climate challenge is an energy challenge.

zh: 世界主要能源约80%均来自碳基能源：包括煤、石油和天然气。
en: About 80% of the world’s primary energy comes from carbon-based sources: coal, oil, and gas.

zh: 它们在燃烧时所释放的二氧化碳导致全球变暖。
en: When burned, they emit the carbon dioxide that causes global warming.

zh: 到2070年，我们需要世界经济几乎百分之百无碳，才能避免全球变暖陷入危险的失控境地。
en: By 2070, we need a world economy that is nearly 100% carbon-free to prevent global warming from running dangerously out of control.

zh: 巴黎协议承认这些基本事实。
en: The Paris agreement recognizes these basic facts.

zh: 它呼吁世界各国在本世纪下半叶实现温室气体（特别是二氧化碳）净排放为零。
en: It calls on the world to cut greenhouse-gas emissions (especially CO2) to net-zero levels in the second half of the century.

zh: 为了达到这一目标，政府不仅要制定截至2030年的NDC计划（也就是所谓的国家确定贡献计划 ） ， 还要制定截止本世纪中叶的减排计划（也就是所谓的低排放发展战略LEDS ） 。
en: To this end, governments are to prepare plans not only to the year 2030 (the so-called Nationally Determined Contributions, or NDCs), but also to mid-century (the so-called Low-Emission Development Strategies, or LEDS).

zh: 世界各国政府之前都从未有过在如此紧迫的时间内改造世界经济核心部门的经历。
en: The world’s governments have never before attempted to remake a core sector of the world economy on a global scale with such an aggressive timeline.

zh: 化石燃料能源系统花了两个多世纪的时间才逐步建立。
en: The fossil-fuel energy system was created step by step over two centuries.

zh: 而现在却要在50年的时间内对其完成全面改造，而且涉及的不是少数几个国家，而是整个世界。
en: Now it must be comprehensively overhauled in just 50 years, and not in a few countries, but everywhere.

zh: 政府需要新方法来制定和实行其低排放发展战略。
en: Governments will need new approaches to develop and implement their LEDS.

zh: 有四大原因导致常规政治无法解决问题。
en: There are four reasons why politics as usual will not be sufficient.

zh: 首先，能源系统就是这样：一个联通多部分和技术的体系。
en: First, the energy system is just that: a system of many interconnected parts and technologies.

zh: 发电厂、管道、远洋运输、输电线路、水坝、土地利用、铁路、公路、建筑、汽车、电器等等均须作为一个整体发挥作用。
en: Power plants, pipelines, ocean transport, transmission lines, dams, land use, rail, highways, buildings, vehicles, appliances, and much more must all fit together into a working whole.

zh: 对这样的系统进行改造不能通过小规模的渐进步骤。
en: Such a system cannot be overhauled through small incremental steps.

zh: 深层次的改造需要重新设计整个系统，以确保所有部分能够持续有效运作。
en: A deep overhaul requires system-wide re-engineering to ensure that all parts continue to work effectively together.

zh: 其次，向低碳能源体系转型仍然在技术方面存在许多重大的不确定性。
en: Second, there are still many large technological uncertainties in moving to a low-carbon energy system.

zh: 汽车去碳化应通过供电电池、氢燃料电池还是先进生物燃料进行？
en: Should vehicles be decarbonized through battery-electric power, hydrogen fuel cells, or advanced biofuels?

zh: 能否通过碳采集及储存（CCS）技术提升燃煤电厂的安全性？
en: Can coal-fired power plants be made safe through carbon capture and storage (CCS)?

zh: 核能在政治领域能否被接受，是否安全、成本低？
en: Will nuclear energy be politically acceptable, safe, and low cost?

zh: 我们必须为研发投资制定计划，解决上述不确定性并改善我们可以选择的技术方案。
en: We must plan investments in research and development to resolve these uncertainties and improve our technological options.

zh: 第三，合理的解决方案���要开展国际能源合作。
en: Third, sensible solutions require international energy cooperation.

zh: （像化石燃料一样 ） ， 一个关于低碳能源的关键事实是其生产和使用往往不在一地。
en: One key fact about low-carbon energy (just like fossil fuels) is that it is not generally located where it will ultimately be used.

zh: 就像煤、石油和天然气必须经过长途运输一样，风能、太阳能、地热和水电也必须经过输电线路的长途运输或者转化为风能及太阳能制成的合成液体。
en: Just as coal, oil, and gas must be transported long distances, so wind, solar, geothermal, and hydropower must be moved long distances through transmission lines and through synthetic liquid fuels made with wind and solar power.

zh: 第四，抵制变革的强大既得利益集团无疑存在于化石燃料行业。
en: Fourth, there are of course powerful vested interests in the fossil-fuel industry that are resisting change.

zh: 比方说，这在美国非常明显，共和党否定气候变化的唯一理由是该党大量接受美国石油行业的出资。
en: This is abundantly clear in the US, for example, where the Republican Party denies climate change for the sole reason that it is heavily funded by the US oil industry.

zh: 这无疑是学术腐败、甚至政治腐败的实例（很可能两者兼而有之 ） 。
en: This is certainly a species of intellectual corruption, if not political corruption (it’s probably both).

zh: 能源体系牵涉到如此众多盘根错节的关系构成了巨大的惯性。
en: The fact that the energy system involves so many complex interconnections leads to tremendous inertia.

zh: 因此向低碳能源体系的转型需要周密的计划、充分的时间、专项融资以及跨越能源生产商、分销商、居民、商业和工业消费者等众多经济部门的协调行动。
en: Shifting to a low-carbon energy system will therefore require considerable planning, long lead times, dedicated financing, and coordinated action across many parts of the economy, including energy producers, distributors, and residential, commercial, and industrial consumers.

zh: 碳排放税等政策可以解决某些问题，但上述措施在能源转型中所能解决的问题也仅限于一部分。
en: Policy measures such as a tax on carbon emissions can help to address some – but only some – challenges of the energy transition.

zh: 还有一个问题需要引起关注。
en: Here is another problem.

zh: 如果政府只是提前10到15年、而非30到50年制定计划，那么他们很可能犯下低级的系统性错误。
en: If governments plan only 10-15 years ahead, as is typical in energy policy, rather than 30-50 years, they will tend to make poor system-related choices.

zh: 例如，能源规划者会从煤转向低碳天然气；而对起决定作用的可再生能源投资却可能仍显不足。
en: For example, energy planners will move from coal to lower-carbon natural gas; but they will tend to underinvest in the much more decisive shift to renewable energy.

zh: 同样，他们可能会选择提高内燃汽车的燃油标准，而不是推动朝电动车的必要过渡。
en: Similarly, they may opt to raise fuel standards for internal-combustion automobiles rather than to push the needed shift to electric vehicles.

zh: 在这个意义上，提前30到50年制定计划不仅对作出正确的长期选择至关重要，而且也能促成正确的短期选择。
en: In this sense, planning 30-50 years ahead is vital not only to make the correct long-run choices, but also to inform the correct short-term choices.

zh: 联合国的深度脱碳途径计划表明了怎样对长期计划进行设计和评估。
en: The UN’s Deep Decarbonization Pathways Project has shown how long-term plans can be designed and evaluated.

zh: 上述挑战对当选政治家而言都绝非易事。
en: None of these challenges sits easily with elected politicians.

zh: 脱碳计划需要在30到50年内执行一以贯之的政策，而政治家可能却仅能把握其中1/10的时间跨度。
en: The decarbonization challenge requires consistent policies over 30-50 years, while politicians’ time horizon is perhaps a tenth of that.

zh: 政治家在涉及大规模公共和私人融资、跨经济部门高度协调合作和面对持续不断的技术不确定性做出决策等一系列问题上都面临很大的难度。
en: Nor are politicians very comfortable with a problem that requires large-scale public and private financing, highly coordinated action across many parts of the economy, and decision-making in the face of ongoing technological uncertainties.

zh: 因此，难怪多数政治家都选择回避这一挑战，而且从1992年联合国气候变化框架公约签订后所取得的实际进展就一直甚微。
en: Small wonder, then, that most politicians have shied away from this challenge, and that far too little practical progress has been made since the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change was signed in 1992.

zh: 我认为关键步骤是将上述问题从短期选举政治中移除。
en: One key step, I believe, is to remove these issues from short-term electoral politics.

zh: 各国应考虑设立掌握专业技术且政治独立的能源机构。
en: Countries should consider establishing politically independent energy agencies with high technical expertise.

zh: 当然，重要的能源决策（如是否部署核能或建设新的输电网）将需要公众深度参与，但计划的制定和执行却不应受到党派政治和游说的过度干预。
en: Of course, key energy decisions (such as whether to deploy nuclear energy or to build a new transmission grid) will require deep public participation, but planning and implementation should be free of excessive partisan politics and lobbying.

zh: 就像政府成功给予央行某种独立性一样，他们应当给予能源机构本着长期思考和行动做出决策的更大的回旋余地。
en: Just as governments have successfully given their central banks some political independence, they should give their energy agencies enough leeway to enable them think and act for the long term.

zh: 在下届全球气候会议上（第22届联合国气候变化会议将于11月在马拉喀什召开 ） ， 摩洛哥政府和我所领导的联合国可持续发展方案网络团队将与其他合作伙伴一道共同举办一届“低排放方案大会 ” 。
en: At the next global climate meeting (COP22 in Marrakesh in November), Morocco’s government and my team at the UN Sustainable Development Solutions Network will join with other partners to co-host a “Low-Emissions Solutions Conference.”

zh: 此次会议将汇聚来自联合国成员国、商界和城市的能源专家制定非常实用的深度脱碳方案。
en: This conference will bring together energy experts from UN member countries, businesses, and cities to work on highly practical approaches to deep decarbonization.

zh: 因为巴黎气候协议已经生效，我们的当务之急是必须确保有效的实施。
en: With the Paris climate agreement now in force, we must move urgently to effective implementation.

zh: 气候阿波罗计划
en: A Climate Apollo Program

zh: 伦敦—1961年，美国面临在太空竞赛上被苏联甩开的危险，总统肯尼迪呼吁实施一项计划 — — 即后来的阿波罗工程（Project Apollo ） — —在20世纪60年代末之前将人送上月球。
en: LONDON – In 1961, when the United States was faced with the threat of falling behind the Soviet Union in the space race, President John F. Kennedy called for a program – eventually known as Project Apollo – to put a man on the moon before the end of the decade.

zh: 该计划有着明确的愿景，再加上为它调集的资源和动员的努力，保证了它的成功。
en: The program’s clearly articulated vision – and the resources and effort mustered in its service – ensured its success.

zh: 肯尼迪宣布该计划后仅仅八年，宇航员尼尔·阿姆斯特朗（Neil Armstrong）就在月球的尘土上留下了脚印。
en: Just eight years after Kennedy’s announcement, astronaut Neil Armstrong pressed his footprint into the lunar dust.

zh: 随着196个国家的代表准备在今年年底齐聚巴黎起草应对全球变暖问题的协定，显然我们现在我们需要一个类似的工程。
en: As representatives from 196 countries prepare to gather in Paris at the end of the year to craft an agreement to tackle global warming, it is becoming clear that we need a similar project.

zh: 6月初，我和前英国政府首席科学顾问大卫·金（David King ） 、 前英国石油公司CEO约翰·布朗（John Browne）以及其他几位合作者一起呼吁采取全球阿波罗计划（Global Apollo Program ） 。
en: In early June, I joined David King, a former chief scientific adviser to the British government, former BP CEO John Browne, and several other co-authors in a call for a Global Apollo Program.

zh: 到目前为止，防止危险气候变化的外交努力集中在协调各国的温室气体减排计划上。
en: Until now, the diplomatic effort to prevent dangerous climate change has focused on coordinating national cuts in greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 但真正需要的是增加支出，而不仅仅是更多的协调。
en: But what is needed is more spending, not just more coordination.

zh: 我们所提出的十年计划需要全世界齐心协力在与气候变化的斗争中取得突破。
en: The decade-long effort we propose would require the whole planet to work together to make a breakthrough in the fight against climate change.

zh: 我们的计划寻求在2025年让无温室气体排放的电力成本下降到煤电以下。
en: It would seek to reduce the cost of electricity from sources that do not emit greenhouse gases below that of coal power by 2025.

zh: 为了实现这一目标，加入该计划的各国需要将GDP的至少0.02%用于这方面。
en: In order to achieve this, countries joining the program would pledge to devote at least 0.02% of their GDP toward the effort.

zh: 英国博物学家兼主持人大卫·艾登堡（David Attenborough）这样描述该计划 ： “ 终于，我们有了一个权威、务实而全面的计划，可以阻止正在威胁我们的星球的灾难。
en: David Attenborough, the British naturalist and broadcaster, has said of the proposal, “at last, we have an authoritative, practical, and comprehensive plan that could avert the catastrophe that is threatening our planet.”

zh: ”比约恩·隆伯格（Bjørn Lomborg）因为对传统遏制气候变化方针持怀疑态度而闻名，他认为我们的想法“是更加明智的方针，也更有可能获得实际成功。 ”
en: Bjørn Lomborg, known for his skepticism toward traditional approaches to fighting climate change, has described this idea as “a much smarter approach and more likely to actually succeed.”

zh: 事实上，最常见的建议有诸多有待改进之处。
en: Indeed, the most frequently floated proposals leave much to be desired.

zh: 在巴黎，许多代表将主张给碳定价，大部分经济学家认为这能够引导消费远离碳密集型燃料。
en: Many in Paris will argue in favor of putting a price on carbon, which most economists believe would channel consumption away from carbon-intensive fuels.

zh: 但也有人怀疑这样的政策是否具有政治可行性。
en: But there are doubts about whether such a policy would be political feasible.

zh: 雪弗龙公司CEO约翰·沃森（John Watson）最近指出碳定价根本不可行。
en: John Watson, CEO of Chevron, recently rejected carbon pricing as unworkable.

zh: “这项政策不会有效，因为客户想要的是平价能源 ， ” 他说 ， “ 它们想要更低而不是更高的能源价格。
en: “It’s not a policy that is going to be effective, because customers want affordable energy,” he said. “They want low energy prices, not high energy prices.”

zh: 类似地，发展中世界的国家领导人 — — 大约三十亿发展中国家人民无法获得平价能源 — — 饱受着改善人民生活水平的巨大压力。
en: Similarly, national leaders in the developing world – where some three billion people do not have access to affordable energy – are under immense pressure to deliver standard-of-living improvements.

zh: 他们有可能厌恶提高能源成本的政策。
en: They are likely to shy from policies that raise the cost of energy.

zh: 比如，印度总理莫迪呼吁增加清洁能源的全球公共投资。
en: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, for example, has called for global public investment in clean energy.

zh: “如果我们能够提供平价解决方案，而不是强加选择，会更有可能成功 ， ” 他指出 ， “ 这要求能够获得更多资源和更好的技术。
en: “We are more likely to succeed if we offer affordable solutions, not simply impose choices,” he argues. “This requires access to more resources and better technology.”

zh: 全球阿波罗计划有助于世界减少二氧化碳排放和能源支出。
en: A Global Apollo Program would help the world reduce its CO2 emissions and cut its energy bills.

zh: 太阳能价格已经大幅下降：阿布扎比国民银行（National Bank of Abu Dhabi）指出，迪拜的大规模太阳能装置能够产生可以与10美元/桶的石油进行价格竞争的能源。
en: The price of solar energy is already plummeting: the National Bank of Abu Dhabi has noted that a large solar installation in Dubai could produce energy at a price that would be competitive with oil at $10 per barrel.

zh: 但大规模使用太阳能和其他可再生电力资源还有巨大的障碍，包括对更廉价、更高效的能源储存和转换方法的需要。
en: But there are significant obstacles to the widespread use of solar energy and other sources of renewable electricity, including a desperate need for cheaper, more efficient means of energy storage and transmission.

zh: 目前，全球研发投资中只有2%用于清洁能源；照此速度，我们不可能很快就找到这些问题的解决办法。
en: Currently, only 2% of the world’s investment in research and development is allocated to clean energy; at this rate, solutions to these problems are unlikely to be found anytime soon.

zh: 全球阿波罗计划将让这些投资提高一倍，并协调弥补技术缺口的努力，让我们告别煤炭和其他碳密集型燃料的日子提前。
en: The Global Apollo Program would double these investments and coordinate the effort to bridge the technological gaps, bringing forward the day when we could eliminate coal and other carbon-intensive fuels.

zh: 在最近的德国G-7峰会后，全球最大经济体领导人发布承诺“与其他有意国家齐心协力提高清洁能源研究、开发和示范的总体协调性透明度，突显可再生能源和其他低碳技术的重要性。
en: Following the recent G-7 summit in Germany, the leaders of the world’s largest economies issued a pledge to “work together and with other interested countries to raise the overall coordination and transparency of clean energy research, development, and demonstration, highlighting the importance of renewable energy and other low-carbon technologies.”

zh: “但类似于全球阿波罗计划���项目只有在全球新兴力量（如中国和印度）也跟进的情况下才能取得成功。
en: But an initiative like the Global Apollo program will succeed only if the world’s emerging powers, such as China and India, throw their weight behind it.

zh: 11月的土耳其G-20峰会有机会实现这一点。
en: They will have a chance to do so at the G-20 summit in Turkey in November.

zh: 2015年巴黎联合国气候变化会议必须产生一个协定为全世界范围引入碳定价。
en: The 2015 United Nations Climate Change Conference in Paris must produce an agreement to introduce a price on carbon worldwide.

zh: 但如果没有降低无碳能源价格的协调战略，这一方针就无从奏效。
en: But that approach will not work without a coordinated strategy to reduce the cost of carbon-free energy.

zh: 如果各国将签署全球阿波罗计划作为巴黎协定的一部分，那么这次会议也许将成为人类朝遏制气候变化迈出的一大步。
en: If countries sign up to the Global Apollo Program as part of the agreement in Paris, the meeting might just mark one giant leap for mankind in the fight against climate change.

zh: 洁净的经济增长
en: Cleaning Up Economic Growth

zh: 英国首相布莱尔保证由他主持的，将于7月6-8日在苏格兰鹰阁（Gleneagles）举行的G8会议的主题将会围绕着两个最为重要和持久的问题展开—第三世界的贫穷和全球变暖。
en: British Prime Minister Tony Blair has promised that the G-8 meeting on July 6-8 at Gleneagles, Scotland, which he will chair, will focus on two of the most important and longstanding global problems—Third-World poverty and global warming.

zh: 长期以来，这两个问题似乎就备受争议。
en: For a long time, these two issues seemed to be at odds.

zh: 发展中国家不想为了一种全球性的公众利益而牺牲自身的发展也是情有可原，特别是在美国，这个全球最富有的国家似乎不愿为此牺牲一点点自己奢侈的生活方式的情况下。
en: The developing world understandably does not want to sacrifice its growth for a global public good, especially when the United States, the richest country in the world, seems unwilling to sacrifice even a little of its luxurious life style.

zh: 由巴布亚新几内亚和哥斯达黎加牵头，一群发展中国家已经提出了一个颇具新意的议案，不仅主动承诺限制温室气体的排放，还表明了以何种能促进自身发展的方式来实现这些承诺。
en: Led by Papua New Guinea and Costa Rica, a group of developing countries, a new rainforest coalition has now come forward with an innovative proposal, not only offering to commit to greenhouse-gas limits, but also showing how this can be done in a way that will promote their development.

zh: 长久以来，发展中国家就一直为我们提供着至关重要的全球公共利益：维护全球环境资产。
en: Developing countries have long provided a vital global public good: maintaining global environmental assets.

zh: 他们的雨林是生物多样性的巨大仓库，并且是碳的主要吸收者，能够降低大气中的二氧化碳浓度。
en: Their rainforests are a vast storehouse of biodiversity, and forests are major carbon sinks, reducing the level of CO2 in the atmosphere.

zh: 我曾于1990年代中期供职于气候变化国际委员会（International Panel for Climate Change ） ， 对关于温室气体排放增长规模的科学证据和随之产生的经济和社会影响进行评估。
en: I served on the International Panel for Climate Change in the mid-1990’s, reviewing the scientific evidence concerning the magnitude of increases in greenhouse gasses and their economic and social consequences.

zh: 那时，已经有不容忽视的证据表明一个急需解决的严重问题的存在，而自那以后的数据—如与两极的冰盖快速消融相关的数据—更是强化了这一结论。 约有近1/4的温室气体排放产生于土地使用的改变，其中又以采伐森林为主。
en: At the time, there was already overwhelming evidence of a serious problem that needed to be addressed, and data since then ­­– concerning, for example, the rapid melting of the polar ice cap – have strongly reinforced this conclusion.

zh: 仅这一项所产生的温室气体量就和美国通过燃烧化石燃料所排放的相当。 （美国是全球温室气体的第一大排放国。
en: About a quarter of all greenhouse gas emissions are from land-use change, mainly deforestation, an amount comparable to US emissions from burning fossil fuels (the US is the single largest contributor to greenhouse gas emissions.)

zh: 通过保全他们的雨林，热带国家提供了一项难以计价的全球服务，而这种服务却远没有得到应有的补偿。
en: By maintaining their rainforests, tropical countries provide an invaluable global service, one for which they have so far failed to be compensated.

zh: 但现在，特别是在《京都议定书》的签署之后，我们至少可以确定部分环境服务的价值：碳固定。 （也就是说，如果他们没有保全其热带雨林，大气中碳集中的水平会比现在高出许多。
en: But, especially after the signing of the Kyoto protocol, we can value at least part of these environmental services: carbon sequestration (that is, if they did not maintain their forests, the level of carbon concentrations in the atmosphere would be enormously higher).

zh: 《京都议定书》还催生了一个进行碳排放交易的新市场，如“欧洲排放交易机制 ” ( ETS ) 。
en: The Kyoto Protocol has generated new markets for trading carbon emissions, such as the European Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS). At current carbon prices, the value of carbon sequestration by tropical rainforests likely equals or exceeds the current level of international aid being provided to developing countries.

zh: 生物多样性和气候的稳定性都是全球性的公益。
en: Biodiversity and climatic stability are global public goods.

zh: 环境保护为全世界带来的益处远远超过开发巴布亚新几内亚这样的国家所带来的价值。
en: The benefits of conservation to the world as a whole far exceed the value of exploitation to a country like Papua New Guinea (PNG).

zh: 巴布亚新几内亚政府想要做正确的事情，为子孙后代保全自然资本。
en: The PNG government would like to do the right thing, to maintain its natural capital for future generations.

zh: 但该国的官员则认为他们目前别无选择。
en: But officials there believe that that they have currently no choice.

zh: 在京都（由于种种原因）已经铸成大错。
en: A huge mistake was made (for a variety of reasons) at Kyoto.

zh: 虽然各国培植森林的行动可以获得补偿，但他们防止采伐森林的努力却不能得到补偿。
en: While countries can be compensated for planting forests, they cannot be compensated for avoiding deforestation.

zh: 因此像巴布亚新几内亚这样的国家如果砍掉他们古老的硬木树林再重新种植也许还更划算。
en: Countries like PNG would thus be doubly better off if they cut down their ancient hardwood trees and replanted.

zh: 但这样的做法是不符合经济和社会逻辑的。
en: But this makes no sense economically or socially.

zh: 应该有很好的激励机制以鼓励这些国家保全他们的森林资源。
en: These countries should be given incentives to maintain their forests.

zh: （通常会遇到与监测和衡量标准有关的技术性问题，但是运用现代技术这些问题都可以迎刃而解。
en: (There are, as always, technical issues to be resolved, concerning monitoring and measurement, but these can be overcome easily with modern technologies.)

zh: ）至少像ETS这样的市场应该为限制采伐森林所带来的良性结果授予相应的信用。
en: At the very least, markets like ETS should credit emissions reductions that result from limiting deforestation.

zh: 有人建议等到2012年《议定书》的修正案出台时再应对这一问题。 但我们等得起吗？
en: Without such a program, unfortunately, developing countries have neither the means nor incentives to underwrite conservation.

zh: 以现在森林消失的速度，仅由巴西和印度尼西亚两国所造成的温室气体集中就会抵消《京都议定书》所带来的排放削减量的近80 % 。
en: There are some 2.7 billion people in over 60 developing countries that are home to the world’s tropical forests. Cutting down the hardwood forests – even when they presently receive just 5% of the final price in, say, New York – is the only way people can make ends meet.

zh: 这项新的雨林动议之所以让人印象深刻就是因为它是由发展中国家自己提出的；它代表了提出国的创造性和社会承诺。
en: Some have suggested waiting to address this issue until 2012, when a revised protocol is supposed to come into effect. But, can we wait?

zh: 发展中国家似乎第一次愿意承担欧洲、日本和其他发达的工业化国家（除美国以外）为了避免一场全球性的灾难而已经承担的那种承诺。
en: At currents rates of deforestation, the combined contributions to greenhouse gas concentrations from Brazil and Indonesia alone would offset nearly 80% of the emission reductions gained from the Kyoto protocol.

zh: 例如，哥斯达黎加的经验已经表明一种环境服务（例如保全自然森林资源）
en: What is so impressive about the new rainforest initiative is that it comes from the developing countries themselves; it represents their creativity and social commitment. For the first time, developing countries seem willing to undertake the kinds of commitments that Europe, Japan, and the other advanced industrial countries (except the US) have made to avoid what could be a global disaster.

zh: 的支付体系能够既保持环境又支持经济发展。
en: Costa Rica, for example, has already shown that a system of paying for the provision of environmental services (like maintaining natural forests) can work in ways that preserve the environment and boost the economy.

zh: 为发展中国家提供的这些环境服务进行补偿可以成为一种切实增加援助的方式—而同时，也为这些国家提供了适宜的市场激励机制。
en: Compensating the developing countries for providing these environmental services would be one way of substantially increasing aid – and at the same time, providing these countries with the right market incentives.

zh: 从全球性的观点来看，利用这些资源的最佳方式是保全森林，这甚至可以通过管理下的砍伐来实现。
en: From a global point of view, the best use of these resources is to maintain the forests, which is even possible with managed cutting.

zh: 这是一项所有国家都能够而且应该支持的计划—在贫国与富国之间，在专注于环境保护的国家和致力于经济增长的国家之间—这项计划能把我们都团结起来。
en: This is an initiative around which all countries can and should rally. In a world divided – between rich countries and the poor, between those focusing on environmental protection and those concentrating on growth – this initiative can unite us all.

zh: 八国峰会的领导人们应该从善如流。
en: The G-8 leaders should heed the call.

zh: 清洁技术的光明未来
en: A Bright Future for Clean Technology

zh: 慕尼黑—观察者认为所谓的清洁技术热门时刻已经过去，这情有可原。
en: MUNICH – Observers might be forgiven for thinking that so-called clean technology's moment in the sun has passed.

zh: 在过去两年中，许多清洁技术股指数表现萎靡。
en: Over the last two years, many clean-tech equity indexes have performed poorly.

zh: 在欧洲，欧盟委员会决定在2017年取消可再生能源补贴，太阳能行业遭遇重创。
en: In Europe, solar power took a hit after the European Commission decided to phase out subsidies for renewable energy by 2017.

zh: 2013年太阳能面板安装数量在德国下降近60 % ， 在意大利下降70 % 。
en: The installation of solar panels fell by nearly 60% in Germany in 2013, and by 70% in Italy.

zh: 与此同时，在英国，只有不到30%的清洁能源计划得到了早期风险投资基金的融资。
en: Meanwhile, in the United Kingdom, less than 30% of early-stage venture-capital-funded clean-tech deals were financed.

zh: 真相是这并非第一次。
en: The truth is that we have been here before.

zh: 清洁能源行业的打击只不过是新兴技术常有的周期性现象：兴奋、预期膨胀、整合 — — 最终则是稳定和增长复苏。
en: The convulsions in the clean-tech sector are simply symptoms of a cycle that characterizes emerging technologies: excitement, inflated expectations, and consolidation – ultimately followed by stability and the resumption of growth.

zh: 事实上，在近期发展趋势背后，有迹象表明更加重大的变局正在酝酿：清洁技术将具有商业可行性。
en: Indeed, underlying recent developments are signs of a much more significant transformation: clean tech is becoming commercially viable.

zh: 对清洁技术未来的信心植根于一项需要：为需要支持日益富有的人口的地球找到可持续方案。
en: Confidence in the clean-tech sector's future is rooted in the need for sustainable solutions for a planet that is supporting an ever-wealthier population.

zh: 在未来20年，中产阶级消费者人数预计将增加到三十亿（目前为18亿 ） 。
en: Over the next 20 years, the number of middle-class consumers is expected to rise to some three billion, from 1.8 billion today. Their new lifestyles will require resources, including energy.

zh: 如此需求激增恰逢寻找、开发和开采新能源和资源变得日益艰难和昂贵。
en: This surge in demand will occur at a time when finding, developing, and extracting new sources of energy and resources will be increasingly challenging and expensive.

zh: 比如，在过去12年中，平均油井实际建设成本增长了一倍；与此同时，尽管尽了最大努力，但近几年来新的矿产发现寥寥无几。
en: Over the last 12 years, for example, the average real construction cost of an oil well has doubled, and in recent years new mining discoveries have been few, despite the industry's best (and often expensive) efforts.

zh: 但清洁能源成本却在向相反方向发展，在需求变得日益尖锐的时候 — — 特别是世界上一些最大的发展中城市的需求，解决方案也在变得日益成熟。
en: But clean-energy costs are trending in the opposite direction, ripening these solutions at a time when need – particularly in some of the world's largest developing cities – is becoming acute.

zh: 清洁技术的未来的一个关键问题是它是否需要监管支持才能繁荣。
en: One pivotal question for the future of clean tech has been whether it needs regulatory support to thrive.

zh: 诚然，欧洲取消补贴极大地打击了该行业。
en: To be sure, the withdrawal of subsidies in Europe hit the sector hard.

zh: 但是，即使德国和意大利失去了它们在新太阳能面板安装数量的冠亚军位置，但中国和日本取代了它们。
en: But, even as Germany and Italy lost their first- and second-place rankings in terms of new solar-power installations, China and Japan took their place.

zh: 全球而言，2006年以来太阳能行业以平均每年57%的速度成长。
en: Globally, the solar-power industry has grown at an average annual rate of 57% since 2006.

zh: 监管支持有效地制造了需求，也让可再生能源供给源形成了规模。
en: Regulatory support has been effective in creating demand and allowing sources of renewable supply to reach scale.

zh: 但这些支持并非总是划算的。
en: But such support has not always been economically efficient.

zh: 德国的经验提供了一个教训：监管的猛然变化会造成需求的波峰和波谷，这对于生处于新兴阶段的行业来说毫无裨益。
en: One lesson from the German experience is that sudden changes in regulation can create peaks and valleys in demand that are not helpful to an industry that is still emerging.

zh: 许多市场的最大风险并非补贴和其他支持将被取消，而是监管结构不随着行业的发展而调整。
en: The biggest risk in many markets is not that subsidies and other supports will be withdrawn, but that the regulatory structure will not adapt as the sector develops.

zh: 随着行业的成熟，政策支持的必要性也随之下降。
en: As industries mature, the case for policy support weakens.

zh: 而太阳能行业确实日益表现出能够在没有监管支持的情况下存活下去。
en: And, indeed, solar power increasingly appears to be able to survive without regulatory help.

zh: 繁荣的全球市场十分有利于所有资源的平等竞争。
en: A thriving global marketplace goes a long way toward leveling the playing field across all resource options.

zh: 在过去五年中，数十家太阳能制造公司倒闭，取代它们的是更强大、更创新、更高效的公司。
en: During the last five years, dozens of solar manufacturing companies have failed, only to be replaced by stronger, more innovative, and more efficient players.

zh: 全球累计太阳能光伏产能中有四分之一强是在去年建成的。
en: More than one-quarter of cumulative global solar photovoltaic capacity was installed just in the past year.

zh: 国际原子能机构在评估太阳能前景时向来保守，如今它预计太阳能将在2050年成为世界第一大电力来源。
en: The International Energy Agency, which has been conservative regarding solar energy's prospects, now expects it to be the world's largest power source by 2050.

zh: 尽管如此，关于清洁技术未来的担忧仍让新项目难以得到融资。
en: Nonetheless, concerns about the future of clean tech have made new projects more difficult to finance.

zh: 但创新性新机制，如清洁技术债券和第三方融资，正在改变局面。
en: But innovative new schemes, such as clean-tech bonds and third-party financing, are changing the picture.

zh: 第三方所有机制 — — 即一家公司安装并维护太阳能面板，换取固定月费或每度电价格 — — 促使加州太阳能使用率提高，为2012年和2013年三分之二以上新安装太阳能面板提供了融资。
en: Third-party ownership, in which a company installs and maintains solar panels, in exchange for either a set monthly rate or a fixed price per unit of power, has driven up adoption rates in California, financing more than two-thirds of new installations in 2012 and 2013.

zh: 类似地，老牌行业巨头的新近参与 — — 如戴姆勒和特斯拉的合作以及塔塔控股SunPower — — 正在降低小企业的融资成本。
en: Similarly, new partnerships with large industry incumbents – such as the tie-up between Daimler and Tesla and the controlling stake that Total took in SunPower – are reducing the cost of finance for smaller firms.

zh: 与此同时，清洁技术公司正在日益变得更加成熟而具有创造力。
en: Meanwhile, clean-tech companies are becoming more sophisticated and creative.

zh: 一个围绕使用信息技术降低能源消费的全新行业已经形成。
en: An entire new industry has been created around the use of information technology to reduce energy consumption.

zh: 一些公司，如C3能源公司（C3 Energy ） ， 提供能够分析电力网络以改善电网经营和资产利用，从而增加利润的电力行业软件。
en: Some companies, such as C3 Energy, offer electric utilities software that can analyze their electrical networks to improve grid operations and asset utilization, thereby increasing profits.

zh: 智能电网硬件在过去十年得到了广泛使用，而随着公司开始学会使用大数据和分析工具，它将变得更加重要。
en: Smart-grid hardware has been deployed widely in the past decade, and as companies figure out how to use big data and analytic tools, it will become much more important.

zh: 谷歌以32亿美元收购Nest Labs就是一个很好的例子，证明了公司对这类数据的看重。
en: Google's acquisition of Nest Labs for $3.2 billion is a good example of the value that companies are placing on this kind of data.

zh: 所有这些使得该行业在去年获得3,100亿美元投资（据彭博社计算 ） 。
en: All of this adds up to an industry that Bloomberg calculates reached $310 billion in investment last year.

zh: 这不是一个“利基”市场细分，而是一个正在商品化的资产密集型行业。
en: This is not a “niche" segment, but an asset-intensive industry on its way to commoditization.

zh: 清洁能源正在成熟，并在经营、营销、销售和分销中逐渐采取证明可行的管理实践。
en: Clean tech is maturing and adopting proven management practices in operations, marketing, sales, and distribution.

zh: 该行业正在日益采用让其他行业获得成功的方法，如降低采购成本和使用精益制造原理。
en: Increasingly, the industry is implementing approaches that have ensured success in other sectors, such as reducing procurement costs and deploying lean principles in manufacturing.

zh: 随着清洁技术企业继续壮大，将会有更多的改善机会。
en: As clean-tech businesses continue to scale up, there will be additional opportunities to improve.

zh: 清洁技术行业的下跌幅度很大；但对于新兴技术来说这是常有的事，这样能够淘汰较弱的选手，让该行业更加强健。
en: The shakeout in the clean-tech industry has been tough; but it has also been typical of emerging technologies, and, by weeding out the weaker players, it has made the sector more robust.

zh: 这是一个迎合增长的全球需要的全球细分市场。
en: This is a global segment meeting a growing global need.

zh: 无须怀疑，清洁技术必将迎来灿烂的未来。
en: There is little room for doubt that the clean-tech industry can expect plenty of sunny days ahead.

zh: 过度自信的清算所
en: Clearinghouse Over-Confidence

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 为了降低再次发生2007—2008年金融危机的可能性，监管者如今正在寻求对金融机构的长期支持方案 — — 至少当他们的注意力可以从希腊债务危机、美国国债上限危机以及潜在的欧元区主权债务危机转变为银行债务危机这样的当务之急解放出来之后是如此。
en: CAMBRIDGE – To reduce the chance that a financial meltdown like that of 2007-2008 will recur, regulators are now seeking to buttress institutions for the longer-run – at least when they can turn their attention from immediate crises like those of Greece’s debt, America’s ceiling on governmental borrowing, and the potential eurozone contagion from sovereign debt to bank debt.

zh: 在他们的各项努力中，最重要的便是为金融衍生品（即导致金融危机中AIG和其他机构倒闭的金融工具）设立清算所。
en: Central to their effort has been to bolster clearinghouses for derivatives – instruments that exacerbated the implosion at AIG and others in the last financial crisis.

zh: 但清算所并非万能灵药，它的局限性影响十分深远的 — — 虽然人们经常忽略这一点。
en: But a clearinghouse is no panacea, and its limits, although easy to miss, are far-reaching.

zh: 当一家公司试图保护自己免受货币波动干扰时，它可以通过衍生品减少自己在目标货币上的风险暴露（比如，它可以承诺，若欧元升值，就赔付其交易对手，而当欧元贬值时，则有交易对手赔付给它 ） 。
en: When a company seeks to protect itself from currency fluctuation, it can reduce its exposure to the target currency with a derivative (for example, it promises to pay its trading partner if the euro rises, but gets paid if it falls).

zh: 尽管使用衍生品的公司减少了它在欧元贬值上的风险暴露，但衍生品实际上带来了新的风险 — — 对手方风险。
en: Although the company using the derivative reduces its exposure to the risk of a failing euro, the derivative comes packaged with a new risk – counterparty risk.

zh: 如果交易对手方倒闭 — — 就像AIG、贝尔斯登和雷曼兄弟一样 — — 那么该公司就会遭受对手方风险，即使欧元下跌，它也得不到赔付。
en: The company risks that if its trading partner fails – as AIG, Bear Stearns, and Lehman did – it won’t be paid if the euro falls.

zh: 更糟糕的是，我们看到，当发生金融危机时，如果许多金融机构持有了太多的合约，一条破产传闻就能让某家机构的衍生品交易对手一窝蜂地要求增加抵押品或立刻赔付，从而触发类似于经典银行挤兑的挤兑，接着，挤兑会蔓延到其他公司。
en: Worse, as we saw in the financial crisis, if many financial institutions have many such contracts, a rumor of insolvency can induce all of one institution’s derivative counterparties to demand collateral or payment simultaneously, triggering a run that resembles a classic bank run, which could then spread to other firms.

zh: 为了减少衍生品市场发生挤兑的风险，世界各国监管者准备要求将衍生品交易纳入清算所或交易所。
en: To reduce the risk of runs in derivatives markets, regulators around the world are poised to require that derivatives trades be carried out through clearinghouses or exchanges.

zh: 清算所能带来诸多好处，但并不能如监管者所愿那样包治百病。
en: The clearinghouses will have many advantages, but not as many as regulators might think.

zh: 但是，首要的问题是，监管者如何起作用？
en: But, first, how does a clearinghouse work?

zh: 当需要货币风险保护的公司与银行做了一笔欧元-美元交易后，双方都会把各自的合约交给清算所。
en: After the company needing currency-risk protection makes its euro-dollar trade with a bank, each of them turns its side of the trade over to the clearinghouse.

zh: 公司和银行之间的权利义务关系就成了双方对中间人，也就是清算所的权利义务关系。
en: The resulting obligations between the company and bank become obligations to and from a middleman, the clearinghouse.

zh: 清算所如何保护自己呢？ 它将要求银行存入一笔预存款（假设银行将于2015年破产 ） ， 并监控银行在清算所内的总“账目 ” 。
en: The clearinghouse protects itself by getting an up-front deposit from the bank (in case the bank fails in, say, 2015), and by monitoring the bank’s total “book” with the clearinghouse.

zh: 当银行在一笔衍生品交易中获利时，清算所就会向银行赔付；当银行发生损失时，它将赔付交易所。
en: When the bank wins on a derivatives trade, the clearinghouse pays the bank; when the bank loses, it pays the clearinghouse.

zh: 当清算所的记录表明银行同时与众多对手做交易时，只要交易净结果为零，清算所就不会感到紧张；监管者认为，这样一来，系统性风险就被减少了，因为金融体系不再需要担心如何一笔一笔计算债务。
en: When the bank has many trades on the clearinghouse’s books, the clearinghouse is fine if these trades net out to about zero; systemic risk, regulators insist, is thereby reduced, because the financial system needn’t worry about collecting the debts, one-by-one.

zh: 这固然是正确的，但得能够相互抵消才行。
en: This is true, but only for as far as the netting process goes.

zh: 清算所还能增加透明度，因为它可以向监管者报告其总风险暴露，对于监管者来说，监管一个中央清算所比监管众多不透明的银行容易多了。
en: The clearinghouse also enhances transparency, because it can report its aggregate exposures to the regulator, who is better positioned to regulate a central clearinghouse than to regulate many opaque banks.

zh: 这也能增强金融体系。
en: This, too, this should strengthen the financial system.

zh: 但是，风险 — — 其中不乏系统风险，而且许多还不小 — — 并没有消除。
en: But risks – many of them systemic, and many of them big – remain.

zh: 不幸的是，清算所的结构掩盖了这一点。
en: Unfortunately, the clearinghouse structure obscures them.

zh: 最显然的是，随着大量交易从银行移向清算所，清算所自身将成为具系统重要性的机构，将变得太大而不能到。
en: Most obviously, as many trades move from the banks to the clearinghouse, the clearinghouse itself will become a systemically vital institution. It will be too big to fail.

zh: 同样存在问题的是这样一个事实：清算所及其会员单位可以计算净盈利和损失，从而减少纳入清算所的交易方的风险，但清算所并不能保证消除整个金融体系所面临的基本风险。
en: Equally problematic is the fact that, while the clearinghouse and its participants can net wins and losses to reduce risk for those inside the clearinghouse, the clearinghouse does not assuredly eliminate the basic risk facing the entire financial system.

zh: 通常，这一风险只是被传递给了清算所之外的债权人。
en: Often, it merely transfers that risk to creditors outside the clearinghouse.

zh: 我们来看看原因。 假设某疲软金融机构（比如美国银行）握有两张独立合约，一张的对手是AIG，另一张是花旗银行。
en: Here’s why: Let’s imagine that a weak financial institution (say, Bank of America), has two separate contracts, one with AIG and one with Citibank.

zh: 美国银行欠这两者每人1亿美元。
en: BofA owes $100 million to each.

zh: 与AIG的合约是衍生品合约，通过清算所交易；但与花旗银行的合约类型有所不同，比如属于常规贷款，因此并不经过清算所进行。
en: The contract with AIG is a derivatives contract, which goes through the clearinghouse; but the contract with Citibank is another kind of contract, maybe just a regular loan, and does not go through the clearinghouse.

zh: 美国银行手上还有第三张合约（假设对手是贝尔斯登 ） ， 这张合约通过清算所进行，价值1亿美元，但亏损方是贝尔斯登。
en: BofA also has a contract with, say, Bear Stearns through the clearinghouse for $100 million, with Bear Stearns on the losing end.

zh: 如果没有清算所，美国银行拥有1亿美元资产（贝尔斯登欠它的1亿美元）和2亿美元债务。
en: Without a clearinghouse, BofA has a $100 million asset (the $100 million that Bear owes it) and owes $200 million.

zh: 但它手上只有1亿美元（假如上面的权利义务包括了美国银行的全部资产和负债 ） ， 将赔付AIG和花旗银行各5000万美元。
en: Having only $100 million (if these obligations are its only assets and liabilities), BofA would have to pay AIG and Citibank $50 million each.

zh: 因此，AIG和花旗各自都将损失5000万美元。
en: Each would suffer a $50 million loss.

zh: 如果AIG具有系统重要性，无法全额收回1亿美元将导致它破产。
en: If AIG is systemically vital, its inability to collect the full $100 million could cause it to fail.

zh: 这时清算所可以站出来保护AIG，其与美国银行的盈利合��抵消了贝尔斯登与美国银行的亏损合约。
en: This is where the clearinghouse protects AIG, whose winning contract with BofA nets out against Bear’s losing contract with BofA.

zh: 在这个例子中，清算所消除了三家机构的对手方风险，但只是将风险转移给了花旗银行，后者原本只损失5000万美元，现在，所有的1亿美元损失都要由它来承担。
en: The clearinghouse here eliminates counterparty risk for these three, but only by transferring the risk to Citibank, which, instead of losing $50 million, ends up losing the full $100 million.

zh: 在这个简化的例子中，AIG、贝尔斯登和美国银行 — — 以及它们的律师、游说团和支持政客 — — 都会表扬清算所减少了对手方风险。
en: In this stripped-down example, AIG, Bear Stearns, and BofA – as well as their attorneys, lobbyists, and supportive policymakers – promote the clearinghouse on the grounds that it reduces risk for its participants.

zh: 而且，正如他们所宣传的，清算所确是做到了这一点，但也只限于其会员。
en: And, as advertised, it does — but only for its participants.

zh: 可是，花旗银行现在凭空多损失了5000万，因为它不能算成是清算所的资产。
en: Citibank, however, now loses $50 million more, because it can’t crack into the clearinghouse’s assets.

zh: 如果额外损失把具有系统重要性的花旗银行推上了绝路，那么清算所的所谓减少系统风险的宣传也就不攻自破了。
en: If that extra loss pushes a systemically vital Citibank over the precipice, the clearinghouse has not reduced systemic risk as advertised.

zh: 清算所是否减少系统风险取决于其内部单位和外部单位的相对系统重要性（在我们的例子中，就是AIG和花旗银行谁更具有系统重要性 ） ， 而不取决于清算所减少其会员单位之间的风险的能力。
en: Whether the clearinghouse reduces systemic risk depends on the relative systemic importance of those inside and those outside the clearinghouse – AIG versus Citibank in this basic example – not on the clearinghouse’s capacity to reduce risk among its members.

zh: 在我们的例子中，如果花旗银行告急，且其系统重要性不亚于AIG，那么清算所只是造成了它拯救了AIG的假象，实际上，它只是把风险从清算所转移到了花旗银行身上，并导致了后者的破产。
en: In this example, if Citibank is precarious and is as systemically vital as AIG, the clearinghouse has obscured that it has saved AIG only by transferring risk from the clearinghouse to Citibank, which then fails.

zh: 近期，大量监管活动致力于激活和强化清算所，并要此类金融安排必须经过清算所进行。
en: Much recent regulatory activity has focused on enabling, enhancing, and requiring clearinghouses for these kinds of financing arrangements.

zh: 诚然，清算所能带来诸多好处，包括更大的透明度，更准确的定价以及更好的监管目标，我们要使得这些具有操作性。
en: Yes, clearinghouses offer many benefits, including greater transparency, better pricing, and better regulatory focus, and we should try to make them viable.

zh: 但是监管者高估了清算所的总体好处。
en: But regulators around the world have overestimated their overall benefit.

zh: 许多被认为是减少系统风险的证据事实上只是把风险转移到了他人头上。
en: Too much of what is justified as reducing systemic risk is really just offloading risk onto others.

zh: 气候行动怎样能使美国强大
en: How Climate Action Can Make America Great

zh: 新加坡 — — 气候变化是人类所面临的最大挑战。
en: SINGAPORE – Climate change is the single biggest challenge facing humankind.

zh: 但身为世界第二大温室气体排放国和气候政策关键行动者的下任美国总统不相信气候变化正在发生，或至少不相信人类在其中发挥推动作用。
en: Yet the next president of the United States – the world’s second-largest greenhouse-gas emitter and a critical actor in climate policy – does not believe it is happening, or at least that humans have a role in driving it.

zh: 如果唐纳德·特朗普真的希望“让美国再次伟大 ” ， 就像他在竞选口号中所宣扬的那样，他需要改变自己的态度，并且接受气候议程。
en: If Donald Trump actually wants to “Make America Great Again,” as his campaign slogan declared, he will need to change his attitude and embrace the climate agenda.

zh: 迄今为止，形势看起来并不乐观。
en: So far, the situation does not look promising.

zh: 尽管有大量科学数据的支撑，特朗普依然声称人类活动导致全球变暖缺少证据证明。
en: Despite a mountain of scientific data, Trump claims that there is no evidence that humans contribute to global warming.

zh: 他甚至称气候变化是一个“骗局 ” ， 是中国人的发明，并以破坏美国制造业竞争力为目标（虽然他后来收回了这一指控 ） 。
en: He once even called climate change a “hoax,” invented by the Chinese to make US manufacturing less competitive (though he later walked back that accusation).

zh: 尽管如此，他并未对人类驱动气候变化的整体怀疑进行重新思考。
en: He has not, however, rethought his broader skepticism about human-driven climate change.

zh: 为了反映这种思路，特朗普已经宣布打算取消燃煤电厂的碳排放限制、加快生产化石燃料以及收回对风能和太阳能的支持。
en: Reflecting this line of thinking, Trump has announced his intention to reverse carbon-emission limits for coal-fired power plants, step up fossil-fuel production, and roll back support for wind and solar power.

zh: 他还承诺要让美国退出去年12月巴黎签署的气候变化协定。
en: He has also pledged to pull the US out of the global climate-change agreement concluded last December in Paris.

zh: 这样的倒行逆施或将对应对气候变化的全球努力造成灾难性的打击。
en: Such a reversal would be catastrophic for global efforts to tackle climate change.

zh: 正如美国总统乔治·W·布什2005年拒绝签署气候变化京都议定书造成新一轮排放激增一样，特朗普拒绝履行美国巴黎协议承诺的决定或将促使其他国家仿效。
en: Just as US President George W. Bush’s refusal to sign the Kyoto Protocol on climate change in 2005 initiated a spiral of rising emissions, a decision by Trump not to fulfill America’s commitments under the Paris agreement could spur others to follow suit.

zh: 毕竟，履行国家承诺所需的费用已经让许多国家忧心重重，尤其是在目前经济复苏乏力的时候。
en: After all, many countries are already worried about the costs of meeting their national commitments, especially at a time of sluggish economic recovery.

zh: 而燃烧化石燃料在大部分经济活动中仍然比利用清洁能源更为廉价（如果不考虑相关环境破坏损失的话 ） 。
en: And burning fossil fuels remains, in most economic activities, cheaper than using cleaner energy (when one does not account for the relevant environmental damage).

zh: 当然，从长远看，燃烧更多化石燃料将推升医疗保健成本，并阻碍工人生产率的提高。
en: Of course, in the longer term, burning more fossil fuels will drive up health-care costs and impede worker productivity.

zh: 然后还有日益频繁和严重的气候相关灾害 — — 包括洪水、干旱、风暴和热浪 — — 造成的经济和人力成本，所有这些在世界范围内都呈现出上升的势头。
en: Then there are the economic and human costs of increasingly frequent and severe climate-related disasters – including floods, droughts, storms, and heat waves, all of which are already on the rise worldwide.

zh: 可以肯定，特朗普最近会见了前美国副总统和积极气候活动家戈尔。
en: To be sure, Trump recently met with the former US vice president and vocal climate activist Al Gore.

zh: 尽管如此，特朗普似乎不太可能改变他对气候变化的看法，特别因为他所挑选的内阁成员大多秉承同样的腔调。
en: Nonetheless, it seems unlikely that Trump will change his tune on climate change, not least because the cabinet members he has selected are largely singing the same song.

zh: 好消息是他可能并不需要这么做。
en: The good news is that he may not have to.

zh: 事实上，特朗普可以为实现其他目标而采取行动 — — 从推动美国经济到强化美国全球影响力 — — 但同样也可以推进气候议程。
en: In fact, there are actions that Trump can take for other ends – from boosting the US economy to enhancing America’s global influence – that would also advance the climate agenda.

zh: 上述首要举措是增加对能源效率和储存、可再生能源系统以及小型安全汽车等气候友好部门的研发投资。
en: The first such action is to increase investment in research and development in climate-friendly sectors, such as energy efficiency and storage, renewable-energy systems, and safer and smaller cars.

zh: 在上述领域实现技术突破 — — 美国最有能力实现这种突破 — — 或将对商业发展产生重大的影响。
en: Technological breakthroughs in these areas – which the US is particularly qualified to realize – would be great for business.

zh: 而建立高科技生产和高效能源部门或将成为特朗普兑现为美国人创造大量工作岗位的竞选承诺的最佳机会。
en: And building high-tech production and efficient energy sectors may be Trump’s best chance of fulfilling his campaign promise to create a large number of jobs for Americans.

zh: 尽管特朗普非常希望振兴对其竞选获胜发挥重要作用的所谓铁锈地带的钢铁和煤炭部门，但这几乎是不可能的（就像从国外带回大量制造业岗位一样 ） 。
en: As much as Trump might like to revive steel and coal in the so-called Rust Belt states that were crucial to his electoral victory, that is likely impossible (as is bringing back large numbers of manufacturing jobs from abroad).

zh: 事实上， 煤电已经在逐步退出美国历史舞台，因为健康和环境（不仅限于气候）等领域的关注迫使这些州关闭工厂。
en: Indeed, coal power is already on its way out in the US, as health and environmental (not just climate) concerns force plants to shut down.

zh: 此外，天然气产量处于历史高位；其在发电领域33%的占比现在已经把煤炭甩在身后。
en: Natural-gas production, meanwhile, is at an all-time high; its 33% share in power generation now exceeds that of coal.

zh: 可再生能源和核电同样在不断增长，这一趋势几乎肯定还远未结束。
en: Renewable-energy sources and nuclear power are also on the rise, a trend that is almost certain to continue.

zh: 为创造铁锈地带复兴，特朗普必须利用这种趋势，推进更加节能创新的方法，上述方法与支持加利福尼亚和纽约经济增长的策略是十分相似的。
en: To create a Rust Belt revival, Trump must capitalize on these trends, advancing a more innovative, energy-efficient approach, much like the one that is helping to support growth in the economies of California and New York.

zh: 特朗普可以通过巩固建筑规范中的能源效率来强化动态盈利节能工业的进步。
en: Trump could reinforce progress in dynamic and profitable energy-efficient industries by entrenching energy efficiency in construction codes.

zh: 新建筑和其他基础设施应当采用节能照明（包括更好地利用阳光 ） 、 采暖和空调系统。
en: New buildings and other infrastructure should feature energy-efficient lighting (including better use of sunlight), heating, and air conditioning.

zh: 通过改造现有建筑实现更有效的能源利用也能带来巨大的回报。
en: There are also huge payoffs from retrofitting existing buildings for more efficient energy use.

zh: 保持和加强美国的国际影响力可能是说服气候怀疑论者特朗普支持气候行动进步的一个关键理由。
en: There is one more key reason why Trump, the climate-skeptic, might be convinced to sustain progress on climate action: preserving and enhancing America’s international influence.

zh: 其他著名的全球领袖 — — 包括中国主席习近平、印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪和德国总理默克尔 — — 已经对污染和环境退化造成的破坏深表关注。
en: Other prominent global leaders – including Chinese President Xi Jinping, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, and German Chancellor Angela Merkel – have expressed concern about the devastation caused by pollution and environmental degradation.

zh: 如果美国否认在这一领域的领导作用，就可能面临相当大的信誉损失。
en: If the US repudiates its leadership role in this area, it risks considerable reputational damage.

zh: 全球气候领导责任将要求美国首先兑现其巴黎承诺。
en: Global climate leadership will require the US, first and foremost, to fulfill its Paris commitments.

zh: 特朗普坚持美国清洁能源计划非常重要，该计划确立了各州逐步减少碳排放目标，即到2030年将发电产生的国内排放相比2005年减少1/3。
en: It is vital that Trump upholds America’s Clean Power Plan, which establishes state-by-state targets for carbon-emissions reductions, with the goal of lowering national emissions from electricity generation by one-third relative to their 2005 level by 2030.

zh: 延长可再生能源生产者和消费者的税收抵免将对实现这一目标产生极大的帮助。
en: The extension of tax credits for renewable-energy producers and consumers would go a long way toward advancing this goal.

zh: 但即便实现巴黎协议制定的目标也不足以避免全球温度的灾难性升高。
en: But even achieving the Paris agreement’s goals will not be enough to avert a catastrophic rise in global temperature.

zh: 我们必须通过推动清洁能源、清洁交通和清洁工业超额完成目标。
en: We must overshoot our targets by advancing clean energy, clean transport, and clean industry.

zh: 要想做到这一点，美国的专业技术和领悟能力将发挥不可或缺的作用。
en: For that, American know-how and savvy will be indispensable.

zh: 特朗普已经希望投资于能源和基础设施建设。
en: Trump already wants to invest in energy and infrastructure.

zh: 如果他能以对气候友好的方式来推进这项工作，美国将会获得巨大的利益 — — 同样获益巨大的还有世界其他各国。
en: If he does so in a climate-friendly way, the US will reap enormous benefits – and so will the rest of the world.

zh: 如果这位前身是商业巨头的总统没有意识到气候变化所造成的危害，他至少应当在看到巨大的商业机会时抓住它。
en: If the mogul-turned-president does not recognize the threat that climate change poses, he should at least be able to recognize a tremendous business opportunity when he sees one.

zh: 守住1.5°C 的气候变化临界值
en: In Defense of the 1.5°C Climate Change Threshold

zh: 马尼拉 — — 今天的地球气温比前工业化时代高1°C，并且可怕的发烧症状已经显露出来了。
en: MANILA – The Earth today is more than 1°C hotter than it was in pre-industrial times, and the terrible symptoms of its fever are already showing.

zh: 仅今年一年，接连不断的飓风就已经摧毁了加勒比群岛，季风所引发的洪水已导致南亚数千万人流离失所，而且大火在几乎每一个洲尽情肆虐。
en: This year alone, back-to-back hurricanes have devastated Caribbean islands, monsoon flooding has displaced tens of millions in South Asia, and fires have raged on nearly every continent.

zh: 将地球从崩溃的边缘拉回来已经是十万火急的任务。
en: Pulling the planet back from the brink could not be more urgent.

zh: 我们生活在气候变化前沿的人 — — 包括群岛、小岛、沿海低地以及快速荒漠化的平原 — — 绝不能坐视气候变暖升级会带来哪些后果。
en: Those of us who live on the front lines of climate change – on archipelagos, small islands, coastal lowlands, and rapidly desertifying plains – can’t afford to wait and see what another degree of warming will bring.

zh: 已经有太多生命和谋生手段正在我们面前消失掉。
en: Already, far too many lives and livelihoods are being lost.

zh: 人们无家可归，重要的资源正日益稀缺，而那些对气候变化最没有责任的人却正在承受最严重的后果。
en: People are being uprooted, and vital resources are becoming increasingly scarce, while those suffering the most severe consequences of climate change are also among those who have done the least to cause it.

zh: 正因如此，菲律宾人利用担任气候变迁脆弱国家论坛（CVF）轮值主席国的机会 — — 该论坛的48个成员国在承受气候变化冲击时首当其冲 — — 竭力确保实现2015年巴黎气候协定明确限制全球温度比前工业化时期高1.5°C的目标。
en: That is why the Philippines used its chairmanship of the Climate Vulnerable Forum (CVF) – an alliance of the 48 countries that stand to bear the brunt of climate change – to fight to ensure that the 2015 Paris climate agreement aimed explicitly to cap global warming at 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.

zh: 对我们而言， 1.5°C绝不仅仅是国际协定中象征性或“梦寐以求”的数字；而是摆在面前的生存限度。
en: For us, 1.5°C isn’t merely a symbolic or “aspirational” number to be plugged into international agreements; it is an existential limit.

zh: 如果全球气温高于这个水平，那么我们称之为家的地方 — — 还有这个星球上其他很多家园 — — 都会变得不再适宜居住甚至彻底消失掉。
en: If global temperatures rise above that level, the places we call home – and many other homes on this planet – will become uninhabitable or even disappear completely.

zh: 2009年当我们首次提出1.5°C的目标时，我们遇到的阻力很大。
en: When we first introduced the 1.5°C target back in 2009, we met substantial resistance.

zh: 气候变化否定者 — — 那些拒绝相信人为造成全球变暖这一科学事实的人 — — 继续否定防止地球温度升高的作用，认为这样做既徒劳无功又毫无必要。
en: Climate-change deniers – those who refuse to believe the science of human-induced global warming – continue to dismiss any such effort to stem the rise in the planet’s temperature as futile and unnecessary.

zh: 但就连善意的气候变化倡导者和决策者往往也反对 1.5°C的目标，他们认为根据科学，人类已经排放的温室气体已经使得该目标几乎不可能实现了。
en: But even well-meaning climate advocates and policymakers often opposed the 1.5°C target, arguing that, according to the science, humans had already emitted enough greenhouse gases to make meeting that goal virtually impossible.

zh: 不过在这方面，科学的结论并不像看上去那样明确。
en: Yet, on this front, the science is not as clear-cut as it might have seemed.

zh: 《自然》杂志最近一篇论文显示，世界剩余的“碳预算 ” — —也就是我们在跨过1.5°C的临界值之前还可以排放的二氧化碳量 — — 在某种程度上比之前想象的要多。
en: According to a recent paper published in Nature, the world’s remaining “carbon budget” – the amount of carbon-dioxide equivalents we can emit before breaching the 1.5°C threshold – is somewhat larger than was previously thought.

zh: 与某些评论人士（而非科学家）不同的是，这一发现并非自满的理由。
en: This finding is no reason for complacency, as some commentators (not scientists) seem to think.

zh: 这并不意味着以前的气候模式过于危言耸听，或者我们在控制全球变暖的问题上可以有某种程度的放松。
en: It does not mean that previous climate models were excessively alarmist, or that we can take a more relaxed approach to reining in global warming.

zh: 相反，这篇论文应当激励 — — 并且在事实上呼吁 — — 采取更加直接、深思熟虑和积极的行动，以确保温室气体排放在几年内达到峰值，并力争在本世纪中叶实现零净排放。
en: Instead, the paper should inspire – and, indeed, calls for – more immediate, deliberate, and aggressive action to ensure that greenhouse-gas emissions peak within a few years and net-zero emissions are achieved by mid-century.

zh: 这究竟是一次什么样的行动？
en: What would such action look like?

zh: 全球排放每年要减少4~6 % ， 直至实现零排放。
en: Global emissions would need to be reduced by 4-6% every year, until they reached zero.

zh: 与此同时，我们必须恢复森林和耕地，以便捕获和隔离更多的二氧化碳排放。
en: Meanwhile, forest and agricultural lands would have to be restored, so that they could capture and sequester greater amounts of carbon dioxide.

zh: 在40年内实现能源和交通系统彻底去碳化需要付出巨大的努力，但却是可能实现的目标。
en: Fully decarbonizing our energy and transportation systems in four decades will require a herculean effort, but it is not impossible.

zh: 除环境后果外，这样的努力也将带来巨大的经济效益，其中包括通过促进创造就业机会帮助发达国家中产阶级并促使发展中国家数亿人摆脱贫困。
en: Beyond their environmental consequences, such efforts would generate major economic gains, boosting the middle class in developed countries and pulling hundreds of millions out of poverty in the developing world, including by fueling job creation.

zh: 能源转型将大大提高节能效率，同时提高发展中国家，尤其是脆弱地区的基础设施、供应链和城市服务弹性。
en: The energy transition will lead to massive efficiency savings, while improving the resilience of infrastructure, supply chains, and urban services in developing countries, particularly those in vulnerable regions.

zh: 联合国开发计划署去年发布的一份报告显示，保持 1.5°C的临界值和创造低碳经济与世界延续当前的政策和减排承诺相比，将使全球GDP增加12万亿美元。
en: According to a report published last year by the United Nations Development Programme, maintaining the 1.5°C threshold and creating a low-carbon economy would add as much as $12 trillion to global GDP, compared to a scenario in which the world sticks to current policies and emissions-reduction pledges.

zh: 声称 1.5°C目标可以实现的论文是由广受尊敬的气候专家撰写，并在经过广泛的同行审议后在一家一流杂志上发表。
en: The paper asserting that the 1.5°C target is achievable was written by well-respected climate experts and published in a top-ranking journal after extensive peer review.

zh: 但这仅仅是一篇论文；了解我们限制全球变暖的能力还有许多工作要做。
en: But it is just one paper; there is still a lot more to learn about our capacity to limit global warming.

zh: 顶尖科学家因此已经在探讨和争论相关发现；他们的回应文章同样将发表在一流杂志上。
en: That is why top scientists are already discussing and debating its findings; their responses will also be published in top journals.

zh: 这就是科学研究的运作方式，也是我们相信气候科学的理由 — — 我们同样相信它的紧急警告。
en: That is how scientific research works, and it is why we can trust climate science – and its urgent warnings.

zh: 明年，政府间气候变化委员会将出版有关1.5°C目标的科学分析荟萃，这很有可能成为对类似研究成果最全面的汇总。
en: Next year, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change will publish its own meta-analysis of all of the science related to the 1.5°C target, in what promises to be the most comprehensive summary of such research.

zh: 但我们不能坐等分析结果出来才采取行动。
en: But we cannot afford to wait for that analysis before taking action.

zh: 去年召开的联合国马拉喀什气候变化大会上，气候变迁脆弱国家论坛成员国已经承诺通过尽快完成向100%可再生能源转型的目标来做好本职工作。
en: The members of the CVF have already committed to doing our part, pledging at last year’s UN Climate Change Conference in Marrakech to complete the transition to 100% renewable energy as soon as possible.

zh: 我们的排放已经是世界最小，但我们的气候目标却在全世界最雄心勃勃。
en: Our emissions are already among the world’s smallest, but our climate targets are the world’s most ambitious.

zh: 但世界能否最终遏制气候变化将取决于当前及历史最大温室气体排放国是否愿意履行道德及伦理责任并强力采取行动。
en: But whether the world manages to curb climate change ultimately will depend on the willingness of the largest current and historical emitters of greenhouse gases to fulfill their moral and ethical responsibility to take strong action.

zh: 全球温度变化保持在1.5°C以下现在在地球物理学上也许还不是不可能完成的任务。
en: Keeping global temperatures below 1.5°C may not yet be a geophysical impossibility.

zh: 但为实现这一目标，我们必须保证人们不认为它在政治和经济上是不可能的。
en: But, to meet the target, we must ensure that it is not treated as a political and economic impossibility, either.

zh: 50年的气候犹疑
en: Fifty Years of Climate Dithering

zh: 悉尼 — — 1965年11月，美国总统林登·约翰逊拿到了有史以来第一份警告大量燃烧化石燃料可能带来危险的政府报告。
en: SYDNEY – In November 1965, US President Lyndon B. Johnson was presented with the first-ever government report warning of the dangers that could result from burning large amounts of fossil fuels.

zh: 五十年在政治领域是相当长的时限，因此政府自那以后一切照旧、几乎未采取任何措施解决危机就愈加的引人注目。
en: Fifty years is a long time in politics, so it is remarkable how little has been done since then to address the threat posed by carrying on with business as usual.

zh: 约翰逊的科学顾问委员会极有先见之明地警告说向大气中排放二氧化碳将引发全球气温升高，从而导致冰盖融化和海平面迅速升高。
en: In remarkably prescient language, Johnson’s scientific advisory committee warned that releasing carbon dioxide into the atmosphere would lead to higher global temperatures, causing ice caps to melt and sea levels to rise rapidly.

zh: “人类在不知不觉中进行了一次超大规模的地球物理实验 ， ” 科学家们警告道。
en: “Man is unwittingly conducting a vast geophysical experiment,” warned the scientists.

zh: “人类在短短几代人时间里燃烧了过去5亿年地球缓慢积累的化石燃料 . . . 二氧化碳含量升高引发的气候变化可能会给人类带来不小的损害 ” 。
en: “Within a few generations he is burning the fossil fuels that slowly accumulated in the earth over the past 500 million years…The climatic changes that may be produced by the increased CO2 content could be deleterious from the point of view of human beings.”

zh: 该委员会的先见之明并不出人意料；自从1824年法国物理学家约瑟夫·傅立叶提出地球大气就像绝缘体般捕获本该散失的热量后，科学就一直承认温室效应的存在。
en: The committee’s foresight is not surprising; the existence of the greenhouse effect had been known to science since the French physicist Joseph Fourier suggested in 1824 that the earth’s atmosphere was acting as an insulator, trapping heat that would otherwise escape.

zh: 而在1859年爱尔兰物理学家约翰·廷德尔通过实验室实验证明二氧化碳具有增温能力后，瑞典物理学家兼诺贝尔奖得主斯万特·阿累尼乌斯就预言烧煤会温暖整个地球 — — 他将此视之为一种积极的现象。
en: And in 1859, the Irish physicist John Tyndall carried out laboratory experiments that demonstrated the warming power of CO2, leading the Swedish physicist and Nobel Laureate Svante Arrhenius to predict that burning coal would warm the earth – which he saw as a potentially positive development.

zh: 约翰逊的顾问绝非如此盲目乐观。
en: Johnson’s advisers were not so Pollyannaish.

zh: 他们的报告准确地预测了20世纪大气中的二氧化碳含量将增长近25 % （ 实际数字为26 % ） 。
en: Their report accurately predicted that the amount of CO2 in the atmosphere would increase by close to 25% over the course of the twentieth century (the actual number was 26%).

zh: 今天，空气中二氧化碳的浓度比工业革命初期提高了近40 % — —根据南极冰盖的钻探记录，毫无疑问已经达到了过去一百万年来的峰值。
en: Today, the atmospheric concentration of CO2 is 40% higher than it was at the beginning of the Industrial Revolution – by far the highest it has been during the past one million years, as we know from drilling into the Antarctic ice.

zh: 此外，约翰逊的科学委员会驳斥了否认气候变化危险者今天仍在使用的反对意见，包括声称自然过程可能导致二氧化碳水平升高。
en: Furthermore, Johnson’s scientific committee rebutted objections that continue to be used today by those who deny the dangers of climate change, including the claim that natural processes might be behind the rise in CO2 levels.

zh: 通过证明只有约半数燃烧化石燃料产生的二氧化碳残留在空气中，该委员会证明了地球并非温室气体的来源，而只是作为吸收器，吸收了人类半数的二氧化碳排放。
en: By showing that only about half of the CO2 produced by burning fossil fuels remains in the atmosphere, the committee proved that the earth acts not as a source of greenhouse gases, but as a sink, soaking up half of our emissions.

zh: 约翰逊内阁顾问无法提供大气中二氧化碳升高会对全球气温造成多大影响的具体预测；他们说做出上述预测首先需要更完善的模型和更强大的电脑。
en: What Johnson’s advisers could not do was offer specific predictions for how much the rise in atmospheric CO2 would affect global temperature; they said they would first need better models and more powerful computers.

zh: 上述计算为下一份里程碑式的报告奠定了基础，这就是美国国家科学院1979年提交的“二氧化碳与气候：科学评估”报告。
en: Those calculations formed the basis of the next landmark report, the 1979 “Carbon Dioxide and Climate: A Scientific Assessment,” prepared by the US National Academy of Sciences.

zh: 这份报告以主要起草者朱尔·查尼（来自麻省理工）的名字命名，堪称为严谨科学探讨的典范，被外界称之为查尼报告。
en: Widely known as the Charney Report – after its lead author, Jule Charney of MIT – it is a model of careful scientific deliberation.

zh: 查尼报告估计大气中二氧化碳含量翻倍将使地球升温约3摄氏度 — — 该预测的准确性今天已经得到了证实。
en: Charney’s report estimated that doubling the amount of CO2 in the atmosphere would warm the earth by about 3° Celsius – a number that is well confirmed today.

zh: 报告还预测海洋热容量将使全球变暖推迟数十年。
en: It also predicted that the heat capacity of the oceans would delay warming by several decades.

zh: 这两项结果都与该报告披露后所观察到的全球变暖情况相符。
en: Both findings are consistent with the global warming observed since the report’s publication.

zh: “我们尝试但一直无法找到任何被忽略或低估的物理效应，可以将目前估测的全球变暖 . . . 控制在可以忽略不计的程度 ， ” 该报告最后说。
en: “We have tried but have been unable to find any overlooked or underestimated physical effects that could reduce the currently estimated global warming … to negligible proportions,” the report concluded.

zh: 之后，全球变暖的科学证据越来越牢固；今天，这两份早期报告中做出的基本结论得到了97%以上气候科学家的赞同。
en: Since then, the scientific evidence has only gotten stronger; today, the basic findings laid out in these two early reports are supported by more than 97% of climate scientists.

zh: 尽管50年来科学共识不断增加，但地球变暖的势头却丝毫没有减弱。
en: And yet, despite 50 years of growing scientific consensus, the warming of the earth continues unabated.

zh: 资金雄厚的游说团体已经在公众心目中播下了怀疑的种子，并成功淡化了上述威胁有多么紧迫。
en: Well-funded lobby groups have sowed doubt among the public and successfully downplayed the urgency of the threat.

zh: 此外，地缘政治阻碍了制定有效的全球对策。
en: Meanwhile, geopolitics has impeded the development of an effective global response.

zh: 195个参与国达成一致的要求也阻碍了十一、十二月巴黎联合国气候变化大会上预期将因协议的签署而达到高潮的国际气候谈判。
en: The international climate negotiations that are expected to culminate in an agreement at the United Nations Climate Change Conference in Paris in November and December have been hampered by the requirement of consensus among the 195 countries participating.

zh: 如果不采取行动，数十亿人将因旱灾、农作物歉收和极端天气而受害。
en: If action is not taken, billions of people will suffer the consequences of drought, crop failure, and extreme weather.

zh: 最终，海平面上升将淹没沿海大城市和摧毁整个岛国。
en: Eventually, rising sea levels will flood large coastal cities and destroy entire island states.

zh: 十九世纪有记录以来最炎热的年份是2005、2010和2014，而去年的纪录几乎肯定会在今年被再次打破。
en: The hottest years since record-keeping began in the nineteenth century were 2005, 2010, and 2014, and last year’s record will almost certainly be broken again this year.

zh: 世界领导人是时候结束50年的瞻前顾后。
en: It is time that world leaders put an end to 50 years of dithering.

zh: 他们必须抓住在巴黎的机会，将短期利益搁置一边，最后为避免迫在眉睫的星球灾难而果断采取行动。
en: They must seize the opportunity in Paris, set aside their short-term interests, and finally act decisively to avert a looming planetary catastrophe.

zh: 应对气候变化对健康的益处
en: The Health Benefits of Fighting Climate Change

zh: 利马 — — 政府往往认为气候变化的解决成本太过昂贵。
en: LIMA – Governments often see climate change as too costly to address.

zh: 事实却是气候变化代价太高、不容忽视。
en: In fact, it is too costly to ignore.

zh: 这解释了为什么世卫组织（WHO ） ， 举例来讲，将预防灾难性气候变化与减少空气污染所带来的“直接健康效益和成本节约”联系在一起。
en: That is why the World Health Organization (WHO), for example, has linked the prevention of disastrous climate change to “immediate health benefits and health cost savings” from the reduction of air pollution.

zh: 统计数据反应的情况异常严峻。
en: The statistics are grim.

zh: 空气污染2012年造成七百多万人早亡 — — 占全球早亡人数的八分之一，而烟草造成的早亡人数也才不到六百万而已。
en: Air pollution caused more than seven million premature deaths – one in eight globally – in 2012, compared to nearly six million premature deaths from tobacco.

zh: 最大的损害来源是人们所说的PM2.5微粒，这种微粒直径还不到2.5微米。
en: One of the biggest causes of harm are the fine particles called PM2.5, with a diameter of less than 2.5 micrometers.

zh: 它们能够深入肺部造成极大的破坏，诱发炎症、癌症、呼吸道感染，或者通过进入血液诱发血管变化，诱使心脏病和中风发作。
en: They wreak havoc by traveling deep into the lungs, contributing to inflammation, cancer, and respiratory infection, or by passing into the bloodstream, where they can trigger changes in blood vessels that cause heart attacks and strokes.

zh: 燃烧柴油和煤同是大气污染的主要原因，约有370万人死于户外烟雾，还有430万人死于室内通风不良。
en: The combustion of diesel and coal are among the main causes of air pollution, with 3.7 million deaths attributed to outdoor fumes and 4.3 million resulting from poorly ventilated homes.

zh: 摩托化运输所释放的环境颗粒物现在占34个经合组织国家早亡人数的半数以上。
en: Motorized transport now accounts for half of premature deaths from ambient particulate matter in the 34 OECD countries.

zh: 燃煤发电也是造成气候变化的二氧化碳及其他温室气体的主要来源，每年造成约150,000人早亡，并且可能在本世纪及以后普遍威胁到人类健康。
en: Coal-fired power is also the main source of carbon dioxide, the main greenhouse gas responsible for climate change, which causes about 150,000 premature deaths annually and threatens pervasive risks this century and beyond.

zh: 可以肯定，煤炭行业已协助数十亿人摆脱贫困，尤其以中国为首，20世纪90年代以来燃煤发电已支撑人均收入实现近700%的增长。
en: To be sure, the coal industry has helped billions of people escape poverty, not least in China, where coal-fired power has underpinned the nearly 700% growth in per capita income since 1990.

zh: 但燃煤国家相对更有损于民众的健康。
en: But human health is at greater risk in countries that burn more coal.

zh: 去年据经济与气候全球委员会研究测算2010年仅悬浮颗粒物一项就在世界最大的煤炭消费国中国造成123万人死亡。
en: Research for the Global Commission on the Economy and Climate last year calculated that particulate matter alone caused 1.23 million premature deaths in China – the world’s top coal-consuming economy – in 2010.

zh: 2012年的测算数据表明88%的空气污染死亡案例发生在占世界人口82%的中低收入国家。
en: Estimates for 2012 suggest that 88% of air-pollution-related deaths occur in low- to middle-income countries, representing 82% of the world’s population.

zh: 西太平洋和东南亚地区分别有167万人和936,000人死亡。
en: The Western Pacific and Southeast Asian regions bear the burden of 1.67 million and 936,000 deaths, respectively.

zh: 但是，日益严重的污染目前已经波及到高收入国家。
en: But pollution is worsening and taking lives in high-income countries as well.

zh: 比方说，PM2.5缩短全欧盟平均寿命八个月，并且和臭氧一起，在2011年造成欧盟28个成员国430,000人过早死亡。
en: For example, PM2.5 reduces life expectancy across the European Union by eight months and, together with ozone, was responsible for 430,000 premature deaths in the EU’s 28 member states in 2011.

zh: 在1952年大雾发生60多年后，英国的PM2.5污染水平仍持续超过世界卫生组织设定的指导原则。
en: In Britain, more than six decades after the Great Smog of 1952, PM2.5 pollution levels still persistently exceed WHO guidelines.

zh: 欧盟国家的空气污染成本每年高达9，400亿欧元。
en: The health costs of air pollution in the EU are up to €940 billion annually.

zh: 世卫组织最近审查了空气污染对健康的影响，结果发现这种影响更加广泛，并出现在比以前所认为浓度更低的情况。
en: The WHO recently carried out a review of the evidence on the health effects of air pollution, and found that the range of such effects is broader and occur at lower concentrations than previously thought.

zh: 除对肺和心脏等器官的影响众所周知，全新证据表明其对儿童发育，包括在子宫内的发育造成不利的影响。
en: In addition to the well-known effects of air pollution on the lungs and heart, new evidence points to its detrimental impact on children’s development, including in utero.

zh: 某些研究甚至把空气污染和糖尿病相提并论，这种病是印尼、中国和西方国家的主要慢性病和主要健康威胁。
en: Some studies even link air pollution to diabetes, a major chronic disease and health challenge in Indonesia, China, and Western countries.

zh: 尽管已经掌握对健康威胁的大量证据，但许多国家仍往往忽视空气质量标准和有效区域合作所需的排放监测 — — 主要原因是政府害怕对国内经济产生影响。
en: Despite the overwhelming evidence of health risks, many countries routinely ignore air-quality standards – as well as the emissions monitoring needed for effective regional cooperation – mainly owing to governments’ fear of their economic impact.

zh: 顾问们借以打造发展战略的经济模型 — — 该模式得到说客的吹捧以影响重大基础设施项目决策 — — 根本没有考虑空气污染造成的人员成本，也没有考虑减排措施带来的长期好处。
en: Economic models used by advisers to shape development strategy – and touted by lobbyists to influence decisions on major infrastructure projects – exclude the human cost of air pollution and the long-term benefits of measures to reduce it.

zh: 解决空气污染问题不仅需要新的经济模式，还需要地方、国家和国际政府联手采取对策。
en: Any solutions to the problems posed by air pollution will require not only new economic models, but also integrated measures by local, national, and international governments.

zh: 比方说，城市交通减排将涉及市长、地方规划人员和国家决策者促进紧凑发展的共同努力。
en: Cutting emissions from urban transport, for example, will involve city mayors, local planners, and national policymakers working together to induce compact development.

zh: 所幸的是，政府正不断加大对有效措施的支持。
en: Fortunately, government support for effective action is growing.

zh: 在2013年1月吞没各大城市的被称为“空气末日”的令人窒息的烟雾以及柴静揭露空气污染灾难性健康影响的最新纪录片（及社交媒体现象 ） “ 穹顶之下”问世后，空气污染已经在中国国内议程中广受关注。
en: Air pollution is at the top of China’s domestic agenda, following the choking smog dubbed “airpocalypse” that engulfed its major cities in January 2013 and Chai Jing’s recent documentary (and social-media phenomenon) “Under the Dome,” which exposed the catastrophic health impacts of air pollution.

zh: 事实上，中国政府已关闭了国内某些污染最重的电厂，从而造成煤炭用量从1998年来首次呈现下降趋势。
en: Indeed, China’s government has closed some of the country’s dirtiest power plants, resulting in a drop in coal consumption last year for the first time since 1998.

zh: 世界卫生大会（世卫组织管理机构）关于空气污染与健康问题的最新决议草案建议各国应“注重”空气污染和气候变化之间的联系。
en: A recent draft resolution on air pollution and health for the World Health Assembly (the WHO’s governing body) suggests that countries should “underscore” a link between air pollution and climate change.

zh: 各国应采纳世卫组织空气质量指导方针，并着重强调在绿色城市规划、清洁能源、高效建筑及安全步行和骑车等领域的更多机会。
en: Countries should adopt the WHO air-quality guidelines and highlight additional opportunities for greener urban planning, cleaner energy, more efficient buildings, and safer walking and cycling.

zh: 政府正式承认削减二氧化碳排放所带来的直接健康福利可以在气候变化、空气污染和人类健康方面同时取得更大的进步。
en: A formal acknowledgement by governments of the immediate health-related benefits of cutting carbon-dioxide emissions can tip the scales toward greater progress on climate change, air pollution, and human health simultaneously.

zh: 各国决策者都应认识到上述结果所带来的经济机会和政治利益。
en: Policymakers everywhere should recognize the economic opportunities – and the political benefits – that such an outcome promises to deliver.

zh: 除去碳指标
en: Beyond Carbon Metrics

zh: 柏林 — — 过去10年来 ， “ 气候变化”几乎成了“碳排放”的同义词。
en: BERLIN – Over the last ten years, “climate change” has become almost synonymous with “carbon emissions.”

zh: 以“碳当量 ” （ CO2e）吨数为计量标准的大气温室气体的减少已逐渐成为地球保护事业的主要目标。
en: The reduction of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere, measured in tons of “carbon equivalents” (CO2e) has emerged as the paramount objective in the quest to preserve the planet.

zh: 但要靠如此简单的做法解决我们目前面临的极度复杂并互相联系的生态危机是不可能的。
en: But such a simplistic approach cannot possibly resolve the highly complex and interconnected ecological crises that we currently face.

zh: 全球环境政策一心一意的关注碳指标恰恰反映了人们对会计和计量标准普遍的痴迷态度。
en: Global environmental policy’s single-minded focus on “carbon metrics” reflects a broader obsession with measurement and accounting.

zh: 世界运行靠的是卡路里、英里、磅以及现在的碳当量吨数等等貌似客观可靠的抽象概念，尤其当它们与“专业 ” （ 往往涉及经济领域）的语言相结合。
en: The world runs on abstractions – calories, miles, pounds, and now tons of CO2e – that are seemingly objective and reliable, especially when embedded in “expert” (often economic) language.

zh: 结果导致我们往往忽视了这些抽象概念的历史影响，以及仍在对其造成影响的权力和政治等动态因素。
en: As a result, we tend to overlook the effects of each abstraction’s history, and the dynamics of power and politics that continue to shape it.

zh: 国内生产总值（GDP）就是一个强大但有点虚幻的全球抽象概念的重要例子，它在二战结束后逐渐成为衡量国家经济发展和绩效的主要指标，当时世界大国建立的国际金融体系本来应该反应其各自相对的经济力量。
en: One key example of a powerful and somewhat illusory global abstraction is the gross domestic product (GDP), which was adopted as the main measure of a country’s economic development and performance after World War II, when world powers were building international financial institutions that were supposed to reflect relative economic power.

zh: 但今天，GDP已经成为民众失望的普遍来源，因为它反应不了现实的民众生活。
en: Today, however, GDP has become a source of widespread frustration, as it fails to reflect the realities of people’s lives.

zh: 抽象概念可以像汽车的远光灯一样给人带来很大启发；但同时也能让光柱以外的地方更加难以看到。
en: Like a car’s high beams, abstractions can be very illuminating; but they can also render invisible what lies outside their light.

zh: 尽管如此，GDP仍然是经济繁荣最主要的衡量标准，这反映了人们对在全球资本主义扩张中应运而生的普遍标准的迷恋态度。
en: Nonetheless, GDP remains by far the dominant measure of economic prosperity, reflecting the obsession with universality that accompanied the spread of capitalism worldwide.

zh: 反映当地具体状况的复杂、细致和定性的想象总是没有线性、总体和定量的解释吸引力那么强。
en: Complex, nuanced, and qualitative imaginings that reflect local specificities are simply not as appealing as linear, overarching, and quantitative explanations.

zh: 在涉及气候变化的问题上，人们的这种偏好体现为一心一意支持让“净”碳排放边际递减的解决办法 — — 这样的办法可能会阻碍全面经济转型、或影响人类找出具体问题并制定恰当的解决办法。
en: When it comes to climate change, this preference translates into single-minded support for solutions that marginally reduce “net” carbon emissions – solutions that may impede broad economic transformations or undermine communities’ capacity to define specific problems and develop appropriate solutions.

zh: 这种做法可以追溯到1992年在里约热内卢召开的地球峰会，从那时起气候政策开始成为这条暴力崎岖之路上被遗忘的替代品。
en: This approach can be traced back to the 1992 Earth Summit in Rio de Janeiro, where climate policy embarked on a rocky and violent path of forgotten alternatives.

zh: 在过去四分之一世纪里，至少出现了三项关键性错误。
en: In the course of the last quarter century, at least three critical mistakes were made.

zh: 首先，政府引入了碳当量的计量单位来计算二氧化碳、甲烷和一氧化碳等不同温室气体所造成的排放效果。
en: First, governments introduced the CO2e unit of calculation to quantify in a consistent manner the effects of disparate greenhouse gases, such as CO2, methane, and nitrous oxide.

zh: 上述气体在方方面面有着很大的不同 — — 包括它们潜在的升温能力、在大气中的停留时间、出现的地域、以及与当地生态系统和经济的互动模式等。
en: The variations among these gases – in terms of their warming potential, how long they remain in the atmosphere, where they appear, and how they interact with local ecosystems and economies – are profound.

zh: 确定单一的计量方法极大地简化了问题，使得决策者可以推行一套全面的解决方案，旨在实现特定的总体目标。
en: A single unit of measure simplifies matters considerably, allowing policymakers to pursue one blanket solution aimed at meeting a specific overarching target.

zh: 其次，联合国气候大会强调“末端”技术 （即以清除大气当中的污染物为目标的方法 ） 。
en: Second, the UN climate change convention emphasized “end of pipe” techniques (methods aimed at removing contaminants from the atmosphere).

zh: 这导致决策者成功转移了人们对更富政治挑战性的目标的注意力，具体来讲就是从根本上限制那些制造排放的人类活动。
en: This enabled decision-makers to deflect attention away from the more politically challenging objective of limiting the activities producing those emissions in the first place.

zh: 第三，决策者决定以“净”排放量为重点，将涉及土地、植物和动物的生物进程与化石燃料燃烧相关进程同时加以考量。
en: Third, policymakers decided to focus on “net” emissions, considering biological processes involving land, plants, and animals together with those associated with the burning of fossil fuels.

zh: 水田和牛像工业设施一样被视为排放源，而热带雨林、单树种人工林和沼泽则可以吸收排放。
en: Just like industrial facilities, paddy fields and cows were treated as emissions sources, and tropical forests, monoculture tree plantations and bogs as emission sinks.

zh: 决策者开始在国外寻找抵消排放的方法，而不是全心全意减少国内排放。
en: Policymakers began to seek solutions that involved offsetting emissions abroad, rather than cutting them at home (or at the source).

zh: 到1997年京都议定书签订时 ， “ 增强灵活性”成为流行一时的风尚，而交易排放证书（或排放许可证）则是首选的政策选项。
en: By 1997, when the Kyoto Protocol was introduced, “more flexibility” was the order of the day, and trading in emissions certificates (or permits to pollute) was the preferred policy option.

zh: 将近20年后，抵消排放的努力不仅在气候政治中根深蒂固；而且已经进入到涉及面更广的环境政策探讨。
en: Nearly two decades later, the effort to offset emissions is not only entrenched in climate politics; it has also made its way into the broader environmental-policy debate.

zh: 世界各地正迅速出现所谓的“生态系统服务”新市场。
en: New markets for so-called “ecosystem services” are emerging all over the world.

zh: 例如，美国的“湿地缓和银行”就是最早出现的此类市场。
en: For example, “wetland mitigation banking” in the United States is one of the older such markets.
