zh: 它涉及保存、强化或创设湿地或溪流，以抵消某计划项目对其他地方类似生态系统所造成的负面影响。
en: It entails the preservation, enhancement, or creation of, say, a wetland or stream that offsets the adverse impacts of a planned project on a similar ecosystem elsewhere.

zh: 人们通过发放可交易证书来实现这一目标。
en: This is done by issuing certificates that can be traded.

zh: 生物多样性抵消计划的作用方式也大体相同：企业或个人可以购买“生物多样性积分 ” ， 以便抵消其碳足迹的影响。
en: “Biodiversity offsetting” schemes work in much the same way: A company or individual can purchase “biodiversity credits” to offset their “ecological footprint.”

zh: 如果上述计划听起来似乎过于便利，这其实是实际情况。
en: If these schemes sound a little too convenient, that is because they are.

zh: 事实上，它们与排放权交易有着同样的概念错误，而且在某些情况下，它们实际将多样性和生态系统转化为二氧化碳当量。
en: In fact, they are based on the same faulty concept as emissions trading, and in some cases, they actually translate biodiversity and ecosystems into CO2e.

zh: 我们不仅没有改变经济体系使之适应地球的自然限度，反而重新定义自然以使其适应我们的经济系统 — — 并且在这个过程中排除了其他形式的知识和真正的选项。
en: Instead of changing our economic system to make it fit within the planet’s natural limits, we are redefining nature so that it fits within our economic system – and, in the process, precluding other forms of knowledge and real alternatives.

zh: 现在，在去年12月召开的巴黎气候峰会后，世界很快又会采取另外一项错误举措，即采纳所谓的“负排放”理念，即假定新技术能够将二氧化碳从大气中清除。
en: Now, in the wake of last December’s climate summit in Paris, the world is on the verge of taking yet another wrong turn, by embracing the idea of “negative emissions,” which assumes that new technologies will be able to remove CO2 from the atmosphere.

zh: 但这样的技术还没有发明出来，并且即使真的发明了，它们的实施也是非常危险的。
en: Yet such technologies have yet to be invented, and even if they were, their implementation would be highly risky.

zh: 我们不仅没有推行成熟的解决方案 — — 即将化石燃料留在地下、从农业产业化转向农业生态化、创建零废物经济及恢复自然生态系统 — — 反而指望某些神奇的创新能在关键时刻神使鬼差地救我们于水火。
en: Rather than pursue proven solutions – leaving fossil fuels in the ground, moving away from industrial agriculture toward agro-ecology, creating no-waste economies, and restoring natural ecosystems – we are counting on some miraculous innovation to save us, deus ex machina, just in the nick of time.

zh: 这种做法的愚蠢应当是显而易见的。
en: The folly of this approach should be obvious.

zh: 如果碳指标继续影响气候政策，新的一代就只会见到一个碳约束 — — 而且如果他们足够幸运，低碳的 — — 世界。
en: If carbon metrics continue to shape climate policy, new generations will know only a carbon-constrained – and, if they are lucky, a low-carbon – world.

zh: 我们不能追求这样一个简单目标，而必须实行旨在改变经济体系以适应 — — 并配合 — — 自然环境的更为丰富的政策。
en: Instead of pursuing such a simplistic vision, we must pursue richer strategies aimed at transforming our economic systems to work within – and with – our natural environment.

zh: 为了实现这一目标，我们必须树立一种全新思维方法，积极夺回并保护替代方法的繁荣发展空间。
en: For that, we will need a new way of thinking that spurs active engagement to reclaim and conserve the spaces where alternative approaches can grow and flourish.

zh: 实现这一目标不会轻而易举，但却值得为此付出代价。
en: It will not be easy, but it will be worth it.

zh: 气候变化与用水安全
en: Climate Change and Water Security

zh: 政府间气候变化问题小组近期发布了令人担忧的数据，该数据是关于全球变暖在世界一些最穷困地区所造成的后果。
en: The Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change recently released alarming data on the consequences of global warming in some of the world’s poorest regions.

zh: 到2100年，世界范围内十亿至三十亿的人口将遭受水荒。
en: By 2100, one billion to three billion people worldwide are expected to suffer from water scarcity.

zh: 全球变暖将加剧蒸发并且使降雨量严重减少，在中东和北非会达到百分之二十。 这使得到世纪中期这些地区人均可用水量可能减半。
en: Global warming will increase evaporation and severely reduce rainfalls – by up to 20% in the Middle East and North Africa – with the amount of water available per person possibly halved by mid-century in these regions.

zh: 某种元素（其象征及精神的重要性与其对人类生活的中心一致）的突然缺乏，将造成过分的紧张并且将加剧世界范围内的冲突。
en: This sudden scarcity of an element whose symbolic and spiritual importance matches its centrality to human life will cause stress and exacerbate conflicts worldwide.

zh: 非洲、中东及中亚将是首批发生冲突的地区。
en: Africa, the Middle East, and Central Asia will be the first to be exposed.

zh: 但是，其影响是世界性的。
en: The repercussions, however, will be global.

zh: 然而这幅凄凉的画面既不是冷漠的借口，亦不是悲观的理由。
en: Yet this bleak picture is neither an excuse for apathy nor grounds for pessimism.

zh: 冲突可能是不可避免的，但战争却不是。
en: Conflicts may be inevitable; wars are not.

zh: 我们防止“水战争”的能力将取决于预见紧张局势、找到控制出现冲突的技术上及制度上的解决办法的集体能力。
en: Our ability to prevent “water wars” will depend on our collective capacity to anticipate tensions, and to find the technical and institutional solutions to manage emerging conflicts.

zh: 好消息是这种解决办法是存在的，并且每天都在证明其功效。
en: The good news is that such solutions exist, and are proving their efficacy everyday.

zh: 大小和设计适宜的大坝可以通过抗击气候变化并调节供水而对人类发展做出贡献。
en: Dams – provided they are adequately sized and designed – can contribute to human development by fighting climate change and regulating water supply.

zh: 然而，在短缺的新含义中，国际性河流的上游基础建设可能影响水质或邻国的水供应，从而造成紧张局势。
en: Yet in a new context of scarcity, upstream infrastructure projects on international rivers may impact water quality or availability for neighboring states, thus causing tensions.

zh: 为尼罗河、尼日尔河或塞内加尔河建立的河流流域组织可以推动分享水力资源的国家之间的对话。
en: River basin organizations such as that established for the Nile, Niger, or Senegal rivers help facilitate dialogue between states that share hydraulic resources.

zh: 通过发展开发国际水路联合设想，这些区域性的合作措施争取资源共有，从而减少了用水争议升级为暴力的风险。
en: By developing a joint vision for the development of international waterways, these regional cooperation initiatives work towards common ownership of the resource, thereby reducing the risk that disputes over water use will escalate into violence.

zh: 大多数国际水路具备了对话的框架，虽然发展阶段和成就有所不同。
en: Most international waterways have such frameworks for dialogue, albeit at different stages of development and levels of achievement.

zh: 若我们严肃对待气候变化预言，国际社会需加强这些措施。
en: If we are to take climate change predictions seriously, the international community should strengthen these initiatives.

zh: 如果没有这些措施，则需通过与所有相关国家合作而创立。
en: Where they do not exist, they should be created in partnership with all the countries concerned.

zh: 官方发展协助可以通过为数据收集筹措资金、提供技术诀窍，或者通过为建设性的谈判决定贷款而为合作创立动机。
en: Official development assistance can create incentives to cooperate by financing data-collection, providing technical know-how, or, indeed, by conditioning loans on constructive negotiations.

zh: 然而国际用水冲突仅是事物的一方面。
en: Yet international water conflicts are only one side of the coin.

zh: 如今所发生的最激烈的水战争是在国家之内而不是在国家之间。
en: The most violent water wars take place today within rather than among states.

zh: 当各群落开始为其生存担忧并且寻求夺取资源之时，出现了水缺乏的种族冲突。
en: A dearth of water fuels ethnic strife, as communities begin to fear for their survival and seek to capture the resource.

zh: 在达尔福尔，周期性发生的干旱损害了农夫与牧民之间的关系。 我们无能为力地目睹的战争随着连年不断加剧的冲突而来。
en: In Darfur, recurrent drought has poisoned relations between farmers and nomadic herdsmen, and the war we are helplessly witnessing today follows years of escalating conflict.

zh: 乍得也有陷入同样的暴力周期的危险。
en: Chad risks falling prey to the same cycle of violence.

zh: 因此，通过本地发展措施以满足人们的最基本需求是很紧迫的。
en: It is thus urgent to satisfy populations’ most basic human needs through local development initiatives.

zh: 农村的水力工程确保了大片土地上人口的用水，可以是防止冲突的有效工具。
en: Rural hydraulic projects, which ensure access to water for these populations over large stretches of land, can prove to be efficient conflict prevention tools.

zh: 通过现代卫星图为牧民及牧群确定适宜地区的帮助而建立安全的放牧走廊。
en: Secured grazing corridors are being established with the help of modern satellite imagery to orient nomads and their herds to appropriate areas.

zh: 这些措施为竞争群落之间的对话及合作提供了难得的机会。
en: Such initiatives provide rare opportunities for dialogue and collaboration between rival communities.

zh: 关键是在紧张升级到极限点以前预测到行动的必要。
en: The key is to anticipate the need for action before tensions escalate to the point of no return.

zh: 用水也是必须解决的问题。
en: Water consumption also must be addressed.

zh: 农业用水占了世界用水70%以上。
en: Agriculture accounts for more than 70% of water use in the world.

zh: 对于将农业用水效率提高到最大程度而言，农事研究及技术创新至关重要，而且必须进一步予以推动。
en: Agronomical research and technical innovations are crucial to maximizing water efficiency in this sector, and they must be taken much further.

zh: 但是处理水资源短缺将不可避免地意味着世界范围内修改农业惯例及政策，以确保其持续性。
en: But addressing scarcity will inevitably imply revising agricultural practices and policies worldwide to ensure their sustainability.

zh: 发展挑战不再仅仅存在于将农业用水引入缺乏的地区。
en: The development challenge no longer solely consists in bringing agricultural water to deprived areas.

zh: 由于咸海、乍得湖、死海巨大收缩的例子，现在需要保存稀有的自然资源并且确保不一致需求间的公正分配。
en: As the dramatic shrinkage of the Aral Sea, Lake Chad, and the Dead Sea illustrate, it now requires preserving scarce natural resources and ensuring their equitable distribution among conflicting needs.

zh: 负责任的使用需要适当的经济鼓励。
en: Responsible use will require adequate economic incentives.

zh: 在西非或中东，中亚或印度，此措施可以为减少用水冲突做出贡献。
en: In West Africa or the Middle East, Central Asia or India, this, too, can contribute to abating clashes over water.

zh: 由于空前规模的威胁，一切照常不是应该的选择。
en: Given the unprecedented scale of the threat, business as usual is not an option.

zh: 冷战由于现实主义、远见及意志的力量而和平结束。
en: The Cold War came to a peaceful end thanks to realism, foresight, and strength of will.

zh: 为了避免地球上发生大规模水战争，那么就应该让这三个特质发挥作用。
en: These three qualities should be put to work if our planet is to be spared major water wars.

zh: 这个全球性的挑战亦需对全球性管理进行改革，这就是我们支持创立联合国环境署，并且赋予其解决当前问题所需的法律及财政资源的原因。
en: This global challenge also demands innovation in global governance, which is why we support the creation of a UN Environment Agency, endowed with the legal and financial resources needed to tackle the issues at hand.

zh: 人类必须开始解决这个用水两难处境。
en: Humanity must begin to resolve this water dilemma.

zh: 等待是不能解决问题的。
en: Waiting is not part of the solution.

zh: 敲响生物多样性丧失的警钟
en: Sounding the Alarm on Biodiversity Loss

zh: 诺维奇—联合国气候变化会议正在德国波恩召开，全球气温的升高再次成为世界议程的焦点。
en: NORWICH – With the United Nations’ climate change conference underway in Bonn, Germany, rising global temperatures are once again at the top of the world’s agenda.

zh: 但要不是气温升高影响到包括人类在内的地球上的生命，为什么还要关注这个问题？
en: But why care about the increase in temperature, if not because of its impact on life on Earth, including human life?

zh: 这是一个需要考虑的重要问题，因为人们相对来说较少关注一个紧密相关、同样重要的人类生存威胁：令人吃惊的全球生物多样性丧失速度。
en: That is an important question to consider, in view of the relative lack of attention devoted to a closely related and equally important threat to human survival: the startling pace of global biodiversity loss.

zh: 获得粮食、水和能源 — — 每个国家安全的基本构成要件 — — 取决于健康、鲁棒、多样化的生态系统以及栖息于其中的生命。
en: The availability of food, water, and energy – fundamental building blocks of every country’s security – depends on healthy, robust, and diverse ecosystems, and on the life that inhabits them.

zh: 但是，拜人类行为所赐，如今地球生物多样性的衰减速度比历史上任何时候都要快。
en: But, as a result of human activities, planetary biodiversity is now declining faster than at any point in history.

zh: 但是，许多决策者仍然没有认识到生物多样性丧失的威胁，和海平面上升、极端天气事件越来越频繁等量齐观。
en: Many policymakers, however, have yet to recognize that biodiversity loss is just as serious a threat as rising sea levels and increasingly frequent extreme weather events.

zh: 尽管国际社会为保护生物多样性做出了很多努力，但关注度仍然不够。
en: This lack of sufficient attention comes despite international commitments to protect biodiversity.

zh: 2010年10月，全球领导人在日本爱知达成了2011—2020年生物多样性战略计划，其中包括了20项宏大的目标 — — 比如将全球栖息地丧失减少一半、结束滥捕滥捞等 — — 签署国同意在2020年前实现这些目标。
en: In October 2010, global leaders met in Aichi, Japan, where they produced the Strategic Plan for Biodiversity 2011-2020, which included 20 ambitious targets – such as halving global habitat loss and ending overfishing – that signatories agreed to meet by 2020.

zh: 捍卫生物多样性也被明确写入了联合国可持续发展目标。
en: Safeguarding biodiversity is also specifically included in the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals.

zh: 但在这些全球生物多样性目标方面的进展大大低于确保全人类可接受的未来的要求。
en: Yet progress toward these global biodiversity goals is likely to fall dangerously short of what is needed to ensure an acceptable future for all.

zh: 决策者们基本上都同意必须将全球升温幅度限制在前工业化水平以上2℃以内 — — 这也是巴黎气候协定的目标。
en: Policymakers have largely agreed on the importance of holding the increase in global temperature to less than 2°C above pre-industrial levels – the goal of the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 但很少有领导人表现出阻止生物多样性丧失的紧迫感。
en: But too few leaders have shown any sense of urgency about stemming biodiversity losses.

zh: 我们想要的可持续的未来取决于是否能够停止这一冷漠。
en: The sustainable future we want depends on ending this indifference.

zh: 为了向这一目标靠拢，由我主持的生物多样性和生态系统维持政府间科学政策平台（IPBES）将在明年3月发布关于生物多样性损失的影响的一系列地标性报告。
en: Toward that end, the Intergovernmental Science-Policy Platform on Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services (IPBES), which I chair, will release a series of landmark reports next March on the implications of biodiversity decline.

zh: 这些报告由100个国家的550多位专家经三年多时间酝酿，评估范围涵盖了四个世界地区：美洲、亚洲和太平洋、非洲以及欧洲和中亚。
en: Prepared over three years by more than 550 experts from some 100 countries, these expert assessments will cover four world regions: the Americas, Asia and the Pacific, Africa, and Europe and Central Asia.

zh: 第五份报告则将针对土地退化和地区和全球层面的重建问题。
en: A fifth report will address the state of land degradation and restoration at regional and global levels.

zh: 这些报告强调趋势和可能的未来，列举在减缓生态系统（从大堡礁到热带雨林）退化方面可用的最佳政策选项。
en: The reports will highlight trends and plausible futures, outlining the best policy options available to slow the degradation of ecosystems, from coral reefs to rainforests.

zh: 总体看来，IPBES报告可以代表全球科学界在生物多样性和生态系统维持状态问题上的共识。
en: Taken together, the IPBES assessments will represent the global scientific community’s consensus view on the state of biodiversity and ecosystem services.

zh: 此外，这些报告还将强调生物多样性丧失和气候变化之间的紧密联系，这两个问题可以同时解决。
en: Moreover, the reports will highlight the close links between biodiversity loss and climate change, which should be addressed simultaneously.

zh: 如果世界不考虑生物多样性和生态系统维持的状态，就无法实现巴黎协定的目标 — — 也无法实现许多可持续发展目标。
en: The world will not be able to meet the goals of the Paris agreement – or many of the SDGs, for that matter – unless it takes into account the state of biodiversity and ecosystem services.

zh: 如今，大部分政府将环境部门从专注于能源、农业和规划的部门中分离出来。
en: Today, most governments separate their environmental authorities from those focusing on energy, agriculture, and planning.

zh: 这导致难以用综合方法治理气候变化或生物多样性丧失问题。
en: This makes it difficult to address climate change or biodiversity losses in a holistic way.

zh: 需要新的创新治理结构将各自为政的政策综合起来。
en: New types of innovative governance structures are needed to bridge these policy silos.

zh: 明年IPBES地区报告发布后，2019年还将在此基础上发布全球评估结果。
en: After the release of IPBES regional reports next year, a global assessment building on them will be published in 2019.

zh: 这将是自权威性的2005年千年生态系统评估以来第一份全球性生物多样性和生态系统维持总体评估。
en: This will be the first global overview of biodiversity and ecosystem services since the authoritative Millennium Ecosystem Assessment of 2005.

zh: 它将考察陆地、淡水和海洋生态系统的健康状况，以及包括各种因素的影响，包括酸化、海洋表面温度升高、贸易、入侵物种、过度捕捞、污染和土地用途改变等。
en: It will examine the health of terrestrial, freshwater, and marine ecosystems, and the impact of factors including acidification, rising sea surface temperatures, trade, invasive species, overfishing, pollution, and land use changes.

zh: 改变对全球自然资产的不可持续的用途的努力要想取得成功，决策者必须反思生物多样性对于人民、环境和经济的意义。
en: The success of efforts to reverse unsustainable uses of the world’s natural assets will require policymakers to reconsider the value of biodiversity for their people, environments, and economies.

zh: 但第一步是要确保我们具备最好的同行审议知识来保证可靠的决策；即将发布的IPBES评估将是迈向这一方向的重要一步。
en: But the first step is ensuring that we have the best peer-reviewed knowledge available to make sound decisions; the forthcoming IPBES assessments will move us in that direction.

zh: 要想让气候变化的全面后果在我们这一代人手上得到解决，我们必须承认人类活动不仅仅导致了每年气温预测上升几度。
en: If the full consequences of climate change are to be addressed in our lifetime, we must recognize that human activity is doing more than just adding a few degrees of temperature to the annual forecast.

zh: 明年年初，我们将拥有关于生物多样性和生态系统维持的数据证明这一点，并了解可以采取哪些政策改变局面。
en: By early next year, we will have the data on biodiversity and ecosystem services to prove it, and the policy options to change course.

zh: 正确定价，保护气候
en: The Right Price for Preserving Our Climate

zh: 华盛顿—本周，全世界领导人齐聚巴黎参加联合国气候变化会议，他们的任务是达成一个全球协定降低温室气体排放。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – When world leaders convene in Paris this week for the United Nations Climate Change Conference, their task will be to reach a global agreement on curbing greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 成功的结果需要证明各国能够齐心协力为了地球的利益而努力，它将给全世界 — — 以及在最近的恐怖袭击中不屈不挠的巴黎人民 — — 带来强有力的希望信号。
en: A successful outcome, demonstrating that countries can work together for the good of the planet, would send a powerful message of hope to the world – and to the people of Paris, who remain unbowed after the recent terrorist attacks.

zh: 气候承诺将在国家自主贡献预案（INDC）或降低全世界排放承诺的基础上做出。
en: Climate pledges will be made on the basis of Intended Nationally Determined Contributions (INDCs), or commitments to the reduction of emissions worldwide.

zh: 我认为排放的定价应该是这些承诺的核心。
en: I believe that the price of emissions should be at the center of these pledges.

zh: 以最低可能代价实现温室气体减排需要能源使用和生产方面的创新。
en: Achieving a decline in greenhouse-gas emissions at the lowest possible cost requires a revolution in energy use and production.

zh: 渐进、可预测并可靠地提高能源价格能为消费者提供强大的激励减少其能源账单。
en: Gradual, predictable, and reliable increases in energy prices would provide strong incentives for consumers to reduce their energy bills.

zh: 与此同时，正确的碳定价能鼓励科技创新投资，从而实现远离化石燃料的平稳转型。
en: At the same time, the right carbon price would enable a smooth transition away from fossil fuels by encouraging investments in technological innovation.

zh: 因此，国际货币基金组织（IMF）建议实施一套由三部分组成的碳燃料战略 ： “ 正确定价、巧妙征税、现在做起 ” 。
en: That is why the International Monetary Fund’s staff have recommended a three-part strategy on carbon fuel: “price it right, tax it smart, and do it now.”

zh: 每个部分都很关键。
en: Each component is essential.

zh: 首先，为化石燃料制定正确价格意味着要考虑它们的真正的环境成本。
en: First, setting the right price for fossil fuels means taking into account their true environmental costs.

zh: 定价必须将所有成本都转嫁给最终用户，不仅包括生产和购买成本，也包括密集依赖化石燃料所导致的伤害成本 — — 如空气污染和气候变化。
en: Prices should pass on to end users the full cost not only of production and acquisition, but also of the damage – including air pollution and climate change – caused by intensive reliance on fossil fuels.

zh: 更公平的碳定价将促使能源储蓄、提振对更清洁的燃料和更“绿色”的投资的需求。
en: A fairer carbon price will drive energy savings and boost demand for cleaner fuels and “greener” investments.

zh: 其次，价格的必要变化应该通过对能源征税实现，采用务实又有效的工具。
en: Second, the necessary change in prices would be achieved by taxing energy, using tools that are both practical and efficient.

zh: 最佳选择是在现有燃料税之外增加碳费，对煤炭、天然气和其他石化产品都这样做。
en: The best option is to build a carbon charge into existing fuel taxes and apply similar charges to coal, natural gas, and other petroleum products.

zh: 由此带来的收入影响将十分可观。
en: The revenue implications would be significant.

zh: 如果排放大国为每吨二氧化碳定价30美元，就能产生相当于GDP的1%左右的财政收入。
en: If large emitting countries were to impose carbon prices of $30 per ton of CO2, they could generate fiscal revenues amounting to about 1% of their GDP.

zh: 这笔收入可以用于管理气候行动的总体财政负担，也可以用来降低扭曲经济活动和妨碍增长的劳动和资本税或者用于在需要的时候降低赤字。
en: These revenues could be used to manage the overall fiscal burden of climate action, as well as to finance cuts in taxes on labor and capital that distort economic activity and harm growth, or to reduce deficits where needed.

zh: 简言之，碳定价事关“巧”征税而不是增税。
en: In short, carbon pricing is about “smart” taxes, not higher taxes.

zh: 巧妙征税应该分阶段逐渐实施，给家庭和企业作出调整的时间，也给新技术形成趋势的时间。
en: Smart taxes should be phased in gradually to allow households and firms time to adjust and for new technologies to come on stream.

zh: 渐进而有针对性的调整对于发展中经济体来说尤其重要，许多发展中经济体几乎完全不曾参与碳排放。
en: Gradual and tailored adjustment is particularly important for developing economies, many of which make little contribution to global emissions.

zh: 在许多案例中，时间是保证建立社会安全网以保护低收入家庭和为能源密集型行业的工人提供再培训计划的必要条件。
en: Time may be necessary, in many cases, to ensure that social safety nets are in place to protect low-income households and to provide retraining programs for workers in energy-intensive industries.

zh: 这一方针也将让气候投资通过私人资本流获得融资。
en: This approach would also allow for climate investments to be financed through private capital flows.

zh: 第三，时间已不容浪费：决策者需要立刻采取行动。
en: Third, there is no time to lose: policymakers need to act immediately.

zh: 能源暴跌是一次千载难逢的良机，应该利用它来推进巧妙、可信、高效的碳定价转型。
en: Given the slump in energy prices, there has never been a better time to undertake the transition to smart, credible, and effective carbon pricing.

zh: 各国也不应该坐等其他国家先���动。
en: Nor should countries wait for others to move first.

zh: IMF的研究表明，公平的碳定价符合许多国家的国家利益 — — 即使忽略对其他国家的负面气候影响也是如此 — — 因为这有助于解决主要的国内环境问题。
en: Work at the IMF has shown that a fair amount of carbon pricing is in many countries’ national interest – even ignoring adverse climate effects on other countries – because it would help resolve major domestic environmental problems.

zh: 据世界卫生组织的数据，室外空气污染每年导致三百万以上的人过早死亡。
en: According to the World Health Organization, outdoor air pollution causes more than three million premature deaths a year.

zh: 而及早采取行动对于避免延后行动所带来的难度 — — 以及成本 — — 倍增至关重要。
en: And early action is essential to avoid the need for much more drastic – and costly – efforts later.

zh: 在巴黎峰会前，160多个国家递交了减排承诺。
en: Ahead of the Paris summit, more than 160 countries submitted emissions mitigation pledges.

zh: 通过实施这些承诺，各国将极大地降低预期未来全球变暖幅度。
en: By implementing these commitments, countries will substantially reduce projected future global warming.

zh: 现在的挑战是履行这些承诺。
en: The challenge now is to deliver on these pledges.

zh: 因此，我们需要合作为碳定价。
en: This is why we need a concerted push for carbon pricing.

zh: 在巴黎，一个由真正的碳定价领导人组成的小组将会发出行动倡议。
en: In Paris, a select group of leaders who are true champions of carbon pricing will issue a call for action.

zh: 以IMF和世界银行为首的碳定价委员会将进一步推动加大国家、地区和市政水平上的政策力度。
en: The Carbon Pricing Panel, led by the IMF and World Bank, will further increase the policy momentum at the national, regional, and municipal levels.

zh: 除了公共部门的努力，我们还需要金融机构和市场的强力参与。
en: In addition to public-sector efforts, we also need the robust engagement of financial institutions and markets.

zh: 对冲工具，比如所谓的灾难债券（catastrophe bonds ） ， 有助于为自然灾难所带来的日益增加的风险提供保险。
en: Hedging instruments such as so-called catastrophe bonds can help insure against the increasing risk posed by natural disasters.

zh: 其他金融工具，比如“绿色”股票指数和“绿色”债券，有助于将投资配置给支持环境可持续增长的部门。
en: Other financial instruments, such as “green” stock indices and “green” bonds, can help reallocate investment to sectors that support environmentally sustainable growth.

zh: 在这方面，可预测、足够高的碳定价也是指引投资选择的不可或缺的因素。
en: Here, too, carbon prices that are predictable and sufficiently high will be essential to guide investment choices.

zh: 本周的光之城攸关人类命运。
en: There is a lot at stake this week in the City of Light.

zh: 巴黎刚刚经历了人性中最丑恶的一面。
en: Paris recently experienced humanity at its worst.

zh: 气候峰会是一次向巴黎展示人性中最美好一面的机会。
en: The climate summit will be an opportunity to show it at its best.

zh: 碳定价起飞
en: Carbon Pricing Takes Off

zh: 波恩—今年，重创加勒比地区、德克萨斯州和佛罗里达州的飓风淹没了高速公路，摧毁了住房和企业，造成了人员伤亡。
en: BONN – The hurricanes that pummeled the Caribbean, Texas, and Florida this year left highways submerged, homes and businesses demolished, and lives lost.

zh: 洪水已经退去，但剧变的景象仍然镌刻在我们的集体记忆中。
en: The floodwaters have since receded, but the images of upheaval remain etched in our collective memory.

zh: 恢复需要多年甚至几十年，以及数十亿美元资金。
en: Recovery will take years, perhaps decades, and it will cost billions of dollars.

zh: 专家们告诉我们，海洋变暖让飓风变得更加强力，而人为气候变暖的其他后果 — — 从非洲之角的严重干旱到亚洲的极端洪水 — — 让数百万人失去了粮食和基本住所。
en: Experts tell us that warming oceans are causing hurricanes to become more powerful, and other consequences of anthropogenic climate change – from severe droughts in the Horn of Africa to extreme flooding in Asia – are leaving millions without food and basic shelter.

zh: 但尽管燃烧化石燃料和致命天气之间的关系多年来越来越紧密，决策者却并不总能听进警告声。
en: But while the link between burning fossil fuels and deadly weather has been strengthening for years, policymakers have not always heeded the warnings.

zh: 这一点正在迅速改变。
en: This is changing rapidly.

zh: 如今，全世界国家、公民和越来越多的企业终于开始行动起来了。
en: Today, countries, citizens, and a growing number of businesses around the world are finally taking action.

zh: 这个月，数千人将齐聚德国波恩参加联合国气候变化会议，提升遏制气候变化的全球目标。
en: This month, thousands gathered for the UN’s climate change conference in Bonn, Germany, to ratchet up global ambition in the fight against climate change.

zh: 两年前巴黎气候协定取得成功后，人们对取得更大进步和保持合作的期望很高。
en: Following the successful Paris climate agreement two years ago, expectations for further progress and continued collaboration are high.

zh: 近期更令人憧憬的计划之一是碳定价领导联盟（CPLC ） ， 该计划集合了30个国家的政府和180多家企业和战略合作伙伴，为二氧化碳排放制定价格。
en: One of the more promising recent initiatives is the Carbon Pricing Leadership Coalition (CPLC), which brings together 30 governments and more than 180 businesses and strategic partners to put a value on carbon dioxide emissions.

zh: 其思想很简单：要想实现巴黎协定的目标，即将全球平均气温限制在前工业化水平以上2℃以内 — — 理想的情况是前工业化水平以上1.5℃以内 — — 就必须大幅削减排放。
en: The idea is simple: if we are to meet the Paris accord’s target of limiting the increase in global average temperature to less than 2° Celsius above preindustrial levels – ideally, to 1.5° above preindustrial levels – we must dramatically cut emissions.

zh: 作为CPLC的联职主席，我们相信削减二氧化碳排放的最佳办法之一，是将吸热气体所造成的社会和经济成本，从公众身上转嫁给污染者。
en: As co-chairs of the CPLC, we believe that one of the best ways to do that is by shifting the social and economic costs of heat-trapping gases from the public to the polluter.

zh: 随着气候紧迫感的日益增加，免费污染、让子孙后代买单已经日益令人难以接受。
en: With the sense of climate urgency increasing, it is no longer acceptable to pollute for free and pass the bill to future generations.

zh: 给碳定价是减少全球排放、同时鼓励可持续和稳健经济增长的最有效的办法。
en: Putting a price on carbon is the most efficient way to reduce global emissions while encouraging sustainable and robust economic growth.

zh: 此外，通过给污染制定价格，政府能够获得收入用于清洁能源、学校和医疗等方面的投资，从而一举两得。
en: Moreover, by putting a price on pollution, governments can generate revenue for investments like clean energy, schools, and health care, making it a double win.

zh: 当然，最终的目标是鼓励企业净化它们的行为，如今，越来越多的商界领袖认识到碳定价是遏制气候变化的最佳办法之一。
en: The ultimate goal, of course, is to encourage businesses to clean up their acts, and today, a growing share of business leaders understand that pricing carbon is one of the best ways to combat climate change.

zh: 他们还认识到，即使花力气降低排放，他们的企业仍然可以兴旺发展。
en: They also recognize that their businesses can thrive even as they work to reduce emissions.

zh: 事实上，许多商界领袖是有效碳定价的最热情的支持者。
en: In fact, many business leaders are among the most enthusiastic supporters of effective carbon pricing.

zh: 就在上个月，碳披露计划（Carbon Disclosure Project）指出，全世界制定了内部碳定价机制计划的公司数量已经达到了近1,400家，而2014年只有150家。
en: Just last month, the Carbon Disclosure Project revealed that the number of companies with plans to pursue internal carbon price mechanisms has grown to almost 1,400 globally, up from 150 in 2014.

zh: 这其中包括100多家全球最大公司，它们的年收入达到了7万亿美元。
en: This includes more than 100 of the world’s largest companies, with total annual revenues of some $7 trillion.

zh: 皇家帝斯曼公司（Royal DSM由本文作者之一领导）制定了每吨50欧元的碳价格，与米其林、达能和通用汽车等跨国公司一起运用有意义的碳定价来让业务“与时俱进 ” 。
en: Royal DSM (which is led by one of the authors) has set a carbon price of €50 ($59) per ton, joining other global companies like Michelin, Danone, and General Motors in applying meaningful carbon prices to “future-proof” their business.

zh: 包括加拿大在内的大约40个国家还为碳污染制定了价格，更多的政府正在准备实施类似的制度。
en: Some 40 countries – including Canada – are also putting a price on carbon pollution, and more governments are planning to implement similar schemes soon.

zh: 2015年，中国宣布建立世界最大规模的碳定价系统。
en: In 2015, China announced plans to create the world’s largest carbon-pricing system.

zh: 今年早些时候，安大略省、魁北克省和加利福尼亚州签订协议，建立了世界第二大碳市场。
en: And earlier this year, Ontario, Québec, and California signed an agreement to create the world’s second-largest carbon market.

zh: 这一趋势必须保持下去 — — 既为了环境，也是出于经济考虑。
en: This trend must continue – for environmental and economic reasons.

zh: 2017年5月的一项碳定价高规格委员会（High-Level Commission on Carbon Prices）的研究 — — 该委员会由两位世界顶尖经济学家约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph E. Stiglitz）和尼古拉斯·斯特恩（Nicholas Stern）主持 — — 发现，制定“强势碳定价”不但是减少全球排放的关键，也是保持创新和增长的关键。
en: A May 2017 study conducted by the High-Level Commission on Carbon Prices – led by two of the world’s top economists, Joseph E. Stiglitz and Nicholas Stern – found that setting a “strong carbon price” is essential not only for reducing global emissions, but also for sustaining innovation and growth.

zh: 平心而论，为碳污染制定价格必须成为让我们的经济和社会与时俱进的大行动的一部分。
en: To be sure, putting a price on carbon pollution must become part of a broader set of actions to future-proof our economies and societies.

zh: 要进一步减少温室气体排放、培养经济自生能力，我们必须改善公共交通；建设能源效率高的建筑；支持企业、创新者和投资者寻找清洁能源方案的努力。
en: To reduce greenhouse-gas emissions further and foster economic vitality, we must improve public transportation; construct energy-efficient buildings; and support efforts by businesses, innovators, and investors to develop clean-energy solutions.

zh: 这正是加拿大正在做的，因为我们知道，这些政策能够减少排放，帮助创造高薪新就业岗位。
en: This is what Canada is already doing, because we know that these policies can reduce emissions and help create new, well-paying jobs.

zh: 人们常说，气候变化既是挑战，也是机会。
en: As is often said, climate change represents both a challenge and an opportunity.

zh: 通过为碳污染定价、理顺我们的集体能力，我们能够解决挑战，抓住机会。
en: By pricing carbon pollution and harnessing our collective abilities, we can address the former and seize the latter.

zh: 将各国和企业的创新和企业家精神集合起来，我们就能遏制气候变化，强化我们的经济和社会，让我们的子孙后代拥有更加健康的地球。
en: Pooling the innovative and entrepreneurial spirit found in countries and businesses will enable us to fight climate change, strengthen our economies and societies, and leave our children and grandchildren a healthier planet.

zh: 气候变化和天主教会
en: Climate Change and the Catholic Church

zh: 罗马—教皇方济各呼吁世界采取行动应对全球变暖，而许多美国保守派坚决反对。
en: ROME – Pope Francis is calling on the world to take action against global warming, and many conservatives in the United States are up in arms.

zh: 教皇应该坚持坚守道德问题，他们说，而不应该进入科学领域。
en: The pope should stick to morality, they say, and not venture into science.

zh: 但是，随着今年气候争论的展开，大多数人将发现教皇的呼吁不容忽视：我们同时需要科学和道德降低地球的风险。
en: But, as the climate debate unfolds this year, most of humanity will find Francis’s message compelling: we need both science and morality to reduce the risk to our planet.

zh: 第一个关注点是，绝大部分美国人同意方济各关于气候行动的呼吁。
en: The first point to note is that an overwhelming majority of Americans agree with Francis’s call for climate action.

zh: 不幸的是，他们的观点没有在美国国会中得到代表。 美国国会捍卫大煤炭公司和大石油公司的利益，而不捍卫美国人民的利益。
en: Unfortunately, their views are not represented in the US Congress, which defends Big Coal and Big Oil, not the American people.

zh: 化石燃料业投入巨资进行游说活动和为米奇·麦康奈尔（Mitch McConnell）和詹姆斯·英霍夫（James Inhofe）等参议员的选战服务。
en: The fossil-fuel industry spends heavily on lobbying and the campaigns of congressmen such as Senators Mitch McConnell and James Inhofe.

zh: 世界气候危机因为美国的民主危机而进一步加剧。
en: The world’s climate crisis has been aggravated by America’s democratic crisis.

zh: 2015年的一份美国人调查现实，压倒性多数受访者（78 % ） 说“如果不采取任何行动遏制全球变暖 ， ” 对美国的未来后果将是“比较严重”或“非常严重”的。
en: In a survey of Americans conducted in January 2015, an overwhelming majority of respondents (78%) said that, “if nothing is done to reduce global warming,” the future consequences for the US would be “somewhat serious” or “very serious.”

zh: 相当比例（74 % ） 的受访者说，如果不采取任何行动遏制全球变暖，子孙后代将受到“一些程度 ” 、 “相当程度”和“严重程度”的伤害。
en: Roughly the same proportion (74%) said that if nothing is done to reduce global warming, future generations would be hurt “a moderate amount,” “a lot,” or “a great deal.”

zh: 也许最能说明问题的事，66%的受访者说他们“更有可能”支持宣称气候变化正在发生和呼吁采取行动转向可再生能源的候选人，只有12%的受访者“更不可能”支持这类候选人。
en: Perhaps most tellingly, 66% said that they would be “more likely” to support a candidate who says that climate change is happening and who calls for a shift to renewable energy, while 12% would be “less likely” to support such a candidate.

zh: 2015年的另一份调查考察了美国基督徒（占人口比例71 % ） 的态度。
en: In March 2015, another survey examined the attitudes of US Christians, who constitute 71% of Americans.

zh: 受访者分为三类：天主教徒、非福音派新教徒和福音派新教徒。
en: The responses were reported for three groups: Catholics, non-Evangelical Protestants, and Evangelicals.

zh: 这些群体的态度更一般地映射出美国人民的态度：69%的天主教徒和62%的主流新教徒表示气候变化正在发生，福音派教徒对此表示同意的比例则为略占多数（51 % ） 。
en: These groups’ attitudes mirror those of Americans more generally: 69% of Catholics and 62% of mainline Protestants responded that climate change is happening, with a smaller majority of Evangelicals (51%) agreeing.

zh: 每个群体的大多数还同意全球变暖会伤害自然环境和子孙后代，遏制全球变暖有助于环境和子孙后代。
en: Majorities in each group also agreed that global warming will harm the natural environment and future generations, and that reducing global warming would help the environment and future generations.

zh: 那么，哪些美国少数群体反对气候行动呢？
en: Which minority of Americans, then, opposes climate action?

zh: 主要有三个群体。
en: There are three main groups.

zh: 第一个群体是自由市场保守派，他们似乎担心政府干预甚于担心气候变化。
en: The first are free-market conservatives, who seem to fear government intervention more than climate change.

zh: 一些该思想的追随者甚至否认铁一样的科学：因为政府干预是坏的，所有他们告诉自己科学也不可能是真的。
en: Some have followed their ideology to the point of denying well-established science: because government intervention is bad, they tell themselves that the science simply cannot be true.

zh: 第二个群体是原教旨主义者。
en: The second group comprises religious fundamentalists.

zh: 他们否认气候变化是因为他们完全拒绝地球科学，他们相信世界会被重新创造，完全不顾物理学、化学和地质学的如山铁证。
en: They deny climate change because they reject earth science entirely, believing the world to be newly created, contrary to the overwhelming evidence of physics, chemistry, and geology.

zh: 但目前第三个群体才是政治上力量最大的群体：石油和煤炭利益集团，2014年，他们投入数亿美元用于选战。
en: But it is the third group that is by far the most powerful politically: oil and coal interests, which contributed hundreds of millions of dollars to the 2014 campaign.

zh: 美国最大的政治献金者大卫和查尔斯·科奇（David and Charles Koch）兄弟是石油商，他们只顾让自己的巨额财富翻倍，丝毫不顾其他人类。
en: David and Charles Koch, America’s biggest campaign financiers, are simply oilmen out to multiply their gargantuan wealth, despite the costs to the rest of humanity.

zh: 也许他们也是真正的气候否认者。
en: Perhaps they are true climate deniers as well.

zh: 而厄普顿·辛克莱尔（Upton Sinclair）有句著名的讽刺 ： “ 让一个人理解某些东西很难，如果他的薪水取决于他不理解这些东西的话。 ”
en: Then again, as Upton Sinclair famously quipped, “It is difficult to get a man to understand something, when his salary depends on his not understanding it.”

zh: 方济各的有一批拼着可能来自所有这三个群体，但他们至少部分地有第三个群体的资助。
en: Francis’s right-wing critics perhaps come from all three groups, but they are at least partly funded by the third.

zh: 教宗科学和社会科学院（Pontifical Academies of Sciences and Social Sciences）以及一些世界顶尖地球和社会科学家4月份在梵蒂冈召开会议时，自由派的哈兰学会（Heartland Institute，多年来一直接受科奇兄弟的支持）在圣彼得广场外阻止了一场徒劳的示威。
en: When the Pontifical Academies of Sciences and Social Sciences and some of the world’s top earth and social scientists met at the Vatican in April, the libertarian Heartland Institute, supported over the years by the Koch brothers, mounted a fruitless protest outside of St. Peter’s Square.

zh: 前往梵蒂冈与会的科学家格外关注强调了气候科学和政策反映了物理学、化学、地质学、天文学、工程学、经济学和社会学的基本原理，其中的关键部分一百多年前便已被人们很好地认识到了。
en: The scientists at the Vatican meeting took extra care to emphasize that climate science and policy reflect fundamental principles of physics, chemistry, geology, astronomy, engineering, economics, and sociology, key parts of which have been well understood for more than 100 years.

zh: 但教皇的右翼批评者在神学方面与在科学方面一样错误百出。
en: Yet the pope’s right-wing critics are as mistaken in their theology as they are in their science.

zh: 他们宣称教皇应该坚守道德领域，这是对罗马天主教廷的根本误解。
en: The claim that the pope should stick with morality betrays a basic misunderstanding of Roman Catholicism.

zh: 教会标榜的是信仰与理性的结合。
en: The Church champions the marriage of faith and reason.

zh: 至少从托马斯·阿奎那的《神学大全 》 （ Summa Theologica，1265—1274年）出版以来，自然定律和黄金规则（Golden Rule）就被认为是教会理论的基本支柱。
en: At least since the publication of Thomas Aquinas’s Summa Theologica (1265-74), natural law and the Golden Rule have been viewed as the fundamental pillars of the Church’s teachings.

zh: 大部分人都知道，天主教会反对伽利略对哥白尼日心说的支持，教皇保罗二世为此在1992年进行了道歉。
en: Most people know that the Church opposed Galileo’s advocacy of Copernican heliocentrism, for which Pope John Paul II apologized in 1992.

zh: 但许多人不知道天主教会对现代科学的支持，包括许多世界领先的天主教牧师在生物学、化学和物理学方面做出的重要贡献。
en: But many are unaware of the Church’s support for modern science, including many important contributions to biology, chemistry, and physics by world-leading Catholic clerics.

zh: 事实上，教宗科学院的前身可以追溯到400等多年前的猞猁学院（Accademia dei Lincei ） ， 伽利略1661年开始在该学院任职。
en: Indeed, the founding of the Pontifical Academy of Sciences traces its origins back more than 400 years, to the Academy of Lynxes (Accademia dei Lincei), which inducted Galileo in 1611.

zh: 当然，方济各的目的不是将现代科学 — — 包括自然科学和社会科学 — — 与信仰和道德联系起来。
en: Francis’s purpose, of course, is to marry modern science, both natural and social, with faith and morality.

zh: 我们好不容易获得的科学知识必须用于促进人类福祉、保护弱势群体和穷人、保护地球脆弱的生态系统、守信于子孙后代。
en: Our hard-won scientific knowledge should be used to promote human wellbeing, protect the vulnerable and the poor, preserve Earth’s fragile ecosystems, and keep faith with future generations.

zh: 可续可以揭露人类引起的环境危机；工程学可以创造保护地球的工具；信仰和道德理性可以提供实践智慧（如亚里士多德和阿奎那所言 ） ， 让我们做出符合共同利益又合乎道德的选择。
en: Science can reveal the environmental dangers caused by humanity; engineering can create the tools to protect the planet; and faith and moral reasoning can provide the practical wisdom (as Aristotle and Aquinas would have said) to choose virtuously for the common good.

zh: 4月的梵蒂冈会议不但包括了世界领先的气候科学家和诺贝尔奖得主，也包括了来自新教、印度教、犹太教、佛教和穆斯林等各种信仰的高级代表。
en: The Vatican gathering in April included not only world-leading climate scientists and Nobel laureates, but also senior representatives of the Protestant, Hindu, Jewish, Buddhist, and Muslim faiths.

zh: 和方济各一样，全球各大主要宗教的宗教领袖敦促我们从信仰和气候科学中汲取智慧，以旅行我们对人类和对地球未来的道德责任。
en: Like Francis, religious leaders of all the world’s major religions are urging us to take wisdom from faith and climate science in order to fulfill our moral responsibilities to humanity and to the future of Earth.

zh: 我们应该听从他们的召唤。
en: We should heed their call.

zh: 适应问题
en: The Adaptation Imperative

zh: 内罗毕—在最近的秘鲁利马联合国气候变化会议准备期间，全世界的注意力集中在了各国将就减少温室气体排放的问题作出多么强的承诺。
en: NAIROBI – In the run-up to the recent United Nations meeting on climate change in Lima, Peru, much of the world’s attention focused on how strongly countries would commit to a framework for cutting greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 毕竟，政府对这一框架的承诺对于确保12月的巴黎协议能够让全球气温升温幅度限制在前工业化水平以上2℃之内至关重要。
en: Governments’ commitment to such a framework, after all, is vital to ensure that the agreement to be signed in Paris in December will keep global temperatures from rising more than 2º Celsius above pre-industrial levels.

zh: 好消息是利马的“气候行动号召”取得了重大进展，足以为在巴黎达成全面气候协议做好准备。
en: The good news is that the Lima “Call for Climate Action” made sufficient progress to enable preparations for a comprehensive climate deal in Paris.

zh: 但利马仍留下了许多未解决的问题 — — 关于适应（adaption）的讨论就反映了这一不足。
en: But it also left many questions unresolved – a shortcoming that was reflected in discussions on adaptation.

zh: 尽管对这一重要话题的新强调值得欢迎，但如何筹集资金、技术和知识以使国家、社会和生态系统能够适应气候变化仍有待进一步解决。
en: Though the new emphasis on this important topic is welcome, how to deliver the funding, technology, and knowledge that countries, communities, and ecosystems need to adjust to climate change requires further articulation.

zh: 即使我们能限制住全球气温的升高，气候变化也会继续发生。
en: Even if we limit the rise in global temperatures, climate change is here to stay.

zh: 各国社会已经开始面临更加极端和频繁的旱灾、水灾和其他气候事件。
en: Communities are already facing more extreme and frequent droughts, floods, and other weather events.

zh: 这些后果将继续恶化。
en: These consequences will only intensify.

zh: 但在利马发布的联合国环境署首份 适应报告表明，世界对于覆盖适应成本完全没有准备。
en: Yet the UN Environment Programme’s first adaptation report, released in Lima, showed that the world remains wholly unprepared to cover the costs of adaptation.

zh: 这些成本将远高于我们此前所设想的。
en: And those costs will be far higher than was previously thought.

zh: 根据该报告，即使气温目标实现，适应成本仍将比此前所预计的至2050年供700—1,000亿美元高1—2倍（甚至有可能高四倍，但可能性较低 ） 。
en: According to the report, even if the temperature target is met, the cost of adaptation will reach 2-3 times the previously anticipated $70-100 billion per year by 2050 (an increase of as much as fivefold is possible, though less likely).

zh: 如果全球气温大幅超过两摄氏度的上限，适应成本将达到最坏情形数字的两倍，世界经济将不堪重负。
en: If global temperatures exceed the two-degree ceiling significantly, adaptation costs could reach double the worst-case figures, placing a crippling burden on the world economy.

zh: 如果世界领导人还需要其他理由才愿意在巴黎达成将全球气温限制在该目标以下的协议的话，上面的计算就是了。
en: If world leaders needed another compelling reason to reach a deal in Paris that keeps global temperatures below the target, this is it.

zh: 调整的成本将由我们每一个人来承担。
en: The burden of adjustment will be borne by everyone.

zh: 但发展中国家、最不发达国家和小型发展中岛国的负担最重。
en: But it will be heaviest for developing countries, least-developed countries, and Small Island Developing States.

zh: 尽管可以获得国际资金，但成本主要将落在国家头上，政府将被迫将宝贵的资源从发展工程挪给适应项目。
en: Though international funding will be available, costs will fall largely to countries, with governments forced to divert scarce resources from development projects to adaptation initiatives.

zh: 诚然，在解决适应需要方面，世界正在进步。
en: To be sure, the world is making some progress toward addressing adaptation needs.

zh: 2012—2013年，来自公共资源的适应资金达到了230—260亿美元。
en: Adaptation funding from public sources reached $23-26 billion in 2012-2013.

zh: 根据联合国气候变化框架公约的最新评估，2011—2012年用于移民和适应措施的全球金融流为3,400—6,500亿美元。
en: According to a recent assessment by the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, global financial flows for mitigation and adaptation measures amounted to $340-650 billion in 2011-2012.

zh: 此外，在利马会议上，澳大利亚、奥地利、比利时、哥伦比亚、挪威和秘鲁承诺为绿色气候基金（Green Climate Fund）注资近102亿美元。
en: Furthermore, pledges at the Lima conference by Australia, Austria, Belgium, Colombia, Norway, and Peru bring the Green Climate Fund to nearly $10.2 billion.

zh: 气候变化的影响正在逐渐扩大，但仍不足以纳入国民和地方预算的考虑因素。
en: And the impact of climate change is increasingly, though still inadequately, being factored into national and local budgets.

zh: 但要防止2020年后出现资金缺口，我们还需要大量融资。
en: But much more financing will be needed to prevent a funding gap after 2020.

zh: 比如，绿色气候基金计划在未来五年每年筹资1,000亿美元 — — 比当前水平高十倍。
en: The Green Climate Fund, for example, is supposed to reach $100 billion per year – ten times higher than it is now – in the next five years.

zh: 巴黎协议中的适应承诺将极大地有利于填补这一缺口。
en: Commitments on adaptation in the Paris agreement would go a long way toward closing this gap.

zh: 国际排放许可拍卖和本国碳排交易机制、碳税、国际转移支付收入、输电附加费和金融交易税将能产生每年2,200亿美元的新增收入。
en: The international auctioning of emissions allowances and allowances in domestic emissions-trading schemes, a carbon tax, revenues from international transport, a surcharge on electricity transmission, and financial transaction taxes could generate as much as $220 billion per year in additional revenues.

zh: 当然，融资绝非成功的适应战略的唯一要素。
en: Of course, funding is not the only component of a successful adaptation strategy.

zh: 联合国适应报告强调，填补技术和只是缺口也很关键。
en: As the adaptation report emphasizes, closing gaps in technology and knowledge is also crucial.

zh: 已有很多技术能够帮助各国适应气候变化的后果。
en: Many technologies that could help countries adapt to the consequences of climate change already exist.

zh: 比如，种植生长更快的科学转基因作物可以让农民抢在（比如）飓风季之前收获，而随着全球气温的上升，飓风的破坏力越来越大。
en: For example, by planting scientifically engineered crops that grow faster, farmers can harvest them before, say, cyclone season, which will become increasingly violent as global temperatures rise.

zh: 但仍然存在巨大的适应壁垒 — — 政府应该通过激励、监管改革和制度升级相结合的手段移除这些壁垒。
en: But there remain significant barriers to adoption – barriers that governments should dismantle through a combination of incentives, regulatory reform, and institutional upgrading.

zh: 这些行动的好处远不止于增加气候恢复力。
en: The benefits of such action would extend beyond increased climate resilience.

zh: 加速收获意味着用更少劳动力获得更高更可靠的产量 — — 这可以带来更高、更稳定的生活水平。
en: Accelerating harvests would mean higher, more reliable production with less labor – a formula for stronger, more stable livelihoods.

zh: 因此，决策者应该追求整合方案 — — 将气候变化适应和移民与更广泛的社会问题（如发展）结合起来。
en: Policymakers should thus pursue integrated solutions that combine climate-change adaptation and mitigation with broader societal concerns, including development.

zh: 知识也能起到类似的动力推动作用。
en: Knowledge would offer similarly monumental benefits.

zh: 《科学》杂志最近发表了一项研究，认为全民教育可以让人民获得必要而适宜的知识工具和技能，因而是适应气候变化、降低极端天气事件致命伤害的最有效的机制。
en: Science magazine recently published research suggesting that universal education, by giving populations the appropriate intellectual tools and skills they need, is the single most efficient mechanism for adapting to climate change and reducing fatalities associated with extreme weather events.

zh: 对适应的国际支持 — — 结合融资、技术和知识等各种手段 — — 极大地有利于推动各国的可持续发展雄心。
en: International support on adaptation – incorporating financing, technology, and knowledge – could go a long way toward advancing countries’ sustainable-development aspirations.

zh: 世界领导人应该认识到这一点 — — 并将适应作为欲在巴黎达成的全球气候变化协议的重要部分。
en: World leaders should recognize this – and establish adaptation as an integral part of the global climate-change agreement to be reached in Paris.

zh: 有人指出，全球经济无法承担适应成本。
en: Some argue that the global economy cannot afford adaptation.

zh: 但是，最新证据表明，拖延行动的会在随后造成更大的代价。
en: But, as the latest evidence shows, delaying action will mean higher costs later.

zh: 如果我们真的想要建设可持续、繁荣、平等的未来，就不能再等了。
en: If we truly want to build a sustainable, prosperous, and equitable future, we cannot afford to wait.

zh: 气候-冲突联合威胁
en: The Climate-Conflict Nexus

zh: 波士顿—从很多方面看，也门和南苏丹是两个世界。
en: BOSTON – Yemen and South Sudan are, in many ways, worlds apart.

zh: 但尽管它们的历史、传统和文化大相径庭，两国却有着同一个痛苦：它们的人民正在承受两大最严重的人造危机的重创：暴力冲突和气候变化。
en: But, despite vast differences in history, tradition, and culture, both countries share one painful feature: their people are now bearing the brunt of two of the most devastating manmade crises: violent conflict and climate change.

zh: 南苏丹陷入冲突已近十年。
en: South Sudan has been mired in conflict for nearly a decade.

zh: 光是在过去五年，就有数万人丧生，近四分之一人口流离失所，其中许多人只能逃往邻近的肯尼亚、乌干达和苏丹。
en: In the last five years alone, tens of thousands have died, and nearly a quarter of the population has been displaced, with many having little choice but to flee to neighboring Kenya, Uganda, or Sudan.

zh: 也门则成为地区影响力争夺战的前线：一方是力挺也门政府的沙特阿拉伯，另一方是支持胡赛叛军集团的伊朗。
en: Yemen, for its part, has emerged as a major front in the ongoing struggle for regional influence between Saudi Arabia, which has ties to Yemen’s government, and Iran, which supports the Houthi rebel group.

zh: 特别是沙特阿拉伯在最近几年中一直对也门进行毁灭性空袭，杀害了无辜平民，将也门基础设施 — — 包括公路、学校、医院、居民楼和市场 — — 夷为平地，让也门人民无法获得基本服务。
en: In recent years, Saudi Arabia, in particular, has been carrying out devastating air strikes that have killed countless civilians and reduced Yemen’s infrastructure – including roads, schools, hospitals, apartment complexes, and markets – to rubble, leaving the country’s people without access to essential services.

zh: 由于水和卫生设施的破坏，也门爆发了现代史上最严重的霍乱。
en: With water and sanitation facilities knocked out, the country is now facing the worst cholera outbreak in modern history.

zh: 暴力冲突的影响因为气候变化而加剧。
en: The effects of violent conflict are being exacerbated by climate change.

zh: 今年的气候变化脆弱指数（Climate Change Vulnerability Index）将南苏丹列为全世界五个最脆弱的国家之一，其气温升幅预计将是全球平均水平的近二点五倍。
en: This year’s Climate Change Vulnerability Index ranks South Sudan among the world’s five most vulnerable countries, with the increase in temperature expected to be nearly two and a half times larger than the global average.

zh: 这将摧毁这个已经陷入绝望中的国家，其95%的人口的生计都依赖气候相关活动，如农业、畜牧业和渔业。
en: This will devastate an already-desperate country, where the livelihoods of 95% of the population depend on climate-related services, from agriculture to animal husbandry and fisheries.

zh: 也门则是气候变化后果最真切的写照之一。
en: Yemen, for its part, is considered among the clearest examples of the tangible consequences of climate change.

zh: 据世界银行数据，自1970年以来，也门灌溉量增加了15倍，而雨水灌溉农业萎缩了近30 % 。
en: According to the World Bank, since 1970, irrigation in Yemen has increased by a factor of 15, as rain-fed agriculture has declined by nearly 30%.

zh: 也门面临着暴雨和夺命洪水 — — 2008年，也门南部洪灾导致了相当于GDP的6%的损失 — — 而在另一个极端，这里的干旱同样肆虐。
en: The country faces both heavy rains and deadly floods – in 2008, floods in southeastern Yemen resulted in losses equivalent to 6% of GDP – and, at the other extreme, devastating droughts.

zh: 全球医疗业日益认识到，战争的传统后果 — — 如受伤、心理创伤和流离失所 — — 因为气候变化效应而加剧，这影响到营养和发育。
en: The global health community is now increasingly recognizing the extent to which the traditional consequences of war – such as injury, trauma, and displacement – are being compounded by the effects of climate change, which undermines nutrition and development.

zh: 比如，在也门，冲突可能导致因为气候变化而变得十分稀缺的水资源受到污染。
en: For example, conflict can, as in Yemen, result in the contamination of water resources, which are already being depleted by climate change.

zh: 类似地，气候变化导致庄稼歉收和生计损失，进而造成营养不良，影响到人民从暴力冲突的伤痛中恢复的能力和应对移民挑战的能力 — — 而这一局面因为医疗基础设施被毁而雪上加霜。
en: Similarly, malnutrition, rooted in the loss of crops and livelihoods from climate change, undermines people’s ability to recover from injuries sustained in violent conflict or endure the challenges of migration – a situation exacerbated by the destruction of health-care infrastructure.

zh: 如此等等。
en: The list goes on.

zh: 所有这些都不是巧合。
en: None of this is a matter of coincidence.

zh: 事实上，如今研究者担心冲突和气候变化之间互相强化，经济和农业损失以及水短缺，所引发的冲突随后进一步影响到健康和生计。
en: In fact, researchers are now concerned that conflict and climate change are mutually reinforcing, with economic and agricultural losses, as well as water shortages, triggering conflicts that then undermine health and livelihoods further.

zh: 在这样的环境下，旧疾病（如霍乱）或新疾病的爆发可能导致新的地区和全球大流行。
en: In such an environment, outbreaks of an old disease (such as cholera) or a new one may lead to new regional and global pandemics.

zh: 情况因为政治算计而进一步复杂化，包括地缘政治考虑（如沙特阿拉伯在也门的幕后行动，以及美国为了迎合选民而拒绝接受科学证据 ） 。
en: The situation is further complicated by political calculations, including geostrategic considerations, like those behind Saudi Arabia’s actions in Yemen, and the rejection of scientific evidence in order to pander to constituents, as in the United States.

zh: 事实上，美国总统特朗普政府撤出巴黎气候协定必然会削弱世界面对气候变化的集体应对力。
en: In fact, the withdrawal of US President Donald Trump’s administration from the Paris climate agreement is set to weaken the world’s collective ability to respond to climate change.

zh: 妇女健康援助资金的削减 — — 这也是特朗普政府的政策 — — 亦然。
en: Cuts in aid funding for women’s health – another Trump administration policy – will not help matters.

zh: 现实是，面对与冲突和气候变化有关的联动性挑战，需要全面的解决方案。
en: The reality is that confronting the interconnected challenges associated with conflict and climate change demands comprehensive solutions.

zh: 当然，有影响力的国家 — — 包括中国、法国和德国 — — 能够起到填补特朗普政府放弃全球领导责任所留下的空白的作用。
en: Of course, influential countries – including China, France, and Germany – have a role to play in filling the gap left by the Trump administration’s retreat from global leadership.

zh: 但科学界和公共卫生界也必须站出来反思如何在冲突环境中管理疾病和处理水短缺。
en: But the scientific and public-health communities must also step up and rethink how to manage diseases and handle water shortages in conflict environments.

zh: 我们已经看到，缺少系统层面的解决方案会带来什么后果。
en: We have already seen what happens in the absence of systems-level solutions.

zh: 以2014年西非埃博拉疫情为例：尽管在应对疟疾方面，支持项目和基础设施准备得十分充分，但各国对于处理新的卫生挑战几乎束手无策。
en: Consider the 2014 Ebola outbreak in West Africa: despite ample support programs and infrastructure focused on confronting malaria, countries were not even remotely prepared to handle a new health challenge.

zh: 埃博拉爆发时，系统应声崩溃 — — 并带来严重的人道和经济后果。
en: When Ebola emerged, the system simply broke down – with overwhelming human and economic consequences.

zh: 因此，科学界和公共卫生界必须立即行动起来深化对冲突和气候变化的综合挑战的理解，找出并填补知识空白。
en: That is why the scientific and public-health communities must work urgently to deepen their understanding of the integrated challenges of conflict and climate change, finding and filling gaps in knowledge.

zh: 第一步是要对当前的局面进行清醒的评估，这肯定要求对现有方案的可靠性和效果进行严格的事实核查。
en: The first step is a clear-eyed assessment of the current state of affairs, which will surely produce a harsh reality check regarding the resilience and effectiveness of existing solutions.

zh: 必须认识到，冲突和气候变化的联合威胁正以飞快的速度蔓延和恶化，解决这一威胁需要跨学科的、基于证据的新工具和方案。
en: It is time to recognize the speed at which the combined threat of conflict and climate change is spreading and intensifying, and that addressing it requires new multidisciplinary, evidence-based tools and solutions.

zh: 控制、限制乃至从根本上扭转气候-冲突联合威胁在我们的集体能力范围之内。
en: It is within our collective capacity to control, limit, and potentially even reverse the effects of the climate-conflict nexus.

zh: 但我们需要行动起来。
en: But we have to do the work.

zh: 打破欧洲的气候变化僵局
en: Breaking Europe’s Climate-Change Stalemate

zh: 伦敦—欧洲有充当遏制气候变化领导者的强大传统。
en: LONDON – Europe has a strong tradition as a leader in the fight against climate change.

zh: 但是，最近，欧洲大陆遇到了关于如何解决这一问题的意识形态僵局，环境可持续性和经济增长常常被描述为水火不容。
en: Lately, however, the continent has reached an ideological impasse over how to address the problem, with environmental sustainability and growth often portrayed as being mutually exclusive.

zh: 如果欧洲想要保持环境领导者的地位，又不失去创新和竞争力中心的地位，就必须抛弃僵化的意识形态，采取现实、务实的办法，实现环境收益又不致牺牲经济发展。
en: If Europe is to remain an environmental leader, as well as a center of innovation and competitiveness, it will have to abandon its ideological rigidness and embrace realistic, pragmatic solutions that can deliver environmental benefits without sacrificing economic development.

zh: 气候变化带来的挑战是实实在在的，不作为的风险也是不可忽视的。
en: The challenges posed by climate change are real, and the consequences of inaction are impossible to ignore.

zh: 与此同时，能源需求日益高涨，找到走出当前经济危机的长期办法也十分紧迫。
en: At the same time, there is a growing demand for energy and a desperate need for a long-term exit from the ongoing economic crisis.

zh: 没有简单易行的办法可以一举解决这两大难题。
en: There is no single, easy solution that addresses both of these imperatives.

zh: 在遏制全球变暖的同时确保经济增长需要平衡的方案组合，包括可再生能源和增加能源效率。
en: Reining in global warming while ensuring economic growth will require a balanced portfolio of solutions, including renewable energy and increased energy efficiency.

zh: 这些方案的关键在于碳捕捉和储存（carbon capture and storage，CSS ） 。
en: Essential among such solutions is carbon capture and storage.

zh: CCS技术在你排放源头捕捉二氧化碳，进行压缩然后永久存储于地下。
en: CCS technology captures carbon dioxide at the source of its emission, compresses it, and stores it permanently underground.

zh: 它提供了在保持有竞争力的工业部门的同时遏制全球变暖的途径。
en: This provides the means for maintaining a competitive industrial sector while simultaneously combating global warming.

zh: 平心而论，与所有创新一样，CCS技术的可行性存在问题。
en: To be sure, as with any innovation, there are questions about the technology's viability.

zh: 但是，指出一点很重要：这些成本与在没有CCS技术的情况下降低二氧化碳排放的巨大成本比起来根本不值一提。
en: It is important to note, however, that these costs pale in comparison with the far greater costs of reducing CO2 emissions without CCS.

zh: 比如，根据国际能源署的数据 , ， CCS部署推迟十年将让电力部门增加7,500亿欧元的去碳化成本。
en: According to the International Energy Agency, for example, a ten-year delay in deploying CCS would increase the cost of decarburizing the power sector by €750 billion ($880 billion).

zh: 它明确表示，CCS必须成为解决方案的一部分。 CCS是唯一一种可以捕捉全球最大二氧化碳制造者至少90%的排放量的技术。
en: It has made it clear that CCS, the only technology that can capture at least 90% of the CO2 emissions from the world's largest producers, must be a part of the solution.

zh: 在欧洲之外，政府和企业已经开始起头并进了。
en: Beyond Europe's borders, governments and businesses are already forging ahead.

zh: 在加拿大，世界首个全规模CCS工程 — — 边界大坝（Boundary Dam）已于2014年10月开始运转，证明了该技术可行并做好了部署的准备。
en: In Canada, the world's first full-scale CCS project, Boundary Dam, came onstream in October 2014, proving that the technology is viable and ready to be deployed.

zh: 阿联酋启动了全球钢铁行业中的首个大规模CCS工程。
en: The United Arab Emirates has initiated the world's first large-scale CCS project in the iron and steel sector.

zh: 中国一直表现出对这项技术的浓厚兴趣，并正在与美国合作发展期CCS技术能力。
en: China continues to show great interest in the technology, and is collaborating with the United States to develop its CCS capabilities.

zh: 欧洲不可以落后。
en: Europe cannot afford to lag behind.

zh: 能源密集型行业直接支持了欧洲大陆400万个工作岗位。
en: Energy-intensive industries directly support four million jobs across the continent.

zh: 投资于CCS有助于通过确保和增加工作岗位、保护关键行业捍卫欧洲的经济基础。
en: Investing in CCS would help preserve Europe's economic base by securing and creating jobs and protecting vital industries.

zh: 它有助于实现支持可持续性和发展的欧洲愿景 — — 这一愿景显然与欧盟委员会主席容克的优先目标（创造就业岗位、维持增长和发展有竞争力的能源联盟）相一致。
en: It would help to realize a vision of Europe that supports both sustainability and growth – a vision that is clearly in line with European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker's priorities of creating jobs, sustaining growth, and developing a competitive energy union.

zh: 但是，为了让降低二氧化碳成为可能，我们需要现实的政策和战略。
en: But, in order for that to be possible, realistic policies and strategies are needed.

zh: 但欧洲应该将认可转化为具体行动。
en: But it is time to translate recognition into concrete action.

zh: 这反过来需要投资激励、改进碳定价、升级碳排交易系统。
en: That, in turn, requires investment incentives, improved carbon pricing, and an upgrade to the emissions trading system.

zh: 局面改变方案需要强大的政治意愿；欧洲领导人表现出他们明白需要做什么，这一点至关重要。
en: A game-changing solution presupposes substantial political will; it is essential that European leaders show that they know what needs to be done.

zh: 可持续增长不必是矛盾。
en: Sustainable growth need not be an oxymoron.

zh: 要实现它，欧洲必须克服让环境争论陷入瘫痪的意识形态僵局。
en: But to achieve it, Europe must overcome the ideological stalemate that is paralyzing the environmental debate.

zh: 要让我们的环境要务与持续增长相契合，就必须现实地、务实地以及 — — 最重要的 — — 立刻展开行动。
en: To reconcile our environmental priorities with continued growth, we must act realistically, pragmatically, and – above all – immediately.

zh: 我们现在都是气候难民
en: We Are All Climate Refugees Now

zh: 纽约 — — 出生于一个被称为全新世的气候时代的现代人类已经跨过边界进入到另一个气候时代，人类世之中。
en: NEW YORK – Modern humans, born into one climate era, called the Holocene, have crossed the border into another, the Anthropocene.

zh: 但在这片危险的全新荒野中不但没有摩西来引导人类，反而出现了一群否认科学者和污染者，正误导人类走向更严峻的危险之中。
en: But instead of a Moses guiding humanity in this new and dangerous wilderness, a gang of science deniers and polluters currently misguides humanity to ever-greater danger.

zh: 我们现在都是必须寻找安全之路的气候难民。
en: We are all climate refugees now and must chart a path to safety.

zh: 正如我们所知，全新世是10，000多年前开始的地质时代，拥有有利的气候条件支撑人类文明。
en: The Holocene was the geological age that started more than 10,000 years ago, with favorable climate conditions that supported human civilization as we know it.

zh: 人类世则是一个新的地质时代，拥有人类从未体验过的新的环境。
en: The Anthropocene is a new geological era with environmental conditions that humanity has never before experienced.

zh: 不幸的是，地球的温度现在高于全新世时代，因为人类通过燃烧煤、石油和天然气而将大量二氧化碳排放到空气中，而且不分青红皂白将全世界的森林和草原开发成农场和牧场。
en: Ominously, the Earth’s temperature is now higher than during the Holocene, owing to the carbon dioxide that humanity has emitted into the atmosphere by burning coal, oil, and gas, and by indiscriminately turning the world’s forests and grasslands into farms and pastures.

zh: 人们正在新环境中遭受苦难和死亡，未来情况还会变的更糟。
en: People are suffering and dying in the new environment, with much worse to come.

zh: 据估计，飓风玛丽亚去年9月在波多黎各造成超过4，000人死亡。
en: Hurricane Maria is estimated to have taken more than 4,000 lives in Puerto Rico last September.

zh: 高强度飓风越来越频繁，而大型风暴正在造成更多 洪水，因为来自变暖海域的热量传递增加、变暖的空气更加潮湿，而且海平面上升 — — 所有这一切都因为人为引发的气候变化而进入到更加极端的情况。
en: High-intensity hurricanes are becoming more frequent, and major storms are causing more flooding, because of the increased heat transfer from the warming waters of the oceans, the greater moisture in warmer air, and the rise in sea levels – all made more extreme by human-induced climate change.

zh: 就在上个月，因干旱和高温所引发的一场毁灭性的森林大火导致雅典郊区90多人死亡。
en: Just last month, more than 90 people perished in the suburbs of Athens from a devastating forest fire stoked by drought and high temperatures.

zh: 而今年夏天，在加利福尼亚、瑞典、英国和澳大利亚等其他炎热和最新干旱地区，同样出现了森林火灾肆虐的情况。
en: Huge forest fires are similarly raging this summer in other hot and newly dry locales, including California, Sweden, Britain, and Australia.

zh: 去年，葡萄牙遭到破坏。
en: Last year, Portugal was devastated.

zh: 今年夏天，世界许多地方都出现了创记录的高温。
en: Many record-high temperatures are being reached around the world this summer.

zh: 人类如何肆无忌惮地冲过全新世边界 — — 就像恐怖电影里的角色那样 — — 完全无视一切明显的警示迹象。
en: How utterly reckless of humanity to have rushed past the Holocene boundary, ignoring – like a character in a horror movie – all of the obvious warning signs.

zh: 1972年，各国政府在斯德哥尔摩召开会议，讨论日益严重的环境威胁。
en: In 1972, the world’s governments assembled in Stockholm to address the growing environmental threats.

zh: 在会议召开前，罗马俱乐部发布了增长极限，首次提出了“可持续”发展轨迹和环境超调风险等概念。
en: In the lead-up to the conference, the Club of Rome published The Limits to Growth, which first introduced the idea of a “sustainable” growth trajectory and the risks of environmental overshooting.

zh: 20年后，里约热内卢亮起了刺眼的红灯，联合国成员国齐聚地球峰会，接纳“可持续发展”理念并签署了制止人为引发的全球变暖、保护生物多样性和阻止土地退化及荒漠化等三项主要的环境公约。
en: Twenty years later, the warning signs flashed brightly in Rio de Janeiro, where United Nations member states assembled at the Earth Summit to adopt the concept of “sustainable development” and to sign three major environmental treaties to halt human-induced global warming, protect biological diversity, and stop land degradation and desertification.

zh: 1992年后，全球最强国家美国明目张胆地无视这三项全新条约，并暗示其他国家放松努力。
en: After 1992, the United States, the world’s most powerful country, ostentatiously ignored the three new treaties, signaling to other countries that they could slacken their efforts as well.

zh: 美国参议院批准了气候和荒漠化条约，但却没有采取任何措施来加以实施。
en: The US Senate ratified the climate and desertification treaties but did nothing to implement them.

zh: 国会甚至拒绝批准保护生物多样性条约，部分由于西部各州的共和党坚持认为土地所有者有权在拒绝国际干涉的情况下利用财产做自己想做的事情。
en: And it refused even to ratify the treaty to protect biological diversity, in part because western-state Republicans insisted that landowners have the right to do what they want with their property without international meddling.

zh: 最新进展是，世界在2015年9月通过了可持续发展目标，并在2015年12月通过了巴黎气候协定。
en: More recently, the world adopted the Sustainable Development Goals in September 2015 and the Paris climate agreement in December 2015.

zh: 但美国政府再次故意无视可持续发展目标，同时在政府落实工作方面处于二十国集团的垫底位置。
en: Yet, once again, the US government has willfully ignored the SDGs, ranking last among the G20 countries in terms of government implementation efforts.

zh: 同时唐纳德·特朗普总统宣布他打算在协议生效四年后的2020年，第一时间让美国退出巴黎气候协定。
en: And President Donald Trump has declared his intention to pull the US out of the Paris climate agreement at the earliest possible moment, 2020, four years after the accord entered into force.

zh: 更糟糕的情况还未出现。
en: Worse is to come.

zh: 由于海洋温度影响相当滞后，人为导致的二氧化碳含量上升尚未达到其全面升温效应的最高峰。
en: The human-caused rise in CO2 hasn’t yet reached its full warming effect, owing to the considerable lag in its impact on ocean temperatures.

zh: 未来几十年还会出现0.5℃左右的全球变暖，这一推断来自大气中二氧化碳的当前浓度（百万分比浓度408 ） ， 而且如果人类一如既往地燃烧化石燃料导致二氧化碳浓度继续飙升，上述时点以后升温效应将更加严重。
en: There is still another 0.5º Celsius or so of warming to occur over the coming decades based on the current concentration of CO2 (408 parts per million) in the atmosphere, and far more warming beyond that if CO2 concentrations continue to soar with the business-as-usual burning of fossil fuels.

zh: 要想实现巴黎协议将升温控制在相对于前工业化水平“远低于2℃”的目标，世界需要在2050年左右果断实现从煤、石油和天然气向可再生能源的过渡，并且从森林砍伐到重新造林及退化土地的恢复。
en: To achieve the Paris agreement’s goal of limiting warming to “well below 2ºC” relative to the pre-industrial level, the world needs to shift decisively from coal, oil, and gas to renewable energy by around 2050, and from deforestation to reforestation and restoration of degraded lands.

zh: 那么人类为什么要在注定的悲剧中愚蠢地向前冲？
en: So why does humanity keep plunging dumbly ahead, toward certain tragedy?

zh: 主要原因是我们的政治体制和大企业故意无视危险和破坏的不断上升。
en: The main reason is that our political institutions and giant corporations willfully ignore the rising dangers and damage.

zh: 政治是为了获取并拥有权力和担任公职的好处，而不是为了解决问题，哪怕是生死攸关的环境问题。
en: Politics is about obtaining and holding power and the perks of office, not about solving problems, even life-and-death environmental problems.

zh: 管理一家大企业是为了股东价值最大化，而不是为了实话实说或避免对地球造成损伤。
en: Managing a major company is about maximizing shareholder value, not about telling the truth or avoiding great harm to the planet.

zh: 追求利润的投资者拥有主流媒体，至少也可以通过购买广告来影响它。
en: Profit-seeking investors own the major media, or at least influence it through their advertising purchases.

zh: 因此，一个小而强的集团维系着以化石燃料为基础的能源系统，不惜对今天和未来的其他人造成越来越大的伤害。
en: Thus, a small yet very powerful group maintains the fossil-fuel-based energy system at growing peril to the rest of humanity today and in the future.

zh: 特朗普是在国会共和党人的怂恿下，服务于污染者利益的最新一个有用的傻瓜。 国会共和党人用科赫工业等环境犯罪企业的捐款来支持竞选活动。
en: Trump is the latest useful fool doing the polluters’ bidding, abetted by congressional Republicans who finance their election campaigns with contributions from environmental culprits such as Koch Industries.

zh: 特朗普在美国政府中塞满了行业游说者，这些人正在系统性地破坏他们能够触及的每一项环境法规。
en: Trump has filled the US government with industry lobbyists who are systematically dismantling every environmental regulation they can reach.

zh: 最近，特朗普已经提名大型污染企业陶氏化学的前律师来领导环保署的超级基金毒物清理计划。
en: Most recently, Trump has nominated a former lawyer for mega-polluter Dow Chemical to lead the Environmental Protection Agency’s Superfund toxic cleanup program.

zh: 这样的事实不是编出来的。
en: You can’t make this stuff up.

zh: 我们需要源于明确全球目标的一种全新政治：那就是通过履行巴黎气候协定、保护生物多样性和减少每年致死数百万人的污染，保护全球民众在安全的环境中生活。
en: We need a new kind of politics that starts with a clear global goal: environmental safety for the planet’s people, by fulfilling the Paris climate agreement, protecting biodiversity, and cutting pollution, which kills millions each year.

zh: 新政治将听取科学和技术专家的意见，远离自私自利的企业领袖和自恋的政治家。
en: The new politics will listen to scientific and technological experts, not self-interested business leaders and narcissistic politicians.

zh: 气候学家使我们能够衡量不断上升的危险。
en: Climatologists enable us to gauge the rising dangers.

zh: 工程师则告诉我们如何到2050年实现向零碳能源的快速过渡。
en: Engineers inform us how to make the rapid transition, by 2050, to zero-carbon energy.

zh: 生态学家和农学家告诉我们如何在更少的土地上种植更多更好的作物，同时结束森林砍伐并让已经退化的土地得到恢复。
en: Ecologists and agronomists show us how to grow more and better crops on less land while ending deforestation and restoring previously degraded land.

zh: 这样的新政治其实有可能。
en: Such a politics is possible.

zh: 事实上，它符合公众的需求。
en: In fact, the public yearns for it.

zh: 例如，绝大多数美国人想要对抗全球变暖，保留巴黎气候协议并拥抱可再生能源。
en: A large majority of the American people, for example, want to fight global warming, stay in the Paris climate agreement, and embrace renewable energy.

zh: 但只要狭隘无知的精英集团迫使美国和其他国家民众在政治的沙漠中漫无目的的游荡，我们就越有可能最终陷入一片荒野，任凭 谁也无法逃脱。
en: Yet, as long as a narrow and ignorant elite condemn Americans and the rest of humanity to wander aimlessly in the political desert, the more likely it is that we will all end up in a wasteland from which there will be no escape.

zh: 气候安全的移民
en: Making Migration Safe for Climate Nexus

zh: 纽约—人类正在移动。
en: NEW YORK – Humanity is on the move.

zh: 我们生活在一个前所未有思想、资金以及（日益加强的）人员流动时代。
en: We are living in an era of unprecedented mobility of ideas, money, and, increasingly, people.

zh: 庞大的人口数量，以及我们消费资源的方式，深远地影响着我们的世界。
en: The sheer size of the human population, combined with how we consume resources, is profoundly reshaping our world.

zh: 我们的“拿-做-存”经济模式为许多国家的数亿人口创造了财富，大幅减少了全球贫困，但也让太多的人落在了身后。
en: While our “take-make-dispose” economic model has created wealth for hundreds of millions of people in many countries, reducing global poverty significantly, it has also left too many behind.

zh: 关键是，这让子孙后代面临着巨大的社会、经济和环境风险。
en: Crucially, it exposes future generations to immense social, economic, and environmental risks.

zh: 也许最重要的风险来自温室气体正在比以往6,600万年更快的速度填充着大气层。
en: And perhaps the most important risk stems from filling the atmosphere with greenhouse gases at a rate higher than at any time in the last 66 million years.

zh: 今天，有十亿人是移民，在国内外迁移。
en: One billion people alive today are migrants, having moved within or beyond their national borders.

zh: 他们成为移民的原因很复杂，包括人口压力、缺少经济机会、环境恶化以及新形式的旅行。
en: They have done so for a variety of complex reasons, including population pressure, a lack of economic opportunities, environmental degradation, and new forms of travel.

zh: 这些因素合在一起，导致了前所未有规模的流民和不安全移民。
en: Combined, these factors are contributing to human displacement and unsafe migration on an unprecedented scale.

zh: 这两类人的数量将因为气候变化逐渐破坏数百万人的生计而扩大。
en: And the levels of both will only rise as the effects of climate change gradually erode millions of people’s livelihoods.

zh: 气候变化正在从根本上减小人类可居住地图。
en: Climate change is fundamentally redrawing the map of where people can live.

zh: 北美页岩地区和中美洲粮食供给遭到破坏；水压力和稀缺在北非和中东愈演愈烈。
en: Food supplies are being disrupted in North Africa’s Sahel region and Central America; and water stress and scarcity are growing worse in North Africa and the Middle East.

zh: 比如，索马里旱灾频仍。
en: Somalia, for example, is experiencing more frequent droughts.

zh: 伊拉克遭到频繁的热浪。
en: Iraq is battling more frequent heat waves.

zh: 前所未有的风暴和洪水摧残着加勒比和墨西哥湾。
en: Unprecedented storms and floods have battered the Caribbean and Gulf of Mexico.

zh: 当反常成为新常态，稀缺、零和竞争和大规模流离失所也将变得更加常见。
en: As the abnormal becomes the new normal, scarcities, zero-sum competition, and mass displacements will become more common.

zh: 但在两个方面有一些好消息。
en: But there is good news to report on two fronts.

zh: 首先，我们的抵抗极端天气的能力有了巨大的进步。
en: First, we are making major strides in building resilience to extreme weather.

zh: 20世纪70年代，孟加拉国因为极端洪水而失去数十万人。
en: In the 1970s, Bangladesh lost hundreds of thousands of people to extreme flooding.

zh: 如今，类似的洪水仍然致命，但数字少了很多。
en: Today, the fatalities from similar occurrences, while no less tragic, are far fewer in number.

zh: 我们正在越来越擅长应对灾难。
en: We are getting better at coping with disasters.

zh: 其次，历史上首次，国际社会开始合作为管理国际移民制定框架。
en: Second, for the first time in history, the international community is coming together to build a framework to manage international migration.

zh: 2018年2月，各国为落实全球安全、有序、规律移民共约（GCM）而开始政府间谈判。
en: Intergovernmental negotiations started in February 2018 with the aim of adopting a Global Compact for Safe, Orderly, and Regular Migration (GCM).

zh: 上个月，联合国大会f完成了 GCM，各国首脑预计将在今年12月在马拉喀什参加高级别会议。
en: And last month, the United Nations General Assembly finalized the GCM, which heads of state are now expected to adopt at a high-level conference in Marrakesh this December.

zh: GCM有望为解决气候导致的移民的行动提供可靠的框架。
en: The GCM promises to provide a sound framework for taking action that addresses climate-driven migration.

zh: 但目前我们必须确保它得到落实。
en: But now we must ensure that it is implemented.

zh: GCM是准备管理安全有序移民的国际一致的体系的几十年一遇的机会。
en: The GCM represents a once-in-a-generation opportunity to set in place an internationally-agreed system for managing safe and orderly migration.

zh: 因此，它有望改善数千万人的生活和前景。
en: As such, it has the potential to improve the lives and prospects of tens of millions of people.

zh: 一旦给正式接受，我们需要确保新框架能实现国际旅行和交流收益最大化，同时解决许多人对无监管移民的担忧。
en: Once it is formally adopted, we will need to ensure that the new framework maximizes the benefits of international travel and exchange, while also addressing the concerns that many people have with unregulated migration.

zh: 最后也是最重要的是，我们必须尽一切可能大幅减少温室气体排放。
en: Finally, and most important, we will have to do everything possible to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions drastically.

zh: 这是将地球温度限制在前工业化水平以上2℃以内的唯一方法 — — 超过2℃的话，升温反馈环就有可能导致气候变化失控。
en: That is the only way to keep the Earth’s temperature within 2°C of pre-industrial levels – the threshold at which spiraling feedback loops could trigger runaway climate change.

zh: 最新报告表明，大气层二氧化碳浓度已超过百万分之410，这应该成为警世钟。
en: The recent report that atmospheric carbon dioxide now exceeds 410 parts per million should serve as a wake-up call.

zh: 我们急需提高资源效率，采用可持续的消费和生产方式，从根本上改变经济模式。
en: We urgently need to become more resource-efficient, by adopting sustainable consumption and production methods, and by fundamentally altering our economic model.

zh: 行动窗口正在迅速关闭。
en: The window for action is quickly closing.

zh: 气候变化和环境恶化正在给制造不可接受的危险水平。
en: Climate change and environmental degradation are creating unacceptable levels of human insecurity.

zh: 如果能够可持续地管理环境，我们就有更大的机会保持移民尊严、权利和尊重。
en: If our environment is sustainably managed, we will have a better chance of upholding migrants’ dignity, rights, and prospects.

zh: 这两个目标密不可分，我们所领导的组织已在支持全世界政府实现目标的努力。
en: These two goals are inseparable, and the organizations that we lead are ready to support the efforts of the world’s governments to achieve them.

zh: 2018年是一次宝贵的思考和规划未来数十年的机会，加快移民和环境方面的动作。
en: The year 2018 presents us with a unique opportunity to think and plan for the decades ahead, by stepping up action on both migration and the environment.

zh: 在我们为安全、规律和有序移民制定框架的时候，我们必须创造性地解决它的根源。
en: As we set in place a framework to provide for safe, regular, and orderly migration, we must harness our creativity to address its causes.

zh: 最重要的是，我们需要有远见的世界领导人，他必须有决心解决完全由我们自己造成、现在已开始反噬我们的问题。
en: Above all, we need far-sighted world’s leaders with the will to fix a problem that is already upon us, and that is entirely of our own making.

zh: 为何气候变化是一个教育问题
en: Why Climate Change Is an Education Issue

zh: 纽约—气候变化影响我们所有人，但我们仍在尽量快地采取行动以治理气候变化的根源、减轻它的伤害，并适应它的影响。
en: NEW YORK – Climate change affects us all, but we still are not acting as quickly as we should to address its causes, mitigate the damage, and adapt to its effects.

zh: 许多人不理解气候变化给全球经济和社会结构所造成的风险。
en: Many people don’t understand the risks climate change poses to global economic and social structures.

zh: 并且，悲哀的是，许多理解这一风险的人并没有对朝向可持续性和清洁能源的全球转型所能带来的意义深远的好处引起重视。
en: And, sadly, many who do understand are dismissive of the far-reaching benefits a global shift to sustainability and clean energy would bring about.

zh: 据最新皮尤（Pew）研究，七成被认为是政治独立的美国人不太关注气候变化可能伤害到他们的问题。
en: According to a recent Pew study, seven out of ten Americans classified as political independents were not very concerned that climate change would hurt them.

zh: 更糟糕的是，耶鲁大学研究者最近发现，全球40%的成年人从来没有听说过气候变化。
en: Worse still, Yale University researchers recently found that 40% of adults worldwide have never even heard of climate change.

zh: 在一些发展中国家（比如印度 ） ， 这一比例高达65 % 。
en: In some developing countries, such as India, that figure climbs to 65%.

zh: 这些数字令人沮丧，但可以改进。
en: These figures are discouraging, but they can be improved.

zh: 耶鲁大学的研究推论道 ， “ 教育程度是公共对气候变化的认识的最强指标。
en: The Yale study concluded that, “educational attainment tends to be the single strongest predictor of public awareness of climate change.”

zh: ”通过投资于高品质教育，我们可以为下一代铺就一条解决这一全球问题的正确道路。
en: By investing in quality education, we can set the next generation on the right path to addressing this global problem.

zh: 教育和气候行动通过三个方面共同作用。
en: Education and climate action work together in three ways.

zh: 首先，教育填补知识空白。
en: For starters, education fills knowledge gaps.

zh: 理解气候变化已经给一个人的生活造成了多大的影响很有实际意义。
en: Understanding how climate change is already having an impact on one’s life can have practical benefits.

zh: 对于最容易受到庄稼欠收和气候变化造成的自然灾害（如山体滑坡和洪水）影响的穷人群体来说尤其如此。
en: This is especially true for poor populations that are most vulnerable to crop failures and natural disasters, such as landslides and floods, caused by climate change.

zh: 每次遭遇新灾难都必须从头重建家园的群体失去了快速发展的机会。
en: Populations that must rebuild from scratch after each new catastrophe miss out on opportunities for rapid development.

zh: 通过理解世界正在变化 — — 以及未来灾难可能性正在上升 — — 这些人可以构建恢复力，并学会如何适应突发和缓慢的气候变化压力。
en: By understanding that their world is changing – and that the likelihood of future disasters is increasing – these populations can build resilience and learn to adapt to the sudden and slow stresses of a changing climate.

zh: 其次，教育能治愈冷漠。
en: Second, education challenges apathy.

zh: 知道哪些手段可以用来遏制气候变化能为经济增长带来巨大的机会。
en: Knowing the measures available to address climate change can open up vast opportunities for economic growth.

zh: 全球投资者必须明白，可持续方案能够增加福利，创造新的经济机会。
en: Global investors should be made to understand that sustainable solutions can increase wellbeing and create additional economic opportunities.

zh: 比如，在尼日尔，教育和农作技术的改进帮助一百多万人的务农真实收入提高了一倍，还修复了大量严重退化的土地。
en: To take one example, in Niger, education and improved farming techniques helped double real farm incomes for more than one million people, while restoring huge tracts of severely degraded land.

zh: 在美国，2014年太阳能相关就业岗位数量已经超过了煤炭。
en: In the US, as of 2014, there were more jobs that depended on solar energy than on coal mining.

zh: 但是，仍有许多人坚持认为实施减轻气候变化影响的措施对于我们当前的生活方式来说成本太高。
en: Still, many people insist that implementing measures to mitigate the effects of climate change is too costly to our current way of life.

zh: 据皮尤研究，几乎七成人相信，考虑到技术的极限，我们将不得不做出重大生活方式变化。
en: According to the Pew study, almost seven out of ten people believe that, given the limitations of technology, they would have to make major lifestyle changes.

zh: 未必如此，教育可以反驳否定气候智能（climate-smart）生活机会的怀疑派。
en: This does not have to be the case, and education can challenge the kind of skepticism that forecloses opportunities for climate-smart living.

zh: 最后，教育提供技术知识，从而让我们能够通过创新构建更美好的未来 — — 包括清洁和安全的能源、可持续农业和更加智能的城市。
en: Finally, education furnishes the technical knowledge needed to build a better future through innovation – one that includes clean and safe energy, sustainable agriculture, and smarter cities.

zh: 扩大教育普及度将带来更多本土创新 — — 企业家寻找解决本地问题的机会。
en: Broadening access to education would lead to more homegrown innovation – entrepreneurs spotting opportunities to address local problems.

zh: 全球而言，我们无法依靠硅谷或牛津等知识中心制定气候变化灵药。
en: Globally, we cannot rely on knowledge centers such as Silicon Valley or Oxford to develop a silver bullet to the climate problem.

zh: 解决方案可以来自各个枢纽，但它们也将来自村庄和发展中城市，来周边前景各异的农民和制造商。
en: Solutions may come from tech hubs, but they will also come from villages and developing cities, from farmers and manufactures with vastly different perspectives on the world around them.

zh: 这将形成一个良性循环。
en: And this will create a virtuous cycle.

zh: 教育人们移居和融入新社会、分享他们所带来的知识将变得更加容易。
en: It is easier for educated people to migrate and integrate into new societies, sharing the knowledge they’ve brought with them.

zh: 幸运的是，今天的年轻一代比此前的几代人受过更好的教育，也更重视降低自身的碳足迹。
en: Fortunately, younger generations today are better educated and more committed to reducing their own carbon footprint than previous generations were.

zh: 他们正在起着领导作用，并迫使我们重新思考我们的行为。
en: They are leading the way and forcing us all to reconsider our own actions.

zh: 但我们必须加强全世界教育普及度，以确保他们的努力不会白费。
en: But we must broaden the availability of education worldwide to ensure that their efforts are not in vain.

zh: 认识到教育的重要性，挪威政府在首相索尔贝格极具远见卓识的领导下成立了国际全球教育机会融资委员会（International Commission on Financing Global Education Opportunity ） ， 我也忝列其中。
en: In recognition of education’s importance, the government of Norway, under the visionary leadership of Prime Minister Erna Solberg, has established the International Commission on Financing Global Education Opportunity, of which I am a member.

zh: 本周，我们将在奥斯陆聚集一堂，我希望我们能直面我们的时间挑战，理解教育是我们所拥有的最优质的问题解决资产，并据此行动。
en: We will meet this week in Oslo, and it is my hope that we will confront the challenges of our time and act on the knowledge that education is the best problem-solving asset we possess.

zh: 消除气候变化的危险不但是一项生存要求，也是一个通往更清洁、更有生产率、更公平的发展路径的机会。
en: Addressing the dangers of climate change is not only an existential imperative; it is also an opportunity to move toward a cleaner, more productive, and fairer path of development.

zh: 唯有受过教育的全球社会才能采取需要的决定性行动实现这一目标。
en: Only an educated global society can take the decisive action needed to get us there.

zh: 水智能能源选择
en: Making Water-Smart Energy Choices

zh: 新德里—毫无疑问，气候变化给地球造成了严重威胁，甚至有可能是生存威胁。
