en: NEW DELHI – Climate change undoubtedly poses a potent – even existential – threat to the planet.

zh: 但现有的遏制气候变化的方法只是单纯地注重削减二氧化碳排放，到头来可能造成严重的伤害，因为它没有考虑到能源业对水资源的消耗 — — 这是气候变化的另一个主要原因。
en: But the current approach to mitigating it, which reflects a single-minded focus on cutting carbon dioxide emissions, may end up doing serious harm, as it fails to account for the energy sector’s depletion of water resources – another major contributor to climate change.

zh: “水既是气候变化的原因，也是气候变化的效应 ， ” 一份国家资源委员会（National Resource Council）报告如是说。
en: “Water is at the heart of both the causes and effects of climate change,” a National Research Council report declares.

zh: 是的，水循环 — — 让水周而复始地从云端落到地上、流向海洋又回到天空的降水、蒸发、冰冻、融化和凝结的过程 — — 始终伴随着陆地、海洋和大气之间的能量交换，决定着地球的气候。
en: And, indeed, the water cycle – the processes of precipitation, evaporation, freezing, melting, and condensation that circulate water from clouds to land to the ocean and back – is inextricably linked to the energy exchanges among the land, ocean, and atmosphere that determine Earth’s climate.

zh: 正如大气层中碳的积累会导致气候变化，水资源的退化和耗竭也是如此。
en: Just as the accumulation of carbon in the atmosphere contributes to climate change, so does the degradation and depletion of water resources.

zh: 而这些过程是互相强化的关系，彼此之间互相推动和强化。
en: And these processes are mutually reinforcing, with each propelling and intensifying the other.

zh: 能源开采、处理（包括炼制）和生产具有高度的水密集性。
en: Energy extraction, processing (including refining), and production is highly water-intensive.

zh: 能源业是除澳大利亚外的所有发达国家最大的耗水大户，而澳大利亚与大部分发展中国家一样，耗水量最大的是农业。
en: The energy sector is the largest consumer of water in every developed country except Australia, where, like in most developing countries, agriculture comes out on top.

zh: 在欧盟，发电厂消耗了一年中淡水总消耗量的44 % ； 美国的这一数字是41 % 。
en: In the European Union, electricity-generating plants alone account for 44% of all freshwater consumed each year; in the United States, that figure is 41%.

zh: 水资源压力越大，水行业所需要的耗能越高，因为人们需要从更深的地下抽水，而地表水也必须流过更长的距离。
en: The more stressed water resources become, the more energy the water sector demands, as groundwater must be pumped from greater depths, and surface water must be transported across longer distances.

zh: 比如，在印度，耗能占地下水成本的90%左右。
en: In India, for example, energy now comprises about 90% of the cost of groundwater.

zh: 这些过程加剧了气候的多变性，也降低了水的易得性，进一步刺激了能源需求，产生难以打破的恶性循环。
en: As these processes fuel climate variability, they reduce water availability and boost energy demand even further, producing a vicious cycle that will be hard to break.

zh: 事实上，满足日益高涨的电力需求、实现生产生物燃料和其他替代燃料的国家目标可能在未来二十五年导致全球用于能源生产的水消耗量增加两倍。
en: In fact, meeting higher electricity demand and achieving national targets for production of biofuels and other alternative fuels would require a more than twofold increase in global water use for energy production over the next quarter-century.

zh: 打破这一循环 — — 从而有效遏制气候变化 — — 的唯一办法是管理好水和能源之间的联系（还有粮食，粮食生产需要依靠水和能源 ） 。
en: The only way to break this cycle – and thus to mitigate climate change effectively – is to manage the nexus between water and energy (as well as food, production of which depends on water and energy).

zh: 换句话说，各国必须做出选择，不但要降低碳密集性，也要降低水密集性。
en: In other words, countries must make energy choices that are not only less carbon-intensive, but also less water-intensive.

zh: 在全球水供给已然相当紧张的情况下，采取水智能（water-smart）型能源方针无比紧迫。
en: With global water supplies already strained, the shift to a water-smart approach to energy could not be more urgent.

zh: 世界三分之二人口 — — 特别是中南亚、中东和北非 — — 面临严重水短缺。
en: Two-thirds of the world’s people – especially in Central and South Asia, the Middle East, and North Africa – confront serious water shortages.

zh: 用人均可用水量衡量，亚洲 — — 全球能源需求增量的主要推动因素 — — 也是全世界最干旱的洲。
en: Asia – the biggest driver of increased global energy demand – is also the world’s driest continent, measured by water availability per capita.

zh: 在这些水压力巨大的地区，短缺已经开始制约能源基础设施的扩张。
en: In these water-stressed regions, shortages have already begun to constrain the expansion of energy infrastructure.

zh: 中国之所以无法发展页岩液压致裂产业，一个重要原因是其页岩储备地区水量不足。
en: One important reason why China has failed to develop its shale hydrocarbon industry is inadequate water in the areas where its deposits are located.

zh: （要从页岩中榨取能源，需要注入数百万加仑的水。 ）
en: (To extract energy from shale, millions of gallons of water must be shot into it.)

zh: 不断加剧的水压力也推高了现有发电项目的成本，程度之大有可能威胁到它们的可行性。
en: Increasing water stress has also driven up costs for existing power-generation projects, possibly jeopardizing their viability.

zh: 从20世纪90年代末一直延续到2012年的澳大利亚千禧大旱就影响了能源生产，导致价格升高。
en: Australia’s Millennium drought, which lasted from the late 1990s until 2012, undermined energy production, causing prices to rise.

zh: 能源短缺的地区通常也是水压力较大的地区，那么，受影响的国家应该怎么做？
en: With energy shortages usually most severe in water-stressed areas, what are affected countries to do?

zh: 首先，它们应该认识到从碳角度讲“清洁”的能源，从水资源角度将有可能是“肮脏”的。
en: For starters, they must recognize that energy that is “clean” in terms of carbon can be “dirty” from a water-resource perspective.

zh: 比如，需要碳捕捉和封存的“清洁”煤炭，以及核电便是水密集的大户。
en: For example, “clean” coal involving carbon capture and sequestration ranks, along with nuclear power, at the top of the water-intensity chart.

zh: 一些可再生能源，如太阳能热电和地热能，也是著名的水密集行业。
en: Some renewables, such as solar thermal power and geothermal energy, are also notoriously water-intensive.

zh: 相反，太阳能光伏和风电 — — 这两种可再生技术正在全球起势 — — 的常规操作不需要水。
en: By contrast, solar photovoltaic and wind power – two renewable technologies gaining traction globally – require no water for their normal operations.

zh: 因此，鼓励发展这类资源应该列为重点。
en: Encouraging the development of such sources should thus be a high priority.

zh: 但是用的能源的类型不是唯一的问题。
en: But the type of energy that is used is not the only issue.

zh: 同样重要的是在规划阶段选择正确的厂房类型。
en: It is also important to select the right types of plants at the planning stage.

zh: 发电用另类降温技术 — — 包括干式和混合制冷 — — 能降低耗水量（尽管目前这些技术的使用受效率损失和成本高企的制约 ） 。
en: Alternative cooling technologies for power generation, including dry or hybrid cooling, can reduce water consumption (though the use of such technologies currently is constrained by efficiency losses and higher costs).

zh: 发电厂也可以坐落在不依靠淡水资源，而依靠盐卤、劣质水和再生水的地点。
en: Power plants should also be located in places where they will rely not on freshwater resources, but instead on saline, brackish, degraded, or reclaimed water.

zh: 亚洲是目前全球新增核电产能的领导者，其大部分新建核电厂坐落在沿海地带，以便更多使用海水。
en: In Asia, which now leads the world in terms of adding nuclear power capacity, most new plants are located along coastlines, so that these thirsty facilities can draw more on seawater.

zh: 但在这方面也存在严重风险。
en: Yet here, too, there are serious risks.

zh: 气候变化导致海平面上升，这带来的威胁可能比自然灾害（如导致2011年日本福岛灾难的海啸）更大。
en: Rising sea levels, as a result of climate change, could pose a much more potent threat than natural disasters, such as the tsunami that caused the 2011 Fukushima catastrophe in Japan.

zh: 此外，沿海地区通常人口稠密、经济发达，找到合适的海边地点建立新核电厂并不容易。
en: Moreover, with coastal areas often densely populated and economically valuable, finding suitable seaside sites for new nuclear plants is no longer easy.

zh: 尽管印度拥有7,200多公里长的海岸线，但其通过沿海电厂扩张核电的计划仍然因为草根反对而难以推行。
en: Despite having more than 4,500 miles (7,200 kilometers) of coastline, India has struggled to implement its planned expansion of nuclear power through seaside plants, owing to strong grassroots opposition.

zh: 真正的能源安全只有在资源、气候和环境可持续的环境下才有可能。
en: True energy security is possible only in the context of resource, climate, and environmental sustainability.

zh: 世界将注意力完全集中在减碳，这不但模糊了这些重要的联系，也助长了对资源稳定不利的措施。
en: The global focus solely on carbon reduction not only obscures these critical linkages, but also encourages measures that adversely impact resource stability.

zh: 应该立即采取更加全面、统一和长期能源、水和其他资源管理和规划方针，着眼于广义环境保护。
en: It is time to adopt a more comprehensive, integrated, and long-term approach to the management and planning of energy, water, and other resources, with a view toward broader environmental protection.

zh: 否则，我们将无法克服我们所面对的可持续发展挑战，造成灾难性后果，首当其冲的将是全世界水压力最大的地区。
en: Otherwise, we will fail to meet the sustainable-development challenges we face, with devastating consequences, beginning with the world’s most water-stressed regions.

zh: 淘汰化石燃料的神话
en: The Myth of a Fossil Fuel Phase-Out

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 世界如何利用能源已经成为全球变暖的热门话题，而对污染和资源紧张的担忧已经引发了一场虚拟的能效战略军备竞赛。
en: BRUSSELS – How the world uses energy is a hot topic for a warming planet, and fears of pollution and resource strain have produced a virtual arms race of energy-efficiency strategies.

zh: 从欧盟到中国，各主要经济体正在发誓通过技术创新和立法改革来降低国内能源强度。
en: From the European Union to China, economies are vowing to reduce their energy intensity with the help of technological innovations and legislative changes.

zh: 但尽管做出了这样的承诺，国际能源署预测消费者的能源需求至少将在2040年前继续保持上升态势。
en: Yet, despite these promises, consumer demand for energy is forecast by the International Energy Agency to rise until at least 2040.

zh: 在世界能源需求不断增长的情况下，决策者如何才能确保能源供应？
en: With the world’s energy needs growing, how can policymakers guarantee supply?

zh: 坦率的讲，世界在能源储备方面没有什么值得担心的。
en: To put it bluntly, the world has nothing to worry about when it comes to reserves.

zh: 在经历了长达40年对能源短缺的担忧后，我们已经进入了一个能源储备丰富的时期。
en: After 40 years of fearing energy shortages, we have entered an era of abundance.

zh: 我们真正需要防范的不是资源的稀缺，而是虚假的陈述。
en: We need to guard against false narratives, not scarce resources.

zh: 这个故事的罪魁祸首是罗马俱乐部，20世纪70年代，这家全球智库利用其来自可疑模型的荒谬预言引发了对能源的焦虑。
en: The culprit of this storyline is the Club of Rome, a global think-tank that, in the 1970s, spurred energy anxiety with its absurd prophecies derived from questionable models.

zh: 作为托马斯·马尔萨斯和保罗·埃尔利希的忠实追随者，该俱乐部认为线性增长是件好事，而指数级增长将带来可怕的后果。
en: As devoted followers of Thomas Malthus and Paul Ehrlich, the club argued that bad things come from exponential growth, and good things from linear growth.

zh: 上述理念助推了将在2000年耗尽石油的预测。
en: This idea fueled the prediction that the world would run out of oil by 2000.

zh: 因为相信这种毫无意义的教条，发达国家任凭利比亚卡扎菲和伊朗阿亚图拉·鲁霍拉·霍梅尼等资源富集国家的专制领袖将他们手中的石油储量作为反对西方的工具 — — 尤其是反对西方对以色列的支持。
en: By adopting this nonsense dogma, developed countries enabled resource-rich authoritarian leaders like Muammar el-Qaddafi in Libya, and Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini in Iran, to use their oil reserves as tools to oppose the West – and particularly its support for Israel.

zh: 这助推了20世纪70年代的石油危机，同时强化了碳氢化合物储量甚至更为有限的错误观点，而且上述观点谎称这些有限的储量主要集中在中东地区。
en: This contributed to the oil shocks of the 1970s, and reinforced the erroneous perception that hydrocarbon reserves were even more limited, and largely confined to the Middle East.

zh: 技术领域的飞速进步，特别是在全新地点勘探和开采碳氢化合物的能力，最终将这样的说法连根拔起。
en: Rapid advances in technology, particularly in the field of exploration and the ability to extract hydrocarbons in new places, eventually upended such narratives.

zh: 今天的能源“危机”并非来源于短缺，而是来源于对污染的顾虑。
en: Today’s energy “crisis” stems not from shortages, but from anxiety over pollution.

zh: 但这样的顾虑并没有减缓我们勘探的习惯。
en: But this anxiety has not slowed our exploration habits.

zh: 恰恰相反，像联合国海洋法公约这样的政策和国际法已经得到修改，目的是发现更多的能源储备。
en: On the contrary, politics and international law, like the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, have been adapted to enable discovery.

zh: 莫桑比克沿海地区的鲁伍马气田就是实例。
en: Consider, for example, the Rovuma gas field off the coast of Mozambique.

zh: 今天，来自意大利和中国等国家的一系列国际企业正在准备投产，非洲最贫困的国家之一注定要获取丰厚的回报。
en: Today, a consortium of international companies from countries including Italy and China is preparing production, and one of Africa’s poorest countries is set to reap huge rewards.

zh: 同样，曾被视为中东唯一一个没有碳氢化合物的国家以色列正坐拥8，000亿立方米的海上天然气储量，按照这个国家目前的年度天然气消费量足够其消耗130多年。
en: Similarly, Israel, once thought to be the only place in the Middle East without hydrocarbons, is sitting on 800 billion cubic meters of offshore gas reserves, more than 130 years of the country’s current annual gas consumption.

zh: 曾经是能源净进口国的以色列现在却面临着巨量天然气出口的真正挑战。
en: Once a net energy importer, Israel today faces the very real challenge of exporting its gas bonanza.

zh: 但近年来全球能源市场最大的技术革命或许来自于美国的页岩油和页岩气生产。
en: But perhaps the biggest technology-driven upheaval for global energy markets in recent years has come from shale gas and shale oil production in the United States.

zh: 美国目前的石油产量高达每天880万桶，比伊拉克和伊朗加起来的总和还要多。
en: At 8.8 million barrels per day, US oil production is now higher than that of Iraq and Iran combined.

zh: 美国的页岩气正被运往亚洲、拉美和欧洲部分地区。
en: US shale gas is being delivered to Asia, Latin America, and parts of Europe.

zh: 这些市场曾长期被卡塔尔、俄罗斯和澳大利亚锁定，但现在全球液化天然气（LNG）产业像石油市场一样已经步入了一个生产过剩的时期。
en: These markets were long locked up by Qatar, Russia, and Australia, but now the global liquefied natural gas (LNG) industry, like the oil market, has entered a period of overproduction.

zh: 综合来看，上述进展已经促成能源价格下跌，并大大削弱了欧佩克的实力。
en: Taken together, these developments have contributed to lower energy prices, and reduced the strength of OPEC.

zh: 不仅如此，因为液化天然气出于环境原因而更被运输部门（尤其是货运和海运托运企业）所青睐，利用石油作为地缘政治武器的可能性已经消失。
en: Furthermore, because LNG is favored by the transport sector (particularly freight and maritime shippers) for environmental reasons, the ability to use oil as a geopolitical weapon has disappeared.

zh: 伊朗急于增加其石油出口，甚至不惜同意放弃其核计划（惊人的是，伊核协议65次提到了“石油”一词 ） 。
en: Iran was so desperate to ramp up its oil exports that it agreed to abandon its nuclear program (strikingly, the Iran nuclear deal mentions the word “oil” 65 times).

zh: 风能和太阳能往往被视为石油和天然气的替代品，但它们在发电领域无法与传统能源展开竞争。
en: Wind and solar are often presented as alternatives to oil and gas, but they cannot compete with traditional sources for electricity generation.

zh: 如果它们有这个能力，欧盟就没有理由通过立法来支持可再生能源的生产过程。
en: If they could, there would be no reason for the EU to support renewable energy production through legislation.

zh: 此外，尽管风能和太阳能技术可以发电，但供暖才是最大的能源需求。
en: Moreover, while wind and solar technologies generate electricity, the biggest energy demand comes from heating.

zh: 例如在欧盟，电力只占到终端能源需求的22 % ， 而供暖和制冷则占45 % ； 余下的33%才是运输。
en: In the EU, for example, electricity represents only 22% of final energy demand, while heating and cooling represents 45%; transportation accounts for the remaining 33%.

zh: 所有这些因素都能够解释为什么现在占到世界能源需求超过80%的化石燃料仍将在可以预见的未来成为全球能源生产的支柱产业。
en: All of these factors help explain why fossil fuels, which currently meet more than 80% of the world’s energy needs, will remain the backbone of global energy production for the foreseeable future.

zh: 这对那些敦促立即淘汰碳氢化合物的人来说也许并不是好消息。
en: This may not come as welcome news to those pushing for an immediate phase-out of hydrocarbons.

zh: 但或许令人安慰的是，技术创新仍将在减轻对空气和水质量的负面影响方面发挥关键的作用。
en: But perhaps some solace can be gained from the fact that technological innovation will also play a key role in reducing the negative impacts on air and water quality.

zh: 在全球气候变化的对话中，发达经济体承诺大幅提高能效并不难理解。
en: Amid the global conversation about climate change, it is understandable that developed economies would promise significant gains in energy efficiency.

zh: 但虽然欧盟可能会致力于减少二氧化碳排放，但其他2015年巴黎气候协定的签署国似乎并不那么坚决。
en: But while the EU may be committed to reducing CO2 emissions, other signatories of the 2015 Paris climate agreement do not seem as resolute.

zh: 如果绝大多数巴黎气候协定的签署国在未来几年实际提升了能源消耗量也并不值得大惊小怪，他们很可能会转向化石燃料，因为他们承担不起其他选择。
en: It would not be surprising if most of the signatories actually raised their energy consumption in coming years, turning to fossil fuels because they cannot afford any other option.

zh: 能源政策在未来许多年仍将进入发达经济体的议事日程。
en: Energy policy will remain on the agenda for advanced economies for many years to come.

zh: 但随着各国努力平衡供应安全和环境目标，他们必须竭尽全力看清事实的本来面目。
en: But as countries work to balance security of supply with environmental goals, they must also commit to getting their facts straight.

zh: 地球工程谬论
en: The Geoengineering Fallacy

zh: 柏林—在全世界为控制引发气候变化的气体排放、限制地球变暖而焦头烂额之际，一项新的技术憧憬正在赢得越来越多的支持者。
en: BERLIN – As the world struggles to rein in emissions of climate-changing gases and limit planetary warming, a new technological silver bullet is gaining supporters.

zh: 地球工程 — — 大规模操纵地球自然系统 — — 作为一种抵消气候变化的负面效应的手段而大受欢迎。
en: Geoengineering –the large-scale manipulation of the Earth’s natural systems – has been popularized as a means of counteracting the negative effects of climate change.

zh: 这门科学的支持者炮制了一个幻觉：可以设法人造一条气候危机的出路，实现2015年巴黎气候协定目标，同时又维持重消费生活方式。
en: Proponents of this science feed the illusion that there is a way to engineer an exit from the climate crisis, meet the goals of the 2015 Paris climate agreement, and maintain a consumption-heavy lifestyle.

zh: 但这个解决办法并不像其支持者想让我们相信的那样简单。
en: But this solution is not as simple as proponents would have us believe.

zh: 把宝押在气候工程上 — — 不论是作为地球保险政策，还是作为遏制气温升高的孤注一掷 — — 不但风险很大，还有可能让人们的注意力从我们所知的唯一能够起作用的方案 — — 减少碳排放上转移。
en: Betting on climate engineering – either as a planetary insurance policy or as a last-ditch measure to combat rising temperatures – is not only risky; it also directs attention away from the only solution we know will work: reducing carbon emissions.

zh: 人们讨讨论的每一项工程技术，都会带来危险和不确定性。
en: Each of the engineered technologies being discussed carries dangers and uncertainties.

zh: 比如，要想测试太阳能辐射管理（SRM）在全球范围上的效率，就必须在环境中进行实验 — — 要么像大气中喷洒粒子，要么认为改变云貌。
en: For example, the only way to test the effectiveness of solar radiation management (SRM) on a global scale would be to carry out experiments in the environment – either by spraying particles into the stratosphere, or by artificially modifying clouds.

zh: 这些测试是为了确定SRM是否能够反射足够的阳光，从而让地球冷却下来而设计，但实验本身可能造成不可逆转的伤害。
en: While such tests would be designed to determine whether SRM could reflect enough sunlight to cool the planet, experimentation itself could cause irreversible damage.

zh: 目前的模型预测，SRM的部署将改变全球降水模式，破坏臭氧层，影响到数百万人的生计。
en: Current models predict that SRM deployment would alter global precipitation patterns, damage the ozone layer, and undermine the livelihoods of millions of people.

zh: 除了生态风险，批评者还警告说，SRM一旦被部署，可能成为强大的武器，让国家、公司或个人有能力操纵气候赢得战略利益（这样的概念，连好莱坞也无法拒绝 ） 。
en: Beyond the ecological risks, critics warn that, once deployed globally, SRM could spawn powerful weapons, giving states, corporations, or individuals the ability to manipulate climate for strategic gain (an idea that not even Hollywood can resist).

zh: 但也许最重要的批评是政治上的：在多边主义饱受挑战的世界中，如何治理全球性生态干预？
en: But perhaps the most important criticism is a political one: in a world of challenged multilateralism, how would global ecological interventions be governed?

zh: 另一类讨论中的气候工程技术 — — 所谓的二氧化碳消除（CDR）也面临类似的问题。
en: Similar questions surround the other major group of climate engineering technologies under debate – so-called carbon dioxide removal (CDR).

zh: 这些技术的支持者提出将二氧化碳从大气中提取出来，储存在地下或海洋中。
en: Proponents of these technologies propose removing CO2 from the atmosphere and storing it underground or in the oceans.

zh: 已有一些CDR方法因为可能引起环境问题而被禁。
en: Some CDR approaches are already prohibited, owing to concerns about possible environmental consequences.

zh: 比如，2008年海洋污染伦敦协议规定禁止将固碳浮游生物注入海洋。
en: For example, fertilization of oceans with carbon-sequestering plankton was banned by the London Protocol on marine pollution in 2008.

zh: 做出该决定的各方担心这样做可能会对海洋生物造成伤害。
en: Parties to that decision worried about the potential damage to marine life.

zh: 但其他CDR方法赢得了支持。
en: But other CDR approaches are gaining support.

zh: 一个讨论最热烈的概念旨在将碳捕获和储存（CCS）技术纳入生物量（biomass）中。
en: One of the most discussed ideas aims to integrate biomass with carbon capture and storage (CCS) techniques.

zh: 这一方法称为“带CCS的生物能 ” ， 或BECCS，寻求将生长快速的植物的二氧化碳吸收能力与地下二氧化碳储存方法相结合。
en: Called “bioenergy with CCS,” or BECCS, this method seeks to pair the CO2-absorption capabilities of fast-growing plants with underground CO2 storage methods.

zh: 支持者认为，BECCS实际可以产生“负”排放。
en: Proponents argue that BECCS would actually yield “negative” emissions.

zh: 但是，与其他工程方法一样，它的前景好得不真实。
en: Yet, as with other engineered solutions, the promises are simply too good to be true.

zh: 比如，成功实施BECCS系统，需要巨量能源、水和肥料。
en: For example, huge amounts of energy, water, and fertilizer would be required to operate BECCS systems successfully.

zh: 其对土地使用的影响可能导致陆生物种损失，加剧土地竞争和本地人口的流离失所。
en: The effects on land use would likely lead to terrestrial species losses, and increase land competition and displacement of local populations.

zh: 一些预测甚至认为，与这些项目相关的土地清理和建设活动可能导致温室气体排放净增，至少在短期是如此。
en: Some forecasts even suggest that the land clearing and construction activities associated with these projects could lead to a net increase in greenhouse gas emissions, at least in the short term.

zh: 还有规模问题。
en: Then there is the issue of scale.

zh: 要通过BECCS实现巴黎协定所规定排放限制，需要4.3亿—5.8亿公顷土地种植所需要的植物。
en: In order for BECCS to achieve emissions limits set by the Paris agreement, between 430 million and 580 million hectares (1.1 billion to 1.4 billion acres) of land would be needed to grow the required vegetation.

zh: 这一令人咋舌的土地用量相当于全世界适耕土地的三分之一。
en: That is a staggering one third of the world’s arable land.

zh: 简言之，要想减少二氧化碳在大气中的含量，有更安全 — — 并经过了考验 — — 的方法。
en: Simply put, there are safer – and proven – ways to withdraw CO2 from the atmosphere.

zh: 政府不应该去炮制认为的固定二氧化碳的“农场 ” ， 而应该专注于保护现有自然生态系统，并让遭到破坏的生态系统恢复。
en: Rather than creating artificial CO2-binding “farms,” governments should focus on protecting already-existing natural ecosystems and allowing degraded ones to recover.

zh: 热带雨林、海洋和泥炭地（如沼泽）拥有巨大的二氧化碳储存力，还不需要进行未经测试的技术操纵。
en: Rainforests, oceans, and peatlands (such as bogs) have immense CO2 storage capacities and do not require untested technological manipulation.

zh: 支持用未经证实的技术来解决一切导致气候变化的问题的人，等于是在暗示世界面临着一个不可避免的选择：地球工程还是灾难。
en: By pushing unproven technologies as a cure for all climate-changing ills, proponents are suggesting that the world faces an unavoidable choice: geoengineering or disaster.

zh: 但事实并非如此。
en: But this is disingenuous.

zh: 政治偏好，而不是科学或生态必要性，才是地球工程吸引力的来源。
en: Political preferences, not scientific or ecological necessity, explain the appeal of geoengineering.

zh: 不幸的是，当前关于气候工程的争论不是民主讨论，而是被技术官僚世界观、自然科学和工程思维，以及化石燃料业的既得利益所主导。
en: Unfortunately, current debates about climate engineering are undemocratic and dominated by technocratic worldviews, natural science and engineering perspectives, and vested interests in the fossil-fuel industries.

zh: 发展中国家、原住民和本地社区必须获得发出声音的权利，从而让所有风险都能够在地球工程技术被测试或实施之前得到充分考虑。
en: Developing countries, indigenous peoples, and local communities must be given a prominent voice, so that all risks can be fully considered before any geoengineering technology is tested or implemented.

zh: 那么，关于地球工程，我们应该如何对话？
en: So what conversation should we be having about geoengineering?

zh: 首先，我们需要反思现有治理格局。
en: For starters, we need to rethink the existing governance landscape.

zh: 2010年，联合国生物多样性公约（CBD）各方一致同意事实上国际中止与气候相关的地球工程。
en: In 2010, parties to the United Nations’ Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) agreed to a de facto international moratorium on climate-related geoengineering.

zh: 但如今，强大的活动集团施加了巨大的压力要让地球工程技术走出实验室，非正式的禁令已经不再足够。
en: But today, with powerful advocates generating so much pressure to bring geoengineering technologies out of the lab, informal bans are no longer sufficient.

zh: 世界急需关于这些技术的研究、部署和治理的真诚的讨论；CBD和伦敦协议是这些治理讨论的重要起点。
en: The world urgently needs an honest debate on the research, deployment, and governance of these technologies; the CBD and the London Protocol are essential starting points for these governance discussions.

zh: 需要最重点审查的技术是威胁到本地土地、粮食安全和水源的CDR项目。
en: Among the technologies that require the most scrutiny are CDR projects that threaten indigenous lands, food security, and water availability.

zh: 这些大规模技术机制必须受到严格的监管，以确保气候变化方案不会对可持续发展或人权造成负面影响。
en: Such large-scale technological schemes must be regulated diligently, to ensure that climate-change solutions do not adversely affect sustainable development or human rights.

zh: 此外，出于对SRM技术可能危害人权、民主和国际和平的考虑，应该彻底禁止其野外测试和部署。
en: In addition, the outdoor testing and deployment of SRM technologies, because of their potential to weaken human rights, democracy, and international peace, should be banned outright.

zh: 这一禁令应该由可问责的强力多边全球治理机构监督。
en: This ban should be overseen by a robust and accountable multilateral global governance mechanism.

zh: 到目前为止，我们还没有找到气候变化的特效药。
en: No silver bullet for climate change has yet been found.

zh: 尽管地球工程技术雄心勃勃，但我们已经有了经过检验的遏制气候变化的选项，它们能够也应该得到大力落实。
en: And while geoengineering technologies remain mostly aspirational, there are proven mitigation options that can and should be implemented vigorously.

zh: 这些选项包括扩大可再生能源、退出化石燃料使用（包括现有化石基础设施的提早报废 ） 、 可持续生态农业的进一步扩散，以及增加经济的能源和资源投入等。
en: These include scaling up renewable energy, phasing out fossil fuels (including an early retirement of existing fossil infrastructure), wider diffusion of sustainable agroecological agriculture, and decreased energy and resource input into our economy.

zh: 地球的未来不容我们拿来作为赌注。
en: We cannot afford to gamble with the future of our planet.

zh: 如果我们能认真地讨论生态上可持续、社会上公正的地球气候保护之道，就没有必要押注于地球工程。
en: If we engage in a serious discussion about ecologically sustainable and socially just measures to protect the Earth’s climate, there will be no need to roll the dice on geoengineering.

zh: 即将到来的气候无家可归潮
en: The Coming Wave of Climate Displacement

zh: 约翰内斯堡—世界各国政府正在参与一系列可能从根本上改变跨境人口流动管理的对话。
en: JOHANNESBURG – Governments around the world are engaged in a series of talks that could fundamentally alter how the movement of people across borders is managed.

zh: 其中一项对话的重点是难民保护；另一项对话的重点是移民。
en: One dialogue is focused on the protection of refugees; the other on migration.

zh: 这些由联合国牵头的讨论不会产生有法律约束力的协议。
en: These discussions, which are being led by the United Nations, will not result in legally binding agreements.

zh: 但对话本身即是形成关于当代移民挑战的共识的宝贵机会。
en: But the talks themselves are a rare chance to forge consensus on contemporary migration challenges.

zh: 最重要的是，它们给了国际社会一次良机为气候变化的影响做好准备，很快，气候变化就将成为全球无家可归和移民的主要原因。
en: And, most importantly, they will offer the international community an opportunity to plan for the impact of climate change, which will soon become a key driver of global displacement and migration.

zh: 据最新统计，全世界共有大约2.58亿移民，其中2.25亿是联合国难民署注册难民。
en: At last count, there were some 258 million migrants worldwide, with 22.5 million people registered as refugees by the UN Refugee Agency. These numbers will be dwarfed if even the most modest climate-related predictions are borne out.

zh: 哪怕是最温和的关于气候的预言成为现实，这些数字都将不值一提。
en: According to the International Organization for Migration, climate change could displace as many as one billion people by 2050.

zh: 据国际移民组织数据，气候变化可能导致2050年十亿人失去家园。
en: And yet no international treaty covers climate-induced migration – a gap that must be addressed now.

zh: 自1951年以来，难民保护国际标准从未如此受到关注。
en: Not since 1951 have international standards for refugee protection received so much attention.

zh: 那一年，面临二战结束后8,000多万无家可归者，联合国成员国起草了一个全面框架实现难民待遇标准化。
en: That year, with more than 80 million people displaced after World War II, UN member countries ratified a comprehensive framework to standardize their treatment of refugees.

zh: 目前正在讨论中的全球难民契约（Global Compact on Refugees）便建立在这一框架的基础上，并加上了赋权难民和援助接收国的策略。
en: The Global Compact on Refugees that is currently under discussion builds on this framework with strategies to empower refugees and assist host governments.

zh: 最重要的是，它将敦促签署过保护“因为自然灾害和气候变化而无家可归者 ” 。
en: Most significantly, it would commit signatories to protecting “those displaced by natural disasters and climate change.”

zh: 第二份协议对于管理气候导致的流离失所影响更大。
en: The second agreement is even more consequential for the management of climate-induced displacement.

zh: 此前从未有过一份全球性的移民管理条约，而过去的双边措施几乎完全聚焦于暴力和冲突作为无家可归的根源。
en: There has never been a global treaty governing migration, and past bilateral efforts have focused almost exclusively on violence and conflict as root causes of displacement.

zh: 全球移民契约（Global Compact for Migration）突破了这些限制，指出气候变化是“迫使人们逃离祖国的有害推动力和结构性因素。 ”
en: The proposed Global Compact for Migration goes beyond these factors, and notes that climate change is among the “adverse drivers and structural factors that compel people to leave their country of origin.”

zh: 这类监管用语确认了全球危险人群早已知道的事：干旱、自然灾害、荒漠化、庄稼歉收和其他许多环境变化正在导致牲口减少、整个社区不再宜居。
en: This type of regulatory language reaffirms what at-risk populations around the world already know: droughts, natural disasters, desertification, crop failure, and many other environmental changes are upending livelihoods and rendering entire communities uninhabitable.

zh: 在我的国家南非，创纪录的干旱正在迫使大城市考虑采取供水配给。
en: In my country, South Africa, a record drought is forcing major cities to consider water rationing.

zh: 如果水短缺持续下去的话，肯定会出现移民。
en: If water shortages persist, migration is certain to follow.

zh: 资源稀缺在政治动荡国家尤其危险，在这些国家，气候变化已经与暴力冲突和公共剧变有了密切联系。
en: Resource scarcity is particularly dangerous in politically unstable states, where climate change has already been linked to violent conflict and communal upheaval.

zh: 比如，沃土和淡水纠纷助长了达尔富尔战争，甚至目前的叙利亚冲突 — — 当今最大的流民产生原因 — — 也是发生在连续干旱促使叙利亚人从农村来到城市以后。
en: For example, disputes over fertile land and fresh water fueled the war in Darfur, and even the current crisis in Syria – one of the greatest sources of human displacement today – began after successive droughts pushed Syrians from rural areas into cities.

zh: 不难预测，未来数年气候变化将造成更多流血。
en: It is not a stretch to predict that climate change will produce more bloodshed in the coming years.

zh: 两个联合国框架可以作为规划如何管理即将到来的气候导致的移民的基础。
en: The two UN frameworks could serve as a basis for planning how to manage the coming climate-induced migrations.

zh: 如果能用科学模型指导决策，国家能够制定有秩序、有尊严、平等的安置策略。
en: With scientific modeling to guide decision-making, states could draft orderly, dignified, and equitable relocation strategies.

zh: 这肯定要比迄今为止的权宜之计更好。
en: This is certainly a smarter approach than the ad hoc responses to date.

zh: 但历史告诉我们，政府不愿意为被迫移民寻找集体方案。
en: But history tells us that governments are reluctant to seek out collective solutions to forced migration.

zh: 如今全世界难民的窘境 — — 挥之不去、不可原谅 — — 便是这方面失败的明证。
en: This failure is visible today in the haunting and inexcusable plight of refugees around the world.

zh: 随着我们进入契约谈判的收尾阶段，应该期待管理前所未有的人口流动的全球计划的谈判者们带来什么？
en: As we enter the final months of the Compact talks, what should we expect of those negotiating the global plan for managing unprecedented movements of people?

zh: 气候变化的原因和后果值得我们关注。
en: The causes and consequences of climate change demand close attention.

zh: 必须让无家可归者能够过上有尊严的生活。
en: Displaced people must be able to get on with their lives in dignity.

zh: 全球难民和移民契约是否能实现这一目标讲师世界领导人的考验。
en: The test of world leaders will be whether the global compacts on refugees and migrants can achieve this.

zh: 气候丧钟为谁而鸣
en: For Whom the Climate Bell Tolls

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 正当我走上讲台，准备讲授自己在加州大学伯克利分校秋季学期的第一节课时，身上忽然感到闷热难耐，以致我赶紧脱下了自己身上的教授粗花呢外套。
en: BERKELEY – Scarcely had I begun my first lecture of the fall semester here at the University of California, Berkeley, when I realized that I was too hot. I desperately wanted to take off my professorial tweed jacket.

zh: 粗花呢外套是一种完美但奇异的服装。
en: A tweed jacket is a wonderful but peculiar costume.

zh: 如果您手上只有羊毛这么一种原料，那么它就是最接近Gore-Tex面料的东西。
en: If all you have for raw material is a sheep, it is the closest thing you can get to Gore-Tex.

zh: 它不仅适合那种时常阴冷下点小雨的气候，而且相对于其重量来说也令人惊讶地保暖 — — 无论是在潮湿或干燥状态下。
en: Not only is it perfect for a cloudy, drizzly climate, it is also surprisingly warm – wet or dry – for its weight.

zh: 在实现集中供暖之前的世界里，这种当下最常与男性正式和半正式服装联系在一起的羊毛织物既高效又舒适，无论您是住在牛津、剑桥、爱丁堡、伦敦，布里斯托尔还是诺维奇。
en: In the world before central heating, the wool fabrics now most commonly associated with male formal and semi-formal attire were both effective and comfortable, regardless of whether one lived in Oxford, Cambridge, Edinburgh, London, Bristol, or Norwich.

zh: 而粗花呢外套随后也传播到了全球各地 — — 人们得为此感谢（或责怪）大英帝国。
en: But tweed jackets and the like also spread around the globe – a mixed blessing for which one can thank (or blame) the British Empire.

zh: 对于那些居住在赤道附近且远离不列颠群岛的细雨和雾气的人们来说，这种服装一直以来都是种诅咒。
en: For those living closer to the equator and away from the drizzle and fog of the British Isles, such garments have long been anathema.

zh: 在集中供暖出现后，羊毛服装即便在温带地区也变得不那么实用了。
en: After the advent of central heating, wool attire became less practical even in temperate zones.

zh: 尽管如此，在世界各地的一些地方，包括苏格兰和英格兰的部分地区（长期以来一直认为使用中央供暖系统是一种愚蠢行为的地方 ） ， 美国东北部和旧金山湾地区，粗花呢外套仍然是一种舒适的选择。
en: Nevertheless, tweed jackets remained a comfortable sartorial option in some places around the world, including Scotland and parts of England (where it was long considered gauche actually to use one’s central heating), the Northeastern United States, and the San Francisco Bay area.

zh: 事实上伯克利的气候是我在华盛顿特区待了三年后决定搬到那里去的一个小原因，在那地方您上两趟班就知道自己羊毛外套能在通勤过程中吸收多少汗水了。
en: As it happens, Berkeley’s climate is one small reason why I decided to relocate here after three years in Washington, DC, where one learns just how much sweat a wool suit can absorb during the daily commute.

zh: 但过去的20年以来，即便是在旧金山湾区东侧，教授服装也变得越来越不舒服。
en: But over the past 20 years, professorial garb has become increasingly uncomfortable, even here on the east side of the Bay.

zh: 当前的气候感觉更像是向南300英里外的圣塔巴巴拉。
en: The climate now feels more like that of Santa Barbara, 300 miles to the south.

zh: 因此越来越多的教职人员都穿着短袖衬衫授课，就像半个世纪以前加州理工学院（该校位于甚至更远的南部，在帕萨迪纳）的人们穿着的那样。
en: And so, more and more of us now lecture in short-sleeve button-down shirts like those worn a half-century ago by the denizens of CalTech (even farther south, in Pasadena).

zh: 尽管如此，对于我们这些居住在美国（以及其他发达国家）的人来说 — — 在接下来的一个世纪里气温变暖可能还不是个大问题。
en: Still, for those of us in the United States – and the Global North generally – warming temperatures probably won’t be that big a problem over the next century. Essentially, the climate will creep north about three miles each year.

zh: 从本质上讲，升温气候大概每年向北延申3英里，导致冰盖消失，沙漠化加速等灾害。
en: There are possible disaster scenarios stemming from the disappearance of snow packs, rapid desertification, and so forth.

zh: 但是这些问题虽然棘手且耗费巨大，却不是不可克服的。
en: But those problems will be inconvenient and costly, not insurmountable.

zh: 即便如此，与气候变化相关的问题既不会仅仅是产生一些不方便，也不会像我们想的那样遥远。
en: Even so, the problems associated with climate change will be neither mere inconveniences, nor as far off as we would like to think.

zh: 目前有20亿农民在从黄河一直到印度河的亚洲六大河谷地区挣扎求存。
en: There are currently two billion near-subsistence farmers living in the six great river valleys of Asia, from the Yellow all the way around to the Indus.

zh: 这些农民谋生手段有限，非农业技能很少，也很难迁徙到其他地方，更别说通过其他方式谋生了。
en: These farmers have limited means and few non-agricultural skills. It would not be easy for them to pick up and relocate, let alone earn their livelihood doing something else.

zh: 在过去的5000年里亚洲六大河谷一直支撑着大部分人类文明。
en: Asia’s six great river valleys have supported most of human civilization for the past 5,000 years.

zh: 在那段时间里，来自该地区高原的积雪总是在恰当的时刻融化，产生恰当体量的流水以支持该地区人民所依赖的作物。
en: During that time, the snow melt from the region’s high plateaus has always arrived at precisely the right moment, and in precisely the right volume, to support the crops upon which the region’s people rely.

zh: 同样，另外十亿人依靠着每年在正确的时点和正确的地方降临的季候风。
en: Similarly, another billion people depend on the monsoon arriving at the right time, and in the right place, each year.

zh: 然而随着地球升温和海平面上升，孟加拉湾和其他地方的旋风模式将发生变化。
en: And yet, as the planet heats up and sea levels rise, the pattern of cyclones in the Bay of Bengal and elsewhere will change.

zh: 如果它们的风力变得更强并开始朝着北上朝着居住在大恒河三角洲海平面或附近区域的2.5亿人口咆哮，那么世界就将面临这一场串的灾难。
en: If they grow stronger and start roaring north toward the 250 million people living at or near sea level in the greater Ganges Delta, the world will face a long train of catastrophe.

zh: 国际社会对这种情况束手无措。
en: The international community is in no way prepared for such a scenario.

zh: 事实上，甚至是美国世界上最富有的国家也还没有准备好迎接新奥尔良的卡特里娜飓风、纽约的桑迪飓风，休斯顿的哈维飓风或是波多黎各的玛丽亚飓风 — — 这场飓风据报已经夺去了2975条生命。
en: Indeed, the US, the wealthiest country in the world, wasn’t even ready for Hurricane Katrina in New Orleans, Hurricane Sandy in New York, Hurricane Harvey in Houston, or Hurricane Maria in Puerto Rico, which is now estimated to have taken 2,975 lives.

zh: 上述四场飓风都位处美国历史上最具破坏性的飓风之列，而且都发生在过去15年间。
en: These four hurricanes have been among the most damaging in US history, and they have all occurred in just the past 15 years.

zh: 其破坏严重至此并不仅仅是由于行政无能或沿海住宅和商业发展密度增加，相反，它是意料之内的气候变化后果。
en: The severity of their impact was not merely a product of administrative incompetence or the increased density of coastal residential and commercial development. Rather, it was the predictable result of a changing climate.

zh: 更糟糕的是，如果按照目前的趋势持续下去与未来的灾害相比这些都只能算是蚊子叮了一下而已。
en: Even worse, as natural disasters go, these were small pinpricks compared to what the future holds in store if current trends continue.

zh: 正如十七世纪诗人约翰·多恩（John Donne）提醒我们的那样 ， “ 没有人 ” — —也没有任何一个民族，地区或国家 — — “是一座孤岛 ” . . . . . . 因此我从不问丧钟为谁而鸣，它为我，也为你。
en: As the seventeenth-century poet John Donne would remind us, “No man” – nor nation, region, or country – “is an island entire of itself. … And therefore never send to know for whom the bell tolls; it tolls for thee.”

zh: 加拿大引领甲烷减排
en: Canada Takes the Lead on Methane Emissions

zh: 渥太华/华盛顿—在遏制气候变化方面，二氧化碳吸引了监管者的主要注意力。
en: OTTAWA/WASHINGTON, DC – In the fight against climate change, carbon dioxide attracts the bulk of regulators’ attention.

zh: 但长期存在的二氧化碳固然是升温的罪魁祸首之一，并不是唯一的嫌犯。
en: But while long-lived CO2 is a key contributor to rising temperatures, it is not the only culprit.

zh: 其他只能短期存在的污染源也在威胁着地球，其中最需要监管的莫过于甲烷。
en: Other short-lived super pollutants are also warming the planet, and none is in greater need of regulation than methane.

zh: 据气候变化政府间委员会的数据，甲烷的吸热作用可以在20年时间里比二氧化碳厉害86倍，它造成了人为引起的变暖的五分之一。
en: According to the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, methane is 86 times more potent than CO2 as a heat-trapping gas over a 20-year period, and is responsible for about a fifth of the warming caused by humans.

zh: 如果国际社会要想实现巴黎气候协定的目标 — — 将全球升温幅度限制在前工业化以上2℃以内 — — 那么控制甲烷就必须作为工作重点。
en: If the international community is to have any chance of meeting targets set by the Paris climate agreement and keep global warming well below 2°C above preindustrial levels, the control of methane must be a high priority.

zh: 但目前的情况是控制甲烷尚未实现全球并进，只有少数国家 — — 其中加拿大是最近的领导者 — — 承诺要管理甲烷。
en: At the moment, however, that is not happening on a global scale, and only a handful of countries – led most recently by Canada – have committed to managing methane.

zh: 美国科学院的一份最新报告说甲烷是一个“有趣的”政策问题，因为找不到主因。
en: A recent report by the US National Academy of Sciences (NAS) called methane an “intriguing” policy problem, because there is no dominant cause.

zh: 最近甲烷排放量的升高被归因为一系列原因，包括森林火灾和稻田发酵。
en: Recent spikes in emissions have been attributed to a variety of sources, including forest fires and fermentation in rice fields.

zh: 测量甲烷 — — 包括用今天的红外线摄像机来测量 — — 难度很大。
en: Measuring methane, including by using today’s infrared cameras, is challenging.

zh: 据美国科学院报告，即便是美国也无法有效地测量、监控和解释甲烷问题。
en: According to the NAS report, not even the United States has the tools to measure, monitor, and account for methane effectively.

zh: 但改良测量工具以侦测甲烷源的希望就在眼前，在加利福尼亚的低空飞机测试中 — — 目的是完善测量工具的卫星应用 — — 取得了成功。
en: But improved measurement tools for detecting sources of methane are on the horizon, and are being successfully tested in California on low-flying planes, with the goal of perfecting the tools for use on satellites.

zh: 即使我们改良了监测甲烷泄露的工具，也必须大力减少甲烷。
en: Even as we improve our tools for detecting methane leaks, we must pursue aggressive methane reductions.

zh: 如果世界能够效仿加拿大和加利福尼亚州在减少甲烷方面的创新，有望实现迅速剧烈地减少甲烷。
en: If the world follows the lead of methane-mitigation innovators like Canada and California, it is possible to make fast and dramatic reductions.

zh: 三个行业迫切需要监管关注，首先是石油和天然气行业。
en: Three sectors need urgent regulatory attention, starting with the oil and gas industry.

zh: 据国际能源署数据，改善石油天然气价值链中的甲烷捕获是一个廉价又有效的方法，每年，石油天然气行业要产生7,600万吨甲烷排放，其中大约一半源自很容易堵住的泄露。
en: According to the International Energy Agency, improving methane capture in the oil and gas value chain would be cheap and effective, given that roughly half of the sector’s 76 million tons of annual methane emissions results from easily contained leaks.

zh: 且甲烷事实上是一种可销售的产品，因此捕获甲烷的净成本可能是零。
en: And, because methane is actually a marketable product, capturing it can be achieved at no net cost.

zh: 其次，农业特别是畜牧业的甲烷排放需要加紧控制。
en: Second, methane emissions in agriculture, and especially in livestock farming, need tighter controls.

zh: 在这里，改善管理也能带来巨大的经济利益。
en: Here, too, improved management has a strong economic rationale.

zh: 比如，强制使用厌氧分解池等甲烷捕获装置有助于农民利用牛和猪所产生的甲烷，提供可再生能源资源，取代化石燃料用于发电设备。
en: For example, mandating the use of methane-capture devices such as anaerobic digesters would help farmers harness methane from cattle and pigs, providing a renewable source of energy generation that could replace fossil fuels used to power equipment.

zh: 最后，各级别政府应该要求捕获和使用填埋和废水处理长所排放的甲烷。
en: Finally, governments at all levels should require the capture and use of methane emitted by landfills and wastewater treatment plants.

zh: 实施了新的甲烷测量方法后，国家、城市和公司能够解决可轻松控制的甲烷源，为应对未来更艰巨的挑战奠定基础。
en: With new methane-measurement practices, countries, cities, and companies could address sources of methane that are easily controlled, laying the groundwork for tougher challenges in the years ahead.

zh: 但是，尽管可行方案唾手可得，许多国家仍然对减少甲烷的便捷方法视而不见。
en: And yet, despite the availability of viable solutions, many countries continue to ignore the low-hanging fruit of methane mitigation.

zh: 美国、墨西哥和加拿大两年前便承诺要采取集体行动降低石油天然气部门的甲烷排放，但迟迟没有取得进展。
en: Two years after the US, Mexico, and Canada pledged to take collective action and reduce methane emissions from the oil and gas sector, progress has stalled.

zh: 在美国，特朗普政府免除了能源公司捕获钻井产生的甲烷的责任，而墨西哥只做出了不具约束力的承诺。
en: In the US, the Trump administration has exempted energy companies from methane capture during drilling, while Mexico has offered only non-binding pledges.

zh: 幸运的是，加拿大没有和它们沆瀣一气。
en: Fortunately, Canada is going in the other direction.

zh: 加拿大监管者刚刚发布的新规则将目标定位未来七年降低石油和天然气行业45%的甲烷排放。
en: Canadian regulators just released new rules aimed at reducing methane emissions from the oil and gas industry by as much as 45% over the next seven years.

zh: 这些规则也巩固了加拿大在减少甲烷方面的全球领导者地位。
en: These rules solidify Canada as a global leader in methane-reduction efforts.

zh: 这些规则也有利于加拿大的国家利益。
en: The rules also advance Canada’s national interests.

zh: 北极预测（Projections for the Arctic）表明，北极地区的变暖速度是世界平均速度的两倍，反射阳光的海冰（reflective sea ice）正在以飞快的速度消失。
en: Projections for the Arctic show that the region is warming at twice the global average and is losing reflective sea ice at a staggering pace.

zh: 如果失去这些将热量反射会太空的冰盾，升温还将加速，导致冻土融化，封存的远古甲烷和二氧化碳将回到大气中。
en: Without this icy shield to reflect heat back into space, warming accelerates, permafrost melts, and ancient stores of methane and CO2 are returned to the atmosphere.

zh: 这一循环不但将推高全球气温，还将威胁到加拿大东北部社会的生存。
en: Not only does this cycle drive up global temperatures, it also threatens the survival of Canada’s northern communities.

zh: 加拿大也许在落实新甲烷规则方面有着更多的激励。
en: Canada may have an added source of motivation for implementing new methane rules.

zh: 但这些规则是一次促使全球各国和城市重新致力于减少甲烷战略的机会。
en: But such rules amount to an opportunity to help countries and cities around the world recommit to methane-mitigation strategies.

zh: 加拿大将在今年6月主办G7峰会，届时其领导人将有机会推动这一日程；他们必须抓住这个机会。
en: When Canada hosts the G7 summit in June, its leaders will have an opportunity to advance this agenda; they must take it.

zh: 如果世界想要实现巴黎协定的气温目标、减缓变暖速度，那么每一种可能造成地球变暖的气体 — — 而不仅仅是二氧化碳 — — 都必须得到测量和适当的管理。
en: If the world is to meet the temperature targets of the Paris accord and slow the pace of warming, every gas responsible for a warmer planet – not just CO2 – must be measured and appropriately managed.

zh: 气候变化的肉制品因素
en: The Meaty Side of Climate Change

zh: 柏林—去年，世界三大肉制品公司 — — JBS、嘉吉（Cargill）和泰森食品（Tyson Foods ） — —所排放的温室气体量比法国还要高，与一些大石油公司等量齐观。
en: BERLIN – Last year, three of the world’s largest meat companies – JBS, Cargill, and Tyson Foods – emitted more greenhouse gases than France, and nearly as much as some big oil companies.

zh: 然而，在埃克森和壳牌等能源巨头因为刺激气候变化而饱受口诛笔伐的同时，肉奶业公司几乎无人关注。
en: And yet, while energy giants like Exxon and Shell have drawn fire for their role in fueling climate change, the corporate meat and dairy industries have largely avoided scrutiny.

zh: 如果我们想要避免环境灾难，这一双重标准就必须改变。
en: If we are to avert environmental disaster, this double standard must change.

zh: 为了激起人们对此问题的关注，农业和贸易政策研究所（Institute for Agriculture and Trade Policy ） 、 GRAIN和德国海因里希·玻尔基金会（Heinrich Böll Foundation）最近组织了一项关于全球牲畜贸易的“超大气候足迹”的研究。
en: To bring attention to this issue, the Institute for Agriculture and Trade Policy, GRAIN, and Germany’s Heinrich Böll Foundation recently teamed up to study the “supersized climate footprint” of the global livestock trade.

zh: 我们的发现令人震惊。
en: What we found was shocking.

zh: 2016年，全球20家最大的肉奶制品公司排放的温室气体量比德国还要高。
en: In 2016, the world’s 20 largest meat and dairy companies emitted more greenhouse gases than Germany.

zh: 如果把这些公司看成一个国家，它将是世界第七大排放国。
en: If these companies were a country, they would be the world’s seventh-largest emitter.

zh: 显然，遏制气候变化需要限制肉奶业的排放。
en: Obviously, mitigating climate change will require tackling emissions from the meat and dairy industries.

zh: 问题是如何实现。
en: The question is how.

zh: 放眼全球，肉奶制品公司已经成为政治强势实体。
en: Around the world, meat and dairy companies have become politically powerful entities.

zh: 最近，两位JBS高管 — — 乔斯利和韦斯利·巴蒂斯塔（Joesley and Wesley Batista）兄弟因腐败问题被捕，揭开了行业腐败的面纱。
en: The recent corruption-related arrests of two JBS executives, the brothers Joesley and Wesley Batista, pulled back the curtain on corruption in the industry.

zh: JBS是世界第一大肉处理商，2016年利润比差距最小的竞争对手泰森食品公司多出近200亿美元。
en: JBS is the largest meat processor in the world, earning nearly $20 billion more in 2016 than its closest rival, Tyson Foods.

zh: 但JBS赢得这一地位受到了巴西开发银行的支持，显然，其所贿赂的1,800多位政客也提供了便利。
en: But JBS achieved its position with assistance from the Brazilian Development Bank, and apparently, by bribing more than 1,800 politicians.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪，温室气体排放绝非该公司的重点关注问题。
en: It is no wonder, then, that greenhouse-gas emissions are low on the company’s list of priorities.

zh: 2016年，JBS和、泰森和嘉吉排放了4.84亿吨气候变化气体，比英国能源巨头英国石油公司多4,600万吨。
en: In 2016, JBS, Tyson and Cargill emitted 484 million tons of climate-changing gases, 46 million tons more than BP, the British energy giant.

zh: 肉奶业大力推动有利于其生产的政策，常常不惜为此牺牲环境和公共健康。
en: Meat and dairy industry insiders push hard for pro-production policies, often at the expense of environmental and public health.

zh: 它们阻挠一氧化二氮和甲烷的减排计划，规避减少空气、水和土壤污染的义务。 它们赚取万贯利润，却让公众来承担污染的成本。
en: From seeking to block reductions in nitrous oxide and methane emissions, to circumventing obligations to reduce air, water, and soil pollution, they have managed to increase profits while dumping pollution costs on the public.

zh: 一个后果是牧业生产目前占了全球温室气体排放量的近15 % 。
en: One consequence, among many, is that livestock production now accounts for nearly 15% of global greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 这一比例要比整个交通业总量还要大。
en: That is a bigger share than the world’s entire transportation sector.

zh: 此外，在未来十年中，肉奶产量的增长中预计将主要来自工业模式。
en: Moreover, much of the growth in meat and dairy production in the coming decades is expected to come from the industrial model.

zh: 如果这一增长趋势与联合国粮农组织的预测吻合的话，我们制止气温升高到灾难水平的能力就会遭到严重破坏。
en: If this growth conforms to the pace projected by the UN Food and Agriculture Organization, our ability to keep temperatures from rising to apocalyptic levels will be severely undermined.

zh: 在上个月在德国波恩举行的联合国气候变化会议（COP23）上，一些联合国机构史上第一次开始关注在农业（包括牲口管理）相关问题上的合作。
en: At the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP23) in Bonn, Germany, last month, several UN agencies were directed, for the first time ever, to cooperate on issues related to agriculture, including livestock management.

zh: 从诸多方面看，这一动作是非常积极的，但一个突出的原因是这将把全球农商（agribusiness）贸易中长期存在的利益冲突曝光于天下。
en: This move is welcome for many reasons, but especially because it will begin to expose the conflicts of interest that are endemic in the global agribusiness trade.

zh: 为了回避气候责任，肉奶行业长期以来一直在宣传，为了食品安全必须扩大产量。
en: To skirt climate responsibility, the meat and dairy industries have long argued that expanding production is necessary for food security.

zh: 它们说，与非洲之角的牧民和印度的小规模生产商相比，公司制企业能够以更高的效率生产肉和奶制品。
en: Corporate firms, they insist, can produce meat or milk more efficiently than a pastoralist in the Horn of Africa or a small-scale producer in India.

zh: 不幸的是，当前气候政策没有反驳这一叙事，有的甚至鼓励增加产量和密集度。
en: Unfortunately, current climate policies do not refute this narrative, and some even encourage increased production and intensification.

zh: 目前的不少政策非但没有制定行业相关排放总量的减排计划，反而激励企业在每头奶牛身上榨取更多的奶，让肉牛能更快地走上屠宰线。
en: Rather than setting targets for the reduction of total industry-related emissions, many current policies create incentives for firms to squeeze more milk from each dairy cow and bring beef cattle to slaughter faster.

zh: 这就需要将动物等同于能共通过技术手段进行改造，实现更小投入产生更多产出的机器，完全忽视了这一模式的其他副作用。
en: This necessitates equating animals to machinery that can be tweaked to produce more with less through technological fixes, and ignoring all of this model other negative effects.

zh: 加利福尼亚州的经验很有说明性。
en: California’s experience is instructive.

zh: 州政府实施了世界上第一个监管农业甲烷排放的政策，制定了雄心勃勃的牛肉处理活动减排目标。
en: Pursuing one of the world’s first efforts to regulate agricultural methane, the state government has set ambitious targets to reduce emissions in cattle processing.

zh: 但加州目前是通过支持大型奶制品生产商，而非小型可持续生产商的融资计划解决问题。
en: But California is currently addressing the issue by financing programs that support mega-dairies, rather than small, sustainable operators.

zh: 这样的“解决办法”只能恶化该行业已然相当拙劣的工人和动物福利记录，并加剧负面的环境和卫生相关影响。
en: Such “solutions” have only worsened the industry’s already-poor record on worker and animal welfare, and exacerbated adverse environmental and health-related effects.

zh: 解决办法确实是存在的。
en: Solutions do exist.

zh: 首先，政府可以将公共资金从工厂化农场和大规模农商转移到规模较小、更注重生态的家庭农场。
en: For starters, governments could redirect public money from factory farming and large-scale agribusiness to smaller, ecologically focused family farms.

zh: 政府还可以用采购政策来帮助建立地方产品市场和鼓励更清洁、更有活力的农场经济。
en: Governments could also use procurement policies to help build markets for local products and encourage cleaner, more vibrant farm economies.

zh: 放眼全球，许多城市已经开始为了解决气候变化而制定能源选择。
en: Many cities around the world are already basing their energy choices on a desire to tackle climate change.

zh: 类似的标准也可以影响大都市的食品政策。
en: Similar criteria could shape municipalities’ food policies, too.

zh: 比如，加大农转医（farm-to-hospital）和农转学（farm-to-school）计划的投资能够确保居民形成更加健康的饮食习惯，加强地方经济，减少肉奶行业的气候影响。
en: For example, higher investment in farm-to-hospital and farm-to-school programs would ensure healthier diets for residents, strengthen local economies, and reduce the climate impact of the meat and dairy industries.

zh: 在太长的一段时间里，肉奶业巨头都没有因为经营活动影响到气候而受到惩罚。
en: Dairy and meat giants have operated with climate impunity for far too long.

zh: 如果我们想要阻止全球气温上升、阻止气候危机，消费者和政府就必须采取更多行动建立、支持和增强有环境良心的生产商。
en: If we are to halt global temperature spikes and avert an ecological crisis, consumers and governments must do more to create, support, and strengthen environmentally conscious producers.

zh: 这对于我们 — — 以及地球 — — 的健康都是一件好事。
en: That would be good for our health – and for the health of our planet.

zh: 下一次难民潮
en: The Next Migrant Wave

zh: 马尼拉—想象你是一位农民。
en: MANILA – Imagine that you are a farmer.

zh: 你的庄稼因为降水波动变得剧烈而歉收，你的井水太咸无法饮用，市场上的大米太贵你买不起。
en: Your crops are withering as weather patterns become more volatile, your well water is too salty to drink, and rice is too expensive to buy at the market.

zh: 于是你离开家园寻找更好的生活。
en: So, you leave home in search of a better life.

zh: 全世界有数百万生活在脆弱社区的人不需要想象这样的情景。
en: Millions of people in vulnerable communities around the world do not have to imagine such a scenario.

zh: 他们就生活在这样的情景中，他们是日益难以预测的气候的受害者；而随着气候变化效应的加剧，他们的数量有可能急剧增加。
en: They are living it now, as an increasingly unpredictable climate takes its toll; and their numbers are likely to soar as the effects of climate change intensify.

zh: 但世界对于这些未来气候移民的准备还不如欧洲对眼下从中东和北非蜂拥而入的人潮。
en: But the world is even less prepared for these future climate migrants than Europe is for the current wave of people fleeing from the Middle East and North Africa.

zh: 大部分气候移民都在国内迁徙，但也有一些别无选择，只能寻求成为海外难民。
en: Most climate migrants will relocate within their own borders, but others will have no choice but to seek refuge abroad.

zh: 如果海平面继续上升超过一米，太平洋岛礁和珊瑚礁国家的全体人口都需要重新安置。
en: If sea levels rise by more than one meter, entire populations of Pacific-atoll and reef-island countries might have to relocate.

zh: 如果有良好的规划和管理，移民可以帮助人们适应这些威胁。
en: If it is well planned and managed, migration can help people adapt to such threats.

zh: 但如果得不到良好的规划和管理，就有可能导致人道危机。
en: But if it is not, it can lead to humanitarian crises.

zh: 总体而言，当下的政策不够充分。
en: Overall, today’s policies are inadequate.

zh: 来源和目的国都急需让人们的迁徙 — — 或在无力或选择不迁徙时留在原地生活 — — 变得更容易、更安全。
en: Source and destination countries urgently need to make it easier and safer for people to move, or to remain where they are if they cannot afford or choose not to leave.

zh: 气候变化将成为助长未来移民潮的诸多因素之一。
en: Climate change will be one of many factors fueling future migration waves.

zh: 尽管一个人是因为环境因素还是其他原因而背井离乡已经越来越难以辨别，但我们知道气候将在移民问题上扮演更重要的角色，因为土壤流失等发展缓慢的威胁和龙卷风等急性风险正在威胁越来越多的人的生计。
en: Although it will become increasingly difficult to distinguish between people fleeing from environmental factors and those who have left for other reasons, we know that climate will play a larger role in migration, as slow-onset threats such as erosion and acute hazards such as cyclones threaten more people’s livelihoods.

zh: 大部分高危人群生活在亚洲，亚洲也是最容易受气候变化影响的地区。
en: Most of the people at risk live in Asia, which is uniquely exposed to the effects of climate change.

zh: 拜近几十年来大量人口向大城市集中的趋势所赐，在大部分人口生活在低海拔地区（因而受到洪水、风暴潮、咸潮和水土流失的威胁）的十个国家中。
en: Nine of the ten countries with the most people living in low-lying areas (who are therefore threatened by flooding, storm surges, salinity, and erosion) are in Asia, owing to mass migration to megacities in recent decades.

zh: 一份最新研究预测，到2060年，亚洲低海拔人口将较2000年翻一番，达到9.83亿，占世界低海拔人口的90 % 。
en: A recent study forecasts that Asia’s low-elevation population could double by 2060, to 983 million, from its level in 2000, thus accounting for 70% of the world’s total.

zh: 在该地区的其他国家，因为降水量减少、咸潮、冰川消融和沙漠化而导致的用水压力将影响到水存量，威胁到人的生计，推高粮食和水的价格。
en: Elsewhere in the region, water stress from reduced rainfall, salinity, glacial retreat, and desertification will hit water stocks, threaten livelihoods, and drive up food and water prices.

zh: 如果世界成功地减轻气候变化，这些重大变故可能不会成为现实。
en: These drastic scenarios might not materialize if the world succeeds in mitigating climate change.

zh: 但各国都不能自满。
en: But no country should be complacent.

zh: 特别是亚洲国家一定要为最糟糕情景做好准备，并实施具有远见的国家政策，如基里巴斯的“有尊严地移民”计划，该计划为这个低海拔太平洋岛国公民提供教育和职业培训，以增加他们出国后找到体面工作的机会。
en: Asian countries, especially, should prepare for worst-case scenarios, and implement far-sighted national policies, such as Kiribati’s “migration with dignity” program, which provides education and vocational training to citizens of the low-lying Pacific island state to improve their chances of finding decent work abroad.

zh: 为亚洲的未来情景做好准备，需要更加完整的数据判断气候相关事件的可能时间和影响，并评估对移民模式造成的效应。
en: Preparations for any future scenario in Asia will require more complete data to judge the potential impact and timing of climate-related events, and to assess their effect on migration patterns.

zh: 各国的具体数据能让各国政府磨合它们的政策。
en: Country-specific data would allow individual governments to hone their policies.

zh: 这包括更加彻底的国家人口普查，这类调查常常忽视贫民窟等边缘化社区。
en: This includes more thorough national censuses, which too often disregard marginalized communities like slum-dwellers.

zh: 人口普查应该是包容性的，以此为基础建立国家数据库监测进展、辨别脆弱人口并与地区共详细信息。
en: Censuses should be conducted inclusively, fed into national databases to monitor progress and identify vulnerable populations, and shared across the region.

zh: 政府应该教育公民气候变化有哪些影响，从而让希望留下或无力迁徙的人做好准备。
en: Governments should educate their citizens about the effects of climate change, in order to prepare those who want to stay or cannot afford to leave.

zh: 移民来源国应该具备国家灾害风险评估（以便为潜��损失做好规划 ） 、 完整的风险地图以及灾难早期预警，以使公民有安全感。
en: Migrant source countries should have national disaster risk assessments (so that they can plan for potential losses), comprehensive hazard maps, and disaster early-warning systems to reassure their citizens.

zh: 应该建设新房屋、道路、桥梁和其他基础设施（如供水系统）以抵御极端天气。
en: And new houses, roads, bridges, and other infrastructure, such as water systems, should be built to withstand extreme weather.

zh: 与此同时，政府应该为确实离开家园的人提供可转移福利，以使他们能够在国外维持生活。
en: At the same time, governments should provide access to portable benefits for those people who do leave, so that they can support themselves abroad.

zh: 目的国应该考虑为流离失所的工人提供应急就业，澳大利亚和新西兰的季节性工人计划就是榜样。
en: And destination countries should consider providing emergency employment for displaced workers, using Australia and New Zealand’s seasonal worker programs as a model.

zh: 目的国还可以建立城市工作和培训中心为即将到来的移民服务，后者普遍缺少从事城市岗位所需要的技能；拥有专业技能的人的资质也应该得到承认，并获得应聘帮助。
en: Destination countries could also establish urban work and training centers for incoming migrants, many of whom will lack the skills required to land city jobs; and they should recognize the qualifications of those who do have expertise, and help them to find work.

zh: 目的国投资于可持续基础设施和为新来者提供的基础服务至关重要。
en: It will be essential for destination countries to invest in sustainable infrastructure and basic services for new arrivals.

zh: 一些城市对于提供服务犹豫不决，因为担心这会引来新的移民。
en: Some cities are hesitant to provide services, because they fear it will attract new migrants.

zh: 但这样的态度只能迫使移民进入贫民窟，从而制造更大的问题。
en: But this attitude only forces migrants into slums, which creates even bigger problems.

zh: 更好的方法是将移民从脆弱的农村地区引导到具备必要条件、能够吸收他们的中型城市周边；而这反过来又能防止大城市不可持续地增长。
en: A better approach is to steer migrants from vulnerable rural areas to nearby medium-size cities equipped with the necessary services to absorb them; this, in turn, will prevent megacities from growing unsustainably.

zh: 根据这些原则制定的全面的计划有助于让移民成为气候变化解决方案的一部分，而不是沦为气候变化的消极效应的一部分。
en: A comprehensive approach along these lines would help to make migration part of the solution to climate change, not just another of its harmful effects.

zh: 许多国家需要资金支持这些计划的实施，令人鼓舞的是，2015年巴黎气候协定成立了一个工作组解决气候相关的流离失所问题。
en: Many countries will need funding to implement such plans, and, encouragingly, the 2015 Paris climate agreement established a taskforce to address climate-related displacement.

zh: 其主要目标之一应该放在确保气候变化适应的融资机制将移民问题也考虑在内。
en: One of its main goals should be to ensure that funding mechanisms for climate-change adaptation encompass migration issues.

zh: 至于现在，我们需要对这一紧迫问题进行跟大力度的全球讨论。
en: For now, we need a more energetic global discussion on this pressing issue.

zh: 气候导致的移民带来了缓解还是混乱取决于我们今天所达成的政策和投资协议。
en: Whether climate-induced migration brings relief or chaos will depend on the policies and investments we agree to today.

zh: 我们应该从现在开始行动起来，让脆弱社区能够决定他们的未来。
en: We should act now to give vulnerable communities a say in their future.

zh: 新气候经济中的增长
en: Growth in the New Climate Economy

zh: 米兰—长期以来，降低二氧化碳排放量、遏制气候变化的行动被认为与经济增长存在根本矛盾。
en: MILAN – Action to reduce carbon-dioxide emissions and mitigate climate change has long been viewed as fundamentally opposed to economic growth.

zh: 事实上，全球经济复苏十分脆弱常常被用于论证推迟这些行动的论据。
en: Indeed, the fragility of the global economic recovery is often cited as a justification to delay such action.

zh: 但全球经济和气候委员会（Global Commission on the Economy and Climate , ） 的最新报告《新气候经济：更好的增长、更好的气候 》 （ The New Climate Economy: Better Growth, Better Climate）驳斥了这一说法。
en: But a recent report, “The New Climate Economy: Better Growth, Better Climate” released by the Global Commission on the Economy and Climate, refutes this reasoning.

zh: 该报告指出，对抗气候变化的努力不但不会阻挠经济增长，反而可以极大地起到提振作用 — — 并且这一天很快就会到来。
en: Far from being a detriment to economic growth, the report concludes that efforts to combat climate change could boost growth considerably – and relatively soon.

zh: 只要你研究过2008年金融危机爆发以来的经济表现就会明白，资产负债表伤害 — — 如过度负债和得不到融资的非债务责任 — — 可能导致增长放缓、突然停止甚至逆转。
en: Anyone who has studied economic performance since the onset of the financial crisis in 2008, understands that damage to balance sheets – such as excess debt and unfunded non-debt liabilities – can cause growth slowdowns, sudden stops, or even reversals.

zh: 而熟悉发展中国家增长的人都明白，人力资本、基础设施和经济知识和技术基础投资不足是形成无法支持持续增长的资产负债表的最终原因。
en: And those familiar with growth in developing countries know that underinvestment in human capital, infrastructure, and the economy’s knowledge and technology base eventually produces balance sheets that cannot support continued growth.

zh: 气候变化和这些不可持续或有缺陷的增长模式并无多大差别。
en: Climate change is not very different from these unsustainable or defective growth patterns.

zh: 它从本质上也是资产负债表问题，其基础是大气中的二氧化碳存量。
en: It, too, is essentially a balance-sheet problem, based on the stock of CO2 in the atmosphere

zh: 按照当前轨迹，在经历三四十年（或更少 ） ， 大气中的二氧化碳水平就将达到破坏气候模式的程度，给环境造成灾难性后果，进而威胁经济和社会系统。
en: On its current trajectory, the world has only 3-4 decades (or less) before atmospheric CO2 reaches levels that disrupt climate patterns, with catastrophic consequences for the environment and, in turn, economic and social systems.

zh: 放任世界的“自然资本 ” — —支持经济和社会系统的资源和生态系统 — — 耗尽本质上无非是另一种形式的破坏性投资不足。
en: Allowing the world’s “natural capital” – the resources and ecosystems that underpin these systems – to be depleted is essentially another form of destructive underinvestment.

zh: 大量支持当前气候预测的科学证据表明，世界不可能完全放弃调整。
en: The massive amount of scientific evidence supporting current climate projections makes it unlikely that the world will forego adjustment entirely.

zh: 但解决调整所产生的复杂的合作和分配问题决非易事，而在认定我们在面临如此之多的其他紧迫挑战时无法承受激进的遏制气候变化战略的情况下，决策者可能会推迟行动。
en: But solving the complex coordination and distributional problems that such adjustments will generate will not be easy, and, convinced that we cannot afford an aggressive mitigation strategy at a time when we are faced with so many other pressing challenges, policymakers could be tempted to defer action on the ground.

zh: 《新气候经济》指出这是个非常坏的主意。
en: “The New Climate Economy” argues that this would be a very bad idea.

zh: 该报告对最新研究、经验和创新做了彻底评估，得出了一个明确的结论 — — 现在行动的成本远比等待低。
en: The report’s thorough assessment of recent research, experience, and innovation led to the unambiguous conclusion that acting now would be far less costly than waiting.

zh: 事实上，现在行动几乎不会产生任何成本。
en: In fact, acting now is barely costly at all.

zh: 低碳经济增长路径和高碳路径并非完全不同 — — 除非后者迅速走向崩溃式失灵。
en: Low-carbon paths of economic growth do not look all that different from high-carbon paths – until the latter veers sharply to the precipice of catastrophic failure.

zh: 换言之，降低二氧化碳排放量的成本 — — 用增长、收入和其他经济和社会表现指标衡量 — — 在短期和中期并不十分高昂。
en: Put another way, the net costs of reducing CO2 emissions – in terms of growth, income, and other measures of economic and social performance – are not all that high in the short and medium term.

zh: 我们现在已经知道高碳增长路径对自然环境造成的后果以及反过来对生活质量的影响，这些成本实际可能为负值。
en: Given what we know now about the consequences of the high-carbon path for the natural environment and, in turn, health outcomes and quality of life, those costs could actually be negative.

zh: 但有一个重要的附带条件：必须立刻采取行动。
en: But there is an important proviso: action must be taken urgently.

zh: 遏制气候变化的行动的经济成本会因为拖延而呈现非线性升高。
en: The economic costs of action to mitigate climate change rise non-linearly as action is delayed.

zh: 如果推迟15年或以上，遏制目标就无法实现，不管付出多大成本。
en: If those costs are deferred for 15 years or more, mitigation targets will be impossible to achieve, at any cost.

zh: 那么，我们如何走上低碳增长路径？
en: So how do we move onto the low-carbon path?

zh: 报告指出，在2050年前建设作为低碳全球经济基础的高能源效率建筑和基础设施、将低碳战略纳入市政规划过程以及充分利用互联网在增强效率方面的潜力能带来诸多裨益。
en: The report points out the benefits of constructing the energy-efficient buildings and infrastructure needed to underpin the low-carbon global economy of 2050, incorporating low-carbon strategies into municipal-planning processes, and tapping the efficiency-enhancing potential of the Internet.

zh: 除此之外，替代能源资源成本将不断下降，技术进步层出不穷，世界减碳目标其实并不遥远，也并不成本高昂。
en: Add to that the declining costs of alternative energy sources and relentless technological advancement, and the world’s carbon-reduction goals do not seem so distant – or costly.

zh: 在评估了报告中所包括的技术、政策选择和分析后，你会得出一个结论：低碳增长路径在短期或许比高碳路径略低，投资更高，消费更低。
en: After evaluating the technologies, policy options, and analysis included in the report, one might conclude that low-carbon growth paths may be slightly flatter in the short term than their high-carbon counterparts, with higher investment and lower consumption.

zh: 尽管如此，你不能就此认为低碳路径较劣，因为低碳路径拥有中长期优势。
en: Nonetheless, it would be difficult to deem them inferior, given their medium-to-long-term advantages.

zh: 报告还提出了气候争论中的另一个重要问题：全球合作对遏制气候变化是否关键？
en: The report also sheds light on another important question in the climate debate: Is global cooperation critical to mitigate climate change?

zh: 对于给定经济体，单独行动是否会导致显著更劣的增长路径 — — 比如破坏可贸易部门的竞争力？
en: For a given economy, does acting alone yield distinctly inferior growth paths – say, by damaging the competitiveness of its tradable sector?

zh: 如果答案是肯定的，那么国际政策合作就似乎是遏制气候变化方面进步的必要前提。
en: If the answer is yes, international policy coordination would seem to be a necessary precondition for progress.

zh: 事实似乎并非如此。
en: This does not appear to be the case.

zh: 支持个体国家向低碳增长路径转型（比如提高能源效率）的国家政策日程有相当大一部分不会导致经济减速；甚至有可能带来比保持高碳路径更高的增长。
en: A substantial portion of a national policy agenda that supports an individual country’s shift to a low-carbon growth path (boosting energy efficiency, for example) will not produce an economic slowdown; such an effort might even lead to higher growth rates than remaining on a high-carbon path would have delivered.

zh: 在最初的近似（first approximation）中，低碳路径是主要战略，并产生了完全不同也远远更加有利的起作用的激励结构观。
en: On a first approximation, low-carbon paths are the dominant strategies, implying a completely different and far more favorable view of the incentive structures at work.

zh: 这意味着，尽管国际合作将是遏制气候变化行动长期成功的重要因素，但其副作用并不一定 — — 也不应该 — — 威胁进展。
en: This means that, though international coordination will be an important factor in the long-term success of action to mitigate climate change, its complications need not – and should not – hold progress hostage.

zh: 发展和实施全球战略是一件难事，因此这是一个好消息。
en: Given the difficulty of developing and implementing a global strategy, that is good news.

zh: 科学证据已经打消了对气候变化所带来的风险规模的质疑。
en: Scientific evidence has eliminated legitimate doubts about the scale of the risks that climate change poses.

zh: 如今，全球经济和气候委员会的分析又基本否定了不作为的经济理由。
en: Now, the Global Commission’s analysis has largely refuted the economic arguments for inaction.

zh: 此外，公众对气候变化也日益关注，采取决定性行动的条件也许已经成熟。
en: Add to that growing public concern about climate change, and the conditions for decisive action may have arrived.

zh: 气候的绝对使命
en: The Climate Categorical Imperative

zh: 开普敦—如今，人们常常被迫在做道德正确之事和做经济有利可图之事中间做出选择。
en: CAPE TOWN – Nowadays, people are too often forced to choose between doing what is morally right and doing what is economically beneficial.

zh: 事实上，他们的选择有时是互相排斥的，这让决定走哪条路变得无比艰难。
en: Indeed, their options sometimes appear to be mutually exclusive, making the decision of which path to take exceedingly challenging.

zh: 但是，有时，道德正确和经济利益是一致的，构成了不可错过的机会。
en: Sometimes, however, moral rectitude and economic interest merge, presenting an opportunity that must not be missed.

zh: 在大主教图图（Desmond Tutu）和前财政部长曼努埃尔（Trevor Manuel）看来，世界对气候变化的反应就是如此。
en: That is the case – from the perspectives of this Archbishop and former finance minister – with the world’s response to climate change.

zh: 道德紧迫性是无可争议的，气候变化的影响 — — 包括极端天气、气温变化和海平面上升 — — 冲击最大的是全球贫困人口，他们也是从导致气候变化的经济活动中受益最少的人群。
en: The moral imperative is indisputable, as the effects of climate change – including extreme weather, temperature changes, and rising sea levels – are felt most keenly by the global poor, who have also benefited the least from the economic activities that cause it.

zh: 此外，气候变化可能加速贫困、加剧不平等，这意味着，除非我们能及时地解决这一问题，否则子孙后代实现发展目标奥的机会将日益渺茫甚至消失。
en: Moreover, climate change could accelerate poverty and inequality in the future, meaning that, unless we address it in a timely manner, it will diminish – or even eliminate – future generations’ chances to achieve their development goals.

zh: 竭尽全力缩小今天的气候变化是一件绝对正确的事。
en: Making every effort to minimize climate change today is, quite simply, the right thing to do.

zh: 幸运的是，解决气候变化的经济利益也十分明确。
en: Fortunately, the economic benefits of addressing climate change are also clear.

zh: 毕竟，气候变化造成了巨大的经济成本 — — 比如频繁极端天气带来的损失。
en: After all, climate change carries significant economic costs – for example, those associated with more frequent and extreme weather events.

zh: 此外，以持续技术创新为基础构建“绿色经济”是为子孙后代创造可持续增长和就业岗位创造新引擎的最明智、最高效的办法。
en: Moreover, building a “green” economy, based on continued technological innovation, is the smartest and most efficient way to create new engines of sustainable growth and job creation for the next generation.

zh: 个人、公司、市政和国家层面的行动至关重要。
en: Action at the individual, company, municipal, and national levels is crucial.

zh: 但事实是气候变化是一个全球问题 — — 因��需要全球方案。
en: But the fact is that climate change is a global problem – and thus requires a global solution.

zh: 世界所拥有的做正确之事 — — 并收获巨大的经济收益 — — 的最重要的工具是全球气候变化协定。
en: The most important tool the world has for doing the right thing – and reaping vast economic benefits – is a universal climate-change agreement.

zh: 因此，全球领导人必须抓住12月巴黎联合国气候变化会议的机会，制定统一的全球行动框架。
en: That is why world leaders must take the opportunity presented by the United Nations Climate Change Conference in Paris this December to develop a single global framework for action.

zh: 事实上，全球领导人已经在致力于这一方向了。
en: In fact, world leaders already pledged to do so.

zh: 由南非发起和主办的年联合国气候变化会议形成了一个协议 — — 尽快实施全球气候变化法律协议，最晚不能超过今年。
en: The UN Climate Change Conference in 2011 – initiated and hosted by South Africa – produced an agreement to adopt a universal legal agreement on climate change as soon as possible, no later than this year.

zh: 德班会议以来，我们取得了重要进展。
en: Important progress has been made since the Durban conference.

zh: 上个月，30多个国家 — — 包括欧元区成员国、加蓬、墨西哥、挪威、俄罗斯、瑞士和美国 — — 递交了2020年后温室气体减排计划。
en: Last month, more than 30 countries – including the European Union’s members, Gabon, Mexico, Norway, Russia, Switzerland, and the United States – submitted their post-2020 plans to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 在未来几周和几个月中，进展还将继续获得动力，其他国家 — — 预计将包括巴西、中国和印度等主要新兴经济体 — — 也将提交它们的承诺。
en: In the coming weeks and months, this momentum will continue to build, as other countries – including, it is expected, major emerging economies like Brazil, China, and India – submit their commitments as well.

zh: 但如果巴黎会议要想取得成功 — — 既包括兑现道德使命，又包括抓住对抗气候变化的经济利益 — — 所有参与国都必须尽快递交2020年后的国家承诺。
en: But if the Paris meeting is to be successful – in terms of both fulfilling the moral imperative and capturing the economic benefits of confronting climate change – every participating country must submit its national contributions for the period beginning in 2020 as soon as possible.

zh: 此外，最终协议还必须包括关于未来50年的有效而宏大的去碳化计划。
en: Furthermore, the final agreement must include an effective and ambitious plan for de-carbonization over the next 50 years.

zh: 事实是，短期和中期承诺根本不足以兑现世界各国政府2009年所做、2010年重申的将全球气温升温幅度限制在工业化前水平以上2℃以内的保证。
en: The fact is that short- and medium-term commitments alone are simply inadequate to fulfill the pledge, made by the world’s governments in 2009 and reiterated in 2010, to cap the rise in global temperatures at 2° Celsius relative to the pre-industrial era.

zh: 一个关键点是制定 — — 并遵守 — — 累进的长期减排战略，向资本市场传递一个清晰的信号：政府对待气候变化的态度是严肃的。
en: It is crucial to create – and adhere to – a progressive long-term emissions-reduction strategy that sends a clear signal to capital markets that governments are serious about confronting climate change.

zh: 这一战略可以包括（比如）激励低碳方案投资。
en: Such a strategy could include, for example, incentives for investment in low-carbon solutions.

zh: 在未来15年终，全球基础设施投资预计将达90万亿美元，这一方针的影响力将是巨大的 — — 甚至是决定性的。
en: With some $90 trillion dollars set to be invested in infrastructure globally over the next 15 years, the impact of such an approach could be considerable – if not decisive.

zh: 在气候变化问题上有所作为具有无可争议的道德和经济收益。
en: The moral and economic imperatives to act on climate change could not be stronger.

zh: 尽管前路坎坷，意料外的新挑战将不断出现，但我们可以从纳尔逊·曼德拉的名言中获得鼓舞 ： “ 任何事情在做成之前看上去都是不可能的。
en: Although the road ahead will be difficult, with new and unexpected challenges arising along the way, we can find inspiration in Nelson Mandela’s famous dictum: “It always seems impossible until it’s done.”

zh: ”我们面临着前所未有的机会实现更加可持续、更加繁荣、社会更加公正的未来。
en: We face an unprecedented opportunity to achieve a more sustainable, prosperous, and socially just future.

zh: 创造这一未来必须从现在开始。
en: Creating that future must start now.

zh: 为何市场无法让地球变凉
en: Why Markets Can’t Cool the Planet

zh: 密尔沃基—全球气温正以令人警惕的速度上升，减少世界化石燃料消费、加速采用绿色能源刻不容缓。
en: MILWAUKEE – With global temperatures rising at an alarming rate, the race is on to lower the world’s consumption of fossil fuels and accelerate the adoption of greener forms of energy.

zh: 讨论最多的方案是用市场力量让传统燃料变得更加昂贵；概念包括给碳定价和保护消除大气中二氧化碳的自然资源。
en: Among the most discussed remedies are those that would use market forces to make traditional fuels more expensive; ideas include putting a price on carbon and protecting natural resources that remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere.

zh: 乍一看，基于市场的策略很有吸引力。
en: At first glance, market-based strategies might seem appealing.

zh: 毕竟，亚当·斯密在《国富论》中指出 ， “ 我们的晚餐不是来自屠夫、酿酒者和面包师的仁慈，而是来自他们对自身利益的关注。
en: After all, as Adam Smith noted in The Wealth of Nations, “It is not from the benevolence of the butcher, the brewer, or the baker that we expect our dinner, but from their regard to their own interest.”

zh: ”换句话说，说服雪弗龙和通用汽车等排放大户拯救地球的作家办法必须诉诸利润动机，对吧？
en: In other words, the best way to convince emitters like Chevron or General Motors to help save the planet must be to appeal to their profit motive, right?

zh: 未必。
en: Not necessarily.

zh: 自由市场固然能指引世界走向更富裕、更健康的未来，但相信斯密的“看不见的手”能赢得与气候变化的斗争将是一个悲剧性的错误。
en: While free markets may have steered much of the world toward a wealthier, healthier future, placing our faith in Smith’s “invisible hand” to win the fight against climate change would be a tragic mistake.

zh: 在资本主义经济中，我们与未来的关系受到瞬息万变的经济力量的引导。
en: In a capitalist economy, our relationship with the future is guided by economic forces that are notoriously fickle.

zh: 糖、大豆、石油和天然气等大宗商品都是相对标准化的产品，这意味着它们可以通过衍生品合约，不断地在全球进行交易。
en: Commodities like sugar, soybeans, oil, and gas are relatively standardized products, meaning that they can be traded instantly and globally through the use of derivative contracts.

zh: 但由于这些合约价格根据关于未来的假定制定，大宗商品价格的波动也相当剧烈。
en: But because these contracts price in assumptions about the future, commodity prices can fluctuate wildly.

zh: 而这一易变性通过三种重要方式让环境规划变得十分复杂。
en: And that variability complicates environmental planning in three important ways.

zh: 首先，价格的不可预测性使得几乎不可能仅仅通过关注短期价值变化侦测自然资源的消耗。
en: For starters, price unpredictability makes it virtually impossible to detect the depletion of natural resources merely by looking at short-term changes in value.

zh: 相反，关于资源稀缺性的不确定性越大，价格波动幅度也越大，进一步加剧了规划困难。
en: On the contrary, the more uncertainty there is about the scarcity of a resource, the greater the price swing, which only compounds the planning difficulty.

zh: 法国数学家尼古拉·柏辽（Nicolas Bouleau）在2013年的论文中观察道 ， “ 市场无法走出清楚的趋势，从本体论层面，这是绝对不可能的。
en: As the French mathematician Nicolas Bouleau observed in a 2013 paper, “markets cannot spell out trends; it is absolutely impossible on an ontological level.”

zh: ”如果可以从金融市场的结果中辨别资源相关趋势，看见这些趋势的人就能据此交易，从而让趋势消失。
en: If resource-related trends were discernible from outcomes in financial markets, those who could see them would trade accordingly and the trends would disappear.

zh: 其次，一切大宗商品未来价格的不确定性意味着生产商投资有助于降低温室气体排放的新技术变得风险畸高。
en: Second, uncertainty about the future price of any commodity makes it exceedingly risky for producers to invest in whatever new technologies might help reduce greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 对大部分生产商和消费者来说，保持现状往往比改变习惯更符合经济利益，即使他们知道现状对环境来说堪称灾难性。
en: For most producers and consumers, it usually makes more economic sense to maintain the status quo than to change their habits, even if they know that the status quo will be disastrous for the environment.

zh: 最后，尽管给宝贵但无法市场化的自然资源贴上价格标签是可能的 — — 如北方针叶林吸收大气中二氧化碳的能力 — — 但可交易的资源的价格波动让大部分保护策略从长期看无法维持。
en: Finally, although it’s possible to put a price tag on precious but non-marketable natural resources – like the capacity of a boreal forest to absorb atmospheric CO2 – the price fluctuations for resources that can be traded make most conservation strategies untenable in the long run.

zh: 这是因为，在某个时点，可交易资源的波动的价格将超过破坏它的固定的成本。
en: That’s because at some point, the volatile price of the tradable resource will exceed the fixed cost of destroying it.

zh: 当一种可燃自愿被发现是，掠夺的压力可能特别强烈。
en: The pressure to plunder can be especially strong when a combustible resource is found.

zh: 加拿大总理特鲁多在2017年3月的得克萨斯州休斯顿能源会议上承认 ， “ 没有一个国家会在地里找到1,730亿桶石油而放任它们埋在地里。 ”
en: As Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau conceded at a March 2017 energy conference in Houston, Texas, “no country would find 173 billion barrels of oil in the ground and just leave them there.”

zh: 金融波动就像是已在变暖的地球上的超级风暴。
en: Financial volatility is like a superstorm on an already-warming planet.

zh: 它不仅让我们无法看到前方的情况；其本身也是环境破坏的力量，带来不可挽回的伤害。
en: Not only does it make it impossible to see what lies ahead; it is itself also a force of environmental devastation, leaving irreparable damage in its wake.

zh: “市场波动与环境周期非常不契合 ， ” 麻省理工学院的加内尔·诺克斯-海耶斯（Janelle Knox-Hayes）指出 ， “ 经济体系花点时间就能从市场动荡中恢复。
en: “Market volatility is ill suited to environmental cycles,” as MIT’s Janelle Knox-Hayes puts it. “Economic systems recover from market turmoil in time.

zh: 环境体系没有这样的奢侈；它们的再生周期是不可变的。 ”
en: Environmental systems do not have the same luxury; their cycles of reproduction are inflexible.”

zh: 生态破坏应该是昂贵的，世界也毫无疑问需要可行的策略让人们不再使用肮脏的能源资源，转而使用更加绿色和可持续的替代品。
en: Ecological devastation should be expensive, and the world no doubt needs workable strategies to move people away from dirty sources of energy toward greener, more sustainable alternatives.

zh: 但听从市场的引导来克服资本主义对环境的破坏必定带来失望 — — 这不啻地球自杀。
en: But to defer to markets to overcome the environmental woes of capitalism is a blueprint for disappointment – and a recipe for planetary suicide.

zh: 战胜气候变化的暴力
en: Weathering the Violence of Climate Change

zh: 圣莫妮卡—印度正在经历140年以来的最严重干旱，印度农民纷纷上街游行。
en: SANTA MONICA – With India experiencing its worst drought in 140 years, Indian farmers have taken to the streets.

zh: 在今年夏天中央邦的一次示威中，警察朝要求豁免债务和更好的农作物价格的农民开枪，导致五人死亡。
en: At a protest in Madhya Pradesh this summer, police opened fire on farmers demanding debt relief and better crop prices, killing five.

zh: 在泰米尔纳德邦，愤怒的农户也举行了类似的示威，点燃蜡烛纪念被杀者。
en: In Tamil Nadu, angry growers have held similar protests, and lit candles in remembrance of those killed.

zh: 而在新德里的一次集会中，农民带来了人体骷髅，据说是因为过去六个月干旱导致歉收而自杀的农民的遗骸。
en: And at one rally in New Delhi, farmers carried human skulls, which they say belonged to farmers who have committed suicide following devastating crop losses over the past six months.

zh: 根据加州大学伯克利分校的塔玛·卡尔利顿（Tamma A. Carleton）的最新研究，印度农民自杀数量随温度的上升而增加，在给定的日子中，温度较平均水平每上升1℃，平均而言会导致自杀事件增加大约70起。
en: According to a recent study by Tamma A. Carleton of the University of California, Berkeley, suicides among Indian farmers have increased with the temperature, such that an increase of 1º Celsius above the average temperature on a given day is associated with approximately 70 additional suicides, on average.

zh: 今年因干旱而导致的动乱不但暴露了失败的农业政策，也突显出气候变化对印度乃至所有国家所造成的威胁。
en: Beyond exposing failed farming policies, this year’s drought-fueled turmoil also underscores the threat that climate change poses not just to India, but to all countries.

zh: 随着全球气温上升、干旱越来越普遍，政治骚动、社会动荡乃至暴力都有可能水涨船高。
en: As global temperatures rise and droughts become more common, political agitation, social unrest, and even violence will likely follow.

zh: 2008年，恶劣的天气导致全球谷物供给不足，粮食价格上扬，从摩洛哥到印尼的许多国家都爆发了社会和政治剧变。
