en: Yet this has been inadequate to stem the spread of disease; in fact, with many of the new and emerging infectious diseases affecting humans originating in animals, veterinarians, microbiologists, and epidemiologists have been trying to understand the “ecology of disease” (how nature, and humanity’s impact on it, spreads disease).

zh: 虽然饮食变化对环境和健康的影响已被广泛证实，但人类迄今为止并未采取任何措施。
en: Though the environmental and health costs of our changing diets have been widely documented, the message has gone largely unheard.

zh: 随着严重水危机、全球气温快速升高、人口惊人增长和冠心病等日益严重的健康问题摆在世界面前，这样的状况必须改变 — — 而且速度要快。
en: With the world facing a serious water crisis, rapidly increasing global temperatures, staggering population growth, and growing health problems like coronary disease, this must change – and fast.

zh: 首先，为缓解资源压力，畜牧生产者应改用包括滴灌在内的节水技术。
en: For starters, to ease some of the resource pressure, livestock producers should switch to water-saving technologies, including drip irrigation.

zh: 与此同时，各国政府及民间团体应推动更多依赖植物蛋白和卡路里的健康饮食。
en: At the same time, governments and civil-society groups should promote healthier diets that rely more on plant-based proteins and calories.

zh: 近期研究结果显示，如果世界停止种植动物饲料作物或将其转用于生物燃料，那么不仅可以结束全球饥荒，而且还能额外养活四十亿人口 — — 超过全球人口稳定之前预计出生的人口数。
en: According to recent research, if the world stopped producing crops for animal feed or diverting them to biofuels, it could not only end global hunger, but also feed four billion extra people – more than the number of projected arrivals before the global population stabilizes.

zh: 肉类消费实际产生的年温室气体排放量甚至超过汽车的使用。
en: Meat consumption actually leads to more greenhouse-gas emissions annually than the use of cars does.

zh: 这并不是说所有人必须成为素食主义者。
en: This is not to say that everyone must become vegetarian.

zh: 但即使肉类消费习惯的局部改变 — — 如消费者选择鸡肉和海鲜而非牛肉 — — 都能产生深远的影响。
en: But even a partial shift in meat-consumption habits – with consumers choosing options like chicken and seafood, instead of beef – could have a far-reaching impact.

zh: 事实上，牛肉生产平均而言需要的土地和水是其他家畜卡路里的28倍和11倍，同时排放高出五倍的温室气体和高出六倍的活性氮。
en: Indeed, beef production requires, on average, 28 times more land and 11 times more water than the other livestock categories, while producing five times more greenhouse-gas emissions and six times more reactive nitrogen.

zh: 采用以植物为主的均衡饮食、尽量减少消耗红肉及加工肉类有助于保护自然资源、对抗由人类活动引起的全球变暖、并减少与饮食有关的慢性病、甚至癌症死亡风险。
en: Adopting a balanced, largely plant-based diet, with minimal consumption of red and processed meat, would help conserve natural resources, contribute to the fight against human-induced global warming, and reduce people’s risk of diet-related chronic diseases and even cancer mortality.

zh: 就像政府已经靠法律、法规和其他工具在劝阻吸烟方面取得巨大成功，他们也必须鼓励民众为自身健康和我们的地球着想开始摄入均衡饮食。
en: Just as governments have used laws, regulations, and other tools with great success to discourage smoking, so must they encourage citizens to eat a balanced diet – for the sake of their health and that of our planet.

zh: 气候歇斯底里
en: Climate Hysteria

zh: 如果你不想听说联合国气候委员会上周发布了一项新的报告，你就得躲在蒙古国的最深处。
en: You would have had to be stuck in deepest Mongolia to avoid hearing that the United Nations’ climate panel, the IPCC, issued a new report last week.

zh: 即使是在那里，你也可能听到了记者们发出的严峻警告。
en: Perhaps even in the depths of Mongolia, you would have heard the dire warnings emitted by journalists.

zh: 你可能会从这些痛苦的噪音中分辨出报告总结说全球气候变暖要比我们想象得要严重，而且我们现在就要采取快速有力的行动。
en: You would have distilled from these agonized noises that the report concluded that global warming is worse than we had imagined, and that we need to take swift and strong action right now.

zh: 如此，你就可能接受了错误信息。
en: You would have been misinformed.

zh: 联合国气候委员会发表了一个不错的报告。 这一报告试图总结全世界科学家对全球气候变暖的了解。
en: The IPCC has produced a good report – an attempt to summarize what the world’s scientists know about global warming.

zh: 不像布什政府那样被人抓住对科学轻描淡写，这一委员会直截了当地告诉我们说是人类要对地球最近的变暖负责。
en: Unlike the Bush administration, caught downplaying the science, the IPCC squarely tells us that mankind is largely responsible for the planet’s recent warming.

zh: 而且，不像戈尔那样周游世界警告说我们的城市将会马上被淹没在海洋里，该委员会避免耸人听闻。
en: And, unlike Al Gore, who has travelled the world warning that our cities might soon be under the oceans, it refrains from scaremongering.

zh: 但是，迷失在这一喧嚣之中的是一个并不令人兴奋的事实，那就是，这一报告并不比委员会在2001年发表的上一份报告更为严峻。
en: But lost among the hype is the unexciting fact that this report is actually no more dire than the IPCC’s last report, issued in 2001.

zh: 在两个重要方面，今年的报告实际上并非如此严峻。
en: In two important ways, this year’s effort was actually less dire.

zh: 报告反映了这一事实，即，从2001年以来科学家们更为确信人类要对全球气候变暖的一大部分负责。
en: The report reflected the fact that since 2001, scientists have become more certain that humans are responsible for a large part of global warming.

zh: 除此之外，这一报告给人以似曾相识的感觉。
en: Otherwise, though, this report had a definite sense of déjà vu .

zh: 有关气温升高、热浪以及寒流的估计几乎和六年以前提出的报告相似。
en: Estimates of temperature increases, heat waves, and cold waves are all nearly identical to those produced six years ago.

zh: 但是，该报告还是包含两个令人惊讶的事实。
en: The report did, however, contain two surprising facts.

zh: 大多数的报道对此都没有提及。
en: Both went unmentioned in most reports.

zh: 首先，世界上的科学家们重新预估海平面将会上升多快。
en: First, the world’s scientists have re-jigged their estimates about how much sea levels will rise.

zh: 八十年代，美国环境保护署预计到2010年，海洋将会上升几米。
en: In the 1980’s, America’s Environmental Protection Agency expected oceans to rise by several metres by 2100.

zh: 到九十年代末，该委员会估计将会上升67厘米。
en: By the 1990’s, the IPCC was expecting a 67-centimeter rise.

zh: 六年以前，它估计海平面将会比目前高出48.5厘米。
en: Six years ago, it anticipated ocean levels would be 48.5 centimeters higher than they are currently.

zh: 在今年的报告中，估计的上升将会是平均38.5厘米。
en: In this year’s report, the estimated rise is 38.5 centimeters on average.

zh: 这尤其令人感兴趣。 这是因为这基本上拒绝了戈尔电影中大多数令人悲痛的场景。
en: This is especially interesting since it fundamentally rejects one of the most harrowing scenes from Al Gore’s movie An Inconvenient Truth .

zh: 戈尔在电影中用生动的细节展示了海平面上升20英尺将会淹没佛罗里达、上海以及荷兰的大部分地区。
en: In graphic detail, Gore demonstrated how a 20-foot rise in the sea level would inundate much of Florida, Shanghai, and Holland.

zh: 委员会的报告则表明，如此夸张毫无科学依据，尽管这些场景令人害怕而且还可能会让戈尔赢得奥斯卡奖。
en: The IPCC report makes it clear that exaggerations of this magnitude have no basis in science – though clearly they frightened people and perhaps will win Gore an Academy Award.

zh: 该报告还揭示了戈尔电影中另一个场景是不可能的，那就是全球变暖会停止湾流的流动，从而将欧洲变成新的西伯利亚。
en: The report also revealed the improbability of another Gore scenario: that global warming could make the Gulf Stream shut down, turning Europe into a new Siberia.

zh: 电影<<后日>>也生动地描绘了这一场景。 委员会直截了当地告诉我们说这一场景是“非常不太可能的 ” 。
en: The IPCC simply and tersely tells us that this scenario – also vividly depicted in the Hollywood movie The Day After Tomorrow – is considered “very unlikely.”

zh: 而且，即使在本世纪湾流会变弱，这其实是好事，因为在陆地地区气候变暖的净量就会减少。
en: Moreover, even if the Gulf Stream were to weaken over the century, this would be good , as there would be less net warming over land areas.

zh: 那么，为何我们对委员会的报告存在非常不同的印象呢？
en: So why have we been left with a very different impression of the climate panel’s report?

zh: 联合国气候变化委员会依法是“政治上中立 ” 。 它应当仅仅告诉我们事实，而将其他问题交给政客们以及选举他们的人们。
en: The IPCC is by statute “politically neutral” – it is supposed to tell us just the facts and leave the rest to politicians and the people who elect them.

zh: 这就是为什么该报告是一个严谨而有理智的文件。
en: This is why the report is a careful and sensible document.

zh: 但是，科学家们和记者作为报告和公众的中介却从事了针对温室的活动。
en: But scientists and journalists – acting as intermediaries between the report and the public – have engaged in greenhouse activism.

zh: 委员会的主任在其他场合呼吁立即采取实质性的行动来降低碳排放，甚至还宣布他希望这一报告将会“震撼世人和各国政府，从而采取更为严肃的行动 ” 。
en: Elsewhere calling for immediate and substantial cuts in carbon emissions, the IPCC’s director even declared that he hoped the IPCC report would “shock people, governments into taking more serious action.”

zh: 在这一重要而又非政治性地位上的人悍然从事这种积极行动是不妥的。
en: It is inappropriate for somebody in such an important and apolitical role to engage in blatant activism.

zh: 想象一下中央情报局局长发表有关伊朗的新评估说“我希望这一报告将会震撼世人和各国政府，从而采取更为严肃的行动 ” 。
en: Imagine if the director of the CIA published a new assessment of Iran, saying “I hope this report will shock people, governments into taking more serious action.”

zh: 气候变化是确实存在而又严肃的问题。
en: Climate change is a real and serious problem.

zh: 但是最近媒体炒作的问题在于，某些人似乎相信，如果不能展示比人类从前所考虑的更为严重的后果和更为恐怖的灾难，新的报告或者进展就无济于事。
en: But the problem with the recent media frenzy is that some seem to believe no new report or development is enough if it doesn’t reveal more serious consequences and more terrifying calamities than humanity has ever considered before.

zh: 确实，媒体炒作基本上没有什么科学依据。
en: Indeed, this media frenzy has little or no scientific backing.

zh: 英格兰最著名的气候学家、坦道尔气候变化研究中心主任麦克·赫尔姆指出，激进环保主义和媒体炒作使用“灾难和混乱作为无的放矢的武器来悲惨地胁迫社会改变行为 ” 。
en: One of England’s foremost climatologists, Mike Hulme, director of the Tyndall Centre for Climate Change Research, points out that green militancy and megaphone journalism use “catastrophe and chaos as unguided weapons with which forlornly to threaten society into behavioral change.”

zh: 用他的话来说 ， “ 我们需要深呼吸，暂停一下。 ”
en: In his words, “we need to take a deep breath and pause.”

zh: 海洋平面上升38.5厘米是一个问题，但是绝��会摧毁人类文明。
en: A 38.5 cm rise in the ocean’s levels is a problem, but by no means will it bring down civilization.

zh: 上个世纪海平面上升了那个数量的一半，大多数人甚至没有注意到。
en: Last century sea levels rose by half that amount without most of us even noticing.

zh: 联合国告诉我们说，在2030年以前，人类在影响气候变化上基本无所作为。
en: The UN tells us that there is virtually nothing we can do that would affect climate change before 2030.

zh: 因此，我们不得不提出这样严肃的问题，那就是，我们是否可以首先关注于其他问题更好，也就是帮助活生生的人们改善生活和抗拒困难的能力，这样他们就可以更好地应付世界的挑战。
en: So we have to ask the hard question of whether we could do better by focusing on other issues first – helping real people improve their lives and resilience so they can better deal with the world’s challenges.

zh: 这一工程被成为哥本哈根共识。 他们发现，在对气候变化承诺采取重大行动之前的很长一段时间，我们应当集中精力处理艾滋病、霍乱、营养不良以及贸易壁垒等问题。
en: When Nobel Laureate economists weighed up how to achieve the most good for the world in a recent project called the Copenhagen Consensus, they found that focusing on HIV/AIDS, malaria, malnutrition, and trade barriers should all be tackled long before we commit to any dramatic action on climate change.

zh: 当世界大肆谈论减少温室气体之时，就很容易忘记还有其他更好的途径来为地球做好事。
en: With the world in a fury about cutting greenhouse gasses, it is easy to forget that there are other and better ways to do some good for the planet.

zh: 良好的决定来自于认真的考虑。
en: Good decisions come from careful consideration.

zh: 联合国气候变化委员会的报告提供了这一点。
en: The IPCC report provides that.

zh: 但是，随之而来的喧哮却于事无补。
en: But the cacophony of screaming that has accompanied it does not help.

zh: 气候公平
en: Climate Justice

zh: 德班 — — 两年前，在哥本哈根气候变化峰会召开前夕，我们俩一起在开普敦倾听五位来自不同非洲国家的农民（其中四位是女性）告诉我们气候变化是如何破坏他们的生活的。
en: DURBAN – Before the Copenhagen climate-change summit two years ago, the two of us sat together in Cape Town to listen to five African farmers from different countries, four of whom were women, tell us how climate change was undermining their livelihoods.

zh: 每个人都向我们解释洪水和干旱以及播种和收获季节的不规律是如何与他们的日常经验相悖的。
en: Each explained how floods and drought, and the lack of regular seasons to sow and reap, were outside their normal experience.

zh: 他们的担心是全世界自耕农和原住民的共同担心，这些与导致气候变化毫不相干的人受气候冲击影响最深。
en: Their fears are shared by subsistence farmers and indigenous people worldwide – the people bearing the brunt of climate shocks, though they played no part in causing them.

zh: 如今，两年过去了，我们来到了今年气候变化会议COP17的举办地南非德班，而非洲和其他地区的贫困人口的状态比两年前更加恶化了。
en: Now, two years later, we are in Durban, where South Africa is hosting this year’s climate-change conference, COP17, and the situation for poor people in Africa and elsewhere has deteriorated even further.

zh: 最新的联合国气候变化跨国委员会报告指出，几乎可以肯定，从全球角度看，高温天气正在变得更热，且出现得更频繁；事实上，在世界大部分地区，高温天数频率提高了十倍。
en: In its latest report, the United Nations Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change concludes that it is virtually certain that, in global terms, hot days have become hotter and occur more often; indeed, they have increased in frequency by a factor of 10 in most regions of the world.

zh: 此外，气候变化存在一个残酷的悖论，即大规模集中降水也愈来愈频繁，这增加了发生洪水的风险。
en: Moreover, the brutal paradox of climate change is that heavy precipitation is occurring more often as well, increasing the risk of flooding.

zh: 自2003年以来，东非地区记录了8个最温暖年份，毫无疑问，这与困扰非洲之角1300万人的大饥荒密切相关。
en: Since 2003, East Africa has had the eight warmest years on record, which is no doubt contributing to the severe famine that now afflicts 13 million people in the Horn of Africa.

zh: 这些都是地球比前工业时代变暖了仅仅1度造成的。
en: These are the consequences that a mere one degree of warming above pre-industrial levels has wrought.

zh: 联合国环境计划署刚出版的报告《消除排放缺口 》 （ Bridging the Emissions Gap）显示，如果我们不采取更强有力的措施削减排放量，那么本世纪气候变暖幅度将上升为4度。
en: The UN Environment Program’s just published report Bridging the Emissions Gap shows that over the course of this century, warming will likely rise to four degrees unless we take stronger action to cut emissions.

zh: 但最新证据表明，我们并没有采取行动，国际能源署的《2011年世界能源报告》显示，二氧化碳排放量再次创出新高。
en: Yet the latest evidence demonstrates that we are not acting – the International Energy Agency’s World Energy Report 2011 reveals that CO2 emissions have rebounded to a record high.

zh: 我们已经获得了警告，人们对COP17的期望很低。
en: We are alarmed that expectations for COP17 are so low.

zh: 应该采取紧急应对措施的国际领袖哪里去了？
en: Where is the global leadership that must respond urgently?

zh: 我们迫切需要一个全球方案。
en: We desperately need a global deal.

zh: 该方案的核心是保留京都议定书。
en: At the heart of this deal is the preservation of the Kyoto Protocol.

zh: 京都议定书并不是完美的工具。
en: The Protocol is not a perfect instrument.

zh: 它在削减全球排放方面做得远远不够，对各国降低排放量增长的要求也远远不足。
en: It does too little to cut global emissions, and it requires too few countries to cut their emissions growth.

zh: 但它是国际法的一部分，而且是有效的。
en: But it is part of international law, and that is vital.

zh: 气候变化是一个全球问题：如果一国不相信其他国家会修正这一问题，那么它也不会感到有必要单独采取行动。
en: Climate change is a global problem: if countries are not confident that others are addressing it, they will not feel an imperative to act themselves.

zh: 因此，设立一个法律框架，给所有国家制定明确共同的规则是至关重要的，也是我们唯一能够获得的确保实施保护最脆弱国家措施的办法。
en: So, having a legal framework with clear and common rules to which all countries are committed is critically important – and the only assurance we have that action will be taken to protect the most vulnerable.

zh: 京都议定书的第一承诺期将在2012年末到期。
en: The first commitment period of the Kyoto Protocol expires at the end of 2012.

zh: 因此欧盟和京都议定书的其他各方（美国从未批准过该协议，中国、印度和其他新兴大国也不受京都议定书约束）必须提交第二承诺期，以确保这一法律框架能够得以延续。
en: So the European Union and the other Kyoto parties (the United States never ratified the agreement, and the Protocol’s terms asked little of China, India, and other emerging powers) must commit to a second commitment period, in order to ensure that this legal framework is maintained.

zh: 与此同时，所有国家都必须承认，延长京都议定书的生命期限并不能解决气候变化问题，必须引入新的覆盖全部国家的法律框架。
en: At the same time, all countries must acknowledge that extending the lifespan of the Kyoto Protocol will not solve the problem of climate change, and that a new or additional legal framework that covers all countries is needed.

zh: 德班会议必须就展开这方面的谈判达成一致 — — 最晚应该于2015年出台新的法律框架。
en: The Durban meeting must agree to initiate negotiations towards this end – with a view to concluding a new legal instrument by 2015 at the latest.

zh: 所有这些不但可行，而且不得不行，因为向低碳的能源友好型经济转型在经济、社会和环境方面都会带来好处。
en: All of this is not only possible, but also necessary, because the transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient economy makes economic, social, and environmental sense.

zh: 问题在于，推动转型需要政治意愿，而不幸的是，政治意愿相当不足。
en: The problem is that making it happen requires political will, which, unfortunately, seems in short supply.

zh: 气���变化是一个公平问题。
en: Climate change is a matter of justice.

zh: 最发达国家导致了气候变化问题，但承受影响的最贫穷国家。
en: The richest countries caused the problem, but it is the world’s poorest who are already suffering from its effects.

zh: 在德班，国际社会必须承诺纠正这一错误。
en: In Durban, the international community must commit to righting that wrong.

zh: 政治领导人必须为子孙后代考虑。
en: Political leaders must think inter-generationally.

zh: 他们需要想到2050年的世界和那时的90亿人口，并在今天做出正确的决策，确保给我们的子孙后代留下适宜生活的世界。
en: They need to imagine the world of 2050, with its nine billion people, and take the right decisions now to ensure that our children and grandchildren inherit a liveable world.

zh: 气候风险的自然答案
en: Nature’s Answer to Climate Risk

zh: 伦敦—全世界近一半人口 — — 大约35亿人 — — 生活在海洋沿岸。
en: LONDON – Nearly half the world’s population – some 3.5 billion people – lives near coasts.

zh: 随着气候变化加剧了风暴、洪水和侵蚀的影响，数亿人的生活和生计受到了威胁。
en: As climate change exacerbates the effects of storms, flooding, and erosion, the lives and livelihoods of hundreds of millions of those people will be at risk.

zh: 事实上，世界经济论坛的最新版《世界风险评估报告 》 （ World Risk Assessment Report）将不能适应气候变化的影响列为全球社会和经济面临的最大的风险（以影响衡量 ） 。
en: In fact, the latest edition of the World Economic Forum’s World Risk Assessment Report names failure to adapt to the effects of climate change as the single greatest risk, in terms of impact, to societies and economies around the world.

zh: 除了威胁生命，更频繁和更强劲的风暴还可能导致基础设施破坏和失去务农、捕捞和旅游业收入，引起成百上千亿美元的损失。
en: Beyond endangering lives, more frequent and stronger storms could cost many billions of dollars, owing to infrastructure damage and lost revenues from farming, fisheries, and tourism.

zh: 此外 ， 《 哈佛商业评论》最近指出，每项新研究的预估成本都会有所增加。
en: And, as the Harvard Business Review recently noted, the projected cost rises with each new study.

zh: 但国际社会目前对遏制风险的支出还不到自然灾害响应支出的五分之一。
en: Yet the international community currently spends on risk mitigation less than one-fifth of what it spends on natural-disaster response.

zh: 对于气候风险问题，预防可谓事半功倍。
en: When it comes to climate risk, an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.

zh: 红十字会全球灾难准备中心主任瑞贝卡·朔勒（Rebecca Scheurer）指出 ， “ 我们花几百万美元用于灾难响应，而如果我们将这些资源更多地用于前端，就可以拯救更多的人。
en: As Rebecca Scheurer, Director of the Red Cross Global Disaster Preparedness Center, put it, “We spend millions of dollars on the response side, and were we to invest more of those resources on the front end we’d save more people.

zh: 就这么简单。 ”
en: It’s as simple as that.”

zh: 气候变化的人力和财务成本吸引着前所未有的注意力，是时候将资源转而投向降低风险上了。
en: With the human and the financial costs of climate change attracting more attention than ever, now is the time to shift resources toward risk reduction.

zh: 这样做要求国家政府、产业界、援助组织和其他非政府组织来负责大部分投资。
en: Doing so will require national governments, industry, aid organizations, and other NGOs to make the most of their investments.

zh: 而效果最好、性价比最高的解决方案就在大自然中。
en: And some of the most effective and cost-effective solutions are already available in nature.

zh: 海岸和海洋生态系统拥有巨大的潜力能够减轻风暴和其他风险的影响，特别是在传统建成基础设施的配合下。
en: Coastal and marine ecosystems have considerable potential to mitigate the effects of storms and other risks, especially when combined with traditional built infrastructure.

zh: 比如，100米的红树林带可以让浪高降低最多66 % ， 并能降低洪水期间的峰值水位。
en: A 100-meter belt of mangroves, for example, can reduce wave height by up to 66% and lower peak water levels during floods.

zh: 健康的珊瑚礁可以让波浪力量减少97 % ， 缓和风暴的影响并预防侵蚀。
en: A healthy coral reef can reduce wave force by 97%, lessening the impact of storms and preventing erosion.

zh: 这些和其他海岸生态系统是保卫环球诸多城市的第一道屏障，从迈阿密到马尼拉莫不如是。
en: These and other coastal ecosystems are the first line of defense for many cities around the world, from Miami to Manila.

zh: 直到最近，这些基于大自然的方案常常被忽视。
en: Until recently, such nature-based solutions were too often overlooked.

zh: 但领导人们日益认识到它们的重要性，并正在���始采取行动，包括国际层面的行动。
en: But leaders increasingly recognize their importance, and are beginning to take action, including on the international level.

zh: 去年12月达成并在上个月签署的巴黎气候协定不但形成了关于解决气候变化的重要性的共识，还明确确认了生态系统在捕捉温室气体、帮助社会适应气候变化影响方面所起的作用。
en: The Paris climate agreement, reached last December and signed last month, not only established a consensus on the importance of addressing climate change, but also explicitly affirmed that ecosystems play a role in capturing greenhouse gases and helping communities adapt to the effects of climate change.

zh: 在国家层面，一些最危险的岛国正在采取重要措施。
en: At the national level, some of the most at-risk island countries are taking important steps.

zh: 比如，去年塞舌尔宣布与巴黎俱乐部债权人和大自然保护协会进行历史上首次“自然债务 ” （ debt for nature）互换。
en: For example, last year, the Seychelles announced a first-of-its-kind “debt for nature” swap with its Paris Club creditors and The Nature Conservancy.

zh: 该互换可以让塞舌尔将改变其2,160万美元债务的用途，用于投资有助提升其抵御气候变化能力的全面的海洋保护方针。
en: The swap will allow the country to redirect $21.6 million of its debt toward investment in a comprehensive approach to ocean conservation that will bolster its resilience to climate change.

zh: 私人部门领袖也开始将目光投向自然工具。
en: Private-sector leaders, too, are starting to look toward natural tools.

zh: CH2M等工程企业正在于墨西哥湾沿岸及周边社区合作寻找将传统和基于自然的方针结合起来的混合方案。
en: Engineering firms like CH2M are working with coastal communities in the Gulf of Mexico and beyond to find hybrid solutions that combine traditional and nature-based approaches.

zh: 就连保险业 — — 其中都是些也许是世界上最厌恶风险的公司 — — 也看到了自然解决方案的潜力。
en: Even the insurance industry – comprising what may be the most risk-averse companies in the world – sees the potential in natural solutions.

zh: 在过去十年中，保险商因为气候相关损失而破费了大约3,000亿美元，而这些钱常常被用于重建同样脆弱的结构。
en: Over the last decade, insurers have paid out some $300 billion for climate-related damage, often to rebuild the same vulnerable structures.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪瑞士再保险公司正在组织研究减轻海洋沿岸社区代价巨大的飓风风险。
en: It is not surprising, then, that the reinsurer Swiss Re has conducted studies on mitigating the costly risks of hurricanes to coastal communities.

zh: 据瑞士再保险公司的一项研究，巴巴多斯每年因为飓风相关成本而损失GDP的4 % 。
en: According to one Swiss Re study, Barbados loses the equivalent of 4% of its GDP every year to hurricane-related costs.

zh: 但用于保护红树林和珊瑚礁的每一美元能够节约20美元的未来飓风损失。
en: But every dollar spent to protect mangroves and coral reefs saved $20 in future hurricane losses.

zh: 基于这些发现，保险公司完全有可能从某一天开始为保护海洋沿岸社区和经济体的湿地和自然基础设施提供保险。
en: Given such findings, it is no longer inconceivable that insurance companies might one day write coverage for wetlands and other natural infrastructure that offers protection for coastal communities and economies.

zh: 大自然还有助于保护生计。
en: Nature can also help to protect livelihoods.

zh: 红十字会领导的越南红树林恢复项目不但降低了对海塘和其他建成基础设施的破坏，还提高了水产养殖产量，从而给当地社区带来更多收入。
en: A Red Cross-led mangrove restoration project in Vietnam not only reduced damage to dykes and other built infrastructure, but also resulted in higher aquaculture yields and thus more income for the local communities.

zh: 格林纳达的红树林和珊瑚恢复项目 — — 红十字会、大自然保护协会和格林纳达格伦威尔（Grenville）社区的渔民合作之间的合作项目 — — 也表现出巨大的提高恢复力的潜力。
en: A mangrove and coral restoration project in Grenada – a joint effort of the Red Cross, the Nature Conservancy, and the fishers of Grenada’s Grenville community – has also shown great potential to increase resilience.

zh: 该项目证明，只需要30米的珊瑚礁就能显著增加龙虾、海螺、章鱼和海胆的数量。
en: Just 30 meters of reef and coral have been shown to increase substantially the population of lobster, conch, octopus, and urchins.

zh: 气候和灾难恢复力是牵涉到所有部门的挑战。
en: Climate and disaster resilience is a challenge that spans across sectors.

zh: 我们的对策亦然。
en: So too must our solutions.

zh: 这些集体措施是制定和实施更有效的预防性战略的关键。
en: Such collaborative efforts are vital to the development and implementation of more effective preventive strategies.

zh: 世界银行、大自然保护协会和合作研究者（包括生态学家、经济学家和工程师）最近发布了一份报告，为这类合作提供了指引。
en: The World Bank, the Nature Conservancy, and partner researchers (including ecologists, economists, and engineers) have recently published a report offering guidelines for such cooperation.

zh: 具体而言，该报告建议以受保护资本和基础设施为标准，基于被保险和工程业通通采用的方法估算海岸生态系统的价值。
en: Specifically, the report recommends calculating the value of coastal ecosystems in terms of protected capital and infrastructure, based on approaches commonly used by the insurance and engineering industries.

zh: 面对气候和灾难风险的增加，投资于基于大自然的方案能保护生命，以高性价比的方式捍卫繁荣 — — 同时还能保全身陷重重危机的全球自然生态系统。
en: In the face of rising climate and disaster risk, investments in nature-based solutions can protect lives and safeguard prosperity in a cost-effective manner – all while preserving imperiled natural ecosystems around the world.

zh: 政府、企业和非政府组织都应该认识到，在打击气候变化影响和保护沿海社区的问题上，保护和恢复大自然也许是我们所能做出的最明智的投资。
en: It is time for governments, business, and NGOs alike to recognize that when it comes to fighting the effects of climate change and protecting coastal communities, preserving and restoring nature may be the smartest investment we can make.

zh: 气候科学还是气候传教？
en: Climate Science or Climate Evangelism?

zh: 发自哥本哈根 — — 美国前总统小布什和英国前首相布莱尔这两位仁兄都已经深刻地领悟到，如果公众发现自己在某些潜在威胁的真相上受到了误导，那么后果就会很严重。
en: COPENHAGEN – As George W. Bush and Tony Blair learned the hard way, the public does not take kindly to being misled about the nature of potential threats.

zh: 在入侵伊拉克问题上，事后调查发现其中的动因都被极度夸大了 — — 某些甚至是捏造出来的 — — 于是民众为此爆发出来的愤怒和反抗在 2008 年把美国共和党赶下了台，而这一切也很可能在今年晚些时候在英国工党身上重演一遍。
en: The after-the-fact revelation that the reasons for invading Iraq were vastly exaggerated – and in some cases completely fabricated – produced an angry backlash that helped toss the Republicans out of power in the United States in 2008 and may do the same to Britain’s Labour Party later this year.

zh: 而在气候变化问题上，全球舆论也发生了类似的转向。
en: A similar shift in global public opinion is occurring with respect to climate change.

zh: 自从去年年底网络黑客公布了数千封来自英国某顶尖研究机构的电子邮件，揭露某些全球最具影响力的气象学家一直以来都在努力粉饰其在气候变化问题上的研究缺陷，阻挠审查，并合谋将自己这一派的气候变化观点强加于人之后，这一转向过程更呈现出加速的趋势。
en: The process picked up momentum late last year, after hackers leaked thousands of e-mails from a top British research facility showing that some of the world’s most influential climatologists had been trying to disguise flaws in their work, blocking scrutiny, and plotting together to enforce what amounts to a party line on climate change.

zh: 而美国权威咨询小组政府间气候变化专门委员会（ IPCC ）最近也陷入了十分尴尬的境地，因为该机构在 2007 年发布的一份影响重大的报告中的某些骇人听闻的预测也被揭露出是毫无科学依据的。
en: More recently, the United Nations’ respected advisory group, the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC), has been deeply embarrassed by the revelation that some alarming predictions contained in an influential report that it released in 2007 have little or no scientific basis.

zh: 尽管这些谬误并未让我们质疑全球变暖确实正在发生，确实是人为所致，而且确实将带来很多麻烦，但这些对 IPCC 的质疑也造成了极大的损害。
en: Although none of these lapses provides any reason to doubt that global warming is real, is man-made, and will create problems for us, these challenges to the IPCC are taking their toll.

zh: 事实胜于雄辩，最近就有调查显示，公众对全球变暖的科学共识越来越不信任了。
en: Indeed, recent surveys show that the public is growing steadily less trusting of the scientific consensus on global warming.

zh: 而在 IPCC 所犯错误中最大的一条，就是其在 2007 年编写的一份关于气候变化潜在影响的报告中对喜马拉雅冰川融化的观点。
en: The biggest headlines about IPCC errors concern a claim about melting Himalayan glaciers that it made in its 2007 report on the likely impacts of climate change.

zh: 报告中说“喜马拉雅冰川比世界其他地方的冰川要消失得更快 ” ， 接着补充说“如果保持现在这个消失速度不变，那么这些冰川很有可能在 2035 年或甚至更早的时间内完全消失。
en: “Glaciers in the Himalaya are receding faster than in any other part of the world,” the report noted, adding that “if the present rate continues, the likelihood of them disappearing by the year 2035 and perhaps sooner is very high.”

zh: ”但令人吃惊的是，这一预测并未基于任何经过了科学审查的研究结果，而只是摘自于世界自然基金会的一份报告，而这一份报告只是简单地复述了一位研究人员未经证实的猜测而已。
en: As it happens, this prediction was not based on any peer-reviewed scientific research but was lifted from a report by the World Wildlife Fund, which was repeating an unproven speculation by a single researcher.

zh: 尽管如此，科学依据的缺乏却未能阻止无数的环保分子利用一切机会引用这一冰川融化的观点。
en: This lack of scientific basis did not stop countless global-warming activists from citing the glacier prediction at every opportunity.

zh: 去年，当印度政府声明说喜马拉雅冰川的状况要比 IPCC 宣称的要好时， IPCC 主席拉津德·巴乔里竟反驳说印度政府的反对是基于“巫术科学 ” 。
en: When the Indian government suggested last year that the Himalayan glaciers were in better shape than the IPCC claimed, the IPCC’s chairman, Rajendra Pachauri, dismissed India’s objections as being based on “voodoo science.”

zh: 而在这一冰川融化��点被揭露为毫无依据之后，印度政府的反应则是在本月初宣布计划建立本国自己的“政府间气候变化专门委员会”来评估全球变暖的影响。
en: Earlier this month, the Indian government reacted to the revelations about the baseless nature of the glacier claim by announcing plans to establish what amounts to its own “Indian IPCC” to assess the impact of global warming.

zh: 印度环境部部长拉姆·拉梅什说 ： “ 在气候科学和气候传教之间是有清晰的区别的，而我本人站在气候科学这一边。
en: India’s environment minister, Jairam Ramesh, declared: “There is a fine line between climate science and climate evangelism.
I am for climate science.”

zh: “气候传教”正是对 IPCC 所作所为的一个写照，因为它夸大了气候变化的某些影响，目的则是吸引政治家的关注。
en: Climate evangelism is an apt description of what the IPCC has been up to, for it has exaggerated some of the ramifications of climate change in order to make politicians take note.

zh: 穆拉里·拉尔是 IPCC 报告中喜马拉雅冰川这部分内容的主要联名作者，他承认他本人及其同事都清楚知道冰川大面积融化的预测根本都没有经过任何科学审核。
en: Murari Lal, the coordinating lead author of the section of the IPCC report that contained the Himalayan error, admitted that he and his colleagues knew that the dramatic glacier prediction was not based on any peer-reviewed science.

zh: 然而，他解释说 ： “ 当时，我们认为如果能够突出这部分内容，那么它将会对政策制定者和政治家产生影响，从而鼓励他们采取一些具体的行动。 ”
en: Nonetheless, he explained, “we thought that if we can highlight it, it will impact policy-makers and politicians and encourage them to take some concrete action.”

zh: 而在这些人的大脑中，所谓的具体行动就是促使政府强制推行大规模二氧化碳减排。
en: The concrete action that they had in mind was getting governments to mandate drastic cuts in carbon-dioxide emissions.

zh: 在过去将近 20 年的时间里，环保分子一直致力于用这种方法来解决全球变暖的问题，最近的尝试则是去年 12 月哥本哈根那场失败的气候峰会。
en: Activists have been pursuing this approach to tackling global warming without success for nearly 20 years, most recently at last December’s failed climate summit in Copenhagen.

zh: 而失败的原因则在于对政治家和公众来说，这套方案的成本太过昂贵了，这也是为什么许多心怀善意的气候科学家最终得出这么一个结论：与其指望理性的讨论能够促进方案的执行，还不如恐吓一下我们这些无知的民众。
en: The problem is that it is too expensive a solution for politicians and the public to swallow easily –which is why many well-meaning climate scientists have apparently concluded that instead of relying on reasoned discussion, they might as well try to scare us witless.

zh: 让我们来回想一下 IPCC 所描述的诸如巨型台风等的极端天气情况。
en: Consider what the IPCC had to say about extreme weather events such as intense hurricanes.

zh: 虽然这些情况导致的财产破坏和经济紊乱的损失一直持续增加。
en: The cost of such events in terms of destroyed property and economic disruption has been rising steadily.

zh: 但所有经过审查的科学研究都显示，这并不是气温上升而导致的，而是因为越来越多的人居住在那些危险地带。
en: Every peer-reviewed study has shown that this is not because of rising temperatures, but because more people live in harm’s way.

zh: 但即便如此，在 2007 年 IPCC 举行的关于气候变迁的评估中，该专家小组的第二工作小组（负责评估全球变暖的潜在影响）选择引用一份当时还未曾公开发表的研究，该研究认为在过去 35 年间全球变暖所造成的损失增长了一倍。
en: Nonetheless, in the IPCC’s influential 2007 assessment of climate change, the panel’s Working Group II (charged with assessing the potential impact of global warming) chose to cite one, then-unpublished study that supposedly found that global warming had doubled damage costs over the past 35 years.

zh: 谁知当这一研究最终发表时，却明确声明在损失增加和全球变暖之间找不到“足够的证据”证明两者之间的联系。
en: In fact, when this study was finally published, it stated categorically that there was “insufficient evidence” to link the increased losses to global warming.

zh: 换句话说，第二工作小组的报告是完全错误的。
en: In other words, what Working Group II reported was plain wrong.

zh: 在 2007 年评估报告的其他部分，第二工作小组声称“亚马逊地区有 40 ％的森林”有被全球变暖摧毁的危险。
en: Elsewhere in the 2007 assessment, Working Group II claimed that “up to 40% of the Amazonian forests” were at imminent risk of being destroyed by global warming.

zh: 然而这一结论却只是基于世界自然基金会的一份报告，而这个报告只引用了一个单一的研究，那份研究甚至跟气候变化无关，仅仅是描述了人类砍伐和焚烧所带来的影响而已。
en: The basis for this claim was a single report from the World Wildlife Fund that itself cited only one study, which didn’t even look at climate change, but rather at the impact of human activities like logging and burning.

zh: 用类似的方式，第二工作小组声称“到 2020 年，在（非洲）某些国家，由雨水灌溉的农业的所产生的收益将减少 50 ％ 。
en: In similar fashion, Working Group II claimed that “by 2020, in some [African] countries, yields from rain-fed agriculture could be reduced by up to 50%.”

zh: ”尽管被引用的频率很高，但这一骇人听闻的统计数字原来只是基于一份由某环境研究智库所做的一份报告中的单一的，连参考资料都没有的重点提要部分。
en: Much quoted since, this alarming statistic turns out to have been based on a single, unreferenced bullet-point from a report by an environmental think tank.

zh: 类似的手法在第二工作小组的报告中还有很多很多，不胜枚举。
en: There are numerous other examples of similar shenanigans by Working Group II.

zh: 然而除了勉强承认其关于喜马拉雅冰川的预测是“有悖事实”之外， IPCC 没有承认任何其他的错漏 — — 更遑论为此而道歉了。
en: Yet, aside from a grudging admission that its predictions about Himalayan glaciers were “poorly substantiated,” the IPCC has yet to acknowledge – much less apologize for – any of the lapses.

zh: 如果 IPCC 真的想做到称职胜任，它就必须坦承其所有的失误，并进而改正。
en: If the IPCC is to do to its job properly, it must own up to all of its missteps and clean house.

zh: 毕竟没人指望它的工作能毫不出错。
en: Nobody expects it to be infallible.

zh: 但我们所不能容忍的，是它不是向政策制定者陈述事实，而是靠恐吓来达到自己的目的。
en: But neither should we tolerate its attempts to scare policy-makers rather than inform them.

zh: 当气候领导者保护肮脏投资时
en: When Climate Leaders Protect Dirty Investments

zh: 日内瓦—气候危机的解决方案常常诞生于大会中，接下来的两周毫无疑问将产生很多“答案 ” 。
en: GENEVA – Solutions to the climate crisis are often associated with big conferences, and the next two weeks will no doubt bring many “answers.”

zh: 大约20,000名代表已经来到德国波恩，参加新一轮联合国气候变化谈判。
en: Some 20,000 delegates have now descended on Bonn, Germany, for the latest round of United Nations climate change talks.

zh: 波恩的谈判应该聚焦于实施巴黎气候协定。
en: The talks in Bonn should focus on the implementation of the Paris climate agreement.

zh: 应该怎么做是显而易见的。
en: And the path forward is clear.

zh: 要将全球气温控制在巴黎所指定的范围内 — — 较前工业化水平升温“显著低于2℃ ” — —唯一的办法是让资本远离化石燃料，涌向零碳项目。
en: The only way to keep the rise in global temperatures within the limit set in Paris – “well below 2°C” higher than pre-industrial levels – is to shift capital away from fossil fuels and toward zero-carbon projects.

zh: 而要想实现这一点，就必须改变全球能源投资管理。
en: To do that, we must change how global energy investments are governed.

zh: 目前，领导气候变化斗争的各国政府，都仍然在支持和保护化石燃料勘探、采掘和运输的项目投资。
en: At the moment, the very governments leading the fight against climate change continue to support and protect investment in fossil-fuel exploration, extraction, and transportation.

zh: 这些政府没有投资于高效率的住房、零碳交通、可再生能源和更好的土地使用体系，它们说一套做一套。
en: Rather than investing in efficient housing, zero-carbon mobility, renewable energy, and better land-use systems, these governments say one thing but still do another.

zh: 根据国际能源署的最新《世界能源投资 》 （ World Energy Investment）报告，2016年全球石油和天然气行业总支出高达6,490亿美元。
en: According to the most recent World Energy Investment report from the International Energy Agency, global expenditure in the oil and gas sector totaled $649 billion in 2016.

zh: 这比可再生发电的投资量2,970亿美元高出一倍多，虽然想要实现巴黎协定的目标，就必须让至少四分之三的已知化石燃料储量留在地下。
en: That was more than double the $297 billion invested in renewable electricity generation, even though achieving the Paris agreement’s target implies leaving at least three quarters of known fossil-fuel reserves in the ground.

zh: 这些数字表明，制度惰性和根深蒂固的行业利益仍是投资流向可再生能源道路上的拦路石。
en: As these numbers suggest, institutional inertia and entrenched industry interests continue to stand in the way of shifting investment into sustainable energy.

zh: 很多问题可以追溯到双边投资条约和范围更广的贸易契约所规定的投资规则上，如北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA ） 、 能源宪章条约（Energy Charter Treaty）和欧盟-加拿大全面经贸协定（CETA ） 。
en: Much of the problem can be traced to bilateral investment treaties and investment rules embedded within broader trade pacts, such as the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), the Energy Charter Treaty, and the EU-Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA).

zh: 这些条约是为了阻止外国投资者被征没而制定，因此包括了投资者-国家纠纷解决（ISDS）机制，允许投资者在政策变化影响到业务的情况下，通过国际仲裁法庭向政府索赔。
en: Because these treaties were designed to shield foreign investors from expropriation, they include investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) mechanisms that allow investors to seek compensation from governments, via international arbitration tribunals, if policy changes affect their business.

zh: 这让政府寻求限制化石燃料采掘的行动投鼠忌器。
en: This has handcuffed governments seeking to limit fossil-fuel extraction.

zh: ISDS案例的赔偿令人咋舌。
en: Compensation from ISDS cases can be staggering.

zh: 2012年，美国投资商向起诉魁北克政府拒绝许可在圣劳伦斯河底进行液压致裂法作业。
en: In 2012, an American investor filed a lawsuit against the Quebec government’s decision to deny a permit for hydraulic fracturing under the Saint Lawrence River.

zh: 这家位于特拉华州的能源企业说，根据NAFTA，魁北克政府的禁令是“专断、任性、非法”的，因此索取2.5亿美元损失赔偿。
en: Arguing that the denial was “arbitrary, capricious, and illegal” under NAFTA, the Delaware-based energy firm sought $250 million in damages.

zh: 2016年，TransCanada能源公司援引NAFTA起诉美国索赔150亿美元损失，因为奥巴马总统拒绝批准Keystone XL输油管道。
en: In January 2016, the TransCanada energy company used NAFTA to sue the United States, claiming $15 billion in losses after President Barack Obama denied a permit for the Keystone XL oil pipeline.

zh: （2017年1月，特朗普总统批准了该项目，该公司随之撤诉。 ）
en: (The company suspended its suit after President Donald Trump approved the project in January 2017).

zh: 2017年7月，魁北克在取消了圣劳伦斯湾安蒂科斯蒂岛的油气勘探合同后，同意向相关公司赔偿近5,000万美元。
en: And in July 2017, Quebec agreed to pay nearly $50 million in compensation to companies after canceling oil and gas exploration contracts on Anticosti Island in the Gulf of Saint Lawrence.

zh: 除了此类赔偿之外，化石燃料行业还能源源不断地获得数千亿美元的补贴。
en: These and other payments are in addition to the hundreds of billions of dollars in subsidies that continue to flow to the fossil-fuel industry.

zh: 巨额的偿付不仅仅耗尽了公帑；仅仅是存这一威胁，就让政府无法追求进取的气候政策，因为它们担心碳依赖行业在国际仲裁法庭上起诉它们。
en: Big payouts do more than drain public coffers; the mere threat of them discourages governments from pursuing more ambitious climate policies, owing to fear that carbon-dependent industries could challenge them in international tribunals.

zh: 幸运的是，这一情况不是一成不变的。
en: Fortunately, this state of affairs is not set in stone.

zh: 许多政府目前正着眼于改革投资机制 — — 不仅作为一个可行项，而且要作为一个必须项。
en: Many governments now see reform of the investment regime not just as a possibility, but as a necessity.

zh: 上个月，联合国贸易和发展会议在日内瓦召开了一次高级别会议，旨在制定全面投资机制改革的选项，包括重新谈判和结束约3,000条过时的条约。
en: Last month, the UN Conference on Trade and Development convened a high-level meeting in Geneva, with the goal of developing options for comprehensive reform of the investment regime, including the renegotiation or termination of some 3,000 outdated treaties.

zh: 政府首先应该修订或退出现有《能源宪章条约 》 （ ETC ） 。 ETC是全世界唯一的专门的能源投资契约。
en: Governments should start by overhauling or exiting the Energy Charter Treaty, the world’s only energy-specific investment pact.

zh: 其投资保护条款和缺少气候条款的情况早已不合时宜。
en: The ECT’s investment protections and lack of climate provisions are no longer appropriate.

zh: 自实施以来，ECT被针对东道国的能源企业援引过100多次，其中一些是对国家能源政策，如德国逐步退出核电的战略的挑战。
en: Since its inception, the ECT has served as the basis for more than 100 claims by energy firms against host countries, with some challenging national environmental policies, such as the nuclear phase-out in Germany.

zh: 俄罗斯和意大利已经退出了ECT；其他国家也应该这样做，或致力于重新谈判ECT。
en: Russia and Italy have already withdrawn from the ECT; other countries should do the same or commit to renegotiating it.

zh: 此外，各国应该将气候问题作为贸易和投资谈判的核心，比如将化石燃料项目剔出投资条款。
en: Moreover, countries should put climate concerns at the center of their trade and investment negotiations, such as by carving out fossil-fuel projects from investment clauses.

zh: 这正是法国最近所提出的动议，其生态部长尼古拉·胡洛（Nicolas Hulot）宣布，法国准备对CETA投“气候否决票 ” 。
en: That is essentially what France recently proposed, when ecology minister Nicolas Hulot announced his country’s intention to enact a “climate veto” to CETA.

zh: 胡洛说，法国不会批准该条约，除非它保证仲裁法庭不干涉气候承诺。
en: Hulot said France would ratify the treaty only if it contained assurances that its climate commitments could not be challenged before arbitration tribunals.

zh: 新环境条约的投资保护条款也应该剔除化石燃料项目，如法国总统马克龙在9月的联合国大会上所提出的《全球环境公约 》 （ Global Pact for the Environment ） 。
en: Fossil-fuel projects could also be exempted from investment protection in new environmental treaties, such as the Global Pact for the Environment presented by French President Emmanuel Macron to the UN General Assembly in September.

zh: 实现全球投资机制再平衡只是通往零碳经济的第一步。
en: Rebalancing the global investment regime is only the first step toward a zero-carbon economy.

zh: 要让资本从重化石燃料项目流出，流向绿色能源项目，各国需要地区、国家和国际层面的新的法律和政策框架。
en: To shift capital from fossil-fuel heavy initiatives to green energy projects, countries will need new legal and policy frameworks at the regional, national, and international levels.

zh: 这些协定应该促进和便利零碳投资。
en: These agreements should promote and facilitate zero-carbon investments.

zh: 本周正在举行的会议和相隔约的巴黎气候峰会这样的大会能够为这些谈判提供起点。
en: Big meetings like the one getting underway this week and the Paris Climate Summit next month can kick-start these conversations.

zh: （作者特别鸣谢IISD的Ivetta Gerasimchuk和Martin Dietrich Brauch为本评论所提供的帮助。 ）
en: (The authors wish to thank Ivetta Gerasimchuk and Martin Dietrich Brauch of the IISD for their help with this commentary.)

zh: 美国的下级选举竞争
en: America’s Race to the Ballot’s Bottom

zh: 华盛顿—希拉里·克林顿的美国总统选战一直“分裂 ” ， 一方面要确保候选人她本人最大可能赢得胜利，另一方面又要明确帮助民主党州长和立法部门候选人赢得投票箱。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Hillary Clinton’s US presidential campaign has been torn between trying to secure the largest possible victory for the candidate herself and explicitly helping fellow Democratic gubernatorial and legislative candidates further down the ballot.

zh: 克林顿是否可以通过取得决定性胜利 — — 从而趁热打铁 — — 帮助下级（down-ballot）候选人或通过更多的时间和金钱个别助选仍有待观察。
en: It’s an open question whether Clinton could do more for down-ballot candidates by winning decisively – so that the enthusiasm trickles down – or by expending time and money to help those candidates individually.

zh: 克林顿阵营已决定双管齐下。
en: The Clinton camp has decided to pursue both strategies.

zh: 距离选举已经不到一周，两位总统候选人正在周游全国：共和党提名人唐纳德·特朗普忙于聚集胜选所需要的270张选举人票，而克林顿则在试图尽可能锁定获胜优势 — — 包括总票数和选举人票。
en: With just a week left before the election, the presidential candidates are crisscrossing the country: whereas Republican nominee Donald Trump is struggling to cobble together the 270 Electoral College votes needed to win, Clinton is trying to lock up as large a victory – in both the popular vote and the Electoral College – as possible.

zh: 一周前，克林顿眼看就要大获全胜。
en: Just a week ago, Clinton seemed to be heading toward an overwhelming victory.

zh: 但10月28日，联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米（James Comey）致信国会，宣布他要重启对克林顿在担任国务卿期间使用私人电子邮件服务器的调查。
en: But on October 28, FBI Director James Comey sent a letter to Congress announcing that he was reopening the investigation into Clinton’s use of a private email server when she was Secretary of State.

zh: 理由？
en: The reason?

zh: 在一次针对克林顿的亲信胡马·阿贝丁（Huma Abedin）的分居丈夫的单独调查期间，在他的笔记本电脑中发现数千封电子邮件。
en: Thousands of emails had been discovered on the laptop of the estranged husband of Clinton’s closest assistant, Huma Abedin, during a separate inquiry into his own activities.

zh: （不，这不是电影桥段。 ）
en: (No, this isn’t a movie plot.)

zh: 科米的决定引起剧烈反弹，但到目前为止并未对竞选产生可观影响。
en: Comey’s announcement triggered an uproar, but it hasn’t so far had a notable impact on the race.

zh: 克林顿阵营甚至没有放弃争取长期以来一直被视为共和党铁票仓的亚利桑那、佐治亚和犹他州。
en: The Clinton campaign has not given up even on winning states that have long been considered Republican strongholds, such as Arizona, Georgia, and Utah.

zh: 而特朗普尽管因为联邦调查局的发现而欢欣鼓舞，仍在继续争取新墨西哥州等对他的选举人票数几乎没有影响的州。
en: And Trump, despite feeling invigorated by the discovery, has continued to pursue states, such as New Mexico, that would do him little good in the Electoral College count.

zh: 但政治新人特朗普幻想自己是一位伟大的政治战略家。
en: But Trump, new to politics, fancies himself a great political strategist.

zh: 特朗普几乎没有政治盟友帮他指点迷津，而克林顿有许多代理人，包括她的丈夫、前总统比尔·克林顿；奥巴马总统和在此次选举中冉冉升起的新星、第一夫人米歇尔·奥巴马；以及副总统拜登和克林顿的副总统竞选搭档蒂姆·凯恩（Tim Kaine ） 。
en: Trump has few political allies to help him out, while Clinton’s many surrogates include her husband, former President Bill Clinton; President Barack Obama and First Lady Michelle Obama, the breakout star of this election; and Vice President Joe Biden and Clinton’s vice-presidential running mate, Tim Kaine.

zh: 两位左翼明星伊丽莎白·沃伦（Elizabeth Warren）和伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）也为克林顿摇旗呐喊；如果她获胜，他们将要求政策和任命方面的回报。
en: Two stars of the left, Elizabeth Warren and Bernie Sanders, have also campaigned for Clinton; if she wins, they will call in the debt both in policy terms and on appointees.

zh: 与此同时，克林顿与正在挑战现任多数的共和党的民主党参议员候选人并肩作战，包括试图罢免宾夕法尼亚州参议员帕特·图梅（Pat Toomey）的凯蒂·麦金迪（Katie McGinty ） ； 希望在新罕布什尔州掀翻参议员凯利·阿约特（Kelly Ayotte）的州长麦基·哈森（Maggie Hassan ） ； 以及正在强力挑战北卡罗来纳州参议员理查德·波尔（Richard Burr）的德博拉·罗斯（Deborah Ross ） 。
en: Meanwhile, Clinton has appeared with Democratic Senate candidates who are challenging incumbent Republicans, including Katie McGinty, who is running to oust Senator Pat Toomey in Pennsylvania; Governor Maggie Hassan, who hopes to topple Senator Kelly Ayotte in New Hampshire; and Deborah Ross, who is mounting a strong challenge to Senator Richard Burr in North Carolina.

zh: 克林顿阵营对一些参议员、众议员和州长席位投入重金，甚至还包括州立法部门选战，而克林顿阵营的实地工作者和志愿者也被动员起来帮助有望一争的下级候选人。
en: The Clinton campaign has poured money into several Senate, House of Representatives, gubernatorial, and even state-legislature races, and Clinton field workers and volunteers have been encouraged to help down-ballot candidates in contentious races.

zh: 奥巴马最近发表了一系列视频讲话支持民主党竞争参议院、众议院和州立法部门。
en: Obama, for his part, recently recorded a series of video endorsements for Democrats running for the Senate, the House, and state legislatures.

zh: 各路专家纷纷表示联邦调查局的决定将有助于共和党的下级候选人，但这纯属猜测。
en: Numerous pundits say that the FBI announcement will help Republicans down-ballot, but that’s pure speculation.

zh: 如果克林顿赢得白宫，并且许多共和党在任者被扫地出门，美国将迎来一起“再见”选举。
en: If Clinton wins the White House and many Republican incumbents are swept out of office, the US will have had a “wave” election.

zh: 但在最后一分钟之前，我们都无法知道结果。
en: But we likely won’t know if this is happening until the last minute.

zh: 在1980年的再见选举中，罗纳德·里根和共和党横扫总统吉米·卡特，并在参议院中也掀翻了多名自由派民主党，但总统之争直到最后一个周末仍处于胶着状态。
en: In the 1980 wave election, when Ronald Reagan and the Republican ticket overwhelmed President Jimmy Carter and toppled several liberal Democrats in the Senate, the presidential race was nearly tied until the final weekend.

zh: 即使民主党在再见竞选中重新赢得参议院，蜜月期也不会维持很久。
en: Even if the Democrats retake the Senate in a wave, the honeymoon won’t last long.

zh: 两年后，又有三分之一参议员需要重选，并且需要捍卫席位的民主党将远多于共和党 — — 与今年的形势正好颠倒。
en: In two years, another third of the Senate will be up for reelection, and far more Democrats than Republicans will have to defend their seats – a reversal of the situation this year.

zh: 当然，克林顿阵营帮助下级候选人绝不仅仅是慈善。
en: Of course, the Clinton campaign isn’t just being charitable by helping down-ballot candidates.

zh: 如果在国会中有更多民主党，她的政府日子会好过得多。
en: Her administration will be far better off with more Democrats in Congress.

zh: 目前，人们仍广泛认为民主党将重新入主参议院 — — 尽管众议院仍无法撼动，因为他们需要掀翻30个共和党席位，这是无法完成的任务。
en: The Democrats are still widely expected to retake the Senate, though not the House, where they would need to flip an unlikely 30 Republican seats.

zh: （大部分众议院席位选区划分不公平，选区边界的划定被人为操纵，有利于在任党。
en: (Most House seats are gerrymandered, with district boundaries manipulated to benefit the incumbent party.)

zh: ）但即使民主党果真重新赢得有100个席位的参议院的多数，共和党仍能够保持对克林顿的立法提案和最高法院执行庭提名的冗长演讲（filibuster）威胁 — — 这需要60票才能打破。
en: But even if the Democrats do regain a majority in the 100-member Senate, Republicans will still be able to hold the threat of a filibuster – which requires 60 votes to break – over Clinton’s legislative proposals and nominations to the executive branch and Supreme Court.

zh: 克林顿阵营及其高调代理人阵容要帮助下级民主党的另一个重要原因是，两党都希望加强对尽可能多的州级位置的掌控，因为控制一州执政地位和至少一个立法机关的党能够左右国会选区如何划定（每十年重划一次 ） 。
en: There’s another important reason for the Clinton campaign and its high-profile surrogates to help down-ballot Democrats. Both parties want to strengthen their hold on as many state-level offices as possible, because the party that controls a state’s governorship and at least one of its legislative chamber gets to oversee how congressional districts are drawn (which happens every ten years).

zh: 选区如何划定影响着众议院的党派构成，从而影响联邦立法的命运。
en: How districts are drawn affects the partisan makeup of the House, and therefore the fate of federal legislation.

zh: （只有参议院可以进行总统提名人投票。 ）
en: (Only the Senate votes on presidential nominations.)

zh: 州也是各党培养未来总统候选人的地方。
en: The states are also where the parties can build their bench of potential future federal officeholders.

zh: 共和党认识到州级政治的重要性远早于民主党，并且建立起比民主党更强的州级基础。
en: The Republicans figured out the importance of state-level politics long before the Democrats, and they have built a much stronger foundation in the states than the Democrats have.

zh: 比如，尽管奥巴马在过去两次大选中都赢得了俄亥俄州，但该州最新一届国会代表中有75%是共和党。
en: For example, even though Obama carried Ohio in the last two elections, its current congressional delegation is 75% Republican.

zh: 目前，美国大选是一宗摇摆事件。
en: The US election is now a volatile affair.

zh: 没人知道还会出什么“幺蛾子”影响选情，但假设总会出现“幺蛾子”是明智的。
en: No one knows what might pop up next to shake up the race, but it is sensible to assume that something will.

zh: 至少，维基解密的披露很有可能还会继续，尽管克林顿因此而受到一些尴尬，但克林顿基金会的腐败或克林顿担任国务卿期间有何不当行为仍未揭露。
en: At the very least, the WikiLeaks disclosures will presumably continue, though, despite being somewhat embarrassing to the Clintons, they haven’t revealed corruption by the Clinton Foundation or improprieties in how Hillary Clinton conducted policy as Secretary of State.

zh: 科米致信国会时，数百万美国人已经投出了他们的选票。
en: By the time Comey sent his letter, several million Americans had already cast their ballots.

zh: 我们无法知道，从现在到选举日，各种各样的揭露会如何影响结果。
en: We cannot know how the various disclosures will affect turnout between now and Election Day.

zh: 我们知道的是，说到底，已经发生或可能发生的一切都不能证明特朗普比克林顿更适合当总统。
en: What we do know is that, ultimately, nothing that has or might happen makes Trump better suited for the presidency than Clinton.

zh: 关于证券市场短期主义的迷思
en: The Chimera of Stock-Market Short-Termism

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 在美国，人们 — — 尤其是政界人士 — — 经常会抱怨美国企业受到了短期股票市场因素的过度影响。
en: CAMBRIDGE – An often-heard refrain, increasingly voiced in US politics, is that corporate America is excessively influenced by short-term stock-market considerations.

zh: 虽然现阶段的美国总统选举进程并不特别侧重于政策，但随着选战迅速落幕，必将有人开始执政并实施各类政策。
en: While the US presidential election is not particularly focused on policy at the moment, the campaign will soon end, at which point people will govern and policies will be adopted.

zh: 鉴于共和党人和民主党人都对这种短期主义表示批评，所以或许会制定其中一些政策中来解决这一问题。
en: Given that both Republicans and Democrats have criticized short-termism, it is possible that some of those policies might aim to address it.

zh: 在这一点上双方都不会有什么分歧。
en: They are unlikely to make any difference.

zh: 然而不仅短期主义的程度遭到了严重夸大，应对这个问题的政策建议也极为匮乏。
en: Not only has the problem of short-termism been woefully exaggerated, but the policy proposals for addressing it are severely lacking.

zh: 例如民主党总统候选人希拉里·克林顿就提议 — — 副总统拜登也对此表示支持 — — 运用资本利得税来鼓励股东更长久地持有手中的股票。
en: Consider Democratic presidential nominee Hillary Clinton’s proposal – which Vice President Joe Biden has endorsed – to use the capital gains tax to encourage shareowners to hold on to their stock for a longer time.

zh: 该提议的逻辑是如果股东频繁买卖自身的股票，企业高管就被迫要在每季度都实现高收益，以确保股价不会下降。
en: The idea is that when shareowners furiously trade their stock, corporate executives feel pressed to ensure high earnings every quarter, so that the share price does not fall.

zh: 而投资于研究和开发的举措虽然能获取长期利益，但却会诱发股东出售股票，公司也会因股价下跌而蒙受损失。
en: Investment in, say, research and development, despite its long-term benefits, can induce shareowners to sell, punishing the company with a declining stock price.

zh: 依据目前的资本利得税政策，只要股东能持股长达一年或更长时间，就能以更优惠的比率来缴交利得税。
en: Today, the lower capital gains rate is available on shareholder profits made when selling stock held for one year or more.

zh: 而克林顿和她的顾问团则希望对持有两年以内的股票执行正常税率，此后每持有多一年下调4个百分点，直到几年后最终与目前的长期持有税率看齐 — — 针对那些投资大户的长期持有税率最高为20 % 。
en: Clinton and her advisors hope, instead, to tax capital gains at ordinary rates for stock held for up to two years, after which the rate would decline by four percentage points per year until, after several years, it reached the current long-term rate, which tops out for wealthy investors at 20%.

zh: 这一观点认为，如果股东知道长期持有一家公司的股票最终会令他们受益于较低税率，自然也就更乐意接受该公司季度收益下滑的状况。
en: If stockholders know that holding a company’s stock will eventually allow them to benefit from a lower tax rate, the argument goes, they will be more willing to withstand a drop in that company’s quarterly earnings.

zh: 企业高管们也拥有了发挥更长期性思维的空间，并因此做出能获取长期回报的决策 — — 即使这些决策在短期内耗资巨大。
en: With greater scope for longer-term thinking, executives would make decisions that have a long-term payoff, even if they are costly today.

zh: 整个方案听起来相当合理。
en: The plan certainly sounds reasonable.

zh: 但问题是资本利得税率的下降并不会阻止大多数股东实施交易；最多只会让其中一些人买卖不那么频繁。
en: The problem is that a falling tax rate for capital gains will not stop most stockholders from trading; at most, it will impel some of them trade less often.

zh: 企业的高管们也依然会担心交易者喊出的股价。
en: Executives will still have to worry about the price that traders accord to their stock.

zh: 当然，减少交易频率还可能产生其他或好或坏的影响。
en: Of course, curtailing the velocity of trading may have other effects, both good and bad.

zh: 如果有太多的资源和太多的人力被投入到了筛选那些股价只是稍微低估或高估了的股票上，希拉里的计划可能是一件好事，因为它将有助于重新分配这些资源。
en: If too many resources and too much brainpower are now devoted to finding slight underpricing or overpricing of stock, Clinton’s program might be a good thing, as it would help to reallocate those resources.

zh: 但如果因交易量减少而使市场变得更加不稳定及不可测，那么对短期主义征税可能无异于饮鸠止渴。
en: If, however, less trading makes markets more volatile and unpredictable, taxing short-termism could turn out to be a cure worse than the disease.

zh: 在任何情况下，希拉里的计划都无法实现其诱导那些左右股价的交易者采取长期性策略的目标。
en: In any case, Clinton’s program will not achieve its stated goal of inducing those doing the trading, and thus setting stock prices, to take a longer-term perspective.

zh: 也无力安抚公司高管，让他们不至于对关心下一季度的业绩如此神经过敏。
en: Nor will it make corporate executives less concerned about the next quarter’s results.

zh: 最终股价还是照常升跌。
en: Prices will, after all, still be going up and down.

zh: 此外还有另一个该计划无法凑效的原因：许多最大的股东都是无需缴税的机构，比如养老基金和基金会。
en: There is another reason the proposal will not be effective: many of the largest shareowners are institutions that don’t pay tax anyway, such as pension funds and foundations.

zh: 即使它意味着支付全额税率，其他许多股东还是会在一年内买卖。
en: And many other stockholders buy and sell within a year, even though it means paying the full tax rate.

zh: 他们的决策时间框架不会受到漫长降临的更有利税率的影响。
en: Their decision-making time horizon will not be affected by a long phase-in of the more advantageous tax rate.

zh: 但希拉里方案不能实现其目标的事实并不意味着这个问题就没法解决了。
en: But the fact that Clinton’s plan will not achieve its goal is not exactly the end of the world.

zh: 与大众的认知相反，股市诱发的短期主义可能并不算是一个经济阻碍因素，也有相当多（虽然不是决定性的）证据表明它并不像许多人认为的那样普遍 — — 或者有危险性。
en: Contrary to widespead belief, stock-market-induced short-termism is probably not much of an economic handicap anyway. There is considerable (though not conclusive) evidence that it is not nearly as widespread – or as problematic – as many think.

zh: 以当前美国股市总市值前十大公司中的四家 — — 亚马逊，苹果，Alphabet（谷歌）和微软���—为例，试问谁能指责它们没有投资于研发或其他长期，有时甚至极富远见的项目？
en: Consider this: four of the ten biggest companies in the United States today, measured by stock-market capitalization, are Amazon, Apple, Alphabet (Google), and Microsoft. None of them can be accused of failing to invest in R&D or other long-term, sometimes even visionary, projects.

zh: 股票市场对它们给予了大力支持。
en: And the stock market supports all of them well.

zh: 如果它们能得到，别人也可以 — — 而且肯定会得到。
en: If they can do it, others can – and surely do.

zh: 简而言之，终结短期主义已经变成一个比其本身更大的政治问题。
en: Simply put, ending short-termism has turned into a bigger political issue than it deserves to be.

zh: 它之所以引起了广泛回响，原因不仅是因为短期主义阻碍了经济，而是因为它保护了那些受益于现状的人 — — 收入丰厚的职员；CEO和高级经理；和公司董事 — — 免于快速变革的冲击。
en: It is a cause that resonates widely not because short-termism is hampering the economy, but because saying that it is justifies protecting those with a stake in the status quo – well-paid employees; CEOs and senior managers; and board directors – from rapid change.

zh: 重点在于我们有更大，更迫切的问题亟待解决。
en: The bottom line is that there are bigger, more pressing problems to address.

zh: 而且，即使短期主义是一个主要问题，希拉里的税务提案也无济于事。
en: And, even if short-termism were a major problem, Clinton’s tax proposal would not resolve it.

zh: 好消息是这个提案在希拉里的议程中并不是特别优先，令她并不急于在当选后当即实施。
en: The good news here is that the plan is not particularly high on Clinton’s agenda, leaving a chance that she might not feel compelled to implement it when elected.

zh: 克林顿经济学 vs 特朗普经济学
en: Clintonomics vs. Trumponomics

zh: 斯坦福—距离美国总统选举只有两个月了，希拉里·克林顿在全国和几个重要摇摆州民调中领先唐纳德·特朗普五个点。
en: STANFORD – Little more than two months from America’s presidential election, Hillary Clinton leads Donald Trump by five points in opinion polls, nationally and in several important swing states.

zh: 但大局尚未确定，特别是考虑到特朗普阵营的人事改组和重大政策演讲，更不用说电子邮件丑闻仍在继续困扰克林顿阵营，包括最近曝光的克林顿基金会顶层工作人员与克林顿领导下的国务院官员之间的电子邮件往来。
en: But nothing is decided yet, especially given the Trump campaign’s staffing shakeup and major policy speeches, not to mention the email scandals that continue to plague the Clinton campaign, including recently released email correspondence between top staff from the Clinton Foundation and officials from the State Department under Clinton.

zh: 目前，媒体和公众的注意力集中在移民、恐怖主义、外交政策和每个候选人各自的潜在性格缺陷上，而很少关注经济政策。
en: So far, the media and public have focused on immigration, terrorism, foreign policy, and each candidate’s potentially problematic personality traits, but far less has been said about economic policy.

zh: 这是一项严重的疏忽，因为两位候选人的经济政策平台大相径庭。
en: This is a serious oversight, because there are substantial differences between the candidates’ economic-policy platforms.

zh: 首先我们来看看政府支出。
en: First, consider government spending.

zh: 克林顿支持福利国家支持，如扩大社会安全福利（该项福利已经成为规模超国民债务的资金短缺的负债项 ） 、 公立大学免学费和学生贷款债务减负，以及给2010年平价医疗法（即奥巴马医保）新增一项“公共选项 ” 。
en: Clinton favors welfare-state expenditures such as expanded Social Security benefits (the unfunded liabilities of which already exceed the national debt), free tuition at public colleges and student-loan debt relief, as well as an added “public option” to the 2010 Affordable Care Act, known as Obamacare.

zh: 她还说将把奥巴马总统花费甚巨的绿色能源产业政策扩大一倍，该政策向某些能源资源甚至具体的公司倾斜，而对其他人不利。
en: She also says she will double down on President Barack Obama’s costly green-energy industrial policy, which favors some energy sources, and even specific companies, at the expense of others.

zh: 反之，特朗普说他不会动社会安全，将废除奥巴马医保用新政策取而代之，并提高政府支出的效率和效果（尽管他并没有提出具体做法 ） 。
en: By contrast, Trump says he will leave Social Security as is, repeal and replace Obamacare, and make government spending more efficient and effective (though here he has not been specific).

zh: 在税收方面，克林顿说她将增加美国税收制度的累进性，即使美国税收制度已经是发达经济体中累进程度最高的。
en: On taxation, Clinton says she will make the US tax system more progressive, even though it is already the most progressive system among the advanced economies.

zh: 具体而言，克林顿希望增加房地产税和最高收入群体的个人税率 — — 这也将影响到小企业 — — 并设置分项扣税上限。
en: Specifically, Clinton calls for increases to the estate tax and the personal tax rate for the highest earners – which also affects small businesses – and caps on itemized deductions.

zh: 她对降低公司税没有表现出多少兴趣。
en: She shows little inclination to lower corporate taxes.

zh: 特朗普提出为个人和美国公司降低税率。
en: Trump is proposing lower tax rates for individuals and US companies.

zh: 目前美国联邦公司税率为35 % ， 是经合组织中最高的。
en: The US currently has a federal corporate tax rate of 35%, the highest in the OECD.

zh: 特朗普希望将它降低到比15%的平均水平更低，商业投资第一年可以全部抵扣税收。
en: Trump is calling for it to be lowered to a below-average 15%, with first-year business investments to be deductible in full.

zh: 在贸易方面，克林顿的态度发生了大幅转变，她现在反对奥巴马政府与其他11个环太平洋国家谈成的跨太平洋合作伙伴关系协议。
en: On trade, Clinton has flip-flopped to oppose the Trans-Pacific Partnership, a multinational trade deal negotiated by the Obama administration and 11 other Pacific Rim countries.

zh: 与她的丈夫不同 — — 比尔·克林顿在总统任上支持并签署了多项自由贸易协定 — — 克林顿正在逐渐转向民主党中的保护主义阵营。
en: Unlike her husband, who supported and signed free-trade agreements during his presidency, Clinton is inching closer to the protectionist wing of the Democratic Party.

zh: 克林顿的贸易立场没有什么两点，但特朗普更加糟糕。
en: Clinton’s trade position has little to recommend it, but Trump’s is even worse.

zh: 特朗普威胁对中国和墨西哥开展贸易战，并说他要重新谈判美国现有贸易协定。
en: Among other things, Trump has threatened a trade war with China and Mexico, and says he would renegotiate America’s existing trade agreements.

zh: 不难理解，克林顿和特朗普的这些话是对被全球化甩开的中低收入工人阶级说的。
en: Clinton and Trump are understandably giving voice to lower- and middle-class workers who have been left behind by globalization.

zh: 但最佳政策反应不是采取保护主义（这将导致更多人境况变得更加糟糕 ） ， 而是更好地帮助失业工人。
en: But the best policy response is not to embrace protectionism (which would leave many more people worse off), but to assist displaced workers better.

zh: 最后，克林顿与特朗普在赤字支出和国民债务等问题上也存在分歧。
en: Lastly, Clinton and Trump differ on deficit spending and the national debt.

zh: 克林顿的社会安全扩张和其他支出，以及她进一步扩大奥巴马医保制度的计划 — — 而不遏���预计将飙升的未来福利成本 — — 意味着庞大的赤字将在她当选总统后继续攀升。
en: Clinton’s Social Security expansion and other spending, and her plans to entrench the Obamacare health-care system further, without reining in future entitlement costs – which are projected to soar – suggest that large deficits would only continue during her presidency.

zh: 这与她丈夫的记录南辕北辙：比尔·克林顿与共和党控制的国会在其总统任期的最后几年实现了预算平衡。
en: That’s a far cry from her husband’s record: Bill Clinton worked with a Republican-controlled Congress to balance the budget in the final years of his presidency.

zh: 特朗普最近降低了他所提出的减税计划的预算成本，使之与共和党立法者自身的目标更加一致。
en: Trump recently reduced the budget cost of his proposed tax reductions to bring them more in line with Republican legislators’ own targets.

zh: 即使合理地估计了来自经济增长的税收收入增量，他仍然需要通过控制支出，特别是福利支出与其减税计划匹配。
en: If properly scored to account for increased tax revenue from economic growth, he would still need to pair his tax cuts with controls on spending, and especially on entitlements.

zh: 否则，特朗普的总统生涯将出现严重的债务问题。
en: Otherwise, a Trump presidency could also have serious debt problems.

zh: 两位候选人形成一致的一个方案是大规模基础设施支出。
en: One proposal the candidates agree on is massive infrastructure spending.

zh: 不幸的是，尽管由联邦政府承担部分开支合情合理，但两位候选人都不能确保这笔钱因为政治化或裙带关系而浪费。
en: Unfortunately, while a portion of this is appropriate for the federal government, neither candidate has ensured that money wouldn’t be misspent through politicization or cronyism.

zh: 美国不需要重复奥巴马政府的“万事俱备”的刺激支出无用功。
en: The United States does not need a repeat of the Obama administration’s “shovel-ready” stimulus-spending boondoggle.

zh: 总而言之，克林顿重视再分配甚于经济增长，而特朗普更重视增长。
en: All told, Clinton would prioritize redistribution above economic growth, while Trump is more growth-oriented.

zh: 美国的增长是一个全球性问题，因为它能通过美国消费需求和贸易推动其他地区的增长。
en: American growth is a global concern because it fuels growth elsewhere through US consumer demand and trade.

zh: 但增长的两大主要源泉 — — 生产率改进和劳动力投入（如总工时数 ） — —近几年来均显著下降。
en: But the two primary sources of growth, productivity gains and labor inputs (such as total man-hours worked), have both fallen off sharply in recent years.

zh: 二战后的几十年中，美国经济平均年增长率为3 % ， 但在过去十年，增长率从未连续三个季度超过3 % 。
en: The US economy grew at an average annual rate of 3% during the decades after World War II, but it has not had even three consecutive quarters of 3% growth during the past decade.

zh: 对于生产率增长的放缓，存在不同的解释。
en: There are different explanations for slowing productivity growth.

zh: 西北大学经济学家罗伯特·戈登（Robert Gordon）提出技术创新对经济增长的贡献已步入此前的技术突破（如电力、动力、航空和计算 ） 。
en: Northwestern University economist Robert Gordon singles out technological innovation for contributing less to economic growth than did previous breakthroughs such as electricity, locomotion, aviation, and computing.

zh: 哈佛大学经济学家劳伦斯·萨默斯（Lawrence Summers）认为原因是“长期停滞 ” ， 这个词的始作俑者是20世纪30年代的阿尔文·汉森（Alvin Hansen ） ， 用来描述长期的需求萎靡和有利可图的投资机会不足。
en: Harvard University economist Lawrence Summers points to “secular stagnation,” a term coined by the economist Alvin Hansen in the 1930s to describe long-term tepid demand and insufficient opportunity for profitable investment.

zh: 我本人的观点是糟糕的经济政策阻碍了商业投资、企业家精神和工作。
en: My own opinion is that poor economic policy has discouraged business investment, entrepreneurship, and work.

zh: 民调表明，尚未作出决定的选民对两位候选人都非常不信任。
en: Polling shows that undecided voters deeply distrust both candidates.

zh: 要想当选并真正拥有实施日程的权力，克林顿必须对过去的错误更加透明、更加坦诚。
en: To get elected and actually have the mandate to enact her agenda, Clinton will need to be more transparent and honest about past mistakes.

zh: 在经济政策方面，她应该走中间道路，支持以增长为重点的措施，远离她在与佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）的党内初选中所采取的左派立场。
en: And on economic policy, she should move to the center, toward growth-focused measures, and away from leftist positions she adopted during her primary campaign against Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders.

zh: 至于特朗普，他需要表现出一些人道精神和包容性，并在他缺少经验的问题上对他人的建议持更加开放的态度。
en: Trump, for his part, will need to show some humility and inclusiveness, and be open to advice from others on issues where he lacks experience.

zh: 共和党正在与民主党进行保持参议院控制权的激烈斗争，但在众议院，他们有望继续保持多数。
en: While the Republicans are in a tight battle with the Democrats to retain control over the Senate, they are likely to maintain a majority in the House of Representatives.

zh: 因此，在许多政策问题上，所有人的目光都集中在众议长保罗·莱恩（Paul Ryan）身上，他可能成为制衡克林顿的力量 — — 有时候与克林顿合作，也可能为特朗普指引方向，成为他的经常性伙伴。
en: As a result, on many policy issues, all eyes will be on House Speaker Paul Ryan, who would likely operate either as a counterbalance – and occasional partner – to Clinton, or as a guide and more regular partner for Trump.

zh: 剪断欧元的羽翼
en: Clipping the Euro’s Wings

zh: 法国总统萨尔科奇呼吁欧洲中央银行采取干预措施来抑制飞扬的欧元，这通常被视为他既不理解也不信任市场。
en: French President Nicolas Sarkozy’s call for the European Central Bank to intervene to curtail the soaring euro is commonly seen as a sign that he neither understands nor trusts markets.

zh: 确实，现在有人把萨尔科奇看作是传统戴高乐派人物。 这些人想要通过人为地让欧元贬值来帮助法国的制造商。
en: Indeed, some now view Sarkozy as a traditional Gaullist who wants to help French producers by artificially devaluing the euro.

zh: 但是，萨尔科奇相信货币市场并不自动地将汇率改变到与国际贸易基本面相符的水平之上，这会不会是有道理的呢？
en: But could Sarkozy be right in believing that currency markets do not automatically drive exchange rates to levels consistent with the fundamentals of international trade?

zh: 毕竟，在国际上可比产品销售的价格是不同的。
en: After all, comparable goods often sell internationally at very different prices.

zh: 例如，根据经济学人杂志报导，麦当劳巨无霸汉堡包在欧元区的售价是大约三欧元，根据目前的汇率大致为四美元，但是在美国只有大约3.2美元。 这表明欧元价格高估大约25 % 。
en: For example, according to The Economist , a Big Mac hamburger sells in the euro zone for about three euros – roughly $4 at the current exchange rate – but for only about $3.20 in the United States, implying that the euro is overvalued by about 25%.

zh: 从过去三十年货币浮动可以清除地看出，由市场决定的汇率趋向于长期大幅摇摆游离于让可比商品在不同国家以可比价格销售的同位水平。
en: It is clear from the last three decades of floating currencies that market-determined exchange rates tend to swing widely and persistently from parity levels that would make comparable goods sell at comparable prices in different countries.

zh: 因此像萨尔科奇那样的政坛人物可能会有理由争辩说中央银行应当采取干预措施来限制这样的摇摆浮动。
en: So politicians like Sarkozy may have grounds to argue that central banks should intervene to limit such swings.

zh: 但是，包括许多中央银行职员在内的经济学家们通常并不苟同。
en: But economists, including many central bank staff, usually do not see things this way.

zh: 尽管在实际货币市场上长期大幅摇摆不定，他们所谓的“理性预期模式”预计，汇率不应该永久地脱离于同位水平。
en: Despite wide and persistent swings in actual currency markets, their so-called “rational expectations models” predict that exchange rates should not deviate from parity in any lasting way.

zh: 他们相信他们找到了用模式方法精确预估货币交易者如何考虑以后的情形，因此他们就认为没有干预的必要，因为，除了暂时的脱离，市场总是合理决定了各种货币价值。
en: Believing that they have found a way to model precisely how currency traders should think about the future, they see no need for intervention because, save for temporary deviations, markets always get currency values right.

zh: 与此相反 ， “ 行为学派经济学家们”认为，某些货币可能会在较长的一段时间里脱离同位水平，但是他们认为这并非由于交易者们试图解释宏观经济基本面的变动情况，而是由于市场心理和非理性的交易。
en: In contrast, “behavioral economists” acknowledge that currencies can depart from parity for a protracted period, but argue that this results not from traders’ attempts to interpret movements in macroeconomic fundamentals, but from market psychology and irrational trading.

zh: 对于他们而言，干预与其说没有必要，不如说不可能。
en: For them, intervention is not so much unnecessary as it is impossible.

zh: 面对大幅波动，中央银行对于抵消交易者们争购某一种货币、进一步脱离其历史基准水平的非理性狂热无能为力。
en: Faced with wide swings, central banks are helpless to counteract traders’ irrational zeal to bid a currency further away from historical benchmark levels.

zh: 毕竟，投机性货币流动占据货币市场上每天两兆美元交易的95 % 。
en: After all, speculative flows account for more than 95% of the $2 trillion traded daily in currency markets.

zh: 但是 ， “ 理性预期”和“行为学派”两种模式在评估政策干预上都存在根本性的缺陷。
en: But both the “rational expectations” and the “behavioral” models are fundamentally flawed for the purpose of assessing policy interventions.

zh: 这两者看起来大相径庭，它们都试图对人类行为作出精确的预计，而无论是“理性”还是“非理性 ” 。
en: As different as they might appear, they attempt to generate exact predictions of human behavior, whether “rational” or “irrational.”

zh: 两者都不考虑到这一事实，即理性既取决于个人对于历史和社会不完善的理解，也取决于他们的动机。
en: Both disregard the fact that rationality depends as much on individuals’ imperfect understandings of history and society as on their motivation.

zh: 他们还忽略了个人创造性所带来的市场结果以及不可预计的社会政治变化。
en: They also ignore the importance for market outcomes of individual creativity and unforeseeable socio-political change.

zh: 一旦经济分析认真考虑这一“不完善的知识 ” ， 我们预估市场结果的内在有限能力的后果也就变得清晰了。
en: Once this “imperfect knowledge” is placed at the heart of economic analysis, the implications of our inherently limited ability to predict market outcomes become clear.

zh: 在货币市场上，基于国际贸易的同位水平只不过是交易者们考虑的众多因素之一。
en: When it comes to currency markets, parity levels based on international trade are merely one of many factors that traders may consider.

zh: 为了试图应付不完善的知识，他们在关注其他宏观经济基本面的时候并不丢失理性，因而争购某一种货币脱离其同位水平。
en: In attempting to cope with imperfect knowledge, they are not irrational when they pay attention to other macroeconomic fundamentals and thereby bid an exchange rate away from its parity level.

zh: 欧元近来相对美元升值就是一个例证。 在大多数情形下，欧元的大幅升值是对美国巨额经常项目赤字、欧元区经济高涨以及欧元区利率上升等情况的反应。
en: The euro’s recent rise against the dollar is a case in point: by most accounts, euro bulls have been reacting to the enormous US current account deficit, a surging euro-zone economy, and rising euro interest rates.

zh: 在交易某种货币之时，考虑这样的基本面哪里有非理性呢？
en: What is irrational about factoring in such fundamentals when trading a currency?

zh: 当然，长久性的脱离同位并不能长久。
en: Of course, persistent swings from parity do not last forever.

zh: 宏观经济基本面的变动可能会将某一种货币价值争购到进一步高于同位水准，他们同时更为关切返回同位的反方向变动、进而是资本损失，这就温和了他们的欲望，增加长期持有。
en: While movements in macroeconomic fundamentals may lead bulls to bid the value of a currency further above parity, they simultaneously become more concerned about a counter-movement back to parity – and thus capital losses – which moderates their desire to increase their long positions.

zh: 这一风险概念建立在被人忽略的凯恩斯的洞察之上。 凯恩斯十分清楚理解资本市场价格波动的不完善知识的中心地位。
en: This concept of risk builds on a neglected insight of John Maynard Keynes, who was keenly aware of the centrality of imperfect knowledge for understanding price fluctuations in asset markets.

zh: 而且，将在某一货币市场持有多头的风险与汇率偏离同位水平联系在一起表明了思考中央银行如何影响市场来限制偏离同位。
en: Moreover, relating the riskiness of holding an open position in a currency market to the exchange rate’s divergence from parity levels suggests a novel way to think about how central banks can influence the market to limit departures from parity.

zh: 每个月，中央银行都根据分析公布其对同位价值的范围估计。 与精确价值不同的是，它反映的是有关某一货币同位固有的不完善知识。
en: Every month, the central bank should announce its estimate of a range of parity values, backed by analysis, which, unlike a precise value, reflects the inherent imperfection of knowledge concerning a currency’s parity.

zh: 在汇率偏离其范围之时，中央银行定期公布将会提高货币交易者们的顾虑，也就是其他交易者将会认为持仓越发具有风险。
en: As the exchange rate moves away from this range, the central bank’s regular announcements would heighten the concern of currency traders that other traders will consider it increasingly risky to hold open positions.

zh: 这就会降低他们这样做的意愿，从而限制货币波动的幅度。
en: This should moderate their willingness to do so, thereby limiting the magnitude of the currency swing.

zh: 这一战略并不意味着中央银行应当试图把汇率限制到预先确定的指标范围之内。
en: This strategy does not imply that central banks should attempt to confine the exchange rate to a pre-specified target zone.

zh: 鉴于货币市场上每日的巨大交易量，这样的企图几乎肯定失败，从而导致货币危机。
en: Given the enormous size of daily volumes in currency markets, such attempts almost always fail, leading to currency crises.

zh: 相反，在本文中提议的“限制波动”策略意味着，在汇率进一步偏离同位水平的时候，中央银行应当使用它们的储备出其不意地进行干预，以便加强其定期公布同位范围对于交易者更大感受资本损失的效果。
en: Instead, the “ limit-the-swings” strategy proposed here implies that, as the exchange rate moves further away from parity, central banks should use their reserves to intervene at unpredictable moments in order to reinforce the effect of their regular announcements of the parity range on traders’ perception of increased risk of capital losses.

zh: 我们提议减低而非消除偏离同位的波动认为，价格波动对于市场确定保证不确定回报的资产价格而言是关键的。
en: Our proposal to reduce ­­– but not eliminate – swings from parity recognizes that price fluctuations may be crucial for markets to ascertain the price of assets that promise an uncertain payoff.

zh: 但是货币波动如果过于巨大和持续就会阻碍实际经济活动。 这也就是为何干预有时是必要的。
en: But currency swings, if too wide and protracted, can impede real economic activity, which is why intervention is sometimes necessary.

zh: 只有通过公开承认经济学家和决策者的知识有限方能使得这样的政策有机会成功。
en: Only by explicitly acknowledging the limits to economists’ and policymakers’ knowledge would such policies have a chance of succeeding.

zh: 缩小亚洲的安全差距
en: Closing Asia’s Security Gap

zh: 发自东京 — — 美国总统奥巴马在去年年末宣布美国将在缩减欧洲驻军的同时强化自身在东亚的地位，此举并不令人感到意外。
en: TOKYO – There was little surprise in President Barack Obama’s announcement late last year that the United States will strengthen its position in East Asia while drawing down its forces in Europe.

zh: 毕竟东亚的安全环境与相对稳定的欧洲不同，处于一种既不可预测又迅速变化的状态。
en: After all, the security environment in East Asia is unpredictable and rapidly changing, unlike in Europe, where it is relatively stable.

zh: 而在这个大背景下，人们可以从欧洲安全与合作组织（Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe，简称欧安组织）最近的历史中有所借鉴，为该区域营造一个综合性多边框架。
en: Against this background, efforts now underway to establish a comprehensive multilateral framework for the region can learn from the recent history of the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE).

zh: 把安全焦点转向东亚的可不仅仅是美国一家。
en: The US is not alone in shifting its security focus to East Asia.

zh: 俄罗斯总统普京即将于今年9月在海参崴首次主办亚太经合组织会议的决定也反映了该国对该区域的兴趣不断增加。
en: Russian President Vladimir Putin’s decision to host Russia’s first Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) meeting in Vladivostok in September reflects his country’s growing interest in the region.

zh: 同时跟美国一样，俄罗斯也参加了上届东亚峰会。
en: And, like the US, Russia attended last November’s East Asia Summit (EAS).

zh: 东亚论坛以及去年7月召开的东盟区域论坛部长级会议都对本区域安全环境的改善做出了重要贡献。
en: The EAS, along with the ASEAN Regional Forum (ARF) ministerial meetings last July, made important contributions to improving the region’s security environment.

zh: 其中部长级会议为构建一个更具可预见性和建设性的亚太地区关系模式所做出的努力基于三个阶段：信心构建，预防性外交和冲突解决。
en: The ARF’s effort to build a more predictable and constructive pattern of relations for the Asia-Pacific region is based on three stages: confidence-building, preventive diplomacy, and conflict resolution.

zh: 在去年的18届部长级会议上已经进入了预防性外交的第二阶段，同时也继续在信心构建措施方面不断强化。
en: At its 18th ministerial conference last year, ARF entered the second phase, preventive diplomacy, while continuing to strengthen confidence-building measures.

zh: 海洋合作也是上届东盟区域论坛部长级会议和东亚峰会的焦点，尤其是在中国在东海和南海地区的活动已经催生了新不确定性的情况下。
en: Maritime cooperation was a focus of attention at both the ARF ministerial meeting and at the EAS, not least because China’s activities in the South and East China Seas have generated fresh uncertainty in the region.

zh: 部长级会议欢迎各方对《落实<南海各方行为宣言>指导方针》的批准通过。
en: The ARF welcomed the adoption of “Guidelines for Implementation of the Declaration on the Conduct of Parties in the South China Sea.”

zh: 同样，东亚峰会则将注意力集中在“打击海盗、海上搜救、海洋环境保护、通航、航海自由，渔业以及其他合作领域”
en: Likewise, the EAS focused on combating “sea piracy, search and rescue at sea, marine environment, maritime security, maritime connectivity, freedom of navigation, fisheries, and other areas of cooperation.”

zh: 两场会议也都将焦点放在灾难应对方面，参加东盟区域论坛的各国部长们也在进一步区域合作方面达成了共识。
en: Both meetings also focused on disaster management, with the ARF ministers reaching a common understanding on furthering regional cooperation.

zh: 位于雅加达的东盟人道主义援助协调中心将在建立一个与该区域灾难相关的信息网络方面扮演核心角色，并为针对各类灾害研究出一些切实的应对方案。
en: The ASEAN Coordinating Center for Humanitarian Assistance in Jakarta is expected to play a central role in building a disaster-related information network across the region, and in developing concrete measures for disaster management.

zh: 同样，参加东亚峰会的许多国家都强调了灾害反应能力的必要性，比如紧急灾害援助。
en: Similarly, many of the countries attending the EAS stressed the need for response capabilities, such as emergency disaster relief.

zh: 日本首相野田佳彦就宣布已经准备好今夏在本国主办一场关于主要灾害的国际会议，为日本提供一个分享2011年日本东北太平洋海啸地震中所吸取教训的机会。
en: Japanese Prime Minister Yoshihiko Noda announced his country’s readiness to host an international conference this summer on major disasters, giving Japan an opportunity to share lessons learned from the 2011 Great East Japan Earthquake and tsunami.

zh: 其目的必须是令到该区域在遭遇自然灾害时具备更加强大的适应和复原能力，并成为一个更宏大区域合作框架的一部分。
en: The aim must be to make the region more resilient to natural disasters as part of a broader framework for regional cooperation.

zh: 亚太地区所发生的急速变化需要既能将增长机会最大化又能尽量减少风险的政策。
en: The rapid changes occurring in the Asia-Pacific region demand policies to maximize growth opportunities while minimizing risks.

zh: 这也是日本外相玄叶光一郎提出与各国建立新的“开放及多层次网络”的原因。
en: That is why Koichiro Gemba, Japan’s foreign minister, has proposed new “open and multilayered networks” with other Asia-Pacific countries.

zh: “多层次”意味着可以通过双边，三边或者多边机制推动针对各类行动的多国合作。
en: “Multilayered” means multinational cooperation on various activities that can be promoted through bilateral, trilateral, or multilateral mechanisms.

zh: 在东盟区域论坛或者东亚峰会框架内的工作已经与这一理念相契合，而日本正在寻求分别与中国和韩国，美国和澳大利亚展开三方对话。
en: Work within the ARF and EAS frameworks is already aligned with this concept, and Japan is pursuing its own trilateral dialogues with China and the Republic of Korea, as well as with the US and Australia.

zh: 日本相信这些网络必须对亚太区所有国家开放，因为它们的建立需要中国的全力参与。
en: Japan believes that these networks must be open to all of the Asia-Pacific region’s countries, as their establishment requires China’s full participation.

zh: 但构建这样一个网络的基础所需的规则很显然必须遵循国际法，而东盟区域论坛会议的最终声明也清晰地反映了这一理念。
en: But the rule needed to form the foundation of such a network must obviously adhere to international law, and the ARF meeting’s final declaration clearly reflected this concern.

zh: 这也正是欧安组织的经验教训与亚洲尝试建立一个区域性架构的相关之处。
en: This is where lessons from the OSCE’s experience are relevant to Asia’s budding efforts to establish a regional architecture.

zh: 尤其是尽管亚太和欧洲之间存在着极大的社会经济和政治差异，欧安组织的信心与安全构建措施也值得深入思考。
en: In particular, despite the significant socioeconomic and political differences between the Asia-Pacific region and Europe, the OSCE’s confidence- and security-building measures are worthy of careful consideration.

zh: 这些措施致力于通过增加欧安组织成员国之间互信以及在军事部署和其他行动方面增加透明度的方式来减少冲突的风险。
en: Such measures aim to reduce the risk of conflict by increasing trust among participating OSCE states, and by contributing to greater transparency in the field of military planning and other activities.

zh: 而作为理解这些欧安组织行为的关键的《维也纳文件 》 （ Vienna Document）也规定各成员国之间必须每年交换关于现有军事力量，兵力组成结构，主要武器和防务系统的相关信息，同时还要求每年在国防方略和军费方面进行沟通。
en: The Vienna Document, which is the key to understanding these OSCE efforts, obliges annual exchanges of information on existing military forces, the structure of armed forces, and major weapons and defense systems. It also requires annual information exchanges on defense planning and budgets.

zh: 在亚太地区实施这些措施可以大大提升亚洲国家之间的信心和互信。
