en: Adoption of such measures in the Asia-Pacific region would do much to promote confidence and trust among Asian countries.

zh: 而朝着这个方面的一些步骤已经在东盟区域论坛的框架下得到了推进，包括近十几年来每年都利用成员国所提供的信息发布《年度安全展望 》 。
en: A few steps in this direction have already been taken within the ARF framework, including the publication for more than a decade of an Annual Security Outlook based on contributions from ARF countries.

zh: 在2010年，参加东盟区域论坛的部长们利用一个简化的标准格式扩大了展望的范围，���中包括公布国家国防方针，国防支出以及各国武装部队总兵力。
en: In 2010, ARF ministers widened the Outlook’s scope with the Simplified Standardized Format, which includes publication of national defense doctrines, defense expenditure, and the total number of personnel in a country’s armed forces.

zh: 有两种主要方法来应对现代区域安全的挑战：其一是北约式的传统结盟制，为应对针对盟国的任何潜在威胁做准备；其二是欧安组织式的综合性多边框架，将一个区域内所有相关的参与者都涵盖在内。
en: There have been two main approaches to meeting modern regional-security challenges: traditional alliances of the NATO type, which prepare for any potential threat to members, and comprehensive multilateral frameworks of the OSCE type, which include all relevant players within a region.

zh: 而欧洲二战后的历史也明白地告诉我们，传统结盟制和综合性多边框架可以是互为补充的，也是维持区域和平稳定的必要条件。
en: As Europe’s post-1945 history clearly shows, traditional alliances and a comprehensive multilateral framework can be complementary, and are essential to maintaining regional peace and stability.

zh: 如今亚太区正见证着一个在东盟区域论坛和东亚峰会框架下建立类似综合性和多边框架的努力。
en: Now the Asia-Pacific region is witnessing efforts to establish a similar comprehensive and multilateral framework through the ARF and the EAS.

zh: 但无论这些努力究竟会取得何种成功，它们必将提升 — — 而不是减弱 — — 现有双边关系的重要性，比如美日同盟。
en: But, however successful such efforts may be, they will enhance, not lessen, the importance of existing bilateral relationships, such as the Japan-US alliance.

zh: 通往性别平等的缓慢长征
en: The Slow March to Gender Parity

zh: 伯克利 — — 国际货币基金组织总裁克里斯蒂娜•拉加德不久前发出警告：增长放缓的“平庸常态”正摆在世人面前。
en: BERKELEY – Christine Lagarde, the International Monetary Fund’s managing director, recently warned that the world risks a new “mediocre normal” of slower growth.

zh: 有此担心的还不止她一人。
en: She is not alone in her concern.

zh: 世界各国经济决策者正寻找各种方法来刺激增长，其中最常见的是投资基础设施。
en: Economic policymakers around the world are looking for ways to boost growth, with infrastructure investment topping most lists.

zh: 但拉加德时常提醒听众，还有一种补救方法往往为人所忽视，那就是改善妇女的经济参与度和晋升空间。
en: But, as Lagarde regularly reminds her audiences, another, often-overlooked remedy is to increase the economic participation and advancement of women.

zh: 女性占全球劳动力的一半、世界消费需求的70 % 。
en: Women account for half of the global labor supply and about 70% of the world’s consumption demand.

zh: 但世界经济论坛刚刚发布的2014年全球性别差距报告证实，还要做很多工作才能释放她们的经济潜能。
en: Yet there remains a long way to go in realizing their economic potential, as the World Economic Forum’s just-released Global Gender Gap Report 2014 confirms.

zh: 该报告统计了142个国家和94%的世界人口，显示在很多发达国家和发展中国家，男性和女性在教育和医疗卫生领域已经或接近实现平等。
en: In many countries, both developed and developing, men and women are at or near parity when it comes to education and health, according to the report, which covers 142 countries and 94% of the world’s population.

zh: 但英勇的巴基斯坦女学生和诺贝尔和平奖得主马拉拉·优素福扎伊遭袭事件表明，某些地方仍不许女童和女人接受教育，甚至不惜为此而诉诸暴力。
en: But, as the attack on the heroic Pakistani schoolgirl and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Malala Yousafzai demonstrated, girls and women are still blocked from education in many places, sometimes through violence.

zh: 此外，在经济参与度和机会领域，女性持续落后男性15-25 % ， 甚至在两性最为平等的社会也同样如此。
en: Moreover, in terms of economic participation and opportunity, women continue to lag behind men by a considerable 15-25% even in the most gender-equal societies.

zh: 全球范围内，只有半数工作适龄女性受雇工作，而且即使她们的教育程度和所从事职业与男性相同，其所获薪酬也只相当于男性的四分之三。
en: Globally, only about half of working-age women are employed, and they earn three-quarters as much as men, even when they have the same level of education and are in the same occupation.

zh: 此外，女性过多从事非正式、临时和兼职工作，其中大部分岗位低效率、低工资、无福利，且晋升机会有限。
en: Meanwhile, women are over-represented in informal, temporary, and part-time jobs, most of which are low-productivity positions with low pay, no benefits, and limited opportunities for advancement.

zh: 依据过去9年的进步速度，弥合世界性别差距并释放相关经济利益还需要81年。
en: Based on the rate of progress over the last nine years, it will take another 81 years to close the world’s economic gender gap and unlock the associated economic benefits.

zh: 据估算女性占全球高层管理职位的约24 % ， 不同地区和发展水平的数据都差不多。
en: By one estimate, women hold about 24% of top management positions globally, with comparable figures across regions and development levels.

zh: 但瑞信研究院（CSRI）最近公布的对不同行业和国家3，000家企业的一项研究结果更令人沮丧：女性平均仅占高层管理职位（首席执行官及其直接下属）的约13 % ， 就连数据最高的北美地区也仅占15 % 。
en: A recent study by the Credit Suisse Research Institute (CSRI) of 3,000 companies in diverse sectors and countries, however, yields a more depressing conclusion: women occupy only about 13% of top management positions (CEOs and people who report directly to them), on average, with even the highest rate, in North America, amounting to only 15%.

zh: 此外，女性参与偏向于公共服务等影响力较小的领域，这些职位晋升到高层的机会有限。
en: Women’s participation, moreover, is skewed toward positions in less influential areas like shared services, in which opportunities for promotion to top positions are limited.

zh: 并且，虽然女性进入公司董事会的比例过去三年内在几乎所有国家和行业都有所增加（提升速度最快的是已经实施配额制度的国家 ） ， 但平均来看仅有12.7%的董事职位为女性占据。
en: And, though female participation on company boards has increased in almost every country and sector over the last three years, with the largest gains occurring in countries that have introduced quotas, women hold only about 12.7% of board positions, on average.

zh: 性别差距不仅伤害女性；而是伤害所有人。
en: The gender gap does not hurt only women; it hurts everyone.

zh: 受过教育的健康女性更有可能培养出受过教育的健康子女，进而创造出良性的发展周期。
en: Healthy, educated women are more likely to have healthier and more educated children, creating a virtuous circle of development.

zh: 世界经济论坛的数据表明国家弥合两性差距（特别在教育和劳动力领域）与其经济竞争力之间存在极强的相关性。
en: WEF data suggest a strong correlation between a country’s progress in closing the gender gap – particularly in education and the labor force – and its economic competitiveness.

zh: 女性有充分的商业理由担任领导职务。
en: The business case for women in leadership is strong.

zh: 聘请更多女性担任高管和董事的企业更贴近客户和员工、解决问题时观点更多样、机构合作与健康指数更高、盈利能力和净资产收益率也更出众。
en: Companies with more women in top management and board positions better reflect the profiles of their customers and employees, benefit from more diverse views when solving problems, rank higher on indicators of organizational cooperation and health, and report higher profitability and returns on equity.

zh: 此外，瑞信研究院研究结果还上述企业显示净资产收益率、估值和派息率较高，而风险偏好方面并没有显著差异。
en: Furthermore, the CSRI study indicates higher returns on equity, higher valuations, and higher payout ratios, with no discernible differences in risk-taking.

zh: 发掘女性的经济潜能需要改变政策、商业惯例和态度。
en: Realizing the economic potential of women requires changes in policies, business practices, and attitudes.

zh: 发达国家应投资提供廉价托儿服务、发展早期幼儿教育并规定育儿假；放弃家庭税而改收个税；并为低收入兼职劳动者提供更优惠的税收减免和福利保障。
en: Developed countries should invest in affordable child care, early childhood education, and parental leave; shift from family to individual taxes; and provide more generous tax credits, benefits, and protections for low-wage and part-time workers.

zh: 发展中国家赋予女性在土地所有权、继承权和信贷权等领域平等权利的法律改革至关重要。
en: In developing countries, legal reforms that give women equal rights in land ownership, inheritance, and access to credit are essential.

zh: 企业应采取具体措施实现性别平等的目标。
en: Businesses can commit to gender parity by taking several concrete steps.

zh: 他们可以设定招聘和聘用女员工的人数；积极展开搜索以实现这些目标；推出导师计划及多元化培训来吸引、聘用和晋升女性员工；并设定透明的薪金级别以跟踪并缩小男女之间的工资鸿沟。
en: They can set targets for recruitment and retention levels; initiate affirmative searches to meet those targets; introduce mentorship programs and diversity training to attract, retain, and promote women; and establish transparent salary bands to help track and reduce gender pay gaps.

zh: 与此同时，人力资源实务应认真考虑无意识偏见、成见和有明确记录的两性行为差异等问题。
en: At the same time, human-resource practices should take account of unconscious biases, risks of stereotyping, and documented gender differences in behavior.

zh: 比方说，研究表明女性与同等资质的男性相比不太自信，也不太容易谈判加薪和升职等类似问题。
en: For example, research finds that women tend to be less confident and less likely to negotiate for pay raises and promotions than equally qualified men.

zh: 企业还可以运用自身的供应商、分销商和伙伴关系来支持女性开办的企业，并鼓励无性别歧视的广告内容。
en: Companies can also use their influence with suppliers, distributors, and partners to support women-owned businesses and encourage gender-neutral advertising.

zh: 企业可以改革岗位结构及报酬来增强灵活性，进而帮助男性和女性平衡工作及家庭需求。
en: And companies can change how jobs are structured and remunerated to enhance flexibility, thereby helping both men and women balance work and family demands.

zh: 女性经济参与和机会中的性别差距随地区的不同而变化。
en: Gender gaps in economic participation and opportunity for women vary significantly across regions.

zh: 世界经济论坛调查结果显示中东和北非性别差距最大，女性在工作场所平均平等率仅有40 % ， 而北美地区则接近80 % 。
en: The WEF’s findings show that the Middle East and North Africa suffer from the widest gender gap, with women reaching only 40% of parity in the workplace, on average, compared with nearly 80% in North America.

zh: 事实上，约旦和突尼斯的总体差距甚至有所扩大。
en: Indeed, the overall gap has widened in Jordan and Tunisia.

zh: 即便如此也存在着积极的势头。
en: Even so, there are positive trends.

zh: 过去9年来，沙特阿拉伯与开始时相比已缩小了经济领域的性别差距，并在这一领域领先于其他任何国家。
en: Over the last nine years, Saudi Arabia has reduced its economic gender gap, relative to its starting point, more than any other country.

zh: 拉加德敦促决策者和企业领袖推进扩大女性经济参与和机会的改革。
en: Lagarde challenges policymakers and business leaders alike to make changes that broaden economic participation and opportunity for women.

zh: 这样做的经济利益非常显著。
en: The economic gains from doing so are significant.

zh: 用世界经济论坛创始人克劳斯·施瓦布的话讲 ， “ 只有释放其全部人才能力的经济体才能保持竞争优势，实现持续繁荣。
en: In the words of Klaus Schwab, the WEF’s founder, “Only those economies which have full access to all their talent will remain competitive and will prosper.

zh: 但更重要的是，性别平等事关公正。 ”
en: But, even more important, gender equality is a matter of justice.”

zh: 很难再找到更令人信服的理由来推动朝着性别平等的进步。
en: It would be difficult to identify more compelling reasons to accelerate progress toward gender parity.

zh: 弥补教育领域的性别差距
en: Closing the Education Gender Gap

zh: 华盛顿 — — 因为在前进道路上面临着各种各样的障碍，在尼日尔读完小学对艾什图·哈马来说从来不是一件确定的事。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Completing primary school in Niger was never a certainty for Aishetu Mahmoudu Hama, given all the obstacles that stood in her way.

zh: “学习很难 ， ” 她后来回忆。
en: “It was hard to study,” she recalls.

zh: “我们坐在地上 — — 有时候垫一块垫子，有时候就直接坐在土里。 ”
en: “We sat on the ground – sometimes on a mat, sometimes just in the dirt.”

zh: 但艾什图坚持了下来，她现在已经是一名23岁的大学生了。
en: But Aishetu persevered, and she is now a 23-year-old university student.

zh: 艾什图知道，如果不接受教育，她生命中的机会很可能仅限于放牧、耕种、结婚和生许多孩子。
en: Aishetu knows that without school, her life chances would likely be confined to herding, farming, getting married, and having a lot of children.

zh: 她根本不可能有其他的机会。
en: There simply would be no other opportunities for her to pursue.

zh: 像鼓励她学习的女教师一样，艾什图希望成为年轻女性和自家兄弟姐妹的榜样。
en: Like the female teachers who inspired her to learn, Aishetu wants to be a role model to younger girls and her own siblings.

zh: 她希望她的故事能激励他们完成自己的学业。
en: She hopes that her story will motivate them to complete their education, too.

zh: 在这样一个国际女童日，艾什图证明教育能为女童和她们身边的人带来改变。
en: On this International Day of the Girl, Aishetu stands as proof of the difference that education can make for girls and the people around them.

zh: 但艾什图克服的困难也提醒我们仍然有太多女孩无法接受教育。
en: But the struggles that Aishetu overcame also remind us that education remains beyond reach for far too many girls.

zh: 这里有一个令人震惊的数据：无法上学的女童人数尽管自2000年以来已经下降了40 % ， 但仍然保持在1.3亿。
en: Consider one appalling statistic: The number of girls not attending school, despite having fallen by 40% since 2000, still stands at 130 million.

zh: 这有助于解释为什么女性要付出比男性更多的努力才能找到有意义的报酬优厚的工作，也解释了为什么女性在全球劳动力中所占的比重持续低于男性。
en: This helps to explain why women struggle more than men to find meaningful, well-paying work, and why the share of women in the global workforce persistently lags behind that of men.

zh: 更糟的是，即使在那些女童受教育程度迅速提高的地方，女性仍然很难在就业领域实现同等的突破。
en: Making matters worse, even where girls’ educational attainment has grown rapidly, commensurate improvements for women in the workforce have remained elusive.

zh: 世界经济论坛2015年的一项研究显示 ， “ 虽然97个国家的女性大学入学率高于男性，但仅有68个国家女性技工占据多数，而仅有四个国家主要是女性领袖。 ”
en: According to a 2015 study by the World Economic Forum, “while more women than men are enrolling at university in 97 countries, women make up the majority of skilled workers in only 68 countries and the majority of leaders in only four.”

zh: 大小企业同样面临着上述性别差距带来的重大代际挑战。
en: These gender gaps represent a major generational challenge for large and small businesses alike.

zh: 在世界范围内，企业已经苦于无法找到适应日益自动化工作流程的足够数量的合格工作者。
en: Worldwide, companies are already struggling to find enough qualified workers for their increasingly automated work processes.

zh: 全球教育机会融资国际委员会去年报告近40%的雇用企业很难招到拥有合适技能的工人。
en: The International Commission for Financing Global Education Opportunity reported last year that nearly 40% of employers are having difficulties recruiting workers with the right skills.

zh: 投资于低收入国家的企业也需要员工保持良好的健康状况。
en: Businesses investing in lower-income countries also need their workers to be healthy.

zh: 如果母亲受过教育会增加这种可能性：她们和她们的家人往往比那些受教育程度较低的母亲及其家人更加健康。
en: This is more likely when mothers are educated: they and their families tend to be healthier than in the case of less educated mothers.

zh: 事实上， 研究表明如果所有育龄妇女都能接受中学教育，那么五岁以前死亡的儿童人数每年将下降约350,000人。
en: In fact, research shows that if all childbearing-age women were to complete secondary education, the number of children dying before age five would drop by about 350,000 each year.

zh: 投资于大多数失学女童所在的发展中和新兴市场国家的企业因此有意愿帮助女童接受应有的教育。
en: The businesses investing in developing- and emerging-market countries that are home to most out-of-school girls thus have an interest in helping girls get the education they deserve.

zh: 如果教育成果有所改善，我们很可能看到更多女性接受今天工作场合所要求的高水平技术培训。
en: If educational outcomes improve, we will likely see far more women pursuing the higher-level technical training that today’s workplaces are demanding.

zh: 为确保1.3亿女童入学，我们需要克服一系列顽固的障碍。
en: To put 130 million additional girls into school, we will have to overcome an array of stubborn barriers.

zh: 在许多国家，女童教育被认为并不重要，因为绝大多数人认为她们只适合在家工作，或者在家庭农场里帮忙。
en: In many countries, educating girls is not considered important, owing to expectations that they will work exclusively at home or on the family farm.

zh: 早婚、性侵犯、经期卫生条件恶劣和人道主义危机仅仅是导致女童教育比男童更加困难的某些因素。
en: Early marriage, sexual assault, a lack of sanitary facilities for menstruating girls, and humanitarian crises are just some of the factors that make completing an education more difficult for girls than for boys.

zh: 而且尤其在边远地区，学费和艰苦的通勤条件也构成了进一步的挑战。
en: And in remote areas in particular, school fees and arduous commutes pose further challenges.

zh: 即使能够克服这些文化、政治和地理障碍，富裕国家也需要为教育发展中国家女童提供比过去多得多的资源。
en: Even if these cultural, political, and geographic hurdles can be cleared, wealthier countries will need to commit far more resources to educating girls in developing economies than they have in the past.

zh: 令人震惊的是，用于教育领域的捐助国海外发展援助份额在过去六年中一直在缩减，目前从数额上看已经小于2010年。
en: Shockingly, the share of donor countries’ overseas development aid that is allocated for education has shrunk over the last six years, and is now smaller than it was in 2010.

zh: 捐助国迫切需要扭转这一趋势。
en: Donor countries urgently need to reverse that trend.

zh: 全球教育合作机构一直是过去15年来推动女童教育的主要催化剂。
en: The Global Partnership for Education has been one of the leading catalysts in educating girls over the past decade and a half.

zh: 因为全球教育合作机构的资助，从2002到2014年间发展中国家接受小学教育的女童增加了3，800万人。
en: Thanks to GPE funding, an additional 38 million girls in developing countries were enrolled in primary school from 2002 to 2014.

zh: 为了巩固这一进展，全球教育合作机构将于2018年2月8日在达喀尔召开由塞内加尔和法国政府共同主办的融资会议。
en: To build on that progress, GPE will hold a financing conference, co-hosted by the Senegalese and French governments, on February 8, 2018, in Dakar.

zh: 我们呼吁世界各地的捐助者帮我们达到截止2020年每年筹集20亿美元的目的。
en: We are appealing to donors around the world to help us reach $2 billion in annual funds by 2020.

zh: 有了足够的资金，全球教育合作机构就可以为超过80个国家8.7亿的儿童教育需求提供支持。
en: With sufficient funding, GPE can support the education needs of 870 million children in more than 80 countries.

zh: 它还可以帮助发展中国家建立教育系统，赋予艾什图这样的女孩发挥自己潜力的机遇。
en: And it can help developing countries build education systems that will give girls like Aishetu the chance to realize their potential.

zh: 在教育的助力下，女童和妇女可以而且能够更好地改变世界。
en: When girls and women are empowered through education, they can and do transform the world for the better.

zh: 在投资发挥她们的潜力方面，我们输不起。
en: Investment in their potential is a bet that can’t lose.

zh: 煤炭的不道德性
en: The Immorality of Coal

zh: 悉尼—在12月的巴黎联合国气候变化会议上形成全球协议的势头似乎正在形成。
en: SYDNEY – Momentum seems to be building for a global deal at the United Nations Climate Change Conference in Paris this December.

zh: 与这一乐观的感觉一同到来的是人们开始认识到化石燃料必须尽快在全球范围内停用。
en: With this sense of optimism comes a keen awareness that the use of fossil fuels must be phased out globally as rapidly as possible.

zh: 尽管取得了这些进步，但有一个部门仍然迟迟没有动作。
en: In the face of this progress, though, one sector stands apart.

zh: 煤炭业似乎铁了心要赚钱而不顾全球环境。
en: The coal industry seems determined to fight for profits at the expense of the global environment.

zh: 该行业宣称煤炭对于结束能源贫困来说至关重要，以此顽固地试图占据道德高点。
en: Perversely, it is furiously attempting to capture the moral high ground by claiming that coal is essential to ending energy poverty.

zh: 煤炭公司及其盟友指出，限制煤炭产量将使贫穷国家无法建设大型廉价发电站，导致农村地区无法使用电灯。
en: Coal companies and their allies argue that limiting coal production would keep the lights off in rural communities by preventing poor countries from building big, cheap power plants.

zh: "在全球变暖政策基金会（Global Warming Policy Foundation，质疑气候变化的智库机构）主办的一次活动中，英国前环境大臣欧文·帕特森（Owen Patterson）指责气候变化活动家双手沾满了“非洲的血液 " 。
en: Speaking at an event hosted by the Global Warming Policy Foundation, a think tank that is skeptical of climate change, the United Kingdom's former environment secretary, Owen Paterson, accused climate-change activists of having “African blood" on their hands.

zh: 姑且不谈这些试图平息批评的言论的巨大的冒犯性，煤炭业正在营造一个错误的选择：结束使用煤炭还是结束贫困。
en: Setting aside the deeply offensive character of such efforts to silence its critics, the coal industry is posing a false choice: end the use of coal or end poverty.

zh: 但是，尽管能源确实是结束贫困的核心手段，但有一点必须澄清：在历史的现阶段，煤炭对所有人都没有好处。
en: But, though energy is indeed central to efforts to end poverty, one must be clear: at this point in history, coal is not good for anyone.

zh: 考虑以下事实：近几个月来，埃博拉病毒吸引了巨大的关注，但煤炭是比埃博拉凶险得多的杀手。
en: Consider this: for all of the attention the Ebola virus has received in recent months, coal is a far deadlier killer.

zh: 北京正在进行的治霾之战 — — 这一问题被称为“空气启示录 " — —强有力地证明了煤炭对空气质量的影响。
en: Beijing's ongoing battle with smog – a problem that has become known as the “airpocalypse" – provides a potent reminder of coal's impact on air quality.

zh: 但在这方面中国首都绝不是一个人在战斗。
en: But China's capital is hardly unique in that respect.

zh: 许多印度城市空气污染与北京差不多，有的甚至远远过之。
en: Many Indian cities have air pollution that is just as bad – and in some cases far worse.

zh: 煤炭业正在试图让发展中国家背上让地球站在气候灾难边缘的不可持续增长模式。
en: The coal industry is seeking to burden developing countries with the same unsustainable growth model that has brought the earth to the brink of climate disaster.

zh: 燃烧化石燃料的可怕后果已开始缠上我们，而受影响最大的正是穷人。
en: The terrible consequences of burning fossil fuels are already upon us, and those suffering the most are the world's poor.

zh: 大部分人都明白煤炭是一个肮脏的行业，为了自身经济福祉，也为了全球气候，澳大利亚等国家应该放弃这一行业。
en: Most people understand that coal is a dirty business, one that countries like Australia should abandon for their own economic wellbeing, as well as for the sake of the global climate.

zh: 这也是我们看到对该行业抵制如此巨大的原因。
en: That is why we are witnessing such resistance from the industry.

zh: 煤炭时代已经过去了，但它还死命做着困兽之斗。
en: Coal's day is over, but it is trying desperately to hang on.

zh: 世界需要快速而公平地远离肮脏能源资源。
en: The world needs a rapid and fair transition away from dirty energy sources.

zh: 这意味着清理发达经济体并致力于防止伤害我们的集体健康和未来的行业的大幅扩张。
en: That means cleaning up developed economies and working to prevent the massive expansion of industries that damage our collective health and future.

zh: 这也意味着与发展中国家合作帮助它们开发现代清洁能源资源以提供廉价的地方生产电力，更不能强迫它们购买化石燃料。
en: It also means working with developing countries to help them develop modern, clean energy sources that provide cheap, locally produced power, and do not oblige them to buy fossil fuels.

zh: 最重要的是，这意味着我们必须停止告诉发展中国家的穷人他们应该做什么，而应该倾听他们要什么。
en: Above all, it means that we must stop telling the poor in developing countries what they should do and start listening to what they want.

zh: 他们要的是 — — 对煤炭业来说，这是个不行的消息 — — 清洁、廉价的能源，让他们能够在不破坏未来的情况下现在就获得电力。
en: And what they want – unfortunately for the coal industry – is clean, affordable energy that powers their present, without costing them their future.

zh: 欧洲的可卡因问题
en: Coke Is It in Europe

zh: 欧洲的领导人们需要严肃对待欧洲的可卡因问题。
en: European leaders need to get serious about Europe’s cocaine problem.

zh: 正有越来越多的欧洲人拜倒在这位“白夫人”的魅惑之下，继续否认这种情况只会产生更严重的后果。
en: The “white lady” is seducing a steadily growing number of Europeans, and remaining in a state of denial will only worsen the consequences.

zh: 可卡因曾经是美国的问题，直到美国在城市里开始了针对其贩卖者和消费者的攻坚战，受打击的对象还有安第斯山区的运毒者和供应商。
en: Cocaine used to be America’s problem, to the point that the United States started a major campaign against sellers and consumers of crack cocaine in the inner cities, drug traffickers, and suppliers in the Andes.

zh: 但现在全世界大多数地方对可卡因的需求平稳或呈下降之势。
en: But now demand for cocaine in most of the world is stable or dropping.

zh: 在过去五年里，古柯的种植被削减了四分之一，而可卡因的查获量几乎翻了一番。
en: Coca cultivation has been slashed by a quarter in the past five years, and seizures of cocaine have almost doubled.

zh: 2005年全世界42%的可卡因都被查获，着实战绩斐然。
en: An impressive 42% of all of the world’s cocaine was seized in 2005.

zh: 只有欧洲在逆流而行。
en: Only Europe is bucking the trend.

zh: 可卡因的使用呈上升之势，特别在西班牙、英国和意大利。
en: Cocaine use is on the rise, especially in Spain, Great Britain, and Italy.

zh: 有许多非正式的证据表明在纸钞和供水中都发现了可卡因的踪迹。
en: There is plenty of anecdotal evidence indicating traces of cocaine found on bank notes and in water supplies.

zh: 还有更严酷的事实。
en: Here are some harder facts.

zh: 西班牙的可卡因使用度—占该国15至64岁人口的3 % - -首次超过了美国。
en: For the first time, the level of cocaine use in Spain – 3% of the population aged 15 to 64 – now exceeds that in the US.

zh: 英国也不甘落后。
en: And the United Kingdom is not far behind.

zh: 在2005年，有2.4%的英国人至少吸食过一次可卡因，比十年前的0.6%有大幅上升。
en: In 2005, 2.4% of the UK population used cocaine at least once, up sharply from 0.6% a decade earlier.

zh: 再看看另一个颇具说明性的指标。
en: Consider another telling indicator.

zh: 十年前，荷兰20%首次接受脱毒治疗的人是可卡因上瘾。
en: Ten years ago, 20% of all new clients entering treatment for drug abuse in the Netherlands were addicted to cocaine.

zh: 而现在这一比例达40 % 。
en: Now it is 40%.

zh: 在西班牙，这一比例从1995年的仅7%攀升到2002年的42 % - -而自那以后肯定还在上升。
en: In Spain, the proportion has soared to 42% in 2002, from just 7% in 1995 – and it has no doubt risen again since then.

zh: 欧洲日趋严重的可卡因问题背后有几个重要因素。
en: Europe’s growing cocaine problem is due to several factors.

zh: 首先，欧洲的吸毒者正从消费海洛因转而吸食可卡因。
en: First, drug users in Europe are switching to cocaine from heroin.

zh: 可卡因的流行是因为它的吸引力：白色，不是暗色；吸食，不用注射；能在起居室或时尚的夜店中消费，而不用屈身穷街陋巷。
en: Cocaine is fashionable because it is attractive: white, not dark; sniffed, not injected; consumed in a living room or a fashionable night-club, not in a dark alley.

zh: 它被看作是胜利者的毒品而不是失败者的毒品。
en: It is seen as a drug for winners, not losers.

zh: 对许多人来说直到身体受损住院或接受戒毒治疗之前，它都是成功的象征。
en: To many it is a symbol of success, until they end up in a hospital or treatment center.

zh: 演艺大腕、公司主管、模特和刻意炫耀这一违法习惯的社交名流使用可卡因当然是在推波助澜。
en: Cocaine use by high-profile entertainers, executives, models, and socialites who flaunt their illicit drug habit certainly does not help.

zh: 媒体对此不加批判的报道也有误导之嫌。
en: Nor does uncritical reporting by the media.

zh: 看起来许多欧洲人都需要被提醒一下：可卡因是种高成瘾性和危害性的毒品。
en: It seems many Europeans need to be reminded that cocaine is highly addictive and harmful.

zh: 这也就是它为什么是受控物质的原因。
en: That is why it is a controlled substance.

zh: 尽管隐君子们可能会否认，认为自己能够控制“娱乐式的吸食 ” ， 但可卡因，引用J.J. Cale的那首著名歌曲来说 ， “ 她不撒谎。 ”
en: While addicts may be in denial, thinking that they can control their “recreational use,” cocaine, to quote the famous song by J.J. Cale, “she don’t lie.”

zh: 其次，许多国家的政府—特别是富国的政府—没能投入足够的政治资本来防止和 处理滥用毒品。
en: Second, too many governments – particularly in rich countries – fail to invest political capital in preventing and treating drug abuse.

zh: 他们没有足够的资源来应对这个问题，所以它们社会发生的毒品问题是自食其果。
en: They are ill equipped to deal with the problem, so their societies have the drug problem they deserve.

zh: 这就提出了一个基本可信度的问题：欧洲怎么能在自身的毒瘾驱动（古柯）种植的情况下敦促哥伦比亚和秘鲁减少供应量呢？
en: This raises a basic credibility issue: how can Europe urge Colombia and Peru to reduce supply when its own drug habit is driving cultivation?

zh: 解决之道是在问题的源头着手从供需两方面双管齐下。
en: The solution is to attack the problem at its source by addressing both supply and demand.

zh: 拉丁美洲的古柯种植需要用农作物来代替。 可卡因在富裕的欧洲的消费量必须降低。
en: Coca crops in Latin America need to be replaced with agricultural crops, and cocaine use in affluent Europe must be reduced.

zh: 解决可卡因问题是一个共同的责任。
en: Solving the cocaine problem is a shared responsibility.

zh: 在供应方面，必须对毒品生产国的贫困农民提供支持，给予他们种植古柯之外的其它可行的替代方案。
en: On the supply side, there must be more support for poor farmers in drug-producing countries to give them viable alternatives to growing coca.

zh: 大多数非法的古柯种植者都是极为贫困的。
en: Most illicit coca growers are extremely poor.

zh: 如果没有合法的经济作物来替代毒品，那么长期来看铲除古柯种植的成效不会显著。
en: Crop eradication will not work over the long term if there is no legal economy to replace drugs.

zh: 毒品控制和发展援助必须齐头并进。
en: Drug control and development assistance must therefore go hand in hand.

zh: 环境保护也是一个问题。
en: Environmental protection is also at issue.

zh: 古柯种植者和生产者砍伐并烧毁森林，用有毒化学物质污染水流并破坏脆弱的生态系统。
en: Coca farmers and producers slash and burn forests, polluting streams with toxic chemicals and damaging fragile ecosystems.

zh: 安第斯地区只有全世界1%的土地，但却拥有世界上15%的植物。
en: The Andean region has less than 1% of the world’s land area, but more than 15% of its plant life.

zh: 大面积的植被正被破坏以便生产这种白色粉末。
en: Vast areas of vegetation are being destroyed for lines of white powder.

zh: 在我们日益关注气候变化的今天，欧洲人应该更加清楚地认识到这种为了短时间的快感而对宝贵且脆弱的生态环境造成的长期毁坏。
en: At a time of growing concern about climate change, Europeans should be made aware of the long-term destruction done to a precious and fragile habitat for the sake of a short-term high.

zh: 但控制供应是不够的。
en: But controlling supply is not enough.

zh: 如果哥伦比亚的农民明天就停止种植古柯，那么全世界1300万可卡因吸食者不受限制的需求很快就能在其它的什么地方刺激并恢复古柯的种植。
en: If all of Colombia’s farmers stopped growing coca tomorrow, unrestrained demand by the world’s 13 million cocaine users would quickly generate as much cultivation somewhere else.

zh: 显然，终极的挑战是防止滥用毒品并成功地治疗并改造其使用者。
en: Clearly, the ultimate challenge is to prevent drug abuse and to treat and rehabilitate drug users successfully.

zh: 瑞典在这方面是一个成功的典范。
en: Sweden is a good example of how to do it right.

zh: 该国的毒品使用量只有欧洲平均水平的三分之一—这是实行几十年严惩毒贩与为吸毒者提供综合脱毒治疗的连续政策（不论政府如何更替）的成果。
en: Drug use there is a third of the European average – the result of decades of consistent policies (irrespective of changes in government) that combine tough punishment of dealers and comprehensive treatment for users.

zh: 我们在防止人们对可卡因上瘾方面做得越多，这些人对他们自身以及他们家庭所造成的危害就越小，流进犯罪分子、叛乱分子和恐怖分子口袋里的钱就越少，对环境的破坏也就越小。
en: The more that can be done to prevent people from becoming cocaine addicts, the less damage these people will do to themselves and their families, the less money will get into the pockets of criminals, insurgents, and terrorists, and the less damage will be done to the environment.

zh: 但除非欧洲彻底清醒并面对自身的毒品瘟疫，否则它就会无所作为。
en: But nothing will be done until Europe wakes up and faces its pandemic.

zh: 冷战经验布什可资汲取
en: Cold War Lessons for George W. Bush

zh: 布什总统最近把当前反对暴力化的圣战恐怖主义斗争同冷战相提并论。
en: President Bush recently drew an analogy between the current struggle against violent jihadi terrorism and the Cold War.

zh: 在一个方面他是正确的，那就是恐怖主义之潮是跨越年代的。
en: He is right in one respect: waves of terrorism tend to be generational.

zh: 不幸的是，像冷战一样，当前的“反恐战争”恐怕不是几年，而是几十年才能结束的。
en: Unfortunately, like the Cold War, the current “war on terror” is likely to be a matter of decades, not years.

zh: 但是，布什在他的比喻当中错过了一个隐含的经验，那就是使用文化的柔性力量的重要性。
en: But Bush missed another lesson implicit in his analogy: the importance of using the soft power of culture.

zh: 冷战是通过威慑苏联侵略的军事力量以及引人入胜的西方文化和观念的力量相结合而赢得的。
en: The Cold War was won by a combination of military power, which deterred Soviet aggression, and the attractive power of Western culture and ideas.

zh: 当1989年柏林墙倒塌时，是锤子和推土机，而非弹药将它推倒。
en: When the Berlin Wall fell in 1989, hammers and bulldozers, not artillery, brought it down.

zh: 不幸的是，布什并未汲取这一经验。
en: Unfortunately, Bush has not learned this lesson.

zh: 冷战期间的学术和科技交流在提升美国的柔性力量上发挥了重要作用。
en: Academic and scientific exchanges during the Cold War played a significant role in enhancing American soft power.

zh: 一些美国的怀疑论派者担心苏联科学家和克格勃间谍会盗取美国技术，但是他们却并没有注意到，苏联的访客们将科学机密连同政治观念一道吸纳进去。
en: While some American skeptics feared that Soviet scientists and KGB agents would steal American technology, they failed to notice that the visitors vacuumed up political ideas alongside scientific secrets.

zh: 这些科学家中的许多人成为苏联主要的人权和自由化鼓吹者。
en: Many of these scientists became leading proponents of human rights and liberalization inside the USSR.

zh: 1958年到1985年期间，大约5万名苏联作家、记者、官员、音乐家、舞蹈家、运动员和学者访问了美国。
en: Some 50,000 Soviets – writers, journalists, officials, musicians, dancers, athletes, and academics – visited the United States between 1958 and 1988.

zh: 亚利山大·亚科夫列夫1958年在哥伦比亚大学进修期间深受影响。
en: Aleksandr Yakovlev was strongly influenced by his studies at Columbia University in 1958.

zh: 他后来成为政治局委员和对米哈伊尔·戈尔巴乔夫施加自由化影响的关键人物。
en: Yakovlev went on to become a Politburo member and key liberalizing influence on Mikhail Gorbachev.

zh: 后来成为克格勃高官的奥列格·卡留金在1997年回忆说 ： “ 交流成为苏联的特洛伊木马，在侵蚀苏联制度上发挥了重要作用。
en: Oleg Kalugin, who became a high KGB official, said in looking back from the vantage point of 1997, “Exchanges were a Trojan Horse for the Soviet Union.

zh: 多年来，交流影响了越来越多的人。
en: They played a tremendous role in the erosion of the Soviet system….They kept infecting more and more people over the years.”

zh: ”但是今天，布什当局却实施烦琐的签证制度，削减了此类交流，特别是同穆斯林国家交流的数量。
en: Yet today, the Bush administration oversees a cumbersome visa program that has cut the number of such exchanges, particularly with Muslim countries.

zh: 冷战期间，大众流行文化也很重要。
en: Popular culture was also important during the Cold War.

zh: 由于其商业主义浓厚，许多知识分子对此不屑一顾。
en: Many intellectuals disdain popular culture because of its crude commercialism.

zh: 但是，这种鄙视却不得要领，因为大众娱乐时常包含有关个性、消费者选择以及其他具有重要政治影响的价值观念的图象和信息。
en: But such scorn is misplaced, because popular entertainment often contains subtle images and messages about individualism, consumer choice, and other values that have important political effects.

zh: 例如，美国电影包含性、暴力以及物质主义，但这并非美国电影的全部内容。
en: American films, for example, include sex, violence, and materialism, but that is not the whole story.

zh: 它们还展现开放、流动、个性、反对权势、多样性以及自由的美国生活。
en: They also portray American life as open, mobile, individualistic, anti-establishment, pluralist, populist, and free.

zh: 正如诗人卡尔·桑博格在1962年所说的那样 ： “ 什么？ 好莱坞比哈佛大学还重要？
en: As the poet Carl Sandburg put it in 1961: “What, Hollywood’s more important than Harvard?

zh: 回答是：不像哈佛那样干净，但更引人入胜。 ”
en: The answer is, not as clean as Harvard, but nevertheless, further reaching.”

zh: 信息和娱乐的区别从来没有像一些知识分子所想象得那样明晰，而且区别正在变得模糊。
en: The line between information and entertainment has never been as sharp as some intellectuals imagine, and it is becoming increasingly blurred.

zh: 一些流行音乐歌词可以含有政治影响。
en: Some popular music lyrics can have political effects.

zh: 文化信息也可以像体育队伍或明星一样，或者由电视或电影传播的多种多样的图象来传播。
en: Cultural messages can also be conveyed by the way that sports teams or stars conduct themselves, or in the multiple images purveyed by television or cinema.

zh: 图象往往比文字更为有力地传播价值观念。
en: Pictures often convey values more powerfully than words.

zh: 甚至连消费快餐也可以有隐含的表现。
en: Even the consumption of fast food can make an implicit statement.

zh: 正如一个印度人家庭描述他们吃麦当劳一样，他们是为了品尝“美国生活的只鳞片爪”而去的。
en: As one Indian family described their visit to McDonald’s, it was stepping out for “a slice of America.”

zh: 尽管苏联限制和审查西方电影，但是那些通过了审查的电影具有毁灭性的政治影响力。
en: Although the Soviet Union restricted and censored Western films, those that made it through had devastating political effects.

zh: 正如一位苏联记者在观看内部放映的批评美国核武器政策的电影后所评论地那样 ： “ 我们绝对大吃一惊。 我们开始理解，在一场核战争中，灾难会降临到他们的头上，也会降临到我们的头上。
en: As one Soviet journalist commented after a restricted showing of films that were critical of American nuclear weapons policies, “They absolutely shocked us….We began to understand that the same thing would happen to us as to them in a nuclear war.”

zh: 苏联观众观看不含政治主题的电影时，还能够知道西方人并不需要排长队买东西，并不是住在集体宿舍中，他们还有自己的汽车。
en: Soviet audiences watching films with apolitical themes nonetheless learned that people in the West did not have to stand in long lines to purchase food, did not live in communal apartments, and owned their own cars.

zh: 所有这些都驳斥了苏联媒体宣扬的负面观点。
en: All of this discredited the negative views promulgated by the Soviet media.

zh: 甚至连摇滚乐也发挥作用。
en: Even rock and roll played a part.

zh: 戈尔巴乔夫的一位顾问后来作证说 ： “ 我们听重金属乐队。 这样，我们一方面顺从“体制”的大部分要求，另一方面不动声色地拒绝它。
en: As one of Gorbachev’s aides later testified, “The Beatles were our quiet way of rejecting ‘the system’ while conforming to most of its demands.”

zh: ”上世纪五十年代，捷克共产党官员把一群年轻人判刑入狱，罪名是播放“腐朽的美国音乐 ” ， 但是，他们这样做却适得其反。
en: Czech Communist officials sentenced a group of young people to prison in the 1950’s for playing tapes of “decadent American music,” but their efforts turned out to be counter-productive.

zh: 当1980年���翰·列农被谋杀后，他的一座雕像立即出现在布拉格，每年他的遇难纪念日时都有要求和平和民主的游行。
en: In 1980, after John Lennon was murdered, a monument to him spontaneously appeared in Prague, and the anniversary of his death was marked by an annual procession for peace and democracy.

zh: 1988年，组织者们成立了列农和平俱乐部，要求苏联军队撤离。
en: In 1988, the organizers founded a Lennon Peace Club that demanded the removal of Soviet troops.

zh: 此时，列农战胜了列宁。
en: Lennon trumped Lenin.

zh: 刚柔并济赢得了冷战。
en: The Cold War was won by a mixture of hard and soft power.

zh: 并非所有的柔性力量都源于美国，看看英国广播公司和重金属乐队就知道了。
en: Not all of the sources of soft power were American – witness the role of the BBC and the Beatles.

zh: 但是，忽视流行文化发挥的作用将是一个错误。
en: But it would be a mistake to ignore the role that popular culture played.

zh: 以史为鉴应当小心谨慎。
en: One has to be careful in drawing lessons for today.

zh: 与穆斯林文化相比，东欧文化更接近于西欧文化。
en: Eastern European cultures were more similar to Western cultures than are Muslim cultures.

zh: 在某些原教旨主义者和恐怖份子眼中，西方文化并无吸引力，而是令人反感。
en: In some fundamentalist circles, and among the terrorists, Western culture evokes repulsion, not attraction.

zh: 伊朗的统治毛拉们把美国描绘为“邪恶撒旦 ” 。 但是，即使在那里，年轻人仍然想在家里偷偷地观看美国电影录像。
en: But even in Iran, where the ruling mullahs describe America as “the great Satan,” the young want to watch American videos in the privacy of their homes.

zh: 穆斯林世界的民意调查显示，美国文化对于温和的大多数人而言是有吸引力的。
en: Polls in the Muslim world show that American culture remains attractive to the moderate majority.

zh: 是美国的政策导致了美国不受欢迎。
en: It is American policies that have led to America’s unpopularity.

zh: 作为起始，布什应当努力鼓励更为大众化的基层接触联络。
en: For a start, Bush could learn to get out of the way and encourage more popular and grassroots contacts.

zh: 如何战胜儿童癌症
en: How to Beat Childhood Cancer

zh: 费城 — — 对父母而言，或许没有比疾病或意外丧子更为深刻的恐惧。
en: PHILADELPHIA – For a parent, there is perhaps no greater fear than the prospect of losing a child to illness or accident.

zh: 儿童癌症最有可能将遥远的恐惧变为难以想象的现实。
en: And it is childhood cancer that has the greatest potential to catapult a remote fear into an unimaginable reality.

zh: 作为一名照顾患癌儿童及其家属超过25年的儿科肿瘤学家，我知道只有面对癌症诊断的家长才能真正理解这种深不见底的恐惧，因为它触动了我们身为家长的价值核心。
en: As a pediatric oncologist, having cared for children with cancer and their families for more than 25 years, I know that only a parent who has confronted such a diagnosis truly understands the depth of this fear, as it touches the core of who we are as parents.

zh: 我也知道我们治疗的儿童更多，疗效更好 — — 而且未来还可能进一步提升。
en: I also know that we are treating more children more effectively than ever before – and that we can do much better still.

zh: 对20世纪60年代出生的孩子而言，被诊断出患有最常见的儿童癌症急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）         其存活率不到10 % ， 也就是说患儿几乎必死无疑。
en: For a child born in the 1960’s, the diagnosis of the most common form of childhood cancer, acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), meant almost certain death, with a survival rate of less than 10%.

zh: 而今天诊断出相同疾病的儿童治愈率却超过80 % 。
en: A child with the same diagnosis today has a better than 80% chance of being cured.

zh: 回顾白血病患儿从20世纪70年代到90年代的五年存活率可以看到治愈率几乎呈直线上升。
en: Looking at the five-year survival rates for children with ALL from the 1970’s through the 1990’s, one sees an almost linear improvement in cure rates.

zh: 20世纪70、80、90年代因此成为名副其实的加速探索和治疗发展期。
en: This makes the 1970s, 1980’s, and 1990’s look like an era of accelerating discovery and therapeutic development.

zh: 但今天治疗癌症患儿的药物几乎都是在20世纪50、60年代发明并通过审批的。
en: But virtually all of the drugs that we use today to cure children with cancer were discovered and approved in the 1950’s and 1960’s.

zh: 因此人们不禁要问，推动四十年突飞猛进的不是新药又是什么因素？
en: So, if new drugs did not fuel four decades of progress, what did?

zh: 卓有成效的持续科学合作是主要推动力。
en: A major driver was a remarkable, sustained scientific collaboration.

zh: 20世纪50年代临床科学家认为因为儿童癌症是一种罕见疾病，没有单一哪个医疗中心有能力研究足够的患者样本以推动儿科肿瘤的进步。
en: In the 1950’s, a group of clinical scientists recognized that, because childhood cancer was a rare disease, no single medical center could study enough patients to make the necessary advances across the spectrum of pediatric oncologic diseases.

zh: 多机构合作研究决策带来了合作团队研究的推进。
en: The decision to conduct collaborative research across multiple institutions resulted in the development of cooperative group research.

zh: 在与儿童癌症的斗争中，这一理念逐渐演变为目前的儿童肿瘤团体（COG ） ， 将横跨北美、澳大利亚、新西兰和欧洲部分地区200余家顶级儿童医院、大学及癌症中心的8，000余名相关专家聚集在一起。
en: In the fight against childhood cancer, this concept evolved into what is now the Children’s Oncology Group (COG), which unites more than 8,000 experts at more than 200 leading children’s hospitals, universities, and cancer centers across North America, Australia, New Zealand, and parts of Europe.

zh: 儿童肿瘤团体对儿童罹患的各种癌症进行研究，有100余项临床试验正在世界各地进行。
en: The COG conducts research across the spectrum of cancers that afflict children, and has approximately 100 clinical trials underway around the world.

zh: 随着合作研究基础构造的逐步建立，研究结果持续改善部分反映出对儿童癌症多元化的理解越来越深。
en: With an emerging infrastructure in place for cooperative research, sustained improvement in outcomes partly reflected an ever-increasing understanding that childhood cancers are diverse.

zh: 举例来讲，儿童急性淋巴细胞白血病并非某个单一病种，而是一系列疾病的组合。
en: Childhood ALL, for example, is not a single disease, but rather a spectrum of diseases.

zh: 对上述多样性的认识导致针对罹患相似病理性癌症的不同患儿群体开展差异化的治疗方法研究。
en: Recognition of this diversity led to the study of different treatment regimens in different sub-populations of children with pathologically similar cancers.

zh: 在此期间，克服骨髓抑制（即导致血细胞计数减少）这种最常见的抗癌药物副作用的技术得到了显著提高。
en: Throughout this period, the ability to overcome the most common side effect of cancer drugs, myelosuppression (a decrease in blood counts), improved dramatically.

zh: 现在可以将红血球和血小板同时输入到贫血患者体内，从而缓解癌症治疗引发的危及生命的出血现象。
en: It began with the ability to transfuse not only red blood cells into anemic patients, but also platelets, reducing the threat of life-threatening bleeding that can accompany cancer therapy.

zh: 对有生命危险的骨髓抑制感染类型及风险的认识越来越普遍，进而导致抗生素的研发及应用效率提高。
en: Equally important, the risks and types of life-threatening infections that come with myelosuppression were increasingly recognized, leading to the development and better use of more effective antibiotics.

zh: 20世纪90年代，刺激骨髓生成抗感染白细胞的细胞激素开始用于癌症治疗，进一步降低了危及生命的感染并发症的护理危险性。
en: Starting in the 1990’s, cytokines, drugs that stimulate bone marrow to produce infection-fighting white blood cells, began to be integrated into cancer treatments, further mitigating the risk of life-threatening infectious complications of care.

zh: 由于上文提到的科学及辅助治疗成果，同样的化疗药物可以更有效地治疗指定类型及细分类型的癌症儿童。
en: As a result of these advances in science and supportive care, the same chemotherapeutic drugs could be delivered much more intensively for children with select types and sub-types of cancer.

zh: 治愈率随着选择性强化开始稳步上升。
en: With selective intensification, cure rates began to increase steadily.

zh: 尽管上述策略的确改善了治疗效果，但治疗所引发的急性及长期发病率一直居高不下。
en: And yet, while this strategy has indeed resulted in better outcomes, the acute and long-term morbidity of therapy has been substantial.

zh: 罹患高风险癌症并接受高剂量化疗的儿童在治疗期间有超过80%概率会遭受一次以上危及生命或致命的严重药物毒性损伤。
en: Children with high-risk cancers who receive dose-intensive chemotherapy have a greater than 80% chance of experiencing at least one severe, life-threatening, or fatal drug-related toxic event over the course of their treatment.

zh: 癌症治疗的后期影响包括永久性器官组织损伤、激素生殖功能减退及癌症复发。
en: The late effects of cancer treatment include permanent organ and tissue damage, hormonal and reproductive dysfunction, and second cancers.

zh: 估计330,000名美国癌症幸存儿童中超过40%患有儿童癌症及治疗引发的严重健康并发症。
en: More than 40% of the estimated 330,000 survivors of childhood cancer in the United States experience a significant health-related complication from childhood cancer and its treatment.

zh: 并且虽然取得了重大进步，但癌症在发达国家仍然是造成一岁以上儿童因病死亡最首要的原因。
en: And, despite our advances, cancer in developed countries remains the leading cause of death from disease in children older than one year.

zh: 但我们正在迎来前所未有的发现时代。
en: We are, however, entering an era of unprecedented discovery.

zh: 我们目前所掌握的发现儿童癌症机制的强大研究工具��以从根本上改变对癌症患儿的治疗。
en: The powerful research tools that we now have to uncover the underlying basis of childhood cancers could fundamentally change how we treat children with these dreaded diseases.

zh: 有些儿童癌症新药可以直接针对恶性肿瘤根本驱动因素发挥作用。
en: For a limited number of childhood cancers, there are new drugs that can target the fundamental drivers of malignancy.

zh: 最明显的例子是格列卫（甲磺酸伊马替尼）在罹患儿童白血病罕见亚型（费城染色体阳性急性淋巴细胞白血病）的儿童身上取得了令人振奋的疗效。
en: The most notable example is the impact of Gleevec (imatinib mesylate) on outcomes for children with an uncommon subtype of leukemia – Philadelphia chromosome-positive ALL.

zh: 在高剂量化疗中添加这种抑制剂已经让患儿的治疗前景显著改善，并将三年无并发症存活率从35%提高到80 % 。
en: The addition of this inhibitor to intensive chemotherapy has dramatically improved the outlook for these children, increasing the rate of three-year event-free survival from 35% to 80%.

zh: 针对性的新药研发可能影响其他儿童癌症亚型的治疗效果，包括间变性大细胞淋巴瘤和其他类型的白血病。
en: The development of targeted new agents is likely to affect outcomes for other subtypes of childhood cancer, including anaplastic large-cell lymphoma and other types of leukemias.

zh: 鉴于儿童癌症的罕见或超罕见性，生物制药业投入资源研制新药的可能性即使最乐观估计也非常有限。
en: Given that childhood cancers are all rare or ultra-rare diseases, the ability of the biopharmaceutical industry to invest resources into development of new treatments is limited at best.

zh: 但确定各种儿童癌症的潜在目标又离不开研究工作。
en: Yet research is needed to identify potential targets for the entire spectrum of childhood cancers.

zh: 在某些潜在目标领域，研发新的治疗方法需要展开公私合作。
en: For some potential targets, public-private partnerships will be needed to develop new therapeutic approaches.

zh: 过去40年已经显示出科研合作可观的投资回报。
en: The past 40 years have demonstrated the remarkable return on investment to be gained in collaborative scientific research.

zh: 现在我们必须充分利用现有的科学机遇并投入资源研发疗效更强、毒性更小的治疗方法，从而提高所有儿童的癌症疗效。
en: Now we must leverage current scientific opportunities and invest the resources needed to develop more effective, less toxic therapies, thereby improving outcomes for all children with cancer.

zh: 哥伦比亚与国际危机
en: Colombia and the International Crisis

zh: 波哥大—仅仅在五个月前，哥伦比亚政府还向其国民保证他们没有受到国际危机的影响。
en: BOGOTA – Just five months ago, Colombia’s government was assuring its citizens that they were protected from the international crisis.

zh: 而现在，分析家们却预言该国经济今年几乎连1%都增长不到。 而这还是最坏的预测。
en: Now, analysts predict that the economy will barely grow 1% this year, and that is the best case scenario.

zh: 这一暗淡的预测标志着哥伦比亚三十年以来最长的一个增长周期的结束，并陷入和许多其他发展中经济体一样脆弱的境地。
en: This bleak forecast marks the end of Colombia’s longest cycle of growth in three decades, leaving the country in the same fragile situation as that of many other developing economies.

zh: 当然，经济恶化并非哥伦比亚一家。
en: Of course, a deteriorating economy is not exclusive to Colombia.

zh: 自从去年中期开始，国际货币基金组织就已经开始调低对整个拉美经济增长的预期。
en: Since the middle of last year, the International Monetary Fund has been reducing its projections for growth across Latin America.

zh: 去年十月，该组织预测该地区今年的增长率会达到3.2 % ； 现在，它却说很可能为负增长。
en: Last October, the Fund estimated that growth in the region would reach 3.2% this year; now, it says that growth will barely be positive.

zh: 而且最糟糕的情况也许还没有发生：如果奥巴马政府不能在未来几周成功地稳定美国经济，拉美很可能还会面临更为严峻的经济下滑局面。
en: And, most likely, the worst is yet to come: if the Obama administration does not succeed in stabilizing the United States economy in the coming weeks, Latin America will most likely face even steeper declines.

zh: 对哥伦比亚而言，好消息是它的经济形势比邻国要好。
en: The good news for Colombia is that it is better off than many of its neighbors.

zh: 虽然在如此令人忧心的形势下预测具体经济数据毫无意义，但大多数分析家都预测哥伦比亚今年的经济表现将不如秘鲁，而与智利和巴西相当，但要好于阿根廷、委内瑞拉和墨西哥。 据预测墨西哥的经济规模将会萎缩2%以上。
en: Although projecting concrete figures is a sterile exercise in these worrisome times, most analysts predict that Colombia’s economic performance this year will be inferior to Peru’s, but similar to Chile’s and Brazil’s and better than that of Argentina, Venezuela, and Mexico, a country expected to contract by more than 2%.

zh: 这种相对良好的形势反映了哥伦比亚较为有利的宏观经济环境。
en: This comparatively benign situation reflects Colombia’s relatively favorable macroeconomic conditions.

zh: 虽然该国从未向其政府所声称的那样免受全球经济衰退之苦，但它确实得益于一些能够减轻国际经济危机所造成的破坏的因素。 特别是考虑到在对外融资如此艰难的情况下，对外汇的持有。
en: Although the country was never as protected from the global downturn as its authorities claimed, the country benefits from some factors that do help ease the damage inflicted by the international crisis, especially with regard to the availability of foreign currency in these times of restrictions on external financing.

zh: 在过去的几年中，哥伦比亚已经成为拉美最具吸引力的三个外资投资目的地之一。 这就使得该国今年的外来投资在很大程度上能够满足对外融资的需求。
en: During the past few years, Colombia has become one of the three most attractive destinations for foreign investment in Latin America, allowing it to cover a significant part of its external financing needs this year.

zh: 另外，在国外工作的哥伦比亚人汇入该国的款额在2008年增长了8 % 。 与外币汇入额已经下降的墨西哥和厄瓜多尔相比，这一结果颇令人意外。
en: Moreover, remittances by Colombians working abroad grew 8% in 2008, a surprising result when compared to countries such as Mexico and Ecuador, where remittances have fallen.

zh: 此外，国际金融市场普遍认为哥伦比亚经济的基本面是健康的。
en: In addition, international financial markets perceive Colombia’s economy as being fundamentally sound.

zh: 政府借贷目前所支付的风险差额与秘鲁和巴西相当，而比阿根廷、委内瑞拉和厄瓜多尔所需支付的要少得多。
en: The current risk premium for government borrowing in international markets is very similar to that paid by Peru and Brazil, and much less than that demanded of Argentina, Venezuela, and Ecuador.

zh: 然而，虽然哥伦比亚的情况没有其邻国那么糟糕，但它想要自己摆脱危机也并非易事。
en: But, while Colombia is not as bad off as some of its neighbors, the country will not be able to pull itself out of the crisis easily.

zh: 不幸的是，在应对国际经济危机所造成的损害方面，该国政府并没有多少失误的余地。
en: Unfortunately, the authorities do not have much margin for error in working to counteract the damage done by the international crisis.

zh: 该国政府在经济景气的时候并没有预留资源，因此它现在就缺少像其他国家政府那样实施积极的公共开支刺激计划所必需的财政空间。
en: The government did not set aside resources while things were going well, and now it does not have the fiscal space needed for an aggressive boost to public spending of the type that many other governments are attempting.

zh: 虽然哥伦比亚政府在数周前宣布了一项基于重要基础设施工程的战略，但其作用将会是有限的：大多数投资项目已经纳入了去年的预算，且负责公共工程的官员在执行大型项目时总是表现出低效率。
en: Although Colombia’s government announced a few weeks ago a strategy based on important infrastructure work, its impact will be limited: most of the investment was already in the budget last year, and the officials in charge of public works have consistently demonstrated inefficiency when executing large-scale projects.

zh: 同时，该国的货币当局在通过降低利率（当通胀的威胁渐行渐远）来刺激经济方面有更多的余地。
en: Meanwhile, the country’s monetary authorities have much more leeway to boost the economy by lowering interest rates at a time when the threat of inflation is diminishing.

zh: 实际上，共和国银行在三月的会议上已经将利率从去年年底的10%降至7 % 。
en: In fact, the Bank of the Republic has reduced its interest rates from 10% at the end of last year to 7% at its last meeting in March.

zh: 这些政策应该能让哥伦比亚的经济在今年勉强增长，但前提是世界经济在第一季度结束前开始回稳。
en: These policies should allow Colombia’s economy to grow – barely – this year, but only as long as the world economy begins to stabilize before the end of the first quarter.

zh: 果真如此，那么哥伦比亚经济在2010和2011年的前景就会比较乐观。 由于外商投资的涌入、安全状况的改善和更好的营商环境，增长率应该接近3 % 。
en: If so, the outlook for Colombia is more favorable in 2010 and 2011, when growth should be close to 3%, thanks to inflows of foreign investment, improvements in security, and a better business environment.

zh: 但如果国际经济危机持续的时间超过了2010年的上半年则全盘皆输，哥伦比亚将在���个经济普遍萎缩的地区挣扎着寻找经济发展的出路。
en: But if the international crisis lasts longer than the first half of 2010, all bets are off, and Colombia will struggle to find its economic footing in a region devastated by generalized contraction.

zh: 和平的哥伦比亚？
en: Colombia at Peace?

zh: 波哥大—哥伦比亚总统桑托斯刚刚宣布的《停止武装冲突框架协议 》 （ Framework Agreement for the End of the Armed Conflict）是他的祖国和整个拉丁美洲的一座里程碑。
en: BOGOTÁ – The Framework Agreement for the End of the Armed Conflict in Colombia that has just been announced by President Juan Manuel Santos is a historic landmark for his country and all of Latin America.

zh: 同时，这也是对外交智慧和谈判技巧的一大贡献。
en: It is also a tribute to diplomatic resourcefulness and negotiating skill.

zh: 该协议的另一方是哥伦比亚革命武装力量（更有名的是其缩写FARC ） 。 长期以来，哥伦比亚用尽各种政治手段都没有与这个拉丁美洲最可怕也是最后一支游击运动力量达成一致。
en: The agreement with the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia, better known as the FARC, came after long years of failed attempts by Colombian governments of all political shades to reach an accommodation with the last, and among the most odious, guerrilla movement to have operated in Latin America.

zh: 此前，FARC — — 不折不扣的恐怖活动、大屠杀和贩毒机器 — — 从未同意就解除武装、成员开始新的社会和政治生活、受害者权利、停止制毒以及参与为考察半个世纪以来的犯罪和冲突活动而设的“信任和责任”委员会等问题展开讨论。
en: Never before has the FARC – a monumental apparatus of terror, mass murder, and drug trafficking – agreed to discuss disarmament, its fighters’ social and political reintegration, victims’ rights, an end to drug production, and participation in “truth and responsibility” commissions to examine the crimes committed during a half-century of conflict.

zh: 但现在，他们点头了。
en: But now it has.

zh: 这一重大变化反映了FARC在长年斗争之后实力的极大削弱、哥伦比亚社会的韧性，以及（也许是最重要的）桑托斯的高明地区政策。
en: This momentous shift reflects the decimation of the FARC following long years of struggle, the resilience of Colombian society, and, perhaps most important, Santos’s brilliant regional policy.

zh: 通过削弱所谓的玻利瓦尔轴心（委内瑞拉、厄瓜多尔和玻利维亚 ） ， FARC游击队不再拥有支持他们的地区环境了。
en: By weakening the so-called Bolivarian Axis (Venezuela, Ecuador, and Bolivia), the FARC guerrillas were left without a supportive regional environment.

zh: 正如中东和中美洲随着冷战的结束迎来和平进程一样，地区变化创造了开启哥伦比亚和平进程的条件。
en: As with peace processes in the Middle East and Central America following the Cold War’s end, regional changes created the conditions for the start of the Colombian process.

zh: 但是，在中东和中美洲，是外部行为人 — — 美国和苏联 — — 推动了变化；而在哥伦比亚进程中，变化产生于内部。
en: But, in the Middle East and Central America, external actors – the United States and the Soviet Union – produced the change; in the case of the Colombian process, the change came from within.

zh: 在设法让FARC加入在古巴举行的秘密谈判之前，桑托斯的地区外交政策改变了该地区的政治形势 — — 从武力恫吓转向了努力合作。
en: Prior to engaging the FARC in secret talks in Cuba, Santos’s regional diplomacy shifted the region’s politics from saber rattling to the hard work of cooperation.

zh: 他让长期以来一直是FARC避风港的委内瑞拉和厄瓜多尔成为愿意与革命战争的古老传统说再见的友好邻邦。
en: He turned Venezuela and Ecuador, which had long been safe havens for the FARC, into friendly neighbors willing to bring an end to the archaic tradition of revolutionary wars.

zh: 事实上，或许最令人瞩目的外交变化是委内瑞拉总统查韦斯已经变身为哥伦比亚冲突解决方案的关键促进者。
en: In fact, in what is perhaps the most remarkable diplomatic turnaround, Venezuelan President Hugo Chávez has become a key facilitator in the resolution of the Colombian conflict.

zh: 与FARC的谈判逐步促成了地区形势的改善，随后出台的是解决哥伦比亚冲突根源的方案。
en: The talks with the FARC evolved as regional détente was followed by an ambitious initiative to address the root causes of the Colombian conflict.

zh: 最令人瞩目的是，2011年6月桑托斯签署了《受害者和土地归还法 》 （ Victims and Land Restitution Law ） ， 联合国秘书长潘基文也出席了签署仪式。
en: Most notably, Santos signed the Victims and Land Restitution Law in June 2011, in the presence of United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon.

zh: 该法为60年冲突中的人权侵害行为受害者提供了补偿，并向农民归还了数百万英亩被夺走的土地。
en: The law provides reparation for the victims of human-rights violations in the course of a 60-year conflict, as well as restitution of millions of hectares stolen from peasants.

zh: 该法也因此削弱了FARC用土地改革为其数不清的暴行开脱的说服力，从而将哥伦比亚推上了和平之路。
en: The law thus puts Colombia on a path to peace by blunting the FARC’s appeal to land reform to justify its untold atrocities.

zh: 不可否认，这是一部十分复杂的法律，而且也绝不是毫无漏洞。
en: The law is undeniably complex, and by no means without shortcomings.

zh: 但是，如果能够按计划实施，它可以带来一场深远的社会革命。
en: But, if implemented as planned, it could bring about a profound social revolution.

zh: 它还代表了全新的和平之路，因为通常只有在冲突结束后才会有这样的法律出台。
en: It also represents a novel approach to peace, given that such laws are normally introduced only after a conflict has ended.

zh: 在哥伦比亚的例子中，向失地农民归还土地以及向受害者和因冲突流离失所者提供经济补偿成了促进和平之道。
en: In this case, returning land to dispossessed peasants and offering financial reparation to the victims and those who were displaced by the conflict became the way to peace.

zh: 事实上，正是FARC前领导人阿方索·卡诺（Alfonso Cano）将该法称为“未来和解的关键”以及“大大有助于冲突的真正解决 ” 。
en: Indeed, it was none other than Alfonso Cano, a former FARC leader, who called the law “essential to a future of reconciliation” and a “contribution to a real solution to the conflict.”

zh: 但是，谈判的悲观者和反对者也不是没有道理。
en: Skeptics and opponents of the negotiations do have a case, however.

zh: FARC在此前和平谈判中的案底表明他们惯常于操纵谈判在并无形成妥协的实际意愿的情况下获得国内和国际合法性。
en: The FARC’s record in previous peace talks reveals a penchant for manipulating negotiations to gain national and international legitimacy without actually being willing to strike a deal.

zh: 因此，桑托斯很可能会步斯里兰卡后尘，用无情的军事攻势瓦解叛军，但这样做的代价将是严重的侵害人权和毁灭平民社区。
en: Santos could, therefore, have been tempted to choose the Sri Lanka way – a ruthless military onslaught to defeat the insurgents, at the price of major human-rights violations and the destruction of civilian communities.

zh: 桑托斯并没有选择这样做，而是选择了最小代价的和平之路。
en: Instead, Santos opted for the path of least expedience.

zh: 毕竟，在哥伦比亚和其他地区，各国通常因战争而合，因和平而分。
en: After all, war, in Colombia and elsewhere, frequently unites nations, while peace divides them.

zh: 哥伦比亚武装冲突若能真正结束，其反响将绝不会仅限于国内。
en: The repercussions of a genuine end to the Colombian armed conflict would be felt far beyond the country’s borders.

zh: 如果查韦斯的委内瑞拉沦为毒品国家，其政权之爪牙充当毒枭，那么这就表明它与FARC有着超凡的关系。
en: If Chávez’s Venezuela has become a narco-state in which the regime’s acolytes are drug lords, this reflects their privileged relations with the FARC.

zh: 墨西哥也将感受到哥伦比亚武装冲突结束的反响，该国的贩毒卡特尔正在摧毁这个国家以及作为世界最大毒品需求源的美国。
en: Repercussions would also be felt in Mexico, where drug cartels are tearing apart the country, and the US, the world’s largest source of demand.

zh: 西非也将受到影响，近几年来，该地区已成为南美毒品流向欧洲的主要中转站。
en: West Africa, too, would be affected, having become in recent years the main transit point for South American drugs headed to Europe.

zh: 前路依然坎坷，最终协议还远未确定。
en: Formidable difficulties still lie ahead, and a final agreement is by no means certain.

zh: 尽管如此，桑托斯仍然大有机会一劳永逸地解决长期以来阻碍拉丁美洲迈向政治和经济一体化的看似神秘无比的暴力革命变化。
en: But Santos nonetheless has a fair chance of burying, once and for all, the specious mystique of violent revolutionary change that has held back Latin America’s political and economic modernization for so long.

zh: 两个哥伦比亚
en: The Two Colombias

zh: 波哥大—在哥伦比亚第二大城市麦德林，你可以听到市长办公室令人印象深刻地介绍该市新涌现的工业园和新科技公司。
en: BOGOTÁ – In Medellín, Colombia’s second-largest city, you can listen to an impressive presentation by the mayor’s office about emerging industrial parks and new technology firms.

zh: 接着扫一眼你的智能手机，你又能发现游击队绑架了某位将军，而为结束与哥伦比亚革命卫队（FARC，拉丁美洲历史最悠久的游击队组织）的数十年内战而进行的谈判陷入了僵局。
en: Then, a glance at your smartphone reveals that guerrillas have kidnapped an army general, and that negotiations to end a decades-long civil war with the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), Latin America’s oldest guerrilla group, are at a standstill.

zh: 在哥伦比亚，你可以在世界级大学参加研讨会研究茁壮成长的跨国公司，与能力卓著的决策者攀谈，与此同时，你又能了解到，在这里，相隔不过数十英里远的公民彼此拔刀相向。 这种现象在拉丁美洲独此一家。
en: Colombia is the only country in Latin America where you can attend seminars at world-class universities, learn about mushrooming multinationals, and chat with supremely competent policymakers, all the while knowing that citizens are confronting one another with machetes and bazookas just a few dozen miles away.

zh: 从这个角度讲，哥伦比亚是两个国家，还进行着旷日持久的交战。
en: In this sense, Colombia is two countries, which have been at war with each other for far too long.

zh: 一方面，哥伦比亚拥有高速的经济增长和繁荣的外国投资，城市面貌焕然一新，创新社会政策层出不穷。
en: On the one hand, there is the Colombia of rapid economic growth and booming foreign investment, of refurbished cities and innovative social policies.

zh: 另一方面，这里是马尔克斯笔下的小说人物、掀起过17场内战并全部败绩的奥雷良诺上校的哥伦比亚。
en: On the other hand, there is the Colombia of Gabriel García Márquez’s fictional Colonel Aureliano Buendía, who started 17 civil wars – and lost all of them.

zh: 坏消息是两个哥伦比亚之间的斗争夺走了无数人的生命，许多公民终身饱受贫困、战火和人权侵害。
en: The bad news is that the struggle between the two Colombias has taken a tremendous human toll, with many citizens having suffered through poverty, warfare, and human-rights violations for most, if not all, of their lives.

zh: 好消息是现代哥伦比亚 — — 和平与进步的哥伦比亚 — — 正在取得胜利。
en: The good news is that the modern Colombia, the country of peace and progress, is winning.

zh: 这一胜利的成果可以在麦德林等地一览无余。 在短短20年前，麦德林还是毒品垄断大亨和暴力的代名词。
en: The fruits of that victory can be seen in places like Medellín, which, just 20 years ago, was synonymous with drug cartels and violence.

zh: 如今，来自全世界的市长和城市规划者带着渴望学习城市复兴的信念涌向麦德林。 这里的公立图书馆将文化带给山麓小村，早出晚归的电缆车每天接送居民上下班。
en: Today, mayors and city planners from all over the world, eager to learn about urban renewal, flock to Medellín, which boasts public libraries that take culture to hillside shanties and gleaming cable cars that haul residents to and from work every day.

zh: 很难想象近几年中有哪个城市经历过像麦德林这样的剧烈转型（迪拜和上海或许可以相提并论 ） 。
en: It is difficult to think of a city that has undergone as dramatic a transformation as Medellín in recent years (though Dubai and Shanghai may be in the running).

zh: 哥伦比亚全国也经历了巨大的经济进步。
en: The country as a whole has also experienced significant economic progress.

zh: 自2008年金融危机以来，哥伦比亚与秘鲁一起名列南美最佳经济选手。
en: Since the 2008 financial crisis, Colombia, along with Peru, has been South America’s top economic performer.

zh: 拜大宗商品价格下跌和美国量化宽松结束所赐，整个地区的经济增长都有所下降，但哥伦比亚的经济实际上还有所加速。
en: As growth slows throughout the region, owing to falling commodity prices and the end of quantitative easing in the United States, Colombia’s economy is actually accelerating.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）预期，哥伦比亚今明两年增长分别将达到4.8%和4.5 % 。
en: The International Monetary Fund expects growth to reach a respectable 4.8% this year and 4.5% in 2015.

zh: 诚然，世界油价的大幅下跌对哥伦比亚是个不利的消息 — — 近几年来，哥伦比亚已成为主要碳氢产品生产国。
en: To be sure, the sharp drop in world oil prices is bad for Colombia, which in recent years has become a major hydrocarbons producer.

zh: 但强大的预算规则（类似于智利）使哥伦比亚很好地锚定了财政政策。
en: But strong budget rules, similar to Chile’s, keep fiscal policy well anchored.

zh: 政府已经表态，如果有需要准备采取增税实现逐渐减少公共债务和改善公共服务的目标。
en: And the government has indicated that, if the need arises, it is prepared to raise taxes to achieve its goal of gradually reducing public debt and improving public services.

zh: 商界尽管一开始有些不情不愿，但现在似乎也愿意配合。
en: The business community, despite some initial reluctance, seems willing to go along.

zh: 哥伦比亚仍是一个高度不平等的社会，基尼系数（衡量不平等成都的常规指标）徘徊在0.5左右，与巴西和智利相当。
en: Colombia remains a highly unequal society, with the Gini coefficient, a common measure of inequality, hovering around 0.5 – in the same range as Brazil and Chile.

zh: 问题的根源是多方面的，其中之一是劳动力市场功能不全，迫使许多哥伦比亚人不得不从事非正式工作或彻底失业。
en: The problem has many causes, one of which is a poorly functioning labor market that forces many Colombians to accept informal work or no work at all.

zh: 但政府不惮于承认再分配问题。
en: But the government does not shy away from talk of redistribution.

zh: 事实上，哥伦比亚已经启动了转移支付（如提高穷人退休者的养老金 ） ， 其政策带来了失业率连续五年下降。
en: Indeed, it has already initiated transfers (such as pension increases for poor retirees), and its policies have contributed to five consecutive years of declining unemployment.

zh: 上周，在麦德林的一次银行业会议上，财政部长毛里西奥·卡德纳斯（Mauricio Cárdenas）发表了热情洋溢的演讲，他指出，尽管总统桑托斯政府的历史根基在于哥伦比亚中右翼政治力量，但其财政审慎和积极的社会政策表明它走的是一条社会民主的“第三条路 ” 。
en: As Finance Minister Mauricio Cárdenas observed in a spirited speech to a banking convention last week in Medellín, though President Juan Manuel Santos’ administration is historically rooted in Colombia’s center-right political forces, its fiscal prudence and activist social policy qualify it as an adherent of the social-democratic “third way.”

zh: 在未来几年中，有两大因素可以继续推动哥伦比亚的发展。
en: In the coming years, two factors could propel Colombia’s continued development.

zh: 其一是太平洋同盟（Pacific Alliance，其余成员还包括墨西哥、秘鲁和智利 ） 。
en: One is the Pacific Alliance, which also includes Mexico, Peru, and Chile.

zh: 企业学会了通过地区市场销售出口新产品。
en: Firms learn to export new products by selling them in regional markets.

zh: 但是，在南美，贸易一体化言论常常被严峻的保护主义现实所窒息。
en: But, in South America, the rhetoric of trade integration has often been stifled by the harsh reality of protectionism.

zh: 幸运的是，随着环太平洋国家（拥有2.15亿人口，贡献37%的拉丁美洲GDP）自由贸易区的巩固，这一点正在改变。
en: Fortunately, with the consolidation of a free-trade bloc among the Pacific Rim countries – home to 215 million people and accounting for 37% of Latin America’s GDP – this is changing.

zh: 第二个因素 — — 目前尚未到来 — — 是和平，即与FARC达成最终确定的停火���谈判中止一不止一次，这次也很有可能不是最后一次。
en: The second factor – which has yet to arrive – is peace, in the form of a definite cessation of hostilities with FARC. This is not the first time that talks have been suspended, and it might not be the last.

zh: 但此前从未有谈判走得如此遥远，在多项领域形成了大量一致。
en: But never before have negotiations progressed so far, reaching substantial agreements in several areas.

zh: 对哥伦比亚来说，最重要的莫过于让公民不再害怕枪林弹雨或半夜在家中遭遇劫持。
en: Nothing is more important than building a Colombia where citizens no longer fear being caught in a hail of bullets or being dragged from their homes in the middle of the night.

zh: 与此同时，我们也不能低估和平的经济红利，波哥大经济学家估计这一红利可以在十年甚至更长的时间里将年GDP增长提高一个百分点。
en: At the same time, one should not underestimate the economic dividend of peace, which economists in Bogotá have estimated could boost GDP growth by as much as one percentage point annually for a decade or more.

zh: 二十五年前，安全繁荣的哥伦比亚还是不可能的任务。
en: A quarter-century ago, a safe and prosperous Colombia seemed impossible.

zh: 但如今，这已经摆在了我们面前。
en: Yet it is now within reach.

zh: 当今世界，政治冲突不断恶化，成功故事少之又少，而哥伦比亚正在给予全世界以希望的理由。
en: At a time of intensifying political conflict and painfully few success stories, Colombians are giving the world reason for hope.

zh: 百年宁静？
en: One Hundred Years of Tranquility?

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯的伟大小说《百年孤独》始于一位“挑起32场内战并全部失利”的上校面对行刑队的一幕。
en: SANTIAGO – Gabriel García Márquez’s great novel One Hundred Years of Solitude starts with a colonel who “started 32 civil wars and lost them all” facing the firing squad.

zh: 事情发生的地点是马孔多这个虚构的小镇，但鲜有读者因此而受骗：这部小说写的是加西亚·马尔克斯的祖国哥伦比亚。
en: The site of the event is the fictional town of Macondo, but few readers are fooled: the novel is about García Márquez’s native Colombia.

zh: 上周，哥伦比亚内战 — — 也是拉丁美洲唯一仅存的一场武装冲突 — — 正式落下了帷幕。
en: Last week, Colombia’s civil war – the sole remaining armed conflict in Latin America – formally came to an end.

zh: 内战持续时间超过50年，吞噬了25万人的生命并导致六百万民众流离失所。
en: It lasted more than 50 years, cost a quarter-million lives, and displaced six million people.

zh: 虽然似乎难以置信，但和平最终到来了。
en: It seems hard to believe, but peace is finally here.

zh: 悲观主义者可能指出还有许多工作要做，战士们还没有交出武器，最终的和平协议也还有待签署。
en: Pessimists will point out that much remains to be worked out, fighters have yet to hand in their weapons, and the final peace agreement has not been signed.

zh: 尽管如此，胡安·曼努埃尔·桑托斯总统和游击队领袖罗德里戈·隆多尼奥·埃切韦里（曾经化名提姆切科）在哈瓦那的握手仍然标志着一个悲剧时代的结束和一个更加充满希望的时代的开始。
en: Still, the handshake in Havana between President Juan Manuel Santos and guerrilla leader Rodrigo Londoño Echeverri (known by the nom de guerre Timochenko) marks the end of a tragic era and the beginning of a far more promising one.

zh: 20世纪60年代起，列宁所说的左翼共产主义：一种幼稚病传染了拉丁美洲。
en: Beginning in the 1960s, Latin America was infected by a bad case of what Lenin called “Left-Wing Communism: an Infantile Disorder.”

zh: 穿上迷彩服进山是包治一切社会疑难杂症的万能良药。
en: Donning fatigues and taking to the mountains was the cure for all social ills.

zh: 游击队运动诞生并快速成长，其结果往往导致分裂和新的游击队产生。
en: Guerrilla movements were born and grew, often only to split up and engender new ones.

zh: 在很多地区 — — 尤其是中美洲 — — 暴力叛乱成为随处可见的现象。
en: In many places – especially Central America – violent insurgency became endemic.

zh: 哥伦比亚的流血事件起源更早，始于1948年自由派总统候选人盖坦遭遇谋杀的所谓“暴力期”之后。
en: Colombia’s bloodshed started even earlier, in the period simply known as “The Violence,” following the murder in 1948 of the liberal presidential candidate Jorge Eliécer Gaitán.

zh: 自由派和保守派之间的战争随着1953年古斯塔沃·罗哈斯·皮尼利亚的血腥专政诞生而结束。
en: The fighting between liberals and conservatives came to an end with the advent of the bloody dictatorship of Gustavo Rojas Pinilla in 1953.

zh: 某种形式的民主政体于1958年回归，但暴力活动却直到现在从未停止过。
en: Democracy of sorts returned in 1958, but violence continued – until now.

zh: 当然，1958年的古巴革命是拉丁美洲革命激情期的典型形象。
en: Of course, the poster child for the period of revolutionary fervor in Latin America was the Cuban revolution of 1958.

zh: 切·格瓦拉炯炯的目光和缀着红星图案的贝雷帽被定格在阿尔贝托·科尔达的标志性照片中，催生了整整一代人的激情澎湃。
en: Che Guevara’s intense gaze and red-starred beret, captured in Alberto Korda’s iconic photograph, mobilized a generation.

zh: 近60年后，古巴革命的梦想却已支离破碎。
en: Nearly six decades later, the dream of the Cuban revolution lies in tatters.

zh: 革命曾引以为豪的领袖菲德尔·卡斯特罗已经成了一个可怜的人物，穿着扎眼的运动服，时不时出来露面说些越来越不连贯的话。
en: Its once-proud leader, Fidel Castro, has become a pathetic figure, clad in garish tracksuits, appearing from time to time to utter increasingly incoherent pronouncements.

zh: 菲德尔的弟弟和他亲自挑选的继任者劳尔主持了本周在哈瓦那举行的和平仪式，让人不禁想起政治领袖是多么缺乏激情和老态龙钟。
en: His brother and handpicked successor, Raúl, as grey and uninspiring as political leaders come, hosted this week’s peace ceremony in Havana.

zh: 20世纪七八十年代，与左翼幼稚革命相对应的是右翼的残酷镇压。
en: In the 1970s and 1980s, the counterpart of childish revolution from the left was murderous repression from the right.

zh: 独裁专制迅速扩散，从巴西、阿根廷到乌拉圭、智利，并一路波及到中美洲的萨尔瓦多、危地马拉和洪都拉斯。
en: Dictatorships proliferated, from Brazil and Argentina to Uruguay and Chile, all the way to El Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras in Central America.

zh: 他们同样作出承诺，但他们的承诺是基于法律秩序和正统的经济管理学。
en: They, too, made promises, theirs based on law and order and orthodox economic management.

zh: 今天，在拉美只有狂人才会相信这样的承诺。
en: Today in Latin America only a lunatic fringe believes such promises.

zh: 当世道变得艰难，没有人再到军营去求助。
en: When the going gets tough, no one turns to the military barracks anymore.

zh: 正如巴西前总统费尔南多·恩里克·卡多佐日前指出的那样，在巴西国内发生的政治危机中，起诉法官的名字家喻户晓，但将领的名字却没人说得出。
en: As former Brazilian president Fernando Henrique Cardoso pointed out recently, in the midst of his country’s political crisis everyone now knows the names of prosecuting judges, but no one knows the names of leading generals.

zh: 无论得来有多么不易，这就是一种进步。
en: That is progress, however hard earned.

zh: 除古巴外，最容易令人回想起拉美过去悲剧性错误的莫过于委内瑞拉。
en: Aside from Cuba, the saddest reminder of Latin America’s tragic mistakes of the past is Venezuela.

zh: 该国从1999年后由民粹主义领袖乌戈·查韦斯及其继任者尼古拉斯·马杜罗统治，现已从政治危机逐渐演化为一场全面的人道主义灾难，仓库里没有粮食、诊所里也没有药品。
en: The country, ruled since 1999 by populist Hugo Chávez and his successor Nicolas Máduro, has gone from a political crisis to a full-fledged humanitarian disaster, with no food in stores or medicines in clinics.

zh: 金融时报报道援引委内瑞拉国民大会的说法 ， “ 长达17年的查韦斯主义见证了超过4250亿公共资金被浪费或盗用。 ”
en: The Financial Times reports that, according to the Venezuelan National Assembly, “17 years of chavismo have seen more than $425 billion of public money stolen or wasted.”

zh: 没人知道会怎么收场，随着哥伦比亚悲剧的结束，委内瑞拉悲剧似乎注定早晚也会终结。
en: No one knows how, but with the Colombian tragedy over, the Venezuelan tragedy seems destined to end sooner rather than later.

zh: 今天，查韦斯主义已经激励不了任何人。
en: Chavismo today inspires no one.

zh: 拉美各地如雨后春笋般出现的各种山寨政权或者已经倒台，或者遭到了严重的削弱。
en: The copycat regimes it spawned around Latin America are gone or severely weakened.

zh: 就像后英国脱欧期的欧洲似乎走向了民族主义和民粹主义，拉美正在引导一股朝着相反方向的潮流。
en: Just as Europe, post-Brexit, seems to be moving toward nationalism and populism, Latin America is heading in the opposite direction.

zh: 运气好的话，山地游击队、身着绿色迷彩的愤怒的煽动者、戴着黑墨镜的令人恐惧的将军随处可见的时代在美洲已经结束。
en: With any luck, the era of the mountain guerrilla, the irate demagogue in green fatigues, or the frightful general in dark glasses is over in the Americas.

zh: 随之而来的是身着无聊蓝西装的谨小慎微的政客，他们承认困难的问题没有容易的解决办法，鄙视空洞的承诺，赞成丘吉尔式的汗水和劳作。
en: What comes next is the era of the prudent politician in a boring blue suit who acknowledges that hard problems have no easy solutions, and who spurns towering promises in favor of Churchillian sweat and toil.

zh: 我们或许终于在政治上走向了成熟。
en: We may finally be growing up politically.

zh: 哥伦比亚的桑托斯、阿根廷的毛里西奥·马克里和秘鲁的佩德罗巴勃罗·库琴斯基是这个新时代的象征。
en: Santos himself in Colombia, Mauricio Macri in Argentina, and Pedro Pablo Kuczynski in Peru are emblematic of this new period.

zh: 他们都是有能力的管理者和��练有素的技术官僚。
en: They are all capable managers and highly trained technocrats.

zh: 在摈弃民粹主义 — — 以及往往随之而来的通货膨胀和财政危机 — — 的情况下发展经济是他们所面临的主要挑战，或许也将成为他们最广为人知的成就。
en: Steering the economy forward without populism – and the inflation and fiscal crisis that always go with it – is their principal challenge and possibly will be their most publicized achievement.

zh: 但他们不能仅以技术实力作为合法性和政治成功的基础。
en: But they should not rely on technocratic prowess alone as the key to legitimacy and political success.

zh: 今天的拉美民众已经厌烦了虚浮的革命承诺，但他们同样以怀疑的目光注视着自由民主机构 — — 以及上述机构的领导者。
en: Today’s Latin Americans have grown disenchanted with vain revolutionary promises, but they also look at their liberal democratic institutions – and the people who lead them – with a skeptical eye.

zh: 在收入不平等、官僚机构反应迟钝和商业行为不透明仍然是日常生活特色的地区，这种状况是可以理解的。
en: This is understandable in a region where income inequality, unresponsive bureaucracy, and opaque businesses practices are still very much a feature of everyday life.

zh: 在欧洲和拉美，今天的选民需要感受到领袖的心是公平的，他们代表所有人（包括弱势群体）采取行动，而非仅仅服务于富裕的精英阶层。
en: In Europe and Latin America, voters today need to feel that their leaders’ hearts are in the right place, and that they are acting on behalf of everyone, including the underprivileged, not merely serving a rich elite.

zh: 健全政策的最终目标及对目标的描述必须全部符合道德。
en: The ultimate goals of sound policy are ethical, and they ought to be described in those terms.

zh: 当领袖对中等收入经济管理不善以至于导致民众挨饿 — — 就像查韦斯和马杜罗在委内瑞拉所做的那样 — — 这种行为是不道德的。
en: When a leader mismanages a middle-income economy so terribly that people go hungry –as Chávez and Maduro have done in Venezuela – that is an immoral act.

zh: 饥饿导致的人类苦难本来可以避免，这显然是一种道德错误。
en: Hunger causes avoidable human suffering, a clear moral wrong.

zh: 寻求共识、避免煽动、追求增量从而实现可持续发展 — — 上述目标听起来似乎都不是那么伟大，但却深刻而且合乎道德。
en: Seeking consensus, avoiding demagoguery, pursuing incremental and, therefore, sustainable solutions – none of that sounds terribly epic, but it is profoundly moral.

zh: 如果拉美领导人能让民众理解其中的道理，那么哥伦比亚和平协议所开启的时代将是漫长而幸福的。
en: If democratic leaders in Latin America can get that message across, then the era inaugurated by the Colombian peace agreement will be a long and happy one.

zh: 哥伦比亚和平协议正在遭受围攻
en: Colombia’s Peace Agreement Is Under Siege

zh: 马德里 — — 2016年，哥伦比亚政府与哥伦比亚革命武装力量（FARC）达成了一项历史性的和平协议，并由此结束了一场导致265，000名哥伦比亚人丧生以及700万人流离失所的长达52年的战争。
en: MADRID – In 2016, Colombia’s government reached an historic peace agreement with the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), ending a 52-year-old war that had killed more than 265,000 Colombians and displaced another seven million.

zh: 上述协议曾被誉为解决看似棘手武装冲突的全新模式。
en: The deal has been hailed as a new model for resolving seemingly intractable conflicts.

zh: 但现在却已陷入前所未有的考验当中。
en: But it is now being tested like never before.

zh: 即使在局面最有利的时刻，也很难彻底消除这样一场旷日持久冲突的根本原因。
en: Eradicating the root causes of such a protracted conflict would be difficult enough in the best of times.

zh: 但随着伊凡·杜克·马尔克斯接任哥伦比亚总统，铲除这场冲突的根源变得更无可能。
en: With Iván Duque Márquez taking over Colombia’s presidency, however, it will become much more so.

zh: 杜克的导师是前任总统阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦，而乌里韦则是设计和平协议的杜克前任胡安·曼努埃尔·桑托斯的政治克星。
en: Duque’s mentor was former President Álvaro Uribe, the political nemesis of Duque’s immediate predecessor, Juan Manuel Santos, the architect of the peace accord.

zh: 杜克已经开始拒绝承认这项协议的支柱性条款，其中首当其冲的是承认哥伦比亚革命武装力量为合法政党，并允许其参与民主选举。
en: Already, Duque has refused to recognize key pillars of the deal, beginning with the FARC’s status as a legitimate political party that can participate in democratic elections.

zh: 他还拒绝承认和平特别管辖权（JEP）条款，创建这一法外司法体系的部分目的是管理过渡时期司法 — — 这是哥伦比亚革命武装力量游击队和与之对抗的右翼准军事组织恶行所留下的烂摊子。
en: He has also rejected the Special Jurisdiction for Peace (JEP), a new extrajudicial court system created as part of the deal to manage transitional justice – the legacy of abuses by FARC guerrillas and the right-wing paramilitary organizations that fought them.

zh: 哥伦比亚有权有势的保守建制派一直对和平特别管辖权所代表的精神倍感不满，因为上述条款把真相和受害者利益放在首位，因此格外注重修复而非惩戒。
en: Colombia’s powerful conservative establishment has never been happy with the liberal spirit underlying the JEP, which aims to be more restorative than punitive, putting the victims – and the truth – front and center.

zh: 结果可能包括承认和弥补肇事者的罪行。
en: The results might include reparations and acknowledgements of perpetrators’ guilt.

zh: 但哥伦比亚革命武装力量的高级领导人实际可以避免因犯下的罪孽而被判刑。
en: But top FARC leaders would be able effectively to avoid prison sentences for their crimes.

zh: 但因为和平特别管辖条款涉及的某些高级军界、商界和政界人物涉嫌与右翼准军事组织有染，这些人现在已经被哥伦比亚参议院免职。
en: Colombia’s Senate, however, has now removed from the JEP’s jurisdiction high-ranking military, business, and political figures suspected of colluding with the right-wing paramilitaries.

zh: 参议员们认为军界需要建立由“公正法官 ” 、 而非和平管辖条款“左翼分子”所主导的新法庭。
en: The senators argue that the military needs a new tribunal with “impartial justices,” rather than the “leftists” of the JEP.

zh: 于是，杜克甚至还未就职就已经破坏了这项协定。
en: In this manner, the deal was undermined before Duque was even inaugurated.

zh: 令人安慰的是由于哥伦比亚宪法法院做出裁决，总统无法对和平协议的条款进行实质性的变更。
en: The good news is that, thanks to a ruling by Colombia’s Constitutional Court, the president cannot substantively change the peace deal’s terms.

zh: 但杜克仍然可以通过压缩实施协议所需的资源和政治关注来削弱协议的执行。
en: But Duque could still weaken the agreement by denying the resources and political attention needed to implement it.

zh: 于是接下来的问题就变成他是否会像桑托斯那样，明知与乌里韦相左仍然坚持选择务实的对策。
en: The question then becomes whether he will choose a pragmatic approach, even if it means clashing with Uribe, just as Santos did.

zh: 但即使杜克不主动破坏和平协议，协议的执行也面临着很大的难题。
en: Even without Duque actively undermining the peace agreement, however, the implementation challenges are profound.

zh: 虽然哥伦比亚革命武装力量已经正式解散，但其部分力量却拒绝停止斗争。
en: While FARC has officially demobilized, some FARC fronts have refused to give up the fight.

zh: 他们现在正与准军事组织全面开战，其中有些源于21世纪初解散的右翼准军事组织；其中包括拒绝桑托斯单独签署和平协议提议的马克思主义民兵民族解放军（ELN ） ， 以及其他争相接管哥伦比亚革命武装力量非法经济的犯罪团伙。
en: They are now locked in an all-out war with paramilitary groups, some of which arose from the right-wing paramilitaries that demobilized in the early 2000s; the National Liberation Army (ELN), a Marxist militia that resisted Santos’ offer of a separate peace deal; and criminal bands vying to take over FARC’s illicit economy.

zh: 非法经济包括制造可卡因的原料古柯。
en: That economy included coca, the raw material for cocaine.

zh: 控制上述及其他非法资产的战斗绝大部分集中在该国约1/4的城市，其中受政府控制的只有不到5 % 。
en: Most of the fight for control of this and other illicit assets is concentrated in about one-quarter of the country’s municipalities, just 5% of which are under state control.

zh: 因为哥伦比亚幅员辽阔，政府为历史上处于边缘化的地区提供服务和体制支持的能力一直与国家的和平与稳定密不可分。
en: Given Colombia’s massive size, the country’s peace and stability have always depended on the state’s ability to provide services and institutional support to historically marginalized areas.

zh: 目前，哥伦比亚革命武装力量撤离的地区缺乏这种支持，导致那里容易出现新的波动，这反映在政治暗杀事件持续攀升当中。
en: Now, areas that have been evacuated by FARC lack such support, leaving them vulnerable to renewed volatility, reflected in a rise in politically motivated assassinations.

zh: 面对暴力威胁的小土地所有者现在被迫贱价将追回的被盗土地出售给大型农工企业，而为其收回土地提供依据的“受害者及土地归还”法恰恰是和平协议的另一项支柱性规定。
en: Small landowners, intimidated by the violence, are now being forced to sell at bargain prices the stolen lands they recovered as part of the Law of Victims and Land Restitution – another pillar of the peace agreement – to major agro-industrial companies.

zh: 上述企业也正在进入哥伦比亚革命武装力量撤出的哥伦比亚亚马逊地区 — — 那里覆盖的原始森林正面临被摧毁的威胁。
en: Such companies are also gaining access to areas of the Colombian Amazon evacuated by the FARC – areas covered in virgin forests that are now in danger of being destroyed.

zh: 仅去年一年，哥伦比亚就失去了近50万公顷的森林覆盖面积 — — 较上一年出现了46%的增长。
en: Last year alone, Colombia lost almost a half-million hectares of forest cover – a 46% increase over the previous year.

zh: 这一重要生态系统的破坏有可能加速气候变化。
en: The destruction of this vital ecosystem threatens to accelerate climate change.

zh: 这都是摆在人们面前的严峻挑战，只有借助长期深入的结构性改革才能克服。
en: These are serious challenges, which can be overcome only with deep and long-term structural reforms.

zh: 但这绝非放弃和平协议的借口。
en: But that is no excuse to give up on the peace deal.

zh: 毕竟，这些挑战是可以预期的：与现有国家间签署的注重边界划定的和平协议不同，非国家主体间订立的协议实际总是伴随着漫长而复杂的国家重建工作。
en: After all, such challenges were to be expected: unlike peace deals between functioning states – which would focus on, say, delimiting borders – agreements with non-state actors are virtually always followed by complex and protracted state-building efforts.

zh: 比方说结束30年暴力为北爱尔兰带来和平的耶稣受难日协议。
en: Consider the Good Friday Agreement that brought peace to Northern Ireland after three decades of violence.

zh: 该协议于1998年签署，但直到七年后爱尔兰共和军才同意解除武装。
en: The deal was signed in 1998, but it was only seven years later that the Irish Republican Army agreed to disarm.

zh: 又过了两年，天主教徒和新教徒才明确达成权力共享协议。
en: Another two years elapsed before Protestants and Catholics reached a definitive power-sharing agreement.

zh: 而当权力共享政府发生动摇时，英国政府的临时直接统治才得以再次实行。
en: When power-sharing governments have faltered, the UK government has temporarily reimposed direct rule.

zh: 像耶稣受难日协议一样，哥伦比亚的和平协议同样基于一种简单的交易：那就是以政治参与换取解除武装。
en: Like the Good Friday Agreement, Colombia’s peace agreement is based on a simple bargain: political participation for disarmament.

zh: 但重建该国荒芜的农村偏远地带是落实协议的唯一方法 — — 来自既得经济利益群体与为之服务的保守政治人物的抵制导致这项本已高度复杂的任务更加难以完成。
en: But the only way to implement the deal is to reconstruct the country’s abandoned rural periphery – a highly complex task made all the more difficult by resistance from vested economic interests and the conservative politicians who serve them.

zh: 国际人权核查委员会报告显示，部分由于上述抵制，哥伦比亚政府迄今为止从经济赔偿、安全保障到援助同意结束古柯生产的农民仅仅实现了18.5%和平协议所规定的改革、法律和承诺目标。
