en: Owing partly to such resistance, Colombia’s government, according to the International Commission on Human Rights Verification, has so far achieved only 18.5% of the reforms, laws, and promises – from economic reparations and security guarantees to assistance to farmers who agreed to end coca production – stipulated by the peace accord.

zh: 杜克的总统任期将依据他挑战既得利益及推动和平进程的意愿来加以衡量。
en: Duque’s presidency will be judged by his willingness to challenge vested interests and advance the peace process.

zh: 和平协议无疑并不完美。
en: The peace deal is not perfect.

zh: 但事实依然是桑托斯留给他的继任者一个摆脱哥伦比亚革命武装力量叛乱祸患并正在走向持久和平的国家，更不要说他还留下了一份可能与民族解放军达成和平协议的路线图。
en: But the fact remains that Santos bequeathed to his successor a country that is free of the scourge of the FARC insurgency and on the path toward lasting peace, not to mention a roadmap for a potential peace deal with the ELN.

zh: 他还同时奠定了农村改革的基础，如果这项改革最终完成，将产生不啻于哥伦比亚土地革命般的巨大效果。
en: He also laid the groundwork for rural reforms that, if completed, would produce nothing less than an agrarian revolution in Colombia.

zh: 这是一次带给哥伦比亚人梦想已久的持久和平稳定的黄金机会，杜克决不能将其浪费掉。
en: Duque must not waste a golden opportunity to deliver to his country the durable peace and stability of which Colombians have long dreamed.

zh: 哥伦比亚送给世界的礼物
en: Colombia’s Gift to the World

zh: 马德里 — — 在古巴哈瓦那长达4年的会谈结束后，哥伦比亚总统胡安·曼努埃尔·桑托斯与拉丁美洲实力最强的叛乱组织哥伦比亚革命武装力量（FARC）谈判达成了结束哥伦比亚历届政府与该组织武装冲突的协议。
en: MADRID – After four long years of talks in Havana, Cuba, Colombian President Juan Manuel Santos has negotiated an end to successive governments’ armed conflict with the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), the most resilient insurgent group in Latin America.

zh: 历时60年的哥伦比亚内战造成约 220,000 人死亡及600万人流离失所。
en: Colombia’s civil war, which lasted for six decades, has killed an estimated 220,000 people and displaced another six million.

zh: 结束这场战争是一项了不起的外交成就，桑托斯理应赢得全世界的掌声。
en: Ending it was a remarkable feat of diplomacy, and Santos deserves the world’s applause.

zh: 事实上，他在本年度诺贝尔和平奖的角逐中应当遥遥领先于其他竞争对手。
en: Indeed, he should be far and away the leading candidate for this year’s Nobel Peace Prize.

zh: 有三大关键因素最终导致了和平协议的签订：哥伦比亚政府军效率提高并大批消灭叛军；桑托斯之前打下的外交基础，修复了哥伦比亚与委内瑞拉、厄瓜多尔和玻利维亚等邻国磕磕绊绊的关系，由这3个邻国组成的轴心一直在为哥伦比亚革命武装力量提供后勤和政治方面的支持；最后，桑托斯巧妙地利用了古巴与美国最新的和解政策来实现哥伦比亚的国内和平。
en: Three significant factors led to the peace accord: the Colombian armed forces’ increased effectiveness, which enabled them to decimate the FARC’s ranks; Santos’s previous diplomatic groundwork, wherein he repaired Colombia’s previously fraught relations with neighboring Venezuela, Ecuador, and Bolivia, an axis that had long contributed to sustaining the FARC by providing logistical and political support; and, finally, Cuba’s new policy of rapprochement with the United States, which Santos was wise to exploit in his own efforts to make peace.

zh: 随着谈判条件日臻成熟，桑托斯还必须化解冲突的根本原因。
en: With the conditions for negotiations in place, Santos also had to address the root cause of the conflict.

zh: 2011年6月他当着联合国秘书长潘基文的面签署了被害人与土地赔偿法。
en: He did this by signing the Victims and Land Restitution Law in June 2011, in the presence of UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon.

zh: 因为同时平定暴力地区、为成百上千万破产农民伸张正义、极大改善生活水平并有效阻止游击力量以土地改革为名行大规模屠杀之实，上述法律成为哥伦比亚和平的分水岭。
en: The law was a watershed, because it simultaneously pacified violent regions, delivered justice for millions of dispossessed peasants, radically improved standards of living, and blunted the appeal of a guerrilla group that used the banner of land reform to justify its untold atrocities.

zh: 该法有关侵犯人权行为中妇女儿童幸存者和因性取向而遭袭者的特别规定甚至得到了联合国驻哥伦比亚高级人权专员的赞誉。
en: It even drew praise from the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights in Colombia for its special provisions for women and children survivors of human rights abuses, and for those targeted for their perceived sexual orientation.

zh: 尽管并非无懈可击，但被害人及土地赔偿法显然为哥伦比亚和平及民族和解铺平了道路。
en: While not flawless, the Victims and Land Restitution Law clearly helped pave the way for peace and national reconciliation in Colombia.

zh: 事实上，在2011年承认这一点的恰恰是名为阿方索·卡诺（吉列尔莫·萨恩斯·巴尔加斯的化名）的哥伦比亚革命武装力量前领导人。
en: Indeed, none other than the FARC’s former leader, Alfonso Cano (the nom de guerre of Guillermo Sáenz Vargas), acknowledged this in 2011.

zh: 哥伦比亚政府过渡司法体制结束冲突并重新吸收哥伦比亚革命武装力量加入哥伦比亚政治进程不可避免地有一些批评者，并在哥伦比亚选民当中造成一定的分歧。
en: Inevitably, the Colombian government’s transitional-justice regime to end the conflict and re-assimilate the FARC into the Colombian political process has some detractors, and has divided the Colombian electorate.

zh: 前总统乌里韦现在是和平协议坚定反对力量的领导者，反对的理由是这份协议没有惩罚哥伦比亚革命武装力量的武装份子。
en: Former President Álvaro Uribe is now leading those who stridently oppose the peace deal on the grounds that it does not go far enough to punish FARC militants.

zh: 即便如此，因为哈瓦那协议在直面真相的同时并未完全回避正义，我们也不能否认这份协议的签署是一种历史性的创新。
en: Nonetheless, the accord signed in Havana is historic and innovative, because it emphasizes truth-telling without eschewing justice altogether.

zh: 该协议的重点不在于报复和复仇，而在于打破种族隔离制度后德斯蒙德·图图大主教曾借以形容南非向多数人统治过渡的“恢复性司法”原则。
en: Its focus is not on vengeance and retribution, but on “restorative justice,” a principle Archbishop Desmond Tutu used to describe South Africa’s transition to majority rule after apartheid.

zh: 哥伦比亚过渡司法模式承认只有当毁于长期野蛮战争的民间社团得以振兴和修复，实现民族和解才成为可能。
en: The Colombian model of transitional justice acknowledges that national reconciliation is achievable only if the communities broken by the long, savage war are repaired and revitalized.

zh: 换言之，哥伦比亚的过渡司法强调受害者地位 — — 并在这一点上远远超过近年来的任何和平进程。
en: In other words, Colombia’s approach to transitional justice puts the victims first – more so than any peace process seen in recent years.

zh: 受害者代表团甚至参加了哈瓦那会谈并会见了曾制造过去诸多屠杀行为的哥伦比亚革命武装力量领导人。
en: Victims’ delegations even joined the Havana talks and met with the FARC leadership that was responsible for so many past atrocities.

zh: 哥伦比亚政府如此开创性的做法似乎也离不开性别小组委员会的工作，该委员会负责审议提案，对代表女性及同性恋群体利益的非政府机构提案展开审议进程。
en: The Colombian government’s pioneering approach seems to have benefited from a gender sub-commission that considered proposals from nongovernmental organizations representing women’s rights and the LGBT community.

zh: 政府还明智地成立了一个特别小组委员会调查流血事件的历史，因为对过去的分歧往往会极大地阻碍和平与和解进程。
en: The government was also wise to establish a special sub-commission to examine the history of the bloodshed, because disagreement about the past often constitutes an insurmountable obstacle to peace and reconciliation.

zh: 哥伦比亚国内政治现在应当成为舆论关注的焦点，因为公众舆论往往能在很大程度上左右和平进程。
en: Colombian domestic politics should now move to the forefront of attention, because peace processes are vulnerable to public opinion.

zh: 战争往往能让国家团结在一起，而和平则因为不可避免地需要做出让步和牺牲而起到分裂作用。
en: While war often unites countries, peace tends to divide them, because it inevitably requires concessions and sacrifices.

zh: 和平的到来需要付出代价，而人们往往就由谁来买单产生争执。
en: Peace comes at a cost, and people often disagree about who should foot the bill.

zh: 对民主领袖而言，和平谈判所涉及的风险往往不可思议地大于发动战争。
en: For a democratic leader, negotiating peace is – perversely – riskier than waging war.

zh: 民选政府和不必承担责任的非国家主体间的非对称和平尤其如此，因为不必承担责任的非国家主体不必担心即将举行的选举、反对派政党、媒体或持怀疑态度的公众。
en: This is especially true for an asymmetric peace process between a democratically elected government and an unaccountable non-state actor, which doesn’t have to worry about upcoming elections, opposition political parties, the press, or a skeptical public.

zh: 尽管面临这些艰苦的限制条件，桑托斯政府从未偏离正确的民主进程。
en: Despite these enormous constraints, the Santos government never deviated from proper democratic procedures.

zh: 它认真听取了全国各地人民议会的提案，并在整个过程中成功地保持了透明。
en: It considered proposals from popular assemblies around the country, and it maintained transparency throughout the process.

zh: 桑托斯成功克服了艰巨的挑战，接下来摆在面前的挑战是即将到来的全民公决。 我们希望哥伦比亚民众能够认识到他们为充满了冲突的世界提供了新的和平模型。
en: Santos has overcome formidable challenges, and the next one is a forthcoming plebiscite, where the Colombian people, one hopes, will recognize that their country has furnished a conflict-ridden world with a new model for peace.

zh: 国际社会应当对此做出充分的认识，并在未来协助哥伦比亚完成按照新协议施政的艰难的转型。
en: The international community should take note of this and assist Colombia in the difficult transition ahead as it implements policies in accordance with the new agreement.

zh: 后冲突阶段任务的艰巨性丝毫不小于和平进程本身。
en: The post-conflict phase will be no less demanding than the peace process itself.

zh: 哥伦比亚永远的痛
en: Colombia’s Eternal Agony

zh: 哥伦比亚今天的局势比以往若干年都好，这不能不说是阿尔瓦罗·乌里韦·贝莱斯（Alvaro Uribe）总统领导有方；但哥伦比亚在很多方面却十分怪异，不得不去面对奇怪而又棘手的挑战。
en: Colombia is in better shape today than it has been for years, thanks largely to President Alvaro Uribe’s leadership, but it remains a bizarre place, one facing strange and intractable challenges.

zh: 有些被绑人质已经被哥伦比亚革命武装部队（FARC）民兵关押了多年。
en: Colombia’s FARC guerrillas have held some of their kidnapping victims for many years.

zh: 准军事组织依然在吸收未成年战士，媒体也曾披露过哥伦比亚政客与毒品大鳄妥协的录像资料。
en: Child soldiers still linger in paramilitary groups, and there are compromising video recordings of leading Colombian politicians and drug lords.

zh: 但最奇怪的也许是，被监禁的民兵拒绝获释出狱，而政府却不惜违反他们的意愿，坚持要给他们自由。
en: Perhaps weirdest of all, there are imprisoned guerrillas who refuse to be set free, and a government that insists on liberating them, even against their will.

zh: 短短1年多以前，乌里韦凭借压倒性票数再次当选，这不仅因为与民兵和国内一般武装力量斗争的“民主安全”政策具有广泛的群众基础，还因为上述政策确实行之有效。
en: Uribe was re-elected just over a year ago by a landslide, a tribute to the popularity and effectiveness of his “democratic security” policy of combating both the guerrillas and the country’s generalized violence.

zh: 拉丁美洲历史最为悠久的两党制度在那次选举中被摧毁，标志是民主变革中心党（Polo Democrático）的总统候选人比自由党（Liberal Party）竞争者赢得了更多的选票，从而最终赋予了从未在投票箱旁看到过变革潜力的左翼势力通过选举表达自己的机会，而在此之前，他们宁愿选择在深山里打游击。
en: Latin America’s oldest standing two-party system was decimated in that election, as the Polo Democrático presidential candidate won more votes than the Liberal Party’s contender, finally giving electoral expression to left-wing forces that had never been able to see more potential for change at the ballot box than by fighting in the mountains.

zh: 有关哥伦比亚与美国之间自由贸易协定（FTA）的谈判也进入了最后阶段。
en: Negotiations on Colombia’s Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with the United States had been finalized.

zh: 即使是乌里韦与右翼准军事化的哥伦比亚联合自卫队（AUC）达成的协议（赦免了30,000名联合自卫队战士犯下的可怕罪行，以换取他们放下武器）似乎也取得了成功。
en: Even the questionable deal Uribe cut with the right-wing paramilitary AUC groups, pardoning up to 30,000 of their members for often horrendous crimes in exchange for their disarmament, appeared successful.

zh: 在乌里韦的领导下，哥伦比亚似乎好运连连。
en: With Uribe in charge, Colombia seemed to be on a roll.

zh: 但自此之后很多成果被白白地浪费，导致现在的哥伦比亚和乌里韦麻烦重重。
en: But much of this success has since been squandered, with both Colombia and Uribe now in deep trouble.

zh: 所谓的“ parapolítica ”丑闻撼动了乌里韦政府，迫使内阁部长提出辞呈，也致使其他人（包括总统本人）陷入到尴尬的境地当中。
en: The so-called parapolítica scandals have rocked Uribe’s government, forcing the resignation of some cabinet ministers, and embarrassing others, including the president himself.

zh: 有关政客和准军事化暴徒（其中一名曾吹嘘亲手杀死了300多名敌人）的照片、录音和录像资料彻底摧毁了某位政界名流的声誉，尽管从未赢得过民众的信任，但真实的图片材料却最终证实了某些人有关于他的最坏的猜疑。
en: Photographs, videos, and audio recordings of politicians and paramilitary thugs (including one who boasts of having personally killed more than 300 of his enemies) have discredited a political elite that, while never very popular, has now had some of the worst suspicions that many held about it graphically confirmed.

zh: 多年以来，人权积极分子及学者一直质疑一个明显的现象：出现规模庞大、穷凶极恶、武器精良、训练有素的军队与民兵作战并非是一种自发的现象。
en: For years human rights activists and scholars suspected the obvious: the emergence of an enormous, vicious, well-armed, and well-trained parallel army to fight the guerillas was not some spontaneous act.

zh: 很多人相信，这是由正规军和政治精英们特别制定并实施的一种策略，目的是向民兵武装发起一场“非正式”的战争。
en: It was, many believed, a deliberate policy devised and carried out by the official military and the political elite to wage war “off the books.”

zh: “ parapolítica ”或“ paragate ”披露的消息似乎确认了另外一种疑惑：准军事力量和贩毒卡特尔之间的界限与民兵武装和贩毒卡特尔之间一样，差别可谓是微乎其微。
en: The parapolítica or paragate revelations seem to confirm another suspicion as well: the distinction between the paramilitaries and the drug cartels, like that between the guerrillas and the cartels, is a nuanced one.

zh: 不幸的是，上述事实披露发生的时间却很不恰当。
en: Unfortunately, these revelations come at the worst possible moment.

zh: 哥伦比亚与美国的自由贸易协定从共和党去年11月在参众两院失去多数席位起就一直处在危险状态。
en: Colombia’s FTA with the US was in danger the moment the US Republicans lost their majority in both houses of Congress last November.

zh: 尽管如此，哥伦比亚协议通过的可能性还是大于另外两个拉美国家（巴拿马和秘鲁）的贸易协定。
en: Still, it seemed more likely to pass than the other two pending Latin American trade deals with Panama and Peru.

zh: 但从目前的情况看，不仅乔治·W·布什总统在北半球最亲密盟友的自由贸易协定由于人权方面的原因在参众两院难获通过，而且同样这位盟友还面临着失去哥伦比亚计划（Plan Colombia）的危险，这项数额巨大、引起争议也异常巨大的美国援助计划从20世纪90年代开始就将成百上千亿美元注入到哥伦比亚，上述资金表面上看是为了对付毒品卡特尔，但实际目的也是为了镇压起义力量。
en: Now it appears that President George W. Bush’s closest ally in the hemisphere will not only have its FTA rejected, owing to human rights concerns in the US House and Senate. Moreover, it might also lose Plan Colombia, the huge – and hugely controversial – American aid program that has funneled tens of billions of dollars into Colombia since the late 1990’s, ostensibly to fight the drug cartels, but also, in fact, to wage counter-insurgency.

zh: 乌里韦花费了数周时间面对面地直接游说美国的重要立法者，这位哥伦比亚总统无疑是他自己最好的宣传员。
en: Uribe has spent weeks directly and personally lobbying key American legislators, and he is undoubtedly his own best advocate.

zh: 但正如前美国副总统阿尔·戈尔前不久在迈阿密拒绝与乌里韦同台演讲一样，很多国会议员都拒绝批准可能把自己与因侵犯人权或与毒品大鳄合谋而臭名昭著、或者兼有上述恶行的遍布污点的政府联系在一起的贸易协定或援助法案。
en: But, just as former US Vice-President Al Gore recently refused to share a dais with Uribe in Miami, many members of Congress refuse to approve a trade agreement or an aid package that may link them to a government tainted by egregious human rights abuses, complicity with drug lords, or both.

zh: 美国从未真正希望将人权问题纳入到贸易协定，在面对压力的时候，美国总统最多同意添加一些劳工和环境方面的要求。
en: The US has never really wanted to include human rights issues in trade agreements; at best, and only when forced, US presidents have consented to incorporating labor and environmental chapters.

zh: 而欧盟的想法却差异巨大，例如在与墨西哥签订的经济和自由贸易协定中，欧盟坚持¾并最终成功写入了“民主条款 ” ， 使得对民主规则和人权的一贯尊重成为了获得经济收益的前提。
en: The European Union thinks differently; in its economic cooperation and free trade agreement with Mexico, for example, it insisted on – and achieved – the inclusion of a “democracy clause” that made its economic benefits conditional on ongoing respect for democratic rule and human rights.

zh: 哥伦比亚遍布污点的人权记录不仅影响到哥政府的国际声誉，而且为有意破坏自由贸易协定的力量提供了充足的弹药。
en: Colombia’s blemished human rights record is affecting its government’s international standing and providing ammunition for those who wish to sabotage the FTA.

zh: 举例来讲，美国国会中赞同保护主义的民主党议员如果能够拒绝批准哥伦比亚自由贸易协定，就可以避免受到反对自由贸易的指责，即使他们很可能批准巴拿马和秘鲁贸易协定也改变不了这样的状况。
en: For example, protectionist Democrats in the US Congress have been able to insulate themselves from charges of opposing free trade if they scuttle Colombia’s FTA, because they will most likely ratify the deals for Panama and Peru.

zh: 乌里韦能否渡过目前的困难时期？
en: Can Uribe survive his current travails?

zh: 答案几乎肯定是可以，除非他本人直接陷入“ parapolítica ”困境，或者美国明确否决自由贸易协定，并推迟为哥伦比亚计划提供后续的资金，或者为继续注资提出附加条件。
en: The answer is almost certainly yes, unless the parapolítica mess reaches him directly, or the US explicitly rejects the FTA and postpones or attaches conditions to renewal of funding for Plan Colombia.

zh: 乌里韦的政治覆灭会让所有人受到伤害， 但出于人权方面的考虑否决自由贸易协定却能够开创健康的先河。
en: Uribe’s political demise would hurt everyone, but the rejection of the FTA on human rights grounds could set a healthy precedent.

zh: 在民主和人权历经高速发展的区域，将贸易和经济政策与这些理念挂钩是种不错的选择。
en: In a region where threats to democracy and human rights are growing, linking trade and economic policy to these considerations is not a bad idea.

zh: 乌里韦也许不该遭受这样的命运，但历史却会以一种奇特的方式发挥作用。
en: Uribe may not deserve such a fate, but history works in strange ways.

zh: 癌症的复发
en: Comeback Cancers

zh: 发自加拿大安大略省伦敦市 — — 人类在多种癌症的治疗方面都取得了进展，而病人的存活期也不断延长，这有赖于两方面的研究：癌症的早期诊断，以及更有效且毒性更低的治疗方法。
en: LONDON, ONTARIO – Progress is being made against many types of cancer, with more patients surviving longer, thanks to research on two fronts: improved methods for earlier detection, and development of therapies that are more effective and less toxic.

zh: 事实上，美国目前约有1000万名癌症康复者，且数量还在稳步上升。
en: Indeed, it is estimated that there are now more than 10 million cancer survivors in the United States alone, and this number has been steadily increasing.

zh: 其他发达国家康复者占总人口的比例也与美国相当。
en: Similar numbers, in proportion to population sizes, are found in other developed countries.

zh: 那些早期发现的癌症 — — 当癌瘤较为细小且尚未扩散（指从原发瘤处蔓延开来）时 — — 更容易通过局部治疗来应对，但一旦扩散则任何治疗方案的成功率都将微乎其微。
en: Cancers that are detected early – when they are small and less likely to have metastasized (spread away from the primary tumor) – are more likely to be treatable with local therapy, whereas successful treatment is ultimately unlikely once metastatic tumors develop.

zh: 而改良的疗法意味着病人可以得到更有效的药物治疗（也更可能得到足够的所需剂量 ） 。
en: And improved therapies mean that patients can be treated with drugs that work better (and that patients are more likely to receive the full dose needed).

zh: 但我们在检测和治疗癌症方面所取得的重大进展也引起了对肿瘤休眠问题的更多重视：病人往往似乎被治愈了，但却在数年甚至数十年之后复发。
en: But our dramatic progress in detecting and treating cancer has also led to growing awareness of the problem of tumor dormancy: a patient appears to be cured, only to have the same cancer return years or even decades later.

zh: 比如在乳腺癌和黑素瘤方面就有25年后再度复发的报告。
en: In breast cancer or melanoma, for example, recurrences 25 years after initial treatment have been reported.

zh: 随着癌症康复者的数量不断增多，我们需要进一步了解肿瘤休眠和转移性复发这两个过程。
en: With a growing number of cancer survivors, we need to understand better the twin processes of tumor dormancy and metastatic cancer recurrence.

zh: 虽然我们对癌症生理特征的理解大幅推进 — — 因此在某方面促进了新低毒药物的研制 — — 但对肿瘤转移尤其是长期肿瘤休眠之后的转移则相对较少。
en: While remarkable progress has been made in understanding the biology of cancer – leading in part to the development of new, less toxic drugs – our understanding of the biology of tumor metastasis, and especially the development of metastases after a long period of tumor dormancy, has lagged.

zh: 我们都知道转移是一个非常缓慢的过程，因为游离到血液中的大多数癌细胞都无法在其他器官中形成转移瘤。
en: We do know that metastasis is a very inefficient process, with most cancer cells that escape into the blood stream failing to form metastatic tumors in distant organs.

zh: 但同时来自来自实验室和临床的最新研究却发现许多游离出原发瘤的癌细胞都能寄居在其他器官中并进入休眠状态。
en: Recent studies – from both the laboratory and the clinic – suggest that many cancer cells that leave the primary tumor may lodge themselves in new organs and go into a dormant state.

zh: 同时也有证据证明这些休眠细胞可以抵抗目前大多数治疗方案。
en: We also have evidence that says that these dormant cells may resist most current treatments.

zh: 这意味着那些专门用于杀灭潜在微转移病症的癌症辅助疗法可能会忽略了一部分重要的弥散性癌症细胞，而这些细胞最终会醒来做恶。
en: This means that adjuvant cancer therapy, designed to kill presumed micrometastatic disease, may be missing an important fraction of disseminated cancer cells, some of which may eventually wake up.

zh: 此外，我们正着手识别那些控制癌症细胞进入冬眠状态并随后唤醒这些细胞的分子机制。
en: Moreover, we are beginning to identify molecular mechanisms that regulate the entry of cancer cells into a dormant state, as well as their re-awakening at later times.

zh: 我们对肿瘤休眠控制的认识还处于非常初级的阶段，但考虑到癌症康复者的数量不断增加，对这一知识的渴求也更加迫切了。
en: Our knowledge of the regulation of tumor dormancy is really in its infancy. But, given the growing numbers of cancer survivors, the need for this knowledge is becoming more pressing.

zh: 事实上，有证据显示肿瘤休眠是治疗的有效部位。
en: Indeed, there is evidence suggesting that tumor dormancy is a valid target for therapy.

zh: 比如对某些类型的乳腺癌来说，患者可能已经接受了超过十几年的抗荷尔蒙治疗，而且这些疗法也取得了成果 — — 成功防止了在某些短期疗法中可能出现的复发状况。
en: For example, in some types of breast cancer, patients may be treated for more than a decade with anti-hormone therapies, and these long-term treatments are working – they are successful at preventing some of the cancer recurrences that occur with shorter treatment.

zh: 但这些长期疗法虽然相对安全，却同时也存在副作用，而且只成功预防了少量的癌症复发。
en: But, while these long-term therapies are relatively safe, they do have side-effects, and the number of cancer recurrences that they prevent is small.

zh: 因此目前的挑战就是进一步了解肿瘤休眠和扩散的过程，并以此确定哪个病人更适合长期疗法。
en: The challenge today is thus to understand the processes of tumor dormancy and metastasis better, in order to determine more accurately which patients will benefit from long-term therapy.

zh: 我们还有许多东西要学，甚至目前该阶段连该问什么问题不知道。
en: We have much to learn, and at this stage don’t even know all of the questions to ask.

zh: 比如说：间接给药法是否和长期疗法一样有效？
en: Would intermittent therapy be as useful as long-term treatment?

zh: 某些原发癌或者是单个患者的某些特征是否能帮助我们预测谁将随后复发并出现扩散？
en: Are there features of the primary cancer, or of individual patients, that can help us predict who will develop late recurrences and metastatic disease?

zh: 后期复发是否根本无法在诊断中预测出来？
en: What if late recurrences simply cannot be predicted at diagnosis?

zh: 是否有某些可变因素 — — 比如生活方式，免疫系统状况或者环境状况 — — 可以影响患者是否发生后期复发？
en: Are there modifiable factors – for example, lifestyle, immune-system status, or environmental conditions – that influence whether or not patients develop late recurrences?

zh: 对这些问题的答案都需要研究，但针对扩散和肿瘤休眠的研究是相当困难的。
en: The answers to these questions will require research, and research into metastasis and tumor dormancy is difficult.

zh: 它需要耐心，创设相关模型，以及进行长期研究的决心。
en: It requires patience, development of models, and willingness to undertake long-term studies.

zh: 我们研究的现象是否具有普遍性？
en: We also need to understand better the prevalence of long-term dormant disease in patients.

zh: 可能许多癌症康复者身上都携带有弥散性肿瘤细胞，但只有其中一部分会重新激活。
en: How common is the phenomenon we are examining? It may be that many cancer patients harbor disseminated tumor cells, and not all of these cells are destined to re-awaken.

zh: 在某些方面，癌症研究的成功也给迅速“治愈”癌症施加了压力，导致临床和实验室研究者们更倾向于回避那些棘手的扩散和长期肿瘤休眠问题。
en: In some ways, the success of cancer research is fueling pressure to “cure” cancer quickly, steering clinical and laboratory researchers away from the tricky problems of metastasis and long-term tumor dormancy.

zh: 但这种做法最终将可能是短视的，因为癌症康复者的增加也导致了后期复发的增加。
en: This focus ultimately may be shortsighted, as the increasing number of cancer survivors leads to an increase in late recurrences.

zh: 事实上，扩散（而非原发瘤）才是大多数癌症致死的原因。
en: Metastases, not the primary tumor, are responsible for most cancer deaths.

zh: 如果我们希望继续提高癌症康复方面的数据，就必须学会如何防止，延迟或阻断导致这些转移性疾病的进程。
en: If we are to continue to improve on cancer survival statistics, we need to learn how to prevent, delay, or thwart the processes that give rise to metastatic disease.

zh: 从科米到水门事件路还很长
en: A Long Way from Comey to Watergate

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 唐纳德·特朗普总统解雇联邦调查局局长詹姆斯·科米的举动前所未有，特朗普担任总统后大部分所作所为也是一样。
en: PRINCETON – President Donald J. Trump’s firing of FBI Director James Comey is unprecedented, as is much of what Trump has undertaken as president.

zh: 尽管与44年前理查德·尼克松总统在水门丑闻期间臭名昭著的“星期六之夜大屠杀”有很多相似之处，但两者的政治局势却完全不同。
en: Despite similarities with President Richard M. Nixon’s infamous “Saturday Night Massacre” 44 years ago, during the Watergate scandal, the political situations are utterly different.

zh: 1973年10月，尼克松直到一个周末才下令解雇一位新任命的特别检察官阿奇博尔德·考克斯，后者之前刚刚发出传票，要求尼克松交出秘密录制的 — — 而且显而易见极具毁灭性的 — — 白宫录像。
en: In October 1973, Nixon, waiting until a weekend, ordered the dismissal of a newly appointed special prosecutor, Archibald Cox, who had issued a subpoena demanding that Nixon hand over secretly recorded – and, as would become clear, highly damning – White House tapes.

zh: 尼克松的反抗直截了当，而且结果是灾难性的。
en: Nixon’s defiance was direct, and the result was disastrous.

zh: 司法部长艾略特·理查德森和副部长威廉·拉克尔夏斯辞职抗议，而不是执行总统的命令。
en: Attorney General Elliot Richardson and Deputy Attorney General William Ruckelshaus resigned in protest rather than carry out the president’s order.

zh: 一名联邦法官裁定解雇考克斯非法。
en: A federal judge ruled the firing of Cox illegal.

zh: 民意调查则首次显示多数美国人赞成弹劾尼克松。
en: Public opinion polls showed, for the first time, a plurality of Americans favoring Nixon’s impeachment.

zh: 于是终场序幕开始。
en: It was the beginning of the end.

zh: 国会议员提出弹劾决议。
en: Congressmen introduced impeachment resolutions.

zh: 尼克松被迫任命一名新的特别检察官。
en: Nixon was forced to appoint a new special prosecutor.

zh: 这出闹剧又上演了十个月，直到最高法院一致命令尼克松交出录像带。
en: The drama thickened for another ten months, until the Supreme Court unanimously ordered Nixon to surrender the tapes.

zh: 几天后，为避免面临这场毫无疑义的弹劾和免职，尼克松辞职了。
en: A few days after that, Nixon resigned rather than face certain impeachment and removal from office.

zh: 相比之下，除非天上的星星重新列队，特朗普解雇科米也许不会标志着任何事情的开始，至少不是什么对总统有害的事。
en: By contrast, unless the stars realign, Trump’s firing of Comey may mark the beginning of nothing, or at least of nothing bad for the president.

zh: 特朗普像尼克松一样很可能犯有严重到应当接受弹劾的罪行 — — 甚至有可能比尼克松的罪行更加严重。
en: Trump, like Nixon, may well be guilty of grave impeachable offenses – even graver offenses than Nixon’s.

zh: 特朗普像尼克松一样可能担心除非解雇负责调查他的人，否则某些可怕的真相将会遭到揭露。
en: Trump, like Nixon, may have feared that unless he fired the person in charge of investigating him, some terrible revelation would be forthcoming.

zh: 但即使这一切都是事实，特朗普和尼克松的不同之处是他很可能会逍遥法外。
en: But, even if all this is so, Trump, unlike Nixon, may very well get away with it.

zh: 这两起事件有许多不同，包括在它们发生的时机上。
en: The two events differ in many ways, including their timing.

zh: 到尼克松解雇考克斯时，水门事件发酵的时间已经远长于有关特朗普和俄罗斯的指控，因此神经已经处于高度的紧张状态。
en: By the time Nixon fired Cox, the Watergate affair had been building for far longer than the allegations about Trump and Russia have, so nerves had been rubbed raw.

zh: 但最重要的差异是在政治领域。
en: The main differences, though, are political.

zh: 在尼克松的时代，坚定的反对派民主党牢牢占据着国会参众两院的多数，还有一些共和党人，尤其是在参议院，对宪法的关切胜过对其自身党派。
en: In Nixon’s time, there were solid adversarial Democratic majorities in both houses of Congress, and there were also some Republicans, especially in the Senate, who put concerns about the Constitution ahead of concerns for their party.

zh: 参议院任命了一个特别委员会，由民主党人山姆·艾尔文和共和党人霍华德·贝克领导，负责听取证词和收集官方证据，正是他们的工作最终导致40名行政官员被起诉和几位白宫高级助理被定罪，以及最后尼克松的辞职下台。
en: The Senate appointed a special select committee, headed by Democrat Sam Ervin and Republican Howard Baker, which heard testimony and gathered official evidence that led to the indictment of 40 administration officials and the conviction of several top White House aides, as well as to Nixon’s resignation.

zh: 而今天共和党的多数议员似乎单方面致力于延缓和缩窄对俄罗斯全力支持特朗普赢得2016年大选进行任何严肃的调查活动，相关报告已经完全拥有过硬的证据支持。
en: Today’s Republican congressional majorities, however, have seemed singularly devoted to slowing and narrowing any serious inquiry into the thoroughly substantiated reports of Russian efforts to throw the 2016 election to Trump.

zh: 虽然也有人谈论，其中甚至不乏某些共和党人，任命一个专门委员会或一位特别检察官来调查有关俄罗斯和特朗普竞选的指控，但与1973年相比，这一调查却遭遇了非同寻常的阻力
en: Although there has been talk, even from some Republicans, about appointing a select committee or a special prosecutor to look into the allegations about the Russians and the Trump campaign, the resistance has been extraordinary compared to 1973.

zh: 上周发生的事件显示，共和党人显然宁愿指责内部人泄密，还有希拉里·克林顿的电邮服务器事件也不愿调查白宫故意不去查证前国家安全顾问迈克尔·弗林与俄罗斯和土耳其之间的惊人关系。
en: Based on the events of the last week, Republicans evidently would rather rail against insider leaks and, yes, Hillary Clinton’s email server than inquire into the White House’s insouciance about former National Security Adviser Michael Flynn’s alarming links to Russia and Turkey.

zh: 如果不出现大的转变，国会调查仍将局限在众议院和参议院常设委员会，他们既没有足够的人力也没有足够的动机去调查这件事。
en: Without a significant shift, the congressional investigations will continue to remain confined to the standing House and Senate committees, where they will likely remain understaffed and under-motivated.

zh: 然后还有媒体。
en: Then there is the press.

zh: 1973年，在多数新闻媒体都放弃报道这一事件后 ， 《 华盛顿邮报》卡尔·伯恩斯坦和鲍勃·伍德沃德的顽强报道维系了水门事件的活跃度。
en: In 1973, dogged reporting by Carl Bernstein and Bob Woodward of the Washington Post kept the Watergate story alive, after most news outlets had dropped it.

zh: 一旦报道得到了外界认可，其余媒体也都开始关注这一丑闻并继续维持对以尼克松为首的白宫的压力。
en: Once their reporting gained traction, the rest of the press picked up the scandal and kept up the pressure on the Nixon White House.

zh: 今天，特朗普可以指望尼克松只能暗暗祈祷的宣传攻势的强烈支持，包括毫无廉耻地挑起论战的福克斯新闻和布莱巴特新闻，还有无数的微博博主（以及俄国控制的网络机器人）制造出大量亲特朗普的宣传攻势。
en: Today, Trump can count on the fervent support of propaganda operations that Nixon could only have prayed for, including the unabashedly polemical Fox News and Breitbart News, as well as the countless bloggers (and, for that matter, Russian-controlled cyberbots) pumping out pro-Trump propaganda.

zh: 在我写这篇文章时，一个又一个福克斯评论员像鹦鹉学舌般地传播白宫的荒谬说法，称特朗普解雇科米是因为这位联邦调查局局长在克林顿竞选期间可怕的所作所为。
en: As I write this, one Fox commentator after another is parroting the White House’s absurd claim that Trump fired Comey because of the terrible things the FBI director did to Clinton during the campaign.

zh: 几乎可以预料福克斯新闻网最大的明星肖恩·汉尼斯开始在直播中煽动“把他关起来”的反对科米的呼声。
en: One almost expects the network’s biggest star, Sean Hannity, to start leading on-air anti-Comey chants of “Lock Him Up!”

zh: 目前局势在那些记得去年10月特朗普曾为科米喝彩，而后由戴着红帽子的支持者宗教仪式般地叫嚣要监禁狡诈的希拉里的人看来是颇具迷幻色彩的。
en: The effect on anyone who recalls Trump’s cheerleading for Comey last October – followed by the red-hatted crowds’ ritualistic baying to jail crooked Hillary – is psychedelic.

zh: 但福克斯新闻网的粉丝总是相信这家电视台的报道。
en: But fans of Fox News usually believe what the channel reports.

zh: 尽管尼克松曾经拥有福克斯新闻未来的斯文加利式人物 — — 年轻的罗杰·艾尔斯的支持，但却远没有完全赢得福克斯和其他新闻媒体。
en: And while Nixon had Fox News' future Svengali, a young Roger Ailes, behind him, Fox and the rest were still two decades away.

zh: 当然，特朗普解雇科米有可能促使某些共和党人受够了特朗普的欺骗并开始仿效贝克的范例。
en: It is possible, of course, that Trump’s firing of Comey will push some Republicans to decide that enough is enough and follow Baker’s example.

zh: 早期的反应良莠不齐：尽管共和党参议员杰夫·弗莱克（Jeff Flake ） 、 约翰·麦凯恩（John McCain）和本·萨斯（Ben Sasse）都表示了不同程度的失望，但通常思想独立的参议员苏珊·柯林斯（Susan Collins）和林赛·格雷厄姆（Lindsey Graham）都支持特朗普的决定。
en: The early responses have been mixed: although Republican Senators Jeff Flake, John McCain, and Ben Sasse have expressed varying degrees of disappointment, normally independent-minded Senators Susan Collins and Lindsey Graham have backed Trump’s decision.

zh: 但在这样动荡的环境中，总是存在打破交易、证人翻供、像导致尼克松垮台一样能证明特朗普有罪的证据一点一滴浮出水面的可能性。
en: There is always a chance, in such a volatile climate, that deals will be broken, witnesses will flip, and facts will emerge that are every bit as incriminating as the evidence that felled Nixon.

zh: 国际事态的发展也可能唤醒一些共和党人，使他们认识到俄国对西方民主国家的攻势，这样的攻势在法国选举刚刚开始时就像是一场未经宣布的战争。
en: International developments might also awaken some Republicans to the magnitude of the Russian offensive on Western democracies, an offensive which, in the wake of the French elections, feels like an undeclared war.

zh: 但是到目前为止，没有理由将特朗普解雇科米看作“星期六之夜大屠杀”或美国政治史上其他政治事件的重演。
en: For the moment, though, there is no reason to see Trump’s firing of Comey as a re-run of Nixon’s “Saturday Night Massacre,” or any other event in American political history.

zh: 美国总统的所作所为可能就像尼克松那样疑似要掩盖真相，但在目前局面下这还不足以曝光他所掩盖的事实。
en: The president may be acting as if he has something terrible to hide, just as Nixon did, but that won’t be enough under the circumstances to cause the exposure of whatever it may be.

zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，特朗普这位输掉民众投票、并通过赢得选举团挤进白宫的自封的局外人总统现在却发现自己在某种程度上得到了比党内人士尼克松更好的保护，后者1972年当选总统时获得了压倒多数的民众和选举团支持。
en: Ironically, Trump, the self-declared outsider who lost the popular vote and squeaked into office by winning the Electoral College, finds himself, for the moment, in some ways more protected than the party man Nixon, who won the 1972 election by overwhelming popular as well as electoral margins.

zh: 承认这一点可能令人不安，但无论局势看似多么悲惨和滑稽，历史都不会简单重复。
en: It may be unsettling to acknowledge, but history is not repeating itself, no matter how tragic or farcical things might appear.

zh: 特朗普还有下台的可能，但需要改变的东西仍有很多。
en: Trump may yet fall, but a lot will have to change.

zh: 即将到来的反民族革命
en: The Coming Anti-National Revolution

zh: 纽黑文—过去几个世纪中，世界经历了一连串各式各样的反压迫知识革命。
en: NEW HAVEN – For the past several centuries, the world has experienced a sequence of intellectual revolutions against oppression of one sort or another.

zh: 这些革命发生在人的思维中，不是通过战争（战争总是有多重根源 ） ， 而是通过语言和通讯技术传播，最终遍及世界绝大部分地区。
en: These revolutions operate in the minds of humans and are spread – eventually to most of the world – not by war (which tends to involve multiple causes), but by language and communications technology.

zh: 最后，这些革命所推动的思想 — — 与战争的根源不同 — — 变得无可争议。
en: Ultimately, the ideas they advance – unlike the causes of war – become noncontroversial.

zh: 我认为，下一场这类革命可能会在二十一世纪发生，它将挑战民族国家的经济意义。
en: I think the next such revolution, likely sometime in the twenty-first century, will challenge the economic implications of the nation-state.

zh: 这场革命将聚焦于不公，而不公源自一个事实，即一些人完全是因为运气而生在穷国，而另一些人生在富国。
en: It will focus on the injustice that follows from the fact that, entirely by chance, some are born in poor countries and others in rich countries.

zh: 随着越来越多的人在跨国公司工作，能够遇见来自其他国家的人，我对于公平的感觉也在受到影响。
en: As more people work for multinational firms and meet and get to know more people from other countries, our sense of justice is being affected.

zh: 这并不是全新的情况。
en: This is hardly unprecedented.

zh: 在《1688：第一场现代革命 》 （ 1688: The First Modern Revolution）一书中，历史学家史蒂文·平克斯（Steven Pincus）令人信服地指出，看待所谓的“光荣革命”的最佳角度不是英格兰议会派推翻了天主教国王，而是开启了世界公平革命的新时代。
en: In his book 1688: The First Modern Revolution, the historian Steven Pincus argues convincingly that the so-called “Glorious Revolution” is best thought of not in terms of the overthrow of a Catholic king by parliamentarians in England, but as the beginning of a worldwide revolution in justice.

zh: 不要光盯着战场。
en: Don’t think battlefields.

zh: 相反，要想想当时流行起来的提供免费分享的报纸的咖啡屋 — — 即复杂交流的场所。
en: Think, instead, of the coffeehouses with free, shared newspapers that became popular around then – places for complex communications.

zh: 即便如此，光荣革命显然标志着全世界开始尊重不赞同强势君主所要求的的“思想统一”的群体的合法性。
en: Even as it happened, the Glorious Revolution clearly marked the beginning of a worldwide appreciation of the legitimacy of groups that do not share the “ideological unity” demanded by a strong king.

zh: 1776年1月，托马斯·潘恩（Thomas Paine）出版小书《常识 》 （ Common Sense ） ， 成为美国十三个殖民州的头号畅销书。 该书标志着另一场此类革命，它不同于一年多后爆发的独立战争（独立战争有着多重根源 ） 。
en: Thomas Paine’s pamphlet Common Sense, a huge bestseller in the Thirteen Colonies when it was published in January 1776, marked another such revolution, which was not identical with the Revolutionary War against Britain that began later that year (and had multiple causes).

zh: 《常识》所触及到的层面是无法衡量的，因为它不但被出售，更是在教堂和集会上被大声朗读。
en: The reach of Common Sense is immeasurable, because it wasn’t just sold but was also read aloud at churches and meetings.

zh: 世袭君主在精神上主宰我们其他人的思想遭到了决定性的拒绝。
en: The idea that hereditary monarchs were somehow spiritually superior to the rest of us was decisively rejected.

zh: 当今世界，包括英国在内都同意这一点。
en: Most of the world today, including Britain, agrees.

zh: 奴隶制的逐渐废除也是如此，它主要不是靠战争，而是靠日益兴起的对残酷和不公的群众意识。
en: The same could be said of the gradual abolition of slavery, which was mostly achieved not by war, but by an emerging popular recognition of its cruelty and injustice.

zh: 此后的1848年欧洲大暴动是对只有少数男性（地主和贵族）才能参与的选举法的示威。
en: The 1848 uprisings around Europe were substantially a protest against voting laws that limited voting to only a minority of men: property holders or aristocrats.

zh: 妇女选举权紧随其后。
en: Women’s suffrage followed soon after.

zh: 在二十世纪和二十一世纪，我们看到民权扩大到种族和性少数群体。
en: In the twentieth and twenty-first centuries, we have seen civil rights extended to racial and sexual minorities.

zh: 所有这些过去的“公平革命”都源自通讯进步。
en: All of the past “justice revolutions” have stemmed from improved communications.

zh: 镇压因距离而兴，因并不实际面对或目睹被镇压者而兴。
en: Oppression thrives on distance, on not actually meeting or seeing the oppressed.

zh: 下一场革命不会消除出生地的影响，单民族成分特权将得到遏制。
en: The next revolution will not abolish the consequences of place of birth, but the privileges of nationhood will be tempered.

zh: 尽管如今遍及全球的反移民情绪的兴起似乎指向相反的方向，但随着通讯的继续增长，不公平感会放大。
en: While the rise in anti-immigrant sentiment around the world today seems to point in the opposite direction, the sense of injustice will be amplified as communications continue to grow.

zh: 最后，对错误的认识将带来巨大的变革。
en: Ultimately, recognition of wrong will wreak big changes.

zh: 现在，这一认识仍然面临爱国冲动的强大竞争，爱国冲动的根源是国民之间的社会契约。 多年来，国民缴纳税收、参军服役，参与建设或保卫他们视之为专属于他们的东西。
en: For now, this recognition still faces strong competition from patriotic impulses, rooted in a social contract among nationals who have paid taxes over the years or performed military service to build or defend what they saw as exclusively theirs.

zh: 放任无限量移民涌入似乎与这一期约相悖。
en: Allowing unlimited immigration would seem to violate this contract.

zh: 但解决出生地不公的最重要举措可能不会针对移民。
en: But the most important steps to address birthplace injustice probably will not target immigration.

zh: 相反，它们专注于构建经济自由。
en: Instead, they will focus on fostering economic freedom.

zh: 1948年，保罗·萨缪尔逊（Paul A. Samuelson）的“要素价格均衡定理”清楚地表明，在无限制的无运输成本自由贸易（以及其他理想化假设）的条件下，市场力量将让全世界所有生产要素价格趋于一致，包括所有标准化劳动的工资率。
en: In 1948, Paul A. Samuelson’s “factor-price equalization theorem” lucidly showed that under conditions of unlimited free trade without transportation costs (and with other idealized assumptions), market forces would equalize the prices of all factors of production, including the wage rate for any standardized kind of labor, around the world.

zh: 在完美世界中，人们不必搬到外国追求更高的工资。
en: In a perfect world, people don’t have to move to another country to get a higher wage.

zh: 最终，他们只需要能够参与生产在国际市场上销售的产出。
en: Ultimately, they need only be able to participate in producing output that is sold internationally.

zh: 随着技术让运输和通讯成本降低到接近于消失的水平，实现这一价格一致化也变得越来越现实。
en: As technology reduces the cost of transportation and communications to near the vanishing point, achieving this equalization is increasingly feasible.

zh: 但价格一致化需要消除旧壁垒、防止新壁垒。
en: But getting there requires removing old barriers and preventing the erection of new ones.

zh: 最近正在谈判中的自由贸易协定 — — 跨太平洋合作伙伴关系 和跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系因为利益集团妄图借此实现自身目的而陷入僵局。
en: Recent free-trade agreements under discussion, the Trans-Pacific Partnership and the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership, have suffered setbacks as interest groups attempt to bend them to their own aims.

zh: 但是，最终我们需要 — — 也有望获得 — — 比它们更好的协定。
en: But, ultimately, we need – and probably will get – even better such agreements.

zh: 要实现要素价格的一致化，人们需要一个稳定的基础，让现实生活职业生涯与他们并不实际居住的国家联系起来。
en: To achieve factor-price equalization, people need a stable base for a real lifetime career connected to a country in which they do not physically reside.

zh: 我们还需要保护现有民族国家中的对外贸易输家。
en: We also need to protect the losers to foreign trade in our existing nation-states.

zh: 美国贸易调整援助计划（TAA）的根源可以追溯到1974年。
en: Trade Adjustment Assistance (TAA) traces its roots in the United States back to 1974.

zh: 加拿大在1995年进行了收入补充计划实验。
en: Canada experimented in 1995 with an Earnings Supplement Project.

zh: 始于2006年的欧洲全球化调整基金年预算只有1.5亿欧元。
en: The European Globalization Adjustment Fund, started in 2006, has a tiny annual budget of €150 million ($168.6 million).

zh: 美国总统奥巴马提出要扩大TAA计划。
en: US President Barack Obama has proposed to expand the TAA program.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，这一提议还仍然只是实验或提议。
en: But, so far, this has meant little more than experiments or proposals.

zh: 最终，下一场革命可能来自日常互动 — — 我们在电脑屏幕上与我们所见的聪慧体面外国人的互动，他们碰巧 — — 而不是出于自身选择 — — 生活在贫困中。
en: Ultimately, the next revolution will likely stem from daily interactions on computer monitors with foreigners whom we can see are intelligent, decent people – people who happen, through no choice of their own, to be living in poverty.

zh: 这应该能带来更好的贸易协定，更好的贸易协定带来社会保险的数量级增长，社会保险在向更公平的全球经济的转型过程中保护一个国家中的人民。
en: This should lead to better trade agreements, which presuppose the eventual development of orders of magnitude more social insurance to protect people within a country during the transition to a more just global economy.

zh: 即将到来的资本主义3.0
en: Coming Soon: Capitalism 3.0

zh: 剑桥 - - 资本主义现在处于近百年来最严重的危机之中。
en: CAMBRIDGE ­– Capitalism is in the throes of its most severe crisis in many decades.

zh: 严重的衰退、全球经济脱节以及世界上发达经济体金融部门实质上大量国有化已经深深地破坏了市场和国家之间的平衡。
en: A combination of deep recession, global economic dislocations, and effective nationalization of large swathes of the financial sector in the world’s advanced economies has deeply unsettled the balance between markets and states.

zh: 人们都在猜测新的平衡在哪里可以找到。
en: Where the new balance will be struck is anybody’s guess.

zh: 那些预言资本主义灭亡的人必须面对一个重要的历史事实，那就是，资本主义具有几乎无限量的重新塑造自我的能力。
en: Those who predict capitalism’s demise have to contend with one important historical fact: capitalism has an almost unlimited capacity to reinvent itself.

zh: 的确，资本主义的可塑性是它克服几百年来周期性危机并且挺过了从马克思以来的抨击的原因。
en: Indeed, its malleability is the reason it has overcome periodic crises over the centuries and outlived critics from Karl Marx on.

zh: 资本主义能否存活不是问题，它肯定可以。 真正的问题是，世界各国领导人是否展示出必要的领导力，在我们从当前危机中脱身的时候把资本主义带入下一个阶段。
en: The real question is not whether capitalism can survive – it can – but whether world leaders will demonstrate the leadership needed to take it to its next phase as we emerge from our current predicament.

zh: 在释放人类社会共同的经济能力上，资本主义无人可比。
en: Capitalism has no equal when it comes to unleashing the collective economic energies of human societies.

zh: 这就是为何从广义上说所有繁荣的社会都奉行资本主义。 这些社会围绕私有财产而建立，并且允许市场在分配资源、决定经济奖赏上发挥重大作用。
en: That is why all prosperous societies are capitalistic in the broad sense of the term: they are organized around private property and allow markets to play a large role in allocating resources and determining economic rewards.

zh: 然而前提条件是，财产权利和市场都无法依赖自身运行。
en: The catch is that neither property rights nor markets can function on their own.

zh: 他们需要其他社会机构予以支持。
en: They require other social institutions to support them.

zh: 所以，产权依赖于法院和执法，市场依赖于监管者来限制滥用并且解决市场崩溃问题。
en: So property rights rely on courts and legal enforcement, and markets depend on regulators to rein in abuse and fix market failures.

zh: 在政治层面上，资本主义需要报酬和转移机制以便使得其结果可以让人接受。
en: At the political level, capitalism requires compensation and transfer mechanisms to render its outcomes acceptable.

zh: 正如当前危机再次证明的一样，资本主义需要稳定性的安排，例如最后靠山的借贷者以及反向周期的财政政策。
en: As the current crisis has demonstrated yet again, capitalism needs stabilizing arrangements such as a lender of last resort and counter-cyclical fiscal policy.

zh: 换言之，资本主义并非自我创造、自我维系、自我监管或者自我稳定。
en: In other words, capitalism is not self-creating, self-sustaining, self-regulating, or self-stabilizing.

zh: 资本主义的历史就是一个学习和重新学习这些道理的过程。 亚当斯密理想化的市场社会要求国家仅仅起到守夜人的作用，仅此而已。
en: The history of capitalism has been a process of learning and re-learning these lessons.  Adam Smith’s idealized market society required little more than a “night-watchman state.”

zh: 政府所要做的全部事情就是确保其分工就是落实产权、维护和平并且征收些许税款用于有限范围的公益。
en: All that governments needed to do to ensure the division of labor was to enforce property rights, keep the peace, and collect a few taxes to pay for a limited range of public goods.

zh: 二十世纪早期，有限的公共机构管理资本主义加以维系。
en: Through the early part of the twentieth century, capitalism was governed by a narrow vision of the public institutions needed to uphold it.

zh: 在实践上，国家发挥的作用经常超越这一观点(例如，1889年陴斯麦在德国推出了养老金 ) 。
en: In practice, the state’s reach often went beyond this conception (as, say, in the case of Bismarck’s introduction of old-age pensions in Germany in 1889).

zh: 但是各国政府继续用限制的眼光来看待其经济作用。
en: But governments continued to see their economic roles in restricted terms.

zh: 这一局面随着社会越发民主、工会以及其他团体越发团结一致反对人们所视的资本主义剥削而开始改变。
en: This began to change as societies became more democratic and labor unions and other groups mobilized against capitalism’s perceived abuses.

zh: 美国试行了反托拉斯政策。
en: Anti-trust policies were spearheaded in the Unites States.

zh: 经济大萧条之后，积极的货币和财政政策作用变得广为接受。
en: The usefulness of activist monetary and fiscal policies became widely accepted in the aftermath of the Great Depression.

zh: 当今工业化国家中公共开支在国民收入中的比例快速上升，从十九世纪末的平均百分之十不到上升到二次大战前的百分之二十以上。
en: The share of public spending in national income rose rapidly in today’s industrialized countries, from below 10% on average at the end of the nineteenth century to more than 20% just before World War II.

zh: 二战结束后，大��数国家建立了精密的社会福利。 在这些国家中，公共部门扩大到国民收入的平均百分之四十以上。
en: And, in the wake of WWII, most countries erected elaborate social-welfare states in which the public sector expanded to more than 40% of national income on average.

zh: 这一“混合经济”模式是二十世纪的杰出成就之一。
en: This “mixed-economy” model was the crowning achievement of the twentieth century.

zh: 在国家和市场之间建立的新平衡开创了发达国家前所未有的社会凝聚、稳定以及繁荣时期。 这一时期一直持续到七十年代中期。
en: The new balance that it established between state and market set the stage for an unprecedented period of social cohesion, stability, and prosperity in the advanced economies that lasted until the mid-1970’s.

zh: 从八十年代以来，这一模式受到创伤，现在似乎已经崩溃。
en: This model became frayed from the 1980’s on, and now appears to have broken down.

zh: 可以用一个词来解释其原因，那就是全球化。
en: The reason can be expressed in one word: globalization.

zh: 战后混合经济是为民族国家建立并且在这一层面上运转的。 这一局面需要阻止国际经济。
en: The postwar mixed economy was built for and operated at the level of nation-states, and required keeping the international economy at bay.

zh: 布雷顿森林体系和关贸总协定体制导致国际经济联合的“影子”形式。 这一形式对国际资本流动施加控制。
en: The Bretton Woods-GATT regime entailed a “shallow” form of international economic integration that implied controls on international capital flows, which Keynes and his contemporaries had viewed as crucial for domestic economic management.

zh: 凯恩斯及其同时代人将其视为管理国内经济的关键所在。 这要求各国实行仅仅是有限的贸易自由化，而且对社会敏感部门，例如农业、纺织品以及服务做出了大量的例外。
en: Countries were required to undertake only limited trade liberalization, with plenty of exceptions for socially sensitive sectors (agriculture, textiles, services).

zh: 这样，各国只要遵守几个简单的国际规则就可以自由地建立自身的国家资本主义版本。
en: This left them free to build their own versions of national capitalism, as long as they obeyed a few simple international rules.

zh: 当前的危机表明形势发生了多大的变化。
en: The current crisis shows how far we have come from that model.

zh: 特别是金融全球化破坏了旧有的规则。
en: Financial globalization, in particular, played havoc with the old rules.

zh: 当中国模式的资本主义遇到美国模式的资本主义的时候，由于没有什么保障体系，就会导致爆炸性的混合。
en: When Chinese-style capitalism met American-style capitalism, with few safety valves in place, it gave rise to an explosive mix.

zh: 没有什么保护性机制来防止全球流动资金过剩。 随后加上美国监管不力，造成庞大的房地产泡沫和崩溃。
en: There were no protective mechanisms to prevent a global liquidity glut from developing, and then, in combination with US regulatory failings, from producing a spectacular housing boom and crash.

zh: 国际上也没有什么东西可以阻拦危机蔓延。
en: Nor were there any international roadblocks to prevent the crisis from spreading from its epicenter.

zh: 人们得出的教训并不是资本主义已经死了，而是我们应该重新塑造适应新世纪的资本主义。
en: The lesson is not that capitalism is dead. It is that we need to reinvent it for a new century in which the forces of economic globalization are much more powerful than before.

zh: 在这一新世纪中，经济全球化的力量要远远大于以往。 正如亚当斯密基本资本主义转变成为凯恩斯的混合经济，我们需要考虑各国混合经济转型到全球经济。
en: Just as Smith’s minimal capitalism was transformed into Keynes’ mixed economy, we need to contemplate a transition from the national version of the mixed economy to its global counterpart.

zh: 这就意味着我们需要构想市场及其支撑机制在全球层面上更好的平衡。
en: This means imagining a better balance between markets and their supporting institutions at the global level .

zh: 有时，这就要求把各种机制从民族国家中延伸开来并且强化全球管治。
en: Sometimes, this will require extending institutions outward from nation states and strengthening global governance.

zh: 另外有些时候，这意味着防止市场扩展到机制范围以外，而这些机制又必须限于国家的范围。
en: At other times, it will mean preventing markets from expanding beyond the reach of institutions that must remain national.

zh: 正确的措施将会因国情以及问题范围不同而各不相同。
en: The right approach will differ across country groupings and among issue areas.

zh: 设计下一代资本主义并非易事。
en: Designing the next capitalism will not be easy.

zh: 但是我们的确可以有历史可以证明，那就是资本主义的可取之处就在于其几乎可以无限可塑。
en: But we do have history on our side: capitalism’s saving grace is that it is almost infinitely malleable.

zh: 正确认识历史
en: Coming to Grips with History

zh: 五月九日将会是莫斯科最重要的庆典。
en: May 9th will be the mother of all celebrations in Moscow.

zh: 这是战胜纳粹德国的60周年纪念日，为此而牺牲生命的人们将被隆重地纪念。
en: The victory over Nazi-Germany 60 years ago will be commemorated and the human sacrifices to this end honoured.

zh: 到目前为止，一切顺利。
en: So far, so good.

zh: 但有几个国家将会缺席聚会。
en: But some nations will be missing from the party.

zh: 两位波罗的海国家的总统决定不出席，因为他们的东道主拒绝承认第二次世界大战结束的历史比战胜希特勒有着更多的内容：由于希特勒和斯大林在战争之初达成的交易，他们的民族不得不面对长达半个世纪的占领。
en: Two Baltic presidents have decided to stay home, because their hosts are not willing to concede that there is more to the history of WWII’s end than the victory over Hitler.

zh: 这个交易就是将东欧在纳粹德国和苏联之间瓜分的所谓1939年《莫洛托夫与里宾特洛甫协议 》 （ Molotov-Rippentrop Pact ） 。
en: Their peoples had to face half a century of occupation because of a deal struck before the war’s onset by Hitler and Stalin, the so-called Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact of 1939 that divided Eastern Europe between Nazi-Germany and the Soviet Union.

zh: 而我对第三位波罗的海国家总统—拉脱维亚的瓦伊拉·维凯-弗赖贝加(Vaira Vike-Freiberga ) — 表示由衷的敬佩。 她决定前往莫斯科，向值得致敬的人致敬，同时也大声指出不应被隐藏的历史。
en: I have to admire the third Baltic president – Vaira Vike-Freiberga from Latvia – who decided to go to Moscow, honouring what should be honoured, and speaking aloud about what should not be hidden.

zh: 通过这样的方式，她表明了她的国家作为北约和欧盟成员的强硬立场，同时也使自己处在道义上的强势地位。
en: By doing so she demonstrates the strong position her country has obtained as a member of NATO and the EU, and she will be the one riding the high moral ground.

zh: 遗憾的是当今的俄罗斯领导人选择不对多年以来对整个波罗的海地区的发展造成破坏的《莫洛托夫与里宾特洛甫协议》加以谴责。 而该协议至今仍是严重威胁俄罗斯及其波罗的海邻国之间关系的政治污染源。
en: It is a pity that the Russian leadership of today has chosen not to condemn the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact that damaged the development of the whole Baltic Sea region for so many years – and still is a source of political pollution threatening to poison relations between neighbors around the Baltic Sea.

zh: 我认为将《莫洛托夫与里宾特洛甫协议》解释为仅仅是建立苏维埃国家安全的一种方式的说法是难以接受的。
en: I find it difficult to accept those who tend to describe the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact as only a measure to build up Soviet national security.

zh: 如果我们回顾过去的90年，波罗的海地区有着一段让我们特别难以应对的历史。
en: In the Baltic Sea Region we have a particularly difficult history to deal with, if we look at the last 90 years.

zh: 在第一次世界大战和旧秩序 - “ Die Welt von Gestern ” - 终结以后，波罗的海地区见证了血腥的革命、恐怖的内战、法西斯主义、共产主义、种族大屠杀、占领、镇压、恐怖主义和流放—不胜枚举。 在这世界的一隅，我们经历了现代社会的所有恐怖。
en: After the end of WWI and the old order – “Die Welt von Gestern” – the Baltic region saw bloody revolutions, terrible civil wars, fascism, communism, genocide, occupations, oppression, terrorism, deportations – you name it, in our part of the world we have indeed had our share of all the horrors of the modern history.

zh: 当‘冷战’结束时，将其说成是“历史的终结”似乎是聪明的。
en: When the Cold War ended, it seemed clever to say that this was “the end of History.”

zh: 但如果我们信以为真—如果我们将历史封藏并遗忘—我们就冒着让历史在恐怖中重演的风险。
en: But if we believe that – if we put a lid on history and leave it behind us – we run a risk that history will resurrect itself with all its horrors.

zh: 因此我们必须正确认识历史，特别是在波罗的海地区，这种认识是建立互信与合作的根本前提条件。
en: Therefore we must come to terms with history, particularly in the Baltic Sea region, where such a reckoning is a fundamental precondition for building mutual confidence and cooperation.

zh: 如果你想在与宿敌的关系中开辟“新的篇章 ” ， 你就不能简单地以否定或压制历史的方式合上“旧的篇章 ” 。
en: If you want to open “new chapters” in relations between old adversaries, you cannot simply close “old chapters” by denying or suppressing history.

zh: 这样做不会有任何好处—这样的事情我们在过去已经见得太多了。
en: Nothing good comes out of doing so – and we have seen enough of that in the past.

zh: 多年以来波罗的海地区就是欧洲政治地图上的一条死胡同—被“铁幕”分割开来。
en: For too many years the Baltic Sea was a blind alley on the political map of Europe – divided by the Iron Curtain.

zh: 它不是共产主义的宣传中所称的“和平之海 ” ， 而是充满不安定和失落的机会的“威胁之海 ” 。
en: It was not a “Sea of Peace” – as the communist propaganda tried to describe it – it was a Sea of Threats, a sea of insecurity and lost opportunities.

zh: 对我的国家丹麦而言，二战的结束意味着自由和民主的回归，并且我们可以用20世纪余下的时间去强化我们的自由，并辅之以富裕。
en: To my country – Denmark – WWII’s end meant a return to freedom and democracy, and we could use the rest of the 20th century to strengthen our freedom, bolstering it with affluence.

zh: 但对于这三个波罗的海国家而言，二战的结束却将它们引入了长达半个世纪的占领和机遇的丧失。
en: But to the three Baltic countries the end of WWII led to half a century of occupation and lost opportunities.

zh: 我们都知道背后的原因：1939年苏联和纳粹德国在《互不侵犯条约》下签订的一个秘密协议 - 《 莫洛托夫与里宾特洛甫协议 》 - 明确了东欧两个独裁政权彼此的势力范围，导致了与芬兰开战，对波罗的海国家的占领，对波兰的进攻与分割，并很可能也导致了对挪威和丹麦的占领。
en: We know to day the cause: the secret protocol to the Treaty of Non-aggression between the Soviet Union and Nazi-Germany, signed in 1939 – the Molotov-Ribbentrop Pact – defining the spheres of interest of the two dictatorships in eastern Europe which led to the war with Finland, the occupations of the Baltic countries, the assault on and division of Poland, and probably also the occupations of Norway and Denmark.

zh: 简言之，这一协定及其赘生物对我们地区的历史造成了重大影响并一直延续到今天。
en: In short, this pact with its excrescence had an enormous impact on the history of our region, right up to this day.

zh: 这就是为什么它仍然阴魂不散，只要我们不直面它，它就会继续搅扰这一地区充满潜力的国家之间的正常关系。
en: That it why it will continue to haunt us, continue to disturb normal relations between the countries in this region with so much unused potential, as long as we do not deal with it in a forthright manner.

zh: 可以用辩论、承认、抨击—除了压制以外的任何方式。
en: Debating, recognizing, denouncing – whatever…. anything but suppressing!

zh: 如果不能正确地认识过去，你就不能在这些历经磨难的国家之间建立起长久的未来关系。
en: You cannot build lasting future relations between countries that have each in their own way suffered so much, without coming to terms with the past.

zh: 直到1989年，在戈尔巴乔夫的公开化政策之下，这一协议的存在才正式被承认。
en: It was not until 1989 that the existence of this protocol was officially admitted, thanks to the Glasnost-policy of Mikhail Gorbachev.

zh: 但有很多人依然在承认这一协议的问题上极为勉强。
en: But too many people still have difficulties with acknowledging this pact for what it really was.

zh: 这样的否认是有百害而无一利的。
en: Such denial is in no one’s interest.

zh: 更别说是在我们努力建设的这样一个欧洲—国家不论大小都确保享有同等的权利和义务，少数民族有着安全感，基本人权作为政治体系不可分割的一部分而深入人心，对邻国充满尊重和期许而不是恐惧和焦虑。
en: Not in the kind of Europe we still have to build – a Europe where big and small countries are assured that they share the same rights and obligations, where minorities feel safe, where basic human rights are accepted as an inextricable part of our political system, and where neighbors are regarded with respect and expectations, not fear and anxiety.

zh: 然而在正确认识历史的问题上困难重重也是意料之中。
en: But it is no surprise that coming to terms with history can be damnably difficult.

zh: 丹麦哲学家祈克果（Soren Kierkegaard）指出了更为根本的问题之一：生命必须在前进中延续—但却只能在回顾中明了。
en: The Danish philosopher Soren Kierkegaard put his finger on one of the more fundamental problems: “Life must be lived forwards – but can only be understood backwards”.

zh: 为了充满信心面对未来，你必须回顾历史—去了解问题的症结所在。
en: In order to look forward with confidence, you also have to look back – and understand what went wrong.

zh: 五月九日莅临莫斯科的每一位领导人都应该记住这一点。
en: Every leader in Moscow May 9th should remember this.

zh: 特别提款权的商业化
en: Commercialize the SDR

zh: 伯克利 — — 中国人民银行行长周小川在近期的20国峰会之前的一番言论引发了国际社会的争论。 他说IMF的特别提款权（SDR）应该取代美元，成为国际上外汇储备的币种。
en: BERKELEY – Zhou Xiaochuan, the governor of the People’s Bank of China, made a splash prior to the recent G-20 summit by arguing that the International Monetary Fund’s Special Drawing Rights should replace the dollar as the world’s reserve currency.

zh: 各界对此反响不一。
en: His reflections elicited nothing if not mixed reactions.

zh: 支持者认为一个国家的货币作为全球货币系统的流通货币本身就有点矛盾。
en: Sympathizers acknowledged the contradictions of a system in which a national unit is used internationally.

zh: 当一个国家的经济增长时，该国的中央银行当然会储备更多的外汇。
en: Central banks understandably seek more reserves as their economies grow.

zh: 如果储备的货币只能是美元的话，美国政府就会人为地降低其价值，以达到减轻美国本国外债的目的。
en: But if those reserves mainly take the form of dollars, then their rising demand allows the United States to finance its external deficit at an artificially low cost.

zh: 这样的 后果就是导致全球金融系统的动荡，甚至全面崩盘。
en: In turn, this allows unsustainable imbalances to build up, leading to an inevitable crash.

zh: 近期的事件就是这样一个例子 — — 从这点来说，周行长要求建立另外一个系统的建议是有道理的。
en: Recent events have highlighted this problem – and Governor Zhou thus was right to call for a different system.

zh: 也许会有人质疑特别提款权能否真正替代美元成为世界的主要货币。
en: But skeptics question whether the SDR could ever replace the dollar as the world’s leading reserve currency, for the simple reason that the SDR is not a currency.

zh: 原因很简单，特别提款权不是一个货币，它是IMF给其成员国发放信贷时的一种组合计算单位。
en: It is a composite accounting unit in which the IMF issues credits to its members.

zh: 这些信贷可以转换成为美元或其他货币，在IMF成员国之间进行转移。
en: Those credits can be converted into dollars and other currencies at the Fund, and can be used in official transactions among IMF member countries.

zh: 但在各国中央银行和政府之间，它并不能进行划转。
en: But they cannot be used in the other transactions in which central banks and governments engage.

zh: 同样也不能作为干预外汇市场的手段，或是用于在其他金融市场。
en: They cannot be used to intervene in foreign-exchange markets, or in other transactions with market participants.

zh: 因此，特别提款权不能作为国家官方的外汇储备单位。
en: This means that the SDR is not an attractive unit for official reserves.

zh: 如果想有改变这种情况，这并不是一件容易的事情。
en: This would not be easy to change.

zh: 虽然美国经济面临种种困难，美元以其不可比拟的深度及美国市场良好的流动性一直把持着各国外汇储备的比重。
en: Despite the trials and tribulations of the American economy, dollar securities remain the dominant form of reserves because of the unparalleled depth and liquidity of US markets.

zh: 各国中央银行可以随意买卖美国债券，而不会影响本国市场的波动。
en: Central banks can buy and sell dollar securities without moving those markets.

zh: 这就是美元的优势。 美元也同样运用于其他金融市场的交易中。
en: There is also the convenience factor: dollars are widely used in a variety of other transactions.

zh: 连欧元都不能撼动美员在外汇储备中的地位。
en: As a result, not even the euro has seriously challenged the dollar as the dominant reserve currency.

zh: 更不用说特别提款权了。
en: Doing so would be even more difficult for the SDR.

zh: 有困难并不说明不可能实现。
en: But difficult does not mean impossible.

zh: 如果中国真的想要将特别提款权作为外汇储备货币的话，就应该创造一个特别提款权的流动市场。
en: If China is serious about elevating the SDR to reserve-currency status, it should take steps to create a liquid market in SDR claims.

zh: 例如发行以特别提款权为币种的债券。
en: It could issue its own SDR-denominated bonds.

zh: 或更进一步，中国可以鼓励20国峰会的其他国家也这么做。
en: Better still, it could encourage other G-20 countries to do likewise.

zh: 当然，这样做是会有成本的，例如最初购买这些债券的投资者会要求一定的费用。
en: They would pay a price, since investors in these bonds would initially demand a novelty premium.

zh: 天下没有免费的午餐。
en: But nothing is free.

zh: 从长期来看，这对金融市场的稳定有好处。
en: That price would be an investment in a more stable international system.

zh: 当然，以往也有创造特别提款权流动市场的尝试。
en: Of course, an earlier attempt was made to create a commercial market in SDR-denominated claims.

zh: 早在20世纪70年代，就出现过商业银行及公司颁发的有条件的特别提款权为单位的债券。
en: Back in the 1970’s, there was some limited issuance of SDR-denominated liabilities by commercial banks and SDR-denominated bonds by corporations.

zh: 但现在已经消失。
en: But these efforts ultimately went nowhere.

zh: 美元更具有流动性，作为老大的地位不容易被撼动。
en: The dollar being more liquid, its first-mover advantage proved impossible to surmount.

zh: 如果要改变这个现状的话，在最初阶段，需要一个官方或是私人机构来启动这个项目，显然，这个角色非IMF莫属。
en: Overcoming that advantage now would require someone to act as market-maker for private as well as official transactions and subsidize the market in its start-up phase. The obvious someone is the IMF.

zh: IMF可以在官方和民间，进行特别提款权的买卖。 缩短和以美元为单位的竞价差距。
en: The Fund could stand ready to buy and sell SDR claims to all comers, private as well as official, at narrow bid/ask spreads competitive with those for dollars.

zh: 美元在20世纪20年代获得了世界货币的地位。 当时新成立的美联储开始买卖美元，建立相应的市场并增加其流动性。
en: The dollar originally acquired international currency status in the 1920’s, when the newly established Federal Reserve started buying and selling dollar acceptances, backstopping the market and enhancing its liquidity.

zh: 如果国际社会真的想把美元作为国际货币的话，IMF也应该被赋予相应的权利。
en: If the international community is serious about the SDR as an international currency, it will have to empower the IMF to do likewise.

zh: 当然，这这样做是有一定代价的。
en: Again, there would be a cost.

zh: 最初IMF必须对特别提款权市场进行补贴，等到其他私人市场慢慢地看到特别提款权的好处，自然会效仿。
en: The IMF would be using real resources to subsidize the market until private market-makers saw it as attractive to provide those services at comparable cost.

zh: IMF的成员国必须愿意支付最初的费用。
en: The Fund’s shareholders would have to agree to incur those costs.

zh: 但是，如果对国际金融市场的稳定有好处的话，难道不值得一试么？
en: But, again, what is this if not an investment in a more stable global monetary system?

zh: 特别提款权如果要成为一个真正的国际货币的话，还需要克服一些障碍。
en: Transforming the SDR into a true international currency would require surmounting other obstacles.

zh: 当特别提款权供应不足的时候，IMF要适当地增发，就如同2008年下半年，美联储为了增加市场流动性而增发美元那样。
en: The IMF would have to be able to issue additional SDRs in periods of shortage, as when the Fed provided dollar swaps to ensure adequate dollar liquidity in the second half of 2008.

zh: 如果还需要有85%以上的成员国同意，特别提款权才可以发放的话，市场的流动性就不可能增加了。
en: At the moment, countries holding 85% of IMF voting power must agree before SDRs can be issued, which is no recipe for liquidity.

zh: 如同美联储对美元，IMF应该被赋予发放特别提款权的权力。
en: The IMF’s management would also have to be empowered to decide on SDR issuance, just as the Fed can decide to offer currency swaps.

zh: 如果特别提款权要成为真正意义上的国际货币的话，那么IMF就要成为类似一个全球的中央银行和国际借贷的最终提供者。
en: For the SDR to become a true international currency, in other words, the IMF would have to become more like a global central bank and international lender of last resort.

zh: 在此次经济危机之前，以上的提法可能不会被接受。
en: Before the crisis, such ideas would have been dismissed out of hand.

zh: 即使在现在，也不可能马上实现。
en: Even now they won’t materialize overnight.

zh: 但周行长的讲话的内涵值得引起大家的深思。
en: But they are the real implications of Governor Zhou’s remarks.

zh: 大宗商品价格为何下跌？
en: Why Are Commodity Prices Falling?

zh: 美国剑桥—6月以来，石油价格暴跌40 % — —这对石油进口国来说是好消息，但对俄罗斯、委内瑞拉、尼日利亚和其他石油出口国来说是坏消息。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Oil prices have plummeted 40% since June – good news for oil-importing countries, but bad news for Russia, Venezuela, Nigeria, and other oil exporters.

zh: 一些人将油价下跌归因于美国页岩能源的爆发。
en: Some attribute the price drop to the US shale-energy boom.

zh: 也有人认为这是因为欧佩克没有就削减供给达成一致。
en: Others cite OPEC’s failure to agree on supply restrictions.

zh: 但这不是故事的全部。
en: But that is not the whole story.

zh: 铁矿石价格也在下跌。
en: The price of iron ore is down, too.

zh: 金、银和铂价格也是如此。
en: So are gold, silver, and platinum prices.

zh: 糖、棉花和大豆价格也在下跌。
en: And the same is true of sugar, cotton, and soybean prices.

zh: 事实上，大部分大宗商品的美元价格今年上半年都下降了。
en: In fact, most dollar commodity prices have fallen since the first half of the year.

zh: 尽管一些具体的部门因素影响着每种商品的价格，但价格下跌是如此广泛 — — 剧烈波动时往往会发生这种情况 — — 这一事实表明有宏观经济因素在起作用。
en: Though a host of sector-specific factors affect the price of each commodity, the fact that the downswing is so broad – as is often the case with big price swings – suggests that macroeconomic factors are at work.

zh: 那么，是什么宏观经济因素促使大宗商品价格下跌？
en: So, what macroeconomic factors could be driving down commodity prices?

zh: 也许是通缩。
en: Perhaps it is deflation.

zh: 但是，尽管通胀很低，甚至有的国家出现了负数，但这绝不是唯一原因，因为商品价格相对于总体价格水平也在下跌。
en: But, though inflation is very low, and even negative in a few countries, something more must be going on, because commodity prices are falling relative to the overall price level.

zh: 换句话说，大宗商品的真实价格在下跌。
en: In other words, real commodity prices are falling.

zh: 最普遍的解释是全球经济减速导致对能源、矿产和农产品需求下降。
en: The most common explanation is the global economic slowdown, which has diminished demand for energy, minerals, and agricultural products.

zh: 事实上，自年中以来，大部分国家的增长都出现了减速，GDP预测也纷纷做出了向下修正。
en: Indeed, growth has slowed and GDP forecasts have been revised downward since mid-year in most countries.

zh: 但美国是个显著的例外。
en: But the United States is a major exception.

zh: 美国的扩张似乎正在日益坐实，预计今年后两季度年增长率将超过4 % 。
en: The American expansion seems increasingly well established, with estimated annual growth exceeding 4% over the last two quarters.

zh: 但美国的大宗商品价格下跌情况尤其严重。
en: And yet it is particularly in the US that commodity prices have been falling.

zh: 比如 ， 《 经济学人 》 （ The Economist）的欧元大宗商品价格指数在去年实际上还有所上涨，下跌的只是该指数的美元值，而受到所有关注的正是这个美元指标。
en: The Economist’s euro-denominated Commodity Price Index, for example, has actually risen over the last year; it is only the Index in terms of dollars – which is what gets all of the attention – that is down.

zh: 这就提醒我们关注货币政策，货币政策作为大宗商品价格的决定因素的重要性常常被忘却。
en: That brings us to monetary policy, the importance of which as a determinant of commodity prices is often forgotten.

zh: 在美国，人们普遍预期货币将会紧缩，美联储已经在10月结束了量化宽松，并有可能在来年提高短期利率。
en: Monetary tightening is widely anticipated in the US, with the Federal Reserve having ended quantitative easing in October and likely to raise short-term interest rates sometime in the coming year.

zh: 这让人想起了似曾相识的历史模式。
en: This recalls a familiar historical pattern.

zh: 20世纪70年代、2002—2004年以及2007—2008年，真实（经通胀调整的）利率的下降伴随着真实大宗商品价格的上升；20世纪80年代美国真实利率的急剧上升导致大宗商品美元价格暴跌。
en: Falling real (inflation-adjusted) interest rates in the 1970s, 2002-2004, and 2007-2008 were accompanied by rising real commodity prices; sharp increases in US real interest rates in the 1980s sent dollar commodity prices tumbling.

zh: 直觉似乎告诉我们，当美联储“印钱”时，资金流入大宗商品和其他领域，推高它们的价格 — — 因此，当利率升高时，价格就下跌。
en: There is something intuitive about the idea that when the Fed “prints money,” the money flows into commodities, among other places, and so bids their prices up – and thus that prices fall when interest rates rise.

zh: 但是，其中的因果关系到底在哪里？
en: But, what, exactly, is the causal mechanism?

zh: 事实上，真实利率影响大宗商品价格有四个渠道（除了它对经济活动水平的任何影响之外 ） 。
en: In fact, there are four channels through which the real interest rate affects real commodity prices (aside from whatever effect it has via the level of economic activity).

zh: 首先，高利率增加了在今天而不是未来开发可储存商品的激励，从而 压低了它们的价格，加速了石油开采、黄金勘探和森林采伐的速度。
en: First, high interest rates reduce the price of storable commodities by increasing the incentive for extraction today rather than tomorrow, thereby boosting the pace at which oil is pumped, gold is mined, or forests are logged.

zh: 其次，高利率还抑制了企业保留存货的意愿（想想保存在油罐中的石油 ） 。
en: Second, high rates also decrease firms’ desire to carry inventories (think of oil held in tanks).

zh: 第三，投资组合经理对利率升高的反应是了结大宗商品合约（如今它们属于一个“资产类 ” ） ，买入国债。
en: Third, portfolio managers respond to a rise in interest rates by shifting out of commodity contracts (which are now an “asset class”) and into treasury bills.

zh: 最后。 高利率促使本币升值，从而降低了在国际市场上交易的大宗商品的本国价格（即使外币价格并未下跌 ） 。
en: Finally, high interest rates strengthen the domestic currency, thereby reducing the price of internationally traded commodities in domestic terms (even if the price has not fallen in foreign-currency terms).

zh: 美国没有在2014年提高利率，因此这些机制大部分还没有直接起作用。
en: US interest rates did not really rise in 2014, so most of these mechanisms are not yet directly at work.

zh: 但预计2015年会出现升息的投机者正在抢先一步了结大宗商品头寸；结果是让明年才应该出现的价格上涨提前到今天。
en: But speculators are thinking ahead and shifting out of commodities today in anticipation of future higher interest rates in 2015; the result has been to bring next year’s price decrease forward to today.

zh: 第四个渠道，即汇率，已经开始起作用。
en: The fourth of the channels, the exchange rate, has already been functioning.

zh: 在美国货币预计将紧缩的同时，欧洲央行和日本央行正在加强货币刺激。
en: The prospect of US monetary tightening coincides with moves by the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan toward enhanced monetary stimulus.

zh: 结果是美元相对欧元和日元升值。
en: The result has been an appreciation of the dollar against the euro and the yen.

zh: 今年上半年以来，欧元对美元贬值了8 % ， 日元对美元贬值了14 % 。
en: The euro is down 8% against the dollar since the first half of the year and the yen is down 14%.

zh: 这就解释了为何如此多的大宗商品的美元价格出现了下跌，而其他货币价格出现了上涨。
en: That explains how so many commodity prices can be down in terms of dollars and up in terms of other currencies.

zh: 翻飞的商品云霄飞车
en: The Commodity Roller Coaster

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 全球大宗商品的超级周期并不是一个新现象。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The global commodity super-cycle is hardly a new phenomenon.

zh: 虽然细节各不相同，主要的大宗商品出口国都倾向于按照同样的剧本行事，而经济表现也往往遵循已知的模式。
en: Though the details vary, primary commodity exporters tend to act out the same story, and economic outcomes tend to follow recognizable patterns.

zh: 但在商品价格周期路径中的可预见性元素，就像坐云霄飞车的过程一样，上下翻飞急转急停，让人吃不消。
en: But the element of predictability in the path of the commodity-price cycle, like that in the course of a roller coaster, does not make its twists and turns any easier to stomach.

zh: 自十八世纪末以来，非石油商品相对于制成品的价格曾先后出现过七到八次的上涨（确切的数目取决于波峰和波谷的定义。
en: Since the late eighteenth century, there have been seven or eight booms in non-oil commodity prices, relative to the price of manufactured goods. (The exact number depends on how peaks and troughs are defined.)

zh: ）这类上涨一般持续7~8年，但始于1933年的那次延续了近二十年。
en: The booms typically lasted 7-8 years, though the one that began in 1933 spanned almost two decades.

zh: 这一例外是首先是得益于二战后欧洲和日本的重建以及美国经济的快速增长。
en: That exception was sustained first by World War II and then by the post-war reconstruction of Europe and Japan, as well as rapid economic growth in the United States.

zh: 而最近这场始于2004年终于2011年的上涨则更符合常规。
en: The most recent boom, which began in 2004 and ended in 2011, better fits the norm.

zh: 商品价格下跌 — — 从波峰到波谷下跌超过30 % — —也会延续差不多长的时间，平均约七年。
en: Commodity-price busts – with peak-to-trough declines of more than 30% – have a similar duration, lasting about seven years, on average.

zh: 目前的下跌目前已进入第四个年头，非石油商品价格（相对于制成品出口价格）迄今已下跌了约25 ％ 。
en: The current bust is now in its fourth year, with non-oil commodity prices (relative to the export prices of manufactures) having so far fallen about 25%.

zh: 大宗商品价格上涨通常与收入增加，更佳的财政状况，货币升值，借贷成本下降以及资本流入有关。
en: Commodity-price booms are usually associated with rising incomes, stronger fiscal positions, appreciating currencies, declining borrowing costs, and capital inflows.

zh: 而在经济低迷时期，这些趋势是相反的。
en: During downturns, these trends are reversed.

zh: 事实上，由于目前的低迷已经持续了四年，许多商品出口国经济活动显着放缓；他们的货币币值在近十年的相对稳定后都有所下跌，利率利差扩大；资本流入也陷入枯竭。
en: Indeed, since the current slump began four years ago, economic activity for many commodity exporters has slowed markedly; their currencies have slid, after nearly a decade of relative stability; interest-rate spreads have widened; and capital inflows have dried up.

zh: 低迷的痛苦程度在很大程度上取决于在上涨过程中政府和个人的所作所为。
en: Just how painful the downturn turns out to be depends largely on how governments and individuals behave during the bonanza.

zh: 如果他们认为自身贸易状况的改善会是长期的 — — 这一观点在价格攀升时往往成为主流 — — 消费和投资的增加往往会超出收入增长，同时公共和私人杠杆率都会提升。
en: If they perceive improvements in their terms of trade as permanent – a view that gains traction as prices climb – increases in consumption and investment tend to outpace income gains, and public and private leverage grows.

zh: 风险在于一旦云霄飞车调头向下，债务危机就将荼毒市场。
en: The risk is that when the roller coaster careens downward, a debt crisis will derail markets.

zh: 而事实上，在商品价格低迷时期，银行，货币和主权债务危机很可能猛增 — — 而如何躲避危机将成为政策制定者的热门话题，正如国际货币基金组织最新发布的《世界经济展望》中指出的那样。
en: And, indeed, during commodity-price downturns, banking, currency, and sovereign-debt crises tend to proliferate – and crisis-avoidance becomes a hot topic for policymakers, as highlighted in the International Monetary Fund’s most recent World Economic Outlook.

zh: 但这并非偶然，在从1970年代末一直延续到1992年的大宗商品价格暴跌过程就伴随着一众发展中国家超过10年的主权债务危机。
en: It is no accident that the last commodity-price collapse, which ran from the late 1970s until 1992, coincided with more than a decade of sovereign-debt crises in the developing world.

zh: 当然，这不是一场普通的下跌。
en: Of course, that was no ordinary downturn.

zh: 相反，它是迄今为止最严重的商品价格暴跌，从顶到底跌了40 % 。
en: On the contrary, it was the most severe commodity-price collapse to date, resulting in a 40% peak-to-trough decline.

zh: 更反常的是，它包含了三波价格下跌，波与波之间间隔1~2年。
en: More atypical, it involved three waves of price declines, divided by 1-2 year respites.

zh: 第一波与1979年秋季美国联邦储备委员尝试控制通胀的努力有关，导致国际利率飙升，在美国和其他地区引发了严重经济衰退。
en: The first wave was connected with the US Federal Reserve’s efforts to bring inflation under control in the fall of 1979, which caused international interest rates to spike, triggering a deep recession in the US and elsewhere.

zh: 第二波始于1985年，当时出现了供应过剩，因为在经济危机之其间许多大宗商品出口国都想方设法去赚些硬通货。
en: The second wave, which began in 1985, reflected a supply glut, as many commodity exporters simultaneously sought to raise hard currency, often in the midst of economic crisis.

zh: 第三浪从1989年到1992年，当时苏联解体导致该区域经济产出暴跌。
en: The third wave, from 1989 to 1992, was fueled by the disintegration of the Soviet Union, which caused output there to collapse.

zh: 如今的问题是当前的大跌是否会遵循类似的轨迹，因为近期的喘息很快又让位于另一次下跌。
en: The question now is whether the current crash will follow a similar trajectory, with the recent break soon giving way to another drop.

zh: 而答案则主要取决于（但不限于）与中国。
en: The answer lies primarily (but not exclusively) with China.

zh: 如果中国经济增速继续放缓 — — 正如那些由债务支撑的投资繁荣所经常导致的那样 — — 商品经济衰退很可能会持续下去，因为没有其他的经济体能够补足这一需求缺口。
en: If China’s economic slowdown persists – as those following investment booms and fueled by debt overhangs often do –the commodity downturn is likely to continue, as no other economy is capable of picking up the demand slack.

zh: 随着美联储提高利率，美国的经济扩张可能很快放缓。
en: The US economic expansion is likely to slow soon, as the Fed raises interest rates.

zh: 同时欧洲相对近期的复苏将可能不甚强劲且向国内服务倾斜。
en: And Europe’s relatively recent recovery will probably be moderate and tilted toward domestic services.

zh: 此外，大宗商品周期的现阶段，价格下降通常会保持下行势头。
en: Furthermore, at this stage of the commodity cycle, price declines typically retain downward momentum.

zh: 在上涨周期的末期许多大宗商品出口国往往已经启动投资项目来扩大产能。
en: By the end of the boom, many commodity exporters had already initiated investment projects to expand production.

zh: 随着这些工程陆续投产，供应量的增加将继续保持对价格的下行压力。
en: As these investments bear fruit, the increased supply will sustain downward pressure on prices.

zh: 同时许多新兴经济体的政府都不愿意维持大量和持续的经常账户赤字（这可以理解 ） ， 将导致他们通过增加出口量来应对疲软的出口价格，即便这将进一步压低价格。
en: And many emerging-economy governments’ understandable aversion to running substantial and persistent current-account deficits will lead them to counter weaker export prices by increasing export volume, even if that drives down prices further.

zh: 这段商品价格的云霄飞车旅程可能还没有结束。
en: This commodity-price roller-coaster ride is probably not over yet.

zh: 虽然我们无法确切知道会发生什么，但审慎的做法莫过于打起精神迎接另一次下坠 — — 同时竭尽所能，避免车毁人亡。
en: While we cannot know for sure what will happen, it would be prudent to brace ourselves for another drop – and do what we can to avoid a crash.

zh: 教育英联邦
en: Educating the Commonwealth

zh: 达累斯萨拉姆/拉各斯— 英联邦拥有53个成员国和24亿人口，是推动积极变化的强大力量。
en: DAR ES SALAAM/LAGOS – With 53 member countries and 2.4 billion people, the Commonwealth is a powerful force for positive change.

zh: 近七十年来，英联邦国家一直是全球贸易、女性赋权、自然资源保护和其他诸多问题上的全球领导者。
en: For nearly seven decades, Commonwealth states have been global leaders on trade, female empowerment, natural-resource protection, and many other issues.

zh: 但在英联邦应对人类发展的新挑战时，其领导层没有足够强调最重要的因素：教育。
en: But as the Commonwealth moves to tackle new challenges in human development, its leadership is failing to place sufficient emphasis on the most important factor of all: education.

zh: 如果不重新致力于这一繁荣的关键要素，其他目标的进步也很容易消逝。
en: Without a renewed commitment to this key building block of prosperity, progress on other goals will be elusive.

zh: 如今，有1.4亿英联邦儿童无学可上。
en: Today, some 140 million children in the Commonwealth are not in school.

zh: 据最新联合国儿童基金会报告，英联邦中最贫困的国家情况最悲惨。
en: According to a recent UNESCO report, the situation is most dire in the poorest Commonwealth countries.

zh: 比如，巴基斯坦有近2,000万儿童没有在正式学校中注册，孟加拉国有700万，莫桑比克有230万，加纳有180万，喀麦隆有160万。
en: In Pakistan, for example, nearly 20 million children are not enrolled in formal education, while seven million are out of school in Bangladesh, 2.3 million in Mozambique, 1.8 million in Ghana, and 1.6 million in Cameroon.

zh: 尼日利亚的情况尤其令人担忧，近九百万小学适龄儿童没有注册，还有数百万人（尤其是女童）无法进入中学。
en: The situation is particularly worrisome in Nigeria, where nearly nine million primary-school-age children are not enrolled, and millions more – especially girls – are denied access to secondary education.

zh: 最富裕和最贫穷的英联邦国家的教育机会分配极不平衡，性别歧视困扰着许多国家。
en: Educational opportunities are also highly unevenly distributed between the richest and poorest Commonwealth countries, while gender discrimination plagues many states.

zh: 如果当前趋势继续，到2030年 — — 即实现17个联合国可持续发展目标的时限 — — 英联邦国家70%以上的儿童的阅读和数学水平将存在缺失。
en: If current trends continue, by the year 2030 – the deadline for meeting the 17 United Nations Sustainable Development Goals – more than 70% of children in Commonwealth countries will be failing reading and math.

zh: 这意味着一大半年轻人无法获得在二十一世纪职场取得成功所需要的技能。
en: This would represent more than half of the total number of young people expected to lack the skills needed to succeed in the twenty-first-century job market.

zh: 如果一个儿童无法上学，家庭、社区和国家的贫困循环就会永久化。
en: When a child doesn’t attend school, their absence perpetuates the cycle of poverty in families, communities, and countries.

zh: 英联邦领导人决不能坐视本国年轻人因为教育投入不足而人生失败。
en: The Commonwealth’s leaders cannot afford to fail their countries’ young people by failing to invest in education.

zh: 好消息是教育机会可以有效推动，以较低的成本覆盖目前被排除在外的大部分人。
en: The good news is that educational opportunities could be delivered effectively, and at low cost, to a majority of those currently excluded.

zh: 事实上，大部分发展中英联邦国家儿童能够从全球教育机会融资国际委员会（International Commission on Financing Global Education Opportunity）制定的创新性方案中获益，我们是该委员会的委员。
en: In fact, most children living in developing Commonwealth countries could benefit from an innovative solution designed by the International Commission on Financing Global Education Opportunity, where we serve as commissioners.

zh: 具体的做法是国际教育融资便利（International Finance Facility for Education，IFFEd ） ， 其旨在通过公共和私人资助撬动各国自身的教育投资。
en: The approach, called the International Finance Facility for Education (IFFEd), aims to leverage countries’ own investments in education with support from public and private donors.

zh: IFFEd计划去年已获得G20的承认，将能确保澳大利亚、加拿大、新西兰、英国和其他国家的资助，以提高非洲和亚洲多边开发银行的贷款能力。
en: The IFFEd program, which was acknowledged by the G20 last year, would secure financial guarantees from donors in Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, and elsewhere to increase the lending capacities of multilateral development banks in Africa and Asia.

zh: 每一美元资助保证都能带来高达5美元的可用教育支出。
en: For every $1 in guarantees, as much as $5 is made available for spending on education.

zh: 一些多边开发银行已经认识到这一机制的价值，并在与委员会一起进一步发展这一便利工具。
en: Several multilateral development banks have already recognized the value of this mechanism and are working with the commission to develop the facility further.

zh: 为了实现这一融资策略的最大化影响，IFFEd将优待致力于教育改革并能监控和追踪结果的国家。
en: To maximize the impact of this financing strategy, IFFEd will favor countries that have committed to educational reforms and are able to monitor and track results.

zh: 我们的目标是在第一个拨款周期撬动20亿美元初期保障资金。
en: Our aim is to leverage an initial $2 billion in guaranteed funding during the first funding cycle.

zh: 我们相信，这一机制能够帮助多达16个落后英联邦国家改善数百万年轻人的教育机会 — — 特别是边缘化女童。
en: We believe that this mechanism could help as many as 16 disadvantaged Commonwealth countries improve educational opportunities for millions of young people – especially marginalized girls.

zh: 增加的融资能够补充目前可通过全球教育合作（Global Partnership for Education）等计划获得的国内资源、双边援助和多边捐助。
en: The additional financing would complement domestic resources, bilateral aid, and multilateral grants that are already available through programs like the Global Partnership for Education.

zh: 要解决英联邦的教育短缺，必须采取果断行动。
en: Bold action is needed if the Commonwealth’s educational shortcomings are to be solved.

zh: 因此，我们将在本月晚些时候在伦敦举行的两年一届的政府首脑会议（Heads of Government Meeting . ） 上敦促英联邦领导人人支持IFFEd。
en: That is why we are urging Commonwealth leaders to support the IFFEd when they gather in London later this month for their biennial Heads of Government Meeting.

zh: 英联邦有一个关注构建繁荣、民主与和平的日程，明确将致力于更前大、更“共同的未来 ” 。
en: With an agenda focused on building prosperity, democracy, and peace, the Commonwealth is clearly committed to a stronger, more “common future.”
