zh: 而实现这一目标的最快捷的方式是让所有成员国都将教育列为重中之重。
en: And the fastest way to achieve its goals is by making education a top priority in every member state.

zh: “如果我们要在世界上实现真正的和平 ， ” 圣雄甘地在1931年、即英联邦成立前近二十年时说 ， “ 就必须从教育开始。
en: “If we are to reach real peace in this world,” Mahatma Gandhi said in 1931, nearly two decades before the Commonwealth was established, “we shall have to begin with the children.”

zh: ”他的话在今天仍然不可不畏先见之明；在这个国内和国际冲突日益频发的世界，投资教育刻不容缓。
en: His words are no less prescient today; in a world that seems increasingly prone to domestic and international conflict, there is no time to waste when it comes to investing in education.

zh: 建设性别包容的工作环境
en: Building a Gender-Inclusive Workplace

zh: 纽约 — — 从好莱坞曝出的一波高调性骚扰案浪潮正在深刻影响着不那么有诱惑力的工作。
en: NEW YORK – The wave of high-profile sexual harassment cases that began with revelations from Hollywood is having a profound impact on far less glamorous work environments.

zh: 就像大型电影制片厂被迫采取行动打击虐待行为一样，由站出来揭露真相的女性#我也是运动所推动的一场类似革命 — — 正在席卷所有地方的工作场所。
en: Just as major film studios have been forced to take action against abuse, a similar revolution – powered by the #MeToo movement of women speaking out – is sweeping workplaces everywhere.

zh: 了解女性在哈维·温斯坦、马特·劳尔和阿尔·弗兰肯等有权有势的男性手中所遭受的苦难是非常可怕的。
en: It has been terrible to learn of the abuse that women suffered at the hands of powerful men like Harvey Weinstein, Matt Lauer, and Al Franken.

zh: 但亲眼目睹企业界认真对待这一事件，并试图为女性员工创造某种“共同的未来”又非常令人鼓舞。
en: But it is also deeply encouraging to see the corporate world take this issue seriously, by attempting to create a “shared future” for their female employees.

zh: 人们对#我也是运动的集体响应可能标志着雇主思考性骚扰和其他涉性问题 — — 如薪酬和权力 — — 等方式的转折。
en: The collective response to the #MeToo movement could mark a turning point in the way employers think about sexual harassment and other issues involving gender – like pay and power.

zh: 但职场革命还远未结束。
en: But the workplace revolution is far from over.

zh: 制定全新战略以鼓励员工进行健康互动是必须的。
en: New strategies are needed to encourage healthy interactions among employees.

zh: 如果能够得到妥善处理，性别平等可以促进商业领域的产量和生产效率，而性别歧视如果遭到忽视，则可能彻底摧毁办公室文化 — — 以及更多。
en: When handled properly, gender equality promotes business output and productivity, whereas sexual discrimination, if ignored, can destroy an office culture – and so much more.

zh: 企业传统上一直采用打勾的方式来应对骚扰，利用书面政策和培训来徒劳地试图鼓励尊重。
en: Companies have traditionally taken a box-ticking approach to addressing harassment, using written policies and trainings in a feeble bid to encourage respect.

zh: 但就像优步和其他技术企业丑闻已经证明的那样，这种自上而下的方式已经被事实证明是无效的。
en: But this top-down approach has proven ineffective, as scandals at Uber and other tech firms have demonstrated.

zh: 如果真想阻止工作场合所曝出的虐待，企业领袖和高管人员需要采用全新的方法。
en: If workplace abuse is to be curtailed, business leaders and C-Suite executives need a fresh approach.

zh: 实现顶层的两性平等是首要任务。
en: The first priority is to achieve gender balance at the top.

zh: 领导层的多样性能够鼓励员工合作，并提升组织的健康度。
en: Diversity in leadership encourages employee cooperation and leads to healthier organizations.

zh: 这算不上是什么新想法 ； 《 哈佛商业评论》2016年所刊发的一份研究结果表明拥有更多高层女性管理者的企业能够赚取的利润也更多。
en: This is not a new idea; a 2016 study published in the Harvard Business Review found that companies with more high-level female executives generate higher profits.

zh: 其他研究结果表明女性在压力下往往能够表现得更好，并做出更明智的决策。
en: Other studies have shown that women perform better under stress, often making smarter decisions.

zh: 但尽管女性能够带来如此明显的好处，她们在世界各地的高层领导岗位却仍然严重代表不足。
en: But, despite the obvious benefits that women bring, they remain under-represented in senior leadership positions at companies around the world.

zh: 数字工作环境也同样需要变革。
en: Change is needed in the digital workplace as well.

zh: 捕食者可能隐藏在冷饮水箱的周围，但他们也同样活跃在在线社区、聊天室和论坛中。
en: Predators may lurk around the water cooler, but they are also active in online communities, chat rooms, and forums.

zh: #我也是运动所提出的疑虑仅短短数小时就在社交媒体上疯传，而类似的愤怒可能随时随地吞没某个组织。
en: Concerns raised by the #MeToo movement spread virally on social media within hours, and similar anger could engulf an organization at any time.

zh: 企业因此必须高度重视推广在线礼仪，并严肃对待员工所表达的任何评论和担忧。
en: Companies must therefore place a premium on promoting online decorum, and take seriously any comments and concerns expressed by their employees.

zh: 多数企业已经在对社交媒体上的声誉风险和客户满意度进行监测；他们也应当这样做来保护自己的员工。
en: Most companies already monitor social media for reputational risks and customer satisfaction; they should do the same to protect their staff.

zh: 最后，企业必须对最年轻员工的忧虑作出积极的回应，他们才是办公室未来的继承者。
en: Finally, companies must be responsive to the concerns of their youngest employees, who will inherit the office of the future.

zh: 随着越来越多的千禧一代进入职场并要求更多平等，最年轻员工已经比他们的前辈声音更强。
en: With more millennials entering the workforce and demanding greater equality, the youngest employees already have a stronger voice at work than previous generations.

zh: 波士顿咨询公司最近的一项研究发现，年轻的男性员工在家庭假和多样性等问题上往往比他们的上级更加开放，这表明性别平等问题的真正领导力可能来自企业最年轻的员工。
en: A recent Boston Consulting Group study found that young male employees are often more open-minded than their superiors on issues like family leave and diversity, suggesting that true leadership on gender equality may actually come from a company’s youngest staff members.

zh: 不仅如此，罗格斯大学的研究人员已经证明超过50%的千禧一代如果能为有共同价值观的企业工作甚至可以考虑削减薪酬，而人力资源管理协会则强调94%的青年员工希望利用他们的技能为一项伟大的事业造福。
en: Moreover, researchers at Rutgers University have shown that more than 50% of millennials would consider a pay cut if it meant working for a company that shared their values, while the Society for Human Resource Management notes that 94% of young workers want to use their skills to benefit a good cause.

zh: 企业不应抵制这样的趋势，而应当就如何利用年轻人的仁爱之心进行思考。
en: Rather than resist these trends, companies should look to harness the benevolence of their youngest talent.

zh: 为建设更具包容性的工作环境，管理层必须迅速制定能支持员工所要求变化的陈述和规则。
en: To build a more inclusive workplace, management must craft narratives that support the changes their employees are demanding.

zh: 最重要的是，员工们需要榜样。
en: Most important, employees need role models.

zh: 像萨尔玛·海耶克、罗斯·麦高恩和瑞茜·威瑟斯彭这样的明星愿意分享她们遭性侵的故事鼓励了来自各行各业的女性分享自己的遭遇。
en: The willingness of celebrities like Salma Hayek, Rose McGowan, and Reese Witherspoon to share their stories of sexual harassment empowered women from many walks of life to speak out, too.

zh: 改变职场文化需要类似的强有力的领导。
en: Changing workplace culture will demand similarly strong leadership.

zh: 这样的改变即将到来，而那些呼吁子孙后代更公平合作的男性和女性则令我深受鼓舞。
en: That shift is on the horizon, and I am inspired by the women and men who are calling on future generations to work together more equitably.

zh: 这些问题的复杂性很容易令人感到不知所措，但如果管理者和员工能致力于建设以目标为导向的包容性工作环境，那么将会不可避免地推动改革。
en: It is easy to feel overwhelmed by the complexity of these issues, but if managers and employees can commit to building purpose-driven and inclusive work environments, change is inevitable.

zh: 好莱坞女性或许已经开启了呼吁工作场所平等的全球事业，但对于我们这些在不那么有诱惑力的环境中工作的女性来说，工作环境革命也同样重要。
en: The women of Hollywood may have initiated what has become a global call for equality at work, but the workplace revolution is no less significant for those of us who walk on less colorful carpets.

zh: 回归正常
en: Getting to Normal

zh: 布鲁塞尔—当金融系统内的大量资产突然变得极具风险、投资者希望卖光手里的持有量时，金融危机就爆发了。
en: BRUSSELS – A financial crisis erupts when a large volume of assets in the financial system suddenly appears to be risky and investors want to get rid of their holdings.

zh: 这些资产变成了“有毒”资产，不仅高风险，而且是不可量化的高风险。
en: These assets become “toxic” – not simply risky, but carrying a risk that cannot be quantified.

zh: 有毒资产不能根据常规风险-回报计算交易。
en: Toxic assets are not traded according to a normal risk-return calculus.

zh: 由于其风险无法计算，其所有者希望卖掉它们 — — 不管什么价格，能卖就行。
en: Given that their risk cannot be calculated, their owners just want to sell them – sometimes at any price.

zh: 2007—2008年，美国住宅按揭抵押证券（RMBS）就出现了这种情形。
en: In 2007-2008, this was the case for a class of securities based on residential mortgages in the United States (RMBS, or residential mortgage-backed securities).

zh: 在繁荣阶段，这些证券被认为是无风险的，人们假设美国房价永不会下跌，因为和平时代还没有发生过这种状况。
en: During the boom phase, these securities were sold as risk-free, on the assumption that US house prices could not decline, as this had never happened before in peacetime.

zh: 但2007年，房地产价格开始全面下跌，按揭损失率激增，这一假设也随之破产。
en: But this assumption was shattered when a broad-based decline in real-estate prices began in 2007 and loss rates on mortgages suddenly increased.

zh: 结果，人们发现RMBS的风险比预计的高得多。
en: As a result, RMBS were found to be much riskier than anticipated.

zh: 一开始，人们找不到以什么为基础来对它们进行理性的重新估价，因为所发生的事件（美国房价在和平时期下跌）是前所未有的。
en: Initially, there was little basis for re-pricing them rationally, because the event (a peacetime decline in US house prices) was unprecedented.

zh: 此外，大量持有RMBS的银行和其他金融机构的风险测量手段有问题，在危机爆发高峰期，如果被迫以跳楼价甩卖手上的RMBS存货，可能导致它们破产。
en: Moreover, banks and other financial institutions, which held large volumes of RMBS, were ill-equipped to measure the risk, and in some cases would have been bankrupted had they been forced to sell their holdings at the fire-sale prices prevailing at the height of the crisis.

zh: 欧元危机的模式也是一样的。
en: The euro crisis followed a similar pattern.

zh: 直到最近，公共债务才不再被认为是终极安全资产。
en: Until recently, public debt was considered the ultimate safe asset.

zh: 事实上，其无风险的地位被写入了欧盟监管框架，银行可以持有大量任意欧元国的公债，而不需要拔备任何资本覆盖潜在损失。
en: Indeed, its risk-free status was embedded in the European Union regulatory framework, which allows banks to hold large volumes of any eurozone country’s public debt without having to put aside any capital to cover potential losses.

zh: 与RMBS一样，公债是完全安全的这一观念也有“事实”支撑 — — 没有哪个发达国家曾经违约过，至少1945年之后是如此。
en: As with RMBS, this view that public debt was totally safe was underpinned by the “fact” that no advanced country, at least in the post-1945 era, had ever defaulted.

zh: 因此，投资者假定他们根本不需要去评估欧元区国家的（国家）公债信用风险。
en: Investors thus assumed that they did not need to assess the credit risk of eurozone countries’ (national) public debt.

zh: 今年初希腊的事实违约打破了投资者的这一幻觉。
en: The de facto default by Greece early this year ended investors’ complacency.

zh: 欧元区外围国国债也因此变为有毒资产。
en: The government bonds of peripheral eurozone countries thus became toxic.

zh: 希腊违约的性质是前所未见的，受此影响，市场对外围国债务的估值开始大幅波动，直到现在还在寻找能够解释风险溢价随时间变化演进的“基本面 ” ， 如赤字和债务水平等等。
en: Given the unprecedented nature of the Greek default, the market valuation of peripheral debt has been fluctuating widely, still searching for “fundamentals,” such as deficit or debt levels, that could explain the evolution of risk premia over time.

zh: 此外，大量银行在资产负债表上持有了太多公债，如果发生全面违约，它们将会破产。
en: Moreover, many banks had so much public debt on their balance sheets that they would have been bankrupted in the event of a full-blown default.

zh: 这导致了欧元区银行系统的大动荡。
en: This led to extreme instability in the eurozone’s banking system.

zh: 当可以债务要么被社会化，要么估值得到稳定并转移到了有能力充分承担风险的投资者手中时，金融危机就结束了。
en: A financial crisis ends when the doubtful debt either has been socialized, or its valuation has stabilized, and it has migrated to investors who are solvent enough to bear the risk.

zh: 美国便是如此。
en: This was the case in the US.

zh: 当局收购了一些“有毒”资产，随着时间的推移，这些资产逐渐变得容易估值，因为几年来的按揭违约率数据让投资者得以找到了测量风险的方法。
en: The authorities acquired some of the “toxic” assets, which over time became easier to value, as a few years of data on mortgage delinquency rates allowed investors to find ways to measure the risk.

zh: 大部分RMBS的市场价格出现了反弹，因为业主放弃物业所造成的损失远比危机高峰期人们担忧的要小。
en: The market prices of most RMBS rebounded as losses due to homeowners simply abandoning their properties were much lower than had been feared at the height of the crisis.

zh: 此外，RMBS持有者变成了有能力支持和管理剩余风险的机构。
en: Moreover, holdings of RMBS migrated to institutions that were able to support and manage the remaining risk.

zh: 如今，RMBS不再被认为是有毒的，因此市场也再次回归了正常运转。
en: Today, RMBS are no longer considered toxic, allowing the market to function normally again.

zh: 最终，美国当局还因为在危机高峰期的收购行为略有盈利。
en: In the end, the US authorities even made a small profit on the assets that they had acquired at the height of the crisis.

zh: 这一模式在欧洲只能部分被复制，因为在欧洲，债务社会化和正常风险评估的回归都要更加困难。
en: This pattern can be only partly repeated in the eurozone, where both debt socialization and a return to normal risk assessment appear more difficult.

zh: 债务社会化能力有限反映了欧盟条约的不援助条款，该条款禁止对（国家）公债施以欧元区层面的直接共同化。
en: Limited capacity for debt socialization reflects the EU Treaty’s no-bailout clause, which bars outright mutualization at the eurozone level of (national) public debt.

zh: 此外，新的援助基金欧洲稳定性机制的贷款能力也被限制在7000亿欧元，只相当于可能需要财政援助国家总公债水平的几分之一。
en: Moreover, the lending capacity of the new rescue fund, the European Stability Mechanism, is capped at €700 billion ($905.6 billion), which represents only a fraction of the total public debt of the countries potentially needing financial assistance.

zh: 只有欧洲央行可以实施欧元区国家债务的社会化。
en: Only the European Central Bank could implement true socialization of national debt in the eurozone.

zh: ���欧盟法律明文规定禁止任何形式的欧洲央行赤字融资。
en: But EU law expressly forbids any form of ECB financing of deficits.

zh: 回归正常风险评估在欧洲也更加困难。
en: A return to normal risk assessment is also more difficult in Europe.

zh: 欧洲委员会庄严宣布，希腊的事实违约（用所谓的“私人部门加入”来巧妙安排）仍属特例，且仅此一例。
en: The European Council has solemnly declared that Greece’s de facto default (orchestrated through so-called “private-sector involvement”) remains an exceptional and unique case.

zh: 但让公债回到无风险的原状的承诺与不断地对国家债务社会化加以限制的做法是不相容的。
en: But the promise of a return to the status quo ante of risk-free public debt is not compatible with the continuing limits on the socialization of national debt.

zh: 事实上，随着外围国银行增加了对母国债券的投资，风险变得更加集中了。
en: Indeed, the risk has become more concentrated as banks in the periphery have increased their investment in their own countries’ bonds.

zh: 欧洲发生主权违约绝不仅仅是在统计风险模型中加上几个值那样简单。
en: A sovereign default in Europe will never be a mere value to be plugged into some statistical risk model.

zh: 这些区别意味着，欧元区危机需要更长时间才能回归正常市场条件。
en: These differences imply that the return to normal market conditions will be slower in the case of the euro crisis.

zh: 尽管如此，这场危机已经有所减轻，因为大部分风险厌恶机构现在已经卖光了手里持有的外围国家主权债务。
en: Nevertheless, the crisis should abate somewhat, because the most risk-averse institutions have by now sold their holdings of peripheral countries’ sovereign debt.

zh: 此外，欧洲央行明确表示它不会允许欧元解体。
en: Moreover, the ECB has clearly stated that it will not allow the euro to disintegrate.

zh: 这一保证为投资者的最大风险提供了担保。
en: That guarantee has insured investors against their biggest risk.

zh: 有补偿的自由贸易
en: The Case for Compensated Free Trade

zh: 伦敦—几乎所有自由派都支持全球化，反对经济民族主义。
en: LONDON – Almost all liberals support globalization and oppose economic nationalism.

zh: 他们忽视了证据表明，当前形式的全球化与民主危险地互不相容。
en: They ignore the mounting evidence that, in its current form, globalization is dangerously incompatible with democracy.

zh: 在2011年的著作《全球化悖论 》 （ The Globalization Paradox）中，哈佛大学的丹尼·罗德里克（Dani Rodrik）说，民族国家、民主和全球化互相矛盾：我们可以拥有其中任意两个，但无法同时拥有全部三个（他称之为“三元悖论 ” ） 。
en: In his 2011 book The Globalization Paradox, Harvard’s Dani Rodrik says that the nation-state, democracy, and globalization are mutually irreconcilable: we can have any two, but not all three simultaneously (he calls this a “trilemma”).

zh: 放眼全球 ， “ 民族”正在以民主的名义革全球化的命。
en: All over the world, the “nation” has been revolting against globalization in the name of democracy.

zh: 今年，美国总统特朗普启动第一轮中国商品关税，而中国以牙还牙时，这一点便已经表露无遗。
en: That became clear this year when US President Donald Trump imposed the first of a widening set of tariffs against Chinese goods, with China retaliating in kind.

zh: 特朗普还撕毁了两个重要国际贸易条约，并威胁要退出世界贸易组织。
en: Trump has also torn up two major international trade treaties and threatened to withdraw from the World Trade Organization.

zh: 美国转向经济民族主义的触发因素是贸易赤字随着美国经济复苏而扩大 — — 2017年达到5,660亿美元，并还在增长。
en: The trigger for America’s turn to economic nationalism is its widening trade deficit – $566 billion in 2017, and growing – as the US economy recovers.

zh: 但更深层次的原因是一种正确的感觉：由此导致的经常项目赤字，如果用短期资本流入即“热”钱融资，便不是“良性”的。
en: But the deeper reason is the correct perception that the resulting current-account deficits are not “benign” when they are being financed by inflows of short-term capital, or “hot” money.

zh: 经常项目赤字意味着一国进口多于出口。
en: A current-account deficit means that a country is importing more than it is exporting.

zh: 这些超额进口可能导致“好”就业岗位净损失。
en: And those excess imports can lead to a net loss of “good” jobs.

zh: 21世纪的第一个十年，六百万制造业岗位消失。
en: Six million manufacturing jobs disappeared in the first decades of the 2000s.

zh: 锈带造就了特朗普总统。
en: The Rust Belt made Trump president.

zh: “应该重建密歇根了，我们再也不会让他们把你们的饭碗从密歇根抢走了。 ”他在2016年对欢呼雀跃的底特律人群说。
en: “It’s time to rebuild Michigan, and we are not letting them take your jobs out of Michigan any more,” he told cheering crowds in Detroit in 2016.

zh: 特朗普的保护主义也有地缘政治根源。
en: Trump’s protectionism also has a geopolitical root.

zh: 金属进口导致许多防务所需要的企业关门。
en: Metal imports have led to the closing of many enterprises that might be needed for defense.

zh: 中国的“中国制造2025”战略计划是一套高科技产业政策，旨在让中国成为未来产业的全球主导者。
en: China’s strategic “Made in China 2025” plan is a high-tech industrial policy aimed at transforming China into a dominant global leader in the industries of the future.

zh: 它严重依赖从美国窃取先进技术。
en: It significantly relies on stealing advanced technologies from the United States.

zh: 如果中国制造2025取得成功，那么美国的经济和政治未来前景黯淡。
en: If MIC25 is successful, the US will have a depleted economic and political future.

zh: 用严格的经济学理论讲，你的贸易伙伴的政治特征应该是无关紧要的。
en: In strictly economic terms, the political character of one’s trading partners should not matter.

zh: 但在战略竞争的世界中，国际商业可能 — — 也常常 — — 是政策的工具，不应该仅仅因为它与宝贵的自由贸易原则相抵触，就不能在这一环境中使用它。
en: However, in a world of strategic competition, international commerce can be, and usually is, an instrument of policy, and its use in that context should not be denied simply because it breaches the sacred principle of free trade.

zh: 十九世纪经济民族主义“急先锋”弗雷德里希·李斯特（Friedrich List）指出，自由贸易需以世界和平为前提。
en: As Friedrich List, the nineteenth-century pioneer of economic nationalism, pointed out, free trade assumes a peaceful world.

zh: 有选择的关税对于保护防务相关行业或阻止其他国家窃取尖端科技或许非常有用。
en: Selective tariffs can be useful for protecting defense-related industries or to prevent other countries from stealing cutting-edge technologies.

zh: 但作为总体贸易政策，关税是粗放的，不够精确。
en: But as an overall trade policy, tariffs are crude and inexact.

zh: 美国将承受高昂的代价，最终可能无法实现大幅降低贸易赤字或其他有意义的收益。
en: The US will incur high costs and might end up without a substantially lower trade deficit or other meaningful benefits.

zh: 有没有办法在不导致贸易战的情况下限制自由贸易？
en: Is there a way to limit free trade that does not lead to trade wars?

zh: 经济学家弗拉基米尔·马什（Vladimir Masch）提出了独创的“有补偿的自由贸易 ” （ CFT）计划，可以在不干扰世界经济体系的情况下实现合理的保护主义目标。
en: The economist Vladimir Masch has advocated an ingenious “compensated free trade” (CFT) plan as a way to achieve legitimate protectionist aims without disrupting the world economic system.

zh: 根据这一计划，决策者将为每年的贸易赤字设定一个上限，并限定贸易伙伴的盈余。
en: Under this plan, policymakers would establish a ceiling for the trade deficit each year and impose limits on trading partners’ surpluses.

zh: （需要从盈余伙伴获得产品，可以不计入贸易伙伴的出口限额。
en: (Any products needed from a surplus partner would be exempted from the partner’s export limit.)

zh: ）在美国的例子中，这一上限将大大影响中国、墨西哥、日本和德国，它们在2017年分别贡献了3,750亿、710亿、690亿和640亿美元的美国贸易赤字。
en: In the US case, this ceiling would largely affect China, Mexico, Japan, and Germany, which contributed $375 billion, $71 billion, $69 billion, and $64 billion, respectively, to the overall trade deficit in 2017.

zh: 根据CFT，贸易盈余国可以将出口缩减至设定的限额。
en: Under CFT, a trade surplus country can reduce its exports to the set limit.

zh: 但如果其政府向贸易伙伴国政府支付等于超额出口价值的罚款，它也可以出口超过限额的量，罚款可以来自出口商，也可以用外汇储备。
en: But it could also exceed its export quota if its government paid the partner government a fine equal to the value of the excess exports, either collecting the necessary sum from its export producers or using its currency reserves.

zh: （收取国政府可以将罚款用于扩大自身的投资计划。
en: (The receiving government could use the fines to enlarge its own investment programs.)

zh: ）但如果盈余国想超额出口而不付罚款，那么它的盈余出口将被禁止。
en: But if the surplus country tried to exceed its export limit without paying the fine, its surplus exports would be blocked.

zh: 这一“智能”保护主义对于粗放的关税有诸多优势。
en: This “smart” protectionism has several advantages over crude tariffs.

zh: 首先也是最重要的是，它会自动防止贸易战。
en: First and foremost, it would automatically prevent trade wars.

zh: 因为CFT只对贸易国的盈余加以限制，盈余国减少其从美进口量的措施都会自动降低其允许的出口值。
en: Because CFT imposes limits just on the trader’s surplus, any attempt by the surplus country to decrease the value of its imports from the US would automatically decrease the value of its allowed exports.

zh: 其次，CFT将一次性面临每个贸易伙伴的政府补贴、价格和货币操纵，以及其他国际贸易肮脏伎俩。
en: Second, CFT would confront, in one stroke for each partner, government subsidies, price and currency manipulations, and the other dirty tricks of international trade.

zh: 与旷日持久且往往徒劳无功的贸易条约“扯皮”不同，它立刻可以产生结果。
en: In contrast to prolonged and often fruitless haggling over trade treaties, results would be obtained immediately.

zh: 第三，通过实现全球经济参与者的金融和贸易安排再平衡，CFT代表着通向解决当前僵局的一步。
en: Third, by re-balancing the financial and trading arrangements of the global economy’s participants, CFT would represent a step toward addressing its current dysfunction.

zh: CFT不是一套完整的方案，因为它没有解决应该谁迁就谁的问题。
en: CFT is not a complete solution, because it leaves open the question of who should adjust to whom.

zh: 必须改革全球支付系统来解决这个问题，引导对称性地调节全球失衡。
en: A reformed global payments system, which mandates symmetrical adjustment of global imbalances, would need to tackle this issue.

zh: 第四，由于美国的地位，它采取CFT将“助推”不太情愿的贸易盈余国接受这样一套支付系统。
en: Fourth, because of America’s leverage, its adoption of CFT would “nudge” reluctant trade surplus countries to accept such a payments system.

zh: 全球金融需要在平衡的支付系统所确定的界限内运行。
en: Global finance would have to operate within the limits that a balanced payments system establishes.

zh: 第五，从对美国的经济收益看，实施CFT将刺激离岸企业和就业岗位回归，从而恢复美国的工业潜力和社会平衡。
en: Fifth, in terms of economic benefits to the US, implementing CFT would stimulate the return of off-shored enterprises and jobs, thus restoring the country’s industrial potential and social balance.

zh: 从历史角度看，CFT必然会单方面激活布雷顿森林协定的稀缺货币条款（第7条 ） ， 该条款允许国际货币金组织（IMF）宣布持续贸易盈余的国家的货币为“稀缺 ” ， 允许其他成员歧视对待该国商品。
en: From a historical perspective, CFT essentially amounts to a unilateral activation of the scarce-currency clause (Article 7) of the Bretton Woods Agreement, which allowed the International Monetary Fund to declare “scarce” the currency of a country running a persistent trade surplus, permitting other members to discriminate against its goods.

zh: 这与关贸总协定（世贸组织的前身）第十二条相一致，后者规定，任何国家“为了捍卫外部金融状况，可以限制允许进口的商品价值量。 ”
en: It is consistent with Article XII of the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (the WTO’s predecessor), which states that any country “in order to safeguard its external financial position and its balance of payments, may restrict the quantity or value of merchandise permitted to be imported.”

zh: 简言之，CFT将解决贸易赤字，克服关税的局限性，打击贸易操纵，纠正当前的主流经济理论，也是迈向重新制定可行的全球支付系统的必要措施。
en: In short, CFT addresses trade deficits, overcomes the limitations of tariffs, fights trade manipulation, corrects current mainstream economic theory, and is a necessary step toward re-establishing a feasible global payments system.

zh: 它能够简明扼要地克服罗德里克三元悖论：同时拥有民族国家、民主和全球化。
en: In a nutshell, it overcomes the Rodrik trilemma: one can have the nation-state, democracy, and globalization at the same time.

zh: 但只有一个民族国家，即美国有实力实现这一点。
en: But only one nation-state, the US, has the clout to deliver this.

zh: 如此，它将阻止世界向恶性经济民族主义的夺命狂奔。
en: By doing so, it would stop the global stampede to a virulent form of economic nationalism.

zh: 光是出于这一理由，马什计划也值得认真考虑。
en: For that reason alone, the Masch plan deserves serious consideration.

zh: 通往核裁军的漫漫长路
en: The Long Road to Nuclear Disarmament

zh: 堪培拉 — — 现在正处在全球核秩序的关键时刻。
en: CANBERRA – This is crunch time for the global nuclear order.

zh: 截止5月12日，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普必须决定是否批准伊朗核协议抑或重新对伊朗实施制裁措施。
en: By May 12, US President Donald Trump must decide whether to recertify the Iran nuclear deal or reimpose sanctions.

zh: 短短几周后，他将会见朝鲜领导人金正恩，这场峰会的结果将影响朝鲜核计划。
en: Only a few weeks later, he is expected to meet North Korean leader Kim Jong-un for a summit that will have implications for that country’s nuclear program.

zh: 由于特朗普处在国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥和国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿等鹰派顾问的包围之下，无核化工作在本月结束前遭遇挫折的可能性很大。
en: With Trump surrounded by hawkish advisers – like Secretary of State Mike Pompeo and National Security Adviser John Bolton – the odds are good that efforts to denuclearize will suffer setbacks before the month is out.

zh: 因此，国际社会坚持现有核义务比以往任何时候都更加重要，其中首推坚持1968年核不扩散条约（NPT ） 。
en: For this reason, it is more important than ever that the international community upholds existing treaty obligations, starting with the 1968 Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT).

zh: 但要想实现这一目标，必须进行艰苦的对话。
en: But to do that, tough conversations must be had.

zh: 多边协议往往在执行过程中都会出现偏差，国际核不扩散机制也是一样。
en: Multilateral agreements are always prone to gaps in application; the international non-proliferation regime is no different.

zh: 比如，虽然以色列和印度都没有签署核不扩散条约，却均被外界视为核武器俱乐部负责任的成员国。
en: For example, while neither Israel nor India have signed the NPT, both states are considered responsible members of the nuclear-weapons club.

zh: 以色列从未因为拥有核弹而遭受过制裁，而印度则拥有核供应国集团的豁免资格，印度还与美国、澳大利亚、加拿大和日本等国签署了几项民用核协议。
en: Israel has never been sanctioned for its bomb, and India has a waiver from the Nuclear Suppliers Group, as well as several civil nuclear agreements with the United States, Australia, Canada, and Japan.

zh: 另一方面，国际社会对巴基斯坦的核武器持容忍态度，但并未正式接受；而朝鲜的事实核武化则被视为是不可容忍的；伊朗的核计划则在核武器研发之前就被遏制了。
en: Pakistan’s nuclear weapons, on the other hand, are tolerated but not accepted; North Korea’s de facto nuclearization is considered intolerable; and Iran’s nuclear program was curbed before a weapon could be developed.

zh: 在这个不完善的框架中，核不扩散条约的缔约国拒绝探讨本国核裁军问题令许多国家感到沮丧。
en: Amid this imperfect framework, many countries have become frustrated by the refusal of NPT signatories to discuss their own disarmament.

zh: 核不扩散条约第六条要求各方本着“真诚的”态度进行核裁军谈判，但已经签署核不扩散条约的核武国家并未将其解读为禁止本国拥有核武库。
en: Article VI of the NPT obliges parties to pursue “in good faith” negotiations to disarm, but the nuclear-weapons states that have ratified the treaty do not interpret this as a prohibition on their possessing a nuclear arsenal.

zh: 相反，在威慑理论的鼓舞下，他们声称核裁军会削弱全球安全的基础。
en: Rather, buoyed by the doctrine of deterrence, they argue that reductions would weaken global security.

zh: 也许不足为奇的是，非核武国家看待问题的方式有所不同。
en: Perhaps not surprisingly, non-nuclear-weapon states see things differently.

zh: 去年，他们在联合国一项补充协议中发表了看法。
en: And, last year, they committed their views to a supplementary treaty at the United Nations.

zh: 今天，已经有58个国家签署了禁止核武器条约（TPNW ） ， 而且有八个国家已经通过，上述条约一旦生效将禁止核武器的使用、威胁使用和拥有。
en: Today, the Treaty on the Prohibition of Nuclear Weapons (TPNW) has been signed by 58 countries and ratified by eight, and if it ever comes into force will ban the use, threat of use, or possession of nuclear arms.

zh: 禁止核武器条约有个更著名的名称是“禁核条约 ” ， 是朝建立新国际标准方面迈出的重要步骤。
en: Better known as the “ban treaty,” the TPNW is an important step toward the establishment of a new international norm.

zh: 它同时也是核不扩散条约失败的合乎逻辑的结果。
en: It is also a logical consequence of the NPT’s failings.

zh: 但因为禁核条约在两个重要领域甚至超越了核不扩散条约，它也引发了某些人的强烈反对。
en: But, because the ban treaty goes beyond the NPT in two key respects, it has also drawn heavy opposition.

zh: 禁核条约将禁止所谓的核分享机制，借助上述机制核武国家的盟友可以将核武器储存在本国国土上。
en: The ban treaty would prohibit so-called nuclear sharing arrangements, whereby allies of nuclear weapon states could store weapons on these states’ territory.

zh: 此外，它将“威胁使用核武器”认定为非法或破坏了核威慑的逻辑基础。
en: Moreover, it undermines the logic of deterrence by making the “threat of use” illegal.

zh: 要想维持全球核不扩散机制，就必须在核不扩散条约和禁核条约相互矛盾的愿景间进行协调。
en: If the global non-proliferation regime is to remain viable, the competing visions reflected in the NPT and the ban treaty must be reconciled.

zh: 要想实现这一目标，国际社会需要就实现国际秩序的战略达成一致，以确保削减核武库的行动强化而非危及地区及全球安全状况。
en: For that to happen, the international community needs to agree on a strategy to achieve an international order in which the reduction of nuclear stockpiles reinforces, rather than jeopardizes, regional and global security.

zh: 毫无疑问谈判将是困难的，但替代选择比少数人自尊受伤要糟糕得多。
en: No doubt these will be difficult discussions, but the alternative is far worse than a few bruised egos.

zh: 有些专家认为强硬反对禁核条约可能导致对核不扩散条约感到失望的国家产生反弹，导致众多国家从1958年条约中退出。
en: Some experts have suggested that hardline opposition to the ban treaty could prompt a backlash from countries that have grown disillusioned with the NPT, leading to widespread withdrawal from the 1968 treaty.

zh: 勿需多言，这种情况产生的负面作用将十分巨大。
en: Needless to say, this would be hugely counter-productive.

zh: 它不仅将破坏现有核秩序并增强许多国家的不安全感；还会增加有核国家对已有核弹的依赖程度。
en: Not only would it destabilize the existing nuclear order and heighten many countries’ sense of insecurity; it would also deepen armed states’ attachment to the bombs they already have.

zh: 尽管存在种种缺陷，核不扩散条约已经实现了多年的核稳定。
en: Its flaws notwithstanding, the NPT has brought years of nuclear stability.

zh: 鉴于核不扩散条约解体会带来严重的全球安全后果，因此无论禁核条约达成与否，即使拒绝签署该条约的国家也需要上述条约能够继续存在下去。
en: Even countries that have refused to sign the treaty have a stake in its survival, with or without the ban treaty, given the serious global security implications of its unraveling.

zh: 因此，所有各方必须刻不容缓地重新挖掘其在切实有效裁军方面的共同利益。
en: Therefore, all sides must urgently rediscover their common interest in practical and effective disarmament.

zh: 上述两份条约可以在尽量减小近期核威胁的框架下产生交汇；减少中期核武器数量；并力争做到长期、彻底、可验证及不可逆转地消灭核武器。
en: The two treaties can converge in a framework that minimizes nuclear threats in the near term; reduces the number of nuclear weapons in the medium term; and aspires to the complete, verifiable, and irreversible elimination of nuclear weapons in the long term.

zh: 国际核不扩散及裁军委员会于2009年简要概述了这一方法；今天一个类似的版本必须被重新提及。
en: This approach was outlined in 2009 by the International Commission on Nuclear Non-Proliferation and Disarmament; a version of it must be resurrected today.

zh: 截止本周末，伊朗核协议的命运将会逐渐清晰；特朗普拒绝重新批准很可能会导致它的毁灭。
en: By the end of this week, the fate of the Iran nuclear deal will be clear; Trump’s refusal to recertify it would very likely signal its demise.

zh: 但无论伊朗核计划命运如何，还有朝鲜核计划，半个世纪以来作为全球核武器秩序基石的核不扩散条约的削弱才是人类所面临的最大威胁。
en: But, regardless of what becomes of Iran’s nuclear program, or of North Korea’s for that matter, a weakening of the NPT – the bedrock of the global nuclear order for a half-century – represents the biggest threat of all.

zh: 在数字经济中重塑竞争
en: Restoring Competition in the Digital Economy

zh: 慕尼黑—数字经济正在制造新的劳资裂痕，它让一家或少数几家企业攫取日益扩大的市场份额。
en: MUNICH – The digital economy is carving out new divides between capital and labor, by allowing one firm, or a small number of firms, to capture an increasingly large market share.

zh: 随着“超级明星”公司经营的全球化，并随之主宰多国市场，由20个发达和主要新兴经济体组成的G20集团市场集中度在过去15年里显著增加。
en: With “superstar” companies operating globally, and dominating markets in multiple countries simultaneously, market concentration throughout the Group of 20 developed and major emerging economies has increased considerably in just the past 15 years.

zh: 要治理这个现象，G20应该建立一个世界竞争网络（World Competition Network）以重塑竞争、解决劳资之间的收入不平等。
en: To address this phenomenon, the G20 should create a World Competition Network to restore competition and address income inequality between capital and labor.

zh: 随着许多G20国家的总收入的越来越大的份额流向资方，世界竞争网络将致力于扭转劳方占GDP之比下降的趋势。
en: As a larger share of total income shifts to capital across many G20 countries, the World Competition Network would seek to reverse the decline in labor’s share of GDP.

zh: 第二次世界大战结束以来，70%的国家GDP以劳动收入的形式体现，其余30%为资本收入。
en: During the period after World War II, 70% of national GDP went to labor income, and the remaining 30% to capital income.

zh: 凯恩斯将劳方比重的稳定性称为一种“奇迹 ” 。
en: John Maynard Keynes described the stability of the labor share as something of a “miracle.”

zh: 但此后这一规则被打破。
en: But the rule has since broken down.

zh: 20世纪80年代中期至今，劳方占世界GDP之比下降到 58 % ， 而资方比重上升到42 % 。
en: Between the mid-1980’s and today, labor’s share of world GDP declined to 58%, while capital’s share rose to 42%.

zh: 当今数字经济中的两大力量驱使劳方占总收入之比在全球范围内不断下降。
en: Two forces in today’s digital economy are driving the global decline in labor’s share of total income.

zh: 一是数字技术本身具有总体偏向于资方的倾向。
en: The first is digital technology itself, which is generally biased toward capital.

zh: 机器人、人工智能和机器学习的进步加速了自动化取代工人的速度。
en: Advances in robotics, artificial intelligence, and machine learning have accelerated the rate at which automation is displacing workers.

zh: 第二个力量是数字经济的“赢家基本通吃”市场，这意味着主宰企业拥有过大的权力，可以提高价格而不会失去许多客户。
en: The second force is the digital economy’s “winner-takes-most” markets, which give dominant firms excessive power to raise prices without losing many customers.

zh: 今天的超级明星公司的超凡地位来自数字技术的网络效应，即，随着更多的人使用某种产品，它会变得更加令人渴望。
en: Today’s superstar companies owe their privileged position to digital technology’s network effects, whereby a product becomes even more desirable as more people use it.

zh: 而尽管软件平台和在线服务的启动需要大量成本，扩张却相对廉价。
en: And although software platforms and online services can be costly to launch, expanding them is relatively inexpensive.

zh: 结果是站稳了脚跟的企业只需要雇用比以前所需少得多的工人就能保持增长。
en: Consequently, firms that are already established can keep growing with far fewer workers than they would have needed in the past.

zh: 这些因素有助于解释为何数字经济让劳动力需求下降的大企业兴旺发达。
en: These factors help to explain why the digital economy has given rise to large firms that have a reduced need for labor.

zh: 此外，一旦这些公司站稳脚跟并在所选择的市场中赢得主宰地位，新经济就让它们能够采取反竞争手段阻止实际或潜在对手挑战自己的地位。
en: And, once these firms are established and dominate their chosen market, the new economy allows them to pursue anti-competitive measures that prevent actual and potential rivals from challenging their position.

zh: 经济学家大卫·澳特尔（David Autor ） 、 大卫·多恩（David Dorn ） 、 劳伦斯·卡茨（Lawrence F. Katz ） 、 卡里斯蒂娜·帕特森（Christina Patterson）和约翰·范·里宁（John Van Reenen）指出，在美国，市场集中度上升最快的行业，劳方占收入比重的跌幅也最大。
en: And, as the economists David Autor, David Dorn, Lawrence F. Katz, Christina Patterson, and John Van Reenen show, the US industries with the fastest-growing market concentration have also seen the largest drop in labor’s share of income.

zh: 这一市场集中度的提升正在加剧拥有机器人（资本）的企业与机器人正在取代的工人（劳动）的企业之间的差距。
en: This increased market concentration is widening the gap between the firms that own the robots (capital) and the workers whom the robots are replacing (labor).

zh: 但面对这一问题要求我们制定数字时代的反垄断政策。
en: But confronting it will require us to reinvent antitrust for the digital age.

zh: 目前，G20国家的国家竞争当局尚无法充分监管全球经营的公司。
en: As it stands, national competition authorities in G20 countries are inadequately equipped to regulate corporations that operate globally.

zh: 此外，G20不能完全指望全球竞争纠正其自身趋向市场集中度不断提高的倾向。
en: Moreover, the G20 cannot simply trust that global competition will correct on its own the tendency toward increased market concentration.

zh: 安德鲁·伯纳德（Andrew Bernard）论证在美国，以及蒂尔里·梅耶（Thierry Mayer）和吉安马可·奥塔维亚诺（Gianmarco Ottaviano）论证在欧洲，国际贸易有利于庞大的超级明星公司。
en: As Andrew Bernard has shown for the United States and Thierry Mayer and Gianmarco Ottaviano have demonstrated for Europe, international trade favors large superstar firms.

zh: 事实上，全球化可能为各行业中规模最大、生产率最高的企业提供了优势，使它们得以扩张 — — 并迫使规模较小、生产率较低的企业退出。
en: Indeed, globalization may provide advantages to the largest and most productive firms in each industry, causing them to expand – and forcing smaller and less productive firms to exit.

zh: 结果，各行业日益被超级明星企业主宰，而它们的劳方占增加值之比较低。
en: As a result, industries become increasingly dominated by superstar firms with a low share of labor in value added.

zh: 美国即是如此。
en: The US is a case in point.

zh: 美国是当今许多超级明星企业所在地，但美国反垄断监管当局不能约束这些企业的市场权力。
en: It is host to many of today’s superstar firms, and yet US antitrust regulators have not been able to restrain those firms’ market power.

zh: G20正在寻求解决市场集中问题的办法，应该从美国的经验中汲取教训，并寻找改进美国的失败结果的方法。
en: As the G20 looks for ways to address the problem of market concentration, it should take lessons from the US experience, and look for ways to improve upon the US’s failures.

zh: 我们不必“白手起家 ” ， 而是需要以国家层面的竞争当局的行业知识为基础，并在此过程中将有经验的人手纳入进来。
en: Rather than starting from scratch, we will need to build on national-level competition authorities’ institutional knowledge, and include experienced personnel in the process.

zh: 欧洲竞争网络可以充当G20层面网络的蓝图。
en: The European Competition Network can serve as a blueprint for a G20-level network.

zh: 世界竞争网络的目标是构建一个有效的法律框架执行竞争法，以约束参与限制竞争的跨国商业活动的公司。
en: The objective of a world competition network is to build an effective legal framework to enforce competition law against companies engaging in cross-border business practices that restrict competition.

zh: 该网络可以协调调查和执法决定，制定关于如何监控数字经济中的市场权力和串谋行为的新指南。
en: The network may coordinate investigations and enforcement decisions and develop new guidelines for how to monitor market power and collusive practices in a digital economy.

zh: 在过去，G20集中关注的是确保跨国企业无法利用司法辖区的差异来避税。
en: In the past, the G20 has focused on ensuring that multinational firms are not able to take advantage of jurisdictional differences to avoid paying taxes.

zh: 但如今，G20需要扩大视野，认识到数字技术所制造的市场结果如果不通过世界竞争网络加以制约，将会一直牺牲工人的利益满足跨国公司的利益。
en: But the G20 now needs to expand its scope, by recognizing that digital technologies are creating market outcomes that, if unchecked by a new World Competition Network, will continue to favor multinational firms at the expense of workers.

zh: 埃及的经济警报
en: Egypt’s Economic Siren

zh: 发自纽波特滩 — — 面对政治局面动荡和街头抗议频发，埃及的政治精英们（不管是执政还是在野党）的稳妥做法应是关注当前动荡的经济含义。
en: NEWPORT BEACH – Facing a turbulent political situation and recurrent street protests, Egypt’s political elite would be well advised to focus on the economic implications of the current turmoil, whether they are in government or in opposition.

zh: 这么做会让他们明白为什么采用一个更具协作性的方法来解决国内的问题能更符合整个国家的集体利益，同时也符合他们自身的个体利益，对此令人信服的理由有以下七条：
en: Doing so would lead them to recognize seven compelling reasons why a more collaborative approach to solving Egypt’s problems is in the country’s collective interest, as well as in their own individual interests.

zh: 首先，如果社会动荡与政治骚乱持续，埃及经济将会以严重的通货膨胀、国际收支问题和预算危机告终。
en: First, if the social and political disorder persists, Egypt’s economy will end up with crippling inflation, severe balance-of-payments problems, and a budgetary crisis.

zh: 而催生一个自我强化的恶性堕落循环的风险将急剧上升。
en: The risk of a vicious, self-reinforcing downward spiral would rise sharply.

zh: 然而，与其说埃及经济会崩溃（上次债务危机期间亚洲和拉丁美洲国家就是如此 ） ， 它更可能会冒险回到令人窒息的管制和黑市交易。
en: But, rather than collapse (in the style of Asian and Latin American economies during the debt crises of old), Egypt’s economy would risk a return to stifling controls and black markets.

zh: 经济效率、投资和就业将会受到严重冲击，然而伴随更缓慢增长的则是更高的商品 — — 包括基本口粮 — — 的价格。
en: Economic efficiency, investment, and employment would take a significant hit, while slower growth would be accompanied by higher prices, including for basic food items.

zh: 大部分社会阶层都会受到损害，而穷人、失业者和年轻人受到的伤害尤甚。
en: Most segments of society would be harmed, with the poor, the unemployed, and the young suffering disproportionately.

zh: 鉴于这样的现实，始于2011年1月25日改革的合法性目标 — — 包容性增长、社会公正和人性尊严 — — 将更加难以实现。
en: With that, the legitimate objectives of the revolution that began on January 25, 2011 – inclusive growth, social justice, and human dignity – would prove even more elusive.

zh: 其二，如果不合作解决本国的政治困境，就不可能出现持久的经济和金融解决方案。
en: Second, no durable economic and financial solutions are possible without cooperatively addressing the country’s political quagmire.

zh: 不管用心有多良苦，技术官僚都不能保证能实施恰当的政策并得到最佳的结果。
en: No matter how well intentioned and gifted, technocrats cannot ensure proper policies and deliver optimal outcomes.

zh: 他们需要统一国家愿景的支撑、可信赖的领导力以及公民的支持。
en: They need the backing of a unifying national vision, credible leadership, and citizens’ support.

zh: 第三，面对长期的经济混乱和政治不稳定，埃及人越来越对革命的“操纵现象”感到失望，这加剧了他们对国家统治精英的不信任。
en: Third, faced with chronic economic disorder and political instability, Egyptians increasingly lament the “hijacking” of the revolution, fueling mistrust of the country’s governing elites.

zh: 既然曾经成功推翻了前总统胡斯尼·穆巴拉克（Hosni Mubarak）并把国家武装力量送回兵营，很多人都随时准备再次走上街头去让领导人承担罪责。
en: Empowered by their success in ousting former President Hosni Mubarak, and then sending the country’s armed forces back to the barracks, many are readily returning to the streets to hold leaders accountable.

zh: 第四，连番的街头抗议加上薄弱的警力助长了一系列小型犯罪活动。
en: Fourth, repeated street protests, combined with a weak police force, fuel small pockets of criminal activity.

zh: 机会主义暴徒煽动远超过他们人数和力量的恐惧和混乱 — — 无论是真实的还是人们感觉到的，这扩大了该国总体的不安意识。
en: Opportunistic thugs foment fear and chaos – real and perceived – that far exceed their number and power, amplifying the country’s general sense of malaise.

zh: 第五，外部经济援助并不能永久地推迟算总账的日子。
en: Fifth, external financial assistance cannot postpone the day of reckoning forever.

zh: 在这个旅游收入一般，需要不断进口食品和其他基本必需品的时期，目前为止一些友好政府给予的紧急支援减缓了埃及外汇储蓄不断缩小态势。
en: Emergency support from a few friendly governments has so far limited the erosion of Egypt’s foreign-currency reserves at a time of mediocre tourism earnings and growing imports of food and other basic necessities.

zh: 在面临外部支付义务且本国货币倍受压的情况下，政府再次向国际货币基金组织寻求48亿美元贷款，并从其他多边及双边来源进行融资。
en: Facing external payments obligations, and with the currency under pressure, the government will again seek a proposed $4.8 billion loan from the International Monetary Fund and co-financing from other multilateral and bilateral sources.

zh: 但要保证这种融资顺利实现则变得越来越困难。
en: But securing this financing is becoming more complicated.

zh: 第六，如果有适当的政治环境，埃及经济的潜力不可低估。
en: Sixth, the Egyptian economy’s potential, given the proper political context, should not be underestimated.

zh: 目前的环境让经济表现显著低于其潜力。
en: Current conditions are keeping economic performance well below potential.

zh: 这个问题可以迅速得到解决；那就是消除低效并重新定位那些由旧体系指派的，服务于少数人而不是多数人的机构则可以显著增加潜在产出。
en: This could be addressed promptly; while eliminating inefficiencies and re-orienting institutions that were co-opted by the old system to serve the few rather than the many would increase potential output significantly.

zh: 最后，埃及的政治领导人可以向其他国家学习。
en: Finally, the country’s political leaders can learn from other countries.

zh: 埃及并不是第一个处在从压抑的过去走向更好更公正未来的革命中挣扎的国家。
en: Egypt is not the first country to struggle in the critical revolutionary pivot from a repressive past to a better and more just future.

zh: 它也不是第一个同时具备不确定的政治过渡期和令人担忧的经济金融环境的国家。
en: Nor is it the first country to combine an uncertain political transition with worrisome economic and financial conditions.

zh: 人们很容易倾向于拒绝其他国家的经验，尤其是在埃及由年轻人发起的草根运动做出了一些没人觉得有可能会发生的事情之后（18天内推翻铁拳统治了30年的总统 ） 。
en: It is tempting to dismiss other countries’ experiences, particularly after Egypt’s youth-led grassroots movement delivered something that no one thought possible (toppling in just 18 days a president that had ruled with an iron fist for 30 years).

zh: 而有些国家确实与埃及有不同之处，借鉴它们的经验则会令埃及误入歧途。
en: And some countries do indeed differ from Egypt to such an extent as to make potential lessons misleading.

zh: 没有一个转型国家能给埃及提供参照。
en: There is no single transition country that offers a guiding light for Egypt.

zh: 但也许有四个国家 — — 南非、巴西、印度尼西亚和土耳其 — — 的经验结合起来与埃及相关，而当涉及到有序政治和经济转型时，它们会在许多方面与埃及许多阶层的人产生共鸣。
en: But there may be a group of four countries – South Africa, Brazil, Indonesia, and Turkey – whose combined experience is relevant and would resonate among many segments of the Egyptian population when it comes to orderly economic and political transitions.

zh: 这四国都面对过全面的劣势。
en: Each of the four faced what many deemed overwhelming odds.

zh: 然而，通过恰当地对其经济和政治挑战作出回应，它们都能做到减少贫困、促进社会公正并扩大公民自由。
en: Yet, by responding properly to their economic and political challenges, they all delivered poverty reduction, greater social justice, and expanded civil liberties.

zh: 总统纳尔逊·曼德拉(Nelson Mandela)领导下的南非显示了引导大众情绪远离复仇走向国家复兴的积极一面。
en: South Africa under President Nelson Mandela illustrated the upside of channeling popular sentiment away from retribution toward national renewal.

zh: 然而没有一个埃及领导可以可靠地传递曼德拉的信息“原谅但不要忘记 ” ， 并一起协同合作 — — 他们能有助于把国家的重点从过去转移到眼前的道路上。
en: While no single Egyptian leader can credibly convey Mandela’s message of “forgive but don’t forget,” together – working collaboratively and cooperatively – they can help to shift the country’s focus from the rear-view mirror to the road ahead.

zh: 总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）领导下的巴西展示了基本改革如何在由重大国内政治转型、投资者撤离以及不友好的全球环境所引起的骚乱下实施的。
en: Brazil under President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva demonstrated how basic reforms can be implemented in the context of turmoil caused by a major domestic political transition, fleeing investors, and an inhospitable global context.

zh: 2004年至2008年期间，曾长期以未来之国著称的巴西 — — “一直都是也永远都会是 ” — —其GDP年增长率为5.5 % 。
en: In 2004-2008, Brazil, which had been perennially known as the country of the future – as in “always has been and always will be” – recorded 5.5% annual average GDP growth.

zh: 它减少了生活在贫困水平的居民比例 — — 从40%减少到25%以下。
en: It reduced the proportion of citizens living in poverty from some 40% to under 25%.

zh: 并在收入不平等方面降低了整整5个点的基尼系数（以100分计算 ） 。
en: And it improved the 100-point Gini coefficient of income inequality by a full five points.

zh: 最后，印度尼西亚（在1997年亚洲金融危机之后）和土耳其（在2001年危机后）都是近期穆斯林人口占多数国家的例子，它们在处理重要的国内政治过渡时果断地克服了经济灾难。
en: Finally, both Indonesia (after the Asian financial crisis of 1997) and Turkey (after its 2001 crisis) are recent examples of Muslim-majority countries that decisively overcame economic mishaps while dealing with major domestic political transitions.

zh: 埃及目前的混乱持续得越久，它的政治精英就越有可能失去民心，这些人民的基本诉求可以总结为：面包、尊严、社会公正和民主。
en: The longer Egypt’s current disarray persists, the more its political elites will lose the battle for the hearts and minds of a population whose basic aspirations are summed up by four well-founded demands: bread, dignity, social justice, and democracy.

zh: 然而，只要有开明的领导和建设性的合作，埃及就可以克服当前的问题。
en: But, with enlightened leadership and constructive cooperation, Egypt can overcome its current troubles.

zh: 在过去，该国统治精英所做的一切与民众合理诉求之间越来越大的差距可以通过实施进一步镇压来解决。
en: In the past, a growing gap between what the country’s governing elites delivered and the population’s legitimate aspirations would have been addressed by imposing further repression.

zh: 然而新的埃及不会允许为这种行为。
en: The new Egypt will not allow this.

zh: 那些赋予普通埃及人的权力已经从根本上改变了一切。
en: The empowerment of ordinary Egyptians has fundamentally changed things.

zh: 埃及的政治精英并没有无限的时间，而目前的经济趋势使得他们采取行动的需要日渐紧迫。
en: Egypt’s political elites do not have unlimited time, and current economic trends are making the need to act increasingly urgent.

zh: 完善20国峰会议程
en: Completing the G-20’s Agenda

zh: 纽约 — 几近崩溃的全球金融系统显示出该系统在结构上的缺陷和监管上的问题。
en: NEW YORK – The near-complete collapse of financial systems worldwide has exposed fundamental weaknesses in their architecture and in how they are regulated.

zh: 如何“防御系统性的缺陷”再度发生，二十国峰会开始重新审视整个系统，并对其整体，而不是单一的机构进行监管。
en: In calling for measures to “guard against systemic risk,” the G-20 summit has begun the process of reconstruction by recognizing that the system in its entirety, not just individual institutions, must be regulated.

zh: 不幸的是，二十国峰会依然老调重弹，依然遵循着金融稳定论坛（Financial Stability Forum ） ， 美联储和其他机构的做法，这些做法包括针对金融机构的不透明性，过度金融杠杆作用，过于庞大的金融机构，逃税天堂和对金融大亨贪婪的报酬奖励，信用评级机构的利益冲突等问题的方案。
en: Unfortunately, the G-20 communiqué offers only more of the same prescriptions for managing systemic risk that the Financial Stability Forum (FSF), the United States Federal Reserve, and others have put forward. These proposals have focused on the problems caused by poor transparency, over-leveraging, outsized financial institutions, tax havens, bad incentives for financial bosses, and credit rating agencies’ conflicts of interest.

zh: 以上的问题都很重要，但唯独忽视了一个基本要点。
en: All of these are important, but they miss a fundamental point.

zh: 没有人会否认在过去的一年房价和股市的跳水，如此快速长期的价格下滑 — — 远远超出了历史上的纪录 — — 更加引发并加重了危机的产生。
en: No one now denies that the past year’s sharp downswings in housing and equity prices, which followed long upswings – far above historical benchmark levels – helped to trigger and fuel the crisis.

zh: 现在下滑的趋势还在继续，有着进一步恶化的可能。
en: As these downswings continue, there is a danger that they, too, may become excessive, dragging the financial system and the economy even deeper into crisis.

zh: 为了制约系统的风险，不仅仅需要对透明度和杠杆系统的监管，还要意识到风险会随着资产价格的变化而变化。 如果金融机构意识到这一点的话，他们会提取资本准备金，以防止房屋价格和证券价格逆转下跌而带来的风险。
en: Containing systemic risks, therefore, requires not just ensuring transparency and managing leverage in the system, but also recognizing that these risks vary along with asset values.  If institutions that were heavily exposed had understood this, they would have raised their capital buffers during the run-up in housing and equity prices in order to protect themselves against the inevitable reversals.

zh: 但我们知道，他们并没有这么做。
en: But, as we now know, they did not.

zh: 失败的一个原因是新巴塞尔资本协议（the Basel II Agreement）的主要条款一：规定了银行如何评定信用风险等级，以及如何界定资本提取准备金，这却体现不出长期资本市场的价格变化。
en: One reason for this failure is that pillar 1 of the Basel II Agreement, which outlines how banks around the world should assess credit risks and determine the size of capital buffers, makes no explicit allowance for long-swing fluctuations in asset markets.

zh: 反之，仅仅依靠风险值的概念来评估短期市场波动的情况。
en: Instead, it relies on value-at-risk (VaR) measures that link risk to standard notions of short-term market volatility.

zh: 问题出在这些方法的假设前提是市场表现良好的时候，风险会降低：在平稳的时期对资金的需求量减少，在市场动荡的时期对资金的需求量增加。
en: The problem here is that these measures implicitly assume that risk declines when markets are doing well: they demand less capital during calm periods and more capital during volatile periods.

zh: 实际上，假设的前提是资本的损失是偶然的，市场的巨变发生在价格的剧烈变化之后，而不是由风险计算的方式来决定的。
en: In effect, the presumption is that capital losses are random, so the sharp reversals and losses that usually ensue after excessive upswings in prices are disregarded in risk calculations.

zh: 实际上，当经济表现良好的时候，价值的衡量体系可能会发生作用。
en: Indeed, because standard measures of the probability of default fall when the economy is doing well and rise when it is not, capital requirements based on these measures tend to be pro-cyclical.

zh: 但市场趋势发生变化时，对资本的需要具有一定的循环性，这样就更加增加了系统的风险性。
en: But this increases systemic risk, rather than reducing it.

zh: 20国峰会现在要对目前的新巴塞尔资本协议作出修改，使它变得反循环性。 西班牙的经验告诉我们，这样做的效果很是成功。
en: The G-20 has now called for revising the Basel II standards so that capital requirements become countercyclical, and Spain’s experience with such requirements suggests that doing so is a step in the right direction.

zh: 但如此的改变还远远不够，原因是现在银行的资产 — — 特别是有着巨额的交易跨国银行 — — 对资本市场长期波动性的风险抵抗是脆弱的。
en: But such revisions of Basel II are not enough, because bank portfolios – especially those of international banks with large trading books – are vulnerable to the risks stemming from long-swing fluctuations in asset markets.

zh: 因此，我们不仅需要反循环的系统，银行资本金提取也必须随着市场上资产的泡沫和波底进行不断地调整。
en: As a result, not only are countercyclical measures needed, but banks’ capital requirements should vary inversely with the boom-and-bust fluctuations in the asset markets to which they are heavily exposed.

zh: 银行必须建立一定的防卫堡垒，以抵御在市场在转向的时候作出必要的调整。
en: Banks’ defenses need to be fortified during excessive upswings in asset prices so that they are able to weather the inevitable reversals.

zh: 金融风险和市场价格需要一个新的价格体系来评估 — — 不完全知识经济Imperfect Knowledge Economics (IKE ) — —用来理解风险和资产波动的关系。
en: The connection between financial risk and asset-price swings emerges from the use of a new approach – Imperfect Knowledge Economics (IKE) – to understanding risk and fluctuations in asset markets.

zh: 此种方法说明了有更多的解决系统风险的方法，以便于风险的识别和资本准备金的确定。
en: This approach implies that more can be done to reduce systemic risk, beyond reforming how risk is measured and capital buffers determined.

zh: 不完全知识经济 (IKE)认为，在一定的范围内，市场自身的调节比监管机关更加有效，但同样指出，价格的变化会变得有叠加效应，市场的参与者应该在长期来看，远离市场价值。
en: IKE acknowledges that, within a reasonable range, the market does a far better (though not perfect) job in setting prices than regulators can. But it also recognizes that price swings can become excessive, in the sense that participants may bid asset prices far from levels that are consistent with their long-term values.

zh: 历史的经验告诉我们，市场的波动是不稳定的，波动越是剧烈，后期的翻转效应也越是明显 — — 对金融体系和经济的影响也越是明显。
en: History teaches that such swings are not sustainable, and that the more excessive they become, the sharper and more costly are the eventual reversals – and the graver the consequences for the financial system and the economy.

zh: 从此次危机中得到的教训是应该采取谨慎的方法，对循环的波动必须加以阻止。
en: The lesson of this crisis is that excessive swings need to be dampened with a set of prudential measures.

zh: 一个可行的选项是对资产的价格宣布“指导原则 ” ， 目的是区分，而不是消除利润和资本金，帮助调整这些范围。
en: One possible measure is to announce “guidance ranges” for asset prices, with targeted variations of margin and capital requirements, not to eliminate, but to help damp down movements outside these ranges.

zh: 解决问题的关键是如何对不同的资产制定不同的处理方式。
en: The key feature of these measures is that they are applied differently depending on whether an asset is over- or undervalued relative to the guidance range.

zh: 目的是让价格不要变得十分离谱，让它回到一个理性的轨道上来。
en: Their aim is to discourage trading that pushes prices further away from the range and to encourage trading that helps to bring them back.

zh: 监管的目的是将金融市场回到一个相对理性的领域。
en: Improving the ability of financial markets to self-correct to sustainable values is the entire point of prudential regulation.

zh: 相反的，一些人认为对卖空行为（其他一些办法例如低估价值）的严格禁止，反而会使得市场越来越不稳定。
en: By contrast, wholesale restrictions on short-selling (and other such measures that pay no regard to whether an asset is over- or undervalued) – an option that some have suggested – could actually lead to greater instability.

zh: 规则在某些环境下会有效而在另一些环境下会失去作用。
en: Rules that are beneficial in some circumstances may become counterproductive in others.

zh: 所以严格遵循一些规则在目前来看不是一个好的选择。
en: So the idea that what the world needs now is more fixed rules will not do.

zh: 不幸的是，目前经济学的理论假设的前提是完美的价格，这让经济学家和政策制定者忽视了资产价格波动在系统中存在的风险。
en: Unfortunately, contemporary economic theory, with its presumption of perfect price discovery in asset markets, has discouraged economists and policymakers from paying any attention to the role of asset-price swings in managing systemic risk.

zh: 当今已经发生的全球金融危机让我们再也不能忽视这些致命的因素。
en: Today’s global crisis shows that we can no longer afford to ignore this vital factor.

zh: 不平等性的复杂性
en: The Complexity of Inequality

zh: 慕尼黑—2013年，托马斯·皮凯蒂（Thomas Piketty）出版了他广受热议的关于收入和财富分配的研究，此后，不平等性成为大部分发达经济体公共争论的前沿话题，从增长缓慢和生产率停滞到民粹主义崛起和英国退欧投票，一切问题都被归咎于此。
en: MUNICH – Since 2013, when Thomas Piketty published his much-discussed study of the distribution of income and wealth, inequality has been at the forefront of public debate in most advanced economies, blamed for everything from slow growth and stagnating productivity to the rise of populism and the Brexit vote.

zh: 但不平等性的定义仍然不明确，其效果也大相径庭，其根源更是众说纷纭。
en: But inequality remains poorly defined, its effects highly variable, and its causes hotly debated.

zh: 即便是最基本的问题 — — 多大的不平等性算是过度 — — 也几乎不可能得到回答。
en: Even the most basic question – how much inequality is too much – is virtually impossible to answer.

zh: 不存在一个经济体处于均衡状态时的“自然不平等率”可供决策者努力实现。
en: There is no “natural rate of inequality” characterizing an economy in equilibrium, a level at which policymakers can aim.

zh: 相反，各国的不平等率是相对的 — — 这是一个狭隘的方法，忽略了从总体经济趋势到不同社会环境中财富不平等性对人口的影响的不同的各种因素。
en: Instead, countries’ rates of inequality are measured against one another – a narrow approach that ignores everything from broader economic trends to differences in the impact of wealth inequality on populations in different social environments.

zh: 当所有人都在抱怨不平等性时，从全球水平看，财富的分配要比以往更加广泛。
en: At a time when everyone seems to be complaining about inequality, wealth is, at the global level, more broadly distributed than ever.

zh: 光是过去16年，跻身全球中产阶级 — — 今天的标准是拥有7,000—42,000欧元金融资产 — — 的人数就增长了一倍多，达到了十亿以上或世界人口的20 % 。
en: In the last 16 years alone, the number of people who qualify for inclusion in the global middle class – at today’s level, people with net financial assets of €7,000-42,000 ($7,400-$44,600) – has more than doubled, to over one billion, or about 20% of the world population.

zh: 增长的不仅仅是中产阶级。
en: And it is not just the middle class that is growing.

zh: 截至去年年底，全世界大约5.4亿人算得上全球富人，净资产超过42,000欧元。
en: At the end of last year, around 540 million people around the world could count themselves among the global wealthy, with net assets above €42,000.

zh: 这一数字比2000年增加了1亿，或25 % 。
en: That is some 100 million, or 25%, more than in 2000.

zh: 取得这一进步的关键是新兴经济体的成功，特别是中国。
en: The key to this progress has been the success of the emerging economies, especially China.

zh: 事实上，许多跻身高财富群体的人并非来自传统“富裕”国家；相反，美国、日本和西欧如今只占世界高财富家庭的66 % ， 而2000年时占90%以上。
en: And, indeed, many of those who have joined the high-wealth group are not from the traditional “rich” countries; on the contrary, the United States, Japan, and Western Europe now have just 66% of the world’s high-wealth households, compared with over 90% in 2000.

zh: 在国家层面，不平等性正在上升，但只是局部地区。
en: On the national level, inequality is rising, but only in some places.

zh: 在新兴经济体，中产阶级拥有的财富比例在增加，这表明财富不平等性有所下降。
en: In the emerging economies, the share of wealth owned by the middle class is increasing, indicating a drop in wealth inequality.

zh: 不平等性上升主要发生在工业化国家，顶层10%拥有财富的比例增长得最快。
en: It is primarily in the industrialized world that inequality is on the rise, with the share of wealth held by the top 10% growing the most.

zh: 这一差异可以用一个事实部分地解释：全球金融危机主要影响了发达国家，特别是欧洲。
en: This discrepancy may be explained partly by the fact that the global financial crisis was most painful for the advanced countries, especially in Europe.

zh: 但危机后发达国家央行所采取扩张性货币政策让情况雪上加霜。
en: But the expansionary monetary policies that advanced-country central banks pursued after the crisis made a bad situation worse.

zh: 这些政策推高了主要由富裕家庭持有的资产价格 — — 特别是债券和股票。
en: Those policies pushed up prices of assets – especially bonds and equities – that were held largely by wealthy households.

zh: 与此同时，这些政策伤害了中产阶级储蓄者，他们通常依赖银行存款等收益较低的储蓄工具。
en: At the same time, they hurt middle-class savers, who typically rely on duller savings instruments like bank deposits.

zh: 在零利率及后来的负利率环境下，这些储蓄者蒙受了损失。
en: With zero or, later, negative interest rates, those savers lost out.

zh: 尽管中位家庭总体而言从借贷成本下降中获益，但富裕家庭获得的好处要大得多，这部分要归因于按揭贷款成本下降，这笔支出占中上阶级收入的比重最大。
en: Though median households are generally benefiting from lower borrowing costs, wealthier households are benefiting much more, thanks in part to savings on mortgage loans, which are highest relative to income for the upper middle class.

zh: 但极端宽松的货币政策的影响远不止于今天的财富和收入效应。
en: But the impact of ultra-loose monetary policy extends far beyond today’s wealth and income effects.

zh: 随着发达国家人口的迅速老化，为晚年储蓄比变得比以往更加重要。
en: With advanced-country populations aging rapidly, saving for old age is more important than ever.

zh: 极低的利率降低了养老资产的积累速度，如今和未来，除了最富裕家庭，其他家庭都可能被迫提高储蓄并/或降低消费。
en: With very low interest rates reducing the rate of accumulation of pension assets, all but the wealthiest households will probably have to boost savings and/or reduce consumption, now and in the future.

zh: 生命周期支出的下降最终将给增长造成消极影响，并有可能制造子孙后代的社会断层线。
en: The decline in lifetime spending will ultimately have a negative impact on growth and potentially generate social fault lines for the coming generations.

zh: 让不平等性的故事更加复杂化的是各个经济体之间的不同，包括不平等性程度在技术上相近的经济体之间。
en: Complicating the inequality narrative further are differences across individual economies, including among those that, technically, have similar levels of inequality. Consider the disparities between the US, Denmark, and Sweden – all three of which are among the world’s most unequal societies, with respect to the distribution of wealth.

zh: 众所周知，丹麦和瑞典具有发达的社会福利制度、免费教育和高劳动力市场参与度。
en: Denmark and Sweden are known for their well-developed social-welfare systems, free education, and high labor-market participation.

zh: 此外，丹麦在去年的联合国世界幸福报告上傲视群雄，表明财富不平等性没有令丹麦人感到多少烦恼。
en: Moreover, Denmark took the top spot in the United Nations’ World Happiness report last year, suggesting that wealth inequality does not trouble Danes too much.

zh: 与这些北欧国家相反，美国缺少多种社会保护，不平等性问题也确实十分令人头痛。
en: By contrast, in the US, which lacks many of the social protections provided by its northern European counterparts, inequality is very troubling indeed.

zh: 过去十年，美国财富不平等性的上升幅度比任何国家都要触目惊心。
en: The increase in wealth inequality there over the last decade has been the most pronounced of any country.

zh: 如今，美国的中产阶级规模很小，他们只持有22%的总净金融财富，是其他工业化国家平均水平的一半，而其财富集中度比任何其他国家都要高。
en: Today, the US has the smallest middle class, holding just 22% of total net financial assets, half the average of other industrialized countries, and the highest concentration of wealth than in any other country.

zh: 与欧洲和日本一样，金融危机及随后的货币政策可能是这一趋势的主要原因。
en: As in Europe or Japan, the financial crisis and subsequent monetary policy might be a major cause for this development.

zh: 但是，另一个因素可能也是数字革命，至少对主流人群而言，它日益成为“财富催化剂 ” 。
en: However, another factor could also be the digital revolution which, at least for the main protagonists, is increasingly turning out to be a “wealth catalyst”.

zh: 无论如何，认识到美国的情况是反常情况十分重要。
en: In any case, it is important to recognize that America’s situation is extraordinary.

zh: 美国的情况不代表西方资本主义的状况。
en: It does not represent the state of Western capitalism.

zh: 它是一个例外，而不是规则。
en: It is the exception, not the rule.

zh: 所有这些对于如何应对不平等性具有重要影响。
en: All of this has important implications for how to tackle inequality.

zh: 简言之，如果各国不平等性的根源和影响不同，政策药方也应该不同。
en: Simply put, if the causes and impacts of inequality differ across countries, so should the policy prescriptions.

zh: 对一些国家而言，比如南欧国家，解决失业问题是让中低收入家庭储蓄和消费的关键。
en: For some countries, such as in southern Europe, tackling unemployment is critical to enable middle- and lower-income households to save and consume.

zh: 其他国家应该注重改善长期储蓄条件，如通过职业退休金计划。
en: Other countries should focus on improving the conditions for long-term savings, such as through occupational pension schemes.

zh: 还有一些国家可以大幅降低税收负担，特别是中低薪收入者。
en: Still others would do well to reduce the tax burden, in particular for low- and middle-wage earners.

zh: 但是，有一个政策药方能够有利于许多不平等性水平最高的国家。
en: There is, however, one policy prescription that would benefit many of the countries with the highest levels of inequality.

zh: 央行必须结束零利率以及（尤其是）负利率。
en: Central banks must bring down the curtain on zero and, especially, negative interest rates.

zh: 这样做必能成为遏制财富不平等性加剧的良好开端。
en: Doing so would certainly be a good start to combating rising wealth inequality.

zh: 挽救难民、挽救欧洲
en: Saving Refugees to Save Europe

zh: 纽约 — — 当6月23日欧洲难民危机推动英国公投脱欧时，它已经开始推动欧盟朝着解体的方向发展。
en: NEW YORK – The refugee crisis in Europe was already pushing the European Union toward disintegration when, on June 23, it helped drive the British to vote to Brexit the EU.

zh: 由此酿成的难民危机和英国脱欧灾难已经强化了排外的民族主义运动，上述运动将试图赢得一系列即将举行的大选 — — 其中包括2017年法国、荷兰及德国全国选举、10月2日欧盟难民政策匈牙利全民公决以及12月4日再度上演的奥地利总统大选。
en: The refugee crisis and the Brexit calamity that it spawned have reinforced xenophobic, nationalist movements that will seek to win a series of upcoming votes– including national elections in France, the Netherlands, and Germany in 2017, a referendum in Hungary on the EU refugee policy on October 2, and a rerun of the Austrian presidential election on December 4.

zh: 欧盟成员国不仅没有团结起来抵制这种威胁，反而越来越不愿意相互合作。
en: Rather than uniting to resist this threat, EU member states have become increasingly unwilling to cooperate with one another.

zh: 它们实行自私自利、以邻为壑的移民政策 — — 比如修建边境围栏 — — 进一步加剧联盟碎片化、严重损害成员国利益并颠覆全球人权标准。
en: They pursue self-serving, beggar-thy-neighbor migration policies – such as building border fences – that further fragment the Union, seriously damage member states, and subvert global human-rights standards.

zh: 目前零零碎碎的难民危机政策在年初欧盟与土耳其签署遏止东地中海难民流入协议时达到高潮，并存在着四大致命缺陷。
en: The current piecemeal response to the refugee crisis, culminating in the agreement reached earlier this year between the EU and Turkey to stem the flow of refugees from the Eastern Mediterranean, suffers from four fundamental flaws.

zh: 首先，协议并不能真正代表欧洲；它由德国总理默克尔出面与土耳其谈判并强加给欧洲各国。
en: First, it is not truly European; the agreement with Turkey was negotiated and imposed on Europe by German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

zh: 其次，执法资金严重不足。
en: Second, it is severely underfunded.

zh: 第三，它实际将希腊变成了一座临时监狱，而且监狱的设施严重匮乏。
en: Third, it has transformed Greece into a de facto holding pen with inadequate facilities.

zh: 最重要的是，上述对策不是自愿的。
en: Most important, the response is not voluntary.

zh: 欧盟正试图强加很多成员国奋力反对的难民配额，迫使难民在他们不愿前往也并不欢迎他们的国家居住，同时将通过非常规手段抵达欧洲的其他人送回土耳其。
en: The EU is trying to impose quotas that many member states strenuously oppose, forcing refugees to take up residence in countries where they are not welcome and do not want to go, and returning to Turkey others who reached Europe by irregular means.

zh: 这种局面非常不幸，因为没有全面庇护和移民政策的欧盟就缺乏存在的基础。
en: This is unfortunate, because the EU cannot survive without a comprehensive asylum and migration policy.

zh: 当前危机不是一次性事件；因为各种各样的原因，它预示着可以预见的未来移民压力很大。
en: The current crisis is not a one-off event; it augurs a period of higher migration pressures for the foreseeable future, due to a variety of causes.

zh: 其中包括欧洲人口不足和非洲人口爆炸；更大区域内看似永恒不变的政治和军事冲突；以及气候变化。
en: These include demographic shortfalls in Europe and a population explosion in Africa; seemingly eternal political and military conflicts in the broader region; and climate change.

zh: 与土耳其的协议从一开始就有问题。
en: The agreement with Turkey was problematic from its inception.

zh: 这笔交易的前提 — — 即庇护寻求者可以合法地返回土耳其 — — 从根本上看是有缺陷的。
en: The very premise of the deal – that asylum-seekers can legally be returned to Turkey – is fundamentally flawed.

zh: 尤其是在7月爆发未遂政变后，对多数叙利亚庇护寻求者而言土耳其并非是“安全的第三国 ” 。
en: Turkey is not a “safe third country” for most Syrian asylum-seekers, especially since the failed coup in July.

zh: 那么全面解决方案又将如何？
en: What would a comprehensive approach look like?

zh: 无论采取何种形式，它都必须以七大支柱为基础。
en: Whatever its final form, it would be built on seven pillars.

zh: 首先，欧盟地区必须以安全有序的方式从前线国家直接接收大量难民。
en: First, the EU must take in a substantial number of refugees directly from front-line countries in a secure and orderly manner.

zh: 这远比当前的混乱状态更能让公众接受。
en: This would be far more acceptable to the public than the current disorder.

zh: 哪怕欧盟承诺每年只接收300,000难民，多数真正的庇护寻求者也会从抵达目的地的概率的角度重新审视自己的行为，从而遏制他们寻求非法进入 — — 因为非法进入者首先已不具备合法的移民资格。
en: If the EU made a commitment to admit even a mere 300,000 refugees annually, most genuine asylum-seekers would view their odds of reaching their destination as good enough to deter them from seeking to reach Europe illegally – an effort that would disqualify them from legal admission.

zh: 其次，欧盟必须重新夺回边境控制权。
en: Second, the EU must regain control of its borders.

zh: 最能让公众疏远和恐慌的莫过于局面的混乱。
en: There is little that alienates and scares publics more than scenes of chaos.

zh: 第三，欧盟需要筹措足够资金以资助全面的移民政策。
en: Third, the EU needs to find sufficient funds to finance a comprehensive migration policy.

zh: 据估计开始几年每年至少要投入300亿欧元，而且“集中投资 ” （ 一开始就投入大量资金，而不是在若干年内投入同样的数额）的收益非常巨大。
en: It is estimated that at least €30 billion per year will be needed for a number of years, and the benefits of “surge funding” (spending a large amount of money up front, rather than the same amount over several years) are enormous.

zh: 第四，欧盟必须建立保护边境、审核庇护申请及重新安置难民的共同机制。
en: Fourth, the EU must build common mechanisms for protecting borders, determining asylum claims, and relocating refugees.

zh: 统一的欧盟庇护程序可以消除庇护投机并在各成员国之间重建信任。
en: A single European asylum process would remove the incentives for asylum shopping and rebuild trust among member states.

zh: 第五，要建立重新安置难民的自愿匹配机制。
en: Fifth, a voluntary matching mechanism for relocating refugees is needed.

zh: 欧盟不能迫使成员国接收他们不想要的难民，或者难民前往不想去的成员国。
en: The EU cannot coerce member states to accept refugees they do not want, or refugees to go where they are not wanted.

zh: 加拿大正在执行的移民计划可以引导和匹配难民和接收社区的偏好。
en: A scheme like the one used by Canada could elicit and match the preferences of both refugees and receiving communities.

zh: 第六，欧盟必须为难民接收国提供更大的支持，并且对非洲实施更为慷慨的计划���欧盟应提供真正现实的计划满足接收国的需求，而不是单纯利用发展基金满足自己的需要。
en: Sixth, the EU must offer far greater support to countries that host refugees, and it must be more generous in its approach to Africa. Instead of using development funds to serve its own needs, the EU should offer a genuine grand bargain focused on the needs of recipient countries.

zh: 这意味着在难民所在国创造工作机会，并以此减轻移民欧洲的压力。
en: This means creating jobs in refugees’ home countries, which would reduce the pressure to migrate to Europe.

zh: 最终营造出欢迎经济移民的宽松氛围是最后的支柱。
en: The final pillar is the eventual creation of a welcoming environment for economic migrants.

zh: 鉴于欧洲持续老龄化，移民带来的好处远远超过整合移民的成本。
en: Given Europe’s aging population, the benefits migration brings far outweigh the costs of integrating immigrants.

zh: 所有证据都显示只要给他们相应的机会，移民可以显著促进创新与发展。
en: All the evidence supports the conclusion that migrants can contribute significantly to innovation and development if they are given a chance to do so.

zh: 坚持其他地方更大规模协议所述的上述七项项原则对于安抚公众情绪、控制庇护寻求者混乱、确保新移民完全融入、与中东和非洲国家建立互惠关系和履行欧洲国际人道主义义务起着至关重要的作用。
en: Pursuing these seven principles, described in greater deal elsewhere, is essential in order to calm public fears, reduce chaotic flows of asylum-seekers, ensure that newcomers are fully integrated, establish mutually beneficial relations with countries in the Middle East and Africa, and meet Europe’s international humanitarian obligations.

zh: 难民危机并非欧洲面对的唯一危机，但却是最紧迫的。
en: The refugee crisis is not the only crisis Europe has to face, but it is the most pressing.

zh: 如果难民问题可以取得重大进展，就能够降低其他问题 — — 从持续不断的希腊债务危机到英国脱欧所造成的动荡局势再到俄罗斯所带来的挑战 — — 的解决难度。
en: And if significant progress could be made on the refugee issue, it would make the other issues – from the continuing Greek debt crisis to the fallout from Brexit to the challenge posed by Russia – easier to tackle.

zh: 拼图的所有部分必须完美贴合，并且成功的希望依然渺茫。
en: All the pieces need to fit together, and the chances of success remain slim.

zh: 但只要存在可能取得成功的战略，希望欧盟存在下去的人们就应当团结执行。
en: But as long as there is a strategy that might succeed, everyone who wants the EU to survive should rally behind it.

zh: 计算的未来
en: The Future of Computing

zh: 苏黎世—1955年，美国计算机科学家约翰·麦卡锡（John McCarthy）创造了“人工智能”一词，自此以后，公众构想出一个有意识的计算机和机器人能像人一样思考和行动的未来。
en: ZURICH – Ever since the American computer scientist John McCarthy coined the term “Artificial Intelligence” in 1955, the public has imagined a future of sentient computers and robots that think and act like humans.

zh: 但尽管这一未来确实可能到来，目前还至相当遥远。
en: But while such a future may indeed arrive, it remains, for the moment, a distant prospect.

zh: 但可以预见的计算前沿亦相当令人激动。
en: And yet the foreseeable frontier of computing is no less exciting.

zh: 我们已经进入了IBM所谓的认知时代。
en: We have entered what we at IBM call the Cognitive Era.

zh: 计算的突破正在增强我们利用大量数据的能力，为某些全世界最重要的决定提供指导，并有望革命整个产业。
en: Breakthroughs in computing are enhancing our ability to make sense of large bodies of data, providing guidance in some of the world’s most important decisions, and potentially revolutionizing entire industries.

zh: “认知计算”一词是指这样的系统，它没有明确的程序，而是为了学习经验而打造。
en: The term “cognitive computing” refers to systems that, rather than being explicitly programmed, are built to learn from their experiences.

zh: 这些系统从无结构的数据中提取有用的信息，从而加快了信息时代，帮助用户完成范围甚广的一系列任务，包括识别独特的市场机会、发现疾病新疗法、为城市、公司和社区制定创新解决方案等。
en: By extracting useful information from unstructured data, these systems accelerate the information age, helping their users with a broad range of tasks, from identifying unique market opportunities to discovering new treatments for diseases to crafting creative solutions for cities, companies, and communities.

zh: 认知时代标志着应用科学理解大自然和推动人类繁荣的新阶段。
en: The Cognitive Era marks the next stage in the application of science to understand nature and advance human prosperity.

zh: 其滥觞可以追溯到2011年，认知计算机系统沃森在游戏秀《Jeopardy ! 》 中打败了两位人类冠军。
en: Its beginning dates to early 2011, when the cognitive computing system Watson beat two human champions on the game show “Jeopardy!”.

zh: 此后，沃森又继续取得了大量成就，证明了认知计算可以使用大数据处理某些人类所面临的最困难的系统性问题的。
en: Since then, Watson has gone on to do much more, demonstrating how cognitive computing can use big data to tackle some of the most difficult systemic issues facing humanity.

zh: 广泛而言，认知系统提供了五项核心能力。
en: Broadly, cognitive systems offer five core capabilities.

zh: 首先，它们创造了更深度的人类参与，使用关于个体的数据创造更加完整的人类互动。
en: First, they create deeper human engagement, using data about an individual to create more fully human interactions.

zh: 其次，它们扩大和提升专家知识，从不同领域的专家中学习，让这些知识能为广泛的群众所用。
en: Second, they scale and elevate expertise, learning from experts in various fields and making that know-how available to broad populations.

zh: 第三，它们提供产品，比如连接到物联网的产品，这些产品具有感知周边世界、了解它们的用户的能力。
en: Third, they provide products, such as those connected to the Internet of Things, with the ability to sense the world around them and to learn about their users.

zh: 第四，它们让操作员得以利用大量数据，有助于管理工作流、提供情境、实现持续学习、改善预测、改进经营效率。
en: Fourth, they allow their operators to make sense of large amounts of data, helping manage workflows, providing context, and allowing for continuous learning, better forecasting, and improved operational effectiveness.

zh: 最后 — — 也许也是最重要的 — — 它们让用户能够感知传统方法无法发现的模式和机会。
en: And, finally – perhaps most important – they allow their users to perceive patterns and opportunities that would be impossible to discover through traditional means.

zh: 认知系统的灵感来自人的大脑，这个器官仍有许多内容等待我们探索。
en: Cognitive systems are inspired by the human brain, an organ that still has much to teach us.

zh: 随着系统规模和复杂程度的增加，传统计算机架构正在走向极限，因为耗电量的激增和元件之间的传输延时日益成为负担。
en: With systems growing in size and complexity, traditional computer architecture seems to be reaching its limits, as power consumption soars and the transmission delay between components becomes increasingly burdensome.

zh: 事实上，就能源效率而言 — — 用“无结构”数据上每能源单位的计算次数衡量 — — 人脑表现要比最佳人造机器还要高出大约10,000倍。
en: Indeed, when it comes to energy efficiency – measured in terms of the number of computations per energy unit on “unstructured” data – the human brain performs roughly 10,000 times better than the best man-made machines.

zh: 如今，据数字力量集团（Digital Power Group）CEO马克·米尔斯（Mark Mills）的数据，计算机消耗了大约世界发电量的10 % 。
en: Today, computers consume about 10% of the world’s electricity output, according to Mark Mills, CEO of the Digital Power Group.

zh: 为了充分实现认知时代的好处，我们必须能够处理巨量信息；在未来15年 ， “ 数字上可接触”的数据数量预计将增加1,000多倍。
en: In order to benefit fully from the Cognitive Era, we will have to be able to harness huge amounts of information; during the next 15 years, the amount of “digitally accessible” data is expected to grow by a factor of more than 1,000.

zh: 只有在能源效率实现巨大的改进，才有可能实现使用如此大量数据所需要的计算量。
en: Performing the calculations necessary for using such a large amount of data will not be possible without huge strides in improving energy efficiency.

zh: 赶超人脑的表现和效率可能需要我们模仿某些大脑结构。
en: Matching the performance and efficiency of the human brain will likely require us to mimic some of its structures.

zh: 我们不必试图从越来越大的芯片中榨取能源密集型性能，可以重新排布计算机元件，组成类似于人脑的密集3D矩阵，从而实现能源效率而不是性能的最大化。
en: Rather than attempting to squeeze energy-intensive performance out of ever-larger chips, we can arrange computer components in a dense 3D matrix similar to a human brain, maximizing not performance, but energy efficiency.

zh: 在3D环境中部署芯片让计算机的各种要素彼此之间更加接近。
en: Arranging computer chips in a 3D environment puts the various elements of the computer closer to one another.

zh: 这不仅缩短了它们的通讯时间；也改善了能源效率，幅度可达5,000倍 — — 有望产生能源效率接近生物脑的计算机。
en: This not only reduces the time they take to communicate; it improves energy efficiency by a factor of as much as 5,000 – potentially providing computers with efficiency close to that of a biological brain.

zh: 目前，通过可用移动技术和热水冷却建造的密度大幅提高的计算机已经实现了比传统系统高十倍的能源效率。
en: Already, a much denser computer built from available mobile technology and hot water cooling allows for ten times higher efficiency than a conventional system.

zh: 但人造计算机效率低下不仅是因为它们需要为芯片供能，也是因为它们需要能源运行空调从而带走处理器所产生的热量。
en: But man-made computers are so inefficient not only because they need to power the chips, but also because they need energy to run the air conditioners that remove the heat generated by the processors.

zh: 人脑在这方面也能提供教益。
en: The human brain has a lesson to teach here as well.

zh: 正如大脑使用糖分和血液提供能源、冷却各个区域，3D计算机也可以使用冷却液体为芯片输送能量。
en: Just as the brain uses sugar and blood to provide energy and cooling to its various regions, a 3D computer could use coolant fluid to deliver energy to the chips.

zh: 除了散热，这种液��还能用于为向处理器提供能量的电化学系统供能。
en: In addition to dissipating heat, the fluid could be used to power an electrochemical system providing power to the processors.

zh: 这反过来能进一步增加封装密度 — — 从而提高效率。
en: This, in turn, would allow for further increases in packaging density – and thus efficiency.

zh: 通过模仿人脑的某些特点，计算机有望大大增加紧凑性、效率和性能。
en: By adopting some of the characteristics of the human brain, computers have the potential to become far more compact, efficient, and powerful.

zh: 而这反过来能让我们充分利用认知计算 — — 为我们的真正的大脑提供新的支持、仿真和启发资源。
en: And this, in turn, will allow us to take full advantage of cognitive computing – providing our real brains with new sources of support, stimulus, and inspiration.

zh: 特朗普同志和真相
en: Comrade Trump and the Truth

zh: 牛津 — — 当美国当选总统唐纳德·特朗普本月底就职时，美国人将比多年以来出现更加分裂的状况。
en: OXFORD – When US President-elect Donald Trump takes office later this month, Americans will be more divided than they have been in years.

zh: 美国总统就职仪式从未得到过美国最古老的敌人俄罗斯如此多的赞美，也从未引起过美国最亲密盟友如此多的紧张。
en: Never before has an American presidential inauguration been met with so many hosannas from the United States’ oldest foe, Russia, and with such nervous anguish from its closest allies.

zh: 而且美国总统当选也从未出现过如此多的民众投票赤字：280万，而且还在统计当中。
en: And never before has a US president been elected with such a popular-vote deficit: 2.8 million and counting.

zh: 一个本该民有、民治、民享的政府其选举结果却明显来自少数人。
en: The leader of a government that is supposed to be of, by, and for the people has been elected by a clear minority of those people.

zh: 这样的民主理念受到克里姆林宫的称道还差不多。
en: It is fitting that only the Kremlin shares this idea of democracy.

zh: 当然，受过教育的观察家们知道美国总统选举并非由民众投票所决定，而是由选举团选出。
en: Of course, educated observers know that US presidential elections are not decided by the popular vote, but by the Electoral College.

zh: 美国的建国之父们为实现民众和国会投票之间的折衷和平衡各州影响而创建了这套系统。
en: The Founding Fathers created this system as a compromise between the popular vote and a vote by Congress, to balance the influence of each state.

zh: 亚历山大·汉密尔顿认为选举团有能力阻止“兼具阴谋天赋和深谙人气艺术”的不合格候选人当选。
en: Alexander Hamilton reckoned that the Electoral College would prevent unqualified candidates with “talents for low intrigue, and the little arts of popularity” from being elected.

zh: 这在相当程度上证实了我的看法，即起草美国宪法的人颇具讽刺天赋。
en: This rather confirms my view that the men who drafted the US Constitution had a sense of irony.

zh: 当特朗普吹嘘自己取得压倒性胜利的时候，某种程度上他的确是带有浓重个人特色的“实话实说 ” 。
en: When Trump brags that he won by a landslide, he is engaging in his characteristic “truthiness.”

zh: 他仅以107,000 票的优势赢得了密歇根、威斯康星和宾夕法尼亚等关键的民主党防火墙州 — — 占全国投票总数的0.09 % 。
en: He won the crucial Democratic firewall states of Michigan, Wisconsin, and Pennsylvania by only 107,000 votes – 0.09% of all votes cast across the country.

zh: 此次选举并不是什么压倒性胜利，而是揉进美国民主眼中的沙子，承诺要让俄国 — — 对不起，是美国 — — “再次伟大 ” 。
en: This election was not a landslide; it was a little sand blown into the great engine of American democracy by the promise to make Russia – sorry, America – “great again.”

zh: 让美国再次伟大显然意味着将精英骗子们赶出政府，然后再用亿万富翁和曾几何时高盛的同事来填满内阁。
en: Apparently, making America great again means pledging to remove elitist crooks from government, and then stuffing your cabinet with billionaires and Goldman Sachs alumni.

zh: 它意味着刺激经济增长，然后对进口商品强征35%的关税。
en: It means spurring economic growth, and then imposing a 35% tariff on imports.

zh: 此外，它还意味着承诺恢复钢铁工人和矿工的工作、停止接纳少数民族、驱逐所有无证移民、实行成百上千亿美元的减税和增加基础设施开支计划、废除奥巴马医改、废除或以某种方式重新谈判国家债务、折磨武装份子并将矛头对准他们的家族。
