en: And it means, among other things, promising to restore steelworkers’ and miners’ jobs, end the cosseting of minorities, deport all undocumented migrants, cut taxes and increase infrastructure spending by hundreds of billions of dollars, repeal Obamacare, eliminate or somehow renegotiate the national debt, torture militants, and target their families.

zh: 即将到来的一年，首都华盛顿的每个人最好都迎合特朗普，否则就有可能面对下流的推特、仇恨邮件和网络攻击。
en: Come next year, everyone in Washington, DC, had better be nice to Trump, lest they be subjected to nasty tweets, hate mail, and online attacks.

zh: 而上天保佑，所有认为特朗普对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京的亲热态度与俄罗斯恶意干预大选有关的人都厄运缠身。
en: And woe betide anyone who suggests that Russia’s malign interference in the election has anything to do with Trump’s own warmth toward Russian President Vladimir Putin.

zh: 别去管中央情报局和联邦调查局给出的俄罗斯黑客同时攻击民主党和共和党邮件，却唯独泄露了民主党的电邮；也不用管美国总统巴拉克·奥巴马现在拿出了一份报告，详细说明了俄罗斯在总统选举中所做的手脚和对俄情报部门的制裁行动。
en: Never mind that the CIA and FBI have concluded that Russia hacked both Democrats and Republicans, but only leaked Democrats’ emails; or that US President Barack Obama has now responded with a report detailing Russia’s involvement and sanctions against Russian intelligence agencies.

zh: 特朗普就职后调查人员将继续就这些重要问题进行取证，我敢打赌随着泄露信息的洪流涌出华盛顿，它们会以几何级数倍增。
en: The inquiries into these weighty matters will continue after Trump’s inauguration, and you can bet that they will multiply, as leaks flood out of Washington.

zh: 其中有些可能是虚假信息或缺乏根据的猜测，但有些却可能是真相，而且可能非常恐怖。
en: Some of these may be false flags or bits of speculation, but others may be true, and possibly horrifying.

zh: 无论如何，它们都将加剧国内分裂，同时削弱美国总统。
en: Either way, they will all be divisive, and they will weaken the US and its president.

zh: 但特朗普仍然可以在这场风暴中全身而退，除非调查人员能够证实其竞选团队和与普京有联系的任何俄罗斯机构共谋。
en: Still, Trump will weather the storm, unless investigators can confirm complicity between his campaign and any Russian entity known to be connected to Putin.

zh: 找到这样的叛国联系所要付出的代价一般人根本想象不出。
en: One can only guess what the prize would be for finding such a treacherous link.

zh: 局面肯定将一片混乱，但我们或许应当庆幸没有上演另外一幕。
en: This will all be very messy, but we should perhaps be grateful that the shoe is not on the other foot.

zh: 如果特朗普的民众选票大幅领先，但希拉里却在选举团投票中险胜。
en: Imagine that Trump had won the popular vote by a wide margin, but suffered a narrow defeat in the Electoral College.

zh: 如果这种情况伴随着中央情报局的调查报告，称俄罗斯情报机构攻击并且泄露特朗普竞选团队的邮件，导致他在竞选中陷入被动。
en: Imagine if this happened alongside CIA reports that Russian intelligence agencies had hacked and leaked Trump’s campaign emails to put him at a disadvantage.

zh: 再想象一下，希拉里·克林顿在她的内阁里塞满了亿万富翁。
en: And imagine that Hillary Clinton was packing her cabinet with billionaires.

zh: 如果出现那种情况，特朗普会怎么做？
en: What would Trump be doing?

zh: 他很可能会集结他的支持者，这些人在误导下相信克林顿及其丈夫是腐败的凶手。
en: He would likely rally his supporters, who have been led to believe that Clinton and her husband are corrupt murderers.

zh: 事实上，如果局面出现逆转，为美国这个我所热爱并一直仰慕的国家未来担心将具备充分的理由。
en: Indeed, if the tables were turned, there would be ample cause to worry for the future of the US – a country that I love and have long admired.

zh: 那么，面对未来的黑暗日子我们有什么对策？
en: So, what can we do in the dark days ahead?

zh: 首先，我们不能容忍谎言在公众探讨和辩论中将真相挤出。
en: For starters, we must not allow lies to crowd out the truth in public discourse and debate.

zh: 如果社交媒体充满谬误，必须用事实来进行回应。
en: If social media are full of falsehoods, counter them with facts.

zh: 如果您的同事在重复伪造的新闻头条或无知偏见的说法，我们应当站出来勇敢纠正。
en: If co-workers are repeating fake-news headlines or ignorant, prejudiced claims, challenge them on it.

zh: 如果电视或广播节目正在歪曲真相，打电话将你的想法告诉他们和他们的广告商。
en: If television or radio news programs are distorting the truth, pick up the phone and tell them and their advertisers what you think.

zh: 要求你的牧师和其他社区领袖卷起袖子一起这么做。
en: And ask your pastors and other community leaders to roll up their sleeves and do the same.

zh: 我们每个公民都必须说出真相，反对偏见和谎言，因为如果我们不坚持真理，接下来牺牲的就将是民主。
en: Each of us, as citizens, must campaign for truth and against prejudice and humbug, because if we lose the truth, democracy will be next.

zh: 正如圣奥古斯丁所说的那样 ， “ 真相就像一头雄狮。 它不需要你来保护。
en: As Saint Augustine supposedly said, “The truth is like a lion; you don’t have to defend it.

zh: 放它出去，它就能够自我保护。 ”
en: Let it loose, and it will defend itself.”

zh: 2017年，我们必须打开关有这头雄狮的铁笼。
en: In 2017, we must open the lion’s cage.

zh: 欧洲智能的移民政策
en: Smart Immigration for Europe

zh: 巴黎 — — 无论报道内容是关于一名非法马里移民爬上一座巴黎建筑物挽救一名幼儿，还是关于意大利成立旨在驱逐50万移民的民粹主义政府，与移民有关的头版头条已经成为欧洲媒体的主要关注。
en: PARIS – Immigration-related headlines have become a staple in Europe, whether the story is of an illegal Malian immigrant scaling a Paris building to rescue a toddler or the formation of a populist government in Italy that aims to deport a half-million migrants.

zh: 但尽管问题不断得到报道 — — 或者，更可能的是，恰恰因为问题不断得到报道 — — 移民政策辩论迄今为止依然受困于误解和政治化。
en: And yet, despite the constant coverage of the issue – or, more likely, precisely because of it – the immigration policy debate remains beset by misconceptions and politicization.

zh: 在英国，虚假和扭曲的说法，比如来自欧洲其他地区的不受限制的移民正在导致工资下降，部分助推了英国退欧公投。
en: In the United Kingdom, the Brexit vote was fueled partly by false and distorted claims, such as that unrestrained migration from the rest of Europe was driving down wages.

zh: 然而，自投票以来，反脱欧阵营也进行过类似的扭曲报道，他们警告，英国一旦退出欧盟，将面临技术工人短缺的状况。
en: Since the vote, however, the anti-Brexit camp has engaged in similar distortions, warning that, once it has left the European Union, the UK will face a skills shortage.

zh: 但许多国家 — — 如澳大利亚、加拿大和新加坡 — — 却在从未签署确保其他国家人员自由流动协议的情况下通过发放与技术相匹配的签证而做得很好。
en: But plenty of countries – such as Australia, Canada, and Singapore – do just fine without agreements guaranteeing freedom of movement from other countries, by issuing skills-matching visas.

zh: 欧洲各地赞成和反对移民力量的这种歪曲事实一直在阻碍就移民问题进行清醒的探讨。
en: Such distortions, by both pro- and anti- immigration forces across Europe, have consistently thwarted sober debate on the topic.

zh: 即使各方似乎正在对移民的经济影响进行合理的成本效益分析，他们也往往只引用研究和数据来支持自己的立场。
en: Even when parties seem to be carrying out a reasonable cost-benefit analysis of immigration’s economic impact, they tend to cite only the studies and data that back their own viewpoint.

zh: 这导致就移民问题达成创造性和有效的解决方案几乎是不可能的。
en: This precludes agreement on creative and effective solutions.

zh: 从我针对高技术人员国际移民所进行的多年研究来看，更不要说我曾经以移民身份生活过，关于移民问题的理性和均衡辩论必须始于移民本身的视角。
en: Judging by my years spent studying the international migration of highly skilled workers, not to mention living as an immigrant, a rational and balanced debate on immigration must begin with the perspective of immigrants themselves.

zh: 究竟是什么驱使个人迁移到通常是未知的全新国度？
en: What drives a person to move to a new and usually unknown country?

zh: 在回答这一问题时，人们很快就会发现移民是与国籍、技术水平、计划海外居住年限以及动机等各不相同的一系列因素相关的一种变化幅度很大的现象。
en: In answering this question, it quickly becomes clear that immigration is a highly varied phenomenon, depending as it does on a diversity of factors such as nationality, skill level, intended duration abroad, and motivation.

zh: 从印度永久移居英国的一名医疗专家的经历与期待在法国挣到更多薪水的罗马尼亚建筑工人大不相同。
en: The experience of a medical specialist moving permanently to the UK from India is very different from that of a construction worker from Romania hoping to secure a better salary in France.

zh: 无论从旅行的方便程度还是他们定居的生活条件，以上两者的经历都与希望在德国等待叙利亚内战结束的叙利亚难民的经历大不相同。
en: From the ease of the journey to the living conditions into which they settle, both the experiences of both are very different from those of a refugee from Syria hoping to wait out that country’s civil war in Germany.

zh: 上述经历的共同之处在于它们往往是出于提高生活水平的愿望，无论是通过获得更有声望的职位、更高的薪酬亦或是人身安全的增加。
en: What these experiences do have in common is they are generally driven by a desire to raise one’s living standards, whether through a more prestigious position, a higher salary, or increased physical safety.

zh: 简言之，移民想要过更好的生活 — — 而不是新身份或新文化。
en: In short, immigrants want better lives – not a new culture or identity.

zh: 尤其是经济移民不过是来自海外的求职者。
en: Economic migrants, in particular, are simply job-seekers from overseas.

zh: 如果可以在国内创造可比的就业机会，他们也许永远不会迁移到外国。
en: If comparable employment could be created at home, they might never migrate at all.

zh: 从这个意义上讲，经济移民难题归根结底是一项就业经济事务。
en: In this sense, the economic migration challenge boils down to an issue of job brokerage.

zh: 有鉴于此，经济移民应当与需要他们的岗位相匹配，达到上述目的可以通过在主要移民输出国最新成立就业中介机构。
en: Given this, economic migrants should be matched with jobs where they are needed, potentially through newly created job-brokering agencies for major immigrant-sending countries.

zh: 此外还可以创建一项受欧盟-土耳其难民交流计划启发的计划 — — 该计划规定对某国发放轮值工作签证的数量要与遣返该国的非法求职移民数量相挂钩。
en: A program inspired by the EU-Turkey refugee-exchange program – in which the number of rotating work visas made available for a country are tied to the number of illegal job-seeking immigrants repatriated to that country – could also be created.

zh: 当然，一旦进入东道国，就应当保护移民作为外国工人的合法权利。
en: Of course, once in the host country, the immigrants’ rights as foreign workers should be protected.

zh: 但他们无需被授予东道国社会公民的一切政治权利和社会福利。
en: But they do not need to be granted full access to the political rights and social benefits of their host society’s citizens.

zh: 这大致就是阿拉伯联合酋长国实行的制度，该国接纳了数百万外国出生的劳动者自愿就业。
en: This is roughly the system that is in place in the United Arab Emirates, where millions of foreign-born workers voluntarily pursue employment.

zh: 外国工人知道他们能够享受劳动和人权保护，法律将会起诉侵权行为，但却不享受额外的特殊权利。
en: They know they will enjoy labor and human-rights protections, with abuses prosecuted under the law, but no additional privileges.

zh: 这套系统使得阿联酋在为800万民众提供提高生活水平机遇的同时，避免遭到本土民众的强烈抵制。
en: This system enables the UAE to give nearly eight million people the opportunity to raise their living standards, while avoiding a backlash from the indigenous population.

zh: 另一个可能在某些领域生效的创新解决方案是瑞士的“G许可证”计划，该计划对居住在本国边境区域并在瑞士边境区域工作的外国人适用。
en: Another innovative solution, which may work in some areas, is Switzerland’s “G permit” scheme, available to foreigners who live in a border zone in their home country and work in a border zone in Switzerland.

zh: （边境区域均提前通过条约划定。
en: (Border zones are established by treaty.)

zh: ）所有跨境通勤人员必须每周回国至少一次。
en: All cross-border commuters must return to their home country at least once a week.

zh: 欧盟能否建立自己的“边境区域”分类，为非洲和近东地区非永久居住的劳动者提供允许自由流动的制度？
en: Could the EU create its own “border zone” category permitting a system of flexible mobility for non-permanent workers from Africa and the Near East?

zh: 否认移民与在东道国生活相关的特权似乎与传统欧洲的自由和平等价值观相悖。
en: Denying migrants the privileges associated with living in their host country may seem to contradict traditional European liberal and egalitarian values.

zh: 作为一名自由主义者，我赞同上述价值观，但承认坚持实施上述政策最终可能会损害移民的利益。
en: As a liberal myself, I share these values, but recognize that insisting on them as a matter of policy ultimately undermines migrants’ interests .

zh: 随着狂热的反移民政治势力在整个欧洲不断扩大，人们必须要问究竟是被有条件接纳（可能包括在有限时期内被接纳 ） 、 还是根本不被接纳符合那些迫切希望找到工作的新移民的愿望。
en: With vehemently anti-immigrant political forces gaining ground throughout Europe, one must ask whether the newcomers desperate for a job are better served by being admitted on a conditional basis (including, potentially, for a limited period), or by not being admitted at all.

zh: 技术移民也导致了类似的困境。
en: Skills-biased immigration gives rise to a similar dilemma.

zh: 欧洲不少人认为这种做法不仅歧视最弱势的移民群体，而且还导致需要高技术工人的国家陷入人才流失的窘境。
en: Many in Europe argue that this approach not only discriminates against the weakest groups of immigrants, but also leads to a brain drain from countries that need highly skilled workers.

zh: 但在这里我们必须再次权衡。
en: But, again, one must examine the trade-off.

zh: 技术移民更有可能顺利融入东道国社会，并为东道国社会增加更多价值。
en: Skilled immigrants are more likely to integrate smoothly into the host society, to which they can add more value.

zh: 这使得东道国和母国之间建立起文化桥梁。
en: This enables the construction of cultural bridges between host societies and home countries.

zh: 更重要的是，与他们留在国内纳税相比，这些移民可以将更多的钱汇回国内。
en: More important, those immigrants can send more money home in remittances than they would have been able to contribute in taxes had they remained.

zh: 移民问题长期以来在欧盟一直非常棘手，尤其因为散布恐惧和感情操纵一直在阻碍人们进行建设性的探讨。
en: The immigration issue has long been a thorn in the EU’s side, not least because of the fear-mongering and emotional manipulation that have impeded constructive debate.

zh: 软化甚至消除上述棘手问题的关键可能是在国家和欧盟层面订立经济移民的社会契约。
en: The key to softening the thorn, if not removing it altogether, may be to establish, at the national and EU levels, a social contract for economic migrants.

zh: 上述“外国劳工权利宪章”将保护移民权利，同时限制他们所享有的社会特权。
en: Such a “foreign worker rights charter” would protect immigrants’ rights, while restricting their social privileges.

zh: 如果移民问题不再是政治议程的决定因素，那么欧盟或许最终能够应对其所面临的无数其他挑战。
en: With immigration no longer dominating the political agenda, the EU might finally be able to address the myriad other challenges it faces.

zh: 理想情况下，欧盟可以凭借同样合作、创造性和明辨是非的方法来实现。
en: Ideally, it would do so with the same kind of cooperative, creative, and clear-eyed approach.

zh: 缺失的增长要素
en: The Missing Ingredients of Growth

zh: 米兰/纽约—如今，全球经济大部已经进入积极趋势：失业在下降，产出缺口在消失，增长在起势，此外，出于尚不明确的原因，通胀仍然低于主要央行的目标。
en: MILAN/NEW YORK – Most of the global economy is now subject to positive economic trends: unemployment is falling, output gaps are closing, growth is picking up, and, for reasons that are not yet clear, inflation remains below the major central banks’ targets.

zh: 另一方面，生产率增长仍然萎靡，收入不平等性不断加剧，文化程度较低的工人难以找到有吸引力就业机会。
en: On the other hand, productivity growth remains weak, income inequality is increasing, and less educated workers are struggling to find attractive employment opportunities.

zh: 在实施了八年的激进刺激后，发达经济体正在走出漫长的去杠杆化过程。 这一过程具有天然的需求侧增长抑制作用。
en: After eight years of aggressive stimulus, developed economies are emerging from an extended deleveraging phase that naturally suppressed growth from the demand side.

zh: 随着债务水平和组成的变化，去杠杆压力已经减小，全球同步扩张成为可能。
en: As the level and composition of debt has been shifted, deleveraging pressures have been reduced, allowing for a synchronized global expansion.

zh: 但是，GDP增长的主要决定因素 — — 以及增长模式的包容度 — — 早晚要归于生产率的提高。
en: Still, in time, the primary determinant of GDP growth – and the inclusivity of growth patterns – will be gains in productivity.

zh: 但是，从目前的情况看，有足够的理由怀疑生产率增长能否自动复苏。
en: Yet, as things stand, there is ample reason to doubt that productivity will pick up on its own.

zh: 政策组合中缺失了一些重要要素，这使得实现全要素生产率增长和转向更包容的增长模式变得更加困难。
en: There are several important items missing from the policy mix that cast a shadow over the realization of both full-scale productivity growth and a shift to more inclusive growth patterns.

zh: 首先，如果没有充分的人力资本，就无法实现增长潜力。
en: First, growth potential can’t be realized without sufficient human capital.

zh: 这是发展中国家经验的教训，但也适用于发达经济体。
en: This lesson is apparent in the experience of developing countries, but it applies to developed economies, too.

zh: 不幸的是，在大部分经济体，技能和能力似乎跟不上劳动力市场结构的迅速变化。
en: Unfortunately, across most economies, skills and capabilities do not seem to be keeping pace with rapid structural shifts in labor markets.

zh: 政府要么不愿，要么无力在教育和技能再培训或收入再分配方面采取果断行动。
en: Governments have proved either unwilling or unable to act aggressively in terms of education and skills retraining or in redistributing income.

zh: 而在美国等国家，收入和财富分配存在严重缺陷，较低收入家庭无力投资于适应迅速变化的就业环境的活动。
en: And in countries like the United States, the distribution of income and wealth is so skewed that lower-income households cannot afford to invest in measures to adapt to rapidly changing employment conditions.

zh: 其次，大部分就业市场存在巨大的信息缺口需要填补。
en: Second, most job markets have a large information gap that will need to be closed.

zh: 工人知道变化正在来临，但不知道技能要求在如何变化，因而无法根据具体的数据来做出选择。
en: Workers know that change is coming, but they do not know how skills requirements are evolving, and thus cannot base their choices on concrete data.

zh: 政府、教育机构和企业均不能在这方面提供足够的指引。
en: Governments, educational institutions, and businesses have not come anywhere close to providing adequate guidance on this front.

zh: 第三，企业和个人总是趋向机会扩张、营商成本较低、招聘前景有利、生活水平优渥的地区。
en: Third, firms and individuals tend to go where opportunities are expanding, the costs of doing business are low, prospects for recruiting workers are good, and the quality of life is high.

zh: 环境因素和基础设施社创造这些有活力和竞争力的条件的关键。
en: Environmental factors and infrastructure are critical for creating such dynamic, competitive conditions.

zh: 比如，基础设施能降低联动的成本，改善联动的质量。
en: Infrastructure, for example, lowers the cost and improves the quality of connectivity.

zh: 大部分支持基础设施投资的观点集中在不利的方面：倒塌的桥梁、拥堵的高速公路、二流的航空流量，如此等等。
en: Most arguments in favor of infrastructure investment focus on the negative: collapsing bridges, congested highways, second-rate air travel, and so forth.

zh: 但决策者的眼光必须超越赶超的需要，兼顾拖延已久的养护。
en: But policymakers should look beyond the need to catch up on deferred maintenance.

zh: 着力点应该放在投资于能为私人部门投资和创新创造全新机会的基础设施上。
en: The aspiration should be to invest in infrastructure that will create entirely new opportunities for private-sector investment and innovation.

zh: 第四，拨用公帑的科学、技术和生物医学研究对于驱动长期创新至关重要。
en: Fourth, publicly funded research in science, technology, and biomedicine is vital for driving innovation over the long term.

zh: 基础研究能增进公共知识，为私人部门创新打开新领域。
en: By contributing to public knowledge, basic research opens up new areas for private-sector innovation.

zh: 不论研究在哪里进行，都会给周边地方经济带来溢出效应。
en: And wherever research is conducted, it produces spillover effects within the surrounding local economy.

zh: 这四个方面几乎都没有成为大部分发达国家现行政策框架的显著关注点。
en: Almost none of these four considerations is a significant feature of the policy framework that currently prevails in most developed countries.

zh: 比如，美国国会所通过的税收改革方案有望提高私人投资，但对遏制不平等性、重塑和重新部署人力资源、改善基础设施或扩充科学和技术知识基本无益。
en: In the US, for example, Congress has passed a tax-reform package that may produce an additional increment in private investment, but will do little to reduce inequality, restore and redeploy human capital, improve infrastructure, or expand scientific and technological knowledge.

zh: 换句话说，税改方案忽视了平衡而可持续的未来增长模式的基础要素，即同时受到供给侧和需求侧（包括投资）支持的较高的经济和社会生产率轨迹。
en: In other words, the package ignores the very ingredients needed to lay the groundwork for balanced and sustainable future growth patterns, characterized by high economic and social productivity trajectories supported by both the supply side and the demand side (including investment).

zh: 雷·达里奥（Ray Dalio ）将投资于经济的人力资本、基础设施和科学基础的路径称为路径A。 另一条路径是路径B，它的特点是对直接提振生产率的领域的投资不足，如基础设施和教育。
en: Ray Dalio describes a path featuring investment in human capital, infrastructure, and the scientific base of the economy as path A. The alternative is path B, characterized by a lack of investment in areas that will directly boost productivity, such as infrastructure and education.

zh: 尽管经济目前偏向于路径B，但只有路径A才能带来更高、更包容和更加可持续的增长，同时改善与大规模主权债务和退休金、社会保障和公费医疗等领域的非债务负担有关的债务积压问题。
en: Though economies are currently favoring path B, it is path A that would produce higher, more inclusive, and more sustainable growth, while also ameliorating the lingering debt overhangs associated with large sovereign debt and non-debt liabilities in areas like pensions, social security, and publicly funded health care.

zh: 这也许只是一厢情愿，但我们希望在新的一年里，政府能够合力推动一个从达里奥的路径B走向路径A的过程。
en: It may be wishful thinking, but our hope for the new year is that governments will make a more concerted effort to chart a new course from Dalio’s path B to path A.

zh: 一个金融自由化主义者的自白
en: Confessions of a Financial Deregulator

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 回顾1990年代，在美国至少有两派人马鼓吹进一步推进金融自由化 — — 也就是撤销禁止商业银行和投资银行混合经营的法律规定，放松银行资本要求，并鼓励创设高风险金融产品和使用金融衍生品。
en: BERKELEY – Back in the late 1990’s, in America at least, two schools of thought pushed for more financial deregulation – that is, for repealing the legal separation of investment banking from commercial banking, relaxing banks’ capital requirements, and encouraging more aggressive creation and use of derivatives.

zh: 问题是如今人人喊打的金融自由化，当年为何就能招摇过市呢？
en: If deregulation looks like such a bad idea now, why didn’t it then?

zh: 第一大派系由美国共和党主导，基本理念就是既然所有监管行为都是错误的，那么金融监管肯定也不是好东西。
en: The first school of thought, broadly that of the United States’ Republican Party, was that financial regulation was bad because all regulation was bad.

zh: 另一大派系则由民主党担纲，其理念也更为复杂，主要基于以下四点观察：
en: The second, broadly that of the Democratic Party, was somewhat more complicated, and was based on four observations:

zh: ·        至少在世界经济的核心地带，各国已经过了超过60年的安稳日子，期间没有任何金融动荡能够对总体层面上的生产和就业造成重大影响。
en: ·        In the global economy’s industrial core, at least, it had then been more than 60 years since financial disruption had had more than a minor impact on overall levels of production and employment.

zh: 虽然现代中央银行在应对通胀冲击方面办法不多，但几十年来在抵抗通缩方面却相当得心应手。
en: While modern central banks had difficulty in dealing with inflationary shocks, it had been generations since they had seen a deflationary shock that they could not handle.

zh: ·         借助自身雄厚经济实力和钻监管规则的空子，各大投资银行寡头（就是包括高盛，摩根士丹利和摩根大通在内的那几个跨国投资银行）的盈利已经大大超越了任何竞争市场所能给予的盈利水平。
en: ·        The profits of the investment-banking oligarchy (the handful of global investment banks, including Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and JP Morgan Chase, among others) were far in excess of what any competitive market ought to deliver, owing to these banks’ deep pockets and ability to maneuver through thickets of regulations.

zh: ·        长期市场回报梯度数据似乎显示金融市场在调动社会风险承担能力方面成效惊人 — — 当然这些数据也是由那些财宏势大且有足够耐心借助地产，股票，金融衍生品和其他风险投资攫取超额回报的企业所取得的。
en: ·        The long-run market-return gradient – by which those with deep pockets and the patience to take on real-estate, equity, derivative, and other risks reaped outsize returns – seemed to indicate that financial markets were awful at mobilizing society’s risk-bearing capacity.

zh: ·        占美国人口1/3的中上层阶级 — — 尤其是富人 — — 能够以合理的利率贷款并投资于高回报领域，而另一外2/3的中低收入者则无此机会。
en: ·        The poorer two-thirds of America’s population appeared to be shut out of the opportunities to borrow at reasonable interest rates and to invest at high returns that the top third – especially the rich – enjoyed.

zh: 这四点观察意味着某些制度实验取得了良好效果。
en: These four observations suggested that some institutional experimentation was in order.

zh: 鉴于美联储成功隔绝了经济风险对总需求的影响，萧条时代流传下来的风险限制措施也似乎不那么重要了。
en: Depression-era restrictions on risk seemed less urgent, given the US Federal Reserve’s proven ability to build firewalls between financial distress and aggregate demand.

zh: 新的借贷和风险分散手段仿佛没什么缺点。
en: New ways to borrow and to spread risk seemed to have little downside.

zh: 坐拥巨资的商业银行和保险企业也加入了与投资银行寡头的竞争，估计也会迫使投资银行业降低其不合理利润。
en: More competition for investment-banking oligarchs from commercial bankers and insurance companies with deep pockets seemed likely to reduce the investment banking industry’s unconscionable profits.

zh: 这东西看上去确实值得一试，但却种下了苦果。
en: It seemed worth trying. It wasn’t.

zh: 平心而论，我们如今都还在收拾这场实验的残局。
en: Analytically, we are still picking through the wreckage of this experiment.

zh: 那些高杠杆跨国金融核心银行的风险控制为何如此糟糕？
en: Why were the risk controls at highly-leveraged money-center universal banks so lousy?

zh: 在金融危机及其余波摧毁私人投资和消费支出的时候，各国中央银行和政府为何没能出手增加和维持总需求水平？
en: Why weren’t central banks and governments willing and able to step up and maintain the flow of aggregate demand as the financial crisis and its aftermath choked off private investment and consumption spending?

zh: 随后的衰退应对政策则引发了更多的质疑：在经济下行风险逐渐清晰，但高通胀预期，高物价压力，甚至挤压私人投资支出的利率上调尚未出现的时候，政府为何没能介入并将失业率恢复到正常水平？
en: More questions arise from the policy response to the subsequent recession. Why, once the magnitude of the downturn became clear, weren’t governments eager to step in to return unemployment to normal levels, especially in the absence of higher inflation expectations, upward pressure on prices, or even interest-rate increases that would crowd out private investment spending?

zh: 金融业又何以调动如此庞大的政治力量将监管改革拒之门外？
en: And how has the financial industry managed to retain so much political power to block regulatory reform?

zh: 此外，如何重建金融系统依然缺乏方向不明。
en: Moreover, how to restructure the financial system remains unclear.

zh: 格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法案（Glass-Steagall Act）分隔投资银行和商业银行的做法极大促进了投资银行寡头的崛起，而来自商业银行和保险公司的竞争不知为何又进一步推高了金融企业的利润水平。
en: The Glass-Steagall Act’s separation of investment from commercial banking greatly benefited the established oligarchy of investment banks, but somehow the entry of competitors from commercial banks and insurers increased financial companies’ profits further.

zh: 对于那些能发现市场上的剩余风险承担能力，由此创设相关证券产品，随后找到能承担这些风险的投资者并收取佣金的金融中间商来说，赚大钱的机会比比皆是。
en: There were significant profit opportunities for financial intermediaries that could find spare risk-bearing capacity, carve out securities to take advantage of it, and thus take a middleman’s cut from matching risks with investors who could gain from bearing them.

zh: 但金融衍生品的出现非但没能分散风险，反而导致了风险的集中，因为把这些风险销售给那些不知如何衡量这类风险的人 — — 这些人事实上连自己承担了何种风险都不清楚 — — 能挣更加多的钱。
en: But the advent of derivatives concentrated risk rather than dispersing it, for there was even more money to be made by selling risk to people who did not know how to value it – or, indeed, what risks they were bearing.

zh: 而那些中央银行在履行其本职工作（稳定名义收入）方面的失职使之不但没能成为优秀的凯恩斯主义者，连好的货币主义者都算不上，也令人们不禁质疑这些机构是否也需要来一场大改革。
en: And central banks’ failure to regard their primary job to be the stabilization of nominal income – their failure not only to be good Keynesians, but even good monetarists – raises the question of whether central banking itself needs drastic reform.

zh: 早在1825年，英格兰银行行长康纳硫斯·布勒就意识到当私人部门出于某种恐慌而突然产生对安全和流动金融资产的需求时，英格兰银行就有责任提供这类资产以防止破产和衰退。
en: Back in 1825, the Bank of England’s Governor Cornelius Buller understood that when the private sector had a sudden panic-driven spike in demand for safe and liquid financial assets, it was the Bank’s responsibility to meet that demand and so keep bankruptcy and depression at bay.

zh: 而他的继任者们又怎么连这一点都不懂呢？
en: How can his successors know less than he did?

zh: 由此看来，我们甚至有可能会恢复到二战后那种管制更为严格的金融体系。
en: It may even be the case that we ought to return to the much more tightly regulated financial system of the first post-World War II generation.

zh: 那个系统很好地服务了各大工业国，至少我们可以在宏观经济总量上看到这一点。
en: That system served the industrial core well, at least as far as we can tell from the macroeconomic aggregates.

zh: 另外我们也清楚地知道：当前所使用的这套系统做不到这一点。
en: We know for certain that our more recent system has not.

zh: 关于冲突矿产的常识
en: Common Sense on Conflict Minerals

zh: 伦敦 — “ 那个在你手指上的钻石，说一下它是怎么样变成你的？ ” 莎士比亚笔下的辛柏林（Cymbeline）问。
en: LONDON – “That diamond upon your finger, say how came it yours?” asks Shakespeare’s Cymbeline.

zh: “他们折磨着我 ， ” 邪恶的埃阿基莫（Iachimo）回答 ， “ 并且不会出声告诉你，它们也会折磨你。
en: “Thou’lt torture me,” responds the villainous Iachimo, “to leave unspoken that which, to be spoke, would torture thee.”

zh: ”如今，在某些全球自然资源贸易的背后的故事 — — 不管有没有说出来 — — 也是那么令人痛苦。
en: The story behind certain parts of the global trade in natural resources today, whether spoken or not, is no less a source of anguish.

zh: 自然资源应该成为一些最需要它的国家的主要发展贡献源泉。
en: Natural resources should be a major contributor to development in some of the countries that need it most.

zh: 但是，在一些最贫穷、最脆弱的国家，自然资源带来了完全相反地东西。
en: And yet, in some of world’s poorest and most fragile states, they bring just the opposite.

zh: 在许多这些国家，自然资源贸易刺激、出资和延长了冲突和骇人听闻的人权侵害。
en: In many of these countries, the trade in natural resources motivates, funds, and prolongs conflict and egregious human-rights abuses.

zh: 钻石、黄金、钨、钽和锡由武装集团采掘、走私和非法课税，为暴虐的军队和安全部门提供预算外资金。
en: Resources such as diamonds, gold, tungsten, tantalum, and tin are mined, smuggled, and illegally taxed by violent armed groups, and provide off-budget funding to abusive militaries and security services.

zh: 以四个非洲国家为例：苏丹、南苏丹、中非共和国和民主刚果。
en: Consider just four African countries: Sudan, South Sudan, the Central African Republic, and the Democratic Republic of Congo.

zh: 这四个国家加起来只占撒哈拉以南非洲地区13%多的人口，但产生了该地区因冲突而在国内流离失所人口的55 % （ 全世界而言则是五分之一 ） 。
en: Together, these resource-rich countries account for just over 13% of the population of Sub-Saharan Africa, but some 55% of the region’s internally displaced persons (and one in five worldwide) due to conflict.

zh: 但这一问题是全球性的，哥伦比亚、缅甸和阿富汗的各地区也存在类似的现象。
en: But the problem is global, with similar patterns in parts of countries such as Colombia, Myanmar, and Afghanistan.

zh: 冲突资源的死亡贸易受供给主要消费市场（如欧盟和美国）的供应链的支持，资金流动方向则正好相反。
en: The deadly trade in conflict resources is facilitated by supply chains that feed major consumer markets, such as the European Union and the United States, with cash flowing back the other way.

zh: 自然资源 — — 比如锡、钽、钨和黄金，它们都与世界某些地方的冲突和人权侵害有关 — — 可用于我们的珠宝、汽车、移动电话、游戏机、医疗器械和数不清的日用品。
en: Natural resources, such as tin, tantalum, tungsten, and gold – all minerals that have been linked in some parts of the world to conflict and human-rights abuses – are found in our jewelry, cars, mobile phones, games consoles, medical equipment, and countless other everyday products.

zh: 帮助买家确定他们的购买行为不会牵涉到可怕的侵害行径的信息需求是显而易见的。
en: There is clear consumer demand for information that will help buyers make sure that their purchases do not implicate them in appalling abuses.

zh: 但协调全球商业和基本人权保护责任并不是消费者的首要责任。
en: But the responsibility to reconcile global commerce with the protection of basic human rights does not fall first and foremost on consumers.

zh: 冲突预防和人权保护主要是国家的责任，并且人们日渐认识到企业也必须有所贡献。
en: Conflict prevention and human-rights protection are primarily the responsibility of states, and it is increasingly recognized that businesses must play their part as well.

zh: 事实上，我们正处于掀起一场全球运动，不再承认不负责任的企业行为为正常现象的临界点上。
en: Indeed, we are now at a critical point in what has become a global movement to stop irresponsible corporate practices from being viewed as business as usual.

zh: 自2010年以来，在冲突地区经营的公司有了全球行为准则。
en: Since 2010, companies working in conflict areas have had a global standard at their disposal.

zh: 经合组织提出了如何负责任地寻找矿产来源的行为指引。
en: The OECD offers guidance on how to source minerals responsibly.

zh: 该指引与业界密切合作制定，提供了“详细建议以使公司尊重人权、避免其矿产采购决定和行为助长冲突。 ”
en: Developed in close collaboration with the industry, it offers “detailed recommendations to help companies respect human rights and avoid contributing to conflict through their mineral purchasing decisions and practices.”

zh: 联合国也支持类似的要求。
en: The United Nations has also endorsed similar requirements.

zh: 2011年，联合国发布了一组《关于商业和人权的指导原则 》 （ Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights ） ， 根据该���则，公司“的经营环境如果可能带来严重人权影响，则应该递交如何解决的正式报告。 ”
en: In 2011, the UN published a set of Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, according to which companies whose “operating contexts pose risks of severe human rights impacts should report formally on how they address them.”

zh: 但是，除了极少数进步行业领导者之外，很少有公司响应这一自愿引导原则。
en: And yet, with the exception of a few progressive industry leaders, few companies have responded to this voluntary guidance.

zh: 2013年，荷兰研究者186家在欧洲证券交易所上市的使用冲突矿产的公司。
en: In 2013, Dutch researchers surveyed 186 companies listed on European stock exchanges that make use of conflict minerals.

zh: 80%以上没有在网站中提到它们如何毕避免为冲突或人权侵害提供资金。
en: More than 80% made no mention on their Web sites of what they had done to avoid funding conflict or human rights abuses.

zh: 类似地，欧盟委员会贸易总司（Directorate General for Trade）发现，在153家欧盟公司中，只有7%在年报或网站中提到了对冲突矿产的尽职调查。
en: Similarly, the European Commission’s Directorate General for Trade found that only 7% of 153 EU companies refer to a due-diligence policy for conflict minerals in their annual reports or on their Web sites.

zh: 美国已经采取了下一步。
en: The United States has already taken the next logical step.

zh: 证券和交易委员会（Securities and Exchange Commission，SEC）要求在产品中使用钽、锡、黄金或钨公司调查原材料的来源，如果发现来源于冲突影响或高风险地区，必须根据经合组织指引减轻供应链风险。
en: The Securities and Exchange Commission requires companies that use tantalum, tin, gold or tungsten in their products to investigate these raw materials’ origin, and to mitigate risks in their supply chains in line with the OECD Guidance if they are found to originate in certain conflict-affected or high-risk areas.

zh: 非洲大湖区国际会议（International Conference on the Great Lakes Region）的12个成员也承诺了类似的强制性尽职调查要求。
en: The 12 member countries of Africa’s International Conference on the Great Lakes Region have committed to similar mandatory due-diligence requirements.

zh: 理应如此。
en: That is as it should be.

zh: 负责任地追溯来源是一种责任而不是一个选项。
en: Responsible sourcing is a duty, not a choice.

zh: 在这方面，欧盟正在落后。
en: And here, the EU is lagging behind.

zh: 3月份，欧盟提出一项计划，根据该计划，披露将继续是自愿性质，这意味着进入欧盟的矿产不需要接受强制性检查。
en: In March, the European Commission proposed a plan under which disclosure would continue to be voluntary, meaning that the minerals that enter the EU would not be subject to mandatory checks.

zh: 此外，该计划的注意力完全放在了原矿石和金属上，而排除了包含相关矿产的产品如移动电话、汽车和医疗器械。
en: The proposal, furthermore, focuses exclusively on raw ores and metals, and excludes products that contain the relevant minerals, such as mobile phones, vehicles, and medical equipment.

zh: 如今，该计划正由欧洲议会和欧洲理事会进行审核。
en: The proposal is now being reviewed by the European Parliament and the European Council.

zh: 关键是两大机构都必须抓住这次机会，通过强制性披露和合规要求以及将覆盖面扩大到制成品和半制成品来强化欧盟的责任。
en: It is crucial that both institutions seize this opportunity to strengthen the EU’s response by making disclosure and compliance mandatory and extending coverage to include finished and semi-finished products.

zh: 更好地监管这些资源的贸易本身无法给冲突地区带来和平。
en: Better regulating the trade in these resources will not itself bring peace to conflict-affected areas.

zh: 但为冲突和人权侵害提供资金绝不是可以接受的做生意的成本。
en: But funding conflict and human-rights abuses is not an acceptable cost of doing business.

zh: 战胜恐惧
en: Confronting Fear

zh: 华盛顿-即便在发达国家出手拯救金融体系使银行间借款的萎缩开始缓解后，不断下滑的经济指数还是使股票市场持续下跌。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Even as the squeeze in interbank lending has started to ease after the rescue of financial systems across the advanced countries, falling economic indicators have sent stock markets tumbling.

zh: 曾经被许多人认为与世界其他地区“分隔”开的新兴市场国家随着外国贷款撤出以及资产变卖也开始承受越来越大的压力。
en: Pressures on emerging-market countries, which were once thought by many to have “decoupled” from the rest of the world, have intensified as foreign loans are called in and assets sold off.

zh: 随着恐惧心理在全世界消费者、企业以及各个国家之间的蔓延，人们谈论的话题已经从发达国家温和的经济衰退转变为严重的全球经济衰退。
en: With fear gripping consumers, companies, and countries worldwide, talk has turned from a moderate advanced-country recession to a major world depression.

zh: 有一种悲观的情绪认为随便我们怎么做都无法阻止它的发生。
en: A sense of despondency has set in that nothing can be done to stop it.

zh: 发生了什么事情？
en: What is going on?

zh: 两周之前所采取的那些稳定金融体系的措施难道都错了吗？
en: Were the measures taken two weeks ago to shore up the financial system simply wrong?

zh: 当然不是。
en: Absolutely not.

zh: 流动资金的提供、银行的重新资本化以及发达国家更加统一的存款保险，这些都是完全正确并且必要的措施。
en: The provision of liquidity, the recapitalization of banks, more uniform deposit insurance across the advanced countries – these were all correct and necessary measures.

zh: 但是后面还有很多的事情需要我们去做。
en: But they were only the first installment on what needs to be done.

zh: 在发达国家，资产价值的下跌以及随之而来的普遍的恐惧心理沉重地打击了消费者和企业的信心，这导致消费持续下降以及公司削减投资。
en: In the advanced countries, the fall in asset values and, more generally, fear of what comes next has shattered consumer and business confidence. Consumption is dropping, and companies are cutting investment.

zh: 金融危机造成了需求的极度萎缩，对此经济学家称之为“凯恩斯衰退 ” 。
en: The financial crisis has created a sharp fall in demand, what economists call a “Keynesian recession.”

zh: 要重建信心，我们只有使用宏观经济工具来刺激需求和维持产量。
en: To help confidence revive, there is no alternative but to use macroeconomic tools to boost demand and sustain output.

zh: 那些利率依然保持在高位的国家可以运用货币政策，但是这种政策在信用紧缩时期的有效性可能会很有限。
en: Monetary policy can be used in countries where interest rates remain high, but its effectiveness in a credit squeeze is likely to be limited.

zh: 因此，财政政策必须扮演关键的角色。
en: Fiscal policy must, therefore, play a central role.

zh: 扩大财政支出通常是有风险的，因为它会增加债务以及可能在将来引发危险。
en: Fiscal expansion is always risky, as it adds to debt and raises dangers later.

zh: 但是鉴于我们现在所面临的局面，在那些债务水平可持续的国家运用这种政策所带来的利益会大于其代价。
en: But, given where we are, the benefits exceed the costs in countries with sustainable debt.

zh: 新兴市场国家还面临另外一个问题。
en: Emerging-market countries face an additional problem.

zh: 它们不但面临着出口和信心的下滑，同时它们还是这场始于美国、随后蔓延到欧洲、现在已经涌入它们国界的金融危机最近的受害者。
en: Not only must they contend with the prospect of falling exports and confidence; they also are the latest victims of a financial crisis that started in the United States, traveled to Europe, and now has swept across their borders.

zh: 外资银行正在削减贷款发放，外国投资者正在以前所未有的规模把资金撤回国内，发达国家为应对危机而采取的措施使它们把资金撤回国内变得更有吸引力，从而使新兴市场国家的日子变得更加艰难。
en: Foreign investors are repatriating their funds on an unprecedented scale. Ironically, the measures being taken to resolve the crisis in advanced countries are making it more attractive to bring money home, making life harder for emerging-market countries.

zh: 为了稳定金融体系以及总体需求，新兴市场国家必须准备好采取与发达国家类似的行动。
en: In order to shore up their financial systems and overall demand, emerging-market countries must be ready to take actions similar to those pursued by the advanced countries.

zh: 但是大部分这些国家最近几年的繁荣得益于全球资本的流入。
en: But the recent prosperity of many of these countries has come from access to global capital.

zh: 现在这种资本流入的突然中断对于这些国家肯定是一个沉重打击，并且使它们面临着一个单靠自己无法解决的特殊挑战。
en: A sudden stop to such flows is a severe blow and raises special challenges that cannot be solved by these countries alone.

zh: 因此发达国家必须准备向它们提供所需要的融资，并且这种资金的提供应该达到前所未有的规模。
en: So the advanced countries must be ready to provide the required financing, and to do so on an unprecedented scale.

zh: 因为如果我们不这样做，那我们很可能将面临范围广泛的拖欠债务、银行控制以及保护主义，这样的结果可能会在未来数年造成这些国家以及全球经济的衰退。
en: The alternative is the prospect of widespread debt default, banking controls, and protectionism – an outcome that would set back these countries, and the global economy as a whole, for years to come.

zh: 国际货币基金组织拥有必要的资金可以投入最高2500亿美元的资金。
en: The IMF has the wherewithal to commit up to $250 billion.

zh: 我们已经启动内部程序和工具以便我们能迅速地提供资金，只要其条件满足我们核心危机政策响应计划的规定。
en: We have set in motion the internal procedures and facilities that will allow us to provide resources quickly, with conditions limited to the core crisis-policy response at hand.

zh: 此外，基金组织正在制定新的流动资金供应，以便向拥有完善的政策和良好基本面、经济增长强劲的新兴市场迅速提供资金。
en: In addition, the Fund is working on a new liquidity line to provide resources immediately to strongly performing emerging markets with sound policies and fundamentals.

zh: 这些能给投资者注入信心。
en: This should give confidence to investors.

zh: 但是考虑到资本流动的规模，我还正在敦促发达国家的政府和中央银行向国际货币基金组织的危机响应计划提供我们所需要的资金。
en: But, given the scale of capital flows, I am also urging the governments and central banks of the advanced countries to provide parallel financing to the IMF’s crisis-response programs.

zh: 同时我认为有必要寻找途径让那些拥有庞大外汇储备的国家也参与进来。
en: I also am convinced of the need to find ways to bring into play the resources of countries with large reserves.

zh: 基金组织将发挥它应有的作用，但是我们还需要采取所有这些行动以提高全球共同应对危机的可信度。
en: The Fund will play its part, but all these actions are needed to reinforce the credibility of the coordinated global response to the crisis.

zh: 同时我们还必须做到未雨绸缪，尤其是对于非洲的低收入国家。
en: We must also think ahead – especially in regard to low-income countries in Africa.

zh: 因为它们对于国际金融市场的参与非常有限，因此迄今为止这些国家在某种程度上并未受到这场风暴的影响。
en: Because of their limited participation in international financial markets, these countries have, so far, been somewhat shielded from the storm.

zh: 但是这种平静并不让人感到安心，并且可能不会延续下去。
en: But it is an uneasy calm that probably will not last.

zh: 许多低收入国家将遭受物价下跌的影响。
en: Many low-income countries will suffer from the decline in commodity prices.

zh: 其他一些国家，包括���些成为新兴市场新的前沿的国家，可能看到流向它们的外国资本出现干涸。
en: Others, including those that were becoming the new frontier in emerging markets, may see their access to foreign capital dry up.

zh: 它们同样需要国际社会的帮助。
en: They, too, will need help from the international community.

zh: 国际货币基金组织和国际开发银行的借款以及将援助资金保持在目前的水平对于我们是否能防止一场新的人类悲剧的发生至关重要。
en: Lending by the IMF and global development banks, and the maintenance of donor aid at current levels, will be essential if we are to avoid new human tragedies.

zh: 恐惧的力量可能是灾难性的，但是它们是可以打破的。
en: The dynamics of fear are potentially catastrophic, but these dynamics can be broken.

zh: 不管金融体系存在什么问题，近些年来真正的基本面、也就是在科技、生产以及社会进步上取得的巨大发展是对全球化作为一种善的力量的真正实证。
en: Whatever the problems in the financial system, the massive improvements over the years in technology, productivity, and social progress – the real fundamentals – are a genuine testament to the power of globalization as a force for good.

zh: 也许现在阻止发达国家的经济衰退以及新兴和低收入国家的增长放缓为时已晚，但是阻止一场全球性的衰退为时并不晚。
en: It may be too late to avoid a recession in the advanced countries and a slowdown in emerging and low-income countries. But it is not too late to avoid a global depression.

zh: 面对民粹主义者
en: Confronting the Populists

zh: 圣马尔坦拉居埃皮耶—我坦白：我不会晚上躺在床上想念主流政治。
en: SAINT-MARTIN-LAGUÉPIE – Here’s a confession: I don’t lie in bed at night missing mainstream politics.

zh: 相反，我正在我位于法国西南部的房子里度过一周，徜徉于乡间。
en: Instead, I am spending a week at my house in southwest France, walking around the countryside.

zh: 夏末的阳光暖洋洋地照在我的背上，树叶正在泛黄，本地农民正准备收获今年的葡萄。
en: The early autumn sun is warm on my back, the trees are starting to change color, and local farmers are preparing for this year’s grape harvest.

zh: 还有什么令人不喜欢的呢？
en: What’s not to like?

zh: 回到政治世界，答案是太多了。
en: Back in the political world, the answer is quite a lot.

zh: 放眼左翼和右翼，几乎没有一位主流领导人正在享受如此美好的一年。
en: On the left and right – few mainstream leaders are having such a good year.

zh: 事实上，想找到值得关注的成就很难。
en: In fact, one must search for any notable achievements.

zh: 在法国，总统奥朗德正在准备明年春天的大选，他看起来就像是一件损坏了的商品。
en: In France, President François Hollande looks like damaged goods as he prepares for next spring’s election.

zh: 法国经济得益于高生产率潜力和高教育程度的劳动力大军，但工会派和其他奥朗德的社会党党员正在阻挠重塑强劲增长的措施。
en: The French economy benefits from high productivity potential and a well-educated work force, but trade unionists and other members of Hollande’s Socialist Party are blocking measures that would restore strong growth.

zh: 与此同时，前总统萨科齐和前总理朱佩正在争夺对中右翼反对派的控制以挑战奥朗德和阻挡极右翼的国民阵线的马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen ） 。
en: Meanwhile, former President Nicolas Sarkozy and former Prime Minister Alain Juppé are vying for control of the center-right opposition in order to challenge Hollande and head off Marine Le Pen of the far-right National Front.

zh: 民调显示，勒庞和萨科齐或朱佩之间都将会有第二轮竞争，这意味着左翼要想打败勒庞就必须选择一位传统右翼候选人。
en: Opinion polls indicate that there will be a second-round run-off between Le Pen and either Sarkozy or Juppé, which means that those on the left will have to choose a conventional right-wing candidate if they want to beat Le Pen.

zh: 她不太可能胜出；但是，6月份英国举行脱欧公投时人们也这么说，唐纳德·特朗普开始竞争美国共和党总统提名人时人们也这么说。
en: She is unlikely to win; but, then again, that’s what most people said about the United Kingdom’s vote in June to leave the European Union and Donald Trump’s campaign in the United States for the Republican Party’s presidential nomination.

zh: 在德国，欧洲最重要的政治家 — — 默克尔激起了选民的愤怒，原因是她坚定地欢迎难民的政策。
en: In Germany, Chancellor Angela Merkel – Europe’s foremost politician – has attracted voters’ ire, owing to her principled policy to welcome refugees.

zh: 反对党左翼党（Left Party）难以成为可信的选举力量；但极右翼的德国另类党（Alternative for Germany）一直在利用反移民情绪并在州选举中蚕食执政党（默克尔的基督教民主党以及中左翼的社会民主党）地盘，包括默克尔的家乡梅克伦堡-西波美拉尼亚州。
en: The opposition Left Party is barely credible as an electoral force; but the far-right Alternative for Germany has been exploiting anti-immigrant sentiments and chipping away at the support of the government parties (Merkel’s Christian Democrats and the center-left Social Democrats) in subnational elections, including in Merkel’s home state of Mecklenburg-West Pomerania.

zh: 在意大利，总理伦齐让经济起死回生的尝试已经失败。
en: In Italy, Prime Minister Matteo Renzi is flailing as he tries to kick a flatlining economy into gear.

zh: 由前总理贝卢斯科尼领导的中右翼反对派大势已去，他的主要对手现在是民粹主义的五星运动（Five Star Movement）以及只有抨击国家政治建制“一招鲜”的地区政客。
en: The center-right opposition, a shifting firmament led by former Prime Minister Silvio Berlusconi, is lost in the political wilderness, and his main opponents are now the populist Five Star Movement and regional politicians who offer little more than disdain for the national political establishment.

zh: 在西班牙，中右翼的人民党的首相拉霍伊正因为反对党西班牙社会工人党拒绝支持他而难以组建政府，与此同时，加泰罗尼亚分裂主义者仍在敲响独立的战鼓。
en: In Spain, Prime Minister Mariano Rajoy of the center-right People’s Party is struggling to form a government after the opposition Spanish Socialist Workers’ Party refused to support him, while Catalan separatists continue to beat the drum for independence.

zh: 在英国，让英国投票退出欧盟的主要是年龄较长、有疏离感的工作阶级和中产阶级选民。 新首相梅正在努力保持党内团结。
en: In the UK, where older, alienated working- and middle-class voters (mainly in England) pushed through Brexit, the new prime minister, Theresa May, is fighting to hold her party together.

zh: 一些内阁成员要求完全与欧洲脱离 — — 即所谓的硬脱欧 — — 也有一些人提出更加明智的中间道路，意欲保持英国商品和服务的最大市场。
en: Some cabinet members are pushing for a complete break from Europe – a so-called hard Brexit – while others press more sensibly for a middle-ground approach to maintain trade with the biggest market for British goods and services.

zh: 这些例子表明，民粹主义正在全欧洲蓬勃发展 — — 即使瑞典和荷兰这样的不可能之地也是如此。
en: As these examples indicate, populists are resurgent across Europe – even in unlikely places like Sweden and the Netherlands.

zh: 眼下，特朗普在欧洲将有一种宾至如归的感觉，应对他所代表的泛欧洲反建制愤怒是当务之急。
en: Now that Trump would feel quite at home almost anywhere on the continent, it is imperative to respond to the pan-Western anti-establishment rage that he represents.

zh: 诚然，2008年全球金融危机以来多年的经济低增长降低了选民对争夺中间派的传统政党的热情。
en: To be sure, slow economic growth in the years since the 2008 global financial crisis has sapped voters’ enthusiasm for traditional parties fighting over the middle ground.

zh: 左翼和右翼执政党在国际合作、自由贸易、公共支出和减税等问题上意见大体相同。
en: Governing parties on the left and the right have generally agreed on issues such as international cooperation, free trade, public spending, and tax cuts.

zh: 如今被视为共和党守护神的罗纳德·里根就是一位政府支出派，而比尔·克林顿削减福利支出，让预算平衡。
en: While Ronald Reagan, today’s Republican patron saint, was a big-government spender, Democrat Bill Clinton cut welfare entitlements and balanced the budget.

zh: 但是，今天的民粹主义者要求的是主流共识范围之外的简单甚至一根筋的答案。
en: Today’s populists, however, demand simple – indeed, simplistic – answers outside the scope of mainstream consensus.

zh: 他们指责全球化伤害了他们的生计和经济前景，并寻找敌人 — — 某种“他者 ” — —来为不确定性和他们所遭遇的向下流动“背锅 ” 。
en: They blame globalization for damaging their livelihoods and economic prospects, and they seek an enemy – some “other” – whom they can vilify for the uncertainty and downward mobility they have experienced.

zh: 民粹主义的世界观不承认灰色地带。
en: The populist worldview admits no shades of gray.

zh: 没有中间道路；相反，追求共识或妥协就是背叛。
en: There can be no middle way; on the contrary, searching for consensus or accommodation is tantamount to treachery.

zh: 通过咆哮和煽动，民粹主义政客正在让世界倒退回前帝国主义时代，让迷信和蒙昧成为更好的选择。
en: Through bluster and demagogy, populist politicians are turning back the clock to a pre-empirical world, in which superstition and obscurantism were apparently better for everyone.

zh: 当然，民粹主义者的美好过去只是黄粱一梦。
en: Of course, populists’ halcyon past is a dreamland.

zh: 但我们如何应对如此多的选民宁可相信虚幻也不愿面对事实的现实？
en: But how do we deal with the reality that so many voters prefer fiction to fact?

zh: 我们显然不应该放弃民主，或站在和特朗普一样敬仰并试图模仿俄罗斯总统普京的准暴君模式的西方人这一边。
en: We certainly should not give up on democracy, or side with those in the West who, like Trump, admire and seek to emulate Russian President Vladimir Putin’s demi-tyrant vision.

zh: 必须对民粹主义者针锋相对。
en: Populists must be confronted head-on.

zh: 他们的拙劣观点必须逐条驳斥，他们的愤怒之指应该用冷静、理性的思考应对。
en: Their shoddy arguments must be rebuked point by point, and their fugues of outrage must be met with calm, rational deliberation.

zh: 同样重要的是解决经济疏离的根源，这意味着首先要为弱势社区提供更好的公共服务，并投资于教育、技术和高薪高技能岗位。
en: It is no less important to address the causes of economic alienation, which means, for starters, providing better public services for disadvantaged communities, and investing in education, technology, and high-wage, high-skill jobs.

zh: 如果我们逃避民粹主义，或对他们的策略和观点照单全收，就会进一步破坏作为西方民主基础的社会契约。
en: If we run away from populists, or try to copy their tactics and arguments, we will further undermine the social contract underpinning Western democracies.

zh: 主流政治领袖面临着雄关漫道。
en: Mainstream political leaders face a challenging road ahead.

zh: 他们需要具备战斗精神，并表现出勇气，而不是流于自满或认命于长期败退。
en: They will need to adopt a fighting spirit and signal confidence in their cause, rather than succumbing to complacency or resigning themselves to a long-drawn-out retreat.

zh: 这是一场不能失败的战争。
en: This is a battle that must be won.

zh: 谴责谋害卡舒吉的凶手
en: Condemning Khashoggi’s Killers

zh: 阿姆斯特丹 — — 沙特记者贾马尔·卡舒吉（Jamal Khashoggi）被预谋残酷杀害的众多细节令人震惊。
en: AMSTERDAM – The details of the brutal, premeditated murder of Saudi journalist Jamal Khashoggi are astonishing.

zh: 首先是凶案发生的地点：不是什么幽暗小巷，而是在他本国驻伊斯坦布尔的领事馆。
en: For starters, there is the location: not some dark alley but inside his country’s consulate in Istanbul.

zh: 接下来则是被指控的肇事者：一个由15名成员组成的团队，其中包括曾在澳大利亚工作并带来一把骨锯的法医，以及换上卡舒吉服装 — — 那时死者尚且尸骨未寒 — — 轻松从后门溜走的伪装者。
en: Next, there are the alleged perpetrators: a 15-member team that included a forensic doctor who once worked in Australia and brought a bone saw, and a body double who put on Khashoggi’s clothes – probably while they were still warm – and casually slipped out the back door.

zh: 但最令人震惊的启示可能是这一点：沙特人知道自己可以摆脱谋杀指控。
en: But the most shocking revelation may be this: the Saudis knew they could get away with murder.

zh: 根据联合国教科文组织 — — 该组织的一部分职能是促进全世界记者的安全 — — 最近公布的数据，每10起记者谋杀案中就有9起的犯罪者未能受到惩处。
en: Recent figures published by UNESCO, the United Nations organization that is tasked, in part, with promoting the safety of journalists worldwide, show that in nine of ten cases, perpetrators are never punished for murdering a journalist.

zh: 由于有罪不罚现象已经成为常态，沙特当局决定铤而走险，反正即使杀人事件曝光也不会有什么后果。
en: Because impunity is the norm, Saudi authorities took the gamble that even if the killing came to light, the consequences would be minor.

zh: 他们也最终得逞了：虽然沙特检察官正以死刑起诉五名嫌疑人，但到目前为止国际上的反应一直不温不火。
en: And they were right: although prosecutors in Saudi Arabia are seeking the death penalty for five of the suspects, the international response has so far been meek.

zh: 尽管全球都在关注该起谋杀，但大多数领导人都只承诺会“考虑”制裁沙特；另一些则彻底否认了这个想法。
en: Despite the global attention the murder has received, most leaders have only promised to “consider” sanctions against Saudi Arabia; others have dismissed the idea outright.

zh: 比如美国总统特朗普就表示，尽管沙特官方的解释并不令人满意，但他无意通过限制武器销售或贸易作为回应。
en: US President Donald Trump, for example, has said that although the official Saudi explanation is unsatisfactory, he has no intention of responding by curbing arms sales or trade.

zh: 法国和西班牙的领导人也表达了类似的观点。
en: Leaders in France and Spain have expressed similar sentiments.

zh: 这种直言不讳的态度表明，当经济利益与人权相冲突时得势的总是前者。
en: Such bluntness illustrates that when economic interests are pitted against human rights, the former always take precedence.

zh: 而我们需要哀悼的不仅是记者生命的流逝，还有对公民自由和言论自由的侵蚀 — — 尤其是在中东地区。
en: It is not only the loss of a journalist’s life that needs to be mourned, but also the erosion of civil liberties and free speech – especially in the Middle East.

zh: 正如保护记者委员会上月报道的那样，沙特最亲密的地区盟友中有三个 — — 阿联酋，埃及和巴林 — — 都声明支持该国对卡舒吉遇害事件的回应。
en: As the Committee to Protect Journalists reported last month, three of Saudi Arabia’s closest regional allies – the United Arab Emirates, Egypt, and Bahrain – issued statements supporting the Kingdom’s response to the Khashoggi killing.

zh: 沙特本国和泛阿拉伯媒体也加入了这一阵营，而一群网络水军迅速展开行动，奋力为沙特统治者辩解并抹黑其批评者。
en: Saudi-owned domestic and pan-Arab media toed the line, too, while an army of online trolls quickly set to work to defend the Kingdom’s rulers and smear its critics.

zh: 这种粉饰行为可不仅限于卡舒吉案；在阿拉伯主流媒体中更难找到针对沙特主导的也门战争的严肃批评。
en: This type of whitewash is not limited to the Khashoggi case; it is even harder to find serious criticism in mainstream Arab media of the Saudi-led war in Yemen.

zh: 面对成千上万人的死亡以及可能额外夺去数百万条人命的毁灭性饥荒，该地区的新闻媒体几乎完全没有提及沙特王储穆罕默德·本·萨勒曼（Mohammed bin Salman）这个干预主义者在其中的作用。
en: With tens of thousands dead and a devastating famine threatening to kill millions more, the region’s news outlets are virtually silent on the role of the Kingdom’s interventionist crown prince, Mohammed bin Salman.

zh: 如果国际社会真正关心如何去捍卫人权，法治和民主价值观，那就必须谴责沙特的暴行。
en: If the international community genuinely cares about defending human rights, the rule of law, and democratic values, it must denounce Saudi Arabia’s brutality.

zh: 这个中东强国一手引发了大范围的死伤，破坏和苦难。
en: One of the Middle East’s most powerful countries is directly responsible for widespread death, destruction, and misery.

zh: 然而西方国家不仅对此表示宽恕；在某些情况下甚至通过提供武器来积极为其提供便利。
en: And yet Western countries are not only condoning these activities; in some cases, they are actively facilitating them by supplying the weapons.

zh: 沙特成为西方的战略盟友究竟符合谁的利益？
en: Whose interests are really served when Saudi Arabia is a strategic ally of the West?

zh: 当然不是也门，巴林和叙利亚那些惨遭边缘化的民众，也不是人权，性别平等以及西方领导人声称坚持的其他许多价值观。
en: It is certainly not the marginalized people of Yemen, Bahrain, and Syria. Nor is it anyone concerned with human rights, gender equality, and many other values Western leaders claim to uphold.

zh: 而再怎么强调像卡舒吉这样的记者对像沙特这类国家的重要性也是不为过的。
en: It is impossible to overemphasize the importance of journalists like Khashoggi to a country like Saudi Arabia.

zh: 如果没有了这些真理的​​提供者，制度和政治腐败就永远不会受到挑战。
en: Without these purveyors of truth, institutional and political corruption would never be challenged.

zh: 这也是不能任由沙特官员在外国法外杀害记者而不受惩罚的原因；政府必须紧急重估自身与沙特的联盟。
en: That is why Saudi officials’ extrajudicial killing of a journalist overseas must not go unpunished; governments must urgently reconsider their alliance with the Kingdom.

zh: 仅仅谴责侵犯人权的行为而不实施有意义的制裁是没有用的。
en: Simply condemning human-rights violations without applying meaningful sanctions will not change its behavior.

zh: 除此之外，国际社会还必须停止将调查和起诉记者谋杀案的责任委托给那些对他们恨之入骨的政府。
en: Beyond that, the international community must stop delegating the responsibility to investigate and prosecute the murder of journalists to the governments that wanted them dead.

zh: 在大多数情况下法治都太过弱势，而那些执法者往往就是是下谋杀令的人。
en: In most instances, the rule of law is too weak, and the very people in charge are those who ordered the executions.

zh: 正义可能永远无法在卡舒吉案中得到伸张，但他的血一定不会白流。
en: Justice may never be served in Khashoggi’s case, but his murder must not be in vain.

zh: 各个重视透明度和言论自由的政府必须共同努力去建立一个国际法庭以便在那些无法或不愿这样做的国家对记者被害案进行起诉。
en: Governments that value transparency and free speech must work together to create an international tribunal to prosecute cases of slain journalists in countries unable or unwilling to do so themselves.

zh: 而另一种选择 — — 让有罪不罚现象得势 — — 则会让犯罪分子逍遥法外并侵蚀新闻业本应捍卫的价值观。
en: The alternative – allowing impunity to prevail – will let criminals off the hook and erode the very values that journalism is meant to defend.

zh: 面纱的困惑
en: Confused by the Veil

zh: 7月23日，数以百万计的土耳其人醒来时将会迎来一个选举后的新土耳其。
en: On July 23 millions of Turks will wake up into a new, post-elections Turkey.

zh: 现在很难预料结果。
en: What will happen is hard to foresee.

zh: 土耳其的政治充满变数，只有外国人才会感觉惊讶。
en: Turkish politics is full of surprises that only foreigners find surprising .

zh: 如今，让大多数土耳其以外的人感到惊讶的是，不是土耳其男子、而是土耳其的妇女处于政治辩论的中心。
en: Today, and this seems to surprise most people outside Turkey, it is women, not men, who are at the heart of political debate.

zh: 确实，在这些选举中，来自各个政党的妇女候选人数量明显增加，而整体的女性政治活动也是如此。
en: Indeed, in these elections the number of women candidates from all parties has visibly increased and so has female political overall activism.

zh: 举行这一选举的原因是由于目前当政的正义和发展党指定外交部长居尔为其总统候选人之时，该国的世俗势力大为不快。
en: This election is taking place because when the AKP party, the conservative party now in power, designated Foreign Minister Abdullah Gul as its candidate for president, the country’s secular elite cringed.

zh: 居尔本人不是问题；问题是他的妻子。
en: Gul was not the issue; the issue was his wife.

zh: 如果居尔被选举为总统，那么，土耳其将会产生第一个佩戴头巾的第一夫人。
en: Had Gul been chosen as president, Turkey would have had its first headscarf wearing First Lady.

zh: 居尔妻子的头巾被解释成为即将来到的黑暗改变的象征。
en: Gul’s wife’s headscarf was interpreted as the symbol of darker changes to come.

zh: 世俗派的精英们认为，如果第一夫人佩戴头巾，那么，整个世俗体制就将遭到破坏。
en: If the First Lady wears a headscarf, maintained the secular-minded elite, the whole secular system could be undermined.

zh: 随后发生的是前所未有的政治动荡，包括从未有过的大规模示威活动。
en: What followed was unprecedented political turbulence, including mass demonstrations on a scale never seen before.

zh: 人们纷纷议论军队可能接管政权，而军队再一次证明是具有生命力的政治角色。
en: There was feverish talk of a possible military takeover, and the army again proved itself to be a seminal political actor.

zh: 在所有这些中，土耳其的妇女处在前沿。
en: Through all this, Turkish women were at the forefront.

zh: 特别是，土耳其西方化、现代化而又世俗的妇女看起来决心表明她们反对存在“另一种”土耳其妇女。
en: In particular, Turkey’s Westernized, modernized, secular women seemed determined to show their opposition to the existence of “the other” Turkish woman.

zh: 性别问题在土耳其民族国家中一直非常重要。
en: Gender issues have always been vital in the Turkish nation-state.

zh: 现代土耳其奠基人凯末尔的基马尔主义由于不仅转变了公共领域，而且也转变了私人领域，也就是母亲、妻子、姐妹以及女儿的领域，因此在所有的穆斯林改革运动中独树一帜。
en: Kemalism (the beliefs associated with the founder of modern Turkey, Musfafa Kemal Atutűrk) is unique among all Muslim reform movements in that it transformed not only the public sphere, but also the private sphere – the domain of mothers, wives, sisters, daughters.

zh: 在二十世纪二十年代和三十年代凯末尔统治时期，所谓“土耳其新妇女”成为了现代和世俗政权的象征。
en: In the 1920’s and 1930’s – the years of Atutűrk’s rule -- the “new Turkish women” became the icon of the modern, secular regime.

zh: 法国人所称的政教分离和世俗主义的区别对于土耳其而言要超过语言上的微妙不同。 在法国巩固了世俗共和国之后不久，土耳其也采纳了基马尔体制。
en: The difference between what the French call laicité and secularism is more than a linguistic nuance for Turkey, which adopted its Kemalist system not long after France entrenched its secular republic.

zh: 宗教象征和引述大多数被从公共领域清除，而宗教被认为是一个私人的事情。
en: Religious symbols and references have to a large extent been removed from the public sphere here, and religion is thought to be a private matter.

zh: 许多第一次访问美国的土耳其人被它的宗教影响所困惑不解。
en: Many Turks who go to the US for the first time are puzzled, indeed, by its religiosity .

zh: 看到宗教象征以及语录出现在公共建筑和钱币上以及法庭里确实令人惊讶。
en: It comes as a surprise to see religious symbols and statements at the entrance of public buildings, on money, inside the courtroom.

zh: 但是在土耳其，头巾并不被认为是一个可有可无的象征。
en: But in Turkey the headscarf is not seen as a trivial symbol.

zh: 共和国建国八十年来，佩戴头巾的妇女的问题是她们不属于理想的现代土耳其妇女的形象。
en: Eighty years after the republic’s founding the trouble with headscarved women is that they do not fit into the picture of the ideal modern Turkish woman.

zh: 乍一看，土耳其妇女之间存在有巨大的心理、文化以及政治鸿沟。
en: At the first glance there seems to be a huge mental, cultural and political gap dividing Turkey’s women.

zh: 但是，如果仔细观察，我们就会发现这一鸿沟就变得虚幻。
en: Yet if we look closer this gap becomes illusory.

zh: 在日常生活中，这两种土耳其妇女要比想象的更为交汇融合在一起。
en: In everyday life the two types of Turkish women are more mixed than they are usually assumed to be.

zh: 姐妹中的一个人戴着头巾而另一个不戴，或者母亲戴着头巾而她的女儿们不戴。 这种景象并不罕见。
en: It is not uncommon for one sister to wear a headscarf while another does not, or a mother to wear a headscarf while her daughters do not.

zh: 有时候两个最好的朋友一个戴着头巾而另一个不戴。
en: Sometimes among two best friends, one is covered and one is not.

zh: 随便沿着伊斯坦布尔熙熙攘攘的街道散步都会发现戴着头巾和不戴头巾的妇女毫不费力、几乎是自然地相互交融在一起。
en: Any stroll along a crowded Istanbul street will show covered and uncovered women effortlessly -- almost naturally -- mixing.

zh: 那么，为什么在政治领域就不能实现类似的姐妹情义呢？
en: Why then can’t a similar sisterhood be achieved in the realm of politics?

zh: 最近一次民意调查表明，土耳其大约60%的妇女出门在外的时候裹住头部。
en: A recent opinion poll shows that around 60% of women in Turkey cover their heads outside their homes.

zh: 但这是不是说60%戴着面纱呢？
en: But does this mean 60% wear the veil?

zh: 这是不是意味着她们所有的人都支持伊斯兰原教旨主义呢？
en: Does it mean that they all support Islamic fundamentalism?

zh: 这两个问题的回答都是否定的。
en: The answer to both questions is negative.

zh: 作为一个小说家，我在用土耳其语写作的时候会遇到八个不同表示头巾的词汇，各个都不相同。
en: As a novelist, when writing in Turkish I can encounter more than eight different words to stand for the headscarf. Yemeni, türban, eşarp, çarşaf,… Each is different.

zh: 不同的妇女出于不同的原因佩戴头巾。
en: Different women wear the headscarf for different reasons.

zh: 某些人出于习惯或者传统原因而非宗教理由。
en: Some wear it out of habit or for traditional reasons rather than religious ones.

zh: 对于其他人来说则出于政治动机。
en: For others the motivation is political.

zh: 并非所有的妇女都是出于宗教保守主义而佩戴头巾，而并非所有佩戴头巾的妇女都是“无知”或者“受到压迫 ” 。
en: Not all women wear a headscarf because of religious conservatism. And not all headscarved women are “ignorant” or “repressed.”

zh: 但是，这一复杂性由于“面纱”的概念而不复存在。
en: But this complexity is lost due to the concept of “the veil.”

zh: 如果人们不加以区分，而且不考虑细微的差别，就会相信60%的土耳其妇女佩戴面纱。
en: If one makes no distinctions and disregards nuances one will end up believing that 60% Turkish women wear the veil.

zh: 但是，同一调查显示，更多地出于政治而非传统原因完全裹住头部的妇女的比例只有不到11 % 。
en: The same poll, however, revealed that the percent of women who cover their heads fully and for more political than traditional reasons is no more than 11%.

zh: 注意细微差别就会有很大的不同。 不同就是说60%的妇女佩戴面纱以及说11%的妇女佩戴面纱。
en: Paying attention to nuances makes a huge difference– the difference between saying that 60% women wear the veil and saying that 11% do.

zh: 不仅西方观察家们，而且连土耳其的精英们也不晓得这一复杂性。
en: This complexity is lost not only on Western observers but also on Turkey’s elite.

zh: 由于这里意识形态的冲突看起来集中在妇女的身体和服装，也许现在应该停止问“一个理想的土耳其妇女应该是什么样子？ ” ， 而是开始问“是不是真的就应该有一种理想的土耳其妇女呢？
en: Because ideological clashes here seem to center around women’s bodies and clothes perhaps it is time we stopped asking “how should an ideal Turkish woman look?” and start asking “should there be an ideal woman Turkish woman at all?”

zh: ”毕竟，多元主义并不只是一个政治原则，而且这也是一个自由社会适用到个人上的原则，而不管是男子还是妇女。
en: After all, pluralism is not only a political principle, it is one a free society applies to individuals – male and female – as well.

zh: 我们土耳其思考伊斯兰是否可以和西方民主共存的问题已经有150多年了。
en: We in Turkey have been tackling the question of whether Islam can coexist with Western democracy for more than 150 years.

zh: 经过150年的西方化和现代化，我们给出的回答是斩钉截铁的“是 ” 。
en: After150 years of Westernization and modernization, the answer we have come up with is a definite “yes.”

zh: 土耳其是一个复杂的国家，具有多种难题。
en: Turkey is a complicated country, with multiple dilemmas.

zh: 土耳其的妇女不仅弥合、也在加剧其紧张局面。
en: Its women both heal and intensify its tensions.

zh: 刚果无休止的战争
en: Congo’s Infinite War

zh: 哈拉雷－一段时间以前，联合国难民机构首脑安东尼奥·古特雷斯（Antonio Guterres）提及到 刚果民主共和国时说 ： “ 因为外部世界没有人感觉受到了威胁，所以国际社会并没有真正对刚果问题加以注意。 ”
en: HARARE – Some time ago, the head of the United Nations refugee agency, Antonio Guterres, said of the Democratic Republic of Congo: “Nobody in the outside world feels threatened, and so the international community is not really paying attention.”

zh: 现在情形已经发生了变化：当前，刚果的东部省份北基伍省（North Kivu）几乎天天都上头条新闻了。
en: Not anymore: currently, Congo’s eastern province of North Kivu is in the headlines almost every day.

zh: 去年八月，北基伍省的省会城市戈马（Goma）北部的战争再度燃起，引起了一个看不到结局的人道主义危机。
en: Last August, fighting to the north of the provincial capital Goma flared up again, provoking a major humanitarian crisis that has no end in sight.

zh: 和在2002年名义上结束的八年内战（当时刚果仍然叫扎伊尔）一样，当前的战争涉及许多不同的当地群体：不仅有反对忠于图西族劳伦·坤达（Laurent Nkunda）将军的武装分子的刚果政府军队，而且还有对20世纪90年代的卢旺达种族屠杀负有责任的卢旺达胡图族叛军，以及以“马伊－马伊”民兵知名的丛林军队。
en: Like the eight-year civil war (in what was then known as Zaire) that nominally ended in 2002, the current fighting involves many different local groups: not only the Congolese government forces, which oppose the insurgents loyal to the Tutsi General Laurent Nkunda, but also the Rwandan Hutu rebels who were responsible for the genocide in Rwanda in the 1990’s and a jungle force known as the “Mai-Mai” militias.

zh: “局面一片混乱 ， ” 一位刚果朋友告诉我。
en: “It is a basket of crabs,” one Congolese friend told me.

zh: 跟往常一样，战争主要的受害者是困在战火中的平民。
en: As always, the main victims are civilians caught in the crossfire.

zh: 新的战争，在名为“戈马协定 ” （ Goma Agreement）的充满希望的和平倡议之后的八个月内，再次开始，这意味着更多的平民死亡，以及刚果东部恢复正常状态的希望更加渺茫。
en: The renewed fighting, coming eight months after a promising peace initiative known as the “Goma Agreement,” means more civilian deaths and little chance of normality returning to the eastern part of Congo.

zh: 然而，即使在战争不那么激烈的时候，刚果也经受着战争间接影响的荼毒。
en: Yet, even at times when fighting is less intense Congo suffers from the indirect effects of the war.

zh: 由国际救援委员会(IRC)进行并于今年早些时候发布的一份死亡率调查显示，这一冲突是第二次世界大战以来世界上最致命的危机：在过去十年中，大约有540万人因为战争及其延迟效应死亡。
en: A mortality survey conducted by the International Rescue Committee (IRC) and released earlier this year demonstrates that this conflict is the world’s most deadly crisis since World War II: an estimated 5.4 million people have died as a consequence of the war and its lingering effects in the last decade.

zh: 今天，有25万人流离失所，其中几乎有一半的人处在叛乱分子控制的区域，没有获取救助的任何途径。
en: Today, a quarter of a million people are on the run, almost half of them on territory under rebel control and with almost no access to aid.

zh: 这些人需要食物和住所，干净的饮用水以及厕所，医疗护理和教育。
en: They need food and shelter, clean water and latrines, medical care, and education.

zh: 他们中的妇女和女孩也需要保护，以免于性暴力的侵害 — — 当家人 被迫转移时，它会突然发生。
en: Women and girls need protection from sexual violence, which flares up when families are forcibly displaced.

zh: 这可能听起来很奇怪，但是从一个人道主义救援机构的观点来看，只要有接近他们的途径，需要帮助的平民处在谁的领土上并不重要。
en: It may sound strange, but from the point of view of a humanitarian relief agency, it is not important on whose territory civilians in need are, as long as there is access to them.

zh: 那些在刚果已经待了几年的救援人员，特别是像我所在的国际救援委员会这样的团体，必须和冲突各方合作，因为到处都是需要帮助的平民。
en: Aid workers who have been in the country for a dozen years, especially from groups like my own IRC, must work with all parties to the conflict because civilians in need are everywhere.

zh: 但是，救援机构需要进行救援的途径。
en: But aid agencies need access.

zh: 为了向平民人口提供保护，联合国维持和平部队刚果民主共和国特派团拥有联合国安理会进行完全干预的特别授权。
en: The UN peacekeeping force in Congo, MONUC, has a mandate from the Security Council for full intervention in order to provide protection to the civilian population.

zh: 所以，当武装分子用枪口阻止救援人员救援，而且救援人员不能通过谈话使事情取得进展的时候，人道主义机构自然会求助于联合国维持和平部队刚果民主共和国特派团，要求保证其救援通道。
en: So when aid workers are stopped at gunpoint and cannot talk their way through, humanitarian agencies naturally turn to MONUC to guarantee access.

zh: 人道主义工作者不是军事战略家，所以他们无法判断部署什么样的和多少维和人员是适当的。
en: Humanitarian workers are not military strategists, so they cannot judge what kind and what size of deployment of peacekeepers is adequate.

zh: 但是，在当地工作的救援机构具有维和人员在场带来的影响的一手经验，并且我们可以有权说，对救援人员的保护有时候是非常不够，以至于他们的人身安全处在危险之中。
en: But the aid agencies that work on the ground have first-hand experience of the impact of peacekeepers’ presence, and we have the authority to say that protection of aid workers can be dangerously inadequate.

zh: 事实上，在去年十月份争夺北部城镇鲁丘鲁（Rutshuru）控制权的战争最激烈的时候，驻扎在那里的国际救援委员会团队决定暂时撤出，因为风险实在是太大了。
en: Indeed, at the height of the fighting for control of the northern town of Rutshuru last October, the IRC teams that were stationed there decided to evacuate temporarily because the risk was simply too great.

zh: 国际救援委员会的工作人员和其他救援机构一起组成了一个卫队，联合国维持和平部队刚果民主共和国特派团提供了武装交通工具来保护这个卫队。
en: Together with other aid agencies, IRC staff formed a convoy and MONUC offered armed vehicles to protect it.

zh: 但是，当武装分子在路上拦住卫队的时候，联合国维持和平部队刚果民主共和国特派团中的乌拉圭维和人员就调转方向消失了，让救援人员听天由命。
en: But when armed men stopped the convoy on the road, the Uruguayan peacekeepers from MONUC simply turned around and vanished, leaving the aid workers to their fate.

zh: 接下来就是武装分子对救援人员长达数小时的折磨，羞辱，用点燃的手榴弹进行的威胁，对着我们一个同事的脚的开枪射击，以及对国际救援委员会所在地的抢劫和掠夺。
en: What followed were many hours of harassment, humiliation, threats with live hand grenades, shots fired at the feet of one of our colleagues, and looting and ransacking of the IRC premises.

zh: 最后，来自联合国维持和平部队刚果民主共和国特派团维和人员中的另一个团体 — — 来自印度的维和人员 — — 来进行了营救，并用直升机帮助救援人员撤出。
en: Finally, another group of MONUC peacekeepers – this time from India – came to the rescue and helped evacuate the aid workers on helicopters.

zh: 保护现在正在进行中的人道主义努力，对北基伍省（North Kivu）流离失所的刚果人纯粹的肉体存活下去至关重要，但是，唯一持久的解决办法是可能和“戈马协定”路线一致的和平协定后的停火。
en: Protecting the humanitarian effort now underway is essential to the sheer physical survival of the Congolese displaced in North Kivu, but the only lasting solution is a ceasefire followed by a peace treaty, possibly along the lines of the “Goma agreement.”

zh: 荒谬的是，当前的战斗和其导致的大量难民有助于引起人们对危机的注意。
en: Paradoxically, the current fighting and the masses of displaced persons that it produced have helped to draw attention to the crisis.

zh: 人们必须抓住这个机会，不但用它来作为加强联合国维持和平部队刚果民主共和国特派团的契机，而且，更重要的是，利用现存的可以支持武装分子和政府让冲突各方回到谈判桌上的一切途径。
en: This moment must be seized not only to beef up MONUC, but, more importantly, to use all existing leverage with the combatants and the governments that back them to get all the parties to return to the negotiating table.

zh: 电视上播放的战争造成的灾难，以及可以���特写镜头观察到残缺，可以并且也必须加以阻止，以免 — — 像在刚果经常发生的那样 — — 危机从新闻报道头版消失了，但是杀戮却以世人看不见的方式在继续。
en: The televised tragedy, and the shortcomings that can be observed close up, can and must be stopped, lest – as often happens with Congo – the crisis disappears from the front pages, while the killing continues unseen.

zh: 美国税收改革的特点
en: The Shape of US Tax Reform

zh: 美国剑桥—大规模税收改革是美国2017年日程的重点。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Major tax reform is high on the agenda for the United States in 2017.

zh: 共和党控制的众议院已经准备多年，拟定了修改企业和个人所得税法的详细方案。
en: The Republican-controlled House of Representatives has been preparing for this for years, creating detailed plans for overhauling how corporate and personal income are taxed.

zh: 如今，共和党在参议院也已经获得多数，并赢下了白宫，这些计划可能成为立法行动的基础。
en: Now, with a Republican majority in the Senate and a Republican president in the White House, those plans can provide the basis for legislative action.

zh: 公司税收改革方案尤其重要。
en: The proposed corporate tax reform is especially significant.

zh: 我认为这将给企业投资带来非常有利的影响，提高生产率和总体经济增长。
en: I believe it will have a highly favorable impact on business investment, raising productivity and overall economic growth.

zh: 新税收规则也将给外国经济体带来重要影响。
en: The new tax rules will also have significant effects on foreign economies.

zh: 目前，改革方案仍然远非板上钉钉，但其特征已经相当明显，包括四个重要要素。
en: Although none of the proposed changes is guaranteed, the likely shape of the proposed tax package is becoming clear. It includes four major components.

zh: 公司利润税率下调。
en: A lower tax rate on corporate profits.

zh: 当前35%的税率是所有工业化国家中最高的。
en: The current 35% rate is the highest rate among all industrial countries.

zh: 众议院共和党和特朗普政府都提出要削减一半，这将导致资本从房地产、非公司制企业和海外持有流向公司投资。
en: The House Republicans and the Trump administration have both proposed halving that rate, which would cause capital to shift to corporate investment from real estate, unincorporated businesses, and foreign holdings.

zh: 目前，公司税收入占GDP的2 % ， 减税方案将让其下降到GDP的1%左右，按目前的经济规模计算，即1,900亿美元。
en: With corporate-tax revenue currently equal to 2% of GDP, the proposed rate cut would reduce revenue by about 1% of GDP, or $190 billion a year in today’s economy.

zh: 由此带来的投资增长将提振增长，降低收入损失；但更偏好于收入中性的税收改革的国会共和党仍面临着挑战。
en: The resulting increase in investment would boost growth and lower the revenue loss; but congressional Republicans, who favor a revenue-neutral tax reform, would still face a challenge.

zh: 对美国企业的海外分支采取领地税收制度。
en: A territorial system for taxing US firms’ foreign subsidiaries.

zh: 美国对其公司的海外分支所赚利润汇回国内部分征收全额国内税率（扣除向外国政府缴纳的税收 ） ， 这在工业化国家是绝无仅有的。
en: The US is unique among industrial countries in subjecting repatriated profits earned by its companies’ foreign subsidiaries to the full domestic tax rate (with a credit for tax paid to the foreign government).

zh: 因此，假设一家美国企业在爱尔兰的利润需向爱尔兰政府缴纳12%的税收，那么如果它将利润汇回美国，还要被征税23 % 。
en: Thus, a US firm that earns a profit in Ireland pays a 12% tax to the Irish government and would now pay an additional 23% on any repatriated profits.

zh: 毫不奇怪，美国企业选择将利润留在海外。
en: Not surprisingly, US firms choose to keep their profits abroad.

zh: 采取领地制将提高对美国的投资，刺激生产率和增长。
en: Adopting a territorial system would increase investment in the US, stimulating productivity and growth.

zh: 税改方案将允许未来美国公司汇回海外利润是不必缴纳任何额外税收。
en: The proposal would allow all future foreign profits of US corporations to be repatriated without any extra tax.

zh: 此前囤积海外的2.1万亿美元利润需要交纳大约10%的一次性税收，可以分几年缴清。
en: The $2.1 trillion of previously accumulated overseas profits would be subject to a one-time tax of about 10%, to be paid over several years.

zh: 现金流公司税。
en: A cash-flow corporate tax.

zh: 这意味着两件事：允许公司立刻扣减所有设备和结构方面的投资，而不是将该成本进行摊销；以及取消新发生债务的利息成本扣减。
en: This means two things: allowing companies to deduct all investments in equipment and structures immediately, instead of spreading the cost over time; and eliminating the deduction for interest costs on newly incurred debts.

zh: 这将降低高负债率所引起的风险，平等对待债务和股本。
en: This would reduce the risk caused by high-debt ratios and put debt and equity on an equal footing.

zh: 我怀疑国会在深挖操作细节时是否真的会实施这项改革。
en: I doubt that Congress will actually enact this reform when it digs into the operational details.

zh: 一项贷款，什么时候是新贷款，什么时候只是已发放信用的展期？
en: When is a loan a new loan, and when is it just a continuation of an existing line of credit?

zh: 如果公司不再借钱融资购买设备，而是转为租赁设备怎么办？
en: What happens when companies shift from borrowing to finance an equipment purchase to leasing that equipment?

zh: 边境税调整。
en: Border tax adjustment.

zh: 和大部分其他国家不同，美国不征收增值税。
en: Unlike most other countries, the US does not have a value-added tax.

zh: 边境税调整将让美国拥有增值税的优势，而不必对国内交易征收该税种。
en: The border tax adjustment would give the US the international advantage of a value-added tax without levying that tax on domestic transactions.

zh: 其作用原理如下：进口商品的公司不允许在计算应税利润时扣除这一进口成本。
en: Here’s how it would work: Companies that import goods would not be allowed to deduct those imports’ cost in calculating their taxable profits.

zh: 假设公司税为20 % ， 这意味着20%的进口税。
en: With a 20% corporate tax rate, that would be equivalent to a 20% import tax.

zh: 出口商品的公司可以从应税收益中扣除出口利润，等于获得了20%的出口补贴。
en: Companies that export goods would be able to exclude the export earnings from taxable income, equivalent to a 20% export subsidy.

zh: 乍一看，这将减少进口、增加出口，但并非如此。
en: Although it looks like this would reduce imports and increase exports, that will not happen.

zh: 经济学学生都会学到，贸易余额取决于国内储蓄和国内投资之差。
en: As every economics student learns, the trade balance depends on the difference between domestic saving and domestic investment.

zh: 边境税调整不改变储蓄和投资，因此也不会改变进口和出口，相反，进口和出口税收的改变将导致美元升值，抵消边境税变化的直接影响。
en: Because the border tax adjustment does not change saving and investment, it wouldn’t change imports and exports. Instead, the changes in taxes on imports and exports would lead to a rise in the value of the dollar that offsets the direct impact of the border tax changes.

zh: 更具体地说，如果实施，边境税调整美元相较其他货币将升至25 % 。
en: More specifically, if the border tax adjustment is adopted, the dollar will increase by 25% relative to other currencies.

zh: 美元升值25%将让进口成本下降20 % （ 正好抵消进口价格因为20%的税收而上涨的幅度 ） ， 同时提高美国出口品对外国买家的成本（正好抵消20%的隐含补贴 ） 。
en: A 25% rise in the dollar lowers the cost of imports by 20% (just enough to offset the increase in import prices caused by the 20% tax), while raising the cost of US exports to foreign buyers (just enough to offset the implied 20% subsidy).

zh: 但既然边境税调整不改善美国贸易余额，国会共和党为何急不可耐地要采取这一措施？
en: But if the border tax adjustment would not improve the US trade balance, why are congressional Republicans eager to enact it?

zh: 真正的原因是它将大幅提振税收收入，而不会增加美国消费者或生产者的负担。
en: The real reason that it would boost tax revenue substantially, without increasing the burden on US consumers or producers.

zh: 目前，美国进出口分别占GDP的15%和12 % 。
en: Currently, US imports and exports are 15% and 12% of GDP, respectively.

zh: 两者之差为GDP的3 % ， 因此，20%的进口税和20%的出口补贴将让GDP净增0.6 % ， 或每年1,200亿美元。
en: Given the difference of 3% of GDP, the 20% import tax and 20% export subsidy raises a net 0.6% of GDP, now equal to $120 billion a year.

zh: 因此，边境税调整可以填补1,900亿美元的公司税削减成本的三分之二，若考虑到降低公司税率对增长的有利影响，这一比例还会更高。
en: The border tax adjustment therefore pays for about two-thirds of the $190 billion cost of the corporate tax cut, and an even larger share when the lower corporate rate’s favorable effect on growth is taken into account.

zh: 此外，由于美国消费者所付出的价格和美国出口商所得到的价格并没有发生改变，这一税收将由外国生产者承担，拜美元升值所赐，它们对美出口的本币收入下降了。
en: And, because there is no change in prices paid by American consumers or received by American exporters, that tax is borne by foreign producers, who, owing to the dollar’s appreciation, receive less in their own currencies for their exports to the US.

zh: 一些美国进口商认为美元不会充分升值到平衡隐含进口税增幅的程度，因此强烈反对边境税调整。
en: There is substantial opposition to the border tax adjustment among US importers who are not convinced that the dollar will strengthen enough to balance the higher implicit import tax.

zh: 但一年获得1,000多亿美元又不会影响到美国消费者和生产者，这样的前景将促使国会推进总体计划中的这一部分。
en: But the prospect of raising more than $100 billion a year without hurting US consumers or producers will drive Congress to move forward with this feature of the overall plan.

zh: 今年的立法将是三十年来美国第一次实施重大税制改革。
en: This year’s legislation will be the first major reform of the US tax system in three decades.

zh: 实现这一改革将为美国公司带来更有利、竞争力更强的税收框架。
en: Enacting it will produce a more favorable and competitive tax framework for American companies.

zh: 新医疗连续统
en: The New Health-Care Continuum

zh: 达沃斯—过去几年中，医疗行业经历了重大变化。
en: DAVOS – The health-care industry has changed dramatically over the past few decades.

zh: 研究和开发给我们带来了全新的治疗手段、强大的诊断学和快速增长的卫生知识。
en: Research and development have given us astonishing new treatments, powerful diagnostics, and a rapidly growing wealth of knowledge.

zh: 医学专业化和供应商蓬勃发展。
en: Medical specializations and providers have proliferated.

zh: 政府和保险商成为强大的行动方。
en: Governments and insurers have become powerful players.

zh: 而患者也成为话语权强大、积极主动的消费者，时刻准备着寻找更优选项，即使需要出国才能实现。
en: And the patient has become a vocal and proactive consumer, ready to search for better options, even if that means going abroad.

zh: 但是，尽管医疗变得更加高效，但也变得更加复杂和昂贵。
en: But, even as health care has become more effective, it has also become more complex and costly.

zh: 医疗体系已难以承受癌症和糖尿病等慢性疾病的重负，而不断增加和老化的人口又进一步增加了压力。
en: Growing and aging populations are putting increased pressure on health-care systems that are already buckling under the burden of chronic diseases like cancer and diabetes.

zh: 据医学研究所（Institute of Medicine）估计，光是在美国，每年就有7,500亿美元 — — 约占医疗总支出的30 % — —被“浪费在不必要的服务、过高的行政成本、欺诈和其他问题上。
en: The Institute of Medicine estimates that in the United States alone, some $750 billion a year – about 30% of total health-care spending – is “wasted on unnecessary services, excessive administrative costs, fraud, and other problems.”

zh: ”如果我们要确保医疗保持平价、我们的子孙后代仍能“有医无类 ” ， 我们就需要深刻反思如何提供和管理医疗。
en: If we are to ensure that health care remains affordable and widely available for future generations, we need to rethink radically how we provide and manage it.

zh: 一个关键问题是医疗需要具有连通性。
en: Crucially, health care needs to become connected.

zh: 全球医疗专业人士之间应该能够轻松地共享相关数据。
en: It should become effortless for medical professionals to share relevant data with colleagues around the world.

zh: 医疗设备和医院系统应该能够兼容各种信息源。
en: Medical devices and systems in hospitals should be able to combine multiple sources of information.

zh: 新一代消费者技术，如可穿戴健康传感器，可以自动向医生预警医疗问题而不必等到急性发作。
en: A new generation of consumer technology, such as wearable health sensors, could automatically alert doctors to potential medical problems before they become acute episodes.

zh: 尽管这一创新必须解决系统互通性和患者隐私保护等挑战，但互联网融入旅游和银行业的经验表明这是可行的。
en: Though such innovations must confront challenges like system interoperability and the need to protect patients’ privacy, the Internet’s integration into the travel and banking industries shows what is possible.

zh: 事实上，互联医疗正在成为现实。
en: Indeed, connected health care is already becoming a reality.

zh: 比如，飞繽fb浦公司开发了一项技术，可以让全世界医生之间共享前列腺癌活体切片的医疗数据。
en: Philips, for example, has developed a technology that allows doctors to share medical data from a prostate cancer biopsy with colleagues around the world.

zh: 在过去，活体切片只能以实体形式共享，这导致确诊前列腺癌的类型变得十分困难。
en: In the past, the biopsy could be shared only physically, which made diagnosing the exact type of prostate cancer difficult.

zh: 结果，外科医生和患者可能选择侵入性外科手术以求安全。
en: As a result, surgeons and patients may have opted for invasive surgery just to be safe.
