zh: 如今，全球医生团队有了新工具，让他们能够合作进行更准确的诊断和强化对个体患者的医疗计划。
en: Now, teams of doctors worldwide have an additional tool, enabling them to work together toward more accurate diagnoses and enhanced treatment plans for individual patients.

zh: 随着更好的预防、更快的诊断、更短的住院时间、更长的独立生活期成为“标配 ” ， 患者全过程体验也会被改变。
en: The entire patient experience will be transformed, with better prevention, quicker diagnoses, shorter hospital stays, and longer independent living becoming the norm.

zh: ���果患者回到医院，他们将带来有用的数据，这些数据由可穿戴设备捕获，标明生命信号的演变。
en: If patients return to the hospital, they will bring useful data, captured by wearable devices, about the evolution of their vital signs.

zh: 他们可以随着治疗的进展而继续跟踪检查资金，他们的数据可以纳入医疗记录，提供对他们健康状况的长期检视，而不是在就医当日进行插入式拍片。
en: They can continue to track themselves as their treatments progress, and their data can be integrated with medical records to provide a long-term view of their health, rather than an episodic snapshot of the day they visit a doctor.

zh: 患者可以获得全天候专业指导和支持，因此能够更有能力管理自身身体状况。
en: With access to professional coaching and support around the clock, patients will feel more empowered to manage their own physical wellbeing.

zh: 互联医疗还可以让更多人获得救命治疗，特别是发展中国家和农村地区人口。
en: Connected health care can also provide access to life-saving treatment to more people, particularly in developing countries and rural areas.

zh: 印度尼西亚是全世界婴儿死亡率最高的国家之一，该国棉兰（Medan）农村地区的助产士使用移动应用收集孕妇的医学数据。
en: In Indonesia, which has one of the world’s highest infant mortality rates, midwives in the rural area of Medan collect medical data from pregnant women using a mobile app.

zh: 这些数据由其他地区的妇科和产科医生分析，使高患病风险的妇女及早获得诊断和治疗。
en: The data are analyzed by obstetricians and gynecologists elsewhere, allowing women at high risk of illness to be identified and treated early.

zh: 在乌干达，村级医疗中心的助产士将压缩超声波扫描数据传送给遥远的专家，使可以获得高技能医护人员服务的新生儿数量接近翻番。
en: In Uganda, midwives in village health centers send compressed ultrasound scans to remote specialists, nearly doubling the number of newborns that can be delivered by a skilled health worker.

zh: 更广泛地说，互联医疗技术可以让专业医疗和消费者市场趋同。
en: More broadly, connected health technology will cause professional health care and consumer markets to converge.

zh: 这将形成一个连续统，从强调健康生活和预防开始，让消费者能够控制自身健康、国家能够改善公民总体福祉。
en: This will create a continuum that starts with a focus on healthy living and prevention, empowers consumers to take control of their own health, and enables countries to improve their citizens’ overall wellbeing.

zh: 接着，这一连续统将带来精确诊断和最小化入侵性治疗，优化质量和成本。 最后，这一连续统包括恢复和家庭护理，尽快改变医疗护理，使其向更舒适、更具性价比的院外实施转变。
en: The continuum will then move on to definitive diagnostics and minimally invasive treatments, optimized for quality and cost, and, finally, to recovery and home care, shifting medical care as soon as possible to more comfortable and cost-effective non-hospital settings.

zh: 政府、保险商、医学专业人士、患者和护理人员需要齐心协力确保向这一健康连续统的转变得到良好管理，扩大其接触范围，改善其结果，强化其生产率。
en: Governments, insurers, medical professionals, patients, and caregivers need to work together to ensure that the transition to this health continuum is well managed, so that access can be expanded, outcomes can be improved, and productivity can be enhanced.

zh: 团结一致的我们有机会改善数十亿人的生活，创造更健康的社会，节约成本，提振经济增长。
en: Together, we have the opportunity to improve the lives of billions of people, create healthier societies, save costs, and boost economic growth.

zh: 征服欧洲的债务高峰
en: Conquering Europe’s Debt Mountain

zh: 发自柏林 — — 据世界贸易基金组织估算，2009年20国集团（G20）各成员国在危机中为支持金融部门而付出的净成本占到了各国GDP总量的1.7 % （ 9050亿美元 ） ， 而任意制定的财政刺激计划金额则在2009年和2010年达到了GDP总量的2 % 。
en: BERLIN – The International Monetary Fund estimates that the crisis-induced net cost of financial-sector support provided by G-20 countries in 2009 amounted to 1.7% of GDP ($905 billion), while discretionary fiscal stimulus amounted to 2% of GDP in both 2009 and 2010.

zh: 除芬兰和卢森堡外，所有欧元区国家都通报本国财政赤字超过了GDP总量的3 % ， 而希腊，西班牙和爱尔兰的赤字则超过10 % 。
en: All the eurozone countries, except Luxembourg and Finland, reported fiscal deficits in excess of 3% of GDP in 2009, while Greece, Spain, and Ireland ran deficits of more than 10%.

zh: 在仅仅一年内，欧元区国家政府的普通债务就上升了大约10 % （ 从2008年的占GDP69.3%上升到2009年的78.7 % ） 。
en: Within a single year, eurozone governments’ general debt increased by almost 10 percentage points (78.7% of GDP in 2009, compared with 69.3% in 2008).

zh: 对德国来说，2010年的联邦预算总额上升到了创纪录的500亿欧元。
en: As for Germany, the 2010 federal budget features a record-high deficit of well above €50 billion.

zh: 公共部门的债务数量将超过1.7万亿欧元，约等于GDP的80 % 。
en: Public-sector debt will surpass €1.7 trillion, approaching 80% of GDP.

zh: 其中占联邦预算超过10%的利息支付额将随着债务的不断堆积而增加 — — 如果利率升高的话，递增的速度还会更快。
en: Interest payments, which consume more than 10% of Germany’s federal budget, will grow along with the mounting debt burden – and even faster if interest rates rise.

zh: 虽然金融危机和紧接着的衰退为如此巨额的债务提供了借口。
en: Yet the financial crisis and the ensuing recession go only so far towards explaining these high levels of indebtedness.

zh: 但事情的真相其实是许多欧盟和G20国家的支出都超过了自身收入 — — 连一直在财政管理方面堪称表率的德国无法独善其身。
en: The truth is that many European and G-20 countries have lived far beyond their means – including Germany, despite its reputation as a paragon of fiscal rectitude.

zh: 即便是在好年景中，各国政府的支出也长期高于收入。
en: Even in good times, governments have for too long been spending more than they received.

zh: 更遭糕的是，有些国家花费的要比他们所能轻易偿还的还要多，因为其国内人口的老龄化已经导致了长期经济增长潜力的衰退。
en: Perhaps worse, some also spent more than they could easily repay, given their economies’ declining long-term growth potential because of the aging of their populations.

zh: 如果我们不立刻作出应对的话，这种挥霍的行为将导致不可持续的高债务水平。
en: Such profligacy has led to levels of debt that will become unsustainable if we do not act.

zh: 这也是德国为何决定在2009年将严格的财政规定写入宪法的原因。
en: This is why Germany decided in 2009 to enshrine strict fiscal rules in its constitution.

zh: “债务刹车 ” ( Schuldenbremse)要求联邦政府在2016年实现结构性赤字不超过GDP0.35%的水平，而德国联邦州(Länder)则在2020年时禁止产生任何结构性赤字。
en: The Schuldenbremse, or “debt brake,” requires the federal government to run a structural deficit of no more than 0.35% of GDP by 2016, while Germany’s Länder will be banned from running structural deficits at all as of 2020.

zh: 当前的联邦政府当然会遵守这些规定，其中包含在2016年将结构性赤字降到100亿欧元的水平 — — 这相当于每年减少70亿欧元。
en: The current federal government will certainly abide by these rules, which implies reducing the structural deficit to approximately €10 billion by 2016 – a reduction of about €7 billion a year.

zh: 福利支出占了今年德国联邦政府支出的一大半。
en: Welfare benefits account for more than half of Germany’s federal spending this year.

zh: 所以削减福利开支（至少是温和地）是无法避免的选择。
en: So there is little choice but to cut welfare spending, at least moderately.

zh: 但这种财政巩固目标只有在公众认为它对整个社会都是公平合理的时候才能实现。
en: But this sort of fiscal consolidation can be achieved only if a majority perceives it as being socially equitable.

zh: 社会福利的受益者，公司福利以及公务员都要共同分担这一政策的成本。
en: Recipients of social and corporate welfare alike, as well as civil servants, must share the sacrifice.

zh: 政府将减少对企业的补贴，并对某些主要能源公司，航空公司和金融机构增税，这是企业在财政巩固措施方面所做出的牺牲。
en: Thus, German corporations will have to contribute to fiscal consolidation through reductions in subsidies and additional taxes on major energy companies, airlines, and financial institutions.

zh: 同样的，公务员将放弃提高工资，而政府则希望通过某些结构性改革在联邦武装力量中每年省下30亿欧元军费。
en: Similarly, civil servants must forego promised pay increases, and the government is looking for annual savings in the federal armed forces of up to €3 billion through structural reforms.

zh: 德国这种强制性的财政规定为其他欧元区国家做了榜样。
en: Germany’s binding fiscal rules set a positive example for other eurozone countries.

zh: 所有的欧元区国家政府都需要用实际行动来实现财政巩固以便使市场 — — 以及本国人民重拾信心。
en: But all eurozone governments need to demonstrate their own commitment to fiscal consolidation in order to restore the confidence of markets – and of their own citizens.

zh: 最近的研究显示，一旦政府的债务负担到达了一个某个不可持续的水平，更多的债务就只能阻碍而不是刺激经济的发展。
en: Recent studies show that once a government’s debt burden reaches a threshold perceived to be unsustainable, more debt will only stunt, not stimulate, economic growth.

zh: 希腊债务危机已经向欧洲的政策制定者发出了明确警告：不能让债务无限堆积下去。
en: Greece’s debt crisis was a clear warning that European policymakers must not allow public debt to pile up indefinitely.

zh: 而欧盟果断向希腊提供短期援助并建立欧洲金融稳定机制来保障欧元稳定的做法无疑是正确的。
en: The EU was right to react decisively to ensure the euro’s stability by providing short-term assistance to Greece and establishing the European Financial Stabilization Mechanism.

zh: 但即便这一稳定机制堪称恢复信心的必需步骤，希腊债务危机也暴露出了欧洲货币联盟财政政策框架的结构性弊端，而这一弊端不能，也不应用平时那种各成员国家不断砸钱的方式来消除。
en: But, while the EFSF is a necessary step towards restoring confidence, the Greek crisis has revealed structural weaknesses of the European Monetary Union’s fiscal-policy framework that cannot, and should not, be fixed by routinely throwing other countries’ money at the problem.

zh: 事实上，当我们尝试修补《稳定与增长公约》的根本性缺陷时，我认为欧洲货币稳定机制只是一个临时性措施，因为它的财政规定及缺乏实际和正式的影响力。
en: Indeed, I consider the EFSF to be a stopgap measure while we remedy the fundamental shortcomings of the Stability and Growth Pact, whose fiscal rules lack both substantive and formal bite.

zh: 这也是我们为何需要一个更有效的危机预防和解决框架的原因，这个框架要加强《稳定与增长公约》的预防和纠正性条款。
en: This is why we need a more effective crisis-prevention and crisis-resolution framework for the eurozone, one that strengthens the Pact’s preventive and corrective provisions.

zh: 对那些严重违反欧洲货币联盟规定的欧元区国家的制裁将更快展开，更少政治方面的犹豫，另外也要更严厉。
en: Sanctions for eurozone countries that seriously infringe EMU rules should take effect more quickly and with less political discretion, and also should be tougher.

zh: 德国和法国都提议对政府借款和支出实施更严厉的管理，一旦有政府违犯，就将受到严厉且半自动生效的制裁。
en: Germany and France have proposed stricter rules on borrowing and spending, backed by tough, semi-automatic sanctions for governments that do not comply.

zh: 那些一再无视削减过量赤字建议或是捏造官方统计的政府，他们的欧盟基金都将被冻结，同时还将剥夺他们的投票权。
en: Countries that repeatedly ignore recommendations for reducing excessive deficits, and those that manipulate official statistics, should have their EU funds frozen and their voting rights suspended.

zh: Monetary union was intended to be neither a panacea for eurozone members nor a get-rich货币联盟既不能是欧元区成员国包治百病的灵药，也不能成为金融投机者的发财宝地。
en: Monetary union was intended to be neither a panacea for eurozone members nor a get-rich scheme for financial speculators.

zh: 它同时也不应该是一个通过普通欧元债券或财政直接输血的方式向各国政府提供更廉价借款从而实现富裕国家向贫穷国家转移支付的系统。
en: Nor was it meant to be a system of redistribution from richer to poorer countries via cheaper borrowing for governments by means of common Eurobonds or outright fiscal transfers.

zh: 如果某些国家一直在赤字下运作并削弱自身竞争力，从而损害欧元的稳定的话，这个联盟就不会成功。
en: It won’t succeed if some countries persistently run deficits and weaken their competitiveness at the expense of the euro’s stability.

zh: 欧洲货币联盟的成立目的是促进结构性改革。
en: EMU was designed to encourage structural reforms.

zh: 那些肆意挥霍的成员国将在《稳定与增长公约》以及其他国家的压力下实现收支平衡并随之提升自身的竞争力。
en: Profligate members were supposed to be forced by the Stability and Growth Pact, as well as by their peers, to live within their means and thus strengthen their competiveness.

zh: 事实上，德国前社会民主党政府削弱《公约》来实施这一点的做法是合适的政治举措，而那些竞争力更低的欧元区国家则坐视工资上升和公共部门膨胀，接着在扩大信用则助长了债务和资产泡沫后则不敢正视问题。
en: Instead, Germany’s former social-democratic government weakened the pact when doing so was politically convenient, while less competitive eurozone members allowed wages to rise and the public sector to become bloated, and then looked away as easy credit fueled both debt and asset bubbles.

zh: 如果债务继续这样堆积下去的话，我们就无法预期可持续增长或者提前应对欧洲政府债务危机。
en: We cannot foster sustainable growth or preempt a sovereign-debt crisis in Europe (or anywhere else) by piling-up more debt.

zh: 欧洲国家需要用一种对增长有益的方式减少他们的赤字，而且必须减少。
en: European countries need to reduce their deficits in a growth-friendly fashion, but reduce them they must.

zh: 这个目标是可以实现的：德国正在将其债务负担减少到可以持续的水平并提升其长期增长前景。
en: It can be done: Germany is reducing its debt burden to sustainable levels while strengthening its long-term growth prospects.

zh: 它这种促进增长的赤字削减，再加上它加强欧洲财政框架的建议，都将成为欧洲经济治理的蓝图。
en: Its course of pro-growth deficit reduction, together with its suggestions for strengthening Europe’s fiscal framework, could serve as a blueprint for European economic governance.

zh: 声援鲨鱼
en: Solidarity With Sharks

zh: 圣何塞 — — 一直以来，有种说法是我们对海洋的了解还不及月球。
en: SAN JOSE – It has long been said that we know more about the Moon than we do about the oceans.

zh: 毕竟已有12人踏上了月球表面，但抵达海洋最深处的却只有3人。
en: After all, 12 people have walked on the surface of the Moon, but only three have been to the deepest part of the sea.

zh: 但现在貌似我们对海洋的了解比想象的还少 — — 我们所造成的危害一直没有被完全认识到。
en: But it now seems that we know even less about the oceans than we thought – and we may well have been doing even more damage than we realized.

zh: 最近一项研究显示渔业产量多年以来一直被严重低估。
en: A recent study found that fishing catches have been substantially underestimated for years.

zh: 这理应引起负责监督公海商业捕鱼行为的地区渔业管理机构的重视，同时必须重视这个问题的还有负责保护濒危迁徙物种的联合国《保护野生动物迁徙物种公约 》 （ CMS）监管者。
en: This should grab the attention of both regional fisheries management organizations, which oversee commercial fishing in the high seas, and those monitoring compliance with the United Nations Convention on the Conservation of Migratory Species of Wild Animals (CMS), which covers endangered migratory species.

zh: 《保护野生动物迁徙物种公约》附录I 规定，今天有必要对大白鲨、5种锯鳐和11种鳐鱼实行最严格的保护。
en: According to the CMS, the species demanding the strictest protection today – listed in Appendix I – include great white sharks, five species of sawfish, and eleven species of ray.

zh: 《保护野生动物迁徙物种公约》将于本月在哥斯达黎加圣何塞召开的洄游鲨鱼会议为推进法规建设提供了重要机会，其目的是保护及可持续利用上述物种，以使其继续发挥顶级捕食者至关重要的生态作用。
en: The CMS meetings on migratory sharks, set to take place this month in San Jose, Costa Rica, represent an important opportunity for advancing regulations to ensure the conservation and sustainable use of these species, so that they can continue to fulfill their critical ecological role as apex predators.

zh: 在2014年厄瓜多尔基多举行的最后一次会议上 ， 《 保护野生动物迁徙物种公约》缔约国增补了若干鲨鱼品种，并鼓励政府通过谈判国际协议的方式对其进行保护。
en: At their last conference, held in Quito, Ecuador, in 2014, the CMS parties added several shark species, the protection of which governments are encouraged to secure through the negotiation of international agreements.

zh: 其中一项协议为2010年签署的《迁徙鲨鱼保护谅解备忘录 》 ， 该备忘录到目前为止共有39个签字国。
en: One such agreement, reached in 2010 and so far signed by 39 parties, is the Memorandum of Understanding on the Conservation of Migratory Sharks.

zh: 尽管不具备法律约束力，但该协议为确保就迁徙鲨鱼种群可持续利用政策达成一致提供了重要的讨论场所。
en: Despite being legally non-binding, the initiative provides an important forum to reach agreement on policies ensuring that any exploitation of migratory shark populations is sustainable.

zh: 但近期渔业产量研究显示我们往往缺少确定何种消费水准可以持续的准确数据资料。
en: But, as the recent study on fishing catches underscores, we often lack the accurate data needed to determine what level of consumption is sustainable.

zh: 在缺乏资料的前提下，应该适用“没有把握就不做”的预防性原则。
en: Without it, the precautionary principle – if in doubt, don’t do it – should be applied.

zh: 问题在于缺乏可靠数据可以让保护特定物种的必要性显得抽象和不那么紧迫，削弱政府抵制其他更直接需求的能力，特别当牵涉到对相关人员的生计予以保护。
en: The problem is that the absence of reliable data can make the need to protect a species seem more abstract and less urgent, weakening governments’ capacity to resist other, more immediate demands, especially the need to protect relevant livelihoods.

zh: 此外，海洋资源消耗仍持续攀高。
en: In the meantime, consumption of the oceans’ resources continues to surge.

zh: 过去两代人时间里，随着世界人口总量翻番至73亿，每年海洋渔业捕捞增长进一步加速，从1950年的2000万吨增长至2010年的7700万吨之多。
en: Over the last two generations, as the world population has doubled to 7.3 billion, the amount of fish taken from the oceans each year has grown even faster, from 20 million metric tons in 1950 to 77 million in 2010.

zh: 这还仅仅是官方数字，不包括非法、管制外及未报告的渔业捕获。
en: And these are only the official figures, which do not account for illegal, unregulated, and unreported catches.

zh: 鉴于鲨鱼通常为（针对金枪鱼）捕捞作业的具有商业价值的次级渔业捕获物，地区渔业管理组织往往不特别规定针对鲨鱼的捕捞细则。
en: Given that sharks are a commercially valuable secondary catch of fisheries (usually those targeting tuna), regional fisheries management organizations tend not to elaborate specific regulations for them.

zh: 鲨鱼因此更容易沦为国际法监管漏洞并因此逃不脱渔民的渔网 — — 尤其考虑到当前渔业普遍采用大型专业网络。
en: It is thus easier for sharks to slip through the gaps in international law than to elude fishermen’s nets – especially the massive specialized nets that fisheries employ nowadays.

zh: 的确，和过去手工捕鱼不同，捕鲸船和现代技术已大幅提高了渔业产量，以满足当地及遥远地区的市场需求。
en: Indeed, unlike the artisanal fisherman of the past, factory ships and modern technologies have enabled the massive scaling up of catches to satisfy demand not only locally, but in distant markets as well.

zh: 有鉴于此，今年来濒危名单增加如此众多的物种应该并不令人感到惊讶。
en: Given this, the addition of so many species to the endangered list in recent years should come as no surprise.

zh: 在当前充满挑战的环境下 ， 《 谅解备忘录》这样的协议在鼓励行动（往往针对特定区域）方面往往更加至关重要。
en: In this challenging environment, initiatives like the Memorandum of Understanding become even more crucial as a means of encouraging (often region-specific) action.

zh: 某些签字国，包括某些太平洋岛国��宣布设立保护鲨鱼的超大规模专属经济区，并划定严禁一切捕捞行为的禁渔海域。
en: Some signatories, including certain Pacific island states, have declared their huge exclusive economic zones to be shark sanctuaries and have established areas where all fishing is prohibited.

zh: 此外，澳大利亚、新西兰和美国均已制定观测计划和体系，以便对鱼类种群进行管理和评估。
en: For their part, Australia, New Zealand, and the United States have created observer schemes and systems to assess and manage fish stocks.

zh: 此外，欧盟现在要求所有鲨鱼上岸时必须保持完整，以响应对割掉鱼翅这一浪费做法的大声疾呼。 这项法规可以防止在海上割去鲨鱼的鱼鳍，并把不那么值钱的鱼身重新扔回到海中。
en: Furthermore, in response to the outcry at the wasteful practice of shark finning, the European Union now requires that all sharks are landed intact, thereby preventing the removal of fins from sharks at sea and the disposal overboard of their less valuable bodies.

zh: 中国政府承诺不在正式宴会上提供鱼翅羹则呼应了欧盟的规则，鱼翅羹在传统上曾被认为是一种美味佳肴。
en: This has been reinforced by the Chinese government’s pledge not to serve shark fin soup, considered a delicacy, at official banquets.

zh: 就连货运公司和航空公司也纷纷宣布采取行动，越来越多企业现在正拒绝提供鱼翅运输服务。
en: Even freight companies and airlines have been spurred to act, with a growing number now refusing to transport shark fins.

zh: 虽然这样的进步值得赞赏，但还有很长的路要走。
en: While such progress should be applauded, there is a long way to go.

zh: 比方说，必须努力解决间接渔获问题（即用旨在捕捞其他鱼类，特别是金枪鱼的渔网捕获鲨鱼 ） 。
en: For example, efforts must be made to address bycatch (the trapping of sharks in nets intended for other fish, especially tuna).

zh: 关键是从渔民及自然资源保护主义者到政府和国际论坛的所有利益相关方通过签署谅解备忘录和类似协议的形式展开合作。
en: The key is for all interested parties – from fisherman and conservationists to governments and international forums – to work together through the Memorandum of Understanding and similar initiatives.

zh: 上述努力的负面经济影响并不像人们预想的那样大；在许多情况下，利用活体鲨鱼进行的其他类型的商业活动可以完全抵消限捕带来的损失。
en: The adverse economic impact implied by such efforts is not nearly as large as one might expect; in many cases, it could be more than offset by other kinds of commercial activities that take advantage of live sharks.

zh: 在马尔代夫、肯尼亚、南非、斐济及某些中美和加勒比国家蓬勃发展的生态旅游业就是很好的例子。
en: The thriving ecotourism operations in the Maldives, Kenya, South Africa, Fiji, and some Central American and Caribbean countries are a case in point.

zh: 在自然栖息地近距离看到吸引旅游者的蝠鲼可以价值数千美元；但如果死在码头上，它的肉和鳃加起来也只是个零头。
en: As a tourist draw, seen at close quarters in its natural habitat, a manta ray can be worth thousands of dollars; dead on a slab at the quayside, its flesh and gills fetch a fraction of that.

zh: 事实可能会证明阻碍今天环保工作的短期思维具有毁灭性效果；事实上，在某种程度上，上述毁灭性效果已经体现得日益显著。
en: The short-term thinking that impedes environmental conservation efforts today could prove devastating; indeed, to some extent, it already has.

zh: 如果我们继续消耗关键生态资源，很快就会加大它们的再生难度。
en: If we continue to deplete critical ecosystems, they will soon become unable to regenerate.

zh: 只有协调一致地即刻合作保护海洋生态系统并保护以此为生者的生计，海洋才能世世代代继续喂养 — — 和吸引世界各地的民众。
en: Only with a concerted, cooperative, and urgent effort to preserve marine ecosystems and protect the livelihoods of those who depend on them will the oceans be able to continue to feed – and fascinate – the world for generations to come.

zh: 巩固拉丁美洲的成就
en: Consolidating Latin America’s Gains

zh: 圣地亚哥—去年土耳其发生未遂政变时，我给我的土耳其朋友发电子邮件表示关注。
en: SANTIAGO – At the time of last year’s failed coup in Turkey, I emailed a Turkish friend expressing concern.

zh: 他的回答让我陷入了沉思。
en: His answer left me thinking.

zh: 在愤懑地回顾了国内的所发生的事件后，他说 ， “ 你在拉丁美洲真是幸运，尽管有时候好像并不是这样。 ”
en: After a somber review of events in his country, he concluded: “You are very lucky to be in Latin America, even though it may not seem that way sometimes.”

zh: 我们拉丁美洲人时常抱怨。
en: We Latin Americans are complainers.

zh: 想到还有其他人比我们更加糟糕，这让我们不寒而栗。
en: We shudder to think that other people’s lot could be worse than ours.

zh: 但如果拉美人能够客观地看待当今世界，很容易就能理解为何许多人认为我们还算幸运。
en: But if a Latin American views today’s world objectively, it’s easy to understand why many would consider us fortunate.

zh: 恐怖主义正在欧洲兴起，而拉丁美洲最后的内战 — — 哥伦比亚内战正在走向结束。
en: Terrorism is on the rise in Europe, just as Colombia’s civil war, the region’s last, is ending.

zh: 我们这一代阿根廷、巴西和智利人生长在荷枪实弹的士兵巡查机场、火车站和其他公共场所的时代。
en: Argentines, Brazilians, and Chileans of my generation grew up with heavily armed soldiers patrolling airports, train stations, and other public places.

zh: 如今，布鲁塞尔、巴黎和伦敦，而不是我们这里，正在发生同样的事情。
en: Today we see the same in Brussels, Paris, and London, not here.

zh: 与美国总统特朗普形成对比的是，一些拉丁美洲民粹主义政客算得上胜任和知情。
en: Compared to US President Donald Trump, some of Latin America’s populist politicians seem almost competent and well informed.

zh: 但这并不是拉丁美洲人第一次有这样的感觉。
en: But this is not the first time Latin Americans can feel this way.

zh: 伟大的古巴裔美国经济史家卡洛斯·迪亚兹-亚历杭德罗（Carlos Díaz-Alejandro）指出：
en: As Carlos Díaz-Alejandro, the great Cuban-American economic historian, put it:

zh: “回顾20世纪30和40年代，大部分拉丁美洲人都会觉得幸运，至少相对其他地区的人类而言是如此。
en: “Reviewing the 1930s and 1940s, most Latin Americans could feel lucky, at least relative to the rest of humanity.

zh: 西班牙和中国内战、第二次世界大战、美国的大萧条、斯大林大清洗、亚洲和非洲的政治不独立，还有印度去殖民地化的痛苦，这些对于巴西人和墨西哥人来说，都是遥远的事情，不可能发生在自己的祖国。 ”
en: The Spanish and the Chinese Civil Wars, World War II, the depth of depression in the United States, Stalinist purges, the political dependence of Asia and Africa, and the pains of decolonization in India and elsewhere could be viewed by Brazilians and Mexicans as remote events that could not happen here any more.”

zh: 最鲜明的对比是政治。
en: The sharpest contrast was political.

zh: “与欧洲、印度乃至北美的思想、宗教和种族混乱相比 ， ” 迪亚兹-亚历杭德罗继续写道 ， “ 当时的大部分拉丁美洲人自认为相当宽容，这个自我评价，至少从相对角度来说是基本正确的，而许多难民在拉丁美洲找到了避风港也可以证明这一点。 ”
en: “In contrast with the ideological, religious, and ethnic frenzies of Europe, India, and even North America,” Díaz-Alejandro continues, “most Latin Americans viewed themselves then as tolerant, a view largely correct at least in relative terms, and demonstrated by the many refugees who found a haven in the region.”

zh: 1948年，哥伦比亚“暴力 ” （ la violencia）拉开帷幕；如今，我们还能目睹委内瑞拉总统马杜罗在国内残酷迫害政治反对派。
en: The year 1948 saw the outbreak of “la violencia” in Colombia; today we witness the murderous persecution of President Nicolás Maduro’s political opponents in Venezuela.

zh: 政治镇压在当时的中美洲稀松平常，古巴至今仍是如此。
en: Political repression was common in Central America back then, and remains common in Cuba today.

zh: 但这些只是证明规律的例外。
en: But they are the exceptions that confirm the rule.

zh: 正如“20世纪30和40年代在拉丁美洲鲜有政治流血 ， ” （迪亚兹-亚历杭德罗语 ） ， 今天大体也是如此。
en: Just as “the 1930s and 1940s witnessed little political bloodletting in Latin America,” in Díaz-Alejandro’s words, the same is largely true today.

zh: 我们的民主仍然不完美，但拉美地区的政治趋于稳定是不容否认的。
en: Our democracies remain imperfect, but the region’s increasing political stability is undeniable.

zh: 如今，我们都存在激进的民粹主义者。
en: We have had our share of wild-eyed populists recently.

zh: 但除了委内瑞拉的极权主义查韦斯派在大规模群众反对声浪中仍能屹立不倒，其他国家的民粹主义正在式微。
en: But with the exception of Venezuela, where authoritarian chavistas remain in power despite massive opposition, populism is on the wane.

zh: 在委内瑞拉，前总统科雷拉成功地让自己挑选的继承人当选总统，但低油价和美元短缺意味着极有可能发生政策缓和（policy moderation ） 。
en: In Ecuador, former president Rafael Correa managed to get his handpicked successor elected, but low oil prices and dollar shortages make a turn toward policy moderation quite likely.

zh: 在阿根廷，总统马克里将庇隆主义的民粹主义者基什内尔扫地出门，尽管发生了不可避免的经济调整和低增长，他仍能保持非常高的支持率。
en: In Argentina, President Mauricio Macri, who ousted the Peronist-populist Cristina Fernández de Kirchner, remains popular despite an inevitable economic adjustment and slow growth.

zh: 20世纪30和40年代是拉丁美洲发生重大社会和政治变化的时代。
en: The 1930s and 1940s were a time of great social and political change in the region.

zh: 外国流入和农村流向城市的移民产生了新的城市中产阶级，他们大多从事公职。
en: Migration from abroad and from the countryside to the city gave rise to a new urban middle class employed mostly in government-related jobs.

zh: 传统地主精英的政治力量衰落，强大的以工人阶级为基础的政党开始出现。
en: The political clout of traditional land-owning elites declined, and powerful new working-class-based parties began to emerge.

zh: 如今，新的中产阶级正在兴起，他们大多在私营企业工作。
en: Today, a new middle class – employed mostly in private firms – is on the rise.

zh: 在许多国家，消费一直处于繁荣，即使经济增长缓慢。
en: In many countries, consumption has been booming, even as economic growth slows.

zh: 购物中心在新建市郊地区大量出现，Facebook已经走进安第斯山脉最偏远的小村庄。
en: Shopping malls crop up in newly built suburbs, and Facebook has made it to the smallest Andean village.

zh: 经济不平等程度仍然剧烈，但拉丁美洲的收入差距在近二十年来一直在减小，而美国和欧洲一直在扩大。
en: Economic inequality remains high, but income disparities in Latin America have been narrowing for nearly two decades, just as they widened in the United States and Europe.

zh: 还有其他与过去相似的经济状况。
en: There are other economic similarities with the past.

zh: 其中之一是大宗商品价格轨迹，在20世纪30年代末到40年代，大宗商品价格在大萧条时期的暴跌后进入涨势。
en: One is the trajectory of commodity export prices, which increased through the late 1930s and 1940s, following the Depression-era collapse.

zh: 类似地，2008—09年危机后，大宗商品再次上扬，直到2015年见顶。
en: They likewise increased after the 2008-09 crisis, peaking in 2015.

zh: 在这两个时期，关键的政策选择都是如何利用充裕的美元。
en: In both cases, deciding what to do with the surfeit of dollars was a key policy choice.

zh: 用迪亚兹-亚历杭德罗的话说，20世纪40年代是“拉丁美洲进口替代工业化的黄金时期 ” ， 出口价值的上升和进口价值的下降带来了巨大的贸易盈余，这笔盈余常常被用来偿还债务。
en: Because the 1940s were, in Díaz-Alejandro’s words, the “golden age of import-substituting industrialization in Latin America,” the increase in export values and the compression of imports meant large trade surpluses, which were often used to repay debt.

zh: 相反，如今，大部分本地私人部门一直在从国外借贷，为直到最近与旨在增加的经常项目赤字融资。
en: Today, by contrast, most local private sectors have been borrowing abroad to finance what were, until recently, rising current account deficits.

zh: 巨量美元计价的债务存量仍然是拉丁美洲的一大弱点。
en: Large stocks of dollar-denominated debt remain a key vulnerability.

zh: 进入20世纪50年代后，拉丁美洲的新出口部门并没有兴起，美元过剩转为美元紧缺。
en: As Latin America entered the 1950s and new export sectors failed to emerge, dollar abundance turned into dollar scarcity.

zh: 枯荣循环和货币危机成为常事。
en: Boom-bust cycles and currency crises became common.

zh: 在最近这个十年的其余时间里，拉美地区决策者都必须竭尽全力确保不会再次发生枯荣循环和货币危机，特别是当发达国家央行开始利率正常化、资本可能回流发达经济体的时候。
en: In what remains of this decade, the region’s policymakers will have to work hard to ensure that it doesn’t happen again, especially as rich-country central banks normalize interest rates and capital flows threaten to turn back toward the advanced economies.

zh: 拉丁美洲在20世纪30和40年代取得相对成功的一个关键是它们愿意抛弃就正统，尝试新政策。
en: A key to the relative success of Latin America in the 1930s and 1940s was the willingness to throw out old orthodoxies and experiment with new policies.

zh: 为了应对大萧条，大部分国家放弃了金本位，制定了新的汇率安排，尝试创新政策刺激本地工业。
en: In response to the Great Depression, most countries abandoned the gold standard, developed new exchange-rate arrangements, and tried novel policies to stimulate local industry.

zh: “拉丁美洲经济思想在20世纪40年代有了自我发展 ， ” 迪亚兹-亚历杭德罗写道 ， “ 联合国拉丁美洲经济委员会的建立是新经济方针 … … 背后的重要推动力。
en: “Latin American economic thinking came into its own during the 1940s,” writes Díaz-Alejandro. “The creation of the United Nations Economic Commission for Latin America was the major impetus behind ... fresh economic approaches.”

zh: 今天也需要新思维保持拉丁美洲最近取得的政治和经济成就。
en: Fresh thinking is also needed today, to sustain Latin America’s recent political and economic gains.

zh: 远离民粹主义的趋势一定要巩固，特别是在经济不会很快恢复增长的时候。
en: The turn away from populism is anything but assured, especially if economies do not start growing again soon.

zh: 大宗商品繁荣很难复现，因此拉丁美洲急需新的出口品 — — 而在这方面，现代 — — 乃至非正统的 — — 产业政策是大有裨益的。
en: With the commodity boom unlikely to return, Latin America urgently needs new export products – and here a bit of modern, if unorthodox, industrial policy could prove useful.

zh: 政治也需要有所动作。
en: Politics also needs to be shaken up.

zh: 公众对传统精英和政党的不满正在积聚。
en: Public dissatisfaction with traditional elites and parties is on the rise.

zh: 成功的政治运动，如马克里的共和国方案（Propuesta Republicana，PRO）仍然只是例外而不是普遍现象。
en: Successful new political vehicles like Macri’s Propuesta Republicana (PRO) are still the exception.

zh: 20世纪30和40年代在许多拉丁美洲国家所出现的政治开放最终让位给了20世纪60年代的政治动荡和20世纪70和80年代的独裁统治。
en: The political opening that occurred in many Latin American countries in the 1930s and 1940s eventually gave way to the political disarray of the 1960s and the dictatorships of the 1970s and 1980s.

zh: 我们决不能重蹈覆辙。
en: We must not allow that to happen again.

zh: 等待建筑革命
en: Awaiting the Construction Revolution

zh: 伦敦—20年来，全球建筑业生产率每年的增长率只有1 % 。
en: LONDON – For 20 years, productivity in the global construction industry has grown at an annual rate of just 1%.

zh: 如今，该行业需要跨入二十一世纪，以便满足新建筑的日益增长的需求、填补全世界日益扩大的住房和基础设施缺口。
en: Now, the industry needs to enter the twenty-first century, so that it can meet increasing demand for new structures and address the world’s growing housing and infrastructure gaps.

zh: 建筑业缓慢的变迁速度与农业和制造业等部门不同，后两者已经随着时间的推移，完成了生产率表现的变迁。
en: The construction industry’s glacial pace of change is unlike that of other sectors such as agriculture and manufacturing, which have transformed their productivity performance over time.

zh: 1947—2010年间，美国制造业实现了760%的累计真实（经通胀调整的）生产率增幅，而建筑业只有6 % 。
en: Between 1947 and 2010, US manufacturing achieved 760% cumulative real (inflation-adjusted) productivity growth, compared to just 6% for construction.

zh: 尽管建筑业一直明白自己的弱点，但并没有表现出改变这一局面的意愿。
en: Although the construction industry has long recognized its weaknesses, it has yet to muster the will to do anything about them.

zh: 考虑到全球住房和基础设施短缺问题日益紧迫，这一状况已经难以为继。
en: But, given the pressing housing and infrastructure shortfalls around the world, this is no longer sustainable.

zh: 许多发达经济体的城镇化已经进入平稳期，但新兴国家的城镇化还会继续。
en: Urbanization may be leveling off in many advanced economies, but it will continue in emerging countries.

zh: 全世界最大的20个城市中有75%位于亚洲，到2025年，这20个城市预计将产生3,600万套新住房的需求。
en: The world’s 20 largest cities, 75% of which are in Asia, will need an estimated 36 million new housing units by 2025.

zh: 此外，2014年的一项估计表明，3.3亿城市家庭居住条件不达标，或不堪住房成本的重负；到2025年，这一数字预计将增加到4.4亿。
en: Moreover, in 2014, an estimated 330 million urban households lived in substandard housing, or struggled financially due to housing costs; that number is projected to rise to 440 million by 2025.

zh: 即使在美国这样的发达经济体，40%的加利福尼亚州人口也无力按照市场价格承担体面的住房。
en: Even in an advanced economy such as the United States, over 40% of California’s population cannot afford decent housing at market rates.

zh: 建筑需求的增长是通过合作改变建筑业、创造价值的巨大机会。
en: The growing demand for structures presents a huge opportunity to reshape the construction sector and create value through concerted action.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所的研究 表明，建筑业如果能够在七大领域做出改变，其劳动生产率可以提高最多60 % 。 这七个领域是监管；设计流程；承包；采购和供应链管理；现场执行；先进的自动化、新技术和材料；以及技能。
en: According to research from the McKinsey Global Institute, the industry could boost its labor productivity by up to 60% if changes are made in seven key areas: regulation; design processes; contracts; procurement and supply-chain management; on-site execution; advanced automation, new technologies, and materials; and skills.

zh: 生产率提高60%可以让每年的产出增加1.6万亿美元 — — 大约相当于一个加拿大经济 — — 让全球GDP增加2 % 。
en: A 60% increase in productivity would create an additional $1.6 trillion in annual output – roughly the equivalent of the Canadian economy – and add 2% to global GDP.

zh: 这些收益 — — 其中三分之一强可以在美国一个国家实现 — — 足以满足当前世界基础设施需求的一半。
en: These gains, more than a third of which can be realized in the US alone, would be enough to meet half the world’s current infrastructure needs.

zh: 管理一个建筑项目绝非易事。
en: Managing a construction project is rarely simple.

zh: 要想取得成功，就需要协调和端对端（end-to-end）项目操作系统，从而使项目中的每个人都明白自己的角色，并在重要业绩指标上达成一致。
en: Success requires coordination and an end-to-end project operating system, so that everyone on a project understands their role and agrees on key performance indicators.

zh: 与此同时，建筑业中带有可重复要素（repeatable elements）的部分 — — 特别是大规模平价住房 — — 可以向制造业式的大规模生产系统变迁，从而克服许多低生产率的根源。
en: At the same time, the parts of the industry with repeatable elements – particularly large-scale affordable housing – could negate many of the root causes of low productivity by shifting toward a manufacturing-style system of mass production.

zh: 这会带来更多的标准化、模块化和预制化。
en: This would entail more standardization, modularization, and prefabrication.

zh: 在这一系统中，大部分建筑实际上都可以在工厂中生产。
en: In such a system, most structures would actually be built in factories.

zh: 大部分工作不再需要不同的交易，各个子行业也不必在建筑工地上争夺空间，而是可以在工地之外的可控环境中完成。
en: Instead of having different trades and subsectors jostling for room on construction sites, the bulk of the work would be carried out offsite, in a controlled environment.

zh: 一些住房建筑公司已经开始实施这一方法。
en: Some residential homebuilders are already implementing this approach.

zh: 比如，一家建造可复制的四层公寓楼的西班牙公司，在雇用劳动力数量相同的情况下，可以较其采用传统建筑方法，多造5—10倍的单位。
en: For example, a Spanish company that builds replicable four-story multifamily buildings can construct 5-10 times more units than it could with traditional construction methods, but employ the same amount of labor.

zh: 类似地，一家加拿大住房建造商提供包括几项定制选项的固定数量的可重复设计，每种设计的成本和具体内容都清晰地罗列在其网站上。
en: Similarly, a Canadian homebuilder offers a fixed number of repeatable designs with several customization options, and lists the costs and specifications of each clearly on its website.

zh: 但如果要让建筑业有机会焕然一新，摆脱几十年来生产率增长萎靡不振的状态，就必须理顺经济激励。
en: But if the construction industry now has a chance to reinvent itself after decades of tepid productivity growth, economic incentives will have to be realigned.

zh: 比如，对于承包商，生产率和利润之间存在着明确的关系，但未必足够强烈。
en: For example, in the case of contractors, there is a clear link between productivity and profitability, but it is not as strong as it could be.

zh: 除非所有者改变预期，否则许多承包商如果采用冗余量更小的更有效、规模更大的系统，可能得不偿失。
en: Unless owners change their expectations, many contractors could lose revenue by moving to a more efficient, larger-scale system with fewer redundancies.

zh: 至于所有者，他们的操作规模往往不足以单枪匹马地改变行业动态。
en: Owners, for their part, usually do not operate on a large enough scale to change industry dynamics singlehandedly.

zh: 他们不愿意承担更多风险，或在了解最终受益的情况下改变要求，于是僵局便诞生了。
en: And because they are reluctant to take on more risk, or change their requirements without knowing the final benefits of doing so, deadlock sets in.

zh: 尽管如此，对新建筑的需求增长仍然可能意味着建筑业即将开始改变。
en: Still, growth in demand for new construction may mean that the industry is about to start moving.

zh: 决策者正在开始严肃研究成本和规模问题，其中包括平价住房危机、趋紧以至于有必要提高基础设施项目资金效率的公共预算，以及对水电行业产生资本成本压力的油价下跌。
en: Policymakers are starting to look seriously at cost and scale issues. These include affordable-housing crises; tight public budgets that make it necessary to squeeze more out of every dollar in infrastructure projects; and lower oil prices putting pressure on capital costs in the hydrocarbons sector.

zh: 在行业内部，进取的大企业，包括许多中国企业，正在世界舞台上展示自己的实力。
en: Within the industry, aggressive large firms, including many from China, are now flexing their muscles on the global stage.

zh: 它们拥有用来投资于增强效率的方法和新生产系统的资本；它们也在利用日益普及的技术 — — 如数字工具、先进机器人或新材料 — — 来大幅推进效率。
en: They have the capital to invest in efficiency-enhancing approaches and new production systems, and they are making use of increasingly accessible technologies – such as digital tools, advanced robotics, or new materials – to turbo-charge efficiency.

zh: 许多行业领袖终于开始认识到变革的必要，并表达出变革的意愿。
en: Many industry leaders are finally recognizing the need to change, and expressing a willingness to do so.

zh: 他们明白，如果不通过反思自己的操作来为即将到来的全行业破坏做好准备，就有可能被有望成为世界的下一次生产率大爆发的机会甩在身后。
en: They know that if they do not prepare for the coming industry-wide disruption by rethinking their operations, they could be left behind in what may turn out to be the world’s next great productivity story.

zh: 新闻报道的回归
en: Journalism’s Comeback

zh: 牛津 — — 在长达数年的不景气后，新闻行业最终出现了温和的复苏迹象。
en: OXFORD – After years of ill health, the news industry is finally showing signs of a modest recovery.

zh: 据最全面的数字媒体消费调查2018年数字新闻报告显示，在消费者信心趋于稳定的同时，订阅量正在呈现出上升的势头。
en: According to the Digital News Report 2018 – the most comprehensive survey of digital media consumption – subscriptions are trending up while consumer confidence has stabilized.

zh: 对这种以信任为交易基础的备受诟病的业务而言，这些脆弱的收获其实就等于有意义的进步。
en: For a much-maligned business that trades in trust, these fragile gains amount to meaningful progress.

zh: 可以肯定，世界媒体仍然感到困惑；这份由路透社新闻研究所编写的报告显示，仅44%的新闻消费者相信知名媒体品牌所发布的内容。
en: To be sure, the world’s media remain troubled; the report, produced by the Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism, shows that only 44% of news consumers believe what established media brands publish.

zh: 但这依然比去年增加了一个百分点，表明行业信任赤字或者已经停止增长或者实际正在萎缩。
en: But that represents an increase of one percentage point from last year, suggesting that the industry’s trust deficit has either stopped growing or is actually narrowing.

zh: 其他调查结果甚至更加利多；例如，年度爱德曼信任度调查报告发现记者正在重新赢得信誉，而对传统和在线新闻的总体信任则已达到七年来的顶峰。
en: Other surveys are even more bullish; for example, the annual Edelman Trust Barometer found that journalists are regaining their credibility, while overall trust in traditional and online-only journalism is at its highest point in seven years.

zh: 上述调查结果促使该公司宣布“专家回归”的趋势现在正在发生。
en: These findings prompted the firm to declare that “the return of experts” is upon us.

zh: 尽管媒体高管现在宣布胜利依然为时尚早，但对近年来声名狼藉的媒体行业来说，这显然是个好兆头。
en: Although it may be too early for media executives to declare victory just yet, these are clearly good signs for an industry that has had its reputation battered in recent years.

zh: 政治两极化导致人们怀疑不支持他们观点的媒体渠道，而新闻编辑成本不断缩减则损害了新闻报道的质量。
en: Political polarization has made people suspicious of media outlets that don’t support their views, while cost cutting in newsrooms has degraded the quality of journalism on offer.

zh: 但正如最新数据所示，记者们似乎找到了解决这些难题的办法。
en: But, as the new data suggest, journalists appear to be finding ways to address these challenges.

zh: 也许今年数字新闻报道最发人深省的趋势是人们越来越不信任社交媒体所发布的内容。
en: Perhaps the most revealing trend in this year’s Digital News Report is the growing distrust in news shared via social media.

zh: 例如，我们的研究发现只有23%的受访者相信他们在社交媒体上看到的新闻，而仅有34%的人相信搜索引擎的搜索结果。
en: For example, our study found that only 23% of respondents trust news they find on social media, and just 34% believe what they turn up in search engines.

zh: 这些数据很有可能为谷歌、脸书和其他技术巨头们带来麻烦，因为像传统媒体机构一样，它们的业务也同样依赖于人们的信任。
en: These figures will likely trouble Google, Facebook, and other tech giants whose businesses are no less reliant on trust than traditional media organizations.

zh: 但随着像脸书这样的平台开始跌跌撞撞，很多传统的媒体渠道却开始重新立足；订阅趋势支持这一结论。
en: But while platforms like Facebook stumble, many traditional media outlets are finding their footing; subscription trends support this conclusion.

zh: 在74，000名调查受访者当中，14%的人表示他们在过去12个月至少曾经付费购买过一次数字新闻，而北欧国家的平均付费购买率则接近30 % 。
en: Of the 74,000 survey respondents, 14% said they paid for digital news at least once during the previous 12 months, while the average in the Nordic countries was closer to 30%.

zh: 在美国，唐纳德·特朗普总统对所谓“虚假新闻媒体”的攻击却产生了相反的效果，促使支持独立新闻业的民众比以往任何时候都多。
en: In the United States, President Donald Trump’s attacks on so-called “fake news media” have had the opposite effect, pushing more people to support independent journalism than ever before.

zh: 例如在2016年，仅9%的美国消费者付费购买在线新闻服务；而上述份额在2017年上升到16 % ， 并在今年保持稳定。
en: In 2016, for example, only 9% of American consumers paid for news online; that share rose to 16% in 2017 and has held steady this year.

zh: 即使在英国这样不乏免费新闻网站的国家，人们也正在投资于高质量的新闻报道。
en: Even in countries like the United Kingdom, which has no shortage of free news websites, people are investing in quality reporting.

zh: 卫报征集捐款或会员付费的模式正在助推其实现财务转型。
en: The Guardian’s model of soliciting donations or membership payments is fueling a financial turnaround.

zh: 在接受调查的几乎每一个国家，处于政治左翼的年轻民众都会表现出最高的付款倾向。
en: In nearly every country surveyed, young people on the political left demonstrate the highest propensity to pay.

zh: 有批评家认为媒体付费模式与互联网作为思想、新闻和信息自由交流场所的初衷相抵触。
en: Some critics argue that the media’s payment model contradicts the original spirit of the Internet as a place for the free exchange of ideas, news, and information.

zh: 反对者认为，把质量最高的报导转移到付费墙后将致使二等公民只能享用二流新闻服务。
en: Moving the best stories behind paywalls, opponents say, will give rise to second-rate news for second-class citizens.

zh: 但这种论调没有考虑三个关键点。
en: But this argument misses three key points.

zh: 首先，根本无力付费订阅新闻的数字联网群体可能小之又小；决定付款意愿的更多的是付费优先事项。
en: For starters, the number of digitally connected people who cannot afford to pay for news at all can be presumed to be quite small; willingness to pay is much more a question of spending priorities.

zh: 此外，为人们认为有价值的东西付费能有助于实现其价值，就像将会员模式置于纯交易模式之上的举动所表明的那样。
en: Moreover, paying for something that one perceives as valuable helps make it so, as the move to prioritize membership models over purely transactional approaches illustrates.

zh: 最后，对于那些真的无力付款的人来说，也有为低收入家庭送去高质量新闻的可行选项。
en: Finally, for those who truly cannot pay, there are viable options for bringing quality journalism to low-income households.

zh: 例如，可以改革税法降低新闻业的从业成本，同时政府或基金会资助可以加大对公共媒体节目的支持力度。
en: For example, tax codes could be reformed to make the practice of journalism more affordable, while government or foundation funding could increase support for public media programming.

zh: 当人们开始为内容付费，新闻业就有动机提高绩效。
en: When people pay for content, journalists gain an incentive to deliver.

zh: 他们会仔细审视产品的价值、全面核查事实、创新、调查并竭力削减困扰许多社交媒体的引人瞩目的廉价噪音数量。
en: They scrutinize their products for value, check facts thoroughly, innovate, investigate, and cut down on the cheap, attention-grabbing noise that plagues so many social-media platforms.

zh: 最重要的是，这些趋势还能够相辅相成；新闻业发展越好，消费者就会越珍视它。
en: Best of all, these trends are mutually reinforcing; the better the journalism is, the more consumers will value it.

zh: 媒体行业本身已经有很长一段时间没有传出过好消息了。
en: It has been a long time since the media industry had good news to report about itself.

zh: 现在局面终于有所扭转，因此我们必须加倍努力保持这种好的品质、信誉和财务可行性势头。
en: Now that we do, it is imperative that we work harder than ever to sustain the trend toward quality, credibility, and financial viability.

zh: 信心仙子辩
en: Debating the Confidence Fairy

zh: 伦敦—2011年，诺贝尔经济学奖获得者保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）用“债券纠察队 ” （ bond vigilantes）和“信心仙子 ” （ confidence fairy）形容预算赤字方面的保守做法。
en: LONDON – In 2011, the Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman characterized conservative discourse on budget deficits in terms of “bond vigilantes” and the “confidence fairy.”

zh: 除非政府削减赤字，否则债券纠察队将通过推高利率迫使它们就范。
en: Unless governments cut their deficits, the bond vigilantes will put the screws to them by forcing up interest rates.

zh: 但如果它们确实削减了赤字，信心仙子将通过刺激比削减赤字所影响的更多的私人支出来奖励它们。
en: But if they do cut, the confidence fairy will reward them by stimulating private spending more than the cuts depress it.

zh: 克鲁格曼认为“债券纠察队”一词也许只对希腊等少数国家适用，但“信心仙子”纯属想象，和收集儿童的牙仙差不多。
en: Krugman thought the “bond vigilante” claim might be valid for a few countries, such as Greece, but argued that the “confidence fairy” was no less imaginary than the one that collects children’s teeth.

zh: 在衰退中削减赤字永远不可能带来复苏。
en: Cutting a deficit in a slump could never cause a recovery.

zh: 政治说辞可能导致好政策无法实施，但无法阻止它成功。
en: Political rhetoric can stop a good policy from being adopted, but it cannot stop it from succeeding.

zh: 毕竟，它无法让坏政策起作用。
en: Above all, it cannot make a bad policy work.

zh: 我最近在一次《纽约书评 》 （ New York Review of Books）活动中与克鲁格曼辩论了这一问题。
en: I recently debated this point with Krugman at a New York Review of Books event.

zh: 我的观点是不良期望可能影响政策的效果，而不仅仅是政策被采取的可能。
en: My argument was that adverse expectations could affect a policy’s results, not just the chances that it will be adopted.

zh: 比如，如果人们认为政府借贷只是延迟了征税，他们可能储蓄更多以应对预期的未来账单。
en: For example, if people thought that government borrowing was simply deferred taxation, they might save more to meet their expected future tax bill.

zh: 深入思考后，我认为我是错误的。
en: On reflection, I think I was wrong.

zh: 信心因素影响政府决策，但不影响决策的效果。
en: The confidence factor affects government decision-making, but it does not affect the results of decisions.

zh: 除了极端情形，信心无法让坏政策产生好结果，而缺少信心也不会让好政策产生坏结果，就好比你怀着人可以飞的错误信念跳出窗户无法战胜重力作用。
en: Except in extreme cases, confidence cannot cause a bad policy to have good results, and a lack of it cannot cause a good policy to have bad results, any more than jumping out of a window in the mistaken belief that humans can fly can offset the effect of gravity.

zh: 始于2008年的大衰退的发展情况说明了这一点。
en: The sequence of events in the Great Recession that began in 2008 bears this out.

zh: 一开始，政府竭尽全力对付它。
en: At first, governments threw everything at it.

zh: 这阻止了大衰退演变为大萧条II。
en: This prevented the Great Recession from becoming Great Depression II.

zh: 但是，在经济触底前，刺激就结束了，而紧缩 — — 预算赤字的加速清偿，主要通过支出削减实现 — — 成为主流。
en: But, before the economy reached bottom, the stimulus was turned off, and austerity – accelerated liquidation of budget deficits, mainly by cuts in spending – became the order of the day.

zh: 一旦焦头烂额的政治精英获得了喘息之机，他们就开始编制阻挠一切后续财政刺激的故事。
en: Once winded political elites had recovered their breath, they began telling a story designed to preclude any further fiscal stimulus.

zh: 衰退是因为财政挥霍造成的，他们说，因此只能通过财政紧缩治愈。
en: The slump had been created by fiscal extravagance, they insisted, and therefore could be cured only by fiscal austerity.

zh: 并且不是旧式紧缩：是穷人而非富人的支出必须削减，因为穷人的支出是真正的麻烦之源。
en: And not any old austerity: it was spending on the poor, not the rich, that had to be cut, because such spending was the real cause of the trouble.

zh: 凯恩斯主义者都知道，在衰退中削减赤字是坏政策。
en: Any Keynesian knows that cutting the deficit in a slump is bad policy.

zh: 毕竟，衰退的定义便是总支出不足。
en: A slump, after all, is defined by a deficiency in total spending.

zh: 试图用减少支出来解决衰退就像是用放血来治疗病人。
en: To try to cure it by spending less is like trying to cure a sick person by bleeding.

zh: 因此，我们大应该问问放血派经济学家/支持者，如哈佛大学的阿尔贝托·阿莱西纳（Alberto Alesina）和肯尼斯·罗格夫（Kenneth Rogoff ） ， 为何他们认为自己的治疗方法能起作用。
en: So it was natural to ask economist/advocates of bleeding like Harvard’s Alberto Alesina and Kenneth Rogoff how they expected their cure to work.

zh: 他们的答案是，认为政策能起作用 — — 即信心仙子 — — 将确保政策的成功。
en: Their answer was that the belief that it would work – the confidence fairy – would ensure its success.

zh: 更准确地说，阿莱西纳指出，尽管放血会恶化病患的状况，但其对预期的积极影响将抵消其消极作用。
en: More precisely, Alesina argued that while bleeding on its own would worsen the patient’s condition, its beneficial impact on expectations would more than offset its debilitating effects.

zh: 受复苏保证的鼓舞，半死的病患会从病床上一跃而起，能跑能跳，能照常饮食，并且很快就会恢复活力。
en: Buoyed by assurance of recovery, the half-dead patient would leap out of bed, start running, jumping, and eating normally, and would soon be restored to full vigor.

zh: 放血派炮制了一些蹩脚证据证明这在少数例子中取得过效果。
en: The bleeding school produced some flaky evidence to show that this had happened in a few instances.

zh: 想以意识形态理由削减公共支出的保守派发现，债券纠察队/信心仙子的故事可以完美契合他们的目的。
en: Conservatives who wanted to cut public spending for ideological reasons found the bond vigilante/confidence fairy story to be ideally suited to their purpose.

zh: 大谈从前的财政挥霍让债券市场将打击负债沉重的政府的说法变得更加可信（也更加可能 ） ； 信心仙子承诺通过提高经济生产率奖励财政节俭。
en: Talking up previous fiscal extravagance made a bond-market attack on heavily indebted governments seem more plausible (and more likely); the confidence fairy promised to reward fiscal frugality by making the economy more productive.

zh: 在阿莱西纳等教授的帮助下，保守派观点可能转变为科学预言。
en: With the help of professors like Alesina, conservative conviction could be turned into scientific prediction.

zh: 而如果阿莱西纳的办法没能产生快速复苏，也有一个显而易见的借口：实施力度不够以至于缺少“信誉 ” 。
en: And when Alesina’s cure failed to produce rapid recovery, there was an obvious excuse: it had not been applied with enough vigor to be “credible.”

zh: 最后，这一疗法终于开始了，比预想的时间晚了好几年，也不是通过财政放血，而是通过大规模货币刺激。
en: The cure, such as it was, finally came about, years behind schedule, not through fiscal bleeding, but by massive monetary stimulus.

zh: 当东倒西歪的病患终于勉强站起来时，财政放血鼓手胜利宣布紧缩见效了。
en: When the groggy patient eventually staggered to its feet, the champions of fiscal bleeding triumphantly proclaimed that austerity had worked.

zh: 这个故事的寓意显简洁明了：衰退中的紧缩不管用，因为中世纪的放血疗法从未管用过：它只能让病患更加虚弱而不是让他们变得强壮。
en: The moral of the tale is simple: Austerity in a slump does not work, for the reason that the medieval cure of bleeding a patient never worked: it enfeebles instead of strengthening.

zh: 在政策的原因和效果之间插入信心仙子并不改变政策的逻辑，而只能暂时让其逻辑变得模糊。
en: Inserting the confidence fairy between the cause and effect of a policy does not change the logic of the policy; it simply obscures the logic for a time.

zh: 复苏即使在财政紧缩时也可能发生，但绝不可能因为财政紧缩而发生。
en: Recovery may come about despite fiscal austerity, but never because of it.

zh: 尽管克鲁格曼阐明个中道理是面向美国读者，但其中的道理也十分契合英国的情况。
en: Although Krugman invented his discourse for an American readership, it perfectly fits the British case as well.

zh: 2010年6月，在其第一份预算中，财政大臣乔治·奥斯本（George Osborne）警告说 ， “ 希腊是一国不直面其问题的例子，我决心避免这一覆辙。 ”
en: In his first budget in June 2010, Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne warned that “you can see in Greece an example of a country that didn’t face up to its problems, and that’s a fate I am determined to avoid.”

zh: 今年3月，在公布英国2015年预算时，奥斯本宣称紧缩让英国再一次“站了起来 ” 。
en: In presenting the United Kingdom’s 2015 budget in March, Osborne claimed that austerity had made Britain “walk tall” again.

zh: 5月7日，这一观点将经受英国议会选举的考验。
en: On May 7, that claim will be put to the test in the UK’s parliamentary election.

zh: 在奥斯本的药方下，英国选民仍然远远没有完全恢复，如果他们决定当初还不如呆在病榻上，也无可指摘。
en: British voters, still wobbly from Osborne’s medicine, can be forgiven if they decide that they should have stayed in bed.

zh: 创造性自我破坏
en: Creative Self-Disruption

zh: 拉古娜海滩—和许多读者一样，我还能生动地回忆起诺基亚主宰手机市场、占据40%以上份额，而苹果还只是电脑公司的日子。
en: LAGUNA BEACH – Like many readers, I still vividly recall when Nokia was the dominant player in mobile phones, with over 40% of the market, and Apple was just a computer company.

zh: 我记得亚马逊还只是知名书店、肮脏的的士或高价豪华轿车还是公共交通或自驾车的唯一替代方案的日子。
en: I remember when Amazon was known only for books, and when dirty taxis or high-priced limousines were the only alternative to public transport or my own car.

zh: 我也记得四季、丽兹卡尔顿、圣瑞吉斯等酒店彼此竞争 — — 而不是和Airbnb竞争 — — 的日子。
en: And I recall when the Four Seasons, Ritz Carltons, and St. Regises of this world competed with one another – not with Airbnb.

zh: 现在，我也许已经老了，但我还没有那么老。
en: Now, I may be old, but I am not that old.

zh: 这些变化最近才发生 — — 很快地发生。
en: These changes happened recently – and fast.

zh: 它们是如何发生的？
en: How did they occur?

zh: 变化的节奏会保持如此快速 — — 甚或还会加速吗？
en: Will the pace of change remain so rapid – or even accelerate further?

zh: 小公司应该如何应对？
en: And how should companies respond?

zh: 一个行业可以通过自上而下的经济、金融、政治和监管变化而改变。
en: An industry can be transformed by top-down economic, financial, political, and regulatory changes.

zh: 但Airbnb、亚马逊、苹果和Uber等公司说明了一种不同类型的改变：敏捷的玩家入侵其他看起来无关的行业，大肆利用并前所未见的巨大机会。
en: But companies like Airbnb, Amazon, Apple, and Uber exemplify a different kind of transformation: agile players invade other, seemingly unrelated industries and brilliantly exploit huge but previously unseen opportunities.

zh: 一个重要并且反直觉的特点是，这样做有利于它们自身的核心竞争力，而不利于它们寻求颠覆的行业的核心竞争力。
en: Importantly and counter-intuitively, doing so serves their own core competencies, rather than those of the industry that they seek to disrupt.

zh: 事实上，这些新来者没有沿用已有方法和过程去竞争，而是创造了全新的游戏计划，改写了目标行业的规则。
en: Indeed, rather than using existing approaches and processes to compete, these entrants created radical new game plans, rewriting the target industry’s rules.

zh: 它们的创造力和激情使他们以不可思议的高速征服 — — 有时甚至毁灭 — — 改变不及的巨头。
en: Their creativity and passion enabled them to subdue – and in some cases even destroy – less adaptable giants remarkably quickly.

zh: 这些公司成功的核心是它们对影响几乎所有行业的根本趋势的理解：通过互联网、应用技术、数字化和社交媒体实现的个体赋权（individual empowerment ） 。
en: Central to these companies’ success has been their understanding of a fundamental trend affecting nearly all industries: individual empowerment through the Internet, app technology, digitalization, and social media.

zh: 与此同时，大部分传统公司仍注重宏观环境，其代价是无法充分应对新的围观层面的力量。
en: Most traditional companies, meanwhile, remain focused on their macro environment, at the expense of responding adequately to the new micro-level forces in play.

zh: 如果现有公司想在这一同时被自上而下和自下而上两股力量左右的新环境下竞争，就必须做出改变，通过学习如何颠覆自己先发制人地颠覆新来者。
en: If existing companies hope to compete in this new environment, shaped by both top-down and bottom-up forces, they will to have to adapt, preempting disruptive new players by figuring out how to disrupt themselves.

zh: 否则它们将面临与诺基亚类似的命运 — — 先是被一家科技公司（苹果）脱媒，然后被另一家（微软）收购。
en: Otherwise, they could face a fate similar to Nokia, which was disintermediated by one tech company (Apple) and acquired by another (Microsoft).

zh: 在改变过程中，公司必须认识到，供给和需求因素在或将推动它们的竞争格局的变化。
en: In this effort, companies must recognize that both demand and supply factors are or will be driving the transformation of their competitive landscapes.

zh: 在需求端，消费者期待从他们所使用的产品和服务中得到更多。
en: On the demand side, consumers expect a lot more from the products and services they use.

zh: 他们想要速度、生产率和便利性。
en: They want speed, productivity, and convenience.

zh: 他们想要轻松的连通性和更大的定制规模。
en: They want easy connectivity and expanded scope for customization.

zh: 此外，TripAdvisor等服务的成功表明，消费者想要更多的参与，公司更快地用真实的改进响应他们的反馈。
en: And, as the success of services like TripAdvisor show, they want to be more engaged, with companies responding faster to their feedback with real improvements.

zh: 在供给端，科技进步正在推翻长期存在的进入壁垒。
en: On the supply side, technological advances are toppling long-standing entry barriers.

zh: 在线汽车服务商Uber利用现有科技撼动了一个长期存在壁垒、常常提供价不廉物不美服务的行业。
en: The online car service Uber adapted existing technologies to transform a long-sheltered industry that too often provided lousy and expensive service.

zh: Airbnb的房间“供给”远远超过了传统饭店能够想象的规模。
en: Airbnb’s “supply” of rooms far exceeds anything to which traditional hotels could reasonably aspire.

zh: 现有公司将不得不高度专业���，受严格保护，或愚蠢地忽视这些破坏。
en: An existing company would have to be highly specialized, well protected, or foolish to ignore these disruptions.

zh: 但是，尽管一些传统行业中的老牌公司一开始寻找适应方法，但另一些公司仍有很多东西要做。
en: But, while some well-established companies in traditional industries are already looking for ways to adapt, others still need to do a lot more.

zh: 一个正在取得进步的传统行业是汽车业，该行业的公司正在追求数字化。
en: One traditional industry in which progress is being made is the automotive branch, where companies are pursuing digitalization.

zh: 尽管新来者毫无疑问将破坏老牌公司的生产平台 — — 艾龙·马斯克（Elon Musk）的特斯拉汽车公司就是明证 — — 但它们是少数。
en: Though new entrants could undoubtedly disrupt incumbents’ production platforms – Elon Musk’s Tesla Motors is a clear example – they are rare.

zh: 近段时间以来，更普遍的竞争威胁来自其他领域的可能影响汽车售后客户价值主张（value proposition）的公司。
en: These days, the more pervasive competitive threat comes from companies in other domains that can erode the customer value proposition after the car is sold.

zh: 汽车公司正在认识到，假以时日，它们所生产汽车的车内数字体验将占据更大的消费者剩余比例，这主要是拜可观的利润率和规模经济所赐。
en: Automotive companies are recognizing that, over time, the digital experience in the cars they produce will command a larger share of the consumer surplus, owing largely to the potential for substantial profit margins and economies of scale.

zh: 因此，它们正在改变它们的汽车以适应新共享经济，让人们可以在车内很好地联网，扩大售后服务范围，并准备着从个体汽车所有向汽车共享的转变。
en: As a result, they are adapting their vehicles to the new sharing economy, helping people to remain well-connected in the car, expanding the scope of after-sale services, and preparing for the shift away from individual car ownership toward car sharing.

zh: 银行也在适应，但动作更慢也更犹豫。
en: Banks are also adapting, but much more slowly and hesitantly.

zh: 如果它们要想有所改进，就必须跳出只是提供应用和在线银行的窠臼。
en: If they are to make progress, they must move beyond simply providing apps and online banking.

zh: 它们的目标应该是客户的全盘参与 — — 客户不仅追求便利和安全，也追求更多地掌控他们的金融命运。
en: Their aim should be holistic engagement of clients, who seek not only convenience and security, but also more control over their financial destiny.

zh: 在这些和其他许多行业，竞争格局毫无疑问正在变得更加复杂、更加不可预测。
en: In these and many other industries, the competitive landscape is undoubtedly becoming more complicated and unpredictable.

zh: 但四个总体原则能够帮助管理者有效地改变思维和商业模式，推动有序的建设性自我破坏。
en: But four general guidelines can help managers effectively adapt their mindsets and business models to facilitate orderly and constructive self-disruption.

zh: ·       首先，公司应该将基准扩大到所在行业的狭隘范围之外，以此实现核心竞争力的现代化。
en: · First, companies should modernize core competencies by benchmarking beyond the narrow confines of their industry.

zh: ·       其次，它们应该更加关注客户，包括通过参与性方式招徕和响应反馈。
en: · Second, they should increase their focus on customers, including by soliciting and responding to feedback in an engaging way.

zh: ·       第三，管理者应该认识到从公司日常运营中所收集的数据的价值，并确保明智、安全地管理这一数据。
en: · Third, managers should recognize the value of the data collected in their companies’ everyday operations, and ensure that it is managed intelligently and securely.

zh: ·       最后，有可能驱动市场细分级别转变的微观层面力量应该在公司的每一个层面上内部化。
en: · Finally, the micro-level forces that have the potential to drive segment-wide transformations should be internalized at every level of the company.

zh: 应用这些原则的公司有更大的机会适应驱动当今全行业快速重构的因素。
en: Companies that apply these guidelines stand a better chance of adapting to what is driving today’s rapid reconfiguration of entire industries.

zh: 根本点仍然是供给和需求：人们比以往更加渴望 — — 事实上，是感到更有力量能够期待 — — 更廉价、更智能、更安全、更高效的工具实现更加“由我做主”的生活。
en: The bottom line, once again, is supply and demand: More than ever, people want – indeed, feel empowered to expect – cheaper, smarter, safer, and more efficient tools to live a more self-directed life.

zh: 无法提供这样的工具的公司将会发现，它们已经来日无多。
en: Companies that fail to deliver will find that their days are numbered.

zh: 霍乱的孟加拉药方
en: A Bangladeshi Prescription for Cholera

zh: 达卡—如今，霍乱应该已经成为了历史。
en: DHAKA – By now, cholera should be history.

zh: 几十年来，卫生官员早已明白如何防止这种疾病，医生早已知道如何治疗这种疾病，发展专家早已认识到有了清洁水和卫生设施，霍乱的爆发就很难形成蔓延。
en: For decades, health officials have understood how to prevent the disease, doctors have known how to treat it, and development experts have recognized that with clean water and sanitation, outbreaks rarely become epidemics.

zh: 不幸的是，世界不是那么简单直白，霍乱的噩梦也还在持续。
en: Unfortunately, the world is not so simple and neat, and the nightmare of cholera persists.

zh: 在世界大部，霍乱事实上已经被驯服。
en: In many parts of the world, cholera has in fact been tamed.

zh: 水传播疾病在发达经济体基本上已经销声匿迹。
en: Waterborne illnesses are virtually nonexistent in advanced economies.

zh: 即使在霍乱仍是一个问题的资源紧缺型国家和地区，口服补水疗法（ORT）的普及也帮助无数人捡回了性命。
en: And even in resource-starved countries and regions where cholera remains a problem, the availability of oral rehydration therapy, or ORT, has helped prevent countless deaths.

zh: 但在危机时期，霍乱仍会肆虐，杀死我们当中最脆弱的群体。
en: And yet cholera continues to flare up during times of crisis, killing the most vulnerable among us.

zh: 如今，也门正在发生最严重的霍乱疫情，武装冲突导致也门医疗、水和卫生设施系统崩溃 — — 而这正是霍乱爆发的条件。
en: One of the worst epidemics today is ravaging Yemen, where armed conflict has led to the collapse of health, water, and sanitation systems – precisely the conditions under which cholera thrives.

zh: 第一批霍乱病例报告于2016年10月；不出一年，病例数量就飙升至600,000以上。
en: The first cholera cases were reported in October 2016; within a year, the number of cases had soared to more than 600,000.

zh: 联合国和世界卫生组织等国际组织在也门卫生官员的合作下，进行了令人印象深刻的应对。
en: International organizations like the United Nations and the World Health Organization, in cooperation with Yemeni health-care officials, have mounted an impressive response.

zh: 他们的努力将致死率保持在传染者总数的0.33%左右（大约2,000人死亡 ） ， 遏制了悲剧的发生。
en: Their efforts have kept the fatality rate to roughly 0.33% of infections (some 2,000 deaths), mitigating the tragedy.

zh: 但也门人正在不可能的环境中苦苦努力，他们需要资源和培训。
en: But Yemenis are working in impossible conditions, and need resources and training.

zh: 我的国家在确保他们获得资源和培训方面起着领导作用。
en: My country is leading the effort to ensure that they receive both.

zh: 10月， 一支也门护士和医生队伍来到孟加拉国国际腹泻病研究中心（International Centre of Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh，icddr,b ） 。
en: In October, a team of Yemeni nurses and doctors arrived at the International Centre of Diarrhoeal Disease Research, Bangladesh (icddr,b), where I have worked for much of my professional life.

zh: 这也是我贡献了大部分职业生涯的地方。 我们的研究所诞生了ORT，世界各地的医护人员来到达卡接受培训，管理这个由糖、盐、其他元素和水组成的简单疗法。
en: Our institute is the birthplace of ORT, and medical professionals from around the world come to Dhaka to be trained to administer this simple solution of sugar, salt, other elements, and water.

zh: 在为期一周的课程中，也门医护人员接受了关于疾病爆发管理、监测手段和环境卫生方面的培训。
en: Over the course of a week, Yemen’s health professionals received training on outbreak management, surveillance methods, and sanitation.

zh: 他们在我们的医院中观察霍乱病人的治疗情况，这一经验为他们提供了第一手关于病例管理和评估脱水情况的训练。
en: They observed the treatment of cholera patients in our hospital, an experience that provided hands-on training for case management and assessing dehydration status.

zh: 这只是icddr,b在危机时期帮助缓解人道灾难的一个例子。
en: This is just one example of how icddr,b has helped alleviate human suffering in times of crisis.

zh: 作为世卫组织全球爆发预警和响应网络（Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network，GOARN）的创始成员，icddr,b已向津巴布韦、苏丹、南苏丹、莫桑比克、叙利亚、索马里、海地、塞拉利昂、埃塞俄比亚和伊拉克派遣了专家团队。
en: As a founding member of the WHO’s Global Outbreak Alert and Response Network (GOARN), icddr,b has deployed expert teams to Zimbabwe, Sudan, South Sudan, Mozambique, Syria, Somalia, Haiti, Sierra Leone, Ethiopia, and Iraq.

zh: 通过分享我们在几十年中所积累的腹泻疾病管理和研究的知识和经验，我们在全球应对疾病爆发方面起着领导作用。
en: By sharing the knowledge and expertise that we have developed over decades of diarrheal disease management and research, we are playing a leading role in global efforts to tackle outbreaks.

zh: 孟加拉国对于战时霍乱爆发有着切肤之痛。
en: Bangladesh knows wartime cholera all too well.

zh: 1971年，当时仍是东巴基斯坦的孟加拉国宣布脱离巴基斯坦独立，战事随之爆发。
en: In 1971, fighting broke out when Bangladesh, then known as East Pakistan, declared independence from Pakistan.

zh: 在随后的冲突中，难民穿越边境，涌入邻国印度，在拥挤的难民营中暂住，这形成了非常完美的条件，霍乱不爆发都难。
en: In the ensuing conflict, refugees poured across the border into neighboring India into crowded camps, creating conditions that inevitably gave rise to cholera outbreaks.

zh: 当时的护理水平非常低，静脉滴注非常罕见，这意味着脱水状况无法得到广泛治疗。
en: The standard of care at the time was poor, and a dearth of intravenous drips meant that rehydration solutions could not be administered widely.

zh: 很多人垂死挣扎，这时，一位叫做迪利普·马哈拉纳比斯（Dilip Mahalanabis）的医生在绝望之中放手一搏。
en: As many people lay dying, a pioneering doctor named Dilip Mahalanabis took a chance in a desperate situation.

zh: 孟加拉国的美国研究者已经证明，ORT可以逆转霍乱病人致命的脱水症状，但其医院外效果仍未得到证实。
en: American researchers in Bangladesh had shown that ORT could reverse fatal dehydration in cholera patients, but its effectiveness outside hospitals had not yet been proven.

zh: 在缺少合适的设备和医护助手的情况下，马哈拉纳比斯在难民营中开展了ORT并拯救了数千人的生命。
en: Lacking proper equipment and medical facilities, Mahalanabis administered ORT in camps, and in the process, saved thousands of lives.

zh: 此后，ORT便成为治疗腹泻疾病的标准方法；在全市及诶拯救了8,000万多人的生命。
en: As a result, ORT became the new standard of care for diarrheal disease treatment; it has since saved more than 80 million people around the world.

zh: 如今，新的战时霍乱危机再次出现，孟加拉国专家也再次应召。
en: Now, new wartime cholera crises have emerged, and Bangladeshi expertise is again being called into service.

zh: 也门只是一个例子。
en: Yemen is only one example.

zh: 8月以来，数十万罗兴亚人从缅甸穿越边境来到孟加拉国，这是自1994年卢旺达种族灭绝以来最大规模的周难民流出量。
en: Since August, hundreds of thousands of Rohingya have crossed the border into Bangladesh from Myanmar, the highest weekly outflow of refugees anywhere in the world since the Rwandan genocide in 1994.

zh: 这些绝望又脆弱的人们住在拥挤的难民营中，生活条件导致致命霍乱疫情的风险很高。
en: These desperate and vulnerable people are crowded into refugee camps, and there is a high risk that conditions may lead to a deadly cholera epidemic.

zh: 为了应对这一威胁，icddr,b和联合国儿童基金会、世卫组织和其他重要相关利益方合作启动了多重霍乱防治计划。
en: In response to this threat, icddr,b is collaborating with UNICEF, the WHO, and other important stakeholders on multiple cholera-prevention initiatives.

zh: 我们改善了清洁水和卫生设施的普及，ORT药包也正在积累。
en: Efforts are being made to improve access to clean water and sanitation, and ORT sachets are being stockpiled.

zh: 我们也和世卫组织一起确保了900,000剂口服霍乱疫苗（OCT ） ， 这也是被国际认可的预防和控制霍乱爆发的工具。
en: We have also worked with the WHO to secure some 900,000 doses of oral cholera vaccine (OCV), an internationally accepted tool to prevent and control outbreaks.

zh: 和ORT一样，OCV的开发也源自孟加拉国，特别是icddr,b。
en: Like ORT, the development of OCV has roots in Bangladesh, and at icddr,b in particular.

zh: 该疫苗的首批成功现场试验就是icddr,b在20世纪80年代完成的，如今，我们的科学家正在集几十年理论知识累积之功，实施第二大规模的OCV战役。
en: The vaccine’s first successful field trials were conducted at icddr,b in the 1980s, and today, our scientists are drawing on decades of institutional knowledge to execute the second-largest OCV campaign ever conducted.

zh: 也许很难想象孟加拉国这样的发展中国家能够在管理如此规模的疾病方面起到先锋作用。
en: It might be hard to imagine that a developing country like Bangladesh could play a pioneering role in managing a disease of such magnitude.

zh: 但一次又一次，孟加拉国的研究者和卫生工作者证明他们在遏制霍乱爆发和拯救生命方面的专业精神。
en: But time and again, researchers and health workers in Bangladesh have demonstrated their expertise at containing cholera outbreaks and saving lives.

zh: 当世界寻找遏制机会型疫情（opportunistic epidemics）的新方法时，决不能忽视发展中国家的现成的科学知识。
en: As the world looks for new ways to curb opportunistic epidemics, it must not overlook the science that developing countries already possess.

zh: 霍乱在全球南方卷土重来。
en: Cholera is back in the Global South.

zh: 但是，我们在孟加拉国的工作证明，全球南方拥有击败它的本事。
en: But, as our work in Bangladesh demonstrates, the Global South has the skills to beat it.

zh: 抑制金融混乱
en: Containing Financial Turmoil

zh: 在那些从美国住房市场泡沫破裂后就一直在预警世界经济风险的人们看来，今天发生的持续性金融市场混乱丝毫不值得大惊小怪。
en: Today’s ongoing financial market turmoil comes as no surprise to those who have been warning about the risks to the world economy from the end of the housing market bubble in the United States.

zh: 今年1月，美国对全球经济的展望就引发了可能给债台高筑的美国住宅市场带来经济阵痛的忧虑。
en: Back in January, the United Nations’ outlook for the global economy raised concerns about the economic pain this might impose on heavily indebted US households.

zh: 它还明确了管理疲弱、联系紧密的全球金融市场和长久以来的全球宏观经济失衡如何影响到包括贫困国家在内的世界经济的发展前景。
en: It also emphasized how weakly regulated, closely interconnected global financial markets, together with persistent global macroeconomic imbalances, jeopardize growth and development prospects in the world economy, including poorer countries.

zh: 美国的经常项目赤字是人们议论最多的一项全球经济失衡指标。
en: The US current account deficit has been the most widely discussed indicator of global imbalances.

zh: 过去5年来，随着史无前例的宽松的国内信贷政策允许家庭以超过自己收入的尺度进行开支，美国每一天吸收其它国家存款的金额都要超过20亿美元。
en: For the past five years, the US has been sucking in more than $2 billion a day of other countries’ savings, as the easy provision of domestic credit on an unprecedented scale has allowed households to spend more than they earn.

zh: 资产（住宅和股票）价格的一路扬升和利率的一路走低更增加了这种借贷方式的魅力，使得继任的金融市场改革者能够说服投资者风险已经在他们的掌控之中。
en: Such borrowing was especially attractive as asset (housing and equity) prices kept rising, interest rates remained low, and succeeding generations of financial market innovators could convince investors that they had mastered the exigencies of risk.

zh: 因此，就连抵押品估值过高的二次借贷也被作为未来美好前景的标志而大肆宣传。
en: Thus, further lending, even against over-valued collateral, was “sold” as a sign of good times ahead.

zh: 特别是当美国消费者的大肆挥霍推动全球经济强劲增长之时，人们对市场非理性繁荣的警告大都充耳不闻。
en: Warnings about irrational market exuberance were largely ignored, especially as US consumer spending helped fuel strong growth across the global economy.

zh: 日本和欧洲的强劲出口支持经济恢复增长、也稳定了投资者的心态，进而又为新兴的工业化国家，特别是中国，提供了进一步的出口机遇。
en: Robust exports from Japan and Europe supported economic recovery and steadied investor confidence, providing, in turn, further export opportunities for newly industrializing countries, most notably China.

zh: 与此同时，国际竞争的加剧抑制了通货膨胀，使得利率维持在较低的水平，这样又进一步推动了消费者的消费支出，完成了貌似良性的整个增长周期循环。
en: Meanwhile, heightened international competition kept the lid on inflation, and interest rates remained low, giving a further boost to consumer spending and completing what looked like a virtuous growth circle.

zh: 时间一长，就连很多最贫困的国家似乎也加入到这次盛宴，在日益提升的能源和原材料价格、国外周而复始的矿业投资以及日益增长的财政收入的支持下获得了强劲的经济发展。
en: Even many of the poorest countries seemed, at long last, to be joining in, posting strong growth on the back of rising energy and raw material prices, renewed mining investments from abroad, and increasing fiscal revenues.

zh: 尽管数字从未像狂热市场人士所想象的那样美好，但的确能将人们的注意力从摇摇欲坠的繁荣基础上转移开去。
en: Although the numbers were never as rosy as market enthusiasts seemed to think, they did divert attention away from the shaky foundations of the newfound prosperity.

zh: 影响巨大的政治家和市场分析人士都对日益迫切的纠正全球失衡的需要不屑一顾 ： “ 为什么要改变这样一种行之有效的方式？ ”
en: The growing need for measures to correct global imbalances was met with disbelief by influential policymakers and market analysts alike: “Why change a winning formula?”

zh: 世界其它国家的命运取决于人们对正在扩散的金融混乱做何反应。
en: The fate of the rest of the world depends on the responses to the unfolding financial turmoil.

zh: 房地产和股票市场的缩水肯定会抑制美国家庭的需求和借贷，很有可能引发经济的滑坡。
en: The contraction of property and stock markets will undoubtedly dampen US household borrowing and demand, potentially triggering a downward spiral.

zh: 如果企图通过关税和其它与贸易有关的措施来进行保护，那么政策的反弹效应可能会对所有国家造成破坏性后果。
en: If protection is sought through tariff and other trade-related measures, then the knock-on effects could have even more devastating consequences for all.

zh: 最近几个星期，几大央行行长已经为金融系统注资3000亿美元、调低向私有银行借贷的利率，并宣布这样的积极措施将一直维持到这次金融混乱的影响平稳过去。
en: In recent weeks, leading central bankers have injected over $300 billion into the financial system, lowered the rates at which they lend to private banks, and announced that such activism will continue until calm returns.

zh: 这些措施也许现在足以使金融市场恢复平静，但却无法解决当前混乱背后的那些更为基本的问题。
en: This may be enough to calm financial markets for now, but it will not redress the more fundamental problems behind the current turmoil.

zh: 在今天这样一个相互依存的世界，需要制定一项共同策略来防止经济衰退，恢复金融市场的长期稳定。
en: In today’s interdependent world, a coordinated strategy is needed to avoid recession and to return lasting stability to financial markets.

zh: 事实上，金融动荡所导致的经济后果再次引发世界的忧虑凸显了10年前亚洲危机后向全新国际金融构架过渡缺乏进展的事实。
en: Indeed, the fact that the world is again worrying about the economic fallout from financial shocks highlights the lack of progress since the Asian crisis a decade ago in moving towards a new international financial architecture.

zh: 尽管在统一标准和扩大监管方面小有成就，但整体重心却过多地放在了加强对发展中国家的管理，而缺乏管理的私有资本流动所引发的系统性问题却没有引起足够的重视。
en: While there has been some progress on harmonizing standards and extending surveillance, there has been far too much emphasis on strengthening governance in developing countries and not enough on systemic problems linked to unregulated private capital flows.

zh: 随着全球经济衰退的风险日益邻近，采取严厉措施并不是纠正全球经济失衡的有效方法。
en: With the imminent threat of global recession, austerity measures are not the way to correct global imbalances.

zh: 相反，赤字国家需要加强出口，恢复进出口贸易的平衡；而贸易顺差国也应该加大进口力度。
en: Rather, deficit countries need to export their way back to balance, while imports should increase in surplus countries.

zh: 不仅如此，需要在最为贫困的国家进行建设性的投资，以便恢复或保持经济的增长。
en: Moreover, productive investments are needed in the poorest countries to resume or sustain economic development.

zh: 决策者需要财政和货币空间才能朝着这个方向努力。
en: Policymakers need the fiscal and monetary space to move in this direction.

zh: 将基础广泛的国际经济监管和政策协调制度化将是重要的长期目标，但到目前为止，世界领导人急需恢复全球需求平衡，并改善针对汇率体系的管理。
en: Institutionalizing a mechanism for broad-based international economic surveillance and policy coordination will be an important longer-term goal, but at this point, world leaders urgently need to rebalance global demand and improve the management of the exchange-rate system.

zh: 要想取得进展，所有政府都必须依靠多边机构、按照多边协议来采取行动。
en: Moving forward requires all governments to act through inclusive multilateral organizations and arrangements.

zh: 尽管国际货币基金组织管理缺乏民主和过于企业化影响了该组织在发展中国家的地位和信任度，也歪曲了扩大监管范围的努力，但在目前却没有其它多边组织可以替代国际货币基金组织所发挥的作用。
en: Despite the IMF’s undemocratic and corporate-like governance, which has undermined its legitimacy and credibility in the developing world and distorted efforts to extend its surveillance role, there is no alternative multilateral body available.

zh: 这样步调一致的共同回应需要在解决迫在眉睫的近期问题的同时，为防止世界经济陷入痛苦的衰退提供中期的解决方案。
en: Such a coordinated response will need to address immediate short-term problems as well as provide medium-term solutions without plunging the world economy into another painful recession.

zh: 这一次，改革必须能够永久性地解决全球经济失衡问题，并直接处理国际金融资本领域最不受控制的因素。
en: And it is imperative that this time around, reforms offer a lasting solution to global imbalances and tackle head on the most unruly elements of international financial capital.

zh: 遏制始于国内
en: Containment Begins at Home

zh: 纽约 — — 本月早些时候，穆罕默德·优素福·阿齐兹，一位24岁的中东裔美国公民在田纳西州查塔怒加市的两座军事基地开火，造成5人死亡。
en: NEW YORK – Earlier this month, Muhammad Youssef Abdulazeez, a 24-year-old US citizen of Middle Eastern descent, opened fire at two military sites in Chattanooga, Tennessee, killing five.

zh: 这起地方性恐怖事件具有全国性意义，因为它证明已故美国外交官兼战略家乔治·凯南的警告是正确的，凯南警告美国外交决策者应该遏制自己的行为冲动，特别是在军事方面。
en: This act of local horror was also one of national significance, for it vindicated the late US diplomat and strategist George F. Kennan’s warning that American foreign policymakers should hold in check their urge to act, especially militarily.

zh: 凯南警告说人们或许永远不会知道报应什么时候会来，但它一定会来的。
en: One can never know when the blowback will come, Kennan warned, but it will.

zh: 事实上，当美国2001年冲进阿富汗、两年后又冲进伊拉克时，凯南所担心的恰恰是不可预见的后果。
en: Indeed, unforeseeable consequences were precisely what concerned Kennan when the United States charged into Afghanistan in 2001 and Iraq two years later.

zh: 毕竟，美国在阿富汗的很多对手，包括本·拉登本人都与1979-1989年苏联占领期间美军训练的叛乱分子穆斯林战斗游击队有着千丝万缕的联系并不是巧合。
en: After all, it was no coincidence that many of those the US was fighting in Afghanistan, including Osama bin Laden himself, had been associated with the Mujahedeen, the guerilla-style units of Muslim warriors whom US forces trained as insurgents during the 1979-1989 Soviet occupation.

zh: 同样，20世纪80年代，美国曾武装萨达姆·侯赛因的伊拉克与伊朗进行战争。
en: Likewise, the US had armed Saddam Hussein’s Iraq to go to war with Iran in the 1980s.

zh: 2001年9月11日的恐怖袭击后，美国人问“他们为什么恨我们？
en: Following the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001, Americans asked, “Why do they hate us?”

zh: ”但尽管自那以后美国本土没有再发生袭击事件，美国总统乔治·W·布什政府却几乎毫无遏制地对两个穆斯林国家发起了破坏活动 — — 布什任期结束后破坏仍在继续，美国发起了空前惨烈的无人机战争。
en: Yet, though the US has experienced no attack on its soil since then, US President George W. Bush’s administration pursued, virtually unchecked, the destruction of two Muslim countries – and the devastation has continued beyond Bush’s tenure with an ever-intensifying campaign of drone strikes.

zh: 这些政策将阿富汗推到了国家失败的悬崖边缘，同时开启了伊斯兰国占领伊拉克超过三分之一领土的可能。
en: These policies have helped push Afghanistan to the precipice of state failure, while opening the way for the Islamic State to take over more than one-third of Iraq’s territory.

zh: 由此造成的上述国家和整个穆斯林世界的不满在欧洲能够越来越明显地被感受到 — — 而且现在正在传播到美国。
en: The resulting discontent in those countries and across the Muslim world has increasingly been felt in Europe – and now is emerging in the US, too.

zh: 可以肯定，美国刑事调查人员还没有正式确定阿齐兹的动机，这名年轻人在科威特出生，似乎并不属于任何恐怖组织。
en: To be sure, US criminal investigators have not officially identified the motives of the Kuwaiti-born Abdulazeez, who does not seem to have belonged to a terror network.

zh: 但现实中不乏在西方长大（阿齐兹在查塔怒加市上的高中和大学 ） ， 梦想破灭、陷入孤立的年轻人寻找值得为之奋斗的事业 — — 并在伊斯兰遭受美国和西方所谓的羞辱中找到奋斗目标的先例。
en: But there is plenty of precedent for an alienated and disenchanted young man, brought up in the West (Abdulazeez attended high school and college in Chattanooga), to seek a cause worth fighting for – and to find it in the perceived humiliation of Islam by America and the West.

zh: 当然，只要“伊斯兰”这个词一出现，西方媒体大��描绘的不是受伤而绝望的个体，而是作为某种巨型伊斯兰阴谋代理的“独狼 ” 。
en: Of course, as soon as the word “Islam” appears, Western media start painting such “lone wolves” as agents of some vast Islamic conspiracy, rather than deeply wounded and desperate individuals.

zh: 这样的解释让恐怖行为更容易理解：恐怖网络的某个齿轮将被启动、甚至不惜对其进行洗脑来实施这样一次袭击活动。
en: Such an interpretation makes the act easier to understand: a cog in a terrorist network would be compelled, even brainwashed, to mount such an attack.

zh: 但如果袭击者只是一个孤立的个体 — — 而且居然还是美国公民 — — 就严重质疑了他或她（虽然在类似情况下袭击者几乎无一例外是男性）背后的制度。
en: But when the attacker is a solitary individual – an American citizen, no less– it raises serious questions about the system from which he or she (though almost always a he in these cases) emerged.

zh: 据某些媒体报道，阿齐兹因无力达到美国的成功标准而产生某种失败感，而美国成功与否主要靠金钱来衡量。
en: According to some press accounts, Abdulazeez felt a sense of failure at his inability to meet America’s standard of success, of which money is the primary measure.

zh: 虽然阿齐兹并不笃信宗教，但据说他曾称颂已故的安瓦尔·奥拉基是战胜失败的典范，后者是一位美国出生的基地组织神职人员，大肆倡导攻击“伪善”的美国。
en: Though he did not appear deeply religious, he allegedly praised the late Anwar al-Awlaki, a US-born al-Qaeda cleric and an advocate of attacks on “hypocritical” America, as a model of triumph over failure.

zh: 有关美国制度的另一项质疑源于阿齐兹的医疗保险公司拒绝批准他参与住院药物酒精计划。
en: Another question about the US system stems from the refusal of Abdulazeez’s health insurer to approve his participation in an in-patient drug and alcohol program.

zh: 因为心理健康问题、包括成瘾人员被忽视而酿成大规模屠杀在美国已经不是第一次。
en: This is far from the first time the US has experienced a mass murder by someone whose mental-health issues, including addiction, had been overlooked.

zh: 这是否反应了系统性失败？
en: Does this reflect a systemic failure?

zh: 更重要的是，这是否有悖于美国的原则？
en: More fundamentally, does it controvert America’s principles?

zh: 但美国仍然专注于伊斯兰恐怖主义的外来祸患，而并未对这些问题进行思考。
en: Rather than considering such questions, the US remains focused on the external scourge of Islamic terrorism.

zh: 凯南数十年前就已经意识到上述趋势，并警告国内外短视政策已经让美国容易受伤。
en: Kennan recognized this tendency decades ago, when he warned that shortsighted policies at home and abroad had already put America in a vulnerable position.

zh: 他建议美国不应沉醉于自己的优势，而应从包括俄国在内的敌人的错误中吸取教训。
en: Instead of basking in its own superiority, he advised, the US should learn from the mistakes of its enemies, including Russia.

zh: 2000年，凯南将布什政府的“全球反恐战争”与俄罗斯对北高加索地区车臣分裂分子的战争进行了比较。
en: In the 2000s, Kennan compared the Bush administration’s “global war on terror” to Russia’s wars against Chechen separatists in the North Caucasus.

zh: 1991年苏联解体时，俄罗斯首任总统叶利钦承诺其臣民“想要多少主权就会得到多少 ” 。
en: When the Soviet Union dissolved in 1991, Boris Yeltsin, Russia’s first president, promised its subjects “as much sovereignty as they can swallow.”

zh: 数百年来一直试图从俄国独立的车臣人将他的承诺当作实现自决的机会。
en: The Chechens, who had sought independence from Russia for centuries, took this promise as an opportunity for self-determination.

zh: 但叶利钦因为不愿在苏联最初解体后失去更多领土而违背了自己的承诺。
en: But Yeltsin, unwilling to lose any more territories after the Soviet Union’s initial breakup, reneged on his pledge.

zh: 1993年，第一次车臣战争爆发。
en: In 1993, the first Chechen war erupted.

zh: 俄罗斯成功击败了分裂分子并继续控制车臣。
en: Russia managed to defeat the separatists and maintain control over Chechnya.

zh: 但这是一次得不偿失的胜利，因为它使许多幻想破灭的愤怒的车臣人转变为宗教原教旨主义者。
en: But it was a Pyrrhic victory, given that it drove many disillusioned and angry Chechens toward religious fundamentalism.

zh: 结果当1999年第二次车臣战争爆发时，战争不再只为争取独立，而演变为伊斯兰对基督徒的全面战争。
en: As a result, when the second Chechen war began in 1999, the fight was no longer just about Chechen independence from Russia; it was a fight for Islam, waged against Christians everywhere.

zh: 俄罗斯在叶利钦的继任者普京领导下再次打败了分裂主义者，恢复了对该地区的联邦控制。
