en: Russia, under Yeltsin’s successor, Vladimir Putin, defeated the separatists again, restoring federal control over the territory.

zh: 15年后，车臣极端分子和伊斯兰国势力同流合污。
en: Fifteen years later, Chechen extremists are fighting alongside the Islamic State.

zh: 有人可能会反对将美国用枪炮输出民主和俄国在叶利钦和普京治下的帝国死亡痉挛进行比较。
en: One might object to comparing America’s desire to export democracy at the barrel of a gun to Russia’s imperial death spasms under Yeltsin and Putin.

zh: 但无论我们愿意与否，两者之间都存在很强的相似关系：两国都被认为是在强行驱使穆斯林的意志。
en: But, whether we like it or not, there is a strong parallel between them: both countries are perceived to be dictating to Muslims.

zh: 事实上，在有关9/11的一次私人谈话中，是凯南最先就这种相似性引起了我的注意。 他指出对很多穆斯林而言，越来越难以分清俄罗斯和西方的区别。
en: And, in fact, it was Kennan who first drew my attention to this similarity, when in a private conversation about 9/11, he noted that, for many Muslims, Russia and the West were becoming indistinguishable.

zh: 两者都被认为是敌视伊斯兰教的世俗国家。
en: Both were viewed as secular states antagonistic to Islam.

zh: 凯南警告正如第一次车臣战争孕育了国家和个人的不满，美国在阿富汗和伊拉克的战争只会助长更多的仇恨和挫折 — — 而这最终会报应回美国。
en: Kennan warned that, just as the first Chechen war bred national and individual resentment, America’s wars in Afghanistan and Iraq would only fuel more hatred and frustration – which would eventually blow back onto the US.

zh: “无法适应让人们攻击这套系统 ， ” 他说 ， “ 因此靠炸弹争取自由永远都不是明智的选择。 ”
en: “The failure to fit the system makes people attack that system,” he said, “so it is never wise to bomb nations to freedom.”

zh: 遏制，而不是纵容
en: Containment, not Appeasement

zh: 美国和世界都在关注布什政府是否会按照伊拉克问题研究小组（Iraq Study Group）所建议的策略从伊拉克撤军。
en: America and the world are focused on whether the Bush administration will adopt the Iraq Study Group’s recommendations for an exit strategy from Iraq.

zh: 这是目前最迫切需要解决的问题，但美国领导人还需要预先考虑未来。
en: That is the most pressing immediate question, but America’s leaders should also be thinking ahead.

zh: 美国需要为伊拉克和中东地区制定后占领期策略，而这项策略必须以21世纪切实可行的国家安全政策为基础，那就是遏制。
en: America needs a post-occupation strategy for Iraq and the Middle East, one grounded in a viable national security strategy for the twenty-first century. That strategy is containment.

zh: 入侵伊拉克之前，布什政府把遏制看作过时的冷战后遗症而不予理睬。
en: In the run-up to the Iraq invasion, the Bush administration rejected containment as an obsolete Cold War hangover.

zh: 武器核查人员被迫撤离，美国选择了先发制人地挑起战争。
en: The weapons inspectors were pulled out, and America opted for preemptive war.

zh: 布什被描绘为以邱吉尔般的坚定意志与新的希特勒对抗，而遏制政策的宣传者则被斥责为姑息和纵容。
en: Bush was portrayed as facing down a new Hitler with Churchillian resolve, and advocates of containment were accused of appeasement.

zh: 可现在我们知道遏制策略是有效的。
en: But now we know that the containment regime worked.

zh: 萨达姆·侯赛因统治下的伊拉克不会威胁到任何人，更不用说是美国了。
en: Saddam Hussein’s Iraq was in no position to threaten anyone, let alone the United States.

zh: 在哈利·杜鲁门（Harry Truman）任总统时担任美国国务院政策计划室（US State Department’s Policy Planning Staff）主任的乔治·凯南（George Kennan）最先提出了遏制策略，当时提出这项策略是为了应对二战结束后苏联所构成的威胁。 乔治·凯南所提出的遏制策略已经不是第一次被人斥责为姑息纵容了。
en: This was not the first time that containment – a strategy devised by George Kennan, the director of the US State Department’s Policy Planning Staff under President Harry Truman, in response to the Soviet threat after World War II – has been rejected as appeasement.

zh: 在1952年的总统竞选中，德怀特·艾森豪威尔（Dwight Eisenhower）和他未来的国务卿约翰·福斯特·杜勒斯（John Foster Dulles）就曾对遏制策略嗤之以鼻，并号召要在东欧地区将苏联“彻底打垮 ” 。
en: In the 1952 presidential election campaign, Dwight Eisenhower and his future secretary of state, John Foster Dulles, heaped scorn on containment, calling instead for a “rollback” of the Soviets in Eastern Europe.

zh: 幸运的是艾森豪威尔政府在当政之后保持了理智，在欧洲继续推行遏制政策，使得现在被认为是为最终赢得冷战立下卓著功勋的遏制政策得以延续下去。
en: Fortunately, once in office, the Eisenhower administration had the sense to stick with containment in Europe, continuing a policy that is widely credited for winning the Cold War.

zh: 约翰·F·肯尼迪总统顶住了巨大的压力，在古巴导弹危机期间继续推行遏制政策，将全世界从全面核战争的边缘拯救回来。
en: President John F. Kennedy’s insistence, against much advice, on containment during the Cuban missile crisis saved the world from nuclear war.

zh: 这绝不是什么姑息纵容，而是经过冷静思考之后真正的坚决果敢。
en: This was calculated resolve, not appeasement.

zh: 遏制的目标是要防止苏联的势力扩大，同时又不给美国造成无法承载的军事负担。
en: Containment’s goal was to prevent Soviet expansion without saddling the US with unsustainable military obligations.

zh: 只要苏维埃社会主义共和国联盟（USSR）不首先发动军事袭击，那么遏制政策就能靠经济大棒和胡萝卜、靠世界共产主义运动的内部矛盾、靠情报和外交手段、靠焕发资本主义民主国家的内部活力来保证我们的安全。
en: So long as the USSR did not stage a military attack, containment’s reliance on economic sticks and carrots, competition within the world communist movement, intelligence and diplomacy, and promoting the vitality of the capitalist democracies would guarantee security.

zh: 凯南是对的：运行失衡的苏联政治制度，再加上它在国际上的过度扩张，最终必然导致苏联的毁灭。
en: Kennan was right: the dysfunctional features of Soviet system, and its over-extension internationally, would lead to its demise.

zh: 每当遏制政策被弃之不用，美国就会付出高昂的代价。
en: When containment has been abandoned, America has paid a high price.

zh: 艾森豪威尔政府在1953年推翻了伊朗的民选政府，理由是认为这个政府过于亲苏。
en: The Eisenhower administration toppled Iran’s elected government in 1953 believing it to be too pro-Soviet.

zh: 他们在推翻原有政府之后培植的国王根本得不到伊朗民众的认可，在1979年的伊斯兰革命运动中被赶下台。
en: The hugely unpopular Shah they installed was swept away in the Islamic revolution in 1979.

zh: 美国在危地马拉和拉美其他地方也犯下了相似的错误。
en: America made comparable errors in Guatemala and elsewhere in Latin America.

zh: 美国悖离遏制策略的教训尤以越南最为惨重。
en: Vietnam was America’s costliest departure from containment.

zh: 就像凯南所说的那样，美国发动战争时并不是为了自己的核心利益，但对手的情况却恰恰相反，因此我们的对手一定会英勇奋战，一直到战争由于持续的时间过长而在美国民众中失去支持。
en: As Kennan explained, when America goes to war over something less than a vital interest, the adversary – for whom vital interests are at stake – will fight long after the war has become too unpopular at home to sustain.

zh: 布什在伊拉克再次犯下了这样的错误。
en: Bush repeated this mistake in Iraq.

zh: 遏制绝不是冷战的后遗症。
en: Containment is hardly a relic of the Cold War.

zh: 遏制在利比亚发挥了作用，成功地在20世纪90年代制止了卡扎菲（Muammar Khadafi）继续支持恐怖主义，将洛克比空难的制造者交出受审，并向在利比亚制造的恐怖主义活动中丧生的英法公民做出赔偿。
en: It worked against Libya, leading Muammar Khadafi in the late 1990’s to stop sponsoring terrorism, turn over the Lockerbie bombers for trial, and pay compensation to British and French victims of Libyan-sponsored terrorism.

zh: 卡扎菲由于美国入侵伊拉克而放弃核计划的说法遭到了弗林特·莱弗里特（Flynt Leverett）的驳斥，莱弗里特在2002到2003年间担任美国国家安全委员会中东事务部主任。
en: Claims that he abandoned his nuclear program in response to the US-led invasion of Iraq have been refuted by Flynt Leverett, director for Middle Eastern affairs at the US National Security Council from 2002 to 2003.

zh: 按照莱弗里特的说法，卡扎菲早在伊拉克战争开始前就已经做出了决定，而且他做出这样的决定显然是对结束对利比亚国际制裁的一种补偿。
en: According to Leverett, Khadafi’s decision predated the invasion and was a response to an explicit quid-pro-quo to end international sanctions against Libya.

zh: 遏制利比亚绝非姑息纵容。
en: Containment against Libya was not appeasement.

zh: 美国在伊拉克就应该实行遏制政策，如今在伊朗也是同样的状况。
en: It should have been the model in Iraq, as it now should be the model in Iran.

zh: 但与此形成鲜明对照的是，现代“击溃”政策的捍卫者拼命要求打击伊朗，理由是伊朗在制造核武器。
en: Instead, defenders of the contemporary equivalent of “rollback” advocate attacking Iran because it is developing nuclear weapons.

zh: 这和20世纪50年代鼓吹对华作战一样愚蠢可笑。
en: This makes about as much sense as it would to attack China in the 1950’s.

zh: 对手之间的冲突能让美国坐收渔利，这是��南最精辟的见解之一。
en: One of Kennan’s great insights was that the US is well served by conflict among America’s adversaries.

zh: 他欢迎铁托在南斯拉夫的崛起，并希望其他国家能够竞相仿效，因为惟其如此才能从内部挑战莫斯科的霸权。
en: He welcomed Tito’s rise in Yugoslavia as an internal challenge to Moscow’s hegemony that he hoped others would emulate.

zh: 布什政府忘记了凯南的教诲，它2002年对伊朗的孤立没有任何意义。 当时温和派在伊朗仍然占据上风，伊朗在阿富汗也仍然与美国进行着合作。
en: This lesson is lost on the Bush administration, which senselessly alienated Iran in 2002, when moderates had the upper hand there and were cooperating in Afghanistan, and reversed decades of US policy by insisting that any Middle East settlement must accept changed “realities on the ground” in the West Bank.

zh: 布什坚持中东和平方案必须接受西岸已经变化了“领土情况 ” ， 彻底改变了已经奉行了几十年的美国政策。 布什政府似乎决意要把对手驱赶到一起¾这种做法把塞谬尔·亨廷顿（Samuel Huntington）所描绘的“文化激烈冲突”的反面乌托邦变成了现实。
en: The administration seems bent on herding adversaries together – transforming Samuel Huntington’s “clash-of-civilizations” dystopia into a self-fulfilling prophecy.

zh: 凯南坚持认为美国应努力建设一个没有霸权的世界，而宣传民主的最佳方法莫过于向世人展示民主的优势所在。
en: Kennan maintained that the US should work to create a world that no one can dominate, and that the best way to spread democracy is to demonstrate its superiority.

zh: 强迫人们接受民主不可能取得成功。
en: Ramming democracy down people’s throats is self-defeating.

zh: 这种做法曾经在东南亚和拉美缔造出强大的共产主义和反美民族主义联盟，同样的做法如今又使中东地区产生了极端伊斯兰主义和反美民族主义的联合运动。
en: Just as it produced a potent fusion of communism and anti-American nationalism in Southeast Asia and Latin America, it is now producing a similar combination of radical Islam and anti-American nationalism across the Middle East.

zh: 只要遏制住恐怖主义宗主国就能遏制住恐怖主义运动。
en: Terrorist groups can be minimized if their enabling states are contained.

zh: 布什教条的捍卫者声称自顾不暇、一片混乱的宗主国不能再给恐怖活动以任何的支持。
en: Defenders of the Bush doctrine claim that this is impossible when they operate out of failed states that cannot police their borders.

zh: 但由于布什教条使国家变得更为混乱，这样的说法从根本上站不住脚。
en: But, given that the Bush doctrine has compounded the failed-state problem, this is a bogus argument.

zh: 无论美国入侵伊拉克前世界上有多少个国家陷入混乱，现在又多了一个混乱的国家。
en: However many failed states there were in the world before America invaded Iraq, there is one more now.

zh: 要想建立中东恐怖主义的遏制机制，就必须确定美国从伊拉克的撤军日期。
en: To build a containment regime against terrorism emanating from the Middle East, a date for America’s departure from Iraq must be set.

zh: 要想转变中东地区对美帝国主义野心的广泛猜测，除此之外再也别无他法。
en: There is no other way to reverse the widespread perception across the region that the US has imperial ambitions.

zh: 另外一个关键性步骤是将解决巴以冲突放在美国外交政策安排的核心。
en: The other essential step is to place resolution of the Israel-Palestine conflict at the center of America’s foreign policy agenda.

zh: 美国必须全力推动能在约旦河和地中海间的广大土地上获得绝大多数民众支持的解决方案。
en: America must push for a solution that can garner the support of significant majorities of all the peoples between the Jordan River and the Mediterranean.

zh: 那才是保护和促进民主最有效的方法。
en: That is the surest means of protecting and promoting democracy.

zh: 外交政策的正确内涵
en: The Right Stuff in Foreign Policy

zh: 美国剑桥—一些批评家批评美国总统奥巴马竞选时口号颇具鼓动性（inspirational ） ， 还提出了“弯曲历史之弓”的雄心，当选后却表现得事务（transactional）而现实（pragmatic ） 。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Some critics complain that US President Barack Obama campaigned on inspirational rhetoric and an ambition to “bend the arc of history,” but then turned out to be a transactional and pragmatic leader once in office.

zh: 但是，在这方面，奥巴马并不是绝无仅有的。
en: In this respect, however, Obama is hardly unique.

zh: 很多领导然在职业生涯中会改变他们的目标和风格。
en: Many leaders change their objectives and style over the course of their careers.

zh: 历史上最伟大的变革型（transformational）领袖 — — 俾斯麦在实现普鲁士领导下的德国统一后变得渐进（incremental）而现实导向。
en: One of the great transformational leaders in history, Otto von Bismarck, became largely incremental and status quo-oriented after achieving the unification of Germany under Prussian direction.

zh: 类似地，富兰克林·罗斯福的外交政策目标和风格在其第一个任期内是温和而渐进的，但在1938年认定希特勒代表了外部威胁后成为变革型。
en: Likewise, Franklin Delano Roosevelt’s foreign-policy objectives and style were modest and incremental in his first presidential term, but became transformational in 1938 when he decided that Adolf Hitler represented an existential threat.

zh: 事务型领导在稳定而可预测的环境中更加有效，而鼓动风格更可能在快速而间断的社会和政治变化时期中出现。
en: Transactional leadership is more effective in stable and predictable environments, whereas an inspirational style is more likely to appear in periods of rapid and discontinuous social and political change.

zh: 像印度的甘地和南非的曼德拉这样的具有变革型目标和鼓动型风格的领袖可以极大地影响不稳定的政治环境所产生的结果，特别是在制度性约束结构薄弱的发展中国家中。
en: The transformational objectives and inspirational style of a leader like Mahatma Gandhi in India or Nelson Mandela in South Africa can significantly influence outcomes in fluid political contexts, particularly in developing countries with weakly structured institutional constraints.

zh: 相反，美国外交政策的形成受国会、法院和宪法等制度的高度约束。
en: By contrast, American foreign-policy formation is highly constrained by institutions like Congress, the courts, and the constitution.

zh: 因此，出现变革型领袖的机会更低。
en: Thus, we would expect less opportunity for transformational leadership.

zh: 但即使是美国宪法，对国会和总统在外交政策方面的权力也语焉不详。
en: But even the US Constitution is ambiguous about the powers of Congress and the president in foreign policy.

zh: 往好了说，它也只是某宪法专家所谓的“斗争邀请 ” 。
en: At best, it creates what one constitutional expert called “an invitation to struggle.”

zh: 此外，外部条件的影响力很大。
en: Moreover, much depends on external conditions.

zh: 威尔逊、富兰克林·罗斯福和杜鲁门均在入主白宫后、在应对外部事件时才发展出了变革型目标。
en: Woodrow Wilson, Franklin Roosevelt, and Harry Truman developed transformational objectives only in response to external events after they entered office.

zh: 危机环境可以将天赋异禀的领袖从美国制度的顽疾 — — 既得利益和官僚惰性的重重约束中解放出来。
en: Crisis conditions can liberate a gifted leader from the accumulated constraints of vested interests and bureaucratic inertia that normally inhibit action in the American system.

zh: 20世纪90年代踌躇满志的克林顿据说相当嫉妒富兰克林·罗斯福可以遇到20世纪30年代的危机环境。
en: Bill Clinton, caught up in the complacent 1990’s, is said to have envied Franklin Roosevelt’s crisis conditions of the 1930’s.

zh: 在这样的局面中，行动的弹性更大。
en: In such situations, action becomes more fluid.

zh: 有着变革型目标的领袖的机会更大，鼓动型风格更可能找到积极响应的追随者并让他们扮演更重要的角色。
en: A leader with transformational objectives faces better odds, and an inspirational style is more likely to find responsive followers and to make their role more relevant.

zh: 比如，小布什就利用了2001年9月11日之后的危机环境要求表现实力并出兵伊拉克。
en: For example, George W. Bush used the crisis conditions after September 11, 2001, in the service of an assertion of executive power, as well as to invade Iraq.

zh: 但是，尽管动荡时期能为变革型领袖创造舞台，并不能因此得出果断而乐于冒险的领袖总是适合解决决定“动荡”性质的危机的结论。
en: But, while turbulent times may set the stage for transformational leaders, it does not follow that bold and risk-loving leaders are always best suited to address the crises that define such periods.

zh: 老布什就与他的儿子不同，他是位事务型领袖，但实施了颇为成功的外交政策。
en: President George H. W. Bush, unlike his son, was transactional, but implemented a very successful foreign policy.

zh: 不管领袖的目标是变革性的还是渐进性的，他们都需要一定的软实力和硬实力技能来增加效率。
en: Whether they are transformational or incremental in their objectives, leaders need certain soft- and hard-power skills to be effective.

zh: 软实力技能包括情商（自我控制和利用心理暗示吸引他人的能力 ） 、 愿景（平衡理想、目标和能力的有吸引力的未来描述）以及沟通（用词语和符号说服内部圈子和外部听众的能力 ） 。
en: Among the soft-power skills are emotional intelligence (self-control and the ability to use emotional cues to attract others); vision (an attractive portrait of the future that balances ideals, objectives, and capabilities); and communication (the ability to use words and symbols to persuade both an inner circle and a broader audience).

zh: 在使用硬实力资源方面，两种技能特别重要：组织力以及在通过欺压、收买和讨价还价中形成获胜联盟方面的无所不用其极。
en: For the use of hard-power resources, two skills are particularly important: organizational capacity and a Machiavellian proficiency in bullying, buying, and bargaining to form winning coalitions.

zh: 说到底，高效领导要求有肆应商（contextual intelligence）和本能判断力，这两种能力有助于领袖理解变化、设定目标并据此协调战略和战术。
en: Above all, effective leadership requires contextual intelligence and an intuitive diagnostic ability that helps a leader understand change, set objectives, and align strategies and tactics accordingly.

zh: 现代新加坡国父李光耀曾经对我说，领袖必须能够快速学习、检验现实、随时准备随环境改变思维并且在危机中保持镇定。
en: As Lee Kuan Yew, the founding father of modern Singapore, once told me, a leader must be a quick learner, test reality, be prepared to change his mind as conditions change, and act calmly in a crisis.

zh: 肆应商既包括面对复杂局面识别趋势的能力，也包括一边改变事件一边适应的能力。
en: Contextual intelligence implies both a capability to discern trends in the face of complexity and adaptability while trying to shape events.

zh: 俾斯麦曾把这种技能称为历史中的本能神迹，一种在清扫过去是抓住要领的能力。
en: Bismarck once referred to this skill as the ability to intuit God’s movements in history, and seize the hem of His garment as He sweeps past.

zh: 更平白点说，有肆应商的领袖与冲浪者一样，具有判断和驾驭新潮流的能力。
en: More prosaically, leaders with contextual intelligence, like surfers, have the ability to judge and adjust to new waves and ride them successfully.

zh: 这种类型的领袖不但能让自己的风格适应环境和追随者的需要，还能创造“教育他们的直觉”的信息流。
en: Leaders of this type not only adapt their style to the situation and to their followers’ needs; they also create flows of information that “educate their hunches.”

zh: 这包括揣摩集团政治并理解不同相关利益者的立场和优势，以便确定何时以及如何使用事务性和鼓动性技能的能力。
en: This involves the ability to size up group politics and understand the positions and strengths of various stakeholders in order to decide when and how to use transactional and inspirational skills.

zh: 这是可以自我制造的幸运。
en: It is the self-made part of luck.

zh: 这一技能在无序局面中至关重要，在这种局面下，通常问对问题比得到正确的答案更难。
en: This skill is crucial in unstructured situations, when it is often more difficult to ask the right questions than it is to get the right answers.

zh: 有肆应商的领袖善于通过定义集团所面临的的问题提供意义或给出路线图。
en: Leaders with contextual intelligence are good at providing meaning or a road map by defining the problem that a group confronts.

zh: 他们明白一个问题中不同价值之间的冲突，也知道如何平衡所欲和所能。
en: They understand the tension between the different values involved in an issue, and how to balance the desirable with the feasible.

zh: 特别地，肆应商要求领袖理解集团文化、实力资源的分布、追随者的需要和需求、信息流以及时机。
en: In particular, contextual intelligence requires an understanding of groups’ cultures; the distribution of power resources; followers’ needs and demands; information flows; and timing.

zh: 肆应商在外交政策中特别重要，因为高效的领袖必须理解其他社会的文化和实力结构，以及它们如何互相影响形成国际体系。
en: Contextual intelligence is particularly important in foreign policy, because an effective leader must understand the culture and power structure of other societies, and how they interact as an international system.

zh: 在多年的外交实践经验中，老布什练就了卓越的肆应商。
en: With years of experience in foreign affairs, George H. W. Bush had excellent contextual intelligence.

zh: 而几乎没有外交实践经验的小布什则否。
en: With almost no experience in foreign affairs, “W” did not.

zh: 其中的差距就是父亲的成功和儿子的失败的差别的来源。
en: That gap proved the difference between the success of the father and the failure of the son.

zh: 中国的电视管制
en: Controlling Chinese Television

zh: 由"无边界记者组织"发布的2003年度《世界新闻自由报告》将中国排在全部166个国家的中的第161位，大致位于伊朗和北朝鲜之间。
en: The 2003 World Press Freedom report put out by the group Reporters without Borders ranks China 161st among 166 nations, somewhere between Iran and North Korea.

zh: 但至少中国现在的电视银屏上已不再有毛泽东时代那些一本正经的情节剧和笨拙的说教式节目了。
en: But Chinese television fare, at least, no longer consists of the prudish melodramas and clumsy indoctrination programs of the Maoist past.

zh: 不经意的观察者会发现在如今中国的电视节目中，性、犯罪、毒品、暴力和老套的游戏节目已是稀松平常，并可能由此得到中国的电视节目内容已经摆脱桎梏的印象。
en: Casual observers of today's freewheeling offerings of sex, crime, drugs, violence, and banal game shows on Chinese TV might come away with the impression that most of the shackles have been removed from televised content.

zh: 然而，如果我们将注意力集中在直白的政治性内容上，这种印象就不复存在了。
en: To be sure, this impression disappears if one focuses on explicit political content.

zh: 与党的原则稍有背离的观点也仍然不会出现在电视上。
en: Viewpoints that deviate in the slightest from Party doctrine are still absent from Chinese TV.

zh: 尽管电视节目在表面上已呈多元化，但对政治话语的控制从上世纪50年代以来就几乎没有改观。
en: Despite the surface diversity of programming, the monolithic control of political discourse has changed little since the 1950's.

zh: 但中国电视节目的巨大播出量使这种控制变得困难。
en: But the sheer volume of China's TV programming makes maintaining such control difficult.

zh: 仅中国中央电视台（CCTV）一家就拥有12个频道（许多频道全天24小时播放节目）和近3000名雇员。
en: China Central Television (CCTV) alone has 12 channels (many broadcasting 24 hours a day), and employs about 3,000 people.

zh: CCTV受中央宣传部和广播电影电视部管辖。
en: CCTV falls under the control of the Propaganda Department and the Ministry of Radio, Film, and Television.

zh: 众多的省、市级电视台也按规定转播CCTV的某些节目。
en: Numerous provincial and municipal TV stations are also required to carry some CCTV programming.

zh: 这种联播方式代表着一项艰巨的行政任务。
en: This combination represents a vast administrative undertaking.

zh: 由于电视节目的需求量如此巨大，使得对电视节目内容的监控必须有最高的效率。
en: Given the staggering amount of programming needed to fill the time slots, content monitoring must be implemented with maximum efficiency.

zh: 由于政府对娱乐节目的战略在20世纪90年代向市场化转变，检查制度有所放宽。
en: Censorship has been made easier, not more difficult, by the government's decision in the 1990's to shift to a free-market strategy for entertainment products.

zh: 政府不再对电视台进行巨额的补贴。 新的"优胜劣汰"的市场机制迫使众多的电视台为了争夺广告收入而制作更受大众欢迎的节目。
en: Big subsidies to TV stations were mostly discontinued, and the new "sink or swim" approach forced TV outlets to compete for advertising revenues, resulting in programming with greater mass appeal.

zh: 因此，正如在文化领域的其它方面实行的策略那样，中国政府在很大程度上放弃了对电视内容在道德方面的控制。
en: Thus, in a strategy mirrored elsewhere in the cultural sphere, the government simply relinquished much control over the moral component of TV content.

zh: 在上世纪80年代和90年代初所实施的反色情的"扫黄"运动已成为历史。
en: The anti-pornography saohuang campaigns carried out in the 1980's and early 1990's are a thing of the past.

zh: 也许是意识到获得充分娱乐和心不在焉的老百姓不太会对公共政策发牢骚，共产党已经允许娱乐节目沿袭西方的模式从而放宽了在微观上的审查。
en: Perhaps realizing that an entertained and distracted populace is less likely to complain about public policy, the Party has allowed entertainment programming to follow the Western model, lessening the need for micro-managed censorship.

zh: 这种政策的结果就是新闻节目和其它节目事实上的分离。
en: The result is a de facto separation between news and everything else.

zh: 这样一来就便于有关部门严格控制新闻节目同时将大量的节目转入较宽松和较低劳动强度的监控体系。
en: This conveniently allows the authorities to control news programming with an iron hand while relegating the bulk of programming to a looser and less labor-intensive monitoring system.

zh: 当然，在中国高度政治化的大环境下，政治会渗透到即便是最无伤大雅的话语之中，许多谈话节目和观众参与的形式也需要一种较为含蓄但却仍然有效的内容管制体系。
en: Of course, given China's highly politicized atmosphere, politics can leak into even the most innocuous areas of discourse, and the many talk shows and audience participation formats necessitate a less intrusive but nonetheless effective system of content regulation.

zh: 我作为节目策划人为CCTV工作所遇到的第一个意外就是这种最低限度的管制体系。
en: The first surprise I encountered while working for CCTV as a program planner was how minimal this system is.

zh: 来自高层的指示和直接的审查极少发生。
en: Top-down directives and outright censorship are rare.

zh: 也几乎没有成文的方针列出禁忌或敏感的话题。
en: Few written guidelines outlining forbidden or sensitive topics exist.

zh: 更没有规定内容的备忘录。
en: No constant memoranda dictate content.

zh: 共产党的官员不会对节目流程的每一步都进行干预，也完全没有执行共产党的指令对已完成的节目进行删节的情况。
en: Party officials don't hover over each step of the process, and virtually no cutting of completed products is carried out on Party orders.

zh: 在表面上看，文案、导演和演员似乎可以自由地策划和制作他们的节目，而几乎不会受到监控。
en: On the surface, writers, directors, and performers seem free to plan and produce their shows with little or no supervision or monitoring.

zh: 那么这种管制体系究竟是如何将不合适的内容拒之门外的呢？
en: So how does such a system block offending content?

zh: 首要的一点是这种体系主要是反应性的。
en: First and foremost, the system is largely reactive.

zh: 定期碰头对节目进行评估的部门领导和审片委员会很少指定节目的内容。 他们仅仅是将发现的问题和建议下达给节目编导。
en: The department heads and oversight committees that meet to evaluate programming seldom dictate content, but merely pass their complaints and recommendations down to programming heads.

zh: 这种自上而下的层级是专断性的；较低层的员工极少有机会发表意见也无权上诉。
en: The top-down hierarchy is autocratic and arbitrary; lower levels have little collaborative input and no right of appeal.

zh: 严重违背上级意见的行为会导致处分或解雇。
en: Serious breaches can result in reprimands or dismissals.

zh: 事实上，这种体系在很大程度上已经成为一种自律。
en: In effect, the system has become largely self-regulating.

zh: 就我的经验来讲，99%的审查都是由文案和制片人自己执行的。
en: In my experience, 99% of all censorship occurs with the writers and producers themselves.

zh: 来自上级的零星投诉和警告使他们建立起一种对可接受内容的界限的直觉，这种直觉使他们的节目从开始制作时就不会有不合适的内容。
en: Sporadic complaints and warnings from above enable them to develop an intuitive sense for the boundaries of acceptable content, so they create shows that are free from offending material from the outset.

zh: 在缺少明确的内容指南的情况下，制片人往往会因为安全起见而使节目更保守。
en: The lack of explicit guidelines also keeps content more conservative than it need be, because producers tend to err on the safe side.

zh: 含糊但却普遍存在的恐吓是使电视台的职员循规蹈矩的主要因素。
en: Vague but pervasive intimidation is the main factor keeping TV personnel in line.

zh: 但还有一种力量也在为共产党的利益服务：中国根深蒂固的强调集体主义和团体导向行为的文化惯性。
en: But another force serves the Party's interests as well: the deep-seated Chinese cultural inertia that stresses collectivist, group-oriented behavior.

zh: 在这样的氛围中，含有政治导向错误的内容不但是种冒险，还是违反社会规范的。
en: In such an atmosphere, inclusion of politically incorrect content is not merely a risky move, but constitutes a breach of social decorum.

zh: 的确，在与中国电视人共事的过程中，我发现了一种微妙的，近乎本能的避免任何特别、新颖、非正统，更别说是颠覆性的内容的倾向。
en: Indeed, working daily with Chinese TV creators, I noticed a subtle, almost instinctive tendency to avoid any content or format that is unusual, novel, or unorthodox, never mind subversive.

zh: 这种情况的例外是当共产党发动如有关1997香港回归和最近的反法轮功的闪电战一类的宣传攻势时。 在这种时候，共产党就会下达指令制作含有某种特殊意识形态内容的节目。
en: The exceptions to this state of affairs are when the Party initiates a propaganda campaign, such as the one associated with the turnover of Hong Kong in 1997, or the more recent anti-Falun Gong blitzkrieg.

zh: 这些节目-称为"任务 " - 被制片人马马虎虎地对付过去，任务完成之后，节目流程又回到那种更为自下而上的模式。
en: At such times, directives are issued to produce programming with specific ideological content, and such shows - dubbed renwu (duties) - are perfunctorily overseen by TV producers, after which the more bottom-up mode returns.

zh: 许多��视制片人已经将这种控制内化成为一种潜意识的日常行为。 在大量的古装剧和肥皂剧中获得充分娱悦的观众也没有要求更为自由的政治内容。
en: Many TV producers have internalized these controls so well that they are an unconscious fact of life, and audiences now entertained by endless costume dramas and soap operas are not clamoring for freer political content.

zh: 如果没有什么巨大的变故，这种信息管制的方式会在21世纪的中国延续下去。
en: Barring some catastrophic change, this method of information control can be expected to continue well into the 21st century.

zh: 结核病、非传染性疾病和艾滋病的经验总结
en: TB, NCDs, and the Lessons of HIV

zh: 纽约 — — 全球健康再次成为人们的核心议题。
en: NEW YORK – Global health is once again in the spotlight.

zh: 9月，联大召开了两次高级别会议 — — 其中一次是探讨终结结核病（TB ） ， 而另外一次则是讨论抗击非传染性疾病（NCDs）的议题。
en: In September, the United Nations General Assembly convened two high-level meetings – one on ending tuberculosis (TB), and the other on fighting noncommunicable diseases (NCDs).

zh: 这是联合国有史以来首次在年度议程中如此高调地探讨两种健康危机。
en: It was the first time ever that the UN featured two health crises so prominently on its annual agenda.

zh: 但随着会议讨论的结束，全球卫生界现在必须集中精力，争取必要的政治承诺，以维护国际协调与规划的正常进行。
en: But with these discussions now over, the global health community must focus on securing the necessary political commitments to sustain international coordination and planning.

zh: 在抗击结核病和非传染性疾病方面值得放仿效的一种模式是抗击传染性艾滋病毒的策略。
en: One model worth emulating in the fight against both TB and NCDs is the approach taken to confront the HIV epidemic.

zh: 自2001年联大召开首届艾滋病毒/艾滋病会议以来，显著改变了这种疾病的轨迹。
en: Since 2001, when the UN General Assembly hosted its first meeting on HIV/AIDS, the trajectory of the disease has shifted dramatically.

zh: 今天，约有2，200万艾滋病毒携带者正在接受医治。
en: Today, some 22 million people living with HIV are receiving treatment.

zh: 结果是，每年因艾滋病而死亡的人数已经减少了一半 — — 从2003年的190万减少到2017年的94万 — — 而在几个遭受疫情打击最严重的国家新增感染率已经降低了接近半数。
en: As a result, annual AIDS deaths have fallen by half – from 1.9 million in 2003 to 940,000 in 2017 – while the rate of new infection has decreased by nearly half in several of the hardest-hit countries.

zh: 就像艾滋病毒/艾滋病一样，控制结核病和非传染性疾病的工作对中低收入国家而言负担沉重 — — 上述工作可以利用从艾滋病防治工作中所汲取的经验教训。
en: Efforts to control TB and NCDs – which, like HIV/AIDS, place a heavy burden on low- and middle-income countries – can leverage the lessons learned from the response to HIV.

zh: 有三条经验尤其值得一提。
en: Three lessons in particular stand out.

zh: 首先，随着全球艾滋病应对措施不断扩大，它所面临的双重挑战包括覆盖难以到达的社区，与此同时还要为越来越多接受治疗的患者继续提供支持。
en: First, as the global AIDS response expanded, it faced the dual challenge of including hard-to-reach communities while continuing to support a growing number of patients receiving treatment.

zh: 作为回应，艾滋病项目已逐渐演变为根据患者的偏好来提供服务。
en: In response, HIV programs have evolved to offer services shaped by the preferences of patients.

zh: 这样的新型护理模式还成功地使大量患者对医疗机构和人员造成的压力有所减轻。
en: Such novel models of care also relieve the burden of large numbers of patients on health facilities and health workers.

zh: 例如，在一些国家，不愿经常找医疗工作人员面诊的病情稳定的患者往往可以得到几个月的药物供应。
en: For example, in several countries, stable patients who prefer to visit their health-care provider less often receive multi-month supplies of medications.

zh: 在南非，多达430万艾滋病毒感染者正在接受治疗，处方药可以通过药剂师管理的自动售货机来获得补充。
en: In South Africa, where as many as 4.3 million people with HIV are receiving treatment, prescriptions can be refilled at pharmacist-managed vending machines.

zh: 在莱索托，人们可能要花几个小时才能赶到最近的医疗机构，艾滋病毒感染测试可以在家中进行，而且对于那些被发现感染艾滋病毒的人，社区医疗服务由当地医疗工作者负责提供。
en: In Lesotho, where people may live hours from a health facility, HIV testing is offered in the home and, for those found to have HIV infection, community treatment is supported by local health workers.

zh: 结核病和非传染性疾病同样可以采用类似的方法。
en: A similar approach could be taken for TB and NCDs.

zh: 对结核病而言，这可能意味着坚持治疗且并未出现耐药性反应的患者可以延长复检时间，而那些出现副反应或需要复杂治疗的患者则可以接受更密集的监护。
en: For TB, this might mean longer gaps between checkups for patients who adhere to treatment and show no signs of drug resistance, while those experiencing side effects or who require more complex treatments could receive more intensive care.

zh: 同样，控制状况良好的非传染性疾病患者如果并未表现出任何症状而且对药物治疗反应不错，可能只需要偶尔到医疗服务机构接受诊治，而那些病情更加复杂的患者则可以受益于更密切的医疗监测和咨询。
en: Likewise, patients with well-controlled NCDs who show no symptoms and are doing well on medications may need only occasional visits to a health-care provider, while those with more complicated cases could benefit from closer medical monitoring and counseling.

zh: 其次，艾滋病计划成功部分来源于设立了整个“级联护理”的总体目标 — — 包括诊断和治疗在内。
en: Second, HIV programs succeeded in part because they established goals for the entire “cascade of care” – from diagnosis to treatment.

zh: 举例来讲，由联合国艾滋病毒/艾滋病联合规划署（UNAIDS）制定的 “90-90-90”目标 — — 具体而言就是90%感染艾滋病毒的人能够得到确诊、90%已经确诊的人能够得到治疗，以及90%得到治疗的人病毒得到控制 — — 有助于集中协调全球艾滋病控制工作。
en: For example, the “90-90-90” targets set by the Joint United Nations Programme on HIV/AIDS (UNAIDS) – in which 90% of people living with HIV have been diagnosed, 90% of those diagnosed with HIV are on treatment, and 90% of those on treatment are virally suppressed – helped focus the global AIDS response.

zh: 事实上，模型表明如果上述目标得以实现，那么到2030年，艾滋病毒将不再成为一种公共卫生威胁。
en: In fact, models suggest that if these targets are achieved, HIV will no longer be a public-health threat by the year 2030.

zh: 设定目标对衡量进展和明确覆盖差距非常有效。
en: Setting targets is useful for benchmarking progress and identifying coverage gaps.

zh: 例如，在许多国家，艾滋病毒服务覆盖差距最大的领域在于诊断，尤其是针对男性和年轻人。
en: For example, in many countries, the largest gap in the coverage of HIV services is in diagnosis, particularly of men and young people.

zh: 结果是，许多计划现在为覆盖上述群体提供了新的选择权，如秘密进行工作场所测试以及自测。
en: As a result, many programs now offer new options to reach these groups, such as confidential workplace testing and self-testing.

zh: 另一种差距主要存在于某些国家被剥夺权利和受到指责的民众，例如与男性有性行为的男性。
en: Another gap is among populations that are disenfranchised and stigmatized in some countries, such as men who have sex with men.

zh: 级联目标可能同样有利于控制结核病和非传染性疾病。
en: Targets along the cascade could be similarly beneficial for controlling TB and NCDs.

zh: 例如，控制结核病伙伴关系已经提出针对结核病的90-90-90治疗目标，尽管这一倡议尚未得到广泛采用。
en: The Stop TB Partnership, for example, has proposed 90-(90)-90 treatment goals for the disease, although they have yet to be widely adopted.

zh: 对非传染性疾病而言，重点是实现联合国可持续发展目标3.4，该目标呼吁到2030年实现将因此类疾病造成的早亡减少1/3。
en: For NCDs, the focus is on achieving UN Sustainable Development Goal 3.4, which calls for a one-third reduction in premature deaths from such illnesses by 2030.

zh: 但后一个目标并未按照非传染性疾病诊断和治疗级联分解落实到位。
en: But the latter goal is not disaggregated along the NCD care cascade of diagnosis and treatment.

zh: 例如，成功实现下列目标将非常有益：包括非传染性疾病项目监控有多少高血压患者已得到诊断并接受治疗，在接受治疗的人中有多大比例已成功控制血压，以及将早亡病例降低到期望范围内将需要提供何种水平的医疗服务。
en: For example, it would be useful for programs to monitor how many people with high blood pressure have been diagnosed and placed on treatment, what proportion of those on treatment have achieved blood-pressure control, and what treatment level would be required to reduce premature deaths by the desired target.

zh: 最后，艾滋病工作得以拓展，得益于重塑诊断和治疗计划市场的强有力的宣传和合作。
en: Finally, the AIDS effort was able to expand as a result of strong advocacy and collaborations that reshaped markets for diagnostic and treatment programs.

zh: 通过预测药物需求、订单汇总和促进市场竞争，再加上密集宣传，决策者和医疗服务提供者才能够确保市场效率。
en: By forecasting medication needs, aggregating orders, and promoting competition, in combination with intense advocacy, policymakers and providers were able to secure market efficiencies.

zh: 由此产生的规模效应能够允许供应企业从低产量、高利润方案成功过渡到高产量、低利润的利润模式。
en: The resulting economies of scale allowed suppliers to shift from low-volume, high-margin solutions to high-volume, low-margin profit models.

zh: 结果是上述工作将艾滋病毒治疗的年度费用从2001年的每位患者超过1万美元降低到2016年的100美元都不到。
en: As a result, these efforts reduced the cost of annual HIV treatments from more than $10,000 per patient in 2001 to less than $100 in 2016.

zh: 同样，控制结核病和非传染性疾病将需要提高用药便利性，降低药物价格使人们负担得起。
en: Likewise, controlling TB and NCDs will require making medications more convenient and affordable.

zh: 虽然结核病对策一直利用战略伙伴关系来扩大覆盖范围，但依然存在着巨大的差距，其中尤为引人注目的是针对儿童和耐药型结核病患者的治疗领域。
en: While the TB response has leveraged strategic partnerships to expand coverage, large gaps remain, the largest being treatments for children and patients with drug-resistant TB.

zh: 对非传染性疾病而言，像 诺华、 辉瑞和印度制药企业西普拉已经竭尽全力向非洲患者提供价格合理的药物。
en: For NCDs, companies like Novartis, Pfizer, and the Indian drug maker Cipla have made efforts to bring affordable medicines to patients in Africa.

zh: 但虽然捐款可能有助于刺激初始需求，但实现降价则需要采取更加有针对性的市场举措。
en: But while donations may help stimulate initial demand, a more deliberate market approach will be needed to achieve price reductions.

zh: 2017年启动的多部门联盟有助于提高效率，但还需要给予额外的支持才能取得成功。
en: A multisectoral coalition launched in 2017 could help drive efficiencies, but it will need additional support to succeed.

zh: 世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞最近呼吁各国政府为抗击结核病及非传染性疾病而加强对医疗系统的领导和投资。
en: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, Director-General of the World Health Organization, recently called on governments to increase their leadership and investments in health systems to fight TB and NCDs.

zh: 但尽管毋庸置疑需要投入更多资源，它们必须辅之以扩大社区参与、指导规划以及扩大预防和治疗的合理战略。
en: But while more resources are no doubt needed, they must be accompanied by sound strategies that engage communities, guide programming, and scale up prevention and care.

zh: 最重要的是，因为人们已经掌握了艾滋病应对策略，因此已经没有必要白费力气做重复的工作。
en: Best of all, with the AIDS response blueprint already in hand, there is no need to reinvent the wheel.

zh: 黄热病归来
en: The Return of Yellow Fever

zh: 西雅图—最近的西非的埃博拉疫情爆发的恐怖尚未在人们脑海中散尽，寨卡病毒便崛起成为全球主要健康威胁之一，目前令南美、中美和加勒比地区研究者和医生们焦头烂额。
en: SEATTLE – Before the horrors of the latest Ebola outbreak in West Africa could even begin to fade from our minds, the Zika virus emerged as a major global health risk, and is now occupying researchers and doctors in South America, Central America, and the Caribbean.

zh: 但另一种病毒 — — 黄热病的致死人数正在迅速上升。
en: Yet the death toll from another virus is rising fast: yellow fever.

zh: 在非洲西南部，安哥拉正面临严峻的黄热病传染疫情 — — 这是30年来首次在这里爆发黄热病疫情。
en: In southwestern Africa, Angola is facing a serious yellow fever epidemic – its first in 30 years.

zh: 自去年12月黄热病病毒在安哥拉首都兼最大城市罗安达现身以来，已经夺走293人的生命，疑似传染病例2,267人。
en: Since the virus emerged in Luanda, Angola’s capital and most populous city, last December, it has killed 293 people and infected a suspected 2,267.

zh: 目前该病毒已经蔓延到安哥拉十八省的六个。
en: The virus has now spread to six of the country’s 18 provinces.

zh: 旅行者已经将黄热病带到了中国、民主刚果和肯尼亚。
en: Travelers have taken cases to China, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Kenya.

zh: 纳米比亚和赞比亚也处于高危预警中。
en: Namibia and Zambia are on high alert.

zh: 黄热病病毒由埃及伊蚊传播 — — 和寨卡病毒一样。
en: Yellow fever virus is transmitted by Aedes aegypti – the same mosquito that spreads the Zika virus.

zh: 其症状包括发热、肌肉疼痛、头痛、反胃、呕吐和疲劳。
en: Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, headache, nausea, vomiting, and fatigue.

zh: 至少一半的重症病例如果得不到治疗将在10—14天内死去。
en: At least half of untreated patients with severe cases of yellow fever die within 10-14 days.

zh: 好消息是，和寨卡和埃博拉不同，黄热病可以用有效疫苗控制，这种疫苗只需要一个月就可以形成终身免疫。
en: The good news is that, unlike Zika or Ebola, yellow fever can be controlled with an effective vaccine, which confers lifelong immunity within a month of administration.

zh: 此外，事实上接种也是安哥拉本月早些时候启动的国家响应计划的核心形式，该相应计划的目标是为罗安达省的640万多人接种黄热病疫苗。
en: And, indeed, vaccination forms the core of Angola’s National Response Plan, initiated early this year with the goal of administering the yellow fever vaccine to more than 6.4 million people in Luanda Province.

zh: 目前，在世界卫生组织、国际疫苗供应协调小组（International Coordinating Group for Vaccine Provision）和南非和巴西等其他国家的大力帮助下（它们供提供了735万剂疫苗 ） ， 90%的目标人群已经接种。
en: So far, nearly 90% of that target population has been vaccinated, thanks largely to the World Health Organization, the International Coordinating Group for Vaccine Provision, and other countries, including South Sudan and Brazil, which together made some 7.35 million doses of the vaccine available.

zh: 大规模接种方案阻止了黄热病的传播。
en: The mass vaccination effort has stemmed the spread of yellow fever.

zh: 但要战胜疫情，接种不但要在罗安达继续进行（该省还有150万人暴露在传染风险下 ） ， 还必须扩展到其他受影响省份。
en: But to end the outbreak, vaccination has to continue not only in Luanda, where an additional 1.5 million are at risk of infection, but also encompass other affected provinces.

zh: 这将是一个重大挑战。
en: This will be a major challenge.

zh: 一个关键问题是成本。
en: One key problem is cost.

zh: 2013年，非洲黄热病疫苗每剂成本为0.82美元 — — 这是大部分发展中国家无法承受的价格。
en: In 2013, the yellow fever vaccine cost $0.82 per dose in Africa – a price that most developing countries cannot afford.

zh: 一份2015年无国界医生组织的报告表明，目前黄热病疫苗几乎比2001年贵了70倍。
en: A 2015 report by Médecins Sans Frontières showed that the vaccine is now almost 70 times more expensive than it was in 2001.

zh: 更糟糕的是，即使各国不缺钱，也面临着严重的供给约束。
en: Making matters worse, even if countries have the money, there are serious supply constraints.

zh: 塞内加尔的达喀尔巴斯德研究所是全球仅有四家生产黄热病疫苗的机构之一，每年可以生产一千万剂，并且产能极难扩张。
en: Senegal’s Pasteur Institute of Dakar, one of only four facilities in the world producing yellow fever vaccines, manufactures about ten million doses per year, and the manufacturing process is extremely difficult to scale up.

zh: 此外，巴斯德研究所即将进行为期五个月的停产翻修，在此期间将无法生产更多疫苗。
en: Moreover, the Pasteur Institute is about to close down for a five-month renovation, during which it will be unable to produce more vaccine.

zh: 幸运的是，情况很快就会改善。
en: Fortunately, the situation is set to improve.

zh: 巴斯德研究所正在距离达喀尔30公里的迪亚姆尼亚迪奥（Diamniadio）建造新产能，预计可以在2019年将产量增加两倍。
en: The Pasteur Institute is constructing a new facility about 30 kilometers from Dakar, in Diamniadio, that is expected to triple production by 2019.

zh: 另一家黄热病疫苗生产商法国赛诺菲巴斯德公司（Sanofi Pasteur）也正在扩大产能。
en: Another yellow fever vaccine manufacturer, Sanofi Pasteur in France, is also expanding its manufacturing capacity.

zh: （另两家生产商位于巴西和俄罗斯 ） 。
en: (The other two manufacturers are based in Brazil and Russia.)

zh: 但是，目前供应十分紧张。
en: For now, however, supplies are tight.

zh: 一种扩大现有储量的方法是减小剂量（减小到常规剂量的五分之一 ） ， 实验表明这样仍然能够抵抗黄热病。
en: One way to stretch existing stores could be by administering a fractional dose (one-fifth of the usual dose), which has also been shown to protect against yellow fever.

zh: 但如果病毒进一步蔓延，即使这样也不足够。
en: But even that may not be enough if the virus spreads further.

zh: 而不幸的是，埃及伊蚊在受影响地区分布密度很高，这意味着传播风险也很高。
en: And, unfortunately, the high density of Aedes aegyptii mosquitoes in the affected areas means that the risk of transmission remains high.

zh: 如果缺乏应对黄热病传染经验、也没有疫苗生产能力的亚洲等地区出现疫情爆发，情况将特别难以控制。
en: An outbreak in a region like Asia, which lacks experience with a yellow fever epidemic and has no capacity to manufacture the vaccine, would be particularly difficult to control.

zh: 据疾病预警服务商ProMED创始人约翰·伍达尔（John P. Woodall）的称，如果黄热病在合适的气候条件下由适合的蚊子种类传播到亚洲的一些部分，那么在疫苗库存建立起来之前将会有数十万人被传染（并可能死去 ） 。
en: According to John P. Woodall, the founder of the disease-alert service ProMED, if yellow fever spreads to parts of Asia with the right climate and mosquito species, hundreds of thousands could be infected (and possibly die) before vaccine stocks are delivered.

zh: 黄热病病毒也有可能传播到美洲，美洲的伊蚊不但可以传播黄热病，也可以传播登革热、寨卡和奇昆古尼亚热。
en: The virus also has the potential to spread to the Americas, which are home to Aedes mosquito vectors that transmit not only yellow fever, but also dengue, Zika, and chikungunya.

zh: 目前，泛美卫生组织已经发布拉丁美洲黄热病预警。
en: Already, the Pan American Health Organization has declared an epidemiological alert for yellow fever in Latin America.

zh: 为了帮助遏制黄热病传播，国际卫生监管当局要求前往34个出现黄热病传染疫情的国家的旅客提供接种证明。
en: To help limit yellow fever’s spread, international health regulations require that all travelers to the 34 countries where yellow fever is endemic present a vaccination certificate.

zh: 但这一监管措施的实施取决于各国的能力，因此不可能十全十美。
en: But the implementation of those regulations depends on each country’s capacity, and is thus far from perfect.

zh: 目前，中国《国际卫生条例》国家归口单位报告了总共九例经实验室确认的来自安哥拉的输入性病例。
en: Already, a total of nine laboratory-confirmed cases of yellow fever imported from Angola have been reported by the National IHR Focal Point of China.

zh: 报告有从强制性接种黄热病疫苗的国家归来的未免疫旅行者黄热病传染病例突显出强制实施接种要求的必要性。
en: Reports of yellow fever infection in non-immunized travelers returning from a country where vaccination against the disease is mandatory highlights the need to reinforce the implementation of vaccination requirements.

zh: 世卫组织正在同多家合作伙伴和安哥拉政府密切合作遏制黄热病疫情爆发。
en: The WHO is working closely with several partners and the Angolan government to combat the current outbreak.

zh: 但是，一些卫生专家指出，还需要做更多事。
en: But, as some health experts have pointed out, even more needs to be done.

zh: 目前，世卫组织必须成立一个紧急委员会协调更广泛的国际响应，动员资金，并牵头促进迅速扩大疫苗产能，同时还要成立一个能够迅速有效地应对未来公共卫生危机的“常设紧急委员会 ” 。
en: The WHO now must convene an emergency committee to coordinate a broader international response, mobilize funds, and spearhead the rapid scale-up of vaccine production, as well as a “standing emergency committee” capable of addressing future public-health crises quickly and effectively.

zh: 转变叙利亚
en: Converting Syria

zh: 阿拉伯和以色列之间的和平需要一种综合的方式来达成，因为许多重大问题都是相互交织的。
en: An Arab-Israeli peace requires a comprehensive approach, because the problems at stake are intertwined.

zh: 没有一种整个阿拉伯世界的共识，不但诸如耶路撒冷和巴勒斯坦难民这样的关键性问题解决不了，而且任何一个被排除在和平进程之外的国家都肯定会坚持扮演革命力量的角色，继续制造地区性的不稳定。
en: Not only are key issues such as Jerusalem and Palestinian refugees insoluble without an all-Arab consensus, but any country that is left out of the peace process is bound to persist in its role as a revolutionary power bent on regional destabilization.

zh: 众所周知，以色列政府从来不喜欢同时与所有敌人进行和平谈判的想法，因为难以承受所需妥协的政治成本。
en: Admittedly, Israeli governments have never liked the idea of negotiating peace with all enemies simultaneously, if only because the political costs of the required concessions would be unbearable.

zh: 因此以色列实现和平的战略总是在两种愿景之间振荡：左派将巴勒斯坦为题视为当务之急，而右翼则倾向于寻求与阿拉伯大国之间的协议。
en: The Israeli strategy of peacemaking therefore oscillates between two visions: while the Israeli left gives priority to the Palestinian problem, the Israeli right prefers pursuing a settlement with the big Arab powers.

zh: 目前的以巴和谈及美国拒绝与叙利亚进行谈判表明我们又重新回到了“巴勒斯坦为先”的理念上。
en: The current Israeli-Palestinian peace talks and the American veto on negotiations with Syria indicate that we have returned to the “Palestine first” concept.

zh: 但成功的机会却是微乎其微。
en: But the prospects of success are desperately dim.

zh: 由于美国人仍然不愿进行克林顿式的倾力斡旋，所以各方看起来都不能满足彼此达成协议的最低要求。
en: With the Americans still refraining from engaging in a Clinton-like level of committed mediation, the parties look to be incapable of meeting each other’s minimal requirements for a settlement.

zh: 他们的失败会给整个地区造成严重的后果。
en: Their failure would have dire consequences for the entire region.

zh: 叙利亚—伊朗—哈马斯－真主党轴心会更大胆地挑战美国在该地区的领导权。 并且随着巴勒斯坦总统阿巴斯被挫败，第三次抗暴运动很可能会出现。
en: The Syria-Iran-Hamas-Hezbollah axis would be emboldened in its challenge to American leadership in the region, and, with Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas humbled and defeated, a third Intifada would be a likely scenario.

zh: 因此，将叙利亚这个伊朗的盟友和哈马斯、真主党等的资助国从战争等式中删除就变得尤为重要。
en: It is therefore vitally important to take Syria, an ally of Iran and the patron of spoilers such as Hamas and Hezbollah, out of the war equation.

zh: 但这需要以色列和美国作出重大改变。
en: But this requires that both Israel and the United States change course.

zh: 叙利亚对应邀加入美国主导的与以色列的和解进程表现出浓厚的兴趣。
en: Syria has a keen interest in being invited into an US-led settlement with Israel.

zh: 阿拉伯各国对以色列最近对叙利亚领土实施的神秘空袭保持缄默反映了该国在阿拉伯世界被孤立的状态―这种孤立让叙利亚人极不舒服。
en: The muted response of the Arab states to Israel’s recent mysterious air raid on its territory reflects its isolation within the Arab world – an isolation with which the Syrians are extremely uncomfortable.

zh: 大马士革的社会党政权有着两项重大的发展经历：Hafez al-Assad将戈兰高地输给了以色列，和他的儿子Bashar失去了黎巴嫩。
en: The Ba’athist regime in Damascus is marked by two major formative experiences: Hafez al-Assad’s loss of the Golan Heights to Israel, and his son Bashar’s loss of Lebanon.

zh: 收复戈兰高地、确立叙利亚在黎巴嫩的特殊利益并与美国达成和解是该政权至关重要的目标也是Bashar在国内巩固其合法性的最佳方式。
en: Recovering the Golan, gaining recognition of Syria’s special interests in Lebanon, and reconciling with America are thus vital objectives for the regime and the best way that Bashar al-Assad can boost his legitimacy at home.

zh: 被重新纳入到阿拉伯共识中及海湾各君主政体在它放弃与伊朗和真主党的什叶派联盟后对其的财政支持，对叙利亚而言是巨大的收获。
en: Syria’s readmission into the Arab consensus and financial support from the Gulf monarchies for abandoning the Shi’a alliance with Iran and Hezbollah would also be significant gains.

zh: Bashar也许缺乏他父亲那样的敏锐，但他也明白一个简单的道理：与以色列和解是它必须付出的代价。
en: Bashar may lack his father’s acumen, but he, too, knows a simple truth: peace with Israel is the price to pay.

zh: 现在的问题仍然是Bashar是否明白和平不仅仅关乎收复戈兰高地，也有赖于和以色列关系的正常化，而这一点正是他的父亲所抗拒的。
en: The question remains whether Bashar understands that peace is not only about regaining the Golan, but also about normalization of relations with Israel, which his father was reluctant to allow.

zh: 老阿萨德担心开放的边界和冲突政治的终结可能削弱他的一党专制。
en: The old Assad feared that open borders and the end of the politics of conflict might erode his one-party system.

zh: 因此和平需要一定程度上的政治和社会经济变革从而减少军事冒险主义的野心。
en: Peace thus requires a degree of political and socioeconomic change to diminish the appetite for military adventurism.

zh: 大马士革的转变不仅仅是可能的，也是与地区和平休戚相关的。
en: A Damascene conversion is not only possible, but is also vital for regional peace.

zh: 现在最现实的情景就是一场叙利亚、哈马斯和真主党三方对以色列的战争。
en: The most realistic scenario is now a three-front war pitting Israel against Syria, Hamas, and Hezbollah.

zh: 但叙－以和平将会如同在叙利亚和伊朗之间插入一只楔子，切断真主党的武器供应线并使稳定黎巴嫩的重要任务能够成功。
en: But a Syrian-Israeli peace would drive a wedge between Syria and Iran, thereby cutting off Hezbollah’s lines of arms supply while allowing the vital task of stabilizing Lebanon to succeed.

zh: 使叙利亚摆脱伊朗人的死亡拥抱的唯一办法就是将其引进一项区域性的和平计划。
en: The only way to extricate Syria from the fatal Iranian embrace is to draw it into a regional scheme for peace.

zh: 可恰恰是因为它的孤立状态和社会党政权偏执的特点，叙利亚人很可能满足不了美国的和谈条件：放弃它们目前的流氓联盟和对恐怖主义的支持。
en: Alas, precisely because of their isolation and the Ba’athist regime’s paranoiac nature, the Syrians are unlikely to meet the US condition for peace talks: abandoning their current rogue alliances and their marriage with terror.

zh: 但大马士革人的转变只能是谈判的结果，而非对他们的先决条件。
en: But a Damascene conversion can only be the outcome of negotiations, not a prerequisite for them.

zh: 那种认为阿－以和平进程需要在叙利亚道路和巴勒斯坦途径之间选择的观点是一种危险的谬论。
en: The idea that the Arab-Israeli peace process requires choosing between a Syrian or a Palestinian track has proved to be a dangerous fallacy.

zh: 巴勒斯坦人和叙利亚人都不会甘愿被排除在外。
en: Neither the Palestinians nor the Syrians will acquiesce to their exclusion.

zh: 国际关系中的革命力量往往对现状极为不满以至于要不惜一切代价破坏它。
en: A revolutionary force in international relations is one whose level of dissatisfaction with the status quo is such that it works to undermine it at any price.

zh: 除了评估巴以谈判的进展，布什总统召集的十一月中东会议还应该开始为以色列和叙利亚的谈判搭建平台。 同时还应该设立一个泛地区的论坛，该论坛对于行动和接触都应该有经各方同意的明确规则。
en: In addition to reviewing the state of the Israeli-Palestinian negotiations, the November Middle East conference that President George W. Bush has called should begin to build a platform for an Israeli-Syrian negotiating track and a region-wide forum where clear rules of conduct and engagement are agreed by all.

zh: 当然，这次会议不会终止大马士革－德黑兰轴心。
en: Of course, this conference will not bring an end to the Damascus-Tehran axis.

zh: 但如果��国能够表现出一种与使其目前在各条战线上都疲于应付的作为全然不同的大国风范，它就可以削弱这个轴心的基础。
en: But if the US exercises a brand of statesmanship different from the one that has so far put it on the defensive on almost every front, it could start to eat away at the foundations of that axis.

zh: 服刑人员出口
en: Convicts for Export

zh: 新德里 — — 中国发明了一项新策略，来缓解监狱人满为患的压力： 雇佣服刑人员在发展中国家的海外项目中充当劳动力。
en: NEW DELHI – China has devised a novel strategy to relieve pressure on its overcrowded prisons: employ convicts as laborers on overseas projects in the developing world.

zh: 这种状况暴露了中国糟糕人权记录的另外一个侧面，也就是当涉及到中国公司的海外经营时，政府无法严格执行自己制定的法律。
en: The practice has exposed another facet of China’s egregious human-rights record, which, when it comes to the overseas operations of Chinese companies, includes the government’s failure to enforce its own regulations.

zh: 中国每年处决的犯人是世界其他国家总和的三倍。
en: China executes three times as many people every year as the rest of the world combined.

zh: 据大赦国际2007年估计，中国秘密处决的罪犯平均“每天约为22人 ” 。
en: Amnesty International has estimated that, in 2007, China secretly executed on average “around 22 prisoners every day.”

zh: 除了是世界执行人数最多的国家外，中国监狱的服刑人数也居世界首位。
en: In addition to being the world’s leading executioner, China has one of its largest prison populations.

zh: 2009年由伦敦英皇学院国际监狱研究中心编纂的《世界监狱人口列表》将中国监狱的总收容人数确定为157万 — — 比爱沙尼亚、几内亚比绍、毛里求斯、斯威士兰、特立尼达和多巴哥、斐济货卡塔尔的人口还要多。
en: The 2009 “World Prison Population List” compiled by the International Center for Prison Studies at King’s College, London, put the total number of inmates in Chinese jails at 1.57 million – larger than the population of Estonia, Guinea-Bissau, Mauritius, Swaziland, Trinidad & Tobago, Fiji, or Qatar.

zh: 向海外基建项目强制派遣服刑人员提出了有关中国人权记录的新问题。
en: The forced dispatch of prisoners to work on overseas infrastructure projects raises new issues regarding China’s human-rights record.

zh: 它也为中国因为货物倾销而饱受批评的的贸易和投资政策增加了一项新的元素。
en: It also adds a new element — the dumping of convicts — to its trade and investment policy, which has been much criticized for dumping goods.

zh: 例如，数千名中国服刑人员被强制派往驻斯里兰卡的中国国有企业项目工地工作，中国试图增强自己在印度洋的区域地位，而斯里兰卡在这方面的战略意义非常重要。
en: Thousands of Chinese convicts, for example, have been pressed into service on projects undertaken by state-run Chinese companies in Sri Lanka, a strategically important country for China as it seeks to enhance its regional position in the Indian Ocean.

zh: 在为斯里兰卡政府提供攻击性武器系统，帮助这个国家结束了长达10年的内战后，中国得到了建设港口、铁路和其他基础设施的项目作为回报。
en: After providing Sri Lanka’s government with offensive weapon systems that helped end the country’s decades-long civil war, China has been rewarded with port-building, railroad, and other infrastructure projects.

zh: 中国服刑人员也被派到了马尔代夫，中国政府正在那里的几个岛上建设4，000栋房屋，作为获取影响力的政府对政府的“礼物 ” 。
en: Chinese convicts also have been dispatched to the Maldives, where the Chinese government is building 4,000 houses on several different islands as a government-to-government “gift” to win influence.

zh: 但到目前为止，中国还未能说服马尔代夫总统租借700个马尔代夫无人小岛中的一个，建设中国海军的小型基地。
en: So far, however, China has failed to persuade the country’s president to lease it one of the 700 uninhabited Maldivian islands for use as a small base for the Chinese navy.

zh: 中国企业在非洲等海外项目中的经营惯例是将当地工人人数控制在最低限度，而绝大多数劳动力则从中国国内抽调，这些人员中有时就包括假释的服刑人员。
en: Chinese companies’ operating practice for overseas projects, including in Africa, is to keep the number of local workers to a bare minimum and to bring in much of the workforce from China, some of which comprises convicts “freed” on parole for project-related overseas work.

zh: 服刑人员和其他中国劳工一样，居住在项目工地的附近。
en: Convict laborers, like the rest of the Chinese workforce on such projects, are housed near the project site.

zh: 这样的话，如果有任何服刑工人逃跑，那么他在陌生环境中很容易被发现。
en: That way, if any convict worker escaped, he would be easy to find in an alien setting.

zh: 按理说，这样的做法与中国商务部2006年8月颁布的法规不符，之所以颁布这项法规是因为当时赞比亚的中国国有铜矿发生爆炸，51名赞比亚工人丧生导致爆发了针对中国企业的集体抗议活动。
en: In theory, such practices run counter to regulations promulgated by the Chinese commerce ministry in August 2006, in response to a backlash against Chinese businesses in Zambia following the death of 51 Zambian workers in an explosion at a Chinese-owned copper mine.

zh: 上述法规号召企业实行“本地化 ” ， 包括雇佣当地员工，尊重当地习俗并遵守各项安全规范。
en: These regulations called for “local­ization,” including hiring local workers, respecting local customs, and adhering to safety norms.

zh: 在2007年访问非洲八国期间，中国主席胡锦涛在与企业界的会晤中强调了在当地开展业务时企业责任的重要性。
en: During an eight-nation 2007 African tour, Chinese President Hu Jintao made a point of meeting with Chinese businesses to stress the importance of corporate responsibility in their local dealings.

zh: 此外，2006年10月，国务院 — — 也就是中国内阁发布了9项指令，命令中国企业尤其要“注意保护环境 ” 、 “支持当地社会和国民的民生事业”和“维护中国的良好形象和企业信誉。 ”
en: Moreover, in October 2006, the State Council – China’s cabinet – issued nine directives ordering that Chinese overseas businesses, among other things, “pay attention to environmental protection,” “support local community and people’s livelihood cause,” and “preserve China’s good image and its good corporate reputation.”

zh: 但中国有时出台法律只是为了减少国外的批评，因此除非某个案例引发了国际关注，否则也很少会真正执行。
en: But Chinese regulations are sometimes promulgated simply to blunt external criticism, and thus are seldom enforced, except when a case attracts international attention.

zh: 比如，中国在2003年通过了环境影响评估法，2008年又接着出台了允许公众参与上述评估的“临时措施 ” 。
en: For example, in 2003 China enacted a law on environmental-impact assessments, which was followed in 2008 by “provisional measures” to permit public participation in such assessments.

zh: 但中国领导人仍然更加热衷于推动出口和经济增长，而不是保护国内的水源和空气。
en: Yet Chinese leaders remain more zealous about promoting exports and economic growth than in protecting the country’s air and water.

zh: 同样，国务院2006年对中国海外企业的九项指令更多地服从于推动出口和增长的目标，即使这种增长增加了当地社会的环境和社会成本也在所不惜。
en: Similarly, the State Council’s 2006 nine directives to Chinese overseas companies have been subordinated to the drive for exports and growth, even when it imposes environmental and social costs on local communities abroad.

zh: 事实上，作为政府“走出去”政策的组成部分，囊括海外合同、促进出口的中国企业可以拿到丰厚的奖励。
en: Indeed, as part of the government’s “going global” policy, Chinese companies are offered major incentives and rewards for bagging overseas contracts and boosting exports.

zh: 服刑劳工的使用为这项政策增添了令人不安的新问题。
en: The use of convict laborers adds a disturbing new dimension to this strategy.

zh: 但即使在服刑人员参与中国海外开发项目之前，有些中国项目，特别是大坝修建计划，已经在博茨瓦纳、缅甸、巴基斯坦、加纳和苏丹卷入了与当地社区的冲突。
en: But even before convicts became part of China’s overseas development effort, some Chinese projects, especially dam-building schemes, were embroiled in disputes with local communities in Botswana, Burma, Pakistan, Ghana, and Sudan.

zh: 实际上，几枚小型炸弹不到三个月前在缅甸的密松大坝工地爆炸，中国企业在饱受叛乱蹂躏的克钦邦修建大坝需要淹没成千上万农民和渔民赖以生存的大片的土地。
en: In fact, several small bombs exploded less than three months ago at the site of Burma’s Myitsone Dam, whose construction by a Chinese company in insurgency-torn Kachin State is displacing thousands of subsistence farmers and fishermen by flooding a wide swath of land.

zh: 中国企业仅靠自身的力量无法释放数千名服刑人员，更不用说为他们办理护照和出国许可证。
en: Chinese companies cannot get thousands of prisoners released on their own, let alone secure passports and exit permits for them.

zh: 很显然要求服刑人员参与海外项目的真正实施者是中国政府。
en: It is obvious that the practice of pressing convicts into service on overseas projects has been instituted at the instance of the Chinese government.

zh: 除非中国政府以尊重基本人权和法治的方式去对待本国和其他国家的公民，否则不大可能得到它在国际舞台上希望得到的那种尊重。
en: Until the Chinese government’s treatment of its own citizens and those of other countries is guided by respect for basic human rights and the rule of law, China is unlikely to command the respect that it seeks on the world stage.

zh: 认真对待金砖国家
en: Taking the BRICS Seriously

zh: 北京—本月早些时候的一个凉爽的夜晚，我沿着莫斯科河泛舟而下，与中国人民代表大会外事委员会主任委员窃窃私语。
en: BEIJING – Sailing down the Moscow River on a cool evening earlier this month, I found myself in intense conversation with the chair of the Foreign Affairs Committee of the Chinese National People’s Congress (NPC).

zh: 与此同时，南非和巴西议员们正在欣赏俄罗斯音乐，在导游的指引下观赏景色。
en: Meanwhile, South African and Brazilian parliamentarians were swaying to Russian music and a guide pointed out the sights.

zh: 金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度、中国和南非）第一次议会论坛在欢乐的气氛中落下了帷幕。
en: The first parliamentary forum of the BRICS countries – Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa – had come to a convivial conclusion.

zh: 会议开始前，许多人质疑五国议会能否找到共同立场。
en: Before the meeting opened, many wondered whether the five parliaments could possibly find common ground.

zh: 暴躁又吵闹的印度人民院（Lok Sabha）总是充斥着争论和破坏，它与端庄高雅、跟随中共决策亦步亦趋的中国人大能有什么共同点？
en: What on earth could India’s fractious and rumbustious Lok Sabha, with its impassioned debates and disruptions, have in common with China’s decorous NPC, a rigorously controlled echo chamber for Communist Party decisions?

zh: 许多人认为，同为新金砖国家集团成员并未提供足够的合作基础。
en: Membership in the new BRICS grouping, many believed, did not provide a strong enough basis for cooperation.

zh: 组团伊始时，这类质疑在金砖国家内部也存在，有人对金砖国家嗤之以鼻，认为它只是某家投资银行发明出来的国际组织。
en: Such skepticism has been leveled at the BRICS grouping itself from its inception, with some dismissing it as the only international organization invented by an investment bank.

zh: 具体而言 ， “ 金砖四国”一词是十多年前由时任高盛公司分析师吉姆·奥尼尔（Jim O’Neill）所提出，最初，南非并没有被算进这一主要发展中经济体行列。
en: Specifically, the term BRIC was coined more than a decade ago by then-Goldman Sachs analyst Jim O’Neill, who did not initially count South Africa among the ranks of the major emerging economies.

zh: 但俄罗斯总统从一开始就喜欢这个观点，在2006年建议四国应该定期会晤。
en: But Russian President Vladimir Putin liked the idea from the start, and suggested in 2006 that the four countries should meet regularly.

zh: 很快，金砖四国就正式组团，并计划每年召开一次峰会。
en: The grouping was soon formalized, with annual summits planned.

zh: 2011年南非也加入其中，巩固了金砖国家对全球南方国家的代表，只有俄罗斯是北方国家。
en: South Africa joined in 2011, solidifying the BRICS’ presence across the global South, with only Russia in the North.

zh: 事实上，正因如此，俄罗斯在这一集团中拥有有趣的核心地位。
en: In fact, this is why Russia’s centrality to the enterprise is so intriguing.

zh: 俄罗斯直到最近都是G-8成员国 — — 北半球最重要的经济集团 — — 这使得它与传统上一直被视为发展中国家在全球论坛上的领导者的其他四个金砖成员国若即若离。
en: Given that Russia was, until recently, a member of the G-8 – the northern hemisphere’s most important economic grouping – it would seem to have little affinity with the other four BRICS members, which have traditionally been viewed as the leading developing-country voices in global forums.

zh: 但是，普京紧紧抓住金砖国家的概念，表明了他渴望构建另一个全球平台、宣扬另一种世界观。
en: But, by seizing on the idea of the BRICS, Putin revealed his desire to build an alternative global platform – and advance an alternative worldview.

zh: 金砖国家组织的不断深化让许多国际观察家感到震惊。
en: The continual deepening of the BRICS enterprise has caught many international observers by surprise.

zh: 除了每年一次的峰会 — — 这一峰会所产生的联合声明涵盖了所有重大全球问题，如和平与安全、联合国改革等 — — 金砖国家还召开了外交部长会议、涉足了智库咨询。
en: In addition to their annual summits – which have produced joint declarations covering every major global issue, from questions of peace and security to United Nations reform – the BRICS have conducted foreign ministers’ meetings and engaged in think-tank consultations.

zh: 此外，金砖国家还成立了总部设在上海、由印度最著名私人银行家为首脑的新开发银行。
en: Moreover, the BRICS have created the New Development Bank, headquartered in Shanghai and headed by one of India’s most respected private-sector bankers.

zh: 从这一背景看，最近召开的议会论坛只是金砖国家不断扩大的机构和机制建设的最新动作。 这一系列动作正在让金砖国家成为不容忽视的国际集团。
en: Seen against this background, the recent parliamentary forum is just the newest in an expanding array of institutions and mechanisms that are establishing the BRICS as an international grouping that cannot be ignored.

zh: 金砖国家的出现恰逢二战后建立的国际体系未来日益受到质疑时。
en: The BRICS are emerging at a time when the future of the international system that arose in the immediate aftermath of World War II is increasingly being called into question.

zh: 在经历了两次世界大战、各种内战、殖民镇压、大屠杀和广岛核爆后，当时的远见卓识的政治家认定，基于联合国宪章和联合机构的自由国际主义（liberal internationalism）是防止大屠杀重现的唯一办法。
en: After two world wars, numerous civil wars, colonial oppression, and the horrors of the Holocaust and Hiroshima, the far-sighted statesmen of the time decided that liberal internationalism, based on the UN charter and allied institutions, was the only way to prevent more carnage.

zh: 而事实上，其实年来你这一体系基本上达到了它的目标。
en: And, indeed, for seven decades, that system has largely achieved its goals.

zh: 它从整体上确保了全球和平，尽管也将许多冲突转移到了外围。
en: It has broadly ensured global peace, although at the cost of shifting many conflicts to the periphery.

zh: 它不但让发展中世界获益良多，也确保了去殖民地化、增进了发展，并为协调新兴国家的声音找到了出路。
en: And it did not benefit only the developed world; it also ensured decolonization, promoted development, and found ways to accommodate the voices of newly emerging countries.

zh: 但看起来现有安排已有所欠缺。
en: But it seems that existing arrangements are no longer adequate.

zh: 中国和印度追求与它们的经济实力相称的全球影响力；巴西和南非正在崛起为洲级大国，而以碳氢化合物为底气的俄罗斯也不满于它在西方体系中的边缘地位。
en: China and India are seeking global influence commensurate with their economic weight; Brazil and South Africa are emerging as continental powerhouses, and hydrocarbon-fueled Russia is chafing at its status on the margins of the Western system.

zh: 毫不奇怪，许多人认为当前体系马上就要发生天翻地覆的变化了。
en: Not surprisingly, many think that the current system is ready for a makeover.

zh: 但是，现有世界列强不会轻易放弃影响力。
en: The existing world powers, however, will not cede their influence so easily.

zh: 中国在世界银行和国际货币基金组织（IMF）的投票权与比利时等量齐观，这实在是荒谬可笑。
en: It is absurd that China’s voting power in the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund is the same as Belgium’s.

zh: 但G-20意欲在这些机构中建立发达经济体与新兴和转型国家实现权力平等的努力遇到了瓶颈。
en: But the G-20’s effort to create parity in these institutions between the advanced economies and the emerging and transition countries has ground to a halt.

zh: 事实上，尽管美国领导人在技术上已经同意了IMF的投票改革，但美国国会仍拒绝批准。
en: Indeed, although US leaders technically agreed to IMF voting reforms, the US Congress has so far refused to ratify them.

zh: 值得注意的是，印度和巴西等国家与（比如）一个世纪前的德国和日本不同，它们并不追求颠覆世界秩序。
en: It is important to note that countries like India and Brazil – unlike, say, Germany and Japan a century ago – are not seeking to overturn the world order.

zh: 它们想要的只是高等级舞台的一席之地。
en: All they want is a place at the high table.

zh: 如果把这条路封死，它们就别无选择，只能自起炉灶 — — 尽管印度、巴西和南非有理由质疑中国领导的世界秩序是否能比当前秩序有所改进。
en: Barring that, they have little choice but to build their own – though India, Brazil, and South Africa have reason to wonder if a Chinese-led world order would be an improvement on the current one.

zh: 金砖国家的反应不难理解，也令人不安。
en: The BRICS’ response is both understandable and disquieting.

zh: 随着国家获得经济和军事实力，就会开始大秀地缘政治“肌肉 ” 。
en: As countries acquire economic and military power, they start exercising their geopolitical muscle, too.

zh: 世界秩序的提倡者的挑战在于在一个框架内容纳新兴力量，这个框架包括可预测的普世规则以及确保所有人都能获得与其规模、能力和对全球体系的贡献相适应的公平交易的全球结构。
en: The challenge for advocates of world order is to accommodate emerging powers within a framework of universal, predictable rules and global structures that ensure everyone a fair deal, appropriate for their size, capabilities, and contributions to the international system.

zh: 与创立1945年后世界秩序的老一辈相比，今天的世界领导人似乎缺少政治家风度、宽广的襟怀和慷慨精神。
en: Today’s world leaders appear to lack the statesmanship, the breadth of vision, and the generosity of spirit of those who created the post-1945 world order.

zh: 他们顽固地执着于他们所主导的体系、不向新来者敞开大门，这让外部力量别无选择。
en: By clinging stubbornly to the system they dominate and barring the door to new entrants, they have left those outside little choice.

zh: 金砖国家有一个共同点：它们都被排斥在它们认为自己所应该拥有的当前世界秩序中的地位之外。
en: What the BRICS countries have in common is their exclusion from the places they believe they deserve in the current world order.

zh: 这也许并不足以成为建立可信的新国际体系的基础。
en: That may not look like enough of a basis for a credible new international system.

zh: 但是，金砖国家的经济有望在2050年超越G-7，目前的外表也许具有欺骗性。
en: But, with their economies on course to overtake those of the G-7 before 2050, looks can be deceiving.

zh: 事实是，如果金砖国家无法在现有国际体系中取得领导地位，它们必然会构建自己的国际体系。
en: The fact is that, if the BRICS are not allowed to help lead within the existing global system, they will inevitably create their own.

zh: 这对1945年建立的世界秩序意味着什么？ 诸君大可开动脑筋自己想象。
en: What that might mean for the world order established in 1945 is anybody’s guess.

zh: 人类城市
en: The Human City

zh: 新加坡 — — 构成全球治理网络的错综复杂的国际组织已经疏远低效到没有人期待取得成果。
en: SINGAPORE – The tangled web of international organizations that constitutes global governance has become so remote and ineffective that few count on it to deliver results anymore.

zh: 如今经过几十年的地盘之争和自我边缘化，这些国际组织必须团结起来完成可持续城市化这项日益紧迫的全球任务。
en: Now, after decades of turf wars and self-marginalization, international organizations must rally around an increasingly pressing global priority: sustainable urbanization.

zh: 世界正在经历史无前例、不可逆转的城市化浪潮，到2030年全球城市人口比例将达60 % 。
en: The world is undergoing an unprecedented and irreversible wave of urbanization, with the share of the global population living in cities set to reach 60% by 2030.

zh: 但飞速城市化推升了工业化石燃料消耗和家庭用水量，同时增加了耕地稀缺地区人们的食品需求。
en: But rapid urbanization is driving up industrial fossil-fuel consumption and household water consumption, and is increasing demand for food in areas where arable land is scarce.

zh: 总之，当前的城市化轨迹是不可持续的。
en: In short, the current urbanization trajectory is not sustainable.

zh: 但改变现状的努力仍然严重不足。
en: But existing efforts to alter the situation remain woefully inadequate.

zh: 尽管联合国大会责成其人居机构联合国人居署推进可持续城市化，但该机构影响力无法确保这一关键问题进入全球议程。
en: While the United Nations General Assembly has tasked its agency for human settlements, UN-HABITAT, with promoting sustainable urbanization, the agency lacks the influence to ensure that this vital issue makes it onto the global agenda.

zh: 此外，尽管联合国机构、非政府组织、企业公民计划和其他慈善组织等国际发展机构的干预行为日益集中在人口稠密的城市，但各机构却很少相互协调形成合力。
en: Moreover, international development players – including UN agencies, NGOs, corporate citizenship programs, and other charitable organizations – rarely coordinate their activities, even though their interventions are increasingly concentrated in densely populated cities.

zh: 鉴于促进可持续城市化及增进协调可以推动妇女权利、气候变化、青年失业及扫除文盲等众多其他领域的合作，因此官方必须重点推进可持续城市化运动。
en: Given that promoting sustainable urbanization and improving coordination would bolster progress in other priority areas (including women’s rights, climate change, youth unemployment, and literacy), sustainable urbanization must become a bureaucratic priority.

zh: 同时可持续城市化必须辅之以技术创新，引导资金流向使城市更宜居、高效、可持续发展的创新成果的研究及分配领域。
en: And it must be complemented by a technological disruption, with investments channeled toward developing and distributing innovations that would make cities more livable, efficient, and sustainable.

zh: 其实，产能建材及零排放交通等众多有用的创新成果已经存在；要做的仅仅是向最���要的人推广它们。
en: In fact, many useful innovations, such as energy-generating building materials and zero-emissions transportation, already exist; they simply need to be made accessible to those who need them most.

zh: 小型水过滤系统、便携式心脏监视器和低成本平板电脑等设备已经显著改善了世界最贫困民众的生活，并在一定程度上改善了经济竞争环境。
en: Devices like small-scale water-filtration systems, portable heart monitors, and low-cost tablet computers are already dramatically improving the lives of the world’s poorest citizens and helping to level the economic playing field.

zh: 能否建立从多样化源头向全球城市人口传播重要知识技术的新联盟将会决定今后全球执政的影响力。
en: The future impact of global governance rests on forging new alignments that facilitate the flow of vital knowledge and technologies from an increasingly diverse array of sources to urban populations worldwide.

zh: 强化可持续城市生活的工具不再单纯地由北向南、由西向东。
en: The tools needed to make urban life more sustainable are no longer flowing only from North to South and West to East.

zh: 中国现已成为太阳能光伏电池最大的出口国，而环保技术产业园正在阿拉伯世界如雨后春笋般崛起。
en: China has taken the lead in exporting solar photovoltaic cells, while clean-tech parks are arising even in the Arab world.

zh: 政府、企业、供应链管理者、企业公民战略师、非政府组织和其他各种力量应全力降低碳排放，同时利用各项资源为实现可持续城市化助力。
en: Governments, companies, supply-chain managers, corporate-citizenship strategists, NGOs, and others should commit to reducing their carbon footprints and to leveraging their resources to contribute to sustainable urbanization.

zh: 所有经济领域不断出现诸如此类的贡献机会。
en: Opportunities to make such contributions are appearing constantly – and across all sectors.

zh: 比方说在建筑领域，承包商与实验室结成伙伴，对隔热性能更强并吸收热能驱动制冷系统的材料展开测试。 公用事业企业运用全新软件工具在家庭和办公室安装智能电表。
en: In construction, for example, contractors are forming partnerships with labs to test materials that better reflect heat while absorbing energy to power cooling systems, and utility companies are leveraging new software tools to deploy smart meters in homes and offices.

zh: 纽约和西雅图两座美国城市对新建筑物能效标准做出了史无前例的提升。
en: Two US cities – New York and Seattle – have raised efficiency standards for new construction to record levels.

zh: 同样，汽车制造企业、移动服务企业和地方政府正联手推动机动车的高效非占有制，希望借此让交通运输持续性更高。
en: Similarly, automobile manufacturers, mobility-services companies, and local governments are working together to advance sustainable transportation by providing incentives for efficient non-ownership of vehicles.

zh: 拼车也因此日渐成为柏林等城市的流行趋势。
en: As a result, carpooling is gaining prevalence in cities like Berlin.

zh: 此外，麻省理工学院研发出折叠电动车CityCar，4辆电动车仅仅占据一个传统的停车位。
en: Furthermore, MIT has developed the foldable electric CityCar, four of which can fit into a conventional parking space.

zh: 在去年召开的里约+20峰会上，8家最大的多边开发银行承诺投入1750亿美元用于可持续交通建设。
en: At last year’s Rio+20 conference, the eight largest multilateral development banks pledged $175 billion to develop sustainable transportation.

zh: 信息技术也可以缓解交通系统的压力。
en: Information technology can also reduce stress on the transportation system.

zh: 比方说，新加坡充分利用目前已接近完工的光纤网络系统，通过引入一系列劳动者远程办公激励举措来缓解城市的交通拥堵。
en: For example, Singapore is harnessing its near-complete fiber-optic network to reduce urban congestion by introducing a spate of measures encouraging workers to telecommute.

zh: 相关措施收效后将可能出现大批自给自足的卫星城，在进一步节约交通能耗的同时培育更积极主动的公民社会。
en: As these measures take effect, self-sufficient satellite towns will likely develop, reducing transportation-related energy consumption further, while fostering a more active civil society.

zh: 在另外一个领域新加坡也一马当先：那就是再生饮用水的生产和销售。
en: Singapore is leading the way in another area as well: production and distribution of potable recycled water.

zh: 全世界众多城市都积极仿效，大力发展水收集和处理计划。
en: Many cities worldwide are following its example, expanding their water catchment and treatment programs.

zh: 此外，旨在利用摩天大楼大棚栽培作物增加城市粮食供应的垂直农场试验正在从美国中西部向日本大阪蔓延。
en: Meanwhile, vertical farm experiments – which aim to augment urban food supplies by cultivating crops in skyscraper greenhouses – are proliferating from the American Midwest to Osaka, Japan.

zh: 印度也在生物及食品废物产能领域取得领先地位。
en: And India has become a leader in converting biomass and food waste into energy.

zh: 当然，我们绝不能忘记全球数十亿农村居民。
en: Of course, the billions of farmers and villagers worldwide should not be forgotten.

zh: 实现农村电气化、提供抗旱种子、农业技术及扩大小额保险等举措不仅对农村人口福利至关重要，还可以促成新一轮“绿色革命 ” ， 让城市居民免受粮食短缺的困扰。
en: Interventions like rural electrification, the provision of drought-resistant seeds and agricultural technology, and the expansion of micro-insurance are vital not only to rural populations’ welfare, but also to catalyze a new “Green Revolution,” without which city dwellers will face severe food shortages.

zh: 虽然新的创新方案天天出现，但真正的挑战在于借助国际合作实现创新成果规模化应用。
en: With new, innovative solutions appearing every day, the real challenge lies in bringing them to scale – and that requires international cooperation.

zh: 虽然“最智能”城市并不一定在技术上最为先进，但它们的技术和公共政策必须注重民众的福利和愿望。
en: But the “smartest” cities are not necessarily the most technologically advanced. Rather, they are the places where technology and public policy support citizens’ welfare and aspirations.

zh: 这一关键事实将指引以“人类城市”为主题的6月举行的新城市基金会第二届年度峰会的讨论，并理应成为可持续城市化举措的核心议题。
en: This crucial fact will guide discussion at the New Cities Foundation’s second annual summit in June – the theme of which is “The Human City” – and should be at the heart of sustainable urbanization initiatives.

zh: 将可持续城市化作为战略重点或许是克服盘根错节的无就业增长危机、青年失业及收入不平等的唯一方法。
en: Making sustainable urbanization a strategic priority might be the only way to overcome the interrelated crises of jobless growth, youth unemployment, and income inequality.

zh: 虽然某些工厂岗位可以实现外包或自动化，但机器人还不能改造建筑、在屋顶安装光伏太阳能电池或者建造垂直农场。
en: While some factory jobs can be outsourced or automated, robots cannot yet retrofit buildings, install solar PV cells on rooftops, or construct vertical farms.

zh: 就连新加坡和东京等某些城市的无人驾驶地铁或汽车项目也需要大量人力建设和管理相关系统。
en: Even the movement in some cities, such as Singapore and Tokyo, toward driverless subways or cars will demand substantial labor to build and manage the relevant systems.

zh: 无论过去还是将来，最需要密集劳动的岗位往往包括住宅、生产设施以及社区建设。
en: In the future, as in the past, the most labor-intensive jobs will involve building homes, production facilities, and, in turn, communities.

zh: 从直升机上撒钱的时机到了？
en: Time for Helicopter Money?

zh: 华盛顿 — — 《经济学家》杂志最近询问货币政策决策者 ， “ 你们是不是没有弹药了？
en: WASHINGTON, DC – “Out of ammo?” The Economist recently asked of monetary policymakers.

zh: ”斯蒂芬·罗奇形容包括日本、欧洲和瑞典央行在内的各大央行推行负实际利率（某些情况下，甚至是负名义利率）之举为“徒劳无功 ” ， 仅仅是“为下一次危机铺平了道路 ” 。
en: Stephen Roach has called the move by major central banks – including the Bank of Japan, the European Central Bank, and the Bank of Sweden – to negative real (and, in some cases, even nominal) interest rates a “futile” effort that merely sets “the stage for the next crisis.”

zh: 而且，在2月召开的20国集团财长会议上，据报道英格兰银行行长马克·卡尼将上述政策称之为“终极零和游戏。
en: And, at the February G-20 finance ministers meeting, Bank of England Governor Mark Carney reportedly called these policies “ultimately a zero-sum game.”

zh: ”这些一直承担着2008年后维持弱复苏任务的主要发达经济体央行是否真的已经别无选择？
en: Have the major advanced economies’ central banks – which have borne the burden of sustaining anemic post-2008 recoveries – really run out of options?

zh: 看上去确实如此。
en: It certainly seems so.

zh: 央行的资产负债表已经膨胀，而政策利率已经达到“接近零”的下限目标。
en: Central-bank balance sheets have swelled, and policy rates have reached their “near zero” lower bounds.

zh: 看似廉价的水在四处流淌，但马儿却不肯喝。
en: There is plenty of cheap water, it seems, but the horse refuses to drink.

zh: 因为看不到通胀迹象，而且经济增长依然温和而脆弱，很多人预计全球经济将长期增长缓慢，有些人甚至担心全球衰退将再次爆发。
en: With no signs of inflation, and growth still tepid and fragile, many anticipate chronic slow growth, with some even fearing another global recession.

zh: 但决策者们还有一个方案：那就是转向“纯粹的”财政政策，即通过印钞来直接推动政府支出 — — 这就是所谓“从直升机上撒钱战术。
en: But policymakers have one more option: a shift to “purer” fiscal policy, in which they directly finance government spending by printing money – a so-called “helicopter drop.”

zh: ”新增货币将绕过金融和企业部门，直接流向最缺水的马：即中低收入消费者。
en: The new money would bypass the financial and corporate sectors and go straight to the thirstiest horses: middle- and lower-income consumers.

zh: 这笔钱可以通过投资就业机会创造和提高生产率的基础设施直接为他们所用。
en: The money could go to them directly, and through investment in job-creating, productivity-increasing infrastructure.

zh: 通过为最需要的人提供购买力，公共支出的直接货币融资还将有助于让不平等快速上升的经济体更加包容。
en: By placing purchasing power in the hands of those who need it most, direct monetary financing of public spending would also help to improve inclusiveness in economies where inequality is rising fast.

zh: 从直升机上撒钱的战略目前得到了左翼和中间派经济学家的一致赞成。
en: Helicopter drops are currently proposed by both leftist and centrist economists.

zh: 在某种意义上，就连某些支持扩大公共基础设施支出但同时希望减税并反对扩大借贷的保守派人士同样在事实上支持从直升机上撒钱。
en: In a sense, even some “conservatives” – who support more public infrastructure spending, but also want tax cuts and oppose more borrowing – de facto support helicopter drops.

zh: 最近，更多激进的提案已经浮出水面，这反映出民众对当前货币政策影响的紧迫感和普遍失望。
en: Recently, more radical proposals have surfaced, reflecting a sense of urgency and widespread disappointment with the impact of current monetary policy.

zh: 除倡议提高最低工资外，有些人正在呼吁实行“逆向收入政策 ” ， 即要求政府强制私营雇主实行全面的工资上涨 — — 此举将推动价格上涨并战胜通缩预期。
en: Beyond advocating higher minimum wages, some are calling for “reverse income policies,” with governments imposing across-the-board wage increases on private employers – a move that would drive up prices and defeat deflationary expectations.

zh: 就连那些观点一贯与极左翼人士相去甚远的经济学家都在考虑实行上述干预政策表明实际局面已经变得多么极端化。
en: The fact that economists whose views typically fall nowhere near those of the far left are even thinking about such interventionism shows just how extreme circumstances have become.

zh: 从某种意义上讲，我支持所有这些提案政策。
en: I favor all of these proposals, in some form.

zh: 上述政策的执行细节当然会有所不同，这取决于各个经济体的不同状况。
en: The details of their implementation would obviously have to vary, depending on each economy’s circumstances.

zh: 比方说德国有很好的条件来执行“逆向收入政策 ” ， 因为其拥有巨额经常账户盈余，虽然无疑要克服重大的政治障碍。
en: Germany, for example, is in a strong position to implement a reverse income policy, given its huge current-account surplus, though there would undoubtedly be major political barriers.

zh: 但扩大教育、技术升级和基础设施支出在任何地方都是无需思考即可作出的决策，而且在政治上的可行度更高。
en: More spending on education, skills upgrading, and infrastructure, however, is a no-brainer almost everywhere, and is politically more feasible.

zh: 但迄今为止挑战的另一方面还强调得远远不够，尽管卡尼、罗奇和其他人已经提出过警告。
en: But there is another dimension of the challenge that has so far not been emphasized nearly enough, despite the warnings of Carney, Roach, and others.

zh: 当零负实际利率成为准永久性政策，就会破坏资金的有效配置，为泡沫、萧条和危机打下基础。
en: Zero or negative real interest rates, when they become quasi-permanent, undermine the efficient allocation of capital and set the stage for bubbles, busts, and crises.

zh: 此类政策还将损害小储户的利益，促进收入进一步在顶层集中，同时它还将创造机会，让实际成本为负的储蓄资金惠及大型金融机构。
en: They also contribute to further income concentration at the top by hurting small savers, while creating opportunities for large financial players to benefit from access to savings at negative real cost.

zh: 虽然听上去与正统观点相去甚远，但某种程度上稍高一些的利率将会为世界经济带来好处。
en: As unorthodox as it may sound, it is likely that the world economy would benefit from somewhat higher interest rates.

zh: 但加息绝不能是一项孤立的政策。
en: Raising interest rates cannot, however, be a stand-alone policy.

zh: 相反，必须将小幅的政策利率升高纳入到更广泛的财政和分配政策，扩大基础设施和技术升级领域的公共支出，并同时执行某些形式更加温和的收入政策，比方说开展“道义劝说 ” 。
en: Instead, small policy-rate increases must be incorporated into a broader fiscal and distributional strategy, implemented alongside more public spending on infrastructure and skills upgrading, as well as some gentle forms of income policies, employing, for example, “moral suasion.”

zh: 即使实行这样的策略，各大央行也必须协调相关政策。
en: Even with such an approach, however, major central banks would have to coordinate their policies.

zh: 如果单一央行试图提高利率，其国内经济将立即通过货币升值、竞争力下降和出口下降而遭到“惩罚 ” ， 所有这些都将破坏总需求和就业状况。
en: If a single major central bank attempted to introduce higher interest rates, its economy would immediately be “punished” through currency appreciation, declining competitiveness, and falling exports, all of which would undermine aggregate demand and employment.

zh: 如果各大央行决定同时提高政策利率，上述溢出效应将会互相抵消。
en: If the major central banks decided to increase their policy rates simultaneously, these spillover effects would cancel one another out.

zh: 一次经过充分协调的行动，也许仅需加息两次，每次25或30基点，既能将真实利率调回正值区间，又对汇率和短期竞争力构不成太大影响。
en: A coordinated move, perhaps raising rates in two modest 25 or 30 basis-point increments, would be neutral in terms of exchange rates and short-term competitiveness, even as it moved real interest rates back into positive territory.
