en: It is an understandable concern: money that the Bank lends to developing countries that ends up in secret bank accounts or finances some contractors’ luxurious lifestyle leaves a country more indebted, not more prosperous.

zh: 世界银行的前任行长沃尔福森和我不顾反对把腐败问题列入该行的议题而广受赞誉。 那些反对者把腐败视为一个政治问题，而非经济问题，因而超出了世界银行的职权范围。
en: James Wolfensohn, the Bank’s previous president, and I are widely credited with putting corruption on the Bank’s agenda, against opponents who regarded corruption as a political issue, not an economic one, and thus outside the Bank’s mandate.

zh: 我们的研究表明，腐败和经济增长之间存在体系上的关系，这一关系使得我们可以探究这一关键问题。
en: Our research showed systematic relationships between corruption and economic growth, which allowed us to pursue this critical issue.

zh: 但是，世界银行开始治理腐败之时，应当注意以下四个问题。
en: But the World Bank would do well to keep four things in mind as it takes up the fight.

zh: 首先，腐败形式多样，所以，反腐战争应当在众多的战线开展。
en: First, corruption takes many forms, so a war on corruption has to be fought on many fronts.

zh: 我们无法打击弱小国家转移少量资金而同时忽视将公共资源大规模地转移到私人手中。 叶利钦统治下的俄罗斯就是一个例子。
en: You can’t fight the diversion of small amounts of money by weak and poor countries while ignoring the massive diversion of public resources into private hands of the sort that marked, say, Russia under Boris Yeltsin.

zh: 在某些国家，公开的腐败主要通过竞选资助进行。 这些资助让政客们用好处回报主要的捐助者。
en: In some countries, overt corruption occurs primarily through campaign contributions that oblige politicians to repay major donors with favors.

zh: 小规模的腐败是坏的，但是政治进程中体制性腐败则会造成更大代价。
en: Smaller-scale corruption is bad, but systemic corruption of political processes can have even greater costs.

zh: 竞选资助以及院外游说导致共用事业在适当的监管框架到位之前快速私有化，其方式产生仅有的几个竞标者。 因而它们会在甚至没有给政府官员直接回扣的情况下阻碍发展。
en: Campaign contributions and lobbying that lead to rapid privatizations of utilities – before appropriate regulatory frameworks are in place, and in a manner that produces only a few bidders – can impede development, even without direct kickbacks to government officials.

zh: 生活从来不是泾渭分明。
en: Life is never black and white.

zh: 正如没有放之四海而皆准的经济发展政策一样，反腐也没有什么灵丹妙药。
en: Just as there is no “one size fits all” policy for economic development, there is no such policy for fighting corruption.

zh: 对付腐败之道应当像腐败本身一样复杂而又形形色色。
en: The response to corruption needs to be as complex and variegated as corruption itself.

zh: 第二，世界银行布道反腐并无不可。
en: Second, it’s fine for the World Bank to deliver anti-corruption sermons.

zh: 但是，重要的还是政策、程序以及体制。
en: But policies, procedures, and institutions are what matter.

zh: 实际上，全世界基本上把世界银行的采购程序视为值得崇拜的典范。
en: In fact, the Bank’s procurement procedures are generally viewed around the world as a model to be admired.

zh: 确实，一些拥有大量美元储备的国家根本不需要世界银行的贷款，但也从世行那里用比从美国那里高得多的利息借钱，因为它们相信这些程序会帮助确保高质量的工程不受腐败侵蚀并成为其他领域的标准。
en: Indeed, some countries with large dollar reserves – hardly in need of World Bank credit – borrowed from the Bank at far higher interest rates than they were getting from the United States, believing that these procedures would help ensure high-quality projects free of corruption and become standard in other areas.

zh: 但是，反腐的成功需要比良好的采购程序更多的东西(例如，避免单个来源的非竞争性竞标 ) 。
en: But success in fighting corruption entails more than just good procurement procedures (avoiding, for instance, single-source non-competitive bidding).

zh: 可以颁布许多其他政策和程序来降低腐败的激励。
en: Many other policies and procedures can be enacted that reduce incentives for corruption.

zh: 例如，某些税收制度要比其他的税制更为抗拒腐败，因为它们可以抑制征税人员的自由裁量权。
en: For example, some tax systems are more corruption-resistant than others, because they curtail the discretionary authority of tax officials.

zh: 第三，世界银行的主要责任是与贫困作战，这就意味着当它面对一个深受腐败侵蚀的穷国时，它的挑战是找到途径来确保款项不被污染并能够用于需要的工程和人们的上面。
en: Third, the World Bank’s primary responsibility is to fight poverty, which means that when it confronts a poor country plagued with corruption, its challenge is to figure out how to ensure that its own money is not tainted and gets to projects and people that need it.

zh: 在某些情况下，这就会要求通过非政府组织提供援助。
en: In some cases, this may entail delivering assistance through non-governmental organizations.

zh: 但是，视而不见很少就是最佳的对应之策。
en: But seldom will it be the case that the best response is simply to walk away.

zh: 最后，尽管发展中国家必须承担铲除腐败的责任，西方国家也需要做很多事情。
en: Finally, while developing countries must take responsibility for rooting out corruption, there is much that the West can do to help.

zh: 至少，西方国家政府和企业不应当串通一气。
en: At a minimum, Western governments and corporations should not be complicit.

zh: 每个行贿总有行贿者，而在很多情况下，行贿者是来自发达工业化国家的企业或其代理人。
en: Every bribe that is taken has a payer, and too often the bribe payer is a corporation from an advanced industrial country or someone acting on its behalf.

zh: 确实，所谓的“自然资源诅咒”的其中一个原因就是腐败盛行，而那些希望将其自然资源折价出售的公司则经常助长腐败。 “自然资源诅咒”是指资源丰富的国家一般而言落后于资源贫乏的国家。
en: Indeed, one reason for the so called “natural resource curse” ­– the fact that resource-rich countries do not, on average, do as well as resource-poor countries – is the prevalence of corruption, too often aided and abetted by companies that would like to get the resources they sell at discount prices.

zh: 美国卡特政府通过反海外腐败法规定美国公司在全球任何地方行贿均为违法，从而做出了重要的贡献。
en: The US under President Jimmy Carter made an important contribution in passing the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, which made bribery by American companies anywhere in the world illegal.

zh: 经合组织反贿赂公约是在正确方向上的另一个步骤。
en: The OECD’s Convention on Bribery was another step in the right direction.

zh: 让所有给政府的支付透明化将会带来更大的进步，而西方国家政府只要通过把这一要求与税收抵扣捆绑在一起就可以鼓励做到这一点。
en: Making all payments to governments transparent would bring further progress, and Western governments could encourage this simply by tying this requirement to tax deductibility.

zh: 处理银行保密也同样重要��银行保密通过给腐败的独裁者提供其资金的安全庇护而便利了腐败。
en: It is equally important to address bank secrecy, which facilitates corruption by providing corrupt dictators with a safe haven for their funds.

zh: 2001年8月，美国的恐怖主义攻击前夕，美国政府否决了经合组织限制秘密银行帐户的决议。
en: In August 2001, just before the terrorist attacks on America, the US government vetoed an OECD effort to limit secret bank accounts.

zh: 尽管美国政府从此以后改变了对恐怖份子银行秘密的立场，但是，对于腐败官员还没有这样做。
en: While the government has since reversed its stance on bank secrecy for terrorists, it has not done so for corrupt officials.

zh: 世界银行的强硬立场将会提升其在反腐战争中的信誉度。
en: A strong stand by the World Bank would enhance its credibility in the war on corruption.

zh: 那些批评世界银行在腐败问题上的立场的人们并非因为他们赞成腐败才这样做。
en: Those who criticize the Bank’s stance on corruption do not do so because they favor corruption.

zh: 某些批评人士担心反腐议程本身的破坏，那就是，这一斗争将会被用来作为削减令美国政府不悦的国家援助的“借口 ” 。
en: Some critics worry about corruption in the corruption agenda itself: that the fight will be used as a “cover” for cutting aid to countries that displease the US administration.

zh: 世行大谈反腐，与此同时计划扩大对伊拉克的贷款看似互不合宜。 这些关切在此找到了共鸣。
en: Such concerns have found resonance in the seeming incongruity of the Bank’s tough talk on corruption and simultaneous plans to expand lending to Iraq.

zh: 无人能够证明伊拉克没有腐败，甚至位于国际腐败程度后排。
en: No one is likely to certify that Iraq is corruption-free – or even ranks low on corruption internationally.

zh: 但是，最为刺耳的批评来自于那些担心世界银行正在偏离其职权范围的人们。
en: The most strident criticism, however, comes from those who worry that the World Bank is straying from its mandate.

zh: 当然，世行必须竭力确保它的钱用在了实处，也就是既要反腐，也要同不称职做斗争。
en: Of course, the Bank must do everything that it can to ensure that its money is well spent, which means fighting both corruption and incompetence.

zh: 但是，金钱本身并不会解决所有问题，而且，一心一意关注反腐也不会带来发展。
en: But money itself will not solve all problems, and a single-minded focus on fighting corruption will not bring development.

zh: 相反，这只会把那些奋力摆脱贫困的人们的注意力从其他同样重要的问题上转移开来。
en: On the contrary, it might merely divert attention from other issues of no less moment for those struggling to lift themselves out of poverty.

zh: 免罚陷阱
en: The Impunity Trap

zh: 纽约 — — 我们的世界是个不受惩罚的世界。
en: NEW YORK – Ours is a world of impunity.

zh: 腐败指控围绕国际足联几十年，上周终于以大规模起诉国际足联官员达到高潮。
en: Allegations of corruption swarmed around FIFA for decades, culminating in indictments of current and former officials last week.

zh: 但国际足联主席布拉特却四次当选，最后一次还是在提起诉讼之后。
en: Yet FIFA President Sepp Blatter was re-elected four times, including after the indictments were filed.

zh: 是的，布拉特最终辞职了，但却是在他和数十名足联官员再次表达了对诚信和法律的蔑视之后。
en: Yes, Blatter has finally resigned, but only after he and dozens of Federation members once again showed their scorn for honesty and the law.

zh: 类似这样的行为遍及全世界。
en: We see this kind of behavior all over the world.

zh: 比如华尔街。
en: Consider Wall Street.

zh: 2013年和2014年，摩根大通为金融渎职支付罚金超过200亿美元；但该公司首席执行官在2014和2015两年依然拿到了2，000万美元的酬劳。
en: In 2013 and 2014, JPMorgan Chase paid more than $20 billion in fines for financial malfeasance; yet the CEO took home $20 million in compensation in both 2014 and 2015.

zh: 再比如巴西、西班牙和其他许多国家爆出的腐败丑闻，即使在执政党高层腐败丑闻公之于众后政府仍然留在台上。
en: Or consider corruption scandals in Brazil, Spain, and many other countries, where governments remain in power even after high-level corruption within the ruling party has been exposed.

zh: 有人能利用巨大的公私权力蔑视法律及伦理规范来谋取私利是不平等最明目张胆的表现。
en: The ability of those who wield great public and private power to flout the law and ethical norms for personal gain is one of the more glaring manifestations of inequality.

zh: 穷人因为轻微的犯罪就被判处无期，而欺诈公众数十亿美元的银行家却应邀出席白宫的国宴。
en: The poor get life sentences for petty crimes, while bankers who fleece the public of billions get invitations to White House state dinners.

zh: 中世纪英国一首著名的小曲表明这种现象自古就有：
en: A famous ditty from medieval England shows that this is not a new phenomenon:

zh: 法律惩戒从平民那里偷鹅的男女但却让偷盗公众财物坏人逍遥法外
en: The law locks up the man or womanWho steals the goose off the commonBut leaves the greater villain looseWho steals the common from the goose.

zh: 今天偷盗现代平民 — — 抢劫政府预算、玷污自然环境、掠夺公众信任者才是最大的窃贼。
en: Today’s greatest thieves are those who are stealing the modern commons – raiding government budgets, defiling the natural environment, and preying on the public trust.

zh: 14名国际足联官员的起诉书所牵扯的不仅是体育界的罪犯，还有某些非常熟悉的机构：瑞士银行秘密账户、开曼群岛避税天堂、空壳公司 — — 以上一切金融附属产业都旨在保护富人免受法律的监督和惩罚。
en: When the indictments against the 14 FIFA officials were filed, the cast of characters included not only miscreants from the sports world, but also some familiar players: secret Swiss bank accounts, Cayman Islands tax havens, shell corporations – all of the financial appurtenances that are literally designed to shield the rich from scrutiny and the law.

zh: 这种情况下，联邦调查局和美国司法部的工作做得非常出色。
en: In this case, the FBI and US Justice Department have done their jobs.

zh: 但他们是穿透了由美国财政部、国税局和国会（加勒比海避税天堂的坚定保护者）建设并保护的金融秘密的黑暗世界才达到了这一目标。
en: But they did so, in part, by penetrating the murky worlds of financial secrecy created and protected by the US Treasury, the Internal Revenue Service, and the US Congress (ever-protective of Caribbean tax havens).

zh: 在某些社会和经济部门，有罪不罚现象现在已经泛滥到被认为是不可避免的。
en: In some societies and economic sectors, impunity is now so pervasive that it is viewed as inevitable.

zh: 当政界和商界领袖的不道德行为被普遍视为“正常 ” ， 就能避开公众舆论的谴责，并让人们更加见怪不怪、习以为常 — — “免罚陷阱”也因此形成。
en: When unethical behavior by political and business leaders becomes widely viewed as “normal,” it then goes unpunished by public opinion, and is reinforced as normal – creating an “impunity trap.”

zh: 比方说，因为美国政客现在如此明目张胆、毫无顾忌地接受富人捐款，不少公众在面对新揭露的财务不当行为（比方说克林顿基金会在道德上可疑的金融交易）时仅仅是玩世不恭地打个哈哈。
en: For example, with politicians in the United States now so flagrantly and relentlessly on the take from wealthy donors, much of the public accepts new revelations of financial impropriety (such as the Clinton Foundation’s morally dubious financial dealings) with a cynical yawn.

zh: 全球银行业的状况尤其令人担忧。
en: The situation in the global banking sector is especially alarming.

zh: 最近对美英金融服务业道德态度的一次严肃的调查显示，不道德和非法活动现在的确被视为普遍现象。
en: A recent careful study of ethical attitudes in the financial-services industry in the US and the United Kingdom showed that unethical and illegal behavior is indeed now viewed as pervasive.

zh: 大约47％的受访者说“其对手可能从事不道德的非法活动 ， ” 还有23%的人认为自己的同事也在这样做。
en: Some 47% of respondents said that it is “likely that their competitors have engaged in unethical and illegal activity,” and 23% believed that their fellow employees have engaged in such activities.

zh: 年轻一代已经总结了心得：32%在金融业从业不到10年的受调查者表示 ， “ 如果没有可能被抓他们很可能会涉足赚取1，000万美元的内幕交易。
en: The younger generation has learned the lesson: 32% of respondents employed in the financial industry for less than ten years said that, “they would likely engage in insider trading to make $10 million if there was no chance of being arrested.”

zh: ”从事类似犯罪活动被抓的几率很可能非常之低。
en: The chance of being arrested for such malfeasance is, alas, probably very low.

zh: 但并非所有社会或行业都陷入了免罚陷阱之中。
en: Yet not all societies or sectors are caught in an impunity trap.

zh: 有些社会，尤其是在斯堪的纳维亚半岛，依然期望他们的政府官员和商界领袖实际践行道德及诚实的准则。
en: Some societies, most notably in Scandinavia, maintain the expectation that their public officials and business leaders should and will act ethically and honestly.

zh: 在这些国家，部长们被迫因为小的违规辞职，这样的违规行为在其他国家看来几乎微不足道。
en: In these countries, ministers are forced to resign for petty infractions that would seem trivial in other countries.

zh: 说服美国、俄罗斯、尼日利亚还有中国的民众腐败其实是可以控制的可能看似有些徒劳。
en: Convincing American, Russian, Nigerian, or Chinese citizens that corruption can indeed be controlled might seem to be a futile task.

zh: 但我们值得为此而努力，因为有压倒性证据显示：有罪不罚现象不仅在道义上有害；并且能带来极高的经济成本，破坏人们的幸福生活。
en: But the goal is certainly worth embracing, because the evidence is overwhelming: impunity is not only morally noxious; it is also economically costly and deeply corrosive to wellbeing.

zh: 最近的研究表明社会“一般信任度”高可以改善经济表现、提高生活满意度。
en: Recent studies have shown that when “generalized trust” in society is high, economic performance is improved and life satisfaction is higher.

zh: 虽然有很多其他理由，但商业协议更容易达成、执行也更为有效。
en: Among other reasons, commercial agreements are more easily reached and efficiently implemented.

zh: 斯堪的纳维亚国家年复一年位列世界最幸福、最繁荣的国家之列并不是巧合。
en: It is no coincidence that the Scandinavian countries rank among the world’s happiest and most prosperous year after year.

zh: 那么跳出有罪不罚的陷阱需要做些什么？
en: So what can be done to overcome an impunity trap?

zh: 部分答案当然是执法（如起诉国际足联）和为举报人提供保护。
en: Part of the answer is of course law enforcement (such as the FIFA indictments) and protection for whistleblowers.

zh: 但仅靠执法是不够的；公众态度同样起到重要作用。
en: Yet law enforcement is not sufficient; public attitudes also play a major role.

zh: 如果公众对欺骗客户的银行家、破坏气候的石油公司高管、纵容回扣的国际足联官员及拉拢上述所有人以换取竞选资金和贿赂的政客表现出鄙视和厌恶，那么少数人的违法行为就不能成为准则。
en: If the public expresses contempt and revulsion for bankers who cheat their clients, oil executives who wreck the climate, FIFA officials who countenance kickbacks, and politicians who cozy up to all of them in exchange for campaign funds and bribes, illegality for the few cannot become the norm.

zh: 公众蔑视可能无法立即结束腐败，但却可以破坏盗窃公共资源者的生活。
en: Public scorn might not end corruption immediately, but it can make life far less pleasant for those who are stealing the commons from the rest of us.

zh: 2016年美国总统候选人马里兰州前州长马丁·奥马利不久前启动了自己的竞选，质疑2008年金融危机后为什么没有一个华尔街首席执行官被追究金融罪责。
en: One candidate for US President in 2016, former Maryland Governor Martin O’Malley, recently launched his campaign by asking why not a single Wall Street CEO was convicted of a financial crime in the wake of the 2008 financial meltdown.

zh: 这个问题很有价值，类此问题能帮助美国跳出有罪不罚的陷阱。
en: It is a good question, the kind that can help the US to overcome its impunity trap.

zh: 但我们还可以问个更简单的问题。
en: Yet we can ask an even simpler question.

zh: 为什么那些银行家仍接受奥巴马总统的宴请，出席光彩夺目的国宴，并接受媒体的虔诚采访？
en: Why are those same bankers still fêted by President Barack Obama, invited to glittering state dinners, and reverently interviewed by the media?

zh: 任何社会可以而且应该做的第一件事就是拒绝尊敬那些故意滥用公众信任的政界和商界领袖。
en: The first thing any society can and should do is deny respectability to political and business leaders who willfully abuse the public trust.

zh: 印度的LBW
en: India’s LBW

zh: 新德里—翻翻最近几周的印度报纸，你会发现政治争议、性丑闻和官员腐败这些平日里充斥于新闻标题的东西突然不见了。
en: NEW DELHI – A casual reader of India’s newspapers for the last several weeks would be forgiven for wondering whether the country was suddenly bereft of political controversy, sex scandals, or official corruption – normally the standard headline fare here.

zh: 占据印度报纸头条大号通版标题的只有一件事，这件事原本通常只出现在体育版。 那就是：板球。
en: The newspapers’ front pages have had space – under massive banner headlines – only for a topic normally reserved for the sports pages: cricket.

zh: 获得如此关注的并不是特别精彩的对抗赛。
en: The cause is not some particularly exciting test match.

zh: 让公众怒不可遏的是关于印度超级联赛（IPL）的耸人听闻的指控 — — 贿赂比赛、球队老板赌球、球手被三版女郎引诱。
en: Instead, the public has been outraged by lurid accusations concerning the Indian Premier League (IPL) – bribes for bad play, owners betting on games, and players seduced by starlets and call girls.

zh: 国家队队长被爆陷入了利益冲突，印度板球界最有权势的官员的女婿被爆卷入了地下赌博网络的非法赌局操纵。
en: The national captain was revealed to have a conflict of interest, and the son-in-law of Indian cricket’s most powerful official was implicated in an illegal gambling operation run by a sinister network of bookies.

zh: 警方通过电话监听逮捕了一大群嫌疑犯，并起诉了不少著名有组织犯罪人物。
en: The police, whose phone taps led to a wave of arrests, have filed charges alleging involvement by well-known organized crime figures.

zh: 他们甚至将某印度国家队队员和流亡分子伊布拉西姆（Dawood Ibrahim）联系在一起，后者被广泛认为是1993年孟买爆炸案的嫌疑主谋，现藏身于巴基斯坦。
en: They have even linked a player for India’s national team to the fugitive Dawood Ibrahim, widely suspected of being the architect of the 1993 Bombay bombings, who has been hiding in Pakistan.

zh: 印度媒体很久没有如此给力了。
en: The Indian media have not had it this good in a long time.

zh: 在多年的腐败丑闻、政治闹剧和示威游行后，这简直是天降馅饼 — — 结合了板球（全民疯狂的运动）和犯罪（国民劣根性）的故事。
en: After years of corruption scandals, political dramas, and protest marches, this was manna from heaven – a story combining cricket, the national obsession, with vice, the national weakness.

zh: 印度全国300多家电视新闻频道也和纸媒一样，把所有的时间都花在了分析警方泄漏或公布的蛛丝马迹上。
en: India’s 300-plus television news channels have been no better than the print media, devoting almost all of their time to parsing every morsel of information leaked or announced by the police.

zh: 此前，在印度造成万人空巷盛况的往往是激动人心的半球比赛，如今，整个印度因为其对立面而如痴如狂 — — 这项绝无仅有的能够抓住全体印度人民想象力的运动的面纱正在被缓缓揭开。
en: A country that traditionally grinds to a halt during an exciting cricket match has now been ground into submission by its antithesis – the slow unraveling of illusions about a game that seizes Indians’ imagination like no other.

zh: 五年前，我在一篇专栏文章中指出了IPL的显著魅力及其将板球转变为电视狂欢式的美国运动。
en: Five years ago, I wrote a column about the phenomenal appeal of the IPL and its transformation of cricket in a manner inspired by the televised razzle-dazzle of American sport.

zh: 印度不但让这个起源于保守优雅的维多利亚时期英国的运动活力四射，还把它带入了二十一世纪，用无孔不入的商业化完善了它。
en: India not only livened up a game that was originally invented in staid and decorous Victorian England; it also brought the game into the twenty-first century, complete with rampant commercialization.

zh: 现在，比赛流程会被两分半钟的“策略暂停”打断，让广告商向数以亿计的狂热电视观众推销商品。
en: Two-and-a-half minute “strategic timeouts” now interrupt the flow of the game, allowing advertisers to hawk their wares to hundreds of millions of enthralled viewers.

zh: 社会学家南迪（Ashis Nandy）有一句名言 ： “ 板球是一项被英国人意外发现的印度运动。
en: The sociologist Ashis Nandy once memorably wrote that “cricket is an Indian game accidentally discovered by the British.”

zh: ”但是，每个IPL观众都会认为，Twenty20板球，即“即时”模式板球，其实是一项印度人有意重新发现的美国运动。
en: Anyone watching the IPL, however, might be tempted to conclude that Twenty20 cricket, the “instant” form of the game, is actually an American game deliberately rediscovered by the Indians.

zh: 其他国家纷纷效而仿之，IPL的锦标赛模式在板球界逐渐兴起。
en: Other countries have followed suit, with tournaments modeled on the IPL springing up throughout the cricketing world.

zh: 对敏锐的观察者来说，IPL代表的不仅仅是一个体育联赛；它的意义不下于新印度崛起的象征。
en: To keen observers, the IPL represented more than a sports league; it signaled nothing less than the emergence of a new India.

zh: IPL的光芒、魅力和过度是一剂解毒剂，让印度人从导致印度过去经济停滞的刻板集权思维中解救出来。
en: In the IPL’s glitz, glamour, and excess lay an antidote to the hidebound statist mentality that had produced economic stagnation in India in the past.

zh: 这是一项冒险，为企业开启了新的天地，也点燃了年轻人的想象力去模仿老板、推广者、球星和球迷所展现出来的企业家精气神。
en: Here was a venture that opened new vistas for businesses and fired the imaginations of young people to emulate the entrepreneurial energies shown by owners, promoters, players, and fans.

zh: IPL成了印度的新产业，受其自身成功启发的新产业。
en: The IPL suggested a new departure for a country inspired by the allure of its own success.

zh: 不难理解，IPL遭到扒皮，露出了欺诈的混乱本质，肆无忌惮的赌博和受贿的选手的“现场操纵”败坏了IPL的名声，是它不再是令人振奋的符号。
en: Understandably, the exposure of the IPL as a morass of deceit, discredited by “spot-fixing” episodes engineered by unscrupulous bookies and venal players, has deflated such heady notions.

zh: 板球依然让众多印度人如痴如醉，但也有很多印度人因为IPL丑闻的曝光而远离板球。
en: Cricket continues to hold many Indians in thrall, but many others have forsaken it in the wake of the IPL revelations.

zh: 媒体的鞭挞来去如风，不消多久就会退去，但公众对IPL趋之若鹜的兴奋不会回来了。
en: The paroxysm of media flagellation will soon abate, but the excitement with which the public followed the IPL will not return.

zh: 重磅人物可能会把IPL华而不实的阴暗面视为后自由化印度的裙带资本主义和商业短视主义的象征。
en: Weighty minds will probably see the IPL’s tawdry underside as emblematic of post-liberalization India’s crony capitalism and business short-termism.

zh: 但用体育来充当国家衰落的大隐喻永远是危险的，因此必须抵制将IPL视为一切当代印度错误的象征的看法。
en: But it is always dangerous to find in sports large metaphors for national decline, so the temptation to view the IPL as symptomatic of everything that is wrong with today’s India must be resisted.

zh: 我一开始也沉迷于IPL堪为勇敢的充满企业家精神的新印度的象征的观点，不愿立刻接受相反的看法。
en: Having initially been seduced by the idea that the IPL showcased the alluring face of a brave new entrepreneurial India, I am reluctant to embrace the opposite view instantly.

zh: 但毫无疑问，媒体每天都在揭露缺陷 — — 自杀���的贪得无厌、追求一夜暴富、求助非法手段，以及最高层道德败坏 — — 这些缺陷表明印度的国民性有着致命缺点。
en: But there is no doubt that the flaws being exposed daily in the media – cupidity on a colossal, almost suicidal scale, the quest for easy money, the turn to illegality, and the lack of ethical standards at the highest levels – reveal dangerous streaks in our national character.

zh: IPL可以继续成为体育娱乐，成为带着孩子在电视前享受快乐夜晚的不错选择。
en: The IPL can continue as sporting entertainment, good for a fun evening with the kids in front of the idiot box.

zh: 但印度人所获得的关于他们自身的揭露就远远没有那么迷人了。
en: But what it has revealed to Indians about themselves is far less amusing.

zh: 板球改革的需要就是印度商业改革的需要。
en: The call for reform in cricket is really a call for reform in the way India goes about its business.

zh: IPL事件所揭露的性格缺陷必须予以纠正，如果印度想要实现其明确承诺、在21世纪的世界舞台上成为主角的话。
en: The character flaws laid bare in the IPL must be curbed if India is ever to fulfill its obvious promise and take its place at the front of the world stage in the twenty-first century.

zh: 腐败如何影响全民健康覆盖
en: How Corruption Impedes Universal Health Coverage

zh: 伊斯兰堡 — — 地球上有近半数人无法获得基本卫生服务。
en: ISLAMABAD – Half of the planet cannot access essential health services.

zh: 对许多人而言，付钱看医生、获取药物、寻求计划生育建议甚至是为预防普通疾病接受免疫接种均不啻于在保持健康和陷入贫困之间作出选择。
en: For many people, paying to see a doctor, obtaining medications, seeking family-planning advice, or even getting immunized against common illnesses is a choice between staying healthy and slipping into poverty.

zh: 而且贫困民众确实拥有的医疗保健选项比以往任何时候均面临来自熟悉敌人的更大威胁。
en: And, more than ever, the health-care options that poor people do have are being degraded by a familiar foe.

zh: 在许多中低收入国家，腐败、开支不足和资源浪费持续困扰着医疗卫生系统。
en: In many low- and middle-income countries, corruption, inadequate spending, and wasted resources pose enduring challenges for health-care systems.

zh: 因为在巴基斯坦长大，我亲眼目睹人们为了获得医疗保健服务而被迫走极端。
en: Growing up in Pakistan, I saw people forced to go to extremes to secure health care.

zh: 例如，家人可能被迫出售耕牛和其他有价值资产以支付昂贵的医疗费用。
en: For example, families might be forced to sell off cattle and other valuables to pay exorbitant medical bills.

zh: 令人震惊的是，即使在今天，与医疗相关的贫困灾难依然在吞噬受害者。
en: What is shocking is that the scourge of health-related poverty continues to claim victims today.

zh: 事实上，在某些国家，民众因高额医疗费而陷入贫困是每天都要面对的现实。
en: Indeed, in some countries, people falling into poverty due to the high cost of health care is an everyday reality.

zh: 在最近访问非洲时，我听到了一个令人痛心的故事，那里的妇女和新生儿常常被医院扣为人质 — — 时间往往长达数月 — — 直至家属能够凑钱结清账单为止。
en: On a recent trip to Africa, I heard a harrowing story of a hospital where women and their newborns are routinely held hostage – often for months – until families can find the money to settle their bills.

zh: 加利福尼亚大学圣地亚哥分校的研究人员认为，腐败、浪费和违反道德的医疗计费导致患者和医疗系统每年损失高达数十亿美元。
en: According to researchers at the University of California, San Diego, corruption, waste, and unethical billing cost patients and health systems billions of dollars annually.

zh: 在美国，欺诈性开支在公共部门卫生支出中的占比高达10 % ， 面临医疗服务经济障碍的民众高达数千万。
en: In the United States, as much as 10% of public-sector spending on health care is lost to fraudulent billing, and tens of millions face significant economic barriers to health care.

zh: 显而易见，改善医疗效果需要在增加政府开支的同时终结那些从医疗系统中吸走关键资源的不光彩行为。
en: Clearly, improving health outcomes requires both increased government spending and an end to shady practices that siphon crucial resources from the health system.

zh: 但实现这一目标究竟需要采取哪些措施？
en: But how?

zh: 纵观世界各地，腐败和勾结是许多医疗系统的体制性难题。
en: Around the world, corruption and collusion are institutionalized in many health-care systems.

zh: 在医疗保健业每年耗费的6.5万亿美元中，估计遭损失、滥用或盗用的数额高达4，550亿美元。
en: Of the $6.5 trillion spent annually on healthcare, an estimated $455 billion is lost, misused, or stolen.

zh: 简言之，医疗费用正导致世界某些最贫困民众陷入破产，因为许多最富有的人正在以不正当方式牟利。
en: Simply put, health costs are bankrupting some of the poorest people in the world, because many of the richest are lining their pockets.

zh: 越来越多的人正在达成共识，将平价、优质的医疗服务列为基本人权。
en: There is growing consensus that affordable, quality health care is a basic human right.

zh: 联合国可持续发展 目标包括全民医疗覆盖。
en: The United Nations Sustainable Development Goals include universal health coverage as a target.

zh: 而接受这一目标的不仅仅是富裕国家：从泰国到哥斯达黎加再到卢旺达，医疗五花八门而资源有限的国家正在投入资金和政治资本，以实现全民医疗覆盖。
en: And it is not only rich countries that have embraced this goal: from Thailand to Costa Rica to Rwanda, countries with mixed health systems and limited resources have dedicated funds and political capital to making universal health care a reality.

zh: 人们正在采取步骤帮助这些国家取得成功。
en: Steps are being taken to help these countries succeed.

zh: 去年，日本承诺出资29亿美元，帮助发展中国家实现全民医疗覆盖。
en: Last year, Japan pledged $2.9 billion to help developing countries achieve universal health coverage.

zh: 而世界银行已经表示， 一个国家的借款能力可能最终与其人力资本投资，包括卫生开支息息相关。
en: And the World Bank has indicated that a country’s ability to borrow from it could eventually be tied to investments in human capital, including health spending.

zh: 但这样的姿态，无论多么值得赞赏 — — 多么期待已久 — — 都不足以消除优质医疗服务的障碍。
en: But such gestures, however laudable – and overdue – will not be enough to remove the barriers to quality health services.

zh: 直到腐败、盗窃、浪费和低效支出得到更有力的解决之前，全民医疗覆盖仍将仅仅是人们的梦想。
en: Until corruption, theft, and wasteful and inefficient spending are addressed more vigorously, universal health coverage will remain aspirational.

zh: 幸运的是，政府越来越致力于化解腐败危机。
en: Fortunately, governments are increasingly committed to solving the corruption crisis.

zh: 逃税和欺诈这两种普遍罪行正接受来自执法部门越来越严厉的审查。
en: Tax evasion and fraud – both common crimes – are drawing closer scrutiny from law enforcement agencies.

zh: 逃税不仅能够洗钱；还抢走了公共部门的重要资源。
en: Tax evasion doesn’t just enable money laundering; it also robs the public sector of important resources.

zh: 这也是联合国为什么已将减少非法资金流视为实现可持续发展目标关键要素的原因之一。
en: This is one reason why the UN has made reducing illicit financial flows a key component of achieving the Sustainable Development Goals.

zh: 随着人们就打击医疗领域腐败行为达成广泛的共识，制定可行的补救措施将成为更艰巨的挑战。
en: With broad agreement on the need to combat corruption in the health sector, the harder challenge will be developing workable remedies.

zh: 国库、财政部和反腐败机构需要加强在预防、侦查和执法方面的合作。
en: National treasuries, finance ministries, and anti-corruption agencies need to strengthen their efforts to cooperate on prevention, detection, and enforcement.

zh: 提高金融系统的透明度也有助于遏制腐败，而民间社会团体、记者和病人则应当推动政府和医疗服务机构加强问责。
en: Improving transparency in financial systems could also help curb corruption, while civil-society groups, journalists, and patients should push for greater accountability from governments and medical providers.

zh: 未来，数据挖掘、人工智能和区块链等新技术可以提供全新方法来检测医疗部门的违法行为；应当充分调查上述和其它工具。
en: In the future, new technologies like data mining, artificial intelligence, and blockchain could offer new ways to detect wrongdoing in the health sector; these and other tools should be investigated fully.

zh: 扩大医疗覆盖面和保护行业财政是国际社会必须同时解决的双重挑战。
en: Expanding health-care access and protecting the sector’s finances are dual challenges that the international community must address together.

zh: 人们需要立即采取行动。
en: There is an urgent need to act without delay.

zh: 癌症、糖尿病和心血管病等非传染性疾病的发病率几乎呈几何级增长，缺乏优质医疗服务将增加许多国家的治理挑战。
en: Rates of noncommunicable diseases like cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease are increasing almost exponentially, and lack of access to quality care will add to many countries’ governance challenges.

zh: 发展战略学家理解健康状况不佳是贫困的先兆，同时也是消除贫困的障碍。
en: Development strategists understand that poor health is a harbinger of poverty and a barrier to eliminating it.

zh: 今天，约8亿人至少将家庭预算的10% 用于购买医疗服务，甚至不惜常常借债来接受所需要的治疗。
en: Today, some 800 million people spend at least 10% of their household budgets on health, often going into debt to fund the treatment they need.

zh: 这么多人看不起医生实在令人感到汗颜。
en: The fact that so many people cannot afford to visit a doctor is truly shameful.

zh: 世界需要全民医疗覆盖；但要想实现这一目标，世界医疗部门自身首先应当进行改革。
en: The world needs universal health coverage; but to achieve it, the world’s health sector must undergo treatment of its own.

zh: 哥斯达黎加是如何做对的
en: How Costa Rica Gets It Right

zh: 圣何塞—极权主义和原型法西斯主义正在世界多处崛起，看到还有一个国家的公民仍然对民主原则坚持不懈着实令人鼓舞。
en: SAN JOSÉ – With authoritarianism and proto-fascism on the rise in so many corners of the world, it is heartening to see a country where citizens are still deeply committed to democratic principles.

zh: 如今，这个国家的人民正在试图重新定义二十一世纪的国家政治。
en: And now its people are in the midst of trying to redefine their politics for the twenty-first century.

zh: 多年来，人口不到五百万的哥斯达黎加因为其进步领导力而广受世界关注。
en: Over the years, Costa Rica, a country of fewer than five million people, has gained attention worldwide for its progressive leadership.

zh: 1948年，在经过短暂的内战后，总统费雷尔废除了军队。
en: In 1948, after a short civil war, President José Figueres Ferrer abolished the military.

zh: 伺候，哥斯达黎加便成为冲突解决和预防研究的中心，建立了联合国管理的和平大学。
en: Since then, Costa Rica has made itself a center for the study of conflict resolution and prevention, hosting the United Nations-mandated University for Peace.

zh: 哥斯达黎加不但拥有丰富的生物多样性，更表现出具有远见卓识的环境领导力，致力于再造森林，全国三分之一领土被划为自然保护区，几乎全部电力都来自清洁的水电。
en: With its rich biodiversity, Costa Rica has also demonstrated far-sighted environmental leadership by pursuing reforestation, designating a third of the country protected natural reserves, and deriving almost all of its electricity from clean hydro power.

zh: 哥斯达黎加人不准备放弃他们的进步遗产。
en: Costa Ricans show no signs of abandoning their progressive legacy.

zh: 在最近的总统竞选中，在高投票率的推动下，奎萨达凭借60%多的支持率赢得胜利，而他的反对者准备限制同性恋婚姻，这是哥斯达黎加长期以来坚持人权政策的倒退。
en: In the recent presidential election, a large turnout carried Carlos Alvarado Quesada to victory with more than 60% of the vote, against an opponent who would have rolled back longstanding commitments to human rights by restricting gay marriage.

zh: 哥斯达黎加加入了所谓的福利联盟（Wellbeing Alliance ） ， 这是一个由少数国家组成的联盟，致力于实施经济表现和社会进步措施国际委员会（International Commission on the Measurement of Economic Performance and Social Progress）强调的概念，设计更好的福利指标。
en: Costa Rica has joined a small group of countries in the so-called Wellbeing Alliance, which is implementing ideas, highlighted by the International Commission on the Measurement of Economic Performance and Social Progress, for constructing better welfare metrics.

zh: 福利联盟承认委员会所强调的GDP的缺陷，寻求确保公共政策能够通过促进民主、可持续性和包容性增长，推进公民的最广义福利水平。
en: Recognizing the shortcomings of GDP that the Commission emphasized, the Alliance seeks to ensure that public policy advances citizens’ wellbeing in the broadest sense, by promoting democracy, sustainability, and inclusive growth.

zh: 该计划的一个重要部分是扩大该国已经相当强大的合作社和社会单位的规模，设法再纳入五分之一人口。
en: An important part of this effort has been to broaden the scope for the country’s cooperatives and social enterprises, which are already strong, embracing in one way or another a fifth of the population.

zh: 这些机构是对资本主义的极端形式的可行替代品，极端资本主义导致了许多道德败坏行为的出现，如金融业的掠夺性贷款和市场操纵、科技公司滥用个人数据，以及汽车工业的排放作弊等。
en: These institutions represent a viable alternative to the extremes of capitalism that have given rise to morally reprehensible practices, from predatory lending and market manipulation in the financial sector to tech companies’ abuse of personal data and emissions cheating in the automobile industry.

zh: 它们建立在构建信任和合作的基础上，也建立在一个信念的基础上：关注成员的福祉不但能提高福利，也能提高生产率。
en: They are based on building trust and cooperation, and on the belief that focusing on the welfare of their members not only enhances wellbeing, but also increases productivity.

zh: 和一些其他国家的公民一样，哥斯达黎加人证明了不平等性是一种选择，公共政策能够确保比光靠市场提供的更大程度的经济平等和机会成本。
en: Like citizens of a few other countries, Costa Ricans have made clear that inequality is a choice, and that public policies can ensure a greater degree of economic equality and equality of opportunity than the market alone would provide.

zh: 他们甚至凭借有限的资源，实现了高质量的免费公费医疗和教育。
en: Even with limited resources, they boast about the quality of their free public health-care and education systems.

zh: 如今，哥斯达黎加寿命预期比美国更高，并在继续增加，而选择不采取改善普通公民福利所需要的措施的美国人，寿命正在变短。
en: Life expectancy is now higher than in the United States, and is increasing, while Americans, having chosen not to take the steps needed to improve the wellbeing of ordinary citizens, are dying sooner.

zh: 但哥斯达黎加固然取得了这些成功，也面临着两个关键性问题：持续的结构性财政赤字和僵化的政治制度。
en: But for all of its successes, Costa Rica faces two critical problems: a persistent, structural fiscal deficit and a gridlocked political system.

zh: 财政赤字的经济学很简单：刺激经济增长，提高税收或减少支出。
en: The economics of fiscal deficits are easy: boost economic growth, raise taxes, or lower expenditures.

zh: 但政治学完全不容易：所有政治领导人都希望经济增长解决问题，但经济增长不是天上掉下来的。
en: But the politics are not easy at all: While every political leader wants economic growth to solve the problem, there is no magic formula to achieve it.

zh: 没人喜欢其他两个选项。
en: No one loves the two remaining options.

zh: 大部分面对这一局面的政府会砍掉基础设施等项目，因为这样做的成本需要几十年才会显现出来。
en: Most governments in such circumstances cut items like infrastructure, because the costs go unseen for decades.

zh: 而对哥斯达黎加来说，这一错误将会更加严重，因为哥斯达黎加的基础设施无法完全跟上经济增长，如果能加以改善，其本身可以成为推动增长的重要因素。
en: That would be an even graver mistake for Costa Rica, where infrastructure has not fully kept up with economic growth and, if improved, could itself be important in promoting growth.

zh: 当然，政府永远可以更加高效，但在经历了多年的整顿后，进一步合理化空间已经不大。
en: Of course, government could always be more efficient, but after years of retrenchment, further rationalization is unlikely to deliver much.

zh: 几乎可以肯定，最好的办法是提高税收。
en: Almost surely, the best way forward would be to raise taxes.

zh: 要让税收与寻求全体公民福利最大化的总体经济战略相适应，税收制度应该遵循三个核心原则：对坏事物（如污染）而不是好事物（如工作 ） ； 税收的设计要尽量减小经济的扭曲；要维持累进性税率结构，让富有个体缴纳收入的更大比例。
en: To reconcile taxation with an overall economic strategy that seeks to maximize all citizens’ wellbeing, the tax system should adhere to three central principles: tax bad things (like pollution), rather than good things (like work); design taxes to cause the least possible distortion in the economy; and maintain a progressive rate structure, with richer individuals paying a larger share of their income.

zh: 哥斯达黎加已经实现了经济绿色化，因此征收碳税无法像其他国家那样筹集那么多资金。
en: Because Costa Rica is already so green, a carbon tax would not raise as much money as elsewhere.

zh: 但由于哥斯达黎加几乎全部电力都是清洁电力，转向电动汽车讲师更有效的二氧化碳减排之道。
en: But, because virtually all of the country’s electricity is clean, a shift to electric cars would be more effective in reducing carbon dioxide emissions.

zh: 这一税收有助于哥斯达黎加成为世界上第一个电动汽车占主导地位的国家，使其更加接近实现碳中性经济的目标。
en: Such a tax could help Costa Rica become the first country where electric cars dominate, moving it still closer to the goal of achieving a carbon-neutral economy.

zh: 在不平等性仍然是一个问题的情况下（尽管不如拉丁美洲其他国家那么尖锐 ） ， 更加累进和全面的所得、资本利得和财产税至关重要。
en: With inequality still a problem (though nowhere near as acute as elsewhere in Latin America), more progressive and comprehensive income, capital gains, and property taxes are essential.

zh: 富人的所得很大一部分通过资本利得获得，而如果资本利得税率比其他所得税率更低，将加剧不平等性，导致扭曲。
en: The rich receive a disproportionately large share of their income through capital gains, and to tax capital gains at rates lower than other forms of income exacerbates inequality and leads to distortions.

zh: 经济学家在许多事情上都存在分歧，但可以形成一致的一点是向得自哥斯达黎加土地的收入或资本利得征税不会让土地逃掉。
en: While economists differ on many matters, one thing they can agree on is that taxing the revenues or capital gains derived from Costa Rica’s land won’t cause the land to move away.

zh: 这就是十九世纪大经济学家亨利·乔治（Henry George）认为土地税是最好的税的原因之一。
en: That’s one reason why the great nineteenth-century economist Henry George argued that the best taxes are land taxes.

zh: 最大的挑战是政治：哥斯达黎加的总统制在有两个主要政党、规则被制定来确保少数意见获得充分尊重的政体中运转良好。
en: The biggest challenges are political: a presidential system like Costa Rica’s works well in a polity divided into two main parties, with rules designed to ensure that minority views are adequately respected.

zh: 但如果选民感到失望的话，这套制度可能会迅速导致僵局。
en: But such a system can quickly lead to political gridlock when the electorate becomes more fractured.

zh: 而在一个日新月异的世界中，政治僵局可能带来高昂的代价。
en: And in a fast-changing world, political gridlock can be costly.

zh: 赤字和预算可能“爆炸 ” ， 变得不可收拾。
en: Deficits and debts can explode, with no path towards resolution.

zh: 年仅38岁的阿尔巴拉多（Alvarado）正在试图为哥斯达黎加创一个新的总统模式，这一模式不必修订宪法，而是从各方遴选部长。
en: Alvarado, who is just 38, is attempting to create a new presidential model for Costa Rica, without changing the constitution, by drawing ministers from a range of parties.

zh: 我们希望，这场合作运动所铸就并植根于哥斯达黎加文化的合作精神能够起作用。
en: One hopes that the spirit of cooperation fostered by the cooperative movement, and ingrained in so much of Costa Rican culture, will make it work.

zh: 果真如此的话，蕞尔小国哥斯达黎加将成为未来的希望灯塔，证明有可能存在另一个世界，在这里，启蒙价值观 — — 道理、理性对话、科学和自由 — — 将会兴盛发达，让所有人都受益。
en: If it does, Costa Rica, despite its small size, will be a beacon of hope for the future, showing that another world is possible, one where Enlightenment values – reason, rational discourse, science, and freedom – flourish, to the benefit of all.

zh: 收入失衡引致的高昂社会成本
en: The Rising Costs of US Income Inequality

zh: 发至伯克利 — — 在过去数十年间，美国的收入失衡现象严重加剧 — — 且未有任何逆转的迹象。
en: BERKELEY – During the last several decades, income inequality in the United States has increased significantly – and the trend shows no sign of reversing.

zh: 而上次出现如此严重的失衡还是大萧条之前了。
en: The last time inequality was as high as it is now was just before the Great Depression.

zh: 如此严重的收入失衡不仅与人们普遍信奉的社会公平和机会均等准则无法匹配；更对美国的经济和民主制度造成了严重威胁。
en: Such a high level of inequality is not only incompatible with widely held norms of social justice and equality of opportunity; it poses a serious threat to America’s economy and democracy.

zh: 导致该国收入失衡状况不断加剧的深层次原因则是绝大多数美国民众的收入停滞。
en: Underlying the country’s soaring inequality is income stagnation for the majority of Americans.

zh: 一方面经济增长收益流向了极少数高收入美国家庭的份额越来越大，另一方面下层那90%家庭的平均收入却自1980年以来一直原地踏步。 按照经济顾问委员会最近发布的一份报告。
en: With an expanding share of the gains from economic growth flowing to a tiny fraction of high-income US households, average family income for the bottom 90% has been flat since 1980.

zh: 如果2013年流向下面那90%家庭的收入比例跟1973年一样的话，年均家庭收入中位数（按照家庭成员数量有所调整）将是18 % 。 或者约9000美元，高于现在的水平。
en: According to a recent report by the Council of Economic Advisers, if the share of income going to the bottom 90% was the same in 2013 as it was in 1973, median annual household income (adjusted for family size) would be 18%, or about $9,000, higher than it is now.

zh: 在缴税和转移支付之后的美国贫穷家庭可支配收入在这数十年中长期落后于其他发达国家的相同人群。
en: The disposable (after tax and transfer) incomes of poor families in the US have trailed those of their counterparts in other developed countries for decades.

zh: 如今美国的中产阶级也步了前者的后尘。
en: Now the US middle class is also falling behind.

zh: 在过去30年中，绝大多数发达国家中等收入家庭的可支配收入增长要比同等的美国家庭要高。
en: During the last three decades, middle-income households in most developed countries enjoyed larger increases in disposable income than comparable US households.

zh: 今年，美国把拥有最富裕中产阶级国家的宝座让给了加拿大，而几个欧洲国家也逐渐赶超了上来。
en: This year, the US lost the distinction of having the “most affluent” middle class to Canada, with several European countries not far behind.

zh: 而倘若把慷慨的公共教育，医疗，和退休收益都计入这些国家的家庭可支配收入计算中的话，那美国中产阶级的相对位置只会滑向得更远。 。
en: Once the generous public benefits in education, health care, and retirement are added to estimates of disposable family income in these countries, the relative position of the US middle class slips even further.

zh: 而美国中产阶级优越生活逐渐失落的主要原因则是工资增长的放缓。
en: The main culprit behind the languishing fortunes of America’s middle class is slow wage growth.

zh: 在1970年代的高峰期过后。 计入通胀后的25到64岁全职员工实际收入中位数陷入停滞，这一部分是由于生产率增长的放缓，另一部分则源自于生产率和工资增长之间不断扩大的鸿沟。
en: After peaking in the early 1970s, real (inflation-adjusted) median earnings of full-time workers aged 25-64 stagnated, partly owing to a slowdown in productivity growth and partly because of a yawning gap between productivity and wage growth.

zh: 自1980年以来，平均实际。 时薪增长仅为每年1 % ， 或仅仅是生产力增长率的一半。
en: Since 1980, average real hourly compensation has increased at an annual rate of 1%, or half the rate of productivity growth.

zh: 工资收入的不平等状况也变得相当明显，加工资最多的人是那最顶端的10 % 。
en: Wage gains have also become considerably more unequal, with the biggest increases claimed by the top 10% of earners.

zh: 此外科学技术变革和全球化减少了中等技能工作在总体就业中的份额，而低技术工种职位的比例则有所增加。
en: Moreover, technological change and globalization have reduced the share of middle-skill jobs in overall employment, while the share of lower-skill jobs has increased.

zh: 这些趋势再加上过去十年中劳动力参与率的持续降低，正好解释了中产阶级收入陷入停滞的原因
en: These trends, along with a falling labor-force participation rate during the last decade, explain the stagnation of middle-class incomes.

zh: 对大多数美国人来说，工资是可支配收入的主要来源，也反过来驱动着个人消费支出 — — 也是目前总需求中份额最大的一部分。 过去数十年间。
en: For most Americans, wages are the primary source of disposable income, which in turn drives personal consumption spending – by far the largest component of aggregate demand.

zh: 随着可支配收入的增长不断放缓。 中产和低收入家庭只能靠借贷来维持消费。
en: Over the past several decades, as growth in disposable income slowed, middle- and lower-income households turned to debt to sustain consumption.

zh: 由于这些家庭努力与富有家庭的消费标准保持同步，导致个人储蓄率急跌，而信贷和抵押贷款负债高涨。
en: Personal savings rates collapsed, and credit and mortgage debt soared, as households attempted to keep pace with the consumption norms of the wealthy.

zh: 在相当一段时间中，不断扩大的收入失衡现象并未拉低消费的增长；事实上 ， “ 跟风消费”的压力孕育了更多的消费者支出，更多的借贷，更多的破产，以及中等和低收入家庭越来越大的财务压力。 。
en: For quite some time, growing income inequality did not slow consumption growth; indeed, “trickle-down consumption” pressures fostered more consumer spending, more debt, more bankruptcy, and more financial stress among middle- and lower-income households.

zh: 而秋后算账的时刻也随着2007至2008年的金融危机而到来。
en: The moment of reckoning arrived with the 2007-2008 financial crisis.

zh: 自那以后，消费总量增长陷入停滞，因为中低收入家庭被迫减少借贷并清偿自身债务，而这往往是通过痛苦的住宅 — — 也是这些家庭的主要（而且往往是唯一）财产 — — 贷款违约行为来实现的。
en: Since then, aggregate consumption growth has been lackluster, as middle- and lower-income families have been forced to reduce their borrowing and pay down their debt, often through painful defaults on their homes – their primary (and often their only) asset.

zh: 由于这些家庭开始勒紧裤腰带生活，消费支出和经济增长的速度就更加依赖于收入分配顶层的群体。
en: As these families have tightened their belts, the pace of consumption spending and economic growth has become more dependent on earners at the top of the income distribution.

zh: 自从衰退在2009年终结之后，社会最顶层的那5%群体的实际消费支出增长了17 % ， 而其他95%的群体的增长仅为1 % 。
en: Since the recession ended in 2009, real consumption spending by the top 5% has increased by 17%, compared to just 1% for the bottom 95%.

zh: 这个经济复原模式也强化了一个长期趋势。
en: The recovery’s pattern has reinforced longer-run trends.

zh: 在2012年，收入最高的那5%的群体占据了个人消费支出的38 % ， 而1995年这个数字为27 % 。
en: In 2012, the top 5% of earners accounted for 38% of personal-consumption expenditure, compared to 27% in 1995.

zh: 在同一时期。 其他80%的群体消费比例则从47%下降到了39 % 。
en: During that period, the consumption share for the bottom 80% of earners dropped from 47% to 39%.

zh: 展望未来，不断加剧的收入失衡以及大部分��国人的收入停滞意味着更疲软的总需求以及更缓慢的经济增长。
en: Looking to the future, growing income inequality and stagnant incomes for the majority of Americans mean weaker aggregate demand and slower growth.

zh: 更重要的是，收入失衡通过其在教育机会和人力资本发展方面的负面作用，又在供应端限制了经济增长。
en: Even more important, income inequality constrains economic growth on the supply side through its adverse effects on educational opportunity and human-capital development.

zh: 出生在低收入和高收入家庭的儿童其实有着同样的天赋，但却占据着不同的教育机会。
en: Children born into low- and high-income families are born with similar abilities.

zh: 低收入家庭的儿童更缺乏接受早期教育的渠道，更可能就读于那些提供低劣12年制教育的学校，也更少机会去接受或完成大学教育。
en: But they have very different educational opportunities, with children in low-income families less likely to have access to early childhood education, more likely to attend under-resourced schools that deliver inferior K-12 education, and less likely to attend or complete college.

zh: 这两种家庭孩子之间随之产生的教育成就鸿沟在儿童早年开始出现，并随着时间的推移不断扩大。
en: The resulting educational-attainment gap between children born into low and high-income families emerges at an early age and grows over time.

zh: 按照某些估算数据，这一鸿沟比20年前扩大了一倍。
en: By some estimates, the gap today is twice as large as it was two decades ago.

zh: 至此美国已经陷入了一个恶性循环：不断增长的收入失衡孕育了教育机会的更加不均等，也随之在教育成就方面催生了更大的不平等。
en: So the US is caught in a vicious circle: rising income inequality breeds more inequality in educational opportunity, which generates greater inequality in educational attainment.

zh: 这反过来意味着被浪费了的人类天赋，教育程度更低的劳动力群体，更缓慢的经济增长。 以及更大的收入失衡。
en: That, in turn, translates into a waste of human talent, a less educated workforce, slower economic growth, and even greater income inequality.

zh: 即便收入失衡的经济成本已经极为庞大，但因此产生的政治成本或许更具破坏性和危险性，因为富人同时具备动机和能力去推动一些政策的实施以维持或强化自身地位。
en: Although the economic costs of income inequality are substantial, the political costs may prove to be the most damaging and dangerous. The rich have both the incentives and the ability to promote policies that maintain or enhance their position.

zh: 考虑到美国最高法院对选举资助行为限制的松绑，高度集中的经济力量也比以往更容易去操纵高度集中政治权力。
en: Given the US Supreme Court’s evisceration of campaign-finance restrictions, it has become easier than ever for concentrated economic power to exercise concentrated political power.

zh: 虽然选举赞助并不一定能保证胜选，却给了经济精英们更多接触和联络立法者，监管者及其他政府官员的渠道，让他们可以塑造更符合自身利益的政治议程。
en: Though campaign contributions do not guarantee victory, they give the economic elite greater access to legislators, regulators, and other public officials, enabling them to shape the political debate in favor of their interests.

zh: 于是乎，美国的政治就越来越被金钱所操纵。
en: As a result, the US political system is increasingly dominated by money.

zh: 这也是一个明确的标志，说明美国的收入失衡状况已经上升到了不仅威胁经济发展，同时也威胁到了民主体制健康运行的程度。
en: This is a clear sign that income inequality in the US has risen to levels that threaten not only the economy’s growth, but also the health of its democracy.

zh: 普京战争的代价
en: The Toll of Putin’s Wars

zh: 斯德哥尔摩 — — 战争将要付出昂贵的代价，俄罗斯人民现在正在感受到这一点。
en: STOCKHOLM – Wars are expensive, as the Russian people are now learning.

zh: 克里姆林正在东乌克兰和叙利亚地区进行军事冒险，尽管这些冲突规模有限，但人们不禁怀疑这个国家是否真正有能力承担。
en: The Kremlin is pursuing military adventures in Eastern Ukraine and Syria, and though these conflicts are limited in scope, one wonders if the country can really afford them.

zh: 身为世界第11大经济体，俄罗斯在短期内可以支撑得住。
en: As the world’s 11th largest economy, Russia can manage in the short term.

zh: 但长远来看结果却可能不容乐观。
en: But the long term is quite another matter.

zh: 据权威的斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所数据显示，从2008到2016年，俄罗斯的军费开支已经从占国内生产总值的3.3 % （ 与美国当前水平大致相当）增长到约占其国内生产总值的5.3 % 。
en: From 2008 to 2016, Russia increased its military expenditures from 3.3% of GDP – which roughly corresponds to the current US level – to 5.3%, according to the authoritative Stockholm International Peace Research Institute.

zh: 俄罗斯政府自己的财政统计数据显示 — — 俄财政数据现在仍令人惊讶地对外开放 — — 其在被占领土克里米亚每年需要耗费的民政支出大约达到20亿美元。
en: According to the Russian government’s own fiscal statistics – which remain surprisingly open – its civilian expenditures in occupied Crimea come to around $2 billion per year.

zh: 虽然找不到俄罗斯在东克里米亚的公开数据，但可以靠谱地假设那里的成本也大体相同。 因此俄罗斯需要花费每年40亿美元 — — 约占其国内生产总值的0.3 % — —来支撑这两项行动。
en: And while there are no public data on its presence in Eastern Ukraine, it is safe to assume that the costs there are roughly the same, in which case Russia is spending $4 billion per year – 0.3% of GDP – on these two operations alone.

zh: 但除军事开支外，俄罗斯还需承担贸易和投资损失的成本，这足以使该国经济在战争期间陷入到增长停滞中。
en: Yet, beyond military expenditures, Russia is also incurring the costs of lost trade and investment, as well as escalating sanctions, which are more than enough to condemn the country to stagnation for as long as its wars last.

zh: 2014年7月，美国联合欧盟对俄罗斯的金融、石油及天然气和国防科技行业实施制裁，以惩戒其对乌克兰顿巴斯地区的军事入侵。
en: In July 2014, the United States and the European Union imposed sanctions on Russia’s finance, oil and gas, and defense technologies sectors, in response to its military aggression in Ukraine’s Donbas region.

zh: 迄今为止，上述措施很好地发挥了作用。
en: So far, these measures have been effective.

zh: 美元才是全球金融领域的王道。
en: In global finance, the dollar is king.

zh: 而因为每一美元的流动都要通过美国银行，美元交易的最终管辖权均属于美国财政部。
en: And because every dollar passes through US banks, dollar transactions are ultimately subject to the US Department of the Treasury’s jurisdiction.

zh: 因此美国可以通过金融制裁切断俄罗斯的国外资金。
en: Through financial sanctions, the US can thus starve Russia of foreign investment.

zh: 2015年8月，据国际货币基金组织估计西方制裁将即刻导致俄罗斯（经通胀调整后的）实际国内生产总值降低1~1.5 % 。
en: In August 2015, the International Monetary Fund estimated that Western sanctions would immediately reduce Russia’s real (inflation-adjusted) GDP by 1-1.5%.

zh: 但从中期来看，国际货币基金组织认为因为低水平的资本积累和技术转移削弱了本已处于下降通道的生产率增长，制裁可能导致高达国内生产总值9%的累计产出损失。
en: In the medium term, however, the IMF concluded that sanctions “could lead to a cumulative output loss…of up to 9% of GDP, as lower capital accumulation and technological transfers weaken already declining productivity growth.”

zh: 在被剔除出美元环流后，俄罗斯企业别无选择只能偿还到期债务。
en: After being cut off from the dollar, Russian corporations have had no choice but to pay off debt as it comes due.

zh: 俄罗斯外债总额因此从2014年6月的7，320亿美元下降到2015年12月的5，190亿美元，此后一直在该水平上下浮动。
en: As a result, Russia’s total foreign debt declined from $732 billion in June 2014 to $519 billion in December 2015, and it has stayed near that level ever since.

zh: 同样，俄罗斯国际外汇储备从2013年底的5，100亿美元降至2015年3月3，560亿美元的新低。
en: Similarly, Russia’s international currency reserves declined from $510 billion at the end of 2013 to a low of $356 billion in March 2015.

zh: 此后，由于俄罗斯长期存在的巨额经常账户盈余，该国外汇储备逐渐恢复到4，580亿美元。
en: Since then, they have recovered to $458 billion, owing to Russia’s persistent and large current-account surplus.

zh: 但从2015至2017年，俄罗斯的外国直接投资每年还不到国内生产总值的2 % 、 — — 该数据较之前些年近乎腰斩 — — 这不仅反映了投资的减少，而且也反映了技术进口的降低。
en: But, from 2015 to 2017, foreign direct investment in Russia amounted to less than 2% of GDP per year, on average – almost half what it had been in the preceding years – reflecting not just falling investment, but also reduced technology imports.

zh: 借助这所有一切，俄罗斯成功维护了宏观经济稳定和外部平衡，但却避免不了产出下降和人民生活水平大幅下滑的厄运。
en: Through all of this, Russia has managed to maintain macroeconomic stability and external balances, but it has suffered a minor decline in output and a major decline in the standard of living.

zh: 在实施制裁的2014到2017年中，民众实际可支配收入下降了17 % 、 投资骤降了12 % ， 虽然国内生产总值在此期间仅下降了0.5％的水平。
en: During the four sanction years from 2014 to 2017, real disposable incomes plunged by 17%, and investment slumped by 12%, though GDP fell by only 0.5% in this period.

zh: 此外，俄罗斯和乌克兰持续升级彼此的贸易制裁行动。
en: Meanwhile, Russia and Ukraine have been imposing escalating trade sanctions on each another.

zh: 结果导致2012至2016年间两国相互贸易下降达80 % 。
en: As a result, their mutual trade fell by 80% between 2012 and 2016.

zh: 贸易战对乌克兰影响更大；但俄罗斯也失去了重要的出口市场和进口军事装备的主要来源。
en: The trade war has hurt Ukraine more; but Russia, too, has lost a significant export market and a major source of imported military equipment.

zh: 曾几何时是俄罗斯最重要能源客户的乌克兰自2015年11月以来从未向俄罗斯进口任何天然气。
en: Once Russia’s most important energy customer, Ukraine has not imported any natural gas from Russia since November 2015.

zh: 同样代价惨重的是俄罗斯在克里米亚和顿巴斯地区没收的财产。
en: Russia’s asset seizures in Crimea and Donbas have also been costly.

zh: 例如，根据1998年乌克兰-俄罗斯双边投资条约，乌克兰企业已在海牙常设仲裁法庭提出了至少八起针对俄罗斯联邦的诉讼。
en: For example, under a 1998 Ukrainian-Russian bilateral investment treaty, Ukrainian companies have filed at least eight lawsuits against the Russian Federation at the Permanent Court of Arbitration in The Hague.

zh: 仅乌克兰国有能源巨头乌克兰石油天然气公司及其子公司就提出了高达70亿美元的索赔要求，而Oschadbank、Privatbank和Ukrnafta等机构则各索赔10亿美元。
en: The Ukrainian state-owned energy giant Naftogaz and its subsidiaries alone are claiming $7 billion in damages, while Oschadbank, Privatbank, and Ukrnafta are seeking compensation of $1 billion each.

zh: 其中一家由乌克兰企业集团提出的诉讼已经获胜，而其他案件也很有可能做出同样的裁决。
en: One case brought by a group of Ukrainian companies has already been won, and the rest are likely to go the same way.

zh: 按照这样的态势，俄罗斯非法没收乌克兰财产或许成本会超过100亿美元。
en: At this rate, Russia’s illegal confiscations will probably cost it at least $10 billion.

zh: 乌克兰石油天然气公司针对俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司提起的诉讼也同样取得了成功。
en: Naftogaz has also brought a successful case against the Russian energy giant Gazprom.

zh: 今年2月，斯德哥尔摩仲裁法庭裁定，俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司必须为破坏两家企业之前的协定赔偿乌克兰石油天然气公司损失25.6亿美元。
en: In February, the Stockholm arbitration court ruled that Gazprom must award Naftogaz $2.56 billion in damages for breach of a previous agreement between the two companies.

zh: 俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司此后拒绝赔偿，而乌克兰石油天然气公司则全力追索俄天然气工业股份公司的海外资产。
en: Gazprom has since refused to pay, and Naftogaz has responded by going after its assets abroad.

zh: 事实证明，俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司可能为其无视商业仲裁所作的判决而付出高昂的成本。
en: Gazprom’s disregard for a commercial arbitration verdict could prove costly indeed.

zh: 由于目前看不到乌克兰冲突有任何解决的希望，制裁措施很可能会长期存在。
en: With no solution to the Ukraine conflict in sight, sanctions will likely remain in place for the long term.

zh: 制裁往往十分棘手，因为引发制裁的冲突往往会不断扩大和演变。
en: Sanctions tend to be sticky, because the conflicts that spur them usually multiply and evolve.

zh: 例如，今年4月，美国因为俄罗斯干预2016年美国总统大选而实施了额外的制裁。
en: For example, in April, the US imposed additional sanctions in response to Russia’s interference in the 2016 US presidential election.

zh: 这些新举措沉重打击了俄罗斯的卢布和股市。
en: Those new measures have hit the Russian ruble and stock market hard.

zh: 而现在，继普京和特朗普今年夏天在赫尔辛基举行的可疑峰会后，美国国会正在发起新一轮攻势。
en: And now, the US Congress is leading a new offensive, following Putin and Trump’s suspicious summit in Helsinki this summer.

zh: 因为去年已经通过制裁法案实行了打击美国对手法，两党国会联盟将很快批准更严厉的制裁措施，例如极有可能打击俄罗斯主权债务和国有金融机构。
en: Having already enacted the Countering American Adversaries Through Sanctions Act last year, a bipartisan congressional coalition will soon approve even more severe sanctions, most likely hitting Russian sovereign debt and state-owned financial institutions.

zh: 仅仅是美国进一步的制裁威胁就已经令俄罗斯市场陷入混乱。
en: The mere threat of more US sanctions has already roiled the Russian market.

zh: 虽然俄罗斯仍勉强维持着1.5%的年增长率，但与其军事侵略相关的年度民事、法律和其他成本现在已经达到其国内生产总值的至少3~4 % ， 也就是450到600亿美元。
en: While Russia’s annual growth rate is stuck at an anemic 1.5%, the annual civilian, legal, and other related costs of its military aggression are now at least 3-4% of GDP – or $45-60 billion.

zh: 克里姆林现在或许还能勉强支撑。
en: The Kremlin may be managing for now.

zh: 但这些不断增加的成本迟早将带来严重的政治后果。
en: But sooner or later, these mounting costs will have serious political consequences.

zh: 伊拉克撤军倒计时
en: Countdown to Withdrawal from Iraq

zh: 美国在伊拉克大规模的军事部署会维持到何时？
en: How long will the United States maintain a large deployment of troops in Iraq?

zh: 这正是当前布什第二任总统任期的中心问题。
en: That is now the central question of George W. Bush’s second term.

zh: 直到最近，布什政府用一句很老套的话作为回答 ： “ 到了该撤军的时候，我们一天都不会拖延。
en: Until recently, the Bush administration answered with an evasive cliché: “as long as it takes and not one day longer.”

zh: ”这就是他们做出的全部许诺。
en: But not anymore.

zh: 11月17日，当民主党鹰派众议员、海军老兵约翰•默撒（John Murtha）提出在六个月内撤出伊拉克的建议时，这种僵持局面才开始得到缓和。
en: The ice began to crack on November 17, when Representative John Murtha, a hawkish Democratic congressman and marine veteran, suggested pulling troops out of Iraq in six months.

zh: 不久，由共和党控制的参议院对“2006年向实现伊拉克全面主权过渡”的议题进行了投票。
en: Soon after, the Republican-controlled Senate voted for “a significant transition to full Iraq sovereignty in 2006.”

zh: 布什开始表示反对，继而改变措辞，表示会比先前预期的时间更早一些削减驻伊部队。
en: After initial resistance, Bush began to change his rhetoric by suggesting that a troop drawdown would occur sooner than previously expected.

zh: 公众对布什伊拉克政策的支持率明显下降。
en: The erosion in public support for Bush’s Iraq policy is stark.

zh: 54%的美国人现在认为美国派遣部队是个错误，而在2003年战争刚刚开始的时候这个数字只有24 % 。
en: Fifty-four percent of Americans now say that the US erred in sending troops, up from 24% at the start of the war in March 2003.

zh: 这在某种程度上反映出伤亡率的持续上升，现在美国士兵的伤亡数量已经超过2100人。
en: In part, this reflects the rising casualty rate, with more than 2,100 American soldiers killed thus far.

zh: 但是这也反映出，越来越多的人认为这场战争是令人失望的。
en: But it also reflects a growing belief that the war is failing.

zh: 民意学专家、现任白宫顾问的杜克大学的彼得•费韦尔（Peter Feaver）最近指出，美国人民在相信战争正义性的前提下尚可以容忍伤亡，并会合乎情理的期待胜利到来。
en: As Duke University’s Peter Feaver, an expert on public opinion who is now serving as a White House advisor, recently pointed out, Americans will tolerate casualties when they believe that a war is just and has a reasonable prospect of success.

zh: 但是对于这两点，他们现在均表示出怀疑。
en: But citizens now doubt both these points.

zh: 政府也正在为过分寻找战争借口和侵略后占领的混乱局面付出代价。
en: The administration is paying the price for overselling the reasons for the war and bungling the post-invasion occupation.

zh: 布什变换措辞强调说，他有自己的“制胜策略 ” ， 这一点儿也不出人意料。
en: Not surprisingly, Bush’s new rhetoric stresses that he has a “strategy for victory.”

zh: 如果我们仍然把胜利定义为伊拉克稳定的民主状态，那么布什似乎就没有充足的时间实施他的“策略”了。
en: If “victory” remains defined as stable democracy in Iraq, it is unlikely that Bush will have enough time to implement his strategy.

zh: 九月，驻伊美军指挥官乔治•凯西（George Casey）将军向国会证实，现代化的武装叛乱已经持续大约十年，在没有美军支援的情况下，伊拉克军队只有一个营的力量可以与之抵抗。
en: In September, General George Casey, the senior American military commander in Iraq, testified to Congress that modern insurgencies last about a decade, and that the Iraqi army had only one battalion capable of fighting without help from American military forces.

zh: 一个月后，颇具影响力的伦敦国际战略研究所做出预计：明年美国的撤军行动规模会比较小，并且伊拉克要建设30万有能力单独镇压叛乱的强大军队，至少还需要5年时间。
en: A month later, the influential International Institute for Strategic Studies in London estimated that US troop withdrawals next year were likely to be small, and that it would take at least five years for Iraq to build the 300,000-strong army needed to fight the insurgency on its own.

zh: 但是对即将于2006年开始的国会大选和2008年的总统大选而言，五年的时间毕竟太长。
en: But, with Congressional elections in 2006 and a presidential election in 2008, five years is too long.

zh: 看来，共和党只有一年半或者两年的时间来实施它的策略了。
en: It seems more realistic that the Republican administration will have only 18 months to two years to implement its strategy.

zh: 同时，民主党成员之间的意见也不一致。
en: The Democrats, meanwhile, are divided.

zh: 约翰•默撒和众议院少数派领袖南希·珀罗希（Nancy Pelosi）等人要求在短期内完成撤军，而以参议院议员约瑟夫•拜登（Joseph Biden）为代表的人则反对固定的时间表，预期美国将在2006年撤军5万，继而在2007年撤出剩余的10万军队。
en: Some, like John Murtha and Nancy Pelosi, the minority leader in the House of Representatives, want a short timetable, while others, like Senator Joseph Biden, resists a firm timetable but predicts a withdrawal of 50,000 US troops in 2006, with many of the remaining 100,000 to follow in 2007.

zh: 我们当中坚持侵略伊拉克是错误的，并且坚持布什应该对缺乏战后规划负责的人现在面临着一个两难的境地：如果美国撤军过于仓促，可能又会错上加错。
en: Those of us who believe that invading Iraq was a mistake, and that Bush is guilty of hubris in his failure to plan adequately for the aftermath, face a dilemma: if America withdraws too precipitously, it may compound these mistakes.

zh: 伊拉克不同于越南，越南在美国撤离之后，进入独裁政府强加的稳定局面。
en: Iraq is not like Vietnam, where American departure was followed by stability imposed by an authoritarian government.

zh: 而伊拉克的危险在于：撤军会导致内战和混乱局面¾而这又为恐怖分子活动提供了最理想的环境。
en: In Iraq, the danger is that departure could be followed by civil war and chaos – ideal conditions for terrorists to maintain havens.

zh: 伊拉克和越南的区别还体现在另外一个方面。
en: Iraq differs from Vietnam in another way as well.

zh: 和北越不一样，逊尼派叛乱者只占总人口的20 % ， 要想控制整个国家不是件容易的事。
en: Unlike the North Vietnamese, the Sunni insurgents will have a difficult time taking over a country where they represent only 20% of the population.

zh: 而什叶派和库尔德人却占据了全国人口的80 % ， 叛乱只是集中在伊拉克18个省份中的4个而已。
en: Indeed, with Shia Arabs and Kurds making up 80% of the country, the insurgency is focused on only four of Iraq’s 18 provinces.

zh: 美国的窘境在于它既是导致问题的一个因素，同时又是解决问题的部分力量。
en: America’s quandary is that it is both part of the problem and part of the solution.

zh: 只要美国部队占领伊拉克一天，就只会招致更多的叛乱。
en: So long as a large number of American troops remains as an occupying force, they serve as a recruiting tool for insurgents.

zh: 正像政治学家罗伯特•帕普（Robert Pape）在一项深入研究中揭示的那样，抵制外国军队占领是自杀性爆炸事件的首要诱因。
en: As the political scientist Robert Pape has shown in a careful study, resistance to foreign occupation is a prime motivation for suicide bombers.

zh: 但是如果美国过早撤离，当选的伊拉克政府又可能无力应付叛乱局面，从而使伊拉克陷入上世纪80年代黎巴嫩、或者90年代阿富汗的状态。
en: But, if America leaves too soon, the elected Iraqi government may be unable to cope with the insurgency, sending Iraq the way of Lebanon in the 1980’s or Afghanistan in the 1990’s.

zh: 同样，如果布什制定一个短期撤军计划，那他可能鼓励叛乱分子坐等他离开。
en: Similarly, if Bush sets a short timetable, he may encourage the insurgents to wait him out.

zh: 但除非他明确表示美���将在近期撤离，否则只会加深别人心目中美国强权占领的印象。
en: But, unless he makes it clear that American troops will leave in the near term, he will reinforce the impression of imperial occupation.

zh: 解决这一尴尬局面的关键是要迫使当地势力达成妥协：在政治进程中接纳逊尼派，同时加快伊拉克人管理自身安全问题的的训练步伐。
en: The key to resolving this dilemma will be to press for local compromises that involve Sunnis in the political process, and to step up the rate of training of Iraqis to manage their own security.

zh: 即便如此，是否会取得成功仍然是个未知数。
en: Even then, success is uncertain.

zh: 一个失败已经非常明显，即：创建一个军事联盟的新保守主义梦想，这一联盟曾被看作是美军对中东进行改造和民主化的长久基础。
en: One failure is already clear: that of the neo-conservative dream of creating a military ally that could serve as a long-term base for American troops in the campaign to transform and democratize the Middle East.

zh: 三次竞选为什叶派占主导地位的政府制造了某种程度上的合法性，但如果没有团队意识和有效机制，选举仅仅是产生出一个多数人进行统治的暴政。
en: Three elections have produced some degree of legitimacy for the Shia-dominated Iraqi government, but without a sense of community and effective institutions, elections merely create a tyranny of the majority.

zh: 这可能比萨达姆•侯赛因的少数派暴政好一些，但仍然谈不上是现代民主。
en: That may be better than Saddam Hussein’s tyranny of the minority, but it is hardly modern democracy.

zh: 布什把他在伊拉克的目标与二战后日本的民主化相提并论，但当时日本完全处于战败状态，人种单一，没有叛乱发生，存在着大量的中产阶级，并且之前有过政治开放的经验。
en: Bush compares his goal in Iraq to the democratization of Japan after World War II. But Japan was a totally conquered, ethnically homogeneous country with no insurgency, a large middle class, and previous experience of political openness.

zh: 尽管这样，取得成功还是用了七年时间。
en: Even then, success took seven years.

zh: 恰恰相反，布什应该制定一个两年计划，在美军撤离前，给予伊拉克政府尽可能充分的施展机会，同时还要强调伊拉克在美军撤离之后必须对自身的安全和政治拯救负责。
en: Instead, Bush should plan on a two-year window to give the Iraqi government as strong a chance as possible before the Americans leave, while emphasizing that Iraqis will thereafter be responsible for their own security and political salvation.

zh: 解决地方问题的地方创新举措
en: Local Innovation for Local Problems

zh: 波士顿 — — 随着我们对不合格及假冒药品的深入理解，这个问题显然正在超出我们之前的想象。
en: BOSTON – As we learn more about the threat from substandard and counterfeit medicines, it is becoming clear that it is a far greater problem than previously thought.

zh: 这也是发展中国家面临的最大隐患，假冒伪劣药品每年造成超过500，000人死亡，还因促使疾病对现有治疗产生抗药性而影响着成百上千万人的健康。
en: It is also a scourge that is most acutely felt in developing countries, where fake and low-quality pharmaceuticals kill more than 500,000 people a year and affect millions more by contributing to the emergence of diseases that are resistant to existing treatments.

zh: 发展中国家决策者致使问题愈加严重，他们更愿意抛开国内到国外去寻找解决办法。
en: Compounding the problem is the approach taken by policymakers in the developing world, who are far more likely to look for solutions abroad than at home.

zh: 这种错误的短视行为严重阻碍了创新和进步。
en: This shortsightedness is a grave mistake that impedes innovation and progress.

zh: 在涉及解决假冒伪劣药品蔓延等极具影响力的健康难题方面，植根于当地的解决办法和创新不仅对成功至关重要；而且带来的收益还可能远远超出原来问题的范畴。
en: When it comes to tackling high-impact health challenges like the proliferation of fake or inferior drugs, local solutions and local innovations are not only likely to be central to any successful effort; they have the potential to provide benefits that go far beyond the scope of the original problem.

zh: 在整个发展中世界，最明显是在非洲，有两大团体对打击伪劣药品兴趣浓厚。
en: Throughout the developing world, but most evidently in Africa, two groups are interested in finding tools to combat the menace of bad drugs.

zh: 其中一个由学生、企业家和研究人员组成的团体热衷于合作及思想交流，一直以寻找能满足当地社会需求的创新解决方案为目标。
en: One group, comprising students, entrepreneurs, and researchers, seeks solutions that are local, original, and tailored to the needs of their societies. Its members are quick to share ideas and eager to collaborate.

zh: 尽管上述团体已经找到了某种创新方法 — — 如加纳企业家西蒙斯利用移动技术来解决假药问题 — — 但还需要更多热情的当地发明家和企业家的加入。
en: While this group has produced some innovative solutions – for example, the Ghanaian entrepreneur Bright Simmons is using mobile technology to address the counterfeit-drug problem – many more passionate local inventors and entrepreneurs must get involved.

zh: 另一个团体的主力是政府官员（包括监管机构 ） 。
en: The other group is made up of government officials, including regulators.

zh: 他们对假冒伪劣药品泛滥深感忧虑，但却不愿以当地创新为依托。
en: They, too, are deeply concerned about the scourge of low-quality and fake drugs, but they are reluctant to rely on local innovation.

zh: 他们认为解决方案已经存在，但是以高端技术的形式存在于全世界最富有的发达国家。
en: In their minds, the solutions already exist, in the form of high-end technology designed and developed in the world’s richest countries.

zh: 上述团体的难题在于如何寻找财政资源引进这些技术。
en: The challenge, for this group, lies in finding the financial resources to import these technologies.

zh: 对发展中国家领导人而言，创造支持创新生态系统的投资回报少之又少，但所需的工作却似乎太过繁杂。
en: For developing-country leaders, the effort needed to create an ecosystem that supports innovation simply appears too great, and the return on investment too little.

zh: 在无数会议和专题讨论会上，各部官员和政府工作人员坚持认为必须找到资金按既有模式进口解决办法。
en: At countless conferences and symposia, ministry officials and government personnel insist that funds must be found to import solutions, à la carte.

zh: 遗憾的是，研究创新、或与当地企业家及发明家合作却从未提上议事日程。
en: Research and innovation, or engagement with local entrepreneurs and inventors, is, unfortunately, never on the agenda.

zh: 决策者鲜有兴趣挖掘国内巨大的智慧、激情和能量。
en: There simply is little interest in tapping into the enormous pool of intellect, passion, and energy at home.

zh: 官员们应当重新思考。
en: Officials would be wise to reconsider.

zh: 越来越多的证据表明必须有当地的支持及合作解决方法才能长久。
en: There is mounting evidence that sustainable solutions must have local support and local partners.

zh: 募集资金从海外进口技术只是解决方法中的一种。
en: Raising funds to import solutions from abroad addresses just one part of the challenge.

zh: 很多国家缺少安装、操作和维护海外设备所需的资源。
en: Many countries lack the resources to install, operate, and maintain equipment that has not been designed locally.

zh: 如果因误用和忽视引发设备故障，就需要更多资金否则项目就宣告下马。
en: As misuse and neglect causes equipment to malfunction, more funds become required or the program simply dies.

zh: 这种方法不仅无法培育当地的创新生态系统（这已经非常令人沮丧 ） ； 同时也反复受困于眼前问题而找不到解决办法。
en: Not only does this approach fail to nurture local ecosystems of innovation, which is deeply frustrating; it also fails – repeatedly – to solve the problem at hand.

zh: 虽然药品质量测试领域某些解决方案来自像西蒙斯那样的非洲企业家，但其中不少都是在区域外机构支持下进行的零散研发。
en: While some solutions in the area of drug-quality testing have come from African entrepreneurs like Simmons, such examples are extremely rare, and many are developed in the diaspora with the support of organizations from outside the region.

zh: 多数研发计划从未邀请过当地的学生参加。
en: For the most part, such initiatives never engage local students.

zh: 解决地方难题或推动地方创新并不是当地教学的主要目标。
en: Local curricula do not focus on local challenges or promote local innovation.

zh: 但创新、可持续方案不能缺少当地人才。
en: And yet local talent is critical for solutions that are both original and sustainable.

zh: 事实上，通过培育包容性的研究文化，当地创新的潜力绝不局限在具体问题的解决。
en: Indeed, by nurturing an inclusive culture of research, local innovation has the potential to provide benefits that extend far beyond the specific problem that is being addressed.

zh: 鼓励弱势群体参与并创造教育学习机会在培养善意的同时推进透明和问责。
en: Nurturing the participation of underrepresented groups and creating opportunities for education and learning not only creates goodwill and promotes transparency and accountability.

zh: 奠定未来研究的稳定基础在打造高效公私伙伴关系的同时强化学术界和国内产业联系，并因此推动经济增长。
en: Building a stable foundation for future research also enables more productive public-private partnerships and stronger links between academia and domestic industry, thereby promoting economic growth.

zh: 外国机构，比方说援助机构或制药企业，可以在推动本土创新上发挥作用。
en: Foreign organizations, such as aid agencies or pharmaceutical companies, do have a role to play in boosting local innovation.

zh: 他们可以在经济上支持创新，建立新型伙伴关系并鼓励决策者更多信任创新研究。
en: They can support it financially, create new partnerships, and encourage policymakers to give it more credence.

zh: 国际社会也要发挥作用。
en: The international community has a role to play as well.

zh: 今年，联合国将实行可持续发展目标，标志着正式启动了全球消除贫困和改善健康的下一阶段工作。
en: This year, the United Nations will adopt the Sustainable Development Goals, marking the start of the next phase of global efforts to eradicate poverty and improve health.

zh: 正如发展中国家打击假冒伪劣药品的实例所表明的那样，地方创新将决定能否成功实现目标。
en: As the example of developing countries’ ongoing fight against counterfeit and low-quality medicines shows, success will depend – far more often than not – on local innovation.

zh: 用教育化解激进化
en: The Education Antidote to Radicalization

zh: 迪拜—只要你来到中东，就一定会注意到该地区青年的教育、企业家精神和职业志向与剥夺他们大多数人的积极为来的严酷现实之间的巨大差距。
en: DUBAI – No visitor to the Middle East can avoid noticing the yawning gap between the educational, entrepreneurial, and occupational aspirations of the region’s young people and the harsh reality that deprives so many of them of a positive future.

zh: 事实上，在中东，有一半的18—25岁群体处于失业或半失业状态。
en: Indeed, in the Middle East, half of those aged 18-25 are either unemployed or underemployed.

zh: 全球难民危机令这一状况雪上加霜。 难民危机导致3,000万儿童流离失所，光是叙利亚就有六百万，其中极少部分有望在学龄阶段返回家园。
en: Aggravating this situation is the global refugee crisis, which has displaced some 30 million children, six million from Syria alone, very few of whom are likely to return home during their school-age years.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪该地区称为达伊莎（Daesh，即伊斯兰国）的集团相信它能够在这个为数巨大的无产且不满的年轻人群体中轻松募集人手。
en: It should come as no surprise that the group known in the region as Daesh (the Islamic State) believes that it can find fertile ground for recruitment in this vast population of dispossessed and disaffected young people.

zh: 达伊莎宣传家滥用社交媒体，正如他们的极端主义前辈和同辈有时滥用清真寺 — — 将它用作激进化的论坛。
en: Daesh propagandists are misusing social media in the way that their extremist predecessors and contemporaries have sometimes misused mosques – as a forum for radicalization.

zh: 该集团一直在发布抹杀伊斯兰教和西方共存可能性的内容，号召年轻人加入圣战。
en: The group consistently posts content that challenges the possibility of coexistence between Islam and the West and calls young people to jihad.

zh: 达伊莎所制作的令人发指的暴力视频具有极大的冲击力。
en: The grotesquely violent videos that Daesh produces have shock appeal.

zh: 但真正吸引不满青年的是他们获邀加入比他们自身和他们所生活的社会更宏大的事业中。
en: But what really attracts disaffected young people is the invitation to be part of something that seems larger than themselves and the societies in which they live.

zh: 伦敦国王学院国际激进化研究中心（ICSR）的希拉兹·马赫（Shiraz Maher）发现这些达伊莎新兵之间有一个共同点 ： “ 义愤、反抗、感到受到迫害，拒绝妥协 ” 。
en: Shiraz Maher of the International Center for the Study of Radicalization (ICSR) at King’s College London identifies a common thread of sentiment among recruits: “righteous indignation, defiance, a sense of persecution, and a refusal to conform.”

zh: 最新的奎利安姆基金会（Quilliam Foundation）报告认为，达伊莎利用青年的渴望作为价值的一部分；该组织的乌托邦诉求是对新圣战斗士吸引力最大的东西。
en: As a recent Quilliam Foundation report concludes, Daesh plays on the youthful desire to be part of something worthwhile; it is the organization’s utopian appeal that is most alluring to new recruits.

zh: 因此，没有人可以否认我们陷入了一场关于心灵和思想的代际战争，这场战争不可能只靠军事手段获得胜利。
en: Given this, few would disagree that we find ourselves in a generational battle for hearts and minds that cannot be won by military means alone.

zh: 硬实力可以清除达伊莎的强硬领袖。
en: Hard power can eliminate Daesh’s hardcore leaders.

zh: 但我们还需要其他手段让近2亿穆斯林青年相信，极端主义绝对是一条死路。
en: But we will need more than that to convince nearly 200 million young Muslims that extremism is, quite literally, a dead end.

zh: 在印度次大陆和中东，有大量未被注意到的有效抵御极端主义的例子：巴基斯坦儿童杂志、面向北非十几岁青少年的视频、中东广播电台，以及反对基地组织的书籍和出版物。
en: There are many examples of under-the-radar operations working to counter extremism across the Indian subcontinent and the Middle East: children’s magazines in Pakistan, videos aimed at teenagers in North Africa, radio stations in the Middle East, and books and publications opposing Al Qaeda.

zh: 它们有助于以多种方式、包括将注意力吸引到背叛方面来揭露达伊莎的真正生活，揭露其残酷、腐败、动辄内部清洗的本质。
en: They can help to expose the truth about life in Daesh – that it is brutal, corrupt, and prone to internal purges – in several ways, including by drawing attention to defections.

zh: 一份2014年的报告指出 ： “ [存在背叛者这一事实]打破了团结的形象，也打破了[该集团]试图展现的决心。 ”
en: As a 2014 report states, “[the very existence of defectors] shatters the image of unity and determination that [the group] seeks to convey.”

zh: 但如果我们想要打赢这场人心之战，维持达伊莎称之为“灰色地带 ” 、 一直试图摧毁的文化空间，就必须有更大的雄心。
en: But we must be more ambitious if we are to win the war of ideas, sustaining the cultural space that Daesh calls the “the grey zone,” which it longs to destroy. It is a space in which Muslims and non-Muslims can coexist, discover their shared values, and cooperate.

zh: 在这个空间中，穆斯林和非穆斯林实现共存，发现他们的共同价值，并精诚合作。
en: Peter Neumann, the director of the ICSR, has proposed a YouTube contest for videos that explain the failings of Daesh.

zh: ICSR主任彼得·纽曼（Peter Neumann）提出举行一次Youtube竞赛，评比解释达伊莎失败之处的视频 ： “ 你会立刻收到5,000个视频 ， ” 他说 ， “ 其中4,000个是垃圾，但其他1,000个很有效 — — 1,000个反[达伊莎的]宣传。
en: “You would receive 5,000 videos in no time,” he says. “Four thousand are junk, but 1,000 of them are effective – 1,000 videos against [Daesh] propaganda.”

zh: 但是，打击极端主义的最佳长期工具是教育。
en: The best long-term tool for countering extremism, however, is education.

zh: 在以色列雅法（Jaffa ） ， 一家由苏格兰圣公会（Church of Scotland）经营的学校向穆斯林、犹太人和基督徒儿童传授宽容的美德。
en: In Jaffa, Israel, a school run by the Church of Scotland teaches the virtues of tolerance to Muslim, Jewish, and Christian children.

zh: 在黎巴嫩，支持宗教多样化的共同学校课程 — — 包括“拒绝一切激进化和宗教或世俗隔离 ” — —正在面向九岁以上逊尼派、什叶派和基督徒儿童开设。
en: Throughout Lebanon, a common school curriculum championing religious diversity – including the “refusal of any radicalism and religious or sectarian seclusion” – is being taught to Sunni, Shia, and Christian children starting at the age of nine.

zh: 黎巴嫩还在学校系统中引入了双班倒，以接收200,000叙利亚难民儿童。
en: The country has also introduced double shifts in its school system to accommodate some 200,000 Syrian refugee children.

zh: 深陷宗派暴力和宗教分裂的黎巴嫩都能宣传共存、为叙利亚难民提供学习的机会，其他中东国家也没有理由不效仿它的榜样。
en: If troubled Lebanon, wracked by sectarian violence and religious divides, can champion coexistence and provide Syrian refugees with a chance to study, there is no reason other countries in the region should not follow its example.

zh: 选择显而易见。
en: The choice could not be clearer.

zh: 我们可以袖手旁观新一代精通网络的穆斯林青年受到伊斯兰教无法与西方价值共存的错误主张的荼毒。
en: We can stand by and watch a new generation of web-savvy Muslim youth be deluged with false claims that Islam cannot coexist with Western values.

zh: 我们也可以认识到中东和穆斯林世界其他地区的青年与全世界青年有着共同的志向。
en: Or we can recognize that the young people of the Middle East and the rest of the Muslim world share the aspirations of young people in every other part of the world.

zh: 所有证据都表明，中东地区青年渴望教育、就业和充分发挥才能的机会。
en: All the evidence indicates that the region’s young people want education, employment, and the chance to make the most of their talents.

zh: 2016年，我们应该以实现他们的这些渴望为目标。
en: Our resolution for 2016 should be to make that happen.

zh: 抵御西方传染病
en: Countering the Contagious West

zh: 纽波特海滩 — — 想象一下，你是某新兴市场国家的主要决策者。
en: NEWPORT BEACH – Imagine for a moment that you are the chief policymaker in a successful emerging-market country.

zh: 自然地，你关注着欧洲愈演愈烈的债务危机，也担心美国政策失当让其无法提振萎靡的经济，心中既有几分震惊，也带着几分愤怒。
en: You are watching with legitimate concern (and a mixture of astonishment and anger) as Europe’s crippling debt crisis spreads and America’s dysfunctional politics leave it unable to revive its moribund economy.

zh: 你会因本国令人瞩目的自力更生能力和成功抵挡了席卷西方的通缩风暴而踌躇满志吗？ 还是会继续小心行事，增加本国的预防性储备？
en: Would you draw comfort from your country’s impressive internal resilience and offset the deflationary winds blowing from the West; or would you play it safe and increase your country’s precautionary reserves?

zh: 这就是目前不少新兴市场经济体所面临的问题，这一问题的影响范围远远超过了国家层面。
en: That is the question facing several emerging-market economies, and its impact extends well beyond their borders.

zh: 事实上，这一问题也是令人越来越担心的全球经济前景的写照。
en: Indeed, it is a question that also speaks to the increasingly worrisome outlook for the global economy.

zh: 我们正面临如此问题，这一事实既令人瞩目，又令人不可思议。
en: The very fact that we are posing this question is novel and notable it its own right.

zh: 你可以把它加入到曾经不可想象、但最近被我们亲眼目睹的事件的名单中去。
en: You can add this to the list of previously unthinkable things that we have witnessed lately.

zh: 这一名单包括（就拿过去几周来说 ） ： 美国失去了宝贵的AAA信用评级、美国在债务违约问题上的政治闹剧、与日俱增的对欧洲外围国家债务重组的担忧以及欧元区可能分崩离析的传闻、以及瑞士大踏步地削弱（对，就是削弱）自己安全港地位。
en: That list includes, just in the last few weeks, America’s loss of its sacred AAA rating; its political flirtation with a debt default; mounting concern about debt restructurings in peripheral European economies and talk about a possible eurozone breakup; and Switzerland’s dramatic steps to reduce (yes, reduce) its safe-haven status.

zh: 换做几年前，新兴市场所面临的问题有着直接明了的答案。
en: The answer to the emerging markets’ question would have been straightforward a few years ago.

zh: 但如今，情况有变。
en: It is not today.

zh: 在旧世界，西方经济萎靡或许已经把新兴市场国家拖入了万劫不复。
en: In the world of old, the West’s economic malaise already would have pulled the rug from beneath most emerging-market countries.

zh: 事实上，在传统智慧看来（有大量痛苦的经验支持传统智慧 ） ， 工业国打个喷嚏，新兴市场就得感冒。
en: Indeed, the conventional wisdom – supported by many painful experiences – was that when the industrial countries sneezed, the emerging world caught a cold.

zh: 但是，多年来，不少（虽然不是全部）新兴市场国家在降低金融脆弱性方面取得了长足的进步，他们积累起了巨大的国际储备，这使得它们获益良多。
en: Today, however, several (though not all) emerging-market countries are benefiting from years of considerable efforts to reduce their financial vulnerability by accumulating huge amounts of international reserves.

zh: 它们还偿还了大部分外部债务，剩余部分也大多转换为了更易管理的本币债务。
en: They have also paid back a significant share of external debt and converted much of what remains into more manageable local-currency liabilities.

zh: 资产负债表方面的巨大改善使新兴国家能够在2008—2009年的全球金融危机中迅速复苏，而西方国家则一直在泥淖中苦苦挣扎。
en: This sharp balance-sheet improvement has been instrumental in enabling emerging countries to bounce back strongly from the 2008-2009 global financial crisis, whereas the West continues to hobble along.

zh: 事实上，在最近欧美衰退卷土重来之前，新兴市场的主要政策难题是增长太快、通胀压力剧增以及经济过热。
