en: The reason that politicians and corporate managers alike hate CDSs is precisely because CDS rates are so useful and so prompt in exposing their mistakes.

zh: 而没有人愿意被挑错。
en: Nobody likes to be found wrong.

zh: 正因为如此，政客和有影响力的企业家经常诱哄媒体，评级机构甚至分析师，让他们把自己的证券评级为正面的。
en: For this reason, politicians and powerful businessmen often cajole the press, the credit rating agencies, and even the analysts to portray their actions in a positive light.

zh: 作为负面信息的主要来源，而且对于那些权威并不感冒，CDS市场才被人们惧怕，政客都想除之以绝后患。
en: As the main source of negative information that is not sensitive to power, the CDS market is feared, and politicians want to eliminate it.

zh: 当然，CDS市场并不完善。
en: Of course, the CDS market is not perfect.

zh: 事实上这并非一个真正有组织性的市场，而只是一种不正式的虚拟交易。
en: In fact, it is not really an organized market, but only an informal virtual exchange.

zh: 现行的交易制度在设计之初并非使得这个市场更加透明有效，而是为了使得控制这个市场的大机构获利。
en: The existing rules are designed not to make it transparent or resilient, but to make it more profitable for large institutions like Goldman Sachs and JP Morgan.

zh: 因此CDS需要外部介入使得CDS市场更加规范化，并且使其合理的向其他地方延伸发展，从而使得政府不再需要介入市场进行救援。
en: So intervention is needed to formalize the CDS market and force appropriate collateralization, so that no government has to step in to rescue any counterparty.

zh: 但是监管CDS市场并不意味着取缔它。
en: But regulating the CDS market does not mean banning it.

zh: 这样做只会为下一轮泡沫埋下种子。
en: To do so would only sow the seeds of the next bubble.

zh: 债务的道德经济
en: The Moral Economy of Debt

zh: 伦敦—每一次经济崩溃都会带来债务豁免需求。
en: LONDON – Every economic collapse brings a demand for debt forgiveness.

zh: 用来偿还贷款的收入切断了，用来作为抵押品的资产价值崩盘了。
en: The incomes needed to repay loans have evaporated, and assets posted as collateral have lost value.

zh: 债权人要求拿回本息，这个要求合法而不合理；债务人大声嚷嚷着要求豁免。
en: Creditors demand their pound of flesh; debtors clamor for relief.

zh: 以“罢免债务 ” （ Strike Debt）为例。 罢免债务是“占领 ” （ Occupy）运动的变体，它号召“全国债务抵制者联合起来，为经济正义和民主自由而斗争。
en: Consider Strike Debt, an offshoot of the Occupy movement, which calls itself “a nationwide movement of debt resisters fighting for economic justice and democratic freedom.”

zh: ”其网站指出 ， “ 在工资停滞、系统性失业和公共服务削减的情况下 ， ” 人们被迫背上债务才能获得最基本的生活必需品，这导致他们“将未来拱手让给银行 ” 。
en: Its Web site argues that “[w]ith stagnant wages, systemic unemployment, and public service cuts” people are being forced into debt in order to obtain the most basic necessities of life, leading them to “surrender [their] futures to the banks.”

zh: 罢免债务运动之一的“滚动禧年 ” （ Rolling Jubilee）采取众筹的方式筹集资金买断和注销债务，其自称这是“集体拒绝式债务抵制 ” 。
en: One of Strike Debt’s initiatives, “Rolling Jubilee,” crowd-sources funds to buy up and extinguish debt, a process that it calls “collective refusal.”

zh: 该组织的突飞猛进之势令人瞩目，目前已筹集700,000多美元，注销了价值近1,860万美元的债务。
en: The group’s progress has been impressive, raising more than $700,000 so far and extinguishing debt worth almost $18.6 million.

zh: 滚动禧年运动之所以能够如此廉价地买下债务，是因为存在二级债务市场。
en: It is the existence of a secondary debt market that enables Rolling Jubilee to buy debt so cheaply.

zh: 怀疑借款人偿付能力的金融机构以跳楼价将债务卖给第三方，有时候出售价格只有面值的5 % 。
en: Financial institutions that have come to doubt their borrowers’ ability to repay sell the debt to third parties at knock-down prices, often for as little as five cents on the dollar.

zh: 买家随后要求借款人偿还这笔债务中的一部分，以此获利。
en: Buyers then attempt to profit by recouping some or all of the debt from the borrowers.

zh: 美国学生贷款提供商萨利美（Sallie Mae）承认它以一五折的价格出售再打包后的债务。
en: The US student-loan provider Sallie Mae admitted that it sells repackaged debt for as little as 15 cents on the dollar.

zh: 为了吸引对通常相当邪恶的催帐者行为的注意力，滚动禧年最近取消了艾弗勒斯学院（Everest College）2,761名学生的学生贷款。 艾弗勒斯学院是一所盈利院校，其母公司克林西安学院集团（Corinthian Colleges）被美国政府以掠夺性借贷为由告上了法庭。
en: To draw attention to the often-nefarious practices of debt collectors, Rolling Jubilee recently canceled student debt for 2,761 students of Everest College, a for-profit school whose parent company, Corinthian Colleges, is being sued by the US government for predatory lending.

zh: 滚动禧年以106,709.48美元买下了它，相当于面值的3 % 。
en: Everest College’s loan portfolio was valued at almost $3.9 million. Rolling Jubilee bought it for $106,709.48, or about three cents on the dollar.

zh: 但这只是沧海一粟。
en: But that is a drop in the ocean.

zh: 光是在美国，学生贷款就超过1万亿美元，相当于GDP的6%左右。
en: In the US alone, students owe more than $1 trillion, or around 6% of GDP.

zh: 而学生只是许多依靠贷款的社会群体之一。
en: And the student population is just one of many social groups that lives on debt.

zh: 事实上，放眼全球，2008—2009年经济衰退导致私人和公共债务负担上升，以至于公共和私人之间的区分已不再明显。
en: Indeed, throughout the world, the economic downturn of 2008-2009 increased the burden of private and public debt alike – to the point that the public-private distinction became blurred.

zh: 爱尔兰总统希金斯在最近的芝加哥讲话中解释了私人债务是如何变为主权债务的 ： “ 由于需要借钱为当前支出融资，同时也主要因为将全额担保扩大到爱尔兰主要银行的资产和负债，爱尔兰中央政府债务占GDP之比从2007年的25%上升到2013年的124 % 。 ”
en: In a recent speech in Chicago, Irish President Michael D. Higgins explained how private debt became sovereign debt: “As a consequence of the need to borrow so as to finance current expenditure and, above all, as a result of the blanket guarantee extended to the main Irish banks’ assets and liabilities, Ireland’s general government debt increased from 25% of GDP in 2007 to 124% in 2013.”

zh: 当然，爱尔兰政府的目的是拯救银行系统。
en: The Irish government’s aim, of course, was to save the banking system.

zh: 但这场援助的意外后果是撼动了人们对政府偿债能力的信心。
en: But the unintended consequence of the bailout was to shatter confidence in the government’s solvency.

zh: 在欧元区，爱尔兰、希腊、葡萄牙和塞浦路斯都不得不重组主权债务以避免直接违约。
en: In the eurozone, Ireland, Greece, Portugal, and Cyprus all had to restructure their sovereign debt to avoid outright default.

zh: 升高的债务/GDP之比给财政政策加上了一道枷锁，也成为让经济探底长期化的紧缩政策的主要依据。
en: Rising debt/GDP ratios cast a pall over fiscal policy, and became the main justification for austerity policies that prolonged the slump.

zh: 这些都不是新鲜事。
en: None of this is new.

zh: 债权人-债务人冲突自巴比伦时代以来就是政治问题。
en: Creditor-debtor conflict has been the stuff of politics since Babylonian times.

zh: 正统永远坚持债权人的神圣权利；而政治需要常常要求减免债务人负担。
en: Orthodoxy has always upheld the sacred rights of the creditor; political necessity has frequently demanded relief for the debtor.

zh: 在任何时候，哪一方获胜取决于债务困境的严重程度和对立的债权人-债务人联盟的紧固程度。
en: Which side wins in any situation depends on the extent of debtor distress and the strength of the opposing creditor-debtor coalitions.

zh: 道德一直是这些冲突中思想因素。
en: Morality has always been the intellectual coin of these conflicts.

zh: 债权人主张得到足额偿付的权利，在历史上总是尽可能多地给违约设置法律和政治障碍，坚持对不能履行债务义务的借款人实施严厉制裁 — — 比如扣除收入，在极端情形中甚至包括入狱乃至奴役。
en: Creditors, asserting their right to be repaid in full, historically have created as many legal and political obstacles to default as possible, insisting on harsh sanctions – garnishment of income, for example, and, at the extreme, imprisonment or even slavery – for borrowers’ failure to honor their debt obligations.

zh: 在烧钱的战争中背上债务负担的政府被要求每年计提“偿债基金 ” （ sinking fund ） 。
en: Governments that incurred debt in costly wars have been expected to set aside annual “sinking funds” for repayment.

zh: 但是，道德并非完全站在债权人一边。
en: Morality, however, has not been entirely on the side of the creditor.

zh: 在希腊语《新约》中，债务意味着“罪恶 ” 。
en: In New Testament Greek, debt means “sin.”

zh: 但是，尽管背负债务或许是罪恶的，但《马太福音》6:12节支持赦免 ： “ 原谅我们的债务，正如我们也原谅了我们的债务人。
en: But, though it might be sinful to go into debt, Matthew 6:12 supports absolution: “forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.”

zh: ”社会广泛反对债权人获得不偿还债务的债务人的房产，这意味着“收回按揭偿还权”是很少采用的极端手段。
en: Widespread social resistance to creditors’ claims on debtors’ property for non-payment has meant that “foreclosure” has rarely been carried to extremes.

zh: 禁止高利贷进一步强化了债务人的立场。
en: The position of debtors was further strengthened by the prohibition of usury – charging unreasonably high interest on money.

zh: 在英国，利率上限直到1835年才被取消；2009年以来央行普遍采取了近零利率则是保护债务人的最新例子。
en: Interest-rate caps were abolished in Britain only in 1835; the near-zero central-bank rates prevailing since 2009 are a current example of efforts to protect borrowers.

zh: 大卫·格雷柏（David Graeber）在其巨著《债：第一个5,000年 》 （ Debt: The First 5,000 Years）中指出，事实的真相是债权人-债务人关系并不包含什么道德铁律；相反，这是一种永远可以商量的社会关系。
en: The truth of the matter, as David Graeber points out in his majestic Debt: The First 5,000 Years, is that that the creditor-debtor relationship embodies no iron law of morality; rather, it is a social relationship that always must be negotiated.

zh: 当精确的定量计算和坚持到底要求履行债务义务成为规则时，冲突和贫穷就会接踵而至。
en: When quantitative precision and an unyielding approach to debt obligations are the rule, conflict and penury soon follow.

zh: 为了防止债务危机反覆，传统社会采取了“禧年法 ” （ Law of Jubilee ） — —将石板清洗干净的仪式。
en: In an effort to stem recurrent debt crises, traditional societies embraced the “Law of Jubilee,” a ceremonial wiping clean of the slate.

zh: 格雷柏写道 ， “ 禧年法规定，所有债务都在‘安息年 ’ （ Sabbath year，即七年后）自动清除，所有因为这类债务而饱受煎熬的人都应被释放。
en: “The Law of Jubilee,” writes Graeber, “stipulated that all debts be automatically canceled ‘in the Sabbath year’ (that is, after seven years had passed), and that all who languished in bondage owing to such debts would be released.”

zh: ”滚动禧年及时地提醒我们，这一社会生活的最古老法则至今仍然重要。
en: The Rolling Jubilee is a timely reminder of the continuing relevance of one of the oldest laws of social life.

zh: 借贷的道德并非波洛涅斯（Polonius）对其子拉厄耳忒斯（ Laertes）所言“不要借钱，也不要借给人钱。
en: The moral of the tale is not, as Polonius instructed his son Laertes, “neither a borrower nor a lender be.”

zh: ”没有借和贷，人类也许还生活在山洞里。
en: Without both, humanity might still be living in caves.

zh: 但是，我们需要限制信用的供给和需求，使之与荆棘的生产能力相配。
en: Rather, we need to limit the supply of and demand for credit to what the economy is capable of producing.

zh: 如何实现这一点并保持企业的自由是政治经济学的未解难题之一。
en: How to do this and maintain freedom of enterprise is one of the great unsettled questions of political economy.

zh: 商业周期的真正驱动力
en: The Real Engine of the Business Cycle

zh: 芝加哥 — — 每一次重大的金融危机都会留下独特的足迹。
en: CHICAGO – Every major financial crisis leaves a unique footprint.

zh: 正如贯穿十九世纪和二十世纪银行业危机表明了金融部门流动性和最后贷款人的重要性一样，大萧条强调了反周期财政及货币政策的必要性。
en: Just as banking crises throughout the nineteenth and twentieth centuries revealed the importance of financial-sector liquidity and lenders of last resort, the Great Depression underscored the necessity of counter-cyclical fiscal and monetary policies.

zh: 而最近这场2008年的金融危机和随后的大衰退则揭示了信贷驱动型商业周期背后的关键驱动因素。
en: And, more recently, the 2008 financial crisis and subsequent Great Recession revealed the key drivers of credit-driven business cycles.

zh: 尤其是大衰退告诉我们可以通过研究家庭负债的上升状况来预测经济活动放缓。
en: Specifically, the Great Recession showed us that we can predict a slowdown in economic activity by looking at rising household debt.

zh: 在美国和其他许多国家，2002~2007年期间家庭债务与GDP比率的变化与2007~2010年的失业增加密切相关。
en: In the United States and across many other countries, changes in household debt-to-GDP ratios between 2002 and 2007 correlate strongly with increases in unemployment from 2007 to 2010.

zh: 比如在危机爆发前亚利桑那州和内华达州的家庭债务大幅增加，爱尔兰和西班牙也是如此；而且在危机爆发后上述四个国家和地区也都经历了特别严重的衰退。
en: For example, before the crash, household debt had increased enormously in Arizona and Nevada, as well as in Ireland and Spain; and, after the crash, all four locales experienced particularly severe recessions.

zh: 事实上远在大萧条爆发之前家庭债务上涨就已经可以预示出经济萧条了。
en: In fact, rising household debt was predictive of economic slumps long before the Great Recession.

zh: 在1994年发表欧洲经济协会主席就职讲话中，时任英格兰银行首席经济学家默文·金（Mervyn King）就指出，1984~1988年家庭债务与收入比率增幅最大的国家也是1989~1992年间实际（扣除通胀后）GDP增长流失最多的。
en: In his 1994 presidential address to the European Economic Association, Mervyn King, then the chief economist at the Bank of England, showed that countries with the largest increases in household debt-to-income ratios from 1984 to 1988 suffered the largest shortfalls in real (inflation-adjusted) GDP growth from 1989 to 1992.

zh: 同样，笔者与普林斯顿大学埃缪尔·维纳（Emil Verner）的共同研究也发现1982~1989年期间美国家庭债务增加幅度较大的那些州在1989~1992年期间的失业率上升幅度以及实际GDP增长下降幅度更大。
en: Likewise, in our own work with Emil Verner of Princeton University, we have shown that US states with larger household-debt increases from 1982 to 1989 experienced larger increases in unemployment and more severe declines in real GDP growth from 1989 to 1992.

zh: 我们还在另一个项目中研究了过去40年来30个国家的数据，并且表明家庭债务相对GDP比率上升会系统地导致GDP增长放缓和失业率上升。
en: In another study with Verner, we examined data from 30 countries over the past 40 years, and showed that rising household debt-to-GDP ratios have systematically resulted in slower GDP growth and higher unemployment.

zh: 而国际货币基金组织最近涵盖更大样本的研究也证实了这一结论。
en: Recent research by the International Monetary Fund, which used an even larger sample, confirms this result.

zh: 总而言之，我们从大量针对家庭债务，房地产市场和商业周期之间联系的研究中得出结论：主要通过家庭需求产生的信贷供应扩张是商业周期的一个重要驱动力。
en: All told, the conclusion that we draw from a large body of research into the links between household debt, the housing market, and business cycles is that expansions in credit supply, operating primarily through household demand, are an important driver of business cycles generally.

zh: 我们称之为“信贷驱动的家庭需求渠道 ” 。
en: We call this the “credit-driven household demand channel.”

zh: 当贷款人基于某些与借款人收入或生产率无关的原因而增加贷款数量并降低信贷利率时，信贷供应就会扩大。
en: An expansion in the supply of credit occurs when lenders either increase the quantity of credit or decrease the interest rate on credit for reasons unrelated to borrowers’ income or productivity.

zh: 在一项新的研究中，我们发现信贷驱动的家庭需求渠道取决于三个主要的概念性支柱。
en: In a new study, we show that the credit-driven household demand channel rests on three main conceptual pillars.

zh: 首先，信贷供应扩张（而不是技术或永久收入冲击）是经济活动的主要驱动因素。
en: First, credit-supply expansions, rather than technology or permanent income shocks, are the key drivers of economic activity.

zh: 这是一个有争议的看法。
en: This is a controversial idea.

zh: 大多数模型都会将宏观经济波动归因于生产力冲击等实际因素。
en: Most models attribute macroeconomic fluctuations to real factors such as productivity shocks.

zh: 但我们相信金融部门本身在借贷意愿方面扮演着一个不被重视的角色。
en: But we believe the financial sector itself plays an underappreciated role through its willingness to lend.

zh: 而我们的第二个支柱表明，信贷供给扩张会通过提高家庭需求而不是企业的生产能力来影响实体经济。
en: According to our second pillar, credit-supply expansions affect the real economy by boosting household demand, rather than the productive capacity of firms.

zh: 毕竟，信贷繁荣往往与通胀上升以及建筑和零售业的就业增加有关，而不是以可交易或出口为导向的商业部门。
en: Credit booms, after all, tend to be associated with rising inflation and increased employment in construction and retail, rather than in the tradable or export-oriented business sector.

zh: 在过去的40年里信贷供应扩张似乎主要是为家庭支出投资提供资金，而不是企业的生产性投资。
en: Over the past 40 years, credit-supply expansions appear to have largely financed household spending sprees, not productive investment by businesses.

zh: 我们的第三支柱解释了为何信贷驱动型商业周期的收缩阶段会如此严酷。
en: Our third pillar explains why the contraction phase of the credit-driven business cycle is so severe.

zh: 主要问题在于当信贷枯竭时 — — 通常在银行危机期间 — — 经济要花很大力气去“适应”负债家庭的支出急剧下降状况。
en: The main problem is that the economy has a hard time “adjusting” to the precipitous drop in spending by indebted households when credit dries up, usually during banking crises.

zh: 即使短期利率降至零，储蓄者也无法进行足量消费去弥补总需求的不足。
en: Even when short-term interest rates fall to zero, savers cannot spend enough to make up for the shortfall in aggregate demand.

zh: 而在供给方面，就业不容易从非贸易部门转移到贸易部门。
en: And on the supply side, employment cannot easily migrate from the non-tradable to the tradable sector.

zh: 最重要的是，各种名义刚性（nominal rigidity ） ， 银行部门的混乱以及遗留的扭曲状况往往会使信贷景气期过后的衰退更为严重。
en: On top of that, nominal rigidities, banking-sector disruptions, and legacy distortions tend to make post-credit-boom recessions more severe.

zh: 我们对信贷周期扩张和收缩阶段的强调也与早期学者的观点相契合。
en: Our emphasis on both the expansionary and contractionary phases of the credit cycle accords with the perspective of earlier scholars.

zh: 正如经济学家查尔斯·P·金德伯格（Charles P. Kindleberger）和海曼·明斯基（Hyman Minsky）所发现的那样，金融危机和信贷供给收缩并不是一个冲击稳定经济体的外部事件。
en: As the economists Charles P. Kindleberger and Hyman Minsky showed, financial crises and credit-supply contractions are not exogenous events hitting a stable economy.

zh: 相反，它们至少在某种程度上应被视为前一段时期经济过热 — — 也就是信贷供应扩张 — — 的后果。
en: Rather, they should be viewed as at least partly the result of earlier economic excesses – namely, credit-supply expansions.

zh: 简而言之，信贷供给扩张往往会播下自我毁灭的种子。
en: In short, credit-supply expansions often sow the seeds of their own destruction.

zh: 为了弄明白崩盘的成因，我们必须去了解繁荣，尤其是在繁荣萧条信贷周期中发挥极端关键作用的行为偏差以及总需求的外部性。
en: To make sense of the bust, we must understand the boom, and particularly the behavioral biases and aggregate-demand externalities that play such a critical role in boom-bust credit cycles.

zh: 但再次还有另外一个问题：是什么首先引发了突然的信贷供应扩张？
en: But that leaves another question: What sets off sudden credit-supply expansions in the first place?

zh: 根据我们对历史事件的解读，我们认为资本迅速涌入金融体系往往会引发信贷供应的扩张。
en: Based on our reading of historical episodes, we contend that a rapid influx of capital into the financial system often triggers an expansion in credit supply.

zh: 而最近爆发的这场危机就是伴随着美国收入不平等状况恶化以及许多新兴市场（美国前美联储主席本·伯南克称之为“全球储蓄过剩 ” ） 的储蓄率上升而出现的。
en: This type of shock occurred most recently in tandem with rising income inequality in the US and higher rates of saving in many emerging markets (what former US Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke described as the “global savings glut”).

zh: 虽然我们关注的是商业周期，但我们相信信用驱动的家庭需求渠道也可能有助于回答其他一些长期困扰着人们的问题。
en: Although we have focused on business cycles, we believe the credit-driven household demand channel could be helpful in answering longer-run questions, too.

zh: 正如旧金山联邦储备银行的奥斯卡·乔达（Òscar Jordà ） ， 莫里茨·舒拉里克（Moritz Schularick）和艾伦·M·泰勒（Alan M. Taylor）所揭示的那样，发达经济体的私人 — — 特别是家庭 — — 信贷相对GDP比率长期以来都在上升。
en: As the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco’s Òscar Jordà, Moritz Schularick, and Alan M. Taylor have shown, there has been a long-term secular increase in private – particularly household – credit-to-GDP ratios across advanced economies.

zh: 而这一趋势则伴随着长期实际利率的相应下降，国内不平等加深以及全国性“储蓄过剩 ” 。
en: And this trend has been accompanied by a related decline in long-term real interest rates, as well as increases in within-country inequality and across-country “savings gluts.”

zh: 而现在的问题在于这些长期趋势之间是否存在联系，以及我们对商业周期频率的了解。
en: The question now is whether there is a connection between these longer-term trends and what we know about the frequency of business cycles.

zh: 信用应得到遵守
en: Credit Where Credit is Due

zh: 过去共产党中央计划抑制中国经济时，固定资产投资成为该政权促进经济发展的衡量标准。
en: In the old days, when communist central planning suffocated China’s economy, fixed-asset investment was the regime’s measure of economic progress.

zh: 出产越多的钢材，越多混凝土灌注下去，越多原油从地下开采出来那么就越好。
en: The more tons of steel produced, slabs of concrete poured, and gallons of crude oil pumped out of the ground the better.

zh: 西方资本主义唯首是瞻的以消费为基础的经济，被当作一只纸老虎甩到了一边。
en: The consumption-based economy, to which the capitalist West had apparently succumbed, was written off as a paper tiger.

zh: 表面上什么都没有改变。
en: On the surface, nothing much has changed.

zh: 中国继续沉迷于投资。 2005年新建工厂和基础设施占到了国民生产总值的41 % ， 占据了几乎一半的经济增长。
en: China remains obsessed with investing –construction of factories and infrastructure accounted for 41% of GDP and around half of economic growth in 2005.

zh: 此外，国家持续高水平的固定资产投资有其意义所在。 建设道路、水管、地铁系统、通讯网络和电子厂是一个幅员辽阔、快速现代化的国家必须要做的。
en: Moreover, the country’s continuing high levels of fixed-asset investment make sense – building roads, water pipes, metro systems, telecommunication networks, and electronics factories is what a vast and rapidly modernizing country must do.

zh: 但是共产党领导人认定在下一个十年，理发师、会计、卡拉OK女服务员、导游和电影导演将成为经济表现的新支柱。
en: But the Communist Party leadership has decided that in the next decade hairdressers, accountants, karaoke hostesses, tour guides, and movie directors will be the new pillars of economic performance.

zh: 在投资增长放缓以及出口市场面临不可预测的商业循环和保护主义情绪的情况下，中国将越来越多地依赖消费来增加工作岗位和收入的增长，而服务业正是消费产生最多的产业。
en: As investment growth slows and export markets endure their unpredictable business cycles and protectionist moods, China will increasingly rely upon consumption for creation of jobs and income – and the service industry is where most consumption occurs.

zh: 现在只有一个问题，那就是中国人似乎不愿意消费，至少根据通常引用的数据是如此。
en: There is only one problem: Chinese people do not seem to want to consume, at least according to commonly cited data.

zh: 国民储蓄2005年已经差不多占到了国民生产总值的50 % ， 这显然意味着中国家庭对医疗、教育以及他们所梦想拥有的新住房的首期付款惶恐不安。
en: National savings amounted to roughly 50% of GDP in 2005, which apparently means that households are so afraid of hospital bills, school fees, and the down-payment on the new apartment they dream of that they save every penny they earn.

zh: 但是，那个储蓄数额背后隐藏了某些更为严峻的东西。
en: But that savings number hides something very critical.

zh: 中国家庭确实把大约他们收入的四分之一都存进了银行。
en: Chinese households do save a lot, about one quarter of their income.

zh: 但是正像世界银行的Louis Kuijs指出的，中国区别于许多其他发展中国家的地方不是在于中国家庭把他们极大部分的收入存了起来，而是在于企业也是如此。
en: But as Louis Kuijs of the World Bank has pointed out, what sets China apart from many other developing countries is not that households save uniquely high levels of their income, but that enterprises do.

zh: 实际上，过去七年间，中国的个人消费以事实上大约10%的速度增长着。
en: Indeed, private consumption in China has been growing in real terms at an annual rate of around 10% for the last seven years.

zh: 这意味着要让中国的家庭进行更多的消费并非无望。
en: This means that getting Chinese households to spend more is not a hopeless mission.

zh: 据信用卡提供商万事达公司称，到2010年中国的中产阶级将达到1亿，其人均可自由支配收入为5590美元，而富裕阶层将达到750万人，人均可自由支配收入为13500美元。
en: According to the credit card provider MasterCard, by 2010 China’s middle class will number 100 million, each with discretionary spending of $5,590, and 7.5 million affluent people, each with $13,500 to spend.

zh: 但是为什么一定要等到2010年呢？
en: But why wait until 2010?

zh: 如果能够建立起一种坚实的信用文化的话，人们今天就可以开始支配未来的收入。
en: If a decent credit culture can be created, people can have access to tomorrow’s income today.

zh: 二十来岁的人可以借钱去买房子，建立家庭，以及去度假，等他们五十多岁的时候再把钱还回来，然后呆在家里享受天伦之乐。
en: People in their twenties could borrow money to buy a house, start a family, and go on holiday, paying the money back when they are in their fifties and would much rather stay at home and enjoy their grandchildren.

zh: 消费信用只是在九十年代后期才开始在中国出现，政策允许银行提供住房抵押贷款，现在这部分的贷款占到贷款总量的10%左右。
en: Consumer credit began in China only in the late 1990’s, with regulations allowing banks to offer mortgage loans, which now amount to about 10% of total loans.

zh: 根据人民银行（中央银行）最近的一次调查，在十个最大的城市里的家庭平均将大约35%的月收入用于偿还抵押贷款，这与其他一些国家已经相差无几了。
en: According to a recent survey by the People’s Bank (the central bank), households in the ten largest cities spend about 35% of their monthly income on average on mortgage repayments, which is comparable to other countries.

zh: 教育贷款和购车贷款现在也可以实现了，已经有2%的家庭拥有了信用卡，这与美国的75%相比虽然显得很低，但是考虑到五年前甚至没有家庭拥有信用卡，这已经很不错了。
en: Loans for education and car purchases are now also possible, and 2% of households have credit cards, which is obviously still low compared to 75% in the United States, but there were no such households just five years ago.

zh: 尽管大多数人持有的是借记卡，但是像中国招商银行这样的银行已经不遗余力地发放真正的信用卡了。
en: Although debit cards remain far more common, banks like China Merchants Bank have been aggressive in issuing real credit cards.

zh: 信用卡正式上市关键的问题在于支付系统还没有建立。
en: A key problem with the credit card rollout is that the payment system is not yet in place.

zh: 市场上最好的银联系统因为太昂贵而使零售商无力承受，许多商店更喜欢用现金支付以逃税。
en: UnionPay, the market leader, is expensive for retailers to install, and many shops prefer cash to avoid tax.

zh: 可是，根据麦肯锡咨询公司提供的数据，没有清偿的信用卡信贷正在快速增长，2004年同比增长了四倍，占国民生产总值0.18 % 。
en: However, outstanding credit on cards is growing, more than quadrupling year on year in 2004, to 0.18% of GDP, according to the consulting firm McKinsey.

zh: 其他几方面的障碍也必须被克服以刺激消费。
en: Several other obstacles must nonetheless be surmounted in order to boost consumption.

zh: 首先，银行核查借款者的信用诚信程度，包括以前从其他银行的贷款的可靠手段还是太少。
en: First, banks still have few reliable means of checking borrowers’ creditworthiness, including previous loans from other banks.

zh: 教育贷款本应在中国的城市和农村快速增长，但是银行不知道应该把钱贷给谁，所以它们没有把钱贷出去。
en: Educational loans should be booming in urban and rural China, but banks do not know to whom to lend, so they are not.

zh: 其次，银行对欠款不还束手无策。
en: Second, banks are vulnerable to non-repayment.

zh: 车贷市场在2003至2004年间曾经昙花一现，但是欠帐比例超过了50 % ， 迫使银行又退了回去。
en: The car loan market underwent a mini-boom in 2003-04, but non-repayment rates in excess of 50% forced banks to pull back.

zh: 收回汽车的困难（谁知道贷款者把车停在哪儿呢？ ） ， 以及出售收回来的汽车的困难（旧车市场依然处于襁褓中）意味着绝大部分这些坏帐只好一笔勾销了事。
en: The difficulty of repossession (where did the borrower park the car?) and sale (the used-car market is still in its infancy) meant that most of these bad loans had to be written off.

zh: ��高人民法院2003年颁布的一项禁止收回作为住宅的房子的判决也像乌云一样压在抵押市场的头顶。
en: There is also a dark cloud over the mortgage market following a judgment by the Supreme People’s Court in 2003 that banned the repossession of homes that are a primary residence.

zh: 最近对于此项规定的修改允许银行收回房子，但是它们必须协助安排贷款者住进价格便宜一些的替代住房。 对于放贷者来说要将此付诸实施简直是一个行政性噩梦，尤其是如果有很多人同时开始违约的话。
en: A recent revision of that decision permits banks to repossess homes, but only if they help arrange alternative lower-cost housing – an administrative nightmare for lenders, particularly if a lot of people start defaulting at the same time.

zh: 第三，消费者普遍不善于面对利率波动的风险。
en: Third, consumers are generally not adept at dealing with interest-rate risk.

zh: 几乎所有的抵押贷款有着与人民银行规定的五年贷款利率不同的浮动利率。
en: Nearly all mortgages have floating rates that vary with the five-year loan rate set by the People’s Bank.

zh: 尽管如此，去年晚些时候，光大银行和其他一些银行开始提供固定利率的抵押贷款。
en: However, late last year, Everbright Bank and some others began offering fixed-rate mortgages.

zh: 现金购进已经放缓，但是2006年四月份银行利率的突然上调也许能帮助公众认识到利率波动的风险。
en: Take-up has been slow, but the April 2006 surprise hike in bank rates may help to sow greater public awareness of interest-rate risk.

zh: 最后，中国需要使其金融产品多样化。
en: Finally, China needs a greater diversity of financial products.

zh: 直到最近，银行还只能提供简单的储蓄账户。
en: Until recently, banks could offer only simple savings accounts.

zh: 但是结构性的储蓄，比如，回报率与纽约证券交易所的行情挂钩的存款慢慢开始发展起来。
en: But structured deposits – for example, deposits whose rate of return is linked to the performance of the New York Stock Exchange – are becoming increasingly popular.

zh: 证券投资基金现在占到了流通股票市场市值总额的大约30 % ， 尽管它还只占国民生产总值的0.9 % ， 而印度的这一数字为超出5 % 。
en: Securities investment funds now account for roughly 30% of tradable stock market capitalization, although this represents only 0.9% of GDP, compared to more than 5% in India.

zh: 随着外资银行进入市场，新的金融产品在经济中所占的重要性可能会得到飞速发展。
en: The economic significance of new financial products is likely to grow more rapidly as foreign banks enter the market.

zh: 如果中国政府能合理颁发许可证的话，那金融部门将在培育和维护未来消费社会的进程中扮演重要角色。
en: If China’s regulators issue the right licenses, the financial sector will play a key role in nurturing and sustaining the consumer society of tomorrow.

zh: 难民式的罪与罚
en: Crime and Punishment, Refugee Style

zh: Giovanna Reggianni被谋杀的惨剧发生在罗马郊区的Tor di Quinto，这一案件在意大利和罗马尼亚都引起了震动。
en: The horrible murder of Giovanna Reggiani that took place near a Romanian refugee camp in the suburb of Tor di Quinto in Rome shocked both Italy and Romania.

zh: 它进一步激发了关于难民和外国居民问题的热烈公众讨论，这场讨论不但席卷了意大利还波及到整个欧洲，并使该案的意义得到进一步提升。
en: The case gained significance by adding fuel to the fiery public debates now underway not only in Italy but across Europe on the status of refugees and foreign residents.

zh: 有的意大利人以暴力方式回应；有些意大利和罗马尼亚的政客，急于诉诸短平快的解决方式，发表了令舆论哗然的言论，与历史上仇外和极权主义的口号如出一辙。
en: Some Italians responded violently; some Italian and Romanian politicians, eager to offer quick and tough solutions, made scandalous statements that echoed the xenophobic and totalitarian slogans of the past.

zh: 不无讽刺的是，我们正遭遇着一种怪异的“民族自豪感”的逆转：正如文化和体育明星们被国家利用，作为集体的世袭财产。
en: We are encountering, not without irony, a kind of grotesque reverse of the “national pride” seen when cultural and sporting stars are appropriated by the state and presented as part of the collective patrimony.

zh: 虽然谋杀是一种个体犯罪，但通过一种针对整个少数族群的方式使这种犯罪悲剧复杂化是不负责任的，并且对于受到不公正惩罚的人和惩罚者本身都会产生严重的道德和社会后果。
en: Although the murder was an individual crime, to compound the tragedy of a crime through measures that target an entire minority is irresponsible, and will have grave moral and social consequences not only for the unjustly punished but also for the punishers.

zh: 毕竟，没有一个少数族群是单一化的。 向警方报案的人就是杀人者的同胞并来自同一个难民营的事实就说明了这一点。
en: No minority is, after all, homogenous, which was demonstrated by the fact that the person who alerted the police was a compatriot of the killer and from the same camp of refugees.

zh: 集体惩罚也意味着意大利人和罗马尼亚人不仅对法西斯主义、纳粹主义和共产主义的历史，还对自己的民族历史犯了健忘症。
en: Collective punishment also means not only a type of amnesia by Italians and Romanians about what happened under fascism, nazism, communism, but also for their own national histories.

zh: 毕竟，为了过上更好的生活，意大利人不仅从南方迁移到北方，还移民到其他国家。
en: Italians, after all, migrated not only from Italy’s south to its north, but also to other countries looking for a better life.

zh: 他们也同样了解作为难民、流亡者和异乡人的感受。
en: They, too, know what it is like to be a refugee, an exile, a stranger.

zh: 就罗马尼亚而言，其与“罗马”族相关的历史也不甚光彩。 这个民族的缺点和行为常常招致诟病但国家却从未采取过任何的切实行动来改善他们的状况。
en: Romania, for its part, has a history not at all admirable in regard to it its “Roma” minority, whose shortcomings and deeds always attract blame but never any real action by the state to improve their condition.

zh: 罗马族最早出现在14世纪的罗马尼亚，但他们的奴隶制却在1856年才被废除！
en: The Roma minority first appeared in Romania in the 14th century, but only in 1856 was its slavery abolished!

zh: 罗马尼亚社会现在正应对着伤害了几代人、延续了数十年的恐怖与谎言、煽动与贫穷所种下的后果。
en: Romanian society nowadays is dealing with the consequences of decades of terror and lies, of demagogy and poverty that scarred several generations.

zh: 这些伤口不可能很快弥合。
en: These wounds cannot be instantly healed.

zh: 共产主义的崩溃释放出一股巨大的人类能量，但它的起点却是特权和资产在老的“精英阶层（nomenklatura ） ” 内部以一种古怪和愤世嫉俗的方式转移，以及一种新的普遍的达尔文主义者的挣扎。
en: Communism’s fall unleashed a huge surge of human energy, but this started with a bizarre and cynical transfer of privileges and assets within the old “nomenklatura,” and with a new general Darwinian struggle.

zh: 虽然罗马尼亚在经济上取得了显著的进步，并且随着民主的到来公民道德的重建也在逐渐萌芽，但罗马尼亚的政治秀—尽管它已加入欧盟—也反映出口是心非、自相矛盾、宿命、惯性和腐败等陈年陋习是多么的顽固。
en: Although economic progress is visible across Romania, and a gradual renewal of a civic conscience through the arrival of democracy has appeared, Romania’s burlesque of a political life – despite its European Union membership – shows how persistent its bad old habits of duplicity, inconsistency, fatalism, inertia, and corruption are.

zh: 的确，腐败现在似乎成为了社会的引擎。
en: Corruption, indeed, now seems to be the society’s engine.

zh: 当今的罗马尼亚仍然有被排挤到社会边缘的弱势和被忽视的群体。
en: There remain in Romania today disadvantaged and neglected groups who are pushed to society’s sordid margins.

zh: 的确，罗马族的人口中有41%是季节性工人，33.5%缺乏任何的专业技能，38.7%是文盲。
en: The Roma population, indeed, has 41% seasonal workers, 33.5 % lack any professional skills, 38.7 % are illiterate.

zh: 这不仅是罗马尼亚的问题，还业已成为全欧洲的问题。
en: This is not only a Romanian problem, but has become a problem for all of Europe.

zh: 被指控谋杀Giovanna Reggianni的25岁青年Nicolae Romulus Mailat在14岁时就被拘押，进入一所工读学校就读。
en: Nicolae Romulus Mailat, the young man of 25 accused of Giovanna Reggianni’s murder, had been interned at age 14 in a school for re-education.

zh: 后来他又一次因为偷窃而获罪，但在来意大利的前一年被赦免。
en: He was later condemned again for theft, but was pardoned a year before arriving in Italy.

zh: 贫穷是造成他在罗马尼亚的少年犯罪和意大利的罪行的原因么？
en: Was poverty the cause of his juvenile offenses in Romania and his crime in Italy?

zh: 在陀思妥耶夫斯基的伟大小说《罪与罚》中，把Raskolnikov推向犯罪深渊的不仅是虚无主义和叛逆心态，还有贫穷。
en: In Dostoievski’s great novel Crime and Punishment , Raskolnikov is pushed to committing his crime not only by his nihilism and rebelliousness, but also by poverty.

zh: 他的社会认同与Mailat不同，他的精神“存在”也迥异，但他的双重罪行却同样令人憎恶。
en: His social identity is not the same as Mailat’s, his spiritual “entity” is drastically different, but his double crime is no less abominable.

zh: 目前，人们没有任何理由希望Mailat能通过痛苦和心灵的重建从他的罪行中找到通向救赎的新起点。
en: For now, there is no reason to hope that Mailat will find through his crime a new start towards salvation through suffering and spiritual renewal.

zh: 但我们也许应该回想一下Raskolnikov的一位对话者在提到他混迹其间的“令人厌恶的索多玛”时所讲的话。 他说贫穷不是一种堕落，而苦难才是。
en: But perhaps we should hear again the words of one of Raskolnikov’s interlocutors when he speaks about the “disgusting Sodome” in which he wanders and says that poverty is not a vice, but misery.

zh: 在贫穷中，人们依然可以保持一份“与生俱来的高尚情操 ” ， 而在苦难中，道德沦丧是固有和灾难性的。
en: In poverty one still keeps a kind of “innate noble sentiment,” while in misery moral collapse is inherent and disastrous.

zh: Mailat企图摆脱他的罗马尼亚苦难和过去，但却想像不到自己在意大利的难民营中会经历和先前同样的苦难；也想像不到自己在镜中的新的日常形象会是一个杀手。
en: Mailat sought escape from his Romanian misery and his Romanian past, but could not imagine that he would find in an Italian refugee camp as much misery as before; that the image in the mirror of his daily new life would be that of a killer.

zh: 了解Tor di Quinto一带可怕的治安状况的人猛烈的抨击了罗马市政府的严重忽视和漠不关心。
en: People who know the frightening neighborhood of Tor di Quinto, where Giovanna Reggiani was killed have harsh words to say about the neglect and indifference of Rome’s city government.

zh: 当然，这虽然不是这一桩或任何一桩罪行的借口，但也不容忽视。
en: This isn’t, of course, an excuse for this crime or for any crime, but it cannot be ignored.

zh: 虽然我们不能期望Mailat奇迹般转世再生，但我们能够也必须要求对和他一样的边缘人群的情况进行彻底评估。
en: Although we cannot expect a miraculous reincarnation of the criminal Mailat, we can and must ask for a radical review of the situation that marginalized people like him face.

zh: 这种评估不光要由罗马尼亚和意大利国家实施，也要由罗马尼亚和意大利的罗马族社团和欧盟同时进行。
en: That review must be done not only by Romanian and Italian states, but by the Roma community in Romania and Italy and also by the European community itself.

zh: 因为该罪犯是所有上述社会组织的一员。
en: For the perpetrator is a member of all these communities.

zh: 我们听到被欧盟的扩大及其所造成的社会紧张状况激怒的声音。
en: We hear voices now who are exasperated by the EU’s enlargement and the social tensions it provoked.

zh: 的确，日渐汹涌的移民潮是我们离心而又全球化的现代性中不容否认的事实。 而它也不仅仅是负面的。
en: Increased migration is, indeed, a daily fact in our centrifugal and global modernity, but it isn’t only a negative one.

zh: 人员的自由流动并不只是意味着更多的社会冲突和更高的犯罪率。
en: The free movement of people doesn’t only mean more social conflict and criminality.

zh: 它也意味着从二战以后就立即开始的一种渐进和有益的共同生活状态。 它作为一种共同努力帮助战败国，并提升它们实现民主和繁荣的机会。
en: It also means a gradual and beneficial cohabitation that began immediately after WWII as a common effort to help out the defeated countries and enhance their chances for democracy and prosperity.

zh: 当我去年访问巴塞罗纳和马德里时，我对这两个城市里的罗马尼亚人群体正在成功壮大的好消息深感欣慰。
en: When I visited Barcelona and Madrid last year, I was delighted to receive enthusiastic news about the successes of the growing Romanian community in these cities.

zh: 有些罗马尼亚难民已经成为地方选举的候选人，由于勤奋和诚实而为人称道。
en: Some Romanian refugees were already candidates for the local elections, praised for their hard work and honesty.

zh: 我希望这样的情况还会发生在其他地方，不仅是在罗马尼亚人中间，也在所有准备好面对我们这个时代的挑衅的人们中间。
en: It will happen, I hope, also in other places and not only with Romanians but with all the people ready to face the provocations of our time.

zh: 因为这些例子不仅是个人的成功，也是群体的胜利。
en: For these are examples not only of individual success, but are victories for the community as well.

zh: 欧洲应该证明自己是一个真正的社会，一个多元、民主、高尚、自由和繁荣的社会。
en: Europe deserves to prove that it is a real community, one diverse, democratic, spiritual, free, and prosperous.

zh: 铁窗后的金融之星？
en: Financial Stars Behind Bars?

zh: 发自芝加哥 — — 每天都有银行和美国政府机构或监管机构进行清偿结算。
en: CHICAGO – Hardly a day goes by without a settlement between a bank and a US government agency or regulator.

zh: 最近的一个纠纷和解发生在美国银行和政府支持的抵押贷款机构房利美（Fannie Mae）之间，它包括：现金共计35.5亿美元；67.5亿美元用于回购不良抵押贷款 — — 这是全美金融公司卖给房利美的，前者后来被美国银行收购；以及额外的13亿现金用以解决房利美与美国银行之间的服务问题。
en: The latest one is between Bank of America and the government-backed mortgage underwriter Fannie Mae: $3.55 billion in cash; $6.75 billion in repurchases of bad mortgages that Countrywide, later acquired by BoA, sold to Fannie; and an additional $1.3 billion in cash to resolve Fannie’s servicing issues with BoA.

zh: 然而，一如在大多数和解中那样，美国银行并没有承认任何错误。
en: And yet, as in most settlements, BoA did not admit any fault.

zh: 美国银行犯错是因为运气不好，还是因为行事草率？
en: Was BoA tripped up by bad luck or sloppiness?

zh: 还是说它和其他金融机构都在故意欺骗投资者？
en: Or did it and other financial institutions behave with intent to defraud investors?

zh: 由于该和解，我们将永远不会知道真相（至少是一个可以经得起公众质疑的版本）是什么。
en: As a result of the settlement, we will never learn the truth (at least the version that is established beyond a reasonable doubt in open court).

zh: 在每一个和解里，调查都会被中止，所有发现都会被封存。
en: In each settlement, the investigations are stopped, and whatever has been found is sealed.

zh: 幸运地是，学术研究对这个重要的事件也许能够作出一些解释。
en: Fortunately, academic research may be able to shed some light on this important matter.

zh: 在最近的一篇论文中，经济学家托马斯·皮茨科斯基（Tomasz Piskorski ） 、 阿米特·塞鲁（Amit Seru）和詹姆斯·维特金（James Witkin）比较了那些证券化抵押贷款在出售时向投资者公开的信息与银行专有数据库内贷款的特征。
en: In a recent paper, the economists Tomasz Piskorski, Amit Seru, and James Witkin compare the characteristics of securitized mortgages as they were disclosed to investors at the time of sale with these loans’ characteristics as they were recorded in the banks’ proprietary databases.

zh: 该数据覆盖的是非代理住房抵押贷款，这与和解所针对的贷款并不相同，而且数据来自多家银行，所以我们并不知道哪些银行参与其中。
en: The data cover non-agency residential mortgages, which are not the same as those targeted by the settlement, and the data come from a pool of banks, so we do not know which banks were present.

zh: 但它们的数据竟如此相似，让人不难明白发生了什么。
en: But their data are similar enough to enable us to learn a lot about what was going on.

zh: 如果大规模的证券化抵押贷款违约完全是运气不好的结果，我们就会看到报告给投资者的数据特征与银行数据库所记录的数据特征是一样的。
en: If the massive wave of defaults on securitized mortgages was purely the result of bad luck, we would expect that the characteristics reported to investors would not differ from those recorded in the banks’ databases.

zh: 与违约风险相关的数据特征更是如此，比如借款人是业主还是投资者，或者该财产是否有二次质押。
en: This is especially true of characteristics that are relevant to default risk, such as whether the borrower was an owner or an investor, or whether there was a second lien on the property.

zh: 事实上，论文的作者们发现超过6%的抵押贷款错报了借款人的房屋使用状况，同时有7%的抵押贷款记录并未公开二次质押状况。
en: In fact, the authors find that more than 6% of mortgage loans misreport the borrower’s occupancy status, while 7% do not disclose second liens.

zh: 当然，任何数据库都会有误差。
en: Of course, any database contains errors.

zh: 那么以上所提到的错误大到足以令人担忧吗？
en: Are these errors large enough to be worrisome?

zh: 我们如何能确定银行故意虚报了这一信息，而不仅仅只是写报告时不小心犯了错？
en: And how can we be sure that the banks knowingly misrepresented this information, rather than that they merely were sloppy in reporting it?

zh: 在这种情况下，该论文的作者们提供了一些有趣的证据。
en: The authors provide some interesting evidence in this context.

zh: 比如，他们表明出错的数据与高违约贷款密切相关：报告出错的贷款违约率比那些在其他方面相似的贷款要高出60 % 。
en: They show, for example, that the misrepresentation is correlated with higher defaults down the line: delinquent payments on misreported loans are more than 60% higher than on loans that are otherwise similar.

zh: 因此，这些错误似乎并不是随机的，而是蓄意人为的。
en: Thus, the errors do not seem to be random, but purposeful.

zh: 而该论文的作者们并未发现的东西也很有趣。
en: What the authors do not find is also interesting.

zh: 虚报的程度似乎与提供给高管的激励以及这些公司内实施的风险管理质量并不相关。
en: The degree of misrepresentation seems to be unrelated to the incentives provided to the top management and to the quality of risk-management practices inside these firms.

zh: 事实上，所有信誉良好的中介在他们的样品上都表现了很大程度的虚报。
en: In fact, all reputable intermediaries in their sample exhibit a significant degree of misrepresentation.

zh: 因此，问题似乎并不仅限于一些害群之马，而是普遍性的。
en: Thus, the problem does not seem to be limited to a few bad apples, but is pervasive.

zh: 如此要找到一个解决方案就更难了。
en: This makes a solution more difficult to achieve.

zh: 毕竟，如果是金融行业的巨头们在误导投资者，那整个行业的文化都需要被改变。
en: After all, if the financial industry’s leaders are misleading investors, it is the culture of the entire industry that needs to be changed.

zh: 不幸的是，这些巨大的清偿和解并没有什么作用。
en: Unfortunately, these giant settlements are unlikely to make a difference.

zh: 这些和解的钱是股东和纳税人出的（大部分结算都是免税的 ） ， 却让那些最终应该负责的人一走了之，而且他们都能带着一大笔钱离开。
en: They are paid by shareholders and taxpayers (most of these settlements are tax-deductible), leaving the people who were ultimately responsible not only to walk away, but to walk away very rich.

zh: 比如，安吉洛·莫兹里奥（Angelo Mozilo）在美国国家金融服务公司任首席执行官期间收入达4.7亿美元。
en: For example, Angelo Mozilo received almost $470 million during his tenure as CEO of Countrywide Financial.

zh: 据我所知，美国银行116亿美元的解决费用，他一分钱也没付。
en: As far as I know, he paid nothing of BoA’s $11.6 billion settlement cost.

zh: 莫兹里奥的确和美国证券交易委员和解了，但费用不一样（内幕交易 ） 。
en: Mozilo did settle with the SEC, but on different charges (insider trading).

zh: 6.75亿美元的费用他只需出4.75亿美元，因为2亿美元的补偿协议是他雇佣合同的一部分。
en: And he paid only $47.5 million of the $67.5 million settlement, owing to a $20 million indemnification agreement that was part of his employment contract.

zh: 为什么莫兹里奥和其他高管能够被允许付相对少的赔偿而又能避免刑事诉讼呢？
en: Why have Mozilo and others been allowed to pay a relative pittance and avoid criminal proceedings?

zh: 若干重要的刑事定罪已经给打击内幕交易发出了强有力的信号。
en: A few prominent criminal convictions have sent a powerful signal in the fight against insider trading.

zh: 如果目标是整个行业范围的欺骗文化，刑事司法系统不也应该被动员来打击银行的抵押贷款欺诈吗？
en: If the target is an industry-wide culture of deception, shouldn’t the criminal justice system be mobilized against banks’ mortgage fraud as well?

zh: 论对艾滋病毒的刑事犯罪化
en: Criminalizing HIV

zh: 约翰内斯堡 - “ 如果法律是这样认定的 ” ， 查尔斯·狄更斯的小说《雾都孤儿》中的邦博先生这样说道“ 那么法律就是个屁。 ”有一种刑事法律，它使艾滋病毒携带者宁愿不知道自己已经被感染并能传播给包括亲人在内的其他人，这样的法律似乎特别适合邦博先生的谴责。
en: JOHANNESBURG – “If the law supposes that,” Mr. Bumble says in Charles Dickens’ novel Oliver Twist, “the law is an ass.”  A criminal law that makes it preferable for carriers of HIV not to know that they are infected and capable of spreading it to others, including their loved ones, seems particularly suited to Mr. Bumble’s condemnation.

zh: 然而，悲剧性的是，世界上许多地方的立法者们在阻止艾滋病毒和艾滋病蔓延的过程中犯了错误，他们通过了一种能增加人们对艾滋病的无知并惩罚艾滋病的受害者的刑事法，而且还会提高该病毒感染的机率。
en: Yet tragically, in a misguided attempt to thwart the spread of HIV and AIDS, lawmakers in many parts of the world have passed criminal statues that promote ignorance about the disease, punish its victims, and enhance the chances that the virus will infect new victims.

zh: 一些中部及西部的非洲国家正在颁布仓促起草的基于非洲示范法之上的政策，那么任何感染了这种病毒的人，如果将病毒传染给别人或使另一人受到感染的威胁，这就成了一种刑事犯罪行为。
en: Some countries in Western and Central Africa are enacting poorly drafted policies based on the African Model Law, which makes it a criminal offense for any person infected by the virus to transmit it to someone else or to expose another person to it.

zh: 在一些管辖区，检察机关可以对艾滋病毒抗体呈阳性的孕妇提出起诉，因为她们让未出生的孩子受到病菌感染的危险。
en: In some jurisdictions, prosecutors can bring charges against pregnant women who are HIV-positive for potentially exposing the virus to their unborn children.

zh: 可以肯定，确实是有罕见的富有戏剧性的案例，如一个艾滋病毒感染者怀着加害别人的意图去感染另一个人。
en: There are, to be sure, rare and dramatic cases in which a person with HIV infects another with the specific intention of inflicting harm.

zh: 事实上非洲一些地区的男性艾滋病毒感染者或艾滋病患者甚至去强奸少女，因为他们相信与处女发生性行为可以治愈艾滋病。
en: It is a reality that men infected with HIV or AIDS in some parts of Africa have even raped girls believing that sex with virgins is a cure.

zh: 一些妇女权利倡导者支持将传播艾滋病毒刑事化的法律，认为这些法律将严惩向性伴侣包括他们的妻子和女朋友隐瞒自己感染了艾滋病毒的男子。
en: And some women’s rights advocates have supported laws that criminalize transmitting HIV, arguing that these laws would punish men who concealed their HIV-positive status from their sexual partners, including their wives and girlfriends.

zh: 但是，现有的刑事法足以让已有准备的司法系统对打算损害他人者进行恰当的制裁。
en: But existing criminal laws are more than adequate to allow willing justice systems to mete out appropriate sanctions against people who intend harm.

zh: 但是，针对所有艾滋病毒携带者的刑事法是起反效果的，本质上也是不公正的。
en: Criminal laws targeting all HIV carriers, however, are counter-productive and inherently unjust.

zh: 这些法律有效地使数以百万计的疾病的无辜受害者特别是其女性受害者沦为犯罪分子。
en: These laws effectively make criminals out of millions of the disease’s innocent victims, especially its women victims.

zh: 例如，在津巴布韦一名妇女最近被判了刑，因为她让的情人处于感染艾滋病毒的危险中，即使她最终没有感染他。
en: In Zimbabwe, for example, a woman was recently sentenced for exposing her lover to HIV even though she did not infect him.

zh: 在乌克兰，人权律师的令人不安的报告中有一名妇女因为传播艾滋病毒给她的丈夫而被定罪，即使他使用了安全套并要求撤回起诉。
en: In Ukraine, human rights lawyers report the troubling case of a woman who was convicted for transmitting HIV to her husband even though he had used a condom, and despite the fact that he asked for the charges to be withdrawn.

zh: 对妇女的性别偏见遍及整个非洲，妇女通常被指责为把艾滋病毒带进两人关系。
en: Gender bias against women permeates throughout Africa, and women are usually blamed for bringing HIV into a relationship.

zh: 这种广泛流行的误解，至少部分源自一个事实，即妇女相对来说更可能知道他们是否感染了艾滋病毒，因为他们在产科诊所作怀孕测试或身体检查时，检查艾滋病毒是常规的检测项目。
en: This popular misconception springs, at least in part, from the fact that women are more likely to know their HIV status because they are routinely tested for HIV at maternity clinics when they seek pregnancy tests or examinations.

zh: 另一方面，大多数男人因为无知和自大，有时还因为忌讳而踌躇不前，拒绝接受自愿检测。
en: Most men on the other hand—deterred by fear, ignorance, pride, and, sometimes, taboo—refuse to be tested voluntarily.

zh: 这损害了法律案件的审判结果的公正性，因为少见测试过HIV的男子，所以一个感染了艾滋病毒的女人在法庭上几乎无法证明是她的男性性伴侣感染了她。
en: This skews the outcomes of legal cases because the lack of testing of men makes it nearly impossible for a woman infected with HIV to establish before a court of law that her male sex partner infected her.

zh: 将传播艾滋病毒刑事化有损于公众健康，因为这些法律阻止了艾滋病毒抗体阳性并有风险感染病毒的人们去寻求测试、辅导和治疗。
en: Laws criminalizing the transmission of HIV undermine public health because they deter people who are HIV-positive and those at risk of acquiring the virus from seeking testing, counseling, and treatment.

zh: 当人们面临刑事制裁的可能性时，对自己是否感染的不知晓就可以作为他们最有效的法律辩护手段。 对于许多人，尤其是对男子以及居住在艾滋病毒治疗十分短缺的地区的人们，被起诉的可能性会起到阻止他们寻求检测的作用，以避免担当刑事责任的风险。
en: When persons face the possibility of criminal sanctions, not knowing their HIV status can be their most-effective legal defense.  Prosecutions will act to deter many people—especially men as well as persons living in areas where HIV treatment is largely unavailable—from being tested because it would expose them to the risk of criminal liability.

zh: 这样的法律还将艾滋病毒的受害者变为社会问题的替罪羊。 战胜这种疾病，需要政府和更广泛的社会群体采取有效的、有时需要冒政治上或文化上的风险的措施，但却没有能做到。
en: Such laws also transform HIV victims into scapegoats for a societal problem for which the governments and broader societies are failing to undertake effective, and sometimes politically or culturally risky, steps that can defeat the disease.

zh: 可悲的是，这些所谓的“冒险”的步骤包括以下这些最基本的事情，例如对疾病的公开讨论、教育和鼓励人们（尤其是男性）去进行检测。
en: Sadly, these “risky” steps include things as rudimentary as open discussion of the disease, education, and encouraging people, and especially men, to undergo testing.

zh: 自从医学科学家于1981年发现首例艾滋病以来，它已经夺去了2500多万人的生命。
en: AIDS has claimed more than 25 million lives since medical scientists first identified it in 1981.

zh: 在治疗方面所作的努力其速度仍然赶不上新感染的人数。
en: New infections continue to outpace treatment efforts.

zh: 基本的预防措施如艾滋病毒测试、男用和女用安全套以及注射毒品用的无菌注射针筒对于绝大多数需要它们的人来说，依然不能得到。
en: Basic precautionary options such as HIV testing, male and female condoms, and sterile syringes for drug injection remain out of reach for the vast majority of those who need them.

zh: 这种令人悲伤的情况要求我们采取有效的行动，而不是增加更多的受害者和替罪羊。
en: This woeful situation demands effective action and not more victims and scapegoats.

zh: 公开和知情的对HIV病毒流行的讨论、预防艾滋病感染的教育、安全套的发放以及其它的战略是目前唯一的已知的预防新的感染的方法。
en: Open, informed discussion of the HIV epidemic, education into HIV prevention, distribution of condoms, and other strategies are the only known way of preventing new infections.

zh: 解决妇女更易感染艾滋病的途径，应该通过保护他们在婚姻财产方面的平等权、实施包括禁止婚内强奸在内的性别暴力的法律以及赋予他们和男子谈判安全性行为的力量的方法。
en: The vulnerability of women to HIV should be addressed by protecting their equal right to marital property, enforcing laws against gender-based violence, including rape in marriage, and empowering them to negotiate safer sex with men.

zh: 被断开的伦敦银行间拆借利率
en: Libor Unplugged

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 去年的伦敦银行间拆借利率（London Interbank Offered Rate，简称Libor）操纵丑闻对伦敦的政治体来说确实是一大冲击。
en: LONDON – Last year’s Libor scandal was a shock to the body politic in London.

zh: 尽管公众及其民意代表们早已见多识广，但银行家们为了一己私利而有计划有步骤地腐蚀这项全球市场基准指标 — — 还是以伦敦来命名首发 — — 存在基础的行为还是让前者大为震惊。
en: Despite all that had gone before, the public and their representatives were stunned to learn that bankers had systematically undermined the foundations of a global market benchmark – one with London in its name to boot – for personal gain.

zh: 对此英国财政大臣乔治·奥斯本（George Osborne）觉得有必要发起一项议会调查。
en: Britain’s Chancellor of the Exchequer, George Osborne, felt compelled to launch a parliamentary inquiry.

zh: 一年之后的6月19号，英国议会银行业标准委员会终于取得了一项重大成果。
en: On June 19, after a year’s work, the Parliamentary Commission on Banking Standards finally laid a large egg.

zh: 银行家们必将对这个成果视为英格兰人所谓“牧师的鸡蛋 ” （ 一位年轻牧师与主教共进早餐但发现端上来的鸡蛋臭了，面对上级的亲切询问而又不敢得罪，牧师无奈回答说这个鸡蛋“肯定有一部分还是好的 ” ） 。
en: Bankers will certainly regard the outcome as what in England we like to call a “curate’s egg” (served a rotten egg by his bishop, a young clergyman, when asked whether the egg was to his liking, replied that it was “good in parts”).

zh: 委员会提出增设一种新的罪名 — — 所谓导致纳税人救助的贸然行为，该罪名同时又被新的“高级人员”管理体制所强化，它会将所有的银行功能归于一个特定的个人，一旦出了问题，他/她就要以个人身份承担责任。
en: They will choke on the commission’s recommendation of a new criminal offense for reckless conduct that leads to taxpayer bailouts, reinforced by a new “senior persons” regime that would ascribe all bank functions to a specific individual, who would be held personally liable when things go wrong.

zh: 委员会认为“高层银行家通过声称不知情或集体决策来逃避自身监管失误所应付的责任 ” 。
en: The commission argues that “top bankers dodged accountability for failings on their watch by claiming ignorance or hiding behind collective decision-making.”

zh: 其委员致力于杜绝这类行为。
en: Its members aim to make that impossible.

zh: 如果银行家们仍继续为所欲为，肆意处置银行资产将会导致牢狱之灾，对这些世界金融主宰者来说不会再有大富翁游戏式的“脱罪卡”这回事了。
en: If they have their way, behaving recklessly with banking assets will result in a prison sentence, with no Monopoly-style “get out of jail free” card for financial masters of the universe.

zh: 我仿佛已经听到了律师们摩拳擦掌的声音：这种违法行为必须被定义得足够具体以便禁得起人权挑战。
en: I can already hear the sound of lawyers sharpening their pencils: the offense must be defined specifically enough to withstand a human-rights challenge.

zh: 而一旦实施，委员会建议的管理体制肯定要比现在纽约或其它金融中心推行的更加严厉。
en: But, if implemented, the commission’s proposed regime would certainly be tougher than what is now on offer in New York or other banking centers.

zh: 而英国的国会议员们显然对现行全球监管的缓慢变革速度极不耐烦；他们想要马上行动。
en: And British MPs are noticeably impatient with what they consider the glacial pace of change in global regulation; they want action now.

zh: 如果英国确实单方面实施了这一措施，对伦敦金融业来说会有什么样的后果呢？
en: If the United Kingdom does proceed in this unilateral way, what would the consequences be for London’s banking industry?

zh: 纽约、法兰克福、甚至巴黎的竞争力会不会因此大幅提升，因为国际银行家们害怕万一自己的衍生品交易再次出事而面临牢狱之灾，纷纷逃离伦敦？
en: Would New York, Frankfurt, or even Paris receive a competitive boost as international bankers, alarmed at the prospect of time behind bars if their derivative trades blow up again, flee the City?

zh: 委员会成员对这个问题给出了两个有点相互矛盾的答案。
en: The commission’s members offer two, somewhat contradictory, answers to that question.

zh: 第一个答案是，坦白地说，他们不在乎。
en: The first is that, frankly, they don’t care.

zh: 委员会认为伦敦“应该忽视大批撤离的风险 ” ， 他们注意到作为全球金融中心的优势一直都伴随着国内经济的相关严重风险。
en: “The risk of an exodus should be disregarded,” the commission says, noting that the advantages of being a global financial center have been accompanied by serious associated risks to the domestic economy.

zh: 跟金融业只占GDP一小部分的美国不同，由于银行业持续紧缩，英国经济的产出仍然未能从2008年后大萧条的损失中恢复过来。
en: Unlike the United States, where the financial sector is smaller as a share of GDP, the UK economy has still not recovered the output lost in the post-2008 Great Recession, owing to continued retrenchment in the banking sector.

zh: 委员会的成员也确实意识到伦敦失去全球金融中心地位对就业和产出来说损失很严重，所以他们还准备了第二套说辞。
en: The commission’s members do recognize that London’s loss of status as a global financial center would be costly in terms of jobs and output, so they developed a second line of argument.

zh: 他们说：在平等的国际金融竞技场上 ， “ 没有什么是天生完美的 ” 。
en: “There is nothing inherently optimal,” they say, about a level playing field in international finance.

zh: 在他们看来，试图建立一个单一的欧洲金融市场迫使各国以“船队中最慢的船”的速度来对2008年危机暴露的错误作出反应。
en: Attempts to develop a single European financial market have, in their view, forced countries to respond to the failings revealed by the 2008 crisis at the speed of the “slowest ship in the convoy.”

zh: 与此这等慢速相反的是，委员会提出 ， “ 如果英国可以表现出自身能建立并坚持远超国际最低限度水平的标准，那么对其作为金融中心可能会有巨大的好处。
en: By contrast, the commission argues, “there may be big benefits to the UK as a financial center from demonstrating that it can establish and adhere to standards significantly above the international minimum.”

zh: ”除了严格的新个人负责体制之外，委员会将制定一个更保守的杠杆比率来补充巴塞尔银行资本标准。
en: In addition to the tough new regime of personal accountability, the commission would supplement the Basel standards on bank capital with a tight leverage ratio.

zh: 随着下一期选举逼近，英国政府一心想要找到刺激经济增长的方法。 他们在做任何改变之前肯定会认真思考，以免做出任何会把商业赶到其它国家的错误决定。
en: The British government, preoccupied with finding ways to stimulate growth as the next election approaches, will no doubt think hard before making any changes that might drive business offshore.

zh: 但英国政府同时又受到两方面的压力，一方面国会受到对银行怀有敌意的媒体和公众舆论强烈支持，非常渴望实施改革；另一方面欧盟又下达指令要实施更严格的管理体制。
en: But the government is caught between a rock and a hard place, hemmed in by a parliament that, strongly backed by a bank-hostile press and public opinion, is eager to enact reforms, and by EU directives to implement a tougher regime.

zh: 那么，国会要求政府必须迅速推行改革并忽视其后果的做法是对的么？
en: So, is the Commission right that the government should move quickly on reform and disregard the consequences?

zh: 正如人们可以从国际性调查中找到的证据所显示的一样，迄今为止实施的监管变化并没有赶走银行家们。
en: Such evidence as one can find from international surveys suggests that the regulatory changes implemented so far have not driven bankers away.

zh: 伦敦已经实施了一套比其他大多数金融中心现有管理体制严格得多的方法。
en: London has already implemented an approach that is tougher than that of most other financial centers.

zh: 对高管奖金征收的税已经让国际银行狠狠地出了一次血。
en: Taxes levied on executive bonuses have cost international banks dearly.

zh: 现在伦敦的银行管理者明显比纽约的同行们要严格并进行着更多的干预。
en: Regulators are now appreciably tougher and more intrusive than their counterparts in New York.

zh: 银行家们并不喜欢这种变化，但他们并没有因此离开伦敦去那些看似更适宜的地方。
en: Bankers don’t like it, but they have not yet left for more congenial locations.

zh: 他们也没有表示将来会离开。
en: Nor do they indicate that they will.

zh: 确实，最新的全球金融中心Z-Yen指数表明伦敦依然保持着榜首位置 — — 而它的利润超过纽约的情况也没有变化。
en: Indeed, the latest Z-Yen index of global financial centers showed London maintaining its first-place position – and with its margin over New York unchanged.

zh: 正如人们所预料的一样，亚洲金融中心正在迎头赶上，但它们还远算不上伦敦某些业务上的直接竞争对手。
en: The Asian centers are catching up, as one would expect, but they are hardly direct competitors for business that would otherwise be done in London.

zh: 法兰克福和巴黎看似是伦敦最合理的竞争对手，却分别只在第十和第二十六位徘徊。
en: Frankfurt and Paris, the most plausible European competitors, languish in tenth and 26th place, respectively.

zh: 一个更严格的监管环境并不一定是件坏事的说法会让评级机构和股票持有者们感到非常紧张。
en: Rating agencies and shareholders are nervous when they hear that a stricter regulatory environment is not necessarily a disadvantage.

zh: 但在一个个人责任强烈影响一个地区内所有个人的管理体制会让银行家们停下来想一想，尤其对那些有着复杂矩阵式管理体系，可以将其产品开发主管转移到别的地方去的国际银行来说。
en: But a regime in which personal responsibility strongly affects individuals in one jurisdiction will give bankers pause for thought, especially in the case of global banks with complex matrix-management systems that enable product heads to be moved elsewhere.

zh: 英国的立法者将需要满足于所有可以以恰当方式夺得合适人才的管理体制。
en: British legislators will need to be satisfied that any new regime captures the right people, in the right way.

zh: 不管这种让狡诈的银行家蹲监狱的想法在政治上多有吸引力，真要把银行家送到监狱是很难实现的。
en: However politically appealing the idea of rogue bankers behind bars might be, putting them there is likely to remain very challenging in practice.

zh: 跛腿的巴基斯坦
en: Crippled Pakistan

zh: 发自新德里 — — 巴基斯坦领导层所面对的问题和困境 — — 包括不断加深的互不信任漩涡，派系仇杀以及厚颜无耻的恐怖主义 — — 简直不可尽数。
en: NEW DELHI – The problems and dilemmas confronting Pakistan’s leadership – including a deepening vortex of mutual suspicions, sectarian killings, and brazen terrorism – are almost too numerous to count.

zh: 而领导层 — — 不管是平民，军人还是目前在政治上最积极的司法人员 — — 都已经被证实是先天不足，令整个国家只剩下残破的经济以及瘫痪了的政治系统。
en: And that leadership – whether civilian, military, and also the now politically active judiciary – has proven congenitally ineffective, leaving the country with a broken economy and a paralyzed political system.

zh: 全世界对该区域的关注核心就是两场塔利班运动的复杂现实 — — 一个在阿富汗，很大程度上由势力强大的巴基斯坦三军情报局控制着；还有一个是在巴基斯坦国内，正在资助一场日益邪恶的旨在反对巴基斯坦政府的游击战争。
en: Central to the world’s concerns about the region is the complex reality of the two Taliban movements – one in Afghanistan, over which Pakistan’s powerful Directorate for Inter-Services Intelligence has a great deal of control, and one in Pakistan itself, which is waging an increasingly vicious guerrilla war against the Pakistani government.

zh: 由于美国和北约已经决定在2014年末前将所有部队撤离阿富汗，很可能塔利班不但会重新夺回权力，还会将巴基斯坦变成一个真正的失败国家。
en: With the United States and NATO due to withdraw all troops from Afghanistan by the end of 2014, there is a real possibility that the Taliban will not only regain power there, but will also turn Pakistan into a truly failed state.

zh: 但振奋人心的是，在向阿富汗运输军事补给的开伯尔山口被切断整整7个月后 — — 这起事件因为北约部队向别境地区开火造成巴基斯坦士兵死伤而引起 — — 北约卡车终于在7月初获得通行许可。
en: Encouragingly, after a gap of seven months when no military supplies could reach Afghanistan via the Khyber Pass – a cutoff that followed the death of Pakistani soldiers at the hands of NATO troops firing across the border – NATO trucks in early July were finally allowed to cross again.

zh: 而美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿也不无保留地宣称 ： “ （巴基斯坦）外长希娜·拉巴尼·哈尔（Hina Rabbani Khar）和我都认识到了由巴基斯坦军人伤亡所引发的错误事件。
en: Somewhat guardedly, US Secretary of State Hillary Clinton announced: “(Pakistani) Foreign Minister (Hina Rabbani) Khar and I acknowledged the mistakes that resulted in the loss of Pakistani military lives.

zh: 我们对巴基斯坦军队所遭受的损失感到抱歉。
en: We are sorry for the losses suffered by the Pakistani military.”

zh: ”前者保证避免在未来发生这类事件的承诺似乎也满足了巴方重开北约边界补给线的条件。
en: Her affirmation of commitment to preventing such an event in the future appears to have sufficed to re-open the border to NATO’s resupply through Pakistan.

zh: 这起搬起石头砸自己脚的危机如今已经落幕，但美巴双方是否又能防止本已复杂且相互依赖的关系不再继续恶化。
en: This self-defeating crisis is now over, but can both sides really prevent further deterioration in their complex, mutually dependent relationship?

zh: 这个问题之所以如此重要，是因为巴基斯坦对国家定义和区域安全的要求是构建在对其周边邻国的恐惧之上。
en: This question matters principally because Pakistan’s quest for national identity and territorial security is rooted in existential fear of its neighbors.

zh: 但不幸的是，正如美国外交智库斯庭森中心（Stimson Center）创始人迈克尔·克里潘所观察到的那样，维持着这个国家的“孤立和下滑”的正是巴基斯坦的官方策略。
en: Unfortunately, as Michael Krepon of the Stimson Center, an American foreign-policy think tank, observes, official Pakistani tactics sustain the country’s “isolation and decline.”

zh: 此外，克里潘认为美国的策略加深了“它与巴基斯坦的不和 ” 。
en: Moreover, America’s tactics, Krepon argues, heighten “its estrangement with Pakistan.

zh: 只要当前的政策保持固定不变，新的争执将不可避免地在巴基斯坦，周边邻国以及美国之间出现。
en: As long as current policies remain fixed, new points of contention seem inevitable between Pakistan, its neighbors, and the United States.”

zh: 南亚地区最大的问题就是美国/北约的撤军究竟会缓解还是进一步加深巴基斯坦的困境。
en: The big question across South Asia is whether or not the withdrawal of US/NATO troops will attenuate Pakistan’s dilemmas or deepen them.

zh: 而这很大程度上将取决于巴基斯坦如何处理其内部骚乱以及阿富汗局势将如何发展。
en: Much will depend on how Pakistan addresses its internal turbulence, as well as how the situation in Afghanistan evolves.

zh: 许多巴基斯坦人，包括认为当前处于政治真空的前外长萨尔塔·阿齐兹（Sartaz Aziz ） ， 对此都不乐观。
en: Many Pakistanis, including Sartaz Aziz, a former foreign minister who sees a policy vacuum, are not sanguine.

zh: 但问题要比缺少一个有效的领导层更严重。
en: But the problem is deeper than an absence of effective leadership.

zh: 正如巴基斯坦记者米尔·穆罕默德·阿里·塔普尔（Mir Mohammad Ali Talpur）所说 ： “ 当国家是构建在一个勉强构造的人造基础或者是宗教基础之上，正如巴基斯坦，以色列和南斯拉夫这样，它们必将转变成为由军国主义理念主导的国家 ， ” 此外 ， “ 自称是伊斯兰教荣光继承者的巴基斯坦也令自己背上了沉重的历史包袱。
en: As Pakistani journalist Mir Mohammad Ali Talpur has put it, “[W]hen states are formed on an artificial basis of contrived nationhood or on the basis of religion, as was the case with Pakistan, Israel, and Yugoslavia, they of necessity turn into…states dominated by militarist ideology.” Furthermore, “Pakistan, by claiming to be the legatee of the glory of Islam burdened itself with heavy historical baggage.”

zh: 但这个国家是否有其他路可走？
en: But could it have done otherwise?

zh: 阿里·塔普尔继续说，这个国家的精英阶层“接受了国家主义和军国主义理念 ” ， 因为那些“自我任命的伊斯兰教捍卫者”以及“甚至是伊斯兰历史上的强盗人物”都被授予了英雄的地位，也因此创造了一个“跟现实完全脱节”的战无不胜且冠冕堂皇的幻象。
en: The elite of Pakistan, Ali Talpur continues, “subscribing to a statist and militarist ideology,” became “the self-appointed defenders of Islam,” and “even the brigands of Islamic history” were accorded the status of heroes, creating an illusion of invincibility and grandeur that is “not in any way in keeping with reality.”

zh: 在这一点上，历届美国政府都只追求自身的利益，令南亚的问题变得更加复杂，也对该区域各国的自然有机成长造成了数不清的危害。
en: Here, successive US governments have compounded South Asia’s problems by pursuing only their own national interests, at an incalculable cost to the natural, organic growth of the region’s countries.

zh: 没有俄罗斯、中国、印度、巴基斯坦、阿富汗和伊朗的应和就不可能达成任何长期解决方案；而这些方案显然也无法由美国和北约单方面推动。
en: Without Russia, China, India, Pakistan, Afghanistan, and Iran acting in concert, no lasting solutions can be found; they certainly cannot be imposed unilaterally by the US and NATO.

zh: 因此一个困境逐渐浮现：在阿富汗的美国/北约部队与自然主张和区域平衡无法和谐一致。
en: Thus, a dilemma arises: the presence of US/NATO forces in Afghanistan is not in harmony with the natural urges and balance of the region.

zh: 毕竟不管有没有美国部队，阿富汗都依然会在那里，而这也是巴基斯坦（和印度）对其未来深切关注的原因。
en: After all, Afghanistan can remain only where it is, with or without US troops, which is why its future will remain an issue of great concern to Pakistan (and to India).

zh: 而这些国家又如何能将自身的国家利益和优先事务与西方大国协调一致？
en: How are these countries to harmonize their own national interests and priorities with those of the Western powers?

zh: 据退役巴基斯坦高级军官卡姆兰·沙菲（Kamran Shafi）说，巴基斯坦“即便没有彻底名誉扫地，但至少已经失去了绝大多数友邦的信任 ， ” 事实上，即便是巴基斯坦的“兄弟国家”沙特阿拉伯都将被指控策划了2008年11月孟买恐怖袭击的嫌疑人引渡到了印度。
en: According to Kamran Shafi, a retired Pakistani army officer, Pakistan “has lost the trust of most, if not all of our friends.” Indeed, even Pakistan’s “brotherly” Saudi Arabia has extradited to India the man blamed by the Indians as one of the masterminds of the horrific terror attacks on Mumbai in November 2008.

zh: 通过将推动和推广恐怖主义视为一项国家政策工具，巴基斯坦似乎根本不想重新赢得信任，而没有了信任，自1947年英属印度分裂以来失落的和平就无法归来。
en: In promoting and pursuing terrorism as an instrument of state policy, Pakistan seems intent on never regaining that trust, without which peace, unseen in South Asia since the partition of British India in 1947, is impossible.

zh: 南亚地区如今似乎正遭受着某种类似英法百年战争的诅咒。
en: South Asia now seems condemned to something akin to a 100-year war.

zh: 但与百年战争不同的是，这场斗争已经蒙上了“互相确保毁灭”的阴影。
en: But, unlike Europe’s Hundred Years’ War, this struggle is shadowed by the potential for mutually assured destruction.

zh: 考虑到印巴双方的核武器库，这场战争将非常漫长。
en: Given the potent Pakistani and Indian nuclear arsenals, the war could be very short indeed.

zh: 欧洲的分裂
en: The Disintegration of Europe

zh: 伦敦—如果说要寻找什么信号证明欧盟正在以令人警惕的速度分崩离析的话，匈牙利沿着其与同为欧盟成员国的克罗地亚的边境修建铁丝网隔离障就是这样的信号。
en: LONDON – If a clear signal was needed that the European Union is falling apart at an alarming rate, Hungary’s construction of razor-wire fences along the border with its fellow EU member Croatia is it.

zh: 当然，欧元区的危机割裂了金融流，导致不同经济体之间的两极分化，影响了对欧盟机构的政治支持，也让欧洲人民开始彼此反感。
en: The crisis in the eurozone has, of course, fragmented financial flows, caused economies to diverge, eroded political support for EU institutions, and set Europeans against one another.

zh: 如今，随着各国政府建设隔离障、重启边境控制，难民危机正在阻挡人员流动、制约贸易。
en: Now, as governments erect barriers and reinstate border controls, the refugee crisis is disrupting flows of people and gumming up trade.

zh: 而随着欧盟分裂迹象日益明显，英国全民公决离开欧盟的风险也在增加。
en: And, as the EU unravels, the risk of Britain voting to leave is rising.

zh: 人们常说，欧盟通过危机进步，因为欧盟专注于进一步一体化这一压倒一切的需求。
en: It is often argued that the EU progresses through crises, because they focus minds on the overwhelming need for further integration.

zh: 但这样的突破至少需要四个要素：对问题有正确的理解、对有效的前进道路形成一致、愿意将更多的主权集中起来，以及有能力推动变革的政治领袖。
en: But such breakthroughs require at least four ingredients: a correct shared understanding of the problem, agreement on an effective way forward, willingness to pool more sovereignty, and political leaders able to drive change forward.

zh: 如今，这四个要素都难觅踪影。
en: All four are now lacking.

zh: 欧洲领导人弱势、意见不一，似乎也没有能力勾勒出欧洲一体化所能提供的可信的美好未来前景，而没有这一前景，他们就无法赢得群众支持、说服顽固的政府承担当前成本的合理份额。
en: EU leaders are weak, divided, and seemingly incapable of setting out a credible vision of the future benefits that European integration could provide, without which they cannot rally popular support and convince recalcitrant governments to bear their fair share of current costs.

zh: 由于没有有效的共同应对方案，欧洲的危机愈演愈烈、彼此强化，并且煽动起单边主义。
en: In the absence of an effective, common response, Europe’s crises fester, feed on each other, and foment unilateralism.

zh: 欧元区和难民危机有一些共同特征，这些特征让它们变得难以克服。
en: The eurozone and refugee crises have common features that make them tricky to resolve.

zh: 两场危机都包含如何分担成本的纠纷，都因为价值冲突而变得复杂化，并且其核心都是新晋住在力量德国。
en: Both involve disputes about sharing costs, complicated by a clash of values, at the center of which lies a newly dominant Germany.

zh: 在负担分担方面，欧盟可谓不可救药。
en: The EU is hopeless at burden sharing.

zh: 欧盟各国政府未就公平的成本分配形成一致（不管是金融危机成本还是接收难民成本 ） ， 而是试图尽量减少自己的义务，把义务转嫁给他人 — — 从而增加了集体成本。
en: Rather than agree on a fair division of costs, whether of the financial crisis or of welcoming refugees, governments try to minimize their obligations and shift them onto others – thereby increasing the collective costs.

zh: 银行危机本可以通过公平果断的重组不可持续债务方案解决，现在演变为一场更大的经济和政治危机，债权人和债务人针锋相对，各国内部和各国之间都是如此。
en: A banking crisis that could have been resolved through a fair and decisive restructuring of unsustainable debts has ballooned into a much greater economic and political crisis that pits creditors against debtors, both within and among countries.

zh: 类似地，欧盟规则规定，难民应该在他们所到达的第一个欧盟成员国授予避难权，但这一规定根本无法实施，也不公平；因为寻求庇护者大多从南欧进入，但希望到达北欧，而希腊和意大利无视欧盟规则，还未难民过境提供便利。
en: Likewise, EU rules stipulating that refugees should be granted asylum in the first member country they reach have proved both unworkable and unfair; because asylum-seekers mostly arrive in southern Europe and want to head north, Greece and Italy ignore the rules and facilitate their passage.

zh: 匈牙利等中转国试图将难民转移到别处。
en: Transit countries such as Hungary try to divert refugees elsewhere.

zh: 安置近750,000今年来欧盟寻求避难的难民 — — 只占欧盟人口的0.14 % — —也因此成为一场生存危机。
en: Resettling the almost 750,000 people who have sought asylum in the EU this year – still only 0.14% of the EU population – has thus become an existential crisis.

zh: 问题的一部分在于决策过程缺乏远见。
en: Part of the problem is blinkered decision-making.

zh: 欧盟领导人狭隘地只关注限制短期金融和政治成本，而不进行关于更广大的长期后果的战略思考。
en: EU leaders focus narrowly on limiting short-term financial and political costs, rather than thinking strategically about broader longer-term consequences.

zh: 2010年重组希腊债务可能会对法国和德国银行（以及它们背后的两国政府）形成潜在金融冲击，但这一损失将比危机延续所造成的飙升的成本小得多。
en: Restructuring Greek debt in 2010 would have implied a financial hit for French and German banks (and the governments that stood behind them), but a much smaller loss than that implied by the mushrooming costs of an enduring crisis.

zh: 类似地，欢迎难民需要拿出公共资金进行初始投资，但只要新来者开始工作，就会产生红利。
en: Likewise, whereas welcoming refugees requires an initial investment of public funds, it can pay dividends as soon as the newcomers start working.

zh: 衰老的欧洲需要有活力的年轻人干本地人不愿意干（或缺少技能干）的工作、为老年人的医疗费用买单、开办企业、追求提振经济增长的新点子。
en: A graying continent needs dynamic young workers to do jobs that locals spurn (or for which they lack the skills), pay for and care for the old, start businesses, and pursue spark new ideas that boost economic growth.

zh: 价值冲突也阻碍着妥协。
en: The clash of values also impedes compromise.

zh: 德国人坚持债务国有道德义务偿还欠债、补偿他们罪恶的放荡生活。
en: Germans insist that debtors have a moral obligation to pay what they owe and atone for their sinful profligacy.

zh: 斯洛伐克总理拒绝难民的理由是“斯洛伐克是为斯洛伐克人而建，不是为少数群体而建 ， ” 这一理由难以服众。
en: A Slovak prime minister who rejects refugees on the grounds that “Slovakia is built for Slovaks, not for minorities” is hard to buy off.

zh: 即使欧盟安置难民的计划让不受欢迎的难民离开匈牙利，该国民族主义极权领导人奥班原则上仍然反对，并指责德国试图将其对难民的慷慨态度强加给邻国是“道德帝国主义 ” 。
en: Even though the EU’s plan to resettle refugees would remove unwanted newcomers from Hungary, Viktor Orbán, the country’s authoritarian and nationalist leader, objects to it in principle, accusing Germany of “moral imperialism” in trying to foist its generous attitude toward refugees on its neighbors.

zh: 直到最近，德国决策者都在试图通过寻求更加欧洲的德国和在资金上支持欧盟来为纳粹历史赎罪，这帮助平息了诸多纠纷。
en: Until recently, German policymakers sought to atone for the country’s Nazi past by seeking a more European Germany and bankrolling the EU, thus helping to smooth over many disputes.

zh: 但是，德国作为首席债权人的地位让其取得了领头羊的位置，如今，德国总理默克尔政府正在寻求建立一个更加德国的欧洲。
en: But, with Germany’s position as creditor-in-chief having thrust it into the driver’s seat, Chancellor Angela Merkel’s administration now seeks to create a more Germanic Europe.

zh: 德国拒绝承认其以邻为壑的经济政策 — — 反映在其巨大的经常项目盈余中 — — 既是欧元区危机的原因，也是阻止解决欧元区危机的主要因素。
en: Germany refuses to accept that its beggar-thy-neighbor economic policies – reflected in its massive current-account surpluses – are both a cause of the eurozone crisis and a major impediment to resolving it.

zh: 相反，德国威胁其他国家为其马首是瞻，错误地将它作为债权人的狭隘利益当作作为一个整体的系统的利益。
en: Instead, it bullies others to get its way, wrongly identifying its narrow interests as a creditor with those of the system as a whole.

zh: 默克尔在难民危机中起到的作用要积极得多。
en: Merkel has played a much more positive role in the refugee crisis.

zh: 德国单方面中止了欧盟庇护申请规则，承诺接受所有到达德国的叙利亚难民。
en: Germany unilaterally suspended application of the EU’s asylum rules and pledged to accept all arriving Syrian refugees.

zh: 但默克尔没有给这些难民提供安全通道加剧了混乱。
en: But Merkel’s failure to offer those refugees safe passage has exacerbated the chaos.

zh: 随后在理应边境开放的申根地区重启边境控制树立了一个可怕的先例，德国的邻国可能会纷纷效仿。
en: Subsequently reimposing border controls within the supposedly border-free Schengen Area set a terrible precedent, prompting Germany’s neighbors to do likewise.

zh: 与此同时，随着欧盟被日益视为经济危机、政治动荡和有害移民的来源，英国人将在2017年底前进行的全民公决中离开欧盟的可能性也在增加。
en: Meanwhile, with the EU increasingly viewed as a source of economic crisis, political turmoil, and unwanted migrants, the risk that Britons will vote to leave in a referendum due before the end of 2017 is rising.

zh: 英国和欧盟已经处于半脱离状态 — — 它身处申根协议之外，没有参加欧元区，许多内政事务（包括避难政策）也和欧盟不同。
en: Britain is already semi-detached – outside of Schengen and with opt-outs from the euro and many home-affairs matters (including asylum policy).

zh: 如今，英国政府正在寻求谈判更宽松的成员资格条件，最后即使留在欧元区，与欧盟的关系也将若即若离。
en: With the government now seeking to negotiate even looser membership terms, Britain will end up more estranged from the EU even if it remains a member.

zh: 民意呈现出均势，很难预测全民公决的结果。
en: Polls are finely balanced and referendums unpredictable.

zh: 在反现状情绪高涨和政治剧变时期，反欧盟阵营可以兜售三种后欧盟未来的梦幻情景：自由市场、没有外国人、社会主义乌托邦。
en: At a time of anti-establishment rage and political upheaval, anti-EU campaigners can peddle three fantasies of a post-EU future: a free-market, foreigner-free, or socialist Utopia.

zh: 相反，亲欧盟阵营只能立足于欧盟的现状 — — 看起来毫无生气。
en: The pro-EU camp, by contrast, has to sell the reality of the EU as it is, warts and all.

zh: 直到最近，欧盟一体化看上去都是不可阻挡的。
en: Until recently, EU integration seemed inevitable.

zh: 这一过程可能停滞，但绝不会逆转。
en: It might stall, but it would never go into reverse.

zh: 越来越多的国家加入欧盟；从未有过家退出。
en: Countries joined; none left.

zh: 但欧盟裂痕已现英国退出可能让一体化的趋势逆转。
en: But with the EU already crumbling, Brexit could turn that dynamic on its head.

zh: 这也是必须趁早解决欧盟问题的原因。
en: That is all the more reason to fix the EU before it is too late.

zh: 自我实现的金融危机
en: Self-Fulfilling Financial Crises

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 根据2005年的预测，2008年金融危机和随后的经济衰退将导致全球发达国家的经济发展水平要比无危机的情况低10 % 。
en: BERKELEY – The 2008 financial crisis and subsequent recession left the Global North 10% poorer than it otherwise would have been, based on 2005 forecasts.

zh: 对于那些希望更深入地了解这一事件的人，我经常会推荐他们去阅读这四本书：二十世纪经济学家查尔斯·P·金德尔伯格（Charles P. Kindleberger）的《狂热，恐慌，和崩溃 》 。 哈佛大学的卡门·M·莱因哈特（Carmen M. Reinhart）与肯尼斯·S·罗格夫（Kenneth S. Rogoff）合著的《这次不一样 》 ； 英国《金融时报》经济评论员马丁·沃尔夫的《转型与冲击 》 ； 还有我的加州大学伯克利分校同事巴里·艾申格林（Barry Eichengreen）撰写的《镜厅 》 。
en: For those hoping to understand this episode better, I have long recommended four books, in particular: Manias, Panics, and Crashes, by the twentieth-century economist Charles P. Kindleberger; This Time Is Different, by Carmen M. Reinhart and Kenneth S. Rogoff of Harvard University; The Shifts and the Shocks, by the Financial Times economics commentator Martin Wolf; and Hall of Mirrors, by my University of California, Berkeley, colleague Barry Eichengreen.

zh: 现在，我想在上述书单中添加第五本书：经济学家尼古拉·金奈伊奥利（Nicola Gennaioli）和安德烈·施莱夫（Andrei Shleifer）合著的《信念危机：投资者心理与金融脆弱性 》 （ 利益披露：施莱夫是我大学本科和研究生时期的室友；如果说如今的我都有些什么好的技能或声誉，那多半是拜他所赐 ） 。
en: Now, I want to add a fifth book to the list: A Crisis of Beliefs: Investor Psychology and Financial Fragility, by the economists Nicola Gennaioli and Andrei Shleifer. (Full disclosure: Shleifer was my roommate in college and graduate school; to this day, I credit him with whatever positive skills or reputation I may have.)

zh: 而《信念危机》之所以如此重要，原因有三：首先，它对那些认定过去十年是美国房地产泡沫必然后果的人做出了令人欣然接受的反驳。
en: A Crisis of Beliefs is important for three reasons. First, it offers a welcome rejoinder to those who argue that the past decade was an unavoidable result of the housing bubble in the United States.

zh: 许多专家仍然声称是泡沫的萎缩触发了金融危机。
en: Many experts still claim that the bubble’s deflation triggered the financial crisis.

zh: 但实际上在危机爆发之前泡沫已经大幅缩小了。
en: But the fact is that the bubble had already deflated substantially before the crisis erupted.

zh: 回想一下，房价在2008年中期就已经回落到（甚至低于）其基本面所能支撑的水平，住宅建筑行业的就业和生产已经下降到远低于趋势的水平。
en: Recall that by mid-2008, home prices had returned to, or even fallen below, levels supported by their underlying fundamentals, and employment and production in the residential construction industry had declined to levels far below trend.

zh: 对资产价值进行重新平衡以及在各部门之间重新分配经济资源的工作也已经完成。
en: The work of rebalancing asset valuations and reallocating economic resources across sectors had already been accomplished.

zh: 可以肯定的是，次级抵押贷和房屋抵押贷的违约仍然造成约7500亿美元的金融资产损失。
en: To be sure, there still would have been around $750 billion worth of financial-asset losses in the form of defaults on subprime mortgages and home-equity loans.

zh: 但这仅仅相当于1987年10月19日全球股市在7小时内所损失市值的1/4。
en: But that is only one-quarter of what global equity markets lost in seven hours on October 19, 1987.

zh: 换句话说，它不足以让全球金融体系陷入困境。
en: In other words, it would not have been enough to sink the global financial system.

zh: 时任美联储主席的本•伯南克（Ben Bernanke）在2008年夏天似乎认定房价调整不会引发任何无法控制的金融危机，因此当时他的关注点都放在了通胀上升的危险上。
en: Ben Bernanke, then Chair of the US Federal Reserve, seemed confident in the summer of 2008 that the correction in housing prices had not triggered any unmanageable financial crisis. At the time, he was mainly focused on the dangers of rising inflation.

zh: 但随后形势却急转直下。
en: And then the bottom fell out.

zh: 金奈伊奥利和施莱夫发现原因在于信念发生了变化。
en: The reason, Gennaioli and Shleifer show, is that beliefs changed.

zh: 投资者开始相信在诸多因素的作用下金融市场已经背负着极高风险。
en: Investors came to believe that financial markets were saddled with highly elevated risk, owing to a number of factors.

zh: 银行间市场陷入困境，房主无力偿还抵押贷款，贝尔斯登投行（Bear Stearns）倒闭，美国财政部出手严管房地美（Freddie Mac）和房利美（Fannie Mae ） ， 而最重要的是雷曼兄弟投行（Lehman Brothers）宣布破产。
en: The interbank market had seized up, homeowners were defaulting on their mortgages, Bear Stearns had collapsed, the US Treasury had intervened to rein in Freddie Mac and Fannie Mae, and, above all, Lehman Brothers had declared bankruptcy.

zh: 由于投资者纷纷抛售资产，导致影子和非影子银行体系都出现了挤提。
en: All of this led to the sudden run on both the shadow and non-shadow banking systems, as investors scrambled to dump assets.

zh: 而它们注入系统的大量风险也成为了现实。
en: The increased risk that they had imputed to the system became a reality.

zh: 像急诊室的分诊护士一样，它们立刻对患者进行了评估然后进行初步诊断，好像根本没有其他选择那样。
en: Like triage nurses in an emergency room, they quickly assessed the patient and then ran with their initial diagnosis as if there were no other option.

zh: 但其实危机的任何一个后果都并非不可避免。
en: And yet nothing about the fallout from the crisis was inevitable.

zh: 如果美联储手里能有一套将那些太大而不能倒的机构纳入破产接收管理并将自身化身为最后风险承担者的应急计划，我们今天可能会生活在一个非常不同的世界。
en: Had the Fed been in possession of contingency plans for putting too-big-to-fail institutions into receivership and becoming the risk-bearer of last resort, we would probably be living in a very different world today.

zh: 与那些回顾过往并得出结论认为这是房地产泡沫必然后果的人不同，金奈伊奥利和施莱夫认识到了应急措施在危机及其后果中发挥的核心作用。
en: Unlike those who look back and conclude that it was all an inevitable consequence of the housing bubble, Gennaioli and Shleifer recognize the central role that contingency played in the crisis and its aftermath.

zh: 金奈伊奥利和施莱夫的第二个重要贡献是表明类似导致了2008~2009年大灾难的“信仰危机”其实深深扎根于人类心理，以至于我们永远无法摆脱它们。
en: Gennaioli and Shleifer’s second important contribution is to show that “crises of beliefs” like the one that precipitated the disaster of 2008-2009 are deeply rooted in human psychology, so much so that we will never be free of them.

zh: 因此审慎政策和危机应对措施都不应将这些事件视为偶然或只会发生一次的例外。
en: Thus, neither prudential policies nor crisis-response measures should treat these occurrences as flukes or one-off exceptions.

zh: 信仰危机一个是必须妥善管理的长期性状况的表征。
en: Crises of belief are manifestations of a chronic condition that must be managed.

zh: 因此，中央银行和财政当局不应以危机已经结束为借口去退缩或放松管理。
en: Thus, central banks and fiscal authorities should not use the end of a crisis as an excuse to step back or to take their hands off the wheel.

zh: 当基本信念出现长期性转变时，人们不应该期望在危机之前支持充分就业，低通胀和均衡增长的相同政策组合在危机之后还能延续下去。
en: When fundamental beliefs have shifted permanently, one should not expect the same policy mix that supported full employment, low inflation, and balanced growth before the crisis to do so afterwards.

zh: 此外下一轮金德尔伯格序列的种子 — — 失业，乐观，狂热，崩溃，恐慌，反感，抹黑 — — 已经被解决上一次经济衰退所需的政策所种下了。
en: Moreover, the seeds of the next Kindlebergian sequence – displacement, optimism, enthusiasm, crash, panic, revulsion, discrediting – have already been sown by the very policies that were needed to address the last downturn.

zh: 金奈伊奥利和施莱夫的书之所重要的第三个原因是其更具技术性且直接适用于经济学领域。
en: The third reason why Gennaioli and Shleifer’s book is important is more technical, and applies directly to the field of economics.

zh: 经济学家早就认识到，要求一个人的代表性个体（representative agent）一直对未来保持理性期望往往会产生一些极不适用于现实世界的模型。
en: Economists have long recognized that requiring one’s representative agent to hold rational expectations of the future tends to produce models that are profoundly inapplicable to the real world.

zh: 但迄今为止还未出现任何有影响力的替代手段。
en: But, until now, no alternative approach has ever gained any traction.

zh: 而金奈伊奥利和施莱夫的分诊护士型投资者分析框架很可能跻身于各大候选模型构建策略的行列。
en: Gennaioli and Shleifer’s investors-as-triage-nurses framework shows great promise for being considered alongside other model-building strategies.

zh: 十年以来人们一直在为2008~2018年的灾难寻找一线希望，希望这一时期能够将金融，行为经济学和宏观经济学更富有成效地整合在一起。
en: For a decade now, people have been looking for a silver lining to the disasters of 2008-2018, hoping that this period will bring about a more productive integration of finance, behavioral economics, and macroeconomic orthodoxy.

zh: 而到目前为止这些寻觅一直只是徒劳。
en: So far, they have been searching in vain.

zh: 但随着《信念危机》的出版，希望也再度降临。
en: But with the publication of A Crisis of Beliefs, there is hope yet.

zh: 曾经有一份更好的救助计划摆在我们面前 … …
en: A Better Bailout Was Possible

zh: 发自纽约 — — 约瑟夫·斯蒂格里茨（Joseph Stiglitz）和拉里·萨默斯（Larry Summers）最近就“长期停滞”及其与2008~2009年金融危机后温和经济复苏的关系进行的交锋相当重要。
