en: NEW YORK – The recent exchange between Joe Stiglitz and Larry Summers about “secular stagnation” and its relation to the tepid economic recovery after the 2008-2009 financial crisis is an important one.

zh: 马克·吐温曾说历史不会重演，但总是惊人地相似。
en: History does not repeat itself, but it rhymes, Mark Twain reportedly once said.

zh: 但照我们最近的经济史看来，套用鲍勃·迪伦（Bob Dylan）的一句名言，历史并不相似，只会不断发出诅咒。
en: But, to paraphrase Bob Dylan, in light of our recent economic history, history doesn’t rhyme, it swears.

zh: 斯蒂格里茨和萨默斯似乎同意政策不足以应对那些被危机所揭露和加剧的结构性挑战。
en: Stiglitz and Summers appear to agree that policy was inadequate to address the structural challenges that the crisis revealed and intensified.

zh: 他们的辩论涉及财政刺激的规模，金融监管的作用以及收入分配的重要性。
en: Their debate addresses the size of the fiscal stimulus, the role of financial regulation, and the importance of income distribution.

zh: 但此外还有其他问题需要进行深入探讨。
en: But additional issues need to be explored in depth.

zh: 我们认为，应对危机时调整负担的天平过度倾向于债权人而非债务人的做法实际上是错过了一个关键的机会，进而导致了危机后的长期停滞。
en: We believe a critical opportunity was missed when the balance of the burden of adjustment was tilted heavily in favor of creditors relative to debtors in the response to the crisis and that this contributed to the prolonged stagnation that followed the crisis.

zh: 而错失此次良机的长期社会和政治后果将是影响极其深远的。
en: The long-term social and political ramifications of this missed opportunity have been profound.

zh: 回到2008年9月，当时的美国财政部长汉克·保尔森（Hank Paulson）引入了总额为7000亿美元的问题资产救助计划，他建议使用这些资金来救助银行，但不会要求获得这些银行的任何股权。
en: Back in September 2008, when then-US Secretary of the Treasury Hank Paulson introduced the $700 billion Troubled Asset Relief Program (TARP), he proposed using the funds to bail out the banks, but without acquiring any equity ownership in them.

zh: 当时，我们以及我们的同事罗伯特·杜格（Robert Dugger）都认为，更有效和公平使用纳税人金钱的做法应该是降低普通美国人持有的抵押贷款价值以响应房价下跌并向那些资金紧缺的金融机构注入资金。
en: At that time, we and our colleague Robert Dugger argued that a much more effective and fair use of taxpayers’ money would be to reduce the value of mortgages held by ordinary Americans to reflect the decline in home prices and to inject capital into the financial institutions that would become undercapitalized.

zh: 由于这些股权可以支撑相当于其规模20倍的资产负债表，7000亿美元或许能在恢复一个健康金融体系方面起到更大作用。
en: Because equity could support a balance sheet that would have been 20 times larger, $700 billion could have gone a long way toward restoring a healthy financial system.

zh: 然而动用资金向银行购买股权的能力并不包含在提交给美国众议院的法案之内。
en: The ability to use funds to inject equity into the banks was not part of the bill presented to the US House of Representatives.

zh: 因此，我们安排时任众议员的吉姆·莫兰（Jim Moran）在一场预先安排好的质询中向众议院金融服务委员会主席巴尼·弗兰克（Barney Frank）询问允许财政部以股权注入的形式使用纳税人金钱的做法是否符合问题资产救助计划的立法精神。
en: So we organized for Representative Jim Moran to ask House Financial Services Chairman Barney Frank in a pre-arranged question whether it was in the spirit of the TARP legislation to allow the Treasury to use taxpayers’ money in the form of equity injections.

zh: 弗兰克当场予以了肯定。
en: Frank replied in the affirmative on the House floor.

zh: 这实际上是保尔森在小布什政府执政末期所使用的工具。
en: This was in fact a tool that Paulson used in the closing days of George W. Bush’s administration.

zh: 但保尔森的用法是错误的：他把各大银行的负责人召集起来并强迫他们收下他所分配的金额。
en: But Paulson did it the wrong way: he summoned the heads of major banks and forced them to take the money he allocated to them.

zh: 但他的做法使银行蒙受了耻辱。
en: But by doing so he stigmatized the banks.

zh: 几个月后奥巴马上台，我们其中一人（索罗斯）一再呼吁萨默斯采取向那些脆弱金融机构注入股权的政策，并将抵押贷款按照现实市场价值进行减记以协助经济复苏。
en: A few months later, when President Barack Obama’s administration arrived, one of us (Soros) repeatedly appealed to Summers to adopt a policy of equity injection into fragile financial institutions and to write down mortgages to a realistic market value in order to help the economy recover.

zh: 萨默斯反驳说这在政治上是不可接受的，因为这意味着将银行国有化。
en: Summers objected that this would be politically unacceptable because it would mean nationalizing banks.

zh: 他断言这样的政策充斥着社会主义理念，但美国不是一个社会主义国家。
en: Such a policy reeked of socialism and America is not a socialist country, he asserted.

zh: 我们觉得他的论点无法令人信服 — — 无论是当时还是现在。
en: We found his argument unconvincing – both then and now.

zh: 然而为了帮金融机构减轻身上的过高估值资产负担，布什和奥巴马政府早已选择将那些负面资产社会化。
en: By relieving financial institutions of their overvalued assets, the Bush and Obama administrations had already chosen to socialize the downside.

zh: 只有那些在复苏状况下有可能获得股票收益的优质资产仍在发行！
en: Only the upside of sharing in the possible stock gains in the event of a recovery was still at issue!

zh: 如果我们的政策建议被采纳，股东和债务持有者（储蓄倾向较高）的损失将比他们当年所承受的更大，而低收入和中等收入家庭（消费倾向较高）的抵押债务负担将有所缓解。
en: Had our policy recommendation been adopted, stockholders and debt holders (who have a higher propensity to save) would have experienced greater losses than they did, whereas lower- and middle-income households (which have a higher propensity to consume) would have experienced relief from their mortgage debt.

zh: 这种调整负担的转变将惩罚那些造成灾难的人，刺激总需求，并减少令绝大多数民众怨声载道的不平等增加状况。
en: This shift in the burden of adjustment would have imposed losses on the people who were responsible for the calamity, stimulated aggregate demand, and diminished the rising inequality that was demoralizing the vast majority of people.

zh: 我们的建议也确实存在问题：向负债累累的抵押贷款持有人提供救济会遭到许多无抵押贷款房主的抵制。
en: We did recognize a problem with our proposal: providing relief to over-indebted mortgage holders would have encountered resistance from the many homeowners who had not taken out a mortgage.

zh: 我们尝试探索克服这个问题的方法，但最终白忙活了一场：奥巴马政府拒绝接受我们的建议。
en: We were exploring ways to overcome this problem until it became moot: the Obama administration refused to accept our advice.

zh: 这样一来，小布什和奥巴马政府的做法与英国政府采取的政策以及美国早期成功金融救助的例子形成了鲜明对比。
en: The approach of the Bush and Obama administrations stands in stark contrast both to the policy followed by the British government, and to earlier examples of successful financial bailouts in the United States.

zh: 在时任首相戈登·布朗（Gordon Brown）领导下的英国，资本不足的银行被告知要去筹集更多资金。
en: In Great Britain, led by then-Prime Minister Gordon Brown, undercapitalized banks were told to raise additional capital.

zh: 它们可以自己去市场筹钱，但政府警告说如果它们筹不到钱英国财政部就会向他们注入资金。
en: They were given the opportunity to go to the market themselves, but they were warned that the UK Treasury would inject funds into them if they failed to do so.

zh: 苏格兰皇家银行和劳埃德银行都请求了政府支持。
en: The Royal Bank of Scotland and Lloyds TSB did require government support.

zh: 股权注入伴随着对高管薪酬和股息分红的限制。
en: The equity injections were accompanied by restrictions on executive pay and dividends.

zh: 与保尔森的注资方式相反，银行如果可以从市场借到款就不会受到侮辱。
en: In contrast to Paulson’s method of injecting funds, banks were not stigmatized if they could borrow from the markets.

zh: 同样，在1930年代的大萧条时期，美国通过借助重建金融公司（Reconstruction Finance Corporation）来获取银行所有权并进行资本重组，并通过房屋所有者贷款公司（Home Owners’ Loan Corporation）来管理抵押贷款重组。
en: Similarly, during the Great Depression of the 1930s, the US took ownership and recapitalized banks via the Reconstruction Finance Corporation (RFC) and managed mortgage restructuring through the Home Owners’ Loan Corporation (HOLC).

zh: 毫无疑问，奥巴马政府向公众做出保证并淡化问题严重程度的做法有助于缓解危机，但这要付出沉重的政治代价。
en: No doubt the Obama administration helped to alleviate the crisis by reassuring the public and downplaying the depth of the problems, but there was a heavy political price to pay.

zh: 政府的政策未能解决潜藏的问题，而保护银行而非抵押贷款持有者的举措进一步加剧了美国富人和穷人之间的差距。
en: The administration’s policies failed to deal with the underlying problems, and by protecting the banks rather than mortgage holders, they exacerbated the gap between America’s haves and have-nots.

zh: 而选民就此对奥巴马政府和民主党国会的抨击也没有落空。
en: The electorate blamed the Obama administration and the Democratic Congress for the results.

zh: 茶党于2009年初成立，得到了亿万富翁科赫兄弟（Charles & David Koch）的大规模资金支持。
en: The Tea Party was formed in early 2009 with large-scale financial support from the billionaire Koch brothers, Charles and David.

zh: 2010年1月，就在华尔街又一次大发奖金之后，马萨诸塞州针对已故参议员泰德·肯尼迪（Ted Kennedy）的参议院席位举行了一次特别选举，共和党人斯科特·布朗（Scott Brown）夺得该席位。
en: In January 2010, Massachusetts held a special election for the late Ted Kennedy’s Senate seat, just after Wall Street paid extravagant bonuses, and elected the Republican Scott Brown.

zh: 共和党随后在2010年中期选举中控制了众议院，在2014年获得了参议院控制权，随后提名了2016年当选的特朗普。
en: The Republicans subsequently took control of the House of Representatives in the 2010 midterm elections, gained control of the Senate in 2014, and nominated Donald Trump, who was elected in 2016.

zh: 民主党必须承认并纠正过去的错误。
en: It is essential that the Democratic party recognize and correct its past mistakes.

zh: 2018年中期选举将为2020年总统大选奠定基础，这是一个很好的机会。
en: The 2018 midterm elections, which will set the stage for the 2020 presidential election, is an excellent opportunity to do so.

zh: 与十年前相比，今天国家面临着更为深层次的政治和经济问题，公众也知道这一点。
en: The political and economic problems that confront the country are much deeper today than they were ten years ago, and the public knows it.

zh: 民主党人必须认识而不是淡化这些问题。
en: The Democrats must recognize these problems, not downplay them.

zh: 今年的中期选举将是一场对特朗普的全民公决，但2020年的民主党总统候选人必须拿出一个足够鼓舞人心的计划。
en: This year’s midterm elections will be a plebiscite on Trump, but the Democratic presidential candidate in 2020 must have a program that many Americans find inspiring.

zh: 选民已经看到共和党人的蛊惑人心的民粹主义究竟会将国家带往何处，而大多数人应该在2018年起身反对它。
en: The electorate has seen where the Republicans’ demagogic populism leads, and a majority should reject it in 2018.

zh: 基因工程的圣杯
en: The Holy Grail of Genetic Engineering

zh: 香港—自从四十年前诞生以来，基因工程便被卫生、农业和工业界寄予厚望。
en: HONG KONG – Since its introduction four decades ago, genetic engineering has been a source of high hopes for health, agriculture, and industry.

zh: 但由于基因编辑过程的复杂性，它也引起了深刻的忧虑。
en: But it has also provoked deep anxiety, not least owing to the laborious nature of the genome-editing process.

zh: 如今，一种新技术 — — CRISPR-Cas既具备了精确性，又能够同时修改多处基因组文本。
en: Now, a new technique, CRISPR-Cas, offers both precision and the ability to modify the genome text at several places simultaneously.

zh: 但担忧的原因并未就此消除。
en: But this has not eliminated reason for concern.

zh: 基因组可以视为一种乐谱。
en: The genome can be viewed as a kind of musical score.

zh: 正如活页乐谱让乐队的乐师们知道何时演奏，基因组让细胞各组成部分（主要是蛋白质）知道应该干什么。
en: Just as sheet music tells musicians in an orchestra when and how to play, the genome tells the cell’s component parts (generally proteins) what they must do.

zh: 乐谱还应该包括作曲家的注释，说明可能的变奏，可以根据具体情况添加或省略的音符。
en: A score may also include notes from the composer, showing possible changes, frills that can be added or omitted depending on the circumstances.

zh: 对基因组来说，这些“注释”来自多代细胞从不断变化的环境中的生存过程。
en: For the genome, such “notes” emerge from cell survival over many generations in an ever-changing environment.

zh: DNA基因计划就像是一本被活页的书：页码顺序可以改变，一些页面甚至可以移植入其他细胞的程序。
en: The DNA genetic program is akin to a fragile book: the order of its pages can change, with some even being moved to another cell’s program.

zh: 比如，将一个页面叠起来，就能降低移动的过程中受到损坏的可能性。
en: If a page is, say, laminated, it is less likely to be damaged as it is moved around.

zh: 类似地，基因程序中的要素，如果有坚固的外衣保护，就能更好地侵入不同的细胞，然后随着细胞的复制而得到复制。
en: Likewise, elements of a genetic program protected by a solid coating are better able to invade a variety of cells, and then to reproduce as the cell reproduces.

zh: 最终，这一要素变成一种病毒并迅速传播。
en: Ultimately, that element becomes a virus, spreading rapidly.

zh: 下一步，复制了无用或者有害病毒的细胞要发展出抵抗它的办法。
en: The next step is for the cell that reproduces a virus, whether useless or harmful, to develop some way to resist it.

zh: 事实上，CRISPR-Cas过程第一次出现就是以这种方式 — — 作为细菌对入侵病毒的抵抗。
en: And, in fact, it was in this manner – as a bacteria’s defense against invading viruses – that the CRISPR-Cas process first emerged.

zh: 这一过程让获得的特征能够得到遗传。
en: That process allows acquired characteristics to become inherited.

zh: 在首次感染过程中，病毒基因组的一个小碎片 — — 一种签名 — — 被复制进入CRISPR基因组岛（一片亲代基因组文本之外的额外的基因组 ） 。
en: In the course of a first infection, a small fragment of the viral genome – a kind of signature – is copied into the CRISPR genomic island (an extra piece of genome, outside of the parent genome text).

zh: 结果，感染的记忆在代际间得到了保留。
en: As a result, the memory of the infection is retained across generations.

zh: 当一个后代细胞被病毒感染时，这一序列会拿来与病毒基因组比较。
en: When a descendant of the cell is infected with a virus, the sequence will be compared to the viral genome.

zh: 如果相似的病毒已经感染过细胞的亲代，则后代就能识别它，特别机制就会摧毁它。
en: If a similar virus has infected a cell’s parent, the descendant will recognize it, and ad hoc machinery will destroy it.

zh: 这一复杂的过程耗费了科学家好几十年去破译，因为这否定了标准的进化论。
en: This complex process took many decades for scientists to decipher, not least because it controverted standard theories of evolution.

zh: 但如今，科学家已经弄清楚了如何去复制这一过程，让人类能够最精确地编辑具体的基因组 — — 这便是近50年来的基因工程圣杯。
en: But now scientists have figured out how to replicate the process, enabling humans to edit, with the utmost precision, specific genomes – the Holy Grail of genetic engineering for nearly 50 years.

zh: 这意味着科学家可以运用CRISPR-Cas机制来纠正基因组中的问题 — — 相当于文本中的拼写错误。
en: This means that scientists can apply the CRISPR-Cas mechanism to correct problems in the genome – the equivalent of typos in a written text.

zh: 比如，以癌症为例，我们想摧毁那些让肿瘤细胞激增的基因。
en: For example, in the case of cancer, we would want to destroy those genes that allow the multiplication of tumor cells.

zh: 我们还想向细胞中引入它们永远无法通过自然基因传输获得的基因。
en: We are also interested in introducing genes in cells that never gained them by natural genetic transfer.

zh: 这些目标都早已有之。
en: There is nothing new about these objectives.

zh: 但是，有了CRISPR-Cas，我们就获得了实现这些目标的“大杀器 ” 。
en: But, with CRISPR-Cas, we are far better equipped to achieve them.

zh: 此前的技术会在被改写的基因组中留下痕迹，导致（比如）抗生素耐药性。
en: Previous techniques left traces in the modified genomes, contributing, for example, to antibiotic resistance.

zh: 反之，通过CRISPR-Cas获得的变异，无法与自然发生的变异相区分。
en: A mutation obtained by CRISPR-Cas, by contrast, is not distinguishable from a mutation that emerged spontaneously.

zh: 因此，美国食品和药品监督局判定这类构造无需标注为转基因生物体。
en: That is why the US Food and Drug Administration has ruled that such constructs do not need to be labeled as genetically modified organisms.

zh: 如果要修改多个基因的话，此前的技术将极其费力，因为这一过程需要按照顺序进行。
en: Previous techniques were especially arduous if one needed to modify several genes, because the process would need to occur sequentially.

zh: 在CRISPR-Cas的帮助下，同时进行基因组修改的能力已经能够创造出与空气接触后也不会氧化或便褐色的真菌和苹果 — — 这一结果要求同时给多个基因去活。
en: With CRISPR-Cas, the ability to perform genome modifications simultaneously has already enabled the creation of fungi and apples that do not oxidize, or turn brown, when they come into contact with air – a result that required several genes to be deactivated simultaneously.

zh: 这类苹果已经上市，并不被认为是转基因产品。
en: Such apples are already on the market, and are not considered genetically modified organisms.

zh: 其他运用正在开发中。
en: Other applications are in development.

zh: 所谓的操纵基因组的基因驱动程序能够减少携病昆虫所造成的伤害。
en: The so-called gene drive procedure for manipulating the genome could diminish the harm caused by disease-carrying insects.

zh: 定向编辑蚊子配子 — — 蚊子是全世界致人死亡数量最多的动物 — — 能够让它们无法传播病毒或寄生虫。
en: Targeted modification of gametes in mosquitoes – the world’s deadliest animal to humans – would render them incapable of transmitting a virus or parasite.

zh: 但应用CRISPR-Cas必须谨慎。
en: But the application of CRISPR-Cas must be approached with care.

zh: 该技术可以成为消灭许多致命疾病的福音，也可能隐含严重的 — — 并且可能是完全不可预料的 — — 风险。
en: While the technology could prove a boon in the fight against many deadly diseases, it also implies serious – and potentially entirely unpredictable – risks.

zh: 首先，由于基因组通过复制大量增长和传播，修改全部基因组只需要修改有限数量的个体，特别是对于生命周期较短的生命体而言。
en: For starters, because genomes multiply and spread with reproduction, modifying an entire population would require modifications to only a limited number of individuals, especially if the organism’s lifecycle is short.

zh: 此外，由于相近物种间的杂交是普遍现象，有可能对一种蚊子的修改会逐步地、不可控地扩大到其他物种。
en: Moreover, given the ubiquity of hybridization among neighboring species, it is possible that the modification of a mosquito species would also spread progressively and uncontrollably to other species.

zh: 动物基因组分析表明，这类事件在过去曾经发生过，物种被能影响生态系统平衡和物种进化（尽管不可能知道如何实现）的基因要素入侵。
en: Analysis of animal genomes shows that such events have taken place in the past, with species invaded by genetic elements that could have affected ecosystem balances and species evolution (though it is impossible to say how).

zh: 此外，如果修改蚊子种群是危险的话，在不进行尽职调查就贸然修改人类细胞 — — 特别是生殖细胞 — — 会发生什么也很难说。
en: And, if modifying a mosquito population is dangerous, there is no telling what could happen if we modify human cells – in particular, germ cells – without doing our due diligence.

zh: CRISPR-Cas技术即将改变世界。
en: CRISPR-Cas technology is poised to change the world.

zh: 现在的重点是确保这些变化是积极的。
en: The imperative now is to ensure that those changes are positive.

zh: 负责任的基因治疗策略
en: Strategies for Responsible Gene Editing

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 发现可以治愈疟疾、莱姆病等多种健康和环境问题的有效新工具确实值得庆贺。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The discovery of a powerful new tool capable of addressing health and environmental problems as diverse as malaria, Lyme disease, and invasive species should be a cause for celebration.

zh: 但因为这种称之为CRISPR的工具能改变整个野生生物种群（并进而改变共同的生态系统 ） ， 确保上述工具的研发必须本着负责任的态度也为科学和社会带来了前所未有的挑战。
en: But, because the tool, called CRISPR, can alter entire populations of wild organisms (and thus shared ecosystems), ensuring that these interventions are developed responsibly poses an unprecedented challenge for science and society.

zh: 人类通过选择性育种改变动植物的历史已经延续了数千年之久；但因为这些改变往往会降低野外生存和繁殖能力，因此不会影响到野生种群。
en: Humans have been altering animals and plants through selective breeding for millennia; but, because these changes typically reduce the capacity for survival and reproduction in the wild, they do not spread to wild populations.

zh: 但CRISPR疗法带来的改变可以让科学家以前所未有的准确度修改DNA，并因此导致了至关重要的不同：上述过程可能会导致“基因驱动 ” ， 具体来讲就是即便不具备提高生存（以及繁殖）能力的效果，但同样可以实现在种群内部代际传递某些基因自然产生的功能。
en: Alterations accomplished using CRISPR, which enables scientists to edit a cell’s DNA with unprecedented precision, are different in one crucial respect: The process can result in “gene drive,” a naturally occurring feature of some genes that enables them to spread through a population over generations, even if they do not help survival (and thus reproduction).

zh: 简言之，我们现在可以考虑以非常具体和重要的方式改变野生种群。
en: Simply put, we can now contemplate altering wild populations in very specific and consequential ways.

zh: 上述改变可能会产生显著的积极作用。
en: Those changes can be highly positive.

zh: 通过改变蚊虫的某些特点，我们可以减少甚至彻底消除疟疾和登革热等古已有之的灾难，这类疾病每年都在困扰数百万人。
en: By altering certain features of mosquitos, we could reduce or even eradicate ancient scourges such as malaria and dengue that afflict hundreds of millions of people each year.

zh: （仅疟疾一种病平均每90秒就导致一名儿童丧生。
en: (Malaria alone kills a child every 90 seconds, on average.)

zh: ）通过对相关动物种群展开永久性免疫，我们可以预防起源于野生动物的莱姆病及其他疾病新发病例，或者防止寨卡病毒等新型病原体的产生，现代医学已经证实导致拉美新生儿大脑发育迟缓的一种传染病其实是由这种病毒造成的。
en: By permanently immunizing the relevant animal populations, we could prevent new cases of Lyme and other diseases that originate in wild organisms, or we could block newly emergent pathogens such as the Zika virus, which has been linked to an epidemic of stunted brain development in newborns in Latin America.

zh: 具体到环境方面，人类活动已经对地球所有生态系统造成了意义深远的影响 — — 对人类自身和其他物种的诸多影响尚处在逐渐明朗的过程当中。
en: As for the environment, human activities have already impacted every ecosystem on Earth, with far-reaching consequences – for us and many other species – many of which are yet to unfold.

zh: 基因驱动因素有可能在很大程度上扭转上述损害的后果。
en: Gene drive elements could potentially reverse much of this damage.

zh: 比方说，限制澳大利亚蔗蟾蜍、夏威夷蚊虫和几乎随处可见的大鼠小鼠等外来入侵物种可以帮助恢复受损的生物群落。
en: For example, limiting invasive species – such as cane toads in Australia, mosquitoes in Hawaii, or rats and mice almost everywhere – could help to restore damaged biomes.

zh: 在不影响其他生态作用的前提下消除害虫对农作物的依赖可以消除使用有毒农药的必要性。
en: And eliminating pests’ attraction to our crops, without diminishing their capacity to fulfill their other ecological roles, would remove the need for toxic pesticides.

zh: 但在我们试图实现上述巨大潜在利益的同时，我们必须牢记整个种群将共同承担基因驱动干预方法的效果。
en: As we attempt to realize these tremendous potential benefits, however, we must bear in mind that the effects of gene drive interventions will be shared by entire communities.

zh: 鉴于生态系统难以言喻的复杂性，必须在这一切开始前展开细致的研究，评估各项干预措施可能造成的后果。
en: Given the vast complexity of ecosystems, careful research will be needed to assess the consequences of each intervention before proceeding.

zh: CRISPR基因运动同时凸显了生态环境以外的一个问题：现有的新技术研发和评估体系在影响深远的有效新工具面前还远远不够。
en: CRISPR gene drives also highlight a problem that goes beyond ecology: Existing systems for developing and evaluating new technologies are woefully inadequate for powerful new tools with broad impacts.

zh: 毋庸讳言，像基因驱动这样不需要广泛采用就能带来广泛影响的技术只有在全社会知情同意的情况下才能够公布。
en: It should be self-evident that technologies like gene drives, which don’t require widespread adoption to have a widespread effect, should never be released without informed community consent.

zh: 但历史模式却恰恰相反，决策过程极少考虑到民众意见和环境后果。
en: Yet history shows the opposite pattern, with decision-making seldom factoring in environmental consequences or citizens’ opinions.

zh: 现在的情况是产品研发成功之前极少听取公众的意见，研发完毕后再想修改却往往太迟了。
en: Nowadays, there are few opportunities for public input until after products are developed, when it is typically too late to make changes.

zh: 但闭门造车的技术研发却不顾越来越了解情况的公众可能大有裨益的贡献，并因此在丧失均衡评估机会的同时招致了公众刻薄的态度 — — 这对科学和社会而言都是高度不负责任且浪费的后果。
en: By ignoring potentially helpful contributions from an increasingly knowledgeable public, closed-door technological development has precluded balanced assessments and created acrimony – a dangerously irresponsible and wasteful outcome for both science and society.

zh: CRISPR基因驱动技术有机会开辟一条全新的道路。
en: CRISPR gene drives offer an opportunity to chart a new course.

zh: 首先，公众宣传和广泛的包容性讨论应始终领先于并指导实验室基因驱动技术的研发工作。
en: For starters, public notification and broadly inclusive discussions should always precede and inform development of gene drive interventions in the lab.

zh: 像我和同事们那样对技术总体状况做出试验可能后果的清晰描述必须与整个研发进程的高度透明相结合。
en: A clear description of the potential impact of an experiment – as my colleagues and I have provided for the technology as a whole – must be followed by transparency throughout the development process.

zh: 这种与群体为导向的研究方法提供了找到和解决研发过程中潜在问题和关注焦点的机会。
en: This community-guided approach to research provides opportunities to identify and address potential problems and concerns during development.

zh: 如果特定问题无法得到充分解决，则研究人员理当准备好结束项目。
en: If a perceived problem cannot be adequately addressed, researchers should be prepared to terminate the project.

zh: 透明度和集体审查也有助于确保科学家履行防止试验事故的基本职责。
en: Transparency and collective scrutiny would also help to ensure that scientists fulfill their fundamental responsibility to protect against laboratory accidents.

zh: 涉及基因驱动的生物试验在事故可能造成实验室以外的潜在损害方面几乎是独一无二的。
en: Experiments involving gene drive organisms are almost unique in terms of the potential harm that a mishap could cause beyond the lab.

zh: 尽管一种基因驱动可以改变由另一种基因驱动带来的DNA水平变化 — — 这是防止意想不到的副作用和滥用的重要保障 — — 但要想扭转生态影响却绝不是那么容易的。
en: Though DNA-level changes spread by one gene drive can be overwritten by another gene drive – an important safeguard against unwanted side effects and misuse – the ecological impacts would not be so easy to reverse.

zh: 可以肯定，多数基因驱动实验即使带来环境风险也都算不上严重。
en: To be sure, most gene drive experiments will pose little, if any, environmental risk.

zh: 但事实证明偶然泄露会严重损害公众对研究人员谦逊和明智地研发这项有效技术的信任度。
en: Nonetheless, an accidental release would prove devastating to public confidence in researchers' ability to develop this powerful technology with wisdom and humility.

zh: 我和我的同事也因此详细论述、说明并公布了几项比较便于实施的限制对策。
en: That is why my colleagues and I have detailed, demonstrated, and publicized several easily implementable confinement strategies.

zh: 负责任做法的另一特点是科学家致力于独立评估拟议中的各项基因驱动技术 — — 如对小鼠进行免疫以杜绝它们对扁虱的莱姆病传播 — — 而非就总体技术做出全局性决策。
en: Another feature of a responsible approach would be a commitment by scientists to evaluate each proposed gene drive intervention – say, immunizing mice so that they cannot transmit Lyme disease to ticks – individually, rather than making a blanket decision on the technology as a whole.

zh: 归根结底，每种疗法的收益和风险都是完全不同的。
en: After all, the benefits and risks of each intervention would be entirely different.

zh: 防止不负责任研究基因驱动技术的终极保障是确保完全由政府和非营利组织从事基因驱动技术的早期研究。
en: A final safeguard against the irresponsible development of gene drive technology is to ensure that early interventions are developed exclusively by governments and nonprofit organizations.

zh: 鉴于曲解安全测试设计和结果的经济动力可能存在，将利润动机排除在研究和决策过程之外将有助于得出均衡的评估结果。
en: Given the potential of financial incentives to skew the design and results of safety tests, keeping the profit motive out of the development and decision-making processes will encourage balanced assessments.

zh: 最低限度是现有的技术研发模式对能产生广泛效果的技术而言还远远不够。
en: The bottom line is that existing models for technological development are inadequate for technologies with broadly shared effects.

zh: 只有依靠早期讨论、透明研发、细心保障和社会指导才能建立起灵活的科学研发模式以适应生态技术。
en: Only with early discussion, transparent research, careful safeguards, and community guidance can we build a responsive model of scientific development well suited to ecological technologies.

zh: 鉴于CRISPR基因驱动技术挽救生命（和环境）的潜力，让我们共同决定采用何种研发方式 — — 以及何时拒绝研发。
en: Given the life-saving (and environment-saving) potential of CRISPR gene drive interventions, let us determine how to develop them – and when to decline to do so – together.

zh: 克里斯汀·赫尔南的选择
en: Cristina Kirchner’s Choice

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯 — — 得益于阿根廷的经济稳定和人们对寡妇的同情，总统克里斯汀·赫尔南（Cristina Kirchner）轻松再度当选，这保证了她能够在没有丈夫奈斯托（Néstor）的情况下治理这个复杂、充满争议又经常干出自我毁灭之事的社会。
en: BUENOS AIRES – Bolstered by Argentina’s economic stability and widespread sympathy for her widowhood, President Cristina Kirchner’s easy re-election has confirmed that she can, indeed, govern a complex, contentious, and at times self-destructive society without her husband, Néstor.

zh: 奈斯托的总统生涯为克里斯汀铺平了道路，但克里斯汀自有一套领导良方。
en: His presidency paved the way for hers, but she is a leader in her own right.

zh: 现在的问题是，在如今更加困难的国内和国际环境下，她将如何扮演自己的领导者角色。
en: The question now is what kind of leader she will want to be in today’s more difficult domestic and international context.

zh: 赫尔南曾在2001年成功地将阿根廷带出了深度危机，让阿根廷的经济增长率能够和中国相媲美。
en: The Kirchners lifted Argentina out of the deep crisis of 2001, presiding over GDP growth rates similar to those of China.

zh: 从某种程度上说，赫尔南重塑了被危机期间的无情调整严重削弱的阿根廷社会和政治生态 — — 当时导致了总统下台、国债违约、生活质量严重下降、一半以上人口陷入贫困的后果。
en: They partly restored Argentina’s social and political fabric, which had been weakened by the brutal adjustments made during that crisis, which triggered a president’s fall from power, default on the country’s debts, and a dramatic decline in living standards that left more than half of the population below the poverty line.

zh: 赫尔南阵营的经济管理（如大面积补贴）减少了失业和贫困。
en: Their management of the economy, which included a deluge of subsidies, reduced unemployment and poverty.

zh: 反对派贬低赫尔南阵营的成就，指出是国际环境，特别是商品价格高企（因此带来了强劲的出口收入）救了她。
en: The opposition underestimates the Kirchners’ achievements, arguing that the international context, particularly high commodity prices – and thus strong export revenues – bailed them out.

zh: 这不无道理，但光凭出口价格有所上涨还不足以保证成功。
en: While that is true, high export prices alone were no guarantee for success.

zh: 但赫尔南阵营并没有充分利用国际环境之东风，他们至今都没有出台能让阿根廷摆脱对商品价格的极端依赖的工业、能源政策、教育及其他领域的结构性改革。
en: But that tailwind may have been squandered, because the Kirchners have yet to make the structural changes – in industry, in the country’s energy policy, in education, and elsewhere – needed to free Argentina from extreme dependence on commodity prices.

zh: 因此，如果大豆价格持续下滑，那么补贴 — — 腐败和献金的温床 — — 将日渐成为公共支出的沉重负担。
en: As a result, if the price of soy continues to fall, subsidies – a source of corruption and patronage – will be an increasingly heavy burden for public spending.

zh: 据非官方数字统计，补贴要占阿根廷GDP的5 % ， 而唯有痛苦的调整才能改变现状。
en: According to unofficial figures, subsidies already represent 5% of GDP, and only painful adjustments can reduce them.

zh: 但本应是紧急修正的方案已经变成了长期政策，因为缺乏将其付诸实践的经济活动。
en: But what was an emergency remedy has become a long-term policy, because there is no economic activity to take its place.

zh: 阿根廷目前享受着消费繁荣，很少有人担心通货膨胀。
en: Few in Argentina, which is enjoying a consumer boom, are worried about inflation.

zh: 但价格的年升高幅度已经达到了20 % ， 如果不加遏制，将导致庇隆主义工会的抗议。
en: But prices are already rising at a 20% annual pace, which, if unchecked, will lead to conflict with the powerful Peronist unions.

zh: 此外，阿根廷历史上饱受通胀破坏经济之苦，因此这一问题必须在失控之间尽快解决。
en: Moreover, given the country’s history of high inflation ravaging the economy, the problem needs to be addressed soon, before it gets out of hand.

zh: 和巴西的关系是另一大考验。
en: Relations with Brazil expose other difficulties.

zh: 今年开始执政的巴西罗瑟夫总统明白，经济增长将会大大放缓，因此实施了雷亚尔贬值的政策来提振巴西的竞争力。
en: Brazilian President Dilma Rousseff’s government, which began its term this year with an understanding that economic growth will slow sharply, devalued the real in order to shore up the country’s competitiveness.

zh: 这对阿根廷来说是个坏消息，因为巴西是其主要贸易伙伴，如今从阿根廷买得更少，向阿根廷卖得更多，破坏了阿根廷的外部环境。
en: That was bad news for Argentina, because Brazil, its main trading partner, will now buy less and sell more, undermining Argentina’s external position.

zh: 在如此困难的国际环境下，赫尔南需要重塑因2001年违约而遭到破坏的与美国和欧洲的关系。
en: In this difficult international context, Cristina Kirchner will need to rebuild relations with the United States and Europe, which have been impaired since the default in 2001.

zh: 其丈夫在违约后的一系列举措以及她本人的措施阻碍了关系改善进程。
en: Subsequent actions by her husband’s administration and her own have blocked improvement.

zh: 奈斯托当着全世界的面摆了美国总统布什一道：在一次国家元首峰会中，作为东道国总统的他举办了争锋相对的反对峰会，邀请了卡斯特罗和查韦斯的支持者。
en: Néstor ridiculed President George W. Bush in front of the world: host to a summit of heads of state, he organized a parallel anti-summit with supporters of Fidel Castro and Venezuelan President Hugo Chávez.

zh: 后来，克里斯汀的外交部长又征用过身处阿根廷领土内的美国军用飞机。
en: More recently, Cristina’s foreign minister presided over the requisitioning of a US military plane on Argentinean soil.

zh: 这些措施都是为了提振国民消费，但美国人对此意见很大。
en: These spectacles were intended for national consumption, but the Americans deeply resented them.

zh: 至于欧洲，赫尔南至今仍未还清阿根廷欠巴黎俱乐部成员国债权人的债务 — — 自违约以来，偿债问题一直悬而未决。
en: As for Europe, the Kirchner’s have not yet paid off Argentina’s debt – pending since the default – to the Paris Club of sovereign creditors.

zh: 所有这些都成了吸引外国投资和获得国际信贷的阻碍。
en: All of this hinders foreign investment and access to international credit.

zh: 与此同时，美国反对世界银行和泛美开发银行向阿根廷提供优惠贷款。
en: In the meantime, the US is opposed to concessionary loans for Argentina from the World Bank and the Inter-American Development Bank.

zh: 在这样的环境下，阿根廷富裕阶层和权力阶层正在用钱投票，将自己的美元资产转移海外。
en: In this context, Argentina’s rich and powerful vote with their wallets and send their dollars overseas.

zh: 今年，资本外流为200亿美元，几乎创下了历史记录。
en: This year, the outflow is nearly $20 billion – almost a record.

zh: 阿根廷是一个紧急状况频发的国家。
en: Argentina is a country that lives in an almost continual state of emergency.

zh: 阿根廷的历史充满了数不胜数的政变、几万人失踪、马岛战争、反复恶性通胀、严重经济危机、外债违约和饥饿的孱弱公民。
en: Its history has seen many coups, tens of thousands of people missing, a war with Great Britain, bouts of hyperinflation, a brutal economic crisis, default on foreign debt, and its most vulnerable citizens going hungry.

zh: 但阿根廷人极富戏剧天赋：我们像探戈一样热情，像萨瓦托（Ernesto Sábato）的小说一样忧郁。
en: But there is also a theatrical intensity about the Argentine character: we are dramatic like the tango and somber like the novels of Ernesto Sábato.

zh: 如此无与伦比的精神让奈斯托获益良多，但阿根廷的政府机构付出了沉重代价。
en: That exceptional spirit benefited her husband, but the country’s institutions paid a high price.

zh: 奈斯托说服国会允许他解决改善预算。
en: Néstor convinced Parliament to allow him to modify the budget.

zh: 接着，他使出了操纵官方统计数字的伎俩试图隐藏通胀。
en: Later, he took the liberty of manipulating official statistics in order to hide inflation.

zh: 此外，他建立了一套让政府为所欲为的体系，但被其妻子所控制的媒体批评得体无完肤。
en: And, while building a system that would do whatever the government wanted, he began a struggle against critical journalism that continues under his wife.

zh: 艰难岁月就在眼前，克里斯汀是努力成为21世纪的庇隆夫人，利用阿根廷人的火热情怀和无与伦比的权力续写史诗新篇章，还是采取罗瑟夫的明智态度，向低效率和腐败宣战，同时强化政府机构的地位？
en: With hard times approaching, will Cristina try to be a twenty-first-century Evita and create an epic by exploiting Argentines’ flamboyant tendencies, armed with an exceptional power or will she adopt Rouseff’s sensible attitude and combat inefficiency and corruption while strengthening governmental institutions?

zh: 如果她选择罗瑟夫的道路，她首先必须抵制住连续当选的诱惑。
en: If she chooses Rouseff’s approach, she will first have to resist the temptation of perpetual re-election.

zh: 她和她的丈夫开创了有趣的传统：每四年在他俩之间交接一次权力。
en: She and her husband had hit upon a novel scheme: alternating power between them every four years.

zh: 如今，克里斯汀已经是一位寡妇，她将面对“跛脚鸭综合症 ” ， 因为她无法再度连任了。
en: Now a widow, she is exposed to the lame-duck syndrome, since she can’t be re-elected again.

zh: 一旦她找不到继续执政的办法，一直对她俯首帖耳的庇隆主义领导人就可以着手掀起权力交接之战了。
en: The same Peronist caudillos that have obeyed her until now could start a war of succession if she does not find a way to continue in office.

zh: 如果她想在四年后仍然握有大权，她可能会这样做。
en: If she wants to retain power four years from now, she might do just that.

zh: 毕竟，如今她对议会有着绝对的控制权。
en: After all, she now holds absolute control over a docile parliament.

zh: 阿根廷和很多拉美国家一样，总统权力无限，其他政府机构都是花瓶，行政和国家权力的界线很模糊。
en: In Argentina, as in many Latin American countries, presidents have so much power that other governmental institutions’ authority fades, eradicating the boundaries between the executive and the state.

zh: 如果克里斯汀唯一的障碍就是她本人，那么阿根廷很难组织未来政治风暴的降临。
en: If the only limits on Cristina are her own, Argentina will not weather the coming storm well.

zh: 任人唯亲的香港中央银行
en: Crony Central Banking in Hong Kong

zh: 香港 — — 香港金融管理局总裁兼职业公务员任志刚就要退休了。
en: HONG KONG – Joseph Yam, the head of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and a career civil servant, is retiring.

zh: 正常情况下这件事不该有什么新闻价值，但实际情况却截然相反，而且有正当理由。
en: Ordinarily, that should not be a newsworthy event, yet it is, and for good reasons.

zh: 香港政府行政长官曾荫权有机会选择一位诚实和能力都无懈可击的人出任金管局总裁，并借此在香港最重要的法定机构之一恢复诚信和善治。
en: Donald Tsang, Chief Executive of Hong Kong’s government, has the opportunity to restore integrity and proper governance in one of the most important statutory bodies in the territory by choosing a person solely on the basis of unimpeachable honesty and competence.

zh: 任一直是许多香港人、包括不懂国际金融的记者们心目中的英雄。
en: Yam remains a hero to many in Hong Kong, including journalists unschooled in international finance.

zh: 在这些人眼中，他是港元的保护者，26年来，港元与美元间一直维持着7.8的固定汇率。
en: To them, he is the guardian of the Hong Kong dollar, which has been fixed at 7.8 to the US dollar for 26 years.

zh: 1998年金融危机期间，贬值会损及拥有香港本地房产但鲜有美元收入或资产的群体的利益。
en: During the 1998 financial crisis, devaluation would have hurt those who owned local real estate but had little earnings or assets in US dollars.

zh: 香港处于寡头垄断地位的地产大亨不顾港币当时处在明显高估的状态，依然反对改革联系汇率。
en: Not surprisingly, Hong Kong’s oligopoly of property tycoons opposed changing the peg despite the currency’s gross overvalue at the time.

zh: 香港为保持7.8的汇率付出了6年经济停滞的代价 — — 上述代价的承担者是全体香港公民。
en: The 7.8 exchange rate was maintained at the cost – borne by all citizens – of six years of economic stagnation.

zh: 港元在理论上由照章办事的货币局管理，这是英国人为小块殖民地发明的货币管理机制。
en: The currency was in theory governed by a rules-based Currency Board, which the British invented for their smaller colonies.

zh: 这种机制把当地货币与英镑挂钩，当地政府无权自行决定货币政策。
en: It tied the local currency to the British Pound, giving local authorities no discretion in monetary policy.

zh: 尽管来源不乏帝国主义色彩，但货币局背后的理论基础却非常扎实。
en: While imperial in origin, the rationale behind the Currency Board was sound.

zh: 殖民地缺乏相关的专业知识。
en: Colonies were short on expertise.

zh: 自由创制货币或调整利率政策可能是经济灾难的代名词 — — 事实上，众多前殖民地独立后也的确证实了这样的推测。
en: Freedom in money creation or in interest-rate policy could mean economic disaster – as, indeed, it did in many ex-colonies following independence.

zh: 任一直以来都因为在货币局的管辖下缺乏政策自由而倍感沮丧。
en: Yam was always frustrated by the lack of policy freedom under the Currency Board.

zh: 1998年危机来袭前，他已经把赋予他流动性和利率操控空间的政策落实到位。
en: Before the crisis struck in 1998 he put in place measures giving him room to manipulate liquidity and interest rates.

zh: 他背离原有的体制也催生了新的漏洞，他根本不晓得这些漏洞的存在，或者认为它们没什么关系。
en: His deviation from the system also created loopholes that he did not know about or thought irrelevant.

zh: 英帝国的创立者正要试图避免此类问题。
en: This was precisely what the British empire-builders had wanted to prevent.

zh: 1997－98年亚洲金融危机期间，当全球职业投资人把目光从泰国和韩国转到香港的时候，迅速就找到了货币管理方式的结构性缺陷。
en: When, during the 1997-98 Asian financial crisis, global investment professionals turned their attention from Thailand and Korea to Hong Kong, they quickly spotted structural weaknesses in the way the currency was managed.

zh: 本地专家此前就曾向任志刚发出过警告，但他对他们的说法不屑一顾，以致于与他一道出席会议的一位经济学家把他的态度形容为“屈尊俯就而且充满蔑视 ” 。 此外，当专家们意识到任、和他没有实权的名义老板曾荫权根本不懂经济推理时，他们在震惊之余转身走开了。
en: Local experts had previously warned Yam about this, but he dismissed their argument in a way that one economist who was present at a meeting with him described as “demeaning and contemptuous”.   Moreover, they left in shock in realizing Yam, and the financial secretary, Donald Tsang, nominally his boss but without real power, didn’t really understand the experts’ economic reasoning.

zh: 香港政府在金管局的领导下，发起了前所未有的干预行动，大量买进当地股票来‘击败’投机商人，但终于未能阻止全球投资者，包括保守的养老基金和共同基金各自四散逃命。
en: Hong Kong ’s government, led by the HKMA, launched an unprecedented intervention, buying up local shares to “defeat” the speculators, but failed to stop the stampede by global investors, including conservative pension and mutual funds.

zh: 终于，当政府即将耗尽全部外汇储备的时候，任意识到必须改变策略。
en: Finally, with the government about to exhaust its entire foreign reserves, Yam realized that he had to change course.

zh: 他明智地接受了批评者的建议，解决了他曾经否认存在的问题。
en: He wisely accepted his critics’ suggestions, fixing the problems that he had denied existed.

zh: 时任香港行政长官的董建华向他颁发了公共服务最高勋章，董后来因能力不够被北京免职。
en: He was awarded the highest public-service medal by the then Hong Kong Chief Executive Tung Chi-wah, who was later ousted by Beijing for incompetence.

zh: 写这篇文章时，任因为未能保护小投资者免受若干银行以债券为伪装销售雷曼兄弟有毒衍生品的欺诈销售策略的蒙蔽而广受批评。
en: At this writing, Yam is widely criticized in Hong Kong for failing to protect small investors against the dishonest sales tactics of a number of banks in their selling of toxic Lehman Brothers derivatives disguised as bonds.

zh: 他不承认自己有任何责任，尽管金管局负责监管所有的金融机构。
en: He denies any responsibility, even though the HKMA oversees all financial institutions.

zh: 任是全世界薪酬最高的公务员，去年年薪高达150万美元。
en: Yam is the highest-paid civil servant in the world, earning US$1.5 million last year.

zh: 他的薪水是美联储主席的7倍，比他自己的顶头上司，香港行政长官高近3倍。
en: His salary is seven times that of the chairman of the US Federal Reserve and nearly 3 times higher than that of his own superior, the Hong Kong Chief Executive.

zh: 他称自己应当为监管私有部门数十亿美元的资金而拿到奖励。
en: He claims that he should be rewarded as a fund manager supervising a multibillion-dollar fund in the private sector.

zh: 但在私有部门专业人士被解雇或因业绩不佳而遭降薪的时候，任却希望拿到私有部门的薪酬，而不承担私有部门的风险。
en: But, whereas private-sector professionals are fired or have their salaries reduced for poor performance, Yam wanted private-sector pay with none of the downside risk.

zh: 香港金管局薪酬委员会全权决定任的薪水。
en: The HKMA’s Compensation Committee had the sole responsibility for setting Yam’s salary.

zh: 但在长达16年的任职期间，任把自己任命的委员塞进了薪酬委员会，这些人是他一手从所辖的金融部门选拔出来的。
en: But, during his 16-year tenure, Yam put his own appointees on that committee, choosing them from the financial sector that he regulates.

zh: 委员会不经审查就批准他的薪酬要求已成惯例。
en: The Committee routinely rubber-stamped his salary demands.

zh: 任的退休为香港政府提供了纠正严重治理问题的一次机遇。
en: Yam’s retirement presents an opportunity for Hong Kong’s government to redress a major issue of governance.

zh: 港府应以下辖金管局的香港政府的薪酬标准来取代金管局的薪酬结构。
en: It should replace the compensation structure by the same civil-service scale applied to the government of which the HKMA is an integral part.

zh: 香港公务员的薪酬已经堪称世界之最。
en: Hong Kong ’s civil servants are already the best paid in the world.

zh: 如果有人试图在谈判雇佣合同时拿公共服务职务的薪酬与私有部门比较，那么他不该来当公务员，而应当直接去私有部门找工作。
en: Anyone seeking to compare a public-service job with the private sector in negotiating an employment contract should simply seek work in the private sector rather than for the public good.

zh: 舍此之外的任何方法不过是打开了腐败之门。
en: Anything else merely opens the door for corruption.

zh: 流传很广的猜测是香港行政长官曾荫权将任命一位通才来接手金管局的工作，此人在个人效忠方面的知名度远胜于金融专业知识。
en: There is much speculation that Hong Kong Chief Executive Donald Tsang is about to appoint a generalist civil servant better known for his personal loyalty than for his financial expertise.

zh: 也没有迹象表明香港金管局的薪资标准将遭到废除。
en: Nor is there any sign that the entire HKMA pay scale should be scrapped.

zh: 无论最后是哪一种结果，都意味着行政长官错失了发送正确信息，表明香港支持良好公共治政，而不是任人唯亲的难得的机遇。
en: Either outcome would mean that the Chief Executive has missed an opportunity to send the right signal that Hong Kong stands for good public governance rather than cronyism.

zh: 危机中的跨国银行业务
en: Cross-Border Banking in the Balance

zh: 伦敦 — — 欧元区危机的威力终于显现出来了。
en: LONDON – The gravity of the eurozone crisis has finally sunk in.

zh: 我们已经投下了最重的赌注。
en: The stakes could not be higher.

zh: 各国政府和金融机构竭尽全力，试图在极其紧张的政治和经济约束中拿出一举解决问题的方案。
en: Governments and international financial institutions have scrambled to put together a solution within exceedingly tight political and economic constraints.

zh: 方案的设计还有相当多的问题需要解决；其中如何实施便是一项重大挑战。
en: Many questions have yet to be answered about the design; implementation will be at least as challenging.

zh: 现在，欧元区领导人必须不仅要捍卫单一货币，而且还要捍卫欧洲金融一体化所带来的好处。
en: Eurozone leaders must now aim to preserve not only the single currency, but also the gains from financial integration in Europe.

zh: 世界上没有哪个地区比欧洲从跨国银行业务中获得更多的好处，如今，这些成就陷入了危机，各大欧洲银行集团本身也随之岌岌可危。
en: No region of the world has benefited more from cross-border banking, yet these achievements are now at risk – and with them the European bank groups themselves.

zh: 跨国银行所面临的威胁不仅来自因主权债务质量下降和增长前景转坏而恶化的资产负债表，也来自政策应对本身。
en: The threat to cross-border banks comes not only from their deteriorating balance sheets in the face of lower sovereign-debt quality and weaker growth prospects, but also from the policy response itself.

zh: 眼下，人们已经接受了欧洲银行需要大笔新资本这一事实。
en: The fact that Europe’s banks need massive amounts of new capital is by now generally accepted.

zh: 但是，尽管新的欧洲银行监管局（European Banking Authority）当机立断，出台并协调所需要的措施，欧洲方案仍然需要将全欧洲的外国银行支行网络纳入考虑范围。
en: Yet, despite valiant attempts by the new European Banking Authority to mandate and coordinate the measures that are needed, a European solution must take account of the network of foreign subsidiaries across Europe.

zh: 动员对欧洲银行的支持力量绝非易事；而将其扩展到所有支行就更加困难了。
en: Mobilizing support for European banks will be hard; extending it to subsidiaries will be even harder.

zh: 但是，与让全欧洲银行暴露于主权债务风险之下这一欠妥考虑相比，通过外国支行进行跨国银行业务对投资者、家庭和东道国均有利，其中获益最大的是目前仍为欧元区最大出口市场的中欧和东欧。
en: But, unlike the ill-advised exposure to sovereign debt across Europe, cross-border banking through foreign subsidiaries has been beneficial for investors, and for home and host countries alike – nowhere more so than in emerging Central and Eastern Europe, still the most important export market for the eurozone.

zh: 对于核心欧元区银行来说，中东欧地区能带来超常回报，并已将其纳入经营范围。
en: For core eurozone banks, this has been a region of extraordinary returns, and it is now integral to their operations.

zh: 在新兴欧洲，外国银行支行有助于建设更加稳定的金融体系，也有助于本国收入水平迅速向欧洲平均水平看齐。
en: In emerging Europe, foreign subsidiaries have helped to build financial systems that are less prone to instability, and have helped economies to converge more rapidly with average European income levels.

zh: 2008年全球危机爆发时，我们还没有保护跨国银行业务网的监管框架，因此暴露出了极大的脆弱性，比如杠杆率过高和外汇风险。
en: When the global crisis erupted in 2008, there was no regulatory framework to protect the cross-border networks, and large vulnerabilities, in the form of excessive leverage and foreign exchange, were exposed.

zh: 此后，我们已经取得了长足的进步：资产负债表已有所强化，融资模式也有所调整。
en: Much has been achieved since then: balance sheets have been strengthened and funding models adjusted.

zh: 在采取欧洲层面的制度改革 — — 特别是欧洲系统性风险委员会（European Systemic Risk Board）和欧洲银行监管局的创设 — — 的同时，支行东道国的监管和监督也在加强。
en: Along with institutional reforms at the European level – particularly the creation of the European Systemic Risk Board and the European Banking Authority – regulation and supervision have been reinforced in subsidiaries’ host countries.

zh: 有的措施可能会增加融资成本，但同时也降低了银行经营的风险。
en: Some of this might make finance more costly, but it will also make banking operations less risky.

zh: 总的来看是利大于弊。
en: On balance, this is a good thing.

zh: 尽管如此，今日的金融稳定性威胁比2008年更大，因为西欧各国政府支持银行体系的能力显然已经达到了极限。
en: Even so, the threat to financial stability is possibly even graver today than it was in 2008, as the capacity of Western European governments to backstop banking systems is clearly reaching its limits.

zh: 外国银行支行因其母国危机深化而成为孤儿将损害新兴欧洲银行体系的信心，从而引发资产价格下跌和信用急剧紧缩。
en: Allowing foreign banks’ subsidiaries to become orphaned amid a worsening crisis in home countries would undermine confidence in emerging Europe’s financial systems, which could trigger asset-price declines and precipitous contractions in credit.

zh: 最终，西欧银行也将受到影响，因为它们与新兴欧洲有着千丝万缕的金融和真实联系。
en: Ultimately, this would boomerang back on Western European banks, given their deep financial and real linkages with the region.

zh: 2008年，我们曾与这样的可怕情景擦肩而过，这要归功于政策干预，包括在所谓的“维也纳倡议 ” （ Vienna Initiative，参与者包括欧洲复兴开发银行和其他机构）框架下的政策协调。
en: In 2008, such a catastrophic scenario was narrowly avoided, owing to policy intervention, including the coordination effort under the so-called Vienna Initiative (in which the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, among others, was involved).

zh: 如今，我们迫切需要新的维也纳倡议来确保金融一体化成就不会倒退。
en: A new pact to secure the achievements of financial integration is now urgently needed.

zh: 各大银行母国和东道国当局必须精诚合作。
en: Authorities from these banks’ home and host countries must sit down together.

zh: 与维也纳倡议相同 ， “ 维也纳2.0”将要求所有相关方作出承诺。
en: As with the Vienna Initiative, a “Vienna 2.0” would require commitments by all concerned parties.

zh: 当局提出了更高的资本要求，作为回应，各大银行将选择是筹集更多资本还是出售更多资产，在此过程中，银行必须考虑其支行在多个国家的重要作用。
en: In responding to the higher capital requirements imposed by authorities, and choosing whether to raise more capital or sell off assets, the banks must take into account the important role that their subsidiaries play in many countries.

zh: 对许多银行来说，这是再自然不过的事情了 — — 它们的外国支行是重要的价值创造者，也是业务模式的关键部分。
en: For many banks, this happens naturally – their subsidiaries, as important value creators, are critical to their business models.

zh: 不过，对某些银行来说，外国支行相对于总行来说规模较小，战略地位也较低。
en: For some, however, the subsidiaries are smaller relative to the parents’ size – and thus less central to their strategies.

zh: 母国也应该有所贡献。
en: Home countries must also contribute.

zh: 在欧元区内部，任何资本重组、担保和其他总行所获得的资金应该以同样规模提供给外国支行。
en: Within the eurozone, any recapitalization, guarantees, and other funds offered to parent banks should be made available to subsidiaries in equal measure.

zh: 任何用来换取资本支持的重组都应该考虑银行集团的跨国性质，不能歧视海外支行。
en: Any restructuring requested in return for capital support should take into account the cross-border nature of the groups and not discriminate against subsidiaries abroad.

zh: 外国支行的东道国则必须给总行吃定心丸 — — 本国金融监管不会朝令夕改。
en: Subsidiaries’ host countries, for their part, must reassure parent banks that financial regulation will remain predictable.

zh: 最近有一些关于金融业税收政策和外汇贷款负担再分配政策的突然变动（往往颇为激进）大大恶化了资本缓冲，也影响到了信用和经济增长的复苏。
en: Some of the recent abrupt – and at times overly ambitious – measures to tax the industry or redistribute the burden of foreign-currency loans have undermined capital cushions and set back recovery in credit and growth.

zh: 所有这些都需要协调。
en: All of this requires coordination.

zh: 欧洲银行监管局迎来了立威良机。
en: The European Banking Authority has a chance to establish itself.

zh: 它必须确保国家利益不会妨碍跨国银行集团的一体性。
en: It must ensure that national interests do not undermine the integrity of the cross-border bank groups.

zh: 最终，我们需要一个泛欧洲的存款保险和银行问题解决机构来接管和重组倒闭的银行。
en: Ultimately, we need a Europe-wide deposit insurance and bank-resolution authority that can take over and restructure failed banks.

zh: 正如欧元区为其成员国带来了金融发展和经济增长，当前的危机正在造成极大的附带伤害风险，其影响远超国界线。
en: Just as the eurozone has fostered financial development and economic growth among its members, the current crisis now risks inflicting severe collateral damage far beyond its borders.

zh: 任何可持续的危及解决方案都必须确保银行集团的一体性，尊重这些银行母国和东道国的利益。
en: Any sustainable solution to the crisis must ensure the integrity of the bank groups and respect the interests of these banks’ home and host countries.

zh: 说到底，如今真正陷入危机的是跨国银行业务。
en: Ultimately, it is cross-border banking that is in the balance.

zh: 创造力、社团主义与群体
en: Creativity, Corporatism, and Crowds

zh: 纽黑文—我们很久以前就从麻省理工学院的罗伯特·索洛（Robert M. Solow）等经济学家的工作中学到，经济增长主要靠学习和创新而不仅是储蓄和资本积累驱动。
en: NEW HAVEN – Economic growth, as we learned long ago from the works of economists like MIT’s Robert M. Solow, is largely driven by learning and innovation, not just saving and the accumulation of capital.

zh: 说到底，经济进步取决于创造力。
en: Ultimately, economic progress depends on creativity.

zh: 正因如此，对当今发达经济体的“长期停滞”的恐慌让很多人不知道如何刺激创造力。
en: That is why fear of “secular stagnation” in today’s advanced economies has many wondering how creativity can be spurred.

zh: 最近的一个主要观点是，我们最需要的是凯恩斯主义经济刺激 — — 比如赤字支出。
en: One prominent argument lately has been that what is needed most is Keynesian economic stimulus – for example, deficit spending.

zh: 毕竟，人们在活跃而非失业时最有创造力。
en: After all, people are most creative when they are active, not when they are unemployed.

zh: 其他人认为刺激与经济活力再生没有关系。
en: Others see no connection between stimulus and renewed economic dynamism.

zh: 德国总理默克尔最近指出，欧洲需要“政治勇气和创造力，而不是几十亿欧元。 ”
en: As German Chancellor Angela Merkel recently put it, Europe needs “political courage and creativity rather than billions of euros.”

zh: 事实上，两者缺一不可。
en: In fact, we need both.

zh: 如果我们要刺激活力，就需要凯恩斯主义刺激和其他鼓励创造力的政策 — — 特别是促进可靠金融机构和社会创新的政策。
en: If we are to encourage dynamism, we need Keynesian stimulus and other policies that encourage creativity – particularly policies that promote solid financial institutions and social innovation.

zh: 在2013年的著作《大繁荣 》 （ Mass Flourishing）中，埃德蒙德·菲尔普斯（Edmund Phelps）认为我们需要促进“保护和启发推动一国内生性创新的个性、想象力、理解和自我表达的文化。
en: In his 2013 book Mass Flourishing, Edmund Phelps argues that we need to promote “a culture protecting and inspiring individuality, imagination, understanding, and self-expression that drives a nation’s indigenous innovation.”

zh: ”他认为创造力被一种叫社团主义（corporatism）的公共哲学所桎梏，只有通过彻底改革金融和其他领域的私人机构才能重塑个性和活力。
en: He believes that creativity has been stifled by a public philosophy described as corporatism, and that only through thorough reform of our private institutions, financial and others, can individuality and dynamism be restored.

zh: 菲尔普斯强调，社团主义思维有着悠久的历史，可以追溯到《新约》十四章的作者圣保罗（Saint Paul ） 。
en: Phelps stresses that corporatist thinking has had a long and enduring history, going back to Saint Paul, the author of as many as 14 books of the New Testament.

zh: 保罗讲人体（拉丁语称为corpus）比喻为社会，指出健康的社会正如健康的人体，每个器官都必须得到保护，不能让任何一个死去。
en: Paul used the human body (corpus in Latin) as a metaphor for society, suggesting that in a healthy society, as in a healthy body, every organ must be preserved and none permitted to die.

zh: 作为公共政策教条的社团主义则是指政府必须支持所有社会成员，不管是个人还是组织，支持倒闭企业、保护现有工作岗位等。
en: As a public-policy credo, corporatism has come to mean that the government must support all members of society, whether individuals or organizations, giving support to failing businesses and protecting existing jobs alike.

zh: 菲尔普斯说，里奥十三世教皇（Pope Leo XIII）在其1891年的《新视通谕 》 （ Rerum Novarum）中宣扬了社团主义观点，庇护十一世教皇（Pope Pius XI）在其1931年《四十年通谕 》 （ Quadragesimo Anno）扩充了这些思想。
en: According to Phelps, Pope Leo XIII advocated a corporatist view in his 1891 encyclical Rerum Novarum, and Pope Pius XI amplified these ideas in his 1931 encyclical Quadragesimo Anno.

zh: 但是，在阅读这些资料时，我没有发现明确的或有说服力的经济思想观点，只有一些关于公平和基督教慈善的基本概念。
en: But, in reading these works, I do not find a clear or persuasive statement of any economic doctrine, except for basic notions of fairness and Christian charity.

zh: 事实上，Ngrams书籍搜索表明“社团主义”一词直到20世纪30年代中期以后才开始流行，成为热点则是在20世纪七八十年代。
en: In fact, an Ngrams search of books shows that the term corporatism began to become popular only after the mid-1930s, and achieved broad currency by the 1970s and 1980s.

zh: 这个词似乎更多地被批评者使用，通常的用途是谴责已成落水狗的法西斯主义，另一个该词汇的使用群体常常歌颂“新”社团主义的要素。
en: The term seems to have been used most often by critics, often to denounce the defunct Fascist philosophy, or by those extolling elements of a “new” corporatism.

zh: 诚然，社团主义思维的要素至今仍在。
en: Surely, elements of corporatist thinking persist today.

zh: 即使不强调政府应该保护企业或冗余工人的人，也仍然会抱有同情心，从而促使这样的结果的产生。
en: People who might not stress that the government should protect failing businesses or redundant workers still have sympathies that might often lead to such outcomes.

zh: 从历史上看，向社团主义思维的一个重要刺激是古斯塔夫·勒庞（Gustave Le Bon）1895年的著作《乌合之众 》 （ The Crowd ） ， 该著作提出了“群体心理学 ” （ crowd psychology）和“集体思维 ” （ collective mind ） 。
en: Historically, an important spur toward corporatist thinking was Gustave Le Bon’s 1895 book The Crowd, which coined the terms “crowd psychology” and “collective mind.”

zh: 对勒庞来说 ， “ 群体中的个体 ” — —不但包括街头愤怒的暴民，也包括其他心理相近的人群 — — “是藏在其他沙粒中的沙粒，风可以随心所欲地将它们扬起。 ”
en: For Le Bon, “An individual in a crowd” – not only angry mobs on the street, but also other psychologically interconnected groups of people – “is a grain of sand amid other grains of sand, which the wind stirs up at will.”

zh: 勒庞认为群体需要强大的领袖以使他们脱离天然的疯狂状态，将他们变为壮丽、活力、华美的文明。
en: Le Bon believed that crowds need strong leaders, to distance them from their natural madness and transform them into civilizations of splendor, vigor, and brilliance.

zh: 墨索里尼和希特勒都从这本书中获得了灵感，并把勒庞的思想融合到法西斯主义和纳粹主义钟来；这些思想并未随着政权的倒闭而死去。
en: Mussolini and Hitler both took inspiration from his book, and incorporated his ideas into Fascist and Nazi ideology; and those ideas did not die with those regimes.

zh: 但在我们这个世纪中 ， “ 群体 ” （ crowd）一词有了截然不同的意义和政治含义。
en: Still, the word “crowd” has taken on an entirely different meaning – and political valence – in our century.

zh: 众包（crowdsourcing）和众筹（crowd-funding）产生了勒庞所无法想象的新的群体类型。
en: Crowdsourcing and crowd-funding have created new kinds of crowds, of the sort that Le Bon never could have imagined.

zh: 勒庞强调，人们无法轻易地作为个体干成大事。
en: As Le Bon emphasized, people cannot easily do great things as individuals.

zh: 他们需要在重新引导群体心理学、促进创造力的组织内一起行动病接受正直的人的领导。
en: They need to operate together within organizations that redirect crowd psychology, facilitate creativity, and are led by people of integrity.

zh: 但是，任何这类组织技术都会犯错，需要实验法。
en: Any such organizational technology, however, is subject to error and requires experimentation.

zh: 当众包的维基百科（Wikipedia）于2010年上线时，他的成功绝非显而易见。
en: When the crowd-sourced Wikipedia was started in 2001, its success was not obvious.

zh: 甚至其创始者之一吉米·威尔斯（Jimmy Wales）也认为有点难以置信 ： “ 你就是开个站点，然后让人们工作，这真是有点令人惊奇。 ”
en: Even one of its founders, Jimmy Wales, found it a little hard to believe: “It’s kind of surprising that you could just open up a site and let people work.”

zh: 2012年，奥巴马总统签署了便利真正的众筹企业的美国创业企业扶助法（Jumpstart Our Business Startups (JOBS) Act ） ， 这也是一项实验。
en: When the United States’ Jumpstart Our Business Startups (JOBS) Act, which facilitated true crowd-funding of enterprises, was signed by President Barack Obama in 2012, it was an experiment, too.

zh: 许多批评者说，这会导致对天真投资者的利用。
en: Many critics said that it would result in the exploitation of naive investors.

zh: 我们仍不清楚这是否属实，或者这项实验会进行得怎么样。
en: We still do not know whether that is true, or how well the experiment will work.

zh: 但如果JOBS法真的以失败告终，我们也不应该抛弃这一思想，而是应该改进它。
en: But if the JOBS Act does not succeed, we should not abandon the idea, but try to modify it.

zh: 最终，我们需要能讲世界人民的各种奇思妙想的创新活动集中起来的社会机构。
en: Ultimately, we need economic institutions that somehow promote the concerted creative actions of a wide swath of the world’s people.

zh: 这些机构不应该是由核心领袖主宰的社团主义机构，这些机构的力量应该来自现代群体的不固定行为。
en: They should not be corporatist institutions, dominated by central leaders, but should derive their power from the fluid actions of modern crowds.

zh: 这些行为中有一些必然会起到干扰作用，因为组织的冲力可能导致它们过犹不及。
en: Some of those actions will have to be disruptive, because the momentum of organizations can carry them beyond their usefulness.

zh: 但它们也必须有足够的持续性，以使人们将事业和未来托付给这些组织。
en: But there must also be enough continuity that people can trust their careers and futures to such organizations.

zh: 承认实验的必要性病设计新形式的经济组织绝不意味着放弃公平和激情。
en: Acknowledging the need to experiment and design new forms of economic organization must not mean abandoning fairness and compassion.

zh: 哭泣吧，可爱的缅甸
en: Cry, Beloved Burma

zh: 仰光 — — 自从1000多年前佛教传播到缅甸以来，僧侣严格遵守宗教制度就一直是人们对缅甸的印象。
en: YANGON – Religious orders of monks have been the face of Burma ever since Buddhism was introduced here more than 1,000 years ago.

zh: 上座部佛教的道德规范规定僧侣不得介入政治或者担任政治职务。
en: For a monk to involve himself in politics or to hold a political post is contrary to the ethical code of Theravada Buddhism.

zh: 但是在今天的缅甸，这种以同情心和不使用暴力为根基的精神哲学却随着僧侣们挑战统治我们国家的军人集团的霸权而出人意料地呈现出了反抗和拒不服从的一面。
en: But in Burma today, this spiritual philosophy, rooted in compassion and non-violence, has assumed unexpected dimensions of defiance and recalcitrance, as monks challenge the hegemony of the military junta that rules our country.

zh: 我们俩都是缅甸的佛教僧侣。 一位是全缅甸僧伽同盟的领导人，领导了最近的抗议活动，另一位是在美国教学的学者。
en: We are both Burmese Buddhist monks – a leader of the All Burma Sangha Coalition that led the recent protests, and a scholar teaching in the United States.

zh: 我们中的一个目前正在四处藏匿，因为缅甸的军政府用暴力和凶残来镇压我们信仰佛教的兄弟姐妹的和平抗议活动。
en: One of us is in hiding today, because Burma’s military government met the peaceful protests of our Buddhist brothers and sisters with violence and brutality.

zh: 许多和尚和尼姑遭到了虐待和殴打，还有数千名被关押起来的僧侣日夜遭受着残忍的虐待。
en: Many monks and nuns have been abused and beaten, and thousands who have been arrested endure continued brutality.

zh: 有1000多民僧侣失踪了，其中有很多可能已经死亡了。
en: More than 1,000 are missing, and many are presumed dead.

zh: 几个星期前，缅甸的僧侣开始上街游行、祈祷并且传播爱心，希望能够和平地解决我们国家所面临的问题。
en: A few weeks ago, Burma’s monks began to march and pray and spread loving kindness in an effort to solve our nation’s problems peacefully.

zh: 缅甸是一个拥有丰富自然资源的国家，但是它的人民却很贫穷。
en: Burma is a country rich in natural resources, but its people are poor.

zh: 当政府突然心血来潮地在一夜之间把燃油的价格提高了500%时，每一个人都受到了巨大的影响，许多人甚至处于绝望的境地。
en: When the government suddenly and capriciously increased the price of fuel by as much as 500% overnight, everyone was affected – and made even more desperate.

zh: 作为僧侣，我们信奉的是缓解我们在任何地方所看到的苦难，这是我们宣誓的一部分。
en: As monks, we believe in alleviating suffering wherever we see it, as part of the vows we have taken.

zh: 我们无法对人民所遭受的苦难视而不见。
en: We could not ignore our people’s suffering.

zh: 我们联合全国的僧侣成立了僧伽同盟。
en: We formed the Sangha Coalition when we saw that the country’s monks were united.

zh: 在国外从事学习和教学的僧侣也很支持我们的行动，大家都联合起来支持在缅甸国内的僧侣。
en: Those of us who are studying and teaching abroad share this unity, and have rallied to the support of those of us in Burma.

zh: 其实不仅仅是是僧侣们联合起来了。
en: And it is not only the monks who are united.

zh: 当我们举行和平游行要求变革时，学生、年轻人、知识分子还有普通民众都跟我们一起冒雨走到大街上。
en: When we started our peaceful marches for change, students, youth, intellectuals, and ordinary people joined us in the streets, in the rain.

zh: 我们认为我们能够呼吁某些，如果不是全部的话，控制我们国家的将军们他们自己也是佛教徒与我们一起努力改变缅甸人民所遭受的许多疾苦。
en: We thought that we could appeal to some, if not all, of the generals – Buddhists themselves – who control our country to join us in trying to right the many ills befalling Burma.

zh: 一开始，我们拒绝接受军人统治集团的施舍以表达我们对他们的不满。
en: At first, we tried to show our displeasure with military rule by refusing to receive alms from them.

zh: 我们把我们的乞讨碗反转过来，以此表达我们的情感。
en: We turned our begging bowls upside down as a gesture of our feelings.

zh: 我们并没有丢失我们对普通士兵的爱，甚至也没有丢失对下令他们残酷地对待他们自己的人民的那些领导的爱，我们只是希望能督促他们在时间还来得及的时候作出改变。
en: We have not lost our loving kindness towards ordinary soldiers, nor even towards the leaders who ordered them to brutalize their own people, but we wanted to urge them to change while there was still time.

zh: 我们知道许多在军队以及与统治集团很接近的组织里的人并不愿意用暴力来对付僧侣。
en: We know that some people in the army and organizations close to the regime have been reluctant to use violence against the monks.

zh: 我们希望告诉那些残酷对待他们自己的国民的人停下来想一想他们的做法是不是符合佛法的教义，不管他们这样做是不是为了缅甸人民的利益着想。
en: We want to tell the people who are violent towards their own countrymen to stop and think whether their actions are in accordance with the dharma, whether they are acting for the good of Burma’s people.

zh: 一些接到命令要殴打我们并且阻止我们游行的士兵最后拒绝按令行动，因为他们理解我们这样做的原因。
en: Some of the soldiers who were ordered to beat us and to stop us from marching actually refused to do so, because they understood the truth of what we were doing.

zh: 我们希望为军方领导人开创一条出路，一条与人民的领导人和族群领导人展开真正的对话以及实现民族团结的路子。
en: We hoped to create a way out for the military leaders, a way to start a real dialogue with the people’s leaders and the leaders of ethnic groups, for the unity of the nation.

zh: 但是这种希望很快就破灭了。
en: But that hope was short-lived.

zh: 军人统治集团现在正在到处搜捕参与游行示威的人，并且正在进行着可怕的残忍镇压。
en: The regime is now hunting down those who participated in the demonstrations and committing unspeakable acts of violence.

zh: 他们袭击了寺庙，蛮横地拘捕和尚和尼姑。
en: They have attacked monasteries and arrested monks and nuns by force.

zh: 到处都是卫兵，所有的大街上，寺庙的宝塔和居民区的四周，他们无处不在。
en: Guards are everywhere, on all the streets, around the pagodas and residential areas.

zh: 有传言说受伤的示威者被集体活埋，而有人亲眼看见仰光附近水道的岸边漂着许多尸体。
en: Wounded demonstrators are reported to have been buried alive in mass graves, and there are confirmed reports of bodies washing ashore in the waterways near Yangon (Rangoon).

zh: 军人统治集团一面在残酷地对待缅甸的民众，一面却在对世界隐瞒它的暴行。
en: The regime is brutalizing the Burmese people, and lying to the world about its actions.

zh: 作为军方代表的觉山准将最近告诉联合国特使甘巴里说大街上的游行者是“冒牌的僧侣 ” 。
en: Brigadier General Kyaw Hsan, a representative of the military, recently told UN Special Envoy Ibrahim Gambari that the marchers in the streets were “bogus monks.”

zh: 但事实是我们是真正的僧侣，并且数千名来自仰光、曼德勒、白古、阿拉干、马圭和实皆为了和平而参加游行示威的人都是真正的僧侣。
en: But we are genuine, and thousands of us – from Rangoon, Mandalay, Pegu, Arakan, Magwe, and Sagaing – demonstrated for peace.

zh: 有些人说缅甸的起义结束了。
en: Some have said that the uprising in Burma is over.

zh: 那正是军人集团想让世界产生的想法。
en: That is what the junta wants the world to think.

zh: 但是我们相信抗议活动代表了在我们国家军人统治终结的开始。
en: But we believe that the protests represent the beginning of the end of military rule in our country.

zh: 那些下令进行镇压的将军们不仅仅是是袭击了缅甸人民，同时了袭击了他们自己的心、灵魂还有精神信仰。
en: The generals who ordered the crackdown are assaulting not only Burma’s people, but also their own hearts, souls, and spiritual beliefs.

zh: 僧侣是佛法的守护者；袭击他们，将军们就是在袭击佛教本身。
en: The monks are the preservers of dharma; by attacking them, the generals attack Buddhism itself.

zh: 我们知道国际社会正在努力帮助我们，但是我们需要更有效的帮助。
en: We know that the international community is trying to help us, but we need that help to be more effective.

zh: 我们非常感谢许多帮助重新获得我们失去了40多年的权利的人和组���。
en: We thank the many people and organizations abroad who are helping us regain the rights denied to us for more than 40 years.

zh: 但是我们也要呼吁国际社会采取更实际和有效的行动。
en: But we also appeal to the international community to make its actions practical and effective.

zh: 军政府为了维护权力会干出任何事，他们的暴行必须让全世界都知道。
en: The military government will do anything to remain in power, and their violent acts must be exposed to the world.

zh: 他们也许可以控制街道和寺庙，但是他们永远无法控制我们的心和我们的决心。
en: They may control the streets and monasteries, but they will never be able to control our hearts and our determination.

zh: 押宝在反乌托邦上
en: Betting on Dystopia

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 随着比特币价格从一年前的峰值一路下跌80 ％ ， 以及更范围的加密货币市场出现系统性崩溃 ， “ 峰值高潮”是否已成明日黄花？
en: CAMBRIDGE – With the price of Bitcoin down 80% from its peak a year ago, and the larger cryptocurrency market in systemic collapse, has “peak crypto” already come and gone?

zh: 事情或许如此，但暂时还不要指望看到真正的信徒们排队去洗掉自己的加密货币纹身。
en: Perhaps, but don’t expect to see true believers lining up to have their cryptocurrency tattoos removed just yet.

zh: 在我参加的最近一次会议上，占主导性的情绪依然认为加密货币的市值将在未来五年进一步爆发至5~10万亿美元。
en: At a recent conference I attended, the overwhelming sentiment was that market capitalization of cryptocurrencies is still set to explode over the next five years, rising to $5-10 trillion.

zh: 对于那些看着比特币价格从2012年12月的13美元走到今天大概4000美元的人来说，面对今年从2万美元跌下来这一波也是无须恐慌的。
en: For those who watched the price of Bitcoin go from $13 in December 2012 to roughly $4,000 today, this year’s drop from $20,000 is no reason to panic.

zh: 人们很有可能会说“价格崩溃显然不是无缘无故的。
en: It is tempting to say, “Of course the price is collapsing.”

zh: ”监管机构正逐渐意识到他们无法容忍这类有利于逃税和犯罪活动但追查代价极为高昂的交易科技大量存在。
en: Regulators are gradually waking up to the fact that they cannot countenance large expensive-to-trace transaction technologies that facilitate tax evasion and criminal activity.

zh: 与此同时，从瑞典到中国的央行都纷纷意识到自己也可以发行数字货币。
en: At the same time, central banks from Sweden to China are realizing that they, too, can issue digital currencies.

zh: 正如我在2016年出版的那本介绍货币历史，现在和未来的书中所强调的那样，当涉及到新形式的货币时，创新工作可能会由私营部门来完成，但政府会在适当的时候会对其进行监管并据为己有。
en: As I emphasized in my 2016 book on the past, present, and future of currency, when it comes to new forms of money, the private sector may innovate, but in due time the government regulates and appropriates.

zh: 但正如我当时也指出的那样，仅仅因为比特币的长期价值更可能变成100美元而非10万美元并不一定意味着它的价值应当归零。
en: But as I also pointed out back then, just because the long-term value of Bitcoin is more likely to be $100 than $100,000 does not necessarily mean that it definitely should be worth zero.

zh: 对加密货币的正确认识应该是将其视为能在一个反乌托邦的未来中给予你回报的彩票，比如在那些流氓和失败国家或是公民已经失去所有隐私的国家内使用。
en: The right way to think about cryptocurrency coins is as lottery tickets that pay off in a dystopian future where they are used in rogue and failed states, or perhaps in countries where citizens have already lost all semblance of privacy.

zh: 在此看来陷入混乱的委内瑞拉成为第一个国家背书加密货币 （ “ Petro ” ） 的发行者绝非巧合。
en: It is no coincidence that dysfunctional Venezuela is the first issuer of a state-backed cryptocurrency (the “Petro”).

zh: 而所有加密货币面临的最终障碍在于必须找到一种方法来购买除非法药物和黑帮打手之外的一系列商品和服务。
en: The ultimate obstacle for any cryptocurrency is that eventually there has to be a way to buy a range of goods and services beyond illicit drugs and hit men.

zh: 如果政府认定在零售商店和银行使用加密货币是非法的，那么它们的价值必将最终崩溃。
en: And if governments ever make it illegal to use coins in retail stores and banks, their value must ultimately collapse.

zh: 许多加密货币鼓吹者坚持认为比特币是“数字黄金 ” ， 部分原因在于其算法已经将其长期供应上限定在了2100万。
en: Many crypto-evangelists insist that Bitcoin is “digital gold,” in part because the long-term supply is algorithmically capped at 21 million.

zh: 但这个说法有点不着边际：首先，黄金一直有着其他用途，当前也被广泛应用于从iPhone手机到航天器的各类新技术上，而比特币则缺乏其他用途。
en: But this is nutty. For one thing, unlike gold – which has always had other purposes and today is employed widely in new technologies from iPhones to spacecraft – Bitcoin has no alternative use.

zh: 即使比特币业者能成功降低进行验证交易的巨大能源成本，其去中心化分类账系统的本质也使其效率远远低于那些拥有像央行这类受信任核心运作方的系统。
en: And even if Bitcoiners manage to find a way to lower the phenomenal energy cost of verifying transactions, the very nature of decentralized ledger systems makes them vastly less efficient than systems with a trusted central party like a central bank.

zh: 如果没有了近乎匿名的特点就无人问津；保持匿名又会成为发达国家政府的眼中钉。
en: Take away near-anonymity and no one will want to use it; keep it and advanced-economy governments will not tolerate it.

zh: 而那些鼓吹者却对上述忧虑不以为然：他们觉得只要还有足够多的人将其视为数字黄金，那么比特币仍会具备极高的价值。
en: The evangelists dismiss such concerns: Bitcoin can still be incredibly valuable as long as enough people perceive it as digital gold.

zh: 毕竟金钱在他们眼中是一种社会约定。
en: After all, they argue, money is a social convention.

zh: 但在过去五十年来一直研究这类问题的经济学家们（包括我）发现，围绕一些本质上毫无价值的资产的价格泡沫最终一定会爆破。
en: But economists (including me) who have worked on this kind of problem for five decades have found that price bubbles surrounding intrinsically worthless assets must eventually burst.

zh: 具备真正潜在价值的资产价格也不会随意偏离历史基准。
en: The prices of assets that do have real underlying value cannot deviate arbitrarily far from historical benchmarks.

zh: 政府发行的货币几乎不能算是种纯粹的社会约定；政府向雇员和供应商付款以及收税都必须以法定货币来进行。
en: And government-issued money is hardly a pure social convention; governments pay employees and suppliers, and demand tax payments in fiat currency.

zh: 但现在谈论新的数字货币世界将如何展现还为时尚早。
en: But it is too soon to say how the new world of digital currencies will play out.

zh: 中央银行即将入局（它们手里的储备已经是某种形式的批发数字货币 ） ， 但这还不是故事的结尾。
en: Central banks will get into the game (their reserves are already a form of wholesale digital currency), but that is not the end of the story.

zh: 例如，美国财政部下属的US Treasury Direct系统已经为零售客户提供了一种以极低成本来持有极短期国债的手段，持有金额低至100美元,还可以交易给系统中的其他人。
en: US Treasury Direct, for example, already offers retail customers an extremely low-cost way to hold very short-term Treasury debt for amounts as little as $100, tradable to others in the system.

zh: 然而层层密布的安全关卡使得这一系统使用起来相对麻烦，政府也可能会采用当今的私营数字技术。
en: Still, heavy security makes the system relatively cumbersome to use, and just maybe governments might adopt one of today’s private digital technologies.

zh: 眼下真正的问题在于全球监管是否以及何时会取缔掉那些政府追踪和监控起来耗费极大的私人搭建系统。
en: For the moment, the real question is if and when global regulation will stamp out privately constructed systems that are expensive for governments to trace and monitor.

zh: 任何愚蠢到试图接受加密货币的大型先进经济体都有可能成为洗钱的全球目的地，正如日本去年所做的那样 — — 该国随后与加密货币保持距离的举动可能是今年j价格大幅波动的原因之一。
en: Any single large advanced economy foolish enough to try to embrace cryptocurrencies, as Japan did last year, risks becoming a global destination for money-laundering. (Japan’s subsequent moves to distance itself from cryptocurrencies were perhaps one cause of this year’s gyrations.)

zh: 最终发达经济体必将在加密货币监管上进行协调，就跟它们采取其他措施来防止洗钱和逃税那样。
en: In the end, advanced economies will surely coordinate on cryptocurrency regulation, as they have on other measures to prevent money laundering and tax evasion.

zh: 但可要这让很多心怀不满的参与者失望了。
en: But that leaves out a lot of disgruntled players.

zh: 毕竟当前有许多国家 — — 包括古巴、伊朗、利比亚、朝鲜、索马里，叙利亚和俄罗斯 — — 都在美国的金融制裁下苦苦挣扎。
en: After all, many today – including Cuba, Iran, Libya, North Korea, Somalia, Syria, and Russia – are laboring under United States financial sanctions.

zh: 他们的政府可不一定关心什么全球外部性，只要那些加密货币能具备一些价值且可以被用于某处就行了。
en: Their governments will not necessarily care about global externalities if they encourage cryptocurrencies that might have value as long as they are used somewhere.

zh: 因此，虽然我们不应对今年的加密货币价格暴跌感到惊讶，但这些货币的价格不一定为零。
en: So, while we shouldn’t be surprised by this year’s cryptocurrency price bust, the price of these coins is not necessarily zero.

zh: 它们跟彩票一样很可能一文不值。
en: Like lottery tickets, there is a high probability that they are worthless.

zh: 但出于某些当前很难预料到的原因，它们可能在某天变得极为值钱，纵使这个可能性微乎其微。
en: There is also an extremely small outside chance that they will be worth a great deal someday, for reasons that currently are difficult to anticipate.

zh: 破坏独裁者
en: Disrupting the Autocrats

zh: 华盛顿—人们曾经广泛相信，互联网的黎明预示着民主的新时代。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The dawn of the Internet, it was widely believed, would herald a new era of democracy.

zh: 一切信息都将变得自由，而这对于基于控制知识的体制来说将构成生存威胁，包括那些原先试图将自己与外部世界隔绝的体制。
en: Information would become free, in all senses, and this would pose an existential threat to regimes based on the control of knowledge, including those that had previously tried to close themselves off from the outside world.

zh: 如今，这一愿景黯然无光，甚至缺陷重重。
en: Today, this vision looks tarnished, if not deeply flawed.

zh: 极权统治者不但学会了如何在本国社会中扭曲和控制信息流，还学会了如何混淆他国人民的视听，甚至破坏此前运转良好的民主。
en: Authoritarian rulers have figured out not only how to distort and control the flow of information within their own societies, but also how to confuse people in other countries and perhaps even disrupt previously well-functioning democracies.

zh: 最近出现的社交媒体似乎稍稍干扰了一下极权主义者 — — 还记得阿拉伯之春吗？ — — 但毫无疑问，如今一切照进。
en: The more recent advent of social media may have disturbed the authoritarians slightly – remember the Arab Spring? – but there is no doubt that they have now regained their stride.

zh: 在几乎每一个地方，独裁者的权力都变得更加安全，往往还掩盖着民主和选举的外衣。
en: In almost all parts of the world, autocrats are becoming more secure in power, often behind a veneer of democracy and elections.

zh: 反对派被清除。
en: Opponents are eliminated.

zh: 媒体被封口。
en: The press is muzzled.

zh: 信息流被严格控制，通过传统的体制支持的媒体阻止和更加现代的软件或自动“机器人”实现。
en: And the flow of information is strictly controlled, through tools ranging from traditional regime-sponsored media outlets to more modern software or automated “bots.”

zh: 据最新《经济学人 》 （ Economist）民主指数，世界上一半的国家2017年比2016年更不民主，而只有5%的世界人口生活在“完全的民主”中。
en: According to the most recent Economist index of democracy, half the countries in the world were less democratic in 2017 than in 2016, and only 5% of the world’s population lives in a “full democracy.”

zh: 现在，一种新的数字技术到来了：加密货币。
en: Now a new digital technology has arrived: cryptocurrency.

zh: 对于这一树立和改变价值的方法如何影响银行系统，人们在激烈地讨论，但其在全球范围内影响政治的潜力基本被忽视了。
en: And while there is a great deal of discussion about how this approach to establishing and transferring value might affect banking systems, its potential impact on politics around the world has been largely overlooked.

zh: 加密货币 — — 如比特币、以太坊和它们的诸多竞争对手 — — 显然与互联网技术有关，但有一个简单又深远的区别。
en: Cryptocurrencies – such as bitcoin, ethereum, and their many competitors – are obviously related to Internet technology, but there is a simple and profound difference.

zh: 互联网可以获得各种形式的信息，而不需要最终收敛到一个观点。
en: The Internet is about accessing information in its many forms, with no need to converge on a single view.

zh: 事实上，互联网天然会让你获得多样化的观点，你必须靠自己来分辨哪些信息正确、谁在为了恶毒的独裁扭曲事实。
en: In fact, the Internet is inherently about giving you access to diverse opinions, at which point you are on your own in terms of figuring out what is accurate and who is distorting truth in the service of some malevolent dictatorship.

zh: 相反，加密货币只有在（同一加密系统内的）所有人就谁昨天持有一个价值单位、今天又转移给谁的问题达成一致的情况下才能起作用。
en: By contrast, cryptocurrencies work only if everyone (within that crypto system) agrees on who held a unit of value yesterday and to whom it was transferred today.

zh: 你可以试图扭曲这一信息，或直接入侵人们的电脑或破坏注册交易的算法 — — 这样的攻击随时都在发生。
en: You can try to distort this information or to hack into people’s computers directly or to disrupt the algorithm that registers transactions – and such attacks are happening all the time.

zh: 但由于加密货币之间在安全性和用途方面竞争激烈，因此我们大可以假设其中最强大的一种能够生存下来。
en: Given competition between cryptocurrencies with regard to their security and usefulness, however, it seems reasonable to suppose that the strongest will survive.

zh: 加密货币的价值在于去中心化（decentralized）管理的数字记录。
en: The value of a cryptocurrency consists in a digital record managed in a decentralized manner.

zh: 记录存在于网络内的大量节点（node）上，因此能够抵御中央控制或“审查 ” — —加密货币创造者、交易者和观察者经常使用这个词，原因正是他们都关心选择性修改记录的问题。
en: The record exists on many nodes within the network, making it resistant to central control or “censorship” – a term used frequently by cryptocurrencies’ founders, traders, and observers, precisely because so many of them are concerned about selective alteration of records.

zh: 不难看出为何极权体制想要阻止人民接触有可能不可追踪的安全的数字记录。
en: It is not difficult to see why an authoritarian regime would want to prevent its people from having access to potentially untraceable, secure digital records.

zh: 首先，接触到这些记录后，公民就能绕过银行系统和内嵌在其中的监控实现支付和赞助。
en: For starters, with access to such records, a citizen could make payments or donations that bypass the banking system and its embedded surveillance.

zh: 限制政治组织的规则能够轻易规避。
en: Rules that restrict political organization would become easier to defy.

zh: 此外，同样种类的记录可用于储存和传递其他信息。
en: Moreover, the same kinds of records could be used to store and transmit other information.

zh: 比如，我的一些同事正在开发一套供用户储存和管理自己的健康记录的系统。
en: For example, some of my colleagues are developing a system that would enable users to store and manage their own health records.

zh: 为何不围绕怨恨和反对体制来构造类似的系统？
en: Why not create a similar system structured around grievances about or protests against the regime?

zh: 而才干之士撰写所谓的智能合同的能力也没有极限。 智能合同根据特定事件的发生来触发支付或其他数字交易（如发送抗议消息 ） 。
en: And there is potentially no limit to how ingenious people can become with regard to writing so-called smart contracts, which will trigger payments or other digital transactions (like sending protest messages) when particular events occur.

zh: 对全世界的活动家来说，唯一的束缚是他们的创造力。
en: For activists around the world, the only constraint is their creativity.

zh: 当然，极权体制已经对危险有所警觉 — — 我们应该预见到他们会用各种严苛的做法剥夺持有加密货币的权利。
en: Of course, authoritarian regimes are already waking up to the dangers – and we should expect them to proscribe holding cryptocurrencies in various draconian ways.

zh: 毫无疑问，他们会开发新工具，试图追踪公民在这方面做了什么。
en: And no doubt they will develop new tools that attempt to track what their citizens do in this regard.

zh: 这将是一场有趣的创新军备竞赛 — — 极权体制很难获胜，因为基础技术（即区块链）是为了规避或避免权力中央化而设计的。
en: This will be an interesting innovation arms race – and one that will be hard for authoritarian regimes to win, given that the underlying technology, known as blockchain, was designed to circumvent or avoid the need for centralized power.

zh: 组织良好的民主国家对于加密货币没什么好怕的。
en: Well-organized democracies have little to fear from cryptocurrencies.

zh: 也许会有一些欺诈 — — 投资者也应该时刻对不完全透明的新奇产品保持警觉。
en: There may be some scams – and investors should always beware of newfangled products that are not completely transparent.

zh: 但在大部分情况下，我们会感受到现有支付方式面临新形式的竞争压力。
en: But mostly we will get new forms of competitive pressure on existing means of making payments.

zh: 一切降低信用卡费、扩大金融包容的东西都应该受到欢迎。
en: Anything that brings down credit card fees and broadens financial inclusion should be welcome.

zh: 相反，政治权力基于控制信息的人肯定会感到新的担忧。
en: By contrast, people whose political power is based on controlling information definitely have something new to worry about.

zh: 极权体制永远会以某种形式存在于许多地方。
en: Authoritarian regimes will always be with us in some form and in many places.

zh: 但如果现在形势朝着有利于偏好更开放的系统和更激烈的有意义的政治竞争的人的方向发展，我们也不必感到惊奇。
en: But it would not be a surprise if the pendulum now starts to swing back in favor of those who would prefer more open systems and a greater degree of meaningful political competition.

zh: 为什么要重新发明货币之轮？
en: Why Reinvent the Monetary Wheel?

zh: 伦敦—崩溃永远是货币实验的兴旺时期，2008—2009年的经济崩盘也不例外。
en: LONDON – Slumps have always been boom times for monetary experiments, and the economic collapse of 2008-2009 was no different.

zh: 货币实验再度兴起的背后是直觉：经济灾难必有货币原因，因此也必有货币解决方案。
en: Underlying this recurrence is the instinctive feeling that economic calamities must have monetary causes, and therefore monetary remedies.

zh: 要么钱太多了，从而引起通胀，要么钱太少了，从而引起萧条。
en: There is either too much money, which causes inflation, or too little, which leads to depression.

zh: 因此，货币改革者的目标 — — 他们中间有大量的庸人和怪人 — — 是“保持货币有序 ” ， 避免货币波动干扰生产和贸易等“实体”经济。
en: So the aim of monetary reformers –among whom are always a large number of quacks and cranks – has been to “keep money in order” and prevent its gyrations from disturbing the “real” economy of production and trade.

zh: 货币改革的进一步动机是对现有秩序大动干戈。
en: A further motive for monetary reform has been to head off more drastic surgery to the established order.

zh: 如果货币波动是经济波动的主因，并且你可以保证正确数量的货币支持正常的商业活动，那么就没有必要进行政府干预。
en: If monetary fluctuations are the main cause of economic fluctuations, and if one can ensure the right quantity of money to support normal business activity, there will be no need for government interference.

zh: 这就是笃信自由市场的经济学家的主要教训。
en: This has been the main teaching of economists wedded to free markets.

zh: 很少有人记得量化宽松（QE）标志着美国总统罗斯福新政的开端。
en: Few remember that quantitative easing (QE) marked the start of US President Franklin D. Roosevelt’s New Deal.

zh: 由于美国实行金本位，财政部收购黄金抬高其价格，进而扩张负债累累的农民的购买力。
en: With the US on the gold standard, the Treasury purchased gold to lift its price and thus augment the buying power of heavily indebted farmers.

zh: 罗斯福的黄金收购狂欢 — — 当时凯恩斯称之为“酒桌金本位 ” — —被认为总体无效。
