en: FDR’s gold-buying spree, described at the time by John Maynard Keynes as “the gold standard on the booze,” has been generally dismissed as ineffective.

zh: 但为了抵御2008年崩盘，美联储的货币主义主席本·伯南克（Ben Bernanke）和其他央行行长通过大规模收购政府证券复活了它。
en: But, to counter the collapse of 2008, the monetarist chairman of the US Federal Reserve, Ben Bernanke, and other central bankers revived it in the form of massive purchases of government securities.

zh: “非常规货币政策 ” — —凯恩斯肯定会称之为“酒桌上的央行 ” — —是默认的复苏机制。
en: “Unconventional monetary policy” – Keynes surely would have called it “central banking on the booze” – was the default recovery mechanism.

zh: 尽管大部分新钱被囤积起来或用于投机，但QE仍然成功地挡住了扩张性财政政策的呼声。
en: Although most of the new money was hoarded or used for speculation, QE succeeded in fending off the call for expansionary fiscal policy.

zh: 在两次崩溃中，银行改革的呼声也很高。
en: Banking reform was also vigorously promoted in the wake of both slumps.

zh: 1933年，美国格拉斯-斯蒂格尔法（Glass-Steagall Act）禁止商业银行用客户存款进行自营投机活动。
en: In 1933, the US Glass-Steagall Act stopped commercial bank proprietors from speculating with their customers’ deposits.

zh: 2009年后，美国多德-弗兰克（Dodd Frank）立法、英国威克斯报告（Vickers Report）和欧盟利卡宁报告（Liikanen report）也都着眼于要让银行体系具备更大的“冲击恢复力 ” 。
en: After 2009, the US Dodd-Frank legislation, the Vickers Report in the United Kingdom, and the European Union’s Liikanen report similarly aimed to make the banking system more “resilient” to “shocks.”

zh: 尽管对银行的冲击是对经济的冲击的结果而非原因，但人们对这一点毫不在意：恢复货币和银行秩序，他们认为，就会让冲击停止。
en: Although the shocks to banking were the effect, not the cause, of shocks to the economy, this was ignored: Restore money and banking to order, the argument went, and shocks would stop.

zh: 加密货币 — — 最新的货币狂热大爆发 — — 的崛起也应该放在这一环境中去理解。
en: This is the context in which the rise of cryptocurrencies – the latest explosion of monetary mania – should be understood.

zh: 这些“点对点电子现金系统”旨在通过货币手段治愈经济痼疾，只是完全绕过了银行。
en: These “peer-to-peer electronic cash systems” aim to cure economic ills by monetary measures, but this time by bypassing banks altogether.

zh: 为什么我们需要这些不健全的中介，加密货币发明者问，如果我们能够创造电子存储和交易系统，确保用户安全和潜在控制着不可见的话？
en: Why do we need these diseased intermediaries, cryptocurrencies’ inventors ask, when we can create electronic storage and transaction systems, secure to their users and invisible to would-be controllers?

zh: 这些新现金生成系统的技术细节很难理解；但它们的灵感很容易理解。
en: The technical details of the new cash-generation systems are difficult to grasp; their inspiration is not.

zh: 2009年1月比特币的出现正逢银行危机。
en: The start of Bitcoin in January 2009 coincided with the banking crisis.

zh: 银行纷纷倒闭，在纳税人的拯救下免于破产。
en: Banks went bust or were rescued from insolvency by taxpayers.

zh: 不难理解，人们希望找到办法避免将自己的钱和货币交易让倒闭的银行和贪婪的税收机关经手。
en: Understandably people wanted to find a way to keep their money and monetary transactions out of the reach of failing banks and voracious tax authorities.

zh: 新加密货币提供了一个方案。
en: The new cryptocurrency offered a solution.

zh: 在比特币的吸引力背后是多重动机，不仅仅包括投机机会、贩毒和洗钱。
en: Many motives lay behind the appeal of Bitcoin, not least opportunities for speculation, drug trafficking, and money laundering.

zh: 但在这些肮脏背后是哈耶克的自由货币市场之梦。
en: But behind the more sordid motives lay Friedrich Hayek’s dream of a free market in money.

zh: 哈耶克在20世纪70年代中期通胀顶峰时期提出了私人发行竞争性货币的方案，他将原因归于央行创造了过多的信用。
en: Hayek introduced his proposal for privately issued competitive currencies at the height of the inflationary surge of the mid-1970s, which he attributed to excessive credit creation by central banks.

zh: “如果我们想让自由企业 … … 存活 ， ” 他说 ， “ 就别无选择，只能用自由竞争取代政府货币垄断和国家货币体系。
en: “If we want free enterprise…to survive,” he argued, “we have no choice but to replace the government currency monopoly and national currency systems by free competition.”

zh: ”政府无法被阻止发行劣币，哈耶克写道 ， “ 在供给良币方面，政府已经失败，必然失败，并将继续失败。
en: Government could not be stopped from making money go bad, Hayek wrote. “Government has failed, must fail, and will continue to fail to supply good money.”

zh: 比特币可视为用新技术阻止货币变坏的尝试。
en: Bitcoin can be seen as an attempt to use new technology to stop money from going bad.

zh: 比如，比特币的总供给是固定的，就像黄金支撑的货币（或多或少地）一样。
en: For example, the total supply of bitcoins is fixed, as it would be – more or less – for a gold-backed currency.

zh: 矛盾的是，尽管比特币是无中生有，却能杜绝“创造”的可能。
en: Paradoxically, although it is created out of nothing, it will offer no possibility of money “creation.”

zh: 比特币以递减的规模被“挖掘 ” ， 直到2040年耗尽，届时将会有2,100万个数字货币。
en: Bitcoin will be “mined” in diminishing quantities until it is exhausted in 2040, having delivered 21 million digital coins.

zh: 换句话说，这种货币没有弹性。
en: In other words, there is no elasticity in the currency.

zh: 这意味着在它耗尽前很久，就会遇到与金本位一样的问题：无法提供足够的货币支持增长的经济和人口。
en: This means that long before the mine is exhausted, the currency will run into the same problem as the gold standard: not providing enough money to support a growing economy and population.

zh: 如果出现囤积比特币的潮流的话，这一问题还会加剧。
en: This would be exacerbated by any tendency to hoard bitcoins.

zh: 与此同时，加密货币并不能提供通胀保护。
en: At the same time, cryptocurrencies provide no security against inflation.

zh: 哈耶克认为竞争性货币体系最终将导致最能保持币值的发行者的垄断。
en: Hayek thought that a competitive currency system would eventually lead to a monopoly of the one that kept its value best.

zh: 但在历史上，我们显然已经走过了这个淘汰通胀性货币的过程，最后的结果就是出现了中央银行。
en: But we have, of course, been through exactly this process of weeding out inflationary currencies throughout history, and we ended up with central banks.

zh: 很有意思的是，任何人都认为应该重新追溯这些步骤，但最终都会来到同一个地方。
en: It is amazing that anyone should consider it necessary to retrace these steps, only to end up in the same place.

zh: 事实上，除了依靠央行行使货币发行控制权、直接或间接控制商业银行体系所创造的信用量，人类社会尚未发现更好的办法能保持货币价值大体不变。
en: The fact is that human societies have discovered no better way to keep the value of money roughly constant than by relying on central banks to exercise control over its issue and to act directly or indirectly on the volume of credit created by the commercial banking system.

zh: 上一次危机的哈耶克主义诊断 — — 银行创造了过多的信用 — — 就其本身而言是正确的。
en: The Hayekian diagnosis of the last crisis – excessive creation of credit by the banks – is correct as far as it goes.

zh: 但我们必须要问为什么会发生这样的事，才能明白对于这个问题没有机械的回答或解决方案。
en: But one has only to ask why this happened to understand that there are no mechanical answers to the question or solutions to the problem.

zh: “看好经济，货币会自己照顾自己”的说法并不十分正确。
en: It’s not quite true to say, “Look after the economy and money will look after itself.”

zh: 但与货币改革本身能够治愈患病的经济的信念相比，它更接近于真理。
en: But it is nearer the truth than the belief that monetary reform on its own will cure the problems of a sick economy.

zh: 新型货币的古老魅力
en: The Old Allure of New Money

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 以2009年创设的比特币为开端的加密货币革命宣称自己正在发明一批新型货币。
en: NEW HAVEN – The cryptocurrency revolution, which started with bitcoin in 2009, claims to be inventing new kinds of money.

zh: 目前已有近2000种加密货币被创造出来，让全球数百万人兴奋不已。
en: There are now nearly 2,000 cryptocurrencies, and millions of people worldwide are excited by them.

zh: 那么这种热情究竟是什么原因造成的，为何迄今为止依然未被那些指责这是一场伪革命的警告所抵消呢？
en: What accounts for this enthusiasm, which so far remains undampened by warnings that the revolution is a sham?

zh: 首先要知道重新发明货币的尝试自古有之。
en: One must bear in mind that attempts to reinvent money have a long history.

zh: 正如社会学家薇薇安娜·扎丽泽（Viviana Zelizer）在其著作《金钱的社会意义》中所指出的那样 ： “ 尽管人们普遍认为‘一块钱就是一块钱，没什么好说的 ’ ， 但其实在世界各地人们都在不断创造不同类型的货币。
en: As the sociologist Viviana Zelizer points out in her book The Social Meaning of Money: “Despite the commonsense idea that ‘a dollar is a dollar is a dollar,’ everywhere we look people are constantly creating different kinds of money.”

zh: ”而许多创新至少在某一段时间内会激起一阵波澜。
en: Many of these innovations generate real excitement, at least for a while.

zh: 作为世界各地的交换媒介，货币的载体虽各不相同，却都同样充满着神秘感。
en: As the medium of exchange throughout the world, money, in its various embodiments, is rich in mystique.

zh: 我们倾向于通过它来衡量人们的价值。
en: We tend to measure people’s value by it. It sums things up like nothing else.

zh: 它似乎有着无穷的含义，却可能也只是围绕消费周期不断流转的纸片而已。
en: And yet it may consist of nothing more than pieces of paper that just go round and round in circles of spending.

zh: 所以货币的价值取决于人们对这些纸片的信念和信任，甚至可以称之为信仰。
en: So its value depends on belief and trust in those pieces of paper. One might call it faith.

zh: 建立一种新的货币可能被视为是一个社区群体对一种理念的信仰声明，以及激发其实现的努力。
en: Establishing a new kind of money may be seen as a community’s avowal of faith in an idea, and an effort to inspire its realization.

zh: 经济学家阿舒卡·莫迪（Ashoka Mody）著作《欧元悲剧：一出九幕剧》中指出，1992年创设欧洲单一货币的真正公共理由是一种“群体思维 ” ， 一种“根植于人们心灵”的信仰，认为“只要存在一个单一货币 … … 就能推动各国走向更加紧密的政治关系。 ”
en: In his book Euro Tragedy: A Drama in Nine Acts, the economist Ashoka Mody argues that the true public justification for creating the European currency in 1992 was a kind of “groupthink,” a faith “embedded in people’s psyches” that “the mere existence of a single currency…would create the impetus for countries to come together in closer political embrace.”

zh: 新的货币理念似乎与革命的范畴一致，也同样伴随着令人信服且通俗易懂的叙述。
en: New ideas for money seem to go with the territory of revolution, accompanied by a compelling, easily understood narrative.

zh: 1827年乔赛亚·沃尔纳（Josiah Warner）就曾开设过一间“辛辛那提时代商店 ” ， 用劳动时长为单位来为商品标价，使用类似纸币的“劳动券 ” 。
en: In 1827, Josiah Warner opened the “Cincinnati Time Store” that sold merchandise in units of hours of work, relying on “labor notes,” which resembled paper money.

zh: 这一新货币被视为是劳动人民重要性的证明，但商店在1830年就结业了。
en: The new money was seen as a testament to the importance of working people, until he closed the store in 1830.

zh: 两年后，时常被尊称为社会主义之父的罗伯特·欧文（Robert Owen）试图在伦敦建立全国劳动公平交易所，以劳动券或“时间钞”作为货币。
en: Two years later, Robert Owen, sometimes described as the father of socialism, attempted to establish in London the National Equitable Labour Exchange, relying on labor notes, or “time money,” as currency.

zh: 在这里，用时间而不是黄金白银作为价值尺度提升了劳动的重要性。
en: Here, too, using time instead of gold or silver as a standard of value enforced the notion of the primacy of labor.

zh: 但跟沃尔纳的时代商店一样，欧文的实验失败了。
en: But, like Warner’s time store, Owen’s experiment failed.

zh: 同样，马克思和恩格斯也提出共产主义的核心前提 — — “废除私有制 ” — —将伴随着“共产主义消灭买卖 ” 。
en: Likewise,Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels proposed that the central Communist premise – “Abolition of private property” – would be accompanied by a “Communistic abolition of buying and selling.”

zh: 然而消除金钱是不可能的，也没有一个共产主义国家这样做过。
en: Eliminating money, however, was impossible to do, and no Communist state ever did so.

zh: 相反，正如大英博物馆最近的“共产主义货币”主题展览所展现的那样，它们发行了许多带有生动的劳工阶层象征的纸币。
en: Instead, as the British Museum’s recent exhibit, “The Currency of Communism,” showed, they issued paper money with vivid symbols of the working class on it.

zh: 它们必须在货币上搞点不一样的东西。
en: They had to do something different with money.

zh: 在1930年代的大萧条期间，与哥伦比亚大学联动的一场名为“专家治国”的激进运动提出用一个名为“erg”的能量标尺来取代金本位的美元。
en: During the Great Depression of the 1930s, a radical movement, called Technocracy, associated with Columbia University, proposed to replace the gold-backed dollar with a measure of energy, the erg.

zh: 在他们以“弗兰克·阿克莱特（Frank Arkright ） ” 为笔名发表的《什么是专家治国》一书中，他们提出了将经济“构建在能量基础之上”来解决失业问题的观点。
en: In their book The A B C of Technocracy, published under the pseudonym Frank Arkright, they advanced the idea that putting the economy “on an energy basis” would overcome the unemployment problem.

zh: 然而在顶尖科学家揭穿了这一理念在技术上站不住脚的地方之后，这场专家治国的热潮就很快平息了。
en: The Technocracy fad proved to be short-lived, though, after top scientists debunked the idea’s technical pretensions.

zh: 但是用先进科学概念包装一个不成熟想法的努力并未停止。
en: But the effort to dress up a half-baked idea in advanced science didn’t stop there.

zh: 与专家治国运动同时期的1932年，经济学家约翰·皮斯·诺顿（John Pease Norton）在计量经济学学会发表讲话时提出了建立一个并非金本位而是电力本位的美元。
en: Parallel with Technocracy, in 1932 the economist John Pease Norton, addressing the Econometric Society, proposed a dollar backed not by gold but by electricity.

zh: 但尽管诺顿的电力美元受到了极大关注，他仍然缺乏充分的理由选择电力来代替其他商品支撑美元。
en: But while Norton’s electric dollar received substantial attention, he had no good reason for choosing electricity over other commodities to back the dollar.

zh: 在大多数发达国家家庭刚刚实现通电，从无线电到冰箱等电子设备进入家庭的时候，电力激发了最为迷人的高科技想象。
en: At a time when most households in advanced countries had only recently been electrified, and electric devices from radios to refrigerators had entered homes, electricity evoked images of the most glamorous high science.

zh: 但是像专家治国一样，这种披上科学大衣的做法却最终适得其反。
en: But, like Technocracy, the attempt to co-opt science backfired.

zh: 报纸专栏作家哈里·I·菲利普斯（Harry I. Phillips）在1933年的一篇评论中将电力美元视为喜剧笑料 ： “ 一想到在所得税申报表上写明向政府发送300伏电压就觉得很好笑。
en: Syndicated columnist Harry I. Phillips in 1933 saw in the electric dollar only fodder for comedy. “But it would be good fun getting an income tax blank and sending the government 300 volts,” he noted.

zh: 现在我们又有了一些新的东西：比特币以及催生了代币发行（Initial Coin Offering）活动的其他加密货币。
en: Now we have something new again: bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies, which have spawned the initial coin offering (ICO).

zh: 这些加密货币的发行者声称代币发行可以免于证券监管，因为它们不涉及任何常规货币，也不赋予任何利润所有权。
en: Issuers claim that ICOs are exempt from securities regulation, because they do not involve conventional money or confer ownership of profits.

zh: 投资代币发行被认为是一种全新的理念。
en: Investing in an ICO is thought of as an entirely new inspiration.

zh: 这些货币创新中的每一项都有独特的技术故事。
en: Each of these monetary innovations has been coupled with a unique technological story.

zh: 但更根本的是，所有这些都与对社会革命的某种深刻的渴望有关。
en: But, more fundamentally, all are connected with a deep yearning for some kind of revolution in society.

zh: 加密货币是一项信仰声明，一批富有企业家精神的世界公民将自己置于国家政府之上，而后者则被他们视为长期不平等和战争的驱动因素。
en: The cryptocurrencies are a statement of faith in a new community of entrepreneurial cosmopolitans who hold themselves above national governments, which are viewed as the drivers of a long train of inequality and war.

zh: 而跟过去一样，公众对加密货币的迷恋与某种神秘感联系在了一起，正如货币本身的价值之谜一样，依附于新型货币与高等科学技术之间的联系之上。
en: And, as in the past, the public’s fascination with cryptocurrencies is tied to a sort of mystery, like the mystery of the value of money itself, consisting in the new money’s connection to advanced science.

zh: 实际上，除计算机科学界外，没有人可以解释加密货币的工作原理。
en: Practically no one, outside of computer science departments, can explain how cryptocurrencies work.

zh: 这种神秘感创造了一种排他性的光环，赋予了新型货币一种魅力，让那些崇拜者们充满了革命般的狂热。
en: That mystery creates an aura of exclusivity, gives the new money glamour, and fills devotees with revolutionary zeal.

zh: 这些都不是什么新鲜事，而就跟与过去的那些货币创新一样，一个引人入胜的故事可能还不足以实现成功。
en: None of this is new, and, as with past monetary innovations, a compelling story may not be enough.

zh: 新生儿的啼哭
en: Cry, the Newborn Baby

zh: 每年，4百万婴儿在出生后4周内死亡，也就是每天死亡超过1万人。
en: Each year, four million babies die in their first four weeks of life – over 10,000 deaths a day.

zh: 大多数新生儿死亡根本不予登记，除了对他们的家庭外，不为人所知。
en: Most of these neonatal deaths go unrecorded and remain invisible to all but their families.

zh: 几乎所有的（99 ％ ） 的死亡发生在中低收入国家，但是，大部分研究和资助却集中于发生在富国的1％的死亡率的高科技护理之上。
en: Virtually all (99%) occur in low- and middle-income countries, but most research and funding focuses on high-tech care for the 1% of deaths occurring in rich countries.

zh: 死亡的最大危险发生在生命开始阶段：四分之三的新生儿（三百万）在出生后一周内死亡，至少1百万的婴儿在出生后第一天死亡，许多人是死在家里，没有正规的医疗护理。
en: The greatest risk of death is at the beginning of life: three-quarters of all neonatal deaths (three million) occur within one week of birth, and at least one million babies die on their first day of life, many at home without any formal healthcare.

zh: 而且，几乎40％的儿童死亡发生在新生儿阶段，非洲和南亚占总数的三分之二。
en: Moreover, almost 40% of all child deaths occur in the neonatal period, with Africa and South Asia accounting for two-thirds of the total.

zh: 不幸的是，发展中国家的儿童存活项目大多集中在出生一个月后发生的肺炎、痢疾、疟疾以及可以通过疫苗防治的死亡原因上，而安全母婴项目大多集中于母亲身上。
en: Unfortunately, child survival programs in the developing world have focused primarily on pneumonia, diarrhea, malaria, and vaccine-preventable causes of deaths after the first month of life, while safe motherhood programs have focused primarily on the mother.

zh: 防治新生儿死亡因此就只能位居母亲和稍大一点的儿童之后了。
en: Prevention of newborn deaths has thus dropped between the cracks of programs focusing on mothers and on older children.

zh: 这是一个巨大的、可以避免的悲剧。
en: This represents a tragedy that is as avoidable as it is immense.

zh: 英国科学杂志柳叶刀最近对新生儿死亡问题的系列文章估计，如果在最需要的地方有效地采取简单的防治措施，就可以防止41％到72％的新生儿死亡。
en: A recent series on neonatal issues in the British science journal Lancet estimated that between 41% and 72% of neonatal deaths could be prevented if simple interventions were provided effectively where they are needed most.

zh: 换言之，每年有3百万婴儿不必死亡。
en: In other words, up to three million babies needlessly die each year.

zh: 众所周知的、低成本以及低科技含量的防治手段，例如破伤风疫苗、专门母乳、低体重婴儿的简单护理以及防止传染的抗生素等并没有提供给那些最需要得到的孩子。
en: Well known, low-cost, and low-tech interventions do not reach those most in need – for example immunization against tetanus, exclusive breastfeeding, simple care for low-weight babies, and antibiotics for infection.

zh: 这些防治手段极为低廉有效, 而且，把这些手段组合在一起并把它们同其他保健措施结合起来可以进一步降低成本。
en: Such interventions are extremely cost-effective, and packaging these interventions together and linking them with other health programs reduces costs further.

zh: 挽救性命要求在最大危险之时赶到死亡率最高的国家的母婴。
en: Saving lives requires that mothers and babies in the highest-mortality countries be reached at the time of greatest risk.

zh: 目前，全世界大约只有一半的妇女生产时有高技能的助产师在场。
en: Currently, only about half of all women worldwide deliver with a skilled attendant present.

zh: 在撒哈拉以南的非洲，不到40％的妇女生产时具有高技能护理；在南非，这个数字低于30 ％ 。
en: In sub-Saharan Africa, less than 40% of women deliver with skilled care; in South Asia, the figure is less than 30%.

zh: 拉丁美洲和南亚已经快速地提供了专业护理，但是，根据目前非洲的进步水平，在2015年的时候仍然有50％的妇女在生产时没有专业护理。
en: Latin America and Southeast Asia have rapidly increased coverage, but at the current rate of progress in Africa, 50% of women will still deliver without skilled care in the year 2015.

zh: 在埃塞俄比亚，最高收入人群中的妇女有四分之一在生产时使用专业护理，而最贫困妇女则只有1 ％ 。
en: In Ethiopia, a quarter of pregnant women in the highest income group use skilled care at delivery, compared to 1% of the poorest women.

zh: 低收入国家表明，快速改善是可能的。
en: Low-income countries have demonstrated that rapid progress is possible.

zh: 斯里兰卡、印度尼西亚、秘鲁和博茨瓦纳都已经在二十世纪九十年代把新生儿死亡率降低了一半。
en: Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Peru, and Botswana all halved neonatal mortality during the 1990s.

zh: 这些国家的成功依赖于在高阶层作出政治承诺，持续提供高质量的母婴和新生儿护理。
en: These countries’ success has depended on sustained high-level political commitment to providing high-quality maternal and newborn care.

zh: 综合规划十分关键。
en: In particular, integrated planning is essential.

zh: 在印度，新生儿保健是全国生育和儿童健康计划的组成部分。
en: In India, newborn health forms part of the national Reproductive and Child Health Program.

zh: 在埃塞俄比亚，新生儿护理被列入新的社区基础上的医疗规划之中。
en: In Ethiopia, newborn care is being incorporated into a new community-based healthcare program.

zh: 当然，没有什么“万能的”解决方案。
en: Of course, there is no “one-size-fits-all” solution.

zh: 新生儿死亡的数量和原因、医疗体系的能力、决策者和资源配置以及国家之间和国家内部不同地区之间面临的阻碍都迥然不同。
en: The numbers and causes of neonatal deaths, the capacity of the health system, and the obstacles faced differ between and within countries, as does support from policymakers and the availability of resources.

zh: 在75个死亡率最高的国家中维持90％的新生儿保健护理所需要的额外成本每年估计只有41亿美元。
en: The additional cost of maintaining essential newborn health interventions at 90% coverage in the 75 countries with the highest mortality is estimated to be a mere $4.1billion per year.

zh: 这个数额补充当前的20亿美元花费，而这20亿美元的仅仅30％专门用来新生儿的护理，而其中的大部分还用于母亲和稍微大一点的儿童。
en: This would supplement current spending of $2 billion, only about 30% of which is for interventions specifically aimed at newborns, while the majority is for interventions that also benefit mothers and older children.

zh: 即使是一个弱小的医疗体系仍然有可能大幅度降低死亡率。
en: Even with a weak health system, it is possible to achieve measurable mortality reduction.

zh: 仅仅由于没有原本是他们的基本权利的基本医疗护理，全世界每年有3百万婴儿死亡。 全世界需要现在行动起来，创造挽救这些婴儿的生命所需要的政治意愿和财政资源。
en: But the world needs to act now to generate the political will and financial resources needed to save the lives of up to three million babies who die each year simply because they are born without the basic care that is their right.

zh: 实际上，继续置处于危险境地的婴儿于不顾是对我们人类自身的荒谬的不人道的行为，因为我们完全知道，新生儿死亡完全是可以防止的大规模的人命毁灭。
en: Indeed, to continue to fail the world’s at-risk children is to deliver a verdict of wanton inhumanity against ourselves, for we are a knowing party to an entirely preventable mass destruction of human life.

zh: 秘鲁的自甘堕落
en: Peru’s Self-Sabotage

zh: 圣马科斯—你也许知道秘鲁是印加文明发源地。
en: SAN MARCOS – You may know Peru as the cradle of Incan civilization.

zh: 你也许尝过美味的秘鲁料理。
en: Or you may have tasted its outstanding cuisine.

zh: 但秘鲁人引以为豪的是另一件事：秘鲁是拉丁美洲增长最快的经济体之一，2014年第一季度 GDP同比增长了 4.8 % 。
en: But Peru boasts another impressive characteristic: it is among Latin America’s fastest-growing economies, with GDP up by 4.8% year on year in the first quarter of 2014.

zh: 但是，秘鲁的长期繁荣还面临着诸多不确定。
en: Peru’s long-term prosperity, however, is far from certain.

zh: 事实上，秘鲁的经济增长主要依靠原材料和碳氢化合物出口，已呈现出减速之势，过去三年年增长率高达5.5—6.9 % 。
en: In fact, Peru’s economic growth – which is based largely on exports of raw materials and hydrocarbons – is already slowing, from annual rates of 5.5-6.9% over the last three years.

zh: 此外，尽管政府认识到需要采取促增长的改革，但实施方针有误。
en: And, though the government recognizes the need for growth-enhancing reform, its approach is all wrong.

zh: 具体而言，总统奥良塔·胡马拉最近获得了立法批准，得以实施一系列“现实”程序削减阻碍采掘炼化行业投资的繁文缛节 — — 而秘鲁经济正需要降低对该行业的依赖。
en: Specifically, President Ollanta Humala recently won legislative approval of a set of “realistic” procedures to reduce the red tape perceived to be hampering investment in the extractive industries – the very industries on which the economy should become less dependent.

zh: 新法律严重削弱了秘鲁监管土地使用、规定环境质量标准以及通过环境影响评估制约公司的不当行为的能力。
en: The new law seriously weakens Peru’s ability to regulate land use, set environmental quality standards, and rein in corporate misconduct through environmental-impact assessments.

zh: 秘鲁政府现在面临着严重的问题。
en: The Peruvian government now has a serious problem.

zh: 新法律除了有损于秘鲁“气候冠军 ” （ climate champion）的国际声誉 — — 一些政府官员一直在努力树立这一形象 — — 还破坏了秘鲁的自然环境和经济增长前景。
en: Beyond diminishing Peru’s international credibility as a “climate champion” – an image that some members of the government have been attempting to cultivate – the law jeopardizes Peru’s natural environment and economic-growth prospects.

zh: 秘鲁政府不但没有做应做之事；还在积极地做不符合国家长期利益之事。
en: Peru’s government has not just failed to do what is needed; it has actively worked against its country’s long-term interests.

zh: 眼下，各国应该更严格地监管土地使用，而胡马拉的“改革”取消了划地限制。
en: At a time when countries should be regulating land use more strictly, Humala’s “reform” eliminates zoning restrictions.

zh: 此外，根据新法律，次级政府不再能够以环境原因限制投资 — — 在严格技术标准和高技能专家指导下做出决定。
en: Moreover, under the new law, subnational governments will no longer be able to limit investments on environmental grounds – decisions that were guided by strict technical standards and highly trained experts.

zh: 相反，将由国家当局 — — 即政治机构 — — 来做这件事。
en: Instead, a national authority – that is, a political body – will call the shots.

zh: 所有这些都会让秘鲁更容易受到公司行为不当导致的环境破坏的影响。
en: All of this makes Peru more vulnerable to corporate misconduct that results in environmental damage.

zh: 雪上加霜的是，新法律逆转了此前的立法，可能减轻违规者受到的刑罚，甚至可以缓期三年。
en: As if that were not enough, the new law, in a reversal of previous legislation, could lead to reduced sentences for offenders, and even allow them to operate with impunity for three years.

zh: 这对于对亚马逊雨林和太平洋大陆架之下丰富储量馋涎欲滴的矿业、石油和天然气公司来说是一个好消息。
en: This is good news for mining, oil, and gas companies eyeing rich reserves under the Amazon rain forest and the Pacific shelf.

zh: 但是，对本地社区而言，这不啻于开启了新的侵占、贫困和纷争之门；而对于全体秘鲁人来说，这会导致国家丧失走上更加可持续的发展之路的千载难逢的良机。
en: But, for indigenous communities, it will open a new chapter of dispossession, poverty, and strife; and, for all Peruvians, it amounts to a massive missed opportunity to put the country on a more sustainable development path.

zh: 问题不在于政府支持企业的政策；提振企业成长和发展的措施对于经济改革计划来说至关重要。
en: The problem is not the government’s efforts to support businesses; measures to bolster business growth and development would be critical to any economic-reform plan.

zh: 但放任环境记录拙劣的公司作业而不予惩罚决非解决办法。
en: But allowing companies with poor environmental records to operate with impunity is no solution.

zh: 一个国家，如其立法康公共利益之慨满足一小撮人的利益，它就无法实现长期包容性繁荣 — — 并且有可能出现社会动荡。
en: A country where legislation is tailor-made to benefit a few, at the expense of the public interest, cannot achieve long-term inclusive prosperity – and is likely to experience social instability.

zh: 新法律并非秘鲁政府所追求唯一的有问题政策。
en: The new law is not the only problematic policy that Peru’s government has pursued.

zh: 上个月，秘鲁国会批准削弱了政府的环境监督权，声称这能够将经济增长率提供1.5—3 % 。
en: Last month, the Congress also moved to weaken the government’s environmental oversight, claiming that this would add 1.5-3% to the economy’s growth rate.

zh: 政府在略长于两周的时间里就推动了这一立法，只是象征性地征求了公众意见，甚至连合理的公共辩论都没有时间进行。
en: The government pushed the proposal through in a little more than two weeks, with only token public consultation and no time for reasoned public debate.

zh: 公民社会团体、政治党派、联合国甚至一些企业利益集团都强烈反对该立法，因此政府的这一行为是难以理解和宽恕的。
en: Given strong opposition from civil-society groups, political parties, the United Nations, and even some business interests, the government’s behavior was both understandable and inexcusable.

zh: 事实上，100多家组织在该法律被批准前拒绝了它，呼吁提高环境标准和加强执法力度。
en: In fact, more than 100 organizations rejected the package before it was approved, while calling for higher environmental standards and stricter enforcement.

zh: 它们认识到，秘鲁所急需的是以未来为导向的新经济愿景，这一愿景的核心应该是减少经济对已成明日黄花的采掘炼化行业的依赖。
en: They recognize that what Peru urgently needs is a new, future-oriented economic vision, focused on reducing its reliance on the extractive industries, whose days are numbered.

zh: “绿色”投资 — — 世界银行最近用鲁棒的经济模型证明，绿色投资不会拖累经济增长 — — 才是好的起点。
en: “Green” investment – which, as the World Bank recently proved using robust economic modeling, does not constrain economic growth – is a good place to start.

zh: 9月，胡马拉将前往纽约展示秘鲁为缓解全球气候危机所做的“果断而雄心勃勃的”行动。
en: In September, Humala will go to New York to outline Peru’s “bold and ambitious” actions to head-off the global climate crisis.

zh: 12月，秘鲁将主办新一轮联合国气候谈判，全球各国政府将齐聚利马，追求全面协定以支持从破坏性化石燃料向低碳能源解决方案的转型。
en: In December, Peru will host the next round of UN climate negotiations, with governments from around the world gathering in Lima to pursue a comprehensive agreement that supports a transition from environmentally devastating fossil fuels to low-carbon energy solutions.

zh: 秘鲁的近期动作严重影响了其作为全球气候领袖行动的能力，给全世界带来了伤害。
en: Peru’s recent actions have severely undercut its ability to act as a global climate leader, to everyone’s detriment.

zh: 秘鲁必须采取以经济多样化和可再生能源投资为基础的新战略，惟其如此，秘鲁才能实现稳定、包容的长期繁荣 — — 并真正为遏制气候变化做出贡献。
en: Only with a new strategy based on economic diversification and investment in renewable energy can Peru achieve stable, inclusive, long-term prosperity – and make a real contribution to mitigating climate change.

zh: 美国回到古巴
en: America Returns to Cuba

zh: 北京—奥巴马访问古巴是1928年柯立芝以来第一位美国总统访问古巴。
en: BEIJING – Barack Obama’s visit to Cuba is the first by a US president since Calvin Coolidge went in 1928.

zh: 美国投资者、外籍古巴人、游客、学者和掮客都将追随奥巴马的脚步。
en: American investors, expat Cubans, tourists, scholars, and scam artists will follow in Obama’s wake.

zh: 美古双边关系正常化将给古巴带来机遇和风险，也给美国带来巨大的成熟度考验。
en: Normalization of the bilateral relationship will pose opportunities and perils for Cuba, and a giant test of maturity for the United States.

zh: 57年前，菲德尔·卡斯特罗领导的古巴革命是对美国的 一次重大心理打击。
en: The Cuban Revolution led by Fidel Castro 57 years ago was a profound affront to the US psyche.

zh: 自美国建国以来，其领导人一直宣扬美国例外论。
en: Since the founding of the US, its leaders have staked a claim to American exceptionalism.

zh: 据美国领导人的观点，美国模式令人无法抗拒，每个体面的国家都必须决然跟随美国的领导。
en: So compelling is the US model, according to its leaders, that every decent country must surely choose to follow America’s lead.

zh: 当外国政府太愚蠢以至于拒绝美国道路时，他们应该因为伤害美国的利益（普世利益的代名词）进而威胁美国安全而受到惩罚。
en: When foreign governments are foolish enough to reject the American way, they should expect retribution for harming US interests (seen to align with universal interests) and thereby threatening US security.

zh: 哈瓦那距离佛罗里达礁岛群只有90英里，美国对古巴的干涉从未停止。
en: With Havana a mere 90 miles from the Florida Keys, American meddling in Cuba has been incessant.

zh: 1820年，托马斯·杰斐逊指出美国“应该抓住第一次可能的机会获取古巴。
en: Thomas Jefferson opined in 1820 that the US “ought, at the first possible opportunity, to take Cuba.”

zh: ”1898年，美国终于这么做了 — — 干预古巴反叛西班牙，从而主张美国对古巴岛的经济和政治的事实霸权。
en: It finally did so in 1898, when the US intervened in a Cuban rebellion against Spain to assert effective US economic and political hegemony over the island.

zh: 在随后的战斗中，美国夺取了关塔那摩，将之作为海军基地，并主张（根据现在闻名天下的普拉特修正案）拥有干涉古巴的未来权利。
en: In the fighting that ensued, the US grabbed Guantánamo as a naval base and asserted (in the now infamous Platt Amendment) a future right to intervene in Cuba.

zh: 此后美国海军反复占领古巴，美国人迅速攫取了大部分获利丰厚的古巴糖种植园的所有权 — — 这也是美国干涉古巴的经济目的。
en: US Marines repeatedly occupied Cuba thereafter, and Americans quickly took ownership of most of Cuba’s lucrative sugar plantations, the economic aim of America’s intervention.

zh: 后来被卡斯特罗推翻的巴蒂斯塔将军是美国力量长期扶持和维系的最后一位高压统治者。
en: General Fulgencio Batista, who was eventually overthrown by Castro, was the last of a long line of repressive rulers installed and maintained in power by the US.

zh: 美国一直控制着古巴，并且根据美国投资者的利益���在二十世纪上半叶，这一出口经济体几乎没有除了糖和烟草种植园之外的产业。
en: The US kept Cuba under its thumb, and, in accordance with US investor interests, the export economy remained little more than sugar and tobacco plantations throughout the first half of the twentieth century.

zh: 卡斯特罗推翻巴蒂斯塔的革命旨在建立一个多样化的现代经济。
en: Castro’s revolution to topple Batista aimed to create a modern, diversified economy.

zh: 但是，由于缺少明确的战略，这一目标没有达到。
en: Given the lack of a clear strategy, however, that goal was not to be achieved.

zh: 始于1959年的卡斯特罗的农业改革和国有化威胁到美国糖业的利益，导致美国引入新的贸易限制。
en: Castro’s agrarian reforms and nationalization, which began in 1959, alarmed US sugar interests and led the US to introduce new trade restrictions.

zh: 这些限制升级到削减古巴对美国出口糖的允许量和禁止美国石油和食品出口至古巴。
en: These escalated to cuts in Cuba’s allowable sugar exports to the US and an embargo on US oil and food exports to Cuba.

zh: 当卡斯特罗转向苏联填补缺口时，艾森豪威尔总统向中央情报局下达颠覆卡斯特罗新政权的密令，导致了1961年肯尼迪政府上台几个月后灾难般的猪湾入侵事件。
en: When Castro turned to the Soviet Union to fill the gap, President Dwight Eisenhower issued a secret order to the CIA to topple the new regime, leading to the disastrous Bay of Pigs invasion in 1961, in the first months of John F. Kennedy’s administration.

zh: 随后，中央情报局获准刺杀卡斯特罗。
en: Later, the CIA was given the green light to assassinate Castro.

zh: 1962年，苏联领导人赫鲁晓夫决定先发制人阻止美国再次入侵 — — 也给美国一个教训 — — 秘密地在古巴部署核弹，从而引发1962年古巴导弹危机，世界徘徊在核覆灭的边缘。
en: In 1962, Soviet leader Nikita Khrushchev decided to forestall another US invasion – and teach the US a lesson – by surreptitiously installing nuclear missiles in Cuba, thereby triggering the October 1962 Cuban missile crisis, which brought the world to the brink of nuclear annihilation.

zh: 由于肯尼迪和赫鲁晓夫过人的冷静，再加上一些好运气，人类最终得到了救赎；苏联撤出了导弹，美国也承诺不会再次发动入侵。
en: Through dazzling restraint by both Kennedy and Khrushchev, and no small measure of good luck, humanity was spared; the Soviet missiles were removed, and the US pledged not to launch another invasion.

zh: 相反，美国加紧了贸易禁运，要求古巴提供国有化产权的补偿，这让古巴义无反顾地加入了苏联阵营 — — 正中后者下怀。
en: Instead, the US doubled down on the trade embargo, demanded restitution for nationalized properties, and pushed Cuba irrevocably into the Soviet Union’s waiting arms.

zh: 古巴仍然保持着只糖业单作，只是其产出现在流向了苏联而不是美国。
en: Cuba’s sugar monoculture remained in place, though its output now headed to the Soviet Union rather than the US.

zh: 半个世纪的苏联式经济，再加上美国贸易禁运和相关政策的影响，给古巴带来了严重伤害。
en: The half-century of a Soviet-style economy, exacerbated by the US trade embargo and related policies, took a heavy toll.

zh: 以购买力衡量，古巴人均收入大约只有美国的五分之一。
en: In purchasing-power terms, Cuba’s per capita income stands at roughly one-fifth of the US level.

zh: 但古巴在识字率和公共卫生方面的成就是巨大的。
en: Yet Cuba’s achievements in boosting literacy and public health are substantial.

zh: 古巴寿命预期与美国相当，远高于大部分拉丁美洲国家。
en: Life expectancy in Cuba equals that of the US, and is much higher than in most of Latin America.

zh: 近几年来，古巴医生在非洲疾病控制方面功不可没。
en: Cuban doctors have played an important role in disease control in Africa in recent years.

zh: 美古外交关系正常化为美古关系带来两个截然不同的情景。
en: Normalization of diplomatic relations creates two very different scenarios for US-Cuba relations.

zh: 第一个情景是美国回到糟糕的老路，要求古巴采取严苛的政策措施换取“正常”的双边经济关系。
en: In the first, the US reverts to its bad old ways, demanding draconian policy measures by Cuba in exchange for “normal” bilateral economic relations.

zh: 比如，美国国会可能坚决要求在古巴补偿在革命期间被国有化的产业；取消美国人购买古巴土地和其他产业的权利限制；以跳楼价私有化国有企业；并结束公共卫生体系等进步的社会政策。
en: Congress might, for example, uncompromisingly demand the restitution of property that was nationalized during the revolution; the unrestricted right of Americans to buy Cuban land and other property; privatization of state-owned enterprises at fire-sale prices; and the end of progressive social policies such as the public health system.

zh: 着实糟糕。
en: It could get ugly.

zh: 在第二个情景将创造打破历史的先例，美国进行自我约束。
en: In the second scenario, which would constitute a historic break with precedent, the US would exercise self-restraint.

zh: 国会重启与古巴的贸易关系，而不坚持古巴根据美国的形象改造自己或强迫古巴重新审视革命后的国有化。
en: Congress would restore trade relations with Cuba, without insisting that Cuba remake itself in America’s image or forcing Cuba to revisit the post-revolution nationalizations.

zh: 古巴不会受到放弃公费医疗或向美国私人投资者开放医疗部门的压力。
en: Cuba would not be pressured to abandon state-financed health care or to open the health sector to private American investors.

zh: 古巴人期待这一相互尊重的关系，但对重新附属于美国的前景感到愤怒。
en: Cubans look forward to such a mutually respectful relationship, but bristle at the prospect of renewed subservience.

zh: 这并不是说古巴应该缓慢执行自身的改革。
en: This is not to say that Cuba should move slowly on its own reforms.

zh: 古巴应该立刻让其货币实现贸易兑换，扩大产权，并（相当谨慎且透明地）私有化一些企业。
en: Cuba should quickly make its currency convertible for trade, expand property rights, and (with considerable care and transparency) privatize some enterprises.

zh: 这些基于市场的改革，再加上强劲的公共投资，能够加速经济增长和多样化，同时保护古巴在卫生、教育和社会服务方面取得的成就。
en: Such market-based reforms, combined with robust public investment, could speed economic growth and diversification, while protecting Cuba’s achievements in health, education, and social services.

zh: 古巴可以也应该将目标定在哥斯达黎加式的社会民主，而不是更粗放的美国资本主义。
en: Cuba can and should aim for Costa Rican-style social democracy, rather than the cruder capitalism of the US.

zh: （25年前，本文第一作者认为波兰也是如此：它应该将目标定在斯堪的纳维亚式的社会民主，而不是里根和撒切尔夫人的新自由主义。 ）
en: (The first author here believed the same about Poland 25 years ago: It should aim for Scandinavian-style social democracy, rather than the neo-liberalism of Ronald Reagan and Margaret Thatcher.)

zh: 因此，美古重建关系对两国都是一个考验。
en: The resumption of economic relations between the US and Cuba is therefore a test for both countries.

zh: 古巴需要大手笔改革以实现其经济潜力而不破坏其巨大的社会成就。
en: Cuba needs significant reforms to meet its economic potential without jeopardizing its great social achievements.

zh: 美国需要实施前所未有的、也尚不习惯的自我控制，给古巴时间和自由处置构建现代多样化经济的需要。 这一现代多样化经济主要应该由古巴人民自己拥有和运转，而不是由北方的邻居代劳。
en: The US needs to exercise unprecedented and unaccustomed self-control, to allow Cuba the time and freedom of maneuver it needs to forge a modern and diversified economy that is mostly owned and operated by the Cuban people themselves rather than their northern neighbors.

zh: 公共政策的叙事根基
en: The Narrative Roots of Public Policy

zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯—在最近的巴拿马美洲峰会（Summit of the Americas）上，古巴总统劳尔·卡斯特罗打破了常规（agreed protocol ） 。
en: BUENOS AIRES – At the recent Summit of the Americas in Panama, Cuban President Raúl Castro chose to break with the agreed protocol.

zh: 他的讲话不是八分钟，而是比这个时间长了五倍，用轻浮松散的事实依据论述了古巴政治史。
en: Instead of speaking for eight minutes, he took six times longer to present a political history of his country that was only loosely based on fact.

zh: 这是为什么？
en: Why?

zh: 作为拥有正式与会资格的经济学专家，我所接受的训练让我用英国哲学家边沁（Jeremy Bentham）的观点看待世界。 边沁认为，公共政策的目的是为最广大人民创造最大幸福。
en: As a card-carrying member of the economics profession, I have been trained to view the world from the perspective of the English philosopher Jeremy Bentham, according to whom the purpose of public policy is to create the greatest happiness for the greatest number of people.

zh: 政策如果不受一些功利主义原则变量的约束，那么（如约翰·罗尔斯（John Rawls）或阿玛蒂亚·森（Amartya Sen）等人所言）它们就必然是无效或不公正的。
en: Policies that do not abide by some variant of this utilitarian principle (as proposed by, say, John Rawls or Amartya Sen) are bound to be inefficient or unfair.

zh: 但心理学和神经科学的新进展表明，要理解社会和政治行为，或者，要改进政策，我们更应该读一读黑格尔而不是边沁。
en: But recent advances in psychology and neuroscience may suggest that if we want to understand social and political behavior, or improve policies, we should be reading Hegel more than Bentham.

zh: 这听起来也许有些奇怪，因为黑格尔是个理想主义者，他永远不会想到神经科学 — — 独立于Geist（通常被译为“思想”或“精神 ” ） 的物质实在 — — 会与他的研究扯上关系。
en: That may sound weird, given that Hegel was an Idealist and would never have expected neuroscience – a material reality independent of Geist (usually translated as Mind or Spirit) – to be relevant to his inquiry.

zh: 安东尼奥·达马西奥（Antonio Damasio）在其名称恰如其分的著作《自我成为思想 》 （ Self Comes to Mind）中指出，大脑创造出一种自传式（autobiographical）的自我意识。
en: As Antonio Damasio argues in his aptly titled book Self Comes to Mind, the brain creates an autobiographical sense of self.

zh: 这一被创造出来的自我行使感知、记忆和渴望功能，它拥有telos（或称目的 ） ， 决策也都是依据它做出的。
en: It is this created self that perceives, remembers, and aspires, that has telos (or purpose), and on behalf of which decisions are made.

zh: 自传式自我 — — 通过它为自己所创造的叙事（narrative ） — —让生活比美国作家、艺术家兼哲学家阿尔伯特·哈伯特（Elbert Hubbard）所说的“一件鸟事接着又一件鸟事”更有意义。
en: It is also the autobiographical self – through the narrative that it creates about itself – that makes life something more than what the American writer, artist, and philosopher Elbert Hubbard once called “one damn thing after another.”

zh: 我们的大脑被设定了一种功能，即发现其他自我在想什么、感觉怎样。
en: And our brains are wired to figure out what other selves are thinking and feeling.

zh: 我认为这一结构也适用于我们如何理解由许多人组成的集体。
en: I believe that this same structure applies to how we understand multi-person groups.

zh: 比如，法律将企业像人一样看待绝非巧合。
en: It is no coincidence, for example, that the law treats corporations as persons.

zh: 我们将我们在其中工作的组织视同于一个有权利、义务、价值、声誉和脾气的人，其管理者认为自己代表这个“人”行动。
en: We think of the organization in which we work as if it was a person with rights, obligations, values, reputation, and temperament, on whose behalf managers regard themselves as acting.

zh: 国家（nations and states）也是如此。
en: The same applies to nations and states.

zh: 我们的大脑需要创造一种共同的自我意识，一个政治学家本尼迪克特·安德森（Benedict Anderson）所谓的 “想象的共同体 ” ， 集体决策的代表对象。
en: Our brains need to create a shared sense of self, an “imagined community,” as the political scientist Benedict Anderson put it, on whose behalf collective decisions are made.

zh: 这一共同体是一个“人 ” ， 它具有超越作为个体的我们的过去和未来。
en: This community is a “person” that has a past and a future that transcend us as individuals.

zh: 它拥有一个历史和一个telos。
en: It has a history and a telos.

zh: 相反，纯粹的边沁主义观点把政治视为一个基于空洞的功利主义算计的不相关的决策的集合。
en: By contrast, a purely Benthamite view would lead to a view of politics as a set of disparate decisions based on a disembodied utilitarian calculus.

zh: 但这让人感觉就像“一件鸟事接着又一件鸟事 ” 。
en: But this would feel like “one damn thing after another.”

zh: 各个时间的政治决策集合都必须有意义，而这一意义必须来自叠加于历史事件之上的叙事。
en: The set of political decisions made over time must make some sense, and this sense must come from the narrative that is superimposed on historical events.

zh: 叙事本身是社会构建的（socially constructed ） ， 只是若即若离地受到事实约束。
en: The narrative itself is socially constructed and only marginally bound by fact.

zh: 比如，根据美国总统奥巴马的叙事，美国时刻准备着朝自由和平等前进，从独立战争到废除奴隶制和妇女、少数族以即其他边缘群体（如同性恋和残障人士）赋权运动都是如此。
en: For example, according to President Barack Obama’s narrative, the United States has always been about a steady march toward freedom and equality, from the War of Independence to the abolition of slavery and the empowerment of women, minorities, and other previously marginalized groups, such as gays and those with handicaps.

zh: 这一叙事从某种程度上说并不正确，但它鼓舞人心。
en: To the extent that this narrative is inaccurate, it is aspirational.

zh: 政治的角色就是创造、维持和改写这一共同自我意识，即“我们”意识 （ “ 他们”意识也随之而定 ） 。
en: It is the role of politics to create, sustain, and reshape this shared sense of self, of us (and hence of them).

zh: 这是一个幻觉，但它是社会创造的幻觉。
en: It is an illusion, but a socially created illusion.

zh: 19世纪60年代，巴伐利亚人和威尼斯人就是这样认为他们是、并且一直以来都是德国人和意大利人。
en: It is how Bavarians and Venetians in the 1860s, for example, became convinced that they were and had always been Germans or Italians.

zh: 类似地，只有新的叙事 — — 新的Geist — — 能够让今天的英国人相信他们是名副其实的欧洲人。
en: Likewise, only a new narrative – a new Geist – can persuade the British today that they are really Europeans.

zh: 自由派，如政治学家德鲁·威斯腾（Drew Westen）所解释的，常常不提共同身份叙事，也许这是因为他们认识到大罪恶常常也是打着这一旗号犯下的。
en: Liberals, as the political scientist Drew Westen has explained, often refrain from the narrative of shared identity, perhaps owing to awareness that great crimes are often committed in its name.

zh: 希特勒将德语词汇Volk（人民）重新定义为污染民族血液的内部敌人的集体受害者 — — 这就是一种类型的叙事，它可以通过种族、宗教或阶级的幌子构建，成为大屠杀的基础。
en: Hitler redefined the German Volk as the collective victim of an internal enemy that was tainting its blood – a type of narrative that, whether framed in terms of race, religion, or class, underlies genocide wherever it occurs.

zh: 但还有一种国家“人 ” ， 由林肯在其葛底斯堡演讲中唤醒。
en: But it was also a national “person” that Abraham Lincoln invoked in his Gettysburg Address.

zh: 在这篇只有272个字的演讲中，林肯将美利坚提炼成一个理想，一个基于人人生而平等命题的理想。
en: In just 272 words, Lincoln synthesized America as an ideal based on the proposition that all men are created equal.

zh: 在这一叙事中，南北战争是为了保证“民有、民治、民享的政府永世长存 ” 。
en: In this narrative, the Civil War was fought to ensure “that government of the people, by the people, for the people, shall not perish from the earth.”

zh: 哲学家阿拉斯代尔·麦金泰尔（Alasdair MacIntyre）在《追求美德 》 （ After Virtue）中指出，叙事框定了个体的道德选择。
en: As the philosopher Alasdair MacIntyre argued in After Virtue, narratives frame individuals’ moral choices.

zh: 类似地，叙事也框定了政府决策。
en: Likewise, narratives frame the choices that governments make.

zh: 在与西班牙共产主义者发生摩擦后，乔治·奥威尔（George Orwell）在其小说《1984》中抓住了叙事重要性的本质 ： “ 控制了过去就控制了未来；控制了现在就控制了过去。 ”
en: After his brush with Communists in Spain, George Orwell captured the essence of the narrative’s importance in his novel 1984: “Who controls the past controls the future; who controls the present, controls the past.”

zh: 比如，保持欧盟内部劳动力市场开放需要人们将自己和新邻居视为欧洲人。
en: For example, maintaining open labor markets in the European Union requires people to regard themselves and their new neighbors as European.

zh: 类似地，委内瑞拉总统马杜罗无法阻止通货膨胀，因为他所陷入的经济福利叙事让他无法证明稳定物价所需要的决定的正确性。
en: Similarly, Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro cannot stop inflation, because the narrative of economic warfare in which he is trapped prevents him from justifying the decisions needed to stabilize prices.

zh: 马克思的比较优势是阅读了黑格尔并创造了一套历史是阶级斗争的历史的叙事，新出现的工业无产阶级必定会形成“阶级意识 ” ， 推翻由资产阶级建立的政治和经济秩序。
en: Marx’s comparative advantage was to read Hegel and create a narrative in which history is the history of class struggle, with the newly emergent industrial proletariat destined to develop “class consciousness” and overthrow the political and economic order created by the bourgeoisie.

zh: 自由民主在叙事之争中处于劣势，因为它总是将集体自我视为一个寻找更好的工作的理性的普通选民。
en: Liberal democracy has been at a disadvantage in the battle for the narrative because it tends to treat the collective self as if it were just a rational median voter in search of a better job.

zh: 但这是不够的。
en: But that is inadequate.

zh: 政策必须契合时下的叙事框架，而政治的伟大任务是决定明天的叙事。
en: Policies must fit within the prevailing narrative framework, while the great task of politics is to shape the narrative of tomorrow.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪，奥巴马用他的巴拿马八分钟来描绘能给最广大人民带来幸福的务实政策，而卡斯特罗用了48分钟重新阐述了过去。
en: No wonder, then, that while Obama used his eight minutes in Panama to delineate concrete policy initiatives that would bring happiness to the greatest number, Castro spent 48 minutes reinventing the past.

zh: 古巴的回归
en: Cuba’s Back

zh: 发自墨西哥城-在时隔47年之后，美洲国家组织在其年度大会上废除了驱逐古巴的决议。
en: MEXICO CITY – After 47 years, the Organization of American States, at its annual General Assembly, has repealed its suspension of Cuba’s membership.

zh: 而这要归功于由古巴、委内瑞拉、洪都拉斯、尼加拉瓜、玻利维亚、多米尼加和厄瓜多尔等国组成的所谓ALBA国家集团（名称取自西班牙语“玻利瓦尔美洲国家替代计划”的首字母缩写 ） ， 是他们成功地使用了威逼利诱之策，促使加拿大，美国和其它拉美民主国家为古巴恢复了名誉。
en: The so-called ALBA countries (the Spanish acronym for the so-called Bolivarian Alternative for the Americas), which includes Cuba, Venezuela, Honduras, Nicaragua, Bolivia, Dominica, and Ecuador, were able partly to outwit – and partly to “out-blackmail” – Canada, the United States, and the Latin American democracies in getting Cuba rehabilitated.

zh: 然而美洲国家组织也为此设下了两大条件：一是古巴必须明确提出恢复成员国地位的申请；二是必须启动对话谈判，不但要古巴遵守美国国家组织宪章及其他组织文件，同时也要令其服从与这些文件所代表的原则 — — 其中最重要的，就是民主以及对人权的尊重。
en: The OAS did, however, lay down two conditions. Cuba must explicitly request reinstatement, and a dialogue must be initiated in accordance with the premises of the OAS Charter and other basic OAS documents, and in consonance with the principles on which those documents are based – most importantly, democracy and respect for human rights.

zh: 但正如许多外交上的妥协方案那样，上述结果令所有人都喜忧参半。
en: Like many diplomatic compromises, the outcome left everyone a bit happy and a bit disappointed.

zh: 因为在这场斗争中谁都能自称是胜利者，也没有谁要被迫承认失败而丢了面子。
en: Everyone could claim victory, and no one was obliged to acknowledge defeat.

zh: 与此同时这些妥协方案和所有财务报表或者女式泳衣有着同样的特质：那就是它们试图掩盖的部分才是最精彩的地方。
en: But those compromises are like statistics or skimpy swimsuits: what they show is less important than what they hide.

zh: 而我脑海中则因此浮现出两个基本的思考，而这些思考点在萨尔瓦多这类拉美“中立”国家中催生出的政策副产品则特别值得注意。
en: Two fundamental considerations come to mind, and their ramifications in “up-for-grab” countries in Latin America, such as El Salvador, are particularly significant.

zh: 第一点思考包含了ALBA国家对其外交政策的操纵手段。
en: The first consideration involves the ALBA countries’ conduct of foreign policy.

zh: 考虑到那些拉美小国不可能抛开委内瑞拉行事，而委内瑞拉总统雨果·查韦斯也不可能在这类重要事务上不看古巴的眼色做人，因此很明显，古巴及其盟友们可不会让美国总统奥巴马在拉美事务上有好日子过。
en: Given that the smaller countries do not act independently of Venezuela, and that Venezuelan President Hugo Chávez does not act without Cuba’s guidance on weighty matters such as these, it is now clear that the Cubans and their allies will cut US President Barack Obama no slack on Latin American issues.

zh: 这些国家可以让美洲国家组织大会轻易地通过接纳古巴的决议，并给奥巴马留下更多时间去说服国会和民众，好让美国可以通过一部可以微妙平衡各方面利益的古巴法案。
en: They could have easily let the OAS assembly go by, giving the new American president more time to prepare his Congress and public opinion for a delicate balancing act.

zh: 而这一法案的关键则在于如何废除美国对古巴施行近50年的贸易、投资和旅游禁令，并使之看上去就像一场艰苦谈判所取得的成果。
en: The key issue here is how to lift the now almost fifty-year old US embargo on trade, investment, and travel to Cuba unilaterally, while portraying it as the result of a negotiation.

zh: 但事实上，这些ALBA国家早已下定决心不向奥巴马做出任何让步，并试图把他逼到死胡同里去：要么美国甘愿冒着激怒古巴裔美国人国会游说团和人权团体的政治风险，赞成ALBA所炮制的新美洲国家组织共识，把那些关于民主和人权的原则和承诺弃之不顾；要么美国人选择特立独行（可能和加拿大一道 ） ， 将自己彻底孤立于拉丁美洲 — — 这可是奥巴马最不想看见的情况。
en: The ALBA countries decided they would concede nothing to Obama, and attempt, instead, to back him into a corner: either the US would go along with the new OAS consensus, angering both parts of the Cuban-American lobby and the human rights community by abandoning principles and commitments, or the US would have to act alone (perhaps with Canada by its side), leaving it totally isolated in Latin America – the last thing Obama wants.

zh: 但由于ALBA集团不断施压要求就它们的提案进行投票或者获取外交让步，并准备向全世界和国内舆论大肆宣扬它们的战果。
en: The ALBA group pushed hard for a vote, or a compromise on its terms, which it could then flaunt to the world and to domestic public opinion.

zh: 至此奥巴马已经无从选择，双方只能各走各路。
en: Obama had no choice but to go along.

zh: 第二点思考则是ALBA国家将继续重复这种行为模式。
en: The second consideration is that this behavior will continue.

zh: 原因很简单：古巴极端需要国际援助，而且能捞到援助的地方也不多。
en: The reason seems clear enough: Cuba needs international aid desperately, and there are not too many places where it can find it.

zh: 古巴原本希望巴西和中国能给予现金援助，但这却在国际金融危机和地缘政治的双重作用下化为泡影。
en: Hopes that Brazil and China would provide cash to Cuba have been dashed by the international financial crisis and geo-politics.

zh: 而尽管最近油价有所回升，委内瑞拉总统查韦斯也不可能再像从前那样资助古巴。
en: And Chávez, despite the recent increase in oil prices, can no longer afford to subsidize Cuba as he did during the boom years.

zh: 因此古巴人只能寄望于从其他地方获取资源，而最有可能贷到款的地方，就是看似遥不可及的泛美开发银行
en: So it seems that the Cubans are hoping to find resources elsewhere, and the only possibility, as remote as it seems, is the Inter-American Development Bank.

zh: 然而在原则上，要成为泛美开发银行会员必须首先成为美洲国家组织成员，这就可以解释古巴为什么会如此强烈要求恢复其成员国资格，也为什么在没有获得无条件接纳之时显得如此沮丧。
en: In principle, IDB membership requires OAS membership, and therein may lie the reason why Cuba insisted so strongly on returning, and why it was ultimately disappointed in not obtaining unconditional re-admission.

zh: 但古巴的解决方案则是一面利用其盟友们去和泛美开发银行建立某种联系，一面在其他地方摆出强硬姿态，正如它现在在萨尔瓦多所作的那样。
en: It will nonetheless attempt to have its allies push for some sort of association with the IDB, while at the same time radicalizing its stance elsewhere, as it is now doing in El Salvador.

zh: 新近上任的萨尔瓦多总统毛里西奥·富内斯是依靠其所属的法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线(FMLN)的选票登上总统宝座的，而这个党派则脱胎于1980至1990年代活跃于当地的一支极左翼游击队组织。
en: Indeed, the new Salvadoran president, Mauricio Funes, was elected on the ticket of the FMLN, the party that succeeded the old, hard-left guerrilla group of the 1980’s and 1990’s.

zh: 富内斯是个温和左派， 不但把自己和巴西总统卢拉以及美国总统奥巴马相提并论，同时还反对委内瑞拉总统查韦斯。
en: He is a moderate, modern leftist who has openly identified himself with Brazilian President Lula and Barack Obama, as opposed to Chávez.

zh: 但他所属的党派却与古巴以及委内瑞拉的关系极端密切。
en: But his party is as close to Cuba and Venezuela as one can get.

zh: 在富内斯7月1日就职典礼之前的内阁成员人选任命之争中，法拉本多·马蒂民族解放阵线的保守势力不但夺取了主动，甚至威胁要走上街头进行斗争。
en: In a showdown over the composition of the cabinet just before his inauguration on June 1, the FMLN old guard won, threatening to take the conflict to the streets.

zh: 而古巴人、尼加拉瓜人和委内瑞拉人同样也不想让富内斯有好日子过，他们坚信历史现在站在自己一方，并且是时候对一切看不顺眼的事情动手了。
en: The Cubans, Nicaraguans, and Venezuelans will not cut Funes any slack, either, believing that history is on their side, and that now is the time to force every issue in sight.

zh: 在某种意义上说它们可能是对的，因为美洲国家组织大会的第二个值得关注之处则是墨西哥、巴西、智利和哥伦比亚这些拉美民主国家将如何行动。
en: They are probably right, up to a certain point, because the second lesson from the OAS assembly concerns the behavior of the Latin American democracies, mainly Mexico, Brazil, Chile, and Colombia.

zh: 这些国家虽然努力与美国保持一致（所以美国总统奥巴马致电巴西总统卢拉求援的说法纯属谣言 ） ， 但又不愿意公开与美国站在同一阵线上，自然也不愿与古巴和委内瑞拉交恶。
en: They tried to accommodate the US (it is rumored that Obama phoned Lula and asked for his help), but were nonetheless unwilling to break with Cuba and Venezuela to side openly with the US.

zh: 因此这些拉美民主国家不愿在任何可能跟ALBA国家发生冲突的议题上于之对抗。
en: They will not do so any time soon, on any issue that may spring up, if it means confrontation with the ALBA countries.

zh: 而古巴领导人菲德尔·卡斯特罗早就看透了这一点，并利用民主国家在人权和民主事务上说一套做一套的事实大做文章。
en: Fidel Castro knows this, and will take advantage of the democracies’ diluted commitment to human rights and democracy.

zh: 以至于在每个正在或即将发生冲突的国家（比如玻利维亚、危地马拉、萨尔瓦多、巴拉圭和厄瓜多尔 ） ， 极左势力都会大肆活动，那些拉美民主国家也只能挣一只眼闭一只眼，而奥巴马要么举手投降（正如在美洲国家组织大会上那样）并在美国国内的抗议声中输掉政治资本，要么就害怕显得孤立而对拉美地区望而却步。
en: In each country where conflict is present or emerging (Bolivia, Guatemala, El Salvador, Paraguay, and Ecuador) the hard-left will push hard, the democracies will look the other way, and Obama will either give in (as at the OAS) and pay a domestic political price, or step back from Latin America, for fear of appearing isolated.

zh: 事已至此，一个重启美国和拉美关系新篇章的绝佳机会，也将彻底消失。
en: A magnificent opportunity for a new start in US-Latin American relations will have been missed.

zh: 培植能源
en: Cultivating Energy

zh: 从气候变化到阴晴不定的油价，所有的迹象都表明一场全球性的能源危机即将到来。
en: From climate change to volatile oil prices, all signs point to a looming global energy crisis.

zh: 应对这场迫在眉睫的挑战意味着人类不能再忽视太阳每天通过光合作用在有机物质里为我们提供的取之不尽的能源。
en: Confronting the growing challenge means that humanity can no longer afford to ignore the inexhaustible resource found in the organic material that the sun provides each day through photosynthesis.

zh: 太阳能使植物吸收碳性气体并由此不仅制造氧气，还制造出其它物质—动物王国的食物和我们的机器所消耗的能源。
en: Solar energy enables plants to absorb carbon gas and thereby produce not only oxygen, but also matter that the animal kingdom uses for food – and that our machines can use for energy.

zh: 自从新石器时代以来，人类就开始培育这些“生物质”作为食物。
en: Since the Neolithic (or late Stone Age) period, humans have been cultivating this “biomass” in order to feed itself.

zh: 然而，即便是在当今世界，它的能源潜力也是被低估了。
en: Yet, even in today’s world, its energy potential is ignored.

zh: 从工业革命开始，人类就从煤炭及其后的石油和天然气中寻找能源，但这导致了不可再生能源的枯竭。
en: Beginning with the industrial revolution, humans sought energy from coal, and later from oil and natural gas, but this leads to the exhaustion of non-renewable resources.

zh: 能源生产多元化的现有替代方案是有限的。
en: Existing alternatives for diversifying energy production are limited.

zh: 由于对其安全性和放射性废料处置的担心，核能也有诸多劣势。
en: Nuclear energy presents a number of disadvantages, owing to concerns about safety and disposal of radioactive waste.

zh: 水电已经得到了广泛应用，但风能和太阳能的利用在结构上呈分散状态，资源的分布也不均衡。
en: Hydroelectric power is already widely used, while wind and solar energy are structurally sporadic and disparately available.

zh: 而生物质却有诸多优势。
en: Biomass, on the other hand, has several advantages.

zh: 其产量巨大，且在全世界都可以获得。
en: Supplies of it are large and available throughout the world.

zh: 此外，将其转化成能源所必需的技术—包括高产燃烧、气体转化和液化为合成燃料—早已被我们掌握了。
en: Moreover, the technology necessary to convert it into energy – including high-yield burning, gas conversion, and liquefaction into synthetic fuel – has long been mastered.

zh: 在第二次世界大战期间就已广泛使用的这一技术，战后又得到了长足发展。
en: Widely used during World War II, this technology has since advanced considerably.

zh: 然而，生物质能源是与化石能源不公平竞争的受害者。
en: Biomass energy, however, is the victim of unfair competition from fossil fuels.

zh: 石油的价格反映了其开采、提炼和分配的成本，但却没有反映出原油产生的成本。
en: Oil’s price reflects its extraction, refining, and distribution costs, but not that of creating the raw material.

zh: 200吨的植物物质经过数百万年的变化才能产生一公升石油，而生产一公升的合成燃料却只需要15公斤植物物质。
en: Millions of years and 200 tons of plant matter are necessary to produce one liter of oil, whereas just 15 kilograms of plant matter are required to make one liter of synthetic fuel.

zh: 在石油供应量极大的情况下，由于每桶价格低于20美金，使得人们开发生物能源的兴趣也随之消退。
en: After the oil glut, with oil below $20 a barrel, interest in developing energy from biomass ebbed, attractive only to “green” militants and those interested in fundamental science.

zh: 生物能源只对“绿色战士”和致力于基础科学研究的人保持着吸引力。
en: Yet the potential is immense.

zh: 地球上的生物质—森林、牧场、热带草原和庄稼—形成了年“回报率”10%的生产资本。
en: The planet’s biomass – forests, pastureland, savannas, and crops – make up productive capital that generates a 10% “return” every year.

zh: 就像一只能量会耗尽但又会被太阳重新充满的电池，只要我们管理得当，这些生物质的供应是永远可再生的。
en: Like a battery that runs out and is then recharged by the sun, this supply is renewable indefinitely, as long as it is managed properly.

zh: 这些资本每年产生的回报目前估计为600亿吨，而其中只有200亿吨作为食物被消耗，100亿吨被用作能源。
en: The annual return on this capital is currently estimated at 60 billion tons, yet only two billion tons is consumed for food purposes and 10 billion tons for energy.

zh: 增加对这一能源的负责任的使用可以为我们应对气候变化做出贡献。 它能减少大气中的碳含量，并遏制化石燃料的使用量。
en: Increasing the responsible use of this energy source would contribute to the fight against climate change by reducing the amount of carbon in the atmosphere and diminishing the amount of fossil fuel required to produce energy.

zh: 此外，它在南方国家的丰富产量还有利于这些国家的经济发展。
en: Moreover, its abundance in southern countries promises to facilitate their economic development.

zh: 如果能在国际社会的支持下获得增长和利用，那么直到今天还被认为是“穷人的能源”的生物质完全可以成为财富之源。
en: Considered the “energy of the poor” until today, biomass could become a source of wealth if it is grown and harnessed with the support of the international community.

zh: 因此 ， “ 能源作物”可以被开发以生产生物燃料。
en: Thus, “energy crops” could be developed to produce biofuel.

zh: 来自于森林、农业和农产业活动的残渣废料可以被收集起来并进行转化。
en: Residue from forest, agricultural, and agro-industrial activities could be collected and converted.

zh: 例如，从理论上讲，非洲国家尼日尔每年产生的600万吨废料可以满足该国全部的能源需求。
en: For example, the six million tons of waste produced annually by Niger could theoretically be used to meet that country’s entire energy needs.

zh: 然而，在许多地方能源作物的种植必然会与粮食作物发生竞争。
en: However, in many places, energy cropping would certainly compete with food crops.

zh: 长期的预计认为在50年的时间里，地球上大多数可耕种的土地都必须用来种植粮食并培育森林。
en: Long-term estimates project that over a 50-year time horizon, most of the planet’s arable land would have to be used to feed the world and for forest conservation.

zh: 因此，专门用于能源生产，特别是生物燃料生产的土地面积可能达不到社会的预期。
en: Thus, areas dedicated to energy production, particularly biofuel, may not reach the level that societies would wish.

zh: 但是，这种竞争在揭示新的全球稀缺资源的同时，也会带来价格的提升，从而鼓励生产者们增加产量并提高产能。
en: But, while such competition would reveal new global scarcities, it would also bring higher prices, thereby encouraging producers to increase yields and productivity.

zh: 因此，尽管培植能源会造成新的制约因素，但它同样也会为许多经济活动的主体开启新的可能性。
en: Thus, while cultivating energy would create new constraints, it would also open new possibilities for many economic actors.

zh: 农民和林业工人能够更多地参与市场，采矿工程师可以对作物种植产生兴趣，银行家也会更关注与作物种植相关的股票。
en: The farmer and the forest worker could become more involved in the market, the mine engineer could begin to take an interest in crop fields, the banker in plant shares, etc.

zh: 但是，为了扩大能源作物的种植规模，我们必须在南、北方的国家都实施新的农业、土地和水务管理、保护生物多样性、燃料税和信息及公众意识提升的政策。
en: But, in order to prepare for a scaling up of energy cropping, new policies must be implemented, both in northern and southern countries, in terms of agriculture, land and water management, protection of biodiversity, fuel taxes, and information and awareness-raising.

zh: 古印第安人和印加人信奉太阳神，他们相信太阳是地球万物的生命之源。
en: The ancient Egyptians and the Incas practiced a religion of the Sun, believing it to be at the beginning of all life on Earth.

zh: 科学已经证明了这一信仰的真实性。
en: Science has since proven this to be the case.

zh: 现在，当利用可再生能源的重要性前所未有地凸现出来时，我们应该利用太阳来培植我们的能源，就像我们的祖先曾经利用它来种植食物一样。
en: Nowadays, when it has become more important than ever that we embrace renewable resources, we should use the Sun to cultivate our energy, just as our ancestors used it to cultivate their food.

zh: 治疗遗传性乳腺癌
en: Curing Hereditary Breast Cancer

zh: 十分之一的发达国家女性患有乳腺癌，并且这种疾病在多数这些国家中正呈上升趋势。
en: In developed countries, breast cancer affects about one in ten women, and in many of these countries the disease is on the increase.

zh: 但是，无论是哪个（或哪些）原因导致了目前这种趋势，我们都知道5%至10%的乳腺癌患者是由于BRCA1或BRCA2基因感染了遗传性缺陷。
en: But, whatever the reason (or reasons) for the rise in their occurrence, we also know that between 5% and 10% of breast cancers are due to an inherited defect that affects the BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes.

zh: 携带变异的BRCA1或BRCA2基因的妇女患上乳腺癌的几率约有80 % 。
en: Women carrying a mutated BRCA1 or BRCA2 gene have roughly an 80% risk of developing breast cancer.

zh: 这些基因内的变异也导致了卵巢肿瘤的发生。
en: A mutation in these genes also leads to an increased risk of developing ovarian tumors.

zh: 十多年前当人们发现BRCA1和BRCA2基因的时候，人们曾对新的有针对性治疗方案期望甚高。
en: When the BRCA1 and BRCA2 genes were discovered more than a decade ago, there were high hopes for novel and targeted therapies.

zh: 令人失望的是，至今还没有出现任何新治疗方案。
en: Disappointingly, no new treatments have yet arisen.

zh: 结果，那些携带高度变异BRCA1 或BRCA2基因的妇女不得不痛苦地选择手术割除她们的胸部和卵巢以抵抗癌症。
en: As a result, many women with a high level of mutated BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes face the tragic choice of having their breasts and ovaries surgically removed to pre-empt cancer.

zh: 最近，我的研究小组和伦敦的研究者们一起，为那些变异BRCA1 或 BRCA2基因携带者提供了真正的希望。
en: Recently, my research group, along with researchers in London, provided some real hope for carriers of mutated BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes.

zh: 两个研究团队描述了如何使用一种化学抑制剂消灭那些携带会引起遗传性乳腺癌的BRCA1或者BRCA2基因缺陷的肿瘤细胞。
en: Both research teams describe how the use of a chemical inhibitor can kill tumor cells that have either a BRCA1 or BRCA2 gene defect causing hereditary breast cancer.

zh: 这种新治疗手段只以肿瘤细胞为目标，不会影响体内的其他健康细胞。
en: This new treatment targets only the tumor cells and is unlikely to affect other healthy cells in the body.

zh: 该发现也能够防止遗传性乳腺癌转化为肿瘤。
en: The discovery could also work to prevent hereditary breast cancer cells from growing into tumors.

zh: 使用于这种治疗手段的化学抑制剂主要针对聚合酶（PARP1 ） ， PARP1通常用于修补DNA的单个碱基断裂 — — 一种常见的自发性DNA损伤。
en: The chemical inhibitors used in this treatment target the enzyme polymerase (PARP1), which is normally involved in the repair of DNA single-strand breaks – a common form of spontaneous DNA lesions.

zh: PARP1蛋白质所产生的化学抑制能够减少这些单个碱基断开的发生。
en: Chemical inhibition of the PARP1 protein results in reduced occurrence of these single-strand break repairs.

zh: 未修复的单个碱基断裂对细胞并无大害。
en: Unrepaired single-strand breaks are not very toxic to cells.

zh: 然而，当这些断裂的碱基作为DNA副本被复制时就会破坏和损伤DNA。
en: However, these breaks disrupt and damage the DNA when they are copied as DNA replicates.

zh: 复制DNA时候所发生的破坏可以通过与BRCA1和BRCA2蛋白质的再结合得到修复，但是拥有变异BRCA1或BRCA2基因的细胞无法再承受这种重组而因此变得对未修复的单个碱基程度更高的断裂更为敏感。
en: The damage arising when copying the DNA is repaired with recombination, involving the BRCA1 and BRCA2 proteins. But cells with mutated BRCA1 or BRCA2 genes are unable to undergo recombination and are therefore much more sensitive to an increased level of unrepaired single-strand breaks.

zh: 妇女体内携带变异BRCA1或BRCA2的正常细胞仍然可以重组，因为它们还有一个功能正常的等位基因 — — 或者基因的另外一种形式。
en: The normal cells of women carrying the BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations can still recombine, because they retain one functional allele—or alternative form—of the gene.

zh: 只有在那些细胞中的BRCA1或BRCA2基因失去了其有效等位基因的情况下，细胞才会变成肿瘤。
en: Only those cells losing this remaining functional allele of the BRCA1 or BRCA2 gene will become tumors.

zh: 因此，只有肿瘤细胞才会有一个功能不正常的重组通道，并完全依赖PARP在复制DNA之前完成修补单个碱基断裂。
en: Thus, only the tumor cells will have a non-functional recombination pathway and rely completely on PARP to repair single-strand breaks before copying the DNA.

zh: 在我们的研究中，我们探寻了使用PARP抑制剂的必备条件，尤其针对具有BRCA1或BRCA2缺陷的癌细胞。
en: In our research, we exploit this requirement to specifically target the BRCA1 or BRCA2-defective cancer cells with inhibitors of PARP.

zh: 该治疗方法不会引起诸多副作用；老鼠对PARP抑制剂的长期治疗表现出良好的耐受性。
en: This treatment is unlikely to cause many side effects; prolonged treatments with PARP inhibitors are well tolerated in mice.

zh: 我们已经展示了PARP抑制剂如何能够有效杀死有BRCA2缺陷的乳腺癌细胞，并且由它们所引发的肿瘤能在使用PARP抑制剂后缩小并彻底消失。
en: We have shown that PARP inhibitors are effective at killing BRCA2-defective breast cancer cells, and that the tumors they cause can fully regress and disappear following treatment with a PARP inhibitor.

zh: 下一步要做的就是研究这种治疗法对人类患者究竟有多有效。
en: The next step is to investigate how efficient this treatment is in human patients.

zh: 我们正准备启动临床实验以测定这些PARP抑制剂在治疗转移性胸壁肿瘤中如何有效。
en: We are now initiating clinical trials to determine how efficient these PARP inhibitors are in the treatment of metastasized breast tumors.

zh: 但是我们必须小心谨慎。
en: But caution is in order.

zh: 具有BRCA1和BRCA2 缺陷的肿瘤的特征是高度的遗传不稳定性。
en: BRCA1 and BRCA2-defective tumors are characterized by a high degree of genetic instability.

zh: 高度转移的胸壁肿瘤可能已经获得能抵抗PARP抑制剂治疗的额外遗传性改变。
en: It is possible that highly metastasized breast tumors might have acquired additional genetic changes causing resistance to treatment with PARP inhibitors.

zh: 因此，我们建议，PARP抑制剂也许在对携带造成这类遗传性乳腺癌基因的妇女的预防性治疗上更有效用。
en: Therefore, we suggest that PARP inhibitors might be more useful in the prophylactic treatment of women carrying the gene responsible for this form of inherited breast cancer.

zh: 原因很简单：刚刚失去正常运作的BRCA1或BRCA2等位基因、并且很快将转变成肿瘤的细胞也是难以经受重组的。
en: The reason is simple: cells that have recently lost the functional BRCA1 or BRCA2 allele and that will later grow into tumors will also be unable to undergo recombination.

zh: 这意味着早期的癌细胞应该对PARP抑制剂较为敏感。
en: This means that early cancerous cells should be sensitive to PARP inhibitors.

zh: 然而，与晚期肿瘤不同的是，它们不太可能得到许多遗传性改变，因此也不太可能对PARP抑制剂具备抵抗力。
en: However, unlike fully developed tumors, they are not likely to have acquired many genetic changes and are therefore unlikely to have gained resistance to PARP inhibitors.

zh: 在癌细胞转变为肿瘤之前，用RARP抑制剂治疗那些携带BRCA1或BRCA2变异体的妇女是防癌方面一个全新的、大有前途的理念。
en: Treating women carrying BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations with PARP inhibitors to kill cancer cells before they grow into tumors is a new and hopeful concept in cancer prevention.

zh: 然而，这种治疗法是否能够被使用还取决于PARP1抑制剂是否对人体完全无害。
en: However, the usefulness of this treatment relies on the fact that PARP1 inhibitors are completely non-toxic to humans.

zh: PARP抑制剂作为预防治疗之用还需要更长的时间的验证，因为治疗手段不会在短期时间内被证明有效。
en: It will also take longer to validate a PARP inhibitor for use as a prophylactic treatment, because the treatment cannot be proven effective in a short time.

zh: 因此，尽管在这几年之内使用PARP抑制剂来治疗肿瘤也许是切实可行的，但是在遗传性乳腺癌预防性治疗手段的广泛使用之前，我们可能至少得等上十年。
en: Thus, while the use of PARP inhibitors to treat established tumors may be feasible within a few years, we could have to wait at least a decade before a prophylactic treatment for inherited breast cancer is widely available.

zh: 货币崩溃归来
en: The Return of the Currency Crash

zh: 坎布里奇—货币市场波动已经存在了几十年甚至几百年。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Currency-market volatility has been around for decades, if not centuries.

zh: 20世纪70年代布雷顿森林体系崩溃后，汇率大起伏成为国际金融市场的标签，在随后的十年以及20世纪80年代大部分时期，剧烈贬值成为家常便饭，而通胀在全世界肆虐。
en: Wide gyrations in exchange rates became a staple of international financial markets after the Bretton Woods system broke down in the early 1970s, and mega-depreciations were commonplace later in the decade and through much of the 1980s, when inflation raged across much of the world.

zh: 即使在20世纪90年代和21世纪的第一个十年的大部分时间里，每年都有10—20%的国家经历过货币大幅贬值或崩溃。
en: Even through much of the 1990s and early 2000s, 10-20% of countries worldwide experienced a large currency depreciation or crash in any given year.

zh: 接着，突然之间平静下来。
en: And then, suddenly, calm prevailed.

zh: 除了与2009年底、2009年初的全球金融危机的大乱象，从2004年到2014年期间，货币崩溃非常罕见（见图 ） 。
en: Excluding the mayhem associated with the global financial crisis of late 2008 and early 2009, currency crashes were few and far between from 2004 to 2014 (see figure).

zh: 但最近的发展趋势表明，这个十年中鲜见货币崩溃的现象有可能只是例外，而不是规则。
en: But recent developments suggest that the dearth of currency crashes during that decade may be remembered as the exception that proves the rule.

zh: 2004—2014年期间货币崩溃基本消失主要是因为稳定的低利率和大量资本流向新兴市场，同时大宗商品价格繁荣 ， （ 大部分）摆脱全球金融危机的国家增长率十分健康。
en: The near-disappearance of currency crashes in the 2004-2014 period largely reflect low and stable international interest rates and large capital flows to emerging markets, coupled with a commodity price boom and (mostly) healthy growth rates in countries that escaped the global financial crisis.

zh: 事实上，许多国家在这一时期的主要担忧是避免货币持续兑美元和其他贸易伙伴货币升值。
en: In effect, many countries’ main concern during those years was avoiding sustained currency appreciation against the US dollar and the currencies of other trade partners.

zh: 2014年，情况发生了变化。 全球环境的恶化让货币崩溃复活了。
en: That changed in 2014, when deteriorating global conditions revived the currency crash en masse.

zh: 自此以后，本文图表样本中的179个国家中有近一半经历过一年贬值15%以上的情况。
en: Since then, nearly half of the sample of 179 countries shown in the figure have experienced annual depreciations in excess of 15%.

zh: 诚然，更有弹性的汇率安排避免了放弃先前宣布的盯住或准盯住汇率机制的闹剧。
en: True, more flexible exchange-rate arrangements have mostly eliminated the drama of abandoning pre-announced pegged or semi-pegged exchange rates.

zh: 但是，到目前为止，没有迹象表明贬值对经济增长起到了有益作用，大部分地区的经济增长依然处于停滞状态。
en: But, thus far, there is little to suggest that the depreciations have had much of a salutary effect on economic growth, which for the most part has remained sluggish.

zh: 从2014年1月到2016年1月，兑美元平均累计贬值幅度接近35 % 。
en: The average cumulative depreciation versus the US dollar has been almost 35% from January 2014 to January 2016.

zh: 许多新兴市场的贬值幅度远高于15 % ， 对它们而言，汇率贬值加剧了外币债务增加所带来的问题。
en: For many emerging markets, where depreciations have been considerably greater, weakening exchange rates have aggravated current problems associated with rising foreign-currency debts.

zh: 此外，在互联世界，货币崩溃的影响并不只局限于危机发生地。
en: Moreover, in an interconnected world, the effects of currency crashes do not end in the country where they originate.

zh: 1994年，中国改革了其汇率安排，统一了汇率双轨制，在此过程中，人民币贬值50 % 。
en: Back in 1994, China reformed its foreign-exchange framework, unified its system of multiple exchange rates, and, in the process, devalued the renminbi by 50%.

zh: 一个极具说服力的观点认为，中国的贬值导致泰国、韩国、印度尼西亚、马来西亚和菲律宾竞争力下降，后几个国家货币都盯住（或准盯住）美元。
en: It has been persuasively argued that the Chinese devaluation resulted in a loss of competitiveness for Thailand, Korea, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines, which had pegged (or semi-pegged) their currencies to the US dollar.

zh: 而它们的逐渐升值反过来酝酿了1997年年中爆发的亚洲危机。
en: Their cumulative overvaluation, in turn, helped set the stage for the Asian crisis that erupted in mid-1997.

zh: 汇率高估是最佳的金融危机领先指标之一。
en: Overvalued exchange rates have been among the best leading indicators of financial crises.

zh: 因此，你免不了要疑问，我们是否面临1994—1997年的情景重现 — — 只不过“演员”对换罢了。
en: So one cannot help but wonder if we are facing a repeat of what happened from 1994 to 1997 – only this time with the roles reversed.

zh: 自2014年年初以来，人民币兑美元仅仅贬值了7.5 % ， 而同期欧元贬值了25%左右，许多新兴市场货币贬值更是要快得多。
en: Since early 2014, the renminbi has depreciated by a mere 7.5% against the dollar, compared to the euro’s roughly 25% depreciation in this period, not to mention even faster currency weakening in many emerging markets.

zh: 对中国这样的以制造业为基础的国家来说，高估-增长链条不容小觑。
en: For a manufacturing-based economy such as China’s, the overvaluation-growth connection should not be underestimated.

zh: 去年8月，中国宣布准备允许人民币略有贬值，并计划最终实现人民币更加自由的浮动，这引起了金融市场的“过山车 ” 。
en: China’s announcement last August of its intent to allow modest depreciation and eventually move the renminbi toward greater exchange-rate flexibility triggered a roller-coaster ride in financial markets.

zh: 为了安抚市场，决策者发布声明，中国的措施将是渐进的。
en: To provide reassurance, policymakers issued statements to the effect that China would move only gradually in that direction.

zh: 但也许亚洲危机的教训告诉我们，在这方面采取渐进主义同样有风险。
en: But perhaps the cautionary tale from the Asian crises is that gradualism on this front carries its own risks.

zh: 当然，过去两年间，货币突然崩溃的潜在以邻为壑效应并非中国所独有。
en: Of course, the potential beggar-thy-neighbor effects of the spike in currency crashes in the past two years are not unique to China.

zh: 任何维持相对固定汇率的国家（包括主要石油生产国）都有可能造成这一效应。
en: They may also apply to any country that has maintained a comparatively fixed exchange rate (a category that includes major oil producers).

zh: 中国与其他国家的不同之处在于其经济相对世界GDP规模较大，其措施对于各个地区的众多国家的影响也较大，不管是初级商品供给国，还是依赖中国资金或直接投资的国家。
en: What distinguishes the Chinese case from others is the sheer size of its economy relative to world GDP, as well as its effects on numerous countries across regions, from suppliers of primary commodities to countries that depend on Chinese funding or direct investment.

zh: 更广泛的要点很简单：新兴市场目前占世界GDP的60%左右，而20世纪80年代初只占35%左右。
en: The broader point is a simple one: Emerging markets now account for around 60% of world GDP, up from about 35% in the early 1980s.

zh: 重塑全球繁荣需要比30多年前更广的地理基础。
en: Restoring global prosperity requires a much broader geographical base than it did back then.

zh: 货币崩溃的回归可能让这一点更加难以实现。
en: The return of the currency crash may make achieving it all the more difficult.

zh: 如何对抗货币操纵
en: How to Fight Currency Manipulation

zh: 华盛顿—用贸易协议阻止国家利用大规模外汇市场干预拉低其货币价值，这样做合适吗？
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Is it appropriate to use trade agreements to discourage countries from using large-scale intervention in the foreign-exchange market to hold down their currencies’ value?

zh: 这就是当今美国经济政策圈的问题。
en: That is the question of the day in American economic-policy circles.

zh: 近几年来，日本、韩国和中国操纵各自货币，使其低估。
en: In recent years, Japan, South Korea, and China have manipulated their currencies to keep them undervalued.

zh: 这刺激了出口、限制了进口，并造成了巨大的经常项目盈余。
en: This boosted their exports, limited imports, and led to large current-account surpluses.

zh: 但如此干预消极地影响了贸易伙伴国，也是现行国际规则所不允许的。
en: But such intervention adversely affects trading partners and is barred under existing international rules.

zh: 不幸的是，这些规则完全无效。
en: Unfortunately, those rules have proved completely ineffective.

zh: 如今，一个新的解决这一问题的机会出现了：跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP ） — —由美国、日本和其他十个拉美和亚洲国家组成的庞大的地区自由贸易协定。
en: Now a new opportunity to address the issue has emerged: The Trans-Pacific Partnership – the mega-regional free-trade agreement involving the United States, Japan, and ten other countries in Latin America and Asia.

zh: 随着TPP接近完成，韩国和中国正在密切观察，其他国家也许想要加入。
en: With the TPP close to being finalized, South Korea and China are watching intently, and other countries may want to join.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马正确地指出，这是一个为二十一世纪制定贸易和投资规则的协定。
en: US President Barack Obama correctly argues that this is an occasion to set the rules for trade and investment in the twenty-first century.

zh: 但美国财政部和美国贸易代表坚决拒绝将禁止货币操纵纳入TPP中，他们提出了五个主要理由，但没有一个与事实相符。
en: Yet the US Treasury Department and the US Trade Representative steadfastly refuse to include any language prohibiting currency manipulation in the TPP, for five main reasons – none of which fits the facts.

zh: 第一个理由是国际货币基金组织（IMF）可以对付货币操纵。
en: The first argument is that the International Monetary Fund can deal with instances of currency manipulation.

zh: IMF确实有与时俱进的指引，定义并试图防止货币操纵。
en: The IMF does have up-to-date guidelines that define and seek to prevent currency manipulation.

zh: 这些指引不仅获得了美国的赞同，在（2005年前后）人民币显著低估、导致美国损失数百万制造业岗位时还获得了美国的强调。
en: These were adopted not only with America’s assent, but at its insistence, at a time (the mid-2000s) when China’s renminbi was greatly undervalued, contributing to the loss of millions of US manufacturing jobs.

zh: 不幸的是，IMF无法强制执行其指引，因为货币操纵者可以暂停这种行为。
en: Unfortunately, the IMF cannot enforce its guidelines, because currency manipulators are able to stall action.

zh: 这已成为根深蒂固的持续模式，包括在我担任IMF首席经济学家期间（2007年初至2008年8月 ） 。
en: This has been the entrenched and continuing pattern, including when I was the IMF’s chief economist (from early 2007 to August 2008).

zh: 美国财政部和贸易代表的第二个理由是可谈判的货币规则不够明确。
en: The second argument made by the US Treasury and the Trade Representative is that no sufficiently precise currency rules can be negotiated.

zh: 但由美国财政部谈成的IMF的指引毫无问题 — — 2007版和2012版均是如此。
en: But there is nothing wrong with the IMF guidelines – both the 2007 and 2012 versions – negotiated by the Treasury itself.

zh: 认识到这一点的国会议员、负责管理国际贸易的众议院筹款委员会的资深民主党委员桑德尔·莱文（Sander Levin）提出TPP货币规则应该基于IMF指引。
en: Recognizing this, Congressman Sander Levin – the senior Democrat on the House Ways and Means Committee, which has jurisdiction over international trade – proposes that a TPP currency chapter be based on the IMF guidelines.

zh: 这些指引能够识别什么时候一国尽管存在巨大的经常项目盈余，但仍在追求长期大规模外国资产买入，从而阻止汇率升值 — — 这正是我们想要阻止的问题。
en: These guidelines identify when a country, despite running a large current-account surplus, is pursuing long-term, large-scale purchases of foreign assets, thereby blocking exchange-rate appreciation – exactly the problem we want to prevent.

zh: （我在这些问题中的部分问题上与莱文有过合作，但在这里我只是代表自己的观点。 ）
en: (I have worked with Levin on some of these issues, but here I am speaking only for myself.)

zh: 反对将反操纵条款写入TPP的第三个理由是它们危及美国实施货币刺激的能力。
en: The third argument against putting anti-manipulation provisions in the TPP is that they would imperil America’s ability to implement monetary stimulus.

zh: 但这反映出对这一问题的彻底误解。
en: But this reflects a thorough misunderstanding of the issue.

zh: 精心制定的TPP货币条款不会妨碍美国的货币独立性。
en: A well-designed currency chapter in the TPP would not impede US monetary independence.

zh: 传统货币政策通过改变短期利率执行，包括央行买入和卖出短期政府债务。
en: Conventional monetary policy operates by altering short-term interest rates, which includes the central bank buying and selling short-term government debt.

zh: 外汇市场干预 — — 买入和卖出外国货币 — — 并不包括在其中。
en: No intervention in the foreign-exchange market – buying and selling foreign currency – is involved.

zh: 类似地，近几年来成为众多主要央行货币政策主流的量化宽松（QE）并不包括买入和卖出外国资产。
en: Similarly, the quantitative easing (QE) that has defined many major central banks’ monetary policy in recent years does not involve buying or selling foreign assets.

zh: 在QE下，美联储购买 — — 并宣布它将购买 — — 资产；唯一的区别是这些资产是长期限美国政府债务工具和各种按揭抵押债券，它们均为美元计价。
en: Under QE, the Federal Reserve buys – and announces that it will buy – assets; the only difference is that these assets are longer-maturity US government debt instruments and mortgage-backed securities of various kinds, all denominated in US dollars.

zh: 第四个理由是没有哪个主要国家目前正在操纵汇率（2005年以来人民币有所升值 ） ， 因此没有什么好担心的。
en: The fourth argument is that no major country is currently manipulating its exchange rate (the renminbi has appreciated since the mid-2000s), so there is nothing to worry about.

zh: 但如果中国或其他任何国家选择大规模干预货币市场，也没有什么可以阻止它们。
en: But there is also nothing to stop China or any other country from resuming large-scale currency-market intervention if and when it chooses.

zh: 而如今在汇率上不存在外交紧张局面意味着正是提出这个问题的好时机。
en: And the lack of diplomatic tension around exchange rates today makes this a good moment to raise the topic.

zh: 支持将货币条款排除在TPP之外的最后一个理由是谈判TPP的国家永远不会同意。
en: The final reason cited in support of excluding a currency chapter from the TPP is that the countries negotiating the deal would never agree.

zh: 但如果逐一考察参与国，这一理由就不再成立了。
en: But this argument does not hold up when the participating countries are examined one by one.

zh: 加拿大、澳大利亚和新西兰是浮动汇率发达经济体，它们不想鼓励货币操纵。
en: Canada, Australia, and New Zealand, developed economies with floating exchange rates, do not want to encourage currency manipulation.

zh: 智利是宏观政策长期可靠的中等收入国家，不支持货币操纵。
en: Chile, a middle-income country that has long had sound and responsible macroeconomic policies, does not favor currency manipulation.

zh: 墨西哥和秘鲁十分担心其他国家再次变成货币操纵国。
en: Mexico and Peru have much to fear from other countries becoming currency manipulators again.

zh: 类似地，目前正在国内采取QE的日本担心其他国家（如韩国和中国）的潜在货币操纵。
en: Likewise, Japan, now running its own version of QE, worries about potential currency manipulation by other countries, such as South Korea and China.

zh: 马来西亚和新加坡建立了巨大的外汇储备存量，现在应该更担心贸易伙伴国的货币操纵。
en: Malaysia and Singapore, having built up a substantial stock of foreign-exchange reserves, should also now be more concerned about currency manipulation by their trading partners.

zh: 越南有更加重要的TPP问题需要解决，特别是劳动权利等问题。
en: Vietnam has much more serious TPP issues to resolve, particularly concerning labor rights.

zh: 而文莱的人口只有区区50万，它不可能提出反对意见。
en: And Brunei Darussalam, with a population of less than 500,000, is unlikely to object.

zh: 货币操纵是可以造成的重大伤害的现实问题。
en: Currency manipulation is a real problem that causes significant damage.

zh: TPP协议 — — 如果能建立可以快速解决无理要求、将注意力集中在真正问题上的纠纷解决机制 — — 可以成为解决这一问题的最好机会。
en: The TPP deal – if it establishes a dispute-resolution mechanism that can quickly dismiss frivolous claims and home in on genuine cases – may offer the best chance to fix it.

zh: 货币操纵的伪装
en: The Currency Manipulation Charade

zh: 纽黑文—美国国会为了跨太平洋洋合作伙伴关系（ Trans-Pacific Partnership ，总统奥巴马的标志性贸易立法）而吵到不可开交隐显一个重大障碍。
en: NEW HAVEN – As the US Congress grapples with the ever-contentious Trans-Pacific Partnership – President Barack Obama’s signature trade legislation – a major stumbling block looms.

zh: 5月22日，参议院以微弱多数 — — 51比48 — — 避免了这一障碍成为现实 — — 在授予奥巴马所谓的“快车道”TPP谈判权的立法中不加入“货币操纵”修正条款。
en: On May 22, the Senate avoided it, by narrowly defeating – 51 to 48 – a proposed “currency manipulation” amendment to a bill that gives Obama so-called “fast-track” authority to negotiate the TPP.

zh: 但这一问题可能随着争论战场转移到众议院而死灰复燃，在众议院，对“强制性货币规则”的支持十分强大。
en: But the issue could be resurrected as the debate shifts to the House of Representatives, where support is strong for “enforceable currency rules.”

zh: 至少十年来，国会一直关注货币操纵 — — 指控一些国家刻意干预外汇市场以抑制本币价值，从而补贴出口。
