en: For at least a decade, Congress has been focusing on currency manipulation – a charge leveled at countries that purportedly intervene in foreign-exchange markets in order to suppress their currencies’ value, thereby subsidizing exports.

zh: 2005年，纽约州自由派民主党参议员查尔斯·舒默（Charles Schumer）和南加州保守派共和党参议员林赛·格雷厄姆（Lindsey Graham）组成了一个不可能的联盟，捍卫身陷重围的美国工人免受不公平的竞争手段的影响。
en: In 2005, Senators Charles Schumer, a liberal Democrat from New York, and Lindsey Graham, a conservative Republican from South Carolina, formed an unlikely alliance to defend beleaguered middle-class US workers from supposedly unfair competitive practices.

zh: 他们指出，停止货币操纵能让美国巨大的贸易赤字减小 — — 给困难重重的工人带来持续的真正福利。
en: Stop the currency manipulation, went the argument, and America’s gaping trade deficit would narrow – providing lasting and meaningful benefits to hard-pressed workers.

zh: 十年前，最初的舒默-格雷厄姆提案赤裸裸地针对中国。
en: A decade ago, the original Schumer-Graham proposal was a thinly veiled anti-China initiative.

zh: 促使他们提出提案的怒火今天仍然存在 — — 2014年美国的商贸赤字依然巨大，而中国占了其中的47 % 。
en: The ire that motivated that proposal remains today, with China accounting for 47% of America’s still outsize merchandise trade deficit in 2014.

zh: 自1995年年中以来，人民币兑美元升值了33 % ， 国际货币基金组织（IMF）已不再认为人民币被低估；中国的经常项目盈余占GDP之比也从2007年的10%降低到2014年的2 % （ 估计值 ） 。
en: Never mind that the Chinese renminbi has risen some 33% against the US dollar since mid-1995 to a level that the International Monetary Fund no longer considers undervalued, or that China’s current-account surplus has shrunk from 10% of GDP in 2007 to an estimated 2% in 2014.

zh: 但这些都不重要。 中国仍然是认为美国工人受害于不公平贸易行为的美国政客的眼中钉。
en: China remains in the crosshairs of US politicians who believe that American workers are the victims of its unfair trading practices.

zh: 尽管这一论调在情绪上和政治上颇具号召力，但却是严重错误的，因为美国存在着严重的储蓄问题。
en: While this argument has great emotional and political appeal, it is deeply flawed, because the United States has an insidious saving problem.

zh: 美国的净国民储蓄率 — — 家庭、企业和政府储蓄总和（经老化产能折旧调整 ） — —目前占国民收入的2.5 % 。
en: America’s net national saving rate – the sum total of household, business, and government saving (adjusted for the depreciation of aging capacity) – currently stands at 2.5% of national income.

zh: 这比2008—2011年间为负的储蓄率已经好了不少，但仍远低于二十世纪最后三十年6.3%的平均水平。
en: While that is better than the negative saving rates of 2008-2011, it remains well short of the 6.3% average of the final three decades of the twentieth century.

zh: 储蓄不足又想增长，美国就必须从国外进口储蓄盈余。
en: Lacking in saving and wanting to grow, America must import surplus savings from abroad.

zh: 而要吸引外国资本，唯一的办法是保持等量国际收支赤字。
en: And to attract that foreign capital, it has no choice but to run equally large balance-of-payments deficits.

zh: 因此，美国经济存在 长期经常项目赤字绝非偶然。
en: So it is no coincidence that the US economy has a chronic current-account deficit.

zh: 尽管这一缺口已从2006年占GDP的5.8%的最高峰下降到2014年的占GDP的2.4 % ， 但仍意味着美国要想增长就必须严重依赖外国储蓄盈余。
en: While this shortfall has narrowed from a peak of 5.8% of GDP in 2006 to 2.4% in 2014, it still leaves the US heavily dependent on surplus foreign savings in order to grow.

zh: 贸易赤字就是这样来的。
en: This is where the trade deficit comes into play.

zh: 美国不只是凭空吸收外国储蓄盈余。
en: The US does not just pluck surplus foreign savings out of thin air.

zh: 要吸引它需要的资本，美国必须通过对外贸易输出美元。
en: To attract the capital it needs, America must send dollars overseas through foreign trade.

zh: 货币操纵论的命门就在这里。
en: And it is here that the currency manipulation argument falls apart.

zh: 2014年，美国对95个国家存在贸易赤字。
en: In 2014, the US ran trade deficits with some 95 countries.

zh: 换句话说，美国所存在的不是可以归结为中国、日本、马来西亚和新加坡等国家贸易操纵的小额双边贸易赤字。
en: In other words, America does not suffer from a small number of bilateral trade deficits that can be tied to charges of currency manipulation by countries like China, Japan, Malaysia, or Singapore.

zh: 相反，美国存在的是对大量国家的多边贸易失衡，而这无法通过关税等双边惩罚措施解决。
en: Rather, the US suffers from a multilateral trade imbalance with many countries, and this cannot be remedied through the imposition of bilateral penalties such as tariffs.

zh: 不解决储蓄问题，限制与少数所谓货币操纵国的贸易只能让美国的贸易赤字转移到其他贸易伙伴身上。
en: Without fixing its savings problem, restricting trade with a few so-called currency manipulators would simply redistribute the US trade deficit to its other trading partners.

zh: 事实上，美国的贸易平衡就像是一个水囊 — — 你朝一点施加压力只能让水从其他地方鼓出。
en: In effect, America’s trade balance is like a water balloon – applying pressure on one spot would simply cause the water to slosh elsewhere.

zh: 此外，这一方针极有可能弄巧成拙。
en: Moreover, this approach could easily backfire.

zh: 比如，假设美国国内储蓄不增，则以货币操纵为由惩罚中国等低成本生产国极有可能导致中国占美国贸易赤字的比重转移到成本更高的生产国身上。
en: For example, assuming that there is no increase in domestic US saving, penalizing a low-cost producer like China for currency manipulation would most likely cause the Chinese piece of America’s trade deficit to be reallocated to higher-cost producers.

zh: 这在功能上等同于对中产阶级家庭增税，而中产阶级正是国会最关心的选民。
en: That would be the functional equivalent of a tax hike on middle-class families – precisely the constituency that so concerns Congress.

zh: 让政客决定货币操纵的结论（应该取决于某些“公平价值”指标来做决定）还会造成其他副作用。
en: Further complications would arise from putting the verdict on currency manipulation – presumably dependent on some type of “fair value” metric – in the hands of politicians.

zh: 这也是国会最大的伪善。
en: This is also the twist that underscores the ultimate congressional hypocrisy.

zh: 货币操纵指控无非是美国逃避解决国内储蓄问题的责任的幌子。
en: The charge of currency manipulation is nothing but a foil for the US to duck responsibility for fixing America’s saving problem.

zh: 美国政客拿不出刺激储蓄的战略 — — 不仅仅是解决联邦政府预算赤字的长期办法，还包括有意义的个人储蓄激励 — — 因而转向了速效办法。
en: Lacking any semblance of a strategy to boost savings – not just a long-term fix to the federal government’s budget deficit, but also meaningful incentives for personal saving – US politicians have turned to yet another quick fix.

zh: 最终，周旋余地将耗尽。 如果国会不喜欢贸易赤字，就需要解决美国的储蓄问题并停止关注完全无关紧要的货币操纵问题。
en: In the end, there is no way around it: If Congress does not like trade deficits, it needs to address America’s saving problem and stop fixating on misplaced concerns over currency manipulation.

zh: 所有这些都不是说美国应该忽视不公平贸易行为。
en: None of this is to argue that the US should ignore unfair trading practices.

zh: 作为世界贸易组织成员国，美国有的是机会用高机构的纠纷解决机制裁决与其贸易伙伴的重大问题。
en: As a member of the World Trade Organization, the US has ample opportunity to use that body’s dispute-resolution mechanism to adjudicate major problems with its trading partners.

zh: 并且美国用这一方法取得了成功。
en: And it has enjoyed success with this approach.

zh: 国会决不能假装采取让对方措手不及的贸易政策就可以掩盖其无力或不愿将着眼点重新聚焦于国内政策日程上的问题。
en: What Congress cannot do is pretend that wrong-footed trade policy is the answer to its inability or unwillingness to refocus its domestic policy agenda.

zh: 当然，指责别人永远比自我批评容易。
en: Of course, it is always easier to blame others than to look in the mirror.

zh: 但历史对于重大贸易错误向来绝不宽容。
en: But history has not been kind to major trade blunders.

zh: 1930年斯穆特-霍利关税法（Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act）挑起了一场全球贸易战，大萧条之所以成为“大 ” ， 原因恐怕就在于此，而今天国会颁布强制性货币规则可能引起报复性措施，给停滞不前的全球经济所急需的贸易流造成灾难性打击。
en: Just as the Smoot-Hawley Tariff Act of 1930 sparked a global trade war that may well have put the “great” in the Great Depression, Congressional enactment of enforceable currency rules today could spark retaliatory actions that might devastate the free flow of trade that a sluggish global economy desperately needs.

zh: 美国参议院拒绝这一危险选项的决定是明智的。
en: The US Senate was wise in rejecting this dangerous option.

zh: 我们只能希望众议院也能拥有相同的智慧。
en: We can only hope that similar wisdom prevails in the House of Representatives.

zh: 货币操纵立法是一场可以也应该避免的悲剧。
en: Currency manipulation legislation is one tragedy that can and should be avoided.

zh: 货币操纵传说
en: The Myth of Currency Manipulation

zh: 东京—本月，日元兑美元汇率跌至125以下，创出13年来新低，随后，日本银行行长黑田东彦表示预计日元不会继续贬值，日元也随之反弹至122附近。
en: TOKYO – This month, the Japanese yen’s exchange rate against the US dollar fell below ¥125, a 13-year low, before rebounding to nearly ¥122 following a statement by Bank of Japan Governor Haruhiko Kuroda that he did not expect further depreciation.

zh: 但是，黑田随后澄清，日本货币决策者不会预测，更不会控制汇率波动。
en: But, as Kuroda later clarified, Japan’s monetary policymakers do not seek to predict, much less control, exchange-rate movements.

zh: 相反，日本银行的目标 — — 与任何高效央行一样 — — 是确保合理的就业和通胀组合。
en: Instead, the BOJ’s goal – like that of any effective central bank – is to ensure the right combination of employment and inflation.

zh: 当然，一国货币政策确实会在短期影响汇率。
en: Of course, a country’s monetary policy does affect exchange rates in the short term.

zh: 但只有在与其他相关国家的货币政策有关时才会有这一效果。
en: But it does so only in relation to monetary policy in other relevant countries.

zh: 对于今天的日本来说，汇率与其说由本国货币扩张决定，不如说由美国转向货币紧缩决定。 此前，美联储的大规模量化宽松给日元造成了升值压力。
en: In the case of Japan today, the exchange rate is being determined less by its own monetary expansion than by America’s move toward monetary tightening, following a period during which massive quantitative easing (QE) by the US Federal Reserve put upward pressure on the yen.

zh: 一国也可以通过直接干预外汇市场影响短期汇率。
en: A country can also influence the short-term exchange rate by intervening directly in the foreign-exchange market.

zh: 但这类干预十分复杂 — — 不仅是因为它们必须考虑该国货币政策方针与相关国家货币政策方针之间的关系。
en: But such interventions are complicated – not least because they must account for the relationship between the country’s monetary-policy approach and that of other relevant countries.

zh: 此外，如果（比如）美国的目标是1美元兑100日元，而日本的目标是120日元，那么结果不但可能包括美国和日本之间出现紧张；不相容的汇率目标还有可能引发更广的市场波动，波及其他经济体。
en: Moreover, if, for example, the United States aims for ¥100 per dollar, while Japan aims for ¥120 per dollar, the result could be not only rising tension between the US and Japan; incompatible exchange-rate targets could also trigger broader market volatility, with spillover effects on other economies.

zh: 基于此，货币政策仍是最有效的汇率运动驱动因素。
en: Given this, monetary policy remains the most effective driver of exchange-rate movements.

zh: 确保有利的汇率平衡的关键是追求旨在确保合意国内通胀和就业组合的政策。
en: The key to ensuring a satisfactory exchange-rate balance is for countries to pursue policies aimed at ensuring a desirable combination of domestic inflation and employment.

zh: 如果（比如）满足国内通胀和就业目标需要加强货币宽松 — — 这会给本币带来贬值压力，提振经济的国际竞争力 — — 那么其他国家也许也不得不追求货币扩张以维持最优国内通胀和就业率。
en: If, for example, meeting domestic inflation and employment targets requires greater monetary expansion – which will place downward pressure on the local currency, bolstering the economy’s international competitiveness – other countries may have to pursue their own monetary expansion to maintain optimal domestic inflation and employment rates.

zh: 这正是全球经济危机后发生的情况。
en: That is precisely what happened after the global economic crisis.

zh: 美国为了阻止通缩和失业恶化，推出了大规模量化宽松计划，英国则紧跟着美国的步伐。
en: The US, in an effort to prevent deflation and stem rising unemployment, initiated a massive QE program, with the United Kingdom following suit.

zh: 一开始，日本银行对于据此调整货币政策显得相当犹豫，坐视日元升值 — — 这一决定导致日本长期停滞的经济陷入了衰退。
en: At first, the Bank of Japan hesitated to adjust its monetary policy accordingly, allowing the yen to appreciate – a decision that drove the country’s long-stagnant economy into recession.

zh: 幸运的是，2013年上台的首相安倍晋三认识到货币宽松的必要性，将其作为他的经济改革和复苏战略 — — 即所谓的“安倍经济学”的三支“箭”之一。
en: Fortunately, when Prime Minister Shinzo Abe came to power in 2013, he recognized the need for monetary expansion, making it one of the three “arrows” of his strategy – dubbed Abenomics – for economic reform and recovery.

zh: 这一方针变化让日本得以阻止了日元的升值、迈向更强劲的增长，同时也没有妨碍美国或英国推进自身货币政策目标的能力。
en: Thanks to this change in approach, Japan was able to arrest the yen’s appreciation and move toward stronger growth, without undermining the ability of the US or the UK to advance their own monetary-policy objectives.

zh: 能做出这样的调整是浮动汇率制度的特点；事实上，四十多年来，这一再证明是全球宏观经济稳定的关键。
en: The capacity for such adjustments is the hallmark of the flexible exchange-rate system; indeed, for more than four decades, it has proved time and again to be the key to global macroeconomic stability.

zh: 在一战后的岁月中，采取独立货币政策的国家复苏速度要快于仍采取金本位的国家。
en: As long ago as the period following World War I, countries that adopted an independent monetary policy recovered faster than those that remained locked into the gold standard.

zh: 但一些经济学家和记者担心各国为了获得全球市场优势，会采取竞争性贬值，引发大规模通货膨胀。
en: Yet some economists and journalists fear that countries, in attempting to gain an advantage in global markets, will engage in competitive devaluations, triggering large-scale inflation in the process.

zh: 这些担忧甚至进入了大型地区自由贸易协定的讨论中 — — 如目前正在谈判中的美国和欧盟的跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系。
en: Such concerns have even made their way into debates about the mega-regional free-trade agreements – namely, the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership between the US and the European Union, and the Trans-Pacific Partnership – that are currently being negotiated.

zh: 如今，许多人要求将可执行的禁止所谓“货币操纵”条款纳入协定中。
en: Many are now calling for the inclusion of enforceable provisions prohibiting so-called “currency manipulation.”

zh: 纳入这些条款将是一个错误 — — 因为汇率问题本质上与贸易协议无关。
en: Including such provisions would be a mistake – not least because exchange-rate issues are intrinsically irrelevant to trade deals.

zh: 事实上，这一方针 — — 它有可能导致给相关经济体带来无穷好处的协定流产 — — 建立在一个谬误的基础上。
en: In fact, such an approach – which has the potential to derail agreements that would bring considerable benefits to the economies involved – is based on a fallacy.

zh: 除非各国直接干预追求互相矛盾的汇率目标，否则就不可能爆发能导致普遍通胀的“货币战争 ” 。
en: Unless countries are using direct intervention to pursue contradictory exchange-rate goals, a “currency war” that generates widespread inflation is highly unlikely.

zh: 如果各国按照本国国内宏观经济目标制定货币政策，汇率将自然形成帕累托（或最大）有效状态。
en: If each country tailors its monetary policy to domestic macroeconomic objectives, exchange rates will settle naturally in a state of Pareto (or maximum) efficiency.

zh: 经济学家杰弗里·弗兰克尔（Jeffrey Frankel）将货币操纵称为“喀迈拉 ” （ chimera ） ， 认为“将阻止货币操纵的措施与贸易协定挂钩过去一直是、现在也是坏主意。
en: The economist Jeffrey Frankel has called currency manipulation a chimera, declaring that “linking efforts to prevent currency manipulation to trade agreements has always been a bad idea, and it still is.”

zh: ”他是正确的。
en: He is right.

zh: 这样做违背了浮动汇率机制最根本的规则：每个经济体都可以制定 — — 和追求 — — 自身的货币政策目标。
en: Doing so would controvert the most fundamental rule of a flexible exchange-rate regime: that each economy can set – and pursue – its own monetary-policy goals.

zh: 经常账户的重要意义
en: The Current Account Counts

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 在日益紧密关联的全球经济中，跨境贸易和金融-资本方面的联系变得比以往任何时候都更加重要。
en: NEW HAVEN – In an increasingly interconnected global economy, cross-border trade and financial-capital linkages have come to matter more than ever.

zh: 而经常账户余额，即国家投资和储蓄头寸之间的差，则是理解这类联系的关键。
en: The current-account balance, the difference between a country’s investment and saving position, is key to understanding these linkages.

zh: 多个经常账户头寸的离散状况非常有助于我们了解全球失衡的状况，而这通常也是危机的先兆。
en: The dispersion of current-account positions tells us much about the state of global imbalances, which are often a precursor of crises.

zh: 贸易紧张局势也是如此，正如当前在世界各地所展现的那样。
en: The same is true of trade tensions, such as those now evident around the world.

zh: 经常账户差异往往会令一个国家与另一个国家产生对立。
en: Current-account disparities often pit one country against another.

zh: 背负经常账户赤字的经济体往往会被国内储蓄不足的困扰。
en: Economies running current-account deficits tend to suffer from a deficiency of domestic saving.

zh: 在缺乏储蓄却又希望实现投资、消费和增长的状况下，它们别无选择，只能从其他国家那里借入过剩的储蓄，从而导致与世界其他地区的经常账户和贸易逆差。
en: Lacking in saving and wanting to invest, consume, and grow, they have no choice but to borrow surplus saving from others, which gives rise to current-account and trade deficits with the rest of the world.

zh: 而拥有经常账户盈余的国家的情况则恰恰相反。
en: The opposite is the case for countries with current-account surpluses.

zh: 它们经常受到低消费水平，过度储蓄和长期性贸易顺差的折磨。
en: They are afflicted by subpar consumption, excess saving, and chronic trade surpluses.

zh: 各界也一直在争论谁应该为这种状况负责 — — 是那些肆意从其他国家抽取资金来资助自身经济增长的赤字国家，还是那些选择通过向国外市场出口产品来增长的盈余国家。
en: There is a long-standing debate over who is to blame for this state of affairs – the deficit countries, which draw freely on the saving of others to finance economic growth, or the surplus countries, which choose to grow by selling their output in foreign markets.

zh: 这种互相指责长期以来都是国际经济政策和贸易紧张局势争端的核心内容，当下尤其如此。
en: This blame game, which has long been central to disputes over international economic policy and trade tensions, is particularly contentious today.

zh: 美国是世界上经常账户失衡规模最为庞大的国家。
en: The United States has the largest current-account imbalance in the world.

zh: 该国自1982年至今一直都维持着赤字局面，唯一的例外是1991年，当时各国对其波斯湾军事行动的献金使之产生了些许盈余（相当于GDP的0.05 ％ ） 。
en: It has recorded a deficit for all but one year since 1982, the sole exception being 1991, when foreign contributions to its military campaign in the Persian Gulf underpinned a miniscule surplus (0.05% of GDP).

zh: 在2000~2017年间，美国积累了9.1万亿美元的累积经常账户赤字。
en: During the 2000-2017 period, the US amassed $9.1 trillion in cumulative current-account deficits.

zh: 这比同期三大盈余经济体 — — 德国，中国和日本 — — 共计8.9万亿美元的累计盈余还要多。
en: That is larger than the $8.9 trillion of cumulative surpluses run collectively by the three largest surplus economies – Germany, China, and Japan – over the same period.

zh: 许多观察人士认为，美国借助长期经常账户赤字对世界其他地区做出了巨大贡献 — — 也就是支撑了大量经常遭受国内需求短缺困扰的盈余国家。
en: Many observers believe that the US is doing the rest of the world a huge favor by running chronic current-account deficits – namely, supporting the large surplus countries, which tend to suffer from a shortfall of domestic demand.

zh: 包括我在内的其他人则更倾向于批评美国长期以来对过度消费的偏好以及盈余经济体在实现这一点上所扮演的角色。
en: Others, including me, are more critical of America’s long-standing penchant for excess consumption and the role that surplus economies play in enabling it.

zh: 虽然双方的观点无疑都有可取之处，但我更担心的是美国的破坏稳定效应。
en: While there is undoubtedly some validity to both points of view, I worry more about the destabilizing role of the US.

zh: 美国这种先消费后储蓄的思维方式是其经常账户赤字的核心，也深深植根于其政治经济中。
en: America’s consume-now-save-later mindset, which is at the heart of its current-account deficit, is deeply embedded in its political economy.

zh: 长期以来美国税法一直鼓励低储蓄和债务融资消费；抵押贷款利息可以用来抵扣应缴税收入，没有任何增值税或国家销售税，而储蓄激励措施的缺失则尤其成问题。
en: The US tax code has long been biased toward low saving and debt-financed consumption; the deductibility of mortgage interest, the absence of any value-added or national sales tax, and a dearth of saving incentives are especially problematic.

zh: 而近期资产泡沫的财富效应也是如此。
en: So, too, are the wealth effects from a profusion of recent asset bubbles.

zh: 自1990年代末以来，在美联储超级调和政策的协助和怂恿下，美国这种依赖资产的经济形式与那个由泡沫估值下的抵押品承保的、同样有害的杠杆周期之间的相互作用就从未消停过。
en: Aided and abetted by the Federal Reserve’s über-accommodation since the late 1990s, there was no stopping the interplay between America’s asset-dependent economy and an equally pernicious leverage cycle underwritten by bubble-inflated collateral.

zh: 既然充满泡沫的资产市场已经打理好了一切，干嘛还要储蓄？
en: Why save out of income when frothy asset markets can do the job?

zh: 而美国经常账户赤字的核心就是这种将基于资产的储蓄置于基于收入的储蓄之上的偏好。
en: The preference for asset-based saving over income-based saving is central to America’s current-account deficit.

zh: 盈余国家也欣然配合这一做法。
en: The surplus countries have been delighted to go along for the ride.

zh: 在它们眼中美国消费狂潮的基础牢不牢靠并不重要。
en: It didn’t matter that the US consumption binge was built on a foundation of quicksand.

zh: 各大盈余经济体的过度出口增长导致了这个全球最大消费国的过度消费。
en: Excess export growth in the large surplus economies enabled the excesses of the world’s largest consumer.

zh: 中国在这方面尤为突出。
en: That was especially the case in China.

zh: 在邓小平“改革开放”政策的推动下，中国的出口部门增长了六倍 — — 从1980年占GDP的6％增长到2006年的36 ％ 。
en: Spurred by Deng Xiaoping’s “reform and opening up,” China’s export sector increased sixfold – from 6% of GDP in 1980 to 36% in 2006.

zh: 反衬美国庞大的经常账户赤字，中国的经常账户从1980年的相对平衡（相当于GDP的+0.1 ％ ） 发展到2007年危机前的9.9％的大比例盈余。
en: Mirroring America’s massive current-account deficit, China’s current account went from relative balance in 1980 (+0.1% of GDP) to a massive surplus of 9.9% in pre-crisis 2007.

zh: 各主要发达经济体的情况也是如此，只不过没那么极端：德国的出口占GDP份额从1980年的19％上升到2007年的43 ％ ， 而同期日本则从13％上升到了17.5 ％ 。
en: The same was true in major developed economies, albeit to a lesser extreme: Germany’s export share of GDP went from 19% in 1980 to 43% in 2007, while Japan’s went from 13% to 17.5% over the same period.

zh: 在许多方面，盈余国家和赤字国家之间的互利式联手最终发展成为全面的相互依存关系。
en: In many respects, a marriage of convenience between the surplus and deficit countries eventually blossomed into full-blown codependency.

zh: 但随着2008年全球金融危机的爆发，一切戛然而止。
en: But then, with the wrenching global financial crisis in 2008, the music stopped.

zh: 从那以后，赤字和盈余国家之间的摩擦加剧，如今甚至可能升级成全面贸易战。
en: Since then, frictions between deficit and surplus countries have intensified, now risking the possibility of a full-blown trade war.

zh: 特朗普政府在声称美国是巨额贸易逆差的受害者方面发挥了特别对抗性的角色。
en: President Donald Trump’s administration has played an especially antagonistic role in asserting that the US is being victimized by large trade deficits.

zh: 但事实上美国的贸易逆差其实是其国内储蓄长期不足所引发的。
en: Yet America’s trade gaps have, in fact, been spawned by a chronic deficiency of domestic US saving.

zh: 尽管政府近期向上修正了依旧低迷的个人储蓄率数据，但驱动着经常账户的美国国民储蓄率仍然惨不忍睹，2009~2017年这段后危机时期的平均净储蓄率仅为1.9 ％ （ 排除折旧因素 ） ， 还不到二十世纪最后三十年平均6.3％水平的1/3。
en: Despite the government’s recent upward revision to a still-depressed personal saving rate, the overall US national saving rate, which drives the current account, remains woefully deficient, averaging just 1.9% in net terms (adjusted for depreciation) over the post-crisis 2009-17 period. That is less than one-third the 6.3% average during the final three decades of the twentieth century.

zh: 未来几年规模庞大且不断增加的联邦预算赤字只会加剧这一问题。
en: Large and growing federal budget deficits over the next several years will only exacerbate this problem.

zh: 将此归咎于中国忽略了近年来中国经常账户盈余大幅下降这一明确而重要的事实 — — 从2007年相当于GDP9.9％降到了2018年的1 ％ 。
en: Blaming China misses the obvious and important point that the Chinese current-account surplus has fallen sharply in recent years, from 9.9% of GDP in 2007 to an estimated 1% in 2018.

zh: 2017年中国的经常账户顺差为1650亿美元，低于德国（2970亿美元）和日本（1950亿美元 ） 。
en: In 2017, China’s current-account surplus of $165 billion was well below that of Germany ($297 billion) and Japan ($195 billion).

zh: 随着中国积极推动以消费者为主导的再平衡政策，它将继续从储蓄盈余转向储蓄吸收，其经常账户状况也很可能转变为长期赤字（事实上今年第一季度就录得了小额赤字 ） 。
en: As China presses ahead with consumer-led rebalancing, it will continue to move from surplus saving to saving absorption, with the distinct possibility that its current account will shift into permanent deficit (a small deficit actually was recorded in the first quarter of this year).

zh: 这意味着又少了一个盈余国家来为偏好赤字的美国自身那种储蓄短缺、过度消费的经济增长提供资金。
en: That will leave a deficit-prone America with one less surplus country to draw on in funding the growth of its saving-short, excess-consumption economy.

zh: 也许世界其他地方会崛起并填补空白，但随着特朗普政府日益脱离全球化，这似乎变得越来越不可能。
en: Maybe the rest of the world will step up and fill the void. But with the Trump administration now disengaging from globalization, that seems less and less likely.

zh: 历史表明经常账户失衡最终会产生重大影响。
en: History suggests that current-account imbalances ultimately matter a great deal.

zh: 一个仍然不平衡的全球经济可能会在未来几年间被迫重温以往的痛苦教训。
en: A still-unbalanced global economy may be forced to relearn that painful lesson in the coming years.

zh: 财政悬崖的教训
en: Lessons from the Fiscal Cliff

zh: 美国剑桥—我从米尔顿·弗里德曼那里学到了很多东西，其中之一是，政府的真正成本是其支出，而不是其税收。
en: CAMBRIDGE – One of the many things I learned from Milton Friedman is that the true cost of government is its spending, not its taxes.

zh: 换句话说，支出要么用当前税收融资，要么借钱融资，而借来的钱无非是未来的税收，它对经济表现的影响和当前税收无甚区别。
en: To put it another way, spending is financed either by current taxes or through borrowing, and borrowing amounts to future taxes, which have almost the same impact on economic performance as current taxes.

zh: 我们可以把这一原理用于美国不可持续的财政赤字。
en: We can apply this reasoning to the United States’ unsustainable fiscal deficit.

zh: 众所周知，消除这一赤字要么通过减支，要么通过增税。
en: As is well known, closing this deficit requires less spending or more taxes.

zh: 传统观点认为合理、平衡的方法将兼顾两者。
en: The conventional view is that a reasonable, balanced approach entails some of each.

zh: 但是，正如弗里德曼所指出的，这两个方法是南辕北辙的。
en: But, as Friedman would have argued, the two methods should be considered polar opposites.

zh: 减支意味着政府变小。
en: Less spending means that the government will be smaller.

zh: 增税意味着政府变大。
en: More taxes mean that the government will be larger.

zh: 因此，偏好小政府者（比如某些共和党）希望完全通过减支来消除赤字；而偏好大政府者（比如总统奥巴马和大部分民主党）希望完全通过增税来消除赤字。
en: Hence, people who favor smaller government (for example, some Republicans) will want the deficit closed entirely by cutting spending, whereas those who favor larger government (for example, President Barack Obama and most Democrats) will want the deficit closed entirely by raising taxes.

zh: 经济学家阿尔贝托·阿勒西纳（Alberto Alesina）研究了经合组织国家的财务稳定状况，发现通过减支消除财政赤字比通过增税对经济好得多。
en: As the economist Alberto Alesina has found from studies of fiscal stabilization in OECD countries, eliminating fiscal deficits through spending cuts tends to be much better for the economy than eliminating them through tax increases.

zh: 一个自然的解释是，支出调整之所以效果更佳，是因为这意味着小政府，从而有利于经济增长。
en: A natural interpretation is that spending adjustments work better because they promise smaller government, thereby favoring economic growth.

zh: 对于给定的政府规模，征税的方法会产生影响。
en: For a given size of government, the method of raising tax revenue matters.

zh: 比如，我们可以选择通过一般所得税、工资税、消费税（比如销售税或增值税）等税种征多少税。
en: For example, we can choose how much to collect via a general income tax, a payroll tax, a consumption tax (such as a sales or value-added tax), and so on.

zh: 我们也可以选择在今天而不是未来（通过改变财政赤字水平）征多少税。
en: We can also choose how much revenue to raise today, rather than in the future (by varying the fiscal deficit).

zh: 有效税收制度的一个一般原则是以对总体经济扭曲程度尽可能小的方式征收给定数量（对应政府长期支出水平）的税额。
en: A general principle for an efficient tax system is to collect a given amount of revenue (corresponding in the long run to the government’s spending) in a way that causes as little distortion as possible to the overall economy.

zh: 通常，这一原则意味着不同水平劳动所得、不同类型消费以及不同征收时间（现在或将来）的边际税率应该相似。
en: Usually, this principle means that marginal tax rates should be similar at different levels of labor income, for various types of consumption, for outlays today versus tomorrow, and so on.

zh: 从这一点出发，美国个人所得税制度的一个缺陷是最底层和最顶层的边际税率太高，前者是因为福利计划，后者是因为累进率结构。
en: From this perspective, a shortcoming of the US individual income-tax system is that marginal tax rates are high at the bottom (because of means testing of welfare programs) and the top (because of the graduated-rate structure).

zh: 因此，自2009年政府一直在以错误的方式行事，极大地提高了底层边际税率（通过大幅增加转移支付项目 ） ， 最近又极大地提高了顶层边际税率（通过提高富人税率 ） 。
en: Thus, the government has moved in the wrong direction since 2009, sharply raising marginal tax rates at the bottom (by dramatically increasing transfer programs) and, more recently, at the top (by raising tax rates on the rich).

zh: 最有效的征税方法之一是美国工资税，该税种的边际税率接近于平均税率（因为不存在减税，税率结构的累进性也较低 ） 。
en: One of the most efficient tax-raising methods is the US payroll tax, for which the marginal tax rate is close to the average rate (because deductions are absent and there is little graduation in the rate structure).

zh: 因此，从有效征税的角度看，在2011—2012年降低工资税并增加（医保方面的）税率结构的累进性是错误的。
en: Therefore, cutting the payroll tax rate in 2011-2012 and making the rate schedule more graduated (on the Medicare side) were mistakes from the standpoint of efficient taxation.

zh: 共和党应该在评估2013年税收和支出变化时考虑这些观点。
en: Republicans should consider these ideas when evaluating tax and spending changes in 2013.

zh: 迈向“财政悬崖”本应具有大量削减政府开支的吸引力，尽管如何削减 — — 福利项目一分不减而防务支出削减太多 — — 并不具有吸引力。
en: Going over the “fiscal cliff” would have had the attraction of seriously cutting government spending, although the composition of the cuts – nothing from entitlements and too much from defense – was unattractive.

zh: 相应的税收收入增加倒至少是全面的，而非仅仅是已经实施的顶层边际税率的不均衡增加。
en: The associated revenue increase was, at least, across the board, rather than the unbalanced hike in marginal tax rates at the top that was enacted.

zh: 但避免财政悬崖妥协的最重要部分是重建有效工资税。
en: But the most important part of the deal to avert the fiscal cliff was the restoration of the efficient payroll tax.

zh: 我估计，将雇员税负提高2个百分点意味着未来十年增加1.4万亿美元税收。
en: I estimate that the rise by two percentage points in the amount collected from employees corresponds to about $1.4 trillion in revenue over ten years.

zh: 这笔巨大的税收增加并不计入标准报税表，因为2011—2012年收入税“假期”一直被视为是定向、临时的。
en: This serious revenue boost was not counted in standard reports, because the payroll-tax “holiday” for 2011-2012 had always been treated legally as temporary.

zh: 诚然，包括国会预算办公室在内的一些宏观经济建模者预测迈向财政悬崖可能早已导致了经济衰退。
en: It is true that some macroeconomic modelers, including the Congressional Budget Office, forecasted that going over the cliff would have caused a recession.

zh: 但这些报告都来自凯恩斯主义模型，而凯恩斯主义模型的预测永远是，随着政府的变大，GDP也会扩张。
en: But those results come from Keynesian models that always predict that GDP expands when the government gets larger.

zh: 完全忽视这些模型是更多政府以及关于财政问题如何解决的不确定性带来的消极影响。
en: Entirely absent from these models are the negative effects of more government and uncertainty about how fiscal problems will be resolved.

zh: 美国陷入另一场衰退不会令人意外，但其原因是坏政府政策和其他因素的合力，而不是削减政府规模。
en: Another recession in the US would not be a great surprise, but it can be attributed to an array of bad government policies and other forces, not to cutting the size of government.

zh: 事实上，削减政府支出应是“短期”应避免的措施以降低衰退可能性的观点是站不住脚的。
en: Indeed, it is nonsense to think that cuts in government spending should be avoided in the “short run” in order to lower the chance of a recession.

zh: 如果说小政府是长期好主意的话（我同意这一观点 ） ， 那么它在短期也是一个好主意。
en: If a smaller government is a good idea in the long run (as I believe it is), it is also a good idea in the short run.

zh: 为什么要给公司税收优惠？
en: Why Give Corporations a Tax Break?

zh: 伯克利—美国总统奥巴马提出将增加收入作为减少未来预算赤字的平衡计划的一部分。
en: BERKELEY – US President Barack Obama has called for additional revenue as part of a balanced plan to reduce future budget deficits.

zh: 但他还建议大幅降低公司税率。
en: But he is also proposing a significant cut in the corporate tax rate.

zh: 对很多人来说，这两点是相互矛盾的：难道不是应该提高而不是降低公司税率，从而让公司为赤字削减贡献“公平份额”吗？
en: To many, this approach seems inconsistent: Shouldn’t the corporate tax rate be raised, not lowered, so that corporations contribute their “fair share” to deficit reduction?

zh: 答案是否定的。
en: The answer is no.

zh: 1986年税法修订后，美国的公司税率为经合组织中最低之一。
en: After its 1986 tax overhaul, the United States had one of the lowest corporate tax rates among OECD countries.

zh: 自此以后，经合组织国家纷纷降低税率以吸引外国直接投资、阻止本国公司将经营和利润移到低税的外国。
en: Since then, these countries have been slashing their rates in order to attract foreign direct investment and discourage their own companies from shifting operations and profits to low-tax foreign locations.

zh: 英国政府最近激进地提出了将公司税率从28%降至20%的三年计划计划 — — 到2015年，其公司税率将是经合组织最低。
en: In the most recent and audacious move, the British government has embarked on a three-year plan to reduce its corporate tax rate from 28% to 20% – one of the lowest in the OECD – by 2015.

zh: 如今，美国是经合组织中公司税率最高的国家。
en: The US now has the highest corporate tax rate of these countries.

zh: 即使考虑各种扣除、豁免和其他减税条款，有效平均税率和边际税率 — — 即公司实际支付的税率 — — 仍高于经合组织平均值。
en: Even after incorporating various deductions, credits, and other tax-reducing provisions, the effective average and marginal corporate tax rates in the US – what corporations actually pay – are higher than the OECD average.

zh: 将税率削减至更具竞争力水平能刺激美国公司更多地投资国内，还能提高美国对外国投资者的吸引力。
en: Cutting the rate to a more competitive level would encourage more domestic investment by US corporations, and would also make the US more attractive to foreign investors.

zh: 资本流动性越来越强，国民公司税率的不同越来越影响到跨国公司经营活动和利润报告地的选择。
en: Capital has become increasingly mobile, and differences in national corporate tax rates have a growing influence on where multinational companies locate their operations and report their income.

zh: 国内外公司均增加在美投资能够刺激经济增长，与此同时，由此带来的资本增加 — — 新企业、工厂、设备和研究 — — 能够改善生产率。
en: Higher investment in the US by both domestic and foreign companies would boost economic growth, while the resulting increase in capital – new businesses, factories, equipment, and research –would improve productivity.

zh: 假以时日，这反过来能够提振真实工资（尽管生产率增长和工资增长的关系在过去二十年中有所减弱 ） 。
en: That should, in turn, boost real wages over time (although the link between productivity growth and wage growth has weakened during the last two decades).

zh: 用有利于增长来论证降低美国公司税的必要性十分有力，这也解释了为何奥巴马建议将税率从35%减至28 % （ 大约相当于其他发达国家的加权平均水平 ） 。
en: The pro-growth rationale for reducing the US corporate tax rate is compelling, and explains why Obama has proposed cutting it from 35% to 28% (roughly the weighted average rate of the other developed countries).

zh: 但税率下降带来的收入损失是巨大的：公司税率每削减一个百分点，未来十年公司税收入就会减少1000亿美元。
en: But a rate cut would be costly in terms of foregone revenues: each percentage point would reduce corporate-tax revenues by about $100 billion over the next decade.

zh: 此外，最新研究表明，公司税负担的很大一部分落在了资本头上，因此降低公司税率会减弱税收体系的累进性，而且这正逢收入不平等性高居历史最高水平的时期。
en: Moreover, recent studies indicate that a significant share of the corporate-tax burden falls on capital, so a reduction in corporate taxes would weaken the progressivity of the tax system at a time when income inequality is at an all-time high.

zh: 出于这些原因，奥巴马力推“收入中性”改革，即保持公司税收入不变，以限制减税、免税和偷漏税 — — 即扩大税基 — — 来填补为降低税率造成的收入下降。
en: For these reasons, Obama is championing a “revenue-neutral” reform that would leave corporate-tax revenues unchanged, with the proposed rate cut financed by limiting deductions, credits, and loopholes, which would broaden the tax base.

zh: 这些特征会增加税法的复杂性，增加依法纳税成本，减少公司税收入。
en: These features add complexity to the tax code, raise the cost of tax compliance, and reduce corporate-tax revenues.

zh: 它们还会影响企业投资何处、如何为投资融资、采取何种企业组织形式以及在何处生产的决策 — — 这些决策的背后是有效税率的巨大差异。
en: They also affect business decisions about what to invest in, how to finance investments, which form of business organization to adopt, and where to produce – reflecting sizeable differences in the effective tax rates behind these choices.

zh: 结果是扩大公司税基绝非易事。
en: As a result, broadening the corporate tax base will not be easy.

zh: 在公司部门内部，三大国内税收优惠是制造业生产扣减、研发免税和加速资本折旧。
en: Within the corporate sector, the three largest domestic tax preferences are the manufacturing production deduction, the credit for research and development, and accelerated depreciation of capital.

zh: 制造业公司是这些优惠措施的最大受益者，而奥巴马意在强化前两项。
en: Manufacturing companies are the major beneficiaries of these preferences, and Obama has proposed strengthening the first two.

zh: 他建议改革第三项，办法是通过限制加速折旧（其他一些发达国家已经开始实施这一做法）以抵消部分收入损失。
en: Instead, he suggests reforming the third by tightening allowances for accelerated depreciation (as several other developed countries have done) in order to offset some of the revenue losses.

zh: 但降低总体公司税率会增加过去投资的税后回报，而限制加速折旧会降低新投资的税后回报。
en: But reducing the overall corporate rate would increase after-tax returns on past investments, while limiting accelerated depreciation would lower after-tax returns on new investments.

zh: 即使取消加速折旧也不可能让税基扩大到足够的程度补偿税率削减至28%的损失。
en: And even eliminating accelerated depreciation would not broaden the tax base enough to finance a rate cut to 28%.

zh: 类似地，尽管限制公司净利息扣除（和其他许多发达国家一样）能够扩大税基、遏制过度依赖债务融资，但也会增加实体资本（通常通过债务融资获得）重大投资的税收负担。
en: Likewise, while limiting the deductibility of net interest for corporations, as many other developed countries have done, would broaden the tax base and discourage excessive reliance on debt financing, it would increase the tax burden on major investments in physical capital, which are often debt-financed.

zh: 减少非公司企业实体（如合伙制企业，这些企业的利��会转换为所有者的个人回报）税收优惠也能扩大公司利润税税基。
en: Reducing the tax preferences for non-corporate business entities (such as partnerships) that pass their income through to their owners’ individual returns would also broaden the tax base subject to the corporate-income tax.

zh: 利润转换公司目前产生着八成以上的企业净利润（此比例为发达国家中最高 ） 。
en: Pass-through companies now account for more than 80% of net business income (by far the highest share in the developed countries).

zh: 这类企业中不乏规模巨大、利润丰厚者，它们享受着与公司同等的法定利益。
en: Several of these entities are very large and profitable, and enjoy the same legal benefits as corporations.

zh: 经济学逻辑表明，从事类似活动的类似规模的企业仅仅因为组织形式的不同而按不同税率缴税。 。
en: Economic logic suggests that businesses of similar size and engaged in similar activities should not pay different tax rates based solely on their organizational form.

zh: 很大一部分企业利润目前按照个人所得征税，这一事实意味着很难将公司税改革和个税改革分开，而奥巴马和国会正是希望这样做。
en: The fact that a large share of business income is currently taxed as personal income makes it difficult to separate corporate tax reform from personal tax reform, as Obama and members of Congress would prefer to do.

zh: 此外，将这两大改革领域分离排除了不少其他发达国家所用的办法，即用增加个人股东层面的公司股本收入税来抵消降低公司税率导致的收入损失。
en: Moreover, keeping the two areas of reform separate rules out the approach adopted by several other developed countries, which have offset some of the revenue losses from cutting corporate tax rates by increasing taxes on corporate equity income at the personal shareholder level.

zh: 这一办法还能打消关于降低公司税率会导致税收累退的顾虑。
en: This approach also addresses concerns about the regressive effects of a cut in the corporate rate.

zh: 该办法既更加累进，也更加有效：资本是高度流动的，因此从公民个人和股东居民头上征税要比从跨国公司头上征税容易得多。
en: It is both more progressive and more effective: with highly mobile capital, it is far easier to collect taxes from individual citizens and resident shareholders than from multinational companies.

zh: 根据一项最新研究，让红利和资本利得税回到1997年前的水平（28 % ） 能抵消美国联邦公司税率从35%降至26%所导致的收入损失。
en: According to a recent study, restoring tax rates on dividends and capital gains to their pre-1997 levels of 28% could finance a reduction in the US federal corporate tax rate from 35% to 26%.

zh: 这一变化既能打消公司将投资移向海外的激励，也能促进美国税收制度的累进性。
en: This change would both reduce the incentive for corporations to shift investments abroad and increase the progressivity of the US tax system.

zh: 类似地，温和的碳税或增值税 — — 同时辅以免税和补贴以抵消低收入家庭所承受的累退影响 — — 能产生足够的收入，抵消公司税率大幅降低的影响并为赤字削减做出重大贡献。
en: Similarly, a modest carbon tax or value-added tax, with credits or subsidies to offset the regressive effects on low-income households, could generate enough revenue both to pay for a significant reduction in the corporate tax rate and to make a meaningful contribution to deficit reduction.

zh: 累进、平衡的预算削减计划和降低公司税率之间并不矛盾。
en: There is no inconsistency between a progressive, balanced deficit-reduction plan and lowering the corporate tax rate.

zh: 在各种税种中，公司税对经济增长为害最甚 — — 如果没有它，有意义地降低赤字将会困难得多。
en: Of all taxes, corporate taxes are the most harmful to economic growth – without which meaningful deficit reduction is far more difficult to achieve.

zh: 捍卫数字转型
en: Securing the Digital Transition

zh: 新德里—每年，世界经济论坛都会发布《全球风险报告 》 （ Global Risks Report ） ， 其中总结了全球专家和决策者的观点。
en: NEW DELHI – Every year, the World Economic Forum publishes a Global Risks Report, which distills the views of experts and policymakers from around the world.

zh: 今年，网络安全在全球关注榜上名列前茅，理应如此。
en: This year, cybersecurity is high on the list of global concerns, as well it should be.

zh: 2017年，世界连续发生网络袭击和安全漏洞，影响了社会的方方面面。
en: In 2017, the world witnessed a continued escalation in cyber attacks and security breaches that affected all parts of society.

zh: 没有理由认为2018年会有所不同。
en: There is no reason to believe 2018 will be different.

zh: 影响是深远的。
en: The implications are far-reaching.

zh: 最紧迫的是，我们必须网络治理和在网治理两手抓。
en: Most immediately, we must grapple with governance of the Internet as well as on the Internet.

zh: 否则，数字技术所产生的机会将会因为监管和法律部门的竞争而白白浪费，最终形成新的界限和新的全球紧张。
en: Otherwise, the opportunities afforded by digital technologies could be squandered in a regulatory and legal arms race, complete with new borders and new global tensions.

zh: 但还有一个更广泛的问题：我们以极快的速度迈向数字时代，但确保全球稳定的措施远远落后了。
en: But there’s a broader issue: For all the speed with which we are racing into the digital age, efforts to ensure global stability are lagging far behind.

zh: 在诸多方面，我们的世界仍在一个威斯特伐利亚框架下组织。
en: In many respects, our world is still organized within a Westphalian framework.

zh: 有（大部分）受承认的边界的国家构成了国际体系的基本组成部分。
en: States with (mostly) recognized borders are the building blocks of the international system.

zh: 它们之间的互动，以及它们共享主权的意愿，决定了当前世界秩序。
en: Their interactions, and their willingness to share sovereignty, define the existing world order.

zh: 但全球化已经逐步改变了基本现实。
en: But globalization has gradually changed the realities on the ground.

zh: 全球化的力量 — — 在一战前的几十年以来一直起起伏伏 — — 最近受到了地缘政治，以及降低技术变革速度的力量的制约，但数字转型将推动全球化继续前进，不过是以不同的方式。
en: And while its force – waxing and waning since the decades preceding World War I – is nowadays being tempered by geopolitics, and by the impulse to slow the pace of technological change, the digital transformation will propel globalization forward, albeit in a different form.

zh: 毕竟，互联网的关键特征便是无领土架构（non-territorial architecture ） 。
en: After all, the Internet’s key feature is its non-territorial architecture.

zh: 互联网打破了传统的界限，对威斯特伐利亚秩序的基础构成了直接挑战。
en: By breaking down traditional borders, it poses a direct challenge to the very foundation of the Westphalian order.

zh: 这是非常具有积极意义的发展趋势，因为它便利了言论自由和跨境商品和思想交换。
en: This is a profoundly positive development, because it facilitates free expression and the cross-border exchange of goods and ideas.

zh: 但是，和一切人类发明一样，互联网可能被滥用，网络犯罪、在线骚扰、仇恨言论、煽动暴力以及在线激进化的崛起说明了一切。
en: But, as with all human inventions, the Internet can be abused, as evidenced by the rise in cybercrime, online harassment, hate speech, incitement to violence, and online radicalization.

zh: 在未来几年中尽力打击这些滥用互联网的行为需要紧密的国际合作以建立和执行共同规则。
en: Minimizing such abuses in the years ahead will require close international cooperation to establish and enforce common rules.

zh: 孤立不是出路，因为没有哪个政府能够单枪匹马解决自身的问题。
en: There can be no solution in isolation, because no single government can tackle the problem on its own.

zh: 随着时间的推移，出现了一大批“字母汤”组织将技术界、企业、政府和公民社会联合起来。
en: Over time, an alphabet soup of organizations has emerged to bring together the technical community, businesses, governments, and civil society.

zh: 如今，ICANN（互联网名称和数字地址分配机构 ） 、 IETF（互联网工程任务组 ） 、 W3C（万维网联盟）提供者互联网构架的事实治理。
en: And bodies such as ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers), IETF (Internet Engineering Task Force), and W3C (World Wide Web Consortium) now provide de facto governance of the Internet’s architecture.

zh: 但在网治理要复杂得多。
en: But governance on the Internet is far more complex.

zh: 在这方面，机构众多，互不协调。
en: Here, the institutional landscape is both crowded and unsettled.

zh: 说它拥挤，是因为为数众多的行动方在为确定网络空间规范框架而竞争。
en: It is crowded because numerous actors are competing to shape the normative framework of cyberspace.

zh: 许多国家存在多个相关部门监管网络活动的情况。
en: Many countries have multiple relevant ministries regulating online activity.

zh: 不同网站和在线服务的社区章程和服务条款大相径庭。
en: Websites and online services have vastly different community guidelines and terms of service.

zh: 公共和私人部门开发者决定着不断变化的互联网基础设施的设计。
en: Public- and private-sector developers determine the design of the Internet’s changing infrastructure.

zh: 各种公民社会组织也在提出自己的网络原则，而国际组织则试图制定多边协议。
en: And numerous civil-society groups are proposing their own sets of cyber principles, while international organizations attempt to develop multilateral agreements.

zh: 说它不协调，是因为拜各国工作重点彼此冲突所赐，政府间合作基本陷入停顿。
en: The landscape remains unsettled because intergovernmental cooperation has largely stalled, owing to conflicting priorities among countries.

zh: 更糟糕的是，专门供不同相关利益方进行互动和制定操作方案的空间太少。
en: Making matters worse, there are still too few dedicated spaces for different stakeholders to interact and devise operational solutions.

zh: 在缺少一致同意的框架的情况下，各国政府往往会采取短期单边措施 — — 强制性数据本地化、过度的内容限制、侵入性监视等 — — 来解决眼前的顾虑，或作为对国内政治压力的响应。
en: In the absence of mutually agreed frameworks, governments will tend to adopt short-term unilateral measures – mandatory data localization, excessive content restrictions, intrusive surveillance – to address immediate concerns, or as a response to domestic political pressure.

zh: 但这样一来，它们也有可能助长加剧而不是遏制国际紧张的动态。
en: But by doing so, they could fuel a dynamic that heightens, rather than minimizes, international tensions.

zh: 数字治理涉及从网络安全到经济和人权的一切，而由于在不同的司法辖区适用哪些法律方面还存在不确定性，结果是所有法律的执行都遭到了削弱，所有人都因此蒙受损失。
en: Digital governance touches on everything from cybersecurity to the economy to human rights, and uncertainty about which laws apply in different jurisdictions weakens enforcement in all of them, leaving everyone worse off.

zh: 此外，解决一个层面的问题的措施，可能很容易影响到其他层面，这意味着不协调的匆忙决策可能造成消极的跨境后果。
en: Moreover, measures to address one dimension can easily affect the others, which means that uncoordinated and rash policy decisions can have negative consequences across the board.

zh: 我曾经有幸主持互联网治理全球委员会，我们的2016年报告强调了这些风险，并提出制定“新的社会契约”来确保互联网的普及性、包容性、安全性和可靠性。
en: When I had the honor of chairing the Global Commission on Internet Governance, our 2016 report highlighted these risks, and called for “a new Social Compact” to ensure that the Internet of the future will be accessible, inclusive, secure, and trustworthy.

zh: 此后的进展十分有限。
en: Progress since then has been limited.

zh: 由于联合国制定全球网络规则的努力遇到了瓶颈，必须有其他方案推动这一进程。
en: Because efforts at the United Nations to establish global cyber rules have reached an impasse, alternative initiatives will have to drive the process forward.

zh: 幸运的是，网络空间稳定全球委员会最近发布了重要的《保护互联网公共核心倡议 》 （ Call to Protect the Public Core of the Internet ） 。
en: Fortunately, the Global Commission on the Stability of Cyberspace recently issued an important “Call to Protect the Public Core of the Internet.”

zh: 而即将在渥太华召开的全球互联网和司法会议（Global Internet and Jurisdiction Conference）将为决策者提供新的宝贵机会继续朝着制定解决方案努力。
en: And the upcoming Global Internet and Jurisdiction Conference in Ottawa will provide another valuable opportunity for policymakers to continue working toward solutions.

zh: 这些技术和法律事宜对于全球从工业时代到数字时代的转变至关重要。
en: Such technical and legalistic proceedings are essential for shaping the global transition from the industrial to the digital era.

zh: 要避免法律军备竞赛，决策者需要为各种微妙问题制定明智的方针，包括调查的互助框架、域名管理机构和服务提供商在治理在线人身攻击方面的作用等。
en: To avoid a legal arms race, policymakers will need to develop a smart approach to a variety of tricky issues, from mutual assistance frameworks for investigations to the role of domain-name administrators and service providers in addressing abusive speech online.

zh: 实现不同司法辖区间的政策一致性应该作为工作重点。
en: Achieving policy coherence across jurisdictions should be a top priority.

zh: 这需要所有相关利益方进行直接持续的互动。
en: Doing so will require direct, sustained interactions among all stakeholders.

zh: 惟其如此，我们才能建立一个保护互联网的跨国性质、保护人权、打击滥用，并维持真正的全球数字经济的框架。
en: Only then can we create a framework to preserve the cross-border nature of the Internet, protect human rights, fight abuse, and sustain a truly global digital economy.

zh: 2004年，科菲·安南（Kofi Annan）说 ， “ 在管理、促进和保护[互联网]在我们的生活中的存在时，我们需要的创造力不比发明互联网更少。
en: As Kofi Annan said back in 2004, “In managing, promoting, and protecting [the Internet’s] presence in our lives, we need to be no less creative than those who invented it.”

zh: ”威斯特伐利亚已经离我们远去。
en: Westphalia is behind us.

zh: 接下来会出现什么取决于我们。
en: What comes next is up to us.

zh: 网络的不安全
en: Cyber Insecurity

zh: 剑桥-2008年8月，俄罗斯军队开进了格鲁吉亚。
en: CAMBRIDGE – In August 2008, Russian troops moved into Georgia.

zh: 观察家们在哪一方先开火的问题上争论不休，但有一个被注意到的此次冲突的方面，将对未来会起重大的影响。
en: Observers dispute who fired first, but there was a little noticed dimension of the conflict that will have major repercussions for the future.

zh: 武装冲突爆发前的数周，电脑黑客们就攻击了格鲁吉亚的一些政府网站。
en: Computer hackers attacked Georgian government Web sites in the weeks preceding the outbreak of armed conflict.

zh: 俄罗斯与格鲁吉亚之间的冲突是首次伴随着武装冲突的重大网络袭击。
en: The Russia-Georgia conflict represents the first significant cyber attacks accompanying armed conflict.

zh: 欢迎各位来到二十一世纪。
en: Welcome to the twenty-first century.

zh: 网络空间存在的威胁和潜在的网络战争说明了现代社会中不断增加的危险性和失控。
en: Cyber threats and potential cyber warfare illustrate the increased vulnerabilities and loss of control in modern societies.

zh: 政府主要担心的是其官僚机构的信息技术基础设施被黑客们攻击，但是，还有远远超出政府电脑设备范围的社会危险性的存在。
en: Governments have mainly been concerned about hacker attacks on their own bureaucracy’s information technology infrastructure, but there are social vulnerabilities well beyond government computers.

zh: 在美国的网络防卫领域的一些专家于2007年9月给美国总统的一封公开信中警告说 ， “ 美国的关键基础设施，包括电力、金融、电信、医疗保健、交通、水利、国防和互联网等，都非常容易受到网络的攻击，因此需要采取快速和果断的预防行动以避免全国性的灾难。
en: In an open letter to the US president in September 2007, American professionals in cyber defense warned that “the critical infrastructure of the United States, including electrical power, finance, telecommunications, health care, transportation, water, defense, and the Internet, is highly vulnerable to cyber attack. Fast and resolute mitigating action is needed to avoid national disaster.”

zh: ”在混沌的互联网空间里，很难确定攻击者到底藏身于何处。
en: In the murky world of the Internet, attackers are difficult to identify.

zh: 在当今各领域之间互相关联的世界里，任何身份不明的对非政府基础设施所进行的网络攻击都可能会带来严重的灾害。
en: In today’s interconnected world, an unidentified cyber attack on non-governmental infrastructure might be severely damaging.

zh: 例如，一些专家认为国家的电网可能特别容易受到攻击。
en: For example, some experts believe that a nation’s electric power grid may be particularly susceptible.

zh: 电力公司使用的控制系统被认为是很脆弱的，一次这样的攻击就可能造成一些城市和地区数天或数周的瘫痪。
en: The control systems that electric power companies use are thought vulnerable to attack, which could shut down cities and regions for days or weeks.

zh: 网络攻击也可以通过让商业网站瘫痪的途径干扰金融市场并造成巨大的经济损失。
en: Cyber attacks may also interfere with financial markets and cause immense economic loss by closing down commercial Web sites.

zh: 某些场景，包括“电子珍珠港 ” ， 似乎是危言耸听，但它们确实是权力从中央政府向个人扩散的真实写照。
en: Some scenarios, including an “electronic Pearl Harbor,” sound alarmist, but they illustrate the diffusion of power from central governments to individuals.

zh: 1941年，强大的日本海军动用了众多资源数造成了数千英里外的灾难性损失。
en: In 1941, the powerful Japanese navy used many resources to create damage thousands of miles away.

zh: 如今，一个黑客使用恶意软件就可以造成遥远的地方的混乱，而他又几乎不需任何成本。
en: Today, an individual hacker using malicious software can cause chaos in far-away places at little cost to himself.

zh: 此外，信息革命使个人能以前所未有的速度和范围从事破坏活动。
en: Moreover, the information revolution enables individuals to perpetrate sabotage with unprecendented speed and scope.

zh: 所谓的于2000年从菲律宾发出的“爱情虫病毒 ” ， 估计已造成了数十亿美元的损失。
en: The so-called “love bug virus,” launched in the Phillipines in 2000, is estimated to have cost billions of dollars in damage.

zh: 恐怖分子也可以钻网上新的安全漏洞的空子来从事不对称的战争。
en: Terrorists, too, can exploit new vulnerabilities in cyberspace to engage in asymmetrical warfare.

zh: 1998年，美国抱怨七个莫斯科互联网地址参与了盗窃五角大楼和美国宇航局的机密，而俄罗斯政府答复说，攻击起源地的电话号码是不通的。
en: In 1998, when America complained about seven Moscow Internet addresses involved in the theft of Pentagon and NASA secrets, the Russian government replied that phone numbers from which the attacks originated were inoperative.

zh: 美国当时根本无法判断俄罗斯政府是否参与了那次事件。
en: The US had no way of knowing whether the Russian government had been involved.

zh: 更近的例子是，2007年中国政府被指控资助了数千桩针对德国联邦政府的电脑以及美国国防部和商业企业的电脑系统的黑客攻击事件。
en: More recently, in 2007, China’s government was accused of sponsoring thousands of hacking incidents against German federal government computers and defense and private-sector computer systems in the US.

zh: 但是，要证明攻击的来源却很难，美国国防部以不得不关闭了其一部分电脑系统而告终。
en: But it was difficult to prove the source of the attack, and the Pentagon had to shut down some of its computer systems.

zh: 2007年，当爱沙尼亚政府迁移纪念苏联战争期间为国捐躯者们的二战雕像时，黑客们的报复是花费昂贵的拒绝服务攻击，使爱沙尼亚的互联网处于瘫痪。
en: In 2007, when Estonia’s government moved a World War II statue commemorating Soviet war dead, hackers retaliated with a costly denial-of-service attack that closed down Estonia’s access to the internet.

zh: 也无法证明是俄罗斯政府还是自发的民族主义反应，或两者都协助了这次跨国攻击。
en: There was no way to prove whether the Russian government, a spontaneous nationalist response, or both aided this transnational attack.

zh: 2008 年1月，美国总统布什签署了两项总统指令，要求建立一个综合性的网络安全计划， 而他的2009年预算要求动用60亿美元的开支来建立一个系统以保护国家网络安全。
en: In January 2008, President George W. Bush signed two presidential directives that called for establishing a comprehensive cyber-security plan, and his 2009 budget requested $6 billion to develop a system to protect national cyber security.

zh: 当选总统奥巴马很可能会效仿此政策。
en: President-elect Barack Obama is likely to follow suit.

zh: 在他的竞选中，奥巴马呼吁���定严厉的网络安全新标准和关键基础设施的抗攻击性，并承诺将任命一位国家网络顾问，直接向他汇报并负责制定政策和协调联邦机构的在这方面的努力。
en: In his campaign, Obama called for tough new standards for cyber security and physical resilience of critical infrastructure, and promised to appoint a national cyber adviser who will report directly to him and be responsible for developing policy and coordinating federal agency efforts.

zh: 这并不是个美差，因为许多相关的基础设施不是由政府直接控制的。
en: That job will not be easy, because much of the relevant infrastructure is not under direct government control.

zh: 就在最近，美国中情局副局长唐纳德·科尔警告说 ， “ 我们政府的计划的信息和价值的重大损失通常不是因为间谍的活动 . . . . 事实上，我非常担心的事情之一是，我们即将依靠的许多新的功能，不再是在由政府签订合同的实验室里研发出来的。
en: Just recently, Donald Kerr, the US deputy director of national intelligence, warned that “major losses of information and value for our government programs typically aren’t from spies....In fact, one of the great concerns I have is that so much of the new capabilities that we’re all going to depend on aren’t any longer developed in government labs under government contract.”

zh: 科尔是这样描述他的所谓的“供应链攻击”的：黑客不仅会窃取有专有权的信息，而且更进一步，在通信硬件和软件中插入错误的数据和程序-即可以让系统瘫痪的木马程序。
en: Kerr described what he called “supply chain attacks” in which hackers not only steal proprietary information, but go further and insert erroneous data and programs in communications hardware and software – Trojan horses that can be used to bring down systems.

zh: 各国政府将发现自己面临一种很难对付的新的威胁。
en: All governments will find themselves exposed to a new type of threat that will be difficult to counter.

zh: 政府可以寄希望于能像吓退核武器或其他武装袭击那样来吓退网络攻击。
en: Governments can hope to deter cyber attacks just as they deter nuclear or other armed attacks.

zh: 但起到这种作用需要一种对攻击作出反应的并能让人相信的威慑力。
en: But deterrence requires a credible threat of response against an attacker.

zh: 而做到这一点的难度正变得很大，因为当今世界中，政府发现很难作出判断攻击来自何方，到底是来自敌对国家还是一个伪装成外国政府的犯罪集团。
en: And that becomes much more difficult in a world where governments find it hard to tell where cyber attacks come from, whether from a hostile state or a group of criminals masking as a foreign government.

zh: 虽然能更加明确地定义网络攻击的国际法律系统再加上在预防措施方面的合作，能起到作用，但无论像这样的裁军式的解决方案，还是像建设电子防火墙和在敏感统中建立冗余这样的防御性措施，都不足以解决问题。
en: While an international legal code that defines cyber attacks more clearly, together with cooperation on preventive measures, can help, such arms-control solutions are not likely to be sufficient. Nor will defensive measures like constructing electronic firewalls and creating redundancies in sensitive systems.

zh: 基于涉及到巨大的不确定性，解决网络安全出现的新问题必须列在每个政府重要的议程上。
en: Given the enormous uncertainties involved, the new cyber dimensions of security must be high on every government’s agenda.

zh: 网络战争与和平
en: Cyber War and Peace

zh: 剑桥 — — 两年前，一条有缺陷的计算机代码感染了伊朗核计划，并摧毁了许多用于铀浓缩的离心机。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Two years ago, a piece of faulty computer code infected Iran’s nuclear program and destroyed many of the centrifuges used to enrich uranium.

zh: 有些观察家称这种明显的蓄意破坏预示着一种新的战争形式，美国国防部长莱昂·帕内塔警告美国人可能会受到“网络珍珠港”袭击。
en: Some observers declared this apparent sabotage to be the harbinger of a new form of warfare, and United States Secretary of Defense Leon Panetta has warned Americans of the danger of a “cyber Pearl Harbor” attack on the US.

zh: 但我们对网络冲突究竟有多少认识？
en: But what do we really know about cyber conflict?

zh: 电脑及相关电子活动的网络域名构成了纯粹人造的复杂环境，上述环境中的人类对手高度智能化而且有针对性。
en: The cyber domain of computers and related electronic activities is a complex man-made environment, and human adversaries are purposeful and intelligent.

zh: 山脉和海洋很难移动，但网络空间却可以借助开关关上和打开。
en: Mountains and oceans are hard to move, but portions of cyberspace can be turned on and off by throwing a switch.

zh: 电子的全球移动远比大型船舶的远距离移动更为廉价和快速。
en: It is far cheaper and quicker to move electrons across the globe than to move large ships long distances.

zh: 多航母特遣部队和潜艇舰队的舰船研发成本创造出巨大的进入壁垒，确保了美国的海上优势。
en: The costs of developing those vessels – multiple carrier task forces and submarine fleets – create enormous barriers to entry, enabling US naval dominance.

zh: 但网络领域的进入壁垒极其低廉，即使非国家参与者和小国也能以低廉的成本发挥重要的作用。
en: But the barriers to entry in the cyber domain are so low that non-state actors and small states can play a significant role at low cost.

zh: 在一本名叫《权力未来》的著作中，我提出政府权力的扩散是本世纪最伟大的政治转折。 网络空间就是一个绝佳的例子。
en: In my book The Future of Power, I argue that the diffusion of power away from governments is one of this century’s great political shifts. & Cyberspace is a perfect example.

zh: 美国、俄罗斯、英国、法国和中国等大国较之其他国家和非国家参与者拥有更强的海洋、天空或太空控制力，但谈论在网络空间占据霸权地位并没有多大意义。
en: Large countries like the US, Russia, Britain, France, and China have greater capacity than other states and non-state actors to control the sea, air, or space, but it makes little sense to speak of dominance in cyberspace.

zh: 如果一定要说有什么影响，那么大国依赖复杂网络系统支持军事和经济活动造成了可以被非国家参与者利用的全新漏洞。
en: If anything, dependence on complex cyber systems for support of military and economic activities creates new vulnerabilities in large states that can be exploited by non-state actors.

zh: 四十年前，美国国防部创造了互联网，而今天，按照多数人的说法，美国仍然在网络的军事和社会应用方面占据领先地位。
en: Four decades ago, the US Department of Defense created the Internet; today, by most accounts, the US remains the leading country in terms of its military and societal use.

zh: 但对联网计算机和通讯的更多依赖致使美国比其他许多国家更容易受到攻击，且网络空间已成为不安全的主要发源地，因为在目前的技术发展阶段，进攻显然比防守更具优势。
en: But greater dependence on networked computers and communication leaves the US more vulnerable to attack than many other countries, and cyberspace has become a major source of insecurity, because, at this stage of technological development, offense prevails over defense there.

zh: “网络攻击”一词涵盖的行为多种多样，包括从简单刺探、丑化网站、拒绝提供服务到从事间谍和破坏活动。
en: The term “cyber attack”covers a wide variety of actions, ranging from simple probes to defacing Web sites, denial of service, espionage, and destruction.

zh: 同样 ， “ 网络战争”一词被用来松散地指代一系列行为，反映出从武装冲突到敌对较量等各式各样的字典涵义（如“两性战争”或“禁毒战争 ” ） 。
en: Similarly, the term “cyber war” is used loosely to cover a wide range of behaviors, reflecting dictionary definitions of war that range from armed conflict to any hostile contest (for example, “war between the sexes” or “war on drugs”).

zh: 另一种极端情况是，有些专家对网络战争适用狭义定义：即国与国之间一场“不流血的战争 ” ， 局限在网络空间的电子冲突。
en: At the other extreme, some experts use a narrow definition of cyber war: a “bloodless war” among states that consists solely of electronic conflict in cyberspace.

zh: 但这回避了网络空间物理和虚拟层面间重要的彼此联系。
en: But this avoids the important interconnections between the physical and virtual layers of cyberspace.

zh: 正像感染伊朗核计划的Stuxnet病毒表明的那样，软件攻击也可以产生非常真实的物理效果。
en: As the Stuxnet virus that infected Iran’s nuclear program showed, software attacks can have very real physical effects.

zh: 网络战争更为有用的定义是网络空间中发生的敌对行动，其所产生的影响放大或者等同于严重身体暴力。
en: A more useful definition of cyber waris hostile action in cyberspace whose effects amplify or are equivalent to major physical violence.

zh: 现实世界中，政府近乎垄断了大规模的武力使用，防守方更加熟悉地形，而进攻则可能因为消耗或疲劳而结束。
en: In the physical world, governments have a near-monopoly on large-scale use of force, the defender has an intimate knowledge of the terrain, and attacks end because of attrition or exhaustion.

zh: 资源和流动性都非常昂贵。
en: Both resources and mobility are costly.

zh: 相比之下，网络世界的参与者多种多样（有时还可以匿名参与 ） ， 实际距离变得无关紧要，而且某些形式的犯罪成本很低。
en: In the cyber world, by contrast, actors are diverse (and sometimes anonymous), physical distance is immaterial, and some forms of offense are cheap.

zh: 因为互联网设计是为了方便使用、而不是安全，进攻方目前相对于防守方仍占据一定的优势。
en: Because the Internet was designed for ease of use rather than security, attackers currently have the advantage over defenders.

zh: 技术进步，包括提高系统安全性的某些“再造”工作最终可能会改变这种状况，但至少到目前为止情况依然如此。
en: Technological evolution, including efforts to “reengineer” some systems for greater security, might eventually change that, but, for now, it remains the case.

zh: 规模大的一方解除对方武装或消灭敌人、占据领土或有效使用的反击策略的能力都受到限制。
en: The larger party has limited ability to disarm or destroy the enemy, occupy territory, or use counterforce strategies effectively.

zh: 网络战争虽然现阶段只是刚刚开始，但却成为最富戏剧性的潜在威胁。
en: Cyber war, though only incipient at this stage, is the most dramatic of the potential threats.

zh: 总的来讲，拥有复杂技术和人力资源的大国可以通过对军事和民用目标发起网络攻击造成大规模中断和实际破坏。
en: Major states with elaborate technical and human resources could, in principle, create massive disruption and physical destruction through cyber attacks on military and civilian targets.

zh: 网络战争的应对之策包括通过拒绝和纠缠实施某种形式的国际威慑、进攻能力、以及在威慑失效的情况下快速网络和基础设施恢复设计。
en: Responses to cyber war include a form of interstate deterrence through denial and entanglement, offensive capabilities, and designs for rapid network and infrastructure recovery if deterrence fails.

zh: 某些时候或许可以通过某些基本规则和军备控制来强化上述步骤，但世界仍处于这一进程的早期阶段。
en: At some point, it may be possible to reinforce these steps with certain rudimentary norms and arms control, but the world is at an early stage in this process.

zh: 如果您认为现阶段意识形态组织所谓的“黑客行动主义”多半属于破坏性滋扰，依然有四类主要危险因素对国家安全构成威胁。 每种危险因素涉及不同的时间跨度：网络战争和经济谍报活动大多与国家相关，而网络犯罪和网络恐怖主义则大多涉及非国家参与者。
en: If one treats so-called “hacktivism” by ideological groups as mostly a disruptive nuisance at this stage, there remain four major categories of cyber threats to national security, each with a different time horizon: cyber war and economic espionage are largely associated with states, and cyber crime and cyber terrorism are mostly associated with non-state actors.

zh: 美国目前的最大的损失源于间谍和犯罪活动，但在未来十年左右的时间里，战争和恐怖主义可能造成比今天更大的威胁。
en: For the US, the highest costs currently stem from espionage and crime, but over the next decade or so, war and terrorism could become greater threats than they are today.

zh: 此外，随着联盟和策略的不断发展，威胁种类可能出现越来越多的重叠。
en: Moreover, as alliances and tactics evolve, the categories may increasingly overlap.

zh: 在美国前国家情报总监、海军上将迈克·麦康奈尔看来 ， “ 恐怖组织迟早将掌握复杂的网络技术。
en: In the view of Admiral Mike McConnell, America’s former director of national intelligence, “Sooner or later, terror groups will achieve cyber-sophistication.

zh: 这有些类似于核扩散，只是比核扩散要容易得多。 ”
en: It’s like nuclear proliferation, only far easier.”

zh: 世界只是刚刚开始看到网络战争的影子 — — 伴随2008年格鲁吉亚常规战争的拒绝服务攻击，或者是近期对伊朗离心机的破坏。
en: The world is only just beginning to see glimpses of cyber war – in the denial-of-service attacks that accompanied the conventional war in Georgia in 2008, or the recent sabotage of Iranian centrifuges.

zh: 国家拥有最强的力量，但非国家参与者更有可能发起灾难性的攻击。
en: States have the greatest capabilities, but non-state actors are more likely to initiate a catastrophic attack.

zh: “网络911”的可能性要大于经常被提及的“网络珍珠港 ” 。
en: A “cyber 9/11” may be more likely than the often-mentioned “cyber Pearl Harbor.”

zh: 各国现在应该坐下来，讨论如何限制网络战争对世界和平的威胁。
en: It is time for states to sit down and discuss how to limit this threat to world peace.

zh: 网络战能否被遏制？
en: Can Cyber Warfare Be Deterred?

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 对“网络珍珠港”的担忧最早出现在20世纪90年代，过去20年来，决策者一直担心黑客会炸毁油管、污染水源、开启泄洪闸和袭击空中交通控制系统制造撞机事件。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Fear of a “cyber Pearl Harbor” first appeared in the 1990s, and for the past two decades, policymakers have worried that hackers could blow up oil pipelines, contaminate the water supply, open floodgates and send airplanes on collision courses by hacking air traffic control systems.

zh: 2012年，时任美国国防部长帕内塔警告说黑客有能力“关闭美国大部分地区的电网 ” 。
en: In 2012, then-US Secretary of Defense Leon Panetta warned that hackers could “shut down the power grid across large parts of the country.”

zh: 这样的灾难性情景暂时尚未发生，但其可能性显然不能排除。
en: None of these catastrophic scenarios has occurred, but they certainly cannot be ruled out.

zh: 在相对温和的水平上，黑客去年毁坏了一座德国钢厂的高炉。
en: At a more modest level, hackers were able to destroy a blast furnace at a German steel mill last year.

zh: 因此安全问题再简单不过：我们能否遏制这样的破坏行动？
en: So the security question is straightforward: Can such destructive actions be deterred?

zh: 有人说遏制在网络世界并非有效策略，因为难以确定袭击的来源和其中所涉及的大量国家及非国家参与者。
en: It is sometimes said that deterrence is not an effective strategy in cyberspace, because of the difficulties in attributing the source of an attack and because of the large and diverse number of state and non-state actors involved.

zh: 我们往往无法确定能用谁的资产冒险以及冒险的时间长度。
en: We are often not sure whose assets we can hold at risk and for how long.

zh: 跟踪调查的问题其实非常严重。
en: Attribution is, indeed, a serious problem.

zh: 如果没有邮件回复地址我们该怎样报复？
en: How can you retaliate when there is no return address?

zh: 核追踪技术远非完美，但只有九个国家拥有核武器；其核材料的同位素标识都明确地为外界掌握；而非国家参与者的进入壁垒很高。
en: Nuclear attribution is not perfect, but there are only nine states with nuclear weapons; the isotopic identifiers of their nuclear materials are relatively well known; and non-state actors face high entry barriers.

zh: 在任何国家或非国家主体均可创造（或在所谓黑网站上购买）几行代码作为武器的网络世界这一切都不再适用。
en: None of this is true in cyberspace where a weapon can consist of a few lines of code that can be invented (or purchased on the so-called dark web) by any number of state or non-state actors.

zh: 一名有经验的攻击者可以将起始点隐藏在若干远程服务器的虚假标志之后。
en: A sophisticated attacker can hide the point of origin behind the false flags of several remote servers.

zh: 虽然鉴证人员可以处理众多服务器之间的“跳转 ” ， 但这往往是需要时间的。
en: While forensics can handle many “hops” among servers, it often takes time.

zh: 比方说，外界普遍认为2014年一次从摩根大通窃取7，600万客户地址的袭击是俄罗斯的杰作。
en: For example, an attack in 2014 in which 76 million client addresses were stolen from JPMorgan Chase was widely attributed to Russia.

zh: 但到了2015年，美国司法部认定由生活在莫斯科和特拉维夫的两名以色列人和一名美国公民领导的复杂的犯罪团伙才是真正的肇事者。
en: By 2015, however, the US Department of Justice identified the perpetrators as a sophisticated criminal gang led by two Israelis and an American citizen who lives in Moscow and Tel Aviv.

zh: 但追踪可以达到一定的程度。
en: Attribution, however, is a matter of degree.

zh: 虽然在有可能遭遇虚假标识的同时很难获取法庭承认的及时高质量鉴证，但现有的追踪水平足以遏制犯罪行为。
en: Despite the dangers of false flags and the difficulty of obtaining prompt, high-quality attribution that would stand up in a court of law, there is often enough attribution to enable deterrence.

zh: 比方说在2014年针对索尼影业的袭击事件中，美国最初试图避免公开用何种方法确定朝鲜为袭击的肇事者。 外界因此普遍怀疑美国所得出的结果。
en: For example, in the 2014 attack on SONY Pictures, the United States initially tried to avoid full disclosure of the means by which it attributed the attack to North Korea, and encountered widespread skepticism as a result.

zh: 几周内，一份媒体报道透露美国可以侵入朝鲜网络。
en: Within weeks, a press leak revealed that the US had access to North Korean networks.

zh: 外界的质疑声逐渐隐退，但却付出了公开敏感情报来源的代价。
en: Skepticism diminished, but at the cost of revealing a sensitive source of intelligence.

zh: 及时、高质量的来源追踪往往既困难又昂贵，但却不是不可能的。
en: Prompt, high-quality attribution is often difficult and costly, but not impossible.

zh: 不仅政府在提高这方面的能力，很多私营企业也介入其中，而它们的介入降低了政府被迫公开敏感来源的代价。
en: Not only are governments improving their capabilities, but many private-sector companies are entering the game, and their participation reduces the costs to governments of having to disclose sensitive sources.

zh: 很多情况都只是程度问题，随着技术的发展提高跟踪取证能力，威慑的强度也可能会增加。
en: Many situations are matters of degree, and as technology improves the forensics of attribution, the strength of deterrence may increase.

zh: 此外，分析人士在评估网络威慑时不应仅限于传统的惩戒和防卫手法。
en: Moreover, analysts should not limit themselves to the classic instruments of punishment and denial as they assess cyber deterrence.

zh: 还需要关注通过经济关联和既定标准来进行震慑。
en: Attention should also be paid to deterrence by economic entanglement and by norms.

zh: 经济关联可以改变中国等大国的成本收益思考，因为袭击美国电网可能导致中国经济受损的后果。
en: Economic entanglement can alter the cost-benefit calculation of a major state like China, where the blowback effects of an attack on, say, the US power grid could hurt the Chinese economy.

zh: 经济关联或许对朝鲜这样的国家不起���用，因为它与全球经济的联系非常微弱。
en: Entanglement probably has little effect on a state like North Korea, which is weakly linked to the global economy.

zh: 目前还不清楚经济关联对非国家主体能产生多大影响。
en: It is not clear how much entanglement affects non-state actors.

zh: 有些可能像宿主被杀的寄生虫那样迅速覆灭，而有些可能根本不在乎这样的后果。
en: Some may be like parasites that suffer if they kill their host, but others may be indifferent to such effects.

zh: 具体到标准而言，主要国家一致认为网络战争应受武装冲突规则的管辖，即要求区分军事和民用目标，并在袭击后果方面遵循对应原则。
en: As for norms, major states have agreed that cyber war will be limited by the law of armed conflict, which requires discrimination between military and civilian targets and proportionality in terms of consequences.

zh: 去年7月，联合国政府专家小组建议将民用目标排除在网络袭击之外，这一规定刚刚在上个月举行的20国集团峰会上得到通过。
en: Last July, the United Nations Group of Government Experts recommended excluding civilian targets from cyberattacks, and that norm was endorsed at last month’s G-20 summit.

zh: 有人提出网络武器尚未在迄今为止的战争中得到运用的原因之一恰恰是因为无法确定对平民目标的损害程度和难以预料的后果。
en: It has been suggested that one reason why cyber weapons have not been used more in war thus far stems precisely from uncertainty about the effects on civilian targets and unpredictable consequences.

zh: 上述规范或许遏制了网络武器在美国军事行动中对伊拉克和黎巴嫩防卫力量的应用。
en: Such norms may have deterred the use of cyber weapons in US actions against Iraqi and Libyan air defenses.

zh: 而在俄罗斯对格鲁吉亚和乌克兰发动的“混合型”战争中，网络手段的应用也是相对有限的。
en: And the use of cyber instruments in Russia’s “hybrid” wars in Georgia and Ukraine has been relatively limited.

zh: 网络威慑变量之间关系不断变化且受到技术和学习能力的影响，大大超过此前核武器的创新速度。
en: The relationship among the variables in cyber deterrence is a dynamic one that will be affected by technology and learning, with innovation occurring at a faster pace than was true of nuclear weapons.

zh: 比方说，改善追踪取证技术可以提高惩罚机制的作用；而改善加密防御技术可以强化防卫威慑力量。
en: For example, better attribution forensics may enhance the role of punishment; and better defenses through encryption may increase deterrence by denial.

zh: 因此目前进攻相对于防御的优势很可能会随时间的流逝而逐渐发生变化。
en: As a result, the current advantage of offense over defense may change over time.

zh: 网络学习能力也同样重要。
en: Cyber learning is also important.

zh: 随着国家和组织更深入地理解互联网对其经济福祉的重要性，网络战运用的成本收益衡量可能会发生变化，就如同随着时间推移学习改变了对核战争代价的理解一样。
en: As states and organizations come to understand better the importance of the Internet to their economic wellbeing, cost-benefit calculations of the utility of cyber warfare may change, just as learning over time altered the understanding of the costs of nuclear warfare.

zh: 与核时代不同，在涉及网络时代的威慑问题上，并不存在一劳永逸的做法。
en: Unlike the nuclear age, when it comes to deterrence in the cyber era, one size does not fit all.

zh: 抑或我们只是屈从于过去过于简单的景象？
en: Or are we prisoners of an overly simple image of the past?

zh: 毕竟，在核惩罚因太过严厉而缺乏可信度的情况下，美国采取了常规的灵活策略，在遏制苏联入侵西欧的行动中加入了防卫的元素。
en: After all, when nuclear punishment seemed too draconian to be credible, the US adopted a conventional flexible response to add an element of denial in its effort to deter a Soviet invasion of Western Europe.

zh: 并且尽管美国从未同意“不首先使用核武器”的正式规范，最终这一禁忌仍然持续扩散，至少涉及主要国家。
en: And while the US never agreed to a formal norm of “no first use of nuclear weapons,” eventually such a taboo evolved, at least among the major states.

zh: 网络时代的威慑或许不是它曾经的样子，但也许固定的模式就从未有过。
en: Deterrence in the cyber era may not be what it used to be, but maybe it never was.

zh: 信息战和软实力
en: Information Warfare Versus Soft Power

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 俄罗斯干预2016年美国总统大选，并被怀疑入侵法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙的竞选服务器不会令任何人感到吃惊，因为弗拉基米尔·普京总统理解（或者说误解）了软实力。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Russia’s interference in the 2016 US presidential election, and its suspected hacking of French President Emmanuel Macron’s campaign servers, should surprise no one, given President Vladimir Putin’s (mis)understanding of soft power.

zh: 在2012年再度当选之前，普京告诉莫斯科的一家报纸“软实力是通过信息和其他影响力手段不必借助武力也能实现外交政策目标的一系列复杂的方法和工具。 ”
en: Before his re-election in 2012, Putin told a Moscow newspaper that “soft power is a complex of tools and methods to achieve foreign policy goals without the use of force, through information and other means of influence.”

zh: 在克里姆林宫看来，邻国的颜色革命和阿拉伯之春起义是美国将软实力应用于新型混合战争的实例。
en: From the Kremlin’s perspective, color revolutions in neighboring countries and the Arab Spring uprisings were examples of the United States using soft power as a new form of hybrid warfare.

zh: 软实力的概念被纳入俄“2013年外交政策概念 ” ， 而在2016年3月，俄罗斯总参谋长瓦列里·格拉西莫夫指出用“常规部队来响应这样的外国威胁是不可能的；我们只能用同样的混合方法来进行抵御。 ”
en: The concept of soft power was incorporated into Russia’s 2013 Foreign Policy Concept, and in March 2016, Russian Chief of General Staff Valery Gerasimov stated that responding to such foreign threats “using conventional troops is impossible; they can be counteracted only with the same hybrid methods.”

zh: 软实力是什么？
en: What is soft power?

zh: 有人认为是军事力量以外的任何行动，但这种认识并不准确。
en: Some think it means any action other than military force, but this is wrong.

zh: 软实力不是通过强制或收买，而是通过吸引和说服来达到既定目的的能力。
en: Soft power is the ability to get what you want through attraction and persuasion rather than threats of coercion or offers of payment.

zh: 软实力本身无所谓好坏。
en: Soft power is not good or bad in itself.

zh: 价值判断要取决于特定行动的目的、手段和后果。
en: Value judgments depend on the ends, means, and consequences of an action.

zh: 思想操纵并不一定胜过暴力强迫（虽然目标对象在精神上的自主权往往要大于其物理进程 ） 。
en: It is not necessarily better to twist minds than to twist arms (though the subject usually has more autonomy in mental rather than physical processes).

zh: 奥萨马·本·拉登既没有威胁也没有收买2001年9月驾机撞向世贸中心大楼的恐怖分子：吸引他们作恶的是他的思想。
en: Osama bin Laden neither threatened nor paid the men who flew aircraft into the World Trade Center in September 2001: he attracted them by his ideas to do evil.

zh: 软实力吸引同样可以用于进攻目的。
en: The soft power of attraction can be used for offensive purposes.

zh: 各国长期以来在公共外交和广播领域耗资数十亿美元争夺吸引力和竞争力 — — 也就是所谓的“心灵与思想之战 ” 。
en: Countries have long spent billions on public diplomacy and broadcasting in a game of competitive attractiveness – the “battle for hearts and minds.”

zh: 像马歇尔计划和美国之音这样的软实力计划在决定冷战结果方面提供了帮助。
en: Soft-power instruments like the Marshall Plan and the Voice of America helped to determine the outcome of the Cold War.

zh: 冷战后，俄国精英相信欧盟和北约东扩和西方推动民主的努力都是为了孤立和威胁俄国。
en: After the Cold War, Russian elites believed that European Union and NATO enlargement, and Western efforts at democracy promotion, were designed to isolate and threaten Russia.

zh: 作为回应，他们试图通过宣传传统主义、国家主权和民族排他性等意识形态来培育俄国的软实力。
en: In response, they tried to develop Russian soft power by promoting an ideology of traditionalism, state sovereignty, and national exclusivity.

zh: 这引起了匈牙利等国的共鸣，匈牙利总理维克托·欧尔班一直赞赏“非自由民主 ” ， 同样被这一理念所吸引的还有中亚贫困国家和西欧右翼民粹运动等散居于俄罗斯边境线上的民众。
en: This resonated in countries like Hungary, where Prime Minister Victor Orbán has praised “illiberal democracy,” as well as among the diaspora along Russia’s borders, in impoverished countries of Central Asia, and among right-wing populist movements in Western Europe.

zh: 信息战可以用来攻击对手，这可以被归结为“消极软实力”的范畴。
en: Information warfare can be used offensively to disempower rivals, and this could be considered “negative soft power.”

zh: 攻击别人的价值观可以降低他们的吸引力，从而导致其相对软实力的削弱。
en: By attacking the values of others, one can reduce their attractiveness and thus their relative soft power.

zh: 非政府主体早已明白可以通过“点名羞辱”等活动来影响跨国公司的品牌资产。
en: Nongovernmental actors have long understood that multinational corporations are vulnerable to having their brand equity diminished through “naming and shaming” campaigns.

zh: 现有证据表明当俄罗斯人开始干预2015年美国总统大选时，其目标在于亵渎和抹黑美国的民主进程。
en: The available evidence suggests that when the Russians began their intervention in the American presidential election in 2015, their objective was to sully and discredit the US democratic process.

zh: 赞赏普京的唐纳德·特朗普当选不过是个意外收获。
en: The election of Donald Trump, who had praised Putin, was a bonus.

zh: 现在，俄罗斯干预欧洲民主国家国内政治旨在削弱代表西方硬实力的北约联盟吸引力，北约联盟一直被俄国视为威胁。
en: Now, Russian interference in European democracies’ domestic politics is designed to reduce the attractiveness of NATO, the embodiment of Western hard power, which Russia views as a threat.

zh: 十九世纪，谁能掌握欧洲控制权主要取决于谁的军队获胜；而今天，它还取决于谁的故事更加动人。
en: In the nineteenth century, the outcome of contests for mastery of Europe depended primarily on whose army won; today, it also depends on whose story wins.

zh: 信息战并非新概念，而且远超软实力的范畴。
en: Information warfare goes well beyond soft power, and it is not new.

zh: 通过现金贿选操纵理念和选举过程已经有悠久的历史，而希特勒和斯大林曾是无线电攻击的先锋。
en: Manipulation of ideas and electoral processes by cash payments has a long history, and Hitler and Stalin were pioneers in radio attacks.

zh: 但宣传性貌似太强的广播缺乏可信度，因此未能吸引某些受众。
en: But broadcasting that seems too propagandistic lacks credibility and thus does not attract – or produce soft power among – some audiences.

zh: 随着国际政治逐渐演变为竞争信誉的游戏，在学生和年轻领导者之间建立个人关系的交流计划往往成为软实力最有效的创造活动。
en: With international politics becoming a game of competitive credibility, exchange programs that develop personal relations among students and young leaders are often far more effective generators of soft power.

zh: 二十世纪六十年代，广播评论员爱德华·穆罗曾说国际交流最重要的部分不是万里之外的电波，而是最后三英尺的个人接触。
en: In the 1960s, the broadcaster Edward R. Murrow said the most important part of international communications is not the ten thousand miles of electronics, but the final three feet of personal contact.

zh: 在今天的社交媒体世界又将发生什么？ 只需轻点鼠标就能交“朋友 ” ， 可以轻松制造假友情，而假消息则可以通过付费喷子和和机器人制造和传播？
en: But what happens in today’s world of social media, where “friends” are a click away, fake friends are easy to fabricate, and fake news can be generated and promoted by paid trolls and mechanical bots?

zh: 俄国完善了这些技术。
en: Russia has perfected these techniques.

zh: 除了像今日俄罗斯和史普尼克这样的正是公共外交喉舌，俄罗斯还雇用付费喷子和僵尸网络大军来制造假消息，以便日后可以像真相一样合法传播。
en: In addition to formal public diplomacy mouthpieces like Russia Today and Sputnik, Russia employs armies of paid trolls and botnets to generate false information that can later be circulated and legitimated as if it were true.

zh: 之后，在2016年，俄罗斯军事情报部门进一步黑进民主党全国委员会的专用网络盗取信息，并将所盗取的信息在线发布以破坏希拉里·克林顿竞选总统。
en: Then, in 2016, Russian military intelligence went a step further, by hacking into the private network of the Democratic National Committee, stealing information, and releasing it online to damage Hillary Clinton’s presidential candidacy.

zh: 尽管信息战已经不是什么新鲜事，但网络技术使其更廉价、更迅速、更广泛，同时也更难察觉，更易否认。
en: Though information warfare is not new, cyber technology makes it cheaper, faster, and more far-reaching, as well as more difficult to detect and more easily deniable.

zh: 但虽然俄国信息战在破坏方面的确取得了某种程度的成功并在某种程度上影响了2016年美国大选，但却未能创造出软实力。
en: But while Russian information warfare has been somewhat successful in terms of disruption, affecting the 2016 US election somewhat, it has failed in terms of generating soft power.

zh: 伦敦波特兰咨询公司发布了一项“软实力30”指数，俄罗斯仅排名第27位。
en: The Portland Consultancy in London publishes a “Soft Power 30” index that ranks Russia 27th.

zh: 2016年，芬兰国际事务研究所发现俄罗斯宣传对主流西方媒体影响不大，而且从未导致任何政策变更。
en: In 2016, Finland’s Institute of International Affairs found that Russian propaganda had little impact on mainstream Western media and had never resulted in any change in policy.

zh: 同时12月芝加哥全球事务委员会一次调查显示俄罗斯在美国民众中的受欢迎程度达到1986年冷战结束后的最低水平。
en: And a Chicago Council on Global Affairs poll in December indicated that Russia’s popularity among Americans was the lowest since the Cold War year of 1986.

zh: 颇具讽刺意味的是，俄罗斯信息战不仅没有受益于特朗普红利，反而因为大幅降低俄罗斯在美国的软实力而妨碍了这位美国总统。
en: Ironically, rather than pocketing the Trump bonus, Russia’s information warfare has handicapped the US president by greatly reducing Russia’s soft power in America.

zh: 正如某些分析人士所指出的那样，应对“谎言龙头”的最佳方法不是试图回应每一个谎言，而是提前作出预警并防范整个过程。
en: As some analysts point out, the best response to a “fire hose of falsehoods” is not to try to answer each lie, but to forewarn and inoculate against the process.

zh: 正如马克龙的胜利所显示的那样，2017年的欧洲大选可能得益于这样的预警。
en: As Macron’s victory has shown, the European elections of 2017 may benefit from such forewarnings.

zh: 道德风险的政治
en: The Politics of Moral Hazard

zh: 布鲁塞尔—这是一场从未停止过的旧争论。
en: BRUSSELS – It is an old and never-ending contest.

zh: 一方是道德风险批评家，他们认为决策者所面临的主要责任之一是给出证明鲁莽行为不会有好处的激励。
en: On one side are the moral-hazard scolds, claiming that one of the major responsibilities confronting policymakers is to establish incentives that demonstrate that imprudent behavior does not pay.

zh: 另一方是金融稳定支持者，对他们来说，对金融系统的信心至关重要，不容有失，不管初衷多善，都不能影响信心。
