en: On the other side are the partisans of financial stability, for whom confidence in the financial system is too precious to be endangered, even with the best possible intentions.

zh: 塞浦路斯是这两大阵营的新战场。
en: Cyprus is the latest battleground between the two camps.

zh: 3月25日，塞浦路斯决定关闭其第二大银行，在此过程中，无保险储户将蒙受巨大损失。 决定做出后，欧元集团主席、荷兰财政迪塞尔布隆姆（Jeroen Dijsselbloem）声称健康的金融部门要求“你在哪里承担风险，就必须在哪里处理风险。
en: On March 25, after the decision had been taken to wind up the country’s second-largest bank, and to impose large losses on uninsured depositors in the process, Eurogroup President Jeroen Dijsselbloem, the Dutch finance minister, declared that a healthy financial sector requires that “where you take on the risks, you must deal with them.”

zh: ”他还说，目标应该定在创造欧洲各国财长“永远不需要考虑”通过欧洲稳定机制（European Stability Mechanism）对银行进行“直接资本重组”的环境。
en: The aim, he added, should be to create an environment in which Europe’s finance ministers “never need to consider a direct recapitalization” of a bank by the European Stability Mechanism. He was apparently reading from a textbook on moral hazard.

zh: 但是，迪塞尔布隆姆话音刚落，欧洲银行股应声暴跌，而他也被许多人（其中不乏他的同事）指责火上浇油。
en: Immediately after this declaration, however, prices of European bank stocks plunged, and Dijsselbloem was accused by many (including some of his colleagues) of having poured oil on a burning fire.

zh: 几小时后，他发表声明指出“塞浦路斯是个特别的例子，其挑战特别艰巨 ， ” 且应对欧洲危机“没有现成模式 ” 。
en: Within hours, he issued a statement indicating that “Cyprus is a specific case with exceptional challenges,” and that “no templates are used” in the approach to the European crisis.

zh: 这并不令人信服。
en: This is not convincing.

zh: 市场从一场危机中学习可用于下一场危机的原则。
en: Markets learn from a current crisis which principles will be applied in the next one.

zh: 而让它们学习正是道德风险之争的关键。
en: And letting them learn is precisely what the fight against moral hazard is about.

zh: 在塞浦路斯危机期间，欧洲决策者一直在经历同样的两难。
en: European policymakers have been agonizing over the same dilemma throughout the Cyprus crisis.

zh: 援助国内麻烦重重的金融机构对已然债务深重的塞浦路斯来说负担太重，IMF坚持它不会假装没看见。
en: The burden of bailing out the country’s ailing financial institutions was too heavy for an already-indebted Cypriot state, and the International Monetary Fund was adamant that it would not pretend otherwise.

zh: 因此，在3月中旬，塞浦路斯开始走向银行系统的突然崩溃，导致该国金融财富的巨大损失。
en: So, in mid-March, Cyprus was heading for a precipitous retrenchment of its banking system, resulting in the loss of a very large part of the country’s financial wealth.

zh: 对IMF和德国来说 — — 它们是这一结果的推手 — — 重要的是防止道德风险的需要。
en: For the IMF and Germany, which pushed for such an outcome, the rationale was the need to prevent moral hazard.

zh: 据说塞浦路斯总统阿纳斯塔夏季斯（Nicos Anastasiades）及其在欧洲机构的支持者渴望避免这一结果 — — 以金融稳定的名义。
en: Cypriot President Nicos Anastasiades, reportedly with some support from European institutions, desperately tried to avoid this fate – in the name of financial stability.

zh: 3月15日夜间性策划那个的解决方案 — — 一次性存款税 — — 在塞浦路斯的立场看来不无道理。
en: The solution found during the night of March 15 – a one-time tax on deposits – was defensible from the Cypriot viewpoint.

zh: 保护国内金融稳定要求限制对大储户的课税，因为其中很大一部分属于外国账户。
en: Preserving domestic financial stability required limiting taxation of large deposits, because a substantial proportion belonged to foreign account-holders.

zh: 于是，避免外资大规模撤离意味着对10万欧元门槛以下的储户课税。
en: Avoiding a massive withdrawal of foreign capital therefore implied taxing all deposits below the €100,000 ($130,000) threshold.

zh: 如果没有外国援助，就不会有其他解决方案。
en: Absent a foreign bailout, no other solution was on offer.

zh: 但这一方案对欧洲其他地区的金融稳定不利，因为这表明10万欧元门槛以下的储户不再受神圣不可侵犯的担保。
en: But this solution was detrimental to financial stability in the rest of Europe, because it signaled that the €100,000 threshold below which deposits are guaranteed was not sacrosanct.

zh: 当然，从法律上说，担保无非是担保者的偿付能力 — — 在这个例子中是濒于破产的塞浦路斯国。
en: Legally, of course, this guarantee is only worth the solvency of the guarantor – in this case the near-bankrupt Cypriot state.

zh: 但担保的废除仍将具有巨大的象征意义，激发整个欧洲的忧虑。
en: But its abrogation would nonetheless be symbolically powerful, sparking anxiety throughout Europe.

zh: 走出这一两难的显而易见的方法是塞浦路斯的欧元区伙伴国承担10万欧元以下储户的税收成本。
en: The obvious way out of this dilemma would have been for Cyprus’s eurozone partners to assume the cost of the tax on deposits below €100,000.

zh: 这样做会让它们拿出约13亿美元，或GDP的约0.01 % — —对于维持金融稳定来说，这一带价不可谓不小。
en: Doing so would have cost them an estimated €1.3 billion, or roughly 0.01% of their GDP – a ridiculously low price to pay for financial stability.

zh: 这样做不会产生多少道德风险：大储户将被课税，而塞浦路斯政府也将遭受IMF/欧元区计划的苛责 — — 这颗药不可谓不苦。
en: It would not have created much moral hazard: large depositors would have been taxed, and the Cypriot government would still have suffered the strictures of an IMF/eurozone program – bitter enough medicine.

zh: 但是，在北欧人民强烈反对银行、反感向南欧的转移支付的当口，德国总理默克尔及其同道并不想要求他们的纳税人为伙伴国的错误买单。
en: But, at a time when northern European citizens are full of resentment against banks and seething with anger over transfers to the south, German Chancellor Angela Merkel and her peers did not want to ask their taxpayers to pay for a partner country’s mistakes.

zh: 3月15日的协议在政治上不可行，也被塞浦路斯议会以一边倒的优势否决。
en: The March 15 agreement was not politically viable, and was overwhelmingly rejected by the Cypriot parliament.

zh: 于是，在这个夭折的解决方案提出十天后，欧元集团改变思路，采取了他们此前竭力避免的方法。
en: So, ten days after the ill-fated solution was proposed, the Eurogroup ministers changed course and adopted the approach that they had tried to avoid.

zh: 迅速清算银行。
en: Banks are being precipitously resolved.

zh: 后果已经显现：为了避免完全崩溃，塞浦路斯被迫采取了资本管制 — — 在欧元区，这是人人视为非法且不可想象的动作。
en: The consequences are already visible: to avoid a complete meltdown, Cyprus has been forced to introduce capital controls – which everyone had thought were illegal and unthinkable within the eurozone.

zh: 结果，投资者和储户意识到，在货币区内部建立金融壁垒是个实实在在的风险。
en: As a result, investors and depositors have learned that the erection of financial barriers within the currency area is indeed a genuine risk.

zh: 塞浦路斯人对欧洲充满了忿恨，极有可能主动退出欧元区。
en: And the Cypriots are so angry at Europe that a deliberate exit from the eurozone has become a distinct possibility.

zh: 最终，真正的争论与其说在于道德风险和金融稳定，不如说在于明智的金融解决方案和政治可行方案。
en: Ultimately, the true contest is less between moral hazard and financial stability than it is between financially sensible and politically acceptable solutions.

zh: 与别处一样，在欧洲金融政策是专家的事 — — 央行、监管者和监督者。
en: In Europe, as elsewhere, financial policy used to be the remit of specialists – central bankers, regulators, and supervisors.

zh: 仅此而已：专家早已失去了正统性。
en: Not anymore: the experts have lost their legitimacy.

zh: 如今，愤怒的人民在决策，政治在推动者金融政策。
en: Nowadays, angry citizens are in charge, and politics is driving financial policy.

zh: 但欧洲的政治是国家政治，一国议会所认定的唯一解决方案，换一个国家的议会会认为完全不可行。
en: But politics in Europe is national, and what one national parliament regards as the only possible solution another national parliament regards as entirely unacceptable.

zh: 欧洲尚未找到这一问题的应对措施，也没有走在找出应对措施的道路上。
en: Europe has not yet found a response to this problem, and it is not on the way to finding one.

zh: 欧洲的永久危机
en: Europe’s Perpetual Crisis

zh: 雅典—塞浦路斯援助协议是欧元区危机发展的分水岭，因为解决银行问题的责任从纳税人转移到了私人投资者和储户头上。
en: ATHENS – The Cyprus bailout deal is a watershed in the unfolding eurozone crisis, because responsibility for resolving banks’ problems has been shifted from taxpayers to private investors and depositors.

zh: 但让塞浦路斯银行储户承受巨大损失违反了存款保险保证，而这一保证又是欧洲银行联盟方案的组成部分，与此同时，资本管制的加强进一步削弱了货币联盟的基础。
en: But imposing major losses on Cypriot banks’ depositors violates the deposit-insurance guarantee that forms part of the proposed European banking union, while the imposition of capital controls further erodes the monetary union’s foundations.

zh: 那么，欧洲在搬起石头砸自己的脚吗？
en: So, is Europe chasing its tail?

zh: 德国和其他欧元区核心国放出的信号是，欧元区内部债务共同化绝无可能，对国家和金融机构的援助（bailout）必须由其债权人的“自救 ” （ bail-in）来平衡。
en: Germany and the other countries of the eurozone core are signaling that debt mutualization within the monetary union is out of the question, and that bailouts of countries or financial institutions will be balanced by “bail-ins” of their creditors.

zh: 存款安全的日益不确定将推高利率、加深欧洲衰退，可能还会导致资本从欧元区疲软外围国流出，流向核心国。
en: Increased uncertainty concerning the safety of deposits will push up interest rates and deepen Europe’s recession, and may also trigger capital outflows from the eurozone’s weaker peripheral economies to the core.

zh: 这或许将是一个意义深远的变化。
en: The implications of this shift may be far-reaching.

zh: 解决债务危机、回归内部和外部平衡的德国模式依赖于赤字国的财政整固和结构性改革。
en: The German model for resolving the debt crisis and returning to internal or external balance relies on fiscal consolidation and structural reforms for the deficit countries.

zh: 但是，如果所有国家同时尝试通过减支和增税改善其财政和外部平衡，那么所有国家都将失败，因为一国的紧缩意味着对其他国家产出需求的减少，反过来导致国内和外部失衡持续。
en: But, if all countries simultaneously attempt to improve their fiscal or external balances by cutting spending and raising taxes, all will fail, because each country’s austerity implies less demand for other countries’ output, in turn perpetuating both domestic and external imbalances.

zh: “自救”债权人会放大这一趋势。
en: “Bailing in” creditors will exacerbate these trends.

zh: 此外，深度而长期的衰退意味着对改革的支持下降，因为政府无法说服公民相信当下的牺牲能确保未来更好的生活。
en: Moreover, a deep and prolonged recession implies vanishing support for reforms, as governments fail to convince citizens that current sacrifice will ensure a better future.

zh: 私有化、市场自由化、开放封闭产业以及减小政府规模意味着与强大的既得利益起冲突，比如受保护产业中的企业、公共部门工会和强势游说集团。
en: Privatization, market liberalization, the opening of closed professions, and government downsizing involve conflicts with powerful vested interests, such as businesses in protected industries, public-sector unions, or influential lobbies.

zh: 解决这些冲突需要社会凝聚力，而不满、社会失序和政治动荡必然会破坏社会凝聚力。
en: Resolving such conflicts requires social alliances, which are invariably undermined by discontent, civil disorder, and political instability.

zh: 最近的意大利选举表明，紧缩政策和追求改革的合力可以造成极坏的效果。
en: The recent Italian election has shown how toxic the association of austerity policies with the pursuit of reform has become.

zh: 反紧缩愤怒扫荡了蒙蒂的前技术官僚政府的改革日程，未来充满不确定性的意大利走回了得过且过的老路。
en: Anti-austerity anger swept away the reform agenda of Mario Monti’s previous technocratic government, leaving Italy, its future uncertain, to continue muddling through.

zh: 相同的情景还出现在希腊，紧缩引发的深度衰退让产出在五年中下降了25 % ， 失业率上升到27 % ， 也在严重削弱持改革态度的中右翼政府。
en: The same scenario seems to be emerging in Greece, where the depth of the austerity-induced recession, with output down by 25% over five years and unemployment at 27%, is paralyzing a reform-minded center-right government.

zh: 这一战略的空白显而易见。
en: The gaps in the strategy are clear.

zh: 首先，欧元区当局误解了债务危机的真正根源。 债务危机的主要原因是核心国和外围国的竞争力差距拉大。
en: First, the eurozone authorities misread the real causes of the debt crisis, which stemmed mainly from a growing competitiveness gap between the core and periphery countries.

zh: 由此产生的私人部门失衡累积为银行问题，并最终转移为主权信用问题。
en: The resulting private-sector imbalances culminated in banking problems that were eventually transferred to sovereigns.

zh: 希腊的财政挥霍与其说是例外，不如说是常规。
en: Greece’s fiscal profligacy was the exception rather than the rule.

zh: 事实上，与美国相反，欧元区当局在2008年全球金融危机爆发后迟迟没有对银行系统进行整固，也没有切断主权信用和银行资产负债表之间的关联。
en: Indeed, in contrast to the United States, eurozone authorities were slow to consolidate the banking system after the global financial crisis erupted in 2008, and failed to sever the ties between sovereigns’ and banks’ balance sheets.

zh: 欧元区当局也没有强力推进结构性改革。
en: Nor did they push strongly for structural reforms.

zh: 相反，它们强调严厉的紧缩政策，并将其推而广之。
en: Instead, they emphasized harsh austerity, which was to be pursued everywhere.

zh: 其次，紧缩的效果因为追求名义而非结构性财政赤字目标而被放大了。
en: Second, the effects of austerity were exacerbated by the choice to pursue nominal, rather than structural, fiscal-deficit targets.

zh: 应该鼓励财政情况较好（即结构性赤字较低）的国家采取更具扩张性的政策，以提振总需求水平。
en: Countries with a stronger fiscal position (that is, smaller structural deficits) should be encouraged to adopt more expansionary policies in order to contribute to lifting overall demand.

zh: 此外，欧洲投资银行的贷款能力也可以大大提高，欧盟结构性基金应该被动员起来，为外围国的投资项目提供资金。
en: Moreover, the European Investment Bank’s lending capacity could be increased substantially, and European Union structural funds mobilized, to finance investment projects in the peripheral economies.

zh: 第三，欧洲央行去年8月宣布的“直接货币交易 ” （ OMT）计划 — — 通过担保欧元区成员国主权债务实现，但有相应的政策条件 — — 在抑制欧元区金融波动方面居功至伟。
en: Third, the European Central Bank’s announcement last August of its “outright monetary transactions” program – through which it guarantees eurozone members’ sovereign debt, subject to policy conditionality – has contributed significantly to subduing financial turbulence in the eurozone.

zh: 但OMT机制并未通过降低关键利率得到强化。
en: But the OMT scheme has not been reinforced by a reduction in key interest rates, which would boost inflation in core countries with external surpluses and thus help to close the competitiveness gap with the periphery.

zh: 降低关键利率能够刺激存在外部盈余的核心国的通胀，有助于减小外围国竞争���差距。
en: Crucially, monetary-policy measures do not address the underlying problem of lack of demand.

zh: 第四，欧元区当局误读了信心因素。
en: Last, but not least, the eurozone authorities misread the confidence factor.

zh: 从理论上说，同时进行财政整固和供给面改革有利于经济复苏，因为这会增加消费者和投资者信心，从而带来更高的支出和产量。 但对于一个不完美运行的货币联盟，这并不一定必然发生。
en: In theory, simultaneous fiscal consolidation and supply-side reform facilitates economic recovery, because it increases confidence among consumers and investors, thereby inducing higher spending and production.

zh: 欧元区正是如此，持续的系统性缺陷侵蚀了信心。 而在这样的环境下，其结果可能是囤积和资本外流，而不是支出增加。
en: But this does not necessarily work in an imperfectly functioning monetary union, such as the eurozone, where the continual appearance of systemic flaws erodes confidence; in such circumstances, the result may be hoarding and capital outflows, rather than increased spending.

zh: 欧元区的缺陷反映了其在概念上与美国的差距，后者才是唯一的成功运行的货币联盟。
en: The eurozone’s flaws reflect its conceptual distance from the US, which is the only model of a well-functioning monetary union.

zh: 欧洲的历史排除了模仿美国模式的可能。
en: Europe’s history rules out emulating the US model.

zh: 但是，为了让欧元区运转起来，货币统一应该扩大至财政和金融领域，从而形成一体化的经济联盟。
en: But, to make the eurozone work, monetary unification should extend to the fiscal and financial fields, thereby creating an integrated economic union.

zh: 欧洲当局越是在引入欧元债券、有效银行和财政联盟以及欧洲央行的最后贷款人地位等问题上逡巡不前，危机就会维持越久。
en: The longer that European authorities postpone the introduction of Eurobonds, an effective banking and fiscal union, and lender-of-last-resort status for the ECB, the longer the crisis will last.

zh: 通过塞浦路斯存款保险担保的事实违约，欧元区在银行联盟计划中退后了一大步。
en: By effectively defaulting on a deposit-insurance guarantee through its actions in Cyprus, the eurozone backtracked on the planned banking union.

zh: 追求同时深化衰退和削弱信心的战略无法解决债务危机。
en: Pursuing a strategy that simultaneously deepens recession and weakens confidence will not resolve the debt crisis.

zh: 由于衰退经济体一再爆发融资问题，政府可能会抵制“自救”以及相应的损失。
en: As funding problems recur in the recession-hit economies, governments may resist “bailing in” and the associated losses.

zh: 社会动荡和政治动荡可能转化为金融和社会危机，最终威胁货币联盟的生存。
en: Civil unrest and political destabilization could erupt into financial and social crises that ultimately threaten the monetary union’s survival.

zh: 简言之，塞浦路斯危机的“解决方案”对欧元区来说根本称不上是解决方案。
en: In short, the “solution” to the Cyprus crisis is no solution at all for the eurozone.

zh: 除非当局采取增长战略 — — 并且快速实施 — — 否则欧元区的前景将越来越暗淡。
en: Unless the authorities embrace a growth strategy – and do so quickly – the eurozone’s prospects will become increasingly bleak.

zh: 塞浦路斯最后也是最好的时机
en: Cyprus’s Last Best Chance

zh: 尼科西亚 — — 人们不禁要把北塞浦路斯最近一次议会选举的结果看作是对和平进程的一次打击。
en: NICOSIA – It is tempting to see the results of the recent parliamentary elections in northern Cyprus as a blow for the peace process.

zh: 土耳其北部塞浦路斯聚居区的选民拒绝让他们领袖麦赫迈特·阿里·塔拉特的政党与他在希腊的塞浦路斯同僚季米特里斯·赫里斯托菲亚斯谈判，制定统一塞浦路斯半岛的条款协议。 近八个月以来，塔拉特几乎每周都要与赫里斯托菲亚斯举行会谈。
en: Voters in the Turkish Cypriot north rejected the party of their leader, Mehmet Ali Talat, who has been meeting almost weekly for eight months with his Greek Cypriot counterpart, Demetris Christofias, to work out the terms of a settlement to reunify the island.

zh: 不过与政治进程相比，选举结果与糟糕的经济状况有着更密切的联系。
en: But the election result has more to do with the dire state of the economy than it does with the peace process.

zh: 选民们切身感受到经济孤立的痛苦，全球经济低迷让这种痛苦进一步加剧。
en: Voters are feeling the pain of economic isolation, made worse by the global downturn.

zh: 尽管失去了议会中的多数席位，但塔拉特仍然领导着土耳其塞浦路斯政府，而且仍将继续代表北方领导谈判的进程。
en: While he has lost his parliamentary majority, Talat is still head of the Turkish Cypriot administration and will continue to lead negotiations on behalf of the north.

zh: 尽管面临着重重困难，但他和赫里斯托菲亚斯双方都决心找到解决的办法。
en: Both he and Christofias remain committed to finding a solution, despite the difficulties they face.

zh: 不过选举结果仍然凸显了这样一个事实：那就是为塞浦路斯问题找到解决方案的时间已经所剩无几。
en: The election result nonetheless underscores the fact that time is running out to find a solution to the Cyprus problem.

zh: 塔拉特已经把2010年初的总统选举确定为达成协议的最后期限，而赫里斯托菲亚斯在自己的联盟内部并非没有政治阻力。
en: Talat has set the presidential election in early 2010 as a deadline for agreement, while Christofias is not without political challenges within his own coalition.

zh: 塞浦路斯给来访者留下的印象颇具欺骗性。
en: Cyprus presents visitors with a deceptive image.

zh: 东地中海艳阳高照的气候吸引着源源不断的旅游者，而南部的欧盟成员地位已经把希腊塞浦路斯人的收入水平推到比欧盟的平均水平还高。
en: The sunny climate of the eastern Mediterranean draws a steady stream of tourists, and European Union membership in the south has pushed income levels for Greek Cypriots higher than the EU average.

zh: 半岛也许还处在分裂状态，但许多人却享受着舒适安闲的生活。
en: The island might be divided, but life for many is comfortable.

zh: 不过，塞浦路斯仍然是一个冲突区域：尼科西亚仍然可以见到建有防御工事的街道，一支联合国维和部队在缓冲区内巡逻，而且有大量的土耳其军队在北部地区驻扎。
en: However, Cyprus remains a conflict zone: there are still fortified streets in Nicosia, a United Nations peacekeeping operation patrols the buffer zone, and there is a substantial Turkish military force in the north.

zh: 因此我们有更多理由确保塔拉特和赫里斯托菲亚斯的勇气和努力不会被白白地浪费掉。
en: This is all the more reason to make sure that the energy and courage of Talat and Christofias are not squandered.

zh: 这两位领袖政治资本有限，要想取得成功也不能只靠自身的良好愿望。
en: These two leaders have limited political capital, and they need more than their own goodwill to succeed.

zh: 首先，他们需要自己人加入到和平进程当中。
en: First, they need their own people to join them in the peace process.

zh: 绝大多数的塞浦路斯人都对现状不满，相信有和平解决的希望，拒绝再次陷入暴力，但却对谈判对手和和平进程抱有深深的不信任。
en: An overwhelming majority of Cypriots are unhappy with the status quo, believe a settlement is possible, and reject any return to violence, but are deeply distrustful of each other and of the peace process.

zh: 他们看到过太多的失败。
en: They have seen too many previous efforts fail.

zh: 特别是在政治家和媒体圈子里，愤世嫉俗和沾沾自喜的文化似乎成了一种自然而然的立场。
en: A culture of cynicism and complacency seems to be the default position, especially among politicians and the media.

zh: 开启和平应当是什么样子的辩论可能会有所帮助。
en: Opening up the debate about what peace could look like would help.

zh: 去年访问塞浦路斯时，我们注意到参政的妇女和青年是多么稀少。
en: When we visited Cyprus late last year, we noticed how few women and young people were engaged in politics.

zh: 像我们这样的老年男性主导了公众辩论，我们强烈敦促塞浦路斯领导人为那些被忽略的人留出更多空档。
en: Old men (like us) dominate public debate, and we strongly urge Cyprus’s leaders to make more space for those whose voices are not so readily heard.

zh: 其次，加强两派民众的交流至关重要。
en: Second, strengthening links between the two communities is essential.

zh: 塞浦路斯岛已经分裂了太长时间，以致于几代人在成长过程中根本不了解另一方的生活状况。
en: The island has been split for so long that generations have grown up with no idea of life on the other side.

zh: 学校、执法机构、足球俱乐部和电话、电力和自来水公司都很难跨过军事分界线进行合作。
en: It is very difficult for schools, law enforcement agencies, soccer clubs, and telephone, electricity, and water companies to cooperate across the Green Line.

zh: 青少年甚至无法跨越障碍发送短信。
en: Teenagers can’t even send text messages across the divide.

zh: 两派民众之间的贸易联系非常有限。
en: Trade between the communities is limited.

zh: 以尊重和敏感的态度降低这些障碍可以有助于弥合过去的创伤，而且更重要的是建立相互信任。
en: Lowering these barriers with respect and sensitivity would help to heal the wounds of the past and, importantly, to build trust.

zh: 研究人员已经估计统一可以提升18亿欧元的年度收入 — — 相当于每个家庭增加5，500欧元之多。
en: Researchers already estimate that reunification could raise annual incomes by about €1.8 billion – more than €5,500 per household.

zh: 人人都应该认识到统一能够带来很多好处，比如简化生活、增强经济、以及抵消任何协议都必不可少的妥协让步。
en: Everyone needs to see that there are benefits to reunification that will simplify life, strengthen the economy, and outweigh the compromises that any settlement will require.

zh: 第三，岛上各派主要地区势力必须尽到自己的职责。
en: Third, the major regional powers, whose presence hangs heavily over the island, need to play their part.

zh: 我们迫切呼吁希腊在和平进程中扮演更加建设性的角色，详细说明与土耳其实现关系正常化的好处，明确支持这个国家获得欧盟成员资格。
en: Greece is urgently called upon to play a more constructive role in the peace process by explaining the benefits of its own normalization of relations with Turkey and its support for that country’s EU membership.

zh: 而土耳其可以宣布从北塞浦路斯象征性撤军，借助这种善意的表示极大地推动人们对和平进程的信心 — — 这一举动也会对土耳其与欧洲的融合有很大的帮助。
en: And Turkey could give a tremendous boost to confidence in the peace process by announcing a symbolic withdrawal of some troops from northern Cyprus as a goodwill gesture – a move that would also greatly assist Turkey’s convergence with Europe.

zh: 最后，国际社会明确表示支持和平协议可以有助于说服双方领导成功的努力会带来相应的认可和酬劳。
en: Finally, explicit international expressions of support for a settlement would help to persuade the leaders of both communities that success would bring proper recognition and reward.

zh: 如果欧盟许以大笔的发展基金肯定会有所帮助，其中也包括在协议达成后解决财产问题。
en: It would certainly help if the EU promised substantial development funds, including for resolution of property issues, once an agreement is in place.

zh: 这是30年来塞浦路斯最好、也许也是最后一次联邦和解机会。
en: This is the best chance in 30 years for a federal settlement in Cyprus, and it may be the last.

zh: 如果这些谈判失败，那么岛屿可能陷入永久的分裂状态。 无论今天的环境多么良好，地缘政治都会随着时间的流逝逐渐笼罩这个小岛。
en: If these talks fail, partition will probably be permanent, and, no matter how benign the environment today, geopolitics will catch up with the island over time.

zh: 无法解决塞浦路斯问题是对北约、土耳其和欧盟间良好关系的一种严重的潜在威胁。
en: Failure to resolve the Cyprus problem is a potentially serious threat to good relations between NATO, Turkey, and the EU.

zh: 塞浦路斯人必须抓住这个机会建设一个健康、统一的国家，最大限度地发掘地区经济潜力，并且安全自信地在世界事务中发挥自身的作用。
en: Cypriots must seize this chance to build a healthy, reunited country that can make the most of its economic potential in the region, and play its part in world affairs with confidence and security.

zh: 救命的信念
en: Lifesaving Convictions

zh: 日内瓦 — — 200多名女孩在北非遭遇绑架令人联想起非洲儿童 — — 尤其女童是何其脆弱。
en: GENEVA – The plight of more than 200 girls abducted in northern Nigeria is a brutal reminder of just how vulnerable children in Africa – particularly girls – can be.

zh: 但认识到这并非现代非洲的真实写照是同样重要的。 坚决保护本国儿童是非洲领导人共同的选择。
en: But it is equally important to recognize that this is not a true reflection of modern Africa, and that African leaders are strongly committed to protecting their countries’ children.

zh: 他们能否提供富裕国家儿童所享有的保护取决于合作和信念这两个关键要素。
en: Their ability to provide the same kind of protection that children in wealthy countries enjoy requires two key ingredients: partnership and conviction.

zh: 究其原因虽然恐怖主义是一种潜在威胁，但非洲儿童面临的最主要的危险依然来自于疾病，而日常免疫往往就是疾病的预防举措。
en: That is because, though terrorism is an insidious threat, the biggest risk to Africa’s children is disease, which often can be prevented through routine immunization.

zh: 事实上，就在世界各国正在为寻找失踪女孩争论不休时，另一项威胁正在重新浮出水面：世界卫生组织最近宣布脊髓灰质炎传播上升为国际公共卫生紧急事件，同时有若干非洲国家正面临着输出疾病的持续风险。
en: Indeed, as the world debates the best way to recover the missing girls, another menace is resurfacing: the World Health Organization recently declared the spread of polio an international public-health emergency, with several African countries now posing an ongoing risk of exporting the disease.

zh: 幸运的是，战胜正在非洲和其他国家夺去生命的小儿麻痹症和其他许多能靠疫苗预防的疾病其实并不乏直接而有效的方法。
en: Fortunately, there are immediate and tangible ways to beat polio and a host of other vaccine-preventable diseases that currently claim innocent lives in Africa and beyond.

zh: 此外，非洲领导人意识到，常规免疫才是为儿童提供长期、可持续保护的最好方法。
en: Moreover, African leaders recognize that the best way to provide children with long-term and sustainable protection is through routine immunization.

zh: 本月初，非洲国家领导人在尼日利亚首都阿布贾会面并通过了免疫非洲2020宣言，承诺投资于国内所有儿童健康和可持续的未来。
en: Earlier this month, African leaders meeting in Nigeria’s capital, Abuja, endorsed the Immunize Africa 2020 declaration, committing themselves to invest in a healthy and sustainable future for all children in their countries.

zh: 上述宣言非常重要，因为只有借助信念的力量我们才能真正带来积极的变化。
en: Such declarations are important, because it is only through the power of our convictions that we can ever truly bring about positive change.

zh: 而且积极的变化也确实发生了。
en: And change is indeed occurring.

zh: 2001年来非洲新推出了不下140种疫苗，这多亏当地领导人和全球疫苗免疫联盟（GAVI）及其合作伙伴联合国儿童基金会、世界卫生组织、世界银行和比尔梅林达盖茨基金会的支持。
en: Since 2001, there have been no fewer than 140 new vaccine launches in Africa, thanks to local leadership and support from my organization, the GAVI Alliance, and its partners, UNICEF, the World Health Organization, the World Bank, and the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation.

zh: 这项工作使非洲的免疫覆盖率从1980年的10%快速增加至2012年的72 % 。
en: As a result of this kind of work, immunization coverage in Africa has increased dramatically, from 10% in 1980 to 72% in 2012.

zh: 现在，从2016年至2020年，非洲50多个国家将通过全球疫苗免疫联盟及其合作伙伴向儿童疫苗接种注入超过7亿美元的直接投资。
en: And now, from 2016 to 2020, Africa’s 50-plus countries will commit more than $700 million directly toward the cost of childhood vaccines through GAVI and its partners.

zh: 这将使非洲一跃成为全球疫苗免疫联盟的第四大投资主体 — — 仅次于英国、比尔及梅林达·盖茨基金会和挪威。
en: This will make Africa the fourth-largest investor in GAVI, behind only the United Kingdom, the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, and Norway.

zh: 这项承诺预示着发展援助正在从传统的慈善型捐助朝着伙伴关系转型。
en: This kind of commitment signals a shift in development aid away from the traditional model of charity toward one built on partnership.

zh: 但鉴于非洲国家已经在医疗卫生服务领域花费了数十亿美元，而非洲大陆又有如此多的竞争性需求，疫苗投资或许并不总是一项显而易见的选择。
en: However, given that African countries already spend billions of dollars on health services, and that the continent has so many other competing needs, investing in vaccines may not always seem an obvious choice.

zh: 2003年我担任卫生及社会事务部长领导公共场所禁烟运动期间，挪威也曾面临着类似的选择。
en: Norway was in a similar situation in 2003 when, as Minister of Health and Social Affairs, I led the effort to ban public smoking.

zh: 当时禁令曾遭遇强烈的反对声浪，我被比喻成全世界最糟的独裁者。
en: At the time, there was strong opposition to the ban, and I was compared to the world’s worst dictators.

zh: 但我深知此举未来将拯救许多人的生命，我相信不采取行动就是我的失职。
en: But I knew that the move would save many lives for years to come, and I was convinced that if I did not act, I would not be doing my job properly.

zh: 我并没有孤军奋战：爱尔兰的同行与我所见略同。
en: And I was not alone: My Irish counterparts agreed.

zh: 随着个人和社会收益的不断凸显，又有100多个国家开始效仿挪威和爱尔兰的范例，今天挪威的烟民数已经减少了一半，高达十分之九的人支持禁烟运动。
en: As the gains to individuals – and society – became clear, more than 100 other countries followed Norway and Ireland’s lead, and today the number of smokers in Norway has been halved, and nine out of ten people support the ban.

zh: 事后看来某些解决方案似乎显而易见；但开始时需要信念的力量才能让解决办法人尽皆知。
en: With the benefit of hindsight, some solutions may seem obvious; but it took the power of conviction to make the solution apparent in the first place.

zh: 现在非洲和全球贫困国家的免疫接种事业就是这样的状况。
en: Such is the case now with immunization in Africa and poor countries worldwide.

zh: 上述国家的领导人已经看到了疫苗接种的好处，也相信未来几年带来的好处会更多。
en: These countries’ leaders have already seen what can be achieved with vaccines, and they see further benefits from immunization in the coming years.

zh: 其实从2000年启动以来，全球疫苗免疫联盟已经辅助4.4亿新增人口进行了预防接种，为挽救600万人的生命尽了一份力。
en: Indeed, since its launch in 2000, GAVI has already supported the vaccination of 440 million additional people, helping to save six million lives.

zh: 但现在因为全球疫苗免疫联盟的合作和捐助者准备本周在布鲁塞尔举行会议制定未来五年的投资计划，我们拥有现实的机会取得进一步的成功。
en: But now, as GAVI Alliance partners and donors prepare to meet in Brussels this week to map out GAVI’s funding for the next five years, there is a very real opportunity to do more.

zh: 在全球疫苗免疫联盟的支持下，我们有机会实现2020年接受免疫接种儿童数翻倍，从而达到总人数近10亿，并从现在起到那时避免超过500万人死亡。
en: With GAVI support, we have within our grasp the chance to double the number of children immunized by 2020, approaching one billion in total and averting the deaths of more than five million lives between now and then.

zh: 非洲领导人已经表明了决心；但在目前许多捐助国仍在努力巩固脆弱经济复苏的时刻，领导人们也要拿出决心和承诺。
en: African leaders have demonstrated their resolve; but, at a time when many donor countries are still struggling to consolidate a fragile economic recovery, it will take commitment and conviction on the part of their leaders, too.

zh: 没有人能够独自做到这一点，但通过合作我们的确可以保护这个世界上最脆弱的儿童。
en: None of us can do it alone, but through partnership we really can help to protect the world’s most vulnerable children.

zh: 被损害的民主
en: Damaged Democracy

zh: 纽约­ — — 即使在最高领袖阿亚图拉·阿里·哈梅内伊决定压制伊朗“受管理的民主”所剩无几的合法性之前，它实际上也是一种特殊的体制。
en: New York – Even before the Supreme Leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, decided to throttle what little legitimacy was left of Iran’s “managed democracy,” it was a peculiar system, indeed.

zh: 虽然伊朗公民有权选举他们的总统，但是候选人却必须接受宪法监护委员会的审查。 这个组织的半数成员是由不经选举产生的最高领袖来挑选的。
en: Although Iranian citizens had the right to elect their president, the candidates had to be vetted by the Council of Guardians, half of whom were picked by the unelected Supreme Leader.

zh: 唯一允许参选的候选人都具有无懈可击的宗教信仰，效忠一个体制 — — 虽然在这个体制里最重要的决定是由非选举产生的神职人员来做出的。
en: The only candidates allowed to run were men with impeccable religious credentials, loyal to a regime whose most important decisions are made by unelected clerics.

zh: 米尔·侯赛因·穆萨维就是这样一个人。 1981年，他被后来的最高领袖阿亚图拉·哈梅内伊挑选成为总理。
en: Mir-Hossein Mousavi, chosen by the late Ayatollah Khomeini to be prime minister in 1981, was such a figure.

zh: 穆萨维作为一个改革派来参与本次竞选，表示自己将为争取更多的新闻自由，妇女的更大权益和减少对伊朗人私生活的限制而奋斗。
en: Mousavi ran as a reformist who said he would strive for greater freedom of the press, more rights for women, and fewer restrictions on the private lives of Iranians.

zh: 他还暗示将在对美谈判时采取更为灵活的立场。
en: He also hinted at more flexibility in negotiations with the United States.

zh: 然而在一场看起来类似作弊的选举程序中，穆萨维被强硬派艾哈迈迪·内贾德击败了。 美国的一些新保守主义者对此如释重负。
en: Yet Mousavi’s defeat by the hardliner, Mahmoud Ahmadinejad, in what looked like a rigged electoral process, was greeted by some neo-conservatives in the US with relief.

zh: 一位卓越的评论家马克思·布特“对伊朗选举的结果略感满意 ” ， 因为奥巴马现在将发现阻挡以色列向伊朗的核设施发动袭击更困难了。
en: One prominent commentator, Max Boot, took “some small degree of satisfaction from the outcome of Iran’s elections,” because Obama would now find it harder to stand in the way of an Israeli attack on Iran’s nuclear installations.

zh: 由于伊朗是敌人（还记得乔治·W·布什的“邪恶轴心论”吗？ ） ， 与该国一个说话行事类似疯狂暴徒的总统打交道，总比和一位理性健全，承诺改革的总统要好一些。
en: Since Iran is the enemy (remember George W. Bush’s “axis of evil”?), it is better to deal with a president who talks and acts like a crazy thug, than with a reasonable-sounding figure who promises reforms.

zh: 看起来这似乎是格外玩世不恭或犬儒主义，当然也的确如此。
en: This would seem like the height of cynicism, which of course it is.

zh: 它提醒我们极端的新保守主义和共产主义的意识形态在精神上是极其接近的。
en: It reminds us of the closeness, in spirit, between extreme neo-cons and communist idealogues.

zh: 激进者的头脑对于采取妥协深恶痛绝。
en: Compromise is anathema to the radical mind.

zh: 一些极端左翼穆斯林，满怀着对西方“帝国主义”和以色列的反感，欢迎穆萨维的落败，其原因就像一位行动者表述的那样 “ （ 反犹太复国主义的）抵抗可不能承受一场亲美的天鹅绒革命 ” 。
en: Some radical leftist Muslims, obsessed with their opposition to Western “imperialism” and Israel, saluted Mousavi’s defeat, for, as one such activist put it, “the [anti-Zionist] resistance cannot afford a pro-American velvet revolution.”

zh: 共产主义者总是趋向无视自由民主政体中选举人的差别（更不用说受“管理”的体制了 ） 。
en: Communists always had a tendency to dismiss the differences between candidates in liberal democracies (let alone “managed” ones).

zh: 他们只不过是同一个溃烂体制中的不同脸孔而已。
en: They were just different faces of the same rotten system.

zh: 实际上，社会民主党人被认为比强硬的保守派更危险，因为他们温和的左翼谈话只是用来延迟革命而已。
en: In fact, social democrats were regarded as more dangerous than hard-line conservatives, because their moderate left-wing talk only served to postpone the revolution.

zh: 这种思维帮助纳粹在1930年代摧毁了德国的民主制度。
en: This kind of thinking helped the Nazis destroy German democracy in the 1930’s.

zh: 布特的反应，还有他的其他说服之道，指出了一个真实的困境。 这一困境总是发生在极权体制之下，而这些体制采用一些民主的假象来支持它们的合法性。
en: The reaction of Boot, and others of his persuasion, points to a genuine dilemma that always occurs in authoritarian systems that use some semblance of democracy to bolster their legitimacy.

zh: 当反对派的候选人被要求参加选举，而且知道他们无法获胜，或者，即使他们赢得选举，也只会被赋予很少的权威，他们该怎么办？
en: What are opposition candidates to do when they are asked to take part in elections that they know they cannot win, or that, even when they can win, will give them only minimal authority?

zh: 如果他们同意，就是在帮助一个自身并不信任的体制合法化，如果他们拒绝，他们就全无影响力。
en: If they agree, they help to legitimize a system in which they do not really believe. If they refuse, they have no influence at all.

zh: 这两种原因都有其正确之处。
en: There are valid arguments to made for either course.

zh: 任何能够表达自己观点的机会，即使是在作弊的选举中，对于人民而言都是一件好事。
en: Any chance for people to voice their views, even in rigged elections, is a good thing.

zh: 而且，由于民主事关机构也同样事关候选人，公民行使投票权也是一件好事。
en: And, because democracy is about institutions as much as about individual candidates, it is also good for citizens to exercise their right to vote.

zh: 这样，当真正的变化的确发生之时，没有人能够宣称人民“还没有准备好 ” 。
en: Then, when real change does occur, no one can claim that the people “are not ready for it.”

zh: 然而，如果投票赋予公民尊严，被卷入舞弊就是屈辱。
en: Still, if voting confers dignity on citizens, participation in a fraud is humiliating.

zh: 并没有一个绝对准绳来衡量如何在这些难有作为的情形下行事，所以人们必须依据每次选举的实质来评判。
en: There is no absolute yardstick on how to behave in these impossible circumstances, so people must judge every election on its merits.

zh: 因为有85%的伊朗选民决定值得参加上一次的选举，他们的决定必须得到尊重。
en: Since 85% of Iranian voters decided that it was worth taking part in the last election, their decision must be respected.

zh: 虽然他们的选择有限，许多人却有足够的信心相信改革派的候选人不仅能够当选，还能改善他们的生活。
en: Although their options were limited, many of them had enough confidence that the reformist candidate would not only get elected, but also make life a little better.

zh: 这也是为什么70%的选民在1997年把票投给了改革派的总统候选人莫哈默德·卡塔米。
en: This is also why 70% voted for Mohammed Khatami, the reformist president, in 1997.

zh: 卡塔米对于新闻自由，个人权利和民主改革同样有出色的见解。
en: Khatami, too, had good ideas about press freedom, individual rights, and democratic reforms.

zh: 他们主要是被掌握终极权力的神职人员击溃的。
en: They were mostly quashed by the clerics who held ultimate power.

zh: 布什政府放弃卡塔米可能于事无补。
en: It probably did not help that the Bush administration gave up on Khatami.

zh: 就像今天的一些新保守主义者一样，布什的外交政策顾问看不到改革派和强硬派之间的区别。
en: Like some neo-cons today, Bush’s foreign policy advisers saw no difference between reformists and hardliners.

zh: 这甚至进一步破坏了卡塔米的权威。
en: This undermined Khatami’s authority even further.

zh: 穆萨维被许多伊朗人视为是第二次机会。
en: Mousavi was regarded by many Iranians as a second chance.

zh: 不幸的是，哈梅内伊也这样想，同时确保艾哈迈迪·内贾德保住了他的总统席位。
en: Unfortunately, Khamenei thought so, too, and made sure that Ahmadinejad held onto his presidency.

zh: 对于所有渴望民主政治尊严的伊朗人而言，这是一次痛苦的打击。
en: This was a sickening blow to all Iranians who crave the dignity of democratic politics.

zh: 但是，这并不意味着他们的尝试是错误或者天真的。
en: But it does not mean that they were wrong, or naïve, to try.

zh: 穆萨维的竞选及其后果清楚地显示出：那些只表示看出候选人之间在风格和陈述上的差别，而对其他不同视而不见的人错了­ — — 即使存在选举舞弊，反对神职威权主义的声音也被世界听到了。
en: Mousavi’s campaign, and its aftermath, showed clearly that those who professed to see no difference between the candidates, except in style and presentation, were wrong: even if the election was rigged, the voices of opposition to clerical authoritarianism were heard.

zh: 对于伊朗在世界的形象而言，选举后的抗议所体现出的静默的尊严，远胜于任何一位民粹派总统摆出的或多或少的好战姿态。
en: The quiet dignity of the protests that followed did more for Iran’s standing in the world than any amount of belligerent posturing by a populist president.

zh: 也许已经产生了一个更重要的后果。
en: There may have been a more important consequence.

zh: 选举，舞弊，以及对随后抗议的暴力镇压显示出了，而且显然加剧了体制内部的纵深裂痕。
en: The election, the fraud, and the violent crackdown on the subsequent protests revealed, and clearly widened, deep rifts inside the regime.

zh: 这就是为什么在大多数情况下争夺选举是最佳方法，即使是在不太乐观的情况下。
en: This is the best reason why in most cases it is best to contest elections, even in unpromising circumstances.

zh: 他们暴露出了独裁政权墙壁上的裂纹。
en: They expose cracks in the wall of dictatorial power.

zh: 艾哈迈迪·内贾德赢得了选举，但结果是体制受到削弱。
en: Ahmedinejad won the election, but the regime is weakened as a result.

zh: 恐怖能够延长痛苦，然而最终一个非法的政体的命运已经注定。
en: Terror can prolong the agony, but in the end an illegitimate regime is doomed.

zh: 坚持相信改革派和强硬派只是同一个敌人的面具，并且因为后者的胜利而心生喜悦，这不仅仅是玩世不恭、犬儒主义，而且还是对一个已经蒙受羞辱的民族再施加额外的侮辱。
en: To persist in the belief that reformists and hardliners are just masks of the same enemy, and to take pleasure in the victory of the latter, is not merely cynical, but is an added insult to a people that has already been humiliated enough.

zh: 低利率伤害调查
en: Surveying the Damage of Low Interest Rates

zh: 华盛顿—2008年金融危机后的多年中，决策者因为避免了第二次大萧条而为自己“点赞 ” 。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – For years after the 2008 financial crisis, policymakers congratulated themselves for having averted a second Great Depression.

zh: 他们用当时做需要的凯恩斯主义财政和货币刺激应对全球衰退。
en: They had responded to the global recession with the kind of Keynesian fiscal and monetary stimulus that the moment required.

zh: 但九年过去后，官方利率仍在零水平线上徘徊，而增长则一直平庸。
en: But nine years have passed, and official interest rates are still hovering around zero, while growth has been mediocre.

zh: 自2008年以来，欧盟平均年增长率只有0.9 % 。
en: Since 2008, the European Union has grown at a dismal average annual rate of just 0.9%.

zh: 在危机后立即形成的广泛的凯恩斯主义共识已经成为当今流行的经济教条：只要增长保持萎靡，年通货膨胀率保持不到2%的水平，那么加大刺激不但是合适的，更是必须的。
en: The broad Keynesian consensus that emerged immediately after the crisis has become today’s prevailing economic dogma: as long as growth remains substandard and annual inflation remains below 2%, more stimulus is deemed not just appropriate, but necessary.

zh: 这一教条背后的观点是有缺陷的。
en: The arguments underlying this dogma do not hold water.

zh: 首先，通胀指标很拙劣，可以随心所欲地控制。
en: For starters, measures of inflation are so poor as to be arbitrary.

zh: 哈佛大学的马丁·费尔德斯坦（Martin Feldstein）指出，政府没有什么好办法测量服务和新技术的价格通胀，而后两者占发达经济体GDP的比重越来越大。 这是因为这些部门的质量会随时间而发生重大变化。
en: As Harvard’s Martin Feldstein notes, governments have no good way to measure price inflation for services and new technologies, which account for an ever greater share of advanced economies’ GDP, because quality in these sectors varies substantially over time.

zh: 此外，不动产和其他资产甚至没有被纳入通胀的计算中。
en: Moreover, real estate and other assets are not even included in the accounting.

zh: 认定通胀必须达到2%的年率也可谓武断。
en: The dictate that inflation must rise at an annual rate of 2% is also arbitrary.

zh: 瑞典经济学家克努特·维克赛尔（Knut Wicksell）一百年前就提出了“自然”利率的概念 — — 在这个利率上，真实（经通胀调整的）GDP增长跟随长期平均值，而通胀保持稳定，这个概念至今仍有意义。
en: Swedish economist Knut Wicksell’s century-old concept of a “natural” interest rate – at which real (inflation-adjusted) GDP growth follows a long-term average while inflation remains stable – makes sense.

zh: 但为何通胀率永远应该保持在2 % ？
en: But why should the inflation rate always be 2%?

zh: 为什么要将服务、新技术以及（比如）中国制造商品与能源和食品一起排除在核心通胀之外？
en: And why aren’t services, new technologies, or, say, Chinese manufactured goods excluded from the measure of core inflation, alongside energy and food?

zh: 考虑到这些缺陷，应该问问，央行的“通胀目标”教条会不会遭遇到20世纪80年代货币主义的命运。 当时，决策者沉溺于货币供给。
en: Given these shortcomings, it is worth asking if central banks’ doctrine of “inflation targeting” will suffer the same fate as monetarism in the 1980s, when policymakers obsessed over the supply of money.

zh: 以今天的通胀水平看，当时的央行连衡量货币数量的可信方法都没有，更不用说实现合意的货币政策结果了。
en: As with inflation today, central bankers then had no credible way even to measure the quantity of money, let alone deliver desired monetary-policy outcomes.

zh: 我们应该考虑庞大的预算赤字可能也是可疑的刺激形式的影响。
en: We should consider the effects of large budget deficits as another dubious form of stimulus.

zh: 2017年，欧盟经济增长徘徊在2.3%的年率水平上，在此之前，成员国已经将预算赤字从2010年平均占GDP的6.4 % ， 下降到平均占GDP的1.5 % 。
en: In 2017, economic growth in the EU swung up to an annual rate of 2.3%, after member states had finally reduced their budget deficits to an average 1.5% of GDP, down from 6.4% of GDP in 2010.

zh: 显然，危机后的财政刺激未必起到了刺激效果。
en: Apparently, the fiscal stimulus after the crisis was not all that stimulating.

zh: 相反，近几年来的货币紧缩倒是似乎起到了积极影响。
en: By contrast, tighter fiscal policies in recent years seem to have had a positive effect.

zh: 通常，金融危机会带来重大结构改革。
en: Usually, a financial crisis gives rise to major structural reforms.

zh: 但不论是2008年金融危机，还是随后的欧元危机（因公共债务过多引起 ） ， 都没有导致受影响国家出现大规模去杠杆化或熊彼特式创造性破坏。
en: But neither the 2008 crisis nor the subsequent euro crisis, which was caused by excessive public debt, led to significant deleveraging or Schumpeterian creative destruction in the affected countries.

zh: 显然，政府支出的洪流打消了进行艰难改革的必要，老牌企业利用廉价融资巩固了自己的地位。
en: Clearly, the flood of government spending alleviated the need for difficult reforms, and allowed incumbent enterprises to shore up their positions with cheap finance.

zh: 一切结构更新的希望都被扼杀在萌芽状态。
en: Any chance at structural renewal was smothered in the crib.

zh: 在欧盟国家中，平均公共债务水平从2009年占GDP的73%升高到2016年占GDP的86 % ， 远高于马斯特里赫特条约所制定的占GDP60%的上限。
en: Among EU countries, average public debt increased from 73% of GDP in 2009 to 86% of GDP in 2016, far above the ceiling of 60% of GDP set by the Maastricht criteria.

zh: 在南欧，公债水平甚至高到了对未来多年的增长形成抑制效应的程度。
en: In Southern Europe, public debts are so large that they will depress growth for years to come.

zh: 然而，过去十年中的极低利率，有可能比赤字支出的毒害作用更大。
en: And yet the past decade of ultra-low interest rates will likely prove even more pernicious than the years of deficit spending.

zh: 下一次金融泡沫破裂会发生在何时、何地，我们尚不清楚。
en: There is no telling when or where the next financial bubble will burst.

zh: 但我们应该认真领会已故的查尔斯·金德尔伯格（Charles Kindleberger）和哈佛大学的肯尼斯·罗格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）和卡门·莱茵啊哈特（Carmen Reinhart）的发现，谨慎行事。
en: But we would do well to heed the findings of economists such as the late Charles Kindleberger and Harvard’s Kenneth Rogoff and Carmen Reinhart, and tread carefully.

zh: 毕竟，泡沫随处可见。
en: After all, one can spot potential bubbles all over the place.

zh: 不动产和其他资产价格在世界大部频创新高。
en: Real-estate and other asset prices are at record highs in much of the world.

zh: 流通中的比特币币值在今年增加了十倍，达到了1,700亿美元，尽管这种加密货币的基本价值仍然颇为可疑。
en: And the value of bitcoin in circulation has increased tenfold just this year, to $170 billion, although the cryptocurrency’s underlying value remains dubious at best.

zh: 极低利率还导致人们争夺高收益率，哪怕治理不善的穷国如塔吉克斯坦也可以发行欧元债券。
en: Ultra-low interest rates have also created such a scramble for higher yields that even a poor, mismanaged country like Tajikistan can sell Eurobonds.

zh: 对塔吉克斯坦总统拉赫蒙来说，这肯定比求助于国际货币基金组织（IMF）更好，后者会要求他进行重大改革。
en: For Tajik President Emomali Rahmon, that certainly beats seeking help from the International Monetary Fund, which would demand substantial reforms.

zh: 感谢低利率，拉赫蒙可以继续在他的前苏联共和国中为所欲为。
en: Thanks to low interest rates, Rahmon can continue to misrule his former Soviet republic as he sees fit.

zh: 极低利率的其他受害者也已经呼之欲出。
en: The many other victims of ultra-low interest rates should be all too apparent.

zh: 中产阶级储蓄者眼看着自己的银行存款的真实价值以每年2%的速度缩水，许多退休者也遭遇到退休金真实价值缩水，这些资金被投资于安全资产，因此几乎无法产生回报。
en: Middle-class savers have watched the real value of their bank deposits decline annually at a rate of about 2%, and many retirees have suffered a real decline in their pensions, which are invested in safe assets and thus yield minimal returns.

zh: 许多保险形式也是如此。
en: The same is also true for many forms of insurance.

zh: 保险商本身做得还不错，但这是因为他们一直在削减保额，大概过不了多久，他们的客户就要怀疑为什么要投保了。
en: Insurers themselves seem to be doing fine, but that is because they have been cutting benefits to the point that their customers will soon wonder why they bothered to take out policies in the first place.

zh: 就连银行也是压力重重。
en: Even banks are beleaguered.

zh: 在发达经济体，传统贷款人受制于各种监管，不得不收缩海外业务。
en: In advanced economies, traditional lenders are now subject to such a mass of regulation that they have had to withdraw from foreign activities.

zh: 毫不奇怪，监管较少的中介（影子银行系统）插进来夺走了它们的大部分业务。
en: Not surprisingly, less regulated intermediaries in the shadow banking system have stepped in to seize much of their business.

zh: 传统上，银行业务的核心是吸引存款，发放贷款。
en: Traditionally, the banking business centered around attracting deposits and issuing loans.

zh: 但拜“长期低迷”的利率所赐，银行业务的比重越来越低，而银行不得不在各种其他金融服务上收取越来越高的费用。
en: But as a result of “low-for-long” interest rates, that share of banking has become ever smaller, and banks have had to charge ever-higher fees for various other financial services.

zh: 此外，低利率让货币流向了比较不透明、投机性质更大的金融机构，如私募股权基金和对冲基金。
en: Moreover, low interest rates have diverted money toward less transparent and more speculative financial institutions, such as private-equity and hedge funds.

zh: 这些机构因廉价信贷而繁荣 — — 在大部分西方国家的税收制度中，信贷比股本融资享受更有利的条件。
en: Such institutions thrive on cheap credit, which enjoys more favorable treatment than equity financing under most Western tax regimes.

zh: 低利率的好处没有流向大众，更没有流向中产阶级，而是流向了富豪 — — 最顶层的0.1 % 。
en: The benefits of low interest rates have accrued not to the population at large, and certainly not to the middle class, but to billionaires – the top 0.1%.

zh: 在过去的十年中，全球财富差距大幅扩大，美国尤甚，由于存在“附带收益”等特殊规则，富豪几乎不纳税。
en: The global wealth gap has widened significantly in the past decade alone, and especially in the US, where billionaires pay little to nothing in taxes thanks to special rules such as “carried interest.”

zh: 而根据新的共和党税收计划，他们的纳税额还会进一步减少。
en: And under the new Republican tax plan, they will pay even less.

zh: 现在的问题是西方制度是否足够强大，能够遏制低利率所造就的全球财阀。
en: The question now is whether Western institutions are strong enough to contain the global plutocracy that low interest rates have wrought.

zh: 大一统的经济理论？
en: A Grand Unified Economic Theory?

zh: 纽约—上个月，美国政府因为两党在国会预算谈判中陷入僵局而关门，这堪称是现代经济政策争论中普遍存在的两极分化现象的缩影。
en: NEW YORK – Last month’s US government shutdown – the result of a partisan standoff in congressional budget negotiations – epitomizes the polarization that prevails in modern economic-policy debates.

zh: 一方面，凯恩斯阵营认为政府干预可以通过刺激总需求并反过来提高就业率从而有助于一切经济体走出危机。
en: On one side, John Maynard Keynes’s cohort argues that government intervention can help any economy grow its way out of crisis by spurring aggregate demand and, in turn, raising the employment rate.

zh: 凯恩斯主义者主张，一国政府有能力 — — 也有责任 — — 解决许多（如果不是全部的话）经济问题。
en: A country’s government, Keynesians contend, has the capacity – and responsibility – to solve many, if not all, of its economic problems.

zh: 另一方面，奥地利学派经济思想（特别是哈耶克的思想）的追随者认为有限政府和自由企业构成了唯一可行的自由和繁荣之路。
en: On the opposite side, followers of the Austrian School of economic thought, especially the ideas of Friedrich Hayek, assert that limited government and free enterprise form the only viable path to liberty and prosperity.

zh: 市场时如何配置稀缺资源的最佳裁判，因此应该成为经济的主要推动力。
en: The market is the best arbiter of how to allocate scarce resources, and thus should serve as an economy’s main driver.

zh: 近几年来，这一长期存在的争论变得越来越激烈 — — 而僵局造成的代价也越来越高。
en: In recent years, this long-running debate has become increasingly contentious – and the costs of stalemate are mounting.

zh: 为了重塑发达经济体的增长，同时保持发展中世界GDP增长的强劲势头并减少贫困，我们需要兼顾这两派的更加统一的经济政策方针。
en: In order to restore growth in developed economies, while sustaining strong GDP growth and reducing poverty in the developing world, a more unified approach to economic policymaking that draws from both traditions is needed.

zh: 针对全球经济危机的官方反应凸显出干预主义模式的优点，证明了果断的政府行动能够有助于增强效率、出清失衡的市场，从而保护经济免受投资下降、失业增加所导致的需求短缺的影响。
en: Official responses to the global economic crisis highlight the interventionist model’s merits, proving that decisive government action can help to enhance efficiency and clear unbalanced markets, thereby protecting the economy from the demand shortfall caused by falling investment and rising unemployment.

zh: 但自由市场也起了关键作用，长期的基于激励的政策促进了科学和技术进步，从而提振经济体的增长潜力。
en: But the free market also has a crucial role to play, with longer-term, incentive-based policies catalyzing scientific and technological advancement – and thus boosting economies’ growth potential.

zh: 在决定如何促进创新又不必牺牲社会保障时，经济学家和决策者应该借鉴物理学。
en: In determining how to promote innovation without sacrificing social protection, economists and policymakers should take a lesson from the field of physics.

zh: 近一个世纪以来，物理学家试图将物理学巨擘之间针锋相对的思想统一起来，包括第一位预言中微子（最小微粒）的泡利和解释了时空曲率的爱因斯坦。
en: For nearly a century, physicists have attempted to merge the competing ideas of the field’s titans, including Wolfgang Pauli, the first physicist to predict the existence of neutrinos (the smallest particles of matter), and Albert Einstein, who explained the curvature of space-time.

zh: 所谓的“万有理论”将不可感知的微观与不可想象宏观调和起来，提供了对宇宙物理性质的全面理解。
en: The so-called “theory of everything” would reconcile the inconceivably small with the unimaginably large, providing a comprehensive understanding of the universe’s physical properties.

zh: 决策者应该致力于将看似分裂的理论统一起来，从而让政策决定与商业周期和经济的发展水平相协调。
en: Policymakers should be working to unite seemingly disparate theories to align policy decisions with the business cycle and the economy’s level of development.

zh: 这一方针应该寻求保护经济体免受政治驱动的政策变化的破坏性冲击，同时又不妨碍政府纠正危险失衡的能力。
en: Such an approach should seek to protect economies from the destabilizing impacts of politically motivated policy changes, without impeding governments’ ability to correct dangerous imbalances.

zh: 官员对于在增长时期减支和退出刺激措施的警惕性至少不能亚于在衰退时期引入这些政策。
en: Officials must be at least as vigilant about reducing expenditure and withdrawing stimulus measures during periods of growth as they are inclined to introduce such policies during downturns.

zh: 这一方针体现了决策是一种艺术而不是一种科学的观点，这是件好事：在经济决策中，我们需要更多的灵活性。
en: To the extent that this approach reflects the view that policymaking is an art, not a science, that is a good thing: the world needs more flexibility in economic policymaking.

zh: 但一些人可能会认为这值得担忧，特别是在全球经济危机导致越来越多的人怀疑基于激励的经济政策时。
en: But some might consider it a cause for concern, especially given growing suspicion of incentive-based economic policies in the wake of the global economic crisis.

zh: 许多人指责危机的根源是几十年来自由放任经济决策方针一直占据支配地位，并正确地赞扬了政府以促进复苏的手段进行的干预。
en: Many blame the crisis on the decades-long ascendancy of a laissez faire approach to economic policymaking, and rightly credit government intervention with facilitating recovery.

zh: 中国等国家取得了巨大的经济成功，在不到一代人的时间里，几亿人摆脱了极端贫困状态，这更��加强了对国家领导体系的支持。
en: The tremendous economic success of countries like China, where hundreds of millions of people have escaped abject poverty in a single generation, has reinforced support for state-led systems.

zh: 在发达国家也有很多人支持国家扮演更重要角色，从而确保迅速老化的人口能够获得承诺的社会福利。
en: In developed countries, too, many advocate a greater role for the state, in order to ensure that promised social benefits are delivered to rapidly aging populations.

zh: 事实上，在许多国家，政府的能力已经左支右绌。
en: In fact, in many countries, the government’s capacity is already strained.

zh: 正如德国总理默克尔所指出的，尽管欧洲以占全世界7%的人口生产了25%的财富，但也占据了50%的全球福利支出。
en: As German Chancellor Angela Merkel has pointed out, though Europe is home to just 7% of the world’s population and produces 25% of the world’s wealth, it accounts for 50% of global welfare payments.

zh: 若把美国也包括进来，那么全球11.5%的人口拿了88%的世界福利支出。
en: When the United States is included, 11.5% of the global population receives 88% of the world’s welfare payments.

zh: 但让自由市场原则彻底成为历史只能造成新的失衡。
en: But relegating free-market principles to the past would simply create a new set of imbalances.

zh: 决策者不能允许极端主义者继续劫持经济政策争论，而必须致力于弥合针锋相对的四象阵营。
en: Rather than allow extremists to continue to hijack economic-policy debates, policymakers must work to bridge competing schools of thought.

zh: 惟其如此，才可能出现有利于生产的学说，并且不会因为政府关门而终结。
en: Only then will productive discourse – the kind that does not end in government shutdown – be possible.

zh: 凯恩斯曾经写道，他同意“几乎所有”哈耶克的思想。
en: Keynes once wrote that he agreed with “almost all” of Hayek’s ideas.

zh: 哈耶克也认为他和凯恩斯“如此全面”的一致“令人安心 ” 。
en: And Hayek found it “reassuring” to know that he and Keynes agreed “so completely.”

zh: 这就带来了问题：到底是什么在阻挠经济学家和决策者设计 — — 或者说寻找 — — 大一统的经济学理论？
en: This raises the question: What is really preventing economists and policymakers from devising – or even seeking – a unified theory of economics?

zh: 中国大兴水利
en: Damming China’s Rivers

zh: 从长远来看，在中国的所有问题中，没有比如何解决经济发展和环境保护之间的尖锐矛盾更为关键的了。
en: Of all China’s problems, none will be more critical over the long run than how it resolves the tension between economic development and environmental protection.

zh: 没有其他地方的斗争结局比中国西南的云南省喜马拉雅山脚下的更为明显。
en: Nowhere are consequences of this struggle clearer than in the Himalayan foothills of the southwestern province of Yunnan.

zh: 云南省是亚洲三条大河的发源地。 它们是湄公河、怒江和金沙江。
en: Yunnan is home to three great Asian rivers: the Mekong, the Salween (or Nu), and the Jinsha.

zh: 三条河流都发端于青藏高原，平行流淌，穿过云南省的西北角进入东南亚。
en: All start on the great Tibetan Plateau and flow in parallel through the northwest corner of the province into Southeast Asia.

zh: 它们是中国未遭破坏的河流，但是现在却注定牺牲来满足中国对能源动力无法满足的饥渴。
en: They are China’s last pristine rivers, but are now slated for sacrifice to satisfy the country’s insatiable thirst for power.

zh: 根据规划，将沿着蜿蜒于云南山谷中的河道中修建几十个水坝。
en: Plans call for dozens of dams to be placed along their serpentine courses through the mountains of Yunnan.

zh: 我最近在云南省北部小镇丽江北面雄伟的虎跳峡游历，从而有机会参观其中一条河流以及规划中的该国最为有争议的水坝。
en: I had the chance to see one of these rivers – and the proposed site of one of the country’s most controversial dams – on a recent trek through the stunning Tiger Leaping Gorge, north of the town of Lijiang in northern Yunnan.

zh: 奔腾的长江其支流金沙江从世界屋脊流淌，从这个十英里长的峡谷倾泻而下，直奔上海和中国东海。
en: On its descent from the roof of the world, the Jinsha River, tributary of the mighty Yangtze, cascades through this ten-mile gorge on its way to Shanghai and the East China Sea.

zh: 如果在这条河流上修建水坝，或者说水坝修建以后，金沙江将为中国沿海城市和工厂提供电力。
en: If, or rather when, the river is dammed, it will help power the cities and factories of coastal China.

zh: 玉龙雪山白雪皑皑，晴空万里。 我的导游小春是一个17岁纳西族少年。
en: The sun was high above white-crowned Jade Dragon Snow Mountain when my guide pointed down the gorge at the brown waters churning thousands of feet below.

zh: 纳西族是云南22个少数民族之一。 他手指数千英尺下翻滚的棕色江水峡谷对我说 ： “ 那里就要建水坝了，这对我们非常不好。
en: “That’s where they will build the dam,” Xiao Chun, a 17-year-old Naxi, one of Yunnan’s 22 ethnic minorities, said.

zh: 会有很多污染。
en: “It will be very bad for us.

zh: 我希望这不会发生。
en: There will be a lot of pollution.
I hope it doesn’t happen.”

zh: 水坝将有用武之地。
en: The dam will have its uses.

zh: 云南省会昆明附近的滇池已经极度萎缩和污染，昆明面临着严重的用水短缺。
en: Dianchi Lake near the provincial capital, Kunming, is so shrunken and polluted that the city faces a serious water shortage.

zh: 从虎跳峡引来的水将冲刷滇池。 昆明没有滇池就无法兴旺繁荣。
en: Water from the Tiger Leaping Gorge will be diverted to flush out Dianchi Lake, without which Kunming will not prosper.

zh: 中国努力保持其经济发动机运转，水坝和水电的确是煤的清洁替代品。
en: As China seeks to keep its economic engine running, dams and hyrdopower do represent a cleaner alternative to coal.

zh: 中国计划到2010年将其水电容量翻一番，达到120百万千瓦，并且至少在以后的20年中修建更多的水电工程。
en: China plans to double its hydropower capacity to over 120 GW by 2010 and to build more hydropower-projects for at least another 20 years.

zh: 专家预计，中国的水电目前只有四分之一得到了利用。
en: Experts reckon that only a quarter of China’s hydropower has yet been tapped.

zh: 但是，有可能得不偿失。
en: Yet the costs may outweigh the benefits.

zh: 西南部的云南省是世界上生物物种最为多样的地区之一，拥有中国一半的动物种类和四分之一的植物种类。
en: Northwestern Yunnan is one of the world’s most biologically diverse areas, home to half of China’s animal species and a quarter of its plant species.

zh: 这些生态系统即使不被水坝所吞没，也几乎肯定会被打破，后患无穷。
en: Whatever portions of this ecosystem that the dams don’t submerge are certain to be disrupted in potentially disastrous ways.

zh: 更为迫切的担忧是，当水库淹没该地区人口稠密的峡谷时，将有大量人口需要被重新安置。
en: A more immediate concern is the immense number of people who will need to be resettled when reservoirs inundate the region’s densely populated valleys.

zh: 从1949年以来，1,600万人由于修建水库而流离失所。
en: Since 1949, 16 million people have been displaced by reservoirs.

zh: 大约1,000万人生活贫困。
en: Some 10 million of them still live in poverty.

zh: 在虎跳峡，只有10万居民迁移。 但是，当地居民担心他们会被下令迁往陡峭的山坡上，在6,000 到9,000英尺的高度上开垦贫瘠土地。
en: At Tiger Leaping Gorge, where a mere 100,000 residents will have to be relocated, residents fear that they will be ordered to move up the steep mountainsides to open marginal land at 6,000 to 9,000 feet.

zh: 反对修建水坝的人士，包括当地敢于直言的环保团体展开了一场看似成功的斗争来保护虎跳峡以及怒江。
en: Dam opponents, including vocal indigenous environmental groups, have waged a seemingly successful battle to protect Tiger Leaping Gorge and the Salween (the Nu River).

zh: 2005年初，在新的环境影响评估法规通过三年之后，国家环保总局下令30个大型工程停工，包括26个没有提交合格的环境影响评估的水电厂。
en: In early 2005, three years after a new law on environmental impact assessments (EIA’s) was passed, the State Environmental Protection Bureau (SEPA), ordered the halt of 30 large projects, including 26 hydropower plants that had failed to submit proper EIA’s.

zh: 其中之一就是怒江上的第一个水坝。
en: Among the suspended projects was the first dam across the Nu/Salween.

zh: 这些努力看起来在该国的领导人中激发了更大的环境敏感度。
en: These efforts appear to have catalyzed greater environmental sensitivity among the country’s leaders.

zh: 政府最近呼吁更为平衡的发展，甚至提出用“绿色指标”来衡量发展。
en: The government recently called for more balanced development, even proposing a “green index” to measure growth.

zh: 温家宝总理说，解决中国的问题时，他想要看到更为“科学发展 ” ， 甚至要求暂停怒江水坝。
en: Indeed, Prime Minister Wen Jiabao has declared that he wants to see more “scientific development” in China’s approach to its problems, and even called for a temporary halt of the Salween (Nu) River dam.

zh: 环保人士被允许参加有关虎跳峡工程的公开听证会，这是破天荒的第一次。
en: Environmentalists were even permitted to take part in a public hearing on the Tiger Leaping Gorge project, a first for China.

zh: 不幸的是，中共对此类民间活动的容忍反复无常。
en: Unfortunately, the Communist Party’s tolerance of such civic activity blows hot and cold.

zh: 推翻格鲁吉亚、乌克兰以及吉尔吉斯坦后苏联领导人的“颜色革命”另中共大惊失色。 中共害怕国内非政府组织也会成为大众起义的催化剂而予以打压。
en: The Party, alarmed by the “color revolutions” that toppled post-Soviet leaders in Georgia, Ukraine, and Kyrgyzstan, is cracking down on domestic non-government organizations for fear that they, too, might become catalysts for popular uprisings.

zh: 在像国家环保总局那样的中央政府机关内对“绿色发展”的支持根本无法保证有效地抵消对环境的破坏。
en: Support for “green development” inside central government organizations like SEPA offers little assurance of an effective countervailing force.

zh: 国家环保总局副局长潘岳在该局停止水坝工程时说 ： “ 我们必须加大力度。
en: “We must sharpen our teeth,” Pan Yue, SEPA’s deputy director, said when the agency halted the dam projects.

zh: ”但是，中国近年来中央权力分散，使得环保总局难以影响省市和地方的政策。
en: But China has seen a steady decentralization of power in recent years, making it harder for SEPA to affect policies at the regional and local levels.

zh: 实际上，地方政府对于北京的权威不像以往那样惧怕。
en: Indeed, local governments appear less afraid of Beijing’s bite than before.

zh: 2003年，联合国教科文组织将云南三江并流公园列为世界自然遗产地。 地方当局意识到虎跳峡水坝可以将税收提高三倍，因此在进行边界谈判的时候，将虎跳峡排除在外赢得了胜利。
en: When boundaries were negotiated for Three Parallel Rivers Park – designated a UNESCO World Heritage site in 2003 – local authorities won a fight to exclude Tiger Leaping Gorge, knowing that a dam there would triple tax revenues.

zh: 中国急需维持9％的年增长率用以防止社会动荡。
en: China urgently needs to maintain an annual growth rate of over 9% as a bulwark against social disorder.

zh: 但是，结果却是中国正在耗尽自己，没有任何主要区域可以保持原始状态了。
en: As a result, however, China is slowly consuming itself, and no major part of China may remain pristine.

zh: 弱欧洲的危险
en: The Danger of a Weak Europe

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 1973年，美国国务卿亨利·基辛格在对越南和中国一段时间的全神贯注后，却宣布了“欧洲年”的决策。
en: CAMBRIDGE – In 1973, US Secretary of State Henry Kissinger, following a period of American preoccupation with Vietnam and China, declared a “year of Europe.”

zh: 最近，在美国总统奥巴马宣布美国战略“支点 ” ， 或再平衡转向亚洲后，许多欧洲人担心为美国所忽略。
en: More recently, after President Barack Obama announced a US strategic “pivot,” or rebalancing, toward Asia, many Europeans worried about American neglect.

zh: 现在，由于正在上演的难民危机、俄罗斯占领东乌克兰并非法吞并克里米亚、以及英国威胁退出欧盟，美国外交在2016年或许有必要再次做出“欧洲年”的决策。
en: Now, with an ongoing refugee crisis, Russia’s occupation of eastern Ukraine and illegal annexation of Crimea, and the threat of British withdrawal from the European Union, 2016 may become, by necessity, another “year of Europe” for American diplomacy.

zh: 无论喊什么口号，欧洲都仍具备相当的实力，并对美国的切身利益至关重要。
en: Regardless of slogans, Europe retains impressive power resources and is a vital interest for the United States.

zh: 尽管美国经济比德国大四倍，但由28个成员国组成的欧盟经济体量与美国对等，其5.1亿的人口规模则要比美国的3.2亿多得多。
en: Although the US economy is four times larger than that of Germany, the economy of the 28-member EU is equal to that of the US, and its population of 510 million is considerably larger than America’s 320 million.

zh: 诚然，美国的人均收入较高，但就人力资本、技术和出口领域而言，欧盟完全当得起美国的经济对手。
en: Yes, American per capita income is higher, but in terms of human capital, technology, and exports, the EU is very much an economic peer.

zh: 2010年危机爆发（即希腊和其他国家的财政问题引发金融市场焦虑）前，有些经济学家纷纷猜测欧元很可能迅速取代美元而成为世界主要储备货币。
en: Until the crisis of 2010, when fiscal problems in Greece and elsewhere created anxiety in financial markets, some economists had speculated that the euro might soon replace the dollar as the world’s primary reserve currency.

zh: 就军事资源而言，欧洲花在国防领域的开支还不到美国的一半，但服役人数却比美国更多。
en: In terms of military resources, Europe spends less than half of what the US allocates to defense, but has more men and women under arms.

zh: 英法两国拥有核武器及在非洲和中东实施海外干预的有限能力。
en: Britain and France possess nuclear arsenals and a limited capacity for overseas intervention in Africa and the Middle East.

zh: 两者同是打击伊斯兰国空袭战争中活跃的合作伙伴。
en: Both are active partners in the airstrikes against the Islamic State.

zh: 就软实力而言，欧洲感染力其实早已有之，而欧洲人一直在国际体系中发挥着核心作用。
en: As for soft power, Europe has long had wide appeal, and Europeans have played a central role in international institutions.

zh: 波特兰集团近期一项研究表明，欧洲在排名前20位的国家中占了14席之多。
en: According to a recent study by the Portland Group, Europe accounted for 14 of the top 20 countries.

zh: 欧洲团结在统一制度下的认知对欧盟邻国产生了强大的吸引力，尽管这种吸引力在金融危机后有所减弱。
en: The sense that Europe was uniting around common institutions made it strongly attractive for the EU’s neighbors, though this eroded somewhat after the financial crisis.

zh: 评估欧洲实力源泉的关键问题是欧盟能否保持足够的凝聚力在一系列国际问题上发出统一的声音，抑或仍然是由成员国不同的民族身份、政治文化和外交政策所定义的有限的机构。
en: The key question in assessing Europe’s power resources is whether the EU will retain enough cohesion to speak with a single voice on a wide range of international issues, or remain a limited grouping defined by its members’ different national identities, political cultures, and foreign policies.

zh: 答案因事而异。
en: The answer varies by issue.

zh: 比方说在贸易问题上，欧洲与美国完全对等，并且能够对美国力量进行制衡。
en: On questions of trade, for example, Europe is the equal of the US and able to balance American power.

zh: 欧洲在国际货币基金组织（IMF）的作用仅次于美国（尽管金融危机削弱了对欧元的信心 ） 。
en: Europe’s role in the International Monetary Fund is second only to that of the US (although the financial crisis dented confidence in the euro).

zh: 在反垄断问题上，欧洲市场的规模和吸引力意味着想要寻求合并的美国企业一定要获得欧盟委员会及美国司法部的双重批准。
en: On anti-trust issues, the size and attractiveness of the European market has meant that American firms seeking to merge have had to gain approval from the European Commission as well as the US Justice Department.

zh: 在网络世界，一个美国和其他跨国公司不能忽视的事实是欧盟正在制定隐私保护的全球标准。
en: In the cyber world, the EU is setting the global standards for privacy protection, which US and other multinational companies cannot ignore.

zh: 但欧洲统一面临着很大的局限性。
en: But European unity faces significant limits.

zh: 民族身份仍然压制着统一的欧洲身份。
en: National identities remain stronger than a common European identity.

zh: 右翼民粹主义政党已经将欧盟机构纳入了他们仇外的对象。
en: Right-wing populist parties have included EU institutions among the targets of their xenophobia.

zh: 欧盟内部的法律融合不断加强，但外交和防务政策融合仍停留在很低限度。
en: Legal integration is increasing within the EU, but the integration of foreign and defense policy remains limited.

zh: 英国首相戴维·卡梅伦已经承诺削减欧盟机构的权力，并将其与欧盟领导人的谈判结果于2017年底前付诸公投。
en: And British Prime Minister David Cameron has promised to reduce the powers of EU institutions and to subject the results of his negotiations with the Union’s leaders to a popular referendum by the end of 2017.

zh: 如果英国最终投反对票并退出欧盟，这将对欧洲士气造成严重的影响 — — 美国已明确表态要避免这样的结果，虽然它对阻止上述结果的发生束手无策。
en: If Britain votes no and exits the EU, the impact on European morale will be severe – an outcome that the US has made clear should be avoided, though there is little it could do to prevent it.

zh: 从长远看，由于出生率低且不愿接受大���模移民，欧洲所面临的人口问题非常严重。
en: In the longer term, Europe faces serious demographic problems, owing to low birth rates and unwillingness to accept mass immigration.

zh: 1900年，欧洲人口占世界的四分之一。
en: In 1900, Europe accounted for a quarter of the world’s population.

zh: 但到本世纪中叶，欧洲人口占比可能下降到6 % — —而且几乎三分之一的人达到65岁以上。
en: By the middle of this century, it may account for just 6% – and almost a third will be older than 65.

zh: 尽管有着德国总理默克尔的卓越领导，尽管目前的移民潮可能解决欧洲长期的人口问题，但它正在对欧盟团结构成威胁。
en: Although the current immigration wave could be the solution to Europe’s long-term demographic problem, it is threatening European unity, despite the exceptional leadership of German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

zh: 多数欧洲国家都产生了强烈的政治反弹，原因是移民流入速度过快（仅去年一年移民人数就超过百万）和许多新移民的穆斯林背景。
en: In most European countries, the political backlash has been sharp, owing to the rapid rate of the inflows (more than a million people in the past year) and the Muslim background of many of the newcomers.

zh: 这同样关系到美国重要的外交利益，但美国所能采取的措施却非常有限。
en: Again, an important American diplomatic interest is at stake, but there is not much the US can do about it.

zh: 欧洲成为美国长期威胁的几率很低，而且军费开支低并非唯一的决定因素。
en: There is little long-term danger that Europe could become a threat to the US, and not only because of its low military expenditure.

zh: 欧洲拥有全世界最大的市场，但却缺乏统一性。
en: Europe has the world’s largest market, but it lacks unity.

zh: 欧洲文化产业十分发达，但就高等教育而言，有27家欧洲大学跻身全球百强行列，而美国则高达52家。
en: And its cultural industries are impressive, though, in terms of higher education, whereas 27 of its universities are ranked in the global top 100, the US accounts for 52.

zh: 如果欧洲克服其内部分歧试图成为美国的全球挑战者，上述资产或许可以部分平衡美国的力量，但却不足以和美国平起平坐。
en: If Europe overcame its internal differences and tried to become a global challenger to the US, these assets might partly balance American power, but would not equal it.

zh: 对美国外交官而言，危险不在于欧洲变得过于强大，而在于它变得过于弱小。
en: For US diplomats, however, the danger is not a Europe that becomes too strong, but one that is too weak.

zh: 如果欧洲和美国保持同盟，两者的资源可以相辅相成发挥作用。
en: When Europe and America remain allied, their resources are mutually reinforcing.

zh: 虽然不可避免的摩擦导致拟议中跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系谈判放缓，但经济分离的可能性不大，而奥巴马将于四月前往欧洲推进跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系。
en: Despite inevitable friction, which is slowing the negotiation of the proposed Trans-Atlantic Trade and Investment Partnership, economic separation is unlikely, and Obama will travel to Europe in April to promote the TTIP.

zh: 美欧的双向直投高于亚洲，有助于双方的经济融合。
en: Direct investment in both directions is higher than with Asia and helps knit the economies together.

zh: 而且虽然美国人和欧洲人几个世纪来一直互相攻击，但与世界其他地区相比他们的民主和人权价值观是共同的。
en: And while Americans and Europeans have sniped at each other for centuries, they share values of democracy and human rights more with each other than with any other regions of the world.

zh: 美国和欧洲都不会威胁对方的关键或重要利益。
en: Neither a strong US nor a strong Europe threaten the vital or important interests of the other.

zh: 但2016年欧洲的削弱可能会对双方利益造成损害。
en: But a Europe that weakens in 2016 could damage both sides.

zh: 反现金事务
en: The Case Against Cash

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 世界已经陷入了纸币的汪洋大海之中，各主要国家央行每年都会释放出等值于数千亿美元的货币，而且主要是类似100美元这样的大面额现钞。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The world is awash in paper currency, with major country central banks pumping out hundreds of billions of dollars’ worth each year, mainly in very large denomination notes such as the $100 bill.

zh: 这些100美元大钞夸张地占据了美国4200美元年人均现金供应的近80 ％ 。
en: The $100 bill accounts for almost 80% of the US’s stunning $4,200 per capita cash supply.

zh: 1万日元钞票（约合100美元）则占了日本货币总量的90 % ， 而该国人均现金持有量约达7000美元。
en: The ¥10,000 note (about $100) accounts for roughly 90% of Japan’s per capita cash holdings at almost $7,000.

zh: 与此同时，正如笔者在近二十年来一直指出的那样，所有这些现金都主要用于促进地下经济 — — 而非合法经济 — — 的增长。
en: And, as I have been arguing for two decades, all this cash is facilitating growth mainly in the underground economy, not the legal one.

zh: 笔者并不是在提倡一个无现金社会，因为这在短期内既不可行，也不可取。
en: I am not advocating a cashless society, which will be neither feasible nor desirable anytime soon.

zh: 但一个现金较少的社会将会是一个更公平也更安全的所在。
en: But a less-cash society would be a fairer and safer place.

zh: 随着借记卡，电子转账和移动支付的发展，现金的使用已经在合法经济（特别是大中型交易）中逐渐减少。
en: With the growth of debit cards, electronic transfers, and mobile payments, the use of cash has long been declining in the legal economy, especially for medium and large-size transactions.

zh: 央行调查显示只有一小部分大面额纸币是由普通民众或企业持有和使用。
en: Central bank surveys show that only a small percentage of large-denomination notes are being held and used by ordinary people or businesses.

zh: 现金有利于犯罪，因为它是匿名的，而易于携带和隐藏的大面额钞票则尤其有问题。
en: Cash facilitates crime because it is anonymous, and big bills are especially problematic because they are so easy to carry and conceal.

zh: 你得有一个公文箱才能装下总值100万美元的100美元钞票，而同样的数额如果用500欧元钞票的话用一个小手提包就够了。
en: A million dollars in $100 notes fits into a briefcase, a million dollars in €500 notes (each worth about $565) fits into a purse.

zh: 当然还有许多种无需借助纸币就能贿赂官员，从事金融犯罪以及逃避税收的手段。
en: Sure, there are plenty of ways to bribe officials, engage in financial crime, and evade taxes without paper currency.

zh: 但这大多涉及非常高昂的交易成本（比如未切割的裸钻）或被侦测的风险（例如通过银行转帐或信用卡付款 ） 。
en: But most involve very high transaction costs (for example, uncut diamonds), or risk of detection (say, bank transfers or credit card payments).

zh: 此外例如比特币这样在逃避侦查方面近乎无懈可击的新时代加密货币几乎都能被用于上述目的。
en: Yes, new-age crypto-currencies such as Bitcoin, if not completely invulnerable to detection, are almost so.

zh: 但它们的价值经常大幅波动，政府也可以有许多手段来限制其使用 — — 比如禁止银行或零售商店接受这类货币。
en: But their value sharply fluctuates, and governments have many tools with which they can restrict their use – for example, by preventing them from being tendered at banks or retail stores.

zh: 而现金则不会存在这样的问题，因为其流动性强而且近乎畅通无阻。
en: Cash is unique in its liquidity and near-universal acceptance.

zh: 而光逃税的成本就大得惊人，仅在美国就达7000亿美元（包括联邦，州和地方税 ） ， 而在高税收的欧洲甚至更多。
en: The costs of tax evasion alone are staggering, perhaps $700 billion per year in the United States (including federal, state, and local taxes), and even more in high-tax Europe.

zh: 犯罪和腐败虽然难以量化，但几乎肯定会产生更大的成本，不仅包括非法毒品药品和诈骗，还有贩卖人口，恐怖主义和敲诈勒索。
en: Crime and corruption, though difficult to quantify, almost surely generate even greater costs. Think not just of illegal drugs and racketeering, but also of human trafficking, terrorism, and extortion.

zh: 此外，雇佣者向无证工人支付现金的行为已经成为非法移民的主要驱动力。
en: Moreover, cash payments by employers to undocumented workers are a principal driver of illegal immigration.

zh: 而打击现金使用则是比修建铁丝网更人性化的遏制非法移民方式。
en: Scaling back the use of cash is a far more humane way to limit immigration than building barbed-wire fences.

zh: 如果政府不是迷醉于印刷纸币所带来的利益的话，它们可能会意识到成本有多么庞大。
en: If governments were not so drunk from the profits they make by printing paper currency, they might wake up to the costs.

zh: 但如今也有了一些亡羊补牢的举动。
en: There has been a little movement of late.

zh: 欧洲央行近日宣布将逐步淘汰500欧元纸币。
en: The European Central Bank recently announced that it will phase out its €500 mega-note.

zh: 然而这一迟到的变革却面对着热爱现金的德国和奥地利人的极力阻挠。
en: Still, this long overdue change was implemented against enormous resistance from cash-loving Germany and Austria.

zh: 但即便是在北欧，其人均货币持有量仍然相对于欧元区整体的大量超标纸币供应（人均超过3000欧元）为少。
en: Yet even in northern Europe, reported per capita holdings of currency are still quite modest relative to the massive outstanding supply in the eurozone as a whole (over €3,000 per capita).

zh: 而不顾一切想要提高税收收入的南欧各国政府则，虽然无法控制印钞，却也已经有所行动了。
en: Southern European governments, desperate to raise tax revenue, have been taking matters into their own hands, even though they do not control note issuance.

zh: 比如希腊和意大利就一直试图通过给零售现金使用额设定上限（分别为1500和1000欧元）来遏制现金使用。
en: For example, Greece and Italy have been trying to discourage cash use by capping retail cash purchases (at €1,500 and €1,000, respectively).

zh: 很显然，现金对小额日常交易以及保护隐私来说都依旧重要。
en: Obviously, cash remains important for small everyday transactions, and for protecting privacy.

zh: 那些赞成维持现状的北欧银行家都喜欢引用俄国小说家陀思妥耶夫斯基的名言 ： “ 金钱是凝固在货币里的自由。
en: Northern European central bankers who favor the status quo like to quote Russian novelist Fyodor Dostoevsky: “Money is coined liberty.”

zh: ”但陀思妥耶夫斯基指的是在十九世纪中叶沙俄监狱里 — — 而非现代自由国家 — — 的生活。
en: Of course, Dostoevsky was referring to life in a mid-nineteenth century czarist prison, not a modern liberal state.

zh: 尽管如此，北欧人也是不无道理的。
en: Still, the northern Europeans have a point.

zh: 问题是当前体系是否取得了合理的平衡，而笔者认为它显然没有。
en: The question is whether the current system has the balance right. I would argue that it clearly does not.

zh: 一套驾驭纸币的方案应具备三个指导原则。
en: A plan for reining in paper currency should be guided by three principles.

zh: 首先，有必要让普通市民继续享受现金的便捷性以及合理的匿名购买数额，同时遏制那些从事大规模反复匿名交易的批发商业模式。
en: First, it is important to allow ordinary citizens to continue using cash for convenience and to make reasonable-size anonymous purchases, while undermining the business models of those engaged in large, repeated anonymous transactions on a wholesale level.

zh: 其次，任何计划应以非常缓慢的速度推进（设想10~20年 ） ， 允许调整和中期修正来应对预想之外的问题。
en: Second, any plan should move very gradually (think a decade or two), to allow adaptations and mid-course corrections as unexpected problems arise.

zh: 第三，改革必须关注低收入家庭（尤其是那些无银行账户者）的需求。
en: And, third, reforms must be sensitive to the needs of low-income households, especially those that are unbanked.

zh: 在笔者的新书《现金的诅咒》中则提供了逐步淘汰大额钞票，只余留下小额钞票（10美元或以下）的方案。
en: In my new book, The Curse of Cash, I offer a plan that involves very gradually phasing out large notes, while leaving small notes ($10 and below) in circulation indefinitely.

zh: 通过向提供低收入户免费银行借记账户 — — 也可以用来接收政府的转移支付，该方案得以在金融上存在一定的包容性。
en: The plan provides for financial inclusion by offering low-income households free debit accounts, which could also be used to make government transfer payments.

zh: 而包括丹麦，瑞典在内的一些国家也已实施了这一最后步骤。
en: This last step is one that some countries, such as Denmark and Sweden, have already taken.

zh: 减少纸币的使用不会终结犯罪和逃税行为；但会迫使地下经济使用风险更大，流动性较差的支付方式。
en: Scaling back paper currency would hardly end crime and tax evasion; but it would force the underground economy to employ riskier and less liquid payment devices.

zh: 虽然在当今的高科技金融世界中现金似乎微不足道，但逐步淘汰大多数纸币的好处可比你想象中要大得多。
en: Cash may seem like a small, unimportant thing in today’s high-tech financial world, but the benefits of phasing out most paper currency are a lot larger than you might think.

zh: 中国改革者可以从欧洲教训中学到什么
en: Europe’s Lessons for China’s Reformers

zh: 布鲁塞尔—2013年所做出的最重要经济政策决策大概要数11月中共十八大三中全会的决定了 — — 市场应该在指导中国经济中起“决定性”作用。
en: BRUSSELS – The most important economic-policy decision of 2013 might well have been taken in November at the Third Plenum of the Chinese Communist Party’s Central Committee, which pledged that the market should be given a “decisive” role in guiding China’s economy.

zh: 目前中国是世界上仅次于欧盟的最大出口国，贡献了大约一半的全球增长，因此北京的决策对世界经济的影响力是最大的，要超过柏林、布鲁塞尔和华盛顿。
en: Because China is now the world’s largest exporter after the European Union, and accounts for about half of global growth, decisions taken in Beijing could have a more important impact on the world economy than those taken in Berlin, Brussels, or Washington, DC.

zh: 但是，尽管中国采取市场经济和改革开放让它在过去三十年中取得了令人惊异的经济成就，但其收入可能已经达到了问题不再是“太少市场”的水平。
en: But, while China’s embrace of the market and opening to the outside world has enabled it to achieve astonishing economic progress over the last three decades, the country might now have reached a level of income at which the problem is no longer “too little market.”

zh: 相反，如今不少中国的关键性问题需要政府扮演更强大的角色。
en: On the contrary, some of China’s key problems today require a stronger role for government.

zh: 比如，空气和水污染问题只有在更多的国家干预（包括中央和地方层面）下才能解决。
en: Air and water pollution, for example, can be addressed only by more state intervention, at both the central and local levels.

zh: 当局目前已将解决这一问题列为当务之急，并且毫无疑问中国有这样做的资源 — — 正如它创造了世界最大的制造业部门。
en: The authorities have now made solving the problem a high priority, and there can be little doubt that China has the resources to do so – much as it created the world’s largest manufacturing sector.

zh: 与雾霾和水污染的斗争关系到国家优势：巨量国内储蓄可以用来为治污设备投资提供必需的融资。
en: The fight against smog and water pollution plays to the country’s strength: the availability of huge domestic savings to finance the necessary investment in pollution-abatement equipment.

zh: 中国领导人所面临的的两难在于，花更大力气治理污染和建设基础设施的需要增加了实现其将经济增长模式从依靠投资和出口转变为依靠消费的目标的难度。
en: The dilemma for China’s leaders is that meeting the need for more in pollution control and infrastructure makes it more difficult to achieve their goal of shifting the country’s economic-growth model from one based on investment and exports to one based on consumption.

zh: 但今天的更多消费会进一步加剧污染问题。
en: But more consumption today would further aggravate the pollution problem.

zh: 因此，经济再平衡可能因为更加紧迫的环境投资需要而被推迟。
en: As a result, economic rebalancing may be delayed by the more urgent need for environmental investment.

zh: 其他经济领域也需要更多地政府监督。
en: Other areas of the economy require greater government oversight as well.

zh: 如果任由市场力量起作用，通信、天然气、电力和水务等网络型行业将趋向于形成垄断或寡头垄断。
en: Network industries like telecoms, gas, electricity, and water tend to become monopolistic or oligopolistic if left to market forces alone.

zh: 运转良好的经济之所以能实现更高水平的福利，不是因为减少了对这些部门的监管，而是因为更有效的监管防止了卡特尔的出现，从而保护了消费者。
en: Well-run economies achieve higher levels of welfare not because there is less regulation of these sectors, but because more efficient regulation prevents the emergence of cartels, thereby protecting consumers.

zh: 同样的逻辑也适用于国有企业改革。
en: Similar reasoning applies to reform of the state-owned-enterprise (SOE) sector.

zh: 关键问题不在于所有权形式（国有还是民营 ） ， 而在于必须保证这些企业根据市场原则在竞争环境下经营。
en: The key problem is less the form of ownership (state or private) than it is the need to ensure that these enterprises operate according to market principles and within a competitive environment.

zh: 欧洲经验肯定了这一点。
en: The European experience confirms this.

zh: 1957年建立了共同市场的《罗马条约》并未区分国有和私营企业，尽管当时经济中的大量部门（煤炭和钢铁行业的大部分，以及许多国家的银行业）都掌握在国家手中。
en: The Treaty of Rome, which established the common market back in 1957, did not distinguish between state-owned and private enterprises, though vast sectors of the economy (most of the coal and steel industry, and in many countries banking) were in state hands at the time.

zh: 相反 ， 《 罗马条约》建立了内部市场规则，阻止了政府给它们的公司带来不公平的优势。
en: Instead, the treaty established internal-market rules that barred governments from giving their companies unfair advantages.

zh: 对欧洲来说，禁止国家援助是一大局面改变因素，因为这迫使国有企业在平等竞技场中经营，从而变得与国内外竞争对手一样高效。
en: The prohibition of state aid was a game changer for Europe, because it forced SOEs to operate on a level playing field and thus to become as efficient as their domestic or foreign competitors.

zh: 而随着地方政客不再能够利用国有企业实现个人目的，大部分成员国都决定不妨将其中许多国有企业私有化。
en: Once local politicians could no longer use the SOEs for their own goals, most member countries decided that they might as well privatize many of them.

zh: 当然，收缩国有企业部门规模需要时间；但这一过程的方向从未受到质疑，因为国有企业的国内外竞争对手自然而然地强烈支持欧盟委员会对国家援助的严格监管。
en: Of course, downsizing the SOE sector took time; but the direction of the process was never in doubt, because the SOEs’ foreign and domestic competitors naturally provided strong political support for the European Commission’s vigorous policing of state aid.

zh: 中国也是如此，今天的关键问题就在于国有企业经营的规则。
en: In China, too, the key issue today is the rules under which the SOEs’ operate.

zh: 与大规模私有化相比，或许更好的做法是限制国家援助，并让竞争者可以在国家援助扭曲竞争时拿起法律武器要求纠正。
