en: Instead of large-scale privatization, it might be better to limit state aid and give competitors legal recourse to seek redress if state aid distorts competition.

zh: 吸引了最多关注的领域是金融业，这不是没有原因的。
en: The area that has attracted the most attention is finance, and for good reason.

zh: 在大部分发达国家，投资不会超过GDP的15 % ， 而中国接近45 % 。
en: In most of the advanced world, investment amounts to little more than 15% of GDP, compared to close to 45% for China.

zh: 因此，金融市场对中国的重要性甚至比美国和欧洲还要高，并且有清晰的信号表明中国的投资生产率在快速下降。
en: Financial markets are thus even more important for China than for the US or Europe, and there are clear signs that the productivity of investment has been declining rapidly in China.

zh: 中国所计划的金融部门改革的关键点 — — 利率自由化或许无法解决这一问题。
en: The lynchpin of the China’s planned financial-sector reforms – interest-rate liberalization – might not address the problem.

zh: 理论上，贷款利率提高应该有助于减少过度投资。
en: In principle, higher interest rates on lending should help to reduce over-investment.

zh: 但是，在存在各种（通常是隐性的）政府担保的制度下，愿意和能够以更大代价举债的未必是效率最高的企业。
en: But, in a system with many – often implicit – government guarantees, it is not always the most efficient enterprises that are willing and able to pay more to borrow.

zh: 贷款利率自由化可能只会导致有政府担保的企业凌驾于规模更小、效率更高的企业之上，导致更严重的资本错配。
en: Liberalizing lending rates might merely lead those with government guarantees to outbid smaller and more efficient enterprises, resulting in more misallocation of capital.

zh: 这意味着金融自由化可能是危险的，除非国有企业也受到预算硬约束。
en: This suggests that financial liberalization might be dangerous until even SOEs are subject to a hard budget constraint.

zh: 全球经济的最强增长引擎并不需要简单的“更多市场 ” 。
en: The global economy’s most powerful growth engine does not need simply “more market.”

zh: 它需要更强的监管框架以确保其市场能够让效率和社会福利最大化。
en: It needs a stronger regulatory framework to ensure that its markets maximize efficiency and social welfare.

zh: 什么让希腊如此特殊?
en: What Makes Greece Special?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—欧元危机似乎已经大致结束了。
en: BRUSSELS – The euro crisis seems to be largely over.

zh: 风险溢价在全面下降，两个国家 — — 爱尔兰和葡萄牙 — — 已经退出了调整计划。
en: Risk premiums continue to fall across the board, and two countries – Ireland and Portugal – have already exited their adjustment programs.

zh: 现在它们已经能够在市场上为自己融资，它们的经济似乎也已重新开始增长。
en: They can now finance themselves in the market, and their economies seem to have started growing again.

zh: 相反，希腊在实现调整计划目标方面仍然存在问题，并且似乎陷入了关于新一轮多边融资计划的没完没了的谈判。
en: By contrast, Greece is still having problems fulfilling the goals of its adjustment program and is engaged in seemingly endless negotiations over yet another multilateral financing package.

zh: 问题总结起来就是两个字：出口（或者说是出口增长乏力 ） 。
en: The problem can be summed up in one word: exports (or, rather, lack of export growth).

zh: 最近这些天来，来自希腊的最重要的消息是政府宣布实现了2013年初级预算盈余（财政余额减去债务利息 ） 。
en: The news from Greece these days has been dominated by the announcement that the government achieved a primary budget surplus (the fiscal balance minus debt service) in 2013.

zh: 这是几十年来希腊政府第一次能够依靠自己的收入支付自己的支出。
en: For the first time in decades, the Greek government has been able to pay for its expenditure with its own revenues.

zh: 这毫无疑问是一个里程碑。
en: This is indeed a milestone.

zh: 但另一个重要得多的新闻却没有吸引多少注意。 那就是2013年希腊的出口还不如2012年。
en: But another, much more important news item has received much less attention: Greece exported less in 2013 than in 2012.

zh: 在多年的市场份额下跌之后，这一萎靡的表现难以解释，因为欧元区外围国的所有其他国家都录得稳健的出口增长。
en: This lackluster performance, which followed years of decline in market shares, is difficult to explain, given that all other countries on the eurozone periphery recorded solid export growth.

zh: 比如，葡萄牙出口在过去几年中每年可以增长约5—6 % ， 尽管它面临着不利的外部环境（西班牙是其最大的市场）和信用动荡，这意味着其出口商很难获得融资。
en: For example, Portuguese exports increased by about 5-6% per year over the last years, despite challenging external conditions (Spain is its biggest market) and a credit crunch, which made it difficult for exporters to obtain financing.

zh: 因此，不管是外部需求萎靡还是缺少融资，都不能作为希腊出口表现拙劣的理由。
en: Neither weak foreign demand nor a lack of financing, therefore, can be the reason for Greece’s poor export performance.

zh: 竞争力低下也不是理由，因为近几年来希腊实际（经通胀调整的）工资成本的降幅比任何其他欧元区国家（爱尔兰除外）都要大。
en: Low competitiveness, too, is not an explanation, as real (inflation-adjusted) wage costs have declined by more in Greece in recent years than in any other eurozone country, with the exception of Ireland.

zh: 但从希腊的经验得出工资通缩对改善竞争力毫无效果也令人难以接受，因为人们广泛认为这正是德国大量获益的原因。
en: But it would be strange to conclude from Greece’s experience that wage deflation is a useless tool for improving competitiveness, given the widespread assumption that Germany benefited massively from it.

zh: 因此，希腊出口表现拙劣的唯一解释就剩下希腊经济仍然极度扭曲，以至于没有对改变的价格信号做出反应。
en: So the only explanation for Greece’s poor export performance must be that the Greek economy has remained so distorted that it has not responded to changing price signals.

zh: 调整能力的缺失是关键性的。
en: This lack of adjustment capacity is crucial.

zh: 在爱尔兰、西班牙甚至葡萄牙，在国内经济崩溃、工资调整时，出口增长都十分强劲。
en: In Ireland, Spain, and even Portugal, exports grew strongly when the domestic economy collapsed and wages adjusted.

zh: 但这些国家的灵活性均相当大，有的已经采取了强力改革。
en: But these countries were already more flexible and, in some cases, undertook strong reforms.

zh: 相反，在希腊，没有证据表明“三驾马车 ” （ 欧盟、欧洲央行和IMF）所要求的许多结构性改革带来了任何扎实的改善。
en: In Greece, by contrast, there is no evidence that the many structural reforms imposed by the “troika” (the European Commission, the European Central Bank, and the International Monetary Fund) have led to any real improvement on the ground.

zh: 相反，许多关于政府和劳动力市场效率的指标实际上还有所恶化。
en: On the contrary, many indicators of efficiency of the way the government and the labor market work have actually deteriorated.

zh: 希腊没什么东西可供出口的论点是站不住脚的。
en: The facile argument that Greece has little to export is irrelevant here.

zh: 问题不在于希腊出口水平低，而在于它没有增长，而��长是完全可能的，特别是在基数较低的时候。
en: The problem is not that Greek exports are low, but rather that they have failed to grow, which should have been possible, especially from a low base.

zh: 几年前，希腊商品和服务出口与葡萄牙相当。
en: Several years ago, Greek exports of goods and services were equal to those of Portugal.

zh: 如今，葡萄牙已经领先希腊近200亿欧元。
en: Today, Portugal is ahead by almost €20 billion ($27.5 billion).

zh: 这意味着希腊产出蒙受了10%以上的潜在损失。
en: This represents a potential loss of more than 10% of output for Greece.

zh: 因此，出口没有增长导致希腊衰退比增长情况长得多、深得多。
en: Lack of export growth thus has made the recession in Greece much longer and deeper than it would have been otherwise.

zh: 如果希腊的出口增长与葡萄牙（或西班牙）保持相同速度，那么衰退现在应该已经结束了。
en: If Greek exports had increased at the same rate as those of Portugal (or Spain), the recession would have ended by now.

zh: 此外，出口增长不力导致财政调整难度大大增加。
en: Moreover, the lack of export growth made the fiscal adjustment much more difficult.

zh: 更高的出口不但可以直接带来更高的收入，还能对国内经济产生乘数效应，从而增加消费税收入。
en: Higher exports would not only have yielded directly higher revenues; they would have had a multiplier effect on the domestic economy as well, thereby increasing consumption tax revenues.

zh: 如今，希腊经常项目处于平衡状态 — — 与几年前两位数的赤字（占GDP比重）相比，着实是一个成就。
en: Greece now has a balanced current account – quite an achievement after double-digit deficits (as a percentage of GDP) a few years ago.

zh: 但与欧元区外围的其他经济体相反，这一改善完全是通过压缩进口实现的。
en: But, in contrast to other economies on the eurozone periphery, this improvement was achieved entirely through import compression.

zh: 这意味着除非出口开始增长，否则就不可能看到持续复苏。
en: This implies that there cannot be any hope for a sustained recovery unless exports start growing.

zh: 人们常说，如果紧缩松一点，内需就会强一点。
en: It is often argued that with less austerity, domestic demand would be stronger.

zh: 这也许是正确的，但更强的内需会导致更高的进口，而这需要用更高的出口收入来支付，因为希腊无法承受外债的继续累积。
en: That might be true, but stronger domestic demand would lead to higher imports, which would need to be paid for with higher export revenues, because the country cannot afford to accumulate more foreign debt.

zh: 没有出口，就没有增长：希腊的债务可持续性最终取决于这一关键参数。
en: No exports, no growth: Greece’s debt sustainability ultimately depends on this key parameter.

zh: 希腊的问题不在于财政调整。
en: What went wrong in Greece was not the fiscal adjustment.

zh: 相反，紧缩也许是太成功（也太痛苦）了。
en: On the contrary, austerity was perhaps too successful (and painful).

zh: 但这是错误的目标。
en: But it was the wrong target.

zh: 对任何以两位数的经常项目赤字为起点的国家来说，调整计划开始时的真正重要的目标必须是出口增长。
en: The really important target for any country starting an adjustment program with a double-digit current-account deficit must be export growth.

zh: 错失这一目标正是希腊走上歧路的原因。
en: Missing this target is what has set Greece apart.

zh: 不幸的是，外部世界对于确保希腊提高出口几乎无能为力。
en: Unfortunately, there is very little the outside world can to do to ensure that the Greece exports more.

zh: 政府必须强迫它通过裁决，议会可以施压使之接受所有人们已知的改革立法，但说到底，改革如何落实、经济如何反应才是最重要的。
en: The government can be forced to pass decrees, and Parliament can be pressured to adopt all the reform legislation known to humanity. But, in the end, it is how reform is applied on the ground, and how the economy responds, that counts.

zh: 调整计划成功与否体现在采取调整的国家，而不是体现在布鲁塞尔或华盛顿。
en: An adjustment program succeeds or fails at home, not in Brussels or Washington.

zh: 欧洲大爆炸十周年
en: Europe’s Big Bang at Ten

zh: 布鲁塞尔—十年前，八个前苏联国家以及内陆国家马耳他和塞浦路斯一起加入欧盟，将欧盟成员国数量从15个增加到25个。
en: BRUSSELS – Ten years ago, eight countries from the former Soviet bloc, together with the island states of Malta and Cyprus, joined the European Union, bringing its membership from 15 to 25.

zh: 当是时，人们担心东扩会制造欧盟内部冲突，因为来自中东欧的新成员国比较贫穷，其中有几个农业部门十分庞大。
en: At the time, it was feared that this eastern enlargement would create tensions within the EU because new members from Central and Eastern Europe were poor and some had large agricultural sectors.

zh: 欧盟支出主要花在了贫穷地区和农民身上，因此许多人担心东扩会让欧盟预算不堪重负。
en: Because the EU spends mainly on poor regions and on farmers, many worried that enlargement would overburden its budget.

zh: 最终，这一问题通过典型的欧洲妥协得到了解决。 东扩得以进行，即便预算（以占欧洲GDP比例衡量）有所减少。
en: In the end, this problem was resolved through a typical European compromise that allowed enlargement to proceed, even though the budget, as a proportion of Europe’s GDP, was reduced.

zh: 如今，农业已不再是欧盟日程上的重大事项。
en: Agriculture has now largely disappeared as a major item on the EU agenda.

zh: 此外，欧盟多年金融框架（Multi-Annual Financial Framework）计划日程意味着由谁为谁支付的问题每七年才会更改一次。
en: Moreover, the planning horizon under the EU’s Multi-Annual Financial Framework implies that the issue of who pays for whom has to be addressed only once every seven years.

zh: 经济一体化的最终目的是提振GDP增长、改善生活水平。
en: The purpose of economic integration is ultimately to boost GDP growth and improve living standards.

zh: 从这个角度看，东扩效果很好。
en: Judged from this perspective, enlargement has worked well.

zh: 转型国在过去十年中大幅赶了上来。
en: The transition countries have caught up considerably over the last decade.

zh: 20世纪90年代中期，许多转型国人均GDP只有老欧盟15国的四分之一到三分之一（以购买力平价衡量 ） 。
en: In the mid-1990’s, many transition countries’ per capita GDP was only about one-quarter to one-third of that of the old EU-15 (in purchasing-power-parity terms).

zh: 新成员国最终加入欧盟时已经赶上了一些差距，但趋同趋势在它们入盟后得到了延续，即使在金融危机期间也没有停止。
en: Some of the distance had already been covered when the new member states finally joined the EU, but the process of convergence has continued, even through the financial crisis.

zh: 新成员国的收入已经达到了老15国的三分之二左右。
en: The new members’ income has reached about two-thirds the level of the EU-15.

zh: 此外，最穷新成员国的进步最大（这与老15国中最穷成员国形成了鲜明对比。 葡萄牙和希腊的收入水平已经倒退回20世纪90年代 ） 。
en: Moreover, the poorest new members gained the most (in contrast to the poorest members of the EU-15, like Portugal and Greece, which are now back to income levels last seen in the 1990’s).

zh: 这一趋同趋势能够解释为何来自东部成员国的求职者并不比更富的老欧盟15国更多。
en: This convergence is the reason why job seekers from the eastern member states are not overwhelming the richer EU-15 countries’ labor markets.

zh: 新成员国原本要穷得多，并且是冲突之源，如今，它们成为了两边的经济优势之源，因为欧盟老15国企业（特别是德国公司）可以将劳动密集型业务外包。
en: The fact that the new members were initially so much poorer, initially a source of tension, turned out to be a source of economic advantage for both sides, as EU-15 firms (especially German companies) could outsource labor-intensive tasks.

zh: 它们的全球竞争力因此增加，同时，目标国获得了急需的直接投资、就业岗位和知识转移。
en: They gained in terms of global competitive, while the target countries gained much-needed direct investment, jobs, and knowledge transfer.

zh: 从纯经济角度讲，东扩显然是双赢措施。
en: In purely economic terms, enlargement was clearly a mutually beneficial proposition.

zh: 当然，东扩的其他角度就不那么成功了。
en: Of course, other aspects of enlargement have worked less well.

zh: 欧元预算拨给新成员国的援助中有很大一部分被用于面子工程，肥了当地建筑公司。
en: A large part of the aid that has flowed from the EU budget to the new member states has been used for prestige projects that enriched local construction companies.

zh: 此外，尽管这一问题并不局限于新成员国 — — 治理体系缓慢而低效、并且腐败横生的意大利和希腊等国也有这种现象 — — 但东扩使其有所加剧；事实上，许多东部成员国的公共管理质量仍远不及欧盟核心国。
en: And, though this problem is not specific to the new member states – the same thing happens in countries like Italy or Greece, with their slow and inefficient administrative systems and extensive corruption – it was rendered more acute by enlargement; indeed, many of the eastern members still have lower-quality public administrations than one finds in the EU core.

zh: 因此，东扩应该被视为有限成功。
en: Thus, enlargement should be viewed as a qualified success.

zh: 最大的担忧之一 — — 欧盟机构可能因为一下子接受十个新成员国而不堪重负 — — 从未成为现实。
en: One of the biggest fears, namely that EU institutions would be overwhelmed by the simultaneous absorption of ten new members, also never materialized.

zh: 新成员国平稳地融入了欧盟机构，它们的国家利益与老成员国已经相当一致。
en: The new member states have integrated smoothly into the EU institutions, where they defend their national interests in much the same way as the older members.

zh: 欧盟在过去几年中所经历的苦难与成员国数量（现已达到28个）无关。
en: The difficulties that the EU has experienced in the last years have little to do with the increase in the number of member states, which has now reached 28.

zh: 欧盟东扩最重要的结果当时几乎无人想到：极大地拉近了欧盟与俄罗斯的距离。
en: The most important consequence of the EU’s eastern enlargement has turned out to be one that few thought about at the time: it brought the Union much closer to Russia.

zh: 而对于转向极权主义并且目睹了欧盟如何让陷入困境的转型国日益繁荣（尽管仍不完美）的民主国家的俄罗斯来说，欧洲与它的前沿太接近了。
en: And, for a Russia that has become authoritarian and has seen how the EU can transform struggling transition countries into increasingly prosperous (albeit imperfect) democracies, Europe is too close for comfort.

zh: 相对繁荣和自由的前景对于乌克兰人来说太有吸引力了，以至于他们推翻了更偏好俄罗斯领导的“欧亚同盟”而放弃欧盟入盟协定的总统。
en: The prospect of relative prosperity and freedom proved so attractive to the people of Ukraine that they toppled a president who preferred a Russian-led “Eurasian Union” to an EU association agreement.

zh: 不幸的是，东乌克兰有大量少数派不认同这一“欧洲召唤 ” ， 因为事态的最新转向而深感威胁。
en: Unfortunately, a significant minority in eastern Ukraine does not share this “European vocation” and feels threatened by the recent turn of events.

zh: 俄罗斯支持了这一趋势，动用武力和其他硬手段煽动冲突，因为民主而繁荣的“欧洲乌克兰”的活生生的例子将会威胁到它的政权。
en: Russia supports these tendencies and has used military and other hard-power tools to stoke tensions, because its regime would be threatened by the living example of a “European” Ukraine that is democratic and prosperous.

zh: 因此，十年来，东扩产生了与预想不一样的结果。
en: So, ten years on, enlargement is turning out differently than expected.

zh: 内部挑战被证明是可以管理的，但如今欧盟需要面对令其措手不及的外部挑战。
en: The internal challenges have proved manageable, but now the EU needs to confront an external challenge for which it is ill prepared.

zh: 我们不需要等待十年去弄清楚欧盟是否可以帮助稳定乌克兰，同时还得面临领导层因其民主和法治精神的基本价值而感到威胁的俄罗斯。
en: We will not have to wait a decade to find out whether the EU can help to stabilize Ukraine while confronting a Russia whose leadership feels threatened by its fundamental values of democracy and the rule of law.

zh: 大西洋两岸的增长差距
en: The Transatlantic Growth Gap

zh: 布鲁塞尔—2008年大爆发的全球金融危机对欧洲和美国的影响是非常相似的 — — 至少在一开始是如此。
en: BRUSSELS – The global financial crisis that erupted in full force in 2008 affected Europe and the United States in a very similar way – at least at the start.

zh: 在大西洋两岸，经济表现在2009年见底，并从2010年开始复苏。
en: On both sides of the Atlantic, economic performance tanked in 2009 and started to recover in 2010.

zh: 但是，随着金融危机变异为欧元危机，美国和欧元区之间逐渐产生了一条经济鸿沟。
en: But, as the financial crisis mutated into the euro crisis, an economic gulf opened between the US and the eurozone.

zh: 在过去三年中（2011—2013年 ） ， 美国经济大约增长了六个多百分点。
en: Over the last three years (2011-2013), the US economy grew by about six percentage points more.

zh: 即使考虑人口差异的增加（目前可以达到每年大约0.5个百分点的水平 ） ， 这三年中美国人均经济增长仍能达到大约4.5个百分点以上。
en: Even taking into account the increasing demographic differential, which now amounts to about half a percentage point per year, the US economy has grown by about 4.5 percentage points more over these three years on a per capita basis.

zh: 个中差异的主要原因是私人消费的不同，美国私人消费在增加，而欧元区在下降，特别是欧元区外围。
en: The main reason for the gap is the difference in private consumption, which grew in the US, but fell in the eurozone, especially in its periphery.

zh: 公共消费的裁抑给美国需求造成的收缩（0.8个百分点）比欧盟（0.1个百分点）更严重。
en: A retrenchment of public consumption actually subtracted more demand in the US (0.8 percentage points) than in the European Union (0.1 points).

zh: 这可能有些令人吃惊，因为布鲁塞尔所施加的紧缩政策一直是人们热议的话题。
en: This might appear to be somewhat surprising in light of all of the talk about Brussels imposed austerity.

zh: 事实上，在过去三年中，欧元区公共消费基本维持不变，而美国大幅下降。
en: In fact, public consumption in the eurozone has de facto remained fairly constant over the last three years, whereas it has declined substantially in the US.

zh: （公共投资也是如此，尽管该指标占GDP比重很小，大西洋两岸的差异不足以在三年时间里造成彼此增长的重大差异 ） 。
en: (The same is true of public investment, though this constitutes such a small proportion of GDP that transatlantic differences could not have had a large impact on growth over a three-year horizon.)

zh: 欧洲私人投资收缩只是增长差异的次要原因（约占三分之一 ） 。
en: The contraction of private investment in Europe accounts for only a small part (one-third) of the growth gap.

zh: 尽管伴随欧元危机而生的金融市场紧张对欧元区外围投资造成了很大的消极影响，但美国投资需求也一直萎靡不振，这缩小了总体差异。
en: Though the financial-market tensions that accompanied the euro crisis had a strong negative impact on investment in the eurozone periphery, investment demand has also remained weak in the US, minimizing the overall difference.

zh: 增长差距的关键因素 — — 美国私人消费的高恢复力 — — 并不令人奇怪，因为美国家庭大幅削减了债务负担（危机前，美国家庭负担占GDP比达到了90%以上 ） 。
en: The resilience of private consumption in the US, the key to the growth gap, is not surprising, given that American households have reduced their debt burden considerably from the peak of more than 90% of GDP reached just before the crisis.

zh: 债务负担的减轻也是消费有望继续成为推动今年和明年美国增长远快于欧元区的关键因素。
en: The lower debt burden is also a key reason why consumption is expected to continue to grow much faster in the US than in the eurozone this year and next.

zh: 但鲜有人问及的关键问题是为何美国家庭能够在高失业和工资几无增长的时期减少债务负担，同时还能维持消费增长。
en: But the crucial question – and one that is rarely asked – is how US households were able to reduce their debt burden during a period of high unemployment and almost no wage gains while sustaining consumption growth.

zh: 答案在于“无追索权”按揭和迅速的破产程序。
en: The answer lies in a combination of “no recourse” mortgages and fast bankruptcy procedures.

zh: 近几年来，数百万通过次级按揭购买的美国住房被收回了赎回权，强迫无法维持债务的屋主离开。
en: Millions of American homes that were purchased with subprime mortgages have been foreclosed in recent years, forcing their owners, unable to service their debt, to leave.

zh: 但是，由于美国许多州都实行了无追索权按揭，总体按揭债务也因此被消灭了，即使房屋的价值已经跌落至无法覆盖剩余按揭的水平。
en: But, as a result of no-recourse mortgages in many US states, the entire mortgage debt was then extinguished, even if the value of the home was too low to cover the balance still due.

zh: 此外，即使在有完全追索权的州 — — 因此屋主仍有义务偿还所有按揭贷款，即剩余贷款减去由卖方所得所覆盖的债务 — — 美国个人破产程序也提供了相对快速的解决办法。
en: Moreover, even in those states where there is full recourse, so that the homeowner remains liable for the full amount of the mortgage loan (that is, the difference between the balance due and the value recovered by selling the home), America’s procedures for personal bankruptcy offer a relatively quick solution.

zh: 2008年以来，数百万美国人申请了个人破产，从而摆脱了个人债务。
en: Millions of Americans have filed for personal bankruptcy since 2008 , thereby extinguishing their personal debt.

zh: 数十万家小企业也是如此。
en: The same applies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses.

zh: 当然，欧元区外围也出现了大量破产。
en: Of course, there has also been a surge of bankruptcies in the eurozone’s periphery.

zh: 但在意大利、西班牙和希腊等国家，破产程序耗时需要以年计，而不像美国那样只需要几周到几个月。
en: But in countries like Italy, Spain, and Greece, the length of a bankruptcy proceeding is measured in years, not months or weeks, as in the US.

zh: 此外，在大部分欧洲大陆国家，个人只有在相当长的一段时间 — — 通常需要5—7年 — — 才能摆脱债务，在此期间，他的大部分收入都必须用于偿还债务。
en: Moreover, in most of continental Europe a person can be discharged of his or her debt only after a lengthy period, often 5-7 years, during which almost all income must be devoted to debt service.

zh: 相反，美国的对应时期通常少于一年。
en: In the US, by contrast, the corresponding period lasts less than one year in most cases.

zh: 此外，欧洲的免除债务条款也比美国严苛得多。
en: Moreover, the terms of discharge tend to be much stricter in Europe.

zh: 一个极端的例子是西班牙，西班牙按揭债务即使在个人破产后也不能免除。
en: An extreme case is Spain, where mortgage debt is never extinguished, not even after a personal bankruptcy.

zh: 这一美国和（大陆）欧洲的关键差异解释了为何美国经济在信用繁荣崩溃面前有如此强大的恢复力。
en: This key difference between the US and (continental) Europe explains the resilience of the US economy to the collapse of its credit boom.

zh: 家庭所积累的过度债务以快得多的速度被消灭；而一旦损失得到承认，人们可以重头开始。
en: The excessive debt accumulated by households has been worked off much more rapidly; and, once losses have been recognized, people can start again.

zh: 因此，大西洋两岸之间的增长差距起因不应该从欧元区过度紧缩或欧洲央行过度审慎上寻找。
en: The cause of the transatlantic growth gap thus should not be sought in excessive eurozone austerity or the excessive prudence of the European Central Bank.

zh: 欧元区经济从其外围金融崩溃中复苏换面有其结构性原因。
en: There are structural reasons for the eurozone economy’s slow recovery from the financial meltdown in its periphery.

zh: 最重要的是，与美国相比，繁荣年份所创造的过度债务清除难度要大得多。
en: Most important, compared to the US, the excess debt created during the boom years has been much more difficult to work off.

zh: 欧洲官员推动欧洲国家实施劳动力和产品市场的结构性改革是正确的。
en: European officials are right to promote structural reforms of EU countries’ labor and product markets.

zh: 但他们还应该修正并加速破产程序，以使损失能够得到更快的承认，让过度负债的家庭能够重新开始，而不是被债务束缚多年。
en: But they should also focus on overhauling and accelerating bankruptcy procedures, so that losses can be recognized more quickly and over-indebted households can start afresh, rather than being shackled for years.

zh: 重启乌克兰经济
en: Restarting Ukraine’s Economy

zh: 布鲁塞尔—在东西方各国，有一个大问题扑面而来 ： “ 谁失去了乌克兰？
en: BRUSSELS – In capitals East and West, one question currently looms large: “Who lost Ukraine?”

zh: ”不幸的是，这并不是现在最重要的问题。
en: Unfortunately, that is not the most important question to be asking right now.

zh: 关系更大的问题是如何稳定乌克兰的局面。
en: The more relevant question is how to stabilize the situation in Ukraine.

zh: 既然无法让俄罗斯远离克里米亚，那么现在的主要挑战就是保持乌克兰其余部分统一并重启其经济。 由于不可持续的财政和外部赤字，乌克兰经济现在毫无活力。
en: Given that little can be done in practice to dislodge Russia from Crimea, the key challenge now is to keep the rest of the country united and to restart its economy, which is now in a state of suspended animation, owing to unsustainable fiscal and external deficits.

zh: 关键改革问题已是众所周知：天然气价格必须大幅提高以反映其成本；国内煤炭生产补贴必须停止；仍在产生巨大特许费的俄罗斯至西欧输气管道的治理问题应该修正。
en: The key reform issues are well known: the price of gas must be increased substantially to reflect its cost, subsidies for domestic coal production must be stopped, and governance of the country’s pipelines, which still earn huge royalties for carrying Russian gas to Western Europe, must be overhauled.

zh: 这些管道通过暗中交易转到了名义上的私人公司手中，至此以后，巨大的输气费收入就和大量天然气一起人间蒸发了，维护工作也陷入了停顿。
en: Ever since these pipelines were effectively handed over to nominally private companies in murky deals, earnings from transit fees have gone missing, along with vast amounts of gas, while little maintenance has been carried out.

zh: 所有这三个问题都是反腐斗争的关键。
en: All three of these issues are crucial to the fight against corruption.

zh: 决定谁能以五分之一的成本获得天然气、谁不能的能源部长显然要面临难以抗拒的压力将这个好处分给能够带来最大贿赂或回扣的人。
en: An energy ministry that decides who can obtain gas at one-fifth of its cost and who cannot is obviously subject to irresistible pressures to distribute its favors to whomever offers the largest bribes or kickbacks.

zh: 同样的逻辑也适用于煤炭补贴，只不过这笔补贴给了效率最低的生产者。
en: The same applies to coal subsidies, except that the subsidies go to the most inefficient producers.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）必然会要求乌克兰改革其天然气和煤炭补贴，以此作为实施金融援助计划的先决条件（金融援助计划大部分将来自欧盟 ） 。
en: The International Monetary Fund will certainly require Ukraine to reform its gas and coal subsidies as a precondition for implementing its package of financial support (of which a substantial contribution comes from the European Union).

zh: 第一批步骤已进入实施阶段，当局最近宣布居民天然气价格将在下个月上调50 % 。
en: The first steps are already being taken, with the authorities recently announcing that household gas prices will rise by 50% next month.

zh: 但是，取消能源补贴固然对平衡预算、巩固经济基础具有绝对必要的作用，但这些措施也有可能大大影响东乌克兰，而东乌克兰有大量俄裔居民。
en: But, while abolishing energy subsidies is absolutely essential to balance the budget and put the economy on a sound footing, these steps also risk hitting eastern Ukraine, which contains a substantial Russophone minority, particularly hard.

zh: 其中一些必然会受到拥有巨大廉价能源资源的“俄罗斯母亲”更美好生活的诱惑。
en: Some there might be tempted by the allure of a better life in “Mother Russia,” with its vast resources of cheap energy.

zh: 东乌克兰的主导产业是过时的能源密集型煤炭和钢铁业。
en: Eastern Ukraine is dominated by old-fashioned energy-intensive coal and steel industries.

zh: 但那里也有不少高科技枢纽，比如为俄罗斯军用直升机生产重要部件的工厂。
en: But it also harbors some centers of technological excellence, such as the factories that produce important spare parts for Russian military helicopters.

zh: 因此，决策者面临的挑战是确保这些高竞争力企业创造新岗位的速度能够超过提高气价和取消煤炭生产补贴所导致的就业岗位减少。
en: The challenge for policymakers will thus be to ensure that the creation of new jobs in these competitive enterprises keeps pace with the job losses arising from higher gas prices and the elimination of subsidies for coal production.

zh: 欧盟必须从两个方面提供支持。
en: The EU should support this in two ways.

zh: 它应该为突然失去俄罗斯市场的企业提供特别市场援助。
en: It should provide special marketing assistance to enterprises that have suddenly lost their Russian markets.

zh: 它也应该开放它的市场，不仅仅取消乌克兰产品的进口关税（已经决定 ） ， 还要授予必要的临时性豁免，即不要求乌克兰产品必须满足所有欧盟的复杂技术标准和监管。
en: And it should open its markets, not only by abolishing its import tariffs on Ukrainian products, which has already been decided, but also by granting a temporary exemption from the need to meet all of the EU’s complicated technical standards and regulations.

zh: 赢得“民心”是动乱时期获得胜利的关键。
en: Winning the people’s “hearts and minds” is the key to victory in an insurgency.

zh: 在东乌克兰，要赢得仍在怀念“昔日好时光”者的支持，光是创造填满他们的钱包的工作是不够的。
en: In the case of eastern Ukraine, winning the support of those who are still nostalgic for the “good old days” must go beyond creating productive jobs that fill their wallets.

zh: 在这方面，欧盟也可以提供帮助。
en: Here, too, the EU could help this process along.

zh: 首先，欧盟可以帮助缓和取暖价格一项便超过家庭收入所造成的社会问题。
en: For starters, it could alleviate the social hardship that will arise when the price for heating alone exceeds household income.

zh: 与此同时，欧盟可以帮助解决取暖成本高企的根源：几乎所有建成房屋的能源效率都十分低下。
en: At the same time, the EU should help to address the cause of extraordinary heating costs: the woeful energy inefficiency of most of the existing housing stock.

zh: 因此，欧盟应该快速行动起来，实施面向“能源穷人”的定向社会支持计划，并辅之以能源效率投资方面的金融支持。
en: The EU should thus quickly implement a targeted program of social support for the “energy poor,” coupled with financial support for investment in energy efficiency.

zh: 20世纪90年代，东欧也不得不大幅提高能源价格。 其经验表明，简单的措施 — — 如更好的分隔加上维护和修补该地区的大量长期被忽视的中央供暖系统 — — 就可以迅速地大幅度降低能源密集度。
en: Experience in Eastern Europe, where energy prices had to be increased substantially in the 1990’s, demonstrated that simple measures – such as better insulation, together with maintenance and repair of the region’s many long-neglected central heating systems – yield a quick and substantial payoff in reducing energy intensity.

zh: 即使是能源效率的微小改善，也能让乌克兰的减少温室气体排放效果胜过花在可再生能源资源上的巨资。
en: Even a slight improvement in Ukraine’s energy efficiency would contribute more to reducing greenhouse-gas emissions than the vast sums currently being spent to develop renewable energy sources.

zh: 但是，由于无处不在的政府腐败和低效，这一计划必须由欧盟-乌克兰联合小组直接管理。
en: But, given widespread government corruption and inefficiency, such a program would have to be administered directly by a joint EU-Ukrainian task force.

zh: 临近的成员国，特别是语言与俄语和乌克兰语相近的国家，应该能够快速动员所需要的技术专家。
en: Nearby member states, especially those whose languages are similar to Russian and Ukrainian, should be able to mobilize quickly the required technical expertise.

zh: 最后，来自天然气管道的收入必须还给国库。
en: Finally, the revenues from the gas pipelines must be returned to the state’s coffers.

zh: 在这方面，欧盟也可以起到主要作用，承认俄罗斯在合理维护管道上的特殊利益以及因为供气获得合理的收入。
en: Here the EU can also play a prominent role by recognizing Russia’s special interest in proper pipeline maintenance and a proper accounting for the gas they carry.

zh: 当然，不应期待乌克兰政府相信刚刚吞并了其部分领土的国家的话。
en: Of course, no one should expect the Ukrainian government to trust the word of a country that has just annexed part of its territory.

zh: 但是，作为提振信心措施，俄罗斯应该获邀参与三方协议，讨论将管道的运营控制权转移给各方都有利益在其中的欧洲复兴开发银行（EBRD ） 。
en: But, as a confidence-building measure, Russia should be invited into a tripartite agreement under which operational control over the pipelines would be entrusted to the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, an institution in which all parties have a stake.

zh: EBRD将捍卫所有各方（包括俄罗斯）的合法利益，确保合理的管道运营和维护，监管输气费的分配。
en: The EBRD would safeguard the legitimate interests of all parties (including Russia), ensuring the proper operation and maintenance of the pipelines and overseeing the distribution of transit fees.

zh: 不论乌克兰是否会“失去 ” ， 或谁会失去乌克兰，这个国家都可以为所有人民提供有吸引力的未来，只要不可避免的经济改革能够与地区凝聚力相容。
en: Regardless of whether Ukraine is “lost,” or who lost it, the country can still offer an attractive future for all of its citizens if unavoidable economic reforms can be made compatible with regional cohesion.

zh: 欧盟可以开放其市场、提供关键领域的资金和技术援助，从而起到重要作用。
en: The EU can play an important role by opening its market and providing funding and technical assistance in crucial areas.

zh: 欧洲应有的政府？
en: The Government Europe Deserves?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—随着行政分支 — — 欧盟委员会内部的最终配置的完成，欧盟也完成了人事交替。
en: BRUSSELS – With the final allocation of portfolios within its executive branch, the European Commission, the European Union has completed its change of guard.

zh: 整个过程从5月底的欧盟议会选举后开始，总共进行了近四个月，最终结果免不了经过了一系列妥协 — — 对于由28个脾气火爆的民族国家组成的欧盟来说，这并不出人意料。
en: The process took almost four months, following the European Parliament election in late May, and the end result was inevitably based on a series of compromises – to be expected for an EU of 28 prickly nation-states.

zh: 事实上，欧盟机构的正常运行需要让所有重要选区（左翼和右翼、东欧和西欧，等等）都不会感到自己被排挤。
en: Indeed, the proper functioning of EU institutions requires that no important constituency (left or right, East or West, and so forth) feels left out.

zh: 而新的欧盟委员会看起来相当强大，在其28个委员中，有超过20人曾经是总理、副总理或部长级的人物。
en: And the new European Commission looks rather strong, given that more than 20 of its 28 members previously served as prime ministers, deputy prime ministers, or ministers.

zh: 这些在曾在国内位居要职的人认为，担任布鲁塞尔的职位是值得的。
en: People who have held high political office at home find it worthwhile to come to Brussels.

zh: 但大部分关注都集中在欧盟的三个顶级职位上：欧盟委员会主席、欧洲理事会主席以及对外事务高级代表。
en: But most attention has focused on the EU’s three top positions: the President of the European Commission, the President of the European Council, and the High Representative for external affairs.

zh: 欧盟委员会新主席 — — 让-克劳德·容克（Jean-Claude Juncker）是第一位凭借其所在派系在欧洲议会选举中的强劲表现而问鼎这一宝座的人。
en: The Commission’s new president, Jean-Claude Juncker, was the first ever to be selected based on his faction’s strong showing in the European Parliament election.

zh: 作为老练的布鲁塞尔内部人士，他不是能发动群众的人。
en: As a seasoned Brussels insider, he was not one to move the crowds.

zh: 弹有时这也是一种优势。
en: But sometimes this can be an advantage.

zh: 内部人士最清楚如何协调互相冲突的利益、如何让制度再次运转起来，容克驾轻就熟地给各委员分配任务就证明了这一点。
en: An insider knows best how to reconcile contrasting interests and how to get the institutional machinery moving again, as Juncker showed with his deft handling of the distribution of tasks among the individual Commissioners.

zh: 选择欧洲理事会主席需要长时间的讨价还价，最终的人选是波兰总理唐纳德·塔斯克（Donald Tusk ） 。
en: Selecting the president of the European Council required considerable time and horse-trading, with Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk emerging as the final choice.

zh: 但是，尽管塔斯克现在位高权重，但欧洲理事会主席并不能决定任何事情。
en: But, though Tusk now has an important-sounding position, the European Council President decides nothing.

zh: 欧洲理事会主席的主要职责是主持欧盟成员国领导人会议，而任职者的影响力取决于他指定日称、促进妥协的能力。
en: The president mainly presides over the meetings of the EU’s national leaders, and an incumbent’s influence depends on his or her ability to set the agenda and facilitate compromises.

zh: 前任主席、钱比利时首相赫尔曼·范龙佩（Herman van Rompuy）拥有处理本国派系联盟的经验，在需要说服国家领导人就欧元危机做出决定时，这一经验派上了大用场。
en: The experience of the previous incumbent, former Belgian Prime Minister Herman van Rompuy, in dealing with his own country’s fractious coalitions proved very useful when he had to persuade national leaders to make decisions during the euro crisis.

zh: 塔斯克也需要在面临现今欧洲新挑战时完成类似的任务，包括俄罗斯队乌克兰的进犯、中东恐怖主义和内部经济停止等。
en: Tusk will have to achieve something similar in the face of the new challenges confronting Europe today, which include Russian aggression in Ukraine, the rise of terrorism in the Middle East, and a stagnant economy at home.

zh: 欧盟的最���迫挑战来自俄罗斯，塔斯克必须调和各国的决定，有的国家（包括他的祖国）感受到来自俄罗斯的紧迫威胁，而有的国家与俄罗斯有着密切的经济关系，欧洲的安全不是它们的近忧。
en: On the EU’s most immediate challenge, posed by Russia, Tusk will have to broker decisions with leaders from countries that feel immediately threatened (like his own) and those for which economic ties with Russia outweigh any threat to European security, which they feel to be remote.

zh: 在经济方面，他必须让充分就业的德国的当务之急与仍在衰退和大量失业中苦苦挣扎的希腊和意大利的当务之急协调起来。
en: On the economy, he must reconcile the priorities of full-employment Germany with those of Greece and Italy, which remain in the grip of recession and sky-high unemployment.

zh: 而正如他爽快承认的，能够与理事会委员（大部分说英语）直接对话也许才是当下最大的挑战。
en: Being able to converse directly with the Council’s members, mostly in English, might be the biggest immediate challenge, as he admitted immediately.

zh: 任命意大利外交部长费得利卡·莫格里尼（Federica Mogherini）为欧盟对外事务和安全政策高级代表受到了广泛的质疑，因为她在对外政策方面经验十分有限。
en: The appointment of the Italian foreign minister, Federica Mogherini, as High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy has been widely questioned, owing to her limited executive experience in foreign policy.

zh: 但是，自8月乌克兰遭遇事实侵略以来，她的政府已经改变了对俄立场，她也成功地让许多批评者认为她十分清楚欧洲所面临的问题（比如，她的大学毕业论文就是关于伊斯兰政治的 ） 。
en: But, since the de facto invasion of Ukraine in late August, her government has changed its position on Russia, and she has sought to convince many critics that she knows the problems facing Europe well (her university thesis, for example, was about political Islam).

zh: 但她有领导能力吗？
en: But can she lead?

zh: 欧洲外交机构欧洲对外行动局（European External Action Service，EEAS）是一个巨大的官僚机构，要想让它具有效率，就必须进行很好的管理。
en: Europe’s foreign service, the European External Action Service (EEAS), is a huge bureaucracy, which must be managed well if it is to be effective.

zh: 此外，尽管EEAS主管被称为“欧盟首席外交官 ” ， 但莫格里尼应该被视为首席执行官，重要决定由成员国领导人在欧洲理事会开会时做出。
en: And, though the head of the EEAS has been dubbed the “EU’s foreign-policy chief,” Mogherini should be seen as its CEO, with key decisions taken by the member states’ leaders when they convene in the European Council.

zh: 因此，缺少管经验是她的重要劣势，她需要一个强大的团队支持她。
en: Her lack of managerial experience is thus her key weakness, and she will have to find a strong team to support her.

zh: 但任命莫格里尼至少有一点令人振奋，尽管这个振奋点不太明显：欧洲央行行长马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）也是意大利人，这是一个有利因素。
en: But there is at least one encouraging, if hidden, signal from Mogherini’s appointment: The fact that the European Central Bank President Mario Draghi is also an Italian was not an impediment.

zh: 这意味着欧洲央行行长不属于根据国籍分配的职位行列，德拉吉的国籍没有被认为影响了他的任何决定。
en: This implies that the ECB presidency is not counted among the posts to be distributed according to nationality quotas, and that Draghi’s nationality is not regarded as having influenced his decisions in any way.

zh: 欧盟机构领导人要想青史留名，就必须具有政治开拓精神。
en: Leaders of the EU’s institutions have to be political entrepreneurs if they are to leave a mark on history.

zh: 他们的决策力是饱受局限。
en: Their decision-making power is limited.

zh: 但他们常常可以影响选择，引导联盟推进欧洲一体化的现有边界。
en: But they can often frame the choices and broker coalitions to push the existing boundaries of European integration.

zh: 欧盟最顶级的三个职位（容克、塔斯克和莫格里尼）在这方面都没有历史成绩。
en: None of the EU’s top three new faces (Juncker, Tusk, and Mogherini) has a track record in this sense.

zh: 显然，各国领导人也喜欢这样的安排。
en: Evidently the national bosses like it that way.

zh: 因此，任命过程中最令人警醒的信息是，成员国领导人不会接受任何可能打破现状、推进一体化的人选。
en: The most sobering message from the appointment process is thus that the member states’ leaders will not suffer anyone who might rock the boat and push integration forward.

zh: 《罗马条约 》 （ Treaty of Rome）中所规划的“日益紧密的联盟”将不会有什么进展。
en: There will be little movement toward the “ever closer union” envisioned in the Treaty of Rome.

zh: 这对于英国人或其他害怕被布鲁塞尔主宰的人来说是个好消息，但对于希望欧洲克服经济停滞、人口下降等困难，成为重要全球行动方的人来说，这令人沮丧。
en: That might come as a relief for those in the United Kingdom and elsewhere who fear domination by Brussels, but it can only dismay those who hope that, despite its sluggish economy and declining population, Europe can become a relevant global actor.

zh: 制裁与团结
en: Sanctions and Solidarity

zh: 布鲁塞尔—欧盟终于同意因为俄罗斯在乌克兰的行为对其实施“三级制裁 ” 。
en: BRUSSELS – The European Union has finally agreed on its “third-level sanctions” against Russia for its actions in Ukraine.

zh: 与往常一样，欧洲达成这一一致经历漫长而艰难的过程。
en: As is usual for the EU, arriving at this point has been a long and difficult process.

zh: 一个一直伴随其间的关键问题是，尽管制裁符合共同目的，但实施制裁的成本是由个体成员国承担的。
en: A key problem all along has been that, though sanctions serve a common purpose, the costs of implementing them are borne by individual member states.

zh: 此外，制裁成本是实实在在、看得见摸得着的，依赖对俄出口的企业的就业将受到冲击。
en: Moreover, the costs are very concrete and visible, as jobs in enterprises that depend on exports to Russia seem to be at stake.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪许多成员国更关心制裁对本国经济造成的潜在影响，而不是像俄罗斯证明其无视国际法和规范将造成后果这一总体外交政策目标。
en: So it was not surprising that many member states were more concerned about the potential cost of the sanctions on their economies than they were about the overall foreign-policy goal of signaling to Russia that its disregard of international law and norms has consequences.

zh: 正因如此，应该成立一个共同基金作为欧盟对俄外交政策立场的一部分，补偿制裁造成的经济成本。
en: That is why a common fund to provide compensation for the economic costs of sanctions should be an integral part of the EU’s emerging foreign-policy stance toward Russia.

zh: 建立这样一个基金可以成为欧盟内部团结的有力标志，同时提供深思制裁成本的性质的理想机会。
en: Creating such a fund would provide a potent symbol of solidarity within the EU, while providing an ideal opportunity to reflect on the nature of the sanctions’ costs.

zh: 从经济学家的视角看，一个关键点是出口销售的损失在本质上并不是成本。
en: From an economist’s perspective, a key point is that losing export sales does not represent a cost per se.

zh: 比如，如果某生产一般消费品的公司 — — 如食品公司，甚至汽车公司也是如此 — — 对俄销售较以前有所下降，你并不一定要把这一下降记为损失。
en: For example, if a company that produces a generic consumer good like food, or even cars, sells less in Russia than it did before, one should not necessarily count the reduction as a loss.

zh: 毕竟，如果产品面临全球市场，那么一个市场的损失可以通过另一个市场销售的增加弥补。
en: After all, if such goods have a global market, a loss of sales in one market can be compensated by higher sales in another.

zh: 事实上，相当大一部分俄罗斯从欧盟进口的商品正属于这些一般消费品，它们不会受到制裁影响。
en: In fact, a large proportion of Russian imports from the EU are precisely of these generic consumer goods, which are not affected by sanctions.

zh: 因此，宣称制裁意味着高昂成本的报告 — — 因为欧盟对俄出口去年高达1,200亿欧元，并且贡献了成千上万工作岗位 — — 具有相当的误导性。
en: Thus, reports claiming that sanctions imply a high cost – because EU exports to Russia amounted to €120 billion ($161 billion) last year and represent tens of thousands of jobs – are highly misleading.

zh: 只有当某企业生产只能在俄罗斯出售的专门商品，并且在生产过程中使用的是无法用于其他商品生产的专业化的劳动力和资本时，才会产生经济损失。
en: An economic loss arises only if a firm produces some specialized good that can be sold only in Russia using labor and capital that are also specialized and cannot be employed to produce something else.

zh: 德国正是如此：举世闻名的德国中小企业往往生产高度专业化的商品；但它同时也以灵活性和适应能力强而骄傲。
en: This applies especially to Germany: The famous German Mittelstand often does produce highly specialized goods; but it also prides itself on its flexibility and adaptability.

zh: 因此，或许有的企业需要补偿，但时间会极其有限。
en: Given this, there might be a case for compensation in some cases, but it should be strictly limited in time.

zh: 不难制定获得欧盟“制裁补偿基金”的客观标准。
en: It would not be difficult to develop objective criteria for access to an EU “Sanctions Compensation Fund.”

zh: 如果企业在制裁所覆盖的领域经营，并且受影响产品的特殊性质决定了很难在其他地方出售，那么它有资格获得补偿。
en: A firm could be eligible for compensation if it operated in the sectors covered by sanctions, and if the product in question had special characteristics that prevented sales from being redirected elsewhere.

zh: 一个补偿资格的定量考察指标可以是过去三年对俄销售额至少占总销售额的四分之一，并且在今年下降程度超过一定百分比。
en: A quantitative test of eligibility could be that sales to Russia over the previous three years accounted for more than one-quarter of total sales and diminished by more than a certain percentage this year.

zh: 补偿的形式可以是员工再培训计划，或许还可以包括针对专业化机器设备的再融资贷款。
en: Compensation would take the form of retraining programs for personnel, and maybe refinancing of loans taken to finance specialized machinery.

zh: ��有两个部门不需要补偿：能源和金融。
en: But there are two sectors in which no compensation is needed: energy and finance.

zh: 为何？
en: Why?

zh: 首先，对欧洲进口俄罗斯能源的威胁可以忽略不计。
en: For starters, the risk to Europe’s energy imports from Russia is negligible.

zh: 如果俄罗斯要求提高其石油的价格，欧洲只要转向全球市场就行了。
en: Should Russia demand a higher price for its oil, Europe could simply turn to the global market.

zh: 类似地，俄罗斯天然气巨头俄气集团（Gazprom）要想提高对欧洲客户的要价，只有打破现有合同才行。
en: Likewise, Russian gas giant Gazprom could increase the price it charges its European customers only by breaking existing contracts.

zh: 此外，欧洲是俄罗斯很大一部分天然气出口的唯一客户，至少在短期，这部分天然气必须由已有管线输送。
en: Moreover, Europe is the only customer for a large share of Russian gas exports, which, at least in the short run, must be transported through the existing pipelines.

zh: 因此，对能源部门的补偿需要十分微小。
en: Given this, the case for compensation in the energy sector is exceptionally weak.

zh: 只有高度专业化的设备制造商 — — 比如在西伯利亚环境条件下的勘探设备 — — 有必要求助于补偿基金。
en: Only the makers of highly specialized equipment, perhaps for exploration under Siberian conditions, might have grounds for drawing on the compensation fund.

zh: 欧洲金融部门的补偿必要性甚至比能源部门还要小。
en: The case for compensation is even weaker in the European financial sector.

zh: 目前受到制裁约束的中期和长期融资只占欧洲银行业务微不足道的一小部分。
en: Providing the kind of medium- to long-term financing that is now subject to sanctions constitutes an infinitesimal fraction of European banks’ business.

zh: 此外，随着俄罗斯政治制度变得日益高压、司法制度变得日益专断，俄罗斯富人将比现在更想在海外为财富和家庭建立安全港。
en: Moreover, as Russia’s political system becomes ever more oppressive, and its legal system ever more arbitrary, rich Russians will be more inclined than they already are to establish a safe base abroad for their wealth and families.

zh: 伦敦等金融中心所提供的自由和法治精神将变得更加有吸引力。
en: The freedom and rule of law provided by financial centers such as London will become even more attractive.

zh: 2006年，欧盟成立了“全球化调整基金 ” （ Globalization Adjustment Fund）以补偿受进口增加冲击最大的部门。
en: In 2006, the EU established a “Globalization Adjustment Fund” to cushion those sectors hardest hit by rising imports.

zh: 尽管这一基金一开始只获得5亿欧元，只占欧盟年度总预算（约1,000亿欧元）的九牛一毛，但其成立是一个重要信号，表明欧盟准备补偿因为共同政策而蒙受损失的部门。
en: Though the Fund initially was allocated only €500 million, a rather modest sum compared to the overall annual EU budget of around €100 billion, its creation was an important signal of the EU’s readiness to compensate those who lose out from a common policy.

zh: 今天，欧盟需要同样的政治信号克服其成员国对推进共同外交政策的决定的抵制。
en: A similar political signal is needed today to overcome EU member states’ resistance to decisions that advance a common foreign policy.

zh: 而所需要的总数相对欧盟总预算来说可能也将是九牛一毛而已。
en: Here, too, the sum needed would probably be rather small compared to the overall EU budget.

zh: 谁赢得了欧洲？
en: Who Won Europe?

zh: 布鲁塞尔—关于谁出任下一任欧盟委员会主席的斗争正在白热化。
en: BRUSSELS – The fight over who will be the European Commission’s next president is heating up.

zh: 一些欧盟领导人最近被拍到现身瑞典某个湖泊的一艘小船，据说正在密谋打击领先者，而英国首相卡梅伦公开宣扬重新评估成员国政府决定谁能进入欧盟执行机构的权利。
en: Several European Union leaders were recently spotted in a small rowboat on a Swedish lake, reportedly scheming against the frontrunner, and British Prime Minister David Cameron has launched a public campaign to reassert the right of EU member states’ governments to decide who will occupy the EU’s executive arm.

zh: 选择欧盟委员会下任主席的过程似乎成了人民的声音（表达于上个月的欧洲议会选举中）和政府幕后交易之间的冲突。
en: The process of choosing the Commission’s president appears to be a conflict between the voice of the people, as expressed in the results of last month’s European Parliament election, and backroom deal-making by governments.

zh: 但现实要更加复杂，真正的民主权力并没有来到声称“赢得”选举的人手中。
en: But reality is more complex, and the genuine democratic mandate did not go to the person who claims to have “won” the election.

zh: 在走向选举期间，主要欧洲政党“家族 ” （ 泛欧洲政党均不在其列，只是国家政党的松散联盟）无不提名了首席候选人作为欧盟委员会主席人选。
en: In the run-up to the election, the major European party “families” (there are no pan-European parties, only loose alliances of national parties) each nominated a Spitzenkandidat as their choice for President of the European Commission.

zh: 略微占优的中右翼的欧洲人民党（European People’s Party在欧洲议会的751个议席中赢得221个）宣布在选举中获胜；其他许多阵营，包括社会党、绿党和自由派，都 同意欧洲人民党首席候选人容克（Jean-Claude Juncker）拥有被选为欧盟委员会主席的道德权利。
en: The center-right European People’s Party, which gained a narrow plurality of 221 seats in the 751-seat parliament, has claimed victory in the election; and many others, including socialists, greens, and liberals, concur that the EPP’s Spitzenkandidat, Jean-Claude Juncker, has a moral right to be selected as President of the Commission.

zh: 事实上，尽管欧洲人民党赢得了29%的席位，而社会党和民主党进步联盟（Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats，简称S&D）只获得了24 % ， 但后者仍可以宣布获胜。
en: In fact, though the EPP won 29% of the seats, versus 24% for the Progressive Alliance of Socialists and Democrats (S&D), the S&D can claim victory.

zh: 毕竟，S&D旗下政党在国家层面赢得了更多选票 — — 加起来达到了4,000万，超过了欧洲人民党旗下政党的3,990万。
en: After all, its affiliated parties at the national level won a greater number of votes – a combined total of 40 million, compared to 39.9 million for parties affiliated with the EPP.

zh: 差距很小，但毫无疑问S&D的支持率更高（24.4%对23.8 % ） 。
en: The difference is small, but there can be no doubt that the S&D won the popular vote (24.4% to 23.8%).

zh: 尽管选举制度完全按比例定胜负，而S&D在民众投票中获胜，但其在欧洲议会中获得的席位反而更少，原因很简单：其所属政党在大国赢得的选票相对较多，而获得一个欧洲议会席位所需要的选票“成本”在大国也更大。
en: Though the election system is purely proportional and the S&D won the popular vote, the reason that it ended up with fewer seats is simple: its affiliated parties won relatively more votes in the larger countries, where it “costs” more voters to gain a single seat.

zh: 反之，欧洲人民党在获得议席选票成本低得多的小国表现较好。
en: Conversely, the EPP performed relatively better in small countries, where the vote cost per seat is much lower.

zh: 最极端的例子是容克的祖国卢森堡。 欧洲人民党在卢森堡获得了近38%的群众选票，而S&D为11 % — —从绝对数目衡量，仅仅是52,000票。
en: The most extreme example is Luxembourg, Juncker’s home country, where the EPP received almost 38% of the popular vote, versus 11% for the S&D – a difference, in absolute terms, of only about 52,000.

zh: 但欧洲人民党比S&D多获得两个欧洲议会席位，这意味着每个席位的成本大概是26,000票。
en: But the EPP obtained two more MEPs than the S&D, which implies a per seat cost of roughly 26,000 votes.

zh: 另一个极端是意大利。 在意大利，S&D赢得41%的选票，而欧洲人民党为22 % 。
en: The other extreme is Italy, where the S&D won 41% of the votes, versus 22% for the EPP.

zh: 从绝对数目衡量，差距在500万票以上，但S&D只比欧洲人民党多获得14个欧洲议会席位。
en: In absolute terms, the difference was more than five million votes, but the S&D won only 14 more MEPs than the EPP.

zh: 在意大利，S&D需要大约370,000票才能获得一个欧洲议会席位，比欧洲人民党在卢森堡的成本大14倍。
en: In Italy, the S&D needed about 370,000 voters to gain one MEP, more than 14 times as many as the EPP needed in Luxembourg.

zh: 因此，欧洲人民党的“胜利”主要要归因于欧洲议会席位平均选票比率在不同国家之间大相径庭这一事实。
en: The EPP’s “victory” was thus due mainly to the fact that the ratio of voters per MEP varies greatly across countries.

zh: 意大利（以及其他大国）的一票的价值远不如小国的一票。
en: A single vote in Italy (and in other large countries) is worth much less than a vote in smaller countries.

zh: 德国宪法法院最近根据这一事实做出了一项争议裁决，取消了政党在德国获得欧洲议会席位所需要的3%选票门槛（结果，极右翼小党派 — — 国家民主党（National Democratic Party）也赢得了一个欧洲议会席位 ） 。
en: The German Constitutional Court recently relied on this fact in a controversial decision striking down the 3% electoral threshold for parties to gain European Parliament seats in Germany (the small far-right National Democratic Party picked up one seat in the European Parliament as a result).

zh: 德国法院的理由是欧洲议会选举不是真正的选举，因为“一人一票”的原则没有受到尊重。
en: The German court’s rationale was that the European Parliament election is not a true election, because the principle of “one person, one vote” is not respected.

zh: 这不仅是民主原则的问题；最近的选举结果表明它可以极大地影响整治结果。
en: This is not only a problem from the standpoint of democratic principles; the results of the recent election have shown the extent to which it can influence political outcomes.

zh: 容克能够在欧洲议会算术中脱颖而出的原因只有一个：他在小国赢得了选票，而选票实际上是按国家规模加权的。
en: Juncker came out ahead in the MEP count for only one reason: he obtained his votes in small countries, and votes are de facto weighted by country size.

zh: 因此，欧洲议会直接代表了欧洲人民、是人民给予了欧洲人民党候选人直接的群众授权因而应该获得成员国的欧洲委员会代表的尊重的观点是站不住脚的。
en: Thus, the claim that the European Parliament directly represents Europe’s people and that the people have given the EPP’s candidate a direct popular mandate that the member states’ representatives in the European Council should respect rings hollow.

zh: S&D获得了更多的选票，因此其首席候选人舒尔茨（Martin Shultz）拥有更大的民主合法性。
en: The S&D obtained more votes, giving its Spitzenkandidat, Martin Schulz, a claim to greater democratic legitimacy.

zh: 欧洲没有趴下
en: Europe Is Still Standing

zh: 布鲁塞尔—从新闻报道看，你或许会得到这样的印象：4亿合格选民在最近的欧洲议会选举中大量投票给了反欧盟阵营。
en: BRUSSELS – Judging from the headlines, one might get the impression that the 400 million citizens eligible to participate in the recent European Parliament elections voted massively against the European Union.

zh: 诚然，反现状阵营政党 — — 主要是欧洲质疑派 — — 赢得了大约五分之一的选票。
en: True, anti-establishment, mostly Euroskeptic, parties won about one-fifth of the vote.

zh: 但要说产生了拒绝欧洲的选举结果实在有失偏颇（或者不公平 ） 。
en: But to characterize the election result as a rejection of Europe simply is not quite accurate (or fair).

zh: 首先，尽管许多人指出欧盟与其公民距离太远，但民调一直显示，对主要欧洲机构的公共信任度仍比国家机构高。
en: For starters, although much has been made of the argument that the EU is too far removed from its citizens, opinion polls have shown consistently that public trust in the major European institutions remains higher than trust in national institutions.

zh: 放眼欧盟，平均而言欧洲议会的通过率仍比国家议会高。
en: Across the EU, the European Parliament still has higher approval ratings, on average, than national parliaments.

zh: 尽管信任度差距在近几年中有所缩小，但即使最近的衰退 — — 这通常被归咎于欧盟所实施的紧缩和欧元区危机 — — 也只是略微降低了欧洲议会对国家议会的优势。
en: Although the trust gap has narrowed somewhat in recent years, even the continuing recession, which is often blamed on EU-imposed austerity and the crisis in the eurozone, has only marginally reduced the European Parliament’s advantage over national parliaments.

zh: 最近民调表明，在整个欧洲，大约40%的人仍信任欧洲议会，而只有25%的人信任本国议会。
en: Recent polls suggest that, across Europe, about 40% of the population still trust the European Parliament, whereas only 25% trust their national parliaments.

zh: 此外，欧洲议会的信任度也仍然高于美国国会，后者的通过率如今低于10 % 。
en: Moreover, the European Parliament retains much higher trust than the US Congress, which has approval ratings that are now below 10%.

zh: 考虑到大西洋两岸的代议机构都在丧失信任度，欧洲议会还算相对更优。
en: Given the general loss of trust in parliamentary institutions on both sides of the Atlantic, the European Parliament is doing relatively well.

zh: 此外，并非所有反对党都拒绝欧盟。
en: Moreover, not all protest parties reject the EU.

zh: 在受危机影响的欧洲国家中，年轻人 — — 他们是受冲击最大的群体 — — 一致支持左翼“反紧缩”政党，最明显的要数希腊。
en: In Europe’s crisis-affected countries, young people, who have been hardest hit, voted en masse for leftist “anti-austerity” parties, most notably in Greece.

zh: 但这些政党并不拒绝欧盟。
en: But these parties do not reject the EU.

zh: 相反，它们希望欧盟能够更加团结，以使其政府能够增加支出。
en: On the contrary, they want more solidarity from the EU, which would enable their governments to spend more.

zh: 反紧缩反对票在政府无法有效实施改革的国家（如希腊）最多，而葡萄牙和西班牙正好相反，它们的经济正在强劲的出口的带动下复苏。
en: The anti-austerity protest vote is strongest where governments have been unable to implement reforms effectively (for example, in Greece), in contrast to Portugal and Spain, whose economies are recovering on the back of strong exports.

zh: 在意大利，总理伦齐的新政府能够通过采取渐进改革而不把所有其所面临的问题归咎于欧盟而抵挡住了欧洲怀疑主义声浪。
en: In Italy, Prime Minister Matteo Renzi’s new government has been able to stem the tide of Euroskepticism by undertaking concrete reforms and not blaming the EU for every problem the country faces.

zh: 拒绝欧盟似乎在北欧更加根深蒂固，北欧老龄人口更倾向于投票给右翼民粹主义政党。
en: The rejection of the EU seems more fundamental in parts of northern Europe, where the elderly tend to vote for right-wing populist parties.

zh: 特别是在英国和法国，对欧盟不满情绪的重要原因是失业状况和失去边境控制的感觉。
en: Especially in the United Kingdom and France, unemployment and a perceived lack of control over borders have played a large role in fostering disaffection with the EU.

zh: 这令人特别担心，因为这两国的问题与欧洲政策关系甚小。
en: This is particularly worrying, given that both countries’ problems have little to do with EU policies.

zh: 法国经济不振不能归咎于布鲁塞尔所施加的紧缩，欧洲甚至不在欧元���内。
en: France’s economic malaise cannot be blamed on austerity imposed from Brussels, and the UK is not even in the eurozone.

zh: 两国的民粹主义者成功地用无关痛痒的问题进行选战宣传。
en: Populists in both countries campaigned successfully on non-issues.

zh: 所有可见研究都表明 ， “ 福利旅游 ” （ welfare tourism）只是个别现象，总体而言移民涌入有利于经济增长。
en: All available studies show that “welfare tourism” is a limited phenomenon, and that immigration fosters economic growth.

zh: 但这些事实抵不过工资停滞（英国）和失业继续攀升（法国 ） 。
en: But these facts do not count when wages are stagnating (as in the UK) or unemployment continues to rise (as in France).

zh: 民粹主义者轻松地将这些问题引导到“欧洲”身上，但这其实只能表明他们对外部世界的恐惧。
en: Populists can easily project these problems onto “Europe,” which in this case merely represents fear of the outside world in general.

zh: 因此，欧盟陷入了一场拉锯：南欧成员国年轻人要求更加团结，而北欧年长者不满于边境开放。
en: The EU is thus caught between demands for more solidarity from the young in its southern members and dissatisfaction with open borders among the elderly in the north.

zh: 一个很有诱惑力的解决办法是放松紧缩并取消自由越境的申根区，以此两头讨好。
en: It is tempting to try to mollify both groups by relaxing austerity and ditching the border-free Schengen area.

zh: 但这根本无助于让政治氛围朝有利于欧洲的方向发展，特别是在法国和英国等国家。
en: But that is unlikely to swing the political pendulum back toward Europe, especially in countries like France and the UK.

zh: 欧洲怀疑派和其他反对党崛起的深层次根源来自对经济状况和功能失调的国家政治制度的普遍不满。
en: The deeper roots of the surge of Euroskeptic and other protest parties originate with the general dissatisfaction with the state of the economy and dysfunctional national political systems.

zh: 用紧缩或欧盟内部自由迁徙的基本权利来进行小修小补无法造成重大区别。
en: Tinkering with austerity or the fundamental right of free movement within the EU will not make much of a difference.

zh: 是国家层面需要改革。
en: Reform is needed at home, in national capitals.

zh: 在这样的背景下，现在饱受关注的欧盟委员会下任主席人选问题并不重要。
en: In this context, the selection of the European Commission’s next president – now the focus of considerable attention – is a sideshow.

zh: 不管选谁，都只能在法国总统奥朗德形成国内亲改革共识和英国首相卡梅伦说服选民移民（其中只有三分之一来自较穷的欧盟成员国）有利于英国经济的条件下才能让欧盟运转起来。
en: Whoever is chosen will be able to make the EU work only if French President François Hollande can build a domestic pro-reform consensus and British Prime Minister David Cameron can convince his electorate that immigrants (only one-third of whom come from the poorer EU member states) benefit the UK economy.

zh: 欧盟没有庞大的预算，充其量只是为这个广袤而多元化的大洲设置了总体经济和社会规则框架。
en: The EU does not have a significant budget, and it sets at most a general framework for economic and social rules that vary widely across a large and diverse continent.

zh: 成败与否主要取决于国家层面。
en: Success and failure are largely determined at the national level.

zh: 问题的发生和解决也在于国家层面。
en: That is where the problems lie and where they must be solved.

zh: 以反欧盟选票面目出现的现象代表的是反对国内社会经济问题的现实。
en: What has taken the form of an anti-EU vote constitutes in reality a protest against socio-economic problems at home.

zh: 系统在运转
en: The System is Working

zh: 梅福德，马萨诸塞州—随着二十国集团财政部长会议在澳大利亚凯恩斯召开，忧郁军团（Legion of Gloom）再次齐聚。
en: MEDFORD, MASSACHUSETTS – As the latest G-20 meeting of finance ministers starts in Cairns, Australia, the Legion of Gloom is at it again.

zh: 他们的传统智慧是 ， “ 系统 ” — —从世界贸易组织和二十国集团到各主要中央银行的全球治理结构 — — 遭到了严重破坏，急需修补。
en: Their conventional wisdom is that “the system” – global governance structures ranging from the World Trade Organization and the G-20 to the major central banks – is badly broken and in desperate need of repair.

zh: 事实上，全球经济秩序在2008年以来运转的相当良好。
en: In fact, the global economic order has worked remarkably well since 2008.

zh: 诚然，大衰退的第一年要比大萧条的第一年严重得多。
en: True, the first year of the Great Recession was more severe than the first year of the Great Depression.

zh: 但是，尽管第一波冲击十分猛烈，但系统的反应出人意料地敏捷。
en: But, despite this initial shock, the system responded in a surprisingly nimble fashion.

zh: 与前几次金融危机触发的全球衰退相比，此次全球经济反弹得相当强劲。
en: Compared to previous global downturns triggered by a financial crisis, the global economy bounced back robustly.

zh: 大部分国家的贸易和产出水平几年前就已经超过危机前水平，全球贫困也在继续迅速减少。
en: Trade and output levels exceeded pre-crisis levels in most countries a few years ago, and global poverty continues to decline rapidly.

zh: 如此反弹的一个关键是，与20世纪30年代相反，全球经济维持着现有环境：贸易壁垒和对外国直接投资的限制仍然很小，跨国贸易在互联网上继续扩张。
en: One key to this rebound was that, in contrast to the 1930s, the global economy maintained existing conditions: trade barriers remained low, as did restrictions on foreign direct investment, and cross-border exchange continued to spread with the Internet.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究所（McKinsey Global Institute）指出，除了跨国金融，全球流动与危机前一样强劲。
en: As the McKinsey Global Institute noted, with the exception of cross-border finance, global flows are just as robust now as they were before the crisis.

zh: 全球机构做出了局部改进，如二十国集团的崛起和国际货币基金组织（IMF）的改革。
en: There has even been a partial revamping of key global institutions, from the rise of the G-20 to reform of the International Monetary Fund.

zh: 事实上，市场对乌克兰或南中国海地缘政治紧张局势冲击所表现出来的恢复力已开始令一些美联储官员表示担心。
en: Indeed, the resiliency of markets to geopolitical tensions in Ukraine or the South China Sea has begun to worry some Fed officials.

zh: 从一切合理指标看，跨国机构和大国政府做了保持全球经济开放所应该做的事。
en: By any reasonable metric, multilateral institutions and great-power governments did what was necessary to preserve the global economy’s openness.

zh: 既然如此，关于系统失灵的误解为何如此广泛呢？
en: So why the widespread misperception that the system failed?

zh: 在这里，我们陷入了一个肮脏的世界政治小秘密：许多国际政治评论家并不十分了解经济学和经济政策。
en: Here, we run into a dirty little secret of world politics: many commentators on international politics do not know much about economics or economic policy.

zh: 国际事务教授总是大谈“高端政治”和“低端政治 ” ， 而经济问题往往被归于后者。
en: International-affairs professionals frequently talk about “high politics” and “low politics,” and they usually relegate economic issues to the latter category.

zh: 当政治评论家评述全球经济时，这一无知就会带来问题。
en: This ignorance matters when political commentators try to write about the global economy.

zh: 他们自然会以最容易获得的事实为指导。
en: They will naturally rely on the most accessible facts as their guide.

zh: 平心而论，某些最显而易见的数据确实表明全球经济秩序正在分裂。
en: To be fair, some of the most obvious data have indeed suggested fragmentation of the global economic order.

zh: 世贸组织谈判多哈回合陷入冻结，二十国集团峰会频现僵持，联合国安理会也处于僵局之中，这些证据似乎已足以证明现状岌岌可危的观点 — — 即使新闻标题背后的事实与这些共识并不相符。
en: The dormancy of the Doha Round of WTO talks, the public deadlock of some G-20 summits, and stalemates at the United Nations Security Council seem like sufficient evidence to proclaim that the status quo is imperiled – even if facts beyond the headlines belie that consensus.

zh: 以“货币战争”问题上的骚动为例。
en: Consider the kerfuffle over “currency wars.”

zh: 2010年，美联储开始暗示第二轮量化宽松（QE2 ） 。
en: In 2010, the Fed began hinting at a second round of quantitative easing, or QE2.

zh: 量化宽松 — — 美联储购买长期金融资产 — — 的一个政策外部性是美元贬值。
en: One of the policy externalities of QE – the Fed’s purchase of long-term financial assets – was a depreciating dollar.

zh: 许多新兴经济体领导人担心本国资产价格出现泡沫和资本涌入导致货币升值压力，一时间怨声四起，巴西财政部长曼特加（Guido Mantega）称之为“国际货币战争 ” 。
en: Fearing domestic asset-price bubbles and upward pressure on their currencies from an inward rush of capital, many emerging-economy leaders complained loudly about what Brazilian Finance Minister Guido Mantega called an “international currency war.”

zh: 在���肆宣传之下被忽视的一个事实是，市场和金融分析师都没有对汇率的过度波动和真正货币战争的可能性感到不安。
en: Lost in all of the hype was the fact that neither markets nor financial analysts were terribly perturbed about excessive exchange-rate volatility or the possibility of an actual currency war.

zh: 2008年秋天以来，汇率波动逐渐减弱至危机前水平。
en: After the autumn of 2008, exchange-rate volatility slowly receded toward pre-crisis levels.

zh: 另一个集体误判的共同原因是用错地方的怀旧情感。
en: Another common reason for the collective misperception is misplaced nostalgia.

zh: 2012年，前美国国家安全顾问斯考克罗夫特（Brent Scowcroft）概括了后危机时代的传统智慧 ： “ 战后领导人建立了IMF、世界银行和关贸总协定，以此建立了前进规则。
en: Former US National Security Adviser Brent Scowcroft encapsulated the post-crisis conventional wisdom in 2012: “The postwar leaders set up the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, and the General Agreements on Tariffs and Trade to develop rules of the road.

zh: 新二十国集团只不过是这一曾经光芒四射的机构建设运动的回光返照。 ”
en: The new G-20 is but a pale reflection of that once-brilliant institution building.”

zh: 但过去建设全球秩序的努力可谓事倍功半。
en: But past efforts at building a global order have had their share of futility.

zh: 任何熟悉布雷顿森林机构历史的人都知道，这些机构的失误和成就一样多。
en: Anyone familiar with the history of the Bretton Woods institutions knows that they experienced as many misses as hits.

zh: 与过去相比，目前的秩序总体而言表现更好。
en: Compared to the past, the current order performed well above average.

zh: 也许对于忧郁军团得势的最深刻的解释是他们来自哪里。
en: Perhaps the deepest explanation for the Legion of Gloom’s strength is where they live.

zh: 根据《经济学人》智库（Economist Intelligence Unit）的数据，2008年至2012年期间，经合组织经济体平均年GDP增长率为0.5 % ， 而非经合组织经济体为5.2 % 。
en: According to the Economist Intelligence Unit, the OECD economies averaged annual GDP growth of 0.5% from 2008 to 2012, whereas non-OECD economies averaged 5.2% growth.

zh: 这非常重要，因为对国际秩序的分析仍然以西方为基准点。
en: This matters because analysis of the international order remains anchored in the West.

zh: 政治学有一个一般规则：经济衰退造成机构内部的不信任。
en: It is a general rule of political science that a faltering economy causes greater distrust in institutions.

zh: 疲软的经济产生系统破坏的感觉，使人们认为掌权者不值得信任。
en: A weak economy feeds perceptions that the system is broken, and that those in authority are not to be trusted.

zh: 因此，经合组织经济体各层次怀疑论日嚣尘上丝毫不令人奇怪。
en: So greater skepticism about all levels of governance in the OECD economies is not surprising.

zh: 分析师也许首先要看局部环境，然后将其外推形成他们对全球机构的评估。
en: Analysts might be looking first at their local circumstances, and then extrapolating from that to their assessments of global institutions.

zh: 在发达世界，对国家复苏迟缓的悲观导致分析师将糟糕的国内和地区治理等同于糟糕的全球治理。
en: Pessimism about slow national recoveries in the developed world is causing analysts to conflate poor domestic and regional governance with poor global governance.

zh: 但日本、美国、英国和欧元区国内经济疲软的主要原因从根本上并不是全球性的。
en: But the primary causes for domestic economic weakness in Japan, the US, the United Kingdom, and the eurozone are not global in origin.

zh: 2008年危机爆发时，日本经济已经停滞了近20年。
en: Japan’s economy had been stagnating for almost two decades when the 2008 crisis erupted.

zh: 类似地，美国从大衰退中复苏一个重大拖累因素也在于国内政策僵局和政策不确定性。
en: Likewise, domestic policy stalemates and political uncertainty acted as a significant drag on the US recovery from the Great Recession.

zh: 自2008年以来，系统表现出令人瞩目的恢复力，这是否意味着它可以抵御下一次危机？
en: Does the system’s remarkable resiliency since 2008 mean that it can withstand the next crisis?

zh: 理论上，答案是肯定的 — — 2008年后的许多改革设计就是为了给全球经济增加冲击吸收。
en: In theory, yes – many of the post-2008 reforms have been designed to add shock absorbers to the global economy.

zh: 但是，在国际关系中，集体误判可以制造其本身的事实。
en: But, in international relations, collective misperceptions can create their own reality.

zh: 如果专家继续坚持认为系统失灵，学究们就会花大量时间和精力用于寻找如何修复被破坏的东西。
en: If pundits continue to insist that the system failed, wonks will devote time and effort to figuring out how to fix what is not broken.

zh: 此外，一旦误判根深蒂固地竖立起来，要想纠正就变得极其困难 — — 特别是在问题的主题并不在专家专业知识范围内的时候。
en: Moreover, it is extremely difficult to correct misperceptions once they ossify – particularly if the topic in question is outside a pundit’s range of expertise.

zh: 讽刺的是，唯一可能阻止系统继续运转的东西乃是对其最伟大组成部分的信心不足。
en: Ironically, the only thing that might stop the system from continuing to work is the low confidence of its greatest proponents.

zh: 美国页岩的全球影响
en: The Global Impact of US Shale

zh: 华盛顿—本世纪以降，能源方面的最大创新是页岩气的开发以及相应的被称为“致密油 ” （ tight oil）的资源。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The biggest innovation in energy so far this century has been the development of shale gas and the associated resource known as “tight oil.”

zh: 页岩能源之所以能位居榜首，不仅是因为其在美国蕴藏量丰富，也是因为其具有深远的全球影响 — — 这一影响将在2014年继续显现。
en: Shale energy ranks at the top not only because of its abundance in the United States, but also because of its profound global impact – as events in 2014 will continue to demonstrate.

zh: 美国页岩气和致密油已在改变全球能源影响，也削弱了欧洲对美国的竞争力和中国的整体制造竞争力。
en: America’s shale gas and tight oil are already changing global energy markets and reducing both Europe’s competitiveness vis-à-vis the US and China’s overall manufacturing competitiveness.

zh: 页岩气和致密油还改变着全球政治。
en: They are also bringing shifts in global politics.

zh: 事实上，页岩能源如何改变美国在中东的角色已成为华盛顿和中东本身的一个热门话题。
en: Indeed, how shale energy may change America’s role in the Middle East is becoming a hot topic in Washington, DC, and in the Middle East itself.

zh: 这场油气领域的“非常规革命”来得并不算快。
en: This “unconventional revolution” in oil and gas did not come quickly.

zh: 液压致裂法1947年即已存在，将这种方法用于紧致的页岩最早可以追溯到20世纪80年代初的得克萨斯州。
en: Hydraulic fracturing – known as “fracking” – has been around since 1947, and initial efforts to adapt it to dense shale began in Texas in the early 1980’s.

zh: 但直到20世纪90年代末和21世纪初，专门针对页岩的液压致裂法才与水平钻井一起臻于成熟。
en: But it was not until the late 1990’s and early 2000’s that the specific type of fracturing for shale, combined with horizontal drilling, was perfected.

zh: 而其对美国能源供应产生值得注意的影响已经是2008年以后的事了。
en: And it was not until 2008 that its impact on the US energy supply became notable.

zh: 自此以后，这一行业发展迅速，目前页岩气已占美国天然气总产量的44 % 。
en: Since then, the industry has developed fast, with shale gas currently accounting for 44% of total US natural-gas production.

zh: 由于供应充足，美国气价已跌至欧洲的三分之一和亚洲的五分之一。
en: Given abundant supply, US gas prices have fallen to a third of those in Europe, while Asia pays five times as much.

zh: 致密油的生产技术与页岩气相同，也刺激了美国的石油产量，2008以来，致密油产量提高了56 % ， 以绝对数衡量，比12个欧佩克成员国中的八个的总产量还要高。
en: Tight oil, produced with the same technology as shale gas, is boosting US oil production as well, with output up 56% since 2008 – an increase that, in absolute terms, is larger than the total output of each of eight of the 12 OPEC countries.

zh: 事实上，国际能源署（International Energy Agency）预计不出几年美国就将取代沙特阿拉伯和俄罗斯成为世界第一大产油国。
en: Indeed, the International Energy Agency predicts that in the next few years the US will overtake Saudi Arabia and Russia to become the world’s largest oil producer.

zh: 五年前，人们预计美国必须进口大量液化天然气（LNG）以弥补预期国内产量缺口。
en: Five years ago, it was expected that the US would be importing large volumes of liquefied natural gas to make up for an anticipated shortfall in domestic production.

zh: 如今，美国不需要进口任何LNG，每年因此省下1 000亿美元进口费用。
en: Now the US is not importing any LNG – thereby saving $100 billion on its annual import bill.

zh: 按当前价格计算，美国石油产量增加也节约了1 000亿美元进口费用。
en: At current prices, the increase in US oil production has been cutting another $100 billion from that bill.

zh: 此外，这场非常规革命还支持了两百多万个工作岗位。
en: In addition, the unconventional revolution supports over two million jobs.

zh: 其全球影响也十分巨大。
en: The global impact has been enormous.

zh: 大部分全球新ING产能都是美国制造。
en: Much of the new global LNG capacity was developed with the US in mind.

zh: 如今，美国市场上充斥着廉价的国产天然气，其中一部分LNG出口至欧洲，给俄罗斯和挪威等传统出口国带来了意料之外的竞争。
en: Now, with the US market cordoned off by cheap domestic gas, some of that LNG is going to Europe, introducing unexpected competition for traditional suppliers Russia and Norway.

zh: 对日本来说，2011年福岛第一核电站灾难后，美国不再需要LNG成为了意外福音。
en: For Japan, the lack of US demand for LNG proved fortunate in the aftermath of the disaster at the Fukushima Daiichi nuclear-power plant in 2011.

zh: 大量LNG因此可以流向日本用于发电，以弥补核电站整体关闭后造成的电力损失。
en: Much of that LNG could go to Japan to generate electricity, replacing the electricity lost from the total shutdown of nuclear power.

zh: 许多其他国家也在根据这场非常规能源革命重新评估其能源政策。
en: Many other countries are reassessing their own energy policies in light of the unconventional-energy revolution.

zh: 中国目睹美国页岩气开发速度之快、程度之深，也将开发其丰富的非常规天然气资源作为优先项目。
en: China, seeing the speed and extent of US shale-gas development, has placed a high priority on developing its extensive unconventional gas resources.

zh: 对中国来说，用天然气取代煤炭用于发电对于减轻因城市污染严重所造成的公众不满和健康问题具有关键意义。
en: For China, replacing coal with natural gas in electricity generation is essential to mitigate public discontent and health problems stemming from the heavy burden of urban air pollution.

zh: 美国页岩能的崛起还带来了更广泛��全球经济影响：美国页岩气正在改变全球经济的竞争力平衡，给美国带来了意料之外的优势。
en: The rise of US shale energy is also having a broader global economic impact: American shale gas is changing the balance of competitiveness in the world economy, giving the US an unanticipated advantage.

zh: 事实上，便宜的天然气正在助力美国制造业复苏，公司纷纷建造新厂、扩建已有设施。
en: Indeed, inexpensive natural gas is fueling a US manufacturing renaissance, as companies build new plants and expand existing facilities.

zh: 放眼欧洲，产业领袖正日益担忧其企业相对于使用低成本天然气的工厂的竞争力的损失及其所造成的制造业从欧洲流向美国的后果。
en: Throughout Europe, industrial leaders are becoming increasingly alarmed by enterprises’ loss of competitiveness to factories that use low-cost natural gas and the consequent shift of manufacturing from Europe to the US.

zh: 德国尤其担心，其GDP一半由出口贡献，并且能源成本仍在节节攀升。
en: This is particularly worrying in Germany, which relies on exports for half of its GDP, and where energy costs remain on a stubbornly upward trajectory.

zh: 高成本意味着德国工业将失去全球市场份额。
en: These high costs mean that German industry will lose global market share.

zh: 不管能源结构变化目标为何，已经饱受高失业之苦的欧盟国家将被迫重新考虑其高成本能源战略，否则就将面临竞争力恶化和就业岗位减少。
en: Whatever their targets for shifting their energy mix, European Union countries, already suffering from high unemployment, will be forced to reconsider high-cost energy strategies or face weakening competitiveness and loss of jobs.

zh: 地缘政治影响已经显而易见。
en: The geopolitical impact is already evident.

zh: 比如，伊朗开始认证对待核谈判，而若没有致密油，这一幕很可能不会发生。
en: For example, Iran is now seriously at the table in nuclear negotiations, which might well not have happened were it not for tight oil.

zh: 当伊朗石油出口遭遇严格制裁时，许多人担心油价会飙升，制裁最终将因为找不到足够的替代供给而以失败告终。
en: When strict sanctions were imposed on Iranian oil exports, many feared that world oil prices would spike, and that the sanctions would ultimately fail, owing to insufficient alternative supply.

zh: 但过去两年来美国石油产量的增加弥补了伊朗产量的下降，使得制裁（以及相应的金融措施）得以奏效，让伊朗开始认真对待两年前所不愿参与的谈判。
en: But the increase in US oil production over the last two years has more than made up for the missing Iranian output, enabling the sanctions (bolstered by parallel financial measures) to work – impelling Iran to negotiate seriously, which it was unwilling to do only two years ago.

zh: 在阿拉伯国家，一个日益增加的忧虑是美国致密油产量的快速增加将减少美国对中东的整体参与程度。
en: In Arab capitals, anxiety is mounting that a rapid increase in US tight-oil production will fuel wholesale US disengagement from the Middle East.

zh: 但这高估了直接石油进口左右美国中东地区政策的程度。
en: But this overstates the extent to which direct oil imports shape US policy toward the region.

zh: 毫无疑问，美国产量的增加加上汽车燃料效率的提高将继续降低美国的石油进口。
en: To be sure, rising US output, combined with greater automotive fuel efficiency, will continue to reduce US oil imports.

zh: 此外，尽管，尽管美国在未来几年仍将进口石油，但更多的进口将来自加拿大（尽管两国对于Keystone XL管道争议重重 ） 。
en: And, while the US will still import oil in the years ahead, more of it will come from Canada (notwithstanding the debate about the Keystone XL pipeline).

zh: 但事实是中东石油供给从未长时间对美国整体石油局面造成很大的影响。
en: But the fact is that Middle East supply has not loomed very large in the overall US petroleum picture for some time.

zh: 毕竟，在致密油增长之前，波斯湾也只提供了美国石油总供给量的10%左右。
en: After all, even before the growth of tight oil, the Persian Gulf provided only about 10% of total US supply.

zh: 并非美国从中东的直接石油进口，而是石油对全球经济和世界政治的重要性左右着美国的战略利益。
en: It was not direct US oil imports from the Middle East, but rather oil’s importance to the global economy and world politics, that helped define US strategic interests.

zh: 中东仍将是具有重大地缘战略意义的竞技场，其石油将依然是全球经济运行的关键。
en: The Middle East will continue to be an arena of great geopolitical importance, and its oil will be essential to the functioning of the global economy.

zh: 这意味着该地区将仍是美国战略意义的核心。
en: This implies that the region will likely remain a central strategic interest for the US.

zh: 但是，总体而言，页岩能源革命确实给美国带来了新的恢复力之源，强化了美国在世界的地位。
en: Overall, however, the shale-energy revolution does provide a new source of resilience for the US and enhances America’s position in the world.

zh: 页岩气和致密油在美国的崛起再一次表明，创新能够改变全球经济和政治实力平衡。
en: The emergence of shale gas and tight oil in the US demonstrates, once again, how innovation can change the balance of global economic and political power.

zh: 反思民主
en: Rethinking Democracy

zh: 普林斯顿—从很多标准看，世界从未变得更加民主。
en: PRINCETON – By many measures, the world has never been more democratic.

zh: 基本上每一个政府都是言必称民主和人权。
en: Virtually every government at least pays lip service to democracy and human rights.

zh: 尽管选举可能并不自由和公正，但大规模操纵选举很少见，只有男人、白人或富人参与的选举也早已成了历史。
en: Though elections may not be free and fair, massive electoral manipulation is rare and the days when only males, whites, or the rich could vote are long gone.

zh: 自由之家（Freedom House）的全球调查表明自20世纪以来 ， “ 自由”国家的比例在稳步增加，已故哈佛政治学家亨廷顿（Samuel Huntington）将这一趋势称为民主的“第三波 ” 。
en: Freedom House’s global surveys show a steady increase from the 1970s in the share of countries that are “free” – a trend that the late Harvard political scientist Samuel Huntington dubbed the “third wave” of democratization.

zh: 民主范式从西方发达国家向全世界其他地区的扩散也许是全球化最重大的好处。
en: The dissemination of democratic norms from the advanced countries of the West to the rest of the world has been perhaps the most significant benefit of globalization.

zh: 但民主也不是只有优点。
en: Yet not all is well with democracy.

zh: 今天的民主政府表现得十分平庸，未来也颇可质疑。
en: Today’s democratic governments perform poorly, and their future remains very much in doubt.

zh: 在发达国家，对政府的不满来自政府无力提供有效的经济政策实现有效的增长和包容性政策。
en: In the advanced countries, dissatisfaction with government stems from its inability to deliver effective economic policies for growth and inclusion.

zh: 在历史较短的发展中民主国家，无法保证公民自由和政治自由造成了进一步的不满。
en: In the newer democracies of the developing world, failure to safeguard civil liberties and political freedom is an additional source of discontent.

zh: 结合了少数服从多数和尊重少数派权利的真正的民主需要两套制度。
en: A true democracy, one that combines majority rule with respect for minority rights, requires two sets of institutions.

zh: 首先是代表（representation）制度，如政党、议会和选举制度，这样才能引出人民的选择、让人民参与到政治活动中来。
en: First, institutions of representation, such as political parties, parliaments, and electoral systems, are needed to elicit popular preferences and turn them into policy action.

zh: 其次，民主需要约束（restraint）制度，如独立的司法和媒体，以保证言论自由等基本权利并防止政府滥用权力。
en: Second, democracy requires institutions of restraint, such as an independent judiciary and media, to uphold fundamental rights like freedom of speech and prevent governments from abusing their power.

zh: 没有约束的代表 — — 即没有法治精神的选举 — — 只能带来多数人的暴政。
en: Representation without restraint – elections without the rule of law – is a recipe for the tyranny of the majority.

zh: 从这个角度讲，民主 — — 许多人所谓的“自由民主 ” — —只有在工业革命引起民族国家的出现和群众剧变和动员后才可能发生。
en: Democracy in this sense – what many call “liberal democracy” – flourished only after the emergence of the nation-state and the popular upheaval and mobilization produced by the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 因此，许多自由民主的最老牌实践国目前正在经历自由民主的危机并不令人惊奇，这只是民族国家发现自己身处压力中的反映。
en: So it should come as no surprise that the crisis of liberal democracy that many of its oldest practitioners currently are experiencing is a reflection of the stress under which the nation-state finds itself.

zh: 对民族国家的攻击来自上层和下层。
en: The attack on the nation-state comes from above and below.

zh: 经济全球化让国民经济政策工具不再效果显著，也削弱了增强社会包容性的传统转移和再分配机制。
en: Economic globalization has blunted the instruments of national economic policy and weakened the traditional mechanisms of transfers and redistribution that strengthened social inclusion.

zh: 此外，决策者往往以（实际的或想象的）来自全球经济的竞争压力为由为其对群众要求反应不力开脱，并以同样的借口实施不受欢迎的政策（如财政紧缩 ） 。
en: Moreover, policymakers often hide behind (real or imagined) competitive pressures emanating from the global economy to justify their lack of responsiveness to popular demands, and cite the same pressures when implementing unpopular policies such as fiscal austerity.

zh: 一个后果是欧洲极端主义组织的崛起。
en: One consequence has been the rise of extremist groups in Europe.

zh: 与此同时，地区分裂运动 — — 如加泰罗尼亚和苏格兰 — — 渐成气候，寻求独立，挑战民族国家的合法性。
en: At the same time, regional separatist movements such as those in Catalonia and Scotland challenge the legitimacy of nation-states as they are currently configured and seek their breakup.

zh: 不管做得太多还是做得太少，许多国家的国民政��正在面临代表危机。
en: Whether they do too much or too little, many national governments face a crisis of representation.

zh: 在发展中国家，约束制度失灵的情况更加常见。
en: In developing countries, it is more often the institutions of restraint that are failing.

zh: 通过选票箱问鼎权力的政府常常会变得腐败和渴望权力。
en: Governments that come to power through the ballot box often become corrupt and power-hungry.

zh: 它们会复制它们所取代的精英治国制度，抑制言论和公民自由，阉割（或绑架）司法。
en: They replicate the practices of the elitist regimes they replaced, clamping down on the press and civil liberties and emasculating (or capturing) the judiciary.

zh: 结果是所谓的“不自由民主”或“竞争性极权主义 ” 。
en: The result has been called “illiberal democracy” or “competitive authoritarianism.”

zh: 委内瑞拉、土耳其、埃及和突尼斯是比较著名的最近的例子。
en: Venezuela, Turkey, Egypt, and Thailand are some of the better-known recent examples.

zh: 当民主无法从经济上或政治上实现时，或许你就可以看到有人会寻求极权主义了。
en: When democracy fails to deliver economically or politically, perhaps it is to be expected that some people will look for authoritarian solutions.

zh: 对许多经济学家来说，将经济政策权授予技术官僚机构以使其免于“乌合之众”几乎永远是更佳选择。
en: And, for many economists, delegating economic policy to technocratic bodies in order to insulate them from the “folly of the masses” almost always is the preferred approach.

zh: 拥有独立央行和财政规则的欧盟在这条路上已经走得相当远。
en: With its independent central bank and fiscal rules, the European Union has already traveled far along this road.

zh: 在印度，商人对中国羡慕不已，祈愿印度领导人能够像中国领导人那样坚决果断地 — — 即更独裁地 — — 解决印度的改革挑战。
en: In India, businessmen look wistfully at China and wish their leaders could act just as boldly and decisively – that is, more autocratically – to address the country’s reform challenges.

zh: 在埃及和泰国等国家，军事干预被视为结束当选领导人担责不力的必要的权宜措施。
