en: In countries like Egypt and Thailand, military intervention is viewed as a temporary necessity in order to put an end to the irresponsibility of elected leaders.

zh: 这些独裁应对措施说到底是自我毁灭的，因为它们深化了民主的弊端。
en: These autocratic responses are ultimately self-defeating, because they deepen the democratic malaise.

zh: 在欧洲，经济政策需要更多而非更少的民主合法性。
en: In Europe, economic policy needs more democratic legitimacy, not less.

zh: 这可以通过两种方法实现：大大加强欧盟层面的民主审查和问责，或者增加成员国在经济政策方面的自主性。
en: This can be achieved either by significantly strengthening democratic deliberation and accountability at the EU level, or by increasing the autonomy of the member states to set economic policy.

zh: 换句话说，欧洲面临着在更多政治联盟和更少经济联盟间的选择。
en: In other words, Europe faces a choice between more political union and less economic union.

zh: 这一选择拖延得越久，民主受伤就越深。
en: As long as it delays making the choice, democracy will suffer.

zh: 在发展中国家，军方对国家政治的干预破坏了民主的长期前景，因为这阻碍了必要的“文化”的发展，包括互相竞争的公民组织之间的节制和妥协。
en: In developing countries, military intervention in national politics undermines long-term prospects for democracy, because it impedes the development of the necessary “culture,” including habits of moderation and compromise among competing civilian groups.

zh: 只要军方继续充当终极政治仲裁者，公民组织的战略就会一直以军方而不是彼此为核心。
en: As long as the military remains the ultimate political arbiter, these groups focus their strategies on the military rather than one another.

zh: 有效的约束制度不是一夜建成的；当权者或许永远不想建立这一制度。
en: Effective institutions of restraint do not emerge overnight; and it might seem like those in power would never want to create them.

zh: 但如果我有可能被选票赶下台、让反对派上台执政，这样的制度可以保护我在日后免受其他人的折磨，正如制度现在保护他们免受我的折磨一样。
en: But if there is some likelihood that I will be voted out of office and that the opposition will take over, such institutions will protect me from others’ abuses tomorrow as much as they protect others from my abuses today.

zh: 因此，强烈的持续政治竞争预期是不自由民主逐渐转变为自由民主的关键先决条件。
en: So strong prospects for sustained political competition are a key prerequisite for illiberal democracies to turn into liberal ones over time.

zh: 乐观者相信新的治国技术和模式能够解决所有问题，让以民族国家为核心的民主成为明日黄花。
en: Optimists believe that new technologies and modes of governance will resolve all problems and send democracies centered on the nation-state the way of the horse-drawn carriage.

zh: 悲观者担心今天的自由民主无法应对中国和俄罗斯等以蛮横的现实政治为指导原则的不自由国家所造成的外部挑战。
en: Pessimists fear that today’s liberal democracies will be no match for the external challenges mounted by illiberal states like China and Russia, which are guided only by hardnosed realpolitik.

zh: 无论如何，民主想要有未来，就必须反思。
en: Either way, if democracy is to have a future, it will need to be rethought.

zh: 发展中经济体内部增长分化日增
en: The Growing Divide Within Developing Economies

zh: 普林斯顿—麦肯锡全球研究所（MGI）的研究者最近深入挖掘了墨西哥经济表现滞后的细节，并有了重大发现：大企业和小企业之间存在出人意料的巨大的生产率增长差距。
en: PRINCETON – When researchers at the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI) recently dug into the details of Mexico’s lagging economic performance, they made a remarkable discovery: an unexpectedly large gap in productivity growth between large and small firms.

zh: 从1999年到2009年，拥有500人或以让雇员的大企业劳动生产率每年都以引人注目的5.8%的速度增长。
en: From 1999 to 2009, labor productivity had risen by a respectable 5.8% per year in large firms with 500 or more employees.

zh: 相反，在雇员人数十人或一年的企业，劳动生产率以每年6.5%的速度下降。
en: In small firms with ten or fewer employees, by contrast, labor productivity growth had declined at an annual rate of 6.5%.

zh: 此外，这些小企业的就业比例此前便已相当高，在1999—2009年间进一步从39%增至42 % 。
en: Moreover, the share of employment in these small firms, already at a high level, had increased from 39% to 42% over this period.

zh: 巨大的墨西哥湾将这个国家分成“两个墨西哥 ” （ MGI研究者语 ） ， 因此，毫不奇怪墨西哥整体经济表现如此差劲。
en: In view of the huge gulf separating what the authors called the “two Mexicos,” it is no wonder that the economy performed so poorly overall.

zh: 尽管大型现代企业在通过投资于技术和技能而不断改善，但生产率低下的小企业拖累了经济。
en: As rapidly as the large, modern firms improved, through investments in technology and skills, the economy was dragged down by its unproductive small firms.

zh: 这看起来像是例外，但事实上这一现象越来越普遍。
en: This may seem like an anomaly, but it is in fact an increasingly common occurrence.

zh: 放眼发展中世界，你可以看到，经济的领先部门和落后部门之间存在着令人困惑的差距。
en: Look around the developing world, and you will see a bewildering fissure opening up between economies’ leading and lagging sectors.

zh: 新奇之处不在于一些企业和行业比其他企业和行业显著更接近于全球生产率前沿。
en: What is new is not that some firms and industries are substantially closer to the global productivity frontier than others.

zh: 生产率异化 — — 或者用发展经济学家的话说，经济二元性 — — 一直是低收入社会的核心特征之一。
en: Productive heterogeneity – or what development economists used to call economic dualism – has always been a central feature of low-income societies.

zh: 新奇之处 — — 亦是令人痛苦之处 — — 在于发展中经济体的低生产率部门没有在衰落，相反，在许多国家，它们还在扩张。
en: What is new – and distressing – is that developing economies’ low-productivity segments are not shrinking; on the contrary, in many cases, they are expanding.

zh: 通常，当工人和农民从传统的低生产率部门（如农业和琐碎服务部门）向现代工厂工作和服务转移时，就会产生经济发展。
en: Typically, economic development occurs as workers and farmers move from traditional, low-productivity sectors (such as agriculture and petty services) to modern factory work and services.

zh: 随着这一过程的展开，发生了两件事。
en: As this takes place, two things happen.

zh: 首先，经济整体生产率上升，因为更多的劳动力受雇于现代部门。
en: First, the economy’s overall productivity increases, because more of its labor force becomes employed in modern sectors.

zh: 其次，经济中的传统和现代部分之间的生产率差距会减小，二元性会逐渐消失。
en: Second, the productivity gap between the traditional and modern parts of the economy shrinks, and dualism gradually diminishes.

zh: 在这一过程中，农业生产率会上升，因为耕种技术会越变越好并且在地头干农活的农民数量会越变越少。
en: Agricultural productivity increases during this process, owing to better farming techniques and a decline in the number of farmers working the land.

zh: 这就是欧洲外围（西班牙、葡萄牙等国家）战后发展的经典模式。
en: This was the classic pattern of postwar development in the European periphery – countries like Spain and Portugal.

zh: 这也是韩国、中国台湾以及后来的中国（它也是最令人瞩目的例子）赖以产生亚洲增长“奇迹”的机制。
en: It was also the mechanism that generated the Asian growth “miracles” in South Korea, Taiwan, and eventually China (the most phenomenal example of all).

zh: 所有这些高增长阶段都有一个共同特征，即快速的工业化。
en: One thing that all of these high-growth episodes had in common was rapid industrialization.

zh: 现代制造业的扩张甚至可以驱动主要依靠国内市场的国家，如20世纪80年代前的巴西、墨西哥和土耳其。
en: Expansion of modern manufacturing drove growth even in countries that relied mostly on the domestic market, as Brazil, Mexico, and Turkey did until the 1980’s.

zh: 结构变化才是最重要的，而不是国际贸易本身。
en: It was structural change that mattered, not international trade per se.

zh: 如今，情况有了显著不同。
en: Today, the picture is very different.

zh: 即使在表现出色的国家，工业化也在以比以前的赶超增长例子快得多的速度失去动力 — — 我将这一现象称为早夭的工业化（premature deindustrialization ） 。
en: Even in countries that are doing well, industrialization is running out of steam much faster than it did in previous episodes of catch-up growth – a phenomenon that I have called premature deindustrialization.

zh: 尽管年轻人仍在从农村涌向城市，但他们的最终归宿往往不是工厂，而是非正式的低生产率服务岗位。
en: Though young people are still flocking to the cities from the countryside, they end up not in factories but mostly in informal, low-productivity services.

zh: 事实上，结构变化正在日益恶化：从制造业到（尚不成熟的）服务业；从可贸易活动到不可贸易活动；从有组织部门到非正式部门；从现代企业到传统企业；从大中型企业到小型企业。
en: Indeed, structural change has become increasingly perverse: from manufacturing to services (prematurely), tradable to non-tradable activities, organized sectors to informality, modern to traditional firms, and medium-size and large firms to small firms.

zh: 定量研究表明这一结构变化模式严重拖累了拉丁美洲、非洲和许多亚洲国家的经济增长。
en: Quantitative studies show that such patterns of structural change are exerting a substantial drag on economic growth in Latin America, Africa, and in many Asian countries.

zh: 有两种方法可以缩小经济中领先和落后部分之间的差距。
en: There are two ways to close the gap between leading and lagging parts of the economy.

zh: 其一是让小微企业能够成长、进入正式经济并提高生产率，而所有这些都需要消除诸多壁垒。
en: One is to enable small and microenterprises to grow, enter the formal economy, and become more productive, all of which requires removing many barriers.

zh: 比如，经济的非正式和传统部分通常无法获得很好的政府服务和基础设施，并且难以进入全球市场，无法获得融资，工人和管理者也往往技能地下、没有受过良好教育。
en: The informal and traditional parts of the economy are typically not well served by government services and infrastructure, for example, and they are cut off from global markets, have little access to finance, and are filled by workers and managers with low skills and education.

zh: 尽管不少政府花了很大的力气扶持小企业，但成功的例子少之又少。
en: Even though many governments exert considerable effort to empower their small enterprises, successful cases are rare.

zh: 支持小企业通常有助于社会政策目标 — — 维持经济中最贫困和最难找到工作的群体的收入水平，而不能刺激产出和生产率增长。
en: Support for small enterprises often serves social-policy goals – sustaining the incomes of the economy’s poorest and most excluded workers – instead of stimulating output and productivity growth.

zh: 第二个策略是扩大老牌现代企业的机会，让它们能够扩张并雇用非此无从进入经济高生产率部分的工人。
en: The second strategy is to enlarge opportunities for modern, well-established firms so that they can expand and employ the workers that would otherwise end up in less productive parts of the economy.

zh: 这也许是效果更好的办法。
en: This may well be the more effective path.

zh: 研究表明，极少有成功的企业是从非正式小企业起步的；相反，它们开创时便已大多具有相当大的规模，由企业家凭借他的技能和市场知识在经济较先进的部分创办。
en: Studies show that few successful businesses begin as small, informal firms; they are started, instead, at a fairly large scale, by entrepreneurs who pick up their skills and market knowledge in the more advanced parts of the economy.

zh: 伦敦经济学院的约翰·萨顿（John Sutton）在非洲所做的企业调查表明，成立现代本国企业的大多是拥有进口活动经验的企业家。
en: Enterprise surveys in Africa by John Sutton of the London School of Economics indicate that it is often entrepreneurs with experience in importing activities who found modern domestic firms.

zh: 跨国公司或国有企业 — — 高技能工人和管理人员的聚集地 — — 的国内分支也是这类企业的一大发源地。
en: Domestic subsidiaries of multinational firms or state-owned enterprises – which are repositories of skilled workers and managers – are also a source of such firms.

zh: 挑战在于创造一个经济环境，激励本地人才和资本投资于经济的现代、可贸易部分的企业。
en: The challenge is to create an economic environment in which there are incentives for local talent and capital to invest in firms in the modern, tradable parts of the economy.

zh: 有时，取消一些令人窒息的政府管制和限制便已足够。
en: Sometimes, it is enough to remove certain of the more stifling government regulations and restrictions.

zh: 有时政府需要采取更具前瞻性的策略 — — 如税收激励、投资特区或有竞争力的货币 — — 已提高这类投资的盈利能力。
en: At other times, governments need more proactive strategies – such as tax incentives, special investment zones, or hyper-competitive currencies – to raise the profitability of such investments.

zh: 与往常一样，合理政策的细节需视本地约束和机会而定。
en: The details of appropriate policies will depend, as usual, on local constraints and opportunities.

zh: 但每个政府都需要扪心自问，是否做了足够的事支持最有能力吸收经济其他部分劳动力的现代部门的产能扩张。
en: But every government needs to ask itself whether it is doing enough to support the expansion of capacity in the modern sectors that have the greatest potential to absorb workers from the rest of the economy.

zh: 皮凯蒂和时代精神
en: Piketty and the Zeitgeist

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 最近无论我去哪里、见哪些人都会听到同样的问题：你怎么看待托马斯·皮凯蒂？
en: PRINCETON – I get the same question these days wherever I go and from whomever I meet: What do you think of Thomas Piketty?

zh: 这个问题其实包含两层意思：你怎么看待皮凯蒂的著作，你对皮凯蒂现象有何见解？
en: It’s really two questions in one: What do you think of Piketty the book, and what do you think of Piketty the phenomenon?

zh: 回答第一个问题相对容易。
en: The first question is much easier to answer.

zh: 我侥幸成为英文版资本在二十一世纪一书最早的读者。
en: By sheer luck, I was among the earliest readers of the English-language version of Capital in the Twenty-First Century.

zh: 出版皮凯蒂著作的哈佛大学出版社在这部书出版前曾给我寄过校样，希望我能写一份封底简介。
en: Piketty’s publisher, Harvard University Press, had sent me the pre-publication galleys, hoping that I would contribute a blurb for the back cover.

zh: 我很高兴能有此幸运，因为这本书的广度、深度和远大目标都让我啧啧称奇。
en: I did so happily, as I found the scope, depth, and ambition of the book impressive.

zh: 我对皮凯蒂、伊曼纽尔·赛斯、安东尼·阿特金森还有其他人在收入分配领域所进行的实证研究当然非常熟悉。
en: I was of course familiar with Piketty’s empirical work on income distribution, carried out jointly with Emmanuel Saez, Anthony Atkinson, and others.

zh: 这项研究已经在超级富豪收入增长问题上做出了令人吃惊的新发现。
en: This research had already produced startling new findings on the rise of the incomes of the super-rich.

zh: 研究表明许多发达经济体的不平等状况已远非二十世纪初可比。
en: It had shown that inequality in many advanced economies has reached levels not seen since the early part of the twentieth century.

zh: 这部著作本身就称得上是才华横溢。
en: It was a tour de force on its own.

zh: 但这部书又远远超出了实证研究的范畴，娓娓讲述了资本主义制度下关于财富发展耐人寻味的警世故事。
en: But the book goes far beyond the empirical work, and narrates an intriguing cautionary tale about the dynamics of wealth under capitalism.

zh: 皮凯蒂告诫我们不要被二十世纪下半叶发达经济体长达数十年外表光鲜的繁荣稳定的共同经历所蒙蔽。
en: Piketty warns us not to be fooled by the apparent stability and prosperity that was the common experience of the advanced economies during a few decades in the second half of the twentieth century.

zh: 在他的讲述中，其实不平等的破坏性力量可能在资本主义中占据主导地位。
en: In his story, it is the un-equalizing, destabilizing forces that may be dominant within capitalism.

zh: 让资本在二十一世纪值得一读的或许不仅是其观点本身，还有亲眼见证一位伟大的思想家试图解决我们这个时代最重大的问题。
en: Perhaps more than the argument itself, what makes Capital in the Twenty-First Century a great read is the sense of witnessing a superb mind grapple with the big questions of our time.

zh: 皮凯蒂重点诠释了收入分配的政治含义；他在资本主义一般规律和偶然因素两者间微妙的摇摆不定；他所提出的大胆（在不少人看来甚至是不切实际）的弥补资本主义固有缺陷的挽救措施令人耳目一新，因为在此之前很少有经济学家做过这样的尝试。
en: Piketty’s emphasis on the political nature of the distribution of income; his subtle back-and-forth between the general laws of capitalism and the role played by contingency; and his willingness to offer bold (if, to many, impractical) remedies to save capitalism from itself are as refreshing as they are rare for an economist.

zh: 因此虽然我很想说自己预见到了这部书出版后的巨大学术和民意成功，事实情况却并非如此。
en: So I would have liked to claim that I was prescient in foreseeing the huge academic and popular success that the book would have upon publication.

zh: 事实上，这本书引起的反响令我惊讶不已。
en: In truth, the book’s reception has been a big surprise.

zh: 一方面，这本书阅读起来难度很大。
en: For one thing, the book is hardly an easy read.

zh: 整部著作差不多有700页长（包括注释部分在内 ） ， 并且虽然皮凯蒂没有耗费大量时间探讨形式理论，但方程式和希腊字母却仍在整部著作中随处可见。
en: It is almost 700 pages long (including the notes), and, though Piketty does not spend much time on formal theory, he is not beyond sprinkling an occasional equation or Greek letters throughout the text.

zh: 书评家称赞皮凯蒂的引述颇具巴尔扎克和简·奥斯汀的神韵；但实际情况却是除少得可怜的文学比喻外，读者看到最多的还是经济学家干巴巴的论述和统计数据。
en: Reviewers have made much of Piketty’s references to Honoré de Balzac and Jane Austen; yet the fact is that the reader will encounter mainly an economist’s dry prose and statistics, while the literary allusions are few and far between.

zh: 经济学界也并不一致看好这部著作。
en: The economics profession’s response has not been uniformly positive.

zh: 整部书都围绕几个会计恒等式展开，试图量化储蓄、经济增长、资本回报与社会财富分配之间的关系。
en: The book’s argument revolves around a number of accounting identities that relate saving, growth, and the return to capital to the distribution of wealth in a society.

zh: 皮凯蒂非常善于通过追踪历史变化状况而在实际数据和抽象关系之间建立联系。
en: Piketty is very good at bringing these abstract relations to life by hanging real numbers on them and tracing their evolution over history.

zh: 尽管如此，这仍然是众所周知的经济关系。
en: Nevertheless, these are relationships that are well known to economists.

zh: 皮凯蒂在上述会计构架的基础上稍作延伸得出了悲观的结论。
en: Piketty’s pessimistic prognosis rests on a slight extension of this accounting framework.

zh: 如果合理假设成立 — — 即富人能够进行足够的储蓄 — — 那么只要平均资本回报率r高于总体经济增长率g，继承财富与收入（或工资）之比将呈现不断扩大趋势。
en: Under plausible assumptions – namely that the wealthy save enough – the ratio of inherited wealth to income (or wages) continues to increase as long as r, the average rate of return to capital, exceeds g, the growth rate of the economy as a whole.

zh: 皮凯蒂认为除动荡不安的二十世纪上半叶外，这种状况一直是历史常态。
en: Piketty argues that this has been the historical norm, except during the tumultuous first half of the twentieth century.

zh: 如果他对未来的预测成立，我们将面对不平等状况前所未有的糟糕处境。
en: If that is what the future looks like, we are facing a dystopia in which inequality will rise to levels never before experienced.

zh: 但在经济学领域进行推断是非常危险的，并且支撑皮凯蒂观点的数据也很难确定是否真实。
en: Yet extrapolation is dangerous in economics, and the evidence that Piketty adduces to support his argument is hardly conclusive.

zh: 诚如很多人所言，如果经济领域资本相对劳动力和其他资源呈现过剩状况且创新速度开始减缓，那么资本回报率r将很有可能会开始降低。
en: As many have argued, the return to capital, r, may well start to decline if the economy becomes too rich in capital relative to labor and other resources and the rate of innovation slows down.

zh: 或者诚如其他人所言，全球经济可能在新兴和发展中世界的推动下呈现加速回升态势。
en: Alternatively, as others have pointed out, the global economy may pick up speed, buoyed by developments in the emerging and developing world.

zh: 我们要认真对待皮凯蒂的观点，但这种观点还谈不上是铁律。
en: Piketty’s vision needs to be taken seriously, but it is hardly an iron law.

zh: 或许这本书的成功来源于时代精神。
en: Perhaps the source of the book’s success should be sought in the zeitgeist.

zh: 即使全球金融危机刚结束时能够整理出同样的观点和论据，我们也很难相信同样的观点在五到十年前会有今天这样的影响力。
en: It is difficult to believe that it would have had the same impact ten or even five years ago, in the immediate aftermath of the global financial crisis, even though identical arguments and evidence could have been marshaled then.

zh: 很长一段时间以来不平等状况愈演愈烈引发的担忧一直在美国积聚。
en: Unease about growing inequality has been building up for quite some time in the United States.

zh: 虽然经济有所复苏，但中产阶级收入继续呈现停滞或下降态势。
en: Middle-class incomes have continued to stagnate or decline, despite the economy’s recovery.

zh: 现在将不平等归结为美国的核心问题似乎颇有道理。
en: It appears that it is now acceptable to talk about inequality in America as the central issue facing the country.

zh: 这或许能够解释皮凯蒂的著作为什么在美国比他的祖国法国受到更多的重视。
en: This might explain why Piketty’s book has received greater attention in the US than in his native France.

zh: 资本在二十一世纪重新点燃了经济学家对财富及其分配态势的兴趣。 亚当·斯密、大卫·李嘉图和卡尔·马克思等古典经济学家都曾关注同样的话题。
en: Capital in the Twenty-First Century has reignited economists’ interest in the dynamics of wealth and its distribution – a topic that preoccupied classical economists such as Adam Smith, David Ricardo, and Karl Marx.

zh: 这本书已经引起关键经验细节及简单有效分析框架的公众辩论。
en: It has brought to public debate crucial empirical detail and a simple but useful analytical framework.

zh: 无论何种原因，它已经对经济学界和公共话题做出了不可磨灭的贡献。
en: Whatever the reasons for its success, it has already made an undeniable contribution both to the economics profession and to public discourse.

zh: 自在阶级
en: A Class of Its Own

zh: 普林斯顿—菲茨杰拉德（F. Scott Fitzgerald）有一句著名的话，说超级富豪“和你我不一样。
en: PRINCETON – The very rich, F. Scott Fitzgerald famously wrote, “are different from you and me.”

zh: ”他们的财富让他们“在我们相信的时候怀疑 ” ， 让他们认为“他们比我们强 ” 。
en: Their wealth makes them “cynical where we are trustful,” and makes them think “they are better than we are.”

zh: 如果说这番话恰如其分地形容了当下，那么可能是因为，当菲茨杰拉德在1926年写这番话时，美国的不平等性之严重与现今不相上下。
en: If these words ring true today, perhaps it is because when they were written, in 1926, inequality in the United States had reached heights comparable to today.

zh: 在平静期的大部分时间里，即在第二次世界大战结束到20世纪80年代，发达国家的不平等性相当温和。
en: During much of the intervening period, between the end of World War II and the 1980s, inequality in the advanced countries was moderate.

zh: 社会中的超级富豪和其他人之间的差距并不特别大 — — 不仅用收入和财富衡量是如此，用地位和社会目标衡量也是如此。
en: The gap between the super-rich and the rest of society seemed less colossal – not just in terms of income and wealth, but also in terms of attachments and social purpose.

zh: 当然，富人的钱更多，但或多或少仍与穷人同处一个社会，认同地理和公民身份让他们同呼吸共命运。
en: The rich had more money, of course, but they somehow still seemed part of the same society as the poor, recognizing that geography and citizenship made them share a common fate.

zh: 密歇根大学的马克·米兹路奇（Mark Mizruchi）在其新书中指出，美国战后公司精英有“一套社会责任和开明自利的伦理观 ” 。
en: As the University of Michigan’s Mark Mizruchi points out in a recent book, the American corporate elite in the postwar era had “an ethic of civic responsibility and enlightened self-interest.”

zh: 他们与工会合作，支持政府在监管和稳定市场方面的强势角色。
en: They cooperated with trade unions and favored a strong government role in regulating and stabilizing markets.

zh: 他们理解应该为了重要的公共品 — — 如州际高速公里和穷人和老人社会安全网 — — 而纳税。
en: They understood the need for taxes to pay for important public goods such as the interstate highway and safety nets for the poor and elderly.

zh: 当时的商业精英政治权力并不亚于现在。
en: Business elites were not any less politically powerful back then.

zh: 但他们将影响力用于推动与国家利益大体一致的日程。
en: But they used their influence to advance an agenda that was broadly in the national interest.

zh: 相反，用詹姆斯·索罗维基（James Surowiecki）的妙语讲，今天的超级富豪堪称“呻吟大亨 ” 。
en: By contrast, today’s super-rich are “moaning moguls,” to use James Surowiecki’s evocative term.

zh: 索罗维基举出的首屈一指的例子是私募股权公司百仕通集团（Blackstone Group）主席兼首席执行官史蒂芬·施瓦茨曼（Stephen Schwarzman ） ， 他的财富目前超过100亿美元。
en: Exhibit A for Surowiecki is Stephen Schwarzman, the chairman and CEO of the private equity firm the Blackstone Group, whose wealth now exceeds $10 billion.

zh: 施瓦茨曼的表现好像“他饱受凡是都要插手、见税眼开的政府和带着嫉妒聒噪不停的大众的困扰 ” 。
en: Schwarzman acts as if “he’s beset by a meddlesome, tax-happy government and a whiny, envious populace.”

zh: 他建议“���许应该提高穷人的所得税，让他们有‘切肤之痛 ’ ， 还把取消他本人受益其中的利息税漏洞比作德国入侵波兰。
en: He has suggested that “it might be good to raise income taxes on the poor so they had ‘skin in the game,’ and that proposals to repeal the carried-interest tax loophole – from which he personally benefits – were akin to the German invasion of Poland.”

zh: ”另一个索罗维基的例子 ： “ 风险资本家汤姆·珀金斯（Tom Perkins）和家得宝（Home Depot）联合创始人肯尼斯·兰根（Kenneth Langone）都把对富人的民粹主义抨击比作纳粹迫害犹太人。 ”
en: Other examples from Surowiecki: “the venture capitalist Tom Perkins and Kenneth Langone, the co-founder of Home Depot, both compared populist attacks on the wealthy to the Nazis’ attacks on the Jews.”

zh: 索罗维基认为，态度的转变与全球化有很大关系。
en: Surowiecki thinks that the change in attitudes has much to do with globalization.

zh: 美国大公司和银行现在能够自由地在全世界做生意，而不再主要依靠美国消费者。
en: Large American corporations and banks now roam the globe freely, and are no longer so dependent on the US consumer.

zh: 美国中产阶级的健康如今已对他们没有什么关系。
en: The health of the American middle class is of little interest to them these days.

zh: 此外，索罗维基还指出，社会主义已经靠边站，也没有必要在拉拢工作阶级。
en: Moreover, Surowiecki argues, socialism has gone by the wayside, and there is no need to coopt the working class anymore.

zh: 但如果公司大佬认为他们以不再需要依赖国民政府，那就大错特错了。
en: Yet if corporate moguls think that they no longer need to rely on their national governments, they are making a huge mistake.

zh: 现实是，成就了他们的财富的市场的稳定与开放从未如此依赖政府行为。
en: The reality is that the stability and openness of the markets that produce their wealth have never depended more on government action.

zh: 在相对平静的时期，政府制定和支持市场赖以运转的规则的作用可能不那么清晰。
en: In periods of relative calm, governments’ role in writing and upholding the rules by which markets function can become obscured.

zh: 市场会表现出自动巡航模式，政府成为最好敬而远之的不受欢迎者。
en: It may seem as if markets are on autopilot, with governments an inconvenience that is best avoided.

zh: 但当经济风暴来临时，所有人都会向本国政府寻求卵翼。
en: But when economic storm clouds gather on the horizon, everyone seeks shelter under their home government’s cover.

zh: 这时，大公司与其母国的关系就凸显无疑了。
en: It is then that the ties that bind large corporations to their native soil are fully revealed.

zh: 前英格兰银行行长默文·金（Mervyn King）恰当地做过一番金融领域的总结 ： “ 全球银行生是全球的，死是国家的。 ”
en: As former Bank of England Governor Mervyn King aptly put it in the context of finance, “global banks are global in life, but national in death.”

zh: 想想美国政府是如何在2008—2009年全球金融危机期间介入确保金融和经济稳定的。
en: Consider how the US government stepped in to ensure financial and economic stability during the global financial crisis of 2008-2009.

zh: 如果政府不出手援助大银行、保险巨头AIG和汽车业，如果美联储不向经济注入巨量流动性，超级富豪的财富可能遭受重创。
en: If the government had not bailed out large banks, the insurance giant AIG, and the auto industry, and if the Federal Reserve had not flooded the economy with liquidity, the wealth of the super-rich would have taken a severe blow.

zh: 许多人指出政府应该专注于拯救屋主；但政府选择了支持银行 — — 金融精英在这一政策中获益最大。
en: Many argued that the government should have focused on rescuing homeowners; instead, the government chose to support the banks – a policy from which the financial elite benefited the most.

zh: 即使在正常时期，超级富豪也依赖政府支持的行为。
en: Even in normal times, the super-rich depend on government support and action.

zh: 信息技术革命及其所催生的公司（如苹果和微软）的背后是基础研究，而基础研究大部分是政府出资的。
en: It is largely the government that has financed the fundamental research that produced the information-technology revolution and the firms (such as Apple and Microsoft) that it has spawned.

zh: 政府建立并执行版权、专利和商标法，保护知识产权，保证成功的创新者能够获得稳定的垄断利润。
en: It is the government that enacts and enforces the copyright, patent, and trademark laws that protect intellectual property rights, guaranteeing successful innovators a steady stream of monopoly profits.

zh: 政府补贴培训高技能劳动力的高等教育机构。
en: It is the government that subsidizes the higher-education institutions that train the skilled work force.

zh: 政府与其他国家谈判贸易协定以确保本国企业能够进入外国市场。
en: It is the government that negotiates trade agreements with other countries to ensure that domestic firms gain access to foreign markets.

zh: 如果超级富豪认为他们以不再是社会的一部分，不再需要政府，那么这不是因为这一信念符合客观现实。
en: If the super-rich believe that they are no longer part of society and have little need of government, it is not because this belief corresponds to objective reality.

zh: 这是因为现时代的媒体大肆宣传市场是自我产生、自我运转的实体。
en: It is because the prevailing story line of our time portrays markets as self-standing entities that run on their own fuel.

zh: 这一宣传让社会所有层面都蒙受折磨，其中中产阶级所遭遇的打击不亚于富人。
en: This is a narrative that afflicts all segments of society, the middle class no less than the rich.

zh: 没有理由认为超级富豪应该比其他群体少点自私。
en: There is no reason to expect that the super-rich will act less selfishly than any other group.

zh: 但他们的自私并非挡在更平等、社会更包容面前的主要障碍。
en: But it is not so much their self-interest that stands in the way of greater equality and social inclusion.

zh: 更重要的障碍是没有认识到市场不可能长期提供繁荣 — — 不管是为谁 — — 除非它们背后有健康的社会和良好的治理的支持。
en: The more significant roadblock is the missing recognition that markets cannot produce prosperity for long – for anyone – unless they are backed by healthy societies and good governance.

zh: 全球经济的真英雄
en: The Real Heroes of the Global Economy

zh: 普林斯顿—如今，寻找可供模仿的成功模式的经济决策者有大把的选择。
en: PRINCETON – Economic policymakers seeking successful models to emulate apparently have an abundance of choices nowadays.

zh: 以中国的为首的诸多新兴和发展中国家在近几十年来频频创出高增长新纪录，为他人树立了可供追随的先例。
en: Led by China, scores of emerging and developing countries have registered record-high growth rates over recent decades, setting precedents for others to follow.

zh: 尽管发达经济体表现远远不及平均水平，但也有显著的例外，比如德国和瑞典。
en: While advanced economies have performed far worse on average, there are notable exceptions, such as Germany and Sweden.

zh: “向我们这样做 ， ” 这些国家的领导人经常说 ， “ 你也能繁荣。 ”
en: “Do as we do,” these countries’ leaders often say, “and you will prosper, too.”

zh: 但是，更仔细地考察一下你会发现，这些国家引以为傲的增长模式绝非放之四海而皆准，因为它们依赖巨额外部盈余刺激可贸易部门和经济的其他部分。
en: Look more closely, however, and you will discover that these countries’ vaunted growth models cannot possibly be replicated everywhere, because they rely on large external surpluses to stimulate the tradable sector and the rest of the economy.

zh: 在过去十年中，瑞典的经常项目盈余平均可达GDP的7%以上；同期的德国平均可达近6 % 。
en: Sweden’s current-account surplus has averaged above a whopping 7% of GDP over the last decade; Germany’s has averaged close to 6% during the same period.

zh: 中国的巨额外部盈余 — — 2007年超过GDP的10 % — —在最近几年大幅收窄，贸易失衡程度已下降至GDP的约2.5 % 。
en: China’s large external surplus – above 10% of GDP in 2007 – has narrowed significantly in recent years, with the trade imbalance falling to about 2.5% of GDP.

zh: 随着盈余的减少，中国经济的增长率也随之下落 — — 事实上，两者的下降几乎是一比一关系。
en: As the surplus came down, so did the economy’s growth rate – indeed, almost point for point.

zh: 平心而论，比较而言中国的年增长依然很高，超过7 % 。
en: To be sure, China’s annual growth remains comparatively high, at above 7%.

zh: 但这一水平的增长反映了前所未有 — — 也不可持续 — — 的国内投资增加，现已接近GDP的50 % 。
en: But growth at this level reflects an unprecedented – and unsustainable – rise in domestic investment to nearly 50% of GDP.

zh: 当投资回到正常水平时，经济增长也会进一步减速。
en: When investment returns to normal levels, economic growth will slow further.

zh: 显然，并不是所有国家都能同时出现贸易盈余。
en: Obviously, not all countries can run trade surpluses at the same time.

zh: 事实上，成功经济体能有超凡经济表现是因为其他国家没有选择模仿它们。
en: In fact, the successful economies’ superlative growth performance has been enabled by other countries’ choice not to emulate them.

zh: 但你永远不可能从（比如）德国财长朔伊布勒（Wolfgang Schäuble）吹嘘德国美德时听说这一点。
en: But one would never know that from listening, for example, to Germany’s finance minister, Wolfgang Schäuble, extolling his country’s virtues.

zh: “20世纪90年代末 ， [ 德国]是毫无争议的欧洲‘病夫 ’ ， ”朔伊布勒最近写道。
en: “In the late 1990’s, [Germany] was the undisputed ‘sick man’ of Europe,” Schäuble wrote recently.

zh: 他指出，让德国焕然一新的是劳动力市场自由化和约束公共支出。
en: What turned the country around, he claims, was labor-market liberalization and restrained public spending.

zh: 事实上，德国确实实施了一些改革，但其他国家也这么做了，且德国的劳动力市场看上去并不比任何一个其他欧洲经济体更灵活。
en: In fact, while Germany did undertake some reforms, so did others, and its labor market does not look substantially more flexible than what one finds in other European economies.

zh: 但是，一个重大��别是德国外部收支平衡的转变，从20世纪90年代的赤字一变而为近几年巨大的盈余，而这要归功于其欧元区（最近则是全世界）贸易伙伴。
en: A big difference, however, was the turnaround in Germany’s external balance, with annual deficits in the 1990’s swinging to a substantial surplus in recent years, thanks to its trade partners in the eurozone and, more recently, the rest of the world.

zh: 正如《金融时报》的沃尔夫（Martin Wolf）和其他人所指出的，德国经济搭了全球需求的顺风车。
en: As the Financial Times’ Martin Wolf, among others, has pointed out, the German economy has been free-riding on global demand.

zh: 其他国家在不依赖外部盈余的情况下在近几十年取得了快速的经济增长。
en: Other countries have grown rapidly in recent decades without relying on external surpluses.

zh: 但大部分国家染上了正好相反的综合症：过度依赖资本流入，而资本流入通过刺激国内信用和消费产生了暂时的增长。
en: But most have suffered from the opposite syndrome: excessive reliance on capital inflows, which, by spurring domestic credit and consumption, generate temporary growth.

zh: 但外围经济体十分容易受到金融市场情绪和资本突然外逃的影响，最近投资者预期美国将收紧货币政策时的表现就是明证。
en: But recipient economies are vulnerable to financial-market sentiment and sudden capital flight – as happened recently when investors anticipated monetary-policy tightening in the United States.

zh: 就拿印度来说，前不久，它还是又一个著名的成功故事。
en: Consider India, until recently another much-celebrated success story.

zh: 过去十年，印度增长与宽松的宏观经济政策和恶化的经常项目 — — 2012年报告赤字超过GDP的5 % ， 但在21世纪初期是有盈余的 — — 不无关系。
en: India’s growth during the past decade had much to do with loose macroeconomic policies and a deteriorating current account – which recorded a deficit of more than 5% of GDP in 2012, having been in surplus in the early 2000’s.

zh: 土耳其则是另一颗逐渐暗淡的明星，它也依赖于巨大的年度经常项目赤字，其中2011年达到了GDP的10 % 。
en: Turkey, another country whose star has faded, also relied on large annual current-account deficits, reaching 10% of GDP in 2011.

zh: 在其他地区，小型前社会主义经济体 — — 亚美尼亚、白俄罗斯、摩尔多瓦、格鲁吉亚、立陶宛和科索沃 — — 在21世纪最初几年均以很快的速度增长。
en: Elsewhere, small, formerly socialist economies – Armenia, Belarus, Moldova, Georgia, Lithuania, and Kosovo – have grown very rapidly since the early 2000’s.

zh: 但看看它们在2000—2013年间平均经常项目赤字 — — 最低是立陶宛，为GDP的5.5 % ， 最高是科索沃，为GDP的13.4 % — —马上就能发现这些国家不能作为模仿对象。
en: But look at their average current-account deficits from 2000 to 2013 – which range from a low of 5.5% of GDP in Lithuania to a high of 13.4% in Kosovo – and it becomes evident that these are not countries to emulate.

zh: 非洲的情况也类似。
en: The story is similar in Africa.

zh: 这片大陆上增长最快的经济体正是那些在2000—2013年能够忍受巨大外部赤字的经济体 — — 利比里亚平均为GDP的26 % ； 莫桑比克17 % ， 乍得14 % ， 塞拉利昂11 % ， 加纳7 % 。
en: The continent’s fastest-growing economies are those that have been willing and able to allow yawning external gaps from 2000 to 2013: 26% of GDP, on average, in Liberia, 17% in Mozambique, 14% in Chad, 11% in Sierra Leone, and 7% in Ghana.

zh: 卢旺达的经常项目稳步恶化，如今赤字已超过GDP的10 % 。
en: Rwanda’s current account has deteriorated steadily, with the deficit now exceeding 10% of GDP.

zh: 世界经常项目收支最终必须归零。
en: The world’s current-account balances must ultimately sum up to zero.

zh: 在最优世界中，追求贸易拉动型增长的盈余国家应该有追求债务拉动型增长的国家的赤字与之匹配。
en: In an optimal world, the surpluses of countries pursuing export-led growth would be willingly matched by the deficits of those pursuing debt-led growth.

zh: 在现实世界中，不存在可以连续确保这一均衡的机制；国家经济政策可能（也经常）互不相容。
en: In the real world, there is no mechanism to ensure such an equilibrium on a continuous basis; national economic policies can be (and often are) mutually incompatible.

zh: 当一些国家想减少赤字但没有国家想减少盈余时，结果就是输出失业和通缩倾向（现在的情况就是如此 ） 。
en: When some countries want to run smaller deficits without a corresponding desire by others to reduce surpluses, the result is the exportation of unemployment and a bias toward deflation (as is the case now).

zh: 当一些国家向减少盈余但没有国家想减少赤字时，结果就是资本流的突然“断流”和金融危机。
en: When some want to reduce their surpluses without a corresponding desire by others to reduce deficits, the result is a “sudden stop” in capital flows and financial crisis.

zh: 随着外部失衡的加剧，这一循环的每一阶段都会变得更加痛苦。
en: As external imbalances grow larger, each phase of this cycle becomes more painful.

zh: 世界经济的真英雄 — — 其他国家应该效仿的榜样 — — 是做得相对较好且外部失衡较小的国家。
en: The real heroes of the world economy – the role models that others should emulate – are countries that have done relatively well while running only small external imbalances.

zh: 奥地利、加拿大、菲律宾、莱索托和乌拉圭无法与世界增长冠军相媲美，因为它们没有过度借贷来维持重商主义经济模式。
en: Countries like Austria, Canada, the Philippines, Lesotho, and Uruguay cannot match the world’s growth champions, because they do not over-borrow or sustain a mercantilist economic model.

zh: 它们是不起眼的经济体，很少出现在标题中。
en: Theirs are unremarkable economies that do not garner many headlines.

zh: 但没有它们，全球经济将比现在更加难以治理。
en: But without them, the global economy would be even less manageable than it already is.

zh: 对狐狸学者的褒奖
en: In Praise of Foxy Scholars

zh: 发自普林斯顿 — — 我们生活在一个复杂的世界，因此不得不努力将其简化。
en: PRINCETON – We live in a complicated world, so we are forced to simplify it.

zh: 我们把周围的人归类为朋友或敌人，将他们的动机分成善意或恶意，并将拥有复杂根源的事件归咎于直接的原因。
en: We categorize people around us as friends or foes, classify their motives as good or bad, and ascribe events with complex roots to straightforward causes.

zh: 这些捷径帮助我们游弋于自身社会存在的复杂性之中,协助我们对自己和他人的行为后果进行预测，从而促进决策。
en: Such shortcuts help us navigate the complexities of our social existence. They help us form expectations about the consequences of our and others’ actions, and thereby facilitate decision-making.

zh: 但由于这种“思维模型”是一种简化，它们必然会出错。
en: But, because such “mental models” are simplifications, they are necessarily wrong.

zh: 它们可能有助于我们迎接日常的挑战，但它们遗漏了很多细节，当我们发现自己处于一个经验分类和已有解释都不太适合的环境中时就会适得其反。
en: They may serve us well as we navigate our daily challenges, but they leave out many details and can backfire when we find ourselves in an environment in which our categorizations and ready-made explanations fit less well.

zh: “文化冲击”这个词指的就是我们对他人行为的期望与实际是如此南辕北辙，以致感觉被这种体验所颠覆了。
en: The term “culture shock” refers to situations in which our expectations about people’s behavior turn out to be so wrong that we find ourselves jolted by the experience.

zh: 然而，没有这些捷径，我们将会迷失或者瘫痪。
en: And yet, without these shortcuts we would be either lost or paralyzed.

zh: 我们既缺乏心智能力也没有足够的知识去破译社会存在中因果关系的完整网络。
en: We have neither the mental capacity nor the understanding to decipher the full web of cause-and-effect relations in our social existence.

zh: 所以我们的日常行为和反应必须基于不完整的，偶尔误导性的思维模型。
en: So our daily behavior and reactions must be based on incomplete, and occasionally misleading, mental models.

zh: 社会科学所能提供的最好东西实际上也没多大差别。
en: The best that social science has to offer is in fact not much different.

zh: 社会科学家 — — 特别是经济学家 — — 使用简单的概念框架 — — 他们口中的“模型 ” — —来分析世界。
en: Social scientists – and economists in particular – analyze the world using simple conceptual frameworks that they call “models.”

zh: 这种模型的优点在于能展现出清晰的因果链条，从而使一个特定的预测可以明确构建于一个特定的假设之上 、 。
en: The virtue of such models is that they make explicit the chain of cause and effect, and therefore render transparent the specific assumptions on which a particular prediction rests.

zh: 好的社会可以会把我们未经检验的知觉转化成一个满是各方向箭头的地图。
en: Good social science turns our unexamined intuitions into a map of causal arrows.

zh: 有时它会展示出当那些直觉延伸到其逻辑结论时是如何产生出一些令人吃惊的意外结果。
en: Sometimes it shows how those intuitions lead to surprising, unanticipated results when extended to their logical conclusions.

zh: 全面通用型框架，比如经济学家喜欢使用的阿罗-德布鲁一般均衡模型，是如此宏观而包罗万象，以致根本无法用于任何现实世界的解释或者预测。
en: Fully general frameworks, such as economists’ beloved Arrow-Debreu model of general equilibrium, are so broad and encompassing that they are totally unhelpful for real-world explanation or prediction.

zh: 有用的社会科学模型都是不含变量的简化。
en: Useful social-science models are invariably simplifications.

zh: 它们舍弃了许多细节去聚焦在某一特定背景下最为关联的方面，而应用经济学家的数学模型就是体现这一点的最精确例子。
en: They leave out many details to focus on the most relevant aspect of a specific context. Applied economists’ mathematical models are the most explicit example of this.

zh: 但不管是否以固定模式存在，社会科学家就是靠把某项事件不断简化来谋生的。
en: But, whether formalized or not, simplified narratives are social scientists’ bread and butter.

zh: 程式化的历史类比往往也是如此。
en: Stylized historical analogies often play a similar role.

zh: 比如国际关系学者就用1938年英国首相张伯伦和希特勒在慕尼黑的会议作为一个模型来解释对一个扩张主义政权使用绥靖政策可能会是无效（或危险）的。
en: For example, international-relations scholars use the famous meeting between Neville Chamberlain and Adolf Hitler in Munich in 1938 as a model of how appeasing a power bent on expansionism can be futile (or dangerous).

zh: 但虽然简化对于解释一项事务来说必不可少，但它也可能会是一个陷阱。
en: But, as inevitable as simplification is for explanation, it is also a trap.

zh: 你很可能会固守一个模型却未能意识到变化了的情境需要另一个不同的模型。
en: It is easy to get wedded to particular models and fail to recognize that changed circumstances require a different model.

zh: 正如其他人一样，社会科学家倾向于过度信任他们偏爱的模型。
en: Like other humans, social scientists are prone to over-confidence in their preferred model of the day.

zh: 他们往往会夸大那些证明该模型的因素同时贬低那些与模型相抵触的新证据 — — 这种现象叫做“证实性偏见 ” 。
en: They tend to exaggerate the support for the model and discount new evidence that contradicts it – a phenomenon known as “confirmation bias.”

zh: 在这个存在多种变化情况的世界上，如果社会科学家使用了错误的模型可能会产生严重的后果。
en: In a world of diverse and changing circumstances, social scientists can do real harm by applying the wrong model.

zh: 基于完善市场的新自由主义经济政策在发展中国家就碰了钉子 — — 正如从前让那些假定称职有能力的官员去制订计划模型那样。
en: Neoliberal economic policies, predicated on well-functioning markets, misfired in developing countries – just as planning models, presuming competent and capable bureaucrats, failed in an earlier era. The efficient-markets theory led policymakers astray by encouraging them to undertake excessive financial deregulation.

zh: 而有效市场市场理论鼓励政策制定者���去实施过度的放松管制，最终导致他们误入歧途。
en: It would be costly to apply the analogy of Munich in 1938 to a specific international conflict when the underlying situation is more reminiscent of Sarajevo in 1914.

zh: 那么我们应该如何在简化和现实这两者之间做出选择？
en: So how should we choose among alternative simplifications of reality?

zh: 严谨的实证测试可能最终能解答当今美国经济最大的问题究竟是凯恩斯式的需求不足还是政策的不确定性。
en: Rigorous empirical tests may eventually settle questions such as whether the US economy today is suffering more from Keynesian lack of demand or from policy uncertainty.

zh: 但我们经常要在缺乏决定性实证依据的情况下实时做出决策。
en: Yet often we need to make decisions in real time, without the benefit of decisive empirical evidence.

zh: 笔者（连同里卡多·豪斯曼，安德烈斯·瓦拉斯科以及其他研究者）针对增长状况诊断方式的研究就是这类工作的例子，展现出如何在一个特定背景下从多个增长制约性因素中筛选出其中较为相关的。
en: My research on growth diagnostics (with Ricardo Hausmann, Andrés Velasco, and others) is an example of this style of work, showing how one can identify in a specific context the more binding among a multitude of growth constraints.

zh: 不幸的是，经济学家和其他社会科学家实际上没有受过如何在不同模型中做出选择的训练，也没有同行会赞赏他们在这方面的能力。
en: Unfortunately, economists and other social scientists get virtually no training in how to choose among alternative models. Neither is such an aptitude professionally rewarded.

zh: 创建一个新理论和实证测试被认为是科学，而一个好的判断力显然属于一门艺术。
en: Developing new theories and empirical tests is regarded as science, while the exercise of good judgment is clearly a craft.

zh: 哲学家以赛亚•柏林（Isaiah Berlin）的著名理论是对两种思维方式进行区分，并比喻为刺猬和狐狸。
en: The philosopher Isaiah Berlin famously distinguished between two styles of thinking, which he identified with the hedgehog and the fox.

zh: 刺猬会沉迷于一个宏大的想法，并坚持不懈。
en: The hedgehog is captivated by a single big idea, which he applies unremittingly.

zh: 狐狸则相反，它缺乏一个宏大的视野，对世界拥有许多不同的看法 — — 其中一些看法甚至是自相矛盾的。
en: The fox, by contrast, lacks a grand vision and holds many different views about the world – some of them even contradictory.

zh: 我们总是可以预见到刺猬会遇到的问题 — — 正如我们可以预测，市场原教旨主义者总是要求更自由的市场，而不顾经济问题的本质。
en: We can always anticipate the hedgehog’s take on a problem – just as we can predict that market fundamentalists will always prescribe freer markets, regardless of the nature of the economic problem.

zh: 狐狸的脑袋里可能会有互不相容的理论在进行竞争。
en: Foxes carry competing, possibly incompatible theories in their heads.

zh: 它们并未依附于到特定的思想，也乐于依据不同的情境来进行思考。
en: They are not attached to a particular ideology and find it easier to think contextually.

zh: 那些能够依据情境需要从一个解释框架过渡到另一个的学者更能为我们指出正确的方向。
en: Scholars who are able to navigate from one explanatory framework to another as circumstances require are more likely to point us in the right direction.

zh: 由此可见，世界需要更少的刺猬，和更多的狐狸。
en: The world needs fewer hedgehogs and more foxes.

zh: 死于金融
en: Death by Finance

zh: 普林斯顿—新兴市场的运势在迅速改变。
en: PRINCETON – How quickly emerging markets’ fortunes have turned.

zh: 不久前，它们还被称为世界经济的救世主 — — 在美国和欧洲等经济体熄火时取而代之成为充满活力的增长引擎。
en: Not long ago, they were touted as the salvation of the world economy – the dynamic engines of growth that would take over as the economies of the United States and Europe sputtered.

zh: 花旗集团、麦肯锡公司、普华永道和其他机构的经济学家纷纷预言从亚洲到非洲都将迎来广泛而持续的增长时代。
en: Economists at Citigroup, McKinsey, PricewaterhouseCoopers, and elsewhere were predicting an era of broad and sustained growth from Asia to Africa.

zh: 但如今，人们对新兴市场再次陷入了一片悲观。
en: But now the emerging-market blues are back.

zh: 美联储收紧货币政策的动作才刚刚开始，新兴市场货币便颓势尽露；放眼望去，人们看到的都是深层次的问题。
en: The beating that these countries’ currencies have taken as the US Federal Reserve begins to tighten monetary policy is just the start; everywhere one looks, it seems, there are deep-seated problems.

zh: 阿根廷和委内瑞拉的不同寻常政策路已经走到了尽头。
en: Argentina and Venezuela have run out of heterodox policy tricks.

zh: 巴西和印度需要新的增长模式。
en: Brazil and India need new growth models.

zh: 土耳其和泰国受制于反映长期发酵的国内冲突的政治危机。
en: Turkey and Thailand are mired in political crises that reflect long-simmering domestic conflicts.

zh: 在非洲，人们开始担心结构性变革和工业化的不足。
en: In Africa, concern is mounting about the lack of structural change and industrialization.

zh: 而中国面临的主要问题是其经济减速会带来软着陆还是硬着陆。
en: And the main question concerning China is whether its economic slowdown will take the form of a soft or hard landing.

zh: 这不是发展中国家第一次因为猛然间的全球金融市场情绪波动而遭受重创。
en: This is not the first time that developing countries have been hit hard by abrupt mood swings in global financial markets.

zh: 令人惊奇之处是我们居然对此感到很惊奇。
en: The surprise is that we are surprised.

zh: 特别是经济学家，他们应该早就学到了一些根本教训。
en: Economists, in particular, should have learned a few fundamental lessons long ago.

zh: 首先，新兴市场兴奋不过尔尔。
en: First, emerging-market hype is just that.

zh: 经济奇迹是罕见的，其发生必非无因。
en: Economic miracles rarely occur, and for good reason.

zh: 政府能够大规模干预实现经济的重组和多样化、同时又能防止国家沦为腐败和寻租的温床的情形只是例外。
en: Governments that can intervene massively to restructure and diversify the economy, while preventing the state from becoming a mechanism of corruption and rent-seeking, are the exception.

zh: 中国和（如日中天时期的）韩国、中国台湾、日本和其他少数国家或地区有过这样的政府；但这些政府所推动的快速工业化与大部分拉丁美洲、中东、非洲和南亚国家无缘。
en: China and (in their heyday) South Korea, Taiwan, Japan, and a few others had such governments; but the rapid industrialization that they engineered has eluded most of Latin America, the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia.

zh: 相反，过去二十年来，新兴市场的增长来自一系列（临时性的）外部环境巧合：大宗商品价格高企、低利率以及看似无穷无尽的外国融资。
en: Instead, emerging markets’ growth over the last two decades was based on a fortuitous (and temporary) set of external circumstances: high commodity prices, low interest rates, and seemingly endless buckets of foreign finance.

zh: 改善的宏观经济政策和总体治理水平也有所助益，但这些只是增长的助推器，而不是发动机。
en: Improved macroeconomic policy and overall governance helped, too, but these are growth enablers, not growth triggers.

zh: 其次，金融全球化被过度吹捧。
en: Second, financial globalization has been greatly oversold.

zh: 对资本流开��被认为能够刺激国内投资、降低宏观经济波动性。
en: Openness to capital flows was supposed to boost domestic investment and reduce macroeconomic volatility.

zh: 但实际上可谓正好相反。
en: Instead, it has accomplished pretty much the opposite.

zh: 我们早已知道，投资组合和短期流入助长了消费繁荣和房地产泡沫，而当市场情绪发生了难以避免的回落并且融资开始枯竭时，灾难性后果就随之而来。
en: We have long known that portfolio and short-term inflows fuel consumption booms and real-estate bubbles, with disastrous consequences when market sentiment inevitably sours and finance dries up.

zh: 因经济越爬越高而踌躇满志的政府本不应该对随之而来的难免的摔个鼻青脸肿感到惊奇。
en: Governments that enjoyed the rollercoaster ride on the way up should not have been surprised by the plunge that inevitably follows.

zh: 其次，浮动汇率是有缺陷的冲击吸收器。
en: Third, floating exchange rates are flawed shock absorbers.

zh: 理论上，市场决定的货币价值应该能够让国内经济免于国际金融波动的影响，在货币流入时升值，在货币流出时贬值。
en: In theory, market-determined currency values are supposed to isolate the domestic economy from the vagaries of international finance, rising when money floods in and falling when the flows are reversed.

zh: 但在现实中，极少数国家可以在不付出代价的情况下得到这一货币盟友。
en: In reality, few economies can bear the requisite currency alignments without pain.

zh: 急剧的货币升值会抹杀一国的国际竞争力。
en: Sharp currency revaluations wreak havoc on a country’s international competitiveness.

zh: 而快速贬值则是央行的噩梦，因为这会造成通胀性后果。
en: And rapid depreciations are a central bank’s nightmare, given the inflationary consequences.

zh: 浮动汇率能够降低调整难度，但无法消除它们。
en: Floating exchange rates may moderate the adjustment difficulties, but they do not eliminate them.

zh: 第四，对全球经济政策协作的信念是错误的。
en: Fourth, faith in global economic-policy coordination is misplaced.

zh: 比如，美国的财政和货币政策永远是首先（如果不是完全的话）根据国内考虑决定的。
en: America’s fiscal and monetary policies, for example, will always be driven by domestic considerations first (if not second and third as well).

zh: 欧洲国家连它们自身的共同利益到照顾不好，更不用说全世界的利益了。
en: And European countries can barely look after their own common interests, let alone the world’s.

zh: 新兴市场政府期望主要金融中心调整政策以应对其他地区的经济环境变化不啻于缘木求鱼。
en: It is naïve for emerging-market governments to expect major financial centers to adjust their policies in response to economic conditions elsewhere.

zh: 在大部分情形中，这并非坏事。
en: For the most part, that is not a bad thing.

zh: 美联储每月都要购买巨量长期资产 — — 这就是所谓的量化宽松（QE ） — —提振了美国的需求和经济活动，也令整体世界经济受益。
en: The Fed’s huge monthly purchases of long-term assets – so-called quantitative easing – have benefited the world as a whole by propping up demand and economic activity in the US.

zh: 没有QE — — 美联储目前正在逐渐结束它 — — 世界贸易将遭受大得多的冲击。
en: Without QE, which the Fed is now gradually tapering, world trade would have taken a much bigger hit.

zh: 类似地，当欧洲能够制定出正确的政策并振兴经济时，世界也会受益。
en: Similarly, the rest of the world will benefit when Europeans are able to get their policies right and boost their economies.

zh: 其他部分则由发展中世界官员决定。
en: The rest is in the hands of officials in the developing world.

zh: 他们必须抵制在外国融资价廉量足时期的诱惑。
en: They must resist the temptation to binge on foreign finance when it is cheap and plentiful.

zh: 在外国资本大量流入的情况下，对可贸易商品的私人投资水平停滞不前是一个非常有力的危险信号，任政府说的如何天花乱坠都不能忽视。
en: In the midst of a foreign-capital bonanza, stagnant levels of private investment in tradable goods are a particularly powerful danger signal that no amount of government mythmaking should be allowed to override.

zh: 官员面临一个简单的选择：保持对资本流的强大的审慎控制，或者准备将一大部分资源用於积累巨额外汇储备作为自我保险。
en: Officials face a simple choice: maintain strong prudential controls on capital flows, or be prepared to invest a large share of resources in self-insurance by accumulating large foreign reserves.

zh: 更深层次的问题在于20世纪90年代以来的全球经济过度金融化。
en: The deeper problem lies with the excessive financialization of the global economy that has occurred since the 1990’s.

zh: 由此造成的政策困境 — — 不平等性加剧、波动增加、管理实体经济的空间被挤压 — — 将在未来几十年中一直成为决策者的难题。
en: The policy dilemmas that have resulted – rising inequality, greater volatility, reduced room to manage the real economy – will continue to preoccupy policymakers in the decades ahead.

zh: 说让政府鲁莽地加入这场狂欢的唯一罪魁是政府本身，这固然正确，但无济于事。
en: It is true, but unhelpful, to say that governments have only themselves to blame for having recklessly rushed into this wild ride.

zh: 现在应该想想世界如何能够在金融和实体经济之间建立更加正常的平衡。
en: It is now time to think about how the world can create a saner balance between finance and the real economy.

zh: 埃尔多安的自作孽
en: Erdoğan’s Self-Inflicted Crisis

zh: 普林斯顿—土耳其执政党正义和发展党（AKP）与其昔日盟友、自愿流亡的传教士法土拉·葛兰（Fethullah Gülen）领导的“服务 ” （ Hizmet）宗教运动之间的恶斗已开始暴露出大量违反被双方用来巩固权力的法治精神的行动。
en: PRINCETON – The dramatic battle between Turkey’s ruling Justice and Development Party (AKP) and its erstwhile ally, the “Hizmet” religious movement led by the self-exiled cleric Fethullah Gülen, has begun to expose the massive rule-of-law violations that these two groups employed to consolidate their power.

zh: 被广泛视为葛兰同情者的检察部门发动了一场波及面极大的反腐调查，到目前为止已有四名部长被捕，并剑指总理埃尔多安之子。
en: Prosecutors widely thought to be Gülen sympathizers have launched a wide-ranging corruption probe that has so far ensnared four ministers and reaches all the way to Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s son.

zh: 埃尔多安和他的顾问已开始反击。
en: Erdoğan and his advisers have now hit back.

zh: 他们指责葛兰主义者实施“官僚政变 ” ， 并参与了一系列肮脏勾当，包括“罗织证据”以密谋推翻埃尔多安政府的罪名栽赃多名将军和“大规模非法监听 ” 。
en: They accuse the Gülenists of mounting a “bureaucratic coup” and engaging in a wide range of dirty tricks, from “planting evidence” against generals who were convicted last year of plotting to overthrow Erdoğan’s government to “extensive unauthorized wiretap[ping].”

zh: 土耳其对军事政变策划者的里程碑式的审判如今被广泛认为是冤假错案 — — 是基于脆弱甚至完全捏造的证据的政治迫害。
en: Turkey’s landmark trials of the alleged military-coup plotters are now widely recognized for what they were – witch hunts based on evidence that was flimsy at best, and often simply concocted.

zh: 这场审判由葛兰主义警察、检察官和媒体炮制。
en: The trials were stage-managed by Gülenist police, prosecutors, and media.

zh: 但他们背后是来自埃尔多安政府的重要支持。
en: But they had crucial support from Erdoğan’s government, which put its weight behind them.

zh: 埃尔多安阵营目前急切地要从这些审判中脱身，把所有责任都推给葛兰主义者不可不谓狡猾。
en: The Erdoğan camp’s current effort to wash its hands of these trials and put the full blame on the Gülenists is disingenuous to say the least.

zh: 埃尔多安曾经宣布，他是“埃尔盖内孔 ” （ Ergenekon）案的起诉者，该案原本的目标是揭发和批斗由军官和世俗民族主义者组成的土耳其“黑暗势力 ” ， 但实际上针对的是大量政治反对派。
en: Erdoğan once famously declared that he was the prosecutor on the “Ergenekon” case, which was supposedly aimed at exposing and combating the Turkish “deep state” composed of military officials and secular nationalists, but that targeted a wide range of political opponents.

zh: 当关于将军们子虚乌有的“大锤 ” （ Sledgehammer）政变图谋的骇人听闻 — — 但完全是拼凑而成 — — 的档案公之于众时，埃尔多安声称自己早就掌握了这些政变，以此为证据背书。
en: When the horrifying – but entirely fabricated – documents behind the generals’ fictitious “Sledgehammer” coup plot came out, Erdoğan lent credence to them by saying that he had been aware of such plots.

zh: 他的部长们攻击被告，并抨击唯一一名做出有利预审裁决的法官。
en: His ministers attacked the defendants and pilloried the lone judge who issued a pre-trial ruling in their favor.

zh: 除了这些公开资料，埃尔多安政府利用了一切权力确保这些和其他政治审判（包括针对库尔德人活跃分子的涉及几百人的大案）能以他们预定的结果结案。
en: Beyond such public statements, the Erdoğan government did everything in its power to ensure that these and other political trials (including a massive one involving hundreds of Kurdish activists) would proceed to their preordained conclusion.

zh: 特别是，司法部门高层被葛兰主��者或准备纳投名状加入葛兰阵营的法官把持着。
en: In particular, the higher echelons of the judiciary were filled with judges who were either Gülenists or ready to do their bidding.

zh: 关于赤裸裸地破坏法治精神的投诉不绝于耳，但他们充耳不闻。
en: Endless complaints about flagrant violations of the rule of law fell on deaf ears.

zh: 如今，埃尔多安及其顾问口风大变。
en: Erdoğan and his advisers sound very different these days.

zh: 新说辞是这些审判受到了非法行为的阻滞，存在针对军方的阴谋，葛兰主义者建立了国中之国。
en: The new line is that these trials were marred by irregularities, that there had been a plot against the military, and that the Gülenists have established a state within the state.

zh: 如此转变，原因很清楚：埃尔多安需要孤立和抹黑葛兰主义者，目前他正在与葛兰主义者进行艰苦的权力斗争。
en: The reason for the conversion is clear: Erdoğan needs to isolate and embarrass the Gülenists, with whom he is now engaged in a bitter struggle for power.

zh: 葛兰主义者以反腐调查为幌子开展反埃尔多安运动。
en: The Gülenists have dressed up their campaign against Erdoğan in the guise of a corruption probe.

zh: 对于熟悉土耳其的人来说，决不会吃惊于建筑工程存在大规模腐败现象。
en: No one who is familiar with Turkey would be surprised to learn that there was large-scale corruption surrounding construction projects.

zh: 但腐败调查背后显然有政治动机，埃尔多安也正确地质疑了检察官动机不纯。
en: But the corruption probe is clearly politically motivated, and Erdoğan is right to question the prosecutors’ motives.

zh: 当前根除腐败的司法活跃正如此前针对“黑暗势力”和真正的政变的起诉风潮，是醉翁之意不在酒。
en: The current round of judicial activism is as much about rooting out corruption as previous rounds were about prosecuting the “deep state” and real coups – which is to say, not much at all.

zh: 但是埃尔多安当初为葛兰运动的行为开了绿灯。
en: But Erdoğan is the one who gave a free pass to the Gülen movement in the first place.

zh: 三年多前，在2010年8月的修宪全民公决后，埃尔多安有一次黄金机会。
en: More than three years ago, Erdoğan had a golden opportunity in the aftermath of the August 2010 constitutional referendum.

zh: 他的大获全胜保证了他大权在握，不需要担心军方和其他极端世俗主义的旧卫道士。
en: His handy win confirmed that he was securely in power and had little to fear from the military and other elements of the ultra-secularist old guard.

zh: 他可以宣布与助他掌权的司法肮脏勾当和媒体操纵决裂。
en: He could have renounced the judicial dirty tricks and media manipulation that had enabled his regime to take hold.

zh: 当时，我写道，如果他不改变现状 ， “ 土耳其将朝着集权主义越滑越深，政治分歧将变得不可调和，新的政治决裂可能将不可避免。
en: At the time, I wrote that if he did not change course, “the country will descend deeper into authoritarianism, political divisions will become irreconcilable, and yet another political rupture may become inevitable.”

zh: ”呜呼，这一预言如今终于实现了。
en: Alas, that prediction has now been fulfilled.

zh: 如今，埃尔多安已无多少好选择，但仍能扭转局势。
en: Today, Erdoğan has fewer good options, but he could still turn the situation around.

zh: 葛兰主义者在司法界和官僚集团的其他部分的阴谋已经造就了为数甚众的反对派；几乎所有人 — — 民主主义者、库尔德人活跃分子、世俗主义者、传统伊斯兰教徒、社会主义者和自由派 — — 都成为过这一阴谋的拉拢对象。
en: Gülenist machinations in the judiciary and other parts of the bureaucracy have created a broad spectrum of opposition; pretty much everyone – nationalists, Kurdish activists, secularists, traditional Islamists, socialists, and liberals – has been at the receiving end of these intrigues at one time or another.

zh: 理论上，埃尔多安可以动员超越AKP范畴的联盟以支持旨在让司法系统回归正常角色的改革。
en: Erdoğan could, in principle, mobilize a coalition that transcends his own AKP to support reforms aimed at returning the judiciary to its proper role.

zh: 当然，这些集团都不会介意目睹埃尔多安的下台；因此要让这些集团加入联盟就必须给予好处。
en: Of course, none of these groups would mind watching Erdoğan go down in flames; so all of them would want something in return for joining such a coalition.

zh: 这些让步是埃尔多安必须付出的代价，也是领导土耳其走出当前乱象所必须付出的代价。
en: Those concessions would be the necessary price for Erdoğan to pay – and just desserts for leading Turkey into its present mess.

zh: 但至少他将可以拥有改写后世史书对其领导力的评价的机会。
en: But at least he would have the chance to ameliorate the harsh judgment that historians will pass on his leadership.

zh: 不幸的是，埃尔多安似乎打算连这次机会都要错过。
en: Unfortunately, Erdoğan seems intent on missing this opportunity as well.

zh: 他选择了以收紧其独裁统治为应对手段，任命检察官和法官的机构将成为司法部的附属物。
en: He has chosen to respond by tightening his autocratic grip, with the body that appoints prosecutors and judges set to become a mere appendage of the justice ministry.

zh: 他的支持者发动了针对葛兰主义者的抹黑运动 — — 和葛兰主义者如出一辙。
en: His supporters have been launching smear campaigns against Gülenists that are reminiscent of Gülenist tactics.

zh: 他似乎认为他可以赢得足够的支持在不扩大联盟的情况下走出危机。
en: He seems to believe that he can retain enough popularity to ride out the crisis without expanding his coalition.

zh: 埃尔多安和葛兰运动之间的斗争已经升级到难以调和的程度了。
en: The battle between Erdoğan and the Gülen movement has escalated to the point where it is hard to imagine a reconciliation.

zh: 好消息是全力以赴的斗争将让埃尔多安政权赖以建立的腐败和司法操纵暴露无遗。
en: The good news is that this tooth-and-nail fight is laying bare the corruption and judicial manipulation on which Erdoğan’s regime was based.

zh: 坏消息是不管谁赢，输家都将是土耳其民主 — — 至少在短期、真正的民主力量形成之前是如此。
en: The bad news is that regardless of who wins, Turkish democracy will be the loser – at least in the short run, until truly democratic forces emerge.

zh: 富人如何统治
en: How the Rich Rule

zh: 普林斯顿—富人比穷人拥有更大的政治权力，这不是新闻，即使在一人一票选举的民主国家也是如此。
en: PRINCETON – It is hardly news that the rich have more political power than the poor, even in democratic countries where everyone gets a single vote in elections.

zh: 但两位政治学家 — — 普林斯顿大学的马丁·吉伦斯（Martin Gilens）和西北大学的本杰明·佩奇（Benjamin Page）最近发现了关于美国的一些冷酷的结论，他们的发现对于美国和其他国家的民主的运作具有重要影响。
en: But two political scientists, Martin Gilens of Princeton University and Benjamin Page of Northwestern University, have recently produced some stark findings for the United States that have dramatic implications for the functioning of democracy – in the US and elsewhere.

zh: 两位作者的研究基于吉伦斯之前的工作的基础上。 吉伦斯费尽心思收集了从1981年到2002年间近2,000个政策问题的民意调查。
en: The authors’ research builds on prior work by Gilens, who painstakingly collected public-opinion polls on nearly 2,000 policy questions from 1981 to 2002.

zh: 接着，两人考察了美国联邦政府是否在调查后四年内采取了被调查政策，并追踪了结果与位于收入分配不同区位的选民的偏好的匹配程度。
en: The pair then examined whether America’s federal government adopted the policy in question within four years of the survey, and tracked how closely the outcome matched the preferences of voters at different points of the income distribution.

zh: 单独看来 ， “ 普通”选民 — — 即位于收入分配中端的选民，他的偏好对政府最终反应具有强大的积极影响力。
en: When viewed in isolation, the preferences of the “average” voter – that is, a voter in the middle of the income distribution – seem to have a strongly positive influence on the government’s ultimate response.

zh: 普通选民所喜欢的政策具有极大的可能成为现实。
en: A policy that the average voter would like is significantly more likely to be enacted.

zh: 但是，吉伦斯和佩奇指出，这会形成一个关于政府决定代表性的错误的乐观印象。
en: But, as Gilens and Page note, this gives a misleadingly upbeat impression of the representativeness of government decisions.

zh: 普通选民和经济精英的偏好在大部分政策事务上并无重大差异。
en: The preferences of the average voter and of economic elites are not very different on most policy matters.

zh: 比如，两个群体的选民都希望看到强大的国防和健康的经济。
en: For example, both groups of voters would like to see a strong national defense and a healthy economy.

zh: 更好的检验政府做了什么的办法是考察这两组人群观点相左时的情形。
en: A better test would be to examine what the government does when the two groups have divergent views.

zh: 在检验中，吉伦斯和佩奇比较了普通选民和经济精英（定义为收入分配最顶端10%的人群）的偏好，研究哪类选民施加的影响更大。
en: To carry out that test, Gilens and Page ran a horse race between the preferences of average voters and those of economic elites – defined as individuals at the top tenth percentile of the income distribution – to see which voters exert greater influence.

zh: 他们发现，普通选民的影响力下降到次要地位，而经济精英仍具有很大影响力。
en: They found that the effect of the average voter drops to insignificant levels, while that of economic elites remains substantial.

zh: 含义很明显：当精英的利益与社会其他阶层相左时，他们的观点最重要 — — 几乎可以无视其他阶层的看法。
en: The implication is clear: when the elites’ interests differ from those of the rest of society, it is their views that count – almost exclusively.

zh: （吉伦斯和佩奇解释说，我们应该将顶层10%的人的偏好作为真正的富人的观点的指标。 真正的富人是最顶尖的1 % ， 他们是精英中的精英。
en: (As Gilens and Page explain, we should think of the preferences of the top 10% as a proxy for the views of the truly wealthy, say, the top 1% – the genuine elite.)

zh: 对于有组织利益集团，吉伦斯和佩奇的结论也是如此。 有组织利益集团对政策形成具有强大影响力。
en: Gilens and Page report similar results for organized interest groups, which wield a powerful influence on policy formation.

zh: 他们指出，如果将利益集团联盟和美国丰裕阶层的偏好考虑进来，则“普罗大众想什么基本上没有什么区别 ” 。
en: As they point out, “it makes very little difference what the general public thinks” once interest-group alignments and the preferences of affluent Americans are taken into account.

zh: 这些令人沮丧的结果引出了一个重要问题：对绝大部分群众的利益视为不见、而对最富有个人几乎有求必应的政客是如何当选 — — 更重要的是，是如何连任的呢？
en: These disheartening results raise an important question: How do politicians who are unresponsive to the interests of the vast majority of their constituents get elected and, more important, re-elected, while doing the bidding mostly of the wealthiest individuals?

zh: 部分原因也许在于大部分选民并不能很好地理解政治制度是如何作用的，也不理解政治制度是如何为经济精英服务的。
en: Part of the explanation may be that most voters have a poor understanding of how the political system works and how it is tilted in favor of the economic elite.

zh: 吉伦斯和佩奇强调，他们的证据并不表明政府政策让普通公民的境况变坏了。
en: As Gilens and Page emphasize, their evidence does not imply that government policy makes the average citizen worse off.

zh: 普通公民常常确实能够获得他们想要的，这是因为他们的偏好往往与精英阶层相似。
en: Ordinary citizens often do get what they want, by virtue of the fact that their preferences frequently are similar to those of the elite.

zh: 这两个群体的偏好的相关性使得选民很难察觉政客的歧视。
en: This correlation of the two groups’ preferences may make it difficult for voters to discern politicians’ bias.

zh: 但另一个更危险的答案在于政治领袖为当选而所采取的战略。
en: But another, more pernicious, part of the answer may lie in the strategies to which political leaders resort in order to get elected.

zh: 代表主要是经济精英的利益的政客需要找到其他途径吸引大众。
en: A politician who represents the interests primarily of economic elites has to find other means of appealing to the masses.

zh: 这条途径可以通过民族主义、宗派主义和身份政治找到 — — 即基于文化价值和符号而不是面包和黄油利益的政治。
en: Such an alternative is provided by the politics of nationalism, sectarianism, and identity – a politics based on cultural values and symbolism rather than bread-and-butter interests.

zh: 当政治建立在这些基础上时，赢得选举的将是最能“激发”我们的潜在文化和心理标签的政客，而不是最能代表我们的利益的政客。
en: When politics is waged on these grounds, elections are won by those who are most successful at “priming” our latent cultural and psychological markers, not those who best represent our interests.

zh: 卡尔·马克思有一句名言，宗教是“人民的鸦片 ” 。
en: Karl Marx famously said that religion is “the opium of the people.”

zh: 这句话的含义是，宗教情绪可以让工人和其他被剥削人民的日常所遭到的物质匮乏模糊化。
en: What he meant is that religious sentiment could obscure the material deprivations that workers and other exploited people experience in their daily lives.

zh: 同样地，宗教右翼的兴起以及随之而起的针对“家族价值观”和其他高度极端化的问题（如移民问题）的文化战争被利用来将美国政治与20世纪70年代末以来的经济不平等性的急剧上升隔离开来。
en: In much of the same way, the rise of the religious right and, with it, culture wars over “family values” and other highly polarizing issues (for example, immigration) have served to insulate American politics from the sharp rise in economic inequality since the late 1970s.

zh: 结果是保守派得以保持权力，尽管他们所追求的经济和社会政策与中产阶级和下层人民的利益根本不相符。
en: As a result, conservatives have been able to retain power despite their pursuit of economic and social policies that are inimical to the interests of the middle and lower classes.

zh: 身份政治危害极大，因为它会画一个圈，圈出享有特权的圈内人并要求排斥圈外人 — — 即外国人、持有不同价值观的人、宗教信仰不同的人和其他种族的人。
en: Identity politics is malignant because it tends to draw boundaries around a privileged in-group and requires the exclusion of outsiders – those of other countries, values, religions, or ethnicities.

zh: 这在非自由民主国家，如俄罗斯、土耳其、匈牙利等国特别明显。
en: This can be seen most clearly in illiberal democracies such as Russia, Turkey, and Hungary.

zh: 为了巩固选举基础，这些国家的领导人严重依赖民族、文化和宗教符号。
en: In order to solidify their electoral base, leaders in these countries appeal heavily to national, cultural, and religious symbols.

zh: 这样做往往能够煽动针对宗教和民族少数派的敌对。
en: In doing so, they typically inflame passions against religious and ethnic minorities.

zh: 对于代表经济精英的政权（这样的政权往往从内到外都腐败透顶）来说，这是一个能带来可观民意好处的策略。
en: For regimes that represent economic elites (and are often corrupt to the core), it is a ploy that pays off handsomely at the polls.

zh: 世界发达国家和发展中国家间不断扩大的不平等性因此造成了对民主政治的两大冲击。
en: Widening inequality in the world’s advanced and developing countries thus inflicts two blows against democratic politics.

zh: 它不但导致中产阶级和下层人民选举权日益被剥夺，也在精英阶层中间酝酿了极其危险的宗派主义政治。
en: Not only does it lead to greater disenfranchisement of the middle and lower classes; it also fosters among the elite a poisonous politics of sectarianism.

zh: 非洲的结构转型挑战
en: Africa’s Structural Transformation Challenge

zh: 普林斯顿—长期被视为经济不健全者的撒哈拉以南非洲地区正在经历自独立后的几年以来的最强的经济增长。
en: PRINCETON – Long viewed as an economic basket case, Sub-Saharan Africa is experiencing its best growth performance since the immediate post-independence years.

zh: 自然资源禀赋起到了提振作用，但好消息并不只限于资源丰富国。
en: Natural-resource windfalls have helped, but the good news extends beyond resource-rich countries.

zh: 埃塞俄比亚、卢旺达和乌干达等国家自20世纪90年代中期以来以东非速度增长着。
en: Countries such as Ethiopia, Rwanda, and Uganda, among others, have grown at East Asian rates since the mid-1990’s.

zh: 非洲的商业和政治领导人对非洲大陆的未来充满了乐观。
en: And Africa’s business and political leaders are teeming with optimism about the continent’s future.

zh: 问题在于这样的表现能否持续。
en: The question is whether this performance can be sustained.

zh: 目前，增长的驱动力来自外部资源（援助、债务豁免和商品资源禀赋）以及取消过去的一些最糟糕的政策扭曲。
en: So far, growth has been driven by a combination of external resources (aid, debt relief, or commodity windfalls) and the removal of some of the worst policy distortions of the past.

zh: 国内生产率因国内商品和服务需求的增长（特别是后者）以及资源的高效使用而获得了提振。
en: Domestic productivity has been given a boost by an increase in demand for domestic goods and services (mostly the latter) and more efficient use of resources.

zh: 麻烦在于未来生产率改进之源来自何方。
en: The trouble is that it is not clear from whence future productivity gains will come.

zh: 根本问题是这些经济体结构转型不力。
en: The underlying problem is the weakness of these economies’ structural transformation.

zh: 东亚国家的快速增长来自短时间内复制了当今发达国家在工业革命后所做的事情。
en: East Asian countries grew rapidly by replicating, in a much shorter time frame, what today’s advanced countries did following the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 农民转变为制造业工人，经济实现多元化，并开始出口一系列日益成熟的商品。
en: They turned their farmers into manufacturing workers, diversified their economies, and exported a range of increasingly sophisticated goods.

zh: 而非洲几乎看不到这一幕。
en: Little of this process is taking place in Africa.

zh: 位于加纳阿克拉（Accra）的非洲经济转型中心（African Center for Economic Transformation）的研究者指出，非洲大陆“增长很快，转型很慢 ” 。
en: As researchers at the African Center for Economic Transformation in Accra, Ghana, put it, the continent is “growing rapidly, transforming slowly.”

zh: 理论上，该地区的劳动密集型工业化潜力是巨大的。
en: In principle, the region’s potential for labor-intensive industrialization is great.

zh: 比如，一家中国制鞋公司向埃塞俄比亚工人支付的薪水只有其支付本国工人薪水的十分之一。
en: A Chinese shoe manufacturer, for example, pays its Ethiopian workers one-tenth what it pays its workers back home.

zh: 经过内部培训，埃塞俄比亚工人的生产率可以达到中国水平的一半或以上。
en: It can raise Ethiopian workers’ productivity to half or more of Chinese levels through in-house training.

zh: 节约下来的劳动力成本足以抵消在非洲环境下做生意的额外成本，如拙劣的基础设施和官僚主义障碍。
en: The savings in labor costs more than offset other incremental costs of doing business in an African environment, such as poor infrastructure and bureaucratic red tape.

zh: 但加总数字表现出完全不同的情景。
en: But the aggregate numbers tell a worrying story.

zh: 只有不到10%的非洲工人在制造业找到了工作，而他们之中又只有一小部分 — — 大概只有十分之一 — — 受雇于拥有先进技术的正规现代企业。
en: Fewer than 10% of African workers find jobs in manufacturing, and among those only a tiny fraction – as low as one-tenth – are employed in modern, formal firms with adequate technology.

zh: 糟糕的是，尽管非洲增长率很高，这方面却鲜有赶紧。
en: Distressingly, there has been very little improvement in this regard, despite high growth rates.

zh: 事实上，如今撒哈拉以南地区的现代化程度还不如20世纪80年代。
en: In fact, Sub-Saharan Africa is less industrialized today than it was in the 1980’s.

zh: 现代行业，特别是非资源可贸易行业的私人投资并未增长，不足以维持结构转型。
en: Private investment in modern industries, especially non-resource tradables, has not increased, and remains too low to sustain structural transformation.

zh: 和所有发展中国家一样，非洲农民也在涌向城市。
en: As in all developing countries, farmers in Africa are flocking to the cities.

zh: 但哥廷根增长和发展中心（Groningen Growth and Development Center）的最新研究表明，农民工最终并未像东亚那样流入现代制造业，而是流入了零售贸易和分销等服务业。
en: And yet, as a recent study from the Groningen Growth and Development Center shows, rural migrants do not end up in modern manufacturing industries, as they did in East Asia, but in services such as retail trade and distribution.

zh: 尽管这些服务业的生产率比大部分农业要高，但它们在非洲并不具有技术活力，也落后于世界标准。
en: Though such services have higher productivity than much of agriculture, they are not technologically dynamic in Africa and have been falling behind the world frontier.

zh: 以卢旺达为例。 卢旺达可谓成功的先驱，自1995年以来其GDP平均年增长率高达令人诧异的9.6 % （ 人均收入增长年率为5.2 % ） 。
en: Consider Rwanda, a much-heralded success story where GDP has increased by a whopping 9.6% per year, on average, since 1995 (with per capita incomes rising at an annual rate of 5.2%).

zh: 国际食物政策研究所（International Food Policy Research Institute）的刁新生（Xinshen Diao）指出，这一增长受不可贸易的服务部门的拉动，特别是建筑业、运输业和餐饮饭店业。
en: Xinshen Diao of the International Food Policy Research Institute has shown that this growth was led by non-tradable services, in particular construction, transport, and hotels and restaurants.

zh: 公共部门主导了投资，而大部分公共投资通过外国援助筹资。
en: The public sector dominates investment, and the bulk of public investment is financed by foreign grants.

zh: 外国援助导致真实汇率升值，加剧了制造业和其他贸易部门所面临的困境。
en: Foreign aid has caused the real exchange rate to appreciate, compounding the difficulties faced by manufacturing and other tradables.

zh: 所有这些都不能抹杀卢旺达在减贫方面的进步，这些进步体现在健康、教育和总体政策环境方面的改革中。
en: None of this is to dismiss Rwanda’s progress in reducing poverty, which reflects reforms in health, education, and the general policy environment.

zh: 毫无疑问，这些改善提高了该国的潜在收入。
en: Without question, these improvements have raised the country’s potential income.

zh: 但改善的治理和人力资本并不一定能带来经济活力。
en: But improved governance and human capital do not necessarily translate into economic dynamism.

zh: 卢旺达和其他非洲国家缺少可以通过充当生产率增长的国内引擎将潜力转化为现实的现代可贸易行业。
en: What Rwanda and other African countries lack are the modern, tradable industries that can turn the potential into reality by acting as the domestic engine of productivity growth.

zh: 非洲经济图景的主要特征 — — 由微型企业、家庭生产和非官方活动组成的非正式部门在吸收日益增长的城市劳动力并充当社会安全网。
en: The African economic landscape’s dominant feature – an informal sector comprising microenterprises, household production, and unofficial activities – is absorbing the growing urban labor force and acting as a social safety net.

zh: 但证据表明非正式部门无法带来缺失的生产活力。
en: But the evidence suggests that it cannot provide the missing productive dynamism.

zh: 研究表明，极少有微型企业可以通过成长超越非正式性质，正如大部分成功企业并非从小型非正式企业起步。
en: Studies show that very few microenterprises grow beyond informality, just as the bulk of successful established firms do not start out as small, informal enterprises.

zh: 乐观者说，关于非洲结构转型的好消息还没有在宏观经济数据中有所体现。
en: Optimists say that the good news about African structural transformation has not yet shown up in macroeconomic data.

zh: 他们很有可能是对的。
en: They may well be right.

zh: 但如果他们错了，那么非洲可能将在未来几十年里面临严重困难。
en: But if they are wrong, Africa may confront some serious difficulties in the decades ahead.

zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲一半人口不到25岁。
en: Half of Sub-Saharan Africa’s population is under 25 years of age.

zh: 根据世界银行的数据，每年都有500万新增15岁以上人口，而15岁是“告别童年，进入成年的门槛 ” 。
en: According to the World Bank, each year an additional five million turn 15, “crossing the threshold from childhood to adulthood.”

zh: 由于积极结构转型速度缓慢，世界银行预测，在未来十年中，只有四分之一的非洲年轻人能找到固定的有薪工作，而这些人中又只有一小部分可以进入现代企业正式部门。
en: Given the slow pace of positive structural transformation, the Bank projects that over the next decade only one in four African youth will find regular employment as a salaried worker, and that only a small fraction of those will be in the formal sector of modern enterprises.

zh: 撒哈拉以南非洲二十年的经济扩张提高了年轻人对好工作的预期，但并没有很大地提升供应这类工作的能力。
en: Two decades of economic expansion in Sub-Saharan Africa have raised a young population’s expectations of good jobs without greatly expanding the capacity to deliver them.

zh: 这就带来了社会游行和政治动荡的危险。
en: These are the conditions that make social protest and political instability likely.

zh: 基于将现有增长趋势简单外推的经济规划会加剧分歧。
en: Economic planning based on simple extrapolations of recent growth will exacerbate the discrepancy.

zh: 相反，非洲政治领导人或许应该抑制预期，同时致力于加快结构转型速度和增加社会包容度。
en: Instead, African political leaders may have to manage expectations downward, while working to increase the rate of structural transformation and social inclusion.

zh: 经济共识的危险
en: The Perils of Economic Consensus

zh: 普林斯顿—芝加哥大学的全球市场计划（Initiative on Global Markets）定期调查一组政治观点各异的顶尖经济学家，询问他们对当前问题的意见。
en: PRINCETON – The Initiative on Global Markets, based at the University of Chicago, periodically surveys a group of leading academic economists, of varying political persuasions, on the issues of the day.

zh: 最近一期的问题是奥巴马的刺激计划是否有助于美国降低失业。
en: Its latest roundup asked whether President Barack Obama’s stimulus plan helped to reduce unemployment in the United States.

zh: 这一正式名为2009年美国复苏和再投资法（American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009）的计划包括政府投入8,000多亿美元用于基础设施、教育、卫生、能源领域；税收激励；以及众多社会项目。
en: Officially known as the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act of 2009, the plan entailed government spending of more than $800 billion on infrastructure, education, health, and energy, tax incentives, and various social programs.

zh: 该计划在经济危机期间实施，是一项经典的凯恩斯主义应对措施。
en: Implemented in the midst of an economic crisis, it was the classic Keynesian response.

zh: 受调查经济学家的意见几乎是一边倒。
en: The economists were virtually unanimous.

zh: 在回答调查的37名顶尖经济学家中，有三十六人表示该，就减少失业的目标而言，该计划是成功的。
en: Thirty-six of the 37 top economists who responded to the survey said that the plan had been successful in its avowed objective of reducing unemployment.

zh: 密歇根大学经济学家贾斯丁·沃尔夫斯（Justin Wlofers）在其《纽约时报》博客上为这一共识喝彩。
en: The University of Michigan economist Justin Wolfers cheered the consensus in his New York Times blog.

zh: 他抱怨说，关于财政刺激是否有效的公共政策贻害良多，并且与专家所了解和形成了一致的东西完全脱节。
en: The virulent public debate about whether fiscal stimulus works, he complained, has become totally disconnected from what experts know and agree on.

zh: 事实上，经济学家在诸多问题上都形成了一致，其中不乏颇具政治争议者。
en: In fact, economists agree on many things, a number of which are politically controversial.

zh: 哈佛经济学家格雷格·曼昆（Greg Mankiw）在2009年列举了其中的一些。
en: The Harvard economist Greg Mankiw listed some of them in 2009.

zh: 以下意见至少获得了90%的经济学家的支持：进口关税和配额降低总体经济福利；租金管制减少住房供给；浮动汇率提供了有效的国际货币体系；美国不应该限制雇主将工作外包给外国；财政政策可以在就业未达充分状态时刺激经济。
en: The following propositions garnered support from at least 90% of economists: import tariffs and quotas reduce general economic welfare; rent controls reduce the supply of housing; floating exchange rates provide an effective international monetary system; the US should not restrict employers from outsourcing work to foreign countries; and fiscal policy stimulates the economy when there is less than full employment.

zh: 在如此多重要问题上都有共识，这与普遍的观点 — — 经济学家极少在任何问题上行促成一致相悖。
en: This consensus about so many important issues contrasts rather starkly with the general perception that economists rarely agree on anything.

zh: “如果把所有经济学家放到一起 ， ” 萧伯纳曾经做过著名的总结 ， “ 他们不会得到任何结论。
en: “If all the economists were laid end to end,” George Bernard Shaw famously quipped, “they would not reach a conclusion.”

zh: ”艾森豪威尔受够了顾问们彼此冲突和对立的建议，据说他曾经要求“单面经济学家”做顾问。
en: Frustrated by the conflicting and hedged advice that he was receiving from his advisers, President Dwight Eisenhower is said to have asked once for a “one-handed economist.”

zh: 毫无疑问，在许多公共政策问题上，经济学家间有着激烈的争论。
en: No doubt, there are many public-policy questions that economists debate vigorously.

zh: 最高所得税率应该是多少？
en: What should the top income-tax rate be?

zh: 应该提高最低工资吗？
en: Should the minimum wage be raised?

zh: 财政赤字应该通过增税还是减支来减少？
en: Should the fiscal deficit be reduced by raising taxes or cutting spending?

zh: 专利刺激还是阻碍���创新？
en: Do patents stimulate or impede innovation?

zh: 在这些和其他许多问题上，经济学家擅长分析问题的两面，我怀疑对这些问题的调查不会出现任何共识。
en: On these and many other issues, economists tend to be good at seeing both sides of the issue, and I suspect that a survey on such questions would reveal little consensus.

zh: 经济学家间的共识有利也有弊。
en: A consensus among economists can arise for both good and bad reasons.

zh: 有时，共识无伤大雅，比如，经济学家们指出，忽略激励的作用是危险的。
en: Sometimes a consensus is innocuous enough, as when you hear economists argue that one ignores the role of incentives at one’s peril.

zh: 你这能反驳这一点吗？
en: Can anyone really disagree with that?

zh: 有时，共识限定于特定场景，其背后是事实积累起来的证据：是的，苏联经济制度效率极低；是的，奥巴马的2009年财政刺激确实降低了失业。
en: Sometimes it is restricted to a particular episode and is based on evidence accumulated after the fact: Yes, the Soviet economic system was hugely inefficient; yes, the Obama fiscal stimulus of 2009 did reduce unemployment.

zh: 但如果共识来自具体模型的普遍适用性，而该模型的假设很容易被违反，那么我们就会面临问题。
en: But when a consensus forms around the universal applicability of a specific model, the critical assumptions of which are likely to be violated in many settings, we have a problem.

zh: 考虑我在上文中列举的存在广泛共识的领域。
en: Consider some of the areas of widespread agreement that I listed above.

zh: 贸易限制降低经济福利的意见显然不是放之四海而皆准的，当出现某些特定状况时（如外部性和规模报酬递增 ） ， 它就不成立。
en: The proposition that trade restrictions reduce economic welfare is certainly not generally valid, and it is violated when certain conditions – such as externalities or increasing returns to scale – are present.

zh: 此外，经济学家还需要做出分配效应的价值判断，而这留给选民本身来做更加合适。
en: Moreover, it requires that economists make value judgments on distributional effects, which are better left to the electorate itself.

zh: 类似地，租金控制降低住房供给的意见在不完美竞争条件下也不成立。
en: Likewise, the proposition that rent controls reduce the supply of housing is violated under conditions of imperfect competition.

zh: 而浮动汇率是有效体系的意见需要依赖关于货币和金融体系运转的假设，而这些假设已被证明是有问题的；我怀疑如在今天做一个调查，支持浮动汇率的人会少得多。
en: And the proposition that floating exchange rates are an effective system relies on assumptions about the workings of the monetary and financial system that have proved problematic; I suspect a poll today would find significantly less support for it.

zh: 或许经济学家们会同意，某些假设在现实世界中更普遍。
en: Perhaps economists tend to agree that certain assumptions are more prevalent in the real world.

zh: 或者他们认为某些模型“平均而言”比另一些更有效。
en: Or they think that one set of models works better “on average” than another.

zh: 即是如此，难道他们不应该和科学家一样装模做样地表示对合理警告的支持？
en: Even so, as scientists, should they not adorn their endorsements with the appropriate caveats?

zh: 他们难道不应该担心上述绝对论断至少在某些条件下会起到误导作用？
en: Shouldn’t they worry that categorical statements such as those above may prove to be misleading in at least some settings?

zh: 问题在于经济学家常常混淆模型（a model）和合意模型（the model ） 。
en: The problem is that economists often confuse a model for the model.

zh: 若是如此，共识就绝不值得喝彩。
en: When that happens, a consensus is certainly not something to cheer about.

zh: 这可能造成两大弊端。
en: Two kinds of mischief may then follow.

zh: 首先是遗漏错误（errors of omission ） — —共识中的盲点让经济学家难以看到未来的麻烦。
en: First, there are errors of omission – cases in which blind spots in the consensus prevent economists from being able to see troubles looming ahead.

zh: 最近的例子是经济学家没有看到各种危险状况的聚集并导致全球金融危机。
en: A recent example is the failure of economists to grasp the dangerous confluence of circumstances that produced the global financial crisis.

zh: 疏忽的原因不在于缺少关于泡沫、信息不对称、激励扭曲和银行挤兑的模型。
en: The oversight was not due to the lack of models of bubbles, asymmetric information, distorted incentives, or bank runs.

zh: 疏忽的原因在于这样的事实：为了给强调有效市场的模型让路，这些模型被忽略了。
en: It was due to the fact that such models were neglected in favor of models that stressed efficient markets.

zh: 其次是处理错误（errors of commission ） — —经济学家顽固地依赖某个特定的关于世界的模型，只看到了那些早就可以预料到失败的政策。
