en: Then there are the errors of commission – cases in which economists’ fixation on one particular model of the world makes them complicit in the administration of policies whose failure could have been predicted ahead of time.

zh: 经济学家鼓吹新自由主义“华盛顿共识”政策和金融全球化就是这样的例子。
en: Economists’ advocacy of neoliberal “Washington Consensus” policies and of financial globalization falls into this category.

zh: 在这两个例子中，经济学家忽略了严重的次优副作用，如学习外部性和制度弱点，这些副作用阻碍了改革，有时甚至让改革适得其反。
en: What happened in both cases is that economists overlooked serious second-best complications, such as learning externalities and weak institutions, which blunted the reforms and, in some cases, caused them to backfire.

zh: 经济学家间的分歧是有益的。
en: Disagreements among economists are healthy.

zh: 这反映了一个事实：经济学是由多元化的模型组成的，匹配现实与模型是一项不完美的科学，很容易犯错。
en: They reflect the fact that their discipline comprises a diverse collection of models, and that matching reality to model is an imperfect science with a lot of room for error.

zh: 公众更应该直面这一不确定性，而不是沉溺于某些知识的外表所带来的虚假的安全感。
en: It is better for the public to be exposed to this uncertainty than for it to be lulled into a false sense of security based on the appearance of certain knowledge.

zh: 韩国的日本镜像
en: South Korea’s Japanese Mirror

zh: 首尔—考虑到日本所面临的艰巨挑战，我们对日本首相安倍晋三结束日本二十年经济停滞的决心只能抱有敬仰之情。
en: SEOUL – Given the daunting challenges facing Japan, one can only admire Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s determination to end the country’s two-decade-long period of economic stagnation.

zh: 他的战略 — — 由大规模货币扩张、政府增支和结构性改革组成的“三支箭 ” — —在理论上是可行的。
en: His strategy – the “three arrows” of massive monetary expansion, increased government spending, and structural reform – is theoretically sound.

zh: 但到目前为止只射出了一支半。
en: But only one and a half arrows have been launched so far.

zh: 刺激计划的效果因为旨在减少日本巨额债务负担的增加消费税计划而被抵消不少。 增加消费税将令日本消费者减少消费支出。
en: The stimulus package is being offset by consumption-tax hikes aimed at reducing Japan’s massive debt burden – a process that will lead many Japanese consumers to adjust their spending downward.

zh: 能源部门、劳动力市场和竞争政策方面的结构性改革似乎也无法立刻就起到效果。
en: The promised structural reforms of the energy sector, labor market, and competition policy have yet to be introduced, and appear unlikely to take effect anytime soon.

zh: 更令人担忧的是难以改变的现实 — — 如快速老龄化且不断减少的人口，这些现实将成为未来几十年中日本经济增长的制约因素。
en: Even more worrisome are larger immutable realities – like a rapidly aging and shrinking population – that will limit Japan’s economic growth in the coming decades.

zh: 但日本的问题并不是独一无二的。
en: But Japan’s problems are not unique.

zh: 事实上，它的近邻和历史上的对头韩国也处在相似的轨迹上。
en: Indeed, its neighbor and historical rival, South Korea, is headed down a similar path.

zh: 区别在于韩国可能仍有时间改善这些趋势并避免日本式的持久低增长和长期衰退的泥淖。
en: The difference is that South Korea may still have time to ameliorate these trends, and avoid a Japanese-style quagmire of permanent low growth and long-term decline.

zh: 作为世界第七大贸易国和过去50年来最令人瞩目的经济成功国家，韩国有可能面临着萧条的未来，主要原因就在于其人口。
en: South Korea – the seventh-largest trading country in the world, and one of the most prominent economic success stories of the last 50 years – is at risk of such a bleak future as a result, first and foremost, of demographics.

zh: 韩国的工作适龄人口以每年1.2%的速度下降，是经合组织国家中下降速度最快的。
en: South Korea’s working-age population is falling by 1.2% annually – the fastest decline among OECD countries.

zh: 韩国的低出生率原因很多，但两大经济因素十分突出。
en: While there are many reasons for South Korea’s low fertility rate, two economic factors stand out.

zh: 首先，家庭债务水平很高，吞噬了四分之一的家庭收入，其中最重的负担在于按揭贷款。
en: First, household-debt levels are enormous, capturing a quarter of income, with mortgage payments taking the lion’s share.

zh: 房价/收入比是美国的两倍多。
en: The ratio of housing prices to incomes is more than double that of the United States.

zh: 其次，韩国家庭被迫将收入的一大块（平均为10 % ） 用于教育。
en: Second, South Korean families feel compelled to spend a large share of their income (10%, on average) on education.

zh: 考虑到家庭储蓄占可支配收入之比只有4 % （ 1988年为20 % ） ，韩国家庭增加支出的空间已经极为有限。
en: With households already saving only around 4% of their disposable income, compared to 20% in 1988, there is little room for additional expenditure.

zh: 韩国劳动力市场的一个伴随特征是女性劳动力参与率是经合组织国家中最低的之一，30—39年龄段女性只有33%参加工作。
en: A concomitant feature of South Korea’s labor market is that women’s labor-force participation rate – a paltry 33% for women aged 30-39 – is among the lowest in the OECD.

zh: 这部分是因为与欧洲和美国相比，韩国人在育儿和工作之间更加难以取得平衡。
en: This partly reflects the difficulty of balancing child rearing with work in South Korea, compared to, say, Europe or the US.

zh: 韩国的女性劳动力参与率甚至比育儿需求强劲的日本还低。
en: South Korea’s female labor-force participation rate is even lower than in Japan, where there are waiting lists for childcare.

zh: 此外，韩国在托儿所方面的投资不足，企业很少提供日托服务。
en: Moreover, South Korea has underinvested in day-care centers, with firms rarely offering childcare support.

zh: 韩国女性通常不会从事待遇优渥的岗位，因此育儿服务对她们来说往往成本太高。
en: Given that South Korean women tend not to hold lucrative jobs, the cost of childcare is often prohibitive.

zh: 最近，韩国提高了最低正常退休年龄，但这对改善劳动力市场前景来说只是杯水车薪。
en: The recent increase in South Korea’s minimum normal retirement age has done little to improve the labor-market outlook.

zh: 中小企业雇用了88%的工人，但其薪水远低于财阀（大型集团公司 ） ， 中产阶级占国民收入的比重也在下降。
en: Wages in the small and medium-size enterprises (SMEs) that employ 88% of workers still lag behind those of major conglomerates, the chaebols; and the middle class is shrinking in terms of its share of earnings.

zh: 但相比日本，韩国存在一些优势。
en: But South Korea does have some advantages over Japan.

zh: 尽管政府的刺激政策提高了国民债务，但债务/GDP比率仍相对较低，约为37 % 。
en: Although the government’s stimulus policies have increased the national debt, the debt/GDP ratio remains relatively low, at roughly 37%.

zh: 相比之下，日本的公债水平超过GDP的220 % 。
en: Public debt in Japan, by contrast, exceeds 220% of GDP.

zh: 此外，尽管韩国对出口的依赖度很高，但国内消费水平也很强健。
en: Moreover, despite South Korea’s dependence on exports, domestic consumption is robust.

zh: 充足的研发支出以及对科技创���前沿的不懈追求为韩国带来了强劲的创新速度。
en: And ample spending on research and development, together with an unrelenting drive to be at the forefront of technological innovation, implies a brisk pace of innovation.

zh: 这有助于应对经济的两大主要挑战：服务业的低生产率。
en: This creates room to address one of the economy’s two main challenges: low productivity in services.

zh: 服务业的生产率比制造业低六倍。
en: As it stands, productivity in services is six times lower than in manufacturing.

zh: 主导生产（而不是就业）的韩国财阀的经营应该做出调整以支持日益重要的服务部门的生产率的提高。
en: The operations of South Korea’s chaebols – which dominate production, if not employment – should be adjusted to support productivity gains in the increasingly dominant services sector.

zh: 与日本一样，这方面的关键是增加服务业的竞争性。
en: The key here, as in Japan, is to foster greater competition in services.

zh: 如果财阀继续自己包揽广告、融资和IT等业务，就会对中小企业的生存空间形成挤压。
en: If the chaebols continue to do their own advertising, financing, and IT, they will starve SMEs.

zh: 此外，韩国需要对产业集中度进行检视，政府应该花大力气提供激励、确保资本获得渠道和降低市场进入壁垒以支持新领域的中小企业成长。
en: A review of industrial concentration is warranted, as is a major government effort to foster SME growth in new ventures by offering incentives, ensuring access to capital, and lowering barriers to market entry.

zh: 增加高端服务岗位就业（特别是女性就业）也能极大地改善韩国的前景。
en: More employment in higher-end service jobs, especially for women, would also improve South Korea’s prospects considerably.

zh: 但是，从长期看，韩国的前景的关键在于劳动力。
en: In the longer term, however, South Korea’s prospects hinge largely on the labor force.

zh: 依赖比率的上升 — — 预计到2030年将突破50 % ， 到那时，韩国人口中65岁以上比例将达到36 % — —可能成为韩国的灾难。
en: The rising dependency ratio – expected to exceed 50% by 2030, when 36% of the population will be above the age of 65 – could spell disaster for the country.

zh: 医疗成本将上升，导致预算吃紧。
en: Health-care costs will rise, increasing the strain on budgets.

zh: 增加移民有利于缓解劳动力压力，但会受到公众的抵制。
en: While increased immigration could help to ease labor-force pressures, it would be met with public resistance.

zh: 在这样的背景下，潜在增长率将回落到2.5%的预测年率水平，即使韩国资本存量形势依然有利。
en: In this context, potential growth may well fall back to the predicted 2.5% annual rate, even though the economy’s capital stock is in good shape.

zh: 韩国从日本身上汲取了大量有益教训。
en: South Korea has learned numerous positive lessons from Japan.

zh: 它夺走了大量日本出口市场；它进口并调节日本的技术；它采取了与日本类似的规划方法；它的财阀也来自日本的财阀模式。
en: It captured many of Japan’s export markets; it imported and adapted Japanese technologies; it employed similar planning methods; and the chaebols are an outgrowth of Japan’s zaibatsu corporate model.

zh: 但是，如今，韩国必须汲取日本的有害教训。
en: Now, however, South Korea must learn from Japan’s negative experiences.

zh: 结构性改革不能拖。
en: Structural reform cannot wait.

zh: 民族主义必须予以引导，使其有利于确保深度经济和社会改革的公共支持。
en: Nationalism should be channeled toward securing public support for deep economic and social reforms.

zh: 如果不能快速果断地解决眼前的挑战后果会是怎样？ 韩国领导人应该一眼就能看出。
en: South Korea’s leaders do not have to look far to find out what will happen if they fail to address looming challenges quickly and resolutely.

zh: 巴勒斯坦能赢得和平吗？
en: Can Palestine Win the Peace?

zh: 拉马拉—上个月，以色列和巴勒斯坦首次达成结束战争的停火协议，这令人瞩目。
en: RAMALLAH – The rollout of the war-ending ceasefire agreement between Israel and Palestine last month was impressive.

zh: 几乎是在同时，巴勒斯坦总统阿巴斯通过电视广播在其拉马拉总部宣布加沙战争结束，而哈马斯领导人号召加沙巴勒斯坦人走上街头庆祝他们所想象的胜利。
en: With almost perfect synchronization, Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas announced the end of the war on Gaza in a televised broadcast from his Ramallah headquarters, while Hamas leaders called on Palestinians in Gaza to take to the streets to celebrate their supposed victory.

zh: 当然，这场战争的结果绝不是“胜利 ” ： 2,200多巴勒斯坦人 — — 大部分是平民 — — 死亡，超过10,000人受伤，数千房屋、学校、清真寺和其他建筑被毁。
en: Of course, with more than 2,200 Palestinians – mostly civilians – killed, over 10,000 injured, and thousands of homes, schools, mosques, and other structures destroyed, the war’s outcome can hardly be called a victory.

zh: 尽管如此，这是巴勒斯坦人首次能够接近于实现对以色列人的互相威慑。
en: Nonetheless, this is the first time that Palestinians have been able to create something close to mutual deterrence with the Israelis.

zh: 进一步加强巴勒斯坦地位的是联合国大会承认巴勒斯坦为非成员观察国，巴勒斯坦外交人权能够利用此地位向以色列施加政治压力，要求后者严肃对待自己的民族自尊。
en: Strengthening Palestine’s position further is the United Nations General Assembly’s recognition of Palestine as a non-member observer state, which Palestinian diplomats can use to exert political pressure on Israel to take their national aspirations seriously.

zh: 巴勒斯坦在国际刑事法庭（International Criminal Court）等联合国机构的成员资格也增加了其领导人的讨价还价实力。
en: Palestine’s membership in UN agencies, not to mention the possibility of joining the International Criminal Court, has also boosted its leaders’ bargaining power.

zh: 所有这些有利形势 — — 更不用说巴勒斯坦人所获得来自国际观察家的巨大的同情了 — — 对于保证巴勒斯坦人在这场51天的战争中所付出的的高昂代价不会打水漂。
en: All of these levers – not to mention the tremendous sympathy and support Palestinians have received from international observers – will be essential to ensure that the high price Palestinians paid during the 51-day war was not in vain.

zh: 但如果巴勒斯坦两大主要派系 — — 哈马斯和法塔赫不能维持统一战线，这些有利形势将是徒劳无益的。
en: But the levers will be useless if the leaders of Hamas and Fatah, the two dominant Palestinian factions, fail to maintain a united front.

zh: 这一合作方针的效果在埃及所牵线的与以色列的间接对话中表露无遗。
en: The effectiveness of such a cooperative approach was apparent in the Egypt-sponsored indirect talks with Israel.

zh: 将哈马斯视为恐怖组织的埃及和以色列乐于见到统一的巴勒斯坦代表团，巴勒斯坦也能从中获益，因为这有助于结束暴力。
en: The unified Palestinian delegation was convenient for Egypt and Israel, both of which consider Hamas a terrorist organization, and for Palestine, because it helped to bring an end to the violence.

zh: 对阿巴斯来说，这也是一个政治大礼，他得以组建一个以其亲信艾哈迈德（Azzam al-Ahmad）为首的代表团，从而获得宣布停火的权利。
en: And it was a political boon for Abbas, who was able to field a delegation headed by one of his confidants, Azzam al-Ahmad, and thus claim the right to announce the ceasefire.

zh: 在经受了战争考验后，成立于冲突爆发前不到两个月的巴勒斯坦联合政府现在将成为加沙重建的主要机构。
en: Having withstood the test of war, the Palestinian unity government that was created less than two months before the conflict began will now become the main vehicle for Gaza’s reconstruction.

zh: 但总理哈马达拉（Rami Hamdallah）将面临巨大的挑战 — — 首先是来自其行政权力饱受限制的加沙的挑战。
en: But Prime Minister Rami Hamdallah will face considerable challenges – beginning with Gaza, where his executive authority is severely limited.

zh: 更广泛地说，联合政府的成功取决于法塔赫领导的巴勒斯坦政府和哈马斯 — — 以及不论何种程度上的伊斯兰圣战组织 — — 有多大能力在通往自由和解放的道路的问题上形成一致，从而巩固它们的合作。
en: More broadly, the unity government’s success depends on the ability of the Fatah-led Palestinian government and Hamas – and, to whatever extent possible, Islamic Jihad – to cement their cooperation by agreeing on a path toward liberation and freedom.

zh: 一个明确、务实的战略将有利于巴勒斯坦赢得急切地期盼结束已有几十年之久的巴以冲突的地区和国际行动方的支持。
en: A clear, realistic strategy will be integral to Palestine’s efforts to win support from regional and international actors eager to end the decades-old conflict with Israel.

zh: 当然，这一意愿需要协调各方。
en: This will, of course, require compromises from all sides.

zh: 哈马斯必须重新考虑其拒绝承认以色列的立场。
en: Hamas must reconsider its refusal to recognize Israel.

zh: 在这方面，巴勒斯坦领导层必须在谈判期间积极反抗以色列，同时更有力地捍卫巴勒斯坦人回家的权利 — — 为了抚慰以色列，这方面的主张常常被忽视。
en: For its part, the Palestinian leadership must pursue active resistance alongside negotiations with Israel, while defending more vigorously Palestinians’ right of return, which it has often ignored in an effort to appease the Israelis.

zh: 但建立统一战略只是第一步。
en: But establishing a unified strategy is only the first step.

zh: 普通巴勒斯坦人毫无疑问必须做出牺牲，但他们也必须在被考虑到 — — 特别是考虑到他们在最近的冲突中付出了高昂的代价，但却从未发出声音。
en: Ordinary Palestinians, who will undoubtedly have to make sacrifices, must be brought on board – especially given the heavy price they incurred during the recent conflict, in which they had no say.

zh: 在广泛的公众支持下，巴勒斯坦联合政府将能够让国际社会支持其公平合理的要求 — — 建立真正独立的国家，免受包围、隔离墙和外国定居点影响，这些都是基本人权要求。
en: With broad public support, Palestine’s unity government will be able to rally the international community behind its fair and reasonable demands for a truly independent state, free of sieges, separation barriers, and foreign settlements – demands that fall squarely within the realm of basic human rights.

zh: 正如国际社会对南非采取孤立政策直至其放弃种族隔离，也可以通过抵制、撤销投资和制裁向以色列施压，同时要求以色列盟友停止为其提供援助和武器。
en: Just as the international community isolated South Africa until it abandoned apartheid, it can put pressure on Israel through boycotts, divestment, and sanctions, while calling upon Israel’s allies to stop providing aid and arms.

zh: 如果巴勒斯坦领导人真的希望结束加沙的暴力循环，就必须从解决自身内部争端，形成一个团结、可靠、有担当的谈判方开始。
en: If Palestine’s leaders truly want to end the cycle of violence in Gaza, they must begin by resolving their own internal disagreements and present themselves as a cohesive, reliable, and committed negotiating party.

zh: 他们必须团结在一个简单而强大的目标身后 — — 用联合国秘书长潘基文（Ban Ki-moon）在纽约联合国大会上的发言讲 ， “ 我们将再次开始建设，但这次必须是最后一次重建。 ”
en: They must band together behind the simple but powerful goal expressed by UN Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon to the General Assembly in New York: “We will build again, but this must be the last time to rebuild.”

zh: 对巴勒斯坦联合政府来说，现在就是开始这一重建过程的实际。
en: For Palestine’s unity government, the time to begin the rebuilding process is now.

zh: 如果法塔赫和哈马斯愿意竭尽全力实现和平，现在就是他们最好的机会。
en: If Fatah and Hamas are willing to do what it takes to achieve peace, this may well be their best chance.

zh: 当代金融黑暗之王？
en: Today’s Dark Lords of Finance

zh: 伦敦—在普利策奖获奖作品《金融之王 》 （ Lords of Finance）中，经济学家利雅卡特·艾哈迈德（Liaquat Ahamad）讲述了四位央行行长因为坚持金本位而“打碎世界 ” 、 引发大萧条的故事。
en: LONDON – In his Pulitzer-Prize-winning book, Lords of Finance, the economist Liaquat Ahamad tells the story of how four central bankers, driven by staunch adherence to the gold standard, “broke the world” and triggered the Great Depression.

zh: 今天的央行行长基本上有了一套新的传统智慧 — — 关于宽松货币政策的智慧。
en: Today’s central bankers largely share a new conventional wisdom – about the benefits of loose monetary policy.

zh: 货币决策者会再一次打碎世界吗？
en: Are monetary policymakers poised to break the world again?

zh: 正统货币政策不再奉金本位为圭臬。 金本位导致20世纪20年代各大央行利率管理失当，引起全球经济萧条并成为第二次世界大战的祸根。
en: Orthodox monetary policy no longer enshrines the gold standard, which caused the central bankers of the 1920s to mismanage interest rates, triggering a global economic meltdown that ultimately set the stage for World War II.

zh: 但自2008年金融危机爆发以来，我们经历了一段前所未有的合作货币宽松时期，它的问题也许不亚于金本位。
en: But the unprecedented period of coordinated loose monetary policy since the beginning of the financial crisis in 2008 could be just as problematic.

zh: 事实上，它对金融市场的巨大影响早已清晰可辨。
en: Indeed, the discernible effect on financial markets has already been huge.

zh: 一阶影响显而易见。
en: The first-order impact is clear.

zh: 机构投资者难以在任何传统安全投资中获得正实际收益率。
en: Institutional investors have found it difficult to achieve positive real yields in any of the traditional safe-haven investments.

zh: 比如，寿险公司为了兑现保证回报率而焦头烂额。
en: Life insurers, for example, have struggled to meet their guaranteed rates of return.

zh: 据瑞士再保险公司（Swiss Re）的最新报告，如果政府债券以接近于“公平价值”的价格交易，2008—2013年美国和欧洲保险公司可以赚得400—800亿美元（假设其50—60%的投资配置给固定收益证券，这也是典型的做法 ） 。
en: According to a recent report by Swiss Re, had government bonds been trading closer to their “fair value,” insurers in America and Europe would have earned some $40-$80 billion from 2008 to 2013 (assuming a typical 50-60% allocation to fixed income).

zh: 对公共退休基金来说，这段时间增加1%的收益率每年能新增收益400—500亿美元。
en: For public pension funds, an additional 1% yield during this period would have increased annual income by $40-50 billion.

zh: 投资者对近零利率的反应是对资产配置方式进行前所未有的调整。
en: Investors have responded to near-zero interest rates with unprecedented adjustments in the way they allocate assets.

zh: 在大部分情况中，他们增加了冒险规模。
en: In most cases, they have taken on more risk.

zh: 首先，他们进入了风险更高的信用工具市场，导致公司债券利差缩小。
en: For starters, they have moved into riskier credit instruments, resulting in a compression of corporate-bond spreads.

zh: 当商业票据回报率被压低到历史低点时，投资者又进入股市。
en: Once returns on commercial paper had been driven to all-time lows, investors continued to push into equities.

zh: 据最新的 道富银行（State Street）调查，在截至2015年4月的六个月中，大约63%的全球机构投资者增加了发达国家股票的配置比例 — — 尽管其中60%的机构投资者认为股市会出现10—20%的回调。
en: Approximately 63% of global institutional investors increased allocations in developed-market equities in the six months prior to April 2015, according to data from a recent State Street survey – even though some 60% of them expect a market correction of 10-20%.

zh: 即使是世界上最保守的投资者也承担了前所未有的风险。
en: Even the world’s most conservative investors have taken on unprecedented risk.

zh: 日本公共退休基金 — — 包括全球规模最大的一家退休基金 — — 以创纪录的利率甩卖本地债券。
en: Japan’s public pension funds, which include the world’s largest, have dumped local bonds at record rates.

zh: 除了增加对外国股票和债券的投资外，它们还连续第五季度增持本国股票。
en: In addition to boosting investments in foreign stocks and bonds, they have now raised their holdings of domestic stocks for the fifth consecutive quarter.

zh: 这些配置决定不难理解，因为固定收益投资收益率低迷；但由此造成的二阶影响可能是灾难性的。
en: These allocation decisions are understandable, given the paltry yields available in fixed-income investments, but the resulting second-order impact could ultimately prove devastating.

zh: 如今，股市走牛已经六年。
en: The equity bull market is now six years old.

zh: 虽然市场因为希腊危机和中国股市崩盘而波动陡增，但估值仍然很高。
en: Even after the market volatility following the crisis in Greece and the Chinese stock market’s plunge, valuations appear to be high.

zh: 标准普尔500指数已经超过了2008年前的高点，市盈率高达18倍。
en: The S&P 500 has surpassed pre-2008 levels, with companies’ shares trading at 18 times their earnings.

zh: 只要全球量化宽松、廉价石油和机构资金流入的东风继续，股市就会继续上涨。
en: As long as the tailwinds of global quantitative easing, cheap oil, and further institutional inflows keep blowing, equities could continue to rally.

zh: 但总有一天真正的市场回调会到来。
en: But at some point, a real market correction will arrive.

zh: 而当回调到来时，退休基金和保险公司将比以往任何时候都更加严重地暴露于股市波动之下。
en: And when it does, pension funds and insurance companies will be more exposed than ever before to volatility in the equity markets.

zh: 股市过热恰逢人口趋势不利于退休基金。
en: This overexposure comes at a time when demographic trends are working against pension funds.

zh: 比如，在德国，20%的人口年龄超过65岁，工作年龄成年人将从今天的5,000万左右下降到2060年的3,400万。
en: In Germany, for example, where 20% of the population is older than 65, the number of working-age adults will shrink from about 50 million today to as few as 34 million by 2060.

zh: 而在你新兴市场，预期寿命的快速增长和生育率的下降可能让中国60岁以上人口比例在2050年翻一番 — — 这意味着五亿不事生产的退休者需要支持。
en: Among emerging markets, rapidly rising life expectancy and plunging fertility are likely to double the share of China’s over-60 population by 2050 – adding roughly a half-billion people who require support in their unproductive years.

zh: 如果股市的严重损失和赡养比的增加所形成的合力导致退休基金难以兑付，那么就必须由政府提供安全网 — — 如果它们可以的话。
en: If the combined effect of steep losses in equity markets and rising dependency ratios cause pension funds to struggle to meet their obligations, it will be up to governments to provide safety nets – if they can.

zh: 2007年，政府债务占全球GDP之比年化增长率高达9.3 % 。
en: Government debt as a percentage of global GDP has increased at an annual rate of 9.3% since 2007.

zh: 比如，在欧洲，希腊绝非唯一一个不堪债务重负的国家。
en: In Europe, for example, Greece is not the only country drowning in debt.

zh: 2014年，整个欧元区的债务水平继续攀升，达到GDP的近92 % — —是1999年开始使用欧元以来的最高值。
en: In 2014, debt levels throughout the eurozone continued to climb, reaching nearly 92% of GDP – the highest since the single currency’s introduction in 1999.

zh: 如果退休基金和政府都无法为老年人提供养老金，那么整个欧洲大陆的各国可能面临日益严重的社会动荡 — — 即希腊闹剧的放大版。
en: If pensions and governments both prove unable to provide for the elderly, countries across the continent could experience rising social instability – a broader version of the saga playing out in Greece.

zh: 自七年前金融危机爆发以来，新金融之王在诸多目标上都取得了成功。
en: The new Lords of Finance have arguably been successful in many of their objectives since the financial crisis erupted seven years ago.

zh: 因此他们理应得到赞美。
en: For this, they deserve credit.

zh: 但是，当仅仅情况发生时，大规模政策应对措施永远会产生意料外的后果，这些后果常常成为下一场大危机的祸根。
en: But, when an emergency strikes, large-scale policy responses always produce unintended consequences typically sowing the seeds for the next full-blown crisis.

zh: 从最近的市场动荡看，现在的问题是下一场危机是不是已经开始了。
en: Given recent market turmoil, the question now is whether the next crisis has already begun.

zh: 达尔富尔的黑暗
en: Darkness at Darfur

zh: 达尔富尔成了国际问题重复出现的最新代名词，同样的问题10年前在卢旺达就登上了头版头条。
en: Darfur is shorthand for the latest example of a recurring international problem, one that gained headlines a decade ago in Rwanda.

zh: 如果很多人成了国内暴力活动的牺牲品，那么世界应该做何反应？
en: What should the world do when a large number of people are the victims of violence originating from within their own country?

zh: 达尔富尔位于苏丹西部，其人口由阿拉伯和非洲穆斯林构成。
en: Darfur itself is a region of Western Sudan comprised of Arab and African Muslims.

zh: 2003年初这里爆发了冲突，苏丹解放运动的起义军对政府军发动了袭击，以扩大自治权，为该地区争取更多的经济利益。
en: Conflict erupted in early 2003 when rebels of the Sudan Liberation Movement attacked government troops in an effort to gain greater autonomy and resources for their region.

zh: 苏丹政府的飞机管辖的军队（外界称之为Jangaweed）不仅报复性地袭击了武装叛乱分子，还殃及了本该支持他们的达尔富尔平民。
en: Sudan government aircraft and government-supported troops (known as jangaweed) retaliated against not only armed rebels but also against civilians deemed to be supporting them.

zh: 无数村庄被清洗、妇女被强奸、非阿拉伯种族被屠杀。
en: Villages have been emptied, women raped, non-Arab men killed.

zh: 目前的危机可能源于某些冲突，可代价却并非如此。
en: The origins of the current crisis may be in some dispute, but the costs are not.

zh: 已经有50，000多名男子、妇女和儿童丢掉了性命，150多万人无家可归。
en: More than 50,000 men, women and children have lost their lives; more than 1.5 million have been made homeless.

zh: 这甚至可以称得上是种族灭绝，美国政府就是这么定义达尔富尔事件的，但大多数国家并没有这么认为。
en: This is arguably genocide, a word used by the U.S. government but by few others to describe what is going on in Darfur.

zh: 与此同时，世界领袖们正在争论如果采取措施会是怎样一种情况。
en: Meanwhile, world leaders are debating what if anything should be done.

zh: 联合国安理会2004年9月18日通过了1564号决议，把大部分矛头指向了苏丹政府。
en: UN Security Council Resolution 1564, passed on 18 September 2004, reserves the bulk of its criticism for the government of Sudan.

zh: 但联合国还没有纸面以外的计划。
en: But the UN is not yet prepared to go beyond words.

zh: 决议威胁说安理会可能考虑对苏丹领导人或该国重要的石油工业进行制裁，但现在还没落实任何处罚措施。
en: The resolution threatens that the Security Council will consider imposing sanctions against Sudanese leaders or against the country’s important oil sector, but introduces no penalties at this time.

zh: 为什么要犹豫呢？
en: Why the hesitation?

zh: 这里最重要的原因恐怕是国际社会都不愿插手别国政府的国内事务。
en: More than anything else it stems from international reluctance to challenge any government over what it is doing within its own territory.

zh: 这反映了人们普遍接受的主权观，这种观念使政府在自己国内几乎可以为所欲为。
en: This reflects a widely-held view of sovereignty, one that allows governments to do essentially what they want within their own borders.

zh: 这种观念既过时又不恰当。
en: Such thinking is inadequate and outmoded.

zh: 首先，这涉及道德因素，在自己的同类遭受杀戮的时候别过头去本身就是错误的。
en: To begin with, there is a moral element. There is something wrong in looking the other way when one’s fellow human being is being slaughtered.

zh: 我们都须要对彼此负起最基本的责任。
en: We all have some basic obligation to one another.

zh: 此外也有实用主义的考虑。
en: There are as well pragmatic considerations.

zh: 在全球化社会里，一个国家发生的事情很容易影响到其它国家。
en: In a global world, what happens within one country can all too easily affect others.

zh: 举个例子，逃离苏丹的难民会对邻国乍得的稳定构成威胁。
en: For example, refugees leaving Sudan can strain the stability of neighboring Chad.

zh: 反对种族清洗和其它针对某个群体的大规模暴力活动也反映了一个约定俗成的原则：那就是公民和政府都有自己的权利。
en: Opposition to genocide and other large-scale acts of violence against a population also reflects the established principle that citizens as well as governments have rights.

zh: 这项原则被写入了很多国际文件，其中最早的是1948年发表的《世界人权宣言 》 。
en: This principle is enshrined in various international documents, beginning with the 1948 Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

zh: 不该容许政府屠杀自己的百姓，也不该容许弱小的政府看着屠杀民众的事情发生而坐视不理，即便他们自己没有参与屠杀。
en: Governments ought not to be allowed to massacre their own people. And weak governments should not be allowed to permit massacres to take place on their own territory even if they are not themselves carrying out the massacre.

zh: 总的来讲，这意味着国家主权的非绝对化。
en: What all this adds up to is a requirement for a concept of state sovereignty that is less than absolute.

zh: 准确的讲，我们也要对主权实行契约制，也就是既承认所有者的责任与义务，也保护他们所享有的权利。
en: To be precise, we need to embrace a contractual approach to sovereignty, one that recognizes the obligations and responsibilities as well as the rights of those who enjoy it.

zh: 这样的主权观实质上会告诉政府和它们的领袖，享有与主权相关的保护和权利是有条件的，如果他们没尽到自己的义务，那么就会相应地丧失部分、乃至在极端状况下，全部的保护和权利。
en: Such an approach to sovereignty would essentially communicate to governments and their leaders that the rights and protections they associate with statehood are in fact conditional, and that governments and leaders would forfeit some or, in extreme cases, all of these rights and protections if they failed to meet their obligations.

zh: 如果国际社会不是仅停留在口头宣传、而是准备好接受一切必要的后果，那么这种观念就会产生影响，那就是：保护无辜的生命免遭大规模杀戮是其它国家乃至全世界的权利和责任。
en: This idea will only have an impact if the international community is prepared to go beyond voicing this principle and accept the necessary consequence: that other states and the world at large have a right and a duty to act to protect innocent life when it is jeopardized on a large scale.

zh: 国际社会对波斯尼亚、科索沃、东帝汶等地区人道主义干涉行动的普遍支持就体现了这样的趋势。
en: Some movement in just this direction was suggested by widespread international support for the humanitarian interventions in Bosnia, Kosovo, and East Timor.

zh: 上述变化的另一标志是修改了非洲联盟的基本文件 （ 《 基本法案 》 ） ，非盟成立于2000年7月，代替了效率低下的非统组织行使地区管理的职能。
en: Another sign of change is the basic document (“Constitutive Act”) of the African Union, the regional organization launched in July 2000 to replace the ineffective Organization of African Unity.

zh: 在表明互不干涉别国内政的基本原则后，文件接着宣布了"如果成员国大会由于战争犯罪、种族清洗和人道主义犯罪等严重局势做出相应的决策，则非盟保留干预其成员国内部事务的权利。
en: After citing the principle of non-interference by one member state in the internal affairs of another, the document goes on to declare “the right of the Union to intervene in a member state pursuant to a decision of the assembly in respect of grave circumstances, namely war crimes, genocide and crimes against humanity.”

zh: "这种情况下的干预可以采取任何形式，包括公开声明、秘密外交、经济政治制裁直至武装干涉。
en: Intervention in such circumstances can take any number of forms, from public rhetoric and private diplomacy to economic and political sanctions to armed intervention.

zh: 说了这些以后，我们再回到达尔富尔，我们能做什么？
en: All of which brings us back to Darfur. What needs doing?

zh: 那里流离失所的人民迫切需要我们的帮助，那些从冲突中侥幸逃生的人们如果不想倒毙在疾病和饥饿之下，就需要我们伸出援手。
en: There is a need for massive assistance to the displaced people of Darfur. Those who have survived conflict require help if they are not to succumb to disease and starvation.

zh: 我们还要继续进行外交努力，以实现持久停火，而后还要拿出解决方案，彻底铲除造成这次危机的主要根源。
en: There is also every reason to renew diplomatic efforts to bring about a lasting cease-fire and, following that, a settlement that addresses the grievances that helped bring about this crisis in the first place.

zh: 但还要强调两点。
en: Two other points require highlighting, though.

zh: 第一点，按照联合国安理会第1564号决议，各国要为非盟提供所需的后勤、物质及资金援助。
en: First, and consistent with UN Security Council Resolution 1564, countries should provide the African Union with the logistical, material, and financial help it has asked for.

zh: 有了这些援助，非盟授权的部队就可以保护难民营、今后还要保护普通的村庄，让男人、女人和孩子们安全地重返家园。
en: With such support, AU-authorized troops could guard the refugee camps and, over time, protect villages so that men, women and children could return home in safety.

zh: 其次，联合国应该兑现自己的承诺，对苏丹政府实施制裁，除非它停止用飞机轰炸村庄、停止为Jangaweed提供支持。
en: Second, the UN ought to make good on its threat and impose sanctions against the Sudanese government unless it stops using its aircraft to destroy villages and unless it stops supporting the jangaweed.

zh: 此外还要对不听命令的具体官员提出战争罪起诉。
en: Criminal indictments for war crimes ought to be issued against specific officials who do not comply.

zh: 全世界一定得行动起来，这不仅是为了拯救达尔富尔的人民，而且是为了防止达尔富尔惨剧在未来重演。
en: It is important that the world act, not simply to save the people of Darfur, but to prevent future Darfurs.

zh: 这关系到无数无辜者的生命。
en: A great deal of innocent human life depends on it.

zh: 白俄罗斯：黑夜还是黎明？
en: Darkness or Dawn in Belarus?

zh: 发自华盛顿特区 — — 随着民主浪潮席卷整个阿拉伯地区，白俄罗斯这块欧洲前苏联阵营最后阵地的形势也急剧恶化 — — 总统亚历山大·卢卡申科于去年12月暴力镇压大选后示威活动并将9位反对他的总统候选人中的7位投入监狱。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – As pro-democracy protests sweep the Arab world, Belarus, Europe’s grim quasi-Soviet redoubt, has taken a turn for the worse since President Aleksander Lukashenko violently suppressed post-election demonstrations in December and imprisoned seven of the nine candidates who stood against him.

zh: 而在世界各国及地区政府 — — 尤其是欧盟 — — 对此作出回应之时，他们应当将卢卡申科的残酷镇压视为一个重要的转折点：该政权已经无法获得民众的支持，并被迫面对其腐朽落后的社会经济模式所导致的恶果了。
en: But, as Western governments – and European Union government, in particular – respond, they should view Lukashenko’s brutal crackdown as a major turning point: the moment when the regime could no longer claim popular support and was forced to confront the failure of its antediluvian socioeconomic model.

zh: 卢卡申科的政权是构筑在三大基础之上的：首先是政府承诺维护民族独立并确保民众至少能拥有一份低收入，而“交易”的筹码则是要民众默许独裁统治；其次是一个不断灌输这种价值观和“交易”必要性的宣传机器；最后则是具体执行这一“交易”的庞大特务机关。
en: Lukashenko’s regime has rested on three pillars: a social contract that promises national independence and a guaranteed low income in exchange for tacit consent to dictatorial rule; a propaganda machine that reinforces the value and necessity of this deal; and a massive security apparatus to enforce it.

zh: 或许在1994年卢卡申科首次上台并执政至今的这十几年间，大多数白俄罗斯人确实认同过这种统治，因为他们相信这样能令自己不致遭遇邻国俄罗斯的那种“东方式的疯狂资本主义”所引发的乱象：腐败丛生的私有化，失业和黑手党统治。
en: For many years after Lukashenko was first elected, in 1994 (he has ruled without interruption ever since), most Belarusians did perhaps tolerate the regime, because they believed that it protected them from the worst excesses of neighboring Russia’s “Wild East” capitalism: corrupt privatization, job losses, and mafia rule.

zh: 但随着时间的流逝以及白俄罗斯人逐渐了解西方，对卢卡申科的信任就再也无法维系下去了。
en: But, over time, and with more Belarusians traveling to the West, belief in Lukashenko’s leadership has become unsustainable.

zh: 民众的工资水平比官方公布的数字要低得多 — — 大概每月只有200~300美元。
en: Wages are much lower than official figures suggest – perhaps as low as $200-300 per month.

zh: 失业率仅0.7 % ， 但主要原因是那些在劳动部门注册的失业者都被发配去一些每月只有10~15美元报酬的社会服务工作。
en: The unemployment rate is 0.7%, but largely because those who register at labor offices are put to work in community-service jobs paying $10-15 per month.

zh: 物价极高，因为政府限制贸易并扶持那些效率极低的国有企业。
en: Prices are high, owing to trade restrictions and government support for inefficient state enterprises.

zh: 官方公布的2010年经济增长率为7.6 % ， 但主要来自于为卢卡申科竞选连任造势的大规模财政支出 — — 须知整个国家经济的2/3都是由国有企业构成 — — 而这个数字自那以后就大幅下降，也没人说得清楚究竟下降了多少。
en: Economic growth, pumped up during the run-up to the presidential election by enormous fiscal spending – two-thirds of the economy is state-owned – was officially 7.6% in 2010, but the rate has plummeted since, though no one is saying by how much.

zh: 尽管过去在维持基本生活水平上取得了成功，但当前的现实就是白俄罗斯早已无法赶上蒸蒸日上的邻国了。
en: Whatever its past successes in maintaining basic living standards, today it is evident that Belarus cannot match its neighbors’ dynamism.

zh: 虽然有许多退休人员和一些工人对卢卡申科的统治表示满意，但许多年轻人和受过教育的人都在去年12月的大选中投了反对票 — — 大量证据显示总统只获得了全部票数中的不到50%
en: While many pensioners and some workers remain content with life under Lukashenko, young people, and those with the most education and talent, voted against him in December – and much evidence suggests that he won less than 50%.

zh: 这个现实显然对总统脆弱的自尊造成了打击。
en: That, apparently, was too much for the president’s fragile ego.

zh: 在不断的镇压和西方逐渐增多的抗议声中，卢卡申科在1月的就职演说中声称自己不会容忍对“稳定”的任何威胁。
en: Amid mounting repression and growing Western protest, Lukashenko vowed in his inauguration address in January that he would tolerate no threat to “stability.”

zh: 但卢卡申科也不是个傻子。
en: And yet Lukashenko is no fool.

zh: 他或许不会尊重选举的结果，但也无法忽视最近这场大选所反映出的政权极端不受欢迎的现实。
en: He might not respect the outcome of elections, but he cannot afford to ignore what the last one revealed about the depths of his regime’s unpopularity.

zh: 他所面临的问题是执政合法性的极大流失，而这意味着单靠镇压已经无法解决问题了。
en: His problem is the regime’s utter loss of legitimacy, which means that repression will not be enough.

zh: 为此卢卡申科需要与白俄罗斯人谈一场新的“交易 ” ， 其中的内容也是他盘算好的：经济上的现代化与政治上的“稳定 ” 。
en: He needs to strike a new bargain with Belarusians, and he knows it: economic modernization with political “stability.”

zh: “交易”的第一步将在今年展开。
en: The first steps will be taken this year.

zh: 当局目前只能依赖国内臃肿而低效的工业来维持就业率，这大概是因为政府的大部分财政收入都是来自于自然资源贸易（主要是提炼俄罗斯原油以及国内的钾矿）以及将俄罗斯石油天然气输往欧洲的运费。
en: The regime currently operates a bloated, inefficient industrial sector to maintain employment, which is possible because the government derives most of its revenue from natural-resources trade (mainly refined Russian oil and domestic potash deposits) and transit fees for deliveries of Russian oil and natural gas to Europe.

zh: 如今卢卡申科寄望于利用民间创业和外国直接投资来实现经济现代化。
en: Yet now, Lukashenko wishes to harness entrepreneurship and foreign direct investment in a bid to modernize the economy.

zh: 白俄罗斯已经拥有了一个据报年纯收入达3亿美元的新生软件工业。
en: Belarus already has a budding software industry that reports net annual revenues of $300 million.

zh: 同时在奥地利和世界银行的支持下，政府正在起草一个覆盖大多数本国主要国有企业的私有化项目。
en: And, with Austrian money and World Bank support, officials are drawing up a privatization program that will cover a significant proportion of the country’s mainly state-owned industry.

zh: 虽然没有列明具体将出售哪些企业，但政府也已宣布将出售巨型钾肥生产商“白俄罗斯钾肥生产联合体”25%的股份。
en: While the specific companies to be sold have not been announced, the government has indicated that it would sell a 25% share of the giant potash producer Belaruskali.

zh: 卢卡申科希望这种大规模的经济改革能赢得西方的支持，平息国内外的批评，并在专制统治下实现经济现代化。
en: Lukashenko hopes that dramatic economic reforms will win Western support, disarm foreign and domestic critics, and achieve economic modernization under authoritarian rule.

zh: 但他可能因此触怒那些下岗工人并助长效率低下的权贵资本，而如果改革步伐太慢的话又无法满足那些投票反对（以及上街抗议）他的人。
en: But he risks angering laid-off workers and empowering inefficient crony capitalists, while moving too slowly to satisfy the desires of those who voted (and took to the streets to protest) against him.

zh: 更何况白俄罗斯又不是中国那��举足轻重的大国，后者的政府即便胡作非为也没人敢惩罚它。
en: And Belarus is no China: it is not too big to be punished for its government’s behavior.

zh: 但西方对白俄罗斯的政策也必须进行小心调整，并应当将重点放在欧洲的软实力上 — — 也就是其社会模式对白俄罗斯人的吸引力。
en: Yet Western policy towards Belarus must be carefully modulated, and it should emphasize Europe’s soft power – the attractiveness of its social model to an increasing number of Belarusians.

zh: 西方需要在反对该政权残酷统治的同时与其民众培养感情并投资于该国经济，如果私有化进程顺利的话这一切都将更容易推行。
en: The West needs to cultivate relations with these people and invest in the economy, while rejecting the brutality of the regime, which may become easier if privatization moves ahead.

zh: 而签证政策将是该方案的重要组成部分。
en: Visa policy will be a big part of the solution.

zh: 白俄罗斯人目前需要在申请欧盟签证时支付60欧元，这相对于当地的低收入来说堪称一大障碍。
en: Belarusians currently pay €60 for an EU tourist visa, which is a major obstacle in view of low wages.

zh: 波兰已经宣布将向白俄罗斯申请者免费颁发签证，但同时也拒绝颁发签证给（据波兰官方宣称）参与了最近大选舞弊的一大批白俄罗斯官员。
en: Poland has announced that it will grant Belarusians visas at no cost, while denying visas to a long list of regime officials that it says were involved in the recent electoral fraud.

zh: 其他欧盟国家也采取了相关制裁，但在放宽白俄罗斯居民签证待遇方面暂时还无所作为。
en: The rest of the EU has followed suit on sanctions against top officials, but could do more to liberalize travel for citizens.

zh: 此外在经济方面的合作则充满争议。
en: Economic engagement is more controversial.

zh: 有人认为投资白俄罗斯就是助纣为虐，但这同时也有助于一个民主白俄罗斯的最终实现。
en: Investment in Belarus arguably strengthens the regime, but it also may be necessary for the eventual emergence of a democratic Belarus.

zh: 私人之间的交易也应当鼓励，而波兰这样的国家对白俄罗斯反对派的支持力度也应该加大。
en: Person-to-person exchanges should also be encouraged, and the support that countries like Poland give to the Belarusian opposition should be stepped up.

zh: 一言以蔽之：白俄罗斯的普通民众和被镇压的受害者无疑亟待帮助，但这个日薄西山的政权也是需要有人扶它一把，而西方也应该最大限度地在这一点上做文章。
en: The bottom line is this: Belarus’s ordinary people and victims of repression need help today. But so does its decrepit regime.

zh: 达尔文，最伟大的心理学家
en: Darwin, the Greatest Psychologist

zh: 科罗纳多，加利福尼亚—大部分人不会把达尔文看做是心理学家。
en: CORONADO, CALIFORNIA – Most people do not think of Charles Darwin as a psychologist.

zh: 事实上，他的工作开启了这一领域的革命。
en: In fact, his work revolutionized the field.

zh: 在达尔文之前，哲学猜测主宰着我们的心理学理解。
en: Before Darwin, philosophical speculation shaped our psychological understanding.

zh: 但即使是伟大的哲学家 — — 柏拉图、亚里士多德、霍布斯、休谟、洛克、康德、叔本华、尼采等 — — 也只能描述当下的精神事件和行为；而不能解释它们的原因。
en: But even great philosophers – Plato, Aristotle, Hobbes, Hume, Locke, Kant, Schopenhauer, Nietzsche, and others – could only describe current mental events and behaviors; they could not explain their causes.

zh: 达尔文提出了深刻的洞见 — — 进化对我们观念的影响与对我们身体的影响一样大。
en: Darwin provided the profound understanding that evolution has influenced the shape of our minds as strongly as it has the shape of our bodies.

zh: 他认为，既然人类是从与现代黑猩猩和大猩猩共有的始祖进化而来的，那么将人类的本能、情感和行为与那些动物相比较应该能比主观猜测学到更多东西。
en: Since humans evolved from the same primate ancestor as modern chimpanzees or gorillas, he suggested one could learn more by comparing human instincts, emotions, and behaviors to those of animals than one can surmise from subjective speculation.

zh: 达尔文说 ， “ 理解了狒狒，你就比洛克更接近形而上学。 ”
en: As he put it, “he who understands baboon would do more towards metaphysics than Locke.”

zh: 哲学不足以理解人类心理的根源，因为自我思考不能使我们知晓我们大部分对环境的反应的背后驱动力。
en: Philosophy is inadequate to understand the roots of human psychology, because self-reflection does not make us aware of the forces that drive most of our reactions to the environment.

zh: 相反，我们受天生倾向的控制，而天生倾向是通过自然和性选择的互惠影响力量发展出来的。
en: Rather, we are subject to inborn tendencies, which develop through the reciprocally influential forces of natural and sexual selection.

zh: 自然选择是同一物种中最能适应环境的群体赢得生殖竞争的过程 — — 直至出现更加适应的群体。
en: Natural selection is the process by which the variants within a species that are best adapted to survive in their environment win the reproductive contest – at least until an even better-adapted variant comes along.

zh: 让人们得以果腹和保护自己的特征增加了我们活得足够长能生育后代，并且把后代哺育和保护直至成年的可能性。
en: The traits that enable people to feed and protect themselves increase the likelihood that they will live long enough to produce offspring, whom they will be able to feed and protect until maturity.

zh: 从某种程度上说，性选择是自然选择的心理延伸。
en: In a sense, sexual selection is the psychological extension of natural selection.

zh: 但是，我们并没有从增加我们生存能力的特征中获得优势，而是从潜在伴侣进化出来的寻找吸引力的品质中获得优势。
en: But, instead of gaining an advantage from traits that enhance one’s ability to survive, one gains an advantage from qualities that potential mates have evolved to find appealing.

zh: 由于人类性选择决定了谁能有最多的后代，从而反过来决定了那些生理和心理特征更能传递下去，因此无助于个人生存的特征仍可能提供生殖优势，从而传递给后代。
en: Given that humans’ sexual choices determine who reproduces most and, in turn, which physical and psychological features are favored over time, a trait that may not help a person to survive can still provide a reproductive advantage that is passed along to offspring.

zh: 换句话说，在选择伴侣的过程中，我们决定了进化的进程。
en: In other words, in choosing a mate, one shapes the course of evolution.

zh: 此外，性选择的原理意味着，除了调节生体机能，神经系统还间接地影响身体和精神的结构结构（比如装饰性特征 ） 、 认知技能（比如音乐天赋）和性格（比如勇气和毅力）的进步发展。
en: Moreover, the principle of sexual selection implies that, in addition to regulating bodily functions, the nervous system indirectly influences the progressive development of bodily and mental structures such as ornamental appendages; cognitive skills like musical ability; and characteristics such as courage and perseverance.

zh: 雄孔雀进化出了色彩斑斓的长尾，唯一原因是雌孔雀进化出了以此判断吸引力的功能。
en: Peacocks have evolved to have long, colorful feathers simply because peahens have evolved to find them attractive.

zh: 达尔文解释道，这些品质是通过“运用选择、爱慕和嫉妒的影响以及声音、色彩和形状方面的审美”而代际传递并强化的。
en: Darwin explained that such qualities are propagated and enhanced over generations, through “the exertion of choice, the influence of love and jealousy, and the appreciation of the beautiful in sound, color, or form.”

zh: 事实上，虽说自然选择是盲目的，但性选择是追求美的 — — 尽管情人眼里出西施。
en: Indeed, while natural selection is blind, sexual selection has an eye for beauty – although the nature of beauty is always in the eye of the beholder.

zh: 人类心理学是通过有时并不容易的自然和性选择平衡发展出来的，因此进化和心理会相互影响和互动。
en: Given that human psychology has developed through a sometimes-uneasy balance of natural and sexual selection, evolution and psychology influence and interact with each other.

zh: 达尔文在理解人类心理方面的贡献包括仔细研究了儿童发育，并发表在1877年的《一个婴儿的白描 》 （ Biographical Sketch of an Infant）上。
en: Darwin’s contributions to understanding human psychology involved careful study of child development, which he reported in 1877 in “Biographical Sketch of an Infant.”

zh: 在他长子威廉（William）出生后的第一个三年中，达尔文以博物学家的老道眼光观察他，记录他的各项发育，从眼睛追逐蜡烛的能力到第一次有意识的动作的发生无所不包。
en: For the first three years of his first-born son William’s life, Darwin observed him with the practiced eye of a naturalist, recording developments as diverse as his ability to follow a candle with his eyes to the first manifestations of conscience.

zh: 达尔文还率先开发了科学心理学的实验工具，比如用脸部表情照片和调查研究人类情感的普遍性。
en: Darwin also pioneered the experimental tools of scientific psychology, such as the use of photographs of facial expressions and surveys to determine the universality of human emotions.

zh: 达尔文在认定自然选择才是进化机制之前便已做出了他的大部分心理学发现，但他等了35年才发表自己的发现。
en: Darwin had already made most of his major psychological discoveries even before he identified natural selection as the mechanism of evolution – but he waited 35 years before publishing his findings.

zh: 这一决定部分是因为他一丝不苟的研究精神，包括在发表理论之前细心收���和研究证据。
en: This decision can be partly attributed to his meticulous approach to research, which entailed carefully collecting and studying evidence before presenting theories.

zh: 但达尔文也知道，既然连他都需要时间接受自己的结论，世界其余部分自然难以面对如此唯物主义的人性观。
en: But Darwin also knew that, if he needed time to accept his own conclusions, the rest of the world was not ready to face such a materialist view of humanity.

zh: 他对难免的批评敬而远之 — — 其中不乏来自朋友和同事者。
en: He shied away from the inevitable confrontation with critics – among whom were friends and colleagues.

zh: 达尔文去世时，他的思想已经在心理学家和神经科学家中间形成了重大影响 — — 尽管他有时并没有完全意识到这一点。
en: By the time Darwin died, his ideas had gained significant influence among psychologists and neuroscientists – even if they did not always fully realize it.

zh: 弗洛伊德从未见过达尔文，但他的导师大多是狂热的达尔文主义者。
en: Sigmund Freud never met Darwin, but most of his mentors were enthusiastic Darwinists.

zh: 正如牛顿以“站在巨人肩膀上”掀起了天文学和物理学革命，弗洛伊德在达尔文的革命性洞见的基础上理解了心理症侯、梦、传说、艺术、人类学和其他很多方面。
en: Just as Isaac Newton revolutionized astronomy and physics by “standing on the shoulders” of his predecessors, Freud built on Darwin’s evolutionary insights in order to understand psychological symptoms, dreams, myths, art, anthropology, and much more.

zh: 弗洛伊德的传记作者琼斯（Ernest Jones）错误地称弗洛伊德为“心理界的达尔文 ” 。
en: Freud’s biographer, Ernest Jones, was mistaken in calling Freud “the Darwin of the mind.”

zh: 达尔文本人才是心理界的达尔文；弗洛伊德只是达尔文的伟大普及者。
en: Darwin himself was the Darwin of the mind; Freud was his great popularizer.

zh: 自达尔文以来，心理学的范围扩大了很多，引入了复杂的认知科学、控制论和大脑造影技术。
en: Since Darwin, academic psychology has expanded significantly, enriched by the sophisticated tools of cognitive science, cybernetics, and brain imaging.

zh: 但这些发展只是达尔文革命性大模型的精细化衍生物。
en: But most of these developments have been derivative elaborations of Darwin’s grand evolutionary model.

zh: 我们关于人类本能的概念的基础全部可以在达尔文175年前不到30岁时写的笔记中找到。
en: The fundamentals of our conception of human nature can all be found in Darwin’s notebooks, written 175 years ago and before his thirtieth birthday.

zh: 大数据的隐患
en: The Hidden Danger of Big Data

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 在博弈论中，无秩序主义的代价描述了在大规模体系中追求自身利益的个人如何倾向于降低整个系统的效率。
en: CAMBRIDGE – In game theory, the “price of anarchy” describes how individuals acting in their own self-interest within a larger system tend to reduce that larger system’s efficiency.

zh: 这种现象普遍存在，几乎所有人都无法避免经常会以某种形式面对。
en: It is a ubiquitous phenomenon, one that almost all of us confront, in some form, on a regular basis.

zh: 举例来讲，如果你是一位负责交通管理的城市规划师，解决所在城市的交通问题可以采用两种方式。
en: For example, if you are a city planner in charge of traffic management, there are two ways you can address traffic flows in your city.

zh: 一般人会选择一种自上而下的集中方法 — — 即深入理解整套系统、找出瓶颈并通过修改加以消除 — — 这种方法比让个体司机在路上做出选择更加有效，个体选择背后的假设是这些选择总体而言能够产生可以接受的结果。
en: Generally, a centralized, top-down approach – one that comprehends the entire system, identifies choke points, and makes changes to eliminate them – will be more efficient than simply letting individual drivers make their own choices on the road, with the assumption that these choices, in aggregate, will lead to an acceptable outcome.

zh: 第一种方式降低了无秩序主义的代价，并充分利用了一切可用的信息。
en: The first approach reduces the cost of anarchy and makes better use of all available information.

zh: 今天的世界到处都是数据。
en: The world today is awash in data.

zh: 仅2015年一年，人类就创造了与此前人类文明同样多的信息。
en: In 2015, mankind produced as much information as was created in all previous years of human civilization.

zh: 每次我们发送邮件、拨打电话或完成交易，我们都会留下数字痕迹。
en: Every time we send a message, make a call, or complete a transaction, we leave digital traces.

zh: 我们正在迅速接近意大利作家卡尔维诺明确预言的“全球记忆状态 ” ， 完整复制我们物质宇宙的全部信息。
en: We are quickly approaching what Italian writer Italo Calvino presciently called the “memory of the world”: a full digital copy of our physical universe.

zh: 随着互联网拓展至物联网实体空间等全新领域，无秩序主义代价将成为社会关键指标，利用大数据分析消灭无秩序主义将越来越具有诱惑力。
en: As the Internet expands into new realms of physical space through the Internet of Things, the price of anarchy will become a crucial metric in our society, and the temptation to eliminate it with the power of big data analytics will grow stronger.

zh: 这样的例子比比皆是。
en: Examples of this abound.

zh: 比方说在亚马逊网上熟悉的买书经历。
en: Consider the familiar act of buying a book online through Amazon.

zh: 亚马逊掌握从个人资料到搜索记录再到电子书中标注过的重点词句等全部用户的海量信息 — — 并利用这些信息来预测用户下次要购买什么样的书籍。
en: Amazon has a mountain of information about all of its users – from their profiles to their search histories to the sentences they highlight in e-books – which it uses to predict what they might want to buy next.

zh: 就像一切形式的集中人工智能一样，人们用过去的模式来预测未来的模式。
en: As in all forms of centralized artificial intelligence, past patterns are used to forecast future ones.

zh: 亚马逊可以调阅你此前购买的10本书，并且越来越准确的提出你可能希望阅读的下一本书的建议。
en: Amazon can look at the last ten books you purchased and, with increasing accuracy, suggest what you might want to read next.

zh: 但这里我们应当思考降低无秩序状态是否会有所失去。
en: But here we should consider what is lost when we reduce the level of anarchy.

zh: 看完前10本书后你最该读的不是完美符合既定模式的书，而是出乎预料或促使你以不同视角看待世界的书籍。
en: The most meaningful book you should read after those previous ten is not one that fits neatly into an established pattern, but rather one that surprises or challenges you to look at the world in a different way.

zh: 与上文提到交通流量的情况相反，优化建议 — — 往往构成你买下一本书的自我实现的预言 — — 或许并非你在线浏览书籍的最佳范例。
en: Contrary to the traffic-flow scenario described above, optimized suggestions – which often amount to a self-fulfilling prophecy of your next purchase – might not be the best paradigm for online book browsing.

zh: 大数据可以过滤掉我们不想看的事物并同时成倍增加我们的选择，但纯粹通过意外发现第十一本书其实非常值得一提。
en: Big data can multiply our options while filtering out things we don’t want to see, but there is something to be said for discovering that 11th book through pure serendipity.

zh: 适用于买书的思考也同样适用于城市和社会等正处在数字化过程中的其他众多体系。
en: What is true of book buying is also true for many other systems that are being digitized, such as our cities and societies.

zh: 集中市政系统现在利用算法来监控红绿灯、地铁应用、废物处理和能源输送在内的城市基础设施。
en: Centralized municipal systems now use algorithms to monitor urban infrastructure, from traffic lights and subway use, to waste disposal and energy delivery.

zh: 世界很多城市的市长都疯狂地迷上了里约热内卢由IBM设计的运营中心中央控制室，城市管理者可以在那里对最新信息实时作出反应。
en: Many mayors worldwide are fascinated by the idea of a central control room, such as Rio de Janeiro’s IBM-designed operations center, where city managers can respond to new information in real time.

zh: 但随着集中算法开始管理社会的方方面面，数据驱动的技术官僚正威胁压倒创新和民主体系。
en: But with centralized algorithms coming to manage every facet of society, data-driven technocracy is threatening to overwhelm innovation and democracy.

zh: 我们应当不惜一切代价避免这样的结局。
en: This outcome should be avoided at all costs.

zh: 分散决策对实现社会多元化必不可少。
en: Decentralized decision-making is crucial for the enrichment of society.

zh: 相反，数据驱动优化从事先预定的模式中得出解决方案，而这些方案在现阶段往往排除了推动人类前进的变革性或违反直觉的理念。
en: Data-driven optimization, conversely, derives solutions from a predetermined paradigm, which, in its current form, often excludes the transformational or counterintuitive ideas that propel humanity forward.

zh: 生活中一定数量的随机性可以导致原本并不存在的新理念或思维模式的产生。
en: A certain amount of randomness in our lives allows for new ideas or modes of thinking that would otherwise be missed.

zh: 而且从宏观角度，它对生活本身同样具有必要性。
en: And, on a macro scale, it is necessary for life itself.

zh: 如果自然界运用可以预测的算法防止DNA复制过程中的基因突变，那么我们这个星球可能仍然处在高度优化的单细胞生物阶段。
en: If nature had used predictive algorithms that prevented random mutation in the replication of DNA, our planet would probably still be at the stage of a very optimized single-cell organism.

zh: 分散式决策能够通过自然和人工共同演化创造人类和机器智能之间的协同作用。
en: Decentralized decision-making can create synergies between human and machine intelligence through processes of natural and artificial co-evolution.

zh: 分散性智能或许有时能够降低短期效率，但却最终能够导致更富创造力、更加多元、更有韧性的社会。
en: Distributed intelligence might sometimes reduce efficiency in the short term, but it will ultimately lead to a more creative, diverse, and resilient society.

zh: 如果我们想要保留意外创新能力，付出无秩序的代价其实非常值得。
en: The price of anarchy is a price well worth paying if we want to preserve innovation through serendipity.

zh: 我的最佳投资
en: My Best Investment

zh: 雅加达—小时候我的梦想是成为一名医生。
en: JAKARTA – When I was boy, I dreamed of becoming a doctor.

zh: 我出生于20世纪50年代初的印尼，当时的印尼大部分家庭无法获得医疗服务。
en: I was born in Indonesia in the early 1950’s, a time when most families in my country lacked access to health care.

zh: 因此，每年都有数千儿童因为麻疹、小儿麻痹症和疟疾等可预防的疾病而死亡。
en: As a result, thousands of children died each year from preventable diseases such as measles, polio, and malaria.

zh: 但医学的革命性突破正在扭转这些致命疾病，而医生在印尼被视为英雄。
en: But revolutionary breakthroughs in medicine were starting to turn the tide on these killers, and Indonesia’s doctors were celebrated as heroes.

zh: 我也想成为英雄，因此努力学习并进入了医学院。
en: I wanted to be a hero, too, so I studied hard and enrolled in medical school.

zh: 但在我父亲病倒后，我改变了计划。
en: My plans changed, however, when my father got ill.

zh: 他是个工作努力的人，在泗水市（Surabaya）做三轮车生意。 当他无法再管理家族企业时，我就从大学辍学了。
en: He was a hard-working man who made pedicabs in Surabaya, and I left university when he could no longer manage the family business.

zh: 最终我成��一名成功的企业家，建立了身为当今东南亚最大金融机构之一的银行。
en: Ultimately, I became a successful entrepreneur and established a bank that is now one of Southeast Asia’s largest financial institutions.

zh: 回头看，我并不后悔。
en: Looking back, I have no regrets.

zh: 事实上，我知道我是个名符其实的幸运儿。
en: Indeed, I know that I have been incredibly blessed.

zh: 非洲、亚洲和西太平洋发展中国家的数百万儿童因为父亲或母亲的病倒或离世而被迫忍受极端贫困。
en: Millions of children in developing countries in Africa, Asia, and the Western Pacific are forced into extreme poverty when a parent gets sick or dies.

zh: 还有数百万儿童因为疾病无法过上健康的、能为社会出力的生活。
en: And millions more suffer from diseases that prevent them from leading a healthy and productive life.

zh: 这就是我决定投资6500万美元给全球抗击艾滋病、结核病和疟疾基金（Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria，以下简称全球基金）的原因。
en: That is why I have decided to invest $65 million in the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria.

zh: 全球基金成立于十年前，当时艾滋病正在全球蔓延，治疗艾滋病毒的药物极其昂贵。
en: When the Global Fund was created a decade ago, HIV incidence was rising around the world, and the drugs used to treat the virus were still prohibitively expensive.

zh: 疟疾每年要夺走数百万人的生命，其中绝大多数是孕妇和五岁以下儿童。
en: Malaria was killing one million people each year, with mortality concentrated among pregnant women and children under the age of five.

zh: 因肺结核而死的人数超过两百万，因为他们得不到廉价的优质治疗。
en: More than two million people were dying from tuberculosis, because they lacked access to low-cost, first-line treatment.

zh: 自成立以来，全球基金在扭转这些传染病局面方面起到了关键作用。
en: Since then, the Global Fund has played a key role in reversing the course of these epidemics.

zh: 在全球层面，艾滋病感染率下降了三分之一，抗艾滋病药物成本下降了99%以上。
en: Worldwide, HIV incidence has fallen by one-third, and the cost of HIV drugs has dropped more than 99%.

zh: 可以睡在杀虫蚊帐里的非洲家庭比例从3%增加到53 % ， 疟疾致死人数也下降了三分之一。
en: The number of African households that sleep under insecticide-treated bed nets has risen from 3% to 53%, and malaria deaths have fallen by one-third.

zh: 结核病致死人数下降了40%多。
en: And TB mortality has dropped more than 40%.

zh: 总而言之，全球基金的支持挽救了九百多万人的生命 — — 了不起的成就。
en: Altogether, support provided by the Global Fund has saved more than nine million lives – a remarkable achievement.

zh: 但全球基金的影响力远不止于拯救生命。
en: But the impact of the Global Fund extends far beyond lives saved.

zh: 当一位艾滋病毒阳性母亲得到了产前治疗，因而她的孩子可以不带着艾滋病出世时，我们就创造了历史。
en: When an HIV-positive mother receives antenatal treatment so that her child can be born HIV-free, we change the future.

zh: 当一名儿童免于脑型疟疾及其所可能造成的终身智力残疾时，我们就创造了新希望。
en: When a child is spared cerebral malaria and the lifelong mental disabilities that it can cause, new possibilities are created.

zh: 当我们致力于让孩子们获得更好的人生起点时，我们就在创造更好的世界。
en: The world becomes a better place when we commit to giving our children a better start.

zh: 全球基金在强化发展中国家医疗方面也起到了关键作用。
en: The Global Fund also plays a critical role in strengthening health care in developing countries.

zh: 全球基金资源协助培训了一代又一代新医生、护士和技术专家，同时大大改善了产妇和儿童医疗的总体质量。
en: Its resources have helped to train new generations of doctors, nurses, and technicians, while dramatically improving the overall quality of maternal and child health.

zh: 这些投资帮助各国在与传染病的斗争中掌握了自己的命运，最终减少了它们对外国援助的依赖。
en: These investments are helping countries take direct ownership of the fight against infectious disease, ultimately reducing their dependence on foreign aid.

zh: 比如，来自全球基金的支持帮助全世界结核病负担第四高的印尼发展出高能高效的全国结核病控制计划。
en: For example, support from the Global Fund has helped Indonesia, which has the world’s fourth-highest TB burden, develop an efficient and effective national TB-control program.

zh: 结果，一百多万例活跃病症得到了成功治疗，致死病例 — — 造成印尼经济生产率损失的程度高达数百万美元 — — 也有所减少。
en: As a result, more than one million active cases have been successfully treated, while the incidence of the disease – which has cost Indonesia’s economy millions of dollars in lost productivity – has been driven down.

zh: 在此类技术支持的帮助下，印尼政府正在建立平价的可持续全国医疗体系，到2019年将实现完全通过国内渠道提供资金。
en: With technical support like this, Indonesia’s government is creating an affordable and sustainable national health-care system that will be fully financed with domestic resources by 2019.

zh: 我相信，全球基金是我们所能做出的最明智的投资之一 — — 许多政府从一开始就明白了这一点。
en: I believe that the Global Fund is one of the smartest investments that we can make – as many governments have understood from the outset.

zh: 美国一直是全球基金最大的支持者，此外还有许多国家做出了贡献。
en: The United States has been the Global Fund’s largest supporter, but many others have done their part.

zh: 比如，澳大利亚自2002年以来向全球基金提供了4.1亿美元，这笔钱让近20万人获得了救命的艾滋病治疗，8万人获得了结核病治疗，七百万人获得了疟疾治疗，1400万张蚊帐送到了需要的家庭手中。
en: For example, Australia has provided US$410 million to the Global Fund since 2002, an amount that has enabled nearly 200,000 people to receive lifesaving HIV treatment, 80,000 people to receive TB treatment, seven million people to be cured of malaria, and 14 million bed nets to be delivered to families in need.

zh: 全球基金照亮了非洲和亚洲数十万儿童的未来 — — 这一个了不起的成就，足以让出资国公民感到自豪。
en: The Global Fund has brightened the futures of hundreds of thousands of children across Africa and Asia – a heroic achievement that should make donor countries’ citizens proud.

zh: 我希望其他有余力支持全球基金的国家娿做出明智投资。
en: I hope that others with the means to support its work will invest so wisely.

zh: 欧洲需要英国吗？
en: Does Europe Need Britain?

zh: 纽约—许多英国人认为他们的祖国可以在身居欧盟之外的情况下表现完美。
en: NEW YORK – Many people in the United Kingdom believe that their country can do perfectly well outside the European Union.

zh: 英国独立党（UK Independence Party）党员甚至认为英国可以做得更好，许多保守党中的“欧洲怀疑派”也作如是观。
en: Members of the UK Independence Party even think that Britain would do better, as do a considerable number of Conservative “Euro-skeptics.”

zh: 他们梦想着英国成为西方的新加坡，成为一个伦敦金融城指挥下的商业帝国。
en: They dream of Britain as a kind of Singapore of the West, a commercial powerhouse ruled from the City of London.

zh: 这就是首相卡梅伦认为有义务为英国人民提供公投机会决定是否留在欧盟这一简单决策的原因。
en: That is why Prime Minister David Cameron felt obliged to offer the British people a referendum on a simple question: in or out.

zh: 卡梅伦个人并不希望英国离开欧盟，但他知道，未来英国政府要想解决这一问题，需要某种形式的民主赞成。
en: Cameron does not personally want Britain to leave the EU, but he knows that some form of democratic consent is needed for future British governments to settle the matter.

zh: 承诺中的公投期在2017年，为时尚远。
en: The year of the promised referendum, 2017, is comfortably far away.

zh: 许多东西会在这段时间中发生改变。
en: Many things may change in the meantime.

zh: 如果欧元区有所进步，那么身处其外的国家怎么做将无关紧要。
en: If the eurozone forges ahead, what countries outside the zone do may not matter much anymore.

zh: 此外，其他欧洲人也许会同意卡梅伦，更加紧密的欧洲政治联盟毫无必要，如果他们有选择的话 — — 也就是说，如果这不是板上钉钉的话。
en: Moreover, other Europeans may end up agreeing with Cameron that ever closer political union in Europe is undesirable – if they have a choice, that is, which is by no means certain.

zh: 与此同时，还要考虑另外一个问题：有多少欧洲人希望英国留在欧盟？
en: In the meantime, there is another question to be considered: how many Europeans want Britain to stay in the EU?

zh: 答案部分取决于国籍。
en: The answer depends partly on nationality.

zh: 小型北欧国家，如荷兰，传统上希望英国留在欧盟。
en: The smaller northern countries, such as the Netherlands, have traditionally wanted Britain to be in.

zh: 没有英国，它们就得受法国甚至更多地受德国左右。
en: Without Britain, they would be bossed around by France, and even more so by Germany.

zh: 而随着二战记忆的淡去，越来越多的荷兰人和斯堪的纳维亚人对身处强大德国的卵翼之下不再感到不安。
en: And yet, as memories of World War II fade, more and more people in the Netherlands and Scandinavia feel content to be under Germany’s powerful wings.

zh: 但德国本身可能更希望保有英国这一伙伴，以免单独面对地中海国家。
en: But Germany itself would probably prefer to keep its British partner, rather than face the Mediterranean countries alone.

zh: 文化仍具有重要作用。
en: Culture still matters.

zh: 而德国人与英国人有着诸多共同点 — — 比和希腊人甚至意大利人多得多。
en: And the Germans have much in common with the British – more than they do with the Greeks, or even the Italians.

zh: 法国则不同。
en: France is a different matter.

zh: 最新民调表明，54%的法国人希望英国离开欧盟。
en: According to a recent poll, 54% of the French would prefer Britain to leave the EU.

zh: 而这可能也与文化有关。
en: This, too, might have something to do with culture.

zh: 英国一直不太受法国人待见。
en: Britain never was very popular in France.

zh: 戴高乐曾两次将英国拒在欧洲经济共同体门外。
en: President Charles de Gaulle blocked British entry into the European Economic Community twice.

zh: 与许多法国领导人一样，戴高乐对“盎格鲁-撒克逊”怀有深深的狐疑。
en: Like many French leaders, de Gaulle was deeply suspicious of the “Anglo-Saxons.”

zh: 在他的宏大观念中，法国天生是欧洲价值的捍卫者，欧洲价值在他看来和法国价值是共生关系。
en: France, in his grandiose view, was the natural guardian of European values, which, according to him, were coextensive with French values.

zh: 1930年，丘吉尔如此评价他的祖国 ： “ 我们与欧洲站在一起，但我们不属于欧洲。
en: In 1930, Winston Churchill said of his country: “We are with Europe, but not of it.”

zh: ”至今仍有许多英国人持有这一观点。
en: It is a sentiment still shared by many in Britain.

zh: 戴高乐也同意这一观点。
en: De Gaulle agreed.

zh: 他曾经不无讽刺地指出，加入欧盟会让英国迷失自己的身份，这是件大憾事。
en: As he once put it, somewhat ironically, Britain would lose its identity as a member of a European union, and this would be a great pity.

zh: 但文化和国籍甚至戴高乐沙文主义无法解释一切。
en: But culture and nationality, or even Gaullist chauvinism, cannot explain everything.

zh: 欧洲的亲英和反英情绪有重要的政治根源。
en: There is an important political dimension to the pro- or anti-British sentiments in Europe.

zh: 表示希望英国离开欧盟的法国人大体是左翼，抱有相反观点的更加右倾。
en: The French who said they wanted Britain to leave the EU were largely on the left, while many who held the opposite view were further to the right.

zh: 原因不甚明了，尽管或许在于右翼包括了新自由派，这群人同意英国对商业和自由贸易的态度。
en: It is not entirely clear why, though it is probably because the right includes neo-liberals, who share the British attitude to business and free trade.

zh: 与全世界的左翼一样，法国左翼也支持高程度的国家控制经济以及以技术官僚而不是自由主义解决方案对付社会和经济问题。
en: Like leftists everywhere, the French left favors a large degree of state control of the economy, together with technocratic rather than liberal solutions to social and economic problems.

zh: 这样的意识形态在欧洲制度的发展中起着关键作用。
en: This type of thinking has played a vital role in the development of European institutions.

zh: 欧洲统一教父之一的让·莫内是这一倾向的写照 — — 天生不相信政客的官僚。
en: Jean Monnet, one of the godfathers of European unification, embodied this tendency – a born bureaucrat who distrusted politicians.

zh: 民主政治混乱而分裂的，充斥着折中主义。
en: Democratic politics is messy and divisive, and riddled with compromises.

zh: 莫内对此深恶痛绝。
en: Monnet hated all that.

zh: 他醉心于统一的理想。
en: He was obsessed by the ideal of unity.

zh: 他希望能成事，为了避免折中，在政治上无所不用其极。
en: And he wanted things to get done, uncompromised by political wheeling and dealing.

zh: 莫内和其他欧洲技术官僚并不反对民主，但出于迫不及待地让欧洲多样化的民族国家统一起来的狂热，他们通常会表现出对民主的忽视。
en: Monnet and other European technocrats were not exactly opposed to democracy, but in their zeal to unify Europe’s diverse nation-states, they often appeared to ignore it.

zh: 欧洲派知道怎样对欧洲人民最有利，也知道应该做什么。
en: The Eurocrats knew what was best for Europe’s citizens, and they knew what needed to be done.

zh: 太多的公共争论或赖在公民及其政治代表的干扰只能延缓成事时间。
en: Too much public debate, or interference from citizens and their political representatives, would only slow things down.

zh: 因此，典型的关于“不可停止的列车”和“不可逆转的决定”的欧盟论调是：公民不应质疑伟大规划者的智慧。
en: Hence the typical EU language about “unstoppable trains” and “irreversible decisions”: citizens are not supposed to question the wisdom of great planners.

zh: 这一对规划的强调是“欧洲工程”总是对左翼极具吸引力的原因之一，不仅仅法国是如此。
en: This emphasis on planning was one reason why the “European project” always appealed to the left – and not only in France.

zh: 对理想模式的技术官僚主义信仰，其内在性质是乌托邦。
en: The technocratic belief in ideal models is inherently utopian.

zh: 左翼还深深地厌恶民族主义 — — 两次灾难性的欧洲大战的根源。
en: Those on the left also shared a deep aversion to nationalism, born of two disastrous European wars.

zh: 英国人正是在丘吉尔式的民族主义的领导下抵挡住了希特勒的进攻，他们从来不感冒对民族主义的厌恶。
en: The British, whose Churchillian nationalism helped them to prevail against Hitler’s attacks, never shared this aversion.

zh: 他们也对英国的自由-民主传统感到深深的自豪，这使得他们不信任得过且过的欧洲官僚。
en: And their deep pride in Britain’s liberal-democratic tradition made them suspicious of meddling Brussels bureaucrats.

zh: 毫无疑问，这部分来自沙文主义甚至排外主义。
en: Some of this is doubtless the result of chauvinism, even xenophobia.

zh: 谁能与外国人分享政治主权？
en: How can one possibly share political authority with foreigners?

zh: 但简单地否定英国人对欧洲人推动更统一的做法的怀疑是不正确的。
en: But it would be wrong simply to dismiss British doubts about the European drive toward greater unity.

zh: 这不仅仅是一种民族主义反应。
en: It is not just a nationalist reaction.

zh: 如今，很多欧洲人讨厌欧盟官僚主义权力的扩张。
en: Many Europeans now resent the expanding powers of EU bureaucracy.

zh: 英国对宏大欧洲计划的抵制可以称得上可能迈向官僚主义的实体（尽管初衷良好）的民主抑制剂，应该被视为纠正技术官僚乌托邦主义的必要措施。
en: British resistance to grand European plans is the democratic grit in an enterprise that could become authoritarian, despite having the best intentions, and should serve as a necessary corrective to the utopianism of the technocrats.

zh: 支持欧洲统一者应该严肃对待针对其政治漏洞的批评。
en: Those who favor European unification should take criticisms of its political flaws very seriously.

zh: 这样做是唯一确保统一的欧洲（不管以什么形式统一）民主和在经济上有益的办法。
en: Doing so is the only chance to ensure that a united Europe, whatever form it takes, will be democratic, as well as economically beneficial.

zh: 这也是欧洲需要英国的原因：不是作为离岸银行和商业中心，而是难以对付的、充满狐疑的和顽固的民主伙伴。
en: That is why Europe needs Britain: not as an offshore center of banking and commerce, but as a difficult, questioning, stubbornly democratic partner.

zh: 戴维·卡梅伦的文化战争
en: David Cameron’s Culture War

zh: 发自纽约 — — 英国首相戴维·卡梅伦的政府最近公布了各发达国家中最为严厉的公共部门预算削减计划，而他手下的教育大臣则宣布要将英国大学的资助经费削减40%之多。
en: NEW YORK – British Prime Minister David Cameron’s government has announced some of the most draconian public-sector cuts any developed country government has ever attempted. Indeed, his minister of education recently declared that funding for Britain’s universities would be slashed by as much as 40%.

zh: 但此举最令人震惊之处，莫过于对艺术和人文学科的削减力度将大于科学和工程学科 — — 即便后者总能触摸到那些商界大财主的钱袋。
en: But the most shocking aspect of the move is that arts and humanities departments will be targeted more aggressively than science and engineering, which are supposedly better for business.

zh: 这种向艺术和人文学科宣战的做法其实毫无新意 — — 虽然在英国如此明目张胆地出现还是头一回。
en: The war against the arts and humanities is nothing new – though this is the first time that the fight has migrated so directly to Britain.

zh: 当年美国的罗纳德·里根政府就曾发起一连串的政策和宣传运动，试图将全国艺术基金会（National Endowment for the Arts）妖魔化。
en: Ronald Reagan pioneered a wave of policy and propaganda in the United States in the 1980’s that demonized the National Endowment for the Arts.

zh: 自那以后，历届共和党政府都恣意压低对各院校芭蕾，诗歌和雕塑等学科的资助，而前纽约市长鲁道夫·朱利安尼这样的政客则通过抨击有争议的视觉艺术家来谋取政治支持。
en: Ever since, Republican governments in the US have slashed funding for ballet, poetry in schools, and sculpture, while demagogues like former New York Mayor Rudolph Giuliani have gained political traction by attacking controversial visual arts.

zh: 但相对于老右派将某些学科讽为“娘娘腔”的过时伎俩，卡梅隆政府的做法则更为险恶。
en: But the Cameron government’s approach is more sinister than the old right-wing tactic of taking aim at disciplines that can be derided as effete.

zh: 英国的此次削减反映了发达国家的一种趋势（这趋势的始作俑者也是美国人！ ） ， 那就是转而压制教育系统，使之无法滋养更公开，更有活力的市民社会，也无法培养出一群无法被奴役的人民。
en: The British cuts reveal a push in developed countries – one that also started in the US – to target the kinds of education that lead to an open, vigorous civil society and a population that is hard to suppress.

zh: 从前在前苏联的铁幕下，是那些诗人，戏剧家，漫画家和小说家争相演绎着统治者讳莫如深的自由主题，并成为秘密警察下手的对象。
en: In the former Soviet bloc, it was the poets, dramatists, cartoonists, and novelists whose works encoded forbidden themes of freedom, and who were targeted by the secret police.

zh: 如今在伊朗、叙利亚，中国和缅甸，这些人也是被恐吓，被禁言和被折磨的一群。
en: Today, they are bullied, silenced, and tortured in places like Iran, Syria, China, and Myanmar.

zh: 虽然美国和英国的政府都不会残暴至此。
en: Obviously, neither the US nor Britain has reached that point.

zh: 但对艺术和人文学科的攻击其实是至关重要的一步棋，目的就是生产出一个逆来顺受，沉默不语的市民群体。
en: But the attack on the arts and humanities is a giant step in the direction of a pliable, dumbed-down citizenry.

zh: 事实上，伴随着美国那些对艺术和人文学科宣战的行为而产生的就是一大批日渐愚昧无知，消极被动的民众，以及一个为大企业利益服务的政府。
en: Indeed, the war against the arts and humanities in the US coincided with the emergence of an increasingly ignorant and passive population and a government that serves at the pleasure of corporate interests.

zh: 众所周知，那些艺术和人文学院一般都不太善于阐述自身所创造的价值。
en: Academics in the arts and humanities are notoriously bad at defending why their work has value.

zh: 但除了增强市民社会的力量并培养追求自由的生活习惯之外，这些学科还有许多好处。
en: But, apart from strengthening civil society and the habits of freedom, these disciplines yield bottom-line benefits as well.

zh: 是谁需要深入阅读，搜寻理据，并提出合理的观点？ 须知这都是诗歌，小说，历史和哲学研究所培养的技能。
en: Who needs to read closely, seek evidence, and make a reasoned argument – skills that the study of poetry, the novel, history, and philosophy provide?

zh: 又是谁需要学习外语和比较文学？
en: Who needs to study languages and comparative literature?

zh: 但在卡梅隆心目中，答案显然是 — — 那些无关紧要的人。
en: For Cameron, evidently, the answer is: no one of importance.

zh: 那么请试想，未来的英国议会竟然有议员不知道一战的起因是什么，或者何为启蒙运动；记者的报道文笔粗糙，逻辑混乱；律师和法官连案卷都读不懂；而间谍和外交官们竟然对所在国的语言文化一无所知。
en: Let us imagine, then, a Britain of tomorrow that includes parliamentarians who don’t know what led to World War I, or what the Enlightenment was; journalists who can’t write compellingly; attorneys and judges who can’t figure out their cases; and spies and diplomats who don’t speak the languages or understand the cultures in which they work.

zh: 到了那时候，英国就跟今天的美国无异了。
en: That Britain will look more like the US of today.

zh: 而就在一念之间，卡梅隆这个曾就学于古典教育大本营伊顿公学，而后又在牛津大学学习哲学，政治和经济的人就将英国的未来影响力一笔勾销。
en: In a heartbeat, Cameron (who himself studied philosophy, politics, and economics at Oxford, having previously attended that bastion of classical education, Eton) has signed away Britain’s global influence.

zh: 但其实英国之所以能在帝国衰落之后依然保持着国际影响力，就是依靠公民的力量以及政策制定者所受到的教育。
en: Having lost its empire, Britain retains outsized global influence simply because of the power of its civilization and the education absorbed by its decision-makers.

zh: 这种魅力就是那些新兴国家留学生对英国大学趋之若鹜，每年为各大院校贡献大笔学费的原因。
en: That allure is why foreign students from emerging countries around the world flock to Britain, putting millions of pounds annually into the coffers of its universities.

zh: 是这些院校创造了这种文明，而通过削减资助，卡梅伦将使未来的英国沦为一个缺乏世界级政治家，作家和文化创新者的国度，只剩下一些在恶俗电视剧中长大的二流科技主义者，其影响力也将最终龟缩在那几个小岛之上。
en: By slashing the funding for the institutions which created that civilization, Cameron has guaranteed that tomorrow’s Britain will be a nation not of world-class politicians, writers, and cultural innovators, but of wonky technocrats raised on bad TV, with little influence beyond their tiny island.

zh: 如果不立刻恢复那些预算的话，卡梅伦和他的意识形态继承人（跟他们的美国同伙一样）将创造无数消极被动的乌合之众，而这些人也是一个政府政策更放肆地与大企业利益同流合污的社会所需要的。
en: If what has been cut is not restored, Cameron and his ideological heirs will create a nation of quiescent citizens who, like their US counterparts, are better suited to a society whose official policies are more directly aligned to the will of corporate interests.

zh: 虽然短期的财政盈余对于卡梅伦来说非常吸引，但对那些从英国的活力，文明和民主传统中受益的英国人民 — — 以及全世界人民来说 — — 这个代价实在是太大了
en: While the fiscal savings may appear attractive to Cameron in the short term, for the British people – and for the rest of the world, which benefits from Britain’s liveliness, civilization, and tradition of democracy – the cost is far too high.

zh: 喧宾夺主的英国移民问题
en: The UK’s Immigration Distraction

zh: 伦敦—英国选民是讨厌外国人，还是只是讨厌不速之客？
en: LONDON – Do British voters hate foreigners, or merely freeloaders?

zh: 上个月，英国首相卡梅伦在建筑设备生产商JCB总部所做的人们期待已久的关于来自其他欧盟国家移民问题的演讲中实质提出了这一问题。
en: That is essentially the question British Prime Minister David Cameron posed in his long-awaited speech on immigration from other European Union countries, delivered last month at the headquarters of the construction-equipment manufacturer JCB.

zh: 卡梅伦的赌注是选民不在意波兰人或是立陶宛人在英国各地的工地上操作JCB的各种机械。
en: Cameron’s gamble is that voters do not mind Poles or Lithuanians operating JCB’s machines on construction sites all over the United Kingdom.

zh: 他们在意的是移民英国的人享受英国的社会福利。
en: What they mind is people immigrating to the UK to take advantage of its welfare benefits.

zh: 这次演讲是卡梅伦对两名他所在的保守党议员倒戈投向反欧盟、反移民的英国独立党（UK Independence Party）的回应。 他担心这可能偷走保守党在明年5月大选中的选票。
en: The speech was Cameron’s answer to the recent defections of two of his Conservative Party MPs to the anti-EU, anti-immigration UK Independence Party, which he fears could steal Conservative votes in the general election next May.

zh: 但是，尽管这次演讲相当聪明，却无法成功地回击英国独立党 — — 也导致英国关于欧盟成员地位的争论搞错了关注点。
en: But, as clever as the speech was, it is unlikely to succeed in beating back UKIP – and it leaves the British debate about EU membership focused on the wrong issue.

zh: 平心而论，卡梅伦的演讲是一次比许多人 — — 甚至包括他自己的政府内的人 — — 所预想的更有政治家风度的赌注。
en: To be sure, Cameron’s speech was a more statesmanlike gamble than many – even within his own government – had anticipated.

zh: 他在最近几周以来的一些评论表明他也许反对欧盟公民完全自由的移动，并不惜与其他欧盟政府对抗 — — 自由移动是欧盟的基本原则之一。
en: Some of his remarks in recent weeks had suggested that he might reject outright the free movement of EU citizens – one of the union’s founding principles – and dare other European governments to oppose him.

zh: 相反，卡梅伦强调英国一直愿意向世界开放，同时限制欧盟移民的福利权。
en: Instead, Cameron emphasized the UK’s enduring desire to be open to the world while restricting EU migrants’ welfare rights.

zh: 具体而言，他提出要求欧盟移民在英国工作四年才能获得资格追缴英国低薪工人所获得的福利金，并结束向移民工人居住在母国的孩子支付福利金。
en: Specifically, he proposed requiring EU migrants to spend four years working in the UK before becoming eligible for the top-up welfare payments that low-paid British workers receive, and to end benefit payments for migrant workers’ children living in their home country.

zh: 尽管这些措施可能在欧洲法院（European Court of Justice）以歧视为由提起上诉，但在即将到来选举举行之前，不可能会有任何起诉。
en: Though such moves could be challenged in the European Court of Justice on grounds of discrimination, any cases are unlikely to arise until well after the upcoming election.

zh: 保守党所面临的政治风险是他们误判了公共情绪。
en: The political danger for the Conservatives is that they are misjudging public sentiment.

zh: 也许选民与外国人之间的问题和他们与不速之客之间的问题一样严重。
en: Perhaps voters have just as much of a problem with foreigners as they do with freeloaders.

zh: 果真如此的话，削减移民福利是不够的。
en: If that is the case, reducing immigrants’ welfare benefits will be inadequate.

zh: 这并不是说卡梅伦应该针对外国人。
en: This is not to say that Cameron should target foreigners.

zh: 相反，他必须改变口风，向选民保证经济未来是光明的。
en: On the contrary, he must change the conversation to reassure voters that their economic future is bright.

zh: 目前，与其他欧洲人民一行，英国人大有一种税收负担过重而不断缩水的公共服务质量过低的感觉，对于过去五年来收入一直下滑也十分愤怒。
en: As it stands, the British, like their counterparts elsewhere in Europe, feel overtaxed for spotty public services that are constantly being cut, and are angry that their incomes have been falling for the last five years.

zh: 结果，许多人开始怨恨福利享受者、害怕饭碗之争 — — 这一情绪正在全欧洲助长民粹主义、反欧盟和反移民政党。
en: As a result, many resent welfare recipients and fear competition for jobs – a sentiment that is fueling the rise of populist, anti-EU, and anti-immigrant parties across Europe.

zh: 英国的关键不同之处在于英国独立党的崛起是在经济迅速增长（每年超过3 % ， 为欧盟最高水平）的背景下发生的。
en: The key difference in the UK is that UKIP is gaining ground with voters despite rapid economic growth (more than 3% annually, the highest rate in the EU).

zh: 从现在到5月，卡梅伦必须让选民相信，英国经济会继续表现强劲，助长真实收入的增加。
en: Between now and May, Cameron must persuade voters that the British economy will continue to perform strongly, fueling an increase in real incomes.

zh: 转换话题也有利于国家利益。
en: A change of subject would also be in the national interest.

zh: 强调移民问题的卡梅伦有可能让英国是否应该留在欧盟成为问题的核心。
en: By banging on about immigration, Cameron risks making it central to the question of whether Britain should remain in the EU.

zh: 毕竟，是他承诺如果2017年仍在位就将举行是否留在欧盟的公投，在此期间则是被频繁描述为英国成员地位“再谈判”和欧盟结构“改革”的时期。
en: He is, after all, the politician who has promised to hold a referendum in 2017, if he is still Prime Minister, on whether to stay or leave, following a period variously described as a “renegotiation” of the UK’s membership and “reform” of the EU’s structure.

zh: 如今，他似乎正在把移民问题打造为这一努力方向的关键考验。
en: He is now making it seem as if immigration will be the key test of that effort.

zh: 这是一个大问题，首先，在人民自由移动的问题上，其他欧盟政府几乎不可能让步，这是写入欧洲一体化奠基文件 — — 1957年罗马条约（Treaty of Rome）的基本原则。
en: That is a big problem. For starters, there is little or nothing that other EU governments can concede on the free movement of people, which is enshrined in the founding document of European integration, the 1957 Treaty of Rome.

zh: 无论如何，英���来自欧盟之外的移民比来自其他欧盟国家的移民更多。
en: In any case, Britain receives more migrants from outside the EU than from other EU countries.

zh: 而来自波兰、意大利或法国的移民比来自索马里、叙利亚或印度的移民更有可能最终会回国。
en: And migrants from Poland, Italy, or France are much more likely than those from Somalia, Syria, or India to return home eventually.

zh: 如果英国公众真的反对移民，他们或许会提到非欧盟移民，而不是（比如）意大利大学生的到来。
en: If the British public truly opposes immigration, they are probably referring to non-EU immigration, not the arrival of, say, Italian university graduates.

zh: 事实上，有一个重要得多的问题应该成为英国关于欧盟的争论的主要焦点：英国作为非欧元区国家在欧盟内部的未来地位。
en: In fact, there is a far more important issue that should serve as the main focus of the British debate on the EU: the UK’s future status inside the EU as a non-member of the eurozone.

zh: 卡梅伦及其财政大臣乔治·奥斯本在英国独立党在民调中崛起之前一直关注着这一问题。
en: This is what Cameron and Chancellor of the Exchequer George Osborne were focusing on until UKIP surged in the opinion polls.

zh: 现在，他们应该重新把注意力集中在这个问题上。
en: It is time to renew that focus.

zh: 卡梅伦政府必须认识到，质疑英国是否离开欧盟才会变得更好的好理由只有一个：不加入欧元区可能导致英国在欧盟决策中处于重大劣势，即使是关于影响单一市场的规则。
en: Cameron’s government must recognize that there is only one good reason to wonder whether the UK might be better off leaving the EU: the risk that remaining outside of the eurozone would leave Britain at a serious disadvantage in EU decision-making, even about rules affecting the single market.

zh: 这听起来有些技术性，确实如此。
en: It sounds a bit technical, and it is.

zh: 但厘清加入欧元区和不加入欧元区的欧盟成员地位的关系可以再相当短的时间内解决并且不必修改条约；事实上，在这方面已经有了进展。
en: But sorting out the relationship between EU members within and outside the eurozone can be done in a fairly short time without new treaties; indeed, progress has already been made on this front.

zh: 卡梅伦和奥斯本接着将可以夸耀他们为英国公众争取到两方面的最佳结果：比陷入停滞的欧元区成员国高得多的经济增长，以及所有欧盟成员地位带来的好处，包括进入单一市场和增强全球影响力。
en: Cameron and Osborne would then be able to boast that they have procured for the British public the best of both worlds: much faster economic growth than the stagnant eurozone members, together with all of the advantages of EU membership, including access to the single market and enhanced global influence.

zh: 这个故事远比在移民福利权问题上纠缠不清更有力。
en: That narrative would be far more powerful than a few tweaks to welfare rights for immigrants.

zh: 戴维·卡梅伦和欧盟的滑铁卢
en: David Cameron and the EU’s Waterloo

zh: 普林斯顿 — — 两百年前的同一个月，拿破仑·波拿巴在滑铁卢战役中败于威灵顿公爵所率盟军之手重新塑造了欧洲的未来。
en: PRINCETON – Two hundred years ago this month, at the Battle of Waterloo, Napoleon Bonaparte’s defeat at the hands of an allied army, led by the Duke of Wellington, reshaped Europe’s future.

zh: 英国或许现在准备再次书写历史。
en: Britain may now be poised to do so once again.

zh: 英国新任的保守党多数政府承诺到2017年底、甚至就在明年就欧盟成员国资格举行公投其实并不像外界所描绘的那样孤立。
en: The United Kingdom, whose new majority Conservative government has pledged to hold a referendum on European Union membership by the end of 2017, perhaps even next year, is not the outlier that it is often portrayed as being.

zh: 事实上，这是欧盟体制萎缩的开始。
en: Indeed, it is at the vanguard of the EU’s institutional atrophy.
