zh: 即使决定继续留在欧盟，英国也将继续稳步将重心转向欧盟之外。
en: Even if it does retain its EU membership, the UK will continue to move steadily away from Europe.

zh: 因为其他地方的商业机会更具吸引力，多数欧洲国家将步英国的后尘。
en: With more attractive commercial opportunities elsewhere, most European countries will follow suit.

zh: 对欧盟而言，满足英国的要求 — — 限制外来工利益、限制可能有损伦敦城的金融监管及否认“前所未有的紧密联盟”的目标需要进行根本性的转变，包括根本没有任何可能的对支撑欧盟体制的条约进行修改。
en: For the EU, meeting the UK’s demands – to restrict benefits for migrant workers, limit financial regulation that could hurt the City of London, and disavow the goal of “ever closer union” – would require a fundamental transformation, including utterly unfeasible changes to the treaties that underpin European institutions.

zh: 讨论内容也因此转向能否赋予英国特殊地位抑或容许其退出更多的欧盟条约。
en: The discussion has thus turned to the possibility of providing the UK with a special status or allowing it to opt out of more EU provisions.

zh: 不过鉴于对一体化好处的质疑声日益高涨，就连这样的解决方法也有可能拆散欧盟。
en: But, given intensifying doubts about the benefits of integration, even that solution would risk unraveling the EU.

zh: 由于凸显欧洲无法再提供经济红利，英国远离欧盟之举将激起其他地方要求改革的呼声。
en: By emphasizing that Europe no longer offers an economic dividend, the UK’s move away from the EU will spur ever louder calls for change elsewhere.

zh: 简单地讲 ， “ 英国退出欧盟论”已经暴露出欧洲的经济和政治裂痕 — — 回到旧日的美好时光已经不可能。
en: Simply put, talk of “Brexit” has exposed Europe’s economic and political fault lines – and there is no going back.

zh: 在其为时任英国财政大臣戈登·布朗撰写的2005年传记中，罗伯特·佩斯顿描述了布朗的实用主义观点，即认为“欧盟只有为英国带来和平繁荣的实际利益才是好东西。
en: Robert Peston, in his 2005 biography of then-Chancellor of the Exchequer Gordon Brown, described Brown’s “pragmatic view that the EU was a good thing only insofar as it delivered practical benefits of peace and prosperity to Britain.”

zh: ”虽然英国人毫不隐讳他们对欧洲一体化支持的民族主义本质，但其他欧盟成员对各自的国内利益也一直没少关注。
en: While the British have been particularly open about the nationalist nature of their support for European integration, other EU members have been no less mindful of their domestic interests.

zh: 第二次世界大战后，欧洲各国的国家利益趋于一致。
en: In the wake of World War II, European countries’ national interests were aligned.

zh: 但1954年通过组建共同军队实现政治统一的努力失败凸显出经济共同利益是欧洲一体化的关键领域。
en: Nonetheless, efforts to establish political unity through a common army failed in 1954, highlighting that economic common ground was the key to European integration.

zh: 并且事实上，在新生欧洲经济共同体内部开放国界的1957年罗马条约促使欧洲内部贸易迅速扩大，从而促成了经济的共同复苏。
en: And, indeed, the 1957 Treaty of Rome, which opened national borders within the new European Economic Community, enabled the rapid proliferation of intra-European trade, thereby contributing to a shared economic recovery.

zh: 上述商业关系所带来的物质利益推动了欧洲的文化转移，从而为共同制度赢得了更多的信任和支持。
en: The material gains of these commercial relationships fostered empathy among Europeans, fueling increased support for – and trust in – shared institutions.

zh: 英国的一体化进程开始较晚，1973年才加入经济共同体；但此后也经历了相似的轨迹，英国民众面对经济利益开始对推动一体化表示支持。
en: This process began later for the UK, which joined the community in 1973; but it followed a similar trajectory, with British citizens responding to economic gains by supporting increased integration.

zh: 首相撒切尔夫人大力倡导1986年单一欧洲法，力求收获最大的经济收益。
en: Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher, by advocating the 1986 Single European Act, sought to maximize those gains.

zh: 按照罗马条约精神，她确保该法案重点开发一个开放和竞争的共同市场，所有成员都按照平等条件进行参与。
en: In the spirit of the Treaty of Rome, she ensured that the act focused on developing an open and competitive common market, in which all members participated on equal terms.

zh: 相反，撒切尔的德国同僚，被外界普遍视为那一代杰出欧洲精英人物的赫尔穆特·科尔总理并没有对单一欧洲法给予热情的支持。
en: By contrast, her German counterpart, Chancellor Helmut Kohl, often regarded as one of that generation’s preeminent European champions, offered only lukewarm support for the Single European Act.

zh: 他更愿意推动欧洲向货币和政治联盟的方向发展，彼时欧洲经济刚刚开始落后于世界其他地区。
en: He preferred to help steer Europe toward monetary and political union, just when its economy had begun to fall behind the rest of the world.

zh: 结果签署了1991年的马斯特里赫特条约 — — 也就是欧洲一体化进入超速阶段的标志。
en: The result was the 1991 Maastricht Treaty – the point when European integration went into overdrive.

zh: 但条约设计师们忙于内部的权力游戏，并没有意识到货币联盟无法阻止欧洲衰落，尤其在美国生产率快速增长和亚洲经济开始崛起之时。
en: But the Treaty’s architects were so busy playing internal power games that they failed to recognize that monetary union could not stem Europe’s decline, especially as the United States was experiencing rapid productivity growth and Asia’s economic rise had begun.

zh: 欧洲的战后恢复任务早已完成，需要重新思考一体化的逻辑。
en: With Europe’s post-war recovery long complete, the logic of integration had to be rethought.

zh: 遗憾的是，这项工作并没有开始。
en: Unfortunately, that did not happen.

zh: 结果是马斯特里赫特条约几乎墨迹未干，过去二十年来一直飙升的欧洲内部贸易和对欧盟机构的支持就开始走下坡路。
en: As a result, intra-European trade and support for European institutions, having soared in the previous two decades, began to decline practically before the ink on the Maastricht Treaty was dry.

zh: 2008年开始的欧元区长期危机加剧了这一趋势，各成员国至今仍在努力恢复经济和金融稳定 — — 很可能在国内生产总值增长方面继续落后于世界其他地区。
en: The eurozone’s protracted crisis, which began in 2008, has exacerbated this trend, with member countries still struggling to restore economic and financial stability – and likely to continue to lag behind the rest of the world in terms of GDP growth.

zh: 任何制度框架都无法生存，除非它符合所在选区的物质利益。
en: No institutional framework can survive unless it serves the material interests of its constituency.

zh: 19世纪，适应不了工业化变革的突尼斯手工业行会变得无关紧要，行会会长们（amins）被留在空壳机构中有名无实。
en: In the nineteenth century, when the Tunisian craft guilds failed to adapt to industrialization, they became irrelevant, and the amins, or guild masters, were left as figureheads in shell institutions.

zh: 今天，欧洲机构可能面临同样的命运。
en: Today, European institutions could face the same fate.

zh: 长期受益于欧洲以外商业关系、且不受欧元拖累的英国尤其有能力反对欧盟体制。
en: Unencumbered by the euro, and benefiting from long-standing commercial relationships beyond Europe, Britain is in a particularly strong position to push back against EU institutions.

zh: 这或者有些自私自利，但却并不令人意外；事实上，因为全欧洲企业都在其他地方寻找市场，英国的做法很可能带动其他地方取得类似的进步。
en: This may be self-serving, but it should not be a surprise; in fact, with businesses throughout Europe seeking markets elsewhere, Britain’s approach may well herald similar developments elsewhere.

zh: 二战阴影下的欧洲一体化是明智而辉煌的成就。
en: European integration in the shadow of WWII was a wise and magnificent achievement.

zh: 但这项历史任务已经完成，现在的欧洲机构需要新的基本原理。
en: But, with that historic task now complete, European institutions need a new rationale.

zh: 因为欧盟不像其他联盟那样具备共同的政治命运，上述原则必须围绕物质利益。
en: And with the EU, unlike other federations, lacking a common political destiny, that rationale must center on material benefits.

zh: 欧盟必须回归其成功的基本动力，以反映罗马条约精神的全新单一市场议程为目的。
en: The EU must return to the fundamental driver of its success, pursuing a renewed single-market agenda that reflects the rationale of the Treaty of Rome.

zh: 不幸的是，现在的欧洲如此四分五裂，以此为核心的全新举措面临“越来越大的政治阻力 ” ， 以至于外界并不看好欧洲实现这一目标的能力。
en: Unfortunately, Europe is so divided nowadays that the ability to achieve such an outcome is not promising, with new initiatives along these lines facing “increasing political resistance.”

zh: 如果欧洲人仅仅借用“前所未有的紧密联盟”的崇高口头禅，他们的体制就会丧失生命力。
en: If Europeans merely invoke the lofty mantra of “an ever closer union,” their institutions will atrophy.

zh: 如果没有新的统一目标 — — 这一目标必须以共同的物质利益，而非担心普京的俄罗斯重新崛起为基础 — — 欧洲的行业协会很快就会倒闭。
en: Without a new unifying objective – one based on shared material gains, not on fear of Vladimir Putin’s resurgent Russia – the European amins will soon be out of business.

zh: 超越通胀目标
en: Beyond Inflation Targets

zh: 爱丁堡—在过去三十年中，央行和学术界对于通胀目标是捍卫宏观经济稳定的关键这一思想越来越自信。
en: EDINBURGH – Over the last three decades or so, central bankers and academics have become increasingly confident that inflation targeting is the key to preserving macroeconomic stability.

zh: 但这一结论实际上根本不可能被证实，而2008年金融危机让很多人认为货币政策的目标不应该仅限于商品和服务的价格。
en: But this is virtually impossible to prove, and the 2008 financial crisis suggested to many that monetary policy should focus on more than the prices of goods and services.

zh: 那么，应该如何修改央行权限范围让它在关注低通胀的同时合理地使用货币政策解决其他问题？
en: So how should a revised mandate for central banks be structured to maintain their focus on low inflation while allowing monetary policy to address other issues when appropriate?

zh: 通胀目标对宏观经济稳定的作用很难确定，原因很简单：你不可能知道如果央行追求相反的目标国家会怎么样。
en: The contribution that inflation targeting makes to macroeconomic stability is difficult to discern for a simple reason: it is impossible to know what would happen if a country’s central bank pursued the opposite course.

zh: 无法直接比较结果，研究者只好用各种策略来识别通胀目标的影响，通常的发现是影响很大（尽管在考虑国家的起点的情况下，其影响会变小甚至降为零 ） 。
en: Unable to compare outcomes directly, researchers have employed a variety of strategies to identify the impact of inflation targeting, and have typically found it to be substantial (though the effect becomes small or even zero when countries’ starting points are taken into account).

zh: 比如，对1997—2007年英国情况的研究显示出始于一个很低的起点的重大改进。 英格兰银行在此期间采取了完全通胀目标并拥有政策独立性。
en: For example, a case study of the United Kingdom for 1997-2007 – a period of full inflation targets and policy independence for the Bank of England (BoE) – indicates considerable improvement from a poor starting point.

zh: 专注于价格稳定伴随着相对较低的通胀（与过去或其他主要经济体相比 ） 、 强劲的增长和极小的产出波动。
en: The focus on price stability was accompanied by relatively low inflation (compared to the past, as well as to other major economies), strong growth, and little output volatility.

zh: 但是，在此期间，英国也经历了持续的汇率失调 — — 英格兰货币政策委员会（MPC）不愿或无法在其现有全县范围内解决这一问题。
en: However, over this period the UK also experienced sustained exchange-rate misalignment, which the BoE’s Monetary Policy Committee was unwilling or unable to address within its existing mandate.

zh: MPC也没能对金融危机前的三次房价快速上涨做出反应，并辩解说房价的上涨是结构性的，原因在于20世纪80年代以来的通胀和利率下降，因此用货币政策予以反应是不合适的。
en: The MPC also failed to respond to any of the three bouts of rapid growth in house prices that preceded the financial crisis, arguing that they were structural in nature –caused by the decline in inflation and interest rates since the 1980’s – so a monetary response was not appropriate.

zh: 在危机前，美联储（它并不是正式的通胀目标派）甚至比MPC更严格地遵循正统 — — 严格到它几乎从未花时间和精力分析房价的波动。
en: In the run-up to the crisis, the US Federal Reserve Board (an informal inflation targeter) was even more committed than the MPC to this orthodox view – so committed, in fact, that it barely allocated any time or resources to analyzing house-price fluctuations.

zh: 因此，尽管通胀目标型央行努力地打消商品和服务的通胀预期，但它们并没有尝试影响资产价格预期。
en: So, while inflation-targeting central banks worked hard to nail down inflation expectations in goods and services, they made no effort to influence asset-price expectations.

zh: 事实上 ， “ 格林斯潘看跌期权 ” （ 前美联储主席艾伦·格林斯潘的货币政策方针）通过设定资产价格下限打消了下跌风险；但它并未设定上限。
en: Indeed, the “Greenspan put” (former Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan’s monetary-policy approach) eliminated the downside risk by setting a floor under asset prices; but it set no ceiling on the upside.

zh: 如果大银行采取“迎风而上”的策略储备，则可以影响预期并至少局部地稳定资产价格，有望减轻 — — 甚至消除 — — 金融危机最大的破坏效应。
en: If major banks had had a “lean against the wind” strategy in reserve, that would have influenced expectations and at least partly stabilized asset prices, possibly mitigating – or even averting – the most damaging effects of the financial crisis.

zh: 将资产价格目标的概念纳入通胀目标仍受到重大争议，反对者的论据是丁伯根原则：如果决策者有一种工具（利率 ） ， 那么他们只能追求一个目标（价格稳定 ） 。
en: The notion of integrating asset-price concerns into inflation targeting remains a source of significant controversy, with opponents citing the Tinbergen Principle: if policymakers have one instrument, the interest rate, they can pursue only one objective, price stability.

zh: 该原则指出，试图追求多重目标会让金融市场和私人部门行为人无所适从。
en: Attempts to pursue multiple objectives, the logic goes, would confuse financial markets and private-sector agents.

zh: 但央行确实需要同时追求多重目标，并且还不能产生坏结果或有损于其自身信誉。
en: But central banks have pursued multiple objectives simultaneously, without bringing about bad outcomes or destroying their own credibility.

zh: 类似地，自2008年以来，许多央行 — — 在政府的压力下 — — 开始对实体经济的具体发展情况做出反应（特别是失业 ） ， 而不再坚持长期价格稳定的单一目标。
en: Likewise, since 2008, many central banks – under pressure from governments – have been reacting specifically to other developments in the real economy (particularly unemployment), rather than maintaining their single-minded focus on long-term price stability.

zh: 英国尤其如此。 英国政府急切地希望在2015年大选前实现经济复苏，要求英格兰银行引入信用补贴以及最近提出的前瞻性指引。
en: This is particularly obvious in the UK, where the government, desperate to see an economic recovery before the 2015 elections, has been pushing the BoE to introduce credit subsidies and, more recently, forward guidance.

zh: 结果，英格兰银行的决策不得不适应短期的增长和通胀权衡 — — 这意味着根据目标而不是工具做出决策。
en: As a result, the BoE’s decisions have been attuned to the short-run trade-off between growth and inflation – meaning that it has been making decisions about goals, not just instruments.

zh: 如今，中央银行需要改变权限范围，不再把价格稳定作为首要的长期目标，而允许决策者在合适的时候追求其他目标。
en: What central banks need now is a revised mandate that upholds price stability as the primary, long-term objective, while allowing policymakers to pursue other objectives when appropriate.

zh: 具体而言，央行应该能够缓慢采取价格稳定措施，如果它认为实体经济实在太脆弱或资产价格失调已经威胁到金融稳定并且无法通过新的宏观审慎工具快速解决的话。
en: Specifically, the central bank should be able to move slowly on price stability if it regards the real economy as unacceptably weak, or if an asset-price misalignment threatens financial stability and cannot be defused quickly by the new macro-prudential instruments.

zh: 在先行安排下，对英格兰银行来说，如果通胀偏离其目标一个百分点以上（不管是低于还是高于 ） ， 其行长都必须向财政大臣写公开信解释偏离的原因并提出消除偏离的计划，其中包括预计时间表。
en: Under the current arrangements for the BoE, if inflation moves more than one percentage point away from its target (in either direction), the bank’s governor is obliged to write an open letter to the Chancellor of the Exchequer explaining the deviation and providing a plan to eliminate it, including a projected timeline.

zh: 修改后的英格兰银行权限 — — 或其他以通胀为目标的央行 — — 可以将这一要求更进一步，具体规定一个主要的长期通胀目标，决策者在其认为有必要时可以偏离这一目标。
en: A revised remit for the BoE – or, in some form, for other inflation-targeting central banks – could take this requirement further, specifying a primary and long-term target for inflation from which policymakers can deviate if doing so is deemed necessary.

zh: 如此，央行行长则应该被要求写公开信解释央行的决定，包括准备在多长时间内将非通胀目标作为首要目标、预计何时可以回归常规操作。
en: In such cases, the central bank’s governor should be required to write an open letter explaining the bank’s decision, including how long it expects to give priority to the non-inflation objective and how it foresees returning to normal operations.

zh: 这样的安排能让央行在透明和问责的环境下放宽职责视野，但既保留了其反通胀信誉，也防止了出于政治动机的或不合理的政策决定。
en: Such an arrangement would allow the central bank to take a wider view of its responsibilities in a context of transparency and accountability, but in a way that both preserves its anti-inflationary credibility and prevents politically motivated or otherwise inappropriate policy decisions.

zh: 反思减排
en: Rethinking Emissions Reduction

zh: 海牙—不管是在联合国气候变化峰会上，还是在冲多“绿色增长”论坛上，可再生能源和能源效率一直被认为是全球变暖的解决办法。
en: THE HAGUE – Whether at United Nations climate-change summits or one of the many “green growth” forums, renewables and energy efficiency are consistently regarded as the solution to global warming.

zh: 就连煤炭行业也在其于去年11月联合国COP19峰会前发布的《华沙公约 》 （ Warsaw Communiqué）中划定了一条效率线。
en: Even the coal industry adopted the efficiency line in its Warsaw Communiqué, released ahead of the UN’s COP19 summit last November.

zh: 但如若更仔细地检视全球能源体系，并更深入地了解排放挑战，就能发现，化石燃料仍将是本世纪最主要的能量源，这意味碳捕捉和存储（CCS）才是应对气候挑战的关键技术。
en: But a closer look at the global energy system, together with a more refined understanding of the emissions challenge, reveals that fossil fuels will likely remain dominant throughout this century – meaning that carbon capture and storage (CCS) may well be the critical technology for mitigating climate change.

zh: 人们广泛关注能源效率和可再生能源，原因在于日本经济学家茅阳一（Yoichi Kaya）1993年所提出的茅阳一恒等式。
en: The widespread focus on efficiency and renewable energy stems from the dissemination of the Kaya Identity, which the Japanese economist Yoichi Kaya developed in 1993.

zh: 茅阳一将总人口和人均GDP、能源效率（单位GDP的能源使用量）以及碳密集度（单位能源的二氧化碳含量）相乘，就得到了二氧化碳排放量。
en: Kaya calculated CO2 emissions by multiplying total population by per capita GDP, energy efficiency (energy use per unit of GDP), and carbon intensity (CO2 per unit of energy).

zh: 人口管理或限制个人财富的动议显然不可能获得支持，因此基于茅阳一恒等式的分析总是剔除前两个乘数，于是能源效率和碳密集度就成了总排放量最重要的决定因素。
en: Given the impracticality of winning support for proposals based on population management or limits on individual wealth, analyses using the Kaya Identity tend to bypass the first two terms, leaving energy efficiency and carbon intensity as the most important determinants of total emissions.

zh: 但这一方便的解释与现实并不相符。
en: But this convenient interpretation does not correspond to reality.

zh: 事实上，二氧化碳向海洋大气排放的速度比风化和海洋沉积等回到生物储存状态的速度快好几个数量级。
en: The fact is that the rate at which CO2 is being released into the ocean-atmosphere system is several orders of magnitude greater than the rate at which it is returning to geological storage through processes like weathering and ocean sedimentation.

zh: 因此，真正重要的是二氧化碳随时间排放量的累计值 — — 这一事实可见于政府间气候变化委员会（Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change）最新的第五版评估报告。
en: In this context, what really matters is the cumulative amount of CO2 being released over time – a fact that the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change recognized in its recently released Fifth Assessment Report.

zh: 自250年前工业时代开始以来，大约5,750亿吨化石燃料和土地中的碳 — — 即两万亿多吨二氧化碳 — — 排入了大气，导致了全球热平衡发生变化，地表温度可能因此上升了1℃（结果分布的中位值 ） 。
en: Since the industrial age began some 250 years ago, roughly 575 billion tons of fossil-fuel and land-fixed carbon – more than two trillion tons of CO2 – have been released into the atmosphere, leading to a shift in the global heat balance and a likely 1°C increase in surface temperature (the median of a distribution of outcomes).

zh: 按照当前速度，到2040年可能会排放1万亿吨碳，或导致2℃的升温。
en: At the current rate, a trillion tons of carbon, or some 2°C of warming, could be reached as early as 2040.

zh: 这一观点与流行的减排进展测量机制不一致，后者关注具体的年度结果目标。
en: This view does not align with the prevailing mechanisms for measuring progress on emissions reduction, which target specific annual outcomes.

zh: 尽管到（比如）2050年实现每年的排放流减少是个积极的进步，但这并不能保证阻止全球温度最终上升等目标的成功。
en: While reducing the annual flow of emissions by, say, 2050 would be a positive step, it does not necessarily guarantee success in terms of limiting the eventual rise in global temperature.

zh: 从气候角度看，温度随时间升高更大程度上是化石燃料资源基础规模和给定能源价格上的开采效率的函数。
en: From a climate perspective, the temperature rise over time is arguably more a function of the size of the fossil-fuel resource base and the efficiency of extraction at a given energy price.

zh: 随着供应链效率的增加，资源的最终开采和使用量也会增加，从而大气中的二氧化碳积累量也会增加。
en: As supply-chain efficiency increases, so does the eventual extraction and use of resources and, ultimately, the accumulation of CO2 in the atmosphere.

zh: 这意味着效率��能促进而不是限制排放的增加。
en: This means that efficiency may drive, not limit, the increase in emissions.

zh: 事实上，自工业革命以来，通过创新实现效率的做法仅仅实现了极少数核心能源转换发明：内燃机、电动马达、电灯泡、燃气轮机、蒸汽机、以及更为晚近的电路等。
en: In fact, since the Industrial Revolution, efficiency through innovation has revolutionized just a handful of core energy-conversion inventions: the internal combustion engine, the electric motor, the light bulb, the gas turbine, the steam engine, and, more recently, the electronic circuit.

zh: 在所有这些例子中，效率提高的结果都是能源使用和排放的增加 — — 不仅是因为这让获得化石燃料资源基础更加容易了。
en: In all of these cases, the result of greater efficiency has been an increase in energy use and emissions – not least because it improved access to the fossil-resource base.

zh: 类似地，各国依赖可再生能源的努力也没什么效果，因为被取代的基于化石燃料的能源仍然具有经济吸引力，这意味着会在其他国家或其他时间使用。
en: Countries’ efforts to rely on renewable energy supplies are similarly ineffective, given that the displaced fossil-fuel-based energy remains economically attractive, which means that it is used elsewhere or later.

zh: 此外，对于中国等快速发展的经济体，可再生能源部署完全没有取代化石燃料；相反，可再生能源构成了燃料供给约束，妨碍了更快的经济增长。
en: And, in the case of rapidly developing economies like China, renewable-energy deployment is not replacing fossil fuels at all; instead, renewables are supplementing a constrained fuel supply to facilitate faster economic growth.

zh: 简言之，完全寄希望于可再生能源的利用超过效率推进型增长、认为效率的强化能拉低需求很可能只是自欺欺人。
en: In short, placing all bets on renewable-energy uptake outpacing efficiency-driven growth, and assuming that enhanced efficiency will drive down demand, may be a foolish gamble.

zh: 相反，决策者应该采取新的气候范式，将注意力集中在限制累计排放量上。
en: Instead, policymakers should adopt a new climate paradigm that focuses on limiting cumulative emissions.

zh: 这首先需要决策者认识到，尽管新能源技术最终会在实用性和经济性两方面胜过化石燃料，但使用化石燃料满足能源需要增长的要求将在未来几十年中继续支撑化石燃料的开采和使用。
en: This requires, first and foremost, recognizing that, while new energy technologies will eventually outperform fossil fuels both practically and economically, demand for fossil fuels to meet growing energy needs will underpin their extraction and use for decades to come.

zh: 最重要的是，这凸显出我们需要专注于部署CCS体系的气候变化的重要性。 CCS使用各种工业过程捕捉化石燃料使用过程中释放的二氧化碳，然后把它们储藏在地下地质构造中，不让它们在生物圈中积累。
en: Most important, it highlights the need for climate policy that focuses on the deployment of CCS systems, which use various industrial processes to capture CO2 from fossil-fuel use and then store it in underground geological formations, where it cannot accumulate in the biosphere.

zh: 毕竟，消费一吨化石燃料但捕捉并储存其排放与改变或推迟化石燃料的消费是完全不同的。
en: After all, consuming a ton of fossil fuel, but capturing and storing the emissions, is very different from shifting or delaying its consumption.

zh: 不幸的是，基于这一思维的政策框架仍然有待浮现。
en: Unfortunately, a policy framework built on this thinking remains elusive.

zh: 欧盟最新发布的2030年气候和能源政策框架的重点仍在旨在提振效率和部署可再生能源的国内政策上。
en: The European Union’s recently released 2030 framework for climate and energy policies maintains the focus on domestic policies aimed at boosting efficiency and deployment of renewable energy.

zh: 尽管这一框架提到了CCS，但欧盟是否决心推广它仍有待观察。
en: While the framework mentions CCS, whether the EU commits to its deployment remains to be seen.

zh: 怎样动员对CCS — — 而不是误解这一问题性质的衍生性方针 — — 的支持和政治意愿将是2030年及其后的真正挑战。
en: Rallying support and political will for CCS – rather than for derivative approaches that misconstrue the nature of the problem – will be the real challenge for 2030 and beyond.

zh: 针对叙利亚难民的长期计划
en: A Long-Term Plan for Syria’s Refugees

zh: 贝鲁特—在与身处黎巴嫩和土耳其的难民和援助工作者共处短短三天后，叙利亚危机的末日情景已经充分展现在我的眼前：10万多人死亡，九百万人流离失所，两百万儿童被赶出校园，脊髓灰质炎等疾病卷土重来，邻国则被难民潮搞得焦头烂额。
en: BEIRUT – After spending just three days with refugees and aid workers in Lebanon and Turkey, the apocalyptic nature of the Syria crisis is all too apparent: more than 100,000 deaths, nine million people displaced, two million children out of school, diseases like polio resurfacing, and neighboring countries struggling to cope with waves of refugees.

zh: 数不清的失去配偶、兄弟姐妹和孩子的悲惨故事（更不用说失去家园和生计了）提供了更多的令人不安的证据，表明叙利亚内战已经演变为地区冲突（伊朗驻贝鲁特大使馆爆炸案就是明证 ） 。
en: Countless heartrending stories of lost husbands, wives, siblings, and children, to say nothing of homes and livelihoods destroyed, provide yet more troubling evidence of how Syria’s civil war has become a regional conflict (as the bombing of Iran’s Beirut embassy suggests).

zh: 反巴沙尔叛军正在相互搏斗，圣战组织正在壮大。
en: Anti-Assad rebels are now fighting each other, as jihadists make gains.

zh: 专家们不再用“月”来讨论冲突，而改用“年”甚至“十年 ” 。
en: Experts no longer talk of the conflict lasting months; they speak in terms of years, or even decades.

zh: 尽管国际救援会（IRC）等援助机构英勇地拯救了无数生命，给地区带来了希望，但可怕的事实是保护公民已成为不可能的任务，特别是来自狙击手和导弹误炸的伤害，更不用说饥饿和无家可归了。
en: Despite heroic efforts by aid agencies like the International Rescue Committee (IRC) to save lives and bring hope to the region, the terrible truth is that it is not possible to protect civilians, especially from snipers and stray missiles, never mind hunger and homelessness.

zh: 战斗派系甚至不承认中立非战斗人员这一概念，对国际战争规范嗤之以鼻。
en: Warring factions do not even recognize the notion of unaffiliated noncombatants, and flout international norms of war.

zh: 除了使用化学武器外，联合国估计有250万平民缺少食品、水和药品，因为一些村镇实在难以进入，有约25万人完全得不到外部援助。
en: In addition to the use of chemical weapons, the United Nations estimates that 2.5 million civilians lack food, water, and medicines, because some towns and villages are too hard to reach, with an estimated 250,000 people completely cut off from outside help.

zh: 叙利亚的邻国几乎被求救声淹没。
en: Syria’s neighbors have been overwhelmed by calls for help.

zh: 黎巴嫩正在试图接收近一百万难民。
en: Lebanon is trying to accommodate nearly one million refugees.

zh: 在土耳其，约20万难民生活在官方难民营中，但至少还有两倍于此的人数在城镇和城市中挣扎过活。
en: In Turkey, an estimated 200,000 refugees are in official camps, but at least twice that number are struggling alone in towns and cities.

zh: 世界各国的援助时断时续：到目前为止只有60%的援助承诺得到了兑现，其中又只有一小部分实际到达了预想的受助者手中，尽管一些机构有能力跨境提供援助，但它们无法突破战斗前线接触到困于战火的人民。
en: Support from around the world is fitful: only 60% of aid pledges have come in, with only a fraction actually reaching the intended beneficiaries. Although some agencies have been able to get aid supplies across national borders, they cannot get through the frontlines of the fighting to reach those caught in the crossfire.

zh: 因此，国际外交努力必须专注于形成临时性停火以输送需求最紧迫的援助，如儿童脊髓灰质炎疫苗。
en: International diplomatic efforts must therefore focus on achieving temporary ceasefires to bring in the most urgently needed help, such as polio vaccines for children.

zh: 正如联合国紧急纾困协调员阿莫斯（Valerie Amos）所坚持的，援助不应该只是不知何时才能结束的日内瓦和平谈判的开胃菜；而应该成为谈判的核心。
en: Aid should not be a mere side show to the seemingly endless peace talks taking place in Geneva; as United Nations emergency relief coordinator Valerie Amos insisted, it must be central to those negotiations.

zh: 但是，由于冲突及其影响预计将持续多年，各机构必须做好长期打算，包括在邻国构建为难民提供服务的能力，如世界银行在约旦和黎巴嫩所做的那样。
en: But, with the conflict and its impact expected to drag on for years, agencies must also plan for the longer term. This includes building capacity in neighboring states, as the World Bank is doing in Jordan and Lebanon, to provide services for refugees.

zh: 这可以通过创新性办法实现。
en: This can be done in creative ways.

zh: 比如，IRC就参与了三个方面的努力：
en: The IRC, for example, is involved in three areas:

zh: · 教育创新：邻国的主流教育体系无法处理难民涌入的情况；且考虑到80%的难民生活在城市地区而不是难民营，因此着重于基于难民营的教育模式是无济于事的。
en: · Innovative education: Mainstream school systems in neighboring countries cannot cope with the refugee influx; and, with more than 80% of refugees living in urban areas rather than in camps, there is little point to focusing on camp-based models of teaching.

zh: 相反，应该采取本地和难民教师网络支持的非正式��育体系 — — 这套体系曾在刚果和阿富汗得到过成功运用 — — 来提供获得承认的教育经历。
en: Instead, a more informal system, supported by networks of local and refugee teachers – a model that was successfully pioneered in Congo and Afghanistan – can provide accredited learning.

zh: · 利用技术：叙利亚人大多识字、会计算，有技术胜任力。
en: · Exploiting technology: Syrians are generally literate, numerate, and technologically sophisticated.

zh: IRC和非盈利新闻组织Internews建立了一个被称为Tawasul （ “ 联系 ” ） 的创新社交网络平台以帮助难民通过信息和建议交流互相帮助。
en: A pioneering social-networking platform called Tawasul (“Connection”), established by the IRC and the non-profit news organization Internews, has been set up to help refugees help one another through the exchange of information and advice.

zh: · 做生意：叙利亚难民习惯于市场经济，因此让他们能够通过贸易讨生活的方案应该得到鼓励。
en: · Doing business: Syrian refugees are accustomed to working in a market economy, so programs that allow them to trade, and therefore support themselves, should be encouraged.

zh: IRC正在投资“工作换现金”计划帮助难民（以及东道主）成立企业。
en: The IRC is investing in “cash for work” programs that will help refugees (and their hosts) build businesses.

zh: 如果我们想减轻叙利亚冲突及其后果的恐怖性，就不仅必须考虑拯救生命的紧急行动，还必须考虑满足让活下来的人活得有意义的长期需求。
en: If we are to lessen the horrors of the Syrian conflict and its consequences, we must think not only about emergency action to save lives, but also about meeting longer-term needs that make those lives worth living.

zh: 向冲突区提供医疗援助、建立水源和卫生站设施、保护难民度过严冬是拯救生命的关键；但我们还必须考虑如何保证活下来的人的教育和生存问题。
en: Bringing medical aid into conflict zones, setting up water and sanitation facilities, and protecting victims during harsh winters are crucial to saving lives; but we must also think about how to safeguard the education and livelihoods of those who survive.

zh: 新兴非洲的居安思危
en: Trouble Amid Plenty in Emerging Africa

zh: 纽约—非洲正在发生迅速的变化 — — 外部人士对非洲的态度亦然，而美国也最终决定紧追中国、欧洲和印度，追求在非洲大陆的利益。
en: NEW YORK – Africa is changing dramatically – and so are outsiders’ attitudes toward it, with the US finally seeming determined to catch up with China, Europe, and India in their interest in the continent.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马与四十个非洲国家首脑和200多个美国和非洲胜业领袖的最新峰会体现了新的、信心更足的情绪。
en: US President Barack Obama’s recent summit with 40 African heads of state and more than 200 US and African business leaders suggests a new, more confident mood.

zh: 这令人欢欣鼓舞；但只要撒哈拉以南非洲诸国继续挣扎于暴力冲突、贫困和腐败之中，非洲大陆的经济潜力就无法充分实现。
en: That is encouraging; but as long as parts of Sub-Saharan Africa continue to struggle with violent conflict, poverty, and corruption, the continent’s economic potential will not be fully realized.

zh: 非洲的经济增长和商业机会令人振奋、极具吸引力。
en: Africa’s economic growth and commercial opportunities are exciting and enticing.

zh: 该地区拥有多达3亿的中产阶级，并且以每年超过5%的速度增加。
en: The region’s 300 million-strong middle class is growing by more than 5% annually.

zh: 非洲大陆引领着移动银行的潮流。
en: The continent leads in mobile banking.

zh: 人均消费支出接近印度和中国水平。
en: Consumer spending per capita is close to Indian and Chinese levels.

zh: 如果外国投资能够与非洲大陆极具活力的私人部门相结合下推动重要部门 — — 特别是教育、医疗和基础设施，非洲就有可能获得其人民所需要的广泛的发展提振。
en: If foreign investment, in partnership with the continent’s vibrant private sector, can benefit key sectors – particularly education, health care, and infrastructure – Africa may gain the broad-based development boost that its people need.

zh: 但投资和增长 — — “非洲崛起 ” — —只是故事的一部分。
en: But investment and growth – “Africa rising” – are only part of the story.

zh: 非洲也有孱弱的一面，冲突和危机困扰着非洲大陆大部，特别是从马里到索马里一线诸国的数千万人。
en: There is also the Africa that is struggling, with conflict and crisis afflicting much of the continent, especially the tens of millions of people living in a belt of countries running from Mali to Somalia.

zh: 即使在最近的利比里亚和塞拉利昂埃博拉大爆发之前，南苏丹、中非共和国和马里都有步索马里和刚果民主共和国的后尘步入分裂和失败之国的行列。
en: Even before the recent Ebola outbreak in Liberia and Sierra Leone, South Sudan, the Central African Republic (CAR), and Mali were at risk of joining a long list of fragile or failing states that already includes Somalia and the Democratic Republic of Congo.

zh: 在这些国家，种族、宗教、经济和其他方面的冲突频发，使得有效治理和提供最基本服务的目标根本无从实现。
en: Ethnic, religious, economic, and other forms of strife in these countries too often overshadow the objectives of effective governance and the delivery of the most basic services.

zh: 这些国家因为大规模杀戮或难民危机才短暂地获得世界较为广泛的关注。
en: These countries come to the wider world’s attention – and then only briefly – following a mass killing or a refugee crisis.

zh: 世界的注意力马上就转移到了别处，任由这些问题继续发酵、生活条件继续恶化。
en: Then attention shifts, leaving problems to grow and living conditions to worsen.

zh: 在世界最新的国家 — — 南苏丹，跨越种族的政治统一在独立斗争期间得到了维系，但在今年分崩离析，陷入暴力冲突。
en: In South Sudan, the world’s newest country, political unity across ethnic lines was maintained during the fight for independence, but collapsed this year into violent conflict.

zh: 目前已有大约150万人流离失所，40万人逃往邻国。
en: Roughly 1.5 million people have now lost their homes, and 400,000 have fled to neighboring states.

zh: 在广泛肆虐的恐怖之中，没有人是安全的。
en: Amid the widespread terror, no one is safe.

zh: 4月份，我的组织有两位成员在参与联合国援助流离失所人士的行动中失去了生命。
en: In April, my own organization lost two staff members working inside a United Nations compound with displaced people.

zh: 而在8月初，七名当地援助工作雇员被盯上并杀害。
en: And, in early August, seven locally hired aid workers were targeted and executed.

zh: 在中非共和国，前塞雷卡（Séléka）战士对基督徒的攻击已经让位给基督徒和信封神力主宰论的反巴拉卡（Anti-balaka）军人对逃亡穆斯林的暴力侵犯。
en: In the CAR, attacks on Christians by Muslim ex-Séléka fighters have been superseded by Christian and animist Anti-balaka militias’ violence against fleeing Muslims.

zh: 中非共和国的穆斯林人口占比从15 % （ 估算）降至不足5 % 。
en: CAR’s Muslim population has dropped from an estimated 15% to less than 5%.

zh: 和往常一样，女性和儿童受到了最大的冲击。
en: As always, women and children suffer the most.

zh: 光是在过去三个月中，中非共和国首都班基的诸国际救援委员会（International Rescue Committee）中心纷纷目睹大量女性逃离暴力和虐待。
en: In the past three months alone, International Rescue Committee centers in the CAR’s capital, Bangui, have witnessed a surge of women escaping violence and abuse.

zh: 这里急需帮助，但帮助却姗姗来迟。
en: Help is urgently needed but slow to come.

zh: 联合国呼吁筹资5.65亿美元用于援助中非共和国，但目前只到位了39 % 。
en: The UN appeal to raise $565 million for the CAR is still only 39% funded.

zh: 联合国呼吁援助南苏丹，在那里，战争让农民无法耕种庄稼，导致现在面临饥荒，但只获得了目标融资额的一半。
en: The UN appeal for South Sudan, which faces famine after fighting prevented farmers from planting crops, has reached only half of its funding target.

zh: 出资疲劳 — — 决策者需要面临以及层出不穷的危机 — — 正在让这些国家付出沉重代价。
en: Donor fatigue – and the multitude of global crises now confronting policymakers – is taking its toll.

zh: 毫无疑问，人道主义行动对于解决这些紧迫危机至关重要。
en: Humanitarian action is undoubtedly essential to address immediate crises.

zh: 但一个很重要的问题是认识到，正如政治危机往往导致人道主义危机，人道主义需要也可能造成政治动荡，来自遇到危机的邻国的大量难民的涌入可能破坏整个地区的稳定。
en: But it is important to recognize that, just as political crises often lead to humanitarian crises, humanitarian need can cause political instability, with mass exodus from crisis-ridden neighboring countries destabilizing entire regions.

zh: 事实上，内战很少被遏制在最初开始的国家。
en: Indeed, civil wars are rarely contained within the countries where they begin.

zh: 难民问题有其深刻根源。
en: Refugee problems are deeply rooted.

zh: 比如，世界上一半穷人生活在饱受冲突困扰的脆弱国家 — — 比十年前高了20 % — —75%的难民与城市地区本地居民生活在一起。
en: Half of the world’s poor, for example, live in fragile and conflict-ridden states – 20% more than ten years ago – and 75% of refugees live among locals in urban areas.

zh: 危机和欠发展是密切关联的。
en: Crisis and under-development are closely interlinked.

zh: 我们日益知道怎样的人道主义行动是有用的。
en: We increasingly know what kind of humanitarian action works.

zh: 基于社区的构建信任计划要优于集中或外部管理的项目。
en: Community-based initiatives that build trust are better than centrally or externally administered projects.

zh: 增强女性保护自己免受暴力的能力，或教授流离失所儿童如何度过创伤都是最有效的恢复手段。
en: Empowering women to protect themselves from violence, or teaching displaced children how to cope with their trauma, are among the most effective paths to recovery.

zh: 我们还知道，没有安全，就不会有发展。
en: We also know that without security, there can be no development.

zh: 如今，超过10万联合国和非盟维和部队在动荡非洲国家执行任务。
en: Today, more than 100,000 UN and African Union peacekeepers are stretched across struggling African states.

zh: 这还不够，特别是在中非共和国和南苏丹。
en: More are needed, especially in the CAR and South Sudan.

zh: 对非经济投资很重要，值得深入思考和长期规划。
en: Economic investment in Africa is important and deserves serious thought and long-term planning.

zh: 奥巴马政府促进非洲大陆的商业机会的做法是正确的。
en: The Obama administration is right to promote commercial opportunities on the continent.

zh: 但光是这样做不能解决仍在威胁数百万人生命的暴力冲突的根源。
en: But that alone will not address the sources of violent conflict that still blight millions of lives.

zh: 人道主义援助必须与经济发展和良好治理并驾齐驱，充当非洲实现其真正潜力的支柱。
en: Humanitarian relief must stand alongside economic development and good governance as the pillars of Africa’s drive to achieve its true potential.

zh: 拯救将军彼得雷乌斯
en: Saving General Petraeus

zh: 普林斯顿—短短一周，美国便从美国大选的高峰来到了政治性丑闻的低估。
en: PRINCETON – The United States has moved from the high of a presidential election to the low of a political sex scandal in one short week.

zh: 对许多美国人来说，大选展示了这个国家最好的一面，但随之而来的是人们已耳熟能详的英雄被赶下神坛的桥段。
en: For many Americans, the election demonstrated what is best about the country, only to be followed by the sadly familiar process of knocking heroes off their pedestals.

zh: 对许多非美国人来说，大选带来了广受欢迎、使人安心的奥巴马的胜利，而彼得雷乌斯辞去中央情报局局长一职纯属毫无必要的自残。
en: For many non-Americans, the election brought the welcome and reassuring victory of Barack Obama, whereas the resignation of David Petraeus as Director of the CIA was an unnecessary, self-inflicted wound.

zh: 事实上，大选和彼得雷乌斯的辞职都是更大图景的一部分：承诺立国的美国。
en: In fact, both the election and Petraeus’s resignation are pieces of a larger whole: an America that lives up to its promises.

zh: 大选让许多美国人觉得，美国有能力进步，也在进步 — — 朝着理想状态进步。
en: The election reminded many Americans that the US is a country committed to and capable of progress – of moving forward toward an ideal vision.

zh: 奥巴马受到了众多少数族裔的支持：非洲裔美国人、拉丁裔、亚裔美国人、穆斯林美国人、同性恋美国人；也受到了代表不足的多数群体 — — 无不感受着不平等和不公正在继续、急切地需要解决的女性的支持。
en: Obama was supported by a coalition of minorities: African-Americans, Latinos, Asian-Americans, Muslim-Americans, gay and lesbian Americans, and an under-represented majority – women – all of whom perceive continuing inequalities and injustices that need to be remedied.

zh: 但是，赢家是全体认为美国事实上致力于“法律面前人人平等 ” — —铭刻最高法院三角墙之上的文字 — — 的人。
en: But the winners were all who believe that America is, in fact, dedicated to “equal justice under law,” the words emblazoned on the pediment of the Supreme Court.

zh: 美国大部分地区种族隔离告别种族隔离还不到半个世纪，非洲裔美国人便已当选美国总统，这部分美国人看到的是美国宪法所包含的凌驾于社会、政治和经济传统偏见之上的价值。
en: In the election of an African-American president less than a half-century after the end of official racial segregation in much of the country, these Americans see the triumph of the values enshrined in the US Constitution over America’s legacy of social, political, and economic prejudice.

zh: 他们看到的是一个代表所有美国人 — — 无论种族、性别、信仰、民族、性取向、是否残疾和经济地位 — — 的进步的总统。
en: They see a president committed to the advancement of all Americans, regardless of race, gender, creed, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, handicap, or economic status.

zh: 他们还看到了一个真正反映世界、吸引着世界各国移民并给予他们作为美国人的平等成功机会的美国。
en: They also see a country that truly does reflect the world, attracting immigrants from every nation and giving them an equal chance to succeed as Americans.

zh: 他们认为这个国家能够以要求所有公民都做出贡献 — — 反过来也让所有公民共享其繁荣 — — 的方法重建基础设施、改革医保系统、增强教育系统、提振经济繁荣。 他们对奥巴马的看法也是如此。
en: And they see a president with a vision of a country that can rebuild its infrastructure, reform its health care, strengthen its educational system, and boost its economic prosperity in ways that require all citizens to contribute – and that will, in turn, allow all citizens to flourish.

zh: 但这一看法如何与彼得雷乌斯的辞职联系在一起？ 彼得雷乌斯在掌管中央情报局之前战功卓著、形象完美，到头来居然爆出了婚外情的丑闻。
en: But how is this vision connected to the resignation of Petraeus, a storied and much-decorated general before he took over the CIA, following the revelation that he had an extra-marital affair?

zh: 从我Twitter上的内容看，大部分外国观察者并不能理解一个身居其祖国最高级、最敏感职位之人应该因为其私生活而下台 — — 这种事情的直接影响仅仅局限于他的家庭。
en: Judging by my Twitter feed, most foreign observers simply cannot understand why a man serving his country in one of its highest and most sensitive positions should step down over something that happened in his private life – something that directly affects only those involved and their families.

zh: 我解释说，美国文化将婚外情看得非常严重，因此如此位置的高官很容易被勒索 — — 而这���作为中央情报局局长所必须杜绝的。
en: American culture, I explained, judges extra-marital affairs very harshly, so a senior official caught in such a position could easily be subject to blackmail – something that a CIA director, of all people, must avoid.

zh: 我的外国评论者回复说，现在婚外情已经曝光了，勒索威胁也就随之烟消云散了，因此彼得雷乌斯应该继续任职。
en: My foreign interlocutors replied that, with the affair now exposed, the blackmail threat has been removed, so Petraeus should stay in office.

zh: 许多美国人都同意这一点。
en: Many Americans agree.

zh: 。 事实上，据称奥巴马本人就不愿接受彼得雷乌斯的辞呈。
en: Indeed, Obama himself was reportedly reluctant to accept Petraeus’s resignation.

zh: 但是，从我的角度看，彼得雷乌斯做出了正确的选择：辞职是他唯一可走的路，如果他想弥补自己的名声的话。
en: From my perspective, however, Petraeus did the right thing: resigning was the only course open to him if he is to have any chance of repairing his reputation.

zh: 彼得雷乌斯毕竟是彼得雷乌斯将军、戎马一生的四星上将、美军伊拉克和阿富汗司令官。
en: Petraeus, after all, had been General Petraeus, a four-star general who had spent his life in the military, commanding the US missions in Iraq and Afghanistan.

zh: 他毕业于 — — 后来执教于 — — 以“责任、荣誉、国家”为校训的西点军校。
en: He graduated from – and later taught at – the US Military Academy at West Point, an institution guided by the motto “Duty, Honor, Country.”

zh: 在我们叛逆的年龄段，很多人会对这一陈腐的校训嗤之以鼻（事实上，也许是对任何校训或口号都会如此 ） 。
en: In our cynical age, many might scoff at such an old-fashioned motto (or, indeed, at the power of any motto or slogan).

zh: 但西点军校的学生不会。
en: West Point cadets do not.

zh: 正如麦克阿瑟将军1962年所告诉他们的，这三个词“形成了你们的基本性格。
en: As General Douglas MacArthur told them in 1962, those three words “build your basic character.

zh: 它们塑造你们作为美国未来守护神的角色。
en: They mold you for your future roles as the custodians of the nation’s defense.

zh: 它们让你们在虚弱时知道自己足够强大，让你们在害怕时足够勇敢面对自己。
en: They make you strong enough to know when you are weak, and brave enough to face yourself when you are afraid.”

zh: ”它们教会你们，麦克阿瑟继续说 ， “ 在掌握别人之前先掌握你自己；保持一颗纯净的心，保持一个崇高的目标。 ”
en: They teach you, he continued, “to master yourself before you seek to master others; to have a heart that is clean, a goal that is high.”

zh: 麦克阿瑟的演讲是激动人心的；有人认为有过度煽情之嫌。
en: MacArthur’s rhetoric is stirring; some would say overblown.

zh: 他所表达的理想是崇高的；他本人不止一次没有做到。
en: The ideals he expressed are lofty; he himself fell short of them on more than one occasion.

zh: 但是，总的来说，美国军队中的男男女女都相信这个理想，并竭力以此作为生活准则，一如美国公民总的来说相信宪法的崇高字句并试图纠正祖国的短处。
en: But, by and large, the men and women of the US military believe in these ideals and do their best to live up to them, just as US citizens generally believe in their Constitution’s lofty words and seek to correct their national shortcomings.

zh: 彼得雷乌斯违反了他自己的个人对妻子和家庭的荣誉和责任信条 — — 在他眼里，他也因此违反了他自己对祖国的荣誉和责任信条，特别是对他所领导的中央情报局的同事们来说。
en: Petraeus violated his own personal code of honor and duty toward his wife and family – and thus, in his eyes, toward his country, particularly to the men and women whom he was entrusted to lead at the CIA.

zh: 当他的婚外情曝光时，他面对的是自己的失败，承担此时的后果，做出了在他看来责任、荣誉和国家信条要求他做出的反应。
en: When his affair came to light, he faced up to his failure, took responsibility for the consequences, and did what he believed that duty, honor, and country required.

zh: 对发酵的丑闻无孔不入的哗众取宠的披露和调查所引起的骚动可能还将持续好几星期。
en: The hubbub of tawdry disclosures and investigations addressing every aspect of a widening scandal may well last for weeks.

zh: 与此同时，美国人只能希望他们所选出的代表能够表现出相同的意愿，勇敢地面对他们的失败、丑闻以及坚持将党性至于国家显而易见的迫切需要之前的行为，并承担责任。
en: In the meantime, Americans can only hope that their national elected representatives show an equal willingness to face up to and take responsibility for their failures, pettiness, and insistence on putting partisanship ahead of the country’s manifest and urgent needs.

zh: 这些官员现在必须承担他们最基本的责任：治国。
en: These officials must now carry out their most fundamental duty: to govern.

zh: 他们必须愿意开诚布公地谈话，相互妥协以制定法律、解决问题、防止危机并打造对未来的信念。
en: They must be willing to negotiate in good faith and compromise in order to enact laws, solve problems, avert crises, and build faith in the future.

zh: 我们希望他们捍卫和支持宪法的誓言不仅仅是誓言。
en: Let us hope that their oaths to defend and uphold the Constitution are more than just words.

zh: 你的每次呼吸
en: Every Breath You Take

zh: 曼谷 — — 印尼移动雾霾、北印度后屠妖节迷雾和中国“空气污染”回潮等可怕的报道反应了亚洲近年来的空气污染灾难。
en: BANGKOK – Fearsome stories about migrating Indonesian haze, post-Diwali smog in northern India, and the return of the “airpocalypse” in China tell of Asia’s recent air-pollution woes.

zh: 不仅是在亚洲，全球室外颗粒物污染每年夺去310多万人的生命，达到疟疾致死人数的5倍，只略低于目前艾滋病致死率的两倍。
en: Not confined to Asia, outdoor particulate pollution claims over 3.1 million lives worldwide every year, five times the number of deaths from malaria and slightly less than double the current AIDS death rate.

zh: 空气中的污染物，尤其是细微颗粒（小于2.5微米，也就是大约像蜘蛛丝那么宽）能够深入人的肺部，再从那里进入血液， 进而引发心肺病、癌症，还有可能导致早产。
en: Airborne pollutants, especially fine particles (smaller than 2.5 microns, or roughly the width of a strand of a spider web), enter deep into the lungs and from there enter the blood stream, causing cardiopulmonary disease, cancer, and possibly premature births.

zh: 这究竟会造成多大的健康风险？
en: Just how significant are these health risks?

zh: 遗憾的是，我们对这个话题的探讨往往并不明确。
en: Unfortunately, discussion of the subject is often opaque.

zh: 我们说空气质量差往往是指它在一定程度上高于世卫组织标准，或者达到了特定的“空气质量指标 ” （ AQI ） 。
en: Poor air quality is often described as reaching a certain “AQI” (Air Quality Index) level, or as being a certain degree above a particular World Health Organization standard.

zh: 但与熟悉的危险比较更有利于加深公众对问题的理解程度。
en: But the general public might better understand the situation if it were framed in terms that compare easily with more familiar hazards.

zh: 比方说，可以用“微死亡率 ” （ micromort）为单位来描述呼吸受污染空气的直接风险，它所代表的是死亡概率的百万分之一。
en: For instance, the immediate risks of breathing polluted air could be described in terms of the “micromort,” the unit representing a one-in-a-million chance of dying.

zh: 一般人平均每天面临约百万分之一的非自然死亡风险。
en: An average person on an average day faces a risk of roughly one micromort from non-natural causes.

zh: 这就为对比设定了有益的基础：举例来讲，潜水每次的死亡风险约为5；而跳伞每跳则为10；在英国生孩子大约是120。
en: This provides a useful starting point for comparison: the risk of scuba diving, for example, is around five micromorts per dive; sky diving is ten micromorts per jump; and giving birth in the United Kingdom is around 120 micromorts.

zh: 相比之下，在污染最严重的情况下呼吸北京的空气大致为15左右。
en: By comparison, breathing in Beijing on its most polluted days equals approximately 15 micromorts.

zh: 但空气污染最令人不安的风险来自于长期接触。
en: But the more troubling risks from air pollution arise from chronic exposure.

zh: 我们可以用“微生存率”来对此进行量化 — — 剑桥统计学家大卫·斯皮格尔霍尔特以此作为某人终其一生的累计风险单位。
en: This can be expressed in terms of “microlives” – a unit developed by Cambridge statistician David Spiegelhalter to describe a person’s cumulative risks over a lifetime.

zh: 1“微生存率”相当于普通青年成人30分钟的预期寿命。
en: One microlife represents 30 minutes of an average young adult’s expected lifespan.

zh: 普通人每天消耗约48个“微生存率 ” ； 但生活方式会影响人消耗“微生存率”的速度。
en: The average person uses up about 48 microlives per day; but lifestyle affects how fast one expends one’s microlives.

zh: 定居在大雾弥漫的北京每天将多消耗2-3个“微生存率 ” ， 相当于缩短近三年的寿命。
en: Settling in smoggy Beijing will use up roughly an additional 2-3 microlives per day, implying a reduction in life expectancy of almost three years.

zh: 定居香港或者圣地亚哥、智利将每天将多消耗1“微生存率 ” ， 而生活在世界污染最严重的城市之一新德里每天则多消耗4-5个“微生存率 ” 。
en: Living in Hong Kong or Santiago, Chile, will cost one additional microlife per day, whereas daily life in New Delhi, one of the world’s most polluted cities, costs an estimated 4-5 microlives.

zh: 相比之下，每天吸4支烟会消耗吸烟者约2个“微生存率 ” ， 这大致相当于在北京生活。
en: By comparison, smoking four cigarettes a day will cost the smoker around two microlives, roughly equivalent to living in Beijing.

zh: 但老化的步伐也可以得以延缓 — — 每天锻炼20分钟能延长2“微生存率”的寿命（除非在浓雾中锻炼 ） ， 而每天喝2到3杯咖啡还能多节省1 “微生存率 ” 。
en: But the aging clock can also be slowed down – 20 minutes of daily exercise will extend life expectancy by two microlives per day (unless done in the smog), and drinking two or three cups of coffee daily saves an additional microlife per day.

zh: 此外，近来的研究结果表明在北京损失的某些 “微生存率”搬到空气洁净的温哥华就可以恢复。
en: Furthermore, recent research suggests that some, if not all, of the microlives lost from living in Beijing could be recovered by moving to, say, Vancouver, with its pristine air.

zh: 除了逃离城市，还可以通过限制特别危险日的空气吸入来控制某些风险因素。
en: Besides skipping town, one can mitigate at least some of the risks by limiting one’s exposure on particularly hazardous days.

zh: 如果能得到现时的空气质量数据，民众就可以选择采取防护措施，如减少体力消耗、待在室内（最好对空气进行过滤）和佩戴口罩（至少佩戴N95级口罩，而不是手术口罩 ） 。
en: If citizens had access to current air-quality data, they could choose to take protective measures, such as minimizing physical exertion, staying indoors (ideally in filtered air), and wearing a mask (an N95-rated mask, at a minimum, not a surgical mask).

zh: 遗憾的是，空气质量信息，特别是最有害的细微颗粒物信息在很多重度污染城市并不容易找到。
en: Unfortunately, air-quality information, especially for the most pernicious fine particles, is not easily available in many highly polluted cities.

zh: 但这样的监测并没有超出发展中国家的能力，因为所需的设备并不十分昂贵。
en: But such monitoring is not beyond the reach of developing countries, because the necessary equipment is not prohibitively expensive.

zh: 理想情况下，人们应当搜集空气质量数据、翻译成易于理解的语言并通过社会媒体实时广泛播出。 这样城市居民就可以采取恰当的对策（这对于体弱者尤其重要 ） 。
en: Ideally, air-quality data should be collected, translated into easily understandable language, and widely disseminated in real-time via social media so that city dwellers can take appropriate action (particularly important for vulnerable individuals).

zh: 中国在这方面已经取得了很大的进步，树立了很好的榜样供其他发展中国家仿效。
en: In this regard, China has made big strides, providing a good example for other developing countries to follow.

zh: 当然，政府不应仅仅满足于监控；而应积极采取措施减少空气污染。
en: Of course, governments should not stop at monitoring; they should take active measures to reduce air pollution.

zh: 在亚洲快速城市化和工业发展的压力下，实现目标需要付出长期的努力，政府必须做出复杂的决策，制定痛苦的经济折衷方案。
en: Against the pressure of Asia’s rapid urbanization and industrial development, this will take sustained effort, involving complex policy decisions and painful economic trade-offs.

zh: 为所有人提供空气质量信息（从根本上实现数据民主化）能使民众更好地参与应付出何种代价应对空气污染的讨论；同时也为高度污染的新环境对健康有何影响这种迫切需要的研究提供了最基本的数据。
en: Making air-quality information available to all – essentially democratizing the data – allows people to engage better in the debate on what sacrifices are acceptable in the fight against air pollution; it also provides basic input for desperately needed research into the health effects of these new highly polluted environments.

zh: 上述深远的健康影响，再加上公民自我保护的现实好处，应该能够刺激哪怕是财政上最捉襟见肘的政府立即实施透明的空气质量监测。
en: These far-reaching health effects, in addition to the immediate benefit of empowering citizens to protect themselves, should spur even the most financially strapped governments to start a transparent air-quality monitoring campaign today.

zh: 蠢人的鼓吹
en: An Advocacy of Dunces

zh: 康科德，马萨诸塞州—想象一下，一群鼓吹者试图警告公众他们感到了某种危险，而证据表明这种危险并不真实，通过散播他们的恐慌，这群人导致人们的行为将更广大的公众 — — 和你 — — 面临危险。
en: CONCORD, MASSACHUSETTS – Imagine that a group of advocates tried to alert the public to a danger that they perceived, only the evidence showed that the danger was not real, and that by spreading their fears, this group was causing people to behave in ways that put the wider public – and you – at risk.

zh: 你会怎么做？
en: What would you do?

zh: 政府应该怎么做？
en: What should the government do?

zh: 澳大利亚用戏剧性的方式回答了这个问题。
en: The government of Australia has answered that question in a dramatic way.

zh: 它取消了一家反疫苗鼓吹团体的免税慈善机构地位，因为他们宣传疫苗威胁公共健康、特别是儿童健康的谣言。
en: It has revoked the tax-exempt charity status of an anti-vaccination advocacy group, on the grounds that their fear-mongering misinformation about the danger of vaccines threatens public health, especially the health of children.

zh: 政府还要求该团体变更名称，从澳大利亚疫苗网络（Australian Vaccination Network）改为澳大利亚疫苗质疑网络（Australian Vaccination-Skeptics Network ） ， 从而明确该鼓吹团体的态度。
en: The government has also required the group to change its name, from the Australian Vaccination Network to the Australian Vaccination-Skeptics Network, in order to make the advocate’s perspective clear.

zh: “我们将进一步确保他们以反疫苗鼓吹者的面目出现 ， ” 新南威尔士州公平贸易部长斯图尔特·埃尔斯（Stuart Ayres）说 ， “ 我们希望确保他们不再传播误导性信息。
en: “We will continue to ensure that they present themselves as an anti-vaccination advocacy,” said New South Wales Fair Trading Minister Stuart Ayres. “We want to make sure that they don’t ever promote misleading information.”

zh: 当然，这是危险领域。
en: This is, of course, dangerous territory.

zh: 尽管证据表明一名并不构成其反对者顽固宣称的伤害，但政府限制言论的行为总归令人担心。
en: Though the evidence is clear that vaccination does not cause the harms that its opponents stubbornly claim it does, any effort by a government to restrict speech is worrying.

zh: 自由社会都不会允许政府根据鼓吹团体的信奉内容来决定哪些鼓吹团体可以说哪些话。
en: No free society should permit its government to decide which advocacy groups can say what, based on what those advocates believe.

zh: 但在这个案例中，澳大利亚官员的行动是完全合适并且重要的公共服务：以鲁棒、一致的医学证据为依据，保护公共健康和安全。
en: But, in this case, the Australian officials’ action was an entirely appropriate, and essential, public service: protecting public health and safety, based on robust and consistent medical evidence.

zh: 证据表明，反疫苗鼓吹者的论点 — — 儿童疫苗导致孤僻和其他长期神经发育伤害是完全错误的。
en: That evidence conclusively disproves the claims of anti-vaccination advocates that childhood vaccination causes autism and other long-term neurodevelopmental damage.

zh: 但仍有一小群杞人忧天者和唯利是图者声嘶力竭地传播恐慌、制造扭曲，他们赤裸裸地撒谎，宣扬疫苗弊大于利。
en: Yet a small but vocal group of alarmists and self-serving profiteers continues to spread fear-mongering distortions and outright lies claiming that vaccines do more harm than good.

zh: 结果，一些社区的疫苗接种率出现下降，特别是反政府自由主义者和回归自然环保主义者聚居的社区。
en: As a result, vaccination rates are declining in some communities, especially those with high concentrations of anti-government libertarians or back-to-nature environmentalists.

zh: 结果，在一些地区，麻疹和百日咳等疾病的社区规模“群体”免疫水平已经不足以将这些疾病限制在总体人口大爆发阈值内。
en: As a result, in some areas, community-wide “herd” immunity levels for diseases like measles and pertussis (whooping cough) have fallen below those necessary to keep them from spreading into the general population.

zh: 疫苗超过时效或没有大到100%效果的成年人健康状况越来越差。
en: Adults in whom the vaccine has worn off or is not 100% effective are increasingly getting sick.

zh: 年纪太小、无法接种百日咳疫苗的婴儿也饱受疾病困扰，甚至出现致死的情况。
en: Infants too young to be vaccinated against pertussis are also falling ill, with some actually coughing and choking themselves to death.

zh: 因此澳大利亚政府的决定毫无疑问是合情合理的。
en: So the Australian government’s decision is clearly justified.

zh: 毕竟，保护我们免受作为个体的我们无法自我保护的威胁困扰是我们授权给政府和核心使命之一。
en: Protecting us from threats from which we cannot protect ourselves as individuals is, after all, a central part of what we empower government to do.

zh: 当面临证据明确支持疫苗、并且可能造成死亡的后果的情况时，政府应该充当现成的威权，以公共安全的名义采取行动 — — 事实上，这也是政府的义务。
en: When the evidence is as clear as it is with vaccines (and the consequences as grave), the government has the well-established authority – indeed, obligation – to act in the name of public safety.

zh: 但疫苗只是鼓吹者可能通过否认科学证据让公众陷于危险的例子之一。
en: But vaccination is only one example of how advocates sometimes put the public at risk by rejecting scientific evidence.

zh: 受意识形态驱动否认人类造成全球变暖正在妨碍我们采取行动遏制导致气候变化的排放、妨碍我们为这一威胁的日益明显也日益危险的后果做好准备。
en: The ideology-driven denial of human-induced global warming is impeding efforts to mitigate climate-altering emissions or prepare for the increasingly obvious – and dangerous – consequences of this enormous threat.

zh: 持枪权管制的顽固反对派 — — 特别是在美国 — — 导致难以杜绝危险分子获得致命武器。
en: Absolutist opposition to any regulation of gun ownership, particularly in the United States, is making it harder to keep deadly weapons out of the hands of those who pose a threat to society.

zh: 抵制生物技术，特别是转基因食品则是另一个例子。
en: Resistance to biotechnology, especially genetically modified (GM) foods, is another example.

zh: 一些转基因应用能够给人类健康带来重大改善，但社会不喜欢这些好处 — — 人们也因此遭罪和死亡 — — 因为反对者拒绝所有转基因应用，而之所以反对，是因为他们不喜欢大公司、商业农业和现代科技。
en: Some applications could bring enormous net benefits to human health, but society is not enjoying those benefits – and people are suffering and dying as a result – because opponents reject all GM applications, owing to a fundamental dislike of large companies, commercial agriculture, or modern technologies generally.

zh: 这是一种转基因杂交种，携带来自胡萝卜的能产生维生素A的基因。 最新研究表明，光是在印度，如果黄金大米在2002年技术成熟时便获得批准，到目前为止可以挽救因维生素A缺乏而失明甚至致死的人口140万年的寿命（经残疾调整 ） 。
en: Consider “golden rice,” a GM hybrid that carries the gene from carrots that makes vitamin A. A recent study found that, in India alone, had golden rice been approved when it was technically ready in 2002, it could have saved 1.4 million disability-adjusted life years for those who instead suffered blindness or death from vitamin A deficiency.

zh: 应该在鼓吹者以价值驱动的观点否认民孤儿的科学证据并让你我置于风险之中时予以反制。
en: It is time to push back against advocates when their values-driven views deny clear scientific evidence and put you and me at risk.

zh: 科学家必须发声，比如最近在英格兰，测试了一种新小麦的研究者要求与反转基因鼓吹者公开辩论。
en: Scientists must speak out, as they did recently in England, where researchers testing a new strain of wheat challenged anti-GM advocates to a public debate.

zh: 鼓吹者拒绝接受，但对田间试验进行了有计划的攻击，这使得支持这些活跃分子的公众数量大减。
en: The advocates refused, but went ahead with planned attacks on the field trials, causing public support for those activists to diminish.

zh: 你我这样的凡人必须反击，我们可以选择加入和在财务上支持一些团体。
en: You and I and our fellow citizens must push back, by choosing which groups to join or to support financially.

zh: 我们需要在立法公共听证中奋起反击，不能让最热情的声音唬住政客和决策者，导致声音最响的一小撮人获得决策胜利而妨碍了更广大社会的大部分利益。
en: We need to push back at public hearings and in testimony about pending legislation, and not let the most passionate voices bully our politicians and policymakers into choices that placate the loudest few, but that deny the greater community the most good.

zh: 此外，当有证据确凿、风险近在眼前时，政府必须反击，就像澳大利亚做的那样。
en: And, when the evidence is clear and the risk imminent, governments must push back, as Australia’s has done.

zh: 感觉和价值永远应该在民主国家中发生。
en: Feelings and values must always have a voice in any democracy.

zh: 我们需要各方的鼓吹激情以推动社会前进。
en: We need the passion of advocates on all sides to move society forward.

zh: 但当这些激情披着事实的画皮出现并置我们于险地时，你、我和我们的政府绝对应该以公共健康核安全的名义异口同声地说 ： “ 够了。 ”
en: But when those passions fly in the face of the facts and put us at risk, it is entirely fair that in the name of public health and safety, you and I and our governments all say, “Enough is enough.”

zh: 新进步政治经济学
en: A New Progressive Political Economy

zh: 伦敦—在《外交事务》上一篇名为《历史的未来 》 （ “The Future of History ” ） 的文章中，弗朗西斯·福山（Francis Fukuyama）指出，尽管援助华尔街带来了广泛的愤怒，但对左翼政党的支持并没有爆发。
en: LONDON – In an article in Foreign Affairs entitled “The Future of History,” Francis Fukuyama pointed out that, despite widespread anger at Wall Street bailouts, there has been no great upsurge of support for left-wing political parties.

zh: 福山把这归因于援助的失败，我赞同他的看法。
en: Fukuyama attributed this – rightly, I believe – to a failure of ideas.

zh: 2008年金融危机暴露了新自由主义资本主义观点的严重漏洞，对过去35年的可观审视证明，与此前30年相比，新自由主义模式在经济增长、金融稳定和社会公正方面的表现都没有胜出。
en: The 2008 financial crash revealed major flaws in the neoliberal view of capitalism, and an objective view of the last 35 years shows that the neoliberal model has not performed well relative to the previous 30 years in terms of economic growth, financial stability, and social justice.

zh: 但可信的进步的替代方案尚未形成。
en: But a credible progressive alternative has yet to take shape.

zh: 这样一种替代方案的主要特征是什么？
en: What should be the main outlines of such an alternative?

zh: 首先，进步的政治经济必须基于对资本主义的坚定信念 — — 即基于大部分资产为私有、主要由市场指导生产和分配收入的经济体系。
en: First, a progressive political economy must be based on a firm belief in capitalism – that is, on an economic system in which most of the assets are privately owned, and markets largely guide production and distribute income.

zh: 但该方案也必须纳入三大决定性进步信念：制度的关键作用、国家参与制度设计以解决利益冲突和提供公共品、以及作为国家经济表现重要标准的社会公正（以公平性为定义 ） 。
en: But it must also incorporate three defining progressive beliefs: the crucial role of institutions; the need for state involvement in their design in order to resolve conflicting interests and provide public goods; and social justice, defined as fairness, as an important measure of a country’s economic performance.

zh: 古典经济学家没有把资本主义视为社会经济体系，也没有把制度视为其中的关键部分，这是一个严重的错误。
en: It was a great mistake of neoclassical economists not to see that capitalism is a socioeconomic system, and that institutions are an essential part of it.

zh: 最近的金融危机由于重大的制度失灵而变得更加糟糕，比如允许银行采用高杠杆率。
en: The recent financial crisis was made far worse by profound institutional failures, such as the high level of leverage that banks were permitted to have.

zh: 实证研究表明，四套制度对企业、因此也对一国的经济增长的表现具有重要影响。
en: Empirical research has shown that four sets of institutions have a major impact on the performance of firms and, therefore, on a country’s economic growth.

zh: 它们是作为金融和劳动力市场基础的制度、公司治理安排、教育和培训体系以及创新的国家体系（提出和扩散新技术的公共和私人制度网络 ） 。
en: These include the institutions underpinning its financial and labor markets, its corporate-governance arrangements, its education and training system, and its national system of innovation (the network of public and private institutions that initiate and diffuse new technologies).

zh: 进步思想的第二大决定性信念是制度并不像新自由主义者认为的那样是自发演进的。
en: The second defining belief of progressive thinking is that institutions do not evolve spontaneously, as neoliberals believe.

zh: 国家必须参与到它们的设计和改革中。
en: The state must be involved in their design and reform.

zh: 对作为劳动力和金融市场以及公司治理基础的制度而言，国家必须协调利益冲突。
en: In the case of institutions underpinning labor and financial markets, as well as corporate governance, the state must mediate conflicting interests.

zh: 类似地，一国的教育和培训体系及其创新的国家体系可以说都是公共品，必须由国家提供。
en: Likewise, a country’s education and training system and its national system of innovation are largely public goods, which have to be provided by the state.

zh: 应该澄清的是，我所说的国家角色应该是扶助性的或支持市场的，而不是传统社会主义者所追求的指令-控制型角色或新自由主义者所钟爱的越小越好的角色。
en: It should be clear that the role for the state that I have been describing is an enabling or market-supporting one. It is not the command-and-control role promoted by traditional socialists or the minimalist role beloved by neoliberals.

zh: 进步思想的第三大关键信念与一国经济表现应该完全用GDP增长和自由来衡量的新自由主义观点相反。
en: The third defining belief of progressive thinking rejects the neoliberal view that a country’s economic performance should be assessed solely in terms of GDP growth and freedom.

zh: 如若你关心社会的福祉，就不可能认为最顶层1%掌握大部分财富的富国比财富略有不及但繁荣被更广泛地共享的国家表现更好。
en: If one is concerned with a society’s wellbeing, it is not possible to argue that a rich country in which the top 1% hold most of the wealth is performing better than a slightly less wealthy country in which prosperity is more widely shared.

zh: 此外，公平是比社会公正更好的平等性指标。
en: Moreover, fairness is a better measure of social justice than equality.

zh: 这是因为很难制定实用有效的政策在市场经济条件下追求平等。
en: This is because it is difficult to devise practical and effective policies to achieve equality in a market economy.

zh: 此外，在平等性和经济增长之间存在现实权衡问题，平均主义即使对许多低收入的人来说也不是值得支持的政策。
en: Moreover, there is a real tradeoff between equality and economic growth, and egalitarianism is not a popular policy even for many low-income people.

zh: 根据我的经验，工会对于工资差异的兴趣比对一刀切的平等政策更大。
en: In my experience, trade unions are much more interested in wage differentials than in a simple policy of equal pay for all.

zh: 我认为，这些便是新进步政治经济学应该具有的核心原则。
en: These are the core principles that I believe a new progressive political economy should embrace.

zh: 我还认为，不采用这一框架而是坚持新自由主义政治经济学的西方国家将发现越来越难以创新和增长。
en: I also believe that Western countries that do not adopt this framework, and instead cling to a neoliberal political economy, will find it increasingly difficult to innovate and grow.

zh: 在新的全球经济中，廉价劳动力泛滥，西方经济体无法在这场企业追求低而又低的劳动力、土地和资本、而政府通过去监管和收缩社会福利吸引它们的“向下竞争”中胜出。
en: In the new global economy, which is awash with cheap labor, Western economies will not be able to compete in a “race to the bottom,” with firms seeking ever-cheaper labor, land, and capital, and governments seeking to attract them by deregulating and shrinking social benefits.

zh: 西方经济体得以在竞争中立足并改善生活条件的唯一出路是认为自己处在一场向上竞争的竞赛中。
en: The only way Western economies will be able to compete and improve their standard of living is by seeing themselves as being involved in a race to the top.

zh: 也就是说，企业必须通过在已有行���中的创新和开发在更新更先进的行业（增加值也会更高）的竞争力来改善它们的增加值。
en: That is, firms must improve their value added through innovation in existing industries, and by developing the capability to compete in new and more sophisticated industries, where value added is generally higher.

zh: 只有在政府抛弃它们对经济没有责任的信念的情况下，公司才能做到这一点。
en: Companies will be able to do this only if governments abandon the belief that they have no role to play in the economy.

zh: 事实上，国家在为激活公司创造力和增长力条件方面具有关键作用。
en: In fact, the state has a key role to play in providing the conditions that enable dynamic companies to innovate and grow.

zh: 人权发展的错误方向
en: A Wrong Turn for Human Rights

zh: 纽约—世界已经进入残酷时代，施害者不会因为暴力而受到惩罚。
en: NEW YORK – The world has plunged into a period of brutality, with impunity for the perpetrators of violence.

zh: 意见不一的联合国安理会束手旁观导致叙利亚无数平民伤亡。 加沙之痛令人绝望，而可以停止它的痛苦的人却无动于衷。
en: Syria is suffering untold civilian casualties as a divided United Nations Security Council sits on the sidelines. Gaza was pummeled to dust yet again with the world watching on. Iraq is in flames, with no end in sight.

zh: 伊拉克陷入了一片火海，并且没有停歇迹象。 南苏丹和中非共和国暴行愈演愈烈，更有无处不在的性暴力肆虐。
en: Atrocities are mounting in South Sudan and the Central African Republic, which are also being swept by an epidemic of sexual violence.

zh: 甚至欧洲也未能幸免：一架民航客机在东乌克兰冲突地区被击落，而官员对实践调查横加阻梗。
en: Even Europe is not immune: a civilian aircraft was shot down over a conflict zone in eastern Ukraine, and officials were prevented from investigating.

zh: 柏林墙已经倒塌二十五年，国际刑事法庭（International Criminal Court）也已经成立十多年，但我们为阻止暴行所做的努力少得可怜，而受害者获得正义也是遥遥无期，更不用说将施害者送上审判席了。
en: Twenty-five years after the fall of the Berlin Wall, and more than a decade after the establishment of the International Criminal Court (ICC), shockingly little is being done to stop these abuses, and the prospects of the victims ever getting justice, let alone bringing the perpetrators to account, seem ever more remote.

zh: 多年来，世界似乎不断地在向承认更多人权和争议需求的方向进步。
en: For many years, the world seemed to be progressing toward greater recognition of human rights and demands for justice.

zh: 随着20世纪八九十年代民主在拉美和中东欧的兴起，这些问题变得日益重要。
en: As democracies emerged in Latin America and Central and Eastern Europe in the 1980s and 1990s, these issues assumed increasing importance.

zh: 尽管战争、冲突和暴行依然存在，但世界各大国总是试图 — — 有时也能成功，尽管局势混乱并且往往姗姗来迟 — — 阻止杀戮。
en: Although wars, conflicts, and atrocities continued, the global powers tried, and occasionally managed – albeit chaotically and usually late – to stop the killing.

zh: 此外，国际社会建立了司法框架处置暴力的后果，这在冷战期间是难以想象的。
en: Moreover, the international community created frameworks for justice to deal with the consequences of violence, a move that was scarcely imaginable during the Cold War.

zh: 新的联合国国际混合法庭成立了，并且起诉了巴尔干半岛、卢旺达、塞拉利昂和柬埔寨的暴行。
en: New UN-backed international and hybrid tribunals were created to bring to account perpetrators of atrocities in the Balkans, Rwanda, Sierra Leone, and Cambodia.

zh: 国际刑事法庭拥有对122个成员国暴行的司法管辖权，可根据国家方面或安理会的要求立案（尽管三个常任理事国（美国、俄罗斯和中国）尚未批准或加入罗马规约（Rome Statute，加入则意味着进入了国际刑事法庭的司法管辖范围 ） ） 。
en: The ICC, with jurisdiction over atrocities committed in 122 member states, was established to try cases referred to it by state parties or the Security Council (even though three permanent members – the United States, Russia, and China – have not ratified or acceded to the Rome Statute, which places parties under ICC jurisdiction).

zh: 此外，许多政府在联合国的支持下，在国内建立了过渡司法制度，包括四十多个“真相委员会 ” （ truth commissions，如阿根廷、萨尔瓦多、东帝汶、摩洛哥和南非 ） 、 赔偿程序以及检查起诉。
en: In addition, many governments, with UN support, created mechanisms for transitional justice at home, including more than 40 “truth commissions” (such as in Argentina, El Salvador, East Timor, Morocco, and South Africa), reparation programs, and prosecutions.

zh: 所有这些努力都不完美，但它们给了受害者发声和承认他们的遭遇的机会，同时也向犯罪者表明，他们的罪行是不会被忘记的。
en: None of these efforts has been perfect, but they have given victims a voice and recognized their suffering, while signaling to culprits that their crimes will not be forgotten.

zh: 这些措施也深深地影响甚至改变了积极的公共披露。
en: Such measures have also deeply affected, and in some cases transformed, public discourse for the better.

zh: 但是，如今国际社会似乎在人权承诺方面出现了倒退。
en: Today, however, the international community appears to be backsliding on its human-rights commitments.

zh: 世界新兴强国缺乏制止暴力的紧迫感，总是组回球狭隘的短期利益而不进行长期和平与正义投资。
en: The world’s emerging powers lack any sense of urgency in addressing abuses, preferring the pursuit of narrower, short-term interests to investing in long-term peace and justice.

zh: 没有国际社会的强劲支持，司法机构面临着压力 — — 也在失去动力。
en: Without robust support from the international community, the institutions of justice are coming under pressure – and losing their momentum.

zh: 一些国家抨击国际刑事法庭；非洲联盟成员国希望国家元首更获得起诉豁免，这破坏了国际刑事法庭的基本原则。
en: Several countries have attacked the ICC; African Union members want heads of state to be immune from prosecution, thus undermining a fundamental principle of the court.

zh: 平心而论，许多正在经历政治转型的国家顽强地追求着某种形式的正义。
en: To be sure, many states undergoing political transition are doggedly pursuing some form of justice.

zh: 比如，正义和人权是柬埔寨历史性和平谈判的核心。
en: For example, justice and human rights are at the heart of the historic peace talks in Colombia.

zh: 尽管阿拉伯之春以失败告终，但突尼斯正在改革中突飞猛进，包括建立了真相和尊严委员会（Truth and Dignity Commission）
en: Despite the collapse of the Arab Spring, Tunisia is pressing ahead with reforms, including the creation of a Truth and Dignity Commission.

zh: 但如果没有国际机构的帮助，这些国家或许难以与难堪的过去充分决裂。
en: But these societies may find it difficult to address adequately their troubled pasts without the support of international institutions.

zh: 在其他地区，人权斗争可能根本无从谈起。
en: Elsewhere, the fight for human rights might become virtually impossible.

zh: 事实上，冷战结束以来，捍卫人权进展都已经十分困难，更不用说扩大成果了。
en: Indeed, it will be hard enough to defend the human-rights gains made since the end of the Cold War, much less to expand them.

zh: 幸运的是，政府对人权进步问题的日益沉默 — — 甚至赤裸裸的阻挠 — — 不会阻止公民社会组织继续为正义而斗争。
en: Fortunately, governments’ growing reticence about progress on human rights – if not outright obstruction – will not stop civil-society groups from continuing their fight for justice.

zh: 阿根廷的“五月广场母亲 ” （ Mothers of Plaza de Mayo）和“斯雷布雷尼察母亲 ” （ Mothers of Srebrenica）等组织一直在勇敢地充当开路先锋；毫无疑问，它们会继续这样做下去。
en: Groups like is Argentina’s Mothers of Plaza de Mayo and the Mothers of Srebrenica have always bravely led the way; they will, no doubt, continue to do so.

zh: 但重要政府（特别是新兴大国政府）缺席这一进程，有可能让世界的问责时代昙花一现。
en: But the absence from this process of key governments, especially the emerging powers, threatens to end the world’s all-too-brief era of accountability.

zh: 国际社会应该痛下决心，重新燃起使命感，从口头到实践履行其对人权和正义世界的承诺。
en: It is time for the international community to redouble its resolve, regain its sense of purpose, and reaffirm, in both word and deed, its commitment to human rights and a more just world.

zh: 达沃斯后的抑郁
en: Post-Davos Depression

zh: 达沃斯—我从1995年开始参加瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛年会，这是所谓的全球精英开会讨论世界问题的会议。
en: DAVOS – I’ve been attending the World Economic Forum’s annual conference in Davos, Switzerland – where the so-called global elite convenes to discuss the world’s problems – since 1995.

zh: 我从未像今年那样感到沮丧。
en: Never have I come away more dispirited than I have this year.

zh: 世界正受到难以解决的问题的困扰。
en: The world is plagued by almost intractable problems.

zh: 不平等性急剧上升，特别是在发达经济体。
en: Inequality is surging, especially in the advanced economies.

zh: 数字革命尽管潜力巨大，但也给隐私、安全、就业和民主造成了巨大威胁 — — 这些挑战因为美国和中国数据巨头，如脸谱和谷歌等公司的垄断实力而进一步加剧。
en: The digital revolution, despite its potential, also carries serious risks for privacy, security, jobs, and democracy – challenges that are compounded by the rising monopoly power of a few American and Chinese data giants, including Facebook and Google.

zh: 气候变化对全球经济造成了生存威胁，这一点已是众所周知。
en: Climate change amounts to an existential threat to the entire global economy as we know it.

zh: 但也许比这些问题更令人寒心的是我们的应对。
en: Perhaps more disheartening than such problems, however, are the responses.

zh: 平心而论，在达沃斯，全世界的CEO们的发言动辄以强调价值观的重要新开头。
en: To be sure, here at Davos, CEOs from around the world begin most of their speeches by affirming the importance of values.

zh: 他们宣称，自己的行动不但要让股东利润最大化，还要为企业员工、所在社区和全世界创造更好的未来。
en: Their activities, they proclaim, are aimed not just at maximizing profits for shareholders, but also at creating a better future for their workers, the communities in which they work, and the world more generally.

zh: 他们甚至还会提到气候变化和不平等性所带来的威胁。
en: They may even pay lip service to the risks posed by climate change and inequality.

zh: 但在听完了今年的这些演讲后，你对驱动达沃斯CEO们的价值观的一切幻想都幻灭了。
en: But, by the end of their speeches this year, any remaining illusion about the values motivating Davos CEOs was shattered.

zh: 这些CEO最关心的风险，是民粹主义对他们所打造、并从中获取丰厚利润的全球化的反攻。
en: The risk that these CEOs seemed most concerned about is the populist backlash against the kind of globalization that they have shaped – and from which they have benefited immensely.

zh: 毫不奇怪，这些经济精英根本没有领会系统是如何辜负了欧洲和美国的大量人口，让大部分家庭真实收入停滞不前，并导致劳动力占收入的比重大幅下降的。
en: Not surprisingly, these economic elites barely grasp the extent to which this system has failed large swaths of the population in Europe and the United States, leaving most households’ real incomes stagnant and causing labor’s share of income to decline substantially.

zh: 在美国，寿命预期已经连续第二年下滑；而如果你只能读到高中毕业，寿命预期的趋势下降更是早就开始了。
en: In the US, life expectancy has declined for the second year in a row; among those with only a high school education, the decline has been underway for much longer.

zh: 就我所听到（或听说）的美国CEO的演讲而言，没有一个人提到美国总统特朗普（他也出参加了年会）的偏执 、 “ 直男癌”和种族主义。
en: Not one of the US CEOs whose speech I heard (or heard about) mentioned the bigotry, misogyny, or racism of US President Donald Trump, who was present at the event.

zh: 没有一人提到让美国总统 — — 因此也就是美国 — — 在世界面前名誉扫地的不断的无知言论、赤裸谎言和鲁莽行为。
en: Not one mentioned the relentless stream of ignorant statements, outright lies, and impetuous actions that have eroded the standing of the US president – and thus of the US – in the world.

zh: 没有一人提到核实事实制度已被抛弃，因此事实本身也被抛弃了。
en: None mentioned the abandonment of systems for ascertaining truth, and of truth itself.

zh: 事实上，没有一位美国企业界“大佬”提到美国政府削减科学拨款。 科学拨款对于加强美国经济的比较优势、支持美国人民生活水平的提高至关重要。
en: Indeed, none of America’s corporate titans mentioned the administration’s reductions in funding for science, so important for strengthening the US economy’s comparative advantage and supporting gains in Americans’ standard of living.

zh: 也没有一人提到特朗普政府拒绝国际机构或攻击国内媒体和司法 — — 这无异于攻击作为美国的民主的基石的制衡机制。
en: None mentioned the Trump administration’s rejection of international institutions, either, or the attacks on the domestic media and judiciary – which amounts to an assault on the system of checks and balances that underpins US democracy.

zh: 来到达沃斯的CEO们大谈特朗普和国会共和党最近落实为法律的税收立法。 这项立法将给大公司以及拥有和经营它们的富豪 — — 比如特朗普本人 — — 带来数千亿美元。
en: No, the CEOs at Davos were licking their lips at the tax legislation that Trump and congressional Republicans recently pushed through, which will deliver hundreds of billions of dollars to large corporations and the wealthy people who own and run them – people like Trump himself.

zh: 这样一部立法，如果得到全面实施，将导致大部分中产阶级税收负担增加 — — 而在过去三十年中，这个群体的财富一直在下降。 对于这个事实，他们倒是显得非常平静。
en: They are unperturbed by the fact that the same legislation will, when it is fully implemented, lead to an increase in taxes for the majority of the middle class – a group whose fortunes have been in decline for the last 30 years or so.

zh: 即使在增长胜于一切的狭隘的物质世界中，特朗普税收立法也不应该受到欢迎。
en: Even in their narrowly materialistic world, where growth matters above all else, the Trump tax legislation should not be celebrated.

zh: 毕竟，它降低了房地产投机的税收 — — 这种活动不曾在任何地方创造持续繁荣，倒是到处制造不平等性加剧。
en: After all, it lowers taxes on real-estate speculation – an activity that has produced sustainable prosperity nowhere, but has contributed to rising inequality everywhere.

zh: 该立法还向哈佛和普林斯顿等大学征税 — — 这里可是无数重要思想和创新的源头 — — 并将降低地方层面的公共支出 — — 在美国不少地方，恰恰是因为教育和基础设施方面的公共投资而实现了繁荣。
en: The legislation also imposes a tax on universities like Harvard and Princeton – sources of numerous important ideas and innovations – and will lead to lower local-level public expenditure in parts of the country that have thrived, precisely because they have made public investments in education and infrastructure.

zh: 特朗普政府显然是准备无视显而易见的事实：在二十一世纪，成功真的需要提高教育方面的投资。
en: The Trump administration is clearly willing to ignore the obvious fact that, in the twenty-first century, success actually demands more investment in education.

zh: 对达沃斯的CEO们来说，对富人和他们的公司减税，再加上去监管化，便是解决所有国家的问题的答案。
en: For the CEOs of Davos, it seems that tax cuts for the rich and their corporations, along with deregulation, is the answer to every country’s problems.

zh: 他们宣称，涓滴经济学（trickle-down economics）最终将确保全体人口都获得经济收益。
en: Trickle-down economics, they claim, will ensure that, ultimately, the entire population benefits economically.

zh: 而CEO们的善心毫无疑问就是确保环境受到保护的所有必要条件，哪怕没有相关监管措施都行。
en: And the CEOs’ good hearts are apparently all that is needed to ensure that the environment is protected, even without relevant regulations.

zh: 但历史的教训是明确的。
en: Yet the lessons of history are clear.

zh: 涓滴经济学没有作用。
en: Trickle-down economics doesn’t work.

zh: 而我们的环境之所以沦落到如此危险的境地，一个重要原因便是公司没有承担应该承担的社会责任。
en: And one of the key reasons why our environment is in such a precarious condition is that corporations have not, on their own, lived up to their social responsibilities.

zh: 如果没有有效的监管并为污染制定真正的代价，就没有理由认为它们会做出和以往不同的行为。
en: Without effective regulations and a real price to pay for polluting, there is no reason whatsoever to believe that they will behave differently than they have.

zh: 达沃斯的CEO们汲汲于恢复增长，汲汲于狂飙突进的利润和薪酬。
en: The Davos CEOs were euphoric about the return to growth, about their soaring profits and compensation.

zh: 经济学家提醒他们，这种增长不可持续，也不包容。
en: Economists reminded them that this growth is not sustainable, and has never been inclusive.

zh: 但这些论点对于物质为王的世界毫无作用。
en: But such arguments have little impact in a world where materialism is king.

zh: 所以，忘了CEO们在演讲开头的那些价值观陈词滥调吧。
en: So forget the platitudes about values that CEOs recite in the opening paragraphs of their speeches.

zh: 他们也许缺少迈克尔·道格拉斯（Michael Douglass）在1987年的电影《华尔街 》 （ Wall Street）中所扮演的角色直白，但他们所传递的信息是一样的 ： “ 贪婪是一件好事。
en: They may lack the candor of Michael Douglas’s character in the 1987 movie Wall Street, but the message hasn’t changed: “Greed is good.”

zh: ”让我感到沮丧的是，尽管这个信息显然是错误的，仍然有大量权势人物认为这是正确的。
en: What depresses me is that, though the message is obviously false, so many in power believe it to be true.

zh: 包容增长或其他
en: Inclusive Growth or Else

zh: 伦敦/华盛顿 – 在今年的瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛会议上，与会者没有就当今全球增长的基础发出疑问，包括自由市场、好治理以及人力资本和基础设施投资等。
en: LONDON/WASHINGTON, DC – At this year’s World Economic Forum meeting in Davos, Switzerland, participants did not question the basic building blocks of growth in today’s global economy: free markets, good governance, and investment in human capital and infrastructure.

zh: 但他们确实批评了增长果实分配的不公平。
en: But they did criticize how unfairly the benefits of growth are being distributed.

zh: 理应如此：如果不加强政策应对，打造一个更加包容的增长模式，
en: Rightly so: without a strong policy response aimed at building a more inclusive growth model, rising populism and economic nationalism will impair the functioning of markets and overall macroeconomic stability – potentially cutting short the current global recovery.

zh: 几乎每一项经济政策，都会对总收入及其分配造成影响。
en: Virtually every economic policy has an impact on both aggregate income and its distribution.

zh: 一些改革 — — 如提高公平性和法律机关效率的改革 — — 有利于增长和平等（机会平等 ） 。
en: Some reforms – such as those promoting impartiality and efficiency of legal institutions – are good for growth and equity (in this case, equality of opportunity).

zh: 产品和劳动力市场的去监管化的具体影响有利有弊，着也许是因为数据局限性和每项改革的具体环境不同所造成的。
en: Incidence results for deregulation of product and labor markets are more mixed, possibly as a result of data limitations and the specific circumstances of each reform.

zh: 相反，对于金融去监管化和国际资本流动自由化，则存在明确的效率-公平权衡：它们刺激了增长，但往往也会加剧不平等性。
en: By contrast, when it comes to financial deregulation and the liberalization of international capital flows, there are clear equity-efficiency tradeoffs: they boost growth, but they also tend to increase inequality.

zh: 一些旨在经常项目交易（商品和服务贸易）自由化的措施也有类似影响的证据。
en: The evidence points in a similar direction for some measures aimed at liberalizing current-account transactions (trade in goods and services).

zh: 这些发现本不足为奇：众所周知，科技的迅速变化和全球化极大地推动了赢家通吃经济的形成。 在赢家通吃经济中，拥有先发优势者能够获得畸高比例的增长受益。
en: These findings should not come as a surprise: it is well-known that rapid technological change and globalization have contributed immensely to the creation of a winner-take-all economy, in which those with a first-mover advantage accrue a disproportionate share of the benefits of growth.

zh: 决策者的任务是确保劣势群体也有机会在现代经济中取得成功，这可以通过在设计各种改革和其他措施时注意分配效应实现。
en: Policymakers’ task is to ensure that the disadvantaged also have opportunities to succeed in the modern economy, by designing all reforms and other measures with an eye to their distributional effects.

zh: 否则，促增长改革将失去政治合法性，让破坏性民族主义、本体论和保护主义力量继续风生水起，从而破坏中长期增长。
