en: Otherwise, pro-growth reforms will lose political legitimacy, enabling destructive nationalist, nativist, and protectionist forces to continue to gain traction and thus to undermine medium- and longer-term growth.

zh: 成功的关键是未雨绸缪，而不是只关注、甚至不能将主要精力放在改良措施上。
en: The key to success will be to take preemptive action, rather than focusing solely (or even primarily) on ameliorative measures.

zh: 这意味着要制定一致的政策方案，将强化需求的政策的分配效应内部化，以及在这些政策的赢家和输家之间形成一个更好的平衡。
en: This means designing coherent policy packages that internalize the distributional effects of supply-enhancing policies, and that aim to create a better balance of winners and losers across those policies.

zh: 在我们为世界经济论坛经济进步全球未来委员会（Global Future Council on Economic Progress）所做的工作中，我们列举了一份推进这一日程的具体行动清单。
en: In our work for the World Economic Forum’s Global Future Council on Economic Progress, we have produced a list of concrete actions that would advance such an agenda.

zh: 第一个关键性焦点领域是技能培训、技能升级和解决工作岗位取代的问题。
en: The first critical area of focus is skills training, skills upgrading, and addressing job displacement.

zh: 全球化和所谓的第四次工业革命提高了劳动力市场的变化速度，形成了一种适应力溢价。
en: Globalization and the so-called Fourth Industrial Revolution have increased the pace of change in labor markets, putting a premium on adaptability.

zh: 公共政策不但可以通过收入支持为转型中的工人提供缓冲，还有助于为学习技能提供激励和机会。
en: Public policies have a role to play not only in providing a cushion for workers in transition, via income support, but also in creating incentives and opportunities for skills acquisition.

zh: 在这方面，政府应该提高终身学习投资，从而实现再培训、重振旗鼓和重获技能。
en: To this end, governments should boost investment in life-long learning to retrain, retool, and reskill.

zh: 比如，政府可以用个人技能账户（skill accounts ） ， 依靠加强私人部门在培训和技能开发中的参与度，给公民的职业生涯提供培训券。
en: For example, governments could use individual skill accounts to provide training grants throughout people’s working lives, conditional on stronger private-sector involvement in training and skills development.

zh: 政府还应该加强激励促使教育机构利用数字技术和新商业模式的力量，提高技能供给。
en: Governments should also reinforce the supply of skills by strengthening incentives for educational institutions to harness the power of digital technology and new business models.

zh: 第二个关键性领域是税收和社会保护。
en: A second critical area is taxation and social protection.

zh: 具体政策因国家社会契约而异，但我们的工作表明，再分配 — — 只要不是极端形式 — — 不会造成显著的效率损失。
en: While the specific policies would vary according to national social contracts, our work suggests that redistribution – unless extreme – does not bring salient efficiency losses.

zh: 此外，再分配所带来的平等性改善有助于让经济增长变得更加可持续，比如，它可以降低可能导致急剧衰退的系统脆弱性。
en: Moreover, the greater equity it brings serves to make economic growth more sustainable, such as by reducing systemic fragilities that can lead to sharp downturns.

zh: 在税收方面，重要的是要通过确保体系不会大幅偏袒富人来捍卫增长模式的政治合法性。
en: When it comes to taxes, it is critical to safeguard the growth model’s political legitimacy by ensuring that the system is not skewed in favor of the wealthy.

zh: 除了增加对租金和不动产的税收，决策者应该采取合作性措施遏制漏税、税负倒置和合法避税。
en: Beyond increased taxation of rents and estates, policymakers should pursue cooperative efforts to stem corporate tax avoidance, tax inversions, and the use of tax shelters.

zh: 财政转移也应该更好地定位，以保护最脆弱群体。
en: Fiscal transfers should also be better targeted, in order to protect the most vulnerable groups.

zh: 类似地 — — 这是第三项关键性改革重点 — — 需要采取更加积极的措施监管金融市场，特别是防止内部交易和洗钱，还应该关闭非法金融中心。
en: Similarly – and this is the third critical reform priority – more aggressive action is needed to regulate financial markets, especially to prevent insider trading and money laundering, and to close down illegal financial centers.

zh: 还需要跨境监管和措施确保冒险者为鲁莽付出合适的高昂代价。
en: Cross-border regulations and measures are also needed to ensure that risk-takers bear an appropriately high cost for recklessness.

zh: 更一般地，各国需要最大限度地利用可用的工具管理跨境资本流动，以减小金融危机风险和相关财政成本。
en: More generally, countries need to avail themselves of the tools at their disposal to manage cross-border capital flows, with the objective of mitigating the risk of financial crises and their associated fiscal costs.

zh: 第四项、也是最后一项重点是采取更加协调的措施以确保公平竞争和避免裙带资本主义。
en: The fourth and final priority is a more concerted effort to ensure fair competition and avoid crony capitalism.

zh: 保证公平的国家竞争平台和基于规则的国际秩序需要有效的竞争政策和执行公平贸易规则。
en: Guaranteeing a level national playing field and a rules-based international order requires effective competition policies and enforcement of fair-trade rules.

zh: 不管是在工业、服务业还是媒体，避免机构或行业（被权势或国家）捕获的反垄断行动对于支持包容性而言至关重要。
en: Whether in industry, services, or the media, anti-trust actions to avoid capture of institutions or industries – by the powerful or the state – are vital to support inclusiveness.

zh: 对全球化的反制 — — 在一些例子中，也包括对资本主义本身的反制 — — 要求我们所采取的经济政策不但能够解决有问题的分配效应，还要能够未雨绸缪。
en: The backlash against globalization – and, in some cases, against capitalism itself – demands economic policies that not only address problematic distributional effects, but also preempt them.

zh: 着需要根本性的思维转变，说到底，企业和政府需要认识到，只有当增长的收益得到广泛分享时，增长才是可持续的。
en: This will require a fundamental change in mindset, with businesses and governments alike recognizing, at long last, that growth can be sustainable only if its benefits are broadly shared.

zh: 达沃斯把不平等性作为讨论焦点的决定是一个令人憧憬的变化趋势。
en: The decision to place inequality at the center of the discussion at Davos this year was a promising development.

zh: 但实际方案仍有待开发。
en: But actual solutions remain undeveloped.

zh: 尽管许多国家内部对于经济不公的担忧日益加剧，但解决问题的政策仍然不足。
en: Despite expressions of anguish about widening economic disparities within many countries, policies to address them remain inadequate.

zh: 要想当前经济复苏得到持续，让全球大大纾困和感到希望的源泉得到持续，这一点就必须有所改变。
en: This must change if the current economic recovery – the source of so much relief and hope around the globe – is to continue.

zh: 达沃斯人的沮丧
en: Davos Man’s Depression

zh: 纽约—15年来，我一直参加在达沃斯举行的世界经济论坛。
en: NEW YORK – For 15 years, I have attended the World Economic Forum in Davos.

zh: 通常情况下，领导者们聚集一堂，分享他们对全球化，技术和市场正如何改良世界所持有的乐观主义。
en: Typically, the leaders gathered there share their optimism about how globalization, technology, and markets are transforming the world for the better.

zh: 即使是在2001年的衰退中，汇聚于达沃斯论坛的人们依然相信下降趋势将是短期的。
en: Even during the recession of 2001, those assembled in Davos believed that the downturn would be short-lived.

zh: 但是这次当商业领袖们分享他们的经验之时，我们可以感觉到乌云密布。
en: But this time, as business leaders shared their experiences, one could almost feel the clouds darkening.

zh: 一位把握了会议精神的演讲者者提出，我们已经从“繁荣与衰退”阶段进入了“繁荣与大决战”阶段。
en: The spirit was captured by one participant who suggested that we had gone from “boom and bust” to “boom and Armageddon.”

zh: 新近冒出的共识是：会议召开时国际货币基金组织就2009年全球停滞作出的预测持有乐观态度，而本轮全球停滞的经济增长率是战后以来最低的。
en: The emerging consensus was that the IMF forecast for 2009, issued as the meeting convened, of global stagnation – the lowest growth in the post-war period – was optimistic.

zh: 唯一的乐观音符是有人评论达沃斯的一致预测几乎总是错误的，所以也许这次的预测可能会被证明是过于悲观了。
en: The only upbeat note was struck by someone who remarked that Davos consensus forecasts are almost always wrong, so perhaps this time it would prove excessively pessimistic.

zh: 同样引人注目的是缺发对市场的信心。
en: Equally striking was the loss of faith in markets.

zh: 在一个参与者甚众的献计群英会中，与会者被问及到底哪一项失误得为这次危机负责，结果有个答案回响不绝：相信市场能够自我校正。
en: In a widely attended brainstorming session at which participants were asked what single failure accounted for the crisis, there was a resounding answer: the belief that markets were self-correcting.

zh: 认为价格可以完全并且有效地反映一切可获的信息的所谓“有效市场”模型也遭到抛弃。
en: The so-called “efficient markets” model, which holds that prices fully and efficiently reflect all available information, also came in for a trashing.

zh: 同样被丢弃的还有通货膨胀目标制：对通货膨胀的过度关注已经把注意力从更根本的问题（即金融稳定性）上转移开来。
en: So did inflation targeting: the excessive focus on inflation had diverted attention from the more fundamental question of financial stability.

zh: 中央银行相信：增长和繁荣要求必须控制通货膨胀，而且仅此一项几乎已经足够，但这种看法从来就不是以正确的经济理论为基础的。 现在的危机进一步滋生了怀疑态度。
en: Central bankers’ belief that controlling inflation was necessary and almost sufficient for growth and prosperity had never been based on sound economic theory; now, the crisis provided further skepticism.

zh: 无论在布什政府还是奥巴马政府内部都没有人企图为美式的随心所欲的资本主义展开辩护，而欧洲的领导者们则论证他们的“社会市场经济”将是未来采用的模型。 “社会市场经济”是一种温和版、提供社会保护的资本主义。
en: While no one from either the Bush or Obama administrations attempted to defend American-style free-wheeling capitalism, European leaders argued for their “social market economy,” their gentler form of capitalism with its social protections, as the model for the future.

zh: 而且它的自动稳定者们还作出了缓和下降趋势的承诺。 在经济灾祸发生的时候，花费会自动上升。
en: And its automatic stabilizers, with spending automatically increasing as economic woes increased, held out the promise of moderating the downturn.

zh: 大部分的美国金融领袖似乎太过尴尬，以至于他们压根儿就没露面。
en: Most American financial leaders seemed too embarrassed to make an appearance.

zh: 也许他们的缺席使得与会者可以更容易地发泄愤怒。
en: Perhaps their absence made it easier for those who did attend to vent their anger.

zh: 有几位劳工领袖因为金融群体缺乏自责而尤感愤怒，他们年年在达沃斯辛勤工作，推动商业界更好地了解劳动者关心的问题。
en: But business leaders from the “real” sector and the few labor leaders who work hard at Davos each year to advance a better understanding of the concerns of working men and women among the business community were particularly angry at the financial community’s lack of remorse.

zh: 有关偿还过去奖金的呼吁赢得了阵阵掌声。
en: A call for the repayment of past bonuses was received with applause.

zh: 实际上，一些美国金融家们受到了极其猛烈的批判， 因为他们看上去持有的立场是：他们也是受害者。
en: Indeed, some American financiers were especially harshly criticized for seeming to take the position that they, too, were victims.

zh: 现实里他们是作恶的人而不是牺牲品。 尤其让人愤怒的是，他们继续用枪指着政府的头要求大规模的紧急援助，并且威胁否则就会经济崩溃。
en: The reality is that they were the perpetrators, not the victims, and it seemed particularly galling that they were continuing to hold a gun to the heads of governments, demanding massive bailouts and threatening economic collapse otherwise.

zh: 钱流向那些引发问题的人，而不是蒙受损失的人。
en: Money was flowing to those who had caused the problem, rather than to the victims.

zh: 更糟糕的是，很多流进银行用以调整资本结构，以便他们可以恢复借贷的资金已经以红利支付和股息的形式流出。
en: Worse still, much of the money flowing into the banks to recapitalize them so that they could resume lending has been flowing out in the form of bonus payments and dividends.

zh: 全世界的商业界并没有获得他们需要的信用，这一事实加剧了在达沃斯表达出来的不满情绪。
en: The fact that businesses around the world were not getting the credit they need compounded the grievances expressed at Davos.

zh: 这轮危机引发了有关全球化的根本问题，而全球化被认为是有助于分化危机的。
en: This crisis raises fundamental questions about globalization, which was supposed to help diffuse risk.

zh: 但它反而使得美国的失利如同传染病一般在世界上传播。
en: Instead, it has enabled America’s failures to spread around the world, like a contagious disease.

zh: 即便如此，出现在达沃斯的忧虑仍然是各国将退出我们有缺陷的全球化进程，而且贫穷国家将蒙受最大损失。
en: Still, the worry at Davos was that there would be a retreat from even our flawed globalization, and that poor countries would suffer the most.

zh: 但是一直以来竞技场就是不平坦的。
en: But the playing field has always been unlevel.

zh: 发展中国家如何能与美国的补贴和担保竞争？
en: How could developing countries compete with America’s subsidies and guarantees?

zh: 因此有哪一个发展中国家能够在国民面前捍卫其进一步向获得政府高度补贴的美国银行开放市场的观点呢?
en: So how could any developing country defend to its citizens the idea of opening itself even more to America’s highly subsidized banks?

zh: 至少就目前而言，金融市场的解放看起来已经死亡。
en: At least for the moment, financial market liberalization seems to be dead.

zh: 不均衡是明显的。
en: The inequities are obvious.

zh: 即使穷国愿意为他们的存款提供担保，这种担保也意味着比来自美国的担保少。
en: Even if poor countries were willing to guarantee their deposits, the guarantee would mean less than that from the United States.

zh: 这部分解释了资金不可思议地从发展中国家流向美国，从世界问题发端的地方。 而且，发展中国家缺乏资源来采取发达国家制定的大型刺激政策。
en: This partly explains the curious flow of funds from developing countries to the US – from whence the world’s problems originated.

zh: 雪上加霜的是，国际货币基金组织迫使大多数向它求助的国家提高利率，降低消费，加重了下降趋势。
en: Moreover, developing countries lack the resources to engage in the massive stimulus policies of the advanced countries.  Making matters worse, the IMF still forces most countries that turn to it for help to raise interest rates and lower spending, worsening the downturns.

zh: 还有更糟糕的：发达国家的银行，尤其是那些接受政府援助的银行似乎退出了发展中国家的借贷业务，包括通过分支机构和子公司进行的借贷。
en: And, to add insult to injury, banks in advanced countries, especially those receiving aid from their governments, seem to be pulling back from lending in developing countries, including through branches and subsidiaries.

zh: 所以大部分发展中国家都是前景黯淡，即使那些已经做“对”了每件事的发展中国家。
en: So the prospects for most developing countries – including those that had done everything “right” – are bleak.

zh: 就像这些都还不够糟一样，达沃斯论坛开幕时美国众议院通过了一项议案，要求经济刺激方案下进行的花费必须使用美国钢铁，虽然20国集团（G-20）呼吁避免采取保护主义来应对危机。
en: As if all this were not enough, as the Davos meeting opened, America’s House of Representatives passed a bill requiring American steel to be used in stimulus spending, despite the G-20’s call to avoid protectionism in response to the crisis.

zh: 在这一连串的焦虑中我们还有另一种担心，那就是借款者和美元储备的持有者可能通过耗尽全球储蓄供给的方式来分别应对前者提防产生的大额美国赤字，和后者对美国可能被诱采用通货膨胀来消解债务的担忧。 在达沃斯，那些信任美国不会用通货膨胀来消解债务的人 有意识地 担心这一幕可能会 在无意间 发生。
en: To this litany of concerns we can add the fear of borrowers that the massive American deficits would drain the supply of global savings, and worries of holders of US dollar reserves, that America may be tempted to inflate away its debt.  At Davos, those who trusted the US not to inflate away its debt intentionally worried that it might happen unintentionally.

zh: 对于精妙无俦的美国联邦储备委员具有手段来处理大量增加的债务和资产折现力，人们几乎不抱信心：它的名声近几年来因为巨大的货币政策失误已经大打折扣。
en: There was little confidence in the none-too-deft hand of the US Federal Reserve – its reputation marred by massive monetary-policy failures in recent years – to manage the massive buildup of debt and liquidity.

zh: 乔治·W·布什执政的黑暗岁月之后，巴拉克·奥巴马总统似乎必然会提升美国的领导能力。 但是达沃斯的气氛显示乐观主义和信心可能都是短期而已。
en: President Barack Obama seems to be offering a needed boost to American leadership after the dark days of George W. Bush; but the mood in Davos suggests that optimism and confidence may be short-lived.

zh: 在全球化中，美国领导了世界。
en: America led the world in globalization.

zh: 当美式资本主义和美国的金融市场声名狼藉之时，美国还将领导世界进入一个保护主义的新时代，就像它在大萧条之中曾经做过的那样吗？
en: With American-style capitalism and America’s financial markets in disrepute, will America now lead the world into a new era of protectionism, as it did once before, during the Great Depression?

zh: 日本应当采用夏令时吗？
en: Should Japan Adopt Daylight Saving Time?

zh: 发自东京 — — 在今夏的极端热浪天气导致日本全国至少110人丧生后，一些人开始担心运动员们在2020年夏季奥运会期间的安全，因为此次盛会将于7月底和8月初在东京举行 — — 也正是这个国家一年中最为炎热潮湿的时节。
en: TOKYO – After this summer’s intense heat waves, which left at least 110 people dead, some in Japan have become concerned about athletes’ safety during the 2020 Summer Olympic Games, which will be held in Tokyo in late July and early August – the hottest and most humid time of year in the country.

zh: 其中一位忧虑者是东京2020奥运会主席森喜朗，他提出了一个解决方案：采用夏令时，这样如马拉松这类安排在早上进行的比赛可以在较为凉爽的时段举行。
en: One such person is Tokyo 2020 Olympics President Yoshiro Mori, who has proposed a solution: adopt daylight saving time (DST), so that events scheduled for the morning, such as the marathon, can be held during cooler hours.

zh: 那么日本会从这一变化中受益吗？
en: Would Japan benefit from such a change?

zh: 在大多数西方国家，夏令时长期以来都被当成一种节约能源以及让劳动者在黑暗的冬季和炎热的夏季延长户外工作时间的手段（尽管欧盟正在考虑消除夏时制，因为觉得其成本高于收益而且会对人体生物钟产生影响 ） 。
en: In much of the West, DST has long been used as a way to save energy and extend outdoor time for workers during the dark winter months and the hot summer months (though the European Union is now considering the elimination of DST, in the belief that it costs more than it saves, and owing to the effect on the human biorhythm).

zh: 根据我在新英格兰居住多年的经验，我起初以为在日本采用夏时制是一个相对简单直接的解决方案 — — 而且不仅仅是针对奥运问题。
en: Given my extensive experience living in New England, I initially viewed the adoption of DST in Japan as a relatively straightforward solution – and not just to the Olympic issue.

zh: 由于日本必须依赖国外（特别是中东）进口化石燃料，因此尤为有动力去尽可能减少能源使用。
en: Japan depends on fossil fuels imported from abroad (especially the Middle East), so it has particularly strong incentive to minimize energy use.

zh: 但是森喜朗的提议却遭到了相当多的反对。
en: Yet Mori’s proposal has been met with considerable opposition.

zh: 一个特别令人信服的论点是在今天的技术条件下此举实际上可能并不会产生多少节能效果。
en: One particularly convincing argument is that, given today’s technologies, it may not actually bring much in the way of energy savings.

zh: 根据日本环境省的数据，如果在2008年时调快一小时预计可以每年节省约9.1亿升原油。
en: According to the Ministry of Environment of Japan, one hour’s adjustment in 2008 would have led to savings of an estimated 0.910 million kiloliters of crude oil annually.

zh: 相对于日本的能源消耗总量(2016年的原油能耗量为5120亿升)来说确实是有所节省的。
en: Compared to Japan’s total energy consumption – 512 million kL of crude oil in 2016 – this is a drop in the bucket.

zh: 如果今天实施夏时制，那么它所降低能耗可能还不到总量的0.2 ％ ， 同时在减排方面的影响也是微不足道的。
en: If DST were implemented today, it would probably reduce energy consumption by less than 0.2%. In terms of emissions reductions, the impact would be similarly negligible.

zh: 当然对于那些依赖进口能源的国家来说任何节约都是有价值的。
en: To be sure, for a country that depends on imported energy, any savings are valuable.

zh: 政府间气候变化专门委员会最近的研究结果表明对化石燃料的依赖导致全球变暖带来的威胁比以前更为紧迫。
en: And the recent findings by the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change have shown that the threat from global warming, owing to reliance on fossil fuels, is even more urgent than previously known.

zh: 但鉴于引入夏时制所可能引发的副作用，目前尚不清楚这种降低能耗的方法是否值得。
en: But, given the potential complications associated with introducing DST, it is not clear whether this particular means of reducing energy consumption is worthwhile.

zh: 尤为引发关注的一个问题在于夏时制可能导致人们工作时间延长。
en: A concern that has attracted particular attention is the possibility that DST would result in people working longer hours.

zh: 日本的商业文化 — — 以那些大名鼎鼎的株式会社为核心 — — 以压力巨大闻名，以至于过劳死或与工作相关的过度疲劳现象屡见不鲜。
en: Japan’s business culture – centered on highly successful kaisha (firms) – is known to be very demanding, to the point that karoshi, or death from overwork or job-related exhaustion, is not uncommon.

zh: 夏时制的批评者们担心如果太阳在工作时间结束时还没下山，管理人员会感觉自己必须继续工作并逼迫下属也这样做。
en: Critics of DST fear that, if the sun is still out at the end of business hours, managers will feel pressure to continue working and push their employees to do the same.

zh: 日本人往往坚持传统，而男性往往很难适应变化。
en: Japanese often cling to tradition, and men tend to have a particularly hard time adjusting to change.

zh: 但当谈到夏令时这个问题时，这个国家的女性领导人们已经证明这并不是一个非黑即白的选项。
en: But, when it comes to implementing DST in Japan, it may not have to be all or nothing, as some of the country’s female leaders are proving.

zh: 日本北部北海道的夏季白昼持续特别长，因此进行季节性调整的诉求也尤其强烈。
en: Hokkaido, Japan’s northern island, has particularly long summer daylight hours, making the case for seasonal adjustment especially strong.

zh: 这就是为什么在2003年北海道知事高桥春美推出了一个实验性且完全自愿的时间表调整计划，其功能与夏令时非常相似。
en: That is why, in 2003, Governor Harumi Takahashi introduced an experimental and entirely voluntary schedule-adjustment plan that functions much like DST.

zh: 政府部门以及企业可以选择允许员工在夏季几个月份中提前一小时上下班。
en: Government offices, as well as firms, can choose to allow their employees to arrive at work and leave an hour earlier than normal during the summer months.

zh: 另一个成功的季节性实验是2005年由现任东京都知事小池百合子（时任环境大臣）所推出的“酷商务”政策。
en: Another successful seasonal experiment was the “Cool Biz” policy introduced by Governor of Tokyo Yuriko Koike in 2005, when she was serving as minister of the environment.

zh: 日本的工作场所放弃了一些着装形式要求 — — 允许职员们穿短袖，不用打领带或穿西装来上班 — — 使办公室和商业零售场所能够最大限度地减少空调的使用。
en: Japanese workplaces sacrificed some formality – allowing workers to wear short sleeves and no ties or jackets to the office – to enable office and retail buildings to minimize their use of air conditioning.

zh: 除了改变办公室空调温度和着装规范外 ， “ 酷商务”还为企业提供了一些其他节能建议 — — 包括允许员工提前到岗上班。
en: Beyond changes to office temperatures and dress codes, Cool Biz offered some other energy-saving advice to businesses – including allowing employees to work earlier.

zh: 有鉴于此，据报小池百合子认同日本引入夏令时的潜在好处可能就不足为奇了。
en: Given this, it is probably not surprising that Koike reportedly recognizes the potential benefits of introducing DST in Japan.

zh: 但即使她对整个国家每年调整两次时钟 — — 而且如果主要是为了迎合2020年东京奥运会 — — 的做法还有点犹豫不决。
en: Yet even she is hesitant about having the entire country change its clocks twice per year, especially if the main motivation relates to the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

zh: 但从她的角度来看某些更为灵活的解决方案（比如在较早时间开始马拉松）似乎更有说服力。
en: More flexible solutions, like starting the marathon at an earlier hour, seem to be more convincing, from her perspective.

zh: 无论日本是否采用夏令时，对此的辩论都会传达出一条信息。
en: Whether or not Japan adopts DST, one message emerges from the debate.

zh: 当谈到如何改变一个抗拒变化的日本时，女性领导者的聪明才智可能决定着未来的走向。
en: When it comes to making changes in change-resistant Japan, the ingenuity of Japan’s women leaders could well be what determines the future.

zh: 德班僵局
en: Deadlock in Durban

zh: 纽约 — — 第十七届联合国气候变化框架会议（简称COP17）正在南非举行，这次会议的时间可谓关键，因为1997年京都议定书将于明年失效。
en: NEW YORK – The 17th conference of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, popularly known as COP-17, is taking place in Durban, South Africa, at a critical moment, as the historic 1997 Kyoto Protocol is set to expire next year.

zh: 但是，与2009年哥本哈根和2010年坎昆的气候变化会议相似，COP17很可能以期望越大失望越大的结局收场。
en: But, like the climate-change conferences in Copenhagen in 2009 and in Cancún in 2010, COP-17 can be expected to spend much and produce little.

zh: 事实上，这些会议的铺张似乎并未收敛，反而有膨胀之势，因为它们的不给力已是众人皆知了。
en: Indeed, the extravagance of these conferences seems to grow, rather than shrink, as their dismal results become more apparent.

zh: 哥本哈根的COP15举行了12天，据估计共吸引了15000名与会代表和5000名记者。
en: COP-15 in Copenhagen lasted 12 days, and is estimated to have attracted 15,000 delegates and 5,000 journalists.

zh: 这么多人飞到丹麦所产生的碳排放可是实实在在的，而会议所追求的排放目标到现在还没个影子。
en: The carbon emissions created by so many people flying to Denmark was real, while the emissions targets that the conference sought remained beyond reach.

zh: 德班也逃不过这个结局 — — 只是规模可能比哥本哈根还要大。
en: That will be true in Durban as well – and on an even greater scale.

zh: 真正的问题是，对气候变化采取有意义行动 — — 而不是像奥巴马在在哥本哈根会议上那样姗姗来迟，而且如同蜻蜓点水一样来了就走 — — 的期望越来越低。
en: The real problem is that the expectations concerning meaningful action on climate change, as opposed to gimmicks such as US President Barack Obama’s last-minute arrival and minuscule gestures in Copenhagen, are now lower than ever.

zh: 有两个问题根本不用指望解决。
en: There are two problems that cannot be wished away.

zh: 首先，由于奥巴马领导不力，在要求国际行动的关键问题上，美国正在“我有什么好处”的扯皮道路上越走越远。
en: First, the United States under Obama’s ineffective leadership has drifted yet further into a “What’s in it for me?” attitude on key issues requiring international action.

zh: 改一下经济学家金德尔伯格（Charles Kindleberger）所谓的“无私霸权 ” ， 我将如今世界所面对的美国称为“自私霸权 ” 。
en: In place of what the economist Charles Kindleberger once called an “altruistic hegemon,” the America that the world now faces is what I call a “selfish hegemon.”

zh: 因此，美国已经实质性地退出了多边贸易谈判多哈回合，奥巴马默许了贪婪商人游说团，如果要求得不到满足，他们是不会在谈判协议上签字的。
en: Thus, the US has virtually pulled out of the Doha Round of multilateral trade negotiations, with Obama acquiescing to greedy business lobbies that will not settle unless more of their demands are met.

zh: 但奥巴马不但抛弃了多哈，他还严重地威胁了多面贸易体系，因为在他的领导下，美国正在将资源和精力用于区别对待的双边贸易协议和最近的跨太平洋合作伙伴关系协定上，后者主要是为了援助担心侵略性的中国的国家以及寻求政治安全（而不是增进贸易 ） 。
en: But not only has Obama abandoned Doha; he has also seriously endangered the multilateral trading system by diverting US efforts and resources to discriminatory bilateral trade deals and, most recently, to the Trans-Pacific Partnership, which will principally aid countries that are worried about an aggressive China and seek political security rather than increased trade.

zh: 在环境问题上也是如此：澳大利亚2007年批准京都议定书之后，美国成了唯一一个仍未批准该协议的国家。
en: The same is true of environmental action: after Australia’s belated ratification of the Kyoto Protocol in 2007, the US remains the only country that has not ratified the agreement.

zh: 第二个问题是美国在国际事务上的分量虽然已有所下降，但仍足以破坏理应成为京都议定书之后的气候变化条约的基础的原则。
en: The second problem is that the sheer weight of the US in international affairs, though diminished nowadays, has nonetheless led to a corruption of the principles that should underpin a new climate-change treaty to succeed the Kyoto Protocol.

zh: 比如，与世界贸易组织不同 — — 世贸组织的争端解决机制可以对拒不执行商定的减少贸易壁垒措施的行为施以惩罚 — — 排放削减并不具有约束性，也没有强制性义务。
en: For example, unlike the World Trade Organization, whose dispute-settlement mechanism imposes penalties for abandoning negotiated reductions of trade barriers, the targets for emission reductions are not binding and enforceable commitments.

zh: 美国不同意和不接受因达不到排放目标而受到制裁；但是，没有惩罚机制，排放削减要求就是无用功，只会激起人们对对抗气候变化努力的冷嘲热讽。
en: The US has not agreed to accept such sanctions for failing to meet emissions targets; but, without penalties, the exercise is largely futile and only encourages cynicism about the effort to combat climate change.

zh: 此外，美国要求废除京都议定书对发展中国家排放义务的豁免，坚持认为中国和印度也必须承担责任，以反映普适的排放“税 ” 。
en: Moreover, abandoning the Kyoto Protocol’s exemption of developing countries from obligations for current emissions, the US has insisted on obligations from China and India that reflect a common form of “taxation” of emissions.

zh: 但这些国家则坚持认为减排责任必须反映人均排放 — — 根据这一标准，美国应该减少比其领导人预期更多的排放量 — — 它们能拿出有说服力的理由。
en: But there are persuasive reasons why these countries insist that the obligations must instead reflect per capita emissions, a criterion that would require far greater emission cuts by the US than its leaders now contemplate.

zh: 此外，这些国家正确地指出，从它们的人均收入看，气候变化行为和消除贫困之间的权衡才是更重要的问题，除非它们能够以低成本获得新技术。
en: Besides, these countries correctly argue that the tradeoff between action on climate change and poverty reduction is more compelling for them at their level of per capita income, unless they can access newly emerging technologies at low cost.

zh: 根据这一要求，美国应该补贴从握有专利权的美国公司流向印度和中国的技术，这是很不现实的。
en: This demand suggests that the US should subsidize the flow of technology to India and China from US firms holding patents, which is highly impractical.

zh: 这正是坎昆的COP16决定成立1000亿美元全球气候变化基金的原因。
en: That is where the $100 billion Global Climate Change Fund, promised at the Cancún COP-16 conference, comes in.

zh: 不幸的是，尽管戈尔登美国环保人士花重金投资于新兴绿色技术，将自身利益与该基金绑在一起，但该基金的资金都花在了开发受专利保护的私有新技术上。
en: Unfortunately, even environmental icons like Al Gore in the US are so heavily invested in new green technology that their self-interest is tied up in this fund being spent on developing privately owned new technologies that are protected by patents.

zh: 诺贝尔奖获得者、农学家布劳格（Norman Borlaug）用公共资金开发的新的“绿色革命”种子可以被世界各地的使用者免费获得。
en: The new “Green Revolution” seeds that the Nobel laureate agronomist Norman Borlaug developed with public money were freely available to all users anywhere.

zh: 用全球气候变基金的资金开发的技术也应该对包括印度和中国在内的全世界开放，以促使各国同意更多地减排。
en: The technology developed by the money spent from the Global Climate Change Fund also should be equally available to all, including India and China, which would then enable them to agree to more emissions cuts.

zh: 事实上，该基金的出资额应该反映发达国家过去一百年中的排放所造成的伤害 — — 美国在治理国内污染时就采取了这一完善的谁侵权谁承担义务的原则。
en: Indeed, even the contributions to the Fund should have reflected the past damage by the developed countries over the course of a century of carbon emissions – an obligation based on the well-established tort principle that the US has accepted for domestic pollution.

zh: 但是，在全球气候变化基金这件事上，美国拒绝完全采用这一办法。
en: But here, too, the US has rejected the idea outright.

zh: 不少设计京都议定书后任条约的明智办法由于为了协调美国为首的要求和反对而遭到了破坏，��致哥本哈根和坎昆COP会议陷入了僵局。
en: Several such sensible ways to design the Kyoto Protocol’s successor treaty have been undermined by efforts to accommodate inappropriate US-led demands and objections, resulting in the impasse that became evident at the COP conferences in Copenhagen and Cancún.

zh: 那些不相信奇迹的人心知肚明，这些障碍不会在德班会议上消失。
en: Those who do not believe in magic know better than to hope that it will somehow disappear in Durban.

zh: 亲爱的世界，请对抗美国
en: Dear World, Please Confront America

zh: 人可不可能不爱自己的祖国呢？
en: Is it possible to fall out of love with your own country?

zh: 两年来，我像许多美国人那样，全心专注于证明、揭露以及提醒整个美国有关布什政府的犯罪行为及其违反《美国宪法》和法治的事实 — — 这在国内通常被边缘化了。
en: For two years, I, like many Americans, have been focused intently on documenting, exposing, and alerting the nation to the Bush administration’s criminality and its assault on the Constitution and the rule of law – a story often marginalized at home.

zh: 我敢肯定，一旦美国人知道布什政府以他们的名义做了什么，他们都会觉得恐惧和愤怒。
en: I was certain that when Americans knew what was being done in their name, they would react with horror and outrage.

zh: . 三个月前，布什政府仍然抓住其邪恶的演讲片断“我们不拷打囚犯”不放。
en: Three months ago, the Bush administration still clung to its devil’s sound bite, “We don’t torture.”

zh: 现在，医生促进人权协会已经发表报告，证明被美国控制的被押人员有外伤，而且，甚至测谎测试都确认了这些被押人员被拷打过。
en: Now, Physicians for Human Rights has issued its report documenting American-held detainees’ traumas, and even lie detector tests confirm they have been tortured.

zh: 红十字组织的报告泄漏了这样的事实：拷打和战争犯罪。
en: The Red Cross report has leaked: torture and war crimes.

zh: 珍·迈尔（Jane Mayer）完美的调查作品《黑暗面》已经上市，该作品显示：拷打是由上层精心设计和指挥的。
en: Jane Mayer’s impeccably researched exposé The Dark Side just hit the stores: torture, crafted and directed from the top.

zh: 《华盛顿邮报》为读者提供了对一个名叫奥马尔·卡德尔（Omar Khadr）的未成年的加拿大人的刑讯审问录像报道，奥马尔·卡德尔展示了他仍然流着血的腹部伤口，哭泣着向抓捕他的人求饶。
en: The Washington Post gave readers actual video footage of the abusive interrogation of a Canadian minor, Omar Khadr, who was seen showing his still-bleeding abdominal wounds, weeping and pleading with his captors.

zh: 所以，事实的真相是公开的并可以自由地获得的。
en: So the truth is out and freely available.

zh: 但是，美国人仍然在小憩，担心他们的体重，逛商场打发时间。
en: And America is still napping, worrying about its weight, and hanging out at the mall.

zh: 我曾经认为在暴露了这么多真相后，有许多美国人会到国会山上守夜，宗教领袖会请求上帝的原谅，并出现类似于19世纪反对奴隶制度运动时的普遍的公众厌恶情绪。
en: I had thought that after so much exposure, thousands of Americans would be holding vigils on Capitol Hill, that religious leaders would be asking God’s forgiveness, and that a popular groundswell of revulsion, similar to the nineteenth-century anti-slavery movement, would emerge.

zh: 根据亚伯拉罕·林肯的观点，如果拷打没有错，那么，就没有什么是错的了。
en: To paraphrase Abraham Lincoln, if torture is not wrong, nothing is wrong.

zh: 然而，这些事件还没有发生。
en: And yet no such thing has occurred.

zh: 在美国的基督教派和犹太教派中没有爆发危机，基督教领导人和犹太教领导人都没有以遭受折磨的政治囚犯耶稣或要求正义的耶和华的名义大声呼吁正义。
en: There is no crisis in America’s churches and synagogues, no Christian and Jewish leaders crying out for justice in the name of Jesus, a tortured political prisoner, or of Yahweh, who demands righteousness.

zh: 我问一个在多信仰界的熟人这是为什么，他回答说 ， “ 主流的基督教会都不在乎这些事情，因为他们是共和党人。
en: I asked a contact in the interfaith world why. He replied, “The mainstream churches don’t care, because they are Republican.

zh: 犹太教会也不在乎这些事情，因为囚犯都是阿拉伯人。 ”
en: And the synagogues don’t care, because the prisoners are Arabs.”

zh: 到这个时候，我才意识到我现在不能爱我的祖国了。
en: It was then that I realized that I could not be in love with my country right now.

zh: 我怎么能这样对人的命运漠不关心呢？
en: How can I care about the fate of people like that?

zh: 如果美国人真是这样认为的，如果这就是真实的我们，那么，我们不配我们拥有的《宪法》和《权利和自由法案 》 。
en: If this is what Americans are feeling, if that is who we are, we don’t deserve our Constitution and Bill of Rights.

zh: 即使美国大肆吹嘘的司法系统也没能抑制这些明显的虐待。
en: Even America’s vaunted judicial system has failed to constrain obvious abuses.

zh: 一个联邦法庭裁决军事法院系统 — — 源自拷打的证据被用来反对被告的星法院 — — 可以继续下去。
en: A Federal court has ruled that the military tribunals system – Star Chambers where evidence derived from torture is used against the accused – can proceed.

zh: 另一个联邦法庭裁决总统可以在任何地方称呼任何人为“敌方武装人员”并视情况拘留他或她。
en: Another recently ruled that the president may call anyone anywhere an “enemy combatant” and detain him or her indefinitely.

zh: 所以，美国人和一个犯罪政权串通在一起。
en: So Americans are colluding with a criminal regime.

zh: 我们已经在我们的文明的盟国中变成了一个不遵守法律的国家 — — 这是对国际法和世界稳定的一个明显的现存威胁。
en: We have become an outlaw nation – a clear and present danger to international law and global stability – among civilized countries that have been our allies.

zh: 我们 — — 恰如其分地 — — 出现在加拿大列出的实行拷打的流氓国家的名单上。
en: We are – rightly – on Canada’s list of rogue nations that torture.

zh: . 欧洲还处在最近巴拉克·奥巴马访问带来的兴奋之中。
en: Europe is still high from Barack Obama’s recent visit.

zh: 许多美国人也希望奥巴马在11月的胜利会击退这个恶梦。
en: Many Americans, too, hope that an Obama victory in November will roll back this nightmare.

zh: 但是，现在不是沉迷于错觉的时候。
en: But this is no time to yield to delusions.

zh: 即使奥巴马获胜，他也极有可能是一个权力被极度削弱的总统。
en: Even if Obama wins, he may well be a radically weakened president.

zh: 布什政府已经建立了一个超越国界的违法机制，在这个机制中如果没有国际干预，靠自己奥巴马是既不能对抗也不能控制这一点的。
en: The Bush administration has created a transnational apparatus of lawlessness that he alone, without global intervention, can neither roll back nor control.

zh: 有人认为，根据国际条约，私人安全公司 — — 例如黑水公司 — — 将会继续经营，既不对总统负责，也不对国会负责，并且不受约束。
en: Private security firms – for example, Blackwater – will still be operating, accountable neither to him nor to Congress, and not bound, they have argued, by international treaties.

zh: 武器制造商和电讯业在维护大肆宣传的“反恐战争”上以及在新的全球监测市场中，拥有几十亿美元的利益，它们会部署一个财力庞大的游说队伍来维护它们的利益。
en: Weapons manufacturers and the telecommunications industry, with billions at stake in maintaining a hyped “war on terror” and their new global surveillance market, will deploy a lavishly financed army of lobbyists to defend their interests.

zh: 而且，如果当选，奥巴马也会受到自身的民主党的制约。
en: Moreover, if elected, Obama will be constrained by his own Democratic Party.

zh: 美国的政党与在欧洲及其它地方的议会民主中常见的有纪律的组织相比，相似的地方很少。
en: America’s political parties bear little resemblance to the disciplined organizations familiar in parliamentary democracies in Europe and elsewhere.

zh: 并且，如果像许多人预期的那样，保守的议员击败了因与布什联合而受害的在职的共和党议员，那么在今年11月份之后，国会中的民主党人会更分裂。
en: And Democrats in Congress will be even more divided after November if, as many expect, conservative members defeat Republican incumbents damaged by their association with Bush.

zh: 虽然，有些民主党人最近启动了对布什政府滥用权利的议会听证会。
en: To be sure, some Democrats have recently launched Congressional hearings into the Bush administration’s abuses of power.

zh: 不幸的是，由于没有媒体的报道，它就没有扩大官方调查和确保真正地承担责任的压力。
en: Unfortunately, with virtually no media coverage, there is little pressure to broaden official investigations and ensure genuine accountability.

zh: 但是，虽然公众的压力没有起到作用，然而，金钱仍然是万能的。
en: But, while grassroots pressure has not worked, money still talks.

zh: 我们需要由文明国家的政府领导的有目的对美国的制裁，包括国际资本剥夺。
en: We need targeted government-led sanctions against the US by civilized countries, including international divestment of capital.

zh: 许多研究显示，在发展中国家将投资和民主以及人权改革联系在一起是有效的。
en: Many studies have shown that tying investment to democracy and human rights reform is effective in the developing world.

zh: 没有理由认为这在反对世界超级大国上是无效的。
en: There is no reason why it can’t be effective against the world’s superpower.

zh: 我们也需要国际协调的从上倒下起诉指挥系统的战争罪犯的策略 — — 像意大利和法国做过的那样，由单个的国家进行指控。
en: We also need an internationally coordinated strategy for prosecuting war criminals at the top and further down the chain of command – individual countries pressing charges, as Italy and France have done.

zh: 虽然美国不是建立国际刑事法院的条约的签字方，但是，违反日内瓦公约第三条的行为都是战争犯罪，对犯下这些罪行的任何人 — — 甚至可能是美国总统 — — 都可以在该公约缔约国的其它193个国家中的任何一个国家进行审判。
en: Although the United States is not a signatory to the statute that established the International Criminal Court, violations of Common Article 3 of the Geneva Conventions are war crimes for which anyone – potentially even the US president – may be tried in any of the other 193 countries that are parties to the conventions.

zh: 全世界都可以追捕这些罪犯。
en: The whole world can hunt these criminals down.

zh: 不守法的美国是一个威胁国际社会其它国家的全球性问题。
en: An outlaw America is a global problem that threatens the rest of the international community.

zh: 如果这个政权逃脱了藐视国际法应得的惩罚，那么，拿什么来阻止下一任政府 — — 或者在紧急情况下，按照秘密继任计划继续执政的本届政府 — — 从事更过分的行为并将目标对准其国内和国外的政治对手？
en: If this regime gets away with flouting international law, what is to prevent the next administration – or this administration, continuing under its secret succession plan in the event of an emergency – from going further and targeting its political opponents at home and abroad?

zh: 现在，对于帮助我们自己，我们美国人要么太无能为力，要么太机能不良。
en: We Americans are either too incapable, or too dysfunctional, to help ourselves right now.

zh: 像拒绝接受治疗的吸毒成瘾者或者精神病人那样，我们需要我们的朋友的介入。
en: Like drug addicts or the mentally ill who refuse treatment, we need our friends to intervene.

zh: 所以，就像我们在状况较好的时候记住我们那样，采取措施 — — 从我们自己手中 — — 挽救我们以及世界。
en: So remember us as we were in our better moments, and take action to save us – and the world – from ourselves.

zh: 或许，到那时候我可以再次爱上我的祖国。
en: Maybe then I can fall in love with my country again.

zh: 死亡和烟草税
en: Death and Tobacco Taxes

zh: 一个全球性致命物正在世界贫穷国家肆虐。
en: A global killer is ripping through the world’s poorer countries largely unchecked.

zh: 在未来25年中，它将在一年时间内造成全世界一千万人死亡，超过霍乱、母死、儿童感染以及疟疾的总和。
en: Within 25 years, it will cause 10 million deaths a year worldwide –more than malaria, maternal deaths, childhood infections, and diarrhea combined .

zh: 超过一半的死者年龄在30岁至69岁之间，早死大约25年。
en: Over half of the dead will be aged 30 to 69, losing about 25 years of life expectancy.

zh: 这一元凶就是烟草。
en: The culprit? Tobacco.

zh: 成为西方国家中首要可防治死因的耽溺在发展中国家大行其道。
en: The same addiction that became the top preventable cause of death in Western countries has made big inroads in developing countries.

zh: 吸烟在二十世纪造成一亿人死亡，大多数在发达国家。
en: Smoking killed 100 million people in the twentieth century, mostly in developed countries.

zh: 按照目前的趋势，吸烟将会在二十一世纪造成大约十亿人死亡，大多数在发展中国家。
en: On current trends smoking will kill about one billion people in the twenty-first century, mostly in developing countries.

zh: 在印度，吸烟造成男女死亡的风险超过肺结核的三倍，甚至造成肺结核的传播。
en: In India, smoking triples the risk of death from tuberculosis in men and women and may even contribute to the spread of tuberculosis to others.

zh: 在中国和印度每年大约一百万人死于吸烟。
en: About 1 million people per year will soon die from smoking in China and India.

zh: 除非大规模戒烟，仅仅在这两个国家大约有一亿五千万年轻成年人死于吸烟。
en: Perhaps 150 million young adults will be killed by tobacco in these two countries alone, unless there is widespread cessation.

zh: 但是过去的吸烟死亡并非一定是世界的将来。
en: But the death tolls of the past need not become the world’s future.

zh: 我们知道如何控制烟草使用。
en: We know how to control tobacco use.

zh: 为了在未来几十年中降低吸烟死亡人数，现在需要十一亿人戒烟。
en: Cessation by the 1.1 billion current smokers is needed to lower tobacco deaths over the next few decades.

zh: 降低儿童吸烟将会主要在2050年后挽救性命。 戒烟是有成效的。
en: Reduced uptake of smoking by children would save lives chiefly after 2050.

zh: 即使那些在四十多岁戒烟的人也可以极大地降低死亡风险，而那些在三十多岁戒烟的人的死亡风险和终生不吸烟的人接近。
en: Quitting works: even those who stop smoking in their 40’s lower their risk of death remarkably, and those who quit in their 30’s have death risks close to lifelong non-smokers.

zh: 增加烟草税、传播吸烟造成的健康风险的信息、禁止公共场合吸烟、完全禁止烟草广告和促销以及戒烟治疗在帮助烟民戒烟上卓有成效。
en: Tobacco tax increases, dissemination of information about the health risks of smoking, smoking bans in public, complete bans on advertising and promotion, and cessation therapies are effective in helping smokers to quit.

zh: 烟草税大概是最为具有成本效益的成年健康干预手段。
en: Tobacco taxes are probably the single most cost-effective intervention for adult health in the world.

zh: 将税收提高三倍将会把香烟价格提高大约两倍(纽约就是这样 ) ， 在2030年以前每年防止大约三百万人死亡。
en: A tripling of the excise tax would roughly double the price of cigarettes (as has happened in New York City), preventing about three million deaths per year by 2030.

zh: 大多数经合组织成员国在过去二十年中开始认真对待烟草控制问题，并且从那时以来减少了男子吸烟死亡。
en: Most OECD countries began to take tobacco control seriously in the last two decades, and have decreased male tobacco deaths since.

zh: 但是发展中国家并没有采取有效的烟草控制措施。
en: But effective tobacco control measures are not underway in developing countries.

zh: 税收大约相当于多伦多街头香烟价格的80 % ， 但是在北京或者德里只有30 % 。
en: Taxes are about 80% of the street price of cigarettes in Toronto, but less than 30% in Beijing or Delhi.

zh: 在许多国家，烟草税收已经在实际价格上下降。
en: In many countries, tobacco taxes have fallen in real terms.

zh: 有关吸烟的健康风险的知识也很低。 1996年，61%的中国烟民认为吸烟对他们“无害或者基本无害 ” 。
en: Knowledge of the health risks from smoking is low: 61% of Chinese smokers in 1996 thought tobacco did them “little or no harm.”

zh: 来自烟草产业的反对力量是烟草控制的明显阻碍。
en: Opposition from the tobacco industry is an obvious obstacle to tobacco control.

zh: 在西方，反对多征税的虚假的经济论点已经遭到驳斥，但是却在发展中国家的财政部通常加以重复。
en: Spurious economic arguments against higher taxes have been debunked in the West, but are still commonly repeated in the finance ministries of developing countries.

zh: 不花在香烟上的钱就会花在其他食品和服务上。
en: Money not spent on tobacco would be spent on other goods and services.

zh: 确实，在大多数国家，即使是烟草需求大幅度降低也并不意味着失业。
en: Indeed, even sharply reduced demand for tobacco would not mean unemployment in most countries.

zh: 增加税收降低消费并且在中期提高财政收入。 增加税率10%就可以在中期内提高税收收入大约7 % 。
en: Tax hikes lower consumption and raise revenue in the medium-term: a 10% higher tax means about 7% higher revenue over the medium term.

zh: 这些资金是治理贫困的宝贵资源。
en: These funds are a precious resource in fighting poverty.

zh: 在中国，提高价格10%将会减少消费5%并且增加足够的国内税收来为三千三百万贫穷的农村人口提高基本医疗。
en: In China, a 10% higher price would reduce consumption by 5% and raise enough excise revenue to pay for a basic health package for 33 million poor rural Chinese.

zh: 即使在走私的情况下，高税收也会降低消费和增加财政收入。
en: Even in the face of smuggling, higher taxes reduce consumption and raise revenue.

zh: 烟草产业助长走私，为的是获得市场份额并吓唬财政部长们降低税收。
en: Smuggling is abetted by the tobacco industry in order to gain market share and scare finance ministers into lowering taxes.

zh: 但是各国政府可以用几个方法来对付。 其中一个例子就是在香烟盒子上用当地语言提出警告并且贴上醒目的税票。
en: But governments can counter it in several ways: local language warnings with a prominent tax stamp on cigarette packs are one example.

zh: 另一个常见的反对烟草控制的论点是，如果人们并没有危害他人，各国政府就不应该干预他们的个人决定。 这一论点有悖常理并且与事实证据不符。
en: Another common argument against tobacco control – that if people are not harming others, governments should not interfere with their individual decisions – is at odds with both common sense and the evidence.

zh: 大多数吸烟者在少年时期或者刚刚成年的时候开始上瘾，那个时候他们目光短浅，缺乏信息，难以做出理性的决定。
en: Most smokers become addicted as adolescents or young adults, when shortsightedness and lack of information make rational decisions difficult.

zh: 在那些有关烟草危害信息丰富的国家，当儿童吸烟者成年的时候，超过80%的人希望他们从来就没有开始。
en: In countries with good information about tobacco risks, by the time child smokers become adults, more than 80% wish they never started.

zh: 最近，巴克利说，尼古丁上瘾并不能被认为是自由选择。
en: Recently, no less than William F Buckley has argued that nicotine addiction cannot be dismissed as free choice.

zh: 而且最近的经济研究发现，出于福利的理由提高税收也是有道理的，因为烟民的代价太高(即使对其他人的外部代价可能较小 ) ， 而且增加香烟税收并不伤害穷人(因为更高税收的自我控制价值可以更多地帮助穷人 ) 。
en: Moreover, recent economic research finds that higher taxes are justified on welfare grounds, because the costs to smokers are huge (even though the external costs to others might be small), and that higher cigarette taxes do not hurt the poor (since the self-control value of higher taxes helps the poor more).

zh: 诺贝尔奖得主森睿智地提醒我们说，不要用不完整的自由派论点驳斥烟草控制的实际理由，这是非常重要的。
en: Nobel laureate Amartya Sen wisely reminds us that “it is important that the practical case for tobacco control is not dismissed on the basis of an incomplete libertarian argument.”

zh: 行动议程是明确的。
en: The agenda is clear.

zh: 各国政府必须严肃对待烟草，把它作为全世界成年人的主要致死因素。
en: Governments must take tobacco seriously as a leading killer of adults worldwide.

zh: 国际扶贫目标必须包含烟草控制。
en: International poverty goals must include tobacco control.

zh: 发展中国家不能被让西方的控制烟草努力如此长久地陷于瘫痪的经济论点所愚弄。
en: Developing countries must not be fooled by the empty economic arguments that paralyzed control efforts in the West for so long.

zh: 盖茨基金会可以资助行动以及研究。
en: The Gates Foundation can fund action and research.

zh: 现在出现了希望的迹象。 超过160个国家已经签署世界卫生组织全球烟草控制条约，而加勒比各国领导人最近宣布他们将联合一致对付烟草问题。
en: There are hopeful signs: more than 160 countries have signed the World Health Organization’s global tobacco control treaty, and the Caribbean heads of state have recently declared they want to tackle tobacco together.

zh: 如果发展中国家戒烟人口的比例从当今的5%不到提高到2020年的40 % ( 正如加拿大目前的戒烟率 ) ， 那么，在2050年以前就可以避免大约一亿五千万到一亿八千万人死于吸烟。
en: About 150-180 million tobacco deaths would be avoided before 2050 if the proportion of adults in developing countries who quit smoking increases from below 5% today to 30-40% by 2020 (like current quit rates in Canada).

zh: 由于控制政策组织儿童开始吸烟，所以，人们可以预期在2050年以后将会有更大的收益。
en: Because control policies deter children from starting, even greater benefits can be expected beyond 2050.

zh: 富兰克林曾经说过，在这个世界上，除了税和死亡之外没有什么事情可以说是确定无疑的。
en: Benjamin Franklin once said, “In this world, nothing can be said to be certain, except death and taxes.”

zh: 但是，我们却有一个可以防止数以亿计的人提早死亡的税收。
en: Yet we have a tax that could prevent hundreds of millions of premature deaths.

zh: 现在就应该使用这一税收。
en: It is time to use it.

zh: 不死的欧洲
en: Death-Defying Europe

zh: 当欧盟准备在这个月晚些时候庆祝《罗马公约》签订50周年时，在外界看来它已是脆弱不堪了。
en: As the European Union prepares to celebrate the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Rome later this month, the EU is widely perceived to be on its knees.

zh: 在2005年，荷兰和法国的全民公决出人意料地使《欧盟宪法》草案遭遇决定性的破坏时，人们觉得这就是欧盟的滑铁卢。
en: European integration, is felt to have, somehow met its Waterloo in 2005, when Dutch and French referendums unexpectedly torpedoed the draft EU constitution.

zh: 媒体报道的焦点集中在据称是欧盟的决策瘫痪，但事实并非如此。
en: Media stories have focused on the paralysis that is said to have gripped EU decision-making, but the reality is different.

zh: 欧盟非凡没有陷入到不可逆转的厄运当中，而是一直在按部就班地平静运作，创建新的政策和项目。
en: Far from suffering an irreversible decline in its fortunes, the EU has been has been conducting business as usual, quietly getting on with the job of constructing new policies and projects.

zh: 看看最近的新闻标题。
en: Take a look at some recent headlines.

zh: 欧盟正在进行一项能源和环境的战略规划，其目的是要结束欧洲内部为获得石油和天然气而进行的恶性竞争，同时也使欧洲成为遏制气候变化努力方面的全球领袖。
en: The EU is putting together an energy and environment strategy that aims to end the self-defeating competition within Europe for oil and gas, while also establishing Europe as global leader in the effort to halt climate change.

zh: 欧盟的共同外交和安全政策可能还不一定意味着欧洲对世界用同一种声音说话，但它已经初具雏形，并已经弥合了由于在伊拉克战争上出现分歧而产生的一些裂隙。
en: The Union’s common foreign and security policy may not yet mean that Europe speaks to the world with one voice, but it is taking shape and has already healed some of the wounds inflicted by disagreements over the war in Iraq.

zh: 同等重要的是欧洲经济一体化继续推进，欧元态势良好，一个单一的金融服务市场也正进入人们的视线。
en: Of equal importance, Europe’s economic integration continues to move ahead, with the euro buoyant and a single marketplace for financial services now coming into sight.

zh: 欧盟创造共同宪法的不幸经历的出发点是担心决策机制正由于大量新成员国的加入（第一次是在2004年5月而再一次是今年年初）而超负荷运转。
en: The starting point for the EU’s unhappy bid to create a shared constitution had been fears that its decision-making mechanisms were being overloaded by the accession of so many new members, first in May 2004 and again at the beginning of this year.

zh: 宪法公约的初衷是要简化这一体系，只是后来它却过于狂热地扩展一份内容冗长、言词华丽的文件，而现在则成为故纸一堆。
en: The constitutional treaty was originally designed to streamline the system, and it was only later that it was over-enthusiastically expanded into the lengthy and pompous document that is now a dead letter.

zh: 然而，有迹象表明即便在没有宪法的情况下，欧盟机器也一直都能运转良好。
en: Yet there are signs that the EU machine has so far been coping rather well without the constitution.

zh: 欧盟去年的立法量几乎和十年以前相同。
en: The volume of EU rule-making last year was almost exactly the same as 10 years ago.

zh: 在2005年和2006年，一系列的欧盟指令、法规和相关报告、绿皮书和通讯继续保持在1996年2800件的总量水平上。 当年正值Jacques Delors掌舵欧盟，而欧盟工程被广泛称道为势不可挡。
en: During 2005 and 2006, the flow of EU directives, regulations, and associated reports, green papers, and communications continued at the same rate as the 2,800 a year chalked up in 1996, when Jacques Delors was at the helm of the European Commission and the EU project was being widely hailed as unstoppable.

zh: 布鲁塞尔现今是一个与华盛顿类似的政府所在地，即便它也是一个欧盟27个成员国间错综复杂的谈判在磕绊中缓慢进展的地方。
en: Brussels is nowadays a government town akin to Washington, D.C, even if it is also a place where complex negotiations among the Union’s 27 members grind forward only slowly.

zh: 更为重要的是，欧洲经济的前景更为光明。
en: On top of all this, the European economy is looking brighter.

zh: 在欧洲的经济发动机德国，失业率降低，商业的信心得到提升。
en: In Germany, the EU’s economic locomotive, unemployment is down and business confidence is up.

zh: 在整个欧盟，在过去三年里纳入10个前共产主义国家的扩盟战略的积极成效似乎正在为欧盟增添新的自信。
en: And throughout the EU, the positive effects of the enlargement strategy that has brought in 10 ex-communist countries over the past three years looks to be generating a new self-confidence.

zh: 以上所述，并非偶然。
en: None of this should be surprising.

zh: 在欧盟细致的政治流程中需要有一个比打击更大得多的挫折才能使一体化进程完全陷入停顿，更别说使其逆转。
en: It would take a good deal more than a hiccup in the EU’s delicate political process to bring integration to a standstill, let alone put it into reverse.

zh: 让欧洲国家以前所未有的姿态紧密团结的全球性压力空前巨大，因此欧盟宪法公约的僵局绝不会使欧洲长时间偏离正轨。
en: The global pressures pushing European nations closer together are as strong as ever, so the impasse over the EU’s constitutional treaty was never going to push Europe off course for very long.

zh: 当然，前进的道路远未明朗。
en: The path ahead is far from clear, of course.

zh: 但一个关于欧盟的未来将如何展开的共识却似乎已然出现。
en: But a consensus does seem to be emerging on how the EU’s future will pan out.

zh: 外交官和政策分析家们大都一致认为失败宪法（草案）的关键因素还可以从废墟中被挽救出来，并转化为“迷你公约”的形式。 这一建议是法国总统竞选中的领军人物Nicolas Sarkozy去年秋天在“欧洲之友”布鲁塞尔的一次会议上提出的。
en: Diplomats and policy analysts are generally agreed that key elements of the failed constitution will be rescued from the wreckage and turned into something along the lines of the “mini-treaty” that Nicolas Sarkozy, the front-runner in the French presidential race, proposed last autumn at a Friends of Europe meeting in Brussels.

zh: 虽然具体内容还只是在人们的猜测中，但在这一共识中，欧盟在明年的某个时候会将许多宪法中最要的程序性机制部署到位。
en: The details are still anyone’s guess, but the consensus view is that the EU will have many of the constitution’s most important procedural mechanisms by sometime next year.

zh: 欧盟还远未脱离困境。
en: The EU is far from being out of the woods.

zh: 在政治文化各不相同的成员国众多的情况下，创建具有连贯性的政策始终是困难的。
en: Creating coherent policies is unremittingly difficult when there are so many nations, each with a different political culture.

zh: 但那种认为宪法危机正拖累所有一切的想法也是错误的。
en: But the idea that the constitutional crisis is holding everything back is mistaken.

zh: 更大的问题是欧盟各国的政府一直纠缠于“建造欧洲”的细节上而却忽略了更广泛的战略问题。
en: The much greater problem has been that EU governments have been concentrating so hard on the details of “building Europe” that they have neglected broader strategic questions.

zh: 在欧洲何去何从及欧洲人需要什么样的欧洲的问题上鲜有讨论。
en: There is little or no discussion of where Europe is heading and what sort of Europe its people want.

zh: 奇怪但却真实的是即便美国在布什总统领导下实行的单边主义也未能引发关于欧洲在世界的未来角色的辩论。
en: It is strange but true that even American unilateralism under President George W. Bush has not provoked a genuine debate over Europe’s future role in the world.

zh: 欧盟的问题不是所谓的“宪法危机 ” ， 而是缺少一种可识别的政治身份。
en: The EU’s problem is not its so-called “constitutional crisis,” but rather its lack of a recognizable political identity.

zh: 拉萨死亡事件
en: Death in Lhasa

zh: 布拉格—4月8日，两名藏人洛桑嘉参和洛亚被拉萨中级人民法院宣判死刑。 罪名是纵火燃烧中国人的商铺，导致人员死亡。
en: PRAGUE – On April 8, two Tibetans, Lobsang Gyaltsen and Loyak, were sentenced to death by the Municipal Intermediate People’s Court in Lhasa.

zh: 另两个藏人 Tenzin Phuntsok 和Kangtsuk被判处死缓。 第三名藏人Dawa Sangpo被判处无期徒刑。
en: Both men were convicted of committing arson that caused death against Chinese owned businesses.  Another two Tibetan activists, Tenzin Phuntsok and Kangtsuk, received a suspended death sentence, and a third, Dawa Sangpo was sentenced by the same court to life imprisonment.

zh: 这是自从2008年春天的那场席卷拉萨和西藏其他城市的骚乱以来，中国法庭首次对参与那场抗议的人士宣判死刑。
en: These latest verdicts are the first death sentences meted out by Chinese courts to those who took part in protests that swept Lhasa and other Tibetan cities in the spring of 2008.

zh: 由于法庭审判是完全封闭的，既没有独立观察员参加也没有外国记者的在场。 按照国际审判标准来看，被告很有可能没有受到公正的审判。
en: Since these trials took place in complete isolation from the rest of the world, with no impartial observers or foreign journalists present, it is to be doubted, strongly, that the defendants received anything remotely like a fair trial in accordance with international judicial standards.

zh: 所以我们请求中国政府撤销对他们的死刑判决，在一个国际认可的标准司法体系中对他们进行公正的审判，这也是中国政府一再承诺的。
en: We therefore appeal to the authorities of the People’s Republic of China to rescind the decision to execute these protesters, and to provide them with an opportunity to be re-tried in a judicial process that is more in keeping with the international standards that China says that it adheres to.

zh: 首先，审判必须是公开的，并且在国际观察员的监督之下举行。
en: And the first standard that must be met is that the trial, first of all, must be verifiable and open to international observation.

zh: 除了关注这些已经被拉萨法院宣判死刑或无期徒刑的这些藏人之外，我们同样关心那些成百名仍然在押的抗议者。
en: But beyond the grim fates of the Tibetans that have now been sentenced by the Tibetan court to death or life imprisonment for the protests that took place a year ago, we are also concerned about the hundreds of other detained protesters who have yet to be tried by the Municipal Court in Lhasa.

zh: 有了此次死刑判决的先例，我们对法庭的公正性不得不提出质疑，我们担心，在这个充满着紧张局势的地区，后续的审判会有更多的死刑判决。
en: Indeed, it is our belief that the recent death sentences could mark the onset of an avalanche of highly doubtful Court rulings in Tibet, which could lead to a worrying number of executions in that tense and troubled region.

zh: 如果中国在世界经济的舞台上已经获得了尊敬，而且正在受益于崛起成为一个经济强国。 那么，中国更应该在西藏，对那些包括少数族群的所有公民都给予公正的司法程序。
en: If China is to gain an international position of respect commensurate with its position in the world economy, as well as to benefit from its rise to pre-eminence among the world economic powers, it is vital that China’s representatives in Tibet acknowledge the need for due legal process for all of its citizens, including its ethnic minorities.

zh: 为了实现公正的审判程序，中国领导人应当允许国际社会的代表进入西藏及其周边省份。
en: Tied to that sense of due process of law is a call for the Chinese leadership to allow representatives of the international community to have access to Tibet and its adjoining provinces.

zh: 自从去年春天那场抗议事件以来，国际观察员一直没被允许进入该区域。
en: For these provinces have now been, for the most part, cut off from international observation ever since the protests that wracked Tibet last spring.

zh: 只有让西藏问题透明化，才能驱散国际社会对中国政府的疑虑。 只有国际社会能够客观公正地在西藏进行采访报道，才能让大家相信中国政府并没有对少数民族进行迫害。
en: Only by making its rule in Tibet more transparent for the rest of the world can the government of the People’s Republic of China dispel the dark shadows of suspicion that now hang over Tibet.  Only by allowing an international presence to report, dispassionately and truthfully, on what is happening in Tibet, will China’s government dispel the idea that its continued rule there means that even more severe human rights abuses will be inflicted on members of China’s ethnic minorities.

zh: 世界遗产之死
en: The Death of World Heritage Sites

zh: 旧金山，加利福尼亚—气候变化又多了一个牺牲品。
en: SAN FRANCISCO, CALIFORNIA – Climate change has claimed another victim.

zh: 今年，世界上最丰富、最复杂的生态系统之一、澳大利亚大堡礁世界遗产区死去近四分之一的珊瑚，是有记录以来规模最严重的珊瑚漂白。
en: Almost one-quarter of the coral in Australia’s Great Barrier Reef World Heritage Area – one of the world’s richest and most complex ecosystems – has died this year, in the worst mass coral bleaching in recorded history.

zh: 即使在大堡礁的最北沿 — — 那里与海岸开发等人类压力距离足够远，因而能够保证珊瑚的健康 — — 珊瑚死亡比例更是高达惊人的50 % 。
en: Even in the far northern reaches of the Reef, long at a sufficient distance from human pressures like coastal development to preserve, to a large extent, coral health, a staggering 50% of the coral has died.

zh: 引发这一漂白潮的是高于平均水平的海水温度，而海水温度高于平均水平的可能性因为气候变化而增加了175倍。
en: The above-average sea temperatures that triggered this bleaching were made 175 times more likely by climate change.

zh: 随着海洋继续从大气中吸收热量，重创大堡礁级别的大规模珊瑚漂白频率可能进步增加，后果也可能更加严重 — — 更不用说其他因温度升高引起的毁灭现象了。
en: As the ocean continues to absorb heat from the atmosphere, large-scale coral bleaching like that which has decimated the Great Barrier Reef – not to mention other destructive phenomena spurred by rising temperatures – is likely to become even more frequent and devastating.

zh: 世界遗产是无价之宝，它们 — — 事实上，还有我们的地球 — — 的未来依赖迅速降低导致气候变化的温室气体排放。
en: The future of priceless World Heritage sites – and, indeed, our planet – depends on the immediate reduction of climate-change-inducing greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 但许多负责保护境内世界遗产的政府不但没有采取强有力的气候行动；实际上还在积极运行煤矿和煤电等肮脏能源项目。
en: Yet many of the governments responsible for protecting these sites within their borders are not only failing to take strong climate action; they are actively pursuing dirty energy projects like coal mines and coal-fired power plants.

zh: 即使大堡礁在我们眼皮底下死去，澳大利亚仍在继续增加肮脏化石燃料的开采。
en: Even as the Great Barrier Reef dies before our eyes, Australia continues to increase its exploitation of dirty fossil fuels.

zh: 去年，澳大利亚政府批准了大型煤矿卡迈克尔（CarMichael）和阿伯特角（Abbot Point）站，后者位于大堡礁附近，为便利卡迈尔克出产的煤向全球出口而建。
en: In the past year, the Australian government has approved both the massive Carmichael coalmine and the Abbot Point terminal, located near the Reef, to facilitate the global export of output from the Carmichael mine.

zh: 卡迈克尔煤矿所产生的排放量将是全世界所有单体煤矿中最大的。
en: The emissions attributable to the Carmichael mine will be some of the highest resulting from a single project anywhere in the world.

zh: 而问题不仅仅局限于澳大利亚。
en: And the problem isn’t limited to Australia.

zh: 地势低洼的孟加拉国是最容易受到气候变化影响的国家之一，其政府支持在毗邻孙德尔本斯（Sundarbans）世界遗产地的地区兴建两座巨型煤电厂。
en: In low-lying Bangladesh, one of the countries most vulnerable to climate change, the government supports a proposal to build two huge coal-fired power plants adjacent to the Sundarbans World Heritage site.

zh: 印度也支持这一计划。
en: India, too, supports the proposal.

zh: 这些电厂不但将产生大量温室气体，还会毁掉孙德尔本斯。 孙德尔本斯是恒河和其他多条河流注入孟加拉湾的地方，这里有壮观的红树林三角洲，是濒危的孟加拉虎和海豚的家园。
en: Not only will these power plants emit large quantities of greenhouse gases; they will also devastate the Sundarbans, where the Ganges and other rivers meet the Bay of Bengal in a spectacular delta of mangrove islands that is home to endangered Bengal tigers and river dolphins.

zh: 发电厂排放的有毒煤尘会污染水质，开展永久性煤炭驳运交通，并且必须开挖河床。
en: The power plants will pollute the waters with toxic coal ash, bring constant coal-barge traffic, and require the dredging of riverbeds.

zh: 烟囱中所排放的汞将在海洋生物体内堆积，永久性污染数百万人和脆弱的野生动物的食物供应。
en: Mercury from the smokestacks will accumulate in the marine life, permanently contaminating the food supply of hundreds of thousands of people and vulnerable wildlife.

zh: 诚然，孟加拉国能源匮乏，要想继续发展经济，这一问题就必须解决。
en: It is true that Bangladesh is energy poor, a problem that must be addressed if it is to continue to develop economically.

zh: 但解决这一问题有其他办法。
en: But there are alternatives.

zh: 孟加拉国有着巨大的可再生能源生产潜力，并且已经是世界屋顶太阳能领先者。
en: The country has significant potential for renewable-energy production, and it is already a world leader in rooftop solar energy.

zh: 当然，避免危险的人为气候变化的责任不能全部落在世界遗产所在国。
en: Of course, the responsibility to avert dangerous anthropogenic climate change does not fall only on countries that are home to World Heritage sites.

zh: 但是，在知道我们现在知道什么的情况下，启动如此具有破坏性的肮脏能源项目是站不住脚的。
en: But, knowing what we know today, initiating such damaging dirty energy projects is indefensible.

zh: 政府不能保护我们的自然遗产，世界遗产委员会（WHC）必须站出来，结束无休止地开发化石燃料。
en: With governments failing to protect our natural heritage, the World Heritage Committee must step up, in order to help bring an end to the relentless exploitation of fossil fuels.

zh: 具体而言，WHC应该向政府发出减少化石燃料相关威胁的建议，列出遭到此类威胁特别严重的世界遗产地，并进行监督。
en: Specifically, the WHC should make recommendations to governments for reducing fossil-fuel-related threats, identify sites that are in particular danger from such threats, and carry out monitoring missions.

zh: 目标首先是鼓励有能力减少指定遗产地的化石燃料相关威胁的政府采取行动。
en: The objective should be, first and foremost, to encourage governments with the capacity to reduce fossil-fuel-related threats to designated sites to take action.

zh: WHC的这一行动还有助于教育和赋权公民社会，同时向金融机构施压不要为大规模开发项目提供资金。
en: Such action from the WHC would also help to educate and empower civil society, while placing pressure on financial institutions to withhold the funding required for massive development projects.

zh: WHC年会 — — 如最近在伊斯坦布尔结束的 — — 是这类措施的理想论坛。
en: The WHC’s annual meetings, such as that which just ended in Istanbul, are the ideal forum for such an effort.

zh: 目前，已有数十个组织和超过60,000个人在委员会敦促印度和孟加拉国取消计划中的煤电厂，转而投资可再生能源。
en: Already, dozens of organizations and more than 60,000 individuals have called on the committee to urge India and Bangladesh to cancel the proposed coal plants and invest in renewable energy instead.

zh: 类似地，数十著名科学家、非政府组织和国际和澳大利亚律师要求WHC劝告澳大利亚不要继续将恶化气候变化对大堡礁的影响的开发项目。
en: Similarly, dozens of renowned scientists, NGOs, and international and Australian lawyers have demanded that the WHC counsel Australia not to continue supporting developments that will exacerbate the impact of climate change on the Great Barrier Reef.

zh: 随着气候变化威胁愈演愈烈，WHC等有影响的机构必须坚决反对依赖煤炭和其他化石燃料这一贻害无穷的遗留问题。
en: As the threat of climate change grows increasingly menacing, influential institutions like the WHC must take a stand against the toxic and insidious legacy of dependence on coal and other fossil fuels.

zh: 如果WHC在这一关键问题上继续沉默，全球世界遗产都要遭殃。
en: If the committee remains silent on this crucial issue, World Heritage sites around the world will suffer.

zh: 印度的一次绞刑
en: A Hanging in India

zh: 新德里 — — 7月30日，既是臭名昭著的匪徒的兄弟、又是注册会计师的雅各布·梅蒙因1993年合谋在孟买策划及实施连环爆炸案，造成257人死亡而被执行绞刑。
en: NEW DELHI – On July 30, Yakub Memon, a chartered accountant and the brother of a notorious gangster now living in self-imposed exile, was hanged for complicity in the planning and execution of serial bomb blasts that killed 257 people in Mumbai in 1993.

zh: 这是三年来印度首次执行绞刑，引发了从惊慌到几乎毫不掩饰的嗜血等各种反应。
en: The hanging, India’s first in three years, has prompted reactions ranging from dismay to scarcely concealed bloodlust.

zh: 这加剧了印度国内对死刑的争论。
en: And it has intensified the domestic debate over the death penalty.

zh: 可以肯定，所有人都认可印度司法体系在梅蒙案中正常发挥了作用。
en: To be sure, no one suggests that India’s judicial system did not function properly in Memon’s case.

zh: 梅蒙按照正当的法律程序被宣判有罪，并依据现行法律来定罪量刑。
en: He was convicted according to due process of law, and his punishment was in accordance with valid statutes.

zh: 监禁的21年间，梅蒙用尽了包括总统特赦在内的一切可能的上诉途径。
en: During his 21 years behind bars, Memon exhausted every possible appeal available to him, including one for presidential clemency.

zh: 最高法院甚至在死刑执行前于凌晨2:30召开紧急听证会，最终决定死刑正常执行。
en: The Supreme Court even held an emergency hearing at 2:30 in the morning, just hours before the execution was set to occur, before deciding to allow it to proceed.

zh: 但问题依然是：法律规定中是否应该包含死刑？
en: But the question remains: Should capital punishment be on the books at all?

zh: 身为一名反对党议员，我因在梅蒙行刑当天凌晨公开表达反对意见而备受指责。
en: As an opposition legislator, I attracted considerable opprobrium for voicing my opinion, on the morning of Memon’s hanging, that it should not be.

zh: 我为政府杀人而深感难过，无论这个人犯有什么样的罪行。
en: I expressed my sadness that our government has killed a human being, whatever his crimes may have been.

zh: 我还说过以国家为主体的杀戮让所有人蒙羞，因为它让我们都沦为杀人犯，和被我们惩罚的人没有区别。
en: State-sponsored killing diminishes us all, I added, by reducing us to murderers, just like those we are punishing.

zh: 我的观点在印度并不受欢迎，我所在政党都拒绝承认我的声明。
en: My view is not popular in India, and my own party disclaimed my statement.

zh: 但我有充分证据表明死刑实际并未对其惩戒的犯罪起到遏制作用。
en: But my position is based on ample evidence that the death penalty does not actually deter the crimes it punishes.

zh: 德里国家法律大学死刑项目搜集的数据表明适用死刑和防止谋杀之间根本不存在统计数据上的相关性。
en: Data collected by the Death Penalty Project at Delhi’s National Law University demonstrate conclusively that there is no statistical correlation between applying the death penalty and preventing murder.

zh: 该证据与其他国家研究都得出了相似的结论。
en: This evidence echoes similar findings in other countries.

zh: 印度死刑执行方式存在的问题也促使我发表了这份声明。
en: My statements were also motivated by problems with the way capital punishment is imposed in India.

zh: 最高法院宣布适用死刑的案件应遵循“罕见中的罕见”的原则。
en: The Supreme Court has declared that the death penalty should be applied only in the “rarest of the rare” cases.

zh: 事实上，印度最近三起实际执行的死刑均源于威胁或夺走大量民众生命的恐怖袭击。
en: And, indeed, the last three executions in the country stemmed from terrorist offenses that threatened or took a large number of lives.

zh: 但死刑判决依然充斥着主观因素。
en: But the decision to impose capital punishment remains highly subjective.

zh: 事实上，是否适用死刑取决于包括司法和社会偏见在内的若干变量。
en: Indeed, whether the death penalty is meted out depends on a number of variables, beginning with judicial and social biases.

zh: 公众愤怒 — — 可能因煽动性的媒体报导而火上浇油 — — 尤其在与恐怖或女性犯罪相关的案例中很有可能导致严判。
en: Public outrage – potentially fueled by inflammatory media coverage – can push for a harsher sentence, especially in cases relating to terrorism or crimes against women.

zh: 经济状况也同样发挥作用，犯罪的穷人由于请不起高质量律师等原因被判死刑的概率比富人大得多。
en: Economic status also comes into play, with poor criminals being executed much more often than wealthy ones, not least because they cannot afford high-quality legal representation.

zh: 总统减刑决策也充满了主观因素。
en: And the president’s decision to commute a sentence is subjective.

zh: 1983年的一个案例表明衡量犯罪行为是否符合“罕见中的罕见”的标准是看它能否“震撼”社会的“集体良知 ” ， 乃至普通民众期待那些司法权的执掌者无论个人同意与否均判处死刑。
en: A 1983 case held that one way to determine whether a crime meets the “rarest of the rare” requirement is whether the community’s “collective conscience” has been “so shocked” that it expects those wielding judicial power to inflict the death penalty, regardless of their personal opinions.

zh: 由此可能导致武断和不成比例的适用死刑。
en: This leaves much room for the arbitrary and disproportionate application of capital punishment.

zh: 2010到2013年间地方法院共做出436起死刑判决。
en: From 2010 to 2013, 436 death sentences were handed down by lower courts.

zh: 其中280起被改判无期，余下不少案件还要在狱中拖上几十年。
en: Of those, 280 were commuted to life imprisonment, with many of the other cases likely to remain in limbo for decades.

zh: 至于已经实际执行的死刑 — — 四年中总共执行了两起 — — 按照客观标准确定相关犯罪比那些没有执行死刑的犯罪更加“罕见”或令人发指几乎没有可能。
en: As for the death sentences that have already been carried out – two in that four-year period – it is impossible to ascertain the objective criteria that made the crimes in question more heinous or “rarer” than those that did not merit execution.

zh: 在事关生死的问题上容不得模糊和主观性。
en: Ambiguity and subjectivity have no place in matters of life and death.

zh: 但在适用死刑的问题上，这两个因素都十分突出。
en: Yet, when it comes to the imposition of capital punishment, both are prominent.

zh: 因此死刑的正确性更加难以证明。
en: That makes it all the more difficult to justify the practice.

zh: 就在梅蒙行刑前几个星期，由负责司法改革的退休法官和法律专家组成的政府机构印度法律委员会组织了针对印度死刑条款及死刑本身目的的有效性评估。
en: Just a couple of weeks before Memon’s execution, India’s Law Commission, a government body composed of retired judges and legal experts that works for legal reform, organized consultations to assess the effectiveness of the provisions governing the death penalty in India and the purpose of the penalty itself.

zh: 不出所料，基于法律委员会听证会上提交的证据和意见，与会人士普遍认为法院无法以公平和非歧视性的态度来对待死刑，同时一边倒地支持废除死刑。
en: Unsurprisingly, based on the evidence and the opinions presented at the Law Commission’s hearings, there was a general consensus that the courts are unable to adopt a fair and non-discriminatory approach to the death penalty, and support for its abolition was overwhelming.

zh: 但近期还不可能废除死刑。
en: That will not happen any time soon.

zh: 印度民众一边倒地支持死刑，特别是对已经定罪的恐怖分子。
en: The Indian public overwhelmingly supports the death penalty, especially for convicted terrorists.

zh: 就梅蒙绞刑的争论往往充斥着感情色彩，比如媒体采访孟买爆炸案的幸存者。
en: The debate over Memon’s hanging was often emotional, with media interviewing survivors of the Mumbai blasts.

zh: 此外，有人提出替代死刑的无期徒刑会导致企图营救其被囚同志的恐怖团体在印度组织劫机和其他袭击活动。
en: Moreover, it has been suggested that the alternative to the death penalty – life imprisonment – would make India vulnerable to hijackings and other assaults by terrorist groups attempting to free their jailed comrades.

zh: 面对如此的安全问题，我所提出的不应剥夺人类生命和国家不应以暴制暴的观点几乎很少有人赞成。
en: In the face of such security concerns, my argument that taking a human life is wrong, and that the state should not compound criminal wrongdoing with its own, found little resonance.

zh: 全球范围内，印度属于仍在不断缩减的少数派范畴。
en: Globally, India is part of a dwindling minority.

zh: 130多个国家已经废除了死刑。
en: More than 130 countries have abolished the death penalty.

zh: 25个国家仍有相关规定，但已经几十年没有执行过任何死刑。
en: Twenty-five countries have it on the books, but have not executed anyone for decades.

zh: 只剩下30多个国家仍旧适用死刑。
en: That leaves roughly 30 countries that still apply it.

zh: 印度在死刑问题上的立场能够引发国际反应；比方说，欧盟国家拒绝向仍旧执行死刑的国家引渡犯罪分子。
en: India’s membership in this group has international repercussions; for example, European Union countries will not extradite criminals to countries where they may face execution.

zh: 但真正的问题可能层次更深：死刑从本质上来讲不过是一种报复。
en: But the real problem is deeper: capital punishment is, at its core, about nothing more than retribution.

zh: 宣传任何杀人（或参与杀人）的人都不配活下去可能非常诱人。
en: It may be tempting to declare that anyone who kills (or participates in killing) innocent people does not deserve to live.

zh: 但复仇是不是国家行动的有效动机，特别当面对的是自己的公民？
en: But is revenge a worthy motive for a state’s actions, especially toward its own citizens?

zh: 印度最伟大的儿子甘地认识到“以眼还眼会使全世界都变成盲人。
en: India’s greatest son Mahatma Gandhi observed that “an eye for an eye makes the whole world blind.”

zh: ”现在，印度仍不愿关注废除死刑。
en: For now, India remains blind to the case for abolishing the death penalty.

zh: 但我相信有一天我们会看到光明。
en: One day, I am sure, it will see the light.

zh: 在那一天到来之前，我还要继续孤独地争取废除死刑。
en: Until then, the lonely battle for its abolition must continue.

zh: 事关防御的辩论
en: Debating Defense

zh: 发自布鲁塞尔 — — 海地大地震向我们明明白白地揭示了两个事实：一，安全问题不光是人为的，二，军队通常是人道救援的一个必不可少的部分。 这是一个及时的提醒，因为安全和防御目前正是北约和欧盟内部讨论的一个主要问题。
en: BRUSSELS – The Haitian earthquake has made two things horrifically clear: security challenges are not only man-made, and military forces are often a vital part of humanitarian aid. This is a timely reminder, because security and defense are now the focus of a major debate within both NATO and the European Union.

zh: 据说那些将军们经常都在为最后一仗作准备 — — 这句老谚语还是包含了一点深刻含义的。
en: Generals, it is said, always prepare to fight the last war – an old jibe, but one that contains an element of truth.

zh: 事实上，军队天然地不具有灵活性，冷战已经过去了 20 年，军队也只是缓慢地在适应自己不断发展的角色而已。
en: Indeed, flexibility does not come naturally to armed forces, with the result that the two decades since the end of the Cold War have seen only slow adaptation to the military’s evolving roles.

zh: 但今年北约优先要考虑的则是对自身战略目的的大刀阔斧的检讨，这是自 1999 年以来联盟从未质疑过的事情，而欧盟则在挣扎着实现自己构建一个名副其实的欧洲防御政策的目标。
en: But NATO’s priorities this year include a sweeping review of its own strategic purpose, something the alliance has not questioned since 1999, while the EU continues to struggle towards its goal of forging a European defense policy worthy of the name.

zh: 在这两方面，所遇到的问题都比解决方案要多。
en: In both cases, there are more questions than answers.

zh: 首先，所谓的安全究竟是什么？
en: To begin with, what is meant by security?

zh: 安全是否跟地缘政治或者是国际关系有关，还是保护社会不受恐怖袭击的伤害？
en: Does it refer to the geopolitics of international relations, or to protecting society against terrorist attacks?

zh: 当然这两者都有，但要制定出能实现这两样截然不同目标的政策的前景远远还没有明朗。
en: It is both, of course, but the sort of policies that will achieve these two very different objectives is far from clear.

zh: 美国和欧洲将如何与全世界政府打交道将是未来几年中一个非常重要的问题。
en: How America and Europe should engage with governments around the world will be crucially important in the coming years.

zh: 此外还有比如气候变化一类的问题，必须意识到还有其他的一些国家正在摩拳擦掌。
en: In addition to issues like climate change, there is also a sense that other players are flexing their muscles.

zh: 一个相对更新的上海合作组织究竟只是中国，俄罗斯和中亚国家之间软弱无力的联盟，还是一个新的全球防御和安全参与者，而且这个参与者的存在将对西方有严重的影响？
en: Is the comparatively new Shanghai Cooperation Organization a flimsy grouping of China, Russia, and the Central Asian countries, or is it shaping up to be a new global defense and security player whose existence will have serious implications for the West?

zh: 而 G20 集团的催生是否强化了大西洋安全关系，还是将导致北约的最终消亡？
en: Does the birth of the G-20 strengthen the Atlantic security relationship, or does it contain the seeds of NATO’s eventual demise?

zh: 事实上，西方的安全思维是否反映了一个即将在 20 年内人口达到 90 亿的世界的现实状况？
en: Indeed, does the West’s security thinking reflect the realities of a world which within two generations will number some nine billion people?

zh: 目前，西方安全的未来是由大西洋联盟内部的紧张关系所塑造的。
en: Right now, the future of Western security is being shaped by tensions within the Atlantic relationship.

zh: 对于阿富汗战争是否是“可以获胜的 ” ， 小布什的“反恐战争”是否将西方拖入了一个堪与冷战相比的长期进程中，联盟内部各方都缺乏一个共识，
en: There is really no consensus on whether Afghanistan is a “winnable” war, and whether the Bush administration’s “war on terror” set the West on a long-term course that may prove comparable in scale to the Cold War.

zh: 而事实上，许多欧洲人都在寻思是否美国在阿富汗和其他地区的领导地位是否就是问题的解决方法。
en: Indeed, many Europeans wonder whether American leadership in Afghanistan and elsewhere is the solution or the problem.

zh: 而在平民安全是否与阿富汗战争根本相关，或者伊朗核项目是否真的对西方构成威胁等方面，美国和欧盟的共识则可能更加少。
en: There is probably even less agreement in both the United States and the EU on whether the security of citizens is genuinely at stake in Afghanistan, and whether the Iranian nuclear program really poses a threat to the West.

zh: 对于欧洲人来说，当自己在安全事务方面的可靠性在许多方面都未能得到满足的时候，自然很难去设定未来的安全议程。
en: It is not that easy for Europeans to set the future security agenda when their credibility on defense matters leaves so much to be desired.

zh: 在欧盟国家 200 万的男女军人中，只有 2% 是做好了战斗准备的。
en: Of the two million men and women in EU countries’ armed forces, only 2% are combat ready.

zh: 也依然难以判断欧洲安全和防御政策是否真的极大提高了欧盟的军事实力和力量延伸。
en: The jury is still out on whether the European Security and Defense Policy has significantly improved the EU’s military capabilities and outreach.

zh: 有些人提出欧洲应当参照自己的农业政策，引入一个类似共同农业政策这样的防御预算，让那些搭便车的欧洲国家也负起责任来。
en: Some argue that Europe needs to follow the example of its agricultural policy and introduce a CAP-style defense budget so that free-rider EU countries start to pay their way.

zh: 也有批评说布鲁塞尔没有作出足够的努力去说服或者强迫欧盟国家去向其他国家开放军备采购。
en: There is also criticism that Brussels still has not done enough to persuade or even force EU governments to open up their military procurement to one another.

zh: 欧盟各国都有一连串理由来反对完全放开本国的军备防御市场，包括对自身国土防御需要的迷惘，对国家主权的考虑，以及保护本国就业和当地高科技生产能力的考虑。
en: European governments have resisted genuine opening of their national defense markets for a host of reasons, including an obsession with meeting national defense requirements, concerns over sovereignty, and a desire to protect jobs and local high-technology capabilities.

zh: 那么我们从此将走向何处？
en: So where do we go from here?

zh: 一批国际智库正连同北约，欧盟委员会和几个国家的政府一道，组织一场在线讨论，时间定在 2 月 4 日 ~9 日。
en: A dozen international think tanks are organizing a worldwide on-line debate, to be held from February 4-9, in association with NATO, the European Commission, and several governments.

zh: 而这场一讨论将不仅对防御专家开放，也对非政府组织，发展问题专家���以及任何对全球安全思维走向有想法的人开放
en: The debate will be open not just to defense experts, but also to non-governmental organizations, development specialists, and anyone with views on where global security thinking should be headed.

zh: 这场持续 5 天的网上讨论将包含 10 个主题，从人权到海盗问题，危机准备，气候变化，发展以及冲突防止问题。
en: The five-day Internet debate will include 10 topics, ranging from human rights to piracy, from crisis preparedness to climate change, and from development to conflict prevention.

zh: 讨论将由高级军事领导人，政治家以及公民社会的领导人在线发起，而这些也将与参与者展开辩论。
en: Discussion will be sparked by on-line appearances by top military, political, and civil-society leaders, who will debate with participants.

zh: 任何有兴趣参加的人都可以在世界各地针对会上的言论发表自己的问题和评论，但必须首先在 www.securityjam.org 上注册。
en: Anyone interested in taking part can log on from anywhere in the world to pose questions or comment on what is being said, but they need first to sign up at www.securityjam.org .

zh: 看到成千上万的人参与这场辩论是一个振奋人心的事情，因为如果没有大众的参与，安全就是难以界定的问题，而那些迫在眉睫的重要改革也会缺乏政治合法性。
en: It is encouraging to see that many thousands are indeed getting involved, because without popular engagement, security will remain undefined, and the important reforms that are needed will lack political legitimacy.

zh: 债务以及美国的衰落
en: Debt and America’s Decline

zh: 发自米兰 — — 意大利以及其他欧洲国家都在处理本国公/私债务方面面临着严重问题，因此让身为一个欧洲人的我来谈论美国不断加剧的债务问题似乎有点不太厚道。
en: MILAN – Italians and other Europeans have serious problems addressing their own national debts, public and private, so it may seem immodest for a European to discuss America’s growing and grave debt problem.

zh: 但如今大西洋两岸的财政困境其实异常相似，摇摇欲坠，在许多欧洲人看来，只能寄望于美国能够做出某些惊世之举，戏剧性地解决自身的债务问题了。
en: But the fiscal realities on both sides of the Atlantic nowadays are very similar, and only lingering trust in the promise of America keeps alive the expectation among some Europeans that some grand American coup de théâtrewill resolve the country’s dire debt situation.

zh: 毫无疑问，许多美国人都意识到自己的国家已经债台高筑。
en: Of course, many Americans recognize the scale of the country’s debt burden.

zh: 美国参谋长联席会议主席（也就是美军官阶最高的人物）迈克尔·马伦上将最近就放言称 ： “ 美国最大的安全威胁就是国家负债。
en: Admiral Mike Mullen, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff and thus America’s highest ranking military officer, recently said, “The greatest danger to American security comes from the national debt.”

zh: ”而10个美国人里大概有5个会同意他的说法，只有不到3个认为恐怖主义或伊朗才是头号敌人。
en: Four Americans out of ten agree with him, whereas less than three in ten deem terrorism or Iran more dangerous.

zh: 美国的世界霸主地位其实一直都跟它的债务水平密切相关。
en: America’s Great Power status has always been tied to its level of debt.

zh: 事实上，正是1914~1917年间零负债的状况确立了美国的崛起。
en: Indeed, it was the absence of debt that marked the United States’ emergence as a world power between 1914 and 1917.

zh: 在向西方盟友发放了60亿美元战争贷款之后，当时的美国由欠债30亿美元（大部分欠英国）的穷亲戚摇身一变成为手握30亿美元净债权的大财主。
en: The US went from owing $3 billion (mostly to Great Britain) to being a net creditor for about the same amount, thanks to $6 billion in war credits given to the Western Allies.

zh: 随后支持欧洲重建的30亿美元贷款进一步巩固了美国世界第一大债权人的地位，而当时美国的债权额几乎相当于其国民生产总值的8 % 。
en: A further $3 billion in credits for European post-war reconstruction cemented America’s status as the world’s premier creditor nation, with its surplus equal to roughly 8% of GNP at the time.

zh: 这一转变意味着美国已经取代英国成为世界金融和货币体系的核心。
en: This shift meant that the US had essentially replaced Britain as the heart of the world’s financial and monetary system.

zh: 在此之前，在金本位和国内稳定政治局面的双重支撑下，伦敦市已经在超过100年的时间内承担着世界资本和金融担保的核心角色。
en: Previously, thanks to the gold standard and Britain’s political stability, the City of London had been the world’s key source of capital and financial guarantees for more than a century.

zh: 这个新时代是在1915年1月突然开启的，当时某种不确定的局面已经持续了数月，然后越来越多的黄金开始被运往纽约。
en: The new era began suddenly in January 1915, when, after a few months of deep uncertainty, gold started to be shipped to New York in increasing quantities.

zh: 而就在几个月之前，波士顿金融界大佬亨利·李·希金森就已经在一封给总统伍德罗·威尔逊的信中勾勒出了美国的新战略。
en: A few months earlier, the veteran Boston financier Henry Lee Higginson had sketched in a letter to President Woodrow Wilson what America’s new strategy should be.

zh: “我们抢占世界第一的机会来了 ， ” 他在信中这样写道。
en: “This is our chance to take first place,” he wrote.

zh: 所有美国金融机构必须按规矩行事，还要还清所有债务，此外，正如伦敦长期以来一直在做的那样，必须维持市场的信心，这就意味着必须保证美元能和黄金自由兑换。
en: America’s financial house had to be put in order, all debts repaid, and, as London had done for a long time, confidence had to be maintained, which meant guaranteeing the dollar’s convertibility into gold.

zh: 在一战期间，美国是列强中唯一一个能保证其货币和黄金之间自由兑换的国家。
en: Alone among the world’s great nations, the US did manage to guarantee dollar convertibility throughout the Great War.

zh: 而在和平到来之时，美元和华尔街也就一跃成为世界金融版图中的霸主。
en: With peace, the dollar and Wall Street became the dominant force on the world’s financial landscape.

zh: 在1993年后由美国总统富兰克林·罗斯福的“新政”所确立的金融市场管理规则，则令美元得以取代英镑成为国际金融系统的核心。
en: The financial-market rules established after 1933 by President Franklin Roosevelt’s New Deal enabled the dollar to replace the British pound at the center of the international system.

zh: 在随后40年间，没有人能挑战美国作为世界银行家的地位，直到理查德·尼克松将美元与黄金脱钩之后。
en: America’s role as the world’s banker went unchallenged for the next 40 years ago, until President Richard Nixon decoupled the dollar from gold.
