zh: 但即便没有了金本位制度，美国的经济实力（加上对石油美元的再循环利用）依然将美元维持在世界之巅。
en: Yet, even without the gold standard, America’s economic might, together with the recycling of petrodollars, kept the dollar on top.

zh: 事实上，美国在1986~1987年财政年度之前依然是世界第一大债权国，但随后就变成了债务国。
en: Indeed, the US remained the world’s premier creditor nation until 1986-1987, when it became a debtor nation again.

zh: 在接着的20年间，美国的债务总额通常维持在3万亿美元左右，并随着美元汇率的升跌而增减变化。
en: In the two decades that followed, America’s debt usually was around $3 trillion, rising or falling with the exchange rate of the dollar.

zh: 然而从1990年开始，美国开始引入越来越多的资本，其中大多数来自亚洲。
en: Starting in 1990, the US began to import more and more capital, particularly from Asia.

zh: 21世纪到来之后中国成为美国债务融资的最大来源国，而美国人对此也乐此不疲，因为这令美联储得以维持一个较低的利率。
en: In the 2000’s, China became the prime source of debt financing, and Americans were happy, because it enabled the US Federal Reserve to keep interest rates low.

zh: 不过有些人却从中看到了危机。
en: There were some who foresaw danger.

zh: 瑞典经济学家阿克谢尔·莱永胡夫预见了资产价格膨胀 — — 尤其是在房地产方面 — — 以及信贷质量的进一步恶化。
en: The Swedish economist Axel Leijonhufvud foresaw asset-price inflation – houses in particular – and a worsening of credit quality.

zh: 很快金融创新就让这些预言变成了现实。
en: Financial innovation soon made that prediction come true.

zh: 2008年是值得铭记的一年，当年只有区区12家上市公司能获得AAA级信用评级，却有超过6000个（大多数来自美国）被评定为AAA级的金融产品。
en: It is enough to remember that in 2008 there were only 12 public companies in the world with AAA credit ratings, but more than 60,000 – mostly American – triple-A structured financial products.

zh: 而美国这个世界银行家也蜕变成为了一个世界级的对冲基金。
en: The US, the world’s banker, had mutated into the world’s hedge fund.

zh: 在这些转变的影响之下，银行家传统的忠诚和信誉 — — “守信 ” — —被抛到了九霄云外。
en: With that change, the banker’s traditional imperative to maintain fidelity and trust – to “keep faith,” as Higginson put it – was forgotten.

zh: 如今美国金融系统那些无法兑现的承诺通通都集中到了国家的公共债务之上，正如意大利的庞大政府债务体现了其过去的挥霍无度那样。
en: And it is in America’s public debt that the debris of its financial system’s broken promises are collected, just as Italy’s massive public debt reflects its past national prodigality.

zh: 美国的债务总额令人震惊。
en: The figures for the US are staggering.

zh: 其公共债务不仅包含了联邦政府的13.2万亿美元债务，还包含了由国内各州以及各县市所欠下的3万亿美元，此外还要加上那些有美国政府背景的房屋信贷机构（房地美，房利美等）的3.9万亿美元欠款 — — 这些机构目前承担了全美超过90%的抵押贷款。
en: Public debt includes not only the federal government’s current $13.2 trillion, but another $3 trillion owed by America’s states, counties, and cities. In addition, there is the $3.9 trillion in debt owed by America’s government-backed housing-finance agencies (Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac, and others), which currently underwrite more than 90% of all US mortgages.

zh: 把上述数字都加在一起之后，美国的公共债务总额几乎等于其GDP的140%
en: As a result, America’s public debt has reached roughly 140% of GDP.

zh: 虽然美国国会很清楚这些数字究竟在警告着什么，但那些议员们却选择睁一只眼闭一只眼。
en: The US Congress is well aware of what these numbers portend, but its members have chosen to avert their eyes.

zh: 事实上，议会也不再要求总统提供对未来5年财政状况的常规预测，只需提交未来一年的展望就可以了。
en: Indeed, the president is no longer required to provide the usual five-year forecast of the country’s fiscal position. A one-year perspective is now deemed sufficient.

zh: 那么世界经济究竟该往何处去？
en: So, where does that leave the world economy?

zh: 至今还没有一个新崛起的世界强权能像1914年的美国那样承担起全球财政的重任。
en: There is no newly emerging Great Power that can assume responsibility for global finance, as there was in 1914.

zh: 当时的华尔街已经蓄势待发。
en: Back then, Wall Street was ready for the job.

zh: 而在未来的某些时候，上海和香港可能会成为接班人，但这种可能性对当今的状况来说，只能是杯水车薪。
en: Someday, Shanghai and Hong Kong might be ready, but that possibility is of little help now.

zh: 债务与民主
en: Debt and Democracy

zh: 发自普林斯顿 — — 欧盟的主权债务危机不但从根本上动摇了欧元，还损害了其民主制度以及政府公信力。
en: PRINCETON – The European Union’s sovereign-debt crisis constitutes a fundamental threat not only to the euro, but also to democracy and public accountability.

zh: 虽然当前欧洲的苦难和踌躇还仅限于希腊，爱尔兰和匈牙利这样的小国。
en: At the moment, Europe’s woes and dilemmas are confined to relatively small countries like Greece, Ireland, and Hungary.

zh: 但这几个国家的政府似乎都违背了民主契约中的一系列基本信条。
en: But all of them look as if their governments have cheated on fundamental articles of the democratic contract.

zh: 而欧盟轮值主席制度则将人们的注意力引向了其中一个国度。
en: The rotating presidency of the EU is about to shed a spotlight on one of these countries.

zh: 匈牙利即将执掌欧盟大权，而对该国总理维克托·奥尔班篡改宪法镇压媒体的讨论却日趋激烈，同时还夹杂着人们对该国金融稳定性的再度忧虑。
en: Hungary’s turn at the EU helm comes at a time of fierce debate over Prime Minister Victor Orbán’s alteration of constitutional law and suppression of press freedom, as well as a new round of worries about the country’s financial sustainability.

zh: 匈牙利有足够的理由为债务的政治后果感到担心。
en: Hungary has many reasons to be sensitive to the issue of the political consequences of debt.

zh: 须知这个国家依然保持着恶性通货膨胀的世界纪录 — — 1940年代该国货币竟然贬值了1027倍，直接导致了共产主义独裁政权的上台。
en: After all, Hungary still holds the world record for hyperinflation, with the currency debased by 1027 in the 1940’s, paving the way for the imposition of Communist dictatorship.

zh: 欧盟的债务计算方式既模糊不清又不可靠。
en: The EU’s debt arithmetic is uncertain and precarious.

zh: 地中海沿岸国家的财政巩固政策可能会成功，并在付出巨大代价的情况下恢复到正常的财政状况。
en: Fiscal consolidation in the Mediterranean countries might just do the trick, and allow – at great cost – a return to normal financing arrangements.

zh: 但如果市场依旧过度焦虑，而现行利率持续高于稳定安全的德国国债利率的话，各国的债务负担状况将迅速恶化。
en: But if market nervousness persists and interest rates remain high relative to rates for secure German debt, the debt burden will rapidly become unsustainable.

zh: 因此欧盟应当对此有所准备并设立一个削减债务的机制。
en: So it might be a good idea for the EU to prepare a mechanism that spells out how debt can be trimmed.

zh: 许多经济体都在计算方式上对这一机制提出了自己的意见。
en: Many economists have argued this case on the basis of arithmetic calculation.

zh: 但欧洲中央银行，尤其是其董事会成员洛伦佐·比尼·斯马吉，则直截了当地否定了该机制 — — 因为该机制在政治和道德上都存在极为重大的影响。
en: But the European Central Bank, notably by ECB board member Lorenzo Bini Smaghi, has elegantly spelled out the case against debt reduction – a case that is politically significant and deeply moral.

zh: 事实上，在公共债务上不能赖账的原则早已和法律保障，代议制政府以及现代民主的发展深深地交织在了一起。
en: Indeed, the principle of not reneging on public debt is deeply intertwined with the development of legal security, representative government, and modern democracy.

zh: 自从1688年英国人民发动光荣革命奋起反抗挥霍无度的斯图亚特王室之后，英国政府就采用了一套新的债务制度：在议会（代议制机构）投票通过预算，以确保人民作为一个整体对政府支出负责。
en: In the wake of the Glorious Revolution of 1688, when Britain revolted against the spendthrift Stuart dynasty, the British government adopted a new approach to debt. Voting on budgets in Parliament – a representative institution – ensured that the people as a whole were liable for the obligations incurred by their government.

zh: 这是一种限制早期专制王朝奢侈宫廷消费（或者军事行动）的宪政手段。
en: A constitutional approach limited the scope for wasteful spending on luxurious court life (and on military adventure), which had been the hallmark of early modern autocratic monarchy.

zh: 而光荣革命的经验在随后的欧洲革命浪潮中进一步得到推广。
en: The lesson of 1688 was reinforced by the next European revolutionary wave.

zh: 法国大革命和拿破仑统治使法国政府负债累累，而革命政权则在滥发纸币 — — 指券（assignat ） ， 流通于法国大革命期间的一种以没收的土地为担保的证券，后当作货币使用 — — 的过程中丧失了自己的信用。
en: In the aftermath of the French Revolution and Napoleon, France was heavily in debt, and the revolutionary regimes had discredited themselves through paper-currency (assignat) inflation.

zh: 在维也纳会议拥戴路易十八复辟之后，皇帝的幕僚们在是否承认拿破仑所欠下的债务方面进行了讨论，而最终承担债务的决定为法国经济提供了急需的法律保障，使其能赶上英国工业革命的脚步。
en: After the Congress of Vienna returned King Louis XVIII to the French throne, his advisers debated whether or not to recognize the debt incurred by Napoleon. The decision not to default contributed to the legal security needed for the French economy to catch up with Britain’s industrial revolution.

zh: 20世纪的战时通货膨胀以及实质性赖账的经验使负责任的财政成为新欧洲共识的一个重要主题。
en: The experience of wartime inflations and de facto defaults in the twentieth century made the theme of responsible finance a crucial part of a new European consensus.

zh: 而欧洲一体化进程的其中一个基础就是承认一个拥有政治合法性的稳定货币的重要性。
en: A foundation of the European integration process was recognition of the importance of a stable currency to political legitimacy.

zh: 事实上，欧盟的法德轴心就是源自于这样一个信条：民主政体的政治秩序必须在确保政府债务安全性的情况下才能实现。
en: Indeed, the EU’s critical French-German axis was held together by the conviction that political order in a democracy depended on the security of debt.

zh: 在德国，对两代中产阶级债券持有人的剥夺被看作是德国皇帝战争以及随后希特勒战争所导致的恶果 — — 换言之，这意味着民主制度的失败。
en: In Germany, the expropriation of two generations of middle-class bond holders was seen as the outcome of the Kaiser’s war, and then of Hitler’s war – in other words, a result of democratic failure.

zh: 在经历了通货膨胀和政府不稳定之后，夏尔·戴高乐重建了法国政治系统以及法国的国家理念，将货币稳定性奉为政府的首要责任。
en: After inflation and unstable government, Charles de Gaulle rebuilt the French political system, but also the idea of the French nation, by championing currency stability.

zh: 他完全继承了拿破仑的政治遗产，认为只有一个强势的货币才能确保国家稳定。
en: He explicitly went back to the legacy of Napoleon, and argued that France could be stable only with a strong currency.

zh: 但在过去20年间席卷了全世界的金融革命似乎切断了代议制政府和公共财政之间的联系。
en: The financial revolution that swept the world over the last two decades seemed to sever the link between representative government and public finance.

zh: 金融衍生物以及其他复杂金融工具则提供了一条路径，让政府得以绕过公民的批准来进行消费。
en: Derivatives and other complex financial instruments seemed to offer a way to circumvent citizens’ responsibility for expenditure to which they had consented.

zh: 换言之，现代政府财政已经变得类似于某种次级贷款，不但产生了一种全球共同分担债务的幻像；规章限制也不再适用。
en: In other words, modern government finance had come to resemble sub-prime mortgages, which created the illusion of universal home ownership; rules and limits no longer applied.

zh: 各国政府可以肆意消费却无需偿还。
en: Countries could practice generosity on the never never.

zh: 欧盟《马斯特里赫特条约》及其《稳定与增长公约》严格规定政府财政赤字不能超过GDP的3 % ， 政府负债不能超过GDP的60 % ， 而各国为了达到这一标准，往往利用会计制度的漏洞来转移多余的支出。
en: The apparently hard rules of the EU’s Maastricht Treaty and its Growth and Stability Pact, which impose a 3%-of-GDP ceiling on fiscal deficits and 60% on government debt, encouraged ingenious accounting to shift expenditure for purely cosmetic purposes.

zh: 跟金融革命同时发生的还有对欧洲人选举权的有效剥夺。
en: The financial revolution went in parallel with the effective disenfranchisement of Europeans.

zh: 在过去20年以来，权力似乎已被转移到了技术精英手中。
en: For the past 20 years, it looked as if power was being shifted to a technocratic elite.

zh: 偷偷摸摸的会计伎俩与见不得光的政治阴谋相结合。
en: Behind-the-scenes accounting tricks were accompanied by behind-the-scenes political tricks.

zh: 而公民们则不出意外地抱怨欧盟机构合法性的衰落。
en: Citizens, unsurprisingly, complained about the declining legitimacy of EU institutions.

zh: 同样，为了担保2008年9月爱尔兰银行所负的债务，爱尔兰政府做出了一些任何负责任政府都不可能考虑的举动。
en: Similarly, in guaranteeing the debt of Irish banks in September 2008, the Irish government did something that no responsible government should have contemplated.

zh: 政府承担了超出爱尔兰国民收入许多倍的债务，以致政府负债上升到GDP总额的1300 % 。
en: It took responsibility for obligations that amounted to a multiple of Ireland’s national income, driving up government debt to more than 1,300% of GDP.

zh: 而至今仍在为这一举动辩护的总理布赖恩·考恩势必将在下一次选举中遭到严厉惩罚。
en: Prime Minister Brian Cowen, who still defends this action, is likely to be massively punished in the next elections.

zh: 但考恩的行为其实是一场更大失败的预兆：公民和纳税人的义务与政府责任之间的纽带已经彻底断裂了。
en: But Cowen’s actions were symptomatic of a broader failure: the fundamental link between the liability of citizens and taxpayers and the responsibilities of government had been broken.

zh: 将一部分欧盟成员国现有债务转化为欧盟债券的想法或许在技术上是可行的，但只有在回复到1688年的英国原则（或者美国革命的原则）之后才能真正发挥其效用。
en: The idea of shifting some part of EU members’ existing government debt to a European bond may be technically appealing, but it will work only if there is a return to the British principles of 1688 (or the principles of the American Revolution).

zh: 欧盟的纳税人必须明白自己只能为自己控制之下的债务负责 — — 而不应为那些不负责任的金融界和不负责任的政府之间的邪恶同盟所造下的罪孽负责。
en: Taxpayers across the EU must have the sense that they control what they owe – and that they will not be held responsible for the mistakes and frauds of the unholy alliance between irresponsible finance and irresponsible government.

zh: 在一个过度杠杆的世界上管理负债
en: Managing Debt in an Overleveraged World

zh: 发自米兰 — — 在去杠杆化的过程中都发生了些什么？
en: MILAN – What ever happened to deleveraging?

zh: 从2008年全球金融危机至今，紧缩和资产负债表修复一直是全球经济高喊的口号。
en: In the years since the 2008 global financial crisis, austerity and balance-sheet repair have been the watchwords of the global economy.

zh: 然而时至今日，债务却比以往任何时候都更加引发对全球增长前景的关注。
en: And yet today, more than ever, debt is fueling concern about growth prospects worldwide.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院一项针对危机后债务发展趋势的研究指出，自2008年以来全球债务总额增加了约60万亿美元 — — 相当于全球GDP的75 ％ 。
en: The McKinsey Global Institute, in a study of post-crisis debt trends, notes that gross debt has increased about $60 trillion – or 75% of global GDP – since 2008.

zh: 比如中国的债务自2007年以来就增加了四倍，并且其债务/GDP比率高达282 ％ — —比包括美国在内的许多其他主要经济体都要高。
en: China’s debt, for example, has increased fourfold since 2007, and its debt-to-GDP ratio is some 282% – higher than in many other major economies, including the United States.

zh: 一个杠杆率上升却无法产生足量总需求以实现潜在增长的全球经济相当危险的。
en: A global economy that is levering up, while unable to generate enough aggregate demand to achieve potential growth, is on a risky path.

zh: 但要评估风险有多大，就必须考虑下列几个因素。
en: But to assess how risky, several factors must be considered.

zh: 首先，必须考虑各部门（家庭，政府，非金融企业，金融部门）的债务构成状况。
en: First, one must consider the composition of the debt across sectors (household, government, non-financial corporate, and the financial sector).

zh: 毕竟，这些部门各自面临的债务压力对整体经济有着非常不同的影响。
en: After all, distress in these sectors has very different effects on the broader economy.

zh: 事实证明，在债务构成的问题上那些总负债/GDP比率相近且相对较高的经济体会呈现​​出巨大差异。
en: As it turns out, economies with similar and relatively high levels of gross debt relative to GDP exhibit sharp differences when it comes to the composition of the debt.

zh: 过度家庭负债产生的风险尤其巨大，因为一旦资产价格收到冲击（尤其是房地产）就会迅速转化为消费减少，因为前者同时削弱了增长，就业和投资，而从这样的冲击中恢复过来又是个漫长的过程。
en: Excessive household debt is particularly risky, because a shock in the price of assets (especially real estate) translates quickly into reduced consumption, as it weakens growth, employment, and investment. Recovery from such a shock is a long process.

zh: 要考虑的第二个因素是名义增长 — — 也就是说，实际增长加上通货膨胀。
en: The second factor to consider is nominal growth – that is, real growth plus inflation.

zh: 当前实际增长低迷，甚至有可能放缓，而大多数国家的通胀则低于目标值，一些经济体甚至面临通货紧缩的风险。
en: Today, real growth is subdued and may even be slowing, while inflation is below target in most places, with some economies even facing the risk of deflation.

zh: 由于债务既是借款人的负债又是债权人的资产，这些趋势就会产生不同的效果，一方面令资产持有人的价值增加，另一方面也增加了债务人的负债。
en: Because debt is a liability for borrowers and an asset for creditors, these trends have divergent effects, increasing value for the asset holder, while increasing the liability of the debtor.

zh: 问题是在这么一个低增长环境下，出现某种形式违约的概率大增。
en: The problem is that, in a low-growth environment, the probability of some form of default rises considerably.

zh: 在这种情况下，双方都是输家。
en: In that case, nobody wins.

zh: 评估债务增长风险的第三个关键因素是货币政策和利率。
en: The third key factor for assessing the risk of growing debt is monetary policy and interest rates.

zh: 虽然没有人确切知道在危机后的世界中一个“正常”的利率环境应该是什么样子，但也可以推断它肯定不应该像今天这个样子 — — 许多经济体都维持着近零利率，部分甚至进入了负值区。
en: Though no one knows exactly what a “normal” interest-rate environment might look like in the post-crisis world, it is reasonable to assume that it will not look like it does today, when many economies are keeping rates near zero and some have even moved into negative territory.

zh: 那些负债水平较高并/或正在上升的主权国家现在可能绝大情况是可以维持的，因为实施了积极宽松的货币政策。
en: Sovereigns with high and/or rising debt levels may find them sustainable now, given aggressively accommodative monetary policy.

zh: 但不幸的是，虽然显然无法永远维持这种和谐状态，但当前的情况却往往被视为半永久性的，制造出一种稳定的幻觉，也削弱了实施推动未来增长的艰难改革的决心。
en: Unfortunately, though such accommodation cannot be sustained forever, today’s conditions are often viewed as semi-permanent, creating the illusion of stability and reducing the incentive to undertake difficult reforms that promote future growth.

zh: 最后（也可以说是最重要）的债务风险塑造因素则与投资有关。
en: The final, and arguably most important, factor shaping debt risk relates to investment.

zh: 利用增加债务来维持眼下的消费量，无论是在家庭还是政府部门，都应该被视为一种不可持续的增长模式组成部分。
en: Increasing debt to sustain current consumption, whether in the household or government sector, is rightly viewed as an unsustainable element of a growth pattern.

zh: 这里中国的情况就是对我们有所教益的。
en: Here, China’s case is instructive.

zh: 从某种意义上说，外界频繁鼓吹中国债务不可持续的说法是正确的。
en: In a sense, the frequent refrain that China’s debt is on an unsustainable path is true.

zh: 毕竟高水平的债务增长确实会令国家在面临负面冲击时显得较为脆弱。
en: After all, high levels of debt increase vulnerability to negative shocks.

zh: 但在另一种意义上，这其实是不得要领的。
en: But, in another sense, this misses the point.

zh: 许多国家政府正在不断增加债务以巩固公共或私人消费。
en: Many governments nowadays are accumulating debt in order to buttress public or private consumption.

zh: 如果过度使用这一手段的话，等于提前透支了未来的需求；这种情况下显然是不可持续的。
en: This approach, if overused, can amount to borrowing future demand; in that case, it is clearly unsustainable.

zh: 但如果作为过渡性措施，以快速重​​启经济或作为负需求冲击的缓冲垫，这种做法可以是非常有益的。
en: But, if used as a transitional measure to help jump-start an economy or to provide a buffer from negative demand shocks, such efforts can be highly beneficial.

zh: 此外，在一个相对高增长的经济体中，只要这些债务被用于资助投资，无论是产生高回报或创造了价值超过债务的资产，那么高债务水平显然并不一定是个问题。
en: Moreover, in a relatively high-growth economy, ostensibly high debt levels are not necessarily a problem, as long as that debt is being used to fund investments that either yield high returns or create assets worth more than the debt.

zh: 在主权债务方面，投资回报可以被视为未来增长的增量。
en: In the case of sovereign debt, the return on investment can be viewed as the increment to future growth.

zh: 好消息是，在中国很多增加的杠杆确实被用于资助投资，这在原则上会创造出能提升未来增长的资产。
en: The good news is that, in China, much of the accumulated leverage has indeed been used to fund investment, which in principle creates assets that will augment future growth.

zh: （但政府最近决定增加财政赤字以刺激经济的政策是否会遵循这一长期促进增长模式，还有待观察。 ）
en: (Whether the results of the government’s recent decision to increase the fiscal deficit to stimulate the economy follow this long-term growth-enhancing pattern remains to be seen.)

zh: 坏消息是，指令性贷款和信贷标准的放宽，尤其是在危机过后，都导致对中国房地产和重工业资产的投资所创造的价值远低于它们的成本。
en: The bad news is that directed lending and the relaxation of credit standards in China, particularly after the crisis, have led to investment in assets in real estate and heavy industry with a value well below the cost of creating them.

zh: 这些投资得到的只能是负回报。
en: The return on them is negative.

zh: 因此中国所谓的债务问题其实并不是个债务问题，而是投资的问题。
en: China’s so-called debt problem is thus not really a debt problem, but an investment problem.

zh: 为了解决这一问题，中国必须改革其投资和金融体系，以便尽可能其筛选掉那些低/负回报投资。
en: To address it, China must reform its investment and financial systems, so that low- or negative-return investments are screened out more reliably.

zh: 这意味着去除因政府对国有银行的兜底所导致的风险错误定价（因为国家肯定不会让这些银行破产 ） 。
en: That means tackling the mispricing of risk that results from the government’s backing of the country’s state-owned banks (which surely could not be allowed to fail).

zh: 许多发达国家也没有投资于高回报的资产，但用意则有所不同：这些国家紧绷的预算和不断上升的债务不允许其大量支出。
en: Many developed countries are also failing to invest in high-return assets, but for a different reason: Their tight budgets and rising debts are preventing them from investing much at all.

zh: 由于这会削弱增长并降低通胀，该其主权债务比减少的速率也大幅下降。
en: As this weakens growth and reduces inflation, the speed at which their sovereign-debt ratios can be reduced declines considerably.

zh: 为了有效刺激经济增长和就业，这些经济体必须开始更加关注其积累的债务类型。
en: In order to spur growth and employment, these economies must start paying closer attention to the kind of debt they accumulate.

zh: 如果债务融资是促进增长的投资，它可能是一个很好的主意。
en: If the debt is financing growth-promoting investment, it may be a very good idea.

zh: 但如果这些融资用于“眼前操作”以刺激短期总需求，这就是非常危险的。
en: If, however, it is financing “current operations” and raising short-term aggregate demand, it is highly risky.

zh: 当然形势是不断变化发展的。
en: Of course, the situation is not cut and dried.

zh: 对公共投资的回归会受到是否存在与其相辅相成的改革的影响，每个国家的情况都会有所不同，同时还存在被滥用的可能，因为有些支出会被误判为投资。
en: The return to public investment is affected by the presence or absence of complementary reforms, which vary from country to country. And there is some potential for abuse, with expenditures being misclassified as investments.

zh: 然而在一个长期利率低下且短期总需求缺乏（这意味着有排挤私营部门的风险很小）的环境中，不放松对投资的财政限制是错误的。
en: Yet, in an environment of low long-term interest rates and deficient short-term aggregate demand (which means there is little risk of crowding out the private sector), it is a mistake not to relax fiscal constraints for investment.

zh: 事实上，正确的公共投资可能会刺激更多私人部门投资，而当前债务辩论所应该做的，就是把这类投资定义出来。
en: In fact, the right kind of public investment would probably spur more private-sector investment. Identifying such investment is where today’s debt debate should be.

zh: 黑暗中的债务重组
en: Restructuring Debt in the Dark

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 随着国际货币基金组织和世界银行华盛顿年会的召开，一个成员国的缺席非常引人瞩目：那就是委内瑞拉。
en: CAMBRIDGE – As the Annual Meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank begin in Washington, DC, one member country is conspicuously absent: Venezuela.

zh: 但有关该国财政状况需要讨论的问题仍有很多。
en: Yet there is much to be discussed about the country’s finances.

zh: 事实上，一场主权债务危机是不可避免的。
en: Indeed, a sovereign-debt crisis is inevitable.

zh: 过去所有重大的主权债务危机 — — 包括墨西哥和希腊主权债务危机 — — 都曾带来过债权人、债务人和国际金融机构的规则、法理或战略变化。
en: All major sovereign-debt crises of the past – including in Mexico and Greece – have generated changes in the rules, jurisprudence, or strategies adopted by debtors, creditors, and international financial institutions.

zh: 最近，阿根廷与债主间爆发长达十五年的法律纠纷 — — 那些拒不合作的债权人的状况比那些数年前就接受债务交换的债权人要好很多 — — 这场法律纠纷破坏了国际金融构架并诞生了新的规则。
en: Most recently, Argentina’s 15-year legal battle with its creditors – in which holdouts did measurably better than creditors who had years earlier accepted a debt exchange – destabilized the international financial architecture and generated a new set of rules.

zh: 委内瑞拉将成为适用新规则的首个国家；这个国家承担不起搞砸的后果。
en: Venezuela will be the first country to navigate the new rules; the country can ill afford to get it wrong.

zh: 委内瑞拉如此严重的危机完全是自己造成的。
en: Venezuela is in a severe crisis of its own making.

zh: 政府在2004-2013年的高油价期间借了高达五倍的外债，侵占了大片经济部门，并对价格、劳动力和货币强制实行严酷的管制政策。
en: The government used the period of high oil prices from 2004 to 2013 to quintuple its external debt, expropriate significant chunks of the economy, and impose draconian price, labor, and currency controls.

zh: 随着2014年油价崩盘，因挥霍无度而失去资本市场借贷能力的委内瑞拉政府选择继续偿还其债券债务，但对进口商和多数非金融债权人的债务实施违约。
en: As the price of oil collapsed in 2014, the government, having lost access to capital markets because of its profligacy, chose to continue servicing its bonded debt and default on its obligations to importers and most non-financial creditors.

zh: 委内瑞拉政府也没有接受国际货币基金组织的建议和出资，而是强制授权拉美历史上最大规模的进口缩减以求平衡外汇。
en: The government also eschewed both advice and financing from the IMF, instead balancing its foreign-exchange flows by mandating the biggest import contraction in Latin America’s history.

zh: 这导致产量下降30%以上（由于进口投入缩减 ） ， 引发700%的通胀并迅速导致大面积的必需品短缺。
en: This caused output to plummet over 30% (owing to the cut in imported inputs), triggered 700% inflation, and led quickly to widespread shortages of essentials.

zh: 除此之外，此次史无前例的重点倾斜导致石油生产陷于崩溃，因为国家石油公司PDVSA未能保住其生产性设施并为向债券持有人偿还债务而拖欠对关键承包商的付款 — — 并因此杀死了会下金蛋的母鸡。
en: Among other things, this unprecedented skewing of priorities led to a collapse in oil production, because the national oil company PDVSA failed to maintain its productive infrastructure and defaulted on payments to key contractors in order to pay its bondholders – thereby killing the goose that laid the golden eggs.

zh: 委内瑞拉失去资本市场意味着除非像PDVSA那样以恶化偿付能力为代价，否则无法实现债务延期。
en: Venezuela’s lack of market access means that it cannot roll over its obligations, except under conditions that worsen its solvency, as PDVSA is trying to do.

zh: 该国也无力换取足够的外汇偿还其到期债务。
en: Nor can it generate sufficient foreign exchange to pay its debts as they come due.

zh: 因此，无论采用哪种方式，委内瑞拉必须要对现有债务进行重组。
en: So, one way or another, Venezuela will need to restructure its existing debt.

zh: 归根结底，重组符合所有人的利益；彻底切断进口只能削弱委内瑞拉的生产和偿债能力。
en: A restructuring is ultimately in everybody’s interest; starving the economy of imports merely weakens Venezuela’s capacity to produce and repay.

zh: 但委内瑞拉可以采用哪些工具在后阿根廷世界与债主达成和解协议？
en: But what tools does Venezuela have at its disposal to secure a cooperative solution with its creditors in a post-Argentina world?

zh: 国际金融机构应当发挥什么样的作用才能促成有效的结局？
en: And what role should international financial institutions play to facilitate an efficient outcome?

zh: 成功债务重组的关键要素是确保类似处境的债权人得到类似的待遇。
en: A critical component of successful debt restructuring is to ensure that similarly situated creditors receive comparable treatment.

zh: 但除非解决“抵制”问题，否则不可能达到这样的目的：如果大部分债主同意减少或推迟收款，就会导致单个债权人借其他债权人的痛苦坚持要求全额偿付始终具有极大的诱惑力。
en: But this is impossible unless the “holdout” problem is solved: if a majority of creditors agree to reduce or postpone their claims, it is always tempting for an individual creditor to hold out for full payment by free riding on other creditors’ pain.

zh: 这也是为什么破产法庭和集体行动条款（CAC）试图对所有债券持有者，包括那些潜在的不合作者，强制执行多数有资质债权人接受的协议。
en: That is why bankruptcy courts and bonds with collective-action clauses (CACs) seek to impose on all bondholders, including potential holdouts, agreements accepted by a qualified majority of creditors.

zh: 阿根廷出现了两个问题。
en: Two things happened in Argentina.

zh: 首先，拖欠的主权债券不存在集体行动条款，因此没有办法迫使抵制者接受最初的协议。
en: First, the defaulted sovereign bonds did not have CACs, so there was no way to force holdouts to accept the initial deal.

zh: 更重要的是，数年后，美国法院接受了由抵制派债权人提出的平等权利条款的全新解释（几乎其他所有主权金融主流参与者及从业者都拒绝接受这一解释 ） 。
en: More important, years later, US courts accepted a novel interpretation of the pari passu clause advanced by holdout creditors (and rejected by virtually all other mainstream participants and practitioners in sovereign finance).

zh: 结果导致阿根廷被禁止向其同意重组的债权人支付现行利息款，除非它同时向所有抵制者支付合同规定拖欠的全部本金和利息。
en: As a result, Argentina was barred from making a current interest payment to holders of its restructured debt unless it simultaneously paid the holdouts the full amount of principal and interest contractually owed to them.

zh: 后阿根廷世界重组难度进一步加大，因为上述案例中抵制者的成功意味着想要谈判的债券持有人必须向投资人解释为什么他们不采取可能更加有利可图的抵制策略。
en: Restructuring in the post-Argentina world is made more challenging because the holdouts’ success in that case means that bondholders inclined to negotiate a solution will have to explain to their own investors why they are not pursuing the potentially more lucrative holdout strategy.

zh: 委内瑞拉的债务问题属于截然不同的性质。
en: Venezuela’s debt is different.

zh: 该国约60%的公共外债由债券组成，其中半数左右的发行者是政府，另外半数是PDVSA。
en: About 60% of the country’s public foreign debt consists of bonds, with about half issued by the government and half by PDVSA.

zh: 政府债券几乎鲜有例外地全部带有集体行动条款，从而在某种程度上更加容易解决抵制问题。
en: With few exceptions, government bonds have CACs, making it somewhat easier to address the holdout problem.

zh: PDVSA债券则悉数在美国发行，且按照规范所有企业债券的法律规定，它们不包含集体行动条款。
en: PDVSA bonds have all been issued in the US and, as legally required of all corporate bonds, they do not contain CACs.

zh: 但PDVSA在委内瑞拉和美国同样有资格申请破产保护。
en: PDVSA may nonetheless be entitled to bankruptcy protection both in Venezuela and in the US.

zh: 在这种情况下，PDVSA可以取得法院授权的“停止令 ” ， 在达成重组协议前避开对其不利的任何法律行动，从而避免资产无序扣押等问题。
en: In this event, PDVSA could obtain a court-mandated standstill order with respect to legal action against it until a restructuring agreement is reached, thereby avoiding a disorderly seizure of assets.

zh: 保障参与的另一种形式的压力是，PDVSA开发委内瑞拉油气储量的独家代理权可以被修改或撤回。
en: As an additional form of pressure to secure participation, PDVSA’s exclusive right to exploit Venezuela’s hydrocarbon reserves can be withdrawn or modified.

zh: （有趣的是，在PDVSA债券的发行文件中，上述两种可能性都被归纳为“风险因素 ” 。 ）
en: (Interestingly, both of these possibilities are highlighted as “risk factors” in the offering documents for PDVSA’s bonds.)

zh: PDVSA和政府也可以引用“退出同意条款 ” ： 即通过与PDVSA债券持有者的简单多数和政府债券持有者的三分之二达成一致来修改债券的某些条款规定 — — 包括阿根廷抵制者所引用的平等权利条款以及其他重要规定。
en: Both PDVSA and the government can also use “exit consents”: changing some of the bonds’ terms – the pari passu clause used by Argentina holdouts, as well as other significant provisions – through agreement with a simple majority of PDVSA bondholders and two-thirds of holders of most government bonds.

zh: 委内瑞拉可以通过采纳强力改革方案和寻求国际货币基金组织的帮助进一步区别自己和阿根廷。
en: Venezuela could further distinguish itself from Argentina by committing to a strong reform program and seeking IMF support.

zh: 国际货币基金组织的特别融资便利规定，委内瑞拉最高有可能获得超过700亿美元的新增融资来支持其改革计划。
en: Under the IMF’s exceptional access facility, Venezuela would potentially be eligible for more than $70 billion of new finance to support its reform program.

zh: 这样的后盾应当对赢得债权人的强力支持大有帮助。
en: And this backing should help to win strong support from its creditors.

zh: 在这样的情况下，基金组织和主要国家政府应当支持委内瑞拉平等对待抵制及达成协议的债权人的决策。
en: In this context, the IMF and major governments should support Venezuela’s decision to treat would-be holdouts no better than creditors with which it reaches agreement.

zh: 因为不愿付款而造成的违约不应当得到国际支持。
en: Defaults stemming from an unwillingness to pay do not deserve international support.

zh: 但如果债务人无力付款，强制付款带不来任何好处。
en: But when a debtor is unable to pay, nothing is gained by forcing payment.

zh: 如果大量抵制协议的债权人坚持要求全额付款，除非其他债权人减少或延迟其付款要求，否则设计有效的债务重组方案就会成为不可能完成的任务。
en: When a significant number of holdouts insist on being paid in full, it becomes impossible to design an effective restructuring, unless other creditors reduce or defer their claims.

zh: 这是对“搭便车”概念的经典诠释。
en: This is the definition of free riding.

zh: 没有对付抵制重组者的策略也就意味着不可能重组，这可能带来混乱，甚至威胁到政府。
en: No strategy to undermine holdouts can also mean no restructuring at all, which could mean chaos or even a failed state.

zh: 无论哪种结果都与国际金融团体或委内瑞拉民众的利益不符。
en: Neither outcome would serve the interests of the international financial community or the Venezuelan people.

zh: 怎样对付债务
en: What To Do About Debt

zh: 日内瓦—在过去几个月中，大量注意力集中到了金融市场动荡上。
en: GENEVA – Over the last few months, a great deal of attention has been devoted to financial-market volatility.

zh: 但股价涨落固然可怕，与这同样可怕的是，与全球经济所面临的真正威胁相比，这些涨落只是浪尖上的涟漪。 巨大的债务海啸正在摧毁家庭、企业、银行和政府。
en: But as frightening as the ups and downs of stock prices can be, they are mere froth on the waves compared to the real threat to the global economy: the enormous tsunami of debt bearing down on households, businesses, banks, and governments.

zh: 如果美联储在今年年底如期开始升息，全球经济 — — 特别是新兴市场 — — 可能陷入严重的麻烦。
en: If the US Federal Reserve follows through on raising interest rates at the end of this year, as has been suggested, the global economy – and especially emerging markets – could be in serious trouble.

zh: 据麦肯锡全球研究所的数据，自2008年雷曼兄弟公司倒闭以来，全球债务增加了大约57万亿美元，在2014年底达到了令人咋舌的199万亿美元，比全球GDP大1.5倍多。
en: Global debt has grown some $57 trillion since the collapse of Lehman Brothers in 2008, reaching a back-breaking $199 trillion in 2014, more than 2.5 times global GDP, according to the McKinsey Global Institute.

zh: 在未来几年中，维持这些债务极有可能越来越困难，特别是如果增长继续停滞而利率开始提高、出口机会依然萎靡不振、大宗商品价格崩盘之势无法挽回的话。
en: Servicing these debts will most likely become increasingly difficult over the coming years, especially if growth continues to stagnate, interest rates begin to rise, export opportunities remain subdued, and the collapse in commodity prices persists.

zh: 大量对债务的关注集中在了欧元区的违约可能上。
en: Much of the concern about debt has been focused on the potential for defaults in the eurozone.

zh: 但新兴市场的重债国可能更加危险。
en: But heavily indebted companies in emerging markets may be an even greater danger.

zh: 发展中国的公司债务据估计已经高达18万亿美元以上，其中有2万亿美元为外币债务。
en: Corporate debt in the developing world is estimated to have reached more than $18 trillion dollars, with as much as $2 trillion of it in foreign currencies.

zh: 风险在于 — — 如20世纪80年代的拉美和90年代的亚洲 — — 私人部门违约将影响到公共部门资产负债表。
en: The risk is that – as in Latin America in the 1980s and Asia in the 1990s – private-sector defaults will infect public-sector balance sheets.

zh: 如今，这一概率比以往更大了。
en: That possibility is, if anything, greater today than it has been in the past.

zh: 日益开放的金融市场让外国银行和资产管理者能够迅速甩卖债务 — — 通常是出于与经济基本面无关的理由。
en: Increasingly open financial markets allow foreign banks and asset managers to dump debts rapidly, often for reasons that have little to do with economic fundamentals.

zh: 当甩卖碰巧遇上货币贬值时，结果可能非常残酷 — — 乌克兰正在领教这个惨痛的教训。
en: When accompanied by currency depreciation, the results can be brutal – as Ukraine is learning the hard way.

zh: 在这样的情形中，私人损失难免成为代价高昂的公共问题，随着政府出手援助债权人以防止经济崩溃，市场波动很快就会跨国传播。
en: In such cases, private losses inevitably become a costly public concern, with market jitters rapidly spreading across borders as governments bail out creditors in order to prevent economic collapse.

zh: 负债政府既比私人债务人强大，又比私人债务人脆弱，认识到这一点很重要。
en: It is important to note that indebted governments are both more and less vulnerable than private debtors.

zh: 主权借款人无法寻求破产法的保护以推迟和重组偿付；与此同时，它们的债权人无法获得非商业公共资产作为未偿还债务的补偿。
en: Sovereign borrowers cannot seek the protection of bankruptcy laws to delay and restructure payments; at the same time, their creditors cannot seize non-commercial public assets in compensation for unpaid debts.

zh: 当政府无法偿付时，唯一的办法是直接谈判。
en: When a government is unable to pay, the only solution is direct negotiations.

zh: 但现有债务重组制度效率低下、支离破碎并且不公平。
en: But the existing system of debt restructuring is inefficient, fragmented, and unfair.

zh: 主权借款人无力维持债务的问题总是发现得过晚，解决的效果也不好。
en: Sovereign borrowers’ inability to service their debt tends to be addressed too late and ineffectively.

zh: 政府不愿承认有偿债能力问题，因为害怕这样会引发资本外流、金融恐慌和经济危机。
en: Governments are reluctant to acknowledge solvency problems for fear of triggering capital outflows, financial panics, and economic crises.

zh: 与此同时，私人债权人担心遭遇“剃头 ” （ haircut ） ， 常常会中止清算，寄希望于情况峰回路转。
en: Meanwhile, private creditors, anxious to avoid a haircut, will often postpone resolution in the hope that the situation will turn around.

zh: 当问题最终被承认时，常常已经陷入了紧急状态，而救援行动又常常着重于支持不负责任的贷款人，而不是便利经济复苏。
en: When the problem is finally acknowledged, it is usually already an emergency, and rescue efforts all too often focus on propping up irresponsible lenders rather than on facilitating economic recovery.

zh: 更糟糕的是，当妥协达成时，债务人要接受绝大部分负担 — — 以强迫紧缩和结构改革的形式，结果是剩余债务更加不可持续。
en: To make matters worse, when a compromise is reached, the burden falls disproportionately on the debtor, in the form of enforced austerity and structural reforms that make the residual debt even less sustainable.

zh: 此外，最近对债权人权利的强化以及债券融资的增加让主权债务重组变得非常复杂，被包括所谓的兀鹫基金在内的高度投机性的坚决不让步的资者滥用。
en: Furthermore, the recent strengthening of creditor rights and the growth of bond financing has made sovereign-debt restructuring enormously complex and open to abuse by highly speculative holdout investors, including so-called vulture funds.

zh: 关于需要更好的方法重组债务，人们正在日渐达成共识，有三个选项浮出了水面。
en: As consensus grows regarding the need for better ways to restructure debt, three options have emerged.

zh: 第一个选项是强化债券市场的法律基础，在合同中引入强集体行动条款并澄清同等权利（公平对待）条款，同时促进GDP指数债券或视情况可转换（contingent-convertible）债券的使用。
en: The first would strengthen bond markets’ legal underpinnings, by introducing strong collective-action clauses in contracts and clarifying the pari passu (equal treatment) provision, as well as promoting the use of GDP-indexed or contingent-convertible bonds. This approach would be voluntary and consensual, but it would miss large parts of the debt market and do little to support economic recovery or a return to sustainable growth.

zh: 第二个方法着重于围绕软法律原则构建共识以指导重组措施。
en: A second approach would focus on building a consensus around soft-law principles to guide restructuring efforts.

zh: 核心原则 — — 正在讨论中的包括主权、合法性、无偏性、透明性、善意性和持续性原则 — — 目前将用于所有债务工具，提供比市场方法更多的合作。
en: The core principles – those under discussion include sovereignty, legitimacy, impartiality, transparency, good faith, and sustainability principles – currently would apply to all debt instruments and could provide greater coordination than market-based approaches.

zh: 但是，尽管这一措施具有为人所熟悉的优点，但它不具有约束性，无法保证足够多的相关方遵守。
en: But, although this effort has the advantage of familiarity, it would be non-binding, with no guarantee that a critical mass of parties would adhere to it.

zh: 第三个选择是尝试通过一组事先形成一致的、作为类似于国家层面的破产法的国际债务分期偿还机制的规则和规范解决这一合作问题。
en: The third option would attempt to resolve this coordination problem through a set of rules and norms agreed in advance as part of an international debt-workout mechanism that would be similar to bankruptcy laws at the national level.

zh: 其目的是防止难以维持外部债务的国家出现金融崩溃，并指导这些国家的经济重回可持续增长。
en: Its purpose would be to prevent financial meltdowns in countries facing difficulties servicing their external debt and to guide their economies back toward sustainable growth.

zh: 该机制将包括允许暂时停止一切偿付（不管是私人债务还是公共债务）的条款、自动搁置债权人诉讼、实施临时性汇率和资本管制、债务人控制条款和关键经常项目交易过渡性融资，以及最终的债务重组和纾困。
en: The mechanism would include provisions allowing for a temporary standstill on all payments due, whether private or public; an automatic stay on creditor litigation; temporary exchange-rate and capital controls; the provision of debtor-in-possession and interim financing for vital current-account transactions; and, eventually, debt restructuring and relief.

zh: 来自加纳、希腊、波多黎各、乌克兰和其他许多国家的证据表明，不合理地管理不可持续债务所带来的经济和社会损失可能十分巨大。
en: Evidence from Ghana, Greece, Puerto Rico, Ukraine, and many other countries shows the economic and social damage that unsustainable debts can cause when they are improperly managed.

zh: 9月，联合国大会通过了一系列原则指导主权债务重组。
en: In September, the United Nations General Assembly adopted a set of principles to guide sovereign-debt restructuring.

zh: 这是重要的一步，但在全球经济面临迫在眉睫的债务墙的时候，还需要做更多的事防止不作为。
en: This is an important step forward, but much remains to be done to prevent much from coming undone as the global economy confronts the looming wall of debt.

zh: 多少发展数据算够？
en: How Much Development Data Is Enough?

zh: 内罗毕—科技的迅速进步极大地降低了收集数据的成本。
en: NAIROBI – Rapid advances in technology have dramatically lowered the cost of gathering data.

zh: 太空、天空、实验室和实地传感器，以及新兴的众包机会和已得到广泛使用互联网和移动电话正在让人们获得从前无从获得的巨量信息。
en: Sensors in space, the sky, the lab, and the field, along with newfound opportunities for crowdsourcing and widespread adoption of the Internet and mobile telephones, are making large amounts of information available to those for whom it was previously out of reach.

zh: 比如，如今非洲农村地区的小农轻点屏幕就可以了解天气预报和市场价格。
en: A small-scale farmer in rural Africa, for example, can now access weather forecasts and market prices at the tap of a screen.

zh: 数据革命为改善个层面决策提供了巨大的潜力 — — 不论是本地农民还是业务遍布全球的发展组织。
en: This data revolution offers enormous potential for improving decision-making at every level – from the local farmer to world-spanning development organizations.

zh: 但光是收集数据是不够的。
en: But gathering data is not enough.

zh: 还必须管理和评估信息 — — 合理地完成这一任务可能远比收集数据更复杂、更昂贵。
en: The information must also be managed and evaluated – and doing this properly can be far more complicated and expensive than the effort to collect it.

zh: 如果需要改善的决策从一开始无法得到合理的识别和分析，就极有可能让巨大的集体努力付诸东流或出现方向性错误。 。
en: If the decisions to be improved are not first properly identified and analyzed, there is a high risk that much of the collection effort could be wasted or misdirected.

zh: 这一结论本身便是基于实证分析。
en: This conclusion is itself based on empirical analysis.

zh: 比如，监测农业或环境管理项目能带来积极影响，这一观点的支持证据很弱。
en: The evidence is weak, for example, that monitoring initiatives in agriculture or environmental management have had a positive impact.

zh: 多个领域 — — 包括环境政策、商业投资和网络安全 — — 的量化决策分析表明，人们倾向于高估做出好决策所需要的数据量或误解需要的数据类型。
en: Quantitative analysis of decisions across many domains, including environmental policy, business investments, and cyber security, has shown that people tend to overestimate the amount of data needed to make a good decision or misunderstand what type of data are needed.

zh: 此外，如果只使用机器算法挖掘大数据集而不首先合理地考察需要作出的决策，就可能谬以千里。
en: Furthermore, grave errors can occur when large data sets are mined using machine algorithms without having first having properly examined the decision that needs to be made.

zh: 数据挖掘导致错误结论的情况不胜枚举 — — 包括用药剂量和法律案例 — — 原因是没有咨询相关领域的专家，导致关键信息被排除在分析之外。
en: There are many examples of cases in which data mining has led to the wrong conclusion – including in medical diagnoses or legal cases – because experts in the field were not consulted and critical information was left out of the analysis.

zh: 决策科学将人们对行为的理解与一致决策的基本原理相结合，它能够让实证数据与专家知识相匹配，从而降低这类风险。
en: Decision science, which combines understanding of behavior with universal principles of coherent decision-making, limits these risks by pairing empirical data with expert knowledge.

zh: 如果我们想让数据革命有利于可持续发展，那么就必须将该领域的最佳实践纳入。
en: If the data revolution is to be harnessed in the service of sustainable development, the best practices of this field must be incorporated into the effort.

zh: 第一步是识别和框定频繁循环决策。
en: The first step is to identify and frame frequently recurring decisions.

zh: 在发展领域，这些决策包括大规模决策，如政府和国际组织的支出重点 — — 从而决定预算配置。
en: In the field of development, these include large-scale decisions such as spending priorities – and thus budget allocations – by governments and international organizations.

zh: 但也包括规模小得多的选择：农民要决定种植哪种庄稼、使用多少肥料，何时以及在哪里出售收成。
en: But it also includes choices made on a much smaller scale: farmers pondering which crops to plant, how much fertilizer to apply, and when and where to sell their produce.

zh: 第二步是在这些决策中建立不确定性的量化模型，包括各种触发因素、后果、控制因素和缓和因素，以及其中所牵涉到的不同成本、收益和风险。
en: The second step is to build a quantitative model of the uncertainties in such decisions, including the various triggers, consequences, controls, and mitigants, as well as the different costs, benefits, and risks involved.

zh: 纳入 — — 而不是忽略 — — 难以测量、高度不确定的因素才能带来最佳决策。
en: Incorporating – rather than ignoring – difficult-to-measure, highly uncertain factors leads to the best decisions.

zh: 在可持续发展方面，这类模型常常包括预测未来数十年中干预对生计和环境的影响。
en: When put in the service of sustainable development, such a model will often involve projecting the impact of interventions on livelihoods and the environment over several decades.

zh: 这一过程要想获得成功，就必须让相关利益方和专家一起梳理重要变量和它们之间的关系。
en: This process is most successful when stakeholders as well as experts are recruited to identify the relevant variables and their relationships.

zh: 这些参与者必须受过训练，能够提供不同变量的不确定性的量化估计。
en: These participants must be trained to provide quantitative estimates of their uncertainty for the different variables.

zh: 比如，基于可获得的数据和自身经验，专家可能以90%的置信度估算出某给定区域的农民平均玉米收成为每英亩0.5—2吨。
en: For example, experts might estimate with 90% confidence, based on available data and their own experience, that farmers’ average maize yields in a given region are 0.5-2 tons per hectare.

zh: 第三步是计算获取更多信息的价值 — — 只有在所有变量的不确定性都得到量化之后，这一步才有可能实现。
en: The third step is to compute the value of obtaining additional information – something that is possible only if the uncertainties in all of the variables have been quantified.

zh: 信息的价值等于理性决策者愿意为此付出多少钱。
en: The value of information is the amount a rational decision-maker would be willing to pay for it.

zh: 因此，我们需要知道新增信息对于改进决策的价值在哪里，以及我们应该花多少钱获得它。
en: So we need to know where additional data will have value for improving a decision and how much we should spend to get it.

zh: 在某些情况中，做出可靠决策不需要更多的数据；但在另一些情况中，获得更多数据可谓价值连城。
en: In some cases, no further information may be needed to make a sound decision; in others, acquiring further data could be worth millions of dollars.

zh: 这一过程会反复进行，直到获得信息已再无价值，并且可靠的决策已经达到。 可靠的决策是指基于信息、价值和决策者或决策机构的偏好所做出的合乎逻辑的结论。
en: This process is repeated until there is no further value in acquiring data and a sound decision – a logical conclusion, based on the information, values, and preferences of the decision-makers or decision-making body – is reached.

zh: 它向决策者和相关利益方提供关于如何改善政策从而最大化积极结果并降低风险（比如发生低通过率的可能性或机构缺乏有效实施的能力）的洞见。
en: It provides decision-makers and stakeholders insights into how to improve policies to maximize positive outcomes and reduce risks, such as the possibility of low rates of adoption or limited institutional capacity for effective implementation.

zh: 简单地认为数据革命一定有利于可持续发展是不够的。
en: It is not enough simply to assume that the data revolution will benefit sustainable development.

zh: 确保这一结果需要认识到严格分析在每一次数据收集工作中的重要性，以及培养新一代决策科学家与决策者合作的重要性。
en: Ensuring that it does will require recognizing the importance of rigorous analysis in every data-collection effort and the formation of a new generation of decision scientists to work alongside policymakers.

zh: 欧元区的抉择时刻
en: Decision Time for the Eurozone

zh: 雅典 — — 德国人反对引入欧元债券、扩大欧元区援助基金以及建立完整的经济治理体系，他们的态度是公开的，立场也是可以理解的。
en: ATHENS – Germany’s arguments against introducing Eurobonds, expanding the eurozone’s bailout fund, and instituting a comprehensive system of economic governance are transparent and easy to understand.

zh: 但他们就一定对吗？
en: But are they right?

zh: 德国人担心，这样的举措会导致国内借贷成本上升，并造成流向穷国的直接或间接的财政转移。
en: The Germans fear that such innovations would lead to a rise in domestic borrowing costs, and to direct and indirect fiscal transfers to poorer countries.

zh: 此外，他们警告说，纾缓过度负债国的负担以使它们的公共财政恢复有序状态会造成道德风险。
en: Moreover, they warn of the moral hazard generated by relieving over-indebted countries from the pressure to put their public finances in order.

zh: 第三，他们还抬出了条约和宪政方面的理由，说确定刺激“财政联盟”形成的规则和程序十分困难。
en: Third, they cite treaty-related and constitutional difficulties in establishing rules and procedures that would simulate a “fiscal union.”

zh: 最后，将欧洲统一起来共同前进，以使过度负债国主权不可避免地有所损失的需要最终也会让德国的主权受到损失。
en: Finally, the need to move ahead with European unification in order to legitimize the inevitable infringement of over-indebted countries’ sovereignty might eventually infringe upon German sovereignty as well.

zh: 另一方面，拒绝接受人们日渐一致的观点 — — 财政联盟是解决债务危机的关键 — — 将使欧元区和德国面临重大风险。
en: On the other hand, refusing to accept the growing consensus that fiscal union is the key to resolving the debt crisis exposes the eurozone, and Germany, to serious risks.

zh: 半死不活的政策将使市场变得不耐烦，也会激起早已准备就绪的投机袭击，不光疲软的外围国家要遭殃，核心的AAA国家如法国（最终还有德国自己）也脱不了干系 — — 它们的银行部门持有着巨量的外围国家债务。
en: Sticking to half-measures exacerbates markets’ impatience and provokes increasingly determined speculative attacks, not only on the weaker peripheral countries, but also on core AAA-rated countries – like France and, eventually, Germany itself – whose banking sectors hold large volumes of peripheral countries’ debt.

zh: 事实上，银行情况恶化正在成为欧元区复苏和稳定的主要威胁。
en: Indeed, weakening banking conditions are emerging as a major threat to the eurozone’s recovery and stability.

zh: 此外，如果发生了主权违约，援助银行的成本可能会远高于发行欧元债券或建立合理的转移支付机制。
en: In the event of sovereign defaults, moreover, the cost of bailing out the banks may far exceed the cost of issuing Eurobonds or instituting a reasonable transfer regime.

zh: 投资者需要获得保证，债务付息成本处于可控状态、债务规模和赤字上限被严密监控以使违约风险最小化并使银行能够成为可持续增长的扎实根基。
en: Investors need to be reassured that debt-service costs are under control, and that debt volumes and deficit limits are firmly monitored in order to minimize default risks and strengthen banks’ ability to lay the groundwork for sustainable growth.

zh: 事实上，当前浮现的欧元区可持续性系统风险造成了一个恶性循环。
en: In fact, the emerging systemic risk concerning the sustainability of the eurozone produces a vicious circle.

zh: 系统风险产生了对过度负债国偿债能力的质疑，这意味着这些国家整合财政并推进改革的努力并不会让财政状况有所改善，而财政状况的改善是克服危机、促进复苏的关键。
en: Systemic risk raises doubts about the solvency of over-indebted countries, which means that these countries’ efforts to consolidate their fiscal position and promote reform do not lead to improvement in financial conditions, which is essential for overcoming the crisis and promoting recovery.

zh: 结果，财政整合变得越来越难以实现，从而导致新一轮投机袭击。
en: As a result, fiscal consolidation becomes increasingly difficult to achieve, inviting renewed speculative attacks.

zh: 此外，从更广泛的角度看，欧洲南部外围国家的经济和社会动荡将造成地缘政治风险。
en: Moreover, viewed from a wider perspective, economic and social turbulence on Europe’s southern periphery will constitute a geopolitical risk.

zh: 欧元内部出现大规模违约相关危机会加剧这一风险。 违约相关的危机可能无法避免，而且会造成类似雷曼兄弟的连锁反应，摧毁整个欧元区。
en: That risk would be exacerbated by the eruption of a major default-related crisis within the eurozone, which might not be contained and, through a Lehman-like domino sequence, could jeopardize the entire edifice.

zh: 欧元区的困境，以及对解决方案提议的反对和支持，可以无止境地争论下去。
en: The eurozone’s dilemmas, and the pros and cons of proposed solutions, can be debated endlessly.

zh: 比如，你可以说，欧元债券将能使欧元区成员国把财政实力拧成一股绳，同时，若能增强欧元作为储备货币的吸引力，就能降低借贷成本，使AAA级国家不至于背上沉重负担。
en: It could be argued, for example, that Eurobonds would allow eurozone members to pool their financial strength and, by enhancing the attractiveness of the euro as a reserve currency, hold down borrowing costs to such an extent that AAA-rated countries are not overburdened.

zh: 法律问题也可以在短期内得到解决，办法是如此设计欧元债：它将包括信用担保、偿还优先顺序，并规定具体的税收流作为抵押品。
en: Legal problems could also be overcome in the short term by designing Eurobonds to include credit guarantees, repayment priorities, and the use of specific tax streams as collateral.

zh: 与此同时，限制道德风险的方案将把欧元债券规模限制在GDP的60%以内，亦即欧元区目前为成员国设定的公债上限。
en: Proposals to limit moral hazard, meanwhile, would do so by limiting Eurobonds to 60% of GDP – the eurozone’s current ceiling for member states’ public debt.

zh: 一个更重要的约束是为财政挥霍国设立更为严格的纪律机制，并将其作为强化制度框架的一部分。
en: A more substantial constraint would be to establish a tougher disciplinary regime on fiscally profligate countries as part of a reinforced institutional framework.

zh: 政治问题 — — 不管如何解决 — — 应该与欧洲银行的脆弱性问题相权衡。
en: Political problems, however they are addressed, should be weighed against the vulnerability of European banks.

zh: 如今，德国银行是主要发达经济体中杠杆率最高的，在危机之初，德国银行的贷款有将近三分之一是贷给希腊、葡萄牙、爱尔兰、西班牙和意大利的公共和私人部门的。
en: Germany’s banks today are the most highly leveraged of any of the major advanced economies, while at the start of the crisis they held close to one-third of all loans made to the public and private sectors of Greece, Portugal, Ireland, Spain, and Italy.

zh: 只要欧元区系统性风险得不到解决，主权违约可能性就不到消除，这将导致银行援助计划不断膨胀，造成不可接受的代价。
en: So long as the eurozone’s systemic risk is not addressed, sovereign defaults are not unlikely, leading to extended bank bailouts that could carry unacceptable costs.

zh: 果真如此的话，银行业危机的大爆发将在欧元区甚至全世界造成一场萧条。
en: In that case, a full-blown banking crisis could bring about a depression in the eurozone and, perhaps, globally.

zh: 从短期看，要降低可能的主权违约所造成的成本，泛欧洲的银行资本重组是关键。
en: Europe-wide bank recapitalization is essential in the short term to contain the cost arising from possible sovereign defaults.

zh: 可是，解决欧元区的深层次缺陷的进程不可以被无限期推迟。
en: However, addressing the eurozone’s deeper defects cannot be postponed endlessly.

zh: 当然，身处如此不确定的环境，过度负债国的财政整合仍在有序进行，这件事本身就令人瞩目；但是欧洲央行继续实施债券购买和流动性支持计划只是权宜之计。
en: Of course, in the midst of so much uncertainty, it is remarkable that the over-indebted countries’ consolidation efforts remain broadly on track; but the European Central Bank’s continued bond-buying and liquidity support is only a temporary palliative.

zh: 现在的路是走不通的，因此相互扯皮绝非正途。
en: An impasse is inevitable, so playing for time is not a solution.

zh: 相反，我们需要欧元债券、成熟完善的债券便利机制、强化欧洲央行权力以便其担起最后贷款人职责，以及英明的经济治理多管齐下。
en: By contrast, a combination of Eurobonds, a fully-fledged debt facility, enhanced powers for the ECB so that it can act as a lender of last resort, and solid economic governance would work.

zh: 从长期看，在资本、生产和劳动力市场上的彻底改革也是必须的，并需要辅之以欧洲层面的更积极、更一致的以提振竞争力、弥补增长缺口为目标的投资战略。
en: In the longer term, radical reforms in capital, product, and labor markets will also be needed, complemented by a stronger and more cohesive investment strategy at the European level, aimed at boosting competitiveness and restoring growth prospects.

zh: 欧洲竞争力并不止全球这一个维度。
en: European competitiveness does not have only a global dimension.

zh: 欧元区内部也存在巨大的差异，核心国和外围国之间的结构性贸易失衡就是明证，这也正是此次债务危机的核心。
en: Large discrepancies exist within the eurozone, reflected in structural trade imbalances between the core and the periphery that lie at the heart of the debt crisis.

zh: 决定欧元区凝聚力和未来增长前进的关键因素是通过补贴和带宽建立一个框架，以便让投资资本流向穷国，从而让它们补上竞争力缺口。
en: The eurozone’s cohesion and future growth depend critically on creating a framework – through grants and loans – for investment capital to flow to the poorer countries in order to close the competitiveness gap.

zh: 借用一句金融界的话来说，欧元“太大而不能倒 ” 。
en: To borrow a phrase from the financial world, the euro is too big to fail.

zh: 下决心越早越好，先发制人，后发制于人，此话对欧元区来说乃至理名言。
en: Decisions should be taken sooner rather than later, so that the eurozone itself shapes events, rather than being commanded by them.

zh: 全球经济的决策时刻
en: Decision Time for the Global Economy

zh: 米兰—在三伏天，米兰比其他许多欧洲城市都安静。
en: MILAN – In the dog days of summer, Milan is quieter than many European cities.

zh: 当地人都跑出去了，米兰城也不像巴黎和罗马那样吸引游客。
en: The locals are away, and, unlike Paris or Rome, tourists do not take their place.

zh: 在米兰和其他地方，人、企业、政府和市场都在放假、减压和沉思。
en: Here and elsewhere, people, businesses, governments, and markets take a break, decompress, and reflect.

zh: 欧洲经济问题仍在那里，等着我们9月假毕归来。
en: Europe’s economic problems will still be here, waiting for us, in September.

zh: 当夏季结束时，重要的问题上的不确定性将成为主宰 — — 不仅仅是在欧洲。
en: And when summer ends, uncertainty about key issues will be the order of the day – and not only in Europe.

zh: 土耳其和巴西出人意料的示威运动引起了对新兴市场增长和经济社会稳定的疑虑。
en: Largely unanticipated protest movements in Turkey and Brazil have raised questions about the economic and social sustainability of emerging-market growth.

zh: 孟加拉国制衣厂的大火引起了全球供应链管理的新问题。
en: The fires in Bangladeshi garment factories have raised new questions about the governance of global supply chains.

zh: 在美国，美联储暗示将在下半年“减弱”其量化宽松政策，结果，以发达国家货币条件为基础的全球套息交易开始退潮，导致信用紧缩和新兴经济体的市场动荡。
en: In the United States, the Federal Reserve hinted at “tapering” its quantitative-easing policy later in the year, and a kind of global carry trade based on monetary conditions in advanced countries started to unwind as a result, causing credit tightening and market turbulence in emerging economies.

zh: 这可能只是一个前奏，随着美国、欧洲和现在的日本退出危机后才去的提振增长模式，复杂性将大大增加。
en: This is probably only a preview of the complexity of the exit from the post-crisis assisted-growth model that has prevailed in the US, Europe, and now Japan.

zh: 9月，美国可能还将迎来预算和债务上限问题上的政治僵局，这让未来前景更加令人迷茫了。
en: A possible political impasse in the US in September over the budget and debt ceiling complicates the outlook further.

zh: 不过，目前的不少不确定性将会减弱。
en: And yet much of the current uncertainty is set to dissipate.

zh: 在未来几个月中，在全球经济中起着系统性关键作用部分的一系列政策决策（或不采取它们）将依次宣布，这将对增长率、资产价格和总体信心产生重大影响。
en: In the coming months, highly consequential policy decisions (or their absence) in systemically critical parts of the global economy will be revealed, with significant effects on growth rates, asset prices, and overall confidence.

zh: 首先，中国新领导层将退出大规模财政和货币刺激，接受经济减速、押注于结构性变革、系统性改革和可持续长期增长。
en: For starters, China’s new leadership has moved away from outsize fiscal and monetary stimulus and accepted an economic slowdown, betting on structural change, systemic reform, and sustainable longer-term growth.

zh: 重要信号将在初秋的中共十八大三中全会上出现。
en: The key signals will come from the Chinese Communist Party’s plenary meeting in the early fall.

zh: 中国的改革要么将支持经济转型、提振信心并提高增长预期，要么将令人失望，将主要注意力集中于国家干预市场的规模和性质上。
en: China’s reforms will either support the economic shift, boosting sentiment and lifting growth forecasts, or they will fall short and disappoint, with attention most likely to be focused on the size and nature of state intervention in markets.

zh: 无论如何，作为未来全球经济的主要增长引擎，其影响将是全球性的。
en: Either way, with the future of the global economy’s principal growth engine at stake, the effects will be felt worldwide.

zh: 在美国，经济去杠杆化进程远比欧洲深入。
en: In the US, economic deleveraging has proceeded significantly further than it has in Europe.

zh: 美国在经历结构性调整，真实（经通胀调整的）GDP处于正增长（尽管显著低于3—3.5%的潜在年增长率 ） 。
en: The US is adjusting structurally and generating real (inflation-adjusted) GDP growth (though well below its potential annual rate of 3-3.5%).

zh: 可贸易部门正在扩张，不需要依赖杠杆就能提振总需求。
en: The tradable sector is expanding and is not dependent on leverage to generate aggregate demand.

zh: 你可以把美国经济想象成8缸发动机，但由于去杠杆化尚未完成、财政整合和拖累、公共部门投资不足以及对中产阶级家庭（总内需的支柱）财务健康和安全的担忧，只有5个缸在转动。
en: One can think of the US economy as an 8-cylinder engine running on five, owing to residual deleveraging, fiscal consolidation and drag, public-sector investment shortfalls, and questions about the financial health and security of middle-income households (the backbone of domestic aggregate demand).

zh: 兼职就业情况在扩大，或将成为劳动力市场的新常态。
en: Part-time employment is spreading and may become the labor market’s new normal.

zh: 还有对美联储提振增长模式的疑问。
en: Then there is the question of the Fed’s assisted-growth model.

zh: 美国经济已经做好了在没有非常规政策支持的情况下增长的准备了吗？
en: Is the US economy ready to grow without abnormal policy support?

zh: 很显然，在今年下半年减弱美联储长期证券月度购买量将导致金融市场资产价值重估。
en: It seems clear that tapering the Fed’s monthly purchases of long-term securities later this year would cause a realignment of asset values in financial markets.

zh: 这将如何影响实体经济则是另一大不确定性。
en: How this spills over into the real economy is yet another source of uncertainty.

zh: 但是，尽管出现了一些过渡期的市场动荡，但总体影响或将是积极的。
en: But, despite some transitional market turbulence, the overall effect will likely be positive.

zh: 风险回归选择给投资者/储蓄者（包括退休基金）带来的好处将超过债务成本；事实上，可贸易部门的重要次级增长引擎并不依赖于低成本债务。
en: The beneficial effect on the risk-return options available to investors/savers (including pension funds) will outweigh the higher cost of debt; indeed, an important subset of growth engines in the tradable sector is not dependent on low-cost debt.

zh: 但欧洲并非如此，9月的德国大选被视为维持欧元承诺的关键晴雨表。
en: The same cannot be said of Europe, where Germany’s general election in September is viewed as a key barometer of continuing commitment to the euro.

zh: 欧洲央行的“直接货币交易 ” （ OMT）计划 — — 尽管是有条件、以短期政府债务为限度，但到目前为止从未使用过 — — 似乎已经稳定了欧元区主权债务市场，尽管增长环境仍十分恶劣（低增长甚至零增长 ） 。
en: The European Central Bank’s “outright monetary transactions” program – though conditional, limited to short-term government debt, and so far unused – appears to have stabilized eurozone sovereign-debt markets, albeit in a low- or zero-growth environment.

zh: 但OMT计划依赖德国的支持。
en: But the OMT program is dependent on German support.

zh: 问题是在南欧增长和就业挑战下（以及决策者和公众显然不能理解没有短期解决方案）德国的支持会延续多久。
en: The question is how long this can last, given southern Europe’s growth and employment challenges (and an apparent lack of understanding among policymakers and the public that there are no short-term solutions).

zh: 在意大利，争论的焦点是税收，特别是微不足道的物业税。
en: In Italy, the debate centers on taxes in general, and the rather miniscule property tax in particular.

zh: 所得税（以及就业税）很高。
en: The income tax (and thus the tax on employment) is high.

zh: 但意大利相对较富，特别是以家庭资产负债表上的物业资产衡量的话。
en: But the country is relatively wealthy, especially in terms of property assets on household balance sheets.

zh: 因此提高物业税、降低所得税有助于创造更有活力、更具竞争力的经济。
en: So higher taxes on property and lower taxes on income would contribute to the creation of a more dynamic, competitive economy.

zh: 但这远没有进入当前公共争论的焦点。
en: But that is far from the current focus of public debate.

zh: 能增强经济灵活性、加快调整速度的关键的自由化改革并没有出现在日程中（因为选民对此缺乏信任 ） 。
en: The key liberalizing reforms that would enhance the economy’s flexibility and pace of adjustment are simply not on the agenda (owing to an underlying lack of trust among voters).

zh: 这一点很重要，因为意大利（和西班牙）的私人部门没有像美国（以及2003—2006年改革后的德国）那样的结构性灵活度。
en: This is important because the private sector in Italy (and in Spain) cannot match the structural flexibility found in the US (and in Germany since its reforms in 2003-2006).

zh: 它们就好像是8缸发动机，现在转动不是5个缸，而只有两三个缸。
en: Think now of an 8-cylinder engine running not on five cylinders, but on two or three at best.

zh: （平心而论，今年上半年开始实施的西班牙劳动力市场改革或已开始提振就业、改善经济的可贸易部门的增长 — — 它主要约束是生产率过低，而不是需求不足。 ）
en: (Admittedly, the Spanish labor market reforms enacted earlier this year may start to lift employment and improve competitiveness and growth on the economy’s tradable side, which is constrained largely by low productivity, not weak demand.)

zh: 但在政治僵局环境下的默认选择 — — 徘徊不前的低增长战略，过度强调财政紧缩，并以高失业（特别是年轻人失业）为特征 — — 不可能长期有效。
en: But the default option in the context of political gridlock – a halting, slow-growth strategy, focused excessively on fiscal austerity and featuring high unemployment (especially for the young) – is unlikely to remain workable for long.

zh: 在某个时点，要么政治日程转向真正的改革，要么情绪转向严重反对欧元。
en: At some point, the political agenda will either shift toward real reform, or sentiment will shift substantially against the euro.

zh: 幸运的是，这一令人不快的不确定性不会维持太久 — — 不管在欧洲还是在别的地方。
en: Fortunately, this uncomfortable uncertainty will not last much longer – in Europe or elsewhere.

zh: 中国领导人将作出选择，德国选民亦然。
en: China’s leaders will make their choices, as will German voters.

zh: 美联储将明确美国货币政策的方向。
en: The Fed will clarify the direction of US monetary policy.

zh: 市场会调整然后平静下来。
en: Markets will adjust and settle down.

zh: 扭曲将开始消退。
en: Distortions will begin to unwind.

zh: 下行风险未除，但我继续对全球经济前景保持谨慎乐观。
en: Without dismissing the downside risks, I remain cautiously optimistic about the global economy’s prospects.

zh: 中国和美国的政策将日益清晰，这两个经济体应该都能获得动力。
en: With greater clarity in terms of Chinese and US policy, both economies should gain momentum.

zh: 这将给发展中国家（其中不少面临困难的国内政策选择）助一臂之力，同时也让欧洲和日本面临的棘手挑战更易解决。
en: That will give developing countries (many of which face difficult domestic policy choices) a tailwind, while making the substantial challenges in Europe and Japan easier to address.

zh: “全民健康”四十年
en: “Health for All” Forty Years On

zh: 日内瓦—四十年前的上个月，134个国家的数千名代表齐聚哈萨克斯坦（当时还是苏联的一部分 ） ， 接受了阿拉木图宣言。
en: GENEVA – Forty years ago last month, thousands of delegates from 134 countries gathered in Kazakhstan, then a part of the former Soviet Union, to adopt the Declaration of Alma-Ata.

zh: 这是一份里程碑式的协定，世界承诺将致力于扩大卫生普及。 浓缩在短短三页纸上的原则一直对公共卫生领域起着深远影响。
en: This landmark agreement committed the world to expanding health access, and the principles it enshrined in a mere three pages continue to have a profound effect on the field of public health.

zh: 宣言经久不衰的吸引力源自其双重特征：它一半是应用科学福音，一半是政治宣言。
en: The declaration’s continuing appeal consists in its dual character: it is part gospel of applied science, part political manifesto.

zh: 它的关键内容包括加强卫生规划的社区领导；削弱现代医学的精英主义；以及解决社会不平等以增进健康结果。
en: Among its key messages are increasing community leadership in health planning; reducing elitism in modern medicine; and tackling social inequality for better health outcomes.

zh: 宣言的核心贡献是它提出了“全民健康 ” ， 即“全民医疗覆盖 ” （ UHC）的前身。
en: The declaration’s central contribution was its articulation of “health for all,” a precursor to universal health coverage (UHC).

zh: 考察UHC的基础思想的起源和演变能够对实现这一目标的未竟的斗争大有裨益。
en: Examining the origins and evolution of UHC’s founding doctrine could prove useful in the ongoing struggle to achieve it.

zh: 1978年的今天的最大不同之一是卫生脆弱性（health vulnerabilities）的广度。
en: One of the biggest differences between 1978 and today is the breadth of health vulnerabilities.

zh: 气候变化和饮食改变成为带来了新的风险类型，而财富不平等和政治排斥深化了脆弱性。
en: Climate change and shifting diets have created new risk categories, while wealth inequalities and political exclusion have produced deeper pockets of vulnerability.

zh: 以移民问题为例。 这一由来已久的现象的政治化造成了严重的公共卫生后果。
en: Consider, for example, the issue of migration: the politicization of this age-old phenomenon has serious public-health consequences.

zh: 卫生市场也发生了很大变化。
en: Health markets have also changed dramatically.

zh: 今天，缺乏监管的私营医疗部门在亚洲、拉丁美洲和非洲的许多国家起着主导作用。
en: Today, poorly-regulated private health-care sectors predominate in many countries in Asia, Latin America, and Africa.

zh: 医疗市场的扩大增加了患者的选择，但个人债务也水涨船高。
en: While the expansion of health-care markets expands patient choice, personal debt is also increasing.

zh: 此外，食品、酒、烟草行业的商业利益破坏了人们的健康，也让遏制心脏病和糖尿病等非传染性疾病的形势变得更加复杂。
en: Moreover, commercial interests within the food, alcohol, and tobacco industries undermine people’s health and complicate efforts to curb the rise in noncommunicable illnesses like heart disease and diabetes.

zh: 遗憾的是，卫生规划的社区参与自1978年以来几乎没有变化。
en: Regrettably, community involvement in health planning has remained virtually unchanged since 1978.

zh: 尽管研究表明，当人们参与到卫生规划时，医疗服务会有所改善，但“参与式治理”在许多发展中国家并不常见。
en: Although research shows that services improve when people participate in health planning, “participatory governance” is not a common feature in many developing countries.

zh: 除了及少数例外 — — 巴西和泰国通常属于突出的例子 — — 以社区为中心的卫生体系十分罕见。
en: With few exceptions – Brazil and Thailand are often singled out – community-centered health systems remain rare.

zh: 阿拉木图宣言的持久遗产是一个共识：卫生只有通过好科学、可靠经济学和破除社会不公的行动相结合，才有可能得到改善。
en: The Declaration of Alma-Ata’s lasting legacy is the consensus that health can be improved only with a combination of good science, sound economics, and action against social injustices.

zh: 20世纪70年代是如此，今天也是如此。
en: This was true in the 1970s, and it is true today.

zh: 国际社会应该在宣言的周年纪念之际，重新致力于它所秉持的价值观。
en: The international community should mark the declaration’s anniversary by recommitting to the values it upholds.

zh: 阿拉木图宣言的三项内容值得特殊关注。
en: Three of Alma-Ata’s messages merit special attention.

zh: 首先，为了改善健康，领导者需要做更多事情建设医院、训练医生；他们还必须保护环境，确保人们能够获得清洁水和公共卫生设施，促进性别平等，创造就业机会，强化基础设施。
en: First, to improve health, leaders need to do more than build clinics and train physicians; they must also protect the environment, ensure access to clean water and sanitation, promote gender equality, create jobs, and strengthen infrastructure.

zh: 尽管这些目标都写入了联合国可持续发展目标（SDG ） ， 但必须更加认真地致力于阿拉木图宣言所提出的全面方针。
en: Although these objectives are incorporated in the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), there needs to be more serious commitment to the holistic approach advocated by the Declaration of Alma-Ata.

zh: 其次，需要做更多事情促进阿拉木图宣言所提出的兼顾实践和伦理问题的跨学科卫生科学。
en: Second, more needs to be done to promote interdisciplinary health sciences that address both the practical and ethical questions posed by Alma Ata.

zh: 重申这一原则的一个机会将在本月到来，即全世界2,000家相关利益方参加的利物浦第五届全球卫生系统研究研讨会。
en: One opportunity to reaffirm this principle will come this month, when some 2,000 stakeholders from around the world gather in Liverpool for the Fifth Global Symposium on Health Systems Research.

zh: 政府决策者、公民社会、媒体和资助人对全民健康事业的参与是强化卫生系统的关键。
en: Engaging government policymakers, civil society, the media, and funders on the message of Health for All will be crucial to strengthening health systems.

zh: 最后，如宣言所描述的，国际卫生组织和捐助人开始了战略再定向，赋能本地的国家层面领导者。
en: Finally, just as the declaration prescribed, international health organizations and donors are beginning to reorient their strategies to empower leaders at the local and national levels.

zh: 尽管还有改进空间，但女性和发展中国家公民出任全球组织重要职位的情况比以前更多了。
en: While there is still room for improvement, more women and citizens of developing countries occupy prominent positions in global organizations than before.

zh: 世界尚未实现1978年所提出的理想。
en: The world has yet to achieve the ideals announced in 1978.

zh: 但我们正走在正确的方向上。
en: But we are moving in the right direction.

zh: 真正的变化贴近于老百姓，而不仅仅在全球权力中心。
en: True change takes place close to common people, and not just in centers of global power.

zh: 它能够贯穿更多代表性公共机构，更多相关科学，更多社会行动。
en: It can come through more representative public institutions, more relevant science, or more social action.

zh: 在所有这些领域，阿拉木图宣言都毫无疑问将是不断的灵感来源。
en: In all of these areas, the Declaration of Alma-Ata will no doubt be a source of continued inspiration.

zh: 人民币的撤退
en: The Retreat of the Renminbi

zh: 纽约 — “ 人民币国际化看上去是无情而不可阻挡的 ， ” 《经济学人》在2014年4月如是说。
en: NEW YORK – “The globalization of the yuan seems remorseless and unstoppable,” pronounced The Economist in April 2014.

zh: 事实上，人民币在全球支付的使用量在2014年4月到2015年8月间翻了一番，达到了总量的2.8 % ， 成为全世界使用量第四多的货币。
en: Indeed, use of the Chinese yuan, or renminbi (RMB), in global payments would double between then and August 2015, to 2.8% of the total, making China’s currency the fourth most used in the world.

zh: 但是，此后这一增长趋势几乎完全逆转。
en: Since then, however, this growth has been almost entirely reversed.

zh: 人民币在全球支付中的占比已经下降到1.6 % ， 名次也下跌到第七。
en: The RMB’s share in global payments has fallen to 1.6%, knocking it down to number seven.

zh: 其在全球债券市场的使用较2015年峰值下降了45 % 。
en: Its use in global bond markets is down 45% from its 2015 peak.

zh: 香港银行的人民币存款几乎腰斩。
en: RMB deposits in Hong Kong banks are also down by half.

zh: 2015年中国跨境贸易中有35%为人民币结算（其余大部分为美元结算 ） ， 而今天这一比例下降到12%左右。
en: And whereas 35% of China’s cross-border trade was settled in RMB in 2015 (with most of the remainder in dollars), that share has fallen to about 12% today.

zh: 人民币形势的反转主要反映了四个因素。
en: The RMB’s reversal of fortune reflects four factors in particular.

zh: 首先，尽管人民币美元价值在2005—2013年之间几乎连年上涨 — — 总涨幅36.7 % — —但此后开始稳步下跌，令投机者望而却步。
en: For starters, whereas the dollar value of the RMB rose nearly every year from 2005 to 2013 – by 36.7% in total – it has since fallen steadily, discouraging speculators.

zh: 2014年以来，人民币汇率贬值幅度逐年扩大，目前以累计贬值11 % ， 尽管中国人民银行通过干预支持人民币（而不是像美国总统特朗普指责的那样要让它贬值 ） 。
en: Since 2014, the exchange rate has weakened by an increasing amount every year, and is now down over 11% since the drop began, despite intervention by the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) to support the currency (not to hold it down, as US President Donald Trump has alleged).

zh: 结果，投资者已经不再认定人民币单边升值的趋势。
en: As a result, investors have abandoned the idea that RMB appreciation is a one-way bet.

zh: 由此导致的资本流入也难以为继。
en: Capital inflows driven by that bet are over.

zh: 人民币对美元贬值反映了中国债务驱动的经济增长的减速和违约风险的增加。
en: The RMB’s fall against the dollar reflects the slowing of China’s debt-fueled economic growth and the accumulation of default risks.

zh: 毫不奇怪，中国居民和公司都在寻找新办法（合法或非法）将钱转移到国外。
en: Chinese residents and companies are, not surprisingly, seeking new ways (legal and otherwise) to move money out of the country.

zh: 4月份，中国人民银行副行长易纲试图安抚紧张的投资者，他在纽约的一次演讲中说，中国银行业不良贷款“在经过一段较长时间的攀升后 … … 已经大体稳定了下来 ， ” 他说 ， “ 这是金融市场上一个好的势头。
en: In April, PBOC Deputy Governor Yi Gang tried to reassure nervous investors in a presentation in New York by saying that the level of non-performing loans (NPLs) in the Chinese banking sector had “pretty much stabilized after a long time of climbing.” This was, he said, “a good development in the financial market.”

zh: 但易纲是在“打太极拳 ” 。
en: But Yi was spinning.

zh: 不良贷款占银行总贷款之比是稳定下来了，但这只是因为贷款总量在不断攀升。
en: NPLs have stabilized as a percentage of total bank loans, but only because the number of loans has continued to rise.

zh: 这些新贷款中有很多给了根本不具有偿还能力的客户，到期时肯定会成为坏账。
en: Many of these new loans are to deadbeat clients, and can be expected to go sour in due course.

zh: 事实上，从绝对值看，2016年不良贷款增加了350亿美元，达到了2,200亿美元。
en: In fact, in absolute terms, NPLs grew by $35 billion in 2016, reaching $220 billion.

zh: 银行还是用会计手段隐瞒了数万亿美元的进一步风险暴露。
en: Banks are also using accounting tricks to hide trillions in further exposures.

zh: 为了阻止汇率贬值，当局收紧了人民币与美元的兑换。
en: In an effort to stem the weakening of the exchange rate, the authorities have made it more difficult to convert RMB to dollars.

zh: 此前，中国当局对于中国海外投资是支持的，现在他们开始阻挠出境并购，阻止国内公司输出资本。
en: Having previously supported Chinese investment abroad, they are now blocking outbound mergers and acquisitions to keep domestic companies from exporting capital.

zh: 它们同时也提高了投资者撤回资本的难度。
en: They have simultaneously made capital repatriation more difficult for foreign investors.

zh: 这有助于将现有资本留在中国，但也让外国人不敢加大投资。
en: While this helps keep existing capital in China, it is also discouraging foreigners from committing more.

zh: 这就是阻止人民币升值的第二个因素。
en: This is the second factor discouraging accumulation of the Chinese currency.

zh: 面临短期经济稳定和货币弹性之间的选择，中国决策者选择了稳定。
en: Faced with the choice between short-term economic stability and currency flexibility, Chinese policymakers are choosing stability.

zh: 这让人们质疑他们对完全可兑换性的长期承诺，而完全可兑换性是人民币赢得真正的储备货币地位的重要一步。
en: This raises questions about their long-term commitment to full convertibility, an important step for the RMB to reach genuine reserve-currency status.

zh: 第三个拖累人民币的因素是中国的出口潜力正在耗尽。
en: The third factor undermining the RMB is that China has exhausted its export potential.

zh: 中国和人民币之所以地位日益显著，原因在于中国自2001年被世贸组织接受以来令人瞩目地融入到全球经济当中。
en: The country and its currency have gained prominence because of China’s extraordinary integration into the global economy since its admission into the World Trade Organization in 2001.

zh: 中国站全球出口之比从1980年的1%增加到2015年的14 % ， 一跃成为世界第一大出口国。
en: China’s share of world exports grew from 1% in 1980 to 14% in 2015, making it the world’s largest exporter.

zh: 但此后其占全球出口之比下降到13.3 % 。
en: But its share of global exports has since fallen, to 13.3%.

zh: 那些将中国视为Amazon.com的国家版、每年都能向更多的人卖出更多东西的人士深感失望。
en: Those who saw China as the national equivalent of Amazon.com, selling more to more people year on year, have been disappointed.

zh: 第四个因素是全球化形势本身的反转。
en: The fourth factor is the reversal of globalization itself.

zh: 资本流 — — 用股票和债券购买量、外国直接投资和贷款衡量 — — 在2007年至2015年间下降了三分之二，从11.9万亿美元减少到3.3万亿美元。
en: Capital flows – in the form of equity and bond purchases, foreign direct investment, and lending – fell by over two thirds, from $11.9 trillion to $3.3 trillion, between 2007 and 2015.

zh: 贸易壁垒越来越高。
en: Trade barriers are up.

zh: 歧视性措施比自由化政策扩张更快。
en: Discriminatory measures are spreading faster than liberalizing policies.

zh: 商贸也在下降，在2011年到2015年间收缩了10 % ， 为第二次世界大战以来收缩幅度最大的四年。
en: Merchandise trade is falling, too, contracting 10% between 2011 and 2015, which was the largest drop over any four-year period since World War II.

zh: 中国也因此不但出口市场占比有所下降，其面临的全球总时长规模也在缩小。
en: China is therefore not only losing export-market share, but is doing so in a shrinking global market.

zh: 结果是中国出口的美元价值较其2015年初的峰值下降了9.1 % 。
en: As a consequence, the dollar value of China’s exports has fallen by 9.1% since its peak in early 2015.

zh: 其净结果是，与几年前相比，世界没有什么理由应该继续囤积人民币。
en: The net result is that, compared to just a few years ago, the world has little, if any, reason to continue accumulating RMB.

zh: 人民币的国际化不再是“无情而不可阻挡的 ” 。
en: The globalization of the RMB is no longer “remorseless and unstoppable.”

zh: 相反，看起来在可预见的未来，人民币的国际化已经真正式微了。
en: On the contrary, it appears, for the foreseeable future, to be well and truly over.

zh: 俄国从回忆到否认
en: From Memory to Denial in Russia

zh: 伦敦 — — 我在俄罗斯最痛苦的经历是1998年参观斯大林时期唯一保存下来的“柏姆36号”强制劳改营。
en: LONDON – My most painful experience in Russia was a visit to Perm-36, the only one of Stalin’s forced-labor camps to have been preserved, in 1998.

zh: 当时我在乌拉尔山区小城柏姆参加莫斯科政治研究学院组织的一次研讨活动。
en: I was in Perm, a city in the Urals, to take part in a seminar of the Moscow School of Political Studies.

zh: 学院的创建者是著名的列娜·内米洛夫斯卡娅，创建的目的是引导后共产主义时期的俄罗斯年轻人认识民主、自治和资本主义。
en: Founded by the remarkable Lena Nemirovskaya, the school’s purpose was to introduce young post-communist Russians to democracy, self-government, and capitalism.

zh: 一个寒冷的三月天，我和几个朋友一道前往劳改营。
en: One bitterly cold March day, I joined a few friends on a trip to the former camp.

zh: 20世纪40年代初建时还是“常规”劳改营的柏姆36号于1972年被改建为关押政治犯的集中营。
en: Built in the early 1940s as a “regular” labor camp, Perm-36 was converted into a concentration camp for political prisoners in 1972.

zh: 1987年，即戈尔巴乔夫执政三年后释放了最后一名政治犯。
en: The last prisoners were released in 1987, three years into Mikhail Gorbachev’s rule.

zh: 现在持不同政见的物理学家安德烈·萨哈罗夫创立的人权组织“纪念”将其改建为警醒俄国人勿忘极权主义过去的古拉格博物馆。
en: Now it was being restored as a Gulag Museum by Memorial, a human-rights group founded by the dissident physicist Andrei Sakharov, to remind Russians of their totalitarian past.

zh: 我们在引导下参观了安全级别最高的监区。
en: We were shown around the maximum-security wing.

zh: 这个监区周围环绕着带刺的铁丝网，当时主要关押俄罗斯以外苏维埃共和国被视为“特别危险惯犯”的政治犯。
en: Surrounded by a barbed-wire perimeter, it had housed the political prisoners, mostly from the non-Russian Soviet republics, who were considered to be “particularly dangerous recidivists.”

zh: 乌克兰电视摄制组1989年拍摄这座监狱后，部分区域遭到了故意破坏。
en: After a Ukrainian television crew filmed the site in 1989, part of it was deliberately destroyed.

zh: 这里关押的囚犯显然遭受到极度物质困难和心理折磨。
en: It was obvious that the prisoners had been subject to psychological torture and extreme physical hardship.

zh: 每间囚室中小得可怜的暖气很难抵挡住十月到四月的严寒。
en: The tiny radiator in each cell could hardly have dented the October-to-April frost.

zh: 囚犯睡在木质或铁质的床铺上。
en: The prisoners slept on wooden planks or iron bunks.

zh: 他们的衣服和被褥用的不是羊毛而是棉花，监室的厕所就是一个敞开的孔。
en: Their clothes and bedcovers were made of cotton, not wool, and an open hole served as the cell’s lavatory.

zh: 我们的导游玛雅解释说当局喜欢让囚犯刺激对方的神经。
en: Our guide, Maya, explained that the authorities liked to put together prisoners who got on each other’s nerves.

zh: 白天他们穿过走廊到一模一样的监室从事制作铁器等毫无意义的活动。
en: During the day, they were moved across the corridor to identical cells in which they uselessly worked making iron implements.

zh: 每天有1个小时时间他们被允许进入“锻炼区 ” ， 一个9英尺（合2.7米）的方形盒子，周围衬有马口铁，头顶是带刺的铁丝网和哨兵的岗亭。
en: For one hour each day, they were allowed into an “exercise block,” a nine-foot (2.7 meters), tin-lined cube, with a barbed-wire roof and a guard post on top.

zh: 除此之外唯一的娱乐就是每周放映宣传电影。
en: The only other “recreation” was a weekly show of propaganda films.

zh: 20世纪80年代柏姆36号关押的56名“危险惯犯”中死亡7人。
en: Of the 56 “dangerous recidivists” held in Perm-36 in the 1980s, seven died.

zh: 其中一位是乌克兰诗人兼民族主义者瓦西里·斯塔茨（Vasyl Stus ） 。
en: One was the Ukrainian poet and nationalist Vasyl Stus.

zh: 当局说他是自杀，但幸存者说是警卫为了取乐拧开了墙上的木板，斯塔茨在熟睡时被木板砸到了头。
en: The authorities called it a suicide, but survivors say that, for fun, the guards unscrewed one of the wooden planks from the wall and dropped it on Stus’s head as he lay sleeping.

zh: 我边听玛雅讲述这个可怕的故事，边看身边陪同的两名年轻男警卫的表情。
en: As Maya recounted the grisly story, I watched the faces of the two young male guards who accompanied us.

zh: 他们的脸就像外面冰封的大地一样毫无表情。
en: Their expressions were as frozen as the ground outside.

zh: 他们是在想足球还是和女朋友做爱？
en: Were they thinking about football or about making love to their girlfriends?

zh: 如果喝下足够的伏特加，他们是否也会杀人取乐？
en: Given enough vodka, would they, too, have been capable of murder for fun?

zh: 我担心答案是肯定的。
en: The answer, I fear, is probably yes.

zh: 邪恶的体制找到需要的僵尸追随者从来都不难。
en: Evil systems never seem to struggle to find the zombie henchmen they need.

zh: 像“纪念”和莫斯科政治研究学院这样的组织在普京领导的俄罗斯无法立足。
en: Organizations like Memorial and the Moscow School of Political Studies have no place in Vladimir Putin’s Russia.

zh: 官方认为他们是“外国代理 ” ， 他们在法律上受到诸多骚扰，以致于很难正常发挥作用。
en: Officially, they are deemed “foreign agents” and have been subject to so much legal harassment that it is almost impossible for them to function.

zh: 今天，古拉格博物馆更换了管理层。
en: Today, the Gulag Museum is under different management.

zh: “新的解说词 ” ， 米哈伊尔·丹尼洛维奇和罗伯特·卡尔森写道 ， “ 并未主要介绍斯大林时代压迫性的强制劳改做法，转而介绍这里的木材生产以及对二战苏联胜利所起到的作用。
en: “The new presentation,” write Mikhail Danilovich and Robert Coalson, “is devoted not to the repressive forced-labor practices of the Stalin era but to the timber production at the plant and to its contribution to the Soviet victory in World War II.”

zh: ”而且，20年后，莫斯科政治研究学院已被迫中止在俄国运营。
en: And, after 20 years, the Moscow School of Political Studies has been forced to suspend its Russian operations.

zh: 博物馆和学院的命运是普京第三届总统任期大规模取缔言论和行动自由的组成部分。
en: The fate of the museum and the school is part of the wider clampdown on freedom of expression and behavior in Putin’s third presidential term.

zh: 在当局领导的宗教、传统和偏执言论中，持不同政见者往往被贴上离经叛道、内奸和叛徒的标签。
en: Dissidents are routinely dubbed deviants, fifth columnists, and traitors, as the regime leads a drive for national unity based on religion, tradition, and paranoid rhetoric.

zh: 这预示着俄国较之后苏联时代早期发生了重大变化。
en: This represents a major shift from Russia’s early post-Soviet days.

zh: 俄国首位民主总理盖达尔领导的自由俄罗斯选择党在1993年大选中赢得了15.5%的选票，并和盟友一道成为杜马的主要力量。
en: The liberal Russia’s Choice party, led by the country’s first democratic prime minister, Yegor Gaidar, received 15.5% of the vote in the 1993 general election, and with its allies formed the largest bloc in the Duma.

zh: 当时舆论普遍认为这是一次灾难性的失败。
en: At the time, this was regarded as a catastrophic failure.

zh: 而今天，自由派候选人甚至无法进入到国家杜马当中。
en: Today, liberal candidates cannot even get into the Duma.

zh: 怎么会变成这样？
en: How has this come to pass?

zh: 戈尔巴乔夫公开化的希望怎么会遭到如此残酷的扼杀？
en: Why have the hopes of Gorbachev’s glasnost been so cruelly snuffed out?
