zh: 人们普遍认为俄罗斯仅仅是恢复原状：自由有史以来在俄国字母表中从来都不过是转瞬即逝的元音字母。
en: A widespread view is that Russia is simply reverting to type: freedom was never more than a fleeting vowel in its historical alphabet.

zh: 但这样的解释非常浅薄。
en: But this is a facile explanation.

zh: 的确，由于无能和派系林立，俄国自由主义自己走向了灭亡。
en: True, Russian liberalism has contributed to its own demise, by its incompetence and factionalism.

zh: 但西方也从未起到好的作用。
en: But the West did not help.

zh: 20世纪90年代，西方未能资助自己倡导的俄罗斯经济改革。
en: In the 1990s, it failed to put money behind the economic reforms that it sponsored.

zh: 2002年将波罗的海国家纳入北约 — — 也是该组织首次侵入前苏联领土 — — 是一次灾难性的错误，导致俄罗斯人不可能在亲西方的同时保持爱国。
en: Expanding NATO into the Baltic States in 2002 – the Alliance’s first enlargement into former Soviet territory – was a catastrophic mistake, which made it almost impossible for a Russian to be both patriotic and pro-Western.

zh: 西方这些故意和疏漏之举损害了俄罗斯政治自由主义的基础，导致普京主义日渐抬头。
en: By both omission and commission, the West cut the ground from under Russian political liberalism, enabling the ascendancy of Putinism.

zh: 迄今为止，普京准确无误地把握着限度。
en: So far, Putin has displayed an accurate sense of limits.

zh: 他让俄国人既保留伟大的梦想，又避免陷入到麻烦之中。
en: He allows Russians to dream of greatness without getting them into serious trouble.

zh: 在他领导下的俄国对制裁毫不理会， 与中国缔结新的联盟，并在叙利亚骚扰、而非公开挑战西方国家。
en: Under his leadership, Russia has shrugged off sanctions, forged a new alliance with China, and annoyed – but not openly challenged – the West in Syria.

zh: 但了解普京的人说他绝不容忍任何争论；他是限度的唯一把控者。
en: But those who know Putin say that he brooks no argument; he is the only one setting the limits.

zh: 没有人能像他那样持续掌握最高权力而不陷入腐化。
en: And no one can maintain supreme power for as long as he has without being corrupted.

zh: 迄今为止，没有其他势力能与普京主义竞争。
en: For the moment, Putinism is the only game in town.

zh: 但尽管“纪念”组织和莫斯科政治研究学院所代表的力量已经被边缘化，但它们并未被完全根除。
en: But, although the forces represented by Memorial and the Moscow School of Political Studies have been marginalized, they have not been eradicated.

zh: 新宏观经济战略
en: A New Macroeconomic Strategy

zh: 纽约—我是宏观经济学家，但我不同意美国最主要的两个宏观经济学阵营：专注于提振总需求的新凯恩斯主义和专注于减税的供给学派。
en: NEW YORK – I am a macroeconomist, but I dissent from the profession’s two leading camps in the United States: the neo-Keynesians, who focus on boosting aggregate demand, and the supply-siders, who focus on cutting taxes.

zh: 近几年来，这两个学派试图克服高收入经济体表现持续疲软的问题，但以失败告终。
en: Both schools have tried and failed to overcome the high-income economies’ persistently weak performance in recent years.

zh: 基于可持续投资拉动型增长的新战略是时候粉墨登场了。
en: It is time for a new strategy, one based on sustainable, investment-led growth.

zh: 宏观经济学的核心挑战是配置社会资源，加以最佳利用。
en: The core challenge of macroeconomics is to allocate society’s resources to their best use.

zh: 选择工作的工人应该找到岗位；工厂应该有效部署其资本；用作储蓄而非消费的收入应该投资以改善未来福祉。
en: Workers who choose to work should find jobs; factories should deploy their capital efficiently; and the part of income that is saved rather than consumed should be invested to improve future wellbeing.

zh: 新凯恩斯主义和供给学派就栽在第三个挑战上。
en: It is on this third challenge that both neo-Keynesians and supply-siders have dropped the ball.

zh: 大部分高收入国家 — — 美国、欧洲大部和日本 — — 投资不足，或没有明智地以未来最佳用途为目标投资。
en: Most high-income countries – the US, most of Europe, and Japan – are failing to invest adequately or wisely toward future best uses.

zh: 投资有两种 — — 国内和国际 — — 对世界而言，这两种投资都有所不足。
en: There are two ways to invest – domestically or internationally – and the world is falling short on both.

zh: 国内投资形式繁多，包括机械和建筑的商业投资、家庭住房投资以及政府对人力（教育、技能 ） 、 知识（研究和开发）和基础设施（交通、电力、水和气候恢复力）的投资。
en: Domestic investment comes in various forms, including business investment in machinery and buildings; household investment in homes; and government investment in people (education, skills), knowledge (research and development), and infrastructure (transport, power, water, and climate resilience).

zh: 新凯恩斯主义方法试图提振国内投资，不管属是哪一类的投资。
en: The neo-Keynesian approach is to try to boost domestic investment of any sort.

zh: 事实上，根据这一观点，支出就是支出。
en: Indeed, according to this view, spending is spending.

zh: 因此，新凯恩斯主义者试图通过极低的利率刺激更多住房投资，通过消费贷款证券化刺激更多的购车行为，试图通过短期刺激计划带来更多的“万事俱备”基础设施工程。
en: Thus, neo-Keynesians have tried to spur more housing investment through rock-bottom interest rates, more auto purchases through securitized consumer loans, and more “shovel-ready” infrastructure projects through short-term stimulus programs.

zh: 当投资支出停滞不前时，他们建议将“过剩”转化为又一场消费盛宴。
en: When investment spending does not budge, they recommend that we turn “excess” saving into another consumption binge.

zh: 相反，供给学派希望通过更多减税和进一步去监管化促进私人（绝不是公共！
en: Supply-siders, by contrast, want to promote private (certainly not public!) investment through more tax cuts and further deregulation.

zh: ）投资。 他们在美国做过几次尝试，最近的例子是小布什政府。
en: They have tried that on several occasions in the US, most recently during the George W. Bush administration.

zh: 不幸的是，去监管化的结果是短命的房地产泡沫，而不是生产性私人投资的持续繁荣。
en: Unfortunately, the result of this deregulation was a short-lived housing bubble, not a sustained boom in productive private investment.

zh: 尽管政策在供给学派和新凯恩斯主义狂热之间摇摆，但一个持久的现实是近几年来大部分高收入国家投资占国民收入的比重大幅下降。
en: Though policy alternates between supply-side and neo-Keynesian enthusiasm, the one persistent reality is a significant decline of investment as a share of national income in most high-income countries in recent years.

zh: 根据IMF的数据，这些国家的总投资支出占GDP之比从1990年的24.9%下降到2013年的20 % 。
en: According to IMF data, gross investment spending in these countries has declined from 24.9% of GDP in 1990 to just 20% in 2013.

zh: 在美国，投资支出从1990年占GDP的23.6%下降到2013年的19.3 % ， 若以净值（剔除资本折旧的总投资）衡量，则降幅更加巨大。
en: In the US, investment spending declined from 23.6% of GDP in 1990 to 19.3% in 2013, and fell even more markedly in net terms (gross investment excluding capital depreciation).

zh: 在欧盟，投资占GDP之比从1990年的24%下降到2013年的18.1 % 。
en: In the European Union, the decline was from 24% of GDP in 1990 to 18.1% in 2013.

zh: 凯恩斯主义和供给学派都没有将注意力集中在这一投资支出持续下降趋势的真正解决办法上。
en: Neither neo-Keynesians nor supply-siders focus on the true remedies for this persistent drop in investment spending.

zh: 我们的社会急切地需要更多投资，特别是改变重污染、能源密集和高碳生产方式，转向基于自然资源的高效利用和低碳能源资源的可持续经济的投资。
en: Our societies urgently need more investment, particularly to convert heavily polluting, energy-intensive, and high-carbon production into sustainable economies based on the efficient use of natural resources and a shift to low-carbon energy sources.

zh: 这类投资需要公共和私人部门相互补充。
en: Such investments require complementary steps by the public and private sectors.

zh: 必要的投资包括大规模部署风能和太阳能、更大规模采取公共（公交车和火车）和私人（小轿车）电力交通、远距离传输可再生能源（如从北海和北非到欧洲大陆以及从加州莫哈韦沙漠（Mojave Desert到美国人口中心）的电网等。
en: The necessary investments include large-scale deployment of solar and wind power; broader adoption of electric transport, both public (buses and trains) and private (cars); energy-efficient buildings; and power grids to carry renewable energy across large distances (say, from the North Sea and North Africa to continental Europe, and from California’s Mojave Desert to US population centers).

zh: 但是，就在我们的社会应该进行这些投资时，美国和欧洲的公共部门却陷入了名符其实的“投资停顿 ” 。
en: But just when our societies should be making such investments, the public sectors in the US and Europe are on a veritable “investment strike.”

zh: 政府打着预算平衡的名号削减公共投资，而在公共监管的电网、责任规则、定价模式和国家能源政策存在不确定性巨大争议时，私人投资者也无法在替代能源领域进行稳健、安全的投资。
en: Governments are cutting back public investment in the name of budget balance, and private investors cannot invest robustly and securely in alternative energy when publicly regulated power grids, liability rules, pricing formulas, and national energy policies are uncertain and heavily disputed.

zh: 在美国，公共投资支出被大幅削减。
en: In the US, public investment spending has been slashed.

zh: 联邦政府和各州都没有政治权力、融资战略和长期规划推进下一代智能清洁技术投资。
en: Neither the federal government nor the states have political mandates, funding strategies, or long-term plans to catalyze investment in the next generation of smart, clean technologies.

zh: 新凯恩斯主义和供给学派都误解了投资困局。
en: Both neo-Keynesians and supply-siders have misunderstood the investment paralysis.

zh: 新凯恩斯主义者将公共和私人投资视为仅仅是总需求的一种。
en: Neo-Keynesians see investments, public and private, as merely another kind of aggregate demand.

zh: 他们忽视与能源系统和基础设施（如旨在推进新技术的定向研发，它们是打开环境可持续的明智的公共和私人投资支出局面的必要条件）有关的公用政策决定。
en: They neglect the public-policy decisions regarding energy systems and infrastructure (as well as the targeted R&D to promote new technologies) that are needed to unleash smart, environmentally sustainable public and private investment spending.

zh: 因此，他们总是弄出各种噱头（零利率和刺激计划 ） ， 而不敦促制定实施稳健投资复苏所需要的具体的国家政策。
en: Thus, they promote gimmicks (zero interest rates and stimulus packages), rather than pressing for the detailed national policies that a robust investment recovery will require.

zh: 至于供给学派，他们似乎完全忘记了私人投资需要公共投资和明晰的政策和监管框架加以补充。
en: The supply-siders, for their part, seem utterly oblivious to the dependence of private investment on complementary public investment and a clear policy and regulatory framework.

zh: 他们鼓吹削减政府支出，天真地认为私人部门能变戏法般地填补空白。
en: They advocate slashing government spending, naively believing that the private sector will somehow magically fill the void.

zh: 但是，他们的削减公共投资的做法拖累了私人投资。
en: But, by cutting public investment, they are hindering private investment.

zh: 比如，如果政府不拿出长期气候和能源政策或刺激建设长距离输电线从而将低碳能源资源引向人口中心的计划，私人发电商就不会投资于大规模可再生能源发电。
en: Private electricity producers, for example, will not invest in large-scale renewable energy generation if the government does not have long-term climate and energy policies or plans for spurring construction of long-distance transmission lines to carry new low-carbon energy sources to population centers.

zh: 混乱的政策细节令自由市场经济学家困扰不堪。
en: Such messy policy details have never much bothered free-market economists.

zh: 另一个选择是用国内储蓄提振外国投资。
en: There is also the option of using domestic saving to boost foreign investments.

zh: 比如，美国可以贷款给低收入非洲经济体从美国公司手中购买新电站。
en: The US could, for example, lend money to low-income African economies to buy new power plants from US companies.

zh: 这套计划能让美国私人储蓄派上重要用场，参与全球减贫斗争，同时还能增强美国的工业基础。
en: Such a policy would put US private saving to important use in fighting global poverty, while strengthening the US industrial base.

zh: 但是，在这方面，新凯恩斯主义和供给学派也都没有致力于改善发展金融机构。
en: Yet here, too, neither the neo-Keynesians nor the supply-siders have exerted much effort to improve the institutions of development finance.

zh: 宏观经济学家不应该建议日本和中国提高消费率，更聪明的做法是鼓励这些经济体利用其高储蓄为投资项目融资 — — 不仅包括国内投资，也包括海外投资。
en: Instead of advising Japan and China to raise their consumption rates, macroeconomists would be wiser to encourage these economies to use their high savings to fund not only domestic but also overseas investments.

zh: 这些考虑对于任何关心协调经济增长和环境可持续性问题的人来说都是显而易见的。
en: These considerations are reasonably clear to anyone concerned with the urgent need to harmonize economic growth and environmental sustainability.

zh: 我们这一代最紧迫的挑战是将全球肮脏的碳基能源系统和基础设施改造成清洁、智能、高效的二十一世纪系统。
en: Our generation’s most pressing challenge is to convert the world’s dirty and carbon-based energy systems and infrastructure into clean, smart, and efficient systems for the twenty-first century.

zh: 投资于可持续经济将极大地改善我们的福祉，有利于利用我们的“过度”储蓄为正确的目标服务。
en: Investing in a sustainable economy would dramatically boost our wellbeing and use our “excess” savings for just the right purposes.

zh: 但这不会从天上掉下来。
en: Yet this will not happen automatically.

zh: 我们需要长期公共投资战略、环境规划、技术路线图、新型可持续技术的公私合作以及更大的全球合作。
en: We need long-term public-investment strategies, environmental planning, technology roadmaps, public-private partnerships for new, sustainable technologies, and greater global cooperation.

zh: 这些工具将创造我们的健康和繁荣所依赖的新宏观经济学。
en: These tools will create the new macroeconomics on which our health and prosperity now depend.

zh: 被高估的美国衰落
en: America’s Overrated Decline

zh: 美国剑桥—随着美国国会选举的临近，关于美国政治制度健康及其全球领导力未来的争论日嚣尘上，一些人拿党派僵局作为美国衰落的证据。
en: CAMBRIDGE – With the approach of the US Congressional elections, questions about the health of America’s political institutions and the future of its global leadership have become rampant, with some citing partisan gridlock as evidence of America’s decline.

zh: 但情况真的这么糟糕吗？
en: But is the situation really that bad?

zh: 根据政治学家萨拉·宾德（Sarah Binder）的看法，自十九世纪末以来，美国两大政党的意识形态分歧从未向现在那么大。
en: According to the political scientist Sarah Binder, the ideological divide between America’s two main political parties has not been as large as it is now since the end of the nineteenth century.

zh: 但是，尽管面临着僵局，但第111届国会仍通过了大型财政刺激、医疗改革、金融监管、一项武器控制条约以及军队同性恋政策修改。
en: Despite the current gridlock, however, the 111th Congress managed to pass a major fiscal stimulus, health-care reform, financial regulation, an arms-control treaty, and revision of the military policy on homosexuality.

zh: 显然，美国政治制度不会衰亡（特别是在党派僵局具有周期性特征的情况下 ） 。
en: Clearly, the US political system cannot be written off (especially if partisan gridlock is cyclical).

zh: 尽管如此，今天的国会仍饱受立法能力不足的困扰。
en: Nonetheless, today’s Congress is plagued by low legislative capacity.

zh: 尽管意识形态一致性在过去二十年中增加了一倍，从占公众的10%升高到21 % ， 但大部分美国人并非一边倒的保守派或自由派，他们希望他们的代表保守和自由兼而有之。
en: Though ideological consistency has more than doubled over the last two decades, from 10% to 21% of the public, most Americans do not have uniformly conservative or liberal views, and want their representatives to meet one another halfway.

zh: 但是，政党的意识形态一致性自20世纪70年代以来就一直在增长。
en: Political parties, however, have become more consistently ideological since the 1970s.

zh: 这并不是美国的新问题，美国宪法的基础是十八世纪自由观 — — 控制权力最好的办法是分散化和对抗性制衡，迫使总统和国会为控制外交政策等领域而斗争。
en: This is not a new problem for the US, whose constitution is based on the eighteenth-century liberal view that power is best controlled by fragmentation and countervailing checks and balances, with the president and Congress forced to compete for control in areas like foreign policy.

zh: 换句话说，美国政府是以低效为目的设计的，这样做是为了确保它不会轻易威胁公民的自由。
en: In other words, the US government was designed to be inefficient, in order to ensure that it could not easily threaten the liberty of its citizens.

zh: 这一低效率或许是对美国制度信心下降的原因。
en: This inefficiency has likely contributed to the decline in confidence in American institutions.

zh: 如今，不到五分之一的公众相信联邦政府在大部分时间里做着正确的事，而1964年的这一比例为四分之三。
en: Today, less than one-fifth of the public trusts the federal government to do the right thing most of the time, compared to three-quarters in 1964.

zh: 当然，这些数字偶尔会在某个时期出现飙升，比如2001年9月11日恐怖袭击后就是如此；但总体而言下降趋势相当明显。
en: Of course, these figures surged occasionally during that period, such as after the September 11, 2001, terrorist attacks; but the overall decline is considerable.

zh: 联邦政府在这方面不是孤家寡人。
en: The federal government is not alone.

zh: 在过去几十年中，对许多高影响力机构的公众信心出现了暴降。
en: Over the last several decades, public confidence in many influential institutions has plummeted.

zh: 从1964年到1997年，信任大学的美国人比例从61%降低到30 % ， 而信任大公司的美国人比例从55%减少到21 % 。
en: From 1964-1997, the share of Americans who trusted universities fell from 61% to 30%, while trust in major companies fell from 55% to 21%.

zh: 信任医疗机构者从73%下降到29 % ， 信任新闻者从29%下降到14 % 。
en: Trust in medical institutions dropped from 73% to 29%, and in journalism from 29% to 14%.

zh: 在过去十��中，对教育机构和军队的信心有所恢复，但对华尔街和大公司的信任仍在继续下降。
en: Over the last decade, confidence in educational institutions and the military has recovered, but trust in Wall Street and large corporations has continued to fall.

zh: 但这些表面上引人警觉的数字可能具有误导性。
en: But these ostensibly alarming figures can be misleading.

zh: 事实上，82%的美国人仍然认为美国是世界上最适合生活的地方，90%的美国人喜欢政府的民主制度。
en: In fact, 82% of Americans still consider the US to be the world’s best place to live, and 90% like their democratic system of government.

zh: 美国人或许对他们的领导人不是完全满意，但这个国家显然没有走到阿拉伯之春这样的革命的边缘。
en: Americans may not be entirely satisfied with their leaders, but the country is certainly not on the brink of an Arab Spring-style revolution.

zh: 此外，尽管党派政治在近几十年来日益极化，但此趋势的起点是20世纪50年代至60年代初，当时，从大萧条中走出并在二战中获胜使得美国人对美国制度的信心空前高涨。
en: Moreover, though party politics have become more polarized in recent decades, this follows the 1950s and early 1960s, when the escape from the Great Depression and victory in World War II fueled unusually high confidence in US institutions.

zh: 事实上，对政府的公共信任的最剧烈降幅发生在20世纪60年代末到70年代初。
en: In fact, the sharpest decline in public trust in the government occurred in the late 1960s and early 1970s.

zh: 此外，对政府的信任的下降并未伴随着公民行为的重大变化。
en: Moreover, declining trust in the government has not been accompanied by significant changes in citizens’ behavior.

zh: 比如，美国国税署（Internal Revenue Service）是公众熊欣欣最低的政府机构之一；但偷漏税情况并没有出现剧烈增加。
en: For example, the Internal Revenue Service is among the government institutions that inspire the least public confidence; yet there has been no major surge in tax evasion.

zh: 从控制腐败的角度看，美国仍比九成的国家强。
en: In terms of controlling corruption, the US still scores in the 90th percentile.

zh: 而尽管二十世纪下半叶总统选举投票率从62%下降到50 % ， 但在2000年实现了企稳，并于2012年回升至58 % 。
en: And though voting rates in presidential elections declined from 62% to 50% in the latter half of the twentieth century, they stabilized in 2000, and rose to 58% in 2012.

zh: 美国人所表现出来的信心下降也许植根于人们对个人主义的态度的更深层次的变化。 对个人主义的态度的变化导致了对权威的顺从程度有所下降。
en: The loss of confidence that Americans have expressed may be rooted in a deeper shift in people’s attitudes toward individualism, which has brought about decreased deference to authority.

zh: 事实上，类似的过程是大部分后现代社会的特征。
en: Indeed, similar patterns are characteristic of most post-modern societies.

zh: 拜美国的分散化联邦制所赐，这一社会变迁可能不会如你所想象的那样影响美国制度的效率。
en: This social shift probably will not influence US institutions’ effectiveness as much as one might think, given America’s decentralized federal system.

zh: 事实上，华盛顿的僵局通常伴随着州和市政层面的政治合作和创新，让公民对州和地方政府 — — 以及许多政府机构 — — 刮目相看，给出远高于联邦政府的评价。
en: In fact, gridlock in the national capital is often accompanied by political cooperation and innovation at the state and municipal levels, leading citizens to view state and local governments, as well as many government agencies, much more favorably than the federal government.

zh: 这一治国之道对美国人民的心态具有深远影响。
en: This approach to governance has had a profound impact on the mentality of the American people.

zh: 一份2002年的研究指出，四分之三的美国人认为自己与社区息息相关，并认为自己的生活质量属于优良之列，近一半的成年人参与公民团体或活动。
en: A 2002 study indicated that three-quarters of Americans feel connected to their communities, and consider their quality of life to be excellent or good, with nearly half of adults participating in a civic group or activity.

zh: 对美国来说，这是好消息。
en: That is good news for the US.

zh: 但这并不意味着美国领导人可以继续无视美国政治制度的短处，如众议院通过不公正地划分选区而出现的“稳得议席”以及参议院臃肿碍事的流程。
en: But it does not mean that America’s leaders can continue to ignore the political system’s shortcomings, such as the gerrymandered “safe seats” in the House of Representatives and obstructive processes in the Senate.

zh: 这些形成僵局的原因是否能克服还有待观察。
en: Whether such sources of gridlock can be overcome remains to be seen.

zh: 此外，有充分的理由怀疑美国是否有能力维持其“超级大国”地位，因为主要新兴经济体正在崛起。
en: And there is legitimate reason to doubt America’s ability to maintain its “hyperpower” status, not least owing to the rise of major emerging economies.

zh: 但是，如保守派作家大卫·弗鲁姆（David Frum）所指出的，在过去二十年中，美国经历了犯罪率、交通事故数、酒精和烟草消费以及二氧化硫和一氧化氮（它们会造成酸雨）排放的快速下降 — — 还引领了一场互联网革命。
en: But, as the conservative author David Frum notes, over the last two decades, the US has experienced a swift decline in crime, auto fatalities, alcohol and tobacco consumption, and emissions of sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxide, which cause acid rain – all while leading an Internet revolution.

zh: 基于此，将美国与（比如）罗马帝国的衰亡相提并论完全是无稽之谈。
en: Given this, dire comparisons to, say, the decline of Rome are simply unwarranted.

zh: 诽谤和阿拉伯世界的发展
en: Defamation and Development in the Arab World

zh: 阿曼—中东和北非的暴力激进主义和内战吸引着全世界的目光，而该地区极度扭曲的司法体系则基本无人关注。
en: AMMAN – With the violent radicalism and civil wars of the Middle East and North Africa capturing the world’s attention, the region’s grossly distorted legal systems are being given short shrift.

zh: 但有问题的法律，比如便利政治和经济压迫的诽谤罪，破坏了发展，贻害生命。
en: Yet problematic laws, like those criminalizing defamation, \ facilitate political and economic repression, undermine development, and destroy lives.

zh: 埃及政府也许是诽谤和渎神法律最大的滥用者，用它们来镇压异见。
en: Egypt’s government is perhaps the biggest abuser of defamation and blasphemy laws to suppress differing views.

zh: 特别是，埃及当局明目张胆地使用埃及刑法典第98条（f）款 — — 禁止公民诽谤“神圣的宗教 ” 、 煽动宗派冲突或冒犯伊斯兰教 — — 逮捕、起诉和关押非多数宗教群体成员，特别是基督徒。
en: In particular, the Egyptian authorities brazenly use Article 98(f) of the Egyptian Penal Code – which prohibits citizens from defaming a “heavenly religion,” inciting sectarian strife, or insulting Islam – to detain, prosecute, and imprison members of non-majority religious groups, especially Christians.

zh: 抓人所需要的只是笼统地宣称他们的行为危害到“公共和谐 ” 。
en: All that is needed is a vague claim that their activities are jeopardizing “communal harmony.”

zh: 此外，作家纳吉（Ahmed Naji）最近被判两年徒刑，因为他“行为不端 ” ， 在他的小说中进行露骨的性描写。
en: Moreover, the writer Ahmed Naji was recently handed a two-year prison sentence for violating “public modesty,” by publishing a sexually explicit excerpt from his novel.

zh: 此前一个月，作者纳乌特（Fatma Naoot）就其获得的三年徒刑进行上诉。 她因为发了一条Facebook批评穆斯林宴席屠宰动物而被定“蔑视伊斯兰教”罪。
en: This came just a month after the author Fatma Naoot appealed the three-year sentence she received when a Facebook post criticizing the slaughter of animals for a Muslim feast led to a guilty verdict for “contempt for Islam.”

zh: 如此等等。
en: The list goes on.

zh: 令人不安的是，根据美国国际宗教自由委员会2015年报告，2011年以来渎神案数量有所增加。
en: Ominously, according to a 2015 report by the US Commission on International Religious Freedom, blasphemy cases have been on the rise since 2011.

zh: 2015年1月，埃及总统塞西发布政令，允许政府禁止一切它认为冒犯宗教的外国出版物，从而扩大了政府已经十分巨大的审查权力，也给记者造成了进一步的压力。
en: In January 2015, President Abdel Fatah al-Sisi issued a decree that permits the government to ban any foreign publications it deems offensive to religion, thereby expanding the government’s already significant censorship powers and increasing pressure on journalists further.

zh: 突尼斯的情况也好不到哪里去，据自由之家（Freedom House）2015年的报告 ， “ 诽谤罪仍是独立报道的最大障碍之一。
en: The situation is not much better in Tunisia, where, according to Freedom House’s 2015 report, “criminal defamation remains one of the biggest obstacles to independent reporting.”

zh: ”此外，许多人担心突尼斯新成立的网络犯罪调查机构将让“政府不受约束地监视土耳其人民 ” ， 一如被阿��伯之春革命赶下台的前总统本·阿里。
en: Moreover, many are concerned that the country’s newly established cyber-crime investigative agency will carry out “unchecked government surveillance on Tunisian citizens,” as occurred under former President Zine El Abidine Ben Ali, who was ousted in the Arab Spring revolution.

zh: 约旦也在加大限制言论自由的措施，2015年6月的网络犯罪法修正案允许检察长在没有法庭指令的情况下拘捕任何被认为使用互联网进行诽谤活动的人。
en: Jordan has also ratcheted up its attempts to limit free expression, with a June 2015 amendment to its cyber-crime law allowing the attorney-general to detain, without a court order, anyone deemed to have used the Internet for defamation.

zh: 尽管约旦言论和出版法禁止因书面观点拘捕记者，但如果这些观点出现在网上，记者就要遭殃了。
en: While Jordan’s Press and Publications Law prohibits the arrest of journalists for opinions expressed in print, journalists are now fair game if those opinions appear online.

zh: 而事实上，不少记者已经被起诉。
en: And, indeed, charges have already been brought against several.

zh: 当今中东最高规格的诽谤相关案件牵涉到巴勒斯坦议会成员巴克（Najat Abu Bakr ） 。 在针对与总统阿巴斯关系密切的内阁部长阿拉吉（Hussein al-Araj）提出腐败指控后，他被检察长传讯。
en: Among the highest-profile defamation-related cases in the Middle East today is that involving Najat Abu Bakr, a member of Palestine’s parliament who has been summoned for interrogation by the attorney-general after leveling corruption accusations against Hussein al-Araj, a cabinet minister with close ties with President Mahmoud Abbas.

zh: 这一动作背后的另一个原因也许是巴克支持约旦河西岸教师罢工，令阿巴斯政府十分难堪。
en: The move seems also to be motivated by Bakr’s support for a teacher’s strike in the West Bank – an embarrassment to the Abbas government.

zh: 根据现行诽谤法，巴勒斯坦检察长有权羁押个人48小时进行问询，但人权组织谴责这一做法。
en: Though Palestine’s attorney-general is allowed, under existing defamation legislation, to hold a person for 48 hours of questioning, human-rights groups have condemned the move.

zh: 巴克拒绝执行传唤令，在议会大厦静坐示威。
en: Bakr, for her part, refused the order, and staged a sit-in at the parliament building.

zh: 巴勒斯坦安全力量包围了大厦，但没有逮捕她。
en: Palestinian security forces surrounded the building, but did not attempt to arrest her.

zh: 中东和北非地区诽谤法的加强 — — 以及日益广泛的应用 — — 是一个危险趋势，正在引起公民社会组织日益猛烈的反击。
en: The intensification – and increasingly broad application – of defamation laws in the Middle East and North Africa represents a dangerous trend, one that is fueling an increasingly powerful backlash from civil-society groups.

zh: 比如，纳吉案刺激了埃及作家、艺术家和制片人发起一场增加艺术创作和言论自由的公共运动。
en: Naji’s case, for example, spurred Egyptian writers, artists, and filmmakers to launch a public campaign for greater freedom of creativity and expression.

zh: 此外，在2011年埃及暴乱中表现积极的前谷歌高管戈尼姆（Wael Ghonim）公开批评将纳吉定罪。
en: Furthermore, the former Google executive Wael Ghonim, who was active in the country’s 2011 uprising, publicly criticized the verdict against Naji.

zh: 一些国有艺术刊物纷纷把显要位置留给纳吉，或者刊登他的画像，要么刊登寥寥数语支持言论自由而将版面的其他部分留白。
en: And several state-owned artistic publications were issued with their front pages either depicting Naji or including just a few words expressing support for free speech, with the rest of the page left blank.

zh: 在约旦，由捍卫记者自由中心（Center for Defending Freedom of Journalists）领导的联盟发起了一项新运动 — — “说话不是犯罪”以提高人们对媒体自由度下降的认识。
en: In Jordan, a coalition led by the Center for Defending Freedom of Journalists has launched a new campaign, “Talk is Not a Crime,” to raise awareness about declining media freedom.

zh: 而在巴勒斯坦，针对通过诽谤法抓捕政治反对者的示威游行势头甚猛，在巴克的群众支持度的关键作用下，政府同意让她返回位于纳布卢斯的家中，免遭拘捕或要求问询。
en: And in Palestine, protests against the use of defamation laws to imprison political opponents have gained traction, with popular support for Bakr having played a key role in spurring the agreement that allowed her to return to her house in Nablus without being arrested or called in for questioning.

zh: 对个案的愤怒只能限于此。
en: Outcries against individual cases can go only so far.

zh: 运动必须 — — 也确实这么做了 — — 将重点放在诽谤法的真正改革上，以确保政府不能使用诽谤法来扼杀异见。
en: Campaigns must – and, increasingly, do – focus on genuine changes to defamation laws, to ensure that governments cannot use them to stifle dissent.

zh: 关键在于取消诽谤案的刑事性质，从而使它们不会带来牢狱之灾；将它们只作为民事案件起诉，对被判诽谤行为成立者课以适当的罚款。
en: The key will be to remove the criminal element from defamation cases, and thus the prospect of imprisonment, and instead prosecute them as civil cases, with those found guilty of defamation being subject to reasonable fines.

zh: 说服立法者让诽谤法去刑事化绝非易事。
en: Compelling lawmakers to decriminalize defamation will not be easy.

zh: 但若所有重要各方精诚合作 — — 特别是媒体、公民社会和人权活动家 — — 再加上地区和国际行动方的支持，它是可以完成的任务。
en: But with a concerted effort from all relevant parties – especially the media, civil society, and human-rights activists – plus the support of regional and international actors, it is possible.

zh: 言论自由对于经济和社会进步具有关键重要性，不容浪费时间。
en: Given the critical importance of free speech to economic and social progress, there is no time to waste.

zh: 击败北朝鲜的核勒索
en: Defeating North Korea’s Nuclear Blackmail

zh: 北朝鲜宣布自己拥有核武器的申明引起了外交恐慌。
en: North Korea’s announcement that it possesses nuclear weapons has fuelled a diplomatic frenzy.

zh: 为了说服北朝鲜重返以消除朝鲜半岛上核威胁为议题的六方会谈（其他五方为中国、日本、美国、俄罗斯和南朝鲜 ） ， 日本、美国和南朝鲜主动提出扩大会谈范围，允许北朝鲜自由提出自己关心的议题。
en: To persuade North Korea to return to the six-party talks – with China, Japan, the US, Russia, and South Korea – on defusing the nuclear threat on the Korean peninsula, Japan, the US, and South Korea have now offered to expand the scope of the talks to allow North Korea to raise any issue that concerns it.

zh: 这可能是个严重的错误。
en: This could be a grave mistake.

zh: 2004年六月，北朝鲜以美国和日本政府政策具有敌意为由，退出六方会谈，致使会谈搁浅。
en: The talks ground to a halt in June 2004, when the North Koreans pulled out, citing the allegedly hostile policies of the US and Japanese governments.

zh: 现在北朝鲜又声称已经制造出了以自卫为目的的核武器。
en: Now they claim to have manufactured nuclear weapons for self-defense.

zh: 尽管在此之前，金正日政府曾数次非正式地承认北朝鲜拥有核武器库，但正式承认，这还是首次。
en: Although there had been several unofficial statements by Kim Jong-Il’s regime admitting that North Korea possessions nuclear arsenal, the announcement was the first official confirmation.

zh: 金正日政府之所以正式承认拥有核武器，是认识到了连任的布什政府在要求北朝鲜完全放弃其核武器方案方面不会让步，而是会继续实行孤立、扼杀北朝鲜的政策。 在此问题上日本也持同样态度。
en: What lay behind the declaration was the regime’s recognition that a second-term Bush administration would not soften its demand for a complete repudiation of its nuclear program, but would instead continue to pursue policies aimed at isolating and stifling North Korea.

zh: 去年6月，金正日政府在退出六国会谈时，就以日本政府对20世纪70年代和80 年代北朝鲜间谍劫持日本公民事件的立场来证明了这一点。
en: The same goes for Japan, whose stance on the abduction of its citizens by North Korean agents in the 1970’s and 1980’s was also cited by the Kim regime last June as a reason for walking out of the six-party talks.

zh: 弄清楚了这点，北朝鲜打出核武器牌的目的就昭然若揭了。 对北朝鲜来说，这是最有利的时机：伊拉克目前的局势使得美国没有任何机动的余地，此举可以迫使美国做出让步，同时可以压制日本国内日益高涨的因为人质劫持问题而要求对北朝鲜进行经济制裁的呼声。
en: With this in mind, the North Koreans’ motives in playing the nuclear trump card are clear, and the timing couldn’t have seemed more advantageous for them: force the Americans into making concessions while the situation in Iraq leaves the US with no room for maneuver, and undercut the rising call in Japan for economic sanctions against North Korea over the abduction issue.

zh: 尽管北朝鲜在核武器能力通告中强烈谴责了日本和美国，但却没有提及中国、俄罗斯和南朝鲜，因为这三国在六方会谈中采取了相对和缓的态度。
en: Thus, whereas North Korea’s announcement of its nuclear capability strongly condemned Japan and the US, it did not mention China, Russia, and South Korea, which had been more conciliatory during the six-party talks.

zh: 事实上，尽管退出了六方会谈，但北朝鲜并没有完全否认通过对话来打破核僵局的可能性。
en: Indeed, in withdrawing from the six-party talks, North Korea did not completely abandon the possibility of resolving the nuclear standoff through dialogue.

zh: 北朝鲜的目的是尽可能地拖延会谈以迫使美国同意进行双边直接谈判，这样北朝鲜就可能从谈判中获得能源和其它援助，并且可以要求为他们“敬爱的领袖”金正日提供安全保障。
en: Rather, North Korea’s aim was to postpone the six-party talks as long as possible in order to force direct bilateral negotiations with the US, in which it would presumably extract energy assistance and other aid while demanding a security guarantee for “Dear Leader” Kim Jong-il.

zh: 在双边谈判问题上，美国没有做任何让步。 美国对北朝鲜最近的核武器宣告做出的反应同样强调了恢复六方谈判的必要性。
en: America didn’t budge on bilateral negotiations, and its response to North Korea’s recent announcement that it possesses nuclear weapons likewise emphasized the need to revive the six-party talks.

zh: 日本态度与美国相仿。
en: Japan adopted a similar stance.

zh: 在去年会谈破裂后，布什政府和日本政府一样，改变了原来对北朝鲜相对温和的态度。
en: Like Japan, the Bush administration’s relatively moderate stance toward North Korea has changed since the talks broke down last year.

zh: 美国似乎在加紧从外交上孤立北朝鲜，正打算将核讨论转移到联合国安理会。
en: The US seems to be tightening its diplomatic encirclement of North Korea with a view to shifting the nuclear discussion to the UN Security Council.

zh: 此外，今年2月，美日安保协议委员会将两国的外交部长与国防部长聚集到华盛顿，讨论与美国先头部队改革相关的共同战略目标。
en: Moreover, the Japan-US Security Consultative Committee brought together the countries’ foreign and defense ministers in Washington in February to discuss common strategic objectives related to the reformation of US forward forces.

zh: 美国驻日部队也包括在其中。 该部队的主要任务将是应对北朝鲜核武器和弹道导弹威胁，以及国际恐怖主义和中国加强军事力量带来的新威胁。
en: This includes US forces in Japan, which will focus on responding to North Korean nuclear and ballistic-missile threats, as well as new threats posed by international terrorism and China’s military build-up.

zh: 美日两国若要维持牢固联盟以确保亚太地区的稳定，则双方在安全问题上保持步调一致将至关重要。
en: Remaining in step with each other on security issues is essential if Japan and the US are to maintain a firm alliance to ensure the stability of the Asia-Pacific region.

zh: 日本政府也正在寻求有效措施以应对北朝鲜在地区和双边事务上（包括人质劫持事件）一贯不诚恳的态度。
en: The Japanese government has also been searching for effective measures to respond to North Korea’s consistently insincere attitude on regional and bilateral issues, including the abduction cases.

zh: 在军事上，日本修订了自卫队方面的相关法律，以建立弹道导弹防务程序，重点针对北朝鲜。
en: Militarily, Japan revised its law on the Self-Defense Forces to establish procedures for ballistic missile defense, with a strong focus on North Korea.

zh: 虽然日本政府在1月15日的内阁例会上，即金正日63岁生日的前一天，达成这一决定并非刻意安排， 但也确实表明了日本政府不受胁迫的决心。
en: The decision, coming at the cabinet’s regular meeting on February 15th, was not intended to coincide with Kim Jong-il’s 63rd birthday the following day.

zh: 日本政府早就怀疑北朝鲜已经拥有核武器，不会因为这一威胁的确认便被迫对相关政策进行根本性大调整。
en: But it did show that Japan’s government, having long suspected that North Korea already possessed nuclear weapons, would not be intimidated into a fundamental policy change by confirmation of the threat.

zh: 此次修订赋予了自卫队司令官更大的权力，可以主动采取防御行动以应对紧急威胁。 这为日本未来的军事态势指明了方向。
en: The revision establishes the future direction of Japan’s military posture by delegating greater authority to the commanders of the Self-Defense Forces to initiate defensive actions against immediate threats.

zh: 据南朝鲜的新闻报道，除了现有的中程“芦洞”导弹外，北朝鲜还改进了“飞毛腿”导弹，其射程在提高后已可��达日本本土（主要岛屿 ） 。
en: According to South Korean news reports, in addition to its existing mid-range Nodong missiles, North Korea has improved its Scud missiles, extending their range to reach Japan’s main islands.

zh: 事实上，如果北朝鲜无视国际公约，不仅继续开发核武器，还开发各种弹道导弹，那么她确实可称得上是无赖国家。
en: If North Korea is, indeed, continuing to develop not only its nuclear arsenal, but also various types of ballistic missiles, in defiance of international commitments, it is truly a rogue state.

zh: 在核武器问题上，日本对北朝鲜的政策应该是继续巩固与美国之间的关系，加强与中国、南朝鲜及俄罗斯的合作，尽一切努力尽早恢复六国会谈。
en: As for the nuclear issue, Japan’s policy toward North Korea should continue to emphasize solidifying ties with the US and strengthening cooperation with China, South Korea, and Russia, making every effort to promote early resumption of the six-party talks.

zh: 但与金正日政府的对话本身不是目的。
en: But dialogue with the Kim regime cannot be an end in itself.

zh: 谈判是必要的，也必须进行充分的谈判，但如果允许北朝鲜将参加六国会谈变成讨价还价的资本，那么就不可能取得任何进步。
en: Negotiation is necessary, and it must be sufficient, but progress will be impossible if North Korea is allowed to turn its mere participation in the six-party talks into a bargaining chip.

zh: 中国面临市场
en: China Confronts the Market

zh: 美国剑桥—人们常常用单路思维看待中国当下的经济颓势：政府没有让市场运转起来。
en: CAMBRIDGE – China’s current economic woes have largely been viewed through a single lens: the government’s failure to let the market operate.

zh: 但这个角度让外国观察者误读了今年汇率和股市的一些最重要的发展态势。
en: But that perspective has led foreign observers to misinterpret some of this year’s most important developments in the foreign-exchange and stock markets.

zh: 诚然，中国当局用各种方式进行了强力干预。
en: To be sure, Chinese authorities do intervene strongly in various ways.

zh: 从2004年到2013年，中国人民银行购入了数万亿美元的外汇储备，从而防止人民币升值幅度大于自由浮动的情形。
en: From 2004 to 2013, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) bought trillions of dollars in foreign-exchange reserves, thereby preventing the renminbi from appreciating as much as it would have had it floated freely.

zh: 最近，当局拿出了所有政策手段，徒劳地试图缓和今年夏天的股价暴跌。
en: More recently, the authorities have been deploying every piece of policy artillery they can muster in a vain attempt to moderate this summer’s plunge in equity prices.

zh: 但被外国人指责为政府干预的后果的一些重要发展态势其实正好相反。
en: But some important developments that foreigners decry as the result of government intervention are in fact the opposite.

zh: 最重要的证据是8月11日人民币兑美元贬值 — — 这一动作让人们想起了美国政客的古老格言 ， “ 小心许愿。
en: Exhibit A is the August 11 devaluation of the renminbi against the dollar – a move that invoked for US politicians the old adage, “Be careful what you wish for.”

zh: ”贬值 — — 必须指出，幅度只有3 % — —反映了人民银行政策的变化。 人民银行想增加市场对汇率的影响。
en: The devaluation – by a mere 3%, it should be noted – reflected a change in PBOC policy intended to give the market more influence over the exchange rate.

zh: 此前，人民银行允许人民币价值日内波动2 % ， 但一般不允许第二天继续累积前一天的波动。
en: Previously, the PBOC allowed the renminbi’s value to fluctuate each day within a 2% band, but did not routinely allow the movements to cumulate from one day to the next.

zh: 如今，每天的收盘汇率将影响第二天的汇率，即向市场水平的调整。
en: Now, each day’s closing exchange rate will influence the following day’s rate, implying adjustment toward market levels.

zh: 当局也许本来不会采取行动，如果日益增加的贬值市场压力能够有助于抵消经济增长颓势的话。
en: The authorities probably would not have moved when they did had it not been for growing market pressure for a depreciation that could help counteract weakening economic growth.

zh: 事实上，提振增长也许是中国政治领导人的主要动机，尽管人民银行仍关注推进加强市场在决定汇率中的作用这一长期目标。
en: In fact, bolstering growth might have been the primary motivation for the country’s political leaders, even as the PBOC remained focused on advancing the longer-term objective of strengthening the market’s role in determining the exchange rate.

zh: 但这两个动机是一致的：市场力量不会对人民币产生贬值压力，如果中国经济基本面不允许的话。
en: But the two motivations are consistent: market forces would not be placing downward pressure on the renminbi if China’s economic fundamentals did not warrant it.

zh: 要求中国浮动汇率的美国政客也许预料的是不同的结果 — — 考虑到市场力量在2014年年中出现了逆转，他们的预期并不太合理 — — 但你很难指责中国没有照办。
en: The American politicians who demanded that China float its currency may have anticipated a different outcome – somewhat unreasonably, given that market forces reversed direction in mid-2014 – but one can hardly blame the Chinese for taking them at their word.

zh: 诚然，中国的汇率远远没有实现自由浮动，更不用说完全可兑换了。 后者要求进一步放松跨境金融流管制。
en: To be sure, China remains far from embracing a free-floating currency, let alone a fully convertible one, which would require further liberalization of controls on cross-border financial flows.

zh: 对于IMF是否将人民币纳入决定其储备资产特别提款权（SDR）的货币篮子而言，在岸和离岸市场的统一比浮动汇率更重要。
en: Unification of onshore and offshore markets is more important than a floating exchange rate in determining whether the International Monetary Fund will include the renminbi in the basket of currencies used to determine the value of its reserve asset, the Special Drawing Right.

zh: 许多这一问题的评论者低估了货币应该是“可自由使用的”这一标准的重要性。
en: Much commentary on the subject has underestimated the importance of the criterion that the currency be “freely usable.”

zh: 尽管如此，许多人担心中国的汇率调整引发了一场“货币战争 ” ， 其他新兴经济体也纷纷贬值。
en: Nonetheless, many are fretting that China’s exchange-rate adjustment has triggered a “currency war,” with other emerging economies devaluing as well.

zh: 但是，一年多来，经济基本面逐渐不利于新兴市场（特别是不利于大宗商品）而有利于美国，因此这场调整应该在预料之内。
en: But, more than a year after the economic fundamentals swung against emerging markets (and especially away from commodities) and toward the United States, this adjustment was due.

zh: 尽管中国的动作可能影响了调整时间，但其他国家的贬值都是难以避免的。
en: Though the Chinese move likely influenced the timing, other devaluations would have inevitably taken place.

zh: 关于竞争性贬值的警告具有误导性。
en: Warnings about competitive devaluations are misleading.

zh: 认为不应将中国金融发展态势归咎于政府干预的第二个证据是在6月达到顶峰的股市泡沫。
en: Exhibit B in the case against attributing financial developments in China to government intervention is the stock-market bubble that culminated in June.

zh: 从传统智慧来看，当局一直在干预，不但包括市场崩溃后的救市措施，也包括在长达一年的涨势期间的干预。 在此期间，上证综合指数几乎翻番。
en: According to the conventional wisdom, the authorities consistently intervened not only to try to boost the market after the collapse, but also during its year-long run-up, when the Shanghai Stock Exchange composite index more than doubled.

zh: 言下之意是，中国决策者，特别是股市监管者，对于泡沫只能责怪自己。
en: The finger-wagging implication is that Chinese policymakers, particularly the stock-market regulator, have only themselves to blame for the bubble.

zh: 毫无疑问，这一说法有些道理。
en: There is undoubtedly some truth to this story.

zh: 显然，股价的反常暴涨受保证金融资买股激增的推动，这一行为在2010—2011年被合法化并受到人民银行去年11月的货币宽松的鼓励。
en: It seems clear that the extraordinary run-up in equity prices was fueled by a surge in margin financing of stock purchases, which was legalized in 2010-2011 and encouraged by the PBOC’s monetary easing since last November.

zh: 类似地，官方媒体等也大量宣传对牛市的支持。
en: Likewise, there was plenty of support for the bull market in government-sponsored news media, for example.

zh: 但许多评论者没有看到，中国监管当局在大牛市的最后六个月采取了遏制价格的措施。
en: But what many commentators fail to note is that China’s regulatory authorities took action to try to dampen prices over the last six months of the run-up.

zh: 1月份，保证金要求有所提高，4月份又提高了一次，同时还扩大了融券标的数量以方便卖空。
en: They tightened margin requirements in January, and again in April, when they also facilitated short-selling by expanding the number of eligible stocks.

zh: 最后扼杀泡沫的事件似乎是中国证监会6月12日宣布限制券商能够用于股票交易贷款的额度。
en: The event that ultimately seems to have pricked the bubble was the China Securities Regulatory Commission’s June 12 announcement of plans to limit the amount that brokerages could lend for stock trading.

zh: 这正是经济学家经常建议的反周期宏观审慎政策。
en: This is precisely the kind of counter-cyclical macroprudential policy that economists often recommend.

zh: 但是，发达经济体很少实施这一建议，而中国和其他许多发展中国家确实常常反周期地调整监管措施，包括银行准备金要求和限制住房抵押贷款。
en: But, whereas advanced economies rarely implement this advice, China and many other developing countries do tend to adjust regulation, including reserve requirements for banks and ceilings on homebuyers’ borrowing, counter-cyclically.

zh: 你可以批评中国监管者他们提高保证金要求的动作的效果没有维持多少时间，你也可以批评他们的动作导致了最近的崩盘。
en: One could criticize the Chinese regulator on the grounds that the effect of its moves to increase margin requirements did not last long; or one could criticize it on the grounds that its moves caused the recent crash.

zh: 但是，无论如何，这些措施是为了阻止市场价格的攀升，而不是促使它们攀升。
en: But, either way, these measures were intended to stem the rise in market prices, rather than to contribute to it.

zh: 这不是一个无关紧要的点。
en: This is not a trivial point.

zh: 去年人民银行的外汇市场干预是为了阻止而不是加剧人民贬值也是如此。
en: Nor is the fact that the PBOC’s interventions in the foreign-exchange market over the last year have aimed to dampen the renminbi’s depreciation, not add to it.

zh: 因此，将中国的问题归咎于政府干预是不负责任的。
en: Given this, it is facile to blame China’s problems on government intervention.

zh: 捍卫民主的本质
en: Defending Democracy’s Essence

zh: 巴黎—1948年，联合国大会通过了世界人权宣言，肯定了“人民的意愿 ” — —民主 — — 应该成为政府的基础。
en: PARIS – On December 10, 1948, the United Nations General Assembly adopted the Universal Declaration of Human Rights, affirming the view that “the will of the people” – democracy – should form the basis of any government.

zh: 但七十年过去了，世界民主来到了危急时刻。
en: But seven decades later, the world’s democracies are in peril.

zh: 二战结束到2000年间，民主国家数量增加了三倍，如今，我们进入了一个持续的政治退步时期。
en: After a fourfold increase in the number of democracies between the end of World War II and 2000, we are now in a sustained period of political regression.

zh: 曾经开放的社会滑向独裁，在许多国家，专制趋势愈演愈烈。
en: Once-open societies are veering toward dictatorship, and in many countries, despotic tendencies are strengthening.

zh: 这些趋势是可以扭转的，但条件是我们必须在民主滑坡的原因上取得一致，并据此校准解决方案。
en: These trends can be reversed, but only if we agree on the causes of democratic backsliding and target our solutions accordingly.

zh: 说起来容易做起来难。
en: That is easier said than done.

zh: 在1967年的论文《真相与政治 》 （ Truth and Politics）中，哲学家汉娜·阿伦特（Hannah Arendt）指出 ， “ 除非能够保证获得事实信息，并且事实本身不容争议，否则观念自由就是一出闹剧。
en: In her 1967 essay “Truth and Politics,” the philosopher Hannah Arendt noted that, “Freedom of opinion is a farce unless factual information is guaranteed and the facts themselves are not in dispute.”

zh: ”不幸的是，阿伦特的闹剧已经成了现实。
en: Unfortunately, Arendt’s farce has become our reality.

zh: 任何民主国家要想有意义，其人民必须能够获得在自由多元的环境所产生的值得信任的信息。
en: For any democracy to be meaningful, its people need access to trustworthy information produced in a free and pluralistic environment.

zh: 但这一基本要求正在受到前所未有的考验。
en: But this basic requirement is being tested as never before.

zh: 环顾全球，寡头正在买断媒体推动他们的利益，增加他们的影响力，而报道歧视和腐败等问题的记者面临着恐吓、暴力和谋杀。
en: Around the world, oligarchs are buying up media outlets to promote their interests and increase their influence, while journalists who report on issues like discrimination and corruption are met with intimidation, violence, and murder.

zh: 在这样的环境下，我们还如何保证观念自由？
en: How can we guarantee freedom of opinion under such conditions?

zh: 信息和通讯技术本应给我们更多而非更少的自由。
en: Information and communication technologies were supposed to give us more freedom, not less.

zh: 早期互联网实现了新闻民主化，结束了传统发行商和亲政府集团的主宰。
en: The early Internet democratized news and ended the dominance of traditional publishers and pro-government conglomerates.

zh: 但这一初心早已不在，取而代之的是“信息丛林 ” ， 资金雄厚的掠食者智胜低调的民众。
en: But this initial promise has given way to an “information jungle,” where deep-pocketed predators outmaneuver an unassuming public.

zh: 如今，政府发动信息战；政客用社交媒体传播谎言；公司游说团体轻而易举地散播欺骗性内容。
en: Today, governments wage information wars; politicians use social media to spread lies; and corporate lobbyists disseminate deceptive content with ease.

zh: 麻省理工学院的一项最近研究发现，线上假新闻传播要快于真新闻 — — 并且常常会快很多。
en: As a study from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology recently found, fake news spreads online faster than real news – often significantly so.

zh: 简言之，信息全球化决定性地有利于将假新闻作为控制手段的人。
en: Simply put, the globalization of information has tipped the scales in favor of those who view falsehood as a tool of control.

zh: 独裁者可以轻而易举地向开放社会输出他们的思想，而在自由条件下产生的内容，很少能够进入独裁社会。
en: Dictators easily export their ideas to open societies, whereas content produced under conditions of freedom rarely moves in the opposite direction.

zh: 这一挑战因为跨国科技公司的成长而加剧，这些公司掌控者公共领域的构架。
en: This challenge has been magnified by the growth of multinational technology companies, which have come to dictate the architecture of the public sphere.

zh: 在民主的历史上，机制的演变改善了新闻的准确性和伦理。
en: In the history of democracy, mechanisms have evolved to improve the accuracy and ethics of journalism.

zh: 尽管监管保护并不完美，也常常不为人所见，但它们为用户和信息生产者都带来了巨大的收益。
en: Although imperfect and often invisible, these regulatory protections have brought many benefits to users and producers alike.

zh: 但媒体行业的变化速度 — — 如电视和纸媒之间，或新闻和广告之间 — — 让这些规则最初的基础变得模糊起来。
en: But the pace of change in the media industry – for example, between television and print, or news and advertising – has blurred the clear distinctions on which these rules were originally based.

zh: 在这一冲突环境中保护民主理想是一项生死攸关的历史使命。
en: Protecting democratic ideals in this conflicting environment is a vital and historic task.

zh: 因此无国界记者组织（Reporters Without Borders，RSF）与诺贝尔奖得主、科技专家、记者和人权活动家一起，发起了信息和民主委员会（Information and Democracy Commission ） 。
en: That is why Reporters Without Borders (RSF) is joining with Nobel laureates, technology specialists, journalists, and human rights activists to launch the Information and Democracy Commission.

zh: 作为这一独立组织的联职主席之一，我们的目标是让全球重新关注“自由多元的公共空间”的价值，并给出能够让记者在不必担心报复的情况下工作、公众能够轻易得到准确信息的方案。
en: As co-chairs of this independent initiative, our goal is to refocus global attention on the value of “a free and pluralistic public space,” and to offer solutions that enable journalists to work without fear of reprisal and allow the public to access accurate information easily.

zh: 未来几周，我们将起草信息与民主国际宣言（International Declaration on Information and Democracy ） ， 并与几个民主国家的领导人合作致力于确保世界各国政府的支持。
en: In the coming weeks, we will draft an International Declaration on Information and Democracy, and in coordination with the leaders of several democratic countries, work to secure support from governments around the world.

zh: 我们的努力将在11月中旬加速，届时全球领导人将齐聚巴黎纪念第100个停战日并出席和平论坛和互联网治理论坛。
en: Our efforts will accelerate in mid-November, when global leaders gather in Paris to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Armistice Day and to attend the Peace Forum and the Internet Governance Forum.

zh: 民主之根在于自由和理性的启蒙思想，它们必须得到捍卫。
en: Democracy, with its roots in the Enlightenment ideals of freedom and reason, must be defended.

zh: 民主政府和公民决不能沦为假新闻 、 “ 钓鱼贴”和暴君的突发奇想的受害者。
en: Democratic governments and citizens must not fall victim to fake news, “trolls,” and the whims of despots.

zh: 信息和民主国际宣言就是为了强化开放社会对抗极权力量的能力。
en: The International Declaration on Information and Democracy is intended to strengthen open societies’ ability to combat authoritarian forces.

zh: 我们有幸或在一个科技潜力无穷的世纪。
en: We all have the good fortune to be alive during a period of extraordinary technological potential.

zh: 但是，我们也有责任确保共享信息的新方式不会演变为压迫工具。
en: And yet, we also have the responsibility to ensure that new ways to share information are not turned into tools of oppression.

zh: 我们的委员会的使命宣言言简意赅地指出 ， “ 民主的生存危如累卵，因为民主无法在没有知情、开放和有活力的公共争论的环境中生存。 ”
en: As the mission statement of our commission succinctly puts it: “Democracy’s survival is at stake, because democracy cannot survive without an informed, open, and dynamic public debate.”

zh: 防卫日本的国防
en: Defending Japanese Defense

zh: 日本政府和国家安全委员会计划在今年底之前修改国家防卫计划大纲（NDPO ） 。
en: Japan’s government and National Security Council plan to revise the country’s National Defense Program Outline (NDPO) by the end of this year.

zh: 提交给首相小泉纯一郎的修改草案给自卫队（SDF）分配了三项关键性的任务：对新的威胁做出有效的反应、参与国际维和活动、抵抗侵略。
en: A draft of proposed changes submitted to Prime Minister Junichiro Koizumi assigns three key tasks to the Self-Defense Forces (SDF): effective response to new threats, participation in international peacekeeping activities, and defense against invasion.

zh: 当前安全因素复杂多变，除了传统的国与国之间的战争外，非国家的活动分子实施的恐怖袭击也频频发生，因此需要一个敏捷、统一的战略。
en: Today’s complex security environment, with terrorist attacks by non-state actors occurring alongside traditional state-to-state wars, demands a nimble, integrated strategy.

zh: NDPO的修改草案似乎认识到这一点，同时强调日本自卫、日美联盟的合作、以及对多边使命做出贡献的必要性。
en: The draft revision of the NDPO seems to recognize this, emphasizing the need for Japan’s own defense efforts, cooperation through the Japanese-US alliance, and contributions to multilateral missions.

zh: 此外，国家安全委员会还指出有必要制定新的计划，建立多功能的灵活防卫部队。
en: Moreover, the National Security Council has indicated the need to introduce a new plan for multi-functional flexible defense forces.

zh: 不幸的是，日本新的安全战略的关键部分仍然模糊不清，自相矛盾。
en: Unfortunately, key components of Japan’s emerging security strategy remain vague and contradictory.

zh: 例如，虽然遭受侵略的可能性被认为很低，但2004年国防白皮书还是辩称自卫队“最基本的职能”是预防最糟糕的事件发生，因为充分的自卫能力不能在一夜之间产生。
en: For example, while the likelihood of an invasion threat is judged to be low, the Defense White Paper of 2004 argues that the SDF’s “most fundamental function” is to prepare for the worst, because sufficient defensive power cannot be developed overnight.

zh: 也就是说，日本明确声称它将结合日美安全制度保卫自己的国家，防止侵略。
en: In other words, Japan will clearly assert its will to defend the nation, and to prevent invasion in combination with the Japan-US security system.

zh: 另一方面，国家安全委员会提议“削减防卫部队的规模 ” ， 暗中降低了自卫的意愿。
en: On the other hand, the National Security Council proposes “scaling down the size of defense forces,” implying mitigation of the will to defend.

zh: 的确，没有建议对自卫队进行“紧急扩建”的事实加剧了这方面的焦虑。
en: Indeed, the failure to suggest any possibility of an “emergency expansion” of the SDF compounds this anxiety.

zh: 诚然，从根本上讲，政府有责任根据财政因素决定自卫部队的适当规模。
en: To be sure, the government is ultimately responsible for determining the appropriate scale of defense power in line with fiscal considerations.

zh: 但是政府同样有责任制定详细的、有现实意义的政策，以便在发生不可预见的威胁时有必要的自卫能力。
en: But it is also the responsibility of the government to prepare a detailed and realistic policy aimed at securing the necessary level of defense capability in the event of unforeseen threats.

zh: 因此，日本政府应该明确表明保卫国家安全的真实意愿。
en: Japan’s government should thus give a clear indication of a true will to defend the country’s security.

zh: 当然，自卫能力不能仅根据部队规模来判断。
en: Of course, defense capability cannot be judged solely according to force levels.

zh: NDPO草案提出要建立一支新型的、具有更强适应性、移动性、灵活性、以及先进的技术资源和情报收集能力的多功能自卫队，这就必须对现有的结构和设备重新进行基本的评估。
en: The draft NDPO’s vision of a new, more adaptable, mobile, flexible, and multi-purpose SDF, with advanced technological resources and information gathering capacity, calls for a fundamental reassessment of the existing organization and equipment.

zh: 按照国际社会为了和平稳定所做的努力，草案还在每个军事部署内创建了一个核心单位，并建立了一套统一的行动制度。
en: In conformity with the international community’s efforts to secure peace and stability, the draft also creates a core unit within each of the military branches, and establishes an integrated operational system.

zh: NDPO设想的军事重组具有深远的意义。
en: The military reorganization that the NDPO envisages is far-reaching.

zh: 日本的地面部队要重组针对面临大规模入侵时的作战能力的现有结构，提高在情况不太严重时采取军事措施的适应能力。
en: Japan’s ground forces are to reorient their current structure, which is geared to combat capability in response to large-scale invasion, toward increased adaptability for military action in less severe circumstances.

zh: 海军要创建一套机制，把重心从冷战时期的反潜艇战（ASW）职能，转移到保卫各个海岛，监督弹道导弹并做出回应，以及防止非法的间谍活动上。
en: The navy is to shift its focus away from the anti-submarine warfare (ASW) capability of the Cold War era, creating a structure aimed at defending islands, monitoring and responding to ballistic missiles, and combating illegal spy ship activities.

zh: 空军要继续监督领空，保持随时回击空中袭击的状态，同时调整反侵略策略，因为空袭的可能性已减小。
en: The air force is to continue its monitoring activities in neighboring airspace and maintain response readiness against air attack, while modifying invasion response tactics somewhat as the likelihood of an attack from the air diminishes.

zh: 反潜艇能力的削弱是一个问题。
en: One problem is the dilution of ASW capability.

zh: 日本需要发展平衡的、能回击新的威胁（如中国海军的迅速壮大，特别是其潜艇力量）的防卫部队。
en: Japan needs to develop well-balanced defense forces with the capacity needed to respond to new threats, such as the rapid build-up of China’s navy, especially its submarine forces.

zh: 西太平洋上反潜艇能力的重要性没有降低。
en: The importance of ASW capability in the Western Pacific has not waned.

zh: 相反，最近中国核潜艇非法侵入日本领海的行为表明，反潜艇能力不但不应该削减，反而应该进一步增强。
en: On the contrary, recent illegal violation of Japanese territorial waters by Chinese nuclear submarines suggests that, rather than being reduced, ASW capability should be built up further.

zh: 如果日本真的决定削减这方面的防卫力量，则必须在质量上进行大胆的改变。
en: If Japan does decide to scale down its defense forces in this respect, a bold and qualitative change is inevitable.

zh: 具体来讲，这可能意味着引入迄今为止被认为是禁忌的设备，如轻型航空母舰或核潜艇。
en: In particular, this could mean the introduction of what has so far been viewed as somewhat taboo equipment, such as light aircraft carriers or nuclear submarines.

zh: 值此不确定时期，就连各国面临的威胁本身都不确定，日本的战略和军事策划者们必须继续寻找方法调整自卫队，以适应如今数不胜数的威胁。
en: In this age of uncertainty, when even the nature of the threats that nations face is uncertain, Japan’s strategic and military planners must continue to seek ways to adapt the SDF to today’s myriad current threats.

zh: 但是其方式必须能指出真正的方向，并且能让日本的人民、军队和邻国信服。
en: But they must do so in a way that provides genuine direction, and that Japan’s people, military, and neighbors find convincing.

zh: 遇到南墙的自由主义
en: Liberals to the Barricades

zh: 圣地亚哥—从奥地利、法国和美国到波兰、菲律宾和秘鲁，反自由民民粹主义者正在崛起。
en: SANTIAGO – From Austria, France and the United States, to Poland, the Philippines, and Peru, illiberal populists are on the rise.

zh: 一些人将此归咎于失控的全球化，一些人归咎于收入不平等，还有一些人归咎于根本没有意识到这一点的高高在上的精英。
en: Some blame runaway globalization; others blame income inequality; still others blame out-of-touch elites who simply don’t get it.

zh: 这些解释不管听起来多么合理，都没有切中要害。
en: Such explanations – however plausible they may be – miss the larger point.

zh: 问题在于政治，而不是经济。
en: The problem is political, not just economic.

zh: 自由民主是人类最伟大的政治成就。
en: Liberal democracy is humankind’s greatest political achievement.

zh: 但放眼全球，自由民主派都不愿振臂高呼。
en: Yet liberal democrats around the world are reluctant to make the case for it.

zh: 无怪乎他们正在失去民心和思想之战。
en: No wonder they are losing the battle for citizens’ hearts and minds.

zh: 问题并不新鲜。
en: The problem is far from new.

zh: 事实上，这正是反自由主义的根源。
en: In fact, it is at the very root of liberalism.

zh: 担心审查或压迫的自由主义思想家多半支持道德中性：他们不支持简单的价值观，或关于好生活的特定定义。
en: Wary of censorship or oppression, liberal thinkers have more often than not espoused moral neutrality: they do not advocate a single set of values, or a particular definition of what constitutes a good life.

zh: 自由社会 — — 几乎是顾名思义地 — — 让公民能按照自己的心意过生活，只要没有第三方遭到伤害。
en: A liberal society – almost by definition – enables its citizens to lead any life they wish, as long as third parties suffer no harm.

zh: 问题在于所有的政治都是亚里士多德政治：关注美德。
en: The problem is that politics everywhere is Aristotelian: concerned with virtue.

zh: 美国人不无道理地将他们的总统宝座称为“名望讲坛 ” （ bully pulpit ） 。
en: Americans refer to their presidency as a bully pulpit with good reason.

zh: 当政客支持某种特定类型的价值观 — — 或美德时，选民都会聆听。
en: When politicians advocate a particular set of values – or virtues – voters listen.

zh: 这可以十分笨拙，约翰·克里（John Kerry）接受2004年民主党总统候选提名时便是如此，他的讲话将“价值”一词重复了32次。
en: This can be done clumsily, as when John Kerry accepted the Democratic Party’s presidential nomination in 2004 with a speech that repeated the word “value” or “values” 32 times.

zh: 但这也可以充满威严，比如小罗伯特·肯尼迪斥责美国人“仅仅为了积累物质财富便拱手让出了个人美德和社会价值 ” 。
en: But it can also be done magisterially, as when Robert F. Kennedy Jr. chided Americans for surrendering “personal excellence and community values in the mere accumulation of material things.”

zh: GDP，他令人难以忘怀地继续说道 ， “ 衡量一切 … … 就是无法衡量让生命有价值的东西。 ”
en: GDP, he memorably added, “measures everything (...) except that which makes life worthwhile.”

zh: 从约翰·穆勒到约翰·罗尔斯再到玛莎·努斯鲍姆（Martha Nussbaum）的哲学家找到了一条走出自由主义的困惑的道路。
en: Philosophers from John Stuart Mill to John Rawls to Martha Nussbaum have sought a way out of liberalism’s quandary.

zh: 宣扬（远远没有到实施的成都）某个群体的价值观（不论宗教还是其他）是歧视性的，也是反自由的。
en: It would be discriminatory and illiberal to promote, much less impose, a particular group’s values, religious or otherwise.

zh: 但政府和政治领袖可以也 应该支持作为自由社会基础的共同价值观 — — 罗尔斯称之位“重叠的共识 ” 。
en: But governments and political leaders can and should advocate the shared values – what Rawls called the “overlapping consensus” – that define a liberal society.

zh: 比如，美国纪念马丁·路德·金的生日，这强调了种族平等的共同理想，也表明美国将献身于这一理想。
en: By commemorating Martin Luther King Jr.’s birthday, for example, the US both underscores and rededicates itself to the shared ideal of racial equality.

zh: 金本人也许正是让这些理想能够（也应该）得到捍卫的热情的最佳写照。
en: It was King himself who arguably provided the best example of the passion with which such ideals can (and should) be defended.

zh: 像他一样的人太少。
en: There are too few like him.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普和法国国民阵线领导人马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）这样的民粹主义者将热情用于恐惧和厌恶的政治。
en: Populists like Donald Trump and French National Front leader Marine Le Pen use passion in the service of a politics of fear and hatred.

zh: 相反，作为启蒙运动产物的自由民主派以最适合小规模的礼貌集会的语调宣传他们的政治理想 — — 将人的理性置于基本情绪之上。
en: By contrast, liberal democrats, products of the Enlightenment all, advocate for their political ideals – which value human reason above base emotions – in a tone best suited to small, polite gatherings.

zh: 这是个严重的问题。
en: This is a serious problem.

zh: “将影响情绪的领域拱手让给了反自由力量 ， ” 努斯鲍姆写道 ， “ 导致了他们在人心方面占尽优势，也有可能让人们认为自由主义价值观温吞又无聊。 ”
en: “Ceding the terrain of emotion-shaping to anti-liberal forces,” writes Nussbaum, “gives them a huge advantage in the people’s hearts and risks making people think of liberal values as tepid and boring.”

zh: 神经科学家史蒂芬·平克（Steven Pinker）告诉我们，理性和情感是同一枚精神硬币的两面。
en: Reason and emotion, neuroscientists like Steven Pinker tell us, are two sides of the same mental coin.

zh: 类似地，认知语言学家乔治·拉科夫（George Lakoff）借用心理学家德鲁·威斯腾（Drew Westen）的话，认为“情感在政治说服中是核心且合法的。
en: Likewise, cognitive linguist George Lakoff, drawing on work by psychologist Drew Westen, concludes that “emotion is both central and legitimate in political persuasion.

zh: 它的使用并非如启蒙运动思想那样属于非法诉求非理性。
en: Its use is not an illicit appeal to irrationality, as Enlightenment thought would have it.

zh: 恰当的情感是理性的。 ”
en: The proper emotions are rational.”

zh: 金在宣扬他的“梦想 ” — —一个他的孩子们“不会因为他们的肤色，而是因为他们的性格内容而获得平价”的社会时非常出色地理解了这一点。
en: King understood this very well when he proclaimed his “dream” of a society in which his children would “not be judged by the color of their skin but by the content of their character.”

zh: 如今，美国总统奥巴马是唯一的宣扬价值和美德的自由民主领导人。
en: Today, US President Barack Obama is the only liberal democratic leader who speaks the language of values and virtue.

zh: 奥巴马常常被批冷酷，有拒人千里之外的感觉，但他在宣传和平和互相尊重的共同生活能力是最可敬的自由主义美德时完全不会有这种感觉。
en: Obama is often criticized for being cool and aloof, and yet there is nothing of the sort in his promotion of the capacity to live together in peace and mutual respect as the most admirable liberal virtue of all.

zh: “我们每一个人都有坚定的信念 ， ” 他在2012年获胜演讲中说 ， “ 当我们经历艰难时光时，当我们作为一个国家做出重大决定时，都必然会激起热情，激起争议 ， ” 他将这称为“我们的自由的标志 ” 。
en: “Each of us has deeply held beliefs,” he said in his victory speech in 2012. “And when we go through tough times, when we make big decisions as a country, it necessarily stirs passions, stirs up controversy,” which he called “a mark of our liberty.”

zh: 但是 ， “ 尽管我们存在各种差异，但我们大部分人都对美国的未来怀有共同的希望 … … 我们信奉慷慨的美国，信奉激情四射的美国，信奉对在我们的学校中学习、在我们的国旗下宣誓的移民之女的梦想持开放态度的宽容的美国。 ”
en: And yet, “despite all our differences, most of us share certain hopes for America’s future...We believe in a generous America, in a compassionate America, in a tolerant America open to the dreams of an immigrant's daughter who studies in our schools and pledges to our flag.”

zh: 最后一句话表明奥巴马也明白自由民主所必须克服的另一个挑战：形成一个可信的我们。
en: That last line reveals that Obama is also aware of the other challenge liberal democracies must overcome: to shape a credible us.

zh: 民粹主义的例子仍然很能说明问题。
en: The populists’ example is again telling.

zh: 特朗普等右翼民粹主义者采取身份政治。
en: Right-wing populists such as Trump engage in identity politics.

zh: 伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）等左翼民粹主义者采取收入政治。
en: Left-wing populists such as Bernie Sanders engage in income politics.

zh: 哈佛大学的丹尼·罗德里克（Dani Rodrik）最近强调 ， “ 存在一个可以将愤怒引导过去的明确的‘他者 ’ 。 ”不管这个他者是中国出口商、墨西哥移民、推定的伊斯兰恐怖分子还是贪婪的华尔街银行家。
en: Whether it is Chinese exporters, Mexican immigrants, presumed Islamic terrorists, or greedy Wall Street bankers, “there is,” as Harvard’s Dani Rodrik recently stressed, “a clear ‘other’ toward which anger can be directed.”

zh: 自由民主需要明确，指责他者无法把我们引导到任何地方，而认定共同责任是构建更好的共同未来的唯一方法。
en: Liberal democrats need to make it clear that we get nowhere by blaming others, and that assuming shared responsibility is the only way to build a better shared future.

zh: 当然，降低收入和权力不平等的经济和政治改革对于我们自身的命运和做出可信的共同牺牲诉求来说都是不可或缺的。
en: Of course economic and political reforms that reduce inequality of income and power are indispensable, both for their own sake and to make appeals to shared sacrifice credible.

zh: 但同样不可或缺的是一种热情表达的道德信念，即“在我们的学校中学习的移民的女儿”是共同的我们中间的真正的一员，拥有完全的权利。
en: Yet just as indispensable is the moral conviction, passionately expressed, that the “immigrant's daughter who studies in our schools” is a genuine member, with full rights, of that common us.

zh: 在人类历史上，没有任何社会或政治组织比自由民主更加接近于实现人人机会平等的理想。
en: No social or political organization in human history has come closer than liberal democracy to realizing the ideal of equal opportunity for all.

zh: 我们还没有达到这一步。
en: We are not there yet.

zh: 但我们已经取得了很大的进步，而坚持自由民主价值观能让我们继续取得更大的进步。
en: But we have come a long way, and by sticking with liberal-democratic values we will go a longer way yet.

zh: 不要圣战和盲从者，不要特朗普和勒庞，不要查韦斯、马杜罗和普京，决不允许这些人破坏这个可能的梦想。
en: No jihadist or bigot, no Trump or Le Pen, no Chávez, Maduro, or Putin, should be allowed to destroy this possible dream.

zh: 不要害怕IMF
en: Don’t Fear the IMF

zh: 美国剑桥—在许多地方，国际货币基金组织（IMF）是一个人见人恨的组织。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The International Monetary Fund is, in many places, the organization that everybody loves to hate.

zh: 按照这些人的说法，IMF 对穷人、妇女、经济稳定和环境不利。
en: According to some, the IMF is bad for the poor, women, economic stability, and the environment.

zh: 因获得诺贝尔奖而拥有巨大影响力的约瑟夫·斯蒂格利茨（Joseph Stiglitz）指责IMF引起并恶化了人们求它解决的经济危机。
en: Joseph Stiglitz, whose influence is amplified by his Nobel Prize, blames the IMF for causing and then worsening the economic crises it was called on to resolve.

zh: 据说IMF这样做是为了拯救资本家和银行家，而不是普通群众。
en: The IMF purportedly does so to save capitalists and bankers, not ordinary people.

zh: 尽管这并非事实，但这一观点确实给IMF造成了极大的伤害，也制约了IMF做好事的能力。
en: Though untrue, this belief does enormous harm and limits the potential good that the IMF can do.

zh: 首先，我们来看看世界如何应对叙利亚等国家的难民危机和金融危机。
en: For starters, consider how the world deals with refugee crises, such as Syria’s, and the way it deals with financial crises.

zh: 顾名思义，联合国难民事务高级委员是个人而非机构。
en: As its name indicates, the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees is a person, not an institution.

zh: 他领导一个“办公室 ” ， 而非完善的组织。
en: He or she heads an “office,” not a full-fledged organization.

zh: 这一弱点迫使德国总理默克尔威逼其欧盟伙伴采取更加团结的措施应对寻求庇护者的持续涌入。
en: This weakness is what forced German Chancellor Angela Merkel to bully her European Union partners into a more coherent response to the ongoing influx of asylum-seekers.

zh: 相反，防止和解决金融危机的体系以一个完善的机构为基础，这个机构就是IMF。
en: By contrast, the system to prevent and resolve financial crises is anchored by a full-fledged institution: the IMF.

zh: 它也许并不完美，但是，与难民、人权或环境等领域相比，它已经领先了好几光年。
en: It may not be perfect, but, compared to areas such as refugees, human rights, or the environment, it is light-years ahead.

zh: 很容易误解IMF是干什么的。
en: It is easy to misunderstand what the IMF does.

zh: 它的大部分努力是为了防止危机。
en: The bulk of its efforts are dedicated to crisis prevention.

zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福在IMF和世界银行宣布成立的1944年布雷顿森林会议上说 ， “ 经济病很容易传染。
en: As Franklin D. Roosevelt said at the 1944 Bretton Woods Conference, where the IMF and the World Bank were established, “Economic diseases are highly communicable.

zh: 因此，每个国家的经济健康都应该得到其远近邻邦的恰当的关注。 ”
en: It follows, therefore, that the economic health of every country is a proper matter of concern to all its neighbors, near and distant.”

zh: 正因如此，当时与会的44国以及如今加入IMF的188国都同意要“就影响彼此的国际货币变化进行磋商和取得一致 … … 并且各国应该胡夏昂帮助以克服短期汇兑困难。
en: That is why the 44 countries in attendance, and the 188 that now belong to the IMF, agreed to “consult and agree on international monetary changes which affect each other… and they should assist each other to overcome short-term exchange difficulties.”

zh: ”在操作层面，这一点被写入了所谓的第四条磋商。
en: Operationally, this is expressed in so-called Article IV consultations.

zh: 这些IMF与成员国政府之间的正式政策讨论（常常每年进行一次）都被记录在案，由IMF理事会（Board of Executive Directors，代表所有188家政府）审核并在线发布供所有人浏览。
en: These formal policy discussions between the IMF and member governments, typically carried out annually, are written up, reviewed by the Fund’s Board of Executive Directors (representing all 188 governments), and published for anyone to read online.

zh: 这是解决其他问题的组织都应该效仿的集体监督和透明度标准。
en: This is a standard of collective surveillance and transparency to which organizations addressing other issues should aspire.

zh: IMF一直是开发各国可用于测量、评估和改善当前宏观经济状况的工具的重镇，包括财政和货币政策以及金融、货币和物价稳定。
en: The IMF has been instrumental in developing the tools with which countries measure, assess, and improve their current macroeconomic position: fiscal and monetary policy, as well as financial, currency, and price stability.

zh: IMF帮助各国寻找更好的方法实施所有这些领域的措施，并试图从许多国家的经验中认识广泛的教训，总结各国可能用到的选择。
en: It helps countries find better ways to implement measures in all of these fields, and it seeks to identify broad lessons from the experience of many countries that may shed light on the options that any particular country has.

zh: 通过对话、研究、建议、技术支持和培训，IMF帮助构建了一个全球实践界（community of practice ） 。
en: Through dialogue, research, advice, technical assistance, and training, the IMF has helped create a global community of practice.

zh: 如今，当央行行长或财政部长比当卫生部长或司法部长容易得多。
en: Today, it is much easier to be a central bank president or a finance minister than it is to be a minister of health or justice.

zh: 这不是因为他们面临的挑战更容易，而是因为以IMF为首的国际实践界提供了其他领域所没有的支持水平。
en: This is not because the challenges are easier, but because the international community of practice, led by the IMF, provides a level of support that simply does not exist in other areas.

zh: IMF最有争议的活动发生在危机管理和解决期间。
en: The IMF’s most controversial activities come during times of crisis management and resolution.

zh: 各国在陷入麻烦、失去或害怕失去在国际市场上借贷的能力时就会要求IMF给予金融援助。
en: Countries ask for IMF financial assistance when they are in trouble and have lost or fear losing the ability to borrow on international markets.

zh: IMF能够动员数千亿成员国资金，为借款国赢得时间重新自力更生。
en: The IMF can mobilize hundreds of billions of dollars of member countries’ money to give borrowers the time to get back on their feet.

zh: 其所拥有的资源比国际社会在其他问题上所能动员的总和还要多得多，因为它的钱是贷出去的，并假设可以获得偿付。
en: Its resources dwarf the sums that the international community can mobilize for other issues, because its money is lent and is supposed to be paid back.

zh: 作为金融支持的交换，IMF通常要求各国解决导致问题发生的失衡，这样它们不仅能够偿还IMF贷款，对其自身也有好处 — — 它们可以重新获得信誉（从而得以进入资本市场 ） 。
en: In exchange for its financial support, the IMF typically requires countries to address the imbalances that caused their problems, not only so that they can repay the money, but also for their own good, so that they can restore their creditworthiness (and hence their access to capital markets).

zh: 但这样就太容易了，根本不会混淆危机本身带来的痛苦和解决危机的办法带来的痛苦。
en: But it is too easy to confuse the pain caused by the crisis itself with that caused by the remedy.

zh: 诚然，IMF难免会犯错，这部分是因为它必须解决的问题和状况总是在变化，因此它永远不知道现有思维是否足以应对新挑战。
en: To be sure, the IMF inevitably makes mistakes, partly because the questions and issues it must address are constantly changing, so that it never knows whether the current state of thinking is adequate to new challenges.

zh: 但IMF足够开放，它能够也必须对其批评做出反应。
en: But it is a sufficiently open organization that it can and must be responsive to its critics.

zh: 现在我们来看看替代方案。
en: Now consider the alternative.

zh: 没有IMF的世界看上去就像今天的委内瑞拉。
en: A world without the IMF looks a lot like today’s Venezuela.

zh: 查韦斯（Hugo Chávez）是IMF批评者的最爱，斯蒂格利茨就是如此 — — 具体可参见他2004年对第四条磋商的质疑。
en: Hugo Chávez became the darling of IMF bashers, including Stiglitz, when he suspended Article IV consultations in 2004.

zh: 结果，委内瑞拉无法获得它有义务通过IMF与世界共享的基本经济信息。
en: As a consequence, Venezuelans lost access to the basic economic information that the country is obligated to share, through the IMF, with the world.

zh: 这一断层阻止了国际社会在委内瑞拉采取真正不负责任政策时的声音。 2012年，委内瑞拉花钱之大方好像油价仍在每桶197美元，而非107美元。
en: The break prevented the international community from expressing its voice as the country undertook truly irresponsible policies, spending in 2012 as if the price of oil was $197 a barrel, not $107.

zh: 此后，随着石油价格的崩盘，委内瑞拉经济也陷入了混乱：GDP以创纪录的速度缩水，通货膨胀率超过200 % ， 货币价值暴跌超过90 % ， 各种短缺层出不穷。
en: With the collapse in the price of oil since then, the economy has gone into a tailspin: GDP is contracting at a record pace, inflation is in excess of 200%, the currency has plunged to less than 10% of its previous value, and massive shortages have emerged.

zh: 委内瑞拉求助于中国国家开发银行为其融资，该银行不会对委内瑞拉施加IMF批评者所不喜欢的条件。
en: Venezuela has tried to finance itself with the help of the China Development Bank, which does not impose the kind of conditionality that IMF bashers dislike.

zh: 相反，它根据秘密条款发放贷款，贷款用途秘而不宣并且腐败，而中国公司在诸多领域取得特权，包括通讯业（华为 ） 、 电器（海尔 ） 、 汽车（奇瑞）和钻井（ICTV）等。
en: Instead, the CDB lends on secret terms, for uses that are undisclosed and corrupt, and with built-in privileges for Chinese companies in areas like telecommunications (Huawei), appliances (Haier), cars (Chery), and oil drilling (ICTV).

zh: 中国人不要求委内瑞拉采取任何行动增加重获信誉的可能性。
en: The Chinese have not required that Venezuela do anything to increase the likelihood that it regains creditworthiness.

zh: 他们只是要求更多的石油作为抵押。
en: They merely demand more oil as collateral.

zh: 不管IMF犯过多么严重的错误，中国国家开发银行的做法都是一个丑闻。
en: Whatever the IMF’s faults, the CDB is a disgrace.

zh: 悲剧的是，大部分委内瑞拉人（以及其他国家的许多公民）认为IMF做得坏事比好事多。
en: The tragedy is that most Venezuelans (and many citizens of other countries) believe that the IMF is there to hurt, not help.

zh: 结果，他们在经济危机期间回避国际社会能够提供的缓解痛苦、加快复苏的大量资源和智慧。
en: As a consequence, they eschew the massive resources and wisdom that the international community can offer at a time of economic crisis to lessen the pain and hasten recovery.

zh: 这给他们带来了更大的痛苦，而IMF批评者是不会承认这一点的。
en: That has left them far worse off than the IMF bashers can bring themselves to admit.

zh: 为经济民粹主义辩护
en: In Defense of Economic Populism

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 民粹主义者厌恶那些对政治行为的限制。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Populists abhor restraints on the political executive.

zh: 在他们看来，既然自己就是“人民”这个庞大群体的代表，那么对他们行使权力的限制肯定就是破坏民意。
en: Since they claim to represent “the people” writ large, they regard limits on their exercise of power as necessarily undermining the popular will.

zh: 如此类推，这种限制只能服务于那些“人民公敌 ” — —少数群体和外国人（对于右翼民粹主义者来说）或金融精英（就左翼民粹主义者而言 ） 。
en: Such constraints can only serve the “enemies of the people” – minorities and foreigners (for right-wing populists) or financial elites (in the case of left-wing populists).

zh: 这在政治上是种危险之举，因为它让大多数人凌驾于少数人的权利之上。
en: This is a dangerous approach to politics, because it allows a majority to ride roughshod over the rights of minorities.

zh: 一旦失去了那些所有那些民粹主义独裁者 — — 从俄罗斯总统普京和土耳其总理埃尔多安，到匈牙利总理维克多·奥尔班以及美国总统特朗普 — — 所痛恨的权力分立，独立司法机构或自由媒体，民主就会堕落为碰巧掌权者的暴政。
en: Without separation of powers, an independent judiciary, or free media – which all populist autocrats, from Vladimir Putin and Recep Tayyip Erdoğan to Viktor Orbán and Donald Trump detest – democracy degenerates into the tyranny of whoever happens to be in power.

zh: 因此民粹统治下的定期选举也就成了遮羞布。
en: Periodic elections under populist rule become a smokescreen.

zh: 在缺乏法治和基本公民自由的情况下，民粹主义政权可以通过操纵媒体和司法机构来延长其统治。
en: In the absence of the rule of law and basic civil liberties, populist regimes can prolong their rule by manipulating the media and the judiciary at will.

zh: 民粹主义者对制度约束的厌恶也扩展到了经济方面，在“为了人民利益”为名进行全面控制意味着各类自治监管机构，独立中央银行或全球贸易规则都不得为他们的横冲直撞设立任何障碍。
en: Populists’ aversion to institutional restraints extends to the economy, where exercising full control “in the people’s interest” implies that no obstacles should be placed in their way by autonomous regulatory agencies, independent central banks, or global trade rules.

zh: 而虽然政治领域的民粹主义几乎都有害无利，但经济上的民粹主义有时却是有道理的。
en: But while populism in the political domain is almost always harmful, economic populism can sometimes be justified.

zh: 让我们首先从人们为何希望对经济政策加以限制开始讨论。
en: Start with why restraints on economic policy may be desirable in the first place.

zh: 经济学家倾向于实施这样的限制，因为完全响应国内政治波动的政策制定可能会产生极为低效率的后果。
en: Economists tend to have a soft spot for such restraints, because policymaking that is fully responsive to the push and pull of domestic politics can generate highly inefficient outcomes.

zh: 尤其是经济政策往往受到经济学家称之为时间不一致性问题的困扰：短期利益经常会阻碍一些长期上更有益的政策的实施。
en: In particular, economic policy is often subject to the problem of what economists call time-inconsistency: short-term interests frequently undermine the pursuit of policies that are far more desirable in the long term.

zh: 一个典型的例子是那种所谓随机应变式货币政策。
en: A canonical example is discretionary monetary policy.

zh: 有权力随意印钞票的政客可能会在短期内产生“惊人的通货膨胀”以提振产出和就业，比如选举之前。
en: Politicians who have the power to print money at will may generate “surprise inflation” to boost output and employment in the short run – say, before an election.

zh: 但此举的不利之处在于企业和家庭都会调整其通胀预期。
en: But this backfires, because firms and households adjust their inflation expectations.

zh: 最终应变式货币政策只会导致更高通胀而无从产生任何产出或就业收益。
en: In the end, discretionary monetary policy results only in higher inflation without yielding any output or employment gains.

zh: 对此的解决方案应该是独立的中央银行，与政治绝缘，完全依赖其维持价格稳定的政治授权而运作。
en: The solution is an independent central bank, insulated from politics, operating solely on its mandate to maintain price stability.

zh: 宏观经济民粹主义的代价是拉丁美洲屡见不鲜。
en: The costs of macroeconomic populism are familiar from Latin America.

zh: 正如杰弗里·D·沙斯（Jeffrey D. Sachs ） ， 塞巴斯蒂安·爱德华斯（Sebastián Edwards）和鲁迪格尔·多恩布什（Rüdiger Dornbusch）多年前所提出的那样，不可持续的货币和财政政策是该区域的灾难之源，而情况直到1990年代实现经济正规化后才开始改观。
en: As Jeffrey D. Sachs, Sebastián Edwards, and Rüdiger Dornbusch argued years ago, unsustainable monetary and fiscal policies were the bane of the region until economic orthodoxy began to prevail in the 1990s.

zh: 民粹主义政策会周期性地带来痛苦的经济危机，而其中受害最深的莫过于穷人。
en: Populist policies periodically produced painful economic crises, which hurt the poor the most.

zh: 为了打破这一循环，该地区政府都纷纷转向制定财政规则并任命技术专家型的财政部长。
en: To break this cycle, the region turned to fiscal rules and technocratic finance ministers.

zh: 另一个例子是外国投资者所受到的官方待遇。
en: Another example is official treatment of foreign investors.

zh: 一旦一家外国企业进行了投资，它就基本上只能任由东道国政府摆布了。
en: Once a foreign firm makes its investment, it essentially becomes captive to the host government’s whims.

zh: 政府经常会忘记为吸引企业而做出的承诺，取而代之的则是一些为本国预算或国内企业的利益而压榨外资企业的政策。
en: Promises that were made to attract the firm are easily forgotten, replaced by policies that squeeze it to the benefit of the national budget or domestic companies.

zh: 但投资方也不是笨蛋，它们会因担心这一结果而到别处投资。
en: But investors are not stupid, and, fearing this outcome, they invest elsewhere.

zh: 因此，政府需要建立自己的信誉，依据所谓的投资者-国家争端解决条款（investor-state dispute settlement）达成贸易协议，允许该企业在国际法庭上起诉相关政府。
en: Governments’ need to establish their credibility has thus given rise to trade agreements with so-called investor-state dispute settlement (ISDS) clauses, allowing the firm to sue the government in international tribunals.

zh: 这都是一些以授权自治机构，技术专家或外部规则的形式实施经济政策限制的例子。
en: These are examples of restraints on economic policy that take the form of delegation to autonomous agencies, technocrats, or external rules.

zh: 如上所述，它们所发挥的宝贵作用就是防止当权者为追求短视政策而搬石头砸了自己的脚。
en: As described, they serve the valuable function of preventing those in power from shooting themselves in the foot by pursuing short-sighted policies.

zh: 然而还存在其他一些经济政策限制措施出现反效果的情况。
en: But there are other scenarios as well, in which the consequences of restraints on economic policy may be less salutary.

zh: 特别是那些由特殊利益集团或精英自身制定以巩固永久决策控制权的限制。
en: In particular, restraints may be instituted by special interests or elites themselves, to cement permanent control over policymaking.

zh: 在这种情况下，委派自治机构或签署全球规则无法服务于社会，只会有利于一小撮“内部人士 ” 。
en: In such cases, delegation to autonomous agencies or signing on to global rules does not serve society, but only a narrow caste of “insiders.”

zh: 当前的民粹主义反弹也部分根源于这一信念，而且不是完全没有道理的，这种情况解释了近几十年来的许多经济决策。
en: Part of today’s populist backlash is rooted in the belief, not entirely unjustified, that this scenario describes much economic policymaking in recent decades.

zh: 跨国企业和投资者日益塑造了国际贸易谈判的议程，打造了一个以牺牲劳动者为代价来令资本过分得益的全球体制。
en: Multinational corporations and investors have increasingly shaped the agenda of international trade negotiations, resulting in global regimes that disproportionately benefit capital at the expense of labor.

zh: 严格的专利规则和国际投资者法庭是最好的例子。
en: Stringent patent rules and international investor tribunals are prime examples.

zh: 自治机构被本应由它们管制的行业所占领。
en: So is the capture of autonomous agencies by the industries they are supposed to regulate.

zh: 银行和其他金融机构在夺取控制权和制定让它们可以自由行事的规则方面极为成功。
en: Banks and other financial institutions have been especially successful at getting their way and instituting rules that give them free rein.

zh: 独立的中央银行在1980年代和90年代的通货膨胀率下降中发挥了关键作用。
en: Independent central banks played a critical role in bringing inflation down in the 1980s and 1990s.

zh: 但是在当前的低通胀环境下，它们对价格稳定的专注给经济政策带来了通缩倾向，同时也对就业的产生和增长造成了影响。
en: But in the current low-inflation environment, their exclusive focus on price stability imparts a deflationary bias to economic policy and is in tension with employment generation and growth.

zh: 而这种“自由技术官僚”地位最高的地方可能是欧盟，因为在欧盟的设计中就是要在很大程度上将经济规则和条例从国家一级的民主审议中抽离出来。
en: Such “liberal technocracy” may be at its apogee in the European Union, where economic rules and regulations are designed at considerable remove from democratic deliberation at the national level.

zh: 实际上在每一个成员国里，这个政治上的差距 — — 也就是欧盟所谓的民主赤字 — — 正是民粹主义和欧洲怀疑论政党兴起的原因。
en: And in virtually every member state, this political gap – the EU’s so-called democratic deficit – has given rise to populist, Euroskeptical political parties.

zh: 在这种情况下，放松对经济政策的制约，将决策自主权归还给民选政府也是可取之举。
en: In such cases, relaxing the constraints on economic policy and returning policymaking autonomy to elected governments may well be desirable.

zh: 特殊的时代需要有在经济政策上进行试验的自由空间。
en: Exceptional times require the freedom to experiment in economic policy.

zh: 为此富兰克林·D·罗斯福的新政就提供了一个恰当的历史事例。
en: Franklin D. Roosevelt’s New Deal provides an apt historical example.

zh: 罗斯福的改革要求他去消除国内保守派法官和经济利益集团以及国外的金本位制度所施加的经济枷锁。
en: FDR’s reforms required that he remove the economic shackles imposed by conservative judges and financial interests at home and by the gold standard abroad.

zh: 我们应该时刻警惕那些扼杀政治多元化并破坏自由民主规范的民粹主义。
