en: We should constantly be wary of populism that stifles political pluralism and undermines liberal democratic norms.

zh: 政治民粹主义是一种必须不惜一切代价去避免的威胁。
en: Political populism is a menace to be avoided at all costs.

zh: 相反，经济民粹主义偶尔也是必要的。
en: Economic populism, by contrast, is occasionally necessary.

zh: 事实上，在这些时候，它可能是遏制其更为危险的政治分支崛起的唯一途径。
en: Indeed, at such times, it may be the only way to forestall its much more dangerous political cousin.

zh: 为全球化辩护
en: In Defense of Globalization

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 我最近前往美丽的智利出席了未来大会（Futures Congress ） ， 并趁此游历了一番拉丁美洲的最南端。
en: LONDON – I was recently in beautiful Chile for a Futures Congress, and I had a chance to travel south to the very tip of Latin America.

zh: 此外最近我还制作了一部BBC广播纪录片《应对全球化 》 ， 并在全英国范围内征集改进本片某些方面内容的看法，同时与一些知名专家讨论了诸多人们关注的话题。
en: I also recently made a BBC radio documentary called “Fixing Globalization,” in which I crisscrossed the United Kingdom in search of ideas for improving certain aspects of it and discussed topical issues with well-known experts.

zh: 在这两个过程中，我的所见所闻使我确信，需要人们为全球化辩护的时代已经过去了。
en: In both cases, I saw things that convinced me that it is past time for someone to come to globalization’s defense.

zh: 智利如今是拉丁美洲最富有的国家，人均国内生产总值约为2.3万美元 — — 与一众中欧国家看齐。
en: Chile today is Latin America’s richest country, with per capita GDP of around $23,000 – similar to that of Central European countries.

zh: 这对一个高度依赖铜矿产业的国家来说堪称一项相当大的成就，也使智利抛离了许多邻国。
en: This is quite an achievement for a country that depends so heavily on copper production, and it sets Chile apart from many of its neighbors.

zh: 然而跟其它许多国家一样，智利也面临多项经济挑战，其增长率还不尽如人意；但它也拥有许多在其国境之外的切实发展机遇。
en: Like many other countries, Chile is facing economic challenges, and its growth rate leaves something to be desired; but it also has many promising opportunities beyond its borders.

zh: 例如，当我牵头组织一项针对抗菌素耐药性的调查报告时，我了解到铜具有强大的抗菌性能，是用来制造那些经常附着和传播细菌的医疗保健设施的理想材料。
en: For example, when I led a review on antimicrobial resistance, I learned that copper has powerful antibacterial properties and is an ideal material for use in health-care facilities where bacteria often spread.

zh: 这意味着智利，澳大利亚和加拿大等铜生产国可以通过向世界各地的医院和其他临床环境中输出价格合理的铜质基础设施来改善全球卫生状况 — — 并提高本国出口量。
en: This means that copper producers such as Chile, Australia, and Canada can improve global health – and boost exports – by introducing affordable copper infrastructure into hospitals and other clinical settings around the world.

zh: 智利也是一个应对地震和海啸的知识库。
en: Chile is also a storehouse of knowledge for managing earthquakes and tsunamis.

zh: 我访问了在2015年经历了有史以来第六强的地震的拉塞雷纳市（La Serena ） 。
en: While I was there, I visited La Serena, which in 2015 experienced the sixth-strongest earthquake ever recorded.

zh: 地震在该地引发的海啸只造成了11人丧生，试想要是发生在世界其它地区，伤亡数字肯定远不止于此。
en: But the ensuing tsunami killed only 11 people, though it surely would have killed far more in many other places.

zh: 而智利官方的提前准备和快速反应似乎是造成这一差别的原因。
en: Chilean officials’ advanced preparation and rapid response seems to have made the difference.

zh: 拥有如此丰富的灾害预防制度经验，智利可以成为其它受地震威胁国家的知识宝库。
en: With so much institutional experience, Chile can be a valuable resource for other countries threatened by seismic events.

zh: 拉塞雷纳还是世界上最好的天文观测点之一，吸引着来自全球各地的顶尖天文学家前来访问。
en: La Serena is also near one of the world’s best stargazing sites, which attracts leading astronomers from around the globe.

zh: 事实上，智利为全球各国科学家构建了非常卓越的合作平台，在某种程度上是因为其就在南极洲北面 — — 而南极洲一直都是开展科学和环境合作的绝佳地区。
en: In fact, Chile hosts much remarkable collaboration among the world’s scientists, in part because it is just north of the Antarctic – long a site for scientific and environmental cooperation.

zh: 除智利之外的另一件值得关注的事件是中国国家主席习近平今年出席了达沃斯世界经济论坛年会。
en: Beyond Chile, it is interesting that Chinese President Xi Jinping is attending the World Economic Forum’s Annual Meeting in Davos this year.

zh: 随着唐纳德·特朗普当选美国总统，英国正在退出欧盟，我本以为这样一个精英论坛的影响力已是明日黄花了。
en: Now that Donald Trump has been elected President of the United States, and the United Kingdom is withdrawing from the European Union, I had assumed that such an elitist event’s glory days were behind it.

zh: 但习近平的出席表明中国正在探索自身在世界舞台上的定位，以及研究当西方势力向内收敛的时候，可以将哪些全球化元素转化为自身的优势。
en: Xi’s presence suggests that China is exploring where it can position itself on the world stage, and which elements of globalization it can harness to its advantage, now that Western powers are turning inward.

zh: 事实上，正如中国驻英大使在我的广播节目中所指出的那样，中国已经是至少70个国家的最大进口国 — — 你没看错，是进口国 — — 占全球总进口量的10-11 ％ 。
en: Indeed, as the Chinese ambassador to the UK pointed out on my radio program, China is already the largest importer – yes, importer – for at least 70 countries, and accounts for about 10-11% of all imports globally.

zh: 尽管存在着一些所谓的经济挑战，但在2020年之前，中国可能会成为比欧盟更大的进口目的地，而且很快就会超过美国。
en: Despite its supposed economic challenges, China will likely be a bigger importer than the EU before this decade is over, and it will probably surpass the US soon thereafter.

zh: 此外，在过去20年中由于中国的崛起以及亚洲拉丁美洲和其他地区的经济发展，各国之间的经济不平等状况得到了大幅改善。
en: Moreover, economic inequality among countries has declined sharply in the past 20 years, owing partly to China’s rise, as well as to economic development across Asia, Latin America, and elsewhere.

zh: 事实上在2010年联合国已经实现了原定在2015年实现的将贫穷人口减少一半的千年发展目标，而最近的预测表明，到2050年，除非洲以外的其它所有地方都将消除贫困。
en: In fact, by 2010, the United Nations had already achieved its Millennium Development Goal of halving poverty by 2015, and recent projections suggest that, by 2050, poverty will be eradicated everywhere except Africa.

zh: 没有全球化，这一切都无法成为现实。
en: This will not happen without globalization.

zh: 非洲国家之间尤其需要进行更多的贸易，并且探讨建立一个非洲自由贸易区。
en: African countries, in particular, will need to trade more with one another, and there is talk of creating an African free-trade area.

zh: 但这项工作随着反贸易情绪不断上涨也可能面临困难。
en: But this could prove difficult now that anti-trade sentiment is on the rise.

zh: 那么那些全球化的批评者 — — 那些错误地将其视为零和游戏的人 — — 是否就是反对消除全球贫困的呢？
en: Are globalization’s critics – those who wrongly consider it a zero-sum game – against eradicating global poverty?

zh: 决策者可以采取行动来减少人们对全球化的忧虑。
en: Policymakers can take action to alleviate anxieties about globalization.

zh: 首先，全球GDP份额中似乎无限增长的利润部分必须停止。
en: For starters, the seemingly endless growth of profits as a share of global GDP must stop.

zh: 任何觉得这听起来激进的人都需要刷新对经济学的认知。
en: Anyone who thinks this sounds radical needs to brush up on economics.

zh: 更高的利润会吸引新的市场进入者，并最终通过竞争削薄原有经营者的利润。
en: Higher profits should attract new market entrants, which would then erode incumbents’ profits through competition.

zh: 但事实上这一情况却并未出现，表明某些市场已被操纵或完全失灵。
en: The fact that this isn’t happening suggests that some markets have been rigged, or have simply failed.

zh: 对此决策者需要在某些领域加强监管来解决这一问题。
en: Policymakers need to address this with stronger regulation in some areas.

zh: 举个例子，正如我以前所呼吁的那样，目前的市场监管环境对股票回购项目太过纵容了。
en: For example, as I have previously argued, the current climate is far too permissive of share-repurchase programs.

zh: 与此同时，政策制定者需要采取措施提高最低收入者的工资，这实际上将有助于提高生产率，因为资本相对于劳动力的成本更低。
en: At the same time, policymakers need to pursue measures to increases wages for the lowest earners, which could actually help boost productivity as capital becomes less expensive relative to labor.

zh: 而且，正如世界银行行长金勇最近为我指出的那样，我们需要加强相关贸易协定法律的执行力度，并更多地帮助那些因这些交易而受影响的国内部门。
en: And, as World Bank President Jim Yong Kim recently pointed out to me, we need to strengthen enforcement of laws governing trade deals, and do more to help challenged domestic sectors that lose out as a result of those deals.

zh: 这让我想起了一个悲伤的故事，一些英格兰西米德兰都市区伍尔弗汉普顿市（Wolverhampton）的固特异轮胎厂下岗工人告诉我，他们在布告栏上看见了自己失去的岗位，但如果想重新申请的话就必须前往墨西哥。
en: This reminds me of a sad story I heard from some laid-off Goodyear Tire workers in Wolverhampton, in England’s West Midlands. They told me that job listings for their lost positions were posted on a notice board, and they could re-apply for them if they wanted to move to Mexico.

zh: 工人们猜测，公司在英国关闭工厂要比在法国或德国关闭那些生产率更低的工厂更容易。
en: The workers surmised that it was easier for the company to close its factory in the UK than to close even less productive factories in France or Germany.

zh: 而这样的变革本应得到更妥善地处理。
en: Surely changes like this can be handled better.

zh: 最后，决策者需要确定发展项目的优先级，例如将英国的“北部发展引擎”和“中部地区发展引擎”列入优先发展规划，并在其他地区启动更多的类似项目。
en: Lastly, policymakers need to prioritize development projects such as the UK’s “northern powerhouse” and “Midlands engine.” And more such initiatives should be launched elsewhere.

zh: 尽管创造了许多挑战，但全球化也使世界成为了比原先更好的所在。
en: Despite the many challenges it has created, globalization has made the world a better place than it otherwise would have been.

zh: 如今我们也仍然需要它来消除贫穷，为所有人提供更高的生活水平。
en: And we still need it to eradicate poverty and generate higher living standards for all.

zh: 什么是国际社会？
en: What Is the International Community?

zh: 巴黎—尽管人们频繁使用“国际社会”一词，但其准确含义 — — 就像其起源 — — 很难弄清楚。
en: PARIS – Despite the frequency with which the phrase “international community” is invoked, its precise meaning – like its origins – is difficult to discern.

zh: 正如法国近期对马里的干预所显示的，这一模糊性的根源在于当今世界最紧迫的外交政策问题。
en: And, as France’s recent intervention in Mali has shown, this ambiguity lies at the root of many of today’s most urgent foreign-policy problems.

zh: 在一些人看来，国际社会根本不存在。
en: For some, an international community simply does not exist.

zh: 也有人比较实际，认为这个词意指决定集体行动的所有国家。
en: For others, the term refers, more pragmatically, to all countries when they decide to act together.

zh: 还有一些人使用更准确地定义，即包括所有具有国际影响的国家 — — 任何身份和主权得到承认并选择参与国际讨论和决策的国家。
en: Still another, more accurate definition encompasses all countries with international influence – that is, any country whose identity and sovereignty is recognized, and that chooses to participate in global discussions and decision-making.

zh: 在语义学之外是后果更严重但同样不清不楚的问题 — — 国际社会的角色和责任。
en: Beyond semantics lies the more consequential, but equally ambiguous, question of the international community’s role and responsibility.

zh: 太宽泛的定义会破坏一国的主权，太狭窄的定义 — — 比如主宰当今世界之物 — — 又会让暴力和动荡蔓延。
en: Just as too broad a definition could undermine a country’s sovereignty, too narrow a definition – like that which seems to predominate today – allows violence and instability to proliferate.

zh: 几百年来，主权国家用条约约束彼此之间的关系 — — 从结束战争和划定边界到建立外交特权和进行贸易。
en: For centuries, sovereign states have regulated their relations – from ending wars and demarcating borders to establishing diplomatic privileges and conducting trade – with treaties.

zh: 这些正式协定加起来组成了国际法，国际法通过设定所有人适用的严格明晰的概念和实施制裁 — — 对违反国际法的一致指责 — — 补偿具体惩罚措施的缺乏。
en: Together, these official agreements comprise international law, which compensates for its lack of specific penalties by establishing strict and unambiguous concepts and one overarching sanction – universal blame for its transgression – that matters to everybody.

zh: 但是，在几百年的缔约史中，国与国之间的暴力从未消失。
en: And yet, throughout these centuries of treaty-making, violence between countries persisted.

zh: 因此各国开始通过建立共同机构来深化和发展国际法。
en: So countries began to deepen and develop international law by building shared institutions.

zh: 这一过程静悄悄地开始 — — 1874年成立了Union Générale des Postes，即日后的万国邮盟，并在没有国际协定需要的区域鲜为人知地运行着。
en: The process began quietly, with the establishment in 1874 of the Union Générale des Postes (which later became the Universal Postal Union), and went virtually unnoticed by those in fields that lacked any need for global agreements.

zh: 但是，第一次世界大战凸显出需要更强的国际合作来维持和平，这催生了国际联盟。
en: The devastation of World War I, however, highlighted the need for stronger international cooperation on peace-keeping, leading to the establishment of the League of Nations.

zh: 但这一组织软弱而低效，主要原因是美国拒绝在国际联盟宪章上签字。
en: But the organization was weak and inefficient, largely owing to the United States’ refusal to ratify its charter.

zh: 结果，国际联盟没能完成它的主要目标 — — 防止有一场世界大战。
en: As a result, it failed to accomplish its primary objective of preventing another world war.

zh: 第二次世界大战爆发后，成立了更强大、更有影响力的机构 — — 联合国。
en: In the wake of World War II, a stronger and more influential institution – the United Nations – was established.

zh: 联合国在人类社会的每一个方面都设有专门机构，成功地支持了去殖民地化、帮助世界各地人民建立国家、避免了地区冲突（特别是以色列和巴勒斯坦）的蔓延。
en: The UN, which has a specialized agency for each aspect of a humane society, has successfully supported decolonization, helped to build states, and averted the spread of regional conflicts, especially that between Israelis and Palestinians.

zh: 联合国的努力还使人们根除了许多传染病，使人们在1982年通过了处理海事纠纷的海洋法公约（Convention on the Law of the Sea ） 、 在1988年成立了政府间气候变化委员会（Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change，其定期报告在评估气候变化��关风险方面起着重要作用 ） 。
en: UN efforts have also led to the eradication of many infectious diseases; the adoption in 1982 of the Convention on the Law of the Sea, the principal framework for handling maritime disputes; and the establishment in 1988 of the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, whose regular reports play an important role in assessing hazards related to climate change.

zh: 但联合国无法遏制冷战、阿尔及利亚战争、越南战争和南斯拉夫战争，也无法阻止柬埔寨和卢旺达的种族灭绝。
en: But the UN was unable to avert the Cold War, wars in Algeria, Vietnam, and Yugoslavia, or genocide in Cambodia and Rwanda.

zh: 与预期相反，共产主义的崩溃并未增进国际合作。
en: Contrary to expectations, the collapse of communism did not bolster international cooperation.

zh: 相反，20世纪末以来的所有国际谈判 — — 关于全球变暖、金融监管和核裁军（尽管美国总统奥巴马和前俄罗斯总统梅德韦杰夫达成了双边核裁军协定）等问题皆是如此 — — 都失败了。
en: On the contrary, all international negotiations – on global warming, financial regulation, and nuclear disarmament (despite the efforts of US President Barack Obama and former Russian President Dmitri Medvedev to conclude a bilateral nuclear-disarmament agreement) – launched since the end of the twentieth century have failed.

zh: 另一大力量 — — 全球公共舆论 — — 也需要用来加强和扩张国际法的范畴。
en: Another force – global public opinion – is needed to strengthen and expand the scope of international law.

zh: 事实上，由非政府组织带动的全球公共舆论促使政府签署了不少条约，比如1997年的禁止地雷公约（Mine Ban Treaty ） 、 成立了不少机构，比如1998年的国际刑事法庭（International Criminal Court ） 。
en: Indeed, global public opinion, galvanized by the actions of NGOs, has pushed governments to sign treaties, such as the 1997 Mine Ban Treaty, and to establish international institutions, such as the International Criminal Court in 1998.

zh: 全球公共舆论的渠道应该加强，以迫使国际社会在新领域承担起责任来。
en: Global public opinion should be channeled more effectively in order to compel the international community to take responsibility in new areas.

zh: 这需要更敏锐的关于威胁领土和全世界人民的暴力和混乱（包括索马里、海地、利比里亚、塞拉利昂以及最近的马里）的集体意识。
en: This will require a more acute collective awareness of the violence and chaos threatening territories and people worldwide, including in Somalia, Haiti, Liberia, Sierra Leone, and, most recently, Mali.

zh: 1月，在西非地区已无战略和经济利益的法国响应了马里人民和看守领导人的要求，干预阻止了来自利比亚和阿尔及利亚的伊斯兰叛军入侵该国。
en: In January, France, which no longer has strategic or economic interests in western Africa, responded to a request from Mali’s citizens and caretaker leaders to intervene to prevent Islamist rebels from Libya and Algeria from overrunning the country.

zh: 在法军成功将占领军从马里北部驱除出境四个月后，大部分法国部队和装备已经调回国内。
en: Four months after France’s military operation successfully expelled occupying forces from northern Mali, most French troops and equipment are headed home.

zh: 这次干预缺少国际社会支持，国际社会（除了英国）没有理解法国决定背后的责任。
en: The intervention lacked the support of the international community, which, with the exception of the United Kingdom, failed to understand the sense of responsibility that underpinned France’s decision.

zh: 但是，在法军撤出、马里极度需要重建之时，国际社会必须采取新角度提供支持。
en: But, with French forces on their way out and Mali desperately in need of rebuilding, the international community must adopt a new perspective and offer its support.

zh: 作为国际社会的旗帜，联合国已经在马里部署了维和部队。
en: The UN, which carries the mantle for the international community, has already deployed a peacekeeping force to Mali.

zh: 此外，根据其规则和实践，联合国还呼吁举行总统选举，目前选举日期定在7月28日。
en: Moreover, in accordance with its regulations and practices, the UN has called for a presidential election, which has now been set for July 28.

zh: 但是，由于马里缺少受公共支持的政党、受到尊敬的候选人以及永久性的投票站体系，如此仓促地举行选举可能导致国际公职人员执政 — — 这样的结果可能令内部冲突重燃。
en: But, given that Mali lacks political parties with popular support, candidates who command respect, and a permanent polling-station system, an election held so soon would probably bring an international civil servant to power – an outcome that could reignite internal conflicts.

zh: 让马里恢复安全需要村落和部落领袖之间的对话。
en: Restoring security in Mali requires dialogues between village and tribal leaders.

zh: 类似地，重建马里基础设施依赖于现存市政当局和村落领袖的谈判。
en: Likewise, rebuilding the country’s infrastructure depends on talks between any remaining municipal authorities and village leaders.

zh: 两个过程都需要时间，没有外部支持，一个也无法成功完成。
en: Both processes will take time, and neither can be completed successfully without external support.

zh: 缺少政府的国家无法自力更生地完成危机后重建。
en: A country that lacks a government cannot rebuild after a crisis without help.

zh: 这并不意味着仅仅因为联合国规则的需要就必须继之以不现实的、可能造成危险的选举仪式。
en: That does not mean forcing it to follow an unrealistic and potentially dangerous electoral ritual just because it is embedded in UN regulations.

zh: 国际社会应该支持马里的逐渐新生 — — 在该国饱受冲突的社会的基础上。
en: The international community should support Mali’s gradual process of renewal where it counts – on the ground in the country’s conflict-battered communities.

zh: 而这取决于全球公众是否支持这一思想。
en: And it is up to the global public to stand up for that idea.

zh: 通缩和民主
en: Deflation and Democracy

zh: 普林斯顿－金融历史中的一部分，是努力寻找测量价值安全而稳定的方法的历史。
en: PRINCETON – The history of finance is partly the history of a struggle for a stable, secure way to measure value.

zh: 然而，像对我们这个不可预知的世界的确定性的任何其他探求一样，这注定是要失败的。
en: And, like any quest for certainty in our unpredictable world, it was doomed to failure.

zh: 当最近的金融危机摧毁了我们能够为资产确定一个精准的价格这一看法的同时，它也有力地突显了这一弱点。
en: The latest financial crisis powerfully highlights this vulnerability, as it destroys any sense that we can put an accurate price on assets.

zh: 现在，许多人深信这一缺陷是金融体系所固有的。
en: Most people are now convinced that this shortcoming is inherent in the financial system.

zh: 但是，有关价值的不确定性也暴露了政治秩序深层次的问题。
en: But uncertainties about value also expose deep problems in the political order.

zh: 在过去，金属货币为价值问题提供了一个解决办法，但是这一解决办法并不便利和令人满意。
en: In the past, metallic money provided an inconvenient and unsatisfactory solution to the question of value.

zh: 说它不便利，是因为在日常交易中，黄金使用起来不方便，而白银对重大交易来说，价值太低。
en: It was inconvenient because gold was awkward for everyday transactions, and silver had too little value for major transfers.

zh: 而且，金属货币在发现了新供给的时候，其价值容易发生不可预测的变化。
en: Moreover, metallic money was prone to unpredictable shifts in value with the discovery of new supplies.

zh: 在16世纪，来自新大陆的白银引发了持续的通货膨胀。
en: The arrival of silver from the New World in the sixteenth century triggered sustained inflation.

zh: 19世纪中期加州黄金储藏的发现，以及50年后阿拉斯加、南非以及澳大利亚黄金储藏的发现，也导致了温和的通胀，而在19世纪70年代和19世纪80年代，这样的发现的缺乏却导致了温和的通缩。
en: The discovery of gold in California in the mid-nineteenth century, and in Alaska, South Africa, and Australia 50 years later, also produced mild inflation, while the absence of such new discoveries in the 1870’s and 1880’s led to mild deflation.

zh: 因此，许多经济学家和政治家断言，纸货币更加易于控制并且更稳定。
en: Consequently, many economists and politicians concluded that paper money could be more easily controlled and more stable.

zh: 这一依赖高度安全的造纸和印刷技术的创新，改变了20世纪。
en: This innovation, which was dependent on high-security paper-making and printing techniques, transformed the twentieth century.

zh: 但是，由于政治滥用的强大诱惑，它最初产生了一个更不稳定的结果。
en: But it initially produced a much less stable outcome, because of the strong temptation of political abuse.

zh: 与温和通胀不同的是，因为政府过度发行纸币，20世纪的许多时候发生的都是极度的通胀。
en: Instead of moderate inflation, most of the twentieth century was wildly inflationary, as governments over-issued currency.

zh: 但是，在20世纪的最后20年里，发生了一个学术革命。
en: In the last two decades of the twentieth century, however, an intellectual revolution occurred.

zh: 将货币政策授予独立的中央银行，可望成为一个对抗印刷钞票的政治压力的完美途径。
en: Entrusting monetary policy to an independent central bank promised to be a perfect way to counter the political pressure to print money.

zh: 在美联储，从1979年开始，保罗·沃克尔（Paul Volcker）开始了一个持续而成功的防止通胀的过程。
en: At the United States Federal Reserve, Paul Volcker engineered a sustained and successful process of disinflation beginning in 1979.

zh: 欧洲在结成货币联盟以及建立欧洲中央银行来管理其新货币欧元的过程中，也吸取了同样的教训。
en: Europe learned the same lesson with the move to monetary union and the creation of the European Central Bank to manage its new currency, the euro.

zh: 结果，人们认为货币稳定问题已经得到了解决，他们可以积累资产，然后将这些资产作为抵押物来借越来越多的钱。
en: As a result, people assumed that the problem of monetary stability had been solved, and that they could pile up assets and then use them as collateral to borrow ever-larger sums.

zh: 但是，在次级抵押贷款危机爆发之后，因为损失程度暗含的不确定性，特别是在雷曼兄弟破产之后，金融资产大规模的毁灭粉碎了人们的这一看法。
en: But the large-scale destruction of financial assets because of underlying uncertainty about the extent of losses in the wake of the sub-prime crisis, and especially after the bankruptcy of Lehman Brothers, shook that assumption.

zh: 源自金融部门的通缩是致命的，它比通货膨胀更难应对，这部分是因为利率只能降到零这样的技术原因。
en: Deflation that emanates from the financial sector is lethal. It is more difficult to deal with than inflation, in part for the technical reason that interest rates can be reduced only to zero.

zh: 利率离零越近，对货币政策来说就越棘手。
en: The closer to zero they fall, the more problematic monetary policy becomes.

zh: 政策工具再也不起作用了。
en: The policy instruments no longer work.

zh: 各国中央银行已经扩张了资产负债表，但是，价格却持续下降并且不确定性增加了。
en: Central banks have expanding balance sheets, but prices continue to fall and uncertainty rises.

zh: 通货紧缩是如此大的一个威胁，并且着手消除通缩的政策制定者比遏制通胀的斗士面临着更为严峻的任务，有其更深层次的原因：所有的价格都不向下运行；特别是因为债务是以名义价值确定的，所以它们都没有调整。
en: There is a further reason why deflation is such a threat, and why policymakers setting out to eliminate it have a much tougher task than inflation fighters: all prices do not move down; in particular debts do not adjust because they are fixed in nominal terms.

zh: 债务的通胀和通缩会产生非常不同的结果。
en: Inflation and deflation of debts produce very different outcomes.

zh: 通胀降低了债务的价值，这对许多人和公司来说，感觉就像是在慢慢品味香槟，在他们没有负担的时候，产生了轻飘飘的美妙眩晕。
en: Inflation reduces the value of debt, which for many people and companies feels like slowly sipping champagne, producing a nice buzz of light-headed excitement as they are unburdened.

zh: 另一方面，通缩增加了债务，人们对此的感觉就像是被铅毯子窒息了一样。
en: Deflation, on the other hand, increases debt, and feels like being smothered by a lead blanket.

zh: 在两次世界大战间的大萧条中，经济学家欧文·费雪（Irving Fisher）准确地描述了债务通缩的过程，在这一过程中，对其资产质量恶化感到担忧的借款人，催收他们的贷款，这迫使借款人清算资产。
en: In the interwar Great Depression, the economist Irving Fisher accurately described the process of debt deflation, in which lenders, worried by the deterioration of their asset quality, called in their loans, pushing borrowers to liquidate assets.

zh: 而这只会进一步使价格下降，导致更多的信贷配��，破产以及银行倒闭。
en: That, in turn, merely drove down prices further, leading to more credit rationing, bankruptcies, and bank failures.

zh: 对通缩的政治回应，是呼吁国家变得更为强有力。
en: The political response to deflation is to call for a stronger state.

zh: 在常规市场操作的范围内应对通缩是不可能的。
en: Dealing with deflation is impossible within the bounds of normal market operations.

zh: 只有国家足够可靠到去承担所有的债务，对此私人机构因为无法承受其风险而不愿持有。
en: Only the state is reliable enough to take on all debt, which private institutions are too risk-intolerant to hold.

zh: 但是，经济学家将对因而发生的国家干预抽象地描述为“总需求”的扩张，掩盖了政府进行具体支出和救助具体行业和个人的政治决策的事实。
en: But economists’ abstract description of the resulting state intervention as an expansion of “aggregate demand” conceals the fact that the government conducts specific expenditures and makes political decisions that rescue specific businesses and individuals.

zh: 在以稀缺为特征的债务通缩背景下，援救操作的具体性不可避免地导致了激烈的政治争论。
en: In the climate of scarcity that characterizes debt deflations, the specificity of bailout operations inevitably leads to intense political debate.

zh: 我们在当前有关救助汽车业的分配效应的讨论中，能看到这一点；在对冲基金有权使用美联储的紧急信用额度的担忧中 — — 对冲基金被广泛认为应该对现在的金融危机负责，也看到了这一点。
en: We see this in the current discussion about the distributional effects of rescuing the automobile industry; or the worry that hedge funds, which are widely blamed for today’s financial malaise, should have access to the Fed’s emergency credit lines.

zh: 当前，有人将危机和日本20世纪90年代的经历进行对比 — — 这是日本“失去的十年 ” ， 在经济方面它也削弱了日本执政的自民党的正当性。
en: Currently, parallels are being drawn to Japan’s experience in the 1990’s – a “lost decade” in economic terms that also undermined the legitimacy of the ruling Liberal Democratic Party.

zh: 当中欧和拉丁美洲对通缩的政治回应破坏了主流的秩序时，大萧条产生了更加震撼的结果。
en: The Great Depression produced more alarming outcomes, as the political response to deflation throughout Central Europe and Latin America destroyed the prevailing order, including several democracies.

zh: 中央集权是20世纪对新的不确定性的典型回应，其不足可能会导致一个早前出现过的反应的形成：伴随着对债务和债务工具不加区分的指责，人们产生了对市场经济强烈的反感。
en: Statism has been a characteristically twentieth-century response to new uncertainty. Its inadequacy may lead to the formulation of a much older answer: revulsion against the market economy, accompanied by indiscriminate condemnation of debt and debt instruments.

zh: 事实上，当政府手忙脚乱地对当前的危机作出回应时，我们应该记住，通缩不仅会导致激进的反资本主义，也会使人们对各种经济或政治组织产生深刻的敌意。
en: Indeed, as governments scramble to respond to the current crisis, we should remember that deflation tends to produce not only radical anti-capitalism, but also a profound hostility to any kind of economic or political organization.

zh: 通缩鬼怪
en: The Deflation Bogeyman

zh: 布鲁塞尔—发达世界的中央银行被通缩恐慌压得喘不过气来。
en: BRUSSELS – Central banks throughout the developed world have been overwhelmed by the fear of deflation.

zh: 本不应该如此：这一恐慌没有根据，沉溺于此十分危险。
en: They shouldn’t be: The fear is unfounded, and the obsession with it is damaging.

zh: 日本是通缩恐慌的典型代表。
en: Japan is a poster child for the fear.

zh: 2013年，几十年的物价（温和）下跌促使日本银行采取了前所未有的货币攻势。
en: In 2013, decades of (gently) falling prices prompted the Bank of Japan to embark on an unprecedented monetary offensive.

zh: 但尽管标题通胀一度上升，推动这一上升的因素 — — 日元竞争性贬值和增税 — — 并不持久。
en: But while headline inflation increased for a while, the factors driving that increase – a competitive depreciation of the yen and a tax increase – did not last long.

zh: 如今，日本又回到了接近通缩的状态 — — 慌张的标题纷纷大力报道。
en: Now, the country is slipping back into near-deflation – a point that panicked headlines underscore.

zh: 但是，与媒体报道所营造的印象相反，日本经济离行将就木还有十万八千里。
en: But, contrary to the impression created by media reports, the Japanese economy is far from moribund.

zh: 失业几乎不存在；就业率不断创出新高；人均可支配收入稳步上升。
en: Unemployment has virtually disappeared; the employment rate continues to reach new highs; and disposable income per capita is rising steadily.

zh: 事实上，即使在日本所谓的“失去的几十年”期间，人均收入增长也与美国和欧洲相当，而就业率的增加表明通缩也许并不像央行行长们所认为的那样可恶。
en: In fact, even during Japan’s so-called “lost decades,” per capita income grew by as much as it did in the United States and Europe, and the employment rate rose, suggesting that deflation may not be quite as nefarious as central bankers seem to believe.

zh: 在美国和欧洲，也没有迹象表明会发生因为央行没能实现通胀目标而导致经济灾难。
en: In the US and Europe, there is also little sign of an economic calamity resulting from central banks’ failure to reach their inflation targets.

zh: 增长虽然不漂亮，但保持稳定，就业也在增加。
en: Growth remains solid, if not spectacular, and employment is rising.

zh: 央行的当前方针有两个关键问题。
en: There are two key problems with central banks’ current approach.

zh: 首先，它们着重于消费物价，而这是个错误的目标。
en: First, they are focused on consumer prices, which is the wrong target.

zh: 消费物价下跌的原因很简单：能源和其他原材料价格在过去两年下跌了一大半。
en: Consumer prices are falling for a simple reason: energy and other raw material prices have declined by more than half in the last two years.

zh: 因此，这一下跌是暂时性的，央行应该将眼光跳过它，正如在石油价格节节攀升时跳过消费物价的增加。
en: The decline is therefore temporary, and central banks should look past it, much as they looked past the increase in consumer prices when oil prices were surging.

zh: 相反，央行应该着重于以名义GDP增长衡量的收入增长率；毕竟，对于重债政府和企业来说，这才是重要的事情。
en: Instead, central banks should focus on the rate of revenue increase, measured in nominal GDP growth; that is, after all, what matters for highly indebted governments and enterprises.

zh: 从这一指标看，根本没有通缩：发达国家GDP价格指数（称为GDP平减指数）平均增长率为1—1.5 % 。
en: By this measure, there is no deflation: The GDP price index (called GDP deflator) in developed countries is increasing by 1-1.5%, on average.

zh: 在欧元区，该指标增长率为1.2 % 。
en: In the eurozone, it is rising at 1.2%.

zh: 这也许还没有到达欧洲央行“低于但接近2 % ” 的目标，但显然无法论证欧洲央行日益激进地动用货币工具刺激经济。
en: This may fall short of the European Central Bank’s target of “below but close to 2%,” but not by a margin substantial enough to justify the ECB’s increasingly aggressive use of monetary instruments to stimulate the economy.

zh: 此外，名义GDP增长超过长期利率。
en: Moreover, nominal GDP growth exceeds the long-term interest rate.

zh: 在通常情况下，长期利率高于GDP增长率，此时富人积累财富的速度比经济其余部分更快 — — 经济学家托马斯·皮凯蒂（Thomas Piketty）如是说。
en: When, as is usually the case, the long-term interest rate is higher than the GDP growth rate, the wealthy may accumulate wealth faster than the rest of the economy – a point made by the economist Thomas Piketty.

zh: 但如今，名义GDP增长远远超过长期利率（在一些国家，长期利率包括最多高大100个基点的风险溢价 ） — —即使是欧元区也是如此，那里的名义GDP增长预计今年可达3%左右。
en: But today, nominal GDP growth far exceeds average long-term interest rates (which, in some countries, include risk premia of up to 100 basis points) – even in the eurozone, where nominal GDP growth is expected to reach about 3% this year.

zh: 这意味着融资环境与2007年信用繁荣顶峰时一样有利，也远比过去20年中的任何时点更好。
en: This means that financing conditions are as favorable as they were at the peak of the credit boom in 2007, and much better than they have been at any other point in the last 20 years.

zh: 你也许指望这一证据能让央行行长们反思他们目前对通缩的担忧。
en: One might expect this evidence to compel central bankers to rethink their current concerns about deflation.

zh: 但他们仍致力于追求通胀目标，认定即使是轻微的通缩也可能引发下降螺旋，需求下降导致物价进一步下跌。
en: But they remain committed to pursuing their inflation targets, convinced that even a slight bout of deflation could initiate a downward spiral, with falling demand causing prices to decline further.

zh: 这是他们的第二个错误。
en: This is their second mistake.

zh: 当然，通缩循环的可能性是有的，其结果也可能非常严重。
en: Of course, a deflationary spiral is possible, and its consequences could be serious.

zh: 如果真实利率显著为正，需求可能崩溃，从而拖累物价，使得借款人不再能够维持债务。
en: If real interest rates were significantly positive, demand could plummet, pushing down prices to the point that it becomes impossible for borrowers to service their debts.

zh: 这一通缩循环导致了20世纪30年代的美国大萧条，几年内物价下跌了20—30 % 。
en: Such a spiral contributed to the Great Depression in the US in the 1930s, with prices falling, in some years, by some 20-30%.

zh: 但我们现在距离这样的环境还十分遥远。
en: But we are nowhere near such conditions today.

zh: 事实上，名义利率处于零水平，而广义物价指数正在上升（尽管幅度很小 ） 。
en: In fact, nominal interest rates are at zero, while the broadest price indices are increasing, albeit gently.

zh: 考虑到融资条件如此有利，毫不奇怪内需依然强劲，几乎所有国家的失业率都回到了危机前的低点。
en: Given that financing conditions are so favorable, it is not surprising that domestic demand has remained robust, allowing unemployment to return to pre-crisis lows almost everywhere.

zh: 欧元区是唯一一个失业仍然严重的大型发达经济体，因此也是唯一一个应该考虑通缩风险的经济体。
en: The eurozone is the only large developed economy where unemployment remains substantial, and thus the only economy where the case could be made for a downside risk of deflation.

zh: 但即使是欧元区，GDP增长也略高于潜在水平（平心而论，其潜在水平相当低迷 ） ， 因此，依然存在的产出缺口正在逐渐填��。
en: But even in the eurozone, GDP growth is slightly above its (admittedly very meager) potential, so that the remaining output gap is being closed gradually.

zh: 此外，欧元区失业保持高企的唯一原因是劳动力参与率在整个衰退期间继续上升；而事实上，就业水平正在回归危机前水平。
en: Furthermore, the only reason why unemployment remains high in the eurozone is that the labor-force participation rate has continued to increase throughout the recession; and, indeed, employment is returning to pre-crisis levels.

zh: 这与通缩鹰派所警告的内容正好相反。
en: This is the exact opposite of what the deflation hawks warn about.

zh: 流行的“沮丧的工人”假说认为，滑向通缩代价高昂，因为长期衰退让工人彻底离开劳动力大军。
en: The popular “discouraged worker” hypothesis holds that a slide into deflation is costly, because a long recession induces workers to leave the labor force altogether.

zh: 这绝不是当今欧洲的情形。
en: That is simply not the case in Europe today.

zh: 证据是明确的。
en: The evidence is clear.

zh: 发达经济体央行应该克服它们对通缩螺旋的不理性的恐慌，停止不顾一切地刺激需求。
en: Developed-economy central banks should overcome their irrational fear of a deflationary spiral, and stop trying desperately to stimulate demand.

zh: 否则，它们将背负大幅扩张的资产负债表而做不出什么成绩。
en: Otherwise, they will find themselves with massively expanded balance sheets, and very little to show for it.

zh: 通缩之忧？
en: Deflation Doldrums?

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 美国和其他一些主要国家的通货膨胀率现在接近为零。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The rate of inflation is now close to zero in the United States and several other major countries.

zh: 《经济学人》最近报道说，他们所调查的经济学家们预测美国和日本的消费价格水平在2009年实际上将会总体下降，欧元区的通胀率则将仅为0.6 % 。
en: The Economist recently reported that economists it had surveyed predict that consumer prices in the US and Japan will actually fall for 2009 as a whole, while inflation in the euro zone will be only 0.6%.

zh: 韩国，台湾和泰国也会出现消费价格水平下降。
en: South Korea, Taiwan, and Thailand will also see declines in consumer price levels.

zh: 价格下降的前景反映出工业生产的崩溃，随之而来的高失业率，以及商品价格的急剧下降。
en: The prospect of falling prices reflects the collapse of industrial production, the resulting high level of unemployment, and the dramatic decline in commodity prices.

zh: 在负通胀的国家，工业生产正以两位数的速度下降，所有商品的价格指数同比都下降了超过30 % 。
en: Industrial production is falling at double-digit rates in the negative-inflation countries, and the price index for all commodities is down more than 30% over the past year.

zh: 通货紧缩可能将会是一个非常严重的问题，因为下降的价格，以及价格会继续下降的预期将会导致现在的经济衰退以三种不同的方式恶化。
en: Deflation is potentially a very serious problem, because falling prices – and the expectation that prices will continue to fall – would make the current economic downturn worse in three distinct ways.

zh: 通缩最直接的不利影响是会增加债务的实际价值。
en: The most direct adverse impact of deflation is to increase the real value of debt.

zh: 如同通胀会通过减少债务的实际价值来帮助债务人，通缩会以增加他们所欠债务的实际价值的方式来损害他们。
en: Just as inflation helps debtors by eroding the real value of their debts, deflation hurts them by increasing the real value of what they owe.

zh: 虽然现在极其轻微的通缩不会产生严重问题，但如果继续下去，价格水平可想而知将会在接下来的几年中累积下降超过10 % 。
en: While the very modest extent of current deflation does not create a significant problem, if it continues, the price level could conceivably fall by a cumulative 10% over the next few years.

zh: 如果发生这一幕，贷款买房者就会发现他的债务的实际价值增加了10 % 。
en: If that happens, a homeowner with a mortgage would see the real value of his debt rise by 10%.

zh: 由于价格下降也会导致他们的工资下降，每月贷款所占工资总额的比例就会上升。
en: Since price declines would bring with them wage declines, the ratio of monthly mortgage payments to wage income would rise.

zh: 除了债务实际成本的上升，通缩对房屋拥有者还意味着更高的贷款与房屋价值比率，会增加贷款拖欠现象，尤其是在美国。
en: In addition to this increase in the real cost of debt service, deflation would mean higher loan-to-value ratios for homeowners, leading to increased mortgage defaults, especially in the US.

zh: 更低的价格水平还会增加商业债务的实际价值，削弱资产负债表，从而让公司更难获得额外的信贷。
en: A lower price level would also increase the real value of business debt, weakening balance sheets and thus making it harder for companies to get additional credit.

zh: 通缩的第二个不良作用就是抬升实际利率，即名义利率和“通胀”率之差。
en: The second adverse effect of deflation is to raise the real interest rate, that is, the difference between the nominal interest rate and the rate of “inflation.”

zh: 当价格上涨时，实际利率必要比名义利率低，因为贷款人所还的美元贬值了。
en: When prices are rising, the real interest rate is less than the nominal rate since the borrower repays with dollars that are worth less.

zh: 但当价格下跌时，实际利率则高于名义利率。
en: But when prices are falling, the real interest rate exceeds the nominal rate.

zh: 而贷款人在计算他们的应纳税收入时只能减掉所支付的名义利息的事实更加剧了这种情况。
en: This is exacerbated by the fact that borrowers can deduct only nominal interest payments when calculating their taxable income.

zh: 因为美联储和其它各央行已将短期利率降得几近零点，所以它们也无法为防止通缩抬升实际利率而进一步降息。
en: Because the US Federal Reserve and other central banks have driven their short-term interest rates close to zero, they cannot lower rates further in order to prevent deflation from raising the real rate of interest.

zh: 更高的实际利率会遏制家庭和公司的信贷消费。
en: Higher real interest rates discourage credit-financed purchases by households and businesses.

zh: 而这就削弱了总体需求，导致更大幅度的价格下跌。
en: This weakens overall demand, leading to steeper declines in prices.

zh: 随之而来的价格和工资普降的非常经济环境又会给家庭和公司造成破坏性的心理影响。
en: The resulting unusual economic environment of falling prices and wages can also have a damaging psychological impact on households and businesses.

zh: 在通缩影响下，我们正进入一片未知领地。
en: With deflation, we are heading into unknown territory.

zh: 如果价格下降1 % ， 那么还会下降10%么？
en: If prices fall at a rate of 1%, could they fall at a rate of 10%?

zh: 如果央行不能继续降息来刺激经济，那么有什么能阻止价格的持续下跌呢？
en: If the central bank cannot lower interest rates further to stimulate the economy, what will stop a potential downward spiral of prices?

zh: 这样的忧虑有损信心，并令推动经济活动的工作变得更加艰难。
en: Such worries undermine confidence and make it harder to boost economic activity.

zh: 有些经济学家曾说应对通缩的最佳办法是让央行超量供应货币以让公众相信在未来会发生通胀，从而降低预期的实际长期利率。
en: Some economists have said that the best way to deal with deflation is for the central bank to flood the economy with money in order to persuade the public that inflation will rise in the future, thereby reducing expected real long-term interest rates.

zh: 这一建议会让各央行继续扩大货币供应量，并且甚至在采取如此举措后不再降低利率。
en: That advice would lead central banks to keep expanding the money supply and bank reserves even after doing so no longer lowers interest rates.

zh: 实际上，美联储、英格兰银行和日本银行正在以“定量宽松（quantitative easing ） ” 的名义这样做。
en: In fact, the Federal Reserve, the Bank of England, and the Bank of Japan are doing just that under the name of “quantitative easing.”

zh: 毫不意外，致力于确保2%的（正式或非正式）年通胀率的央行官员们不愿意公开放弃成命并坚持说他们在追求更高的通胀率。
en: Not surprisingly, central bankers who are committed to a formal or informal inflation target of about 2% per year are unwilling to abandon their mandates openly and to assert that they are pursuing a high rate of inflation.

zh: 不论如何，他们的扩张性举措有助于提升达成目标水平的长期通胀预期。
en: Nevertheless, their expansionary actions have helped to raise long-term inflation expectations toward the target levels.

zh: 在美国，政府债券利率从五年期的1.80%上升到十年期的2.86%和三十年期的3.70 % 。
en: In the US, the interest rate on government bonds now rises from 1.80% at five years to 2.86% for 10-year bonds and 3.70% for 30-year bonds.

zh: 将其与政府的通胀保护债券相比显示出相应的预期通胀率为五年期0.9 % ， 十年期1.3%和三十年期1.7 % 。
en: Comparing these interest rates with the yields on government inflation-protected bonds shows that the corresponding implied inflation rates are 0.9% for five years, 1.3% for 10 years and 1.7% for 30 years.

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，虽然各央行现在专注于应对通缩问题，但更长期、更严重的风险却是随着各国经济复苏和各银行动用新近获得的大量储备来创造扩大支出和需求的信贷，通胀会很快抬头。
en: Ironically, although central banks are now focused on the problem of deflation, the more serious risk for the longer term is that inflation will rise rapidly as their economies recover and banks use the large volumes of recently accumulated reserves to create loans that expand spending and demand.

zh: 重建世界森林
en: Rebuilding the World’s Forests

zh: 牛津 — — 人类与森林一直是一种棘手的关系。
en: OXFORD – Humankind has always had a tricky relationship with forests.

zh: 我们靠它们来调节气候和降雨量、清洁空气和水、养活各种植物和动物及支持超过10亿人的生计。
en: We depend on them to regulate the climate and rainfall, clean our air and water, sustain myriad species of plants and animals, and support the livelihoods of over a billion people.

zh: 但我们不断毁灭它们，以至于现在仅保留了全世界原有森林覆盖的一半左右。
en: Yet we continue to destroy them, to the point that only half the world’s original forest cover remains.

zh: 怎样强调砍伐森林的代价都不夸张。
en: The price of deforestation can hardly be overstated.

zh: 树木在生长时会消耗大量二氧化碳，这使它们在吸收能导致气候变化的汽车、工厂、发电站和牲畜所排放的温室气体过程中发挥了重要作用。
en: Trees consume large amounts of carbon dioxide as they grow, making them vital tools for absorbing the greenhouse-gas emissions – from cars, factories, power stations, and livestock – that result in climate change.

zh: 如果我们继续丧失森林覆盖，就不可能实现巴黎协议所规定的到2050年将全球变暖限制在（高于前工业时代水平）2摄氏度的目标。
en: If we continue to lose forest cover, the Paris climate agreement’s goal of limiting global warming to less than two degrees Celsius (above pre-industrial levels) by 2050 will be impossible to achieve.

zh: 事实上，为实现这一目标，我们需要恢复已经消失的大量森林覆盖。
en: In fact, to meet that target, we will need to restore a significant amount of forest cover that is already gone.

zh: 重新植树造林有两种方法。
en: There are two ways to approach reforestation.

zh: 第一种是让农业用地逐渐荒废，然后等待它们自然恢复到森林状态。
en: The first is to allow agricultural lands to fall into disuse, and then wait for them to revert naturally to forest.

zh: 这种方法成本很低，但可能需要几十年才能看到效果。
en: This wouldn’t cost much, but it would take decades.

zh: 第二种方法更加积极主动：种植成百上千亿棵新的树木。
en: The second option is more proactive: plant billions of new trees.

zh: 作为2014年签署的纽约森林宣言的一部分，各国政府承诺恢复数数亿公顷的森林面积。
en: As part of the New York Declaration on Forests, signed in 2014, governments pledged to restore hundreds of millions of hectares of forests.

zh: 但因为当今绝大多数政府面临现金短缺，投资兑现这些承诺颇具挑战性。
en: But, with most governments short on cash these days, financing the pledge has proved challenging.

zh: 在这样的背景下，我们必须力求让私营部门提供所需要的资金。
en: Against this background, we must try to engage the private sector to deliver the needed investment.

zh: 如果森林具有经济价值，人们更有可能种植森林而不是毁灭它。
en: When forests have an economic value, they are more likely to be cultivated than destroyed.

zh: 而且事实上，人类已经有数千年植树牟利的历史。
en: And, indeed, trees have been cultivated for profit for millennia.

zh: 今天，生产性森林覆盖面积超过10亿公顷，约占世界森林面积的四分之一左右。
en: Today, productive forests cover an area of more than a billion hectares, or about one-quarter of the world’s forested land.

zh: 这些森林出产燃料木材，而燃料木材占到树木砍伐的约一半左右。
en: Such forests produce fuelwood, which accounts for about half of tree removals.

zh: 它们还能出产成衣材料、用于肥皂和润滑剂的油料、水果和可可等其他食品。
en: They also produce materials for clothes, oils for soaps and lubricants, fruits, and other foods, such as cocoa.

zh: 对上述产品的需求持续增长，虽然不如计算机普及所造成的报纸印刷下降的速度快。
en: Demand for these products is growing, though not as fast as demand for newspaper print falls as a result of computerization.

zh: 怎样才能提高对森林产品的需求？
en: How can demand for forest products be increased?

zh: 建筑业提供了一个充满希望的机会。
en: A promising opportunity lies in construction.

zh: 木材一直就是重要的建筑材料，而且迄今为止，美国、斯堪的那维亚和东南亚部分地区的住宅建筑仍然使用木材。
en: Timber has always been an important building material, and remains so for residential construction in places like the United States, Scandinavia, and parts of Southeast Asia.

zh: 但今天多数建筑都使用砖石、砂浆和混凝土，而较大的建筑物则使用钢材 — — 这些材料在生产过程中都会产生大量的碳排放。
en: But most buildings today are constructed using bricks and mortar, concrete, and, for larger structures, steel – all materials that produce substantial carbon emissions during the manufacturing process.

zh: 虽然木材不太可能完全替代这些材料，但新型工程木材的竞争力却越来越强。
en: While it is unlikely that timber can fully replace any of these materials, new types of engineered wood are making it more competitive.

zh: 其中有一种叫交叉复合木材（CLT ） ， 就是将多层木材用胶水粘在一起制造出与钢材或混凝土强度类似的板材，从而实现取代其他建筑材料。
en: One of these is cross-laminated timber (CLT), which is made by gluing together layers of wood to create panels that are as strong as steel or concrete, and thus can replace those materials in buildings.

zh: 人类确切了解利用木材削减二氧化碳排放的好处还需要进行更多研究。
en: More research is required to determine the precise benefits of using timber to cut CO2 emissions.

zh: 英国最著名的木结构建筑专家，建筑师安东尼·蒂斯特顿 - 史密斯提供了其中一种意见。
en: One estimate comes from architect Anthony Thistleton-Smith, one of the United Kingdom’s leading experts on wooden buildings.

zh: 他最近指出，虽然典型的英国家庭碳足迹约为20到21吨，但交叉复合木材建成的房屋其碳足迹为负19到20吨。
en: He recently noted that, whereas a typical British home has a carbon footprint of around 20-21 tons, a CLT home has a negative footprint of 19-20 tons.

zh: 换句话讲，每栋由交叉复合木材建造的房屋节约了四十吨的二氧化碳排放。
en: In other words, every home built with CLT saves 40 tons of CO2 emissions.

zh: 如果今年英国需要建造的30万栋新房全部采用交叉复合木材建造，那么相当于路上减少了250万辆汽车。
en: If the 300,000 new homes targeted for completion in the UK this year were built using CLT, it would be like taking 2.5 million cars off the road.

zh: 由此产生的气候效益可能十分巨大。
en: The climate benefits could be massive.

zh: 像许多气候措施一样，成本可能是实施的主要障碍。
en: As with so many climate measures, cost can be a major barrier to implementation.

zh: 而且一份联合国报告显示，交叉复合木材在欧洲的价格高于混凝土。
en: And, according to a United Nations report, CLT is more expensive than concrete in Europe.

zh: 但交叉复合木材处在发展的初级阶段，从事这种木材生产的只有少数几家工厂。
en: But CLT is still in its infancy, with only a handful of factories in operation.

zh: 随着交叉复合木材供应链的不断发展，成本将必然像可再生能源那样随之下降。
en: As the CLT supply chain develops, costs will inevitably fall, as has happened with renewable energy.

zh: 此外，建筑商报告使用交叉复合木材建筑房屋的总成本已经与使用混凝土非常接近，因为它所需要的时间更少。
en: Moreover, builders report that the total costs of building with CLT already end up similar to those of building with concrete, because it takes less time.

zh: 毕竟，交叉复合木材不同于混凝土的优势在于它不需要时间凝固。
en: After all, unlike concrete, CLT doesn’t need time to set.

zh: 当然，完成这样的转变绝非一朝一夕之功。
en: Of course, delivering such a transformation will not be easy.

zh: 必须克服来自生产传统建筑材料的既得利益者的压力，包括确保在补贴问题上能够展开公平竞争。
en: Vested interests – pressure from industries producing traditional building materials – must be overcome, including by ensuring a level playing field in terms of subsidies.

zh: 此外，公众的关注 — — 例如消防安全或预防疾病 — — 必须得到解决，而且建筑商必须学习新的技能。
en: Furthermore, public concerns – for example, regarding fire safety or infestation prevention – must be addressed, and builders will have to learn new skills.

zh: 最重要的是，必须大幅改善监管，以确保需求增加不会导致进一步的森林砍伐。
en: Most important, monitoring will have to be improved considerably, so that increased demand does not result in more deforestation.

zh: 对许多国家而言，由此产生的经济机会应当足以让应对这些挑战所付出的努力成为值得。
en: For many countries, the economic opportunities should be sufficient to make addressing these challenges worthwhile.

zh: 新种植的森林可以再造农业，而新工厂可以为投资者和企业家创造机会。
en: New plantations could regenerate rural areas, as new factories created opportunities for investors and entrepreneurs.

zh: 政府和大型企业可以利用快速增长的绿色债券市场为早期过渡提供资金，包括建成用无人机和卫星成像系统监控不可持续砍伐行为的系统。
en: Governments and larger companies would be able to tap the fast-growing green-bond market to fund the early transition, including the creation of systems using drones and satellite imaging to monitor for unsustainable forestry practices.

zh: 将经济发展与降低温室气体排放相统一的机会非常罕有。
en: Opportunities to align economic development with the reduction of greenhouse-gas emissions are rare.

zh: 但重新造林能够达到这样的效果。
en: Yet that is what reforestation offers.

zh: 我们必须通过以恢复植树为基础的建筑转型利用这次机会，因为树木是这个世界上最有效的碳捕获工具。
en: We must take advantage of this opportunity, by pursuing a construction transformation based on restoring trees, the world’s most effective carbon-capture tool.

zh: 在这个“新木材时代 ” ， 我们要种树、用树盖房，并让我们的森林茁壮成长。
en: In this “new age of timber,” we would grow wood, build with wood, and allow our forests to thrive.

zh: 巴黎的REDD+
en: REDD+ Handed in Paris

zh: 柏林—联合国粮农组织启动第一个全球政府间阻止森林流失的项目 — — 热带森林行动计划已经三十年。
en: BERLIN – It’s been 30 years since the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations launched the Tropical Forestry Action Plan, the first global intergovernmental initiative to halt forest loss.

zh: 三十年来，森林采伐之势从未减小，而最新的阻止滥伐措施 — — 被称为“减少滥伐和毁林所致排放 ” （ Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation，REDD+ ） — —看上去也不太可能收到成效。
en: Since then, deforestation has continued unabated, and the latest international effort to stop it – an initiative known as Reducing Emissions from Deforestation and Forest Degradation (REDD+) – looks no more likely to be effective.

zh: 这两个协议远远没有达到保护世界森林的效果，其最邻人瞩目的结果反倒是昂贵咨询报告的层出不穷。
en: Far from protecting the world’s forests, the most notable outcome of these two agreements has been, ironically, the production of reams of expensive consultancy reports.

zh: REDD+是联合国气候变化框架公约的一部分，而管理其实施的协定预计将在联合国气候变化巴黎会议上完成。
en: REDD+ was created as part of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change, and the agreement governing its implementation is expected to be finalized during the UN Conference on Climate Change in Paris.

zh: 但如果世界领导人认真对待阻止森林流失的问题，就应该放弃REDD+，替之以解决大规模采伐的根本动机的机制。
en: But if world leaders are serious about halting forest loss, they should instead abandon REDD+ and replace it with a mechanism that addresses the underlying drivers of large-scale deforestation.

zh: REDD+的缺陷确凿地表现在它应对它意欲解决的问题的方法上。
en: The flaws in REDD+ are evident in how it approaches the problem it is meant to solve.

zh: 其绝大多数项目将林居民族和农民视为滥伐的主要群体。
en: The vast majority of its projects treat forest peoples and peasant farmers as the main agents of deforestation.

zh: REDD项目开发者似乎腿与着重于限制传统农业的项目特别感兴趣，却回避真正的滥伐原因：工业化农业的扩张、大规模基础设施工程、大规模采伐作业以及失控的消费。
en: REDD project developers seem to be especially fond of projects that focus on restricting traditional farming practices, even as they shy away from efforts to tackle the true causes of deforestation: the expansion of industrial agriculture, massive infrastructure projects, large-scale logging, and out-of-control consumption.

zh: 这些缺陷在社会丛林计划（Socio Bosque Program）中尽显无疑。 社会丛林计划是REDD+的一个厄瓜多尔项目，它着眼于控制森林社区和农民耕作，却忽略了工业活动带来的远远更加巨大的潜在伤害。
en: These shortcomings are exemplified in the Socio Bosque Program, a REDD+ initiative in Ecuador, in which efforts to control forest communities and peasant farming overlook the far larger potential damage caused by industrial activity.

zh: 经过该计划，依赖森林生活的社区与环境部签署了一份为期五年的协议，同意限制森林使用，他们获得的回报是一小笔的现金补偿。
en: Under the program, forest-dependent communities sign five-year agreements with the Ministry of Environment, agreeing to restrict forest use in return for small cash payments.

zh: 与此同时，该计划档案明确规定，如果其辖区成为油田或矿床，那么协议无效。
en: At the same time, the program’s documentation explicitly nullifies the agreement if the area under its jurisdiction becomes slated for oil exploitation or mining.

zh: 今天，农民被阻挡在森林之外，这是遏制气候变化的一部分；明天，同一片森林可以被连根拔起，因为有公司要开采作为气候变化问题根源的化石燃料。
en: Today, peasant farmers are being barred from forests as part of the fight against climate change; tomorrow, the same forests could be uprooted in order to allow companies to extract the fossil fuels that are the underlying cause of the problem.

zh: 短视地将目标集中在农民和森林民族，并且这一方针在国际机构和气候谈判员的日程中占主导地位，其背后有一套危险的逻辑。
en: There is a disturbing rationale for this myopic focus on peasants and forest people and for the prominence of this approach on the agendas of international agencies and climate negotiators.

zh: 看起来，REDD+与阻止森林流是没有什么关系，倒是大方地允许工业化国家继续污染。
en: REDD+, it turns out, has less to do with stopping forest loss than with allowing industrialized countries to continue to pollute.

zh: 该计划背后的方法是一盘更大的棋 — — 建立排放额度市场的一部分。 排放额度市场允许污染者继续排放温室气体，只要它们获得证实它们在其他地方帮助阻止了等量排放的证明即可。
en: The approach underlying the initiative is part of a broader effort to create a market for emission credits, which would allow polluters to continue releasing greenhouse gases if they can produce a certificate attesting that they have contributed toward preventing a similar amount of emissions elsewhere.

zh: REDD+所保护的森林是这些可贸易污染资格 — — 碳额度的重要来源。
en: The forests being protected by REDD+ are important producers of these tradable certificates to pollute, known as carbon credits.

zh: 通过实验性项目实施REDD为这一方针的支持者提供了推动其日程的坚实基础。
en: And REDD implementation through experimental projects provides advocates of this approach a solid foundation on which to advance their agenda.

zh: 对工业化国家来说，碳额度可以让它们轻松实现在京都议定书等协议中做出的国际承诺。
en: For industrialized countries, carbon credits have proved to be an easy way to meet their international commitments under agreements like the Kyoto Protocol.

zh: 如果REDD额度在巴黎获得通过，各国和各公司可以付钱给厄瓜多尔或其他地区的农民保护REDD+等项目规定可以采伐的树木 — — 从而不必做出艰难的结构变化来削减国内排放。
en: If REDD credits are approved in Paris, countries and companies could pay peasant farmers in Ecuador or elsewhere to protect trees that programs like REDD+ claim they otherwise would have chopped down – thereby avoiding the need to make difficult structural changes to cut emissions at home.

zh: 根据约束这些交易的规则，实际排放量为零这一事实并不重要，重要的是获得了可交易的污染许可。
en: Under the rules governing these transactions, the fact that no emissions were actually cut does not matter; what is important is that the tradable permission to pollute has been obtained.

zh: 不幸的是，巴黎会议的与会者几乎没有激励质疑这一方针。
en: Unfortunately, few of those meeting in Paris have incentives to question this approach.

zh: 对政府来说，REDD+这样的项目提供了一个避免政治成本高昂的变化的机会。
en: For governments, programs like REDD+ offer an opportunity to avoid politically costly changes.

zh: 对于大自然保护协会（The Nature Conservancy ） 、 保护国际（Conservation International ） 、 世界野生动物基金（World Wildlife Fund ） 、 野生动物保护协会（Wildlife Conservation Society）等国际保护组织来说，该计划带来了国际发展和慈善资金。
en: And for international conservation groups like The Nature Conservancy, Conservation International, the World Wildlife Fund, and the Wildlife Conservation Society, the program provides access to international development and philanthropic funding.

zh: 当然，最大的受益者是公司，它们对土地的饥渴是大部分大规模滥伐的动因。
en: The biggest beneficiaries, of course, are the corporations whose hunger for land is driving most of the large-scale deforestation.

zh: 除了允许它们继续砍树 — — 只要它们能带来必须的碳额度，REDD+还在事实上将森林流失的罪魁从它们的行为转移到了与森林的长期健康关系最紧密的社区身上。
en: In addition to allowing them to continue cutting down trees as long as they can produce the necessary carbon credits, REDD+ effectively shifts the blame for forest loss away from their actions and onto communities that have the greatest stake in forests’ long-term health.

zh: 如果巴黎的气候谈判员真的想要阻止森林流失、控制气候变化，他们就应该抛弃REDD+，解决这些问题的根源。
en: If the climate negotiators meeting in Paris are truly interested in halting forest loss and bringing climate change under control, they should pull the plug on REDD+ and address the underlying causes of these problems.

zh: 巴黎的措施不应该是控制森林民族和农民的生活和行为，而应该着重于结束大规模滥伐、把化石燃料留在地底下。
en: Rather than attempting to control the lives and actions of forest peoples and peasant farmers, the effort in Paris should focus on ending large-scale deforestation and leaving fossil fuels in the ground.

zh: 让伊朗的石油武器失去效用
en: Defusing Iran’s Oil Weapon

zh: 像北朝鲜一样，伊朗政府不会畏怯于在它的核计划问题进行摊牌。
en: Like North Korea, the Iranian government will not shy from a showdown over its nuclear program.

zh: 为什么要畏怯呢？
en: Why should it?

zh: 核武器正是让美国不敢像对伊拉克那样对付伊朗的终极保证。
en: A nuclear weapon is the ultimate guarantee that the United States can never do to Iran what it did to Iraq.

zh: 此外，这场与美国之间的斗争还可以收到他们迫切需要的国内支持。
en: Moreover, this struggle with the US rallies much-needed domestic support.

zh: 那么，美国如何才能削弱伊朗的地位呢？
en: What, then, can the US do to undermine Iran’s position?

zh: 作为世界上的第四大石油出口国，伊朗从过去四年来全球翻了三倍的石油价格中获得了巨大的利益。
en: As the world’s fourth largest oil exporter, Iran has profited mightily from the tripling of global oil prices over the last four years.

zh: 它的经济稳定依赖于石油收入，而这正是伊朗统治者最最脆弱的地方。
en: Its economic stability is dependent on oil revenues, so it is here that Iran’s rulers are vulnerable.

zh: 美国的外交官从来没有要求联合国安理会对伊朗的能源出口施加制裁。
en: American diplomats are never going to persuade the UN Security Council to impose sanctions on Iran’s energy exports.

zh: 但是布什政府可以寻求办法来遏制全球的能源价格，而这应该首先从拒绝被伊朗总统内贾德引诱进他随心所欲地逐步增强的紧张局势开始。
en: But the Bush administration can seek ways to contain global energy prices – and it should begin by refusing to be baited into escalating tensions whenever Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad pleases.

zh: 内贾德在挑起外交冲突上很有一套。
en: Ahmadinejad has proven resourceful in driving the diplomatic conflict.

zh: 他的政府拒绝国际社会要求它中止铀浓缩活动的呼吁，无视联合国要求的最后期限，武装伊拉克的民兵组织，提供武器给真主党与以色列进行战争，否认二战期间纳粹对犹太人的大屠杀，以及在霍尔姆兹海峡附近进行军事演习，世界上40%通过海上进行运输的石油需要从那里经过。
en: His government has rejected international calls to halt uranium enrichment, ignored UN-imposed deadlines, armed Iraqi militias, supplied Hezbollah with weapons for attacks on Israel, denied the Holocaust, and staged military exercises near the Strait of Hormuz, through which 40% of the world’s sea-traded oil passes.

zh: 所有这些挑衅使得油价持续上涨，从而肥了伊朗政府的腰包。
en: All these provocations add upward pressure on oil prices, enriching the Iranian government.

zh: 当最高领导人哈梅内伊暗示伊朗将会打石油牌时，美国国务卿赖斯并不相信他的说法。
en: When Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei hinted that Iran could play the oil card, US Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice dismissed the idea.

zh: “别忘了伊朗大约80%的预算要依赖石油 ， ” 她说，所以如果它“中断石油供应的话它根本无法生存下去。 ”
en: “Let’s just remember that Iran is some 80% dependent on oil in its budget,” she said, so it is “not really able to live with a disruption.”

zh: 但是如果伊朗略微减少一下它投放到国际市场上的石油数量，那么价格的上涨很有可能抵消（也许是全部）它因为减少出口数量而带来的损失。
en: But if Iran pulls modest amounts of its oil from international markets, price increases are likely to offset (perhaps completely) any loss in revenue from the supply cut.

zh: 此外，对于霍尔姆兹海峡的威胁可以使伊朗无需减少出口量就迫使石油价格上涨。
en: In addition, threats to the Strait of Hormuz would allow Iran to force prices up without any reduction in output.

zh: 事实上去年伊朗政府每一次在国际舞台上的公开行动都增加了能源市场的风险并不是偶然的。
en: It is not an accident that virtually every public move Iran’s government has made in the international arena over the past year has added risk to energy markets.

zh: 有些时候，美国有效地、也许不是有意地削弱了伊朗的地位。
en: At times, the US has effectively – if unintentionally – undercut Iran’s position.

zh: 今年夏天，布什政府提出愿意与伊朗进行直接对话。
en: This summer, the Bush administration offered Iran direct talks.

zh: 九月份，布什联合国大会上作了出人意料地低调的演讲。
en: In September, Bush made an unexpectedly low-key speech to the UN General Assembly.

zh: 俄罗斯、中国和法国的拒绝对实行制裁劝说美国官员在安理会采取惩罚性的行动前给“外交努力提供更多的时间 ” 。
en: Resistance to sanctions from Russia, China, and France has persuaded US officials to “allow more time for diplomacy” before pushing for punitive action in the Security Council.

zh: 所有这些选择都帮助平抑了能源市场的价格。
en: All of these choices helped return slack to energy markets.

zh: 油价已经从七月中旬的每桶78美元降到了十月初的不到60美元。
en: Oil prices have fallen from above $78 per barrel in mid-July to less than $60 in early October.

zh: 这种下跌归功于为化解伊朗核计划问题的紧张局势所作的巨大努力，使伊朗政府丧失了金钱，也加剧了该政权的国内问题。
en: The drop – due in no small measure to an easing of tensions over Iran’s nuclear program – is costing the Iranian government money, compounding the regime’s domestic problems.

zh: 伊朗国内的通货膨胀正变得越来越严重，也许已经达到了20 % 。
en: Inflation in Iran is rising, perhaps to as high as 20%.

zh: 哈梅内伊已经要求内贾德关注这一越来越严重的问题。
en: On October 1, Khamenei called on Ahmadinejad to address the growing problem.

zh: 某些补贴的物品和服务的价格是被冻结的，但是持续上升的通货膨胀使得这些补贴对于政府来说负担越来越重。
en: There are price freezes on certain subsidized goods and services, and rising inflation makes these subsidies even more expensive for the government.

zh: 事实上，政府已经暗示它也许会实行石油配额制。
en: Indeed, the government indicates that it may begin rationing gasoline.

zh: 失业率达到了大约12 % ， 而在年轻人中的比例也许是这个的两倍。
en: Unemployment stands at about 12%, and is probably twice as high among young people.

zh: 美国可以通过避免会导致能源价格上涨和稳固伊朗经济的声明和行动来削弱伊朗政权。
en: The US can undermine the Iranian regime by avoiding statements and actions that help drive energy prices higher and bolster Iran’s economy.

zh: 政府官员应该降低政治温度。
en: Administration officials should lower the political temperature.

zh: 他们应该向伊朗提出进行直接对话。
en: They should again offer Iran direct talks.

zh: 布什应该邀请内贾德到华盛顿来。
en: Bush should invite Ahmadinejad to Washington.

zh: 甚至是请他到克劳福德农场去。
en: Better yet, invite him to Crawford.

zh: 为他做早餐。
en: Make him breakfast.

zh: 华盛顿方面还应该敦促实际上掌控着世界上所有的闲置生产能力的沙特阿拉伯把它们的出口维持在一个高水平以遏制油价。
en: Washington can also press the Saudis, who control virtually all of the world’s spare capacity, to keep their output high to contain prices.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯掌权的逊尼派比美国更多地受到伊朗支持让地区权力平衡倾向什叶派的威胁。
en: Saudi Arabia’s ruling Sunnis are more threatened than is the US by Iran’s support for a shift in the regional balance of power toward Shia Muslims.

zh: 是的，内贾德也许会找到办法来重新挑起冲突。
en: Yes, Ahmadinejad will probably find a way to re-escalate the conflict.

zh: 没人能够阻止伊朗威胁霍尔姆兹海峡。
en: No one can stop Iran from threatening the Strait of Hormuz.

zh: 但是如果布什提出进行对话的话那么就没人能够再指责美国了。
en: But no one can blame the US for that when Bush is offering to talk.

zh: 伊朗也许还需要两到三年的时间才能造出核武器。
en: Iran probably needs two or three years to develop a nuclear weapon.

zh: 到那时候内贾德在国内的地位又将如何呢？
en: How strong will Ahmadinejad’s domestic position be then?

zh: 如果美国不对他施加威胁从而帮助他获得国内支持，那么如果他无法重振经济就会削弱他在国内的地位。
en: If the US does not provide him with threats that help rally domestic support, his failure to revitalize Iran’s economy will erode his standing at home.

zh: 更低的油价意味着可以花在会给他带来声望的国内工程，或者是核计划上的钱会少得多。
en: Lower oil prices would mean less money to spend on domestic projects that buoy his popularity – or on the nuclear program.

zh: 如果减少伊朗的石油收入没能削弱内贾德的地位，那么美国还保留着采取军事行动的选择。
en: If cutting into Iran’s oil income fails to weaken Ahmadinejad, the US would retain military options.

zh: 但是通过鉴定限制伊朗的收入来削弱他的国内地位比通过外交努力来劝说他的政权自愿搁置铀浓缩活动或者强行采取制裁成功的可能性更大。
en: But undermining his domestic standing by limiting Iran’s revenues stands a better chance of succeeding than diplomatic efforts to persuade the regime to suspend uranium enrichment voluntarily, or coercive sanctions.

zh: 缓解紧张局势不会让布什得到那些主张采取强有力的战略的人的支持。
en: Easing tensions will not win Bush points with those who prefer a muscular strategy.

zh: 但是政府采取对抗的办法正面临着失败，因为这正是伊朗的统治者们所想要的。
en: But the administration’s confrontational approach is failing, because it is precisely what Iran’s rulers want.

zh: 解除俄罗斯的能源武装
en: Defusing Russia’s Energy Weapon

zh: 发自哥本哈根 — — 随着冬天的临近，居住在中东欧地区的人们又会再度回忆起去年冬天因俄罗斯故意停止天然气供应而带来的森森寒意。
en: COPENHAGEN – As winter approaches, many people in Central and Eastern Europe remember the chill caused last winter by Russia’s deliberate cut-off of gas supplies.

zh: 那场冲突提醒人们，天然气现在已经变成了克林姆林宫最重要的政治工具，因为它正试图在那些自认为是俄罗斯“近邻”的地区重新确立自己的优先利益。
en: That shutdown was a harsh reminder that gas is now the Kremlin’s primary political instrument as it seeks to re-establish its privileged sphere of interest in what it thinks of as Russia’s “near-abroad.”

zh: 而如果我们依然允许莫斯科在欧洲能源供应上颐指气使的话，那么付出的代价就将非常沉重 — — 不但是欧洲，还有俄罗斯。
en: If Russia is allowed to continue imposing Moscow rules on Europe’s energy supplies, the result will be costly – not only for Europe, but for Russia as well.

zh: 欧盟把能源问题视为双边事务来处理的日子已成过去，因为目前有一些较大的成员国正尝试在牺牲欧洲整体利益的情况下维护自己的狭隘利益。
en: So it is past time that the European Union stopped treating energy as a bilateral issue, with some of the larger member states trying to protect their own narrow interests at the expense of the common European good.

zh: 对此欧盟迫切需要建立一个共同的天能源政策以及一个天然气的单一市场。
en: The EU urgently needs to build a common energy policy and a single market for natural gas.

zh: 倘若不能确立这两方面政策的话，那么可能引发的灾难性风险就是俄罗斯将会设立新的障碍，继续维持这个自普京上台执政以来就已经在全世界眼皮底下实施的“分而治之”策略。
en: Until both are established, there is a grave risk that Russia will use new blockades to continue the kind of divide-and-rule policy that the world has witnessed since Vladimir Putin came to power.

zh: 而那条计划在波罗的海底铺设的北溪天然气管道就是一个绝佳范例，让欧洲所面临的问题暴露无遗。
en: The planned Nord Stream gas pipeline on the bottom of the Baltic Sea is a good example of the problems that everyone in Europe is facing.

zh: 该管道由俄罗斯－德国－荷兰三国合资联营，但其中能源巨头俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司却独占51％的股份并因此牢牢掌握着主导权。
en: The pipeline has been established as a Russian-German-Dutch consortium, but it is the Russian energy giant Gazprom that is in the driver’s seat with 51% of the shares.

zh: 而铺设这条管道的作用，则是令俄罗斯可以直接将天然气输送到德国而无需借道现有的陆上管道。
en: Nord Stream will enable Russia to deliver natural gas directly to Germany without using the existing land-based connections.

zh: 这件事初看上去没有什么问题。
en: At first glance, there seems to be no problem.

zh: 但俄罗斯希望兴建北溪管道的真正原因 — — 须知这条管线可比现有管网更为昂贵 — — 则是这条管线可以让俄罗斯在切断某些欧盟国家（比如波兰 ） ， 波罗的海国家和邻国（如乌克兰）天然气供应的同时，继续保持对德国以及其他西欧国家的天然气供应。
en: But the real reason Russia wants to build Nord Stream – which is more expensive than the existing gas-pipeline network – is that it will enable Russia to interrupt gas supplies to EU member countries like Poland, the Baltic states, and neighbors like Ukraine, while keeping its German and other West European customers snug and warm.

zh: 那些有充足理由去恐惧俄罗斯停供天然气的国家都为此大声呼吁，认为兴建北溪管道的政治目的远大于经济需要。
en: Countries that have good reason to fear a Russian manufactured chill have loudly proclaimed that Nord Stream is politically rather than economically motivated.

zh: 毕竟扩展现有陆上管网的成本将比铺设海底管线便宜得多。
en: After all, it would be much cheaper to expand existing land pipelines than to build undersea.

zh: 此外俄罗斯足以满足未来需求的天然气商业开采储量也意味着北溪管道可以被用来切段对那些“不讨俄罗斯喜欢”的国家的供应。
en: Moreover, Russia’s ability to meet future gas demand from commercially viable reserves suggests that Nord Stream could be used to cut off gas sales to unfavored clients.

zh: 但这些关注却都被强大的北溪关系政治游说团抛到了一边，而该游说团正是由当年在位时批准了北溪管线计划，并在卸任后旋即受雇于俄罗斯天然气工业股份公司的德国前总理格哈德·施罗德所率领的。
en: Yet these concerns have been pushed aside by the powerful pro-Nord Stream lobby, led by former German chancellor Gerhard Schröder, who, having approved Nord Stream while in office, was quickly hired by Gazprom after he left it.

zh: 在大多数民主国家，这样的举动很快会受到监察部门的关注。
en: In most democracies, such a move would have quickly received prosecutorial attention.

zh: 但对施罗德受雇于该公司的正当性的严肃调查却从来没有启动过，这可能是受制于德俄两国经济关系的范围和严重性。
en: But no serious investigation of the propriety of Schröder’s dealings was ever launched, perhaps because of the scale and importance of German-Russian economic ties.

zh: 而在今年11月，北溪管道计划意外地得到了三个斯堪的纳维亚半岛国家（丹麦，瑞典和芬兰）的批准，三国还同意在本国领海的海床上铺设管线。
en: This November, Nord Stream was given a surprising go-ahead by three Scandinavian countries that will lend their seabed to the project: Denmark, Sweden, and Finland.

zh: 而他们似乎只是将这个事件视为“技术性问题 ” ， 并在得到了环境保护方面的承诺之后就心满意足了。
en: They seem to regard the case as a “technical issue,” and are now satisfied because environmental guarantees have been given.

zh: 但北溪管道可不是一个“技术性问题 ” 。
en: But Nord Stream is no “technical issue.”

zh: 那些害怕遭到停气威胁的国家的意见必须得到尊重，而这也是为什么需要建立一个单一的欧盟天然气市场的原因。
en: The concerns of countries that fear being left out in the cold must be addressed, which is why it is necessary to establish a single EU market for natural gas.

zh: 只有这样，才能确保任何一个国家都不会匍匐于俄方的压力之下。
en: That way, no one would be left exposed to Russian pressure.

zh: 毫无疑问，欧洲需要俄罗斯的天然气，但对俄罗斯会因此而垄断并钳制欧洲的担心也是略显夸张了。
en: Europe undoubtedly needs Russian gas, but fears that this gives Russia a monopolistic stranglehold over Europe are exaggerated.

zh: 须知目前俄罗斯占欧洲天然气总进口量的份额才刚刚达到40 % ， 已经比1980年的80%好了很多。
en: Russia’s share of total EU gas imports is just above 40% today, compared to 80% in 1980.

zh: 此外，俄罗斯天然气只占欧洲基本能源总供应量的6 % - 7 % 。
en: Moreover, Russian gas represents only 6-7% of the EU’s total primary energy supply.

zh: 所以在总体上，我们无需在俄罗斯天然气依赖这个问题上如此恐慌。
en: So, in general, dependence on Russian gas should not be feared.

zh: 但问题是许多位处东部的欧盟国家对俄罗斯天然气的依赖度高于平均水平。
en: The problem is that some countries in the eastern part of the EU are much more dependent on Russian gas than the average figures suggest.

zh: 因此这些国家必须得到某种稳定的承诺，而这也是它们身为欧盟成员国所应得的。
en: Thus, they must be guaranteed the kind of solidarity that is fundamental to EU membership.

zh: 当然，有了去年遭遇切断天然气供应的经验也有一个好处：新的可替代管线计划孕育着新的希望，比如借道土耳其将阿塞拜疆天然气输往欧洲的“纳布科”管线。
en: Last year’s experience with interrupted gas supplies did have one benefit: new life was blown into plans for alternative routes, like the Nabucco pipeline that is to bring Azeri gas to Europe through Turkey.

zh: 欧盟和俄罗斯双方也达成了在可能停气之前事先知会对方的协议。
en: An early warning system on potential supply cuts has also been agreed between Russia and the EU.

zh: 而充满魅力的乌克兰女总理尤丽亚·季莫申科似乎已经成功说服普京签订一个新的供气协定。
en: And it looks like Ukraine’s Prime Minister Yulia Tymoshenko has charmed Prime Minister Putin into concluding a new gas deal.

zh: 但在那些最可能面临停气的国家中，恐慌依然严重。
en: Yet anxiety remains high in the countries most exposed to new supply cuts.

zh: 此外，和作为一个统一整体的欧盟签订天然气协定也符合俄罗斯的利益。
en: It is in Russia’s own interest that the EU deal with it as a united entity.

zh: 对俄罗斯天然气供应的持续恐慌和不确定无疑会使那些最容易遭遇停气的国家想方设法阻挠欧盟和俄罗斯双方形成新的伙伴关系和合作协议。
en: Continued fear and uncertainty about Russian gas supplies would undoubtedly lead the most exposed EU countries to seek to protect themselves by blocking EU-Russia negotiations on new partnership and cooperation agreements.

zh: 就在今年11月的国情咨文讲话中，俄罗斯总统迪米特里·梅德韦捷夫强调了俄罗斯经济现代化的迫切需要。
en: In his State of the Nation speech this November, Russian President Dmitri Medvedev stressed the need for modernization of the Russian economy.

zh: 而与欧盟之间更紧密的联系很显然是实现这一目标的最佳路径。
en: Closer cooperation with the EU is the most obvious way to make this possible.

zh: 但只要俄罗斯一天还被视为一个敲诈者而不是一个合作者的话，这样的合作，就永远不可能发生。
en: But, so long as Russia is perceived as an energy blackmailer and not a partner, such cooperation will be impossible.

zh: 危险边缘的东北亚
en: Northeast Asia on the Brink

zh: 东京 — — 中国拒绝如期出席今年的中日韩峰会将三国拖入了困难时期。
en: TOKYO – China’s refusal to attend this year’s summit with Japan and South Korea as scheduled comes at a trying moment for all three countries.

zh: 尽管亚洲地区活力居全球之冠，但却缺少解决 — — 或至少是缓和 — — 激化地区紧张局势的国际争端的组织机制。
en: Although Asia is the world’s most dynamic region, it has a paucity of institutional mechanisms for resolving – or at least mitigating – international disputes of the type that are ratcheting up tension across the region.

zh: 因为当前的三方年度峰会带来了东北亚三巨头制度性对话的切实希望，中国不愿参与今年的峰会绝非好的预兆。
en: Because the now-annual trilateral summits offer real hope for creating an institutionalized dialogue among Northeast Asia’s “Big Three,” China’s unwillingness to participate this year does not bode well.

zh: 当然，各国往往选择在国际峰会上签署协议，而不是艰苦地讨价还价试图改善关系。
en: Of course, international summits are usually an occasion for countries to sign agreements, not for the hard bargaining that can begin to improve their relations with one another.

zh: 但此次中、日、韩在紧张关系升级之际会面，三国领导人本可以借此机会加强东北亚的战略稳定局势。
en: But with China, Japan, and South Korea due to meet at a time of growing tension among all three countries, the three leaders could have seized the moment to enhance strategic stability across Northeast Asia.

zh: 但实际情况却恰恰相反，紧张关系很可能持续下去。
en: Instead, tensions are now likely to continue to fester.

zh: 稳定关系的第一步是领导人承认并向民众强调三国经济越来越高的依存度。
en: The first step in putting relations on a more stable footing is for each leader to acknowledge –and emphasize for their citizens – the ever-increasing interdependence of the three economies.

zh: 贸易、投资和生产链正在以20年前人们无法想象的方式将中、日、韩三国联系在一起。
en: Trade, investment, and production chains now link China, Japan, and South Korea in ways that no one could have imagined 20 years ago.

zh: 1945年以后的欧洲历史证明，共同的经济利益为实现区域安全和历史性和解奠定了的坚实基础。
en: As European history since 1945 has demonstrated, shared economic interests can provide a solid foundation for building both regional security, and ushering in historic reconciliations.

zh: 此外，作为地区头号威胁的朝鲜核武库同时损害了三国的利益。
en: Moreover, the region’s greatest threat – North Korea’s nuclear arsenal – endangers all three countries.

zh: 尽管威胁有大有小，但失策的后果任何人都承受不起。
en: While the threat may not affect them equally, none can afford a misstep.

zh: 因此如果三国领导人讨论并制定共同方案，安全利益同样可以促进合作。
en: So even security interests can serve to foster greater cooperation, if the countries’ leaders discuss and develop a common approach.

zh: 可悲的悖论是在中、日、韩一体化不断深入、甚至连安全风险都或有重合的同时，三国的外交关系却陷入不断恶化的境地。
en: The sad paradox, however, is that, as economic integration among China, Japan, and South Korea has deepened, and even as their security risks have sometimes merged, their diplomatic ties have deteriorated.

zh: 当然，谁都无法将自身安危系于别国的承诺，日美联盟或许是有史以来大国依靠承诺维系安全的唯一实例。
en: Of course, none can fully entrust their security to the word of the others – Japan’s alliance with the United States is perhaps the only time in history when a great power has ever done that.

zh: 各国无疑都将追求 — — 并想方设法确保自身的利益。
en: Each will undoubtedly pursue – and find the means to secure – its own interests.

zh: 但这并不是说冲突是不可避免的。
en: But that does not mean that clashes are inevitable.

zh: 鉴于当今亚洲的国家规模及联盟结构，通过霸权来控制对手的野心根本无法考虑。
en: In today’s Asia, it is impossible to manage rival ambitions through hegemony, given the size of the countries involved and the structure of their alliances.

zh: 因此这三国必须学会友好相处。
en: So all three countries must learn to live together amicably.

zh: 第一步相对简单：三国都必须在外交考量中更多地考虑到别国的安全担忧。
en: Here the first step is relatively straightforward:  all three countries must give greater weight to factoring into their diplomatic calculations the others’ national-security fears.

zh: 他们还必须意识到，针对国内民众的言论行动和实际政策一样可以引发别国的疑虑。
en: They also need to recognize that rhetoric and actions aimed at domestic audiences, no less than actual policies, can inflame suspicions.

zh: 遗憾的是，中日韩三国主要团体称正在举行的地区争霸赛意味着探讨合作问题不仅幼稚、而且不合时宜。
en: Unfortunately, key groups in all three countries claim that the contest for regional mastery now underway means that talk about cooperation is not only naïve, but obsolete.

zh: 有些日韩战略思想家认为中国不仅要取代美国的亚洲领导地位，而且要在经济上主宰亚洲。
en: Some Japanese and Korean strategic thinkers believe that China is intent not only on displacing the US as Asia’s leading power, but also on economic domination of the region.

zh: 他们认为中国想重新成为“中央帝国 ” ， 而邻国则只能俯首称臣。
en: They see a China seeking to re-establish itself as “The Middle Kingdom,” with its neighbors reduced to vassal and tributary states.

zh: 尽管中国的军事实力与美国不可同日而语，但因为中国正在寻找削弱美国优势的技术手段，其目前的军事集结仍被视作为不可接受的危险之举。
en: While China’s military capacities are no match for America’s, its current military build-up is viewed as posing unacceptable risks nonetheless, because China also is seeking technological means to negate America’s military advantages.

zh: 如果中国取得成功，与中国经济关系日益紧密的邻国就有可能为了取悦中国而调整自己的政策。
en: Should China succeed, its neighbors – which are increasingly tied to its economy – might adjust their policies to appease Chinese preferences.

zh: 中国有可能不费一枪一弹就成为亚洲的核心国。
en: A Sino-centric Asia could emerge without a shot being fired.

zh: 但中国人眼中的地区局势却是完全不同的样子。
en: But the region looks very different through Chinese eyes.

zh: 从他们的角度看，日渐衰落的美国正用尽一切手段阻挠中国的崛起。
en: From this perspective, a declining US is doing everything that it can to thwart China’s rise.

zh: 美国人可能整天把合作挂在嘴边，但遏制才是真正的目的。
en: America might speak the language of cooperation, but its real game is containment.

zh: 因此与美国及其地区盟国日韩的任何长期合作都只会帮助美国捆住中国的手脚。
en: So any sustained cooperation with the US and its regional allies – Japan and South Korea – would only help America to shackle China.

zh: 恰恰相反，中国应该公然对抗那些提出争议要求的邻国。
en: Instead, China should openly confront those neighbors with which it has disputed claims.

zh: 鉴于对亚洲局势的看法相去甚远，在东北亚三巨头之间寻求合作究竟有没有意义？
en: Given these disparate visions of what Asia looks like, is there any point in seeking cooperation among Northeast Asia’s Big Three?

zh: 拒绝出席三边峰会的中国似乎给出了否定的答复。
en: A China that balks at participating in a trilateral summit seems to think there is not.

zh: 如果受到挑战，三国无疑都将为了维护自身的安全而竭尽全力。
en: If challenged, all three would undoubtedly do what they must to preserve their security.

zh: 但以对抗作为首选战略将成为严重的失误。
en: But to adopt confrontation as their preferred strategy would be a serious mistake.

zh: 三国间爆发任何冲突都将严重损害所有三方的利益。
en: Any conflict among them would leave them all significantly worse off.

zh: 而且重建和平后，他们将发现自己再度回到原点，无法避开建设另两方起重要作用的地区秩序。
en: And, when peace was restored, they would find themselves back at square one, still needing to build a regional order in which the others would play a big part.

zh: 东北亚的当前局势并不需要三国中任何一国放弃珍视的民族要求。
en: The current situation in Northeast Asia does not require any of the three countries to abandon cherished national claims.

zh: 但三国领导人必须在愿望和现实间加以区别，并且必须对国内民众做出解释。
en: But their leaders must distinguish between those that are aspirations and those that are realizable, and they must begin to explain to their citizens this distinction.

zh: 举例来讲，三方均不应为了某个小岛而把外交和安全关系变为一场零和游戏，而且中国的持续崛起、朝鲜的最终统一抑或日本的复兴也不应被另外两国视为战略威胁。
en: None should reduce their diplomatic and security relations to a zero-sum game over claims to this or that island, for example. Nor should China’s continued rise, Korea’s eventual reunification, or Japan’s renaissance be regarded by the others as a strategic threat.

zh: 危机管理根本无法维系经济关系密切、但主权要求和历史主张相反的国与国关系。
en: Crisis management is no way to sustain relationships that are economically close but riddled by rival claims and bitterly contested historical narratives.

zh: 只要中日韩三国继续把每一次接触都看作算旧帐或夺取战略优势的机会，东北亚就始终无法逃脱边缘政策的命运。
en: As long as China, Japan, and South Korea regard every encounter with one another as an opportunity to settle scores or gain some strategic advantage, brinkmanship will remain Northeast Asia’s fate.

zh: 事实上，三巨头目前的紧张关系让地区最不计后果的朝鲜成了最大的受益者。
en: Indeed, the main beneficiary of the current tensions among the Big Three is the region’s most reckless actor – North Korea.

zh: 这样的结果令人沮丧，而且充满讽刺。
en: That outcome is as frustrating as it is ironic.

zh: 只要不触发盟国的直接对抗和安全保障承诺，三巨头就都不会面临真正的威胁。
en: None of the Big Three can be seriously threatened without triggering direct resistance and the security guarantees of allies.

zh: 因此三国领导人必须想法设法会晤并寻求真正的合作，同时力求建设能够协调相互愿景和利益的全新机制。
en: For this reason, the leaders should find a way to meet soon and commit themselves to seeking genuine cooperation, as well as to building mechanisms that will enable them to reconcile their visions and interests with those of the others.

zh: 路障前的戴高乐
en: De Gaulle at the Barricades

zh: 伦敦 — — 今年恰巧是法国继拿破仑之后最伟大领袖的整数周年纪念高度集中的年度。
en: LONDON – By coincidence, this is a busy year for round-number anniversaries for France’s greatest leader since Napoleon.

zh: 120年前查尔斯·戴高乐出生于里尔。
en: Charles de Gaulle was born 120 years ago in Lille.

zh: 他在40年前一天傍晚玩纸牌游戏时因心脏病发作病逝于科隆贝双教堂村的家中。
en: He died 40 years ago at his home in Colombey-les-deux-Églises, expiring of a heart attack as he played solitaire one evening.

zh: 70年前，他在1940年6月法国沦陷后乘飞机飞到伦敦，在BBC发表了那次著名的讲话，号召法国人民奋起抵抗纳粹的侵略。
en: Seventy years ago, he delivered his celebrated call to resistance over the BBC after flying to London from France as it collapsed in June 1940.

zh: 今年同样面临着知名度远不那么高的周年纪念，当时戴高乐向世人展示了他集于一身的罕见的决心、政治技巧及演说能力，他正是凭借着这些与意志坚定的反对派直接对抗。
en: This year also marks a much less noted anniversary, an occasion on which de Gaulle showed how his rare combination of determination, political skill, and rhetorical ability could be brought to bear to face down determined opposition.

zh: 这是延续至今的第五共和国在创立过程中的核心时刻。
en: It was a central moment in the establishment of the Fifth Republic, which continues to this day.

zh: 阿尔及利亚战争在促使戴高乐以67岁高龄于1958年重新掌权的过程中发挥了重要作用。
en: The war in Algeria played the key role in enabling de Gaulle to return to power in May 1958, at the age of 67.

zh: 尽管他的回忆录描绘了一幅深知自己意图的领袖人物的典型形象，但我为新传记所进行的研究工作却表明他针对地中海危机的政策实际是希望和挫折的融合。
en: Though his memoirs paint a characteristic portrait of a leader who knew what he was doing, research for my new biography shows that his policy towards the crisis across the Mediterranean combined hope and frustration.

zh: 他希望法国能够在军事上控制民族解放阵线（FLN ） ， 同时又因为极端混乱的政治局势和难以说服移民保持现状的选择行不通而感到懊丧。
en: He hoped that France could dominate the National Liberation Front (FLN) militarily, and was frustrated at the extremely messy political situation on the ground and the difficulty of persuading the settlers that maintaining the status quo was untenable.

zh: 1958年，他对阿尔及尔主要由欧洲黑脚构成的人群说“我理解你们 ” 。
en: In 1958, he told a crowd in Algiers made up mainly of pieds noirs Europeans “Je vous ai compris” (“I have understood you”).

zh: 但到了1960年，这种短期的愉悦已经让位于曾受他利用重新掌权的人们的仇恨，这些人将他视为叛徒，恨不能令他和他一手创立的政权一同消失掉。
en: But, by 1960, euphoria had given way to rancor among those whom he had used to regain office but who now saw him as a traitor to be neutralized along with the regime he had brought into being.

zh: 催生著名“路障周”的是在德国报纸《南德意志报》上发表的对伞兵部队将领雅克·马苏的访问，马苏在访问中说军队中的部分人士后悔要求戴高乐重新上台，无法理解他的政策，并为他成为“左翼人士”而感到失望。
en: The catalyst for what came to be known as “Barricades Week” was an interview published in the German newspaper Sueddeutsche Zeitung with the parachute general Jacques Massu, in which he said that part of the army regretted having called de Gaulle back to power, did not understand his policy, and was disappointed that he had become “a man of the left.”

zh: 马苏作为一名坚定的戴高乐主义者，本应该知道无论他感到多么沮丧，都不该当众毫不掩饰地讲出这样的大实话。
en: Massu, a convinced Gaullist, should have known better than to say such home truths publicly, whatever his own frustrations.

zh: 他此后立即被调往法国乡村的一个指挥所。
en: He was promptly sidelined to a command in provincial France.

zh: 在爱丽舍宫与戴高乐情绪激动的会晤后，马苏致电给自己敦促发动政变的总参谋长安托尼·阿古德上校。
en: After a stormy meeting with de Gaulle at the Élysée Palace, Massu telephoned his chief of staff, Colonel Antoine Argoud, who had been pressing for a coup.

zh: 随后举行了大规模罢工，激进的学生在阿尔及尔市中心竖起路障。
