en: A general strike was called, and militant students threw up barricades in the center of Algiers.

zh: 当警察释放催泪瓦斯的时候，黑脚们选择了开火。
en: When police attacked with tear gas, pieds noirs opened fire.

zh: 在随后发生的枪战中，14名安全部队成员和8名示威者丧生，200人受伤。
en: In the ensuing gun battle, 14 members of the security forces and eight demonstrators were killed, and 200 people were wounded.

zh: 极端主义理论家让雅克苏西尼宣布 ， “ 推翻独裁政权的时候到了。
en: “The hour has come to bring down the regime,” the extremist ideologue, Jean-Jacques Susini declared.

zh: ” “ 革命之火将从阿尔及尔燃烧到巴黎。 ”
en: “The revolution will start from Algiers and reach Paris.”

zh: 戴高乐当时待在科隆贝，但立即回到了巴黎。
en: De Gaulle was at Colombey, but returned immediately to Paris.

zh: 据一位在总统府走廊上看到他的官员回忆他当时正在小声嘟囔 ： “ 麻烦极了！
en: An official who saw him in the corridor of the palace recalled him muttering: “What a business!

zh: “麻烦极了！
en: What a business!”

zh: 在召开内阁会议时，他坚持认为必须平息这场对新生共和国发起的挑战。
en: At a cabinet meeting, he insisted that the challenge to the new republic had to be put down.

zh: 总理米歇尔·德勃雷被派往阿尔及尔，但叛乱分子对他不屑一顾，他毫无建树，空手而归。
en: The prime minister, Michel Debré, was sent to Algiers, but the rebels treated him contemptuously, and he flew back empty handed.

zh: 巴黎到处流传着极端主义者成立影子政府的谣言。
en: Rumors flew of the creation of a shadow government by extremists in Paris.

zh: 总统的军事事务官员被告知要随身佩戴手枪。
en: Members of the presidential military staff were told to carry handguns.

zh: 戴高乐召见马苏的后继者让克雷将军，告诉他“欧洲人不想让阿拉伯人作出选择 ， [ 但]穆斯林人不想步布列塔尼亚人的后尘。
en: Summoning Massu’s successor, General Jean Crépin, de Gaulle told him, “The Europeans do not want the Arabs to make a choice, [but] the Muslims do not want to be Bretons.

zh: 如果军队崩溃，那么崩溃的是阿尔及利亚[以及]法国。 ”
en: If the army collapses, it is Algeria [and] France which collapses.”

zh: 随着戴高乐身着军装，在电视上向人们展示他对这一全新媒介的全面控制，决定性的时刻到来了。
en: The decisive moment came when de Gaulle, in military uniform, went on television to demonstrate his mastery of the new medium.

zh: 他说 ， “ 我古老而又亲爱的国家，现在再次面临着一次严峻的考验 ， ” 他坚称掌握自决权是唯一的出路，并号召军队抵制与叛乱分子的被动联系，并下令重建公共秩序。
en: “Well, my dear and old country, here we are again facing a heavy test,” he said. Insisting that self-determination was the only way ahead, he called on the army to reject even passive association with the insurrection and instructed it to re-establish public order.

zh: 如果国家在所面临的挑战面前屈服 ， “ 法国将比在前途未卜的海洋上漂浮着的破旧的可怜玩具好不了多少 ， ” 他发出警告。
en: If the state bowed before the challenge it faced, “France would be no more than a poor, broken toy floating on an ocean of uncertainty,” he warned.

zh: 将军的面孔从电视屏幕上消失还不到15分钟，阿尔及利亚的40支部队就宣誓效忠。
en: Within 15 minutes of the General’s face fading from the screen, 40 army units in Algeria declared their loyalty.

zh: 设立路障的人们被劝告离开据点，叛乱领袖被捕或逃往西班牙。
en: The men at the barricades were persuaded to leave their stronghold; the insurrectionary leaders were either detained or escaped to Spain.

zh: 击败军事叛乱是巴黎的共和国当局首次在与为推翻第四共和国出过力的黑脚们的较量中占得上风。
en: The defeat of the military revolt was the first time that the republican authority of Paris had been asserted over the pieds noirs who had helped to bring down the Fourth Republic.

zh: 戴高乐的坚决果断和演说才能 — — 在叛乱者们支支吾吾、笨手笨脚的反衬下 — — 成就了国家权力的至高无上。
en: De Gaulle’s firmness and rhetoric – aided, it must be said, by the fumbling of the rebels – established the primacy of the state.

zh: 第二天发表了戴高乐的画像，但画像上的那张面孔充满了坚定和力量。
en: The next day, de Gaulle’s face was drawn, but he was resolute and full of energy.

zh: 同情移民的政府部长，特别是长久以来的戴高乐主义者雅克·苏斯戴尔遭到解雇。
en: Ministers who sympathized with the settlers, notably the long-time Gaullist Jacques Soustelle, were sacked.

zh: 国民议会授予戴高乐一年的法令执政权限。
en: The National Assembly granted de Gaulle the power to rule by decree for a year.

zh: 工会举行象征性的一小时罢工，以示支持政府。
en: Trade unions held a symbolic one-hour strike to back the government.

zh: 民意调查显示将军的支持率高达75 % 。
en: An opinion poll gave the General 75% backing.

zh: 第五共和国转危为安，历史性的一页已经翻过。
en: The Fifth Republic was safe, and a historic page had been turned.

zh: 北方出生的戴高乐对远隔重洋的情绪化的移民群体更加蔑视。
en: The disdain felt by de Gaulle, a man of the north, for the emotional settlers across the sea had deepened.

zh: 两年之后，在戴高乐的冷酷无情引发了第二次叛乱后，法国和民族解放阵线签订的依云和平协议让阿尔及利亚最终实现独立。
en: Two years later, after de Gaulle’s steeliness repulsed a second uprising, the Evian peace agreements between France and the FLN brought Algeria’s independence.

zh: 需求还是供给？
en: Demand or Supply?

zh: 芝加哥 — — 经济学的全部内容就是需求与供给。
en: CHICAGO – Economics is all about demand and supply.

zh: 供需一般相互平衡，否则的话就会产生强大的力量让两者相互靠近。
en: Typically, the two are equal, and, if not, powerful forces push them towards each other.

zh: 但美国失业率长期居高不下意味着供需出现了本质性问题： 是总需求太低，还是供给出现了问题？
en: But, with high and persistent levels of unemployment in the United States, there is a real question about the nature of the problem: is aggregate demand too low, or are there problems with supply?

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马总统政府似乎认为问题出现在需求领域，因此一次次通过刺激措施在降税的同时增加转让和政府开支，以此刺激消费和投资。
en: President Barack Obama’s administration seems to think that the problem is one of demand, and has passed stimulus measure after stimulus measure, reducing taxes and increasing transfers and government spending in order to boost consumption and investment.

zh: 美联储也抱有类似的想法，不仅将短期利率压至最低，而且采取冒险政策控制长期利率。
en: The Federal Reserve is of a similar mind, not only maintaining rock-bottom short-term interest rates, but also embarking on an adventurous policy targeting long-term rates.

zh: 某些改革派经济学家鼓吹采取更激进的措施。
en: Some progressive economists want even more.

zh: 这些政策为什么没能抑制失业，即使经济复苏已经开始？
en: Why have these policies not worked thus far in bringing down unemployment, even though the growth recovery is well under way?

zh: 改革派经济学家说刺激计划已经成功阻止了更深的衰退（情况甚至可能更糟 ） ， 但是这些措施太束手束脚，无法带来强劲的复苏。
en: The progressive economist says that stimulus worked, staving off a much deeper recession – if not worse – but that the measures were too timid to generate a robust recovery.

zh: 保守派经济学家回应正是因为政府对纳税人的钱财如此大手大脚，才导致害怕未来加税的美国家庭放低姿态，增加储蓄。
en: The conservative economist responds that it is precisely because the government has become so free with taxpayers’ money that households, fearful of future taxes, are hunkering down and increasing savings.

zh: 此外，越来越激进的政府也让企业对未来的监管和税收措施感到不安，因此不愿进行投资。
en: Moreover, the increasingly activist government has left businesses uneasy about future regulatory and tax measures, and thus reluctant to invest.

zh: 两者的观点都有一定道理。
en: The truth probably lies somewhere in between.

zh: 用于救济失业、州别援助和某些建设项目的政府开支很可能避免了一场更令人痛苦的衰退，但居高不下的赤字也令美国家庭深感忧虑，他们在消费狂潮褪去后试图降低负债，重新储蓄。
en: Government spending – especially on unemployment benefits, aid to states, and some construction projects – probably helped avert a more wrenching downturn, but continued red ink worries households, which are also trying to rebuild savings and reduce debt after a spending binge.

zh: 医疗保健等领域的监管变数不仅令其难以做出长期的投资决策，也使企业难以建立长期的雇佣关系。
en: The regulatory uncertainty created in areas such as health care makes it difficult not only for the health-care industry to make long-term investment decisions, but also for businesses to make long-term hires.

zh: 不过，在迫不及待地评判现行政策之前，我们应该对近来美国经济复苏期就业增长缓慢的问题有一个清醒的认识。
en: Nevertheless, before rushing to judgment about current policy, we should recognize the trend in recent US recoveries of slow job growth.

zh: 从1960到1991年，美国一般能迅速从经济衰退中复苏。
en: From 1960 until 1991, recoveries from recessions in the US were typically rapid.

zh: 从经济复苏的谷底算起，平均需要八个月恢复到之前的就业率。
en: From the trough of the recession, the economy recovered the lost jobs in eight months on average.

zh: 1991到2001年经济衰退的复苏过程难度很大。
en: The recoveries from the recessions of 1991 and 2001 were very different.

zh: 比如在2001年，产值恢复只用一个季度，就业恢复却用了38个月。
en: For instance, in 2001, it took just one quarter for output to recover, but 38 months for jobs to come back.

zh: 造成这一结果的原因颇多。
en: Explanations abound.

zh: 有些经济学家提出与以往经济衰退期临时解雇工人，恢复期又重新雇佣不同，1991年开始的岗位裁撤更加长期。
en: Some economists argue that, unlike past recessions, in which workers were temporarily laid off from an industry only to be rehired as the recovery picked up, job losses starting in 1991 were more permanent.

zh: 企业一直拖到衰退期才决定关闭没有商业价值的工厂并解雇工人加大了经济衰退的冲击力。
en: Matters were exacerbated by firms’ postponement until a recession of hard choices about closing unviable plants and shedding workers.

zh: 这导致失业工人被迫转行寻找工作，这样需要的时间更长，也需要接受更多培训。
en: As a result, unemployed workers had to find jobs in new industries, which took more time and training.

zh: 还有人提出网络的普及降低了企业快速雇工的难度。
en: Others suggest that the Internet has made it easier for firms to hire quickly.

zh: 因此，企业像过去那样在复苏初期因害怕雇不到人而影响销售，从而进行恐慌性雇佣的行为减少，今天的企业宁愿先确认复苏已切实开始。
en: So, rather than hire in a panic at the first sign of recovery, as they did in the past, for fear that they will be unable to do so later and lose sales, firms today would rather ensure that the recovery is well established before hiring.

zh: 这也解释了今年雇临时工流行的原因。
en: Hence also the growth in temporary hires today.

zh: 不管正确的解释是什么，近期经济衰退的历史表明，就业恢复需要时间并不稀奇。
en: Regardless of what the right explanation is, the history of recent recessions suggests that we should not be surprised that the job recovery is taking time.

zh: 但问题的某个方面的确与以往有所差异： 那就是建筑工人大批失业。
en: There is, however, an aspect of the problem that is different this time: layoffs in construction.

zh: 这从另一个侧面解释了就业增长为何始终不温不火，也为政策决定给出了有益的启迪。
en: Therein lies an additional explanation for tepid job growth, as well as a salutary lesson about policy.

zh: 建筑就业在之前的繁荣期大幅增加，房地产投资的GDP占比从1997到2006年增长了50 % 。
en: In the last boom, construction jobs expanded significantly, with investment in housing as a share of GDP increasing by 50% from 1997 to 2006.

zh: 正如我的同事埃里克·赫斯特及其合作者所揭示的那样，2000－2006年间建筑就业GDP占比增长最快的州在2006－2009年收缩也最猛烈。
en: As my colleague Erik Hurst and his co-authors have shown, states that had the largest rise in construction as a share of GDP in 2000-2006 tended to have the greatest contraction in that industry in 2006-2009.

zh: 这些州在2006－2009年失业率的变化也最剧烈。
en: These states also tended to have the largest rise in unemployment rates between 2006 and 2009.

zh: 失业大军中不仅包括建筑工人，还包括水暖工和电工等房地产附属工种，以及房地产中介和银行职员等辅助性行业。
en: The unemployed comprise not only construction workers, but also ancillary workers, such as real-estate brokers and bankers, as well as all those who work on houses, such as plumbers and electricians.

zh: 因此失业波及的范围远远超过建筑业。
en: So the job losses extend far beyond those in the construction industry.

zh: 很难想象总需求的任何增长能够推动房地产市场重新雇佣所有人员，而且请记住一点，稳定升值预期支撑了房地产市场的��荣发展，而今天看来这些希望已经彻底破灭。
en: It is hard to believe that any increase in aggregate demand will boost the housing market – which, remember, was buoyed by visions of steady price appreciation that few seem likely to hold today – sufficiently to re-employ all these workers.

zh: 据赫斯特估算这种“结构性”失业可能占总失业数的三个百分点。
en: Hurst estimates that this “structural” unemployment may account for up to three percentage points of total unemployment.

zh: 换句话讲，如果不是建筑业拖累，美国的失业率可能只有6.5 % — —远好于今天的失业率数据。
en: In other words, were it not for construction, the US unemployment rate would be 6.5% – a far healthier situation than today.

zh: 决策者们应该记住是宽松的货币政策推进了房地产市场繁荣，美国上次经济衰退恢复期间依靠同样政策成功推高了就业率。
en: Policymakers should remember that the housing boom was fueled by easy monetary policy, which sought to expand job growth as the US recovered from the last recession.

zh: 事实上，很多人离开学校从事无需任何技术的建筑工种，导致拉斯维加斯高中毕业率显著降低。
en: Indeed, high-school graduation rates dropped in Las Vegas as people left school for readily available unskilled construction jobs.

zh: 现在这些没受过教育的失业者不得不面对比大学毕业生高出两倍以上的失业率。
en: Now those uneducated unemployed are experiencing more than three times the unemployment rate of college graduates.

zh: 他们很难再找到合适的工作机会。
en: It will be very hard for them to return to the workforce.

zh: 决策者应当吸取的教训显而易见： 与其一次次拼命刺激需求，给未来留下一大堆潜在问题，改善就业的长效方法是推动失业人员“再培训 ” ， 特别是针对那些从事建筑相关行业的劳动力。
en: The lesson for policymakers is clear: instead of constantly trying to boost spending and potentially creating problems for the future, a more sustainable way to improve job growth is to facilitate the “re-skilling” of the unemployed, especially those who were in construction-related jobs.

zh: 最终，更良性的劳动力供给将创造更健康、更长效的需求。
en: Eventually, better labor-force supply will create healthier and more sustainable demand.

zh: 去军事化的穆斯林政治
en: Demilitarizing Muslim Politics

zh: 伊斯兰堡—穆斯林政府可以将自己从本国权势军方手中解放出来，建立可以与自由民主国家相提并论的文官执政吗？
en: ISLAMABAD – Can Muslim governments free themselves from their countries’ powerful militaries and establish civilian control comparable to that found in liberal democracies?

zh: 埃及、巴基斯坦和土耳其等国尽管情况大相径庭，却都面临着这一相同紧要问题。
en: This question is now paramount in countries as disparate as Egypt, Pakistan, and Turkey.

zh: 要预测这场斗争结果如何，就必须理解地区的历史。
en: To predict how this struggle will play out, it helps to understand the region’s past.

zh: 自从伊斯兰教于700年前创立以来，就一直有着军队深度干预政治和治理的传统。
en: Since Islam’s founding in the seventh century, it has maintained a tradition of deep military engagement in politics and governance.

zh: 事实上，伊斯兰教军事力量的见涨是其在全世界快速传播的助力器。
en: Indeed, Islam’s increasing military prowess helped it to spread rapidly around the world.

zh: 军队是伊斯兰教在中东以及波斯、南欧和印度次大陆生根发芽的关键。
en: The military was responsible for Islam’s implantation throughout the Middle East, as well as in Persia, Southern Europe, and the Indian sub-continent.

zh: 只要新征服的土地上建立起穆斯林国家，那么军队就是其治国的全部。
en: And once a Muslim state was established in newly conquered lands, the military became integral to its governance.

zh: 军队全面干预国家的顶峰是奥斯曼帝国，其统治者建立了一支新式军队，军士大多来源于伊斯兰教控制的欧洲国家。
en: The military’s incorporation into the state was most prominent in the Ottoman Empire, whose rulers created a new type of military force that drew its manpower mostly from Islamic-ruled parts of Europe.

zh: 这些苏丹亲兵（被编入奥斯曼帝国步兵的基督教雇佣军）要么从欧洲征召，要么从奥斯曼帝国控制下的国家强征。
en: These Janissaries (Christian boys conscripted to serve in Ottoman infantry units) were either recruited from Europe or abducted from countries under Ottoman control.

zh: 苏丹亲兵被禁止结婚，也不能拥有物业，这防止了他们对奥斯曼王朝之外的东西产生忠诚感。
en: Janissaries were not allowed to marry or to own property, which prevented them from developing loyalties outside of the imperial court.

zh: 但是，这些限制在16世纪被取消，此后直到苏丹亲兵在19世纪被消灭之前，他们一直是伊斯坦布尔最有实力的力量（甚至在埃及建立了自己的王朝 ） 。
en: But, after these restrictions were removed in the sixteenth century, and up until their extermination in the nineteenth century, the Janissaries became extremely powerful in Istanbul (and even established their own dynasty in Egypt).

zh: 穆斯林国家的军队主导状况随着19世纪早期奥斯曼帝国的灭亡而崩溃。
en: Military domination in Muslim countries survived right up to the fall of the Ottoman Empire in the early twentieth century.

zh: 殖民势力填补了帝国衰落之后留下的空缺，它们拥有自己的军队，因此不需要当地力量来进行治理。
en: The colonial powers that filled the vacuum left by the declining empire had their own militaries, and therefore did not need local forces to govern.

zh: 但当20世纪欧洲人从穆斯林世界撤离时，当地力量死灰复燃，开始角逐政治控制。
en: But when Europeans withdrew from the Muslim world in the twentieth century, these forces rushed back in to wrest control of politics.

zh: 20世纪中叶，军队在埃及、巴基斯坦和其他阿拉伯国家掌握了权力。
en: The military rose to power in Egypt, Pakistan, and other Arab countries in the early and mid-twentieth century.

zh: 在土耳其，军队将自己描述为世俗土耳其共和国的卫士，但1923年成立的土耳其共和国的建立者阿塔图尔克本人便是一名军人。
en: In Turkey, the military proclaimed itself the guardian of the secular Republic of Turkey, founded in 1923 by Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, himself a military man.

zh: 如今，动摇着穆斯林世界大部的革命运动正受着伊斯兰军队统治史的束缚。
en: Today, the revolutions rocking much of the Muslim world are bedeviled by Islam’s military past.

zh: 在这些民众起义的早期，被排挤在政治和经济权利之外的人群开始要求包融和参与。
en: In the first phase of these popular uprisings, those who had been politically and economically excluded began to demand inclusion and participation.

zh: 现在，革命进入了第二阶段，其标志是出现了要求旧军事势力不再掌权的正式努力。
en: Now a second phase is underway, marked by a serious effort to divest the old military establishment of its power.

zh: 这场斗争正在埃及、土耳其和巴基斯坦以各自不同的形式展开着。
en: This struggle is manifesting itself in different ways in Egypt, Turkey, and Pakistan.

zh: 在埃及，前总统穆巴拉克被罢黜后接管政治转型的军方不为穆斯林和世俗力量所容。
en: In Egypt, the military’s takeover of the political transition after the ouster of former President Hosni Mubarak is unacceptable to Muslim and secular forces alike.

zh: 大部分埃及人希望士兵远离政治，回到军营中去。
en: Most Egyptians want the soldiers to leave politics and return to their barracks.

zh: 伊沙姆·艾利安（Essam el-Erian）的伊斯兰自由正义党（Islamist Freedom and Justice Party）在最近的埃及议会选举中赢得了最多的席位。 最近，艾利安说，穆斯林兄弟会（Muslim Brotherhood，伊斯兰自由公正党的紧密盟友）并不指望军事统治者会自愿放弃权力。
en: Essam el-Erian, whose Islamist Freedom and Justice Party recently won the most seats in Egypt’s parliamentary elections, recently said that the Muslim Brotherhood (to which the party is closely tied), does not expect the military rulers to relinquish power voluntarily.

zh: 他们需要被说服离开，如果说服不能奏效的话，就需要动用武力。
en: They will have to be persuaded to leave, and, if that does not work, forced out.

zh: 议会驱逐军事统治者的第一步是捍卫其选择100位立宪大会参与者的权利。
en: The parliament’s first step in ultimately removing them would be to defend its authority to choose the members of a planned 100-person constitutional assembly.

zh: 与此同时，在土耳其，有着深厚伊斯兰传统根基的正义与发展党（Justice and Development Party）正在寻求限制军队的作用。
en: Meanwhile, in Turkey, the Justice and Development Party, which has strong roots in the country’s Islamic tradition, is now seeking to limit the military’s role.

zh: 不过，土耳其武装力量声称负有宪法使命来保护土耳其共和国的世俗传统。
en: The armed forces, however, claim a constitutional mandate to protect the Republic’s secular traditions.

zh: 土耳其的将军们多次干预政治，捍卫基马尔主义（Kemalism，即将伊斯兰土耳其推向欧洲式自由主义的阿塔图尔克关于现代化的世俗意识形态 ） 。
en: And Turkey’s generals have intervened in politics several times to defend Kemalism – Atatürk’s secular ideology of modernization that pushed Islamic Turkey towards European-style liberalism.

zh: 但是，对于这三个国家来说，土耳其在政治去军事化方面做得最成功。
en: But, of the three countries, Turkey has most successfully demilitarized its politics.

zh: 信奉基督教的总理埃尔多安已经连续三次赢得连任，他可以凌驾于军队之上行使权力。
en: The charismatic prime minister, Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, having won three consecutive elections, has been able to exert his authority over the military.

zh: 他颇有争议地囚禁了军方高级将领伊尔克·巴斯布格（İlker Başbuğ ） 。 土耳其检方指控他意图颠覆政府 — — 尽管许多人认为这根本是无稽之谈。
en: Controversially, he has jailed the army’s top general, İlker Başbuğ, whom Turkish prosecutors have accused – many say implausibly – of plotting to overthrow the government.

zh: 最后，巴基斯坦军队 — — 治理巴基斯坦长达32年，占巴基斯塔全部历史的一半 — — 正在努力地重新赢得决策影响力。
en: Finally, Pakistan’s military, which has governed the country for half of its 64-year history, is fighting hard to retain influence over policymaking.

zh: 由于无法控制美国军队的行动 — — 包括击毙本·拉登 — — 巴基斯坦军队正在竭力试图插手该国与印度和美国的关系。
en: Humbled by its inability to control United States military operations, including the one that killed Osama bin Laden, the army is struggling to play a hand in the country’s evolving relations with India and the US.

zh: 尽管如此，军方临到人忌惮树敌过多，因此在最近宣布它们无意干涉政治。
en: Nevertheless, wary of provoking widespread hostility, military leaders have indicated recently that they have no intention of intervening in politics.

zh: 自从阿拉伯之春爆发以来，已有四个根深蒂固的体制被推翻，其他体制也受到了日益增加的压力，这给阿拉伯人民带来了希望，他们的要求不再会被忽视，新来的治理者将考虑到他们的需求。
en: Since the Arab Spring began, four long-established regimes have been removed, while others are under increasing pressure, giving ordinary Arabs hope that their demands will no longer be ignored, and that those who govern will be mindful of citizens’ needs.

zh: 但真正的革命只有在人民有了真正的代表，而不是军队开始左右国家的政治进程时才会发生。
en: But that – the real revolution – will happen only when true representatives of citizens, rather than the military, begin to set their countries’ political course.

zh: 叙利亚不是解决办法的解决办法
en: Syria’s No-Solution Solution

zh: 马德里—叙利亚一片血腥狼藉。
en: MADRID – Syria is a blood-soaked shambles.

zh: 多年的内战导致200,000多人死亡，一百万人受伤，670万人在国内流亡。
en: Four years of civil war have left more than 200,000 dead, one million wounded, and 6.7 million people internally displaced.

zh: 另有380万人以难民身份流落国外，1,300万人（战前人口总共只有2,000万）需要人道主义援助。
en: Another 3.8 million are living as refugees outside the country, and 13 million (out of a pre-war population of 20 million) are in need of humanitarian assistance.

zh: 两名优秀的联合国特使 — — 科菲·安南和拉赫达尔·布拉西米（Lakhdar Brahimi）因为叙利亚自动孳生的包里循环而辞职。
en: Two illustrious United Nations special envoys – Kofi Annan and Lakhdar Brahimi – have resigned in the face of Syria's self-perpetuating spiral of violence.

zh: 但是，在这一悲剧的背景下，我们仍有理由保持谨慎乐观。
en: But, against this bleak background, there is reason for cautious optimism.

zh: 库尔德武装在进行了几个月的苦斗后最近终于成功地将伊斯兰国势力清除出边境小镇科巴尼（Kobane ） 。
en: Kurdish forces recently succeeded, after months of heavy fighting, in expelling the Islamic State from the border town of Kobane.

zh: 此外，新的联合国特使斯特凡·德米斯图拉（Staffan de Mistura）发起了务实而有决心的“阿勒颇第一”战略，旨在冻结这一被摧毁城市的军事行动，方便援助的进入。
en: Moreover, the new UN envoy, Staffan de Mistura, has initiated a pragmatic and determined “Aleppo first" strategy, which aims to freeze military operations in the shattered city and facilitate the entry of aid.

zh: 这会成为叙利亚的转折点吗？
en: Could this mark a turning point for Syria?

zh: 叙利亚危机爆发时，没人预测到会如此严重、漫长和复杂。
en: When the crisis in Syria erupted, nobody predicted how serious, protracted, and complex it would turn out to be.

zh: 首先，观察者低估了叙利亚人民不断加深的绝望感，这种感觉促使他们支持圣战组织或巴沙尔·阿萨德政权。
en: For starters, observers underestimated citizens' ever-deepening sense of hopelessness, which has driven them to support jihadi groups or the Assad regime.

zh: 叙利亚冲突的另一个独特之处是其不对称性，这一不对称性来自冲突所包括的众多不同的行动方。
en: The conflict is also unique in its asymmetry, stemming from the numerous and disparate actors involved.

zh: 常规军队只有两支：库尔德武装和忠于总统巴沙尔的部队。
en: There are only two conventional armies: the Kurdish fighters and the forces loyal to President Bashar al-Assad.

zh: 反对派由依赖外国赞助的派系组成。
en: The opposition comprises factions dependent on foreign sponsors.

zh: 事实上 ， “ 民族主义”反对派只是众多负责保护小片领土的派系的松散组合 ， “ 自由叙利亚军 ” （ Free Syrian Army）则无异于幻想。
en: Indeed, the “nationalist" opposition is merely an assortment of factions responsible for protecting small territories, and the “Free Syrian Army" is little more than a fantasy.

zh: 严峻的事实是组织最好的集团是圣战者：伊斯兰国、叙利亚救国阵线（Jabhat al-Nusra）和伊斯兰阵线（Islamic Front ） 。
en: The stark reality is that the best-organized groups are the jihadists: the Islamic State, Jabhat al-Nusra, and the Islamic Front.

zh: 德米斯图拉的计划旨在通过将政策焦点从无情的军事行动上移开稳定局面 — — 以军事为焦点只能令伊斯兰国受益。
en: De Mistura's plan aims to stabilize the situation by shifting the policy focus away from a relentless military campaign – an approach that is benefiting only the Islamic State.

zh: 该计划强调阿勒颇 — — 它不仅是商业枢纽、叙利亚最大城市，也是叙利亚的一个微缩景观 — — 这使该计划与在霍姆斯（Homs）和叙利亚其他地区所实施的不可靠的停火协议不同。
en: The plan's emphasis on Aleppo – which is not only a commercial hub and Syria's largest city, but also represents a sort of microcosm of the country – distinguishes it from the shaky cease-fires that have been implemented in Homs and elsewhere in the country.

zh: 德米斯图拉的战略的主要优点是其本身并非和平计划。
en: The strategy's main strength is that it is not, in itself, a peace project.

zh: 它不要求任何或所有派系投降或解除武装，相反，它只是呼吁停止激烈战斗，让各种人道主义援助得以实行从而防止阿勒颇的全面崩溃。
en: Instead of requiring that any or all factions surrender or relinquish their weapons, it calls only for the cessation of heavy fighting, to allow for the delivery of humanitarian aid and prevent Aleppo's total collapse.

zh: 这一冻结战事 — — 由有效的执行机制保证 — — 将是一次信心建设取得进展的重要机会。
en: Such a freeze – guaranteed by an effective enforcement mechanism – would present an important opportunity to make progress in confidence-building.

zh: 最近在开罗和莫斯科的谈判取得了朝这个方向的成果，虽然规模很小但不容忽视。
en: Recent talks in Cairo and Moscow produced small, but not negligible, steps in that direction.

zh: 目标应该是启动相关行动方之间的建设性对话 — — 并最终达成一致。
en: The objective should be to initiate a productive dialogue – and, ultimately, achieve consensus – among relevant actors.

zh: 在这场代理战争中，如果不在各派系的主要支持源 — — 伊朗、沙特阿拉伯和卡塔尔之间形成协议，就无法产生解决办法。
en: In this proxy war, no solution will be possible without the agreement of the factions' main sources of support – Iran, Saudi Arabia, and Qatar.

zh: 类似地，土耳其不但必须解决难民流入问题、与叙利亚边境的安全问题，以及它作为圣战者中转国的立场问题，它还必须制定与官方对该国库尔德人少数群体要求的担忧不同的针对伊斯兰国连贯政策。
en: Likewise, Turkey must not only address the inflow of refugees, security concerns along its border with Syria, and its position as a transit country for jihadists; it must also develop a coherent policy toward the Islamic State that is not subsumed in official anxiety over demands by the country's Kurdish minority.

zh: 其他力量也可以起到作用。
en: Other powers will also have a key role to play.

zh: 美国对德米斯图拉计划的支持象征着总统奥巴马政府的悄然的建设性变化 — — 不再要求巴沙尔立即下台。
en: Support by the United States for de Mistura's initiative symbolizes a quiet – and constructive – shift by President Barack Obama's administration from its demand that Assad step down immediately.

zh: 但是，欧盟对叙利亚政策仍是一团糟，成员国只是同意成立一个“地区信托基金”解决这场危机。
en: The European Union's policy toward Syria, however, remains confused, with member states having managed to agree only to create a “regional trust fund" to address the crisis.

zh: 稳定的叙利亚对欧盟具有重大意义，这谁由其地理位置决定的，因此欧洲领导人应该在叙利亚问题常采取绝不含糊的立场。
en: Given the EU's strong interest in a more stable Syria, rooted in its geographical proximity, it is time for European leaders to take an unequivocal stance on Syria.

zh: 但这场冲突的持续解决办法最终还是取决于叙利亚人民 ， 。
en: But a lasting solution to the conflict ultimately comes down to the Syrians.

zh: 事实上，形成叙利亚领导的解决办法所需要的基础在2012年的第一次日内瓦协商（Geneva I Communiqué）中就已经建立。
en: In fact, the foundations for the kind of Syrian-led political solution that is needed were laid with the 2012 Geneva I Communiqué.

zh: 当时，连续多伦协商都以失败告终，原因是“要么全有，要么全无”思维，而这又主要是因为错误地认为巴沙尔与土耳其的本·阿里和埃及的穆巴拉克一样，将在相对较短的时间内被推翻。
en: At that time, successive rounds of negotiations failed, owing to an all-or-nothing mentality, based largely on the mistaken assumption that Assad, like Tunisia's Zine el-Abidine Ben Ali and Egypt's Hosni Mubarak, would be ousted relatively quickly.

zh: 但德米斯图拉明确地表明他的目标不是与巴沙尔保持长期和平，也不把巴沙尔交出权力作为和平的先决条件。
en: But de Mistura has made it clear that he aims neither to build a lasting peace with Assad nor to establish Assad's departure from power as a precondition for peace.

zh: 他的解决方案介于这两者之间，西方 — — 特别是欧洲 — — 必须接受它。
en: The solution lies between these two options, and the West – especially Europe – must accept that.

zh: 对叙利亚和平进程提出不切实际的要求必然会以失败告终。
en: Placing unrealistic demands on a Syrian peace process is a sure route to failure.

zh: 务实是至关重要的，即使这意味着一些重要行动方，包括欧盟，必须放下矜持。
en: Pragmatism is essential, even if it means that some relevant actors, including the EU, have to swallow their pride.

zh: 该地区的稳定和叙利亚人民的生死（以及活下来的叙利亚人的命运）都取决于此。
en: The stability of the region and the lives (and what is left of the livelihoods) of the Syrian people depend on it.

zh: 民主飓风
en: A Democratic Hurricane

zh: 纽约—没有什么比全面发酵的危机更能吸引眼球的了。
en: NEW YORK – Nothing concentrates the mind like a full-blown crisis.

zh: 和其他数百万纽约市民一样，我也听到了飓风桑迪掠过我窗、吹打我门的声音。
en: Like millions of other people in New York City, I heard Hurricane Sandy rattling my windows and battering my doors.

zh: 不过我比很多人幸运一点，飓风对我的侵扰也只限于吹打而已。
en: I was luckier than many. Rattling is all it did.

zh: 多年来，专家一直在警告类似风暴会摧毁纽约市陈旧的市政基础设施。
en: For many years, experts have been warning that such storms would overwhelm the city’s antiquated urban infrastructure.

zh: 海水灌入了开放的地铁。
en: Salt water came streaming into open subways.

zh: 断电将三分之一曼哈顿陷入了前现代的黑暗状态。
en: Damage to the power supply reduced a third of Manhattan to a pre-modern state of darkness.

zh: 而这只是纽约的情况。
en: And that was just New York.

zh: 在新泽西州的不少地方，许多仍拥有自己的房子的幸运者被汹涌的污水流灌进的家里。
en: In parts of New Jersey, many people fortunate enough still to have a house are cut off by rivers of raw sewage lapping at their doors.

zh: 没人能斩钉截铁地说这场大风暴是由全球变暖引起的，但几乎所有专家都同意，极点海冰融化和海平面上升的影响将导致未来风暴更加厉害。
en: No one can say with certainty that this particular storm was caused by global warming, but almost all experts agree that the effects of polar-ice melt and sea-level rise will make future storms worse. And yet neither candidate in the United States’ presidential campaign bothered to mention the potentially catastrophic consequences of climate change.

zh: 从这个角度看，飓风桑迪就像是枪支暴力。
en: In this sense, Hurricane Sandy was like gun violence.

zh: 在整个竞选季中 — — 尽管在此期间发生了数起受到高度关注的群体枪击事件 — — 不管是总统奥巴马还是其挑战者罗姆尼都不愿意讨论许多州都存在的法律问题，即允许任何人携带致命武器，随时随地制造死亡案件。
en: Throughout the campaign season – and despite several highly publicized mass shootings in this period – neither President Barack Obama nor his challenger, Mitt Romney, wished to discuss the problem of laws in many states that allow almost anyone to carry lethal weapons and spray death around at random.

zh: 当然，个中原因在于解决这些问题无法带来足够的选票。
en: The reason, of course, is that there are not enough votes to be gained in addressing these matters.

zh: 即使多数美国人同意气候变化确实存在，未来灾难似乎也是遥不可及，或者会发生在其他地方，既然如此，为什么现在有什么好担心的呢？
en: Even if a majority of Americans agree that climate change is real, future disasters seem a long way off, or might happen somewhere else, so why worry about them now?

zh: 也许纽约和其他许多地方要做很多事情才能防止未来的洪水，但是，正如一位前市政官员在一次采访中所说的 ， “ 不到事情发生，人们是不会愿意为它掏腰包的。 ”
en: Perhaps more should be done to protect New York, among many other places, against future flooding, but, as a former city official told an interviewer: “Until things happen, people aren’t willing to pay for it.”

zh: 这是否是民主制度的一个严重弱点？
en: Does this point to a serious weakness in the democratic system?

zh: 毕竟大部分选民考虑的是眼前的利益 — — 更少税负、更多工作、更低汽油价格，等等 — — 而不会去规划未来，因为未来是不可预测的。
en: Most voters, after all, think about their immediate interests – less taxation, more jobs, lower gasoline prices, and so on – and not about planning for the future, which is, in any case, unpredictable.

zh: 我们只希望当下感觉良好。
en: We want to feel good right now.

zh: 而这正是民主选举的政客所迎合的情绪。
en: And that is precisely the sentiment to which democratically elected politicians will cater.

zh: 未来嘛，它会自己照顾自己的。
en: The future will take care of itself.

zh: 对于这种态度，我有话要说。
en: There is something to be said for this attitude.

zh: 号召为未来乌托邦而牺牲的政治让人为了各种不可能实现的理想而奋斗，给人类造成了严重的灾难。
en: The kind of politics that imposes sacrifices for the sake of future utopias has caused immense human suffering in the service of a variety of impossible ideals.

zh: 既然如此，不如还是坚守当下吧。
en: Better, then, to stick to the here and now.

zh: 但为了当下的享受而停止一定程度的未来集体利益和沉迷于乌托邦幻境一样有害。
en: Yet postponing, for the sake of immediate gratification, a certain degree of planning for the future collective good can be as disastrous as indulging in utopian schemes.

zh: 或许存在一些超越自私自利、做必需完成之事的非乌托邦方法。
en: Perhaps there are some non-utopian ways of transcending selfish interests and doing what is necessary.

zh: 比如，在许多国家，选民甘愿把票投给商业大亨：受够了政客为自身利益喋喋不休，让雷厉风行的强人执政，像经营公司一样治理国家吧。
en: For example, in various countries, voters have been tempted to elect business tycoons: enough with politicians bickering over selfish interests – let the can-do strongmen take charge and run countries like corporations.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼就是这样一个人物。
en: Silvio Berlusconi was one such figure.

zh: 从某种程度上说，罗姆尼也在诱导这一情绪，只是没那么赤裸裸罢了：他知道如何经营一家投资公司，既然如此，为什么不能经营好美国联邦政府呢？
en: Mitt Romney, in a milder, less flamboyant manner, has appealed to these sentiments as well: he knew how to run an investment company, so why not the US federal government?

zh: 但是，在实践中，这类大亨政客有自己的利益和目的需要追求。
en: In practice, however, such tycoon politicians have their own interests and gratifications to pursue.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼确实在按照精英公司的方法治国：如同私人采邑一样提拔亲信、威吓批评者，用大把金钱换取人们如奴婢般的忠诚。
en: Berlusconi did indeed run Italy the way he runs his companies: like a private fiefdom, promoting cronies, intimidating critics, and paying people vast sums of money in exchange for their slavish devotion.

zh: 2009年夺去数百人生命的L’Aquila地震两年后，该市重建工作仍毫无进展，尽管在地震发生后的公共秀当中，贝卢斯科尼戴着一顶消防帽亲自坐镇指挥。
en: And, two years after the earthquake in L’Aquila in 2009, which killed hundreds of people, nothing much had been done to reconstruct the city, despite an initial flurry of publicity stunts showing Berlusconi, posing in a fireman’s hat, personally taking charge.

zh: 更加认真的技术官僚是如何治理列宁资本主义中华人民共和国的呢？
en: What about the more serious-minded technocrats who run the Leninist-capitalist People’s Republic of China?

zh: “中国模式”是资本主义经济和专制政府的结合，并被频繁地宣传比混乱、猥琐、妥协的自由民主制度更优越。
en: The “Chinese model,” combining a capitalist economy with authoritarian government, has frequently been hailed as superior to the messy, dithering, compromising ways of liberal democracies.

zh: 中国领导人不需要担心选举问题，可以做更长远的规划，完成必要的工作，而不会受到狭隘私人利益和吹毛求疵媒体的干扰。
en: With no need to concern themselves about elections, China’s leaders can afford to plan for the longer term and do what is necessary without being impeded by petty selfish interests or a carping press.

zh: 这样的安排事实上可以让中国用多年的时间建设完整的城市以及高速铁路、剧场、体育场、工业园、超级大坝和其他大型项目。
en: These arrangements have indeed made it possible for China to build entire cities in a matter of years, as well as high-speed railways, opera houses, stadiums, industrial parks, massive dams, and whatnot.

zh: 许多人因此脱贫，拥有正确政治关系的人更是攫取了巨额财富。
en: Many people have been lifted out of poverty, and those with the right political connections have become enormously rich.

zh: 但这种类型的专制缺少透明度，因此导致了大规模腐败和重大错误，更不用说愈演愈烈的生态破坏了。
en: But the lack of transparency in this type of autocracy has also led to massive corruption and huge blunders, not to mention the growing signs of ecological ruin.

zh: 中国政府的批评者 — — 即便是那些只愿意报道错误和失误的批评者 — — 都在高压之下噤了声：或者在警署被殴打，或者被判处严厉徒刑，有的甚至惨遭谋杀。
en: Chinese critics of the government, or even those who simply wish to report mistakes or wrongdoing, are silenced with a heavy hand: beatings in police stations, draconian jail sentences, or even murder.

zh: 这些人包括2008年四川地震后公开表达对学校建筑质量低下、导致孩子丧生的愤怒之情的家长。
en: That is what happened to the parents who openly expressed their anger about the ill-constructed school buildings that collapsed in the 2008 Sichuan earthquake, killing their children.

zh: 这些孩子之所以丧生，是因为腐败的当地官员放任开发商使用劣质建筑材料中饱私囊。
en: The children died because corrupt local officials had allowed developers to enrich themselves by using inferior building materials.

zh: 尽管有各种各样的缺陷，但当选官员需受公众问责，并有可能被选民选下台的制度仍比大亨或技术官僚治国的制度好。
en: Despite its flaws, a system in which elected officials are held publicly accountable and can be voted out of office is still preferable to rule by tycoons or technocrats.

zh: 此外，有时候，即使是民主国家也会发生重大变化，尽管动员选民为推动必要改革齐心协力往往需要以严重危机为契机，20世纪30年代导致罗斯福新政的大萧条便是显例。
en: And, sometimes, radical changes are made, even in democracies, though a severe crisis often is required to mobilize voters behind a collective push for essential reform, as was true of the Great Depression in the 1930’s, which led to Franklin Roosevelt’s New Deal.

zh: 也许飓风桑迪将刺激美国公民和政客认证对待气候变化问题，并采取旨在保护美国城市和海岸线的公共政策。
en: Perhaps Hurricane Sandy will spur US citizens and politicians to take climate change seriously – and to implement public policies aimed at protecting America’s cities and coastlines.

zh: 果真如此的话，我们倒要抱怨这场危机来的太晚了。
en: If so, we can only hope that this crisis will not have come too late.

zh: 民主从本国开始
en: Democracy Begins At Home

zh: 布什政府已经扩大了它的外交政策中心的民主成分。
en: The Bush administration has put expansion of democracy at the center of its foreign policy.

zh: 比起单纯扩展美国霸权，这是更为高尚的使命。
en: This is a far nobler calling than simply expanding American hegemony.

zh: 问题是，布什真的会这么做吗？ 他真得明白民主的含义吗？
en: The question is, does Bush really mean it, and does he genuinely understand what democracy means?

zh: 布什政权对沙特阿拉伯的地方选举大家赞扬，但是妇女的权利呢 — — 包括她们的选举权呢？
en: The Bush administration praised Saudi Arabia’s municipal elections, but what about the rights of women—including their voting rights?

zh: 它对委内瑞拉民主选举产生的领导人的倒台拍手称好（如果它并没有积极参与策划他的倒台的话 ） ， 却继续支持巴基斯坦的军事独裁者。
en: It welcomed (if it did not actively participate in) the toppling of Venezuela’s democratically elected leader, but it continues to support Pakistan’s military dictator.

zh: 它批评俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，但仅仅只是在普京有违商业利益之后。
en: It criticizes Russian President Vladimir Putin, but only after he goes against business interests.

zh: 布什政权对俄罗斯的媒体集中化颇为担忧，但却对意大利的媒体集中化却保持沉默。
en: And it may raise concerns about media concentration in Russia, but remains silent about media concentration in Italy.

zh: 从更基本的理解层面来说，美国的行为有伪善之嫌。
en: There is a taint of hypocrisy in a more fundamental sense.

zh: 布什政府强调选举重要性，它做得很对，因为不这么做就无法进行选举。
en: The Bush administration is right to emphasize the importance of elections, without which democracy is inconceivable.

zh: 但是民主包含的内容远远甚于定期选举，选举的合法性也取决于民主对选举程序本身的信赖度。
en: But democracy entails more than periodic elections, and the legitimacy of elections depends on the public’s confidence in the electoral process itself.

zh: 从这个角度而言，最近两届的美国选举都无法为全世界做出楷模。
en: In this respect, the last two American presidential elections have hardly been models for the world.

zh: 美国前总统吉米·卡特已经对美国最近的选举是否符合美国应当遵守的标准提出质疑。 由他创立的亚特兰大中心监督全球的选举。
en: Former President Jimmy Carter, whose Atlanta center monitors elections around the globe, has raised questions about whether America’s recent election lives up to the standards the United States should uphold.

zh: 尽管前总统比尔·克林顿努力确保所有授权选举的美国人能登记选举，但是共和党人试图撤销这项进程，在登记和选举过程中都设置了障碍。
en: Where former President Bill Clinton sought to ensure that all Americans who are entitled to vote are registered to vote, the Republicans have tried to reverse these advances, putting obstacles in the way both of registration and voting.

zh: 现代技术能轻而易举地以最低的成本获得投票机器的文件记录，但是还是有几个州拒绝使用这种成本微小的安全装置。
en: Modern technology makes it easy to have a paper trail for voting machines, at little cost; yet several states chose not to provide this minimal safeguard.

zh: 撇开选举不说，公民们只有在消息灵通的条件下，才能有效检查政府的工作。
en: Beyond elections, citizens can provide an effective check on government only if they are well informed.

zh: 那正是知情权如此重要的原因。
en: That is why right-to-know laws are so important.

zh: 当然，政治家们总喜欢在不受监督的条件下秘密工作。
en: Of course, politicians prefer to work in secrecy, without oversight.

zh: 我们无法想象，雇用一个工人，但却允许他不必向他的老板汇报他正在做什么。
en: No one can imagine hiring a worker, but allowing him not to inform his employer about what he is doing on the job.

zh: 政治家们为公民工作，公民有权知道他们雇佣的人正在做些什么。
en: Politicians work for the citizenry, which has the right to know what their employees are doing.

zh: 公民有权知道他们的钱何去何从，制定政策是在向谁咨询。
en: Citizens have the right to know how their money is being spent and who is being consulted to form policy.

zh: 他们有权知道安隆 （Enron）和石油公司是否在影响能源政策。
en: They have the right to know whether Enron and the oil companies are shaping energy policy.

zh: 他们有权知道，为什么美国人和全世界被伊拉克大规模杀伤性武器的虚假情报所误导。
en: They have the right to know why America, and the world, was misled by false claims about weapons of mass destruction in Iraq.

zh: 我把调查的重点放在不对等的信息对经济运作的影响。
en: My research has focused on the consequences of asymmetries in information for the functioning of the economy.

zh: 但是，正确信息的匮乏对政治进程产生了一样严重的后果。
en: But a lack of accurate information has equally, if not more, severe consequences for political processes.

zh: 决定发动伊拉克战争是最具戏剧性的例证，但是在布什执政期间美国还有许多其他例子。
en: The decision to go to war in Iraq is the most dramatic example of this, but there have been many others in America under Bush.

zh: 美国老年健康医疗计划在医疗保险中提供药物福利，也许是个正确的决定。
en: Providing drug benefits under Medicare, America’s health-care program for the aged, may have been the right decision.

zh: 但是限制政府与医药公司讨价还价的权利却纯粹是个投降之举，并且提供完全失真的成本信息是说不过去的 — — 根据目前估计该成本将在今后十年超过一万一千亿美元。
en: But restricting government’s ability to bargain with the drug companies was a pure give-away, and nothing justifies providing grossly distorted information about the costs—now estimated to be in excess of 1.1 trillion over the next decade.

zh: 这是布什政府原本计划数量的三倍。
en: This is three times the amount original projected by the Bush administration.

zh: 当前，布什政府卷入了一场有关社会保障危机的虚假信息风波。
en: Today, the Bush administration is engaged in a disinformation campaign about an impending social security crisis.

zh: 尽管布什政府应该有所作为，但是这个问题的程度还不足以引起一场危机。
en: While something should be done, the magnitude of the problem hardly foreshadows a crisis.

zh: 相反，只要2001年和2003年花费在减税计划中的一小部分钱，该体系基本能在未来75年保持根基稳定。
en: On the contrary, the system could almost surely be put on a solid footing for the next 75 years with a fraction of what was spent on the 2001 and 2003 tax cuts.

zh: 良好的信息沟通不仅要求知情权，也需要话语权 — — 一个多样化的媒体。
en: Good information requires not just the right to know, but also the right to tell—a diversified media.

zh: 正如我们已经注意到的那样，在俄罗斯出现了对电视广播缺乏多样性的正当投诉，但是布什并没有对美国联邦通信委员会努力削弱媒体集中化法律作法提出反对。
en: There are, as we noted, justified complaints about the lack of diversity in television broadcasting in Russia, yet Bush has not opposed efforts by America’s Federal Communications Commission to weaken laws on media concentration.

zh: 民主体系也要求认可个人权利。
en: Democracy also requires recognizing the rights of individuals.

zh: 破坏任何个人权利的行为将危害到每个人的权利。
en: Undermining any individual’s rights jeopardizes everyone’s rights.

zh: 尽管在布什政权下，美国已经破坏了基本民权，诸如可以保证个人在遭到政府拘禁时求助于司法审查权的人身保护权。
en: Yet under Bush, the US has undermined basic civil rights, such as habeas corpus, which guarantees individuals recourse to judicial review when the state detains them.

zh: 许多人在关塔纳摩（Guatanamo）被延长扣留 — — 没有控诉也没有审判 — — 这就是对这一权力的根本性破坏。
en: The extended detention of dozens of individuals in Guantanamo—without charge and without trial—is a basic abrogation of this right.

zh: 幸运的是，即使布什不明白这些基本准则，美国的法庭却是明白的，虽然它只是马后炮地迫使它的政府遵守这些条例。
en: Fortunately, even if Bush does not understand such basic principles, America’s courts do, and they are now, albeit belatedly, forcing his administration to abide by them.

zh: 最后，如果对达到《世界人权宣言》所称的最低生活水平的权利毫无意识的话，又何来选举权的价值？
en: Finally, of what value is the right to vote without recognition of the right to a certain minimal standard of living, as enshrined in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights?

zh: 在那些大多数人民生活在最低生活保障下的国家，购买选票实在太容易了。
en: In countries where much of the population lives below subsistence level, buying votes is all too easy.

zh: 但是唯一让布什政府意识到的经济权是知识产权，把医药公司的利益放在那些威胁人们生命的疾病、资金的自由流动之前，这对许多国家都产生了破坏性的影响。
en: But the only economic rights the Bush administration recognizes are intellectual property rights, putting the interests of drug companies ahead of those with life threatening diseases, and the free mobility of capital, which has had such devastating effects on many countries.

zh: 美国的民主体系仍是世界大部分国家的敌人，而现在布什政府大力普及民主的做法值得称道。
en: America’s democracy remains the envy of much of the world, and it is good that the Bush administration now champions the expansion of democracy forcefully.

zh: 但是如果它更仔细地看看自己的国家，如果它更诚实地检查它自己的行为，如果它加入一个更广范围内的有关民主究竟意味着什么的谈话，布什政府也许能变得更加可信，取得更多的胜利。
en: But the administration would be far more credible, and have far more success, if it took a closer look at home, if it examined its own practices more honestly, and if it engaged in a broader discussion of what democracy really means.

zh: 被破坏的民主承诺
en: Democracy’s Broken Promises

zh: 圣地亚哥 — — 自由民主正处在重重包围之中。
en: SANTIAGO – Liberal democracy is under siege.

zh: 左翼和右翼民粹主义者不仅猛烈抨击全球化和中产阶级收入停滞不前；他们正在质疑自由民主制度的合法性以及管理上述制度的政治精英。
en: Populists of the right and left are not only lashing out at globalization or stagnating middle-class incomes; they are calling into question the legitimacy of the institutions of liberal democracy and of the political elites who manage those institutions.

zh: 人们很容易将现状归咎于民粹主义分子奉行的后真实主义政治。
en: It’s facile to blame the politics of post-truth practiced by populists.

zh: 如果当前民主实践没有问题，谎言和夸张将很难奏效。
en: Lies and exaggerations would not work if current democratic practice were without problems.

zh: 我们必须重新审视，如果可能的话，彻底解决意大利民主，也就是理论家诺贝尔托·博比奥所谓的“被破坏的民主承诺。 ”
en: We must re-examine and, if possible, redress what the Italian democratic theorist Norberto Bobbio called the “broken promises of democracy.”

zh: 任何曾经参加过竞选的人都曾听到过选民那种熟悉的疑虑 ： “ 我们只在选举的时候才能看到你们政治家。
en: Anyone who has ever campaigned for office has heard voters’ familiar refrain: “We only see you politicians at election time.”

zh: ”政治家似乎遥远而且不值得信任，民众对民调组织这样说。
en: Politicians seem distant and untrustworthy, citizens tell pollsters.

zh: 民粹主义分子恰恰利用了这种距离。
en: Populists exploit that gap.

zh: 现代民主采取代议制。
en: Modern democracy is representative.

zh: 当民选代表花费更多时间在议会而非与民众互动，他们并不是在忽略自己的职责；他们恰恰是在履职。
en: When elected representatives spend more time in Parliament than they do interacting with citizens, they are not neglecting their duties; they are doing their job.

zh: 但现代民主的陈词滥调却提出截然不同的说法：强调贴近选民，保持对他们的关注。
en: But the rhetoric of modern democracy claims otherwise: it emphasizes closeness to voters and their concerns.

zh: 当与现实的对比显得太过刺眼，政治领导人的信誉就会遭受损失。
en: When the contrast with reality is too glaring, political leaders’ credibility suffers.

zh: 在民主体制下，政治家是委托人（即选民）所授权的代理。
en: In democratic systems, politicians are agents acting on a mandate from the principals (the voters).

zh: 而且，像经济领域一样，因为委托人可能无法分辨合格和无能代理而产生了民主的委托-代理问题。
en: And, as in economics, democracies’ principal-agent problem is a problem because the principal may not be able to distinguish capable agents from inept ones.

zh: 而且代理人自身利益可能与委托人不一致。
en: And agents may have interests of their own that clash with the principal’s.

zh: 结果是民众有很多理由不信任政界人士。
en: As a result, citizens have plenty of reasons not to trust politicians.

zh: 民主政体通过体制手段努力确保政客和选民的利益保持一致。
en: Democracies endeavor to ensure by institutional means that the interests of politicians and voters are aligned.

zh: 在英国，选举议会议员的选区相对较小，而在美国，众议院议员必须每两年寻求连任。
en: In Britain, the constituencies that elect members of Parliament are relatively small, and in the United States, members of the House of Representatives must seek reelection every two years.

zh: 但这些方法本身并非没有问题，包括狭隘主义以及竞选频率过大所导致的政客受制于资助其竞选活动的特殊利益集团而非选民。
en: But these solutions are not without their own problems, including parochialism and the risk that the frequency of elections will make politicians beholden not to voters, but to the special interests that finance their campaigns.

zh: 民主政治家也试图说服选民他们自身的利益与选民利益一致。
en: Democratic politicians also try to persuade voters that their own interests are aligned with those of the electorate.

zh: 这样的工作可能是健康的，比如当官员公开其竞选资金来源及可能的利益冲突。
en: Such efforts can be healthy, as when officials disclose the sources of their campaign funds and possible conflicts of interest.

zh: 但这种做法也有可能产生不健康的后果，比方说当候选人迎合选民的恐惧和愤怒。
en: But they can also be unhealthy, as when candidates pander to voters’ fears and resentments.

zh: 事实上，哈佛大学和麻省理工学院研究人员最近发表的两篇引人入胜的论文从政客试图向选民证明他们并未受制于权势影响的角度解释了民粹主义的崛起。
en: Indeed, two fascinating recent papers by researchers at Harvard and MIT explain the emergence of populism in terms of politicians’ efforts to signal to voters that they are not beholden to powerful interests.

zh: 因此，尽管民粹主义政策牺牲整体经济福利，但理性的选民仍会选择它，因为它们是区分不同类型政治家所付出的代价。
en: Thus, although populist policies reduce overall economic welfare, rational voters choose them because they are the price of distinguishing between different types of politicians.

zh: 正如其中一篇论文所指出的那样 ： “ 一旦领导人不一定保持诚实，雇佣那些无能的领袖就似乎体现出价值。 ”
en: As one of the papers puts it: “once leaders are not necessarily honest, it may be worth hiring those that are incompetent.”

zh: 博比奥强调对民主政客信任的缺失同样源于另外两大难题。
en: Bobbio emphasizes that lack of trust in democratic politicians also arises from two additional difficulties.

zh: 其一是现代社会极致多元化，众多利益竞相争夺代表资格；政客无法代表普遍意志。
en: One is that modern societies are pluralistic, with many interests vying to be represented; there is no general will for a politician to represent.

zh: 还有就是在代议制民主中，没有任何约束力量强制当选政治家以某种特定的方式行事。
en: The other is that in a representative democracy there is no binding mandate for the elected politician to act in a certain way.

zh: 一旦当选，她就有权确定什么是社会利益，以及实行什么样的政策来推动它。
en: Once she is elected, it is up to her to decide what the good of society is and which policies will advance it.

zh: 冲突的可能性是显而易见的。
en: The potential for conflict is obvious.

zh: 即使在政客所代表的意义并不相互冲突的不太可能的情况下，就最佳政策达成一致也并不容易。
en: Even in the unlikely event that the interests a politician represents do not clash with one another, there will be no easy agreement about the best policies.

zh: 更糟的是，一名能干而且诚实的政治家可能确实选择了最佳政策；但在不完全信息环境下，她可能无法说服选民她做了正确的事。
en: Worse, an able and honest politician may indeed choose the best policies; but, in an environment of imperfect information, she may be unable to persuade voters that she did the right thing.

zh: 假设目标是创造就业机会，而这位政治家选择了实现这一目标的最佳政策。
en: Suppose that the goal is to create jobs, and that the politician chooses the best policy to achieve that goal.

zh: 但之后发生的外部冲击导致就业下降。
en: Then, an external shock causes employment to fall.

zh: 选民们永远无法确定正确的政策是什么，但他们怀疑政治家夸大了外部冲击的影响，并借此来推卸工作机会丧失的责任。
en: Voters can never be sure of what the correct policy was, but they suspect the politician of exaggerating the size of the shock to explain away lost jobs.

zh: 所有选民都知道在需要工作时无法找到工作，而他们将这个问题归咎于政治家。
en: All voters know is that they cannot get a job when they want one, and they blame the politician for this.

zh: 随着社会复杂程度越来越高，评估和选择政策的难度不断加大，这种紧张局面发生的概率也随之不断增加。
en: As societies become more complex and the difficulty of evaluating and choosing policies grows, so will the potential for this kind of tension.

zh: 拥有做出复杂政治决策知识的技术专家们在社会地位上越来越重要，但公众评价却不断恶化。
en: Technocrats endowed with the knowledge needed to make complex policy decisions will rise in social importance but fall in public esteem.

zh: 记得前英国司法部长迈克尔·戈夫在英国退欧辩论中说过 ： “ 这个国家的民众已经受够了专家。
en: Recall former UK justice minister Michael Gove’s remark in the midst of the Brexit debate: “people in this country have had enough of experts.”

zh: ”或者，就像博比奥所说的那样 ， “ 专家执政和民主是对立的：如果专家还是工业社会的主人公，普通民众就将丧失核心作用。 ”
en: Or, as Bobbio puts it, “technocracy and democracy are antithetical: if the expert is the protagonist of industrial society, this rules out a central role for ordinary citizens.”

zh: 还有最后一个令事态变��更加复杂的因素：即技术导致民众传递多重需求的速度大幅增加。
en: Add one final complicating factor: technology vastly increases the speed at which citizens transmit multiple demands.

zh: 如果街角的垃圾没有被收走，一座城市的市长几乎立刻就会从推特和Facebook上了解情况。
en: A town’s mayor will know almost instantly from Twitter and Facebook if rubbish is not collected from a street corner.

zh: 但现代的制衡体系拖慢了采取对策的速度。
en: And yet modern checks and balances slow down any response.

zh: 假设市长希望建立一套新的垃圾收集和处理系统，就需要进行详细的环境影响评估和漫长的公民协商。
en: Suppose the mayor wants to institute a new rubbish collection and disposal system. Detailed environmental impact assessments and lengthy citizen consultations will be required.

zh: 在新体系确立并运行所需的数年时间里，偶尔会出现垃圾无法收集的状况，这种状况几乎每天都在增加民众期望和民主成效之间可能产生的冲突。
en: In the years that it will take for the new system to be up and running, rubbish will occasionally go uncollected, sharpening – almost by the day – the potential for conflict between what citizens expect and what democracy can deliver.

zh: 也许问题不仅在于当前的民主实践，而且在于某些民主倡议者所提出的期望。
en: Perhaps the fault lies not only with the current practice of democracy, but also with the expectations raised by some of democracy’s advocates.

zh: 民主的承诺确实已被打破。
en: Democracy’s promises have indeed been broken.

zh: “但是 ” ， 博比奥质疑 ， “ 这些承诺是否真能兑现？
en: “But,” Bobbio asks, “were they promises which really could have been fulfilled?

zh: 我的答案是不能。 ”
en: I would say no.”

zh: 这里可能适用丘吉尔古老的格言：民主是排除其它一切选择后最糟糕的政府制度。
en: The old Churchillian dictum may apply here: democracy is the worst system of government except for all the others.

zh: 在现代代议制民主体制下，民众比人类历史上任何时候都享有更多的个人自由和物质繁荣。
en: Under modern representative democracy, people enjoy more personal freedom and more material prosperity than at any other time in human history.

zh: 我们比以往任何时候都更可能实现赋予所有人自由和尊严的价值观。
en: We are closer than ever to fulfilling the values of liberty and dignity for all.

zh: 难道这些还不足以作为自由民主最有力的宣传？
en: Are those not sufficiently powerful advertisements for liberal democracy?

zh: 民主缓行
en: Democracy Comes Second

zh: 民主正缓慢的向全世界各处传播。
en: Democracy is slowly spreading around the world.

zh: 从中东到拉丁美洲和亚洲，许多专制政权或正逐渐采取步骤朝着更民主和更负责任的政府形式的方向迈进，或已成为羽翼丰满、功能完善的民主政体。
en: From the Middle East to Latin America and Asia, many autocracies are taking gradual steps towards more democratic and accountable forms of government, or have become fully-fledged and well functioning democracies.

zh: 美国政府决心运用其影响力在许多发展中国家强化政治自由；的确，民主的扩张业已成为美国对外政策的基石。
en: The US administration is determined to consolidate political freedoms in many developing countries under its sphere of influence; indeed, expansion of democracy has become a cornerstone of American foreign policy.

zh: 有很多理由使得当前的民主潮可喜可贺。
en: There are many reasons to celebrate the current democratic wave.

zh: 民主是与更少的不公正和滥用权力，与基本的公民和政治自由以及与政府对其公民真正优先事务的敏感度联系在一起的。
en: Democracy is associated with less injustice and abuse, with basic civic and political freedoms, and with greater sensitivity by governments for the true priorities of its citizens.

zh: 但民主对经济成功有多重要呢？
en: But how important is democracy for economic success?

zh: 据经验显示，没有多重要。
en: Not much, the empirical evidence suggests.

zh: 这可能有些出乎意料。
en: This might appear surprising.

zh: 毕竟，并非所有的富国都有民主政府，而最穷的国家（主要在非洲）也并不都是非民主的。
en: After all, is it not true that virtually all rich countries have democratic forms of government, while the poorest countries (mainly in Africa) are non-democracies?

zh: 的确，就全世界来看，民主与较高的人均收入都有很强的关联。
en: Indeed, throughout the world, democracy is strongly correlated with higher per capita income.

zh: 但当我们从时间而不是空间层面来看时，这种关联就不复存在了。
en: But this correlation goes missing when one looks at the dimension of time rather than space.

zh: 成为民主政体的国家在其政治转型之后通常不会获得更快的经济增长；而反之亦然，未能成功实现民主或重归专制的国家的经济发展也通常不会比以前更糟糕。
en: Countries that become democracies do not, on average, achieve faster economic growth after their political transition; and, vice versa, democracies that fail and relapse into autocracy do not, on average, do worse than before.

zh: 我们在一些国家看到的收入与民主之间的正相关性可能是一种因果倒置：民主由于国家日渐富裕而很可能会更稳固。
en: The positive correlation between income and democracy that one sees across countries could be due to reverse causation: democracy is more likely to persist as a country grows richer.

zh: 它也有可能是由于特殊的历史或文化环境引起的：在经济发展和发展及维持其民主政体的能力方面，有些社会就是比另一些社会更成功。
en: It could also be due to special historical or cultural circumstances: some societies are just more successful than others, both in terms of economic development and with regard to their ability to develop and maintain democratic political institutions.

zh: 我们在不同国家观察到的收入与民主之间的正相关性不管是由于什么原因，都不应与因果关系混为一谈。
en: Whatever the reason for the observed positive cross-country correlation between income and democracy, it should not be confused with causality.

zh: 民主对于实现经济成功似乎并不重要。
en: Being democratic does not seem important in securing economic success.

zh: 当然，民主转型的方式繁多，将其简单叠加就难免会有误导之嫌。
en: Of course, there are many different kinds of democratic transitions, and lumping them all together might be misleading.

zh: 在现实中，经济与政治体系的互动与一种重要的特性有关。
en: An important distinction in practice concerns the interaction between the economic and the political system.

zh: （如果）一个民主体制诞生在一种市场机制健全、国外直接投资广泛和国际贸易量庞大的开放的经济环境中，那么它就更能够强化经济自由主义、稳定人们的预期从而吸引更多的投资和实现更快的经济增长。
en: A democracy born in an open economic environment, with a well functioning market system, widespread foreign direct investment, and sizeable international trade, is likely to consolidate economic liberalism, stabilize expectations, and hence lead to more investment and faster growth.

zh: 反之，如果经济被国家严格掌控，针对国外进口和资本流动的壁垒高筑，或依赖出让可耗尽的资源来换取外汇，那么这样的政体向民主转型的过程就会充斥着民粹主义和再分配的麻烦，从而不利于经济增长。
en: Conversely, if an economy is tightly controlled by the state, has protectionist barriers against foreign imports and capital movements, or relies on rents from exhaustible resources to obtain foreign currency, transition to democracy can be plagued by populism and struggles for redistribution, hurting economic growth.

zh: 经验主义的证据支持这样一个观点：即一个民主政体的成功取决于其政治转型期所实行的经济体制的开放度。
en: Empirical evidence supports the idea that the success of a democracy depends on the openness of the underlying economic system at the time of political transition.

zh: 在二战结束后，更为成功的民主转型都是以广泛的经济改革为先导的。 这些改革延伸了市场范围，从而有利于经济的国际融合。
en: In the post-WWII period, the more successful episodes of democratic transitions have been preceded by widespread economic reforms that extended the scope of the market and facilitated international integration.

zh: 这样的例子包括1980年代末期的智利和南韩，以及1990年代中期的墨西哥。
en: Examples include Chile and South Korea in the late 1980’s and Mexico in the mid-1990’s.

zh: 相反，当一个国家企图在脆弱和封闭的经济环境中实现民主转型时，其结果就会糟糕得多。
en: Conversely, when democratic transition was attempted in a fragile and closed economic environment, the outcome was much worse.

zh: 这样的例子有拉丁美洲和菲律宾在1980年代中期的民主化，还有1980年代早期的土耳其和1990年代的尼泊尔。
en: This applies to the episodes of democratization in Latin America and the Philippines in the mid-1980’s, but also to Turkey in the early 1980’s and Nepal in 1990.

zh: 中国和俄罗斯之间的对比也很适用于这一类型。
en: The contrast between China and Russia also fits this pattern very well.

zh: 中国首先向世界开放了它的经济体系，并直到现在（步伐太慢了一点）才开始考虑政治改革。
en: China first opened its economic system to the rest of the world, and only now is it thinking (a bit too slowly) about political reform.

zh: 而俄罗斯却跳跃式地进入民主体制，然后才开始担心用市场体系代替社会主义的问题。
en: Russia instead jumped into democracy, and only then worried about replacing socialism with a market system.

zh: 俄罗斯可能是别无选择，但中国式的道路似乎更能带来持久的经济成功。
en: There was probably no other way to do it in Russia, but the Chinese path seems much more likely to lead to lasting economic success.

zh: 这并不意味着民主无足轻重。
en: This does not mean that democracy is unimportant.

zh: 但以经济改革为先的改革次序对于成功的经济发展至关重要。
en: But the sequence of reforms is critical for successful economic development, with economic reforms coming first.

zh: 在有着开放而健全的市场机制的情况下，民主更有机会带来持久的繁荣。
en: When an open and well functioning market system is in place, democracy has a much better chance to lead to lasting prosperity.

zh: 其中一个重要的原因就是，为了创造一个成功的市场体系，国家必须尊重基本的个人权利：法制、私有财产和实施公正。
en: An important reason for this is that, in order to create a successful market system, the state must respect basic individual rights: the rule of law, private property, and the enforcement of justice.

zh: 这些根本的权力是民主政府的细胞。
en: These fundamental rights are part and parcel of democratic government.

zh: 但就经济发展而言，这些基本权利比普选权和真正的政治竞争等纯粹的政治权力更为重要。
en: But when it comes to economic development, these fundamental rights are more important than other purely political aspects of democracy, such as universal suffrage and genuine political competition.

zh: 西方世界正是这样在十九和二十世纪实现民主的。
en: This is how the Western world became democratic in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.

zh: 以经济自由主义为先导，政治自由主义紧随其后。
en: Economic liberalism came first, political liberalism later.

zh: 但当今年轻的民主政体们做任何事都必须更快。
en: But today’s young democracies have to do everything much faster.

zh: 它们没有将选举权局限于有产阶级或有更高教育程度的人群的奢侈。
en: They don’t have the luxury of restricting suffrage to property owners, or to more educated citizens.

zh: 但无论如何，我们都应该铭记历史的教训。
en: Nevertheless, we should remember the lessons of history.

zh: 以经济改革为先导的政治改革更有望成功。
en: Political reforms are more likely to be successful if they are preceded by economic reforms.

zh: 我们必须坚持让埃及和巴基斯坦改善它们的市场体系，实行法制，将经济向国际贸易和资本流动开放。
en: We should insist that Egypt or Pakistan improve their market system, apply the rule of law, and open their economies to international trade and capital movements.

zh: 允许自由选举和真正的政治竞争同样至关重要，但这应该在经济改革之后，而不是在其之前进行。
en: Allowing free elections and true political competition is also critically important, but this should follow economic reforms, not precede them.

zh: 克服民主近视
en: Overcoming Democratic Myopia

zh: 纽约—尽管指标信号相当积极，但全球经济仍然充满了风险。
en: NEW YORK – Despite positive indicators, the global economy remains beset with risks.

zh: 几乎所有风险都来自结构性挑战，因此要消除它们，必须依靠领导人的长期思维。
en: And because virtually every one of those risks arises from structural challenges, mitigating them will require long-term thinking by leaders.

zh: 不幸的是，今天有长期思维的领导人不多，特别是民主国家领导人。
en: Unfortunately, there is not a lot of that on offer nowadays, particularly in the world’s democracies.

zh: 问题在于政治周期和经济周期脱节。
en: The problem lies in the disconnect between political and economic cycles.

zh: 正常的经济周期可以持续5—7年。
en: A normal economic cycle lasts 5-7 years.

zh: 但据麦肯锡全球研究所（MGI）的数据，G20政治领导人的平均任期已下降到创纪录的低位3.7年（1946年时为六年 ） 。
en: But, according to the McKinsey Global Institute, the average tenure of a G20 political leader has fallen to a record-low 3.7 years (compared to six years in 1946).

zh: 政客们专注于赢得下一场选举，实施的常常是能给他们带来短期回报的政策，甚至不惜为此牺牲长期增长和稳定。
en: Focused on winning the next election, politicians often implement policies that will bring short-term rewards, even at the cost of long-term growth or stability.

zh: 财政赤字的扩大便是这一权衡的体现。
en: This trade-off is exemplified by widening fiscal deficits.

zh: 据美国国会预算办公室数据，按目前的趋势，美国预算赤字在未来30年将翻三倍，从2017年占GDP的2.9%增加到2047年占GDP的9.8 % ， 原因是减税和其他取悦选民（或者同样重要地，取悦赞助人）的超预算措施。
en: In the United States, according to the Congressional Budget Office, the budget deficit is on course to triple over the next 30 years, from 2.9% of GDP in 2017 to 9.8% in 2047, owing to the effects of tax cuts and other budget-busting measures implemented to appeal to voters (or, equally important, to appease donors).

zh: 这制约了政府在教育和基础设施等领域进行前瞻性投资的能力。
en: This undercuts the government’s ability to make forward-thinking investments in areas like education and infrastructure.

zh: 政客们因为短视而受到奖励，这导致西方民主国家难以向（比如）极权的中国那样确保稳定的长期增长。
en: With politicians effectively rewarded for myopic thinking, the Western democracies find themselves struggling to secure stable long-term growth in a way that, say, authoritarian China is not.

zh: 在民主制度下，至少有两个办法解决这个问题。
en: There are at least two ways to address this problem in a democratic context.

zh: 首先，可以要求政府更加坚决地执行前任的政策决定。
en: First, governments could be bound more firmly to their predecessors’ policy decisions.

zh: 如此，已经通过辩论、得到落实的更具前瞻性的立法就有时间产生实际影响，而不必被继任政府废除了事。
en: That way, more forward-thinking legislation that has been debated and enacted will have time actually to take effect, without the risk that it will simply be repealed by a subsequent administration.

zh: 欧盟提供了具长期约束力的承诺如何起作用的例子。
en: The European Union provides one example of how long-term binding commitments can work.

zh: 1992年的马斯特里赫特条约要求欧洲政府将公共债务水平限制在GDP的60%以内，年度预算限制在GDP的3%以内。
en: The 1992 Maastricht Treaty committed European governments to cap public debt at 60% of GDP, and annual budget deficits at 3% of GDP.

zh: 此后，欧洲政府逐步让各自国家符合这一标准。
en: Since then, governments have gradually brought their countries into alignment with this standard.

zh: 但欧盟的经验也表明，这些“有约束力”的义务并不总是被视为无懈可击，特别是在经济饱受压力的时候。
en: But, as the EU’s experience also shows, such “binding” obligations are not always treated as unassailable, particularly during times of economic stress.

zh: 2008年金融危机爆发后，显然希腊、意大利、西班牙和葡萄牙等国家都违反了它们的马约承诺。
en: In the aftermath of the 2008 financial crisis, it became clear that countries like Greece, Italy, Spain, and Portugal breached their Maastricht commitments.

zh: 尽管如此，向政府明确时间长度超过选举周期的要求能够让立法日程更加从长计议，因为它们减少了党派政策交替。
en: Nonetheless, establishing commitments for governments that extend beyond electoral cycles can imbue legislative agendas with a longer-term perspective, as they reduce partisan policy turnover.

zh: 这一方针也适用于美国总统奥巴马的立名立法 — — 平价医疗法。
en: Such an approach would have been useful for US President Barack Obama’s signature legislation, the Affordable Care Act.

zh: （ACA）确保ACA至少在相当长的时间内保持有效，而不至于被特朗普政府立即推翻或能让美国缺陷重重的医保体系发生根本性的变化，包括通过“奥巴马医保”本身的改进。
en: Ensuring that the ACA would remain in place for some minimum fixed term, rather than leaving it vulnerable to immediate repeal by Donald Trump’s administration, might have enabled a more fundamental transformation of America’s flawed health-care system, including through improvements to “Obamacare” itself.

zh: 另一个鼓励决策者长期着眼的方法是将他们的任职期限扩大到（比如）六年 — — 与经济周期长度大致相当。
en: Another way to encourage longer-term thinking among policymakers would be to extend their terms in office to, say, six years – roughly the length of economic cycles.

zh: 这样，他们就不必将全部任期用于争取连任，从而有时间和政治空间去考虑复杂结构性变化的细节，制定刺激经济潜在增长的政策。
en: Instead of spending their entire term campaigning for reelection, policymakers would have the time and political space to consider the nuances of complex structural challenges and formulate policies that boost the economy’s potential growth.

zh: 在一些国家，政治领导人已经拥有更长的任期。
en: In some countries, political leaders already serve longer terms.

zh: 比如，巴西联邦参议员八年精选一次。
en: In Brazil, for example, federal senators are elected for an eight-year term.

zh: 在墨西哥和菲律宾，总统任期为六年。
en: In Mexico and the Philippines, each presidential term lasts six years.

zh: 相反，在美国，众议员每两年就要面临一次选举，迫使总统和参议员 — — 任期分别为四年和六年 — — 总某种程度上都不得不以两年为时间框架进行操作。
en: In the US, by contrast, members of the House of Representatives face an election every two years, forcing even the president and senators – who serve four- and six-year terms, respectively – to operate, to some extent, on a two-year time horizon.

zh: 当然，延长选举周期风险很大，因为这有可能让不称职或有其他问题的领导人掌权更长时间。
en: Of course, longer electoral terms are risky, as they could enable incompetent and otherwise problematic leaders to remain in power for longer.

zh: 因此，这一变化必须与另一项改革齐头并进：改变潜在决策者的合规要求，着眼于确保领导者不但要有执政经验，还要有处理真实世界挑战的经验。
en: That is why the change would have to be pursued in tandem with another reform: changing the eligibility requirements for would-be policymakers, with an eye to securing leaders who have experience not just running for office, but also handling real-world challenges.

zh: 在一篇2012年的文章中，诺丁汉大学的菲利普·考利（Philip Cowley）指出，2010年末，英国主要政党的领导人的经验为二战结束后以来最少。
en: In a 2012 article, the University of Nottingham’s Philip Cowley noted that, in late 2010, the leaders of the major British political parties had less experience than any others of the post-war era.

zh: 类似地，英国下议院的一项2012年的研究发现，1983—2010年间英国议会职业政客数量增长了三倍多，从20人增加到90人。
en: Similarly, a 2012 study by the British House of Commons Libraryrevealed that, from 1983 to 2010, the number of career politicians in Parliament had more than quadrupled, from 20 to 90.

zh: 职业政客数量的增长与对当选领导人的效率的日益质疑同步。
en: The rise of career politicians has coincided with growing cynicism about the effectiveness of elected leaders.

zh: 事实上，2016年世界经济论坛的一份调查表明，民主国家公民对领导人的信任度为全球最低，2015年的一项皮尤（Pew）调查发现80%多的美国公民不相信联邦政府的所为永远正确。
en: In fact, according to a 2016 World Economic Forum survey, citizens in democratic countries trust their leaders less than those elsewhere, while a 2015 Pew survey found that more than 80% of US citizens do not trust the federal government to do what is right consistently.

zh: 也许是这一怀疑推动了政治新鲜人特朗普在2016年的美国总统竞选中战胜了希拉里·克林顿（Hillary Clinton ） 。
en: Such suspicion probably contributed to the victory of the political neophyte Donald Trump over Hillary Clinton in the 2016 US presidential election.

zh: 无论如何，今天的经济风险不会消失，而要让这些风险最小化，所采取的改革必须是长期政策日程的一部分。
en: In any case, today’s economic risks will not go away, and they can be minimized only with the type of reforms that must form part of a long-term policy agenda.

zh: 在制定这一日程方面，民主国家似乎处于劣势。
en: In terms of crafting such agendas, democracies seem to be at a disadvantage.

zh: 但这不是必然的。
en: But this need not be the case.

zh: 困境中的民主
en: Democracy in Distress

zh: 巴黎 — — 民主主义在应对危机之时是否过于缓慢？ 民主制度在制定长期计划时是否显得过于稚嫩？
en: PARIS – Is democratic time too slow to respond to crises, and too short to plan for the long term?

zh: 在许多世界上的发达民主国家都处在经济危机和社会危机不断加深的时期，这个问题显得尤为关键。
en: At a time of deepening economic and social crisis in many of the world’s rich democracies, that question is highly relevant.

zh: 例如，意大利首相马里奥·蒙蒂很有必要，用合情合理的雄心壮志出台全方面的改革政策。
en: In Italy, for example, Prime Minister Mario Monti has the necessary and legitimate ambition to carry out comprehensive reform.

zh: 他既有能力而且又正直可信赖，但却面临着拟结构性所带来的阻碍。 过去领导人拥有三年的时间使选民们信服他们出台的政策所带来的利益，但当今的临到人却只有三个小时的时间去说服全球金融市场支持他们的政策
en: He is both competent and honest, but faces a quasi-structural impediment: whereas leaders once had three years to convince voters of their policies’ benefits, they now have three hours to convince global financial markets to back their approach.

zh: 蒙蒂被一些意大利的立法委员所阻挠，这些立法委员，从深层次的角度来说，不懂改革和市场，但却要求短期而又立竿见影的明确结果。 蒙蒂能否超越自身与生俱来的聪明才智，运用足够的意志力和阐明事物的透彻能力去实现这一行动？
en: Caught between Italian legislators who, deep down, do not understand that change and markets in quest of near-immediate certainties, can Monti transcend his natural prudence and act with sufficient clarity and decisiveness?

zh: 同样，美国的政治体系也变得越来越功能失调。
en: In the United States, too, the political system is becoming increasingly dysfunctional.

zh: 政治哲学家弗朗西斯日前评论道，无论谁会取得2012年总统选举的胜利 ， “ 选民主义”都有可能会压倒“民主主义 ” 。
en: The political philosopher Francis Fukuyama goes so far as to say that “vetocracy” could triumph over democracy, regardless of who wins the 2012 presidential election.

zh: 三权分立，是美国建国领导人在Montesquieuz这样的哲学家的影响下建立起来的治国纲领。 但这一原则现如今将美国领向了几近瘫痪的状态。
en: The separation of powers, a principle established by the US founders under the influence of philosophers such as Montesquieu, is leading today to near-paralysis.

zh: 民主主义不仅由于其在危机爆发时期反应时间过慢而备受打击；而且当人们想要对将来制定长期的计划时，把自身因素考虑进去的时候，所面临的困难也使民主遭到不小的冲击。
en: Democracies suffer not only from their slow reaction time at moments of crisis, but also from the difficulty that they face in projecting themselves into the future and planning for the long term.

zh: 在大西洋的两岸的国家，政治领导人知道他们必须要为自己的国家做一些贡献，但是当他们在实际做贡献的时候却不知道应该如何连任。
en: On both sides of the Atlantic, political leaders know what they must do for their countries, but don’t know how to get re-elected if they actually do it.

zh: 他们似乎一直由于结构问题而被指责为短期主义。
en: They seem to be structurally condemned to short-termism.

zh: 但是，并不是因为民主主义的“时间问题 ” ， 而致使这种民主主义的时代似乎就此宣告结束。
en: But it is not because democracies have a “time problem” that their era seems to some to be over.

zh: 中国将自己国家的计划已经制定到了二十二世纪，并为此感到自豪，这不无道理。
en: China is rightly proud to be able to project itself into the twenty-second century.

zh: 但是，中国将这种长期的制定计划能力归功于本国的文化积淀，而并非是自身的政治制度。
en: But China owes that quality of long-term thinking much more to its culture than to the nature of its political system.

zh: 中国人喜欢长远的考虑问题，原因是因为中国人自古以来就是这样做的。 这并不是因为他们是非民主人士。
en: Chinese think long term because they are Chinese, not because they are not democrats.

zh: 当然，中国领导人可以不必太过于担心中国大众的观点就可以对重大事件做出应对。
en: China’s leaders can, of course, react to events without much regard for Chinese public opinion.

zh: 毕竟，对于绝大多数的中国老百姓来说，即使文明的社会正在形成，随之产生了新的利益和需求，并且这些利益和需求再也不能像过去那样完全地被控制和掌控，他们也并不梦寐以求实行民主制度。
en: After all, the great majority of Chinese do not dream of democracy, even if something like a civil society is emerging, generating new interests and demands that can no longer be totally controlled or manipulated, as in the past.

zh: 但是，在一个全球化，透明化起主导位置的时代，这恰恰是非民主政权国家的劣势。 有谁会梦想成为一名中国公民?
en: But that is precisely the weakness of non-democratic regimes in a global age dominated by transparency: Who dreams of becoming a Chinese citizen, or even a citizen of Singapore?

zh: 甚至可以说成为一名新加坡公民？ 在朝鲜世袭连任主席的余波中，一些战略思想家正确地强调了中国在未来朝鲜半岛局势方面的核心作用。
en: In the aftermath of North Korea’s hereditary succession, strategic thinkers rightly emphasize China’s key role in shaping the peninsula’s future.

zh: 但是，尽管人们看到了在“伟大的领袖”金正日死后，朝鲜人民表现出来的歇斯底里，极度悲恸的画面，但大多数的朝鲜人民可能梦想着加入民主化的韩国。 （即使许多的韩国民众很惧怕这种情况出现）
en: But, despite the scenes of hysteria that followed the death of the “Great Leader” Kim Jong-il, most North Koreans probably dream of joining democratic South Korea (even if many South Koreans fear that prospect).

zh: 大多数的中国人民可能不想向西方人那样去治理国家，但是假设他们唯一的目标是向西方人那样花钱也可能是错误的。
en: The majority of Chinese may not want to be governed like Westerners, but it would be wrong to assume that their only ambition is to spend like Westerners.

zh: 他们取得的成功越大，他们就会越发变得个人主义，就会期望从管理他们的人的身上得到更多的尊敬和照顾。
en: The more successful they are, the more individualistic they will become and the more they will expect the respect and consideration of those who govern them.

zh: 相比之下，一旦中国的经济增长衰退，反对腐败呼声则会越来越高，腐败在任何一个国家中都是导致衰败的来源，而经济衰退则可能会在未来数年间出现。
en: By contrast, if China’s economic growth slows, which is likely in the coming years, protest against corruption – a source of fragility for any regime – will escalate.

zh: 事实上，不久到来的中国领导人换届选举中，两个最高领导人的位置已经被选定，这一决定只是通过大约至多100人选举过程产生，而这一过程只是例行公事罢了，记住这一点尤为重要。
en: Indeed, it is important to bear in mind that, ahead of the upcoming Chinese leadership transition, new occupants for only the top two posts have been chosen, and that through a process of gradual anointment by roughly a hundred people at most.

zh: 目前，发达国家的经济危机很有肯能会导致全球经济衰退（即使目前为止还没有造成全球范围内的经济萧条 ） 。 这不仅仅揭露了民主制国家政权的许多弊病，同时这场危机充当了这些弊病的培养基和催化剂。
en: The current crisis in the advanced countries, which may very well lead to a global recession (if it is not already doing so), not only reveals the many maladies of democratic regimes, but also acts as their incubator and accelerator.

zh: 然而，这场危机可能会对那些非民主制国家造成更加严重的冲击。 这些国家表面上看起更加有效率，而实际上却更加脆弱。
en: And yet the crisis may turn out to have an even greater impact on non-democratic systems that seem to be more efficient, but are in reality much more fragile.

zh: 我们可以从俄罗斯和中国不断增加的不稳定中得到这一结论。
en: We see this in mounting unrest in both Russia and China.

zh: 民主主义比长远的选择更加具有抵抗力，这和某些人的想法背道而驰。
en: Contrary to what one might think, democracy is more resilient than the alternatives in the long run.

zh: 但只要民主人士一直坚信这种观点，这种观点就会维���原本的正确性。
en: This will remain true as long as democrats remain convinced of it.

zh: 非民主模式实际上不可能真正挑战民主主义。
en: Non-democratic models cannot truly challenge democracy.

zh: 只有民主人士的错误行为才能够挑战民主主义。
en: Only the misbehavior of democrats can do that.

zh: 迎回埃及民选政府
en: Bring Back Egypt’s Elected Government

zh: 纽约—停止埃及日渐加深的极端化和日渐增加的流血需要马上采取第一步：恢复穆尔西作为埃及合法当选总统的职位。
en: NEW YORK – Putting an end to Egypt’s deepening polarization and rising bloodshed requires one urgent first step: the reinstatement of Mohamed Morsi as Egypt’s duly elected president.

zh: 军事政变推翻他是不公正的。
en: His removal by military coup was unjustified.

zh: 诚然，数百万示威者反对穆尔西执政，但即使是群众街头示威也不构成打着“人民”的旗号行军事政变之实的充分理由，因为选举结果一再表明并非如此。
en: While it is true that millions of demonstrators opposed Morsi’s rule, even massive street protests do not constitute a valid case for a military coup in the name of the “people” when election results repeatedly say otherwise.

zh: 毫无疑问，埃及社会存在深刻的宗派、思想、阶级和种族分歧。
en: There is no doubt that Egyptian society is deeply divided along sectarian, ideological, class, and regional lines.

zh: 但自2011年推翻穆巴拉克30年的统治以来，这个国家进行了好几次投票。
en: Yet the country has gone to the polls several times since the February 2011 overthrow of Mubarak’s 30-year rule.

zh: 结果表明，伊斯兰政党和立场拥有强大的民众支持率，尽管它们也让埃及的分裂表露无遗。
en: The results have demonstrated strong popular support for Islamist parties and positions, though they also make clear the country’s schisms.

zh: 2011年末、2012年初，埃及举行了议会选举。
en: In late 2011 and early 2012, Egypt held parliamentary elections.

zh: 穆尔西的正义和公正党（Freedom and Justice Party，由穆斯林兄弟会创立）赢得多数，伊斯兰两大阵营加起来获得了约三分之二的选票。
en: Morsi’s Freedom and Justice Party, created by the Muslim Brotherhood, secured a plurality, and the two major Islamist blocs together received roughly two-thirds of the vote.

zh: 2012年6月，穆尔西击以52%对48%的优势败对手、穆巴拉克的最后一任总理沙菲克（Ahmed Shafik）赢得总统选举。
en: In June 2012, Morsi defeated his rival Ahmed Shafik, Mubarak’s final prime minister, by a margin of 52-48% to win the presidency.

zh: 在2012年12月的全民公投中，64%多数投票赞成穆斯林兄弟会支持的宪法草案（尽管投票率并不高 ） 。
en: In a national referendum in December 2012, a 64% majority of those voting approved a draft constitution backed by the Muslim Brotherhood (though turnout was low).

zh: 世俗观点 — — 穆尔西的权力欲破坏了萌芽期的埃及民主 — — 根本站不住脚。
en: The secular argument that Morsi’s lust for power jeopardized Egypt’s nascent democracy does not bear scrutiny.

zh: 穆斯林兄弟会的世俗、军事和穆巴拉克时期反对者用尽一切方法 — — 民主的和不民主的 — — 阻挠其民主权力实践。
en: Secular, military, and Mubarak-era foes of the Muslim Brotherhood have used every lever at their disposal, democratic or not, to block the Islamist parties’ democratic exercise of power.

zh: 这与埃及几十年来的历史惯例一致 — — 作为穆斯林兄弟会和伊斯兰政治力量得不到合法地位，它们的成员被关押、严刑拷打和流放。
en: This is consistent with a decades-old pattern in Egyptian history, in which the Brothers – and Islamist political forces in general – were outlawed, and their members imprisoned, tortured, and exiled.

zh: 穆尔西的统治不民主的说法产生于他一再试图让民选议会和总统逃脱军队设置的反民主陷阱。
en: Claims that Morsi ruled undemocratically stem from his repeated attempts to extricate the popularly elected parliament and presidency from anti-democratic traps set by the military.

zh: 2011—2012年穆斯林政党在议会选举大获全胜后，军队领导层和最高法院（由穆巴拉克时期法官把持）设法颠覆新议会，阻止它召开大会起草新宪法。
en: After the Islamist parties’ huge victory in the 2011-2012 parliamentary elections, the military leadership and the Supreme Court (filled with Mubarak-era judges) worked to derail the new parliament and prevent it from establishing an assembly to draft a new constitution.

zh: 关键动作发生在2012年6月。 当是时，完全由穆巴拉克时代遗老组成的最高法院以似是而非的托辞宣布议会选举结果无效。
en: The key action came in June 2012, when the Supreme Court, staffed entirely with Mubarak-era holdovers, nullified the results of the parliamentary elections on specious grounds.

zh: 军队将再次获得完全合法的权力。
en: The military was set to reassert full legislative powers.

zh: 于是，随后穆尔西在总统选举中的胜出掀起了一场关于议会和宪法未来的大战，穆尔西试图保护民主选出的议会，而军队想要解散它。
en: Morsi’s subsequent victory in the presidential election therefore set up an epic battle over the future of the parliament and the constitution, as Morsi attempted to protect the democratically elected parliament while the military fought to dissolve it.

zh: 最终，穆尔西坚持应该由民选议会召开制宪大会，并最终产生了2012年12月全民公投通过的宪法草案。
en: In the end, Morsi insisted that the elected parliament create a constitutional assembly, which produced the draft approved in the December 2012 referendum.

zh: 与典型的政治革命一样，埃及经济状况在这些权力斗争中从恶化走向更加恶化。
en: As is typical of political revolutions, Egypt’s economic situation has gone from bad to worse in the course of these power struggles.

zh: 革命往往产生面临急剧上升的社会需求的政府（比如要求涨薪和增加福利支出 ） ， 与此同时又往往伴随着资本外逃、金融动荡和生产的严重破坏。
en: Revolutions tend to confront new governments with steeply rising social demands (for wage increases and higher welfare spending, for example) at a time of capital flight, financial turmoil, and deep disruptions of production.

zh: 在埃及的例子中，关键的旅游业因为革命而大幅萎缩。
en: In Egypt’s case, the crucial tourist sector contracted sharply after the revolution.

zh: 失业率出现了飙升，货币出现了贬值，食品价格上升到危险的水平。
en: Unemployment soared, the currency depreciated, and food prices rose dangerously.

zh: 所有这些一点都不令人惊奇，也绝非缺乏经验、市场信心和对各级权力完全控制的新政府所能治理。
en: None of this is surprising, and little of it can be managed by a new government that lacks experience, market confidence, and full control of the levers of power.

zh: 从历史上看，外部行为人因此扮演着决定性作用。
en: Historically, outside parties have thus played a decisive role.

zh: 外国政府和IMF会扩大对新政府的救命融资线吗？ 还是会让新政府自生自灭，任由其被货币贬值和通货膨胀的漩涡吞噬？
en: Will foreign governments and the International Monetary Fund extend vital finances to the new government, or will they let it flounder and drown in a tsunami of currency depreciation and inflation?

zh: 在这方面，不厚道的西方 — — 一边大谈民主，一边唯恐对伊斯兰教避之不及 — — 摊了牌。
en: Here, the feckless West – torn between its democratic rhetoric and its antipathy to the Islamists – showed its hand.

zh: 西方虚与委蛇，极尽拖延，迟迟不给出承诺和援助。
en: The result was equivocation and delay, rather than commitment and assistance.

zh: 在穆巴拉克倒台后的两年半时间里，IMF一直在与埃及政府扯皮，却不发放一分钱的贷款，这不啻扼杀埃及的经济前途，助长了埃及的社会动荡，催生了最近的政变。
en: The IMF has talked with the Egyptian government for two and a half years since Mubarak’s overthrow without so much as lending a single cent, sealing the Egyptian economy’s fate and contributing to public unrest and the recent coup.

zh: 媒体纷纷报道西方最终向埃及军队推翻穆尔西、逮捕穆斯林兄弟会领导层以及镇压伊斯兰教徒开了绿灯。
en: It appears from press reports that the West finally gave the green light to the Egyptian military to overthrow Morsi, arrest the Muslim Brotherhood’s leadership, and repress the Islamist rank and file.

zh: 美国总统奥巴马不愿意站出来支持埃及民选领导人，甚至不愿称他们的被推翻为“政变 ” （ 从而保护了源源不断流向埃及军队的美国资金 ） ， 这表明事到临头，西方与反伊斯兰阵营穿一条裤子，镇压民主。
en: US President Barack Obama’s unwillingness to stand up for Egypt’s elected leaders, or even to label their overthrow a “coup” (thereby protecting the continued flow of US funds to the Egyptian military), shows that when push came to shove, the West sided with the anti-Islamists in subverting democracy.

zh: 当然，用经典的奥威尔式调侃说，西方这么做都是以民主的名义。
en: Of course, in classic Orwellian fashion, the West did so in democracy’s name.

zh: 政变和西方对政变的自得（如果说不是共谋的话）会毁掉埃及。
en: The coup and the West’s complacency about it (if not complicity in it) could devastate Egypt.

zh: 穆斯林既不是边缘政治团体，也不是恐怖主义势力。
en: The Islamists are neither a marginal political group nor a terrorist force.

zh: 他们代表着埃及人口的很大一部分，可能占一半甚至以上，也显然是埃及组织最好的政治力量。
