en: They represent a large part of Egypt’s population, perhaps half or more, and are certainly the country’s best-organized political force.

zh: 试图镇压穆斯林兄弟会、否认穆尔西通过选举获得的总统位置极有可能导致大规模暴力和扼杀民主，不管西方和埃及反伊斯兰派如何粉饰他们的行为。
en: The attempt to repress the Muslim Brotherhood and to deny Morsi the presidency to which he was elected will most likely lead to massive violence and the strangulation of democracy, however the West and Egyptian anti-Islamists try to justify their actions.

zh: 在这一点上，西方正确的做法是呼吁埃及军队恢复穆尔西的总统职位、迅速提供资金帮助稳定埃及经济，以及支持真正的多元主义，而不是在选举结果不合意就诉诸军事政变的多元主义。
en: At this point, the correct course for the West would be to call on Egypt’s military to reinstate Morsi; to offer prompt financing to help stabilize the Egyptian economy; and to support true pluralism, not the kind that reverts to military coups when elections produce inconvenient results.

zh: 多元主义意味着接受伊斯兰政治势力在新埃及和该地区其他国家的优势。
en: True pluralism means accepting the strength of Islamist political forces in the new Egypt and other countries in the region.

zh: 没有多元主义，西方极有可能沦为埃及滑向暴力和经济崩溃的帮凶。
en: Short of this, the West will most likely end up as an accomplice to Egypt’s continuing downward spiral into violence and economic collapse.

zh: 世界银行民主的缺失
en: Democracy in Inaction at the World Bank

zh: 世界银行行长詹姆斯•沃尔芬森已经公布了离任的打算，现在世行这个全世界最重要的多边发展促进组织正在寻找新的带头人。
en: James Wolfensohn, the president of the World Bank, has announced his intention to leave, and the search is on for a new head of the world’s most important multilateral organization promoting development.

zh: 在第三世界的贫困问题终于被承认为我们面临的最严峻问题和最大挑战的今天，选择谁为世行行长更是至关重要。
en: The choice is especially important now, when poverty in the Third World is finally being recognized as our greatest problem and challenge.

zh: 世界银行“银行”的这一称呼削弱了这一组织的重要性，也淡化了其角色的多面性。
en: The World Bank’s designation as a “bank” understates its importance and its multifaceted roles.

zh: 世行确实为各国的各种项目提供贷款，也为这些国家渡过危机提供帮助（如在1997-1998年间，为韩国提供了100亿美元的贷款 ） 。
en: It does lend money to countries to undertake a variety of projects, and to help them through crises (such as the $10 billion it provided to Korea in 1997-1998).

zh: 在世界各地的战后重建方面，世界银行不管是过去，还是现在都一直发挥了至关重要的作用。
en: It has been, and is, playing a vital role in post-conflict reconstruction around the world.

zh: 但世界银行还为最贫困国家的教育、卫生事业等提供赠款及低息贷款，并为这些国家的发展战略提供建议。
en: But the Bank also provides grants and low-interest loans to the poorest countries, particularly for education and health, and advises these countries on development strategies.

zh: 世界银行还经常和国际货币基金组织联手，强迫这些国家接受建议。 否则不仅世界银行和国际货币基金组织会中断对该国的援助，而且还会设法阻止其他捐赠者和资本市场为该国提供基金。
en: It has often joined with the IMF in strong-arming countries into accepting this “advice”: unless they do, they will not only be cut off by the IMF and the World Bank, but also by other donors, and capital markets will be discouraged from providing funds.

zh: 有时—批评者会说是“经常 ” — 国际货币基金组织和世界银行提供的建议具有误导性。
en: Sometimes – its critics will say often – the advice provided by the IMF and World Bank is misguided.

zh: 在20世纪80 年代和90年代初，情况确实如此。 当时在国际货币基金组织和世界银行，右翼思潮一统天下，给各国开的处方都是“一刀切 ” ， 全都是私有化、自由化、宏观经济稳定（意思是价格稳定）那一套，很少注意到就业问题、公正问题和环境保护问题。
en: This was certainly true in the 1980’s and early 1990’s, when right-wing ideology dominated, producing a one-size-fits-all prescription entailing privatization, liberalization, and macroeconomic stability (meaning price stability), with little attention to employment, equity, or the environment.

zh: 从第二个意义上来说 ， “ 银行”这一提法也不妥当：尽管世界银行把其成员都称为“股东 ” ， 但它很难算得上是私有银行。
en: The term “bank” is a misnomer in a second sense: while the World Bank refers to its members as “shareholders,” it is hardly a private bank.

zh: 正相反，世界银行是一个全球性的公共机构。
en: On the contrary, the World Bank is a global public institution.

zh: 尽管在世界银行中控制着投票的七大工业国都宣称他们致力于民主和良性统治，并全力支持将上述两者作为他们的基本目标，但他们的言与行却大相径庭。
en: But, while the G-7 countries, which dominate voting at the Bank, all declare their commitment to democracy and good governance – and espouse promoting them as one of their central objectives – there is a yawning gap between what they preach and what they practice.

zh: 事实上，这些国际机构领导人的整个选举程序都已经过时落伍。 这不仅损害了这些机构的效能，而且对承诺致力于民主的七大工业国来说，也是一种嘲讽。
en: Indeed, the entire process of choosing these international institutions’ leaders is a historical anachronism that undermines their effectiveness and makes a mockery of the G-7 countries’ commitment to democracy.

zh: 这一选举程序始于60年前，并受制于一项协议。 该协议规定世界银行行长只能由美国人来担任，而国际货币基金组织的领袖则非欧洲人莫属。
en: This process, established at the outset 60 years ago, is framed by an agreement that an American would lead the World Bank and a European would lead the IMF.

zh: 世界银行行长由美国总统指定，而国际货币基金组织总裁则由欧洲集体决定，只有在候选人完全不合格时，另外一方才可以行使反对权。
en: The American president would choose the Bank’s head, and Europe would collectively decide on the IMF leader, with the understanding that the other side would exercise its veto only if a candidate were totally unacceptable.

zh: 在美国，总统所有的任命都必须要经过国会的认可，即使参议院很少提出反对意见，这一审查程序也非常重要，因为总统明白他的权力只能到此为止。
en: Within the United States, all major presidential appointments must be ratified by the Senate; even if rejections are rare, the vetting process is important, for the president knows that he can go only so far.

zh: 但对总统来说，世界银行行长的任命却是一桩少有的美事，任命甚至不必通过国会听证会。
en: But the presidency of the World Bank is a rare presidential plum – an appointment that is not subject even to Congressional hearings.

zh: 如果多边国际机构本身都没有拿自己所提倡的开放、透明与参与的标准来同样要求自己，那他们提出的民主改革建议怎么可能被认真对待？
en: How can advice on democratic reforms be taken seriously when the multilateral institutions that offer it do not subscribe to the same standards of openness, transparency, and participation that they advocate?

zh: 为什么沃尔芬森的接班人只能局限于美国人（尤其是效忠某一政党的美国人 ） ？
en: Why should the search for Wolfensohn’s successor be limited to an American (and especially an American loyal to a particular political party)?

zh: 为什么接班人的寻找程序不公开进行？
en: Why is the search process going on behind closed doors?

zh: 难道这些国际公共机构不应该寻找最合格的人选，而不受种族、宗教、性别、民族的限制？
en: Shouldn’t these international public institutions be looking for the best-qualified person, regardless of race, religion, gender, or nationality?

zh: 目前四处传言的两名候选人—这一消息很可能是当成探测气球故意泄漏出来的¾尤其令人觉得不安。
en: The two names that have been floated so far ­– presumably leaked as trial balloons – are particularly disturbing.

zh: 直言不讳地说，考虑到世界银行的重要性，两名假定的美国候选人，美国国防部副部长保罗·沃尔福兹（Paul Wolfowitz）和前惠普公司首席执行官卡莉·菲奥瑞娜（Carleton Fiorina ） ， ���已经在全球引起了很大争议。
en: To put it bluntly, given the World Bank’s importance, consideration of either putative US candidate, Assistant Defense Secretary Paul Wolfowitz or former Hewlett-Packard CEO Carleton Fiorina, have been highly controversial around the world.

zh: 即使惯例允许美国总统指定世界银行行长，但世行的成功取决于别人的信任。
en: Even if convention allows the American president to appoint the World Bank’s head, the organization’s success depends on the confidence of others.

zh: 在经济发展和金融市场方面，沃尔福兹和菲奥瑞娜都没有经验，也没有接受过任何培训。
en: Neither Wolfowitz nor Fiorina have any training or experience in economic development or financial markets.

zh: 当然，过去指定的一些人员结果表现得比预期的要好得多。 他们能得体应付突如其来的情况，尽管如果按公开的、客观的选举程序，他们的资历根本不足以让他们进入决选名单。
en: Of course, some past appointees turned out to be far better than anticipated; they rose to the occasion, despite qualifications that, in any open and objective selection process, would never even have left them on the short list.

zh: 他们证明了总有超常发挥的可能存在。
en: They proved that there is always a chance of outperforming.

zh: 但这不能抵消发挥失常的风险，这也就是为什么寻找最佳候选人才是最好的政策的原因。
en: But this does not outweigh the risk of underperforming, which is why the best policy is to look for the best candidate.

zh: 有一些绝对一流的人才可以胜任世行行长这一工作。 他们已经展示了他们的智力、人品、政治及管理技能以及对经济发展的控制能力。
en: There are some absolutely first-rate individuals who could step into the job, people who have shown their command of economic development, their intellect and personal integrity, and their political and managerial skills.

zh: 这些潜在的候选人包括墨西哥前总统埃内斯托·塞迪略，他拥有耶鲁大学的博士学位，现在该大学任教 ， 《 金融时报》 曾 在一篇社论中对他进行过大力推荐。 阿米尼奥·弗拉革，普林斯顿大学博士、巴西中央银行前任行长。
en: Such potential candidates include former Mexican president Ernesto Zedillo, a Yale Ph.D. who now teaches there and has been strongly supported in an editorial in the Financial Times; Arminio Fraga, a Princeton Ph.D. and former head of Brazil’s central bank; and Kemal Dervis, a former World Bank vice-president who has taught at Princeton and successfully managed one of Turkey’s crises as finance minister.

zh: 德尔维什，世界银行前任副行长，曾在普林斯顿大学任教，并在任土耳其经济事务部部长时使土耳其成功地度过了一次危机。 为什么全世界不接受具备这些才干的候选人，而要满足于接受别人呢？
en: Why should the world settle for anything less than candidates of this caliber?

zh: 现在是7大工业国用行动来支持自己关于民主的言论的时候了。
en: It is time that the G-7 countries back up their democratic rhetoric with action.

zh: 在美国企图发动伊拉克战争时，很多国家提出反对。
en: Many stood up to the US as it pushed for the war in Iraq.

zh: 他们对美国声称大规模杀伤性武器带来的危险迫在眉睫这点表示怀疑，他们的怀疑是正确的。
en: They were right to be skeptical about US claims of an imminent danger from weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 现在处于危急关头的是第三世界数10亿条生命和他们的福利，这些都取决于全球反贫困战争。 比起伊拉克战争来，重要性可谓有增无减。
en: What is at stake here is no less important: the lives and well being of billions in the Third World depend on a global war on poverty.

zh: 在这一战争中，选择适合的将军不一定能确保胜利，但错误的选择却肯定会加大失败的可能性。
en: Choosing the right general in that war will not assure victory, but choosing the wrong one surely enhances the chances of failure.

zh: 论美国茶党的民主
en: Democracy in Tea Party America

zh: 伯克利—1835年，法国政治家和道德哲学家托克维尔出版了《论美国的民主》上卷。 他之所以写这么本书，是因为他觉得法国正陷入大麻烦中，可以从美国身上学到很多东西。
en: BERKELEY – When the French politician and moral philosopher Alexis de Tocqueville published the first volume of his Democracy in America in 1835, he did so because he thought that France was in big trouble and could learn much from America.

zh: 要是他看了佛罗里达州坦帕市的共和党全国大会上仍作如是观，那真是有鬼了。
en: So one can only wonder what he would have made of the Republican National Convention in Tampa, Florida.

zh: 对托克维尔来说，法国先是被专制的波旁王朝攫取了中央集权，接着又受到大革命和拿破仑帝国的折腾，于是新封建秩序摧毁殆尽，不管是优点还是缺点都没有留下。
en: For Tocqueville, the grab for centralized power by the absolutist Bourbon monarchs, followed by the French Revolution and Napoleon’s Empire, had destroyed the good with the bad in France’s neo-feudal order.

zh: 几十年后，新秩序仍有待建立。
en: Decades later, the new order was still in flux.

zh: 至少在托克维尔的想象中，旧秩序的国民狂热地保护非同寻常的自由，唯恐失去独立性。
en: In Tocqueville’s imagination, at least, the old order’s subjects had been eager to protect their particular liberties and jealous of their spheres of independence.

zh: 他们明白，他们被纳入了一张义务、权力、责任和特权之网，这张网就像法兰西一样大。
en: They understood that they were embedded in a web of obligations, powers, responsibilities, and privileges that was as large as France itself.

zh: 但是，在1835年的法国人中间 ， “ 自利主义”已经产生了“自负 … … 毫不逊色的盲目 ” 。
en: Among the French of 1835, however, “the doctrine of self-interest” had produced “egotism…no less blind.”

zh: “打倒了贵族”的法国人“心满意足地看着留下的废墟。 ”
en: Having “destroyed an aristocracy,” the French were “inclined to survey its ruins with complacency.”

zh: 针对1835年的“病态”法国，托克维尔用健康的美国作为对比。 在美国，关于应该追求自我利益的观点也像法国一样流行，但两者之间并不一样。
en: To the “sick” France of 1835, Tocqueville counterposed healthy America, where attachment to the idea that people should pursue their self-interest was no less strong, but was different.

zh: 他认为，不同之处就在于美国人明白自己无法在四邻萧条的情况下独自繁荣。
en: The difference, he thought, was that Americans understood that they could not flourish unless their neighbors prospered as well.

zh: 因此，美国人虽然追求自我利益，但是以一种“正确理解”的方式在进行。
en: Thus, Americans pursued their self-interest, but in a way that was “rightly understood.”

zh: 托克维尔指出“美国人热衷于解释 … … 为自己考虑是如何一贯地让他们互相帮助，并促使他们牺牲部分时间和财物去创造福利的。
en: Tocqueville noted that “Americans are fond of explaining…[how] regard for themselves constantly prompts them to assist each other, and inclines them willingly to sacrifice a portion of their time and property to the general welfare.”

zh: ”相反，法国人面临这样一个未来 ： “ 很难预测盖过自负的愚蠢会把他们引向何方”以及“他们会让自己陷入怎样的耻辱和不幸，唯恐自己不得不牺牲一些自身福利和成功来为同类造福。 ”
en: The French, by contrast, faced a future in which “it is difficult to foresee to what pitch of stupid excesses their egotism may lead them,” and “into what disgrace and wretchedness they would plunge themselves, lest they should have to sacrifice something of their own well-being to the prosperity of their fellow-creatures.”

zh: 在托克维尔看来，1835年法国之病源于波旁王朝是一个自上而下的指令-控制型政府，而美国的健康来自它自下而上的草根民主政府。
en: For Tocqueville, France’s sickness in 1835 stemmed from its Bourbon patrimony of a top-down, command-and-control government, whereas America’s health consisted in its bottom-up, grassroots-democratic government.

zh: 托克维尔认为应该给予地方社区足够的权力决定自身事务，这样人们“就能一窥 … … 将私人利益和公众利益连在一起的紧密纽带 ” 。
en: Give the local community enough control over its own affairs, Tocqueville argued, and one “will see at a glance…the close tie which unites private to general interest.”

zh: “地方自由让大量公民开始重视邻里和家族影响，永久地将人们团结起来，迫使他们互相帮助，尽管各人的性格癖好各不相同。 ”
en: It was “local freedom which leads a great number of citizens to value the affection of their neighbors and of their kindred, perpetually brings men together, and forces them to help one another, in spite of the propensities which sever them.”

zh: 托克维尔的不朽名著距今已经将近两个世纪了。
en: Nearly two centuries have passed since Tocqueville wrote his masterpiece.

zh: 公共利益和个体美国人的私人利益之间的联系变得更加密切了，尽管他们的私人利益往往系于开曼群岛的某个邮政信箱。
en: The connection between the general interest and the private interest of individual Americans has, if anything, become much stronger, even if their private interest is tied to a post office box in the Cayman Islands.

zh: 事实上，在过去一代人中，没有哪笔私人股权财富不是通过投资或与这个繁荣的北大西洋世界经济产业核心做交易得到的。
en: Indeed, no private-equity fortunes were made over the past generation without investing in or trading with the prosperous North Atlantic industrial core of the world economy.

zh: 但个人和隔壁邻居联合起来采取共同政治行动改变生活的机制被大大削弱了。
en: But the mechanisms that individuals can use to join with their immediate neighbors in political action that makes a difference in their lives have become much weaker.

zh: 比如，如果密苏里州堪萨��城30个街区的溪边（Brookside ） “ 光小区”的1000户人家有25%与预先订阅，那么谷歌将会立刻为所有1000户家庭提供价格极低、速度极快的互联网服务。
en: If, say, 25% of the 1,000 households in the 30-block Brookside “fiberhood” in Kansas City, Missouri, pre-subscribe, Google will provide all 1,000 with the opportunity to get very cheap, very fast Internet service very soon.

zh: 但这只是证明这一规则的显著例外。
en: But that is the proverbial exception that proves the rule.

zh: 而坎帕共和党大会意欲庆祝这一规则 — — 这无异于是在宣布托克维尔所看到的美国已经不复存在：美国人不再相信富人之富是建立在其他人共富的基础上的。
en: And the Republicans gathered in Tampa to celebrate the rule – to say that the America that Tocqueville saw no longer exists: Americans no longer believe that the wealth of the rich rests on the prosperity of the rest.

zh: 相反，富人之所以致富，仅仅是因为自身的运气和努力。
en: Rather, the rich owe their wealth solely to their own luck and effort.

zh: 富人 — — 只有富人 — — “创造”了他们自身。
en: The rich – and only the rich – “built” what they have.

zh: 牺牲他们的部分私人利益支持公众利益的意愿会破坏顶层1%的灵魂和财富。
en: The willingness to sacrifice some part of their private interest to support the public interest damages the souls and portfolios of the 1%.

zh: 也许道德和知识趋势会被逆转，而美国也将继续因托克维尔两个世纪前所观察到的原因而出类拔萃。
en: Perhaps the moral and intellectual tide will be reversed, and America will remain exceptional for the reasons that Tocqueville identified two centuries ago.

zh: 否则的话，托克维尔肯定会说，今天的美国正如当年的法国。
en: Otherwise, Tocqueville would surely say of Americans today what he said of the French then.

zh: 主要区别只在于如今“预测盖过自负的愚蠢会把他们引向何方”以及“他们会让自己陷入怎样的耻辱和不幸”非常容易。
en: The main difference is that it has become all too easy “to foresee to what pitch of stupid excesses their egotism may lead them” and “into what disgrace and wretchedness they would plunge themselves.”

zh: 尼罗河畔的民主？
en: Democracy on the Nile?

zh: 埃及总统胡斯尼·穆巴拉克关于修改宪法，从而使总统选举以直接、竞争方式进行的惊人决定，可以说是在埃及和阿拉伯世界的民主道路上迈出了一大步。
en: The surprise decision by Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak to propose a constitutional amendment that would allow direct and competitive presidential elections may be a giant step for democracy in Egypt and the Arab World.

zh: 在多元化民主模式下生活多年的西方人可能很难理解这一举措对于一个50多年持续处于军事统治下的国家来说是一次多么巨大的转变。
en: Westerners used to pluralistic democracy may find it hard to understand what a potentially huge shift this will be in a country accustomed to military rule for over 50 years.

zh: 在现有的政治体制下，埃及市民只能在每6年举行一次的全民公决仪式上露一面，对唯一的候选人说赞成或者反对。
en: Under the current system, Egyptian citizens can only show up on the day of a presidential referendum every six years and say yes or no to the single name that appears on the presidential ballot.

zh: 这也是为什么虽然投票者态度冷漠，像穆巴拉克这样的人仍旧能获得超过90%以上选票的原因所在。
en: This explains why someone like Mubarak always received over 90% of the vote, albeit amid indifferent turnout.

zh: 叙利亚和以色列的强硬派使用这一手段做得更为出色。 毫无疑问，原因在于他们要求每一位选举人在所投选票的底部写上自己的名字和地址。
en: Syrian and Iraqi strongmen have done even better with this system, no doubt because they demanded that the names and addresses of voters be put at the bottom of each ballot.

zh: 很多人始终认为只有埃及完全参与到中东的民主化进程中去，这一进程才会被快速推进。
en: Many people have long argued that democratization in the Middle East will not get far until Egypt becomes fully engaged in the process.

zh: 而埃及若不能首先对其宪法进行修改¾削弱总统的君主权利、限制其任期年限，便不会真正踏上民主化道路。
en: Egypt could not truly set out on a path of democratization without first amending its constitution – to downsize the Pharaonic powers of its president and set limits on his term in office.

zh: 毕竟，今年已经是穆巴拉克当政的第二十四个年头，希望进行公开总统选举的声明迈出了重要的一步。
en: Mubarak, after all, is already in his 24th year as president. So the announcement that he wants competitive presidential elections is an important first step.

zh: 这种政权制度可能会认为它能够把这一程序为己所用，然而一旦人民感到被赋予了权利，局面就未必那样容易控制。
en: The regime may assume that it will be able to use the process to its own advantage, but events may not be that easy to control once people begin to feel empowered.

zh: 民主的妖怪已经从瓶子里钻出来了。
en: The democratic genie is out of the bottle.

zh: 不管怎么说，埃及不是这一地区唯一踏上民主道路的国家。
en: In any case, Egypt is not the only country in this troubled region that is now embarking on the road of democracy.

zh: 在中东一端的土耳其和在另一端的摩洛哥已经顺利上路了。
en: Turkey at one end of the Middle East and Morocco at the other are already well on their way.

zh: 这一次，真正掀起舆论波澜的似乎应该说是相继进行的，发生在伊拉克、巴勒斯坦以及位居其次的沙特阿拉伯的大选以及已经显露积极态势的大选结果。
en: The real groundswell this time seems to have come from the close timing and positive outcomes of recent elections in Iraq, Palestine, and to a lesser degree in Saudi Arabia.

zh: 在黎巴嫩前总理哈里里遇刺身亡后，反对叙利亚对黎占领的示威规模空前，并且没有减弱趋势。
en: The unprecedented demonstrations against Syria’s occupation of Lebanon following the assassination of its former prime minister, Rafiq al-Hariri, show no signs of abating.

zh: 埃及的反对派也在此前几周举行了日趋浩荡的游行以及其它形式的非暴力反抗。
en: Egyptian opposition groups, too, have staged increasingly bold marches and other forms of civil disobedience in the last few weeks.

zh: 民众愤怒的催化剂是一月底反对派领导人Ayman Nour在病中被逮捕并关押这一事件。
en: The catalyst for their anger was the arrest and detention of the ailing opposition leader Ayman Nour at the end of January.

zh: 政府的粗暴行为再次激起了多次国内运动，要求结束穆巴拉克的统治时代。
en: The government’s heavy-handed behavior reinvigorated the homegrown “Kifaya” (Enough) movement, which has demanded an end to the Mubarak regime.

zh: 一时之间，认为埃及人被动、怯于行动的观点似乎站不住脚了。
en: Suddenly the popular wisdom that Egyptians are passive and afraid to act did not seem to be holding up.

zh: 一个地方、区域、乃至国际力量的联盟正在团结起来与尼罗河畔的一贯暴政抗衡。
en: An alliance of local, regional, and international forces is uniting against tyranny-as-usual on the banks of the Nile.

zh: 最近公众压力的浪潮似乎已经动摇了统治政权。
en: The recent wave of popular pressure appears to have shaken the regime.

zh: 就在一个月前，穆巴拉克还认为要求宪法改革是徒劳无益的。
en: Only a month ago, Mubarak dismissed demands for constitutional reform as “futile.”

zh: 但是，不管是什么因素改变了他的主意，实施大选的决定还是应该受到欢迎的。
en: But, whatever combination of events brought about his change of heart, election initiative should be welcomed.

zh: 对于修整埃及多年停滞不前的政治体制来说，这只是必要的第一步，但还远远不够。
en: It is a necessary – but insufficient – first step for overhauling Egypt’s stagnant political system.

zh: 埃及人早已对突尼斯象征性的改革有所警觉，在那儿，在位多年的总统本·阿里自己绘制了一幅关于修改宪法的漫画。 他似乎对公开的总统选举敞开大门，然而却在之后精心挑选了几位“对手 ” ， 上演了一次伪装竞选。
en: Egyptians are already wary of token reforms à la Tunisia, where longstanding President Zine El Abidin Bin Ali created a caricature of a constitutional amendment that appeared to open the door for competitive presidential elections, but then staged a sham contest with a few handpicked “opponents.”

zh: 以前对突尼斯总统的全民公决中，本·阿里始终保持获得99%的选票，现在他的得票率是96 % 。
en: In previous Tunisian presidential referenda, Bin Ali routinely received 99% of the vote; he now got 96%.

zh: 让我们期盼穆巴拉克能够更加认真的对待这次选举改革。
en: Let us hope that Mubarak is more serious about electoral reform.

zh: 作为衡量他真诚度的标尺，他首先必须立即释放Ayman Nour，采取措施结束国家长达24年的“紧急状态 ” ， 正是这一“紧急状态”有效阻止了政治性竞选活动的发生。
en: As a measure of sincerity, he needs to order the immediate release of Ayman Nour and take steps to terminate the 24-year-long state of emergency, which effectively prevents political campaigning from taking place.

zh: 穆巴拉克还应该明确限制：总统执政不得超过连续2届的5年任期。
en: Mubarak should also endorse a limit of no more than two successive five-year terms for any president.

zh: 同样必要的还有建立信任体制，包括给予媒体公开和平等的接触机会，而现在媒体是由国家控制。
en: Equally necessary are confidence-building measures, including open and equal access to the media, which are now state-controlled.

zh: 我在这里宣布：我打算加入到即将到来的总统大选的角逐中去，从而开启对上述实质性改革的公开讨论。
en: I have announced that I intend to contest this upcoming presidential election as a way of opening debate on these essential reforms.

zh: 但是一旦今年秋天的大选能够保证以自由、公开的方式进行，我很乐意重新回到我的个人生活中去，作一个普通的老百姓。
en: But I would gladly go back to my life as a private citizen once guaranteed a free and open election this fall.

zh: 如果得以切实贯彻，这些措施将作为穆巴拉克的遗产，传承下去。
en: If seriously implemented, these steps will transform Mubarak’s legacy.

zh: 连同黎巴嫩、伊拉克和巴勒斯坦事件，它完全有可能给阿拉伯世界带来迟到已久的自由的春天。
en: Along with events in Lebanon, Iraq, and Palestine, it may well usher in an Arab spring of freedom, one long overdue.

zh: 民主推进的再思考
en: Democracy Promotion Reconsidered

zh: 坎布里奇—布什总统以鼓吹推进民主是美国外交政策的核心而闻名。
en: Cambridge – President George W. Bush was famous for proclaiming the promotion of democracy a central focus of American foreign policy.

zh: 执此论调的并非他一人。
en: He was not alone in this rhetoric.

zh: 自威尔逊以来的大多数美国总统都做过类似的表示。
en: Most American presidents since Woodrow Wilson have made similar statements.

zh: 因此当国务卿希拉里早些时候在国会就美国对外政策的“三‘D ’ ” —防御（defense ） 、 外交（diplmacy）和发展（development ） — 作证时就备受关注。
en: So it was striking when Secretary of State Hillary Clinton testified to Congress earlier this year about the “three D’s” of American foreign policy – defense, diplomacy, and development.

zh: 代表民主（democracy）的“D”显然不在此列，这意味着奥巴马政府的政策变化。
en: The “D” of democracy was noticeable by its absence, suggesting a change in policy by Barack Obama’s administration.

zh: 克林顿和布什都频繁引证民主对安全的有益作用。
en: Both Bill Clinton and George W. Bush frequently referred to the beneficial effects of democracy on security.

zh: 他们援引社会科学研究的成果，称民主政体之间几乎不会开战。
en: They cited social science studies that show that democracies rarely go to war with each other.

zh: 但是，更确切地说，学者们所言是 自由 民主政体之间几乎从不开战，这很可能是因为自由主义宪政文化比仅仅选举的事实更重要。
en: But, more carefully stated, what scholars show is that liberal democracies almost never go to war with each other, and it may be that a liberal constitutional culture is more important than the mere fact of elections.

zh: 尽管选举重要，但自由民主并不仅仅是“选举民主 ” 。
en: While elections are important, liberal democracy is more than “electocracy.”

zh: 脱离了宪法和文化制约的选举可能造成暴力，就像波斯尼亚和巴勒斯坦权力机构。
en: Elections in the absence of constitutional and cultural constraints can produce violence, as in Bosnia or the Palestinian Authority.

zh: 而非自由的民主政体则会相互攻击，如1990年代的厄瓜多尔和秘鲁。
en: And illiberal democracies have fought each other, as Ecuador and Peru did in the 1990’s.

zh: 在国内外的许多批评者眼中，布什政府的过度政策使民主推进的理念黯淡无光。
en: In the eyes of many critics at home and abroad, the Bush administration’s excesses tarnished the idea of democracy promotion.

zh: 布什以民主之名行入侵伊拉克之实就意味着民主可以用枪炮强加于人。
en: Bush’s invocation of democracy to justify the invasion of Iraq implied that democracy could be imposed at the barrel of a gun.

zh: “民主”一词与其特殊的美国变量相关联就增加了帝国主义的内涵。
en: The word democracy came to be associated with its particular American variant, and took on an imperialist connotation.

zh: 另外，布什的夸张言词又常常与其实际行动不符，从而其虚伪也备受诟病。
en: Moreover, Bush’s exaggerated rhetoric was often at odds with his practice, giving rise to charges of hypocrisy.

zh: 对他而言，批评津巴布韦、古巴和缅甸比非议沙特阿拉伯和巴基斯坦要容易得多。 他先前对埃及的批评之声也很快变得温和了。
en: It was far easier for him to criticize Zimbabwe, Cuba, and Burma than Saudi Arabia and Pakistan, and his initial criticism of Egypt was soon toned down.

zh: 然而，在对布什政府政策失败的过度反应中有一种危险。
en: There is a danger, however, in over-reacting to the failures of the Bush administration’s policies.

zh: 民主的成长不是美国强加于人的，而它本身也可能有许多形式。
en: The growth of democracy is not an American imposition, and it can take many forms.

zh: 随着各个经济体的发展和人民对现代化的适应，更大程度参与的愿望广泛存在。
en: The desire for greater participation is widespread as economies develop and people adjust to modernization.

zh: 民主并没有遭受挫折。
en: Democracy is not in retreat.

zh: “自由之屋 ” ， 一个非政府组织，在布什上任之初列出了86个自由国家，而在他执政末期，这一数字略有增加，达到89个。
en: Freedom House, a non-governmental organization, listed 86 free countries at the beginning of the Bush years, and a slight increase to 89 by the end of his term.

zh: 民主仍然是个值得为之努力的广泛目标。 但将这个目标与用于实现它的手段区分开来是非常重要的。
en: Democracy remains a worthy and widespread goal, but it is important to distinguish the goal from the means used to attain it.

zh: 武断地推进和较为温和地支持民主化之间是有区别的。
en: There is a difference between assertive promotion and more gentle support of democratization.

zh: 避免高压政治、不成熟的选举和虚伪的高调也并不是要排除一种富有耐心的政策—它所依赖的是经济援助、幕后外交、协助公民社会发展的多边策略、法制和管理良好的选举。
en: Avoiding coercion, premature elections, and hypocritical rhetoric should not preclude a patient policy that relies on economic assistance, behind-the-scenes diplomacy, and multilateral approaches to aid the development of civil society, the rule of law, and well-managed elections.

zh: 与对支持国外民主的对外政策手段同等重要的是我们在国内实践它的方式。
en: Equally important to the foreign-policy methods used to support democracy abroad are the ways in which we practice it at home.

zh: 当我们试图将民主强加于人，我们就玷污了民主。
en: When we try to impose democracy, we tarnish it.

zh: 当我们将自己的最佳传统发挥到极致时，才能激励他人仿效，从而创造吸引的软实力。
en: When we live up to our own best traditions, we can stimulate emulation and create the soft power of attraction.

zh: 这种方式就是里根所说的“山丘上的亮丽城市 ” 。
en: This approach is what Ronald Reagan called the “shining city on the hill.”

zh: 例如，美国内外的许多人都开始对美国式的政治制度颇有微词。 他们认为这是种被金钱左右并对局外人关闭大门的制度。
en: For example, many people both inside and outside the United States had become cynical about the American political system, arguing that it was dominated by money and closed to outsiders.

zh: 阿巴马在2008年的当选在很大程度上恢复了美国的软实力。
en: The election of Barack Hussein Obama in 2008 did a great deal to restore the soft power of American democracy.

zh: 美国国内实践自由民主的另一个方面是当前饱受争议的美国应对恐怖主义威胁的方式。
en: Another aspect of America’s domestic practice of liberal democracy that is currently being debated is how the US deals with the threat of terrorism.

zh: 在2001年“9.11”恐怖袭击之后极度恐惧的大气候下，布什政府着手歪曲对国际和国内法的解释，并由此玷污了美国的民主，削弱了其软实力。
en: In the climate of extreme fear that followed the attacks of September 11, 2001, the Bush administration engaged in tortured legal interpretations of international and domestic law that tarnished American democracy and diminished its soft power.

zh: 幸运的是，在自由的媒体、独立的司法和多元的立法体系帮助下，这些举措被置于公众辩论之中。
en: Fortunately, a free press, an independent judiciary, and a pluralist legislature helped to hold for such practices up public debate.

zh: 奥巴马宣称将在一年内关闭关塔纳摩湾的羁押设施，并将相关的法律备忘录公之于众。 这些备忘录是用来开脱那些现在被认为是对被羁押者的折磨行为。
en: Obama has proclaimed that he will close the Guantánamo Bay detention facility within a year, and he has declassified the legal memos that were used to justify what is now widely regarded as torture of detainees.

zh: 但如何应对恐怖主义的问题不仅事关历史。
en: But the problem of how to deal with terrorism is not just a matter of history.

zh: 这种威胁仍然存在，我们需要记住的一个重点是民主政体中的人民既需要自由也需要安全。
en: The threat remains alive, and it is important to remember that people in democracies want both liberty and security.

zh: 在极度恐惧的时刻，态度的钟摆摇向了频谱的“安全”一端。
en: In moments of extreme fear, the pendulum of attitudes swings toward the security end of that spectrum.

zh: 在美国内战期间，林肯暂时中止了 habeas corpus 的权利—被羁押者有权在法庭上挑战被羁押事实的原则。 罗斯福在二战初期也拘留了日裔美国公民。
en: Abraham Lincoln suspended the right of habeas corpus – the principle that detainees are entitled to challenge their detention in a court of law – during the Civil War, and Franklin Roosevelt interned Japanese-American citizens during the early days of World War II.

zh: 当布什政府中一些更具理性的成员现在被问到为何在2002年会采取那样的立场时，他们列举了“9.11”之后的炭疽袭击和对美国民众遭受第二次袭击的广泛恐惧。
en: When some of the Bush administration’s more reasonable members are asked today how they could have taken the positions they did in 2002, they cite the anthrax attacks that followed 9/11, the intelligence reports of an impending attack with nuclear materials, and the widespread fear of a second attack against the American people.

zh: 在如此的环境下，自由民主和安全之间关系紧张。
en: In such circumstances, liberal democracy and security are in tension.

zh: 恐怖主义是一种表演。
en: Terrorism is a form of theatre.

zh: 它不是通过彻底破坏，而是通过戏剧性地表现对平民的残暴来产生效果。
en: It invokes its effects not by sheer destruction, but by dramatizing atrocious acts against civilians.

zh: 恐怖主义就像柔道。
en: Terrorism is like Ju-jitsu.

zh: 较弱的对手通过借力打力来战胜较强的一方。
en: The weaker adversary wins by leveraging the power of the stronger against itself.

zh: 恐怖分子希望创造一种恐惧和不安全的氛围来挑动我们通过降低我们自身自由民主的质量来伤害自己。
en: Terrorists hope to create a climate of fear and insecurity that will provoke us to harm ourselves by undercutting the quality of our own liberal democracy.

zh: 如果我们要保全和支持国内外的自由民主，那么在防范新的恐怖袭击的同时了解和避免过去所犯的错误就至关重要。
en: Preventing new terrorist attacks while understanding and avoiding the mistakes of the past will be essential if we are to preserve and support liberal democracy both at home and abroad.

zh: 这就是奥巴马政府在当下的美国引导的一场辩论。
en: That is the debate that the Obama administration is leading in the US today.

zh: 民主、职责与荣誉
en: Democracy, Responsibility, and Honor

zh: 很少有哪一天过去，而没有传出某位政府部长宣布辞职的消息。
en: Hardly a day goes by on which we do not hear of a government minister somewhere resigning his or her office.

zh: 某种意义上讲，这一点不奇怪。
en: In a sense, this is hardly surprising.

zh: 毕竟，仅欧盟内部的25个成员国就雇佣了1000多位部长，如果算上副职的话还会翻番。
en: After all, the twenty-five member states of the European Union alone employ hundreds of ministers between them - and even more if junior ministers are included.

zh: 但部长们为什么会辞职？
en: But why do ministers resign?

zh: 更有趣的是：为什么尽管有人早该辞职，却没有这么做？
en: More interestingly still: why do some not resign although there seem to be compelling reasons for some to do so?

zh: 不以实际调查为基础的概括肯定是猜测。
en: In the absence of empirical research, generalizations must be guesswork.

zh: 部长们辞职往往由于陷入丑闻，这些丑闻近来常与政党筹资有关。
en: Ministers frequently resign because they find themselves involved in scandals, often connected in recent times with financing political parties.

zh: 仅在意大利就能找到好几个牺牲品。
en: In Italy, one encounters several ghosts of such past misdeeds.

zh: 有些时候，部长们由于所谓的"个人原因"选择辞职。
en: Sometimes ministers resign for what they call "personal reasons."

zh: 这样的理由可能隐藏着更引人注目的因素，比如美国中情局局长乔治·特尼特不久前的辞职。
en: Such reasons may conceal more compelling factors, as the recent resignation of American CIA Director George Tenet suggests.

zh: 但托尼·布莱尔失去最出色、也最忠诚的内阁友人Alan Milburn，则纯粹是因为后者希望有更多时间陪伴家人。
en: But Tony Blair lost one of his best and most loyal cabinet friends, Alan Milburn, because he genuinely wanted to spend more time with his family.

zh: 布莱尔同样失去了外交大臣Robin Cook和发展援助大臣Clare Short。
en: Blair also lost his ministers of foreign affairs and of development assistance, Robin Cook and Clare Short, respectively.

zh: 两人的辞职源于对伊战争问题上严重的政策分歧，他们最终选择了离开。 Cook先生至今仍活跃在英国政坛。
en: In their case, it was a serious policy disagreement - over the Iraq war - that made them go, and Mr. Cook certainly remains a politician-in-waiting.

zh: 布莱尔首相的国防大臣杰夫·胡恩和他的美国同僚唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德却仍然在位。
en: Yet Geoff Hoon, Prime Minister Blair's defence minister, as well as his American counterpart, Donald Rumsfeld, remain in office.

zh: 这两人均非丑闻缠身，也不是对领导政策持有疑义。
en: Neither, to be sure, is clearly involved in a manifest scandal, nor do they disagree with the policies set by their leaders.

zh: 恰恰相反，他们不仅全力支持，而且顽固地捍卫政策执行中存在的偏差，比如说虐俘事件。
en: On the contrary, they not only support these policies but stubbornly defend even their aberrations, like the mistreatment of prisoners of war.

zh: 部长们展开调查，把将军们抛到一边，让他们提前退休。 尽管他们把疟俘者告上军事法庭，但显然不愿回答议员，更不用说来自公众的有关自身去留问题的质问。
en: These ministers institute investigations, they move generals sideways or even into premature retirement, they haul perpetrators before military tribunals; but they apparently see no reason to respond to those members of Congress or Parliament, let alone of the public, who wonder whether it is not time for the ministers themselves to go.

zh: 伊拉克罪行尤其引人注目，但其它事例也同样能够说明问题。
en: The case of crimes in Iraq is particularly dramatic, but less obvious cases make the same point.

zh: 例如德国交通部长主持修建并引以为豪的道路收费系统，最后变成了代价昂贵的毁灭性灾难。
en: The German minister of transport, for example, presided over a catastrophic and costly failure of a road toll system that he had proudly announced.

zh: 但即便如此他也能继续留任，而把失败的责任归咎于人，私有公司成了这次事故的替罪羊。
en: But even he may stay in office to try again, having blamed others - in this case private companies - for the debacle.

zh: 如果灾难发生时部长并未直接参与，他或她就可以指责执行既定政策的官僚或承包商，自己却不为此承担任何责任。
en: If something unacceptable happens without a minister's direct involvement, he or she can get away with it, or so it seems, by pointing a finger at the bureaucrats or contractors who are responsible for implementing an approved policy.

zh: 是否总是如此？
en: Was it always thus?

zh: 我们希望不是。
en: One would like to think not.

zh: 每件事都让我们想起两个道德准则，今天谈起政府时这两种观念都已不再时髦：责任和荣誉。
en: In any case, two ethical concepts come to mind, neither of which is much in vogue these days when talking about government: responsibility and honor.

zh: 但两者都是，至少曾经是管理道德的组成部分。
en: Both values are, or at least used to be, part of the ethics of governance.

zh: 职责意味着部长要对辖区发生的每件事负责，事实上，只有他们要承担严格意义上的责任。
en: Responsibility concerns the fact that ministers are accountable for everything that happens within their sphere. In fact, they alone are accountable in the strict sense.

zh: 议会制度下，他们能够而且必须面对人民选举的代表，解释曾经发生的一切。
en: In parliamentary systems, they can and must appear before the elected representatives of the people and explain what happened.

zh: 由于须负直接责任，因此事故发生后部长们仅查出责任者是不够的。
en: Because they alone are directly accountable, it is not enough for a minister to point to and name the miscreants in any particular case.

zh: 公务员不能以同样的方式自我辩白，而必须由部长们代为辩护。
en: Civil servants cannot defend themselves in the same way; they have to be defended by their ministers.

zh: 如果事态严重，部长无法为下属辩护的话，公务员就必须接受惩罚，而部长仍然要承担责任。
en: If something of such severity has happened that a minister finds it impossible to defend them, they may have to pay the penalty, but the minister still must assume responsibility.

zh: 我们有理由认为拉姆斯菲尔德部长没有纵容伊拉克的疟俘事件，更不用说下达命令了。
en: It is proper to assume that Secretary Rumsfeld did not condone, let alone order, the abuse of Iraqi prisoners.

zh: 也许有人会愤怒地质问交到他办公桌上的说明和报告是否含有相关的内容。
en: There may be the vexing question of whether instructions or reports passed over his desk that contained relevant information.

zh: 但无论如何，部长都要为领导下的错误勇敢地承担责任。
en: But, either way, the minister is ultimately and uniquely responsible for what happened under his command.

zh: 即便作恶者已经被绳之以法，他也不能逃避理应承担的职责。
en: He cannot escape this responsibility even if the perpetrators are identified and prosecuted.

zh: 这也是第二种道德观¾荣誉之所在。
en: This is where the second ethical concept, honor, comes into play.

zh: 这个词也许听上去老气横秋，但在拉姆斯菲尔德的问题上，它意味着也许宪法或法律没有要求部长为伊拉克疟俘丑闻辞职，但不久前相关人员的主动辞职曾被视作荣誉的象征。
en: This may seem an old-fashioned term. What it says in Rumsfeld's case is that there may be no legal or constitutional obligation for a responsible minister to resign over the Iraqi abuse scandal; but once upon a time it would have been regarded as a matter of honor that he does resign.

zh: 这种做法不仅表明这位部长已经认识到自己肩负的责任，而且表明他将民主制度的完整性置于个人利益之上，更不用说他为之服务的选民的期望了。
en: Such a step not only demonstrates that the minister in question is fully aware of the burden of his responsibility, but also that he puts the integrity of democratic institutions above his personal interest, let alone the electoral prospects of those whom he served.

zh: 民主不仅宝贵，更是一套不太稳定的价值观。
en: Democracy is a precious but also a precarious set of values.

zh: 如果希望说服他人相信民主，那么最好表明：我们不仅相信选举和多数意志，而且信奉责任与荣誉的美德。
en: If we want to persuade others to subscribe to it, we do well to demonstrate that we not only believe in elections and majorities but also in the virtues of responsibility and honor.

zh: 民主国家的烧船
en: Democracy’s Burning Ships

zh: 芝加哥—自20世纪70年代以来，博弈论在学术上的流行使得宏观经济学家开始强调“承诺”的重要性。 承诺本是意在通过限制决策者自由裁量权改善长期经济结果的策略。
en: CHICAGO – Since the late 1970’s, the academic diffusion of game theory has led macroeconomists to emphasize the importance of “commitment,” a strategy that aims to enhance long-term economic outcomes by restricting policymakers’ discretion.

zh: 这一观点是反直觉的：更少怎么会产生更多？
en: The idea seems counterintuitive: How can less produce more?

zh: 尽管从历史上看并不精确，但策略性承诺的最佳例子是寇蒂斯（Hernán Cortés）的传奇故事：在征服墨西哥的过程中，他决定烧掉西班牙远征队的船。
en: While not historically accurate, one of the best examples of a strategic commitment is provided by the legend of Hernán Cortés, according to which, in his quest to conquer Mexico, he decided to burn the ships that had brought his expedition from Spain.

zh: 乍一看，这是个疯狂举动：为什么自己毁掉万一失败唯一可能的退路？
en: At first, this might seem like a crazy move: Why intentionally destroy the only possible way out in case of defeat?

zh: 据说寇蒂斯这样做是为了激发士气。
en: Cortes allegedly did it to motivate his troops.

zh: 断了退路，士兵就会有强大动力去大胜仗。
en: With no escape route, soldiers were highly motivated to win.

zh: 亚历山大大帝据说在征服波斯的过程中也用了同样的计谋。
en: Alexander the Great is said to have done something similar when conquering Persia.

zh: 为了产生效果，承诺战略必须是可信的 — — 也就是说，不能马上食言。
en: To produce its benefit, a commitment strategy should be credible – that is, it cannot be reversed quickly.

zh: 从这个角度看，寇蒂斯的策略是完美的：一旦打了败仗，西班牙人根本没时间重新造船。
en: In this sense, Cortés’s strategy was perfect: in case of defeat, the Spanish would have no time to rebuild the burned ships.

zh: 要想起作用，承诺策略还必须具有万一失败代价沉重的特点：如果寇蒂斯失败，就没有一个西班牙士兵能够生还。
en: To work properly, a commitment strategy should also be costly in case of failure: had Cortés lost, no Spanish soldier would have escaped alive.

zh: 正是这样的成本帮助激发了他的士兵的士气。
en: It is precisely this cost that helped motivate his soldiers.

zh: 问题在于，我们注定只能听到运用此类策略获得成功的历史案例。
en: The problem is that we are bound to hear about only the successful historical examples of such a strategy.

zh: 如果寇蒂斯失败的话，他早就被遗忘在历史长河中了，即使被记住，也是作为愚蠢的自大狂 — — 居然不自量力地想打败伟大的帝国。
en: Had Cortés’s strategy failed, he would have gone down in history – if he was remembered at all – as an arrogant fool who thought that he could defeat a great empire.

zh: 该策略最早在经济政策中的应用是中央银行。
en: One of the earliest applications of this strategy to economic policy is in the design of central banks.

zh: 这里的逻辑是，货币决策者应该独立于政治制度，因为当选举临近时，政客可能会迫使货币当局以持久高通胀的代价“买”来暂时性的高就业。
en: Monetary policymakers, the argument goes, should be independent from the political system, because, when elections near, politicians will likely pressure them to “buy” temporarily higher employment at the cost of permanently higher inflation.

zh: 为了避免这一低效的权衡，政府应该通过将央行与政治隔离管住了央行行长的双手。
en: To prevent this inefficient trade off, governments should tie central bankers’ hands by insulating them from political influence.

zh: 许多宏观经济学家把20世纪80年代通胀的持续下降归功于该策略的广泛应用。
en: Many macroeconomists attribute the sustained decline in inflation since the early 1980’s to the widespread use of this strategy.

zh: 受此鼓舞，决策者还开始将它应用于其他领域。
en: And, encouraged by its success, policymakers started applying it elsewhere.

zh: 金融自由化便是以追随市场友好型政策的承诺为卖点的。
en: Financial liberalization was sold as a commitment to follow market-friendly policies.

zh: 如果未来政府抛弃这一政策，则资本外逃将迫使他们就范。
en: If a future government deviated from the policy, capital flight would bring it to its knees.

zh: 同样的策略也可以用于扩大政府外债、货币局制度甚至货币联盟。
en: The same applies to extensive government borrowing from abroad, to currency boards, even to currency unions.

zh: 欧元的诞生无非是极端形式的承诺：欧洲各国政府将尽力往德国财政纪律标准上靠。
en: The creation of the euro is nothing but an extreme form of commitment: European governments tried to lash themselves to the German mast of fiscal discipline.

zh: 这些机制的普及引出了民主难题。
en: The diffusion of these mechanisms raises the issue of democracy.

zh: 当寇蒂斯宣布烧掉西班牙战船的时候，他并没有发起投票。
en: When Cortés allegedly burned the Spanish ships, he did not take a poll.

zh: 如果他组织了投票，那么他可能也会胜出（这一策略是明智的 ） ， 但谁也不能保证结果会如何。
en: Had he done so, he might have won (the strategy was clever), but it was not a foregone conclusion.

zh: 但即使承诺策略产生了有益激励，也有可能不值得冒险。
en: But even if the commitment strategy produced beneficial incentives, it might not have been worth the risk.

zh: 寇蒂斯被光荣之梦蒙了心，即使获胜希望渺茫也不惜牺牲手下的军队。
en: Perhaps Cortés, blinded by his dreams of glory, was ready to sacrifice his troops even when the odds of victory were too slim.

zh: 幸运的是，如今的民选政府会进行投票，因此它们的所作所为反映的是民意。
en: Nowadays, fortunately, democratically elected governments make these decisions, which thus should reflect the people’s will.

zh: 但这些决定的性质意味着它们必须被仔细审视。
en: Yet, given their nature, these decisions deserve special scrutiny.

zh: 毕竟，它们被设计成不可逆转的决定，将束缚住政府的手脚，成为宪法性质的约束。
en: After all, they are – by design – irreversible decisions that tie the hands of future governments, which makes them tantamount to constitutional norms.

zh: 从这个角度讲，它们不能像常规立法那样走同样的批准程序。
en: As such, they should not be subject to the same approval process as normal legislation.

zh: 如果先期作出承诺者具有比烧船更有吸引力的短期好处，则这一问题会变得尤为严重。
en: This problem is particularly severe when the up-front action that seals the commitment has short-term benefits that are more attractive than burning the ship.

zh: 当一国政府开始借外债或加入货币联盟时，好处是利率的下降。
en: When a government starts to borrow abroad or chooses to enter a currency union, these benefits take the form of reduced interest rates.

zh: 因此，立刻获得的好处就会比潜在的未来成本具有更大的政治吸引力。
en: Thus, the immediate benefits become more politically salient than potential future costs.

zh: 通过使用该策略，马基雅弗利主义政府能够促使不情愿的选民接受与他们的意愿背道而驰的政策。
en: By using this strategy, a Machiavellian government can induce a reluctant electorate to accept a policy that is contrary to its will.

zh: 许多人会说，这是如此。
en: Many people would say that this is exactly the point.

zh: 对南欧国家来说，加入欧元���直接或间接地迫使其公民接受了一定程度的他们本无能力接受的财政纪律。
en: For southern European countries, joining the euro was – explicitly or implicitly – a way to force their citizens to accept a degree of fiscal discipline that they were incapable of adopting on their own.

zh: 但这到底是民主决策，还是“启蒙”的精英在强迫不知情的公民做选择？
en: But was this a democratic decision, or one that an “enlightened” elite forced upon its unwitting citizens?

zh: 我担心后者才是正确的，对欧盟反对声四起也是如此。
en: I fear that the latter is true – hence the growing resentment against the European Union.

zh: 让受害者雪上加霜的是，当前的欧洲领导人并不“拥有”过去的决策。
en: To add insult to injury, current European leaders do not “own” their past decisions.

zh: 他们不承认他们或他们的前任烧掉了船。
en: They do not admit that they or their predecessors are the ones who burned the ships.

zh: 他们把矛头指向了欧洲。
en: They blame Europe.

zh: 结果，原本作为促使欧洲进一步一体化的欧元却在让欧洲分崩离析。
en: The result is that the euro, sold as a way to integrate Europe further, is tearing it apart.

zh: 民主狂热症
en: Democratic Hysteria

zh: 伯克利 — — 在近来令印美这两个世界最大的民主国家陷入瘫痪的政治僵局中，在威廉·巴特勒·叶芝口中一向精明强干的两国领导人彻底丧失了说服力，而错误肤浅的舆论却愈演愈烈。
en: BERKELEY – In the political impasses that recently paralyzed the world’s two largest democracies, India and the United States, both countries’ usually clear-sighted leaders, to paraphrase William Butler Yeats, lacked all conviction, while the misguided and the shallow were full of passionate intensity.

zh: 事实上，类似这样的狂热几乎没有消退的迹象。
en: Indeed, that passion shows little sign of waning.

zh: 对经济问题一无所知的美国人在目睹身边失业、房屋止赎的悲惨景象和美国国际地位江河日下的同时，一边从财政清廉的过时主张中汲取狂热，一边紧紧抓住手里的圣经，拥护对美国宪法做出的幼稚解读。
en: In the US, the economically illiterate, seeing misery all around from lost jobs, foreclosed homes, and the ever more apparent decline in America’s international status, are distilling their frenzy from obsolete advocates of fiscal rectitude, while clutching their Bibles and espousing a juvenile understanding of the US constitution.

zh: 但他们的做法只能令美国经济越陷越深，同时进一步加大经济复苏的难度。
en: But their efforts are only digging a bigger hole for the US economy, making recovery much more difficult.

zh: 就连他们厌恶税收的金主们也在赞赏这群乌合之众捍卫其财产做法的同时，开始对这种不计后果的想法给投资环境和股票价格造成的冲击表示担忧。
en: Even their tax-averse sponsors, while appreciative of the rabble’s efforts to protect their wealth, are now fearful of the impact of these wayward ideas on the investment climate and equity prices.

zh: 2008年肩负着美好愿望和期待上任的巴拉克·奥巴马总统现在就像被车灯照着的野鹿般不知所措。
en: President Barack Obama, elected with a great deal of goodwill and hope in 2008, is now caught like a deer in the headlights.

zh: 他知道经济的短期需要与国债管理的长期需要相左，但是他无力提供果断的领导。
en: He knows that what the economy needs in the short run is different from what needs to be done to manage public debt in the long run, but he is unable to provide decisive leadership.

zh: 他寻求妥协的错误举动只能进一步激起反对者的狂热。
en: His misguided efforts at compromise only fuel his opponents’ frenzy.

zh: 曾经以诚实智慧闻名于世的印度总理曼莫汉·辛格如今也已陷入瘫痪，面对同样蛊惑人心的民粹运动无法采取统一有效的行动。 这次民粹运动是由绝食活动家安纳·赫扎尔领导的反腐败改革运动，前不久刚刚以充满狂热混乱的妥协宣告结束。
en: In India, Prime Minister Manmohan Singh, who once enjoyed a strong reputation for integrity and intelligence, has been similarly paralyzed, acting erratically in the face of an equally demagogic populist movement – the anti-graft crusade led by a fasting activist, Anna Hazare – which just ended in a frantic and uneasy compromise.

zh: 赫扎尔在义愤填膺地挥舞着旗帜的城市中产阶级和以感性为追求目标的媒体怂恿下，用尽一切手段夺取圣雄甘地的衣钵，他善于模仿甘地的虔诚，但却不具备甘地赖以为本的智慧。
en: Hazare, egged on by a flag-waving and indignant urban middle class and sensation-seeking media, tries mightily to claim Mahatma Gandhi’s mantle; he is good at mimicking Gandhi’s piety, but lacks his root wisdom.

zh: 基层官员（警察、法院和政府职员）腐败一向在印度屡禁不绝。
en: Low-level corruption (the police, courts, and government clerks) has always been widespread in India.

zh: 近年来经济的快速发展导致各种腐败花样百出。
en: The type of corruption that has increased in recent years is partly a consequence of rapid economic growth.

zh: 像土地、矿产和碳氢化合物这样的公共资源和电信频谱价值迅猛增长，在这场资源控制争夺战中，商人们开始寻求捷径。
en: Public resources, like land, minerals, and hydrocarbons, and the telecommunications spectrum, have shot up in value, and in the scramble to control them, businessmen seek shortcuts.

zh: 腐败愈演愈烈的另一个原因是竞选开支猛增，政客因此从商人那里募集资金，并许诺为其提供报偿。
en: Another reason for rising corruption is the soaring expense of elections, with politicians raising money from business as part of a quid pro quo.

zh: 印美两国都不为竞选活动提供公共财政支持，但美国允许大企业为竞选捐款，而印度法律一般不允许这样做（因此企业在竞选捐款时往往都偷偷摸摸 ） 。
en: Both India and the US have little public financing of elections, and large business donations that are legal in the US are often illegal (and hence given underhandedly) in India.

zh: 但印度的反腐败运动没有针对腐败蔓延的结构性因素，相反却哀叹世风日下，要求额外加设依靠严刑峻法实行监管和惩罚的政府机构。
en: But, instead of addressing the structural causes of rising corruption, India’s anti-graft movement bemoans a supposed weakening of ethical values and demands additional agencies with draconian powers to monitor and punish.

zh: 对民主进展缓慢感到不满的城市中产阶级转而信奉圣人和他们的魔法圣物。
en: The urban middle classes, impatient with the slow processes of democracy, latch on to holy men and their magic potions.

zh: 就像美国一样，公众的愤怒不知怎样被从行贿的富人身上转向了腐败的政客。
en: Just as in the US, public rage is somehow directed away from the rich bribe-givers and onto venal politicians.

zh: 美印两国都需要思考如此愤怒的民粹运动对民主制度的长期影响。
en: In both countries, the long-run implications of such angry populist movements for the health of democratic institutions need to be pondered.

zh: 其中印度尤其如此，因为那里的竞选活动活跃，普通人相比美国参与热情更高，但同时其他民主机构又不够强大，有些甚至无法正常运转，而且司法程序过于缓慢，偶尔还会发生腐败现象。
en: This is particularly true for India, where elections are vigorous and common people participate in them more enthusiastically than in the US, but other democratic institutions remain weak and sometimes dysfunctional, and the judiciary is too slow and occasionally corrupt.

zh: 民粹分子向欢呼的人群批评当选政客是小偷和劫匪，但同时也贬低代议政府制度和流程。
en: To loud cheers from the crowds, the populists damn elected politicians as thieves and looters, but in the process disparage the institutions and processes of representative government.

zh: 就在不那么遥远的过去，非洲、拉美和南亚等地区随处可见的这类诋毁往往降低了民粹独裁主义的控制难度。
en: In the not-too-distant past, widespread denigration of this sort in Africa, Latin America, and other parts of South Asia often made it easier for populist authoritarianism to take hold.

zh: 事实上 ， “ 安纳就是印度，印度就是安纳”这句流传甚广的口号让人回想起1975－1977年英迪拉·甘地紧急统治下的苦难岁月，当时她的追随者就喊出了“英迪拉就是印度”的口号。
en: Indeed, the widely heard slogan “Anna is India, India is Anna” reminds some of the dark days of Indira Gandhi’s emergency rule in 1975-1977, when her followers raised the slogan of “Indira is India”.

zh: 但这些口号贩子忽略了印度的极端多样性。
en: But the slogan-mongers overlook India’s extreme diversity.

zh: 包括印度1.5亿穆斯林在内的很多少数民族群众就公开反对赫扎尔的活动。
en: Many members of ethnic minorities, including the country’s 150 million Muslims, openly oppose the Hazare movement.

zh: 某位贱民（印度古老种姓制度的最底层）领袖担忧安纳的成功会推动某些多数派领导人发起更大规模的运动，废除赋予低种姓民众特定尊严的保护性权利和反歧视性雇佣政策。
en: One Dalit (the lowest level of India’s old caste system) leader expressed his fear that Anna’s success might inspire some majoritarian leader to rouse an even larger movement to rescind the protective rights and affirmative-action policies that have brought the lower castes some dignity.

zh: 一些非政府组织领导人也抗议赫扎尔的要求取代了他们自己截然不同的反腐败计划。
en: And some NGO leaders object that their own, very different anti-corruption agenda is being pre-empted by Hazare’s demands.

zh: 在人口众多的国家吸引一批人的支持并非难事。
en: In a populous country, it is not difficult to attract a large crowd.

zh: 电子媒体特别关注挥舞旗帜拥护民族主义事业的色彩斑斓的民众。
en: The electronic media are particularly attracted to colorful crowds waving flags and espousing nationalist causes.

zh: 正如某位记者指出，当1998年5月400，000群众（远多于赫扎尔在德里的追随者数量）在加尔各答游行抗议政府的核试验计划时，媒体却几乎没有注意到。
en: As one journalist pointed out, when 400,000 people (far more than Hazare’s followers in Delhi) marched in Kolkata in May 1998 to protest against the government’s nuclear tests, the media barely noticed.

zh: 即使几乎所有人都支持某项运动（美国或印度近来的政治运动并非如此 ） ， 民主在程序和参与层面仍然存在着根本的冲突。
en: Even when movements have near-universal support (which is not the case with the recent political movements in the US or India), there is a fundamental tension between democracy’s procedural and participatory aspects.

zh: 除选举改革外，政治参与渠道和民怨表达都必须遵守制度和程序，而相关制度应当至少可以免受政治混乱的影响。
en: Apart from electoral reform, outlets for political participation and expression of public grievances must be balanced by institutions and procedures that are partly insulated from the rough-and-tumble of politics.

zh: 当然，代议制政府有时的确反应迟钝，特别是在选举间歇期的时候，但直接民主却并非解决之道。
en: Of course, representative government does sometimes become unresponsive, particularly between elections, but direct democracy is not the solution.

zh: 1978年美国加州举行的物业税征收限额全民公投导致州政府运转失灵加剧就是明证。
en: The US state of California, which has become increasingly dysfunctional since a 1978 popular referendum capped property taxes, can attest to that.

zh: 像安纳·赫扎尔那样以绝食扰乱公共秩序并胁迫仓促通过立法也绝非解决之道。
en: Nor is it an answer to demand hasty enactment of legislation in the face of a threat to cause public disorder by starving oneself to death, as Anna Hazare has done.

zh: 世界两个最大民主国家的多数民众都明白民主无法提供神奇的解决方法。
en: Most citizens in the world’s two largest democracies understand that democracy does not offer magic solutions.

zh: 我们这个时代最可悲的问题就在于太多的人愿意尝试病态的权宜之计和捷径。
en: One of the most lamentable developments of our time is that so many are now prepared to try unhealthy palliatives and short cuts.

zh: 民主的不平等性
en: Democratic Inequality

zh: 芝加哥—美国家庭储蓄率为什么会在大衰退前剧减？
en: CHICAGO – Why did the household savings rate in the United States plummet before the Great Recession?

zh: 我的两位芝加哥大学同事贝特兰（Marianne Bertrand）和摩尔斯（Adair Morse）给出了一个有趣的回答：因为收入不平等性的加剧。
en: Two of my colleagues at the University of Chicago, Marianne Bertrand and Adair Morse, offer an intriguing answer: growing income inequality.

zh: 贝特兰和摩尔斯发现，在危机爆发的前几年中，收入最高的5%的家庭消费较高的地区（通常以州为单位 ） ， 收入水平较低的家庭消费也较高。
en: Bertrand and Morse find that in the years before the crisis, in areas (usually states) where consumption was high among households in the top fifth of the income distribution, household consumption was high at lower income levels as well.

zh: 在剔除了一系列可能的原因后，他们认为，较穷家庭会模仿同一地区较富家庭的消费模式。
en: After ruling out a number of possible explanations, they concluded that poorer households imitated the consumption patterns of richer households in their area.

zh: 与收入较低家庭“尽力赶上富豪”的观点一致的是，居住在高消费富裕消费者附近的小康之家会将大量支出花在富裕家庭的常见消费项目上，比如珠宝、美容、养生和家政服务等。
en: Consistent with the idea that households at lower income levels were “keeping up with the Vanderbilts,” the non-rich (but not the really poor) living near high-spending wealthy consumers tended to spend much more on items that richer households usually consumed, such as jewelry, beauty and fitness, and domestic services.

zh: 事实上，许多人通过贷款来维持支持，这导致了在富人收入（和支出）更高的地区，较穷家庭陷入财务困境甚至破产的比例显著较高。
en: Indeed, many borrowed to finance their spending, with the result that the proportion of poorer households in financial distress or filing for bankruptcy was significantly higher in areas where the rich earned (and spent) more.

zh: 若不是这种模仿性消费的话，小康之家近几年平均应能增加800美元的年储蓄。
en: Were it not for such imitative consumption, non-rich households would have saved, on average, more than $800 annually in recent years.

zh: 这是我所见到的关于收入不平等的弊端第一批详细研究之一。
en: This is one of the first detailed studies of the adverse effects of income inequality that I have seen.

zh: 该研究超越了吸引眼球的“1 % ” 争论，指出即使是大多数美国人每天都碰得到的不平等性 — — 即本文的典型读者和其他人群之间的不平等性 — — 也具有相当大的弊端。
en: It goes beyond the headline-grabbing “1%” debate to show that even the everyday inequality that most Americans face – between the incomes of, say, typical readers of this commentary and the rest – has deep pernicious effects.

zh: 同样有趣的还有该研究所发现的收入不平等性与危机前经济政策之间的联系。
en: Equally interesting is the link that the study finds between income inequality and pre-crisis economic policy.

zh: 在危机爆发的前几年中，来自收入不平等性较严重地区的共和党议员更倾向于赞成扩大穷人的住房信用的立法（但民主党几乎清一色地赞成此类立法，因此较难识别他们的动机 ） 。
en: Republican Congressmen from districts with higher levels of income inequality were more likely to vote for legislation to expand housing credit to the poor in the years before the crisis (almost all Democrats voted for such legislation, making it hard to distinguish their motives).

zh: 而就富人支出对小康家庭支出的影响而言，房价变动更大的地区该影响也越大，这表明住房信用和以上涨的房屋价值作抵押贷款的能力通过小康之家支撑了过度消费。
en: And the effect of spending by the rich on non-rich households’ spending was higher in areas where house prices could move more, suggesting that housing credit and the ability to borrow against rising home equity may have supported over-consumption by the non-rich.

zh: 但最令我眼前一亮的是立法者对不平等性的反应的今昔不同之处。
en: I was most fascinated, though, by the difference in legislators’ response to inequality now and in the past.

zh: 美联储的拉姆查兰（Rodney Ramcharan）和我对意在刺激贷款竞争的1927年麦克法登法案（McFadden Act）的国会表决进行了研究，我们发现，来自地权分配高度不平等的地区（当时，许多地区的主要收入源是务农）的立法者更倾向于反对该法案。
en: In a study of the congressional vote on the McFadden Act of 1927, which sought to boost competition in lending, Rodney Ramcharan of the US Federal Reserve and I found that legislators from districts with a highly unequal distribution of land holdings – farming was the primary source of income in many districts then – tended to vote against the act.

zh: 至少是在该案例中，更大的不平等性导致立法者偏向于更少的消费和贷款扩张。
en: More inequality led legislators, at least in that case, to prefer less competition and less expansion in lending.

zh: 我们还发现，银行竞争越少的县，农场繁荣月温和，大萧条前泡沫破裂的危害也越轻。
en: And we found that counties with less bank competition experienced a milder farmland boom, and therefore a smaller bust in the years before the Great Depression.

zh: 在这些研究中，我们可以得到一个显而易见的教训，即意外后果的重要性。
en: The obvious lesson to be drawn from these episodes is the importance of unintended consequences.

zh: 在20世纪初，国会选区中的富裕地主可能同时也是地区银行的所有者，或者与地区银行所有者是亲朋好友。
en: In the early twentieth century, a congressional district’s rich landowners were likely to own the local banks as well, or to be related to, or friends with, bank owners.

zh: 他们可以从限制竞争、控制融资中得到好处。
en: They benefited from limiting competition and controlling access to finance.

zh: 代表们是替所在选区权势利益者投票的。
en: Representatives voted on behalf of their districts’ powerful interests.

zh: 他们偏向于更少的信用市场竞争，这不是因为担心不知情的农民，而是为了捍卫权势贷款人的利益。
en: They preferred less competition in credit markets not out of concern for the unwitting farmers, but in order to defend powerful lenders’ profits.

zh: 他们得逞了，但也造成了一个附带效应：保护了这些选区被卷入金融狂热。
en: It worked, but an unintended collateral effect was to protect these districts from getting carried away by the financial frenzy.

zh: 为什么21世纪的立法者会有所不同？
en: Why did twenty-first-century legislators behave differently?

zh: 愤世嫉俗（但越来越普遍）的观点是立法者仍然是在为支票投票 — — 2008年危机爆发前的金融立法无不是为了满足金融部门的胃口，让更多的客户去吞下不良贷款和可以按揭。
en: The cynical, and increasingly popular, view is that they were again voting their pocketbooks – all financial legislation in the run-up to the 2008 crisis was supposedly driven by the financial sector’s appetite for more customers to devour with teaser loans and dubious mortgages.

zh: 但是，如果投票被金融部门所影响，那么一贯被视为财阀代言人的共和党应该一边倒地支持立法。
en: But, if voting was influenced by the financial sector, the supposed party of the plutocrats, the Republicans, should have voted in unison for the bill.

zh: 但他们却分裂为两个阵营，原因在于选区内的小康之家对获得融资的渴望不同。
en: Instead, they split on the basis of whose non-rich constituents were more desirous of obtaining finance.

zh: 21世纪的立法者似乎更加民主，响应着选民或许并不正确的愿望，而不再首先满足权势金融利益者。
en: Twenty-first-century legislators seemed to be more democratic, responding to their voters’ possibly misguided wishes, rather than primarily to powerful financial interests.

zh: 事实上，一旦其行为的意外后果 — — 危机的爆发让小康之家陷入了重重财务困境 — — 变得清晰，贝特兰和摩尔斯的研究表明，来自不平等地区的立法者会反对金融部门，保护自己的选民，投票限制“发薪日”贷款人所能获得的利率（他们以极高利率向过度负债的低收入借款人发放贷款 ） 。
en: Indeed, once the unintended consequences of their actions – more financial duress for the non-rich after the crisis – became clear, Bertrand and Morse show that the legislators in unequal districts moved against the financial sector to protect their constituents, voting to set limits on interest rates charged by “payday” lenders (who lend to over-indebted lower-income borrowers at very high interest rates).

zh: 当然，这样的立法也会有不可预知的后果，未来的研究将会有所揭示，但其立法动机是无可置疑的。
en: Of course, such legislation will have unanticipated consequences, which future studies will unearth, but the intent behind it cannot be doubted.

zh: 我们不能因为这些就认定扩大融资的可获得性是件坏事。
en: We should not come away from these episodes thinking that expanding access to finance is bad.

zh: 总的来说，更易获得融资是件好事（只要不是发生在危机之前！
en: In general, expanding access is beneficial (just not before a crisis!), but finance is a powerful tool that has to be used sensibly.

zh: ） ， 但融资这个工具威力太大，必须小心使用，所谓过犹不及是也。
en: Access is good; excess is bad.

zh: 但最重要的一点是，尽管立法的初衷和结果之间存在差别，但与过去相比，现在的立法者更加在乎贫穷选民了。
en: But there is a more important point: while there are many gaps between the intent and consequences of legislation, legislators do seem ultimately to care more about their less-moneyed constituents than they did in the past.

zh: 民主更强大了。
en: Democracy is stronger.

zh: 在这个愤世嫉俗的时代，这一点令人鼓舞。
en: In these cynical times, that is encouraging.

zh: 刚果更美好的未来
en: A Better Future for the Congo

zh: 伦敦—刚果民主共和国（民主刚果）已经成为国家失败的代名词。
en: LONDON – The Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has become synonymous with state failure.

zh: 没有哪个国家承受过比民主刚果更残酷的冲突、更强盗和腐败的政府，或浪费掉更多的资源财富。
en: No country has endured more brutal conflicts, hosted more kleptocratic and corrupt governments, or squandered more resource wealth.

zh: 在困于政治不确定、经济衰退和暴力升级循环的民主刚果，人道灾难成为家常便饭。
en: Trapped in a cycle of political uncertainty, economic recession, and escalating violence, humanitarian disaster has become a way of life.

zh: 但刚果有望拥有更美好的未来。
en: Yet a better future is possible.

zh: 在东倒西歪的鲁巴亚（Rubaya）小学你可以看到希望之光。 这是一座位于与卢旺达接壤的北基伍省郁郁葱葱的山岭中的小镇。
en: At the ramshackle Rubaya primary school, in a small town in the lush green hills of North Kivu province, bordering Rwanda, one gets a glimpse of that possibility.

zh: 儿童们聚精会神地坐在拥挤的教室中，脸上充满了热情、雄心和希望。
en: Children sit attentively in overcrowded classrooms, with enthusiasm, ambition, and hope lighting up their faces.

zh: 13岁的多萝西·贾克提（Dorothy Gakoti）想要成为一名医生。
en: Dorothy Gakoti, aged 13, wants to become a nurse.

zh: “如果我在学校取得成功，就能过上机会更多的更好的生活 — — 可以帮助到我的家庭和社区 ， ” 她说。
en: “If I succeed in school, I can have a better life with more opportunity – and I can help my family and community,” she declares.

zh: 但民主刚果 — — 包括北基伍省 — — 仍然面临艰巨挑战。
en: Yet the DRC – including North Kivu – remains beset with challenges.

zh: 几十个基于种族形成的称为“麦麦 ” （ Mai-Mai）的武装集团大肆抄掠本地人扣。
en: Dozens of ethnically based armed groups called Mai-Mai prey on local populations.

zh: 性暴力（通常针对年轻女童）根深蒂固，得不到充分报告。
en: Sexual violence, often targeting young girls, is as endemic as it is under-reported.

zh: 大约450万儿童营养不良，其中近一半严重不良。
en: Some 4.5 million children are malnourished, almost half of them severely.

zh: 在罹患有生命危险的疾病（如肺炎和疟疾）的儿童中，只有一小半能获得治疗。
en: Less than half of the children who contract potentially deadly diseases like pneumonia and malaria receive treatment.

zh: 更糟糕的是，大约三分之一的民主刚果学龄儿童根本接受不到教育。
en: Making matters worse, about one-quarter of the DRC’s school-age children are not receiving any education at all.

zh: 而那些能够入学的人，学习结果也相当糟糕：多萝西没有自己的课本和铅笔，授课所用的法语她理解起来也很困难。
en: And those who do go to school face abysmal learning outcomes: Dorothy doesn’t have a book or pencil to her name, and she struggles to understand French, the language of instruction.

zh: 但就此认定民主刚果发展失败也是错误的。
en: Yet writing off the DRC as a development failure would be a mistake.

zh: 自2003年灾难性的五年战争结束以来，民主刚果取得了长足的进步。
en: Since the end of a devastating five-year war in 2003, the country has made marked gains.

zh: 三分之二人口的每日生活费用仍不足1.25美元，但贫困和儿童死亡率有所下降，免疫接种率和入学率有所上升。
en: While two-thirds of its people still survive on less than $1.25 per day, poverty and child mortality have fallen, while rates of immunization and school enrollment are rising.

zh: 此外，民主刚果拥有巨大的未发觉经济潜力。
en: Moreover, the DRC has vast untapped economic potential.

zh: 它拥有一大半世界已知钴储量（钴是计算机芯片和锂电池的关键成分）和大约80%的世界钶钽铁矿供应（用于手机和其他设备的抗热金属 ） 。
en: It possesses over half of the world’s known reserves of cobalt (a key component in computer chips and lithium-ion batteries) and around 80% of the world’s supply of coltan (a heat-resistant metal used in mobile phones and other devices).

zh: 民主刚果也是铜、金、锡、钨和钻石的主要生产国。
en: The country is also a major producer of copper, gold, tin, tungsten, and diamonds.

zh: 除此之外，刚果还拥有肥沃的土壤和全世界最大水电潜力之一，它理应成为地区乃至整个非洲的经济强国。
en: Add to that fertile soils and some of the world’s greatest hydro-power potential, and the DRC should be a regional, if not continental, economic powerhouse.

zh: 如何解释民主刚果巨大的经济潜力和悲惨的儿童情况之间的脱节？
en: What explains the disconnect between the DRC’s vast economic potential and the condition of its children?

zh: 首先，政府没有建立税收体系动员卫生和教育方面的公共投资。
en: For starters, the government has failed to create a tax system to mobilize resources for public investment in health and education.

zh: 事实上，民主刚果的岁入-GDP之比位列世界最低行列，外国行为人和本地既得利益在掠夺这个国家。
en: In fact, the DRC has one of the world’s lowest revenue-to-GDP ratios, with foreign actors and local vested interests effectively pillaging the country.

zh: 在约瑟夫·康拉德（Joseph Conrad）的小说《黑暗之心 》 （ Heart of Darkness）中，他写了一个后来被他描述为“最恶劣的争相掠夺，堪称人类良心史的污点”的地方。
en: In his novel Heart of Darkness, set in the DRC, Joseph Conrad wrote about what he later described as “the vilest scramble for loot that ever disfigured the history of human conscience.”

zh: 但即便是康拉德，看到外国矿业投资者过去十年在民主刚果所攫取的巨额收益和极低的税率也会感到骇然。
en: Yet even Conrad would have been aghast at the windfall gains and rock-bottom tax rates that foreign mining investors have secured over the last decade.

zh: 国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行都批评外国矿业投资者获得的交易过于慷慨，尽管它们设计和推动了这些交易。
en: Both the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank have criticized the excessive generosity of the deals provided for foreign investors in mining, despite having designed and pushed them.

zh: 美国财政部指控一家外国投资商通过“不透明的腐败”交易赚取13亿美元 — — 是民主刚果政府卫生总支出的五倍多。
en: The US Treasury Department has accused one foreign investor of gaining $1.3 billion – more than five times total government health financing in the DRC – through “opaque and corrupt” deals.

zh: 政府岁入不足直接体现在公共服务投资不足上。
en: The lack of government revenue is directly reflected in under-investment in public services.

zh: 为罹患疟疾的孩子寻医问药的家长，为孩子的上学奔波的家长，都必须自掏腰包 — — 这对很多家庭来说成为不可能的任务。
en: Parents seeking treatment for a malaria-stricken child, or a place for that child in school, must pay from their own pocket – an impossibility for many.

zh: 鲁巴亚小学的教室已然拥挤不堪，但与我交谈的每一位民主刚果儿童家里都有辍学的兄弟姐妹，因为家里供不起每学期10美元的学费。
en: As crowded as the Rubaya primary school’s classrooms are, every child I spoke to there had a sibling not attending school, because their family couldn’t cover the fees – around $10 per term.

zh: 政治动荡进一步干扰了发展措施。
en: Political turbulence has further disrupted development efforts.

zh: 总统卡比拉应该在2016年要求举行选举，但如今选举排到了2018年12月 — — 选举的推迟加剧了仇恨，也刺激了暴力。
en: The election that President Joseph Kabila was supposed to have called in 2016 is now scheduled for December 2018 – a delay that has intensified grievances and spurred violence.

zh: 去年，大约两百万民主刚果人 — — 其中一半住在此前和平的中部省份开赛 — — 被迫逃离家园。
en: Last year, some two million people in the DRC, half of them in the previously peaceful central province of Kasai, were forced to flee their homes.

zh: 在国内流离的总人数目前已高达450万 — — 仅次于目前处于冲突中的叙利亚 — — 另有750,000人逃往邻国。
en: The total number of internally displaced people now stands at 4.5 million – second only to Syria in current conflicts – while another 750,000 have fled to neighboring countries.

zh: 这些流离失所者和难民生活在令人绝望的条件中，无法获得充足的住所、营养和保健，也几乎无法获得教育。
en: These displaced people and refugees are living in desperate conditions, without adequate shelter, nutrition, and health care, and with virtually no access to education.

zh: 每年，民主刚果都有150万工人进入劳动力市场，提高他们的生产率、为他们创造就业岗位是让民主刚果走向与过去不同、充满希望的道路的必要条件。
en: Boosting productivity and creating jobs for the more than 1.5 million workers entering the labor market each year are essential to put the DRC on a different, more hopeful path.

zh: 在这方面，教育至关重要。
en: Here, education is critical.

zh: 每多读一年书，都能增加9%的收入。
en: Each additional year of schooling is associated with a 9% increase in income.

zh: 因此，扩大学习机会将大大降低贫困，特别是考虑到民主刚果有近一半的人口不到15岁。
en: Expanded opportunities for learning would thus go a long way toward reducing poverty, especially given that almost half of the DRC’s population is under 15 years of age.

zh: 但改善教育普及必须辅之以减轻儿童营养不良和改善健康状况的战略。
en: But improved access to education must go hand in hand with strategies to combat child malnutrition and poor health.

zh: 全民教育和全民医疗是民主刚果儿童赢得更美好的未来的关键。
en: Education for all and universal health provision hold the key to a better future for DRC’s children.

zh: 要取得进步，下届政府必须迫切采取行动构建税基。
en: Progress will require the next government to take urgent action to build a tax base.

zh: 更紧急的是，除非今年就制定出有效应对民主刚果日益升级的人道危机的措施，否则损失将十分惨重 — — 并且受难的将不仅仅是民主刚果本身。
en: More immediately, unless an effective response to the DRC’s escalating humanitarian crisis is mounted this year, the level of suffering will be immense – and not just in the country itself.

zh: 邻国对此都十分清楚，民主刚果发生的一切不会仅限于民主刚果。
en: As neighboring countries know all too well, what happens in the DRC often doesn’t stay in the DRC.

zh: 本周将在日内瓦召开一次紧急峰会，出资国应借此机会遏制最糟糕情形，提供17亿美元 — — 联合国所估算的有效应对所需要的资金。
en: An emergency summit planned for this week in Geneva is an opportunity for donors to stave off the worst, by providing the $1.7 billion the United Nations estimates an effective response will require.

zh: 这需要出资国不再短视且错误地认为民主刚果已经不可挽回，相反，它们应该帮助民主刚果构建民主刚果儿童理应得到的未来。
en: That will require donors to abandon their short-sighted and wrong-headed perceptions of the DRC as a lost cause, and instead help the country build the future that its children deserve.

zh: 民主战胜恐怖
en: Democracy Trumps Terrorism

zh: 伦敦 — — 那天我漫步巴黎街头时，空气是暖的，天是蓝的，我感觉我置身其中的世界是最美好的。
en: LONDON – As I strolled through Paris the other day, the air was warm, the sky was blue, and I felt like I was in the best of all possible worlds.

zh: 像往常一样，巴黎看起来十分优雅，散发出快乐和自信。
en: As always, Paris looked elegant and exuded confidence and cheerfulness.

zh: 法国刚刚选出了一位聪明、年轻、帅气、勇敢的新总统，似乎与这座城市的气质非常配合。
en: France had just elected a clever, young, handsome, and brave new president, who seemed to match the city’s ambience.

zh: 没有令生活变得灰暗的坏消息，我完全有理由迈着轻快的脚步。
en: Without much bad news to darken the day, I had every reason to walk with a spring in my step.

zh: 当然，情况可能会有很大不同。
en: Of course, things could have been very different.

zh: 仅仅18个月前，一次对巴黎的恐袭造成130人死亡，数百人受伤。
en: It was just 18 months ago that a terrorist attack in Paris left 130 people dead and hundreds more injured.

zh: 去年7月在尼斯，一名袭击者在法国国庆日当天驾驶一辆卡车穿过这座城市的海滨长廊，杀死86人。
en: Last July in Nice, an attacker drove a truck through a Bastille Day crowd on the city’s seafront promenade, killing 86.

zh: 其后不久，一名歹徒在诺曼底的一间教堂里割开了一位年长牧师的喉咙。
en: Not long after that, an assailant slit an elderly priest’s throat at a church in Normandy.

zh: 上个月，就在第二轮法国总统选举之前，一名警察在香榭丽舍大街被枪杀。
en: And last month, just before the second round of the French presidential election, a policeman was gunned down on the Champs-Élysées.

zh: 这些邪恶之举发端于对一种伟大宗教的曲解，却并没有阻止法国选民选出伊曼纽尔·马克龙，这位年轻人知道要想保持警惕就要给予所有社会成员应有的尊重。
en: These wicked acts, stemming from a distorted interpretation of a great religion, did not stop French voters from electing Emmanuel Macron, a man who knows that vigilance requires us to respect all members of our community.

zh: 要想打败邪恶，我们必须反对排斥和仇恨，而且我们决不能玷污社会中很大部分人的名声。
en: To fight evil, we must reject exclusion and hate, and we must not blacken the reputation of a large segment of our society.

zh: 最近一件事让我想起了这个教训，当时我乘坐一辆出租车从巴黎市中心去往巴黎北站。
en: I was reminded of this lesson recently, on a taxi ride from central Paris to the Gare du Nord.

zh: 司机在抱怨来自优步的竞争后（伦敦的出租司机也常有类似的抱怨 ） ， 继续诅咒这个世界和其中所有的人和事。
en: The driver, after complaining about the competition from Uber (a familiar refrain from London taxi drivers, too), went on to denounce the world and everything in it.

zh: 他声称全球化和大规模移民正在摧毁工作，压垮公共服务，破坏法国的民族认同感并且滋生恐怖分子。
en: He claimed that globalization and mass immigration are destroying jobs, overwhelming public services, compromising French national identity, and breeding terrorists.

zh: 勿需多言，这位司机刚刚把票投给了马琳·勒庞 — — 尽管他看起来并不像是国民阵线口中所谓“血统纯正”的法国人。
en: Needless to say, the driver had voted for Marine Le Pen – although he did not look like what the National Front would call a “pureblooded” Frenchman.

zh: 当然，多数法国人投票与他相反。
en: Of course, most of France voted the other way.

zh: 而且尽管这位司机的不满仍有很大市场，但他们却无法实事求是地连贯解决今天所出现的问题。
en: And while the driver’s grievances still have wide currency, they do not represent a coherent, fact-based approach to today’s problems.

zh: 就像我们在曼彻斯特袭击中再次见证的那样，英国同样面临着自己的恐怖主义威胁。 我的祖父母曾在这座英国西北部城市担任校长，这里也是我父亲的出生地。
en: Britain faces its own terrorist threats, as we have seen yet again with the horrendous attack in Manchester, the northwestern city where my grandparents were head teachers, and where my father was born.

zh: 到目前为止，死亡人数累计达到22人，其中很多人是儿童。 这使得曼彻斯特体育馆恐袭事件成为造成52人死亡的2005年7月伦敦地铁爆炸案之后英国最严重的恐怖事件。
en: So far, the death toll stands at 22, many of them children, making the attack on the Manchester Arena Britain’s worst encounter with terrorism since the London Underground bombings in July 2005, which killed 52.

zh: 其后也曾发生过小规模的类似事件。
en: There have been similar but smaller-scale incidents since then.

zh: 而且，过去几十年，伦敦及其他城市（包括1996年的曼彻斯特）都曾遭受过爱尔兰民族主义武装分子的恐怖袭击。
en: And, in previous decades, London and other cities (including Manchester in 1996) withstood attacks by Irish nationalist militants.

zh: 但英国人像法国人一样，并未惊慌失措或者不假思索地做出反应。
en: And yet Britons, like the French, have not panicked or responded in a knee-jerk fashion.

zh: 我们仍旧愿意生活在自由和开放的社会，因此，我们的反应一向平和而坚定。
en: We continue to prefer living in free and open societies, so we have always reacted with calm and measured resolve.

zh: 这种坚定是民主的优势之一。
en: That resolve is one of the strengths of democracy.

zh: 我们决不会把政治议程拱手让给那些只会简单喊喊口号、论据粗糙而且政策极端的人。
en: We will never hand the political agenda over to those who offer only simplistic slogans, crude arguments, and extreme policies.

zh: 那些想要把我们的问题强加给“别人 ” — —以种族、民族、宗教或国籍做为区分方式 — — 的人永远都是少数。
en: Those who want to pin their problems on “the other” – as defined by race, ethnicity, religion, or nationality – will always be in the minority.

zh: 他们的目标是封锁人们的思维和心灵。
en: Their goal is to close hearts and minds.

zh: 他们既无兴趣了解暴力的成因，也无兴趣找到有效的方式来加以解决。
en: They have no interest in understanding the causes of violence, or in developing effective ways to address them.

zh: 民主的良好意识部分基于国家利益高于党派的理解。
en: The good sense of democracies is based, in part, on the understanding that country matters more than party.

zh: 在民主国家，有效的决策依赖于理性和妥协。
en: In democracies, effective policymaking rests on compromise and reason.

zh: 我们生活在民主国家的人不会接受恐吓放弃平衡温和的信念，因为我们理解多数社会某些深层次的东西：即生存与死亡相比我们总是选择生存。
en: Those of us who live in democracies will not be terrorized into discarding our sense of balance and moderation, because we understand something profound about most societies: life always wins over death.

zh: 虽然的确存在所谓的原罪 — — 暗中积蓄、爆发、伤害年轻人及其家人和朋友的邪恶 — — 但原善同样存在，并且总能在恐怖分子的暴行后表现出来。
en: Although there is such a thing as original sin – the wickedness that simmers, blows up, and scars young children and their family and friends – there is also original virtue, which is always present after terrorist atrocities.

zh: 我们看到停下脚步伸出援手的路人；救护伤者的护士和医生；失踪人员搜索者，还有人留宿受害者的家人，或者将人们从大规模屠杀的现场护送回家中。
en: It is manifested in the passers-by who stop to help; in the nurses and doctors who attend to the injured; and in those who search for the lost, offer families a bed for the night, or escort people home from the scene of a mass murder.

zh: 那些策划恐怖行为的人也许永远不会明白他们的事业不会成功。
en: The people who plan and commit terrorist acts will probably never learn that theirs is a lost cause.

zh: 未来进一步的攻击无疑会在开放社会中继续发生。
en: Open societies will undoubtedly have to withstand further assaults in the future.

zh: 但如果有一点明确，那就是恐怖分子无法击垮民主制度。
en: But if one thing is clear, it is that terrorists cannot defeat democracy.

zh: 在法国，选民刚刚出于希望而非绝望选出了一位新总统；而在英国，我们将很快在6月举行又一次自由公正的选举。
en: In France, voters just elected a new president out of hope, not despair; and in the UK, we will soon hold another free and fair election in June.

zh: 民主将会经受住像曼彻斯特恐袭那样的袭击，而民主国家的公民将会以勇气和慷慨的姿态做出回应。
en: Democracy will withstand attacks like the one in Manchester; and democratic citizens will respond with courage and generosity.

zh: 人工智能的民主化
en: Democratizing Artificial Intelligence

zh: 发自牛津 — — 人工智能是下一个技术前沿，而且具备缔造或打破世界秩序的潜力。
en: OXFORD – Artificial Intelligence is the next technological frontier, and it has the potential to make or break the world order.

zh: 人工智能革命既可以让“数十亿底层民众”摆脱贫困，让那些失去效能的机构得以革新，也有可能加剧社会不公，导致不平等状况恶化。
en: The AI revolution could pull the “bottom billion” out of poverty and transform dysfunctional institutions, or it could entrench injustice and increase inequality.

zh: 而最终的结果将取决于我们如何引导这些未来的变革。
en: The outcome will depend on how we manage the coming changes.

zh: 不幸的是，人们在引导技术革命方面一直都表现拙劣。
en: Unfortunately, when it comes to managing technological revolutions, humanity has a rather poor track record.

zh: 以互联网为例，它对世界各地的社会都产生了巨大的影响，也改变了我们的沟通，工作和消闲方式，但同时也搅乱了一些经济部门，强行变革了一些长期存在的商业模式，还创造了几个全新的行业。
en: Consider the Internet, which has had an enormous impact on societies worldwide, changing how we communicate, work, and occupy ourselves. And it has disrupted some economic sectors, forced changes to long-established business models, and created a few entirely new industries.

zh: 但互联网并未带来许多人预期的全面转型，当然没能解决诸如消灭贫困或者送人类到达火星等重大问题。
en: But the Internet has not brought the kind of comprehensive transformation that many anticipated.

zh: 正如在线支付系统PayPal的联合创始人彼得·蒂耶（Peter Thiel）曾经指出的那样 ： “ 我们本想要能飞的汽车；谁知却最终收到了140个推特字符。
en: It certainly didn’t resolve the big problems, such as eradicating poverty or enabling us to reach Mars. As PayPal co-founder Peter Thiel once noted: “We wanted flying cars; instead, we got 140 characters.”

zh: 事实上，在某些方面互联网甚至令我们的某些问题更加恶化。
en: In fact, in some ways, the Internet has exacerbated our problems.

zh: 它在为普通人创造了机会的同时也为最富有和最强大的人创造了更多的机会。
en: While it has created opportunities for ordinary people, it has created even more opportunities for the wealthiest and most powerful.

zh: 伦敦政治经济学院研究人员最近发布的一项研究显示，互联网其实加剧了不平等，那些受过高等教育的高收入人士从网络上获取了最大的好处，一些跨国企业以此实现了大幅增长 — — 但同时却逃避了应该承担的责任。
en: A recent study by researchers at the LSE reveals that the Internet has increased inequality, with educated, high-income people deriving the greatest benefits online and multinational corporations able to grow massively – while evading accountability.

zh: 即便如此，人工智能革命或许可以实现我们所需的变革。
en: Perhaps, though, the AI revolution can deliver the change we need.

zh: 人工智能 — — 其重点是推进机器的认知能力，使它们可以自我“学习 ” — —已经重塑了我们的生活。
en: Already, AI – which focuses on advancing the cognitive functions of machines so that they can “learn” on their own – is reshaping our lives.

zh: 人们以此推出了自动驾驶汽车（虽然还不会飞 ） ， 以及虚拟的个人助理甚至自动攻击的武器。
en: It has delivered self-driving (though still not flying) cars, as well as virtual personal assistants and even autonomous weapons.

zh: 但这还只不过是人工智能潜力的一点表象，而它最终可能会产生我们还未能完全理解的社会，经济和政治变革。
en: But this barely scratches the surface of AI’s potential, which is likely to produce societal, economic, and political transformations that we cannot yet fully comprehend.

zh: 人工智能不会成为新的行业；而是会渗透并永久改变现有的所有行业。
en: AI will not become a new industry; it will penetrate and permanently alter every industry in existence.

zh: 人工智能不会改变人的生命；而是将改变人作为人的界限和意义。
en: AI will not change human life; it will change the boundaries and meaning of being human.

zh: 这一转变将如何以及何时发生 — — 以及如何引导其深远的影响 — — 是让学者和政策制定者们碾转反侧的问题。
en: How and when this transformation will happen – and how to manage its far-reaching effects – are questions that keep scholars and policymakers up at night.

zh: 有些人觉得人工智能时代是天堂，人类所有的问题都告解决，有些人担心会诞下一个反乌托邦，人们的生存反过来遭到其创造物的威胁。
en: Expectations for the AI era range from visions of paradise, in which all of humanity’s problems have been solved, to fears of dystopia, in which our creation becomes an existential threat.

zh: 对科学突破的预测是极为困难的。
en: Making predictions about scientific breakthroughs is notoriously difficult.

zh: 1933年9月11日，知名核物理学家卢瑟福爵士对大批听众指出 ： “ 任何希望从原子反应中寻找能源来源的人都是在说瞎话 ” 。
en: On September 11, 1933, the famed nuclear physicist Lord Rutherford told a large audience, “Anyone who looks for a source of power in the transformation of the atoms is talking moonshine.”

zh: 谁知第二天早晨，物理学家里奥·西拉德（Leo Szilard）就推导出了一个由中子诱导的链式核反应理论；此后不久，他就申请了核反应堆的专利。
en: The next morning, Leo Szilard hypothesized the idea of a neutron-induced nuclear chain reaction; soon thereafter, he patented the nuclear reactor.

zh: 对许多人来说，错误在于假设新的技术突破必定大幅抛离过去的成就。
en: The problem, for some, is the assumption that new technological breakthroughs are incomparable to those in the past.

zh: 例如许多学者，专家和实践者都赞同谷歌母公司Alphabet执行主席埃里克·施密特（Eric Sc​​hmidt）的说法，认为技术现象具有人类“无法理解”也不应该去“扰乱”的一系列固有特性。
en: Many scholars, pundits, and practitioners would agree with Alphabet Executive Chairman Eric Schmidt that technological phenomena have their own intrinsic properties, which humans “don’t understand” and should not “mess with.”

zh: 其他人则可能犯下相反的错误，过度沉溺于历史的类比之中。
en: Others may be making the opposite mistake, placing too much stock in historical analogies.

zh: 在这些人之中，科技作家和研究者叶夫根尼·莫洛佐夫（Evgeny Morozov）预计会出现一定程度的路径依赖，目前的话语论述会塑造我们对技术未来的思考，从而影响了技术的发展走向。
en: The technology writer and researcher Evgeny Morozov, among others, expects some degree of path dependence, with current discourses shaping our thinking about the future of technology, thereby influencing technology’s development.

zh: 但未来的技术其实可能会影响我们的叙事，并创造出一种自我强化的循环。
