en: In 2013, Russian chief of the general staff Valery Gerasimov described a doctrine for hybrid warfare that blends conventional weapons, economic coercion, information operations, and cyber attacks.

zh: 在冷战期间，信息就被大规模用于迷惑和分化敌人。
en: The use of information to confuse and divide an enemy was widely practiced during the Cold War.

zh: 如今基本的模式并未改变，改善的只是传播虚假信息的速度和成本。
en: What is new is not the basic model, but the high speed and low cost of spreading disinformation.

zh: 相对于那些携带大量现金和机密的传统间谍，电子手段更快，更廉价，更安全，也不容易被抓住把柄。
en: Electrons are faster, cheaper, safer, and more deniable than spies carrying around bags of money and secrets.

zh: 如果俄罗斯总统普京认为自己的国家已经陷入与美国的斗争中，但又碍于核战争的风险而无法使用高水平的武力，那么也许网络就是件“完美武器 ” 。
en: If Russian President Vladimir Putin sees his country as locked in a struggle with the United States but is deterred from using high levels of force by the risk of nuclear war, then perhaps cyber is the “perfect weapon.”

zh: 而这正是《纽约时报》记者大卫·桑格（David Sanger）的重量级新书的书名，他认为除了“常常用来破坏银行，数据库和电网”之外，网络攻击“还可以用来腐蚀统合民主本身的公民理念。 ”
en: That is the title of an important new book by New York Times reporter David Sanger, who argues that beyond being “used to undermine more than banks, databases, and electrical grids,” cyberattacks “can be used to fray the civic threads that hold together democracy itself.”

zh: 俄罗斯在2016年美国总统大选中实施的网络干扰相当具有创新性。
en: Russia’s cyber interference in the 2016 American presidential election was innovative.

zh: 俄罗斯情报机构不仅破解了民主党全国委员会的电子邮箱，还通过维基解密和其他网站一点一点地释放消息来塑造美国新闻议程；他们还利用美国的社交媒体平台传播虚假新闻并激化对立的美国人群体。
en: Not only did Russian intelligence agencies hack into the email of the Democratic National Committee and dribble out the results through Wikileaks and other outlets to shape the American news agenda; they also used US-based social-media platforms to spread false news and galvanize opposing groups of Americans.

zh: 黑客攻击是非法行为，但使用社交媒体去散播混乱则不然。
en: Hacking is illegal, but using social media to sow confusion is not.

zh: 而俄罗斯信息战创新的高明之处就在于将现有技术与在一定程度上撇清关系 — — 同时又稍稍低于公开攻击的门槛 — — 的能力相结合。
en: The brilliance of the Russian innovation in information warfare was to combine existing technologies with a degree of deniability that remained just below the threshold of overt attack.

zh: 美国情报机构曾就俄方这一策略向奥巴马提出警示，而总统则在2016年9月与普京会面时警告对方不要贸然行事。
en: US intelligence agencies alerted President Barack Obama of the Russian tactics, and he warned Putin of adverse consequences when the two met in September 2016.

zh: 因奥巴马担心俄罗斯会将攻击升级，破坏选举设施或投票设备，进而危及希拉里的胜选，所以不愿公开抨击俄方或采取强硬行动。
en: But Obama was reluctant to call out Russia publicly or to take strong actions for fear that Russia would escalate by attacking election machinery or voting rolls and jeopardize the expected victory of Hillary Clinton.

zh: 大选结束后，奥巴马立刻将此事公之于众，驱逐了一批俄罗斯间谍还关闭了一些外交设施，但美方应对的弱点抵消了任何阻吓作用。
en: After the election, Obama went public and expelled Russian spies and closed some diplomatic facilities, but the weakness of the US response undercut any deterrent effect.

zh: 而由于特朗普总统将这个问题视为对其胜选合法性的政治挑战，他的政府也未能采取有力措施。
en: And because President Donald Trump has treated the issue as a political challenge to the legitimacy of his victory, his administration also failed to take strong steps.

zh: 打击这种新武器需要制定一项战略，以组织包括所有政府机构在内的广泛国家级应对行动，并强调实施更有效的威慑。
en: Countering this new weapon requires a strategy to organize a broad national response that includes all government agencies and emphasizes more effective deterrence.

zh: 惩罚可以通过有针对性的报复在网络领域内进行，并通过实施更强有力的经济和个人制裁来实施领域外惩罚。
en: Punishment can be meted out within the cyber domain by tailored reprisals, and across domains by applying stronger economic and personal sanctions.

zh: 我们还需要实施抵消性威慑 — — 令攻击者的工作成本高于其所获得的收益。
en: We also need deterrence by denial – making the attacker’s work more costly than the value of the benefits to be reaped.

zh: 有许多方法可以令美国成为一个更坚固也更具复原能力的目标。
en: There are many ways to make the US a tougher and more resilient target.

zh: 所采取的步骤包括对州和地方选举官员进行培训；要求使用纸质记录作为电子投票机的备份；鼓励选举策划者和各党派使用加密和双因素认证等措施来改善网络环境；与企业合作消灭社交媒体机器人；要求核实政治广告的信息源（正如在电视上那样 ） ； 禁止外国发布政治广告；推动独立的事实核查；还有就是提高公众的媒体素养。
en: Steps include training state and local election officials; requiring a paper trail as a back-up to electronic voting machines; encouraging campaigns and parties to improve basic cyber hygiene such as encryption and two-factor authentication; working with companies to exclude social media bots; requiring identification of the sources of political advertisements (as now occurs on television); outlawing foreign political advertising; promoting independent fact-checking; and improving the public’s media literacy.

zh: 上述这些措施都成功限制了俄罗斯对2017年法国总统大选的干预。
en: Such measures helped to limit the success of Russian intervention in the 2017 French presidential election.

zh: 在这方面外交也可以发挥作用。
en: Diplomacy might also play a role.

zh: 即使美苏在冷战期间是针锋相对的意识形态死敌，但双方也能够谈判达成协议。
en: Even when the US and the Soviet Union were bitter ideological enemies during the Cold War, they were able to negotiate agreements.

zh: 鉴于俄罗斯政治制度的威权性质，所谓不干涉俄罗斯选举的承诺可能毫无意义。
en: Given the authoritarian nature of the Russian political system, it could be meaningless to agree not to interfere in Russian elections.

zh: 尽管如此，依然可能建立限制信息攻击强度和频率的规则。
en: Nonetheless, it might be possible to establish rules that limit the intensity and frequency of information attacks.

zh: 在冷战期间，双方都不会处决对方的间谍 ， 《 海上事故协定》也限制了近距离海军监视的骚扰程度。
en: During the Cold War, the two sides did not kill each other’s spies, and the Incidents at Sea Agreement limited the level of harassment involved in close naval surveillance.

zh: 眼下达成此类协议似乎不太可能，但未来值得探讨。
en: Today, such agreements seem unlikely, but they are worth exploring in the future.

zh: 最重要的是，美国必须证明网络攻击和操纵社交媒体是必须付出代价的，因此也无法成为低于武装冲突水平战争的完美武器。
en: Above all, the US must demonstrate that cyber attacks and manipulation of social media will incur costs and thus not remain the perfect weapon for warfare below the level of armed conflict.

zh: 欧洲银行能拯救欧盟吗？
en: Can Europe’s Banks Save the EU?

zh: 纽约—美国政府以德意志银行在美国不正当销售按揭证券为由对其课以数十亿美元罚款，这无助于改善欧盟信心，欧盟信心仍然受到经济增长低迷、失业高企、移民挑战和不确定性积累的影响。
en: NEW YORK – The multi-billion-dollar fine that the US government recently sought to impose on Germany’s Deutsche Bank for mis-selling mortgage securities in the United States has done little to improve confidence in the European Union, which remains plagued by slow economic growth, high unemployment, immigration challenges, and mounting uncertainty.

zh: 德意志银行丑闻让人们得以一瞥有望拯救欧洲工程的最后选择 — — 类似于美式橄榄球中的“万福玛丽亚传球 ” 。
en: What the Deutsche Bank scandal has done is shine a light on a last-resort option – a kind of “Hail Mary pass,” in American football terms – that could potentially save the European project.

zh: 欧元区占世界GDP的20%左右，但在FT500全球排名前十大银行和金融服务机构中难觅欧元区踪影。
en: Despite representing around 20% of world GDP, the eurozone does not have a top-ten bank or financial services institution in the FT 500 global ranking.

zh: 银行系统如此分散脆弱的连带效应淋漓尽致地表现在欧洲其他对欧盟成员国经济未来至关重要的行业的拙劣表现中，如技术和能源行业。
en: The knock-on effects of such a fragmented and vulnerable banking system are apparent in Europe’s relatively poor showing in other sectors, such as technology and energy, that are vital for EU members’ economic future.

zh: 欧洲不缺银行：德国有1,500多家银行，意大利也有600多家。
en: Europe has no shortage of banks: Germany has more than 1,500, and Italy has over 600.

zh: 但许多银行属于所谓的“僵尸银行 ” ， 分行众多，存款稀少，融资成本远超成功的同行。
en: But many are “zombie banks,” with too many branches, too few deposits, and funding costs that far exceed those of their more successful peers.

zh: 事实上，据国际货币基金组织（IMF ） ， 欧洲银行业有三分之一 — — 持有价值8.5万亿美元的资产 — — 仍然孱弱不堪，无法产生可持续利润。
en: In fact, according to the International Monetary Fund, some one-third of Europe’s banking sector, representing assets worth $8.5 trillion, remains weak and unable to generate sustainable profits.

zh: 所有这些给欧盟经济以及整个欧洲政治实验造成了巨大的失败风险。
en: All of this creates significant downside risks for the EU economy and, ultimately, the entire European political experiment.

zh: 据IMF自身的测算，重塑欧洲银行系统稳定要让至少三分之一的欧洲银行关门或合并。
en: Restoring stability in Europe’s banking system, by the IMF’s own estimate, will require at least one-third of Europe's banks to close or merge.

zh: 至于德意志银行，市场投机者似乎已经预测将发生合并，比如与另一家德国机构德商银行（Commerzbank）合并。
en: For Deutsche Bank, market speculators already seem to be expecting a merger, such as with Commerzbank, another German institution.

zh: 但如果要让这样的合并成为整合欧洲银行业、强化欧盟的第一步，那么需要进行跨国合并，德意志银行要与法国和/或意大利主要金融机构合并。
en: But, if such a merger is to be the first step toward consolidating the European banking sector and strengthening the EU, it should be a cross-border affair, bringing Deutsche Bank together with a significant French and/or Italian financial institution.

zh: 这一方针可以成为欧洲政治信誉的局面改变因素，而政治信誉也许是维持欧盟梦最关键的东西。
en: Such an approach could be a game changer in terms of the EU’s political credibility, which is perhaps most crucial to keeping the EU dream alive.

zh: 跨国欧洲银行合并能带来诸多好处。
en: A cross-border European bank merger would have several benefits.

zh: 与一切合并一样，整合业绩不佳的孱弱银行能让它们强化资产负债表、重组预计高达1万亿欧元、比世界其他地区高出三倍左右的不良贷款，从而有利于整体经济。
en: As with any merger, consolidating weak, underperforming banks would enable them to strengthen their balance sheets and restructure non-performing loans – estimated to be worth some €1 trillion ($1.1 trillion), roughly three times higher than other global jurisdictions – thereby benefiting the wider economy.

zh: 但产生欧洲超级银行的跨国合并在应对长期经营挑战（特别是流动性和资本）方面效果更好。
en: But a cross-border merger that creates a kind of European super-bank would be even more effective in addressing perennial operational challenges (in particular, liquidity and capital).

zh: 更重要的是，此类金融重组能够打开对投资融资和推动经济增长至关重要的信用渠道。
en: More important, this type of financial restructuring would open credit channels that are vital to fund investment and drive economic growth.

zh: 跨国欧洲合并还能让世界经济的关键地区拥有一家与其全球重要性相符的银行。
en: A cross-border European merger would also give a key region of the world economy a bank that is commensurate with its global importance.

zh: 顶级欧洲大银行将拥有大得多的全球竞争力，挑战美资银行的主宰。
en: A European banking champion would be far more competitive globally, rivaling the brawn of America’s dominant banks.

zh: 建立这样一家机构在今天尤其紧迫，因为全世界许多国家都在日益拒绝经济开放，采取保护主义政策和各自为政的监管。
en: Creating such an institution is particularly urgent today, given that many countries worldwide seem to be increasingly rejecting economic openness in favor of more protectionist policies and balkanized regulation.

zh: 在更加分散、更少全球化的世界中，跨国资本流正在减少 — — 据国际金融研究所的报告，去年新兴市场净资本流入自1998年以来首次出现负值 — — 欧洲银行基础设施需要广化和深化才能实现繁荣。
en: In a more fragmented, less globalized world, where cross-border capital flows are declining – last year, the Institute of International Finance reports, net capital flows for emerging markets were negative for the first time since 1988 – Europe’s banking infrastructure will need to become broader and deeper in order to thrive.

zh: 跨国合并可以成为拯救欧洲银行业的关键的第三个也许也是最重要的原因是这将向市场参与者和欧洲公民释放出信号，政治领导人仍将致力于欧洲一体化。
en: The third – and perhaps most important – reason why cross-border mergers might be the key to saving Europe’s banking sector is that they would signal to market participants and European citizens alike that political leaders are committed to European integration.

zh: 同样的，政治和经济背景让这一动作变得更加迫切。
en: Again, the political and economic backdrop intensifies the urgency of such a move.

zh: 财政一体化进展陷入停滞。
en: Progress toward fiscal integration has stalled.

zh: 国家日程常常被置于合作之上。
en: National agendas have often taken priority over cooperation.

zh: 英国即将开始完全脱离欧盟的谈判 — — 这一决定完全可以看成是对欧洲当前一体化模式的控诉。
en: And the United Kingdom is set to start negotiating its way out of the EU altogether – a decision that can reasonably be viewed as an indictment of Europe’s current integration model.

zh: 从金融市场和投资者的角度看，跨国合并可视为利好，刺激信心。
en: From the perspective of financial markets and investors, a cross-border merger would be viewed bullishly, boosting confidence.

zh: 即使对普通公民而言，任何欧盟并没有走向分裂的信号都将带来巨大的好处，为高度不确定的环境营造安全感。
en: Even for ordinary citizens, any indication that the EU is not simply going to fall apart would carry major benefits, offering some semblance of assurance in a highly uncertain environment.

zh: 平心而论，跨国合并是一个激进的方案。
en: To be sure, a cross-border merger is a radical proposal.

zh: 要聚集其所需要的政治意愿绝非易事。
en: The amount of political will it would require will not be easy to muster.

zh: 但不入虎穴焉得虎子？
en: But no bold play is ever a sure thing.

zh: 事实是，没有可信而透明的深化联系的证据 — — 不仅包括财政方面，也包括商业和金融（现代经济的基石）方面 — — 欧盟将永远是一个联系松散、信誉并不卓著的国家集合。
en: The truth is that, without credible and transparent evidence of deepening linkages – not just in fiscal matters, but also in business and finance (the backbone of a modern economy) – the EU will remain a loosely connected and not particularly credible collection of countries.

zh: 我们在最近几年中已经看到，这一安排无法解决欧盟成员国的经济问题。
en: As we have seen in the last few years, such an arrangement will not resolve those countries’ economic woes.

zh: 你也许会说，现在不是推动加强一体化的时机。
en: One might argue that now is not the time to push toward greater integration.

zh: 局面太支离破碎，群众反对也太强。
en: The situation is too fragile, and popular opposition is too strong.

zh: 怀疑派会说，哪怕增长能达到中等表现，政治环境也将大大改善。
en: If growth were even middling, skeptics might say, the political environment would be far more amenable.

zh: 但欧盟目前貌合神离的结构无法坚持下去。
en: But the EU’s current disjointed structure will not hold.

zh: 如果不马上采取强力行动，欧盟的裂痕将继续扩大，形成日益强大的政治分歧，最终威胁到整个欧洲工程。
en: If strong action is not taken soon, the cracks will only widen, generating increasingly powerful political discord and, ultimately, dooming the entire European project.

zh: 贬低生命
en: Devaluing Life

zh: 2001年8月，美国总统布什告诉美国人民说，他担心“一种贬低生命的文化 ” ， 而且他相信，作为美国总统，他承担“促进和鼓励在美国和全世界尊重生命的重大责任 ” 。
en: In August 2001, President George W. Bush told Americans that he worried about “a culture that devalues life,” and that he believed that, as President of the United States, he has “an important obligation to foster and encourage respect for life in America and throughout the world.”

zh: 这一信念促使布什否决了为可能鼓励摧毁人类胚胎的干细胞研究提供联邦资助。
en: That belief lay behind Bush’s denial of federal government funds for stem-cell research that could encourage the destruction of human embryos.

zh: 尽管布什政府承认，某些科学家相信干细胞研究可以为影响到1亿2千8百万美国人的疾病提供新的治疗方法，但是在布什看来，这一前景明显地并不为摧毁人类胚胎提供理由。
en: Although the Bush administration acknowledged that some scientists believe stem cell research could offer new ways of treating diseases that affect 128 million Americans, this prospect evidently did not, in Bush’s view, justify destroying human embryos.

zh: 上个月，这位同一个总统所统率的军队把一枚导弹瞄准了一个靠近阿富汗边境的巴基斯坦村庄达马多拉的一个房子。
en: Last month, the military forces that this same president commands aimed a missile at a house in Damadola, a Pakistani village near the Afghanistan border.

zh: 18个人被炸身亡，其中包括5名儿童。
en: Eighteen people were killed, among them five children.

zh: 这次袭击的目标是基地组织二号人物扎瓦赫里。 尽管据报道这一恐怖组织中级别较低的人物被炸身亡，但是他并没有被炸死。
en: The target of the attack, Al Qaeda’s number two man, Ayman al-Zawahiri, was not among the dead, although lesser figures in the terrorist organization reportedly were.

zh: 布什并没有对这一袭击道歉，也没有训斥下令轰炸的人。
en: Bush did not apologize for the attack, nor did he reprimand those who ordered it.

zh: 他明显地相信炸死一个重要的恐怖分子首领的机会就足以为发射几乎肯定会杀死无辜的导弹提供充足的理由。
en: Apparently, he believes that the chance of killing an important terrorist leader is sufficient justification for firing a missile that will almost certainly kill innocent human beings.

zh: 其他美国政客们也持同样立场。
en: Other American politicians took the same stance.

zh: 保守派共和党参议员洛特也是一个知名的反堕胎人士，他评论这场袭击时说 ： “ 我们绝对应当这样做。
en: Senator Trent Lott, a conservative Republican – and a prominent opponent of abortion – said of the attack: “Absolutely, we should do it.”

zh: ”令一名重要的共和党人麦凯恩参议院尽管经常与布什意见相左，还表达对平民死亡的遗憾，但是补充说 ： “ 我不能告诉你我们不会再这样做了。 ”
en: Senator John McCain, another leading Republican, though one often ready to disagree with Bush, expressed regret for the civilian deaths, but added, “I can’t tell you that we wouldn’t do the same thing again.”

zh: 的确，让现今的美国政府说它不会再这样做了是件困难的事情，因为以前它做了很多次。
en: Indeed, it would be hard for the current administration to say that it wouldn’t do the same thing again, because it has done it many times before.

zh: 2001年11月1日，由于一辆塔利班的卡车停放在了街道旁，美国军机轰炸了苏莱曼，那是一群泥瓦房。
en: On November 1, 2001, American planes bombed Ishaq Suleiman, a group of mud huts, because a Taliban truck had been parked in one of the streets.

zh: 卡车在轰炸之前就已经离开，但是12名当地村民被炸死，14人受伤。
en: The truck left before the bomb hit, but 12 local villagers were killed and 14 were injured.

zh: 在阿富汗的战争中，还有许多人死于无辜。
en: There are many more such stories of innocent lives being lost in the war in Afghanistan.

zh: 在伊拉克也是一样，美国的袭击夺去了许多平民的生命。
en: In Iraq, too, American attacks have taken the lives of many civilians.

zh: 这样的例子很多。
en: Again, one of many examples will suffice.

zh: 2003年4月5日，巴士拉的一个平民区域被炸。
en: On April 5, 2003, a civilian neighborhood in Basra was bombed.

zh: 目标是因使用化学武器对付伊拉克人而著称的马基德将军，也叫“化学阿里 ” 。
en: The target was General Ali Hassan al-Majid, known as “Chemical Ali” because of his use of chemical weapons against Iraqis.

zh: 一枚炸弹击中了受人尊重、受过良好教育的哈姆迪家族的房子。 这家人里没有一个属于当权的伊拉克复兴社会党。
en: One bomb hit the home of the Hamoodi family, a respected, educated family, none of whose members belonged to the ruling Baath Party.

zh: 全家14人中，10人被炸死，包括一名婴儿、一个两岁的孩子、一个10岁的男孩以及一个12岁的女孩。
en: Of the extended family of 14, ten were killed, including an infant, a two-year-old baby, a 10-year-old boy, and a 12-year-old girl.

zh: 四个月后，马基德被生擒。 炸弹没有击中他们的预定目标。
en: Four months later, Majid was captured alive; the bombs had missed their intended target.

zh: 这一准备造成平民死亡、而且打击并非具有重大军事意义的目标的一贯模式表明，与人类胚胎相比较，布什以及其他支持生命者美国领导人对在阿富汗、伊拉克以及巴基斯坦的无辜人的生命漠不关心。
en: This consistent pattern of readiness to inflict civilian casualties – often when striking targets that are not of vital military significance – suggests that Bush and other pro-life American leaders have less concern for the lives of innocent human beings in Afghanistan, Iraq, and Pakistan, than they have for human embryos.

zh: 这是一种奇怪的优先重点。
en: This is a bizarre set of priorities.

zh: 没有一个父母会对胚胎损失像孩子死亡那样感到悲痛。
en: No parents grieve for a lost embryo in the way that they would grieve over the death of a child.

zh: 胚胎没有能力痛苦、怀有希望或者对由于死亡而突然中断的未来抱有欲望。
en: No embryos are capable of suffering, or have hopes or desires for the future that are abruptly cut off by their death.

zh: 人们有可能用一种功利主义的推算来给达马多拉无辜平民的死亡提供理由，也就是说，从长远来看，杀死基地组织领导人将会挽救更多数量的无辜百姓。
en: It might be possible to justify the loss of innocent human life in Damadola by a utilitarian calculation that killing Al Qaeda’s leaders will, in the long run, save a larger number of innocent human beings.

zh: 毕竟，如果他们逍遥法外，它们可能会成功地实施进一步的恐怖主义攻击，造成数以千计甚至使数以万计的无辜平民死亡。
en: After all, if they remain at large, they may succeed in carrying out further terrorist attacks that take hundreds or even thousands of innocent lives.

zh: 但是，布什却不能依赖于这一论断，因为这正是在摧毁胚胎、从而在长远上挽救死于目前无药可久的疾病的人的生命问题上他拒绝资助的理由。
en: Bush, however, cannot rely on that argument, for it is precisely the kind of justification that he rejects when it comes to destroying embryos in order to save, in the long run, those dying from diseases for which we currently have no cure.

zh: 其他说教者会说，为研究目的摧毁胚胎和在军事攻击中错杀平民的区别在于，前者是有意的杀戮而后者则是无意的“间接损害 ” ， 是可以预料的、战争行为中的正当的副作用。
en: Other moralists will say that the difference between destroying embryos for research purposes and killing civilians in military attacks is that the former is deliberate killing, whereas the latter deaths are “collateral damage” – unintended, if foreseeable, side-effects of a justifiable act of war.

zh: 我们可以同意，杀死无辜并不是那些规划以及下令在达马多拉袭击的人的根本意图。
en: We can grant that it was not the primary intention of those who planned and authorized the attack on Damadola to kill innocent people.

zh: 我们还可以接受这样的说法，也就是扎瓦赫里是一个危险的敌人，仍然活跃于恐怖主义运动，而且他是一个合法的军事目标。
en: We can also accept that al-Zawahiri is undoubtedly a dangerous foe, still active in a terrorist movement, and that he is a legitimate military target.

zh: 这一特定的袭击可能以这样的理由而站住脚。
en: Perhaps this particular attack can be justified on those grounds.

zh: 但是，采取可能有预料地杀死无辜的行动是可以接受的信条将会产生导致我们理应善待而不不善待被杀身亡的人的结果。
en: Nevertheless, the doctrine that it is acceptable to take actions that will foreseeably kill innocent people can have the effect of leading us to treat more lightly than we should the deaths of those killed.

zh: 这看起来就是发生在美国指挥链中的事情。
en: That, it seems, is what has happened somewhere in the American chain of command.

zh: 一辆塔利班的卡车并不能为轰炸平民正常生活的村庄提供理由。
en: The presence of a Taliban truck does not justify bombing a village in which civilians are going about their daily lives.

zh: “化学阿里”是萨达姆军事精英中的一个特别邪恶的成员，但是他在袭击的时候已经不再指挥军队了。 为了将其草草绳之以法而滥杀无辜是错误的。
en: Killing innocent people in order to bring a kind of rough justice to “Chemical Ali” – a particularly nasty member of Saddam’s military elite, but one who at the time of the raid was no longer in command of military forces – is wrong.

zh: 这种允许甚至是赞同此类战术的文化并不是真心真意地致力于鼓励尊重生命。
en: A culture that allows – and even endorses – such tactics is not one that is genuinely committed to encouraging respect for life.

zh: 我们可以相当确信，如果周围的平民是美国人的话，美国军队是不会以同样的方式行动的。
en: We can be quite sure that American forces would not have acted in the same way if the civilians nearby had been other Americans.

zh: 破解生产力难题
en: Understanding the Productivity Puzzle

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 一直以来，所谓的生产力难题都困扰着各主要经济体的经济学家和政策制定者们：当前的每小时产出显著低于（如果2008年前的增长趋势持续）所应该达到的水平。
en: LONDON – In all major economies, the so-called productivity puzzle continues to perplex economists and policymakers: output per hour is significantly lower than it would have been had the pre-2008 growth trend continued.

zh: 这些数字在经合组织国家中相当碍眼，而英国尤甚。
en: The figures are stark, particularly so in the United Kingdom, but also across the OECD.

zh: 当然经济学家早已对此提出了许多精妙的解释，但仍然没有一个能具备足够说服力以达成共识。
en: And while it goes without saying that economists have many ingenious explanations to offer, none has yet proved persuasive enough to create a consensus.

zh: 据英国国家统计署统计，2015年法国的每小时产出比以前正常趋势增长率下应得的产出水平低了14 ％ 。
en: According to the UK’s Office for National Statistics, output per hour in France was 14% lower in 2015 than it would have been had the previously normal trend growth rate been matched.

zh: 美国低了9 ％ ， 德国低了8 ％ ， 但两国已经是发达经济体中表现最好的国家了（尽管只是相对而言 ） 。
en: Output was 9% lower in the United States and 8% lower in Germany, which has remained the top performer among developed economies, albeit only in relative terms.

zh: 如果这个新的较低增长率持续下去，到2021年美国人的平均收入将比自1945年以来保持的约2％的年度生产力增长率下的收入水平低16 ％ 。
en: If this new, lower growth rate persists, by 2021 average incomes in the US will be 16% lower than they would have been had the US maintained the roughly 2% annual productivity gain experienced since 1945.

zh: 而英国体现出的是关于该综合征的一项特殊慢性症状。
en: The UK exhibits a particularly chronic case of the syndrome.

zh: 2007年英国的生产率比经合组织的平均水平低9 ％ ， 到2015年，这一差距扩大到18 ％ 。
en: British productivity was 9% below the OECD average in 2007; by 2015, the gap had widened to 18%.

zh: 令人震惊的是，英国的每小时生产力比德国低35 ％ ， 比美国低30 ％ ， 即便法国人都可以在周五休假的情况下达到英国工人一周的平均生产水平。
en: Strikingly, UK productivity per hour is fully 35% below the German level, and 30% below that of the US. Even the French could produce the average British worker’s output in a week, and still take Friday off.

zh: 由此看来，除了影响所有发达经济体的因素之外，英国的管理尤为薄弱。
en: It would seem that, in addition to the factors affecting all developed economies, the UK has particularly weak management.

zh: 人们已经认识到促成该状况的一些因素。
en: Some contributing factors are generally acknowledged.

zh: 在金融危机及其余波期间，虽然银行的资本重建遏制了新贷款的发放，但超低利率使一些企业得以幸存，于是它们的管理层选择留用员工，尽管因此会拉低回报。
en: During the crisis and its immediate aftermath, when banks’ efforts to rebuild capital constrained new lending, ultra-low interest rates kept some firms’ heads above water, and their managers retained employees, despite making a relatively low return.

zh: 另一方面，生产力更高的新创新企业却面临着难以筹集增长所需资本的局面，所以它们要么选择停止扩张，要么选择用劳动力取代资本的方式来实现扩张。
en: On the other hand, new, more productive, and innovative firms found it hard to raise the capital they needed to grow, so they either did not expand, or did so by substituting labor for capital.

zh: 换句话说，低利率让那些负债累累的僵尸企业得以苟延残喘，从而拉低了生产力水平。
en: In other words, low interest rates held productivity down by allowing heavily indebted zombie companies to survive for longer than they otherwise would have done.

zh: 英国央行已经承认这方面的有所取舍，如果能在危急恢复阶段将利率上调至危机前水平，英国的生产力水平将比当前高出1~3 % ， 但问题在于他们无法接受因此产生的后果 — — 收入增长放缓和失业率上升。
en: The Bank of England has acknowledged that trade-off, estimating that productivity would have been 1-3% higher in the UK had it raised interest rates to pre-crisis levels in the recovery phase. But they believe the consequences – slower income growth and higher unemployment – would have been unacceptable.

zh: 这个论点现在已经超出了银行体系，扩展到了资本市场本身。
en: This argument has now been extended beyond the banking system, to the capital markets themselves.

zh: 中央银行的批评者声称，大规模量化宽松政策推动下的持续低利率政策使得资产价格普遍无差别上涨。
en: Critics of central banks have claimed that a sustained policy of exceptionally low interest rates, reinforced by huge doses of quantitative easing, have caused asset prices to rise indiscriminately.

zh: 这不仅对财富分配产生负面影响；也降低了资本市场将高生产力高潜力企业和其他本应破产企业区分开来的能力。
en: That has not only had adverse consequences for the distribution of wealth; it has also muted the ability of capital markets to distinguish between productive, high-potential firms and others that deserve to fail.

zh: 根据这一观点，这场大潮让某些不适合航海的船只都漂浮起来了。
en: According to this view, a rising tide lifts even fundamentally unseaworthy boats.

zh: 这个论点有一定的解释力，虽然其没有解释高薪资产管理人员的附加值，以及这些人的投资是否只是基于货币政策对相对价格的影响，而毫不关心个别公司的策略和绩效。
en: This argument has some explanatory power, though it says little about the value added by highly paid asset managers and whether they really are prepared to put their money to work simply on the basis of a monetary-policy effect on relative prices, paying no attention to individual companies’ strategies and performance.

zh: 但是该论点引出了一个关键问题：央行应该怎么办？
en: But the key question the argument raises is what to do about it.

zh: 为了提高生产力，是否就该提前收紧政策，让那些弱势企业一命呜呼？
en: Would it really have been preferable to tighten policy far earlier, to kill off weaker companies in the interests of improving productivity?

zh: 英国央行已经给出明确答复，其他主要中央银行也都回答了这个问题：他们可不这么认为。
en: The BoE has given an explicit answer, and the other major central banks implicit answers, to that question. They do not think so.

zh: 一个解决问题的较佳选项可能是让市场监管机构更大力地动用手边的工具。
en: A preferable approach to resolving the problem might be more vigorous use of the tools available to market regulators.

zh: 在这些机构眼中，对投资者的保护要比其所监管市场的分配效率更重要。
en: These authorities tend to focus more on investor protection than on the allocational efficiency of the markets they oversee.

zh: 保护投资者固然应当，但正如诺贝尔经济学奖获得者尤金·法马（Eugene Fama）指出的那样 ： “ 资本市场的主要作用就是分配经济资本存量的所有权。 ”
en: Investor protection is important, of course, but as the Nobel laureate Eugene Fama put it, “the primary role of the capital market is allocation of ownership of the economy’s capital stock.”

zh: 专注于这一目标的监管机构会在监督信息披露透明度方面特别严格，并将努力促进企业以及投资者之间的激烈竞争 — — 后者对这一目标的实现极为重要。
en: A regulator focused on that objective would be especially rigorous in overseeing the transparent disclosure of information, and would seek to promote vigorous competition among companies and also, crucially for this objective, among investors.

zh: 如果资产管理人员仅靠追踪市场基准指标就可以赚取巨额回报，这显然是不可接受的。
en: It should not be acceptable for asset managers to earn extravagant returns for following a market benchmark.

zh: 毫无疑问，生产力难题还存在着其他方面。
en: There are, no doubt, other dimensions to the productivity puzzle.

zh: 也许我们测量产出的方式有问题。
en: Maybe we are not measuring output well.

zh: 随着发达经济体越来越构建于服务之上，我们的产出测量也越来越不客观。
en: As developed economies become more service-based, our measures of output become less objective.

zh: 在许多服务业中，产出是根据投入来有效衡量的。
en: In many service industries, outputs are effectively measured by inputs.

zh: 也许我们也没有衡量质量的提升，这可能意味着产出的增加遭到了低估。
en: Maybe we are not measuring enhancements in quality, which may mean that output increases are understated.

zh: 也许我们已经进入了一个基于互联网技术的生产力提升已被耗尽的阶段，因此需要另一场技术跃进来再次出发。
en: Maybe we have reached a point at which the productivity boost from Internet-based technology has been cashed, and we need another technological leap to move forward again.

zh: 但是随着利率逐步正常化，中央银行面临的一个主要挑战就是制定一个框架来考量货币政策对资本配置的影响。
en: But one key challenge for central banks, as we edge toward the normalization of interest rates, will be to develop a framework for thinking about the impact of monetary policy on the allocation of capital.

zh: 这个任务极为紧迫，因为生产力或实际工资增长的长期缺乏会产生非常严重的社会和政治影响。
en: The task is urgent, as the social and political implications of a prolonged period of no productivity or real wage growth may be very serious.

zh: 事实上，这可能就是美国和英国政治动荡背后的原因。
en: Indeed, arguably they have been factors behind the political upheavals in the US and the UK already.

zh: 发展中国家和全球危机
en: Developing Countries and the Global Crisis

zh: 纽约 — — 今年可能是二战以来世界经济最糟糕的一年，世界银行估计世界经济将下滑高达2 % 。
en: NEW YORK – This year is likely to be the worst for the global economy since World War II, with the World Bank estimating a decline of up to 2%.

zh: 即使那些没有犯任何错误的发展中国家（而且它们的宏观经济政策和调控政策还要远远优于美国）也受到了影响。
en: Even developing countries that did everything right – and had far better macroeconomic and regulatory policies than the United States did – are feeling the impact.

zh: 中国经济可能继续增长，但是速度会大大放缓，远远低于这些年来每年11 % - 12%的增长速度，而这主要是因为出口急剧下挫。
en: Largely as a result of a precipitous fall in exports, China is likely to continue to grow, but at a much slower pace than the 11-12% annual growth of recent years.

zh: 除非采取行动，危机将把另外多达两亿的人口拖入贫困之中。
en: Unless something is done, the crisis will throw as many as 200 million additional people into poverty.

zh: 这场全球危机要求我们作出全球性的应对，然而不幸的是，作出回应的责任依然只停留在国家层面。
en: This global crisis requires a global response, but, unfortunately, responsibility for responding remains at the national level.

zh: 每个国家都力图让自己设计的一揽子经济刺激计划能够最大程度地造福于本国公民，而不是最大限度地影响全球经济。
en: Each country will try to design its stimulus package to maximize the impact on its own citizens – not the global impact.

zh: 各国在评估经济刺激方案的规模时，都会在 本国 预算的成本和收益之间保持平衡，而这一收益是以本国的经济增幅和就业率增幅来计算的。
en: In assessing the size of the stimulus, countries will balance the cost to their own budgets with the benefits in terms of increased growth and employment for their own economies.

zh: 由于一些收益（主要是在小的开放型经济体里）将会带来其他收益，这些一揽子刺激计划可能规模过小，设计也要逊色一些，这就是为什么需要全球性、相互协作的一揽子刺激计划。
en: Since some of the benefit (much of it in the case of small, open economies) will accrue to others, stimulus packages are likely to be smaller and more poorly designed than they otherwise would be, which is why a globally coordinated stimulus package is needed.

zh: 这是来自联合国专家委员会关于全球经济危机的若干重要信息之一。 我担任这个委员会的主席。
en: This is one of several important messages to emerge from a United Nations Experts Commission on the global economic crisis, which I chair – and which recently submitted its preliminary report to the UN.

zh: 这份报告支持许多由G-20（20国集团）提出的倡议，但它敦促针对发展中国家采取更有力的措施。
en: The report supports many of the G-20 initiatives, but it urges stronger measures focused on developing countries.

zh: 例如，尽管人们认识到几乎所有国家都需要采取刺激措施（我们现在都是凯恩斯主义者 ） ， 但许多发展中国家没有资源来这样做。
en: For instance, while it is recognized that almost all countries need to undertake stimulus measures (we’re all Keynesians now), many developing countries do not have the resources to do so.

zh: 而且现存的国际借贷机构也同样缺乏资源。
en: Nor do existing international lending institutions.

zh: 但是如果我们要避免卷入另一轮债务危机，一些钱，也许是很多钱，将被迫以补贴的形式来发放。
en: But if we are to avoid winding up in another debt crisis, some, perhaps much, of the money will have to be given in grants.

zh: 而且，过去的援助伴随着繁多的“条件 ” ， 其中一些实施互相矛盾的货币和财政政策 — — 这和现在的需要背道而驰；这些条件还迫使受惠国放松金融管制，而这正是导致危机的原因之一。
en: And, in the past, assistance has been accompanied by extensive “conditions,” some of which enforced contractionary monetary and fiscal policies – just the opposite of what is needed now – and imposed financial deregulation, which was among the root causes of the crisis.

zh: 在世界的许多地方，基于各种原因，IMF(国际货币基金组织)的名声都蒙上了不小的污点。
en: In many parts of the world, there is a strong stigma associated with going to the International Monetary Fund, for obvious reasons.

zh: 而且，心怀不满的不止是借款方，还有潜在的资金提供方。
en: And there is dissatisfaction not just from borrowers, but also from potential suppliers of funds.

zh: 今日的流动资金来源于亚洲和中东，但是为什么这些国家应该把钱献给这样的组织：他们的声音在其中受到限制，而且这些组织还经常推行与他们的价值和信仰相对立的政策？
en: The sources of liquid funds today are in Asia and the Middle East, but why should these countries contribute money to organizations in which their voice is limited and which have often pushed policies that are antithetical to their values and beliefs?

zh: 针对IMF和世界银行提出的多项管理改革似乎终于摆上了桌面。 这些改革将在上述两家机构的领导者选择方面发挥最为明显的影响。
en: Many of the governance reforms proposed for the IMF and the World Bank – affecting, most obviously, how their heads are chosen – finally seem to be on the table.

zh: 然而改革进程缓慢，而危机却不会停步等待。
en: But the reform process is slow, and the crisis will not wait.

zh: 因此，应该通过包括地区性机构在内的多种渠道来提供援助（和IMF一起或是取代IMF ） ， 这是极为重要的。
en: It is thus imperative that assistance be provided through a variety of channels, in addition to, or instead of, the IMF, including regional institutions.

zh: 我们可以创造新的借款工具，而管理机制也应该和21世纪更加协调一致。
en: New lending facilities could be created, with governance structures more consonant with the twenty-first century.

zh: 如果这一切能够迅速完成（我认为它能 ） ， 这些工具将成为资金发放的重要渠道。
en: If this could be done quickly (which I think it could), such facilities could be an important channel for disbursing funds.

zh: 在2008年11月举行的G-20峰会上，各国领袖们强烈谴责了贸易保护主义，并且承诺本国不会实行保护主义。
en: At their November 2008 summit the G-20 leaders strongly condemned protectionism and committed themselves not to engage in it.

zh: 不幸的是，世界���行的研究注意到：20个国家中有17 个实际上已经采取了新的贸易保护措施，最为明显的就是美国，它在一揽子刺激计划中含有“只买美国货”的条款。
en: Unfortunately, a World Bank study notes that 17 of the 20 countries have actually undertaken new protectionist measures, most notably the US with the “buy American” provision included in its stimulus package.

zh: 然而，长久以来，人们已经认识到，补贴可能和关税一样具有毁灭性，甚至还不如关税公平，因为富裕国家更有能力提供补贴。
en: But it has long been recognized that subsidies can be just as destructive as tariffs – and even less fair, since rich countries can better afford them.

zh: 如果全球经济曾经有过一个公平的竞技场，那它已经不再存在了：美国所提供的巨额补贴和紧急援助已经改变了一切，而且这种改变也许是不可逆转的。
en: If there was ever a level playing field in the global economy, it no longer exists: the massive subsidies and bailouts provided by the US have changed everything, perhaps irreversibly.

zh: 的确，即使是发达工业国家里没有收到补贴的公司也处于一个不公平的优势位置。
en: Indeed, even firms in advanced industrial countries that have not received a subsidy are at an unfair advantage.

zh: 他们能冒其他公司不能冒的风险，因为他们知道一旦失败了，他们可以获得紧急援助。
en: They can undertake risks that others cannot, knowing that if they fail, they may be bailed out.

zh: 尽管人们可以理解国内政治的准则 — — 这些准则导致了补贴和担保的出现，但是发达国家需要认识到自身行为的全球性后果，并且为发展中国家提供补偿性的援助。
en: While one can understand the domestic political imperatives that have led to subsidies and guarantees, developed countries need to recognize the global consequences, and provide compensatory assistance to developing countries.

zh: 由联合国委员会提出的，更为重要的中期倡议里还有这样一条：创立全球性的经济协作理事会，该理事会不仅要协调经济政策，还会对面临的问题和机构之间的分歧进行评估。
en: One of the more important medium-term initiatives urged by the UN Commission is the creation of a global economic coordinating council, which would not only coordinate economic policy, but would also assess impending problems and institutional gaps.

zh: 例如，随着衰退加剧，部分国家将会面临破产。
en: As the downturn deepens, several countries may, for example, face bankruptcy.

zh: 但是我们尚未创立一个处理此类问题的完整架构。
en: But we still do not have an adequate framework for dealing with such problems.

zh: 美元作为储备货币的机制是现今全球金融体系的基石，但是现在这一机制出现了问题。
en: And the US dollar reserve-currency system – the backbone of the current global financial system – is fraying.

zh: 中国已经表示了关注，它的央行领导人加入了联合国委员会，号召采用新的全球储备机制。
en: China has expressed concerns, and the head of its central bank has joined the UN Commission in calling for a new global reserve system.

zh: 联合国委员会认为，如果我们想要取得富有活力的稳定复苏，那么必须处理这个老问题 — — 远在75年之前甚至更早一些时候，凯恩斯就提出了这个问题。
en: The UN Commission argues that addressing this old issue – raised more than 75 years ago by Keynes – is essential if we are to have a robust and stable recovery.

zh: 这类改革不会在一夜之中就得以完成。
en: Such reforms will not occur overnight.

zh: 但是现在如果不就此展开行动，它们将 永远 也不会发生。
en: But they will not occur ever unless work on them is begun now.

zh: 遏制发展中国家资本外流
en: Closing Developing Countries’ Capital Drain

zh: 纽约 — — 发展中国家即将在本年度迎来一个重大的增长放缓。
en: NEW YORK – Developing countries are bracing for a major slowdown this year.

zh: 根据联合国发布的《2016年世界经济形势与展望》报告，这些国家在2015年的平均增长将只有3.8 ％ — —是2009年全球金融危机以来最低水平，萧条程度也跟2001年并无二致。
en: According to the UN report World Economic Situation and Prospects 2016, their growth averaged only 3.8% in 2015 – the lowest rate since the global financial crisis in 2009 and matched in this century only by the recessionary year of 2001.

zh: 更需牢记的是，中国经济的放缓以及俄罗斯联邦和巴西的深度衰退只是导致增长全面衰退的一部分原因。
en: And what is important to bear in mind is that the slowdown in China and the deep recessions in the Russian Federation and Brazil only explain part of the broad falloff in growth.

zh: 诚然，在中国对自然资源的需求下降（占了全球基���金属需求的近一半）是这类产品价格大幅下跌的主因，也重创了许多拉丁美洲和非洲发展中国家和新兴经济体。
en: True, falling demand for natural resources in China (which accounts for nearly half of global demand for base metals) has had a lot to do with the sharp declines in these prices, which have hit many developing and emerging economies in Latin America and Africa hard.

zh: 事实上，联合国报告指出有29个经济体可能会受到中国经济放缓的严重影响。
en: Indeed, the UN report lists 29 economies that are likely to be badly affected by China’s slowdown.

zh: 而油价自2014年7月以来超过60％的下跌也削弱了石油出口国的增长前景。
en: And the collapse of oil prices by more than 60% since July 2014 has undermined the growth prospects of oil exporters.

zh: 但真正让人担心不只是商品价格的下跌，还有大规模的资本外流。
en: The real worry, however, is not just falling commodity prices, but also massive capital outflows.

zh: 2009~2014年间，发展中国家总共获得了2.2万亿美元的净资本流入，部分原因是发达经济体的量化宽松政策在令利率处于近零水平。
en: During 2009-2014, developing countries collectively received a net capital inflow of $2.2 trillion, partly owing to quantitative easing in advanced economies, which pushed interest rates there to near zero.

zh: 对资本更高回报的渴求驱使投资者和投机者转向发展中国家，这类流入增加了杠杆，撑起了股价，并在某些情况下支撑了商品价格上涨。
en: The search for higher yields drove investors and speculators to developing countries, where the inflows increased leverage, propped up equity prices, and in some cases supported a commodity price boom.

zh: 比如孟买、约翰内斯堡，圣保罗和上海证券交易所的总市值几乎在金融危机后的数年内翻了近三倍。
en: Market capitalization in the Mumbai, Johannesburg, São Paulo, and Shanghai stock exchanges, for example, nearly tripled in the years following the financial crisis.

zh: 在此期间，其他发展中国家的股市也出现了类似的大幅飙升。
en: Equity markets in other developing countries also witnessed similar dramatic increases during this period.

zh: 但如今资本流动的方向出现了自2006年以来的第一次逆转，在2015年从发展中国家净流出了超过6000亿美元 — — 相当于先前六年各国净资金流入总额的四分之一强。
en: But the capital flows are now reversing, turning negative for the first time since 2006, with net outflows from developing countries in 2015 exceeding $600 billion – more than one-quarter of the inflows they received during the previous six years.

zh: 其中最大的资金流出渠道是银行渠道，在2015年一年内各大国际银行就将其在发展中国家的信贷总量削减了超过8000亿美元。
en: The largest outflows have been through banking channels, with international banks reducing their gross credit exposures to developing countries by more than $800 billion in 2015.

zh: 这种规模的资本外流可能造成众多影响：流动性干涸，借贷成本增加，货币走弱，储备耗尽，并导致股票和其他资产价格下跌。
en: Capital outflows of this magnitude are likely to have myriad effects: drying up liquidity, increasing the costs of borrowing and debt service, weakening currencies, depleting reserves, and leading to decreases in equity and other asset prices.

zh: 此外还会对实体经济产生大型连锁反应，包括严重损害发展中国家的增长前景。
en: There will be large knock-on effects on the real economy, including severe damage to developing countries’ growth prospects.

zh: 这不是发展中国家第一次面对如何管理亲周期性热钱的难题，但此次的规模是压倒性的。
en: This is not the first time that developing countries have faced the challenges of managing pro-cyclical hot capital, but the magnitudes this time are overwhelming.

zh: 在亚洲金融危机期间的1997年，从东亚经济体的资本净流出也不过120亿美元。
en: During the Asian financial crisis, net outflows from the East Asian economies were only $12 billion in 1997.

zh: 不过当今的东亚经济体也能更好地承受这样大规模的外流，因为1997年金融危机后各国外汇储备都有所增加。
en: Of course, the East Asian economies today are better able to withstand such massive outflows, given their accumulation of international reserves since the financial crisis in 1997.

zh: 事实上，各国的外汇储备规模比​​亚洲金融危机时增长了超过三倍。
en: Indeed, the global stock of reserves has more than tripled since the Asian financial crisis.

zh: 以中国为例，虽然该国在2015年动用了近5000亿美元外汇储备来对冲资金外流同时防止人民币大幅贬值；但它手中仍握有超过3万亿美元储备。
en: China, for example, used nearly $500 billion of its reserves in 2015 to fight capital outflows and prevent the renminbi’s sharp depreciation; but it still has more than $3 trillion in reserves.

zh: 这些储备可以在某种程度上解释为何庞大的外流规模未能触发一场发展中国家的全面金融危机。
en: The stockpile of reserves may partly explain why huge outflows have not triggered a full-blown financial crisis in developing countries.

zh: 但是并非所有国家都是如此殷实。
en: But not all countries are so fortunate to have a large arsenal.

zh: 那些鼓吹要让破坏稳定的短期资本自由流动的人再次被证明是错误的。
en: Once again, advocates of free mobility for destabilizing short-term capital flows are being proven wrong.

zh: 许多新兴市场国家已经意识到了这种危险并试图减少资本流入。
en: Many emerging markets recognized the dangers and tried to reduce capital inflows.

zh: 以韩国为例，该国从2010年开始实施了一系列宏观审慎措施，旨在缓和顺周期性的跨国银行部门负债。
en: South Korea, for example, has been using a series of macro-prudential measures since 2010, aimed at moderating pro-cyclical cross-border banking-sector liabilities.

zh: 但正如上述数据显示，这些措施只取得了部分成功。
en: The measures taken were only partially successful, as the data above show.

zh: 现在的问题是，他们如今应该怎么办？
en: The question is, what should they do now?

zh: 在2008年后通过资本流入提高了杠杆水平的发展中国家企业部门尤其脆弱。
en: Corporate sectors in developing countries, having increased their leverage with capital inflows during the post-2008 period, are particularly vulnerable.

zh: 资本外流对其股票价格产生了不利影响，推高它们的负债/权益比率，增加了违约的可能性。
en: Capital outflows will adversely affect their equity prices, push up their debt-to-equity ratios, and increase the likelihood of defaults.

zh: 这个问题在以商品出口为主的发展中经济体中尤为严重，因为企业往往会预期商品价格持续高企而大幅借债。
en: The problem is especially severe in commodity-exporting developing economies, where firms borrowed extensively, expecting high commodity prices to persist.

zh: 许多发展中国家政府未能从以前的危机中得到教训，借助法规和税收去限制和遏制外汇风险。
en: Many developing-country governments failed to learn the lesson of earlier crises, which should have prompted regulations and taxes restricting and discouraging foreign-currency exposures.

zh: 如今各国政府需要迅速采取行动以避免为这些风险承担责任。
en: Now governments need to take quick action to avoid becoming liable for these exposures.

zh: 加快对债务人有利的破产程序可以确保快速调整，并为重启债务谈判提供了一个框架。
en: Expedited debtor-friendly bankruptcy procedures could ensure quick restructuring and provide a framework for renegotiating debts.

zh: 发展中国家政府也应鼓励将这类债务转换为与GDP挂钩或其他类型的指数化债券。
en: Developing-country governments should also encourage the conversion of such debts to GDP-linked or other types of indexed bonds.

zh: 那些具有较高外债以及外汇储备的国家也应该考虑在国际资本市场上将本国的主权债务买回来，充分利用债券价格下跌的优势。
en: Those with high levels of foreign debt but with reserves should also consider buying back their sovereign debt in the international capital market, taking advantage of falling bond prices.

zh: 虽然储备可能会提供一些​​缓冲来将资本流出的不良影响最小化，但在大多数情况下它们都是不够的。
en: While reserves may provide some cushion for minimizing the adverse effects of capital outflows, in most cases they will not be sufficient.

zh: 发展中国家应当抵制那种试图利用升息以遏制资本外流的诱惑。
en: Developing countries should resist the temptation of raising interest rates to stem capital outflows.

zh: 从历史上看，加息收效甚微。
en: Historically, interest-rate hikes have had little effect.

zh: 事实上，提高利率会破坏经济增长，进而削弱了各国偿还外债的能力，所以效果可能会适得其反。
en: In fact, because they hurt economic growth, further reducing countries’ ability to service external debts, higher interest rates can be counterproductive.

zh: 宏观审慎措施可以阻止或延缓资本外流，但这样的措施也可能是不够的。
en: Macro-prudential measures can discourage or delay capital outflows, but such measures, too, may be insufficient.

zh: 在某些情况下，可能有必要引入选择性，有针对性和有时限的资本管制来遏制外流，尤其是通银行渠道的外流。
en: In some cases, it may be necessary to introduce selective, targeted, and time-bound capital controls to stem outflows, especially outflows through banking channels.

zh: 例如，例如有必要限制发达国家银行与其发展中国家分支机构之间的资本转移。
en: This would entail, for example, restricting capital transfers between parent banks in developed countries and their subsidiaries or branches in developing countries.

zh: 参照1997年马来西亚的成功例子，发展中国家也可以暂时停止所有资金提款以稳定资本流动和汇率。
en: Following the successful Malaysian example in 1997, developing countries could also temporarily suspend all capital withdrawals to stabilize capital flows and exchange rates.

zh: 这也许是许多发展中国家避免灾难性金融危机的唯一办法。
en: This is perhaps the only recourse for many developing countries to avoid a catastrophic financial crisis.

zh: 而重要的是，它们得尽快行动起来。
en: It is important that they act soon.

zh: 本文观点与联合国及其成员国无关。
en: The views expressed here do not represent the views of the United Nations or its member states.

zh: 扭转非洲医疗人才流失
en: Reversing Africa’s Medical Brain Drain

zh: 牛津—不难理解，乌干达派遣近300名健康工人前往特立尼达和多巴哥的计划引起了人们的惊恐。
en: OXFORD – There is understandable consternation over Uganda’s plan to send almost 300 health workers to Trinidad and Tobago.

zh: 据报道，该计划包括乌干达11名注册精神病医师中的四人、28名放射科医师中的20人和92名儿科医生中的15人。
en: The plan reportedly includes four of Uganda’s 11 registered psychiatrists, 20 of its 28 radiologists, and 15 of its 92 pediatricians.

zh: 作为回报，特立尼达和多巴哥（其医生-病人比是比乌干达高12倍）将帮助乌干达开发最近发现的油田。
en: In return, the Caribbean country (which has a doctor-to-patient ratio 12 times higher than Uganda’s) will help Uganda exploit its recently discovered oil fields.

zh: 乌干达外交部长说，该协议是乌干达通过技能和技术转移促进国家利益的使命的一部分，也是一次通过为其公民提供就业机会换取外汇的机会。
en: Uganda’s foreign ministry says the agreement is part of its mandate to promote the country’s interests abroad through the transfer of skills and technology, as well as an opportunity to earn foreign exchange by sourcing employment for its citizens.

zh: 但这一说辞无法让乌干达的国际赞助者满意；美国已经表示严重关注，比利时也叫停了对乌干达医疗业的援助。
en: But Uganda’s international donors are not convinced; the United States has voiced strong concern, and Belgium has suspended development aid to Uganda’s health-care sector.

zh: 我的两位朋友 — — 一位妇科医师和一位儿科医师 — — 已申请加入该计划。
en: Two of my friends, a gynecologist and a pediatrician, have applied to go.

zh: 如果我仍在乌干达与他们共事，我也许也会被吸引加入其中。
en: Had I still been working with them in Uganda, I might have been tempted to join the exodus.

zh: 乌干达医疗专业人士具有很高的才华和资质。
en: Uganda’s health-care professionals are talented and highly qualified.

zh: 但他们的工作条件往往差到令人发指，需要作出巨大的个人牺牲。
en: But they often work in appalling conditions at great personal sacrifice.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪他们会失去一腔热情，寻求其他地区的工作机会。
en: So it is not surprising that they become disheartened and seek professional opportunities elsewhere.

zh: 他们知道，现状令人沮丧，必须做出改变。
en: They know that the status quo is failing, and that something has to change.

zh: 我也知道。
en: I knew it, too.

zh: 2009年，我即将成为乌干达第六名神经外科医师，在穆拉戈国立中心医院（Mulago National Referral Hospital，乌干达最高级的医院）就职。
en: In 2009, I was on track to become only the sixth neurosurgeon in Uganda, working at Mulago National Referral Hospital, the country’s main tertiary institution.

zh: 有时我们不得不因为排水系统故障导致废物回流至无菌环境而取消大手术。
en: We sometimes had to cancel major operations when the malfunctioning sewage system in our theatre regurgitated waste into what was supposed to be a sterile environment.

zh: 我们的人手严重不足。
en: We were severely understaffed.

zh: 有一次，在连续倒班后，我实在筋疲力尽，不慎在为一名艾滋病毒阳性患者抽血时用针头划伤了自己。
en: Once, during a string of consecutive night shifts, I was so tired that I accidentally pricked myself with a needle while drawing blood from an HIV-positive patient.

zh: 我接受了一个月的被称为“后暴露 ” （ Post-Exposure，PEP）的抗逆转录病毒治疗，并且因为治疗的副作用而不得不停止工作。
en: I was given an antiretroviral treatment called Post-Exposure (PEP) for a month and had to take time off work because of the drug’s side effects.

zh: 与此同时，让我更加痛苦的是，政府扣发了我的薪水 — — 这已经不是第一次了。
en: Meanwhile, adding to my anguish, the government delayed payment of our salaries – and not for the first time.

zh: 乌干达与特立尼达和多巴哥之间的协议违反了世界卫生组织国际卫生工作人员招聘（International Recruitment of Health Personnel）的全球规则，该规则旨在阻止从卫生工作者严重短缺的国家招聘人手。
en: The deal between Uganda and Trinidad and Tobago violates the World Health Organization’s global code on the International Recruitment of Health Personnel, which is aimed at discouraging the recruitment of personnel from countries that have a critical shortage of health-care workers.

zh: 乌干达智库公共政策研究所（Institute of Public Policy Research）将该计划称为“国家批准的人才流失 ” （ state-sanctioned brain drain ） 。
en: A Ugandan think tank, the Institute of Public Policy Research, has called the plan a “state-sanctioned brain drain.”

zh: 该智库已将政府告上法庭，试图迫使其收回成命。
en: It has taken the government to court in an effort to force it to reverse its decision.

zh: 但事实上，乌干达可能在不经意间被一项创新性政策所羁绊。
en: But the truth is that Uganda may have inadvertently stumbled upon an innovative policy.

zh: 如果该计划得到恰当的执行，将有利于医疗业和国家 — — 筹集更多资金、强化医疗工作者技能和动力、创造一个侨民参与模式。
en: If the plan is executed properly, it could benefit both the health-care sector and the country, by raising additional funds, strengthening medical workers’ skills and motivation, and creating a model for engaging with the diaspora.

zh: 其他面临类似挑战、留住医疗工作者的发展中国家可以借鉴乌干达的经验。
en: Other developing countries facing similar challenges with retaining health-care workers could learn from Uganda’s experience.

zh: 当然，这类大面积招募可能对发展中国的医疗体系形成巨大的消极影响。
en: Of course, this type of mass recruitment could have a major adverse impact on developing countries’ health-care systems.

zh: 但同样应该认识到，把医疗工作者绑定在一个失败的体系上是不明智的。
en: But it also should be recognized that it is not sensible to chain health-care workers to a failing system.

zh: 必须找到办法鼓励医生为祖国医疗体系做出贡献，同时为他们提供实现个人和职业目标的机会。
en: There has to be a way to encourage doctors to contribute to their country’s health-care system, while offering them an opportunity to achieve their personal and professional goals.

zh: 要让计划起效，接收国必须同意只通过政府招聘医疗专业人士。
en: In order to make it work, the recipient country would have to agree to recruit health-care professionals solely through the government.

zh: 然后，该国可以对员工的海外收入征税，用税收收入发展本国医疗体系。
en: The country could then tax the foreign income of its workers and use the revenues to develop its health-care system.

zh: 此外，任何协议都应该你明确要求为被招聘医疗工作者提供教育和职业发展机会。
en: Moreover, any agreement should explicitly require the provision of education and professional-development opportunities for recruited health-care workers.

zh: 接收国可以向新员工开放医学院和医疗培训计划，或资助其国内的医疗教育和奖学金。
en: The recipient country might open their medical schools and health-care training to new recruits, or help pay for health-care education and a scholarship fund back home.

zh: 这样，乌干达等发展中国家不但可以培养更多的医疗专业人士，也将有资金派遣员工赴海外培训。
en: That way, developing countries like Uganda could not only train more health-care professionals, but also have funds to send workers abroad for training.

zh: 这类计划的影响可以十分深远，因为医疗专业人士短缺问题不仅局限于撒哈拉以南非洲。
en: The impact of such programs could be far-reaching, because the deficit of medical professionals is not limited to Sub-Saharan Africa.

zh: 大量高资质医生移民到英国和美国，包括发达国家在内的世界其他地区都在经历医学人才外流。
en: With so many qualified doctors emigrating to the United Kingdom and the US, the rest of the world, including developed countries, is also experiencing a tremendous medical brain drain.

zh: 大约35,000名希腊医生移民到了德国，而保加利亚也在“流失医生 ” ， 每年有多大600人外流（相当于该国每年医学院毕业生人数 ） 。
en: Roughly 35,000 Greek doctors have emigrated to Germany, while Bulgaria is “bleeding doctors,” losing up to 600 every year (equal to the country’s annual number of medical-school graduates).

zh: 但发展中国家面临的挑战最严峻。
en: But developing countries face the biggest challenge.

zh: 高技能卫生工作者比例小于万分之22.8的国家八成分布在非洲，另有13%位于东南亚。
en: Eighty percent of countries where the density of skilled health workers is less than 22.8 per 10,000 people are in Africa, and another 13% are in Southeast Asia.

zh: 如此短缺的结果在最近的西非埃博拉危机中暴露无遗。
en: The effects of such shortages were made clear during the recent Ebola crisis in West Africa.

zh: 麻烦在于乌干达和其他地区所谓的人才流失并不是这一医疗工作者短缺的原因。
en: The trouble is that the so-called brain drain in Uganda and elsewhere is not the cause of this dearth of health-care workers.

zh: 这只是已处于危机中的医疗体系的一个症候。
en: It is only a symptom of health-care systems that are already in crisis.

zh: 最终的解决方案不是阻止专业人士赴海外工作；而是确保改善培训和更好的工作条件。
en: The ultimate solution is not to discourage professionals from working abroad; it is to ensure better training and more amenable working conditions.

zh: 这样，我们医疗专业人士才能专注于我们的本职工作：为我们的人民IT提供医疗服务。
en: That way, we health-care professionals can focus on the task at hand: providing health care to our people.

zh: 颠倒的世界
en: A World Turned Inside Out

zh: 纽黑文—千疮百孔、奄奄一息的全球经济现在表现出缓慢但确然的走出深度危机后萎靡的迹象。
en: NEW HAVEN – Slowly but surely, a bruised and battered global economy now appears to be shaking off its deep post-crisis malaise.

zh: 如果国际货币基金组织（IMF）的最新预测成为现实 — — 老实说只是有可能 — — 2017—2018年世界GDP平均每年增长近3.6 % ， 那么将比前两年的3.2%略有提高。
en: If the International Monetary Fund’s latest forecasts are borne out – an iffy proposition, to be sure – the nearly 3.6% average annual growth in world GDP expected over the 2017-2018 period would represent a modest uptick from the 3.2% pace of the past two years.

zh: 金融大危机过去整整十年后，全球增长终于回到了3.5%的20世纪80年代后趋势。
en: Fully a decade after the Great Financial Crisis, global growth is finally returning to its 3.5% post-1980 trend.

zh: 但这场往返旅程很难说预示着世界回归常态。
en: But this round trip hardly signals that the world is back to normal.

zh: 相反，世界经济的“新常态”思想可能言过其实，它忽略了过去九年全球增长动态的一个反常的转变。
en: On the contrary, the overhyped idea of a “new normal” for the world economy overlooks an extraordinary transformation in the global growth dynamic over the past nine years.

zh: 在边际上，最近的改善集中在发达经济体，目前它们的2017—2018年预期平均GDP增长率为2 % — —比此前九年平均每年1.1%的前所未有的萎靡水平着实有所提高。
en: At the margin, the recent improvement has been concentrated in the advanced economies, where GDP growth is now expected to average 2% over 2017-2018 – a meaningful pick-up from the unprecedentedly anemic 1.1% average growth of the preceding nine years.

zh: 其中美国相对强势（2.4 % ） ，但预计将受到欧洲（1.7 % ） ，当然还有日本日本（0.9 % ） 的拖累。
en: Relative strength in the United States (2.4%) is expected to be offset by weakness in both Europe (1.7%) and of course Japan (0.9%).

zh: 但是，发达经济体年增长率预计仍见显著低于1980—2007年间2.9%的长期趋势。
en: However, annual growth in the advanced economies is expected to remain considerably below the longer-term trend of 2.9% recorded during the 1980-2007 period.

zh: 相反，发展中世界的速度仍将保持更快。
en: By contrast, the developing world keeps chugging along at a much faster pace.

zh: 尽管它们的2017—2018年平均增长率预计只有4.6 % ， 比此前九年的水平低了大约半个百分点，但仍将比发达世界的扩张速度快一倍。
en: Although the average growth rate expected for these economies over 2017-2018, at 4.6%, is about half a percentage point lower than during the preceding nine years, they would still be expanding at more than twice the pace of the developed world.

zh: 毫不奇怪（至少对于我们这些从来不相信中国会出现硬着陆的人来说 ） ， 发展中世界的优势预计将集中在中国（6.4 % ） 和印度（7.5 % ） ，而拉美（1.5 % ） 和俄罗斯（1.4 % ） 将是拖累因素。
en: Unsurprisingly (at least to those of us who never bought into the Chinese hard-landing scenario), strength in the developing world is expected to be concentrated in China (6.4%) and India (7.5%), with growth lagging in Latin America (1.5%) and Russia (1.4%).

zh: 这一发达经济体和发展中经济体之间的持续分化如今已经到达了一个临界点。
en: This persistent divergence between developed and developing economies has now reached a critical point.

zh: 从1980年到2007年，发达经济体平均贡献了世界GDP的59 % （ 用购买力平价衡量 ） ， 而发展中和新型经济体加起来占了41%的份额。
en: From 1980 to 2007, the advanced economies accounted for an average of 59% of world GDP (measured in terms of purchasing power parity), whereas the combined share of developing and emerging economies was 41%.

zh: 今时已不同往日。
en: That was then.

zh: 据IMF最新预测，2018年这一比例将完全颠倒过来：发达经济体占41 % ， 发展中世界占59 % 。
en: According to the IMF’s latest forecast, those shares will completely reverse by 2018: 41% for the advanced economies and 59% for the developing world.

zh: 世界经济增长的钟摆已经从所谓的发达国家严重倾向新兴和发展中经济体。
en: The pendulum of world economic growth has swung dramatically from the so-called advanced countries to the emerging and developing economies.

zh: 新吗？
en: New?

zh: 绝对新。
en: Absolutely.

zh: 常态吗？
en: Normal?

zh: 远远算不上。
en: Not even close.

zh: 这是一个非常令人瞩目的发展趋势，至少对我们对宏观经济学的理解提出了三个根本问题。
en: It is a stunning development, one that raises at least three fundamental questions about our understanding of macroeconomics:

zh: 第一，是时候反思货币政策的角色了吗？
en: First, isn’t it time to rethink the role of monetary policy?

zh: 发达世界复苏萎靡发生在史上最大力度货币宽松的背景下 — — 政策利率保持零区间并且央行通过大幅扩表注入巨量流动性长达八年时间。
en: The anemic recovery in the developed world has occurred against the backdrop of the most dramatic monetary easing in history – eight years of policy interest rates near the zero bound and enormous liquidity injections from vastly expanded central-bank balance sheets.

zh: 但这些非常规政策对实体经济活动、中产阶级就业岗位和工资的影响非常有限。
en: Yet these unconventional policies have had only a limited impact on real economic activity, middle-class jobs, and wages.

zh: 相反，过剩的流动性溢出到金融市场，让资产价格持续升温，也为富有的投资者创造了丰厚的回报。
en: Instead, the excess liquidity spilled over into financial markets, sustaining upward pressure on asset prices and producing outsize returns for wealthy investors.

zh: 不管你喜不喜欢，货币政策已经成为助长不平等性的工具。
en: Like it or not, monetary policy has become an instrument of mounting inequality.

zh: 第二，发展中世界终于打破长期以来对发达世界的依赖了吗？
en: Second, has the developing world finally broken free of its long-standing dependence on the developed world?

zh: 我早就指出，这种“脱钩”论是子虚乌有，因为较贫穷国家一直是出口拉动型增长，这意味着它们的经济与较富裕国家的外部需求挂钩。
en: I have long argued that claims of such a “decoupling” were spurious, given the persistence of export-led growth in poorer countries, which tethers their economies to external demand in richer countries.

zh: 但如今，事实是另一幅图景。
en: But the facts now speak otherwise.

zh: 在危机后的2008—2016年期间，全球贸易平均增长率下降到3 % — —只有1980—2016年正常值6%的一半。
en: Growth in global trade slowed to a 3% average pace over the 2008-2016 post-crisis period – half the 6% norm from 1980 to 2016.

zh: 但是，在此期间，发展中经济体的GDP增长几乎不受影响。
en: Yet, over the same period, GDP growth in the developing economies barely skipped a beat.

zh: 这证明，发展中世界现在对全球贸易周期的依赖性大大降低，更加依赖内需。
en: This attests to a developing world that is now far less dependent on the global trade cycle and more reliant on internal demand.

zh: 最后，中国在世界经济格局调整中是否扮演了巨大的作用？
en: Finally, has China played a disproportionate role in reshaping the world economy?

zh: 中国的再平衡表明很可能确实如此。
en: Chinese rebalancing suggests that this may well be the case.

zh: 历史上，中国的出口拉动增长战略取得了巨大的成功，再加上以中国为中心的全球供给链的快速成长，共同构成了我从来不信什么脱钩论的主要原因。
en: Historically, China’s hugely successful export-led growth strategy, together with the rapid growth of China-centric global supply chains, was the major reason why I never bought the decoupling story.

zh: 但出口占中国GDP之比从2007年的35%大幅下降到2015年的20 % ， 与此同时，中国占全球产出的比重从11%上升到17 % 。
en: Yet the export share of Chinese GDP tumbled from 35% in 2007 to 20% in 2015, while its share of global output surged from 11% to 17% during this period.

zh: 中国，世界最大的出口国，可能正是全球脱钩的排头兵。
en: China, the world’s largest exporter, may well be in the vanguard of global decoupling.

zh: 这引出了一个更加强大的趋势：中国产业结构的迅速变迁。
en: This hints at an even more powerful trend: the rapid transformation of China’s industrial structure.

zh: 中国第三产业（服务业）占GDP之比从2007年的43%增加到2016年的52 % ， 而第二产业（制造业和建筑业）的比重同期从47%下降到40 % 。
en: China’s tertiary sector (services) has gone from 43% of GDP in 2007 to 52% in 2016, whereas the share of the secondary sector (manufacturing and construction) has fallen from 47% to 40% over the same period.

zh: 主要拜预防性储蓄（体现了社会安全网的空白）所赐，私人消费占总需求之比增长较为缓慢，但在这面形势也令人感到乐观。
en: While the private consumption share of aggregate demand increased more slowly, largely owing to high precautionary saving (which reflects gaps in the social safety net), there are grounds for optimism on this front as well.

zh: 事实上，中国电子商务的爆炸式增长表明了一条通往生机勃勃的新消费文化的捷径，这条捷径，今天的发达经济体处于相近发展阶段时是可望而不可及的。
en: Indeed, the explosive growth of Chinese e-commerce points to a shortcut toward a newly vibrant consumer culture that was unavailable to today’s advanced economies at a similar stage of development.

zh: 在结构性变化的历史上，变迁和冰山一样缓慢，但中国的演进有如百米冲刺。
en: In the annals of structural change, where shifts tend to be glacial, China’s evolution is a sprint.

zh: 所有这些都表明世界与金融大危机前的主流世界已经截然不同，新的世界引出了关于货币政策的效果、发展战略以及中国的角色的根本性问题。
en: All of this speaks to a radically different world than that which prevailed prior to the Great Financial Crisis – a world that raises profound questions about the efficacy of monetary policy, development strategies, and the role of China.

zh: 80万亿美元的全球经济已经浮现出康复迹象，但必须用于以往不同的视角来看待进步。
en: While some healing of an $80 trillion global economy is now evident, progress needs to be seen through a different lens than used in past cycles.

zh: 世界已经颠倒，发展中世界的新活力让发达经济体的漫长萎靡黯然失色。 这是一个新世界，但绝不是常态世界。
en: A world turned inside out, with new dynamism in the developing world far eclipsing lingering malaise in the advanced economies, is new – but hardly normal.

zh: 危机时代的增长
en: Growth in a Time of Disruption

zh: 发自佛罗里达州劳德代尔堡 — — 发展中国家的持续高增长目标如今面临着多项重大障碍 — — 其中许多他们基本上是无力破除的。
en: FORT LAUDERDALE, FLORIDA – Developing countries are facing major obstacles – many of which they have little to no control over – to achieving sustained high growth.

zh: 除了发达经济体增长缓慢以及危机后货币和金异常情况之外，还有数字技术所带来的破坏性影响，而这将削弱发展中国家在劳动密集型制造业方面的比较优势。
en: Beyond the headwinds generated by slow advanced-economy growth and abnormal post-crisis monetary and financial conditions, there are the disruptive impacts of digital technology, which are set to erode developing economies’ comparative advantage in labor-intensive manufacturing activities.

zh: 由于上述趋势都是不可逆转的，因此适应是唯一的选择。
en: With the reversal of these trends out of the question, adaptation is the only option.

zh: 机器人技术在电子装配业已经实现了长足的发展，而缝纫行业 — — 一直以来都是很多国家加入全球贸易体系的敲门砖 — — 则可能是下一个目标。
en: Robotics has already made significant inroads in electronics assembly, with sewing trades, traditionally many countries’ first entry point to the global trading system, likely to come next.

zh: 随着这种趋势持续，逐渐地也没什么必要将供应链安置在位置相对固定且具备成本效益的劳动力聚集区周围，而是向终端市场靠拢。
en: As this trend continues, the imperative to build supply chains based on the location of relatively immobile and cost-effective labor will wane, with production moving closer to the final market.

zh: 比如阿迪达斯就已经在德国建厂并安装生产高档运动鞋的机器人生产线，同时计划在美国开设第二家。
en: Adidas, for example, is already building a factory in Germany, where robots will produce high-end athletic shoes, and is planning a second one in the United States.

zh: 有鉴及此，发展中国家需要立即采取行动调整自身增长战略。
en: Given all of this, developing countries need to act now to adapt their growth strategies.

zh: 而制定一个合理框架则必须考虑下列几个关键因素：
en: A sensible framework for doing so must account for several key factors.

zh: 首先，发达国家所面临的问题 — — 从经济放缓到政治上的不确定性 — — 可能会继续存在，在一段较长的时期内压低全球各地的增长潜力。
en: First, the problems in advanced countries – from slow economic growth to political uncertainty – are likely to persist, reducing potential growth everywhere for an extended period.

zh: 在这个背景下，发展中国家千万不能尝试那种试图利用积累过度债务这类不可持续手段来提振需求的做法。
en: In this context, developing countries must not succumb to the temptation to try to boost demand through unsustainable means, such as the accumulation of excess debt.

zh: 相反，发展中国家（尤其是那些处于经济发展早期阶段的国家）必须为本国商品找到新的外部市场，并尽力拓展与发展中国家之间的贸易机会，因此其中许多国家其实具有相当强大的购买力。
en: Instead, developing countries, particularly those in the earlier stages of economic development, must find new external markets for their goods, by maximizing trade opportunities with their counterparts in the developing world, many of which have considerable purchasing power.

zh: 虽然这种需求肯定无法完全抵消先进国家的需求下降，但却有助于减轻对经济的冲击。
en: While such demand will surely not offset the drop in advanced-country demand completely, it can help to soften the blow.

zh: 第二，公共和私人的投资仍然是一个强有力的增长引擎。
en: Second, investment, both public and private, remains a powerful growth engine.

zh: 对于那些产能过剩的经济体来说，有针对性的投资可以产生双重效益，在激发短期需求的同时又促进未来的经济增长和生产力。
en: In economies with excess productive capacity, targeted investment can yield a double benefit, generating short-run demand and boosting growth and productivity thereafter.

zh: 因此应该尽量补足那些能实现高社会和个人回报的投资项目资金缺口，甚至完全填平。
en: Given this, shortfalls in investment that promises high social and private returns must be reduced, and even eliminated.

zh: 这些提高增长和生产率的投资应主要由国内储蓄来融资，当然发行债务也是一个选项。
en: These growth- and productivity-enhancing investments should be financed primarily from domestic savings, though some can also be financed with debt.

zh: 而长期稳定的基础设施投资可以至少部分地由国际发展机构提供经费。
en: Long-term, stable infrastructure investments can be financed at least partly by international development institutions.

zh: 第三以保护并提高实体经济增长潜力的方式来管理资本账户至关重要。
en: Third, it is critical to manage the capital account in a way that protects and enhances the real economy’s growth potential.

zh: 来自低利率国家的大规模资本流入可以很轻易地推高汇率，令经济中的贸易部门压力陡增。
en: Large inflows of capital from countries with low interest rates can easily push up exchange rates, putting the tradable part of the economy under pressure.

zh: 同时，资本流向逆转的预期也会增加风险，阻碍投资，并可能导致突发信贷紧缩。
en: At the same time, the prospect of a capital-flow reversal adds risk, deters investment, and can produce sudden credit-tightening events.

zh: 在这种情况下，有选择性的资本管制和小心谨慎的储备管理可以有助于稳定国际收支平衡，并确保进出口交换比价（terms of trade）不会变化得太快以致被生产力增长所抵消。
en: In this context, selective capital controls and careful reserve management can help to stabilize the balance of payments and ensure that the terms of trade do not change too fast to be offset by productivity growth.

zh: 事实上，成功的发展中国家甚至在全球金融危机发生之前就采取这类政策了。
en: In fact, successful developing countries were pursuing such policies even before the global economic crisis hit.

zh: 第四，需要运用加入这场数字革命的现实性手段。
en: Fourth, a realistic approach to the digital revolution is needed.

zh: 一方面，发展中国家应该认识到虽然数字技术的破坏性影响不断加剧，却也不可能在一夜之间淘汰它们的增长模式。
en: On one hand, developing countries should recognize that disruption, while happening fast, will not render their growth models obsolete overnight.

zh: 例如中国的持续增长和不断扩大的家庭收入就为低收入经济体的低成本制造业创造了机会。
en: China’s continued growth and rising household income are creating opportunities for lower-income economies in low-cost manufacturing.

zh: 另一方面，发��中国家必须认识到对他们的增长模式必然会在数字技术的影响下产生变革。
en: On the other hand, developing countries must accept the inevitability of changes to their growth models caused by digital technologies.

zh: 但与其将此视为一种威胁并试图抵抗，发展中经济体应该通过拥抱颠覆性的创新来接纳这一趋势。
en: Instead of viewing these changes as a threat, and trying to resist them, developing economies should be getting ahead of them, by embracing disruptive innovations.

zh: 这意味着投资 — — 包括物质和人才 — — 去发展支持应用这类技术的能力。
en: This means investing in the capacity – physical and human – to support their use.

zh: 除了升级制造业之外，发展中国家应准备好实现向服务业的转型，因为随着收入的增加这是不可避免的 （尽管准确时间很难预测 ） 。
en: Beyond upgrading manufacturing, developing countries should be preparing for the shift toward services that they will inevitably undergo as incomes rise (though the precise timing is hard to predict).

zh: 事实上各国应寻求各种机会去提升自身的服务业贸易水平，就像印度和菲律宾所做的那样。
en: Indeed, they should be seeking ways to exploit opportunities to boost their trade in services, much like India and the Philippines have done.

zh: 第五，不要忽视了经济增长收益的分配状况。
en: Fifth, the distribution of gains from economic growth cannot be ignored.

zh: 发达经济体在这方面犯过错误，导致政治两极分裂、反政府情绪高涨，政策一致性以及社会凝聚力下降。
en: The advanced economies tried that, and the result has been rising political polarization, intensifying anti-establishment sentiment, declining policy coherence, and weakening social cohesion.

zh: 尤其是在经济低增长环境中，发展中国家是无法承担犯同样错误所付出的代价的。
en: In a low-growth environment, in particular, developing countries cannot afford to make the same mistake.

zh: 第六，是重要的是尽早建立可持续的增长模式。
en: Sixth, it is important to establish sustainable growth patterns early on.

zh: “绿色”的手段不但可刺激额外的增长;还能提高增长的质量以及普通人民的生活。
en: A “green” approach would not only stimulate additional growth; it would also be likely to increase the quality of growth, not to mention the lives of ordinary people.

zh: 此外将在长期内构建远更具回复力的经济。
en: Moreover, it will lead to a far more resilient economy in the long run.

zh: 最后，创业活动是将经济潜力变为现实的重要步骤。
en: Finally, entrepreneurial activity is vital to translate economic potential into reality.

zh: 支持这类活动的政策 — — 如通过消除创造新企业和加强融资机会的障碍 — — 不应被排除在增长战略之外。
en: Policies that support such activity, such as by removing obstacles to new business creation and enhancing financing opportunities, cannot be left out of growth strategies.

zh: 开放国外信息、 理念、 专长和人才的流动渠道也会起到推动作用。
en: Opening channels for flows of information, ideas, expertise, and talent from abroad can only enhance these efforts.

zh: 发展中经济体或许无法掌控当前的这些挑战，但这并不意味着它们对此就无能为力。
en: Developing economies may not have much control over the headwinds that they face today, but that does not mean that they are powerless.

zh: 还有很多措施可以实施，不仅为了维持温和的增长，还要确保一个更繁荣、 抗冲击能力更强的未来。
en: Much can be done not just to sustain moderate growth, but also to secure a more prosperous and resilient future.

zh: 全球健康的新方向
en: A New Direction for Global Health

zh: 纽约 — — 今天的国际合作状况很容易令人感到失望，但全球健康依然是各国合作取得显著进展的领域。
en: NEW YORK – It is easy to be discouraged about the state of international cooperation today, but global health remains an area in which the world has come together to do significant good.

zh: 过去十几年来，国际行动已经为数百万人提供了抗艾滋病毒/艾滋病治疗、拓展了儿童免疫范围并推动各国大幅增加对从疟疾到产妇保健等其他健康挑战的全球支持。
en: Over the last dozen years, international initiatives have delivered HIV/AIDS treatment to millions, expanded childhood immunization, and spurred a dramatic increase in global support for addressing other health challenges, from malaria to maternal health.

zh: 对全球健康事业的国际支持是投资于发展中国家的未来繁荣和民众福祉。
en: International support for global health is an investment in developing countries’ future prosperity and the wellbeing of their people.

zh: 这样的投资全球富裕国家完全能够承担得起。
en: It is an investment that the world’s richest countries can well afford.

zh: 比方说，美国是全球健康援助资金的主要赞助国，2013年上述投资在美国总支出中仅占0.23%的份额。
en: For example, the United States is the leading contributor of global health aid, which accounted for just 0.23% of US spending in 2013.

zh: 但投资回报却令人叹为观止。
en: The returns on that investment have been remarkable.

zh: 儿童死亡率大幅下降。
en: Child mortality is plunging.

zh: 数百万得不到救治将死于艾滋病毒/艾滋病的患者生命依然在延续。
en: Millions who would have otherwise perished from HIV/AIDS are still alive.

zh: 受援国越来越能实现自给自足 — — 并有能力开展更好的贸易和战略合作。
en: Countries that were aid recipients are increasingly self-sufficient – and have become better trade and strategic partners as a result.

zh: 但中低收入国家的健康需求正在悄然发生变化。
en: But the health needs of low- and middle-income countries are now shifting.

zh: 城市化、全球贸易和消费者市场的急剧变化 — — 富裕国家的类似变化发生在数十年前 — — 正在以更大规模、更快速度在依旧贫困的国家上演。
en: Dramatic changes in urbanization, global trade, and consumer markets – which occurred over decades in wealthy countries – are happening at a faster rate, and at a much larger scale, in still-poor countries.

zh: 上述趋势带来了卫生设施改善和粮食产量增加等可观的健康福利，但同时也带来了巨大的挑战。
en: These trends have brought substantial health benefits, such as better sanitation and increased food production, but have given rise to significant challenges as well.

zh: 埃博拉就是个举世闻名的例子。
en: Ebola is one high-profile example.

zh: 截至去年底，死于埃博拉的人数不足2，000人，而且从1976年该病毒最初发现开始，死者全部集中在中非地区。
en: Prior to this year, Ebola had killed fewer than 2,000 people, all in Central Africa, since it was first identified in 1976.

zh: 2014年死于埃博拉的人数却已超过原有数据的3倍，埃博拉国际感染病例充斥着晚间新闻，令最近美国州及地方选举的选民们感到寝食不安。
en: The virus has killed more than three times that number in 2014, with enough cases spreading internationally to dominate nightly news broadcasts and spook voters in recent US state and local elections.

zh: 主要原因是中小型城市的发展。
en: A major reason is the growth of small- and medium-size cities.

zh: 城市化在西非以每年3%的速度递增（相比北美和欧洲的0.2% 和 0.3 % ） 。
en: Urbanization is increasing in West Africa at a rate of 3% per year (compared to 0.2% and 0.3%, respectively, in North America and Europe).

zh: 结果导致百万人以下级别的定居点迅速扩张，但相关公共卫生基础设施却非常有限。
en: The result has been the proliferation of settlements of a million people or fewer living with limited public-health infrastructure.

zh: 如此拥挤的城市是埃博拉等新型传染病理想的孵化器。
en: These cramped cities are ideal incubators for outbreaks of emerging infectious diseases like Ebola.

zh: 随着地区贸易增长和流动人口增加，疫情很可能在国际控制措施合围前快速发展。
en: With greater trade and travel to the region, outbreaks are likely to spread before international containment can coalesce.

zh: 国际健康需求变化的另一个例子是心脏病、癌症和其他非传染性疾病（NCD）在中低收入国家增长极快。
en: Another example of changing global health needs is the stunningly fast increase of heart disease, cancers, and other noncommunicable diseases (NCDs) in low- and middle-income countries.

zh: 上述疾病曾被认为仅仅是富裕国家才需要面对的挑战，但今天已经成为发展中国家最主要的致死及致残原因，仅2013年就导致近8百万人逝于60岁生日之前。
en: Once thought to be challenges for affluent countries alone, these diseases have quickly become the leading cause of death and disability in developing regions, killing nearly eight million people before their 60th birthdays in 2013.

zh: 在由外交关系委员会资助的一份近期报告中，我们重点强调心脏病、癌症、糖尿病和其他非传染性疾病在发展中国家不断上升和国际抗击艾滋病毒/艾滋病及其他传染性疾病所取得重大成就间的对比。
en: In a recent report sponsored by the Council on Foreign Relations, we highlight the contrast between rising rates of heart disease, cancer, diabetes, and other NCDs in developing countries and the success of international efforts on HIV/AIDS and other infectious diseases.

zh: 从1990到2010年，中低收入国家非传染性疾病的致死及致残率比传染性疾病的下降速度快300 % 。
en: From 1990 to 2010, death and disability from NCDs in low-income countries increased 300% faster than the rate of decline in infectious diseases.

zh: 近期导致埃博拉疫情背后的某些因素同样驱动着非传染性疾病高企的发病率。
en: Some of the same factors at work in the recent Ebola outbreak drive the high rates of NCDs.

zh: 新兴经济体密集城市住宅区的居民往往要面对室内室外污染，而且很难摄取到充足的营养。
en: Inhabitants of densely packed urban areas in emerging economies often face both indoor and outdoor pollution, and are less likely to have access to adequate nutrition.

zh: 上述国家绝大多数医疗系统缺乏慢性病和预防保健的经验，也欠缺最基本的消费者保护。
en: Most health systems in these countries are not built for chronic or preventive care and lack basic consumer protections.

zh: 发展中国家吸烟率从1970到2000年增长了两倍。
en: From 1970 to 2000, cigarette consumption tripled in developing countries.

zh: 而在高收入国家可以预防的子宫颈癌或可以治愈的糖尿病等疾病在发展中国家往往与死刑无异。
en: Diseases that in high-income countries are preventable, like cervical cancer, or treatable, such as diabetes, are often death sentences in developing countries.

zh: 国际投资并未适应不断变化的全球健康需求，特别是在非传染性疾病领域。
en: International investments have not yet adjusted to changing global health needs, especially with respect to NCDs.

zh: 2010年，因艾滋病毒/艾滋病致死或致残而损失的单位年寿命对应69.38美元的国际援助（根据扣除伤残因素的寿命年数，即 DALY计算 ） ； 疟疾扣除伤残因素后的寿命年数所对应的国际援助是每年16.27美元，而产妇、新生儿及儿童健康问题扣除伤残因素后的寿命年数所对应的国际援助是每年5.42美元。
en: In 2010, $69.38 of international aid was spent for each year lost to death or disability from HIV/AIDS (as measured in disability-adjusted life years, or DALYs), $16.27 was spent per DALY lost to malaria, and $5.42 per DALY lost to poor maternal, newborn, and child health.

zh: 但心脏病、癌症和其他非传染性疾病扣除伤残因素后的寿命年数所对应的国际援助却仅有每年0.09美元。
en: But only $0.09 was spent per DALY lost to heart disease, cancer, and other NCDs.

zh: 与此同时，新型非传染病疫情正在不断恶化。
en: Meanwhile, the emerging NCD epidemic is worsening.

zh: 事实上，世界经济论坛目前预测到2030年发展中国家因上述疾病造成的损失高达21.3万亿美元。
en: Indeed, the World Economic Forum is predicting $21.3 trillion in losses from these diseases in developing countries by 2030.

zh: 但在非传染性疾病领域完全可以取得进展。
en: Yet progress on NCDs is possible.

zh: 虽然高收入国家肥胖率一直攀升，但因心脏病、癌症及其他非传染性疾病造成的早亡和残疾已经表现出明显的下降趋势。
en: Despite much higher rates of obesity in high-income countries, premature death and disability from heart disease, cancers, and other NCDs have declined substantially.

zh: 这一成就背后的大部分工具和政策都成本低廉，但在发展中国家并未广泛采用。
en: Most of the tools and policies underlying this success are cheap, but not widely implemented in developing countries.

zh: 其中包括减少心脏病发作的低成本药物，以及在欧美大幅降低吸烟率的相同的烟草税和广告规则。
en: They include low-cost drugs to reduce heart attacks, vaccines to prevent cervical cancer, and the same tobacco taxes and advertising rules that dramatically cut smoking rates throughout Europe and the US.

zh: 某些试点项目已经将这些工具和政策成功纳入中低收入国家由捐款人赞助的艾滋病毒/艾滋病及其他传染性疾病项目。
en: Pilot programs have successfully integrated these tools and policies into donor-funded programs on HIV/AIDS and other infectious diseases in low- and middle-income countries.

zh: 如果未来十年，中低收入国家能以富裕国家2000到2013年的速度改善非传染性疾病的预防和治疗环境，五百万人的死亡将能够得以避免。
en: If, over the next decade, low- and middle-income countries could improve NCD prevention and treatment at the same rate as the average rich country from 2000 to 2013, they would avert more than five million deaths.

zh: 该回报率接近在艾滋病毒和儿童免疫领域最成功的全球健康投资，而且因为同样的原因应该是非常值得的投资项目：和平包容的全球经济需要以健康、高效的生活为条件。
en: That return is comparable to the most successful global health investments in HIV and childhood immunization, and it is an investment worth making for the same reason: a peaceful, inclusive global economy presupposes healthier, more productive lives.

zh: 为何经济学家把
en: Why Economists Put Health First

zh: 帕洛阿尔托—在理想世界中，不论是谁，不论在哪里，你都能获得你所需要的卫生服务，并且不需要支付超过你支付能力之外的部分。
en: PALO ALTO – In an ideal world, everyone, everywhere, would access the health services they need without having to pay more than they could afford.

zh: 但这一“所有人的健康 ” — —亦称全民医疗覆盖 — — 真的是不论富裕国家还是最贫穷国家都可行的吗？
en: But is “health for all” – also known as universal health coverage – really possible, not just in rich countries, but in the poorest countries, too?

zh: 简单的回答是“是的 ” 。
en: In short, yes.

zh: 因此，我们与来自近50个国家的数百位经济学家同侪一起敦促领导人们将全民医疗覆盖投资作为日程重点。
en: That’s why we joined hundreds of fellow economists in almost 50 countries to urge leaders to prioritize investments in universal health coverage.

zh: 由洛克菲勒基金会召集、现已征集到300多个签名的《经济学家宣言 》 （ Economists’ Declaration）背后的更广泛的动力将全球卫生与发展推向了一个历史十字路口。
en: And the broader impetus behind this Economists’ Declaration, convened by The Rockefeller Foundation and now with more than 300 signatures, has placed global health and development at a historic crossroads.

zh: 9月份，联合国大会开始实施新的15年全球目标作为世界在2030年结束贫困、塑造包容性繁荣、确保健康地球的措施指引。
en: In September, the United Nations General Assembly adopted a new set of 15-year global goals to guide the world’s efforts to end poverty, foster inclusive prosperity, and secure a healthy planet by 2030.

zh: 在全世界领导人准备实施最有雄心的全球代办事项清单之际 — — 可持续发展目标将从1月1日开始开始 — — 决定从哪里开始也许是一个艰巨的任务。
en: As world leaders prepare to enact the most ambitious global to-do list yet – the Sustainable Development Goals will be launched on January 1 – deciding where to begin may seem a daunting task.

zh: 但是，对经济学家来说，答案是显而易见的：发展战略的新篇章必须把重中之重放在改善医疗上 — — 并且不能让任何一个人落后。
en: For economists, however, the answer is clear: The next chapter of development strategy should assign a high priority to better health – and must leave no one behind.

zh: 让所有人都能获得高质量基本卫生服务而不必面临财务困境首先是一项正确的事业。
en: Reaching everyone with high-quality, essential health services without the threat of financial ruin is, first and foremost, the right thing to do.

zh: 健康和生存是几乎所有人的基本价值。
en: Health and survival are basic values to virtually every individual.

zh: 此外，和粮食等其他宝贵商品不同，它们无法在没有成熟社会政策的情况下实现供给。
en: Furthermore, unlike other valuable goods, such as food, they cannot be supplied without deliberate social policy.

zh: “可预防死亡”在中低收入国家仍然司空见惯，这一事实表明我们的医疗体系低劣不堪或者资源不足，而不意味着我们缺少医学知识。
en: The fact that “preventable deaths” remain common in low- and middle-income countries is a symptom of broken or under-resourced health-care delivery systems, not a lack of medical know-how.

zh: 如果从现在开始增加卫生投资，那么到2030年，我们可以大幅接近所有家长都不会因为可预防原因失去孩子 — — 所有孩子也不会因为可预防原因失去一位双亲的目标。
en: If we increase investments in health now, by 2030 we can be that much closer to a world in which no parent loses a child – and no child loses a parent – to preventable causes.

zh: 全民医疗覆盖也是明智的。
en: Universal health coverage is also smart.

zh: 当人们身体健康、财务稳定时，他们的经济就会更强大、更繁荣。
en: When people are healthy and financially stable, their economies are stronger and more prosperous.
