zh: 首先投资于卫生将产生十倍于初始成本的收益，并且有可能成为其他新全球发展日程的最终付款人。
en: And, with benefits ten times greater than initial costs, investing in health first may ultimately pay for the rest of the new global development agenda.

zh: 因此，问题不在于全民医疗覆盖是否有价值，而在于如何让它成为现实。
en: So the question is not whether universal health coverage is valuable, but how to make it a reality.

zh: 100多个国家朝着这一方向采取了措施；在此过程中，他们揭示了加速迈向全民健康目标的重要机会和战略。
en: More than a hundred countries have taken steps down this path; in the process, they have revealed important opportunities and strategies to accelerate progress toward the goal of health for all.

zh: 特别是，我们认为三个领域 — — 技术、激励和看似“非卫生”投资 — — 都有可能大大推动全民医疗覆盖。
en: In particular, we believe that three areas – technology, incentives, and seemingly “non-health” investments – have the potential to advance universal health coverage dramatically.

zh: 首先，技术正在快速成为局面改变因素，特别是在医疗普及差距最大的发展中国家。
en: First, technology is fast becoming a game changer, especially in developing countries, where the gap in access to health care is the widest.

zh: 肯尼亚通过“m-PESA”而在世界移动资金（mobile money）方面取得了领先地位，该国远程医疗的爆发让农村患者和卫生工作者得以通过视频会议与肯尼亚大医院的医护人员交流，从而以极为低廉的成本改善了医疗质量。
en: In Kenya, which already leads the world in mobile money through “m-PESA,” an upsurge in telemedicine is enabling rural patients and health practitioners to interact, through video conferencing, with staff in Kenya’s main hospitals – thereby increasing quality of care at very little cost.

zh: m-PESA基金会与非洲医学研究基金会合作，还开始实施社区卫生志愿者在线培训，并大量利用SMS/WhatsApp群消息完善培训，让该群体保持联系，分享重要更新。
en: The m-PESA Foundation, in partnership with the African Medical Research Foundation, has also begun implementing online training of community health volunteers and complementing these trainings with bulk SMS/WhatsApp group messages to keep the group connected and share important updates.

zh: 高价值低成本技术投资有助于我们增加每一美元投入的产出。
en: Investments in high-value, low-cost technologies will help us achieve more with every dollar.

zh: 利用激励的力量是加快卫生改革的另一种方法。
en: Harnessing the power of incentives is another way to accelerate health reforms.

zh: 激励可以也应该在不必非要穷人在获得医疗服务时付费的情况下实现。
en: This can and should be done without forcing the poor to pay for health-care services at the point of delivery.

zh: 比如，但国家根据结果（比如儿童接种疫苗的数量或比例）向私人部门支付时，我们了解到问责性和结果都得到了改善。
en: For example, when the state pays the private sector based on outcomes (for example, the number or share of vaccinated children), both accountability and results have been known to improve.

zh: 乌干达和肯尼亚的生殖健康券计划正在为人们提供获得私人部门高质量服务的途径。
en: Voucher programs for reproductive health care in Uganda and Kenya are now providing access to quality services from the private sector.

zh: 最后，构建高弹性医疗体系 — — 在面临冲击时能够弯曲而不断裂 — — 意味着改善其他与人类健康密切相关的公共品。
en: Finally, building resilient health-care systems – flexible enough to bend, but not break, in the face of shocks – means improving other public goods that are closely linked to human health.

zh: 这些公共品包括清洁水和卫生间设施，以及让紧急救护服务得以实现的道路和基础设施。
en: These include clean water and sanitation, and roads and infrastructure that enable emergency care and delivery of services.

zh: 卫生体系并不存在于真空中，如果我们认真对待可持续发展问题，那么现在就应该明白补充性系统的投资是一种“加成 ” （ trade-on ） ， 而不是“权衡 ” （ trade-off ） 。
en: Health systems do not exist in a vacuum, and if we are serious about sustainable development, it is time to understand that investments in complementary systems are “trade-ons” not trade-offs.

zh: 我们应该警惕将医药视为通往更健康的唯一道路的看法。
en: We should be wary of viewing medicine as the only path to better health.

zh: 世界发展目标能否成功取决于我们覆盖最贫穷、最边缘化人口的能力，他们仍然是全世界最容易致死和致残的人群。
en: The success of the world’s development goals hinges on our ability to reach the poorest and most marginalized populations, who continue to bear the brunt of death and disability worldwide.

zh: 在现状基础上自然进步无法覆盖他们。
en: A natural progression of the status quo will not be enough to reach them.

zh: 相反，我们必须投资和推广新技术，理顺激励，认识到卫生体系无法存在于真空中，以此将公共卫生体系推广到常规边界之外。
en: Instead, we must push public health systems beyond their usual boundaries by investing in and promoting new technologies, sharpening incentives, and recognizing that health systems do not exist in a vacuum.

zh: 全民医疗覆盖是正确的、明智的、早就应该实施的。
en: Universal health coverage is right, smart, and overdue.

zh: 要想实现所有人的卫生需要都能获得满足、没有人受困于贫困的世界，我们的领导人必须认识到这一点，并据此行动。
en: To achieve a world where everyone’s health needs are met and nobody is trapped in poverty, our leaders must heed this message and act on it.

zh: 基本收入能有助于穷国吗？
en: Could a Basic Income Help Poor Countries?

zh: 伯克利—将无条件全民基本收入制度化，以此改造福利国家，这一古老的概念最近成为政治界的时髦想象。
en: BERKELEY – The old idea of recasting the welfare state by instituting an unconditional universal basic income has lately been capturing imaginations across the political spectrum.

zh: 左翼将它视为一个简单的、具有潜在完整性的减贫良药。
en: On the left, it is regarded as a simple and potentially comprehensive antidote to poverty.

zh: 右翼将它视为打破复杂的福利官僚、同时兼顾一些社会转移义务，并且不会显著减弱激励的方法。
en: On the right, it is viewed as a means to demolish complex welfare bureaucracies while recognizing the need for some social transfer obligations in a way that doesn’t weaken incentives significantly.

zh: 而在机器人可能取代诸多行业的工人时，它又为惨淡的未来提供了一些保证。
en: It also provides some assurance for the dreaded future when robots may replace workers in many sectors.

zh: 但它真的管用吗？
en: But could it actually work?

zh: 目前，这个问题主要在发达国家被着手解决 — — 并且数字看来情况不妙。
en: So far, the question has been addressed primarily in advanced countries – and the figures do not look promising.

zh: 尽管据信加拿大、芬兰和荷兰目前都在考虑基本收入的概念，但一些著名的发达国家经济学家警告这完全是不可承受的。
en: Though Canada, Finland, and the Netherlands are reportedly now considering the idea of a basic income, some prominent advanced-country economists warn that it is blatantly unaffordable.

zh: 比如，在美国，在现行制度下，向每位成年人每年发放10,000美元救济 — — 低于官方单身贫困线 — — 就将耗尽几乎所有联邦税收入。
en: In the United States, for example, an annual handout of $10,000 to every adult – less than the official poverty threshold for a single person – would exhaust almost all federal tax revenue, under the current system.

zh: 也许正是出于这样的算计，让瑞士选民在本月早些时候的全民公决中一边倒地拒绝了这一概念。
en: Perhaps it was that kind of arithmetic that spurred Swiss voters to reject the idea overwhelmingly in a referendum earlier this month.

zh: 但中低收入国情况如何？
en: But what about low- or middle-income countries?

zh: 事实上，在贫困线较低、现有社会安全网管理起来事倍功半的地方，基本收入在财政上很有可能是可行的 — — 从社会角度更是令人向往。
en: In fact, a basic income may very well be fiscally feasible – not to mention socially desirable – in places where the poverty threshold is low and existing social safety nets are both threadbare and expensive to administer.

zh: 以印度为例，印度有五分之一左右的人口生活在官方贫困线以下，而官方贫困线是很低的。
en: Consider India, where about one-fifth of the population live below the official poverty line, which is itself very low.

zh: 拥有所谓的“低于贫困线”卡片的公民有资格获得政府救济，但调查显示大约一半穷人没有这张卡片 — — 而有大约非贫困者拥有这张卡片。
en: While citizens with so-called “below-poverty-line” cards are eligible for government relief, surveys show that about half of the poor do not have the card – while about one-third of the non-poor do.

zh: 许多其他发展中国家也面临类似的问题，以扶贫为初衷的福利最后落入了境况较好的人手中，而许多福利发放对象却没有获得福利，原因既有政治和行政勾结，也有真正的结构挑战。
en: Many other developing countries face similar problems, with benefits intended for the poor accruing to better-off people, while many of the intended recipients miss out, owing to a combination of political and administrative collusion and genuine structural challenges.

zh: 如果就业岗位集中在非正式部门（主要是自雇者 ） ， 没有任何正式的账户记录或收入数据，收入调查将很难进行。
en: Means-testing can be very difficult in an environment where jobs are concentrated in the informal sector, primarily in self-employment, without any formal account-keeping or income data.

zh: 在这样的情况下，识别穷人可能成本高昂、腐败、复杂、引起争议。
en: Under those circumstances, identifying the poor can be costly, corrupt, complicated, and controversial.

zh: 无条件基本收入可以消除大量此类混乱。
en: An unconditional basic income could eliminate much of this mess.

zh: 问题在于政府是否能够承受而不需要增加纳税人负担和破坏经济激励。
en: The question is whether governments can afford it, without increasing the burden on taxpayers and undermining economic incentives.

zh: 在印度，答案也许是肯定的。
en: In India, the answer could be yes.

zh: 如果印度12.5亿人口没人都获得每年10,000卢比（149美元）的基本收入 — — 大约相当于官方贫困县的四分之三 — — 则总支出将达到GDP的10%左右。
en: If each of India’s 1.25 billion citizens received an annual basic income of 10,000 rupees ($149) – about three-quarters of the official poverty line – the total payout would come to about 10% of GDP.

zh: 德里国家公共财政与政策研究所估算，印度政府每年向境况较好群体发放的暗补和明补便远高于这一数字，更不用说公司部门的税收减免了。
en: The National Institute of Public Finance and Policy in Delhi estimates that every year the Indian government doles out significantly more than that in implicit or explicit subsidies to better-off sections of the population, not to mention tax exemptions to the corporate sector.

zh: 只要取消一些或全部这些补贴 — — 当然，卫生、教育、营养、农村和城市发展计划以及环境保护支出除外 — — 政府就可以确保向所有人 — — 无论穷富 — — 发放合理的基本收入的资金。
en: By discontinuing some or all of these subsidies – which, of course, do not include expenditures in areas like health, education, nutrition, rural and urban development programs, and environmental protection – the government could secure the funds to offer everyone, rich and poor, a reasonable basic income.

zh: 如果政府缺少取消足够的补贴的政治勇气，那么还有两个选择。
en: If the government lacks the political courage to eliminate enough subsidies, two options remain.

zh: 它可以采取措施提高税收收入，比如改善房地产税（目前极低 ） ， 也可以降低引入和基本收入水平。
en: Either it could take steps to boost tax revenues, such as by improving property-tax collections (currently extremely low), or it could reduce the level of any basic income it introduces.

zh: 政府不应该做得是用其他社会福利项目的资金来支持基本收入机制。
en: What governments should not do is fund a basic-income scheme with the money from other key social-welfare programs.

zh: 进本收入可以取代一些被极端扭曲的福利支出，但它无法代替（比如）公共教育和医疗、学前营养计划或公职岗位就业保障。
en: While a basic income can replace some egregiously dysfunctional welfare spending, it cannot substitute for, say, public education and health care, preschool nutrition programs, or employment guarantees in public works.

zh: 毕竟，基本收入仍然十分有限，也没有办法确保个人会将其中足够多的部分用于实现有利于社会的教育、医疗和营养水平。
en: After all, the basic income would still be severely limited, and there is no way to ensure that individuals would allocate enough of it to achieve socially desirable education, health, or nutrition levels.

zh: 如果将这些局限性考虑在内，没有理由认为基本收入计划不能在发展中国家起作用。
en: If these limitations are taken into account, there is little reason to think that a basic-income program could not work in developing countries.

zh: 事实上，最常见的反对基本收入机制的观点根本没有说服力。
en: Indeed, the most frequently heard arguments against such schemes are far from convincing.

zh: 根据批评者的说法，主要的弊端在于基本收入会削弱工作动机，特别是对于穷人而言。
en: The main drawback, according to critics, is that a basic income would weaken the motivation to work, particularly among the poor.

zh: 其逻辑认为，由于工作的价值不止于收入，因此这可能带来严重的问题。
en: Given that the value of work extends beyond income, the logic goes, this could pose a serious problem.

zh: 比如，欧洲社会民主派担心基本收入可能破坏作为当前社会保险计划基础的工人凝聚力。
en: European social democrats, for example, worry that a basic income could undermine the worker solidarity that underpins current social-insurance programs.

zh: 但是，在发展中国家，占主导地位的非正式部门的工人已然被排除在社会保障计划之外。
en: But, in developing countries, workers in the dominant informal sector are already excluded from social-insurance programs.

zh: 并且可行的基本收入必然不足以（至少现在如此）让人们完全将工作抛诸脑后。
en: And no feasible basic income would be large enough, at least for now, to enable people simply to leave work behind.

zh: 事实上，在最贫困群体中，基本收入能缓解目前严重超负荷工作的人的一些压力 — — 特别是女性，从而增强工作的尊严和凝聚力增强效应。
en: In fact, among the poorest groups, basic incomes would enhance the dignity- and solidarity-enhancing effects of work, by easing some of the pressure on people – particularly women – who are now vastly overworked.

zh: 自雇人员，如小型生产商和销售商，不必时时为生计担心，能够进行更具战略性的决策，增强他们面对贸易商、中间人、债权人和地主的讨价还价能力。
en: Instead of constantly fearing for their livelihoods, self-employed people, such as small-scale producers and vendors, could engage in more strategic decision-making, taking advantage of their enhanced bargaining power against traders, middlemen, creditors, and landlords.

zh: 反对基本收入的最后一个理由是穷人将把钱用于对个人或社会不利的行为，如赌博和酗酒。
en: The final argument against basic income is that the poor will use the money to fund personally or socially detrimental activities, such as gambling and alcohol consumption.

zh: 但包括厄瓜多尔、印度、墨西哥和乌干达在内的多国的直接现金转移支付经验并没显示出多少这些不当用途的证据；总体而言，现金被花在了有价值的商品和服务上。
en: But experiences with direct cash transfers in a range of countries, including Ecuador, India, Mexico, and Uganda, have not provided much evidence of such misuse; in general, the cash is spent on worthwhile goods and services.

zh: 空想社会主义和自由主义者所构想的全民基本收入方案也许在发达国家还操之过急。
en: Proposals for a universal basic income, fancied by utopian socialists and libertarians, may be premature in the advanced countries.

zh: 但这一机制在发展中国家中不应该被否定，发展中国家的条件决定了它们可以抛弃管理不善、效率低下的福利计划而另辟蹊径。
en: But such schemes should not be dismissed in the developing world, where conditions are such that they could offer an affordable alternative to administratively unwieldy and ineffective welfare programs.

zh: 基本收入不是万灵丹；但对于生活在极端贫困之中的超负荷工作的发展中国家公民而言，基本收入显然可以让他们喘口气。
en: Basic incomes are no panacea; but for overworked developing-country citizens living in extreme poverty, they would certainly be a relief.

zh: 全球南部的医疗创新
en: Health-Care Innovation in the Global South

zh: 达卡 — — 每天都有儿童死于可预防和治疗的腹泻和肺炎等疾病，这些受害者绝大多数来自发展中国家。
en: DHAKA – Children die from preventable and treatable conditions like diarrhea and pneumonia every day, with the developing world accounting for the majority of victims.

zh: 在资源贫乏环境中提供具有成本效益的创新方案其必要性已经不能再明显了。
en: The need to produce innovative and cost-effective solutions that can be delivered in resource-deprived settings could not be more apparent.

zh: 以占5岁以下儿童死亡人数15%的肺炎为例，15%意味着每年致死近百万儿童。
en: Consider pneumonia, which accounts for 15% of all deaths of children under five years old – nearly a million children – each year.

zh: “新生儿呼吸机 ” （ 持续气道正压通气）是因严重肺炎入院儿童治疗的关键部分，由压缩机为患者输送氧气，从而在整个治疗过程中保证连续的空气流。
en: A key component of the treatment of hospitalized children with severe pneumonia is “bubble CPAP” (continuous positive airway pressure), in which a compressor delivers oxygen to the patient, ensuring a continuous flow of air during the treatment process.

zh: 在发达国家，持续气道正压通气这样的呼吸支持主要由机械式呼吸机负责提供。
en: In the developed world, mechanical ventilators provide the respiratory support of bubble CPAP.

zh: 但发展中国家的医疗体系无法负担价格昂贵的机械式呼吸装置，从而导致成百上千万的全球南部患者得不到挽救生命的持续气道正压通气治疗。
en: But mechanical ventilators are far too expensive for developing-country health systems, leaving millions of patients in much of the Global South without access to life-saving bubble CPAP.

zh: 凭借专业医学知识和创新思维，我在医疗研究机构icddr,b的同事契斯堤（Jobayer Chisti）用空洗发水瓶和塑料管等即使在贫困国家都随处可见的原料研发了一种简单廉价的持续气道正压通气替代疗法。
en: But with a combination of medical expertise and inventive thinking, Jobayer Chisti, my colleague at the health research organization icddr,b, has developed a simple and affordable alternative to bubble CPAP using materials that are readily available even in poor countries, such as empty shampoo bottles and plastic tubing.

zh: 去年，契斯堤率领其团队与来自澳大利亚的同事合作，在澳大利亚国际发展署的资助下在孟加拉国开展了一项临床实验，比较这种替代设备和世卫组织在资源匮乏环境下推荐的低或高流量吸氧疗法的实际效果。
en: Last year, Chisti and his team, in collaboration with colleagues from Australia and with funding from the Australian Agency for International Development, conducted a clinical trial in Bangladesh to compare the efficacy of this alternative apparatus to the low- and high-flow oxygen therapies recommended by the World Health Organization in resource-poor contexts.

zh: 这项试验取得了振奋人心的成果。
en: The results were inspiring.

zh: 结果显示这种超低成本设备提供的治疗与标准的低或高流量吸氧疗法有着同样的效果。
en: Bubble CPAP delivered with the ultra-low cost apparatus was shown to be as effective as the standard low- and high-flow oxygen therapies.

zh: 事实上，用简易持续气道正压通气设备治疗的婴儿死亡率仅有4 % ， 而接受低流量吸氧治疗的婴儿死亡率则为15 % 。
en: In fact, just 4% of infants died when treated with the improvised bubble CPAP device, compared with 15% of those receiving low-flow oxygen therapy.

zh: 进一步测试契斯堤替代性持续气道正压通气疗法 — — 更不用说在无法提供常规疗法的地区进行应用 — — 的理由是十分清楚的。
en: The case for further testing of Chisti’s alternative bubble CPAP delivery system – not to mention its implementation in places where alternative treatments are not available – is clear.

zh: 如果未来的试验能表现出同样出色的疗效，那么低成本的气泡新生儿呼吸机可以成为资源匮乏地区治疗肺炎的标准疗法，从而每年可以因此挽救成千上万条生命。
en: If future trials demonstrate similar high efficacy, low-cost bubble CPAP could become the standard of care for pneumonia in resource-deprived settings, potentially saving thousands of lives every year.

zh: 但契斯堤研究的影响��远远不止其发明本身。
en: But Chisti’s research has implications far beyond the invention itself.

zh: 他进一步证明了一直在引领我本人在icddr,b妇幼保健司的工作的理论，即在资源匮乏地区生活和工作的创新人士最有可能完成高成本效益疗法的研发及测试工作。
en: It reinforces the idea, which has been a defining motivation of my own work leading the Maternal and Child Health Division at icddr,b, that innovators living and working in resource-poor settings are among the best equipped to develop and test cost-effective health solutions.

zh: 毕竟，最了解脆弱的医疗系统本身限制的莫过于其中的工作者。
en: After all, nobody understands the limitations of a weak health-care system better than someone who has to work in one.

zh: 这也告诉我们为什么像icddr,b这样全球联网并植根于发展中国家的医疗研究机构是非常宝贵的。
en: That is why globally networked, developing-country-based health research institutes like icddr,b are invaluable.

zh: 它们为当地研究创新人士提供了了解外人可能永远无法了解的机遇的平台，并在完全切合设计目的的环境中设计和评估他们的想法。
en: They provide a platform for local researchers and innovators to recognize opportunities that an outsider may never see, and to develop and evaluate their ideas in the precise environment for which they are designed.

zh: 利用搜集到的数据，发展中国家医疗创新人士可以搭建起临床进步转化为国家公共政策的平台，上述平台不仅适用于他们自己的国家，而且对世界各地资源匮乏的社区全都适用。
en: With the data they collect, developing-country health-care innovators can set the stage for their clinical advances to be transformed into national public policies, not just in their own countries, but in resource-deprived communities worldwide.

zh: 最终的结果有望彻底改变世界各地被忽视的贫困人口的生活。
en: The results promise to transform the lives of neglected and impoverished people everywhere.

zh: 血液探秘
en: Blood Quest

zh: 华盛顿—在最发达国家，病人对输血安全性有信心。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – In most developed countries, patients can be confident about the safety of blood transfusions.

zh: 问题是保持稳定的无污染献血源有时并不容易。
en: The problem is that maintaining a steady, uncontaminated supply of donor blood is not always easy.

zh: 有没有希望保证随时随地都有安全血液的充足供应？
en: Is it possible to ensure an adequate supply of safe blood once and for all?

zh: 当今血液供给 — — 通常来自志愿捐献 — — 可能被艾滋病和其他病原污染。
en: Today’s blood supplies, often donated by volunteers, can be contaminated with HIV and other infectious agents.

zh: 献血者献的血必须冷藏，保质期为28天。
en: And donor blood must be kept in cold storage, where it has a 28-day shelf life.

zh: 出于污染担忧 — — 以及更持久血源的军事利益 — — 血液的合成替代品研究长期以来一直是医学的优先发展项目。
en: Given fear of contamination – and military interest in a more durable supply – research into synthetic alternatives has long been a medical priority.

zh: 使用血液替代品的思想起源于17世纪，至今仍吸引着研究者。
en: The idea of using blood substitutes was first advanced in the seventeenth century, and continues to attract researchers today.

zh: 在寻找储藏稳定、携带便捷、普遍是用的血液替代品（以便在战场等极端环境中代替标准输血操作）的过程中，一些可能引起输血医学革命的产品已经被开发出来。
en: Several products that could revolutionize transfusion medicine have already been developed in the pursuit of shelf-stable, portable, one-type-fits-all blood substitutes, which could replace standard blood transfusions in extreme situations, such as on the battlefield.

zh: 但是，拜重大科学挑战所赐，在三十多年的积极研究和开发后，仍未有可临床使用的产品获得监管批准。
en: But, after more than three decades of active research and development, no clinically viable product has obtained regulatory approval, owing to the significant scientific challenges.

zh: 血液是复杂的混合液体，包含了血浆蛋白质、红细胞、血小板和其他细胞成分。
en: Blood is a complicated stew of plasma proteins, red blood cells, platelets, and other cellular components.

zh: 这些元素实现着关键功能，比如输送氧气、营养物质和免疫球蛋白（可防卫传染病 ） ， 并调节水含量、温度和pH水平。
en: These elements perform crucial functions, such as transporting oxygen, nutrients, and immunoglobulins (which defend against infection), and regulating water content, temperature, and pH level.

zh: 20世纪初，研究者开始考察红细胞中的血红蛋白 — — 负责将氧气从呼吸器官送到身体其他部位的蛋白质。
en: In the early twentieth century, researchers began to examine hemoglobin – the protein responsible for carrying oxygen from the respiratory organs to the rest of the body – in red blood cells.

zh: 他们发现，从老化细胞中分离出来后 — — 不管来自人血或牛血，还是通过基因工程获得 — — 自由血红蛋白可以重新焕发活力，化学结构稳定，并能作为血液“替代品”用于注射，其携氧效率不输于红细胞，但携氧时间短得多。
en: They found that, when isolated from aging cells – whether from human or cow blood, or from genetically engineered sources – free hemoglobin can be rejuvenated, chemically stabilized, and re-infused as a blood “substitute” that can carry oxygen as effectively as red blood cells, but for a much shorter time.

zh: （无血红蛋白的合成血液替代品，即所谓的氟碳化合物，携氧效率就比较低。 ）
en: (Non-hemoglobin synthetic blood substitutes, known as fluorocarbons, have proved to be less effective oxygen carriers.)

zh: 但自由血红蛋白可能在人体内造成严重破坏，造成高血压、心脏骤停甚至死亡。
en: But free hemoglobin can wreak havoc in the human body, causing hypertension, cardiac arrest, or even death.

zh: 事实上，在几乎所有生物中，血红蛋白都被封闭在红细胞中，以保护肢体免受这种蛋白质的消极作用（并反过来保护血红蛋白免受肢体消化酶的作用 ） 。
en: Indeed, in almost all living creatures, hemoglobin is encapsulated in red blood cells, which protect the body from the protein’s negative effects (and, in turn, protect hemoglobin from the body’s digestive enzymes).

zh: 尽管如此，专家仍相信，基于血红蛋白的产品可以用于拯救外伤病人，也能治疗因为宗教原因拒绝献血血源的患者（比如耶和华见证人（Jehovah’s Witnesses）信徒 ） 。
en: Experts nonetheless believe that hemoglobin-based products can be used to save the lives of trauma patients, as well as to treat patients who object to donated blood on religious grounds (for example, Jehovah’s Witnesses).

zh: 血红蛋白包含了亚铁血红素，一种含有铁元素的化合物。 铁是一种过渡金属，可以氧化（或曰“生锈 ） 。
en: Hemoglobin contains hemes, chemical compounds that contain iron – a transition metal that can undergo oxidation, or “rusting” processes.

zh: 在红细胞之外 ， “ 好”的亚铁 — — 唯一的携氧形式 — — 被不可控地氧化，形成“坏”的三价铁和“丑”的高价铁的血红蛋白形式。
en: Outside of red blood cells, “good” ferrous iron – the only oxygen-carrying form – is oxidized uncontrollably to form the “bad” ferric and “ugly” ferryl forms of hemoglobin.

zh: 当血红蛋白被释放到人的循环系统中时，高价铁形式最终会自我毁灭，伤害周围组织的分子。
en: When released into a person’s circulatory system, hemoglobin in these higher oxidation states eventually self-destructs, damaging molecules in surrounding tissue.

zh: 由于这些有害形式的血红蛋白难以在活着的系统中予以研究，研究者一般都忽视它们。
en: Given that these mischievous forms of hemoglobin are difficult to study in living systems, researchers have largely ignored them.

zh: 反之，他们将注意力集中在防止肾脏过滤输入的血红蛋白；防止血红蛋白漏出血管壁；以及防止合成血红蛋白破坏一氧化氮上（一氧化氮是血管内产生的气体，它有助于血管膨胀，增加血流 ） 。
en: Instead, they have focused on strategies for preventing the kidneys from filtering the infused hemoglobin; the hemoglobin from leaking through the blood-vessel walls; and synthetic hemoglobin from destroying nitric oxide (a gas produced in blood vessels that helps them to dilate and increase blood flow).

zh: 一些研究者认为一氧化氮的反应最有问题，因为这增加了血压。
en: Some researchers consider the reaction with nitric oxide the most problematic, because it raises blood pressure.

zh: 但在寻找控制这些氧化反应方面已经取得了进步。
en: But progress has been made in finding ways to control these oxidation reactions.

zh: 研究者（包括我的实验室）已经研究了肢体如何自然处理偶然从老化红细胞和受血液疾病（如溶血性贫血）影响的细胞中释放出来的血红蛋白。
en: Researchers (including at my laboratory) have investigated how the body naturally handles the occasional release of hemoglobin from aging red blood cells and from cells affected by blood diseases, such as hemolytic anemia.

zh: 他们发现，肢体的第一道血红蛋白氧化作用防线是一个还原过程，在这个过程中，尿酸分子和抗坏血酸（维生素C）分子通过将铁还原为较难氧化的形式来阻止氧化。
en: They have found that the body’s first line of defense against hemoglobin oxidation is a process of reduction, in which molecules like uric acid or ascorbic acid (vitamin C) impede oxidation by reducing the iron to a less oxidizing species.

zh: 此外，血液中含有一些蛋白质，专门用来清扫血红蛋白及其碎片。
en: Moreover, a host of blood proteins are specialized scavengers of hemoglobin or its fragments.

zh: 它们降低血红蛋白的毒性，安全地将其清除，为在被称为巨噬细胞的专门作用细胞中的后续过程做准备。
en: They reduce its toxicity and safely clear it for further processing within specialized cells called macrophages.

zh: 比如，触珠蛋白紧紧地绑定于血红蛋白的亚基上，而血液结合素在血红蛋白释放亚铁血红素将它们捉住。
en: For example, haptoglobin tightly binds to hemoglobin subunits, while hemopexin captures the heme when the hemoglobin releases it.

zh: 最新的治疗可能性包括将触珠蛋白与血红蛋白一起注入循环系统，或者将维生素C作为添加成分，以此增加安全有效的血液替代品开发的成功机会。
en: Some recent therapeutic possibilities include the co-infusion of haptoglobin with hemoglobin in circulation or with vitamin C – additives that hold promising implications for the development of safe and effective blood substitutes.

zh: 研究者必须以这些进步为基础。
en: Researchers must build on this progress.

zh: 让输血更有效的安全血液替代品和新治疗选择将显著改进挑战性状况的治疗。
en: Safe blood substitutes and new therapeutic options that make blood transfusion more effective would significantly improve treatment in challenging situations.

zh: 最终，这可以拯救大量生命。
en: Ultimately, that promises to save many lives.

zh: 填补医疗数据缺口
en: Closing the Health-Care Data Gap

zh: 波士顿—如今，世界许多地方饱受信息过载之苦，但仍有一些地方信息稀缺。
en: BOSTON – While much of the world today suffers from information overload, there are still places where information is scarce.

zh: 而这种稀缺有时候会让人们失去生命。
en: And that scarcity sometimes costs people their lives.

zh: 在桑给巴尔最大的公共卫生机构Mnazi Mmoja医院的产科病房，患者数据都写在一块白板上。
en: In the maternity ward of Zanzibar’s largest public-health facility, Mnazi Mmoja Hospital, patient data are listed on a dry-erase board.

zh: 上面的信息包括接收妇女数量、她们的状况的类型和严重性以及她们是否存活下来。
en: The information on the board consists of the number of women admitted, the type and severity of their conditions, and whether or not they survived.

zh: 这些数据充其量只是聊胜于无。
en: These data may be better than nothing, but not by much.

zh: 没有日期或时间戳，也没有长期存档系统。
en: There are no dates or timestamps or long-term filing systems.

zh: 给白板拍照是严格禁止的，因此记录只能保持到被擦去为止。
en: With photographs of the board strictly forbidden, records last only as long as they are on it.

zh: 桑给巴尔对卫生记录的态度并非独此一家。
en: Zanzibar’s attitude toward health records is not unique.

zh: 事实上，桑给巴尔也许比整个非洲和亚洲的许多其他地方谨慎多了，很多地方根本没有数据收集系统。
en: In fact, Zanzibar is probably more careful than many other places throughout in Africa and Asia, where data-collection systems simply do not exist.

zh: 当一个国家数据赤字如此严重时，其公共卫生政策、预算和战略只能由政治权宜或猜测决定。
en: When a country suffers from such a data deficit, its public-health policies, budgets, and strategies are decided by political expediency or guesswork.

zh: 有时猜测正确，但大部分时间是错误的。
en: Sometimes the guesses are right, but most often they are not.

zh: 这是发展中世界所面临的一个重大卫生制度挑战。
en: This is a major challenge for health-care systems in the developing world.

zh: 收集所有患者的准确数据（同时尊重隐私）对于应对公共卫生威胁、护理过失和医疗错误来说至关重要，也是让影响整个社会或国家的公共卫生问题讨论变得公开诚实的必要条件。
en: Collecting accurate information on all patients (while still respecting privacy) is vital to tracking public-health threats, lapses in care, and medical errors, and is a necessary and essential condition for holding open and honest debates about health-care issues that can affect entire communities or countries.

zh: 据约翰霍普金斯大学医学院的马丁·马卡里（Martin Makary）和迈克尔·丹尼尔（Michael Daniel）在《英国医学期刊 》 （ British Medical Journal）上的分析，在美国，医疗错误是第三大致死原因，仅次于心脏病和癌症。
en: According to a British Medical Journal analysis by Martin Makary and Michael Daniel of the Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, in the United States, medical errors alone are the third leading cause of death, after heart disease and cancer.

zh: 在他们的分析中，医疗错误包括坏医生、糟糕的临床判断、工作人员或科室之间的沟通不畅以及误诊等。
en: In the context of their analysis, medical errors could include bad doctors, poor clinical judgment, miscommunications between staff members or departments, and incorrect diagnoses.

zh: 没有理由认为这一问题仅限于美国。
en: There is no reason to think this problem is confined to the US.

zh: 发展中国家的医疗条件往往面临更严峻的挑战，如医院管理层技术能力不足、人手短缺、缺乏优质训练、医疗品质低劣、医疗渎职惩罚相对不力等。
en: Health-care settings in the developing world often face even steeper challenges, such as lack of technical capacity among hospital management, staff shortages, poor training, low-quality medicines, and relative impunity for medical malpractice.

zh: 不幸的是，由于我们的数据过于有限，无从知道这些因素对发展中国家拙劣的健康结果和可避免的死亡的影响程度有多大。
en: Unfortunately, because we have such limited data, we cannot know the extent to which any of these factors contribute to poor health outcomes and avoidable deaths in developing countries.

zh: 可靠的数据不但有望拯救无数生命，还能降低成本，包括财务成本和心理成本。
en: Aside from potentially saving countless lives, reliable data can reduce costs, financially and psychologically.

zh: 尽管在遏制艾滋病、疟疾和结核病方面取得了巨大进步，但中低收入国家的医疗财务负担仍然非常大。
en: The financial burden of health care in low- and middle-income countries is substantial, despite the progress that has been made in fighting HIV, malaria, and tuberculosis.

zh: 除了这些部分是因为认识充分而得到治疗和追踪的疾病，许多疾病根本没有得到识别，仍在制约公共卫生服务。
en: Beyond these diseases, for which there is treatment and tracking, thanks partly to ample awareness, many illnesses go unidentified and continue to strain public-health services.

zh: 对于疾病负担高昂、存在宗法等级制度以及以来传统医学的庞大而分散的农村人口的社会来说，认识死亡的共同原因是改善医疗的唯一办法。
en: Understanding common causes of death is the only way to improve health care in communities with a high disease burden, patriarchal hierarchies, and large and dispersed rural populations that rely on traditional medicine.

zh: 在这样的环境中，患者与医生的很少有互动，因此抓住一切机会收集记录很重要。
en: In these settings, patient interactions with doctors are rare, so it is important to collect records on them at every opportunity.

zh: 不同的社会医疗需求也不同，充分理解需求何在并不容易。
en: Different societies have different health-care needs, and fully comprehending what they are is no easy task.

zh: 但我们可以从三个步骤开始这一过程。
en: But we can begin the process with three steps.

zh: 首先是社区内部的意识创造。
en: The first is to create awareness within communities.

zh: 所有人都希望自己和所爱的人获得健康和有活力的生活，因此他们必定欢迎关于所在社区的人为何死亡或得病的洞见。
en: All people want healthy and productive lives for themselves and their loved ones, so they will welcome new insights into why people in their community die or get sick.

zh: 在公民新闻（citizen journalism）和社交媒体时代，即使在贫穷国家，公共意识运动也要比从前更加容易。
en: With the advent of citizen journalism and social media, even in poor countries, public-awareness campaigns are now more affordable than ever.

zh: 第二步是制定更好的收集数据方法。
en: The second step is to devise better ways to collect data.

zh: 许多发展中国家缺少使用复杂数据收集工具所需要的资金、基础设施和训练；但这并不意味着它们不能在数据收集方面取得重大进步。
en: Many developing countries lack the funds, infrastructure, and training needed to use sophisticated data-collection tools; but that doesn’t mean they can’t make significant improvements in data collection.

zh: 哈佛大学公共卫生学院的阿图尔·贾万德（Atul Gawande）指出，简单的检查清单就可以在数据收集和做出更佳决策方面起到效果。
en: As Atul Gawande of Harvard University’s School of Public Health has shown, simple checklists can be effective in both collecting data and making better decisions.

zh: 如果卫生工作者和决策者知道哪些数据有用、为什么有用，就能能改变公共卫生结果。
en: If health-care workers and policymakers know which data are useful and why, they will already be in a better position to change public-health outcomes.

zh: 最后一步是建立透明的数据收集监督。
en: The final step is to establish transparent oversight of the data being collected.

zh: 一些数据可能引起政治不适或反直觉结果，导致政客将它们隐瞒。
en: Some data may point to politically inconvenient or counterintuitive conclusions, and politicians could be tempted to sweep it under the rug.

zh: 在社交媒体和开放新闻时代，我们应该要求新收集数据对各类公共卫生问题研究者和卫生机构工作者开放。
en: In the age of social media and open-access journals, we should demand that newly collected data be made available to a broad range of people researching public-health issues and working in health-care settings.

zh: 说到底，我们也许无法阻止某种疾病所引起的死亡。
en: Ultimately, we may not be able to prevent deaths caused by certain illnesses.

zh: 但有了更多信息，我们就有能力防止那些因为我们的自满或无能而引起的疾病。
en: But with more information, it is within our power to prevent those deaths that are caused by our own complacency or incompetence.

zh: 发展3.0
en: Development 3.0

zh: 北京 — — 在工业革命以前，世界各国人均收入相当。
en: BEIJING – Until the Industrial Revolution, the world was quite flat in terms of per capita income.

zh: 但是从那以后，随着一些西方工业化国家在政治和经济方面迅速统治世界，各国财富急速分化。
en: But then fortunes rapidly diverged, with a few Western industrialized countries quickly achieving political and economic dominance worldwide.

zh: 近些年，即使是在爆发2008年金融危机之前，全球经济形势已发生了显著变化。
en: In recent years – even before the financial crisis erupted in 2008 – it was clear that the global economic landscape had shifted again.

zh: 直到2000年,七大工业国约占全球GDP的三分之二。
en: Until 2000, the G-7 accounted for about two-thirds of global GDP.

zh: 今天,中国和一些大型发展中国家已经成为世界发展的领头人。
en: Today, China and a few large developing countries have become the world’s growth leaders.

zh: 然而,尽管是在谈论亚洲的崛起,但是在过去几十年中只有少数的东亚经济体实现了从低收入到高收入的转变。
en: Yet, despite talk of a rising Asia, only a handful of East Asian economies have moved from low- to high-income status during the past several decades.

zh: 此外，从1950年到2008年，世界上只有28个经济体能够以十个百分点或者更快的速度缩小与美国的人均收入差距，其中只有12个非西方经济体。
en: Moreover, between 1950 and 2008, only 28 economies in the world – and only 12 non-Western economies – were able to narrow their per capita income gap with the United States by ten percentage points or more.

zh: 与此同时,150多个国家被困在低收入或中等收入的状态中。
en: Meanwhile, more than 150 countries have been trapped in low- or middle-income status.

zh: 缩小与高收入工业化国家的差距仍是世界发展面临的主要挑战。
en: Narrowing the gap with industrialized high-income countries continues to be the world’s main development challenge.

zh: 二战后的后殖民时期，结构主义模式是主流的发展模式，目标是为了改变贫困国家的产业结构，使其与高收入国家的产业结构相似。
en: In the post-colonial period following World War II, the prevailing development paradigm was a form of structuralism: the aim was to change poor countries’ industrial structure to resemble that of high-income countries.

zh: 通常，结构主义者会建议政府采取进口替代策略，通过公共部门的干预来克服“市场失灵 ” 。
en: Structuralists typically advised governments to adopt import-substitution strategies, using public-sector intervention to overcome “market failures.”

zh: 称此为“发展经济学1.0 ” 。
en: Call this “Development Economics 1.0.”

zh: 采用这种方式的国家，获得了初始投资导向型的成功，紧随其后的是不断的危机和萧条。
en: Countries that adhered to it experienced initial investment-led success, followed by repeated crises and stagnation.

zh: 从“发展思想”转变成新自由主义华盛顿共识，即私有化，自由化，稳定化，这些将会给发展中国家带去理想化的市场体系，这些体系在发达国家已经建立起来了。
en: Development thinking then shifted to the neoliberal Washington Consensus: privatization, liberalization, and stabilization would introduce to developing countries the idealized market institutions that had been established in advanced countries.

zh: 称此为“发展经济学2.0 ” 。
en: Call this “Development Economics 2.0.”

zh: 华盛顿共识改革的结果充其量也就只引起了一点争议，但在许多发展中国家，一些经济学家甚至将20世纪八九十年代描述为“迷失的年代 ” 。
en: The results of the Washington Consensus reforms were at best controversial, and some economists have even described the 1980’s and 1990’s as “lost decades” in many developing countries.

zh: 鉴于发展中国家持续贫困,双边捐助者和全球发展社区越来越关注该地区的教育和卫生项目,既是出于人道主义的原因又是为了带来经济增长。
en: Given persistent poverty in developing countries, bilateral donors and the global development community increasingly focused on education and health programs, both for humanitarian reasons and to generate growth.

zh: 但是服务提供系统却不尽人意，所以焦点转移到促进该项目的绩效，埃斯特·迪弗洛等麻省理工学院贫穷行动实验室的研究人员率先对此进行了随机对照试验。
en: But service delivery remained disappointing, so the focus shifted to improving project performance, which researchers like Esther Duflo at MIT’s Poverty Action Lab have pioneered with randomized controlled experiments.

zh: 我称其为“发展经济学2.5 ” .
en: I call this “Development Economics 2.5.”

zh: 在北非的旧体制下，人们的教育程度大幅提高，但是却没能促进经济发展，也没能给受过教育的青年创造就业机会。 从北非的经历来看，这种发展政策的有效性值得怀疑。
en: But, judging from experience in North Africa, where education improved greatly under the old regimes, but failed to boost growth performance and create job opportunities for educated youth, the validity of such an approach as a fundamental model for development policy is dubious.

zh: 实现了动态增长和工业化的东亚及其他经济体,没有采取进口替代策略。 相反，他们追求出口导向型增长。
en: The East Asian and other economies that achieved dynamic growth and became industrialized did not follow import-substitution strategies; instead, they pursued export-oriented growth.

zh: 同样地，毛里求斯、中国和越南没有施行华盛顿共识所提倡的快速自由化（所谓的“休克疗法 ” ） ，他们遵循一种双轨渐进的方法（但是各种管理指标却一直表现很差 ） 。
en: Likewise, countries like Mauritius, China, and Vietnam did not implement rapid liberalization (so-called “shock therapy”), which the Washington Consensus advocated; instead, they followed a dual-track gradual approach (and often continued to perform poorly on various governance indicators).

zh: 在教育，卫生，缓解贫困和其他人类发展指标方面，两组国家都取得了巨大进展。
en: Both groups of countries achieved great advances in education, health, poverty reduction, and other human development indicators.

zh: 他们都没有使用随机控制实验来设计他们的社会或经济项目。
en: None of them used randomized control experiments to design their social or economic programs.

zh: 如今，需要一个“发展经济学3.0 ” 。
en: Today, a “Development Economics 3.0” is needed.

zh: 我认为，从认识一个国家的经济结构到促使其改变，这种转化如同将婴儿和洗澡水一起倒掉。
en: In my view, the shift from understanding the determinants of a country’s economic structure and facilitating its change is tantamount to throwing the baby out with the bath water.

zh: 记住，亚当·斯密将其巨著称为《对国民财富产生的原因和性质的研究 》 （ 简称《国富论 》 ） 。
en: Remember that Adam Smith called his great work An Inquiry into the Nature and Causes of the Wealth of Nations.

zh: 同样，发展经济学应该建立在现代经济增长的产生原因和性质的研究之上，也就是，在经济发展过程中的结构变化的研究。
en: In a similar spirit, development economics should be built on inquiries into the nature and causes of modern economic growth – that is, on structural change in the process of economic development.

zh: 迄今为止 ， “ 发展思想”主要关注发展中国家所没有的（发达国家的资本密集型产业 ） ， 以及发达国家表现较好的方面（华盛顿共识的政策和管理方式 ） ， 或者是在人道主义立场看来很重要但并未直接导致结构变化的方面（卫生和教育 ） 。
en: Development thinking so far has focused on what developing countries do not have (developed countries’ capital-intensive industries); on areas in which developed countries perform better (Washington Consensus policies and governance); or on areas that are important from a humanitarian point of view but do not directly contribute to structural change (health and education).

zh: 在《新结构经济学》一书中，我提出，以发展中国家所拥有的（他们的禀赋）为基础，将焦点转向他们好的方面（他们的相对优势 ） 。
en: In my book New Structural Economics, I propose shifting the focus to areas where developing countries can do well (their comparative advantages) based on what they have (their endowments).

zh: 动态结构变化从那里开���,成功将孕育成功。
en: With dynamic structural change starting from there, success will breed success.

zh: 在我们这个全球化的世界,一个国家的最佳产业结构，即所有的产业都符合国家的相对优势，在国内国际市场具有竞争优势，这种产业结构是由该国的禀赋结构所决定的。
en: In our globalized world, a country’s optimal industrial structure – in which all industries are consistent with the country’s comparative advantages and are competitive in domestic and international markets – is determined by its endowment structure.

zh: 一个运转良好的市场需要激励国内企业的投资选择与该国的竞争优势相一致。
en: A well-functioning market is required to provide incentives to domestic firms to align their investment choices with the country’s comparative advantages.

zh: 如果整个国家的企业能这样做，那么该国的经济将会具有竞争力，资本将会迅速积累，禀赋结构将会改变，有竞争优势的领域将会转化，经济也会需要升级其产业结构到一个相对较高的资本密集度。
en: If a country’s firms can do that, the economy will be competitive, capital will accumulate quickly, the endowment structure will change, areas of comparative advantages will shift, and the economy will need to upgrade its industrial structure to a relatively higher level of capital intensity.

zh: 所以，成功的产业升级和经济多元化需要首位行动者,而且需要技能、物流、交通、融资渠道的提升,以及其他各种变化,许多都超出了首位行动者的能力。
en: So successful industrial upgrading and economic diversification requires first-movers, and improvements in skills, logistics, transportation, access to finance, and various other changes, many of which are beyond the first-movers’ capacity.

zh: 政府需要提供足够的鼓励措施,来激励首位行动者,而且应该发挥积极作用,提供必要的改进措施或协调私人公司在那些领域的投资。
en: Governments need to provide adequate incentives to encourage first-movers, and should play an active role in providing the required improvements or coordinating private firms’ investments in those areas.

zh: 很明显，结构改变具有创新性。
en: Structural change is, by definition, innovative.

zh: 发展中国家，通过复制高收入国家的结构变化，可能会因此受益于自己的后发优势。
en: Developing countries may benefit from the advantage of backwardness by replicating the structural change that has already occurred in higher-income countries.

zh: 基于成功国家的经验，每一个发展中国家在几十年里有可能继续保持8%的年增长率(或更高 ) ， 在一代或两代里成为中等收入甚至是高收入国家。
en: Based on the experiences of successful countries, every developing country has the potential to sustain 8% annual growth (or higher) for several decades, and to become a middle- or even a high-income country in one or two generations.

zh: 关键是要有正确的政策框架，促进私营企业与国家的比较优势相一致，在结构变化的过程中受益于后发优势。
en: The key is to have the right policy framework in place to facilitate private-sector alignment with the country’s comparative advantages, and to benefit from latecomer advantages in the process of structural change.

zh: 以发展为目的的发展援助
en: Development Aid for Development’s Sake

zh: 几乎日复一日，美国和欧洲都在威胁一些弱小国家的政府接受它们的政治束缚，不然就要进行经济制裁或停止发展援助。
en: Almost daily, the United States and Europe brandish threats to impose economic sanctions or cut off development assistance unless some vulnerable government accepts their political strictures.

zh: 最近一次这样的威胁是针对新当选的以哈马斯为首的巴勒斯坦政府。
en: The most recent threats are towards the new Hamas-led government in Palestine.

zh: 不久前曾受到过类似威胁的还有乍得、埃塞俄比亚、海地、肯尼亚、玻利维亚、乌干达等国政府，缅甸政府也一直受到西方的长期制裁。
en: Other recent examples include threats vis-à-vis Chad, Ethiopia, Haiti, Kenya, Bolivia, Uganda, and long-standing sanctions against Myanmar.

zh: 这样的策略是错误的。
en: Such tactics are misguided.

zh: 把发展援助作为一种政治武器只会加深不稳定的贫困国家所受的痛苦，而无法实现援助国希望实现的政治目标。
en: The use of development aid as a political stick merely deepens the suffering of impoverished and unstable countries, without producing the political objectives sought by donors.

zh: 了解个中原因需要长期关注地缘政治，特别是美国和欧洲全球霸权的逐步衰落。
en: To understand why requires taking a long-term view of geopolitics, particularly the gradual decline of US and European global domination.

zh: 亚洲和发展中世界正在经历技术和经济的快速发展，过去一百年间文化和政治觉悟的迅速普及已经使国家自主成为我们这个时代不可动摇的信念，结束了殖民主义的统治。
en: Technology and economic development are proliferating across Asia and the developing world, while the spread of literacy and political awareness during the past century made national self-determination by far the dominant ideology of our age, leading to the end of colonialism.

zh: 民族主义还催生了反对美国和欧洲强权的“抗体 ” ， 不再允许发达国家干涉其它国家的内部事务。
en: Nationalism continues to produce powerful political “antibodies” to American and European meddling in other countries’ internal affairs.

zh: 正是由于对这一点缺乏了解，至少从1979年推翻伊朗王朝后，美国在中东的外交政策就屡遭挫折。
en: The failure to understand this lies behind repeated US foreign policy debacles in the Middle East, at least since the toppling of the Shah of Iran in 1979.

zh: 美国继续天真地把伊朗当作可以操纵的木偶，无论是出于争夺石油还是别的什么目的。
en: The US naively continues to view the Middle East as an object of manipulation, whether for oil or for other purposes.

zh: 在中东地区，大多数人认为美国是为了控制波斯湾石油才发动的伊拉克战争¾这种看法似是而非，因为我们都清楚这场战争的真正缘由。
en: In the Middle East, the Iraq war is widely interpreted as a war for US control of Persian Gulf oil – a rather plausible view given what we know about the war’s true origins.

zh: 错就错在令人难以置信的傲慢和天真使美国（和英国）领导人相信：人们会像迎接救星那样欢迎西方军队，而不会把他们看成占领者。
en: Only incredible hubris and naiveté could bring US (and UK) leaders to believe that Western troops would be greeted as liberators rather than as occupiers.

zh: 对外援助的政治化同样反映了这种傲慢自大。
en: The politicization of foreign aid reflects the same hubris.

zh: 即便美国一再声称支持中东民主，它对哈马斯获胜的第一反应就是要求新当选的政府归还5000万美元的美国援助。
en: Even as the US rhetorically champions democracy in the Middle East, its first response to Hamas’s victory was to demand that the newly elected government return $50 million in US aid.

zh: 期望长久和平的人的确无法接受哈马斯的宗旨，这一点甚至像埃及这样的阿拉伯国家都有过明确的表示。
en: Hamas’s doctrines are indeed unacceptable for long-term peace, as even some Arab states, such as Egypt, have made clear.

zh: 但取消援助更有可能的结果是加剧混乱，而不是使以色列和巴勒斯坦之间达成能为人所接受的长期妥协。
en: But cutting aid is likely to increase turmoil rather than leading to an acceptable long-term compromise between Israel and Palestine.

zh: 一届新当选的巴勒斯坦政府至少刚开始时理应得到合理的对待。
en: A newly elected Palestinian government should be treated, at least initially, with legitimacy.

zh: 今后，如果它支持恐怖，行为恶劣，我们可以改变政策。
en: Later, if it behaves badly by sponsoring terror, policies can change.

zh: 取消援助应该是最后采取的非常手段，而不是迎头一击。
en: An aid cutoff should be a policy of last resort, not a first strike.

zh: 取消援助一般不会带来预期的政治效果，这里面至少有两个原因。
en: Aid cutoffs regularly fail to produce desired political results for at least two reasons.

zh: 首先，无论是美国还是欧洲国家都没有裁定政府好坏的合法权利。
en: First, neither the US nor European countries have much standing as legitimate arbiters of “good governance.”

zh: 富裕国家尽管自己腐败无能，长期以来却一直对其它国家的内政指手画脚。
en: Rich countries have long meddled, often with their own corruption and incompetence, in the internal affairs of the countries that they now lecture.

zh: 美国鼓吹“优秀统治 ” ， 但自己内部也爆出种种丑闻：无缘无故对别国发动战争、议会发生贿赂事件以及像哈利佰顿（Halliburton）这样与政治有染的公司在一夜之间大发横财。
en: The US preaches “good governance” in the shadow of an unprovoked war, congressional bribery scandals, and windfalls for politically connected companies like Halliburton.

zh: 其次，无论从哪个角度来讲，美国和欧洲取消援助或实施制裁的威胁除了给本已贫困潦倒、风雨飘���的国家雪上加霜之外根本起不到其它任何作用。
en: Second, US and European threats to cut off aid or impose sanctions are in any case far too weak to accomplish much besides undermining already unstable and impoverished countries.

zh: 看一下不久前取消对埃塞俄比亚援助的情况就清楚了：每年每个埃塞俄比亚人从这笔援助中只能得到约15美元¾而且这其中的很大一部分实际上还付给了来自欧美的顾问。
en: Consider the recent threats to cut Ethiopia’s aid, which is on the order of $15 per Ethiopian per year – much of it actually paid to US and European consultants.

zh: 如果认为威胁取消援助就能改变目前埃塞俄比亚国内复杂的政治走向，简直纯属是天方夜谭。
en: It is sheer fantasy to believe that the threat of an aid cutoff would enable the US and Europe to influence the course of Ethiopia’s complex internal politics.

zh: 取消对埃塞俄比亚的援助却能够令大批的穷人丧命，他们缺医少药、也得不到化肥和改良的种子。
en: An aid cutoff to Ethiopia would nonetheless lead to a lot of death among impoverished people, who will lack medicines, improved seeds, and fertilizer.

zh: 事实上，如果援助断断续续，最终的结果会非常可悲。
en: Indeed, the track record of on-again-off-again aid is miserable.

zh: 断断续续的援助已经使海地经济陷入下降的通道而无法自拔。
en: Stop-and-go aid has left Haiti in an unmitigated downward spiral.

zh: 对缅甸长达10年的制裁不仅没有使昂山素姬重新获得权力，反而加剧了那个国家的极端贫困和疾病负担。
en: The decade-long sanctions against Myanmar have not restored Aung San Suu Kyi to power, but have deepened the disease burden and extreme poverty in that country.

zh: 威胁取消对肯尼亚、乍得和其它地方的援助会使本来已经糟得不能再糟的形势进一步恶化。
en: Threatened aid cutoffs in Kenya, Chad, and elsewhere would make desperately bad situations worse.

zh: 这绝不是说美国和欧洲应该按照腐败独裁者的意愿采取行动。
en: None of this is to suggest that the US and Europe should abide every move by every corrupt dictator.

zh: 但国际经济事务中的现实主义要求我们必须承认：官方发展援助只有从长远的角度看才有可能实现稳定和民主的广泛政治目标。
en: But realism in international economic affairs requires accepting that official development assistance can help achieve the broad political objectives of stability and democracy only in the long run.

zh: 长期繁荣公正的经济发展是通向民主稳定最为可靠的道路。
en: The most reliable path to stable democracy is robust and equitable economic progress over an ample period of time.

zh: 有鉴于此，提供官方发展援助的关键标准应该是看能否真正促进经济的发展。
en: The overwhelming standard for supplying official development assistance should therefore be whether official assistance actually promotes economic development.

zh: 因此，发展援助必须可以依靠、可以预测，还必须以可以监管、可以衡量、也可以评价的方式直接满足发展需求。
en: As such, it must be reliable, predictable, and directed towards development needs in ways that can be monitored, measured, and evaluated.

zh: 能否实现对援助的管理和衡量？
en: Can the aid be monitored and measured?

zh: 款项有没有被盗用？
en: Is it being stolen?

zh: 是否支持了真正的发展需求，比如种植更多粮食？ 控制疾病或者建设交通、能源和通讯基础设施？
en: Is it supporting real development needs, such as growing more food, fighting disease, or building transport, energy, and communications infrastructure?

zh: 如果发展援助能够满足真正的需要，那么就应该把它提供给不稳定的贫困国家，确保它能够拯救生命、改善经济状况，从而改善实现民主和“优秀统治”的长远前景。
en: If development aid can be directed to real needs, then it should be given to poor and unstable countries, knowing that it will save lives, improve economic performance, and thus also improve the long-term prospects for democracy and good governance.

zh: 最大限度地利用更多援助
en: Making the Most of More Aid

zh: 巴黎 — — 消除全球贫困的努力从未如此热烈。
en: PARIS – The effort to eradicate global poverty has never been more intense.

zh: 经合组织最新数据显示2014年，官方发展援助（ODA）连续第二年达到创纪录的1，350亿美元总额。
en: In 2014, for the second consecutive year, official development assistance (ODA) totaled a historic high of $135 billion, according to new OECD data.

zh: 这表明发达经济体仍然致力于促进全球发展，尽管他们自身的经济近来也出现了问题。
en: This indicates that advanced economies remain committed to promoting global development, despite their own recent problems.

zh: 再加上中国、阿拉伯国家和拉美国家以投资和贷款形式投入的大笔支出，流向发展中国家的官方发展援助显然已经达到史无前例的金额。
en: Add to this total the substantial spending by China, Arab states, and Latin American countries in the form of investments and loans, and it is clear that flows of ODA toward the developing world have reached unprecedented levels.

zh: 但我们不能让整体数据所带来的幸福感抢走资金有效利用的风头。
en: And yet happiness about the headline numbers should not be allowed to obscure opportunities to channel these funds more effectively.

zh: 来自捐助国的官方援助协助降低了半数贫困和儿童死亡率，并带动了其他许多方面的进步。
en: Official aid from donor countries has helped to halve extreme poverty and child mortality, and it has driven progress on many other fronts as well.

zh: 但人们已经清楚地看到持续的发展援助并不足以到2030年消除极端贫困，落实将在今年下半年达成的联合国新的可持续发展目标。
en: But it is becoming clear that sustained flows of development aid will not be enough to eradicate extreme poverty by 2030 and implement the new United Nations Sustainable Development Goals, which are to be agreed upon later this year.

zh: 今天的援助款如果被用于动员国内税收和对援助依赖国进行私人投资，产生的影响将比现在大得多。
en: The money being spent on aid today could have a substantially greater impact if it were used to mobilize domestic tax flows and private investment in aid-dependent countries.

zh: 经合组合4月8日引入的新指标官方发展援助总额可以更准确地反映官方发展援助。
en: This use of ODA can be better captured in the new indicator introduced on April 8 by the OECD: Total Official Support for Development.

zh: 平均而言，发展中国家税收占GDP的17 % ， 而经合组织国家则占34%的份额。
en: On average, developing countries raise 17% of their GDP in taxes, compared with 34% in OECD countries.

zh: 某些国家税收可能仅占GDP的10 % 。
en: Some collect as little as 10%.

zh: 资金非法逃往国外解释了绝大部分的损失税收。
en: Much of the lost tax revenue escapes in illicit flows and ends up abroad.

zh: 以非洲为例，每年因非法流动损失的资金约500亿美元，远高于其所得到的发展援助总额。
en: Africa, for example, loses around $50 billion a year in illicit flows, much more than it receives in development aid.

zh: 发展中国家税收增加GDP1%所带来的资金相当于两倍的官方发展援助 — — 而且可以悉数投入教育、卫生、安全或现金支付计划。
en: Enabling developing countries to generate just 1% more of GDP in taxes would mobilize twice as much money as the total amount of ODA – and all of it could be channeled into education, health, security, or cash disbursement schemes.

zh: 加强税收体系的资金回报是非常惊人的。
en: The returns from money spent on strengthening tax systems can be staggering.

zh: 在肯尼亚，由经合组织领导的无国界税收督察项目发现与当局合作打击避税行为每投入1美元，就能带来1，290美元的增量收入。
en: In Kenya, Tax Inspectors Without Borders, a project led by the OECD, found that every dollar spent working with authorities on cracking down on tax avoidance produced $1,290 in increased revenues.

zh: 同样，在菲律宾，支持税收改革的50万美元带来了超过十亿美元的增量税收。
en: Similarly, in the Philippines, a half-million dollars provided to support tax reform generated well over $1 billion in additional tax receipts.

zh: 但今天仅有0.1 % 、 或不到1.2亿美元的发展援助被用于支持发展中国家的税收改革。
en: Yet today, only 0.1% of all development aid, just under $120 million, goes toward supporting tax systems in developing countries.

zh: 发展援助如果得到正确引导用于降低风险，也能对私人投资起带动作用。
en: Development aid, properly channeled, also has the potential to mobilize private investment if it is spent to reduce risk.

zh: 发展援助支持的担保、软性贷款和股权投资有助于吸引投资者，马里的太阳能项目和埃塞俄比亚的生产企业项目就是实例。
en: Guarantees, soft loans, and equity investments backed by development aid can help attract investors, as has occurred with solar energy projects in Mali and manufacturing plants in Ethiopia.

zh: 2014年，时任欧盟发展专员安德里斯·皮尔巴格斯报告总值为21亿欧元（合22亿美元）的拨款“从2007年来已在226个项目中实现了约407亿欧元的杠杆效果。 ”
en: In 2014, then-EU Commissioner for Development Andris Piebalgs reported that grants worth €2.1 billion ($2.2 billion) had “achieved an estimated leverage of €40.7 billion in 226 projects since 2007.”

zh: 重要的是援助针对需求最迫切的领域。
en: It is important, too, that aid target the areas where it is most needed.

zh: 虽然去年援助额再创新高，但向世界最不发达国家所提供的资金实际呈下降趋势。
en: Even as aid remained at record levels last year, funds provided to the world’s least-developed countries actually dropped.

zh: 相对富裕国家的长期计划获得了更多资金，而一系列贫困国家则再次遭到忽视。
en: Long-standing programs in better-off countries received greater amounts of money, while a string of poorer candidates were once again overlooked.

zh: 当世界领导人7月在亚的斯亚贝巴可持续发展融资峰会会晤时，他们必须同意援助那些资金来源最匮乏、吸引投资者最困难、税收体制也最落后的国家。
en: When world leaders meet in Addis Ababa in July for the Financing for Sustainable Development Summit, they must agree to channel aid to those countries with the least access to other sources of finance, the greatest difficulty in attracting investors, and the weakest tax systems.

zh: 种族及宗教少数族裔和力求脱贫的当地农村人口等弱势群体应该得到特别的关注。
en: Vulnerable groups, such as ethnic and religious minorities and indigenous rural populations struggling to break out of poverty, should receive special attention.

zh: 经合组织发展援助委员会的29个成员国已承诺扭转全球最贫困国家的援助下降趋势。
en: The 29 member countries of the OECD’s Development Assistance Committee have committed to reversing the decline in aid to the world’s poorest countries.

zh: 上述捐助国还承诺实现至少将本国国民总收入的0.15%用于向最不发达国家提供发展援助。
en: These donor countries have also pledged to meet a UN target of spending at least 0.15% of their gross national income on development assistance to the least-developed countries.

zh: 此外，他们还就新规达成一致，以更柔和的条件向最贫困国家划拨资源，并落实确保债务可持续性的全新保障举措。
en: Moreover, they have agreed on new rules that should channel more resources on softer terms to the poorest countries, and that implement new safeguards to ensure debt sustainability.

zh: 纵观人类历史，我们这代人第一次有能力让地球上所有人从赤贫当中摆脱。
en: We are the first generation in human history with the means to pull every person on the planet out of abject poverty.

zh: 实现目标的资金十分充足。
en: There is enough money in the world.

zh: 关键在于我们如何更明智的利用。
en: It is critical that we use it more wisely.

zh: 国际发展领导力的新模式
en: New Paths for Leadership in International Development

zh: 西雅图—官方发展援助（ODA）有助于拯救生命、构建更加稳定和安全的社会、推动世界各国的软实力。
en: SEATTLE – Official development assistance (ODA) helps to save lives, build more stable and safer societies, and project soft power around the world.

zh: 这就是我的老板比尔·盖茨最近在伦敦皇家联合军种防务研究所（Royal United Services Institute）面对英国著名军事和安全思想家时所提出的概念。
en: That is a point that my boss, Bill Gates, drove home recently, when he addressed the United Kingdom’s leading military and security thinkers at the Royal United Services Institute in London.

zh: 比尔曾经被问及他如何回应因为英国位列符合联合国指定的须将国民总收入的0.7%用于发展援助的极少数国家之一而觉得“泄气”的英国人。
en: Bill had been asked how he would respond to anyone in the UK who felt “demoralized” by the fact that Britain is one of only a few countries that meet the United Nations-mandated commitment to spend 0.7% of its gross national income on development aid.

zh: 但强调英国ODA的影响只是答案的一部分；比尔还强调，许多其他国家也在满足它们的援助承诺。
en: But highlighting the impact of British ODA was just part of the answer; Bill also emphasized the many other countries that are also meeting their aid commitments.

zh: 在欧洲，丹麦、荷兰、挪威、卢森堡和瑞典满足联合国的这一标准已经有一段时间了，而德国最近也加入了它们的行列。
en: In Europe, Denmark, the Netherlands, Norway, Luxembourg, and Sweden have been meeting the UN threshold for a while, and Germany recently joined their ranks.

zh: 法国还没有做到，但正在加大投入。
en: France is not there yet, but it is increasing its contribution.

zh: 除了欧洲，沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国和卡塔尔也位列世界最主要ODA出资国行列 — — 许多人尚不了解这个事实。
en: Beyond Europe, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Qatar are also among the world’s largest significant ODA donors – a reality of which not many people are aware.

zh: 它们都是中东最大的多边发展机构生活和生计基金（Lives & Livelihoods Fund）的出资国。
en: They are all donors to the Lives & Livelihoods Fund, the Middle East’s biggest multilateral development initiative.

zh: 该基金的其他出资者包括伊斯兰开发银行、伊斯兰团结发展基金（Islamic Solidarity Fund for Development）以及比尔和梅琳达·盖茨基金会。
en: The fund’s other donors are the Islamic Development Bank, the Islamic Solidarity Fund for Development, and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

zh: 规模达25亿美元的生活和生计基金正在支持旨在穆斯林世界最贫困社区消灭疾病、促进基本医疗、支持农民和发展基础设施的重要项目。
en: The $2.5 billion Lives & Livelihoods Fund is supporting critical projects targeting disease eradication, primary health care, support for farmers, and basic infrastructure in the poorest communities throughout the Muslim world.

zh: 该基金成立于去年，批准了3.63亿资金投向阿拉伯和非洲国家的六个大项目。
en: It began last year with $363 million in approved funding for six large projects in Arab and African countries.

zh: 2月份，第一个项目、规模3,200万美元的塞内加尔疟疾治疗项目正式起航，新一轮项目也在本月早些时候获得批准，总授权资金规模已经超过6亿美元。
en: In February, the first initiative, a $32 million project to combat malaria in Senegal, got underway, and another round of projects was approved earlier this month, taking the total authorized funding to more than $600 million.

zh: 援助无法解决中东和非洲穆斯林国家所面临的所有问题。
en: Aid cannot solve all the problems facing Muslim countries in the Middle East and Africa.

zh: 但它可以哺育更加稳定、繁荣、健康的社会，使它们更加能够抵抗内战和恐怖主义。
en: But it can support the emergence of more stable, more prosperous, and healthier societies that are less vulnerable to civil war or terrorism.

zh: 盖茨基金会相信 ， （ 特别是）来自穆斯林世界的出资者在解决贫困和动荡问题方面起着不可或缺作用。
en: The Gates Foundation believes that donors from the Muslim world, in particular, have an integral role to play in addressing poverty and instability.

zh: 合作 — — 通过整合资源和共享专业经验 — — 所能取得的成就远远大于各自为政。
en: Far more can be achieved together – by combining resources and sharing expertise – than separately.

zh: 国内项目能够支持这些国家引领国际发展的能力。
en: Domestic projects can support these countries’ capacity to lead the way on international development.

zh: 比如，由哈立德国王基金会和盖茨基金会支持的沙哈夫（Shaghaf）奖学金项目旨在鼓励最聪明的沙特年轻人 — — 其中不乏许多女性 — — 在专注于地方和全球社会影响的非营利部门追求职业发展。
en: For example, the Shaghaf fellowship program, supported by the King Khalid Foundation and the Gates Foundation, is designed to encourage some of the brightest young Saudis – many of them women – to pursue careers in the non-profit sector that focus on local and global social impact.

zh: 但国际发展成功的真正关键是合作。
en: But the real key to success in international development is cooperation.

zh: 通过整合资源、共享专业经验，盖茨基金会等组织和英国和阿联酋等出资国政府能够实现比各自独立行动大得多的成就。
en: By combining resources and sharing expertise, organizations like the Gates Foundation and donor governments, from the UK to the UAE, can achieve far more than would be possible alone.

zh: 幸运的是，中东国家政府似乎认识到这一点，正在日益寻求发展合作。
en: Fortunately, governments in the Middle East seem to recognize this, and are increasingly seeking development partnerships.

zh: 机会遍地都是。
en: And there are plenty of opportunities.

zh: 阿联酋一直是消灭脊髓灰质炎的先锋，而英国也对这一项目慷慨解囊。
en: The UAE has been a major champion of polio eradication, an endeavor that the UK has funded generously.

zh: 卡塔尔最近以出资者的身份加入了疫苗联盟（Gavi ） ， 而英国是该组织最近几年来的最大出资者。
en: Qatar has joined recently as a donor to Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance, to which the UK has been the largest donor in recent years.

zh: 沙特阿拉伯是全球艾滋病、结核病和疟疾基金的长期出资者，而该基金也是英国投入重金的项目。
en: Saudi Arabia is a longstanding donor to the Global Fund for AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria, another partnership in which the UK is a significant player.

zh: 观察者常常强调为发展中国家提供援助所带来的软实力收益。
en: Observers often point to the soft-power benefits of providing aid to developing countries.

zh: 但他们常常忽略了增强合作推动国际发展的出资国之间的关系所带来的优势。
en: But they often fail to notice the advantages brought about by strengthening relationships among donor countries that work together to advance international development.

zh: 出资国如果能认识到这一事实，抓住机会与和它们共担消灭贫困大任的新的全球伙伴构建关系的机会，将收获巨大的收益。
en: Donor countries would do well to embrace this reality and seize opportunities to build ties with new global partners that share their commitment to fighting poverty.

zh: 不抛弃任何一名难民
en: Leave No Refugee Behind

zh: 纽约 — — 世界民众流离失所的速度前所未有。
en: NEW YORK – The world has entered an era in which people are being displaced at an unprecedented rate.

zh: 2014年，冲突和迫害每天迫使42，500人逃离家园，是2010年的将近4倍。
en: In 2014, conflict and persecution forced 42,500 people a day to flee their homes, nearly quadruple the number from 2010.

zh: 目前近6，000万人被迫流离失所 — — 这是二战后前所未有的危机。
en: Almost 60 million people are now forcibly displaced – a crisis unmatched since World War II.

zh: 现状不可接受，但却并非无法避免。
en: This is unacceptable, but it is not inevitable.

zh: 1945年，人类历史上最致命的冲突促成了联合国的建立。
en: In 1945, the world responded to the deadliest conflict in human history by establishing the United Nations.

zh: 今天，身为联合国难民及发展机构负责人的我们呼吁世界积极应对目前史无前例的动荡，赋予人们重建生活必不可少的工具。
en: Today, as heads of UN refugee and development agencies, we call for the world to respond to this monumental upheaval by giving people the tools they need to rebuild their lives.

zh: 我们相信前进之路始于2030年可持续发展目标，该目标是联合国为了兑现消除贫困和不平等斗争中“不抛弃任何一名难民”的承诺于去年9月一致通过的。
en: We believe that the path forward begins with the 2030 Sustainable Development Goals, which the UN, affirming a pledge to “leave no one behind” in the fight against poverty and inequality, adopted unanimously last September.

zh: 国际社会现行的流离失所政策主要依靠人道主义援助，其宗旨是在寻求永久解决方案的过程中提供快速赈济物资以挽救生命。
en: The international community’s current approach to displacement relies mainly on humanitarian aid, which provides rapid, lifesaving relief while the search for a permanent solution is underway.

zh: 但在现实中很难找到解决方案。
en: But solutions are proving more elusive than ever.

zh: 2014年仅有1%的难民得以重返家园，而多数流离失所者不是流亡数天或数月，而是数年或数十年，甚至一生都无法重返家园。
en: Just 1% of refugees were able to return home in 2014. The vast majority of those displaced spend not days or months in exile, but years or decades, even entire lifetimes.

zh: 他们面临被抛弃的危险。
en: They risk being left behind.

zh: 以肯尼亚第三代难民索玛雅为例。
en: Consider Somaya, a third-generation refugee in Kenya.

zh: 数十年前，她的祖母逃到哈加德拉难民营以躲避索马里爆发的残酷冲突。
en: Decades ago, her grandmother fled to the Hagadera refugee camp to escape the brutal conflict in Somalia.

zh: 她的母亲就出生在那里，她也是。
en: Her mother was born there, and so was she.

zh: 她们从未跨出过方圆五平方英里（13平方公里）的难民营半步。
en: Neither of them has set foot outside the five-square-mile (13 square kilometers) camp.

zh: 她们的生活用品全来自祖母的皮箱，静静等待着离开这里的时机。
en: They still live out of her grandmother’s suitcases, waiting for a chance to move on.

zh: 像索玛雅一样，多数难民生活在发展中世界。
en: Like Somaya, most refugees live in the developing world.

zh: 但很多时候，本可以为难民提供帮助的发展组织面临经费不足和规定僵化的困扰，导致难民的需求无法得到满足。
en: And yet, too often, development organizations that could provide refugees with a hand up face insufficient funding and stiff regulations that prevent them from addressing refugees’ needs.

zh: 长期流离失所对索玛雅这样的人造成重负。
en: Long-term displacement inflicts profound burdens on people like Somaya.

zh: 难民在太多时候面临工作和行动自由方面的限制，致��其几乎不可能抚养家庭或为所生活的社会提供帮助。
en: Refugees too often face limits on their ability to work and move freely, making it all but impossible to provide for their families or to contribute to their host communities.

zh: 他们生活在地狱边缘，除依靠人道主义援助外别无选择。
en: They live in limbo, with no choice but to rely on humanitarian aid.

zh: 另一种情况是他们被迫在非正规经济中寻找出路，从而可能成为逮捕、性剥削、童工或其他虐待行为的受害者。
en: Or they are obliged to seek a living in the informal economy, where they risk falling victim to arrest, sexual exploitation, child labor, or other abuses.

zh: 黎巴嫩13岁的叙利亚难民阿纳斯是另外一个例子。
en: Consider another example: Anas, a 13-year-old Syrian refugee in Lebanon.

zh: 他的家人没有他每天所赚的5美元根本无法生存。
en: His family cannot survive without the $5 he earns every day.

zh: 因此，他没有上学，而是拣选煤块作为燃料出售。
en: So, instead of going to school, he sorts lumps of coal for sale as fuel.

zh: 阿纳斯这样的难民在行使对摆脱贫困必不可少的权利时苦苦挣扎 — — 包括教育、医疗、行动自由、就业、土地和住所。
en: Refugees like Anas struggle to exercise precisely those rights – to education, health care, freedom of movement, and access to work, land, and housing – that are essential to escaping poverty.

zh: 改变现状需要让发展团体提供更多支持的政治和经济变革。
en: Fixing this will require political and economic changes that allow the development community to provide more support.

zh: 发展和流离失所之间的关系十分明确，我们需要为应对上述挑战共同担责。
en: The relationship between development and displacement is clear, and we need to begin to consider these challenges as areas of joint responsibility.

zh: 大规模流离失所导致公共资源紧张，即使中等收入国家也无法摆脱；如果外界无法提供足够的援助，它会抵消多年以来的发展成果。
en: Large-scale displacement strains public resources, even in middle-income countries; without sufficient outside help, it can undo years of progress.

zh: 在世界为难民及其收容国提供更多、更好的支持之前，可以预见支付的人道主义援助永远不会停止、而只会越来越多。
en: Until the world gives more and better support to host countries and the refugees living there, we can expect to pay ever-larger sums for humanitarian programs that never end.

zh: 但还有硬币的另外一面。
en: But there is another side to the coin.

zh: 如果流离失所者被允许学习技能、实现愿望，他们能带来新的发展机遇。
en: When displaced people are allowed to develop their skills and pursue their aspirations, they create new opportunities for growth.

zh: 发展机构因此必须赶在新一轮贫困和脆弱彻底失控前（无论它们出现在何种领域）更加灵活地采取对策。
en: This is why development agencies must have more flexibility to address new cycles of poverty and fragility – wherever they appear – before they spiral out of control.

zh: 彻底摒弃老套难民形象的时机已经成熟，难民不应再被视为无所事事、伸手乞讨的被动的援助接受者。
en: The time has come to discard the clichéd image of refugees as passive recipients of aid, sitting idly with outstretched hands.

zh: 如果说这种形象反应了什么，那么它所反应的是强加给难民的各国不完全对策下难民的境况。
en: If anything, that image reflects circumstances that have been imposed upon refugees and reinforced by the world’s incomplete response.

zh: 难民是创业者。
en: Refugees are entrepreneurs.

zh: 他们是艺术家。
en: They are artists.

zh: 他们是教师、工程师和掌握各种技能的劳动者。
en: They are teachers, engineers, and workers of all types.

zh: 他们是丰富的人力资本源泉，而我们却未能对其善加利用。
en: They are a rich source of human capital that we are failing to cultivate.

zh: 国际社会不能再继续对如此的潜能视而不见，或坐视最脆弱的群体被社会边缘化。
en: The international community can no longer afford to ignore so much potential or to sit by while the most vulnerable are pushed to the margins of society.

zh: 在新闻头条呼吁关注这些悲剧所造成的人文代价的同时，我们必须牢记我们可以采取除震惊以外的其他对策。
en: As news headlines call attention to the human costs of these tragedies, we must remember that we have the choice to respond with more than just shock.

zh: 我们可以拒绝对出生在别处、但生活在我们身边的人进行经济排斥。
en: We can reject the economic exclusion of those who live among us but were born somewhere else.

zh: 我们可以加倍努力政治解决迫害和冲突。
en: We can redouble our efforts to seek political solutions to conflict and persecution.

zh: 我们可以授权人道主义和发展伙伴，从危机爆发的那一刻就开始合作。
en: We can empower humanitarian and development partners to work together from the moment a crisis erupts.

zh: 总而言之，我们可以履行“不抛弃一个难民”的承诺。
en: In short, we can honor our pledge to “leave no one behind.”

zh: 为对抗气候变化融资
en: Financing the Fight Against Climate Change

zh: 巴黎—气候变化已给发展中世界造成了严重破坏。
en: PARIS – Climate change is already wreaking havoc throughout the developing world.

zh: 比如，越南报告说，一些自然灾害因为气候变化而加剧，而自然灾害每年造成的损失相当于其GDP的2 % 。
en: Vietnam, for example, has reported that natural disasters, some of them exacerbated by climate change, have caused annual losses equivalent to 2% of its GDP.

zh: 在埃塞俄比亚等农业国，更长时期的干旱和更频繁的洪水正在威胁牲畜和食品供给。
en: In agriculture-dependent countries like Ethiopia, longer droughts and more frequent flooding are threatening livelihoods and food supplies.

zh: 12月，国际社会将在巴黎召开联合国气候变化会议，确定并梳理对抗气候变化的资金源必须作为重中之重。
en: As the international community gears up for the United Nations Climate Change Conference in Paris in December, identifying and streamlining sources of financing for the fight against climate change must be a top priority.

zh: 法国开发署（French Development Agency，AFD，由我担任CEO）等开发银行可以做出贡献。
en: Development banks like the French Development Agency (AFD), where I am CEO, are well placed to contribute.

zh: 首先，开发银行可以为同时有利于发展和环境的工程提供融资。
en: For starters, development banks can finance projects that benefit both development and the environment.

zh: 如今，全球变暖已是所有发展项目规划时都要考虑的关键因素。
en: Global warming is now a vital factor to consider when planning any development project.

zh: 比如，气候变化的影响可能给基础设施 — — 农业灌溉、公共交通和其他几乎所有领域 — — 带来临界风险。
en: For example, the effects of climate change can pose critical risks to infrastructure – agricultural irrigation, public transportation, or nearly anything else.

zh: 与此同时，收入的增加 — — 发展项目的目标 — — 几乎总是意味着增加自然资源和能源的消费，导致更多排放和进一步变暖。
en: Meanwhile, rising incomes – a goal of any development effort – nearly always means increased consumption of natural resources and energy, resulting in more emissions and further warming.

zh: 这一全球变暖和发展之间的连锁反应揭示了为何法国政府要求AFD所提供的资金中至少有50%用于能对环境产生积极影响的发展项目。
en: Such interlocking relationships between global warming and development explain why the French government requires that at least 50% of the funding provided by the AFD be directed toward development projects that also have a positive impact on the environment.

zh: 这方面的例子包括埃塞俄比亚的风电场、改善马达加斯加森林管理、印度尼西亚和越南的全国气候规划、哥伦比亚的清洁城市交通等。
en: Examples include wind farms in Ethiopia, better forest management in Madagascar, nationwide climate plans in Indonesia and Vietnam, and clean urban transport in Colombia.

zh: 开发银行还可以在设计金融工具、让私人投资者也为对抗气候变化做出贡献方面起到重要作用。
en: Development banks can also play an important role in designing financial tools that allow private investors to contribute to the fight against climate change.

zh: 但今天的融资挑战已不再是数量。
en: But today’s funding challenge is no longer just about quantity.

zh: 尽管潜在的气候友好型发展融资源包括养老基金、保险公司、基金会和主权财富基金，但我们常常忽略确保投资被引导到定位准、效率高的项目的机制。
en: Though potential sources for climate-friendly development financing now include pension funds, insurance companies, foundations, and sovereign wealth funds, what is often missing are mechanisms to ensure that investments are channeled into well-targeted and effective projects.

zh: 一个解决方案是“绿色 ” （ 或“气候 ” ） 债券。
en: One solution is “green” (or “climate”) bonds.

zh: 这一工具具有传统债券的所有特征，但它们由有助于可持续发展或对抗气候变化的投资支持。
en: These instruments have all the characteristics of conventional bonds, but they are backed by investments that contribute to sustainable development or the fight against climate change.

zh: 到目前为止，只有少数组织或政府（包括世界银行、美国马萨诸塞州和法国的法兰西岛地区）发行了绿色债券，总的来说数量极为有限。
en: Until recently, only a few organizations or governments, including the World Bank, the American state of Massachusetts, and the French region of Île de France, issued green bonds, and generally the amounts involved were modest.

zh: 但在过去两年中，其他行动方也进入了市场，发行量大幅增加。
en: But in the past two years, other players have entered the market, and volumes have skyrocketed.

zh: 2014年，绿色债券的发行量超过了此前所有年份的总和。
en: In 2014, emissions of green bonds exceeded the total in all previous years combined.

zh: 事实上，绿色债券供不应求。
en: Indeed, demand is outstripping supply.

zh: 最近的债券发行都出现了超募 — — 这一趋势有望持续下去。
en: The latest bond offers were all oversubscribed – and the trend is likely to continue.

zh: 保险业承诺将其绿色投资翻番，到2015年底达到840亿美元。
en: The insurance industry has committed to double its green investments, to $84 billion, by the end of 2015.

zh: 9月，三家来自北美和欧洲的主要养老基金宣布计划到2020年将增加低碳投资持有量增加310亿美元。
en: And in September, three major pension funds from North America and Europe announced plans to increase their holdings in low-carbon investments by more than $31 billion by 2020.

zh: 随着这些债券的市场的扩张，它们必须更好地得到包装和认证。
en: As the market for these bonds expands, they must be better labeled and certified.

zh: 目前尚不存在协调标准（harmonized standards ） 。
en: Today, harmonized standards do not exist.

zh: 支持这些债券的资产质量完全取决于发行者的商誉和技术技能。
en: The quality of the assets backing the bonds depends solely on issuers’ goodwill and technical skills.

zh: 我们需要开发具体的指导原则和评级方法。
en: Specific guidelines and rating methods need to be developed.

zh: 再这样的背景下，最近一系列机构投资者联合决定测量和披露至少5,000亿美元规模投资中的碳足迹，这是一项重大进步。
en: In this context, the recent decision by a coalition of institutional investors to measure and disclose the carbon footprint of at least $500 billion in investments is a step forward.

zh: 9月，AFD发行了1亿欧元气候债券，其目标之一是助力具体质量标准的制定。
en: In September, the AFD issued €1 billion ($1.2 billion) in climate bonds, with one goal being to contribute to the development of concrete quality standards.

zh: 在一家公司社会责任评级机构的帮助下，我们得以向投资者提供关于投资组合对温室气体排放的直接影响的具体信息和问责程序。
en: With the help of a major agency that rates corporate social responsibility, we were able to provide investors with solid information – and an accountability process – about the portfolio’s direct impact on greenhouse-gas emissions.

zh: 事实上，通过这些债券融资的工程被要求满足严格的标准，包括事前碳足迹分析、清楚重大气候变化影响证明，以及与本地和国家行动方所追求的更广泛的战略一致的设计。
en: Indeed, the projects financed by these bonds were required to meet stringent criteria, including a prior analysis of their carbon footprint, proof of a clear and significant impact on climate change, and a design that is aligned with the broader strategies being pursued by local actors and countries.

zh: 气候债券有望助力国家和机构满足强制性减少二氧化碳排放的承诺。
en: Climate bonds have the potential to empower countries and institutions as they move toward meeting enforceable commitments to reduce CO2 emissions.

zh: 但是，要想气候债券产生效果，就必须有明确的指导原则和可靠的评估框架。
en: However, if they are to be effective, they will require clear guidelines and a reliable framework for assessment.

zh: 在世界各个国家和机构领导人准备12月巴黎会议的时候，正确地进行融资应该成为重中之重。
en: As leaders from countries and institutions from around the world prepare to meet in Paris in December, getting the financing right should be a top priority.

zh: 基于证据的医学的问题
en: What’s Wrong with Evidence-Based Medicine?

zh: 西雅图—任何医疗体系都要平衡覆盖度、质量和成本 — — 通常都会集中关注其中之一或之二而牺牲其他。
en: SEATTLE – Every health-care system balances coverage, quality, and cost – often focusing on one or two at the expense of the others.

zh: 比如，欧洲的医疗体系关注覆盖度、确保所有人都能获得医疗；与之相反，在美国，质量才是最重要的。
en: European systems, for example, tend to focus on coverage and ensure universal access to care; in the United States, by contrast, quality appears to be paramount.

zh: 但是，不管你认为什么才是最重要的，显然美国在所有三个方面都有改进空间。
en: But, whatever one’s view is about the proper priorities, it is clear that the US has room for improvement in all three areas.

zh: 幸运的是，美国已经采取措施改进所有三个领域。
en: Fortunately, efforts are underway to address each of them.

zh: 而美国的动作对其他国家也有影响。
en: And efforts in the US have implications for other countries as well.

zh: 美国患者保护和平价医疗法（Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act，现被广泛称为“奥巴马医保”的标志性立法）旨在扩大覆盖度，与此同时，凯撒医疗机构（Kaiser Permanente）等所谓的责任医疗组织试图通过协调医疗服务供应商和患者的利益控制成本。
en: The US Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act (the landmark legislation now widely known as “Obamacare”) aims to widen coverage, while so-called accountable care organizations, such as Kaiser Permanente, try to contain costs by aligning the interests of providers and payers.

zh: 但是，通过应用基于证据的医学（evidence-based medicine，EBM）提高质量的做法有可能忽视我们所知道的的人类认知和专业知识，并且常常不利于医生的专业判断所起到的关键作用。
en: However, efforts to raise quality through the application of evidence-based medicine (EBM) risk ignoring what we know about human cognition and expertise, and may undermine the vital role played by a physician’s expert judgment.

zh: 至少有三个理由值得关注。
en: There are at least three reasons to be wary.

zh: 首先，EBM的基础是根本上对医生直觉（即依赖多年经验的基于模式的判断）的不信任。
en: For starters, EBM is grounded in a fundamental distrust of physicians’ intuition – that is, the rendering of pattern-based judgments that rely on years of experience.

zh: 平心而论，怀疑直觉不无道理，因为直觉出错的例子不胜枚举。
en: To be sure, there are good reasons to be skeptical of intuition, given the countless cases in which it has proved to be wrong.

zh: 但这并不意味着所有直觉都有缺陷，或者技艺高超的医生的直觉在医疗中毫无作用。
en: But it does not follow that all cases of intuition are flawed or that skilled intuition has no function in healthcare.

zh: 医生在多年的时间里打磨专业技能，当获得了足够多的对其判断的反馈机会时，他们就能形成极有价值的直觉，特别是在疑难杂症中。
en: Physicians develop expertise over many years, and when they have ample opportunities for feedback about their judgments, their intuitions are valuable, particularly in more complex cases.

zh: 有经验的医生可以评估患者的关键信号，并在患者的生命状况测试结果 — — 比如他是否是耄耋之年的糖尿病患者并且还是个烟枪，还是只有三周大的婴儿。
en: An experienced physician will evaluate a patient’s vital signs and test results in the context of the patient’s life – for example, whether he is an octogenarian with diabetes and a smoker’s cough, or a three-week premature baby.

zh: 在启发式、直觉和经验的作用下，有经验的医生能够很好地理解疑难杂症，制定对策。
en: With heuristics, intuition, and experience, an experienced physician can best understand a complicated case and develop a plan.

zh: 事实上，有经验的医生的结论可能比EBM所提供的结论更加准确。
en: In fact, an experienced doctor’s conclusions may be more accurate than those provided by EBM.

zh: 这是因为，尽管EBM基于来自随机试验和严格实验的数据，但它所适用的状况是在这些测试中的病人的近似情况。
en: That is because EBM, though based on data from randomized trials and rigorous experiments, is designed for situations that approximate the conditions of patients in those tests.

zh: 问题在于，当条件变化时，试验结果就不那么可靠了。
en: The problem is that when the context changes, the trial results become less reliable.

zh: 此时，医生必须确定他的患者的状况与相关研究的匹配程度。
en: In such cases, the physician must determine how close his or her patient’s situation matches that in the relevant studies.

zh: 如果病情不如试验中严重，那么医生必须决定是否采取建议方案。
en: If the disease is not as advanced as in the trials, the doctor will have to decide whether to embark on the recommended protocol.

zh: 临床医生可能无法确认哪些约束是不可违反的。
en: And clinicians may be unsure about which constraints are inviolate.

zh: 最终，最后判断要根据EBM支持者抨击甚至蔑视的个人经验和模式识别做出。
en: Ultimately, the final judgment is informed by personal experience and pattern recognition, an approach that EBM supporters discount or even disparage.

zh: EBM的第二个问题是它无法对不断演化的医疗环境提供指导。
en: A second problem with EBM is that it offers little guidance when a medical condition is evolving.

zh: 比如，急性哮喘可能是某一时刻治疗的中心点，但随后可能转为患者的糖尿病。
en: For example, acute asthma may be the focus of care at one moment, but might shift to the patient’s diabetes later.

zh: EBM指导要么以哮喘治疗为中心，要么以糖尿病为中心，而不可能同时以两者为中心，甚至不关注两者之间的互动和随时间的变化。
en: EBM guidelines focus on asthma treatment or diabetes, but not both, or even how they may interact and change over time.

zh: 最后 — — 或许也是贵关键的 — — 你必须指导临床医生在EBM知识基础存在空白时怎样做决定。
en: Finally, and perhaps most critically, one must ask how clinicians are to make decisions when there are gaps in the EBM knowledge base.

zh: 医生往往要识别趋势，提出包含猜测因素的假说，他们的假说只有在随后的试验中才能得到证实。
en: Doctors often spot trends and develop hypotheses that involve guesswork, and that are validated by trials only later.

zh: 医生应该因此忽视观察到的模式等待数据吗？
en: Should doctors therefore ignore observed patterns until the data are in?

zh: 事实上，你或许会问，如果临床医生不在一开始主动地尝试探索问题，这类试验如何会启动呢？
en: Indeed, one might wonder how such trials are initiated at all if clinicians do not tentatively explore a problem in the first place.

zh: 坚持所有医疗决定都必须基于现有最佳实践会扼杀这一尝试、阻止潜在医学突破。
en: To insist that all treatment decisions be based on existing best practices stifles this exploration and prevents potential medical breakthroughs.

zh: EBM的支持者反驳说，生产数据并转为最佳实践的工作应该由研究者来完成；临床医生的作用是实施成果。
en: Advocates of EBM respond that it is the job of researchers to generate the data that are turned into best practices; the clinician’s role is to implement the results.

zh: 但这一观点与医学史背道而驰。 在医学史中，进展只能在实践者注意到反常、发现现有“最佳实践”漏洞或改进已有方法后发生。
en: But this approach runs counter to medical history, in which advances come only after practitioners notice anomalies, discover flaws in current “best practices,” or improve on existing approaches.

zh: 从溃疡治疗到关节置换术在内的大量医学进步都来自临床发现而不是试验成果。
en: Many medical advances, from ulcer therapies to joint replacement, have evolved through clinician curiosity, not as a result of trials.

zh: 此外，EBM的重要来源本身也被认为有误导性。
en: Moreover, important sources of EBM have themselves proved to be misleading.

zh: 被认为所在领域黄金法则的《弗莱明厄姆心脏研究 》 （ Framingham Heart Study）被证明存在漏洞，因为它是以白人男性为中心撰写的。
en: The Framingham Heart Study, considered the gold standard in its field, was shown to be flawed, owing to its focus on white males.

zh: 比如，该研究所识别的一个重要的心脏病症状（感到“胸口坐着一头大象 ” ） 只在5%的女性身上发生。
en: For example, a key symptom of a heart attack identified by the study (the feeling of “an elephant sitting on my chest”) is found in only 5% of women.

zh: 一位急诊医生悲哀地向我们坦承 ， “ 我想，在我的病床上去世的女性都是因为我遵守最佳实践而死的。 ”
