en: But now health-care providers can receive training from anywhere by way of smartphones and tablets.

zh: 我们的合作伙伴之一最后一英里健康组织（Last Mile Health）建立了一个纯数字平台，专门提供社区卫生教育。
en: One of our partners, Last Mile Health, has created an entire digital platform specifically tailored for community health education.

zh: 这些和其他奴隶正在实现医疗供给和培训的去中心化，赋能地方工作者 — — 所有这些对于实现全民医疗覆盖都至关重要。
en: These and other efforts are decentralizing health-care provision and training, and empowering local practitioners – all of which is essential for achieving universal health coverage.

zh: 不消说，数字技术还及鞥推动下一轮拯救生命的治疗方法。
en: Needless to say, digital technologies will also be driving the next wave of life-changing therapies.

zh: 社交网络技术已经让临床试验变得更加高效，人工智能和预测分析让临床试验可以更快进行。
en: Social-networking technologies have already made recruitment for clinical trials more efficient, and artificial intelligence and predictive analytics have allowed for trials to be conducted much faster.

zh: 在纵观数字图景，实现最重大的改善还是要靠宽带。
en: Across the digital landscape, however, it is broadband that will deliver some of the most significant improvements of all.

zh: 在低收入国家，高速互联网将是各层卫生体系的局面改变因素。
en: In low-income countries, high-speed Internet can be a game-changer at every level of the health system.

zh: 但在资源匮乏国家建设宽带基础设施是一项复杂的挑战。
en: Building broadband infrastructure in resource-poor countries is a complex challenge, though.

zh: 数字卫生服务常常在政府机构、企业和非政府组织之间变得支离破碎。
en: Too often, digital-health services are fragmented among government agencies, businesses, and nongovernmental organizations.

zh: 许多纯属措施叠床架屋，合作机会被白白浪费。
en: Many efforts are duplicated as a result, and chances for collaboration are squandered.

zh: 乌干达便是一个警示性例子：2012年，各种数字卫生项目互相“掐架 ” ， 政府被迫宣布暂停一切数字卫生项目。
en: Uganda is a cautionary tale: In 2012, so many conflicting digital health projects were in play that the government was forced to declare a temporary moratorium on all of them.

zh: 由诺华基金会担任联职主席的宽带委员会数字健康工作组专注于如何利用技术改善NCD治疗。
en: The Broadband Commission Working Group on Digital Health, which is co-chaired by the Novartis Foundation, is focusing on how technology can improve care for NCDs.

zh: 在9月的联合国大会期间，委员会发布了《数字健康憧憬：解决非传染性不疾病，加快LMIC全民医疗覆盖 》 （ The Promise of Digital Health: Addressing Non-communicable Diseases to Accelerate Universal Health Coverage in LMICs ） 。 目标是为决策者和其他相关利益方提供务实建议，帮助他们重新思考数字健康如何解决NCD。
en: During the United Nations General Assembly in September, the Commission published The Promise of Digital Health: Addressing Non-communicable Diseases to Accelerate Universal Health Coverage in LMICs. The goal is to offer pragmatic advice to policymakers and other stakeholders to help them reimagine the way digital health can address NCDs.

zh: 显然政府必须加强力度整合部门间数字健康措施，并在必要时协调私人和非营利部门相关利益方。
en: Clearly, governments must do more to integrate digital-health efforts across ministries, and to coordinate with private- and nonprofit-sector stakeholders when possible.

zh: 这些合作在菲律宾等地已在进行，其国家电子健康指导委员会（National eHealth Steering Committee）负责监督各种数字健康项目，从而为数字创新创造理想环境。
en: Such collaboration is already happening in places like the Philippines, where a National eHealth Steering Committee oversees a suite of digital-health initiatives, thus creating an ideal environment for digital innovation.

zh: 尽管如此，技术并非万灵丹，因此我们必须明智地选择工作重点。
en: Still, digital technology is not a panacea, so we must choose our priorities wisely.

zh: 第一项重点应该放在结果上。
en: The first priority should be on outcomes.

zh: 在许多国家，医疗服务提供者因为执行的任务，而不是最终结果受到奖励。
en: In many countries, health providers are rewarded for tasks they perform, rather than for end results.

zh: 结果导向的数字技术能够确保改变这一点。
en: Outcome-oriented digital technologies can ensure that this changes.

zh: 第二项重点是改善数字素养。
en: A second priority is to improve data literacy.

zh: 数字技术让我们获取和挖掘各层次数据，形成洞见 — — 从个体生物学到疾病的全球模式。
en: Digital technologies allow us to capture and mine data for insights at every level – from individual biology to global patterns of disease.

zh: 医疗服务提供者和管理者的训练科目因此必须包括统计、数据管理和分析方面的指令，以便医疗服务提供者能够紧跟数字进步。
en: Training curricula for health-care providers and administrators should thus include instruction in statistics, data management, and analytics so that providers can keep up with digital advances.

zh: 最后一项重点是要记住数字技术只有在用于改善系统功能时才有价值。
en: A final priority is to bear in mind that digital technology is valuable only if it is being used to improve how systems function.

zh: 医生不应该花更多的时间用于输入数据而非照顾患者。
en: Physicians should not be spending more time entering data than they do caring for patients.

zh: 幸运的是，应用得当的话，数字技术能够帮助这一过程自动化，让医疗服务提供者能过做最擅长的工作。
en: Fortunately, when applied properly, digital technology can help automate the process so that providers are freed up to do what they do best.

zh: 世界签署SDG已经三年，包括实现全民医疗覆盖和全民平价互联网接入等短期目标。
en: It has been three years since the world ratified the SDGs, including near-term objectives to achieve universal health coverage and universal, affordable Internet access.

zh: 最近的进步表明，我们应该对实现这些目标感到乐观。
en: Recent progress shows that we should be optimistic about achieving these targets.

zh: 但成功取决于我们如何让数字革命惠及全人类。
en: But success will depend on whether we can harness the digital revolution for the benefit of all.

zh: 确保数字革命的安全
en: Securing the Digital Revolution

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — — 那些在铁路开始运营之前大笔投资运河的人真的非常可怜。
en: BRUSSELS – Pity the person who invests heavily in canals right before the railways start operating.

zh: 例如，我们可以理解布里奇沃特运河（也许也是英国第一条运河）的投资者会强烈反对计划中的利物浦和曼彻斯特铁路线。
en: You could understand, for example, why the sponsor of the Bridgewater Canal (perhaps England’s first) would vehemently oppose the planned Liverpool and Manchester Railway.

zh: 但技术进步的脚步却是无法阻止的 — — 同样无法逃避的还有技术进步所带来的全新挑战。
en: But the march of technology could not be stopped – nor could the new challenges it raised.

zh: 今天的数字创新也同样如此。
en: The same is true of today’s digital innovations.

zh: 当利物浦和曼彻斯特铁路线终于在1830年开通时，它带来了一场革命性的胜利，不仅开启了蒸汽时代，而且以人们从未预见的方式改变了世界。
en: When the L&M Railway eventually opened in 1830, it was a revolutionary success, kickstarting the age of steam and changing the world in ways that could not have been foreseen.

zh: 随着铁路时代的展开，金属轨道像树叶上的脉络一样铺遍了工业化世界，实现了前所未有的联通能力，而犯罪分子迅速对这种能力加以利用。
en: As the railway age unfolded, with metal tracks spreading across the industrializing world like veins on a leaf, a new level of connectivity was achieved, which criminals were quick to exploit.

zh: 事实上，最终人们不得不建立一支完整的警察部队来对铁路安全进行管理。
en: Indeed, an entire police force eventually had to be created to manage railway security.

zh: 随着世界来到又一次连通性革命的边缘，特别是基础设施将从根本上改变我们彼此联系的方式，这样的经验教训不应当被忽视。
en: With the world on the brink of another revolution in connectivity, especially in terms of infrastructure that will fundamentally change the way we connect with each other, the lessons of this experience should not be ignored.

zh: 即将到来的数字时代阶段影响将远远超出交通运输领域。
en: And the coming phase of the digital age will affect far more than just transportation.

zh: 我们不是在谈论物联网，而是在谈论万物互联：即将到来的数字未来更加分散化，并以前所未有的方式联系数据、物体和人。
en: We are not talking about the Internet of Things, but about the Internet of Everything: a more decentralized digital future, connecting people, data, and objects like never before.

zh: 在安全方面，我们需要确保我们不是像过去那样坐在一条缓慢移动的运河驳船上，而8:15抵达曼彻斯特的火车在我们身边呼啸而过。
en: In terms of security, we need to ensure we aren’t sitting, as it were, on a slow-moving canal barge while the 8:15 to Manchester flashes past.

zh: 我们需要清楚地看到这些技术将会带来的战略漏洞，并预测恶意行为主体可能如何利用全新数字基础设施来谋取自身利益或进行武器部署。
en: We need to take a clear-eyed look at the strategic vulnerabilities that these technologies will bring, and anticipate how malicious actors could attempt to exploit new digital infrastructure for their own gain or to deploy it as a weapon.

zh: 某些挑战已经十分明确，例如滥用社交媒体传播虚假信息 — — 以及利用诸如deepfake视频和人工智能等尖端工具。
en: Some challenges, such as the misuse of social media to spread disinformation – using, among others, cutting-edge tools like deepfake videos and artificial intelligence – are already clear.

zh: 但至关重要的是，我们同样在谈论基础设施本身。
en: But, crucially, we are also talking in terms of the infrastructure itself.

zh: 第五代移动通讯技术5G构成了某种特别的挑战。
en: The fifth generation of mobile communication technology, 5G, poses a particular challenge.

zh: 它将成为全球联通的支柱，这就提出了有关供应链安全和起源等事务的战略和安全问题。
en: It will be the backbone of global connectivity, which raises strategic and security questions about issues like supply-chain security and provenance.

zh: 我们怎样才能确保所使用的未来几代欧洲技术 — — 不仅限于5G — — 的安全性？
en: How can we be sure that the components used in future generations of European technology – not only 5G – will be secure?

zh: 目前的状况是，数字供应链安全远非密不透风，最近有报告显示企业在其采购的服务器主板上发现了神秘的芯片，似乎是在制造时加上去的。
en: Already, digital supply-chain security is far from airtight, reflected in recent reports of companies finding mysterious chips on their server motherboards, seemingly added at the time of manufacture.

zh: 英国政府已经警告电信企业要非常谨慎地考量它们的供应商，而美国则一直在寻求限制某些形式的外国直接投资，所涉及的领域包括半导体和机器人等关键技术。
en: The British government has warned telecoms companies to consider their suppliers very carefully, while the United States has been looking to restrict some kinds of foreign direct investment in key technologies like semiconductors and robotics.

zh: 为保障数字基础设施供应链安全，我们需要提高技术组件来源的透明度。
en: To secure the digital-infrastructure supply chain, we need greater transparency regarding the provenance of technological components.

zh: 保持供应企业多样化也至关重要。
en: Maintaining a diversity of suppliers is also vital.

zh: 此外，需要共同的标准和规则来建立国际合作伙伴的可信度。
en: Furthermore, common standards and rules are needed to establish the trustworthiness of international partners.

zh: 这是法国总统伊曼纽尔·马克龙最近在巴黎网络空间信任与安全呼吁中所描绘的提案基础。
en: That is the basis of a recent proposal by French President Emmanuel Macron, described in the Paris Call for Trust and Security in Cyberspace.

zh: 按照马克龙的说法，恶意行为主体对数字产品和服务的漏洞加以利用已经使互联网成为冲突的策源地。
en: The Internet, according to Macron, has become a site of conflict, where malicious actors exploit the vulnerabilities of digital products and services.

zh: 他提议欧洲以合法与合作为基础建立起“信任网络 ” 。
en: He proposes that Europe create an “Internet of Trust,” based on lawfulness and cooperation.

zh: 他的观点我完全赞同。
en: I agree.

zh: 欧洲人应当能够在清楚其自由言论等基本价值观和权利受到保护的基础上继续安全地享受他们的在线生活。
en: Europeans should be able to continue enjoying their online lives secure in the knowledge that their fundamental values and rights, such as free speech, are protected.

zh: 我们迫切需要一种战略来平衡我们利用技术创新的需求，这样才能保护我们的经济未来，同时避免在此过程中造成大规模安全漏洞。
en: We need a strategy that balances our need to harness technological innovation in order to safeguard our economic future with the need to avoid creating massive security vulnerabilities in the process.

zh: 随着技术培训已经走上正轨，我们必须为缓解当前风险迅速采取行动，同时还要确保我们正在为避免未来威胁奠定所需的基础。
en: And with the technology train already hurtling down the track, we must act fast to mitigate current risks and ensure that we are laying the groundwork needed to avoid future threats.

zh: 面对这一公认的巨大挑战，我们需要避免做出短视的反应，例如保护主义和其他扼杀创新的举措。
en: In confronting this admittedly huge challenge, we need to avoid short-sighted responses, such as protectionism and other measures that stifle innovation.

zh: 相反，我们必须清楚地了解风险的范围和规模，并确定真正的战略是什么。
en: Instead, we must map the scale and extent of the risk, and decide what is truly strategic.

zh: 对于欧洲而言，这不仅意味着保护供应链，还意味着对我们自身的技术行业展开统一的大规模投资行动。
en: For Europe, this means not just protecting supply chains, but also pursuing large-scale, coordinated investment in our own tech industries.

zh: 欧洲委员会尤其有能力推动这项跨部门的工作。
en: The European Commission is uniquely well placed to drive this cross-sectoral work.

zh: 现在欧洲捍卫其数字未来仍然为时未晚。
en: It is not too late for Europe to safeguard its digital future.

zh: 即使是布里奇沃特运河的所有者最终也看到了潮流的走向 — — 并斥巨资投入到竞争的铁路。
en: Even the owner of the Bridgewater Canal eventually saw the way the wind was blowing – and invested heavily in the rival railway.

zh: IT如何威胁民主
en: How IT Threatens Democracy

zh: 慕尼黑—人们曾经欢呼互联网和社交媒体为散播民主和自由创造了新机会。
en: MUNICH – The Internet and social media were once hailed for creating new opportunities to spread democracy and freedom.

zh: 推特、脸谱和洽社交媒体也确实在2009年的伊朗、2011年的阿拉伯世界和2013—2014年乌克兰的群众起义中扮演了关键角色。
en: And Twitter, Facebook, and other social media did indeed play a key role in popular uprisings in Iran in 2009, in the Arab world in 2011, and in Ukraine in 2013-2014.

zh: 那时候，推特的力量比刀剑还要大。
en: Back then, the tweet did at times seem mightier than the sword.

zh: 但极权政权很快就开始镇压互联网自由。
en: But authoritarian regimes soon began cracking down on Internet freedom.

zh: 它们担心崭新的数字世界，因为这个世界超过了它们彼此差不多的安全机制的能力范围。
en: They feared the brave new digital world, because it was beyond the reach of their analogue security establishments.

zh: 它们的担心纯属杞人忧天。
en: Their fears proved unfounded.

zh: 从结果看，大部分社交媒体驱动的群众起义因为没有有效的领导而失败，传统政治和军事组织仍然占据着上风。
en: In the event, most social media-enabled popular uprisings failed for want of effective leadership, and traditional political and military organizations retained the upper hand.

zh: 事实上，这些政权开始利用社交媒体为自己服务。
en: In fact, these regimes have begun to wield social media for their own ends.

zh: 我们都听说俄罗斯暗中利用社交媒体影响乌克兰、法国、德国以及（最出名的）美国的选举结果。
en: We have all heard the allegations that Russia covertly used social media to influence electoral outcomes in Ukraine, France, Germany, and, most famously, in the United States.

zh: 脸谱估计，其网上的俄罗斯内容，包括帖子和付费广告，被1.26亿美国人（相当于美国人口的40 % ） 所浏览。
en: Facebook has estimated that Russian content on its network, including posts and paid ads, reached 126 million Americans, around 40% of the nation’s population.

zh: 我们应该回想一下，早先俄罗斯指责西方煽动乌克兰和格鲁吉亚的“颜色革命 ” 。
en: We should recall earlier accusations by Russia of the West’s role in fomenting the “color revolutions” in Ukraine and Georgia.

zh: 互联网和社交媒体则是另一个秘密操纵民意的战场。
en: The Internet and social media provide another battlefield, it seems, for the surreptitious manipulation of public opinion.

zh: 既然技术上最先进的国家都无法保证选举过程的完整性，不难想象技术较落后的国家面临着怎样的挑战。
en: If even the most technologically advanced countries cannot protect the integrity of the electoral process, one can imagine the challenges facing countries with less know-how.

zh: 换句话说，威胁是全球性的。
en: In other words, the threat is global.

zh: 如果没有事实和数据，仅仅是操纵的可能性就能助长阴谋论，在公共信任已然相当低迷的时候破坏对民主和选举的信念。
en: In the absence of facts and data, the mere possibility of manipulation fuels conspiracy theories and undermines faith in democracy and elections at a time when public trust is already low.

zh: 社交媒体的意识形态“回音壁”加剧了人们的天然偏见，也扼杀了健康的争论的机会。
en: Social media’s ideological “echo chambers” exacerbate people’s natural biases and diminish opportunities for healthy debate.

zh: 这带来了实打实的影响，因为它制造了政治极化，影响了领导人形成妥协的能力，而妥协是民主稳定的基础。
en: This has real-world effects, because it fosters political polarization and erodes leaders’ capacity to forge compromises, the basis of democratic stability.

zh: 类似地，仇恨言论、恐怖主义诉求和种族和性骚扰在互联网上找到了“主场”的感觉，有可能导致真实世界中的暴力。
en: Likewise, the hate speech, terrorist appeals, and racial and sexual harassment that have found a home on the Internet can lead to real-world violence.

zh: 但社交媒体算不上第一次挑战政治制度的通讯革命。
en: But social media are hardly the first communication revolution to challenge political systems.

zh: 印刷品、广播和电视都是各自时代的革命性因素。
en: The printing press, radio, and television were all revolutionary in their day.

zh: 它们也都逐步地得到了监管，哪怕是在最自由的民主国家也是如此。
en: And all were gradually regulated, even in the most liberal democracies.

zh: 如今，我们必须考虑如何让社交媒体也和传统媒体一样，接受同样的透明度、问责和税收规则约束。
en: We must now consider how to submit social media to the same rules of transparency, accountability, and taxation as conventional media.

zh: 在美国，一群参议员提出了《诚实广告法案 》 ， 该法案将适用于印刷品、广播和电视的规则应用于社交媒体。
en: In the US, a group of senators has introduced the “Honest Ads Act,” which would extend the rules that apply to print, radio, and television to social media.

zh: 他们希望该法案能在2018年中期选举前成为法律。
en: They hope it will become law before the 2018 midterm election.

zh: 在德国，新的《网络执行法 》 （ Netzwerkdurchsetzungsgesetz）要求社交媒体公司在24小时内删除仇恨言论和假新闻，否则将面临最高5,000万欧元的罚款。
en: In Germany, a new law, the Netzwerkdurchsetzungsgesetz, requires social-media companies to remove hate speech and fake news within 24 hours or face fines of up to €50 million ($63 million).

zh: 这些措施也许有用，但我不确定国家法律是否足以监管在线政治行为。
en: As useful as these measures may be, I am not sure that national laws will be adequate to regulate online political activity.

zh: 许多穷国无法抵挡这样的阻力，而执法不论在哪个国家都将十分困难，因为许多数据并不是在监管所在国储存和管理的。
en: Many poorer countries will not be able to put up such resistance, and enforcement will be difficult everywhere, because much of the data are stored and managed outside the regulating country.

zh: 不论是否需要新的国际规范，我们都应该小心一点：在遏制过度行为的过程中，不可妨碍言论自由的基本权利。
en: Whether or not new international norms are necessary, we should be careful that in seeking to curb the excesses, we do not jeopardize the fundamental right to freedom of expression.

zh: 事实上，开放社会不应该过度反应，以防破坏作为合法性基础的自由。
en: Indeed, open societies should not over-react, lest they undermine the very freedoms on which they base their legitimacy.

zh: 但我们也不能继续坐视不理。
en: But nor can we remain idle.

zh: 一些硅谷和其他地方的主要行动方掌握着我们的命运；但如果我们可以把它们“拉上船 ” ， 就能够纠正当前制度的失灵。
en: A few major players, in Silicon Valley and elsewhere, hold our fate in their hands; but if we can get them on board, we can address the failings of the current system.

zh: 2012年，我召集了选举、民主和安全呢全球委员会（Global Commission on Elections, Democracy, and Security）研究和应对选举完整性所面临的挑战以及推进合法选举流程。
en: In 2012, I convened the Global Commission on Elections, Democracy, and Security to identify and tackle the challenges to the integrity of elections and promote legitimate electoral processes.

zh: 只有被人民普遍认为公正可信的选举，能够带来和平民主的领导层换届，赢家获得合法性，输家获得保护。
en: Only elections that the population generally accepts as fair and credible can lead to a peaceful and democratic rotation of leadership, conferring legitimacy on the winner and protecting the loser.

zh: 在科菲·安南基金的赞助下，我将召集一个新委员会 — — 这次将由社交媒体和信息技术界的意见领袖和政治领导人组成 — — 来帮助我们解决这些至关重要的新问题。
en: Under the auspices of the Kofi Annan Foundation, I will now convene a new commission – this time, with the masterminds of social media and information technology, as well as political leaders – to help us address these crucial new issues.

zh: 我们将致力于找到可行的方案服务于民主，捍卫选举的完整性，同时抓住新技术所带来的许多机会。
en: We will set out to find workable solutions that serve our democracies and safeguard the integrity of our elections, while harnessing the many opportunities new technologies have to offer.

zh: 我们将给出一些建议，我们希望这些建议能够协调技术进步与人类最伟大的成就之一 — — 民主之间的破坏性对立。
en: We will produce recommendations that will, we hope, reconcile the disruptive tensions created between technological advances and one of humanity’s greatest achievements: democracy.

zh: 技术不会一成不变，民主也应该如此。
en: Technology does not stand still, and nor should democracy.

zh: 我们必须迅速行动起来，因为数字进步也许只是滑向“老大哥”控制的奥威尔的世界的第一步，在这个世界里，成千上万传感器布置在我们的智能手机和其他装置中收集数据，并把我们变得易于操纵。
en: We have to act fast, because digital advances could be just the start of a slippery slope leading to an Orwellian world controlled by Big Brother, where millions of sensors in our smartphones and other devices collect data and make us vulnerable to manipulation.

zh: 手机和手表所收集的数据应该归谁所有？
en: Who should own all the data collected by our phones and watches?

zh: 这些数据应该如何使用？
en: How should such data be used?

zh: 如果其他人要用的话，是否应该得到我们的同意？
en: Should its use by others require our consent?

zh: 使用我们的数据的人由谁来问责？
en: To whom are those using our data accountable?

zh: 这些都是将影响到自由的未来的大问题。
en: These are the big questions that will shape the future of freedom.

zh: 维护尊严，还是走向没落？
en: Dignity or Decline?

zh: 发自东京 — — 既是数学家，同时也是著名作家的藤原正彦写了本名为《国家の品格 》 （ 国家的尊严）的书，并一举创下了300万册的销售记录。
en: TOKYO – Kokka no Hinkaku, The Dignity of a State, is the title of a recent book by the Japanese mathematician Masahiko Fujiwara that has sold three million copies.

zh: 而日本人对此书的讨论是如此热烈，以至于“品格”一词都摇身一变成了流行语。
en: Talk about the book in Japan is so fervid that the term “dignity” (hinkaku) has become a buzzword.

zh: 事实上，日本这种把国家尊严上升为中心议题的现象并不令人吃惊。
en: That Japan’s dignity is now a central issue should surprise no one.

zh: 因为此时正是日本必须规划其未来之路的时刻 — — 作为中国这个巨大国家的邻邦，要么走下坡路，要么努力维持自身的尊严。
en: For this is a moment when Japan must chart its course – either decline or dignity – as a “state” (kokka) in relation to its giant neighbor, China.

zh: 而日本的对中关系问题也在9月被激化，当时一位中国船长驾驶渔船与两艘日本巡逻船在尖阁诸岛（即钓鱼岛）附近洋面发生碰撞，该岛属于日本领海范围以内的领土，因此日本海岸警卫队逮捕了该名船长。
en: The issue of relations with China crystallized in September, when the Japanese Coast Guard arrested the captain of a Chinese trawler after his ship hit two Japanese patrol boats near the Senkaku Islands, which are part of Japan and within its territorial waters.

zh: 事件发生之后，日本与同样宣称对该岛拥有主权的中国之间的紧张局势当即升温。
en: Tension between Japan and China – which claims the islands – immediately soared.

zh: 许多年来，日本政府在岛屿领土争端上一直都采取“维持现状，不惹麻烦”的策略，沉默应对中国（和台湾）的一次次挑衅。
en: For many years, Japanese governments have taken a “let-sleeping-dogs-lie” approach to territorial disputes over the islands, ignoring repeated provocations by China (and Taiwan).

zh: 但在亲中的鸠山由纪夫政府于2009年9月大选上台之后，形势就发生了变化。
en: But that ended with the election of September 2009, which ushered in the pro-China administration of Prime Minister Yukio Hatoyama.

zh: 鸠山在政治上非常幼稚，甚至公开宣称要把东海变成中国主导下的“兄弟之海 ” 。
en: Hatoyama was naïve enough to declare publicly his intention of turning the East China Sea into a Chinese-led “Sea of Fraternity.”

zh: 他同时还主张让美国空军基地撤出冲绳，直接得罪了美国人这个日本最大的盟友。
en: He also earned the distrust of the United States, Japan’s most important ally, by advocating the relocation outside Japan of a US air base on Okinawa.

zh: 这一切导致鸠山最终于今年早些时候下台，但外交现实主义却未能回归日本政坛，恰恰相反，鸠山的继任者菅直人依然相信日本能够脱离过去的历史和所处地域行事。
en: Diplomatic realism was not restored after Hatoyama’s fall from power earlier this year. Instead, his successor, Naoto Kan, continues to believe that Japan can somehow opt out of history and a turbulent region.

zh: 在今年9月联合国大会上的发言中，菅直人宣称他的政府正寻求实现一个“尽可能减少民众苦难的社会 ” 。
en: Speaking at the United Nations plenary meeting this September, Kan said that his government seeks to achieve a “society in which human suffering is reduced a minimum.”

zh: 而国防问题则被晾在了一边。
en: National security is treated as a low-grade issue.

zh: 与此同时，中国也在实践着自己的“尊严”之路 — — 这在亚洲其他国家（朝鲜除外）看来就是某种统治权。
en: Meanwhile, China is following its own definition of “dignity,” which looks to almost everyone in Asia – other than Kan’s government – as a right to dominate.

zh: 事实上中国已经撕下了面具，彻底暴露出其称霸太平洋的野心了。
en: Indeed, China no longer even tries to hide its desire for hegemony in the Pacific.

zh: 中国似乎要把尖阁诸岛问题上的对峙视为对日方决心的考验 — — 虽然当年朝鲜在这方面一败涂地。
en: China appears to have seen the standoff over the Senkaku Islands as a test of wills – a test Kan’s government failed abysmally.

zh: 为了报复日方拒绝释放船长的举措，中国暗示其将召回驻日大使，停止双边部长级交流，并取消1万名中国游客的赴日行程。
en: In retaliation for Japan’s refusal to release the trawler captain, China hinted that it might recall its ambassador from Tokyo, suspended bilateral ministerial-level exchanges, and canceled a tour to Japan for about 10,000 Chinese.

zh: 更过分的是，中国以涉嫌间谍活动的理由逮捕了日本藤田公司的四名日本雇员。
en: More ominously, the Chinese arrested four employees of Fujita, a Japanese construction company, on suspicion of espionage.

zh: 但这四人实际上是受日本政府委派，来华处理二战日军遗弃化学武器的。
en: The four were in China for a project commissioned by the Japanese government to dispose of chemical weapons abandoned by the Japanese military after World War II.

zh: 中国官员还声称可能停止对日稀土出口 — — 这是许多日本企业生产所必须的关键原材料 — — 也最终实施了非正式的稀土禁运。
en: Chinese officials also suggested the possibility of banning exports to Japan of rare-earth elements – raw materials crucial for many Japanese manufacturing processes – and appear to have done so informally.

zh: 外交经验和手腕都乏善可陈的菅直人政府选择了屈服，并在前一段时间释放了中方船长，政府甚至还试图让正式逮捕该名船长的地方检查厅来背这个黑锅。
en: Inexperienced and diplomatically inept, Kan’s administration buckled, releasing the trawler captain early. His government then sought to pin the blame on the local prosecutor who had formally arrested the captain.

zh: 这种软弱的外交态度使日本民众大为震惊，菅直人政府的民意支持率也因此一落千丈。
en: This display of weak-kneed diplomacy appalled many Japanese, and popular support for Kan’s administration has plummeted.

zh: 而中方对稀土元素 — — 人称“工业的维生素 ” — —的实质性禁止出口对日本企业造成了严重冲击，因为这些公司97%的稀土原料都来自中国。
en: The de facto export ban on rare-earth elements – often referred to as “industrial vitamins” – struck a terrible blow to Japanese companies, which rely on China for 97% of their supply.

zh: 在诸多稀土元素中，钕和镝都被广泛运用于环保汽车和家电领域，是制造马达的磁性材料，铒是生产光纤的掺杂物，而铈则是液晶显示器玻璃的抛光粉原料。
en: Among a variety of rare-earth elements, neodymium and dysprosium are widely used as a magnetic material for motors in environmentally friendly vehicles and home appliances, while erbium is used as a dopant in optical fibers and cerium as an abrasive for polishing liquid crystal display (LCD) glass.

zh: 这种“稀土恐吓”的作用范围可不仅限于日本，因为中国的稀土开采量占全世界90%以上，大约12万吨。
en: The “rare-earth threat” is not confined to Japan, as China accounts for over 90% of the world’s production, roughly 120,000 tons.

zh: 但这本来不算什么威胁，因为全世界拥有足够的稀土储量。
en: But this shouldn’t be a threat at all, because the world has ample reserves of these elements.

zh: 事实上，稀土元素的“稀”只是由于它们分布量少，且必须经过漫长的过程才能从矿石中分离出来。
en: Indeed, rare-earth elements are “rare” only in the sense that they are distributed in small quantities and must be extracted from ores, a time-consuming process.

zh: 稀土矿遍布全世界。
en: Rare-earth mines are found throughout the world.

zh: 中国对全球市场的垄断仅仅是因为其拥有大量靠近地表的稀土矿藏而已。
en: China dominates the global market simply because it has fairly abundant rare-earth ores close to the surface.

zh: 当然，中国还拥有大量的廉价劳动力去处理矿石。
en: Of course, China also has abundant cheap labor to process ore.

zh: 中国南部地区的稀土矿（内蒙古地区除外）含有对人体和环境有害的放射性物质。
en: Rare-earth ores in southern China – all except for those in Inner Mongolia – contain radioactive substances that pose significant threats to human health and the environment.

zh: 其他国家或许会担心稀土处理过程中的工人健康问题，但对中国来说，这根本不是个问题。
en: Other countries might worry about the health risk to workers in rare-earth processing, but that does not appear to be true of China.

zh: 面对中���稀土生产商的杀伤性低价策略，美国及世界其他国家的稀土矿纷纷关闭。
en: In the face of aggressive price cutting by Chinese rare-earth producers, many mines in the US and elsewhere in the world were shut down over the years.

zh: 即便是在中日争端之前，中国已经开始限制稀土出口，并将其定义为一项重要战略资源。
en: Even before the trawler incident, China was trying to regulate rare-earths, defining them as a strategic resource.

zh: 中国官员声称对稀土过度开采和非法出口的关注引发了对该行业监管力度的加强。
en: Chinese officials say that concern over the overexploitation and illicit export of rare earths prompted them to regulate the industry more closely.

zh: 但这种管制与杀伤性低价策略相结合则暴露出了中国垄断稀土的企图，而对日本的实质性稀土禁运则似乎是对这种垄断迷梦的一次利益测试。
en: But this regulation, when combined with China’s aggressive pricing, suggests a desire to assert monopoly control, and the de facto ban of rare-earth exports to Japan looks like an effort to test the benefits of this looming monopoly.

zh: 然而中国这番举动也令世界各国纷纷提高了警惕。
en: China’s move, however, put the rest of the world on alert.

zh: 许多国家正开始计划开发国内稀土资源或寻找相关替代资源，并进一步加快科技研究，摆脱稀土依赖。
en: Many countries are now planning to develop their own or alternative sources of rare-earth elements, and to accelerate efforts to develop technologies that are free of them.

zh: 此外，中国限制稀土出口的背后有着另一个动机：它想迫使全球高科技企业都转移到中国生产，以便让本土企业吸收前者的技术。
en: But China has another motive for tightening the noose on rare-earth exports: it wants to force high-tech firms to operate in China, so that local companies can absorb their technologies.

zh: 正如一名中方高级官员所说，即便稀土出口受限，日本企业也能通过在华设厂的方式保证生产。
en: A senior official of a Chinese company has said that, even though rare-earth exports have been restricted, Japanese companies can secure their supply by launching operations in China.

zh: 怪只怪菅直人政府无能，面对着中国的百般敲诈勒索，却找不到一个能维护日本国家尊严的方式。
en: If there is a response to such blackmail that could preserve Japan’s dignity, the Kan government is unlikely to find it.

zh: “比利印度”论
en: Belindia Has Spoken

zh: 圣地亚哥—四十年前，巴西经济学家埃德马尔·巴查（Edmar Bacha）将他的祖国称为“比利印度 ” ： 繁荣而现代的比利时和贫穷而落后的印度的合体。
en: SANTIAGO – Forty years ago, the Brazilian economist Edmar Bacha named his country Belindia: a combination of prosperous and modern Belgium and poor and backward India.

zh: 很多观察者看来，在上周日的总统选举中，巴西的印度部分支持现任总统迪尔马·罗塞夫，而比利时部分支持社会民主党人艾西奥·尼维斯（Aécio Neves ） 。
en: In last Sunday’s presidential election, according to many observers, the Indian part of Brazil voted for the incumbent, President Dilma Rousseff, and the Belgian part voted for the social democrat Aécio Neves.

zh: 印度比比利时大，所以罗塞夫赢了。
en: India is larger, so Rousseff won.

zh: 这正在迅速成为巴西选举的标准解说词。 这次选举是近期最针锋相对、竞争最激烈的一次。
en: This is fast becoming the standard account of Brazil’s election, the most acrimonious and hotly contested in recent memory.

zh: 不难看出为何如此。
en: And it is easy to see why.

zh: 在巴西欠发达的东北部，迪尔马（在巴西，政客和足球明星一样，用首名称呼自己）取得压倒性胜利。
en: In Brazil’s underdeveloped Nordeste, Dilma (in Brazil, politicians, like footballers, go by their first name) swept the vote.

zh: 在相对富裕的南部（占巴西经济产出的70 % ） ，艾西奥大获全胜。
en: In the relatively rich South, which accounts for 70% of Brazil’s economic output, Aécio won handily.

zh: 如果把选民根据倚赖政府救济（在东北部比例很高）还是倚赖教育（在南部比例较高）分类，也会出现类似的结果。
en: Similar divisions appear when voters are classified according to dependence on government handouts (high in the Northeast) or years of schooling (high in the South).

zh: 但除了这一总体图景之外，此次选举还有诸多细节值得关注。
en: Yet there is more to this election than this broad-brush picture suggests.

zh: 1974年，当巴查发明“比利印度”一词时，毫无疑问繁荣而现代的巴西只占总体的极少部分。
en: In 1974, when Bacha coined his term, it went without saying that the prosperous and modern Brazil was just a tiny sliver of the total.

zh: 2014年 ， “ 比利时”巴西候选人尼维斯赢得了超过48%的选票。
en: In 2014, Neves, the candidate of “Belgian” Brazil, won more than 48% of the vote.

zh: 这凸显出巴西在过去四十年中的变化，以及中产阶级的壮大和影响力的日增。
en: That reveals how much the country has changed in the last four decades, and how large and influential its middle class has become.

zh: 正是这批对腐败和经济停滞不满的中产阶级开始反对执政的劳工党（Workers’ Party ） ， 把票投给了变化。
en: It was precisely that middle class, fed up with allegations of corruption and a sluggish economy, that turned against the ruling Workers’ Party (PT) and voted for change.

zh: 但同样令人惊讶的是，尽管经济萎靡 — — 在罗塞夫的第一个任期中，平均经济增长率只有1.5 % ， 目前更是陷入了技术性衰退，已连续两个季度出现收缩 — — 迪尔马和劳工党仍拥有巴西数千万穷人和被排除的公民的支持。
en: But it is also striking that despite the weak economy – growth will barely average 1.5% during Rousseff’s first term, and the economy is now in a technical recession, having contracted in two consecutive quarters – Dilma and the PT managed to retain the support of Brazil’s tens of millions of poor and excluded citizens.

zh: 这部分是因为衰退并没有给就业带来很大影响，而这意味着许多家庭尚未感受到冲击。
en: This is partly because the recession has not made a big dent in employment, which means that many households have yet to feel the impact.

zh: 迪尔马还获得了商品超级周期的支持，商品超级周期让巴西资金充裕，因此能够实施大手笔现金转移支付几乎，将无数家庭带出了贫困。
en: Dilma was also helped by the commodity super-cycle, which filled Brazil’s coffers and made it possible to run ambitious cash-transfer programs that helped pull countless families out of poverty.

zh: 这些政策实际上是尼维斯所在的巴西社会民主党（Party of Brazilian Social Democracy）前总统卡多佐（Fernando Henrique Cardoso）启动的，但在群众的印象中，这是迪尔马的政治导师兼前任、同样来自劳工党的卢拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）的功劳。
en: These policies were actually launched by former President Fernando Henrique Cardoso of Neves’s Party of Brazilian Social Democracy (PSDB), but are associated in the popular imagination with Dilma’s political mentor and predecessor, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, also of the PT.

zh: 迪尔马声称艾西奥会削减这些广受支持的计划（但她并无证据 ） ， 成功地重创了社会民主党。
en: By claiming (with no evidence) that Aécio would cut these popular programs, Dilma dealt the PSDB a sharp electoral blow.

zh: 利用商品收入赢取政治支持并非巴西所独有的战略。
en: Using commodity revenues to obtain political support is not a strategy unique to Brazil.

zh: 在阿根廷、玻利维亚、厄瓜多尔和委内瑞拉，民粹主义者都使用同样的伎俩。
en: In Argentina, Bolivia, Ecuador, and Venezuela, populists have tried the same trick.

zh: 而与它们截然不同的智利保守党人皮涅拉（Sebastián Piñera）和社会党人巴切莱特（Michelle Bachelet）也是如此。
en: So have the vastly different governments of the conservative Sebastián Piñera and the socialist Michelle Bachelet in Chile.

zh: 这个相似的名单还可以拉得更长。
en: And the similarities do not end there.

zh: 如今，商品繁荣正在终结，所有这些国家都面临寻找新经济引擎维持增长和创造就业的挑战。
en: Now that the commodity boom is ending, all of these countries face the challenge of building a new economic engine to sustain growth and create jobs.

zh: 没有了商品带来的巨额财富，它们必须发展能生产新商品和服务的新产业，而这需要新技能和新的基础设施类型。
en: Without the commodity windfall, they must develop new sectors that can produce new goods and services, requiring new sets of skills and new types of infrastructure.

zh: 这是难以完成的任务，特别是在巴西。
en: This is a tall order, especially for Brazil.

zh: 巴西经济的结构缺陷早已众所周知，但并未采取多少纠正这些缺陷的措施。
en: The structural deficiencies of its economy have long been understood, but little has been done to correct them.

zh: 巴西拥有南美最大的政府（税收占GDP的比例超过三分之一 ） ， 但巴西当局储蓄和投资太少，导致了微观和宏观经济问题。
en: Brazil has South America’s biggest government (with a tax take exceeding one-third of GDP), yet the authorities save and invest too little, which creates both micro- and macroeconomic problems.

zh: 在微观层面，公共投资过少意味着基础设施破旧不堪、出口成本高企。
en: On the micro side, too little public investment means poor infrastructure and high export costs.

zh: 邻国阿根廷所实施的高昂出口税巴西一项都没有实施，但沉重的交易成本起到了一样的效果。
en: Brazil has none of neighboring Argentina’s hefty export taxes, but its heavy transport costs have the same effect.

zh: 教育也没有得到多少公共资金支持，特别是学前教育和小学教育。
en: Education, too, receives little public funding, especially at the pre-school and primary levels.

zh: 与智利相同，巴西大幅提高了学校入学率，但并未为后进儿童提供高质量的学习机会。
en: Like Chile, Brazil has sharply increased school enrollment but has yet to provide high-quality learning opportunities to disadvantaged children.

zh: 在经合组织国际PISA排名（衡量教育成就 ） ， 巴西几乎垫底，名次低于墨西哥和智利。
en: In the OECD’s international PISA rankings of educational achievement, Brazil places near the bottom, below Mexico and Chile.

zh: 在宏观层面，公共储蓄不足意味着国民储��不足。
en: On the macro side, too little public savings means insufficient savings at the national level.

zh: 当巴西可以获得国际资金时，这催生了短期的繁荣和大规模经常项目赤字（通过大量对外借款融资 ） 。
en: When international funds are available, this produces short-lived booms and large current-account deficits, financed by heavy external borrowing.

zh: 当国际流动性枯竭时 — — 巴西和拉丁美洲经常遭遇这种情况 — — 就会出现国内投资疲软和经济增长停滞。
en: When international liquidity dries up, as it often does for Brazil and Latin America, weak domestic investment and sluggish growth follow.

zh: 尼维斯提出了纠正这些缺陷的计划。
en: Neves had a plan to address these shortcomings.

zh: 迪尔马没有。
en: Dilma does not.

zh: 她的选举前夜演讲充斥着对团结和对话的呼吁，应承诺“采取紧急措施”重塑增长。
en: Her election-night speech was full of calls for unity and dialogue, and included a pledge to “take urgent action” to resume growth.

zh: 但是，和她的选战战略一样，她的演讲缺少具体内容。
en: But, like her campaign, the speech was short on specifics.

zh: 在产业政策方面，劳工党直觉正确，但手段错误。
en: On industrial policy, the PT has the right intuition but the wrong tools.

zh: 和国内主导行业合作推进创新是一回事；通过价格控制（如能源 ） 、 歧视性补贴和保护主义这样做是另一回事。
en: Partnering with leading domestic sectors to promote innovation is one thing; doing so through price controls (as with fuels), indiscriminate subsidies, and protectionism is another.

zh: 近几年来，巴西采取的是后一种方式。
en: In recent years, Brazil has taken the latter route.

zh: 罗塞夫没有多少时间可以浪费了。
en: Rousseff has little time to waste.

zh: 她面临的是一个公共债务负担沉重（占GDP的60 % ） 、货币波动剧烈、通货膨胀高企的巴西。
en: She will govern a country with substantial public debt (60% of GDP), a volatile currency, and high inflation.

zh: 紧张的金融市场将继续掣肘巴西政府。
en: Nervous financial markets will keep the government on a tight leash.

zh: 尼维斯和他的社会民主党通过这次选举而壮大了不少，但他们也将在未来几年中面临艰巨挑战。
en: Neves and his PSDB have come out of this election considerably strengthened, but they also will face difficult challenges in the coming years.

zh: 社会民主党在国会中的占比增加了（包括在参议院的尼维斯本人）并将在不少巴西大州执政，包括拥有4,300万人口、占巴西GDP三分之一的圣保罗州。
en: The social democrats will have a larger delegation in Congress (including Neves himself in the Senate) and will govern some of Brazil’s larger states, including São Paulo, home to 43 million people and one-third of the country’s GDP.

zh: 但要想在2018年问鼎总统宝座，社会民主党必须让巴西穷人 — — 即巴查的印度部分 — — 相信社会民主党是代表他们的政党，其所支持的政策将让他们获益最多。
en: But to reach the Planalto Presidential Palace after the 2018 election, the PSDB will have to convince poor Brazilians – those living in Bacha’s India – that it works on their behalf, and that the policies it advocates benefit them the most.

zh: 如此，也只有如此，巴西长期存在的分裂局面才会开始得到纠正。
en: Then, and only then, will Brazil’s longstanding divisions begin to heal.

zh: 到那时，巴西将水到渠成地出现现代、高效的社会民主党政府。
en: When they do, the country will get the modern and effective social-democratic government that it deserves.

zh: 特朗普经济学前景黯淡
en: A Dim Outlook for Trumponomics

zh: 纽约—美国总统特朗普履新已经六个月，我们可以带着更多的自信来评估美国经济的前景和他 政府的经济决策。
en: NEW YORK – Now that US President Donald Trump has been in office for six months, we can more confidently assess the prospects for the US economy and economic policymaking under his administration.

zh: 与特朗普执政的总体情况一样，这方面充满着悖论。
en: And, like Trump’s presidency more generally, paradoxes abound.

zh: 最主要的谜团是金融市场表现和实体经济之间的脱节。
en: The main puzzle is the disconnect between the performance of financial markets and the real.

zh: 股票市场高歌猛进，频创新高，而美国经济在2017年上半年平均增长率只有2 % — —慢于奥巴马总统任职期间的增长率 — — 在今年余下的时间中也难有起色。
en: While stock markets continue to reach new highs, the US economy grew at an average rate of just 2% in the first half of 2017 – slower growth than under President Barack Obama – and is not expected to perform much better for the rest of the year.

zh: 股市投资者仍然寄希望于特朗普能拿出刺激增长、提高公司利润的政策。
en: Stock-market investors continue to hold out hope that Trump can push through policies to stimulate growth and increase corporate profits.

zh: 此外，工资增长的停滞意味着通货膨胀不会达到美联储的目标率，而这又意味着美联储将不得不以慢于预期的速度实现利率正常化。
en: Moreover, sluggish wage growth implies that inflation is not reaching the US Federal Reserve’s target rate, which means that the Fed will have to normalize interest rates more slowly than expected.

zh: 较低的长期利率和较弱的美元对美国股市来说是利好，而特朗普的亲商日程理论上对个股来说也是利好，即使目前的氛围让人们要退出所谓的特朗普再通胀交易。
en: Lower long-term interest rates and a weaker dollar are good news for US stock markets, and Trump’s pro-business agenda is still good for individual stocks in principle, even if the air has been let out of the so-called Trump reflation trade.

zh: 而现在，也不必担心大规模财政刺激计划会推高美元、迫使美联储提高利率。
en: And there is now less reason to worry that a massive fiscal-stimulus program will push up the dollar and force the Fed to raise rates.

zh: 从特朗普政府的政治无能看，更安全的假设是，刺激将远远低于预期，甚至根本不会有刺激。
en: In view of the Trump administration’s political ineffectiveness, it is safe to assume that if there is any stimulus at all, it will be smaller than expected.

zh: 特朗普政府无力推动经济政策的状况不太可能会发生改变。
en: The administration’s inability to execute on the economic-policy front is unlikely to change.

zh: 国会共和党取代平价医疗法（奥巴马医保）的尝试以失败告终，因为温和派共和党拒绝投票支持将剥夺2,000万美国人医保的法案。
en: Congressional Republicans’ attempts to replace the Affordable Care Act (Obamacare) have failed, not least because moderate Republicans refused to vote for a bill that would deprive some 20 million Americans of their health insurance.

zh: 特朗普政府现在正在推行税收改革。 而这场改革的难度同样巨大。
en: The Trump administration is now moving on to tax reform, which will be just as hard, if not harder, to enact.

zh: 早先的税改方案预期能够通过取消奥巴马医保和所谓的“边境调节税 ” （ 也已经被放弃）来节约支出。
en: Earlier tax-reform proposals had anticipated savings from the repeal of Obamacare, and from a proposed “border adjustment tax” that has since been abandoned.

zh: 这使得国会共和党没有多少施展空间。
en: That leaves congressional Republicans with little room for maneuver.

zh: 由于美国参议院预算协调规则要求所有减税计划都必须在十年后实现收入中性，因此共和党要么大幅降低最初的税率下调幅度，要么拿出一份得不偿失的临时性有限减税方案了事。
en: Because the US Senate’s budget-reconciliation rules require all tax cuts to be revenue-neutral after ten years, Republicans will either have to cut tax rates by far less than they had originally intended, or settle for temporary and limited tax cuts that aren’t paid for.

zh: 要想有利于美国工人并刺激经济增长，税收改革需要增加富人的负担，并为工人和中产阶级减负。
en: To benefit American workers and spur economic growth, tax reforms need to increase the burden on the rich, and provide relief to workers and the middle class.

zh: 但特朗普的方案反其道而行之：根据计划的不同，80—90%的好处将收入分布顶层10%的人的囊中。
en: But Trump’s proposals would do the opposite: depending on which plan you look at, 80-90% of the benefits would go to the top 10% of the income distribution.

zh: 更重要的是，美国公司并非如同特朗普和国会共和党所声称的那样，是因为税率太高而囤积了数万亿美元现金而拒绝进行资本投资。
en: More to the point, US corporations aren’t hoarding trillions of dollars in cash and refusing to make capital investments because the tax rate is too high, as Trump and congressional Republicans claim.

zh: 相反，企业之所以不愿意投资，是因为工资增长低迷抑制了消费，从而抑制了总体经济增长。
en: Rather, firms are less inclined to invest because slow wage growth is depressing consumption, and thus overall economic growth.

zh: 除了税收改革，特朗普通过1万亿美元基础设施支出刺激短期增长的计划也还没有水落石出。
en: Beyond tax reform, Trump’s plan to stimulate short-term growth through $1 trillion in infrastructure spending is still not on the horizon.

zh: 特朗普政府并不准备直接拿出如此巨大的投资，而是希望通过向私人部门提供些许税收激励，来让它们领衔各大项目。
en: And, instead of direct government investment of that amount, the administration wants to provide modest tax incentives for the private sector to spearhead various projects.

zh: 不幸的是，要让基础设施项目实现有始有终，光靠税收优惠是不够的，而“万事俱备”型项目又少之又少。
en: Unfortunately, it will take more than tax breaks to bring large infrastructure projects from start to finish, and “shovel-ready” projects are few and far between.

zh: 贸易方面则是喜忧参半。
en: On trade, there is good news and bad news.

zh: 好消息是特朗普政府没有追求激进的保护主义政策，比如将某些国家列为货币操纵国、征收跨境关税，或推行边境调节税等。
en: The good news is that the administration has not pursued radically protectionist policies, such as branding countries as currency manipulators, introducing across-the-board tariffs, or pushing for the border adjustment tax.

zh: 坏消息是特朗普坚守其“买美国货、雇美国人”的信条，他的保护主义姿态给增长造成的伤害将甚于拯救的就业岗位。
en: The bad news is that Trump is sticking to his “buy American, hire American” credo, and his protectionist gestures will hurt growth more than they save jobs.

zh: 他已经抛弃了跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP）和与欧盟进行的跨大西洋贸易和投资伙伴关系（TTIP）谈判。
en: He has already abandoned the Trans-Pacific Partnership and negotiations for the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership with the European Union.

zh: 他正在重新进行北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）谈判。 他还可能试图重新进行其他自由贸易协定谈判，比如与韩国的双边协定。
en: He is renegotiating the North American Free Trade Agreement, and he may try to renegotiate other free-trade agreements, such as the bilateral deal with South Korea.

zh: 他还可能向中国发动贸易战，对钢铁和其他产品征收关税 — — 特别是在考虑到如今中国应对朝鲜核威胁升级不力的情况下。
en: And he could still start a trade war with China by introducing tariffs on steel and other products – especially now that China has been uncooperative in responding to North Korea’s escalating nuclear threat.

zh: 特朗普还可能限制移民，这会抑制美国的增长潜力。
en: Trump could also limit the US’s growth potential by restricting immigration.

zh: 除了禁止来自六个穆斯林占多数国家的入境者，特朗普政府还准备限制高技能工人移民，加紧驱逐无证移民。
en: In addition to barring visitors from six predominantly Muslim countries, the administration is intent on restricting migration for high-skill workers, and is ramping up deportations of undocumented immigrants.

zh: 这，以及大肆宣传的边境墙，将导致未来劳动力供给减少，从而抑制经济增长，特别是在美国人口持续老龄化、退出劳动力的情况下。
en: This, along with the much-ballyhooed border wall, will cut future labor supply, and thus economic growth, especially as the American population continues to age and drop out of the labor force.

zh: 最后，特朗普的去监管化日程无法提振经济增长，假以时日，其中的许多措施实际上还将削弱增长。
en: Lastly, Trump’s deregulation agenda will not boost economic growth, and may actually weaken it over time.

zh: 如果金融监管过度放松，其结果可能是又一场资产和信用泡沫乃至又一次金融危机和衰退。
en: If financial regulations are loosened too much, the result could be another asset and credit bubble, and even another financial crisis and recession.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普的退出巴黎气候协定的决定，以及放松环境监管的政策，将导致生态破坏、太阳能等绿色经济产业增长放缓。
en: Meanwhile, Trump’s decision to withdraw from the Paris climate agreement, combined with a rollback of environmental regulations, will lead to ecological degradation and slower growth in green-economy industries such as solar power.

zh: 而劳动力保护的减弱将进一步削弱工人的议价能力，从而拉低工资增长和总体消费。
en: And weaker labor protections will further reduce workers’ bargaining power, thus holding down wage growth and overall consumption.

zh: 毫不奇怪，实际和潜在增长被限定在2%左右。
en: It is little wonder that actual and potential growth is stuck at around 2%.

zh: 诚然，通胀率较低，公司利润和股市节节攀升。
en: Yes, inflation is low, and corporate profits and stock markets are soaring.

zh: 但华尔街和普罗大众之前的鸿沟变得越来越大。
en: But the gap between Wall Street and Main Street is widening.

zh: 受流动性和非理性繁荣驱动的高市场估值并没有反映基本经济现实。
en: High market valuations that are fueled by liquidity and irrational exuberance do not reflect fundamental economic realities.

zh: 最终，市场修正将不可避免。
en: An eventual market correction is inevitable.

zh: 唯一的问题是到时候特朗普会把谁当成替罪羊。
en: The only question is whom Trump will blame when it happens.

zh: 外交最黯淡的时刻
en: Diplomacy’s Darkest Hours

zh: 马德里 — — 如今，外交并没有经历辉煌时刻。
en: MADRID – Diplomacy is not having its finest hour nowadays.

zh: 恰恰相反：当今大多数冲突都抵制外交途径解决。
en: Quite the contrary: resistance to diplomatic solutions is a common thread in most of today’s major conflicts.

zh: 阿富汗会继续淌血，直到北约联军最终认识到只有通过与塔利班谈判才能有可能结束战争。
en: Afghanistan will continue to bleed until the allies finally recognize that only by engaging the Taliban do they stand a chance of ending the war.

zh: 但是西方同样需要认识到，军事手段很难结束那些包含强烈文化和宗教因素的冲突，比如结束对伊斯兰政治势力的放逐 — — 哈马斯、黎巴嫩真主党等。
en: But the West will also have to recognize that conflicts with a potent cultural and religious component are simply not susceptible to a military solution – a realization that points toward ending the ostracism of political Islam – Hamas and Hezbollah, for example.

zh: 此外，伊朗核武发展的势不可挡证明了国际社会没能抑制这一地区的核武潮流。
en: Meanwhile, Iran’s unstoppable rush to develop nuclear weapons could prove to be a monument to the international community’s failure to stem the atomic tide in the region.

zh: 巴以冲突继续披上外交谈判的伪装，数十年来都是如此。
en: The Israeli-Palestinian conflict continues to be the diplomatic charade that it has been for many years now.

zh: 以色列与叙利亚、黎巴嫩之间的紧张局势也没有得到缓解。
en: And nothing has attenuated the tensions between Israel and both Syria and Lebanon.

zh: 历史告诉我们，外交通常只有在强权的支持下才能带来结果。 这就是美国前总统、诺贝尔和平奖获得者西奥多·罗斯福的存在主义世界观。
en: History teaches that diplomacy all too frequently produces results only when backed by overwhelming power.

zh: 他曾说 ： “ 从长期起来看，正义的战争比最富庶的和平年代更能让人的灵魂受益。 ”一个世纪后，现任美国总统奥巴马在中东身陷两场无望获胜的战争。
en: Such was the existentialist worldview of US President and Nobel Peace Prize laureate Theodore Roosevelt, a major advocate of American expansionism: “A just war is, in the long run, far better for a man’s soul than the most prosperous peace.”

zh: 他也获得了诺贝尔和平奖。 在获奖发言中，他为“正义的战争”带来的伤害道歉。
en: A century later, another American president, Barack Obama, immersed in two hopeless wars in the Middle East, received his Nobel Peace Prize with an apology for “just wars.”

zh: 事实上 ，有许多诺贝尔和平奖的获得者 — — 罗斯福、乔治·马歇尔、梅纳赫姆·贝京、萨达特、伊扎·拉宾、阿拉法特以及基辛格，他们要么在最后认识到军事力量的局限性，要么相信克劳塞维茨的理论：战争是政治的延续，只是方式不同。
en: Indeed, the list of Nobel Peace Prize laureates is not lacking in men – Roosevelt, George Marshall, Menachem Begin, Anwar Sadat, Yitzhak Rabin, Yasser Arafat, and Henry Kissinger – who either ended up recognizing the limits of military power or were simply following Clausewitz’s dictum that war is the continuation of politics by other means.

zh: 只有当各方陷于十分痛苦的僵局时，用外交途径来解决冲突的时机才成熟。
en: Conflicts start to be ripe for diplomatic solutions only when the parties get trapped in an unbearably painful mutual deadlock.

zh: 如果没有这种僵局，联合国决议和过早的和平倡议都不能中止战争态势。
en: Without such a deadlock, neither United Nations resolutions, nor premature peace initiatives can cut short the dynamic of war.

zh: 只有在出现僵局的时候，权力共享的方案 — — 如在北爱尔兰、黎巴嫩、危地马拉、伊拉克等 — — 才会变成现实可行的选择。
en: It is only then that formulas for power-sharing – such as those in Northern Ireland, Lebanon, Guatemala, or Iraq – emerge as a realistic alternative.

zh: 是北约强势的军事干预为终止前南斯拉夫的大屠杀和种族清洗创造了条件，而不是欧洲的外交途径。
en: It was NATO’s robust military intervention, not European diplomacy, that created the conditions for the end of genocide and ethnic cleansing in the former Yugoslavia.

zh: 马尔蒂·阿赫蒂萨里完全有资格获得诺贝尔和平奖，因为他为科索沃的独立提供了提供了外交解决方案。
en: Martti Ahtisaari fully deserved his Nobel Peace Prize for articulating a diplomatic solution to Kosovo’s drive for independence.

zh: 但是如果要不是塞尔维亚的军事力量受到了削弱，科索沃的独立也不会实现。
en: But this could not be achieved before Serbia was militarily humbled.

zh: 尽管捷克斯洛伐克通过“天鹅绒分离”和平地分为两个国家，这十分鼓舞人心，但是无论在欧洲还是其他地方，这种现象都不是常态。
en: However encouraging, Czechoslovakia’s peaceful “velvet divorce” into two states has not been the norm in Europe or elsewhere.

zh: 要不是1973年的赎罪日战争（第四次中东战争 — — 译者注 ） ， 以色列和埃及永远都不会达成和平协议。
en: If it were not for the 1973 Yom Kippur War, Israel and Egypt would never have reached a peace settlement.

zh: 而正是第一次海湾战争和以占区巴勒斯坦人的暴动为1991年的马德里和会以及随后奥斯陆协议创造了条件。
en: And it was the first Gulf War and Palestinian Intifadah that created the conditions for the 1991 Madrid Peace Conference and the subsequent Oslo Accords.

zh: 在拉宾被暗杀后，人们越来越相信巴以和平协议将会是“精疲力尽之人的和平 ” ， 而不是拉宾说的“勇敢者的和平 ” 。
en: After Rabin’s assassination, the notion has been gaining ground that any Israeli-Palestinian accord would be the “peace of the exhausted,” not Rabin’s “peace of the brave.”

zh: 尽管如此，巴以冲突具有特殊性：要么是60年的僵局对双方来说还没到难以承受的地步，要么双方宁愿为冲突付出代价，也不愿违背各自的民族精神。
en: But the Israeli-Palestinian conflict is nonetheless sui generis: either the parties’ six-decade mutual deadlock is not unbearable enough, or they prefer to pay the price of conflict rather than compromise their national ethos.

zh: 正是因为双方会谈解决问题的希望渺茫，所以人们要求国际社会为双方提供强制解决方案的呼声越来越响。
en: Such is now the loss of hope in a negotiated solution that those who advocate an internationally imposed solution seem to be gaining ground.

zh: 如果一场内部冲突不是因为双方的僵局而结���，而是因为一方取得了压倒性的胜利，那么这场内部冲突很少需要外交解决方案。
en: Internal conflicts that end not with mutual deadlock but with an overwhelming victory by one of the parties hardly ever produce diplomatic solutions.

zh: 在斯里兰卡的内战中，持续多年的斡旋和和平提议没能结束战争，也没能结束对泰米尔族的摧毁。
en: Long years of mediation and endless peace proposals in the Sri Lanka conflict failed to end the war and the devastation of entire Tamil communities.

zh: 只有在政府军彻底打败“泰米尔猛虎”组织的叛乱分子时 ， “ 和平”才得以实现。
en: “Peace” came about only with the total and unconditional defeat of the Tamil Tiger rebels.

zh: 同样，车臣、比夫拉、西藏以及中东的库尔德人地区没能获得独立完全是因为它们的军事力量薄弱。
en: Likewise, the failure of Chechnya, Biafra, Tibet, or the Kurdish areas of the Middle East to reach independent statehood is attributable entirely to their military impotence.

zh: 相反，厄立特里亚、东帝汶、前南斯拉夫的地区能获得独立是因为它们耗尽了占领者或者国内敌对势力的力量。
en: By contrast, Eritrea, East Timor, and parts of the former Yugoslavia achieved independence by exhausting their occupiers and/or their internal rivals.

zh: 在少数的一些例子中，外交确实能阻止战争。
en: There are few cases where diplomacy actually succeeded in preventing war.

zh: 而最伟大的外交成功总是在流血事件之后发生的，而不是在此之前。
en: Almost invariably, the greatest diplomatic successes have followed, rather than preceded, bloodshed.

zh: 1919年，约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯建议一战后欧洲的政治家们摒弃复仇式的爱国主义，通过欧洲一体化来缔造将来的和平环境。
en: In 1919, John Maynard Keynes told the statesmen of post-World War I Europe to abandon their vindictive patriotism for the sake of building a future of peace based on European integration.

zh: 不幸的是，在另一次世界大战之后，欧洲的领导人们才相信凯恩斯的建议的合理性。
en: Alas, it took another world war to convince European leaders of the validity of Keynes’s approach.

zh: 于是欧盟 — — 一个完全通过外交和共识建立的帝国 — — 在废墟中耸现。
en: The European Union – an empire built through diplomacy and consensus – emerged out of the ashes.

zh: 然而，我们不能因此转而相信宿命论。
en: One should, however, resist falling back on fatalism.

zh: 哥伦比亚的新总统胡安·曼努埃尔·桑托斯停止了与委内瑞拉的战争势头，通过恢复地区外交渠道安抚了整个“玻利瓦尔轴心 ” （ 委内瑞拉、厄瓜多尔以及玻利维亚 ） ， 以此表现出了真正的气概。
en: Colombia’s new president, Juan Manuel Santos, showed genuine courage in cutting short a march to war with Venezuela and calming down the entire Bolivarian axis (Venezuela, Ecuador, and Bolivia) by reviving the region’s diplomatic channels.

zh: 他是真正革命性转折人物，把充斥着战争叫嚣的政治转化为实现地区和平的努力奋斗。
en: His was a truly revolutionary shift from the politics of saber-rattling to the hard work of establishing regional peace.

zh: 当然，在倡导和平的民权社会中，公众外交还是能带来许多希望的。
en: To be sure, much hope still lies in popular diplomacy, in civil society mobilizing for peace.

zh: 政府经常需要公众外交的劝诱来接受妥协。
en: Frequently, governments need to be coaxed into accepting the inevitability of compromise, thanks to pressure from below.

zh: 民权社会对弥合北爱尔兰天主教徒和新教教徒心理鸿沟的支持为和平创造了条件。
en: Civil society’s support for bridging the psychological gap between Catholics and Protestants in Northern Ireland helped pave the way to peace.

zh: 而以色列在18年徒劳的军事占领后于2000年3月从黎巴嫩撤军，这在很大程度上反映了“四母亲运动”对以色列政府的巨大影响。
en: And Israel’s withdrawal from Lebanon in May 2000, after 18 years of useless military occupation, largely reflected the immense impact of the “Four Mothers’ Movement” on Israel’s government.

zh: 但是仅靠公众外交从未成功迫使政治领导人结束战争，谋求和平。
en: But popular diplomacy alone never forces political leaders to end wars and make peace.

zh: 战场的战斗结束后，正式的外交于是就开始清理战斗未解决的问题。
en: Official diplomacy begins where the battlefield ends.

zh: 不幸的是，在如今最有破坏性的军事化冲突中，外交与战争的界限令人难以捉摸。
en: Unfortunately, in today’s most consequential militarized conflicts, that boundary is still nowhere in sight.

zh: 暴君和外交官
en: The Despot and the Diplomat

zh: 丹佛 — — 2005年，早在我担任朝鲜核计划六方会谈的美方首席谈判代表时，我拿到了针对当时的首次会晤，也就是由中方主办、朝鲜代表参加的一次宴会所下达的指示。
en: DENVER – Back in 2005, when I was the United States’ lead negotiator at the six-party talks on North Korea’s nuclear program, I looked at the instructions I received for my first meeting, a Chinese-hosted banquet that included a North Korean delegation.

zh: 如果宴会期间有人举杯祝酒（在中国宴会上这种情况非常常见 ） ， 我不能参与。
en: If there was any toasting (not unheard of at Chinese banquets), I was not to join in.

zh: 显然，他们希望我坐在那儿，交叉双臂、怒目而视、不碰酒杯，直到所有人将酒杯放回到桌上为止。
en: Apparently, I was expected to sit there, without touching my glass, glowering with arms folded until everyone else had placed theirs back on the table.

zh: 后来，当我首次访问朝鲜，我接到指示不要对主人露出微笑。
en: Later, when I visited North Korea for the first time, I was instructed not to smile at my hosts.

zh: 显然，他们希望我一直怒目而视。
en: Apparently, I was expected to offer only angry stares.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普显然修改了这些指示。
en: Donald Trump has obviously modified those instructions.

zh: 事实上，随着对金正恩领导能力无休止的赞美、他对金正恩手下一位将军拙劣的即兴敬礼以及他对朝鲜所有事物（尤其是关于海滨房产开发潜力）的认可，特朗普已经撕掉了美国的所有伪装，放弃推动更广泛的价值观。
en: In fact, with his unending praise of Kim Jong-un’s leadership, his clumsy, impromptu salute of one of Kim’s generals, and his endorsement of all things North Korean (especially the potential for beachfront property development), Trump has all but abandoned any pretense that the US promotes a broader set of values.

zh: 但尽管特朗普做得可能有些过火，但认为美国代表应当在敬酒时木然呆坐、不碰酒杯也未能营造出恰当的氛围。
en: But while Trump may have overshot the mark, the idea that the US delegation should sit with glasses untouched during a toast also strikes the wrong tone.

zh: 1995年9月，在波斯尼亚战争最后一个月，由助理国务卿理查德·霍尔布鲁克率领的美国和平谈判代表团抱着与塞尔维亚独裁者斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇举行会谈的目的抵达贝尔格莱德。
en: In September 1995, during the final month of the Bosnian War, the US delegation to peace negotiations, led by Assistant Secretary of State Richard Holbrooke, arrived in Belgrade for talks with Serbia’s dictator, Slobodan Milošević.

zh: 米洛舍维奇称他不能强迫波斯尼亚塞族撤出重武器，并解除对萨拉热窝长达四年的血腥封锁。
en: According to Milošević, he could not compel the Bosnian Serbs to withdraw their heavy weapons and lift the bloody four-year siege of Sarajevo.

zh: 他要求霍尔布鲁克与波斯尼亚塞族领导人卡拉季奇和姆拉迪奇会面，这两位塞族领袖后来都被裁定犯有战争罪。
en: He asked Holbrooke to meet with the Bosnian Serb leaders, Radovan Karadžić and Ratko Mladić, both of whom were later convicted of committing war crimes.

zh: 霍尔布鲁克询问他们在哪里。
en: Holbrooke asked where they were.

zh: “就在那边的别墅 ， ” 米洛舍维奇回答 ， “ 要不要我打电话给他们？
en: “Over there in that villa,” Milošević replied.
“Can I call for them?”

zh: 霍尔布鲁克匆忙召集我们这些代表进行讨论。
en: Holbrooke hastily brought our delegation together for a quick parley.

zh: “我们应当见他们吗？ ”他问我。
en: “Should we meet them?” he asked me.

zh: “如果见他们，我们要不要和他们握手？
en: “And if we do, should I shake their hands?”

zh: ”想想数十万萨拉热窝人 — — 其中许多人遭到谋杀，还有不少人因为持续的围困而濒临饥饿 — — 我回答说 ， “ 握个手，之后早完事早回国。
en: Thinking about the hundreds of thousands of Sarajevans – the many who had been murdered and those facing starvation as a result of the continuing siege – I replied, “Shake their hands and let’s get this over with and go home.”

zh: ”我们同他们握了手。
en: We did.

zh: 对萨拉热窝的围困第二天就得到了解除。
en: The siege of Sarajevo was lifted the next day.

zh: 无论握手是否有所助益，但握拳的谈判几乎不可能成功。
en: Whether shaking a hand helps or not, negotiating while shaking a fist has little record of success.

zh: 副总统迈克·彭斯原定在今年的平昌冬奥会上会见朝鲜代表团。
en: During this year’s Pyeongchang Winter Olympics, Vice President Mike Pence was scheduled to meet with the North Korean delegation.

zh: 也许为了要在国内巩固支持，彭斯在会面前传达了当时非常强硬的谈话要点。
en: Perhaps to cover his back at home, Pence delivered what were then the usual tough-sounding talking points before the meeting.

zh: 朝鲜人立刻取消了会晤，就像在问，如果这样还有什么必要会谈？
en: The North Koreans promptly canceled, as if to ask, What would be the point?

zh: 在参与六方会谈期间，我尽量避免抨击朝鲜。
en: During the period I dealt with the six-party talks, I avoided adding my voice to the anti-North Korean invective.

zh: 我知道很快 — — 往往每隔一周 — — 我就要重新和他们见面，虽然示强或许能在华盛顿对我有所帮助，但它在谈判前线却起不到任何作用，而我的工作是通过谈判说服朝鲜弃核。
en: I knew that soon – often every other week – I would have to meet them again, and while a display of moxie might help me in Washington, it would not help at the tip of the spear, where it was my job to negotiate away the North Koreans’ nuclear ambitions.

zh: 在电视脱口秀上大放厥词和与朝鲜人面对面谈判是完全不同的。
en: There is a big difference between talking tough on television talk shows and sitting across from the North Koreans.

zh: 直接外交是为达到严肃目的而采用的严肃手段。
en: Direct diplomacy is a serious means to a serious end.

zh: 隔得老远摆摆姿态不包括在这当中。
en: Posturing from a distance is not part of it.

zh: 有时很难理解肢体语言。
en: Sometimes body language is hard to get right.

zh: 身为美国驻伊拉克大使，我从华盛顿接到的指示很少考虑到对产生的后果负责任。
en: As US ambassador to Iraq, the instructions I received from Washington rarely came with any commensurate sense of responsibility for the outcome.

zh: 我被告知我的职责包括帮助伊拉克反对派推翻当时的总理努里·马利基。
en: I was told that my job included helping the Iraqi opposition rid themselves of then-Prime Minister Nuri al-Maliki.

zh: 美国官员沉醉于华盛顿会议室中极度狂热的强硬表像，就像高中运动员在大赛前狠敲更衣柜。
en: US officials reveled in their amped-up toughness in Washington meeting rooms, like high school athletes banging on the lockers before a big game.

zh: 但当他们真的上场与马利基会面，他们没有给马利基任何理由相信他们考虑了他的利益。
en: But when they actually came out on the field and met with Maliki, they gave him no reason to believe they wanted anything but the best for him.

zh: 而我会坐在会议室里看马利基盯着我，想知道我为什么之前警告他美国政府会对他的专制统治失去耐心以及由此带来的可怕后果。
en: I would sit in such meetings watching Maliki glance over at me, wondering why I had previously warned him of diminishing US government patience with his autocratic rule and dire consequences.

zh: 此外，华盛顿派来的人表达太过微妙细致，马利基可能需要一台解码装置才能理解他们想表述的真实含义。
en: Meanwhile, the visitors from Washington made points that were so subtle and nuanced that Maliki would have needed a decoding device to comprehend their real meaning.

zh: 任何外交官必须在代表国家进行的谈判中明确目的，也就是说对预期结果和实现结果的最佳方式有着清醒的认识。
en: Any diplomat must be purposeful in a negotiation on behalf of his or her country, which means being clear-eyed about the desired outcome and the best way to achieve it.

zh: 在新加坡，核心问题是朝鲜核武计划。
en: In Singapore, the issue was the North Korean nuclear weapons program.

zh: 其他问题其实都是无关紧要的。
en: Nothing else really mattered.

zh: 时间会证明朝鲜人是否会回馈特朗普所表达的关爱。
en: Time will tell whether the North Koreans reciprocate Trump’s professed affection for them.

zh: 金几乎没有做出任何让步，但也许有史以来首次因为一位美国总统对朝鲜所谓美韩联合军演的忧虑全盘接受而感到目瞪口呆（其实朝鲜人心里清楚美韩军演属于防御性质 ） 。
en: Kim gave away little, and was probably stunned when, for the first time ever, a US president accepted at face value North Korea’s supposed anxiety about US joint military exercises with South Korea (which the North Koreans know to be defensive in purpose).

zh: 这个让步实在太大，无论如何都必须收回。
en: That was too large a concession, and, one way or another, it will have to be taken back.

zh: 从更广义的角度讲，必须设计一套涵盖所有直接相关方的和平及安全框架 — — 包括韩国、日本、俄罗斯和中国。
en: More broadly, a framework for peace and security that includes all the directly affected parties – South Korea, Japan, Russia, and China – will need to be designed.

zh: 同样，朝鲜几乎世界最糟的人权纪录必须在未来某个时间被提及 — — 也许就像我在六方会谈中所表述的那样，要纳入最终的美朝外交关系。
en: Similarly, North Korea’s human rights record, one of the world’s worst, will have to be taken up in the future – perhaps, as I signaled during the six-party talks, as a component of eventual diplomatic relations.

zh: 但目前，朝鲜核计划必须处在谈判议程的首要位置。
en: But, for now, the North Korean nuclear program must be at the top of any negotiating agenda.

zh: 特朗普的对朝方法能否成功将取决于新加坡峰会之后的外交努力。
en: Whether Trump’s approach actually works with North Korea will depend on the diplomacy that follows the Singapore summit.

zh: 国务卿麦克·蓬佩奥，这项任务已经交到你的手里。
en: Over to you, Secretary of State Mike Pompeo.

zh: 中东裁军
en: Disarming the Middle East

zh: 特拉维夫－以色列拼命呼吁国际社会行动起来，以遏制其情报机构描述的伊朗“核弹大跃进”的请求，没有得到它期望的正面反应。
en: TEL AVIV – Israel’s desperate plea that the world act to curtail what its intelligence service describes as Iran’s “gallop toward a nuclear bomb” has not gotten the positive response that Israel expected.

zh: 随着联合国的制裁机制现在已经被证明完全无效，以及国际外交在阻止伊朗掌握铀浓缩技术上的显然不起作用，以色列被逼进了一个角落里。
en: With the United Nations sanctions regime now having proven to be utterly ineffective, and with international diplomacy apparently futile in preventing the Iranians from mastering the technology for enriching uranium, Israel is being boxed into a corner.

zh: 应该是一个重大的国际调停努力事件，现在正在沦为一场预示灾难的以色列－伊朗大摊牌。
en: What was supposed to be a major international effort at mediation is deteriorating into an apocalyptic Israeli-Iranian showdown.

zh: 这是一个令人感兴趣的异常现象，这是因为，尽管有伊朗总统默罕默德·艾哈迈德内贾德无耻的反犹言论，伊朗显现的军事实力的意义远远超过了以色列这个犹太国家的范围。
en: This is an intriguing anomaly, for, notwithstanding Iranian President Mahmoud Ahmadinejad’s vile anti-Semitic rhetoric, the implications of Iran’s emerging power extend far beyond the Jewish state.

zh: 事实上，它影响了整个阿拉伯世界 — — 特别是脆弱的海湾国家，甚至影响到了阿富汗和巴基斯坦。
en: Indeed, it affects the entire Arab world, particularly the vulnerable Gulf countries, and even Afghanistan and Pakistan.

zh: 对于欧洲和作为在中东有重要影响力的美国来说 ，阻止现在威胁中东的核扩散趋势，也符合它们的利益，因为一个拥有核武器的伊朗会为该地区不受控制的核武器竞赛打开大门。
en: The United States, as a major Middle East power, and Europe also have an interest in stemming the tide of nuclear proliferation that now threatens the Middle East. For a nuclear Iran would open the gates to an uncontrolled rush for the bomb across the region.

zh: 国际制度没能有效地解决中东核问题的主要原因是俄罗斯－美国的分歧，而刚愎自用的美国策略是造成这一分歧的主要原因。
en: The international system’s failure to address effectively the nuclear issue in the Middle East stems mostly from the Russia-US divide, to which wrongheaded American strategy has contributed mightily.

zh: 俄罗斯不可能希望伊朗拥有核武器。
en: Russia cannot want a nuclear Iran.

zh: 但是，在俄罗斯探求对抗其认为充满敌意的美国政策的手段，以及与西方讨价还价更有利的安全框架的途径的时候，它拒绝加入由美国领导的遏制伊朗核野心的国际行动。
en: But in its quest for leverage against what it perceives as hostile American policies, and as way to bargain for a more acceptable security framework with the West, the Russians refuse to join America’s leadership in international efforts to curtail Iran’s nuclear ambitions.

zh: 俄罗斯不仅是对伊朗的外交孤立政策奏效的关键，而且 — — 通过其已经对伊朗作出的出售武器的保证 — — 也是伊朗政府保护其核设施能力的关键。
en: Russia holds the key not only to Iran’s diplomatic isolation, but also – through the weapons transfers that it has already pledged to Iran – to the Iranian government’s capacity to protect its nuclear installations.

zh: 在2007年10月，弗拉基米尔·普京成为自勃列日涅夫后访问伊朗的第一位俄罗斯领导人，并使五位里海沿岸国家领导人会晤。
en: In October 2007, Vladimir Putin became the first Russian leader since Leonid Brezhnev to visit Iran, bringing along five leaders of the Caspian Sea states.

zh: 从那以后，普京已经开始暴露美国孤立伊朗政策的破产。
en: Since then, Putin has sought to expose the bankruptcy of America’s policy of isolating Iran.

zh: 俄罗斯可能能遏制伊朗政权，但是，它只有在换得美国对其在前苏联加盟共和国的利益的尊重，以及在可能的情况下对冷战后的战略协定进行修改的情况下，才会这样做。
en: Russia probably can tame the Iranian regime, but it will do so only in exchange for America’s respect for its interests in the former Soviet Republics, and possibly also a revision of post-Cold War strategic agreements.

zh: 但是，即使伊朗被俄罗斯抛弃，它也不大可能放弃其核野心，除非其区域安全担忧得到解决。
en: But, even if abandoned by the Russians, it is highly unlikely that Iran will give up its nuclear ambitions unless its regional concerns are addressed.

zh: 伊朗追求拥有核武器的动力反映了一个广泛的国民共识，该共识是根深蒂固的易于受到攻击和遭到背叛的结果。
en: Iran’s nuclear drive reflects a broad national consensus, the result of a deep-seated sense of vulnerability and betrayal.

zh: 伊朗人记得，当萨达姆·侯赛因在20世纪80年代使用化学武器袭击伊朗的时候，国际社会是怎样的冷漠。
en: The Iranians remember how the international community remained indifferent when Saddam Hussein attacked with chemical weapons in the 1980’s.

zh: 而且，美国现在在伊拉克可怕的权力存在也让他们感到不舒服。
en: Nor is the presence of America’s formidable might in today’s Iraq comforting to them.

zh: 伊朗认为它是国际双重标准的受害者 — — 国际社会接受了巴基斯坦和印度的核地位，更不要提以色列了 — — 而这只会增强其受到歧视的感觉以及继续其野心的决心。
en: Iran believes that it is the victim of an international double standard – acceptance of Pakistan’s and India’s nuclear status, not to mention Israel’s – which only fuels its sense of discrimination and its resolve to pursue its ambitions.

zh: 通过暴露《不扩散核武器条约》的不足，作为该条约签字国的伊朗已经向以色列发出这样的信号：区域秩序再也不能建立在作为非《不扩散核武器条约》缔约国的以色列的核垄断的基础上了。
en: By exposing the inadequacy of the Nuclear Non-Proliferation Treaty, Iran, a signatory, has signaled to Israel that the regional order can no longer be based on Israel’s nuclear monopoly as a non-NPT member.

zh: 因此，核问题的解决方法不仅在于迫使像伊朗和叙利亚这样的《不扩散核武器条约》的缔约国遵守它们的承诺，而且在于在中东建立一个更广泛的区域安全和合作体制。
en: Hence, the solution lies not only in forcing NPT members like Iran and Syria to comply with their commitments, but in creating a broader regional security and cooperation architecture in the Middle East.

zh: 但是，只要以色列拒绝讨论其自身的核能力问题，阿拉伯人不大可能同意这样的体制。
en: But it is highly unlikely that the Arabs will agree to such a system so long as Israel refuses to address her own nuclear capabilities.

zh: 任何区域安全体制都将不得不以中东成为一个没有大规模毁灭性武器 — — 包括核武器，化学和生物武器 — — 的区域为前提。
en: Any regional security architecture will have to be premised on the Middle East becoming a zone free of all weapons of mass destruction, including nuclear, chemical, and biological weapons.

zh: 中东取得了自二战结束后，世界上唯一一个使用过这样的武器的区域的臭名昭著名声。
en: The Middle East retains the infamous distinction of being the only region in the world to have used such weapons since the end of World War II.

zh: 确实，阿拉伯国家都既开发又使用过化学和生物武器 — — 到目前为止还不是用它们来攻击以色列，而是攻击该地区的其他人。
en: Indeed, Arab states have both developed and used chemical and biological weapons – not against Israel, so far, but against others in the region.

zh: 伊拉克使用这类武器来攻击伊朗，埃及在20世纪70年代的也门战争中使用过它们，伊拉克用它们来攻击其本国的库尔德人。
en: Iraq used them against Iran, Egypt in its war in Yemen of the 1970’s, and Iraq against its own Kurds.

zh: 在1993年，以色列签署了禁止化学武器的国际条约���但是没有批准这个条约，因为只要以色列保持其核优势，阿拉伯国家就拒绝批准该条约。
en: In 1993, Israel signed the international treaty banning chemical weapons, but did not ratify it because of the Arab states’ refusal to follow suit as long as Israel maintained its nuclear advantage.

zh: 国际社会必须认识到中东安全等式不是一个简单的包含以色列对阿拉伯世界的线性等式。
en: The international community must recognize that the Middle East security equation is not a simple linear one involving Israel versus the Arab world.

zh: 在一个以前已经认为使用大规模毁灭性武器恰当的区域，核武器的扩散会对每一个人造成威胁。
en: The proliferation of nuclear weapons in a region that has seen fit to use weapons of mass destruction before threatens everyone.

zh: 所以，核问题的解决，需要诸如美国和俄罗斯这样的外部强国在该地区不要成为对方政策的破坏者，而要共同努力建立一个没有大规模毁灭性武器的地区。
en: So a concerted effort is needed by outside powers such as the US and Russia, not to act as spoilers of each other’s policies in the region, but to create a WMD-free zone.

zh: 这样的区域体制不能建立在政治真空上。
en: Such a regional system cannot be built in a political vacuum.

zh: 帮助该地区主要政治争端找到解决办法的重大努力，是一个至关重要的先决条件。
en: A major effort to assist in the solution of the region’s major political disputes is a vital prerequisite.

zh: 解决核武器问题的时间很紧迫。
en: The nuclear clock is ticking.

zh: 解决假消息难题
en: Solving the Disinformation Puzzle

zh: 加利福尼亚州门洛帕克 — — 自从2016年11月举行的美国总统大选凸显出数字渠道面对假消息是多么脆弱无助以来，关于如何打击“假消息”的辩论就从未停止过。
en: MENLO PARK, CALIFORNIA – Ever since the November 2016 US presidential election highlighted the vulnerability of digital channels to purveyors of “fake news,” the debate over how to counter disinformation has not gone away.

zh: 自从脸书、谷歌和推特高管出席国会听证会就俄罗斯消息来源如何利用其平台来影响选举结果回答质疑以来，我们已经在短短八个月内取得了很大的成果。
en: We have come a long way in the eight months since Facebook, Google, and Twitter executives appeared before Congress to answer questions about how Russian sources exploited their platforms to influence the election.

zh: 不过假如说在搜寻解决之道的漫长过程中有一个问题已经明确，那就是能解决一切问题的良方是根本不存在的。
en: But if there is one thing that the search for solutions has made clear, it is that there is no silver bullet.

zh: 我们需要的不是用一招解决所有问题，而是从不同角度解决问题的循序渐进的方法。
en: Instead of one comprehensive fix, what is needed are steps that address the problem from multiple angles.

zh: 现代信息生态系统就像一个魔方，要想把每个方块移动“到位”需要采取循序渐进的步骤。
en: The modern information ecosystem is like a Rubik’s Cube, where a different move is required to “solve” each individual square.

zh: 在涉及数字虚假消息时，至少需要思考四个维度的因素。
en: When it comes to digital disinformation, at least four dimensions must be considered.

zh: 首先，谁在分享虚假信息？
en: First, who is sharing the disinformation?

zh: 从法律和惯用模式的层面，尤其是在对言论自由保护无与伦比和制裁国外干预相对严格的美国，比起由本国民众参与宣传的虚假消息，对待由外国主体参与传播的假消息的处理方式可能会截然不同。
en: Disinformation spread by foreign actors can be treated very differently – both legally and normatively – than disinformation spread by citizens, particularly in the United States, with its unparalleled free-speech protections and relatively strict rules on foreign interference.

zh: 在美国，可以通过混合运用自然语言处理和地理定位技术来辨别境外信息传播主体，从而阻止不那么复杂的国外干预活动。
en: In the US, less sophisticated cases of foreign intervention might be addressed with a mix of natural-language processing and geo-locating techniques to identify actors working from outside the country.

zh: 如果平台层面干预失败，还可以采用涉及面更广的政府干预措施来进行补救，例如采用一般性制裁举措。
en: Where platform-level changes fail, broader government interventions, such as general sanctions, could be employed.

zh: 其次，为什么虚假信息会得到分享？
en: Second, why is the disinformation being shared?

zh: “错误信息 ” — —也就是无意间传播的不准确信息 — — 与有意传播的虚假信息或宣传攻势完全不同。
en: “Misinformation” – inaccurate information that is spread unintentionally – is quite different from disinformation or propaganda, which are spread deliberately.

zh: 我们至少可以部分通过新闻扫盲或事实核查活动，防止并无恶意的行为主体在无意间对虚假消息进行分享。
en: Preventing well-intentioned actors from unwittingly sharing false information could be addressed, at least partly, through news literacy campaigns or fact-checking initiatives.

zh: 阻止恶意行为主体故意分享上述信息相对较为复杂，并与他们想要达到的具体目标是息息相关的。
en: Stopping bad actors from purposely sharing such information is more complicated, and depends on their specific goals.

zh: 例如，对那些受利润驱动的人 — — 比如现在通过运营“虚假新闻”网站赚取成千上万美元的臭名昭著的马其顿少年 — — 破坏其收入模式的全新广告政策可能会有所帮助。
en: For example, for those who are motivated by profit – like the now-infamous Macedonian teens who earned thousands of dollars running “fake news” sites – new ad policies that disrupt revenue models may help.

zh: 但出于政治或社会原因分享虚假消息的人却不会受到上述政策的影响。
en: But such policies would not stop those who share disinformation for political or social reasons.

zh: 如果那些行为主体通过有组织网络来进行运作，那么干预措施可能需要破坏整个网络才能最终生效。
en: If those actors are operating as part of organized networks, interventions may need to disrupt the entire network to be effective.

zh: 第三，虚假消息通过何种渠道来进行分享？
en: Third, how is the disinformation being shared?

zh: 如果行为主体仅通过社交媒体来分享内容，那么修改平台政策和/或政府法规或许就可以应付。
en: If actors are sharing content via social media, changes to platforms’ policies and/or government regulation could be sufficient.

zh: 但这些变化必须是具体的。
en: But such changes must be specific.

zh: 例如，为防止利用机器人人为放大内容影响，平台可以要求用户披露其真实身份（尽管这种做法在专制体制内部可能出现问题，因为在那里匿名对民主倡导者是一种保护 ） 。
en: For example, to stop bots from being used to amplify content artificially, platforms may require that users disclose their real identities (though this would be problematic in authoritarian regimes where anonymity protects democracy advocates).

zh: 为对精密的微校准行为进行限制 — — 即利用消费和人口统计数据来预测个人的兴趣和行为，以便对其想法和行动产生影响 — — 平台也许必须修改他们的数据分享和隐私政策，并落实新的广告规则。
en: To limit sophisticated microtargeting – the use of consumer data and demographics to predict individuals’ interests and behaviors, in order to influence their thoughts or actions – platforms may have to change their data-sharing and privacy policies, as well as implement new advertising rules.

zh: 举例来讲，平台应当 — — 而且现在在某些情况下也的确在这么做 — — 披露政治广告的目标人群、禁止某些定位标准或者限制目标小组的最小规模 — — 而不是赋予广告用户机会让他们仅花30美元就能一次性接触2，300名可能的“犹太仇恨者 ” 。
en: For example rather than giving advertisers the opportunity to access 2,300 likely “Jew Haters” for just $30, platforms should – and, in some cases, now do – disclose the targets of political ads, prohibit certain targeting criteria, or limit how small a target group may be.

zh: 这是一场军备竞赛。
en: This is a kind of arms race.

zh: 无良主体会迅速规避数字平台实施的任何变化。
en: Bad actors will quickly circumvent any changes that digital platforms implement.

zh: 新技术 — — 如利用区块链来协助验证原始照片 — — 将持续得到应用。
en: New techniques – such as using blockchain to help authenticate original photographs – will continually be required.

zh: 但毫无疑问，与政府监管机构相比数字平台能更灵活地定期调整政策。
en: But there is little doubt that digital platforms are better equipped to adapt their policies regularly than government regulators are.

zh: 但数字平台无法仅凭一己之力管理虚假信息，尤其因为某些估算方法显示，社交媒体仅占最臭名昭著的“假新闻”网站流量的约40%左右。 因为其他百分之60%来自“有组织”或“暗交际 ” （ 如朋友间的消息和电子邮件）渠道，要想对这些途径进行管理恐怕要困难得多。
en: Yet digital platforms cannot manage disinformation alone, not least because, by some estimates, social media account for only around 40% of traffic to the most egregious “fake news” sites, with the other 60% arriving “organically” or via “dark social” (such as messaging or emails between friends).

zh: 虚假信息谜题最后 — — 或许也是最重要的 — — 维度是分享哪些内容。
en: The final – and perhaps the most important – dimension of the disinformation puzzle is: what is being shared?

zh: 专家往往关注那些彻头彻尾的“假”消息，这些消息识别起来往往没什么难度。
en: Experts tend to focus on entirely “fake” content, which is easier to identify.

zh: 但哪怕仅仅因为人们一般不愿因为分享彻头彻尾的假消息而让自己显得愚蠢，数字平台自然而然有动机来限制这些内容的传播。
en: But digital platforms naturally have incentives to curb such content, simply because people generally do not want to look foolish by sharing altogether false stories.

zh: 但人们一般喜欢阅读和分享与自己相近的观点；如果它能引发强烈的情绪 — — 尤其是愤怒，那当然就更加理想。
en: People do, however, like to read and share information that aligns with their perspectives; they like it even more if it triggers strong emotions – especially outrage.

zh: 因为用户非常喜欢这类内容，所以平台有强烈的动机来展示它。
en: Because users engage heavily with this type of content, digital platforms have an incentive to showcase it.

zh: 这样的内容不仅仅会带来两极分化；它往往具有误导性和煽动性，同时有迹象表明它能破坏建设性的民主对话。
en: Such content is not just polarizing; it is often misleading and incendiary, and there are signs that it can undermine constructive democratic discourse.

zh: 但基于扭曲认知的危险分歧和由不同世界观驱动的激烈政治辩论的分界线究竟在何处？
en: But where is the line between dangerous disagreement based on distortion and vigorous political debate driven by conflicting worldviews?

zh: 如果说有人有这个权利，那么该由谁来划定它？
en: And who, if anybody, should draw it?

zh: 即使上述道德问题得以解决，大规模识别问题内容仍面临着严峻的现实挑战。
en: Even if these ethical questions were answered, identifying problematic content at scale confronts serious practical challenges.

zh: 许多最令人担忧的虚假信息案例并未关注任何特定的选举或候选人，而把利用社会分歧当成自己的目标。
en: Many of the most worrisome examples of disinformation have been focused not on any particular election or candidate, but instead on exploiting societal divisions along, say, racial lines.

zh: 而且它们往往都是免费的。
en: And they often are not purchased.

zh: 因此就像脸书和推特均予认可的诚实广告法一样，制定新的竞选广告监管规则也许无法将问题解决掉。
en: As a result, they would not be addressed by new rules to regulate campaign advertising, such as the Honest Ads Act that has been endorsed by both Facebook and Twitter.

zh: 如果虚假信息的解决之道在美国尚不明确，那么放在国际背景下就更加棘手，因为在多国背景下问题更加分散和不透明 — — 这也从另一个角度解释了为什么制定综合全面的解决方案是不可能的。
en: If the solutions to disinformation are unclear in the US, the situation is even thornier in the international context, where the problem is even more decentralized and opaque – another reason why no overarching, comprehensive solution is possible.

zh: 但虽然每项举措仅能解决少部分问题 — — 修改广告政策可能解决5 % ， 而修改微观定位政策可能解决20 % — —但加起来却可以取得显著的进步。
en: But, while each measure addresses only a narrow issue – improved ad policies may solve 5% of the problem, while different micro-targeting policies may solve 20% – taken together, progress can be made.

zh: 最终结果将实现这样一种信息环境，尽管它并不完美，但却仅包括相对少量的问题内容 — — 这在重视言论自由的民主社会是不可避免的。
en: The end result will be an information environment that, while imperfect, includes only a relatively small amount of problematic content – unavoidable in democratic societies that value free speech.

zh: 好消息是专家现在可以从脸书获取受隐私权保护的数据，以协助他们了解（并改善）平台对世界各地选举和民主的影响。
en: The good news is that experts will now have access to privacy-protected data from Facebook to help them understand (and improve) the platform’s impact on elections – and democracies – around the world.

zh: 人们希望谷歌、推特、Reddit和Tumblr等数字平台能够效法脸书。
en: One hopes that other digital platforms – such as Google, Twitter, Reddit, and Tumblr – will follow suit.

zh: 如果认识正确，同时致力于根本性、哪怕是渐进的变化，数字平台的社会和政治影响力可以创造 — — 或至少是改善当今陷入困境的民主体制的安全环境。
en: With the right insights, and a commitment to fundamental, if incremental, change, the social and political impact of digital platforms can be made safe – or at least safer – for today’s beleaguered democracies.

zh: 驱散恐怖阴云
en: Dispersing the Terrorist Storm

zh: 发自华沙 — — 当时是华沙时间2001年9月11日下午3点，我正在跟波兰驻纽约总领事通电话。
en: WARSAW – On September 11, 2001 at three p.m., Warsaw time, I was talking on the telephone with Poland’s Consul General in New York.

zh: 她告诉我说纽约世界贸易中心遭到了两架飞机的撞击。
en: She informed me that two planes had hit the World Trade Center.

zh: 在那一刻，我意识到这可不仅仅是一场普通的空难。
en: That moment, I realized, was more than just a plane crash.

zh: 美国，世界，乃至我们所有人的生活，都被彻底地改变了。
en: The United States, the world, indeed our very lives, were about to change fundamentally.

zh: 回顾十年前，很显然当年发动袭击的伊斯兰狂热分子在两大重要方面打错了算盘：首先他们以为西方民主国家非常软弱 — — 因此不愿也无法追究其极端主义暴行。
en: Ten years later, it is clear that the fanatics behind those attacks miscalculated in two central respects. They regarded Western democracies as weak – unwilling or unable to respond to their evil extremism.

zh: 他们梦想全世界穆斯林社区及国家会在袭击后实现总动员，在千年轮回之后重建一个安拉的国度。
en: And they expected Muslim communities and countries around the world to rise up and mobilize behind their millenarian worldview.

zh: 但民主世界对此却毫不犹豫，迅速对各类大小恐怖行为作出了一连串反应。
en: But, far from being uncertain or indecisive, the democratic world responded with unrelenting determination to terrorist outrages of all shapes and sizes.

zh: 欧美各地纷纷建立了相关机制以共享潜在恐怖袭击信息，并采取迅速（有时甚至有点粗暴）的行动来防止或是扑灭这些威胁，同时还尽可能地与印度、俄罗斯、巴基斯坦，海湾国家以及其他重要国际伙伴展开密切合作。
en: Across Europe and in America, new arrangements have been set up to pool information about possible terrorist attacks and take the speedy (and sometimes robust) action needed to prevent or disrupt them. Where possible, we work closely with India, Russia, Pakistan, the Gulf states, and other key international partners.

zh: 而欧盟为此建立的一系列机构和政策则生动体现出当代跨国整合政策所带来的实际益处。
en: The institutions and policies established by the European Union are a vivid example of the unobtrusive benefits of modern cross-border integration.

zh: 欧盟各国对高敏感度情报以及治安信息的交流程度堪称前所未有，并因此在确保高度法制和民主的同时提升了公共安全。
en: EU member states share highly sensitive intelligence and police information as never before, thereby increasing public security while upholding world-class legal and democratic standards.

zh: 这些行动方案也都经过了细心调整，既尊重社会的多样性，又减少了狭隘偏激思想的政治空间。
en: These operational measures have been complemented by carefully calibrated policies that aim to acknowledge social diversity but reduce the political space available for intolerance and bigotry.

zh: 但成功无法一蹴而就。
en: Success does not come easy.

zh: 虽然大部分基地组织领导人都已丧命，但我们的民主体制无疑也经历了关于手段与结果孰轻孰重，个人自由与国家权威之间如何平衡的激辩。
en: Most of Al Qaeda’s leaders are dead, but our democracies rightly experience impassioned debates about means and ends, and about the balance between individual freedom and state authority.

zh: 在当前的全球经济困境下公众对移民和就业的关注难免过于急迫，以致失业民粹主义及其相关矛盾所引发的风险都会上升。
