en: In the current difficult global economic climate, public concerns about immigration and access to jobs inevitably grow more acute, increasing the risk that rival forms of lumpen populism and associated tensions will emerge.

zh: 最重要的是，西方对其境内极端主义的有效压制迫使那些潜在的恐怖分子 — — 大多数躲在全球偏远地区，希望因此逍遥法外 — — 使用更高级别的技术（来逃脱搜捕 ） 。
en: Above all, the West’s effective crackdown on domestic extremism has tended to drive would-be terrorists – now often based in remote parts of the world, where they hope to operate with impunity – to higher levels of technical sophistication.

zh: 但这又催生了痛苦的政策困境，使得最亲密的反恐盟友都会心生嫌隙。
en: As a result, painful policy dilemmas arise, and they can divide even the closest allies.

zh: 试问如果某些国家无法/不愿采取必要措施阻止其境内的恐怖行动策划，应该如何应对？
en: How best to respond if some states cannot or will not take the necessary steps to thwart terrorist planning on their territory?

zh: 如果某些国家可能采取刑讯逼供，又该如何处理因此取得的恐怖行动情报？
en: How to deal with evidence of terrorist planning gleaned from states suspected of practicing torture?

zh: 恐怖主义的极端无政府主义狂热正不断绷紧和考验着我们自身的信念。
en: The sheer nihilistic irrationality of terrorism strains and tests our own beliefs like nothing else can.

zh: 但过去十年在纽约，伦敦和马德里发生的恐怖袭击并未动摇西方民主制度。
en: Yet the terrorist blows inflicted on New York, London, and Madrid over the past decade have not shaken Western democracies.

zh: 而我们的社会也比以前变得更加坚韧，开放和多样化。
en: Our societies are more resilient, open, and diverse than ever.

zh: 没错，我们可能不一定会获得最后的胜利。
en: That said, we are not doomed to succeed.

zh: 因为即便满怀善意的社会政策都可能带来意料之外的后果。
en: Even well-intentioned social policies can have unwelcome consequences.

zh: 但无论如何，我们都要感谢警方和情报部门，正是他们的默默不懈努力保证了公众的安全。
en: Above all, we should be grateful to the police forces and intelligence agencies whose unflagging hard work and dedication far away from the public eye help keep us safe.

zh: 而9·11恐怖分子的第二个错误则是自以为能激发反西方伊斯兰极端主义的汹涌浪潮。
en: The 9/11 terrorists’ second blunder was to believe that their terrorist attacks would inspire irresistible surge in anti-Western Islamist extremism.

zh: 当然在世界的某些地方这种极端化过程也确实发生了。
en: In some parts of the world, radicalization of this sort did take place.

zh: 然而9·11事件后大多数伊斯兰恐怖极端主义的受害者 — — 往往遭到自杀式的卑劣袭击 — — 都是伊拉克，巴基斯坦或者其他国家的穆斯林。
en: Yet, since 9/11, most victims of Islamist-inspired terrorist extremism – often in the vile form of suicide attacks – have been Muslims, in Iraq, Pakistan, and elsewhere. Terrorist groups have to resort to organized crime to fund themselves.

zh: 简而言之，基地组织及其同党的暴力狂热非但未能带领起一场全球伊斯兰革命，却成为了一个令人厌恶（却可以被制服）的意识形态毒药。
en: In short, far from leading some sort of worldwide Islamist revolution, the violent fanaticism of Al Qaeda and other organizations now resembles a repulsive, but manageable, form of ideological toxic waste.

zh: 更何况今年的焦点也无法逆转地从他们身上转向了别处：北非和中东的数百万民众开始争取一个具备基本民主权利和法治的正常社会。
en: And the focus this year has shifted decisively away from it. Millions of people in North Africa and the Middle East have started to demand a normal society with basic democratic rights and, above all, the rule of law.

zh: 他们也欢迎美国，欧洲以及全球慎重而又无损当地人尊严的援助。
en: They welcome measured and respectful US, European, and wider support.

zh: 面对这些意想不到的挑战，某些穷途末路的统治者 — — 比如叙利亚总统阿萨德 — — 用镇压甚至恐怖主义的手段来镇压开明的人民。
en: Faced with this unexpected challenge, some desperate rulers, above all now in Syria, have been using repressive, even terrorist methods against their open people.

zh: 而欧洲对阿萨德政权的压力也正不断加大。
en: European pressure on President Bashar al-Assad’s regime is intensifying.

zh: 在利比亚，卡扎菲骇人听闻的暴政已经崩溃；欧盟也非常乐意帮助利比亚人民建立一个多党制民主国家。
en: In Libya, Col. Muammar el-Qaddafi’s appalling tyranny has collapsed; the EU will be generous in helping the Libyan people start to build a modern pluralist society.

zh: 波兰关于创设一个欧洲民主基金的倡议将能在该国扮演核心角色，同时也有助于完成欧洲自身内部的民主化进程，比如在白俄罗斯或是正处于民主倒退过程中的乌克兰。
en: Poland’s initiative to create a European Endowment for Democracy could play a leading role here, and with Europe’s own unfinished business of democratization in Belarus and elsewhere, like backsliding Ukraine.

zh: 有一些人决定要实施恐怖活动，其中只有极少数人能真正实施，而最后只有一小撮人能成功。
en: Few people decide to commit terrorist outrages. Of those who do, a minute fraction actually tries to carry them out, and only a tiny number of those succeed.

zh: 但9·11带给我们最重要的教训莫过于在任何自由社会中都会有一些人会滥用自己的自由并造成极大破坏，尤其是在这些行为背后的动机都自相矛盾之时。
en: But the main lesson of 9/11 is that in any free society a tiny number of people can exploit their freedom and do vast damage, especially when the underlying motivation is incoherent.

zh: 这一方面体现在今年7月挪威的大屠杀事件上，同时也在维基解密组织未经编辑而泄露大批外交电文的可耻行为中暴露无遗。
en: This is exemplified in very different ways by the murderous killing spree in Norway in July, and now by WikiLeaks’ disgraceful release of huge numbers of unredacted diplomatic cables.

zh: 9·11事件至今已历十年，恐怖主义威胁或许也因此变得更加多样化和不可预测。
en: The terrorism threat ten years from now probably will be even more diverse and unpredictable.

zh: 在欧洲大量本地化的“单一议题”极端组织需要密切监控。
en: In Europe various homegrown “single issue” extremist groups need close monitoring.

zh: 在每一个案例中，我们都能看到那些偏执者赋予自身决定他人命运的权力，并使用现代科技来为自己的邪恶目的服务。
en: In each case, we see obsessive people arrogating to themselves the right to decide others’ fate, and using modern technology for their harmful purposes.

zh: 从本质上看，这种形式分散却焦点高度集中的威胁几乎无法被事先辨认和破除。
en: By its very nature, this sort of disaggregated but highly focused threat is almost impossible to identify and intercept in advance.

zh: 很显然民主世界不可能用防弹钢板把自己包裹起来，但只要随时保持警惕并尽力维护作为自身社会基础的价值观，我们就能尽量缩小这些风险。
en: Of course, the democratic world cannot build a bomb-proof house. But we can minimize risk by remaining vigilant and upholding at all times the values on which our societies are based.

zh: 打断气候变化
en: Disrupting Climate Change

zh: 丹佛—在美国经历了创纪录的飓风季，亚洲经历了泛滥的洪水季之后，我们很容易对气候变化的不断加速感到绝望。
en: DENVER – After a season of record-breaking hurricanes in the United States and floods across Asia, it would be easy to despair about the accelerating pace of climate change.

zh: 然而，尽管末日预兆频现，我们仍然能够实现规模足够大、速度足够快的能源转型，从而遏制全球气温的升高。
en: Yet, despite the apocalyptic omens, an energy transformation big enough and fast enough to curb the spike in global temperature remains within reach.

zh: 更妙的是，我们不需要坐等新发明的出现来落实我们所需要的变化；转型可以立刻开始，由企业提供受市场推动的有利可图的方案。
en: Better still, we do not need to wait for new inventions to implement the changes we need; the transformation can happen right now, with profitable solutions delivered by businesses and driven by markets.

zh: 将全球升温幅度限制在前工业水平以上2℃以内，这是2015年巴黎气候协定所制定的目标。 实现这一目标需要减少化石燃料依赖，改变农作物种植、木材采伐和土地使用的方式。
en: Limiting the increase in global temperature to within 2º Celsius of preindustrial levels – the target set by the 2015 Paris climate agreement – will require decreasing reliance on fossil fuels, and changing how the world grows crops, harvests timber, and uses land.

zh: 落基山研究所（RMI）的新研究表明，这两个结果都是可行的，它们所形成的合力可以“积极地”打断气候变化的进程。
en: New research by the Rocky Mountain Institute (RMI) shows that both outcomes are possible, and that, together, the impact can “positively” disrupt the trajectory of climate change.

zh: 根据我们的研究，如果未来的能源供给和需求，以及森林和土地储存碳元素的方式，能够遵循一定的方法，就能大大降低变暖的速度。
en: According to our analysis, there are pathways for the future supply and demand of energy, and for how forests and land store carbon, that, if followed, will dramatically slow the pace of warming.

zh: 通过加快已经开始的清洁能源转型，有望将温室气体排放量降低到当前消费模式所隐含的水平之下。
en: By accelerating the clean-energy transition that is underway, it is possible to reduce greenhouse-gas emissions below what would be expected under current consumption patterns.

zh: 这一情景并不像有些人想象的那样遥远。
en: This scenario is not as far-fetched as some might believe.

zh: 世界已经开始了朝向清洁能源、电力驱动和更加智能的电力和土地使用系统的转变，其速度之快超出了任何人 — — 包括专家在内 — — 的预测。
en: The world is already switching to cleaner energy, to electric mobility, and to smarter power and land-use systems faster than anyone, including experts, anticipated.

zh: 而这不是第一次发生变化速度超过预期的情况。
en: And it’s not the first time the pace of change has exceeded expectations.

zh: 比如，1980年，美国电话电报公司聘请麦肯锡公司对二十年内美国移动电话使用数量进行预测。
en: In 1980, for example, AT&T hired McKinsey & Company to forecast the number of mobile phones that would be in use in the US within two decades.

zh: 麦肯锡的顾问预测，到2000年，美国移动电话市场规模将达到900,000台左右。
en: The consultants predicted that by 2000, the US mobile phone market would support about 900,000 devices.

zh: 事实上，2000年有超过一亿台移动电话被售出。
en: In fact, over 100 million phones were sold that year.

zh: 如今，地球上的移动电话数量比其人口还要多。
en: Today, the planet has more phones than people.

zh: 太阳能和风能也经历过类似的错误预测。
en: Solar and wind energy have suffered similarly flawed projections.

zh: 几十年来，国际原子能机构和美国能源情报署（US Energy Information Agency）的专家们无不低估了来自这些资源的供给会以多快速度增长。
en: For decades, experts at the International Energy Agency and the US Energy Information Agency underestimated how quickly supplies from these sources would grow.

zh: 他们的猜测总是低估，并且每年只是略微向上调整预测，从来没能跟上现实进度。
en: They consistently guessed low, increasing their forecasts only slightly every year, without ever catching up to reality.

zh: 但随着清洁能源企业不断创新，利用风能和太阳能的生产成本不断下降。
en: But as clean-energy businesses innovated, the cost of production from wind and solar declined.

zh: 能源变得更加廉价，用途则随之增加。
en: Energy became cheaper, and usage increased as a result.

zh: 政府模型通常无法抓住类似的回报递增现象。
en: Government models typically do not account for such expanding returns.

zh: 低估当今能源转型的另一个原因是其规模与此前几次新技术转换有所不同。
en: Another reason for underestimating the speed of today’s energy transition is that the scale is different from previous conversions to new technologies.

zh: 人们从烧木材到烧煤，再从烧煤到烧石油 ， “ 新”能源资源都来自规模非常巨大的资本项目，如煤矿、离岸油气田、炼油厂等。
en: When people switched from burning wood to burning coal, and then to burning oil, the “new” energy sources came from very large capital projects, like coalmines, offshore oil and gas fields, and refineries.

zh: 部署这些项目成本高昂，并且要转嫁到消费者头上。
en: The high costs of deploying these projects were then passed on to consumers.

zh: 相反，在今天的能源市场中，消费者拥有更大的控制权。
en: By contrast, in today’s energy market, consumers have more control.

zh: 想想看，在屋顶安装太阳能板是多么方便，只需要一天就能完成。
en: Consider how easy it is to install rooftop solar panels; it can be done in a single day.

zh: 数百万小机器 — — 光伏电池、风力涡轮、电池和智能电器 — — 推动着今天的能源转型。
en: Millions of small machines – photovoltaic cells, wind turbines, batteries, and smart appliances – are driving today’s energy transformation.

zh: 在这个分布式系统中，每个新设备都很廉价并且很快能够产生回报，因此实验成本很低，技术也能迅速得到改进。
en: Each new device in this distributed system is cheap and pays off quickly, so experimentation is affordable, and the technology can improve rapidly.

zh: 结果是给全球竞争者带来了巨大的竞争舞台，产生更快的创新和新业务模式，达到规模经济。
en: The result is a huge field of global competitors, with faster innovation and new business models that are helping to achieve economies of scale.

zh: 清洁能源革命的硬件与移动电话和笔记本电脑，而不是矿山和炼油厂更加相近。
en: The hardware of the clean-energy revolution has more in common with mobile phones and laptops than with mines and refineries.

zh: 它们可以在所有大型市场中出售，具备可扩展生产链和仍在不断成熟中的技术，因此，向更加清洁的电力的转型的速度比许多专家的预测都要快。
en: Because it can be sold in very large markets, with scalable production chains and still-maturing technologies, the transition to cleaner power is happening faster than many experts predicted it would.

zh: 尽管如此，即使是迅速实现“更加绿色”的能源转变，也不足以让全球平均气温限定在前工业化水平以上2℃以内。
en: Still, not even a rapid shift toward “greener” energy will be enough to keep global average temperature within 2º of preindustrial levels.

zh: 要想实现这个目标，世界还需要让更多温室气体离开大气层。
en: To achieve that, the world will also need to take more greenhouse gases out of the atmosphere.

zh: 幸运的是，这也是可能的。
en: Fortunately, that, too, is possible.

zh: 在农业和土地保护中纳入减碳策略，就能将更多导致温室效应的气体锁定在森林和土壤中。
en: By incorporating carbon-reducing strategies into agriculture and land conservation, more heat-trapping gases can be locked up in forests and soils.

zh: 然而，尽管这些技术已经存在，但要想取得成功，还需要推广免耕农业，采用永续栽种原则，加强湿地管理，使用轮牧技术等。
en: But while the techniques already exist, success will require increasing the use of no-till farming, adopting permaculture principles, better managing wetlands, and using rotational grazing techniques, among other measures.

zh: 推动能源和土地使用发生重大变化的市场力量很强，但2017年风暴季提醒我们，我们所面临的气候紧迫性需要我们采取强力紧急行动。
en: The power of markets to drive radical changes in energy and land use is great, but as the storm season of 2017 should remind us, the climate emergency we face requires vigorous and urgent action.

zh: 改变人们获取和消费能源以及使用土地的方式需要很强的激励和政策框架推动成功。
en: Transforming the way people acquire and consume energy, and use land, will require strong incentives and policy frameworks to set the course for success.

zh: 但也不要绝望：我们仍有时间拯救我们的气候。
en: But don’t despair: there is still time to save our climate.

zh: 转型已经开始 — — 并且将以比大部分人预料的更快的速度展开。
en: The transformation has already begun – and it will play out faster than most people expect.

zh: 管理被破坏的年代
en: Managing the Age of Disruption

zh: 纽约 — — 仅凭直觉就大胆预测很少会是好主意。
en: NEW YORK – Bold predictions based on intuition are rarely a good idea.

zh: 1973年撒切尔夫人任教育大臣时，曾众所周知地断言英国在她有生之年不可能选出一位女首相。
en: Margaret Thatcher, as Education Secretary in 1973, famously asserted that the United Kingdom would not have a woman prime minister in her lifetime.

zh: IBM总裁托马斯·J·沃森曾在1943年宣称“世界市场可能需要五台电脑。
en: IBM’s president, Thomas J. Watson, declared in 1943 that there was “a world market for perhaps five computers.”

zh: ”而当有声电影于1927年首次亮相时，华纳兄弟影业的哈利·华纳质问 ， “ 究竟谁想听演员讲话？ ”
en: And, when movies with sound made their debut in 1927, Warner Brothers’ Harry Warner asked, “Who the hell wants to hear actors talk?”

zh: 值此四大力量破坏全球经济、颠覆我们绝大多数假设时，像这样从过去经历中总结出来的直觉其错误的可能性甚至更大。
en: At a time when four powerful forces are disrupting the global economy, upending most of our assumptions, such pronouncements on the future, shaped by intuitions based on the past, are even more likely to be wrong.

zh: 所谓四大“破坏力”本身都是转型性力量，它们无时无刻不在放大着各自的效果，为世界带来前所未有且不可预知的根本性变化 — — 这些变化会证明我们的直觉错误。
en: Each of these four “great disruptions” is transformational on its own, and all are amplifying the effects of the others, producing fundamental and unpredictable changes on a scale the world has never seen – and that will prove our intuitions wrong.

zh: 最重要的破坏性力是经济活动转移到新兴市场城市。
en: The first great disruption is the shift of economic activity to emerging-market cities.

zh: 就在2000年， 95％的全球财富500强企业总部还设在发达国家。
en: As recently as 2000, 95% of the Fortune Global 500 was headquartered in developed economies.

zh: 而截止到2025年，近半数全球财富500强企业的总部将设在新兴经济体，其中设在中国的总部数量将超过美国和欧洲。
en: By 2025, nearly half of the Fortune Global 500 companies will be based in emerging economies, with China home to more of them than the United States or Europe.

zh: 城市是上述转变的急先锋。
en: Cities are at the vanguard of this shift.

zh: 2010到2025年近半数的全球GDP增长将来自440个新兴市场城市，其中不少西方高管甚至可能都从未听说。
en: Nearly half of global GDP growth from 2010 to 2025 will come from 440 emerging-market cities, many of which Western executives may not even know exist.

zh: 比方说位于北京东南的城市天津，其当前GDP几乎堪与斯德哥尔摩相媲美 — — 而到2025年甚至可能相当于整个瑞典的规模。
en: They are places like Tianjin, a city southeast of Beijing with a GDP that is practically on par with Stockholm’s today – and could equal all of Sweden’s by 2025.

zh: 第二大破坏力是不断加速的技术变革。
en: The second great disruption is the acceleration of technological change.

zh: 尽管技术一直是变革的推动力，但现在随着数字和移动技术前所未有的普及，技术的影响力简直是无处不在的。
en: While technology has always been transformative, its impact is now ubiquitous, with digital and mobile technologies being adopted at an unprecedented rate.

zh: 电话发明后用了50多年时间才在半数美国家庭中普及，而手机普及率从世界人口不到3%猛增至超过三分之二仅用20年就完成了。
en: It took more than 50 years after the telephone was invented for half of American homes to have one, but only 20 years for cellphones to spread from less than 3% of the world’s population to more than two-thirds.

zh: 2006年Facebook还只有600万用户；但今天已经达到14亿之多。
en: Facebook had six million users in 2006; today, it has 1.4 billion.

zh: 移动互联网以难以想象的速度为数十亿新兴经济体民众带来经济增长的曙光。
en: The mobile Internet offers the promise of economic progress for billions of emerging-economy citizens at a speed that would otherwise be unimaginable.

zh: 它使得创业新贵有机会与老牌企业竞争。
en: And it gives entrepreneurial upstarts a greater chance of competing with established firms.

zh: 但技术变革也带来了风险，尤其是对那些因自动化失业或没有掌握先进技术的工人来讲。
en: But technological change also carries risks, especially for workers who lose their jobs to automation or lack the skills to work in higher-tech fields.

zh: 人口是第三大破坏力量。
en: The third disruption is demographic.

zh: 世界多数地区的人口增长将在几个世纪以来首次达到平衡。
en: For the first time in centuries, our population could plateau in most of the world.

zh: 事实上，人口老龄化趋势在发达国家已经非常明显，现在已经蔓延到中国，并将很快波及拉丁美洲。
en: Indeed, population aging, which has been evident in the developed world for some time, is now spreading to China and soon will reach Latin America.

zh: 三十年前，仅有占全球很小部分人口的少数几个国家其生育率远低于每名妇女2.1个孩子的替代率。
en: Thirty years ago, only a few countries, home to a small share of the global population, had fertility rates substantially below the replacement rate of 2.1 children per woman.

zh: 而2013年，约60%的世界人口已居住在生育率低于替代率的国家。
en: In 2013, about 60% of the world’s population lived in countries with sub-replacement fertility rates.

zh: 由于老年人相对劳动年龄人口的数量越来越多，因此对劳动人口造成的压力也越大越大，偿还政府债务、资助公共服务及养老体系所需的税收收入不断萎缩。
en: As the elderly increasingly outnumber working-age people, pressure is building on the labor force, and tax revenues, needed to service government debt and fund public services and pension systems, are diminishing.

zh: 最后的破坏力是当今世界越来越密切的联系，货物、资本、人员和信息的跨界流动比过去容易得多。
en: The final disruption is the world’s increasing interconnectedness, with goods, capital, people, and information flowing ever more easily across borders.

zh: 就在不久前，国际联系还主要体现在欧洲和北美的大型贸易枢纽；而现在，复杂而又庞大的网络覆盖了一切。
en: Not long ago, international links existed primarily among major trading hubs in Europe and North America; now, the web is intricate and sprawling.

zh: 新兴经济体间的资本流动在短短十年间增加了一倍，2009年有超过10亿人跨越国界，是1980年跨境人数的五倍。
en: Capital flows among emerging economies have doubled in just ten years, and more than one billion people crossed borders in 2009, over five times the figure in 1980.

zh: 由此带来的挑战 — — 一系列意想不到的新增对手、来自远方的波动性及本地就业机会的消失 — — 已经让工人和企业措手不及。
en: The resulting challenges – a host of new and unexpected competitors, volatility stemming from faraway places, and the disappearance of local jobs – are already overwhelming workers and companies.

zh: 当然，这样的联系也能带来重要的机遇；但人们内心所隐藏的对于熟悉的偏爱会妨碍工人、企业甚至政府利用这样的机遇。
en: Of course, this interconnectedness also offers important opportunities; but an implicit bias toward the familiar is impeding the ability of workers, firms, and even governments to take full advantage of them.

zh: 对企业而言尤其如此。
en: This is especially true for companies.

zh: 麦肯锡研究显示从1990年到2005年，美国企业几乎总是根据过往业绩来分配资源，而不是未来的机遇。
en: According to McKinsey research, from 1990 to 2005, US companies almost always allocated resources on the basis of past, rather than future, opportunities.

zh: 屈从于上述惯性的企业或许会在新全球经济中垮台，而不是发展壮大。
en: Firms that succumb to such inertia will probably sink, rather than swim, in the new global economy.

zh: 但有些企业会适应环境，利用前所未有的机遇来保持自身的敏捷。
en: Some firms, however, will adapt, taking advantage of unprecedented opportunities to remain agile.

zh: 它们会放弃建设新总部、租用新店面或购买新餐厅等需要投入大量前期资本的传统需求，转而开设卫星销售点、设立网上商店或启用流动食品车。
en: Instead of, say, building a new headquarters, renting a storefront, or purchasing a restaurant – traditional requirements that demanded large amounts of up-front capital – they can open a satellite sales office, create an online store, or launch a food truck.

zh: 灵活性和响应能力将使这些公司能够茁壮成长。
en: Flexibility and responsiveness will enable such firms to thrive.

zh: 当前经济转型的速度和规模无疑令人胆怯。
en: The pace and scale of the current economic transformation is undoubtedly daunting.

zh: 但仍有很多保持乐观的理由。
en: But there is plenty of reason for optimism.

zh: 国内不平等可能表现出上升趋势，但国与国之间的不平等已经大幅下降。
en: Inequality may be on the rise within countries, but it has dropped dramatically among them.

zh: 从1990到2010年有将近10亿人摆脱赤贫；未来二十年另外三十亿人将进入全球中场阶级。
en: Nearly a billion people were lifted out of extreme poverty from 1990 to 2010; another three billion will join the global middle class in the next two decades.

zh: 1930年，在大萧条最恐怖时期，约翰·梅纳德·凯恩斯称“渐进经济体”的生活水平将在今后一百年提升4-8倍。
en: In 1930, at the height of the Great Depression, John Maynard Keynes declared that the standard of living in “progressive economies” would increase 4-8 times over the subsequent 100 years.

zh: 事实已经证明了他在当时被指“极度乐观”的预测正确，且实际改善幅度很可能达到他预测范围的上限。
en: His prediction, which was regarded as hopelessly Pollyannaish at the time, has turned out to be correct, with the improvement likely to be at the top of his projected range.

zh: 有别于同代人的是，凯恩斯认清了起作用的经济力量，及时调整自己的思维，并且最关键的是，不惧怕抱有乐观的态度。
en: Keynes, unlike many of his contemporaries, recognized the forces at work in the economy, adjusted his thinking, and, crucially, was not afraid to be optimistic.

zh: 我们也必须这样。
en: We must do the same.

zh: 种族民族主义的破坏力
en: The Disruptive Power of Ethnic Nationalism

zh: 发自特拉维夫 — — 今年夏天，以色列通过了一项极富争议的新“民族国家法 ” ， 声称 “ （ 行使）民族自决权”是“犹太人独有的权利 ” ， 同时将希伯来语确立为以色列的官方语言而将阿拉伯语降级到一个“特殊地位 ” 。
en: TEL AVIV – This summer, Israel passed a controversial new “nation-state law” that asserted that “the right [to exercise] national self-determination” is “unique to the Jewish people” and established Hebrew as Israel’s official language, downgrading Arabic to a “special status.”

zh: 然而在多元化社会中强加某种同质身份定义的动力并非以色列所独有，相反你在整个西方世界都可以看到 — — 这对和平来说可不是个好兆头。
en: But the drive to impose a homogeneous identity on a diverse society is hardly unique to Israel. On the contrary, it can be seen across the Western world – and it does not bode well for peace.

zh: 在过去几十年的快速全球化过程中民族主义其实从未真正远离我们，只是不敌人们对更大经济繁荣的寄望而已。
en: In the last few decades of rapid globalization, nationalism never really left, but it did take a backseat to hopes of greater economic prosperity.

zh: 然而近期对全球化的抵制 — — 不仅出于经济不安全和不平等，还由于对社会和人口构成变化的担忧 — — 引发了那种老一套种族民族主义的卷土重来。
en: Yet the recent backlash against globalization – triggered not only by economic insecurity and inequality, but also by fears of social and demographic change – has brought a resurgence of old-fashioned ethnic nationalism.

zh: 这种趋势在一些专家所谓的“记忆潮”或“纪念狂热”中得到了体现和强化：一些博物馆，纪念馆，遗址以及其他强调与当地身份和历史联系的公共空间纷纷涌现。
en: This trend is reflected in and reinforced by what some experts call a “memory boom” or “commemorative fever”: the proliferation of museums, memorials, heritage sites, and other features of public space emphasizing links with local identities and history.

zh: 人们越来越渴望拥有一种特定且独有的身份定义而非倡导多样性。
en: Rather than celebrating diversity, people are increasingly eager to embrace a particular and exclusive identity.

zh: 在美国，白人越来越认定自己将成为少数民族 — — 预计将在2045年实现的里程碑式事件 — — 并将此视为一种存续性威胁，并且往往表现得好像自己就是一个弱势群体。
en: In the United States, white people increasingly view the prospect that they will become a minority – a milestone expected to be reached in 2045 – as an existential threat, and often act as if they are a disadvantaged group.

zh: 美国总统特朗普正是利用了这种情绪去赢得支持，而他的共和党如今依靠对“不活跃”选民的强力清洗，严格的选民身份法以及关闭投票站来让少数民族投票更加困难。
en: US President Donald Trump capitalized on such feelings to win support, and his Republican Party is now relying on overzealous purges of “inactive” voters, stringent voter ID laws, and closures of polling places to make it more difficult for minorities to vote.

zh: 与此同时，对欧盟开明价值观的支持也已经受到了侵蚀。
en: Meanwhile, support for the European Union’s enlightened values has eroded.

zh: 如今有点讽刺意味的是，右翼民族主义政党已经建立了一个大联盟以提高自身在2019年5月欧洲议会选举中的机会。
en: Now, somewhat ironically, a grand alliance of right-wing nationalist parties has been established to improve their chances in the May 2019 European Parliament elections.

zh: 这些势力对“身份政治”表示反对（同时又不断对自认国家真正代表的白人群体喊话 ） 。
en: Such forces rail against “identity politics” (while speaking to predominantly white crowds who insist that they are their nation’s true representatives).

zh: 这种言论也得到了一些左翼和右翼知识分子的同情。
en: This rhetoric has gained sympathy from some intellectuals on both the left and the right.

zh: 比如马克·里拉（Mark Lilla）和弗朗西斯·福山（Francis Fukuyama）这样的评论家都表示多元文化主义和国际合作最后都不过是自由派精英的幻想。
en: Multiculturalism and international cooperation, authors such as Mark Lilla and Francis Fukuyama argue, turned out to be a fantasy of the liberal elites.

zh: 同样，长期以来一直谴责“超自由主义”的英国哲学家约翰·格雷（John Grey）试图将英国脱欧投票 — — 某种明显的本土主义和仇外心理的爆发 — — 归咎于其上。
en: Similarly, the British philosopher John Gray, who has long decried “hyper-liberalism,” has attempted to turn the Brexit vote – a clear outburst of nativism and xenophobia – on its head.

zh: 在格雷看来，推动一个违背大多数欧洲人意愿的“跨国政府”的欧盟应该对那些最恶劣形式民族主义的崛起负责。
en: According to Gray, by pushing for a “transnational government” that most Europeans did not want, the EU was responsible for the rise of the worst kinds of nationalism.

zh: 他坚称抵制英国脱欧就等同于回归到“过去的黑暗欧洲 ” 。
en: Resisting Brexit, he insists, would restore a “dark European past.”

zh: 英国前首相托尼·布莱尔的一系列反恐法规是在2005年受基地组织启发的伦敦自杀爆炸事件后颁布的，这也使他成为了第一个否定所谓超自由主义的西方领导人。
en: Former British Prime Minister Tony Blair’s anti-terror laws, enacted after the 2005 al-Qaeda-inspired suicide bombings in London, made him the first Western leader to repudiate so-called hyper-liberalism.

zh: 如今，从特朗普政府，匈牙利总理维克多·奥尔班（Viktor Orbán）以及波兰实际领导人雅罗斯瓦夫·卡钦斯基（Jarosław Kaczyński）的“非自由主义 ” ， 再到意大利民粹联合政府身上都可以看到西方世界的这种否定。
en: Today, such repudiation can be seen across the Western world, from Trump’s administration and the “illiberalism” of Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán and de facto Polish leader Jarosław Kaczyński to Italy’s populist coalition government.

zh: 类似以色列民族国家法所规定的种族民族主义长期以来一直是中欧和东欧政治的主要内容。
en: Ethnic nationalism like that enshrined by Israel’s nation-state law has long been a staple of politics in Central and Eastern Europe.

zh: 血统和宗教 — — 而不是公民身份 — — 曾经是欧洲各国相互征伐时期的国家定义。
en: Blood and religion, not citizenship, was what defined the nation during periods of subjugation.

zh: 在经历了第二次世界大战的毁灭之后，该地区的许多国家都是通过大规模的种族清洗恢复了主权。
en: After the devastation of World War II, many of the region’s nations recovered sovereignty through large-scale ethnic cleansing.

zh: 战后的欧洲一体化未能使中欧和东欧十九世纪末的多民族梦想成为现实，相反仇外心理和极端民族主义的幽灵已然复活，反对德国战后赎罪行为的极右翼德国选择党（Alternative für Deutschland）近期不断高涨的支持率就是一个极佳例子。
en: Post-war European integration failed to resuscitate Central and Eastern Europe’s fin de siècle multi-ethnic dream. Instead, the ghosts of xenophobia and ultra-nationalism have been revived, exemplified in Germany by surging support for the far-right Alternative für Deutschland, which rejects post-war Germany’s expiations.

zh: 因此德国总理默克尔的开明难民政策可能会成为德国赎罪政治的最后体现。
en: German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s enlightened refugee policies might thus turn out to be the last manifestation of Germany’s politics of guilt.

zh: 同样，在首先从未承认过罪责的奥地利，总理塞巴斯蒂安·库尔兹（Sebastian Kurz）的极右翼反移民联盟已经准备好要终结欧盟的“去身份化”政治。
en: Similarly, in Austria – which, to be sure, never admitted guilt in the first place – Chancellor Sebastian Kurz’s far-right, anti-immigration coalition is poised to end the EU’s politics of “identity annihilation.”

zh: 西欧本来应该没有种族民族主义。
en: Western Europe was supposed to be free of ethnic nationalism.

zh: 这些现代民族国家都是沿着公民而非民族线路而打造，国家被定义为一个公民的社区。
en: Modern nation-states were shaped along civic, not ethnic, lines, and the nation was defined as a community of citizens.

zh: 种族，肤色和性别从未被认为是全面且平等的公民参与的障碍。
en: Race, color, and gender were never supposed to be obstacles to full and equal civic participation.

zh: 此外西欧在很大程度上是世俗的，而中欧和东欧的大部分地区（更别说美国）更有可能将其身份与基于宗教的道德秩序联系起来。
en: Moreover, Western Europe is largely secular, whereas much of Central and Eastern Europe (not to mention the US) is more likely to link its identity to a religion-based moral order.

zh: 有鉴于此，西欧激进民族民族主义的兴起是对恐怖主义和大规模移民的恐慌性回应，也是一场更为根本的转型性危机。
en: Given these factors, in Western Europe, the rise of radical ethnic nationalism as a response to fears of terrorism and mass migration represents a more fundamentally transformative crisis.

zh: 那些北欧传统道德超级大国更是如此。
en: This is all the more true of Northern Europe’s traditionally moral superpowers.

zh: 极右翼的丹麦人民党和瑞典民主党的崛起 — — 发源于瑞典法西斯主义以及他们对1950年代神话式白人瑞典的怀念 — — 对欧洲有史以来最完美的社会民主模式构成了毁灭性打击。
en: The rise of the far-right Danish People’s Party and Sweden Democrats, with their roots in Swedish fascism and their nostalgia for the mythic white Sweden of the 1950s, amounts to a devastating blow to the most perfect model of social democracy that Europe has ever produced.

zh: 在这些民族主义者看来社会福利国家是不能取代民族认同的。
en: The social-welfare state, the nationalists claim, cannot substitute for ethnic identity.

zh: 最近发表在《民主化》学报上的一项研究表明，目前全球自由民主的总体水平与1991年苏联解体后不久的记录一致。
en: A recent study published in the journal Democratization shows that the overall level of liberal democracy worldwide now matches that recorded shortly after the collapse of the Soviet Union in 1991.

zh: 正如福山所说，一场“民主衰退”依然发生，但它却集中在了在世界上更为民主的地区：西欧和北美，拉美和加勒比地区以及东欧。
en: There has been a “democratic recession,” as Fukuyama calls it, but it is concentrated in the more democratic regions of the world: Western Europe and North America, Latin America and the Caribbean, and Eastern Europe.

zh: 鉴于这些地区对维护自由世界秩序的重要性 ， （ 白人）种族民族主义的兴起很可能会引发严重后果。
en: Given these regions’ importance to upholding the liberal world order, the rise of (white) ethnic nationalism has potentially serious consequences.

zh: 除非这些国家能设计出一种可以平衡自由民主价值观和人们归属感的新方法，否则就终将走上灾难之路。
en: Unless these countries devise a new way to balance liberal democratic values and people’s craving for a sense of belonging, they will end up paving a path to disaster.

zh: 金融危机被浪费了吗？
en: Was the Financial Crisis Wasted?

zh: 伦敦—在全球金融危机爆发十周年之际，一大波反思正在向我们涌来。
en: LONDON – As the tenth anniversary of the start of the global financial crisis approaches, a wave of retrospective reviews is bearing down on us.

zh: 其中有很多试图回答大哉问：金融体系是否已经过根本性改革，因此我们有信心能够防止2008—2009年间的萧条和破坏性事件？ 还是这场危机被白白浪费了吗？
en: Many of them will try to answer the Big Question: Has the financial system been fundamentally reformed, so that we can be confident of preventing a repeat of the dismal and destructive events of 2008-2009, or has the crisis been allowed to go to waste?

zh: 对于这个问题，不会有共识答案。
en: There will be no consensus answer to that question.

zh: 有人会认为，危机后改革，特别是相关银行的资本要求，走得太远了，用产出衡量的成本过于高昂。
en: Some will argue that the post-crisis reforms, especially those concerning banks’ capital requirements, have gone too far, and that the costs in terms of output have been too high.

zh: 也有人会说，还有很多必须做的事没有做，银行需要显著更高的资本，而最近的瑞士公投的支持者们认为，兴许银行应该被剥夺创造货币的能力。
en: Others will argue that far more must be done, that banks need far higher capital, and possibly, as the proponents of a recent Swiss referendum argued, that banks should lose their ability to create money.

zh: 但理性观察者都必须承认，变化是显著的。
en: But any reasonable observer must acknowledge that there has been a very significant change.

zh: 大部分大银行的资本比2007年提高了三四倍，质量也好了很多。
en: Most large banks now have 3-4 times as much capital, and of far higher quality, than they had in 2007.

zh: 系统性机构现在还要求补充缓冲。
en: Additional buffers are now required in systemic institutions.

zh: 风险管理也大大加强了。
en: Risk management has been greatly strengthened.

zh: 监管干预力量也比从前强了许多。
en: And regulatory intervention powers are far more robust.

zh: 严格监管的政治之城仍然很强，至少在除了美国之外的所有地方都是如此，而即使在美国，特朗普政府的措施也主要有利于社区银行而非华尔街。
en: Political support for tough regulation remains strong, at least everywhere except the United States, and even there the Trump administration’s measures have mainly benefited community banks, not Wall Street.

zh: 但有一个领域，实现的成果少得可怜。
en: There is one area, however, where far less has been achieved.

zh: 美联储前主席保罗·沃尔克（Paul Volcker）观察道 ， “ 几乎每一次金融危机尸体解剖都说 ， [ 美国]错综复杂的监管制度是金融崩溃的原因之一。 ”
en: As former US Federal Reserve board chair Paul Volcker has observed, “virtually every post-mortem of the financial crisis cites the convoluted regulatory system [in the US] as a contributory factor in the financial meltdown.”

zh: 但试图解决金融危机所暴露的缺陷的2010年多德-弗兰克（Dodd-Frank）立法并没有带来多少改变。
en: Yet the 2010 Dodd-Frank legislation, which sought to address the shortcomings exposed by the financial crisis, made very few changes.

zh: 它只是取消了一个很小的中间机构，几乎无人为它惋惜的美国储蓄管理局（Office of Thrift Supervision ） ， 同时又加上了另一个 — — 消费金融保护局（Consumer Financial Protection Bureau ） ， 现任政府非常不喜欢这个机构，让人担心它还能存在多久。
en: It abolished only one small agency, the unlamented Office of Thrift Supervision, and added another, the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, a body so little loved by the current administration that one wonders about its longevity.

zh: 沃尔克所强调的乱局并未得到解决。
en: The convolution highlighted by Volcker was not addressed.

zh: 他对今天的结论是“美国金融机构监管制度高度分散、过时、无效。
en: His verdict today is that “the system for regulating financial institutions in the US is highly fragmented, outdated, and ineffective.”

zh: ”除此之外，一切都很好！
en: Aside from that, all is well!

zh: 毫无疑问，美国是一个异类。
en: The US is undoubtedly an outlier.

zh: 世界其他地区呢？
en: What of the rest of the world?

zh: 有一些变化，也许最引人关注的要数英国，机构安排有了很大改变。
en: There have been a few changes, perhaps most notably in the United Kingdom, where we enjoy rearranging institutional deck chairs.

zh: 充分整合后的金融服务局（Financial Services Authority，我是首任主席）的功能回到了英格兰银行手中或重新分配给了金融监管局（Financial Conduct Authority ） 。
en: The functions of the fully integrated Financial Services Authority (of which I was the first chair) have been returned to the Bank of England or reallocated to the Financial Conduct Authority.

zh: 由国际清算银行和巴塞尔银行监督委员会所设置的金融稳定研究所（Financial Stability Institute）的一项最新研究指出，受评估的79个国家中有11个做出了一些变化。
en: A recent study by the Financial Stability Institute, established by the Bank for International Settlements and the Basel Committee on Banking Supervision, concludes that 11 of the 79 countries assessed have made some changes.

zh: 有趣的是，尽管英国实施了改革，微弱的国际趋势仍然是监管整合，而不是传统模式，即用不同机构监管保险和证券，同时由央行监督银行体系。
en: Interestingly, despite the UK reform, the weak international trend remains toward integrated regulation, and away from the traditional model whereby different agencies regulate insurance and securities, while the central bank oversees the banking system.

zh: 但全世界的实际做法大相径庭。
en: But there remains a remarkable diversity of practice worldwide.

zh: 在79个国家中，有39个仍是三部分立模式，23个国家拥有了统一的监管机构（其中九个更是升格为货币当局 ） 。
en: Of the 79 countries, 39 still operate a three-way sectoral breakdown, and 23 have integrated agencies (nine of which double up as the monetary authority).

zh: 还有九个国家为两部监管制，八个国家选择了所谓的“双峰 ” （ Twin Peak）制度，一家机构负责资本市场监管，另一家监督商业行为。
en: Nine others have two agencies divided along sectoral lines, and eight have chosen a so-called Twin Peaks system, with one agency handling capital-market regulation and the other overseeing business conduct.

zh: 你也许认为，关于在危机中哪些管用，哪些不管用的分析会产生一定程度的一致意见。
en: One might have expected that some degree of agreement would have emerged from an analysis of what did, and did not, work in the crisis.

zh: 但并没有此类迹象。
en: But there is little sign of it.

zh: 分析所得出的结论是模棱两可的。
en: The conclusions of what analysis there has been are somewhat ambiguous.

zh: 很难说某种结构在所有地方都比另一种运行得更好。
en: It is hard to say that one structure worked better than another in every place.

zh: 但有一些建议性的结论。
en: But there are some suggestive assessments.

zh: 一份国际货币基金组织（IMF）对危机前监管的研究表明 ， “ 有统一监管机构的国家[在当时一般不属于央行 ] ， 监管质量的一致性更好。
en: An International Monetary Fund study of pre-crisis regulation concluded that “countries with integrated supervisory agencies [at that time generally outside the central bank] enjoy greater consistency in quality of supervision.”

zh: ”换句话说，它们更严格地符合巴塞尔标准。
en: In other words, their compliance with Basel-set standards was more rigorous.

zh: 但是，在危机后发生变化的国家，央行总是拥有了更大的权力。
en: Yet, where changes have been made since the crisis, central banks have typically been given greater powers.

zh: 这一危机后改革的结构多样性无助于确保全球标准实施的一致性。
en: This structural diversity of post-crisis reforms does not help ensure consistency in the implementation of global standards.

zh: 欧盟的问题尤其严重。
en: It is particularly problematic in the European Union.

zh: 目前，欧元区已经有了银行联盟，但大约一半成员国的监管机构仍设在央行内部，而另一半则设在央行外部。
en: There is now a banking union in the eurozone, but supervisors in around half of the member states are in the central bank, while they are outside it in the other half.

zh: 金融稳定委员会（FSB）就没事可干了吗？
en: Is there not a job here for the Financial Stability Board?

zh: FSB就不能评估实践做法，然后指出更偏好的结构，或至少指出一些不偏好的结构吗？
en: Could the FSB not review practices and point to a preferred structure, or at least some non-preferred ones?

zh: 很不幸，没人对此有兴趣。
en: There is, unfortunately, no appetite there for picking up that thistle.

zh: 国家监管机构无意批评自己的制度。
en: National supervisors have no interest in criticizing their own systems.

zh: 金融稳定研究所的评估表现出更多的勇气。
en: The Financial Stability Institute’s review showed a bit more courage.

zh: 字里行间，作者们几乎没有考虑过分部模式，但结论却虎头蛇尾，仅仅提出“看起来，定期按照流行的目标，对各司法辖区监管结构的功能进行评估是值得的。 ”
en: Reading between the lines, the authors think little of the sectoral model, but their anticlimactic conclusion is only that “it looks worthwhile to regularly conduct assessments of the functioning of the supervisory architecture in each jurisdiction in the light of prevailing objectives.”

zh: 谁能反驳这个结论呢？
en: Who could disagree with that?

zh: 作者们显然很明白，每一篇学术文章都应该这样语焉不详，从而争取更多的研究。
en: The authors were clearly mindful that every academic paper worth its salt ends with a plea for more research.

zh: 因此，我们似乎注定要在高度多样化的体系中蹒跚前行。
en: So we seem set to limp along with a highly diverse system.

zh: 即便是2008年金融危机，也没能将既得利益从许多国家拔除。
en: Even the 2008 financial crisis did not dislodge the vested interests in many countries.

zh: 因此，尽管金融监管得到了实质性加强 — — 这显然是最重要的事情 — — 但其落实仍然需要经过分散的国家机构。
en: So while financial regulation has been materially strengthened, which is clearly the most important thing, its implementation remains in the hands of a patchwork quilt of national agencies.

zh: 远离化石燃料，迎接美好未来
en: Divest in a Better Future

zh: 西雅图—有时，衡量一场运动有多少动力的最佳办法是看批评者的反应。
en: SEATTLE – Sometimes the best measure of a movement’s momentum is the reaction of its critics.

zh: 10月初，当澳大利亚国立大学(ANU)宣布将出售七家化石燃料和矿业公司股票时，澳大利亚保守政客异口同声地对ANU进行了猛烈抨击。
en: When, in early October, the Australian National University (ANU) announced that it would sell its shares in seven fossil-fuel and mining companies, it triggered a chorus of criticism from the country’s conservative politicians.

zh: 表面上看，这些自由市场赢家马上行动起来告诉ANU应该如何花钱。
en: These nominal champions of the free market were quick to tell the university what it should do with its money.

zh: 澳大利亚财政部长乔·霍吉（Joe Hockey）批评ANU的决定是“违背现实 ” 。
en: The Treasurer of Australia, Joe Hockey, disparaged the ANU’s decision as being “removed from reality.”

zh: 其他人也纷纷加入其中，称之为“丢人 ” 、 “非常奇怪 ” 、 “心胸狭隘、不负责任 ” 。
en: Others chimed in, calling it “a disgrace,” “very strange,” and “narrow-minded and irresponsible.”

zh: 事实上这一决定所涉资金相对很小 — — 只相当于ANU大约10亿美元投资组合的不到2 % — —但丝毫没有妨碍批评者的热情。
en: Never mind that the sums involved were relatively small – making up less than 2% of the university’s estimated $1 billion portfolio.

zh: 随着远离化石燃料的呼声日涨，如此恐慌的反应也变得越来越平常。
en: As the drive to divest from fossil fuels picks up speed, such panicky responses are becoming increasingly common.

zh: 澳大利亚反对派之怒让我想起了2013年我在美国国会前参与听证、表示我们应该“让我们的煤炭留在地下原来的位置”时所收获的反应。
en: The outrage of Australia’s conservatives reminds me of the reaction I received when I testified before the US Congress in 2013 that we should “keep our coal in the ground where it belongs.”

zh: 来自美国煤炭业中心西弗吉尼亚州共和党议员大卫·麦金利（David McKinley）说我的证词“让他打了一个寒颤 ” ， 接着把话题引向了我担任市长的西雅图市的犯罪率。
en: David McKinley, a Republican congressman from West Virginia, in the heart of America’s coal country, replied that my words “sent a shiver up [his] spine,” then changed the subject to the crime rate in Seattle, where I was Mayor.

zh: 就连埃克森美孚公司看起来也受了惊。
en: Even ExxonMobil appears shaken.

zh: 该公司最近发布了一篇长篇辩护博文，作为对其所谓联合国秘书长潘基文的气候变化特使玛丽·罗宾逊（Mary Robinson ） “ 声嘶力竭地鼓吹”远离化石燃料的反应。
en: The company recently published a long, defensive blog post responding to what it described as a “full-throated endorsement” of fossil-fuel divestment by Mary Robinson, United Nations Secretary-General Ban Ki-moon’s special envoy for climate change.

zh: 化石燃料行业显然将远离化石燃料运动视为潜在威胁。
en: The fossil-fuel industry clearly sees the divestment movement as the political threat that it is.

zh: 当足够的人对化石燃料生产投资说“不“时，下一步就必然是让煤炭、石油和天然气留在地下。
en: When enough people say no to investing in fossil-fuel production, the next step has to be keeping coal, oil, and gas in the ground.

zh: 如果我们想阻止气候变化的最危险后果，这是不可缺少的步骤。
en: That is a necessary step if we are to head off the most dangerous consequences of climate change.

zh: 为了防止世界气温上升幅度超过2℃的阈值，我们必须让大约80%的已知化石燃料储备保持原状。 气候学家认为，如果升温幅度超过2℃，就将无法减轻气候变化的最恶劣影响。
en: To prevent world temperatures from rising above the 2º Celsius threshold that climate scientists believe represents a tipping point beyond which the worst effects could no longer be mitigated, we will need to leave approximately 80% of known fossil-fuel reserves untapped.

zh: 石油和煤炭公司及其政治盟友警告我们，如果我们这样做，财政就会崩溃 — — 好像热浪、干旱、风暴和海平面上升不会让它们的财政和社会崩溃似的。
en: Oil and coal companies and their political allies warn us of fiscal catastrophe if we do that – as if heat waves, droughts, storms, and rising seas did not bring their own fiscal and social catastrophes.

zh: 作为西雅图市市长，我支持建设能源高效型建筑；开发太阳能、风能和水电；多采用步行、骑车和公共交通代替驾车出行 — — 这些策略有助于构建恢复力更强的经济、提供化石燃料的替代方案。
en: As Mayor of Seattle, I supported the creation of energy-efficient buildings, the development of solar, wind, and hydroelectric power, and a shift toward walking, biking, and public transit as alternatives to driving – strategies that can help to build a more resilient economy and provide viable alternatives to fossil fuels.

zh: 但它们无法防止最糟糕的全球变暖，特别是如果煤炭和石油公司只是换一个地方出售产品的话。
en: But they cannot prevent the worst of global warming, particularly if they result in coal and oil simply being sold elsewhere.

zh: 我们的治理体系并不完善，同样，总有一天公众和公众领袖会要求我们直面关于气候变暖的真相。
en: As imperfect as our governance systems are, at some point the public and its leaders may demand that we confront the truth about global warming.

zh: 那时，我们将实施大幅减少化石燃料使用所必要的监管和法律控制手段。
en: At that point, they will put in place the regulatory or legal controls needed to reduce fossil-fuel use dramatically.

zh: 如���你是审慎、小心的投资者，就应该深刻思考迎来这一时刻的可能性。
en: If you are a prudent and cautious investor, contemplate that possibility for a moment.

zh: 化石燃料行业的股票价值将崩溃 — — 它们的估值基础是公司能够开采和燃烧所有已知储备这一假设。
en: Stock values in the fossil-fuel industry – which are based on the assumption that companies will be able to extract and burn all known reserves – will plummet.

zh: 投资于这些公司风险极大。
en: Investing in these companies, it turns out, is extraordinarily risky.

zh: 所有读过投资学的人都知道 ， “ 过去的表现并不能保证未来表现 ” 。
en: As anyone who receives investment statements knows, “past performance is no guarantee of future performance.”

zh: 这一现实构成了另一个远离化石燃料的理由。
en: That reality implies another compelling case for divestment.

zh: 诚然，会有人说世界永远不会变，我们将永远依赖化石燃料。
en: To be sure, some will claim that the world will never change and that we will continue to depend on fossil fuels forever.

zh: 但你只要看看西雅图，同性恋夫妻在市政厅结婚，大麻在持牌零售商店销售，这些都表明该人类有能力反思根深蒂固的假设。
en: But one has only to look to Seattle, where gay couples marry in City Hall and marijuana is sold in licensed retail outlets, to see the human capacity to reexamine deeply held assumptions.

zh: 审慎的投资者和明智的商业领袖会着眼于经济的未来方向而不是昨天的位置。
en: The prudent investor, and the wise business leader, will look where the economy is headed, not where it has been.

zh: ANU的决定在任何一个非石油和天然气公司代言人的人眼里都是英明的，而若以未来的眼光看，这一决定更是明智无比。
en: The ANU’s decision looks like a sage one to anyone not in thrall to oil and gas companies, and it will only look wiser with the passing of time.

zh: 他们做了一件好事。
en: Good on them.

zh: 2013年，当我决定让西雅图远离化石燃料时，我的决定受到了必须面对全球变暖后果的年轻人的热烈响应，普通大众也很支持。
en: When I put Seattle on the path to divestment in 2013, my decision was well received by the young people who will have to live with the consequences of global warming, as well as the general public.

zh: 尽管政治压力的增加，但ANU管理层只需要聆听学生的声音。
en: As the political pressure mounts, the university’s administrators need only listen to the students.

zh: 我们需要更多ANU所表现出来的勇气。
en: We need more courage like that shown by the ANU.

zh: ANU领导人打败了在澳大利亚炙手可热的煤炭和石油利益集团。
en: Its leaders bucked the power of coal and oil interests, which wield enormous power in Australia.

zh: 如果我们大家都为此喝彩，其他人也能这样做。
en: If they can do it to popular acclaim, others can, too.

zh: 离则死，合则生
en: Divided We Fall

zh: 发自伦敦 — — 今夏美国国内的政治需要压倒了经济理性，国会与总统奥巴马在税收、授权，赤字以及刺激方案上争持不下。
en: LONDON – Politics trumped sensible economics in the United States this summer, when Congress and President Barack Obama could not agree on taxes, entitlements, deficits, or an investment stimulus.

zh: 欧洲各国领导人也左右为难：一方面排除了违约和贬值的可能性，另外一方面又不愿推行赤字和刺激计划。
en: Europe’s leaders were also paralyzed – ruling out defaults and devaluations, as well as deficits and stimulus.

zh: 而通过实施实质负利率，印钞，注入流动性并补贴各商业银行，世界各地的中央银行管理者们（最近是美联储主席伯南克）似乎都认定自己已经尽力了。
en: And, having run negative real interest rates, printed money, plowed in liquidity, and subsidized commercial banks, central bankers everywhere – most recently US Federal Reserve Chairman Ben Bernanke – appear to have concluded that they, too, have reached the limit of what they can do.

zh: 于是，只有很少一部分人怀疑世界正在失控状态下滑向第二次探底。
en: As a result, few people today doubt that the world is drifting, rudderless and leaderless, towards a second downturn.

zh: 夏天来临之前那场关于我们是否面对一个低增长“新常态”的问题已经不复存在，因为已经没有任何东西能维持常态了。
en: The pre-summer debate about whether we faced a “new normal” of slower growth has been resolved: nothing now looks normal.

zh: 希望再挺一挺来蒙混过关的策略已经失效。
en: Muddling through has failed.

zh: 由于无法在全球贸易协定，气候变化条约，增长协议或者经济体制改革等方面达成一致，世界很可能会陷入一个争相贬值、货币战争，贸易限制以及资本管制的新保护主义格局之中。
en: Unable to conclude a global trade deal, climate-change agreement, growth pact, or changes in the financial regime, the world is likely to descend into a new protectionism of competitive devaluation, currency wars, trade restrictions, and capital controls.

zh: 但现在还没到承认失败的时候。
en: But this is not a time for defeatism.

zh: 那些声称已经用尽一切手段的国家其实只是穷尽了本国能使用的路数。
en: Countries claiming to have reached the limit of what they can do really mean that they have reached the limit of what they can do on their own.

zh: 而实现持续增长和就业的策略并不能依靠某个国家的一次性计划，而是要通过全球政策协调来达成。
en: The way forward to sustained growth and employment is not through a flurry of one-off national initiatives, but rather through global policy coordination.

zh: 这其实是2009年4月所订立的目标，当时G20集团给自己定下了三大关键任务。
en: That was the goal back in April 2009, when the G-20 set itself three critical tasks.

zh: 首先要防止全球衰退，这一点已经实现了。
en: The first, preventing a global depression, was achieved.

zh: 而另外两个 — — 改革全球金融系统，并因此制定一个增长协议 — — 应当成为G20下次会议的主要议程。
en: The other two – a growth pact, underpinned by a reformed global financial system – should now be the main items on the G-20’s agenda when it meets.

zh: 2010年时国际货币基金组织预测一个涵盖宏观经济，贸易和政策体制的协调策略将使全球GDP实现5.5%的额外增长，并因此创造2500~5000万个就业岗位并使9000万人脱离贫困。
en: In 2010, the International Monetary Fund estimated that a coordinated approach to macroeconomic, trade, and structural policies could achieve 5.5% higher global GDP, create 25-50 million additional jobs, and lift 90 million people out of poverty.

zh: 但考虑到世界经济当前面临的结构问题以及生产消费之间的巨大缺口，一个全球增长协议如今显得更加必不可少。
en: But a global growth pact looks even more indispensable today, given the world economy’s structural problems and huge imbalances between production and consumption.

zh: 有人说1930年那场史上最严酷经济危机其实是另一更严峻问题的先兆，这一看法或许看上比较奇怪。
en: It may seem strange to describe the greatest financial crisis since the 1930’s as a symptom of a bigger problem.

zh: 然而当历史学家回顾1990年后那场将20亿新生产者卷入世界经济的全球化浪潮时，他们会发现在2010年左���其实出现了一个转折点：150年来西方（美国以及欧盟）第一次在制造、生产、出口，贸易和投资方面被世界其他地区全面超越。
en: But, when historians look back on the wave of globalization after 1990 – which has brought two billion new producers into the world economy – they will find a turning point around 2010. For the first time in 150 years, the West (America and the European Union) was out-manufactured, out-produced, out-exported, out-traded, and out-invested by the rest of the world.

zh: 事实上，亚洲消费市场的规模将在2020年中前期达到美国市场规模的两倍。
en: Indeed, by the early to mid-2020’s, the Asian consumer market will be twice the size of the US market.

zh: 然而今天西方和亚洲市场依然相互依存。
en: Today, however, the West and Asia remain mutually dependent.

zh: 亚洲出口额中的2/3销往西方，而发展中国家间贸易仅占全球贸易总额的20 % 。
en: Two-thirds of Asia’s exports still end up in the West, and south-south trade accounts for just 20% of global turnover.

zh: 换句话说，10年前美国引擎足以驱动全球经济，而未来10年内随着新兴市场国家中产阶层消费力的不断增强，它们将最终占据这一角色。
en: Put another way, ten years ago the US engine could drive the world economy, and ten years from now the emerging-market countries stand to take over that role, particularly given the rising purchasing power of their middle classes.

zh: 但目前为止欧美都无法在不增加进口的情况下增加消费，而中国以及其他新兴市场也不能在缺乏西方强劲市场的情况下扩展其生产或消费。
en: But, for now, America and Europe cannot expand their consumer spending without increasing exports, while China and the emerging markets cannot easily expand their production or consumption without the guarantee of strong Western markets.

zh: 因此，我们首先必须重新恢复G20增长协议（该协议如今已降格为国际货币基金组织所谓“一项针对那些财政失衡国家的深入分析报告 ” ） 所包含的全球合作大视野。
en: So, first, we must restore the broad vision of global cooperation contained in the G-20 growth pact (which has since been downgraded to what the IMF now calls “an in-depth analysis of…those countries identified as having large imbalances”).

zh: 同时还需要一个更广泛也更深入的议程：中国应当同意提升家庭支出和消费品进口；印度应当开放市场以使贫苦民众受惠于廉价进口商品；欧美则应当提升竞争力以增加出口。
en: But a broader and deeper agenda is needed: China should agree to raise household spending and consumer imports; India should open its markets so that its poor can benefit from low-cost imports; and Europe and America must boost competitiveness in order to increase their exports.

zh: G20集团在2009年时也曾强调未来的稳定需要一个新的全球金融体制来维持。
en: The G-20 was also adamant in 2009 that future stability required a new global financial regime.

zh: 英格兰银行的大卫·迈尔斯预测在未来20年内还将再发生3次经济危机。
en: David Miles of the Bank of England predicts three more financial crises in the coming two decades.

zh: 而如果他的同事安德鲁·霍尔丹关于亚洲承受压力增大将导致混乱的论断是对的话，西方必将对自己未能认真确立全球资本充足率和流动性标准以及一个更精确的早期预警系统而懊悔不已。
en: And, if the BoE’s Andrew Haldane is right that rising pressures in Asia threaten future turmoil, the West will regret its failure to entrench global capital-adequacy and liquidity standards and a more transparent early-warning system.

zh: 这一问题其实早已露出端倪。
en: The problem is already evident.

zh: 欧洲的银行部门债务额是美国的5倍，相当于GDP的345 % 。
en: Europe’s banking-sector liabilities are nearly five times higher than in the US, at 345% of GDP.

zh: 德国银行的资产杠杆比率高达32。
en: Germany’s banks are leveraged at 32 times their assets.

zh: 因此金融稳定不仅需要银行进行财务重组，还需要一个重整的欧元，该货币一方面构建在财政和货币政策协调之上，另一方面则奠基于一个更有作为，足以在最后时刻贷款给单一国家政府（而非单一银行）的欧洲中央银行。
en: So, not only is bank recapitalization essential for financial stability, but so is a reformed euro, built on fiscal and monetary coordination and an enhanced role for the European Central Bank in supporting individual governments (not individual banks) as lender of last resort.

zh: 如果不能将注意力重新聚焦放在长期债务消减之上，G20集团国的增长和稳定就是空谈。
en: The G-20 will not achieve growth and stability without a renewed focus on long-term debt reduction.

zh: 但同时也存在着避免陷入下滑周期的短期紧迫要求。
en: But there is also a short-term imperative to avoid a cycle of decline.

zh: 因此我们应当采纳罗伯特·斯基德尔斯基的国家投资银行提议来改善自身基础设施（而不仅仅是环境）来应对未来的挑战并刺激增长和就业。
en: So we should draw on Robert Skidelsky’s national investment bank proposals to equip our infrastructure – not least our environment – for future challenges and to stimulate growth and job creation.

zh: 其中一个榜样就是拥有500亿欧元资本并有能力进行4000亿欧元投资的欧洲开发银行。
en: One model is the European Investment Bank, which, with €50 billion of capital, has been able to invest €400 billion.

zh: 但或许可以和中国谈谈如何利用其外汇储备进行投资，并和西方跨国公司商讨回流利润的税务问题。
en: But there is perhaps a deal to be done with the Chinese on investing their reserves and with Western multinationals on the tax treatment of repatriated profits.

zh: 最后，正如诺贝尔奖经济学奖得主迈克尔·斯宾塞所展示的那样，增长如今已经成为创造就业的一个必要但不充分条件。
en: Finally, as the Nobel laureate economist Michael Spence has shown, growth is now a necessary but insufficient condition for job creation.

zh: 青年失业的流行病尤其需要新的手段来应对 — — 比如设立一个开发银行来帮助中东和北非地区不断膨胀的青年人口实现就业，并在其他地区推行职业培训和学徒项目。
en: Today’s epidemic of youth unemployment, in particular, requires new approaches – a development bank, for example, to help employ the bulging youth population in the Middle East and North Africa, and training and apprenticeship programs elsewhere.

zh: 而G20集团的增长协议也必须成为一项就业增长协议。
en: The G-20’s growth compact must be a jobs compact, too.

zh: 代表着全球80%生产额的G20集团在2009年成为了唯一能够协调全球经济政策的多国实体。
en: The G-20, which represents 80% of world output, came into its own in 2009 as the only multilateral body able to coordinate global economic policy.

zh: 但不幸的是，其成员国迅速抛弃了这个目标并着手寻求单一国家解决方案。
en: Unfortunately, its member states soon abandoned that goal and defaulted to national solutions.

zh: 然而可以预见的是，单打独斗已经无法确保经济复苏，良机也因此再度降临到了G20会议身上。
en: Predictably, going it alone has proven futile in ensuring economic recovery. The G-20’s time has come again.

zh: 而法国总统萨科齐越快召集G20成员国共同行动，效果就越好。
en: The sooner French President Nicolas Sarkozy calls the G-20 together to act, the better.

zh: 中东似曾相识
en: Déjà-vu in the Middle East

zh: 柏林 - - 历史是否重演？
en: BERLIN -- Does history repeat itself, after all?

zh: 中东最近的局势发展表明的确如此，因为布什总统任期尾端的形势越发与克林顿总统任期最后一年的相像。
en: Recent developments in the Middle East suggest that the answer is “yes,” because the situation at the end of President George W. Bush’s tenure increasingly resembles that of Bill Clinton’s final year in the presidency.

zh: 两位总统在任期的最后都寻求解决世界上最为危险的冲突，而面临着时间迅速流逝的威胁。
en: Both presidents, at the end of their respective terms, sought to resolve one of the world’s most dangerous conflicts, while facing the threat that time was running out on them.

zh: 人们或许会绝望。 布什政府明显浪费了大部分七年时间，原本可以在这段时间里寻求解决途径。
en: One could despair: the Bush administration has obviously wasted almost seven years during which it could have pursued a solution.

zh: 我们现在又回到了出发点，也就是2001年1月轻率放弃的戴维营和塔巴会谈将会重新开始。
en: We are now back to the starting point: the Camp David and Taba talks – flippantly abandoned in January 2001 – are to be taken up again.

zh: 然而，正如智者所言，迟到总比没有好！
en: Still, as the wise saying goes, better late than never!

zh: 将在马里兰州安娜波利斯举行的中东问题会议应该是各方之间最终地位谈判的论坛，首先处理巴勒斯坦建国问题及其边界(1967年的边界，其中一部分谈判交换领土 ) 、 首都(耶路撒冷 ) 、 以色列定居点以及巴勒斯坦难民返回家园的权利。
en: The Middle East conference to be held in Annapolis, Maryland should be a forum for final status negotiations between the parties, dealing above all with the establishment of a Palestinian state and its borders (those of June 1967, with some negotiated exchanges of territory), its capital (Jerusalem), Israeli settlements, and the right of return for Palestinian refugees.

zh: 这一会议还应该处理安全问题、结束长达几十年的战争状态以及阿拉伯国家承认以色列的问题。
en: It should also address questions of security, the termination of the decades-long state of war, and recognition of Israel by the Arab states.

zh: 确实，现在应该在两国方案上取得进展了，因为巴勒斯坦人越发失去早晚拥有自己的国家的希望。
en: Indeed, it is high time for progress on a two-state solution, because the Palestinians are increasingly losing hope of ever having a state of their own.

zh: 没有这一进展，中东冲突将会继续处于僵局，而暴力只会加剧。
en: Without it, the Middle East conflict will remain at a stalemate and violence will only intensify.

zh: 多年来，各方不断就所有这些问题进行谈判以求可以接受的妥协，但是都无果而终。
en: Acceptable compromises on all of these questions have been negotiated repeatedly by the parties and stowed away for many years.

zh: 唯一缺乏的就是达成和平协议的政治意愿及力量。
en: The only missing ingredient is the political will and strength to enter into a peace agreement.

zh: 但是，以色列和巴勒斯坦政府缺乏的就是这一政治力量。
en: But this very political strength is precisely what both the Israeli and Palestinian governments lack.

zh: 以色列总理奥尔穆特和巴勒斯坦总统阿巴斯在国内都处于劣势，而且鉴于双方都要做出的妥协，他们冒着很大的风险。
en: Israeli Prime Minister Ehud Olmert and Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas are very weak domestically, and, given the compromises needed on both sides, they will be risking a lot.

zh: 这对于布什总统也一样。
en: The same is true of President Bush.

zh: 确实，美国政府甚至并不全心全意支持自身的建议。
en: Indeed, the US government does not even stand whole-heartedly behind its own initiative.

zh: 莱斯国务卿想要召开这一会议而且费尽周折来加以推动。
en: Secretary of State Condoleezza Rice wants the conference to happen and has done much to push it ahead.

zh: 但是，没有布什的支持真正的突破就不可能。 他愿意接受多少风险呢？
en: But how much risk is Bush – without whom a real breakthrough will be impossible – prepared to accept?

zh: 所幸的是，现有的最终地位谈判上可以接受的禁区已经解除，双方都是如此。
en: Fortunately, existing taboos about what is acceptable in the final status talks have fallen – on both sides.

zh: 奥尔穆特和阿巴斯两人共同的弱点产生了对和平协议的共同的兴趣。
en: The parallel weakness of Olmert and Abbas has produced a parallel interest in a peace settlement.

zh: 实际上，两人都希望通过和平协议来达到在政治上生存下去的目的。 奥尔穆特通过新的选举，而阿巴斯通过可以取得对哈马斯优势的全民公决来达到目的。
en: Indeed, both men hope for political survival through a peace agreement: Olmert by means of new elections and Abbas by a referendum through which he can regain ascendancy over Hamas.

zh: 所以 ， “ 强人之间的和平”失败后，是否“弱者之间的和平”可以成功呢？
en: So will a failed “Peace of the Strong“ be followed by a successful “Peace of the Weak”?

zh: 以色列和巴勒斯坦国内局势发生了改变，而地区政治环境也朝着积极的方向发生了改变，因为今天的大多数阿拉伯国家更为担心伊朗的地区控制，而非以色列。
en: As the domestic situations in Israel and Palestine have changed, so, too, has the regional political environment changed in a positive direction, because most Arab states today are more afraid of Iran’s regional domination than they are of Israel.

zh: 这一局势发展提供了一个前所未有的机遇。
en: This development offers an unprecedented opportunity.

zh: 毫无疑问，这里还是有显而易见的苦难。
en: There are obvious pitfalls, to be sure.

zh: 奥尔穆特在其党内、特别是其联合政府内的移动空间非常小。
en: Olmert’s room for maneuver within his party, and particularly within his coalition, is very small.

zh: 他能否在边界和耶路撒冷问题上做出足够的让步？
en: Can he make sufficient concessions on borders and Jerusalem?

zh: 阿巴斯同样也存有疑虑。
en: Similar doubts apply to Abbas.

zh: 特别是在巴勒斯坦人担心他们最终放弃过多而没有在他们认为是其根本要求上得到的让步的情况下，他能否实现奥尔穆特寻求的安全保证？
en: Can he deliver the security guarantees that Olmert needs, especially given the Palestinians’ fear that, in the end, they will give too much, without getting back concessions on what they see as their fundamental demands?

zh: 而且，关键的障碍不是谈判，而是落实无论达成的何种协议，而其政治代价将会很高。
en: Moreover, the critical hurdle will not be the negotiations, but rather implementation of whatever agreement may emerge – and its political cost will be very high.

zh: 巴勒斯坦人已经身处内战。
en: The Palestinians are already in the midst of a civil war.

zh: 和平所需要的妥协可能同样会导致以色列内部的强烈的政治对抗。
en: The compromises necessary for peace are likely to lead to a stark political confrontation in Israel as well.

zh: 很明显，奥尔穆特在考虑将最终地位协议和路线图机制相结合。
en: Obviously, Olmert is thinking of fusing an agreement on the final status with the Road Map mechanism.

zh: 这一协议应当逐步实施，而其进展应当取决于各方在各个步骤上落实义务的情况。
en: Such an agreement should be implemented gradually, and progress should depend on the parties’ fulfillment of their obligations each step of the way.

zh: 但是，此类机制只有在第三方(美国 ， “ 美国加”或者中东四方)可以监督协议的情况下才会奏效。
en: Yet a mechanism of this kind can only work if a third party (the US, the “US plus,” or the Middle East Quartet) is available to monitor the agreement.

zh: 否则，有关落实这条或者那条条款的争议将会导致整个进程回到人们所熟悉的中东无果而终的流沙之中。
en: Otherwise, disputes about fulfillment of this or that provision will lead the entire process back into the familiar quicksand of Middle East futility.

zh: 所以，从现实的观点来看，安娜波利斯会谈取得积极的成果几乎不可能。
en: So, from a realistic point of view, a positive outcome for the Annapolis talks seems almost impossible.

zh: 这���冲突在过去无法解决，目前三个关键人物即布什、奥尔穆特和阿巴斯都在国内处于困境。 为什么这一冲突可以由这三个人突然解决(或者取得进展) 呢？
en: Why should this conflict, which has proven to be unsolvable in the past, be suddenly solved (or brought closer to a solution) by three actors – Bush, Olmert, and Abbas – who are all in a state of profound domestic weakness?

zh: 卡尔·马克思说过，历史总是重演，先是悲剧，然后是闹剧。
en: Karl Marx wrote that history always repeats itself, first as tragedy, then as farce.

zh: 人们可能担心戴维营是悲剧，而安娜波利斯是闹剧。
en: One might fear that Camp David proves to be the tragedy and Annapolis the farce.

zh: 但是，这是中东，过去的突破都是来自于失败而非胜利。
en: But, then, this is the Middle East, where earlier breakthroughs grew out of defeat, not victory.

zh: 所以人们不应该放弃希望，即使希望看来难以维系。
en: So one should never give up hope, even when hope seems impossible to sustain.

zh: 保卫索契奥运会
en: Securing the Sochi Olympics

zh: 莫斯科—2007年，俄罗斯总统普京来到危地马拉城，为俄罗斯申办今年的索契冬奥会加油打气。 他知道，成功获得主办权是整个过程中最容易的一步。
en: MOSCOW – In 2007, when Russian President Vladimir Putin traveled to Guatemala City to support his country’s bid to host this year’s Winter Olympics in Sochi, he knew that winning would be the easiest step in the process.

zh: 许多人笑话说，只有俄罗斯会提出在亚热带海滨度假胜地举办动机体育大会。
en: Many joked that only Russia would propose a subtropical seaside resort for a winter-sports competition.

zh: 但是，尽管关于周边山脉降雪不足和俄罗斯及时建造所需基础设施能力不足的担忧自俄罗斯赢得主办权以来逐渐被打消，仍然有一个严重问题挥之不去：恐怖主义威胁。
en: But, while concerns about a lack of snow in the surrounding mountains, or about Russia’s ability to build the needed infrastructure in time, have gradually receded since Russia was awarded the games, one major apprehension has remained: the threat of terrorism.

zh: 索契位于北高加索地区，苏联解体后，这里经历了车臣的长期野蛮武装叛乱，临近的达吉斯坦随后更是成为伊斯兰极端主义和恐怖主义的温床。
en: Sochi is located in the North Caucasus region, which, following the Soviet Union’s dissolution, experienced a long and brutal armed insurgency in Chechnya, while neighboring Dagestan, in particular, later became a hotbed of Islamist extremism and terrorism.

zh: 事实上，普京果断地对北高加索分裂主义实施无情打击的举动赢得了俄罗斯人民的一致支持，时任总统叶利钦也因此在1999年把他作为自己的继任者。
en: In fact, Putin gained widespread support among the Russian people through his decisive and ruthless handling of separatism in the North Caucasus – support that helped persuade then-President Boris Yeltsin to appoint Putin as his successor in 1999.

zh: 入主克里姆林宫后，普金军事胜利和政治和解双管齐下，成功使车臣恢复平静，车臣与其说是俄罗斯联邦的真正的一部分，不如说是附庸于俄罗斯的一个封建汗国。
en: Once in office, Putin – with a military victory and a policy of reconciliation – managed to pacify Chechnya, leaving it more a feudal khanate associated with Russia than a real part of the Russian Federation.

zh: 结果，在过去十二年中，俄罗斯和车臣以及车臣内部一直保持着和平。
en: As a result, for the last dozen years, there has been peace with – and within – Chechnya.

zh: 恐怖主义才是更顽固的挑战。
en: Terrorism has turned out to be a more stubborn challenge.

zh: 2002年，车臣战事临近尾声时，北高加索恐怖分子绑架了一家莫斯科剧院中的数百人。
en: As the war in Chechnya was drawing to a close in 2002, hundreds of people in a Moscow theater were taken hostage by terrorists from the North Caucasus.

zh: 类似地，2004年北奥塞梯别斯兰（Beslan）的数百名学生遭到武装集团的劫持。
en: Similarly, in 2004, hundreds of schoolchildren in Beslan, North Ossetia, were seized by an armed group.

zh: 这两起袭击的总死亡人数超过了500人。
en: The death toll in these two attacks alone topped 500.

zh: 2005年，伊斯兰武装分子包围了北高加索地区首���纳尔奇克（Nalchik）并占领了一天。
en: In 2005, armed Islamists seized Nalchik, a regional capital in the North Caucasus, and held it for a day.

zh: 2010年，达吉斯坦自杀袭击者在莫斯科地铁制造了两起爆炸事件，至少40人丧生。
en: In 2010, at least 40 people died in two explosions in the Moscow metro set off by suicide bombers from Dagestan.

zh: 2011年，莫斯科多莫杰多沃机场又发生一起类似爆炸事件，37人丧生。
en: The following year, 37 people were killed in a similar fashion at Moscow’s Domodedovo airport.

zh: 尽管普京表示准备授权采取针对可疑恐怖分子的打击 ， “ 不管他们身在何处 ” ， 但恐怖袭击仍在继续发生。
en: The attacks have continued, despite Putin’s stated willingness to authorize strikes against suspected terrorists, “wherever they may be.”

zh: 可以说自苏联解体以来，恐怖分子无时无刻不再与俄罗斯开战。
en: It is fair to say that terrorists have been at war with Russia almost from the very moment the Soviet Union dissolved.

zh: 但他们斗争的目标不再是高加索某片地区的独立；而是建立一个基于伊斯兰教法的“高加索哈里发 ” 。
en: But it is no longer a fight for independence for a particular region in the Caucasus; instead, it is a fight to establish a “Caucasus caliphate” based on Sharia law.

zh: 恐怖分子的手段也发生了变化。
en: The terrorists’ methods have also changed.

zh: 他们的策略选择已不再是20世纪90年代的武装动乱或21世纪最初十年的组成军事单位进行侵略，而是个人恐怖行动。
en: Their tactic of choice is no longer armed insurgency, as in the 1990’s, or raids by groups of militants, as in the 2000’s, but individual acts of terror.

zh: 他们的目标包括高加索地区的警署和加油站、鞑靼斯坦主流穆斯林牧师、俄罗斯各地的普通民众等。
en: The targets range from police stations and liquor stores in the Caucasus to mainstream Muslim clerics in Tatarstan to ordinary people elsewhere in Russia.

zh: 实施了去年波士顿马拉松爆炸案的达纳耶夫（Tsarnaev）兄弟便是这类恐怖主义的写照，他们的目标是全体现代世俗社会，不管是在俄罗斯还是别国。
en: The Tsarnaev brothers – responsible for last year’s Boston Marathon bombings – exemplify this brand of terrorism, aimed at modern secular society in general, whether in Russia or elsewhere.

zh: 从一开始就显而易见的是，囊括了恐怖分子所反对的一切要素的索契奥运会也极有可能成为恐怖袭击的目标。
en: It has been clear from the beginning that the Sochi Olympics, which epitomize everything that the terrorists oppose, would be a likely target.

zh: 最近在俄罗斯南部的伏尔加格勒和北高加索地区的五山城（Pyatigorsk）所发生的爆炸事件（夺走了三十六人的生命）可能就是传递给俄罗斯人的信号，证明他们防不胜防，也让世界其他国家知道索契很危险，最好不要前往。
en: The recent bombings in Volgograd, in southern Russia, and Pyatigorsk, in the North Caucasus – which claimed three dozen lives – were probably designed to send the message to Russians that they are defenseless, while communicating to the rest of the world that Sochi is too dangerous to visit.

zh: 而从某种程度上说，他们取得了成功。
en: And, to some extent, they have succeeded.

zh: 尽管国际社会一致谴责恐怖袭击并承诺杜绝恐怖主义，但仍有一些人取消了索契之行。
en: Some have canceled their trips to Sochi, despite the international community’s condemnation of the attacks and vow to defy terrorism.

zh: 美国国防部长哈格尔最近对记者说，美国将和俄罗斯安全官员合作，一旦索契发生袭击事件，将撤出其中的美国人。
en: US Defense Secretary Chuck Hagel recently told reporters that the US, working with Russian security officials, will be prepared to extract Americans from Sochi in the event of an attack.

zh: 但事实是索契也许是现今俄罗斯保护最完善的地方。
en: But the fact is that Sochi is perhaps the best-protected place in Russia today.

zh: 索契事关普京的个人安全，因此俄罗斯警方和安全部门的最紧要的任务便是确保奥运会不会发生任何事件。
en: With Putin’s personal standing at stake, the top priority of Russia’s police and security services is to ensure that the games proceed without incident.

zh: 这就引起了另一大风险：在索契周边部署主要执法力量的情况下，恐怖分子可能会在奥运会期间袭击别处。
en: This raises another risk: with major law-enforcement assets deployed in or near Sochi, terrorists might try to strike elsewhere during the Olympics.

zh: 毕竟俄罗斯是一个广袤的大国，而恐怖分子是渺小的，难以察觉，部分也是因为他们通常使用原始通信工具，难以侦测。
en: After all, Russia is a vast country, and the terrorist cells are small and notoriously difficult to penetrate, partly because they often use primitive modes of communication that are difficult to detect.

zh: 此外，尽管打击恐怖主义的国际合作很有裨益，但其影响受狐疑和互不信任的掣肘，波士顿马拉松爆炸案已经证明了这一点。
en: And, while international cooperation to combat terrorism is useful, its impact is constrained by suspicion and mistrust, as the Boston Marathon bombings highlighted.

zh: 在索契奥运会进行的同时，在试图破坏奥运会或至少干扰奥运会气氛的恐怖分子和以挫败恐怖分子计划为任务的俄罗斯安全部门之间的竞争已经展开。
en: Parallel to the Sochi Olympics, another contest is already underway between the terrorists who seek to disrupt the games, or at least mar the atmosphere surrounding them, and the forces of the Russian state, whose task is to thwart the terrorists’ plans.

zh: 这是一场俄罗斯绝对不容有失的竞争。
en: This is one contest that Russia absolutely must win.

zh: 补充抗氧化剂真的有效吗？
en: Do Antioxidant Supplements Work?

zh: 塞尔维亚尼什 — — 远在古希腊的时候人们就了解了饮食对于健康的影响。
en: NIS, Serbia – The influence of diet on health has been known since the Ancient Greeks.

zh: 我们的身体无法合成一些重要的合成物，所以我们的健康部分依赖于我们所吃和喝的东西。
en: Our bodies simply cannot synthesize many essential compounds, so our health partly depends on what we eat and drink.

zh: 被认为能帮助保护我们不致患上癌症和心脏病的抗氧化剂正是这样一种必须输入我们体内的元素。
en: Antioxidants, which are believed to help protect us against both cancer and heart disease, are one such element that must import into our bodies.

zh: 研究表明水果和蔬菜摄入越多与降低患慢性病的危险之间存在着非常明显的正比关系。
en: Studies have shown that there is a significant positive association between a higher intake of fruits and vegetables and reduced risk of chronic disease.

zh: 水果和蔬菜含有丰富的微量营养素，其中的一些，包括β胡萝卜素（维生素A的前身 ） 、 维生素C、维生素E和硒，都有可能成为抗氧化剂。
en: Fruits and vegetables are sources of numerous micronutrients, and some, including b-carotene (a precursor of vitamin A), vitamin C, vitamin E, and selenium, have potential as antioxidants.

zh: 但是到底是什么使水果和蔬菜对我们身体如此有益至今尚不清楚。
en: But what specifically makes fruits and vegetables so beneficial is not clear.

zh: 抗氧化剂的主要作用是防止对细胞组分的氧化损伤，所以人们认为包含在膳食中的抗氧化剂能够减少这类损伤以及患病的危险。
en: The main role of antioxidants is to prevent oxidative damage to cellular components, so it has been proposed that dietary antioxidants decrease such damage and with it the risk of disease.

zh: 这也使人们对于补充抗氧化剂可能会有的预防潜力产生了浓厚的兴趣。
en: This has stimulated interest in the possible preventive potential of antioxidant supplements.

zh: 事实上，食用补充抗氧化剂在发达国家已经非常普遍。
en: Indeed, consumption of antioxidant supplements in developed countries has become widespread.

zh: 现在在发达国家中有超过三分之一的成年人服用抗氧化药片，这比吃水果和蔬菜要简单多了。
en: More than one-third of adults in developed countries now ingest antioxidant pills, which is much easier than eating fruits and vegetables.

zh: 但是它对我们人体同样有益吗？
en: But will the benefits be the same?

zh: 在任何干预研究中，对于补充抗氧化剂的防治效果最有说服力和最直接的证据需要尽心随机和受控的临床试验。
en: As with any therapeutic intervention, the most convincing and direct proof of the preventive efficacy of antioxidant supplements requires randomized, controlled clinical trials.

zh: 这种试验会排除参与者饮食记录上的问题，并且控制所有已知和未知的复杂因素的影响。
en: Such trials eliminate the problems of participants’ dietary record and controls the effects of both known and unknown confounding factors.

zh: 迄今为止，进行了许多以验证人们所猜想的补充抗氧化剂的有益作用。
en: So far, many studies have been conducted to verify the supposed beneficial effects of antioxidant supplements.

zh: 但是，尽管许多流行病研究的结果几乎都肯定了它的作用，临床试验的结果在很大程度上却并没有定论。
en: But, while the results of epidemiological studies have been almost uniformly positive, the results of clinical trials have remained largely inconclusive.

zh: 一些临床试验因为发现了补充抗氧化剂的有害作用而提前结束了。
en: Some clinical trials were terminated prematurely because harmful effects of antioxidant supplements were observed.

zh: 事实上，现在有压倒性的证据可以使我们对抗氧化药片的防治效果产生疑问。
en: Indeed, the overwhelming evidence currently calls into question the preventive effect of antioxidant pills.

zh: 恰恰相反，它们也许是有害的，服用这些药片的人死亡的风险加大了。
en: On the contrary, they may be harmful, leading to an increased risk of mortality in people consuming them.

zh: 对于补充抗氧化剂的负面作用有一些可能的解释。
en: There are several possible explanations for the negative effect of antioxidant supplements.

zh: 首先，抗氧化剂所要对抗的“自由基”有两面的生理功能。
en: First, the “free radicals” that anti-oxidants act against perform a dual biological function.

zh: 作为它们正常功能的一部分，自由基在所有细胞中持续不停地被产生。
en: Free radicals are produced continuously in all cells as part of their normal functioning.

zh: 在正常的浓度下，它们是我们机体消灭不想要的细胞的反应的一种重要的介质。
en: In moderate concentrations, they are essential mediators of reactions by which our bodies eliminate unwanted cells.

zh: 在消灭我们身体中的自由基时，我们也就干预了消灭受损细胞，包括癌细胞的重要防御机制。
en: By eliminating free radicals from our body, we interfere with important defensive mechanisms for eliminating damaged cells, including cancerous cells.

zh: 所以抗氧化物质同样也会对人产生伤害。
en: So antioxidant substances can also harm people.

zh: 而如果我们的膳食中通常包含安全水平、高浓度的补充抗氧化剂就会很危险。
en: Whereas our diets typically contain safe levels, highly concentrated antioxidant supplements can be hazardous.

zh: 事实上，到底多大量的抗氧化剂可以对人体带来保护目前并不清楚，并且也许因人而异。
en: In fact, the amounts of antioxidants that lend protection are not known and probably differ among individuals.

zh: 受到更多氧化应激的人对于抗氧化剂的要求也许会更高。
en: People exposed to increased oxidative stress may have elevated antioxidant requirements.

zh: 此外，药片中的补充抗氧化剂是合成的，与自然产生的抗氧化剂相比在生物化学上是不平衡的。
en: Moreover, antioxidant supplements in pills are synthetic and biochemically unbalanced compared to their naturally occurring counterparts.

zh: 它们也没有像其他药剂那样经过严格的毒理研究。
en: Nor are they subjected to the same rigorous toxicity studies as other pharmaceutical agents.

zh: 事实上，我们对于我们的身体是怎样对它们进行新陈代谢的以及它们之间是怎样相互作用的缺乏实质性的知识。
en: Indeed, we still lack substantial information on how our bodies metabolize them and how they interact with one another.

zh: 其结果是，我们至今尚不清楚它的服用剂量、服用期限以及同时服用其他药物是否会影响它的作用。
en: As a result, it is still unclear whether dosage, duration of use, or parallel intake of other agents determine differences in their effect.

zh: 我们同样不清楚氧化应激是慢性病以及老化过程的首要起因还是一个次要现象。
en: It also is unclear whether oxidative stress is a primary cause or a secondary phenomenon of chronic diseases, as well as of the aging process.

zh: 在大多数的人体疾病中，氧化应激仅仅是一种症状。
en: In most human disease, oxidative stress is merely a symptom.

zh: 所以氧化应激与疾病之间的联系不应被过分强调。
en: So the link between oxidative stress and disease should not be overemphasized.

zh: 我们对于抗氧化剂的作用机制还知之甚少。
en: There are still many gaps in our knowledge of the mechanisms of action of antioxidant supplements.

zh: 服用相对高量的补充抗氧化剂的效果和安全性这样的基本问题尚需得到解决。
en: Basic issues concerning the efficacy and safety of consuming relatively high doses of antioxidant supplements need to be resolved.

zh: 我们需要进行持续的临床试验和进一步的研究来提高我们的认识。
en: Results of ongoing clinical trials and further studies are required to improve our knowledge.

zh: 与此同时，我们知道抗氧化剂可能会给我们的健康带来我们不想要的后果。
en: In the meantime, we know that antioxidants can cause unwanted health consequences.

zh: 所以抗氧化剂的最佳来源应该是膳食，而不是营养补给物。
en: So the optimal source for antioxidants is diet, not supplements.

zh: 总而言之，我们应该停止服药片，而去吃更多的水果和蔬菜。
en: In short, we should stop taking pills and eat more fruits and vegetables.

zh: 金融业足够安全了吗？
en: Is the Financial Sector Safe Enough Yet?

zh: 坎布里奇—全球金融危机十年后，全世界决策者仍在评估如何最好地阻止银行倒闭再次拖累经济的风险。
en: CAMBRIDGE – A decade after the global financial crisis, policymakers worldwide are still assessing how best to prevent bank failures from tanking the economy again.

zh: 两份最新出版物 — — 一份来自美国财政部，另一份来自美联储经济学家 — — 为情况提供了一个指标。
en: Two recent publications – one from the US Department of the Treasury, and another by Federal Reserve economists – provide an indication of where we are.

zh: 美国财政部报告考察了是否要用完全基于法庭的机制取代2010年多德-弗兰克法（Dodd-Frank Act）的监管者领衔的破产大银行清盘程序。
en: The US Treasury report examined whether to replace the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act’s regulator-led process for resolving failed mega-banks – the Orderly Liquidation Authority (OLA) – with a solely court-based mechanism.

zh: 财政部的研究是在总统特朗普的指示下进行的，他受到几位共和党国会领袖的压力 — — 如得克萨斯州众议员、众议院金融服务委员会主席杰布·亨萨林（Jeb Hensarling ） — —他支持用法庭取代监管机构。
en: The Treasury’s study was undertaken under instructions from President Donald Trump, who was responding to pressure from several Republican congressional leaders – such as Representative Jeb Hensarling of Texas, the chair of the House Financial Services Committee – who advocate replacing regulators with courts.

zh: 最终，尽管财政部赞扬了倒闭银行基本破产（basic bankruptcy）的优点，但拒绝撤销监管机构领衔银行重组的权力。
en: Ultimately, while the Treasury extolled the virtues of basic bankruptcy for failed banks, it rejected repealing regulators’ powers to lead bank restructurings.

zh: 亨萨林对财政部的结论表示非常失望，和同事们坚持多德-弗兰克是政府不恰当干预的范例，很有可能拿纳税人的钱来援助银行。
en: Hensarling expressed deep disappointment with the Treasury’s conclusion, and he and his colleagues continue to insist that Dodd-Frank is an example of inappropriate government meddling that raises the risks of taxpayer-funded bailouts.

zh: 但财政部认识到，撇开监管机构的提议大有问题。
en: But, as the Treasury recognized, eliminating the regulators is a problematic proposition.

zh: 重组危机中的银行需要规划，需要熟悉银行的优势和劣势，需要知道如何决定高波动经济中的最佳破产时机，需要具备与外国监管机构协作的能力。
en: Restructuring banks in a crisis requires planning, familiarity with the bank’s strengths and weaknesses, knowledge of how best to time the bankruptcy in a volatile economy, and a capacity to coordinate with foreign regulators.

zh: 在没有监管机构的事先规划和实时建议以及国际协作的情况下，法庭无法胜任这些任务，特别是在现有银行破产准备时间内 — — 48小时周末。
en: The courts cannot fulfill these tasks, especially not in the time currently allotted for a bank bankruptcy – a 48-hour weekend – without regulators’ prior planning and immediate advice, as well as international coordination.

zh: 此外，如果多家大银行同时倒闭，破产法庭无法管理随之而来的整个经济的危机。
en: Moreover, if multiple mega-banks sank simultaneously, bankruptcy courts could not manage the economy-wide crisis that would follow.

zh: 它们缺乏制定全国恢复计划的训练。
en: They lack the training to devise a nationwide recovery plan.

zh: 它们也无法与外国监管机构协调流程。
en: And they are in no position to coordinate proceedings with foreign regulators.

zh: 考虑到所有这些因素，取消监管机构领衔的重组可能是一个巨大的退步。
en: Given all of this, eliminating regulator-led restructuring would amount to a big step backward.

zh: 因此，财政部的报告是一个好消息，特别是因为，在没有财政部的支持的情况下，众议院很有可能不会推动这一变革。
en: So the Treasury’s report is good news, especially because, without Treasury support, the House of Representatives may well stop pushing for this change.

zh: 但第二份最新发布 — — 由几位美联储经济学家做出 — — 表明还有工作有待完成。
en: Yet the second recent publication – by several Fed economists – suggests that there is work to be done.

zh: 该报告的主要结论是重组计划尚未反映在市场对银行债券的定价中。
en: That report’s main conclusion is that restructuring planning is not yet reflected in the market’s pricing of bank bonds.

zh: 危机后，国际货币基金组织（IMF）工作人员和其他人的研究认为，银行需要大幅增加吸收损失的股本。
en: After the crisis, studies by International Monetary Fund staff and others concluded that banks needed much more loss-absorbing equity.

zh: 2009年，许多主要银行的每一美元资金中只有五美分来自股本；其他都是债务（存款、隔夜贷款和长期贷款 ） 。
en: In 2009, only five cents of every dollar of funding for many major banks came from equity; the rest was debt (deposits, overnight loans, and long-term loans).

zh: 因此，如果银行在其经营过程中每一美元债务损失了六美分，就会有一些债权人得不到足额偿付。
en: So if the bank lost six cents in its operations per dollar of debt, some creditor could not be fully paid.

zh: 为了避免损失，许多债权人竞相抽取现金，让整个银行系统承受压力，并有引起挤兑的可能。
en: Seeking to avoid losses, many creditors would rush to cash out, putting pressure on the entire banking system and potentially triggering a run.

zh: 据IMF的研究，如果银行的每一美元资金中有15美分来自股本的话，那么大部分银行都能抵挡住金融危机。
en: According to the IMF study, most banks could have weathered the crisis effectively if 15 cents of every dollar of funding had come from equity.

zh: 但尽管监管机构推动股本增加，银行每一美元资金仍然只有八到九美分来自股本，最大的银行甚至连这一次优比例都要求降低。
en: Yet banks still hold only eight or nine cents per dollar of funding in equity, despite regulators’ pushed for an increase , and the biggest banks have called for reducing even this suboptimal ratio.

zh: 监管者和银行家尝试寻找中间道路增加安全。
en: Regulators and bankers have sought a middle ground to boost safety.

zh: 除了现在持有的八美分股本，银行的目标是让另外八美分债务能够在一个周末的时间里转换为股本。
en: In addition to the eight cents of equity they are holding, banks are now aiming to hold another eight cents per dollar of debt that could be turned into equity in the course of a weekend.

zh: 在这一情形中，受损银行能够吸收更多损失并保持营业，降低债权人的挤兑激励。
en: In such a scenario, a damaged bank could absorb more losses and remain in operation, diminishing creditors’ incentive to run.

zh: 但有一个潜在弊端。
en: But there is a potential hitch.

zh: 根据当前计划，会事先指定一些债权人在银行股本耗尽的时候吸收倒闭银行的损失。
en: Under the current plan, certain creditors are designated in advance to absorb a failed bank’s losses once the equity is wiped out.

zh: 这些债权人的债务因此风险更高，较之未被制定转换为股本的债务，应该对银行更加昂贵。
en: Those creditors’ debts are thus riskier, and should be more expensive to the bank than the debt that is not designated to be turned into equity.

zh: 但美联储经济学家认为，在市场中并非如此。
en: Yet the Fed economists conclude that, in the market, this is not the case.

zh: 为什么？
en: Why?

zh: 第一种可能相当乐观：金融市场不认为在现有债务的生命周期中会爆发另一场金融危机。
en: The first possibility is rather optimistic: financial markets don’t think there could be another financial crisis during the life of the existing debt.

zh: 但银行真的相信未来十年没有机会爆发危机吗？
en: But could markets really believe that there is zero chance of a crisis in the next decade?

zh: （比如）贸易战或财政危机（预测的万亿美元赤字达到的话）的风险是实实在在、显而易见的，并体现在高波动的股市价格中。
en: The risks of, say, a trade war or a fiscal crisis (when the projected trillion-dollar deficits are reached) are real, apparent, and priced by volatile stock markets.

zh: 另一个更加中性的可能是市场之所以没有对不同种类的债券分别定价，是因为它们不理解计划会让一些债权人受损，而让另一些债权人安全。
en: Another more neutral possibility is that markets aren’t pricing the different types of debt differently because they do not understand that the plan involves hitting some creditors hard and keeping others safe.

zh: 但这也不太可能，因为计划早就在金融圈中公布了，穆迪（Moody’s）等评级机构也认为吸收损失的债务比常规债务风险更大。
en: But this is also unlikely, because the plan has been well publicized in financial circles, and ratings agencies like Moody’s count the loss-absorbing debt as riskier than banks’ regular debt.

zh: 第三种解释不太吉利。
en: The third explanation is more ominous.

zh: 也许金融市场知道计划，只是（尚）不认为它们可信。
en: Maybe financial markets understand the plans, but don’t (yet) find them credible.
