zh: 大银行的周末重组从未尝试过，评论员仍然认为有潜在的障碍需要克服。
en: Weekend restructuring of mega-banks has never been tried, and commentators still see potential hurdles to overcome.

zh: 也许了解情况的投资者认为，归根结底银行和政府不会将指定吸收损失的债权人和其他人区分对待。
en: Maybe knowledgeable investors assume that, ultimately, banks and the government will not treat the designated loss-absorbing creditors any differently than others.

zh: 要么一损俱损，要么一救俱救。
en: Either everyone will go down, or everyone will get bailed out.

zh: 如果这才是原因的话，着实令人失望，因为制定监管领衔和法庭领衔的重组机制都已经做了大量功课。
en: If this is the reason, it is disappointing, given how much work has gone into developing both the regulatory-led and the court-led restructuring mechanisms.

zh: 亨萨林的多德-弗兰克法案“匝道”能奏效吗？
en: Could Hensarling’s Dodd-Frank “Off-Ramp” Work?

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 上个月，美国众议院金融服务委员会的共和党人主席杰布·亨萨林（Jeb Hensarling）在纽约经济俱乐部发表了一次内容广泛的演讲，提议彻底改革美国金融监管制度。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Jeb Hensarling, the Republican chair of the Financial Services Committee in the US House of Representatives, delivered a wide-ranging speech last month at the Economic Club of New York, proposing to overhaul US financial regulation.

zh: 关于金融危机的责任，亨萨林一面指责监管机构，一面为华尔街开脱；谴责政府资助下的银行救助行动；还将2010年的多德 - 弗兰克金融改革立法视为夺权之举；并呼吁国会强化对美联储监督。
en: Hensarling blamed regulators and excused Wall Street for the financial crisis; condemned government-funded bank bailouts; characterized the 2010 Dodd-Frank financial-reform legislation as a power grab; and called for increased congressional oversight of the Federal Reserve.

zh: 大多数亨萨林的提议 — — 即便如今得到了一份党派意味浓厚的众议院银行委员会文件和一篇有偏向性的华尔街日报评论文章支持 — — 在政治上都是毫无意义的（这些提案都必须得到参议院60票赞成以及总统签字方能通过 ） ， 同时也已经被民主党尖锐批评为过于冒险和偏袒银行 — — 大多数提议确实如此。
en: Most of Hensarling’s proposals – even backed, as they now are, by a partisan-sounding document from the House Banking committee and a favorable Wall Street Journal review – are political nonstarters. (They would have to get 60 Senate votes and a presidential signature to pass.)

zh: 即便如此，亨萨林的其中一项理念是非常值得探讨的：那些愿意增加自身可用资本金的银行是否可以摆脱多德-弗兰克法案的监管，照他的话说，与其大家都挤在一条路上，为何不能安排一条“匝道”让一些人能选择另一条路线？
en: They have already been sharply criticized by Democrats as being too risky and pro-bank – which they largely are. That said, one of Hensarling’s ideas is well worth exploring: an “off-ramp,” as he put it, from Dodd-Frank regulation for banks that willingly increase their available capital.

zh: 让我们先回到一些基本问题上：政府之所以会为银行存款做担保，是因为银行破产可能会损害整个经济。
en: Let’s go back to basics for a moment. The government guarantees bank deposits because a banking failure could hurt the entire economy.

zh: 这引发了道德风险，因为银行为了增加大股东的收益，会疏于管理那些实际上属于公众的资金。
en: This creates moral hazard, as banks, looking for big shareholder gains, become lax in managing what effectively becomes the public’s money.

zh: 它们毫不介意去冒巨大的风险，反正出事了只要把银行交回给政府来去偿还储户和其他债权人就行了。
en: They feel comfortable taking big risks, because if they lose, they just turn the bank over to the government to pay off depositors and other creditors.

zh: 反之一旦博赢，银行及其股东们就赚大了。
en: And if they win, they and their shareholders keep the bonanza.

zh: 监管机构使用两个关键措施来遏制这种冒险行为：它们要求银行持有更多资本，并保证投资，贷款和操作比银行计划中更为安全（也意味着潜在利润减少 ） 。
en: Regulators use two key measures to mitigate such risk-taking: they require banks to hold more capital and to keep investments, loans, and operations safer (and potentially less profitable) than the banks want them to be.

zh: 因为这两大核心监管手段都指向同样的目的，所以理论上是可以互相替换的 — — 监管机构可以将银行的资本要求设置到极高水平，也可以将银行活动的风险程度压得极低。
en: Because these two central regulatory methods achieve the same end, they can theoretically be substituted for one another – regulators can set banks’ capital requirement very high, or they can set the riskiness of banks’ activities very low.

zh: 在实践中，由于监管机构都无法做到完美，所以它们选择在两方面都做一些规定。
en: In practice, because regulators cannot do either perfectly, they do some of each.

zh: 亨萨林的“匝道”提议就构建于这一权衡之上，给银行更多的回旋余地以决定自身是否想少风险或更多的资本。
en: Hensarling’s off-ramp proposal builds on that tradeoff, giving banks more leeway to decide whether they want less risk or more capital.

zh: 基础的监管将会是两个手段的典型混合物，但个别银行可能会选择更高的基本要求以换取参与高风险投资和运营的许可。
en: Baseline regulation would be the typical mixture of the two, but individual banks could opt for substantially higher capital requirements in exchange for permission to engage in riskier investments and operations.

zh: 换句话说，它们可以通过提高一种调控手段的约束来换取另一种调控手段的松绑。
en: In other words, they could reduce the constraints of one regulatory measure in exchange for tightening those of the other.

zh: 这在概念上是合理的。
en: This is conceptually sound.

zh: 但亨萨林对其提议的阐述中存在一些问题，而且问题还不小。
en: But there are problems with Hensarling’s proposal as he has articulated it. And they are not small.

zh: 第一，亨萨林提案将对那些“匝道”选项银行的资本比例要求太低，只相当于总资产的10 ％ 。
en: First, the ratio of capital that Hensarling would require of banks that take an off-ramp is far too low, at 10% of total assets.

zh: 这虽然高于当前的水平，但并未高到足以保证银行的安全性。
en: That is higher than current levels, but not high enough to ensure bank safety.

zh: 金融稳定委员会和国际货币基金组织都各自意识到，许多遭到2007~2008年金融危机威胁的银行都需要比当前水平多一倍的资本金才能全身而退。
en: The Financial Stability Board and the International Monetary Fund each found that many banks threatened during the financial crisis of 2007 and 2008 would have needed double today’s levels of capital to survive intact.

zh: 而如果要推行亨萨林提案的话，由于对风险的规管有所降低，这一资本金水平必须更高。
en: Were the Hensarling proposal to be implemented, those levels would have to be even higher, owing to the reduction in risk regulation.

zh: 只有当资本金比率被大幅提高 — — 达到“震慑”的水平 — — 那些银行高管才会意识到在放宽监管指令的情况下，承担过度风险是不符合银行自身或其股东利益的。
en: Only if capital were increased substantially – to “shock and awe” levels – would the banks and their executives conclude, without regulatory instruction, that it is not in their or their stockholders’ interest to take on much risk.

zh: 亨萨林提案的第二个问题是，只要企业所得税政策不变，银行都会拒绝这一做法。
en: A second problem with Hensarling’s proposal is that banks are likely to reject it as long as corporate tax policy remains unchanged.

zh: 正如我在从前的评论文章以及近期与迈克尔·托奇（Michael Troege）合作发表的学术论文中所指出的那样，要求银行保留更多的资本金会导致它们的收税金额上升，因为它降低了可以用来抵税的债务水平，增加了应纳税的股权。
en: As I have argued in previous commentaries, and in a recent academic paper written with Michael Troege, requiring banks to have more capital raises their tax bill, because it reduces the level of tax-deductible debt and increases that of taxable equity.

zh: 如果税法不改革，很少有银行会觉得权衡政策有吸引力，因为较高的税收将抵消采取采纳亨萨林提案的回报。
en: If the tax code is not reformed, few banks will find the tradeoff attractive, because a higher tax bill will cancel out returns from taking Hensarling’s offer.

zh: 第三个问题是个逻辑问题：亨萨林方案将硬性规定那些选择走监管“匝道”的银行应该达到哪些标准参数并将其写入法律，从而束缚了监管机构的手脚。
en: The third problem is one of logistics: Hensarling’s plan would hardwire into legislation the parameters for banks to take a regulatory off-ramp, thus tying regulators’ hands.

zh: 一旦银行达到了10％的资本金，监管机构既无法阻止其实施关键性兼并行动，也不能将其定义为具备系统重要性和风险的机构。
en: Once a bank had the 10% capital, it could neither be stopped from key mergers nor be determined to be systemically important and risky.

zh: 由于金融环境变化极快，那些比国会更能适应新环境的监管者应拥有自由裁量权去设定资本金要求和贷款风险的权衡标准。
en: Because financial circumstances change quickly, regulators, who can adapt to new conditions faster than Congress can, should have discretion to set capital-requirement and loan-risk tradeoff benchmarks.

zh: 但在亨萨林方案中，它们无法这样做。
en: Under Hensarling’s plan, they would not.

zh: 更凶险的是，在废除大部分的多德 - 弗兰克法案风险监管之后，亨萨林方案将几乎完全消除了银行选择“匝道”的激励因素。
en: More insidious, by repealing much of the Dodd-Frank risk regulation, the Hensarling proposal would virtually eliminate banks’ incentive to choose the off-ramp.

zh: 不会有足够的监管措施让他们觉得有必要选择另一条道路。
en: There wouldn’t be enough regulation for them to feel the need to escape.

zh: 于是乎银行可以鱼和熊掌兼得。
en: Banks could thus have their cake and eat it.

zh: 尽管存在上述问题，但监管机构应该感谢亨萨林提出了一个灵活框架权衡的概念。
en: Despite all of this, regulators should thank Hensarling for pushing forward the concept of a flexible tradeoff framework.

zh: 虽然这一提案的具体细节有待商榷，但至少这一概念具有真正的潜力。
en: While the details of his particular proposal are problematic, to say the least, the concept has real potential.

zh: 可能可能催生一个更具活力 — — 也更安全的 — — 金融体系。
en: The result could be a more dynamic financial system – and also a safer one.

zh: 经济制裁能管用吗？
en: Do Economic Sanctions Work?

zh: 美国剑桥—新闻频频报道西方对俄罗斯、伊朗和古巴实施经济制裁，这是个盘点这些措施效果如何的良机。
en: CAMBRIDGE – With Western economic sanctions against Russia, Iran, and Cuba in the news, it is a good time to take stock of the debate on just how well such measures work.

zh: 简单的回答是经济制裁通常只有十分有限的效果，即便它们可能是表现道德决心的重要方法。
en: The short answer is that economic sanctions usually have only modest effects, even if they can be an essential means of demonstrating moral resolve.

zh: 如果经济制裁要在二十一世纪扮演重要的治国角色，我们就必须认真想一想它们在过去表现如何。
en: If economic sanctions are to play an increasingly important role in twenty-first-century statecraft, it might be worth reflecting on how they have worked in the past.

zh: 加里·哈夫鲍尔（Gary Hufbauer）和杰弗里·肖特（Jeffrey Schott）在他们关于这一话题的经典著作中指出，经济制裁至少可以追溯到公元前432年希腊政治家和军事家伯里克利颁布了所谓的“迈加拉法令 ” （ Megarian decree）以处理三名阿斯帕齐娅妇女被绑架事件。
en: As Gary Hufbauer and Jeffrey Schott note in their classic book on the topic, the history of economic sanctions goes back at least to 432 BC, when the Greek statesman and general Pericles issued the so-called “Megarian decree” in response to the abduction of three Aspasian women.

zh: 在现代，美国利用经济制裁追求各种目标，比如20世纪79年代卡特政府用它来推进人权、20世纪80年代用它来阻止核扩散等。
en: In modern times, the United States has employed economic sanctions in pursuit of diverse goals, from the Carter administration’s efforts in the 1970s to promote human rights, to attempts to impede nuclear proliferation in the 1980s.

zh: 在冷战时期，美国也利用经济制裁动摇不友善国家，特别是拉丁美洲国家，尽管制裁效果往往并不怎么样，即使在政权最终发生更迭的国家也是如此。
en: During the Cold War, the US also employed economic sanctions to destabilize unfriendly governments, especially in Latin America, though they do not appear to have played more than a minor role, even where regime change eventually occurred.

zh: 20世纪90年代初对塞尔维亚的经济制裁并未威慑其对波斯尼亚的入侵。
en: Economic sanctions on Serbia in the early 1990s did not deter the invasion of Bosnia.

zh: 显然，美国政府对国际象棋传奇鲍比·费舍尔（Bobby Fischer）的象征性惩罚（因为它在贝尔格莱德参加比赛，违反了制裁规定）并没有给被包围的萨拉热窝带来多少喘息。
en: Certainly, the US government’s symbolic punishment of chess legend Bobby Fischer (for playing a match in Belgrade that violated sanctions) provided no relief for the besieged city of Sarajevo.

zh: 旧苏联也玩制裁游戏 — — 比如针对中国、阿尔巴尼亚和南斯拉夫。
en: The old Soviet Union played the sanctions game as well – for example, against China, Albania, and Yugoslavia.

zh: 苏联的制裁也没有多少成功，不过也许芬兰是个例外，它最终做了政策屈服，以换取苏联放松1958年实施的制裁。
en: It, too, did not have much success, except perhaps in the case of Finland, which ultimately bent its policies to gain relief from sanctions imposed in 1958.

zh: 大部分现代制裁往往是大国和小国的对立，但也有一些例子发生在对等国家之间，比如20世纪50年代至80年代英国和西班牙因为直布罗陀的反目。
en: Most modern cases of sanctions pit a large country against a small country, though there are a few cases involving countries of equal size, such as the long quarrel, from the 1950s to the 1980s, between the United Kingdom and Spain over Gibraltar.

zh: 哈夫鲍尔和肖特以及其他人指出，制裁的效果往往十分令人失望 — — 许多学者甚至推论说，实施制裁的原因常常是政府为了向国内群众表明它“正在做些什么 ” 。
en: As Hufbauer and Schott, among others, have illustrated, the effects of sanctions are often fairly disappointing – so much so that many scholars have concluded that such measures often are imposed so that governments can appear to domestic audiences to be “doing something.”

zh: 显然，美国队古巴的严厉制裁并没有导致卡斯特罗政权倒闭；事实上，奥巴马总统转而与古巴重建完全外交关系倒有可能效果更好。
en: Certainly, severe US sanctions on Cuba failed to bring the Castro regime to heel; indeed, President Barack Obama’s move to reestablish full diplomatic relations may have more effect.

zh: 但有时制裁确实管用。
en: But sometimes sanctions do work.

zh: 20世纪80年代所形成的对南非实施制裁的强大国际共识最终帮助结束了种族隔离。
en: The strong international consensus to impose sanctions on South Africa in the 1980s eventually helped bring an end to apartheid.

zh: 类似地，制裁还让伊朗重回谈判桌，尽管伊朗政府愿意将其核野心延缓多久还不得而知。
en: Likewise, sanctions have helped bring Iran to the bargaining table, though it is not clear how long its government will be willing to defer its nuclear ambitions.

zh: 而如今，俄罗斯经济也陷入��巨大的麻烦 — — 虽然这也许只是天上掉下来的馅饼，真正的伤害是全球油价大崩盘带来的。
en: And the Russian economy today is in big trouble, though this might be described as a lucky punch, with the real damage being done by an epic collapse in global oil prices.

zh: 油价崩盘极大地打击了俄罗斯政府收入，一些俄罗斯人声称是美国和沙特合谋要让俄罗斯就范。
en: Some in Russia, where the price collapse has hit government revenues hard, claim that the US and Saudi Arabia are conspiring to bring Russia to its knees.

zh: 但这实在是太抬举美国战略家了。
en: But that gives US strategists far too much credit.

zh: 油价暴跌更有可能的元凶是美国页岩能革命和中国增长急剧放缓的共同作用。
en: A more likely culprit for the steep price decline is a combination of the shale-energy revolution in the US and the sharp slowdown in Chinese growth.

zh: 中国的放缓可以解释大宗商品价格的普遍下跌，阿根廷和巴西等与美国当局没什么矛盾的国家也遭受了打击。
en: China’s slowdown has helped precipitate a broad-based fall in commodity prices that is having a devastating effect on countries like Argentina and Brazil, with which the US authorities presumably have little quarrel.

zh: 过去经济制裁收效甚微的一个主要原因是并非所有国家都遵守制裁规则。
en: One of the major reasons economic sanctions have fallen short in the past is that not all countries have complied.

zh: 事实上，实施国国内观点的巨大差异也常常破坏制裁。
en: Indeed, significant differences of domestic opinion in the imposing country often undermine sanctions as well.

zh: 此外，制裁实施国不许准备好解决其自身的弱点。
en: Moreover, countries imposing sanctions must be prepared to address their own vulnerabilities.

zh: 朝鲜也许是当今世界最邪恶的政权，我们都希望其野蛮的政府早日倒台。
en: North Korea is perhaps the most noxious regime in the world today, and one can only hope that its cruel government collapses sometime soon.

zh: 金氏政权经历严厉经济制裁而屹立不倒，也许是因为中国害怕国界另一边出现一个统一的朝鲜而不愿撤回对朝支持。
en: The Kim regime has clung to power despite being subject to severe economic sanctions, perhaps because China, fearing a united Korea on its border, has not yet been willing to withdraw its support.

zh: 但是我们很容易忘记国际关系中存在不同观点，即使是在最极端的情形也是如此。
en: Yet it is easy to forget that there are different viewpoints in international relations, even in the most extreme situations.

zh: 尽管朝鲜被控入侵索尼影业公司电脑并受到指责（理应如此 ） ， 但必须承认，从朝鲜精英的角度讲，他们的国家只是在以与其他任何人一样的方式运用经济关系。
en: Though North Korea’s alleged attack on Sony Pictures’ computers has been rightly condemned, it must be admitted that from the perspective of the North Korean elite, their country simply applied economic retaliation much like anyone else does.

zh: 索尼影业拿朝鲜领袖 、 “ 小将军”金正恩开涮。
en: Sony Pictures had produced a satire poking fun at North Korea’s leader, the “Young General” Kim Jong-un.

zh: 这是令人无法容忍的冒犯，朝鲜精英的反应是经济破坏而非军事行动。
en: This was an intolerable affront, to which the elite responded with economic sabotage rather than military action.

zh: 我们也不要忘了，俄罗斯也使用网络袭击为其外交政策服务。
en: Let us also not forget that Russia, too, has deployed cyber attacks in the service of foreign-policy goals.

zh: 事实上，俄罗斯黑客比朝鲜厉害多了（尽管许多顶尖人才都加入了黑帮而不再战略部门供职 ） 。
en: Indeed, Russia has far more formidable hackers than North Korea (though much of the top talent currently is employed in mafia rings, rather than in strategic operations).

zh: 当今世界，核扩散以使全球性常规战争不再具有现实可能性，经济制裁和经济破坏也许将在二十一世纪地缘政治中扮演重要角色。
en: In a world where nuclear proliferation has rendered global conventional war unthinkable, economic sanctions and sabotage are likely to play a large role in twenty-first-century geopolitics.

zh: 古希腊伯里克利的制裁并没有阻止冲突，反而最终引发了伯罗奔尼撒战争。
en: Rather than preventing conflict, Pericles’s sanctions in ancient Greece ultimately helped to trigger the Peloponnesian War.

zh: 我们只能希望，在二十一世纪，更聪明的头脑可以胜出，经济制裁将带来谈判而非暴力。
en: One can only hope that in this century, wiser heads will prevail, and that economic sanctions lead to bargaining, not violence.

zh: 有什么是重要的吗？
en: Does Anything Matter?

zh: 发自牛津 — — 道德判断有对错之分吗？
en: OXFORD – Can moral judgments be true or false?

zh: 或者说，伦理根本只是一种任由个人选择的纯粹主观事物？ 又或者，伦理可能取决于个人身处社会的文化状况？
en: Or is ethics, at bottom, a purely subjective matter, for individuals to choose, or perhaps relative to the culture of the society in which one lives?

zh: 对于这些问题，我们可能刚刚才找到答案。
en: We might have just found out the answer.

zh: 在哲学圈里，那种认为道德判断包含了客观真理的观点早在1930年就被宣布为过时了，因为逻辑实证主义者认为似乎没有任何方法能证实道德判断的真实性，而这种判断只不过是我们自身感受和态度的一种表述罢了。
en: Among philosophers, the view that moral judgments state objective truths has been out of fashion since the 1930’s, when logical positivists asserted that, because there seems to be no way of verifying the truth of moral judgments, they cannot be anything other than expressions of our feelings or attitudes.

zh: 比如当我们说“你不应该打那小孩 ” ， 我们所做的仅仅是表达了对你打小孩行为的不认同，或者是鼓励你不要打他，至于你打孩子究竟是对是错，则并无真理可言。
en: So, for example, when we say, “You ought not to hit that child,” all we are really doing is expressing our disapproval of your hitting the child, or encouraging you to stop hitting the child. There is no truth to the matter of whether or not it is wrong for you to hit the child.

zh: 尽管这种伦理观点经常受到挑战，但大部分反对意见都来自于那些只会引用神谕的宗教思想家，因此在高度世俗化的西方哲学里没什么市场。
en: Although this view of ethics has often been challenged, many of the objections have come from religious thinkers who appealed to God’s commands. Such arguments have limited appeal in the largely secular world of Western philosophy.

zh: 另一种对客观真理的辩护观点并未诉诸于宗教，但在反对流行哲学观点方面也没有太大进展。
en: Other defenses of objective truth in ethics made no appeal to religion, but could make little headway against the prevailing philosophical mood.

zh: 但在上个月哲学界发生了一件大事：德里克·帕菲特那让人期待已久的新书《论最重要的》出版了。
en: Last month, however, saw a major philosophical event: the publication of Derek Parfit’s long-awaited book On What Matters.

zh: 这位牛津万灵学院的名誉研究员在此之前只出版过一部著作《理与人 》 ， 1984年发行，好评如潮。
en: Until now, Parfit, who is Emeritus Fellow of All Souls College, Oxford, had written only one book, Reasons and Persons, which appeared in 1984, to great acclaim.

zh: 帕菲特在书中所持有的全套世俗主义观点，以及他在应对矛盾立场时所使用的综合性方法，在过去几十年来首次使那些反对伦理客观性的人陷入了被动。
en: Parfit’s entirely secular arguments, and the comprehensive way in which he tackles alternative positions, have, for the first time in decades, put those who reject objectivism in ethics on the defensive.

zh: 《论最重要的》可谓是一部鸿篇巨著：上下两册共1400页尽是密密麻麻的推理论证。
en: On What Matters is a book of daunting length: two large volumes, totaling more than 1,400 pages, of densely argued text.

zh: 但整本书的核心观点在前400页里就给出了，这对那些充满求知欲的人来说不算是个难以应付的挑战 — — 特别是帕菲特受过英语哲学优良传统的熏陶，总是尽力把书写得清晰明了，从不像那些肤浅的哲学家那样使用一些模糊不清的词语。
en: But the core of the argument comes in the first 400 pages, which is not an insurmountable challenge for the intellectually curious – particularly given that Parfit, in the best tradition of English-language philosophy, always strives for lucidity, never using obscure words where simple ones will do.

zh: 书中遣字造句言简意赅，观点鲜明，作者还经常使用生动的例子来阐明其观点。
en: Each sentence is straightforward, the argument is clear, and Parfit often uses vivid examples to make his points.

zh: 因此对于那些与其是想了解“什么是最重要的 ” ， 不如说是想从客观角度了解“是否有任何事物真的可以成为重要”的读者来说，该书堪称一场思维的盛宴。
en: Thus, the book is an intellectual treat for anyone who wants to understand not so much “what matters” as whether anything really can matter, in an objective sense.

zh: 许多人都认为理性都只是工具性的：推理仅告诉我们怎样得到想要的东西，但我们的基本需要和欲望是不在推理的能力范围之内的。
en: Many people assume that rationality is always instrumental: reason can tell us only how to get what we want, but our basic wants and desires are beyond the scope of reasoning.

zh: 但帕菲特指出这种想法是错的。
en: Not so, Parfit argues.

zh: 无论一个人现在是否关心（或决定）是否要在未来某个时刻遭受痛苦，但正如人们能够把握住1+1=2的真理那样，因此人们也可以看到“我有理由在未来某个时刻避免遭受痛苦 ” 。
en: Just as we can grasp the truth that 1 + 1 = 2, so we can see that I have a reason to avoid suffering agony at some future time, regardless of whether I now care about, or have desires about, whether I will suffer agony at that time.

zh: 而我们也同样有理由让其他人免遭痛苦（尽管不一定有充分的理由 ） 。
en: We can also have reasons (though not always conclusive reasons) to prevent others from suffering agony.

zh: 这种自证的规范性真理成为了帕菲特为伦理客观性辩护的基础。
en: Such self-evident normative truths provide the basis for Parfit’s defense of objectivity in ethics.

zh: 反对伦理客观性的一个重要论点是人们在是非判断上存在着重要的分歧，而这种分歧又延伸到了无法用愚昧或困惑的标准来判断的哲学家身上。
en: One major argument against objectivism in ethics is that people disagree deeply about right and wrong, and this disagreement extends to philosophers who cannot be accused of being ignorant or confused.

zh: 倘若如康德和边沁这样的伟大哲学家就我们应该做什么的问题发生了分歧，那么对这个问题真的存在一个客观的答案吗？
en: If great thinkers like Immanuel Kant and Jeremy Bentham disagree about what we ought to do, can there really be an objectively true answer to that question?

zh: 帕菲特对这种观点的反对使他得出了一个可能比反对伦理客观性更为大胆的观点。
en: Parfit’s response to this line of argument leads him to make a claim that is perhaps even bolder than his defense of objectivism in ethics.

zh: 他考察了三种关于我们该做什么的主流理论 — — 一种源自康德，一种源自霍布斯，洛克，卢梭以及当代哲学家罗尔斯和斯坎隆的社会契约传统，还有一种源自边沁的功利主义 — — 并指出康德主义和社会契约理论必须经过修正方能成立。
en: He considers three leading theories about what we ought to do – one deriving from Kant, one from the social-contract tradition of Hobbes, Locke, Rousseau, and the contemporary philosophers John Rawls and T.M. Scanlon, and one from Bentham’s utilitarianism – and argues that the Kantian and social-contract theories must be revised in order to be defensible.

zh: 随后，他指出这些修正后的理论是与后果论（一种与功利主义同属一个庞大体系的理论）的一种特殊形式相一致的。
en: Then he argues that these revised theories coincide with a particular form of consequentialism, which is a theory in the same broad family as utilitarianism.

zh: 如果帕菲特是对的，那么各种表面上互相冲突��道德理论之间的分歧要比我们想象的要少。
en: If Parfit is right, there is much less disagreement between apparently conflicting moral theories than we all thought.

zh: 而各种理论的支持者，用帕菲特生动的话来说，其实是“在从不同的路上攀登着同一座山 ” 。
en: The defenders of each of these theories are, in Parfit’s vivid phrase, “climbing the same mountain on different sides.”

zh: 而如果读者阅读《论最重要的》一书是为了找到答案来回答书名所提出的问题，那么他们可能要失望了。
en: Readers who go to On What Matters seeking an answer to the question posed by its title might be disappointed.

zh: 帕菲特的真正用意在于抨击主观主义和虚无主义。
en: Parfit’s real interest is in combating subjectivism and nihilism.

zh: 除非能够证明客观主义是正确的，否则在他看来就根本没有什么是重要的。
en: Unless he can show that objectivism is true, he believes, nothing matters.

zh: 当帕菲特真正面对“什么是重要的”这一问题时，他的答案可能会浅显得让人感到意外。
en: When Parfit does come to the question of “what matters,” his answer might seem surprisingly obvious.

zh: 比如说，他告诉我们，现在最重要的是“我们那些富人减少些奢侈生活方式，不要再让气候变暖，用其他方式来爱护我们的星球，使其能继续养育我们这些智慧生物。 ”
en: He tells us, for example, that what matters most now is that “we rich people give up some of our luxuries, ceasing to overheat the Earth’s atmosphere, and taking care of this planet in other ways, so that it continues to support intelligent life.”

zh: 或许我们中的许多人早已得出了这样的结论。
en: Many of us had already reached that conclusion.

zh: 而我们从帕菲特的书中所汲取的，则是把这个结论以及其他道德命题作为客观真理来捍卫的可能性。
en: What we gain from Parfit’s work is the possibility of defending these and other moral claims as objective truths.

zh: 紧缩能推动经济增长吗？
en: Does Austerity Promote Economic Growth?

zh: 发自纽黑文 — — 荷兰出生的英国哲学家兼讽刺作家伯纳德·曼德维尔在其1724年出版的经典名著《蜜蜂的寓言：私人的恶德，公众的利益》中用一首长诗来描述一个原本繁荣，却突然选择以节俭为美，放弃一切额外支出和奢侈消费的（蜜蜂）社会，诗文如下：
en: NEW HAVEN – In his classic Fable of the Bees: or, Private Vices, Publick Benefits(1724), Bernard Mandeville, the Dutch-born British philosopher and satirist, described – in verse – a prosperous society (of bees) that suddenly chose to make a virtue of austerity, dropping all excess expenditure and extravagant consumption. What then happened?

zh: 地价房价骤跌；
en: The Price of Land and Houses falls;

zh: 那些为享乐而建的，壮丽宫殿，
en: Mirac’lous Palaces, whose Walls,

zh: 那些底比斯式的，雕梁斗拱，
en: Like those of Thebes, were rais’d by Play

zh: 都要转手 ； … …
en: Are to be let; . . . .

zh: 建筑行业尽毁
en: The building Trade is quite destroy’d

zh: 营造者们也失了业 ； … …
en: Artificers are not employ’d; . . .

zh: 那些幸存者们，变得克己而勤奋
en: Those, that remain’d, grown temp’rate strive

zh: 不为消费，只为生存 … …
en: Not how to spend, but how to live . . .

zh: 在金融危机的影响下许多发达国家都启动了紧缩政策，而这首诗的内容听上去也与它们的近况极为相似 — — 莫非曼德维尔才是预言我们这个时代的真正先知？
en: That sounds a lot like what many advanced countries have been going through, after financial-crisis-induced austerity plans were launched, doesn’t it? Is Mandeville a genuine prophet for our times?

zh: 《蜜蜂的寓言》从出版至今依然拥有一大批追随者并引发了大量的争论。
en: Fable of the Bees developed a wide following, and generated substantial controversy, which continues to this day.

zh: 而欧洲大部分国家以及其他地区国家的政府所采用的紧缩政策以及个人消费支出的缩减，都可能导致一场全球性衰退。
en: The austerity plans being adopted by governments in much of Europe and elsewhere around the world, and the curtailment of consumption expenditure by individuals as well, threaten to produce a global recession.

zh: 但我们怎么知道曼德维尔对于紧缩的判断是对的？
en: But how do we know if Mandeville is right about austerity?

zh: 他的研究方法 — — 一首阐述自身理论的长诗 — — 往往难以令当今的人们信服。
en: His research method – a long poem about his theory – is hardly convincing to modern ears.

zh: 哈佛大学经济学家阿尔伯托·阿里辛纳（Alberto Alesina）最近总结了一些关于政府赤字缩减政策 — — 即支出缩减和/或加税 — — 会否导致这类负面效应的证据 ： “ 对这个问题的答案是一个大大的‘不’字。
en: Harvard economist Alberto Alesina recently summarized evidence concerning whether government deficit reduction – that is, expenditure cuts and/or tax increases – always induces such negative effects: “The answer to this question is a loud no.”

zh: ”有时（甚至是经常性的 ） ， 经济会在政府大幅减少赤字后蓬勃发展；有时（但只在有可能的情况下 ） ， 紧缩政策能以上述手段提振信心并激发复苏。
en: Sometimes, even often, economies prosper nicely after the government’s deficit is sharply reduced. Sometimes, just maybe, the austerity program boosts confidence in such a way as to ignite a recovery.

zh: 我们必须谨慎地研究这个问题，并意识到曼德维尔所提到的状况实际上是一个统计学上的现象：你永远无法全面预测政府紧缩政策的结果，因此我们只能询问这么一个计划成功推动经济复苏的可能性究竟有多大。
en: We have to examine the issue with some care, understanding that the issue that Mandeville raised is really a statistical one: the outcome of government deficit reduction is never entirely predictable, so we can ask only how likely such a plan is to succeed in restoring economic prosperity.

zh: 而其中最重要的问题则是解释可能存在的逆向因果关系。
en: And the biggest problem here is accounting for possible reverse causality.

zh: 比如说，如果某些与未来经济相关的证据使某国政府担心可能出现经济过热和通胀，它可能会尝试通过加税和降低政府支出来为国内需求降温。
en: For example, if evidence of future economic strength makes a government worry about economic overheating and inflation, it might try to cool domestic demand by raising taxes and lowering government spending.

zh: 即便这些防止过热措施只取得了部分成功，但在普通旁观者眼里，这些紧缩政策似乎��经实质上增强了经济。
en: If the government is only partly successful in preventing economic overheating, it might nonetheless appear to casual observers that austerity actually strengthened the economy.

zh: 同样，政府的赤字不仅会因紧缩而下降，也可能是因为股票市场对经济增长的预期带来了更多资本利得税收入。
en: Likewise, the government’s deficit might fall not because of austerity, but because the stock market’s anticipation of economic growth fuels higher revenues from capital-gains tax.

zh: 这一次我们可能也会从政府赤字的角度，认为是紧缩实现了繁荣。
en: Once again, we would see what might appear, from looking at the government deficit, to be an austerity-to-prosperity scenario.

zh: 而国际货币基金组织的贾米·瓜加尔多（Jaime Guajardo ） ， 丹尼尔·利（Daniel Leigh）和安德烈·佩斯卡托利（Andrea Pescatori）最近研究了过去30年内17国政府所采取的紧缩政策。
en: Jaime Guajardo, Daniel Leigh, and Andrea Pescatori of the International Monetary Fund recently studied austerity plans implemented by governments in 17 countries in the last 30 years. But their approach differed from that of previous researchers.

zh: 他们把焦点放在政府的动机之上，并研究政府官员们的言论，而不仅仅是公共债务的模式。
en: They focused on the government’s intent, and looked at what officials actually said, not just at the pattern of public debt.

zh: 他们研读预算报告，检讨金融稳定政策，甚至观看那些政府高官的新闻采访。
en: They read budget speeches, reviewed stability programs, and even watched news interviews with government figures.

zh: 在他们的定义中，紧缩政策是那些政府将加税或者削减支出视为一个将产生潜在长期收益的明智政策，而不是对短期经济预测的回应或者尝试减少经济过热的风险。
en: They identified as austerity plans only those cases in which governments imposed tax hikes or spending cuts because they viewed it as a prudent policy with potential long-term benefits, not because they were responding to the short-term economic outlook and sought to reduce the risk of overheating.

zh: 他们的研究发现紧缩政策具有减少消费支出并削弱经济的明显趋势。
en: Their analysis found a clear tendency for austerity programs to reduce consumption expenditure and weaken the economy.

zh: 这个结论如果是正确的话，那么政策制定者们就要小心了。
en: That conclusion, if valid, stands as a stern warning to policymakers today.

zh: 但包括加州大学圣地亚哥分校经济学教授维拉莉尔·拉梅（Valerie Ramey）在内的批评者则认为上述论证并不完整。
en: But critics, such as Valerie Ramey of the University of California at San Diego, think that Guajardo, Leigh, and Pescatori have not completely proven their case.

zh: 拉梅认为上述研究结果可能只是反映了一个不同形式的逆向因果关系，因为政府之所以更可能用紧缩政策来应对高公共负债水平，就是因为它有理由相信经济状况将令债务负担特别令人忧虑。
en: It is possible, Ramey argues, that their results could reflect a different sort of reverse causality if governments are more likely to respond to high public-debt levels with austerity programs when they have reason to believe that economic conditions could make the debt burden especially worrisome.

zh: 但这看上去似乎不太可能 — — 有人会认为一个悲观的经济预测将促使政府推迟（而不是加速）紧缩措施。
en: That may seem unlikely – one would think that a bad economic outlook would incline governments to postpone, rather than accelerate, austerity measures.

zh: 同时为了回应她的评论，三位作者也确实尝试对紧缩计划推出时市场对政府债务问题严重性的预期进行了评估，并发现了类似的结果。
en: And, in response to her comments, the authors did try to account for the severity of the government’s debt problem as perceived by the markets at the time that the plans were implemented, finding very similar results.

zh: 当然拉梅也可能是对的。
en: But Ramey could be right.

zh: 但即便顺推这一因果关系，人们可能也会发现政府支出削减或者加税之后会经历一段不景气时期。
en: One would then find that government spending cuts or tax hikes tend to be followed by bad economic times, even if the causality runs the other way.

zh: 最终，评判紧缩政策的问题在于经济学家无法运行一个完全受控实验。
en: Ultimately, the problem of judging austerity programs is that economists cannot run fully controlled experiments.

zh: 比如研究者们测试百忧解（一种抗抑郁药物）的时候，他们可以把被试者随机分为控制组和实验组并反复测试。
en: When researchers tested Prozac on depressed patients, they divided their subjects randomly into control and experimental groups, and conducted many trials.

zh: 而在国家债务问题上显然是无法做到这一点的。
en: We cannot do that with national debt.

zh: 因此我们是否就可以认为那些历史分析并无教益？
en: So do we have to conclude that historical analysis teaches us no useful lessons?

zh: 我们是否应该回到曼德维尔及其某些继承者（包括凯恩斯）的抽象推理方式，认为有理由去预期紧缩政策将导致衰退？
en: Do we have to return to the abstract reasoning of Mandeville and some of his successors, including John Maynard Keynes, who thought that there were reasons to expect that austerity would produce depressions?

zh: 没有抽象理论能预测人们究竟将如何对一项紧缩政策做出反应。
en: There is no abstract theory that can predict how people will react to an austerity program.

zh: 我们没有选择，只能回顾那些历史证据。
en: We have no alternative but to look at the historical evidence.

zh: 而贾米·瓜加尔多及其同僚所发现的证据也确实显示政府深思熟虑后出台的紧缩政策后面往往会伴随一段不景气时期。
en: And the evidence of Guajardo and his co-authors does show that deliberate government decisions to adopt austerity programs have tended to be followed by hard times.

zh: 政策制定者们不可能有几十年去等待经济学家们找出一个确定的答案 — — 而这个答案甚至永远都无法得出。
en: Policymakers cannot afford to wait decades for economists to figure out a definitive answer, which may never be found at all.

zh: 但根据我们目前的证据来判断的话，欧洲以及其他地区的紧缩政策似乎将带来令人失望的结果。
en: But, judging by the evidence that we have, austerity programs in Europe and elsewhere appear likely to yield disappointing results.

zh: 资本主义导致贫困？
en: Does Capitalism Cause Poverty?

zh: 美国剑桥—如今，资本主义被人认为是诸多问题的罪魁：贫困、不平等、失业，甚至全球变暖。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Capitalism gets blamed for many things nowadays: poverty, inequality, unemployment, even global warming.

zh: 教皇方济各最近在玻利维亚的演讲中说 ： “ 这个制度现在已经令人无法容忍：农业工人无法容忍、劳工无法容忍、共产主义者无法容忍、各民族无法容忍。
en: As Pope Francis said in a recent speech in Bolivia: “This system is by now intolerable: farm workers find it intolerable, laborers find it intolerable, communities find it intolerable, peoples find it intolerable.

zh: 地球本身 — — 用圣方济各的话说，我们的姐妹大地（Mother Earth ） — —也无法容忍。 ”
en: The earth itself – our sister, Mother Earth, as Saint Francis would say – also finds it intolerable.”

zh: 但让方济各感到如此不安的问题是他所谓的“放肆的资本主义”的结果吗？
en: But are the problems that upset Francis the consequence of what he called “unbridled capitalism”?

zh: 或者，它们是资本主义令人意外地没有完成人们所期待的使命所造成的吗？
en: Or are they instead caused by capitalism’s surprising failure to do what was expected of it?

zh: 旨在推进社会正义的日程应该基于控制资本主义还是消除制约资本主义扩张的壁垒？
en: Should an agenda to advance social justice be based on bridling capitalism or on eliminating the barriers that thwart its expansion?

zh: 拉丁美洲、非洲、中东和亚洲的答案显然是后者。
en: The answer in Latin America, Africa, the Middle East, and Asia is obviously the latter.

zh: 要明白这一点，回忆一下马克思所构想的未来是很有裨益的。
en: To see this, it is useful to recall how Karl Marx imagined the future.

zh: 对马克思来说，资本主义的历史作用是再组织生产。
en: For Marx, the historic role of capitalism was to reorganize production.

zh: 家庭农场、手工作坊 、 “ 店主的国度 ” （ 据说拿破仑曾经带着鄙夷如此称呼英国）都将 一去不返。
en: Gone would be the family farms, artisan yards, and the “nation of shopkeepers,” as Napoleon is alleged to have scornfully referred to Britain.

zh: 所有这些小资产阶级活动都会被类似于今天的Zara、丰田、空中客车和沃尔玛等大机构颠覆。
en: All these petty bourgeois activities would be plowed over by the equivalent of today’s Zara, Toyota, Airbus, or Walmart.

zh: 因此，生产方式将不再像家庭农场或手工作坊那样由做工作的人所有，而是由“资本”所有。
en: As a result, the means of production would no longer be owned by those doing the work, as on the family farm or in the craftsman’s workshop, but by “capital.”

zh: 工人只拥有自身的劳动，并被迫用劳动换取可怜的工资。
en: Workers would possess only their own labor, which they would be forced to exchange for a miserable wage.

zh: 尽管如此，他们仍将比“失业的后备军”更加富有。 由闲置劳动力组成的“失业的后备军”规模足够大，足以让他们害怕失去工作；又足够小，不会浪费让他们工作所能榨取的剩余价值。
en: Nonetheless, they would be more fortunate than the “reserve army of the unemployed” – a pool of idle labor large enough to make others fear losing their job, but small enough not to waste the surplus value that could be extracted by making them work.

zh: 从前所有的社会阶级都会转变为工作阶级，所有的生产方式都集中在不断减少的“资本”所有者群体手中，在这种情况下，无产阶级革命将给人类带来完美正义的世界：用马克思的名言，就是 “各尽所能，按需分配 ” 。
en: With all previous social classes transformed into the working class, and all means of production in the hands of an ever-dwindling group of owners of “capital,” a proletarian revolution would lead humanity to a world of perfect justice: “From each according to his ability, to each according to his needs,” as Marx famously put it.

zh: 显然，诗人兼哲学家保罗·瓦勒里（Paul Valéry）是正确的 ： “ 未来和其他所有东西一样，不再会与昨日相同。
en: Clearly, the poet and philosopher Paul Valéry was right: “The future, like everything else, is no longer what it used to be.”

zh: ”但我们不应该哂笑马克思的著名的错误预言。
en: But we should not make fun of Marx’s well-known prediction error.

zh: 毕竟，物理学家尼尔斯·玻尔（Niels Bohr）讽刺性地指出 ： “ 预言是困难的，特别是对未来的预言。 ”
en: After all, as the physicist Niels Bohr wryly noted, “Prediction is difficult, especially about the future.”

zh: 现在我们知道 ， 《 共产党宣言》墨迹未干，而欧洲和美国的工资便开始了长达160年的增长，让工人跻身中产阶级，拥有汽车、按揭、退休金和小资产阶级情调。
en: We now know that as the ink was drying on the Communist Manifesto, wages in Europe and the United States were beginning a 160-year-long rise, making workers part of the middle class, with cars, mortgages, pensions, and petty bourgeois concerns.

zh: 今天的政客承诺创造就业机会 — — 或者更多的供资本剥削的机会 — — 而不接收生产方式。
en: Politicians today promise to create jobs – or more opportunities to be exploited by capital – not to take over the means of production.

zh: 资本主义之所以能够实现这一转变，是因为生产的再组织让生产率得以前所未有地提高。
en: Capitalism could achieve this transformation because the reorganization of production allowed for an unprecedented increase in productivity.

zh: 在1776年就被亚当·斯密预见为增长引擎的企业内部的劳动分工实现了个体之间的知识分工，使整体知识能够大于各部分之和，并形成了不断增长的交换与合作的网络。
en: The division of labor within and across firms, which Adam Smith had already envisioned in 1776 as the engine of growth, allowed for a division of knowhow among individuals that permitted the whole to know more than the parts and form ever-growing networks of exchange and collaboration.

zh: 现代公司拥有生产专家、设计专家、市场专家、销售专家、财务专家、会计师、人力资源管理专家、物流专家、税务师、合同专家等各种专业人员。
en: A modern corporation has experts in production, design, marketing, sales, finance, accounting, human resource management, logistics, taxes, contracts, and so on.

zh: 现代生产不仅仅是资本（Das Kapital）所有的建筑和设备的堆积加上可替代的工人的机械操作。
en: Modern production is not just an accumulation of buildings and equipment owned by Das Kapital and operated mechanically by fungible workers.

zh: 相反，现代生产是一张由拥有不同类型人力资本（Das Human-Kapital）的人才组成的协作网络。
en: Instead, it is a coordinated network of people that possess different types of Das Human-Kapital.

zh: 在发达世界，资本主义确实将几乎所有人都改造成为受薪劳工，但资本主义也让他们走出贫困，让他们获得了比马克思所想象的更繁荣的生活。
en: In the developed world, capitalism did transform almost everyone into a wage laborer, but it also lifted them out of poverty and made them more prosperous than Marx could have imagined.

zh: 这不是马克思唯一的错误。
en: That was not the only thing Marx got wrong.

zh: 更令人意外的是，资本主义生产再组织在发展中世界逐渐消失，让绝大多数劳动力脱离它的控制。
en: More surprisingly, the capitalist reorganization of production petered out in the developing world, leaving the vast majority of the labor force outside its control.

zh: 数字令人震惊。
en: The numbers are astounding.

zh: 美国只有九分之一的人是自由职业者，而印度的这一比例为20分之19。
en: While only one in nine people in the United States are self-employed, the proportion in India is 19 out of 20.

zh: 不到五分之一的秘鲁工人受雇于马克思所构想的私人企业。
en: Fewer than one-fifth of workers in Peru are employed by the kind of private businesses that Marx had in mind.

zh: 在墨西哥，这一比例为三分之一。
en: In Mexico, about one in three are.

zh: 即使在国家内部，福利政策也与有多少比例的劳动力被资本主义生产雇用强烈相关。
en: Even within countries, measures of wellbeing are strongly related to the proportion of the labor force employed in capitalist production.

zh: 在墨西哥新莱昂州，三分之二的工人受雇于私人企业，而恰帕斯的这一比例只有七分之一。
en: In Mexico’s state of Nuevo León, two-thirds of workers are employed by private incorporated businesses, while in Chiapas only one in seven is.

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪，人均��入在新莱昂州要比恰帕斯州高九倍多。
en: No wonder, then, that per capita income is more than nine times higher in Nuevo León than in Chiapas.

zh: 在哥伦比亚，波哥大人均收入比麦考（Maicao）高四倍。
en: In Colombia, per capita income in Bogota is four times higher than in Maicao.

zh: 毫不奇怪，波哥大的资本主义就业率要高出六倍。
en: Unsurprisingly, the share of capitalist employment is six times higher in Bogota.

zh: 在饱受贫困困扰的玻利维亚，方济各批评“不管什么价格都要有利润，而丝毫不考虑社会排斥和自然环境破坏问题的心态 ， ” 以及“原始而天真地相信行使经济权力的人的善意以及被神圣化的现有经济制度的作用。 ”
en: In poverty-stricken Bolivia, Francis criticized “the mentality of profit at any price, with no concern for social exclusion or the destruction of nature,” along with “a crude and naive trust in the goodness of those wielding economic power and in the sacralized workings of the prevailing economic system.”

zh: 但如此解释资本主义的失败根本不着边际。
en: But this explanation of capitalism’s failure is wide of the mark.

zh: 世界上最盈利的公司并没有在剥削玻利维亚。
en: The world’s most profitable companies are not exploiting Bolivia.

zh: 它们根本就没有来到玻利维亚，因为这里无法盈利。
en: They are simply not there, because they find the place unprofitable.

zh: 发展中世界的根本问题是资本主义没有再组织最贫穷国家和地区的生产和就业，将大部分劳动力排斥在经营范围之外。
en: The developing world’s fundamental problem is that capitalism has not reorganized production and employment in the poorest countries and regions, leaving the bulk of the labor force outside its scope of operation.

zh: 拉斐尔·迪·特拉（Rafael Di Tella）和罗伯特·麦考洛克（Robert MacCulloch）指出，世界上最贫穷的国家的特征不是天真地相信资本主义，而是完全不相信资本主义，这导致了大规模政府干预和商业管制。
en: As Rafael Di Tella and Robert MacCulloch have shown, the world’s poorest countries are not characterized by naive trust in capitalism, but by utter distrust, which leads to heavy government intervention and regulation of business.

zh: 在这样的条件下，资本主义无法繁荣，经济也一直贫穷。
en: Under such conditions, capitalism does not thrive and economies remain poor.

zh: 方济各将目光集中于世界最贫穷群体的处境，这是正确的。
en: Francis is right to focus attention on the plight of the world’s poorest.

zh: 但是，他们的苦难不是放肆的资本主义造成的，而是被错误地约束的资本主义造成的。
en: Their misery, however, is not the consequence of unbridled capitalism, but of a capitalism that has been bridled in just the wrong way.

zh: “治愈癌症”会杀死病人吗？
en: Does “Curing” Cancer Kill Patients?

zh: 坦帕 — — 癌症患者和政治家“治愈”癌症的要求越来越强烈。
en: TAMPA – Patients and politicians increasingly demand a “cure” for cancer.

zh: 但事实证明控制可能是比治愈更切合实际的方法。
en: But controlling the disease may prove to be a better strategy than striving to cure it.

zh: 上个世纪，德国诺贝尔奖得主保罗·奥利克首创了“神奇弹药”概念 — — 这是一种能杀灭肿瘤细胞或者致病组织、同时又不伤及正常细胞的化合物。
en: A century ago, the German Nobel laureate Paul Ehrlich introduced the concept of “magic bullets” – compounds engineered to target and kill tumor cells or disease-causing organisms without affecting normal cells.

zh: 50年后抗生素研制成功似乎证实了奥利克的想法。
en: The success of antibiotics 50 years later seemed to validate Ehrlich’s idea.

zh: 药物灭菌带来如此巨大的胜利喜悦，以致于“抗癌斗争”一直以来都是基于这样一种假设：如果研究人员足够的聪明和勤奋，总有一天我们能够找到杀灭癌细胞的神奇弹药。
en: So influential have medicine’s triumphs over bacteria been that the “war on cancer” continues to be driven by the assumption that magic bullets will one day be found for tumor cells if the search is sufficiently clever and diligent.

zh: 但人们以往与异常物种打交道的经验和最近有关肿瘤进化动力学的数学模型告诉我们，彻底治愈绝大多数癌症可能是不现实的目标。
en: Yet lessons learned in dealing with exotic species, combined with recent mathematical models of the evolutionary dynamics of tumors, indicate that eradicating most cancers may be impossible.

zh: 不仅如此，这样做还有可能使问题进一步恶化。
en: Trying to do so, moreover, could worsen the problem.

zh: 在奥利克出生的1854年，伊利诺伊州首次发现了小菜蛾。
en: In 1854, the year Ehrlich was born, the diamondback moth was first observed in Illinois.

zh: 后来的五十年里，小菜蛾传遍了北美地区。
en: Within five decades, the moth had spread throughout North America.

zh: 现在美洲、欧洲、亚洲和澳洲都能找到它的身影。
en: It now infests the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Australia.

zh: 使用化学药剂杀灭小菜蛾的努力只在很短的时间内起到了效果。
en: Attempts to eradicate it using chemicals worked only fleetingly.

zh: 20世纪80年代末，生物学家发现了对所有已知杀虫剂具有耐药性的菜蛾品种。
en: In the late 1980’s, biologists found strains that were resistant to all known insecticides.

zh: 于是农民们不再试图彻底消灭小菜蛾。
en: So farmers abandoned their efforts to eliminate the moth.

zh: 相反，多数人为了持续达到相对满意的作物产量，现在只有在感染率超过一定限度时才使用杀虫剂。
en: Instead, most now apply insecticides only when infestation exceeds some threshold level, with the goal of producing a sustainable and satisfactory crop.

zh: 在“综合害虫治理”的大旗下，数百种入侵物种现在借助限制害虫繁殖数量，但并不试图彻底消灭它们的策略得到了成功地控制。
en: Under the banner of “integrated pest management,” hundreds of invasive species are now successfully controlled by strategies that restrict the population growth of pests but do not attempt to eradicate them

zh: 肿瘤细胞适应各种环境条件、包括有毒化学物质的能力与农作物害虫和其他入侵性物种所表现出来的进化能力非常相似。
en: The ability of tumor cells to adapt to a wide range of environmental conditions, including toxic chemicals, is similar to the evolutionary capacities demonstrated by crop pests and other invasive species.

zh: 像小菜蛾的例子所表明的那样，扩散的癌细胞很少能够被成功的杀灭。
en: As in the case of the Diamondback moth, successful eradication of disseminated cancer cells is rare.

zh: 但尽管少有成功的先例，但癌症治疗的典型目标仍然与杀菌治疗非常相似 — — 那就是尽可能多的杀死癌细胞。 人们认为这样在最好情况下能够治愈疾病，而在最坏情况下也能尽可能延长患者的存活时间。
en: But despite the paucity of success, the typical goal in cancer therapy remains similar to that of antimicrobial treatments – killing as many tumor cells as possible under the assumption that this will, at best, cure the disease and, at worst, keep the patient alive for as long as possible.

zh: 某些类型的癌症，比如霍奇金淋巴瘤、睾丸癌和急性髓细胞性白血病，一般都可以借助积极的化疗达到治愈目的。
en: Some types of cancer – for example, Hodgkin’s lymphoma, testicular cancer, and acute myeloid leukemia – can be consistently cured using aggressive chemotherapy.

zh: 但这些恶性细胞似乎对“治疗”特别敏感。
en: But these malignant cells seem to be particularly responsive to “treatment.”

zh: 就像入侵性物种会适应杀虫剂一样，多数癌细胞也会适应治疗措施。
en: Just as invasive species adapt to pesticides, most cancer cells adapt to therapies.

zh: 事实上，癌细胞和入侵性物种之间的相似之处表明成功治疗癌症的原则或许并不在于微生物学领域的神奇弹药，而在于应用生态学领域对进化动力学的研究。
en: Indeed, the parallels between cancerous cells and invasive species suggest that the principles for successful cancer therapy might be found not in the magic bullets of microbiology but in the evolutionary dynamics of applied ecology.

zh: 最近的研究显示治愈癌症的努力实际可能加速催生抗药性，导致癌症复发，从而降低患者的存活几率。
en: Recent research suggests that efforts to eliminate cancers may actually hasten the emergence of resistance and tumor recurrence, thus reducing a patient’s chances of survival.

zh: 究其原因是由于肿瘤生物学中不为人知的部分：那就是抗药性对癌症治疗的削弱作用。
en: The reason arises from a component of tumor biology not ordinarily investigated: the cost of resistance to treatment.

zh: 在对化疗产生抗药性的过程中癌细胞会遭受损失。
en: Cancer cells pay a price when they evolve resistance to chemotherapy.

zh: 比如为了对抗有毒药品，癌细胞可能会加快DNA的修复速度，或者主动将抗癌药物挤出细胞膜。
en: For example, to cope with toxic drugs, a cancer cell may increase its rate of DNA repair, or actively pump the drug out across the cell membrane.

zh: 在靶向治疗中，药物对癌细胞存活以及扩散所需要的分子信号产生干扰，而癌细胞则有可能通过激活或者采用替代路线来适应抗癌药物。
en: In targeted therapies, in which drugs interfere with the molecular signaling needed for proliferation and survival, a cell might adapt by activating or following alternative pathways.

zh: 这些方法将会耗尽本可以用于入侵健康细胞或者进行扩散的能量，并以此来降低癌细胞的健康程度。
en: All these strategies use up energy that would otherwise be available for invasion into non-cancerous tissues or proliferation, and so reduce a cell’s fitness.

zh: 实际采用的抗癌机制越是复杂昂贵，与之对抗的癌细胞的健康状况就越差。
en: The more complex and costly the mechanisms used, the less fit the resistant population will be.

zh: 若干研究成果支持了癌细胞为获得抗药性而付出代价的假设。
en: That cancer cells pay a price for resistance is supported by several observations.

zh: 在实验室环境中对化疗产生抗药性的细胞一般会在化疗解除后失去抗药性。
en: Cells in   laboratory cultures that are resistant to chemotherapies typically lose their resistance when the chemicals are removed.

zh: 对吉西他滨化疗产生抗药性的肺癌细胞比对药物治疗敏感的其他肿瘤细胞的扩散性、侵略性和能动性都有所下降。
en: Lung cancer cells that are resistant to the chemotherapy gemcitabine are less proliferative, invasive, and motile than their drug-sensitive counterparts.

zh: 虽然抗药细胞在从未接受过治疗的肿瘤中也十分常见，但它们的数量通常很小。
en: Although resistant forms are commonly found in tumors that haven’t yet been exposed to treatment, they generally occur in small numbers.

zh: 这种现象表明抗药细��并没有被对药物敏感的细胞彻底击溃，而是在两种细胞混合的情况下竭力扩张。
en: This suggests that resistant cells are not so unfit that drug-sensitive cells completely out-competed them, but that they struggle to proliferate when both types are present.

zh: 我们的模型显示在不进行任何治疗的情况下，没有抗药性的癌细胞将会战胜不那么健康的抗药细胞。
en: Our models show that in the absence of therapy, cancer cells that haven’t evolved resistance will proliferate at the expense of the less-fit resistant cells.

zh: 但当敏感细胞被积极的治疗手段大量杀死的时候，那么抗药细胞就会不受限制地大量扩散。
en: When a large number of sensitive cells are killed, say, by aggressive therapies, resistant types can proliferate unconstrained.

zh: 这意味着高剂量化疗实际可能会使进一步治疗无效的几率加大。
en: This means that high doses of chemotherapy might actually increase the likelihood of a tumor becoming unresponsive to further therapy.

zh: 因此，正像恰当的使用杀虫剂可以控制侵入性物种一样，旨在保持癌细胞数量稳定可控的治疗方法也可以让敏感细胞抑制住耐药细胞的生长，从而提高患者的生存几率。
en: So, just as judicious use of pesticides can control invasive species, a therapeutic strategy designed to maintain a stable, tolerable tumor volume could improve a patient’s prospects for survival by allowing sensitive cells to suppress the growth of resistant ones.

zh: 为了验证这一理念，我们采用传统高剂量化疗的方法对小白鼠所患的人类卵巢癌进行治疗。
en: To test this idea, we treated a human ovarian cancer, grown in mice, with conventional high-dose chemotherapy.

zh: 结果是癌细胞迅速减少，但随之快速复发，杀死了小白鼠。
en: The cancer rapidly regressed but then recurred and killed the mice.

zh: 但当我们用调整到能够保持癌细胞数量稳定的药物剂量为小白鼠进行治疗的时候，实验动物虽然没有被完全治愈，但却实现了长时间存活。
en: Yet when we treated the mice with a drug dose continuously adjusted to maintain a stable tumor volume, the animals, though not cured, survived for a prolonged period of time.

zh: 设计一套保持肿瘤细胞稳定而不是彻底杀灭所有癌细胞的治疗方案需要不计较任何一次治疗的即时杀伤效果。
en: Designing therapies to sustain a stable tumor mass rather than eradicate all cancer cells will   require a strategy that looks beyond the immediate cytotoxic effects of any one treatment.

zh: 研究人员需要明确癌细胞获得耐药性及其所付出代价之间的联系机制。
en: Researchers will need to establish the mechanisms by which cancer cells achieve resistance and what it costs them.

zh: 他们需要理解耐药癌细胞的进化动力状况，并设计出抑制或者利用其适应性特点的相关治疗策略。
en: They will need to understand the evolutionary dynamics of resistant populations, and design strategies to suppress or exploit the adapted characteristics.

zh: 当然，癌症研究人员不应放弃对更有效的癌症治疗方法、甚至是治愈方法的研究。
en: Of course, cancer researchers should not abandon their search for ever-more-effective cancer therapies, even for cures.

zh: 但或许是时候调整我们对神奇弹药的探索，承认达尔文进化动力学的冰冷现实。 彻底战胜癌症的医学目标可能需要让位于这样一种理念，那就是维持来之不易的平衡局面或许是能够实现的最高目标。
en: But it may be time to temper our quest for magic bullets and recognize the cold reality of Darwin’s evolutionary dynamics.  Medicine’s goal of a glorious victory over cancer may need to yield to our recognizing that an uneasy stalemate may be the best that can be achieved.

zh: 债务问题要紧吗？
en: Does Debt Matter?

zh: 伦敦—如今，欧洲上空飘荡着债务的幽灵。
en: LONDON – Europe is now haunted by the specter of debt.

zh: 这个幽灵令所有欧洲领导人心惊胆寒。
en: All European leaders quail before it.

zh: 为了把它赶走，他们正在把各自的经济推向磨难。
en: To exorcise the demon, they are putting their economies through the wringer.

zh: 但这一招似乎并不显灵。
en: It doesn’t seem to be helping.

zh: 他们的经济仍然蹒跚，而债务并没有停止增长。
en: Their economies are still tumbling, and the debt continues to grow.

zh: 评级机构标准普尔刚刚下调了欧元区九国主权债务评级，法国赫然在列。
en: The credit ratings agency Standard & Poor’s has just downgraded the sovereign-debt ratings of nine eurozone countries, including France.

zh: 英国很可能将步其后尘。
en: The United Kingdom is likely to follow.

zh: 如果你还没有被愚昧蒙蔽了双眼，那么这次大面积降级的原因就很容易看清。
en: To anyone not blinded by folly, the explanation for this mass downgrade is obvious.

zh: 如果你有意要让GDP下降，那么你的债务-GDP必定会随之上升。
en: If you deliberately aim to shrink your GDP, your debt-to-GDP ratio is bound to grow.

zh: 削减债务，除了违约之外，唯一的办法就是让经济增长起来。
en: The only way to cut your debt (other than by default) is to get your economy to grow.

zh: 担心债务乃是人类本能；因此，消灭债务的政策目标在普通公民眼中断然是不会错的。
en: Fear of debt is rooted in human nature; so the extinction of it as a policy aim seems right to the average citizen.

zh: 众所周知，财务债务的意思是欠钱，通常是借来的钱。
en: Everyone knows what financial debt means: money owed, often borrowed.

zh: 如果你对到时候无法偿还所欠的钱感到不确定，那么你的债务就会让你产生焦虑。
en: To be in debt can produce anxiety if one is uncertain whether, when the time comes, one will be able to repay what one owes.

zh: 这种焦虑已经转移到了国民债务层面，也就是政府欠其债权人的债务。
en: This anxiety is readily transferred to national debt – the debt owed by a government to its creditors.

zh: 人们会问，政府将如何偿还它们所欠下的数千亿美元债务？
en: How, people ask, will governments repay all of the hundreds of billions of dollars that they owe?

zh: 正如英国首相卡梅伦所言 ： “ 政府债务和信用卡债务是一样，迟早要还的。 ”
en: As British Prime Minister David Cameron put it: “Government debt is the same as credit-card debt; it’s got to be paid back.”

zh: 接下来出现的是，为了偿还（或至少减少）国民债务，政府必须消除其预算赤字，因为支出超过收入会继续增加国民债务。
en: The next step readily follows: in order to repay, or at least reduce, the national debt, the government must eliminate its budget deficit, because the excess of spending over revenue continually adds to the national debt.

zh: 事实上，如果政府行动不力，那么国民债务将变得 — — 用今天的行话讲 — — “不可持续 ” 。
en: Indeed, if the government fails to act, the national debt will become, in today’s jargon, “unsustainable.”

zh: 在这里，仍然可以用家庭债务来类比。
en: Again, an analogy with household debt readily suggests itself.

zh: 我的逝世并不会让我的债务消失，稍有头脑的公民都知道这一点。
en: My death does not extinguish my debt, reasons the sensible citizen.

zh: 我的债权人将拥有对我的财产 — — 即我准备遗留给子孙后代的所有东西 — — 的第一索偿权。
en: My creditors will have the first claim on my estate – everything that I wanted to leave to my children.

zh: 类似地，政府长期未能偿还的债务也将成为子孙后代的负担：我可以从政府的铺张浪费中获得好处，这得由我的子孙后代买单。
en: Similarly, a debt left unpaid too long by a government is a burden on future generations: I may enjoy the benefits of government extravagance, but my children will have to foot the bill.

zh: 这就是为什么削减债务成为大多数政府财政政策的核心。
en: That is why deficit reduction is at the center of most governments’ fiscal policy today.

zh: 一个具有“可信”的“财政整合”计划的政府想必不太会对其债务违约，或把它留给未来去偿还。
en: A government with a “credible” plan for “fiscal consolidation” supposedly is less likely to default on its debt, or leave it for the future to pay.

zh: 人们认为，这能让政府以更低的成本借到钱，反过来拉低私人借款人的利率，从而能够提振经济活动。
en: This will, it is thought, enable the government to borrow money more cheaply than it would otherwise be able to do, in turn lowering interest rates for private borrowers, which should boost economic activity.

zh: 于是，财政整合就成了经济复苏的不二法门。
en: So fiscal consolidation is the royal road to economic recovery.

zh: 这便是如今大多数发达国家的指导方针，但其中至少有五大漏洞，而由于财政整合说听起来无懈可击，因此这五大漏洞很少有人注意到。
en: This, the official doctrine of most developed countries today, contains at least five major fallacies, which pass largely unnoticed, because the narrative is so plausible.

zh: 首先，政府不同于个人，其债务并不是必须“偿还”的。
en: First, governments, unlike private individuals, do not have to “repay” their debts.

zh: 拥有本国中央银行的政府可以通过印刷本国货币借给自己。
en: A government of a country with its own central bank and its own currency can simply continue to borrow by printing the money which is lent to it.

zh: 这一点对欧元区国家是不成立的。
en: This is not true of countries in the eurozone.

zh: 但这些国家的政府也不是必须“偿还”其债务的。
en: But their governments do not have to repay their debts, either.

zh: 如果（外国）债权人给它们施加太多的压力，它们可以选择违约。
en: If their (foreign) creditors put too much pressure on them, they simply default.

zh: 违约绝不是好事。
en: Default is bad.

zh: 但违约之后的日子并不会比不违约差。
en: But life after default goes on much as before.

zh: 其次，刻意削减赤字并不是政府平衡预算的最佳方式。
en: Second, deliberately cutting the deficit is not the best way for a government to balance its books.

zh: 在经济萧条时削减赤字绝非复苏之路，反之，恰恰是收缩之路，因为这意味着连同政府收入所依赖的国民收入一起削减了。
en: Deficit reduction in a depressed economy is the road not to recovery, but to contraction, because it means cutting the national income on which the government’s revenues depend.

zh: 这会让赤字削减变得更困难而不是更容易。
en: This will make it harder, not easier, for it to cut the deficit.

zh: 英国政府于2010年6月宣布赤字削减计划，但现在，它所必须借入的资金规模比计划中多了1120亿英镑。
en: The British government already must borrow £112 billion ($172 billion) more than it had planned when it announced its deficit-reduction plan in June 2010.

zh: 第三，国民债务并不是子孙后代的净负担。
en: Third, the national debt is not a net burden on future generations.

zh: 尽管这会提高未来税收负担，但这一负担会从纳税人手中转移到债权人那里。
en: Even if it gives rise to future tax liabilities (and some of it will), these will be transfers from taxpayers to bond holders.

zh: ���可能会造成令人不快的分配后果。
en: This may have disagreeable distributional consequences.

zh: 现在试图削减国民债务将给子孙后代造成净负担：收入会马上出现下降，利润会缩水，退休基金规模会不足，投资项目会被取消或中止，住房、医院、学校也将无法建设。
en: But trying to reduce it now will be a net burden on future generations: income will be lowered immediately, profits will fall, pension funds will be diminished, investment projects will be canceled or postponed, and houses, hospitals, and schools will not be built.

zh: 未来政府的境况会因此更加糟糕，因为它们失去了本可以留在手中的资产。
en: Future generations will be worse off, having been deprived of assets that they might otherwise have had.

zh: 第四，国民债务规模和政府融资成本之间并没有多少联系。
en: Fourth, there is no connection between the size of national debt and the price that a government must pay to finance it.

zh: 日本、美国、英国和德国的国民债务偿还成本一样低，尽管它们的债务水平和财政政策相差极大。
en: The interest rates that Japan, the United States, the UK, and Germany pay on their national debt are equally low, despite vast differences in their debt levels and fiscal policies.

zh: 最后，政府借债的低成本并不会自动拉低私人部门的资本成本。
en: Finally, low borrowing costs for governments do not automatically reduce the cost of capital for the private sector.

zh: 毕竟，公司借款人不可能以像美国国债那样的“无风险”收益率借钱，有证据表明，货币扩张可以拉低政府债务的利率，但很难影响银行向公司和家庭发放的新贷款的利率。
en: After all, corporate borrowers do not borrow at the “risk-free” yield of, say, US Treasury bonds, and evidence shows that monetary expansion can push down the interest rate on government debt, but have hardly any effect on new bank lending to firms or households.

zh: 事实上，这里的因果关系正好相反：英国和其他地区的政府利率之所以如此之低，是因为私人部门贷款利率太高了。
en: In fact, the causality is the reverse: the reason why government interest rates in the UK and elsewhere are so low is that interest rates for private-sector loans are so high.

zh: 马克思著名的《共产党宣言中》中说道 ， “ 共产主义的幽灵”游荡在欧洲上空，而如今 ， “ 就欧洲的所有势力已经结成了一个神圣同盟，驱逐”国民债务的幽灵。
en: As with “the specter of Communism” that haunted Europe in Karl Marx’s famous manifesto, so today “[a]ll the powers of old Europe have entered into a holy alliance to exorcise” the specter of national debt.

zh: 但意在清除债务的政客们应该记住另一个著名的幽灵 — — 革命的幽灵。
en: But statesmen who aim to liquidate the debt should recall another famous specter – the specter of revolution.

zh: 欧洲是否有意求死？
en: Does Europe Have a Death Wish?

zh: 柏林 — — 自2010年希腊债务危机伊始，欧洲主要国家就应该已经清楚它可能给欧盟带来什么样的风险和后果。
en: BERLIN – From the start of the Greek debt crisis in 2010, the major European players should have understood the risks and consequences that it posed for the European Union.

zh: 但在旁观者看来显然并非如此。
en: They certainly don’t give that impression to onlookers.

zh: 受危机影响的远远不只希腊：无序破产可能把欧盟南部周边经济体（包括某些大国在内）拖入财政深渊，而主要欧洲银行和保险公司也将同时倒下。
en: The crisis was always about much more than Greece: a disorderly insolvency there would threaten to pull other economies on the EU’s southern periphery, including some very big ones, into the fiscal abyss, along with major European banks and insurers.

zh: 全球经济将由此陷入另一场金融危机，其所造成的冲击力不亚于2008年秋。
en: That could plunge the global economy into another financial crisis, delivering a shock equivalent to the autumn of 2008.

zh: 随之而来的欧元区失败将不可能无损于欧洲共同市场。
en: It would also mean a eurozone failure that would not leave the Common Market unharmed.

zh: 有史以来第一次，事态的发展直接关系到欧洲计划的生死存亡。
en: For the first time in its history, the very continuance of the European project is at stake.

zh: 但因为严重缺乏领导和国家利己主义作怪，致使欧盟及其重要成员国犹豫不决，迟迟无法采取行动。
en: And yet the behavior of the EU and its most important member states has been irresolute and dithering, owing to national egotism and a breathtaking absence of leadership.

zh: 国家可以像企业那样破产，但与企业不同的是，他们破产之后也不会消失。
en: States can go bust just like companies, but, unlike companies, they don’t disappear when that happens.

zh: 国家因此不应受到惩罚，他们的长期利益也不容忽视。
en: That is why states should not be punished, and why their ongoing interests should not be underestimated.

zh: 破产国家可能需要外界协助在金融及其他诸多领域展开重组，这样才能逐步摆脱危机的影响。
en: Insolvent states need help with restructuring, both in the financial sector and well beyond it, so that they can work their way out of crisis.

zh: 上述判断显然适用于希腊，希腊的结构性问题甚至比目前的财政困难影响更大。
en: This is certainly true of Greece, whose structural problems are much more sweeping than even its financial difficulties.

zh: 到目前为止，欧盟和希腊政府还未能解决希腊的结构性问题。
en: Thus far, the EU and the Greek government have failed to address Greece’s structural problems.

zh: 但为了让希腊人 — — 和变幻莫测的金融市场 — — 看到隧道尽头的亮光，他们需要制定（并资助）恰当的经济重建政策。
en: But they need to develop (and fund) an appropriate strategy for economic reconstruction, in order to make clear to the Greeks – and to skittish financial markets – that there is light at the end of the tunnel.

zh: 希腊人没有大规模债务减免就无法摆脱危机已是不争的事实。
en: Everyone knows that Greece will be unable to work its way out of crisis without massive debt relief.

zh: 唯一问题是该国的债务重组是有序可控、还是混乱并具有传染性。
en: The only question is whether the country’s debt restructuring will be orderly and controlled or chaotic and contagious.

zh: 无论如何，德国是否为希腊债务买单的国内辩论都显得滑稽可笑。
en: Either way, Germany’s internal debate about whether to pay for the Greek debt is risible.

zh: 根本没有可能拒绝买单，因为德国和其他所有欧元区国家都在同一条船上。
en: Refusing to pay is not a viable option, because Germany and all other eurozone members are in the same boat.

zh: 如果希腊债务违约引发人们对欧洲体系中举足轻重的银行和保险公司的即时关注，那么他们也将随这条船一同沉没。
en: A Greek default would threaten to sink them, too, for it would raise immediate concerns about the solvency of Europe’s systemically important banks and insurance companies.

zh: 那么欧元区政府首脑们还在等些什么？
en: So what are the eurozone’s heads of government waiting for?

zh: 他们是否因为个人的政治前途而不愿对民众和盘托出？
en: Are they reluctant to come clean with their people out of fear for their own political futures?

zh: 欧洲金融危机实质是一场政治危机，因为欧盟领导人无法做出必要的决策。
en: The European financial crisis is really a political crisis, because EU leaders are unable to decide on the necessary measures.

zh: 反之，大把的时间都被浪费在国内政策等次要问题上。
en: Instead, time is lost on secondary issues largely rooted in domestic policy concerns.

zh: 从原则上看，要求银行参与化解债务危机的融资无疑是正确的。
en: It is certainly right, in principle, to argue that the banks should participate in financing the resolution of the debt crisis.

zh: 但如果“大到不能倒闭的银行”的亏损可能诱发新一轮的金融危机，坚持让银行买单就没有什么道理了。
en: But it makes little sense to insist on it as long as losses by banks that remain “too big to fail” could trigger a renewed financial crisis.

zh: 实现这一目标需要在2009年初对金融系统进行全面检查，但那次机会基本已经被浪费掉了。
en: Any chance to make this work would have required overhauling the financial system early in 2009, but that opportunity was largely wasted.

zh: 只要关系到欧盟生死的政治危机得不到解决，欧盟的稳定就会继续遭到金融危机的破坏。
en: As long as the EU’s life-threatening political crisis continues, its financial crisis will continue to destabilize it.

zh: 化解危机确定的核心问题是：如果不实现欧洲政治统一，欧元和作为整体的欧盟就无法继续存在。
en: At the heart of resolving the crisis lies the certainty that the euro – and with it the EU as a whole – will not survive without greater European political unification.

zh: 如果欧洲人希望保住欧元，我们必须立即达成政治联盟；如若不然，欧元和欧洲一体化的成果就将付之东流。
en: If Europeans want to keep the euro, we must forge ahead with political union now; otherwise, like it or not, the euro and European integration will be undone.

zh: 欧洲也将失去半个多世纪来超越民族主义所取得的一切收获。
en: Europe would then lose nearly everything it has gained over a half-century from transcending nationalism.

zh: 在新的世界秩序正逐步形成的背景下，这对欧洲人而言无疑是场悲剧。
en: In the light of the emerging new world order, this would be a tragedy for Europeans.

zh: 遗憾的是，即将卸任的欧洲央行行长让·克洛德·特里谢建议设立的“欧元区财长”一职遭到国家和政府首脑们不假思索的否决。
en: Unfortunately, when the outgoing president of the European Central Bank, Jean-Claude Trichet, proposed a step in this direction by suggesting that a “European Secretary of the Treasury” be created, heads of state and government dismissed the idea out of hand.

zh: 欧洲理事会甚至几乎没有人愿意承认这场欧洲危机的深度。
en: Hardly anyone on the European Council seems willing even to acknowledge the depth of the EU crisis.

zh: 解决这场危机需要加强而非削弱欧洲一体化。
en: Resolving this crisis requires more Europe and more integration, not less.

zh: 是的：富裕国家 — — 首先是德国 — — 将必须承担解决危机的费用。
en: And yes: the rich economies – first and foremost Germany – will have to pay for the way out.

zh: 这场危机的两大关键角色德国和法国必须制定联合对策，因为只有他们齐心协力才能促成解决方案顺利通过。
en: Germany and France, the two crucial players in this crisis, will have to devise a joint strategy, because only they, working together, can push through a solution.

zh: 问题在于2005年法国针对欧盟宪法的全民公投否决了政治一体化进程的深入，而经济一体化进程的深入则可能因为德国的犹豫而陷入失败。
en: The problem is that the French referendum on the EU constitution in 2005 vetoed further political integration, while further economic integration may now fail because of Germany.

zh: 因此必须要进行全面调整货币联盟的法德双边公开对话。
en: What is required, therefore, is an open bilateral French-German dialogue about a comprehensive realignment of the monetary union.

zh: 更改协议绝无可能，因此必须找到其他的办法，这也使法德合作显得尤为重要。
en: Treaty changes are impossible; therefore, different methods will need to be found, which makes the Franco-German partnership all the more important.

zh: 无论欧盟陷入了怎样的政治危机和困境，欧洲人都必须记住欧盟存在无论对现在还是未来有多么重要。
en: Regardless of the EU’s political crisis and paralysis, Europeans should not forget how important its existence is and will continue to be.

zh: 你只要回顾一下20世纪早期的情况就明白我为什么这样说。
en: One has only to look back to the first half of the twentieth century to understand why.

zh: 欧元区可以走韩国之路吗？
en: Does Europe Have a Korean Option?

zh: 华盛顿 — — 至少从表面上看，欧元区当前状况与韩国在1997年崩盘时截然不同。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – On the surface, at least, the situation in the eurozone today and South Korea in the fall of 1997 look very different.

zh: 两者都是严重的经济危机，但欧元区的问题来自政府债务水平高企，而韩国的问题来自大规模资本外逃和货币崩溃，且债务基本上全部来自公司部门。
en: Both are cases of severe economic crisis, to be sure. But the eurozone’s problems stem from high levels of government debt, while South Korea faced massive capital flight and a collapsing currency – and almost all of the debt was in the corporate sector.

zh: 尽管如此，欧元区还是可以从韩国身上学到经验，后者当年以任何人都没想到的速度走出了危机，实现了明智的改革和快速复苏。
en: Nevertheless, the eurozone could learn from the experience of South Korea, which came through its crisis more quickly than anyone expected, combining sensible reforms with a rapid recovery.

zh: 韩国迅速扭转局势的关键在于韩元的大幅贬值。
en: The key to the South Korean turnaround was a large depreciation of the currency, the won.

zh: 欧元贬值似乎也是欧元区扭转局势的可行之道。
en: A depreciation of the euro seems to be one likely way that the eurozone will turn the corner.

zh: 不同的危机各有各的不同，但韩国危机与20世纪90年代的其他新兴市场危机有着诸多相似之处。
en: Every crisis is different, but South Korea shared many features with other troubled emerging markets in the 1990’s.

zh: “财阀 ” — —即政治上紧密联系的大型公司集团 — — 通过低成本债务迅速扩张。
en: Large, politically well-connected groups of companies – known as chaebol – expanded rapidly by taking on large amounts of cheap debt.

zh: 外部股东对财阀内部的权势人物无法产生任何影响，债权人放心地把钱借给财阀，因为他们认定大财阀对政府而言非常重要，政府不会坐视它们倒闭。
en: Outside shareholders had little influence over the powerful individuals who ran the chaebol, and creditors lent money freely, assuming that the leading chaebol were too important for the government to allow them to go bankrupt.

zh: 与此同时，政治因素在债务积累过程中扮演着重要角色，创造了极大的脆弱性，当投资者感到情况不妙时，经济危机就迅速发生了。
en: Meanwhile, political factors played an important role in allowing debt to build up – creating vulnerabilities that could quickly become an economic crisis once investors became nervous.

zh: 尽管韩国国有银行在名义上控制着资本流动，但私人部门和政府之间的机密联系让财阀有恃无恐。
en: Even though South Korean state-owned banks nominally controlled the flow of capital, tight relationships between the private sector and the government meant that the chaebol felt they had little to fear.

zh: 在1997年的崩盘中，危机先是袭击了泰国和印度尼西亚，然后在韩国引起了全面恐慌。
en: In the fall of 1997, after crises battered Thailand and Indonesia, full-scale panic erupted in South Korea.

zh: 随着韩元的贬值，公司部门的外国贷款负担大大增加，这进一步加剧了恐慌。
en: As the currency depreciated, the corporate sector’s foreign loans became more onerous – further exacerbating the panic.

zh: IMF的早期支持都没能让情况稳定下来。
en: Early support offered by the International Monetary Fund did not stabilize the situation.

zh: 如今，欧元区不存在外债问题 — — 所有的问题债务都是欧元债，且大部分是欧洲政府欠本国银行的债务。
en: The eurozone today does not have a foreign-debt problem – all of the debt in question is in euros, and most of it is owed by European governments to their own countries’ banks.

zh: 但正如希腊和意大利所显示的，这是一个危险的组合。
en: But this is a toxic combination, as Greece and Italy have discovered.

zh: 欧洲债务动态与韩国截然不同，但两者的问题都是难以克服的。
en: European debt dynamics are quite distinct from those in South Korea, but the problem in both instances could be considered insurmountable.

zh: 显而易见的危机疏散同道是经济增长，经济增长能拉低债务-GDP比率，让利息支付看起来更加合理。
en: The obvious escape route leads through economic growth, which would reduce the debt-to-GDP ratio and make interest payments look reasonable.

zh: 但欧洲并不具备采取标准刺激手段的条件：债务水平高企让束缚住了财政政策的手脚，而担心通胀的欧洲央行又不肯放松货币政策。
en: But the standard ways to stimulate the European economy are not available: fiscal policy is constrained by already-high debt levels; and the European Central Bank, fearing inflation, has kept a tight rein on monetary policy.

zh: 欧洲谈判桌上的其他办法，包括各种各样的“结构性改革 ” ， 均无法提供短期快速增长之路。
en: None of the other ideas on the European table, including various kinds of “structural reform,” will provide fast growth in the short term.

zh: 9月，葡萄牙曾计划采取一种“内部贬值 ” ， 降低薪资税，提高增值税；但这一计划现在已被束之高阁，最主要的原因是在政治上不可行。
en: In September, Portugal planned to pursue a form of “internal devaluation,” by cutting payroll taxes and increasing the VAT; this has now been shelved, presumably because it is politically unworkable.

zh: 另一方面，真实贬值可以对实体经济产生神奇疗效。
en: A genuine devaluation, on the other hand, would work wonders for the real economy.

zh: 如果欧元贬值30 % （ 经通胀调整 ） ， 死气沉沉的意大利经济就能重获生机。
en: The moribund Italian economy would spring to life if the euro fell by 30%, adjusted for inflation.

zh: 1997年，韩国经济发生崩盘，1998年毫无起色，但到了1999年，GDP大增11.1 % 。
en: In 1997, South Korea’s economy took a nosedive, and 1998 was still difficult, but GDP soared by 11.1% in 1999.

zh: 欧元是一种自由浮动货币，很少会被干预 — — 也就是说，其汇率是由市场决定的 — — 如何让它贬值取决于货币政策。
en: How the euro would be able to depreciate, given that it is a floating currency with very little intervention – that is, the exchange rate is largely market determined – depends on monetary policy.

zh: 如果欧洲央行同意放松银根，提供足够“流动性”以支持各种各样的援助计划，那么投资者会担心通胀，从而欧元会走弱。
en: If the ECB agreed to loosen monetary policy or provide enough “liquidity” to support various bailouts, investors would fear inflation, weakening the euro.

zh: 另一方面，如果欧洲央行更想让主要国家（如意大利）对其债务违约，那么欧元可能会进一步贬值，因为投资者会担心违约将蔓延。
en: On the other hand, if the ECB preferred to let major countries, such as Italy, default on their debts, this would likely weaken the euro even further, as investors feared a contagion of defaults.

zh: 贬值永远不会是欧元区官员直言不讳的选择，但从目前来看，这正是欧洲在走的路。
en: While depreciation would never be eurozone officials’ stated policy, it currently looks like all roads lead in that direction.

zh: 当然，货币贬值也不是万能灵药。
en: Of course, currency depreciation is not a panacea.

zh: 韩国当年的步子就迈得相当艰难，政府和大财阀之间冲突不断，有的财阀甚至公开违抗法律。
en: The South Korean situation also involved difficult steps, including a confrontation between the government and the largest chaebol, some of which had quite blatantly violated the law.

zh: 在一系列争锋相对后 — — 在此期间，大宇公司威胁要违约，各政治势力联手挽救 — — 政府取得了胜利；炙手可热的大宇集团破产并被重组。
en: After a series of showdowns, in which one company, Daewoo, threatened to default, and political forces rallied to its assistance, the government won; the hugely powerful Daewoo group underwent bankruptcy and restructuring.

zh: 总的来说，韩国成功地削弱了公司部门的过度权力（这给如今如何对付巨型银行提供了经验 ） 。
en: Overall, South Korea managed to curb its corporate sector’s excessive power (which holds lessons for dealing with today’s mega-banks).

zh: 类似地，欧洲需要修复其深层次结构性问题。
en: Similarly, Europe needs to fix its deeper structural problems.

zh: 欧洲需要一个财政中心 — — 正如1787年的美国需要一个联邦机构来征税。
en: It needs a fiscal center – much as the United States needed a federal authority to tax in 1787.

zh: 事实上，欧洲需要举行一次美国先发会议 — — 及其后的艰难宪法批准争论。
en: Indeed, the Europeans need the equivalent of the US Constitutional Convention – and the difficult ratification debate that followed.

zh: 但欧元一定程度的贬值有助于促进内部治理改革的实现。
en: But some depreciation of the euro would provide a bridge to reach internal governance reform.

zh: 此外，不管你喜不喜欢，欧元的压力正在与日俱增，欧洲领导人可能被迫走上贬值之路。
en: And, like it or not, rising pressure on the euro is likely to force European officials to cross it.

zh: 增长能有未来么？
en: Does Growth Have a Future?

zh: 米兰 — — 当全球正在走出近一百年来最严重的经济危机之时，我们能有什么期待么？
en: MILAN – What can we expect as the world’s economy emerges from its most serious downturn in almost a century?

zh: 简单的回答就是“全新的模式 ” ， 也就是放缓增长步伐，建立一个少一点风险，多一点稳定的金融系统，应对不同时期的一些挑战（例如能源，气候和地球人口分布的不平衡性等 ） ， 这将考验我们是否有能力管理和监控世界的经济。
en: The short answer is a “new normal,” with slower growth, a de-risked and more stable core financial system, and a set of additional challenges (energy, climate, and demographic imbalances, to name a few) with varying time horizons that will test our collective capacity to improve management and oversight of the global economy.

zh: 从中期来看，较低的增长率是很有可能的一个走向。
en: Lower growth is the best guess for the medium term.

zh: 虽然可能性很大，但没有人真正知道现实的发展是如何。
en: It seems most likely, but no one really knows.

zh: 此次金融危机来势汹汹，不仅让我们看到了全球经济增长的不稳定性，风险和不平衡性；也告诉我们，在危机发生之前，没能“预见”到不断增加的系统性风险的存在。
en: The financial crisis, morphing quickly into a global economic downturn, resulted not just from a failure to react to growing instability, risk, and imbalance, but also from a widespread pre-crisis inability to ”see” the rising systemic risk.

zh: 这些负面的影响会在接下来的几年里体现出来。
en: These defining characteristics will condition the responses and the results in coming years.

zh: 一些快速增长的国家，例如中国和印度，对其他国家的影响要大一些。
en: There are countervailing forces. The high-growth countries (China and India) are large and getting larger relative to the rest.

zh: 他们对世界经济回暖的贡献要大于一些发达国家。 但美国无疑还是全球经济回暖的龙头。
en: That alone will tend to elevate global growth compared to the world where industrial countries, and the US in particular, were in the growth driving seat.

zh: 目前的金融危机被称为全球的"资产负债表式"的萧条，之所以有如此深而广泛的破坏力，问题在于资产负债表上的金融和房屋项目上。
en: The current crisis has come to be called a “balance-sheet recession” of global scope and tremendous depth and destructive power because of its origins in the balance sheets of the financial and household sectors.

zh: 资产负债表的破坏有其特殊性。 在未来，央行和各国监管机构不能仅仅把焦点放在（货物和服务的）通胀，增长和（真实经济的）就业状况上，还需要兼顾资产负债表的变化。
en: Extreme balance-sheet destruction is what made it distinctive.  In the future, central banks and regulators will not be able to afford a narrow focus on (goods and services) inflation, growth, and employment (the real economy) while letting the balance-sheet side fend for itself.

zh: 例如对稳定性的保证，衡量资产的可持续性，金融杠杆和 资产负债表等都需要我们密切地关注。
en: Somewhere in the system, accountability for stability and sustainability in terms of asset valuation, leverage, and balance sheets will need to be assigned and taken seriously.

zh: 金融监管需要修改，关注的重点应该放在资金，外汇储备和利润等要素；对金融杠杆加以限制，以降低系统风险。 加强监管的全面性和打击国际性的套利行为等。
en: Financial re-regulation should and will emphasize capital, reserve, and margin requirements; limiting systemic risk buildup by constraining leverage; eliminating fragmented and incomplete regulatory coverage and regulatory arbitrage (a huge challenge internationally); and a focus on transparency.

zh: 关注系统的透明性，对银行系统的一些功能加以隔离和限制，这样全球的信贷市场就不那么容易崩盘。
en: Isolating and further constraining a portion of the banking system, so that the channels of credit intermediation are less prone to complete and simultaneous breakdown, also seems likely.

zh: 近期以来，运用资金的成本开始增加。 债券开始升值。
en: Relative to the recent past, the cost of capital will increase, debt will be more expensive and less ubiquitous, and risk spreads will not return to pre-crisis compressed levels.

zh: 风险的扩散也不会回到危机爆发之前的水平。 资产泡沫虽然不能消除，但也不会被金融杠杆而放大。
en: Assets bubbles will not disappear, but they will be less likely to be turbocharged by leverage.

zh: 美国消费者将会放弃以往的消费模式，开始增加储蓄，减少开支。
en: American consumers will save more and spend less, abandoning the pattern of the last few years.

zh: 全球需求上的巨大窟窿（大约至少7000亿美元）将会随着时间，通过一些经济体国家，例如中国和日本的逐步增长的消费而慢慢弥补。
en: The large hole (on the order of $700 billion or more) in global aggregate demand will have to be filled over time by a compensating increase in consumption in surplus economies, such as China and Japan.

zh: 复苏持续的时间越长，通过贸易保护主义的方法，发展中国家在全球市场上所占份额就会越大。
en: The longer this takes, the greater the incentives at the national level to capture a share of global demand via protectionist measures.

zh: 近期，发达国家和发展中国家都推出了一套刺激方案，这些贸易保护主义措施是可以理解的。
en: The recent increase in protectionist measures is an understandable political price for a range of stimulus packages in advanced and developing countries.

zh: 但这也会导致需求放慢，而且很难在短期内得到改善。
en: But such measures may increase – and will be harder to phase out over time – in the context of a shortfall in aggregate demand.

zh: 对全球不平衡性问题来说，我们要有前瞻性的眼光。
en: This is the forward-looking version of the global imbalance issue.

zh: 通过采取相互合作的政策，不管是否有效，都将对全球经济的多国激励结构产生巨大影响，从而对未来的发展产生影响。
en: Its resolution via coordinated policy action (or a failure to resolve it through such action) will have a huge impact (for good or ill) on the multinational incentive structure surrounding the global economy – and hence on its likely growth.

zh: 为了更好地监管世界经济，过去的七国或是八国峰会已经演变到了现在的20国家峰会。
en: Responsibility for overseeing the global economy is passing rapidly from the G-7/8 to the G-20, as it should.

zh: 这是件好事情，因为这20个国家的GDP占全球的90 % ， 人口占全球总人口的三分之二，所以说这样的改变是必要的。
en: The latter accounts for 90% of global GDP and two-thirds of the world’s population, so this shift is highly desirable – indeed, essential.

zh: 但这也存在一些风险，例如剩下来的三分之一人口（大多数是一些小国家）的利益如何体现出来，特别是他们在全球经济架构中的位置如何得以保证。
en: But there is a risk that the interests of the remaining one-third of the world’s people (and the majority of the small countries) will not be adequately represented as the international architecture for managing the global economy evolves.

zh: 在此次危机中，有相当多的20国集团以外的国家基本上没��什么防范：他们相对是一些小而贫穷的国家，没有可用的财政资源，缺乏外汇储备来增加市场的流动性，无法修复难看的资产负债表。
en: In the current crisis, a substantial fraction of countries outside the G-20 are essentially defenseless: small relatively poor economies, no fiscal capacity for stimulus, and inadequate reserves to offset the capital outflows that occurred to shore up damaged balance sheets in advanced markets.

zh: 在20国集团内部，存在着一些措施来保护绝大多数的公民。
en: Within the G-20 countries, there are mechanisms that attend to the interests of the most vulnerable citizens.

zh: 而在全球经济中，最容易受到伤害的是这些中小国家。
en: In the global economy, the most vulnerable are whole countries.

zh: 忽视他们的利益不仅仅是道德层面的问题，同样会引起潜在的社会经济层面的问题。
en: Inattention to their interests is not just a moral issue, but a potentially explosive social and economic one.

zh: 因此，国际经济组织的作用就需要加强，让他们有足够地权利和资源来做这些事情，这样，在未来可能发生金融经济动荡的时候，他们可以起到“断路器”的作用 ， 。
en: As a result, the world’s international economic institutions will need to be strengthened in terms of governance and resources so that they can act as circuit-breakers in the event of future financial and economic turbulence.

zh: 在此次危机中，IMF不仅资金不足，而且在一些重要的国家中缺乏公信力。 现在IMF被赋予更多的资源。
en: Entering the crisis, the International Monetary Fund was underfunded, and it continues to lack credibility and trust in certain systemically important parts of the world.

zh: 从经济危机的爆发开始，时间已经过去了8个月，我们还只是停留在临时的紧急救助计划上，而不是对整个系统进行修补。
en: It is now in the process of being better funded, but we are eight months into a crisis in which international capital flows became volatile and were driven largely by emergency responses rather than underlying economic fundamentals.

zh: 同样的，目前的核心问题还是对市场的信心，看来恢复起来还需要一定时间。
en: Thus, there remains the central question of trust and confidence in the system, which have been badly damaged and will take time to rebuild.

zh: 目前，普遍的观点是，在绝大多数国家中，金融市场已经受到严重的破坏。 但是，相对开放的市场体系仍然是有活力的，它可以增长财富，减少贫穷和增加机会。
en: At the moment, the majority view in most countries is that the financial system failed badly, but that the incentives and dynamics of the broader market-based system in a relatively open global architecture remain the best avenues for wealth creation, poverty reduction, and the expansion of opportunity.

zh: 同时，这也会产生一些不平衡和不稳定的因素，但是，我们不能在倒掉洗澡水的同时，连婴儿也一起丢掉。
en: There are, of course, dissidents, and the balance could shift quickly. It is not inconceivable that the baby will be thrown out with the bath water.

zh: 对于目前的危机没有什么灵丹妙药。
en: There is no magic bullet for today’s crisis.

zh: 我们可能采取的步骤只能是：务实而稳定的推进，在国家和国际层面上提高监管水平，增强国与国联合行动的能力，以避免单独行动和不协调的行动。
en: Pragmatic, steady progress at the national and international levels in improving the regulatory architecture and increasing our collective ability to avoid non-cooperative behavior and suboptimal equilibria, is the best course to follow.

zh: 我们也正在这么做。
en: It is the course we are on.

zh: 但目前来看，如何有一个清晰明确的路线，大家还没有什么共识。
en: But for now, it is a journey without a clearly defined, widely accepted endpoint.

zh: 卖淫合法化有用吗？
en: Does Legalizing Prostitution Work?

zh: 阿姆斯特丹－卖淫大概是荷兰个人服务业中唯一有效率的部分。
en: AMSTERDAM – Prostitution is virtually the only part of the personal services industry in the Netherlands that works.

zh: 在阿姆斯特丹，在没有提前两周预约的情况下，修个指甲都不行，但是，男性却可以在任何时候买到性 — — 并且价格还很具有吸引力。
en: One can’t get a manicure in Amsterdam without booking an appointment two weeks in advance, but men can buy sex anytime – and at an attractive price.

zh: 荷兰在2000年10月将卖淫合法化，只不过是将荷兰长期存在的容忍卖淫嫖娼的传统条文化而已。
en: The legalization of prostitution in October 2000 merely codified a long-standing Dutch tradition of tolerance towards buying and selling sex.

zh: 但是，将卖淫合法化是解决问题的正确途径吗？
en: But is legalization the right approach?

zh: 即使是在荷兰，那些出卖其身体的妇女和女孩子，也常常遭到皮条客和嫖客的威胁、殴打、强奸和恐吓。
en: Even in the Netherlands, women and girls who sell their bodies are routinely threatened, beaten, raped, and terrorized by pimps and customers.

zh: 在最近的一次刑事审判中，土裔德籍的俩兄弟被指控强迫100多位妇女到阿姆斯特丹的红灯区( De Wallen )工作。
en: In a recent criminal trial, two German-Turkish brothers stood accused of forcing more than 100 women to work in Amsterdam’s red-light district ( De Wallen ).

zh: 根据一位受害人的代理律师的说法，这些妇女中的大多数人来自被乱伦，酗酒以及父母自杀破坏的家庭，或者来自东欧或东南亚国家，受到体面工作机会的诱惑或被其父母卖掉，从而成为非法人口买卖的牺牲品。
