en: According to the attorney who represented one of the victims, most of these women come from families marred by incest, alcohol abuse, and parental suicide. Or they come from countries in Eastern Europe or Southeast Asia and have fallen victim to human trafficking, lured by decent job offers or simply sold by their parents.

zh: 这些妇女是阿姆斯特丹旅游最吸引人的地方（接下来是卖大麻的咖啡馆 ） 。
en: These women are Amsterdam’s leading tourist attraction (followed by the coffee shops that sell marijuana).

zh: 但是，这些妇女中估计有50％到90%的人事实上就是性奴隶，每天都遭到强奸而警察却袖手旁观。
en: But an estimated 50-90% of them are actually sex slaves, raped on a daily basis with police idly standing by.

zh: 她们的客人没有因为强奸而被起诉，是令人难以理解的，然而，荷兰政治家认为，妓女是不是自愿工作不能确定。
en: It is incomprehensible that their clients are not prosecuted for rape, but Dutch politicians argue that it cannot be established whether or not a prostitute works voluntarily.

zh: 因为受到这些妓女日常遭遇的惊吓，有些阿姆斯特丹刑警队的警官要求调到其他部门工作。
en: Appalled by their daily routine, police officers from the Amsterdam vice squad have asked to be transferred to other departments.

zh: 只有在今年，阿姆斯特丹市政当局才开始因为有些妓院和犯罪组织有联系，而将它们关掉。
en: Only this year, the city administration has started to close down some brothels because of their ties to criminal organizations.

zh: 根据《美国流行病学杂志》刊登的一份研究报告，妓女的平均死亡年龄是34岁。
en: According to a study published in the American Journal of Epidemiology , the average age of death of prostitutes is 34.

zh: 在美国，妓女在工作场所被杀害的机率是妇女从事的第二危险的工作 — — 在酒类专卖店的工作 — — 的51倍。
en: In the United States, the rate at which prostitutes are killed in the workplace is 51 times that of the next most dangerous occupation for women, working in a liquor store.

zh: 其他的研究显示，十个妓女中就有九个急切地想要逃离卖淫的工作。
en: Other studies show that nine out of ten prostitutes urgently want to escape the job.

zh: 几乎有一半的妓女企图自杀过至少一次。
en: Almost half have attempted suicide at least once.

zh: 在1999年，瑞典政府将卖淫非刑事犯罪化，但是，却将拉皮条或嫖娼规定为犯罪。
en: In 1999, the Swedish government decriminalized the sale of sex, but made it an offense to pimp or to buy sex.

zh: 在瑞典被称为“嫖娼法”的法律规定下，付钱买性可以通过罚款或高达六个月的监禁加以处罚，还要加上向公众曝光作为羞辱。
en: Under Sweden’s so-called “Sex Purchase Law,” paying for sex is punishable by fines or up to six months in prison, plus the humiliation of public exposure.

zh: 按照瑞典政府的说法，在瑞典的妓女数量因此而减少了40 ％ 。
en: According to the Swedish authorities, the number of prostitutes in Sweden has dropped 40% as a result.

zh: 因为生意不景气了，人口贩卖犯罪集团倾向于避开瑞典。
en: Human trafficking rings tend to avoid Sweden, because business has gone sour.

zh: 挪威，一个有提到妇女权利就会被比下去的名声的国家，仔细对比了瑞典模式和荷兰模式，确定瑞典模式是应该遵循的模式。
en: Norway, a country that has a reputation to lose when it comes to women’s rights, carefully compared the Swedish and Dutch models and concluded that Sweden’s was the one to follow.

zh: 现在，它已经相应地改变了其立法。
en: It has now changed its legislation accordingly.

zh: 瑞典模式的成功并不令人惊奇。
en: The success of the Swedish approach is not so surprising.

zh: 根据加州的一项研究，大多数嫖娼的男性都会因为公开曝光的风险而不敢嫖娼。
en: According to a study in California, most men who bought sex would be deterred by the risk of public exposure.

zh: 例如，79%的人说如果嫖娼可能会被通报给他们的家人，他们就不敢嫖娼。
en: For example, 79% said that they would be deterred if there was a chance that their families would be notified.

zh: 而高达87%的人说，如果受到警方可能将他们的照片或名字在当地报纸上公布的威胁，他们就不敢嫖娼。
en: And a whopping 87% said that they would be deterred by the threat that the police might publish their photographs or names in the local newspaper.

zh: 这些男性中的大多数人对女性表现出病态的行为。
en: Most of these men showed pathological behavior towards women.

zh: 他们中每五人就有一人承认强奸过一名妇女，而每五人中就有四人说嫖娼成瘾。
en: One in five admitted to having raped a woman, while four out of five said that going to prostitutes was an addiction.

zh: 卖淫经常被称作是“最古老的职业 ” 。
en: Prostitution is often dubbed “the oldest profession.”

zh: 但是，这仅仅是证明剥削通常易受攻击的女性（在荷兰也有少量男妓，但是，他们没有像妓女那样被皮条客兜售）的正当性的方法。
en: But this is merely a way of justifying the exploitation of mostly vulnerable women (there is also a much smaller number of male prostitutes in the Netherlands, but they are not pimped out like female prostitutes).

zh: 结束卖淫，需要领导能力和真正的性别平等观念。
en: It takes leadership and a vision of true gender equality to put an end to prostitution.

zh: 瑞典公开姓名和进行羞辱的方法完全是非荷兰式的。
en: The Swedish practice of naming and shaming is quite un-Dutch.

zh: 但是，对有些男性来说，嫖娼乐趣的一部分可能就是施加在有关的女性身上的羞辱。
en: But, for some men, part of the pleasure of buying sex may be the humiliation conferred on the woman involved.

zh: 对另一些男性来说，像纽约州前州长艾略特·斯皮策（Eliot Spitzer）那样，嫖娼最吸引人的地方可能是小心翼翼和匿名的承诺。
en: For others, like former New York Governor Eliot Spitzer, the promise of discretion and anonymity may be the most appealing aspect of buying sex.

zh: 但是，无论如何，将嫖客示众既是公正的惩罚，又是有效的威慑。
en: In any case, pillorying the clients is both a just punishment and an effective deterrent.

zh: 联合国仍有生命力么？
en: Does the UN Still Matter?

zh: 拥有192个成员国和从安全到难民再到公共卫生的包罗万象的授权，联合国是世界上唯一一个全球化组织。
en: With 192 members and a mandate that covers everything from security to refugees to public health, the United Nations is the world’s only global organization.

zh: 但在美国的民意调查表明三分之二的美国人认为联合国行事不力。 很多人认为这个组织被在萨达姆掌权时的“石油换食品”计划中所产生的腐败玷污了。
en: But polls in the United States show that two-thirds of Americans think the UN is doing a poor job, and many believe it was tarnished by corruption during the Iraq oil-for-food program under Saddam Hussein.

zh: 还有许多人认为联合国应该为中东林林总总的无法解决的问题负责。
en: Many also blame the UN for failing to solve the Middle East’s myriad problems.

zh: 但这样的观点反映出人们对联合国特点的误解。
en: But such views reflect a misunderstanding of the UN’s nature.

zh: 联合国在更大程度上是其成员国的一个工具而不是国际政治舞台上的一个独立角色。
en: The UN is more an instrument of its member states than an independent actor in world politics.

zh: 诚然，联合国秘书长潘基文可以发表演讲、召集会议并提出动议，但他所扮演的角色更多的是一位秘书而不是“长 ” 。
en: True, UN Secretary General Ban Ki Moon can make speeches, convene meetings, and propose actions, but his role is more secretary than general.

zh: 有时联合国秘书长被比作一位“世俗的教皇 ” ， 他可以运用说服的软实力，但在经济或军事的硬实力方面却很难有所作为。
en: Sometimes likened to a “secular Pope,” the UN Secretary General can wield the soft power of persuasion but little hard economic or military power.

zh: 联合国所拥有的硬实力必须从其成员国求借而来。
en: What hard power the UN has must be begged and borrowed from the member states.

zh: 而当成员国们不能就某项动议达成一致时，联合国也就举步维艰了。
en: And when they cannot agree on a course of action, it is difficult for the organization to operate.

zh: 正如有人不无诙谐地说 ： “ 我们已经碰到过联合国了，我们就是联合国！
en: As one wag has put it, “We have met the UN and it is us!”

zh: ”成员国应该为联合国所受的责难承担相当的责任。
en: When blame is assigned, much of it belongs to the members.

zh: 就拿石油换食品计划来说吧。 该计划是成员国为缓解在针对萨达姆政权所进行的禁运给伊拉克人造成的伤害而设计的。
en: Consider the oil for food program, which was designed by member states to provide relief to Iraqis hurt by sanctions against Saddam’s regime.

zh: 联合国秘书处在监控计划进行方面的工作不到位，其间还产生了腐败行为。
en: The secretariat did an inadequate job of monitoring the program and some corruption was involved.

zh: 被萨达姆挪作他用的更大部分资金反映了各成员国政府对该计划的设计。 它们对这种滥用职权的行为故意熟视无睹。
en: But the much larger sums that Saddam diverted for his own purposes reflected how the member governments designed the program, and they chose to turn a blind eye to the abuse.

zh: 然而，该计划的问题却被新闻界扭曲为“联合国的错。 ”
en: Yet the program’s problems are portrayed in the press as “the UN’s fault.

zh: 整个联合国系统的成本约为每年200亿美元，这比华尔街在一个景气的年份所派发的红利都要少。
en: The cost of the entire UN system is about $20 billion, or less than the annual bonuses paid out in a good year on Wall Street.

zh: 在总预算中，位于纽约的秘书处所得到的仅占10 % 。
en: Of that sum, the secretariat in New York accounts for a mere 10%.

zh: 有些大学的年预算都比这要多。
en: Some universities have larger budgets.

zh: 另有70亿美元用于支持联合国在如民主刚果共和国、黎巴嫩、海地和巴尔干等地进行的维和行动。
en: Another $7 billion supports UN peacekeeping forces in places like the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Lebanon, Haiti, and the Balkans.

zh: 剩下的预算—一半以上—都由联合国的特别机构开支掉了。 这些机构分布于世界各地，通常在管理全球贸易、发展、卫生和人道主义援助方面发挥着重要作用。
en: The rest – more than half – is spent by the UN’s specialized agencies, which are located around the world and often play an important role in managing global trade, development, health, and humanitarian assistance.

zh: 例如，联合国难民署帮助解决难民问题；世界粮食计划署为营养不良的儿童提供帮助；而世界卫生组织则支持公共卫生信息系统。 这些系统对应对来自于禽流感等流行性疾病的威胁至关重要。
en: For example, the UN High Commission for Refugees helps to alleviate the problems of displaced persons, the World Food Program provides assistance to malnourished children, and the World Health Organization supports the public health information systems that are crucial for dealing with threats from pandemics like avian flu.

zh: 联合国没有资源解决如艾滋病或全球气候变化等新问题，但它在敦促各国政府采取行动方面可以起到重要的召集者的作用。
en: The UN does not have the resources to solve the problems in new areas like AIDS or global climate change, but it can play an important convening role in galvanizing the actions of governments.

zh: 即便在安全方面，联合国仍然发挥着重要作用。
en: Even in the area of security, the UN retains an important role.

zh: 在1945年制定的最初的集体安全概念里，各国应该联合起来阻止并惩罚侵略者。 这一概念由于苏联和西方在冷战时期的敌对而未能实现。
en: The original 1945 concept of collective security, by which states would band together to deter and punish aggressors, failed because the Soviet Union and the West were at loggerheads during the Cold War.

zh: 当多个国家的联盟共同行动在1991年将萨达姆驱逐出科威特以后，在很短的一段时间里，集体安全的最初概念似乎会成为一种“世界新秩序 ” 。
en: For a brief moment after a broad coalition of countries acted together to force Saddam Hussein out of Kuwait in 1991, it looked like the original concept of collective security would become “a new world order.”

zh: 但这样的希望只是昙花一现。
en: Such hopes were short-lived.

zh: 1999年的科索沃和2003年的伊拉克问题都证明了在联合国内部不能达成共识。
en: Consensus within the UN proved unachievable on both Kosovo in 1999 and Iraq in 2003.

zh: 怀疑者们总结说联合国已变得与安全问题无关。
en: Skeptics concluded that the UN had become irrelevant for security questions.

zh: 然而在2006年，当以色列与真主党在黎巴嫩的冲突陷入僵局时，各成员国又忙不迭地寻求联合国维和部队的介入。
en: Yet in 2006, when Israel and Hezbollah fought to a stalemate in Lebanon, states were only too happy to turn to a UN peacekeeping force.

zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，维和行动并未出现在最初的宪章里。
en: Ironically, peacekeeping was not specified in the original charter.

zh: 它是由第二任秘书长Dag Hammarskjold和加拿大外交部长Lester Pearson于英法在1956年的苏伊士危机中入侵埃及后所发明的。
en: It was invented by the second Secretary-General, Dag Hammarskjold, and Canadian Foreign Minister Lester Pearson after Britain and France invaded Egypt in the Suez crisis of 1956.

zh: 从那以后，联合国维和部队已经执行了超过60次的任务。
en: Since then, UN peacekeeping forces have been deployed more than 60 times.

zh: 现��有来自于不同国家的约10万名士兵在世界各地佩戴着联合国的蓝色头盔。
en: There are now roughly 100,000 troops from various countries wearing UN blue helmets around the world.

zh: 维和行动也经历了起起落落。
en: Peacekeeping has had its ups and downs.

zh: 波斯尼亚和卢旺达是1990年代的失败。 时任联合国秘书长的科菲•安南便提出了维和计划改革的动议，以应对种族灭绝和大屠杀的问题。
en: Bosnia and Rwanda were failures in the 1990’s, and then Secretary General Kofi Annan proposed reforms to deal with genocide and mass killings.

zh: 在2005年9月的联合国大会上，各成员国接受了对弱势族群的“保护责任 ” 。
en: In September 2005, the states in the UN General Assembly accepted the existence of a “responsibility to protect” vulnerable peoples.

zh: 也就是说，各国政府不能再对其公民为所欲为了。
en: In other words, governments could no longer treat their citizens however they wanted.

zh: 联合国还为此设立了一个新的“和平建设委员会”以协调防止种族清洗行为再度发生的行动。
en: A new Peace-building Commission was also created to coordinate actions that could help prevent a recurrence of genocidal acts.

zh: 例如在东帝汶独立的过渡进程中，联合国就发挥了至关重要的作用。 它现在正为布隆迪和塞拉利昂的政府制定相关计划。
en: In East Timor, for example, the UN proved vital in the transition to independence, and it is now working out plans for the governments of Burundi and Sierra Leone.

zh: 在民主刚果共和国，维和部队虽然未能阻止所有的暴力，但却帮助拯救了生命。
en: In the DRC, peacekeeping forces have not been able to curb all violence, but they have helped to save lives.

zh: 现在的考验就是苏丹达尔福尔地区的局势。 在那里，外交官们正试图建立一支由联合国和非洲联盟共同领导下的维和部队。
en: The current test case is the situation in Sudan’s Darfur region, where diplomats are trying to establish a joint peacekeeping force under the UN and the African Union.

zh: 在伊拉克战争后已将联合国妖魔化的有毒政治空气中，广泛的幻灭感也不足为奇。
en: In the poisonous political atmosphere that has bedeviled the UN after the Iraq War, widespread disillusionment is not surprising.

zh: 潘基文的担子不轻。
en: Ban Ki Moon has a tough job.

zh: 但各个成员国很可能会发现他们需要联合国这样一个拥有独特的召集和合法化力量的全球化工具，而不应该对其提出质疑。
en: But, rather than calling the UN into question, states are likely to find that they need such a global instrument, with its unique convening and legitimizing powers.

zh: 虽然联合国的体系远非完美，但没有它这个世界将会更加贫穷和混乱。
en: While the UN system is far from perfect, the world would be a poorer and more disorderly place without it.

zh: 超级美元的衰败
en: Dog Days For The Super Dollar

zh: 如果美元丧失其超级货币的地位，美国作为世界主导超级大国的地位是否会随之动摇呢？
en: CAMBRIDGE -- Is the United States’ position as the world’s dominant superpower at risk if the dollar loses its super-currency status?

zh: 可能不会，但是，如果美元从霸主位置跌落，美国人肯定会发现其全球霸权将会大为费钱。
en: Maybe not, but Americans will certainly find global hegemony a lot more expensive if the dollar falls off its perch.

zh: 知道目前，美国人通过从轻易受到影响的外国人那里廉价借钱并且把钱投资于高回报的外国资产、土地以及债券而攫取利润。
en: Until now, Americans have been raking in profits by borrowing cheaply from pliant foreigners and investing the money in high-yield foreign equities, land, and bonds.

zh: 如果把资本收益计算进去，那么，在最近几年中，美国人每年获得了大致3000亿美元到4000亿美元的利润，这一数目大体相当于美国整个军事预算。
en: Counting capital gains, Americans have profited to the tune of $300 billion to $400 billion annually in many recent years – an amount roughly equivalent to the entire US military budget.

zh: 法国前总统德斯坦曾经引人注目地抱怨美国的“嚣张特权 ” 。
en: Former French president Valéry Giscard d’Estaing once famously complained about America’s “exorbitant privilege.”

zh: 美国似乎可以让世界充斥美元货币和债务，而不必为更高的通货膨胀或者利率而付出代价。 德斯坦对此十分气恼。
en: D’Estaing was incensed that the US seemed to be able to flood the world with dollar currency and debt without ever seeming to pay a price in terms of higher inflation or interest rates.

zh: 价值8000亿美元的货币供应中至少有一半是在外国持有，主要是在世界上的地下经济。
en: At least half the $800 billion US currency supply is held abroad, mainly in the world’s underground economy.

zh: 但是，中日两国中央银行持有巨额低息美元债务，而美国人则用风险资本、私人股本以及投资银行在世界上横冲直撞，赚取巨额收益。 这才是真正大钱所在。
en: But the really big bucks come from the fact that places like the People’s Bank of China and the Bank of Japan passively hold enormous volumes of low-interest US debt, while Americans romp around the world with venture capital, private equity, and investment banks, reaping huge gains.

zh: 美国风光了一阵，而美国的金融霸主肯定消除了作为超级大国的负担。
en: It has been a great ride for the US, and America’s financial supremacy has certainly eased the burden of being a superpower.

zh: 但是，在美国次级房贷危机已经正在下滑的美元当中，美国的嚣张特权现在似乎有点不稳了。
en: But, between the sub-prime US mortgage crisis and the dollar’s ongoing decline, America’s exorbitant privilege now looks a bit shaky.

zh: 在过去五年中，美元已经贬值25 % 。 如果美国经济衰退(目前的机率是一半对一半 ) ， 美元还会贬值更多。
en: The dollar is already down 25% over the past five years, and if the US tips into recession – a 50/50 chance right now -- the dollar is going to drop a lot more.

zh: 外国投资者们已经开始重新分配他们的投资组合，将货币转换成欧元、英镑，甚至是新兴市场国家货币例如巴西的雷亚尔和南非的兰特。
en: Foreign investors are already reshuffling their portfolios, moving into euros, pounds, and even emerging-market currencies like the Brazilian real and the South African rand.

zh: 饱受争议的“国家财富基金”为中东、亚洲、俄国以及其他地方的各国政府投资。 它们只是从低回报并且迅速贬值的美元债券中转移并寻求替代投资的表象之一。
en: Controversial “sovereign wealth funds,” which invest funds for governments in the Middle East, Asia, Russia, and elsewhere, are just one manifestation of the search for alternatives to low-yielding, rapidly depreciating, dollar bonds.

zh: 即使没有投资组合转移，美国人也不应该指望他们近年来的运气可以在今后保持。
en: Even without any portfolio shift, Americans shouldn’t expect their recent luck to hold up in the future.

zh: 如果出现全世界的经济下滑，任何买空股票以及卖空债券的地区都会损失惨重。
en: If there is a global downturn, any region that is long stocks and short bonds is going to get burned.

zh: 不幸的是，美国的决策者们面临美元地位日益增长的风险不仅不扶持美国的主要出口，而是似乎更愿意竭力加以利用。
en: Unfortunately, faced with the growing risks to the dollar’s status, American policymakers, rather than nursing the country’s premier export, seem to be more interested in milking it.

zh: 美国政府本身通过大量的赤字已经受益。
en: The US government itself has taken advantage by running vast deficits.

zh: 对于汇率问题，美联储似乎只是关心其对于经济增长和通货膨胀的影响，而当前，疲软的美元正在促进美国的出口。
en: The Federal Reserve appears to care about exchange rates only to the extent that they affect growth and inflation, and right now the weak dollar is helping US exports.

zh: 最后但是不是最为次要的一点是，美国的税收政策根本不鼓励私有部门的储蓄，特别是给房地产以税收优惠。
en: Last but not least, US tax policy hardly encourages private-sector savings, especially giving the preferential tax treatment of real estate.

zh: 我和加州大学伯克利分校的奥茨菲尔德教授一段时间以来一直警告说，如果不加以积极主动的政策调整，美元有可能会大幅度崩盘，并且伴随许多风险。
en: Professor Maury Obstfeld of the University of California at Berkeley and I have been warning for some time that without pro-active policy adjustments, the dollar is vulnerable to a sharp collapse, with many attendant risks.

zh: 不幸的是，这一局面似乎正在显现。
en: Unfortunately, that scenario now seems to be unfolding.

zh: 仅仅在今年，与美国的主要贸易伙伴相比，美元的购买力价值已经下降了10 % ， 而且在2008年可能还会下降这么多。 而如果全球的投资者们决定从美元脱身，美元下跌可能会更快。
en: This year alone, the dollar’s value has fallen by another 10% in purchasing power terms against America’s major trading partners, and it could fall at the same rate in 2008 – or faster if global investors decide to cut and run.

zh: 在中国总理、石油输出国组织各国领导人以及世界上最富有的超级模特都对美元表示担忧的时候，你就可以知道我们将会面临崎岖不平的道路。
en: When the Chinese premier, OPEC heads of state, and the world’s richest supermodel all express concern about the dollar, you can be sure we are in for a bumpy ride.

zh: 美国人的好消息是，世界交易和金融体系存在巨大的惰性。
en: The good news for Americans is that there is enormous inertia in the world trading and financial system.

zh: 历经几十年和两次世界大战英镑才失去其超级货币地位。
en: It took many decades and two world wars before the British pound lost its super-currency status.

zh: 现在美元还没有任何明显的继任者。
en: Nor is there any obvious successor to the dollar yet.

zh: 确实，次级房贷危机让欧洲的金融体系看起来也和美国的一样弱不禁风。
en: Indeed, the sub-prime crisis has made the European financial system look just as vulnerable as that of the US.

zh: 同样道理，尽管人民币可能在50年内称雄世界，但是中国百病丛生的金融体系不会让它马上就加冕。
en: Likewise, while the Chinese Yuan might be king in 50 years, China’s moribund financial system will prevent it from being crowned anytime soon.

zh: 即使某些石油输出国组织领导人像委内瑞拉的查维斯公开地呼吁打击美元，绝大部分世界贸易还是以美元计价的。
en: A huge share of world trade is denominated in dollars, even if some OPEC presidents, such as Venezuela’s Hugo Chávez, openly preach mutiny.

zh: 各国中央银行所持有的外汇储备的一半以上依然是美元。
en: Central banks still hold more than 50% of their foreign exchange reserves in dollars.

zh: 但是还有很多危险信号。
en: But danger signs abound.

zh: 除非美国立即行动起来，否则，其超级货币霸主的地位就会大为减损。
en: Unless the US gets its act together soon, it may find the value of its super-currency franchise much diminished.

zh: 美国的纳税人一贯以痛恨加税著称，他们可能会开始考虑美国超级大国地位的实际的经济代价。
en: American voters, who are famously loathe to increase taxes, might start thinking a lot harder about the real economic costs of their country’s superpower status.

zh: 更好地解决气候变化问题
en: Doing Better on Climate Change

zh: 洛杉矶 — — 我们经常听到，应对全球变暖是我们这个时代的确定任务。
en: Los Angeles – Tackling global warming, we are often told, is the defining task of our age.

zh: 一大群权威学者告诉我们必须刻不容缓地大幅度降低排放。
en: An army of pundits tells us that we need to cut emissions, and cut them immediately and drastically.

zh: 但是这种说法显然正在丧失人心。
en: But this argument is clearly losing the battle for hearts and minds.

zh: 根据最新的皮尤调查，全球变暖已经成为美国人最不看重的政策问题。
en: Global warming has now become the lowest-priority policy problem among Americans, according to a new Pew survey.

zh: 另一项皮尤调查则显示全世界最大的排放国中国比美国更不看重全球变暖问题。 只有24%的中国人认为全球变暖是一个严重问题，中国也因此成为全世界最不看重全球变暖的国家。
en: Another Pew survey showed that China, the world's biggest emitter, cares even less than the US about global warming.  Just 24% of Chinese regard global warming as a very serious problem, making China the world's least concerned country.

zh: 在英国，一项Opinium公司的调查显示多数选民认为环境税的主要目的是聚敛钱财，而不是保护环境，而10个受调查者中有7个不愿为应对气候变化缴纳更多赋税。
en: In the UK, an Opinium survey shows that most voters think green taxes are mainly for raising cash rather than the environment, and 7 out of 10 are not willing to pay more in taxes to combat climate change.

zh: 与此同时，全球变暖问题拟议中的解决方案糟糕透顶。
en: At the same time, the proposed solutions for the problem of global warming have been awful.

zh: 1992年在里约热内卢，来自富裕国家的政界人士承诺到2000年降低排放，但却没有履行。
en: In Rio de Janeiro in 1992, politicians from wealthy countries promised to cut emissions by 2000, but did no such thing.

zh: 1997年领导人在京都再次会面，承诺到2010年执行更严格的碳减排政策，但碳排放量却持续攀升，而《京都议定书》在改变现状方面几乎不起任何作用。
en: Leaders met again in Kyoto in 1997 and promised even stricter carbon cuts by 2010, yet emissions keep increasing, and Kyoto has done virtually nothing to change that.

zh: 更悲惨的是当今年12月领导人在哥本哈根会面的时候，他们还将拿出更多一模一样的方案：再一次做出不大可能真正兑现的彻底的减排承诺。
en: What is most tragic is that when leaders meet in Copenhagen this December, they will embrace more of the same solution: promises of even more drastic emission reductions that, once again, are unlikely to be fulfilled.

zh: 即使在最好的时候，不断在付出巨大代价的情况下承诺过高而又无所作为也无法赢得民心，更何况现在显然谈不上是最好的时候。
en: Measures that consistently over-promise and under-achieve at vast cost do not win hearts and minds in the best of times. And this is manifestly not the best of times.

zh: 幸运的是，我们有更好的选择，获取成功的几率要高得多：我们应该把像太阳能那样的低碳能源发展成旧有能源真正有竞争力的替代品，而不是让它们成为想感觉更加“绿色”的富人的保留节目。
en: Fortunately, we have a much better option, with a much better chance of success: we should make low-carbon energy sources like solar power become a real, competitive alternative to old energy sources, instead of the preserve of rich people who want to feel “greener.”

zh: 因此我们应当对新技术发明进行有效的投资。
en: We should therefore invest on an effective scale in inventing new technology.

zh: 与人们想象的恰恰相反 ， 《 京都议定书》并没有促进这方面的研究。
en: Contrary to what one would imagine, the Kyoto Protocol has not prompted this research.

zh: 实际上，科研投资从20世纪80年代就开始下降，并且从那以后就没有上升过，即使在《京都议定书》的缔约国中也同样如此。
en: Indeed, research investment has plummeted since the 1980’s and has actually not increased since, even among Kyoto-participating countries.

zh: 大规模投资于低碳能源、太阳能或其他新技术的研发很快就会使新能源价格低于化石燃料。
en: Investing heavily in research and development of low-carbon energy, solar power, or other new technologies would become cheaper than fossil fuels much more quickly.

zh: 效益估算显示每耗费1美元投资，我们就能取得16美元的效益价值。
en: Economic estimates show that for every $1 spent, we would do $16 worth of good.

zh: 所有国家都应该同意拿出国内生产总值的0.05%用于低碳能源的研究与开发。 这样全球总开支将会比目前的替代能源研究开支高出15倍，即便如此依然比《京都议定书》低6倍之多。
en: Every country should agree to spend 0.05% of its GDP on low-carbon energy R&D. The total global cost would be 15 times higher than current spending on alternative energy research, yet six times lower than the cost of Kyoto.

zh: 如此性质的一份协议将成为全世界新的《京都议定书 》 — —主要的不同是这份协议会真正发挥作用，得到全世界认可的机会也更高。
en: An agreement of this nature could be the new Kyoto treaty for the world – the principal difference being that this protocol would actually make a difference and stand a good chance of global acceptance.

zh: 为什么不双管齐下：一方面投资于研发，另��方面继续承诺降低碳排放？
en: Why not do both: invest in R&D, but still promise to cut carbon emissions now?

zh: 京都议定书式的政策永远只能是摆脱化石燃料道路上让我们付出惨痛代价的歧途。
en: Kyoto-style policies can only ever be an expensive distraction from the real business of weaning us off fossil fuels.

zh: 有两个根本原因决定了在应对全球变暖过程中把重点放在降低碳排放是错误的选择。
en: There are two fundamental reasons why a focus on reducing carbon emissions is the wrong response to global warming.

zh: 首先，使用化石燃料仍然是发展中国家唯一的一条脱贫致富路。
en: First, using fossil fuels remains the only way out of poverty for developing countries.

zh: 煤炭提供了全世界能源需求的半数。
en: Coal provides half of the world’s energy.

zh: 在中国和印度，煤炭占到总发电量的80%之多，它们帮助中国和印度的劳工过上了他们的父辈难以想象的高质量生活。
en: In China and India, it accounts for about 80% of power generation, and is helping Chinese and Indian laborers enjoy a quality of life that their parents could barely imagine.

zh: 限制排放因此意味着为数亿人的成功故事画上句号。
en: Capping emissions means, effectively, ending this success story for hundreds of millions of people.

zh: 还没有哪种“绿色”能源能在不远的将来便宜到可以替代煤炭的应用。
en: There is no “green” energy source that is affordable enough to replace coal in the near future.

zh: 相反，我们大规模的研究努力将在本世纪中叶使绿色能源低于化石燃料的价格。
en: Instead, our upsized research will make green energy cheaper than fossil fuels by mid-century.

zh: 其次，立即降低碳排放非常昂贵 — — 其所需的成本远远超过了相关的收效。
en: Second, immediate carbon cuts are expensive – and the cost significantly outweighs the benefits.

zh: 如果本世纪《京都议定书》彻底得到落实，它只能使温度降低微乎其微的0.2oC（合0.3°F ） ， 而每年却必须付出高达1800亿美元的代价。
en: If the Kyoto agreement had been fully implemented throughout this century, it would have cut temperatures only by an insignificant 0.2°C (0.3°F), at a cost of $180 billion every year.

zh: 从经济的角度讲 ， 《 京都议定书》每投资1美元只能产生约30美分的效益。
en: In economic terms, Kyoto only does about 30 cents worth of good for each dollar spent.

zh: 而像欧盟提出的更深层次的碳减排目标 — — 即12年后比20世纪90年代降低20 % — —只能在付出10万亿美元成本的前提下，实现全球温度截止2100年降低六十分之一摄氏度（约合三十分之一华氏度 ） 。
en: And deeper emissions cuts like those proposed by the European Union – 20% below 1990 levels within 12 years – would reduce global temperatures by only one-sixtieth of one degree Celsius (one-thirtieth of one degree Fahrenheit) by 2100, at a cost of $10 trillion.

zh: 这样1美元产生的效益只有区区4美分。
en: For every dollar spent, we would do just four cents worth of good.

zh: 全球变暖争论最不可救药的问题是几乎所有的主要倡导人物 — — 政治家、竞选者和学者权威 — — 都已经知道今年12月哥本哈根谈判桌上的旧式协议对温度可以产生忽略不计的效果。
en: The saddest thing about the global warming debate is that nearly all of the key protagonists – politicians, campaigners, and pundits – already know that the old-style agreement that is on the table for Copenhagen this December will have a negligible effect on temperatures.

zh: 除非我们改变方向，让我们的所作所为切实可行，否则今年12月在哥本哈根的“成功”宣言将会毫无意义已经再清楚不过。
en: Unless we change direction and make our actions realistic and achievable, it is already clear that the declarations of “success” in Copenhagen this December will be meaningless.

zh: 我们将会做出承诺。
en: We will make promises.

zh: 但我们不会履行承诺。
en: We will not keep them.

zh: 我们将浪费另外10年的光阴。
en: And we will waste another decade.

zh: 恰恰相反，我们必须挑战《京都议定书》的正统提法。
en: Instead, we must challenge the orthodoxy of Kyoto.

zh: 我们有能力做得更好。
en: We can do better.

zh: 更好地发展
en: Doing Development Better

zh: 美国剑桥—金墉被任命为世行行长或许是意料中事，长期以来，这个位子都是美国人的特权。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Jim Yong Kim’s appointment as World Bank president may have been predictable, given the long-standing tradition that renders the selection an American prerogative.

zh: 但仅仅是金墉需要与另两名候选者奥孔乔-伊韦拉和奥坎波竞争这个事实便已表明在发展政策领域存在深刻的分歧，因为金墉和两位竞争对手的观点是完全不同的。
en: But even the appearance of competition between Kim and the other candidates, Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala and José Antonio Ocampo, served to expose a deep fissure within the field of development policy, because Kim and his two rivals represented dramatically different approaches.

zh: 金墉的观点是自下而上。
en: The vision for which Kim stands is bottom-up.

zh: 他直接关注穷人，关注向贫困社区提供服务（如教育、卫生和微信贷 ） 。
en: It focuses directly on the poor, and on delivering services – for example, education, health care, and microcredit – to their communities.

zh: 这一传统的信条可以用“发展就是一步一个脚印”来概括。
en: This tradition’s motto could be, “Development is accomplished one project at a time.”

zh: 奥孔乔-伊韦拉和奥坎波代表了另一种观点，这种观点将着眼于整个经济。
en: The other approach, represented by Okonjo-Iweala and Ocampo, takes an economy-wide approach.

zh: 它强调影响整个经济环境的广泛的改革，因此关注国际贸易、金融、宏观经济学和治理等领域。
en: It emphasizes broad reforms that affect the overall economic environment, and thus focuses on areas such as international trade, finance, macroeconomics, and governance.

zh: 第一种观点的实践者偶像是非政府组织领袖，如微金融领域先驱、格莱珉银行创始者尤努斯和印度自由职业女性联合会（Self-Employment Women’s Association，SEWA）创始人伊拉·巴特（Ela Bhatt ） 。
en: Practitioners in the first group idolize NGO leaders like Mohammad Yunus, whose Grameen Bank pioneered microfinance, and Ela Bhatt, a founder of India’s Self-Employment Women’s Association (SEWA).

zh: 第二种观点的偶像则是具有改革精神的财政和经济部长，如印度的曼莫汉·辛格（Manmohan Singh）和巴西的卡多佐。
en: The heroes of the second group are reformist finance or economy ministers such as India’s Manmohan Singh or Brazil’s Fernando Henrique Cardoso.

zh: 乍一看，这无非是又一场经济学家和非经济学家之争，但分歧其实在于学科分野之内，而不是之间。
en: At first sight, this might seem like another dispute between economists and non-economists, but the rift runs within, rather than between, disciplinary boundaries.

zh: 比如，最近如星火燎原般成为发展经济学热门的田野实验和随机控制试验（RCT）便严格地属于自下而上的发展传统。
en: For example, recent work with field experiments and randomized controlled trials (RCTs), which has caught on like wildfire among development economists, lies strictly in the tradition of bottom-up development.

zh: 两种观点的相对效率很难判断。
en: The relative effectiveness of the two visions is not easy to determine.

zh: 宏观方法的支持者指出，最成功的发展通常是整体经济改革的结果。
en: Proponents of the macro approach point out that the greatest development successes have typically been the product of economy-wide reforms.

zh: 中国（以及其他东亚地区韩国和中国台湾）在二三十年间就能取得如此重大的减贫成果，很大程度上要归功于经济管理的改善（早先在教育和卫生方面的投资也起着同样重要的作用 ） 。
en: The dramatic reductions in poverty achieved by China over the span of a few decades, as well as by other East Asian countries like South Korea and Taiwan, resulted largely from improved economic management (as much as earlier investments in education and health may have played a role).

zh: 激励和产权安排方面的改革，而不是减贫计划，才是让经济腾飞的动力。
en: Reforms in incentives and property-rights arrangements, not anti-poverty programs, enabled these economies to take off.

zh: 麻烦在于，这些经验并没有如人们所愿那样为其他国家起到榜样性的作用。
en: The trouble is that these experiences have not proved as informative for other countries as one might have wished.

zh: 亚洲式改革并不放之四海而皆准，且关于具体政策的作用也存在重大争议。
en: Asian-style reforms do not travel well, and, in any case, there is significant controversy about the role of specific policies.

zh: 特别是，亚洲奇迹的关键到底是经济自由化还是给经济自由化加以限度？
en: In particular, was the key to the Asian miracle economic liberalization or the limits that were placed on it?

zh: 此外，宏观传统在跨国证据支持力有限的具体建议 （ “ 实行统一的低关税 ” 、 “取消银行利率上限 ” 、 “改善你的‘做生意’排名 ” ） 和缺少操作内容的笼统建议 （ “ 融入世界经济 ” 、 “追求宏观经济稳定 ” 、 “改善契约执行 ” ） 之间摇摆不定。
en: Moreover, the macro tradition vacillates between specific recommendations (“set low and uniform tariffs,” “remove interest-rate ceilings on banks,” “improve your ‘doing business’ ranking”) that find limited support in cross-country evidence, and broad recommendations that lack operational content (“integrate into world economy,” “achieve macroeconomic stability,” “improve contract enforcement”).

zh: 站在自己的立场上，自下而上传统的发展专家可以面无愧色地宣称，成功需要用教育、公共卫生或具体环境下的微信贷项目的效率来证明。
en: Development specialists in the bottom-up tradition, for their part, can deservedly claim success in demonstrating the effectiveness of education, public health, or microcredit projects in specific contexts.

zh: 但这些项目往往治标不治本。
en: But, too often, such projects treat poverty’s symptoms rather than its causes.

zh: 减贫的最佳办法往往不是帮助贫困者在现有生计方面做得更好，而是要让他们从事不同的生计。
en: Poverty is often best addressed not by helping the poor to be better at what they are already doing, but by getting them to do something altogether different.

zh: 这就需要生产的多样化、城市化和工业化，而这些反过来有要求看起来与扶贫相去甚远的政策干预（比如修正监管规则和为货币价值定位 ） 。
en: This calls for diversification of production, urbanization, and industrialization, which in turn require policy interventions that may lie at considerable distance from the poor (such as fixing regulations or targeting the value of the currency).

zh: 此外，与宏观层面的经济改革一样，具体项目所能提供的经验也相当有限。
en: Moreover, as with macro-level economic reforms, there are limits to what can be learned from individual projects.

zh: 在具体条件下进行的随机控制试验无法产生可供条件不同的决策者参考的有用硬经验。
en: An RCT conducted under specific conditions does not generate usable hard evidence for policymakers in other settings.

zh: 参考经验需要做一定程度的外推，将得自硬经验的随机评估转换为软经验。
en: Learning requires some degree of extrapolation, converting randomized evaluations from hard evidence into soft evidence.

zh: 好消息是，在发展政策方面已经取得了世纪进步，而且在意识形态不同的背后也存在一定程度的趋同 — — 不是关于什么才是有用的，而是关于我们应该怎��看待发展政策。
en: The good news is that there has been real progress in development policy, and, beneath the doctrinal differences, is a certain convergence – not on what works, but on how we should think about and do development policy.

zh: 两种传统的最佳新近成果所指向的预期是相同的，均赞成诊断式、实用性、实验性、具体环境具体分析的策略。
en: The best of the recent work in the two traditions shares common predilections. Both favor diagnostic, pragmatic, experimental, and context-specific strategies.

zh: 传统发展政策有跟风倾向，总是从一个大方向倒向另一个大方向。
en: Conventional development policy has been prone to fads, moving from one big fix to another.

zh: 政府干预过少、政府干预过多、信贷不足、产权缺位等等，这些东西都会阻碍发展。
en: Development is held back by too little government, too much government, too little credit, the absence of property rights, and so on.

zh: 补救措施是规划、华盛顿共识、微信贷以及让穷人获得地权。
en: The remedy is planning, the Washington Consensus, microcredit, or distributing land titles to the poor.

zh: 与此相对的是，新办法采取了不可知论的立场，承认我们并不知道什么会起作用，并认为束缚发展的约束往往要具体问题具体分析。
en: By contrast, the new approaches are agnostic. They acknowledge that we do not know what works, and that the binding constraints to development tend to be context-specific.

zh: 政策实验是发现过程的核心同时需辅之以监控和评估，以缩短学习循环。
en: Policy experimentation is a central part of discovery, coupled with monitoring and evaluation to close the learning loop.

zh: 实验并不一定得是随机控制试验，毫无疑问，中国就在没有合适控制组的情况下从政策实验中学到了很多经验。
en: Experiments do not need to be of the RCT type; China certainly learned from its policy experiments without a proper control group.

zh: 这一类型的改革者不相信有“最佳实践”和普适方案。
en: Reformers in this mold are suspicious of “best practices” and universal blueprints.

zh: 他们的着眼点在于适合本地经济和政治环境或大或小的政策创新。
en: They look instead for policy innovations, small and large, that are tailored to local economic circumstances and political complications.

zh: 发展政策领域可以也应该重新统一，以共享诊断式具体分析方法为中心。
en: The field of development policy can and should be reunified around these shared diagnostic, contextual approaches.

zh: 宏观发展经济学家需要认识到实验方法的优势，接受热衷于随机化评估的政策方法。
en: Macro-development economists need to recognize the advantages of the experimental approach and adopt the policy mindset of enthusiasts of randomized evaluation.

zh: 微观发展经济学家需要认识到，你可以从各种经验中学习，尽管随机化评估非常有用，但其效果通常局限于狭窄的适用范围。
en: Micro-development economists need to recognize that one can learn from diverse types of evidence, and that, while randomized evaluations are tremendously useful, the utility of their results is often restricted by the narrow scope of their application.

zh: 最后，两大阵营应该更加谦逊：宏观发展实践者不能思而不学，微观发展实践者不能学而不思。
en: In the end, both camps should show greater humility: macro-development practitioners about what they already know, and micro-development practitioners about what they can learn.

zh: 美元和牢骚
en: The Dollar and its Discontents

zh: 布鲁塞尔—美国总统特朗普的单边主义正在给世界造成不可逆转的深远影响。
en: BRUSSELS – US President Donald Trump’s unilateralism is reshaping the world in profound and irreversible ways.

zh: 他正在破坏多边机构的运行。
en: He is undermining the working of multilateral institutions.

zh: 至于其他国家，则不再把美国视为可靠的盟友，感到不得不发展自己的地缘政治实力。
en: Other countries, for their part, no longer regard the United States as a reliable alliance partner and feel impelled to develop their own geopolitical capabilities.

zh: 现在，特朗普政府正在削弱美元的全球作用。
en: Now the Trump administration is eroding the dollar’s global role.

zh: 他单方面重启了对伊朗制裁，威胁要惩罚与伊斯兰共和国做生意的公司，不准它们在美国银行有往来。
en: Having unilaterally reimposed sanctions on Iran, it is threatening to penalize companies doing business with the Islamic Republic by denying them access to US banks.

zh: 这是一个严重的威胁，因为美国银行是跨境贸易的主要美元来源。
en: The threat is serious because US banks are the main source of dollars used in cross-border transactions.

zh: 据世界银行间金融通讯协会（SWIFT）的数据，跨境支付总额的近一半使用美元进行，这一比例远大于美国占世界经济的比例。
en: According to the Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT), dollars are used in nearly half of all cross-border payments, a share far greater than the weight of the US in the world economy.

zh: 作为对特朗普政府立场的回应，德国、法国和英国联合俄罗斯和中国，宣布计划准备绕开美元、美国银行和美国政府的审查。
en: In response to the Trump administration’s stance, Germany, France, and Britain, together with Russia and China, have announced plans to circumvent the dollar, US banks, and US government scrutiny.

zh: “计划”这个词也许有点用力过猛，因为他们几乎没有提供什么细节。
en: “Plans” may be a bit strong, given that few details have been provided.

zh: 但三国一般性地描述了要成立一个独立的金融实体，由相关问题国家所有和组织，旨在便利伊朗和外国公司之间的交易。
en: But the three countries have described in general terms the creation of a stand-alone financial entity, owned and organized by the governments in question, to facilitate transactions between Iran and foreign companies.

zh: 这些公司应该会用欧元而非美元结算权益，从而不再依赖美国银行。
en: Those companies will presumably settle their claims in euros, not dollars, freeing them from dependence on US banks.

zh: 而由于欧洲特殊目的金融机构也绕过了SWIFT，美国将很难追踪伊朗和外国公司之间的交易，从而也难以实施惩罚。
en: And insofar as the Europeans’ special-purpose financial vehicle also bypasses SWIFT, it will be hard for the US to track transactions between Iran and foreign companies and impose penalties.

zh: 这样一套机制可行吗？
en: Is this scheme viable?

zh: 建立另一套支付渠道不存在什么纯技术障碍，但这么做肯定会激怒特朗普，他有可能回应以针对冒犯国家的新一轮关税。
en: While there is no purely technical obstacle to creating an alternative payments channel, doing so is certain to enrage Trump, who will presumably respond with another round of tariffs against the offending countries.

zh: 不幸的是，这就是政治独立的代价，至少在目前是如此。
en: Such, unfortunately, is the price of political independence, at least for now.

zh: 其他国家因为依赖美元而有过惨痛教训，它们会集体远离美元吗？
en: Having learned a painful lesson about dependence on the dollar, will other countries move away from it more generally?

zh: 事实是，美元的适用范围过于广泛，实现这一目的十分困难。
en: The fact that the dollar is used so widely makes doing so difficult.

zh: 银行和公司偏好使用美元，因为大量其他银行和公司也使用美元，并希望对手方也这么做。
en: Banks and companies prefer using dollars because so many other banks and companies use dollars and expect their counterparties to do likewise.

zh: 转向另一种货币需要协调行动。
en: Shifting to another currency would require coordinated action.

zh: 但如果欧洲三大国政府真宣布进行这样的协作的话，这一情景就不再可以忽略。
en: But with the governments of three large European countries having announced just such coordination, such a scenario can no longer be excluded.

zh: 不妨回忆一下，当初美元是如何赢得国际主导地位的。
en: It is worth recalling how the dollar gained international prominence in the first place.

zh: 1914年前，美元几乎没有国际作用。
en: Before 1914, it played essentially no international role.

zh: 但地缘政治冲击，再加上制度变化，改变了美元的地位。
en: But a geopolitical shock, together with an institutional change, transformed the dollar’s status.

zh: 地缘政治冲击是第一次世界大战，一战让中立国难以和英国银行做交易，用英镑结算账户。
en: The geopolitical shock was World War I, which made it hard for neutral countries to transact with British banks and settle their accounts using sterling.

zh: 制度变化是联邦储备法成立了一个实体，它能够提高美元计价信用市场的流动性；同时，美国银行首次被允许在海外经营。
en: The institutional change was the Federal Reserve Act, which created an entity that enhanced the liquidity of markets in dollar-denominated credits and allowed US banks to operate abroad for the first time.

zh: 到20世纪20年代初，美元已经赶上 — — 在某些方面，已经超越 — — 英镑的国际交易主要载体地位。
en: By the early 1920s the dollar had matched and, on some dimensions, surpassed sterling as the principal vehicle for international transactions.

zh: 这一先例表明，很有可能再过5—10年，美国就将失去时任法国财政部长德斯坦（Valéry Giscard d’Estaing）著名的“嚣张特权 ” 。 这一特权来自美国可以发行世界主要国际货币。
en: This precedent suggests that 5-10 years is a plausible time frame over which the US could lose what Valéry Giscard d’Estaing, then France’s finance minister, famously called the “exorbitant privilege” afforded it by issuing the world’s main international currency.

zh: 这并不意味着外国银行和公司将完全抛弃美元。
en: This doesn’t mean that foreign banks and companies will shun the dollar entirely.

zh: 美国金融市场规模庞大，流动性良好，并可能一直保持这一状态。
en: US financial markets are large and liquid and are likely to remain so.

zh: 美国银行在全球范围内经营。
en: US banks operate globally.

zh: 特别是，外国公司将继续使用美元与美国本身做交易。
en: In particular, foreign companies will continue to use dollars in transactions with the US itself.

zh: 但在美国单边主义时代，外国公司将想要对冲赌注。
en: But in an era of US unilateralism, they will want to hedge their bets.

zh: 如果特朗普单边主义的地缘政治冲击导致出现制度创新，让欧洲银行和公司能够更便利地用欧元进行支付，那么转变就有可能相当迅速（想必 ） 。
en: If the geopolitical shock of Trump’s unilateralism spurs an institutional innovation that makes it easier for European banks and companies to make payments in euros, then the transformation could be swift (as it were).

zh: 如果伊朗石油出口换来欧元而不是美元，它将使用这些欧元来支付进口商品。
en: If Iran receives euros rather than dollars for its oil exports, it will use those euros to pay for merchandise imports.

zh: 随着其他国家的公司赚取欧元而非美元，央行也不再有那么多理由持有美元以准备干预外汇市场、稳定本币对美元汇率。
en: With companies elsewhere earning euros rather than dollars, there will be less reason for central banks to hold dollars in order to intervene in the foreign exchange market and stabilize the local currency against the greenback.

zh: 此时，一切已无法挽回。
en: At this point, there would be no going back.

zh: 扶持欧元的一个动机是让欧洲不再过于依赖美元。
en: One motivation for establishing the euro was to free Europe from excessive dependence on the dollar.

zh: 中国寻求人民币国际化可能也有这一动机。
en: This is likewise one of China’s motivations for seeking to internationalize the renminbi.

zh: 目前，这两个计划充其量只能说喜忧参半。
en: So far, the success of both efforts has been mixed, at best.

zh: 讽刺的是，特朗普正在通过惩罚欧洲和中国，帮助它们实现目标。
en: In threatening to punish Europe and China, Trump is, ironically, helping them to achieve their goals.

zh: 此外，特朗普也在浪费美国的杠杆。
en: Moreover, Trump is squandering US leverage.

zh: 与欧洲和中国合作的话，他有可能能够威胁到伊朗和在伊朗做生意的公司，只要有证据表明伊朗没有履行去核化义务，就会受到全面有效的制裁。
en: Working with the Europeans and the Chinese, he could have threatened Iran, and companies doing business there, with comprehensive and effective sanctions had there been evidence that the country was failing to live up to its denuclearization obligations.

zh: 但合作确保伊朗遵守规则正是特朗普政府在今年早些时候撕毁的联合全面行动计划所要解决的问题。
en: But working together to ensure Iran’s compliance was, of course, precisely what the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action, renounced by the Trump administration earlier this year, was established to do.

zh: 美元加入货币战争
en: The Dollar Joins the Currency Wars

zh: 纽约—如今，许多发达经济体和新兴市场内需疲软，决策者开始用出口导向型增长提振经济增长和就业。
en: NEW YORK – In a world of weak domestic demand in many advanced economies and emerging markets, policymakers have been tempted to boost economic growth and employment by going for export led-growth.

zh: 这需要弱势货币以及常规和非常规货币政策实现需要的贬值。
en: This requires a weak currency and conventional and unconventional monetary policies to bring about the required depreciation.

zh: 今年年初以来，全球20多家央行在欧洲央行和日本银行的引领下放松了货币政策。
en: Since the beginning of the year, more than 20 central banks around the world have eased monetary policy, following the lead of the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan.

zh: 在欧元区，外围国需要弱势货币以减少外部赤字和刺激增长。
en: In the eurozone, countries on the periphery needed currency weakness to reduce their external deficits and jump-start growth.

zh: 但由量化宽松导致的欧元弱势进一步刺激了去年已经高达GDP的8%的德国经常项目盈余。
en: But the euro weakness triggered by quantitative easing has further boosted Germany’s current-account surplus, which was already‎ a whopping 8% of GDP last year.

zh: 其他欧元区核心国的外部盈余也在上升，这使得整个货币联盟的总体失衡十分庞大并且不断增加。
en: With external surpluses also rising in other countries of the eurozone core, the monetary union’s overall imbalance is large and growing.

zh: 在日本，量化宽松是首相安倍晋三的改革计划 — — “安倍经济学”的第一支“箭 ” 。
en: In Japan, quantitative easing was the first “arrow” of “Abenomics,” Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s reform program.

zh: 它让日元急剧贬值，现在正在导致贸易盈余增加。
en: Its launch has sharply weakened the yen and is now leading to rising trade surpluses.

zh: 欧洲央行和日本银行采取量化宽松让美元承受了巨大的升值压力。
en: The upward pressure on the US dollar from the embrace of quantitative easing by the ECB and the BOJ has been sharp.

zh: 美元兑其他发达大宗商品出口国（如澳大利亚和加拿大）和许多新兴市场货币的汇率也出现了走强。
en: The dollar has also strengthened against the currencies of advanced-country commodity exporters, like Australia and Canada, and those of many emerging markets.

zh: 对这些国家来说，油价和大宗商品价格下跌引发货币贬值，有助于抵消出口下降对增长和就业的影响。
en: For these countries, falling oil and commodity prices have triggered currency depreciations that are helping to shield growth and jobs from the effects of lower exports.

zh: 美元兑经济和金融十分脆弱的新兴市场货币也在升值。 这些经济体存在财政和经常项目双赤字、通胀抬头和增长放缓、巨额存量内外债务以及政治动荡。
en: The dollar has also risen relative to currencies of emerging markets with economic and financial fragilities: twin fiscal and current-account deficits, rising inflation and slowing growth, large stocks of domestic and foreign debt, and political instability.

zh: 甚至中国在去年也短暂地允许人民币兑美元贬值，而产出增长放缓可以诱使政府让人民币贬值更多。
en: Even China briefly allowed its currency to weaken against the dollar last year, and slowing output growth may tempt the government to let the renminbi weaken even more.

zh: 与此同时，贸易盈余再次上升，部分是因为中国在全球市场上大量倾销其供给过剩的商品 — — 如钢铁。
en: Meanwhile, the trade surplus is rising again, in part because China is dumping its excess supply of goods – such as steel – in global markets.

zh: 直到最近，美国决策者对美元强势并不十分担忧，因为美国增长前景比欧洲和日本都要光明。
en: Until recently, US policymakers were not overly concerned about the dollar’s strength, because America’s growth prospects were stronger than in Europe and Japan.

zh: 事实上，今年初，人们希望美国内需足以支持其GDP增长率接近3 % ， 即使美元表现出强势。
en: Indeed, at the beginning of the year, there was hope that US domestic demand would be strong enough this year to support GDP growth of close to 3%, despite the stronger dollar.

zh: 人们认为，油价下跌和就业创造将提高可支配收入和消费。
en: Lower oil prices and job creation, it was thought, would boost disposable income and consumption.

zh: （能源部门以外的）资本支出和住宅投资将随着增长的加速而走强。
en: Capital spending (outside the energy sector) and residential investment would strengthen as growth accelerated.

zh: 但如今，情况已有所不同。 美国官员的汇率神经过敏症正在日益显露。
en: But things look different today, and US officials’ exchange-rate jitters are becoming increasingly pronounced.

zh: 美元升值速度比所有人的预期都要快；而2015年一季度数据显示，美元升值对净出口、通货膨胀和增长的影响也比决策者的统计模型所表明的更大更快。
en: The dollar appreciated much faster than anyone expected; and, as data for the first quarter of 2015 suggest, the impact on net exports, inflation, and growth has been larger and more rapid than that implied by policymakers’ statistical models.

zh: 此外，强劲的内需没有成为现实；一季度消费增长十分疲软，资本支出和住房投资更是萎靡不堪。
en: Moreover, strong domestic demand has failed to materialize; consumption growth was weak in the first quarter, and capital spending and residential investment were even weaker.

zh: 结果，美国实际上已经加入了阻止美元进一步升值的 “货币战争 ” 。
en: As a result, the US has effectively joined the “currency war” to prevent further dollar appreciation.

zh: 美联储官员开始直言美元是影响净出口、通货膨胀和增长的因素。 美国当局也开始日益批评德国和欧元区采取弱化欧元的政策而不采取刺激内需的政策 — — 比如临时性财政刺激和加快工资增长。
en: Fed officials have started to speak explicitly about the dollar as a factor that affects net exports, inflation, and growth.‎ And the US authorities have become increasingly critical of Germany and the eurozone for adopting policies that weaken the euro while avoiding those – for example, temporary fiscal stimulus and faster wage growth – that boost domestic demand.

zh: 此外，口头干预之后将是政策动作，因为增长放缓和低通胀 — — 部分是拜强势美元所赐 — — 将让美联储比预期更晚更慢地退出零政策利率。
en: Moreover, verbal intervention will be followed by policy action, because slower growth and low inflation – partly triggered by a strong dollar – will induce the Fed to exit zero policy rates later and more slowly than expected.

zh: 这将逆转部分最近的美元涨幅，阻止增长和通胀的下降风险。
en: That will reverse some of the dollar’s recent gains and shield growth and inflation from downside risks.

zh: 货币摩擦最终可能导致贸易��擦，而货币战争可能导致贸易战争。
en: Currency frictions can lead eventually to trade frictions, and currency wars can lead to trade wars.

zh: 而这可能让正在着力完成大型地区级跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（Trans-Pacific Partnership，TPP）的美国陷入麻烦。
en: And that could spell trouble for the US as it tries to conclude the mega-regional Trans-Pacific Partnership.

zh: 关于奥巴马政府是否能够在国会赢得足够选票批准TPP的问题现在变得更加不确定，因为一项立法提案试图对参与“货币操纵”的国家征收关税。
en: Uncertainty about whether the Obama administration can marshal enough votes in Congress to ratify the TPP has now been compounded by proposed legislation that would impose tariff duties on countries that engage in “currency manipulation.”

zh: 如果这一将贸易和货币政策联系起来的立法被写入TPP，亚洲参与者将拒绝加入。
en: If such a link between trade and currency policy were forced into the TPP, the Asian participants would refuse to join.

zh: 如果大部分政府追求通过内需刺激增长的政策，而不是以邻为壑的出口手段，世界将会变得更好。
en: The world would be better off if most governments pursued policies that boosted growth through domestic demand, rather than beggar-thy-neighbor export measures.

zh: 但这需要它们更少依赖货币政策，更多依赖合理的财政政策（如增加生产性基础设施的支出 ） 。
en: But that would require them to rely less on monetary policy and more on appropriate fiscal policies (such as higher spending on productive infrastructure).

zh: 甚至提高工资、因此提高劳动收入和消费的收入政策也比货币贬值（这样会抑制真实工资）更有利于国内增长。
en: Even income policies that lift wages, and hence labor income and consumption, are a better source of domestic growth than currency depreciations (which depress real wages).

zh: 全球贸易余额总数等于零，这意味着不可能所有国家都成为净出口国 — — 而货币战争终归是一场零和博弈。
en: The sum of all trade balances in the world is equal to zero, which means that not all countries can be net exporters – and that currency wars end up being zero-sum games.

zh: 因此，美国加入战团只是时间问题。
en: That is why America’s entry into the fray was only a matter of time.

zh: 美元和经济萧条
en: Dollars and Depression

zh: 一路下跌的美元已经成了导致全球性大规模宏观经济萧条的源泉。
en: The falling dollar has emerged as a source of profound global macroeconomic distress.

zh: 现在的问题是此次经济萧条究竟会糟糕到何种地步。
en: The question now is how bad that distress will become.

zh: 世界经济是不是正面临着危险？
en: Is the world economy at risk?

zh: 目前存在着两种可能性。
en: There are two possibilities.

zh: 如果全球储户和投资者预期美元将会继续贬值，那么除非把钱存在美国及美元资产中能得到适当的补偿，这就意味着美国和外国的利息差距将会拉大，否则他们将会抛售手中持有的美元资产。
en: If global savers and investors expect the dollar’s depreciation to continue, they will flee the currency unless they are compensated appropriately for keeping their money in the US and its assets, implying that the gap between US and foreign interest rates will widen.

zh: 其结果是，美国的资本成本会大幅度提高，利率居高不下会导致家庭的主要资产 — — 住宅价值缩水，从而打击投资者的积极性，降低消费支出。
en: As a result, the cost of capital in the US will soar, discouraging investment and reducing consumption spending as high interest rates depress the value of households’ principal assets: their houses.

zh: 由此产生的经济衰退也许会导致悲观情绪进一步蔓延、消费开支进一步缩减，从而加剧美元的贬值趋势。
en: The resulting recession might fuel further pessimism and cutbacks in spending, deepening the downturn.

zh: 身处经济萧条之中的美国不可能再扮演世界最后一个进口商的角色，而这可能会使世界其他国家也陷入衰退的泥潭。
en: A US in recession would no longer serve as the world’s importer of last resort, which might send the rest of the world into recession as well.

zh: 人人认为美元即将贬值的世界将是一个陷入经济危机的世界。
en: A world in which everybody expects a falling dollar is a world in economic crisis.

zh: 与此形成鲜明的对照，在美元已经贬值的世界中，可能会发生经济动荡，但不可能发生经济危机。
en: By contrast, a world in which the dollar has already fallen is one that may see economic turmoil, but not an economic crisis.

zh: 如果美元已经贬值 — — 如果没有人认为美元还会进一步大幅缩水 — — 那么就没有必要为持有美国资产的全球储户和投资者提供补偿。
en: If the dollar has already fallen – if nobody expects it to fall much more – then there is no reason to compensate global savers and investors for holding US assets.

zh: 恰恰相反，在这种情况下却存在着机遇：归根结底，美元还可能探底回升。 美国利率将维持正常水平，资产价值也不会过度缩水，投资开支也不会受到金融动荡的影响。
en: On the contrary, in this scenario there are opportunities: the dollar, after all, might rise; US interest rates will be at normal levels; asset values will not be unduly depressed; and investment spending will not be affected by financial turmoil.

zh: 当然，还有可能出现其他混乱：当美国的工资水平由于美元贬值而显得低廉时，向美国出口的难度就会增大，而其他国家也必须依靠其他的需求来源维持各自国内的就业状况。
en: Of course, there may well be turbulence: when US wage levels appear low because of a weak dollar, it is hard to export to America, and other countries must rely on other sources of demand to maintain full employment.

zh: 如果对美元构成威胁的资产价格变化让热爱风险或鲁莽的贷款人陷入麻烦，政府也许不得不对金融体系给予某种程度的支撑。
en: The government may have to shore up the financial system if the changes in asset prices that undermined the dollar sink risk-loving or imprudent lenders.

zh: 但这些都是、或者应该是我们能够解决的问题。
en: But these are, or ought to be, problems that we can solve.

zh: 而恰恰相反，大规模持续性美元贬值的普遍预期所带来的居高不下的美元利率却是没有办法解决的宏观经济问题。
en: By contrast, sky-high US interest rates produced by a general expectation of a massive ongoing dollar decline is a macroeconomic problem without a solution.

zh: 但迄今为止还没有迹象表明全球储户和投资者预期美元将会贬值。
en: Yet so far there are no signs that global savers and investors expect a dollar decline.

zh: 这种预期理应产生的美元和外国长期利率间的巨大息差并没有出现，而如果息差出现，就能够反应出人们对美元的贬值预期。
en: The large gap between US and foreign long-term interest rates that should emerge from and signal expectations of a falling dollar does not exist.

zh: 不仅如此，填平美国经常帐户赤字所需的每月650亿美元继续源源不断地流入。
en: And the $65 billion needed every month to fund the US current-account deficit continues to flow in.

zh: 这样世界经济也许能躲开一场可能发生的灾难。
en: Thus, the world economy may dodge yet another potential catastrophe.

zh: 事实也许会证明这只是一厢情愿。
en: That may still prove to be wishful thinking.

zh: 归根结底，美国仍然庞大的经常帐户赤字注定了美元将会继续贬值。
en: After all, America’s still-large current-account deficit guarantees that the dollar will continue to fall.

zh: 即便如此，大规模经常帐户赤字表明货币价值高估的宏观经济逻辑却继续被国际金融投资者和投机者们视而不见。
en: Even so, the macroeconomic logic that large current-account deficits signal that currencies are overvalued continues to escape the world’s international financial investors and speculators.

zh: 在某种层次上，这一事实令人沮丧：我们经济学家相信人们有足够的智慧理解周边的环境，也有足够的能力保护自己的利益。
en: On one level, this is very frustrating: we economists believe that people are smart enough to understand their situation and capable enough to pursue their own interests.

zh: 但投资于美元计价资产的典型投资者 — — 无论他是富有的个人、退休基金还是中央银行 — — 都没有采取措施保护自己不受未来很可能发生的美元贬值的侵害。
en: Yet the typical investor in dollar-denominated assets – whether a rich private individual, a pension fund, or a central bank – has not taken the steps to protect themselves against the very likely dollar decline in our future.

zh: 在这种情况下，经济学家眼中的坏事对世界经济而言却是件好事：我们面对的也许只是美国的金融衰退，而不是居高不下的长期利率和全球经济萧条。
en: In this case, what is bad for economists is good for the world economy: we may be facing a mere episode of financial distress in the US rather than sky-high long-term interest rates and a depression.

zh: 经济学家无法解释这样的现象，但却没有理由不为此感到庆幸。
en: The fact that economists can’t explain it is no reason not to be thankful.

zh: 低利率保证高资产价格吗？
en: Do Low Interest Rates Ensure High Asset Prices?

zh: 世界范围内的资产价格—股票、商业不动产，甚至石油—都处在历史的高位。
en: Asset prices– stocks, commercial real estate, and even oil – are, historically, at high levels around the world.

zh: 虽然通过历史可以很好地预测未来趋势，但根本性的变化不时发生，从而催生新的模式。
en: Although history is often a good predictor of future trends, every now and then something fundamental changes that makes for a new pattern.

zh: 现在的一个重要问题时，今天高企的资产价格是否是某些根本性变化的产物，或者说泡沫是否已经形成。
en: The important question now is whether today’s high asset prices are the result of some such fundamental development, or whether bubbles have formed.

zh: 一种对高资产价格耳熟能详的辩护认为实际的（计入通胀因素的）长期利率是非常低的。
en: One oft-heard justification for high asset prices is that real (inflation-adjusted) long-term interest rates are very low.

zh: 但投资者们应该对这种观点保持警惕。
en: But investors should be wary of this argument.

zh: 它看似有理，但却并不是结论性的，更重要的是，它的确没有告诉我们这种高价格是可持续的。
en: It may sound plausible, but it is hardly conclusive, and, more importantly, it certainly does not tell us that high prices are sustainable.

zh: 当然，不可否认的是，实际长期利率已经显著降低—这种变化不是突如其来，也不是最近才有，而是在过去的二十多年里以一种较为平稳的速度发生的。
en: It is, of course, true that real long-term interest rates have declined quite markedly – not suddenly and not only recently, but at a fairly steady pace for more than twenty years.

zh: 根据国际货币基金组织（IMF）的说法，世界实际长期利率在1984年达到顶点，平均为7 % ， 而到了2004年则降低到2%以下。
en: According to the IMF, world real long-term interest rates peaked at nearly 7% on average in 1984, and fell to just below 2% by 2004.

zh: 在此期间利率有所起伏，但总体上呈下降趋势，且下降的幅度—近5个百分点—是惊人的。
en: There were some ups and downs along the way, but the overall trend has been downward, and the magnitude of the decline – nearly five percentage points – is striking.

zh: 布什总统经济顾问委员会主席，极有可能在明年一月份接替格林斯潘，继任美联储主席的候选人之一，Ben Bernanke将过去十年以来的实际利率下降称作一场“全球性储蓄过剩 ” 。
en: Ben Bernanke, the Chairman of President George W. Bush’s Council of Economic Advisors and a likely candidate to succeed Alan Greenspan as the Federal Reserve’s chairman in January, has called the decline in real interest rates over just the last decade a “global savings glut.”

zh: 但当今全球的储蓄并不是“过多 ” ， 而是储蓄额高到了足够的程度，以至于以实际利率来衡量的收益要比以前低很多了。
en: It is not that there is “too much” saving around the world today, but that the amount of saving has been high enough that returns, as measured by real interest rates, are a lot lower than they once were.

zh: 在2005年三月的一次演讲中，Bernanke 说这一“过剩 ” ， 可以用来解释美国经济的几个特点，其中还可能包括巨大的财政和贸易赤字。
en: In a March 2005 speech, Bernanke argued that this “glut” helps explain several features of the American economy, possibly including the enormous fiscal and trade deficits.

zh: 低实际利率意味着任何长期资产，如果年实际收益为100美金，那么在1984年按收益率7%计算的实际价值是1429美金，但同样的收益按今天仅2%的收益率计算，则其实际价值必须是5000美金。
en: Low real long-term rates mean that any long-term asset that pays, say, $100 a year in real terms would have been worth a real $1,429 in 1984, when it yielded 7%, but would have to be worth a real $5,000 now, when it yields just 2%.

zh: 因而如此大幅度的长期利率下跌似乎意味着实际资产的价格膨胀，从而解释了我们现今所见的高价格。
en: A decline in long-term rates of such magnitude would thus appear to imply massive price inflation for real assets, justifying the high prices we are in fact seeing.

zh: 在一些高价投资的鼓吹者们看来，这就是盖棺定论了。
en: Case closed, according to some advocates of pricey investments.

zh: 但这样的说法是有漏洞的。
en: But there are holes in this case.

zh: 我们必须考查实际利率在10或20年前高出许多的原因，并思考其内涵。 我们还必须从更广泛的历史中考查资产价格及其与实际利率的关系。
en: We have to look at the reasons that real interest rates were so much higher 10 or 20 years ago, and think about what that means, and we also have to look at the broader history of asset prices and their relation to real interest rates.

zh: 20年前，实际短期利率以历史标准来看非常之高，那是因为当时世界各国的央行想要对其在持续上升的通货膨胀面前的无所作为开刀。
en: Twenty years ago, real short-term interest rates were exceptionally high by historical standards because the major central banks of the world wanted to combat what was seen at the time as inaction against spiraling inflation.

zh: 对于当时的美联储主席Paul Volcker而言，为了遏止通胀而在1981-1982年间让世界陷入经济衰退，需要相当的勇气—或是鲁莽，观��因人而异。
en: It took the courage – or recklessness, depending on your point of view – of US Federal Reserve Chairman Paul Volcker to send the world into recession in 1981-2 in order to break the back of inflation.

zh: 这场衰退是破坏性的，但它也有一个亮点：给予全世界一个启示—一家独立的中央银行为确保价格稳定可以采取强硬措施。
en: That recession was destructive, but it had one silver lining: an inspiration to the world that an independent central bank can take tough measures to ensure price stability.

zh: 然而，当世界范围的1981-1982经济衰退使通胀迅速降低时，名义长期利率却并未立即下降，因为世界市场仍然没有对此信服。
en: But, while the worldwide recession of 1981-2 brought inflation down rapidly, nominal long-term interest rates did not fall immediately, for the world’s markets were still not convinced.

zh: 因此，实际长期利率在1980年代中期仍然保持在高位。
en: Hence, real long-term rates remained quite high in the mid-1980’s.

zh: 逐渐地，随着贷方对未来持续低通胀的信心日益增强，实际长期利率才开始下降。
en: Gradually, with lenders becoming increasingly confident in subsequent years that low inflation was here to stay, real long-term interest rates began heading south.

zh: 但这段历史说明1980年代真正的实际长期利率并不像我们所计算的那样高。 因为那时对长期通胀的期望值肯定比某一年份的通胀率要高得多。
en: But this history means that the true real long-term interest rate was not as high in the 1980’s as our measures show, because long-term inflation expectations must have been much higher than the one-year inflation rate was at the time.

zh: 例如，长期债券的持有者一定认为在1981-1982年的全球经济衰退过去之后，通胀会强力反弹。
en: Holders of long-term bonds, for example, must have thought that inflation would come roaring back after the effects of the 1981-2 global recession had passed.

zh: 在1980年代，与通胀指数挂钩的债券市场发育还不健全。
en: The inflation-indexed bond markets were not well developed in the 1980’s.

zh: 但我们的确知道1984年最发达的此类市场（在英国）报出的长期实际利率仅为3%左右—比IMF的数字低得多。
en: But we do know that in 1984 the best-developed such market (in the United Kingdom) was quoting long-term real interest rates of only around 3% – far below the IMF’s figure.

zh: 即便我们接受实际利率在1980年代中期确实很高的说法，那么由此做出的符合逻辑的结论则是1980年代的股票和房地产市场的价格本应该更低，而不是2005年的实际资产价格应该很高。
en: Even if we were to accept that real rates were genuinely very high in the mid-1980’s, then the logical conclusion would be that the stock and housing markets should have been even lower in the 1980’s, not that real prices should be very high in 2005.

zh: 实际上，如果我们从更长期的观点来考量美国的实际利率，将前一年的通胀从政府债券的实际收益中扣除，我们会发现虽然它们比20年前低了很多，但就历史标准而言却并不低。
en: In fact, if one takes a longer view of real interest rates in the US, calculated by subtracting the previous year’s inflation from the nominal government bond yield, one finds that, while they are much lower than 20 years ago, they are not low by historical standards.

zh: 1891-1979年期间（在Volcker监察到借款成本急剧上升之前刚结束的这段时期）的平均实际长期政府利率仅为1.25 % 。 这和现今的实际长期利率非常接近。
en: The average real long-term government interest rate in 1891-1979 – a period ending just before Volcker oversaw soaring growth in borrowing costs – was a mere 1.25%, which is very close to the real long-term interest rate today.

zh: 简而言之，我们不应该过分纠缠于过去20年以来的实际长期利率的降低。
en: In short, we simply shouldn’t read too much into the decline in real long-term interest rates over the last 20 years.

zh: 从历史上看，实际利率变化起伏颇大，却并未表现出与资产价格的相关性。
en: Historically, real rates have jumped around a lot, showing little correlation with asset prices.

zh: 不论其在另外方面会带来什么好处，现今全世界范围内的低利率都无法保证未来的资产价格不会下跌。
en: Whatever their other benefits, the low rates we see around the world now hardly amount to insurance against future drops in asset prices.

zh: 破坏时代
en: Age of Disruption

zh: 伦敦—2013年，世界朝着数字时代又进了一步。 这是一个变化的新纪元，对社会经济的影响将比工业革命大2—3倍。
en: LONDON – The year 2013 moved the world further into the Digital Age – a global epoch of changes whose likely impact on the world economy will be 2-3 times greater than that of the Industrial Revolution.

zh: 世界数据总量的90%左右是在过去两年里创造出来的。
en: Some 90% of the world’s total data were created in the past two years.

zh: 到2020年，储存数据数量将比2010年大50倍。
en: By 2020, the quantity of stored data could be 50 times greater than it was in 2010.

zh: 许多权威人士认为这一数据大爆炸堪比新型石油，甚至是一种全新的资产类别。
en: Many pundits regard this massive explosion of data as the new oil, even a new asset class.

zh: 数据的丰沛受近乎无处不在的互联网的刺激。
en: This profusion of data is being fueled by the near ubiquity of the Internet.

zh: 到2020年，智能电话将把其他20—30亿人联系起来，数十亿机械传感器监控着从拖拉机到飞机引擎的一切东西，而计算能力的进一步突破将带来数据储存和分析的大量增加。
en: Smart phones are set to connect an additional 2-3 billion of the world’s citizens by 2020, with billions of machine sensors monitoring everything from tractors to jet engines, and further breakthroughs in computing power enabling massive increases in data storage and analysis.

zh: 在这样的环境下，数据管理和分析的顺畅性将是成功组织的关键。
en: In this environment, fluency in data management and analytics will be vital for successful organizations.

zh: 2011年，麻省理工学院（MIT）的布莱恩约尔弗森（Erick Brynjolfsson）及其同事发表了一项研究，他们发现使用数据驱动决策的公司生产率比不使用数据决策的公司高5—6 % 。
en: A study published in 2011 by MIT’s Erik Brynjolfsson and his colleagues found that companies using data-driven decision-making had a 5-6% higher productivity rate than those that did not.

zh: 捕获、组织数据、从中提炼洞见并交易数据已成为所有行业、所有部门的核心能力之一。
en: The ability to capture, organize, extract insights from, and transact with data has now become a core competency for every industry and across every sector.

zh: 来自新的数据和分析大杂烩的破坏效应在公共和私人部门蔓延着。
en: The disruptions resulting from the new crucible of data and analytics are spreading across both the public and private sectors.

zh: 流行视频流媒体网站Netflix利用其用户搜索、观赏、暂停和评论的庞大数据库推出了专门面向互联网设计的连续剧《纸牌屋 》 （ House of Cards ） 。
en: Netflix, the popular video-streaming website, used its vast database of user searches, views, pauses, and reviews to design the made-for-the-Internet series “House of Cards.”

zh: 该连续剧请来了热门导演大卫·芬奇（David Fincher ） 、 热门演员凯文·史派西（Keven Spacey ） ， 剧名则借用了一个英国流行秀 — — 它们在Netflix流行度评分中均名列前茅。
en: The series combined a popular director (David Fincher), actor (Kevin Spacey), and plotlines borrowed from a popular British show with the same title – all of which scored highly on Netflix’s popularity metrics.

zh: 在其他行业，数据驱动的决策在产品开发、市场营销和客户互动等方面也在迅速成为标准，作为直觉和经验的补充（有时甚至是取代 ） 。
en: In other industries, too, data-driven decision-making in product development, marketing, and customer interactions is fast becoming the standard, supplementing (and in some cases replacing) intuition and experience.

zh: 数据驱动的决策还被用于改良供应链、改进工作安排和优化生产过程。
en: It is also streamlining supply chains, refining workforce schedules, and optimizing manufacturing processes.

zh: 更大程度的破坏可能发生在夸行业领域，获得专有数据的特权正在重新决定竞争战线。
en: More significant disruption is likely to occur across industries, as privileged access to proprietary data redraws competitive battle lines.

zh: 拥有深厚数据集的公司日益拥有驾驭传统主业之外的市场的能力 — — 领先者已在抓住机会。
en: Companies with deep data sets will increasingly have the ability to play in markets outside their traditional domains – and leaders already are seizing the opportunities.

zh: 在中国电子商务公司阿里巴巴���中小型网商也可以申请信用。
en: At Alibaba, the Chinese e-commerce company, small and midsize vendors in its network can also apply for credit.

zh: 阿里巴巴利用交易数据发放贷款，为32万家公司提供了运营资本（超过160亿美元 ） ， 到目前为止，其效率远远超过普通银行。
en: Alibaba has financed the working capital of 320,000 companies (more than $16 billion) using transaction data to underwrite the lending – and has done so far more efficiently than the average bank.

zh: 政府也意识到数据分析可以改变其全球地位。
en: Governments, too, are sensing that data analytics can change their global standing.

zh: 比如，新加坡制定了一套十年蓝图，核心是发展包括数据分析在内的强大的信息和通信业。
en: Singapore, for example, has a ten-year master plan that focuses on the development of a robust information and communications industry, including data analytics.

zh: 最近当局实施了一项公开数据计划，让人们可以轻松获得大量政府数据。
en: More recently, the authorities launched an open-data initiative, making vast amounts of government data easily accessible.

zh: 但是，尽管许多组织意识到了数据分析的重要性，但以多大的热情拥抱这一潮流大相径庭。
en: And yet, though many organizations recognize the importance of data analytics, there is wide variation in how aggressively they have moved to embrace it.

zh: 早期的接受者如亚马逊和乐购很快就建立起了必要的人才储备和经验，如今正致力于分析对组织的影响最大化（即探索破坏性机会 ） 。
en: Early adopters, such as Amazon and Tesco, which quickly built up the requisite talent bases and experience, are now shifting gears to maximize the impact of analytics on their organizations (that is, exploring disruptive opportunities).

zh: 但更多的组织仍处于小规模试验和聘用首批数据科学家阶段。
en: Many more organizations, however, are still only conducting small-scale experiments and hiring their first data scientists.

zh: 好消息是许多公司将能够加速变化的节奏。
en: The good news is that many companies will be able to accelerate the pace of change.

zh: 人才是一个振奋人心的领域。
en: Talent is one promising area.

zh: 挖掘数据分析的潜力需要深厚的先进技术储备。
en: Tapping the potential of data analytics requires deep pools of advanced technical expertise.

zh: 毫无疑问，长于数据管理和高级分析的员工供不应求，新出现的“译员 ” （ translator，即疏通IT和数据、分析和商业决策关系的人才）群体亦然。
en: To be sure, workers skilled in data management and advanced analytics are in short supply, as are members of an emerging class of “translators” – those whose talents bridge IT and data, analytics, and business decision-making.

zh: “译员”对于跨越诸多业务功能的复杂转化过程至关重要。
en: Translators are essential to complex transformation efforts that cross many business functions.

zh: 大学正在迅速做出调整以满足膨胀的需求，许多大学开设了结合分析与商业的跨学科项目。
en: Universities are quickly adapting to meet the swelling demand, and many have launched interdisciplinary programs that combine analytics and business expertise.

zh: 技术的快速进步也使得实现分析的影响变得更加容易。
en: Rapid advances in technology are also making it easier to realize the impact of analytics.

zh: 对许多公司来说，最大的挑战是将来自统计模型的洞见转化为日常经营活动的实际变化。
en: One of the biggest challenges for many companies has been to convert insights from statistical models into real changes in day-to-day operations.

zh: 位居一线的个体缺少将洞见与行动联系起来的直观工具。
en: Individuals on the front lines have lacked intuitive tools that link insights to action.

zh: 但数据可视化方面的进步、应用研发周期的加快以及技术的稳步消费化正在改变局面，给管理者带来个性化的易于理解的方案。
en: But advances in data visualization, faster development cycles for applications, and the steady consumerization of technology are changing that, putting customized, easy-to-understand solutions in managers’ hands.

zh: 比如最近被孟山都公司收购的气候公司（Climate Corporation）拥有30多年的天气数据、60年的农作物产量数据兆兆字节计的土壤类型信息数据。
en: For example, the Climate Corporation, recently acquired by Monsanto, combines more than 30 years of weather data, 60 years of crop-yield data, and multiple terabytes of information on soil types.

zh: 该公司利用历史信息储备和先进的算法，通过直观的门户网站为农民提供收费建议。
en: With that reservoir of historical information and sophisticated algorithms, the company offers fee-based advice to farmers through an intuitive online portal.

zh: 各组织纷纷寻求机会创新、提振收入、提高生产率，而领导团队也必须作出调整。
en: As organizations pursue these opportunities to innovate, boost revenues, or increase productivity, leadership teams will also need to adjust.

zh: 定义新的数据驱动战略、管理海量信息新储量、找出新模式、跨功能管理以及围绕新任务激励组织需要新的管理能力。
en: Defining new data-driven strategies, managing massive new stores of information, reaching out to new partners, managing across functions, and energizing the organization around a new mission will likely require new management capacity.

zh: 企业一直在有组织地创新。
en: Firms innovate organizationally all the time.

zh: 1961年，加州电子元件制造商Ampex第一次正式使用“首席财务官”一词。
en: In 1961, Ampex, a California electronics manufacturer, became the first company formally to use the term “Chief Financial Officer.”

zh: 如今，这一职位已经无处不在。
en: Today, that role is ubiquitous.

zh: 在数字时代取得领先可能需要诸如首席数字官、首席分析官或首席数据官之类的新角色，尽管目前已经采取这一做法的公司相对较少。
en: Leading in the Digital Age may require creating new roles such as Chief Digital Officer, Chief Analytics Officer, or Chief Data Officer, though relatively few companies so far have taken such steps.

zh: 在未来，一个组织的整体成功需要有一位领导者负责这些功能，并且他必须是值得信赖的高层管理团队成员。
en: In the future, an organization’s overall success will require that the leader responsible for such capabilities be a trusted member of the top management team.

zh: 很少有领导者能够在全新领域构筑管理基础的同时组建结合各种前所未知类型能力的团队。
en: Few leaders have ever developed management muscle in completely new fields while assembling teams combining previously unknown types of talent.

zh: 战略选择面临着同样新鲜的领域，好比大众传媒开启了市场营销的新时代，或全球化要求组织足迹的彻底变化。
en: The strategic options confront equally fresh terrain, perhaps similar to when mass media opened a new era of marketing, or globalization required radical reshaping of organizational footprints.

zh: 在2014年及以后，CEO和董事会需要决定新的当务之急，明智地进行投资，并准备好支持实验。
en: In 2014 and beyond, CEOs and their boards will need to establish new priorities, invest wisely, and be willing to support experimentation.

zh: 在大破坏无可避免的时代，在警惕风险的同时时刻准备着迅速果断地采取行动的人将获得巨大的潜在好处。
en: In times when major disruption is certain, the enormous potential rewards accrue to those who, while vigilant against risk, are prepared to act boldly and swiftly.

zh: 欧洲的价值地理
en: Europe’s Geography of Values

zh: 巴黎—面对回归帝国传统和苏联式的欺骗手段和回光返照的俄罗斯，欧洲应该如何应对？
en: PARIS – Confronted with Russia’s reassertion of its imperial tradition and the deceptive methods and reflexes of the Soviet past, how should Europe respond?

zh: 欧洲应该以“地理的价值 ” （ the value of geography）还是以“价值的地理 ” （ the geography of values）为重？
en: Should it give priority to “the value of geography” or to “the geography of values”?

zh: 选择前者的人打着短期“能源现实主义”的旗号，认为最关键的是要与俄罗斯达成协议，以为内欧洲缺少美国的页岩气和页岩油。
en: Those who opt for the former do so in the name of short-term “energy realism,” arguing that it is vital to reach an agreement with Russia because Europe lacks America’s shale gas and oil.

zh: 根据这一逻辑，没了俄罗斯，美国可以活，欧洲活不了。
en: According to this reasoning, the United States can live without Russia, but Europe cannot.

zh: 此外，对现实主义者来说，美国对其最悠久、最值得信任的盟友的蔑视行为 — — 体现在美国国安局牵涉其中的监控丑闻中 — — 已经让“价值共同体”的思想失去了信誉。
en: Moreover, for the realists, America’s defiant behavior toward its oldest and most faithful allies – reflected in the recent surveillance scandals implicating the National Security Agency – has discredited the very idea of a “community of values.”

zh: 如果美国不再尊重其所宣扬的价值，欧盟又为何要失去打着支持它们的名号的克里姆林宫的善意？
en: If America no longer respects the values that it professes, why should the European Union lose the goodwill of the Kremlin in the name of upholding them?

zh: 这些现实主义者还认为，通过让欧盟的立场与北约一致，欧洲有欠考虑地选择了羞辱俄罗斯 — — 这样的行为是毫无用处的，并且是危险的。
en: Such realists also claim that by aligning the EU’s positions with those of NATO, Europe has recklessly chosen to humiliate Russia – a useless and dangerous course of action.

zh: 他们说，现在应该采取让历史和地理常识与能源需要想妥协的政策。
en: The time has come, they say, for a policy that reconciles historical and geographic common sense with energy necessity.

zh: 欧洲的未来俄罗斯有着不可摆脱的联系，而美国已经背弃了欧洲，欧洲即便不能破除幻想，也应该意识到双方的利益不一致。
en: Europe’s future is inexorably linked to that of Russia, whereas America has turned its back on Europe, out of disinterest if not disillusion.

zh: 对光荣的过去的庆典 — — 诺班底登陆日70周年纪念 — — 无法掩盖淋漓的现实：尽管欧洲试图实现能源资源的多样化，但在可预见的未来都无法摆脱俄罗斯。
en: The commemoration of a glorious past – the 70th anniversary of D-Day – cannot hide the diminished present: Though Europe may try to diversify its energy resources, it cannot do without Russia in the foreseeable future.

zh: 现实主义者问，为何要为比俄罗斯人本身还要腐败、文明程度还要差得多的乌克兰人牺牲？
en: Why, the realists ask, should one die for Ukrainians who are even more corrupt and much less civilized than the Russians themselves?

zh: 作为一个独立国家，乌克兰本来是有机会的，但没有抓住，这是拜其政治精英的见利忘义所赐。
en: Ukraine had its chance as an independent state and failed, the victim of its political elites’ venality.

zh: 是时候结束这段悲伤的插曲了。
en: It is time to close this unhappy parenthesis.

zh: 这一愿景不是理论上的。
en: This vision is not theoretical.

zh: 在整个欧盟，不管左翼还是右翼，不管哪种职业，你都能找到这一愿景，只不过外表各不相同。
en: It can be found, in various guises, throughout the EU, on the right and the left, and in all professions.

zh: 感到美国相对衰落和欧洲对其价值和模式的信心的日渐深刻的损失导致了通常建立在昔日反美主义遗留的基础上的立场的合理化。
en: The perception of relative US decline and the EU’s deepening loss of confidence in its values and model seem to legitimize a stance that is built in many cases on the remnants of older anti-Americanism.

zh: 另一条道路 — — 强调价值的地理多过地理的价值 — — 则是欧洲工程和北约创始人所选择的的道路。
en: The other path, which emphasizes the geography of values over the value of geography, was the one chosen by the founding fathers of the European project and NATO.

zh: 这一派认为，没有认清普京的帝国图谋凸显出欧洲沦为无情依赖关系的鱼肉的风险。
en: According to this view, failure to recognize Putin’s imperial designs would heighten the risk of Europe falling prey to a non-benevolent form of dependency.

zh: 对欧洲来说，聆听东方的勾魂曲 — — 俄罗斯的战略实力和欧盟的经济实力互补的旋律 — — 就好比是向黑社会缴纳保护费。
en: For Europe, to heed the siren song from the East – a melody of complementarity between Russia’s strategic power and the EU’s economic power – would be akin to paying the Mafia for protection.

zh: 民主国家俱乐部如何能够将其安全完全寄托给公开蔑视其“孱弱”政治制度的独裁势力？
en: How could a club of democracies be entirely dependent for its security on an authoritarian power that openly despises their “weak” political systems?

zh: 这一俄罗斯的反民主、移民和同性恋论调在欧盟最保守、最极端和最民主主义的政党中找到支持，这不是巧合。
en: It is no coincidence that this Russian discourse opposing democracy, immigrants, and homosexuality should find support among the EU’s most conservative, extremist, and nationalist parties.

zh: 相反，欧盟模式的优势和吸引力依赖于其民主性质。
en: By contrast, the strength and attractiveness of the EU model depends upon its democratic nature.

zh: 不再梦想欧洲的欧洲人 — — 他们把和平、妥协以及最重要的自由视为理所当然 — — 没有意识到事态的严重性。
en: Europeans who have stopped dreaming about Europe, who take peace, reconciliation, and above all freedom for granted, do not realize what is at stake.

zh: 持有“能源的国家理由 ” （ energy raison d’état）而让欧洲将其三分之一的能源资源系于俄罗斯身上不啻自杀。
en: To embrace an “energy raison d’état” that leaves Europe dependent upon Russia for about one-third of its energy resources would be suicidal.

zh: 欧洲有第二条路可走。
en: Alternatives do exist.

zh: 只要有决心，欧洲可以对克里姆林宫和俄罗斯天然气公司（Gazprom）说不。
en: Europe can say no to the Kremlin and Gazprom if only it has the will to do so.

zh: 既现实又有尊严的政策是拿出坚决和决心给普京的俄罗斯定下限度。
en: The only possible policy that can be both realist and dignified consists in a combination of firmness and resolution to set limits to Putin’s Russia.

zh: 这是因为，美国已不是从前的美国（小布什做的太多，奥巴马做的太少 ） ， 欧洲的基于价值的盟友比任何时候都要弥足珍贵。
en: It is precisely because America is no longer what it used to be (having done too much under George W. Bush and too little under Barack Obama) that Europe’s values-based alliance is more indispensable than ever.

zh: 这些价值带来了柏林墙的倒塌，激励了基辅的示威者勇敢地面对乌克兰的严冬，走上广场。
en: It is these values that led to the fall of the Berlin Wall and motivated the demonstrators in Kyiv to brave the brutal Ukrainian winter outdoors on the Maidan.

zh: 亚洲人和欧洲人都能比欧洲人更好地理解欧洲价值的重要性。
en: From Asia to Africa, people seem to have a much better understanding than Europeans of the significance of European values.

zh: 你只消听一听他们对这一和平、妥协甚至相对平等（与美国相比）的大陆的赞美即可领略一二。
en: You just have to listen to them praising the continent of peace, reconciliation, and even relative equality (compared to the US).

zh: 对欧盟来说，选择从未如此清晰。
en: For the EU, the choice has never been clearer.

zh: 要想生存和繁荣，欧盟就必须将确定价值的地理作为压倒一切的任务。
en: If it is to survive and prosper, it must set the geography of values above all else.

zh: 俄罗斯和中国的不现实政治
en: Unrealpolitik in Russia and China

zh: 巴黎—玛格丽特·麦克米兰（Margaret Macmillan）在其探讨一战起源的新书《结束和平的战争 》 （ The War That Ended Peace）中指出，唯一可以确定的因素是领导力很重要。
en: PARIS – In her recent book on the origins of World War I, The War That Ended Peace, Margaret MacMillan concludes that the only thing one can say with certainty about its causes is that leadership matters.

zh: 没人真的愿意打仗，但没人知道如何反对打仗，因为像德国的俾斯麦这样的伟大政治家（他的克制让欧洲得到了几十年的和平）也会在1914年的欧洲败下阵来。
en: No one really wanted war, but no one knew how to oppose it, because great statesmen like Germany’s Otto von Bismarck, whose self-restraint preserved peace in Europe for decades, were missing in Europe in 1914.

zh: 如今，俄罗斯和中国的行为表明我们面临着类似的领导力空缺。
en: A similar leadership void has become palpable in recent behavior by Russia and China.

zh: 在走向一战的过程中，政治和军事领导人没能意识到工业生产和大规模运输已经改变了战争的性质。
en: In the run-up to WWI, political and military leaders failed to grasp how industrial production and mass transportation had altered the character of warfare.

zh: 美国内战本应成为对欧洲的警告。
en: The American Civil War should have served as a warning for Europeans.

zh: 但欧洲仍把自己当作世界中心，以“传播文明”为名将对手送往非洲和亚洲，而完全没有注意到新世界的惨痛教训。
en: But a Europe that considered itself the center of the world, exporting its rivalries to Africa and Asia in the name of a “civilizing mission,” was utterly incapable of paying attention to the harsh lessons of the New World.

zh: 如今，不管是俄罗斯总统普京还是中国国家主席习近平，也都没有吸取这些教训。
en: Today, neither Russian President Vladimir Putin nor Chinese President Xi Jinping seem to have learned those lessons, either.

zh: 在乌克兰，俄罗斯必须选择与欧洲建设怎样的关系。
en: In Ukraine, Russia must choose what kind of relationship it wants to have with Europe.

zh: 如果乌克兰回到克里姆林宫的怀抱 — — 不管是通过重新统一还是某种形式的“芬兰化 ” — —俄罗斯就将重新开启一个古老的欧洲问题：与1643—1815年间的法国和魏玛德国一样，对于邻国而言，它将变得“太甚 ” ， 而对于自己的雄心而言，它又“不够 ” 。
en: If Ukraine returns to the Kremlin’s orbit, whether through direct reintegration or some kind of “Finlandization,” Russia will end up reenacting an old European problem: like France from 1643 to 1815 and Wilhelmine Germany, it will be both “too much” for its neighbors and “not enough” for its ambitions.

zh: 姑且不论俄罗斯为何需要花费如此大的代价维持比其本身还要腐败无能的乌克兰政权，拥有比法国更大的领土和4500万人口的乌克兰实际上是欧洲地缘政治均衡的决定因素。
en: Leaving aside why Russia should want to pay so much money to sustain a Ukrainian regime that is even more corrupt and dysfunctional than its own, Ukraine, with a territory greater than France and a population of 45 million, is the de facto linchpin of Europe’s geopolitical equilibrium.

zh: 与十八世纪比他大两倍的波兰不同，乌克兰不存在分裂问题，即西部加入欧洲，东部回归俄罗斯。
en: Unlike Poland three times in the eighteenth century, there can be no question of partition, with western Ukraine joining Europe and the country’s east returning to Russia.

zh: 因此，乌克兰的文明选择 — — 选民主的欧盟还是独裁的俄罗斯 — — 将对整个欧洲大陆造成巨大的战略后果。
en: As a result, Ukraine’s civilizational choice – between a democratic European Union and an autocratic Russia – will necessarily have major strategic consequences for the entire European continent.

zh: 中国在南海 — — 目前还包括其领空���—所面临的问题性质类似。
