en: The problem that China faces in the South China Sea – and now in its airspace – is of a similar nature.

zh: 中国也失去了其一直以来的对外政策特征 — — 克制了吗？
en: Is China, too, losing the sense of restraint that characterized its foreign policy until recently?

zh: 如今，中国表现出一种不耐烦，这与其长期国家利益相悖。
en: The Chinese seem now to be displaying an impatience that is contrary to their country’s long-term interests.

zh: 中国突出的全球地位是显而易见的，也是被所有人所承认的。
en: China’s heightened global status is obvious and recognized by all.

zh: 但作为对其文明充满自信、对其未来充满信心的超级大国，为什么不能保持宁静，不争朝夕？
en: But where is the serenity of a great power so confident in the superiority of its civilization, and so secure in its future, that it bides its time?

zh: 通过宣扬地区霸权野心，中国已经成为越南、印尼和菲律宾等国家的共同敌人。
en: By flaunting its hegemonic regional ambitions, China has managed to unify against it countries as diverse as Vietnam, Indonesia, and the Philippines.

zh: 如今，这些国家比以往任何时候都更希望美国继续充当亚洲力量。
en: These countries now want more than ever America’s continuing presence as an Asian power.

zh: 事实上，它们甚至抛开了与日本的历史恩怨，更加认同日本首相安倍晋三政府的基调及其最新的更加强硬的防务政策，更担心中国最近的耀武扬威。
en: Indeed, transcending their historical enmity with Japan, they tend to show more understanding for the rhetoric of Japanese Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s government – and its new and more muscular defense policy – than for China’s recent demonstration of force.

zh: 有人说，历史无所不包，但我们从中什么也学不到。
en: It is sometimes said that history teaches us nothing, for it contains everything.

zh: 但学习古典外交在今天可能比在二十世纪更加有用。
en: Yet the teachings of classical diplomacy are probably more useful today than they were in the twentieth century.

zh: 宏大意识形态的时代已经过去了；新时代的特征是严格的利益召唤算计。
en: The age of grand ideologies is behind us; an era marked by strict calculation of interest beckons.

zh: 与此同时，战争的变化可能更甚于外交 — — 消极结果更大。
en: In the interim, war may have changed more than diplomacy – and probably for the worse.

zh: 我们的武器的杀伤力因为“敌人”变得更加分散而登峰造极。
en: Our weapons’ destructive power has peaked at a time when the “enemy” is becoming more diffuse.

zh: 你如何在不稳定的基础上发动战争？
en: How do you make war on instability?

zh: 你如何与消失在公民社会中的敌人战斗？
en: How do you fight an adversary that disappears into civil society?

zh: 即使技术进步已经改变了外交官的职责，外交游戏的规则从根本上说并未改变。
en: Even if technological progress has changed the diplomat’s job, the rules of the diplomatic game remain fundamentally the same.

zh: 成功的前提是理解利益，感受对手的感觉，以及现代化和自我克制的内省。 这些都是俄罗斯和中国所欠缺的。
en: Success presupposes an understanding of the interests and perceptions of one’s counterparts, as well as an innate sense of moderation and self-limitation, something that both Russia and China seem to be lacking.

zh: 相反，你可能弄不清楚美国总统奥巴马是否不应该学习俾斯麦，而应该学习领导普鲁士统一德国的铁血首相俾斯麦。
en: By contrast, one may wonder whether US President Barack Obama should not also learn from Bismarck – but from Bismarck the Iron Chancellor, who united Germany behind Prussia.

zh: 在其对伊朗政策中 — — 以及更能说明问题的对叙利亚政策中 — — 他是否拿出了足够强硬和明确的态度？
en: Is he demonstrating enough toughness and clarity of vision in his policy toward Iran – or, even more to the point, toward Syria?

zh: 俾斯麦证明了冷血的现实政治是维持和平的最好方式。
en: Cold-blooded realpolitik, as Bismarck showed, is the best way to keep the peace.

zh: 非洲悖论
en: The African Paradox

zh: 巴黎—本月早些时候，帕斯卡·辛比康瓦（Pascal Simbikangwa）审判在巴黎开始。
en: PARIS – Earlier this month, the trial of Pascal Simbikangwa, accused of complicity in the genocide in Rwanda, in which 800,000 people were killed between April and July 1994, began in Paris.

zh: 辛比康瓦被控参与了导致1994年4月—7月800,000人丧生的卢旺达种族灭绝。
en: Unfortunately, mass killings in Africa continue.

zh: 不幸的是，非洲的大规模杀戮仍然没有停止，特别是在博尔（Bor）市附近。
en: In South Sudan, Africa’s newest state, massacres of civilians are still taking place, particularly around the city of Bor.

zh: 法国对中非共和国的军事干涉并没有结束那里的社会间暴力。
en: And French military intervention in the Central African Republic has not put an end to severe inter-communal violence there.

zh: 然而奇怪的是，尽管非洲的社会间暴力一直存在，并且或许比世界其他地区更加严重，却扔不妨碍这个块大陆成为希望之光。
en: Yet, paradoxically, even as such episodes continue to occur in Africa, perhaps on a larger scale than anywhere else in the world, the continent has also become a beacon of hope.

zh: 事实上，极端暴力的持久存在与非洲有利的人口结构及其近几年来的经济 — — 甚至政治和社会 — — 进步形成了鲜明的对比。
en: Indeed, the perpetuation of extreme violence contrasts starkly with Africa’s favorable demographic profile, and its economic – and even political and social – progress in recent years.

zh: 解释这一悖论的一个思路是一段长达四个世纪的插曲的结束。
en: One way to think about this paradox is in terms of the closing of a four-century-long parenthesis.

zh: 自十七世纪以来，非洲一直主要作为一个历史客体（object of history）存在。
en: Since the seventeenth-century, Africa has been mainly an object of history.

zh: 非洲人民先是被当作奴隶像商品一样被贸易，成为其他地区的经济增长之源。
en: Its people were first treated by the slave trade as mere commodities, necessary for economic growth elsewhere.

zh: 接着，殖民势力人为地肆意瓜分这块大陆，打着冠冕堂皇的“文明化”的幌子极尽贪婪之能事。
en: Then colonial powers carved up the continent artificially and arbitrarily, masking their greed behind noble-sounding goals: theirs was a “civilizing” mission.

zh: 然后，在二十世纪上半叶，欧洲在两次世界大战中泥足深陷，而非洲为此付出了居民的鲜血和资源。
en: Later, during the first half of the twentieth century, Africa offered the blood of its inhabitants, and then recourse to its territories, to a European continent in the throes of two world wars.

zh: 而在二十世纪下半叶，在经历了残酷的反殖民地斗争后，非洲的新兴独立国家又称为冷战的代理战场。
en: And, in the second half of the twentieth century, after a brutal anti-colonial struggle, Africa’s newly independent countries became proxy battlegrounds in the Cold War.

zh: 与此形成对比的是，如今非洲正在走向重回历史主体（subject of history）之路。
en: Today, by contrast, Africa is in the process of returning as a subject of history.

zh: 非洲有十亿多居民，占世界人口的18 % ， 它正在重新获得十六世纪初的地位。
en: With more than one billion inhabitants, representing 18% of the world’s population, Africa is regaining the place it occupied at the beginning of the sixteenth century.

zh: 当时的欧洲有一亿人，占世界人口的20 % 。
en: Then, with 100 million people, it represented 20% of the world’s population.

zh: 到十九世纪中叶，在经历了200多年的殖民和奴役后，非洲人口下降到9,500万，只占世界总数的9 % ， 与此同时，其他大洲经历了人口的大规模增长。
en: By the middle of the nineteenth century, after more than 200 years of colonialism and slavery, Africa’s population had fallen to 95 million – just 9% of the world total – whereas other continents had experienced a large population increase over the same period.

zh: 在经济上，撒哈拉以南非洲过去十年的年均GDP增长为5—6 % 。
en: Economically, Sub-Saharan Africa has experienced a decade of 5-6% average annual GDP growth.

zh: 坦桑尼亚今年的增长应该能达到7 % 。
en: In Tanzania, growth this year should be around 7%.

zh: 当其他主要经济体（除了中国）正面临减速时，非洲携其无穷无尽的能源资源和珍惜原材料（包括稀土元素）自然成为了投资者注意力的焦点。
en: At a time when the major emerging economies – with the exception of China – are facing a sharp slowdown, Africa, with its untapped energy resources and precious raw materials, including rare earth minerals, has naturally become a focus of investors’ attention.

zh: 但是，尽管非洲可以被认为是希望之洲，它却不可能成为“新亚洲 ” ， 即全球增长的长期发动机，这是文化、政治、地缘政治也许还有心理因素共同作用的结果。
en: But, though Africa can be described as the continent of hope, it is unlikely to become the “New Asia” – that is, a long-term dynamo of global growth – for a combination of cultural, political, geopolitical, and perhaps psychological reasons.

zh: 亚洲经历过持续的大一统帝国。
en: Asia has experienced the historical continuity of great empires.

zh: 中国是这一现象的最佳写照。
en: China is the best illustration of this phenomenon.

zh: 中国是一个重新崛起的大国，而不是一个新兴大国，这是能够阐释中国自信的一个决定性因素。
en: It is a reemerging power, not an emerging one, a decisive factor that explains Chinese confidence.

zh: 亚洲各大国之间有着悠久的对抗和竞争史，这也是其近期经济成功的一大重要原因。
en: Asia’s long history of rivalry and competition among its various powers has also been an important factor in its recent economic success.

zh: 中国、日本和韩国之间的竞争和模仿的动态竞争是和平妥协的二战后欧洲所没有的；非洲亦然。
en: The dynamic of competition and emulation among China, Japan, and South Korea has not existed in peacefully reconciled post-WWII Europe; there is nothing like it in Africa, either.

zh: 尼日利亚不是非洲的中国。
en: Nigeria is not Africa’s equivalent of what China is for Asia.

zh: 后种族隔离时代南非尽管取得了显著的进步，也不可能成为非洲的中国，甚至不可能成为非洲大陆警察。
en: And post-apartheid South Africa, for all its progress, has not fulfilled the expectations placed on it, and remains unlikely to become the continent’s gendarme.

zh: 殖民主义和奴隶贸易构成了非洲的一大历史裂痕。
en: Colonialism and the slave trade constituted a historical rupture for Africa.

zh: 除了人员伤亡 — — 包括1,000—1,500万直接受害者 — — 绝对镇压也是自信缺失的独特源头。
en: Beyond the human toll – including 10-15 million direct victims – absolute subjugation begot a unique loss of confidence.

zh: 今天，谁能说出非洲有哪些帝国和王国？
en: Who today can name Africa’s great empires and kingdoms?

zh: 有谁知道十六世纪发现拉丁美洲黄金以前黄金来自哪里？
en: Who knows where the worlds’ gold came from before its discovery in Latin America in the sixteenth century?

zh: 非洲必须找到它所急需的对其他地区看待它的信心。
en: Africa must find the confidence it desperately needs in the way others look at it.

zh: 问题在于其他地区都对非洲大陆的前殖民地时期历史一无所知。
en: The problem is that others are abysmally ignorant about the continent’s pre-colonial past.

zh: 你可以批评中国人的愤世嫉俗，但在非洲自我形象的转变方面，中国起到的作用比其他任何国家都要大。
en: One may criticize the cynicism of the Chinese, but it is China that has contributed more than any other country to the transformation of Africa’s self-image.

zh: 如今，非洲的未来掌握在非洲人民自己手里。
en: Today, it is Africans themselves who hold their continent’s future in their hands.

zh: 随着非洲回归历史主体而不是客体，它正在体现人类的所有恐惧和希望。
en: And, as Africa returns as a subject, rather than an object, of world history, it appears to embody all the fears and hopes of humanity.

zh: 非洲的一切都是极端的：沙漠化、人口的大规模运动，是的，还有种族灭绝暴力，但新式经济增长甚至新治理模式的希望也是如此。
en: Everything is there in extreme form: desertification, mass movements of populations, and, yes, genocidal violence – but also the hope for new forms of economic growth, if not new modes of governance.

zh: 法国犹太人之伤
en: The Trauma of France’s Jews

zh: 巴黎 — “ 犹太人去死！
en: PARIS – “Death to the Jews!”

zh: ”在巴黎和其他法国城市，这类充满仇恨的字眼纷纷涌现。
en: In Paris and other French cities, the hate-filled words ring out.

zh: 自从十九世纪末的德雷福斯案（Dreyfus Affair）以来，法国就存在攻击犹太教堂的行为。
en: Attacks on synagogues have taken place for the first time since the Dreyfus Affair at the end of the nineteenth century.

zh: 在法国近郊地区，比如以宗教和种族容忍氛围著名的萨尔塞勒镇（Sarcelles ） ， 年轻人们有组织地故意针对犹太人财产发动攻击。
en: In suburban areas near Paris, such as the town of Sarcelles, known for its climate of religious and ethnic tolerance, groups of young people have deliberately targeted Jewish properties.

zh: 法国犹太社会面临着来势汹汹的反移民民粹主义，现在又出现了反犹太复国示威游行（这往往与新形式的反犹主义相辅相成 ） ， 这令他们非常痛苦又迷惑不解。
en: Faced with the spectacular rise of anti-immigrant populism in France, and now with anti-Zionist demonstrations (which often coincide with an updated version of anti-Semitism), the French Jewish community is anguished and puzzled.

zh: 一些犹太人很快开始质疑他们在这个人权之国是否还有未来。
en: Some of its members are quietly asking themselves whether there is a future for them in the land of human rights.

zh: 法国犹太人正在重新经历他们在二十世纪所经历的双重伤害：二战中的死亡集中营和1962年阿尔及利亚独立后的大逃亡。
en: French Jews are rediscovering the dual trauma that they experienced during the twentieth century: the death-camp deportations of World War II and their flight from Algeria following its independence in 1962.

zh: 预计这两段经历将决定 — — 并放大 — — 当下的感情色彩。
en: It is to be expected that these episodes color – and tend to exacerbate – the emotions of the present.

zh: 东欧犹太人的法国后裔从未妥协于这片大陆 — — 包括维希政府治下的法国。 在这里他们经历了大屠杀。
en: French descendants of Eastern European Jews have not yet fully come to terms with a continent – including Vichy France – that they still associate with the Holocaust, whereas Jews from the Maghreb tend to resent the fact that even in France, they remain surrounded by “Arabs.”

zh: 而来自马格里布（Maghreb）的犹太人憎恨一个事实 — — 他们仍处于“阿拉伯人”的包围中。 事实上，法国南部很大一部分犹太人社区都支持极右翼的国民阵线（National Front ） ， 在马琳·勒庞（Marine Le Pen）的领导下，该党对穆斯林掀起了仇外主义。
en: Indeed, a significant portion of the Jewish community in the south of France votes for the far-right National Front, which, under the leadership of Marine Le Pen, has concentrated its xenophobia on Muslims.

zh: 在如此紧张的局势下，毫不奇怪，在经历了七十年的间断后，反犹主义是否回归法国的问题正在全球引起轩然大波。
en: In this tense setting, it comes as no surprise that the question of whether anti-Semitism has returned to France, after a seven-decade hiatus, is making international headlines.

zh: 英国和美国媒体将此与纳粹时代相提并论，有的甚至在法国犹太教堂遭袭后认为这是法国的“水晶破碎之夜 ” （ Kristallnacht ） 。
en: British and American media reports have made comparisons to the Nazi era, with some even referring, in the aftermath of attacks on French synagogues, to a French Kristallnacht.

zh: 如此夸张的比较必须严词拒绝，因为这违背了因为维希政府向纳粹德国投降而饱受摧残的犹太人的记忆。
en: Such hyperbole must be firmly rejected, for it offends the memory of those who suffered as a result of Vichy France’s collaboration with Nazi Germany.

zh: 1943年，盖世太保在尼斯逮捕了我的父亲，随后他被法国宪兵押送至巴黎市郊德兰西（Drancy）的临时集中营，随后被押解送至奥斯维辛。
en: After the Gestapo arrested my father in Nice in 1943, he was escorted by French gendarmes to the transit camp at Drancy, in the Paris suburbs, before being deported to Auschwitz.

zh: 相反，2014年，法国对犹太教堂做了保护，并谴责任何形式的反犹主义。
en: In 2014, by contrast, the French state defends the synagogues and denounces any form of anti-Semitism.

zh: 但如果说法国并不反犹，那么反犹主义确实存在于法国 — — 并且在今天比在战后时期更加嚣张。
en: But even if the French state is not anti-Semitic, anti-Semitism does exist in France – and probably more so recently than in the postwar period.

zh: 而中东局势的恶化当然也在其中起到了重要作用，特别是来自加沙的恐怖画面。
en: And the worsening situation in the Middle East has, of course, played a key role in this, particularly the shocking images from Gaza.

zh: 由以色列发动的不对称战争不但不容于阿拉伯人和穆斯林，世界上大部分人都对此表示不齿。
en: The asymmetrical war being waged there by Israel seems disproportionate to a majority of world opinion, not just Arabs and Muslims.

zh: 平心而论，没有哪个国家可以消极接受火箭弹袭击它的城市。
en: To be sure, no state can passively accept rocket attacks on its cities.

zh: 并且，哈马斯也故意选择人口稠密地区部署军事武器，以蒙在鼓里的无辜市民 — — 或者那些有时被以色列官员以毫不掩饰的怀疑��度称为“不相关”的人群 — — 为保护盾。
en: And, yes, Hamas deliberately chooses to place its military arsenal in highly populated areas under the involuntary protective shield of innocent civilians – or those Israeli officials sometimes refer to, with barely concealed mistrust, as the “uninvolved.”

zh: 但以色列采取恐怖战略威慑哈马斯的继续打击或重建暂时“安静”代价沉重，不仅巴勒斯坦人大量伤亡，以色列士兵也损失惨重；并且全球以色列人的安全状况都因此恶化。
en: But the strategy of terror used by the Israeli authorities to deter further attacks or to restore a temporary “quiet” has been costly not only in terms of Palestinian lives lost and Israeli soldiers killed; it has also contributed to the deterioration of the security of Jews around the world.

zh: 在法国，许多犹太人既表达出对以色列的深深的爱，也表示对以色列现在的所作所为深感忧虑 — — 他们的表达通常都是安静的。
en: In France, too, many of them express – often quietly – both their deep love for what Israel is and their deep concern for what Israel is now doing.

zh: 认为中东冲突不应该波及法国是一回事。
en: It is one thing to say that the Middle East conflict should not be exported to France.

zh: 认识到丧生的巴勒斯坦妇孺的景象对法国人所造成的不可避免的印象是另一回事。 他们与巴勒斯坦感同身受，正如犹太人与以色列感同身受。
en: It is another to recognize the inevitable impact of images of dead Palestinian women and children on communities in France that feel close to Palestine the way that Jews feel close to Israel.

zh: 如果说加沙的景象在法国引起了极大共振，那么部分原因就在于惊人的数字：欧洲最大穆斯林社区遇上了欧洲最大犹太社区。
en: If the images from Gaza seem to resonate so much in France, it is partly a matter of sheer numbers: the largest Muslim community in Europe faces the largest Jewish community in Europe.

zh: 但这不仅仅是数字的问题。
en: But it is not only a question of numbers.

zh: 袭击犹太教堂的年轻暴徒大多来自无业游民、失去生活希望者。
en: The young thugs who have attacked synagogues come mostly from the ranks of the unemployed and frustrated.

zh: 他们将怒气发泄在了没有让他们融入其中的制度上。
en: They vent their rage at a system that does not integrate them.

zh: 他们甚至憎恨法兰西共和国对二战期间犹太人苦难的纪念。
en: They even resent the Republic’s commemoration of Jews’ suffering during WWII.

zh: 对他们来说，昔日的恐怖是抽象的，只有当下的恐怖才能让他们感同身受。
en: For them, past horror is abstract; only the present horror can be felt.

zh: 今天的中东惨象与穆斯林少数群体的不满（有时受极端原教旨主义意识形态影响）的碰撞不应该混淆传统法国反犹主义（资产阶级白人 ） ， 他们仍然存在，并且隐藏得并不深。
en: The encounter between the images of today’s Middle East and the discontent of Muslim minorities (sometimes influenced by radical fundamentalist ideologies) should not be allowed to obscure traditional French anti-Semitism, white and bourgeois, which still lingers and is never far beneath the surface.

zh: 拜互联网所赐，这一意识形态已开始日益暴露。
en: Thanks to the Internet, it, too, has begun to emerge more often.

zh: 但法国做了必须做的事镇压和遏制反犹主义。
en: But the French state does what it has to do to repress and contain anti-Semitism.

zh: 与纳粹时代的欧洲相提并论并不能让正在火山边上起舞的法国安下心来 — — 尽管当时和现在存在如此多的重大历史差异。
en: Comparisons to Nazi-era Europe do nothing to reassure a community that, despite all of the major historical differences between then and now, cannot quite shake the feeling that it is dancing on the rim of a volcano.

zh: 土耳其失去的幻想
en: Turkey’s Lost Illusions

zh: 巴黎 — “ 日复一日，欧洲正在远离土耳其。 ”土耳其欧盟事务部长巴基斯（Egemen Bağış）上周如是说。
en: PARIS – “Day by day, Europe is moving further away from Turkey,” Egemen Bağış, Turkey’s Minister for European Union Affairs, declared last week.

zh: 但事实正好相反：在幻想破灭和违抗的共同作用下，近几年来土耳其拉开了自己与欧洲之间的距离。
en: But the reverse is equally true: With a mixture of disillusion and defiance, Turkey has been distancing itself from Europe in recent years.

zh: “如果你们不想要我们”土耳其人不啻于如是说 ， “ 我们也真的不想要你们。 ”
en: “If you do not want us,” the Turks appear to be saying, “we really do not want you.”

zh: 在现实中，在“阿拉伯之春”爆发近三年后，土耳其迷失自我的程度更甚于欧洲，即使土耳其需要欧洲的程度更甚于土耳其人之所愿承认。
en: In reality, nearly three years after the beginning of the “Arab Spring,” Turkey is more in search of itself than it is of Europe, even if it needs Europe more than Turks are willing to admit.

zh: 什么是当代土耳其，什么是它的价值，什么是它在快速变化的地区环境中的命运？
en: What is Turkey today, what are its values, and what is its destiny in a highly fluid regional environment?

zh: 阿拉伯之春最开始被视为土耳其的良机，一次彰显其国家经济成功、民主政治模式和不可或缺的地区战略作用的理想机会。
en: The Arab Spring was initially seen as a great opportunity for Turkey, an ideal setting in which to highlight the country’s economic success, democratic political model, and indispensable strategic role in the region.

zh: 作为世界上最伟大帝国之一的继承者，土耳其向世界证明，伊斯兰教可以与现代性完美相容 — — 这对像埃及这样的阿拉伯国家来说是一个鼓舞人心的例子。
en: The inheritors of one of the world’s great empires were proving to the world that Islam and modernity were perfectly compatible – an inspiring example for Arab countries like Egypt.

zh: 相反，土耳其的作用激发了埃及人民的保留态度；毕竟，奥斯曼帝国曾经统治过埃及。
en: Instead, Turkey’s role inspired reservations among Egyptians; after all, the Ottoman Empire had ruled over Egypt.

zh: 在土耳其方面，则存在主宰阿拉伯世界的情绪。
en: And, on the Turkish side, there was a sense of superiority vis-à-vis the Arab world.

zh: 苏联的解体唤醒了土耳其人在高加索和中亚的“新奥斯曼”雄心，而中东革命似乎给予了早已成为过往云烟的奥斯曼帝国继承者（如果不是孤儿的话）收复失地的机会。
en: The collapse of the Soviet Union awakened “neo-Ottoman” Turkish ambitions in the Caucasus and Central Asia, and revolution in the Middle East seemed to offer the heirs (if not orphans) of a long-dead empire an opportunity to avenge its loss.

zh: 如果懒散而恐惧的欧洲不想要土耳其，真是太糟糕了；历史给了土耳其人好得多的替代方案。
en: If a lazy and fearful Europe did not want Turkey, so much the worse for Europe; history was offering more glorious alternatives to the Turks.

zh: 尽管土耳其人对布鲁塞尔和巴黎来说太东方、太带宗教色彩，但从开罗和突尼斯城的角度看，土耳其堪称理想的通往民主的西方和经济活力四射的亚洲的穆斯林桥梁。
en: Whereas Turkey could appear too Oriental and too religious in Brussels or Paris, when viewed from Cairo or Tunis, it looked like an ideal Muslim bridge to the democratic West and economically dynamic Asia.

zh: 此外，土耳其堪称胜负手，因为它对两大伙伴和对手 — — 伊朗和叙利亚采取“睦邻”政策，并支持执政生涯短暂的埃及总统穆尔西。
en: Moreover, Turkey could play some powerful cards, owing to its “good neighbor” policy with two partners and rivals, Iran and Syria, as well as its support for the short-lived presidency of Mohamed Morsi in Egypt.

zh: 不幸的是，土耳其精英的希望（如果不是期望）并没有实现。
en: Unfortunately, Turkish elites’ hopes (if not expectations) were not realized.

zh: 阿拉伯革命最终暴露了土耳其自身的弱点和矛盾，并且因为总理埃尔多安的镇压政策和自负的政治风格而进一步加剧。
en: The Arab revolutions ended up exposing Turkey’s own weaknesses and contradictions, further aggravated by Prime Minister Recep Tayyip Erdoğan’s repressive policies and overweening political style.

zh: 一个明证是今春伊斯坦布尔塔克西姆广场（Taksim Square）的游行演变为全国各地开花的示威（尽管示威的性质更接近于巴西最近的骚乱和1968年的巴黎反抗，而不是埃及和土耳其的群众运动 ） 。
en: This became clear in the demonstrations that spread this spring from Istanbul’s Taksim Square to much of the rest of the country (though the protests had more in common with Brazil’s recent unrest or the revolt in Paris in 1968 than with the popular movements in Egypt or Tunisia).

zh: 如今，土耳其的特点是对该国不断扩大的影响力的骄傲和希望不如对其分崩离析的担忧。
en: What characterizes Turks today is not so much pride and hope in their country’s expanding influence as fear of its disintegration.

zh: 库尔德问题困扰着土耳其，除此之外，越来越多的土耳其人感到他们正在失去对两大关键问题的控制，即叙利亚和伊朗危机。
en: The Kurdish problem preoccupies Turks, as does their growing sense that they are losing control of two essential issues – the Syrian and Iranian crises.

zh: 最近几个月来，土耳其政府对叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德政权的立场越来越强硬，认为必须将他推翻。
en: In recent months, Turkey’s government has adopted an increasingly tougher stance toward Syrian President Bashar al-Assad’s regime, convinced that it can only fall.

zh: 从这个角度看，美国和俄罗斯最近所达成的协议是令人沮丧的消息：作为摧毁其化学武库的交换，巴沙尔政权可能会保留。
en: The agreement recently reached by the United States and Russia is, from this standpoint, frustrating news: For the price of destroying its chemical arsenal, the regime may have saved itself.

zh: 于是，土耳其必须思索讨好西方究竟有什么好处。
en: So Turkey must wonder what purpose is to be served by courting the West.

zh: 如果结局是被美国抛弃（如果不是背叛的话 ） ， 为什么还要在美国的压力下重启与以色列的最新正式对话？
en: Why resume, under US pressure, a nearly normal dialogue with Israel if the outcome is to be abandoned, if not betrayed, by American policy?

zh: 类似地，由于伊朗总统鲁哈尼的温和论调，加上伊朗与西方关于其核计划的纠纷有望取得进展，土耳其大有无用（如果不是孤立的话）之感。
en: Similarly, Iranian President Hassan Rouhani’s moderate rhetoric, together with possible progress on Iran’s dispute with the West over its nuclear program, has left Turkey with a sense of uselessness, if not isolation.

zh: 如果一国感到自己在关键时刻被边缘化，它如何自认为以及被别人认为是至关重要的地区行动方？
en: How can a country perceive itself, and be perceived by others, as a key regional actor if it finds itself marginalized at the critical moment?

zh: 历史正在中东演进，但并非按土耳其希望的方向。
en: History is moving in the Middle East, but not in the direction that Turkey would prefer.

zh: 此外，随着土耳其经济增长势头的减弱，其政府立场的强硬，以及其外交表现日益令人失望，许多土耳其人如今公开质疑形势。
en: And, with their country’s economic growth faltering, its government hardening, and its diplomatic performance a source of growing disappointment, many Turks now openly wonder what happened.

zh: 但是，他们往往决不会采取开放、积极的自我批评，而是回归咄咄逼人的民族主义，表现出十足的戒心，其实反映的是日益缺失的自信。
en: But, far from engaging in an open and positive self-examination, they are too often retreating into a strident nationalism that is all the more defensive to the extent that it reflects a growing lack of self-confidence.

zh: 土耳其最近的挑战是克服失去的幻想。
en: Turkey’s current challenge is to overcome lost illusions.

zh: 而这意味着土耳其人可能比所愿承认的更加需要欧洲。
en: And that means that Turks may need Europe more than they are willing to admit, even to themselves.

zh: 但今天的欧洲比昔日准备得更充分、更愿意与土耳其进行严肃对话吗？
en: But is Europe today any more ready and willing than it was yesterday to engage in serious talks with Turkey?

zh: 欧洲的反欧者
en: Europe’s Anti-Europeans

zh: 巴黎—2005年，欧盟的两个创始国法国和荷兰以全民公投拒绝了欧盟宪法条约。
en: PARIS – In 2005, two founding members of the European Union, France and the Netherlands, rejected by popular referendum the EU’s proposed constitutional treaty.

zh: 这两个国家的两个极右翼政党 — — 法国国民阵线（French National Front）和荷兰自由党（Dutch Freedom Party）如今抢在2014年5月的欧洲议会选举前结成了同盟。
en: Two far-right parties from these countries, the French National Front and the Dutch Freedom Party, have now formed an alliance ahead of the European Parliament elections in May 2014.

zh: 它们希望吸引欧盟国家立场相似的政党，组成一股强大的议会派别除掉“欧洲恶魔 ” — —自由党领袖怀德斯（Greet Wilders）这样称呼欧盟。
en: They hope to attract likeminded parties in other EU countries and form a parliamentary bloc powerful enough to slay “the monster of Europe,” as Geert Wilders, the Freedom Party’s leader, calls the EU.

zh: 法国和荷兰在这场下三滥阴谋中当先并不是巧合。
en: It is no accident that France and the Netherlands have taken the lead in this sordid venture.

zh: 这两个国家都处于深刻的身份危机中，身份危机让它们仇视欧洲、外国人、移民和一切代表“其他人”的人。
en: Both countries are in the midst of a deep identity crisis that is mutating into disdain for Europe, foreigners, migrants, and all who represent the “other.”

zh: 这两个国家都在经历公众对传统政治精英的日渐怀疑。
en: And both countries are experiencing an increase in popular suspicion toward traditional political elites.

zh: 在这样的背景下，即将到来的欧洲议会选举似乎成为为极端主义政党量身定做的机会，最新的公共观点调查表明国民阵线将成为法国首屈一指的政党。
en: In this environment, the upcoming European Parliament elections seem tailor-made for extremist parties, with recent public-opinion polls suggesting that the National Front will come out on top in France.

zh: 大部分公民对欧洲选举漠不关心，这导致了低投票率 — — 除了那些（根据他们所反对者的定义）想要表达对现状的愤怒和失望的人。
en: European elections leave most citizens indifferent, which translates into low voter turnout – except among those who, defined by what they oppose, wish to express their anger and frustration with the status quo.

zh: 国民阵线领袖勒庞（Marine Le Pen）精干高效，她提出的口号十分直接 ： “ 欧洲反对人民，因此人民必须奋起反对欧洲。
en: Marine Le Pen, the National Front’s leader, is shrewd and efficient, running on a straightforward message: “Europe is against the people, so the people must mobilize against Europe.”

zh: ”她外表上是个温和派，远比其父、国民阵线前领袖让-马里·勒庞（Jean-Marie Le Pen）有号召力。
en: With her semblance of moderation, she is far more appealing than her father and former party leader, Jean-Marie Le Pen.

zh: 她的战略是与过去的反犹主义彻底撇清关系，以此打入法国政坛主流，从而让国民阵线成为式微的传统右翼的貌似合法的替代者。 自萨科齐在2012年总统选举中败北以来，传统右翼一直处于内斗之中。
en: Her strategy is to enter the mainstream of French politics by shedding all traces of past anti-Semitism, thereby turning the National Front into a seemingly legitimate alternative to a decadent traditional right, which has suffered a prolonged bout of infighting since Nicolas Sarkozy’s defeat in the 2012 presidential election.

zh: 在何来，怀德斯 — — 与其说他是一个真实党派的领袖，不如说他在演独角戏 — — 已经进入了政府，他只需要简单地与勒庞结盟，就能向后者提供合法性的外衣。
en: In the Netherlands, Wilders – more a one-man show than the leader of a real party – has already been in government, thereby providing a veneer of legitimacy to Le Pen simply by forming an alliance with her.

zh: 有趣的是，主要丹麦和英国反欧政党拒绝步怀德斯后尘，与一个曾经是、现在可能仍以反犹主义为核心的政党订立契约。
en: Interestingly, the main Danish and British anti-European parties have refused to follow suit, refusing to enter into a pact with a party that was and probably remains anti-Semitic at its core.

zh: 但最终让欧洲极右翼政党抱团的东西与让茶党在美国共和党内部崛起东西十分相似：隐蔽的种族主义和排外主义。
en: And yet what ultimately unites Europe’s far-right parties is similar to what underlies the Tea Party’s rise within America’s Republican Party: covert racism and xenophobia.

zh: 尽管茶党的追随者 — — 早先的一份民调显示89%为白人，只有1%是黑人 — — 以压倒一切的重要性反对的是政府支出，但他们也接受政府对他们自己的帮助。
en: Though the Tea Party’s followers – a group that one early opinion poll identified as 89% white and just 1% black – claim to oppose government spending above all else, they accept government help for themselves.

zh: 他们不能接受的是黑人总统和政府为“他人”支出。
en: What they cannot accept is a black president and government spending on “others.”

zh: 类似地，尽管欧洲民粹主义者以其对“布鲁塞尔”的反对作为令旗，他们的意识形态与他们的前辈的动机并没有区别。
en: Likewise, though Europe’s populists use their opposition to “Brussels” as a rallying flag, their ideology retains the atavism that motivated their forebears.

zh: 今天的极右翼势力可能反穆斯林甚于反犹 — — 怀德斯甚至是以色列拥趸 — — 但他们与20世纪30年代前辈的反人类、愤世嫉俗和种族主义的世界观一脉相承。
en: Today’s far-right forces may be more anti-Muslim than anti-Semitic – Wilders may even be sincerely pro-Israel – but they maintain the anti-humanist, cynical, and racist worldview of their predecessors in the 1930’s.

zh: 当然，像法国这样的国家不会回到20世纪30年代的政治状态，不仅是因为法国人对1940年的军事和道德崩溃记忆犹新。
en: Of course, a country like France is not returning to the politics of the 1930’s, if only because the memories of the country’s military and moral collapse in 1940 have not faded.

zh: 但对黑人司法部长托比拉（Christiane Taubira）的恶毒的种族主义攻击在过去几十年是不可想象的。
en: But the vicious racist attacks on the justice minister, Christiane Taubira, who is black, would have been unthinkable in past decades.

zh: 此外，在整个欧洲，禁忌的缺失以及人为事事可评论、人人可攻讦的观念导致了种族主义事件的增加，尽管从表面上看无不是孤立事件。
en: And, throughout Europe, the loss of taboos and the belief that anything can be said – and anyone insulted – has led to an increase in racist incidents that are only superficially isolated.

zh: 欧洲不会转向法西斯主义；但忽视欧洲正在走向歧途，或者将近来的发展趋势简单地归因为经济不振和高失业也是十分危险的。
en: Europe is not about to turn fascist; yet it would be dangerous to ignore that it is going astray, or to attribute recent developments solely to economic hard times and high unemployment.

zh: 更加基本的因素，包括政治和伦理方面的因素也在起作用。
en: More fundamental causes, political as well as ethical, are at work.

zh: 比如，德国比其他欧洲国家更好地阻止了民粹主义，这不仅是因为德国经济坚挺，德国历史也构成了抵抗力。
en: For example, Germany fares better than other European countries in its resistance to populism, not only because its economy is strong and its history constitutes a form of vaccination.

zh: 德国人还应该感谢其政治领袖（包括现任总理默克尔和她的前任施罗德）的勇气和能力。
en: Germans can also thank the mettle and competence of their political leaders, including Chancellor Angela Merkel and her predecessor, Gerhard Schröder.

zh: 对现今民粹主义/法西斯主义政党的罪恶同盟的最佳应对措施就是勇气、决心和明白无误的立场。
en: The best response to today’s unholy alliance of populist/racist parties is courage, determination, and clarity of position.

zh: 任何主流保守政党和极右翼势力组成的联盟都必然会被打败 — — 不管是在道德上还是在政治上。
en: Any alliance by mainstream conservative parties with far-right forces will turn out to be a guarantee of defeat – moral as well as political.

zh: 这是欧洲历史上已经发生过的事实，也是现今美国共和党发生的事实。
en: That was true in Europe’s past, just as it is true for America’s Republicans today.

zh: 有时候，我们不能和魔鬼共饮一瓢水。
en: Sometimes no spoon is long enough to sup with the devil.

zh: 法国的不和谐四重奏
en: France’s Dissonance Quartet

zh: 巴黎—莫扎特的《不和谐四重奏》很有可能是人类有史以来最美妙的室内乐章。
en: PARIS – Mozart’s “Dissonance Quartet” is arguably one of the most beautiful pieces of chamber music ever written.

zh: 莫扎特之所以叫它“不和谐四重奏 ” ， 很大程度上是因为第一乐章的不同寻常。 而这一标题倒是很好地契合了如今法国政坛的丑陋窗台。
en: The title, linked to its highly unusual first movement, describes perfectly the far less beautiful state of French politics today.

zh: 目前，四方主导着法国的政治舞台：两方属于左派，即奥朗德和瓦尔斯；另两方属于右派，即萨科齐和朱佩。
en: A quartet of figures currently dominate France’s political stage: two on the left, François Hollande and Manuel Valls; and two on the right, Nicolas Sarkozy and Alain Juppé.

zh: 与室内音乐的前提条件相反，他们并没有心往一处使，而是或多或少地公开相对，这样的批评算是轻的。
en: It is an understatement to say that contrary to the prerequisites of chamber music, they do not play together, but more or less openly against one another.

zh: 在左派阵营，执政的社会党在3月的市政选举中一败涂地，奥朗德的支持率下降之猛尽显无疑。
en: On the left, catastrophic results for the ruling Socialists in municipal elections in March revealed the depth to which Hollande’s popularity has sunk.

zh: 在即将到来的欧洲议会选举中，社会党面临着同样的重创，因此奥朗德别无选择，只能让他深受民众欢迎的内政部长瓦尔斯入主马提尼翁府（总理办公室 ） 。
en: With the Socialists facing a similar drubbing in the upcoming European Parliament election, Hollande had no choice but to install his highly popular interior minister, Manuel Valls in the Hôtel Matignon (the prime minister’s office).

zh: 在第五共和国历史上，权力第一次如此远离爱丽舍宫（总统官邸 ） 。
en: For the first time in the history of the Fifth Republic, power seems to be dramatically shifting away from the Elysée Palace (the seat of the presidency).

zh: 法国宪法的条文和精神规定总理乃是国家二号人物 — — 比如萨科齐把菲永称作“我的合作者 ” ， 他的关键作用是保护总统。
en: The letter and spirit of France’s constitution makes the prime minister the country’s second in command – “my collaborator,” as Sarkozy said of François Fillon – whose key role is to protect the president.

zh: 但如今，奥朗德完全要指望他的总理。
en: But now Hollande is completely dependent on his prime minister.

zh: 2012年问鼎权力的左派的不和谐从奥朗德执政伊始便已开始。
en: The dissonance on the left, in power since 2012, began as soon as Hollande assumed office.

zh: 极左翼谴责奥朗德政府是“社会自由主义 ” ， 在瓦尔斯领衔内阁后，这个声音甚至更大了。
en: The far-left denounces his administration’s “social-liberalism,” which is even more clearly pronounced with Valls leading the cabinet.

zh: 尽管瓦尔斯本人一再否认，但这位不时被称为“左派萨科齐 ” — —因为他精力充沛并且是十足的机会主义者 — — 的人物确实似乎占据了主导地位。
en: Despite his many declarations to the contrary, Valls – sometimes described as the “Sarkozy of the left” because of his restless dynamism and, yes, opportunism – really does seem to be in charge.

zh: 奥朗德让自己陷入了可怕的窘境。
en: Hollande has placed himself in a terrible predicament.

zh: 如果瓦尔斯获得成功，那么胜利将属于他而不是奥朗德，进一步强化他昭然若揭的寻求在2017年成为总统的野心。
en: If Valls succeeds, the triumph will be his, not Hollande’s, reinforcing his transparent ambition to become President himself in 2017.

zh: 如果瓦尔斯失败，就将进一步削弱奥朗德连任的机会。
en: If Valls fails, his defeat will further weaken Hollande’s chances of winning a second term.

zh: 无论如何，前景都不美妙，这让许多左派日益产生被背叛和沮丧的感觉。
en: Many on the left, facing only unattractive scenarios, feel increasingly betrayed and dispirited.

zh: 在右派，萨科齐尽管在两年前被奥朗德击败，但仍然自视为他唯一的替代者。
en: On the right, Sarkozy, despite his defeat two years ago, still views himself as the only alternative.

zh: 但他面临着艰苦的战斗。
en: But he faces an uphill battle.

zh: 尽管他是完美的政客，并且显然被其所在政党的许多活跃分子所挂念，但其他法国选民反对他的立场更加鲜明 — — 原因大多数出于个人问题，并且没有理由改变立场。
en: Though he is a consummate politician who is clearly missed by many of his party’s activists, the rest of France’s voters have even more clearly rejected him, mostly over issues of personality, and see no reason to modify their stance.

zh: 权力就像大自然，见不得存在真空。
en: Power, like nature, abhors a vacuum.

zh: 在以压倒性优势连任波尔多市长后，希拉克的前总理（亦是萨科齐的前外交部长）朱佩已经卷土重来，成为法国最受支持的政治人物，左派和中间派都有他的支持者。
en: Overwhelmingly reelected as Mayor of Bordeaux, Juppé, a former prime minister under Jacques Chirac (and once Sarkozy’s foreign minister), has reemerged as the most popular political figure in France, with sympathizers on the left and in the center.

zh: 近20年前，朱佩因为实施���需的改革而成为法国最不受欢迎的政客之一，如今，他或许因为幸灾乐祸而得到了原谅。
en: Juppé, whose efforts nearly 20 years ago to impose badly needed reforms made him one of the country’s most unpopular politicians, might be forgiven a bit of schadenfreude.

zh: 他的年龄（68岁）可能成为他在2017年大选中的一大障碍，但也有可能成为优势：他是四人中唯一一位让人放心的政治家式的人物。 其他三人中一个是令人失望的现任，另两人急不可耐并且眼里只有全力。
en: His age (he is 68) might prove to be a handicap in 2017, but it could also be an advantage: he is the only reassuring statesman-like figure in a quartet whose other members are an uninspiring incumbent and two power-obsessed men in a hurry.

zh: 但舞台上并不只有这四人。
en: But this quartet is not alone on the stage.

zh: 第五名选手、极右翼政党国民阵线（National Front）领袖勒庞（Marine Le Pen）给支持者带来焕然一新的内容。
en: A fifth player, Marine Le Pen, the leader of the far-right National Front, offers the audience a radically different score.

zh: 勒庞十分乐于见到一个接一个的琐碎丑闻困扰左派和右派（这部分要归因于近几年来左右两大阵营渐成水火之势 ） 。
en: Le Pen is only too happy to capitalize on the succession of petty scandals hitting both the left and the right (attributable partly to the climate of near-civil war prevailing in both camps in recent years).

zh: 比如，最近的丑闻让奥朗德失去了一位关键顾问，在左翼媒体曝光利益冲突后，他被迫辞职。
en: The latest scandal, for example, cost Hollande a key adviser, who was forced to resign after left-wing media exposed a conflict of interest.

zh: 法国主流政坛的这一不和谐的关键在于欧洲。
en: At the heart of this dissonance in mainstream French politics is Europe.

zh: 一些左翼团体 — — 他们在2005年对欧盟宪法条约说了“不 ” — —以社会和经济理由反对欧洲，经常把问题提到国家主权的高度。
en: Some segments of the left – who said “No” in 2005 to the proposed European Union Constitutional Treaty – oppose Europe for a combination of social and economic reasons, often resorting to appeals to national sovereignty.

zh: 右派也同样存在分歧，即使不把许多反资本主义者包括近来，和欧盟的左翼反对者一样，他们谴责布鲁塞尔欧盟委员会的“命令 ” （ diktat）以及法国政府的俯首帖耳。
en: The right is equally divided on the issue of Europe, even if it does not include many anti-capitalists in its ranks. Like the EU’s leftist opponents, they denounce “diktats” from the European Commission in Brussels and the French government’s acquiescence in them.

zh: 不幸的是，这些层层叠叠的不和谐的一个后果已经尽显无疑。
en: Unfortunately, one consequence of these multiple layers of dissonance is becoming all too clear.

zh: 许多民调显示，国民阵线作为唯一一个对欧洲持团结而统一的负面立场的政党，将赢得下个月的欧洲议会选举。
en: The National Front, the only party to present a coherent, united, and purely negative position on Europe, is predicted by many public opinion polls to win next month’s European Parliament election.

zh: 果真如此的话，法国政治不和将成为欧洲的问题。
en: If it does, France’s political cacophony will become a problem for Europe as well.

zh: 普京大帝
en: Putin the Great

zh: 巴黎—一天，俄罗斯城市中将竖起普京纪念碑，下面镌刻着铭文 ： “ 让克里米亚回归俄罗斯母亲的人 ” 。
en: PARIS – One day, monuments to Vladimir Putin may stand in Russian cities, bearing the inscription: “The man who returned Crimea to Mother Russia.”

zh: 也许纪念碑还将在许多欧洲广场上竖立起来，歌颂这位俄罗斯总统是“欧洲统一之父 ” 。
en: But perhaps monuments will be erected on many European squares as well, acclaiming Russia’s president as “The Father of United Europe.”

zh: 事实上，普京快刀斩乱麻地吞并克里米亚让欧洲各国政府对俄罗斯的态度迅速统一起来，其效果远好于数十次双边和多边会议。
en: Indeed, Putin’s swift move to annex Crimea has done more to harmonize European governments’ views on Russia than dozens of bilateral or multilateral meetings.

zh: 上周，在柏林，我发现法国和德国精英们在讨论如何应对俄罗斯对乌克兰的侵略时意见相当统一。
en: In Berlin last week, I heard French and German elites speak with one voice in discussing how to respond to Russia’s aggression in Ukraine.

zh: 当然，说和做是完全不同的。
en: Of course, words are not deeds.

zh: 但是，由于普京，欧盟或许已经找到了自柏林墙倒塌以来一直寻觅不得的新故事和动力。
en: Yet, thanks to Putin, the European Union may have found the new narrative and momentum that it has sought since the fall of the Berlin Wall.

zh: 欧洲急需动力。
en: Europe badly needs that momentum.

zh: 面对俄罗斯改变欧洲后冷战时代秩序的新帝国渴望，欧盟如想表现出强大和可信，就必须以一个声音发声。
en: Confronted with a neo-imperial Russia’s desire to revise the post-Cold War order in Europe, the EU must speak with a single voice if it wants to appear strong and credible.

zh: 并且它必须和美国一起发声，正如在冷战期间（大部分时候）那样。
en: And it must speak as one with the United States, just as it (mostly) did during the Cold War.

zh: 至于美国，它也似乎因为乌克兰危机而受到了新的刺激。
en: The US, for its part, also seems newly galvanized by the crisis in Ukraine.

zh: 似乎美国对其新/老敌人的理解 — — 这个它无法像理解阿富汗、阿拉伯和伊朗一样理解的对手 — — 产生了新的目标感。
en: It is as if the Americans’ familiarity with their new/old enemy – an adversary whom they understand in a way that they do not understand Afghans, Arabs, or Persians – has provided a renewed sense of purpose.

zh: 民主国家联盟卷土重来 ， “ 美国来自火星，欧洲来自金星”的幽默比喻已不再适用。
en: The alliance of democracies is back, and the facile quip that America comes from Mars and Europe from Venus no longer makes sense.

zh: 面对真正来自火星、似乎只理解和尊重武力的俄罗斯，世界民主国家的稳固性必须保持下去，而其基础便是在伊拉克和阿富汗所看不见的目的统一性。
en: Confronted with a Russia that really does come from Mars and seems to understand and respect only force, the firmness of the world’s democracies must prevail, underpinned by a unity of purpose that was lost in Iraq and Afghanistan.

zh: 随着乌克兰局势的发展，历史相似性尽显无疑。
en: As events have taken their course in Ukraine, historical analogies have multiplied.

zh: 对一些人来说，我们正身处1914年，一场没人愿意看到但没人能够阻挡的世界大战迫在眉睫。
en: According to some, we are in 1914, on the eve of a world war that few want but that no one can prevent.

zh: 我们也可能正身处1938年，纳粹德国吞并了苏台德，已演变成不可遏止的侵略者。
en: Or we are in 1938, in the aftermath of Nazi Germany’s annexation of the Sudetenland, confronted with an aggressor who will not be appeased.

zh: 我们也可能正身处1945年，几十年的冷战即将揭开帷幕。
en: Or we are in 1945, on the eve of a decades-long cold war.

zh: 我们也可能正身处1991年，南斯拉夫内战频仍，多民族社会分解为几个战斗阵营。
en: We could also be in 1991, in the midst of Yugoslavia’s implosion, watching a multi-ethnic society divide into warring camps.

zh: 我们也可能正身处2008年8月的格鲁吉亚，普京的俄罗斯正在第一次用武力扩充版图。
en: Or we could be in August 2008, in Georgia, when Putin’s Russia redrew a map by force for the first time.

zh: 所有这些类比都有现实因素，虽然没有一个完美地相似。
en: All of these analogies contain an element of truth, even if none applies perfectly.

zh: 但要理解普��最近的态度和行为，另一个类比可能更加重要：1835—1836年的克里米亚战争。 这场战争造成800,000多人死亡，其中包括250,000俄罗斯人。
en: But to understand Putin’s current attitude and behavior, another analogy is probably more important: the 1853-56 Crimean War, in which more than 800,000 people died, including 250,000 Russians.

zh: 这场给沙皇尼古拉斯一世统治时期的俄罗斯人带来无尽灾难的对英国、法国和奥斯曼帝国战争的借口是俄罗斯单方面宣布的保护耶路撒冷圣域的责任。
en: The pretext for the war, which pitted the Russians, under Czar Nicholas I, against the British, French, and Ottomans, was Russia’s self-declared responsibility to protect Jerusalem’s holy places.

zh: 尼古拉斯一世的统治结合了帝国雄心和宗教狂热（即针对奥斯曼帝国，也针对天主教 ） ， 而俄罗斯的战败也是伟大的。
en: Nicholas’s reign combined imperial ambition and religious fervor (directed against both the Ottoman Empire and the Catholic Church), and Russia’s defeat was glorious.

zh: 在旷日持久的塞瓦斯托波尔围城战中，120,000俄罗斯士兵为国捐躯。
en: During the long siege of Sevastopol, more than 120,000 Russian soldiers lost their lives.

zh: 列夫·托尔斯泰取材这场战争写出了名著《战争与和平 》 。
en: Leo Tolstoy, who took part in the war, found in it a source of inspiration for his novel War and Peace.

zh: 普京过去便以彼得大帝的政治继承人的面目示人。
en: Putin used to present himself as the political heir of Peter the Great.

zh: 但他可能最终被铭记为新尼古拉斯一世（他的肖像悬挂在普京办公室中 ） ： 一位极端保守的沙皇，掌权时间太长，与现实脱节。
en: He may instead be remembered as a new Nicholas I (whose portrait hangs in his office): an ultra-conservative czar who was in power too long and lost touch with reality.

zh: 普京结合了民族主义、正教和克格勃生涯所塑造的心理习惯，他是一颗定时炸弹，必须小心应对，但首先必须巩固根基。
en: Combining nationalism, orthodoxy, and the mental habits of his KGB years, Putin constitutes an explosive mixture that must be handled with care, but above all with firmness.

zh: 这意味着需要在政治和经济上支持乌克兰。
en: This implies the need to stand behind Ukraine both politically and economically.

zh: 5月25日的大选不但必须按计划进行，还必须尽可能创造最佳条件，即使普京将竭尽全力破坏它。
en: The general election on May 25 must not only take place as planned, but must do so under the best possible conditions, even as Putin does his utmost to derail them.

zh: 防止这一结果需要遏制乌克兰规模虽小但声势浩大的极右翼政党，他们的反俄沙文主义极有利于普京升级冲突。
en: Preventing that outcome requires containing Ukraine’s small but loud far-right parties, whose anti-Russian chauvinism makes them Putin’s closest ally in escalating the conflict.

zh: 剥夺八国集团资格等对俄罗斯或普京亲密盟友的制裁是不够的。
en: Sanctions against Russia, such as its ejection from the G-8, or against Putin’s closest allies will not suffice.

zh: 目标应该是让普京相信欧洲（包括意大利和德国）可以从别处获得天然气和石油：如尼日利亚和巴西，更不用说来自美国的页岩能源了。
en: The goal should be to convince Putin that Europe (including Italy and Germany) has alternatives to its gas and oil: Nigeria and Brazil, for example, not to mention the possibility of US shale energy.

zh: 事实上，普京或许为欧洲提供了意料之外的机会完成其共同能源政策 — — 从长期看，共同能源政策更加理性，成本也更低。
en: Indeed, Putin may have given Europe an unexpected opportunity to create, at long last, a common energy policy, one that would be more rational and much less costly in the long run.

zh: 当然，欧洲（以及其他世界民主国家）现在所面临的意义深远的国际关系重构是有代价的。
en: Of course, the far-reaching reappraisal of international relations that now confronts Europe (the rest of the world’s democracies) will have a cost.

zh: 必须做出牺牲。
en: Sacrifices will have to be made.

zh: 但在这场消耗战中，专制的俄罗斯落败的可能性高于民主的欧洲。
en: But in this game of attrition, despotic Russia has more to lose than democratic Europe.

zh: 有一点是肯定的：普京没有止于格鲁吉亚，也不会止于克里米亚。
en: One thing is certain: Putin did not stop with Georgia, and he will not stop with Crimea.

zh: 除非现在就为他的野心划定界限，否则最可怕的历史类比将最接近现实。
en: Unless the limits to his ambitions are set now, the scariest historical analogies will become the most accurate.

zh: 第二轮遏制辩论
en: The Containment Debate, Round Two

zh: 巴黎 — — 冷战开始时，想要遏制和击退共产主义的美国人曾经展开过激烈的辩论。
en: PARIS – At the Cold War’s outset, there was an intense debate in the United States between those who wanted to contain communism and those who wanted to roll it back.

zh: 有时这场辩论也被称之为“遏制升级版 ” ， 即应该满足于限制苏联的野心，还是有必要采取更为激进的立场？
en: Was it sufficient to fix limits on the Soviet Union’s ambitions, or was a more aggressive stance, sometimes described as “containment plus,” necessary?

zh: 美国总统奥巴马及其前国务卿（和可能的继任者）希拉里·克林顿近来的口水战让这个问题的辩论再度变得火爆。
en: The recent spat between US President Barack Obama and his former secretary of state (and possible successor), Hillary Clinton, seems to have revived that debate.

zh: 但今天当西方面临中东“伊斯兰国”和俄罗斯修正主义的双重挑战时，这样的辩论是否还有意义？
en: But are its terms of reference useful today, as the West faces the simultaneous challenges of the Islamic State in the Middle East and a revisionist Russia?

zh: 西方领导人认为这两项挑战可以区别对待，即可以对俄罗斯进行遏制，但必须对“伊斯兰国”实施打击的理念是否正确呢？
en: Are Western leaders right to assume that the two challenges are distinct, and that containment will suffice in the case of Russia, while rollback is absolutely necessary in the case of the Islamic State?

zh: 基本的理念是西方需要俄罗斯不亚于俄罗斯需要西方，但谁也不希望中东腹地成为伊斯兰狂热份子的庇护所。
en: The West needs Russia as much as Russia needs the West, the thinking goes, whereas no one (to say the least) needs a sanctuary for Islamist fanatics in the heart of the Middle East.

zh: 因此必须通过经济制裁、战略团结和外交接触说服俄罗斯改弦易辙；相反 ， “ 伊斯兰国”的野心不可遏制，因此只剩下镇压这一项选择。
en: That is why Russia must be persuaded to change course through a combination of economic sanctions, strategic unity, and diplomatic engagement; by contrast, the Islamic State’s ambitions cannot be contained, so they must be suppressed.

zh: 但西方需要重新审视自己的策略，因为这两项挑战具有相同点。
en: But the West needs to rethink its strategy, because the two challenges are not entirely distinct.

zh: 假如奥巴马在一年前大马士革郊区袭击发生后坚持其化武“红线 ” ， 那么俄罗斯总统普京可能不会在乌克兰如此有恃无恐。
en: Had Obama not failed to enforce his chemical-weapons “red line” in Syria a year ago, following an attack on a suburb of Damascus, Russian President Vladimir Putin probably would not have been as daring as he was in Ukraine.

zh: 同样，协助库尔德人抵抗“伊斯兰国”能对克里姆林起到警示作用。
en: Likewise, helping the Kurds to confront the Islamic State could send the right message to the Kremlin.

zh: 面对这样的双重挑战必须具备长期统一的战略思想和教学技能。
en: Confronting this dual challenge presupposes a combination of long-term, coordinated strategic thinking and pedagogical skill.

zh: 领导人必须善于解释和说明。
en: Leaders must explain and clarify.

zh: 鉴于针对美国和西方大范围挑战的复杂性和紧迫性，像奥巴马最近接受《纽约时报》采访时那样仅仅表示“我不做蠢事”并不足以服众。
en: To say, “I don’t do stupid things,” as Obama did recently in an interview with the New York Times, is not enough, given the complexity, urgency, and scale of the threats America and the West are facing.

zh: 冷战的单一性几乎不需要任何解释工作。
en: The simplicity of the Cold War left little need for explanation.

zh: 西方只有一个对手，而双方都清楚恐怖平衡逻辑的游戏规则。
en: The West had only one opponent, and both sides understood the rules of the game (that is, the logic of the balance of terror).

zh: 总之 ， “ 苏联人的心理”相对容易解读。
en: Above all, the “Soviet mind” was relatively easy to decipher.

zh: 当今挑战之所���复杂不仅仅因为问题多元，还因为“圣战心理”很难把握。
en: The complexity of today’s challenges consists not only in there being more than one, but also in the difficulty of understanding the “jihadi mind.”

zh: 当然，我们可以说“伊斯兰国”恢复逊尼哈里发王国的梦想和普京的新帝国主义野心一样不合时宜。
en: Of course, one can say that the Islamic State’s dream of restoring a Sunni caliphate is as anachronistic as Putin’s neo-imperial ambition.

zh: 我们也可以说普京和“伊斯兰国”都从西方的软弱中吸取力量，特别是西方无法明确可靠地限制他们的行动。
en: One can also say that both Putin and the Islamic State have drawn much of their strength from the West’s weakness, particularly its failure to have enforced clear and credible limits to their actions.

zh: 但即便普京和“伊斯兰国”曾经从西方的困惑、犹豫和分裂中受益，他们也绝不是纸老虎。
en: But, if Putin and the Islamic State have benefited from the West’s confusion, hesitation, and division in dealing with them, they are not paper tigers.

zh: 如果他们是纸老虎，西方只需等待对手在矛盾的重压下自行崩溃：于俄罗斯而言或许是高估自己的手段，而于“伊斯兰国”而言则是其残暴行为的可怕后果。
en: If they were, the West would need only to wait for its adversaries to collapse under the weight of their own contradictions: Russia’s overestimation of its means, and, in the case of the Islamic State, the consequences of its appallingly cruel behavior.

zh: 这种情况似乎有些过于乐观。
en: That scenario seems optimistic at best.

zh: 尽管“伊斯兰国”并非不可抵御，但它带来的挑战比基地组织严重得多。
en: Though the Islamic State is resistible, it represents a much bigger challenge than Al Qaeda ever did.

zh: 它为自己制定了具体的地区目标，并且拥有充足的资金、先进武器和高素质的军事指挥官。
en: It has set for itself a concrete territorial goal, and has ample financing, sophisticated weapons, and a highly competent military command.

zh: 与此同时，今天高估“伊斯兰国”的实力和昨天低估他们一样具有危险性。
en: At the same time, it would be as dangerous to overestimate the Islamic State’s capabilities today as it was to underestimate them yesterday.

zh: 同样的逻辑也适用于俄罗斯的普京。
en: The same logic applies to Putin’s Russia.

zh: 占领克里米亚的闪电行动执行得非常到位，但同样的策略却没有在更复杂分裂的乌克兰东部地区发挥作用。
en: The seizure of Crimea was a swift, well-executed move, but the same tactics have not worked in the more complex and divided context of eastern Ukraine.

zh: 虽然俄罗斯赢得了克里米亚，但却很可能失去了乌克兰。
en: By winning Crimea the way that it did, Russia may well have lost Ukraine.

zh: 在B·H·里德尔·哈特反思一战经验的经典论述战略：间接方法中，哈特坚持认为直接进攻在防御工事中的敌人是匹夫之勇。
en: In his classic treatise Strategy: The Indirect Approach, B.H. Liddell Hart, reflecting on his World War I experiences, insisted on the foolhardiness of direct attacks on an entrenched enemy.

zh: 他认为 ， “ 战略上最直截了当的方式往往欲速而不达。 ”
en: “In strategy,” he argued, “the longest way round is often the shortest way there.”

zh: 今天，里德尔·哈特也许会鼓励西方集中力量协助中东的库尔德战士和东欧的乌克兰政府。
en: Today, Liddell Hart would probably encourage the West to concentrate its efforts on helping the Kurdish fighters in the Middle East and aiding Ukraine’s government in Eastern Europe.

zh: 在进行上述努力的同时我们不应将合作方过于理想化。
en: That dual effort should be pursued without idealizing these partners.

zh: 并不是西方支持他们他们就“好 ” ； 但无论如何他们比各自的竞争对手好得多。
en: They are not “good” simply because the West is backing them; but they are, in any case, infinitely better than the forces they are resisting.

zh: 无论是遏制还是打击，游戏规则都应该十分清楚。
en: Be it containment or rollback, the rules of the game should be clear.

zh: 通过对其进行限制，西方将更清晰地界定对象和规则。
en: By setting limits to “them,” the West will define – with newfound clarity – who and what it is.

zh: 法国的小巨人
en: France’s Little Big Man

zh: 巴黎—国民刻板影响不易消除，特别是在最有影响力的国民在竭尽所能证明这一印象的情况下。
en: PARIS – National stereotypes do not fade easily, especially if those with the greatest influence seem to be doing their best to justify them.

zh: 以法国为例。
en: Consider the case of France.

zh: 在外国人看来，莫里哀的故乡对政治领袖的偷情容忍度颇高，而对急需的经济改革却正好相反。
en: To outsiders, the land of Molière is a country where political leaders’ extramarital relationships are tolerated, while badly needed economic reforms are not.

zh: 但世界可能要感到惊奇了 — — 或者说至少半惊半奇。
en: But the world could be in for a surprise – or at least half a surprise.

zh: 对政客的暧昧关系来说，典型的法国作风是保持；而对于改革问题，改变或许即将到来了。
en: When it comes to politicians’ liaisons, continuity may prevail in France; but on the issue of reform, change may be around the corner.

zh: 奥朗德总统宣布了一系列措施，如果得到实施，将迎来一场和平的革命：一场连他更有魄力的前任萨科齐都不敢尝试的和产业界和商业界的大妥协，尽管他的立场更为保守（或者说这正是他敢于尝试的原因 ） 。
en: President François Hollande has announced measures that, if implemented, would amount to a peaceful revolution: a major reconciliation with the industrial and business world that even his more energetic predecessor, Nicolas Sarkozy, dared not attempt, despite – or precisely because of – his more conservative inclinations.

zh: 但是，变革的现实因为“保持”的刻板印象而受阻。
en: The reality of change, however, has been hampered by the stereotype of continuity.

zh: 奥朗德大胆的300亿欧元减税以提振经济的计划至少部分地因为他的私生活遭到曝光而受到了阻挠。
en: Hollande’s daring pledge of €30 billion ($40.6 billion) in tax cuts to boost the economy has been hijacked, at least in part, by revelations about his private life.

zh: 在一张被曝光的照片上，奥朗德头戴头盔，坐在一辆小轮摩托的后座，由警卫带着去和一位电影女星约会。 曝光后的民意调查现实，法国人对此兴致阑珊。
en: Public-opinion polls following the publication of photographs of a helmeted Hollande riding on a scooter behind one of his bodyguards to an assignation with a movie actress suggest that the French are mildly interested.

zh: 但现实比这更加微妙。
en: But the reality is more nuanced.

zh: 对于这种事情的曝光，法国人在道德上并不会受到太大冲击。
en: The French are not morally shocked by such revelations.

zh: 尽管前总统密特朗的第二家庭几乎完全是国家机密，只有一小撮精英知道，媒体也配合地帮忙隐瞒，但他的情人和他们的女儿仍参加了他的葬礼。
en: Though former President François Mitterrand’s second family was virtually a state secret, known only to a select elite and hidden from the public by a reverential press, his mistress and their daughter attended his funeral.

zh: 而萨科齐在担任总统之初以私生活混乱而著称，全法国都知道。
en: And Sarkozy’s tumultuous private life at the beginning of his presidency was on open display.

zh: 与英国人和美国人不同，法国人对性的沉迷远不及对丑闻的热衷。
en: Unlike the British and the Americans, the French are much less obsessed with sex than they are with financial scandal.

zh: 民调显示了一个有趣的二元性：法国人希望私人空间自由的最大化和公共空间保护的最大化。
en: Public-opinion surveys reveal an interesting dualism: the French want maximum freedom in the private sphere and maximum protection in the public sphere.

zh: 因此，法国人不会从道德角度批判奥朗德，但会从政治角度这样做。
en: Thus, the French do not criticize Hollande on the ground of ethics, but on the ground of politics.

zh: 这个“伟大国家”的总统、太阳王和戴高乐的政治继承者给自己下了个套：他坐在小轮摩托上的形象太滑稽了。
en: The president of “la Grande Nation,” political heir of the Sun King and General de Gaulle, has made a fool of himself: he looked simply ridiculous on his scooter.

zh: 维克多·雨果创造了“小拿破仑”来形容拿破仑三世。
en: Victor Hugo coined the formula “Napoleon le petit” to describe Napoleon III.

zh: 从他的导师和榜样身上汲取了如此之多公共和私生活灵感的首位法国社会党总统奥朗德会有一天被称为“小密特朗”吗？
en: Will Hollande, who seems to take so much inspiration for both his public and private life from his mentor and model, France’s first-ever Socialist president, one day be described as “Mitterrand le petit”?

zh: 综艺节目是法国特色，堪与面包、奶酪和葡萄酒相提并论，但这并没有加强这位支持率已然低得离谱的总统的尊严和信誉。
en: Vaudeville may be a French specialty, like bread, cheese, and wine, but it does not strengthen the dignity and credibility of an already spectacularly unpopular presidency.

zh: 奥朗德希望称为一位“寻常总统 ” 。
en: Hollande wanted to be a “normal president.”

zh: 在这张拍摄于他幽会途中的照片中，他似乎超越了自我。
en: In the stolen images of him en route to a tryst, he seems to be outdoing himself.

zh: 而法国人的幽默感 — — 哪怕他是政客 — — 马上在他的弱点上体现出来。
en: And French humorists – and even politicians – have been quick to play on his vulnerability.

zh: 奥朗德也许与另一位女性坠入了爱河；确实如此。
en: Hollande may be in love with another woman; it does happen.

zh: 但是，即使确实如此，也不能在最糟糕的时刻被曝光 — — 恰好赶上他试图把法国引向急需的勇敢新旅程的当口。
en: But, if he is, it could not have been revealed at a worse moment, precisely when he was intent on steering the country onto a new, courageous, and badly needed course.

zh: 你可能会感叹在全球互联网时代再无私人和公共生活的界限，但你必须适应它，而奥朗德显然没有适应。
en: One may regret the disappearance of boundaries between private and public life in our global Internet age, but one must adjust to it – and Hollande clearly has not.

zh: 当然，关键问题是奥朗德为何等了18个月才开始做正确的事情、通过减轻导致法国企业竞争力低下的税务负担提振法国经济。
en: Of course, the key question is why Hollande waited 18 months before doing the right thing and helping the French economy by alleviating the tax burden that had been reducing French enterprises’ competitiveness.

zh: 官方回答是不利的全球经济条件让他别无选择。
en: The official answer is that deteriorating global economic conditions left no other choice.

zh: 对包括我在内的一些人来说，奥朗德从一开始就是真正的社会民主党。
en: For some, including me, Hollande was from the start a true social democrat.

zh: 但是，由于以社会主义者的形象参与了选战，并且他自己的阵营分歧很深、导致他在议会无法获得真正多数，因此他不得不拖延很久才让其亲产业的立场表露无遗（对金融业，他仍然十分痛恶 ） 。
en: But, having campaigned as a socialist, and with his own camp’s deep divisions leaving him no real majority in parliament, he could not afford to reveal his pro-industry orientation (he continues to denounce the financial sector) without a significant delay.

zh: 你称这是现实主义也好，是政治勇气也罢，一年半的时间已经浪费掉了，法国及其经济遭到了严重拖累。
en: Whether one calls that realism or lack of political courage, a year and a half has been lost, seriously hampering France and its economy.

zh: 但是，如今，法国可能终于要进入正确方向了。
en: Now, however, the country may at long last be headed in the right direction.

zh: 但当头的总统却可能变得更加孱弱了。
en: But it is likely to have a weaker president at the helm.

zh: 现在奥朗德还有三年时间证明，在正确思想的刺激下，他可以用经济成果，而不是个人行为改变他 — — 以及法国 — — 的形象。
en: Hollande now has three years to prove that, animated by the right ideas, he can transform his image – and that of France – with economic results, if not by his personal behavior.

zh: 回顾维也纳会议
en: The Congress of Vienna Revisited

zh: 巴黎—两百年前，1814年9月25日，俄国沙皇亚历山大一世和普鲁士国王威廉三世来到维也纳，受到奥地利皇帝弗朗茨一世的欢迎。 维也纳会议的召开带来了数百年以来欧洲最长的和平时期。
en: PARIS – Two hundred years ago, on September 25, 1814, Russia’s Czar Alexander I and Friedrich Wilhelm III, the King of Prussia, were greeted at the gates of Vienna by Austria’s Emperor Franz I. The start of the Congress of Vienna ushered in the longest period of peace Europe had known for centuries.

zh: 那么，为何此事的纪念日完全被忽视了呢？
en: So why has its anniversary all but been ignored?

zh: 诚然，维也纳会议常常被视为标志着拿破仑倒台后反动势力的胜利。
en: True, the Congress of Vienna is mostly viewed as marking the victory of Europe’s reactionary forces after the defeat of Napoleon.

zh: 但是，考虑到如今全球一篇混乱甚至动荡的局面，类似于维也纳会议的“普鲁士式”乡愁也许并不算差。
en: Yet, given today’s growing global confusion, if not chaos, something like “Proustian” nostalgia for the Congress may not be out of order.

zh: 毕竟，这次会议通过艰难但成功的谈判重建了法国大革命和拿破仑战争所造成动剧变的国际秩序。
en: Here, after all, was a meeting that, through tough but successful negotiations, reestablished international order after the upheavals caused by the French Revolution and the Napoleonic Wars.

zh: 这给今天带来了什么教训？
en: Can we apply any of its lessons today?

zh: 为了回答这个问题，我们不仅应该考虑1815年的《维也纳条约 》 （ Treaty of Vienna ） ， 还应该考虑1648年的《威斯特伐利亚和约 》 （ Peace of Westphalia）和1919年的《凡尔赛和约 》 （ Treaty of Versailles）这三次和约以各自的方式结束了欧洲历史上的血腥篇章。
en: To answer that question, we should consider not just the 1815 Treaty of Vienna, but also the 1648 Peace of Westphalia and the 1919 Treaty of Versailles, each of which in its own way brought to an end a bloody chapter in European history.

zh: 1648年签订的条约通过信奉“谁的王国，他的宗教 ” （ cuius regio,eius religio）原则结束了近一百年的宗教战争。
en: The treaties signed in 1648 concluded nearly a century of religious warfare by enshrining the principle of cuius regio, eius religio (“whose realm, his religion”).

zh: 维也纳会议恢复了实力平衡原则，其观念基础是所有各方拥有超越各自野心的共同利益，并重新建立了国联（Concert of Nations ） 。 国联在两代人的时间里阻止了1789—1815年间领土和思想修正主义。
en: The Congress of Vienna reinstated the principle of the balance of power, based on the belief that all parties shared a common interest transcending their respective ambitions, and re-established the Concert of Nations, which for two generations stopped territorial and ideological revisionism of the type seen from 1789 to 1815.

zh: 相反 ， 《 凡尔赛和约》显得太严厉而无法遵循，同时又太软弱而无法强制执行，反而为二战铺平了道路。
en: By contrast, the Treaty of Versailles, too harsh to be honored and too weak to be enforced, paved the way for World War II.

zh: 在这三个条约中，维也纳会议所达成的条约为我们提供了一个镜像，可帮助我们理解当前环境的特征。
en: Of the three treaties, the one produced by the Congress of Vienna offers a sort of mirror image to help us understand the specificity of our current conditions.

zh: 在维也纳，欧洲列强无不与会。
en: In Vienna, the European powers were among themselves.

zh: 它们感觉属于一个伟大、团结的家庭，这种感觉因为外交官员的共同贵族血统而得到了加强。
en: Their feeling of belonging to a great and unified family was reinforced by the common aristocratic origins of their diplomats.

zh: 没有文化上的“他者”的问题。
en: The cultural “other” was not an issue.

zh: 当然，今天我们不可能拥有重建彼时世界（或重建成为时代错误的宗教分裂威斯特伐利亚秩序）的雄心，而拥有建立脱胎于不同假设的新秩序的雄心。
en: Of course, the ambition today cannot be to recreate that world (or to reestablish an anachronistic Westphalian order of religious separation), but rather to devise a new order predicated on different assumptions.

zh: 事实上，眼下全球失序的一个关键因素是，与维也纳会议 — — 或者说1648年的各方 — — 相反，国际体系的主要行动方没有因为捍卫现状的共同意愿联合起来。
en: Indeed, one of the keys to our current global disorder is that, in contrast to the Congress of Vienna – or, for that matter, the parties of 1648 – the international system’s main actors are not united by a common will to defend the status quo.

zh: 主要行动方可归为三类：公开的修正主义者（如俄罗斯和伊斯兰国 ） ； 准备着为保护最低限度秩序斗争者（如美国、法国和英国 ） ， 以及言行不一的矛盾国家，包括中东的关键行动方（如土耳��和伊朗 ） 。
en: The main actors fall into three categories: open revisionists, like Russia and the Islamic State; those ready to fight to protect a minimum of order, such as the United States, France, and Great Britain; and ambivalent states – including key regional players in the Middle East, such as Turkey and Iran – whose actions fail to match their rhetoric.

zh: 在如此分裂的环境中，美国总统奥巴马为击败伊斯兰国而建立的“温和派”联盟 — — 一个包括沙特阿拉伯、卡塔尔和阿联酋在内的集团 — — 是相当脆弱的。
en: In such a divided context, the alliance of “moderates” created by US President Barack Obama to defeat the Islamic State – a group that includes Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates – is weak at best.

zh: 跨文化联盟也许是中东合法军事行动的先决条件；困难在于，除非奥巴马的地区联盟得到显著扩大，否则当前盟友对美国军事干预的热情也许很快就会消退。
en: A multicultural coalition is probably a requirement of legitimate military action in the Middle East; the dilemma is that unless Obama’s regional coalition broadens considerably, his current allies’ enthusiasm for US military intervention is likely to diminish quickly.

zh: 也许可以重新建立“两极争霸”格局，就像1815年后的英国和俄国（尽管奥地利、普鲁士和法国等其他行动方也不容小觑 ） ， 美国和中国分别代替英国和俄国的地位。
en: Or perhaps something like the “bipolar hegemony” of Great Britain and Russia after 1815 (though other players like Austria, Prussia, and France mattered) could be reconstituted, with the US and China substituting for Great Britain and Russia.

zh: 这似乎也是亨利·基辛格的终极梦想 — — 他用德语做标题的著作《世界秩序：关于国家和历史进程的思考 》 （ World Order: Reflections on the Character of Nations and the Course of History）可一窥端倪。
en: This seems to be Henry Kissinger’s ultimate dream – a dream that one can glimpse in his latest book, Germanically entitled World Order: Reflections on the Character of Nations and the Course of History.

zh: 但我们可以依赖这个梦的实现吗？
en: But can we depend on that dream’s realization?

zh: 在这个面临着俄罗斯扩张主义和救世派暴徒的恐怖主义的今天，维也纳会议的教训似乎遥远又不相干。
en: At a time when we are confronted by Russian expansionism and the extremism of messianic thugs, the lessons from the Congress of Vienna may seem distant and irrelevant.

zh: 但有一点是显而易见的，国家（state）具有超越民族重点问题（national priority）的共同利益。
en: Yet one is obvious: States possess common interests that should trump national priorities.

zh: 中国、印度和巴西是世界体系的相关利益方，这意味着他们也需要最低限度的秩序。
en: China, India, and Brazil are stakeholders in the world system, which means that they, too, need a minimum of order.

zh: 但这也意味着它们要为维持这一秩序做出贡献。
en: But that implies that they also contribute to maintaining it.

zh: 比如，追随俄罗斯与美国对立并不能最好地符合中国的利益，中国应该选择秩序的一方，而不应该选择破坏秩序的一方。
en: China’s interests, for example, would be best served not by playing Russia against the US, but by choosing the party of order over the party of disorder.

zh: 当代梅特涅、卡斯尔雷、亚历山大一世和塔列朗的聚会也是一个梦：根本没有这样的聚会。
en: A gathering of the modern equivalents of Metternich, Castlereagh, Alexander I, and Talleyrand is also a dream: there are none.

zh: 但是，在面临当今日益失序、暴力日益升级的局面时，我们所有的领导人如能从他们的先辈中汲取一些灵感，将善莫大焉。 200年前的这个星期为近一百年的和平打开了大门。
en: But, in confronting today’s growing disorder and escalating violence, the leaders we have would do well to draw some inspiration from their forebears, who 200 years ago this week opened the way to nearly a century of peace.

zh: 不平等的噩梦
en: The Inequality Nightmare

zh: 阿布扎比 — — 1999年，尼日利亚经济学家萨姆·阿鲁科曾说过这样的名言 ， “ 穷人因为饥饿而无法入睡，而富人则因为穷人饿着肚子无法入睡而睡不着。
en: ABU DHABI – “The poor cannot sleep, because they are hungry,” the Nigerian economist Sam Aluko famously said in 1999, “and the rich cannot sleep, because the poor are awake and hungry.”

zh: ”没有人能够逃脱收入和深层次财富不平等的影响，因为人类繁荣所依赖的政治经济制度不可能无休止地让某些人越来越富，而让其他人越来越穷。
en: We are all affected by deep disparities of income and wealth, because the political and economic system on which our prosperity depends cannot continue enriching some while it impoverishes others.

zh: 困难时期穷人对本国领袖和经济制度失去信心；而经济向好时，也没有多少人能分得一杯羹。
en: During hard times, the poor lose faith in their leaders and the economic system; and when times are good, too few enjoy the benefits.

zh: 多年来，衡量经济不平等的基尼系数在发展中国家和发达国家（包括美国在内）都一路上升。
en: The GINI coefficient, a measure of economic inequality, has been rising for many years in developing as well as developed countries, including the United States.

zh: 欧洲失业率（特别是年轻人的失业率）急剧上升导致不平等现象加剧。
en: In Europe, inequalities have intensified as a result of rapidly rising unemployment, especially among young people.

zh: 有人的反应是参与骚乱；有人支持极右翼的排外政党；而更多人则默默压抑着怒火，对政治家及其所代表制度不满的情绪越来越强。
en: Some have reacted by rioting; others have backed far-right xenophobic political parties; many more seethe quietly, growing ever more resentful of politicians and the system they represent.

zh: 问题最为鲜明是占全球GDP 80%的世界特大城市。
en: The problem is starkest in the world’s megacities, which account for around 80% of global GDP.

zh: 但即使最发达城市贫富差距也非常显著。
en: But even in the most developed cities, disparities can be marked.

zh: 比方说，当你搭乘伦敦地铁从政府中心区威斯敏斯特向东前往仅仅6英里（约为14站）开外的坎宁镇，地面居民的平均寿命每站都会缩短6个月。
en: For example, as you travel on the London Underground just six miles (or 14 stops) east from the heart of government at Westminster to Canning Town, the life expectancy of the inhabitants at each successive stop falls by six months.

zh: 但不平等现象在城市化速度最快的新兴经济体才最为严重。
en: But inequality is most acute in emerging economies where urbanization has been fastest.

zh: 到2030年，预计将有超过27亿人迁移到城市，这种情况几乎将是发展中国家的专利。
en: By 2030, an estimated 2.7 billion more people will have migrated to cities, almost entirely in developing countries.

zh: 但等待很多人的恐怕不是他们想象中的好生活和好工作，而是绝望和排斥。
en: Many will encounter hopelessness and exclusion there, rather than the good jobs and better life for which they came.

zh: 孟买、内罗毕和金沙萨等特大城市其实是处在巨型贫民窟包围中的小城镇 — — 就像一片绝望海洋中的财富绿洲。
en: Megacities like Mumbai, Nairobi, and Kinshasa are essentially small cities surrounded by huge slums – pockets of wealth in a sea of despair.

zh: 它们与东京、纽约或伦敦等根本没有可比性，发达城市虽然也有贫民区，但财富的分配显然更加合理。
en: None resembles the likes of Tokyo, New York, or London, which, despite areas of deprivation, are notable for a more equitable distribution of wealth.

zh: 国家层面上不平等现象也同样显著，尤其是非洲某些资源丰富的国家。
en: Such disparities are equally apparent at the national level, especially in some of Africa’s resource-rich countries.

zh: 在私人飞机需求蓬勃发展的同时，60%的民众每天依靠不到1.25美元生活。
en: While demand for private jets is booming, 60% of the population lives on less than $1.25 a day.

zh: 随着世界总的来讲变得更加富裕，绝大多数的利益都持续流向一小撮精英人物。
en: As the world overall grows richer, the benefits continue to flow overwhelmingly to a tiny elite.

zh: 推动包容性增长的努力因此变得至关重要，这不仅出于道德方面的原因，同时也是为满足全球经济体制生存的需要。
en: As a result, efforts to promote more inclusive growth have become crucial, not only for moral reasons, but also to ensure the survival of the global economic system.

zh: 这里涉及的不仅仅是财富分配。
en: This involves more than wealth distribution.

zh: 它意味着促使民众 — — 或特定民族、宗教或区域团体代表参与公共政策决策，以消除他们被边缘化或永久失败的感受。
en: It means bringing people – or representatives of specific ethnic, religious, or regional groups – into public-policy decision-making, in order to allay their sense of marginalization or perpetual failure.

zh: 这意味着创造真正的就业机会吸引工人远离非正规经济，以便使他们能够（在照章纳税的同时）享受到劳动保护。
en: It means creating real jobs to draw workers away from the informal economy, so they can benefit from workplace protections (and pay taxes).

zh: 这还意味着制定与实际情况相符的政策。
en: And it means framing policies that are appropriate to conditions on the ground.

zh: 每个国家都有自己的政策重点，政策措施可能的范围是相当广泛的。
en: Every country will have its own specific priorities, and the range of possible policy measures is quite broad.

zh: 相关措施可能包括建立社会安全网、促进性别平等、支持农民、拓宽金融服务渠道以及不计其数的其他举措。
en: It might include a social safety net, promotion of gender equality, support for farmers, improvement of access to financial services, or countless other initiatives.

zh: 但不久前世界经济论坛以最佳方式散播财富的讨论认为，有两组最重要的政策似乎是放之四海皆准的灵丹妙药。
en: But two overriding sets of policies appear to apply in almost all cases, according to a recent World Economic Forum debate on how best to spread the wealth.

zh: 第一组政策旨在确保贫困儿童有机会获得不错的教育，以此来打破跨世代贫困现象。
en: The first seeks to ensure that poor children have access to a reasonably good education as a means to reduce intergenerational poverty.

zh: 第二组政策对资源富国尤其适用，旨在保证所有民众 — — 尤其是最贫困群体 — — 从毋庸置疑的国家财富中分得一杯羹。
en: The second set of policies, which are particularly relevant in resource-rich countries, aims at guaranteeing all citizens – and especially the poorest – a share of revenues from what are unquestionably national assets.

zh: 事实证明上述政策已经在巴西等地收到了效果，那里开创性的Bolsa Familia（家庭补贴）政策只要贫困群体让子女上学、吃有营养的饭菜，并满足改善其福利的其他相关规定就为贫困家庭提供现金转移支付。
en: Such policies have been shown to work in places like Brazil, whose pioneering Bolsa Familia (or family allowance) policy provides cash transfers to poor families on the condition that their children attend school, eat properly, and fulfill other criteria to improve well-being.

zh: 墨西哥的“机遇”计划也起到类似的作用。
en: Mexico’s “Opportunity” program performs a similar function.

zh: 盛产石油的阿拉斯加拿出部分资源收入为所有居民发放红利，这一模式已经在为若干发展中国家所仿效。
en: Oil-rich Alaska pays dividends from its resource revenues to all of its citizens, a model that several developing countries are seeking to emulate.

zh: 尽管经济学家继续辩论相关计划的优点和缺点，但这些计划设置起来却不是特别复杂。
en: Although economists continue to debate the advantages and disadvantages of such schemes, they are not particularly complicated to set up.

zh: 难点在于建立伙伴关系并制定目标。
en: The challenge lies in forging partnerships and agreeing goals.

zh: 政府、企业、非政府组织和公民个人，无论贫富，都可以扮演应有的角色。
en: Governments, businesses, non-governmental organizations, and individual citizens, rich or poor, all have a role to play.

zh: 如果我们继续长时间对贫富差距的危险视而不见，那么几个不眠之夜将远远不能概括由此造成的惨痛后果。
en: If we ignore the dangers of wealth disparities for much longer, the consequences will be far more distressing than a few sleepless nights.

zh: 拉姆斯菲尔德和灵巧力量
en: Donald Rumsfeld and Smart Power

zh: 美国国防部长拉姆斯菲尔德最近谈论布什当局的全球性反恐战争时说 ： “ 在这场战争中，某些最为关键的战役并不是在阿富汗的山岭或者伊拉克的街巷中进行的，而是在位于纽约、伦敦、开罗以及其他地方的新闻室中开展的。
en: Donald Rumsfeld, America’s Secretary of Defense, recently spoke about the Bush administration’s global war on terror. “In this war, some of the most critical battles may not be in the mountains of Afghanistan or the streets of Iraq, but in newsrooms in New York, London, Cairo, and elsewhere.

zh: 我们的敌人已经娴熟地适应了在媒体时代中作战，但是我们在很大程度上却还没有 ” 。
en: Our enemies have skillfully adapted to fighting wars in the media age, but for the most part we have not.”

zh: 好消息是，拉姆斯菲尔德开始意识到无法单纯通过军事力量赢得反恐斗争。
en: The good news is that Rumsfeld is beginning to realize that the struggle against terrorism cannot be won by hard military power alone.

zh: 坏消息是，他还是不理解柔性力量，也就是通过吸引而非高压强制达到目的的能力。
en: The bad news is that he still does not understand soft power – the ability to get what you want through attraction rather than coercion.

zh: 经济学家杂志评论拉姆斯菲尔德的言论说 ： “ 直到最近，他还直截了当地把重视柔性力量视为老欧洲对恐怖主义温柔的绥靖主义 ” 。
en: As The Economist commented about Rumsfeld’s speech, “until recently he plainly regarded such a focus on ‘soft power’ as, well, soft – part of ‘Old Europe’s’ appeasement of terrorism.”

zh: 现在，拉姆斯菲尔德终于认识到赢得人心的重要性，但是，正如经济学家杂志所指出的那样 ， “ 他讲话的大部分集中在美国如何运用滑头的公关赢得宣传战争 ” 。
en: Now Rumsfeld finally realizes the importance of winning hearts and minds, but, as The Economist put it, “a good part of his speech was focused on how with slicker PR America could win the propaganda war.”

zh: 换言之，拉姆斯菲尔德在把美国的问题归咎于媒体的时候，他忘记了市场营销的首要法则，那就是如果你的产品不佳，即使是最好的广告也无法让它畅销。
en: In other words, in blaming the media for America’s problems, Rumsfeld forgot the first rule of marketing: if you have a poor product, not even the best advertising will sell it.

zh: 拉氏对欧洲方式的不信任包含了真相本质。
en: Rumsfeld’s mistrust of the European approach contains a grain of truth.

zh: 正如美国的行为方式看似其军事独霸可以解决所有问题一样，欧洲利用欧盟的吸引力实现它所要实现的目标。
en: Europe has used the attractiveness of its Union to obtain outcomes it wants, just as the US has acted as though its military pre-eminence could solve all problems.

zh: 但是，仅仅指望钢性力量或者柔性力量都是错误的。
en: But it is a mistake to count too much on hard or soft power alone.

zh: 将二者有效结合起来的能力就是“灵巧力量 ” 。
en: The ability to combine them effectively is “smart power.”

zh: 冷战期间，西方使用钢性力量来威慑苏联侵犯，同时利用柔性力量来腐蚀铁幕背后的共产主义信仰。
en: During the Cold War, the West used hard power to deter Soviet aggression, while it used soft power to erode faith in Communism behind the iron curtain.

zh: 那就是灵巧力量。
en: That was smart power.

zh: 为了实现灵巧目的，欧洲应当更多地投资于其钢性力量资源，而美国则应对其柔性力量予以更大的关注。
en: To be smart today, Europe should invest more in its hard-power resources, and America should pay more attention to its soft power.

zh: 在布什总统的第一个任期内，国务卿鲍威尔理解并提出柔性力量，而拉氏在2003年被问及柔性力量的时候回答说 ： “ 我根本就不知道它是什么东西 ” 。
en: During President George W. Bush’s first term, Secretary of State Colin Powell understood and referred to soft power, whereas Rumsfeld, when asked about soft power in 2003, replied “I don’t know what it means.”

zh: 为了这一无知付出代价是高昂的。
en: A high price was paid for that ignorance.

zh: 幸运的是，在布什的第二个任期内，莱斯和休斯坐镇国务院，拉氏的声望则由于众多足以令在私营部门解雇或者辞职的失策而受到削弱，布什已经表现出对美国柔性力量更多的关心。
en: Fortunately, in his second term, with Condoleezza Rice and Karen Hughes at the State Department and Rumsfeld’s reputation dented by failures that in the private sector would have led to his firing or resignation, Bush has shown an increased concern about America’s soft power.

zh: 当然，柔性力量并非包治百病的灵丹妙药。
en: Of course, soft power is no panacea.

zh: 例如，柔性力量对在二十世纪九十年代让塔利班停止支持基地组织上就束手无策。
en: For example, soft power got nowhere in attracting the Taliban government away from its support for Al Qaeda in the 1990’s.

zh: 只有动用了钢性的军事力量才切断了那一联系。
en: It took hard military power to sever that tie.

zh: 同理，北韩独裁者金正日喜欢看好莱坞电影，但是，那并不大可能影响他是否放弃核武器项目的决定。
en: Similarly, North Korean dictator Kim Jong Il likes to watch Hollywood movies, but that is unlikely to affect his decision about whether to give up his nuclear weapons program.

zh: 只有钢性力量才能决定这一选择，特别是如果中国同意经济制裁的话。
en: Such a choice will be determined by hard power, particularly if China agrees to economic sanctions.

zh: 尽管布什当局目前的多边外交可能对组织其他国家参加孤立伊朗的联盟有所帮助，但是，柔性力量也无力制止伊朗的核子项目。
en: Nor will soft power be sufficient to stop Iran’s nuclear program, though the legitimacy of the Bush administration’s current multilateral approach may help to recruit other countries to a coalition that isolates Iran.

zh: 但是，柔性力量却可以更好地实现其他的目标，例如促进民主和人权。
en: But other goals, such as promoting democracy and human rights, are better achieved by soft power.

zh: 正如美国在伊拉克所学习到的那样，高压强制实现民主化是有局限的。
en: Coercive democratization has its limits, as the US has learned in Iraq.

zh: 这并不意味着拉氏的五角大楼对美国柔性力量无关紧要。
en: This does not mean that Rumsfeld’s Pentagon is irrelevant to American soft power.

zh: 有时人们把军事力量混同于钢性力量，但是，同样的军力有时却可以有助于柔性力量。
en: Military force is sometimes treated as synonymous with hard power, but the same resource can sometimes contribute to soft power.

zh: 训练有素的军力有时可以引人入胜，而军事合作和培训项目则可以建立起增进国家柔性力量的跨国网络。
en: A well-run military can be a source of attraction, and military cooperation and training programs can establish transnational networks that enhance a country’s soft power.

zh: 2004年印度洋海啸后美军提供人道主义救援令人印象深刻，帮助了美国的吸引力并提升了它的柔性力量。
en: The US military’s impressive work in providing humanitarian relief after the Indian Ocean tsunami in 2004 helped restore America’s attractiveness, and enhanced its soft power.

zh: 但是，误用军事资源也可以削弱柔性力量。
en: But the misuse of military resources can also undercut soft power.

zh: 苏联在二战后的几年里掌握了大量的柔性力量。
en: The Soviet Union possessed a great deal of soft power in the years after World War II.

zh: 但是，它后来针对匈牙利和捷克斯洛伐克使用钢性力量的方式则摧毁了其作为解放者的吸引力。
en: But the Soviets’ attractiveness as liberators was destroyed by the way they later used their hard power against Hungary and Czechoslovakia.

zh: 残酷无情和对“正义战争”分清青红皂白以及适度的原则置之不理同样也可以摧毁合法性。
en: Brutality and indifference to “just war” principles of discrimination and proportionality can also destroy legitimacy.

zh: 2003年美军最初入侵伊拉克势如破竹，某些外国人肃然起敬。
en: The efficiency of the initial American military invasion of Iraq in 2003 created admiration in the eyes of some foreigners.

zh: 但是，占领伊拉克杂乱无章，阿布格里卜的虐囚事件以及由拉氏提出的在关塔那摩基地不经聆讯关押囚犯的政策等事件破坏了柔性力量。
en: But this soft power was undercut by the inefficiency of the occupation, the mistreatment of prisoners at Abu Ghraib, and the policy – initiated by Rumsfeld – of detainment without hearings at Guantánamo.

zh: 的确，没有人会指望我们能够吸引阿塔或者拉登之流。
en: To be sure, no one expects that we can ever attract people like Mohammed Attta or Osama bin Laden.

zh: 对付他们，我们需要钢性力量。
en: We need hard power to deal with such cases.

zh: 但是，当今的恐怖主义威胁并非亨廷顿的文明的冲突。
en: But today’s terrorist threat is not Samuel Huntington’s clash of civilizations.

zh: 这是一场伊斯兰世界大多数普通人以及一小部分企图压制他人接收其高度意识形态化和政治化的宗教版本的人之间的内战。
en: It is a civil war within Islam between a majority of normal people and a small minority who want to coerce others into a accepting a highly ideological and politicized version of their religion.

zh: 除非温和派取胜，否则我们就无法得胜。
en: We cannot win unless the moderates win.

zh: 除非极端分子招募的人数低于我们干掉和威慑的人数，否则我们无法取胜。
en: We cannot win unless the number of people the extremists recruit is lower than the number we kill and deter.

zh: 拉氏可能在原则上理解这一演算，但是其言行表明他并不知道如何在实践中平衡方程式。
en: Rumsfeld may understand this calculus in principle, but his words and actions show that he does not know how to balance the equation in practice.

zh: 没有柔性力量，求得平衡乃至占据获胜的制高点都是不可能的。
en: Doing so – and thus being in a position to win the war – is impossible without soft power.

zh: 美国政治的王牌
en: The Trumping of American Politics

zh: 华盛顿—民主党和共产党正在进行漫长的党内遴选程序，以选出明年总统大选的候选人。 两党面临相同的问题。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – As Republicans and Democrats go through the long process of selecting a nominee for next year’s presidential election, both parties face the same question.

zh: 目前主导竞争的反现状 — — 甚至反政治 — — 情绪会不会继续下去？
en: Will the anti-establishment – even anti-political – mood now dominating the contest last?

zh: 至少这一回，劳动节（9月的第一个星期一）不再是总统竞争的分界点：总主题早已定下。
en: For once, Labor Day (the first Monday in September) was not the presidential race’s demarcation point: the overall themes had already been set.

zh: 今年夏天，对政府和传统政客的深恶痛绝像龙卷风一样席卷整个总统竞争，一些曾被视为资深竞争者的选战一败涂地。
en: Revulsion at government and traditional politicians hit the presidential contest like a tornado in the summer, flattening the campaigns of some who were once seen as serious contenders.

zh: 当然，共和党有这种情绪并不令人奇怪，因为该党日益右倾，并且一直反对总统奥巴马。
en: Among Republicans this sentiment is, of course, no surprise, given their party’s steady rightward drift and consistent antipathy toward President Barack Obama.

zh: 但共和党推出了一位富有的“大嘴巴”加入战团，他抨击传统政客是“蠢货 ” ， 并称他单枪匹马就可以解决战斗。
en: But it suited a wealthy, noisy braggart who barreled into the race attacking conventional politicians as “stupid” and insisting that he alone could get things done.

zh: 那些将唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）贬低为“丑角”的人没有看清他早已洞察到共和党的时代精神，并且他精准地知道将利刃插向竞争对手的何处。
en: Those who wrote off Donald Trump as a “buffoon” failed to see that he has shrewdly read the Republican zeitgeist, and that he knows precisely where to stick the knife into competitors.

zh: 他将佛罗里达州前州长杰布·布什（Jeb Bush）称为“低能”人士，这严重挫伤了这位（甚至在他正式加入选战前就）被许多人当成最喜爱的候选人。
en: His depiction of former Florida governor Jeb Bush as a man of “low energy” has done real damage to a candidate whom many had assumed – even before he formally entered the race – would be the favorite.

zh: “唐纳德 ” （ 没有任何人的名字识别度能超过这位前电视人）将他的号召力建立在美国爱国主义和阴暗面上。
en: “The Donald” (no one has better name recognition than the former TV personality) has pitched his appeal both to American patriotism and the country’s dark side.

zh: 他提出了“让美国再次伟大”的口号，目标直指那些因为美国不在能够将自己的意志加在日益困惑的世界之上而沮丧的人群。
en: His slogan, “Make America Great Again,” is aimed at those who are frustrated that the US can no longer impose its will on an increasingly confusing world.

zh: 对他们，也对特朗普而言，奥巴马是罪魁：他没有抵挡住外交领导人（内塔尼亚胡可能会反对这一点 ） ； 他过早从伊拉克撤军（尽管撤军时间表是他的共和党前任制定的 ） ； 他甚至为美国而“道歉 ” 。
en: For them, and for Trump, Obama is to blame: he doesn’t stand up to foreign leaders (Binyamin Netanyahu might disagree); he withdrew from Iraq too soon (though the timetable was set by his Republican predecessor); he even “apologizes” for America.

zh: 特朗普利用了美国长期存在的一定程度的种族主义和本土论：他宣誓要设法围剿和驱逐大约1,100万非法留美外国人，在美墨边境建立一道墙 — — 由墨西哥买单。
en: Trump plays to America’s persistent veins of racism and nativism: he vows somehow to round up and deport some 11 million undocumented aliens and fortify America’s border with Mexico by building a wall – paid for by Mexico.

zh: 他的惊人的自恋（他所做的一切都“了不起、伟大、完美、最好 ” ） 是他的招牌，也是他的政策。
en: His striking narcissism (everything he does is “outstanding, great, terrific, the best”) is both his trademark and his policy.

zh: 8月中旬，即使发表了足以让平庸候选人一败涂地的公开言论，特朗普的支持者数量仍在上升，专家们猛然醒悟，他绝不是这个夏天的“调味品 ” 。
en: Around mid-August, as Trump’s poll numbers rose even after public statements that would have brought down mere mortal candidates, it dawned on the pundits that he was no summer infatuation.

zh: 很明显，他有可能赢得第一场提名竞争 — — 艾奥瓦州党代会，并且他在第二场竞争 — — 新罕布什尔州和其他州也处于领先。
