en: It became evident that he might win the first nominating contest, the Iowa caucuses, and that he was leading in the second, New Hampshire, and other states.

zh: 认为他可能成为共和党候选人已不再是个笑话。
en: It was no longer laughable to say that he could be the Republican nominee.

zh: 但“反制度”这场选战的情绪并不局限于共和党。
en: But the “anti-system” mood of this election campaign is not confined to the Republicans.

zh: 社会主义者伯尔尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）和富豪唐纳德·特朗普正在寻找相同的动力。
en: Bernie Sanders the socialist and Donald Trump the plutocrat are addressing much the same impulse.

zh: 桑德斯用明确的陈述句提出了一个政府政策的理想概念，吸引了日益左倾的民主党人士。
en: Speaking in clear, declarative sentences, Sanders sets forth an idealistic conception of government policy that appeals to a great many people on the growing left of the Democratic Party.

zh: 相反，杰布·布什和民主党志在必得的提名人希拉里·克林顿采取的是传统政治。
en: By contrast, Jeb Bush and the Democrats’ presumed nominee, Hillary Clinton, embody traditional politics.

zh: 布什和克林顿的风格是专注的团队、包装和谨慎；而特朗普和桑德斯被追随者视为“直言不讳 ” 。
en: Both come across as focus-grouped, packaged, and cautious, whereas Trump and Sanders are seen by their followers as “telling it like it is.”

zh: 桑德斯切入点是公众对美国领导人 — — 包括中间派的比尔·克林顿 — — 所做出的妥协的沮丧情绪。
en: Sanders appeals to the popular frustration with the compromises made by America’s leaders, including the centrist Bill Clinton.

zh: 希拉里·克林顿试图通吃民主党内分裂的两翼，而随着桑德斯吸引大量群众（这是她所没有做到的 ） ， 她开始左倾。
en: Hillary Clinton, trying to straddle the divide between the two wings of the Democratic Party, is increasingly leaning to the left as Sanders draws enormous crowds, something she has yet to accomplish.

zh: 此外，她的阵营正在苦苦摆脱一项披露所造成的困局：在担任奥巴马的国务卿期间，她通过私人邮件服务器处理公务。
en: Moreover, her campaign is struggling to escape the quagmire produced by revelations that she conducted official business on a private email server during her tenure as Obama’s Secretary of State.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普受到了共和党内部全方位的支持：温和派和保守派、受过高等教育者、福音派、男性和女性。
en: Meanwhile, Trump’s appeal among Republicans is across the board: moderates and conservatives, college-educated, Evangelicals, men and women.

zh: 他的支持者还包括白人至上论者：6月，特朗普得到了美国最大的新纳粹“新闻”网站The Daily Stormer的支持 。
en: It also includes white supremacists: in June Trump was endorsed by The Daily Stormer, America’s largest neo-Nazi “news” website.

zh: 波士顿的两位极右翼活跃分子殴打了一位无家可归的拉丁裔男子，其中一人说他们是代表特朗普行凶的，特朗普评论说，他的一些追随者“相当热情”一项关于特朗普支持者的民调 发现，66%相信奥巴马是穆斯林，61%相信他非出生在美国（这一点早已被证伪，但此后特朗普仍然在宣传这一点 ） 。
en: When two far-right activists in Boston beat a homeless Latino man, with one saying that they had acted in Trump’s name, the candidate commented that some of his followers are “passionate.” A poll of Trump supporters found that 66% believe that Obama is a Muslim, and 61% that he was not born in the US (a claim that Trump continued to trumpet long after it had been disproved).

zh: 与特朗普最接近的共和党竞争者本·卡尔森（Ben Carson）是著名外科医生，他也没有政治经验，常常语出惊人。
en: Trump’s closest Republican rival, Ben Carson, a renowned neurosurgeon, also has no political experience and says outlandish things.

zh: 但卡尔森总是悄悄地说，这也许是他在艾奥瓦州的的支持率高于其他共和党竞争者（在一项民调中与特朗普打了平手）的原因。
en: But Carson says them quietly, which may be why his favorability rating in Iowa is higher than that of his Republican competitors (pulling even with Trump in one poll).

zh: 比如，卡尔森说，异性恋者蹲过监狱就变成了同性恋；美国在镇压思想和反对派方面就像纳粹德国；总统不需要执行最高法院宣布同性婚姻合法的最近的里程碑式裁决。
en: Carson has said, for example, that people enter prison as heterosexuals and come out gay; that America is like Nazi Germany in suppressing ideas and opponents; and that the president need not enforce the Supreme Court’s recent landmark decision legalizing gay marriage.

zh: 特朗普和卡尔森，以及其他两位作为政治局外人参选者 — — 德克萨斯州参议员泰德·科鲁兹（Ted Cruz）和惠普公司前CEO卡莉·菲奥丽娜（Carly Fiorina ） — —目前赢得艾奥瓦州共和党支持率的60%左右。
en: Trump and Carson, along with two other candidates running as political outsiders – Ted Cruz, a senator from Texas, and former Hewlett-Packard CEO Carly Fiorina – currently account for around 60% of support among Iowa Republicans.

zh: 布什和其他人 — — 包括兰德·保罗（Rand Paul ） 、 斯科特·沃克尔（Scott Walker）和马克·卢比奥（Marco Rubio ） ， 他们都曾经是政治媒体的宠儿 — — 形势惨淡。
en: Bush and the rest of the field, including Rand Paul, Scott Walker, and Marco Rubio – all one-time darlings of the political press – are floundering.

zh: 为了收复失地，一些人，特备是沃克尔，已经陷入了试图比特朗普更特朗普的陷阱。
en: To recover ground, some, especially Walker, have fallen into the trap of trying to out-Trump Trump.

zh: 但只有一个特朗普，他的参选正在导致一些共和党官员的震怒，特别是他的竞选策略公然敌视拉丁裔。
en: But there’s only one Trump, and his candidacy is causing conniptions on the part of Republican Party officials, particularly given his campaign’s open hostility toward Latinos.

zh: 2012年奥巴马连任后，共和党岭南道人进行了一项研究，研究表明该党候选人必须赢得更多拉丁裔选票才能重新入主白宫。
en: Following Obama’s re-election, in 2012, Republican leaders commissioned a study that showed that the party’s nominee will have to win more Latino votes than ever to win the White House.

zh: 如果特朗普成为共和党候选人，这一希望十分渺茫。
en: There is scant chance of that if Trump is the party’s standard-bearer.

zh: 目前，特朗普已经颠覆了政治引力定律。
en: So far, Trump has defied the laws of political gravity.

zh: 但他的获选人资格仍有可能泡汤，因为他的对手出局后，他们的支持者（以及有钱的金主）可能会团结在他们看来更有利的人选周围。
en: But it remains possible that his candidacy will crash as some of his rivals drop out and leave their supporters (and wealthy backers) to crystallize around someone they see as a more viable alternative.

zh: 对于共和党领导人来说，这令人松一口气。 最近特朗普已经承诺（很容易推翻 ） ， 如果竞争共和党内候选人失败，他不会作为独立候选人参选。
en: That would be a relief to Republican Party leaders, who recently obtained Trump’s vow (easily undone) not to mount an independent presidential campaign should he fail to win the party’s nomination.

zh: 与此同时，两党的老牌势力都有理由感到紧张。
en: In the meantime, both party establishments have reason to be nervous.

zh: 如今，桑德斯在新罕布什尔州遥遥领先于克林顿，资深评论家开始猜测美国人最终将需要在桑德斯和特朗普之间做出选择。
en: With Sanders now polling well ahead of Clinton in New Hampshire, serious commentators have begun speculating that Americans will ultimately be asked to choose between Sanders and Trump.

zh: 特朗普治下的美中关系将向何处去？
en: Which Way for US-China Relations Under Trump?

zh: 北京 — — 美国大选中唐纳德·特朗普的惊人胜利已经颠覆了决定美国政治和世界各国对美看法的一切确定因素。
en: BEIJING – Donald Trump’s shocking victory in the US presidential election has upended all of the certainties that have shaped not only American politics, but also how the world thinks about the United States.

zh: 特朗普现在必须直面美国国际关系管理的本质，可以说，美中关系是全世界最重要的关系。
en: Trump must now confront the nitty-gritty of managing America’s international relationships, and arguably none is more important for the world than that between the US and China.

zh: 但这同时也是特朗普竞选期间最受质疑的关系。
en: But it is also the relationship that was put in the most doubt by the tenor of Trump’s campaign.

zh: 这位当选总统可能导致双边关系复杂化，尤其鉴于他首年任期恰逢中国共产党定于明年秋天召开的第十九次全国代表大会。
en: The president-elect could complicate bilateral relations, particularly given that his first year in office will coincide with the Chinese Communist Party’s 19th National Congress next fall.

zh: 在理想世界里，特朗普和中国国家主席习近平都希望美中关系保持稳定。
en: In an ideal world, both Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping should want to keep US-China relations stable.

zh: 但鉴于特朗普挑起对中国恐惧的长篇大论和就中国南海领土要求及朝鲜核野心方面的持续分歧，保持中美关系稳定并非易事。
en: But this will prove difficult, given not only Trump’s Sinophobic rhetoric, but also ongoing disagreements about Chinese territorial claims in the South China Sea and North Korea’s nuclear ambitions.

zh: 此外，美中关系可能成为美国国内全球贸易、美元价值和保护主义争端的受害者。
en: Moreover, US-China relations could fall victim to US domestic disputes about global trade, the value of the dollar, and protectionism.

zh: 许多中国观察家都认为特朗普被迫将在国内面对前所未有的分歧。
en: Many Chinese observers accept that Trump will have to grapple with unprecedented divisions at home.

zh: 他不仅将要应对深感震惊的民主党的挑战，而且还要面对公开或秘密反对他候选资格的共和党人。
en: He will be challenged not only by the now shell-shocked Democrats, but also by Republicans who opposed his candidacy, whether openly or covertly.

zh: 在这种情况下，他必须先以整肃美国国内秩序为重。
en: Under these circumstances, he will have to emphasize putting America’s own house in order.

zh: 可如果他把这项工作与竞选时“美国第一”的提法相互混淆，就有可能进一步加剧紧张关系。
en: If, however, he confuses such an effort with his campaign’s “America first” thrust, even more tension is likely.

zh: 除国内政治外，国际秩序在近年来也经历了几次冲击，并深刻改变了美中关系的全球氛围。
en: Beyond domestic politics, the international order has experienced several shocks in recent years, profoundly changing the global context for US-China relations.

zh: 乌克兰和叙利亚旷日持久的冲突暗示了美俄之间陷入新冷战，这些国家和其他地方的混乱局面正日益严重地影响到国家经济和安全机制。
en: Protracted conflicts in Ukraine and Syria hint at a new Cold War between the US and Russia, and the turmoil in those countries, as well as elsewhere, is increasingly disrupting national economies and security regimes.

zh: 作为两个主导世界的大国，美中必须探索在如此不稳定的环境下如何共同努力。
en: As the world’s two leading powers, the US and China must figure out how to work together in such unstable conditions.

zh: 今天，它们之间不稳定的关系在合作的同时伴随着激烈竞争。
en: Today, their unsteady relationship features cooperation alongside intensifying competition.

zh: 而后者比前者吸引了世界更多的关注，这一点并不令人感到惊奇。
en: Not unsurprisingly, the latter has gained more of the world’s attention than the former.

zh: 奥巴马总统一直在强化美国在中国周边的军事存在、强化亚洲安全联盟，并公开干预南中国海的领土争端。
en: President Barack Obama has been reinforcing the US military presence in and around China’s neighbors, beefing up security alliances in Asia, and very publicly intervening in the territorial disputes in the South China Sea.

zh: 中国领导层认为这些举措，还有拟议中十二国泛太平洋贸易伙伴协定，共同组成了“遏制”中国战略。
en: The Chinese leadership views these moves, as well as the proposed 12-country Trans-Pacific Partnership trade deal, as an effort to “contain” China.

zh: 在美国重新平衡对亚洲地缘政治战略的同时，中国也正通过新的安全及全球发展倡议，包括连接中国和欧亚大陆多数经济体的“一带一路”计划，宣示其在全球的实力存在。
en: At the same time that the US is rebalancing its geopolitical strategy toward Asia, China is asserting its global presence with new security and international-development initiatives, including the “one belt, one road” project, which will link the Chinese economy with much of Eurasia.

zh: 同样，中国主导的亚洲基础设施投资银行（美国认为该行是中国挑战现有国际秩序的工具）继续吸引加拿大等遥远的潜在成员，后者于今年8月时申请加入。
en: Likewise, the China-led Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank – which the US views as a Chinese tool for challenging the existing international order – continues to attract such faraway prospective members as Canada, which applied to join in August.

zh: 中美之间的零和游戏将使两国间更有可能爆发冲突。
en: Zero-sum competition between the US and China will make a conflict between the two countries more likely.

zh: 潜在的引爆点之一是朝鲜的核武器项目。
en: One potential flashpoint will be North Korea’s nuclear-weapons program.

zh: 美国已经在采取措施通过强化弹道导弹防御系统防止朝鲜对美国本土或韩国发起攻击。
en: The US is already taking measures to prevent North Korea from attacking it, or South Korea, through enhanced ballistic missile defense systems.

zh: 新上任的特朗普政府可能辅之以军事行动，以增加对中国的压力。
en: The new Trump administration could supplement those efforts with military action to increase the pressure on China.

zh: 但特朗普在竞选期间宣布可以接受将核武器技术带到日本或朝鲜半岛的策略将在东北亚造成自朝鲜战争以来各国再未亲眼目睹过的危机。
en: But any effort to bring nuclear-weapons technology to Japan or the Korean Peninsula, something that Trump declared acceptable during the campaign, would create a crisis in Northeast Asia the likes of which the world has not seen since the Korean War.

zh: 中美两国也有可能因台湾问题而爆发冲突。
en: The US could also clash with China over Taiwan.

zh: 1995到1996年台海关系危机以来台湾和中国大陆的关系一直相对和平，时任美国总统比尔·克林顿曾将美国一个航母战斗群派到台湾海峡。
en: Relations between Taiwan and mainland China have been fairly peaceful since the 1995-1996 Taiwan Strait Crisis, when then-US President Bill Clinton sent an American aircraft-carrier battle group into the strait.

zh: 但台湾对中国而言仍然是高度敏感和感性的问题。
en: But Taiwan remains a highly sensitive – and emotive – issue for China.

zh: 如果对台关系恶化，也有可能影响到美中关系。
en: If relations with the island sour, so, too, could the US-China relationship.

zh: 正常的美中关系令世界各国受益，因此两国应当进一步公开它们的国家利益。
en: The world benefits when US-China relations stay on track, so both countries should be more transparent about their national interests.

zh: 在明确立场约束下两国都可以采取战略克制政策，避免像过去那样有时夸张地炫耀武力。
en: With clearly defined positions, each country could pursue a policy of strategic restraint, avoiding the swaggering displays of force that have sometimes tempted them in the past.

zh: 如果美中两国爆发冲突，中国的现代化进程可能脱轨，中国人民可能无法实现习近平所宣布的“中国梦 ” 。
en: If a conflict between the US and China were to erupt, China’s modernization could be derailed, and the Chinese people would miss out on the “Chinese Dream” that Xi has declared as their goal.

zh: 而对美国而言，外交崩溃意味着中国“失控 ” ， 美国人普遍认为1949年毛泽东击败美国支持的蒋介石国民党政权时中国曾处在失控状态。
en: For the US, a diplomatic breakdown would indicate that China had been “lost,” as it previously was thought to have been lost when Mao Zedong defeated Chiang Kai-shek’s US-supported Nationalist regime in 1949.

zh: 更广义地讲，美中敌对会对全世界产生影响，并且会破坏应对气候变化等全球挑战的国际努力。
en: More broadly, US-China hostility would be felt worldwide, and would disrupt international efforts to confront global challenges such as climate change.

zh: 为避免短期内陷入这样的局面，美中两国应考虑成立联合小组，聘请两国知名专家和经验丰富的高官。
en: To avoid that scenario in the short term, the US and China should consider forming a joint team that includes experienced, high-ranking officials and prominent experts from both sides.

zh: 该小组可以指导2017年的美中关系、识别潜在冲突并在紧张局势达到沸点之前提出解决方案。
en: This group could chart a course for US-China relations in 2017, identify potential conflicts, and recommend solutions before tensions can reach a boiling point.

zh: 有了这样的全新双边关系外交框架，美中两国的战略对抗或许可以避���。
en: With a new diplomatic framework for bilateral relations, the US and China could ward off strategic confrontations.

zh: 长远来看，美中需要通过加深对话建立对国际秩序的共同愿景，这样任何一方就不会屈服于诱惑来组建对立集团。
en: In the long term, the US and China need deeper dialogue and a shared vision for the international order, so that individual countries will not be tempted to form rival blocs among themselves.

zh: 美中还应合作推进“全球化2.0”版本，改革能够包容全部发达和新兴国家的国际规则和体制。
en: The US and China should also work together toward “globalization 2.0,” by reforming international rules and institutions to accommodate both established and emerging countries.

zh: 尽管未来几年美中两国冲突的可能性切实存在，但也同样存在改善合作的空间。
en: While there is much potential for conflict between the US and China in the coming years, there is also space for improved cooperation.

zh: 事实上，在特朗普取胜造成的重大不确定性下，构建新型关系比以往任何时候更具有战略价值，因为全球环境不断变化，而且美中两国都面临着区域地缘政治和国内挑战。
en: Indeed, amid the vast uncertainty created by Trump’s victory, a new relationship now makes more strategic sense than ever, given changing global circumstances, regional geopolitics, and domestic challenges in both the US and China.

zh: 特朗普现在必须选择以合作还是对抗作为美国对华政策的主基调。
en: Trump must now choose between cooperation and confrontation as the framework for US policy toward China.

zh: 他的选择应当显而易见：合作改革国际秩序将惠及美中双方。
en: His choice should be obvious: a collaborative effort to reform the international order would benefit both sides.

zh: 竞选过程中的小丑
en: Clowns on the Campaign Trail

zh: 纽约 — — 被人称为“唐纳德”的房地产大亨兼真人秀主持人唐纳德·特朗普不太可能成为美国的下一任总统。
en: NEW YORK – Donald Trump, the real-estate tycoon and reality-show host, also known as “The Donald,” is unlikely to be the next president of the United States.

zh: 他在多数问题上都粗鲁、无知、大嗓门，精心修饰的张狂的金发也令他看上去略显荒唐。
en: He is loud, crude, ignorant about most things, and looks absurd in his puffed up blond comb-over hairdo.

zh: 就连狂热的共和党人都不屑地称他为“小丑 ” ， 并用“马戏班”来形容他的竞选活动。
en: Even ardent Republicans have dismissed him as a “rodeo clown,” and his campaign as a “circus.”

zh: 《赫芬顿邮报》纯粹将特朗普的竞选当作娱乐新闻报道。
en: The Huffington Post covers Trump’s campaign strictly as entertainment news.

zh: 但现在，特朗普遥遥领先于共和党总统竞选提名的所有对手。
en: Yet, for the moment, Trump is leaving all his rivals for the Republican presidential nomination in the dust.

zh: 即使在以怪诞著称的美国政界，这样的情况也非同寻常。
en: Even in US politics, which can be very strange, this is extraordinary.

zh: 如何解释特朗普的人气？
en: What explains Trump’s popularity?

zh: 他的所有支持者是否都是“疯子 ” ， 就像参议员约翰·麦凯恩不太明智的指责？
en: Are all his supporters “crazies,” as Senator John McCain, perhaps unwisely, called them?

zh: 特朗普的批评者认为他迎合了愤愤不平的选民们最基本的天性，那就是痛恨外国人（尤其是墨西哥人 ） 、 不信任银行家（或者任何接受过高等教育者 ） 、 到现在都没法接受父亲是黑人的奥巴马。
en: Trump’s critics argue that he is playing to the basest instincts of disaffected voters, who hate foreigners (especially Mexicans), distrust bankers (or anyone with a higher education, for that matter), and still can’t get over the election of a president whose father was black.

zh: 用喜剧演员乔恩·斯图尔特的话说，特朗普就是美国的代表，或者至少代表为数众多的生活在小镇且年龄偏大的白人一族。
en: Trump, in the comedian Jon Stewart’s words, is “America’s id,” or at least the id of a large number of mostly white, mostly older, mostly small-town Americans.

zh: 可能的确是这样。
en: Now, all this may be so.

zh: 但特朗普代表了民主世界一种普遍存在的现象。
en: But Trump is part of a wider phenomenon throughout the democratic world.

zh: 愤愤不平的选民随处可见，无论是在美国、印度还是欧洲。
en: Disaffected voters can be found everywhere, whether in the US, Europe, or India.

zh: 但他们不仅远离主流政党转而追随那些信誓旦旦要将腐败精英清理出权力中心者；他们还喜欢政治娱乐者，如果你愿意也可以称之为小丑。
en: But they are not only turning away from mainstream political parties and following populists who promise to clean out the corrupt elites from the centers of power; they also share a taste for political entertainers, or clowns if you like.

zh: 毕普·格里洛，一位真正的职业喜剧演员，现在领导着意大利第二大政党。
en: Beppe Grillo, a real professional comedian, now leads the second largest political party in Italy.

zh: 他的目标是要推翻该国政治体制，带领意大利退出欧元区从而打击欧盟。
en: His aim is to overturn the country’s political establishment and upset the European Union by taking Italy out of the euro.

zh: 当然，某种意义上，意大利人三次选出的总理都很像小丑。
en: In a sense, of course, Italians already voted three times for a clownish figure as prime minister.

zh: 同样是房地产界亿万富翁的贝卢斯科尼甚至比特朗普更加离经叛道，而且同是操纵大众媒体的高手（从字面上看确实如此，因为意大利多数大众媒体都归贝卢斯科尼所有 ） 。
en: Silvio Berlusconi, another real-estate billionaire, who began his career as a crooner on a cruise ship, was even more outrageous than Trump, as well as a master of the mass media – literally so, as he owned most of it in his country.

zh: 贝卢斯科尼在职业生涯开始阶段曾在游轮上当过歌手。 特朗普的情况也十分相似，很多人，尤其是男性，喜欢他恰恰是因为他无耻的言论和行动。
en: As is true of The Donald, many people, especially men, liked him not despite his outrageous statements and behavior, but because of them.

zh: 一位名叫维克多·特鲁希略的电视喜剧演员现在已经是墨西哥最家喻户晓的政治评论人物，但多数人都称之为“恐怖小丑Brozo ” 。
en: A television comic named Victor Trujillo, but better known as Brozo the Creepy Clown, became the most influential political commentator in Mexico.

zh: 在从不以“丑角政客”闻名的荷兰，皮姆·杜恩是民粹主义崛起早期的领导人物，杜恩是位张扬的同性恋，他在公共场合露面总是既有挑衅性又极富娱乐效果。
en: In the Netherlands, not normally a country known for clownish politicians, the surge of populism was first led by Pim Fortuyn, a flamboyantly gay man who staged provocative, and always richly entertaining, public appearances.

zh: 同样，他语出惊人的天分不但不是障碍，反而能帮助他取得成功。
en: Again, his talent for shocking statements was an asset, not a hindrance.

zh: 2002年杜恩横死后，留着染成银灰色头发的前朋克摇滚歌手威尔德斯就成了荷兰民粹主义天空中最闪亮的角色。
en: After his violent death in 2002, Geert Wilders, a former punk rocker with a pile of dyed platinum blond hair, shone brightest in the Dutch populist firmament.

zh: 除了独特的发型（谢顶的贝卢斯科尼让人在他头上作画 ） ， 新民粹主义者大都有几个共同之处。
en: Apart from peculiar hairstyles (the balding Berlusconi has his head painted), the new populists have several things in common.

zh: 无论是不是亿万富翁，他们都对排斥自己的所谓精英阶层有着强烈的敌视。
en: Whether billionaires or not, they share a prickly hostility to so-called elites, from whom they feel socially excluded.

zh: 威尔德斯和特朗普之流同样利用了大众的反移民情绪。
en: Wilders and Trump, among others of their ilk, also play on popular anti-immigrant sentiment.

zh: 特朗普将美国的墨西哥人称为“强奸犯 ” 。
en: Trump called Mexicans in the US “rapists.”

zh: 威尔德斯则想禁止古兰经并阻止穆斯林移民荷兰。
en: Wilders wants to ban the Koran and stop Muslims from moving to his country.

zh: 但这些同样源于对精英阶层的不满，他们指责精英阶层允许外国人移民到本国。
en: But this, too, is part of the same resentment against elites, who are blamed for allowing foreigners to arrive in the first place.

zh: 在欧洲，对移民和伊斯兰教的反感可以迅速转化为敌视被视为根深蒂固的精英们的另���个堡垒的欧盟。
en: In Europe, antipathy to immigrants, or Islam, can quickly switch to hostility toward the European Union, which is seen as yet another bastion of entrenched elites.

zh: 这是威尔德斯和格里洛的共同之处。
en: This is what Wilders and Grillo have in common.

zh: 但我认为有一个根本原因让政治小丑们成绩如此之好。
en: But I think there is a more basic reason why political clowns are doing so well.

zh: 很多人都非常厌恶专业政治阶层。
en: Many people are fed up with the professional political class.

zh: 过去，左翼政治人物往往来自工会，而保守党则多是富商或地主。
en: In the past, politicians of the left often came from the trade unions, while conservatives were rich businessmen or landowners.

zh: 社会阶层有其各自的利益，这表现在有明确意识形态差异的截然不同的政党。
en: Social classes had their own interests, which were represented by parties divided by clear ideological differences.

zh: 但人们感到政党和政党之间的差别越来越小。
en: Increasingly, however, people see no difference between politicians from one party or another.

zh: 他们被归并到“华盛顿 ” 、 “布鲁塞尔”或“华尔街”等模糊的分类之中。
en: They are lumped together under such rubrics as “Washington,” “Brussels,” or “Wall Street.”

zh: 这种看法可能有所夸大，尤其是在美国。
en: This perception is exaggerated, especially in the US.

zh: 美国如果选出共和党总统真会出现截然不同的效果，特别是现在共和党占据了国会两院多数。
en: The country really would be a different place under a Republican president, especially with a Republican majority in both houses of Congress.

zh: 但很多地方意识形态差异在很大程度上已不复存在也是现实状况。
en: But it is certainly true in many places that ideological differences have largely collapsed.

zh: 社会民主党与奉行不干涉政策的保守派组成政府联合执政。
en: Social democrats govern in coalition governments with laissez-faire conservatives.

zh: 新自由主义处于主导地位。
en: Neoliberalism reigns.

zh: 政治越来越像同阶层成员争夺就业的被操纵的制度，而不是代表集体利益的思想争夺胜利的地方。
en: More and more, politics looks like a rigged system whereby members of the same political class compete for jobs, rather than for the victory of ideas, or on behalf of larger collective interests.

zh: 那么特朗普主义或格里洛主义就是对职业政治家的反抗。
en: Trumpism, then, or Grilloism, is a revolt against the professional politicians.

zh: 特朗普的参选对手不只是民主党。 他同样也在与党内机构竞争。
en: Trump is not just trying to run against a Democrat for the presidency; he is running against his own party’s establishment as well.

zh: 他的支持者厌倦了共和党和民主党在华盛顿达成的妥协。
en: His supporters are disgusted with the compromises made in Washington between leading Republicans and Democrats.

zh: 他们认为在治理多元化大国时两党合作没有必要；它不过是腐败的一种表现形式。
en: To them, bipartisan cooperation is not necessary to the governance of a large and diverse country; it is a form of corruption.

zh: 他们因此在五年前投票给茶党政客，后者主张政府不接受与民主党谈判的协议。
en: That is why they voted five years ago for Tea Party politicians, who preferred a government shutdown to a negotiated deal with Democrats.

zh: 他们也因此为特朗普这样华而不实的大嗓门欢呼。
en: And that is why they are cheering for a showy loudmouth like Trump.

zh: 但没有妥协的民主根本无法管理。
en: But, without compromise, a democracy becomes ungovernable.

zh: 美国正切实面临着这样的威胁。
en: The US is in grave danger of this now.

zh: 即使特朗普不会成为下一任总统，民粹主义也已经造成了损失。
en: Even though Trump will not become the next president, the populist damage has already been done.

zh: 特朗普的正常美联储
en: Donald Trump’s Normal Fed

zh: 坎布里奇—特朗普的总统生涯几乎完全置常规制度规范于不顾，如何解释他绝对合理的美联储理事会任命？
en: CAMBRIDGE – In a presidency that has shown little regard for conventional institutional norms, how can one explain Donald Trump’s completely reasonable appointments to the Federal Reserve Board?

zh: 最新提名人、哥伦比亚大学教授理查德·克拉里达（Richard Clarida）和堪萨斯州银行委员米歇尔·鲍曼（Michelle Bowman）延续了选择理性技术官僚的模式，而这个模式选出的第一任便是现任美联储主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔（Jerome Powell ） 。
en: The most recent nominations, Columbia professor Richard Clarida and Michelle Bowman, the bank commissioner for the state of Kansas, continue a pattern of choosing seasoned technocrats, beginning, most importantly, with Jerome Powell, the new Fed chair.

zh: 如果特朗普是一位正常的总统，那么任命能够确保有效决策、拥有高度评价的个人实乃应有之义。
en: If Trump were a normal president, appointing highly regarded individuals who can ensure effective policymaking would be business as usual.

zh: 但特朗普常常选择几乎毫无政府经验的官员，给他们的任务也往往是给所在部门制造尽可能大的破坏。
en: But here is a president who has often chosen officials with little government experience, and then seems to task them with creating the most disruption possible in the departments they are selected to run.

zh: 但对于美联储，这位《交易的艺术 》 （ The Art of the Deal）作者提名的副主席是一位学者（克拉里达 ） ， 他最著名的论文题为《货币政策的科学 》 （ The Science of Monetary Policy ） 。
en: Yet for the Fed, the author of The Art of the Deal has nominated as vice-chair an academic (Clarida) whose most famous paper is entitled “The Science of Monetary Policy.”

zh: 完全正常，你也许会这样说，因为保持美联储稳定而给予特朗普好评就像是因为不开启核战争而给他高分。
en: All right, you might say, giving Trump credit for maintaining stability at the Fed is like giving high marks for not starting a nuclear war.

zh: 央行独立性的概念在过去30年中在全世界政客心中已经根深蒂固。
en: The idea of central-bank independence has gained enormous traction over the past 30 years among politicians worldwide.

zh: 它不但是美国、欧元区和日本等民主实体的规范，俄罗斯总统普京和匈牙利总理欧尔班也不得不耗费巨大的时间和力量来挑战各自的央行。
en: Not only is it the norm in democracies such as the United States, the eurozone and Japan, but even strongman leaders like Russian President Vladimir Putin and Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán pause long and hard before challenging their central banks.

zh: 但人们忘记了央行独立性这个概念究竟有多新。
en: But people forget just how new the idea of central-bank independence really is.

zh: 可敬的英格兰银行赢得货币独立性不过20年。
en: The venerable Bank of England gained monetary independence only 20 years ago.

zh: 20世纪80年代初，我撰写论证独立性可以作为树立央行反通胀信誉的工具的学术论文时，我被各种期刊拒稿。
en: Back in the early 1980s, when I wrote an academic paper making the case for independence as a tool to establish central banks’ anti-inflation credibility, one journal after another rejected it.

zh: 审稿人对于独立性或许不止是可以被政府轻易打破的毫无意义的表面文章的概念嗤之以鼻。
en: The referees scoffed at the idea that independence could be more than a meaningless façade, easily pierced by the government.

zh: 这让我们回到特朗普。
en: Which brings us back to Trump.

zh: 这是否只是他漫长而艰难的暂停，随后他将向美联储施压在2020年选举前支撑经济，并最终将共和党减税法案所造成的巨额赤字货币化？
en: Is he just pausing long and hard before pressing the Fed to stoke the economy ahead of the 2020 election, and ultimately to monetize the massive deficits wrought by Republican tax cuts?

zh: 如果这是他的计划 — — 谁会真的相信逼到绝境的特朗普不会祭出高通胀 — — 那么好消息是他的美联储任命不会让他轻易讨到好果子吃。
en: If that is his plan – and who really believes a cornered Trump would not resort to high inflation? – the good news is that his Fed appointments will not make his life easy.

zh: 特朗普确实好像明白这一点。
en: Trump does appear to understand this.

zh: 毕竟，在2016年竞选中，他本人抨击鲍威尔的前任珍妮特·耶伦（Janet Yellen ） ， 说她降低利率为希拉里·克林顿（Hillary Clinton）助选。
en: After all, on the campaign trail in 2016, he himself railed against Powell’s predecessor, Janet Yellen, for allegedly holding down interest rates to facilitate Hillary Clinton’s election.

zh: 如今，特朗普成了总统，而这也成了他在2020年所乐见的事。
en: Now as president, that is exactly what he would like to see in 2020.

zh: 在去年面试耶伦候选人的过程中，据说他只问了一个关键问题 ： “ 你不会提高利率，搅黄我的漂亮股市的，对吧？ ”
en: Interviewing candidates to succeed Yellen last year, he supposedly asked just one key question: “You aren’t going to raise interest rates and ruin my beautiful stock market, are you?”

zh: 诚然，特朗普因为需要赢得参议院批准提名人选而有所克制。
en: True, Trump is somewhat constrained by the need to win Senate approval of his nominations.

zh: 事实上，一些保守派共和党反对他的另一个任命人选、卡耐基梅隆大学的马文·古德弗伦德（Marvin Goodfriend ） ， 因为他敢于提出美联储可能需要新的货币政策方针（负利率）来面对下一次深度衰退或金融危机。
en: In fact, some conservative Republicans have objected to another of his appointments, Marvin Goodfriend of Carnegie Mellon University, for daring to suggest that the Fed might need a new approach to monetary policy (negative interest rates) to confront the next very deep recession or financial crisis.

zh: 尽管有朝一日美联储几乎肯定会采取这一建议（我也发表过关于这个问题的文章 ） ， 但古德弗伦德的提名没有获得美国参议院银行委员会的批准。
en: And although someday the Fed will almost surely embrace this advice (I have also published on the issue), Goodfriend’s nomination barely survived the US Senate Banking Committee.

zh: 但到目前为止，参议院给了特朗普想要的东西，许多共和党有可能会选择一位破坏者 — — 比如信奉“结束美联储”的罗恩·保罗（Ron Paul）门徒 — — 或另一位保守派，宣传回到一战前的金本位。
en: But, by and large, the Senate has given Trump what he wants, and many Republicans would have embraced a disrupter – for example, a disciple of Ron “End the Fed” Paul – or another conservative preaching a return to the pre-World War I gold standard.

zh: 不幸的是，美联储独立性之战远未结束。
en: Unfortunately, the battle for the Fed’s independence is far from over.

zh: 特朗普可能会等到真正的冲突爆发后才亮招。
en: Trump may just be keeping his powder dry until a real conflict erupts.

zh: 目前，美联储的升息计划大多为预防性。
en: Right now, the Fed’s planned interest-rate hikes are largely prophylactic.

zh: 通胀升高得非常缓慢，虽然经济看上去热得发烫。
en: Inflation is rising only very slowly, even as the economy seems to be running red-hot.

zh: 但清算日总会来临。
en: But the moment of reckoning could still come.

zh: 假设特朗普保持健康，避免弹劾并连选连任，那么他在2019和2020年最不愿意看到的情景将是利率急剧升高、不合时宜的失业升高，以及他的漂亮股市可能发生价格崩盘。
en: And, assuming that Trump stays healthy, avoids impeachment, and runs again, the last thing he would want in 2019 and 2020 is sharply higher interest rates, an untimely rise in unemployment, and a likely price collapse in his beautiful stock market.

zh: 如果发生动荡，美联储颇为自负的独立性可能比大部分人所认识到的更加脆弱。
en: In a crunch, the Fed’s much-vaunted independence could prove more fragile than most people realize.

zh: 美联储独立性没有写进美国宪法，总统和国会都有一定的控制权。
en: It is not enshrined in the US Constitution, and the president and Congress maintain several levers of control.

zh: 1913年，国会建立的美联储，原则上国会也可以对它进行改制，大幅提高国会监督或收紧它的资金。
en: An act of Congress created the Fed in 1913, and in principle Congress could revamp it, say, by greatly increasing congressional oversight, or by starving it of funding.

zh: 事实上，历史上国会经常会讨论这么做的立法。
en: Indeed, from time to time bills have floated around Congress that would have done just that.

zh: 如今，美联储任命被视为好比是特朗普宇宙的总管。
en: For now, Fed appointees have been treated almost as well as generals in the Trump universe.

zh: 诚然，在赤字高企、2020年总统竞选日益临近的情况下，考验时刻就在眼前。
en: True, with ballooning deficits and the approach of the 2020 election campaign, testing times lie ahead.

zh: 但目前而言，还是让我们承认这是到目前为止特朗普总统生涯中大体正常的领域。
en: But for now, let’s acknowledge that this is one area where the Trump presidency has been almost normal – so far.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的外交政策挑战
en: Donald Trump’s Foreign-Policy Challenges

zh: 坎布里奇—在2016年美国总统选战中，当选总统唐纳德·特朗普对构成自由世界秩序基础的联盟和机构提出了质疑，但他并未提出具体的新政策。
en: CAMBRIDGE – During his campaign, US President-elect Donald Trump questioned the alliances and institutions that undergird the liberal world order, but he spelled out few specific policies.

zh: 也许他的胜利所引出的最重要的问题是，始于二战结束的漫长的全球化阶段是否实质终结。
en: Perhaps the most important question raised by his victory is whether the long phase of globalization that began at the end of World War II is essentially over.

zh: 未必如此。
en: Not necessarily.

zh: 即使跨太平洋合作伙伴关系（TPP）和TTIP等贸易协定失败、全球化速度减慢，技术仍然在推动生态、政治和社会全球化 — — 以气候变化、跨国恐怖主义和移民等形式 — — 不管特朗普是否喜欢。
en: Even if trade agreements like the Trans-Pacific Partnership and the Transatlantic Trade and Investment Partnership fail and economic globalization slows, technology is promoting ecological, political, and social globalization in the form of climate change, transnational terrorism, and migration – whether Trump likes it or not.

zh: 世界秩序不仅只限于经济，而美国仍然是它的核心。
en: World order is more than just economics, and the United States remains central to it.

zh: 美国人常常误解我们在世界中的地位。
en: Americans frequently misunderstand our place in the world.

zh: 我们在扬威论和衰落论之间摇摆。
en: We oscillate between triumphalism and declinism.

zh: 1957年苏联发射人造卫星后，我们认为我们衰落了。
en: After the Soviets launched Sputnik in 1957, we believed we were in decline.

zh: 20世纪80年代，我们认为日本人有十英尺那么高。
en: In the 1980s, we thought the Japanese were ten feet tall.

zh: 2008年大衰退后，许多美国人错误地认为中国已经比美国更加强大。
en: In the aftermath of the Great Recession of 2008, many Americans mistakenly believed that China had become more powerful than the United States.

zh: 尽管特朗普在选战中大放厥词，但美国并未衰落。
en: Despite Trump’s campaign rhetoric, the US is not in decline.

zh: 拜移民所赐，美国是唯一一个到世纪中叶仍不需担心人口下降的主要发达国家；其能源进口依赖正在下降而不是升高；它站在影响本世纪的重要技术发展的最前沿（生物、纳米、信息等 ） ； 它的大学名列世界前茅。
en: Because of immigration, it is the only major developed country that will not suffer a demographic decline by mid-century; its dependence on energy imports is diminishing rather than rising; it is at the forefront of the major technologies (bio, nano, information) that will shape this century; and its universities dominate the world league tables.

zh: 许多重要问题将挤爆特朗普的外交政策日程，但其中一些问题最为重要 — — 即与中国和俄罗斯的大国关系，以及中东动荡。
en: Many important issues will crowd Trump’s foreign policy agenda, but a few key issues will likely dominate – namely great power relations with China and Russia and the turmoil in the Middle East.

zh: 强大的美军仍是解决所有这三个问题的必要条件，但不是充分条件。
en: A strong American military remains necessary but not sufficient to address all three.

zh: 保持欧洲和东亚军事平衡是美国影响力的重要源泉，但特朗普有一点是���的：控制民族主义人民组成的中东国家的内政将导致失败。
en: Maintaining the military balance in Europe and East Asia is an important source of American influence, but Trump is correct that trying to control the internal politics of nationalistic populations in the Middle East is a recipe for failure.

zh: 中东正在经历一系列复杂的革命，这些革命源于人为划定的后殖民地时代边界线、宗教派系斗争、以及联合国开发规划署的《阿拉伯人道发展报告 》 （ Arab Human Development Reports）中所描述的现代化迟迟无法实现。
en: The Middle East is undergoing a complex set of revolutions stemming from artificial post-colonial boundaries; religious sectarian strife, and the delayed modernization described in the United Nations’ Arab Human Development Reports.

zh: 由此导致的动荡可能会持续数十年，并将继续培养激进圣战恐怖主义。
en: The resulting turmoil may last for decades, and it will continue to feed radical jihadist terrorism.

zh: 欧洲在法国大革命后动荡了25年，外部势力的军事干预只能让局面更加糟糕。
en: Europe remained unstable for 25 years after the French Revolution, and military interventions by outside powers made things worse.

zh: 但是，即使中东能源进口有所减少，美国仍不能放弃中东，因为美国在以色列、核不扩散、人权等问题上都有重大利益。
en: But, even with reduced energy imports from the Middle East, the US cannot turn its back on the region, given its interests in Israel, non-proliferation, and human rights, among others.

zh: 叙利亚内战不仅仅是一场人道灾难；它也正在动摇整个地区和欧洲。
en: The civil war in Syria is not only a humanitarian disaster; it is also destabilizing the region and Europe as well.

zh: 美国无法忽视这些情况，但其政策应该是遏制，是通过推进和强化我们的盟友影响结果，而不是直接军事控制，后者成本既高，还可能适得其反。
en: The US cannot ignore such events, but its policy should be one of containment, influencing outcomes by nudging and reinforcing our allies, rather than trying to assert direct military control, which would be both costly and counterproductive.

zh: 相反，亚洲地区力量平衡使我们在那里大受欢迎。
en: In contrast, the regional balance of power in Asia makes the US welcome there.

zh: 中国的崛起让印度、日本、越南和其他国家日益担心。
en: The rise of China has fueled concern in India, Japan, Vietnam, and other countries.

zh: 管理（managing）中国的全球崛起是本世纪外交政策的重大挑战之一，美国跨党派的“融合但保证 ” （ integrate but insure）双轨战略 — — 美国邀请中国加入自由世界秩序，同时重申与日本的安全条约 — — 仍然是正确方针。
en: Managing China’s global rise is one of this century’s great foreign-policy challenges, and America’s bipartisan dual-track strategy of “integrate but insure” – under which the US invited China to join the liberal world order, while reaffirming its security treaty with Japan – remains the right approach.

zh: 一个世纪前，德国崛起（到1900年时已经超越英国）所引起的恐慌促成了1914年的大灾难，与此不同的是，中国在总力量上尚无法超越美国。
en: Unlike a century ago, when a rising Germany (which had surpassed Britain by 1900) stoked fears that helped precipitate the disaster of 1914, China is not about to pass us in overall power.

zh: 即使其经济总量到2030年或2040年超越美国，其人均收入（衡量经济成熟度的更好的指标）仍将落后。
en: Even if China’s economy surpasses America’s in total size by 2030 or 2040, its per capita income (a better measure of an economy’s sophistication) will lag.

zh: 此外，中国的军事“硬实力”和吸引力“软实力”也无法与美国并驾齐驱。
en: Moreover, China will not equal US military “hard power” or its “soft power” of attraction.

zh: 李光耀曾说，只要美国保持开放并吸引世界人才，中国将“让你发财”但不会取代美国。
en: As Lee Kuan Yew once said, so long as the US remains open and attracts the talents of the world, China will “give you a run for your money,” but will not replace the US.

zh: 出于这些原因，美国不需要遏制中国的政策。
en: For these reasons, the US does not need a policy of containment of China.

zh: 唯一一个可以遏制中国的国家就是中国。
en: The only country that can contain China is China.

zh: 当中国与掀起邻国的领土冲突时，它就遏制了它自己。
en: As it presses its territorial conflicts with neighbors, China contains itself.

zh: 美国需要开展东南亚经济项目，重申其与日本和韩国的联盟关系，并继续改善与印度的关系。
en: The US needs to launch economic initiatives in Southeast Asia, reaffirm its alliances with Japan and Korea, and continue to improve relations with India.

zh: 最后是俄罗斯，这是一个衰落中的国家，但其核武库仍足以摧毁美国 — — 从而仍然是美国和其他国家的潜在威胁。
en: Finally, there is Russia, a country in decline, but with a nuclear arsenal sufficient to destroy the US – and thus still a potential threat to America and others.

zh: 俄罗斯几乎完全依赖能源资源收入，属于“单一作物经济 ” ， 机构腐败，人口和卫生问题积重难返。
en: Russia, almost entirely dependent on revenues from its energy resources, is a “one crop economy” with corrupt institutions and insurmountable demographic and health problems.

zh: 总统普京对邻国和中东的干预，及其针对美国和其他国家的网络攻击，虽然本意是让俄罗斯看上去重新强大起来，但从长期看只能让俄罗斯的长期前景更加恶化。
en: President Vladimir Putin’s interventions in neighboring countries and the Middle East, and his cyber attacks on the US and others, though intended to make Russia look great again, merely worsen the country’s long-term prospects.

zh: 不过，在短期，衰落的国家常常会更多地冒险，因此变得更加危险 — — 1914年的奥匈帝国即是明证。
en: In the short run, however, declining countries often take more risks and are thus more dangerous – witness the Austro-Hungarian Empire in 1914.

zh: 这就形成了一个政治两难。
en: This has created a policy dilemma.

zh: 一方面，抵御普京对1945年后自有秩序禁止国家动用武力从邻国攫取领土的规定的践踏十分重要。
en: On the one hand, it is important to resist Putin’s game-changing challenge to the post-1945 liberal order’s prohibition on the use of force by states to seize territory from their neighbors.

zh: 与此同时，特朗普正确地提出要避免完全孤立一个在诸多方面 — — 包括核安全、核不扩散、反恐、北冰洋以及伊朗核阿富汗等地区问题 — — 与美国利益重叠的国家。
en: At the same time, Trump is correct to avoid the complete isolation of a country with which the US has overlapping interests when it comes to nuclear security, non-proliferation, anti-terrorism, the Arctic, and regional issues like Iran and Afghanistan.

zh: 金融和能源制裁是威慑的必要条件；但美国必须与俄罗斯做交易，这样才有利于我们的一些真正的利益。
en: Financial and energy sanctions are necessary for deterrence; but we also have genuine interests that are best advanced by dealing with Russia.

zh: 掀起新冷战对任何人都没有好处。
en: No one would gain from a new Cold War.

zh: 美国没有衰落。
en: The US is not in decline.

zh: 特朗普最紧迫的外交政策任务是调整他的口风，向盟友和其他人保证我们仍将继续充当自由世界秩序的核心角色。
en: The immediate foreign-policy task for Trump will be to adjust his rhetoric and reassure allies and others of America’s continuing role in the liberal world order.

zh: 唐纳德国王的疯狂
en: The Madness of King Donald

zh: 华盛顿 — — 美国首都已经近乎陷入恐慌。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – Much of America’s capital has entered a state of near-panic.

zh: 最近几天，唐纳德·特朗普总统比以往任何时候都更加怪异，尽管很少明说，但政治家和民众藏在心里的问题一直是：我们可以对这个人做些什么？
en: In recent days, President Donald Trump has been acting more bizarrely than ever, and the question raised in the mind of politicians and civilians alike, though rarely spoken aloud, has been: What can be done with this man?

zh: 美国是否真的可以静候罗伯特·穆勒特别检察官结束调查（基于他会发现总统犯有某种罪行的假设 ） ？
en: Can the United States really afford to wait for Special Counsel Robert Mueller to wrap up his investigation (on the assumption that he’ll find the president guilty of something)?

zh: 这可能还需要等待很久。
en: That could still take quite a while.

zh: 鉴于美国有意或无意与朝鲜爆发战争的危险加剧，时机问题已经变得越来越紧迫。
en: The question of timing has become increasingly urgent, given the heightened danger that the US will deliberately or accidentally end up in a war with North Korea.

zh: 这种风险，加之特朗普越来越奇特的行为，已经导致华盛顿的紧张情绪超过包括水门事件那段黑暗时期在内的以往任何时候。
en: That risk, coupled with Trump’s increasingly peculiar behavior, has made Washington more tense than I’ve ever known it to be, and that includes the dark days of Watergate.

zh: 坦率地说：人们担心这位精神错乱的总统可能导致美国陷入核战争当中。
en: To put it bluntly: the worry is that a mentally deranged president might lead the US into a nuclear war.

zh: 就在上周，特朗普精神状态不稳的证据已经堆积如山了。
en: In just the past week, evidence of Trump’s instability has piled up.

zh: 在表彰美国二战本土英雄的椭圆形办公室纪念仪式上，他发表的种族主义言论激怒了接受表彰的英雄。
en: During an Oval Office ceremony to honor Native-American heroes of World War II, he offended them by issuing a racist comment.

zh: 他史无前例而且毫无必要地因为转发英国新法西斯集团的反穆斯林言论而挑衅英国首相，而英国首相本应是美国最亲密的盟友。
en: He picked an unprecedented and unnecessary fight with the prime minister of the United Kingdom, supposedly America’s closest ally, by retweeting a British neo-fascist group’s anti-Muslim posts.

zh: 为争取赢得一名民主党参议员对其待决减税法案的投票，他专程前往这名参议员所在的州并就她的过往历史说谎（虽然减税方案如此偏向美国前百分之一的最富裕人群，以至于没有任何民主党参议员为其投票 ） 。
en: In an effort to win a Democratic senator’s vote for his pending tax-cut bill, he traveled to her state and told lies about her record (though the tax bill was so tilted to the richest 1% of Americans that no Democratic senator voted for it).

zh: 而且他继续引诱朝鲜领导人金正恩，后者似乎同样处于不稳定的状态下。
en: And he continued to bait North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, who seems equally unstable.

zh: 与此同时，华盛顿邮报和纽约时报都刊登了总统私人行为令人不安的相关报道。
en: At the same time, both the Washington Post and The New York Times ran articles containing disturbing stories about the president’s private behavior.

zh: 据报导，特朗普曾告诉与他关系亲密的人他认为记录了他在镜头之外开玩笑抓住女性生殖器的臭名昭著的“接触好莱坞”的影像资料是一场骗局，尽管他在总统竞选活动最后几周华盛顿邮报发表这篇文章时曾承认其真实性并为此道歉了。
en: Trump, it was reported, told people close to him that he considers the infamous “Access Hollywood”recording of him joking, off-camera, about grabbing women’s genitals to be a fraud, even though he admitted its authenticity and apologized after the Post released it in the final weeks of the presidential campaign.

zh: 特朗普也在不断重提巴拉克·奥巴马并非美国出生的虚假言论 — — 恰恰是依靠这样的虚假指控他才开启了自己的政治生涯，因为承受不住来自顾问的压力，他在大选之前就已经放弃了这一说法。
en: Trump has also been revisiting his mendacious claim about Barack Obama having not been born in the US – the bogus allegation that launched his political career, which, under pressure from advisers, he’d renounced prior to the election.

zh: 他在一篇推文中表示他曾拒绝了时代杂志提名他为“年度人物”的建议，因为最终这一建议能否成行是不确定的。
en: He said in a tweet that he had turned down Time magazine’s suggestion that it would name him “Person of the Year,” because it wasn’t definite.

zh: （特朗普对在时代封面上的露面机会是极为珍视的 ） 。
en: (Trump sets great store by such appearances on Time’s cover).

zh: 但据一名时代杂志官员透露这样的事从未发生过。
en: But a Time official said that no such thing had occurred.

zh: 特朗普似乎患有一种或几种精神障碍的事实导致精神科医生、政客和记者陷入两难的选择。
en: The fact that Trump appears to have some mental disorder, or disorders, has created a dilemma for psychiatrists, politicians, and journalists alike.

zh: 美国精神病协会规定其成员不得在没有进行过检查的情况下对病人作出诊断。
en: The American Psychiatric Association has a rule that its members may not offer diagnoses of people they have not examined.

zh: 但鉴于某些精神病学家将此视为全国紧急情况，导致许多人已经打破规则公开谈论或撰文记录他们对特朗普精神状态的专业评估。
en: But, given what some psychiatrists see as a national emergency, many have broken the rule and spoken or written publicly about their professional assessments of Trump’s mental state.

zh: 最被人广为接受的观点是他患有自恋型人格障碍，这种障碍比普通自恋要严重的多。
en: The most widely accepted view is that he suffers from a narcissistic personality disorder, which is far more serious than simply being a narcissist.

zh: 按照梅约诊所的说法，这种疾病的特点是“患者对其自身重要性的认识严重膨胀，从心底里需要过度的关注和敬佩、与身边人的关系错乱并缺乏对他人的同情心。
en: According to the Mayo Clinic, such a disorder “is a mental condition in which people have an inflated sense of their own importance, a deep need for excessive attention and admiration, troubled relationships, and a lack of empathy for others.”

zh: ”此外 ， “ 在这种极度自信的表象背后所隐藏的脆弱的自尊心容易受到最轻微的批评的影响。 ”
en: Moreover, “behind this mask of extreme confidence lies a fragile self-esteem that’s vulnerable to the slightest criticism.”

zh: 这个定义完全贴合特朗普经常展示的人格特征。
en: This definition is all too reflective of traits that Trump regularly exhibits.

zh: 基于特朗普在20世纪80年代末接受采访时的讲话和他现在讲话的对比 — — 词汇量大大缩小且流利程度要低得多 — — 还有几位医学专业人士所持的另外一种观点是总统患有早期痴呆症。
en: Another view held by a number of medical professionals, based on how Trump spoke in interviews in the late 1980s and how he speaks now – with a far more limited vocabulary and much less fluency – is that the president is suffering from the onset of dementia.

zh: 据一本由医学专业订阅人员出资、广受尊敬的医学参考杂志UpToDate显示，痴呆的症状包括激动、侵略性、妄想、幻觉、冷漠或失控。
en: According to the highly respected medical reference UpToDate, a subscription-financed service used by professionals, the symptoms of dementia include agitation, aggression, delusions, hallucinations, apathy, and disinhibition.

zh: 众多国会共和党议员非常担忧特朗普总统的执政能力 — — 总统这份工作要求越来越高。
en: Numerous Republican members of Congress are deeply worried about Trump’s capacity to handle the presidency – an incredibly demanding job.

zh: 据说很快就会被取代的国务卿雷克斯·蒂勒森曾用“白痴”一词来形容特朗普。
en: Secretary of State Rex Tillerson, rumored to be replaced soon, is said to have called Trump a “moron.”

zh: 近日特朗普的反常行为日益严重应当被归结为因为穆勒针对特朗普及其竞选活动可能与俄罗斯相勾结，并由俄罗斯出面争取对其有利的2016年选举结果的调查所引发的焦虑情绪越来越强烈 — — 这样的调查可能导致被控共谋罪。
en: Trump’s heightened erratic behavior in recent days has been attributed to his growing anxiety about Mueller’s investigation into his and his campaign’s possible collusion with Russia in the Kremlin’s effort to tilt the 2016 election in his direction – an investigation that could end in a charge of conspiracy.

zh: （特朗普似乎是不接受俄罗斯干预大选的华盛顿唯一一位重要人物。
en: (Trump appears to be the only significant figure in Washington who won’t accept that Russia interfered.)

zh: ）特朗普行为越来越怪异甚至是发生在12月1日有消息确认特朗普首位国家安全顾问兼亲密竞选助理退休将军迈克尔·弗林同意向法庭承认曾向联邦调查局说谎，以换取他配合调查之前的事。
en: And that increasingly bizarre behavior came even before the news broke, on December 1, that Trump’s first national security adviser and close campaign aide, retired General Michael Flynn, had agreed to plead guilty to one count of lying to the FBI in exchange for his cooperation with the investigation.

zh: 这一事件极其重要，是因为弗林绝对是穆勒成功策反的曾担任官员的最高级别人士。
en: What made this highly significant was that Flynn is far and away the highest former official whom Mueller has “flipped.”

zh: 事实上，慷慨的认罪协议已经表明弗林已经准备供出竞选活动和白宫中比他更重要的人物。
en: Indeed, the generous plea deal makes it clear that Flynn is prepared to name figures higher than he was in the campaign and the White House.

zh: 这样的人没有几个。
en: That’s not very many people.

zh: 人们有理由推测弗林将供出特朗普的女婿兼高级顾问贾里德·库什纳。
en: It has already been speculated, with reason, that Flynn will point a finger at Trump’s son-in-law and senior adviser, Jared Kushner.

zh: 但特朗普之前曾数次努力让检查人员放过弗林的事实已经发出强烈的信号，弗林知道特朗普拼命想要向检查人员掩盖的一些事。
en: But Trump’s several earlier efforts to steer prosecutors away from Flynn were strong signals that Flynn knows something that Trump desperately hopes that prosecutors won’t find out.

zh: 我们可能很快就会知道究竟是什么事。
en: We may learn what that is fairly soon.

zh: 与此同时，美国和全世界民众都在焦急地等待特朗普将对最近事件的糟糕进展采取何种对策。
en: Meanwhile, American and the world nervously await Trump’s reaction to this latest very bad turn of events for him.

zh: 不称职的年代
en: The Age of Incompetence

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 2017年1月20日，美国总统当选人唐纳德·特朗普就将上任。 作为总统，他的得票数比对手少了近300万票；而与他一同工作的参议院共和党多数派的总得票数又比民主党参议员要少1300万票。
en: BERKELEY – On January 20, 2017, US President-elect Donald Trump will take office having received almost three million fewer votes than his opponent; and he will work with a Republican Senate majority whose members won 13 million fewer votes than their Democratic opponents.

zh: 只有议长保罗·瑞恩（Paul Ryan）率领的众议院共和党团多数人赢得了数量上的多数，代表了在2016年选举日投票的美国人中的55 ％ 。
en: Only the Republican majority in the House of Representatives, led by Speaker Paul Ryan, has any claim to represent a numerical majority of the 55% of Americans who voted on Election Day 2016.

zh: 特朗普还将在支持率低于50％的情况下开始自己的总统任期。
en: Trump will also begin his presidency with an approval rating below 50%.

zh: 而这个支持率也是前所未有的 — — 或者如特朗普的白字推文（随后被删除了）所说的那样，是“不总统的（unpresidented ） ” 。
en: This is unprecedented – or “unpresidented,” as one of his semi-literate tweets put it (before he deleted it) – in the history of such ratings.

zh: 美国这个世界上最古老的民主政府，原来是不民主的。
en: The government of the world’s oldest democracy is, in fact, not democratic.

zh: 另一个前所未见的事实是，在特朗普是否够资格担任总统这个问题上，总统所属党派中只有很少成员表示赞同，对手民主党更是全数反对，大家都觉得他更适合当一名啦啦队长。
en: Also unprecedented is the fact that so few members of the president-elect’s own party, and none of the Democratic opposition, consider him to be qualified for the duties of the presidency, apart from serving as Cheerleader-in-Chief.

zh: 当然，特朗普现象并非一日之功。
en: Of course, the Trump phenomenon has been gestating for a long period.

zh: 除了令人尊敬的老布什之外，上一位具备必要的知识，智慧，气质和价值观的共和党人总统已经是1957年的事情了。
en: With the honorable exception of George H.W. Bush, who had the requisite knowledge, intelligence, temperament, and values to serve, the last time a fully qualified Republican was inaugurated was in 1957.

zh: 没有人否认理查德·尼克松具被担任总统所需的知识和智慧；但大多数人会承认他在气质和价值观上都有所欠缺。
en: No one denies that Richard Nixon had the knowledge and intelligence to be president; but most people will admit that his temperament and values left something to be desired.

zh: 同样，大多数人认为罗纳德·里根缺乏执政必备的知识和智慧。
en: Similarly, most people thought that Ronald Reagan lacked the requisite knowledge and intelligence for the office.

zh: 据记者彼得·詹金斯（Peter Jenkins）记载，英国前首相撒切尔夫人曾经评论里根说 ： “ 这个可怜的家伙没什么脑子 ” 。
en: According to the journalist Peter Jenkins, former British Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher once said of Reagan, “Poor dear, there’s nothing between his ears.”

zh: 而在上任69天后遭刺杀受伤后，里根在就职时表现的总统资质也随着时间的推移而逐渐泯灭，而情况在他罹患阿尔茨海默病后则变得更加糟糕。
en: And the qualifications that Reagan did have on Inauguration Day eroded over time, after he was wounded in a failed assassination attempt 69 days into his presidency, and, later, when he began to suffer from Alzheimer’s disease.

zh: 然而里根的气质和价值观（总的来说）非常适合当总统。
en: Still, Reagan’s temperament and values (generally speaking) were well suited to the presidency.

zh: 他完全明白身居顶峰并不意味着自己就是老板。
en: He fully understood that being the star did not mean that he was the boss.

zh: 作为好莱坞演员和美国总统，里根拥有一批聪明，专注和训练有素的专业人员来为​​他的攥写演讲辞并指导其一举一动。
en: Both as a Hollywood actor and as a US president, Reagan had smart, dedicated, and trained professionals writing his lines and directing his moves.

zh: 他知道自己的工作是在屏幕上做好表演，最好不要干扰摄影机机背后以及后期制作编辑室里那些决定最终出品的人。
en: He knew that his job was to be on screen, and not to interfere with the people behind the camera and in the post-production editing room, who were responsible for the finished product.

zh: 而这也是小布什在2001年上任时大多数观察家所希望看到的样子：一个随和谦逊，愿意在那些父亲留下来的优秀顾问团队的指导下行事的啦啦队长。
en: This is what most observers expected to see when George W. Bush took office in 2001: a folksy cheerleader who would follow the lead of the wise advisers he had inherited from his father.

zh: 但是在年轻的小布什的眼中他不仅是个站在台前的明星，还得是个“决策者 ” 。
en: But the younger Bush came to think of himself not just as the star, but as “the decider,” too.

zh: 虽然副总统迪克·切尼和国防部长唐纳德·拉姆斯菲尔德在1970年代一直表现成熟老道，但他们在21世纪初就变得不靠谱了。
en: And while Vice President Dick Cheney and Secretary of Defense Donald Rumsfeld had been savvy policymakers back in the 1970s, they had become rather erratic by the early 2000s.

zh: 无论出于何种原因，小布什与两个人结盟决定了他的命运。
en: For whatever reason, Bush bonded with the two, which sealed his fate.

zh: 他自离任以来就没有出席过任何一届共和党全国会议，或许他一直在悔恨，后悔不该在2000年11月派自己的总法律顾问詹姆斯·贝克（James Baker）去佛罗里达州运作重新计票，这样当总统的人就会是阿尔·戈尔了。
en: He has not attended any Republican National Conventions since leaving office, and he may wish that he had he never sent James Baker to Florida in November 2000 to secure his victory over Al Gore.

zh: 特朗普显然未能从小布什那中吸取任何教训。
en: Trump clearly has not taken any lessons from the second Bush presidency.

zh: 他知道自己是明星，但也错误地自认有足够的知识和智慧来担任成为老板。
en: He knows that he is the star, but he also wrongly believes that he has the knowledge and intelligence to be the boss.

zh: 他似乎尚未意识到大选已经结束了，而自己可能在新的总统角色中遭遇突然且永久的挫折，与此同时最符合他自身利益的东西不是那些口号式的提案，而是能为美国带来安全和繁荣的实实在在的政策。
en: He seems unaware that his campaign is over, that he could fail catastrophically and permanently in his new role, and that it is in his own interest to ensure that his proposals are sound, not just as slogans, but as actual policies that will keep the US safe and create prosperity.

zh: 那么，那些对未来感到恐惧的数百万美国人如今该如何是好？
en: So, what should the millions of Americans who now fear for the future do?

zh: 首先，我们可以在州一级开展工作，想方设法去减少任何有缺陷或不可行的特朗普政策提案的影响。
en: First, we can work at the state level to try to neutralize any Trump policy initiatives that are flawed or infeasible.

zh: 国家立法机构中的民主党人和那些有原则的共和党人需要共同努力，不管华盛顿特区发生了什么，都要确保税收收入的流转并以此资助许多符合美国利益的支出项目。
en: Democrats and principled Republicans in state legislatures need to work together to keep tax revenues flowing and to fund the many spending programs that are in the American interest, regardless of what is happening in Washington, DC.

zh: 他们应该相互承诺，不管谁在2021年上台，他们不会互相为当前作为破坏者的角色而互相指责。
en: And they should promise each other that, regardless of who comes to power in 2021, they will not hold each other liable for acting as disruptors today.

zh: 而在国家层面，我们应该不断提醒共和党参议员他们的选民人数比民主党少了1300万。
en: At the national level, we should constantly remind Senate Republicans that they speak for 13 million fewer voters than the Democrats do.

zh: 我们应该提醒保罗·瑞安，他在2001~08年间追随与小布什政府经济和外交政策提案的做法是个错误，而对一个显然不称职的政府表示无条件支持的做法就是对国家的背叛。
en: And we should remind Paul Ryan that he made a mistake by going along with the Bush administration’s discredited economic and foreign-policy initiatives between 2001 and 2008, and that it is a disservice to the country to show unconditional partisan support for an administration that is so obviously unfit.

zh: 如果这一切努力都告失败，我们也应该记住，与一个比他的对手少了近300万票的不受欢迎的总统做斗争不仅是件正确的事情；也会成为一场伟大的现实电视直播秀。
en: And, if all else fails, we should remember that standing up to an unpopular president who received almost three million fewer votes than his opponent is not just the right thing to do; it will also make for great reality TV.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普的中东选择
en: Donald Trump’s Choices in the Middle East

zh: 特拉维夫—美国当选总统唐纳德·特朗普说了很多关于外交事务的讲话，但从来没有触及实质。
en: TEL AVIV – US President-elect Donald Trump has said a lot about foreign affairs, without really saying anything at all.

zh: 他虚与委蛇的发言几乎完全没有透露他将采取怎样的外交政策，也没有多少理由可以相信，当他的方针变得明确时，我们将看到美国 — — 或者说全世界—正需要的政策。
en: His muddled statements offer little insight into what kind of foreign policy he will actually pursue, and there is not much reason to believe that, when his approach does become clear, it will be what the United States – or the world – needs.

zh: 特朗普是一名商人，而不是一名政治家。
en: Trump is a businessman, not a statesman.

zh: 他的思维是有多少利润和损失会立刻兑现 — — 他宣布美国的盟友需要为安全联盟做出更大贡献便是这一世界观的明证。
en: He thinks in terms of immediate profits and losses – a worldview that is exemplified in his declarations that US allies need to contribute more to security alliances.

zh: 在挑战不断变化、威胁日益严峻的时代，坚持这一狭隘的孤立主义方针无法给任何人带来好处。
en: At a time of evolving challenges and growing threats, adhering to this narrow-minded, isolationist approach is unlikely to do anyone much good.

zh: 一个特朗普无法忽视的地区是中东。
en: One region that Trump will not be able to ignore is the Middle East.

zh: 特别是叙利亚危机将让美国深陷其中，但特朗普的选择十分有限。
en: The crisis in Syria, in particular, will draw the US in, though Trump’s choices there are limited.

zh: 毕竟，美国的“温和”圣战主义盟友绝不比叙利亚总统巴沙尔·阿萨德更加“可人 ” ， 而所谓的伊斯兰国也还远远没有消灭。
en: After all, America’s “moderate” jihadist allies are no more palatable than President Bashar al-Assad, and the so-called Islamic State is far from defeated.

zh: 前纽约市长、特朗普亲信顾问、有可能进入特朗普内阁的朱利安尼（Rudy Giuliani）将消灭伊斯兰国定义为特朗普政府第一外交要务。
en: Former New York City Mayor Rudy Giuliani, a close Trump adviser and possible member of Trump’s cabinet, has identified defeating ISIS as the administration’s first foreign-policy priority.

zh: 特朗普宣称他“比将军们更加了解伊斯兰国。
en: Trump has claimed that he knows “more about ISIS than the generals do.”

zh: ”但这根本不可能。
en: But that is unlikely.

zh: 毕竟。 彻底消灭一个从混乱中崛起的运动的唯一办法是构建强大称职的国家，特朗普既没有计划，也没有耐心这样做。
en: After all, the only way fully to defeat a movement that thrives amid chaos is to build strong and competent states, a task for which Trump lacks both the inclination and the patience.

zh: 如果特朗普选择纯军事干预，他将发现每一场“胜利”都会给更多的暴力和恐怖制造空间。
en: If Trump opts for a purely military approach, he will find that every “victory” merely creates space for more violence and terror.

zh: 尽管美国领导的联军相继收复拉卡和摩苏尔能够改善美国在其逊尼派盟友中的地位，但也缓解了俄罗斯—伊朗—真主党轴心的压力。
en: While the conquest of Raqqa and Mosul by a US-led military campaign would improve America’s standing among its Sunni allies, it would also relieve pressure on the Russia-Iran-Hezbollah axis.

zh: 伊斯兰国撤出后，伊朗所支持的什叶派军阀将血洗摩苏尔的逊尼派社区。
en: Iran-backed Shia militias would unleash a killing spree against Sunni communities in Mosul after ISIS withdrew.

zh: 持续动荡以及逊尼派所收到的压力将助长更多恐怖主义，不管它们是与伊斯兰国牵扯在一起还是全新集团。
en: The ensuing turmoil and pressure on Sunni populations would fuel more terrorism, whether associated with ISIS or with entirely new groups.

zh: 不管特朗普在叙利亚采取何种方针，都必定会受到俄罗斯总统普京的影响。
en: Whatever tack Trump takes in Syria, it will surely be influenced by Russian President Vladimir Putin.

zh: 特朗普必须降低美国在叙利亚战争中对俄罗斯的依赖程度，以遏制普京利用其对叙利亚的影响力赢得在乌克兰问题上的筹码。
en: Trump must cut America’s dependence on Russia in the Syria war, in order to resist Putin’s efforts to use his influence in Syria to gain leverage with regard to Ukraine.

zh: 当然，特朗普是否愿意挑战他曾经表达过敬仰之情的普京仍不确定。
en: Of course, Trump’s willingness to challenge Putin, for whom the president-elect has voiced admiration, is uncertain.

zh: 但美国的安全和军事建制派，以及约翰·麦凯恩（John McCain）等共和党参议员不可能允许特朗普在叙利亚和乌克兰俯首帖耳，导致“俄罗斯复兴 ” 。
en: But America’s security and military establishment, together with Republican senators like John McCain, are unlikely to allow Trump to “Make Russia Great Again” by surrendering both Syria and Ukraine.

zh: 在乌克兰屈服便足以俄罗斯在所谓的“影响力范围”耀武扬威，甚至有可能导致北约解体。
en: The surrender of Ukraine alone would embolden Russia to reassert itself in its supposed “sphere of influence,” potentially causing NATO to come apart.

zh: 从选战中的言辞看，特朗普可能并不担心北约或任何美国安全联盟的解体，至少目前如此。
en: Judging by his campaign statements, Trump might not be worried about the unraveling of NATO – or of any US security alliance, at least not yet.

zh: 但结果可能是灾难性的，因为缺少美国的安全保证和结构可能刺激核扩散。
en: But the results could be disastrous, not least because a lack of US security guarantees and structures could spur nuclear proliferation.

zh: 特朗普承诺中止伊朗核协议尤其令人担忧。
en: Trump’s promise to suspend the Iran nuclear deal is particularly worrying.

zh: 伊朗已经准备了一个强大的代理人 — — 真主党，正是为了在反击伊朗的敌人利用这样的时机。
en: Iran has prepared Hezbollah to be a powerful proxy for precisely those occasions when it needs to strike back at Iran’s enemies.

zh: 此外，中止核协议将导致伊朗立刻成为核力量。
en: Moreover, suspending the nuclear deal would cause Iran to become a nuclear power in no time.

zh: 在一个不存在集体安全安排的地区，恐怖组织可以轻易得到自己的原始核设施。
en: In a region with no collective security architecture, terrorist groups could easily acquire their own primitive nuclear devices.

zh: 因此，美国在中东的疏远盟友 — — 沙特阿拉伯、埃及和以色列 — — 的上策是不再反对伊朗核协议，转而鼓励特朗普保证核协议的实施。
en: Given this, America’s estranged allies in the Middle East – Saudi Arabia, Egypt, and Israel – would be well advised to drop their opposition to the Iran deal, and instead encourage Trump to keep it in place.

zh: 类似地，特朗普承诺减少向外国盟友提供资金，以此作为“美国第一”整体战略的一部分，这可能让它们对他当选总统感到不悦。
en: Likewise, Trump’s promise to reduce funding to foreign allies, as part of a broader “America first” strategy, should be tempering their joy at his victory.

zh: 另一个可能影响特朗普在中东的选择的疏远盟友是土耳其。 最近几个月中，土耳其与俄罗斯的关系有所缓和。
en: Another estranged ally that could shape Trump’s choices in the Middle East is Turkey, which has pursued something of a détente with Russia in recent months.

zh: 为了挽救双边关系，特朗普必须牺牲与库尔德人的合作。 叙利亚和伊拉克的库尔德武装是美国在摩苏尔和拉卡战事中最可靠的盟友。
en: To salvage the bilateral relationship, Trump would have to sacrifice America’s partnership with the Kurds, whose militias in Syria and Iraq have been America’s most reliable allies in the battles for Mosul and Raqqa.

zh: 土耳其埃尔多安也许也想消灭伊斯兰国，但他更想遏制库尔德人自治的野心。
en: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan may want ISIS defeated, but he wants to quell the Kurds’ ambitions of self-rule even more.

zh: 为了报答库尔德人的帮助而支持他们建国对埃尔多安来说是不可接受的，为了阻止这一幕发生，他甚至可以阻止消灭伊斯兰国。
en: Rewarding the Kurds for their help by backing their bid for statehood would be so unacceptable that, to prevent it, Erdoğan might even try to thwart the defeat of ISIS.

zh: 此外还有来自伊拉克、叙利亚和伊朗的反对，显然库尔德独立不再选择项之中。
en: Add to that opposition from Iraq, Syria, and Iran, and it is clear that Kurdish independence is not in the cards.

zh: 但巴勒斯坦建国应该成为一个选择项。
en: Palestinian statehood, however, should be.

zh: 特朗普以其反复无常的风格对此发表了很多言论，助长了一些巴勒斯坦人的希望，认为特朗普当选将有利于巴勒斯坦。
en: In his own erratic way, Trump has said as much, fueling hopes among some Palestinians that his election could end up working in their favor.

zh: 但以色列狂热的定居者的印象正好相反，他们认为特朗普胜选是在巴勒斯坦土地上无限制扩张定居点的通行证。
en: But Israel’s fanatic settler movement has the opposite impression, viewing Trump’s victory as a license for the unrestrained expansion of settlements in Palestinian lands.

zh: 最终，特朗普如何打好美国在以巴冲突中的手牌 — — 美国拥有不可或缺的影响力的唯一一个中东问题 — — 可能取决于当事方之间发生了什么。
en: In the end, how Trump uses US leverage in the Israel-Palestine conflict – the only issue in the Middle East where the US enjoys such indisputable influence – might depend on events on the ground.

zh: 具体而言，如果定居点建设风潮大幅扩张，那么最终很可能引发特别激烈的第三次巴勒斯塔起义。
en: Specifically, a settlement-building spree might end up triggering a particularly fierce third Palestinian intifada.

zh: 但特朗普不能坐等危机推着他制定日程。
en: But Trump should not wait for a crisis to impose an agenda on him.

zh: 相反他应该认识到，自1948年以来，美国的逊尼派疏远盟友从未向现在那样有如此大的动机与以色列保持和平并与之展开地区安全合作，并且这样的安排只有在巴勒斯坦建国的情况下才能合理化。
en: Instead, he should recognize that now, more than at any time since 1948, America’s estranged Sunni allies have a strong incentive to make peace with Israel and collaborate with it on regional security, and that such an arrangement could be legitimate only with the creation of a Palestinian state.

zh: 由于这也有利于美国与阿拉伯民族的和解，童儿有利于美国国家安全利益，因此特朗普应该毫不犹豫地抓住机会。
en: Given that this would also support US reconciliation with the Arab peoples, thereby serving America’s national security interests, Trump should not hesitate to seize the initiative.

zh: 古罗马的唐纳德·特朗普
en: Ancient Rome’s Donald Trump

zh: 迪克拉，艾奥瓦—民粹主义在美国政治的历史悠久而丰富，从左翼的休·朗（Huey Long）到右翼的乔治·华莱士（George Wallace ） ， 再到 — — 更近一些 — — 1992年的罗斯·佩洛特（Ross Perot）和今天的唐纳德·特朗普。
en: DECORAH, IOWA – Populism has a long and colorful history in American politics, from Huey Long on the left and George Wallace on the right, to – more recently – Ross Perot in 1992 and Donald Trump today.

zh: 但民粹主义的根源历史要久远得多 — — 超过了两千年，发端于罗马共和国末期。
en: But the roots of populism stretch much further back in time – more than two millennia, to the beginning of the end of the Roman Republic.

zh: 在罗马共和国的大部分时间里，治国的都是老牌政治家族和知道怎样让民众安顺的可靠的权力掮客。
en: For most of its history, the Roman Republic was governed by old political families and reliable power brokers who knew how to keep the masses in line.

zh: 选举有之，但有意设计为让执政阶级获得群众选片的大部分。
en: Elections were held, but they were deliberately designed to give the ruling classes the lion’s share of the popular vote.

zh: 如果率先投票的罗马贵族已经选择了执政官，那么官员常常连下等阶层的投票箱都不愿意开启了。
en: If the Roman aristocracy, which voted first, chose a man for office, officials often would not even bother to count the ballots cast by the lower classes.

zh: 偶尔，心怀不满的农民、小酒馆老板和赶驴人也会愤起反抗，迫使统治者免除债务或者获得在政府发声的机会，但这些动乱很快就会通过承诺更美好的未来和雇用一些赋闲角斗士抓获首恶来平息。
en: On occasion, disgruntled farmers, tavern owners, and donkey drivers would rise up and press their rulers for debt relief and a real voice in government, but these revolts were put down quickly with promises of better times ahead and by hiring a few off-duty gladiators to rough up the chief troublemakers.

zh: 在公元前二世纪末，贵族格拉古兄弟试图从内部进行政治革命，结果被保守派贵族所杀。
en: In the late second century BC, the aristocratic Gracchi brothers tried to bring about a political revolution from within, only to be killed by the conservative nobility.

zh: 最终将这一体系推翻的是一位名叫普布利乌斯·克劳狄乌斯·普尔喀的贵族，他是腰缠万贯又野心勃勃的民粹主义煽动家，解决受规则摆布。
en: The man who ultimately brought down the system was a wealthy and ambitious nobleman named Publius Clodius Pulcher, a populist demagogue who refused to play by the rules.

zh: 克劳狄乌斯一贯剑走偏锋，不可捉摸，令罗马民众又惊又喜。
en: Clodius had always been eccentric and unpredictable in ways that both shocked and amused the Roman populace.

zh: 年轻时，他煽动内兄部队哗变。
en: As a young man, he had incited a mutiny among his brother-in-law’s troops.

zh: 接着，当他被海盗抓住时，由于海盗提出的赎金要求太低而令他勃然大怒。
en: Then, when pirates captured him, he took deep offense at the small ransom they accepted for his release.

zh: 对克劳狄乌斯来说，没有什么是神圣的。
en: Nothing was sacred to Clodius.

zh: 他的行为越是乖张，民众就越喜欢他。
en: The more audacious his behavior, the more the public loved him for it.

zh: 比如，克劳狄乌斯是罗马著名的妇女之友，他因为男扮女装混入只限女性参与的祭祀玻娜女神的宗教节日而犯下渎神罪行，他这样做的目的是勾引凯撒的妻子庞培娅。
en: In Rome, for example, Clodius, a noted ladies’ man, committed sacrilege by dressing up as a woman and infiltrating the female-only religious festival of the goddess Bona Dea, with the aim of seducing Pompeia, Julius Caesar’s wife.

zh: 这一丑闻导致凯撒和庞培娅离婚，并且催生了著名的俗语：凯撒的老婆必须无可置疑。
en: The scandal led Caesar to divorce Pompeia, and gave rise to the famous quip that Caesar’s wife needed to be beyond suspicion.

zh: 克劳狄乌斯通过组建庞大的法律团队和大肆贿赂逃脱了惩罚，接着，他进入政界，试图保证很快就将他鄙视为小丑的执政阶级的尊重。
en: After escaping punishment by employing a large legal team and doling out generous bribes, Clodius entered politics in an effort to secure the respect of the ruling class, which was quick to dismiss him as a buffoon.

zh: 克劳狄乌斯的批评者没有意识到他聪明、果断，并且充分利用了普通民众的不满。
en: What Clodius’s critics failed to realize was that he was smart, determined, and very much in touch with the frustrations of the common people.

zh: 在被精英阶层拒绝后，克劳狄乌斯开始在他追求权力的过程中打破一切规则。
en: After the elite rebuffed him, Clodius began breaking every rule in his quest for power.

zh: 他放弃了贵族身份，正式加入平民阶级，将自己定位为愤怒的罗马工人阶级的领袖。
en: He gave up his standing as a nobleman and officially joined the plebs, positioning himself as the leader of the angry Roman working classes.

zh: 利用天生的魅力、煽动的言辞和挑拨建制派政客的敏锐感觉，他强行通过了西方历史上首个定期免费派发小麦的立法。
en: Using his natural charm, fiery rhetoric, and keen sense of how to play establishment politicians against each other, he rammed through legislation establishing the first regular handout of free grain in Western history.

zh: 这让他获得了大量普通群众的追随，特别是在最近的经济动荡中失业的人。
en: This provided him with a huge following among the common people, especially those who had lost their jobs in recent economic upheavals.

zh: 他成为落马街头的国王，并发动了罗马共和国前所未见的民粹主义暴动。
en: He became the king of the Roman streets and unleashed a populist uprising unlike anything the Republic had ever seen.

zh: 罗马的执政阶级对于如何控制仍然被他们鄙视的克劳狄乌斯束手无策。
en: Rome’s ruling classes had no idea how to control Clodius, whom they continued to despise.

zh: 著名雄辩家、建制派政客西塞罗哀叹，如果共和国继续不遭到破坏， 那么至少让它毁在真正的男人手里。
en: If the Republic were going to be destroyed, the famous orator and establishment politician Cicero lamented, at least let it fall by the hand of a real man.

zh: 克劳狄乌斯对西塞罗的报复是将他驱逐，并实施爬上权力金字塔顶端的计划。
en: Exacting revenge, Clodius engineered Cicero’s exile and laid his plans to rise to the top of the political pyramid.

zh: 在谋求裁判官（地位仅次于罗马执政官的民选职位）过程中，选举两次中断，原因是普尔喀的追随者和他的对手安尼乌斯·麦洛派在街头斗殴。
en: During his campaign for the praetorship, an elected magistrate that ranked just below Rome’s ruling consuls, the elections had to be postponed twice because of fighting in the streets between his followers and the faction of his enemy, Annius Milo.

zh: 克劳狄乌斯在阿皮亚大道偶遇麦洛，结果引起双方卫兵之间的打斗，克劳狄乌斯身受重伤。
en: When Clodius happened to meet Milo along the Appian Way, a fight broke out between their guards, and Clodius was gravely wounded.

zh: 麦洛认识到，死去的对手威胁总比愤怒的活着的对手小，因此下令手下了结克劳狄乌斯。
en: Reckoning that a dead rival was less of a threat than a live and angry one, Milo ordered his men to finish him off.

zh: 但尽管克劳狄乌斯已经受戮，其所释放的民粹主义力量仍然充满活力，并且很快就有了新的领军人物，首屈一指的便是凯撒。
en: But though Clodius had been killed, the populist forces he unleashed remained very much alive, and they quickly found new champions, most notably Caesar.

zh: 执政阶级茫然而无助地眼看着他们掌控了几百年的国家从手中溜走。
en: The ruling classes stood by dazed and helpless as control of the state they had run for centuries slipped from their hands.

zh: 公元前49年，凯撒越国卢比孔河，掀起罗马内战。
en: In 49 BC, Caesar crossed the Rubicon, engulfing Rome in civil war.

zh: 凯撒在3月15日事变中被杀，随后发生的动乱彻底摧毁了执政阶级的权力。
en: Caesar’s murder on the Ides of March was followed by a revolt that destroyed, once and for all, the power of the ruling classes.

zh: 独裁帝国崛起，罗马共和国永远消失。
en: An autocratic Empire arose, and the Roman Republic vanished forever.

zh: 朝鲜的唐纳德·特朗普
en: The Donald Trump of North Korea

zh: 丹佛 — — 人人都说万众瞩目的朝鲜劳动党第七次代表大会结果令人失望。
en: DENVER – By all accounts, the much-anticipated Seventh Congress of the Workers’ Party of Korea was a non-event.

zh: 如果说35年来首次召开的朝鲜最高机构此类会议有任何影响的话，那就是浇灭了暴躁的国家领导人金正恩将注意力转向经济改革的任何希望。
en: If the first such meeting of North Korea’s highest organ in more than 35 years had any impact at all, it was to dash any hopes that the country’s irascible leader, Kim Jong-un, would turn his attention to economic reform.

zh: 金正恩竭尽全力避谈朝鲜经济混乱，他的所作所为向世界清楚地表明核计划才是朝鲜真正的骄傲。
en: In the time Kim spent avoiding discussing North Korea’s shambolic economy, he made it abundantly clear that the country’s real pride is its nuclear program.

zh: 尽管过去曾经承诺放弃核武器开发，但朝鲜政府近年来一直在进行新的研究，显然抱有达到某个全新技术里程碑的希望。
en: Despite past pledges to abandon nuclear-weapons development, the government has lately been pursuing new research, evidently in the hope of proclaiming the achievement of some new technological milestone.

zh: 1989年柏林墙倒塌以来，世界多数国家已经接受了自由市场。
en: Since the fall of the Berlin Wall in 1989, most of the world has jumped on the free-market bandwagon.

zh: 但朝鲜却一直坚持奉行孤立政策。
en: But North Korea has held fast to its isolation.

zh: 该国邪教般的政权催生了高度民族主义的世界观，在他们看来与其他国家 — — 更不要说整个国际社会 — — 的任何全面合作都是对朝鲜主权的威胁。
en: Its cult-like regime has encouraged a hyper-nationalist worldview, according to which any systematic cooperation with another country – much less the international community at large – is considered a threat to North Korea’s sovereignty.

zh: 而且，最近召开的劳动党七大表明这种情况不太可能迅速得到改观。
en: And, as the latest party congress made clear, this will not change anytime soon.

zh: 而今天，朝鲜看起来越来越不像局外人，而更像民族主义、自给自足和独裁主义大潮的先行者。
en: Nowadays, however, North Korea is beginning to look less like an outlier than a forerunner in a broader trend toward nationalism, autarky, and authoritarianism.

zh: 在自由之家和其他非政府机构看来，全球趋势表现出20世纪上半叶以来从未有过的专制政权抬头倾向。
en: Global trends, as measured by Freedom House and other nongovernmental authorities, include a surge in despotic regimes not seen since the first half of the twentieth century.

zh: 民族主义浪潮几乎无所不在，从冲突易发区到世界最繁荣的民主国家。
en: The embrace of nationalism can be seen virtually everywhere, from conflict-prone regions to the world’s most robust democracies.

zh: 尽管另一个朝鲜的崛起暂时还不太可能，但至少可以说不断发展的民族主义和反自由主义势头是令人不安的。
en: While the emergence of another North Korea is not in the cards, the growing momentum of nationalism and illiberalism is troubling, to say the least.

zh: 结构性问题普遍存在，尤其鉴于中央政府很容易腐败、筋疲力竭和不堪重负。
en: No country is free of structural problems, especially given the ease with which central governments can become overburdened, exhausted, and corrupt.

zh: 而且平衡中央集权和少数族裔偏好、局部权利和地方机构权威从来都不容易办到。
en: And it is never easy to balance the power of the center with the preferences of minorities, the rights of regions, and the authority of local entities.

zh: 但这些年也找到了许多缓解内部失衡及冲突的办法。
en: But, over the years, solutions have emerged to ease these internal imbalances and clashes.

zh: 其中之一是融入更大范围的欧盟等机构。
en: One such solution is integration into broader structures, such as the European Union.

zh: 举例来讲，人们认为入盟方面的进展能够解决巴尔干冲突。
en: Strife in the Balkans, for example, was supposed to be resolved with progress toward EU membership.

zh: 帮助国家认识并促进共同利益的其他种类的超国家机构和联盟也能造成类似的影响。
en: Other kinds of supra-national structures and alliances that help countries to recognize and advance common interests have a similar impact.

zh: 不幸的是，这种模式现在也已江河日下。
en: Unfortunately, that model is not what it used to be.

zh: 而且如今，民意调查显示超国家实体的吸引力正在迅速减弱。
en: And, nowadays, public opinion polls indicate that supra-national entities are losing their appeal.

zh: 英国下个月就是否留在欧盟进行公投或许是最突出的例子。
en: Perhaps the most salient example is the United Kingdom’s referendum on continued EU membership next month.

zh: 而且欧洲怀疑主义政党在整个欧洲大陆纷纷崛起，甚至在某些地方已经加入了执政联盟。
en: And Euroskeptic parties are on the rise across Europe, and have even joined government coalitions in some places.

zh: 此外，未参与欧洲一体化的国家（如土耳其）现在似乎很高兴自己没有加入，这样它就可以在不考虑外部利益或不承担外部责任的情况下选择自己前进（或者后退）的方向。
en: Meanwhile, countries left out of European integration – such as Turkey – now seem pleased to have missed the boat, as they attempt to chart their own way forward (or, it often seems, backward) without external interests or responsibilities constraining their behavior.

zh: 但在其对中东局势施加影响力时，与其说土耳其像是强大的民族国家还不如说更像傲慢固执的区域列强。
en: But, as Turkey moves to shape Middle Eastern affairs, it looks less like a robust nation-state than like a bumptious regional power that has learned little and forgotten less.

zh: 当然，中东持续动荡不仅影响土耳其，而且影响到整个世界。
en: Of course, the Middle East’s ongoing turmoil is one of the main challenges facing the entire world, not just Turkey.

zh: 那些相信阿拉伯之春运动会开启阿拉伯世界全新民主时代和参与性执政的民众从来没有预料到会遭遇倒退的力量 — — 比方说自称的“伊斯兰国 ” — —将地区推向更加原始的对部落和教派的效忠。
en: Those who believed that the Arab Spring would give rise to a new era of democracy and participatory governance in the Arab world never anticipated the power of retrograde forces – such as the self-described “Islamic State” – to push the region toward more primeval forms of tribal and sectarian loyalty.

zh: 就连一直竭尽全力维护世俗政府的国家也已经陷入到类似的陷阱，似乎军方才是唯一能够执行其意愿的有凝聚力的力量。
en: Even countries that have fought hard to maintain secular government have fallen into a familiar trap, with the military emerging as the only cohesive body capable of imposing its will.

zh: 而在阿拉伯之春革命刚刚发生时看似正在建立民主制度的埃及其实是落入上述陷阱的典型形象。
en: Egypt, which seemed to be establishing democracy in the wake of the Arab Spring revolutions, is the poster child for this trap.

zh: 民主制度的弱化伴随着另外一种令人不安的趋势：那就是敌对情绪再次出现在合作远比竞争对双方更为有利的国家。
en: The weakening of democracy is accompanied by another disturbing trend: the reemergence of hostility among counties that would benefit far more from cooperation than competition.

zh: 普京所领导的俄罗斯已经成为主要的修正主义力量，它试图通过武力改变苏联解体时的现状，甚至改变苏维埃政权鼎盛时所作出的（允许克里米亚并入乌克兰的）决策。
en: Vladimir Putin’s Russia has become a major revisionist power, seeking to change by force the terms of the Soviet Union’s breakup, and even decisions taken at the height of Soviet power (namely, the incorporation of Crimea into Ukraine).

zh: 中国也已开始（尤其是在南中国海）单方面维护其领土要求。
en: China, too, has engaged in unilateral efforts to assert its territorial claims, especially in the South China Sea.

zh: 这不仅导致中国与东南亚邻国关系复杂化（上述邻国越来越惶惶不安地注视着中国的崛起 ） ， 同时也导致中国与（若干地区国家签署条约的）美国关系恶化。
en: That has not only complicated its relations with its Southeast Asian neighbors, which have watched China’s rise with growing trepidation, but also with the United States, which maintains treaty ties with several of those states.

zh: 但美国也有其自身的问题。
en: But the US has its own problems.

zh: 总统初选 — — 具体而言是唐纳德·特朗普异军突起成为美国共和党推定提名人 — — 正导致世界对美国在当今乱世期间的领导能力提出质疑。
en: The presidential primaries – specifically, Donald Trump’s rise to become the US Republican Party’s presumptive nominee – are raising doubts about America’s capacity to help lead the world through troubled times.

zh: 特朗普的竞选以好战的民族主义和移民提案为特色 — — 从大规模修墙阻挡移民到禁止所有穆斯林进入美国 — — 以及不分青红皂白地批评美国与盟国和敌国之间的关系。
en: Trump’s campaign has been marked by bellicose nationalism and anti-immigrant proposals – from the construction of a massive wall to keep out immigrants to a ban on all Muslims from entering the US – as well as reckless criticisms of America’s relations with friends and foes alike.

zh: 但他却仍有可能在选举中获胜；事实上，他能够指挥数量庞大且往往非常忠实的追随者。
en: Yet he remains electorally viable; indeed, he commands a large and often virulently loyal following.

zh: 其中反映并且强化的国内政治紧张凸显了今天的世界秩序是多么脆弱。
en: The internal political strain that this reflects and reinforces highlights just how vulnerable the world order is today.

zh: 因为风格暴躁鲁莽，特朗普似乎缺乏当今世界稳定执政的所需的知识、智慧和性格。
en: With his blustery and reckless style, Trump seems to lack the knowledge, wisdom, and temperament needed to execute the steady stewardship that today’s world requires.

zh: 从这个意义上讲，他与乳臭未干的金正恩有很多共同点 — — 所不同的是，如果特朗普掌握权力，他所控制的将是影响力大得多的国家。
en: In that sense, he has quite a lot in common with the callow Kim – except that, if Trump gains power, he will have control of a far more influential country.

zh: 唐纳德·特朗普传递的信号
en: Donald Trump’s Message

zh: 坎布里奇 — — 唐纳德·特朗普11月在共和党总统候选人提名竞争中保持领先已经造成了某种程度的恐荒。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Donald Trump’s lead in the race for the Republican Party’s nomination as its presidential candidate in November has caused consternation.

zh: 共和党体制担心他无法战胜可能的民主党候选人希拉里·克林顿。
en: The Republican establishment fears he will not be able to defeat Hillary Clinton, the likely Democratic nominee.

zh: 但某些观察家则担心特朗普当选总统后美国的未来。
en: But some observers worry more about the prospect of a Trump presidency.

zh: 有些人甚至将特朗普视为潜在美国墨索里尼式的人物。
en: Some even see Trump as a potential American Mussolini.

zh: 无论有什么问题。 今天的美国都不是1922年的意大利。
en: Whatever its problems, the United States today is not like Italy in 1922.

zh: 宪法制度的牵制和平衡，加之公正的法律制度，或许完全可以制约这位真人秀表演者。
en: The Constitution’s institutional checks and balances, together with an impartial legal system, are likely to constrain even a reality-TV showman.

zh: 真正的危险不在于特朗普入主白宫后会践行他的诺言，而在于他力求入主白宫时抛出言论所造成的损伤。
en: The real danger is not that Trump will do what he says if he reaches the White House, but the damage caused by what he says as he tries to get there.

zh: 评判领袖的标准不仅在于其决策的有效性，还在于他们能否创造内涵并将其传授给追随者。
en: Leaders are judged not only on the effectiveness of their decisions, but also by the meaning that they create and teach to their followers.

zh: 多数领袖通过迎合所在团体现有身份认知和一致看法来获取支持。
en: Most leaders gain support by appealing to the existing identity and solidarity of their groups.

zh: 但伟大领袖则会教育追随者认识他们所处群体以外的世界。
en: But great leaders educate their followers about the world beyond their immediate group.

zh: 在70年内德国第三次入侵法国的二次大战后，法国领导人让·莫内认定对战败的德国施以报复将再次酿成悲剧。
en: After World War II, during which Germany had invaded France for the third time in 70 years, the French leader Jean Monnet decided that revenge upon a defeated Germany would produce yet another tragedy.

zh: 相反，他制定了一项后来逐步演化为欧盟的体制计划，这让人们很难想象会再次爆发这样的战争。
en: Instead, he invented a plan for the gradual development of the institutions that evolved into the European Union, which has helped make such a war unthinkable.

zh: 或者以伟大的领导人纳尔逊·曼德拉为例，曼德拉可以轻易选择限定其所在机构服务南非黑人，并为长达数十年的种族隔离屈辱及其自身的监禁寻求报复。
en: Or, to take another example of great leadership, Nelson Mandela could easily have chosen to define his group as black South Africans and sought revenge for the injustice of decades of apartheid and his own imprisonment.

zh: 相反，他不知疲倦地通过语言和实际行动来吸引不同身份的追随者。
en: Instead, he worked tirelessly to expand the identity of his followers both by words and deeds.

zh: 作为某种著名的颇具象征意义的姿态，他身着南非羚羊队的球衣出席一场橄榄球比赛，这支球队此前曾是南非白人至上主义的象征。
en: In one famous symbolic gesture, he appeared at a rugby game wearing the jersey of the South African Springboks, a team that had previously signified South African white supremacy.

zh: 曼德拉扩大追随者阵营的努力与邻国津巴布韦总统罗伯特·穆加贝所采取的狭隘策略形成了鲜明的对比。
en: Contrast Mandela’s efforts to teach his followers about a broader identity with the narrow approach taken by Robert Mugabe next door in Zimbabwe.

zh: 和曼德拉不同，穆加贝利用殖民时代积累的怨愤来博取支持，现在则完全依靠武力来进行执政。
en: Unlike Mandela, Mugabe used colonial-era grievances to build support, and now is relying on force to remain in power.

zh: 今天的美国，虽然经济仍在增长且失业率处于4.9%的低位，但很多人仍然感觉自己无法享受国家的繁荣。
en: In the US today, while the economy is growing and the unemployment rate is at a low 4.9%, many feel excluded from the country’s prosperity.

zh: 很多人将过去几十年不平等的扩大归咎于外国人而非技术，组织一股反对移民和全球化的势力可谓举手之劳。
en: Many blame rising inequality over the past few decades on foreigners, rather than technology, and it is easy to rally opposition both to immigration and globalization.

zh: 除经济民粹主义外，即使多数问题早已不是新鲜事，但绝大部分民众仍然感受到与种族、文化和族裔相关的文化变革的威胁。
en: In addition to economic populism, a significant minority of the population also feels threatened by cultural changes related to race, culture, and ethnicity, even though much of this is not new.

zh: 下一任总统必须教育美国人如何面对他们视为威胁的全球化进程。
en: The next president will have to educate Americans about how to deal with a globalization process that many find threatening.

zh: 从某种意义上讲，国家身份是人们想象出来的群体概念，因为很少有人曾经体验过其他类型的文明。
en: National identities are imagined communities in the sense that few people have direct experience of the other members.
