zh: 这样的规定可以保证富裕国家投入更多的资金，从而减少应对气候变化争论中的许多政治情绪。
en: It would ensure that richer nations pay more, taking much of the political heat from the debate.

zh: 几十年的会谈没有对碳排放产生任何冲击。
en: Decades of talks have failed to make any impact on carbon emissions.

zh: 期望中国和印度在受益很小的情况下进行大规模的碳排放减排，会将哥本哈根会议置于一条肯定是另一个失去的机会的道路之上。
en: Expecting China and India to make massive emission cuts for little benefit puts the Copenhagen meeting on a sure path to being another lost opportunity.

zh: 然而，与此同时，中国和印度带来的挑战可以变成我们改变方向，结束我们对减少排放的沉迷以及转而关注研发的推动力 — — 关注研发更为明智而低廉，并且可能实际上带来变化。
en: Yet, at the same time, the Chinese and Indian challenge could be the impetus we need to change direction, end our obsession with reducing emissions, and focus instead on research and development, which would be smarter and cheaper – and would actually make a difference.

zh: 不要为多哈哭泣
en: Don’t Cry for Doha

zh: 剑桥－他们会还是不会呢？
en: CAMBRIDGE – Will they or won’t they?

zh: 世界各国的贸易部长会最终签订一个新的降低农业补贴和工业关税的多边贸易协定呢，还是会空手而归？
en: Will the world’s trade ministers eventually sign a new multilateral trade agreement that reduces agricultural subsidies and industrial tariffs, or will they walk away empty-handed?

zh: 当本轮谈判于2001年在卡塔尔的多哈启动的时候，随着随后无数的起起落落、谈判濒于失败以及谈判时间的延长，这个故事就上演了。
en: The saga has been ongoing since November 2001, when the current round of negotiations was launched in Doha, Qatar, with numerous subsequent ups and downs, near-collapses, and extensions.

zh: 最近一轮在日内瓦进行的会谈再次以没有达成任何协议收场。 根据一些财经报道和经济学家的说法判断，对它的期望再高都不为过。
en: The latest round of talks in Geneva has once again failed to produce an agreement.  Judging by what the financial press and some economists say, the stakes could not be higher.

zh: 如果这场所谓的“发展回合”以成功结束，就会使在贫困国家的几亿农民脱离贫困并可以确保全球化继续下去。
en: Conclude this so-called “development round” successfully, and you will lift hundreds of millions of farmers in poor countries out of poverty and ensure that globalization remains alive.

zh: 如果“发展回合”以失败结束，就会给世界贸易体系一个几乎致命的打击，使南方的希望幻灭并刺激了北方的保护主义。
en: Fail, and you will deal the world trading system a near-fatal blow, fostering disillusionment in the South and protectionism in the North.

zh: 而且，像新闻主笔急于提醒我们的那样，在世界金融体系在次级抵押贷款危机下岌岌可危以及美国进入衰退的时候，本回合失败的负面影响尤其巨大。
en: And, as the editorialists hasten to remind us, the downside is especially large at a time when the world’s financial system is reeling under the sub-prime mortgage crisis and the United States is entering a recession.

zh: 但是，如果从更旁观的角度看多哈议程，你会奇怪为什么会有这些大惊小怪。
en: But look at the Doha agenda with a more detached set of eyes, and you wonder what all the fuss is about.

zh: 富裕国家支持农民的政策倾向于压低世界价格及减少了发展中国家的农产品生产者的收入，这是事实。
en: True, farm-support policies in rich countries tend to depress world prices, along with the incomes of agricultural producers in developing countries.

zh: 但是，对于绝大部分的农产品，逐步取消这些补贴对世界价格的影响有限 — — 最多只有几个百分点。
en: But for most farm products, the phasing out of these subsidies is likely to have only modest effects on world prices – at most a few percentage points.

zh: 这和最近世界市场经历的巨大的农产品价格涨幅相比，是微不足道的，并且最终，它也会被这些农产品市场具有的高度的波动性所吞没。
en: This is small potatoes compared to the significant run-up in prices that world markets have been experiencing recently, and it would in any case be swamped by the high volatility to which these markets are normally subject.

zh: 虽然更高的全球农产品价格帮助了农产品生产者，但是它们也伤害了发展中国家的城市家庭，许多这样的城市家庭也很贫穷。
en: While higher world farm prices help producers, they hurt urban households in developing countries, many of which are also poor.

zh: 这就是最近食品价格的飙升使许多粮食生产国施加出口限制以及在那些关注全球贫困的人中几乎造成惊慌的原因。
en: That is why the recent spike in food prices has led many food-growing countries to impose export restrictions and has caused near panic among those concerned about global poverty.

zh: 很难将这些担忧和多哈贸易回合至少可以使几千万人 — — 如果达不到几亿人的话 — — 脱离贫困这样的观点统一起来。
en: It is hard to square these fears with the view that the Doha trade round could lift tens, if not hundreds, of millions out of poverty.

zh: 最恰当的说法是，在富裕国家进行的农业改革对世界的穷人来说，是一件好坏参半的事。
en: The best that can be said is that farm reform in rich countries would be a mixed blessing for the world’s poor.

zh: 明显的好处只在诸如棉花和糖这样的几种商品中存在，而贫困家庭并不大量消费这些东西。
en: Clear-cut gains exist only for a few commodities, such as cotton and sugar, which are not consumed in large quantities by poor households.

zh: 美国、欧盟以及其它富裕国家进行农业改革的最大赢家是它们本国的纳税人和消费者，这些纳税人和消费者长期以来为他们的农民同胞获得的补贴和保护买单。
en: The big winners from farm reform in the US, the EU, and other rich countries would be their taxpayers and consumers, who have long paid for the subsidies and protections received by their farming compatriots.

zh: 但是别搞错了：我们在这里谈论的是国内政策改革和内部收入再分配。
en: But make no mistake: what we are talking about here is domestic policy reform and an internal redistribution of income.

zh: 这可能对效率甚至公平都有好处。
en: This may be good on efficiency and even equity grounds.

zh: 但是，这应该成为世界贸易组织的当务之急吗？
en: But should it have become the primary preoccupation of the World Trade Organization?

zh: 工业关税呢？
en: What about industrial tariffs?

zh: 富裕国家要求像印度和巴西这样的发展中国家大幅降低进口关税以换取它们的农业补贴的逐步取消。
en: Rich countries have demanded sharp cuts in import tariffs by developing countries such as India and Brazil in return for phasing out their farm subsidies.

zh: （富裕国家为什么需要穷国贿赂它们以使它们做对自己有好处的事是一个不解之谜 ） 。
en: (Why they need to be bribed by poor countries to do what is good for them is an enduring mystery.)

zh: 但是，在这里，这些措施潜在的好处也很小。
en: But here, too, the potential benefits are slim.

zh: 发展中国家适用的税率虽然比发达国家要高，但是也已经处在历史最低点了。
en: Applied tariff rates in developing countries, while higher than in advanced countries, are already at an all-time low.

zh: 根据世界银行的统计，彻底消除所有的商品贸易障碍对发展中国家收入的最终推进比例不超过1 % ， 对发达国家收入的影响就更小了。
en: According to World Bank estimates, complete elimination of all merchandise trade restrictions would ultimately boost developing-country incomes by no more than 1%. The impact on developed-country incomes would be even smaller.

zh: 并且，当然，多哈回合只是减少这些贸易障碍，而不是完全消除它们。
en: And, of course, the Doha Round would only reduce these barriers, not eliminate them altogether.

zh: 多哈回合建立在这样一个神话上，即关注农业的谈判议程构成了一个“发展回合 ” 。
en: The Doha Round was constructed on a myth, namely that a negotiating agenda focused on agriculture would constitute a “development round.” This gave key constituencies what they wanted.

zh: 这给了重要的支持者需要的东西，它为富裕国家的政府和当时的世界贸易组织秘书长麦克·摩尔提供了一个取得对反全球化的抗议者的道德高地的机会，给美国一个拆除欧盟共同的农业政策的手杖。
en: It provided rich-country governments and then-WTO Director General Mike Moore with an opportunity to gain the moral high ground over anti-globalization protesters. It gave the US a stick with which to tear down the EU’s common agricultural policy.

zh: 并且，它是为几个中等收入且是农业出口大国的发展中国家（例如巴西，阿根廷和泰国）量身定制的。
en: And it was tailor-made for the few middle-income developing countries (such as Brazil, Argentina, and Thailand) that are large agricultural exporters.

zh: 但是，由支持贸易谈判“自行车理论 ” — —认为贸易体制只有在自由化中不��进步才能不倒的观点 — — 的贸易官员和经济学家推进的“发展”回合神话已经事与愿违，因为美国和主要的发展中国家发现很难使它们的农业部门自由化。
en: But the myth of a “development” round, promoted by trade officials and economists who espouse the “bicycle theory” of trade negotiations – the view that the trade regime can remain upright only with continuous progress in liberalization – backfired, because the US and key developing countries found it difficult to liberalize their farm sectors.

zh: 印度拒绝接受它感到可能使印度的小农生产者处于危险境地的刚性规则，是最终导致最近一轮谈判失败的原因。
en: What ultimately led to the collapse of the latest round of negotiations was India’s refusal to accept rigid rules that it felt would put India’s agricultural smallholders in jeopardy.

zh: 更重要的是，潜藏在自行车理论中的担忧被极大地夸大了。
en: More importantly, the fears underlying the bicycle theory are wildly inflated.

zh: 我们生活在历史上最自由的贸易体制中不是因为世界贸易组织执行它，而是因为重要的国家 — — 不管是富裕国家还是穷国 — — 都发现更大程度的开放符合它们的最佳利益。
en: We live under the most liberal trade regime in history not because the WTO enforces it, but because important countries – rich and poor alike – find greater openness to be in their best interest.

zh: 真正的危险在其它地方。
en: The real risks lie elsewhere.

zh: 一方面的危险是现在的危言耸听会自我实现 — — 由于恐慌，贸易官员和投资者将想象中的灾难变成了现实。
en: On one side is the danger that today’s alarmism will prove self-fulfilling – that trade officials and investors will turn the doomsday scenario into reality by panicking.

zh: 另一方面的危险是 ， “ 发展回合”的完成没能达到它引起的高预期，从而进一步在长期内侵蚀了全球贸易规则的正当性。
en: On the other side is the danger that a completed “development round” will fail to live up to the high expectations that it has spawned, further eroding the legitimacy of global trade rules over the longer run.

zh: 最后，极有可能是氛围 — — 心理和预期 — — 而不是实际的经济效果决定结果。
en: In the end, it may well be the atmospherics – psychology and expectations – rather than the actual economic results on the ground that will determine the outcomes.

zh: 所以，不要为多哈哭泣。
en: So don’t cry for Doha.

zh: 它从来就不是一个发展回合，而且，它不会使明天的世界和昨天的世界看起来有任何的不同。
en: It never was a development round, and tomorrow’s world will hardly look any different from yesterday’s.

zh: 莫把东方之龙喂饱了
en: Don’t Feed the Dragon

zh: 经过三年与美国总统布什的磕磕碰碰之后，欧盟渴望着被当作一个真正的世界级“选手”来对待。
en: The European Union, after a three-year spat with President Bush, is keen to be regarded as a world player to be reckoned with.

zh: 许多欧盟领导人在与中国的“战略性合作”方式中看到了这种尊种，而这一新合作方式将有助于抑制超级大国美国的权利。
en: Many EU leaders see newfound respect coming in the form of a “strategic partnership” with China that is designed to balance the power of the United States.

zh: 有些人希望高级军备贸易也能在这一新型合作中有所体现 — — 这一观点最近正在推动欧盟解除对华实施长达15年的军售禁令。
en: Some want that partnership to include trade in advanced weaponry—witness the recent push to remove the EU’s 15-year-old ban on arms sales to China.

zh: 尽管美国极力反对，但是许多欧洲国家却对他们的反对呼声不屑一顾。
en: Although America objects strongly, a number of Europeans shrug off any opposition.

zh: 但是中国可不是普普通通的贸易伙伴。
en: But China is no ordinary trading partner.

zh: 即使不公开对抗西方价值观和利益，中国也有威胁台湾、谋求亚洲地区霸主地位的企图。 当然，这有悖于欧洲和西方世界的利益，更不消说日本、印度和亚洲其他国家了。
en: If not openly committed to opposing Western values and interests, China’s interests in cowing Taiwan and in asserting regional hegemony across Asia certainly are not those of Europe and the West, not to mention Japan, India, and the rest of Asia.

zh: 事实上，中国和俄罗斯、白俄罗斯以及其他一些专制政权早就意见一致地承认了暴政专权的维克托·亚努科维奇当选乌克兰总统，尽管他在选举中并不得志。
en: Indeed, China stood with Russia, Belarus, and a few other despotic regimes in prematurely recognizing the thuggish, ballot-stuffing Viktor Yanukovych as President of Ukraine.

zh: 这一点丝毫不令人奇怪，在乌克兰的这场橘色革命中，几千名反对派的抗议者在聚集在基辅中央独立广场的情景，大概一下子就让中国领导人想起了15年前的天安门广场事件，当然也想起了他们所采取的与乌克兰截然不同的严酷镇压政策。
en: This should come as no surprise, as the Chinese government does not plan to hold free and fair elections soon. Indeed, perhaps Ukraine’s Orange Revolution, with those thousands of protesters in Kiev’s Independence Square served as a potent reminder to China’s leaders of the Tiananmen Square protests 15 years ago, and – in contrast to Ukraine – their own strategy of brutal repression.

zh: 虽然中国已不再如15年前般黑暗，但是中国人权记录依然糟糕。
en: If not as dark as 15 years ago, China’s human rights record remains abysmal.

zh: 欧盟最具综合权威性的英国外务办公室年度人权报告在2004年谴责中国政府滥用死刑（甚至将死刑用于贪污、嫖娼、贩毒和税务诈骗罪犯 ） 、 长期镇压持不同政见者、禁止宗教和自由言论（包括互联网）
en: The British Foreign Office’s annual human rights report for 2004, the most comprehensive in the EU, condemns China’s extensive use of the death penalty (even for such crimes as corruption, pimping, drug offenses, and tax fraud), its systematic torture of dissidents, and its restrictions on freedom of speech – including the Internet – and religion.

zh: 在欧盟-中国的峰会上，这些弊端被一再提及，但结果却石沉大海，收效甚微。
en: All of these abuses are raised repeatedly at EU-China summits, to little or no avail.

zh: 自1989年天安门广场屠杀事件后欧盟联合美国对华禁售武器，难道现在应该是结束这条禁令的时候了吗？
en: So is this the time to end the arms ban imposed by both Europe and America after the Tiananmen Square massacre in 1989?

zh: 令人担心的还不止是中国的人权纪录。
en: China’s human rights record is not the only problem.

zh: 目前没有有效机制能够防止中国政府将欧盟的军备武器用于国内镇压，这点足以堪忧，更何况，还没有任何机制能够阻止中国向朝鲜等国再次出口武器。
en: It is bad enough that no mechanism exists to prevent China’s government from using EU arms for internal repression. But nor does any mechanism exist that would stop China from re-exporting the weapons to places like North Korea.

zh: 事实上，有记录表明中国曾帮助巴基斯坦建造原子弹。
en: Indeed, China has a track record as a serial proliferator, having helped Pakistan build its atomic bomb.

zh: 而它是否曾向伊朗提供导弹和火箭推进原料目前尚未定论。
en: Its role in providing missile and rocket propulsion materials to Iran remains unclear.

zh: 不过法国和德国声称此类批判早已过时，英国及意大利也紧随其后发表相同见解（但他们遭到了荷兰、斯堪的纳维亚地区的国家和一些东欧前社会主义国家的反对，这些东欧国家对社会主义镇压可是在熟悉不过了 ） 。
en: Yet France and Germany, with Britain and Italy not far behind, say such criticism is outdated. (They are strongly opposed by Holland, the Scandinavian countries, and the former Communist countries of Eastern Europe, which are familiar with communist repression.)

zh: 废除军售出口禁令的支持者们辩称，这些老调重弹并不能真正反映中国在人权方面的进步，相反却让俄罗斯与其邻居在热火朝天的军火交易中赚得盆盈钵满，令欧洲的军火生意蒙受损失。
en: Supporters of lifting the arms export ban argue that this litany of sins does not reflect China’s real improvements in human rights and penalizes European armaments jobs to the benefit of Russia, which enjoys a lively arms trade with its neighbor (something it might one day regret).

zh: 法国的对华港口解禁也代表着法国承认中国在反伊斯兰恐怖主义活动中的重要地位。
en: For France, lifting the embargo is also an important symbol, one that recognizes China’s role in fighting Islamist terrorism.

zh: 去年10月，利比亚参加反恐阵营并放弃发展大规模杀伤性武器，欧盟因此公开解除对其制裁。
en: Libya had such EU restrictions lifted last October ostensibly for joining the fight against terrorism and abandoning its weapons of mass destruction.

zh: 支持复苏欧中军火贸易的人们将这些事件看作动荡政治的稳定器，并希望恶化的政治不会殃及火热的生意。
en: In addition, those in favor of reviving EU-China arms trade see such sales as a stabilizer in bouts of political turbulence and are loath to let bad politics interfere with good business.

zh: 中国的支持者们指出1998年的《欧盟关于武器出口的行为规范》能有效限制军火销售，但是他们想当然地忽略了一个事实，即该行为规范属于“自愿”性质，对各成员国不具强制性。
en: China apologists claim that the 1998 EU Code of Conduct on Arms Exports is sufficient to limit arms sales. But they conveniently ignore the fact that the Code of Conduct is voluntary and thus not enforceable.

zh: 这也是为什么欧洲议会在11月全票通过，只有当该行为规范具备法律约束力时才能解除对华武器禁售。
en: This is why the European Parliament voted across party and national lines in November against lifting the ban until the EU Code of Conduct is made binding.

zh: 究竟什么才能统一大西洋联盟各国的军备出口政策呢？
en: Can anything pull the Atlantic alliance’s policies on arms exports together?

zh: 与一个有中国这样人权纪录的国家进行贸易往来除了要熟悉经济形势外，更要适应更为深层广泛的外交目的。
en: Trade with a country with China’s human rights record must not only make economic sense; it must also fit the wider aims of foreign policy.

zh: 也就是说，要避免那些会让外交陷于不利的商业贸易。
en: That means, above all, avoiding trade that makes it more difficult to pursue those aims.

zh: 就像上世纪七八十年代，美国听了本国小麦农民的话而改变其外交政策，这件事给美国总统留下了笑柄；而欧洲政府有意将亚洲证券抵押给动荡不安的中国一事也遭到批评。
en: Just as American presidents looked foolish when they bent US foreign policy to the dictates of American wheat farmers in the 1970’s and 1980’s, European governments that are prepared to mortgage Asian security to a restless China also command no respect.

zh: 这个教训是深刻的：安全利益高于商业利益。
en: The lesson is clear: security interests must come before business interests.

zh: 因此欧美必须相互合作，以保证与华尖端军备和武器相关技术贸易不会加强中国军事力量，同时保证获准合法向中国市场出口货物的西方生产商之��的竞争不会影响到西方政治的步调一致。
en: So transatlantic coordination is needed, to ensure that any trade of sophisticated arms and weapons-related technologies with China does nothing to enhance China’s military power, and that competition between Western producers of goods that may legitimately be sold to China does not damage Western political unity.

zh: 在冷战时期曾有这样一个贸易机制：在1949年到柏林墙拆除期间，咨询小组统筹委员会(Cocom)在一个君子协议框架下，监控着西方世界向苏联的技术出口，可谓卓有成效。
en: In the Cold War era, there was a mechanism for such trade. From 1949 until the fall of the Berlin Wall, the Consultative Group Coordinating Committee (Cocom) monitored and controlled the export of Western technology to the Soviet Union.

zh: 他们为和平解决争端、修补贸易漏洞提供了一个良好的机会，而这，正是我们现在迫切需要的。
en: It did so by a gentlemen’s agreement, and with reasonable success. Cocom provided an opportunity to settle squabbles and plug loopholes quietly.

zh: 医疗改革勿要紧跟美国步伐
en: Don’t Follow America on Health Care

zh: 多伦多 — — 美国最高法院开始考虑合理医疗费用法案（这一历史性的医疗改革方案被奥巴马的对手嘲笑为“奥巴马医改 ” ） ，但是值得注意的是，虽然2010年颁布了医疗改革法律，但是当年没有享受医疗保险的美国人口却创下历史新高 — — 大约50万美国居民（1/6的美国人口）无力支付巨额的医疗费用。
en: TORONTO – With the United States Supreme Court set to begin considering the Affordable Care Act (the historic health-care reform derided by opponents as “Obamacare”), it is worth noting that the number of Americans without health insurance reached an all-time high in 2010, the year the law was enacted. Roughly 50 million US residents (one in six) pay out-of-pocket for medical expenses.

zh: 这一惊人数字产生的原因并不只是因为2008年爆发的经济衰退，长期的政治和政策选择也有难辞其咎。
en: The 2008 recession is not the only reason for this staggering figure; long-term political and policy choices are also to blame.

zh: 在全球范围内，特别是经济迅速增长的国家，这一教训很简单：避免美国的私人医疗保健模式。
en: Globally, but especially for rapidly growing economies, the lesson is simple: avoid America’s private health-care model.

zh: 世界上大多数高收入国家都通过政府资助的预付系统为医疗保健买单，美国却是例外。
en: The US is one of the few high-income countries that does not finance health care through a publicly funded prepaid system.

zh: 富裕国家每年平均医疗支出约占国内生产总值的11 ％ ， 其中80％以上来自公共资金，只有14％用于医疗服务。
en: On average, wealthier countries spend roughly 11% of their GDP on health, with more than 80% publicly financed and only 14% of spending taking place on a fee-for-service basis.

zh: 公共财政（在某些情况下，政府监管下的合作保险基金也等同于公共融资）为大多数医疗服务买单，私人保险只补充提供极少的额外服务。
en: Public finance (or, in some cases, government-regulated cooperative insurance funds that amount to public financing) pays for most discretionary medical services, with private insurance supplementing only minimal extra services.

zh: 多数富裕国家之所以选择公共融资方式来资助医疗保健，主要以下几个原因考虑。
en: Most rich countries choose to finance their health care publicly for several reasons.

zh: 首先，自由市场运作的卫生保健体系通常不能保证公平且效率低下。
en: First, free-market health care is usually inequitable and inefficient.

zh: 个人需求差别很大，但是私人保险公司往往不愿投保那些最需要医疗服务的人群（例如那些已经生病的人，或可能会引发其他健康问题的糖尿病患者 ） 。
en: Individual needs vary significantly, and private companies are often unwilling to insure the very people who need the most care (such as those who are already ill, or who have conditions like diabetes, which predispose them to other health problems).

zh: 此外，那些购买医疗保险的人（承保人和病人）不可能获取必要信息以选择最安全、最有效的治疗方式。
en: Moreover, those who buy care – insurers and patients – are unlikely to have the information necessary to choose the safest and most effective treatments.

zh: 与此同时，公共开支发挥着经济闸门的作用，可以控制国家整体开支，防止私人保险公司引发的成本快速上升。
en: At the same time, public spending acts as a brake on overall spending, and prevents the rapid cost escalation to which America’s private insurance companies contribute.

zh: 美国每年支出其国内生产总值的1 ％ ， 仅仅是为了管理复杂低效的保险体系。
en: The US spends 1% of its GDP annually simply to administer its complex, unwieldy insurance system.

zh: 如果最高法院当前没有通过改革计划，美国医疗保健支出总额将从现在GDP的16％上升到2025年GDP的25 ％ 。
en: Without reform of the type now before the Supreme Court, total US health expenditures will rise from 16% of GDP today to 25% by 2025.

zh: 现行制度产生的经济影响已经非常严重。
en: The economic impact of the current system already is severe.

zh: 去年美国人口普查显示，生活在贫困线以下的美国人口数量显著增加，这当然与缺乏健康保险密切相关，但同时也反映出美国过度依赖以雇主为基础的保险覆盖体系。
en: The last US census showed a marked increase in the number of Americans living below the poverty line, a fact closely related to lack of health insurance, which in turn reflects over-reliance on employer-based insurance coverage.

zh: 新兴市场经济体政府在制订卫生保健系统时应牢记以下五点。
en: In emerging-market economies, governments should bear in mind five considerations when devising health-care systems.

zh: 首先，医疗领域的投资会为“贫困陷阱”提供重要的社会保障安全网络，经济动荡时期尤为如此。
en: First, investments in health provide an important safety net against poverty traps, especially in times of economic upheaval.

zh: 例如，由于灾难性卫生支出（一般定义为医疗成本超过家庭总支出的10 ％ ） ，印度每年有37万人没有享受医疗保险而沦落至贫困线以下。
en: For example, each year, 37 million uninsured Indians fall below the poverty line because of catastrophic health expenditures (generally defined as costs exceeding 10% of a household’s total expenditures).

zh: 第二，公共医疗融资使穷人可以自由支配财富以满足其他需要。
en: Second, public financing of health care frees the poor to use their money to satisfy other needs.

zh: 在低收入国家中，所有医疗保健支出中有一半（约占GDP的2.5 ％ ） 属于非预算款项开支，而这一比重在中等收入国家仅为GDP的2 ％ 。
en: In low-income countries, half of all health-care spending (about 2.5% of GDP) is out-of-pocket (compared to 2% in middle-income countries).

zh: 这一巨大开支占据了贫困家庭总收入的很大部分，抑制了更富有成效的家庭投资，却几乎没有创造任何工作岗位，而且这些开支对于医生和医院往往是免税的，因为他们经常通过暗箱操作捞取油水。
en: This spending consumes a large proportion of poorer households’ income, precludes more productive household investments, creates few jobs, and often remains untaxed, as doctors and hospitals are frequently paid under the counter.

zh: 第三，公开医疗融资可以提高整体就业率。
en: Third, publicly financing health could increase overall employment.

zh: 加拿大各省从1961年到1975年就分阶段引入国民健康保险。
en: Canada’s provinces phased in national health insurance from 1961 to 1975.

zh: 一方面，推行该方案的地区在就业和工资方面均出现上涨，但平均工时却保持不变。
en: Employment and wages rose where the program was introduced, even though average working hours were unchanged.

zh: 另一方面，私人保险水平较高的省份，就业率较低，工资增长较慢。
en: Provinces with high levels of private insurance coverage, on the other hand, had lower employment rates and slower wage growth.

zh: 最近，加拿大击败了美国，获得了丰田汽车投资建立新厂的竞标，部分原因是因为美国昂贵的私人医疗保险成本会使汽车制造成本增加几千美元。
en: More recently, Canada beat the US in a bid for a new Toyota plant, in part because private health-insurance costs in the US add several thousand dollars to the cost of manufacturing a car there.

zh: 第四，较富裕国家现行的国家卫生保健系统可以作为选择采用类似系统的新兴市场经济体效仿的模型。
en: Fourth, existing national health-care systems in wealthier countries can serve as models for emerging-market economies that choose to adopt similar systems.

zh: 公共融资需求并不意味着只有公共部门提供服务，私人医院和诊所有时也可以更有效地提供服务，这一点非常重要。
en: Importantly, public finance need not mean only public delivery; private hospitals and clinics can sometimes deliver services more effectively.

zh: 1995年台湾推行了一种“单付费者制度 ” ， 极大地遏制了医疗费用上涨，改善了人口的生活质量。
en: Taiwan initiated a single-payer system in 1995, significantly curbing health-care costs and improving the population’s quality of life.

zh: 墨西哥的新全民健康保险制度首先在该国最贫穷的地区实施。
en: Mexico’s new universal health-insurance system was implemented first in the poorest parts of the country.

zh: 另一方面，中国的健康保险撤回政府投资，这一做法产生的严重后果发人深省。
en: China, on the other hand, provides a sobering example of the consequences of withdrawing publicly financed health insurance.

zh: 20世纪80年代初，中国推行的市场化改革使近100万农村居民几乎在一夜之间失去医疗保险。
en: In the early 1980’s, market reforms left roughly 100 million rural citizens without insurance, almost overnight.

zh: 非预算款项开支暴涨，婴儿死亡率停止下降，疾病监测系统削弱，这可能在一定程度上导致了2002-2003年SARS疫情爆发，全球超过900人死亡，经济损失估计约60亿美元。
en: Out-of-pocket costs skyrocketed, infant mortality rates stopped declining, and the disease surveillance system was weakened, which may have contributed to the SARS epidemic in 2002-2003, which took more than 900 lives worldwide and caused economic losses worth an estimated $60 billion.

zh: 中国政府已经公开承认改革失败，并承诺将支出几十亿美元用于公共融资的医疗保健。
en: The Chinese government has acknowledged that the reforms were a flop, and has committed to spending several billion dollars on publicly financed health care.

zh: 最后，政府要遵循医疗保险“覆盖所有人而不覆盖一切”的原则，调查研究哪些服务最划算，哪些服务不应接受公开资助，因为这些服务不仅成本高而且效益低。
en: Finally, following the principle, “everyone is covered, but not everything is covered,” governments must investigate which services are most cost-effective, and which should not be publicly financed, because they are both expensive and ineffective.

zh: 保险服务的数量可以总是与增加居民收入和政府收入状况保持一致。
en: The list of insured services can always grow in step with incomes and government revenues.

zh: 提高烟草税尤其能产生双重效益：一方面可以减少吸烟（成年人死亡的首要原因 ） ， 另一方面政府可以增加收入。
en: In particular, higher tobacco taxes yield a double benefit: they reduce smoking, a leading cause of adult death, and raise revenue.

zh: 中国、印度和南非都致力于推行国民健康保险。
en: China, India, and South Africa have all committed to adopting national health insurance.

zh: 哪个国家可以率先达到这一目标，不仅取决于该国的财政收入多少，而且也取决于是否有克服既得利益的政治意愿。
en: Which country achieves this goal first will depend not only on revenue, but also on the political will to overcome vested interests.

zh: 这也将取决于医疗体系规整合理医疗保健方案、监控医疗服务状况、正确地评估新的治疗方法的能力。
en: It will also depend on institutions’ ability to design rational health care, monitor delivery, and properly assess new treatments.

zh: 美国医疗保健费用非常昂贵，效益低下，所以人们只能寄希望于“奥巴马医改”模型及美国未来的竞争对手实施的改革方案，希望这些方案会推动美国建立长期逾期而未曾兑现的政府资助的普遍卫生保健系统。
en: Health-care costs in the US are exorbitant, with low value for money. One can only hope that “Obamacare,” together with the models being implemented by the US’s future competitors, will nudge the US to adopt a long overdue universal, publicly financed health-care system.

zh: 莫学美联储
en: Don’t Follow The Fed

zh: 美联储面临着两难的困境，因为它需要在美国经济遭到飓风摧残的时候继续提高利率。
en: The US Federal Reserve faces a dilemma, for it needs to continue raising interest rates in the face of a hurricane-devastated economy.

zh: 欧洲央行也需要借鉴美联储未能尽早提息的教训：在漫长的低利率货币稳定期过后，迟迟不把利率提高到更为正常和恰当的水平很可能带来危险的后果。
en: The Fed’s failure to raise rates earlier thus holds a powerful lesson for the European Central Bank: after a prolonged period of monetary stability at unusually low interest rates, waiting too long to raise rates to more normal and appropriate levels holds dangerous consequences.

zh: 美联储迟迟不肯开始利率正常化的过程，现在它要为此付出代价。
en: The Fed was late in beginning the interest-rate normalization process, and it is now paying a price.

zh: 即便与美联储有着不同的经营环境和限制条件，欧洲央行也绝不能犯同样的错误。
en: The ECB must not make the same mistake, even bearing in mind that the two central banks operate in different milieus and under different constraints.

zh: 欧元区内，到处可以看到通货膨胀即将开始的警示迹象。
en: Warning signs of impending inflation abound across the euro zone.

zh: 一段时间以来，货币供应的增长远远超过了目标水准，这是流动能力过强的信号。
en: Money-supply growth has been well above target levels for some time now, indicating excess liquidity.

zh: 9月份的通胀指数超过了欧洲央行2%的目标，达到了2.6%¾对2006年通胀的最新预测也是如此（12月初将公布最新的预测结果 ） 。
en: September headline inflation, at 2.6%, is above the ECB’s 2% target ­– as is the latest forecast for 2006 inflation (updated forecasts will be released at the beginning of December).

zh: “薪金稳定期可能正在接近尾声 ， ” 欧洲央行首席经济学家易辛发出警告，暗示着飞速上涨的能源价格可能正在向整个价格体系内部渗透（这就是所谓的“次轮效应 ” ） 。
en: “The period of wage moderation may be coming to an end,” warns Otmar Issing, the ECB’s chief economist, implying that soaring energy prices may now be feeding through into the overall price level (so-called “second-round effects”).

zh: 在上述情况下，当然找不到延迟提高利率的理由。
en: In these circumstances, there is no good reason to wait to raise interest rates.

zh: 能源价格居高不下的时间越长，就越有可能引发通货膨胀，次轮效应就越有可能成为现实。
en: The longer energy prices remain at their current lofty levels, the greater the probability that inflationary expectations will increase and that second-round effects will materialize.

zh: 欧洲央行进一步拖延利率正常化很可能引发激烈的通货膨胀，给欧洲经济复苏带来灾难性的后果，因为欧洲央行没有其它选择，只能猛踩货币政策的刹车。
en: Further procrastination on interest-rate normalization by the ECB could well lead to a nasty bout of inflation. This would be disastrous for Europe’s economic recovery, as the ECB would have no choice but to slam down hard on the monetary brakes.

zh: 没有人愿意看到这样的状况。
en: No one wants this.

zh: 最好现在就提高50个基准点¾这样就能在控制通胀的同时允许经济继续恢复下去，也比今后让通货膨胀翻三番或四番强。
en: Better a 50-basis-point increase now – thereby allowing the economic recovery to continue by keeping inflation in check – than triple or quadruple that figure down the road.

zh: 古语说得好 ， “ 防患于未然 ” ， 这在货币政策领域的确是再贴切不过的。
en: The old adage that “an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure” applies with particular force to monetary policy.

zh: 从上月举行的欧洲央行管理委员会讨论结果看 ， “ 预防措施”似乎马上就会在欧元区域内付诸实施。
en: Judging from the outcome of last month’s meeting of the ECB’s Governing Council, that “ounce of prevention” appears to be right around the corner for the euro-zone economy.

zh: 实际上，欧洲央行近几个月已经加快了警告通胀危险的步伐¾早前的“我们要警惕”变成了9月份的“我们特别要警惕 ” ， 此后又变成了10月份的“要确保对价格稳定中上涨因素的强烈警惕 ” 。
en: Indeed, the pace of ECB warnings about the risks of inflation has quickened in recent months – the earlier “We are vigilant” became “We are particularly vigilant” in September, which became “Strong vigilance with regard to upside risks to price stability is warranted” in October.

zh: 如果仍然不采取行动，管理委员会就会冒着用尽形容词和丧失信誉的危险。
en: The Governing Council is in danger of running out of adjectives – as well as credibility – if it does not act soon.

zh: 欧洲央行行长让·克洛德·特里谢在10月会议后的新闻发布会上回答问题时态度少有的强硬。
en: The tone of ECB President Jean-Claude Trichet’s comments in the Q & A section of the press conference following the October meeting was unusually hawkish.

zh: 当说到“我们必须阻止次轮效果变为现实”时，特里谢似乎在呼吁人们采取未雨绸缪的措施。
en: Trichet appeared to be calling for a pre-emptive approach when he said, “We must not allow second-round effects to materialize.”

zh: 欧洲央行行长首次愿意当众承认管理委员会在会上讨论了提高利率带来的正面和负面影响。
en: For the first time, the ECB president was willing to admit publicly that the Governing Council had discussed the pros and cons of a rate hike at the meeting.

zh: 尽管如此，10月份的当前利率仍然被形容为“尚属合适 ” ， 这表明欧洲央行还没有下定忍辱负重的决心。
en: Nonetheless, current interest rates were described as “still appropriate” in October, signaling that the ECB has not yet reached a decision to bite the bullet.

zh: 可以肯定的是，出乎意料的经济增长放缓或欧元价值的大幅提升会推迟不可避免的利率飙升。
en: To be sure, an unexpected slowdown in economic activity or a strong rise in the value of the euro could postpone the inevitable rate hike.

zh: 但可以确定的是欧洲央行利用10月的新闻发布会来警告政治家、工会还有市场，宣布长期以来的消极货币政策已经走到了尽头。
en: But what seems clear is that the ECB used the October press conference to warn politicians, trade unions, and the markets that its long period of monetary-policy inactivity is coming to an end.

zh: 退出过程开始了。
en: The exit process has begun.

zh: 不是所有人都为此感到高兴。
en: Not everyone is happy with this news.

zh: 像法国的希拉克、意大利的贝卢斯科尼和欧盟成员国财政部长这样的政客就继续要求保持固定、甚至是更低的利率水平。
en: Politicians – like Jacques Chirac in France, Silvio Berlusconi in Italy, and ECOFIN (the finance ministers of the European Union’s member states) – continue to press for fixed, even lower, interest rates.

zh: 但政治家很容易采用不负责任的货币政策。
en: But it’s easy for politicians to be irresponsible about monetary policy.

zh: 没有人会因为价格疯涨而责怪他们，他们也大可不必为把通胀魔鬼赶回到瓶子里去而煞费苦心。
en: They are not the ones who will be blamed for soaring prices, nor are they the ones who will have to force the inflation genie back into the bottle.

zh: 通过逼迫央行出台低于实际状况的利率政策，政治家们把欧洲央行当成了经济不景气的替罪羊。
en: By constantly pushing for lower interest rates than the ECB can deliver, politicians set the central bank up as a scapegoat for Europe’s poor economic performance.

zh: 他们争辩说，欧洲经济发展缓慢不是由于他们领导结构改革的失败，而是由于利率总是居高不下。
en: Europe is doing badly, they argue, not because of their own failure to lead the structural reform process, but because interest rates are too high.

zh: 与此同时，欧洲央行用不着像美联储那样，连续12次开会把利率提高25个基本点，而且还要继续提高。
en: At the same time, the ECB does not need to go nearly as far as the Fed, which has raised interest rates in increments of 25 basis points at 12 consecutive meetings, with still more to come.

zh: 对于欧洲央行来讲，一次提高50个基本点足可以应付目前的状况¾此后利率可以在相当一段时间内保持稳定。
en: For the ECB, an increase of 50 basis points could do the job at this point – after which rates could probably be put on hold for some time.

zh: 美联储等得实在太久，才启动了利率正常化的进程。 不仅如此，因为它在利率周期的下降阶段拼命地降低利率，所以在目前的上升阶段就必须花费更大的力气，才能把利率提高到恰当的水平。
en: The Fed waited too long to start the normalization process, and, because it was more aggressive in lowering rates in the downward phase of the interest-rate cycle, it has had to be more aggressive in raising them in the upward phase.

zh: 这与欧洲向往或需要的那种灵活的货币政策相去甚远。
en: This is not the type of volatile monetary policy that Europe wants or needs.

zh: 铭记Duisenberg的遗策
en: Don’t Forget Wim Duisenberg’s Legacy

zh: 去年12月欧洲中央银行的利率提升中最让人意外也最具争议的一点就是：该行把利率从两年半以来的超低水平上，提高了仅25个基点，并没有承诺会进一步升息。
en: The most surprising and controversial thing about last December’s rate hike by the European Central Bank was that, after two and a half years of keeping interest rates at exceptionally low levels, the bank ventured an increase of only 25 basis points with no promise of more to come.

zh: 欧洲央行所承受的政治压力可能是造成这一怯懦举动的原因。
en: Political pressure on Europe’s central bank may be the reason for that timid move.

zh: 欧洲央行的现任行长Jean-Claude Trichet与其前任Wim Duisenberg所处的环境达不相同。 这位前任曾说出“我听到政客们的言论，但却并不听从”这句名言。
en: Jean-Claude Trichet, the current ECB president, may be in the same job but not the same environment as his predecessor Wim Duisenberg, who famously remarked, “I hear the politicians, but I don’t listen.”

zh: 而欧洲央行现在所承受的压力要比在Duisenberg的时代大得多。
en: Political pressure on the ECB today is much greater than in Duisenberg’s time.

zh: 政治环境也更为严酷。
en: The political environment is much more hostile.

zh: 有些压力可能对欧洲央行的政策决策产生潜移默化的影响。
en: Some of this pressure may be seeping through and affecting ECB policy decisions.

zh: 这是一种极为负面的情况—也是欧洲央行2006年的最大挑战。 政客们的影响不仅可能造成货币过剩，而这对于一家以价格稳定为第一要务的中央银行而言是非常严重的。
en: This is an extremely negative development ­– and one of the central bank’s biggest challenges for 2006.

zh: 这种过剩还会严重阻碍结构性改革。 而这一改革对于欧洲在充满竞争的全球经济中的繁荣至关重要。
en: Not only will politicians’ influence be towards monetary excess, which of course is a serious enough matter for a bank whose primary mandate is price stability, but also the excess will constitute a serious barrier to structural reform, which is essential for European prosperity in a competitive global economy.

zh: 欧洲的政客们愈渐认为额外流动资金和经济改革可以相互替代。
en: Increasingly, Europe’s politicians regard excess liquidity and economic reform as substitutes for one another.

zh: 央行越是提高货币流动性，政客们就越不肯在改革上花力气。
en: The more the bank gives on liquidity, the less the politicians will do on reform.

zh: Duisenberg认清了这种联系并坚持立场。
en: Duisenberg recognized this linkage and held firm.

zh: 欧洲央行在12月份的微弱升息，加上没有进一步货币紧缩计划的乏力承诺，都表明Trichet不是Duisenberg。
en: The ECB’s paltry rate hike in December, together with the supine promise of no plans for further monetary tightening, demonstrates that Trichet is no Duisenberg.

zh: 欧洲的财政部长们和欧洲央行进行了一场煞费苦心的搏弈。
en: Europe’s finance ministers have played a clever game with the ECB.

zh: 即便他们已经屈从了25基点的利率上升，但这些政客们仍然大张旗鼓地唱反调，其目的在于防止他们真正害怕而却更顺理成章的事发生：一次50基点的利率提升和未来进一步升息的警告。
en: Even though they were already resigned to a 25-basis-point rate increase, the politicians made a big show of being opposed to it, aiming to prevent what they really feared and what was certainly more warranted: a 50-basis-point hike and a warning of more on the way.

zh: 他们的战略奏效了。
en: Their strategy worked.

zh: 卢森堡的财政部长在12月会议之后以外交辞令宣称 ： “ 结果本来会更糟。 ”
en: Luxembourg’s finance minister, Jean-Claude Juncker, diplomatically declared after the December meeting that, “The result could have been worse.”

zh: 的确，就连市场也被愚弄了，它因为这一次毫不起眼的升息给了欧洲央行一个好分数。
en: Indeed, even the markets were fooled, giving the ECB a good grade for its unremarkable rate hike.

zh: 以某些市场工具指标来衡量的通胀预期在升息之后实际有所下降，表明市场对欧洲央行限制价格压力的信心增强。
en: Inflationary expectations, as measured by the rates on certain market instruments, actually fell after the hike, indicating increased confidence that the ECB will keep a lid on price pressures.

zh: 虽然这次微不足道的升息以欧洲央行监管理事会的共识的形式出现，但事实很快表明这一决定是有争议的。
en: Although the meager rate hike was presented as a consensus of the ECB’s Governing Council, it soon became apparent that the decision had been controversial.

zh: 有些理事会成员对Trichet在12月新闻发布会上的鸽派立场感到不快，并在稍后通过媒体表达了他们的不满。
en: Some Council members, unhappy with Trichet’s dovish stance at the December press conference, made their displeasure known via the press soon after.

zh: 德国联邦银行行长Axel Weber在接受《法兰克福汇报》采访时明确地说未来的利率提升已经摆上了台面。
en: In an interview with Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung, for example, Bundesbank president Axel Weber made it clear that future rate hikes were very much on the table.

zh: 其他成员也表明了观点，于是期货市场迅速做出反应，将三月份的期货价格提高了25个基点。
en: Others spoke out as well, and the futures markets quickly predicted another 25-basis-point rate hike in March.

zh: Trichet在12月的新闻发布会上所声称的共识根本不存在。
en: The consensus alleged at the December press conference simply did not exist.

zh: 随着政治压力对欧洲央行政策决策的干预日益明显以及一个虚假的共识，现在的法兰克福弥漫着对过去的好日子和对Wim Duisenberg的怀念也不足为奇，就连他的那些前批评者们也有同感。
en: With political pressures encroaching on the bank’s policy decisions and a faux consensus, it is not surprising that there is now nostalgia in Frankfurt for earlier times and for Wim Duisenberg, even among his former critics.

zh: Duisenberg的高超能力—没有得到报界与公众足够的欣赏—致力于共治，在一个容易意见不和的机构中真正地建立共识，以及用Trichet自己的话讲 ， “ 在高度苛刻和极端敌对的情况下保持魄力的非凡能力。 ”
en: Duisenberg’s great skills – under-appreciated by the press and public alike – were genuine consensus-building in a potentially divisive body and, in Trichet’s own words, “an exceptional ability to keep his nerve in some highly demanding and extremely hostile environments.”

zh: 特别是，这位固执的荷兰人明白在其最高货币管理机构与政客们的关系过于温情的情况下，欧洲所面临的极度危险。 这在欧洲的财政部长们将经济改革和额外流动资金在本质上看成是一回事时更是如此。
en: In particular, the stubborn Dutchman understood the extreme danger if Europe’s top monetary authority became too cozy with Europe’s politicians, especially at a time when many EU finance ministers view economic reform and excess liquidity as being essentially the same thing.

zh: Wim Duisenberg于去年逝世，但他的价值观、哲学和智慧必须被继承下来。
en: Wim Duisenberg died last year, but his values, philosophy, and wisdom must not be allowed to die with him.

zh: 新的一年为Jean-Claude Trichet提供了一次绝好的机会来下定决心：尽管形势更为严峻，他也要在自己的政策和程序中更忠实地反映Duisenberg及其遗策。
en: The New Year provides a perfect opportunity for Jean-Claude Trichet to resolve that, despite the more trying circumstances in which he must operate, his own policies and procedures will more faithfully reflect Duisenberg and his legacy.

zh: 他只有这么做才对得起欧洲。
en: Europe deserves no less.

zh: 不要对非洲关上大门
en: Don’t Shut the Door on Africa

zh: 维也纳 — — 如今，一美元在富裕国家干不了多少事。
en: VIENNA – These days, a dollar won’t get you very far in a rich economy.

zh: 但是在我出生的塞拉利昂这样的穷国，即使半美元也可以挽救一条性命或者让一家人吃上饱饭。
en: But in a poor country like the one I come from, Sierra-Leone, even half a dollar can save a life or feed an entire family.

zh: 投在非洲的每分钱都能起作用，能让非洲拥有更美好的未来。
en: Every penny invested in Africa counts today and to secure Africa’s future.

zh: 专家在这个问题上出奇的一致：金融、食品和能源危机对“生活在底层的十亿人口 ” （ 60个国家中仅靠1天约1美元糊口的最贫困的民众）打击最严重。
en: Experts are unanimous: the financial, food and energy crisis will hammer the “bottom billion” – the poorest in some 60 countries that survive on around a dollar a day – the hardest.

zh: 由于这场危机，许多非洲国家可能无法在2015年的最后期限前实现减轻贫困的千年发展目标。
en: Because of the crisis, many African countries are likely to miss the 2015 deadline for the Millennium Development Goal of poverty reduction.

zh: 非洲大陆过去10年间取得了显著的社会经济成就。
en: The continent has made some significant socio-economic gains over the last decade.

zh: 这些是我在不久前访问贝宁、加纳、埃塞俄比亚、埃及、纳米比亚、尼日利亚、塞内加尔和南非等国家时亲眼所见。
en: I’ve seen this for myself during recent travels to Benin, Ghana, Ethiopia, Egypt, Namibia, Nigeria, Senegal, and South Africa.

zh: 这些国家的成就包括：自由市场改革、经济自由化、持续改善商业环境、妇女赋权和教育。
en: These gains include, to name a few: free-market reforms, liberalization of economies, the steady introduction of pro-business environments, empowerment of women, education.

zh: 但今天这些成就大都遭到了严重的挑战。
en: But most of these gains are now seriously threatened.

zh: 金融危机打击了汇款。
en: The financial crisis has dealt a blow to remittances.

zh: 移民大批失业，或者挣扎着给国内的亲属留出活命钱。
en: Migrants are losing their jobs or struggling to set aside cash for their relatives back home.

zh: 世行最新一次全球经济前景预测表明今年汇款额将下降5%到8 % 。
en: The World Bank's latest global economic outlook suggests remittances will fall by 5% to 8% this year.

zh: 但这不过是数千万笔可追踪汇款的冰山一角。
en: But this is just the tip of the iceberg of the tens of millions that can be tracked.

zh: 外国企业正在撤资，进出口融资也因此而枯竭。
en: Foreign companies are pulling back capital, drying import and export financing.

zh: 贸易额大幅下降。
en: Trade is declining.

zh: 失业率，尤其是青年和妇女等弱势群体的失业率非常惊人。
en: The unemployment rate, especially among disadvantaged groups – young people and women – is staggering.

zh: 只在塞拉利昂一个国家，60%以上的年轻人都处于无业状态。
en: In Sierra-Leone alone, over 60% of the country’s youth are jobless.

zh: 未能帮助“生活在底层的十亿人口”可能引发大范围移民和全球动荡。
en: A failure to help the "bottom billion" could fuel mass migration and global insecurity.

zh: 对最穷的国家视而不见意味着让一场引发饥荒、动荡和大范围移民的大规模危机推迟爆发。
en: Ignoring the poorest nations means postponing a much larger crisis which will lead to famine, unrest, and massive migration.

zh: 贫穷同样能滋生疾病，而合法及非法的移民流动会把这些疾病带到富裕国家。
en: Poverty is also an incubator for diseases, and the flow of legal and illegal migrants will carry them to rich nations.

zh: 贫穷绝不只是‘他们的’问题，同样必须引起‘我们的’关注。
en: Poverty is not just ‘their’ problem. It is ‘our’ problem too.

zh: 如果发展中国家垮掉的话，就会有数百万人来敲我们的门，而他们的首选避难所就是欧洲。
en: If developing countries collapse, there will be millions knocking on our front doors, and the first port of call will be Europe.

zh: 如此大规模的移民迁徙会严重损害某些国家本已紧张的社会关系，引发不可预知的后果。
en: Such mass migration will severely hurt already strained social relations in some countries and lead to unpredictable consequences.

zh: 只有协调一致的全球对策才能确保从长远来看最贫困的十亿人会来欧洲旅游和做生意，而不是寻求避难。
en: Only a coordinated global response can guarantee that in the long run people from the poorest billion will visit Europe as tourists and business partners, not as asylum seekers.

zh: 非洲也必须尽自己的力量。
en: Africa needs to do its share.

zh: 这块大陆需要投资学习参与全球竞争，摆脱对捐助计划和小农经济的过度依赖。
en: It needs investments to shift away from a dependence on a donor-driven agenda and peasant-driven agriculture, and learn to compete on a global level.

zh: 它可以通过工业化和建立统一市场实现可持续发展。
en: It can generate sustainable growth through industrialization, and by creating a single market.

zh: 它需要推动生产和贸易，拓展农工业和农业综合企业，创造财富和新的就业机会。
en: It needs to promote production and trade, expand agribusiness and agro-industries, and create wealth and new jobs.

zh: 发展农业综合企业可以刺激经济增长、推动地区贸易、并同时减轻贫困和改善食品安全。
en: Agribusiness development can stimulate broader economic growth, boost regional trade, and at the same time enhance food security, and reduce poverty.

zh: 发展中国家的许多人可以受益于全球化。
en: Globalization has been good to many in the developing world.

zh: 在如此关键时刻，我们不能让成果付之东流。
en: At this critical moment, we can’t allow this to fade away.

zh: 我们要让全球化惠及更多民众，确保实现下列目标：
en: We need to make this a more inclusive process, and make sure that:

zh: ·        金融资源不断流向非洲和发展中世界，不断推进它们与全球经济的融合；
en: ·        financial resources keep flowing to Africa and the developing world so they continue integrating into the global economy;

zh: ·        防止保护主义，开放市场；
en: ·        protectionism is avoided and markets stay open;

zh: ·        最贫困国家可以通过贸易摆脱贫困；
en: ·        the poorest nations can grow out of poverty through trade;

zh: ·        妥善管理自然资源，推动范围更广，受惠人数更多的经济发展
en: ·        there is good governance of natural resources to fuel broader and inclusive development

zh: 亚洲和其���地区新兴工业化国家的丰富经验可以教授非洲国家如何刺激经济发展，加速创造财富并缓解这块大陆的贫困状况。
en: The abundance of relevant experiences from the newly industrialized countries in Asia and elsewhere can show African countries how to galvanize their economies, accelerating the process of wealth creation and poverty reduction on the continent.

zh: 还有最后一个要点。
en: And last but not least.

zh: 没有能源，就不可能实现发展。
en: Development without access to energy won’t happen.

zh: 这次危机有助于制定新的策略：更多利用可靠、廉价、可再生能源，实现可持续发展，提高能源利用效率，确保经济发展不会消耗更多能源，导致环境恶化，包括引发气候变化。
en: This crisis could help formulate a new approach: increase access to reliable, affordable and renewable energy services for sustainable development, promote energy efficiency to make sure economic growth does not raise energy demand and environmental degradation, including climate change.

zh: 非洲有丰富的水电开发潜力，但迄今为止只有7%得到了开发。
en: Africa has great hydropower potential but only 7% has been exploited so far.

zh: 非洲的天然气占全球总储量的8 % 。
en: Africa’s natural gas reserves amount to about 8% of global reserves.

zh: 石油占全球总储量的十分之一。
en: It has 10% of global oil reserves.

zh: 但发展传统和可再生能源都需要进行巨大的投入。
en: But it requires major investments to develop both traditional energy means and renewable ones.

zh: 伦敦二十国峰会上承诺的一万亿美元究竟如何投向非洲仍不明朗。
en: It is still unclear exactly how much of the $1 trillion pledged at the London G20 summit will find its way to Africa.

zh: 因此我们必须记住这个数字，不停地提醒世界领袖生活在他们阴影之下的发展中世界民众的需求。
en: That’s why we need to keep an eye on the figures and keep reminding world leaders of the needs of those in the developing world that live in their shadow.

zh: 这样可以确定优先政策，把避免人类灾难的对策落到实处，并协助非洲在全球经济谈判中占据一席之地。
en: This will set policy priorities straight, put strategies in place to avert a human catastrophe, and help Africa secure its rightful place at the global economic table.

zh: 自由民主的双重威胁
en: The Double Threat to Liberal Democracy

zh: 坎布里奇—如今，自由民主危机饱受诘难。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The crisis of liberal democracy is roundly decried today.

zh: 特朗普成为美国总统、英国的退欧投票，以及欧洲其他国家民粹主义者在选举中的崛起，与“反自由民主”所带来的威胁遥相呼应 — — 后者是一种极权主义政治，标榜群众选举，但丝毫不尊重法治和少数群体的权利。
en: Donald Trump’s presidency, the Brexit vote in the United Kingdom, and the electoral rise of other populists in Europe have underscored the threat posed by “illiberal democracy” – a kind of authoritarian politics featuring popular elections but little respect for the rule of law or the rights of minorities.

zh: 但较少有分析师指出，反自由民主 — — 或民粹主义 — — 并不是唯一的政治威胁。
en: But fewer analysts have noted that illiberal democracy – or populism – is not the only political threat. Liberal democracy is also being undermined by a tendency to emphasize “liberal” at the expense of “democracy.”

zh: 自由民主还因为一个为强调“自由”不惜牺牲“民主”的趋势的破坏。
en: In this kind of politics, rulers are insulated from democratic accountability by a panoply of restraints that limit the range of policies they can deliver.

zh: 在这种政治中，统治者通过一整套全面的政策约束，来彻底摆脱民主问责。
en: Bureaucratic bodies, autonomous regulators, and independent courts set policies, or they are imposed from outside by the rules of the global economy.

zh: 政治理论家亚查·芒克（Yascha Mounk）在其重要新著《人民与民主 》 （ The People vs. Democracy）中将这类体制 — — 它们与反自由民主构成了恰当的对称 — — “反民主自由 ” 。
en: In his new and important book The People vs. Democracy, the political theorist Yascha Mounk calls this type of regime– in apt symmetry with illiberal democracy – “undemocratic liberalism”.

zh: 他指出，我们的政治体制早已不再像自由民主那样运作，而日益类似于反民主自由。
en: He notes that our political regimes have long stopped functioning like liberal democracies and increasingly look like undemocratic liberalism.

zh: 欧盟也许正是这一趋势的极点。
en: The European Union perhaps represents the apogee of this tendency.

zh: 在政治一体化缺位的情况下成立单一市场和货币联盟需要将政策委托给技术官僚机构，如欧盟委员会、欧洲央行和欧洲法院等。
en: The establishment of a single market and monetary unification in the absence of political integration has required delegation of policy to technocratic bodies such as the European Commission, the European Central Bank, and the European Court of Justice.

zh: 决策日益远离公众的视野。
en: Decision-making increasingly takes place at considerable distance from the public.

zh: 虽然英国并非欧元区成员，但退欧派所提出的“夺回控制权”仍能够直击许多欧洲选民所感到的失望。
en: Even though Britain is not a member of the eurozone, the Brexiteers’ call to “take back control” captured the frustration many European voters feel.

zh: 美国并没有发生这些情况，但类似的趋势让许多人感到被剥夺了公民权。
en: The United States has experienced nothing quite like this, but similar trends have made many people feel disenfranchised.

zh: 芒克指出，决策成为“字母汤”监管机构的自留地 — — 从环境保护署（EPA）到食药监督局（FDA ） 。
en: As Mounk notes, policymaking is the province of an alphabet soup of regulatory bodies – from the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) to the Food and Drug Administration (FDA).

zh: 独立法庭用司法审议的特权来推动民权、扩大生育自由、引入各种其他社会改革，这令它们遭到相当大一部分群众群体的反对。
en: Independent courts’ use of their prerogative of judicial review to promote civil rights, expand reproductive freedom, and introduce many other social reforms have encountered hostility among considerable segments of the population.

zh: 而通过世界贸易组织（WTO）或北美自由贸易协定（NAFTA）等国际安排实现治理的全球经济被广泛认为遭到了操纵，不利于普通工人。
en: And the rules of the global economy, administered through international arrangements such as the World Trade Organization (WTO) or the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA), are widely perceived as being rigged against ordinary workers.

zh: 芒克的书的价值在于同时强调了构成自由民主的两个词的重要性。
en: The value of Mounk’s book is to highlight the importance of both of liberal democracy’s constitutive terms.

zh: 我们需要约束政治权力以防多数人（或权势人物）凌驾于少数人（或无权无势者）的权利之上。
en: We need restraints on the exercise of political power to prevent majorities (or those in power) from riding roughshod over the rights of minorities (or those not in power).

zh: 但我们也需要公共政策响应选举偏好并受其问责。
en: But we also need public policy to be responsive and accountable to the preferences of the electorate.

zh: 自由民主具有内在脆弱性，因为两者的调和并不会产生天然的政治均衡。
en: Liberal democracy is inherently fragile because reconciling its terms does not produce a natural political equilibrium.

zh: 当精英拥有了充分的权力，便不再有兴趣思考公众的总体偏好。
en: When elites have sufficient power, they have little interest in reflecting the preferences of the public at large.

zh: 当群众动员起来要求权力，他们与精英所形成的妥协很少能够产生可以保护在谈判桌前没有带表的人的权利的可持续的守护者。
en: When the masses mobilize and demand power, the resulting compromise with the elites rarely produces sustainable safeguards to protect the rights of those not represented at the bargaining table.

zh: 因此，自由民主有一种向某个反面堕落的倾向 — — 反自由民主或反民主自由。
en: Thus, liberal democracy has a tendency to deteriorate into one or the other of its perversions – illiberal democracy or undemocratic liberalism.

zh: 在我们的文章《自由民主的政治经济学 》 （ The Political Economy of Liberal Democracy）中，沙伦·穆坎德（Sharun Mukand）对自由民主的基础进行了讨论，与芒克不谋而合。
en: In our paper “The Political Economy of Liberal Democracy,” Sharun Mukand and I discuss the underpinnings of liberal democracy in terms similar to those Mounk uses.

zh: 我们强调社会被两股政治裂痕所割裂：将少数人和种族、宗教或意识形态多数人分开的身份裂痕；以及将富人和其他人分开的财富差距。
en: We emphasize that societies are divided by two potential cleavages: an identity split that separates a minority from the ethnic, religious, or ideological majority, and a wealth gap that pits the rich against the rest of society.

zh: 这些裂痕的深度和性状决定了各种政治体制的可能性。
en: The depth and alignment of these divisions determine the likelihood of various political regimes.

zh: 自由民主的可能性永远受到反自由民主或我们所谓的“自由独裁”的制约，具体取决于是多数人还是精英占据上风。
en: The possibility of liberal democracy is always undercut by illiberal democracy at one end and what we call “liberal autocracy” at the other, depending on whether the majority or the elite retain the upper hand.

zh: 我们的框架有助于突出自由民主的产生需要偶然的环境。
en: Our framework helps to highlight the fortuitous circumstances under which liberal democracy emerges.

zh: 在西方，自由先于民主产生：权力分隔、言论自由和法治在精英同意扩大公民权和群众治国（popular rule）之前便已存在。
en: In the West, liberalism preceded democracy: separation of powers, freedom of expression, and the rule of law were already in place before elites agreed to expand the franchise and submit to popular rule.

zh: “多数人的暴政”仍然是精英的一大担忧 ， （ 比如）在美国，人们用精心设计的制衡制度来对付它，长期以来有效束缚了行政部门。
en: The “tyranny of the majority” remained a major concern for elites, and was countered in the US, for example, with an elaborate system of checks and balances, effectively paralyzing the executive for a long time.

zh: 在发展中世界，群众动员发生在自由传统或自由实践尚未形成的情况下。
en: Elsewhere, in the developing world, popular mobilization occurred in the absence of a liberal tradition or liberal practices.

zh: 自由民主很难成为可持续的结果。
en: Liberal democracy was rarely a sustainable outcome.

zh: 唯一的例外韩国等相对平等主义的单一民族国家，这些国家没有显而易见的社会、意识形态、种族或语言分歧可供独裁者利用 — — 不论是反自由独裁者还是反民主独裁者。
en: The only exceptions seem to be relatively egalitarian and highly homogeneous nation-states such as South Korea, where there are no obvious social, ideological, ethnic, or linguistic divisions for autocrats of either kind – illiberal or undemocratic – to exploit.

zh: 欧洲和美国的当今发展态势表明了令人不安的可能性：那里的自由民主也可能已是明日黄花。
en: Today’s developments in Europe and the US suggest the vexing possibility that liberal democracy may have been a passing phase there as well.

zh: 当我们为自由民主危机而悔恨不已的时候，不要忘了反自由并非我们所面临的唯一威胁。
en: As we rue liberal’s democracy’s crisis, let us not forget that illiberalism is not the only threat that confronts it.

zh: 我们还必须找到办法绕过不充分的民主的陷阱。
en: We must find a way around the pitfalls of insufficient democracy as well.

zh: 谨慎之年
en: The Year of Betting Conservatively

zh: 纽约—7月份开始的全球股市反弹正在失去动力，这并不令人奇怪：发达国家和主要新兴市场国家都没有发生增长前景的重大改善，因此反弹总是无根之木。
en: NEW YORK – The upswing in global equity markets that started in July is now running out of steam, which comes as no surprise: with no significant improvement in growth prospects in either the advanced or major emerging economies, the rally always seemed to lack legs.

zh: 如果要预测什么的话，修正走势可能马上就会到来，因为最近几个月的宏观经济数据令人失望。
en: If anything, the correction might have come sooner, given disappointing macroeconomic data in recent months.

zh: 从发达国家开始。 欧元区衰退从外围国蔓延到了核心国，法国步入了算退，德国也陷入了双重夹击 — — 主要出口市场（中国/亚洲）增速减缓，其他市场（南欧）全面萎缩。
en: Starting with the advanced countries, the eurozone recession has spread from the periphery to the core, with France entering recession and Germany facing a double whammy of slowing growth in one major export market (China/Asia) and outright contraction in others (southern Europe).

zh: 美国经济增长继续萎靡，今年大部分时间都只有1.5—2 % ； 而日本正在进入新的衰退。
en: Economic growth in the United States has remained anemic, at 1.5-2% for most of the year, and Japan is lapsing into a new recession.

zh: 英国与欧元区一样，已经开始了双底衰退，而即使是强劲的商品出口国 — — 加拿大、北欧和澳大利亚 — — 也因为美国、欧洲和中国的不振而面临着减速。
en: The United Kingdom, like the eurozone, has already endured a double-dip recession, and now even strong commodity exporters – Canada, the Nordic countries, and Australia – are slowing in the face of headwinds from the US, Europe, and China.

zh: 与此同时，新兴市场经济体 — — 包括所有金砖国家（巴西、俄罗斯、印度和中国）和阿根廷、土耳其和南非等其他大国 — — 在2012年也出现了减速。
en: Meanwhile, emerging-market economies – including all of the BRICs (Brazil, Russia, India, and China) and other major players like Argentina, Turkey, and South Africa – also slowed in 2012.

zh: 在政府最新的财政、货币和信用注入下，中国的减速在近几个季度中已有所缓解；但这样的刺激只能维持中国不可持续的增长模式 — — 太过依赖于固定资产投资和储蓄，太少私人消费支持。
en: China’s slowdown may be stabilized for a few quarters, given the government’s latest fiscal, monetary, and credit injection; but this stimulus will only perpetuate the country’s unsustainable growth model, one based on too much fixed investment and savings and too little private consumption.

zh: 2013年，全球增长下行风险将因财政紧缩扩大到大部分发达国家而被放大。
en: In 2013, downside risks to global growth will be exacerbated by the spread of fiscal austerity to most advanced economies.

zh: 到目前为止，衰退性财政拖累集中在欧元区外围国和英国。
en: Until now, the recessionary fiscal drag has been concentrated in the eurozone periphery and the UK.

zh: 但现在正在向欧元区核心国蔓延。
en: But now it is permeating the eurozone’s core.

zh: 而在美国，即使总统奥巴马和国会共和党在预算计划问题上达成一致，避免跌入“财政悬崖 ” ， 支出削减和税收增加也必将拖累2013年的增长至少1%的GDP。
en: And in the US, even if President Barack Obama and the Republicans in Congress agree on a budget plan that avoids the looming “fiscal cliff,” spending cuts and tax increases will invariably lead to some drag on growth in 2013 – at least 1% of GDP.

zh: 在日本，地震后重建财政刺激将退出，2014年将启动新的消费税。
en: In Japan, the fiscal stimulus from post-earthquake reconstruction will be phased out, while a new consumption tax will be phased in by 2014.

zh: 因此，IMF认为大部分发达国家步调一致地采取过度前瞻的财政紧缩将恶化2013年的全球增长前景是完全正确的。
en: The International Monetary Fund is thus absolutely right in arguing that excessively front-loaded and synchronized fiscal austerity in most advanced economies will dim global growth prospects in 2013.

zh: 那么，又是什么让最近的美国和全球资产市场发生了反弹。
en: So, what explains the recent rally in US and global asset markets?

zh: 答案很简单：中央银行再一次祭出了流动性大杀器，这给了风险资产一剂强心剂。
en: The answer is simple: Central banks have turned on their liquidity hoses again, providing a boost to risky assets.

zh: 美联储采取了激进的无期限量化宽松（QE ） 。
en: The US Federal Reserve has embraced aggressive, open-ended quantitative easing (QE).

zh: 欧洲央行所宣布的“直接货币交易”计划降低了欧元区外围国主权债务危机和货币联盟崩溃的风险。
en: The European Central Bank’s announcement of its “outright market transactions” program has reduced the risk of a sovereign-debt crisis in the eurozone periphery and a breakup of the monetary union.

zh: 英格兰银行从QE转向了CE（信用宽松 ） ， 日本银行则再度增加了QE操作规模。
en: The Bank of England has moved from QE to CE (credit easing), and the Bank of Japan has repeatedly increased the size of its QE operations.

zh: 许多其他发达国家和新兴国家的货币当局也削减了政策利率。
en: Monetary authorities in many other advanced and emerging-market economies have cut their policy rates as well.

zh: 而在低增长、低通胀、近零短期利率和更多QE的环境下，大部分发达国家的长期利率维持在低水平（欧元区外围国是例外，它们的主权风险仍然相对较高 ） 。
en: And, with slow growth, subdued inflation, near-zero short-term interest rates, and more QE, longer-term interest rates in most advanced economies remain low (with the exception of the eurozone periphery, where sovereign risk remains relatively high).

zh: 因此，毫不奇怪，渴望收益率的投资者纷纷涌入股市、商品、信用工具和新兴市场货币。
en: It is small wonder, then, that investors desperately searching for yield have rushed into equities, commodities, credit instruments, and emerging-market currencies.

zh: 但如今，全球市场修正或许已经开始。 主要原因是增长前景黯淡。
en: But now a global market correction seems underway, owing, first and foremost, to the poor growth outlook.

zh: 与此同时，尽管欧洲央行果断行动，成立银行、财政、经济和政治联盟的谈判也在进行中，但欧元区危机仍未解决。
en: At the same time, the eurozone crisis remains unresolved, despite the ECB’s bold actions and talk of a banking, fiscal, economic, and political union.

zh: 特别地，希腊、葡萄牙、西班牙和意大利仍然岌岌可危，而欧元区核心国已经产生了援助疲劳。
en: Specifically, Greece, Portugal, Spain, and Italy are still at risk, while bailout fatigue pervades the eurozone core.

zh: 此外，在财政、债务、税收和监管诸领域充满了政治和政策不确定性。
en: Moreover, political and policy uncertainties – on the fiscal, debt, taxation, and regulatory fronts – abound.

zh: 在美国，财政担忧是三重的：若不能达成政治协议，则2013年将自动发生税收增加和大规模支出削减的“悬崖”风险；债务上限问题上党派斗争死灰复燃；以及中期财政紧缩的新斗争。
en: In the US, the fiscal worries are threefold: the risk of a “cliff” in 2013, as tax increases and massive spending cuts kick in automatically if no political agreement is reached; renewed partisan combat over the debt ceiling; and a new fight over medium-term fiscal austerity.

zh: 在许多其他国家和地区 — — 比如中国、韩国、日本、以色列、德国、意大利和加泰罗尼亚 — — 即将到来的选举和政治过渡也会产生增加政策不确定性的效果。
en: In many other countries or regions – for example, China, Korea, Japan, Israel, Germany, Italy, and Catalonia – upcoming elections or political transitions have similarly increased policy uncertainty.

zh: 发生修正走势还有另一个原因：股市估值正在提高：市盈率正处在高位，而每股收益增长缓慢，由于增长和通胀都很低，未来很可能发生出人意料的每股收益下降。
en: Yet another reason for the correction is that valuations in stock markets are stretched: price/earnings ratios are now high, while growth in earnings per share is slackening, and will be subject to further negative surprises as growth and inflation remain low.

zh: 在不确定性、波动性和尾部风险再度上升的环境下，修正走势可能会快速加速。
en: With uncertainty, volatility, and tail risks on the rise again, the correction could accelerate quickly.

zh: 事实上，如今地缘政治不确定性也在增加：由于谈判和制裁可能都无法阻止伊朗开发核武器实力的动作，伊朗-以色列军事冲突风险仍然很高；以色列和加沙哈马斯可能爆发新战争；阿拉伯之春可能会演变为经济、社会和政治动荡的严冬；而中国、韩国、日本、中国台湾、菲律宾和越南的领土纠纷正在点燃民族主义力量。
en: Indeed, there are now greater geopolitical uncertainties as well: the risk of an Iran-Israel military confrontation remains high as negotiations and sanctions may not deter Iran from developing nuclear-weapons capacity; a new war between Israel and Hamas in Gaza is likely; the Arab Spring is turning into a grim winter of economic, social, and political instability; and territorial disputes in Asia between China, Korea, Japan, Taiwan, the Philippines, and Vietnam are inflaming nationalist forces.

zh: 随着消费者、企业和投资者变得更加谨慎和风险厌恶，2012年下半年的股市反弹已经见顶。
en: As consumers, firms, and investors become more cautious and risk-averse, the equity-market rally of the second half of 2012 has crested.

zh: 而由于发达国家和新兴市场都面临着严重的下行风险，修正走势可能只是2013年全球经济和金融市场糟糕表现的开端。
en: And, given the seriousness of the downside risks to growth in advanced and emerging economies alike, the correction could be a bellwether of worse to come for the global economy and financial markets in 2013.

zh: 打倒债务重压
en: Down with Debt Weight

zh: 伦敦—全球金融危机爆发已近四年，许多人感到奇怪，为何经济复苏需要如此之长的时间。
en: LONDON – Nearly four years after the start of the global financial crisis, many are wondering why economic recovery is taking so long.

zh: 事实上，甚至连专家都对此不得其解。
en: Indeed, its sluggishness has confounded even the experts.

zh: 按IMF的预计，世界经济应该在2011年增长4.4 % ， 在2012年增长4.5 % 。
en: According to the International Monetary Fund, the world economy should have grown by 4.4% in 2011, and should grow by 4.5% in 2012.

zh: 而事实上，世界银行的最新数据表明，2011年的增长率只有2.7 % ， 今年则将减缓至2.5 % — —就是这个数字也可能被向下修正。
en: In fact, the latest figures from the World Bank indicate that growth reached just 2.7% in 2011, and will slow this year to 2.5% – a figure that may well need to be revised downwards.

zh: 预测和实际结果不符，可能的原因有二。
en: There are two possible reasons for the discrepancy between forecast and outcome.

zh: 要么是金融危机所造成的损害比人们意识到的更严重，要么经济药方的疗效比政客所认为的更低。
en: Either the damage caused by the financial crisis was more serious than people realized, or the economic medicine prescribed was less efficacious than policymakers believed.

zh: 事实上，人们很快就抓住了银行危机的重心。
en: In fact, the gravity of the banking crisis was quickly grasped.

zh: 2008—2009年期间，在美国和中国的领导、英国的协作以及德国不太情愿的支持下，巨量刺激得以实施。
en: Huge stimulus packages were implemented in 2008-9, led by the United States and China, coordinated by Britain, and with the reluctant support of Germany.

zh: 利率大幅下降，资不抵债的银行得到了援助，印钞机开足马力，税收被削减，公共支出则大增。
en: Interest rates were slashed, insolvent banks were bailed out, the printing presses were turned on, taxes were cut, and public spending was boosted.

zh: 一些国家还贬值了本国货币。
en: Some countries devalued their currencies.

zh: 结果，形势得到了控制，并出现了比预期更猛的反弹。
en: As a result, the slide was halted, and the rebound was faster than forecasters expected.

zh: 但刺激措施将银行危机转换为了财政和主权债务危机。
en: But the stimulus measures transformed a banking crisis into a fiscal and sovereign-debt crisis.

zh: 2010年以降，为了应对人们对主权违约的担心，各国政府开始增税减支。
en: From 2010 onwards, governments started to raise taxes and cut spending in response to growing fears of sovereign default.

zh: 从那时开始，复苏之势被逆转了。
en: At that point, the recovery went into reverse.

zh: 正如莱因哈特（Carmen Reinhart）和罗格夫（Kenneth Rogoff）在他们的《这次不同了 》 （ This Time is Different）中所言，对付深度银行危机，没有包管用的灵药。
en: As Carmen Reinhart and Kenneth Rogoff tell it in their masterly book This Time is Different, there is no secure way of short-circuiting a deep banking crisis.

zh: 危机起源于“债务的过度积累 ” ， 债务过度积累导致经济“易受信心危机打击 ” 。
en: The crisis originates with “excessive debt accumulation,” which makes economies “vulnerable to crises of confidence.”

zh: 政府不得不出售援助商业银行；接着，又不得不等着商业银行来救。
en: Commercial banks have to be bailed out by governments; then governments have to be bailed out by commercial banks.

zh: 最后，政府和商业银行都不得不靠中央银行施以援手。
en: In the end, both have to be bailed out by central banks.

zh: 在莱因哈特和罗格夫看来，所有这些都包括在“漫长而严重的经济活动收缩”中。
en: All of this, according to Reinhart and Rogoff, involves a “protracted and pronounced contraction in economic activity.”

zh: 他们指出，二战以来，如若危机爆发，则在信心危机结束、经济恢复增长后还将平均持续4.4年 — — 这是必须的“去杠杆化”所需要的时间。
en: They reckon that the average length of post-war crises has been 4.4 years – the time it takes for the necessary “de-leveraging” to occur – after which the crisis of confidence is over and economic growth revives.

zh: 但是，这并不是故事的全部。
en: However, there is something missing in the story.

zh: 大萧条之后的复苏持续了10年，比二战后的平均复苏长度长一倍有余。
en: Recovery from the Great Depression took about 10 years, more than twice the post-war average.

zh: 莱因哈特和罗格夫给出了一些大萧条后复苏增长缓慢的原因：一是政策反应速度太慢，而是金本位（金本位意味着各国无法通过出口走出萧条 ） 。
en: Reinhart and Rogoff offer a couple of reasons for the difference in recovery rates: the slow policy response to the Great Depression and the gold standard, which meant that individual countries could not export their way out of depression.

zh: 换句话说，财政政策和货币政策机制在崩溃的深度和经济复苏所经历的时间长度上均具有决定性的影响。
en: In other words, fiscal policy and the monetary-policy regime have a decisive influence both on the depth of the collapse and how long before the economy recovers.

zh: 同样显著的是，20世纪五六十年代期间，凯恩斯主义主宰着经济治理，同时布雷顿森林体系管理着汇率，在此期间基本没有发生危机，而在20世纪70年代，金融崩溃卷土重来。
en: It is also significant that big financial collapses occurred again in the 1970’s, after being virtually absent in the 1950’s and 1960’s, when the Keynesian system of managed economies and the Bretton Woods system of managed exchange rates was in place.

zh: 莱因哈特和罗格夫所考察的战后危机均发生在1977—2001年间。
en: The major post-war crises that Reinhart and Rogoff consider run from 1977 to 2001.

zh: 这些危机之所以发生，是因为银行监管和资本管制被取消；而它们的持续时间之所以短于20世纪30年代，是因为政策反应不再那么呆板。
en: They occurred because regulation of banks and controls on capital movements were lifted; they were shorter than in the 1930’s because the policy responses were not idiotic.

zh: 印尼总统苏西洛在本月早些时候强调也强调了这一点，他不无得意地对英国首相卡梅伦说，印尼在1998年危机后的成功复苏是受了凯恩斯的启发。
en: Indonesian president Susilo Bambang Yudhoyono emphasized that point earlier this month, boasting to British Prime Minister David Cameron that Indonesia’s successful recovery plan after the 1998 collapse was inspired by John Maynard Keynes.

zh: “我们必须保证人们能够买东西；我们必须保证工业能够生产东西 … … ”
en: “We must ensure that the people can buy; we must ensure that industries can produce…”

zh: 如今，不少国家，特别是欧元区国家，似乎已无多少政策选择。
en: Today, many governments, especially in the eurozone, seem to have run out of policy options.

zh: 在财政紧缩成为时尚的当下，它们实际上放弃了“人们能够买东西”和“工业能够生产东西”的策略。
en: With fiscal austerity all the rage, they have given up ensuring that “people can buy” and “industries can produce.”

zh: 各中央银行已经接过了维持经济增长的重任，但它们印出来的钞票大部分被截留在了银行体系中，无法刺激停滞的消费和萎靡的投资。
en: Central banks have been handed the job of keeping economies afloat, but most of the money that they print remains stuck in the banking system, unable to arrest stagnating consumption and falling investment.

zh: 此外，欧元区本身是一个迷你金本位区，重债成员国无法贬值货币，因为没有货币可贬。
en: Moreover, the eurozone itself is a mini-gold standard, with heavily indebted members unable to devalue their currencies, because they have no currencies to devalue.

zh: 因此，在中国增长也开始放缓的情况下，世界经济似乎注定要走一段时间触底之路，一些国家的失业率正在攀向或超过了20 % 。
en: So, given that Chinese growth, too, is slowing, the world economy seems destined to crawl along the bottom for some time yet, with unemployment rising in some countries to 20% or more.

zh: 财政、货币和汇率方面皆已无计可施，还有什么办法走出漫长的衰退？
en: With fiscal, monetary, and exchange-rate policies blocked, is there a way out of prolonged recession?

zh: 耶鲁大学的吉安纳科普洛斯（John Geanakoplos）提出了大规模债务减记的办法。
en: John Geanakoplos of Yale University has been arguing for big debt write-offs.

zh: 政府不应该坐等破产来摆脱债务，而应该“强行免除债务 ” 。
en: Rather than waiting to get rid of debt through bankruptcies, governments should “mandate debt forgiveness.”

zh: 它们可以从贷款人手中购买不良贷款，并免除部分可偿还本金，同时降低贷款人的抵押品要求和借款人的债务积压。
en: They could buy bad loans from lenders and forgive part of the principal payable by borrowers, simultaneously reducing lenders’ collateral requirements and borrowers’ debt overhang.

zh: 在美国，定期资产抵押政权贷款便利（Term Asset-Backed Securities Loan Facility，TALF）和公私投资计划（Public-Private Investment Program，PPIP）便是事实上的以次级按揭贷款持有者为目标的债务免除机制，但规模实在太小。
en: In the US, the Term Asset-Backed Securities Loan Facility (TALF) program and the Public-Private Investment Program (PPIP) were in effect debt-forgiveness schemes aimed at sub-prime mortgage holders, but on too small a scale.

zh: 但债务豁免的原则显然同样适用于公债，特别是欧元区公债。
en: But the principle of debt forgiveness clearly has applications for public debt as well, especially in the eurozone.

zh: 担心公债过剩的是持有公债的银行。
en: Those who fear excessive public debt are the banks that hold it.

zh: 对它们来说，垃圾公债并不比垃圾私债更安全。
en: Junk public bonds are no safer for them than junk private bonds.

zh: 贷款人和借款人都能从全面的债务豁免中获益。
en: Both lenders and borrowers would be better off from a comprehensive debt cancelation.

zh: 生活因政府急不可耐地实行去杠杆化而大受困扰的公民的境况也可以得到改善。
en: So would citizens whose livelihoods are being destroyed by governments’ desperate attempts to de-leverage.

zh: 从原理上说，债务豁免方法的基础是人们相信债权人将和债务人分担违约责任，因为当初给出不良贷款的乃是债权人。
en: Philosophically, the debt-forgiveness approach rests on the belief that creditors share culpability for defaults with debtors, since they made the bad loans in the first place.

zh: 只要借款人在获得贷款时没有糊弄贷款人，那么贷款人就至少要为贷款交易负一定的责任。
en: As long as the borrower has not misled the lender at the time of taking the loan, the lender bears at least some responsibility for the transaction.

zh: 1918年时，凯恩斯敦促豁免协约国内部因一战而产生的债务。
en: In 1918, Keynes urged the cancelation of inter-Allied debts arising from World War I.

zh: “我们根本无法前进，除非我们的四肢可以从纸镣铐中解放出来 ， ” 凯恩斯写道。
en: “We shall never be able to move again, unless we can free our limbs from these paper shackles,” he wrote.

zh: 1923年，他的呼吁变成了警告，当下的决策者们想必会认真留心到 ： “ 契约绝对论者 … … 才是真正的革命孕育者。 ”
en: And, in 1923, his call became a warning that today’s policymakers would do well to heed: “The absolutists of contract…are the real parents of revolution.”

zh: 打倒人权
en: Down With Human Rights

zh: 联合国与人权运动之间的关系一直含混不清。
en: The relationship between the United Nations and the human-rights movement has always been ambiguous.

zh: 一方面，人权这种意识形态¾就像过去的共产主义和现在的新自由主义一样，人权的确是一种意识形态¾从本质上来讲墨守陈规，依靠各项条约和其它国际国内协定确保其合法性。
en: On the one hand, human-rights ideology – and it is an ideology, every bit as much as Communism was or neo-liberalism is today – is profoundly legalist, claiming legitimacy from treaties and other international and national instruments.

zh: 这里面首当其冲的是《联合国1948年世界人权宣言 》 。
en: These include, as “first among equals,” the UN’s 1948 Universal Declaration of Human Rights.

zh: 联合国是现代人权运动的发祥地，从很多方面来讲，人权运动从发端后从未真正离开过这里。
en: The modern human-rights movement was born out of the UN, and in many ways it has never entirely left home.

zh: 从另一个方面，与其说联合国是通往世界政府之路的中转站，还不如说它是颁布人权、平等、以及个人和经济自由领域崇高理想的头号讲坛（不管美国的某些保守极端分子做何感想 ） 。
en: On the other hand, the UN is more a bully pulpit for the promulgation of the high ideals of human rights, equality, and personal and economic freedom than it is a way station on the road to world government (no matter what some conservative extremists in the United States imagine).

zh: 实际上，作为一个政府间机构，联合国制度的核心是所有官员，下至最低级的雇员，上至联合国秘书长，都必须为成员国，特别是强国的利益服务。
en: Indeed, at its institutional core, the UN is an inter-governmental body whose officials, from the most junior staffer to the Secretary General, serve at the pleasure of its member states – above all, its powerful member states.

zh: 这种理想与现实间不可调和的矛盾造成了联合国一方面能实现某些人权目标，而另一方面却又阻碍着某些目标的实现。
en: As a result of this profound contradiction between ambition and mandate, the UN often seems to impede the advance of human-rights goals as much as it realizes them.

zh: 质疑者只要想想从吴丹到科菲·安南的历任联合国秘书长都不愿会见，甚至在某些情况下不愿在联合国办公地接待那些不幸出生在强大国家的破坏人权行为的受害者就非常清楚了。
en: Doubters need only recall the unwillingness of Secretary General after Secretary General, from U Thant to Kofi Annan, to meet with – or, in some cases, even to permit on the UN’s premises – victims of human rights violations who had the misfortune of being born in powerful countries.

zh: 尽管联合国在理智上致力于推进人权运动的发展，但它却没有傻到为了接待来自西藏或车臣的活动人士而激起中国或俄国人的不满。
en: For all the UN’s intellectual commitment to the furtherance of human rights, it knows better than to incite the displeasure of the Chinese or the Russians by receiving activists from Tibet or Chechnya.

zh: 公平地讲，没有任何一位联合国秘书长对人权运动理想的尊重超过了科菲·安南，也没有任何人比安南更愿意把人权理想与联合国运作结合在一起，哪怕这种结合仅仅停留在口头上。
en: In fairness, no UN Secretary General has paid greater homage to the ideals of the human-rights movement, or attempted, at least rhetorically, to associate the UN with those ideals, than Kofi Annan.

zh: 当然，只是口头上说说并不等于现实，联合国的宣言常常与日常运作相去甚远。
en: Rhetoric is not reality, of course, and the UN’s declarations have often seemed far removed from its daily practice.

zh: 但语言也并非毫无作用，的确很少有人质疑在安南任职期间，人权问题在国际权衡中所占的分量超过了以往任何时候。
en: But words are not without consequences, and there is little question that human rights has occupied a higher place in international deliberations during Annan’s tenure than ever before.

zh: 不仅如此，被安南任命为联合国人权事务高级专员的前爱尔兰总统玛丽·罗滨逊对很多发展中国家采纳人权议程起到了至关重要的作用，这种人权日程以前常常被看作西方国家干涉别国内政十分现成的借口。
en: Moreover, Annan’s appointee as UN High Commissioner for Human Rights, former Irish President Mary Robinson, was instrumental in many developing countries’ adoption of a human-rights agenda, which previously was often viewed as a flag of convenience for Western meddling.

zh: 据安南身边的人透露，秘书长希望在联合国最近结束的会议上进一步扩大胜利的成果。
en: People close to Annan say that he hoped to build on these successes during the UN’s recently concluded summit.

zh: 他在三月份写道 “ （ 联合国）机构[必须]像重视安全发展一样重视人权事业。
en: In March, he wrote that “the Organization [must] take the cause of human rights as seriously as those of security and development.”

zh: ”他重要的提案之一就是用新的人权理事会取代已经失去人们信任的联合国人权委员会，该委员会甚至没有将利比亚、古巴或津巴布韦等臭名昭著的人权侵害国排除在外的起码机制，而新的机构至少在理论上将不再容忍这种令人尴尬的局面继续存在。
en: Among his key proposals was the replacement of the largely discredited UN Commission on Human Rights – a body that has no mechanism for excluding even notorious human-rights violators like Libya, Cuba, or Zimbabwe – with a new Human Rights Council, where such embarrassments would in theory not be tolerated.

zh: 人们普遍认为，这次会议在很大程度上是一次失败。
en: It is generally agreed that the summit was largely a failure.

zh: 安南本人也在第60届联合国大会的开幕讲话中明确承认了这种观点。
en: Annan himself conceded as much in the speech he gave at the opening of the 60th UN General Assembly.

zh: 导致失败的原因一言难尽。
en: There are many reasons for this.

zh: 其中既有美国政府在最后时刻将反对会议声明的几百项不同意见置之不理，从而把这份声明缩减为没有任何实质意义的陈词滥调；也有发展中国家对联合国的更多努力是否诚如安南所言尚存疑虑，他们害怕所谓的人权运动不过又是一个现成的借口¾甚至更糟，沦为西方军事干涉的法律依据。
en: There was the US government’s eleventh-hour decision to table hundreds of objections to the final Summit Declaration, effectively reducing it to a series of lowest-common-denominator platitudes. There was also skepticism among developing countries about whether a stronger UN commitment to human rights was what Annan claimed it to be or, instead, merely a moral flag of convenience – or worse, a legal warrant for Western military intervention.

zh: 布什总统不久前任命的美国驻联合国大使，激进的反联合国外交家约翰·博尔顿所提出的战略引起了人们的广泛关注，这种关注也确实恰如其分。
en: A great deal of attention has been paid to the stratagems of John Bolton, the fiercely anti-UN diplomat whom President Bush recently appointed US ambassador to the UN, and rightly so.

zh: 但这样的讨论忽略了第三世界怀疑论有害的协同作用：即所谓的人道主义干涉不过是殖民主义的又一次回潮，或者是奉行单边主义的美国政府对被其视作人权破坏国的敌人发起的又一次先发制人的战争。
en: But what has tended to get lost in these discussions are the malign synergies between a Third World suspicious that so-called humanitarian interventions are only colonialism redux and a unilateralist US administration wedded to the concept of pre-emptive war against enemies that it equates with states that violate human rights.

zh: 由于布什政府的官员一再强调建立民主、以人权为导向的政治制度是美国外交政策的核心，并且为确保上述核心在必要时甚至不惜使用武力，更使得那些只在美国入侵阿富汗和伊拉克的行动中看到了侵略性帝国主义的人们对所谓的人权事业疑心重重。
en: Because the Bush administration, as its officials repeatedly insist, placed the installation of democratic, human-rights-oriented regimes, by force if necessary, at the core of US foreign policy, those who see only aggressive imperialism in America’s interventions in Afghanistan and Iraq view human rights in a more skeptical light.

zh: 从某种意义上讲，曾是布什最有力支持者的联合国、安南和人权活动人士都因此陷入了困境。
en: In a sense, the UN, Annan, and the human-rights activists who have been perhaps his biggest backers, are caught in the crossfire.

zh: 所有这一切都让我想起了伟大的西班牙导演路易斯·布努艾尔的最新力作。
en: All of this brings to mind one of the great Spanish director Luis Buñuel’s late films.

zh: 这部还未上映就获得好评的影片表现了���群反对拿破仑统治的西班牙游击队员被带到一堵墙边等待执行死刑。
en: The pre-credit sequence shows a group of Spanish guerrillas during the insurgency against Napoleon being led to a wall where they are to be executed by firing squad.

zh: 执行开始时，一名法国士兵扛着三色旗走上前去，上面写着那几个伟大的字眼 ， “ 自由、平等、友爱。
en: At the head of the firing party, a French soldier carries the Tricolor forward. On it are the great words, “Liberty, Equality, Fraternity.”

zh: ”游记队员们被带到墙边，正当士兵们把枪举过肩膀时，一名起义者高喊 ， “ 打倒自由！
en: The guerrillas are led to the wall, and, just as the soldiers are raising their guns to their shoulders, one insurgent shouts, “Down with liberty!”

zh: ”看起来我们现在也没走多远。
en: We have not progressed very far, it seems.

zh: 欧元区的末日
en: Down with the Eurozone

zh: 纽约 — — 欧元区危机似乎正在达到高潮，希腊在违约边缘苦苦徘徊，几乎要可耻地退出货币联盟了；如今意大利也即将失去市场信任。
en: NEW YORK – The eurozone crisis seems to be reaching its climax, with Greece on the verge of default and an inglorious exit from the monetary union, and now Italy on the verge of losing market access.

zh: 但欧元区的问题远不止这些。
en: But the eurozone's problems are much deeper.

zh: 欧元区的问题是结构性的，而且严重影响着至少四个国家：爱尔兰、葡萄牙、塞浦路斯和西班牙。
en: They are structural, and they severely affect at least four other economies: Ireland, Portugal, Cyprus, and Spain.

zh: 在过去十年中，五猪国（PIIGS，葡萄牙、爱尔兰、意大利、希腊和西班牙）是欧元区最初和最后消费者，支出比收入更多，并存在前所未有的经常项目赤字。
en: For the last decade, the PIIGS (Portugal, Ireland, Italy, Greece, and Spain) were the eurozone's consumers of first and last resort, spending more than their income and running ever-larger current-account deficits.

zh: 与此同时，欧元区核心国（德国、荷兰、奥地利和法国）则组成了最初和最后生产者阵营，支出比收入更少，并存在前所未有的经常项目盈余。
en: Meanwhile, the eurozone core (Germany, the Netherlands, Austria, and France) comprised the producers of first and last resort, spending below their incomes and running ever-larger current-account surpluses.

zh: 这些外部失衡被2002年以来欧元的强势以及欧元区内部真实汇率和竞争力的两极分化所强化了。
en: These external imbalances were also driven by the euro’s strength since 2002, and by the divergence in real exchange rates and competitiveness within the eurozone.

zh: 德国和其他核心国家的单位劳动成本有所下降（因为工资增长赶不上生产率 ） ， 导致了真实汇率的贬值和经常项目盈余的增加，而五猪国（以及塞浦路斯）的情况正好相反，它们出现了真实汇率的升值和经常项目赤字的恶化。
en: Unit labor costs fell in Germany and other parts of the core (as wage growth lagged that of productivity), leading to a real depreciation and rising current-account surpluses, while the reverse occurred in the PIIGS (and Cyprus), leading to real appreciation and widening current-account deficits.

zh: 在爱尔兰和西班牙，私人储蓄急剧下降，同时房地产泡沫助长了过度消费之风；而希腊、葡萄牙、塞浦路斯和意大利的问题则是过度财政负债恶化了外部失衡问题。
en: In Ireland and Spain, private savings collapsed, and a housing bubble fueled excessive consumption, while in Greece, Portugal, Cyprus, and Italy, it was excessive fiscal deficits that exacerbated external imbalances.

zh: 由此产生的过度消费国的私人公共部门债务积累随着房地产泡沫破裂（爱尔兰和西班牙）以及经常项目赤字或财政缺口（或两者兼而有之）在整个欧元区外围变得不可持续而变得难以收场。
en: The resulting build-up of private and public debt in over-spending countries became unmanageable when housing bubbles burst (Ireland and Spain) and current-account deficits, fiscal gaps, or both became unsustainable throughout the eurozone's periphery.

zh: 此外，外围国家的巨额经常项目赤字 — — 受过度消费推动 — — 伴随着经济停滞和竞争力的丧失。
en: Moreover, the peripheral countries’ large current-account deficits, fueled as they were by excessive consumption, were accompanied by economic stagnation and loss of competitiveness.

zh: 如之奈何？
en: So, now what?

zh: 系统性再通胀是重塑欧元区外围国增长和竞争力的最佳选择，但须辅之以必要的紧缩措施和结构性改革。
en: Symmetrical reflation is the best option for restoring growth and competitiveness on the eurozone's periphery while undertaking necessary austerity measures and structural reforms.

zh: 这意味着欧洲央行大举放松货币政策；向流动性不足但仍未破产的经济体提供无限量最后贷款支持；欧元急剧贬值从而将经常项目赤字扭转为盈余；以及欧元区核心国在外围国被迫实施紧缩时实施财政刺激。
en: This implies significant easing of monetary policy by the European Central Bank; provision of unlimited lender-of-last-resort support to illiquid but potentially solvent economies; a sharp depreciation of the euro, which would turn current-account deficits into surpluses; and fiscal stimulus in the core if the periphery is forced into austerity.

zh: 不幸的是，德国和欧洲央行反对这一选择，因为这会使核心国的通胀暂时略高于外围国。
en: Unfortunately, Germany and the ECB oppose this option, owing to the prospect of a temporary dose of modestly higher inflation in the core relative to the periphery.

zh: 德国和欧洲央行计划对外围国实施第二选择，这个药方更为痛苦，是衰退性紧缩：财政紧缩、结构性改革以提振生产率并降低单位劳动成本，以及通过价格调整实现的真是贬值（而不是名义汇率调整 ） 。
en: The bitter medicine that Germany and the ECB want to impose on the periphery – the second option – is recessionary deflation: fiscal austerity, structural reforms to boost productivity growth and reduce unit labor costs, and real depreciation via price adjustment, as opposed to nominal exchange-rate adjustment.

zh: 这一选择会带来诸多问题。
en: The problems with this option are many.

zh: 首先，财政紧缩虽然必不可少，但会在短期加深衰退。
en: Fiscal austerity, while necessary, means a deeper recession in the short term.

zh: 即使是结构性改革，也会在短期降低产出水平，因为这要求解雇员工、关闭亏钱企业，并逐渐将劳动和资本重新配置给新兴产业。
