en: Even structural reform reduces output in the short run, because it requires firing workers, shutting down money-losing firms, and gradually reallocating labor and capital to emerging new industries.

zh: 因此，为了防止产生前所未有的衰退螺旋，外围国需要真实贬值以改善外部赤字。
en: So, to prevent a spiral of ever-deepening recession, the periphery needs real depreciation to improve its external deficit.

zh: 但即使价格和工资在未来数年内下降30 % （ 这很有可能引发社会和政治的不可持续性 ） ， 债务的真实价值仍将显著上升，让政府和���人债务人深陷资不抵债泥潭。
en: But even if prices and wages were to fall by 30% over the next few years (which would most likely be socially and politically unsustainable), the real value of debt would increase sharply, worsening the insolvency of governments and private debtors.

zh: 简言之，欧元区外围国已难逃节约悖论（paradox of thrift ） ： 太快太大地增加储蓄导致新一轮衰退，让债务愈加不可持续。
en: In short, the eurozone's periphery is now subject to the paradox of thrift: increasing savings too much, too fast leads to renewed recession and makes debts even more unsustainable.

zh: 而如今，甚至连核心国也受到了节约悖论的影响。
en: And that paradox is now affecting even the core.

zh: 如果外围国陷入债务高企、产出下降、竞争力疲软和结构性外部赤字的通缩性陷阱无法自拔，那么它们最终将面临第三选择：违约并退出欧元区。
en: If the peripheral countries remain mired in a deflationary trap of high debt, falling output, weak competitiveness, and structural external deficits, eventually they will be tempted by a third option: default and exit from the eurozone.

zh: 这样做能让它们通过让新的本国货币贬值重塑经济增长和竞争力。
en: This would enable them to revive economic growth and competitiveness through a depreciation of new national currencies.

zh: 当然，这样一种欧元区无序崩溃将产生不亚于2008年雷曼兄弟倒闭的冲击波。
en: Of course, such a disorderly eurozone break-up would be as severe a shock as the collapse of Lehman Brothers in 2008, if not worse.

zh: 为了避免这一幕发生，欧元区核心国将被迫采取第四和第五选择：给外围国好处，让它们维持低增长、低竞争力现状。
en: Avoiding it would compel the eurozone's core economies to embrace the fourth and final option: bribing the periphery to remain in a low-growth uncompetitive state.

zh: 这要求接受在私人和公共部门债务上的巨大损失，并支付巨大的转移成本以提振产出停滞不前的外围国的收入水平。
en: This would require accepting massive losses on public and private debt, as well as enormous transfer payments that boost the periphery’s income while its output stagnates.

zh: 意大利在几十年来都在做类似的事情：北方补贴南方。
en: Italy has done something similar for decades, with its northern regions subsidizing the poorer Mezzogiorno.

zh: 但类似的持久性财政转移在欧元区是不可能发生的，因为德国人是德国人，希腊人是希腊人。
en: But such permanent fiscal transfers are politically impossible in the eurozone, where Germans are Germans and Greeks are Greeks.

zh: 这也意味着德国和欧洲央行的权力要比人们认为的要小。
en: That also means that Germany and the ECB have less power than they seem to believe.

zh: 除非它们放弃让外围国承受所有痛苦的不对称调整（衰退性通缩 ） ， 采取更加对称的办法（外围国实施紧缩和结构性改革，同时在整个欧元区实施再通胀政策 ） ， 否则货币联盟的缓慢出轨过程将随着外围国的违约和退出而加速。
en: Unless they abandon asymmetric adjustment (recessionary deflation), which concentrates all of the pain in the periphery, in favor of a more symmetrical approach (austerity and structural reforms on the periphery, combined with eurozone-wide reflation), the monetary union's slow-developing train wreck will accelerate as peripheral countries default and exit.

zh: 希腊和意大利的近期乱象可能是这一过程的发端。
en: The recent chaos in Greece and Italy may be the first step in this process.

zh: 显然，欧元区的得过且过政策已经走入了死胡同。
en: Clearly, the eurozone’s muddle-through approach no longer works.

zh: 除非欧元区迈向更深层次的经济、财政和政治一体化（走与短期提振增长、竞争力和债务可持续性目标相一致的路线，这三者是解决不可持续的债务并减少慢性财政和外部赤字问题的必须办法 ） ， 否则衰退性通缩将必然导致欧元区陷入混乱的崩溃。
en: Unless the eurozone moves toward greater economic, fiscal, and political integration (on a path consistent with short-term restoration of growth, competitiveness, and debt sustainability, which are needed to resolve unsustainable debt and reduce chronic fiscal and external deficits), recessionary deflation will certainly lead to a disorderly break-up.

zh: 意大利太大，因此不能倒；同样，因为它太大，因此救不起。 如今，意大利正处于走向不归路的边缘，欧元区终结的大幕正在拉开。
en: With Italy too big to fail, too big to save, and now at the point of no return, the endgame for the eurozone has begun.

zh: 有序、强制的债务重组将是第一步，接下来则是一些国家退出货币联盟，最终，欧元区将分崩离析。
en: Sequential, coercive restructurings of debt will come first, and then exits from the monetary union that will eventually lead to the eurozone’s disintegration.

zh: 新江户时代之梦
en: Dreaming of a New Edo Era

zh: 首尔 — — 11月中旬，所有的目光将会汇聚首尔，这座韩国首都将要召开20国集团领导人的首次峰会。
en: SEOUL – In mid-November, all eyes will shift to Seoul, when G-20 leaders convene for the first time in the South Korean capital.

zh: 这项决策早就应该做出，因为韩国已经成为一个引人注目的成功案例： 在短短一代人的时间里，韩国人从内战的重创、北方共产主义兄弟的威胁、长期的贫困和40年的军事独裁统治中解放出来，已经成为世界第13大经济体和亚洲最具活力的民主制度。
en: The choice is long overdue, as South Korea is a remarkable success story: in one generation, the South Koreans, formerly pummeled by civil war, under constant threat from their Northern communist brethren, long mired in poverty, and ruled by military dictators for 40 years, have built the world’s 13th largest economy and Asia’s most vibrant democracy.

zh: 历史上一直处于中国和日本这两大邻国的夹缝之中，韩国长期以来被外界视为文化特征模糊的弱国。
en: Historically squeezed between its two giant neighbors, China and Japan, South Korea had long been perceived as an underdog with a fuzzy cultural identity.

zh: 不过在亚洲，日本领导人不等首尔峰会就已经开始密切关注韩国。
en: In Asia, however, Japan’s leaders are not waiting for the Seoul summit to take a closer look at South Korea.

zh: 韩国曾经是日本的殖民地（1910－1945 ） ， 那里的本土居民曾被视为劣等民族。
en: South Korea was formerly a Japanese colony (1910-1945), and the natives were treated like an inferior race.

zh: 而今天，韩国经济10年来的年均增长率为5 % ， 而日本同期的年均增长率只有0.42 % 。
en: Today, South Korean’s economy has been growing annually by 5% on average for ten years, whereas Japan grew by 0.42% per year during the same period.

zh: 你可以说韩国尚不属于成熟的经济体，现在不过是在追赶更发达的日本。
en: One could argue that South Korea is not yet a mature economy and is only catching up with a more advanced Japan.

zh: 20世纪70年代情况的确如此，但现在已经发生了很大变化。
en: This was the case in the 1970’s, but no more.

zh: 与中国得益于因成百上千万农民工融入工业经济而带来的低价劳动力不同，韩国的成功秘诀是私有企业、创新和高质量的产品： 三星和现代，而不是低廉的工资，是推动韩国经济成长的发动机。
en: Whereas China’s growth is fueled by low-cost labor as millions of peasants enter the industrial economy, this is not the South Korean recipe for success, which has been driven by private entrepreneurship, innovation, and quality products: Samsung and Hyundai, not cheap wages, are South Korea’s growth engines.

zh: 韩国成功的另一个关键是稳定的政府和私有部门之间形成了良好的平衡关系。
en: Another key to South Korea’s success story is the well-balanced relationship between stable governments and the private sector.

zh: 去年底韩国财团击败法国中标阿联酋四座核反应堆修建工程显而易见地证明了这一点。
en: This was clearly demonstrated late last year when a South Korean consortium won a contract to build four nuclear reactors in the United Arab Emirates late last year, beating out the French.

zh: 20世纪70年代日本人也曾掌握协调国家和私有部门目标的方法，但后来渐渐迷失了方向。
en: The Japanese knew how to coordinate state and private-sector goals in the 1970’s, but then lost their way.

zh: 20世纪80年代日本“奇迹”的缔造者之一、日本著名经济学家神原英资说 ， “ 我们现在应当仿效韩国。
en: “We should now emulate the South Koreans,” says Eisuke Sakakibara, a leading Japanese economist, who was one of the architects of the Japanese “miracle” of the 1980’s.

zh: ”日本人现在开始来到首尔寻找奇迹。
en: Japanese in search of a miracle now travel to Seoul.

zh: “在日本，我们把1990到2000年称为‘迷失的十年 ’ ， 自由市场经济学家林文夫说。
en: “In Japan, 1990 to 2000 was called the ‘lost decade,’” says the free-market economist Fumio Hayashi.

zh: 现在日本正在经历又一个迷失的十年。
en: Now Japan is completing its second lost decade.

zh: 林文夫和神原英资 — — 实际上几乎所有的日本经济学家 — — 已经或多或少地就如此壮观停滞的根本原因达成了共识： 日本人已经不再奋力工作。
en: Hayashi and Sakakibara – indeed, most Japanese economists – more or less agree on the fundamental reason for such spectacular stagnation: the Japanese have stopped working hard.

zh: 工作时间减少、假期增多和人口的减少（自2005年以后）已经不出所料地破坏了日本的经济发展。
en: Fewer hours worked, longer vacations, and a declining population (since 2005) have, predictably, undermined Japanese growth.

zh: 要想扭转这种局面，神原英资说 ， “ 日本人应当努力工作，多生孩子，并开放移民。
en: To turn this situation around, says Sakakibara, “the Japanese should work more, have more children, and allow immigration.”

zh: ” 但日本社会根本不存在实现这些目标的动力。
en: But the incentives to make any of this happen are just not there.

zh: 日本人仰仗他们过去的投资仍然过着舒适的生活，生活水平比韩国人高三分之一。
en: The Japanese still live comfortably, better by one-third than the South Koreans, thanks to their past investments.

zh: 日本的海外企业仍然有利可图，而且日本仍是电子或碳纤维等高科技细分市场的全球领导者。
en: Japanese companies abroad remain profitable and Japan is still the global leader in high-tech niches like electronics or carbon fibers.

zh: 比方说，苹果的iPhone和波音最新款飞机都高度依赖于由日本掌握专利的创新技术。
en: For example, Apple’s iPhone and Boeing’s latest airplane rely heavily on Japanese-patented innovations.

zh: 这样的比较优势可能在一段时间内让日本避免麻烦，但中国或韩国早晚会赶上日本。
en: These comparative advantages may keep Japan above water for a while, but only until China or South Korea catch up.

zh: 你可能因此认为日本人应该忧心忡忡，但实际情况并非如此。
en: One would thus expect Japan to be anxiety-ridden, but it is not.

zh: 没错，新形式的贫困和失业正在抬头，但它们仍然被家庭团结或企业惯例所掩盖。
en: True, new forms of poverty and unemployment are rising, but they remain well hidden behind family solidarity or corporate customs.

zh: 企业削减过多的年终奖金，但并没有将其彻底取消。
en: Companies reduce their superfluous employees’ annual bonuses, but do not get rid of them.

zh: 年轻的日本人在30岁之前一般不找工作，妇女婚后则大多待在家里。
en: Young Japanese tend not to work before their 30’s, and married women stay at home.

zh: 以老年选民为基础的政党并不热衷于任何变化。   目前统治日本的摇摇欲坠的短期政治联盟更愿意通过所谓公共刺激来赢得时间，或者用补贴养活那些效率低下的公司。
en: Political parties that rely on an aging constituency are not tempted to call for change.  The sort of shaky short-term political coalitions that rule Japan nowadays prefer to buy time through so-called public stimulus, or to preserve inefficient companies with subsidies.

zh: 近20年来执政党派诸如此类的短视政策令政府债务激增，严重妨碍了相关的私人投资。
en: Twenty years of such shortsighted policies, whatever the party in power, have fueled government debt, hindering private investment.

zh: 更令人惊讶的是，日本国内居然出现了一批停滞的鼓吹份子。
en: More strikingly, stagnation has found its promoters in Japan itself.

zh: 著名知识份子兼东京副市长的猪濑直树已经断言“增长的时代已经过去。
en: A leading public intellectual Naoki Inose, who is also Tokyo’s vice governor, has declared that “the era of growth is over.”

zh: ” 当日本遭受西方帝国主义威胁的时候，他曾说，日本必需走开放（1868年）和现代化的道路。
en: When Japan was threatened by Western imperialism, he says, the country had to open up (in 1868) and modernize.

zh: 这一进程现在已进行完毕。
en: This process has been completed.

zh: 日本现在正在与其自身的社会和谐及零增长的传统重新接轨。
en: Japan is now ready to reconnect with its own tradition of social harmony and zero growth.

zh: 谈及1600－1868这段时期，猪濑直树把这叫做新江户时代。 “相对较少的人口将享受积累起来的充足财富，而且从现在起，日本将把创造力用于完善自己的文化。
en: Referring to the 1600-1868 period, Inose calls this future the New Edo era: “a smaller population will enjoy the sufficient wealth that has been accumulated, and, from now on, it will invest its creativity in refining the culture.”

zh: ” 1853年，美国海军准将佩里驾驶“黑船”打开了日本的市场，第一个江户时代就此结束。
en: The first Edo collapsed when the United States Navy opened up the Japanese market with the arrival of Commodore Perry’s “black ships” in 1853.

zh: 第二个江户时代究竟能否抵挡中国的远大抱负？
en: Will the second Edo be able to resist Chinese ambitions?

zh: “新江户时代需要一支强大的日本军队 ， ” 猪濑直树承认。
en: “The New Edo era needs a strong Japanese army,” admits Inose.

zh: 所谓第二次江户时代可能听上去像诗意的乌托邦，但却产生了切实的影响力： 神原英资观察到日本学生不再到国外留学，同时也“没有人再学习英语。
en: This second Edo era may sound like a poetic utopia, but it has some influence: Sakakibara observes that Japanese students do not study abroad anymore, and that “nobody learns English.”

zh: ” 在韩国日益全球化、学习英语、欢迎越来越多移民的同时，日本却正在步入一个“去全球化进程 ” 。
en: At a time when South Koreans are becoming more globalized, learning English, and welcoming a growing number of immigrants, Japan is entering a “de-globalization process.”

zh: 这一趋势令人忧虑，而且不仅对日本如此： 韩国作为亚洲唯一的民主国家恐怕独木难支。
en: That is a worrying trend, and not only for Japan: South Korea can hardly stand alone as the lone Asian democracy.

zh: 如果日本人不赶快从江户之梦中醒来，亚洲很可能最终成为中国的领地。
en: If the Japanese do not wake up from their Edo dream, Asia might very well become a Chinese empire.

zh: 20国集团峰会会讨论这个议题吗？
en: Will this be debated at the G-20?

zh: 不会公开讨论，但在走道里私下讨论丝毫不足为奇。
en: Not openly, but certainly in the corridors.

zh: 滑向激流
en: Drifting Towards the Rapids

zh: 伦敦 — — 我们被告知自己生活在一个充满焦虑的年代，需要操心的地方很多，令人安心的确定性却少之又少。
en: LONDON – We are told that we live in anxious times, with lots to worry about and no more comforting certainty.

zh: 但过去几个世纪究竟又有多么舒适呢？
en: But just how comfortable were all those past certainties, anyway?

zh: 我在一个由全球核毁灭威胁保证和平稳定的世界中长大。
en: I grew up in a world in which peace and stability were assured by the threat of global nuclear annihilation.

zh: 我大学的第一个学期恰逢古巴导弹危机。   共产主义东方隔着柏林墙怒视着民主资本主义的西方。
en: My first term at university coincided with the Cuban missile crisis.  The Communist East glowered over the Berlin Wall at the democratic and capitalist West.

zh: 这两大阵营各自的代理在亚非两大洲进行着较量。
en: The two sides fought proxy wars in Africa and Asia.

zh: 成千上万人为捍卫民主阵线在越南献出生命，而现在这个国家已成为外国人蜂拥而入的投资对象。
en: Tens of thousands died to hold democracy’s frontline in Vietnam, where foreigners now rush to invest their money.

zh: 毛泽东的疯狂和国大党误入歧途的社会主义致使中国和印度的亿万人无法享受全球繁荣。
en: Hundreds of millions were shut out of global prosperity in China and India by the madness of Mao Zedong and the misguided socialism of the Congress Party.

zh: 这难道真的是美好时光？
en: Were those really better times?

zh: 今天能让我们辗转反侧的大问题是什么？
en: And what are the big problems today that should cause us to lose sleep?

zh: 首先，今天的问题是过往成功的结果。
en: Well, first and foremost, today’s problems are the result of past success.

zh: 世界人口比一百年前增加了四倍，产值达到过去的40倍，二氧化碳的排放量则是过去的17倍还多。
en: There are four times more people in the world than there were a hundred years ago, producing 40 times as much output and spewing 17 times as much carbon dioxide into the atmosphere.

zh: 这就是世界面临的现实问题，我们所采取的对策还远远不够。
en: That is the existential issue confronting the world, to which our response remains hopelessly inadequate.

zh: 其次，我们发现自己的处境非同寻常，因为我们的全球领袖美国也是全世界最大的债务国。
en: Second, we find ourselves in the unusual position of having a global leader – the United States – that is also the world’s biggest debtor.

zh: 如果美国过去没有借那么多债，世界也不会有这么快的发展速度。
en: If America had not in the past borrowed so much, the world would not have grown so fast.

zh: 美国更像是座世界大商场，而不像是世界的领导者。
en: The US was more the world’s emporium than its imperium.

zh: 但想想如果2007年前美国有的是贸易顺差和比14万亿更为合理的国内信用卡持卡人负债，那世界与今天相比将会有多么大的不同。
en: But just think how different everything would look if America had a trade surplus and a more manageable level of domestic borrowing than the $14 trillion run-up in debt by credit-card holders before 2007.

zh: 第三，像以往一样，面对街道上新来的大孩子，世界正在艰难而努力的适应过程中。
en: Third, as has always happened in the past, the world is trying with some difficulty to adjust to the arrival of a new and very big kid on the block.

zh: 中国千年以来一直是世界最大的国家，19世纪中叶以前也一直是最大的经济体，主要原因是有众多的生产者和客户。
en: China has been the world’s largest country for millennia, and until the mid-nineteenth century it was the largest economy, too – mainly because it had so many consumers and producers.

zh: 情况很快又会和当时一样，即使按人均财富算中国也紧随阿尔巴尼亚，大致排在全世界百位左右。
en: That will soon be the case again, even though in terms of per capita wealth China ranks roughly 100th in the world, trailing Albania.

zh: 但重新崛起的大国并非只有中国一个，此外还有印度和巴西 — — 其中印度人口的总数和年轻人数量将很快超过中国。
en: But China has re-emerged a big hitter, along with India – whose population will soon be bigger and younger than China’s – and Brazil.

zh: 面对这些不断成长的经济和政治势力我们又有何对策？
en: How do we cope with this growth of economic and political clout?

zh: 在中国开始耀武扬威 — — 比方说，追求对周边海域和海底石油控制的同时 — — 这个国家所能带来的最大危害是四分五裂，而不是继续繁荣。
en: While China may have started to throw a bit of its weight around – for example, in its own neighbourhood in pursuit of maritime reach and undersea oil – the main threat that it poses is that the country falls apart, not that it continues to thrive.

zh: 其四，随着情势的变化，二战后制定全球规则及确保其实施的制度已经失去了大部分政治经济影响力和合法性。
en: Fourth, while all this has been happening, the institutions set up after World War II to create global rules and to preside over their implementation have lost much of their political and economic sway and legitimacy.

zh: 联合国和布雷顿森林机构再也不能反映世界的权力平衡，而即使各国不得不面对的共同问题越来越多，它们进行主权交流解决问题的意愿却越来越弱。
en: The United Nations and the Bretton Woods institutions no longer reflect the world’s power balance, and, even as the scale of problems common to all countries has increased, their willingness to share sovereignty to tackle them has diminished.

zh: 在这种情况下，我们迫切需要坚强智慧的领导人物。
en: In these circumstances, we badly need strong and wise leadership.

zh: 除了美国，很难找出谁还能扮演这一角色。
en: Absent America, it is difficult to see where this is likely to come from.

zh: 华盛顿一位英明总统被政治制度捆住了手脚，使得就国内改革或国外行动达成共识几乎成为不可能完成的任务。
en: An intelligent president in Washington is hobbled by a political system that makes it all but impossible to build a consensus for reform at home or decisive action abroad.

zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马总统的很多政治对手将美国对国际机构的领导以及有关参与和多边主义的承诺视为对美国的背叛态度。
en: Many of President Barack Obama’s political opponents regard the notion of American leadership of international institutions and a commitment to engagement and multilateralism as a form of un-American treachery.

zh: 美国战后在欧洲的伙伴虽然仍占据世界总产值的五分之一，但却因提升国际竞争力和挽救共同货币所付出的努力不够而陷入困境无法自拔。
en: For their part, America’s post-war partners in Europe, while still representing more than one-fifth of the world’s output, are obsessed with their own inadequate efforts to improve their international competitiveness and save the currency that many of them share.

zh: 期待欧盟在国际舞台上采取自信和统一一致的政治行动没有多大希望。
en: It is not much good looking to the European Union for self-confident and concerted political initiative on the international stage.

zh: 而新崛起的大国呢？
en: And what of the emerging powers?

zh: 中国从由美国一手制造的全球市场中获得了巨大的好处。
en: China has taken huge advantage of the global marketplace created above all by the US.

zh: 但它却对造就美国民主繁荣和平的成功政策提出挑战，同时又拿不出取代这种模式的好的办法。
en: But it now challenges the principles on which America’s successful policy of a democratic and prosperous peace was based, and it has no alternative model to put in its place.

zh: 力求保住出口企业的优势和不顾政治和经济代价购买大宗商品是中国，而不是世界各国的政策。
en: Attempting to retain advantages for your exporters and to buy up commodities regardless of the political and economic price is a tactic for China, not a strategy for the world.

zh: 其他新兴国家同样没有任何计划，虽然印度迟早会对中国炫耀武力越来越警惕，而巴西则可能最终质疑是否真有必要纵容委内瑞拉和古巴。
en: Nor is there any plan on offer from other emerging powers, though in time India may show growing alarm about China’s muscle-flexing, and Brazil may question whether it has really been wise to cosset Venezuela and Cuba.

zh: 那么谁能遏制伊朗的核抱负？
en: So who will contain Iran’s nuclear ambitions?

zh: 谁能调停中东和平？
en: Who will broker a Middle East peace?

zh: 谁能阻止全球陷入货币战争和贸易保护主义的漩涡？
en: Who will prevent a global drift into currency wars and trade protectionism?

zh: 谁能保证今年12月坎昆的气候变化会议不会与去年的哥本哈根会议遭遇同样的命运？
en: Who will ensure that the Cancứn climate-change conference this December does not meet the same fate as last year’s Copenhagen summit?

zh: 谁能为造成从恐怖主义到非法贩毒等多种问题的失败和滑向失败国家的重建任务出力并树立道德典范？
en: Who will add strength and moral authority to the task of rebuilding the failed and failing states that incubate so many of our problems, from terrorism to illicit drugs?

zh: 昨天并不像我们记忆中那般美好。
en: Yesterday was not as good as we remember it.

zh: 但如果今天失去领导，明天的危险性将会大大增加。
en: But today lacks leadership, and tomorrow could be far more dangerous as a result.

zh: 与此同时，我们正不知不觉地向着前方激流中越来越近的危险滑去。
en: Meanwhile, we drift downstream seemingly oblivious to the looming peril of the rapids ahead.

zh: 为了发展的无人机
en: Drones for Development

zh: 日内瓦—近几年来，无人航空器给全世界人们带来了无数想象和噩梦。
en: LAUSANNE – Unmanned aerial vehicles have populated both the imagination and nightmares of people around the world in recent years.

zh: 4月，美国海军宣布了一项称为LOCUST（低成本无人航空器分蜂技术）的试验计划，官员承诺，该计划将“自主克敌 ” ， 从而“为水兵和海军陆战队员带来决定性战术优势 ” 。
en: In April, the United States Navy announced an experimental program called LOCUST (Low-Cost UAV Swarming Technology), which officials promise will “autonomously overwhelm an adversary” and thus “provide Sailors and Marines a decisive tactical advantage.”

zh: 从该计划的命名和任务看 — — 以及从无人机武器褒贬不一的到的记录看 — — 毫不奇怪许多人质疑飞行机器人的继续大量增加。
en: With a name and a mission like that – and given the spotty ethical track record of drone warfare – it is little wonder that many are queasy about the continued proliferation of flying robots.

zh: 但低空工业应用仍将继续发展。
en: But the industrial use of the lower sky is here to stay.

zh: 每天有三百多万人在天上飞。
en: More than three million humans are in the air daily.

zh: 每个大型人类定居点都通过航空交通与另一个人类定居点相连。
en: Every large human settlement on our planet is connected to another by air transport.

zh: 中国无人飞行器制造商DJI正在迈向100亿美元估值。
en: DJI, a Chinese UAV manufacturer, is seeking a $10 billion valuation.

zh: 货运无人机将在未来几年成为规模更大的产业，原因很简单 — — 摆脱了人类重量和生命支持系统，无人机可以以更低的成本实现同样程度快捷和安全的飞行。
en: Cargo drones will grow into an even larger industry in the coming years, simply because, unencumbered by the weight of humans and their life-support systems, they will fly more cheaply but be just as fast and safe.

zh: 在发达国家，货运无人机的早期关注点集中在所谓的最后一英里 — — 将一桶冰淇淋送往郊区的草坪。
en: In rich countries, early interest in cargo drones has focused on the so-called last mile – a tub of sorbet onto a suburban lawn.

zh: 但更大的机会在于贫穷国家的中程飞行。
en: But the bigger opportunities are in flying the middle mile in poorer countries.

zh: 全球大约8亿人难以获得紧急服务，并且这一状况在可预见的未来难以改变，因为没有足够的钱修��连同他们。
en: Some 800 million people around the world have limited access to emergency services, and that will not change in the foreseeable future, because there will not be enough money to build roads to connect them.

zh: 接驳这些孤立社区的中等规模、中等航程飞行的无人机能够拯救生命、创造就业。
en: By flying medium-size loads middling distances to many of these isolated communities, cargo drones can save lives and create jobs.

zh: 货运无人机包含了世界银行行长金墉所谓的“实现的科学 ” （ science of delivery ） 。
en: Cargo drones embody what Jim Yong Kim, the president of the World Bank, calls the “science of delivery.”

zh: 我们知道我们需要实现什么：大部分紧迫问题已经有了解决方案。
en: We know what we need to deliver: the solutions to many of our most pressing problems already exist.

zh: 问题是如何实施。
en: The question is how.

zh: 为了回答这些问题，人道主义者、机器人专家、建筑师、物流师和其他人团结在一项叫做红线（Red Line）的新计划背后。 红线是一家位于瑞士的联盟，旨在加速紧急货运无人机的开发和建设世界上首个无人机机场 — — 位于非洲。
en: Answering that question is why humanitarians, roboticists, architects, logisticians, and others have joined together in a new initiative called Red Line, a Swiss-based consortium to accelerate development of emergency cargo drones and build the world’s first droneports – in Africa.

zh: 这听起来像是技术乌托邦 — — 或至少是对资源的巨大浪费。
en: It sounds techno-utopian – or at least like a huge waste of resources.

zh: 毕竟，最成功的发展组织的经验表明我们应该对先进技术给穷人带来有意义的变化的力量保持怀疑。
en: After all, the experience of the most successful development organizations suggests that we should be skeptical about advanced technology’s power to bring about meaningful change for the poor.

zh: 诚然，处理能力成本的下降带来了新效率，特别是智能手机和相关空际无线连接。
en: Yes, the falling cost of processing power creates new efficiencies, particularly in smartphones and related sky-fi connectivity.

zh: 但装置往往只是耀眼的点缀。
en: But gadgets are mostly blinking bling.

zh: 低成本教师培训、社区医疗、学徒制，这些看起来没有什么新意的东西才能为穷人带来成果。
en: It is boring stuff like low-cost teacher training, community health care, and apprenticeships that produces results for the poor.

zh: 因此，许多发展专家更青睐“节约型创新”而非技术。
en: That is why many development experts favor “frugal innovation” over technology.

zh: 位于孟加拉国的世界第三大非政府发展组织BRAC有130万注册于仅有一间校舍的学校的学生 — — 并且几乎没有 笔记本电脑。
en: The Bangladesh-based BRAC, the world’s largest development NGO, has 1.3 million children enrolled in one-room schools – and hardly a laptop in sight.

zh: 因此，为何要对货运无人机保持乐观？
en: So why be optimistic about cargo drones?

zh: 硅谷言必称“破坏 ” ， 但一个看好货运无人机的理由正是它们根本不具有破坏性。
en: Silicon Valley speaks the bulldozer language of “disruption,” but one reason to favor cargo drones is precisely that they are not disruptive at all.

zh: 相反，它们能扩大非洲、亚洲和拉美边远地区的分销网络，那里贫穷和疾病横行，距离遥远，根本无路可走。
en: Instead, they can augment existing distribution networks in remote regions of Africa, Asia, and Latin America where poverty and disease are pervasive, distances are great, and roads will never be built.

zh: 货运无人机特别适合所谓的地方代理人实现模式（local-agent delivery model ） 。
en: Cargo drones are particularly well suited to the so-called local-agent delivery model.

zh: 公司和组织已经表明，在非洲和南亚的难以到达的地区，经过训练成为微型创业家的女性常常最适合实现对其村庄最重要的商品和服务，那么她们只有非常有限的识字能力，接受过非常有限的正式教育。
en: Companies and organizations have shown that in hard-to-reach places in Africa and South Asia, women trained as micro-entrepreneurs are often best positioned to deliver essential goods and services to their villages, even if they have limited literacy and formal education.

zh: 比如，BRAC的社区卫生工作者完全在微连锁（micro-franchising）的基础上工作，从销售基本商品（如打虫药、抗疟疾药和避孕药）的利润中赚钱。
en: BRAC’s community health workers, for example, work entirely on a micro-franchising basis, making their money from margins on sales of basic commodities like de-worming medication, anti-malarial drugs, and contraceptives.

zh: 尽管货运无人机永远无法取代地面交通，但它们可以确保关键商品和服务抵达需要的人手中。
en: Though cargo drones will never replace ground transport, they can ensure that vital goods and services get to where they are needed.

zh: 移动电话在非洲能够取得飞越式发展，原因就在于这项技术比投资通讯线路基础设施便宜得多。
en: Mobile phones took off in Africa because the technology was so much cheaper than investment in landline infrastructure.

zh: 如今，非洲的道路也是如此。
en: The same can be said today about Africa’s roads.

zh: 和移动电话一样，货运无人机可以成为最珍贵的创造：为最需要的人工作的装置。
en: Like the mobile phone, the cargo drone can prove to be the rarest of creatures: a gadget that works for those who need it most.

zh: 无人机飞行梦想
en: Flights of Unmanned Fancy

zh: 波士顿 — — 几乎没有哪种现代硬件能像无人机那样令人们兴奋异常。
en: BOSTON – Few pieces of modern hardware have inspired as much excitement as the drone.

zh: 虽然非军用无人机（UAVs）最初被当作纯粹的娱乐用品上市销售，但企业家和工业巨头没过多长时间就抓住了无人机所提供的无穷无尽的可能。
en: While nonmilitary unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) were initially marketed as purely recreational gadgets, it has not taken long for entrepreneurs and industrial giants to seize on the endless possibilities they offer.

zh: 到2020年，美国的无人机年销售量预计将达到700万架，而许多人已经在预测无人机将通过远程送货、机载监控或现在仍然无法预见的应用方式重塑我们城市的未来。
en: Annual sales in the United States are expected to reach seven million units by 2020, and many are already predicting a future in which drones reshape our cities – through remote delivery of goods, airborne surveillance, or as yet unforeseen applications.

zh: 但其中一种可能性更能吸引人类的集体想象力：那就是无人机将很快成为大量载人的工具。
en: Yet one possibility has captured our collective imagination more than any other: the idea that drones will soon be moving people over cities en masse.

zh: 飞的能否有一天将我们从花园里提起，而后在电影院或我们最心爱的餐厅前再将我们轻轻放下？
en: Might flying taxis one day pluck us from our front gardens and delicately plop us down outside the cinema or our favorite restaurant?

zh: 在我们为下一代空中出租车心花怒放之前，我们先来思考一下如果天空充满了将人们运抵下一个目的地的成群结队的小型直升机实际将意味着什么？
en: Before we mentally hail the next air cab, let’s consider what it would actually mean if the skies were filled with swarms of miniature helicopters ferrying people to their next destination.

zh: 虽然无人机在将来会有很多重要的用途，但我不相信民众的城市交通将会或者应当成为其中的一个。
en: Though drones will have many important uses in the future, I do not believe moving people around cities will, or should, be one of them.

zh: 无人空中交通的梦想并不是现在才有的。
en: The dream of unmanned aerial transportation is not new.

zh: 当弗里茨·朗为其1927年的突破性影片《大都会》创作未来城市景观时，天空中布满了令人眼花缭乱的高楼和精巧的飞行器。
en: When Fritz Lang created the futuristic cityscape for his groundbreaking 1927 film, Metropolis, he filled its skies with vertiginous towers and compact flying vehicles.

zh: 而后，到了20世纪60年代初，汉娜-巴伯拉动画工作室制作了《杰森一家 》 ， 这是一部大胆描绘全美家庭未来派生活的卡通系列剧。
en: Then, in the early 1960s, the Hanna-Barbera animation studio produced The Jetsons, a cartoon series following the escapades of a futuristic all-American family.

zh: 影片一开始这家人乘坐一辆能折叠成手提箱大小的悬浮车围绕轨道城市旋转，之后一家之主乔治将折叠好的悬浮车带进了他的办公室。
en: In the opening credits the family whizzes around Orbit City in a hover car that folds up into a briefcase, which George, the family patriarch, then carries into his office.

zh: 1982年科幻大片《银翼杀手》中出现了被称为“旋转器”的飞行警车。
en: In 1982, the science-fiction blockbuster Blade Runner featured flying police cars called “spinners.”

zh: 今天，如此虚构版的未来似乎即将变成现实。
en: Today, a version of such make-believe futures would seem tantalizingly within reach.

zh: 优步正在投资研发飞车技术。
en: Uber is investing in flying car technology.

zh: 今年初，空客推出了Pop.Up ，这是一种用于个人交通的垂直起降概念车。
en: Earlier this year, Airbus launched Pop.Up, a vertical takeoff and landing concept vehicle for personal mobility.

zh: 而Volocopter是一家承诺“为所有人制造飞机”的德国初创企业，这家企业设计了2X，这是一架有18扇水平旋翼的微型直升机，将于今年晚些时候在迪拜开始进行测试飞行。
en: And in a venture that promises “flight for all,” German start-up Volocopter has designed the 2X, a miniature helicopter with 18 rotors that will begin test flights in Dubai later this year.

zh: 所有这一切是否都表明都市人很快将像乔治·杰森那样飞行在城市上空？
en: All of this suggests that urbanites will soon be zipping around urban airspace like George Jetson, right?

zh: 事实恐怕并非如此。
en: Wrong.

zh: 尽管拥有巨额投资和远大前景，但我们的城市不太可能在短期内充满空中飞人却有着物理和现实的理由。
en: Despite big investments and bigger promises, there are physical and practical reasons why it is highly unlikely that our cities will be filled with airborne people movers anytime soon.

zh: 首先来看看物理规律。
en: First, let’s consider the physics.

zh: 任何曾在直升机起飞前站在附近的人都会明白需要大量能量才能将重物垂直抬升到空中。
en: Anyone who has stood near a helicopter taking off will understand that a lot of energy is required to lift a heavy object vertically into the air.

zh: 无人机水平旋翼实际就是大型风扇，向下挤压空气才能实现飞行器向上抬升。
en: Drone rotors are essentially big fans, pushing air down to create upward propulsion.

zh: 不产生巨大噪音和空气扰动实现起飞根本不可能。
en: There is no way to achieve lift without creating a vast amount of both noise and air disturbance.

zh: 纽约市民都很清楚这一点。
en: Residents of New York City know this well.

zh: 人们对纽约哈德逊河上一座城市主要直升机停机坪的噪音投诉曾导致对旅游业经营者监管的增加。
en: Complaints about noise from one of the city’s main helipads on the Hudson River led to increased regulation of tour operators.

zh: 但即使在该法案出台前，每月游客的飞行次数也少于5，000次。
en: Yet, even before that legislation, there were fewer than 5,000 tourist flights per month.

zh: 现在想象一下如果纽约市800万居民哪怕每人每隔几周飞行一次：这座城市将会变得无法居住。
en: Imagine if all of the city’s eight million residents took even one flight every few weeks: the city would become unlivable.

zh: 限制我们热情的还有其他技术性因素。
en: Other factors that should curb our enthusiasm are more technological.

zh: 即便电池性能大幅改良延长了无人机航程，但人们对大批人员空中运输车辆的迷恋会造成令人望而生畏的安全风险因素。
en: Even with dramatically improved batteries extending drones’ range, the crush of vehicles needed to move large numbers of people overhead would present a daunting safety hazard.

zh: 现代汽车可能充满了危险，但一架飞的电池耗尽或水平旋翼破坏将会导致沉重的车辆坠入密集居住区之中。
en: Modern cars may be dangerous, but a dead battery or a broken rotor blade in a flying taxi would cause a heavy vehicle to fall onto a densely populated area.

zh: 而且我们还不知道这些无人机能否抵御黑客、恐怖分子或其他犯罪分子的进攻，也不知道空中交管系统将怎样为人们提供安全指引。
en: And we still don’t know whether such drones could be protected from hackers, terrorists, or other criminals, or how air traffic control systems might guide people safely.

zh: 但无人机仍将对未来民众的生活、交易和互动产生革命性的影响。
en: Drones will still have a transformative impact on how future populations live, do business, and interact.

zh: 事实已经证明小型无人机在诸多方面拥有潜力 — — 从人道主义援助物资运送到安全保障提供。
en: Small UAVs have already proven their potential across diverse fields – from humanitarian-aid delivery to security.

zh: 无人机无需大规模基础设施建设即可飞越地理障碍，而且可以将边远社区与世界其他地方密切联系起来。
en: Drones transcend geographical barriers without the need for large-scale physical infrastructure, and can bring isolated communities into close contact with the rest of the world.

zh: 比如在巴西，政府正在利用装有摄像头的无人机来对偏远农场是否违反劳动法进行检查。
en: In Brazil, for example, the government is deploying camera-equipped drones to inspect remote agricultural producers suspected of breaking labor laws.

zh: 而无人机已经在监测空气质量并为医疗突发事件提供援助。
en: And drones are already monitoring air quality and providing support during health emergencies.

zh: 但城市交通不属于无人机技术的适用范畴。
en: But urban mobility is not an appropriate application for UAV technology.

zh: 大众交通问题脚不用离开地面就完全可以解决 — — 而且可能很久之后飞的才会成为可行的选择。
en: The problems of mass transportation can be fixed with our feet planted firmly on the ground – and long before flying taxis are even a viable alternative.

zh: 随着数字网络和实时数据的不断改进，自动汽车、卡车和船舶 — — 就像我和同事在阿姆斯特丹已经完成原型设计的Roboat那样 — — 其快速和有效性完全可以满足我们的需求。
en: With improvements to digital networks and real-time data, autonomous cars, trucks, and boats – like the Roboat that colleagues and I are prototyping in Amsterdam – can be made fast and effective enough for all our needs.

zh: 不离开地面将能避免建设新的基础设施网，比如像昂贵的“垂直起降机场”项目。
en: And staying on the ground will obviate the need for networks of new infrastructure, like costly “vertiports.”

zh: 人类社会乘坐私人飞车从城市上空掠过的梦想一直吸引着电影制作者的想象力 — — 现在甚至吸引了某些投资者加入其中。
en: Society’s enduring dream of whizzing over a city in private flying cars has long captured the imagination of filmmakers – and now even some investors.

zh: 但由于大大小小的实际因素，这样的愿景仍将停留在梦想当中。
en: For practical reasons large and small, however, it is a vision that will remain the stuff of fantasy.

zh: 所有人的救命药
en: Life-Saving Drugs for All

zh: 普林斯顿—始于去年的利比里亚、塞拉利昂和几内亚的埃博拉致命大爆发凸显出制药生产的一个问题。
en: PRINCETON – The deadly outbreak of Ebola in Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Guinea that began last year highlighted a problem in the production of pharmaceuticals.

zh: 一旦情况清楚地表明传染病无法得到迅速遏制，一些企业就会迅速安排潜在治疗和疫苗的临床试验，这表明它们已经具备了生产可靠潜在产品的能力。
en: Once it became clear that the epidemic would not be rapidly contained, several firms quickly arranged for clinical trials of potential treatments and vaccines, indicating that they already had the ability to produce plausible candidates.

zh: 埃博拉不是新疾病：它在1976年就已经得到了识别。
en: Ebola is not a new disease: it was first identified in 1976.

zh: 但是，在2014年前，最大的爆发发生在2000年的乌干达，425人被感染，224人死亡。
en: Prior to 2014, however, the largest outbreak was in Uganda, in 2000, when 425 people were infected and 224 died.

zh: 尽管我们已知埃博拉具有传染性和高致死率，但我们认为只有非洲贫困的农村人口属于高危人群。
en: Though Ebola was known to be both contagious and often fatal, it was thought that only Africa’s impoverished rural population was at risk.

zh: 对制药企业来说，开发埃博拉疫苗和治疗手段不具商业吸引力，因此没有进行多少投资。
en: For pharmaceutical firms, the development of a vaccine or treatment was not commercially attractive, and so it did not warrant investment.

zh: 所有这些都随着最近的大爆发而改变。
en: All that changed with the latest outbreak.

zh: 2014年9月，美国疾病控制和预防中心（Centers for Disease Control and Prevention）预测，在最糟糕的情形中，不出4个月将由140万人被传染。
en: In September 2014, the United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention predicted that, in the worst case, 1.4 million people could be infected within four months.

zh: 媒体散布恐慌，说埃博拉可能传播到丰裕国家，这催生了不同寻常的预防措施。
en: Media-fed fears that the disease could spread to affluent countries led to extraordinary precautions.

zh: 在美国，总统奥巴马要求国会拨款62亿美元，其中24亿美元用于降低埃博拉进入美国的风险和建立50座美国埃博拉治疗中心。
en: In the United States, President Barack Obama asked Congress for $6.2 billion, including $2.4 billion to reduce the risk of the disease becoming established in America and set up 50 US Ebola treatment centers.

zh: 最糟糕情形没有成为现实。
en: The worst-case scenario did not materialize.

zh: 2015年4月，最接近的估计是大约25,000人被传染，近10,000人死亡。
en: As of April 2015, the best estimate is that about 25,000 people have been infected, with approximately 10,000 deaths.

zh: 西非以外地区只有不到30例病例和五人死亡。
en: Outside West Africa, there have been fewer than 30 cases, and only five deaths.

zh: 尽管如此，恐慌，特别是看到了新的有利可图的市场，让制药企业争相研发埃博拉相关产品，而卫生官员则哀叹为何不早点这样做。
en: Nevertheless, the fears, and especially the prospect of a new and lucrative market, set pharmaceutical firms scrambling to develop Ebola-related products, while health officials lamented that nothing had been done beforehand.

zh: 我不是在批评制药公司因为没有市场而不去生产埃博拉疫苗。
en: I am not criticizing pharmaceutical companies for not producing an Ebola vaccine when there was no market for it.

zh: 它们不是慈善机构。
en: They are not charities.

zh: 如果我们希望它们生产帮助发达国家穷人的产品，就需要找到办法让它们的投资 — — 以及它们的股东 — — 获得回报。
en: If we want them to make products that will help the poor in developing countries, we need to find ways of giving them – and their shareholders – a return on their investment.

zh: 制药公司没有激励帮助发展中国家的穷人，但它们很有激励为丰裕国家的人民开发产品。
en: Whereas pharmaceutical companies lack incentives to aid the poor in developing countries, they have strong incentives to develop products for people in affluent countries.

zh: 一种叫做Soliris的药，每年每位病人要耗费440,000美元。
en: One drug, Soliris, costs $440,000 per patient per year.

zh: 相反，葛伍维尔（GiveWell）估算，在疟疾为主要致死原因的地区分发蚊帐，只要3,400美元就可以拯救一条人命。
en: In contrast, GiveWell estimates that the cost of saving a life by distributing bed nets in regions where malaria is a major killer is $3,400.

zh: 并且被拯救的大多是儿童，而即使在发展中国家，他们的预期寿命也至少有50岁，换算下来拯救一年性命的成本只有68美元。
en: Given that most of the lives saved are those of children, who even in developing countries have a life expectancy of at least 50 years, this equates to a cost of $68 per year of life saved.

zh: 我们真的应该给予丰裕国家的人相当于发展中国家贫困儿童6,000多倍的生命价值吗？
en: Should we really be valuing the life of a person in an affluent country at more than 6,000 times the value of the life of an impoverished child in a developing country?

zh: 由于绝大多数医疗和制药研究以影响丰裕国家人民的产品为目标，因此���们只能解决全球疾病负担的一部分。
en: Because the overwhelming majority of medical and pharmaceutical research is directed toward products that affect people in affluent countries, it targets only part of the global burden of disease.

zh: 一些政府和基金会出资的研究以主要影响穷人的疾病为目标，但这些研究不系统，也缺少其他情况下效果显著的制药创新激励。
en: Some government- and foundation-funded research addresses diseases that primarily affect poor people, but these efforts are not systematic and do not use the incentives that work well to drive pharmaceutical innovation elsewhere.

zh: 纠正这一失衡的一个很有希望的尝试是耶鲁全球正义计划（Global Justice Program）主管托马斯·波奇（Thomas Pogge）和卡尔加里大学经济学家艾丹·霍利斯（Aidan Hollis）七年前发起的健康影响基金（Health Impact Fund）项目。
en: One promising attempt to correct this imbalance is the proposal for a Health Impact Fund that Thomas Pogge, director of the Global Justice Program at Yale, and Aidan Hollis, an economist at the University of Calgary, launched seven years ago.

zh: 如果健康影响基金能获得足够的融资，它可以提供与降低全球疾病负担效果相匹配的产品开发激励。
en: If the Health Impact Fund could be adequately financed, it would provide incentives to develop products in proportion to their impact in reducing the global burden of disease.

zh: 在最近的埃博拉爆发前存在这样一个基金是否能推动埃博拉疫苗和治手段的开发，我们无法确定。
en: It is not certain that the existence of such a fund prior to the recent Ebola outbreak would have led to the development of vaccines or treatments for the disease.

zh: 但制药公司将对这类产品有所考虑 — — 其他在地球某处拯救生命、改善健康的治疗手段亦然，不管人们是否有支付能力。
en: But pharmaceutical companies would have been considering such products – as well as other treatments to save lives or improve health anywhere in the world, regardless of people’s ability to pay.

zh: 如今，波奇和霍利斯对他们的方案进行了微调，使其做好了进行真实世界实验的准备。
en: Pogge and Hollis have now refined their proposal to the point that it is ready for a real-world trial.

zh: 开发某产品的某公司将获得一定比例的奖励金，金额基础为它在竞争可得资金的产品所取得的总健康改善成果中的所占比例。
en: A company that develops a product would earn a share of reward money based on its share of the health improvements achieved by all the products competing for the available funds.

zh: 但是，仍然需要足够的奖励金 — — 也许需要政府、非政府组织、基金会和制药业资助1亿美元 — — 以刺激认真的投资。
en: What is still needed, however, is sufficient reward money – perhaps $100 million from governments, NGOs, foundations and the pharmaceutical industry – to stimulate serious investment.

zh: 这一试点计划将有助于贫穷患者，也将考验科学家公正准确地测量健康影响的能力。
en: Such a pilot program would benefit poor patients and would test scientists’ ability to measure health impact fairly and accurately.

zh: 该计划啊还将提供需要的证据促使政府、基金会和全球机构大幅增加支持，以满足扩大当前影响制药公司决策的激励体系的需要。
en: It would also provide the evidence needed to go to governments, foundations, and global institutions for the much larger sums required to expand the present system of incentives that guide pharmaceutical companies’ decisions.

zh: 如果试点成功，我们将找到办法支持不论国籍和财富、平等保护一切生命和改善全人类健康的药物和疫苗的开发。
en: If the pilot is successful, we will have found a way to support the development of drugs and vaccines that gives equal weight to protecting the lives and improving the health of all human beings, irrespective of their nationality or wealth.

zh: 药品、体育运动和道德规范
en: Drugs, Sport, and Ethics

zh: 当奥林匹克运动会场地今年夏天重新回到它的发源地希腊，药品检测实验室可能会和奥运会竞赛场地一样备受人们的关注。
en: When the Olympic Games return to Greece this summer, the results at the drug testing laboratory may get as much attention as what happens at the Olympic stadium.

zh: 兴奋剂的使用历史和兴奋剂的控制情况，在奥林匹克运动会上的表现是令人泄气的 - - 一个漏洞百出的大杂烩条例、毫无疑义的国家支持的欺骗、和半心半意不规则的执行情况。
en: The history of drugs, and drug control, at the Olympics is discouraging - a farrago of ill-informed rules, outright state-sponsored cheating, and half-hearted and erratic attempts at enforcement.

zh: 最近，一个新的有效控制兴奋剂的操作模型又燃起了人们的希望。 它将兴奋剂的检测和执行工作，从原来直接由国际奥林匹克委员会和国家政府机构管理改为世界反运动禁药组织以及类似国家级组织管理。
en: A new model has recently revived hope for effective drug control by moving testing and enforcement from the direct control of the International Olympic Committee and the national governing bodies to the World Anti-Doping Agency and similar organizations at the national level.

zh: 世界反运动禁药组织，举例来说，在发现一种新的名叫THG的合成类固醇药品中就发挥了重要作用。 从加利弗尼亚承办机构到奥林匹克和职业运动员都与这种兴奋剂有染。
en: The US Anti-Doping Agency, for example, played a central role in uncovering a new synthetic steroid known as THG linked to a California firm catering to Olympic and professional athletes.

zh: 但是新燃起的希望也可能走向沮丧，除非我们能够积极地回应道德挑战。
en: But the renewed hope will be frustrated unless we can respond effectively to the ethical challenge.

zh: 如果我们不能解释清楚为什么在体育运动中服用兴奋剂是错误的这个问题，那么再多的禁令也无济于事。
en: No amount of interdiction will suffice if we do not explain clearly what, precisely, is wrong with using performance enhancing drugs in sport.

zh: 有三个正当的理由来禁止这些药品：确保体育比赛公平；保护运动员诚实正直的品行；确保体育竞赛的意义和价值。
en: There are three compelling reasons to ban such drugs: assuring all athletes that the competition is fair; preserving the integrity of the athlete; and safeguarding what gives sport its meaning and value.

zh: 年轻的奥林匹克选手将他们的生命奉献给了他们的运动项目，一心希望有机会赶超那些世界最顶尖的优秀运动员。
en: Young Olympians devote their lives to their sport for the opportunity to match themselves against the world's most gifted and dedicated athletes.

zh: 金牌获得者和其它选手之间的区别可能只差那么一两秒或几英寸。
en: The difference between gold medalist and also-ran may be measured in fractions of seconds or inches.

zh: 一点小小的帮助就可以改变这一切。
en: A tiny advantage can make all the difference.

zh: 那么如果这个小小的帮助就是服用兴奋剂，又会怎样呢？
en: What if that advantage comes from using a performance enhancing drug?

zh: 对那些想凭实力参加比赛的运动员来说，他们便面临着被不比他们更快、更强或更努力，但因服用兴奋剂而赢得体能的选手打败的可能，这对于运动员个人来说有着深刻的影响。
en: For athletes who want to compete clean, the threat that they may be beaten by a competitor who is not faster, stronger, or more dedicated, but who takes a drug to gain the edge, is profoundly personal.

zh: 当药品被禁止，但一些运动员照吃不误的时候，运动场地的天平其实已经向那些欺骗者倾斜。
en: When drugs are prohibited but some athletes use them anyway the playing field tilts in favor of the cheater.

zh: 如果我们禁止在奥林匹克运动会上服用兴奋剂，那么我们就应该负起责任，奉劝运动员不要做这种傻事、对运动员进行严格检测、并惩罚那些服用了兴奋剂的运动员。
en: If we prohibit drugs in the Olympic Games, we owe it to the athletes to deter, detect, and punish those who cheat.

zh: 诚实正直现在似乎已经过时了，但它却是我们做人做事的基本准则。
en: Integrity seems like an old-fashioned idea, but it is at the heart of who we are and how we live.

zh: 服用兴奋剂会从两个方面影响到运动员正直的品行。
en: Performance enhancing drugs affect the individual athlete's integrity in two ways.

zh: 第一，如果药品被禁止，那么选择不使用它们就是对人格的考验。
en: First, if drugs are banned, then choosing not to use them is a test of one's character.

zh: 正直的人不会不诚实，正直的人不会追求用一种非法获得的优势来击败他的竞争对手。
en: A person of integrity does not behave dishonestly. A person of integrity does not seek to prevail over his competitors by methods that give him an illegitimate advantage.

zh: 第二，正直意味着人格的完整、不受阻碍、道德健全和远离腐败。
en: Second, the concept of integrity implies wholeness, being unbroken, moral soundness and freedom from corruption.

zh: 当一个运动员通过服用兴奋剂而赢得比赛，他自己会怎么想？
en: When an athlete wins by using a performance enhancing drug, what does that mean for the athlete's own understanding of what happened?

zh: 我是世界最好选手吗？
en: Am I the world's best?

zh: 或我的胜利只能依赖于兴奋剂了吗？
en: Or was my supposed victory hopelessly tainted by the drug's effects?

zh: 通过使用兴奋剂而赢得的胜利对运动员来说，其含义是模糊的，隐晦的。
en: The meaning of a drug-aided victory is ambiguous and elusive even for the athlete.

zh: 它是堕落和病态的结果，与真正的胜利正好相反。
en: It is the result of corruption and brokenness, the very opposite of authentic victory.

zh: 什么才能造就真正的胜利？
en: What makes a victory authentic?

zh: 什么才是体育运动的意义和价值所在？
en: What gives sport its meaning and value?

zh: 我们希望冠军选手具备超凡的身体素质，以及堪称模范的刻苦训练和技艺。
en: We expect the winning athlete to combine extraordinary natural talents with exemplary effort, training and technique.

zh: 这些才是人类的精华所在。
en: These are all forms of human excellence.

zh: 有一些是我们生来就有的，有一些则不是。
en: Some we are born with - or not.

zh: 就象我热爱篮球运动，但我注定永远不会长到6英尺高。
en: As much as I loved playing basketball, I was destined never quite to reach six feet in height.

zh: 一个精确的起跳和自愿接受惩罚的心永远也无法弥补我个子的矮小和平庸的跳跃能力。
en: An accurate jump shot and the willingness to take punishment never made up for my size and mediocre leaping ability.

zh: 不管我们有哪些天生的能力，它们都是完美的。
en: Whatever natural abilities we have must be perfected.

zh: 我们获得成功 - - 也可能不会 - - 是通过人类的美德，如我们在面对严格训练时的意志力，在伤痛中仍然坚持不懈的决心，和我们在与对手抗争时的聪明才智，以及其它一些因素如富有经验的教练、优良的设备和营养调理等。
en: We achieve this - or not - through a combination of virtues such as fortitude in the face of relentless training, physical courage as we persevere through pain, and cleverness when we outsmart our opponents, along with other factors such as helpful coaching, optimized equipment, and sound nutrition.

zh: 天才应该受到尊重：他们幸运地具备了常人所敬畏的身体素质、勇气、坚韧、竞争意识、和其它受到我们推崇的人类美德。
en: Natural talents should be respected for what they are: the occasionally awesome luck of the biological draw. Courage, fortitude, competitive savvy, and other virtues rightfully command our moral admiration.

zh: 其它因素，如仪器设备、教练、营养，虽然也为运动员走向成功起到了重要作用，但不会引起同样的敬畏和尊重。
en: The other factors - equipment, coaching, and nutrition - contribute to an athlete's success but don't evoke the same awe or esteem.

zh: 当我们看到一个短跑选手创造了100米跑的世界纪录，我们尊重的不是他或她穿的鞋，也不是他或她在赛前接受了什么样的教导或在能量吧得到了哪些享受。
en: When we watch a sprinter set a new Olympic record in the hundred meter dash, it's not the shoes he or she wears that command our admiration. Nor is it the coaching received or the energy bar consumed just before the event.

zh: 所有这些，对于一个世界纪录来说，就象是一架好的照相机对拍出令人难忘的美国西部照片的当代摄影怪杰安塞尔·亚当斯那样必需，或象优质大理石和凿子对米开朗基罗创造大卫雕塑那样必不可少。
en: All of these contribute to the record, just like a good camera was necessary for Ansel Adam's unforgettable photos of the American West, or good marble and sharp chisels for Michelangelo's sculpture of David.

zh: 但我们最关心的、赋予这项成就意义和价值的，是运动员无法言喻的天才素质和超凡的奉献精神。
en: But what we care about most, what gives that achievement its meaning and value, is the ineffable combination of remarkable natural talents and extraordinary dedication.

zh: 服用兴奋剂掩盖了自然能力，也破坏了奉献精神和我们推崇的美德。
en: Performance enhancing drugs disguise natural abilities and substitute for the dedication and focus that we admire.

zh: 服用兴奋剂使体育运动变得廉价，使胜利者被排除在其它人之外，并剥夺了那些品德高尚的优秀运动员赢得本应属于他们的夺冠机会。
en: Performance enhancing drugs cheapen sport, making winners out of also-rans, and depriving virtuous and superior athletes of the victories that should be theirs.

zh: 让兴奋剂远离体育运动不是一件容易的事，也不能确保成功。
en: Getting performance enhancing drugs out of sport will not be easy, and success is not assured.

zh: 但既然我们追求公平、公正、公开的体育竞赛原则，追求体育比赛的意义和价值，那么一切努力都是有意义的。
en: But the effort is worthwhile as long as we care enough about fairness, integrity, and the meaning and value of sport.

zh: 药物遗传学家
en: Drugstore Geneticist

zh: 加利福尼亚拉霍拉 — — 2000年6月人类基因序列草图刚刚公布时，美国总统比尔·克林顿曾踌躇满志地宣告 ， “ 即便不能治愈所有人类疾病，这项发现也将为绝大多数人类疾病的诊断、预防和治疗工作带来革命性的变化。
en: LA JOLLA, CALIFORNIA – Back in June 2000, when the draft human-genome sequence was announced, US President Bill Clinton proclaimed, “It will revolutionize the diagnosis, prevention, and treatment of most, if not all, human diseases.”

zh: ” 十年后，满腔希望变成了失望，报纸的头版头条写道“基因图谱并未带来几种新的治疗方式 ” 。
en: A decade later, hope has given way to disappointment, reflected in headlines like “Gene Map Yields Few New Cures.”

zh: 但是对人类基因研究所能带来潜在医学突破的悲观情绪是不切实际的期望造成的。
en: But pessimism about the potential of human-genome research to yield medical breakthroughs has arisen from unrealistic expectations.

zh: 事实上，尽管人类并没有找到治愈最凶险疾病的“银弹 ” ， 但在基因药物作用（也叫基因药理学）领域却已经取得了引人瞩目的进步。
en: Indeed, while “silver bullets” that can cure our most feared diseases have not been found, progress in the area of gene-drug interactions, known as pharmacogenomics, has been extraordinary.

zh: 人体对处方药的反应变数由某些主要基因确定，而一项名叫全基因组关联研究（GWAS）的技术已经使确定这种基因的能力有了很大的提高。
en: The ability to determine the principal genes that account for our variable response to prescription drugs has been advanced by a technique known as a genome-wide association study (GWAS).

zh: 人类总基因数约为60亿，但只要研究基因芯片中的约100万个基因（占基因总数的0.01 % ） 就可以窥见人类基因的大部分奥妙。
en: The whole human genome has approximately six billion bases, but a window into its composition can be probed using approximately one million bases (0.01% of the genome) via a gene chip.

zh: 芯片上的基因就好比邮编索引，是特别选定的信息丰富且有代表性的基因储藏库。
en: The bases on the chip are selected because they are informative, tagging bins of the genome, like a post-code directory.

zh: 利用全基因组关联研究法，我们已经掌握了很多药物反应的生物学基础 — — 其中既包括药物疗效，也包括主要副作用。
en: Using GWAS methodology, we have learned the biological basis for responses to many drugs – both their effectiveness and important side-effects.

zh: 几年来此类进展的实例不胜枚举，包括他汀类药物、波立维、干扰素、华法令和抗生素氟氯西林。
en: Examples of this progress in the past couple of years are plentiful, and include the statins, Plavix, interferon, warfarin, and the antibiotic flucloxacillin.

zh: 降血液胆固醇含量的他汀类药物其主要副作用是严重的肌肉发炎，现在只需进行简单的基因类型测试即可预知是否会产生这样的负面后果。 对波立维的反应也可以通过这种方法提前测知，波立维是仅次于他汀类药物的应用最广泛的处方药。
en: The main side-effect of statins, which lower cholesterol in the blood, is severe muscle inflammation, and it can now be predicted with a simple genotype test, as can the response to Plavix, the second most commonly prescribed drug after statins.

zh: 携带至少一种基因变异，致使机体无法代谢波立维的患者其支架堵塞的风险比常人高300%之多。
en: Those individuals who carry at least one copy of the gene variant that does not allow the body to metabolize Plavix have a 300% higher risk of clotting a stent.

zh: 这类基因变异非常普遍，30%欧洲血统和50%亚洲血统的患者是这类变异基因的携带者。
en: This variation of the genome is exceptionally common, present in 30% of individuals of European ancestry and more than 50% of those of Asian ancestry.

zh: 针对此类患者把波立维的给药剂量翻倍，并随时进行现场测试掌握血小板数量就能解决对药物不敏感的问题。
en: In many such patients, doubling the dose of Plavix, and checking the platelet function with a point-of-care test to assure suppression, can override the lack of response.

zh: 此外还有普拉格雷或替卡格雷等其他替代用药，这些药可以替代波立维防止支架堵塞。
en: There are alternative drugs, such as prasugrel or ticagrelor, which can be used instead of Plavix to bypass the problem.

zh: 一年前刚刚用于治疗丙肝患者的干扰素，在现阶段的确非常引人注目。
en: The story of interferon, given for one year to patients with hepatitis C virus, is particularly striking.

zh: 这种治疗价格非常昂贵（约合50,000美元 ） ， 并且使所有患者产生类似流感症状和浑身不适等副作用。
en: This treatment is very costly (about $50,000) and makes all patients feel quite ill with flu-like symptoms and general malaise.

zh: 但药物仅对半数患者有效。
en: But the drug works in only half of the people treated.

zh: 我们现在知道只需一次简单的基因类型测定即可了解干扰素对特定患者的疗效，而那些疗效不佳的患者可以服用很多正在研制的新药。
en: We now know that a simple genotype sorts out who will or will not benefit from interferon, and there are many new drugs in development for those who will not.

zh: 通过基因类型测定预知疗效的例子还有很多。
en: The list goes on.

zh: 对广泛用于抗血液凝结的处方药华法令，基因类型测定可以引导患者服用正确的剂量，并缩短进入稳定期所需的时间。
en: For warfarin, a widely prescribed drug used to prevent blood clots, genotyping can guide the right dose and hasten the time it takes to get to steady state.

zh: 基因类型测定也可以提前预知氟氯西林或罗美昔布等药物是否会产生严重的肝脏毒性。
en: Genotyping can also predict severe liver toxicity for drugs such as flucloxacillin or lumiricoxib.

zh: 有一点毋庸置疑，那就是我们的预测能力还很不完善。
en: To be sure, our predictive ability is far from complete.

zh: 我们只能通过全基因组关联研究法了解最为普遍的基因变异现象。
en: We know only common gene variants from the GWAS approach.

zh: 此外，多数药物都还没有进行过研究，因此要填补这些空白还需要做很多工作。
en: Furthermore, most drugs have not even been studied yet, so there is a long way to go fill in the holes.

zh: 尽管如此，短短几年来已经取得了实质性的显著进步。
en: Nevertheless, substantive and remarkable progress has been made, all in the last few years.

zh: 此外，终有一天我们会通过全基因测序方式了解与罕见基因变异相关的治疗反应或副作用。
en: Moreover, someday we will know – via sequencing of the whole genome – about rarer genomic variations that are correlated with treatment response or side-effects.

zh: 这为新一代药理学奠定了基础。
en: This has paved the way for next-generation pharmacies.

zh: 现在可以在20分钟内完成基因类型测定，而且随着时间的推移速度还会进一步提高。
en: Genotyping can now be accomplished in 20 minutes, and over time will get even faster.

zh: 在开具药理基因学特性已知的处方药物时，可以让客户接受快速的基因类型测定，以确定合适的药物种类、药物剂量或可能造成的严重副作用。
en: To fill a prescription for a drug with a known pharmacogenomic profile, a customer can get rapid genotyping to determine appropriate dose, drug, or predilection for serious side-effects.

zh: 在理想状况下，很多人都会向消费基因公司递交唾液样本，后者将分析他们的基因药理数据并成立基因类型专家组负责每月更新数据，并将其存储在智能手机上。
en: Or even better, many people will submit a saliva sample to a consumer genomics company, which will analyze all of their pharmacogenomic data and perform an extensive panel of genotypes, updated every month, and store the data on their smart phones.

zh: 涉及处方药邮购业务的情况下，上述基因数据将会成为客户资料库中一种常规资料。
en: For mail-order prescriptions, such genomic data would be a routine part of the customer database.

zh: 美国由处方药集采企业（PBM）负责集中处理所有大规模企业（拥有超过2亿员工）的药物处方。
en: In the United States, pharmacy benefit managers (PBM) handle prescriptions for almost all large employers and account for more than 200 million individuals.

zh: 两家最大的处方药集采企业（Medco和CVS/Caremark）已经宣布了针对多种药物的大规模基因类型测定计划。
en: Two of the largest PBMs, Medco and CVS/Caremark, have announced plans to conduct large-scale genotyping for many drugs.

zh: 他们的目的在于更有效地运用处方药，同时相对于其他处方药集采企业占据竞争优势。
en: Their motives include more efficient use of prescription drugs, along with getting an edge on other PBM competitors.

zh: 由于美国的处方药开支高达每年3000亿美元，因此削减开支的余地肯定很大。
en: With annual expenditures for prescription drugs in the US totaling $300 billion, there is certainly room to cut costs.

zh: 令人遗憾的是，尽管监管部门竭力推荐多种药物，但医学界目前仍拒绝将药物基因数据应用于临床实践当中。
en: Unfortunately, the medical community is resisting the use of pharmacogenomic data in clinical practice, despite regulatory authorities’ recommendations for many drugs.

zh: 处方药集采企业和消费基因公司可以在推动数据的应用方面发挥积极的作用。
en: PBMs and consumer genomic companies can be a positive force by facilitating or advancing the use of such data.

zh: 基因药理学的最终目的是以恰当的剂量为恰当的患者提供不产生严重副作用的恰当的药品。
en: The ultimate goal of pharmacogenomics is to provide the right drug, at the right dose, for the right individual, without any significant side-effects.

zh: 尽管对基因组研究的实际影响普遍存在误解，但这门学科已经开始渐入佳境，如果我们想要抓住实现个性化医疗的难得机遇，我们就必须很好地利用这样的势头。
en: Despite widespread misperceptions about the practical impact of genomic research, the science has hit its stride, and we need to capitalize on this momentum if we are to realize the opportunity of individualized medicine.

zh: 新一代药理学向实现这一目标迈出了充满希望的一步。
en: Next-generation pharmacies represent a promising step toward that goal.

zh: 针对女性的禁毒战争
en: The Drug War on Women

zh: 纽约 — — 我在社会主义的波兰长大时，国际妇女节被用来庆祝妇女的贡献和成就。
en: NEW YORK – When I was growing up in communist Poland, International Women’s Day was viewed as an opportunity to celebrate women’s contributions and accomplishments.

zh: 但其实这只是个空洞的记号。
en: But it was a hollow token.

zh: 翌日，妇女们依然要继续面对机会有限的生活。
en: The following day, women went back to their lives of limited opportunity.

zh: 几代人的歧视不是一天的节日可以矫正的。
en: No one-day holiday can do much to redress generations of discrimination.

zh: 国际禁毒政策制度的影响同样反映了这样的现实。
en: The impact of the international drug-policy regime reflects this reality.

zh: 妇女最常出现在供应链的底部，往往扮演“毒品贩运者 ” 。
en: In the drug supply chain, women are most commonly found at the bottom, often acting as “mules.”

zh: 如果被捕，尽管往往是非暴力初犯，但依然面临着严酷的最低强制刑期的处罚。
en: When a woman is caught, although she is often a non-violent first time offender, she faces a harsh mandatory minimum sentence.

zh: 对毒贩子而言，这些女性是可以牺牲的。
en: To the traffickers, these women are expendable.

zh: 她们很少会得到保释、或者聘请律师，因为她们对整个贩毒机制没有任何价值。
en: Bail is rarely put up for them, or a lawyer hired, because they hold no value to the trafficking structures.

zh: 而且，单凭自身力量，这些女性缺乏知识和资源，无法真正理解司法系统。
en: And, left on their own, these women lack the knowledge and resources to navigate the criminal justice system.

zh: 她们也不太可能掌握有价值的信息，很难换取当局的从轻发落。
en: Nor are they likely to have the right kind of information to trade with authorities in exchange for a lighter sentence.

zh: 因涉毒而被判入狱的妇女数量远比其他任何罪行要多。
en: More women are sent to jail for drug offences than for any other crime.

zh: 仅在拉美，在押女犯的70%都因为涉毒。
en: In Latin America alone, they account for 70% of women in prison.

zh: 对贩运者监禁数十年的刑罚对贩毒贸易的影响微不足道；但对妇女及其家庭的伤害却是灾难性和不可逆转的。
en: The impact on the drug trade of incarcerating a drug mule for a decade is minuscule; but the effect on the women and their families is devastating and irreversible.

zh: 苏联解体后的塔吉克斯坦和吉尔吉斯斯坦之行令我最早注意到禁毒政策对女性的影响。
en: I first noticed the effects of drug policy on women when I traveled to Tajikistan and Kyrgyzstan after the collapse of the Soviet Union.

zh: 在吉尔吉斯山区，有不少村子整村都没有一个男人；他们都到俄罗斯去打工了。
en: In the Kyrgyz mountains, there were entire villages with not a man in sight; they had become migrant workers in Russia.

zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦独立短短两年，监狱中就关满了被判贩毒罪名的女性。
en: Within two years of Kyrgyzstan’s independence, prisons filled with women held on drug-trafficking charges.

zh: 这些人都是普普通通的妇女，其中有些甚至是戴着头巾的“老妇 ” 。
en: These were ordinary women, some of them “babushkas” wearing headscarves.

zh: 在与高级执法官员交谈的过程中，我被告知这些女性都曾从阿富汗贩运毒品，以支付购买鞋子和课本的开销。
en: When speaking to senior law enforcement officials, I was told that the women were smuggling drugs from Afghanistan to pay for shoes and schoolbooks.

zh: 对塔吉克和吉尔吉斯刑事体系而言，她们是新发动的禁毒战争最容易实现的成果。
en: To the Tajik and Kyrgyz criminal justice system, they were the lowest-hanging fruit in the newly launched war on drugs.

zh: 这种状况下的女性面临同时失去自由和家庭的双重惩罚。
en: Women in such circumstances face a double punishment: loss of liberty and family.

zh: 被判毒品相关罪名往往意味着失去孩子的监护权。
en: To be convicted of a drug-related crime often means losing custody of one’s children.

zh: 如果入狱的女性是单亲家庭的支撑者并且其子女被送入抚养系统，或者如果她入狱时就已经怀孕，那么她很可能永远也无法再见到自己的孩子。
en: If the woman sent to jail is the head of a single-parent household and her children are placed in foster care, or if she is pregnant when entering prison, it is likely that she will never see them again.

zh: 妇女可以成为旨在打击贩毒集团的法律的牺牲者。
en: Women can be victims of laws designed to combat trafficking organizations.

zh: 很多人仅仅因为和参与贩毒的男性一起生活就被控为同谋。
en: Many have been charged with conspiracy simply for living with a man involved in drug sales.

zh: 在美国某些州，公共援助的申请者（往往是女性）必须接受毒品测试。
en: In some US states, applicants for public assistance, who are usually women, have to undergo drug testing.

zh: 在很多国家，毒品治疗程序实际确保了有孩子的女性不可能接受服务。
en: In many countries, drug-treatment protocols effectively ensure that women with children will be unable to receive services.

zh: 在中亚很多地区，毒品依赖者必须在当局登记才能接受治疗，这将自动导致女性有可能失去孩子的抚养权。
en: In much of Central Asia, a drug-dependent person has to register with authorities to receive treatment, which automatically puts women at risk of losing their children.

zh: 在东欧，多数治疗毒品的长期项目都远离市区，并且没有托儿服务。
en: In Eastern Europe, most available drug treatment takes place in long-term programs located at centers far from urban centers and without child-care services.

zh: 很少有女性能抽出6个月或以上的时间，抛开子女或父母进入这样的机构戒毒。
en: Few women are able to take six months or more from caring for children or parents to enter such a facility.

zh: 伴随着吸毒女性的刑罚和屈辱意味着她们不太可能像男性那样主动承认因吸毒行为而需要帮助。
en: The criminalization and stigmatization of women who use illicit drugs means that they are less likely than men to self-identify as needing assistance for drug dependence.

zh: 这部分解释了为什么登记接受戒毒的女性数量很少。
en: This helps explain the low numbers of women who use services.

zh: 就像在某些文化中女性要等男性和儿童吃过之后才能吃饭一样，她往往会用丈夫用过的针管注射，从而导致感染艾滋病毒或丙肝的风险升高。 性交易和吸毒人群高度重合同样导致女性的感染风险更大。
en: In the same way that in some cultures a woman eats only when men and children have finished, she injects with syringes that her partner has already used, putting them at higher risk of contracting HIV or Hepatitis C. The significant overlap between sex work and drug use also places women at higher risk.

zh: 此外，世界各国女性的弱点也往往被国内贩毒体系所利用。
en: National drug regimes, moreover, prey on the vulnerabilities of women worldwide.

zh: 曾经有一名肯尼亚女性将可卡因带入英国，而我曾与逮捕她的伦敦机场官员对坐谈话。
en: I sat once with an official at a London airport who picked up a Kenyan woman bringing cocaine into the United Kingdom.

zh: 他透露招募者曾经告诉这位女性，即使她被拦住，其后果也仅仅是遣返，因为她既是一位女性也是一位母亲。
en: The woman had been told by a person who recruited her that if she was stopped, she would simply be sent home without repercussions because she was a woman and a mother.

zh: 事实是半公斤可卡因就会带来10年的强制刑罚。
en: In reality, the half-kilo of cocaine brought a ten-year mandatory sentence.

zh: 一旦被囚禁在国外，这些母亲既没有法律支援也没有经济资源，往往会失去与家中子女的任何联络。
en: Once imprisoned abroad, such mothers, with no legal support or economic resources, often have no contact with their children back home.

zh: 必须���禁毒政策进行改革以期纠正刑事司法、医疗卫生和福利制度方面的系统性错误，避免让陷入毒品战交叉火力的女性困境进一步恶化。
en: Part of the effort to reform drug policy must address the systemic faults in criminal justice, health care, and welfare that exacerbate the plight of women caught in the crossfire of the war of drugs.

zh: 为戒毒女性提供托儿服务的政策可能会招致全世界道德制高点占领者的强烈谴责。
en: The kind of policy that provides childcare for women seeking drug treatment might be anathema to the righteous occupiers of the world’s moral high ground.

zh: 但只有以对性别敏感的眼光来审视禁毒政策并致力于减少伤害，我们才能扭转禁毒战争的不利局面，阻止世世代代最为脆弱的妇女和女童继续成为这场战争的牺牲者。
en: But until we start to look at drug policy through a gender-sensitive lens and focus on harm reduction, we will continue to wage a losing war on drugs, in which generations of our most vulnerable women and girls are casualties.

zh: 干涸的中国
en: Dry China

zh: 发自中国贵州安顺 — — 位于中国贵州省西南部的黄果树瀑布是一处无比壮观的景点，作为亚洲最大的瀑布，激流从200英尺高的峭壁上一泻而下，发出惊雷般的声响，白浪纷飞，彩虹隐现 — — 但这一切都得在瀑布有水的时候。
en: ANSHUN, GUIZHOU PROVINCE, CHINA -- The Huangguoshu Waterfall in China’s southwestern Guizhou Province is a magnificent sight, when there is water. The largest waterfall in Asia, it plunges over a sheer cliff more than 200 feet high in a thundering display of foam, mist, and rainbows.

zh: 不幸的是，这处自然奇观最近却正饱受煎熬。
en: Unfortunately, this wonder of nature has recently suffered an indignity.

zh: 每天晚上，瀑布就像某座被拧紧了水龙头的花园喷泉那样 — — 断水了。
en: Each evening, it gets turned off as if it were a garden fountain.

zh: 以其充沛的降雨，山川，地下河，溶洞以及热带植物闻名于世的中国西南部地区，如今却正在遭遇一场据说是自明代以来最严重的干旱。
en: This part of China’s southwest, known for its abundant rainfall, mountains, underground rivers and caves, and tropical flora, has recently been gripped by a drought that many say is the worst since the Ming Dynasty.

zh: 因此当给这个贫困地区带来宝贵收入的游客陆续离开了瀑布的观景台之后，当地政府就会关闭控制白水河（该河上游水库的蓄水量已经低于警戒线了）的水闸，然后瀑布的水就停了。
en: So, after all the tourists that irrigate this poor region with precious income leave the viewing platforms below the falls, authorities close the sluice gates that dam the White Water River on the dangerously low upstream reservoir, and the falls cease.

zh: 赶在第二天早上游客到来之前，他们又开闸放水，于是这个死一般寂静的瀑布突然又像安装了某种虚拟视觉装置那样转眼间变得生机勃勃了。
en: Then, each morning, before the tourists reappear, they unceremoniously open the gates again, so that the eerily silent falls suddenly revive in a simulacrum of normalcy.

zh: 而这种对该区域自然景观的控制只是应对最近侵扰中国的严酷气候灾害 — — 从洪水，干旱，再到非季节性暴风雪以及大规模沙尘暴 — — 的其中一项措施，也没有人能说明白这些灾难背后的成因究竟是什么。
en: The disturbance to so elemental a part of this region’s natural architecture is a measure of only one of the many kinds of severe weather aberrations – from floods and droughts to unseasonal blizzards and massive dust storms – that have been unsettling China of late. No one can say with any certainty what the causes are.

zh: 为了降低这种麻烦不断的气候模式所造成的影响，中国的官员们不惜投入巨资，启动了一批空前绝后的工程，其中包括耗资550亿美元的南水北调工程，用大规模的技术手段，兴建三条运河，将水从以往水量充沛的南部输送到北部；此外还广泛挖井取水，打井的深度也是前所未有的；在全国范围内开展植树运动；甚至还包括了大规模的“人工气候干预”计划。
en: To try to compensate for these perturbed weather patterns, Chinese officialdom has launched an unprecedented array of costly projects. These include the titanic $55 billion South-North Water Transfer Project, a massive engineering effort to construct three canals to bring water from China’s normally wet south to its arid north; a widespread campaign to dig ever-deeper wells; a nationwide tree-planting campaign; and even an extensive effort at  “weather modification.”

zh: 照国家气象局局长郑国光的说法 ： “ 用科学技术就能拯救那些遭遇几十年来最严重旱灾的人民。
en: According to Zheng Guoguang, the Director of the China Meteorological Administration, “Science and technology will answer the prayers of those living through the harshest drought in decades.”

zh: ”他还提到中国3000多个县中已经有2/3试行了人工降雨，有时甚至在争夺雨云方面引发法律纠纷。
en: He says that two-thirds of China’s almost 3,000 counties have tried artificial methods to induce more rainfall, sometimes resulting in lawsuits over rights to mine passing clouds for water.

zh: 这项工程共动用了6533门高炮，5939个火箭发射架以及许多架次的飞机来播撒干冰，液态氮和碘化银，好让覆盖中国大陆1/3面积的云团洒下雨来。
en: Such efforts, Zheng reports, have involved some 6,533 cannons, 5,939 rocket launchers, and numerous aircraft in an attempt to seed clouds across one-third of China’s landmass with dry ice, ammonia, and silver iodide.

zh: 但光靠科学技术就能解决这些不仅由中国本身所导致的问题吗？
en: But can science and technology really solve problems that are not caused by China alone?

zh: 越来越多的科学家开始怀疑当今中国降雨模式的剧变是由气候变化引发的。
en: More and more scientists are beginning to suspect that global warming has caused the radically changed patterns of precipitation now seen across China.

zh: 如果情况属实的话，不管中国政府上马多少大型工程或者组织了多么完美的补救措施，也永远不可能独力解决目前的干旱状况。
en: If true, China will never resolve droughts such as the current one in Guizhou by itself, regardless of how many large-scale engineering projects the government undertakes, or how well organized remedial efforts are.

zh: 毕竟，应对全球性问题还得有全球性的解决方案。
en: After all, global problems demand global solutions.

zh: 在中国前国家主席毛泽东还大权在握之时，最令他本人感到骄傲的一句名言就是“自力更生 ” ， 当旧中国遭受列强威胁恐吓，入侵，半殖民地化，乃至在他青年时期还遭受占领的年月里，毛泽东就开始深深怀疑外国政权 — — 甚至连共产主义“同志”也包括在内 — — 是否会愿意让中国独立自主，更别说帮助中国了。
en: When Chairman Mao still reigned supreme, one of his most vaunted principles was zili gengsheng, or “self-reliance.” Since China had been bullied, invaded, semi-colonized, and even occupied during most of his formative years, he was deeply suspicious that any foreign country – even a “fraternal” Communist ally – could ever be relied upon to leave China alone, much less actually help it.

zh: 中共领导层也因此逐渐变得多疑，对外界充满了不信任，尤其是对那些所谓的“超级大国 ” 。
en: As a result, the Party leadership became steeped in suspicion and distrust toward the outside world, especially toward the so-called “great powers.”

zh: 时至今日，即便毛泽东的革命时代已成往事，全球化效应也已在中国周边编织了一张新的互相依存网之时，中国领导人（特别是老一代领导人）始终残留着对外部合作的警惕，尤其在涉及到“核心利益”的时候。
en: Even today, with Mao’s revolution long gone and globalization having knit a new fabric of inter-dependence around China, there remains, particularly among older leaders, a residual wariness about relying on collaboration with outsiders, especially when it comes to “core interests.”

zh: 但导致中国融入全球共同利益的不仅是全球市场，还有类似核扩散以及世界环境问题 — — 尤其是气候变化 — — 也都影响了中国的领导人（以及世界其他地方的领导人 ） 。
en: But it is not just world markets that have enmeshed China in a new commons. Issues such as nuclear proliferation and the global environment – and especially climate change – have also snuck up on China’s leaders (and everyone else).

zh: 不管是否愿意，全世界的领导人其实都被一张无法逃避的大网裹住了。
en: Like it or not, leaders everywhere are now enfolded in an inescapable web.

zh: 因此尽管中国喜欢独来独往，但合作已经不仅仅是一个选项，而是一种必需。
en: So, despite China’s predilection for aloofness, cooperation is not merely an option, but a necessity.

zh: 对此中国也必须重新检讨自身对于主权的旧观念。
en: And that means that China also must reconsider its rigid notion of sovereignty.

zh: 这种转变对任何国家来说都是个非常艰难的过程，尤其是中国这个曾经自以为是世界中心，同时也保留着一种不可侵犯的特质，随时都可以闭门谢客的国家。
en: This is a difficult adjustment for any country to make, especially one like China, which has a history of imagining itself as being at the center of the world while also remaining an inviolable entity that can close its doors whenever it chooses to do so.

zh: 但要知道这一切都已经是老一套了。
en: That time is past.

zh: 中国领导人已经承诺“开放”超过一代人时间。
en: China’s leaders have been committed to a process of “opening” for more than a generation.

zh: 但他们对任何外部干涉的迹象依然保持着神经质式的敏感，即便是那种认为中国国内事务也可能是他国事务的建议，反之亦然。
en: But they remain neuralgic about any hint of outside interference, including even the suggestion that their nation’s business might also be the business of other peoples, and vice versa.

zh: 贵州省的干旱，不管原因为何，都在提醒我们中国人民的命运已经无可避免地和其他地方发生的事务联系在了一起，而且再也没有一个国家，能够选择或者找到一个独立于全球利益共同体的单方面解决方案了。
en: The drought in Guizhou, whatever its cause, is a reminder that the fate of China’s people has become inextricably linked to what happens elsewhere, and that no country can opt out or find unilateral solutions separate from the global commonweal any longer.

zh: 迪拜成功的秘密
en: The Secret of Dubai’s Success

zh: 迪拜 — — 随着中东各国政府试图摆脱对自然资源的依赖并建立多样化、适应性强的经济，他们应当学习迪拜的经验。
en: DUBAI – As governments across the Middle East try to wean themselves off natural resources and build diversified, resilient economies, they should take some lessons from Dubai.

zh: 迪拜的故事令人叹为观止。
en: It’s a remarkable story.

zh: 迪拜只用了不到一代人的时间就实现了向投资商业和高端文化重要中心的转型。
en: In less than a generation, Dubai has transformed itself into a major center for investment, commerce, and high-end culture.

zh: 虽然2008年全球金融危机沉重打击了这个城市国家（因为其不动产资产风险高涨 ） ， 但迪拜经济迅速得到了恢复，这一点由于迪拜申请主办2020年世博会而得到了证实。
en: Although the 2008 global financial crisis hit the city-state hard (owing to its exposure to inflated real-estate assets), it recovered quickly, as evidenced by its bids for events such as the World Expo 2020.

zh: 我们应当仔细思考迪拜是怎样不仅在面对危机时生存下来，而且还实现了发展和繁荣。
en: How Dubai managed not only to survive, but to thrive, in the wake of the crisis warrants closer scrutiny.

zh: 因此，今年夏天，我开始调研所谓的迪拜弹性增长模式，以及这种模式可能面临的挑战。
en: So, this past summer, I began investigating the so-called Dubai model of resilient growth, and the challenges that may lie ahead for it.

zh: 在研究中，我与政府官员和商界精英进行了40多次深度访谈，并以辅助数据资源来充实我的研究成果。
en: As part of my research, I conducted more than 40 in-depth interviews with government officials and business elites, and fleshed out my findings with secondary data sources.

zh: 迪拜的经济增长和适应性应归功于其吸引力、品牌和国家主导发展的“ABS模式 ” 。
en: Dubai’s growth and resilience is attributable to its “ABS model” of attraction, branding, and state-led development.

zh: 就像汽车的防抱死制动系统防止其在危险环境下侧滑失控，迪拜的三管齐下战略保证其发展计划不偏离轨道，即使是在经济危机之中。
en: Just as a car’s anti-lock braking system prevents it from skidding out of control in dangerous situations, Dubai’s three-prong strategy keeps its development agenda on track, even during economic crises.

zh: 在国家主导的经济发展方面，迪拜模式代表了海湾国家的典型。
en: With respect to state-led development, Dubai’s approach is typical of Gulf states.

zh: 迪拜社会坚持部落传统，支持由王室家族领导的精英统治者在决定经济发展方向及形式方面发挥无所不能的家长式作用。
en: Its society adheres to tribal traditions that afford its ruling elite, headed by the royal family, a paternal and omnipotent role in determining the direction and form of economic development.

zh: 这意味着这家“迪拜集团”可以迅速无缝地适应不断变化的经济环境。
en: This means that “Dubai, Inc.” can quickly and seamlessly adapt to changing economic circumstances.

zh: 迪拜有时被称为沙漠新加坡，因为它像新加坡一样经历了由政府主导的庞大经济增长，并因为积极主动、富有远见卓识的领导力而将一个自然资源有限的小型城市国家发展成为一个重要的国际贸易中心。
en: Dubai is sometimes called the Singapore of the Desert, because, like Singapore, it has experienced enormous state-directed economic growth, and benefits from proactive, visionary leadership that has turned a small city-state with limited natural resources into an important international entrepôt.

zh: 此外，迪拜成功建立了自主品牌，成功吸引了实现其增长目标所需的外资和劳动力大量流入。
en: Moreover, Dubai has done a good job of branding itself to attract the foreign investment and labor needed to achieve its growth ambitions.

zh: 像借助城市景观和天际线提升城市形象的纽约、上海和拉斯维加斯一样，迪拜利用其自身的都市风光和空中轮廓展现了其以创新为主导的特征。 迪拜拥有约150座摩天大楼，这一数量超过了除纽约和香港之外的其他任何城市。
en: Like New York, Shanghai, and Las Vegas, which have all enhanced their images through architecture, Dubai conveys its innovation-oriented identity through its cityscape and skyline, which has around 150 skyscrapers, more than any other city except New York and Hong Kong.

zh: 迪拜还修建了首家3D打印办公楼、令人赞叹的人工岛、世界唯一一座（号称 ） “ 七星级的酒店 ” 、 内设水族馆的购物中心、室内滑雪和跳伞设施，以及一系列标志性游乐园和建筑物。
en: Dubai also has the first 3D-printed office building, stunning manmade islands, the world’s only (self-proclaimed) “seven-star hotel,” shopping malls combined with aquariums, indoor skiing, and skydiving facilities, and an array of iconic buildings and amusement parks.

zh: 这里同时举办全世界最昂贵的赛马和其他奢侈的体育赛事。
en: It also hosts the world’s most expensive horseraces and other lavish sporting events.

zh: 迪拜的政治稳定、安全、包容、文化多样性和高水准生活进一步强化了迪拜的品牌形象，吸引了来自世界各国的拥有熟练技术的外籍雇员。
en: Dubai’s brand is further strengthened by its political stability, safety, tolerance, cultural diversity, and high standard of living, which are a draw for skilled expatriates from around the world.

zh: 此外，阿联酋用其他国家无法比拟的经济特区吸引外国投资者。
en: Moreover, the emirate appeals to foreign investors with special economic zones that few other states can match.

zh: 迪拜四小时飞行半径内生活着20亿民众，因此它对游客和投资人拥有超强的吸引力原本就在意料之中。
en: Two billion people live within a four-hour flight radius of Dubai, so it is unsurprising that it has emerged as a compelling location for visitors and investors alike.

zh: 就像我所采访的一位女性商人所说的那样 ， “ 强烈吸引世界各地投资者和游客的所有元素在迪拜全都具备 ， ” 同时有“大量阿拉伯青年梦想来到这里并实现‘迪拜梦 ’ ” 。
en: As one businesswoman I interviewed put it, “Dubai has all the ingredients of an extremely popular attraction for investors and tourists from around the world,” with “a substantial number of Arab youth aspiring to come and live the ‘Dubai Dream.’”

zh: 迪拜还成功地以能吸引低技术外来工人为其增长引擎注入动力的劳工政策吸引高技术工人和投资来对其竞争优势进行补充。
en: Dubai has complemented its competitive advantage in attracting high-skill workers and investment with labor policies that also bring in lower-skill foreign workers to power its growth engine.

zh: 但不久的将来依靠外国工人可能会造成结构性问题。
en: But reliance on foreign workers could run into structural problems down the road.

zh: 虽然企业可以在困难时期迅速裁减人员，但当经济条件逐步改善时却会导致劳动力短缺。
en: While firms can quickly shed workers during hard times, this then results in labor shortages when conditions improve.

zh: 尤其是吸引比裁减高技术工人所需的时间要长得多。
en: Higher-skill workers, in particular, take much longer to attract than to let go.

zh: 另外一个危险因素是尽管阿拉伯联合酋长国政治和经济长期稳定，但重大的地区动荡却可能导致外国工人，无论其技术水平如何，不顾高薪承诺和引人入胜的生活方式匆忙逃离。
en: Another risk is that, while the emirate has enjoyed a long period of political and economic stability, a significant regional upheaval could cause foreign workers, whatever their skill level, to take flight, regardless of the promise of high salaries and an attractive lifestyle.

zh: 迪拜对外国劳工的依赖也因此威胁到其抵御未来冲击的长期经济潜能。
en: Dubai’s reliance on foreign labor thus threatens its long-term economic capacity to withstand future shocks.

zh: 正因为意识到这些潜在风险，迪拜领导层全面计划彻底改革教育以开发本土人力资本。
en: Aware of these potential risks, Dubai’s leadership has just approved a comprehensive plan to overhaul education aimed at developing indigenous human capital.

zh: 迪拜统治者谢赫·穆罕默德·本·拉希德表示 ， “ 我们期待培养出有能力使用未来工具的新一代学生。 ”
en: Dubai’s ruler, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid, said that, “We look forward to developing a new generation of students that is equipped to use the tools of the future.”

zh: 教育改革可能需要一代人甚至更长时间才能取得成功。
en: Educational reforms will likely require a generation or more to bear fruit.

zh: 新加坡最终通过大规模投资教育和优先普及国内中学以上教育成功了建立起一座高技能的本土人才库。
en: Singapore eventually managed to develop a highly skilled base of indigenous talent by making large investments in education and setting completion of post-secondary study as a national priority.

zh: 这座城市国家现在在科学和数学的国际测试中几乎得到最高分。
en: The city-state now scores near the top in science and math on international tests.

zh: ABS模式可以解释迪拜的经济活力以及全球金融危机后该国的迅速复苏。
en: The ABS model explains Dubai’s economic resilience and its quick recovery after the global financial crisis.

zh: 但它同时可以帮助酋长国为迎接新挑战而对国内领略进行调整。
en: But it also helps the emirate adjust its strategy to account for new challenges.

zh: 就像汽车的ABS系统让驾驶者更容易减速或改变航向避开危险障碍一样，迪拜由国家主导的发展架构可以根据增长目标和中东地区及全球不断变化的情况调整其吸引力和品牌建设行为。
en: Just as a car’s ABS makes it easier for a driver to slow down or change course to avoid dangerous obstacles, Dubai’s state-led development apparatus can realign its attraction and branding activities in accordance with its growth goals and changing circumstances in the Middle East and beyond.

zh: 另一方面，如果政府无法解决其结构性问题 — — 也就是欠发达的本土人力资本 — — 那么它本质上将驾驶着一辆更加危险的轿车，这辆车很难甚至根本不可能避开障碍，除非我们将车轮彻底锁定。
en: On the other hand, if the government fails to fix its structural problem – under-developed indigenous human capital – it will essentially be driving a more dangerous car, one in which it will become difficult or impossible to avoid obstacles without the wheels locking up.

zh: 丢掉里斯本备忘录
en: Dump the Lisbon Agenda

zh: 刚接任欧盟委员会主席，葡萄牙前总理杜朗·巴罗佐就应立即着手恢复欧盟经济政策的秩序和重心。
en: As soon as he takes office as President of the European Commission, Durao Barroso - Portugal's former Prime Minister - should devote urgent attention to restoring order and focus to the European Union's economic policies.

zh: 巴罗佐办公桌上堆积如山的文案都与里斯本备忘录有关，2000年，欧盟国家和政府领导人批准了一项雄心勃勃的计划，2010年前把欧盟建成"最有竞争力和活力的知识经济 " 。
en: The thickest file on his desk concerns the Lisbon agenda, an ambitious programme approved in 2000 by the EU heads of state and government with the goal of making the Union "the most competitive and dynamic knowledge economy" by 2010.

zh: 计划涵盖了所有主要的经济政策领域：包括创新和企业精神、福利改革和社会包容、劳动技术和就业能力、性别平等、劳动力和产品市场开放以及"可持续"发展。
en: All major fields of economic policy are covered: innovation and entrepreneurship, welfare reform and social inclusion, skills and employability, gender equality, labour and product market liberalisation, and "sustainable" development.

zh: 这些目标无疑都很有价值，但本质上却属于国家政治决策的范畴。
en: All of these are worthy goals, to be sure, but they belong intrinsically to the sphere of national political decisions.

zh: 按照欧盟条约的规定，欧盟实际无权在上述领域颁布法令和政策，更谈不上执行权。
en: Indeed, under the European Treaties, the Union has no competence to enact legislation and policy in these domains, nor powers to enforce them.

zh: 但在欧盟委员会的敦促下，欧洲理事会发明了新的政策方针，起名叫"公开协调 " ， 目的无非是想挤进上述那些领域。
en: But the European Council, spurred by the European Commission, invented a new policy approach - called "open coordination" - in order to impinge on these fields.

zh: 公开协调规定：欧盟要对共同目标进行定义、由成员国自愿遵守，并在欧洲理事会开展同级审阅。
en: Open coordination entails the definition of common goals at the EU level, voluntary compliance by the member states, and peer review of results within the European Council.

zh: 这样的公开协调不可避免地遭到了失败。
en: Inevitably, open coordination has failed to deliver on its promises.

zh: 更有甚者，人们产生了欧洲理事会能以某种方式实现发展和生产率的错误看法，这给了本就不愿在国内推行不受欢迎政策的各国领导人转移目标的借口。
en: Moreover, the delusion that the European Council can somehow call growth and productivity into being has provided a diversion to national politicians who are unwilling to push for unpopular decisions back home.

zh: 有鉴于此，我对巴罗佐的第一条建议就是彻底摒弃里斯本备忘录。
en: My first suggestion to Barroso, therefore, is to scrap the Lisbon agenda.

zh: 只有这样才能表明：各国决策者需要为国家经济状况承担责任。
en: Only this will make it clear that responsibility for national economic performance lies with national policy-makers.

zh: 我再接着谈谈欧盟级别的宏观经济协调。
en: This brings me to the subject of macroeconomic coordination at the EU level.

zh: 《马斯特里赫特条约》设计了经济和货币联盟的简单政策框架。
en: The Maastricht Treaty envisaged a simple policy framework for economic and monetary union.

zh: 货币政策由独立央行负责集中托管，而财政政策仍由各成员国自己负责。
en: Monetary policy was centralized and entrusted to an independent central bank, while fiscal policy was left to the member states.

zh: 各国政府要遵守额外赤字程序的规定，接受财政赤字不超过国内生产总值3%和政府债务不超过国内生产总值60%的双重束缚（至少也要向上述数字靠拢 ） 。
