en: In both places, I witnessed firsthand the virus’s devastating impact: suffering, fear, despair, and, ultimately, death.

zh: 就连琐碎小事也被赋予了特殊的涵义：这个地区的民众都不敢握手。
en: Even the trivial has become weighted with meaning: no one shook hands.

zh: 真相是埃博拉病毒继续传播 — — 并且以很快的速度。
en: The truth is that the Ebola virus continues to spread – and quickly.

zh: 诚然，病毒在利比亚已经得到控制 — — 但也仅限于利比亚，并且就连在那里，也无法确保疫情不再次发生。
en: Granted, it has been contained in Liberia, but only in Liberia, and even there, there is no way to ensure that another outbreak will not occur.

zh: 埃博拉传播的方式与我们之前目睹的不同。
en: Ebola is spreading in ways that differ from what we have previously seen.

zh: 埃博拉不具备流感那样的传播速度，这一特点曾经限制了疫情的规模，使疫情主要集中在农村地区。
en: The virus does not spread as rapidly as many others, such as influenza, which in the past limited the scale of epidemics, particularly because outbreaks were confined to rural areas.

zh: 但此次病毒已经来到了城镇和城市，这大大增加了病毒的危险性。
en: But this time, the virus has entered cities and towns, making it especially dangerous.

zh: 密集的人口为一切病毒传播提供了肥沃的土壤，更不用说这次的埃博拉疫情。
en: High population density provides fertile ground for any virus, let alone Ebola.

zh: 西非普遍贫困、医疗资源稀缺、城市拥挤等危险组合带来的打击可能具有毁灭性。
en: West Africa’s treacherous combination of widespread poverty, scarce medical resources, and crowded urban areas can be devastatingly deadly.

zh: 据报道今年有近 7,500人死于埃博拉，超过 16,000人遭到感染。
en: Nearly 7,500 people are reported to have died from Ebola this year. More than 16,000 are reported to have been infected.

zh: 这些还只是大概的数据，虽然上述信息大致反映了疫情状况及对策的有效性，官方警告这些可能远低于真正的数据。
en: These are ballpark figures, and while they provide important information about the trajectory of the epidemic and the effectiveness of response efforts, officials warn that the real numbers are probably far higher.

zh: 健康是一项全球性的公益事业。
en: Health is a global public good.

zh: 在多数国家，宪法或法律保障公民拥有健康权。
en: In most countries, the right to health is enshrined in the constitution or legislation.

zh: 世卫组织定义健康权包括“能及时得到有一定质量、可以接受且负担得起的医疗救治。
en: The right, according to the World Health Organization (WHO), includes “access to timely, acceptable, and affordable health care of appropriate quality.”

zh: ”但一旦涉及埃博拉，几乎没有任何国家能做出这样的保证。
en: But, in the case of viruses like Ebola, few states, if any, can issue such guarantees.

zh: 从道德角度看，国际社会有责任利用掌握的机构、权威、财力雄厚的企业和个人 — — 还有知识和财富 — — 为阻止埃博拉病毒传播采取必要的措施。
en: From a moral point of view, it is incumbent upon the international community, with its institutions, authorities, resourceful businesses, and individuals – as well as its knowledge and wealth – to deploy the necessary means to stop the spread of Ebola.

zh: 即便从自利的角度必要性也同样强烈。
en: The imperative is equally strong from a purely self-interested point of view.

zh: 如果病毒得不到迅速控制，所有人 — — 所有国家 — — 都将会处在危险之中。
en: If the virus is not quickly contained, everyone – every country – will be at risk.

zh: 好消息是埃博拉病毒可以得到遏制。
en: The good news is that Ebola can be contained.

zh: 最终也可以彻底根除。
en: Eventually, it can be eradicated.

zh: 但要想做到这一点，必须��了解和诊断病毒为前提。
en: If we are to achieve this, however, the virus must be understood and diagnosed.

zh: 必须防止病毒进一步传播，并提供有效的治疗方式。
en: Its spread must be prevented, and treatment must be offered.

zh: 虽然现在还没有经临床验证的治疗埃博拉的疫苗，但这种状况可能很快发生改变。
en: Though there is no clinically proven vaccine against Ebola, this could soon change.

zh: 今年3月埃博拉病毒爆发后，一家独立的非营利性研究机构巴斯德研究所一直致力于了解这种病毒并研究治疗方案。
en: Since the outbreak of the virus in March, the Institut Pasteur, an independent, non-profit research organization, has worked to understand how the virus can be contained and what treatment can be offered.

zh: 我们的研究人员通过追踪病毒传播了解疫情变化，我们正努力协助当地科研和医务人员开展抗击病毒的斗争。
en: Our researchers are tracking the spread of the virus to understand how epidemics evolve, and we are working to empower local scientific and medical personnel.

zh: 我们预期2015年将有两种疫苗制剂进入临床试验阶段。
en: We expect to have two vaccine agents ready for clinical trials in 2015.

zh: 巴斯德研究所的 埃博拉工作组在西非和法国的实验室抗击埃博拉病毒，研究病毒及其传播方式，以求千方百计找到阻止疫情传播和预防新疫情爆发的解决方案。
en: The Institut Pasteur’s Ebola Task Force is fighting the virus on the ground in West Africa and in the laboratory in France, studying the virus and how it spreads, and leaving no stone unturned to find a medical solution that will stop this outbreak and prevent new ones.

zh: 巴斯德研究所携手世卫组织和无国界医生组织、红十字会及红新月会等非政府组织，为抗击病毒及其起源做出自己的贡献。
en: Together with the WHO and non-governmental organizations including Médecins Sans Frontières and the Red Cross and Red Crescent, the Institut Pasteur is committed to fighting the virus and its causes.

zh: 世界各国承诺给予财政和其他支持以解决人们最担心的问题：为受灾民众和社区提供援助。
en: Countries around the world have pledged support, financial and otherwise, to tackle the most immediate concerns: helping affected people and communities.

zh: 很多国家已经参与研究埃博拉病毒的成因、传播途径和治疗手段。
en: Many countries already contribute to research into the causes, spread, and treatment of the Ebola virus.

zh: 我们已经成立国际“自愿联盟 ” ， 呼吁所有国家、相关机构、企业和有能力的个人积极加入。
en: An international “coalition of the willing” has been established, and we call on all states, relevant organizations, interested businesses, and qualified individuals to join it.

zh: 如果共同努力，我们迟早能看到消灭埃博拉的一天。
en: Together, we can and will see the end of Ebola.

zh: 埃博拉病毒及更多
en: Ebola and Beyond

zh: 华盛顿 — — 美国和欧洲面对各自境内出现的几起孤立的埃博拉感染个案反应严重过度。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The United States and Europe have grossly overreacted to a few isolated cases of the Ebola virus within their borders.

zh: 这些惊慌失措的反应还不仅仅是没有任何用处。
en: These panicked responses are not just futile.

zh: 因为违反了基本科学原理，这些举措挑战了强制公共卫生行动的基本道德准则。
en: By violating basic scientific principles, they defy the fundamental ethical criterion for compulsory public-health action.

zh: 而且在保护民众免遭埃博拉感染（更不要说防止未来发生类似的全球性健康危机）的问题上 — — 如此做法的效果可能适得其反。
en: And when it comes to protecting citizens from Ebola – not to mention preventing similar global health crises from emerging in the future – these responses may well be counterproductive.

zh: 过度反应最惊人的例子来自于美国，美国的第一反应是加强筛查来自几内亚、利比里亚和塞拉利昂的旅客。
en: The most egregious examples of overreach have occurred in the US, where the initial response entailed enhanced screening of travelers from Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

zh: 更成问题的是，某些州甚至对从埃博拉受灾国返回美国的志愿医疗工作者强制执行为期21天的隔离检疫政策。
en: More problematic, several states instituted mandatory 21-day quarantines for volunteer health workers returning to the US from Ebola-stricken countries.

zh: 幸运的是，隔离检疫令所引发的政治风波很快迫使某些州长放宽了这项政策。
en: Fortunately, the political backlash against the quarantine orders quickly prompted some state governors to ease them.

zh: 发达国家现在应当认识到保护民众免遭埃博拉病毒侵袭的最佳方法是协助阻止病毒在西非的传播。
en: It is time for developed countries to recognize that the best way to protect their citizens from Ebola is to help stop the spread of the virus in West Africa.

zh: 而这首先需要在埃博拉肆虐最严重的三个国家长期执行“强化反应”政策。
en: This requires, first and foremost, a sustained “surge response” to Ebola in the three most affected countries.

zh: 上述反应政策必须得到充足（且大额的）资金支持；派遣训练有素的医生、护士和社区卫生工作者；并提高当地诊断、治疗、追踪接触者和隔离感染者的能力。
en: Such a response must be underpinned by adequate (and considerable) funding; well-trained doctors, nurses, and community health workers; and improved local capacity for diagnosis, treatment, contact tracing, and the isolation of infected individuals.

zh: 时间已经非常紧迫。
en: There is no time to waste.

zh: 事实上，缺乏有勇气的领导人已经使国际社会针对当前埃博拉疫情的有效反应来得太迟，从而大大增加了这次危机所付出的代价。
en: Indeed, the dearth of bold leadership has already delayed an effective international response to the current Ebola outbreak for far too long, drastically increasing the costs of the crisis.

zh: 除了阻止埃博拉蔓延，国际社会必须在未来可能的健康危险中吸取这次危机的教训，制定以证据为基础的有效可靠的早期举措。
en: Beyond stemming the spread of Ebola, the international community must apply the lessons of the current crisis to future potential health hazards, by developing a credible response that emphasizes early, robust, and evidence-based action.

zh: 为此必须落实三项主要政策。
en: To this end, three key initiatives should be launched.

zh: 首先，世卫组织应当设立突发事件应急基金，一旦宣布为“国际关注的突发公共卫生事件”就可以启用。
en: First, the World Health Organization should commit to an emergency contingency fund that it could deploy for surge capacity as soon as it declares a “public health emergency of international concern.”

zh: 假使在埃博拉病毒爆发时存在基金支持最初的应急反应，世卫组织极有可能及时将其定性为一场国际突发事件。
en: Had such funding been available to mount a robust initial response when Ebola emerged, the WHO would have had a strong incentive to declare an international emergency in a timely manner.

zh: 事实上，世卫组织评审委员会曾于2011年提议设立这样的基金，当时的建议额度至少在1亿美元以上。
en: In fact, a WHO review committee recommended just such a fund, amounting to at least $100 million, in 2011.

zh: 虽然只占国际医疗援助不到0.5%的数额在经济上完全可以承受，但世卫组织最终还是没能实现这一目标。
en: Though that would have been eminently affordable, representing less than 0.5% of international health assistance, the WHO failed to establish it.

zh: 这项决策的愚蠢如今显而易见，同样显而易见的还有应当大幅追加应急基金金额至5亿美元。
en: The folly of this decision is now painfully obvious, as is the fact that the contingency fund should be significantly larger – up to $500 million.

zh: 有效危机应对策略的另一根支柱是由世卫组织牵头领导各国政府建立应急储备的医疗队伍，招募训练有素的医务人员，随时准备在资源稀缺的条件下实施快速部署。
en: The second pillar of an effective crisis-response strategy is an emergency reserve workforce – established by the WHO, in cooperation with national governments – comprising well-trained health professionals who are prepared for rapid deployment in low-resource settings.

zh: 医疗保健体系薄弱（因此特别容易受到疫情爆发影响）的国家会因此得到必要的人力资源支持，从而迅速将医疗危机控制住。
en: This would provide countries with weak health-care systems – which are particularly susceptible to disease outbreaks – with the human resources they need to bring health crises quickly under control.

zh: 当然，国家建设卫生保健系统和保护民众健康的责任并没有因此减弱。
en: Of course, such measures do not diminish countries’ responsibility for strengthening their health-care systems and safeguarding their populations.

zh: 因此防止未来爆发公共健康危机最后也最重要的步骤是设立国际卫生系统基金，以便在紧急状况下有效做出反应，并且在平时提供全面的医疗卫生服务。
en: That is why the last and most important step toward preventing future global health crises is the creation of an international health system fund to support national efforts to acquire the capacity both to respond effectively in emergencies and to deliver comprehensive health services in normal times.

zh: 上述基金应隶属于2005年签署的国际医疗卫生条例框架，并且在民众健康权的基础上推进全民医疗保健服务。
en: Such a fund would fit into the International Health Regulations framework that was agreed to in 2005, and advance the cause of universal health care, based on the principle that all people have a right to health.

zh: 政府还应当拨出充足的国内资金实现上述目标，比方说非洲国家首脑切实履行2001年阿布贾宣言承诺，拿出国家预算的至少15%投资公共卫生部门。
en: Governments would also be expected to allocate adequate domestic funds to achieve these goals, with, for example, African heads of state fulfilling the 2001 Abuja Declaration’s pledge to allocate at least 15% of national budgets to the health sector.

zh: 但对于低收入国家来讲，如果没有国际基金的长期协助，建立强效医疗卫生系统几乎是不可能完成的任务。
en: But, for lower-income countries, significant progress toward establishing strong health-care systems would be virtually impossible without support from a sustainable international fund.

zh: 鉴于设立上述基金需要在低收入国家投入数十亿美元的巨额资金，社会动员是争取必要政治支持的关键因素。
en: Given that creating such a fund would entail a massive multi-billion dollar investment in lower-income countries, social mobilization is the key to generating the necessary political support.

zh: 从这个意义上讲，对抗艾滋病的全球对策 — — 包括美国总统针对艾滋病的应急计划和抗击艾滋病、肺结核及疟疾的全球基金 — — 可以作为一种有效的模式发挥作用。
en: In this sense, the global response to AIDS – spurred by the US President’s Emergency Plan for AIDS Relief and the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria – could serve as a useful model.

zh: 除建立健全的卫生保健基础设施外，各国政府还需要实行问责制，确保为民众提供健康服务。
en: Beyond establishing strong health-care infrastructure, national governments will need to develop systems of accountability to deliver health services to their populations.

zh: 其中包括对资源进行公平、透明的管理、落实反腐败保障、对进度实施监控、促进民间社会参与和对失败进行问责。
en: This includes fair and transparent stewardship of resources, anti-corruption safeguards, tools for monitoring progress, civil-society engagement, and accountability for failures.

zh: 为了实现上述目标，某国际联盟正在推动签署全球医疗卫生框架公约，旨在促进地方、国家及全球范围内良性的健康监控。
en: To advance these objectives, an international coalition is pushing for a Framework Convention on Global Health, aimed at fostering good governance for health at the local, national, and global levels.

zh: 基于健康权原则的这项公约将为资金及其他责任的分配提供明确的指导原则。
en: The treaty, based on the principle of a right to health, would provide clear guidelines for the allocation of funding and other responsibilities.

zh: 西非爆发的埃博拉疫情应当促使国际医疗卫生政策做出修正，推动建立快速反应机制和高效的医疗卫生基础设施。
en: The West African Ebola epidemic should inspire a course correction on international health policy, reinforcing the need for rapid-response tools and strong health-care infrastructure.

zh: 制定提供实现上述目标所需长期灵活投资的框架是一项明智高效、并且符合所有人利益的投资。
en: Establishing frameworks to provide scalable, sustainable funding to achieve these goals is a wise and affordable investment – one that is in everyone’s interest.

zh: 这项人道主义政策将使世界各国受益，无论是现在还是未来。
en: This is one humanitarian response that would provide vast benefits worldwide, now and in the future.

zh: 民众可以享受到的发展
en: Development for the People

zh: 纽约 — — 自从10年前西非地区的残酷内战结束后，现在的埃博拉疫情夺走生命、摧毁社区、催生孤儿的速度可谓史无前例。
en: NEW YORK – The Ebola epidemic in West Africa is destroying lives, decimating communities, and orphaning children at a rate not seen since the region’s brutal civil wars ended more than a decade ago.

zh: 在利比亚，60%的市场目前已陷入瘫痪；在塞拉利昂，10，000名艾滋病毒感染者中仅有五分之一仍在接受抗逆转录病毒治疗；几内亚政府报告危机造成高达2.2亿美元的资金缺口。
en: In Liberia, 60% of markets are now closed; in Sierra Leone, only one-fifth of the 10,000 HIV patients who are on anti-retroviral treatments are still receiving them; and Guinea’s government is reporting a $220 million financing gap because of the crisis.

zh: 如果疫情无法迅速得到扭转，利比里亚和塞拉利昂恢复和平和几内亚民主转型开始后所取得的多数经济和社会成果均有可能毁于一旦。
en: If the outbreak is not contained soon, most of the economic and social gains achieved since peace was restored in Liberia and Sierra Leone, and since Guinea’s democratic transition began, could be reversed.

zh: 上述三个国家目前局势既分裂又脆弱，并且在这场危机中很容易出现震荡。
en: All three countries remain fragile, divided, and, as the current crisis highlights, uniquely prone to shocks.

zh: 从更广义的角度看，目前这场地区危机理应激发人们对世界如何支持并推进发展这一课题的思考。
en: More broadly, the region’s current crisis should inspire reflection about how the world supports and advances development.

zh: 上述国家面对危机束手无策的一个重要原因是对民众投资的长期欠缺，因此阻碍普通民众从经济增长中收获好处。
en: One important reason for these countries’ vulnerability is the consistent lack of investment in their populations, which has prevented ordinary citizens from reaping the benefits of economic growth.

zh: 事实上，虽然几内亚、利比里亚和塞拉利昂经济在埃博拉病毒爆发前10年分别以2.8 % 、 10%和8%的年均增速快速增长，但其民众的日常生活却鲜有改善迹象。
en: Indeed, while the economies of Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone grew rapidly in the ten years prior to the Ebola outbreak – at average annual rates of 2.8%, 10%, and 8%, respectively – their populations have seen little improvement in their daily lives.

zh: 超过65%的外国直接投资都流向了采掘和伐木业，上述行业一向因较少创造就业机会和导致财富向少数人集中而在人们的印象中臭名昭著。
en: More than 65% of foreign direct investment has gone toward mining and logging, which are notorious for generating little employment and concentrating wealth in the hands of a few.

zh: 同样，虽然内战结束后利比里亚和塞拉利昂的医疗服务有所改善，但其质量和覆盖范围仍然远低于西非标准。
en: Likewise, though health services in Liberia and Sierra Leone improved after their civil wars ended, quality and coverage have remained well below West African standards.

zh: 埃博拉病毒来袭时，利比里亚4百万民众仅有区区120名医生。
en: When Ebola struck, Liberia had only 120 doctors for its four million citizens.

zh: 再加上管理松散、人满为患、清洁环境恶劣的庞大的城市贫民窟 — — 上述国家一直拼命试图遏制疫情因此也就不足为怪。
en: Add to that sprawling urban slums – semi-governed, overcrowded, and poorly sanitized – and it is not surprising that these countries have struggled to contain the epidemic.

zh: 埃博拉在上述三国造成的威胁都不仅局限在医疗领域。
en: The threat that Ebola poses in all three countries extends beyond health care.

zh: 据2012年非洲民主动态调查显示，整个地区长期冲突和治理不善的传统导致对政府和国家机构的信任严重缺失。
en: Throughout the region, a history of conflict and a legacy of poor governance have fueled a deep distrust of governments and state institutions, as indicated in a 2012 Afrobarometer survey.

zh: 事实上，这些国家公认社会契约的缺位一直是确立政治权威及有效治理的主要障碍。
en: Indeed, these countries’ lack of an established social contract has been the main obstacle to establishing political authority and effective governance.

zh: 不仅如此，这种环境为谣言的传播创造了肥沃的土壤，其中包括政府和救援人员合谋让民众感染病毒。
en: Moreover, this environment has created fertile conditions for the spread of wild theories including that the government and aid workers are conspiring to infect citizens.

zh: 很多人根本不承认埃博拉病毒的存在，称政府为从国际社会筹集更多资金而凭空捏造了整个事件（筹集来的资金民众永远也不可能看到 ） 。
en: Many people deny that the Ebola virus exists at all, claiming that their governments have invented it to raise additional funds – which they will never see – from the international community.

zh: 这样的疑虑和恐惧导致家庭藏匿亡者及在夜间举行葬礼，某些社区甚至发展到袭击医疗工作者。
en: Such doubts and fears are leading families to hide their dead and conduct funerals at night, with some communities going so far as to attack health workers.

zh: 这一切都让阻止疾病蔓延的工作变得极为困难。
en: All of this is making it extremely difficult to halt the spread of the disease.

zh: 在这种具有高度传染性及致命性的病毒摧毁对领导人缺乏信任的分裂、贫困的社会之际，承袭原有做法无疑是远远不够的。
en: With a highly contagious and lethal virus devastating poor and fragmented societies that distrust their leaders, business as usual is not enough.

zh: 阻止当前埃博拉疫情并防止类似流行病的唯一途径是根治诱发病毒传播的最基本的社会和政治弱点。
en: The only way to halt the current Ebola outbreak, and prevent similar epidemics, is to address the fundamental social and political vulnerabilities that have allowed the virus to flourish.

zh: 关键是要通过增加医疗、教育和其他公共服务投资将民众置于发展工作的核心位置。
en: The key is to place people at the center of development efforts, by increasing investments in health care, education, and other public services.

zh: 同时必须竭尽全力创造更多就业机会。
en: At the same time, a strong effort must be made to bolster job creation.

zh: 可靠的支撑结构和充分的经济机会可以增强家庭和国家的适应能力。
en: With a reliable support structure and adequate economic opportunity, households – and, in turn, countries – become more resilient.

zh: 那些身处抗击埃博拉前沿的力量 — — 包括联合国发展计划署 — — 一直在动员社会群体对抗疾病并支持医疗团队，同时协助幸存者及感染患者家属面对这场悲剧。
en: Those at the forefront of the fight against Ebola – including the United Nations Development Program – have been mobilizing communities against the disease, supporting medical teams, and helping survivors and families of the infected cope with the tragedy.

zh: 虽然上述工作的重要性已经无以复加，我们必须制定长期战略加强这些脆弱国家的防御能力。
en: While these efforts could not be more important, they must be backed by a longer-term strategy to strengthen these fragile countries’ defenses.

zh: 埃博拉病毒将被打败，但这场爆发所暴露出的问题应推动执政者从根本上转变工作重点。
en: Ebola will be defeated, but the vulnerabilities that this outbreak has exposed should spur a fundamental shift in focus among policymakers.

zh: 今天主导全球思维的发展理念强调经济增长及政府建设高于社会进步。
en: The development approach that dominates global thinking today emphasizes economic growth and state-building over social progress.

zh: 但增强社会适应性和对机构信任度的唯一方法是将繁荣所需的相关工具和信心交给民众。
en: But the only way to boost a society’s resilience and ability to trust impersonal institutions is to give the people who comprise it the tools – and confidence – they need to prosper.

zh: 无国界疾病
en: Diseases Without Borders

zh: 达沃斯—当今世界风险似乎比以往任何时候都要大。
en: DAVOS – Today’s world seems more risk-laden than ever.

zh: 气候变化的影响日益明显，地缘政治紧张局势日益升级，国家危机和崩溃频发，经济机会不充分也不平等，还有传染病的肆意蔓延 — — 而这只是其中一些最严重的威胁 — — 它们给我们带来了极大的不确定环境。
en: The increasingly visible effects of climate change, rising geopolitical tensions, state crisis and collapse, inadequate or unequal economic opportunities, and the spread of infectious diseases – to name just some of the highest-profile threats – have created an environment of great uncertainty.

zh: 2015年，这些风险会有所消停吗？ 世界领导人的会晤能带来遏制它们的真正战略吗？
en: Will 2015 be the year when these risks come to a head, or the moment when world leaders come together to develop real strategies for mitigating them?

zh: 本周，我和全球商业、政府、政治、艺术和学术界领袖一道参加瑞士达沃斯世界经济论坛，讨论世界所面临的风险。
en: This week, I am joining leaders from the worlds of business, government, politics, the arts, and academia at the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland, to discuss the risks that the world faces.

zh: 当然，确定哪些挑战应该得到最多关注并非易事。
en: Of course, determining which challenges merit the most attention will not be easy.

zh: 世界经济论坛的年度《全球风险 》 （ Global Risks）报告能起到帮助作用。
en: That is where the WEF’s annual Global Risks reports can help.

zh: 该报告由全球大约900名专家和决策者参与世界经济论坛全球风险观点调查。 在今年的报告中，十年来第一次出现了环境和地缘政治担忧压倒经济风险的现象。
en: Drawing on the perspectives of roughly 900 experts and decision-makers from around the world who participate in the WEF’s global risks-perception survey, this year’s report found that, for the first time in its ten-year history, economic risks are taking a backseat to environmental and geopolitical concerns.

zh: 具体而言，与会者将有地区后果的国家间冲突列为2015年世界所面临的首要风险（按可能性排名 ） ， 极端气候事件紧随其后。
en: Specifically, participants rated interstate conflict with regional consequences as the top risk, in terms of likelihood, facing the world in 2015, with extreme weather events coming in second.

zh: 按影响排名的最高风险是水危机和传染病蔓延。
en: The top risks in terms of impact were water crises and the spread of infectious diseases.

zh: 当然，这只是强调目前世界着多大的危险。
en: The point, of course, is not simply to highlight how much danger the world currently faces.

zh: 《全球风险报告》列出了专家最关注的风险，突出了重要的行动机会。
en: By illuminating experts’ top-rated risks, the report highlights important opportunities for action.

zh: 世界经济论坛创始人克劳斯·施瓦布（Klaus Schwab）指出，2015年可能是“人类命运之年 ” 。
en: According to WEF founder Klaus Schwab, 2015 can be a “year of destiny for humankind.”

zh: 事实上，如果全球领导人 — — 不管是多边组织、政府、私人部门还是公民社会团体 — — 能抓住机会加强合作，长期发酵的风险可以在形成不可收拾之势之前得到遏制。
en: Indeed, if global leaders – from multilateral organizations, governments, the private sector, and civil-society groups – seize opportunities for closer cooperation, long-simmering risks can be cooled before they boil over.

zh: 共同和合作行动可以带来重大差别的一个领域是传染病的蔓延。
en: One area where concerted, collaborative action can make a major difference is the spread of infectious diseases.

zh: 达沃斯会议期间，将讨论成立一个新的全球流行病紧急机制，通过向各国提供必要资金帮助它们快速响应国内危机。
en: During the meeting in Davos, officials will discuss the creation of a new global pandemic emergency facility that would enable countries to respond quickly to crises within their borders by providing them with the needed funds.

zh: 世界急需这一能力，仍在西非社会肆虐、夺走数钱生命并且还将有大量人口因此丧生的埃博拉便是明证。
en: To understand how badly the world needs this capacity, one need look no further than the ongoing Ebola pandemic, which has ravaged West African societies, claiming thousands of lives and upending many more.

zh: 迅速、坚决的响应可以在很大程度上遏制病毒。
en: A rapid and determined response could have done much to contain the virus.

zh: 但国际响应既迟缓，也不充分。
en: But the international response was delayed and inadequate.

zh: 事实上，在危机爆发的六个月中，只有30支医疗响应队在几内亚、利比里亚和塞拉利昂治疗和看护病患。
en: Indeed, six months into the crisis, just 30 medical-response teams were treating and caring for patients on the ground in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

zh: 卫生工作人员、设备和供给的短缺让许多人无法得到治疗，让病毒进一步蔓延。
en: The shortage of health workers, facilities, and supplies prevented many people from receiving treatment, allowing the virus to spread further.

zh: 对埃博拉看似不可阻挡的蔓延之势的担忧妨碍了受影响国的贸易、商业活动和旅行。
en: Fear of the disease’s seemingly inexorable spread hampered trade, business activity, and travel in the affected countries.

zh: 12月，世界银行将此前位居高速增长行列的几内亚、利比里亚和塞拉利昂的增长估计做了向下修正，2015年，这些国家预计将损失16亿美元收入。
en: In December, the World Bank downgraded its growth estimates for the formerly fast-growing economies of Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone, which are now expected to lose $1.6 billion in income in 2015.

zh: 为了更好地做好准备以处理未来流行病，世界必须从现在开始投资于强化公共卫生体系、提高发展中国家的疾病预防能力，并创造灵活的新融资工具。
en: In order to become better prepared to tackle future pandemics, the world must invest now in strengthening public-health systems, bolstering developing countries’ disease-prevention capacity, and establishing new and flexible financing instruments.

zh: 全球流行病紧急机制可以动员公共和私人资源以及前置融资，从而在发生全球卫生紧急状况时，大规模快速响应所需要的资金支持已经就位。
en: A global pandemic emergency facility could mobilize public and private resources and frontload financing, so that when a global health emergency arises, funding is in place to support an immediate response at scale.

zh: 埃博拉危机表明，在流行病爆发后才开始组织行动太耗费时间，会造成巨大的经济和 — — 更重要的 — — 人力损失。
en: As the Ebola crisis has demonstrated, passing the hat once a pandemic has taken hold is far too time-consuming and carries huge economic and, more important, human costs.

zh: 这一全球资源可以为发展全面战略应对下一次传染病暴发打下基础，包括快速派遣卫生工作者和供给的计划。
en: Such a global resource could underpin the development of a comprehensive strategy to address the next outbreak, including a plan for putting health workers and supplies on the ground quickly.

zh: 它甚至可以为疫苗和药品生产商提供市场信号。
en: It could even provide a market signal for producers of vaccines and drugs.

zh: 世界经济论坛《全球风险》报告强调，我们需要鲁棒的计划应对流行病威胁。
en: The WEF’s Global Risks report emphasizes the need for robust plans to face the threat of pandemics.

zh: 在发展中国家城市和非正式住所 — — 在这些场所传染病传播起来更加容易 — — 快速增长的背景下，这一需要尤其迫切。
en: This is especially urgent in light of the rapid growth of cities and informal settlements – where infectious diseases can spread more easily – in developing countries. We need to start creating those plans now.

zh: 毕竟，我们不知道下一场流行病会在何时爆发。
en: After all, we do not know when the next pandemic will strike.

zh: 我们不可能消除全球风险。
en: We cannot eliminate global risk.

zh: 但是，我们可以让我们的经济和社会拥有更强大的恢复力，从而更好地实现威胁影响的最小化。
en: We can, however, make our economies and societies more resilient and thus better equipped to minimize the impact of the threats we face.

zh: 从这个角度讲，前瞻措施 — — 如全球流行病紧急机制 — — 是让世界变成我们所有人更安全的家园的关键。
en: In this sense, forward-thinking initiatives like the global pandemic emergency facility are crucial to making the world a safer place for all of us.

zh: 三大全球健康危机
en: Three Global Health Threats

zh: 旧金山—西非埃博拉大爆发是一场悲剧，它彰显出加强国家和全球层面医疗系统的紧迫性。
en: SAN FRANCISCO – The tragic Ebola outbreak in West Africa has underscored the imperative of strengthening health systems at both the national and global level.

zh: 但是，尽管埃博拉吸引了全世界对系统缺陷的关注，但目标必须放在消灭持久流行病上，这些疾病正在悄然在全世界人口中间传播痛苦和死亡。
en: But, though Ebola has focused the world’s attention on systemic shortcomings, the goal must be to combat the abiding epidemics that are quietly inflicting suffering and death on populations worldwide.

zh: 毫无疑问，埃博拉制造了极大的痛苦。
en: Ebola has undoubtedly wrought tremendous agony.

zh: 但它并不是世界所面临的第一场瘟疫 — — 也不是最灾难性的瘟疫。
en: But it is not the first – or the most devastating – pandemic the world has faced.

zh: 事实上，人类已知最致命的疾病是天花；直到1796年爱德华·詹纳（Edward Jenner）发明了天花疫苗前，它一直是欧洲的第一死亡原因。
en: In fact, smallpox is the deadliest disease known to humanity; until Edward Jenner developed the vaccine in 1796, it was the leading cause of death in Europe.

zh: 在1980年被消灭前，据估计天花总共造成3亿—5亿人死亡。
en: Before its eradication in 1980, it killed an estimated 300-500 million people.

zh: 十四世纪的黑死病杀害了7,500万—1亿人，相当于欧洲人口的一大半。
en: The Bubonic plague of the fourteenth century killed 75-100 million people – more than half of Europe’s population.

zh: 1918年流感大爆发夺走了近7,500万人的生命，或世界总人口的3—5 % ， 比第一次世界大战的死亡人数还多出一倍多。
en: Nearly 75 million people, or 3-5% of the world’s population, died in just a few months during the 1918 influenza pandemic – more than twice the number of people killed in World War I.

zh: 世界仍在与艾滋病作斗争，目前，艾滋病已经造成4,000多万人死亡和相近数字的感染者，其中95%的受害者生活在发展中国家，直到艾滋病开始在发达国家出现肆虐之势，高效的抗逆转录病毒疗法才被开发出来，但这一疗法大部分身患艾滋病的穷人是无法获得或承担的。
en: The world continues to grapple with HIV/AIDS, which has already caused more than 40 million deaths and infects a similar number of people today, with 95% of the epidemic’s victims living in developing countries. Only when HIV/AIDS began to gain traction in advanced countries were highly effective anti-retroviral therapies developed – therapy that most of the poor people suffering from the disease could not access or afford.

zh: 类似地，政府、多边组织和非政府组织对埃博拉爆发响应不及时反映出一个事实：这场疫情蹂躏的是穷国。
en: Similarly, the failure of governments, multilateral organizations, and NGOs to respond quickly enough to the Ebola outbreak reflects the fact that the disease has ravaged poor countries.

zh: 但是，在这个全球互联程度前所未有的时代，确保足够充实的医疗系统和存在解决类似疫情的结构事关每个人的利益。
en: But, at a time of unprecedented global interconnectedness, everyone has a stake in ensuring that adequate health-care systems and structures are in place to address such a pandemic.

zh: 实现这一点需要提供必需的投资；毕竟，有效的国家卫生系统和密切的监控是抵御疾病暴发的第一道防线。
en: Achieving this requires providing the needed investment; after all, effective national health systems and agile surveillance are the first lines of defense against outbreaks of disease.

zh: 在这方面，埃博拉不仅是一场健康危机，也是一场人道主义、经济和政治危机。
en: At this point, Ebola is not only a health crisis, but also a humanitarian, economic, and political crisis.

zh: 诚然，我们已经取得了一些进展。
en: To be sure, some progress has been made.

zh: 联合国埃博拉紧急情况响应小组（Mission for Ebola Emergency Response）的“70/70/60”计划 — — 隔离70%的埃博拉患者，确保70%的葬礼在60天内安全进行 — — 大致上得到了很好的实施，显著降低了新病例。
en: The United Nations Mission for Ebola Emergency Response’s “70/70/60” plan – to isolate 70% of Ebola patients and ensure that 70% of burials are conducted safely within 60 days – has largely been implemented, reducing the number of new cases considerably.

zh: 但人们仍在遭受病痛和死亡 — — 原因往往是无法得到可信消息或充分治疗。
en: But people are still suffering and dying – often owing to a lack of access to credible information or adequate treatment.

zh: 当然，在捍卫人口健康的问题上，存在一条保护公众和侵犯个人权利的界线。
en: Of course, when it comes to safeguarding the health of populations, there is a fine line between protecting the public and impinging on individual rights.

zh: 因此，所有公共卫生干预都必须首先聚焦于科学事实，并避免情绪或恐慌的反应。
en: That is why all public-health interventions must focus first and foremost on scientific facts, and avoid emotional or panicked responses.

zh: 在此背景下，强制隔离来自埃博拉疫区国家的旅行者显然是政策失败 — — 一如当局试图遏制1350年的欧洲黑死病和1665年伦敦疫情。
en: In this context, the imposition of mandatory quarantines on travelers from Ebola-affected countries was an obvious policy failure – just as they were when authorities tried to contain the Black Death of 1350 in Europe or the Plague of London in 1665.

zh: 国际社会不应该把时间浪费在基于恐惧的战略上，而必须利用人力和金融资源确保基于事实的、紧密合作的集体行动。
en: Instead of wasting time on fear-based strategies, the international community must leverage human and financial resources to ensure fact-based, concerted, collective action.

zh: 这一联合行动方针是可行的；事实上，以前也实行过。
en: Such a united approach is possible; indeed, it has happened before.

zh: 在世纪之交时，抗艾滋病、结核病和疟疾全球基金（Mission for Ebola Emergency Response’s ） 、 比尔和梅琳达·盖茨基金会（Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation）和疫苗联盟GAVI（GAVI, the Vaccine Alliance）一致打造了改善全球健康的新措施。
en: At the turn of the century, the establishment of institutions like the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis, and Malaria, the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, and GAVI, the Vaccine Alliance, coincided with a renewed effort to improve global health.

zh: 联合国的千年发展目标（Millennium Development Goals）承诺 — — 其中包括四个健康相关目标、覆盖了营养、母婴健康和传染病 — — 体现了改善全球健康的政治共识。
en: The UN’s commitment to the Millennium Development Goals – which included four health-related targets, covering nutrition, maternal and child health, and infectious diseases – reflected a political consensus to improve health worldwide.

zh: 这一机构结构大大促进了这些领域中的进步；比如，五岁以下儿童夭折率自1990年以来下降了49 % 。
en: This institutional architecture has facilitated considerable progress in many of these areas; for example, the under-five mortality rate has plummeted by 49% since 1990.

zh: 但还有很多要做。
en: But there is far more to be done.

zh: 在东南亚和撒哈拉以南非洲等地区，母婴健康和传染病仍是当务之急。
en: In regions like Southeast Asia and Sub-Saharan Africa, maternal and child health and infectious diseases remain priorities.

zh: 事实上，十个儿童夭折率最高的国家全部位于撒哈拉以南非洲；西非出生的婴儿，其在五岁前死去的概率是西欧出生的婴儿的30倍。
en: In fact, the ten countries with the highest child mortality rates are all located in Sub-Saharan Africa; a baby born in West Africa is 30 times likelier to die before the age of five than one born in Western Europe.

zh: 即使在国家内部，也存在巨大的不平等。
en: Even within countries, massive inequalities remain.

zh: 比如，墨西哥格雷罗州（Guerrero）和新莱昂州（Nuevo León）城市婴儿死亡率相差十倍之多。
en: For example, there is a ten-fold difference in infant mortality between municipalities in the Mexican states of Guerrero and Nuevo León.

zh: 此外，由于不少大趋势的共同作用 — — 比如城市化、人口老龄化、肥胖、久坐、吸烟、饮酒等 — — 导致慢性非传染性疾病的大幅增长，还存在着一些静默的流行病，特别是在收入较低的国家。
en: Moreover, silent epidemics have taken hold, particularly in lower-income countries, as the combination of mega-trends like urbanization, population aging, obesity, sedentary lifestyles, smoking, and alcohol consumption has spurred the rise of chronic non-communicable diseases (NCDs).

zh: 对大部分国家的成年人来说，癌症、糖尿病和心血管疾病已成为致残和致死的主要原因。
en: For adults in most countries, cancer, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease have become leading causes of disability and death.

zh: 新兴传染病（如埃博拉）也许更加紧迫，但慢性非传染性疾病的健康影响要大得多，更不用说它们所导致的高昂且不断增加的社会和经济成本了。
en: Emerging infectious diseases like Ebola may be more compelling, but the health impact of chronic NCDs, not to mention their high and growing social and economic costs, is substantially larger.

zh: 没有时间可供浪费。
en: There is no time to waste.

zh: 决策者必须追求果断行动遏制烟草、酒精和致胖食物的消费等风险因素的传播。
en: Policymakers must pursue aggressive action to curb the spread of risk factors like the consumption of tobacco, alcohol, and obesogenic foods.

zh: 世界面临着三大健康挑战：我们必须构建可持续的国家和全球卫生体系以快速有效地响应埃博拉等违纪；消灭或控制传染病；并解决悄然兴起的慢性非传染性疾病的流行。
en: The world is facing a three-prong health challenge: We must build sustainable national and global health systems that can respond quickly and effectively to crises like Ebola; eliminate or control infectious diseases; and address the quietly rising epidemic of chronic NCDs.

zh: 要在所有这三个方面取得成功，我们需要保持卫生基础设施、管理和人才的投资。
en: To succeed on all three fronts, we need sustained investment in health infrastructure, management, and personnel.

zh: 平等性是关键。
en: Equality is key.

zh: 这意味着改善医疗和教育的普及度。
en: This means improving access to health care and education.

zh: 但这也意味着解决超过公共卫生日程的更深层次的社会不平等。
en: But it also means addressing the deeper social inequities that extend beyond the public-health agenda.

zh: 在制定2015年后发展目标时，世界领导人必须铭记，健康是基本人权。
en: In formulating the post-2015 development goals, world leaders must remember that health is a fundamental human right.

zh: 战埃博拉的伦理学
en: The Ethics of Fighting Ebola

zh: 普林斯顿—最后，我们也许会幸运地看到，一小撮发达国家人民 — — 四个美国人和一个西班牙人 — — 遏制了埃博拉。
en: PRINCETON – It may, in the end, turn out to be fortunate that a handful of people in developed countries – four in the United States and one in Spain – have contracted Ebola.

zh: 唯一悲剧的是托马斯·邓肯（Thomas Duncan ） ， 他是这几个病人中唯一一个丧命的，虽然在非洲造成13,000多例病患和近5,000人死亡，但埃博拉在发达国家基本没有引起什么关注。
en: Tragic as this was for Thomas Duncan, the only one of these patients who has died, if all of the more than 13,000 cases and nearly 5,000 deaths had occurred in Africa, Ebola would never have aroused nearly as much attention in rich countries.

zh: 从这个角度看，埃博拉是 — — 或者说曾经是 — — 有时被称为90/10法则的一个例子：90%的医学研究被用于只占全球疾病负担10%的疾病。
en: In this respect, Ebola is – or, rather, was – an example of what is sometimes referred to as the 90/10 rule: 90% of medical research is directed toward illnesses that comprise only 10% of the global burden of disease.

zh: 世界从1976年就知道埃博拉病毒具有致命性；但是，由于受害者都是穷人，制药公司没有动力研发疫苗。
en: The world has known about the deadly nature of the Ebola virus since 1976; but, because its victims were poor, pharmaceutical companies had no incentive to develop a vaccine.

zh: 事实上，制药公司治疗男性秃顶还能多赚一点儿。
en: Indeed, pharmaceutical companies could expect to earn more from a cure for male baldness.

zh: 丰裕国家的政府研究基金也往往集中精力针对导致本国公民死亡的疾病而不会关注致死人数更多的疟疾和痢疾。
en: Government research funds in affluent countries are also disproportionately targeted toward the diseases that kill these countries’ citizens, rather than toward diseases like malaria and diarrhea that are responsible for much greater loss of life.

zh: 但埃博拉在发达国家只是引起了几个病例 — — 以及持续引发恐慌的新闻标题和隔离措施 — — 就引起了对当今传染病全球性的重视。
en: But the tiny number of Ebola cases in rich countries – and the ensuing panic-inducing headlines and quarantine measures – have brought home the global nature of infectious disease today. Mass travel has made effective containment of epidemics extremely difficult.

zh: 对抗传染病的最佳防御是在发源地战胜它，而这要求良好的医疗服务。
en: The best defense against an infectious disease is to fight it where it originates, and that requires good health services.

zh: 埃博拉似乎已经被赶出了尼日利亚，这很大程度上要归功于尼日利亚拥有盖茨基金会（Gates Foundation）所支持的一家医院，该医院有受过训练的人手和设备控制疫情。
en: Ebola appears to have been eradicated from Nigeria, in no small part because that country had a Gates Foundation-supported hospital with personnel trained and equipped to control infectious diseases.

zh: 如果在过去一二十年里富裕国家对利比里亚、塞拉利昂和圭亚那予以更大的支持，当前的埃博拉大爆发即使不能预防也可以得到最大程度的遏制。
en: If, over the past decade or two, affluent countries had done more to assist Liberia, Sierra Leone, and Guinea, the current Ebola outbreak could have been minimized, if not prevented.

zh: 但现在只能亡羊补牢了，科学家正在忙不迭寻找埃博拉疫苗和有效治疗方案。
en: But now it is too late for that, and scientists are rushing to find both a vaccine and an effective treatment for Ebola.

zh: 在这方面，我们应该以怎样的伦理学作为指导？
en: What ethical considerations should guide them in their search?

zh: 判断疫苗效果的标准办法是设计实验，可能的受益者被随机分配给两个组别，一组接受可能有效的疫苗，另一组接受没有活性成分的替代品（称之为安慰剂 ） 。
en: The standard way to judge the efficacy of a vaccine is to conduct a trial in which those who could benefit are randomly assigned to two groups, one of which receives the potentially beneficial vaccine, while the other receives a substance with no active ingredients, known as a placebo.

zh: 为了避免可能的混淆因素，比如知道接受了疫苗的实验对象过度冒险或实验者渴望证明疫苗有效，研究必须是“双盲”的：实验对象、实验者和数据收集者都不知道谁得到疫苗，谁得到安慰剂。
en: To avoid possible confounding factors, such as greater risk-taking by those who know they have been vaccinated, or the desire of those conducting the trial to show that the vaccine works, the study is “double blind”: Neither the subjects nor those administering the trial and collecting the data know who got the vaccine and who got the placebo.

zh: 只有一个考察小组能够得到包含这些信息的数据。
en: Only an independent group examining the data sent in from the field has that information.

zh: 如果不进行这样的实验，效果就有可能只是幻觉，因为可能是其他因素导致了低传染率。
en: Without such a trial, the appearance of efficacy may be an illusion, because other factors would have led to a lower rate of infection anyway.

zh: 但如果成功的疫苗可以获得 — — 并且以没有传染风险的健康志愿者为对象的安全性实验证明它没有危害 — — 那么不把它送到照顾患者和重症患者、自己也极有可能染上埃博拉的医护人员手中就是不道德的。
en: Yet if a promising vaccine is available – and if safety trials in healthy human volunteers who are not at risk of infection demonstrate that it does no harm – to deny it to those who are tending to the sick and dying, at great risk to their own health, seems unethical.

zh: 这一问题很快就会成为必须回答的问题，因为制药巨头葛兰素史克（与美国国家过敏和传染病研究所（US National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases）一起）和加拿大公共卫生署（Public Health Agency of Canada）已经在研发备选疫苗。
en: That question will soon need to be answered, because both the pharmaceutical giant GlaxoSmithKline (in conjunction with the US National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases) and the Public Health Agency of Canada have candidate vaccines in development.

zh: 在最近的世界卫生组织日内瓦会议上，葛兰素史克公司疫苗研发团队主管里普雷·巴罗（Ripley Ballou）指出，比较潜在埃博拉疫苗和针对其他病毒的疫苗的随机控制实验是最符合伦理的效果评��方式。
en: At a recent World Health Organization meeting in Geneva, Ripley Ballou, the head of GlaxoSmithKline’s program to develop a vaccine, argued that a randomized controlled trial comparing a potential Ebola vaccine with a vaccine that protects against another virus would be the most ethical way to assess efficacy.

zh: 基于实验结果，结果可以在三个月内获得，让人们以更大的信心进入生产和分销阶段。
en: Depending on the outcome, results could be available within three months, allowing production and distribution to go ahead with greater confidence.

zh: 无国界医生组织（Médecins Sans Frontières，其有3,000多名成员正在埃博拉最猖獗地区奋战）的代表强烈反对给埃博拉高风险人群使用安慰剂。
en: Representatives of Médecins Sans Frontières (Doctors without Borders), which has more than 3,000 staff members combating Ebola in the most affected countries, strongly opposed giving placebos to anyone at high risk of contracting the disease.

zh: 但巴罗似乎说服了很多参会者，使他们认为他的方案在长期能够挽救更多生命。
en: But Ballou appears to have persuaded many of the participants at the meeting that his proposal will save more lives in the long run.

zh: 果真如此的话，随机控制实验就是最符合伦理的选择。
en: If that is true, a randomized controlled trial could be the most ethical option.

zh: 在治疗问题上，情况有所不同。
en: When it comes to treatment, the situation is different.

zh: 在《柳叶刀 》 （ The Lancet）上个月刊登的一封信中，来自多个国家和地区的医生、科学家和生物伦理学家 — — 包括圭亚那、加纳、尼日利亚、塞内加尔以及英国、法国、中国香港和美国 — — 指出随机试验只有在两组对象之间存在“均势 ” （ 平衡）的情况下才有效。
en: In a letter published last month in The Lancet, doctors, scientists, and bioethicists from a wide range of countries – including Guinea, Ghana, Nigeria, and Senegal, as well as Britain, France, Hong Kong, and the United States – argued that a randomized trial is justified only when there is “equipoise,” or balance, between the two options offered.

zh: 医生不知道备选治疗是否弊大于弊时，或他们不清楚两种治疗哪种更有可能治愈患者时属于这种情况。
en: This can happen when doctors do not know whether a proposed treatment will do more harm than good, or when they are in doubt about which of two treatments is more likely to cure the patient.

zh: 但是，对于传染后致死率接近70%并且没有已被接受的现成治疗方法的埃博拉来说，患者可能理性地拒绝参与可能获得安慰剂的实验，还不如参与存在些许恢复希望的实验性治疗。
en: But, when facing a disease that kills up to 70% of those who are infected, and no accepted treatment yet exists, patients could reasonably refuse consent to a trial in which they might receive a placebo, rather than an experimental treatment that offers some hope of recovery.

zh: 在这种情形中，仔细监控眼下的不同治疗中心的结果，然后以相同治疗中心引入实验性治疗后所实现的结果作比较也许更符合道德。
en: In such cases, it might be more ethical to monitor carefully the outcomes of different treatment centers now, before experimental treatments become available, and then compare these outcomes with those achieved by the same centers after experimental treatments are introduced.

zh: 与随机实验不同，没人会得到安慰剂，并且仍有可能确定哪种治疗更加有效。
en: Unlike in a randomized trial, no one would receive a placebo, and it should still be possible to detect which treatments are effective.

zh: 翻过埃博拉这一页
en: Turning the Page on Ebola

zh: 华盛顿—去年始于马诺河联盟（Mano River Union）四国之三的几内亚、塞拉利昂和利比里亚的埃博拉是该疾病自1976年在中非首次确诊以来最严重的一次。
en: WASHINGTON, DC – The Ebola outbreak that began last year in Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Liberia, three of the four countries of the Mano River Union, is the most severe on record since the disease was first diagnosed in Central Africa in 1976.

zh: 埃博拉的影响是灾难性的，我们三国的在数十年冲突和动荡后所取得的重大社会经济进步岌岌可危。
en: The impact of the epidemic has been devastating, calling into question our three countries’ significant socioeconomic progress in the aftermath of decades of conflict and instability.

zh: 到目前为止，该地区报告25,791起病例，其中死亡病例10,689起 — — 几乎是此前各次埃博拉爆发死亡人数的总和。
en: The region has so far registered a total of 25,791 cases and 10,689 deaths – almost ten times the number of deaths from all other Ebola epidemics combined.

zh: 2014年，我们三国预计增长率为4.5 % — 11.3 % 。
en: For 2014, the projected growth rates for our three countries were 4.5%-11.3%.

zh: 如今，预测值以下调到2.2%或以下。
en: These projections have now been reduced to 2.2% at best.

zh: 如果没有遏制措施，衰退将是难以避免的。
en: In the absence of mitigation measures, a recession cannot be ruled out.

zh: 埃博拉的不受控蔓延暴露出我们的国民医疗体系的缺陷，也暴露出地区和全球机构协作和有效响应能力不足。
en: The uncontrolled spread of the disease exposed the shortcomings of our national health care systems, as well as regional and global institutions’ weak capacity for coordination and effective response.

zh: 简言之，我们对于这种规模的大爆发应对准备不足，更不用说预防了。
en: Simply put, we were ill prepared to cope with, much less prevent, an outbreak on this scale.

zh: 我们对于埃博拉影响地区因此丧生的数千条生命有着集体责任。
en: We bear a collective responsibility for the thousands of lives lost to Ebola and the tens of thousands affected by the disease.

zh: 如今，感谢机构改善和适应，我们距离战胜埃博拉又近了一步。
en: And, today, thanks to institutional improvement and adaptation, we are closer to winning the fight against Ebola.

zh: 尽管埃博拉在该地区尚未得到遏制和根除，但其传播已经放慢；现在，我们必须开始恢复计划，而这必须包括强化保护我们的人民的生命和未来的国家、地区和国际体系。
en: Although the disease has not been contained and eradicated throughout the region, its spread has slowed; now we have to start planning our recovery, which must include strengthening the national, regional, and international systems that protect our people’s lives and futures.

zh: 作为三个受影响国的总统，2月份我们三人在几内亚科纳克里（Conakry）举行了会晤。 我们与科特迪瓦一道采取了一项共同战略消灭埃博拉和疫后经济社会恢复。
en: We, the presidents of the three affected countries, met in Conakry, Guinea, in February, joined by Côte d’Ivoire, to adopt a common strategy to end the epidemic and guide post-Ebola socioeconomic recovery.

zh: 这次会晤后，3月初布鲁塞尔举行了出资人会议，两周后，塞拉利昂弗里敦（Freetown）又举行了协调我们的技术委员会的会议。
en: This meeting was followed by a donors meeting in Brussels at the beginning of March, and a meeting in Freetown, Sierra Leone, two weeks later to coordinate our technical committees.

zh: 我们将在华盛顿国际货币基金组织（IMF）和世界银行春季会议上继续这方面的努力。
en: We will continue to build on these efforts in Washington, DC, at the spring meetings of the International Monetary Fund and the World Bank.

zh: 我们决心通过交换信息、共享技术专业知识、建立创新性普及型社区医疗体系、加强公共教育战略等手段根除埃博拉，包括家庭可以共享的措施，如用水、环境卫生和预防卫生（WASH）标准。
en: We are determined to eradicate Ebola by exchanging information, sharing technical expertise, creating innovative and accessible community health systems, and intensifying public education strategies, including steps that can be shared in families, such as applied water, sanitation, and hygiene (WASH) standards.

zh: 惟其如此，私人部门投资 — — 就业和稳定生活的引擎 — — 才会开始恢复。
en: Only then can investment by the private sector – the engine of employment and stable livelihoods – begin to recover.

zh: 埃博拉病毒的传播因为我们三国的共同历史和文化变得更加方便 — — 疾病轻易地跨境传播，迅速地从偏远农村地区向城市中心地区蔓延。
en: The spread of the Ebola virus has been facilitated by our countries’ shared history and culture, which has enabled the disease to cross borders easily and move quickly from remote rural areas to urban centers.

zh: 不幸的是，埃博拉迫使我们关闭部分边境，这阻止了人们与亲人的接触和获得看护。
en: Unfortunately, the epidemic forced us to close some of our borders, preventing access to relatives and care.

zh: 我们希望我们的基础设施、卫生政策和经济优势能够通过鼓励合作和就业创造的联系 — — 社区支持系统和发展走廊 — — 惠及各国人民。
en: We want our infrastructure, health policies, and economic strengths to benefit people across borders through links – community support systems and development corridors – that encourage collaboration and job creation.

zh: 我们也呼吁我们的国际伙伴支持共同经济刺激计划，并以可以强化增长、增加就业的务实方案为重点。
en: And we ask our international partners to support a common economic stimulus plan, with an emphasis on practical solutions that can enhance growth and increase employment.

zh: 对我们的恢复措施来说，四个要素至关重要。
en: Four elements are essential to our recovery effort.

zh: 首先是建立恢复力强的公共卫生体系，而这需要训练有素的社区卫生工作者以扩大农村地区覆盖面。
en: The first component is the creation of resilient public health systems, which requires trained community health workers in order to expand coverage in rural areas.

zh: 这还需要每个国家建立全国性供水和环境卫生计划和设施良好的传染病控制中心。
en: It also requires nationwide water and sanitation programs and well-equipped centers for the control of infectious diseases in each country.

zh: 其次，我们需要以基础设施为重点，特别是道路和电力和通讯网络。
en: Second, we need to focus on infrastructure, particularly roads and electricity and telecommunication networks.

zh: 我们呼吁非洲开发银行成立一个基础设施基金、扩展2013年启动的马诺河计划（Mano River Initiative ） ， 以深化地区一体化为目标。
en: We ask the African Development Bank to take the initiative in creating an infrastructure fund, an extension of the Mano River Initiative, launched in 2013, with the objective of furthering regional integration.

zh: 我们还呼吁我们的伙伴国要认识到，最初以十年为着眼点的项目必须尽快实施。
en: And we ask our partners to recognize that programs originally planned on a ten-year time horizon, must be implemented urgently.

zh: 第三，我们需要通过鼓励私人部门的信心支持经济复苏。 私人部门信心因为该地区成本上升而大受打击。
en: Third, we need to support economic recovery by encouraging confidence within the private sector, which has been hit by rising costs in the region.

zh: 具体而言，该地区可以从地方企业家补贴、外国投资者优惠融资和贷款、政府预算支持等措施中获益。
en: Specifically, the region would benefit from grants to local entrepreneurs, concessional financing and loans to foreign investors, and budgetary support from the government.

zh: 最后，按照非洲委员会（Commission for Africa ） 、 联合国和非洲联盟的建议，我们呼吁完全豁免我们的外债。
en: Finally, in line with the recommendation of the Commission for Africa, the United Nations, and the African Union, we ask for a total cancellation of our foreign debt.

zh: 这将使我们能够恢复财政灵活性，从而让我们能够共同出资重建我们的卫生体系。
en: This would allow us to recover the fiscal flexibility we need to enable us to co-finance the reconstruction of our health systems.

zh: 我们敦促我们的国际伙伴以与帮助我们对抗埃博拉病毒同样的合作精神、同样的紧迫感支持我们的经济复苏。
en: We urge our international partners to support our economic recovery in the same spirit of cooperation, and with the same sense of urgency, that helped us fight the Ebola virus.

zh: 齐心协力的我们能够建立比埃博拉疫情爆发前更加强大的医疗体系、基础设施和地区机构。
en: Together, we can build health care systems, infrastructure, and regional institutions that will be stronger than before the start of the epidemic.

zh: 齐心协力的我们能够为我们的人民留下持续的卫生和进步遗产。
en: Together, we can build a lasting legacy of health and progress for our peoples.

zh: 帮助欧洲央行下定决心
en: Helping the ECB Cross the Rubicon

zh: 发自巴黎 — — 在外界的预期中，欧元区货币政策官员将在1月22日召开的欧洲中央银行下一轮政策制定会议上齐聚一堂，共同创造一段历史。
en: PARIS – Eurozone monetary officials are expected to make history when they gather for the European Central Bank’s next policy-setting meeting on January 22.

zh: 观察家们预计欧洲央行主席马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）及其同僚将最终下定决心，宣布启动一项大规模量化宽松政策 — — 换言之，就是大规模采购各国政府债券。
en: Observers anticipate that ECB President Mario Draghi and his colleagues will finally cross the Rubicon and announce the launch of a large-scale program of quantitative easing (QE) – in other words, high-volume purchases of government bonds.

zh: 虽然欧洲央行已经抵制了量化宽松政策达五年之久，即便其他各主要国家央行都采取了这一政策，但欧洲央行执行委员会成员伯努瓦·科赫（Benoît Coeuré）已经将其称之为“基准选项 ” 。
en: Though the ECB has resisted QE for more than five years, even as other major central banks embraced it, Executive Board member Benoît Coeuré has already called it the “baseline option.”

zh: 在表面上看，欧洲央行拥有许多启动量化宽松的理由。
en: On the face of it, the ECB has many reasons to launch QE.

zh: 近两年以来，欧元区的通胀一直未能达到2%的目标。
en: For two years, inflation has consistently failed to reach the 2% target.

zh: 在十一月，年度价格增幅为0.3 % ， 而最近的油价大跌将在未来几个月带来更进一步的下行压力。
en: In November, the annual price growth was just 0.3%, while the recent collapse in oil prices will generate further downward pressure in the coming months.

zh: 而更重要的是通胀预期已经开始动摇。 经济预测专家和投资者们都预期这种无法达到目标的状况将一直维持到中期。
en: Even more important, inflation expectations have started to de-anchor: forecasters and investors expect the undershooting of the target to persist over the medium term.

zh: 低通胀已经成为了经济复苏及欧元区内部经济重新调整的一大严重阻碍。
en: Low inflation is already a serious obstacle to economic recovery and rebalancing within the eurozone.

zh: 而彻底的通缩则会成为更加严重的威胁。
en: Outright deflation would be an even more dangerous threat.

zh: 此外，金融市场在很大程度上认定量化宽松已经是板上钉钉的事情，以至于其中绝大多数的债券利率和汇率都已经提前出现了变动。
en: Moreover, financial markets consider QE so likely that the largest part of its bond-rate and exchange-rate consequences have already been priced in.

zh: 一旦欧洲央行打破了这一预期，那么债券和外汇市场将面对一场突然且破坏性的破位：长期利率将上升，股票市场会下跌，汇率则会走高。
en: Should the ECB disappoint expectations, bond and foreign-exchange markets would confront an abrupt and damaging unwinding of positions: long-term interest rates would rise, stock markets would sink, and the exchange rate would appreciate.

zh: 这可不是欧洲所需要的东西，因为美国花费一个季度所取得的增长，前者需要努力整整一年才能实现。
en: That is not what Europe needs as it struggles to achieve in a year the growth that the United States has already recorded in a single quarter.

zh: 但对此的犹豫情绪也是明显存在的。
en: Yet hesitations are palpable.

zh: 德国央行行长简斯·魏德曼（Jens Weidmann）依旧公开质疑这项做法。
en: Jens Weidmann, the president of the German Bundesbank, remains openly skeptical.

zh: 虽然魏德曼不否认通缩的危险，但他认为最近价格数据所体现出来的后果不会如想象中严重，而全面量化宽松的结果则会比预计的更加危险。
en: Though Weidmann does not deny the risk of deflation, he argues that the consequences of recent price data may be less serious than believed, while those of full-fledged QE could be more serious than assumed.

zh: 他的几位同僚也同样对此持保留意见。
en: Several of his colleagues share his reservations.

zh: 这就很有必要去理解为何在法兰克福还未能就最佳的行动进程达成任何协议。
en: It is important to understand why there is still no agreement in Frankfurt on the best possible course of action.

zh: 在美国的数据似乎已经验证了美联储的战略之时，为何欧洲央行依然踌躇不前？
en: At a time when the US data seem to validate the Federal Reserve’s strategy, why is the ECB hesitating?

zh: 与一般认识相反的是，这一事务并不单纯是理念之争。
en: Contrary to conventional wisdom, the issue is not one of pure doctrine.

zh: 没错，德国央行曾经激烈反对欧洲央行对高负债欧元区成员国的有条件支援，也支持了针对德拉吉创新举措 — — 直接货币交易计划 — — 的法律行动。
en: Yes, the Bundesbank fiercely opposed the ECB’s conditional support of debt-distressed eurozone members and backed legal challenges to Draghi’s innovation, the outright monetary transactions (OMT) scheme.

zh: 但德国官员们并未质疑为实现货币政策目的而批量采购债券行为的合法性，而其中就有某些状况需要用到量化宽松。
en: But German officials do not dispute the legitimacy of wholesale bond purchases for monetary-policy purposes, and that there can be circumstances that require QE.

zh: 对欧盟条约的正统诠释反对欧洲央行向某一特定国家提供援助，因为这将破坏货币和财政政策两者的各自独立：为了某特定国家的利益而调拨公共资源的权限只属于议会，而非央行。
en: Orthodoxy rules out providing ECB support to a particular country, because this would violate the separation between monetary and fiscal policy: The authority to commit public resources to the benefit of a particular country belongs exclusively to parliaments, not the central bank.

zh: 但批量采购各国政府债券则不会产生类似的担忧。
en: But a wholesale purchase of government bonds does not raise similar concerns.

zh: 与2012年宣布直接货币交易计划时不同，量化宽松的目标不是去帮助政府维护市场融资渠道。
en: Unlike in 2012, when the OMT was announced, the objective of QE is not to help governments keep market access.

zh: 在原则上，量化宽松与主权债务偿付能力无关。
en: In principle, QE has nothing to do with sovereign solvency.

zh: 它只是一个当央行政策利率已经触碰到“0”这一下限并因此无法继续压低的时候所必须采用的货币政策工具。
en: It is a monetary instrument that the central bank must rely on when its policy interest rate has hit the zero lower bound and thus cannot be pushed lower.

zh: 政府的负债水平与使用这一工具的决策是无关联的。
en: The debt level of the government is irrelevant to the decision to use it.

zh: 但是通过压低长期利率，央行对政府债券的采购可以帮助维持政府债务体系的正常运行。
en: But, by lowering long-term interest rates, central-bank purchases of government debt can help contain government debt service.

zh: 借助这种方式，量化宽松可以让一个本该破产的政府 — — 这对央行来说堪称一场噩梦 — — 维持偿付能力。
en: In this way, QE can keep solvent a government that otherwise would be insolvent – a nightmare scenario for a central bank.

zh: 对此日本就是一个很好的例子。
en: Japan is a case in point.

zh: 日本银行已经持有相当于该国GDP总额40%的政府债券，并承诺在首相安倍晋三的经济激活进程框架下每年购入相当于GDP总额16%的债券。
en: The Bank of Japan already holds government securities worth 40% of GDP, and it is committed to annual purchases worth 16% of GDP within the framework of Prime Minister Shinzo Abe’s economic revitalization agenda.

zh: 日本银行采购方案的庞大金额意味着其已经完全控制了政府债券市场。
en: The mammoth size of the BOJ program implies that it has taken full control of the market for government paper.

zh: 在这种相当于赤字两倍的年度采购行为之下，所谓的政府债券“市场”也基本上名存实亡。
en: With annual purchases amounting to twice the deficit, it has become hard to speak of a “market” for government debt.

zh: 日本银行成为了事实上的价格制定者。
en: In fact, the BOJ sets the price.

zh: 这种情况会令央行成为政府行为的人质。
en: Such a situation can make the central bank hostage to the government’s behavior.

zh: 安倍承诺一旦遏制住通缩且经济恢复增长就要恢复公共财政的可持续性，而日本银行的对应行动也能因此推断出来。
en: The BOJ’s action is predicated on Abe’s commitment to restoring the sustainability of public finances once deflation has been defeated and the economy has returned to growth.

zh: 一旦安倍无法兑现承诺，则日本银行必将陷入困境。
en: Should Abe fail to deliver, the BOJ would be trapped.

zh: 如果日本银行停止购买政府债券，就像引发一场主权危机并导致自身投资组合的价值受损（尤其当它开始出售自身资产负债表上的债券时 ） 。
en: If it stopped buying government debt, it could trigger a sovereign crisis and reduce the value of its own portfolio (especially if it started selling the bonds on its balance sheet).

zh: 而持续收购只会不断强化政府对银行的控制。
en: But continuing its purchases would tighten the government’s grip.

zh: 因此对任何实施量化宽松的央行来说，对政府的信任非常重要。
en: Trust in the government is therefore vital for any central bank that embarks on QE.

zh: 而这种信任在欧洲早已失落了。
en: This trust is missing in Europe.

zh: 尽管不断添加各类法律文本和程序，欧盟的财政框架依然缺乏可信度，也未能给予欧洲央行信心，无法让后者觉得这些国家将在债券采购行动让其躲过了进一步市场压力后继续寻求财政可持续性。
en: Despite an accumulation of legal texts and procedures, the EU fiscal framework lacks credibility and does not give the ECB confidence that governments will continue to pursue sustainability after its bond purchases shelter them from market pressure even further.

zh: 此外，跟其他央行不同，欧洲央行的谈判对手不止一个，也没有任何一个对其负责的政府事实上或让人感觉能掌控欧元区这个整体。
en: Moreover, unlike its counterparts, the ECB does not face a single interlocutor, and none of the governments that hold it accountable is or feels in charge of the eurozone as a whole.

zh: 这是一个极为不利的情况，也解释了曾经担忧各国政府可能联合起来削弱其独立性风险的欧洲央行，为何会摇身一变成为了财政政策协作的最坚定倡导者。
en: This is a deeply unfavorable situation, which explains why the ECB, once obsessed with the risk that governments would coalesce to assail its independence, has turned into the staunchest advocate of fiscal-policy coordination.

zh: 这一担忧也因此是可以理解的。
en: Concern is therefore understandable.

zh: 但这并不能消除对大胆非常规反通缩手段的需求，也不应因此阻止欧洲央行启动量化宽松。
en: But it does not diminish the need for bold unconventional action against deflation, and it should not prevent the ECB from launching QE.

zh: 与日本的比较点出了政府以负责任，单独和集体的方式采取行动的必要性。
en: The parallel with Japan highlights the need for governments to behave responsibly, individually and collectively.

zh: 欧洲的民选国家领导人需要扮演极大的角色，也不应该回避自身的责任。
en: Europe’s elected national leaders have a large role to play, and they must not eschew their duties.

zh: 他们给欧洲央行的信心越多，量化宽松策略就越有效。
en: The more confidence they give to the ECB, the more effective QE will be.

zh: 欧洲的危机考验
en: Europe’s Trial by Crisis

zh: 发自柏林 — — 大约2500年前，古希腊哲学家赫拉克利特（Heraclitus）指出战争是一切事物之父。
en: BERLIN – Some 2,500 years ago, the ancient Greek philosopher Heraclitus concluded that war is the father of all things.

zh: 如果能活到今天，他或许会再增添一句：危机是一切事物之母。
en: He might have added that crisis is their mother.

zh: 幸运的是，在相互核毁灭的威胁之下，大国强权之间的战争已经不再是一个现实的选项。
en: Fortunately, war between world powers is no longer a realistic option, owing to the threat of mutual nuclear destruction.

zh: 但大型的国际危机，比如当前的全球金融危机却依然伴随着我们 — — 而这或许不完全是件坏事。
en: But major international crises, such as the current global financial crisis, remain with us – which might not be an entirely bad thing.

zh: 正如战争那样，危机彻底打破了现状，这意味着新的改革机会得以产生 — — 却不具备战争的那种破坏性 — — 而这些机会在平时是很难有机会出现的。
en: Just as in war, crises fundamentally disrupt the status quo, which means that they create an opportunity – without war’s destructive force – for change that in normal times is hardly possible.

zh: 克服危机需要做出一些原本无法想象的事，而不仅仅是可施行的方案。
en: To overcome a crisis requires doing things that previously were barely conceivable, let alone feasible.

zh: 这就是欧盟过去3年来所发生的情况，因为全球金融危机不仅从根本上动摇了欧洲；还有可能威胁到其生存。
en: That is what has happened to the European Union over the last three years, because the global financial crisis has not only shaken Europe to its foundations; it has assumed life-threatening proportions.

zh: 相比于2009年初，我们现在面对的是一个与过去差异巨大的欧盟 — — 联盟分化成为一个组成欧元区的前锋成员国和一个尚未加入欧元区的后卫成员国。
en: Compared to the beginning of 2009, we are now dealing with a significantly different EU – one that has become divided between a vanguard of member states that form the eurozone and a rearguard, consisting of member states that remain outside it.

zh: 出现这种情况的原因并非出自恶意，而是危机的压力所致。
en: The reason is not evil intent, but rather the pressure of the crisis.

zh: 如果欧元想生存下来的话，欧元区成员国必须行动起来，而其他对欧洲一体化有不同程度承诺的成员国则依然处于边缘地位。
en: If the euro is to survive, eurozone members must act, while other EU members with various levels of commitment to European integration remain on the fringe.

zh: 事实上，在危机爆发之后几乎所有的禁忌都被打破了。
en: Indeed, almost all taboos that existed after the eruption of the crisis have now been abolished.

zh: 其中大多数当初都是在德国推动之下建立的，但如今却在德国政府的积极支持之下被废除。
en: Most were established at German instigation, but now they have been removed with the German government’s active support.

zh: 这是一个令人印象深刻的表单：拯救银行的国家责任；欧盟条约关于禁止援助国家政府的神圣规定；反对对欧洲进行经济治理的条款；禁止欧洲央行直接资助政府的禁令；拒绝支持共同承担债务的决定；最后，欧洲央行从旧的德意志银行的翻版转型成一个基于盅格鲁-萨克逊模式的欧洲联邦储备银行。
en: It is an impressive list: national responsibility for bank rescues; the sanctity of the EU treaty’s proscription of bailouts for governments; rejection of European economic governance; the ban on direct government financing by the European Central Bank; refusal to support mutual liability for debt; and, finally, the transformation of the ECB from a copy of the old Bundesbank into a European Federal Reserve Bank based on the Anglo-Saxon model.

zh: 剩下的就是对欧洲债券的抵制，但这也将最终消失。
en: What remains is the rejection of Eurobonds, but that, too, will ultimately disappear.

zh: 唯一的问题就是这项戒条究竟会在下一轮德国大选之前还是之后被打破。
en: The only question is whether that taboo will fall before or after next year’s German general election.

zh: 而答案则取决于危机的未来进程。
en: The answer depends on the future course of the crisis.

zh: 德国作为欧洲最大的经济体，正在危机中扮演着一个古怪，甚至有时显得离奇的角色。
en: Germany, Europe’s largest economy, is playing a strange, sometimes bizarre, role in the crisis.

zh: 自从德意志联邦共和国1949年建立以来这个国家从未变得如此强大。
en: At no point since the founding of the Federal Republic in 1949 has the country been so strong.

zh: 它已经成为了欧盟的领头羊，但却既不愿意也没有能力去领导这个集体。
en: It has become the EU’s leading power; but it is neither willing nor able to lead.

zh: 正因为这个原因，欧洲的许多改变都在不顾德国反对的情况下发生了。
en: Precisely for this reason, many of the changes in Europe have occurred despite German opposition.

zh: 最后，德国政府只能求助于政治180度转向的手腕，结果就是德国虽然在经济上强大，却在制度上逐渐弱化 — — 该国在欧洲央行管理委员会中影响力逐渐减弱的状况正好反映出这一变动。
en: In the end, the German government has had to resort to the art of the political U-turn, with the result that Germany, though economically strong, has grown institutionally weaker – a dynamic exemplified by its reduced influence in the ECB’s Governing Council.

zh: 旧的德意志银行已经在9月6日归于沉寂，因为尽管德意志银行主席延斯·魏德曼（Jens Weidmann）一力反对，欧洲央行依然采取了其“完全货币交易”计划 — — 可以无限制地购买欧元区危机国的政府债券。
en: The old Bundesbank was laid to rest on September 6, when the ECB adopted its “outright monetary transactions” program – unlimited purchases of distressed eurozone countries’ government bonds – over the objections of a lone dissenter: Bundesbank President Jens Weidmann.

zh: 而埋葬旧德意志银行的不是欧洲央行主席马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi ） ， 而是德国总理安吉拉·默克尔（Angela Merkel ） 。
en: And the undertaker was not ECB President Mario Draghi; it was German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

zh: 德意志银行并不是一场南欧危险合谋的受害者；相反是它自己落在了潮流后面。
en: The Bundesbank did not fall victim to a sinister southern European conspiracy; rather, it rendered itself irrelevant.

zh: 如果它得势的话，欧元区将不复存在。
en: Had it gotten its way, the eurozone would no longer exist.

zh: 将理想放在实用主义之上在任何危机中都必输无疑。
en: Placing ideology above pragmatism is a formula for failure in any crisis.

zh: 目前来说，欧元区正处在形成一个银行联盟的门槛上，随后则会是一个财政联盟。
en: Currently, the eurozone is on the threshold of a banking union, with a fiscal union to follow.

zh: 但即便只成立一个银行联盟，向一个政治联盟推进的压力也将不断增大，
en: But, even with only a banking union, the pressure toward political union will grow.

zh: 由于拥有27个成员国（克罗地亚加入后将达到28个 ） ， 欧盟条约的修改将变得不可能，不仅因为英国继续反对进一步的欧洲一体化，但也由于许多成员国都必须就修订发起公民投票。
en: With 27 members (28 with the approaching addition of Croatia), EU treaty amendments will be impossible, not only because the United Kingdom continues to resist further European integration, but also because popular referenda would be required in many member states.

zh: 这些表决将成为对各国政府危机政策的审判，没有政府会头脑发热到想要去做这一点。
en: These plebiscites would become a reckoning for national governments on their crisis policies, which no sound-minded government will want.

zh: 这意味着到了某些时候就需要达成一些政府间协议，而欧元区将朝着跨政府联邦制度的方向发展。
en: This means that intergovernmental agreements will be needed for some time to come, and that the eurozone will develop in the direction of inter-governmental federalism.

zh: 这肯定是令人兴奋的，因为它将带来一些完全意料之外的政治一体化可能性。
en: This promises to be exciting, as it will offer completely unexpected possibilities for political integration.

zh: 最后，法国前总统尼古拉·萨科齐（Nicolas Sarkozy）将得势，因为当今的欧元区是由一个由成员国政府首脑（极其财政部长）组成的事实上的经济政府所领导。
en: In the end, former French President Nicolas Sarkozy has prevailed, because the eurozone today is led by a de facto economic government that comprises member countries’ heads of state and government (and their finance ministers).

zh: 欧洲联邦主义者会欢迎这一点，因为随着越来越多政府首脑转变成为一个欧元区整体的政府，它们当前这种既是欧盟执行者又是立法者的双重角色就越快被废弃。
en: European federalists should welcome this, because the more these heads of state and government turn into a government of the eurozone as a whole, the faster their current dual role as the EU’s executive and legislative branch will become obsolete.

zh: 欧洲议会将无法填补这个不断扩大的真空地带，因为它缺乏财政方面的主权 — — 这一权利将依然无限期地握在各国立法机关手里。
en: The European Parliament will not be able to fill the emerging vacuum, as it lacks fiscal sovereignty, which still lies with national parliaments and will remain there indefinitely.

zh: 只有各国议会能填补这一真空，而它们需要一个在欧元区内的共同平台 — — 某种“欧元议院 ” — —以此它们可以控制欧洲的经济治理。
en: Only national parliaments can fill the vacuum, and they need a common platform within the eurozone – a kind of “Euro Chamber” – through which they can control European economic governance.

zh: 欧洲议会以及布鲁塞尔的联邦主义者不应感到被威胁。
en: Federalists in the European Parliament, and in Brussels generally, should not feel threatened.

zh: 相反，他们应当意识到并利用这个独一无二的机会。
en: On the contrary, they should recognize and use this unique opportunity.

zh: 各国议员和欧洲议会议员应当迅速集合起来并理清互相之间的关系。
en: National MPs and MEPs should come together quickly and clarify their relationship.

zh: 在中期内，一个拥有两个议院的欧洲议会将浮现。
en: In the medium term, a European Parliament with two chambers could emerge.

zh: 这个危机为欧洲带来了一个巨大的机会。
en: This crisis offers a tremendous opportunity for Europe.

zh: 它定义了未来几年的议程：银行联盟，财政联盟，政治联盟。
en: It has defined the agenda for years to come: banking union, fiscal union, and political union.

zh: 而缺失的则是一个针对危机国家制定的经济增长战略；但考虑到南欧地区不断动荡的局势，这样一个战略的出台是无可避免的。
en: What remains missing is an economic-growth strategy for the crisis countries; but, given mounting unrest in southern Europe, such a strategy is inevitable.

zh: 如果能认识到危机所创造的机会，欧洲人就有理由去保持乐观 — — 并大胆而果断地抓住这个机会。
en: Europeans have reason to be optimistic if they recognize the opportunity that their crisis has created – and act boldly and decisively to seize it.

zh: 货币联盟的稳定与繁荣
en: Stability and Prosperity in Monetary Union

zh: 法兰克福—有一个普遍的错误概念 — — 欧元区是一个没有财政联盟的货币联盟。
en: FRANKFURT – There is a common misconception that the euro area is a monetary union without a political union.

zh: 但这反映的是对货币联盟含义的深刻误解。
en: But this reflects a deep misunderstanding of what monetary union means.

zh: 货币联盟之所以成为你可能，唯一的原因是欧盟国家间已经实现了深度一体化 — — 而共用一种货币深化了这个一体化。
en: Monetary union is possible only because of the substantial integration already achieved among European Union countries – and sharing a single currency deepens that integration.

zh: 如果欧洲货币联盟比许多人想的更有韧性，其唯一原因是质疑它的人误判了它的政治面。
en: If European monetary union has proved more resilient than many thought, it is only because those who doubted it misjudged this political dimension.

zh: 他们低估了欧元区成员国之间的联系、它们集体投资的规模、以及它们联手解决告急的共同问题的意愿。
en: They underestimated the ties among its members, how much they had collectively invested, and their willingness to come together to solve common problems when it mattered most.

zh: 但同样明显的是，我们的货币联盟仍不完善。
en: Yet it is also clear that our monetary union is still incomplete.

zh: 两年前，所谓的“四主席 ” （ 欧盟理事会主席与欧盟委员会、欧洲央行和欧元集团主席的密切合作）做出了这一诊断。
en: This was the diagnosis offered two years ago by the so-called “Four Presidents” (the European council president in close collaboration with the presidents of the European Commission, the European Central Bank, and the Eurogroup).

zh: 此外，尽管在某些领域取得了重要进展，但其他方面的工作仍有待完成。
en: And, though important progress has been made in some areas, unfinished business remains in others.

zh: 但“完善”货币联盟意味着什么？
en: But what does it mean to “complete” a monetary union?

zh: 最重要的是，它意味着创造一系列条件，使各国加入其中能获得更大的稳定与繁荣。
en: Most important, it means having conditions in place that make countries more stable and prosperous than they would be if they were not members.

zh: 加入其中比位于其外更好。
en: They have to be better off inside than they would be outside.

zh: 在其他政治联盟，凝聚力通过强大的共同身份维持，但往往也通过富裕地区和贫穷地区持久的财政转移从而在事后实现收入平均来维持。
en: In other political unions, cohesion is maintained through a strong common identity, but often also through permanent fiscal transfers between richer and poorer regions that even out incomes ex post.

zh: 在欧元区，这一国家间的单向转移在可预见的未来不会存在（欧盟团结政策中确实有关于转移支付的内容，但规模有限制，并主要是为了支持低收入国家或地区的“赶超”过程 ） 。
en: In the euro area, such one-way transfers between countries are not foreseen (transfers do exist as part of the EU’s cohesion policy, but are limited in size and are primarily designed to support the “catching-up” process in lower income countries or regions).

zh: 这意味着我们需要另辟蹊径确保每个国家都会因为加入欧元区而持续变得更好。
en: This means that we need a different approach to ensure that each country is permanently better off inside the euro area.

zh: 这主要意味着两点。
en: This implies two main things.

zh: 首先，我们必须为所有国家创造独立繁荣的条件。
en: First, we have to create the conditions for all countries to thrive independently.

zh: 所有成员国都需要能够利用单一市场中的比较优势、吸引资本、创造就业岗位。
en: All members need to be able to exploit comparative advantages within the Single Market, attract capital, and generate jobs.

zh: 它们还需要足够的灵活性以快速应对短期冲击。
en: And they need to have enough flexibility to respond quickly to short-term shocks.

zh: 这就需要采取结构改革刺激竞争、减少不必要的繁文缛节、增强劳动力市场的适应力。
en: This comes down to structural reforms that spur competition, reduce unnecessary red tape, and make labor markets more adaptable.

zh: 到目前为止，是否实施这类改革基本上仍是国家权力。
en: Until now, whether or not to carry out such reforms has largely been a national prerogative.

zh: 但在像我们这样的联盟中，这显然也是共同利益。
en: But in a union such as ours they are a clear common interest.

zh: 欧元区国家需要相互依赖实现增长。
en: Euro area countries depend on one another for growth.

zh: 更基本的是，如果结构改革不足导致货币联盟内部的持久分化，将制造退出幽灵 — — 所有成员国最终都会因为这一幽灵蒙受损失。
en: And, more fundamentally, if a lack of structural reforms leads to permanent divergence within the monetary union, this raises the specter of exit – from which all members ultimately suffer.

zh: 在欧元区，各地的稳定与繁荣取决于各国共同繁荣。
en: In the euro area, stability and prosperity anywhere depend on countries thriving everywhere.

zh: 因此，有很强大的理由在欧元区内共享更多的主权 — — 这样才能构建真正的经济联盟。
en: So there is a strong case for sharing more sovereignty in this area – for building a genuine economic union.

zh: 这不仅意味着加强现有程序。
en: This means more than beefing up existing procedures.

zh: 这意味着共同治理：从合作转变为共同决策，从规则转变为机构。
en: It means governing together: shifting from coordination to common decision-making, and from rules to institutions.

zh: 财政转移缺位的第二个影响是各国需要更多地投资于其他机制以共担冲击成本。
en: The second implication of the absence of fiscal transfers is that countries need to invest more in other mechanisms to share the cost of shocks.

zh: 即使是较灵活的经济体，内部调整也永远慢于拥有本国汇率时的情形。
en: Even with more flexible economies, internal adjustment will always be slower than it would be if countries had their own exchange rate.

zh: 因此，风险共担是防止衰退留下永久疤痕、刺激经济分化的关键。
en: Risk-sharing is thus essential to prevent recessions from leaving permanent scars and reinforcing economic divergence.

zh: 解决方案的一个关键是通过金融一体化改善私人风险共担。
en: A key part of the solution is to improve private risk-sharing by deepening financial integration.

zh: 事实上，我们越是不希望公共风险共担，就越需要私人风险共担。
en: Indeed, the less public risk-sharing we want, the more private risk-sharing we need.

zh: 欧元区银行联盟应该成为鼓励深化银行部门一体化的催化剂。
en: A banking union for the euro area should be catalytic in encouraging deeper integration of the banking sector.

zh: 但风险共担也事关资本市场深化，特别是股市，因此，我们还需要快速推进资本市场联盟。
en: But risk-sharing is also about deepening capital markets, especially for equity, which is why we also need to advance quickly with a capital markets union.

zh: 但是，我们仍必须承认财政政策在货币联盟中的关键作用。
en: Still, we have to acknowledge the vital role of fiscal policies in a monetary union.

zh: 专注于欧元区价格稳定的简单货币联盟无法应对只影响一个国家或地区的冲击。
en: A single monetary policy focused on price stability in the euro area cannot react to shocks that affect only one country or region.

zh: 因此，为了避免长期地方崩溃，国家财政政策可以起到稳定作用至关重要。
en: So, to avoid prolonged local slumps, it is critical that national fiscal policies can perform their stabilization role.

zh: 要让国家财政稳定器起作用，政府必须能够在经济受压时以低廉的成本借贷。
en: To allow national fiscal stabilizers to work, governments must be able to borrow at an affordable cost in times of economic stress.

zh: 强大的财政框架对于实现这一目标、阻止国家间传染来说是不可或缺的。
en: A strong fiscal framework is indispensable to achieve this, and protects countries from contagion.

zh: 但危机经验表明，在极端市场紧张时期，即使是坚挺的初始财政状况也无法给溢出效应提供绝对保护。
en: But the crisis experience suggests that, in times of extreme market tensions, even a sound initial fiscal position may not offer absolute protection from spillovers.

zh: 因此，我们更加需要经济联盟：如果提高国家的未来增长前景的信心，它们采取消极措施应对暂时性赤字升高的可能性就越小。
en: This is a further reason why we need economic union: markets would be less likely to react negatively to temporarily higher deficits if they were more confident in future growth prospects.

zh: 通过让政府致力于结构改革，经济联盟可以提供让各国真正摆脱债务的信誉。
en: By committing governments to structural reforms, economic union provides the credibility that countries can indeed grow out of debt.

zh: 说到底，国家间经济趋同不能只依靠设立货币联盟的门槛标准，或设立有时需要满足的条件。
en: Ultimately, economic convergence among countries cannot be only an entry criterion for monetary union, or a condition that is met some of the time.

zh: 国家间经济趋同需要一个随时随地都要满足的条件。
en: It has to be a condition that is fulfilled all of the time.

zh: 出于这一原因，要完善货币联盟，我们最终必须深化我们的政治联盟：在新的机构秩序中明确权利和义务。
en: And for this reason, to complete monetary union we will ultimately have to deepen our political union further: to lay down its rights and obligations in a renewed institutional order.

zh: 欧洲的影子预算
en: Europe’s Shadow Budget

zh: 慕尼黑 — — 有关2015-2017年欧盟委员会3150亿欧元（合3900亿美元）投资计划的更多细节终于水落石出。
en: MUNICH – More details about the European Commission’s €315 billion ($390 billion) investment plan for 2015-2017 have finally come to light.

zh: 由欧盟委员会主席让 - 克洛德·容克于11月宣布的这项计划实际相当于规模庞大的影子预算，将为公共投资项目提供两倍于欧盟年度官方预算的巨额支持并最终协助政府避开稳定与增长公约规定的债务限制。
en: The program, announced by European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker in November, amounts to a massive shadow budget, twice as large as the European Union’s annual official budget, that will finance public investment projects and ultimately help governments circumvent debt limits established in the Stability and Growth Pact.

zh: 该借款安排将假手新的欧洲战略投资基金，在欧洲投资银行的保护伞下进行运作。
en: The borrowing will be arranged through the new European Fund for Strategic Investment, operating under the umbrella of the European Investment Bank.

zh: 该投资基金将拨备50亿欧元的启动资金，其中部分来自以欧盟委员会160亿欧元担保为后盾对欧洲投资银行现有资产进行重估。
en: The EFSI will be equipped with €5 billion in start-up capital, produced through the revaluation of existing EIB assets, and will be backed by €16 billion in guarantees from the European Commission.

zh: 该基金预计将以此撬动约630亿欧元的信贷资产，每借出一块欧元预计将使私人投资者取得5欧元左右的产出 — — 由此计算总投资将接近3150万欧元的目标。
en: The fund is expected to leverage this to acquire roughly €63 billion in loans, with private investors subsequently contributing some €5 for every euro lent – bringing total investment to the €315 billion target.

zh: 虽然欧盟国家不会提供任何实际资金，但他们会为私人投资者提供隐性及显性担保，这与欧元债券所隐含的连带责任颇有相似之处。
en: Though EU countries will not contribute any actual funds, they will provide implicit and explicit guarantees for the private investors, in an arrangement that looks suspiciously like the joint liability embodied by Eurobonds.

zh: 德国总理安格拉·默克尔断然拒绝欧元债券提议后，欧盟组织了大批金融专家寻找创造性的规避方式。
en: Faced with German Chancellor Angela Merkel’s categorical rejection of Eurobonds, the EU engaged a horde of financial specialists to find a creative way to circumvent it.

zh: 欧洲战略投资基金就是他们煞费苦心想出的方式。
en: They came up with the EFSI.

zh: 虽然基金到2015年年中之前都无法实际运行，但欧盟成员国已经上报了多个项目提请欧洲委员会审议。
en: Though the fund will not be operational until mid-2015, EU member countries have already proposed projects for the European Commission’s consideration.

zh: 截止十二月初，全部28个欧盟成员国政府均已提交了申请 — — 而且申请项目仍在不断增加。
en: By early December, all 28 EU governments had submitted applications – and they are still coming.

zh: 我所领导的 伊佛经济研究所在对申请文件进行评估时发现，近2，000个潜在项目将总共耗资1.3万亿欧元，其中2017年年底前需要投入的部分约为5，000亿。
en: An assessment of the application documents conducted by the Ifo Institute for Economic Research, of which I am President, found that the nearly 2,000 potential projects would cost a total of €1.3 trillion, with about €500 billion spent before the end of 2017.

zh: 其中约53%将用于公共项目；15%用于公私合作（PPPs ） ； 21%投向私人项目；仅有略多于10%的项目无法进行归类。
en: Some 53% of those costs correspond to public projects; 15% to public-private partnerships (PPPs); 21% to private projects; and just over 10% to projects that could not be classified.

zh: 公共项目想必会涉及欧洲战略投资基金，由政府承担利息支付和分期摊销。
en: The public projects will presumably involve EFSI financing, with governments assuming the interest payments and amortization.

zh: 公私合作将带来混合融资，由私营实体在承担部分风险的同时获得部分收益。
en: The PPPs will entail mixed financing, with private entities taking on a share of the risk and the return.

zh: 私人项目将包括提供基础设施，通过私人运营商收取过路费或使用费来偿还债务。
en: The private projects will include the provision of infrastructure, the cost of which is to be repaid through tolls or user fees collected by a private operator.

zh: 我不像其他某些批评者那样认为该计划无法支撑欧洲经济体的需求。
en: Unlike some other critics, I do not expect the program to fail to bolster demand in the European economy.

zh: 毕竟，计划于3年内投资完成的这3，150亿欧元占欧盟年GDP2.3%的份额。
en: After all, the €315 billion that is expected to be distributed over three years amounts to 2.3% of the EU’s annual GDP.

zh: 如此庞大的投资势必会产生影响。
en: Such a sizeable level of investment is bound to have an impact.

zh: 但上述计划在法律上仍然非常可疑，因为它凭空创造了与欧盟和国家预算平行运作的巨额影子预算，从而将巨大的风险负担强加在纳税人头上。
en: But the program remains legally dubious, as it creates a massive shadow budget financed by borrowing that will operate parallel to the EU and national budgets, thereby placing a substantial risk-sharing burden on taxpayers.

zh: 因为国家无论其资信状况都可以以相同的利率借用资金，且很多项目申请国因为不久前刚刚烧光巨额资金而无法再次从金融市场获得融资。
en: Because every country, regardless of its creditworthiness, can borrow at the same interest rate, projects will be undertaken in countries that recently have burned such huge amounts of capital that they can no longer tap financial markets for funding.

zh: 就像危机期间采取的许多其他“保护”措施一样，这种对市场过程的扭曲将有助于巩固欧洲投资资本的次优配置，并对未来几年的经济增长构成阻碍作用。
en: Just like the many other “protective” measures taken during the crisis, this distortion of market processes will help to cement the sub-optimal allocation of European investment capital, hampering economic growth for years to come.

zh: 雪上加霜的是，这种债务共同化带来的新增借款仅有一小部分将被纳入国家预算之中。
en: Making matters worse, only a fraction of the new borrowing enabled by the mutualization of liability will be factored into national budgets.

zh: 这会导致欧盟范围内债务管理协议形同虚设，包括将总体赤字限制在GDP3％的稳定与增长公约，以及2012年 “财政契约 ” ， 该契约规定债务占GDP比率超过60%的国家在完全符合契约规定前必须每年削减二十分之一的债务。
en: This will render meaningless EU-wide debt-management agreements, including the Stability and Growth Pact, which limits the overall deficit to 3% of GDP, and the 2012 “fiscal compact,” which stipulates that countries whose debt-to-GDP ratios exceed the 60% limit should reduce them by one-twentieth annually until they are in compliance.

zh: 近年来，银行一直因通过特殊用途工具和管道、利用影子预算过度承担风险而饱受指责。
en: In recent years, banks have been berated for using shadow budgets, in the form of special-purpose vehicles and conduits, to take on excessive risk.

zh: 欧盟现在也在采用类似的措施，这即便从最保守的意义上讲也非常令人担任。
en: It is worrisome, to say the least, that the EU is now resorting to similar tricks.

zh: 欧洲央行：如今的欧洲后盾
en: Ecb Is Now Europe’s Anchor

zh: 欧洲中央银行（ECB）扬名之时指日可待。
en: The European Central Bank is making its reputation at this time of turmoil and crisis.

zh: 就在欧盟宪法在法国和荷兰遭到拒绝一个月后，最近在布鲁塞尔召开的欧盟峰会又在一场国家利己主义的激烈争辩中收场，而欧盟预算事项却毫无进展。
en: Barely a month after the rejection of the European Union Constitution in France and the Netherlands, the EU Summit in Brussels ended in a surprisingly acrimonious orgy of national egoisms and no deal. Then the terrorists struck in London.

zh: 当欧盟陷入政治混乱的时候，ECB必须成为稳定的后盾。
