en: With all this trouble, the ECB is showing itself to be an “anchor of stability” by steadfastly sticking to its mandate of insuring price stability.

zh: 欧洲正在遭受一场旷日持久并且已经对欧洲的经济复苏形成障碍的信任危机。
en: Europe suffers from a profound crisis of confidence.

zh: 由于对他们政治领导人解决多方面问题的能力缺乏信心，公民们正在未雨绸缪地为这场他们相信很快会来到的危机做准备，与此同时，商人们不愿投资，因为他们不相信政府将会采取任何必要的经济改革。
en: Its economy, for example, cannot recover properly because consumers, lacking confidence in the ability of their political leaders to solve the economy’s manifold economic problems (budget deficits, pensions, etc.), are saving for a rainy day they feel is just around the corner—and businessmen are reluctant to invest, because they don’t trust government to make the necessary economic reforms.

zh: 正如不光彩的布鲁塞尔峰会所清楚表现出的那样，这种对欧盟政治领导层的信任的缺乏是完全有道理的。
en: The public’s lack of confidence in the EU’s political leadership is totally justified.

zh: 欧洲的政治领导人并没有真正地为解决欧洲基本问题做一些有建设性的事情 — — 改革高额福利国家以保证他们能适应全球化的竞争，相反他们却用有关“极端自由的盎格鲁-萨克逊典范 ” 、 英国的预算返款以及高利率的论调作幌子，好像经济衰退是欧洲中央银行的过错一样。
en: Instead of actually doing something constructive about Europe’s essential problem --reforming expensive welfare states to ensure global competitiveness--Europe’s political leaders are hiding behind straw man arguments about “ultra liberal Anglo Saxon models,” and pressuring the ECB to lower interest rates as if European economic weakness were Frankfurt’s fault.

zh: 为了破坏ECB的独立性，欧洲的财政部长们正在寻求在银行的决定权上拥有更大的发言权。
en: Europe’s finance ministers portray the ECB as closed to dialogue.

zh: 卢森堡首相兼欧元集团主席让·克洛德·容克在欧盟议会的经济及货币事务委员会召开前表示，欧元区的财长们应该在对ECB表达他们的观点时态度更强硬。 他呼吁欧元集团的部长们和ECB之间应当展开“开放坦率的”谈话。
en: When testifying before the EU Parliament’s Economic and Monetary Affairs Committee, Luxembourg prime minister and Euro-group chairman Jean-Claude Juncker said there should be “open and frank” talks between the euro-group ministers and the ECB—and French finance minister Dominique de Villepin said the same thing.

zh: 谁需要这样的谈话？
en: According to a knowledgeable ECB source, however, Europe’s finance ministers regularly meet in secret with the ECB leadership for a mutual and frank exchange of views on monetary policy and other issues.

zh: 所有欧元区的财长们一致所要讨论的就是降低利率，而这将无助于欧洲经济的复苏。
en: The dialogue already exists though the public does not know it. Such disingenuousness does little to boost confidence in Europe’s political leadership.

zh: 通过将利率维持在历史最低纪录，ECB已经使欧洲在很长一段时间保持了货币稳定。
en: The ECB has done all it can for growth by giving Europe a prolonged period of monetary stability at record low interest rates.

zh: 有谁真的相信在预料到利率下调后，消费者们会对开销支出缩手缩脚 — — 商人们会延缓他们的投资呢？
en: Does anyone really believe consumers are holding back on spending —and businessmen postponing their investments—in anticipation of that next drop in interest rates?

zh: 正如凯恩斯（Keynes）说的那样，师傅引进门，修行在个人。
en: To paraphrase Keynes, you can lead a horse to water but you can’t make him drink.

zh: “欧洲现在最不需要的就是降低利率 ， ” 一位颇具影响力的ECB监管理事会成员在一次对现行状况的公正评估中说道。 屈服于外界的政治压力并不是“稳定后盾”的含义。
en: “The last thing Europe needs now is an interest rate cut,” says one influential member of the ECB Governing Council in a candid assessment of the current situation.  Capitulating to outside political pressure is no one’s definition of an “anchor of stability.”

zh: 欧元会崩溃，并且ECB将作为一家信誉良好的中央银行关门。
en: The euro would collapse, and the ECB finished as a creditable central bank.

zh: 此外，ECB的首席经济学家Otmar Issing预测，随着通货膨胀的可能性增加，长期利率将走高，而非下降。
en: Moreover, ECB chief economist Otmar Issing predicts long- term interest rates would go up—not down—as inflationary expectations increased.

zh: 因此，降级利率的做法不仅是愚蠢的，更是疯狂的。
en: So cutting interest rates would not only be stupid—it would be crazy.

zh: 但是ECB不会削减利率，即使这暗示着它可能就是为了阻止政治狼群。
en: But the ECB is not going to cut rates even though, for public relations reasons of keeping the political wolves at bay, it deceptively hints it might.

zh: ECB坚持着自己的立场，通过这样做它向欧洲公民表明他们至少还有一个欧盟机构可以信任。
en: Don’t be fooled by such feints. The ECB is holding fast and, in doing so, demonstrates to Europe’s peoples that there is at least one EU institution they can trust.

zh: 这点至关重要。
en: This is vital.

zh: 历史已经告诉我们政治动乱通常导致的就是通货膨胀，而通货膨胀只会引发更多的骚动。
en: History shows political turmoil often leads to inflation, which only fuels further turmoil.

zh: 欧洲人可以用他们的最后一块欧元打赌ECB不会让刚刚起步的共同货币被通货膨胀所破坏，因为他们工作不合格的领导人现在害怕他们会失去民众。
en: Europeans can bet their last euro the ECB will not let the fledgling common currency be ravaged by inflation because their political leaders, having failed to do their jobs, now fear they might lose them.

zh: 事实上，ECB在坚持自己的主张中所表现出来的勇气应该成为欧洲未来的政治家门的榜样。
en: Indeed, the courage currently demonstrated by the ECB in sticking to its guns should serve as a model for Europe’s future politicians.

zh: 一旦他们意识到他们不能威吓ECB进行不必要的自我消亡式的利率降低，欧盟领导人也许能鼓起领导的勇气 — — 这毕竟是他们被选举出来所要完成的任务。
en: Once they realize they can’t bully the ECB into unwanted and self-destructive interest rate cuts, EU leaders actually might summon up the will to lead—which is, after all, what they have been elected to do.

zh: 走上邪路的欧洲央行
en: The ECB Goes Rogue

zh: 发自蒂尔堡 — — 欧洲中央银行又故伎重施了。
en: TILBURG – The European Central Bank has done it again.

zh: 在其最近在法兰克福举行的会议上，欧洲央行理事会决定进一步增加债券采购规模，将额度由每月600 亿欧元（折合670 亿美元）提升到800 亿欧元，而且还可以购买公司债券。
en: At its recent meeting in Frankfurt, the ECB Governing Council decided to increase bond purchases further, from €60 billion ($67 billion) to €80 billion per month, with corporate bonds now also eligible for purchase.

zh: 存款利率也再次降低，目前为-0.4 % 。
en: The deposit rate, too, was reduced once again, and now stands at -0.4%.

zh: 这是可远远算不上是一个中性的政策 — — 也令欧洲央行大幅逾越了其维持货币稳定的职权范围。
en: This is far from a neutral policy – and it takes the ECB far beyond its mandate of preserving monetary stability.

zh: 最近这一系列政策举措背后的动机相当明确 ︰ 欧洲央行主席马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）致力于抑制严重威胁经济增长的通货紧缩状况。
en: The motivation behind the recent policy moves is clear: ECB President Mario Draghi is committed to curbing deflation, a serious threat to economic growth.

zh: 因为在通货紧缩的环境中偿付债务愈发艰难，所以企业会倾向于推迟投资。
en: After all, in a deflationary environment, it is more difficult to repay debt, so companies will tend to postpone investment.

zh: 最近欧盟统计局的数据显示，上个月的年度消费者价格指数下降了 0.2 % ， 引发外界高度关注。
en: Recent Eurostat figures, which show that the annual consumer-price index fell by 0.2% last month, heighten concerns.

zh: 但虽然当前情况属于技术性通货紧缩 — — 也就是，持续的价格水平下降，并可能在就业或其他合同上体现出来 — — 但并非结构性通缩。
en: But while what is happening is technically deflation – that is, sustained price-level decreases that may be reflected in employment or other contracts – it is not structural deflation.

zh: 相反，它很大程度上反映了自2014 年6月以来下跌了 70%以上的低油价影响。
en: Instead, it largely reflects low oil prices, which have fallen by more than 70% since June 2014.

zh: 事实上，如果剔除能源和食品价格，欧元区现正处于结构性低通胀的状况。
en: In fact, if we discard energy and food prices, the eurozone is in a situation of structural low inflation.

zh: 这与石油价格相结合应该在实际上有益于经济，因为它大幅推动了消费和投资。
en: That, together with the oil price, should actually benefit the economy, as it gives a boost to consumption and investment.

zh: 所以为何欧洲央行推行的大规模量化宽松计划 — — 将足量资金投入流通 — — 未能刺激对商品和服务的需求？
en: So why has the ECB’s massive quantitative easing (QE) program, which has put plenty of money into circulation, failed to stimulate demand for goods and services?

zh: 一个问题是银行不愿将负存款利率转化为储蓄利率，因为担心会流失储户。
en: One problem is that banks are reluctant to pass the negative deposit rate through to the savings rate, for fear of losing depositors.

zh: 因此，他们被迫进一步增加其向中小型企业抵押贷款和借款的利润率。
en: They are thus forced to increase further their margins on mortgages and loans to small and medium-size enterprises.

zh: 因此与量化宽松政策的目标背道而驰的是，银行给家庭和企业的贷款反而减少了。
en: As a result, contrary to the goal of QE, they are extending less credit to households and companies.

zh: 与此同时，银行、 家庭和中小型企业仍在高杠杆经营，并需要一段时间来偿还其债务。
en: Meanwhile, banks, households, and small and medium-size enterprises are still excessively leveraged, and need time to pay down their debts.

zh: 虽然这似乎暗示欧洲央行将重点放在提振通胀是正确的，但事实上债券购买计划的简单扩张忽略了困扰欧元区内部各弱势经济体的基础结构问题。
en: While this might seem to suggest that the ECB’s focus on boosting inflation is the right one, the reality is that a straightforward expansion of the bond-purchase program ignores the underlying structural issues afflicting the eurozone’s weaker economies.

zh: 更糟糕的是，通过允许这些经济体进行低息贷款，量化宽松政策令它们避免了实施艰难的结构性改革。
en: Worse, by enabling those economies to borrow cheaply, QE permits them to avoid implementing difficult structural reforms.

zh: 德拉吉和欧洲央行理事会内的鸽派 — — 即欧洲南部各国央行的行长们 — — 似乎认为，他们只需给一辆车加油就能让它跑起来，即便其离合器早已失灵。
en: Draghi and the doves on the ECB Governing Council – namely, the presidents of southern European countries’ central banks – seem to think that they can get a car moving simply by giving it more gas, even if its clutch is broken.

zh: 而在理事会中的鹰派如德意志银行总裁简斯·魏德曼(Jens Weidmann)以及荷兰中央银行行长克拉斯·克努特(Klaas Knot)看到了这个方法的愚蠢之处，无奈他们只是少数派。
en: The hawks in the ECB Governing Council, such as Bundesbank President Jens Weidmann and De Nederlandsche Bank President Klaas Knot, see the folly in this approach, but they are in the minority.

zh: 量化宽松政策之所以能有效刺激美国的经济增长，是因为它通过资本市场进行运作。
en: QE was effective in spurring economic growth in the United States, because it functioned via the capital market.

zh: 而欧洲缺乏允许资本账户实现重新平衡的统一资本市场，其政策通过银行贷款渠道生效，所以它膨胀 — — 并扭曲了 — — 债券和股票的价格。
en: But, in Europe, where there is no unified capital market to allow portfolios to rebalance, the policy works through the bank lending channel, so it inflates – and distorts – the prices of bonds and stocks.

zh: 更成问题的是，欧洲央行政策导致大量财富从经济更强势的北方欧元区国家 — — 德国、 芬兰和荷兰 — — 的储户 （包括退休人员） 转移到包括法国、 希腊、 意大利、 葡萄牙和西班牙在内的南部欧元区国家债务人身上。
en: More problematic, the ECB policy results in a substantial redistribution of wealth from savers (including retirees) in the stronger northern eurozone countries – namely, Germany, Finland, and the Netherlands – to the debtors in the southern eurozone countries, including France, Greece, Italy, Portugal, and Spain.

zh: 这种转移支付从就不是这一经济和货币联盟的特点，欧洲央行显然也不具备强制推动该联盟根本性变革的职权 — — 尤其是在这些变化只有利于一个国家集团的情况下。
en: Such transfers were never supposed to be a feature of the Economic and Monetary Union, and it is clearly not within the ECB’s mandate to force fundamental changes to the EMU system – especially if those changes favor one group of countries.

zh: 欧洲央行现行政策方针的问题极为严重的。
en: The problems with the ECB’s current policy approach are serious.

zh: 然而欧洲央行似乎致力于此 — — 尤其是因为量化宽松政策的受益者似乎要多于那些为之付账的人。
en: Yet the ECB seems committed to it – not least, it seems, because QE’s beneficiaries outnumber those who are footing the bill.

zh: 欧洲央行保持这怪异和不负责任政策的时间越长，车毁人亡的可能性就更大。
en: The longer the ECB keeps up this bizarre and irresponsible policy, the greater the chances that, when the car finally does get going, it will careen out of control.

zh: 不负责任的欧洲央行
en: The Irresponsible ECB

zh: 法兰克福—道琼斯工业平均指数最近“闪崩 ” ， 暴跌近1,600点，正说明金融市场和经济行为人是多么依赖扩张性货币政策。
en: FRANKFURT – The Dow Jones Industrial Average’s recent “flash crash,” in which it plunged by nearly 1,600 points, revealed just how addicted to expansionary monetary policy financial markets and economic actors have become.

zh: 长期低利率和量化宽松给投资者造成了不恰当地给风险定价的激励。
en: Prolonged low interest rates and quantitative easing have created incentives for investors to take inadequately priced risks.

zh: 这些政策保持时间越长，对全球金融稳定的威胁也越大。
en: The longer those policies are maintained, the bigger the threat to global financial stability.

zh: 事实上，极端宽松的货币政策早就不再合适了。
en: The fact is that ultra-loose monetary policy stopped being appropriate long ago.

zh: 全球经济 — — 特别是发达世界 — — 复苏之势越来越强。
en: The global economy – especially the developed world – has been experiencing an increasingly strong recovery.

zh: 据国际货币基金组织（IMF）的最新《市场经济展望 》 ， 经济增长将在未来几个季度中保持势头，特别是美国和欧元区。
en: According to the International Monetary Fund’s latest update of its World Economic Outlook, economic growth will continue in the next few quarters, especially in the United States and the eurozone.

zh: 但包括IMF在内的国际机构担心通胀和利率预期的变化会自然造成突发市场回调，同时坚持货币政策必须逐步收紧。
en: Yet international institutions, including the IMF, fear the sudden market corrections that naturally arise from changes in inflation or interest-rate expectations, and continue to argue that monetary policy must be tightened very slowly.

zh: 因此央行依然搁置货币政策正常化，结果是资产价格上涨，市场剧烈扭曲，大幅回调不可避免。
en: So central banks continue to postpone monetary-policy normalization, with the result that asset prices rise, producing dramatic market distortions that make those very corrections inevitable.

zh: 平心而论，美联储自2013年便已告别货币宽松，开始逐步减少、最终停止购买债券并缩减其资产负债表。
en: To be sure, the US Federal Reserve has moved away from monetary expansion since late 2013, when it began progressively reducing and ultimately halting bond purchases and shrinking its balance sheet.

zh: 自2015年年底以来，基准联邦基金利率已上升至1.5 % 。
en: Since the end of 2015, the benchmark federal funds rate has been raised to 1.5%.

zh: 但美联储的政策仍然远远算不上正常。
en: But the Fed’s policy is still far from normal.

zh: 在经济周期末期的情况下，名义增长预期超过4 % ， 失业保持低位 — — 更不用说已经出现过热风险 — — 美联储的行动已然落后。
en: Considering the advanced stage of the economic cycle, forecasts for nominal growth of more than 4%, and low unemployment – not to mention the risk of overheating – the Fed is behind the curve.

zh: 其他发达经济体央行仍处于极端风险模式中，表现还不如美联储。
en: Other advanced-economy central banks, still stuck in extreme crisis mode, are doing even worse.

zh: 日本银行和欧洲央行都没有表现出任何收紧货币政策的信号，尽管经济指标已与危机及随后欧元区的二次探底期间截然不同。
en: Neither the Bank of Japan nor the European Central Bank has provided any indication that it is set to tighten monetary policy, even though economic conditions today are totally different from those that prevailed during the crisis and subsequent double-dip recession in the eurozone.

zh: 特别是欧洲央行，以通缩风险感知和通胀低于预期为由保持低利率政策。
en: The ECB, in particular, defends its low-interest-rate policy by citing perceived deflationary risks or below-target inflation.

zh: 但真相是“坏”通缩的风险 — — 即自我强化的物价、工资和经济表现的向下螺旋 — — 从未在作为整体的欧元区出现。
en: But the truth is that the risk of a “bad” deflation – that is, a self-reinforcing downward spiral in prices, wages, and economic performance – has never existed for the eurozone as a whole.

zh: 2014年后，通胀急剧下降显然和能源和原材料价格的下跌有关。
en: It has been obvious since 2014 that the sharp reduction in inflation was linked to the decline in the prices of energy and raw materials.

zh: 简言之，欧洲央行不应该将低通胀视为持续甚至长期现象，视其为要求采取积极货币政策反应的条件。
en: In short, the ECB should not have regarded low inflation as a permanent or even long-term condition that demanded an aggressive monetary-policy response.

zh: 问题在于，欧洲央行官员过度注重通过满足短期通胀目标来确保物价稳定 — — 短期通胀被宽泛地定义为“低于但接近2 % ” ，具体而言，就是1.9 % 。
en: The problem is that ECB officials have become excessively focused on ensuring price stability by meeting a short-term inflation target, defined broadly as “below, but close to, 2%,” with the specific goal being 1.9%.

zh: 这与欧洲央行理事会在2003年对此前四年的货币政策进行了评估之后所确定的意图并不相符。
en: This is out of line with the intentions of the ECB’s Governing Council, as enunciated in 2003, after an evaluation of the previous four years of monetary policy.

zh: 当时，欧洲央行确认了其在1998年所认定的物价稳定定义，但澄清其目标是保持中期通胀目标，同时承认央行无法足够精确地控制通胀，无法指定具体的通胀率。
en: At that time, the ECB confirmed the definition of price stability it adopted in 1998, but clarified that it aims to maintain the inflation target over the medium term, while recognizing that a central bank cannot control inflation with enough precision to establish a specific rate.

zh: 欧洲央行的政策也和经济现实不相符：和全球经济大部一样，欧元区正在强劲复苏。
en: The ECB’s policy is also out of line with economic reality: the eurozone, like most of the rest of the global economy, is experiencing a strong recovery.

zh: 但欧洲央行可能将最近的股市波动视为它应该保持当前政策的证据。
en: Yet the ECB will probably view the recent stock-market turbulence as confirmation that it should maintain its current policies.

zh: 尽管欧洲央行理事会似乎认为扩张性政策对于支持GDP和就业增长以及遏制通缩仍然至关重要，但其实并非如此。
en: Although the Governing Council seems convinced that expansionary policies remain vital to support GDP and employment growth, and to keep deflation at bay, that seems unlikely.

zh: 事实上，如今这些政策对复苏的作用已能可靠地衡量，结论也许只是温和作用 — — 绝对不值2015年4月以来购买资产所花掉的2.3万亿欧元，更不用说为了保持零或负利率而造成的后果了。
en: Indeed, insofar as the impact of these policies on the recovery can be reliably measured, it is probably modest – definitely not worth the €2.3 trillion ($2.8 trillion) in assets purchased since April 2015, not to mention the other consequences of maintaining zero or negative interest rates.

zh: 这些后果之一是欧洲央行的政策利率失去了其指引方向和信号显示的作用。
en: One of those consequences is that the ECB’s policy interest rate has lost its steering and signaling functions.

zh: 另一个后果是风险不再能够恰当地得到定价，这导致资源配置失当、银行和公司僵尸化，从而延长了去杠杆化。
en: Another is that risks are no longer appropriately priced, leading to the misallocation of resources and zombification of banks and companies, which has delayed deleveraging.

zh: 第三个后果是债券市场被完全扭曲，高负债国家的财政整合无从推进。
en: Yet another is that bond markets are completely distorted, and fiscal consolidation in highly indebted countries has been postponed.

zh: 因此，欧洲央行政策的收益很难说，但成本不容置疑。
en: So the benefits of the ECB’s policy are questionable, and its costs indisputable.

zh: 欧洲央行的当前政策是极不负责任的，也没有任何改变政策的计划。
en: The current ECB policy is thus simply irresponsible, as is the utter lack of any plan for changing it.

zh: 从这个角度讲， 欧洲央行理事会有意或无意地遵循了诺贝尔经济学奖得主保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）所做的建议 — — 日本银行应该在名义利率已经为零、货币政策有可能失效的情况下“可信地承诺不负责任 ” 。
en: In this sense, the ECB’s Governing Council is, consciously or unconsciously, following the Nobel laureate economist Paul Krugman’s 1998 advice that the Bank of Japan “credibly promise to be irresponsible” when nominal interest rates are already at zero and monetary policy is in danger of becoming ineffective.

zh: 克鲁格曼说，央行应该通过持续货币扩张来引发通胀，从而降低真实利率。
en: The central bank, Krugman declared, should stoke inflation through ongoing monetary expansion, in order to reduce real interest rates.

zh: 几年前，克鲁格曼又重申了这一建议，他和美国前财长劳伦斯·萨默斯（Lawrence H. Summers）一起复活了“长期停滞”理论。
en: Krugman repeated this recommendation a few years ago, when he, along with former US Treasury Secretary Lawrence H. Summers, revived the theory of “secular stagnation.”

zh: 但该理论的讨论现在已经结束 — — 理应如此。
en: But discussion of that theory has now ended – and for good reason.

zh: 现在，欧洲央行的不负责任的货币政策也应该结束了。
en: It is time to end the ECB’s irresponsible expansionary policies as well.

zh: 如今，货币政策已经变成了次级财政政策，央行面临越来越严重的政治压力人为压低利率。
en: Today, monetary policy has become subordinate to fiscal policy, with central banks facing intensifying political pressure to keep interest rates artificially low.

zh: 最近的股市动荡表明，这极大地提高了金融动荡风险。
en: As the recent stock-market turmoil shows, this is drastically increasing the risk of financial instability.

zh: 当更多更严重的市场回调不断发生、甚至影响到实体经济时，央行还有什么工具可用？
en: When more – and more severe – market corrections take place, possibly affecting the real economy, what tools will central banks have left to deploy?

zh: 欧洲央行尽职了吗？
en: Is the ECB Doing Enough?

zh: 发自法兰克福 — — 二战后德国首任总理康拉德·阿登纳（Konrad Adenauer）曾说过一句名言 ： “ 为什么我要为昨天说过的话负责？
en: FRANKFURT – Konrad Adenauer, Germany’s first chancellor after World War II, famously said: “Why should I care about the things I said yesterday?”

zh: ”意思是事情发展的速度往往会超出我们的理解能力。
en: What he meant was that events can sometimes unfold at a speed that outpaces our ability to understand them.

zh: 因此随着2014年即将落下帷幕，也值得让我们去扪心自问，以事后检讨的方式来反思 ： “ 在面对众多威胁之时，我们这些欧洲中央银行的管理者们是否能像我们所被授予的任命那样，采取了足够迅速的行动去维持价格稳定？
en: So, as 2014 winds down, it is worth asking ourselves, with the benefit of hindsight: Have we at the European Central Bank reacted swiftly enough to maintain price stability in the face of threats, as our mandate requires?

zh: ”而答案在我看来，是肯定的。
en: I think the answer is yes.

zh: 我们注意到我们的货币政策对对私人借贷的影响已经不再像过去那样有效。
en: We noticed that our monetary policy was no longer having the effect on private borrowing costs to which we were accustomed.

zh: 很显然银行系统内部的各条贷款渠道已经变得紊乱；过度严苛的贷款条件正在压抑需求。
en: It was obvious that the lending channels in the banking system had become dysfunctional; excessively restrictive borrowing conditions were suppressing demand.

zh: 对此欧洲央行做出了跟其他任何央行一样的回应：我们重新梳理了自身货币政策和借贷成本之间的关系，务求将家庭和企业所承担的平均贷款利率压下来。
en: In response, the ECB did precisely what any central bank would have done: we acted to restore the relationship between our monetary policy and the cost of borrowing, aiming to bring down the average rate that households and firms have to pay.

zh: 在六月的时候，我们采取了一系列定向长期再融资操作（简称TLTROs ） ， 为各银行提供最长达4年的固定利率超低息融资。
en: In June, we introduced a series of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (known as TLTROs) to provide funding for banks at very low fixed rates for a period of up to four years.

zh: 这是为了让银行可以随之纾缓贷款者所承担的压力。
en: The TLTROs were designed to maximize the chances that banks would pass on the funding relief to borrowers.

zh: 而另一个收购有资产担保股票/债券的项目则是为了进一步促进更低利率融资从银行到消费者的转移而专门设计。
en: Our programs to purchase asset-backed securities and covered bonds were tailored to help lubricate further the transmission of lower funding costs from banks to customers.

zh: 上述手段结合在一起，为解决银行贷款错位问题的根源因素做出了有力的回应，并因此令新的信贷流更快地流向实体经济。
en: Together, these measures offer a powerful response that addresses the root causes of impaired bank lending, thereby facilitating new credit flows to the real economy.

zh: 同时有初步证据表明这些措施都为欧元区经济带来一些前期实质性利好。
en: And tentative evidence suggests that they are delivering some initial tangible benefits to the euro area’s economy.

zh: 与此同时通胀也持续走低。
en: At the same time, inflation has continued trending down.

zh: 在11月，由于原油价格自夏季末期一路暴跌，欧元区年度通胀率下跌到了周期性低点0.3 % 。
en: In November, annual inflation in the euro area fell to a cyclical low of 0.3%, largely owing to the sharp fall in oil prices since the end of the summer.

zh: 但核心通胀（排除较多变动的能源和食品价格）的下降也意味着总需求疲软。
en: But falling core inflation (which excludes volatile energy and food prices) also points to weak aggregate demand.

zh: 事实上欧洲央行最新发布的一份机构预测中也大幅调低了对宏观经济发展的预测。
en: And, indeed, the ECB’s latest staff projections entail a notable downgrading of the macroeconomic outlook.

zh: 油价下跌和低通胀期延长的展望似乎也影响到了通胀预期。
en: Falling oil prices and the prospect of a prolonged period of low inflation also seem to have affected inflation expectations.

zh: 考虑到最近油价动荡的影响，风险在于通胀可能会在未来几个月临时滑入负值区间。
en: Given the potency of the recent oil-price shock, the risk is that inflation may temporarily slip into negative territory in the coming months.

zh: 一般来说，央行会欢迎一个正面的供应井喷。
en: Normally, any central bank would welcome a positive supply shock.

zh: 毕竟低油价会推高实际收入并可能推动未来产量提升。
en: After all, lower oil prices boost real incomes and may lead to higher output in the future.

zh: 但这还不是庆祝的时候，毕竟要实现中期价格稳定就得有稳定挂钩的通胀预期，而货币政策正是要应对这种脱钩风险。
en: But we may not be able to celebrate. After all, because well-anchored inflation expectations are indispensable for medium-term price stability, monetary policy must respond to a risk of de-anchoring.

zh: 这也是为何欧洲央行管理委员会反复重申，一致承诺要在自身委任权限内动用额外的非常规工具来在必要时应对低通胀期延长，或是货币刺激手段无法完成令我们（欧洲）的资产负债表向2012年初规模靠拢的情况。
en: That is why the ECB Governing Council has reiterated its unanimous commitment to use additional unconventional instruments within its mandate should it become necessary to address a prolonged period of low inflation, or should the monetary stimulus fall short of our intention to move our balance sheet toward its size in early 2012.

zh: 这或许意味着把我们明年年初手段的范围，路径和构成进行转换，而欧洲央行和各国央行的人对此也已经升级了技术准备，因此一旦有需要，进一步的措施就能及时实施。
en: This would imply altering the scope, pace and composition of our measures early next year, and staff from the ECB and national central banks have stepped up technical preparations for further measures, if needed, with a view to implementing them in a timely manner.

zh: 如果我们觉得经济需要进一步刺激，其中一个选项会是将欧洲央行的直接资产采购扩大到其他资产门类。
en: If we were to judge that the economy is in need of further stimulus, one option could be to extend the ECB’s outright asset purchases to other asset classes.

zh: 但一定要记住资产采购本身并不是目的。
en: But it is important to remember that asset purchases are not an end in themselves.

zh: 它们是货币政策的一项工具，而非目标。
en: They are an instrument, not a target, of monetary policy.

zh: 一个选择额外措施的重要条件应该是它们对私营经济宏观融资条件的影响力。
en: An important criterion for the choice of additional measures should be the extent of their influence over broad financing conditions in the private economy.

zh: 比如说，购买由欧元区非金融机构发行的债券或许会对企业的融资成本产生某种直接的传递效应。
en: For example, purchases of bonds issued by euro-area non-financial corporations (NFCs) would probably have some direct pass-through effect on firms’ financing costs.

zh: 但相比于其他资产门类，这类债券的市场还相对薄弱。
en: But, compared to other asset classes, the market for NFC bonds is relatively thin.

zh: 如果买的是欧元区国家发行的主权债券 — — 唯一一个规模不是问题的市场，那就是另一回事了。
en: It would be a different matter if we were to decide to buy bonds issued by euro-area sovereigns – the only market where size would generally not be an issue.

zh: 对这一市场的介入或会发出一个强烈信号：欧洲央行会把宽松型的货币政策继续维持一段时间。
en: Interventions in this market would likely entail a stronger signal that the ECB is committed to maintaining an accommodative monetary policy for an extended period of time.

zh: 而干涉手段对主权债券市场的效力 — — 也就是它们进一步降低家庭和企业借贷成本的能力 — — 也取决于银行部门所处的状态。
en: The effectiveness of interventions in the sovereign-bond market – that is, their ability to lower the borrowing costs of households and firms further – will also rest on the state of the banking sector.

zh: 更高的资本储备金率，更低的坏账风险，更透明的资产负债表将增加欧洲央行量化刺激手段传导到更广大经济范围的机会。
en: Higher capital ratios, lower exposure to bad loans, and more transparent balance sheets increase the chances that the ECB’s quantitative impulses will be transmitted to the wider economy.

zh: 这也是为何欧洲央行对各银行资产负债表的综合评估和全欧银行监督计划的启动能有助于活化欧元区的不良贷款。
en: That is why the completion of the ECB’s comprehensive assessment of banks’ balance sheets and the start of Europe-wide banking supervision will help revitalize sluggish lending in the euro area.

zh: 尤其是银行资产负债表的不断明晰和透明，加上资本更充足的银行部门，将创造一个更有益处的贷款环境。
en: In particular, increased clarity and transparency about banks’ balance sheets, together with a better-capitalized banking sector, will create a more supportive lending environment.

zh: 但一个购买主权债券的决定也必须构建和融合于欧元区的制度特殊性，包括《欧盟条约》设下的限定条件。
en: But a decision to purchase sovereign bonds would also need to build on and factor in the institutional specificities of the euro area, including the limits set by the EU Treaty.

zh: 我们也极为严肃认真地对待这些限制。
en: We take these limits very seriously.

zh: 未来的一年将充满着挑战和不确定性。
en: The year ahead will be challenging and rife with uncertainty.

zh: 但如果说往事能给我们任何教益的话，那就是如果我们完成自身被委任使命的能力变得岌岌可危，那么我们就会毫不犹豫地行动。 ·
en: But if the past holds any lesson, it is that, if our ability to fulfill our mandate is at risk, we will not hesitate to act.

zh: 新哲学家
en: The New Philosophers

zh: 普林斯顿—在最近的澳大利亚二十国集团财长会议上，美国财政部长杰克·卢指出“与我们的一些欧洲朋友之间存在哲学差异 ， ” 接着敦促欧洲花更大力气提振其长期萎靡不振的增长率。
en: PRINCETON – At the recent meeting of G-20 finance ministers in Australia, US Treasury Secretary Jack Lew noted “philosophical differences with some of our friends in Europe,” before urging Europeans to do more to boost their anemic growth rate.

zh: 如此用词令人震惊，也凸显出欧洲探寻走出经济萎靡之路的艰难。
en: The terminology is striking, and underscores the difficulty of Europe’s search for a way out of its current malaise.

zh: 加拿大财政部长乔·奥利佛（Joe Oliver）也加入了要求欧洲财政扩张的行列 — — 欧洲央行内部似乎也有一些人支持这一立场。
en: Canada’s finance minister, Joe Oliver, joined the call for fiscal expansion in Europe – a position for which there seems to be some support within the European Central Bank.

zh: 事实上，欧洲央行行长马里奥·德拉吉支持依靠德国等财政较坚挺的国家提高支出。
en: Indeed, ECB President Mario Draghi has advocated higher spending by more fiscally strong countries like Germany.

zh: 欧洲央行执行委员会委员贝努特·寇尔（Benoit Coeure）及其前同事、现德国劳动部副部长耶格·阿斯缪森（Jörg Asmussen）最近指出，德国应该“利用其现有空间采取措施促进投资、降低工人的税收负担。 ”
en: And ECB Executive Board member Benoit Coeure, together with his former colleague Jörg Asmussen, currently Germany’s deputy labor minister, recently suggested that Germany should “use its available room for maneuver to promote investments and reduce the tax burden of workers.”

zh: 事实上，世界上大部分人认为德国应该采取更为扩张的财政政策。
en: In fact, most of the world believes that Germany should adopt a more expansive fiscal policy.

zh: 根据这一观点，紧缩是反生产的，因为它带来了让长期财政整合更加困难的减速和衰退。
en: According to this view, austerity is counter-productive, because it induces slowdowns and recessions that make long-term fiscal consolidation more difficult.

zh: 但德国人 — — 以及一些其他北欧国家的人，可能还有一些中国经济学家 — — 仍有所保留。
en: But Germans – as well as some other Northern Europeans, and perhaps some Chinese economists – remain reticent.

zh: 他们认为响应刺激要求只能导致更多的刺激要求，形成一个彼此强化的分肥动态，一切财政整合观点都会被排除在外。
en: They believe that responding to calls for stimulus would simply lead to more such calls, creating a log-rolling, pork-barrel dynamic in which any hope for fiscal consolidation is ruled out.

zh: 刺激与紧缩之争由来已久。
en: The stimulus-versus-austerity debate is an old one.

zh: 20世纪七八十年代，美国时不时要求德国和日本要充当全球经济的火车头。
en: In the 1970s and 1980s, the United States regularly called on Germany and Japan to act as locomotives for the global economy.

zh: 但是，直到最近，这一分歧都是从利益而非“哲学”角度出发的。
en: But, until recently, the divergences were viewed in terms of interests, not “philosophies.”

zh: 美国人希望为其商品创造更高需求和更高价格；而德国人和日本人想捍卫出口行业。
en: Americans wanted additional demand for their goods and higher prices, while the Germans and Japanese defended their export industries.

zh: 正如卢的最近讲话所表明的，今天的问题来自对立双方信念体系的根深蒂固的分歧，关于公平和责任的意识形态问题压倒了关于什么是对所有人最好的前进道路的务实讨论。
en: The problem today, as Lew’s recent statement highlighted, stems from deeply entrenched differences between the opposing sides’ belief systems, with ideological questions about fairness and responsibility trumping pragmatic discussion of the best way forward for everyone.

zh: 历史学家罗伯特·卡甘（Robert Kagan）在2002年指出，美国人和欧洲人不但世界观不同；所处的世界也完全不一样。
en: As the historian Robert Kagan argued in 2002, Americans and Europeans do not only have different worldviews; they occupy entirely different worlds.

zh: 哲学差异极难调和。
en: Philosophical differences are extremely difficult to reconcile.

zh: 柏拉图学派和亚里士多德学派斗争了上千年，康德学派和功利主义学派也针锋相对了几百年。
en: Just as Platonists and Aristotelians struggled against one another for millennia, Kantians and utilitarians have been at one another’s throats for centuries.

zh: 如此深刻的理论冲突会产生现实世界后果，它们阻碍危机局面下的建设性争论和合作行动。
en: Such deep theoretical conflicts have real-world consequences, as they impede constructive debate and cooperative action in crisis situations.

zh: 对2003年伊拉克战争的根本性意识形态分歧影响了十多年来的全球政治。
en: Fundamental ideological divisions over the 2003 Iraq war have strained global politics for more than a decade.

zh: 现代政治进程和结构十分不利于协调 — — 更不用说和解了 — — 哲学争议。
en: Modern political processes and structures are simply not well suited for conducting – much less settling – philosophical disputes.

zh: 民主制度的产生就是为了让竞争的各利益方达成交易，议会就是专门用来寻找正确的让步组合以便在总体可接受的方案上形成一致。
en: Democratic institutions are designed for making deals between competing interests, with parliaments specializing in finding the right combination of concessions to enable agreement on a generally accepted solution.

zh: 类似地，二十国集团等国际论坛之所以存在，也正是为了说服大量截然不同的国家为了共同的经济、政治或安全利益而将哲学问题抛在一边。
en: Likewise, international forums like the G-20 exist precisely to persuade a large number of vastly different countries to set aside philosophical questions for the sake of their shared economic, political, or security interests.

zh: 哲学并不只是在这里或那里稍稍退让几步，对难点进行模糊化处理以使最后一切都能通过。
en: Philosophies do not just give a little here and there, blurring over the difficult bits in the hope that everything will work out in the end.

zh: 你可以想象一下要求康德学派给绝对命令（categorical imperative）添加一点功利主义。
en: Imagine asking a Kantian to add just a bit of utilitarian calculation to the categorical imperative.

zh: 当然，解决哲学争论也不是不可能的。
en: Of course, resolving a philosophical debate is not impossible.

zh: 通过正式辩论克服这些困难是前现代的标准做法。
en: It was standard pre-modern practice to overcome such differences with a formal disputation.

zh: 在十六世纪初，德国贵族试图解决新教改革家带来的哲学挑战，他们的办法是把马丁·路德请进争论，与最著名的正统天主教神学家约翰·艾克（Johannes Eck）辩论。
en: In the early sixteenth century, the German princes attempted to settle the philosophical challenge presented by Protestant reformers by engaging Martin Luther to debate a prominent orthodox Catholic theologian, Johannes Eck.

zh: 这种办法在现代难以看到踪迹，但1944年联合国布雷顿森林货币和金融会议庶几接近于此。
en: There are not that many modern varieties of this sort of practice, but the 1944 United Nations Monetary and Financial Conference at Bretton Woods comes close.

zh: 通过系统性地引入与建立可行国际体系相关的经济问题，专家们创立��一个新的全球经济和政治秩序。
en: By systemically engaging with the economic issues involved in building a viable international system, experts created a new global economic and political order.

zh: 从某种程度上讲，中央银行已开始模仿中世纪哲学学派，用讨论而不仅是政策本身解决作为政策决定基础的问题。
en: In a sense, central banks have begun to resemble medieval philosophical faculties, with discussions addressing the issues underlying policy decisions, rather than just the policies themselves.

zh: 比如，欧洲央行正在展开争论以决定在何种条件下偏离财政正统或许有利于长期稳定。
en: In the ECB, for example, a debate is underway to determine under which conditions deviation from fiscal orthodoxy might be stabilizing in the long term.

zh: 这一争论如何收场可能会决定一种新型的国际合作。
en: How that debate is resolved could lead to a new kind of international cooperation.

zh: 如今，大西洋两岸的政策进程都陷入了停滞，美联储和欧洲央行已经实施了一系列政策创新，寻找可以促进和保持经济复苏的办法。
en: At a time when political processes are stalled on both sides of the Atlantic, the US Federal Reserve and the ECB have been engaging in a series of policy innovations, feeling their way toward a solution that could promote and sustain economic recovery.

zh: 在此基础上，欧洲央行正在重塑自己的身份，试图成为新思想和哲学综合的催化器。
en: On this basis, the ECB is recasting itself as the incubator of a new intellectual and philosophical synthesis.

zh: 但中央银行的最高政策真理仲裁者的新角色充满了风险。
en: But central banks’ new role as supreme arbiters of policy truth is fraught with hazard.

zh: 由于从它们的纠纷和分析中产生的解决方案是技术官僚 — — 而非民主 — — 进程的产物，因此可能引起民粹主义者的抵制。
en: Given that the solutions that emerge from their disputations and analyses will be the product of technocratic – not democratic – processes, they are likely to trigger populist backlashes.

zh: 此外，中央银行所产生的政策方针可能太过复杂，彼此联系太深，无法有效运行。
en: Moreover, the policy approaches that central banks produce may be too complex and interlinked to function efficiently.

zh: 特别是，让扩张性政策取决于一系列微观经济改革的实施的做法颇有问题。
en: In particular, the attempt to make expansionary policies conditional on the implementation of a host of microeconomic reforms is problematic.

zh: 要是将财政退路和结构性改革的复杂关系中只实现了一部分，其结果可能令人失望 — — 甚至令生产倒退。
en: If only some parts of a complex package linking fiscal leeway with structural reform are realized, the outcome is likely to disappoint – or even prove counterproductive.

zh: 到那时，旧哲学争论可能会卷土重来。
en: When it does, the old philosophical divisions are likely to resurface.

zh: 是时候为欧洲央行松绑了
en: Time to Untie the ECB’s Hands

zh: 发自苏黎世 — — 欧洲央行最近宣布将在今年12月结束资产购买，这显示出它对自身实现价格稳定的能力充满信心。
en: ZURICH – The European Central Bank’s recent announcement that it will try to end asset purchases by this December means that it has confidence in its ability to achieve price stability.

zh: 但那些认为价格稳定应该成为欧洲央行单一且压倒一切的政策目标的人或许会搬了石头砸自己的脚，尤其是在否定政策制定者所急需的灵活性的情况下。
en: But those who decided that price stability should be the ECB’s single, overriding policy goal may have shot themselves in the foot, not least by denying policymakers much-needed flexibility.

zh: 欧洲央行将价格稳定定义为通胀“在中期内低于但接近2 ％ 。
en: The ECB defines price stability as inflation “below, but close to, 2% over the medium term.”

zh: ”这甚至比德国央行在引入欧元之前那段光辉历史中所取得的通胀率还低一点，又实际上比全部其他央行所追求的目标更为严苛。
en: That is a lower inflation rate than even the Bundesbank achieved during its celebrated pre-euro history, and it is a tighter target than virtually all other central banks pursue.

zh: 对于一些鱼与熊掌都想兼得的人来说，这显然是件美事。
en: For some, too much of a good thing is apparently wonderful.

zh: 无可否认，在全球金融危机和采用量化宽松政策期间 — — 当时通胀率远低于2 ％ — —欧洲央行的这一价格稳定定义毫无问题。
en: To be sure, the ECB’s definition of price stability was not a problem during the period between the global financial crisis and the adoption of quantitative easing, when inflation was well below 2%.

zh: 对那些认为货币政策过度从紧的人来说，欧洲央行采取的任何可能将通胀推向目标区间的做法都是正确的。
en: To those who believed that monetary policy had been too tight, the ECB was right to do whatever it could to push inflation up toward the target range.

zh: 但对于那些支持欧洲央行“以稳定为导向的货币政策 ” （ 这个词暗示其他人无视货币不稳定风险）的人来说，价格稳定目标显然已经变得过于局限。
en: Yet for those in favor of the ECB’s “stability-oriented monetary policy” – a term suggesting that others disregard the risk of monetary instability – the price-stability objective has evidently become too constraining.

zh: 从他们的角度看来，尽管欧元区的通胀率过低，但资产购买行为从来都不应该发生，而且早在很久以前就该提高利率了。
en: From their perspective, asset purchases never should have happened, and interest rates should have been raised long ago, despite the eurozone’s too-low rate of inflation.

zh: 可以肯定的是，那些持这种观点的人都会非常支持欧洲央行的强硬价格稳定目标。
en: It is safe to assume that those who hold this view were highly supportive of the ECB’s hardline price-stability objective.

zh: 他们会声称低利率会引发随着时间的推移而变得日益尖锐的金融稳定风险。
en: They would contend that low interest rates raise financial-stability risks that grow more acute with time. That is probably true.

zh: 这或许是真的，然而它忽略了过早提高利率也会加剧金融不稳定的事实。
en: And yet it ignores the fact that raising interest rates prematurely can also fuel financial instability.

zh: 无论如何，这个论点没有什么实际意义，因为欧洲央行所接受的政治授权本身就排除了任何可能与价格稳定相冲突的加息行为。
en: In any case, the argument is moot, because the ECB’s mandate rules out any rate increase that could conflict with price stability.

zh: 当然，那些支持更高利率的人会反驳说1％甚至更低的通胀实际上也“接近”2 ％ ， 意味着价格稳定已经实现，货币政策也可以随之收紧了。
en: Of course, those in favor of higher interest rates would counter that inflation of 1% or even less is in fact “close” to 2%, implying that price stability has been achieved and monetary policy can be tightened.

zh: 换句话说，他们并不认为“接近2 ％ ” 应该是处于1.7~1.9％的范围内。
en: In other words, they do not share the view that “close to 2%” means something in the range of 1.7-1.9%.

zh: 但这个论点是有害无益的。
en: But this is a pernicious argument.

zh: 持续维持低于债务人预期水平的通胀会最终转化为较高的实际利率，这反过来又可能引发贷款者（包括抵押人，企业和政府）的违约。
en: Running inflation below the level debtors had reason to expect translates into high real interest rates, which in turn risks triggering defaults among borrowers, including mortgagors, firms, and governments.

zh: 而低于通胀目标也很危险的，因为通胀预期和利率将随着时间而下跌，这使得欧洲央行更有可能在下一次经济衰退时将利率调至零下限。
en: Undershooting the inflation target is also dangerous because inflation expectations and interest rates will decline over time, which makes it more likely that the ECB will reach the zero lower bound when the next downturn occurs.

zh: 此外它还增加了使资产购买再次成为必要的可能性。
en: It also increases the likelihood that asset purchases will become necessary once again.

zh: 那些支持收紧政策的人也会注意到对于储蓄者，保险公司和养老基金来说低利率是有问题的，因为它们投资组合中的股票比例通常较低。
en: Those in favor of a policy tightening would also note that low rates are problematic for savers, insurance companies, and pension funds, whose portfolios often include few equities.

zh: 但欧洲央行的政治授权也并没有说货币政策必须照顾到储户或金融业的利益。
en: But nowhere does the ECB’s mandate say that monetary policy should be set in the interest of savers or the financial industry.

zh: 实际看来，最初旨在保护欧元区免受意大利式通胀影响的欧洲央行价格稳定目标最终使其免受了德国主导型通缩的影响。
en: As a practical matter, the ECB’s price-stability objective, originally designed to protect the eurozone from Italian-style inflation, has ended up protecting it from German-inspired deflation.

zh: 但虽然欧洲央行的政治授权迫使它不时会做些正确的事情，却并不意味着我们将来也会如此幸运。
en: But just because the ECB’s mandate has forced it to do the right thing on occasion does not mean that we will be so lucky in the future.

zh: 全球金融危机要求发达经济体的央行应对那些制定其政治授权的人所几乎无法想象的状况。
en: The global financial crisis required advanced economies’ central banks to contend with circumstances that those who crafted their mandates scarcely could have imagined.

zh: 但事实上事情往往无法如预期般推进，而这也正是为何在制定央行的目标时应该为政策制定者在极端事件发生时留出灵活性 — — 或者是违反规则的高度抽象性许可。
en: The fact that things often do not work out as expected is precisely why central banks’ objectives should be written to give policymakers flexibility – or poetic license to bend the rules – when extreme events occur.

zh: 如果不这样的话，政策制定者就会变得比理想状况下更为低效。
en: Otherwise, policymakers will be less effective than they otherwise could be.

zh: 由于欧洲央行在价格稳定方面的政治授权是由《欧洲联盟运作条约》固定为法律，因此只有条约修正案才能对其做出改变。
en: Because the ECB’s price-stability mandate is legally codified by the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, it cannot be altered without a treaty amendment.

zh: 但是“低于但接近2 ％ ” 这个短语是欧洲央行自己的发明，因此只需大笔一挥就能进行修改。
en: But the phrase “below, but close to, 2%” is the ECB’s own, and thus can be changed with the stroke of a pen.

zh: 因此，欧洲央行应考虑两项改动。
en: As such, the ECB should consider two alterations.

zh: 首先，它应该摆脱“接近”这个词所固有的模糊性，通过设定一个目标来向公众 — — 以及各欧洲央行管理委员会成员 — — 明确其货币政策目标。
en: First, it should get rid of the ambiguity inherent in the words “close to,” by setting a point target to provide clarity to the public – and to ECB Governing Council members – about what its monetary policy aims to achieve.

zh: 无论该目标是1.8 ％ 、 2％还是某个范围都不太重要。
en: Whether that target is 1.8% or 2%, or whether it is surrounded by a range, is less important.

zh: 其次，欧洲央行必须澄清金融稳定性和商业状况是如何影响其政策决策的。
en: Second, the ECB must clarify how financial stability and business conditions factor into its policy decisions.

zh: 许多人认为通过精确定义“中期”来延长政策范围将使决策者有空间去暂时追求其他目标。
en: Many have argued that lengthening the policy horizon by precisely defining “the medium term” would give policymakers room to pursue other objectives temporarily.

zh: 毕竟金融危机和深度衰退都是通缩式的，因此也会危及价格稳定。
en: After all, because financial crises and deep recessions are deflationary, they, too, jeopardize price stability.

zh: 随着欧洲央行最终退出上次危机，现在正是思考它已经（或应该）学到什么教训的好时机。
en: With the ECB finally exiting the last crisis, now is a good time to reflect on what lessons it has (or should have) learned.

zh: 欧洲央行也应未雨绸缪，为下一次经济衰退早做准备。
en: The ECB must not delay in positioning itself for the next downturn.

zh: 欧洲央行的错误武器
en: The ECB’s Faulty Weapon

zh: 布鲁塞尔— 欧元区通货膨胀难以摆脱下降之势，这给欧洲央行造成了极大的压力，它必须得做“一些事”防止日益严重的通缩。
en: BRUSSELS – With inflation in the eurozone stubbornly remaining on a downward trajectory, pressure on the European Central Bank to do “something” to prevent outright deflation is growing.

zh: “这些事”常常被理解为大规模资产购买，或曰量化宽松（QE ） 。
en: This “something” is usually understood to be massive asset purchases, or quantitative easing (QE).

zh: 但QE真能成功吗？
en: But would QE actually do the trick?

zh: 不难预测，这一讨论目前又陷入了国家模式：债权国不反对通缩，因为这增加了它们的投资的价值；而债务国的偿债负担会日益沉重。
en: The discussion has so far followed easily predictable national patterns: Creditor countries do not object to deflation, because it increases the real value of their investment, whereas debtor countries’ repayment burdens would grow heavier.

zh: 在封闭经济中，每一笔债权都必须存在相应的债务。
en: In a closed economy, to every credit there must a corresponding debt.

zh: 但考虑个体国家：一些国家存在巨大的外债，而另一些维持着巨大的债权。
en: But consider individual countries: some run a large foreign debt, while others maintain a large creditor position.

zh: 美国和德国是债权-债务对立的两大极端。
en: The United States and Germany are at opposite extremes of the creditor-debtor scale.

zh: 美国受益于用本国货币发行债务的“过度特权 ” ， 30多年来维持着巨大的经常项目赤字。
en: The US, benefiting from the “exorbitant privilege” of issuing debt denominated in its own currency, has run current-account deficits for more than 30 years.

zh: 美国居民的总外债（大部分用美元计价）超过7万亿美元。
en: The total foreign debt of US residents (most of which is in US dollars) is above $7 trillion.

zh: 这意味着美国的每一次降息都会让整个国家相对于债权国（如德国，其利息收入会随之下降）获益。
en: This implies that any reduction in US interest rates would benefit the country as whole, relative to creditor countries, like Germany, where interest income would fall.

zh: 在欧元区内部，直到最近其外部账户都保持接近平衡的状态，最近则出现了类似的债权国/债务国问题，德国和荷兰处于一端，大部分欧元区南部国家处于另一端。
en: Within the eurozone, where until recently external accounts were nearly balanced, a similar creditor/debtor spectrum has emerged, with Germany and the Netherlands at one end, and much of the eurozone south at the other.

zh: 这部分解释了德国财经媒体对QE的敌对立场，而过度负债的外围国声嘶力竭地呼吁欧洲央行采取更多行动。
en: This partly explains both the hostile stance toward QE adopted in the German financial press and the over-indebted periphery countries’ increasingly desperate calls for more action by the ECB.

zh: 但是，在欧元区，用QE响应这一呼吁大有问题。
en: In the eurozone, however, QE is a questionable response to such calls.

zh: QE是一种特殊工具，在央行短期和中期政策利率已经接近于零并且希望降低长期利率时使用。
en: QE is a special instrument used when a central bank’s short- and medium-term policy rates are already at zero and it wants to lower long-term interest rates.

zh: 这意味着QE只有在长期（市场）利率变化对私人部门影响的重大的经济中才有效。
en: This implies that QE can be effective only in economies in which changes in long-term (market) interest rates play an important role in the private sector.

zh: 但欧洲并非如此。 在欧洲，大部分投资通过银行贷款融资，这些贷款通常期限并不长 — — 往往小于五年 — — 因为银行本身没有多少可靠的长期资金源。
en: But this is not the case in Europe, where most investment is financed via bank loans that typically do not have long-term maturities – often less than five years – because banks themselves have little secure long-term financing.

zh: 此外，这些贷款的利率并不与市场利率挂钩，而是与银行的再融资成本（已经接近于零）挂钩。
en: Moreover, the interests rates charged on these loans are not linked to market rates, but rather to the bank’s refinancing cost, which is already close to zero.

zh: 因此，在欧元区，更低的政府债券长期利率无法改善公私部门的融资条件并提振投资需求。
en: In the eurozone, lower long-term rates for government bonds are thus unlikely to improve the corporate sector’s financing conditions and boost investment demand.

zh: 相反，在美国，用发行债券给投资融资的比例要高得多，而债券的期限比银行贷款更长。
en: By contrast, in the US, a much larger proportion of investment is financed by issuing bonds, which can have a longer maturity than bank loans.

zh: 此外，这些债券都用与政府债券收益率曲线的利差定价，这意味着QE对公司融资成本具有立竿见影的效果。
en: Moreover, these bonds are priced as spreads on the government-bond yield curve, implying that QE will have an immediate impact on enterprises’ financing costs.

zh: 对家庭而言，降低利率的主要影响通过按揭被感受到。
en: For households, the main impact of lower interest rates is felt through mortgages.

zh: 但南欧大部主要依靠浮动利率。
en: But most of southern Europe relies mainly on floating rates.

zh: 这意味着QE不会触及（比如）西班牙家庭，因为他们的按揭与已接近于零的短期利率挂钩。
en: This implies that QE would not reach, say, Spanish households, whose mortgages are indexed to short-term rates, which are already close to zero.

zh: 在美国，当利率下降时，家庭可以有还款选择。
en: In the US, households have a prepayment option on their mortgages should interest rates fall.

zh: 此外，按揭往往都被证券化，这意味着按揭包（bundles of mortgages）可在市场上售出的利率的下降对家庭支出具有重大影响，因为下降的长期利率常常会造成按揭再融资波动，降低家庭月供，从而提高可支配收��。
en: Moreover, mortgages are usually securitized. This implies that a fall in the rate at which bundles of mortgages can be sold on the market can have a strong impact on household spending, because lower long-term rates typically lead to waves of mortgage refinancing, leaving households with lower monthly payments – and thus higher disposable income.

zh: 当中央银行大量购买债券时，所有资产（包括房产）价格都倾向于上涨。
en: When the central bank buys large amounts of bonds, all asset prices, including housing, tend to increase.

zh: 在这方面，高房价刺激消费的美国同样对欧洲起着误导作用。
en: Here, too, the US, where higher house prices stimulate consumption, is a misleading example for Europe.

zh: 在美国，屋主自住率很高，金融体系让家庭可以相对廉价地获得自家房子的权益，可以通过第二留置权（second liens ） ， 也可以通过再融资全部按揭。
en: Owner occupancy rates are high in the US, and the financial system allows households to extract the equity in their homes relatively cheaply, either by second liens or by refinancing the entire mortgage.

zh: 这在大部分欧洲国家都不可行，特别是在德国。 德国的贷款/房价比限制相当保守，再融资成本很高，并且大部分银行会拒绝任何试图通过将“房屋权益”套现筹钱度假或买新车的行为。
en: This is not possible in most of Europe, and especially not in Germany, where loan-to-value limits remain conservative, refinancing is costly, and most banks would frown on any attempt to cash in on “home equity” to finance a vacation or a new car.

zh: 此外，较高的房价和房租使收入从贫穷家庭（往往租房）向富有家庭（拥有自己的房子）转移。
en: Moreover, higher house prices and rents distribute income from poorer households (which typically rent) to richer households (which own the houses).

zh: 但穷人的消费倾向比富人高得多。
en: But the poor have a much higher propensity to spend than the rich.

zh: 租户之国的房地产繁荣实际上可能带来总需求下降。
en: A housing boom in a nation of renters might actually lead to lower aggregate consumption.

zh: 因此，金融结构的差异严重影响着防止通缩措施的效果。
en: Differences in financial structure thus matter profoundly in the effort to prevent deflation.

zh: 尽管QE在美国这样的金融体系灵活的债务国很有效果，但在金融体系饱受的债权经济体很有可能适得其反。
en: Though QE might work in a debtor economy with a flexible financial system like the US, it could backfire in a creditor economy with a conservative financial system.

zh: 这，而不是担心欧洲央行最终购买的是信誉低下的政府的债券，才是反对欧元区实施QE的真正原因。
en: This, rather than the fear that the ECB might end up buying the bonds of untrustworthy governments, is the real argument against QE in the eurozone.

zh: 把通缩放在首位
en: Putting Deflation First

zh: 剑桥—欧洲央行正在朝量化宽松行动，虽然动作踯躅，但方向确定。
en: CAMBRIDGE – The European Central Bank is moving, hesitantly but ineluctably, toward quantitative easing.

zh: 通缩威胁 — — 以及此前措施的无效 — — 让欧洲央行别无选择。
en: The threat of deflation – and the ineffectiveness of its previous measures – leaves it no choice.

zh: 问题时欧洲央行的动作是否足够快。
en: The question is whether the ECB will be able to move quickly enough.

zh: 欧洲央行已经开始尝试通过购买高品质资产支持证券放松信用条件。
en: The ECB has already attempted to ease credit conditions by purchasing high-quality asset-backed securities.

zh: 它购买以私人部门按揭贷款现金流为支持的证券 — — 所谓的有担保债券，还提出了购买公司债券和欧洲投资银行发行的多边证券的想法。
en: It has bought securities backed by cash flows from private-sector mortgages, so-called covered bonds, and it has floated the idea of buying corporate bonds and multilateral securities issued by the European Investment Bank.

zh: 但显然这是不够的。
en: But it is clear that this will not be enough.

zh: 私人部门证券供给有限，反映出欧洲银行贷款的指导地位以及证券化市场的沮丧情绪。
en: Supplies of private-sector securities are limited, reflecting the dominance of bank lending in Europe and depressed sentiment in securitization markets.

zh: 扩大这类证券的供给需要时间，而时间正是欧洲决策者所缺少的。
en: Augmenting the supply of such securities will take time, which is not something European policymakers possess.

zh: 出于这些理由，光是购买私人部门证券无法让欧洲央行实现其所宣称的将资产负债表扩大1万亿欧元的目标。
en: For all these reasons, purchasing private-sector securities alone will not enable the ECB to achieve its stated goal of expanding its balance sheet by €1 trillion ($1.2 trillion).

zh: 无法克服通缩幽灵，欧洲央行行长德拉吉就需要继续致力于构建欧洲央行董事会的共识 — — 全体一致的共识更好 — — 以购买政府债券。
en: Unable to vanquish the specter of deflation, ECB President Mario Draghi will need to continue working to build a consensus – even better, unanimity – within the bank’s governing board for purchases of government bonds.

zh: 但德拉吉和他的同事们只能小步前进，因为德国担心量化宽松只不过是剧烈通胀的代名词。
en: But Draghi and his colleagues will proceed in small steps, given fears in Germany that quantitative easing is just another name for runaway inflation.

zh: 一开始，欧洲央行将购买小量政府债券；若无法造成经济大决战，就将扩大购买量。
en: Initially, the ECB will buy a small volume of government bonds; when this fails to produce economic Armageddon, it will begin to scale up its purchases.

zh: 预计我们将在1月看到第一批小动作。
en: We can expect to see the first of these baby steps in January.

zh: 问题在于这一渐进主义不会奏效。
en: The problem is that this kind of incrementalism will not work.

zh: 问题是通缩，量化宽松只有通过改变预期才能起作用。
en: When the problem is deflation, quantitative easing will help only by transforming expectations.

zh: 当通缩预期根深蒂固时 — — 目前的欧洲就是如此 — — 消费者和投资者就会推迟支出，以期明天的价格和成本会更低。
en: When deflationary expectations are entrenched, as they are in Europe today, consumers and investors delay spending on the ground that prices and costs will be lower tomorrow.

zh: 这一预期会自我实现，因为支出减少意味着更少的通胀 — — 甚至价格下跌。
en: Those expectations become self-fulfilling, because less spending means even less inflation and, in the worst case, falling prices.

zh: 通缩预期可以转变为通胀预期 — — 从而鼓励增加支出。 这只有通过制造震惊和畏惧的政策才能实现。
en: Deflationary expectations can be transformed into inflationary expectations – thereby encouraging more spending – only by policies that induce shock and awe.

zh: 需要大手笔措施让家庭和企业相信未来会不同于今日。
en: Dramatic measures are needed to convince households and firms that the future will be different from the past.

zh: 欧洲央行需要让他们相信，如德拉吉在2012年7月所言，它会“竭尽全力”把经济带出通缩陷阱。
en: The central bank needs to convince them that it will do “whatever it takes,” as Draghi put it in July 2012, to jolt the economy out of its deflationary lethargy.

zh: 日本银行正在行长黑田东彦的带领下朝这个方向努力。
en: That is what the Bank of Japan, under Governor Haruhiko Kuroda, is attempting to do.

zh: 但欧洲央行暂时还无法采取相同的方针，因为北欧担心和厌恶激进的货币政策。
en: But the ECB seems temperamentally incapable of adopting the same approach, given fear and loathing in northern Europe of radical monetary action.

zh: 量化宽松的反对者担心它带来通胀 — — 这个立场有些奇怪，因为当前的欧洲经济颇为松弛。
en: Opponents of quantitative easing worry that it augurs inflation – a peculiar position, given the European economy’s current slack.

zh: 他们担心购买证券会埋下新一轮金融泡沫和破裂的种子。
en: They worry that securities purchases will sow the seeds of another financial bubble and bust.

zh: 这一担忧也有些奇怪，因为金融市场目前面临着严格得多的监管。
en: This too, is a peculiar fear, given that financial markets are now subject to much more stringent regulation.

zh: 对量化宽松最有影响力的反对是这会放松欧洲政府的改革压力。
en: The most influential objection to quantitative easing is that it will relieve the pressure on European governments to reform.

zh: 根据这一道德风险观点，只有在仍需面对枪口时，当局才会推动痛苦的劳动力和产品市场改革并追求必要的财政整合以争取投资者的信心。
en: According to this moral-hazard argument, the authorities will push ahead with painful labor- and product-market reforms and pursue the fiscal consolidation needed to gain the confidence of investors only if they remain under the gun.

zh: 如果欧洲央行购买它们的债券，各国政府就可以无视市场压力。
en: If the ECB purchases their bonds, governments will be able to ignore market pressure.

zh: 事实上，持这一观点的人 — — 他们是欧洲央行采取激进行动的最强大的障碍 — — 采用了自上而下的分析。
en: In fact, those who advance this view – which is the most powerful obstacle to radical ECB action – have their analysis upside down.

zh: 在当前条件下，通胀率接近于零，这一情况十分危险，政府不愿采取任何可能增加通缩风险的动作。
en: Under current conditions, with the inflation rate dangerously close to zero, governments are reluctant to do anything that increases the risk of deflation.

zh: 而从短期看，结构改革和财政整合都有通缩作用。
en: And structural reform and fiscal consolidation are both deflationary in the short run.

zh: 财政整合意味着减少公共支出。
en: Fiscal consolidation means less public spending.

zh: 而减少支出意味着减小价格上涨压力 — — 在通缩环境下，欧洲最不愿看到的就是这一情况。
en: And less spending means less upward pressure on prices – which is the last thing Europe needs in a deflationary environment.

zh: 增加劳动力和产品市场灵活性的结构改革也有通缩作用。
en: Structural reform that increases the flexibility of labor and product markets is deflationary as well.

zh: 在失业率超过11%的情况下强工资灵活性将使企业削减工资，而更低的劳动力成本令他们可以通过降低价格争夺市场份额。
en: Enhancing wage flexibility in an environment in which unemployment exceeds 11% will allow firms to cut wages, and lower labor costs will permit them to cut prices in an effort to gain market share.

zh: 加剧产品市场竞争的去监管化也会类似地导致价格下降（竞争的结果 ） 。
en: Deregulation that intensifies product-market competition will similarly lead to lower prices (that being what competition does).

zh: 在其他环境中，这些可能是积极的结果。
en: In other circumstances, these would be positive outcomes.

zh: 事实上，欧洲确实可以从财政整合和机构改革中获益良多 — — 但是在长期，而不是在面临内通缩问题的短期。
en: Indeed, Europe does stand to reap significant benefits from fiscal consolidation and structural reform – but in the long run, not in the short run, when the problem is deflation.

zh: 欧洲政府也知道这一点。
en: And European governments know it.

zh: 据此，欧洲央行能够鼓励财政整合和结构改革的最佳办法是驱逐通缩幽灵。
en: It follows that the best thing the ECB could do to encourage fiscal consolidation and structural reform is to banish the specter of deflation.

zh: 只有全面量化宽松可以做到。
en: Only full-bore quantitative easing can do that.

zh: 那些表示反对、认为如此大胆的行为会阻挠财政整合和结构改革的人应该思考一下通缩会带来什么。
en: Those who object that such audacity would discourage fiscal consolidation and structural reform should consider what deflation would do.

zh: QE者，负鼠也
en: The Lemmings of QE

zh: 纽黑文—欧洲央行可预见地加入了世界其他货币当局行列，开始了史上最大央行业务实验。
en: NEW HAVEN – Predictably, the European Central Bank has joined the world’s other major monetary authorities in the greatest experiment in the history of central banking.

zh: 到目前为止，一切都是那么熟悉。
en: By now, the pattern is all too familiar.

zh: 首先，央行将常规政策利率下降到可怕的“零下限 ” 。
en: First, central banks take the conventional policy rate down to the dreaded “zero bound.”

zh: 但经济继续萎靡，而常规工具已经用尽，于是央行采取了非常规方法 — — 量化宽松（QE ） 。
en: Facing continued economic weakness, but having run out of conventional tools, they then embrace the unconventional approach of quantitative easing (QE).

zh: 这一战略背后的理论很简单：央行无法让信用的价格进一步降低，转向了扩张信用的数量。
en: The theory behind this strategy is simple: Unable to cut the price of credit further, central banks shift their focus to expanding its quantity.

zh: 隐含观点是这一从价格到数量调整的变化在作用上等同于增加货币政策宽松。
en: The implicit argument is that this move from price to quantity adjustments is the functional equivalent of additional monetary-policy easing.

zh: 因此，即使名义利率处于零下限，央行手里仍有武器。
en: Thus, even at the zero bound of nominal interest rates, it is argued, central banks still have weapons in their arsenal.

zh: 但这些武器可适用于它的任务吗？
en: But are those weapons up to the task?

zh: 对欧洲央行和日本银行来说，它们都面临可怕的经济和总物价水平的下行风险，这绝不是一个可以等闲视之的问题。
en: For the ECB and the Bank of Japan (BOJ), both of which are facing formidable downside risks to their economies and aggregate price levels, this is hardly an idle question.

zh: 对美国来说，它的量化宽松最终后果还有待观察，答案也仍然有待揭露。
en: For the United States, where the ultimate consequences of QE remain to be seen, the answer is just as consequential.

zh: 量化宽松的影响取决于货币政策的“3T ” ： 传递（transmission，货币政策影响实体经济的渠道 ） ； 牵引（traction，经济对货币政策的反应）和时间一致性（time consistency，当局实现充分就业和物价稳定等具体承诺目标的坚定信心 ） 。
en: QE’s impact hinges on the “three Ts” of monetary policy: transmission (the channels by which monetary policy affects the real economy); traction (the responsiveness of economies to policy actions); and time consistency (the unwavering credibility of the authorities’ promise to reach specified targets like full employment and price stability).

zh: 尽管金融市场欢呼量化宽松的到来，更不用说美联储的踌躇满志，但基于3T的分析表明欧洲央行应该三思而后行。
en: Notwithstanding financial markets’ celebration of QE, not to mention the US Federal Reserve’s hearty self-congratulation, an analysis based on the three Ts should give the ECB pause.

zh: 从传递角度看，美联储的重点在所谓的财富效应。
en: In terms of transmission, the Fed has focused on the so-called wealth effect.

zh: 首先，自2008年底以来，美联储资产负债表扩张了3.6万亿美元 — — 远远高于量化宽松期间名义GDP的增长规模2.5万亿美元 — — 这提振了资产市场。
en: First, the balance-sheet expansion of some $3.6 trillion since late 2008 – which far exceeded the $2.5 trillion in nominal GDP growth over the QE period – boosted asset markets.

zh: 人们认为投资者投资组合表现的改善 — — 标准普尔500指数从其2009年危机导致的底部反弹了三倍多 — — 将让消费者财富增加，从而刺激支出。
en: It was assumed that the improvement in investors’ portfolio performance – reflected in a more than threefold rise in the S&P 500 from its crisis-induced low in March 2009 – would spur a burst of spending by increasingly wealthy consumers.

zh: 日本银行也用类似的理由论证其量化和定性宽松（QQE）政策。
en: The BOJ has used a similar justification for its own policy of quantitative and qualitative easing (QQE).

zh: 但是，欧洲央行要形成财富效应更加困难，这主要是因为欧洲个人持有股票（不管是直接持有还是通过养老金账户持有）规模远小于美国和日本。
en: The ECB, however, will have a harder time making the case for wealth effects, largely because equity ownership by individuals (either direct or through their pension accounts) is far lower in Europe than in the US or Japan.

zh: 对欧洲来说，货币政策更可能通过银行传递，而随着欧元贬值提振出口 — — 欧元兑美元汇率去年下跌了15 % — —则货币也是一个传递渠道。
en: For Europe, monetary policy seems more likely to be transmitted through banks, as well as through the currency channel, as a weaker euro – it has fallen some 15% against the dollar over the last year – boosts exports.

zh: 量化宽松的真正症结在于牵引。
en: The real sticking point for QE relates to traction.

zh: 在美国，消费是危机后复苏疲软的主要原因，这正说明了牵引因素的重要性。
en: The US, where consumption accounts for the bulk of the shortfall in the post-crisis recovery, is a case in point.

zh: 在债务过多和储蓄不足的环境下，财富效应对于改善资产负债表衰退作用甚微。 当房产和信用泡沫破裂时，资产负债表衰退令美国家庭遭受重创。
en: In an environment of excess debt and inadequate savings, wealth effects have done very little to ameliorate the balance-sheet recession that clobbered US households when the property and credit bubbles burst.

zh: 事实上，2008年初以来年化平均真实消费增长率只有1.3 % 。
en: Indeed, annualized real consumption growth has averaged just 1.3% since early 2008.

zh: 当前，真实GDP复苏每年大约在2.3 % — —比过去周期的正常水平低两个百分点 — — 很难认为对量化宽松的普遍赞扬理所应当。
en: With the current recovery in real GDP on a trajectory of 2.3% annual growth – two percentage points below the norm of past cycles – it is tough to justify the widespread praise of QE.

zh: 日本的大规模量化和定性宽松也面临着类似的牵引问题。
en: Japan’s massive QQE campaign has faced similar traction problems.

zh: 日本银行将其资产负债表规模扩大至GDP的近60 % — —比美联储还要高一倍 — — 但它发现，其结束通缩的努力正在日益失效。
en: After expanding its balance sheet to nearly 60% of GDP – double the size of the Fed’s – the BOJ is finding that its campaign to end deflation is increasingly ineffective.

zh: 日本再次陷入了衰退，而日本银行也刚刚将今年通胀目标从1.7%调低到1 % 。
en: Japan has lapsed back into recession, and the BOJ has just cut the inflation target for this year from 1.7% to 1%.

zh: 最后，量化宽松的时间一致性也令人失望。
en: Finally, QE also disappoints in terms of time consistency.

zh: 美联储一直用一套描述经济和/或通胀风险状态的基于数据的条件论证其后量化宽松时期的正常化战略。
en: The Fed has long qualified its post-QE normalization strategy with a host of data-dependent conditions pertaining to the state of the economy and/or inflation risks.

zh: 此外，目前美联储依靠模棱两可的形容词为金融市场提供指引，最近将表述从保持“相当长”时间的低利率变为承诺“耐心”地决定何时提高利率。
en: Moreover, it is now relying on ambiguous adjectives to provide guidance to financial markets, having recently shifted from stating that it would maintain low rates for a “considerable” time to pledging to be “patient" in determining when to raise rates.

zh: 但瑞士国民银行才是刺入量化宽松心脏的最锋利的利刃。 自2011年瑞郎盯住欧元以来，瑞士国民银行通过印钱防止瑞郎过度升值。
en: But it is the Swiss National Bank, which printed money to prevent excessive appreciation after pegging its currency to the euro in 2011, that has thrust the sharpest dagger into QE’s heart.

zh: 1月15日，瑞士国民银行出人意料地宣布放弃盯住欧元 — — 一个月前它还在重申盯住欧元的承诺 — — 曾经严守纪律的瑞士国民银行已经顾不上时间一致性的信誉要求了。
en: By unexpectedly abandoning the euro peg on January 15 – just a month after reiterating a commitment to it – the once-disciplined SNB has run roughshod over the credibility requirements of time consistency.

zh: 瑞士国民银行的资产接近瑞士GDP的90 % ， 它的“反水”给无期限的量化宽松的界限和作用造成了严重问题。
en: With the SNB’s assets amounting to nearly 90% of Switzerland’s GDP, the reversal raises serious questions about both the limits and repercussions of open-ended QE.

zh: 并且这是一次无情的提醒，让人们留心欧洲央行行长德拉吉“不惜一切代价”拯救欧元之类的承诺。
en: And it serves as a chilling reminder of the fundamental fragility of promises like that of ECB President Mario Draghi to do “whatever it takes” to save the euro.

zh: 在量化宽松时期，货币政策撕去了纪律和连贯性的伪装。
en: In the QE era, monetary policy has lost any semblance of discipline and coherence.

zh: 随着德拉吉尝试兑现他在近两年半前许下的承诺，该承诺的界限 — — 如美联储和日本银行的可以比较的保证 — — 可以变得更加明确。
en: As Draghi attempts to deliver on his nearly two-and-a-half-year-old commitment, the limits of his promise – like comparable assurances by the Fed and the BOJ – could become glaringly apparent.

zh: 中央银行就像是悬崖边的负鼠，完全无视它们面临的风险。
en: Like lemmings at the cliff’s edge, central banks seem steeped in denial of the risks they face.

zh: 欧洲央行和它的批评者
en: The ECB and Its Critics

zh: 巴黎—在北欧，特别是德国，欧洲央行决定采取量化宽松引起了舆论大哗。
en: PARIS – In Northern Europe, especially Germany, the European Central Bank’s decision to embark on quantitative easing (QE) has triggered an avalanche of indictments.

zh: 许多指责毫无根据甚至是无稽之谈。
en: Many are unfounded or even baseless.

zh: 一些人则弄混了情况。
en: Some are confusing.

zh: 也有人过于重视猜测的危险而忽视了实际危险。
en: Others give greater weight to speculative dangers than to actual ones.

zh: 几乎没有人谈论实际问题，也忽视了潜在解决方案。
en: And few point to real problems, while ignoring potential solutions.

zh: 从批评看，你也许会认为零通胀是一种幸福。
en: Judging by the criticism, one might consider zero inflation a blessing.

zh: 但若果真如此的话，全世界的央行早就将零利率作为它们的目标了。
en: But if that were true, central banks around the world would have set it as a target long ago.

zh: 相反，所有央行都将物价稳定定义为较低、稳定但为正的通胀。
en: Instead, all of them define price stability as low, stable, but positive inflation.

zh: 这是因为零通胀存在三个巨大的消极作用。
en: That is because zero inflation has three overwhelmingly negative consequences.

zh: 首先，它破坏标准货币政策的效果（因为如果利率远低于零，存款人就会将现金从银行中抽出放入保险箱 ） 。
en: First, it erodes the effectiveness of standard monetary policy (because if interest rates went much below zero, depositors would withdraw cash from banks and put it in safes).

zh: 其次，它让相对工资（比如制造业相对服务业的工资）更加刚性，因为工资合同常常根据欧元确定。
en: Second, it makes relative wages (of, say, manufacturing versus services employees) more rigid, because wage contracts are generally set in euro terms.

zh: 第三，它增加了过去的债务的负担，让解决公私债务危机的过程变得更加痛苦。
en: And, third, it increases the burden of past debts and makes exiting from a private or public debt crisis even more painful.

zh: 但是，批评者说，没有理由需要担心，因为欧元区的近零通胀只不过是因为石油价格的暴跌。
en: But, say the critics, there is no reason to worry, because the eurozone’s near-zero inflation is merely the result of the sharp drop in oil prices.

zh: 不幸的是，确实存在许多理由需要担心。
en: Unfortunately, there is indeed plenty of reason to worry.

zh: 欧元区消费物价通胀已经连续22个月低于目标值 — — 远远先于油价开始崩溃。
en: Consumer price inflation in the eurozone has been below target for 22 consecutive months – long before the price of oil started collapsing.

zh: 廉价石油是增长的助推剂；但它也降低了长期通胀预期，而长期通胀预期才是货币政策的真正目标。
en: Cheaper oil is a boon for growth; but it also lowers long-term inflation expectations, which are the true target of monetary policy.

zh: 批评者还说，低于目标的通胀是重塑竞争力的必要条件。
en: Then there is the critics’ claim that below-target inflation is needed to restore competitiveness.

zh: 这纯属混淆视听。
en: This is just confusing.

zh: 诚然，实现欧元区内部竞争力的再平衡还远未完成，一些国家因此需要低于平均值的通胀以降低高于平均值的成本。
en: It is true that rebalancing competitiveness within the eurozone has not yet been completed, and that some countries thus need to record below-average inflation to cut above-average costs.

zh: 但对欧元区整体来说，这一点并不成立。
en: But this is not true of the eurozone as a whole.

zh: 泛欧元区竞争力取决于产品质量和欧元汇率，这两者都是灵活变化的。
en: Eurozone-wide competitiveness depends on product quality and the euro exchange rate, which is flexible.

zh: 从这个角度讲，通胀是一个无关因素。
en: Inflation is irrelevant in this respect.

zh: 尽管如此，欧洲央行批评者担心魔法师的学徒（sorcerer’s apprentice ） ： 量化宽松这样的货币动作最终会导致通胀失控。
en: Nonetheless, the ECB’s critics fear the sorcerer’s apprentice: monetary initiatives like QE will ultimately cause runaway inflation.

zh: 这其中的逻辑可谓怪异。
en: This reasoning is strange, at best.

zh: 如果批评者的要点是央行犯了错，那么应该指出欧元区的错误是让通胀过低才对。
en: If the critics’ point is that central banks make mistakes, it seems worth pointing out that the mistake made in the eurozone was to let inflation reach excessively low levels.

zh: 如今，欧洲央行正在奋起反击，但如日本决策者所看到的，摆脱通胀绝非易事。
en: Now the ECB is reacting with force, but, as Japanese policymakers have found, exiting from deflation is far from easy.

zh: 欧洲央行行长马里奥·德拉吉（Mario Draghi）也许无法让通胀回升到2 % 。
en: ECB President Mario Draghi may fail to bring inflation back to 2%.

zh: 或者他可能用力过猛。
en: Or he may overshoot.

zh: 没人知道。
en: Nobody knows.

zh: 但更大的概率是猜测的威胁将阻止欧洲央行与实实在在的危险搏斗。
en: But it is odd to claim that a speculative danger should prevent the ECB from fighting one that is all too real.

zh: 接下来看看量化宽松不合法的说法。
en: Then comes the claim that QE is illegal.

zh: 但欧洲央行的主要责任是实现并维持物价稳定。
en: But the ECB’s primary responsibility is to achieve and maintain price stability.

zh: 当常规利率政策不再有效时，它就有义务祭出其他工具。
en: When conventional interest-rate policy becomes impotent, its duty is to rely on other instruments.

zh: 购买政府债券是欧盟条约明文允许的。
en: The purchase of government bonds is explicitly authorized by the EU Treaty.

zh: 这并不是说量化宽松没有弊端。
en: This is not to say that QE has no downside.

zh: 它可能造成资产价格泡沫。
en: It probably will create asset-price bubbles.

zh: 极低利率通过两��方式推高资产价格：它们增加股票或固定收入债券的未来收入流的现值；它们让获得信用和购买房产变得更加容易负担。
en: Ultra-low interest rates lift asset prices in two ways: they increase the present value of the future income stream of a stock or a fixed-income bond; and they make credit and property purchases more affordable.

zh: 因此，资产价格通胀有可能发生，决策者必须通过监管工具（如信用上限）遏制这一风险。
en: So asset-price inflation is likely, and policymakers will have to contain it through regulatory tools, such as credit limits.

zh: 此外，量化宽松可能加剧不平等。
en: Moreover, QE probably will increase inequality.

zh: 股票、债券和土地价格的上涨将增加拥有者的财富。
en: The rise in the price of stocks, bonds, and land will increase their owners’ wealth.

zh: 显然，无房户就无从从中获利。
en: Obviously, those without property will not benefit.

zh: 但欧洲央行的货币动作也有助于助推增长、创造就业，从而让穷人获益。
en: But the ECB’s monetary initiative will also help reignite growth and create jobs, thereby benefiting the poor.

zh: 解决因量化宽松导致的不平等是政府的任务，而它们也拥有完成这一任务的工具：税收。
en: It is governments’ task to address the rise in inequality resulting from QE, and they have an instrument for that: taxation.

zh: 美联储采取量化宽松时，有人指责它在输出问题，因为激进的货币宽松难免会令货币贬值。 如今，同样的指责对准了欧洲央行。
en: When the United States Federal Reserve embarked on QE, it was accused of exporting its problems, because aggressive monetary easing inevitably weakens the currency. The same charge is now being leveled against the ECB. But this is misleading.

zh: 但这是错误的。 最终，美国的复苏给其贸易伙伴带来的好处超过了弊端。
en: Ultimately, the US recovery helped its trade partners more than it hurt them.

zh: 在全球货币互相依存的当今世界，游戏规则是每一个货币联盟都必须追求其自身的物价稳定。
en: In today’s world of global monetary interdependence, the rule of the game is that every currency union should pursue its own price stability.

zh: 欧洲央行也不例外。
en: The ECB has not departed from this standard.

zh: 德国的另一个主要担忧是量化宽松可能成为创立欧元债券的后门。
en: Another major concern in Germany is that QE could be a backdoor means of creating Eurobonds.

zh: 但欧元债券是发行人之间彼此互相提供担保的契约。
en: But a Eurobond is a pact among issuers offering each other mutual guarantees.

zh: 而欧洲央行并非发行人；它是一个独立机构，购买决策由其自主做出。
en: The ECB, however, is not an issuer; it is an independent agency, and the decision to buy is its own.

zh: 此外，80%的风险将由国家央行分别承担。
en: Furthermore, 80% of the risk will be borne by national central banks individually.

zh: 北欧对欧元债券的反对体现了对货币积极主义可能阻挠结构改革的道德风险担忧。
en: Northern European opposition to Eurobonds reflects moral-hazard concerns that monetary activism will discourage structural reforms.

zh: 但是，在当前长期停滞的背景下，TINA（没有替代方案）的改革观点正在日益式微。
en: But, in the current context of protracted stagnation, the TINA (there is no alternative) argument for reform is losing strength by the day.

zh: 在看不见回报的情况下，改革疲劳正在日益出现。
en: Absent a visible payoff, reform fatigue is setting in.

zh: 新政策组合应该兼顾宏观层面的支持和微观层面的变革。
en: The new policy mix should combine macro-level support and micro-level change.

zh: 认为量化宽松将破坏财政纪律的观点无法彻底排除，因为其支持者和反对者都同意财政纪律的时代已经过去了。
en: The argument that QE will destroy fiscal discipline cannot be rejected out of hand, because both its proponents and its adversaries seem to agree that its days are over.

zh: 但是，尽管欧洲央行的债券购买计划确实能缓和政府的市场压力，但这一压力已经没有什么效果。
en: But, though it is true that ECB bond purchases will shelter governments from market pressure, such pressure was already fairly ineffective.

zh: 保守信用和保证不推脱责任是政府的指责。
en: It is governments’ job to uphold their end of the bargain and ensure that they do not shirk their responsibilities.

zh: 这也是欧盟“财政契约”的目的。
en: This is what the EU’s “fiscal compact” is for.

zh: 最后，德国批评者抱怨欧洲央行的货币政策不与德国的经济状况相契合。
en: Finally, German critics complain that the ECB’s monetary policy is not geared to German economic conditions.

zh: 确实如此，但这是不可避免的。
en: This is both true and unavoidable.

zh: 欧洲央行要对欧元区整体负责。
en: The ECB is responsible for the eurozone as a whole.

zh: 其货币政策不可能随时完美契合所有成员国的需要。
en: Its monetary policy cannot be perfectly suited to all members’ needs all of the time.

zh: 对欧元的第一个十年来说，欧洲央行的政策对西班牙太宽松了；如今则是对德国太宽松了。
en: For the euro’s first ten years, the ECB’s policy was too lax for Spain; now it is too lax for Germany.

zh: 不应该因此指责欧洲央行。
en: The ECB should not be blamed for doing its job.

zh: 欧洲央行的新宏观经济现实主义
en: The ECB’s New Macroeconomic Realism

zh: 纽约—欧洲央行终于启动了量化宽松（QE）政策。
en: NEW YORK – The European Central Bank has finally launched a policy of quantitative easing (QE).

zh: 现阶段的关键问题是德国是否会给予欧洲央行所需要的方便，使其以足够的力度实施货币扩张。
en: The key question at this stage is whether Germany will give the ECB the freedom of maneuver needed to carry out this monetary expansion with sufficient boldness.

zh: 尽管 QE不能带来长期增长，但它大大有利于结束自2008年以来让欧元区饱受折磨的衰退。
en: Though QE cannot produce long-term growth, it can do much to end the ongoing recession that has gripped the eurozone since 2008.

zh: 本周，在QE预期下，欧洲股市创出历史新高，这不但表明市场信心增加，也是货币宽松提振投资和消费的直接渠道。
en: The record-high stock-market levels in Europe this week, in anticipation of QE, not only indicate growing confidence, but are also a direct channel by which monetary easing can boost both investment and consumption.

zh: 但一些观察家，如诺贝尔奖获得者保罗·克鲁格曼（Paul Krugman）和前美国财政部长劳伦斯·萨默斯（Larry Summers ） ， 依然质疑QE是否真的有用。
en: But some observers, such as Nobel Laureate Paul Krugman and former US Treasury Secretary Larry Summers, continue to doubt whether QE can really be effective.

zh: 克鲁格曼最近表示，一个“通缩漩涡”正在拖累世界经济大部，下跌的物价导致了无法摆脱的需求下降螺旋。
en: As Krugman recently put it, a “deflationary vortex” is dragging down much of the world economy, with falling prices causing an inescapable downward spiral in demand.

zh: 世界银行和国际货币基金组织（IMF）似乎也同意这一点，两家机构最近又都再度调低了增长预期。
en: The World Bank and International Monetary Fund seem to agree, as both recently lowered their growth forecasts a few notches.

zh: 悲观派指出，世界经济受制于难以克服的总需求不足，导致新的“长期停滞 ” 。
en: Pessimists argue that the world economy suffers from an insurmountable shortage of aggregate demand, leading to a new “secular stagnation.”

zh: 货币政策被视为相对无效，因为名义利率存在著名的零下限（zero lower bound ） 。
en: Monetary policy is seen to be relatively ineffective, owing to the notorious zero lower bound (ZLB) on nominal interest rates.

zh: 这一观点指出，在政策利率接近于零的情况下，央行对于通胀漩涡或多或少会产生无力感，经济也会陷入著名的流动性陷阱。
en: With policy interest rates near zero, the argument goes, central banks are more or less helpless to escape the deflationary vortex, and economies become stuck in the infamous liquidity trap.

zh: 在这一情形中，需求无法有效地自我强化，于是拉低物价、提高实际（经通胀调整的）利率，并进一步抑制需求。
en: In this scenario, the demand insufficiency feeds on itself, pushing down prices, raising real (inflation-adjusted) interest rates, and lowering demand further.

zh: 自2008年以来，这一观点在美国和英国的凯恩斯主义经济学家中占据了主流。
en: This perspective has been prominent among Keynesian economists in the United States and the United Kingdom since 2008.

zh: 克鲁格曼认为日本曾经是唯一陷入慢性通胀的主要经济体 — — 从20世纪90年代便已如此，而如今欧盟、中国以及最近的瑞士（从高企的瑞郎和下跌的物价看）纷纷步了日本后尘。
en: Krugman argues that Japan was only the first of the major economies to succumb to chronic deflation, back in the 1990s, and has now been followed by the European Union, China, and most recently Switzerland, with its soaring franc and falling prices.

zh: 从这一观点看，美国也仍处于这一漩涡附近，因此急需凯恩斯主义者一再呼吁的财政刺激。 财政刺激与货币政策不同，悲观派认为它在零利率下限特别有效。
en: The US, in this view, remains near the vortex as well, prompting the Keynesians’ repeated calls for more fiscal stimulus, which, unlike monetary policy, is seen by the pessimists to be especially efficacious at the ZLB.

zh: 在我看来，悲观派夸大了通缩风险，这也是他们最近预测失准的原因。
en: In my view, the pessimists have exaggerated the risks of deflation, which is why their recent forecasts have missed the mark.

zh: 最令人瞩目的是，他们没能预测到美国和英国的反弹。 美国和英国出现了增长加速和失业下降，即使它们削减了赤字。
en: Most notably, they failed to predict the rebound in both the US and the UK, with growth rising and unemployment falling even as deficits were cut.

zh: 要不是准确地诊断了2008年危机，是无法开出有效的药方的。
en: Without a proper diagnosis of the 2008 crisis, an effective cure cannot be prescribed.

zh: 悲观派认为投资意愿出现了大幅下降，凯恩斯所谓的“动物精神”损失惨重。
en: The pessimists believe that there has been a large decline in the will to invest, something like the loss of “animal spirits” described by Keynes.

zh: 根据这一观点，即使利率极低，投资需求也将保持低水平，因此总需求也会依然不足。
en: Even with very low interest rates, according to this view, investment demand will remain low, and therefore aggregate demand will remain insufficient.

zh: 通缩将进一步恶化形势，只有大规模财政赤字才能填补需求缺口。
en: Deflation will make matters worse, leaving only large fiscal deficits able to close the demand gap.

zh: 但2008年深度衰退的原因要更加具体，解决办法也必须更有目标性。
en: But the causes of 2008’s deep downturn were more specific, and the solutions must be more targeted.

zh: 2008年危机前，受影响最大国家出现了大规模房地产泡沫（美国、英国、爱尔兰、西班牙、葡萄牙和意大利 ） 。
en: A large housing bubble preceded the 2008 crisis in the hardest-hit countries (the US, the UK, Ireland, Spain, Portugal, and Italy).

zh: 哈耶克在20实际30年代就警告说，这一投资不当过程的后果需要时间才能消化，因为随后会发生具体资本(在这个案例中是房地产存量)会出现过度供给。
en: As Friedrich Hayek warned back in the 1930s, the consequences of such a process of misplaced investment take time to resolve, owing to the subsequent oversupply of specific capital (in this case, of the housing stock).

zh: 但比房地产泡沫破坏力更大的是雷曼兄弟倒闭后发生的席卷全球资本市场的金融恐慌。
en: Yet far more devastating than the housing bubble was the financial panic that gripped capital markets worldwide after the collapse of Lehman Brothers.

zh: 美联储和美国财政部决定给市场一个教训，放任雷曼兄弟倒闭，这是特别糟糕的信号。
en: The decision by the US Federal Reserve and the US Treasury to teach the markets a lesson by allowing Lehman to fail was a disastrously bad call.

zh: 恐慌剧烈而严重，央行不得不行使其最后贷款人的基本作用。
en: The panic was sharp and severe, requiring central banks to play their fundamental role as lenders of last resort.

zh: 美联储在雷曼兄弟倒闭的前几年中表现拙劣，而在此之后表现特别出色，向市场注入大量流动性遏制了恐慌。
en: As poorly as the Fed performed in the years preceding the Lehman Brothers’ collapse, it performed splendidly well afterward, by flooding the markets with liquidity to break the panic.

zh: 英格兰银行亦然，尽管其反应速度稍慢一些。
en: So, too, did the Bank of England, though it was a bit slower to react.

zh: 按惯例，日本银行和欧洲央行反应最慢，在更长的时间里保持了更高的政策利率，没有采取QE和其他扩大流动性的措施，直到现在才幡然悔悟。
en: The Bank of Japan and the ECB were, characteristically, the slowest to react, keeping their policy rates higher for longer, and not undertaking QE and other extraordinary liquidity measures until late in the day.

zh: 事实上，这要求两家机构的新领导人 — — 日本银行的黑田东彦和欧洲央行的马里奥·德拉吉(Mario Draghi ) — —最终开始指定正确的货币政策。
en: Indeed, it required new leaders in both institutions – Haruhiko Kuroda at the BOJ and Mario Draghi at the ECB – finally to set monetary policy right.

zh: 好消息是，即使在零利率下限，货币政策仍然有效。
en: The good news is that, even near the ZLB, monetary policy works.

zh: QE提高了股价，降低了长期利率，让货币发生贬值，也舒缓了信贷动荡，即使利率已经接近于零。
en: QE raises equity prices; lowers long-term interest rates; causes currencies to depreciate; and eases credit crunches, even when interest rates are near zero.

zh: 欧洲央行和日本银行没有因为再通胀工具不足而受损，它们因为没有采取足够的合适行动而受损。
en: The ECB and the BOJ did not suffer from a lack of reflationary tools; they suffered from a lack of suitable action.

zh: 货币政策起效是一个好消息，因为财政刺激对短期需求管理而言不是一个强力工具。
en: The efficacy of monetary policy is good news, because fiscal stimulus is a weak instrument for short-term demand management.

zh: 讽刺的是，在著名的1998 年的文章中，克鲁格曼解释过个中缘由。
en: Ironically, in an influential 1998 paper, Krugman explained why.

zh: 当时他指出 — — 也正如我意 — — 短期减税和转移支付会部分地储蓄起来而不是花掉，而公共债务会成倍增长，给财政平衡和经济带来长期影响。
en: He argued at that time, and rightly in my view, that short-term tax reductions and transfers would be partly saved, not spent, and that public debt would multiply and create a long-term shadow over the fiscal balance and the economy.

zh: 即使目前利率处于低位，他说，它们也终会上升，从而增加新增债务的偿付负担。
en: Even if interest rates are currently low, he noted, they will rise, thereby increasing the debt-service burden on the newly accumulated debt.

zh: 在所有主要央行纷纷追求扩张性货币政策的情况下，石油价格迅速下跌，而信息技术的持续进步刺激了投资机会，因此2015年及以后的经济增长前景要好于悲观者的意见。
en: With all major central banks pursuing expansionary monetary policies, oil prices falling sharply, and the ongoing revolution in information technology spurring investment opportunities, the prospects for economic growth in 2015 and beyond are better than they look to the pessimists.

zh: 上升的利润，合理的企业投资前景，欧洲和美国几乎所有国家都存在的基础设施支出的巨大不足，向撒哈拉以南非洲等低收入地区出口资本品的融资机会和满足全球投资低碳新能源体系需要的机会，这些都是乐观的理由。
en: There are rising profits, reasonable investment prospects for businesses, a large backlog on infrastructure spending almost everywhere in Europe and the US, and the opportunity to finance capital-goods exports to low-income regions, such as Sub-Saharan Africa, and to meet the worldwide need for investment in a new, low-carbon energy system.

zh: 如果私人投资存在短缺，问题不在于真的缺少好项目；而在于缺少政策明确性和互补性长期公共投资。
