en: There are convincing arguments on both sides, though we count ourselves as cautious techno-optimists.

zh: 真正没有争议的是各国内部的不平等性在迅速加剧。
en: What is not really up for debate is that inequality within countries is rising fast.

zh: 不同国家的不平等性各不相同，但几乎所有国家都出现了不平等性加剧的情况，收入和财富日益向最顶层集中。
en: While individual countries show different levels of inequality, its rise has been evident almost everywhere, with income and wealth increasingly concentrated at the very top.

zh: 随着新技术 — — 不管它们能带来多少生产率的提高 — — 不断增加技能溢价，不断将利润向前沿企业转意思，不断导致新的准垄断“赢家通吃”局面扩大到全球规模，这一趋势还将加速。
en: This trend will accelerate as new technologies, regardless of how much productivity growth they generate, continue to increase the skill premium, shift income to frontier firms, and allow new types of near-monopoly, “winner-take-all” positions to develop on a global scale.

zh: 这就引出了今天增长繁荣中的最大危险。
en: Herein lies the biggest danger in today’s exuberant headlines about growth.

zh: 许多人相信高增长是国家解决政治和社会混乱局面的虚拟灵丹，包括民粹主义和民族主义。
en: Many believe that rapid growth can act as a virtual panacea for countries’ political and social woes, including the rise of populism and nationalism.

zh: 但如果高增长的收益被顶层5%或1%攫取，社会紧张必然会加剧。
en: But if the benefits of rapid growth accrue to the top 5% or 1%, social tensions are bound to rise.

zh: 事实上，制定能逆转危险的政治趋势、促进更广泛共享的增长的政策将十分困难。
en: And the fact is that it will be difficult to develop policies that can reverse damaging political trends and promote more widely shared growth.

zh: 这并不是说我们束手无策。
en: This is not to say that nothing can be done.

zh: 相反，制定解决方案应该成为重点事项，政策争论要集中在能够创造真正的包容型经济的手段上。
en: On the contrary, devising solutions should be a high priority, with the policy debate centering on measures that would help to create truly inclusive economies.

zh: 手段之一是普及平价品质教育，包括技能升级和再培训。
en: One such measure would be broad-based access to affordable and quality education, including skills upgrading and retraining.

zh: 鼓励竞争的发展和监管框架，以及阻止侵蚀税基的政策也有所助益。
en: The development of regulatory frameworks that encourage competition would also help, as would limiting tax-base erosion.

zh: 公共研究拨款应该让纳税人能够从可盈利的结果中获益。
en: Public research should be funded in a way that gives taxpayers a stake in profitable outcomes.

zh: 类似地，基础设施投资应该具有明确的权益相关目标。
en: Likewise, infrastructure investments should have explicit equity-related objectives.

zh: 应该从两个方面遏制不平等性：确保税前收入以更加包容的形式增加，以及强化和平等化税收和转移支付的作用。
en: The goal should be to attack inequality on two fronts: ensuring that pre-tax incomes rise in a more inclusive fashion and strengthening the equalizing role of taxes and transfers.

zh: 考虑到市场的全球性，许多政策都需要国际合作才能产生效果。
en: Given the global nature of markets, many policies will require international cooperation to be effective.

zh: 与国际贸易、投资、竞争和知识产权相关的问题联系日益密切，全面解决它们的全球方针也变得至关重要。
en: With issues concerning international trade, investment, competition, and intellectual property rights increasingly linked, global approaches that can address them in a holistic way have become vital.

zh: 如果不能实现更大的包容性 — — 这是一个困难但可以实现的目标 — — 将激发社会紧张，助长已经形成气候的民族主义，产生最终让所有人都受损的破坏。
en: Failure to achieve greater inclusiveness – a difficult but attainable goal – would stoke social tensions and fuel already-resurgent nationalism, producing disruptions that would ultimately lead to losses for everyone.

zh: 但今天的增长好消息有可能掩盖这一风险，因为它有可能削弱实现必要的变革的意愿，让经济只能仰仗涓滴效应。
en: Yet today’s good growth news risks obscuring that risk, as it threatens to weaken the will to make the needed changes, leaving economies to rely on trickle-down effects.

zh: 有利于我们的经济趋势
en: The Economic Trend Is Our Friend

zh: 发自伯克利 — — 近期以来全世界都被一种浓稠的幻灭感所笼罩着。
en: BERKELEY – These are days of grave disillusionment with the state of the world.

zh: 那些邪恶的狂热宗教杀戮势力 — — 某些西方人以为自1750年就已经灭绝了的东西 — — 又卷土重来来了，而那些我们认为早已在1945年被埋葬在柏林城废墟之下的民族主义，偏见和种族主义势力也与之相结合并进一步得到了强化。
en: Sinister forces of fanatical, faith-based killing – something that we in the West, at least, thought had largely ended by 1750 – are back. And they have been joined by and are reinforcing forces of nationalism, bigotry, and racism that we thought had been largely left in the ruins of Berlin in 1945.

zh: 此外，2008年以来的经济增长状况一直令人极为沮丧，也没有什么理由去指望能在未来五年出现好转。
en: In addition, economic growth since 2008 has been profoundly disappointing. There is no reasoned case for optimistically expecting a turn for the better in the next five years or so.

zh: 由于全球体制无法催生不断增长的繁荣，导致在好年景时有助于遏制回荡在我们这个时代的杀戮恶魔的信任和信心都遭到了损害。
en: And the failure of global institutions to deliver ever-increasing prosperity has undermined the trust and confidence which in better times would serve to suppress the murderous demons of our age.

zh: 悲观情绪在这段时期非常容易出现 — — 也许是太容易了。
en: Pessimism understandably comes easy these days – perhaps too easy.

zh: 事实上，热情和积极的逆向思维也准备就绪：如果我们不仅仅是以未来五年的眼光来看待全球经济增长，而是放长到未来30~60年，这幅图景将会更加光明。
en: In fact, enthusiastic and positive contrarianism is in order: if we look at global economic growth not just five years out, but over the next 30-60 years, the picture looks much brighter.

zh: 原因很简单：自二战以来推动全球经济增长的大规模趋势一直都没有停止过。
en: The reason is simple: the large-scale trends that have fueled global growth since World War II have not stopped.

zh: 越来越多人接触到提高生产率的新技术，更多的人在从事互惠互利的贸易，而出生人口则在减少，从而纾缓了长久以来对所谓人口炸弹的担忧。
en: More people are gaining access to new, productivity enhancing technologies, more people are engaging in mutually beneficial trade, and fewer people are being born, thus allaying any continued fears of a so-called population bomb.

zh: 此外，创新虽然可能是自1880年代以来有所放缓，但却从未停止 — — 尤其是在北半球。
en: Moreover, innovation, especially in the global north, has not ceased, even if it has possibly slowed since the 1880s.

zh: 尽管战争和恐怖主义不断恐吓我们，我们却再也没有看到二十世纪那种标志性的大规模种族灭绝。
en: And while war and terror continue to horrify us, we are not witnessing anything on the scale of the genocides that were a hallmark of the twentieth century.

zh: 幸运的是这种大趋势很可能会持续下去，据宾大世界图表研究项目 — — 对全球经济增长的总结性信息的最佳数据来源 — — 发布的数据 ， 。
en: Fortunately, these major trends are likely to continue, according to data from the Penn World Table research project, the best source for summary information on global economic growth.

zh: 平均实际（撇除通胀后）人均国内生产总值显示1980年的世界比1950年提升了80 ％ ， 而2010年又比1980年提升了80 % ， 换句话说，我们的物质生活丰富程度较1950年提升了三倍。
en: The PWT data on average real (inflation-adjusted) per capita GDP show that the world in 1980 was 80% better off than it was in 1950, and another 80% better off in 2010 than it was in 1980. In other words, our average material wellbeing is three times what it was in 1950.

zh: 全球物质生活的三倍提升可能听起来很多，但其实也是被低估了的。
en: Tripling global material wellbeing may sound like a lot, but if anything it’s a low estimate.

zh: 我们用所有商品和服务的产量来衡量GDP，但却未合理计算那些存在但无法衡量的价值 — — 例如那些社交媒体用户不花一分钱就享受到的服务所产生的巨大利益。
en: The way we measure real GDP accounts for all the goods and services being produced, but it doesn’t properly account for value that exists but cannot be measured – such as the immense benefits that accrue to social-media users from services that cost them nothing.

zh: 更重要的是我们正在生产一些通过使用价值而非市场价值来促进社会福祉的商品。
en: More than ever before, we are producing commodities that contribute to social welfare through use value rather than market value.

zh: 有人会说这不是什么新鲜事，但只要考虑到我们现在花大量时间与各类信息技术系统互动，而其中的收入流顶多只是一个与附加广告捆绑在一起的涓涓细流，就知道这种说法是错误的。
en: Some would argue that this is nothing new, but that argument is unpersuasive, given the sheer bulk of time we now spend interacting with information-technology systems where the revenue flow is, at most, a tiny trickle tied to ancillary advertising.

zh: 宾大世界图表数据也允许我们按国家排序，因此我们可以看看占全球人口30%的中国和印度的情况。
en: The PWT data also allow us to sort by country, so let’s consider the cases of China and India, which comprise 30% of humanity.

zh: 中国的人均实际GDP在1980年时比世界平均水平低60 ％ ， 如今则高出25 ％ 。
en: China’s real per capita GDP in 1980 was 60% lower than the world average, but today it is 25% above it.

zh: 而1980年时的印度实际人均GDP低于世界平均水平70％以上，如今已经缩短了一半的差距。
en: India’s real per capita GDP in 1980 was more than 70% below the world average, but India has since closed that gap by half.

zh: 这一进步是无可争议的;但是为了避免描画得过于美好，我们也应该考虑全球不平等状况，因为自1950年以来世界各国就没有显示出任何向着一个共有的繁荣水平靠拢的迹象。
en: This is indisputable progress of one kind; but, to avoid painting too rosy a picture, we should also consider global inequality. The world’s countries have shown no sign since 1950 of converging at a shared level of prosperity.

zh: 根据宾大全球图表的数据，1950年时有2/3的国家人均实际GDP高于或低于全球平均水平至少45 % ， 差距幅度可以高达225 ％ 。
en: According to the PWT data, two-thirds of all countries in 1950 had real per capita GDP veering above or below the global average by at least 45%, and by as much as 225%.

zh: 到1980年该一差距已经扩大到至少33 ％ ， 幅度达300 ％ ； 如今则是28％和360 ％ 。
en: By 1980, that spread had widened to at least 33% and as much as 300%; and today it is 28% and 360%, respectively.

zh: 但总体来说当今世界经济的个人平均指标比1980年更加平等。
en: Still, all told, the world economy is a more equal place for the average individual today than it was in 1980.

zh: 这在某种程度上要归功于一系列强有力的领导者，比如中国的邓小平和印度的拉吉夫·甘地。
en: This is partly thanks to a series of strong leaders, such as those in China since Deng Xiaoping, and in India since Rajiv Gandhi.

zh: 但目前还没有更多像中国和印���这样的大国挺身而出实现飞跃发展，也很少有观察家相信，中国国家主席习近平和印度总理莫迪有能力继承前辈的发展轨迹。
en: But there are no more countries as big as China and India to stand up and make significant leaps in development, and few observers are confident that Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi will match their predecessors’ growth legacies.

zh: 事实上，如果世界经济没有更多的机会去加快技术转移，同时更多国家从高速增长的发展中经济体持续成长为更稳定状态的发达经济体，那么长期、快速的发展的事例可能会成为历史。
en: Indeed, such episodes of prolonged, rapid growth may become a thing of the past if the world economy has no more opportunities to accelerate technology transfer, and if more countries continue to mature from high-growth developing economies to more steady-state developed economies.

zh: 虽然创新引擎本身可能真的会运行得更慢。
en: It may well be true that the engine of innovation itself will run more slowly.

zh: 但它仍然会继续运行，人们仍然会采用新技术，世界经济仍将增长。
en: But it will still run, and people will still adopt new technologies, and the world economy will still grow.

zh: 只要没发生恐怖主义核战争这类噩梦场景，你可以期望我的后继者们在2075年回顾往事，并欣喜地发现他们的世界也比我们今天要好上三倍。
en: Short of a nightmare scenario like terror-driven nuclear war, you can expect my successors in 2075 to look back and relish that, once again, their world is three times better off than ours is today.

zh: 在那之后的事情就更难预测了。
en: Beyond that, things are harder to predict.

zh: 如果我们不当即采取行动减缓和扭转全球温度变化趋势，气候变化将成为缠扰2080年后世界的幽灵。
en: If we fail to act now to slow and reverse global temperature trends, climate change will be the specter stalking the post-2080 world.

zh: 在这种情况下，我们的曾孙们就没什么需要感谢我们了。
en: In that case, our great-grandchildren will have little to thank us for.

zh: 经济增长的众多良方
en: Economic Growth’s Many Recipes

zh: 麻省，剑桥 — — 对贫穷社会的全面愿景总是统领有关发展的“宏大构想 ” 。
en: CAMBRIDGE, MA. -- Development “big think” has always been dominated by comprehensive visions about transforming poor societies.

zh: 从所谓的“大力推动”到“平衡增长 ” ， 从“华盛顿共识”到“第二代改革 ” ， 其重点总是飘忽不定。
en: From the so-called “Big Push” to “Balanced Growth,” from the “Washington Consensus” to “Second Generation Reforms,” the emphasis has been on wholesale change.

zh: 今天在发展问题上的风潮也不例外。
en: Today’s fashion in development is no different.

zh: 对于“管治”议程的盛行关注带来了大范围工作，力图在发展中国家重塑机制，作为经济发展的前提条件。
en: The prevailing obsession with the “governance” agenda entails a broad-based effort to remold institutions in developing societies as a prerequisite for economic growth.

zh: 联合国千年发展项目包含在人力资本、公共基础设施以及农业科技等领域大规模协调一致的投资推动。
en: The United Nations Millennium Project involves a large-scale, coordinated big push of investment in human capital, public infrastructure, and agricultural technologies.

zh: 但是，此类全面策略也有特立独行的异议人士，其中，赫希曼无疑最为突出。
en: But there have also been iconoclastic dissenters from such comprehensive approaches, among whom Albert Hirschman was without doubt the most distinguished.

zh: 实际上，联合国社会科学研究委员会已经认可了赫希曼具有创意的贡献，并且在今年以他的名字设立了一份奖项。
en: Indeed, Hirschman’s seminal contributions have now been recognized by the United States Social Science Research Council, which this year established a prize in his honor.

zh: 在其卓著的生涯中，赫希曼的治学兴趣从经济发展转移开来。
en: Hirschman’s interests shifted away from economic development over the course of his illustrious career.

zh: 但是，当他还在参与发展问题的辩论之计，他就会经常提醒世人，任何具有采取全面项目能力的国家从一开始就不是欠发达国家了。
en: But when he was still involved in development debates, he would frequently remind his contemporaries that any country that had the capacity to undertake comprehensive programs would not be underdeveloped to begin with.

zh: 的确，他曾经抨击加尔布雷斯提出一长串使得外国援助有效的先决条件。
en: Indeed, he once chided John Kenneth Galbraith for enunciating a long list of prerequisites for foreign aid to be effective.

zh: 赫希曼写道，如果发展中国家能够满足这些条件，它们就可以给美国提供外援了！
en: If developing countries could meet these conditions, he wrote, they would be in a position to send foreign aid to the United States!

zh: 赫希曼相信，经济发展的可能性并非全面理论想要人们相信的那样有局限。
en: Hirschman believed that the possibilities for economic development are not nearly as constrained as comprehensive theories would lead us to believe.

zh: 欠发展问题独有的不平衡创造了决策者们可以抓住的机遇。
en: The imbalances specific to underdevelopment create opportunities that policymakers can seize on.

zh: 我们不应当依赖于外国的时尚观点，而是需要进行试验并且寻找独特的解决之道，让我们规避限制发展的社会结构。
en: Instead of relying on fads emanating from abroad, we need to experiment and look for the unique solutions that will allow us to circumvent ingrained social structures that inhibit growth.

zh: 赫希曼有关发展问题的中心观点极为成功。
en: Hirschman’s central insights on development have held up extremely well.

zh: 过去半个世纪的主要经验就是决策者必须具有战略眼光，而不是面面俱到。
en: The key lesson of the last half-century is that policymakers must be strategic, rather than comprehensive.

zh: 他们不应当盼望他们可以让他们的社会全面转型，而是应当最大程度地利用现有条件。
en: They have to do the best with what they have instead of wishing they could transform their society wholesale.

zh: 他们需要确定重点和机遇并且在此基础上展开工作。
en: They need to identify priorities and opportunities, and work on them.

zh: 他们应当追求连续累积的变化，而非包罗万象、一蹴而就的突破。
en: They must seek sequential, cumulative change rather than a single, all-inclusive breakthrough.

zh: 成功的国家具有某些共同特点。
en: Successful countries do share some common features.

zh: 它们都提供某种程度的、有效的产权保护和强制履约，维持宏观经济稳定，努力融入世界经济，并且为产生效益的多样化和创新确保适当的环境。
en: They all provide some degree of effective property rights protection and contract enforcement, maintain macroeconomic stability, seek to integrate into the world economy, and ensure an appropriate environment for productive diversification and innovation.

zh: 但是实现这些目标的途径迥然不同。
en: But how these ends are achieved differs.

zh: 例如，更大程度地融入世界市场可以通过以下方式实现：韩国实行出口补贴，马来西亚采用出口加工区，新加坡推行跨国公司的投资优惠，中国实行经济特区，墨西哥缔结自由贸易协定，而智利则采纳进口开放。
en: For example, greater integration with world markets can be achieved via export subsidies (South Korea), export-processing zones (Malaysia), investment incentives for multinational enterprises (Singapore), special economic zones (China), regional free trade agreements (Mexico), or import liberalization (Chile).

zh: 最佳设计的政策总是取决于当地情况，利用现有优势并且努力克服国内限制条件。
en: The best-designed policies are always contingent on local conditions, making use of pre-existing advantages and seeking to overcome domestic constraints.

zh: 这就是为何成功的改革不能总是照搬。
en: That is why successful reforms often do not travel well.

zh: 毕竟，改革并非温室作物，可以随意在任何土壤中移植。
en: Reforms, after all, are not hothouse plants that can be transplanted at will in any soil.

zh: 而且，创造经济增长要求有的放矢，而不是面面俱到。
en: Moreover, generating economic growth requires hitting the right targets, not doing everything at once.

zh: 任何时候重要的问题都是减轻社会当前的强力局限，这也是为何不同的地方需要不同的政策。
en: What matters at any point in time is to alleviate a society’s immediate binding constraints – another reason why different policies are needed for different places.

zh: 二十世纪七十年代末期，农业供应激励不足限制了中国。
en: China was constrained by poor supply incentives in agriculture in the late 1970’s.

zh: 如今，巴��受到信贷不足的局限。
en: Today’s Brazil is constrained by inadequate supply of credit.

zh: 萨尔瓦多受制于缺乏外贸商品的生产激励。
en: El Salvador is constrained by inadequate production incentives in tradable goods.

zh: 津巴布韦则受到不良管治之苦。
en: Zimbabwe is constrained by poor governance.

zh: 这些问题都要求采用不同的方式来释放增长潜力。
en: These problems all require different methods for unlocking growth.

zh: 我们所需要的是有所选择、目标明确的改革，而不是一张洗衣清单。
en: What we need is selective, well-targeted reforms, not a laundry list.

zh: 各国如果不利用高速增长时期来加强其机制基础就会陷入困境。
en: Countries run into trouble when they do not use high-growth periods to strengthen their institutional underpinnings.

zh: 两种机制尤其需要加强。 一是冲突管理机制来增强经济对抗外部冲击的韧性，二是促进高效多样化的机制。
en: Two kinds of institutions in particular need shoring up: conflict management institutions to enhance economies’ resilience to external shocks, and institutions that promote productive diversification.

zh: 七十年代末期，由于第一种机制软弱，非洲的增长崩溃。 九十年代早期，由于第二种机制无力，拉美的发展失败了。
en: Growth collapsed in Africa in the late 1970’s because of the weakness of the former, and fizzled in Latin America after the first half of the 1990’s because of the weakness of the latter.

zh: 这一思路对于设计合适的全球经济安排具有极大的影响。
en: This line of thinking has vast implications for the design of appropriate global economic arrangements.

zh: 赫希曼对于世界贸易组织和国际货币基金组织当前侵入各国国内决策的程度一定会感到惊讶。
en: Hirschman would be aghast at the extent of intrusion into domestic policymaking that the World Trade Organization or the International Monetary Fund engage in nowadays.

zh: 由于国际官僚喜好所谓“最佳实务”和共同标准，这些机构根本难以做到寻求具有创新性、适应各国特殊国情的独特的途径。
en: As international bureaucracies with a penchant for “best practices” and common standards, these institutions are woefully unsuited to the task of seeking innovative, unique pathways suited to each country’s particular circumstances.

zh: 但是赫希曼同样也会指责发展中国家政府，因为它们没有履行其责任并把责任如此随便地交给了外部机构。
en: But Hirschman also would no doubt chide developing country governments for not living up to their responsibilities and for passing on the buck so freely to these external agencies.

zh: 因为在最后，还是要由各国来说 ： “ 谢谢，但是我们不需要；我们用自己的方法处理。 ”
en: For, ultimately, it is up to each country to say, “Thanks, but no, thanks; we’ll do it our way.”

zh: 许多经济学家对赫希曼的策略感到怀疑，因为这些策略并不符合这些经济学家一贯训练所实施的经济学理论。
en: Many economists were skeptical about Hirschman’s approach because they could not quite fit it into the economics they had been trained to practice.

zh: 但是多年来，经济学也变得丰富多彩。
en: But, over the years, economics has become richer, too.

zh: 动态模型变得更为平常 ， “ 次佳实务”经济学蓬勃涌现，政治经济学成为主流，而行为经济学则对“理性参与者”提出了质疑。
en: Dynamic models have become much more common, an economics of the “second-best” has flourished, political economy has become mainstream, and behavioral economics has thrown the “rational actor” into doubt.

zh: 结果，赫希曼要比自己想象得越发不如此特立独行。
en: As a result, Hirschman looks less and less the maverick that he fancied himself to be.

zh: 常规智慧可能最终与他并驾齐驱。
en: Conventional wisdom may finally be catching up with him.

zh: “半个面包”增长
en: Half-a-Loaf Growth

zh: 米兰—在经济增长萎靡的时期，全球各国都在尝试构思和实施刺激和维持复苏的战略。
en: MILAN – At a time of lackluster economic growth, countries around the world are attempting to devise and implement strategies to spur and sustain recovery.

zh: 这里的关键词是战略：要想成功，决策者必须保证这些措施能开放经济、提振公共投资、加强宏观经济稳定、增加市场恢复力、资源配置激励以合理且完整的方案实施。
en: The key word is strategy: to succeed, policymakers must ensure that measures to open the economy, boost public investment, enhance macroeconomic stability, and increase reliance on markets and incentives for resource allocation are implemented in reasonably complete packages.

zh: 只追求其中几个目标所产生的结果会大大下降。
en: Pursuing only some of these objectives produces distinctly inferior results.

zh: 中国就是一个绝佳的例子。
en: China provides a telling example.

zh: 1978年邓小平启动“改革开放”政策之前，中国公共部门投资相对较高。
en: Before Deng Xiaoping launched the policy of “reform and opening up” in 1978, the country had relatively high levels of public-sector investment.

zh: 但中央计划经济缺少市场激励，也基本对全球经济的主要商品、投资和技术市场封闭。
en: But the centrally planned economy lacked market incentives and was largely closed to the global economy’s major markets for goods, investment, and technology.

zh: 结果，公共投资回报十分平庸，中国经济表现也十分低下。
en: As a result, returns on public investment were modest, and China’s economic performance was mediocre.

zh: 中国的经济转型起始于20世纪80年代在农业部门中引入市场激励。
en: China’s economic transformation began with the introduction in the 1980s of market incentives in the agricultural sector.

zh: 随后是逐渐向全球经济开放的过程，这一过程在20世纪90年代有所加速。
en: These reforms were followed by a gradual opening to the global economy, a process that accelerated in the early 1990s.

zh: 经济增长大踏步向前，公共投资回报也大幅上升，改革是时候不久年GDP增长率就达到了9%以上。
en: Economic growth surged ahead, and returns on public investment soared, reaching an annual growth rate above 9% of GDP, shortly after the reforms were implemented.

zh: 成功增长战略的关键是确保政策之间要相互加强和强化。
en: The key to a successful growth strategy is to ensure that policies reinforce and enhance one another.

zh: 比如，提振公共投资回报 — — 对任何增长计划，这一点都是关键 — — 需要相辅相成的政策和条件，从资源配置到制度环境在内的诸多领域都是如此。
en: For example, boosting returns on public investment – critical to any growth plan – demands complementary policies and conditions, in areas ranging from resource allocation to the institutional environment.

zh: 就效率而言，一揽子政策要大于各部分之和。
en: In terms of effectiveness, the policy package is more than the sum of its parts.

zh: 当然，政策组合的具体内容要根据一国发展阶段而定；早期阶段增长动态与中等收入和发达国家截然不同。
en: Of course, the specific portfolio of policies varies depending on the stage of a country’s development; early-stage growth dynamics are distinctly different from those in middle-income and advanced countries.

zh: 但重要性是一样的。
en: But the imperative is the same.

zh: 正如发展中的中国在实施了全面一揽子政策后才实现了高速增长，如今挣扎于重塑可持续增长模式的发达国家发现，全面的政策计划组合只能产生缓慢复苏和低于潜力的增长和就业创造。
en: Just as a developing China achieved rapid growth only when a comprehensive policy package was implemented, the advanced countries struggling to restore sustainable growth patterns today have found that incomplete policy packages produce slow recoveries and below-potential growth and job creation.

zh: 以欧盟和美国在危机后的表现为例。
en: Consider the post-crisis performance of the European Union and the United States.

zh: 尽管两大经济体问题相似，但美国的表现要更好一些（尽管它仍面临创造中等收入就业机会的巨大挑战 ） 。
en: Though both have had their share of problems, the US is performing somewhat better (though it still faces major challenges in generating middle-income employment).

zh: 区别不在于美国实施了以公共部门投资为核心的大规模财政刺激；美国没有实施这类刺激，尽管包括我在内的许多经济学家认为这能产生更快的复苏和更强的长期增长。
en: The difference is not that the US launched a large fiscal stimulus focused on public-sector investment; no such stimulus was implemented, though many economists, including me, believe that it would have generated a faster recovery and stronger long-term growth.

zh: 区别也不在于美国政治效率更高；没人会认为美国政府今天的运转情况优秀，因为党派之争日益激烈，对政府合理角色的争论也日益尖锐。
en: Nor is the difference greater political effectiveness; few would say that the US government is functioning well nowadays, given rising partisanship and sharp disagreement about its proper role.

zh: 美国经济受益于两个因素：它的结构弹性更大、相对欧洲活力更足；以及美联储权力更广，实施了远比欧洲央行更激进的货币政策。
en: The US economy has benefited from two factors: its greater structural flexibility and dynamism relative to Europe, and the broader mandate of the US Federal Reserve, which has pursued a far more aggressive monetary policy than has the European Central Bank.

zh: 尽管对这两大因素谁更重要还存在争议 — — 诚然，要作出比较十分困难 — — 但可以确定地说，这两大因素都起到了促进美国复苏的作用。
en: Though analysts differ on the relative importance of these two factors – and, indeed, it is difficult to weight them – it is safe to say that both played a role in facilitating the US recovery.

zh: 如今，欧洲将宝押在了增加公共部门投资上，将欧盟层面资金和国家投资计划相结合，也许还会辅之以欧盟财政规则的修改。
en: Europe is now placing a large bet on an increase in public-sector investment, using a combination of EU-level funding and national investment programs, perhaps augmented by a modification of the EU’s fiscal rules.

zh: 考虑到公共部门投资不足是增长萎靡的常见原因，这一步骤的方向是正确的。
en: Given that public-sector underinvestment is a common cause of subpar growth, this is a step in the right direction.

zh: 但光靠公共投资是不够的。
en: But public investment is not enough.

zh: 没有全面的结构改革鼓励私人投资和创新 — — 从而让经济能够做出调整并在全球化的技术推动型经济中竞争 — — 公共投资计划对增长的影响将令人无比失望。
en: Without complementary structural reforms that encourage private investment and innovation – and thus enable economies to adapt and compete in a global, technology-driven economy – a public-investment program will have a disappointingly weak impact on growth.

zh: 相反，债务融资的公共投资能产生短期刺激，但其代价是长期财政稳定。
en: Instead, debt-financed public investment will produce a short-run stimulus, at the cost of longer-term fiscal stability.

zh: 问题在于结构改革以难以实施闻名。
en: The problem is that structural reforms are notoriously difficult to implement.

zh: 首先，它们面临来自短期输家的政治抵制，包括得到现有僵化结构保护的公司和部门。
en: For starters, they face political resistance from short-run losers, including the companies and sectors that existing rigidities protect.

zh: 此外，为了确保这些改革最终能让所有人受益，必须有强大的��任文化和决心以防止更灵活的安排导致滥用。
en: Moreover, in order to ensure that such reforms ultimately benefit everyone, there must be a strong culture of trust and a determination to prevent more flexible arrangements from leading to abuses.

zh: 最后，结构改革需要时间才能见效。
en: Finally, structural reforms require time to take effect.

zh: 欧元区尤其如此。 加入共同货币区时，欧元区成员国放弃了加速过程的关键工具 — — 调整汇率以契合不同经济体的生产率水平。
en: This is particularly true in the eurozone, whose members abandoned a crucial tool for accelerating the process – exchange-rate adjustments to account for different economies’ productivity levels – when they adopted the common currency.

zh: 欧洲央行行长德拉吉最近指出，因为个体欧盟国家的拖累增长的政策产生了消极外部效应，也许它们不应该成为某些政策领域的核心政策。
en: ECB President Mario Draghi recently argued that, because individual EU countries’ growth-retarding policies have negative external effects, perhaps they should not have unimpeded control in certain policy areas.

zh: 尽管成员国的金融监督权已经因为银行监管和破产清算机制的集中化而受到了限制，但德拉吉的建议仍具有深远意义。
en: Though member countries’ financial supervisory authority is already being limited through centralization of bank regulation and resolution mechanisms, Draghi’s suggestion is more far-reaching.

zh: 你也许会质疑德拉吉的建议在欧盟环境下是否具有政治可行性。
en: One wonders if Draghi’s proposal is politically feasible in the EU context.

zh: 即使答案是肯定的，也还有必要性问题。
en: Even if it were, would it be necessary?

zh: 所有经济体都有次结构，这些次结构的经济生产率、增长和活力彼此大不相同。
en: All economies have sub-units across which economic productivity, growth, and dynamism vary considerably.

zh: 事实上，治理质量和政策差异似乎是持久存在的，即使总体表现相当漂亮的经济体也是如此。
en: Indeed, differentials in the quality of governance and policies seem persistent, even in economies that perform pretty well overall.

zh: 也许一部分答案在防止次结构 — — 在欧盟的例子中就是成员国 — — 在改革方面落后。
en: Perhaps part of the answer is to prevent sub-units – in the EU’s case, member countries – from falling short on reforms.

zh: 但集中也有其成本。
en: But centralization carries its own costs.

zh: 押注于政策趋同有其内在风险，因此劳动力流动性 — — 它让宝贵的人力资本特别是教育程度较高的年轻人离开落后地区，前往能提供更多更好就业机会的地区 — — 能成为调整的关键工具。
en: Given the risk inherent in betting on policy convergence, labor mobility – which enables highly valuable human capital, especially well-educated young people, to leave lagging regions for those that offer more and better employment opportunities – could prove to be a critical tool for adjustment.

zh: 目前的情况，劳动力流动性在欧盟并不完美。
en: As it stands, labor mobility is imperfect in the EU.

zh: 但是，随着语言培训和类似于里斯本增长和就业战略（旨在创造创新型“学习经济 ” ， 以包容性社会和环境政策为基础）的政策的实施，流动性能够得到强化。
en: But, with language training and the implementation of something like the Lisbon strategy for growth and jobs (which aimed to create an innovative “learning economy,” underpinned by inclusive social and environmental policies), mobility could be enhanced.

zh: 但增强劳动力流动性并非万灵丹。
en: But more fluid labor mobility is no panacea.

zh: 与其他所有增长战略要素形成互相强化效应是实现成功的唯一办法。
en: As with every other element of a growth strategy, mutually reinforcing efforts are the only way to achieve success.

zh: 有半个面包也许比什么都没有更好，但只有一半要素是无法产生一半的想要结果的。
en: Half a loaf may be better than none, but half the ingredients do not translate into half of the hoped-for results.

zh: 增长难题
en: The Growth Conundrum

zh: 伯克利 — — 世界正面临一个重大难题。
en: BERKELEY – The world faces a major dilemma.

zh: 虽然过去50年经济快速增长对支持经济发展至关重要，但我们现在已经了解增长也能带来严重的不良后果，特别是在环境领域。
en: While rapid economic growth, such as that realized over the past 50 years, is critical to support development, we now also know that it can have serious adverse consequences, particularly for the environment.

zh: 我们该如何平衡必要的增长与可持续性之间的关系？
en: How can we balance the imperatives of growth and development with the need to ensure sustainability?

zh: 超10亿人已在过去20年来人均收入前所未有的增长中脱贫。
en: The unprecedented growth of per capita income during the last 20 years has lifted more than one billion people out of extreme poverty.

zh: 发展中国家预期寿命自20世纪70年代中期以来延长了20年，且过去30年来成人文盲率几乎降低了一半左右。
en: In developing countries, life expectancy has increased by 20 years since the mid-1970s, and the illiteracy rate among adults was almost halved in the last 30 years.

zh: 但经济快速发展已经给环境造成了巨大的压力。
en: But rapid economic growth has placed enormous pressure on the environment.

zh: 此外，经济发展还造成收入差距不断拉大，现在在很多国家已经达到历史高位（尽管世界各国间缩小了这种收入差距 ） 。
en: Moreover, it has been accompanied by rising income inequality, which has now reached historic highs within many countries (though, across countries, such inequality has declined).

zh: 有鉴于此，有人可能认为经济增长放缓对世界有利。
en: Given this, one might argue that slower growth would be good for the world.

zh: 经济增长放缓已经近在咫尺。
en: In that case, the solution would be at hand.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院（MGI）新近发布的报告显示，全球诸多国家人口老龄化及生育率下降可能会在今后50年显著抑制全球经济。
en: According to a new report by the McKinsey Global Institute (MGI), aging populations and declining fertility rates in many parts of the world could dampen global growth considerably over the next 50 years.

zh: 事实上，即便生产率仍以与近半个世纪相同的速度增长，全球经济增长仍将下降40 % ， 上述状况还远比不上过去5年本已乏力的增长率。
en: Indeed, even if productivity were to expand at the same rapid rate as during the last half-century, global growth would fall by 40%, far below the anemic rate of the last five years.

zh: 就业增长也将显著放缓。
en: Employment growth is also set to slow significantly.

zh: 这样一来，即便人口增长速度放缓，人均收入增长也将下降约19 % 。
en: As a result, even with slower population growth, per capita income growth would fall by about 19%.

zh: 可以肯定，未来50年GDP仍将增长到原来的3倍，而人均收入仍将实现两倍的增幅。
en: To be sure, GDP would still triple, and per capita income would double, over the next 50 years.

zh: 但这样的长期增长率仍与过去50年6倍的GDP增长和近3倍的人均收入增长不可同日而语。
en: Nonetheless this rate of long-term growth would constitute a sharp break with the six-fold GDP expansion and nearly three-fold increase in per capita income of the last 50 years.

zh: 虽然经济放缓尤其在环保领域确有其潜在的好处，但即将到来的经济增速放缓所伴随的风险也不可小觑。
en: Despite its potential benefits, especially for the environment, the impending growth slowdown carries significant risks.

zh: 虽然增长本身不是目的，但它能实现一系列社会目标，包括为成百上千万弱势群体和穷人创造经济就业机会并提供社会商品，比方说教育、医疗和养老保险。
en: While growth is not an end in itself, it enables the achievement of a broad set of societal goals, including the creation of economic and employment opportunities for millions of vulnerable and poor people and the provision of social goods like education, health care, and pensions.

zh: 那么，尽管有着人口和环境等诸多制约因素，我们如何确保这些需求能得到满足？
en: So how do we ensure that these imperatives are fulfilled, despite demographic and environmental constraints?

zh: 通过提高生产率确保经济增长是一个开始。
en: The first step is to secure economic growth through productivity gains.

zh: 生产率增长是必要的加速器，完成保持GDP总量增长所需的80%生产率增长和人均收入增长所需的22%生产率增长其相关任务非常艰巨。
en: The needed acceleration in productivity growth – by 80% to sustain overall GDP growth and by 22% to sustain per capita income growth at the rates of the last half-century – is daunting.

zh: 但根据对五大经济部门的案例研究，麦肯锡全球研究院发布报告认为虽然不靠无法预见的技术进步实现这一目标“难度巨大 ” ， 但却并非绝无可能。
en: But, based on case studies in five economic sectors, the MGI report finds that achieving it, though “extremely challenging,” is possible – and without relying on unforeseeable technological advances.

zh: 四分之三的生产率提升可以源于“追赶型”增长，即各国采取措施实现零售部门现代化、完成对汽车制造业的兼并整合、提高医疗效率及控制食品加工中的浪费，这些措施的效果已经在诸多国家得到过证实。
en: Three-quarters of the potential pickup in productivity could come from “catch-up” improvements, with countries taking steps – modernizing their retail sectors, consolidating automobile production into a smaller number of larger factories, improving health-care efficiency, and reducing food-processing wastage – that have already proven effective elsewhere.

zh: 其余则可以源于技术、运营和商业创新 — — 比方说研发新种子提高农业产量、利用新材料（如碳纤维复合材料）生产更轻、更牢固的汽车飞机以及数字化病例。
en: The rest can come from technological, operational, and business innovations – for example, developing new seeds to increase agricultural yields, using new materials (such as carbon-fiber composites) to make cars and airplanes lighter and more resilient, or digitizing medical records.

zh: 另一个显著增长机会在于提高妇女就业和生产率。
en: Another significant growth opportunity lies in boosting the employment and productivity of women.

zh: 如今只有约半数的劳动年龄女性实现了就业。
en: Today, only about half of the world’s working-age women are employed.

zh: 她们的收入约为同行业男性收入的四分之三，其中有很大比例从事低效和临时的非正式工作。
en: They earn about three-quarters as much as men in the same occupations, and are over-represented in informal, temporary, and low-productivity jobs.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院估计提升女性人口劳动参与率可以使未来半个世纪的潜在劳动力增长接近60 ％ 。
en: MGI estimates that increasing women’s labor-force participation rate could contribute almost 60% of potential labor-force growth during the next half-century.

zh: 实现这一目标需要雇主和政府消除妨碍女性入职、留任和晋升的歧视性做法，并实行协助劳动者平衡工作及家庭责任的信贷、税收和家庭支持政策。
en: Realizing this potential will require efforts by both employers and governments to eliminate discriminatory practices that impede the recruitment, retention, and promotion of women, as well as credit, tax, and family support policies to help workers balance their responsibilities at work and at home.

zh: 此外，为减轻持续快速增长对环境的影响，各国必须大幅提高其资源利用效率。
en: Meanwhile, in order to mitigate the environmental impact of continued rapid growth, the world must improve its resource efficiency considerably.

zh: 麦肯锡全球研究院及其他机构已经寻找到源于明智利用有限资源的诸多对生态负责任的增长机会。
en: MGI and others have identified numerous ecologically responsible growth opportunities emanating from the smarter use of limited resources.

zh: 以提高能源效率为例，完全可以实现从现在起到2020年预计能源需求减半的任务。
en: Consider improvements in energy efficiency, which could halve projected energy demand between now and 2020.

zh: 世界第八大经济体加利福尼亚的经历已经证明严格的能效标准在现实中完全可以有利于经济增长和就业。
en: As California – the world’s eighth-largest economy – has demonstrated, strict energy-efficiency standards can actually be good for growth and jobs.

zh: 事实上，在过去30年美国其他地区人均能源需求增加50%的情况下，诸如此类的政策在不影响经济增长的前提下并未增加加利福尼亚的人均能源需求。
en: Indeed, such policies have kept California’s per capita energy demand constant for the last three decades – even as such demand grew by 50% in the rest of the United States – without compromising growth.

zh: 因为可以导致巨大的成本节约，我们有充足的商业和消费理由提高资源生产率。
en: There is a strong business and consumer case for improving resource productivity, as it could lead to substantial cost savings.

zh: 幸运的是，支持实现上述目标的政策在发达国家和发展中国家都正在悄然兴起。
en: Fortunately, policies that support this goal are gaining momentum in developed and developing countries alike.

zh: 即使女性参与劳动和提高资源节约型生产率能够保持经济高速发展，一个关键的挑战依然是收入差距。
en: Even if gains in female labor-force participation and resource-efficient productivity growth sustain high rates of economic growth, one key challenge remains: income inequality.

zh: 事实上，增长和收入差距之间的关系并不简单；毕竟，收入差距在增长缓慢的发达国家和快速增长的发展中国家都有扩大的趋势。
en: In fact, there is no simple relationship between growth and income inequality; after all, inequality has been increasing in both slow-growing developed economies and fast-growing emerging economies.

zh: 法国经济学家托玛斯·皮克提认为当资本回报率超过经济增长时收入不平等增加，也就是说经济快速增长本身对不平等现象构成抑制。
en: According to the French economist Thomas Piketty, income inequality rises when the return on capital exceeds economic growth, meaning that, by itself, faster economic growth would reduce inequality.

zh: 国际货币基金组织经济学家用其他方法也发现了缩小收入差距和快速增长之间呈正相关，并认定再分配政策可以增加经济增长速度并提高持续性。
en: Using a different approach, economists at the International Monetary Fund also find a positive relationship between lower income inequality and faster growth, concluding that policies that redistribute income can foster faster, more sustainable growth.

zh: 经济增长仍具有重要意义。
en: Growth still matters.

zh: 随着人口环境的影响从正面转为负面，更加凸显出急迫的环境问题，如何在提高资源利用效率的同时促进更具包容性的经济增长成为企业和政府需要认真思考的问题。
en: As demographic tailwinds turn into headwinds, and environmental challenges become ever more apparent, businesses and governments need to think carefully about how to improve resource efficiency while fostering more inclusive economic growth.

zh: 特朗普的外国仰慕者
en: Trump’s Foreign Admirers

zh: 坎布里奇—唐纳德·特朗普不喜欢拉丁美洲人，还鼓吹建一道墙把他们与美国隔离开。
en: CAMBRIDGE – Donald Trump doesn’t like Latin Americans and advocates building a wall to separate them from the United States.

zh: 与往常的这类冷漠相比，拉丁美洲人总要以牙还牙，正如穆斯林和其他感到被这位共和党总统提名人冒犯的人一样。
en: As usual with such snubs, Latin Americans tend to reciprocate the sentiment, as do Muslims and others who feel affronted by the Republican Party’s presidential nominee.

zh: 但许多讨厌特朗普的人对于限制性的移民政策却是无比热衷。
en: But many of those who dislike Trump share his passion for restrictive immigration policies.

zh: 对社会很有利的东西被描述为很恶劣，这样的公共政策领域少之又少。
en: There are probably few areas of public policy where something that is so good for society is portrayed as being so bad.

zh: 当然，将社会问题归咎于外国替罪羊是政治老把戏。
en: Of course, projecting a society’s problems onto foreign scapegoats is an old political tactic.

zh: 但移民的积极效应显而易见，而对他们的敌意如此之深，这着实令人震惊。
en: But the extent to which hostility to immigration goes against the evidence of its salutary effects is surprising.

zh: 关于移民的最新研究表明，移民对本地人的福利具有巨大的积极效应。
en: Recent research on immigration shows very large positive effects on the welfare of locals.

zh: 比尔和莎莉·科尔（Bill and Sari Kerr）指出，移民仅占美国人口的13 % ， 但贡献了26%的企业家，36%的新企业领导团队中至少有一名移民。
en: Bill and Sari Kerr have shown that, while immigrants represent about 13% of the US population, they account for 26% of all entrepreneurs, and about 36% of new firms have at least one immigrant in the leadership team.

zh: 这表明移民是美国经济活力和就业创造的重要生力军。
en: This suggests that immigration is a large part of the story behind American economic vitality and job creation.

zh: 不仅美国有这样的现象。
en: This is not a uniquely American phenomenon.

zh: 相反，这是一个普遍现象。
en: On the contrary, it’s pretty universal.

zh: 在智利，来自不相邻国家的移民成为企业家的可能性是本国居民的四倍。
en: In Chile, immigrants from non-neighboring countries are four times more likely to be entrepreneurs than natives.

zh: 在委内瑞拉，意大利、西班牙和葡萄牙移民（大多在20世纪五六十年代迁徙而来，其正规教育水平不如本国居民）成为企业家的可能性是本国居民的十倍。
en: In Venezuela, Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese immigrants, who moved there mostly in the 1950s and 1960s, and whose level of formal schooling was lower than that of the natives, were ten times more likely to be entrepreneurs.

zh: 哈佛大学的鲁比卡·尼德尔科斯卡（Ljubica Nedelkoska）发现，如今，2010年危机爆发后从希腊返回祖国的阿尔巴尼亚人纷纷成为企业家，提高了从未离开故土的阿尔巴尼亚人的就业和工资。
en: Today, Albanians returning to their country from Greece after the 2010 crisis there became entrepreneurs and increased the employment and wages of those who never left, as shown by Harvard’s Ljubica Nedelkoska.

zh: 我和胡安·何塞·奥巴克（Juan José Obach）正在进行的一项研究发现，在外国人较多的行业和地区工作的巴拿马人的薪酬显著高于外国人较少的场合的人。
en: In ongoing research with Juan José Obach, we found that Panamanians who work in industries and regions with more foreigners earn significantly more than those who work where foreigners are less prevalent.

zh: 这表明周围出现更多外国人符合本地人的利益。
en: This indicates that it is in the interest of the locals to have more foreigners around.

zh: 布鲁金斯学会的达尼·巴哈尔（Dany Bahar）和巴黎经济学院的西里尔·拉波波尔特（Hillel Rapoport）发现，一国的比较优势朝移民祖国的方向发展：新国家变得擅长生产旧国家成功造出来的东西。
en: Dany Bahar of the Brookings Institution and Hillel Rapoport of the Paris School of Economics have found that countries’ comparative advantage evolves toward that of their migrants’ countries of origin: the new country becomes good at producing what the old country successfully makes.

zh: 区别在于，一般而言，许多发展中国家的移民和外国就业政策比美国更加严格。
en: The difference is that, in general, many developing countries have more restrictive immigration and foreign employment policies than the US does.

zh: 这些政策也对移民造成了更大的消极效应，因为这些国家原本就不是很有吸引力的目的国。
en: Such policies also have larger negative effects on migration, because these countries are not the most attractive destinations to begin with.

zh: 以智利为例。 智利是拉丁美洲最富裕、也许也是最成功的国家之一，总是喜欢自比于澳大利亚、新西兰和加拿大等治理良好的资源富裕国。
en: Consider Chile, one of Latin America’s richest and arguably most successful countries, which likes to compare itself to Australia, New Zealand, and Canada, well-run countries that are rich in natural resources.

zh: 但如今智利变得故步自封：它没有在赶超更富裕的国家，并且在经济多样化方面遇到了麻烦。
en: But now Chile is in a rut: it is not catching up with richer countries, and it is having trouble diversifying its economy.

zh: 在探讨个中缘由时，比较自己与榜样的外国出生人口比例很有裨益。
en: As it ponders why, it would benefit from comparing itself to its role models in terms of the proportion of the population that is foreign-born.

zh: 在智利，这一比例不到2 % 。
en: In Chile, it is less than 2%.

zh: 澳大利亚、新西兰和加拿大分别为27 % 、 28 % 、 和20 % ， 这部分要归因于这些国家积极的移民政策。
en: In Australia, New Zealand, and Canada, it is 27%, 28%, and 20%, respectively, a consequence in part of these countries’ activist immigration policies.

zh: 积极的政策也帮助以色列在20世纪90年代初吸引了近一百万苏联犹太人，这相当于以色列人口的12 % 。
en: Activist policies were also behind the almost one million Soviet Jews that Israel attracted in the early 1990s, representing 12% of the Israeli population.

zh: 研究表明这场巨型实验对以色列经济和高技能本地人产生了巨大的积极效应。
en: Studies have shown that this huge experiment had very large positive effects on the economy and on skilled locals.

zh: 智利缺少移民有助于解释智利为何缺少企业家精神、创新和多样化。
en: The missing immigrants in Chile can help explain the dearth of entrepreneurship, innovation, and diversification.

zh: 为数甚少的来到智利的韩国人帮助复兴了智利纺织业。
en: The few Koreans that Chile let in helped revive its textile industry.

zh: 在这方面，哥伦比亚比智利糟糕得多。
en: Colombia is much worse than Chile in this regard.

zh: 在哥伦比亚，外国人仅占人口的不到0.3 % ； 事实上，海外哥伦比亚人口是哥伦比亚海外人口的15倍。
en: There, foreigners represent less than 0.3% of the population; indeed, there are more than 15 Colombians living abroad for every foreigner living in the country.

zh: 智利和哥伦比亚移民水平极低是否是因为外国需求低迷或本国壁垒高企？
en: Are the extremely low levels of immigration in Chile and Colombia a problem of low foreign demand or high domestic barriers?

zh: 这个问题可以通过研究一项正在进行中的非常可悲的实验回答：大量人口因为灾难性的经济和社会崩溃而从委内瑞拉移民。
en: This question can be answered by studying a very sad ongoing natural experiment: the massive emigration from Venezuela, owing to the country’s catastrophic economic and social implosion.

zh: 委内瑞拉人，包括最有才华的群体，一直在寻找移民对象。
en: Venezuelans, including the most talented, have been trying to find places to go.

zh: 如果你以为智利和哥伦比亚官僚有比限制移民更重要的事情，那你就错了。
en: You would be mistaken if you imagined that bureaucrats in Chile and Colombia had more important things to do than restricting immigration.

zh: 这两个国家接��的委内瑞拉人少之又少，远远不如哥斯达黎加、巴拿马、加拿大、西班牙、澳大利亚和美国。 智利和哥伦比亚在人口和技能水平方面都可以在这些国家中名列中游。
en: Both countries have been letting very few Venezuelans enter, proportionally fewer than Costa Rica, Panama, Canada, Spain, Australia, and the United States, countries that are at both ends of Chile and Colombia in terms of income or skill level.

zh: 比如，哥伦比亚以委内瑞拉没有给予同样待遇为由中止了针对委内瑞拉人的南方共同市场签证制度。
en: Colombia, for example, has suspended a Mercosur-based visa mechanism for Venezuelans on the grounds that Venezuela does not reciprocate.

zh: 这一决定不但冷血；也相当具有自伤力，因为这意味着哥伦比亚用委内瑞拉进入本国换取哥伦比亚人进入委内瑞拉。
en: This decision is not just heartless; it is patently self-destructive, for it assumes that Colombia is exchanging Venezuela’s access to its country for access by Colombians to Venezuela.

zh: 但对哥伦比亚来说，好处来自它所吸引的技能、企业家精神和多元化，而不是放行的人。
en: But the benefits to Colombia come from the skills, entrepreneurship, and diversity it attracts, not from the ones it lets go.

zh: 并且如今还有谁相去委内瑞拉？
en: And who would want to go to Venezuela these days, anyway?

zh: 要求对等对于特朗普来说毫无意义。
en: Invoking reciprocity is nonsense worthy of Trump.

zh: 坏移民政策的问题不仅局限于拉丁美洲。
en: The problem of bad immigration policies is not limited to Latin America.

zh: 比如，南非如果能通过更加自由的移民政策放松其技能和企业家精神约束，将受益良多。
en: South Africa, for example, would benefit enormously from relaxing its skills and entrepreneurship constraints through more liberal immigration policies.

zh: 但南非却反其道而行之。
en: But the country has instead moved in exactly the opposite direction.

zh: 特朗普想在美国实施的移民政策诡异地与他所不喜欢和不喜欢他的国家所采取的政策如出一辙。
en: The immigration policies that Trump wants for the US bear an eerie resemblance to the policies adopted in the countries he dislikes and that dislike him.

zh: 实施之后，特朗普极有可能寻找新的替罪羊。
en: If adopted, Trump would most likely seek new scapegoats.

zh: 但当前的替罪羊应该学会像讨厌特朗普一样讨厌自身的移民政策。
en: But the current scapegoats should learn to dislike their own immigration policies as much as they appear to dislike Trump.

zh: 为何反自由的民主会受欢迎？
en: Why Are Illiberal Democrats Popular?

zh: 布鲁塞尔 — “ 反自由的民主”在欧洲崛起，这是现时代最邪恶的趋势之一。
en: BRUSSELS – The rise of “illiberal democracy” in Europe is one of the most baneful trends of our time.

zh: 这些政权常常以一位领导人为核心，他通过支配 — — 有时甚至取消 — — 制衡制度集中权力。
en: These regimes are typically centered on a leader who concentrates power by overriding – and in some cases eliminating – institutional checks and balances.

zh: 俄罗斯的普京、土耳其的埃尔多安和匈牙利的欧尔班是这一现象最为显著的三个例子。
en: Russia’s Vladimir Putin, Turkey’s Recep Tayyip Erdoğan, and Hungary’s Viktor Orbán represent three of the most visible manifestations of this phenomenon.

zh: 但真正值得注意 — — 并且十分危险 — — 的是这些政权是如何能够保持公共支持的。
en: But what is really noteworthy – and dangerous – is how these regimes have been able to retain popular support.

zh: 控制电视、广播和报纸等传统媒体，当然是这些政权能够保持选举多数的原因之一。
en: Control over traditional media, like television, radio and newspapers, is of course one reason why these regimes maintain their electoral majorities.

zh: 但操纵，乃至赤裸裸地控制媒体，无法解释反自由领导人受欢迎现象的持久性（民调说明了这一点 ） 。
en: But manipulation, or even outright control, of the media cannot explain the enduring popularity, borne out by opinion polls, of illiberal leaders.

zh: 这些领导人取得政治成功的关键原因是，这些政权尽管将自己定位为反西方，实际上遵循了所谓的华盛顿共识，即采取审慎的宏观经济政策和开放市场。
en: The key reason for these leaders’ political success is that these regimes, despite positioning themselves as anti-Western, have followed the so-called Washington Consensus, which prescribes prudent macroeconomic policies and open markets.

zh: 普京治下的俄罗斯是这一方针的模范，政府常常能够实现预算盈余，并积累了巨量外汇储备。
en: Russia under Putin is the poster child for this approach, with the government usually running budget surpluses and accumulating vast foreign-exchange reserves.

zh: 欧尔班治下的匈牙利也采取了审慎的财政政策；而埃尔多安自掌权以来，对土耳其也采取了同样的方针。
en: Hungary has also followed a prudent fiscal policy under Orbán; and Erdoğan has done the same in Turkey since coming to power.

zh: 这三个国家的公共债务因此已经降得很低，或（如匈牙利）正在下降。
en: Public debt in all three countries is thus either already low or (as in Hungary) declining.

zh: 在其中两个国家，政权的自由派前任因为让国家陷入金融危机而失去了信誉。
en: In two of these three cases, the regime’s liberal predecessors had lost credibility because they had led the country into a financial crisis.

zh: 反自由强人接受了华盛顿共识的基础 — — 长期而言，审慎宏观政策能带来更好的经济表现 — — 他们常常将宏观经济管理委托给与不参与政治的专家。
en: Illiberal strongmen have nonetheless accepted the basis of the Washington Consensus – that prudent macroeconomic policies deliver better economic performance in the long run – and have usually delegated macroeconomic management to apolitical experts.

zh: 他们抵挡住诱惑，不采取短期财政或货币刺激来提高支持率，而是依靠身份政治和来保持选举优势。
en: They have resisted the temptation to use short-term fiscal or monetary stimulus to increase their popularity, relying instead on identity politics to maintain electoral dominance.

zh: 长期的结果是经济表现相对稳定，选民也感到相对满意。
en: The longer-run result has been relatively solid economic performance – and relatively satisfied voters.

zh: 这与其他强人的方针形成了鲜明对比。 比如，已故的委内瑞拉领导人查韦斯用漫长的石油繁荣的收入来支撑慷慨的社会福利计划，以此来维持公共支持率。
en: This contrasts sharply with the approach of, say, Venezuela’s late strongman leader Hugo Chávez, who maintained popular support for 14 years by spending the proceeds of a long oil-price boom on generous social programs.

zh: 如今，石油价格较2014年下跌了大约一半，委内瑞拉再也没有现成的财政缓冲以维持进口，因此，查韦斯的继任者马杜罗正面临着一场灾难性的经济危机和日益升级的群众骚动。
en: Now, with oil prices down by roughly half since 2014 – and no fiscal cushion in place to sustain imports – Chávez’s successor, Nicolás Maduro, is confronting a catastrophic economic crisis and escalating popular unrest.

zh: 因此，审慎政策是政权维系的有效的长期策略。
en: Prudent policies thus amount to an efficient long-term strategy for regime preservation.

zh: 欧洲的反自由强人们认识到，如果挥霍无度导致金融危机，需要国际货币基金组织（IMF）的援助，他们掌权的日子也就时日无多了。
en: Europe’s illiberal strongmen have recognized that if overspending leads to a financial crisis and the need to seek assistance from the International Monetary Fund, their days in power will be numbered.

zh: 审慎的宏观经济政策支持了增长，但它们只有在经济保持相对自由的情况下才会有效。
en: Prudent macroeconomic policies support growth, but they can work only if the economy remains relatively free.

zh: 到目前为止，普京和埃尔多安都没有将他们的民族主义言辞和保护主义政策对应起来。
en: Until now, neither Putin nor Erdoğan have matched their nationalist rhetoric with protectionist policies.

zh: 相反，普京的俄罗斯加入了世界贸易组织，而埃尔多安也从未质疑土耳其与欧盟的关税同盟，即使土耳其与欧盟的关系越来越恶化。
en: On the contrary, Putin’s Russia joined the World Trade Organization; and Erdoğan has never called into question Turkey’s customs union with the European Union, even though bilateral relations with the EU have gone from bad to worse.

zh: 对强人们来说，长期的挑战是保持他们的反自由政治政权的经济自由。
en: The longer-term challenge for strongmen is to keep their illiberal political regimes economically liberal.

zh: 随着时间的推移，将越来越大的经济份额交给朋友和家庭控制的诱惑会越来越强，腐败也会跟着增加，因为主要矛盾变成了发展政治关系、讨好体制。
en: Over time, the temptation to hand over control of a growing share of the economy to friends and family becomes stronger, and corruption tends to increase, as the main game in town becomes developing political connections and currying favor with the regime.

zh: 到了这一步，增长就必然会开始下降。
en: When this happens, growth is bound to decline.

zh: 目前，这一长期威胁在俄罗斯最为明显。
en: This long-run threat is now most evident in Russia.

zh: 普京掌权正逢石油价格从历史低点开始上涨。
en: Putin happened to come to power at a time when oil prices began rising from a historic low.

zh: 因此，俄罗斯能够在随后的大宗商品超级周期中保持强劲增长不足为奇。 而最近，商品超级周期已经结束。
en: It was thus not surprising that Russia could grow strongly during the ensuing commodity super-cycle, which ended only recently.

zh: 石油价格繁荣期的宏观经济管理足够审慎，让普京政权能够抵挡最近的石油价格下滑。
en: Macroeconomic management during the oil-price boom had been prudent enough to allow the regime to withstand the recent fall in oil prices.

zh: 但如今，大宗商品周期超级周期已经结束了近三年，俄罗斯的前景看上去黯淡无光。
en: But now, nearly three years after the end of the commodity super-cycle, the outlook for Russia is bleak.

zh: 生活水平陷入了停滞；经济的潜在增长率人们广泛估计只有1.5 % — —这意味着俄罗斯将一直比欧洲其他国家更穷。
en: Living standards have stagnated; and the economy’s potential growth rate is widely estimated to be just 1.5% – a level implying that Russia will remain permanently poorer than the rest of Europe.

zh: 土耳其可能也已经抵达了类似的转折点。
en: Turkey might have reached a similar turning point.

zh: 埃尔多安的正义与发展党（AKP）接手的经济从深度金融危机中反弹，拜持续的城市化和人口教育水平提高所赐，土耳其经济具有巨大的增长潜力。
en: Erdoğan’s Justice and Development Party (AKP) inherited an economy that was rebounding from a deep financial crisis and had substantial growth potential, owing to ongoing urbanization and gains in the population’s educational level.

zh: 直到最近，AKP政府的干预都局限在国内经济事务上，比如政府采购和基础设施支出。
en: Until recently, the AKP’s government limited its interference to the domestic side of the economy, such as government procurement and infrastructure spending.

zh: 但在去年的未遂军事政变后，埃尔多安政权授权给自己没收由被控同情所谓的居伦运动（Gülenist movement）的人所拥有的企业。 埃尔多安指控居伦运动策划了政变。
en: But, after last year’s botched military coup, the regime has empowered itself to seize businesses owned by those accused of sympathizing with the so-called Gülenist movement, which Erdoğan accuses of having masterminded the coup attempt.

zh: 已有数百家企业被没收，划归埃尔多安亲信管理。
en: Hundreds of businesses have already been seized and placed under the administration of Erdoğan’s close associates.

zh: 如果这一趋势继续，企业家将停止投资，增长也将停滞。
en: If this continues, entrepreneurs will stop investing, and growth will falter.

zh: 问题在于，一旦反自由政权开始走这条路，就难以重新做出可信的尊重产权的承诺，因为在反自由的民主中确保这一点的制度 — — 比如司法独立和专业公务员队伍 — — 都已不复存在。
en: The problem is that once an illiberal regime has started down this road, it cannot easily re-establish a credible commitment to respect property rights, because the institutions that ensure this in liberal democracies, like an independent judiciary and a professional civil service, no longer exist.

zh: 今天的欧洲强人们通过保持长期繁荣所需要的相对经济自由来维持群众支持。
en: Today’s European strongmen have retained popular support by maintaining the relative economic freedom on which long-term prosperity depends.

zh: 但随着这些政权越来越极权，他们取悦选民的能力也变得越来越可疑。
en: But as these regimes become increasingly authoritarian, their ability to keep voters happy is becoming more and more doubtful.

zh: 巨富亚洲
en: Crazy Rich Asia

zh: 发自剑桥 — — 在最近一部爆红电影《摘金奇缘 》 （ Crazy Rich Asians，改编自新加坡作家关凯文2013年出版的一部小说）中，女主角纽约大学经济学教授瑞秋与男友一起前往新加坡与家人见面。
en: CAMBRIDGE – In the surprise hit movie “Crazy Rich Asians” (based on a 2013 Kevin Kwan novel), a New York University economics professor (Rachel), travels with her boyfriend to Singapore to meet his family.

zh: 到了那里她才发现自己的心上人尼克是一个亚洲豪门家族的继承人，而尼克的母亲则绝不容许儿子跟平民女子结婚 — — 不管她是不是亚裔美国人。
en: There, she learns, apparently for the first time, that her significant other (Nick) is heir to one of Asia’s largest fortunes and has a mother intent on making sure her son does not marry a commoner, Asian-American or not.

zh: 部分由于其（极为出色的）全华班演员团队（也非常罕见 ） ， 部分因为它勾起了人们对早期伟大浪漫喜剧时代的回忆，这部电影引起了巨大轰动，甚至可能为片中饰演强势但充满爱心的母亲角色的杨紫琼 （ 《 卧虎藏龙》的女主角）迎来一座迟到的奥斯卡小金人。
en: Partly because of its (terrific) all-Asian cast (an extreme rarity), and partly because it recalls earlier eras of great romantic comedies, the film has caused a lot of buzz. Perhaps there will even be a long overdue Oscar for Michelle Yeoh (from “Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon”), who plays the steely but loving mother.

zh: 但这部电影也展现了新加坡这个大多数西方人不甚熟悉的地方。
en: But the film also stars Singapore, a place unfamiliar to most Westerners.

zh: 对一些人来说，电影中真正令人震惊之处莫过于亚洲某些地区的巨富程度。
en: For some, the real shocker in the movie will be just how crazy rich parts of Asia have become.

zh: 如果想了解这座岛屿城市国家的迅速崛起，人们只需将《摘金奇缘》中那座闪闪发光的大都市与1940年由宾·克罗斯比（Bing Crosby ） ， 多萝西·拉穆尔（Dorothy Lamour）和鲍勃·霍普（Bob Hope）出演的经典喜剧《新加坡之路》中描绘的小渔村进行比较 ， 。
en: To get a sense of the island city-state’s meteoric rise, one need only compare the glittering metropolis depicted in “Crazy Rich Asians” with the hut-filled fishing village depicted in the 1940 classic comedy, “Road to Singapore,” starring Bing Crosby, Dorothy Lamour, and Bob Hope.

zh: 这种比较使人们很容易理解片中虚构的杨氏家庭如何通过早期房地产投资晋身超级富豪。
en: The comparison makes it easy to understand how the fictional Young family became ultra-rich as early real-estate investors.

zh: 作为一个2017年度年产出达3250亿美元并拥有560万居民的国家，新加坡目前在经济上可以与丹麦比肩（尽管其​​人口更加多样化 ） 。
en: With annual output of approximately $325 billion in 2017 and 5.6 million inhabitants, Singapore now ranks with Denmark economically (though its population is more diverse).

zh: 鉴于丹麦通常在全球生活质量调查中高居前列，上述比较就显得有点吹捧了。
en: This is a flattering comparison, given that Denmark typically ranks at or near the top in global quality-of-life surveys.

zh: 新加坡不像丹麦那样积极实施收入再分配，而是选择维持较低税收并集中转移支付给低收入人群。
en: Singapore does not redistribute income as aggressively as Denmark, choosing instead to maintain lower taxes and concentrate transfers on low-income individuals.

zh: 尽管如此，所有公民都可以获得高质量的医疗保险和学校教育，而且许多公民也有资格获得高额补贴住房。
en: Nevertheless, all citizens have access to high-quality health coverage and schooling, and many are also eligible for heavily subsidized housing.

zh: 在《摘金奇缘》中贫困被（相当巧妙且滑稽地）描绘为一场长途飞行，只不过是在经济舱而非头等舱而已。
en: In “Crazy Rich Asians,” poverty is depicted (rather ingeniously and hilariously) as a long-haul flight in economy rather than first class.

zh: 虽然亚裔美国人都为这部好莱坞主流中的亚洲演员突破之作感到欢欣鼓舞，但该片在新加坡国内却备受争议。
en: Although Asian Americans have embraced the film as a breakthrough for Asian actors in mainstream Hollywood productions, is hotly debated in Singapore itself.

zh: 尽管许多新加坡人为“CRA ” （ 该片在新加坡式英语中的简称）将催生旅游热潮而感到兴奋，但也有很多人发出了投诉。
en: Although many Singaporeans are excited that “CRA” (as it is called in Singlish) will catalyze a tourist boom, complaints are rife.

zh: 一是片中人物没有更多地使用新加坡式英语短语；二是片中根本没有提及这个城市国家内部庞大的印度和马来族群。
en: One is that the characters don’t use more Singlish phrases; another is that the city-state’s large Indian and Malay communities are invisible.

zh: 最重要的是针对杨氏家族的超大财富出现了民粹主义抵制声音，令人质疑为什么新加坡没有资本收益或遗产税。
en: Most of all, there is a populist backlash against the Young family’s outsize wealth, making some question why Singapore has no capital-gains or estate taxes.

zh: 尼克凭什么可以继承这么多钱？
en: Why should Nick be allowed to inherit so much money?

zh: 但这种抵制可能不如美国或欧洲人所期望的那样强烈。
en: But the backlash is perhaps less than an American or a European might expect.

zh: 这或许是因为中产阶级在新加坡独特的体制下日子过得不错，这个体系完全按照市场经济运行，但政府则在长期规划和投资中发挥着重要作用。
en: This may be because the middle class has done fairly under Singapore’s unique system, which is very much a market economy, but one where the government plays a big role in long-term planning and investment.

zh: 有人可能会愤世嫉俗地指出如果该国能减少媒体管制，那么抵制声音肯定会更加明显。
en: One might cynically say that the backlash would be much more visible if there were less restrictions on the media.

zh: 但可以肯定的一点是经济增长的放缓 — — 尤其是影响到中产阶级收入之时 — — 才是欧美民粹主义的主要推动因素，金融危机无疑加剧了这种趋势。
en: But surely slowing growth, especially where it affects middle-class incomes, has been a major driver of populism in Europe and the United States, exacerbated no doubt by the financial crisis.

zh: 虽然新加坡的增长也有所放缓，但它的日子仍然比欧洲要好过。
en: Although Singapore’s growth has also slowed, it still compares favorably to Europe.

zh: 新加坡金融管理局预测2018年的增长率将超过3 ％ ， 与众多发达经济体垂涎的美国相当。
en: The Monetary Authority of Singapore is forecasting that growth will exceed 3% in 2018, on par with the United States, which is now the envy of the advanced economies.

zh: 鉴于临近赤道地区通常伴随着增长疲软和贫困，新加坡的成功就显得更为显眼了。
en: Singapore’s success is all the more remarkable given that proximity to the equator is usually associated with weak growth and poverty.

zh: 更何况新加坡几乎就在赤道上（在《摘金奇缘》其中一段让人感觉不可思议的片段中，有人开着敞篷吉普车到机场接尼克和瑞秋 ） 。
en: Yet Singapore is situated virtually on top of it. (In one implausible scene in “Crazy Rich Asians,” Nick and Rachel are picked up at the airport in an open-air jeep.)

zh: 那些在会议上激辩究竟是“体制”还是“文化”对增长更为重要的增长经济学家都希望用继承了英国体制和中国文化元素的新加坡作为论据。
en: Economists who study growth almost come to blows at conferences over whether “institutions” or “culture” are more important to growth, with both sides seeking to take credit for Singapore, which inherited English institutions and elements of Chinese culture.

zh: 如今人们希望亚洲能在好莱坞文化中占据更大的份额，能有更多的电影去展现亚洲场景和演员。
en: And now, one hopes, Asia will become a bigger part of Hollywood culture, with more films featuring Asian locales and actors.

zh: 仅花费3000万美元（相比迪士尼预算超过3亿美元的《复仇者联盟：无限战争 》 ） 拍摄的《摘金奇缘》已经在全球获得了超过2亿美元的收入。
en: Produced for just $30 million (compared to over $300 million for Disney’s “Avengers: Infinity War”), “Crazy Rich Asians” has already grossed over $200 million worldwide.

zh: 这对于任何一部电影而言都是令人印象深刻的，尤其是对于那些以博弈论课程作为开篇的电影而言。
en: That’s impressive for any film, and perhaps especially for one that opens with a lesson in game theory.

zh: 在第一幕中，瑞秋使用扑克向全班的注视下演示了一个概念，而她还只是一名研究生教学助理。
en: In the first scene, Rachel uses poker to illustrate a concept to a large class sitting in rapt attention, and she schools a graduate teaching assistant.

zh: 当然大多数关于博弈论的课程都涉及很多关于战略关系的数学而不是玩游戏，但它们一样可以很有趣。
en: Of course, most courses on game theory involve a lot of mathematics about strategic relationships, not playing actual games.

zh: 比如普林斯顿大学教授阿维纳什·迪克西特（Avinash Dixit）使用《奇爱博士》等电影的片段来说明关键概念而闻名。
en: But they can be fun all the same. Princeton University Professor Avinash Dixit famously uses clips from films such as “Dr. Strangelove” to illustrate key concepts.

zh: 现在也许好莱坞会使用《摘金奇缘》这类电影来列举出一个在过去几十年间创下诸多经济奇迹之地的关键概念。
en: Now perhaps Hollywood will use films like “Crazy Rich Asians” to illustrate key concepts about a region that is the biggest economic success story of the last several decades.

zh: 别担心，类似的故事还有很多很多。
en: There are many more stories about that story to be told.

zh: 摆对经济模型的位置
en: Putting Economic Models in Their Place

zh: 伯克利—决策者向经济学家讨教时，他们期待获得基于科学的建议，而不是学术流派主义或政治预设。
en: BERKELEY – When policymakers turn to economists for guidance, they expect the advice they receive to be grounded in science, not academic factionalism or political presuppositions.

zh: 毕竟，他们所实施的政策会对真实的人民产生真实的影响。
en: After all, the policies they will be putting in place will have real implications for real people.

zh: 然而不幸的是，可靠的科学并不总是推动经济分析和政策建议背后的力量。
en: Unfortunately, however, sound science is not always the driving force behind economic analysis and policy recommendations.

zh: 纽约大学的保罗·罗默（Paul M. Romer）最近批评了他所谓的现代经济学的“数学性 ” ， 认为经济学家应该采取措施排除这个沉闷科学中的学术流派主义和政治学。
en: In a recent critique of what he calls the “mathiness” of modern economics, Paul M. Romer of New York University argues that economists should take measures to exclude academic factionalism and politics from the dismal science.

zh: 罗默的观点十分契合他所属领域的一场未完的争论 — — 思想在促进经济增长中的作用。
en: Romer grounds his case in an ongoing debate in his field about the role that ideas play in promoting economic growth.

zh: 罗默的主要担忧似乎是一些经济学家有一种倾向，将对于特定理论的真理称为对于一切理论的真理，因此适合真实世界。
en: Romer seems to be worried principally about some economists’ tendency to claim that what is true about certain types of theories is true of all theories and thus applicable to the real world.

zh: 作为这种倾向的一个例子，罗默援引了芝加哥大学经济学家罗伯特·卢卡斯（Robert Lucas）的工作。 他在2009年的论文《思想和增长 》 （ Ideas and Growth）中认为，书本或蓝图在促进增长中毫无用处。
en: As an example of this tendency, Romer cites the work of the University of Chicago economist Robert Lucas, who, in his 2009 paper “Ideas and Growth,” dismisses the role that books or blueprints can play in driving growth.

zh: “一些知识可以‘包含在’书本、蓝图、机器和其他实物资本中，并且我们知道如何将资本引入增长模型 ， ” 卢卡斯说 ， “ 但我们也知道这样做本身并不能提供持续增长的引擎。 ”
en: “Some knowledge can be ‘embodied’ in books, blueprints, machines, and other kinds of physical capital, and we know how to introduce capital into a growth model,” Lucas argued, “but we also know that doing so does not by itself provide an engine of sustained growth.”

zh: 问题在于卢卡斯的说法只适合一些经济增长模型，这些模型有严格的假设，即“包含的”资本回报会随着资本的积累趋近于零。
en: The problem is that Lucas’s statement is true only for models of economic growth that are specified in such a way that the return on “embodied” capital drops to zero as capital accumulates.

zh: 罗默指出，许多模型根本不这么假设。
en: As Romer notes, there are many models for which this is simply not true.

zh: 卢卡斯作为普遍真理所提出的东西 — — 经济增长之路不可能通过创造和获取“包含在”书本、蓝图和机器中的知识找到 — — 其基础是一个未受检验的决定，将注意力限制在少数几种模型上。
en: What Lucas makes out to be a general truth – that the path to economic growth cannot lie in creating and acquiring the kind of knowledge that is “embodied” in books, blueprints, and machines – rests on a barely examined decision to restrict attention to only a few kinds of models.

zh: 从某种程度上说，卢卡斯的决定是可以论证的，如果他所选择的模型是唯一的正确模型的话。
en: Lucas’s decision might be somewhat justifiable if the models he chose were the only ones that were correct.

zh: 但事实当然并非如此。
en: But of course that is not the case.

zh: 除了批评从个例推出普遍结论的做法外，罗默还将矛头指向了认为经济模型只允许一种互动模式和一种个体决策模式的人。
en: In addition to criticizing those that draw general conclusions from specific cases, Romer takes aim at those who claim that economic models permit only one mode of interaction and only one mode of individual decision-making.

zh: 罗默的主要反对点是一个假设：经济增长模型中唯一允许的互动式所谓的“价格接受 ” ， 即买卖商品和服务在由市场提供的当前价格水平上进行。
en: Romer’s principle objection is to the assumption that the only interaction allowable in economic growth models is what is known as “price taking,” the buying or selling of goods and services at the price currently offered by the market.

zh: 我要在此基础上增加我对另一个假设的反对：个体决策永远是理性预期的。
en: I would add to that my objection to the assumption that individual decision-making is always characterized by rational expectations.

zh: 这些假设也许足以成为构建模型帮助我们理解世界的基础，但只有在市场过程构造完全正确，平稳地在总量水平上排除所有有大量证据证明存在于个体水平上的偏离价格接受和理性预期的情况。
en: Assumptions like these might be adequate as foundations on which to build models to help us understand the world, but only if market processes were structured exactly right, smoothing out at the aggregate level all the deviations from price-taking and rational expectations that are clearly evident at the individual level.

zh: 要知道市场是否符合这些标准、哪些市场符合这些标准、何时符合这些标准是一个实证问题。
en: Asking whether, which, and when market processes meet such criteria is an empirical question.

zh: 宣布所有市场过程都必须如此构造理论“渎职 ” 。
en: Claiming that all market processes must be so structured is theoretical malfeasance.

zh: 而这一情况普遍存在。
en: And it is widespread.

zh: 在增长理论领域，罗默认为当前一代新古典派经济学家的论文无不引入了价格接受均衡的必要理论限制。
en: In the field of growth theory, Romer sees the current generation of neoclassical economists grind out paper after paper imposing the theoretical restrictions necessary for a price-taking equilibrium.

zh: 他正确地指出，这些论文除了让作者在学术地位博弈中取得进步外别无其他用处。
en: As he correctly notes, such papers are useless for any purpose other than advancing their authors’ positions in academic status games.

zh: 与此同时，在我的领域 — — 宏观经济学中，我看到经济学家、银行家、实业家、技术官僚和政客都宣称政府可以实施用来加速经济复苏的政策风险太大，甚至不利于生产。
en: Meanwhile, in my field, macroeconomics, I see economists, bankers, industrialists, technocrats, and politicians make the claim that the policies governments could implement to speed an economic recovery must be, if not counterproductive, at least too risky.

zh: 毕竟，这是极其严格的理性预期模型所预言的。
en: After all, that is what a model with a very restricted class of rational expectations would predict.

zh: 与此同时，我们应该认识到，罗默所指出的问题不是什么新问题。
en: At the same time, we should recognize that the problem Romer pinpoints is not a new one.

zh: 几天前我读到了加拿大经济学家雅各布·维纳（Jacob Viner）和法国经济学家艾蒂尼·芒图（Étienne Mantoux）对扩张性财政和货币政策的批评。
en: Just the other day, I came across critiques of expansionary fiscal and monetary policy made by the Canadian economist Jacob Viner and the French economist Étienne Mantoux.

zh: 他们在20世纪30年代（大萧条期间！ ）认为政府刺激就业的措施必然会产生令人厌恶的无端的通货膨胀，有可能导致长期产出下降。
en: They both argued in the 1930s (in the middle of the Great Depression!) that government efforts to boost employment would always result in undesirable and unwarranted inflation, and would probably reduce output in the long run.

zh: 罗默观点最令人担忧之处是注意到这个问题非常困难。
en: What is most depressing about Romer’s argument is how unlikely it is to be heeded.

zh: 罗默也许可以说服学界经济学家在做出与经济增长理论的普遍性有关的结论时更加谨慎。
en: Romer may be able to convince academic economists to be more cautious about making claims concerning the generality of theories of economic growth.

zh: 但银行家、实业家、技术官僚和政客 — — 他们负责制定和实施影响人民生活的政策 — — 是否也会这样做就不好说了。
en: But it is less than clear that bankers, industrialists, technocrats, and politicians – who are responsible for the policies that impact people’s lives – will do the same.

zh: 分化之年
en: A Year of Divergence

zh: 拉古娜海滩—在即将到来的明年 ， “ 分化”一词将成为全球经济主题，可以适用于经济趋势、政策和表现。
en: LAGUNA BEACH – In the coming year, “divergence” will be a major global economic theme, applying to economic trends, policies, and performance.

zh: 随着明年的临近，这些分化之势将越来越难以调和，让决策者面临一个选择：克服目前阻碍有效行动的障碍，或放任经济陷入动荡。
en: As the year progresses, these divergences will become increasingly difficult to reconcile, leaving policymakers with a choice: overcome the obstacles that have so far impeded effective action, or risk allowing their economies to be destabilized.

zh: 多速的全球经济将由四组国家主导。
en: The multi-speed global economy will be dominated by four groups of countries.

zh: 第一组以美国为首，经济表现将继续改善。
en: The first, led by the United States, will experience continued improvement in economic performance.

zh: 它们的劳动力市场将更加强劲，工资复苏伴随就业创造。
en: Their labor markets will become stronger, with job creation accompanied by wage recovery.

zh: 经济增长的好处的分配将不会像过去几年那样不平等，尽管已经获得好处的人还将拿走大部分好处。
en: The benefits of economic growth will be less unequally distributed than in the past few years, though they will still accrue disproportionately to those who are already better off.

zh: 第二组国家以中国为首，将稳定在比最近的历史平均水平更低的增长水平上，同时在结构上继续趋于成熟。
en: The second group, led by China, will stabilize at lower growth rates than recent historical averages, while continuing to mature structurally.

zh: 它们的经济模式将变得更加可持续 — — 间发的全球金融市场动荡会干扰这一努力但不会扼杀它们。
en: They will gradually reorient their growth models to make them more sustainable – an effort that occasional bouts of global financial-market instability will shake, but not derail.

zh: 它们还将致力于深化内部市场，改善监管框架，加强私人部门实力，扩大基于市场的经济管理范围。
en: And they will work to deepen their internal markets, improve regulatory frameworks, empower the private sector, and expand the scope of market-based economic management.

zh: 第三组国家以欧洲为首，将陷入艰苦斗争，因为持续的经济停滞将助长一些国家的社会和政治觉醒、让地区政策决定复杂化。
en: The third group, led by Europe, will struggle, as continued economic stagnation fuels social and political disenchantment in some countries and complicates regional policy decisions.

zh: 萎靡的增长、通缩压力和过度负债将拖累投资，带来下行风险。
en: Anemic growth, deflationary forces, and pockets of excessive indebtedness will hamper investment, tilting the balance of risk to the downside.

zh: 在挑战最严峻的经济体，失业特别是年轻人失业将继续处于值得警惕的高位并持续下去。
en: In the most challenged economies, unemployment, particularly among young people, will remain alarmingly high and persistent.

zh: 最后一组国家构成了“两可”国家，它们的规模和联系具有重要的系统影响力。
en: The final group comprises the “wild card” countries, whose size and connectivity have important systemic implications.

zh: 最显著的例子是俄罗斯。
en: The most notable example is Russia.

zh: 面对经济衰退深化、货币崩溃、资本外逃和进口收缩导致短缺的局面，总统普京将需要决定是否改变对乌克兰方针，与西方合作以换取制裁放松并构建更加可持续、多样化的经济。
en: Faced with a deepening economic recession, a collapsing currency, capital flight, and shortages caused by contracting imports, President Vladimir Putin will need to decide whether to change his approach to Ukraine, re-engage with the West to allow for the lifting of sanctions, and build a more sustainable, diversified economy.

zh: 另一个方案是试图通过扩大俄罗斯对乌克兰的干预转移国内群众的不满。
en: The alternative would be to attempt to divert popular discontent at home by expanding Russia’s intervention in Ukraine.

zh: 这一方针极有可能导致新一轮制裁和反制裁，使俄罗斯陷入更深的衰退 — — 甚至可能引发政治动荡或更大的外交冒险 — — 同时也深化欧洲的经济萎靡。
en: This approach would most likely result in a new round of sanctions and counter-sanctions, tipping Russia into an even deeper recession – and perhaps even triggering political instability or more foreign-policy risk-taking – while exacerbating Europe’s economic malaise.

zh: 巴西是另一个值得关注的两可国家。
en: Brazil is the other notable wild card.

zh: 险些输掉最近的选举的总统罗塞夫以释放出信号表示愿意改进宏观经济管理，包括阻止国家主义复萌。 眼下，国家主义复萌的潜在好处与其所造成的附带伤害和意外后果比起来不值一提。
en: President Dilma Rousseff, chastened by her near loss in the recent presidential election, has signaled a willingness to improve macroeconomic management, including by resisting a relapse into statism, the potential benefits of which now pale in comparison to its collateral damage and unintended consequences.

zh: 如果罗塞夫采取这一政策，巴西将与墨西哥一起稳定2015年的拉丁美洲，帮助该地区克服低油价扰动委内瑞拉经济带来的破坏效应。
en: If she delivers, Brazil would join Mexico in anchoring a more stable Latin America in 2015, helping the region to overcome the disruptive effects of a Venezuelan economy roiled by lower oil prices.

zh: 随着货币政策分歧的压力日趋增大，多速经济表现将带来多样化的央行政策，特别是在具系统重要性的发达经济体。
en: This multi-speed economic performance will contribute to multi-track central banking, as pressure for divergent monetary policies intensifies, particularly in the systemically important advanced economies.

zh: 美联储已经停止了其大规模长期资产购买操作，可能将于2015年三季度开始提高利率。
en: The US Federal Reserve, having already stopped its large-scale purchases of long-term assets, is likely to begin hiking interest rates in the third quarter of 2015.

zh: 相反，欧洲央行将追求其自身的量化宽松，在明年一季度引入新措施扩大资产负债表。
en: By contrast, the European Central Bank will pursue its own version of quantitative easing, introducing in the first quarter of the year a set of new measures to expand its balance sheet.

zh: 日本银行将保持货币政策火力全开。
en: The Bank of Japan will maintain its pedal-to-the-metal approach to monetary stimulus.

zh: 当然，分化没有理论边界。
en: Of course, there is no theoretical limit on divergence.

zh: 问题在于汇率变化是如今唯一的协调机制，而某些市场的估值和基本面的分歧极其巨大，价格极有可能陷入波动。
en: The problem is that exchange-rate shifts now represent the only mechanism for reconciliation, and the divide between certain market valuations and their fundamentals has become so large that prices are vulnerable to bouts of volatility.

zh: 对美国来说，走强的经济和不再有利的货币政策的组合将给美元汇率带来更多的对欧元和日元升值压力 — — 目前美元已经有了大幅升值。
en: For the US, the combination of a stronger economy and less accommodative monetary policy will put additional upward pressure on the dollar’s exchange rate – which has already appreciated significantly – against both the euro and the yen.

zh: 很少有其他国家愿意让货币升值，因此美元的升值趋势继续走强走宽，有可能引发国内政治反对。
en: With few other countries willing to allow their currencies to strengthen, the dollar’s tendency toward appreciation will remain strong and broad-based, potentially triggering domestic political opposition.

zh: 此外，随着货币市场日益难以承担有序协调者的角色，各国之间有可能出现摩擦。
en: Moreover, as it becomes increasingly difficult for currency markets to perform the role of orderly reconcilers, friction may arise among countries.

zh: 这可能干扰反常平静、目前令人相当满意的股市。
en: This could disturb the unusual calm that lately has been comforting equity markets.

zh: 幸运的是，有办法确保2015年的分化不会导致经济和金融灾难。
en: Fortunately, there are ways to ensure that 2015’s divergences do not lead to economic and financial disruptions.

zh: 事实上，大部分政府 — — 特别是欧洲、日本和美国 — — 拥有需要的工具平息日益升级的紧张，并在此过程中释放经济的生产潜力。
en: Indeed, most governments – particularly in Europe, Japan, and the US – have the tools they need to defuse the rising tensions and, in the process, unleash their economies’ productive potential.

zh: 避免分化引起灾难不是侦测设计问题；经济学家们已经有了一个相当广泛 — — 尽管还没有形成完全一致 — — 的关于国家、地区和全球层面需要什么措施的共识。
en: Avoiding the disruptive potential of divergence is not a question of policy design; there is already broad, albeit not universal, agreement among economists about the measures that are needed at the national, regional, and global levels.

zh: 这是一个实施问题 — — 正确解决这一问题需要大量的持续政治意愿。
en: Rather, it a question of implementation – and getting that right requires significant and sustained political will.

zh: 决策者解决分化风险的压力将在明年增加。
en: The pressure on policymakers to address the risks of divergence will increase next year.

zh: 不作为的后果的影响将远不止于2015年。
en: The consequences of inaction will extend well beyond 2015.

zh: 合作走向下一个经济范式
en: Working Toward the Next Economic Paradigm

zh: 拉古纳海滩—几十年来，西方世界坚信定义明确、被广泛接受的经济范式，并在国家和全球层面身体力行。
en: LAGUNA BEACH – For decades, the Western world put its faith in a well-defined and broadly accepted economic paradigm with applications at both the national and global levels.

zh: 但如今，人们对“专家”解释 — — 更不用说预测 — — 经济发展的能力的信心每况愈下，在这样背景下，这一信念也受到了影响。
en: But, against a background of declining confidence in the ability of “experts” to explain, let alone predict, economic developments, that faith has deteriorated.

zh: 在新范式尚未浮现的情况下，世界经济分裂风险高企，已然十分脆弱的国家将进一步落后。
en: With a new paradigm having yet to emerge, the world economy faces a heightened risk of fragmentation, with already-vulnerable countries being left even further behind.

zh: 直到最近一直主导着大部分经济思维和决策的范式存在于所谓的“华盛顿共识”中 — — 这是一份被广泛接受的个体国家政策药房 — — 也（在国际层面）应用于推进经济和金融全球化。
en: The paradigm that, until recently, dominated much of economic thinking and policymaking is embodied in the so-called Washington Consensus – a set of ten broadly applicable policy prescriptions for individual countries – and, at the international level, in the pursuit of economic and financial globalization.

zh: 个中概念简言之就是，如果在国内采取市场定价和去监管，同时打造自由贸易和相对开放的跨境资本流，就可以让各国受益。
en: The idea, simply put, was that countries would benefit from embracing market-based pricing and deregulation at home, while fostering free trade and relatively open cross-border capital flows.

zh: 加强各国之间的经济和金融联系被视为实现持续收益、提高效率和生产率、减轻金融动荡威胁的最佳办法。
en: Deepening the economic and financial linkages among countries was viewed as the best way to deliver durable gains, enhance efficiency and productivity, and mitigate the threat of financial instability.

zh: 这一方针还被认为能够产生共同利益，包括加强内部社会流动性、降低国与国之间的暴力冲突风险等。
en: This approach was also deemed to yield collateral benefits, from enhancing internal social mobility to reducing the risk of violent conflict among countries.

zh: 这一方针还有望支持发展中和发达国家间的积极趋同，从而减少绝对和相对贫困、遏制非法跨境移民的经济激励。
en: And it promised to support the positive convergence of developing and developed countries, thereby reducing both absolute and relative poverty and weakening economic incentives for illegal cross-border migration.

zh: 该方针受到了绝大多数大学都会教授的传统经济理论的支持，其兴起可以追溯到柏林墙的倒塌和苏联解体，这两起事件让前共产主义国家以及中国纷纷加入西方主导的世界秩序，提高了总生产和总消费。
en: Supported by the traditional economic theories taught at most universities, this approach was energized after the fall of the Berlin Wall and the disintegration of the Soviet Union, when the former communist countries, together with China, joined the Western-dominated world order, boosting total production and consumption.

zh: 但到了一定时候，对华盛顿共识的信心演变成盲目信仰。
en: But, at a certain point, confidence in the Washington Consensus turned into something like blind faith.

zh: 结果是决策者和经济学家无不踌躇满志，世界经济越来越容易受到小冲击的影响，并在2008年演变为一场危机，世界几乎陷入灾难性的多年经济萧条。
en: The resulting complacency, among policymakers and economists alike, contributed to the world economy becoming more vulnerable to a series of small shocks that, in 2008, culminated in a crisis that pushed the world to the brink of a devastating multi-year economic depression.

zh: 突然之间，全球化的优势被其弊端所压倒。
en: Suddenly, the advantages of globalization paled in comparison to the risks.

zh: 特别是，这次危机源于美国，它正是华盛顿共识和自由放任全球化最主要的鼓吹者，通过其在G7、国际货币基金组织（IMF ） 、 世界银行和世界贸易组织中的地位不遗余力的推动全球化。
en: It didn’t help that the crisis originated in the United States, which had hitherto been the main advocate for the Washington Consensus and unbridled globalization, including through its role in multilateral organizations like the G7, the International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, and the World Trade Organization.

zh: 分析的失败也要承担部分责任。
en: Analytical failures were partly to blame for this.

zh: 经济学研究不够深入，没有对迅速增长和日益不受监管的金融部门与实体经济之间的联系形成全面的理解。
en: The economics profession did not go far enough to develop a comprehensive understanding of the connection between a rapidly growing and increasingly deregulated financial sector and the real economy.

zh: 主要技术创新的影响没有得到很好地认识。
en: The impact of major technological innovations was poorly understood.

zh: 为了微观经济分析的精致性，行为科学的洞见重视不够 — — 甚至完全视而不见，结果它们变得很容易建立模型但缺乏现实性且过度简化。
en: And insights from behavioral science were inadequately regarded – if not shunned altogether – in favor of analytically elegant microeconomic underpinnings that were model-friendly, but unrealistic and overly simplistic.

zh: 与此同时，决策者忽视了不平等性加剧的经济、政治和社会后果 — — 不仅包括收入和财富不平等性，也包括机会不平等性 — — 结果导致中产阶级被逐渐掏空，而技术和非技术的发展放大了这一趋势。
en: Meanwhile, policymakers overlooked the economic, political, and social consequences of rising inequality – not just of income and wealth, but also of opportunity – thereby allowing the middle class gradually to be hollowed out, a trend that was exacerbated by both technological and non-technological developments.

zh: 决策者还低估了金融传染和移民潮的风险。
en: They also underestimated the risks of financial contagion and surges in migration flows.

zh: 结果，行为规范和规则远远落后于现实，政治极化不断加剧。
en: As a result, behavioral norms and rules lagged far behind realities on the ground, and political polarization intensified.

zh: 在国际层面，战后既成秩序日益受到崛起的中国的挑战，其巨大的地理和人口规模使其具备了系统重要性，尽管其人均收入仍相对较低，政治制度也与自由市场经济格格不入。
en: At the international level, the established post-war order was increasingly challenged by a rising China, whose sheer size, in terms of both geography and population, enabled it to achieve systemic importance, despite a relatively low per capita income and a political system that seemed at odds with a liberal market-based economy.

zh: 主要全球经济机构难以足够迅速地适应。
en: The major global economic institutions struggled to adapt quickly enough.

zh: 事实上，尽管进行了一些调整，IMF和世界银行的治理结构仍然更多地体现了过去的现实，特别是欧洲的影响力畸高。
en: In fact, notwithstanding a few tweaks, the governance structure of the IMF and the World Bank remained more reflective of past realities, with Europe, in particular, maintaining disproportionate influence.

zh: 即使是因为G7显得过于狭隘和排他、不足以为经济政策的有效协调提供支持而应运而生的G20，也无法改变局面。
